SITAKULWE ngusomabhizinisi isikole saseMthwalume, kwaQoloqolo, kuward 15 iSibonguJeza Primary School esinamagumbi amancane okufundela.USomabhizinisi wakule ndawo, uMnuz Jacob Gumede wenkampani iLunga Da Bhiva, unikezele ngegumbi elilodwa lokufunda ukuze kuzonezeleleka amagumbi okufunda kulesi sikole.Ekhuluma neSolezwe uGumede uthe njengosomabhizinisi ubone kumqoka kakhulu ukuthi abuyisele emphakathini kube khona akwenzela lesi sikole.Ukhale ngokuthi okumsukimisile ukuthi ukuqaphelile ukuthi lesi sikole sinamgumbi amancane kakhulu okufundela.''Ngibone kungcono ukuthi njengosomabhizinisi wakhona andaweni kube khona engikwenzayo. Bekungeke kube lula ukuthi ngithule ekubeni ngibona ukuthi likhona iqhaza engingaba nalo kulesi simo lesi sikole esibhekene naso,''echaza.Uthe kuhle ukuthi osomabhizinisi babonakale beklama indima ukulekelela imiphakathi abakuyona. Uveze ukuthi basebenzise imali elinganiselwa ku-R180 000 ukuphothula wonke lo msebenzi. ''Angeke size siyikhalelele yonke le mali ngoba yenze into ebelulekile kakhulu. Ayikho into engikholwa ukuthi imqoka ngaphezulu kwemfundo.Yingakho sibone kungcono ukuba sifake isandla,''echaza.Uveze nokuthi emagcekeni alesi sikole bafake nesigwedla samanzi ngenxa yokuthi bayiqonda kahle kamhlophe indaba yenkinga yamanzi ebhekene nalo mphakathi wakule ndawo.''Yonke leya ndawo inenkiga yamanzi yingakho sibone kufanele ukuba sibalekelele nangamanzi,''usho kanjena.Uveze ukuthi lesi sikole sesizoba nabafundi abangu-84 ngemuva kokuba kunezelwe leli gumbi. Ekuqaleni uthe bebengu-54. Uthe ufisa ukusibona lesi sikole sikhula nangokwesibalo.Amalungu omphakathi akule ndawo akushayele elikhulu ihlombe leli lokhu okwenziwe yilo somabhizinisi.UGumede uveze ukuthi leli gumbi kulithathe izinyanga ezine ngaphambi kokuba liphothulwe ngokugcwele.Ubonge umakhi walo owaziwayo endaweni, uMnuz Skhona Madlala athe uvolontiyile walakha mahhala ethi yindlela naye abuyisela ngayo emphakathini.NgoJanuwari lo somabhizinisi uke wazibambela mathupha elungisa umgwaqo ngenxa yokuthi ubungekho sesimweni esifanele.Uthishanhloko wesikole, uNksz Hlongwa ubonge kakhulu kuGumede ngeqhaza lakhe kulesi sikole. Uthe kuyajabulisa ukubona abantu basemphakathini bebuyisela kuwona.
UYINYATHELE emsileni uSihlalo weKhomishini eVikela iMiphakathi, ezeNkolo neziLimi, uNkk Thoko Mkhwanazi-Xaluva ngokuveza ukuthi ukholelwa emadlozini osekuvukuze ulaka olusha ngaye kubantu abangamaKrestu osekunesikhathi bekhala ngokuthi uyabanyundela. UNkk Mkhwanazi-Xaluva, njengoSihlalo we-CRL Rights Commission, uzithola ekulesi simo nje yingoba waphakamisa ukuthi amasonto awalawulwe ngokuthi abhaliswe futhi kukhishwe amalayisensi abefundisi azolawulwa wumthetho eNingizimu Afrika.Isikhalo sakhe esikhulu esokuthi maningi amabandla anemikhuba ecindezela nethunaza abantu. Ubefuna ukuba uMkhandlu wakhe unikwe amandla okuphenya la masonto athe chithi saka ukuthi awanyatheli yini amalungelo abantu abangamakholwa. Lesi siphakamiso senyusa imimoya emakholweni amaningi ekhuza ibhadi ngokuthi uhulumeni ufuna ukushayela abezenkolo imithetho ngendlela abakhonza ngayo, okuyinto uMthethosisekelo ongayivumi.Ekhuluma neSolezwe Ngempelasonto ngalokhu, uSolwazi Musa Xulu phambilini obekade eyingxenye yomsebenzi wale Khomishini, uthe uNkk Mkhwanazi-Xaluva akenzanga kahle ngokugqashiya ngokuthi uyisangoma ekubeni azi ukuthi uphethe isikhundla esimqoka kanjena.UXulu ukhuluma kanjena nje kune-video eveza uXaluva ekhuluma emi phambi kwezangoma esho ukuthi yena uyakholelwa kwelakhe idlozi. ''Asazi mhlawumbe phela awabo amadlozi awabasebenzeli,'' uzwakala ebhinqa kanje engacacisi ukuthi ubhekise kubani.UXulu lokhu uthi kubi ngoba kuzodala inzondo phakathi kukaMkhwanazi-Xaluva namaKrestu. ''Ngingasho kugcwale umlomo nje ukuthi ube budedengu kakhulu ngokukhuluma ngaleya ndlela. Okubi kakhulu ngaye wukuthi umane akhulume nje noma yikanjani ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, kumele akuyeke lokho ngoba kuzomfaka enkingeni,'' kuxwayisa uXulu.Eqhuba uthe lusazoqhubeka udungunyane phakathi kukaMkhwanazi-Xaluva namaKrestu uma eqhubeka eziphatha ngale ndlela.UXulu ukhale ngokuthi enye inkinga enkulu wukuthi uMkhwanazi-Xaluva akayiqondi kahle inkolo yobuKrestu, wathi ngenye yezinto ezidala ukuthi enze noma kanjani.''Iqiniso ukuthi indaba yamadlozi nayo ingenye inkolo ngokwayo. Uma-ke uzothatha umuntu onjalo uthi wena makabheke amaKrestu vele izoba khona nakanjani inkinga okuyiyo kanye le esizithola sibhekene nayo manje,'' usho kanjena.Eqhuba uXulu uthe kwakhona ukuthi ufuna ukulawula ukusebenza kwabefundisi namabandla kuwuphawu olusobala lokuthi udidekile futhi akaqondi kahle ukuthi iyini inkolo yobuKrestu.''Inkolo yobuKreistu izilawula yona kusukela endulo kodwa uMkhwanazi-Xaluva wathi uzoyilawula ngenxa yokudideka nokungaqondi kahle ukuthi yini le akuyona," kusho uXulu.Uqhuba athi ngokomthetho ka-2002 uMkhwanazi-Xaluva kumele abeseke abezilimi, amasiko nabamabandla, bese ebachushisa uma kukhona lapho okubonakala bentula khona umhlahlandlela."Kulo mthetho ke akukho nokukodwa lapho kuthiwa makalawule amakholwa, kodwa-ke nangu uyakweza. Ngeke kwenziwe lutho-ke ngoba nalabo abambekile bathule ekubeni enza into engekho kulo mthetho."Inhlangano iSouth African Church Defenders izwakalise ukungenami okukhulu ngale nkulumo kaMkhwanazi-Xaluva. Ithe yingakho nje ecindezela kangaka amaKrestu yingoba vele ukholelwa emadlozini, umelene namaKrestu.Le nhlangano ezinyangeni ezedlule ike yahlela imashi eThekwini lapho ibikhala khona ngoMkhwanazi-Xaluva imsola ngendlela acindezela ngayo amakholwa.USihlalo wale nhlangano, uMfu Mpfariseni Mukhuba, enkulumeni yakhe wathi abakunqeni ukubhekana ngeziqu zamehlo noMkhwanazi-Xaluva bese kuyacaca ukuthi iyiphi eyogoba uphondo.Walimisa ngesihloko elokuthi uNkk Mkhwanazi-Xaluva umelene nebandla likaNkulunkulu futhi unomcabango wokuthi angenza noma yini kulona.UMkhwanazi-Xaluva emasontweni adlule uye KwaMaphumulo, endaweni ebizwa ngokuthi Ikhaya Labafundi eyotshela umsunguli wale ndawo, uMfundisi Vusumuzi Sibiya, ukuthi akayeke leli bandla. Kule ndawo kuhlangene abantu abathi sebezinikele ekusebenzeleni umbuso weZulu, bahlukene nakho konke okomhlaba.UMkhwanazi-Xaluva wasongela uMfundisi, ethi uma kuke kwafa umuntu kuleya ndawo uyobuya engasadle nkobe zamuntu. Abanye balaba bazalwane bakhetha nokuyeka imishanguzo yodokotela ngoba bethi elabo ithemba liseNkosini.
UMAKADEBONA kwezobuciko futhi oyisazi samasiko, uSolwazi Velaphi "VVO” Mkhize, usedalule ukuthi bekuhlale kuyisilonda kuyena ukubona kushabalala igama lezingqalabutho zobuciko, ezabamba iqhaza kuleli zwe ngezikhathi zobandlululo.UMkhize usho kanje exoxa neSolezwe ngencwadi eyiqoqo lezinkondlo zesiZulu ayihlelile esihloko sithi UMSAMO: Imfihlo Yempophoma: Kuthangi - Izolo - Nanamuhla, edidiyele izinkondlo eziwu-28 zowayeyisishoshovu sobuciko nembongi uBethuel Blose Ndelu, owayaziwa ngelikaNonkamfela - ongasekho emhlabeni."Kumqoka ukuthi thina esisaphilayo kube wumsebenzi wethu ukuthi sizihluphe ngokuvumbulula imisebenzi emidala yobuciko bamaciko akithi angasekho emhlabeni, aze ashona ingayibonanga ilanga - bese siyididiyela futhi siyenze kabusha ukuze ibe wumthombo wolwazi ozohlale ukhona futhi ube wusizo esizukulwaneni esizayo,” usho kanje.Eqhuba, uthe kade afisa ukuhlanganisa imisebenzi yobuciko kaNonkamfela, kodwa kwangashesha ukwenzeka ngenxa yokuthi bekukuningi kakhulu obekumxinile okubalwa nemisebenzi yasemsakazweni Ukhozi FM neqondene naye yesintu."Ngize nngaqala ukusebenzela kulo msebenzi ngoba yena uNonkamfela esefika amagemugemu kimina ngephupho, engikhumbuza ukwenza lo msebenzi - njengoba kuvele kuyinto esasiyikhulumile savumelana ukuthi ngisale ngimqedelela yona uma eshona engakayiqedi. Imisebenzi yakhe yobuciko eminingi ayenza ngezikhathi zobandlululo."Kungithathe cishe iminyaka emithathu ukuqoqa cishe lonke ulwazi ngebengizokudinga ukudidiyela incwadi njengoba isizophuma iyilokhu esiyikhona manje. Bekudingeka ukuthi sivumbulule enqwabeni yemiqulu yolwazi enemisebenzi yakhe,” kusho uMkhize.Uthe uhlanganise le ncwadi ngosizo lwabahluzi oSolwazi Gugu Mazibuko we-University of Johannesburg, Nksz Fortunate Ngconco woMnyango wezemiDlalo, ubuCiko namaSiko KwaZulu-Natal noMnuz Senzo Mkhize - omsize ukuvumbulula ezinye izinkondlo."Lo msebenzi udidiyele izinkondlo ezihluba udlubu ekhasini ngobunzima umuntu omnyama adlule kubona ngenkathi kusabusa uhulumeni wengcindezelo, bese kuba khona nalezo eziqhakambisa ubuhle bemvelo namandla ayo ukulungisa izimo ezithile ezweni,” kusho yena.Le ncwadi izobiza u-R250 iyinye, kanti izoqala ukutholakala emcimbini wokuyethula ozoba se-UKZN ophikweni iHoward College, eThekwini, ngoLwesithathu kusuka ngo-3 ntambama kuya ku-7 kusihlwa.
IMOTO: JMC VIGUS DOUBLE CABAKULULA ukuhlabeka umxhwele ngento uqala ukuyibona. Kimina lesi simo sokuncoma senzeke ngiseLanseria International Airport, eGauteng, ngibona okokuqala ngqa iveni i-JMC Vigus double cab. Inenjini engu-2.5l kadizili enamandla angu-123kW ne-torque engu-430Nm. U-gearbox uhlukene kabili njengoba kukhona oyi-6 speed manual noyi-8 speed automatic.Kushayeleke isipikili sokuthi ayizweli futhi yakhelwe ubunzima ngenkathi sinyuka sehla ngayo imiqansa, siyifaka odakeni, siyibhukudisa emaxhaphozini aseSyringa Park, eMuldelsdrift. Yize ifikela emhlabeni owenile ngokwezimbangi - okuyiToyota Hilux engaconsi phansi kosomatekisi neFord Ranger eyintandokazi kwabamathenda, Isuzu D-Max neMahindra Pik UP, iJMC Vigus ibukeka ingase iphendule amatafula ngenxa yentengo yayo engambi eqolo. Kulabo abahlala ezindaweni zamakhosi njengakoLoskop, Lotheni, eMpendle, Nkandla naseMashobeni, nabalayishela abantu izimpahla besuka ezitolo, basengaphephela kuyo, iqhubeke impilo. Ingigeze inhliziyo ngakhumbula ukuthi empeleni iChina kade yahamba phambili kwezobuchwepheshe uma ubheka ukuthi emakhaya izinto esizisebenzisayo, phecelezi amagajethi, amaningi akhiwa khona.Ngisho uTerence Tracy we-Afro Offroad 4x4 Driver Training uvumelane nami ezishaya isifuba, ethi iJMC edayisa izimoto ezilinganiselwa kuhhafu wesigidi ngonyaka emhlabeni jikelele, ishaye into ecokeme nge-Vigus double cab.Iphawula i-Head of Product kwaJMC nakwaGAC Motor, uKarabo Ndaba, izwakale ilibuka ngeso elihle ikusasa le-JMC Vigus double cab 4x4, yathi abantu baseMzansi abaphume ngobuningi bayoyithenga ngoba bayobe bengashayanga eceleni. I-JMC iveze ukuthi ngo-7.1l kadizili uyakwazi ukuhamba ufinyelele ku-100km kanti uma uzohamba ngayo etiyeleni kufanele ibe ku-2H, obhuqwini uyibeke ku-4H. Koxakile onezithiyo eziningi uyibeka ku-4L, ungayixini ngoba bungachitheka bugayiwe.Leli veni lethulwa nje, bekungakapholi amaseko iJMC - izimoto zayo ezilethwa yiSalvador Caetano South Africa - yethule iveni layo lokuqala eNingizimu Afrika, iVigus, intengo yayo ebiqala ku-R299 900 i-single cab.Amasondo ayo okwazi ukunqamula ngawo kuyo yonke indawo angu-17 inch. Ine-hill descent control engadinge ukuthi ubambe ibhreki uma usendaweni eyehlelayo njengoba izenzela yona umsebenzi. Inama-airbag amane kwewumshini ozishintshayo kanti kweshintshwayo mabili. Inama-LED daytime running lights nezitebhisi zokugibela.Leli veni isakhiwo salo elifuze olweFord yango-1970, bathi likwazi ukuthwala isisindo esingu-915kg. Ukuze uhlale uphephile linensiza ekwazisayo uma umoya wehlile emasondweni.Lishiye umhlaba ngo-225mm, ubude lingu-5 335mm kanti ububanzi ingu-1 882mm.Ngaphakathi ine-touchscreen infotainment system engu-12.8 inch oxhuma kuyo iselula nge-Apple CarPlay/Android Auto kanti i-instrument cluster ezimele yodwana ingu-9.0 inch.Izihlalo zangaphambili eziyisikhumba zihlelwa ngogesi, akudingi ulokhu usidonsa. Inekhamera ecacisa bha uma uhlehla kanti iyakutshela uma ususondele eduze kwento ezoyihuzula noma isisondele odongeni. Ngisho uya phambili iyakubikela ukuthi uqaphele ingozi. Lidunyiswa ngesikhiye kanti ine-hand brake edinga ukuthi uyitoboze maqede uyenyuse ngesandla.Le 4x4 ye-JMC ishaya nge-grille nengemuva elinamagama akuheha ukude le, nengikholwa ukuthi azokwenza amakhasimende ayiqaphele futhi akhulume ngayo ngisho isiyosithela.Ngakolunye uhlangothi, iJMC 2.5TD 4x2 double cab auto engiyibambe ngilibhekise eCradle of Humankind World Heritage Site, ingikhumbuze i-Ford Territory ngendlela eshushuluza ngayo emgwaqweni. Ngisho neJMC Vigus eshintshwayo ebengihlezi ngemuva kuyo sibheke e-OR Tambo International Airport, ibishibilika engena kamnandi amagiya ayo. UKUQOKWA kukaLiet General Puleng Dimpane njengebamba esikhundleni sokuba uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa kuZwelonke sekuqubule impikiswano ngokuthi ngabe ukufanele ngokuphelele yini ukumelana nokudingeka kulo msebenzi.ULiet General Dimpane umenyezelwe uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ngoLwesine, ukuthi usezobamba kulo msebenzi, ngenxa yokumiswa kobekuwona uLiet General Fannie Masemola. UMasemola ubuyiselwe eceleni ngenxa yokuthi ubhekene necala lokwephula umthetho i-Public Finance Management Act of 1999.UMasemola umiswe kusukela ekutheni evele eNkantolo yeMantshi ePitoli ngoLwesibili emva kokuthi ethunyelelwe amaphepha ngenyanga edlule, eyalelwa ukuthi avele enkantolo mayelana nezinsolo abhekene nazo zokwephula umthetho.Ubhekene namacala amane okwephula umthetho mayelana nethenda ka-R360 million yezinsiza kusebenza zezempilo zoPhiko lwamaPhoyisa iSouth African Police Service, okuvela ukuthi yatholwa usomabhizinisi osolwa ngezenzo zobugebengu uMnuz Vusimuzi "Cat” Matlala.Ngaphambi kwalokhu, uLiet General Dimpane wayekade eyiSikhulu esiPhezulu sezeziMali khona oPhikweni lwamaPhoyisa, kanti uke wafakaza kabili, lapho aveza khona ukuthi akakaze abe neqhaza endleleni okwenganyelwa ngayo leyo thenda.Ngenkathi uMcwaningi Mabhuku Jikelele eveza ukuthi iwu-R650 million imali eyasebenza ngendlela engafanele embuthweni wamaphoyisa onyakeni wemali ka-2024/25, lokho kubandakanya no-R360 million wethenda okwahlomula uMatlala kuyona.Okhulumela i-MK Party, uMnuz Nhlamulo Ndhlela, ugxeke isinqumo sikaRamaphosa ngalokhu, asichaze ngokuthi asiyixazululi nhlobo inkinga yobugebengu nenkohlakalo embuthweni wamaphoyisa.UNdhlela ukhale ngokuthi uDimpane akanawo amava adingekayo nafanele omkhakha wobuphoyisa, njengoba imisebenzi eminingi aseyenzile phambilini, kubalwa nabewenza manje - ibigxile kakhulu ekucwaningeni amabhuku nezomnotho.Ilungu lePhalamende le-Action SA, uNksz Dereleen James, lidalule ukuthi kubaxakile ukuthi uDimpane unikwe kanjani lo msebenzi ekubeni kwaziwa ukuthi izinto eziningi zonakale kunguyena obebhekele ukusebenza kwemali yophiko lwamaphoyisa."Ukuqokwa kwakhe kusishiya nemibuzo eminingi yokuthi ngabe akunagcobho yini, futhi kwenza sibe magange ukubheka ukuthi akukho chashaza yini elingase linamekeke egameni lakhe,” kusho uNksz James.UMnuz Ian Cameron weDemocratic Alliance (DA) uthe nakuba bebefisa ukuthi kube khona okwenzekayo ngoMasemola, kodwa abanaso isiqiniseko sokuthi uDimpane uzokwazi yini ukumelana nalo msebenzi ikakhulu ngoba akanawo amava awo.ULiet General Dimpane unamava eminyaka eya ku-20 omsebenzi, kanti uqale ukwenza umsebenzi wokuba yiSikhulu soPhiko lwezeziMali kwezamaPhoyisa ngo-2018. Ngaphambi kwalokho uke waba yiPhini likaKhomishana wamaPhoyisa eFree State, waba yiNhloko yoPhiko lwezeziMali lwe-SAPS, futhi wabamba isikhashana ekubeni wuMholi woPhiko lokuCwaninga amaBhuku emaPhoyiseni. Ngokwemfundo uneziqu ze-BCom in Business Administration.Khonamanjalo, uMshushisi woMbuso u-Adv Santhos Manilall watshela iNkantolo ukuthi uMasemola kumele avele enkantolo naye uMatlala nabanye abathintekayo kulo mkhonyovu wethenda. Icala likaMasemola lizobuyela eNkantolo yeMantshi ePitoli ngoMeyi 13.

Sibaqoke eminxeni ehlukene okubalwa owezobuchwepheshe besimanje, ezokwakha, imboni yemfashini, ezempilo nezobuhle okubamba iqhaza elimqoka ukufukula umnotho wesifundazwe sethu,” kusho uNksz Ngobese.Eqhuba, udalule ukuthi kulokhu baqikelelile ukuthi kuqhakambiseke kakhulu osomabhizinisi besifazane njengoba bewu-66% abangenelile, okusho ukuthi nembokodo izoba neqhaza elinqala nelibonakalayo ekukhuliseni umnotho nokuthuthukisa umphakathi."Konke lokhu esikwenzayo kokuveza amabhizinisi asemalokishini nasezindaweni zasemakhaya kuzosiza kakhulu ukuthuthukisa osomabhizinisi, kube kulekelela ngokuthi kwakhe amathuba okwandisa abatshalimali ukuze bafukuleke,” usho kanje.Uthe nakulo nyaka iwu-20 iminxa ehlukene yamabhizinisi okuzoklonyeliswa osomabhizinisi abanqobile kuyona, bese kuthi abazonqoba kuyona bahlukaniselane umklomelo ka-R1 million wokuxhasa amabhizinisi abo."Izinga losomabhizinisi esibathole kulo nyaka lisinike ithemba lokuthi emva kokuhlomula kwabo kulolu hlelo bazokwazi ukubamba iqhaza elimqoka emphakathini futhi sizibophezele ukuqhubeka nalo mbono esiwenzayo,” kuthembisa uNksz Ngobese.

Umsunguli ophinde abe ngumholi waleli bandla, uMbhishobhi Goodenough Makhanya, uyena obeqhuba umsebenzi wokubagcoba ngokumsethethweni elekelelwa wumkakhe, uMbhishobhikazi Zodwa Makhanya.Entshumayelweni yakhe uMbhishobhi Makhanya abeyibhekise kwabebegcotshwa ubatshele ukuthi kukho konke abakwenzayo abaqinisekise ukuthi banyathela ngokucophelela.Ubatshele ukuthi uhlobo lomsebenzi abangena kuwo ludinga ukuthi babe ngabantu abakwaziyo ukubekezela futhi abakuqondayo ukuthi ziyafika izimo kodwa kuya ngokuthi umelana kanjani nazo.''Okumqoka wukuthi kumele nazi ukuthi nilapha ngoba nilandwe wuNkulunkulu uqobo okunguyena odale izulu nomhlaba. Kungaba yinto embi-ke ukuthi ngelinye ilanga kukhulunywe indaba yokuthi niphumile ebandleni ngenxa yabantu ekubeni kungeyibo abaniholele lapha,'' usho kanjena.Ubadonse ngendlebe wathi noma ngabe kufika ziphi izinselo bangabi ntekenteke baze bacabange ukuliphosa ithawula.''Kumele nazi ukuthi nisendaweni ezodala ukuthi kwesinye isikhathi nibuye nizibuze niziphendule ukuthi kanti kwenzekani. Noma kungaba njani kodwa nina okwenu ukuma ngoba uNkulunkulu nunibekile kule ndawo ngoba enithembile futhi kakhulu,'' usho kanjena.Abebegcotshwa bathembise ukuthi konke bazokwenza ngendlela efanele baphinde baqinisekisa nokuthi bazonyathela ngokucophelela.Le ndumezulu yenkonzo ibihanjelwe ngamgatsha ahlukene aKwaZulu Natal.
UMENGAMELI webandla ama-Afrika, ubonge wanconcoza kumalungu aleli bandla ngokuzikhandla enze konke okusemandleni ngenhloso yokuqinisekisa ukuthi ibandla liba nezakhiwo ezisezingeni elihle. UMfu Nkosinathi Hlomuka onguMengameli waleli bandla uncome amakholwa enkonzweni yakamuva ebiseMtshezi.Uveze ukuthi minyaka yonke baye benze isiqiniseko sokuthi sikhona isakhiwo esiqedwayo ngoba bafuna ukuthi leli bandla libe nezindawo zokukhonzela kuyona yonke indawo.Uthe naye uqhubeka emsebenzini omuhle owaqalwa abanye omengameli bangaphambili abake balihola ibandla.''Uma uzothula ubheke kahle uzobona ukuthi mkhulu kangakanani umsebenzi nabanye omengameli abangaphambi kwami abawenzile uma kukhulunywa ngodaba lokwakhiwa kwezakhiwo zebandla,'' usho kanje.Eqhuba uthe zikhona nezinye izakhiwo abasematasa nazo ngoba "alikho iSekethe okumele kukhulunywe indaba yokuthi liswele indawo yokukhonzela kumbe likhonzela ezikoleni".Echaza, uthe yonke le misebenzi yinto esuka kudala kumsunguli webandla lama-Afrika, ongasekho uMfu Gadner Mvuyane owayeyala amalungu ewatshela ukuthi awazenzele izinto.''Okujabulisayo wukuthi konke asitshela khona kubonakala kusahamba kahle kuze kube yimanje," usho kanje.
UKUNYUKA kwezigameko zabafundi basemanyuvesi okuthiwa baphila nokuhlukumezeka sekusukumise inhlangano iSouth African Union of Student kanye nezinye izinhlaka ukuze kube khona okwenziwayo ngalokhu.NgoLwesihlanu eBlue Water, eThekwini le nhlangano ngokubambisana nabeWear Your Brand bathule ngokusemthethweni ingqungquthela ezokuba ngoJuni okuzobe kuhloswe ngayo ukuqwashisa abafundi abaphila nokuhlukumezeka kodwa buthule.Kuvelile lapha ukuthi laba bafundi ukuhlukumezeka bakuthola,ezindawerni ezahlukene okungaba yisemakhaya ebudlelwaneni nakwezinye izindawo.USihlalo wale nhlangano, uMnuz Quinton Oliphant uveze ukuthi le ngqungquthela ibandakanya izikhungo zintathu eziphakeme yiMangosuthu University of Technology (MUT), University of KwaZulu Natal (UKZN) kanye neDurban University of Technology (DUT).Uthe abakabi nalo usuku oluqondile lwayo, kodwa izokube isingethwe ngesinye salezi zikhungo ezingenhla.Uthe ngokwacwaningo abalwenzile batholile ukuthi baningi kakhulu abafundi abasezikhungweni zemfundo ephekeme abahlukumzekayo ngezindlela ezahlukene. Uthe yingakho le ngqunguthela beyethe elokuthi yiGBVF Summit.''Akumele sithule kodwa njalo uma kukhona isimo esingesihle kuhle ukuthi sisukume,''echaza.Uveze ukuthi kuzophinde kube khona umjaho ozobe useThekwinin nawo okuzobe kuhloswe ngawo ukuthi kuxwayiswe ngalesi sihlava. Uveze ukuthi kungekudala kuzobe sekuvulelekile ukungenela kwabafuna ukuba yingxenye yabazogijima.UNksz Nomasina Zulu onguMengameli wenhlangano iWear Your Brand uthe kubajabulisile kakhulu ukuba yingxenye yokuhlelwa kwalolu hlobo lwengqungquthela.Uthe nabo kungabajabulisa ukuthi kube khona indima abayiklamayo ekutheni kube khona okwenziwayo mayelana nengwadla yabafundi abasezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme okuthiwa baphila nokuhlukumezeka.''Iqiniso ukuthi lento ayidingi abantu abathile kuphela kodwa kunalokho udinga ukuthi wonke umuntu abe yingxenye yayo. Nathi sizibophezele ekutheni kube khona esikwenzayo ngalokhu,'' usho kanje.
OYISIKHULU samaphoyisa esisamisiwe Ekurhuleni, uMnuz Julius Mkhwanazi, noyimenenja yedolobha lakhona Ekurhuleni, uMnuz Kagiso Michael Lerutla, bazofaka isicelo sebheyili ngoLwesibili ekuseni enkantolo yeMantshi yaseBoksburg.Bakhalelwe ngamasongo kaSigonyela ngempelasonto edlule ngamacala enkohlakalo nokuphazamisa ukusebenza kwengalo yomthetho. BASADIDEKILE ngokubulawa komfundi oyedwa nokugwazwa kwababili baseMenzi okwenzeke ngoLwesine ntambama eMlaza.Kuvela ukuthi kusuke uthuli lwezichwe phakathi kwabafundi nabathile bangaphandle kwesikole ngesikhathi bexabana ngesizathu esingakaqinisekiswa ngokuphelele.Kuvela ukuthi umnyombo wengxabano ususwe wukuthi kube nelungu lomphakathi elibize abafundi libasola ngokuthi badayisa (amaswidi) ngaphakathi esikoleni.Kuthiwa ilungu lomphakathi libathethisile abafundi labasabisa ngokuthi kufanele bayeke ukudayisa ngaphakathi emagcekeni esikole okanye bakhokhe kulona intela yokudayisa.Kuvela ukuthi leli lungu lomphakathi lidinwe lathelwa ngamanzi labe selibagwaza liphindelela abafundi, kwalimala kabi ababili kwashona oyedwa.Umthombo waleli phephandaba izolo uveze ukuthi kukhulu ukudideka ngalesi sehlakalo njengoba kungaqondakali ukuthi kahle hle kwenzekeni.''Eqinisweni lesi sigameko senzeke ngaphandle kwamagceke esikole. Sithole ukuthi kuqhamuke umuntu wangaphandle wabalwisa abafundi wagcina ngokuthi abalimaze,'' kusho umthombo.Umthombo uveze ukuthi ababili abafundi baphuthunyiswe esibhedlela.kodwa oyedwa usephumile omunye akakaphumi.Uveze ukuthi kuvulwe icala ngalolu daba wathi sebethembe uphenyo lwamaphoyisa ukuze bathole ukuthi kwenzekeni ngampela.Izolo uPhiko lwe-ANCYL luhambele eMenzi ngemuva kokuba luzwe ngalesi siga sangoLwesine. OnguNobhala walolu phiko, uNksz Nokulunga Khuzwayo, usigxekile kakhulu lesi sehlakalo.''Silimele kakhulu ngokudlula komfundi emhlabeni ngale endlela. Sifisa ukuthi umthetho usebenze.. Eqhuba uthe bezwe ukuthi umfundi ubeziphilisa ngakho ukudayisa. Uchaze lesi senzo njengesikhombisa ubulwane obukhulu.Lesi sikole sike saba sematheni futhi eminyakeni eyedlule ngesikahthi amaDelangokubona ephazamisa ukwakhiwa kwaso ngoba efuna ukuba yingxenye yakho.Ukwakhiwa kwaso kugcine kuqedeliwe ngemuva kokuba uMphathiswa wezeMisebenzi yoMphakathi kanye neNgqalasizinda KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Martin Meyer, engenelelile.IMenzi ibalwa nezinye izikole ezikhiqiza imiphumela emihle ka-matric unyaka nonyaka. Ukusebenza ngokuzimisela kothisha bakhona kuyinto ehlale ibatshazwa yizwe lonke. Nangonyaka odlule siphinde senza okufanayo.
UMNYANGO wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal usudalule izinto ocabanga ukuthi ziyimbangela yezibalo ezishaqisayo zokukhulelwa kwezingane nentsha ezirekhodiwe ngonyakamali u-2025/26.Imininingwane ikhombisa ukuthi zingu-421 izingane ezineminyaka engu-10 kuya ku-14 ezikhulelwe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, bangu-28 108 abakhulelwe ababikiwe entsheni eneminyaka engu-15 kuya ku-19. Phambilini abeChildline KZN bacashunwa kwi-IOL bezwakalisa ukukhathazeka ngokuthi izibalo zikhomba izinkinga zokuhlukunyezwa, ukuxhashazwa, ubumpofu, amagebe emfundo, ukuntuleka kokwesekwa kwentsha, ukungalingani, indawo engaphephile, kanye nokufa kwemindeni.Kuthiwa into ehamba phambili eholela intsha Ophathe wukufuna ukuzizwela umuzwa wokuya ocansini. Lokhu kubhebhethekiswa okomlilo wequbula yizinkundla zokuxhumana nezinhlelo zethelevishini.Ongoti bavumelana ngokuthi abazali babudedengu ekuqapheleni ukuthi izingane zabo yini eziyibukayo kwithelevishini nakumaselula. Bathi ngaleyo ndlela, izingane zingcina sezibuka izinto ezingakakulungeli ukuthi zizibone ngenxa yeminyaka. Kuthiwa izingane zigcina zibuka izinto ezingaziqondi bese zifuna ukuzizwela ngokwazo ukuthi lezo zinto zinjani uma zenziwa. Kwenye inkathi kuyenzeka kwithelevishini kungene into engazilungele izingane zibe zibuka zihleli nabazali. Lapha kuvela ukuthi abanye abazali baye bangakwazi ukulawula isimo ngendlela efanele. Leli phuzu ligqamisa abazali abangakwazi ukukhuluma nezingane zabo ngezinto okungafanele zingene kuzo. Kuhlaluka ukuthi yisifo sakhona esesithathwa njengamahlalakhona kwabansundu ukungakhulumi nezingane ngezinto ezijulile okubalwa kuzo nokuya ocansini. Akuqondakali ukuthi yini efaka abazali amanzi emadolweni ngoba ukwesaba kwabo kungenisa amanzi endlini.Enye into ebekwa eqhulwini njengesihlava sokukhulelwa kwentsha yingcindezi yontanga. Kuthiwa intsha engontanga kulula ukuthi ifakelane ingcindezi ngokwenza izinto eziphambene nokulunga.Izingxoxo zezingane ezingaba bukhoma noma ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, zingenza oyingxenye yazo agcine esengena ezintweni angaziqondi ngokuphelele njengokuya ocansini agcine esekhulelwa noma esekhulelisa. Enye ingozi yengcindezi yontanga yizidakamizwa. Ochwepheshe kwezokukhuliswa kwezingane basanwaya amakhanda bexakwa wukuthi kungani izingane njalo zikhetha ukungena kwi-internet uma zifuna ulwazi ngezinto ezithinta ucansi. Okuxaka kakhulu ongoti wukuthi nolwazi olungaziphephisa lusuke lukhona kepha intsha ikhetha ukugxila noma ukusebenzisa olungabalungele abantu abasebancane ngokweminyaka.Ephuzwini lendlala, kuqhakanjiswa ukuthi izingane zamantombazane zigcina ziya ocansini ngoba zifuna ukuhlomula ngezinto ezinhle ezisuke zizidinga. Lapha kubalwa amaselula nemali.Lapha kugcina sekunechilo lokuthi abanye abazali bagcina sebamukela lawo manyala bathembele ekondliweni yizingane ezilala no-sugar daddy njengoba zithola imali zize zibhekelele nezidingo zemindeni.Enye inkimbinkimbi wuphuzo oludakayo, oluholela ekutheni intsha izibandakanye nocansi olungaphephile futhi ingahlelile. Lapha umphumela kuba wukuthola izifo kanye nokukhulelwa."Uvala" kuthiwa wudlame lwezobulili kokunye oluthinta imindeni kanye nokuthwalwa kwezingane okuthiwa wumkhuba odlange ezindaweni eziqhelelene namadolobha amakhulu.
UMNYANGO wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, usezinhlelweni zokwandisa isibalo sothisha ezikoleni.UMphathiswa womnyango uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka, uthe kuseyisiqalo okwenzekile kuqashwa othisha bakwaGrade R muva nje."Bangu-500 othisha bakwaGrade R abaqale kule nyanga. Sizimisele ukuqhubeka sandise isibalo sothisha esifundazweni," kusho uHlomuka izolo ekhuluma esiShayamthetho eMgungundlovu. UHlomuka usho lokhu nje othisha abangaqashiwe bahlale bekhala ngokushaywa indiva ngumnyango. Baqhinqa emahhovisi omnyango eMgungundlovu befuna ukuqashwa. Sekuphenduke insakavukela ukuthi bayomasha bekhala ngokungaqashwa. Muva nje umnyango umemezele ukuthi uzoqasha othishanhloko, amaphini othishanhloko kanjalo nezinhloko zezifundo ezikoleni. Zevile ku-3 000 izikhala ezikhangisiwe. UHlomuka uthe bafuna ukuqinisa ukufundiswa kwezibalo ezikoleni. Ubalule nokuthi baqinisa nokufundiswa kwesiNgisi, ukuze abafundi bakuqonde abakufundayo. "Siqinisa ukufundiswa kweMaths ukuze kuphuculwe ikhono labafundi kulesi sifundo. Ukwenza kahle kwabafundi kwa-matric, kuncike esisekelweni okumele sisiqinise," kusho uHlomuka. Uthe bafuna ukuphucula nemiphumela ka-matric ukuze isifundazwe silokhu siqhubeka nokwenza kahle. UHlomuka uthe bafuqa nezifundo zobuchwepheshe okubalwa i-Coding and Robotics."Ngalezi zifundo silungiselela abafundi kwezithinta ubuchwepheshe. Kunesidingo sokuthi izifundo ezifundwayo zihambisane nokudingwa wumnotho."UHlomuka uthe bayabalalela othisha, abafundi kanjalo nabazali bese bakha uhlelo oluzobhekana nabakudingayo."Siyabhekana nohlelo lokuthuthukisa othisha kanjalo nengqalasizinda ezikoleni. Imali eyabelwe umnyango kumele ithuthukise abafundi kanjalo nezikole." Usho lokhu nje kuhlale kukhalwa ngokuhluleka komnyango ukulungisa ingqalasizinda ezikoleni ngenxa yezinkinga zemali.Le nkinga yenza umnyango ungakwazi ukukhokhela ngesikhathi osonkontileka osebenza nabo. Umnyango uhluleke ukuthenga izincwadi zokufunda ezikoleni nyakenye. Ukwazi ukuthenga i-stationery.Namhlanje iSadtu izoba senkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu lapho ifuna kuphoqwe umnyango ukuthi uthenge izincwadi nezinye izinsiza. Okunye ifuna umnyango ufake imali yezikole eyaziwa ngama-Norms and Standards.Minyaka yonke izinyunyana zihlale zilwa nomnyango ngendaba yemali yezikole engafakwa ngesikhathi. Le mali isetshenziselwa ukulungisa izinto ezincane ezonakele ezikoleni okubalwa nokukhokhela ugesi namanzi.
ITHIMBA elijutshwe yiSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini lithi ziyathembisa izingxoxo zalo namaqembu ameleleke ePhalamende mayelana nodaba lokuchibiyela umthetho olawula isikhwama esigade umhlaba kaZulu, iNgonyama Trust.Ithimba libe nemihlangano namaqembu ezepolitiki ameleleke ePhalamende ayisishiyagalombili kulezi zinsuku ezimbili ezedlule.Obekuxoxwa emhlanganweni yisiphakamiso seSilo sokuba kuchitshiyelwe umthetho olawula iNgonyama Trust.IMbube ifuna umthetho ugunyaze ukuthi kube iyona eqoka amalungu ebhodi leNgonyama Trust, njengamanje amalungu ebhodi aqokwa uNgqongqoshe wezoMhlaba.IMbube ifuna nokuthi iNgonyama Trust iphathwe uhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal esikhundleni sokuthi iphathwe uhulumeni kazwelonke.Amaqembu ahlangane nethimba yi-ANC, MKP, DA, EFF, Bosa, ACDP, FF Plus neRise Mzansi.UNdunankulu kaZulu, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, uthe izingxoxo zabo namaqembu ezepolitiki zihambe kahle."Amaqembu azibophezele ekwesekeni izinguquko ezizokwenza ukuthi kuzuze abantu abahlala ezindaweni zamakhosi."Kuxabene ubendle kwiNgonyama Trust njengoba iSilo singahoshelani namalungu ebhodi esiwasola ngokuthi awafuni ukusamukela njengosihlalo webhodi.Imizamo kaNgqongqoshe wezoMhlaba, uMnuz Mzwanele Nyhontso, yokuchitha amalungu ebhodi yahluleka.UNyhontso waqale wabhalela amalungu ebhodi incwadi ewabuza ukuthi kungani kufanele angamiswa.Amalungu ebhodi atshela uNyhontso ukuthi akanawo amandla okuwamisa emsebenzini.Muva nje, uNyhontso uzame ukuhlakaza ibhodi kodwa isinqumo sakhe sachithwa yiNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu.
UKUHLANGANA enyuvesi besaqeqeshelwa umkhakha wokuthwebula nokubonana njalo uma benza imisebenzi yabo yalo mkhakha kwaze kwaqinisa ubudlelwano kwizinsizwa ezinhlanu, futhi kwazisiza nangokuzibula ngenkampani ezisiza ukusebenza ndawonye. Labo woMnuz Sabelo Magwaza weSabelo Mag yaseMlaza, wuSiphesihle Biyela weSphewato Media yaseNanda, wuBusiswa Chiliza wenkampani Umshuthi Media yaseMagabheni, wu-Emihle Dlamini wePluug Talk Studio yaKwaMashu noMonde Mhlongo weMonde Films yaseClermont - asebesebenzisana enkampanini yabo abayiqale ndawonye iKune Studio.Engxoxweni neSolezwe Ngempelasonto, uMagwaza uthe baqale ukuzwana noBiyela noDlamini besaqeqeshelwa lomkhakha eDurban University of Technology (DUT) ngo-2020, okuthe ngo-2022 bahlangana noChiliza noMhlongo - sebevele sebenamabhizinisi abo alo msebenzi, okuqinise ubudlelwano babo baze bashisekela ukusebenzisana ndawonye."Kuqale kancane kuwukuthi siyalekelelana uma kukhona oyedwa phakathi kwethu osuke enomsebenzi omkhulu nodinga izandla eziningi, kwagcina kuba wumkhuba wethu ukuthi njalo siyalekelelana uma kunemisebenzi enjalo - sase sanquma ukuqala le nkampani ngenhloso yokuthi uma kunemisebenzi emikhulu siyenze egameni layo kuphela,” kusho uMagwaza.Eqhuba, uthe ukuqala iKune Studio kubasize kakhulu ukuthola imisebenzi yemicimbi emikhulu yohulumeni neyemicimbi emikhulu yobumnandi ejwayele ukwenzeka eThekwini namaphethelo, okubasiza ukuthi benze inzuzo ngezindlela eziningi futhi ezihlukene."Lokhu kusisiza nangokuthi uma kwenzeka ukuthi oyedwa wethu athole ikhasimende elidinga ukwenzela umsebenzi odinga abantu abaningi, kuba lula ukuthi alidlulisele kwiKune Studio - bese singena sonke kalula kanjalo, okusisiza kakhulu ukuya phambili,” kusho yena.Uthe wethemba ukuthi ukungenisa kwabo ngale ndlela ehlukile kanjena kuzokhuthaza nabanye abantu abasha abanamakhono ehlukene basemalokishini ukulandela ezinyathelweni zabo ukwenza kahle, nokusebenzisana ukuze baphumelele.
ASHAYA phansi ngonyawo amaKhomanisi athi ngeke avume ukuchukuluzwa yi-ANC.Lokhu kushiwo unobhala jikelele weSACP uMnuz Solly Mapaila, othe abakaze bayibuke njengesitha i-ANC."Asikaze sibe nenkinga yokuthi i-ANC ingenela ukhetho. Asikaze siqondise muntu ubugwegwe ngokuvotela i-ANC. Ngeke sivume ukuthi kuchukuluzwe amalungu ethu ," kusho uMapaila. Usho lokhu nje i-ANC neSACP babhekene ngeziqu zamehlo ngodaba lokungenela ukhetho ngokuzimela kweSACP. Phambilini iSACP ibivota ne-ANC kanti manje lezi zinhlangano zizoba yizimbangi.UMapaila uthe eminyakeni engu-30 edlule, bebelokhu beseka i-ANC kanti bebeze bayikhankasele."Siyaqhubeka asijiki ekungeneleni ukhetho oluzayo. Ngeke sisatshiswe muntu ngokungenela ukhetho," kuqhuba uMapaila. Uyalele amalungu eSACP ukuthi angavumeli muntu ukuthi awasabise."Ningavumi ukusatshiswa nganoma yingani njengoba singenela ukhetho. Ningasuli ngoba nisatshiswa," usho kanje.Uthe ngeke bawachukuluze amalungu anquma ukuqhubeka nokuba yingxenye ye-ANC."Sizosihlonipha isinqumo samalungu asala kwi-ANC, ngeke siwakhiphe inyumbazana. Akekho umuntu okumele asatshiswe ngoba siphila ngokwentando yabantu eyalwelwa kanzima." Ugqugquzele abahlukunyezwayo ukuthi babike ngokushesha."Abasatshiswayo kanjalo nabathuswa ngokuthi bazoqondiswa ubugwegwe, abasibikele ngokushesha. Akwesekwe namalungu ethu ajutshwe kuhulumeni yi-ANC." Uthe abayona ingozi kwi-ANC wathi into eyingozi kakhulu ukulawulwa koMbuso yidlanzana kanjalo nokulahleka kwethemba kubasebenzi. "Ukungenzi kahle kukahulumeni, ukulahlekelwa yithemba kwabantu ngezinye zezinto eziyinkinga kuleli. Yizona zinto ezinkulu eziyizingqinamba." Uyalele izinhlaka ezifundazweni nasezifundeni ukuthi zibe nemihlangano okuzobhungwa kuyona indaba yomdonsiswano okhona ne-ANC. Uthe kuzoba nezifundo zokwazisa amalungu ngesinqumo sokuzimela okhethweni kanjalo nombono we-SACP ngohulumeni basekhaya.Isinqumo seSACP sidale uqhekeko nangaphakathi ezinhlakeni zale nhlangano njengoba kuze kwahlakazwa ubuholi baKwaZulu-Natal ngoba kuthiwa abuhambisani nalesi sinqumo. Kwaqokwa ubuholi besikhashana kulesi sifundazwe njengoba kuthiwa abanye abaholi bakhala ngokuthi iSACP iyagagamela ngokuzimela okhethweni.
UTHOLA izinsongo zokubulawa umndeni wenyanga eyayidumile KwaMhlabuyalingana, uMnuz James "God'olulala amankankane" Mthembu (61), kulandela ukubulawa komunye wabasolwa ngokuyisoconga ngeSonto.Kulesi sigameko, okuthiwa senzeke eThengani, khona eManguzi, owesilisa obegqekezelwa ngenhloso yokuthi aphucwe imoto, udubule kwafa "isigebengu", uMnuz Sifiso "Coach" Malwane.Ngokusho kwamaphoyisa, uMalwane, ubengungqondongqondo emacaleni obugebengu bokwebiwa kwezimoto endaweni, bese zeqiswa umngcele, zibhekiswe eMozambique.Kuthiwa ubulawa nje, amaphoyisa abemfunela icala lokubulawa kukaGod'olulala amankankane, owadutshulwa ngoyaba lwezinhlambu ekhaya lakhe ePhelandaba, eManguzi ngasekupheleni kuka-Okthoba nyakenye. UMalwane kuthiwa ubefunelwa necala lokudutshulwa, kubulawe uMnuz Juda Mthethwa ngoFebhuwari 2023.Umthombo ocele ukuthi ungadalulwa uthe umndeni kaGodo usuqalile ukuthola izinsongo ngoba usolwa ngokuthi ubhiyozela ukubulawa kukaMalwane. "Kuthiwa njengoba bejabula nje, nabo basazobulawa,” kusho umthombo.Uqhube wathi okwenzekayo, ukuthi kubulawe abathintekayo ekubulaweni kukaGodo, yinto umndeni obuyilindele vele njengoba ubunayo inkolelo yokuthi umufi uzozilwela nalabo abamsoconga. Ithintwa indodana kaGodo, uMnuz Mandla Mthethwa, yale yaphetha ukuphawula, yathi lolu daba lubucayi, akukho umndeni ongakuphawula. Isolezwe lihlulekile ukuthola ukuphawula komndeni kaJuda njengoba isihlobo, sithe kulukhuni ukuthi bangaphawula ngesehlakalo, kwathi ucingo lukankosikazi kamufi, lwakhala lwangaphendulwa. Osekomitini, elilwa nobugebengu obusemngceleni, uMnuz Joseph Ngubane, uthe nakuba ebulewe ungqondongqondo kodwa kusekhona ukukhathazeka emphakathini ngoba basekhona abanye abasele. Uthe bajatshuliswa wukuthi umgilwa odubule umufi ukwazile ukuzivikela, ehlaselwa. "Neyakhe impilo ibisengcupheni, nabo bebedubula bebhekise kuye,” kusho uNgubane. Uthe ithimba eliyisipesheli elasungulwa ukuze libhekane nalolu hlobo lobugebengu, lisawubambe kahle."Kuke kuthule, ngoba izigebengu ziyalalisa, kodwa bese kubuye kubhoka ke futhi,” usho kanje, enezela ngokuthi njengoba kwenzeke isigameko nje, ikhona imoto eyiveni ethathwe kuzosa kube yizolo eBhambanana. Unxuse umphakathi ukuthi uqhubeke ubambisane namaphoyisa ekulweni nalobu bugebengu, waphinde wawuxwayisa ngokuthi uqaphele ngoba izigebengu zalolu hlobo ziyingozi. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda uthe umufi ungomunye wezelamani zakwaMalwane ezaziwayo, ezisohlwini lwabasolwa abafunwa amaphoyisa ngamacala okubulala kanjalo nawobugebengu obusemngceleni."Phakathi kwalawo macala, kukhona nelokubulala uMnuz Juda Mthethwa,” kusho uNetshiunda. Uthe umufi udutshulwe wafa ngesikhathi kubanjwa inkunzi eThengani, eManguzi, ngeSonto. Uthe uMalwane nomunye abehamba naye bagqekeze umuzi, bephethe izibhamu, bafuna ngodli izikhiye zemoto kumnikazi womuzi. "Umgilwa usheshe wathatha isibhamu sakhe, wadubula ebhekise kubasolwa, abaphunyule babaleka. Umufi ubaleka nje, udubulekile,” kusho uNetshiunda.Uthe amaphoyisa alwa nobugebengu obusemngceleni azwe ukuthi kunesidumbu esingcwatshwe ngendlela engafanele eMgodiwemvubu ngeSonto. "Amaphoyisa athole ukuthi leso sidumbu ngesikaMalwane obedutshulwe esikhathini esingengakanani ngosuku olufanayo. Kuvele ukuthi singcwatshwe ngokuyimfihlo wumfowabo, uMnuz Musa Malwane, naye ofunelwa uxhaxha lwamacala okubulala nawobugebengu obusemngceleni,” kusho uNetshiunda. Uqinisekise ukuthi lezi zelamani zifunelwa necala lokubulawa kwenyanga edumile eManguzi, uJames 'God'olulala amankankane’ Mthembu. Uthe isidumbu sikamufi sigcine simbiwa ngokulandela uhlelo olufanele, kanti uphenyo lwamaphoyisa lusaqhubeka. Uthe nokucingwa kusaMusa nakho kusaqhubeka, wanxusa abangaba nolwazi ngokuthi uphi, bathinte amaphoyisa.
UTHI ubhecwa ngobende inyama engayidlanga uthishanhloko waseMpumulwane Primary, KwaMaphumulo, uMnuz Sithembiso Khumalo obhekene necala lokusocongwa kwephoyisa loMkhandlu weTheku, uCaptain Zwelakhe Thomas Ntombela. Lokhu ukusho eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini izolo.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi umufi wadutshulwa wafa esigamekeni esenzeka ngoMeyi 2023 esemzini wakhe kwa-S, eMlaza. Waphuthunyiswa eSiphingo Medical Towers okuyilapho okwafike kwamenela khona.Bekungokokuqala ukuthi uKhumalo angene ebhokisini selokhu laqala leli cala. UKhumalo ungaphandle ngebheyili ayithola leli cala lisaseNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMlaza ngo-2023.Ngaphambi kokuba angene ebhokisini ummeli wakhe,u-Advocate Mdu Mvune, ubekade efake isicelo sokuthi akhishwe phambili engazange abethule ubufakazi okuyinto inkantolo eyichithile wase engena kanjalo ebhokisini uKhumalo.UKhumalo uqale ngokuveza ukuthi uMzo Ntombela inkabi eyavuma icala yagwetshwa ingumakhelwane wakhe kanjalo noKhulani Cele inkabi edonsa esikadilkakajele naye uthe ungamakhelwane wakhe.Ebuzwa ukuthi uyamazi yini uNkk Faith Ntombela uthe akamazi kodwa ngaphambi kokubulawa komyeni wakhe wake wambona KwaDukuza.Utshele inkantolo ukuthi akalazi nephoyisa okukhulunywa ngalo, nendawo okuthiwa labulawelwa kuyona akayazi.''Angimazi lo muntu okukhulunywa ngaye nendawo enikhuluma ngayo okwenzeka kuyona isigameko,'' usho kanjena esebhokisini ephendula imibuzo yommeli wakhe, u-Advocate Mvune.Ebuzwa ukuthi kukhona yini afisa ukukusho mayelana nokubulawa kukamufi uthe akukho ngoba akazi lutho udidekile ukuthi kungani eyamaniswa naleli cala. "Okokuqala nje ngangizotholani ngokubulala umuntu engingamazi,'' ubuze kanjena.Uthe waqala ukubona uFaith ngesikhathi ethola ucingo olwaluvela kuCele owayemcela ukuba ahambe aye eMega City, eMlaza ayothatha imoto.''Ngesikhathi engishayela ucingo wangitshela ukuthi kunemoto yakhe ayithengile okumele ngiyoyilanda eMega City. Ngenxa yokuthi angithandanga ukuhamba ngedwa ngacela uMzo ukuba ngihambe naye njengoba naye uCele wayemazi uMzo ngoba sonke sakhelene,'' usho kanjena.Uthe uCele wayelokhu ebashayela ucingo ebheka ukuthi sebekuphi nendawo.''Engakuqaphela wukuthi wayefona esebenzisa izingcingo ezihlukene. Ngesikahthi sesidlula eGateway wangitshela ukuthi imoto ngizoyifica ipake ngasegaraji eMega City,'' kuchaza yena.Eqhuba uthe wamtshela nokuthi uzohlangana nowesifazane omfishane, ompofu, ogqoke amateku amhlophe futhi ozobe ehamba nge-mercedes benz."Wangitshela ukuthi loyo wumkakhe,'' kusho uKhumalo.''Ngampela sengifikile kwaqhamuka le moto kwehla yena kanye lo muntu wesifazane engitshelwe ngaye. Ngambuza ukuthi ungubani wangiphendula ngokuthi angibuze lo muntu ongithumileyo,'' usho kanjena.Uthe bahamba nayo imoto baya KwaMaphumulo, ishayelwa uMzo ethole umyalelo wokuthi mayiyiswe emagcekeni akwaCele.Ngakusasa uthe wethuka uma ethi uyaphuma egcekeni lakwakhe ekhangwa yiCreta eSilver Grey phakathi kukhona uFaith kanye nodadewabo kaCele.''Bangitshela ukuthi sebemtholile umuntu ozobashayelela imoto kumele iphindele emuva,'' kuchaza yena. Ebuzwa ngobudlelwane bakhe noMzo uthe wayekade emsebenzela kwakhe ekhanda izimoto kodwa wamxosha ngemuva kokuba entshontshe imoto yakhe. ''Kodwa wabuye waxolisa ngamvumela ukuba abuye ezosebenza,'' usho kanje.Ebuzwa ukuthi kukhona yini lapho benoCele noma uFaith abake babhunga ngetulo lokusoconga umufi uthe lutho. UCele sasixhunyaniswa wukuthi ungumakhelwane ethanda ukuthi ngimazise ngokuthi kwenzekani emndenini wakhe. UFaith sasingaxhumani naye,'' kusho yena.U-Advocate Mvune izolo utshele inkantolo ukuthi ingabusebenzisi ubufakazi obuphambi kwayo obethulwe uFaith noMzo ekhala ngokuthi buyashayisana futhi buntekenteke.Wenze izibonelo lapho okushayisana khona ubufakazi obethulwe yilaba.Eqhulwini uqale wakhuluma ngokuthi uFaith esitatimendeni sakhe esifungelwe ayevuma kusona icala waveza ukuthi umyeni wakhe wayemhlukumeza, kodwa uma esethula ubufakazi ebhokisini useshaya ingqimphothwe uthi ubudlelwane bakhe nomufi babubuhle kakhulu kwaze kwafika isikhathi lapho eficwa khona wukufa.Uqhubekile wathi esitatmendeni sakhe sokuvuma icala, uFaith wathi kwavunyelwana ngokuthi inkabi uMzo, izokhokhelwa u-R150 000 uma iwenze ngempumelelo umsebenzi wokusoconga umufi, kodwa uma esemile ebhokisini usethi akazi lutho ngesivumelwano semali esithinta iukukhokhelwa kwenkabi.Uqhubekile uMvune wathi uMzo esitatimendeni wathi uKhumalo owamnikeza isibhamu kanye nezinhlamvu.''Esitatimendeni uMzo uthe waze wazifaka yena izinhlamvu esibhamini. Kodwa uma esemi ebhokisini useyashintsha futhi uthi uKhumalo owafaka izinhlamvu,'' kuchaza uMvune.
I-ANC isabisa ngokuthi izobadiliza ezikhundleni zikahulumeni labo abazoqoma ukukhankasela idlelandawonye layo elikhethe ukungenela ukhetho ngokuzimela, i-SACP.UNobhala Jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, uthe abazokhetha ukukhankasela amaKhomanisi okhethweni oluzayo bazozibeka engcupheni yokukhishwa ezikhundleni abajutshwe kuzo kuhulumeni.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba ngoLwesine. Kunenqwaba yabaholi be-SACP abanezikhundla kuhulumeni okubalwa kubo uNgqongqoshe wezeSayensi nezobuChwepheshe, uDkt Blade Nzimande, uNgqongqoshe wezeMfundo ePhakeme, uMnuz Buti Manamela, noNdunankulu waseLimpopo, uDkt Phophi Ramathuba.I-ANC inikeze amalungu ayo umnqamulajuqu wezinsuku eziyishumi ukuba asho ukuthi azokhankasela liphi iqembu okhethweni lohulumeni basekhaya oluzayo.UMbalula uthe labo abazokhetha ukungaphumeli obala, bazothatha ngokuthi bazokhankasela i-SACP.UMbalula uthe kuyicala ukukhankasela iqembu elincintisana ne-ANC okhethweni, wathi labo abenza lelo cala bazothathelwa izinyathelo."Onke amalungu e-ANC aphoqelekile ukuba akhankasele i-ANC nabayimele okhethweni. Ngisho nalabo abanobulungu be-SACP baphoqelekile ukuthi bakhankasele i-ANC. Abangeke baphumele obala ukuthi bazokhankasela i-ANC, sizothatha ngokuthi bazokhankasela elinye biqembu. Abakhankasela iqembu elincintisana ne-ANC bazothathelwa izinyathelo."Uma ujutshwe esikhundleni kuhulumeni sizokuthathela izinyathelo okubalwa kuzo ukuthi sikukhiphe esikhundleni. Sizokukhipha esikhundleni ngoba uzokube ukhankasela iqembu elibanga ne-ANC okhethweni, nokuyinto ephambene nemigomo ye-ANC." UMbalula uthe amalungu e-SACP angeke axoshwe kwi-ANC."Siyasihlonipha isinqumo se-SACP sokungenela ukhetho. Angeke silwe namaKhomanisi emkhankasweni wethu. Asinankinga namalungu e-SACP. I-SACP inabaholi abanohlonze abanye babo bajutshwe ezikhundleni kuhulumeni. Amanye amalungu e-SACP anombono ohlukile ngodaba lokungenela ukhetho."Asikho empini. Into nje okufanele abantu bakhethe ukuthi bazokhankasela liphi iqembu. Awukwazi ukukhankasela womabili amaqembu. Kufanele ukhethe iqembu elilodwa. Awukwazi ukuthi namhlanje uzokhankasela i-ANC, uvuke kusasa usukhankasela i-SACP."UMbalula uthe bayoze bayibone emva kokhetho i-SACP."Mhlawumbe le nto sizoyixoxa emva kokhetho. Uma sekuphume imiphumela yokhetho mhlawumbe sizobona ukuthi singakwazi yini ukusebenzisana ne-SACP. Ngeke uphinde usizwe sikhuluma ngale ndaba."
I-ANC izokwenza ezinye izinguquko ebuholini bayo obuphethe esifundazweni iKwaZulu-Natal kanye nasezifundeni zakulesi sifundazwe.UNobhala jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, uveze ukuthi bazomemezela ithimba lesikhashana elisha elizohola i-ANC esifundazweni baphinde bamemezele nabazohola i-ANC ezifundeni.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba ngoLwesine. UMbalula uthe ithimba elisha elizohola isifundazwe uzolimemezela ngempelasonto."Sesisemaphethelweni okuqokwa kwethimba elisha elizohola i-ANC KwaZulu-Natal. NgoMgqibelo ngizobe ngiKwaZulu-Natal, lapho sizoqoka khona ithimba elisha. Sivele sesibaqokile abaholi abaphezulu abazohola ithimba."Ithimba ebelikhona belinabaholi abangaphezu kuka-60.Kulindeleke ukuthi abaningi badliwe yizembe njengoba uMbalula akuveza phambilini ukuthi bazolinciphisa ithimba.UMbalula wakhala nogokuthi ithimba ebelikhona liyahluleka ukwenza umsebenzi walo, lazi ukulwa izimpi zangaphakathi kuphela.Waze wafanisa ithimba nohlobo lwemoto i-Tazz.I-ANC isanda kumemezela izinguquko ebuholi obuphezulu bethimba elihola isifundazwe.Kulezi zinguquko kuqokwe uMnuz Mike Mabuyakhulu njengomdidiyeli, kwathi uMnuz James Nxumalo waqokwa njengomgqugquzeli.Kulezi zinguquko ezimenyezelwe uMbalula ngeledlule, abaholi abanohlonze okubalwa kubo, uMnuz Jeff Radebe, uNkk Nomusa Dube-Ncube, noNkk Weziwe Thusi, badliwe yizembe.UMbalula uveze ukuthi bazophinde baqoke amathimba azohola i-ANC ezifundeni."NgoMsombuluko, ngeholidi, sizoqoka ubuholi bazo zonke izifunda ze-ANC KwaZulu-Natal."Lokhu kusho ukuthi buzodliwa yizembe ubuholi be-ANC ezifundeni obaqokwa ngonyaka odlule.Ubuholi obuzomenyezelwa wuMbalula buzohola umkhankaso we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal.Kubheda uhlelo kwi-ANC KwaZulu-Natal njengoba yaphunyukwa yisifundazwe okhethweni lwango-2024.I-ANC iyiqembu lesithathu ngobukhulu KwaZulu-Natal, iyingxenye kahulumeni wokubambisana.Izinto zaqala ukuyibhedela okhethweni lohulumeni basekhaya lwango-2021 i-ANC KwaZulu-Natal lapho eyalahlekelwa khona yinqwaba yomasipala.
KUKHONA nobeyisisebenzi kwabathathu abasolwa ngecala lokubulala ngesihluku umndeni wabayisikhombisa eNewark, KwaDukuza, ngoLwesibili.Izidumbu zabafi okuthiwa baneminyaka ephakathi kuka-20 no-83, kuvela ukuthi zikhonjwe abasolwa eMelmoth, ngoLwesithathu. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe kubasolwa okuthiwa baneminyaka ephakathi kuka-21 no-28, kukhona oyedwa obeyisisebenzi emzini wabafi. Uthe kulindeleke ukuthi bavele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaKwaDukuza, namuhla. Elandisa ngesigameko, uthe abagilwa baqale bathunjwa, besuswa ekhaya labo eliseNewark ngoLwesibili ebusuku, bayobulawa eMelmoth."Yisisebenzi esihlanza indlu esihlabe umkhosi ngesigameko ngoLwesithathu ekuseni, kulandela ukuthi sifike ekhaya labagilwa, sathola ukuthi kugqekeziwe, amalungu omndeni ayisikhombisa wonke engekho, kanjalo nemoto ingekho,” kusho uNetshiunda. Uthe kube sekubizelwa endaweni yesigameko amaphoyisa aseNewark kanjalo namanye ama-unit amaphoyisa. Kuwona uthe kusebenzisane amaphoyisa aseNewark, abaphenyi baKwaDukuza, KwaDukuza Tactical Response Team, Provincial Counter Intelligence Unit, Provincial Counter Kidnapping Unit neProvincial Serious Violence Crimes Unit. Uthe uphenyo lwawo luqale lwawaholela KwaHlomendlini, eMandeni, lapho okufike kwaboshwa khona abasolwa ababili ngoLwesithathu. "Oyedwa wabasolwa utholwe neselula yoyedwa wabagilwa. Umkhondo ube usuwakhomba KwaDendethu, eSundumbili, amaphoyisa lapho okufike kwaboshwa khona umsolwa wesithathu,” kusho uNetshiunda. Udalule ukuthi umsolwa wesithathu yena utholwe nesibhamu. Uthe angu-11 amaselula abagilwa, atholwe kubasolwa. Uthe yilapho amaphoyisa ethole khona ukuthi oyedwa wabagilwa ubesebenzela abagilwa. Kwabe sekuvela nokuthi abasolwa ngokubambisana bagqekeze emzini wabagilwa, bababopha ngentambo. "Kuvela ukuthi oyedwa wabo uqale wadlwengula umgilwa oneminyaka engu-20 ngaphambi kokuba babalayishe emotweni yomunye wabo (abagilwa), bayikhomba eMelmoth,” kusho uNetshiunda, othe bahambe ibanga elilinganiselwa ku-200km ukusuka emzini wabagilwa kuyiwa endaweni yesigameko. Uveze ukuthi amaphoyisa athole ukuthi umsolwa obedlwengule umgilwa (20) ekhaya lakhe, uphinde wamdlwengula okwesibili sekufikwe eMelmoth. Uthe emva kokumdlwengula isibili, ube esefuna ngodli imininingwane yabagilwa abathathu yasebhange nezinombolo zakhona eziyimfihlo. "Emva kokuthola le mininingwane, babe sebebadubula bebabulala bobathathu. Laba abanye abagilwa abane, bona bagwazwe, baze bafa,” kusho uNetshiunda. Uthe uphenyo lwamaphoyisa luveze ukuthi ngoLwesibili ebusuku kanjalo nangoLwesithathu ekuseni, kube nemali ekhishwe emabhange abagilwa izikhawu eziningi. UKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Mkhwanazi, uwashayele ihlombe amaphoyisa ngokusheshe ababophe abasolwa. Ube eseyalela abaphenyi ukuthi baqinisekise ukuthi ubulungiswa buyenzeka ukuze izihlobo zabagilwa zizothobeka amanxeba. Uthe kuyakhathaza ukuzwa ukuthi omunye wabasolwa ubeqashwe abagilwa. "Siyabanxusa abaqashi ukuthi abazikhathaze ngokuthola ulwazi ngomuntu abamqashayo, baphinde bayihlole indlela yabo yokuziphatha esolisayo,” kusho uMkhwanazi. Uthe imvamisa, ezindaweni ezingamapulazi noma ezithe qekelele, amacala enziwa ngabantu ngabagilwa ababaziyo noma abasondelene nabo.
SEWUQOKE imenenja entsha uMasipala wesiFunda uMzinyathi oholwa yiMeya uNkk Thembisile Mchunu. Okhethwe kulesi sikhundla nguMnuz Mlungisi Ntanzi obebambile kusona phambilini.UNkk Mchunu uthe uyabethemba kakhulu ubuholi bukaNtanzi ukuthi uzokwazi ukwenza izinto ngendlela. Uchaze lesi sikhundla njengesiwumgogodla wokusebenza kukamasipala.''Anginakho nokuncane nje ukungabaza ukuthi uNtanzi uzokwazi ukwenza umsebenzi omuhle kulesi sikhundla. Okuhle kakhulu wukuthi ubevele ebambile kusona lokho kuzokwenza ukuthi akwazi ukuqhubeka nento ayiqonda kangcono,'' usho kanjena.Ube esenxusa bonke abasebenzi bakamasipala ukuthi bameseke uNtanzi ukuze aqhubeke nokusebenza kahle nangokuzikhandla.Ekhuluma ngemuva kokuqokwa kwakhe uNtanzi uthe okuseqhulwini kuyena ukwenza konke okusemandleni ngenhloso yokubhekana ngqo nodaba lwenkinga yamanzi.NgokukaNtanzi uyakuqonda kahle kamhlophe ukuthi abantu bakule ndawo bafisa kangakanani ukuthi kugcine kuxazululeke inkinga yamanzi.Ugcizelele ukuthi ufuna ukubuyisa isithunzi salo masipala ngokuthi kuxazululwe ingwadla yokushoda kwamanzi.NgoLwesithathu uNtanzi nePhini leMeya eMzinyathi, uNksz Nothile Zungu, bahambele uMasipala waseMvoti beyohlola umsebenzi wokufakwa kwamanzi okuqhubekayo KwaLatha, eMvoti.Iphini lemeya lithembise ukuthi kuyothi kuphela unyaka umsebenzi usuphothuliwe, abantu bakule ndawo sebewathola amanzi kompompi.
BAFUNA amaphoyisa abhukule ekuphenyeni izigameko zokwebiwa kwemfuyo abantu baseMawuleni, ePort Shepstone, abakhala ngokuthi sebephelile amasela. Esigamekweni sakamumva, okuthiwa senzeke ngoLwesihlanu, owesilisa wendawo onguMnuz Mthobisi Cele, webelwe izinkomo eziyisikhombisa.Elandisa ngesehlakalo asifanise nesimngcwabe ephila, uthe umelusi wakhe uqaphele ngezikhathi zantambama, izinkomo sezibuya emadlelweni ukuthi eziyisikhombisa azibonwa. Uthe kuyinqubo yendawo ukuthi abelusi noma imindeni iyazivulela izinkomo ezibayeni, zizihambele ziye emadlelweni, baze bazibone ntambama uma sezibuya khona. Uthe ngesikhathi zidla emadlelweni akekho osuke ehleli nazo eziqaphile. "Kuthe uma kuyobhekwa emadlelweni, kwaficwa ngamanqina azo kanjalo nemiswani, okunye kungekho, kwacaca ukuthi zebiwe yilabo abazibulala khona lapho, maqede balayishe inyama yazo, bese bekhala amaphepha,” kusho uCele.Uthe uvukele emaphoyiseni ekuseni ngoMgqibelo, ukuyovula icala, nokuyilapho ezithele khona phezu kolwazi lokuthi ngayizolo, amaphoyisa athole imoto eyiveni, i-NP200, ebiphantshelwe yisondo esigodini saseMntentweni, bude buduze nedolobha i-Port Shepstone."Athe le moto ayithole ingenamuntu phakathi, isele dengwane. Athi uma eyibheka ngemumva, athola kukhona inqwaba yenyama nezinhloko. Athi uma eyongikhombisa, nebala ngathola ukuthi yizo izinkomo zami lezi engithi zidukile,” usho kanje. Uthe amaphoyisa aqhubeke amtshela ukuthi athe uma ephenya ngale moto etholakele, kwavela ukuthi yayibikwe ukuthi yebiwe esiteshini samaphoyisa i-Durban Central nyakenye. "Ngiphatheke kabi ngokuthi sintshontshelwe imfuyo ngale ndlela. Sifisa amaphoyisa enze kangcono ngamacala okwebiwa kwemfuyo ngoba siyawabika ngethemba lokuthi kukhona abazoboshwa kodwa uphenyo lwakhona luphelele emoyeni,” kusho uCele.Uthe njengoba yena elahlekelwe yimfuyo, ungowesibili emndenini ukulahlekelwa esikhathini esiyizinyanga ezimbalwa. "Umalume wami ubulawelwe ezine ngasekupheleni konyaka odlule. Nezakhe zabulawa ngendlela efanayo emadlelweni. Yena-ke akazange athole namkhondo. Naye wabika emaphoyiseni kodwa icala laphelela emoyeni,” kubeka uCele.Uthe uma ekhumbula kahle, lesi yisigameko sesithathu esikhathini esingangezinyanga eziyisishiyagalombili."Zibulawelwa endaweni eyodwa, nokwenza sicabange ukuthi amasela asicekela phansi abantu ababodwa,” kusho uCele, othe indlela okwenzeka ngayo babuye babe nakho ukusola ukuthi amasela kungenzeka kube abantu bendawo abasebenzisana nabokuhamba. Uthe lokhu bakusho ngoba abanazo izimpendulo zokuthi umuntu wokuhamba angaluthathaphi ulwazi lokuthi amadlelo endawo angakuphi. Unxuse amaphoyisa ukuthi alusukumele lolu daba ngoba nakuba omunye umuntu engayibuka incane into yokwebiwa kwemfuyo kodwa isuke iwudume lwengozi kubanikazi. Wenze umfanekiso ngaye, wathi lezi zinkomo ezebiwe zingabiza u-R120 000 uma zidayiswa. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uCaptain Ntathu Ndlovu, uthe amaphoyisa aseMehlomnyama aphenya icala lokwebiwa kwemfuyo kulandela ukuthi kwebiwe izinkomo eziyisikhombisa eMawuleni. "Uphenyo lwamaphoyisa nomphakathi luholele eNdundumeni lapho okutholakale khona ukuthi izinkomo zihlinziwe, kwasala izimpondo namanqina kuphela,” kusho uCapt Ndlovu, othe akukabi bikho muntu oseboshiwe.
I-DA ifuna kubizwe umhlangano ophuthumayo ohlanganisa iminyango ehlukene kahulumeni, okubalwa nezinhlaka zokuphepha nezokushushiswa komphakathi, ukuze kubhungwe ngesihlava sokukhulelwa kwezingane kuleli.Leli qembu libhalele uSihlalo wekomiti labesiFazane, iNtsha nabaPhila nokuKhubazeka ePhalamende, ukuze abize umhlangano ofaka iminyango ehlukene okubalwa oweMfundo eyisiSekelo, owezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi, owezeMpilo, amaphoyisa kanjalo nophiko lwezokuShushisa kuleli, iNational Prosecuting Authority.Okhulumela i-DA eMnyangweni wezabesiFazane, iNtsha nabaPhila nokuKhubazeka, uNksz Angel Khanyile, uthe bakhathazekile ngesihlava sokukhulelwa kwezingane. Uthe ziyashaqisa izibalo zezingane ezikhulelwe KwaZulu-Natal, onyakenimali u-2025/26. "Izibalo ziveza ukuthi zingu-421 izingane ezineminyaka engu-10 kuya ku-14 ezikhuleliwe esifundazweni onyakenimali u-2025/2026. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izingane ezintathu zikhulelwa ezinsukwini ezimbili," kusho uNksz Khanyile.Uthe lezi zibalo zikhomba ukuhlukunyezwa kwezingane kuleli."Kulo mhlangano kumele yonke iminyango iveze iqhaza layo ekulweni nalesi sihlava. Kudingeka kube nokubambisana kweminyango ukuze kulandelelwe amacala asuke ebikiwe agcina egweba abathintekayo." Uthe umthetho ucacile ukuthi ingane eneminyaka engu-12 ayikwazi ukuvuma ukuya ocansini. Ukhale ngosonhlalakahle athe bayahluleka ukubika amacala emaphoyiseni."Ezinye iziteshi zamaphoyisa aziwamukeli la macala. Umthetho wezingane kanjalo nothinta ucansi, uyalela ukuthi kubikwe icala uma kunengane eneminyaka engaphansi kwengu-16 ekhulelwe."Uthe ngeke bakuvumele ukuthi kudlwengulwe izingane ziphinde zikhuleliswe."Abomthetho kumele benze umsebenzi wabo, abenzi bobubi baboshwe, bajeziswe," usho kanje. Uthe umthetho ukubeka kucace ukuthi uhulumeni kumele enze okuthile. Umthetho uyalela othisha, abahlengikazi, odokotela, osonhlalakahle nabanye abasebenza nezingane ukuthi babike emaphoyiseni uma kunengane encane ekhulelwe.Kowezemfundo kwakhalwa ngokuthi abanye abazali, bagcina behoxisa amacala emuva kokuba osuke enze icala ethembise ukukhokha inhlawulo. Abanye othisha sebekwe balahlwa amacala okulala nezingane. Abanye kuthiwa bathembisa ukukhokha ilobolo ukuze bangaboshwa, bese imindeni iba manqika ukuvula amacala okudlwengula.
UMHOLI we-EFF, uMnuz Julius Malema, ufuna kuthathelwe izinyathelo umshushisi wecala eliholele ekutheni agwetshwe iminyaka emihlanu ebhadla ejele, u-Advocate Joel Cesar.UMalema ufake isikhalo esisemthethweni enhlanganweni yezokushushisa, iNational Prosecuting Authority (NPA), lapho ecele khona ukuthi kuphenywe uCesar.UCesar ubengumshushisi ecaleni likaMalema lokuqhumisa isibhamu.Encwadini yabameli, uMalema usola uCesar ngokwephula imigomo yeNPA.UMalema uthe uCesar wenza okungafanele ngesikhathi egunyaza ukuthi isibhamu esaqhunyiswa uMalema sibuyiselwe kumnikazi waso ekubeni inkantolo ingakanqumi ukumkhipha phambili umnikazi wesibhamu.Umnikazi wesibhamu, uMnuz Adriaan Snyman, watholwa engenacala.USnyman, owayengumqaphi kaMalema ngesikhathi eqhumisa isibhamu, ubonakala kwi-video enikeza uMalema isibhamu asiqhumisa ngesikhathi kunomcimbi wokugubha iminyaka engu-10 kwasungulwa i-EFF.UMalema uthe uCesar wakhipha umyalelo wokuthi uSnyman abuyiselwe isibhamu ngaphambi kokuthi inkantolo imkhiphe phambili."UCesar watshela abameli bakaSnyman ukuthi isibhamu bazosithola enkantolo. Isibhamu sabuyiselwa kuSnyman ekuseni ngosuku okwaphuma ngalo isinqumo sokuthi akanacala. Lokho kusho ukuthi wabuyiselwa isibhamu ngaphambi kokuthi kuphume isinqumo senkantolo."UMalema uqhuba athi uCesar akanalo igunya lokukhipha umyalelo wokuthi kubuyiselwe uSnyman isibhamu.UMalema uthe yimantshi noma ijaji abanamandla okunquma ukuba kubuyiselwe ubufakazi emuva uma sekuphothulwe icala."Kusobala ukuthi wephula imigomo yeNPA uCesar ngokukhipha umyalelo angagunyaziwe ukuba awukhiphe."Kusale kancane ukuba uMalema ayolala ezikhindini ngesikhathi inkantolo imgweba iminyaka emihlanu ebhadla ejele ngesonto eledlule.UMalema wasindiswa wukuthi wafaka isicelo sokuphonsela inselelo isigwebo sakhe.Inkantolo yabe isimdedela ngesexwayiso.Isicelo sikaMalema sokuphonsela inselelo isigwebo sakhe sizolalelwa enkantolo enkulu.Ukugwetshwa kukaMalema iminyaka emihlanu ebhadla ejele kubeka engcupheni isikhundla sakhe sokuba yilungu lePhalamende.Umthetho awumuvumeli umuntu oseke wadonsa isigwebo esingaphezu kwezinyanga ezingu-12 ukuthi abe yilungu lePhalamende.
OSOMABHIZINISI abasafufusa nabashisekela ukuchumisa amabhizinisi abo bazothola ithuba lokucetshiswa ngokumele bakwenze ukuthola intuba yokuphumelela ngawo uma sebehambele umbukiso wezamabhizinisi waminyaka yonke i-Durban Business Fair (DBF).Lo mbukiso wokukhangisa ngamabhizinisi ozoba seDurban Exhibition Centre, eThekwini, kusuka ngo-Ephreli 30 kuya kuMeyi 2, uzokwendlalelwa yi-Business Indaba izoba se-ICC, ngo-Ephreli 29 ngo-9 ekuseni, lapho okuzobhungwa ngamasu okukhulisa ibhizinisi.Nonyaka ukhuza ibuya ihlandla lesi-28 lo mbuthano wamabhizinisi, ondikimba yawo yanonyaka ithi Enabling SMME Growth Through Funding, Compliance, Market Access, and Strategic Partnerships - okusho ukuthi kuzosizwa osomabhizinisi abasafufusa ngamathuba okuxhaswa ebhizinisini, wukuthola amakhasimende nobumqoka bokusebenzisana nabanye.Ezikhulumini kuzobe kukhona isikhulu esiphezulu seProudly SA, uNkk Happy Khumalo-Ngidi, umqondisi woPhiko lokuThutha nokuHwebelana ngeMpahla kuMasipala weTheku, uNksz Sbo Ncube, ilungu loHlaka lwezeNtela eZweni i-SARS, uNksz Wandisa Madyibi nenye yezimenenja zeSEDA, uMnuz Thula Mkhwanazi.Lezi zikhulumi zizobe zidingida izihloko ezisemqoka kubalwa imigudu okumele ilandelwe wosomabhizinisi abasafufusa ukubasiza baxhaseke, izinkinga zokuswela imali, umthelela omubi wokunyuka kwamanani empahla, yimigudu esemqoka okumele ilandelwe yilabo abasanamabhizinisi, ikakhulu abasanda kuwaqala namasu okubasiza ukuwachumisa.Umbukiso wamabhizinisi uzobe usuvulwa ngokusemthethweni ngo-Ephreli 30, nguNgqongqoshe woMnyango wokuThuthukisa amaBhizinisi amaNcane, uNkk Stella Ndabeni-Abrahams, bese naye azisa ngezinhlelo zoMnyango wakhe zokuthuthikisa osomabhizinisi abasafufusa.Usihlalo wekomiti loPhiko lokuThuthukisa uMnotho nokuHlela kuMasipala weTheku, iKhansela uThembo Ntuli, uthe lo mbukiso usemqoka kakhulu ukusiza amabhizinisi asafufusa ngamathuba azonikezelwa kuwona ngokwehlukana kwawo."Leli thuba lihlanganisa izinhlaka ezihlukene futhi eziwukhiye wokuthuthuka kosomabhizinisi abasafufusa, lapho bekwazi ukuthi bathole amathuba, amasu namathuluzi okubasiza ukufukula amabhizinisi abo, okusiza ukufukula umnotho wethu,” kusho uNtuli.Abafisa ukwethamela lo mbuthwano wokubhunga ngezamabhizinisi, ohlelwa wuMasipala weTheku -
