ABAHOLI KwaZulu-Natal, uNdunankulu Thami Ntuli, noKhomishana wamaPhoyisa esifundazwe uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, sebephumele obala bakhuza udlame olubhekiswe kwabokufika olufufusayo kulandela ukwandwa kwemibhikisho elwa nabokufika eminye yayo egcina isiba nodlame.Bathe ababhikishi abanalo ilungelo lokuhambe behlola ukuthi abokufika banawo yini amaphepha okuba kuleli njengoba kunezinhlaka ezigunyazwe ukwenza lo msebenzi.Uya ngokubanciphela umhlaba KwaZulu-Natal abokufika njengoba cishe usuku nosuku sekuba nombhikisho wokulwa nabakuleli ngokungemthetho.Imibhikisho miningi kakhulu eThekwini naseMgungundlovu, muva nje isiba khona nasemadolobheni amancane ngisho nasezindaweni zamakhosi imbala. Kukhona amakhosi asephumele obala athi awasabadingi abokufika.Izinhlangano iWomen's Liberation Movement ne-African Solidarity Network, zithe kungase kwenzeke imbedumehlwana yango-2008 no-2015 uma lunganqandwa udlame olufufusayo.Ngo-2015 kwabulawa abokufika abayisikhombisa ngesikhathi kunezigameko zokuhlaselwa kwabo KwaZulu-Natal nasezingxenyeni zeGoli. Kwashiswa inqwaba yezitolo zabokufika kuleyo mibhikisho.Ngo-2008 kwabikwa ukuthi kwashona abantu abangu-62 ngesikhathi kunodlame olubhekiswe kwabokufika olwaqala eGoli lwagcina selusabalele ezifundazweni eziningi okubalwa neKwaZulu-Natal.Esitatimendeni esikhishwe ngokuhlanganyela, izinhlangano ezikhuza udlame zithe kunezinkomba zokuthi isimo singase sibhebhetheke uma kungakhuzwa."Kulezi zinyanga ezedlule sibonile kushuba isimo KwaZulu-Natal. Kube nemibhikisho ngaphandle kwesikole i-Addington Primary, kube nezinsolo zokuvimba abokufika ezibhedlela nasezikoleni, baningi nje abantu abavelile abakhuluma izinto ezicwasa abokufika."Izinhlangano zinxuse amaphoyisa ukuba abophe abaphehla udlame.Zinxuse amakhosi, izinhlaka zikahulumeni, abamasonto nosomabhizinisi ukuba bangenelele."NeSilo uMisuzulu kaZwelithini sineqhaza elibalulekile okufanele silibambe ekubuyiseni uzinzo."UNtuli unxuse abantu ukuthi behlise umoya, wathi akufanele kubukeke sengathi abantu baKwaZulu-Natal bacwasa abantu bokufika.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabeSABC News."Kufanele kucace ukuthi inkinga esinayo ingabantu abakuleli ngokungemthetho. Akufanele kube nokudideka kule nto. Umuntu wangaphandle ofuna ukuba kuleli kufanele abe namaphepha amgunyaza ukuba abe kuleli. Abangenawo amaphepha kufanele babuyele emazweni abo."UMkhwanazi yena uthe usazoba nomhlangano nabaholi bezinhlangano ezihlela imibhikisho.UMkhwanazi uthe ababhikishi abakuqeqeshelwe ukubona ukuthi abantu bokufika banamaphepha aqondile yini.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabeNewzroom Afrika."Uma ababhikishi benolwazi ngabantu bokufika abakuleli ngokungemthetho kufanele babikele amaphoyisa kube yiwona aphenyayo. Bazogcina sebephambanisa nabantu balana eNingizimu Afrika bebadidanisa nabokufika."
UKHALA ngokwenzelwa phansi amaphoyisa umndeni wowesilisa okuthiwa wagwazwa wafa kunetiye (umsebenzi wesintu) kamakhelwane eKoki, eMzimkhulu, ngo-Ephreli nyakenye. Kulesi sigameko okuthiwa senzeka emini kwabha phambi kwawo wonke umuntu, kwabulawa ngesihluku uMnuz Ziphilele Mtambo (42).Ngokusho kukamfowabo kamufi, uMnuz Nyameko Mtambo, kwakungu-Ephreli 25, 2025, kwenzeka umshophi. Uthe isigameko senzeka egcekeni lalapho okwakwenziwe khona umsebenzi, okuyikwamakhelwane wakwamufi kanjalo nowabasolwa. Uthe isigameko senzeka lapho okwakuhleli khona wonke umuntu, okukhona kubo nezihlobo zakhe umufi kanjalo nabanye omakhelwane."Kuthiwa ingxabano yaqala ngenxa yotshwala. Umufi wayefuna ukuphuziswa utshwala, abasolwa bengafuni aphuze. Kuthiwa baqala basukuma bamshaya, bemhlanganyela. Kwathi kusabukwa lokho, oyedwa wabo wakhipha uhalakasha lommese, wamgwaza ephindelela,” kusho uMtambo.Uqhube wathi izihlobo zikamufi ezazikhona endaweni yesigameko, zamphuthumisa esibhedlela, nokho kwamenela ngezikhathi zasebusuku, emva kokulaliswa amahora ambalwa. Uthe amaphoyisa abizwa endaweni yesehlo, afika umufi esephuthunyiswe esibhedlela, abuza imibuzo ngokwenzekile kumnikazi womuzi, kwavulwa icala, wathi abasolwa banele babona ukuthi umufi uselimele kanzima, babaleka endaweni. "Kwaphela izinsuku ezimbalwa bengekho endaweni kodwa babuye babuya. Sathi singcwaba base bebuyile, abangaboshwa,” kusho uMtambo. Uqhube wathi babelokhu belindele ukuthi bazoboshwa kodwa kwangenzeka lokho. "Okusiphatha kabi ukuthi sekuze kwaphela cishe unyaka bezihambela ngokukhululeka emphakathini, sabantu abangaze benze lutho. Thina ngapha salahlekelwa othandiweyo ngenxa yabo,” kusho uMtambo.Uthe okubaphatha kabi ukuthi bayazizwa izinkulumo abasolwa abazikhuluma emphakathini, lapho beqhosha ngokuthi akukho mnyakazo ozoke wenzeke ngecala ngoba bona bawakhokhela imali amaphoyisa. Uthe abazi ukuthi le nkulumo iyiqiniso kangakanani kodwa uma bebuka okwenzeka ecaleni, limi ndawonye, basola sengathi iyiqiniso."Esikukhalelayo ubulungiswa. Sesifisa ukuthi kungenelele noMkhwanazi (uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa eKZN, uLt-General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi) ngoba usizo asilutholanga emaphoyiseni ebesiwathembile,” usho kanje. Amaphoyisa athe ayiveli imininingwane eqondene nalolu daba ngokwenombolo yecala Isolezwe ebeliyinikwe umndeni.
IZINYANE leNkosi yaseMathulini, eMgababa, esanda kukhothama, lithi mabangadideki abantu bakulesi sizwe ngoba yinye inkosi futhi inkosi iyazalwa kayiqokwa ngabantu.UMntwana uMazwi Luthuli oyindodana yeNkosi esikhotheme, uPhathisizwe Luthuli, usho kanjena ngesikhathi kunohlelo lokuhlinzekwa kwabafundi bezikole zaseMgababa ngemifaniswano yesikole, obuqhubeka emagcekeni enkosi.Izinyane likugcizelelile ukuthi inkosi iyazalwa, hhayi le nto yabathile abakhonjwayo ukuze bangene ezikhundleni. Izinyane kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi yilona elasukunyiswa ngosuku lokutshalwa kwenkosi lethulwa njengozongena esikhundleni sikayise.''Mabangadideki abantu, yinye Inkosi yesizwe saseMathulini, ikhona yazalwa,'' usho kanjena ezisho yena.Izinyane likhuluma kanjena nje, kufanele kukhunjulwe ukuthi kuke kwanemibiko eveza ukuthi usha phansi umbango wesihlalo sobukhosi kulesi sizwe.Kuvela igama likaMnuz Msawakhe Luthuli ozichaza njengoyise wenkosi ekhotheme, owatshela Isolezwe ukuthi naye kumfanele ukuba sesihlalweni sokuhola isizwe.Khona lapho, kuvela negama likaMnuz Busani Luthuli owengamele isikhwana sesizwe saseMathulini futhi ongumfowabo wenkosi esanda kukhothama.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi inkosi yaguqa isigubhukane. Likhuluma izinyane, liveze ukuthi lizimisele ukuqhubeka nemisebenzi kayise emihle yokunakekela umphakathi abekade eyenza esadla anhlamvana.Yize izinyane lithe fahla ngodaba lombango wesihlalo sobukhosi kodwa lithe alithandi ukukhuluma ngalolu daba ngenxa yokuthi kusaziliwe. Lithe konke kuzocaca uma sekuphelile ukuzila.Mayelana nohlelo lokuhlinzekwa kwabafundi bezikole zakule ndawo ngemifaniswano, lithe yinto uyise abeyikhonzile kakhulu, lathi yingakho-ke nalo libone kukuhle ukuba likwenze lokhu uyise ayenentshisekelo yakho kakhulu.''Ubaba ubengumuntu obezifela kakhulu ngemfundo. Wayengenza noma yini uma nje kukhulunywa ngodaba lwemfundo. Yingakho nami ngibone kukuhle ukuthi ngingalenzi iphutha kodwa ngiqhubeke nalolu hlelo ngoba ngihlonipha ubaba ongizalayo," usho kanjena.Kuvelile lapha ukuthi lo mcimbi ukuze uphumelele izinyane liwenze ngokubambisana nabaxhasi abehlukene okuyibona abafake isandla ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ziyatholakala izinto ezidingwa ngabafundi.Zingaphezulu kuka-20 izikole zakule ndawo ezihlomule ngomfaniswano wesikole. Othishanhloko bezikole balushayele ihlombe lolu hlelo, bathi luklama indima enkulu ekulekeleleni abafundi abantulayo basezikoleni zaseMgababa. Isikole, uMnganiwakhe High, esike saba sematheni naso singezinye sezihlomulile.Ngaphambi kokuba aqale ukukhuluma, abantu ebebehambele umcimbi basukumile bathi "Bayede!''INduna yakule ndawo, uMnuz Lungani Makhathini, nayo ilimise ngesihloko elokuthi inkosi yakule ndawo yinye, esho lona kanye izinyane lenkosi.Kodwa-ke uMakhathini uthe ngenxa yokuthi bayahlonipha, bazolinda ukuzila kwezinsuku ezingu-90 ngaphambi kokuba konke kuhlale obala.Unxuse isizwe ukuba siqhubeke nokweseka izinyane njengoba besikade vele senza nakuyise esadla anhlamvana. Uthe abangabazi nje nakancane ukuthi uMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal, uzomemezela lona izinyane njengelifanele ukuhlala esihlalweni.
KUMISWE uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa othweswe amacala ayamene nethenda yezigidi zamarandi, uGeneral Fannie Masemola, kwabe sekuqokwa uLieutenant General Puleng Dimpane, ukuba abambe isikhundla.Ukumiswa kukaMasemola kumenyezelwe nguMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba izolo.UMasemola uthweswe amacala ayamenele nethenda ka-R360 million eyanikwa inkampani kasomabhizinisi obhekene noxhaxha lwamacala, uMnuz Vusimuzi "Cat" Matlala.UMasemola uvele kafushane eNkantolo yeMantshi ePitoli, ngoLwesibili, lapho ebebhekene khona necala lokwephula imigomo yokuphathwa kwemali yomphakathi, i-Public Finance Management Act.URamaphosa uthe banqume ukunika uMasemola ikhefu njengoba esabhekene nezinsolo.UMasemola uzobuyela enkantolo ngenyanga ezayo, lapho uzokube evele noMatlala namanye amaphoyisa angu-12 athweswe amacala athinta ithenda eyanikwa inkampani kaMatlala.URamaphosa uthe uyamethemba uLieutenant General Dimpane ukuthi uzowenza kahle umsebenzi.ULieutenant General Dimpane ubephethe ezeziMali emaphoyiseni.
ZITAKULWE yiqembu Inkatha Freedom Party (IFP) izelamani zakwaNzimande eSikhalambazo, eMandeni, ku-ward 15, ebezihlala endlini esesimweni esingagwinyisi amathe ngenxa yokuthi ibingaqediwe ukwakhiwa, ingenamawindi futhi ingenazo nezicabha.Lapha kukhulunywa ngoNksz Lindelwa Nzimande (50) ohamba ngesihlalo esinamasondo kanye nomfowabo uMnuz Mjabuliseni Nzimande (48) ohamba ngezinduku.Ngemuva kokuba loyo oyilungu lophiko lukazwelonke kwi-IFP futhi ogaqele esokuhola leli qembu eMandeni, uMnuz Lonhle Gumede, ezwile ngalokhu usukumele phezulu wayiqedela indlu wathenga amawindi nezicabha washiya negilosa.UGumede uhambele kulo muzi ephelezelwa ngamanye amalungu e-IFP. Uthe kuyinto eseqhulwini ngaso sonke isikhathi kubona beyiNkatha ukuqikinisekisa ukuthi bayanakekelwa abantu abaphila nokukhubazeka.''Ngesikhathi ngizwa ngalokhu ngibone kungcono ukuba ngingayizibi le nto kodwa ngisukume ngifake isandla. Ngiwumuntu okholelwayo kakhulu ekutheni kumele bathandwe futhi banakekelwe ngayo yonke indlela ikakhulu labo abaphila nokukhubazeka,''echaza.Uthe uyafisa ukuthi bathole ukusizakala nabanye abantu abaphila nokukhubazeka abasezingxenyeni ezehlukene zeKwaZulu-Natal kanjalo naseNingizimu Afrika jikelele.''Lena yinselelo kunoma ngubani ukuthi lapho ekhona abhukule kube khona akwenzayo ukulekelela abantu abaphila nokukhubazeka. Akukhathaleki ukuthi noma ngabe kuyinto encane kangakanani, inqobo nje uma kukhona abalekelelwa ngakho," echaza.Uthembise ukuthi basazoqhubeka nokufaka isandla uma nje kukhona abantu abadinga ukulekelelwa ikakhulukazi labo abaphila nokukhuzeka.UNksz Nzimande ubonge wanconcoza kubaholi ngokubakhumbula. Uthe ubengalindele ukuthi kukhona abantu abangaqhamuka benze okuthile ukuze kuqedelwe ukwakhiwa kwendlu yakhe nomfowabo.''Ngiyabonga kakhulu. Ngiswele wona amazwi okubonga. Inkulu kabi le nto eyenzekile kuleli khaya. Bengicabanga ngivele ngiphelelwe amagama ngingazi ukuthi yini esingayenza ukuze lendlu esihlala kuyone iqedelwe," echaza.Uthe bekungathi uyaphupha ngenkathi ebona abantu befika bephethe amawindi nezicabha nakho konke okudingekayo ukuze kuqedelwe indlu.Nomfowabo uhambe emazwini kadadewabo wathi bazizwa bejabule kakhulu ukuthola usizo olumqoka kangaka.''Siyabonga kakhulu ngalokhu okuhle kangaka. Kuyasijabulisa thina njengabantu abaphila nokukhubazeka ukubona ukuthi bakhona abantu abasithandayo futhi abazimisele ngokusilekelela ngezindlela ezahlukene," echaza.
ISILO samaZulu uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini, sigqugquzele abantu ikakhulu intsha ukuthi babhalisele ukuvota okhethweni oluzayo.IMbube ithe yeseka umsebenzi weKhomishini yoKhetho kuleli, esemkhankasweni wokukhuthaza abantu ukuthi babhalisele ukuvota okhethweni lohulumeni basekhaya. Sikusho lokhu emuva kokuhlangana nezikhulu zekhomishini, esigodlweni eMashobeni, oPhongolo ngoLwesibili.Okhulumela ihhovisi leSilo, uMntwana Thulani Zulu, uthe iMbube iweseka ngokugcwele umsebenzi wekhomishini njengoba kuza ukhetho. "IMbube igqugquzele abantu ikakhulu intsha ukuthi ibhalise ukuze ivote. Inxuse intsha ukuthi ikwenze lokhu ngokuthula," kusho uMntwana Thulani.Uthe izikhulu zekhomishini zisemkhankasweni wokuhambela izinhlaka zobuholi bomdabu njengoba kuzoba nokhetho."Ithimba labekhomishini lenabe ngezinhlelo zokhetho okubalwa namalungiselelo alo. Likhulume nangomkhankaso wokufundisa abantu ngokuvota." Uthe kubhungwe nangombiko wakamuva oveze ukuthi abantu baKwaZulu-Natal, bamanqika ukuthi bavote ngoba sebelahle ithemba kuhulumeni.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi lo mbiko waveza ukuthi abantu bakulesi sifundazwe sebelahle ithemba kakhulu uma kuqhathaniswa nezinye izifundazwe ngokuvota ngenxa yokuthi abasamethembi uhulumeni.UMntwana Thulani uthe bayakwamukela ukuthi ikhomishini iyabuhlonipha ubuholi bomdabu nokugqugquzela abantu basemakhaya ukuthi bavote. Izikhulu zekhomishini bezikulesi sifundazwe lonke leli sonto zizoxoxa nezinhlaka ezehlukene okubalwa noNdunankulu wesifundazwe, uMnuz Thami Ntuli. Kusasa kulindeleke lezi zikhulu zibe nesithangami nabezindaba ukuzochaza ngohambo lwazo kulesi sifundazwe. Kwenzeka lokhu nje, ikhomishini iyalele amaqembu ezepolitiki ukuthi asheshe alungise uhlu lwabantu azofolosa ngabo okhethweni oluzayo.Izikhulu zekhomishini zikhuluma ePhalamende, zithe amacala amaningi ayexazululwa okhethweni lukazwelonke nolwezifundazwe lwango-2024, ayemayelana nezikhalo ngabajutshwe amaqembu."Amaqembu kumele kuthi kushaya uJulayi 30, abe eseyiphothulile eyohlu lwabantu abazowamela. Aba maningi amacala okwadingeka siwaxazulule ayethinta abantu abazojutshwa amaqembu okhethweni lwango-2024," kusho uMamabolo izolo ngesikhathi bekhuluma ngamalungiselelo okhetho, ekomitini loMnyango wezaseKhaya ePhalamende. NgoJuni 20 no-21, 2026 kuzovulelwa abantu ukuthi babhalisele ukuvota. Mayelana nosuku lokhetho kusalindwe uNgqongqoshe wokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu kuleli, uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa, ukuthi amemezele usuku.UHlabisa kulindeleke ukuthi amemezele usuku lokhetho ngaphambi kokuphela kukaJuni. Ukhetho kulindeleke ukuthi lube ngoNovemba noma uJanuwari.
LIZOQALA ukuqulwa ekuqaleni kwenyanga ezayo elowesilisa waseMlaza, oneminyaka engu-28, okuthiwa waqotha amalungu omphakathi ayisishiyagalombili kuleli lokishi nyakenye. Lokhu kuvezwe yiJaji uJacqueline Henriques ngesikhathi ummangalelwa, uMnuz Sanele Dlamini evele phambi kweNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini ngoLwesithathu. Ummangalelwa usolwa ngesigameko okuthiwa senzeka endaweni yokucima ukoma ekwa-U, eMlaza ngoMeyi 16, 2025. Kuthiwa esigamekweni okusolakala ukuthi kwakungesokuziphindeselela ngokubulawa komfowabo, ummangalelwa waqotha amalungu omphakathi ayisishiyagalombili.Kuthiwa abafi kwaqinisekiswa ukuthi bangoMnuz Sbanisezwe Ngcobo, Lindani Ngcobo, Mduduzi Ntobela, Nkanyiso Khumalo, Vumakwenkosi Ndlovu, Sihle Shange, Nksz Thandiwe Madondo noNksz Mbalenhle Mjoko. Kuthiwa kulesi sigameko kwasinda abane kanti abasolwa babaleka endaweni yesehlo. Ummangalelwa osenkantolo kuphela osaboshiwe ngaso. Enkantolo kuvele ukuthi abafi babulawa nje, babekade bezijezisele ababebasola ngobugebengu. Kuthiwa bahlasela ummangalelwa nomfowabo, ababebasola ngokuthi sebewuqedile umphakathi, bewubamba inkunzi.Kuthiwa ummangalelwa, umfowabo ongasekho uMnuz Lungelo Dlamini nomngani wabo uMnuz Secunda Msomi bataxwa "wumphakathi owawusukhathele" ngoMeyi 16, 2025. Kuthiwa kulesi sigameko, uLungelo walimala kabi washona ngenxa yezingozi ayezithole ngalolo suku. Kuthiwa ngosuku olufanayo, uSanele, owayediniwe, wacela usizo kwabanye, ukuba bamlekelele aziphindiselele ngokubulawa komfowabo. Kuthiwa babe sebeya emijondolo kwa-U, lapho amalungu omphakathi ayebhiyozela khona "ukuphumelela ukufundisa lezi zelamani kanjalo nomngani wazo isifundo".Kuthiwa ummangalelwa, nayehamba nabo, bafika kule ndawo, bavulela ngenhlamvu, kwafa abayisishiyagalombili. Enkantolo kuvele ukuthi bafa ngenxa yokudutshuwa ezindaweni ezehlukene emzimbeni, okuthiwa abanye babedubuleke emakhanda, izifubeni kanjalo nakwesingenhla. Ummangalelwa uveze ukuthi uhlela ukubiza abakhe ofakazi abazomvikela uma sekuqulwa icala.
KUPHELILE ngabafundi bakaJesu baseDanango, KwaMaphumulo, igama labo elibe sematheni emasontweni edlule. Kungumlando manje ukuthi Isolezwe laba ngelokuqala ukubika kabanzi ngalolu daba.Laya khona lakhuluma nomsunguli webandla uMfu Vusumuzi Sibiya owageqa amagula ngohlobo lwempilo ehlukile athi iphilwa ngabafundi bakaJesu.Wasebenzisa amagama athi bonke abahlala kule ndawo yingoba badele konke okomhlaba. Phakathi kwezinto athi bazidelile amabhizinizisi, imali, yimisebenzi, yimindeni, isikole kanye nabayeka ukudla imishanguzo yokuthithibilasa igciwane lengculazi. NgoMsombuluko uvelelwe ngokukhulu uSibiya ngesikhathi ebizwa umkhandlu wenkosi yakwaQwabe omyalele ukuba abafundi bakaJesu baphume baphele endaweni. Ikhuluma lapha Inkosi uQwabe ilimise ngesihloko elokuthi uSibiya uphambene nenqubomgomo yesizwe."Mina bengingazi ukuthi kanti wena uhlala nabantu abaningi kangaka kwakho futhi obenzisa izinto ezinjena," isho kanjena.Inkosi ithe aqale ukuzwa ngalolu daba ngemuva kokuba kade lubhalwe kwiSolezwe. Kube sekuphuma isinqumo sokuthi makuphele ngabafundi bakaJesu engakapheli amahora angu-48.Lwagoba uphondo kuSibiya wavuma wathi kuzoba njalo. Izolo ekuseni abafundi bakaJesu bebematasa beqiqinga izimpahla zabo bebuyela emakhaya abo.Nokuba kunje uSibiya utshele Isolezwe ukuthi kakuphelile ngombuso kaNkulunkuku ngoba laba abahlukana nabo emhlabeni bayohlangana ezulwini isangasekho inkosi eyobaxosha.Phambilini uSibiya watshela Isolezwe ukuthi ngempela bashiye konke okomhlaba."Umhlaba sekumele wazi manje ukuthi kunesizwe esingcwele kodwa esisemhlabeni esidele konke. Bhala utshele abantu sesifikile isikhathi," washo kanjena.Kwakukhona abazigqaja ngokuthi bashiye ngisho ukuzibandakanya nocansi ngoba kuyisono.Kwaba khona nabaqinisekisayo ukuthi balaxaze imfundo sebesezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme ngoba beshiswe ivangeli likaSibiya lokudela konke.Nokho kuse ngokunye ngesikhathi izinhlaka ezahlukene zikahulumeni seziqala sezifika kule ndawo.Kuqale uMnyango wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi KwaZulu-Natal walanda izingane ezingafundi ezingu-19. Akuphelanga lapho lo Mnyango ubuyele sewuhamba noMphathiswa wawo uNkk Mbali Shinga ekhashwa uNkk Thoko Mkhwanazi-Xaluva (weKhomishini Yokugqugquzela Nokuvikela Imiphakathi Yamasiko, Ezenkolo, Nezilimi), owayevutha engabaselwe etshela uSibiya ukuthi le nto ayenzayo angeke iphethe kahle.Wamtshela ukuthi laba bantu abanqabela ukuba badle imishanguzo uzobangcwaba. Wamtshela nokuthi uma esebuya okwesibili kuyoba khona ukukhala nokugedla kwamazinyo.
UYATHUTHUMELA owesifazane wakwa-H, eMlaza, othi ubhacile njengoba esaba ukuthi umyeni wakhe kungenzeka aphinde amenze isilo sengubo njengoba ezame ukumdubula kodwa wamshweba waphinda wamgxokogxa ngesikele esithweni sakhe sangasese. UNksz Wendy Zondi (36) wakwa-H, eMlaza, uvele ahlengezele izinyembezi uma echaza ngokulimala kwakhe athi kwenzeke ezinyangeni ezedlule.Uthe umyeni wakhe, uMnuz Kagiso Ndimande (38) wafika endlini ntambama baba nokuhilizisana nakhona athi akaqondi ukuthi kahle hle kwakubangelwa yini, wathi umyeni wakhe wafika ekhaya "edle amponjwana" wakhala ngokuthi akakuthandi ukujwayelwa kabi umuntu omganile.UNksz Ndimande uthe kuthe uma embuza ukuthi kwenzekani kodwa engaphenduli, kunalokho ebelesela amazwi awodwa wokuthi akakuthandi ukujwayelwa kabi.Eqhuba, uthe umyeni wakhe ube eseqonda kuyena ehlezi kusofa wamqala ngempama, wathi esababaza lokho wamane wadonsa isibhamu sakhe wamshaya ngesidunu emhlane nasekhanda..Uthe waqhubeka wamshaya waze wadubula kodwa engamphenduli uma embuza ukuthi kwenzenjani futhi woneni ukuze axolise, wathi wayengezwa mshini, wamthatha wamyisa egumbini labo okuyilapho amkhumule khona ngezansi naye wase eyakhumula ibhulukwe.''Ngaleso sikhathi bengizitshela ukuthi uzothamba mhlawumbe usefuna senze inkonzo yasekameleni kanti angibuzanga, umuntu kukhulu afuna ukukwenza kimina,'' echaza.Uthe umyeni wakhe ube esemthatha emsondeza kahle wambeka echosheni lombhede samuntu abazokwenza inkonzo njengoba naye ekhumule ibhulukwe."Emqondweni wami bese ngizitshela ukuthi siya ocansini,'' echaza.Uthe umuzwe esememeza esethi ngeke aze alale naye yena ngoba uyamcika futhi unephunga elingelihle."Ngemuva kwalokho, wathatha isikele wangilimaza ngaphansi,'" echaza.Nakhona lapho, uthe waqhubeka embuza ukuthi wenzeni kepha impendulo engayitholi, kunalokho uthe umyeni wakhe wayephenduke isilwane ebona kahle nje ukuthi usho ukumudla eluhlaza futhi usho ukuqeda nje nya ngaye.Uthe kukhona lapho ayemshaya aze amhudule phansi endlini, walimala kabi emhlane nasezingalweni ngokunjalo. Uveze ukuthi wagcina ekwazile ukuphuma endlini abaleke ayofuna usizo.Njengamanje ubhacile ngoba ubona kahle ukuthi umyeni wakhe uma engahlangana naye angaqeda ngaye.''Ngenxa yalesi simo ngibone kungcono ukuba ngithuthe emzini wethu ngiye kwenye indawo ngoba ngisabela impilo yami," kusho yena.Uthe udaba ulubikile emaphoyiseni waboshwa umyeni wakhe wavela nasenkantolo kodwa kuyimanje ungaphandle ngebheyili.''Uyabona njengoba engaphandle ngebheyili ngisaba kakhulu ngoba angimazi ukuthi yini ayicabangayo ngami. Ukukhuluma iqiniso nje, ngizizwa ngingaphephile nje nhlobo,'' echaza.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant Paul Magwaza, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi kunowesilisa oboshwe ngamaphoyisa ngemuva kokuba ezame ukubulala owesifazane oneminyaka engu-36. Uthe lo wesifazane walimala kabi.''Lo wesifazane walimala, umsolwa yena uke wavela eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMlaza,'' usho kanjena.
ISOSHA elisolwa ngokudubula libulale umkalo, litshele iNkantolo yesiFunda sasePinetown, izolo ukuthi wazidubula yena, wafa. Lokhu kuza njengoba uMnuz Lwanda Mxolisi Zungu, ethula ubufakazi phambi kwenkantolo ngecala lokufa komkakhe, uNkk Tania Zungu.UNkk Zungu wadutshulwa wafa ekhaya labo elisePinetown, ngoJanuwari 3, 2024. UZungu utshele inkantolo ukuthi ngokusuku lwesigameko, umufi wazidubula ephindelela kwaze kwaba kasishiyagalombili. UZungu ubehlonywa imibuzo umshushisi woMbuso, uMnuz Rowan Souls. Ethula ubufakazi bakhe, uZungu uthe wezwa umkakhe ekhokha isibhamu sakhe, ngesikhathi ematasa ecinga amateki okojima. Uthe ngesikhathi esifanayo, umkakhe washo ngengila, ememeza unina, naye owayekhona endlini, ethi uZungu uyamhlasela. Ngokusho kukaZungu, wagxumela embhedeni ukuzivikela, eqinisekisa ukuthi umbhobho wesibhamu wawungabhekile ngakuye. Uthe umbango wesibhamu wasuka khona embhedeni, kwathi kuso leso sixakaxaka, isibhamu saqhuma. Ugcizelele eyokuthi akazange yena asicindezele lapho esidubula khona isibhamu kodwa wehluleka ukusho ukuthi ubani pho owadubula kasishiyagalombili. Izinhlamvu eziyisikhombisa zangena zonke entanyeni kamufi, kwathi eyesishiyagalombili, yangena esifubeni. "Uyavumelana nami ukuthi umkakho wayengeke azidubule?” kubuza uSouls.UZungu uphendule ngelithi isibhamu sadubula ngesikhathi sisezandleni zikamufi. "Isibhamu saqhuma ngesikhathi sisezandleni zakhe. Ngiyadideka. Ngizamile ukukuchaza ukuthi isibhamu saqhuma ngesikhathi kukhona umbango waso, saqhuma kaningi saze sayeka. Angizange kodwa ngithi wazidubula,” kusho uZungu. Imantshi, uMnuz Muntukayise Khumalo, ibuzisisile ukuthi kwenzeka kanjani ukuthi isibhamu siqhume ngaphandle kokuthi oyedwa wabo asiqhumise, uphendule ngelithi akazi ukuthi saqhuma kanjani, akwaziyo nje ukuthi sona saqhuma. Ugcine esephendula ngokuthi isibhamu sasingeke siqhume ukube babengalwi, besibanga. Emva kokucindezelwa ngemibuzo uSouls, ugcine esethi uye unkosikazi wakhe owacindezela isibhamu. "Engingakuvumi ukuthi wazibulala. Mhlawumbe wacindezela isibhamu ngephutha, hhayi ngoba nakhu ayezibulala,” kusho uZungu. USouls ube esekhumbuza uZungu ngobufakazi bukadokotela bokuthi umufi wayezophelelwa amandla esadubuleke kabili entanyeni, nokho uZungu ubuphikisile lobu bufakazi bukadokotela. Icala lizoqhubeka ngenyanga ezayo.
ISIKHULU esiphezulu seKhomishini yezoKhetho kuleli, i-Independent Electoral Commission (IEC), uMnuz Sy Mamabolo, siyalele amaqembu ezepolitiki ukuthi asheshe alungise uhlu lwabantu azofolosa ngabo okhethweni oluzayo.UMamabolo uthe amacala amaningi ababewaxazulula okhethweni lukazwelonke nolwezifundazwe lwango-2024, ayemayelana nezikhalo ngabajutshwe amaqembu."Amaqembu kumele kuthi kushaya uJulayi 30, abe eseyiphothulile eyohlu lwabantu abazowamela. Aba maningi amacala okwadingeka siwaxazulule ayethinta abantu abazojutshwa amaqembu okhethweni lwango-2024," kusho uMamabolo izolo ngesikhathi bekhuluma ngamalungiselelo okhetho, ekomitini loMnyango wezaseKhaya ePhalamende. UMamabolo uthe zizoba zimbili izimpelasonto zokubhalisela ukuvota ngaphambi kokhetho."Eyokuqala kwamenyezelwa ukuthi izoba ngoJuni 20 no-21. Eyesibili izoba ngasekuqaleni kuka-Agasti."Uthe balindele ukuthi lufakwe ngokusemthethweni emqulwini kahulumeni usuku lokhetho ngo-Agasti. Lokhu kuzokwenziwa nguNgqongqoshe wokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu kuleli, uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa. UHlabisa kulindeleke amemezele usuku lokhetho ngaphambi kokuphela kukaJuni. Ukhetho kulindeleke ukuthi lube ngoNovemba noma uJanuwari.UNksz Dawn Mbatha, isikhulu esibhekele imali kwikhomishini, uthe banesabelomali sika-R4.75 billion kulo nyakamali.Uthe bayaxoxa noMnyango kaMgcinimafa ngemali njengoba kubhekwe okhethweni. UMamabolo uthe baqinisa izinhlelo zabo ukuze kungabi nezikhalo ngemiphumela yokhetho. "Sizowamema namaqembu ezepolitiki ukuthi alethe abacwaningi abazobheka uhlelo lwemiphumela esilusebenzisayo ukuze kungabi nezikhalo. Kwaba nezikhalo okhethweni lwango-2024 ngezinkinga ezithinta ibhodi eliveza imiphumela yokhetho," usho kanje.Lezi zinselelo zakhalisa amaqembu amaningi. Kwakucima ibhodi isikhathi eside. Kwenzeka lokhu nje iMKP ifuna luhlehliswe ukhetho oluzayo, ikhala ngokuthi kumele lubanjwe uma sekuxazululwe isikhalo eyasifaka mayelana nemiphumela yokhetho lwango-2024.I-IEC yazichitha izikhalo zeMKP kanti leli cala elafakwa yileli qembu kulindeleke ukuthi liqulwe eNkantolo yezoKhetho ngenyanga ezayo. Umholi weMKP, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, uthe ukugijimela ukuba nolunye ukhetho ekubeni singakaphumi isinqumo ecaleni abalifakile kuzokwenza ukuthi abantu bangayithembi imiphumela yokhetho."Kufanele sibatshele ukuthi sifuna ukwazi ukuthi ashonaphi amavoti ethu antshontshwa okhethweni olwedlule. Asibatshele ukuthi asifuni ukuthi kube khona olunye ukhetho ngoba kunezinkinga abangakazixazululi," kusho uZuma.
LISAZOKUBA ukudla kwejele iphoyisa elisolwa ngokuba ubhululu wemigulukudu, uSergeant Fannie Nkosi, njengoba kuchithwe isicelo salo sebheyili.INkantolo yeMantshi i-Pretoria North ichithe isicelo sebheyili sikaNkosi izolo. UNkosi uboshelwe amacala okwephula imigomo yokugcinwa kwezibhamu, ukutholakala nesiqhumane nezinhlamvu nelokutholakala namadokodo amacala asavalwa.Imantshi uThandi Theledi ithe uNkosi uhlulekile ukuveza izizathu zokuthi kungani kufanele adedelwe ngebheyili.UMbuso ubungafuni ukuthi uNkosi anikwe ibheyili usabela ukuthi angase abalekele icala, njengoba ububeke nokuthi ubona uNkosi ephephile uma esejele ukunokuba anikwe ibheyili ngenxa yokuthi uzwana nemigulukudu engase ifune ukumenzakalisa uma enikwa ibheyili.Ubusabela nokuthi ubengazama ukuphazamisa uphenyo ngenxa yokuthi uyiphoyisa.UNkosi uzogcinwa ejele njengoba amaphoyisa eqhubeka nophenyo lwawo.Usolwa ngokusondelana nosomabhizinisi ababhekene noxhaxha lwamacala, uMnuz Vusimuzi "Cat" Matlala noKatiso "KT" Molefe.Ngesikhathi efakaza phambi kweKhomishini eholwa yiJaji Mbuyiseli Madlanga, kwavela ukuthi uNkosi kukhona imali ayeyithola kulabo somabhizinisi abasobishini.Kuphinde kuvele ukuthi wayesondelene nosomatekisi owayesatshiswa okwenyoka, uMnuz Jotham "Mswazi" Msibi nePhini likaKhomishana wamaPhoyisa elimisiwe, uLieutenant General Shadrack Sibiya.UNkosi waboshwa emva kokugasela kwamaphoyisa emzini wakhe kulandela ukuvela kwakhe phambi kweKhomishini kaMadlanga.UNkosi usamisiwe emsebenzini njengoba ebhekene nenqwaba yezinsolo.
BAKHATHAZEKILE aboMnyango wezaseKhaya, abachithe njengamampunge imibiko esabalele yokuthi abaseLesotho akusadingeki ukuthi baveze ama-passports uma bengena emingceleni yakuleli. UMnyango uthe asikho isivumelwano esifuze lesi phakathi kwelakuleli nelaseLesotho."AbaseLesotho basazowaveza ama-passports uma bengena kuleli. Ngeke bakwazi ukusebenzisa omazisi babo kuphela uma beza kuleli," kusho uMnyango.UMnyango uveze ukuthi ukungena kuleli ngaphandle kwe-passports, kuzobe kuwukuphula imithetho yezwe. "ONgqongqoshe beminyango yezaseKhaya eLesotho nakuleli, bahlangana eKapa, ngo-Ephreli 17, 2026, ukuze kuxoxwe ngeziphakamiso ezithinta imingcele. Uma kumele kwenziwe izinguquko kwezemingcele, kudingeka ukuthi kuchitshiyelwe umthetho okufaka nePhalamende. Akukho hlelo oluthinta lokhu oluqhubekayo." UMnyango uthe kusamile ukuthi abantu bakuleli uma beya eLesotho kudingeka baveze ama-passports kanti nakanjalo nabaseLesotho kumele benze okufanayo uma beza kuleli.
KUMINZE isangoma, okuthiwa besiyohlambulula abantu edamini laseNanda, endaweni yaseSikebheni, eMzinyathi, ngoMsombuluko. Ngokusho komthombo, umufi ongowesifazane, ubehamba nabanye abantu abambalwa beyogezwa."Uminze engakabagezi. Bekusewuye kuphela obesangene emanzini,” kusho umthombo. Uveze ukuthi isigameko senzeke kusakhanya, nokho umufi abakwazanga ukumhlenga ebebekhona."Asazi ukuthi bebesukaphi, kodwa akubona abendawo,” kusho umthombo.Ikhansela lendawo, uMnuz Falakhe Gcabashe, lithintwa yiSolezwe, lithe lisanda kuzwa ngodaba, lathi alikakabi nolwazi olugcwele. "Engikutholile wukuthi umufi nalabo abehamba nabo ababona abantu bendawo. Asikabi nalo ulwazi lokuthi bebesuka kuphi nendawo. Okusho ukuthi bebezokwenza lokho ebebezokwenza bese behamba,” kusho uGcabashe. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uSergeant Thenjiswa Ngcobo, uthe amaphoyisa aseNanda avule idokodo lokufa komuntu ukuze liphenywe kulandela ukuminza komuntu edamini laseNanda ngoMsombuluko. "Kusolwa ukuthi owesifazane ubegeza abantu edamini eliseSikebheni ngesikhathi eminza,” kusho uSgt Ngcobo.
IPHINDE yagubuzelwa yifu elimnyama iNdlunkulu kaZulu kulandela ukuguqa kukaMntwana Gcinabani Thembisile "Sister Eunice" Zulu (78), waseZibindini.UMntwana uGcinabani ushone ngoMgqibelo, nokuwusuku obekufihlwa ngalo omunye uMntwana waseNdlunkulu kaZulu, uGibizizwe Zulu (67), wasoSuthu.Okhulumela iSilo, uMntwana uThulani kaGqikazi Zulu, uzwakalise ukukhathazeka ngokuguqa ngokulandelana kwabantwana baseNdlunkulu."Nina beSilo senginamahloni ukuthi ngilokhu ngibika ngezindaba ezibuhlungu nezingehli kahle. INdlunkulu kaZulu isiphinde yehlelwa yifu elimnyama. Egameni leSilo samabandla onke, nasegameni leNdlunkulu nesizwe sonke sithi akwehlanga olungehliyo, nilale ngenxeba nina beSilo."UMntwana uThulani uchaze uMntwana uGcinabani njengomuntu obenenhliziyo emnene futhi ezinikele okholweni.UMntwana uThulani uthe uMntwana uzofihlwa ngoMgqibelo."Umngcwabo uzokuba seKuthokozeni kweZibindi, eShoba, eFilidi. Sengathi umoya wakhe ungalala ngokuthula."UMntwana uGibizizwe yena ufihlwe ngoMgqibelo, oSuthu.UMntwana uGibizizwe ubeseduze kweSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini, futhi uyena owayekhongela iMbube ekhweni layo kwaMyeni.UMntwana uThulani uthe ukushona kwabaNtwana ikakhulukazi labo abangoyise beNgonyama, kuphazamisa umsebenzi weMbube. "Siyazi ukuthi abaNtwana njengoba bengoyise beNgonyama yibona ethembele kubo ukuthi njengoba ikhona ihlezi esihlalweni, mayibheka ngapha nangapha ibona ukuthi oyise bakhona, okwenza ukuthi izinze. Kodwa lokhu kufana nokuhlwithwa amaphiko ayo okundiza."Baningi abanye abaNtwana abayizinsika eNdlunkulu kaZulu abaguqe kule minyaka edlule.Phakathi kwabaguqe ngonyaka odlule kubalwa uMntwana uHenrietta Zulu kanye noNdlunkulu Thoko Mantombela Zulu owayegane owayeyibamba bukhosi, uMntwana uMcwayizeni Zulu.
UKHOMISHANA wamaPhoyisa kuZwelonke, uGeneral Fannie Masemola, uthi umsulwa ezinsolweni abekwa zona.UMasemola uthe akukho okuphambene nomthetho akwenza ngesikhathi kukhishwa ithenda yezigidi zamaRandi eyanikwa inkampani kasomabhizinisi obhekene noxhaxha lwamacala, uMnuz Vusumuzi 'Cat' Matlala.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi evele eNkantolo yeMantshi ePitoli, izolo.UMasemola ubekwe icala lokuphula imigomo yokusetshenziswa kwemali yomphakathi iPublic Finance Management Act.Inkampani kaMatlala yanikezwa ithenda kaR360 million, kodwa yabuye yahoxiswa ithenda emva kwezinsolo zokungalandelwa kwemigomo.UMasemola uthe akalazi icala abekwa lona."Ngiyazi ukuthi mina ngimsulwa. Akukho okuphambene nomthetho engikwenzile. Ngizodedela inkantolo yenze umsebenzi wayo. Kufanele engabe ngijaha izigebengu kodwa ngilapha namhlanje ngibekwe amacala okuphula imigomo yokusetshenziswa kwemali."Akucaci ngekusasa likaMasemola emaphoyiseni njengoba kukhona abafuna ukuthi amiswe emsebenzini bese kuqala uphenyo ngokuthi kufanele yini aqhubeke nokuphatha isikhundla.UMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, waveza ukuthi uzonquma maduze ngodaba lukaMasemola.UMasemola utshele abezindaba ukuthi sebeke baluxoxa lolu daba noRamaphosa."Ngeke ngihambe nginekela izwe izinto engizixoxa nomengameli. Ngizolinda isiphetho sezingxoxo."UMasemola unxuse amaphoyisa ukuthi aqhubeke nomsebenzi wawo, angaphazanyiswa wukuboshwa kwakhe."Amaphoyisa awaqhubeke enze umsebenzi wawo. Awaqhubeke asebenza ngokuzikhandla. Kungenzeka ukuthi ngiboshiwe njengamanje, kodwa bona kufanele baqhubeke nomsebenzi wabo. Ziningi izinto esizitholayo njengoba siphenya amacala ahleliwe. Sisezithendeni zabantu abathinteka ebugebengwini. Sesiyazi ukuthi obani abenza ubugebengu obuhleliwe."Icala elibhekene noMasemola lihlehliselwe uMeyi 13.Icala likaMasemola lihlanganiswe nelinye elibhekene namaphoyisa athwese amacala athinta ithenda efanayo.UMasemola uzovela nalamaphoyisa uma esebuyela enkantolo.Amaphoyisa angu-12, asolwa ngokuhlanganyela kuleli cala, abhekene namacala ahlanganisa ukukhwabanisa, ukushushumbisa imali nokuphula imithetho yemali.Amaphoyisa phambilini anikezwa ibheyili ephakathi kuka-R40 000 kuya ku-R80 000 ngokwahlukana.UMatlala naye uthweswe icala elithinta ithenda, uzovela nezikhulu zamaphoyisa uma icala selibuyela enkantolo.
UKHIHLE isililo eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini, owesilisa obhekene necala lokugwaza abulale ingoduso yakhe, esigamekweni esenzeka ngo-Okthoba 20, 2024, eMorningside, eThekwini.UMnuz Mhleli Ndaba (33) ubhekene necala lokubulala ingoduso yakhe, uNksz Dima Phohlo (31). Lesi sehlakalo kwavela ukuthi senzeka ngemuva kwengxabano eyayishubile eyaqubuka phakathi kwabo. UNdaba ungaphandle ngebheyili okuyinto eyabashiya bemangele abomndeni kamufi, besola inkantolo ngobudedengu bebuza ukuthi udedelwa kanjani umuntu obulele?Izolo, bekungokokuqala ukuba uNdaba angene ebhokisini, ethule obakhe ubufakazi mayelana naleli cala. Uqale wafungiswa ukuthi konke azokusho kuliqiniso elimsulwa. Uveze ukuthi umufi babenezingane ezimbili naye. Zithe zisuka nje, uNdaba watshela inkantolo ukuthi walimala ekhanda esigamekweni esenzeka esahlala eMhlanga, ngo-2021. Kuleso sigameko, uthe wahilizisana kabi nonogada owayekade ebanqabela ukuba bangene ngaphakathi endlini benomufi kanti unogada uzogcina ngokumphusha kabi, okwenza wawela endaweni embi walimala, ikhanda laklayeka, esho ekhomba lapho alimala khona.Ngenxa yalokho uthe unenkinga yokuthi izinto eziningi uyazikhohlwa, watshela inkantolo ukuthi ingalindeli ukuthi konke uzokukhumbula okwenzeka ngelanga lesigameko sokufa kwengoduso yakhe.Sekubuyelwa esigamekweni esenzeka kufa ingoduso, uthe kuncane kakhulu akukhumbulayo ngenxa yakho belu njalo ukuthi unenkinga yokuthi walimala kabi ekhanda, izinto eziningi uyazikhohlwa. Ebuzwa ummeli wakhe ukuthi yini ayikhumbulayo ngaleli langa, uthe: "Ukuthi kwakumele ngihambe ngiyohlangana nomngani wami ngenxa yokuthi ngangifelwe yimoto. Inkinga kwaba ukuthi umufi wayengayizwa kahle indaba yokuhamba kwami. Ngiyakhumbula kancane ukuthi ngesikhathi ngiphuma ngiya esangweni, wangilandela."Ebuzwa ummeli wakhe ukuthi ngabe uyakhumbula yini egwaza kabuhlungu ingoduso yakhe emqaleni ngesikhathi bexabana emgwaqweni njengoba kuvela kwi-video, nakhona lapho uthe lutho akasakhumbuli nje nhlobo.''Ngabe ngiqamba amanga, angikhumbuli nje nhlobo ngigwaza uDimpho,'' uphendule kanje waqala wadinda isililo enkantolo. Uqhubekile ummeli wakhe wambuza ukuthi uyakhumbula yini eseboshwa?''Ngikhumbula kancane kufika amaphoyisa kimina engibuza ukuthi ngiyabona yini ukuthi sengenzeni? Ngiyakhumbula sengisesiteshini samaphoyisa, kulokhu kufika abantu engibaziyo bengitshela ukuthi ngilapha nje yingoba ngilimaze kabi uDimpho. Akekho kodwa owayefuna ukungitshela ukuthi ulimale kangakanani njengoba ngangibabuza." Uthe umphenyi uyena owamtshela ukuthi uDimpho akasekho emhlabeni. Yilapho athe waqala khona ukwazi ukuthi kanti usebulele umuntu amthanda kangaka empilweni yakhe.Ummeli wakhe umbuzile ukuthi wake waba yini nezinhloso zokuthi ambulele uDimpho ngelinye ilanga?''Umbuzo onjani loyo, ngingambulala kanjani umuntu engimthandayo. Angiphathi ngalesiya sikhathi, kuningi esasikuhlela sobabili nomufi njengoba wayesenza unyaka wesithathu enyuvesi. Okunye kwakho kwakungukuthi sasifuna ukuyothenga umuzi wethu ngoba sasesikhathele ukukhokha irenti." Ebuzwa ukuthi babunjani ubudlelwane bakhe nomufi ngesikhathi sesigameko, uphendule ngokukhulu ukuzethemba, wathi babuhle kakhulu.Esephothula ubufakazi bakhe ummeli wakhe, umbuzile ukuthi kukhona yini angathanda ukukusho ngalolu daba. Uphendule wathi: "Angikaze ngibe nenhloso yokubulala uDimpho ngenxa yokuthi ngenza isinqumo sokuthi umndeni wami nezingane zami, ngiyobaphatha kahle bonke. Le nto yokuhlukumeza umuntu ayikho emizweni yami yegazi."Isolezwe lalikhona ngosuku inkantolo eyadlala ngayo i-video yelanga lesigameko. Kuyona kubonakala uNdaba ephuma endlini elandelana nomufi. Emgwaqweni babonakala beba nokuhilizisana, kuba nesikhathi lapho uNdaba ebonakala khona egwaza umufi ephindelela. Ngaphambi kokuba amgwaze, kubonakala izingane zabo zingena phakathi kwabo.Ngesikhathi kuqhubeka ukuhilizasana phakathi kwabo, kubonakala omunye ozama ukulamula kodwa uNdaba usho ukumqeda, bese eyabaleka naye. Kuthi esedindilizile umufi, enye ingane yakhe ibonakala izama ukumvusa.UNdaba ubekade ephelezelwa ngabomndeni wakhe abekade bezomeseka. Ubeswenke econsa efake isudi. Bebekhona nabomndeni kamufi. Icala liyaqhubeka.
UMHOLI weMKP, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, ufuna kuhlehliswe ukhetho lohulumeni basekhaya oluzayo.UZuma ufuna ukhetho okufanele lube phakathi kukaNovemba noJanuwari, lubanjwe uma sekuxazululwe isikhalo esafakwa yiMKP mayelana nemiphumela yokhetho lukazwelonke nezifundazwe lwango-2024.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma namalungu eMKP ngeSonto ebusuku emhlanganweni obuhanjelwe yizinhlaka zeqembu esifundeni iTheku. IMKP yaphonsela inselelo imiphumela yokhetho lwango-2024, lapho yaba yiqembu lesithathu ngobukhulu ePhalamende. Inhlangano eyengamele ukhetho, i-Independent Electoral Commission (IEC), yazichitha izikhalo zeMKP. Icala elafakwa iMKP kulindeleke ukuthi liqulwe eNkantolo yezoKhetho ngenyanga ezayo.UZuma uthe ukugijimela ukuba nolunye ukhetho ekubeni singakaphumi isinqumo ecaleni abalifakile kuzokwenza ukuthi abantu bangayithembi imiphumela yokhetho. Unxuse amalungu eqembu ukuba asho ngazwi linye ukuthi aluhlehliswe ukhetho oluzayo."Kufanele sibatshele ukuthi sifuna ukwazi ukuthi ashonaphi amavoti ethu antshontshwa okhethweni olwedlule. Asibatshele ukuthi asifuni ukuthi kube khona olunye ukhetho ngoba kunezinkinga abangakazixazululi." Umhlangano wangeSonto ububizelwe ukuzolungiselela ukhetho. UZuma unxuse amalungu eqembu ukuba asebenze ngokuzikhandla uma sekuqale umkhankaso wokhetho. Uthe bafuna ukunqoba ngamalengiso kuMasipala waseThekwini.Ngokwemiphumela yokhetho lwango-2024, iMKP iyona eyathola amavoti amaningi eThekwini, okusho ukuthi ngabe yilona leli qembu eliphethe umkhandlu ukuba kwakuvotelwa omasipala.IMKP ibinemihlangano yokulungiselela ukhetho kuzo zonke izifunda zaKwaZulu-Natal. Imihlangano ibihanjelwe abaholi abaphezulu kwiMKP okubalwa kubo unobhala jikelele, uMnuz Sibonelo Nomvalo, nephini lomholi weqembu, uDkt John Hlophe.Kusuke umsindo kweminye imihlangano okubalwa obusesifundeni iMoses Mabhida kanye nasesifundeni Ilembe. Ezinkundleni zokuxhumana kusabalale ama-video amalungu eMKP kulezi zifunda exabana wodwa.
USHAYA amakhala umndeni wowesifazane okuthiwa ugwazwe wabulawa ngesihluku kanye nendodana yakhe eNgwelezane, eMpangeni.Kulesi sigameko esenzeke ngoLwesine olwedlule, kushone uNkk Thuli Khumalo (56) nengane yakhe yomfana uMbuso Khumalo (13). Kuthiwa izidumbu zabo zitholwe ekhaya, zinamanxeba okugwazwa emzimbeni. Ngokusho kwesihlobo esicele ukungadalulwa, umndeni kawuyizwa kahle eyokubulawa kwabo "yisigebengu”.Sitshele Isolezwe ukuthi esinye isihlobo esisondelene nomufi, sitshele umndeni ukuthi isigameko senzeke sikhona naso ekhaya. Kuthiwa sithe sona besicashile ngesikhathi isigebengu sigwaza sibulala owesifazane nendodana yakhe. "Okudidayo wukuthi esitatimendeni asibhalise emaphoyiseni, uguqukile kulokhu akusho emndenini, wathi ufike isigameko sesenzekile kodwa umbonile umsolwa kancane,” kusho isihlobo.Elanda ngalokhu okuthiwa isihlobo sikutshele amaphoyisa, umthombo uthe siwatshele ukuthi sifike ekhaya sibuya emsebenzini, saqaphela ukuthi akukhanyisiwe endlini kodwa kuvuliwe."Uveze ukuthi uthe esengaphakathi wabona isithunzi sithi shazi, wazitshela ukuthi uMbuso. Uthe uhambe wayokhanyisa ngasekhishini, lapho abone khona ukuthi akuyena uMbuso kodwa isigebengu esiphethe ijazi lakhe ne-laptop, maqede, saphuma sabaleka,” kusho umthombo.Uqhube wathi isihlobo sitshele amaphoyisa ukuthi siphumile sasijaha isigebengu, esivele seqa uthango, sawa, sashiya phansi i-laptop nejazi. "Uthe ngesikhathi esebuyela endlini, ilapho abone khona ukuthi uMbuso ulimele, wase etshela omakhelwane,” kusho umthombo.Umthombo uthe ngesikhathi kufika umndeni nomakhelwane endaweni yesigameko, lesi sihlobo besingakayikhulumi ekalona wesifazane."Kubuze umndeni ukuthi uphi uThuli, kwayima kuqala ecingwa. Yiso sihlobo esijike samthola kuqala phansi kombhede, naye egwaziwe,” umthombo usho kanje.Uthe awekho amaconsi egazi abeconse aze ayofika ngaphansi kombhede. Uthe basola sona isihlobo lesi ngokufa kwalaba ababili ngenxa yokushintshashintsha inkulumo uma sichaza okwenzekile. Umthombo uveze ukuthi basola ukuthi lesi sihlobo sifike sagwaza lona wesifazane, sase sifihla isidumbu sakhe ngaphansi kombhede."Sisola ukuthi uMbuso yena ubulawelwe ukuthi ubone okuthile, naye wasale esebulawa,” sisho kanje.Umthombo uqhube wathi okunye okwenza bashaye amakhala ukuthi bathole ngasekupheleni konyaka odlule, ukuthi lona wesifazane ubehlukunyezwa kuleli khaya."Yena uMbuso uke wagijima waya emzini wesinye isihlobo, eyocela ukuthi sizolamulela unina ngoba uyashawa. Nebala waficwa eshaywa ngempela,” kusho umthombo. Uthe yena futhi uMbuso ubethi uma edlala nezinye izingane, akhiphe amazwi athi ziyajabula zona ngoba abazo omama abashaywa muntu. "Siwatshelile amaphoyisa konke lokhu nokuthi sifuna uphenyo lwawo luqale khona egcekeni ngoba aseneme ngezitatimende ezingafani,” kusho umthombo.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uLt Col Paul Magwaza, uthe amaphoyisa aseMpangeni aphenya amacala amabili okubulala kanjalo nelokugqekeza kulandela isigameko esenzeke eNgwelezane ngoLwesine. "Kubikwa ukuthi ubaba uthole isidumbu sendodana yakhe nesomkakhe emagumbini ahlukene, benamanxeba okugwazwa emzimbeni. Utshele amaphoyisa ukuthi ngesikhathi engena endlini, owesilisa ongaziwa uphume eyinhlamvu ephethe ubhakha, okuthe uma ejomba uthango, i-laptop yaqathaka," kusho uMagwaza. Uthe akukaboshwa muntu ngesigameko.
SILULELWE inyanga ezayo esokuphawula ngemigomo ethinta isifundo somlando, iHistory ezikoleni zakuleli. Bekumele kuvalwe ngeSonto ukuphawula ngemigomo ethinta lesi sifundo kodwa uNgqongqoshe weMfundo eyisiSekelo, uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, walula isikhathi.Umnyango ufuna abantu baphawule ngemigomo kulesi sifundo, kusuka kuGrade 4 kuya kuGrade 12.Okhulumela umnyango, uMnuz Terence Khala, uthe silulwe ngezinsuku ezingu-30, isikhathi sokuthi umphakathi uphawule ngemigomo. "Manje sekuzovalwa ngoMeyi 19, 2026 ukwamukela ukuphawula komphakathi ngemigomo. Lokhu sikwenze emuva kokuba bebebaningi, abasafuna ithuba lokuphawula," usho kanje.Ugqugquzele abasafuna ukuphawula ukuthi bakwenze lokhu ngokushesha."Siwumnyango sifuna ukuthi lesi sifundo sifundise abafundi ukucabanga ngendlela ehlukile, baphinde bafundiswe ngomlando wezwe." Inyunyana yothisha iSadtu, ifuna ukuthi kugxilwe ekufundiseni ngomlando wase-Afrika. Le nyunyana isamile ekutheni ifuna lesi sifundo sibe yimpoqo kubona bonke abafundi.UNobhala Jikelele weSadtu, uDkt Mugwena Maluleke, uthe bebelokhu besho ukuthi bafuna kugxilwe ekufundiseni ngomlando othinta izwekazi i-Afrika, hhayi amazwe aphesheya."Sifuna kugxilwe ekufundiseni ngezinto ezithinta i-Afrika, kungagxilwa kakhulu ezintweni ezithinta amazwe ase-Europe. Sethemba ukuthi le migomo ekhishelwe umphakathi, nathi esizophawula ngayo nge-History, izobalula eyokuthi sibe yimpoqo lesi sifundo." Uthe uma isifundo siyimpoqo, sizokwenza ukuthi abafundi bazi lapho besuka khona nokuthi kwenzekani ezweni labo.Abafuna ukuphawula bangabhalela ku: Director-General, baqondise ku: Florence Modipa, oyiChief Education Specialist: Curriculum Policy, Department of Basic Education, 222 Struben Street, Pretoria, 0001; noma bathumele kwi:Department of Basic Education, Private Bag X895, Pretoria, 0001; noma bathumele nge-email ku:[email protected].
UNIKWE isigwebo seminyaka engu-46 ebhadla ejele, owesilisa olahlwe yicala lokudlwengula nokubulala owesifazane esigamekweni esenzeka ngoDisemba 2023.UNkosinathi Ndala (41), waboshwa nabangani bakhe abathathu okunguSphamandla Mkhulise (24), Thulani Bhengu (24) kanye noTalent Mbongeni Ntanzi (21).Babesolwa ngokubulala uNksz Nonhlakanipho Buthelezi (23), okuthiwa bamthatha ephuma endaweni yokuzijuxuza eseChesterville, iClasic Lounge. Kuthiwa bacela ukumgibelisa emotweni ukuze bamyise ekhaya yena nomngani wakhe. Imoto eyayinalaba kuthiwa yathubeleza njalo yangabagodukisa umufi nomngani wakhe, yaze yama kuN2 emgwaqweni obheke KwaDukuza, okuyilapho umufi nomngani wakhe kuthiwa bashaywa base beyadlwengulwa.Umngani kamufi waphulukundlela wabaleka, wasinda kanjalo. Umufi owayehlala eManzimtoti, kuthiwa kwathi sebeqede ukumdlwengulwa, bathatha isidumbu sakhe basiphonsa ngaphansi kwebhuloho. Waze watholakala ngakusasa ngemuva kokuba umngani wakhe ekhombise amaphoyisa indawo yesigameko. Ngaphambilini bake bafaka isicelo sebheyili kodwa inkantolo yabachitha.Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi laba abanye abasolwa, balivuma icala bachaza konke okwenzeka, inkantolo yanquma ukubagixabeza ngezigwebo zeminyaka emithathu ngoba balivuma base benikeza inkantolo ubufakazi ngakho konke okwenzeka. Nakuba kunjalo kodwa uNdala ubesamile ekuphikeni icala, ethi ubhecwa ngobende inyama engazange ayithi mbibi. Ngesonto eledlule inhlanzi ishelwe amanzi, walivuma icala.NgoLwesihlanu inkantolo ibe isimgixabeza ngesigwebo seminyaka engu-46 ebhadla ejele. Ubebhekene necala lokudlwengula, elokubulala kanjalo nelokuphazamisa ukusebenza kwengalo yomthetho. Phambilini kwahlaluka ukuthi unina kamufi, uNkk Nomusa Xulu, isimo sakhe sibi futhi asikaze siphinde sibuyele esimeni esikahle selokhu kwenzeka lesi sigameko.Isihlobo esikhulume neSolezwe, uMnuz Philani Nzuza, sithe bajabule ekugcineni ukuthi ubulungiswa sebuze benzeka, bajeza bonke ababa neqhaza ekubulaweni kukaNonhlakanipho. Uncome kakhulu inkantolo ngokwenza konke okusemandleni, iqinisekisa ukuthi leli cala liphothulwa ngendlela efanele.''Sijabule kakhulu ngokuthi ekugcineni bonke ababandakanyekayo kuleli cala bajezile. Lokhu kusho lukhulu kithina sonke singumndeni. Noma engeke esabuyela emhlabeni uNonhlakanipho kodwa okungenani siyazi ukuthi abambulele bajezile kunokuthi kukhulunywe indaba yokuthi bazikhululekele nje ababoshiwe,'' usho kanje.

AZONIKWA umnqamulajuqu wezinsuku eziyishumi, amalungu e-ANC anobulungu be-SACP ukuba acacise ukuthi azokhankasela liphi iqembu okhethweni lohulumeni basekhaya oluzayo njengoba womabili la madlelandawonye ezolungenela ukhetho.Unobhala jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, uthe azozifaka obishini amalungu azokhetha ukungayiphenduli incwadi yakhe. Uma kukhona abazokhetha ukungayiphenduli incwadi, baqoke ukukhankasela iSACP, bazoba nenkinga. Imigomo ye-ANC icacile ukuthi awukwazi ukukhankasela iqembu elibanga ne-ANC okhethweni." Kunenqwaba yabaholi be-SACP abanezikhundla kuhulumeni okubalwa kubo uNgqongqoshe wezeSayensi nezobuChwepheshe, uDkt Blade Nzimande, uNgqongqoshe weMfundo ePhakeme, uMnuz Buti Manamela, noNdunankulu waseLimpopo, uDkt Phophi Ramathuba.UMbalula uthe ngeke amalungu e-ANC aphoqwe ukuthi asule ekubeni amalungu eSACP."Akukhona ukuthi silwa ne-SACP, into esiyenzayo wukuvikela i-ANC. Asinankinga nabantu abanobulungu be-SACP kodwa awukwazi ukukhankasela lezi zinhlangano zombili. Kufanele ukhethe iqembu elilodwa ozolikhankasela. Abanye bavele sebekhethile. Ngeke baxoshwe abantu abangamalungu e-SACP." UMbalula uthe abanalo itwetwe lokuthi ukungenela kweSACP ukhetho kungase kwenze ukuthi i-ANC ingenzi kahle okhethweni. Sizohlangana nabo okhethweni."UMbalula uthe sebeluqalile uhlelo lokuqoka abazomela i-ANC okhethweni oluzayo. "Amakhansela awenza kahle umsebenzi wawo sinethemba lokuthi azophinde akhethwe. ZIFUNGE zagomela ukuthi zizoqhubeka nokuwuvala ngamathayi avuthayo umgwaqo uR66, eShowe, izakhamuzi ezingenawo amanzi eZiqwaqweni, eMlalazi.Lezi zakhamuzi esezinengekile zitshele Isolezwe ukuthi sekuphele izinyanga ezimbili zingenawo amanzi.Omunye wazo, uMnuz Ntethelelo Mpungose, uthe okubacasula kakhulu wukuthi izakhamuzi zaku-ward 9, okuyi-ward engumakhelwane wabo, zona zinawo amanzi. "Sizizwa sideleleka siyizakhamuzi zaku-ward 10. Asiqondi ukuthi kwenzeka kanjani ukuthi ku-ward 9 abekhona amanzi, kuthi kweyethu, kungaphumi ngisho iconsi kompompi,” kusho uMpungose.Uthe bezwe ngandlebenye ukuthi kukhona abasebenzi bakaMasipala wesiFunda, iKing Cetshwayo, abathengwa yiqembu elithile lepolitiki ukuthi bavale amanzi ku-ward 9."Asazi ukuthi lezi zinsolo ziyiqiniso kangakanani kodwa zisicabangisa okuningi ngoba ngempela asinikwa thina amanzi,” usho kanje. Uthe sebeze baqashe izimoto ezibabiza u-R200 ukuyobakhelela amanzi ku-ward 9. Uthe okubuhlungu wukuthi iningi alisebenzi, alinayo le mali."Kudingeka ukuthi ukhiphe okungenani o-R200 ababili ngesonto ukuze uthole amanzi anele. Asinayo le mali. Eminye imizi iphethwe yizaguga. Ziphoqeleka ukuthi zihlephule empeshenini yazo ukuze zithole amanzi,” kusho uMpungose.Uthe ezinye izaguga zisuke zingenayo le mali, zize zingene ezibophezelweni nabezimoto eziqashwayo ukuthi abahambe bayozikhelela amanzi, zizokhokha uma sezihole impesheni. Uveze ukuthi okunye okubaphatha kabi wukuthi akhona amaloli athunyelwayo ukuthi abahlinzeke ngamanzi kodwa abashayeli bawo, bawadayisela imindeni enemali."Amaloli afika ebusuku azokwethela abanamathangi, abawakhokhela u-R500 amanzi. Abangenamali, basala kanjalo,” kusho uMpungose, othe nalokhu bafuna kungenelelwe kukho.Esinye isakhamuzi, uMnuz Sibusiso Mkhize, sithe, bazoqhubeka nokubhikisha kuze kuphume amanzi kompompi babo. "Sikhathele wukuxhashazwa. Balokhu bebika imbiba nebuzi, thina esikufunayo amanzi,” kusho uMkhize.Okhulumela uMasipala wesiFunda iKing Cetshwayo, uNkk Rekha Naidoo, uthe akusekude ukuthi inkinga yamanzi ebhekene nomphakathi waku-wadi 10 eMlalazi ixazululwe ngokugcwele. Uthe iziphathimandla zikamasipala waseKing Cetshwayo kanjalo nowaseMlalazi, zibe nomhlangano nezakhamizi ezithintekayo."Ukuphazamiseka kwamanzi bekudalwa ukuthikamezeka kwesiphehli samanzi Kwahlokohloko. Lokhu kulungisiwe ngoLwesihlanu," kusho uNkk Naidoo. Uthe okunye ukwenzekayo ukuthi amanzi avulelwa imiphakathi ngezikhathi ezehlukene, okwenza bangakwazi ukuwathola ngesikhathi esisodwa amanzi. "Kulezo zindawo amanzi asuke engaphumi kuzona, siwahlinzeka ngamaloli," usho kanje.Uthembise ukuthi lesi simo esibonakala eZiqwaqweni, sizoshintsha esikhathini esingamasonto ambalwa kusuka manje njengoba kukhona izinhlelo zokuqeda inkinga yamanzi kuwadi 9 no-10.Uthe projekthi yokuqala edle uR65 million esisetshenzwe cishe u-78%, ezolungela ukunikezelwa emphakathini ezinyangeni ezimbili ezizayo, izohlinzeka ngamanzi imindeni engu-1 350 yaseNkume, Gawozi naseZiqwaqweni. Uveze ukuthi eyesibili edle uR72 million, izohlinzeka isibalo esifanayo semindeni yakuwadi 9, yona uthe isiku-92% umsebenzi osuqediwe kuyona.
AMALUNGU e-IFP asekhululekile ukugqoka izikibha ezinobuso bomholi weqembu, uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa. Lesi sinyathelo kuvunyelwane ngaso emhlanganweni woMkhandlu kaZwelonke kwi-IFP, obuseMpangeni, ngeSonto.Kulo mhlangano kuphinde kwavela nokuthi ingqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi beqembu izoba ngonyaka ozayo. Isolezwe lithole ngemithombo yalo ukuthi amalungu eqembu, anikezwe imvume yokuthi afake izikibha ezinobuso bukaHlabisa.Phambilini amalungu eqembu abevunyelwe ukufaka izikibha zomsunguli weqembu, Inkosi Mangosuthu Buthelezi. Omunye umthombo uveze ukuthi ingqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi beqembu izoba ngonyaka ozayo. Okhulumela i-IFP, uMnuz Mkhuleko Hlengwa, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi ingqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi be-IFP kuzwelonke nasesifundazweni izoba ngoMashi. Uthe banqume ukuthi zonke izingqungquthela zibe ngonyaka ozayo ukuze kungaphazamiseki umkhankaso wokhetho.I-IFP yagcina ukuba nengqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi beqembu ngo-2019, ngesikhathi uButhelezi edlulisela izintambo kuHlabisa. UHlengwa akazange ayiphendule imibuzo mayelana nokusetshenziswa kobuso bukaHlabisa ezikibheni.Umholi we-IFP ocele ukuba igama lakhe lingadalulwa, uthe ujabulise okwengane ngesikhathi uMkhandlu kaZwelonke uvumelana ngokuthi sezingafakwa izikibha ezinobuso bukaHlabisa. "Ngangizibuza ukuthi azigqokwa ngani izikibha ezinobuso bomuntu omdala ngoba uyena umholi weqembu. Ngijabule kabi uma umkhandlu kazwelonke uthi sesingazigqoka izikibha. UBulawayo wakhonjwa emazulwini, buka ukuthi i-IFP ikhula kanjani. Kuyasho ukuthi wangena ngendlela eqondile esikhundleni. Wanikezwa wumnikazi weqembu."Uthe: "Ulokhu eqhubekile nokwamukela amalungu amasha. Ebuholi bakhe sinongqongqoshe namaphini ongqongqoshe kuhulumeni kazwelonke. Lapha KwaZulu-Natal yithina esiphethe uhulumeni. Ngijabulise okwengane encane."Lo mholi uthe ubevele eseqalile ukugqoka isikibha esinobuso bukaHlabisa. "Le nto yezikibha ibuhlukumeza. Bese ngivele ngisigqoka. Uma ungena emhlanganweni weNkatha ububukwa ngelinye iso. Bebekuxwaya kube sengathi kungena umuntu weMKP noma owe-ANC. Ngihamba ngikhululekile, namanje ngisigqokile."Eqhuba uthe yena akasiboni isidingo sokuthi kube nengqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi."Yini lena esiyijahile? Angisho ukuthi ayingabi khona. Kodwa mina ngithi ingqungquthela ayibe khona uma sekuwukuthi sibona sengathi lona okhona uyayizikisa inqanawe. Ngokomthetho kufanele kuze kusho yena umuntu omkhulu ukuthi usebuthaka."Uphinde wanxusa amalungu eqembu ukuba aseke uHlabisa."Sonke nje ngothi lwethu asesekeni uBulawayo ukuze ayise i-IFP phambili."
AMAPHOYISA aveze ukuthi izikhulu zikaMasipala waseKurhuleni, uBrigadier Julius Mkhwanazi noMnuz Kagiso Lerutla, baboshelwe ukuthi baqasha umuntu owaya kozenza uLerutla enkantolo.ULerutla oyimenenja yomkhandlu, kuthiwa waqasha umuntu ukuthi ayozenza yena enkantolo lapho ayebhekene khona necala lokushayela budedengu. Lokhu kuvezwe okhulumela amaphoyisa kuzwelonke, uBrigadier Athlenda Mathe. UBrigadier Mathe uthe lo muntu owayeqashiwe wakhokhelwa imali ayihlukaniselana noMkhwanazi. Isinqumo esicelweni sakhe sebheyili sizokhishwa kusasa.Naye uMatlala uvele kafushane enkantolo izolo, lapho kunqunywe khona ukuthi asuswe ejele eliKwaZulu-Natal, iBongweni, ayogcinwa eKgosi Mampuru.

UMASIPALA wesiFunda uMgungundlovu udingisa umshayeli weloli yamanzi obanjwe oqotsheni edayisa amanzi.IMeya, uMnuz Mzi Zuma, ithe abasafuni ukuphinde babone lo msebenzi esebenza ezindaweni ezingaphansi koMgungundlovu. Umsebenzi uqashwe yinkampani ehlinzeka umasipala ngezimoto zamanzi.UZuma uthe utshele izikhulu zomasipala ukuba zitshele inkampani eqashe lo msebenzi ukuthi akasadingakali eMgungundlovu. Lo msebenzi ubanjwe edayisa amanzi eMaqongqo, ngaphansi koMasipala waseMkhambathini. Ngesikhathi ebanjwa edayisa amanzi, bekufanele ngabe uhlinzeka amanzi ezindaweni ezingaphansi koMasipala waseRichmond.IMaqongqo neRichmond ziqhelelene ngebanga elingaphezu kuka-60 KM kanti lezi zindawo zihlukaniswe yizindawo ezingaphansi koMasipala waseMsunduzi. Umshayeli ubanjwe ethela amanzi emzini yabantu ekhethekile.UZuma uthe umuntu uma efuna ukuthelelwa amanzi emzini wakhe, kufanele awathenge amanzi kwamasipala bese umasipala uthumela imoto ezomthelela leso sibalo samanzi asithengile. Uthe imizi ebithelelwa amanzi ilo mshayeli, ibingazange iwathenge amanzi kumasipala. UZuma uthe abashayeli abadayisa amanzi benza ukuthi abantu bagcine bengawatholi amanzi ngenxa yokuthi abashayeli bawayisa kulabo abasuke bewathengile."Kunabantu abangawatholi amanzi. Ngesikhathi ngikhuluma nabantu, kukhona abathe kunamasonto amabili bengathelelwa amanzi. Nina ninemizi yenu eniyithelela amanzi. Abantu uma bebona imoto yamanzi, baphuma nezigubhu namabhakede, nina niyabadlula ngoba kunemizi eniyithelela amanzi. Umphakathi wonke awunawo amanzi, le mizi ethandwa inina ithola amanzi."UZuma uthe isenzo salo msebenzi senza ukuthi umasipala ulahlekelwe imali. "Usuqhuba ibhizinisi lakho. Ithina esithwala izindleko zebhizinisi lakho. Thina sikhokha imali wena uziqhubela ibhizinisi lakho. Sikhokhela ukuthi umphakathi uthole amanzi, nina nihambisa amanzi lapho enazi khona ukuthi nithola imali."UZuma uthe lo mshayeli uzodala ukuthi abantu abangawatholi amanzi badinelwe umasipala."Ulindiwe eRichmond kodwa wena usuzakhele uhlelo lwakho ukuthi uzosebenza kanjani. Sizothukwa abantu eRichmond, ulindiwe eRichmond. Wena uyashushuluza yonke le ndlela. Le moto ohamba ngayo ine-tracker. Umqashi wakho uzofuna ukuthi simkhokhele imali eningi uma ebuka ibanga olihambile. Uthunywe eRichmond wena uziyela lapho othanda khona. Nakhona lana awuzile ukuzosiza abantu uzoziqhubela ibhizinisi lakho."UZuma uthe inkampani eqashe lo msebenzi kuzofanele imtholele umsebenzi kwenye indawo."Asifuni ukuphinde sikubone la eMgungundlovu. Akuyona indawo yokuganga lena."

KUNENHLANSI yethemba ezikoleni zaKwaZulu-Natal, emva kokukhangiswa kwezikhala ezibalelwa ku-3 000 zothishanhloko, amaphini othishanhloko kanjalo nabazobhekela izifundo.Lezi zikhala zikhangiswe ngaphansi kwesekhula uHRM Circular 10, ka-2026. UMphathiswa woMnyango, uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka, uveze uthe bakhiphe izikhala ezingu-3 002 zothishanhloko, amaphini abo kanjalo nabazobhekela izifundo.Uthe bazikhangise ukuze kuqiniswe ezemfundo esifundazweni. "Sizinikele ekutheni siqinise imfundo esifundazweni. Simile ekutheni sifuna ukulokhu senza kahle uma kuziwa emiphumeleni."Uthe akuzovalwa kuphela izikhala kodwa kuzoqiniswa ukuphathwa kwezikole."Sibeka abafundi phambili yingakho siqinisa ukuphathwa kwezikole. Sinxusa othisha ukuthi bazifake izicelo ngesikhathi esibekiwe kulezi zikhala ezikhangisiwe," usho kanje. Ezikhaleni ezikhangisiwe zingu-1 784 abazobhekela izifundo, babengu-673 othishanhloko, bese bebangu-545, amaphini othishanhloko.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi kuhlale kunesikhalazo esifundazweni, kothisha abangaqashiwe abakhala ngokungadedelwa kwezikhala eMnyangweni.UMnyango uhlale ukuveza ukuthi ubhekene nengcindezi yemali eyenza ungakwazi ukuvala ezinye izikhala. Othisha abangaqashiwe baze bamashele emahhovisi oMnyango, kokunye balale ngaphandle kwawo izinsuku, bekhala ngendlala yomsebenzi. Kuba nombango uma kukhangiswe izikhala zothishanhloko, amaphini abo kanjalo nababhekele iminyango. Okususa umsindo ukuthi baningi abasuke begaqele ukunyuselwa kulezi zikhundla zokuphatha. Uqophe umlando uMnyango wesifundazwe emiphumeleni ka-matric yanyakenye, ngokulala endaweni yokuqala uma kuqhathaniswa nezinye izifundazwe. Lokhu kwenzeka phezu kwezinkinga lo Mnyango obhekene nazo zokungakwazi ukuvala izikhala zabahloli, nabaphethe amasekethe ngenxa yemali.UMnyango uhluleka nawukukhokhela ngesikhathi osomabhizinisi osebenza nabo ngenxa yemali. Kwaze kwangenelela noNdunankulu wesifundazwe, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, kanjalo noNgqongqoshe kazwelonke, uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, enkingeni ebhekene noMnyango kodwa isimo asikashintshi.

njengoba bethole u-88% ku-R125.1 billion oklanyelwa omasipala.UMncwango uthe lesi simo sikhomba ukuthi izwe libuswa abaholi abangakulungele ukuphatha izwe ngobuqotho, futhi indlela abenza ngayo ikhomba ukuthi abayikhathalele inhlalakahle nentuthuko yomphakathi."Kuyiqiniso elingenakuphikwa ukuthi okunye okusibeka lapho esikhona manje wukuthi ezinye iziphathimandla zomasipala zithatha imali okumele ngabe isiza ezidingweni zomphakathi, ziyitshale emikhankasweni yazo yokhetho - okuyisenzo esiphambene nomthetho."Lilonke nje kusobala ukuthi ubuholi obusemandleni manje kudingeka ukuthi buzinuke amakhwapha ngendlela okwengamela ngayo imali yokusiza umphakathi.Kuyacaca ukuthi sekuyisikhathi sokuthi kutholakale isandla sobuholi obusha obuzobeka izidingo zomphakathi phambili - ngoba laba abakhona manje sebehlulekile,” kusho uMncwango.UMncwango udalule nokuthi okufakazela ukungathembeki nokungaholi ngobuqotho komasipala wukuthi kumanje sekuphele iminyaka emibili yonke afaka incwadi efuna ukucaciseleleka ngezinsolo zokuqashwa kwabantu abayizipoki ohlelweni lwe-EPWP.Leli phephandaba liyibonile incwadi eyathunyelwa wuMncwango ngoJulayi ngo-2024, ayeyibhekise kuMasipala weTheku ebuza ukuthi kwagcina kwenzekenii ngalezo zinsolo, aveze ukuthi kuze kube yimanje do impendulo. UMcwaningi Mabhuku Jikelele udalule nokuthi kuleli qoqo lomasipala abanogcobho kukhona noMkhandlu omkhulu weTheku, omasipala bezifunda nomasipala abayizizinda nensika yomnotho wesifundazwe.Kuvele nokuthi kunomasipala abawu-10 asebehlale kuleli qoqo labangenzi kahle iminyaka ewu-10 nangaphezulu, okukhomba ubukhulu bomonakalo oqhubekayo ngalesi simo.
LIHLALELWE ifulaha lomsebenzi ithimba elijutshwe iSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini ukuba liyonxenxa amaqembu ezepolitiki ameleleke ePhalamende ukuba aseke isiphakamiso sokuba kuchibiyelwe umthetho olawula ukuphathwa kwesikhwama esigade umhlaba kaZulu, iNgonyama Trust.Ithimba eliqokwe yiMbube lizokuba nemihlangano namaqembu ameleleke ePhalamende ngesonto elizayo.Amaqembu avume ukuhlangana nethimba i-ANC, MKP, DA, EFF, IFP, PA, ACDP, PA, Bosa, Rise Mzansi, PAC, ActionSA, FF Plus ne-UDM. Kuzobe kuphekwa kuthululwa njengoba le mihlangano izokuba ngoLwesine nangoLwesihlanu.Ithimba kuzofanele ligawule libheke lapha ePhalamende ngoba lolu daba luke lwaphathwa kuleli zinga kanti imiphumela ayibanga njengesifiso seNdlunkulu. Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi iPhalamende lake lajuba ithimba elaliholwa owayengumengameli, uMnuz Kgalema Motlanthe. Umbiko waleli thimba waphakamisa ukuthi kuqedwe ngeNgonyama Trust.Amaqembu ezepolitiki amaningi ayekhona ePhalamende ngaleso sikhathi azwakalisa ukuzeseka izincomo zombiko wango-2017.Kepha lo mbiko wagcina uphelela emoyeni emva kokubhoka kukaZulu uholwa yiSilo uGoodwill Zwelithini kaBhekuzulu.IZICAGOGO ZAMAQEMBUAkuyona imfihlo ukuthi amaqembu amaningi ezepolitiki awajabule ngendlela okuphethwe ngayo iNgonyama Trust. Amanye avame ukuzwakalisa ukuthi umhlaba ongaphansi kwalesi sikhwama kufanele kube ngokahulumeni.Okuningi ukushaya amakhala kusuke kuthinta izimali lapho izikhulu zeNgonyama Trust zibizwa ukuba zizophendula ePhalamende ngokusetshenziswa kwezimali.Ithimba leNdlulamithi liya ePhalamende ngesikhathi esibukhunyana lapho lingekho iqembu elaphumelela ukhetho ngamalengiso. Lesi simo senza umsebenzi wethimba ube nzima njengoba kuzofanele lizame ukubonisana nezicagogo ngezicagogo zamaqembu ameleleke ePhalamende.Lowo akuwona umsebenzi olula.Kunzima ukuphasisa ukushintshwa komthetho ePhalamende ngoba kwawona amaqembu abusa ngokubambisana abuye engavumelani ewodwa.Lokhu kwabonakala kakhulu ngesikhathi kunesiphakamiso sokwenyusa ngo-2% intela eyengezwa empahleni ethengwayo. Sagcina singaphumelelanga lesi esiphakamiso ngenxa yokungavumelani kwamaqembu abusa ngokubambisana.Ithimba kuzofanele lizilungiselele ukubhekana nazo zonke lezi zimo. AMANDLA KAZULU NESILOKungenzeka nokho ukuthi lesi simo sivune ithimba ngoba amaqembu amaningi ezepolitiki aseyakugwema ukuphikisana neSilo bukhoma.Lokhu kungenxa yokwesabela ukuthi ukuphikisana neSilo kwenza ukuthi abantu baKwaZulu-Natal bengalivoteli lelo qembu eliphikisana noMlomo ongathethi manga.Lona unyaka wokhetho lohulumeni basekhaya, kwazi bani mhlawumbe ithimba lingase liyinqobe le mpi ngokusetshenzelwa yisihe osopolitiki ababa naso ngale sizini.Injongo enkulu yomhlangano ukuba kunxenxwe amaqembu ezepolitiki ukuthi aseke isiphakamiso sokuba kuchibiyelwe umthetho iNgonyama Trust Act ukuze iMbube izonikwa amandla okuqoka amalungu ebhodi.Umthetho okhona njengamanje unikeza uNgqongqoshe wezoMhlaba amandla okuqoka amalungu ebhodi. Akusiniki ukuthula iSilo ukunikwa kukangqongqoshe amandla okuqoka amalungu ebhodi.Amalungu ebhodi akhona njengamanje abhekene ngeziqu zamehlo neSilo. Ukube kuya ngayo iMbube ngabe kade la malungu ebhodi axoshwa.IMbube ikhala ngokuthi amalungu ebhodi awayihloniphi futhi awafuni ukuyamukela njengoSihlalo webhodi. La malungu aqokwa ngesikhathi uMnyango usaphethwe uNkk Thoko Didiza, osenguSomlomo wePhalamende.Ungqongqoshe ophethe, uMnuz Mzwanele Nyhontso, usezame kaningi ukuxosha amalungu ebhodi.Mumva nje uNyhontso uzame ukuxosha amalungu ngenxa yokuthi sekusule ubuthaphuthaphu amanye nokwenza abasele bangabi yisibalo esanele ukuthi bakwazi ukwenza umsebenzi. Amalungu ebhodi anikela eNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu eyophonsela inselelo isinqumo sikaNyhontso.Nebala inkantolo yakhipha isivimbelo sesikhashana esichitha isinqumo sikaNyhontso sokuxosha amalungu ebhodi.KUBOSHELWE IZINGQWEQWEOkunye okufunwa iiMbube ukuthi iNgonyama Trust iwele ngaphansi kukahulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal esikhundleni sikahulumeni kazwelonke.Ithimba leMbube eliholwa uNdunankulu kaZulu, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, libophele izingqweqwe zemikhakha eyahlukene, ikakhulu kwezomthetho.Phakathi kwamanye amafolosi, kukhona iJaji eselathatha umhlalaphansi uMjabuliseni Isaac Madondo, nommeli wasemaJajini, u-Advocate Tembeka Ngcukaitobi.Amakhosi asesifundazweni azwakalise ukuyeseka imizamo yeMbube yokuba kuchibiyelwe umthetho olawula iNgonyama Trust.Amakhosi athe afuna ukuthi iMbube kube yiyo ngokubambisana nawo elawula iNgonyama Trust.Akusho lokhu emhlanganweni wawo okhethekile obungoLwesibili. Umhlangano ubuhanjelwe amakhosi aqhamuka kuzo zonke izifunda.Kuleli sonto iMbube ihlangane noNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, lapho igcizelele khona ukubaluleka kokuba kubuyiswe uzinzo kwiNgonyama Trust. Okhulumela iSilo, uMntwana uThulani kaGqikazi Zulu, uthe iSilo siyalele uNtuli ukuba axhumane noNyhontso ukuze bezoqhamuka neqhinga lokuxazulula izinkinga ezibhekene neNgonyama Trust. "Lokhu kubalwa ukubhekana nezinselelo zokuphatha, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kunomthetho ocacile, nokubuyisela ukusebenza okugcwele kwalesi sikhungo ngendlela evikela izimfuno zesizwe samaZulu nokuqinisekisa ukwethenjwa ngumphakathi."ISilo sigcizelele ukuthi ukusebenzisana phakathi kwehhovisi likaNdunankulu, uMnyango wezoMhlaba nehhovisi lomphathi weNgonyama Trust. INgonyama iphinde yathi i-Ingonyama Trust iseyimpahla ebalulekile esizweni nasesifundazweni, edinga ukuphathwa ngobunono, obala, nangokuvumelana nawo wonke amazinga kahulumeni."

Ngijabule kakhulu ngokuthi namhlanje ngithole le ndondo. BUSADIDEKILE ubuholi besikole imaphephetha High, ematata, enanda, kulandela isigameko sokungqongqiswa kwenye ingxenye yaso ngolwesihlanu.Emlilweni okuthiwa ubonwe omakhelwane ezintatha, kushiswe ihhovisi likathishanhloko, elephini lakhe, amane ama-head of department nekilasi elilodwa elincikene nompheme okungqongqiswe imoto ebisetshenziswa abafundi abenza izifundo zokukhenikha.Usihlalo wesigungu sesikole, umnuz Mzokhona Khumalo, uthe basashayisana ngamakhanda ngokuthi ubani lo obenesifiso sokucekela phansi isikole."Kusobala ukuthi umlilo uthungelwe umuntu futhi sisola ukuthi ubesebenzisa ibhomu likaphethroli. Okusididayo ukuthi ukwenze lokhu nganhlosoni ngoba azikho izinxushunxushu esikoleni. Othisha bonke bayezwana, iSGB nayo iyezwana. Akukho muntu onanxa nomunye,” kusho uKhumalo.Uthe kuningi okumqoka okubalahlekele ngaphakathi emagunjini ashisiwe. Phakathi kwakho ubale ama-riphothi abafundi abequkethe imiphumela yabo yokuphela kwesigaba sokuqala sonyaka, athe bebezonikwa wona maduze. Uphinde wabala nemishini emithathu yokufothokhopha, amaphepha abalulekile abafundi, izincwadi kanjalo nazo zonke ezinye izinsizakusebenza ezisetshenziswa othisha uma befundisa. "Sife olwembiza futhi asikazi nokuthi izothini indlela eya phambili. Abahloli bafikile ngosuku lwesigameko, bafike babuka umonakalo, babhala phansi abakubonile. Thina sizoba nomhlangano sodwa kusasa (esho namuhla) bese sibiza owabazali bonke maduze,” kusho uKhumalo. Uthe ukufunda nokufundisa akukazoqhubeka ngoba umonakalo ucekele phansi zonke izinsizakusebenza zawo wonke amabanga esikole.Udalule ukuthi uthole ucingo lumbizela esigamekweni ngo-5:45 ekuseni, wathatha imizuzu engu-15 ukuthi afike khona. Uthe ufike kukhombisa ukuthi imoto isishe yangqongqa kanti kulawa amanye amahhovisi, umlilo ubusha ngaphakathi ungakaphumeli ngaphandle. Umthombo weSolezwe, uthe kwenzeka lesi sigameko nje, kunesonto kukhishwe wonke amafasitela emakilasini angomahamba nendlwana esikoleni. Uveze ukuthi ngasekuqaleni konyaka, kukhona umuntu owahamba wathwebula isikole, maqede wakhenikha isithombe nge-Artificial Interligence (AI), sakhombisa isikole sisha, wase esinameka ezinkundleni zokuxhumana. "Kwathi uma kugijinywa kuyiwa esikoleni, kwatholakala ukuthi asinalutho. Akuzange kunakwe lutho ngaleso sikhathi kodwa sekuyacaca manje ukuthi leso senzo sasixoxa indaba,” kusho umthombo, othe ayinuki ingosiwe.Uphinde wadalula eyokuthi kukhona umoya wokudayiswa kwezikhala zokufundisa kulesi sikole, okuthiwa sinezikhala zothisha ezimbili. Nokho uthe akekho ofuna ukuphumela obala ngaleyo ndaba, okusolakala ukuthi ingahle ibe yisizathu sokushiswa kwesikole. AboMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal - kweminye imithombo yabezindaba - baveze ukuthi banalo ulwazi ngesigameko, bathi sithikameze ukufunda nokufundisa.
UNOBHALA Jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, usole umndeni wosomabhizinisi abafunelwa amacala kuleli, abakwaGupta, njengongqondongqondo emkhankasweni weMKP wokhetho lwango-2024, owawudla lubi ezinkundleni zokuxhumana.UMbalula uthe abakwaGupta yibona abapheka umkhankaso weMKP, owawushisa kakhulu enkundleni yezokuxhumana i-Tiktok. Indlela abanamandla ngayo, benza uze ukhohlwe ukuthi uZuma akuyena owayephethe izwe ngesikhathi kunezinsolo zokulawulwa koMbuso yidlanzana."I-MKP yamangaza abaningi okhethweni lwango-2024, njengoba yaba yiqembu lesithathu ngobukhulu ePhalamende. UMbalula uthe ukugxeka kwabo iMKP ngesikhathi kubhekwe okhethweni, akuzange kubasize. "Abanye bethu bacabanga ukuthi uma begxeka uZuma, sizothola amavoti. Ukugxeka uZuma akusisizi, empeleni ukumgxeka kwenza isimo sethu sibe sibi kakhulu."UMbalula uthe abaholi be-ANC nabo kufanele bazilungiselele ukulwa impi eqhubeka ezinkundleni zokuxhumana."Sibaningi kabi singabaholi be-ANC. Kungani kungethina esimandla lapha ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ngoba ithina esibaningi? Abantu bakholelwa izinto ezikhulunywa abantu abagxeka i-ANC ngenxa yokuthi thina asiphawuli ezinkundleni zokuxhumana. Asikhulumi ngezinto ezinhle ezenziwa uhulumeni, nokwenza ukuthi abantu bakholelwe kulaba abagxeka uhulumeni." UMbalula uthe kufanele bazibambe ziqine njengoba kubhekwe okhethweni lohulumeni basekhaya."Akuzukuba lula okhethweni lohulumeni basekhaya."Okuzokwenza ukuthi kube nzima kakhulu kwi-ANC kulolu khetho ukujikelwa idlelandawonye layo, i-SACP, elinqume ukungenela ukhetho ngokuzimela. I-SAPC ibiyaye iseke i-ANC uma kunokhetho kodwa kulolu khetho inqume ukuzimela. Izolo, i-ANC ibibambe imihlangano ezifundeni ezahlukene, lapho ibiyazisa khona amalungu ayo ngesinqumo esithathwe isigungu esiphezulu ngodaba lokungenela ukhetho kwamaKhomanisi. Namhlanje abaholi be-ANC, bazochazela abezindaba ngesinqumo esithathiwe.
NGOKUJWAYELEKILE amabandla amaningi amaZayoni avame ukusebenzisa inyanga uJulayi noma u-Agasti ukwenza iNkonzo yaminyaka yonke yesiVuno, okusetshenziswa yona ukuphana izipho zezithelo, amaveji nokudla okwehlukene - ukukhombisana uthando nokunakekelana. Kepha abebandla lamaZayoni, i-The New Zion City in SA: Omacekeceke, egatsheni laseZimbokodweni, eNingizimu yeTheku, bakwenza ngendlela ehlukile lokhu njengoba sebekwenze umkhuba wabo abawenza kahlanu ngonyaka.UMvangeli waleli bandla, uMnuz Nkosinathi Dladla, uthe lo mbono wabafikela ngokuthi bekuhlale kubakhathaza ukuthi uma beyokhonza kubo kamzalwane othile, abatatazelele uma sekuqediwe ngoba efuna ukukhipha unyawo lokukhombisa ukubabonga ngokungenisa endlini yakhe. "Sibone lapho ukuthi kufanele senze uhlelo olunjena ukusiza ukuthi uma sivakashele umzalwane ukuyokhonzela kubo noma kwakhe, kube yithina esiletha nezipho kuyena, ukusiza ukugwema ukuthi angene agamanxe ephaketheni elungisa okudliwayo. Uthe le nkonzo bayenza kahlanu ngonyaka okuba yingoFebhuwari, Ephreli, Juni, Agasti nango-Okthoba - kanti futhi bazama ukuthi ibe nobulungiswa ngokuthi njalo uma bezoyenza, benza i-draw yokuhlalukisa ukuthi elandelayo iya kuliphi ilungu lebandla. "Nalapho sekuthengwa ukudla esizoya nakho kulelo lungu, siyahlukanisela ukuthi lelo nalelo lungu lizothenga kudla kuni. Konke sikwenza ngokubambisana ukuze kungabi wumthwalo emalungwini ebandla, kunalokho kwakha futhi kuqinisa ukubumbana ebandleni,” usho kanje.UDladla ukhuthaze nabanye abazalwane bakwamanye amabandla ukuba bakhuthalele ukwenza izinhlelo ezifuze lezi ngenhloso yokwakha nokuqinisa ukwazana kubazalwane, okungasiza ukuthi amabandla akhule futhi kungabi lula ukuthi abe nezinxushunxushu.
