IPHALAMENDE lichithe isicelo se-African Transformation Movement (ATM), sokuba kuqalwe uhlelo lokukhipha uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa esikhundleni.I-ATM ibifuna ukuthi kuqalwe uhlelo lokukhipha uRamaphosa esikhundleni emva kombiko wophiko olugada ukusebenza kwamaphoyisa, i-Ipid, oluveze ukuthi abaqaphi bakaRamaphosa baphula imigomo ngesikhathi bephenya ngokuntshontshwa kwezindodla zemali epulazi likaRamaphosa.Umbiko we-Ipid osanda kunekelwa izwe, ukhombe ngenjumbane izikhulu ezazigada uRamaphosa ngesikhathi kuntshontshwa imali epulazini lakhe ngo-2021. IPhalamende lake lwaqala uhlelo lokukhipha uRamaphosa esikhundleni ngo-2022, ngesikhathi kuvela izinsolo okukuqala. Nokho iPhalamende lachitha umbiko wethimba elaliholwa yijaji eselathatha umhlalaphansi, uSandile Ngcobo, okwasho ukuthi uRamaphosa uyaphunyula esiphakamisweni sokuthi akhishwe esikhundleni.I-ATM iyona eyayifake isicelo sokuthi kuqalwe uphenyo lokukhipha uRamaphosa esikhundleni esachithwa. Emva kokudedelwa kombiko we-Ipid, i-ATM, iphinde yabhalela iPhalamende icela ukuthi kuvuswe lolu daba. USomlomo wePhalamende, uNkk Thoko Didiza, uthe iPhalamende livele selaqeda ngalolu daba.Ukusho lokhu empendulweni yencwadi ayithumele i-ATM. "Uzokhumbula ukuthi ngesikhathi ufaka isicelo sokuqala, wawufuna kuphenywe izinsolo ezifanayo. IPhalamende lanquma ukuqoka ithimba elalizophenya. Sekuwumlando ukuthi iPhalamende lanquma ukuchitha umbiko wethimba."UNkk Didiza uthe iPhalamende alikwazi ukubuye liqale phansi liphenye lezi zinsolo, ngaphandle uma kungaba nesinqumo senkantolo esiphoqa ukuthi kuqalwe phansi uphenyo. I-EFF yaphonsela inselelo ukuchithwa kombiko wethimba eliholwa uNgcobo.INkantolo yoMthethosisekelo kulindeleke ukuthi ikhiphe isinqumo sayo maduze. Umholi we-ATM, uMnuz Vuyo Zungula, uthe kuyabadumaza ukuchithwa kwesicelo sabo. UZungula uthe uNkk Didiza usebenzise izaba ukuchitha isicelo sabo. Uthe bazoqhubeka nokulwela ukuthi uRamaphosa aphendule ngodaba lwasePhala Phala.
ZIYIFANISE nokunqoba kwesifundazwe empini yobugebengu obubucayi, eyokuvulwa kweForensic Science Laboratory (FSL), eMayville, eThekwini, ngoLwesihlanu. Izinhlaka ezilwa nobugebengu emphakathini, zithe le laboratory enikezelwe nguNgqongqoshe wemiSebenzi yoMphakathi kuzwelonke, uMnuz Dean Mcpherson kwibamba likaNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa kuzwelonke, uSolwazi Firoz Cachalia, ibuyisa ithemba empini yokulwa nobugebengu esifundazweni.Phakathi kokunye okuningi okuyamaniswa nophenyo lwamacala, izoba yisikhungo esizohlola amasampula olibofuzo oluqondene namacala okudlwengula enzeka esifundazweni. Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi phambilini, amasampula alolu hlobo abethunyelwa esikhungweni esenza umsebenzi ofanayo esisePitoli. Lokhu bekuholela ekutheni kube khona izikhalo ngamacala abucayi afana nawokudlwengula njengoba bekuhlale kuvela ukuthi uyaphela nonyaka imiphumela yolibofuzo ingabuyile. Lokhu kuthiwa bekudalwa ukuthi lesi sikhungo senza umsebenzi osuke ulethwe nangezinye izifundazwe. Umsunguli weThekwini Neighbourwood Watch, eqapha ubugebengu emalokishini ehlukene eThekwini, uMnuz Andile Jali, uthe ukuvulwa kwesikhungo kuwukunqoba eyobugebengu esifundazweni. "Lokhu kusho ukuthi uphenyo olumaqondana nokuhlolwa kolibofuzo emacaleni okudlwengula, seluzoyeka ukushaya ngonyawo lonwabu, lokhu kusho ukushesha kokutholakala kobulungiswa kubagilwa bokudlwengulwa kanjalo nemindeni yabo,” kusho uJali. Uthe indaba yokwethembela esikhungweni ebesisePitoli, bekubalahlekisela ngethemba abagilwa kanjalo nemindeni yabo."Umuntu ubefike adlwengule, aboshwe, bathi bayabona abagilwa nemindeni yabo, usededelwe, usezihambela ngokukhululeka emphakathini, kube sengathi ezobulungiswa zibenzela phansi."Uthe uma kwenzeka okufuze lokhu imiphakathi igcina isola amaphoyisa ngokuthi ehlulekile ukwenza umsebenzi wawo ekubeni kungekho asuke angakwenza ukuphuthumisa uhlelo lokuhlolwa kolibofuzo. Uqhube wathi abakubhekile manje ukushesha kokuphothulwa kwamacala okudlwengula enkantolo njengoba kungasekho okuzoba yisithiyo ophenyweni oluqondene nokuhlolwa kolibofuzo.Isolezwe likhumbule iziwombe ezimbalwa ezike zenzeka lihambele amanye amacala ezinkantolo ezehlukene eThekwini. Kwesinye isiwombe esenzeka eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini, eminyakeni embalwa edlule, kwangena icala lokudlwengulwa kowesifazane lapho imantshi eyayilisingethe yakhombisa okukhulu ukunengeka ngokuhamba kwesikhathi eside ingabuyi imiphumela yolibofuzo. "Leli cala ngiyalihoxisa okwesikhashana. Sekuphele inqwaba yezinyanga ingabuyi imiphumela yolibofuzo. Ukuthi uhulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika uyahluleka ukulungisa inkinga yokubambezeleka kwemiphumela yolibofuzo e-laboratory, akuyona inkinga yami leyo noma ekamsolwa,” kwasho imantshi. Yaqhuba yathi ukumgcina ngaphakathi esitokisini umsolwa ngesikhathi kusalindwe imiphumela yolibofuzo okungaziwa ukuthi iyobuya nini, kuwukucindezela amalungelo akhe. Ngaleso sizathu, yamdedela, yathi necala iyalihoxisa, lobuye livulwe uma sekubuye imiphumela yolibofuzo.Kwenzeka esifanayo eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseNtuzuma, nyakenye, lapho okwakuboshwe khona uthisha wasesikoleni iMtapo High, eLindelani, ngecala lokudlwengula umfundi, wamkhulelisa. Imantshi yavele yamdedela ngaphandle kokuthandabuza, ithi vele kusazothatha eside isikhathi ukuthi icala liqulwe njengoba kwakusazolindwa imiphumela yolibofuzo, okungaziwa ukuthi izobuya nini ePitoli.
ISHAYA amakhala iNdlunkulu kaZulu ngemuva kokuvela kwezindaba zokuthi sekuseMome mayelana nokugunyazwa ngokusemthethweni komsebenzi wokudayisa ngomzimba.Lokhu kuvele ngemuva kokuthi uMnyango wezoBulungiswa ukuqinisekisile ukuthi akusensuku zatshwala ngaphambi kokuba abadayisa ngomzimba bathole igunya lokwenza lo msebenzi ngaphansi kwemigomo.Uma lo mthetho ohlongozwayo ugcina ngokuphumelela, okhulumela iNdlunkulu uMntwana uThulani Zulu uthe kuyobe kusho ukubola kwezwe.Ulimise ngesihloko elokuthi bona njengeNdlunkulu abahambisani nje nhlobo nale ndaba ehlongozwayo ngoba izokonakalisa izinto eziningi esizweni.Uthe ngokosikompilo lakwaZulu umuntu wesifazane izinkomo zakhe zidliwa uyise uma esadla anhlamvana.UMntwana ubuze ukuthi kulesi simo-ke lapho owesifazane edayisa ngoqobo lwakhe bese imali idliwa uyena ngabe kusho ukuthi usengene esikhundleni sikayise yini.''Yini nje ngempela engalunga uma kuphasiswa lolu hlobo lomthetho? Angikholwa wukuthi kukhona okungabuye kuhambe kahle. Lihle nje iqiniso, phela yichilo leli okukhulunywa ngalo. Yinto okungamele nje ngabe kuze kuyakhulunywa nangayo ngoba yimbi futhi kakhulu,'' usho kanje.Eqhuba ukhale ngokuthi uma lo mthetho ugunyazwa bese beba baningi nabantu besifazane abawenzayo lo msebenzi lokho nakanjani kuyoholela ekutheni kunciphe nemishado.Okwamanje ukudayisa ngomzimba kuyinto engavumelekile eNingizimu Afrika kodwa eyenzekayo. Yize kunjalo, uhulumeni uthi uhlelo lokuguqula lokho luhamba kahle kakhulu nezingxoxo ziya kuvuthondaba.Lolu daba luxoxwa yizinhlaka ezehlukene ezibandakanya uMnyango wezoBulungiswa, owezeMpilo, owezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi owezaseKhaya kanye nowezokuShushisa.Lokhu kuvele ngemuva komhlangano omkhulu obuphakathi koyiPhini eMnyangweni wezoBulungiswa kuleli, u-Andries Nel kanye nezinhlaka ezehlukene ezimele abadayisa ngomzimba okubandakanya uhlaka olubizwa ngeSex Workers Organisatiion, Sex Workers Education And Advocacy Taskforce (SWEAT). Lo mbiko udedelwe ngemuva kwezinyanga kucutshungulwa lolu daba.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi iKhabhinethi iqale yaphasisa uhlaka ngo-2022. Kwaba khona abanganeliseki ngalokhu, okwagcina sekuholela ekutheni ngo-2025 iminyango ehlukene kahulumeni ihlangane ukuze icubungule lolu daba bese iba nemibuzo.Okhulumela uMnyango wezoBulungiswa kuleli, uTerrence Manase, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi izingxoxo ngalolu daba sezikwelinye izinga.Uveze ukuthi iPhini likaNgqongqoshe, uNel, linikeze isiqiniseko ezinhlanganweni ezimele abadayisa ngomzimba ukuthi lo mthetho uzobukeka kanjani.Phakathi kokunye uthe ngeke baze baphoqwe ukuba babhalise futhi ngeke baphoqwe ukuba bahlolele igciwane lengculaza.ISonke Gender Justice ithe baningi kakhulu abesifazane abadayisa ngomzimba abaye babe yizisulu zokuhlukumezeka. Ngokocwaningo kuvela ukuthi ingxenye yabadayisa ngomzimba seyake yabhekena nengwala yokuhlukunyezwa.INhlangano i-UNAID ikholelwa ekutheni ukugunyazwa kwalo mthetho kungagwema izinto eziningi njengoba ithi u-33% kuya ku-46% wabadayisa ngomzimba utheleleka ngegciwane lengculazi.
SIZOVELA enkantolo nozakwabo ocashunwe ngamaphoyisa, isikhulu samaPhoyisa kuMasipala waseKurhuleni esimisiwe, uBrigadier Julius Mkhwanazi.UMkhwanazi oboshwe ngempelasonto, uzovela eNkantolo yeMantshi eBoksburg, namhlanje. UMkhwanazi usolwa ngokusondelana nosomabhizinisi obhekene noxhaxha lwamacala, uMnuz Vusumuzi "Cat" Matlala.Kusolwa ukuthi uMkhwanazi wagunyaza ukuthi izimoto zikaMatlala zifakwe amalambu aluhlaza futhi kwavela kwiKhomishini eholwa yiJaji Mbuyiseli Madlanga, ukuthi uMkhwanazi kunemali ayeyithola kuMatlala. Ngaphandle kwalokho, uMkhwanazi uphinde abhekane nezinsolo okubalwa kuzo nezokufihla ubufakazi ecaleni lokufa komuntu. UMkhwanazi ushaqwe ngamaphoyisa kungakapheli izinsuku ezingaki eqede ukwethula ubufakazi phambi kweKhomishini kaMadlanga, lapho ebephekwe khona ngebhodwe elincane.Okhulumela amaphoyisa, uBrigadier Athlenda Mathe, uthe uMkhwanazi uboshwe yithimba eliphenya amacala asuka kwiKhomishini kaMadlanga. UMkhwanazi ubhekene necala lenkohlakalo nelokuphazamisa ukusebenza kwengalo yomthetho.UBrigadier Mathe uthe ukuboshwa kukaMkhwanazi akuhlangene nobufakazi obethulwe kwiKhomishini kaMadlanga, wathi futhi akuhlangene nophenyo obeluqhutshwa uphiko olugade ukusebenza kwamaphoyisa, i-Ipid. Uphenyo lwe-Ipid lwaphakamisa ukuthi amaphoyisa kaMasipala waseKurhuleni, asolakala ecaleni lokufa komuntu, kufanele athathelwe izinyathelo.UMkhwanazi naye uyathinteka kuleli cala. UBrigadier Mathe uthe kukhona abanye abasolwa abasazokhalelwa amasongo kaSigonyela."Ithimba liyaqhubeka nomsebenzi walo. Kukhona abanye abasolwa ithimba elisezithendeni zabo. Amacala aphenywa asukela ezinsolweni zenkohlakalo ophikweni lwamaphoyisa kaMasipala waseKurhuleni." Izolo, kuphinde kwaboshwa esinye isikhulu sakuMasipala waseKurhuleni. UBrigadier Mathe uthe lesi sikhulu siboshwe sisesikhumulweni sezindiza i-OR Tambo International Airport.Sibhekene necala lenkohlakalo, ukukhwabanisa nokuphazamisa ukusebenza kwengalo yomthetho."Sizovela enkantolo kusasa (namhlanje)."
EZIKOLENI zasemakhaya kunenkinga yezingane ezithwala kanzima ezifundweni ezithile, kungekhona ukuthi azikuqondi ezikufundiswayo - kepha ngenxa yokuthi aziwaqondi amagama athile emibuzweni ukuthi aqonde ukuthini ngesiZulu.Usho kanjalo uMnuz Nhlanzeko Ngwenya waseMasundwini, KwaNongoma, elandisa ngomcabango wombono wakhe wosomqulu wamagama esiNgisi ahunyushelwe esiZulwini osihloko sithi ALL Action Assessment Verbs: for English First Additional Language and Mathematical Terminology Lists.Engxoxweni yakhe neSolezwe ngalo mqulu aqale ukuwuhlanganisa ngo-2017, kwaze kwaba wu-2018 - uthe umcabango wawo wamfikela ngokuthi kusukela aqala ukuba uthisha eminyakeni ewu-20 edlule ubeqaphela ukuthi abanye abafundi abami ndawonye emabangeni abakuwona ngoba bengakhaliphile, kepha bahlulwa wukuhumusha amanye amagama asetshenziswayo uma bebuzwa imibuzo ezivivinyweni. "Ngiqale kanjalo ukucwaninga ngamagama okuvame ukuthi anike abafundi inkinga yokungakwazi ukuwahumusha ngendlela efanele ikakhulu esiNgisini naseziBalweni nakwezinye izifundo, ngasebenzisa ulwazi lwami lwezemfundo namava obuthishela ukuqhamuka nezincazelo ezizokwenza kube lula ukuwaqonda kahle,” usho kanje.Eqhuba, uthe inkinga ekhona okwamanje wukuthi akakayitholi indlela yokuthi lo mqulu ufinyelele kwaboMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal nasezweni lonke, athemba nakholelwa ekuthini ungabahlaba umxhwele futhi wenze babone ukuthi ungasiza kanjani."Ngibona kuyinto ezoba wusizo ikakhulu ezikoleni zasemakhaya ngoba yilapho ziningi khona izingane ezithwala kanzima ukuhumusha amagama esiNgisi ngesiZulu ukuze ukufunda ngokuqonda kungabi wumthwalo,” kusho uNgwenya. Udalule nokuthi okunye futhi okuhle ngalo mqulu wukuthi udidiyele namanye amagama esiNgisi acotshelelwa wona wuSolwazi Thengamehlo Ngwenya ongasekho mhlabeni owayefundisa eDurban University of Technology, okusize ngokuwuqinisa."Lawo magama kwavela ukuthi avame ukuba yinkinga kubafundi abasuke bezokwenza unyaka wokuqala emanyuvesi, okuveza ngokusobala ukuthi kunenkinga yokungakwazi ukuhumusha amagama esiNgisi,” kusho uNgwenya ofundisa isiNgisi kwaGrade 11 eKing Dinuzulu High, khona KwaNongoma.Ngale kwamava okufundisa eminyaka ewu-20, uNgwenya uneziqu zemfundo ze-BA in Communication Science ne-Post Graduate Certificate in Education kwase-University of Zululand; neze-BA Honours in Language Practice zase-University of The Free State.
Izelamani zakwaNdimande, uSiyabonga noMalusi, ezalaxaza ibheyili ngesonto eledlule, manje sezithweswe icala. Lezi zelamani zitholwe uhlu lwamacala okubulala ngokusemthethweni kanti zizovela eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini ngoJuni 19, 2026, ukuze kuqalwe uhlelo lwezendlalelo zokuqulwa kwecala, futhi zihlangene nabanye abasolwa abahlanu. Basolwa ngamacala okubulala, itulo lokubulala, nelokuzama ukubulala mayelana nesigameko sokudubula u-AKA noTibz, kanye nokuhlobene namanye amacala okubulala nokugebenga embonini yamatekisi.Omunye wabalandeli abakhulu baka-AKA, obesenkantolo uWade Daniels, uthi ujabulile ngokuthi icala liyaqhubeka ngemuva kokubambezeleka. Ukholelwa ukuthi ukuqulwa kwecala eNkantolo eNkulu kuzoletha izimpendulo futhi kusondeze umndeni kaKienan Forbes (AKA) eduze nobulungiswa kanye nokugoqwa kwalo okulindelwe isikhathi eside. "Sonke silahlekelwe yindoda elungile futhi umndeni wayo kumele uphatheke kabi ngokuthi leli cala lidonswe ngethemba ukuthi bazobuthola maduze ubulungiswa. Ngizizwa ngingcono njengoba icala selizongena enkantolo enkulu ngoba ekugcineni bazoyixazulula inkinga bafune ubulungiswa ngokubulawa kuka-AKA,” kusho uDaniels.
INSELELO yokungabinamali eyanele ngasohlangothini lukahulumeni yenza ungakwazi ukuqasha othisha abadingeka ezikoleni zakuleli. Le nkinga ihlale ivezwa njengenye yezinselelo ezibhekene noMnyango weMfundo eyisiSekelo, njengoba othisha abangaqashiwe begcina sebeqhinqa emahhovisi befuna ukuqashwa.Sekuphenduke insakavukela ukuthi intsha ihlale ikhala kuhulumeni ngokushoda kwamathuba emisebenzi, kulo mkhakha. NoSolwazi uPhumlani Myende, wophiko loMkhakha wezeMfundo lwase-University of KwaZulu-Natal, uthe nakuba ekuqonda ukukhathazeka kwabantu abasha abaneziqu zalo mkhakha kodwa abangasebenzi, kepha ziningi izinselelo eziholela kuleso simo.UMyende uthe akukhona ukuthi amathuba omsebenzi walo mkhakha awasekho, kepha kunezimo ezenza ukuthi uhlelo lokuqasha othisha lungabe lusenzeka ngendlela efanele nobekwenzeka ngayo eminyakeni edlule, lapho othisha abebeqashwa khona kakhulu. "Enye yezingqinamba ezikhona wukuthi uhulumeni awunayo imali eyanele yokuthi kuqashwe futhi kukhokhelwe isibalo sothisha abadingekayo ezikoleni ezweni, lokho kufakazelwa wukuthi ngokomthetho, kumele ngabe amagumbi okufundela aba nezingane eziwu-35 igumbi ngalinye, kepha kwezinye izikole kuba nabafundi abawu-60, ngisho nangaphezulu."Uthe:"Konke lokho kuwuphawu lokuthi inkulu kakhulu inkinga ekhona, kangangokuthi kwezinye izikole kuyenzeka ukuthi kube nothisha abaze baphoqeleke ukufundisa izifundo abangaqeqeshelwe ukuzifundisa ngenxa yokungabi namali kukahulumeni.” Eqhuba, uthe ocwaningweni olwenziwe yiStellenbosch University ngo-2022 kuya ku-2024, kwavela ukuthi enye futhi inkinga ekhona wukuthi kunenqwaba yabantu abaqeqeshelwe umkhakha wobuthishela, kodwa bagabe ngezifundo ezingasadingeki kangako ezikoleni. "Nokuthi futhi kunenkinga yothisha abaqeqeshelwe ukufundisa izifundo zasemabangeni aphezulu ekubeni kube kusobala ukuthi othisha abadingeka kakhulu abazofundisa emabangeni aphansi, okubonakala abantu abaningi bekushalazela lokho,” kusho uMyende.Udalule nokuthi izikhungo zemfundo ephakeme, kumele zibuyekeze indlela ezihlele ngayo izifundo zobuthishela, zingabe zisaxutshwa ngendlela eyenza ukuthi ngisho umuntu esefunde wagogoda kepha kube lukhuni satshe ukuthola umsebenzi ngesicucu sakhe."Akukhuthazwe izingane ukukhetha imikhakha efanele, nezozisiza ukukwazi ukuziphilisa nokuba wusizo ezidingweni zesikhathi esiphila kusona manje. Akungabi lula ukuthi umuntu avele adumele izifundo okungaziwa ukuthi uma eseziphothulile, uzosebenza kuphi."Uthe nalabo abaqeqeshelwe umkhakha wobuthishela neminye imikhakha, kumele bazi futhi baqonde ukuthi akuwona wonke umuntu ozoba nenhlanhla yokuqashwa, ngakho mhlawumbe kungakuhle ukuqala manje babheke amanye amasu okuphila.
UVEZE ubufakazi obusha ayengabuvezanga kwisitatimende esifungelwe sokuvuma icala, uNongcebo Faith Ntombela, ecaleni lokubulawa komyeni wakhe, owayeyiphoyisa eMkhandlwini weTheku, uCaptain Zwelakhe Thomas Ntombela.Umufi kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi wadutshulwa wabulawa esigamekweni esenzeka esemzini wakhe, kwaS, eMlaza, ngoMeyi 3, 2024. Waphuthunyiswa esibhedlela eSiphingo Medical Towers, okuyilapho okwafike kwamenela khona.Ngemuva kwalokho, uFaith, uthishanhloko waseMpumulwane Primary KwaMaphumulo, uMnuz Sithembiso Khumalo, bakhalelwa ngamaSongo kasiGonyela ngaleli cala. UFaith udonsa isigwebo sikadilikajele ngaleli cala, uKhumalo ungaphandle ngebheyili. Kwavela negama lenkabi evele idonsa isigwebo sikadilikajele ngelinye icala, uKhulani Cele. ENkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini, bekungokokuqala ukuba uFaith angene ebhokisini athule ubufakazi. Uveze ukuthi konke kwaqala ngesikhathi eba nokuxhumana noCele, owahubhuza amanga ezibiza ngokuthi uyisikhulu esiphezulu se-African National Congress (ANC), uMnuz Siboniso Duma.Utshele inkantolo ukuthi bebejwayele ukukhuluma noCele ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, engazi ukuthi kanti ukhuluma nenkabi edonsa isigwebo sikadilikajele.''Ngelinye ilanga, ungitshele ukuthi kumele ngiye ejele kukhona umuntu acela ukuba ngiyombheka, nebala ngavuma ngambuza ukuthi ubani loyo, wangitshela ukuthi uK Cele,'' echaza. Uthe wakwenza lokho waya ejele eliseMgungundlovu, iNew Prison, kodwa uthe zabizwa zonke iziboshwa kwaze kwasala yena yedwa ngenxa yokuthi wayengalazi igama eliphelele lomuntu azombona njengoba wayetshelwe ukuthi uK Cele.Eqhuba uthe abasebenza kuleli jele bamsiza bamtshela ukuthi uCele okhona uKhulani.''Bangingenisa, base bembiza uCele weza kimina. Waqhamuka esengibiza ngegama lami, nami ngavuma wangibuza nempilo,'' echaza. Ngemuva kwalokho, uthe yilapho uCele wagonyuluka khona ngokuthi empeleni uyena uDuma lo abekade exhumana naye sonke lesi sikhathi enkundleni yokuxhumana.''Kwangithusa lokho kodwa ngemuva kokuba angilandisa ngayo yonke inkulumo yethu ebesiba nayo, ngabona ukuthi uyena ngempela lo muntu.''Esephindela emuva, uthe waqhubeka waba nokuxhumana "noDuma" kodwa esazi kahle ukuthi unguCele. Kuke kwaba khona isikhathi lapho ecele khona amanzi ekhala ngokoma, wawathola wase ebonakala emamatheka. Uqale wethula ubufakazi ngesiZulu, ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, wagcina esekhuluma isiNgisi. Ebuzwa uMshushisi, u-Advocate Krishen Shah, ukuthi laqala kuphi itulo lokusocongwa komyeni wakhe, uphendule ngokuthi: ''Laqala kuwumbuzo nje nami engawuphendula nginganakile. UCele wangibuza ukuthi ngingakhethani ukuthi kubulawe izingane zami noma umyeni wami? Ngamphendula ngokuthi ngingancamela izingane zami ukuba ziphile." Uthe uCele wabe esemphendula ngokuthi yilokho ke okuzokwenzeka. ''Kwathi uma ngimbuza ukuthi kungani kuzokwenzeka, wangitshela ukuthi umyeni wami akekho ngcwele njengoba mina ngicabanga.''Uphinde wadalula ukuthi uCele wamtshela ukuthi umyeni wakhe usebhizinisini elibucayi lezikhali. ''Angizange ngiyikholwe leyo nto ngesikhathi engitshela yona kodwa wangitshela ukuthi kwisisefo somyeni wami kugcwele inqwaba yezinhlamvu, angofika ngibheke.'' Nebala uthe wakwenza lokho, wakufica futhi ngampela okwakushiwo uCele. Enkantolo ziveziwe izithombe zezinhlamvu okukhulunywa ngazo, wabuzwa ukuthi ngabe yizona yini, wavuma.''Lokhu kwangithusha ngoba ngangazi ukuthi emsebenzini wakhe kakuvumelekile."Utshele inkantolo ukuthi umyeni wakhe wayenezibhamu ezimblili okungesomsebenzi nesinye okwakungesakhe athe sasihlezi sikhona esisefweni. Ebuzwa ukuthi laba yini iqhaza likathishanhloko kuleli tulo, uthe kwaqale kwaba neqhinga lokuqala lokuba umyeni wakhe abulawe ngoshevu kodwa uthi lokho akwenzekanga ngoba waba manqika ukuba akwenze. Uveze ukuthi uCele wamtshela ukuthi ushevu ozosetshenziswa uzowuthola kuKhumalo KwaMaphumulo, nebala uthe waya kuKhumalo wabuya nawo ushevu.Uthe akazange awusebenzise, kunalokho wamane wacabanga ukuthi kumele azibulale yena nokwaholela ekutheni agcine elele esibhedlela. Eqhubeka, uthe seliphunzile lelo qhinga likashevu, kwabe sekuhlelwa leli lokumbulala ngokumdubula.''Kukhona lapho uKhumalo owafika khona kimina ezobheka izibhamu lezi zomyeni wami ukuthi zisesimweni esikahle yini sokuthi zingasebenza. Wazibuyisa emuva kokuzibheka." Ebuzwa ukuthi yini le eyabangela ukuthi amane avume kalula nje ukuthi kubulawe umyeni wakhe singekho nesizathu esibambekayo, uthe wagcina eselingeka ngoba kwase kukhona nabasabisa ukuthi kuzolinyazwa abantwana bakhe.Uveze nokuthi uKhumalo uyena owayekhanda izimoto zikamyeni wakhe, njengoba nangelanga abahlangana ngalo enxanxatheleni yezitolo iMega City eMlaza, yingoba uKhumalo wayezolanda imoto iSuzuki ebovu, ukuze ayoyikhanda. Lobu ngobunye ubufakazi obungazange buvele kuqulwa icala kanjalo nangesikhathi esevuma icala uFaith, ukuthi nomufi wayemazi uKhumalo ngoba enendawo ekhanda izimoto.Mayelana nenkokhelo ka-R150 000 eyayizonikezwa inkabi, uMzo Ntombela, edonsa isigwebo seminyaka engu-20 ngaleli cala, uthe akanalwazi ngayo, okuyinto ephambanayo nekwisitatimende esifungelwe ayevuma kusona icala njengoba kukhona lapho athi khona: ''Kwavunyelwana ngokuthi inkabi izonikezwa u-R150 000." Ummeli kaKhumalo, u-Advocate Mdu Mvune, umbuzile uFaith ukuthi yini athi wayengazi lutho ngenkokhelo manje ekubeni kwisitatimende waveza udaba luka-R150 000.''Ngaluveza ngoba ngazi ngalo ngemuva kokuba esebulewe umyeni wami kodwa ngaphambi kwalokho akukho engangikwazi,'' kuchaza uFaith.U-Advocate Shah umbuzile ukuthi ngabe kukhona yini angathanda ukukusho emndenini kamufi njengoba ukhona enkantolo, uphendule ngokuthi kuningi kodwa wathi uyokusho ngesikhathi esifanele.Nakuba uFaith ethi laqala sambuzo itulo lokusocongwa komyeni wakhe kodwa kukhona lapho enkantolo ake waveza khona ukuthi umyeni wakhe wayemhlukumeza yingakho aze afinyelela kulesi sinqumo.
UMFELANDAWONYE wezinyunyana zabasebenzi, iCosatu, uhlabe ikhwelo kuhulumeni ukuthi uphinde uqhamuke nezinye izindlela zokunciphisa ukuzwela kokunyuka kwentengo kaphethroli nodizili, okulindeleke ukuthi kwenzeke ekuqaleni kukaMeyi.Ekuqaleni kwenyanga intengo yelitha likaphethroli u-93 no-95 inyuke ngo-R3.06. Ekadizili u-500ppm inyuke ngo-R7.37 kwathi elika-50ppm lanyuka ngo-R7.51. Ilitha likapharafini linyuke ngo-R11.67.Lokhu kunyuka kwentengo kudalwe yimpi ephakathi kwe-Iran ne-Israel (ebambisene ne-United States of America). Iphazamise ukuthuthwa kukawoyela ongahluziwe eStrait of Hormuz. Uhulumeni wamemezela ukuthi uzokwehlisa isikhashana intela kaphethroli ngo-R3 isuka ku-R4.10 yaba ngu-R1.10 ilitha. Kudizili yehle isuka ku-R3.93 yaba ngu-R0.93 ilitha kule nyanga futhi kuzophinde kubuyekezwe ngezayo. Lokhu wathi kuzowulahlekisela ngo-R6 billion emnothweni.Uhulumeni ekhasini lawo kwi-X, uveze ukuthi ukunyuka kwentengo kawoyela nokushintshashintsha kwamandla erandi, kulindeleke ukuthi kunyuse intengo kaphethroli ezinyangeni ezizayo.ICosatu ithe imibiko yakamuva yeCentral Energy Fund, iveza ukuthi intengo yelitha likaphethroli ingase yenyuke ngo-R3, R10 elikadizili no-R7 kwelikapharafini. "Lokhu ngokunye ukushayeka emnothweni onyuka ngo-1% kule minyaka engaphezu kuka-10 nasempini yamazinga okungasebenzi aku-41.1%. I-International Monetary Fund isivele ikwehlisile ukuqagela kokunyuka komnotho ngo-2026, yakubeka ku-1% isuka ku-1.4%,” kusho iCosatu.Ithe ukwehliswa kwentela kaphethroli inyanga eyodwa yigxathu elihle kodwa kudingeka okunye ngokushesha. Ithe inovalo lokuthi abasebenzi nomnotho ngeke bakwazi ukumelana nokunye ukunyuka kwentengo kaphethroli, udizili nopharafini."Udizili ubalulekile ezithuthini zomphakathi abasebenzi abathembele kuzo kanjalo nopharafini osetshenziswa yizinkulungwane zemindeni. Abasebenzi bavele bacwile ezikweletini, banakekela izihlobo eziyisikhombisa umsebenzi ngamunye, bachitha u-40% womholo wabo kwezokuthutha futhi ngeke bakwazi ukumelana nokunyuka kwentengo kaphethroli, kadizili nekapharafini.”ICosatu ithe kumele kuphinde kwehliswe intela kaphethroli nenye intela. Ibalule nokuthi kumele kuqhanyukwe nezindlela zokwehlisa intengo kapharafini. Okunye ithe wukuthi kwenziwe izithuthi zomphakathi zishibhe.
UNGQONGQOSHE wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu, uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa, ufuna kuqiniswe izinhlelo zokuvikela abantu kwizinhlekelele ezihlasela kungazelele muntu.UHlabisa uthe izikhukhula zango-2022 KwaZulu-Natal, zenza abantu abevile ku-40 000 bangaba nendawo yokuhlala."Kwafa abantu abangu-500 ngenxa yalezi zikhukhula. Muva nje kube nezikhukhula eLimpopo, ezidale omkhulu umonakalo. Abantu balahlekelwa imizi yabo, baba ondingasithebeni," kusho uHlabisa ekhuluma engqungqutheleni ebibhunga ngezindlela zokubhekana nezinhlekelele ezweni, eGoli muva nje. UHlabisa uthe elakuleli libhekene nesimo sokuhlasela kwezinhlekelele ezehlukene. Ubale izikhukhula, isomiso, imililo yequbula, izimvula ezina ngamandla kanjalo neziphepho."Lokhu kudalwa ukuguquguquka kwesimo sezulu. Kudingeka kube nezinhlelo zokukwazi ukuhlonza izinhlekelele zingakahlaseli." Ukhale ngokuthi abesifazane, izingane, abaphila nokukhubazeka nabadala, yibona ababa yizisulu zezinhlekelele. "Noma ikhona imithetho yezinhlekelele kodwa ngeke isebenze iyodwa. Kudingeka ubuholi obunqala ukubhekana nalesi simo. Kudingeka nokubambisana ezinhlakeni ezehlukene ukuze inqotshwe le mpi." Uthe kudingeka kwenziwe izinhlelo kusenesikhathi kuphinde kube nezinto ezizosheshe zihlonze uma kuzoba nenhlekelele ukuze kusheshe kuxwayiswe abantu."Omasipala baneqhaza elibalulekile odabeni lwezinhlekelele. Kodwa babhekene nezinselelo, ezinye zazo zifaka indawo okwakhiwe kuyona imizi, ukuvumbuka kwemijondolo kanjalo nezinye. Kudingeka kucetshiswe abantu ngolwazi ngezinhlekelele." Ubalule nobuchwepheshe wathi buneqhaza elibalulekile ekutheni kusheshe kuhlonzwe izinhlekelele.Uthe kumele kwakhiwe ingqalasizinda esezingeni ukuze ikwazi ukumelana nesimo esinzima sokushintsha kwezulu.
BABHEKENE nengwadla omastende abakhala ngokuqonga kwezindleko zamanzi, ugesi kanjalo nezinye izinto kulabo abaqashise izitshudeni ezikhokhelwa yisikhwama esixhasa ngemali yokufunda ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme nasemakolishi amakhono amaTVET KwaZulu-Natal, iNational Students' Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS).Labo mastende bakhala ngokuthi selokhu kuqale unyaka, abakaze bakhokhelwe yiNSFAS. Bathe iNSFAS izisabisa okwenyoka izitshudeni, bona ayibashayi ndiva ngoba ziyabhikisha uma imihlomulo yazo ingangenanga.Omunye womastende okhulume neSolezwe, wacela ukungavezwa, uthe sebecabanga ngisho ukukhipha izitshudeni, ngenxa yokuthi abakhokhelwe. "Asazi manje ukuthi kumele senzenjani, ngoba sihambise yonke into ezikhungweni nakwiNSFAS, kodwa kuze kube yimanje asikakhokhelwa. Konke okuthinta imininingwane yezitshudeni, nokusayinwa kwezinkontileka kwahanjiswa kodwa lutho imali."Umastende uveze ukuthi uma sekumele bakhokhelwe, uhlelo olusha olusetshenziswayo luyabakhahlela."Senza ubuntu ngoba iNSFAS isikhokhela izinyanga ezingu-10 kuphela ngonyaka, kodwa thina siyazamukela izitshudeni kusuka ngoJanuwari ngoba zisuke zingenayo indawo yokufihla ikhanda. Sikwenza lokhu ngoba sisuke singafuni ukuthi zihlupheke, noma zilale endle kodwa thina asicatshangelwa futhi asibongwa ngokwenza lokhu." Uthe bafuna ukukhokhelwa okungokwabo kusuka ngoFebhuwari kuze kube yimanje."Kuyophela u-Ephreli manje kodwa lutho imali. Siqashe onogada ezindaweni zethu okuhlala kuzo izitshudeni. Sikhokhela ugesi, amanzi nabanye abasebenzi abahlanza lezi zindawo. Sikhokhela ngisho i-WiFi ukuze izitshudeni zikwazi ukufunda. Sesicabanga nokungazikhokheli zonke lezi zidingo ukuze sifake ingcindezi yokuthi sikhokhelwe."Omunye umastende naye ocele ukungavezwa, uthe bekuzoshuba ukuba bekuyizitshudeni ezingayitholi imihlomulo. "Ngabe kume nse yonke into manje ukuba bekuyizitshudeni ezingayitholi imihlomulo yazo. Akekho umuntu okungaphela izinyanga ezingaka engakhokhelwe bese engawi bhu. Bayasiwisa bhu phansi ngoba sizogcina sesivala ngenxa yokungakhokhelwa," kusho lo mastende othe, sebejahwa omashonisa futhi abasakwazi nokuthola imali emabhange. Uthe phambilini iXquel, iyona eyayikhokhelwa yiNSFAS, ukuze ikhokhele omastende abazimele eKZN kodwa yaphucwa la mandla."Manje sekudingeka umastende axhumane ngqo neNSFAS. Asikwazi ukuxhumana neNSFAS ngoba akukho mnyango obhekele imali esingakwazi ukuxhumana nawo uma singakhokhelwe. Sidukuza ebumnyameni ekubeni yonke into efunwa yiNSFAS sayenza singomastende." Empendulweni ebhekiswe kwiSolezwe ekhishwe ngaphansi kwebamba lesikhulu esiphezulu seNSFAS uMnuz Waseem Carrim, ithe abalesi sikhwama yibona asebengamele uhlelo lokukhokhelwa komastende.Ithe ukuze kungabambezeleki ukukhokhelwa komastende, imininingwane yabo yasemabhange kumele iqinisekiswe (verified) ukuze uhlelo lokukhokhelwa lungabakhahleli."Inombolo kamazisi noma yokubhaliswa kwebhizinisi, kumele ihambisane ne-akhawunti yasebhange. Isibongo noma igama lenkampani kumele kuhambisane nomnikazi we-akhawunti," kusho iNSFAS.INSFAS ithe isixoxile nezinhlangano ezimele omastende, ngezinselelo ezithinta ukukhahlelwa komastende uma sekumele bakhokhelwe nebhange iFNB, ukuze kucetshiswe omastende ngokumele bakwenze.
INYUNYANA yothisha iSadtu isiphakamise ukuthi ifuna ukuthi kugxilwe ekufundiseni ngomlando wase-Afrika esifundweni i-History ezikoleni zakuleli. Le nyunyana isamile ekutheni ifuna lesi sifundo sibe yimpoqo kubona bonke abafundi.ISadtu isho lokhu nje, uMnyango weMfundo eyisiSekelo, ukhiphele umphakathi ukuthi uphawule ngemigomo ethinta lesi sifundo somlando ezikoleni. UMnyango ukwenze lokhu ukuze uqinise ukufundiswa kwalesi sifundo, kusuka kaGrade 4 kuya kaGrade 12.UNobhala Jikelele weSadtu, uDkt Mugwena Maluleke, uthe bebelokhu besho ukuthi bafuna kugxilwe ekufundiseni ngomlando othinta izwekazi i-Afrika, hhayi amazwe aphesheya. "Sifuna kugxilwe ekufundisweni ngezinto ezithinta i-Afrika, kungagxilwa kakhulu ezintweni ezithinta amazwe ase-Europe. Sethemba ukuthi le migomo ekhishelwe umphakathi, nathi esizophawula ngayo nge-History, izobalula eyokuthi sibe yimpoqo lesi sifundo." Uthe uma isifundo siyimpoqo, sizokwenza ukuthi abafundi bazi la besuka khona nokuthi kwenzakalani ezweni labo.UMnuz Terence Khala oyibamba lomkhulumeli woMnyango, uthe bese kunesikhathi bebheka izindlela zokubuyekeza ukufundiswa kwalesi sifundo ezikoleni. Uthe kwaqokwa nethimba elalibheka ukubuyekezwa kwalesi sifundo eMnyangweni. "Leli thimba lalibheka indaba yokuthi kubuyekezwe uhlelo lokufundisa lesi sifundo, ukubheka ukuthi izincwadi zalesi sifundo zihambisana nokuphakanyisiwe ngokufundiswa kwalesi sifundo kanjalo nezinhlelo zokucija othisha abafundisa lesi sifundo. Umbiko wethimba wathulwa ePhalamende, esigungwini soNgqongqoshe bezemfundo, kanjalo naku-Umalusi."Uthe bazwile ngokuphawula okukhona okuthinta ukufundiswa komlando ngelakuleli, njengoba kunabakhathazekile ngokuthi kungenzeka kushiywe ngaphandle ezinye zezinto. UNDUNANKULU waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, uthe kuyamkhathaza ukungathathelwa ngokushesha izinyathelo zokuqondiswa kobugwegwe kwezikhulu zeminyango kahulumeni wesifundazwe, ezisolwa enkohlakalweni kanye neziphula imithetho yokuphathwa kwemali.UNtuli uthe ukungathathelwa ngokushesha izinyathelo kwezikhulu ezisolwa enkohlakalweni, kwenza ukuthi abantu bangawuthembi uhulumeni. Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma emhlanganweni weKhabhinethi yesifundazwe okhethekile, obuhanjelwe yizo zonke izinhloko zeminyango kahulumeni wesifundazwe.Esitatimendeni, uNtuli uthe bafuna ukuthi bathathelwe izinyathelo ngokushesha abangawulandeli umthetho wokuphathwa kwemali. "Ngesikhathi singena emandleni, sazibophezela ngokuthi sizoyiphatha ngobuqotho imali yomphakathi. Siphelile isikhathi senkohlakalo, ukukhwabanisa kanye nesabantu abahlulwa wukwenza umsebenzi wabo. Ukungathathelwa ngokushesha izinyathelo kwabasolwa enkohlakalweni, kwenza ngibe nomuzwa wokuthi abantu bazobona sengathi bayayekwa abenza okuphambene nomthetho. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi abantu bangawuthembi uhulumeni wesifundazwe. Akufanele sigcine ngokukhuluma nje, kodwa kufanele sihambe emazwini esawasho ngesikhathi sizibophezela ekuholeni ngobuqotho."UNtuli uthe uyazi ukuthi kwesinye isikhathi ukuqondiswa ubugwegwe kwezikhulu kubanjezelwa wukuthi kunemigomo okufanele ilandelwe uma kunohlelo lokuqondiswa ubugwegwe."Kufanele kube nezingxoxo nezinye izinhlaka ezifana neSpecial Investigating Unit, ukuze kubonakale ukuthi zingaxazululwa kanjani izinkinga ezibambezela ukuqondiswa kobugwegwe. Kufanele kube khona indlela yokusebenzisana ezokwenza ukuthi bathathelwe izinyathelo ngokushesha abathintekayo."UNtuli uphinde watshela izikhulu zeminyango ukuba ziqinisekise ukuthi bakhokhelwa zingakapheli izinsuku ezingu-30, osomabhizinisi abasuke benikwe amathenda."Umthetho obekwe wuMnyango kaMgcinimafa uthi kufanele iminyango kahulumeni ikhokhele usomabhizinisi zingakapheli izinsuku ezingu-30, ngaphandle uma kunezizathu ezivimba ukuthi umnyango uhlangabezane nalo mnqamulajuqu. Yonke iminyango kahulumeni kufanele ilwele ukuthi ibakhokhela bonke osomabhizinisi zingakapheli izinsuku ezibekiwe. Ukukhokha ngesikhathi kweminyango kahulumeni, kuzokwenza ukuthi amabhizinisi amancane angaphazamiseki kuphinde kudaleke namathuba emisebenzi."

Lokhu kwenzenge ngoLwesithathu cishe ngabo-09:30 ekuseni, isikhulu sezokuHlunyeleliswa kwezimilo esisejele laseBoksburg, ngesikhathi senza imisebenzi ejwayelekile yokulawula ukungena, senze uphenyo ezimotweni ezingena emagcekeni. Ngesikhathi kuseshwa, lesi sikhulu simise imoto emhlophe ye-SAPS ebinamalungu amabili e-SAPS, oyedwa egqoke umfaniswano wamaphoyisa, omunye egqoke izingubo zabantu. Ngesikhathi lisesha imoto, isikhulu sithole upulasitiki oluhlaza esinamaphilisi e-mandrax angu-82 kanye nensangu, ufihlwe ngaphansi kwesihlalo. Amaphoyisa amabili abe eseboshiwe. Laba bobabili bazovela enkantolo maduze.

LIFUNA ubulungiswa iphoyisa lesifazane elithi lihlukunyezwa uwmphathi walo. Leli phoyisa elicele ukuba kugodlwe igama lalo lithe selikhathele manje yile mpilo. Liveze ukuthi kusukela ngo-2013 lihlukunyezwa wumphathi walo elingazi ukuthi kumayelana nani.Lithe selize lavula icala njengoba umphathi walo eke walixhimfa ngesibhakela phakathi emsebenzini."Angisazi ukuthi kumele ngiyithini mina le nto kodwa iyangihlukumeza kakhulu. Lo muntu kuyacaca ukuthi ubona ingane encane lapha kimina. Selokhu ngazalwa ubaba nomama, angikaze ngihlukunyezwe kanjena mina," lisho kanje. Okulikhathazayo wukuthi lidukuza ebumnyameni ngomnyombo wokuhlukunyezwa kwalo wumphathi."Ngabe kungcono ukuba ngiyazi ukuthi sibangani manje ngidikekile futhi kakhulu," kuchaza iphoyisa.Lithe inkinga yaqala ngesikhathi lifelwe yimoto selifika emva kwesikhathi emsebenzini."Kukhona lapho angishaya khona waze wangitshela ukuthi kumele ngazi ukuthi angisiyo indoda. Liveze nokuthi alithandi nokudalula igama lesiteshi okwamanje ephepheni."Loya muntu wenza noma yini noma yikanjani akekho umuntu ongamazi. Uma ebhekene nawe usuke uvelelwe, unesihluku loya baba," lisho kanje.Lithe likholwa wukuthi lukhona usizo elizoluthola uma liphumela obala ngalolu daba. Liveze ukuthi elinye icala lalivula ngo-2013, kodwa alazi ukuthi kwenzekani laphinda lalivula nangonyaka odlule."Angazi noma la macala ayasebenza yini kodwa ngisola sengathi ngidlala ngesikhathi nje," lichaza.Kuyimanje lithe lisamile ukusebenza ngoba seliyagula ngenxa yempatho engeyinhle emsebenzini. Liveze nokuthi selize licabange nokuzibulala ngenxa yobunzima elibhekene nabo. Lidalule nokuthi like lacela ukuthi lishintshelwe kwesinye isiteshi kodwa kwaba uyena futhi umphathi walo owathi lutho eLuthela sihlezi nawe la.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uLieutenant Colonel Paul Magwaza, ukuqinisekisile ukuvulwa kwecala mayelana nalolu daba. KUQOPHEKE umlando ngesikhathi inhlangano yamatekisi iSouth and North Beach Taxi Association, ngaphansi kweSantaco, inikeza abashayeli izindondo ngokusebenza kwabo kahle nangokuzikhandla. Lo mcimbi wezindondo ebeziqala ngqa ukuba khona, ubuseCoastlands Hotel, eMusgrave, muva nje. Abashayeli bebeklonyeliswa ngokuhluka kweminxa abebeqokwe kuyona.USihlalo waseSouth and North Beach Taxi Association, uMnuz Yusuv Khaliva, uthe inhlosongqangi yale miklomelo wukukhombisa abantu ukuthi bayawubona umsebenzi wabashayeli bamatekisi kule mboni. Uthe futhi bebehlose kakhulu ukuthi kube nento abayenzayo ukukhuthaza abashayeli bamatekisi.''Bekumqoka kakhulu ukuthi kube khona into esiyenzayo ukuze sikhuthaze abashayeli bamatekisi. Iqiniso phela kumele livele ukuthi mkhulu kakhulu umsebenzi abawenzayo laba bantu. Konke esiyikhona kungenxa yabo njengoba bevuka njalo ekuseni bethutha abantu,'' usho kanje. Uthe ngabe benza iphutha elikhulu uma bengase bakushalazele ukuthi inkulu kakhulu indima eklanywa abashayeli bamatekisi kule mboni.''Abasizi thina kuphela kodwa basiza nomphakathi ukuze ufinyelele kalulula emsebenzini njalo ekuseni. Abagcini lapho baphinde baqinisekise ukuthi bayababuyisela abantu emakhaya nantambama, okuyinto omunye umuntu angathatha sengathi ilula kanti akunjalo,'' kuchaza uKhaliva.Uthe bahlale phansi babonisana ngokuthi mabasungule le miklomelo ukuze kube khona into ezobakhuthaza abashayeli babo. Uthe bangajabula kakhulu uma nabanye benza into enjengalena abayenzile. ''Kungaba yinto enhle kakhulu uma nabanye ososeshini bengakwenza lokhu ukuze kube yinto eyenziwa yiKwaZulu-Natal yonkana,'' kuchaza yena.Ezinye izikhulu ebeziyingxenye yalo mcimbi zikhuthaze kakhulu ukusebenzisana phakathi kwabagibeli nabashayeli. Kulo mcimbi okuqaphelekile kakhulu kube yindlela abashayeli ebebeswenke ngayo njengoba bebefake amasudi amibalabala.Umshayeli ovelele kube nguMnuz Bongani Malimela, okhale wemuka nesheke lika-R5 000. Ubonge kakhulu ngokuthi kugcine kube uyena othola le ndondo. Uthe lokhu kumakhele isithombe sokuthi uyakwazi ukuxhumana kahle nabagibeli bakhe njengoba ukuze anqobe bekumele anxenxe abagibeli ukuba bamvotele.Phakathi kweminye iminxa ebikhona kukhona nowemoto ehlanzekile, owomshayeli oqokwe ngabanye abashayeli ngenxa yendlela aziphatha ngayo, oka-rank manager neminye eminingi. Bonke abaklonyelisiwe bamukeliswe amasheke.
ISAZI sezomthetho wokusetshenziswa kwezinkundla zokuxhumana, uNkk Emma Sadleir, simile ekutheni indodakazi yomholi weMKP, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, uNkk Duduzile Zuma-Sambudla, yayilokhu iyiphehlile eyodweshu ngesikhathi sezibhelu zango-2021.Sikusho lokhu izolo, ngesikhathi sifakaza eNkantolo eNkulu eThekwini, lapho ummeli kaNkk Zuma-Sambudla, u-Advocate Dali Mpofu, ekhale ngokuthi lo ngoti ufakaza ngaphandle kombiko ofanele, obizwa ngokuthi i-expert report.Lo ngoti ubehlonywa ngemibuzo ngobufakazi bakhe abethula phambilini, abuqoqa enkundleni yokuxhumana i-X, wase ebhala i-memorandum ngalokho akuthola. Wabe esenikezela ngombono wakhe ngokuziphatha kukaNkk Zuma-Sambudla. UNkk Sadleir utshele inkantolo ukuthi umqulu awusebenzisile ukwethula ngawo ubufakazi bakhe i-memorandum, akuwona umbiko (expert report). Uthe lokhu kwenzeka ngesizathu sokuthi abophiko loKlebe abeza kuye ukuzomtshela ukuthi kudingeka acubungule okwakubhalwe ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, abazange babuye kuye ukuzomtshela ukuthi ahlanganise lo mbiko ngoba uzoba wufakazi enkantolo. Uthe wathi uma esebizelwa enkantolo, waphoqeleka ukuthi athule ubufakazi bakhe esebenzisa ayekubhale kwi-memorandum.Uthe mabili amacala abophiko loKlebe ababethe bafuna abalekelele kuwo; elokuqala elalabo ababegqugquzela udlame besebenzisa inkundla yokuxhumana uWhatsApp, bese elesibili kube eliqondene nommangalelwa (uNkk Zuma-Sambudla).Uthe emva kokuhlanganisa i-memorandum yakhe eyayihambisana nombono wakhe wokuthi likhona icala okufanele aliphendule enkantolo ummangalelwa, wabe eseyihambisa kwabophiko loKlebe. Emphosa imibuzo uMpofu, uthe bashaya amakhala ngokwethula kwakhe ubufakazi ngaphandle kombiko wesazi (expert report). "Uyavuma kodwa ukuthi lo mqulu othule ngawo ubufakazi akuyona i-expert report kodwa yi-memorandum? Sizophakamisa ukuthi ubufakazi bakho buchithwe ngoba inkantolo ayikwazi ukulalela ubufakazi besazi ngaphandle kombiko,” kubeka uMpofu.UNkk Sadleir uphendule ngelithi ukuthi ubufakazi bakhe ubethule ngaphandle kombiko, abukuguquli ubuqiniso balokho akuthola njengesazi. Wengeze ngelithi ngisho ngabe wayewuhlanganisile umbiko uMpofu ambuza ngawo, wayezothatha khona lokhu akubhale kwi-memorandum, akunameke lapho ayezobhala khona umbiko.Uthe akazange asazi isizathu esenza oKlebe bangabe besabuyela kuyena ukuzomtshela ukuthi akahlanganise umbiko wesazi. Ecacisa ngokunye athi wakuthola, uthe kwakungama-tweet angu-2 uNkk Zuma-Sambudla awafaka ekhasini lakhe esikhathini esingamahora angu-36 kulandela ukuboshwa kukayise.Phakathi kwawo, uthe kwakukhona eyayithi "Siyanibona” ("we see you”), athe wayebalula izindawo ezehlukene lapho okwase kuqubuke khona udlame. UNkk Sadleir uthe ngokucubungula kwakhe, lokhu kwakukhombisa ukuthi ugqugquzela udlame, kukhombisa injabulo, ukuthakasela kanjalo nokubonga.Uthe ikhasi lomuntu ofana noNkk Zuma-Sambudla lithathwa njengelinomthelela kubantu njengoba linabalandeli abangaphezu kuka-360 000. Uveze nokuthi ungumuntu odumile, ozalwa owayengumengameli nakho okuba nomthelela ekutheni into ayishoyo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, ilalelwe abantu abaningi. Uveze ukuthi lokhu kwabonakala nangesibalo sabantu abaphinde bafaka ayekuphanyeke kule nkundla yakhe emakhasini abo.IJaji uMnuz Mbuzeni Mathenjwa, lilihlehlisele inamuhla icala, ukuze kulethwe ufakazi omusha.UNkk Zuma-Sambudla, ubeswenke econsa ngesudi yakhe emnyama, eshaye nezicathulo zakhe ezimnyama ezihambela phezulu. Ubebukeka ezikhululekele, kuthi uma kuthathwa ikhefu, abonakale exhawula abeMKP ebebezomeseka, aphinde athathe izithombe nalabo ebebefuna ukushutha naye. Phakathi kwabebezomeseka bekukhona noyilungu leMKP ePhalamende, uMnuz Vusi Shongwe.
ASIBANGE sisalalelwa izolo, eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini, isicelo sombango wamafa ophakathi kowayeyiphoyisa likaMasipala weTheku, uMnuz S'bu Mpisane nowayengunkosikazi wakhe, uNksz Shauwn Mkhize.Bekulindeleke ukuthi inkantolo ilalele isicelo sombango wamafa kulandela isehlukaniso somshado esakhishwa yinkantolo ngoNovemba 2024. Nokho kwagcina kungafinyelelwanga ekutheni bazohlukaniselana kanjani amafa. UMpisane ufuna kubuyekezwe izinto ezimbalwa mayelana nokwahlukaniselana kwamafa njengoba babeshade umshado owahlanganisayo. UMpisane obeswenke ngesudi emnyama enemikhono emfishane, ubonakale efika enkantolo ngethemba lokuthi udaba lwakhe luzolalelwa. Nokho ubonakale eqhwetshwa ebizelwa ngaphandle ngabameli bakhe, ukuyongqumuza okuthile, okuthe emva kwesikhathi babonakala bephuma behamba. Ubebukela ezikhululekele ebusweni, engakhombisi kudinwa noma kuphatheka kabi. Isolezwe lithole ukuthi abameli bakhe belulekwe ngokuthi bambhalele incwadi uNksz Mkhize, emphoqa ukuba abekhona enkantolo uma sekulalelwa isicelo sikaMpisane. Ngaleso sizathu icala lagcina lingahlalanga, kwangacaca nokuthi lizophinde lihlale nini. Ngokwamaphepha asenkantolo, uMpisane ufuna kubuyekelwe isigaba sesibili sencwadi yesehlukaniso, ukuze kwengezwe ezinye izinto, eveza eyombango oqhubekayo wempahla abayithola ngesikhathi beshade umshado ohlanganisa amafa. Umshado walaba ababili wabhidlika emva kweminyaka eyevile ku-20 beshadile. Kwenzeka lokhu nje, uNksz Mkhize ujahwa abe-South African Revenue Service (SARS) ngesikweletu sentela ebalelwa phakathi kuka-R37 million kuya ku-R40 million.
UHULUMENI ushicilele imigomo yokulawula ukusebenza kwe-Artificial Intelligence (AI), wase umema umphakathi ukuthi uphawule ngayo kuze kube wu-4 ntambama ngoJuni 10.Le migomo ishicilelwe wuMnyango wezokuXhumana nobuChwepheshe kusomqulu kahulumeni ngoLwesihlanu. Uhulumeni ukuhlukanise ngokwezigaba ezintathu ukwethulwa kwemigomo. Ngonyaka-zimali wokuqala osongwe ngenyanga edlule, ubeke eqhulwini ukuthi kuphothule imiyalelo futhi ubheke imigomo ephuthumayo ye-AI.Ngo-2026/27, ufuna ukuqala ushicilele imiyalelo futhi ulawule imikhakha esengcupheni kwi-AI. Ngonyaka zimali ka-27/28, ufuna imigomo isebenze ngokugcwele futhi uyithuthukise ihambisane nokushintsha kwayo i-AI. Uhulumeni uthe ufuna ukuthi imigomo iholele ekutheni kunyuke ukusetshenziswa kwe-AI ezikhungweni zomphakathi, ezizimele nasemphakathini.Ufuna i-AI idale amathuba omsebenzi. Ufuna kusetshenziswe i-AI ukugcina ulimi, ubuciko, nomculo kwakudala. Abantu okubhekwe ukuthi bahlomule ngemigomo ngabantu abasha, izingane, abesifazane abaphila nokukhubazeka, osomabhiiznisi, abatshalimali nezikhungo zikahulumeni. Kunabasebenzisa i-AI ukwenza imifanekiso engekho, umuntu ebonakala enza noma esho into angakaze ayisho.Uhulumeni ufuna kusungulwe nesikhwama esifana nesokunxephezela abalimale emgwaqweni i-Road Accident Fund. Lesi ngesokunxephezela abantu noma izikhungo i-AI, ethathe izinqumo ngabo kodwa ezingashayi emhloleni kungaziwa kuzogxekwa bani.Isibonelo, kungaba yi-AI enqaba isicelo sokuboleka imali kungafanele, imifanekiso okungeyona ngomuntu okungaziwa yenziwe ngubani, ukulinyazwa wumsihini osebenza nge-AI nokunye.I-AI ifuna kuvikelwe nezingane ezikhangisweni ze-AI, ezingenza ukuthi zichithe isikhathi esithe xaxa zidlala amakhompyutha noma amaselula.
Utholakale edindilizilw emotweni umsolwa ozilimaze ehlomisa iziqhumane ngesikhathi kugetshengwa imali enkabeni yedolobha laseKranskop ngoMsombuluko, 13 Ephreli 2026.Lo mlisa utholakale eshonile emotweni ebisetshenziswa ebugebengwini emgwaqeni owubhuqu ngaseTugela River, obheke eNkandla ngoLwesibili, 14 Ephreli 2026. Imoto yemali ibanjwe ntambama kwathathwa imali engadalulwanga kanti onogada abathathu kubikwa ukuthi baphucwe izibhamu. Kubikwa ukuthi kuphinde kwadunwa izimoto ezine ezisetshenziswe abasolwa ukubalekela. Abasolwa baphinde badubula bebhekise esiteshini samaphoyisa ngesikhathi kubanjwa inkunzi, nokho alikho iphoyisa noma ilungu elilimale. Umkhankaso wokuthungatha abanye abasolwa, okukholakala ukuthi okungenani bangu-12, uyaqhubeka.

IBISIYIBONA indlela yayo ingwazi yeLadysmith Black Mambazo, uMdletshe Albert Mazibuko, edlule emhlabeni ngeSonto eledule, emuva kokugula njengoba igcizelele kumfowabo isesibhedlela ukuthi ifuna ukufihlwa kuphi ngaphambi kokuthi kuyenele ngakusasa.UMazibuko (77) ushonele esibhedlela esiseThekwini, emuva kokugula isikhashana. Umfowabo u-Abednigo Mazibuko, oke wacula kwiMambazo ngaphambi kokuthatha umhlalaphansi, uthe uMazibuko wazisholo yena ukuthi ufuna ukufihlwa kubo eNtabamhlophe, Estcourt."Ubengaqali, wakusho futhi kudala ukuthi uma ehamba ufuna ukuya ekhaya. Nakulokhu esegula ngiyombona esibhedlela kuwuMgqibelo, kanti uzohamba ngeSonto, washo wathi ningibeke eceleni kukamfowethu. Niyabona ngapha eduze kwesango. Ngadumala ngoba mina nginethemba lokuthi lo muntu uzophila, wase ekhuluma amagama anzima asinda kangaka. Wathi ningibeke ekhaya impela, ngifuna ukuya ekhaya eduze kukamfowethu. Usethuse kanti usekhuluma okokugcina,” kusho u-Abednigo. U-Abednigo ubekhuluma esithangamini nabezindaba eClermont, izolo, emzini womsunguli weMambazo ongasekho, uJoseph Shabalala. Uthe umfowabo ugule isikhathi esincane kodwa kwamqinisa waze wahlinzwa.Umchaze njengomuntu obenenhlonipho, ehlonipha wonke umuntu kungakhathalele ukuthi mncane noma mdala. Uthe balahlekelwe yisibani ebesegcine nomlando womndeni. Uphethe ngokubonga ukwesekwa wathi bathola izingcingo nemiyalezo evela ngisho phesheya kwezilwandle.URussel Mthembu oyilungu leMambazo eselathatha umhlalaphansi, uthe uMazibuko wayehlale ebagqugquzela ukuthi basebenze kanzima. "Wayethi sisalima, mhla saphumelela umhlabathi uzophenduka igolide, kwenzeka njengoba esho.”ILadysmith Black Mambazo ibuye ngeSonto, eNingizimu Afrika, emuva kokuphothula umjikelezo wase-United States of America (USA).Omunye wabaholi bayo uSibongiseni Shabalala, uthe ngesikhathi bethola izindaba zokudlula kukaMazibuko, babeyohlola imishini yokucula ngaphambi kwekhonsathi yabo kwaba nzima nokuqhubeka. "Kwase kusele imicimbi emine kuya kwemihlanu ukuthi siqede, sibuye. Saqhubeka sayenza sesiyibhekise kuye uMazibuko ngoba sazi ukuthi ukuba ubekhona, ubezosigqugquzela ukuthi asiqhubeke siyibambe kuyona le ndlela abeyihamba.”Uthe uMazibuko, owajoyina iMambazo ngo-1969 nobesethathe umhlalaphansi, ubesadlala indima eqenjini uma lizilolonga aphinde alikhumbuze lapho eliduka khona."Sifunde okukhulu thina kubaba uMazibuko kusuka sijoyina ngo-1993. Ukuzimisela, ukugcina isikhathi nokuthanda umsebenzi safunda futhi sesiphakathi eMambazweni, nokubambisana nokulalelana ukuthi yikhona okwenza iphupho liphumelele,” kusho uSibongiseni.USibongiseni uveze ukuthi bacele ukulindwa babuye phesheya ukuze bezovalelisa ngaphambi komngcwabo. UMazibuko uzokhonjulwa enkonzweni ezoba seCFCI eBerea, eThekwini ngo-10 ekuseni kusasa. Inkonzo yomngcwabo izoba sesikoleni iMtshezi High, Estcourt ngoMgqibelo ekuseni.
Amaphoyisa aseWestern Cape azwakalise ukukhathazeka okukhulu ngemuva kwesigameko sokubulawa kwathathu eGugulethu ngoMsombuluko ebusuku. Isigameko sokudubula senzeke cishe ngabo-8.22 ebusuku. Owesithathu wesilisa utholwe ngaphandle kwegceke enenxeba lokudutshulwa ekhanda. Abesilisa abashonile baneminyaka engu-33 no-46 ubudala," kusho uTraut. KUHLOSWE ukuthi kulungiswe inkinga yokuvunwa kwezihlahla ngokwedlulele kanjalo nokuzingelwa kwezilwane okungekho emthethweni, ngekhemisi labelaphi bendabuko elivulwe yinhlangano yokongiwa kwemvelo esiqiwini iHluhluwe iMfolozi Park (HiP) ngoMgqibelo.Lokhu kushiwe uMphathiswa woMnyango wezokuThuthukiswa koMnotho, ezokuVakasha nezeMvelo KwaZulu-Natal, uMfundisi Musa Zondi, obeyingxenye yalo mcimbi.Kuthiwa bonke abelaphi bendabuko abasemthethweni, sebezothenga izihlahla kanjalo nokunye okufana namathambo, amafutha, izikhumba zezilwane ezithile nokunye kuleli khemisi elethiwe ngokuthi iseMpilweni Warehouse. UZondi uthe ukukhula kokuvunwa kwezihlahla nokuzingelwa kwezilwane okungekho emthethweni, okuholele ekutheni basibone isidingo sokuvula indawo efuze le, ezodayisa lezi zinto ngokusemthethweni. "Ukuvunwa kwazo okungekho emthethweni nokudayiswa kwazo emakethe engavumelekile, kuyingozi kwimvelo kanjalo nakulezo zitshalo nezilwane ezisengcupheni yokushabalala,” kusho uZondi.Uthe ukwakhiwa kwaleli khemisi akwenziwanga njengoba kulula kodwa kwenziwe ngoba kubonakala isidingo. "Besibhekene nenkinga enkulu yokudayiswa nokuthengwa obekungalawuleki, ukuvuna okwedlulele ezindaweni ezivikelekile yize kunezimvume,” usho kanje. Udalule ukuthi lokhu bekugcina kuholela ekutheni kulahleke imali emakethe engakahleleki. Uthe konke okuzodayiswa kule ndawo kuzobe kuqinisekisiwe, kulandeleka futhi kuyamene nemithetho ehambisana nokongiwa kwemvelo. Uveze ukuthi kubalulekile ukuthi kuqhakambiswe ukuthi le ndawo yenzelwe ukweseka ababelaphi bendabuko. Ubalule nokuthi lokhu kuzobuyisa kabusha isithunzi kwezokwelapha, ubuqotho kanjalo nokusimamisa kezokwelapha ngendabuko. UZondi uthe imali ezophuma ekudayisweni kwalezi zinto, izophinde itshalwe ukuphindaphinda okufanayo. Uthe ikhemisi lenzeke layimpumelelo ngokubambisana kwezeMvelo KZN Wildlife, SAPPI, Provincial People and Parks, kanjalo neNyuvesi yaKwaZulu-Natal, wathi kulindeleke ukuthi le ndawo iqale ukusebenza ngokugcwele emva kwezinsuku eziyisikhombisa.Uveze nokuthi bahlela ukuthi eminyakeni emihlanu ezayo, kube sekukhona amakhemisi afana naleli nakwezinye izingxenye zesifundazwe.

Lokhu kuvezwe uNobhala Jikelele weNFP obambile, uMnuz Sunset Xaba, encwadini ayibhekise ezinhlakeni zeqembu.UNksz Shinga ubekade ebhekene nekomiti lokuqondiswa ubugwegwe, emva kokuba ashaya indiva umyalelo weqembu wokuba aseke isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, esasifakwe yiMKP.I-NFP iyona engababeki benkosi esiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal. UXaba uthe embikweni wesikhashana, ulahlwe yiwo wonke amacala abhekene nawo. "Isinqumo sekomiti siveza obala ubucayi bamacala awenzile. Isinqumo siyisifundo kulabo abangafuni ukulandela umthetho. Onke amalungu kufanele ahloniphe umthetho weqembu, akukhathaleki ukuthi uphethe siphi isikhundla."UXaba uthe ikomiti kulindeleke ukuthi likhiphe isigwebo ngoLwesithathu."Amalungu ekomiti elibhekelele ukusebenza kwansuku zonke kwiNFP, ayanxuswa ukuba alungiselele ukukhishwa kwesigwebo. Ayanxuswa ukuba aqhubeke nokuhola iqembu ngokucophelela." Umthombo ongaphakathi uthe kulindeleke ukuthi iNFP imxoshe uNksz Shinga ekubeni yilungu leqembu, okuzomlahlekisela ngesikhundla sokuba uMphathiswa.Uqhuba umthombo, uthe iNFP ihlela ukufaka umholi wayo, uMnuz Ivan Barnes, esikhundleni sikaNksz Shinga."Bake bazama vele ukukhipha uNksz Shinga befake uBarnes kodwa bahluleka. Bazophinde bazame futhi." I-NFP ijwayele ukuhlulwa emacaleni lapho isuke izama ukuxosha abantu ebajube ezikhundleni."Ukuxoshwa kukaNksz Shinga kungabeka engcupheni uhulumeni wokubambisana ophethe esifundazweni. Ukuphuma kweNFP kuhulumeni wesifundazwe kungashiya amaqembu abusa ngokubambisana nezihlalo ezingu-40 kwezingu-80 esiShayamthetho.Ubuholi beNFP kade bamemezela ukuhoxa kwabo kuhulumeni wesifundazwe, baze bayalela noNksz Shinga ukuba asule esikhundleni sokuba uMphathiswa.Kuze kube namhlanje, uNksz Shinga akakaze asule esikhundleni futhi uyaqhubeka nokuvota namaqembu abusa ngokubambisana esiShayamthetho. UNksz Shinga uphinde abe uSihlalo weNFP esifundazweni.

IZOKWENZELWA enkundleni yezemidlalo iPrincess Magogo Stadium, KwaMashu, kusuka ngo-5 ekuseni inkonzo yokugcina ka-Lady Apostle Nonhlanhla Patricia Gama webandla lamaZayoni elidume iNingizimu Afrika yonke i-Trust in Christ Ministries.Ngaphambi kwenkonzo yokugcina kaLady Apostle Gama (43), oshone entathakusa ngoMsombuluko, kuzoba nenkonzo yomlindelo ezoba KwaMashu Indoor Sports Centre namhlanje ngo-10 ebusuku.Kuthintwa uMfu Vusi Gama, ongumholi waleli bandla nomyeni kamufi, uthe umkakhe bazomkhumbula kakhulu ngokuthi ubewumholi omqoka kakhulu ebandleni futhi kuwuyena obhekele ukuhola ibandla ikakhulu ohlangothini lomama bebandla nentsha yesifazane. "Sizomkhumbula ngeqhaza lakhe elimqoka ebandleni lokuqinisekisa ukuthi ibandla lihlala libumbene, esithemba ukuthi abazalwane abasele ebandleni bazoqhubeka kulowo mgudu ukuze ibandla liqhubeke liye phambili nomsebenzi kaNkulunkulu ungalimali,” kusho uGama.Eqhuba, uthe benze ngamabomu ukuthi kuthi uma kuphela umlindelo ekuseni, kungene inkonzo yomngcwabo ekuseni ngo-5 ngenhloso yokuthi kushaye u-11 sekuqedwe yonke into ngenxa yokuthi baningi kakhulu abantu abezayo abasuka ezindaweni ezihlukene ezweni. I-Trust In Christ Ministries ngelinye lamabandla aseZayoni ahlonishwayo ngenxa yeqhaza elimqoka alibambile ukukhulisa nokuthuthukisa umculo wamaZayoni kule minyaka ewu-32 lasungulwa okufakazelwa wukuthi manje selinamagatsha awu-49 ezweni lonke.
IBANDLA lamaZayoni, Isiqalo Sokuthula KwamaKrestu Church of God in Zion, lisebenzise umbuthano wokukhumbula iNkosi uJesu Kristu - uMkhosi wePhasika, ukuqinisa izinhlaka zobuholi baleli bandla - obekuhlangene nokugubha iminyaka ewu-20 lasungulwa. Lokho kwenzeke ngenkathi leli bandla, okumanje linamagatsha amabili - lihlangene kule nkonzo yoMkhosi wePhasika ebiseSikhonyane Primary School, eNdulinde, eMandeni, enyakatho yeKwaZulu-Natal ngempelasonto edlule.Kulo mbuthano kukhushulwe uMfu uMfundiseni Mpanza obewuMfundisi webandla nowakwakhe uNkk Smangele Mpanza, banikwa izikhundla zokuba wuMfundisi noMfundisikazi jikelele bebandla - okusho ukuthi yibona asebebhekele wonke amagatsha ebandla, inhlalakahle yawo, wukukhula nokubambisana kwabazalwane bawo. UMnuz uLeonard Mpungose nowakwakhe uNksz uThandi Nxumalo noMnuz uMfanafuthi Magwaza begatsha laseNtuzuma, eThekwini, bona banikwe imisebenzi yokuba ngabeFundisi nomFundisikazi bebandla ngokubambisana. UMnuz uLindokuhle Nxumalo, ongumholi wekwaya yebandla - yena unikwe isikhundla sokuba wuMshumayeli webandla.ONksz uHlengiwe Nxumalo noNkk uNonhlangla Dludla begatsha laseNdulinde, noNksz uGirlie Hlanguza noNksz uZandile Biyela begatsha laseNtuzuma - bona bagixatshezwe ngomsebenzi wokuba woGosa bebandla, okusho ukuthi yibona asebebhekele ukuphatheka kahle kwabazalwane uma kuhlangenwe ezinkonzweni ezinkulu nezimqoka ebandleni. Umholi waleli bandla, uMbhishophi uScelo Mpungose, uthe bewubuholi bebandla babone kusemqoka ukuthi bahloniphe laba bazalwane ngale misebenzi ngoba bebona ukuzikhandla kwabo nokukhombisa amakhono nesineke kwabo kuyona bengakayigcotshelwa."Nanokuthi ukuze ibandla likhule ngendlela efanele liyadinga ukuthi libe nazo zonke izinhlaka ezimqoka neziyinsika yokuthi liye phambili, yingakho sizamile ukuthi sivale zonke lezi zikhala ebezivuleke ngenkathi kuhamba abanye abazalwane ebandleni, sase sengeza nakuleyo misebenzi emqoka kodwa ebingenabantu abayenza ngokugcwele,” usho kanje. UMpungose ukhuthaze laba bazalwane ukuthi bahole ibandla ngobuqotho futhi baqinisekise ukugwema ukusebenzisa amandla abanikwe wona nabathenjwe ngawo ukuphilisa abazalwane ngesandla sensimbi, ngoba ngenye yezinto lezo ezibuyisela ibandla emuva.
UMHOLI we-IFP, uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa, uthe ukuvumbuka kweqembu iMKP, kwabaphuca iqatha emlonyeni okhethweni lwango-2024, njengoba ekholelwa ukuthi babezozidlela amahlanga KwaZulu-Natal, ukuba lalingekho iqembu eliholwa owayengumengameli wezwe, uMnuz Jacob Zuma.UHlabisa uthe ukuvumbuka kweMKP sekusele kancane kufike ukhetho, kwaphendula amatafula. Ukusho lokhu izolo, ngesikhathi enengxoxo nabamaphephandaba angaphansi kwe-Independent Media.I-MKP iyona eyahamba phambili KwaZulu-Natal njengoba yathola u-45%, yalandelwa i-IFP yona eyathola u-18%. UHlabisa uthe ukube ayivelanga iMKP, alikho elinye iqembu elalizomelana nabo KwaZulu-Natal. "Ngesikhathi kuyiwa okhethweni lwango-2024, i-IFP yayikhombisa ukukhula. Ukube yayingekho iMKP sasizonqoba ngamalengiso. I-DA kunezindawo engakwazi ukukhula kuzona lapha KwaZulu-Natal. I-ANC yona aziyihambeli kahle izinto lapha KwaZulu-Natal. Ingakho yalahlekelwa isifundazwe okhethweni olwedlule. Yasuka ku-54% yathola u-17%. Bonke la bantu abavotela iMKP, babengeke bavote okhethweni olwedlule."UHlabisa uthe kwabamangaza okwenziwa yiMKP okhethweni njengoba babengabhekile ukuthi ingahamba phambili ngamavoti KwaZulu-Natal."Okwenzeke okhethweni olwedlule kusivule amehlo. I-MKP yaya okhethweni ingahlelekile. Nani nazibonela, kwakufike kumenyezelwe ukuthi iMKP izoba nomcimbi wokukhankasela ukhetho, uthi uyezwa ntambama sekuthiwa loyo mcimbi usuhoxisiwe. Kwesinye isikhathi wawuzwa sekuthiwa umholi wayo akafikanga emcimbini. Ukuze ukwazi ukukhankasela ukhetho, kufanele ube nezinhlaka zeqembu. I-MKP yayingenazo izinhlaka." UHlabisa uthe abanye abantu abavotela iMKP babequbisile. Uthe abanye abantu abavotela iMKP babelandwa emakhaya ngezimoto ezazihlelwe amanye amaqembu ezepolitiki kodwa bafike ezikhungweni zokuvota, bavotele iMKP."Abantu ababefake izikibha zeMKP babembalwa. Kwamangala bonke abaholi bamaqembu ezepolitiki uma sekuphuma imiphumela. Bazibuza ukuthi baqhamukaphi la bantu abavotela iMKP ngoba abantu ababefike ezikhungweni zokuvota babelethwe yibona ngezimoto."UHlabisa uthe kukhona izinkampani ezicwaningayo ezazisho ukuthi iMKP izonqoba ngamalengiso."Sakhetha ukungazilaleli lezi zinkampani. Sasibuza ukuthi zikuthathaphi lokhu ezikushoyo."
UMHOLI we-IFP, uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa, usephumele obala wathi akavimbile ukuthi kube nengqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi beqembu.UHlabisa uthe okubambezele ingqungquthela wukuthi bafuna ukwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi kulandelwa yonke imigomo. Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi enengxoxo nabamaphephandaba angaphansi kwe-Independent Media.I-IFP ilokhu yagcina ukuba nengqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi ngo-2019. Kukuleyo ngqungquthela lapho umsunguli weqembu, Inkosi Mangosuthu Buthelezi, adlulisela khona izintambo kuHlabisa. Ingqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi kwakufanele ibe ngo-2024 kodwa yahlehliselwa unyaka odlule, nakhona yagcina ihlehliswa. UHlabisa uthe akusilona iqiniso ukuthi benza ngamabomu ukuthi ingqungquthela ingabi khona."Abanye bathi siyasaba ukubiza ingqunguthela ngoba sisaba ukuphuma ezikhundleni. Mina anginqabile ukuthi kube nengqungquthela, inqobo nje uma kuzolandelwa yonke imigomo."UHlabisa uthe kubalulekile ukuthi kulandelwe yonke imigomo ukuze bagweme ukuthi kube khona abantu abaphonsela inselelo ukuhlala kwengqungquthela. Ingqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi be-IFP izokuba khona uma sekulandelwe yonke imigomo."Asifuni kwenzeke lokhu okwenzeke e-Eastern Cape (engqungqutheleni yokukhetha ubuholi be-ANC). Asifuni kube nesimo lapho inkantolo izonquma ngosuku lwengqungquthela ukuthi ingqungquthela ayichithwe, abantu sebeze bahamba amabanga amade bethi beze engqungqutheleni. Uma ngizwa imali okuthiwa imosheke e-Eastern Cape, ngiyathuka, angifuni nathi sehlelwe yisimo esifanayo."UHlabisa uthe kunamaziko angu-600 angakagcotshwa."La maziko angaphonsela inselelo ukuhlala kwengqungquthela uma singase sikhethe ukuwashiya ngaphandle." UHlabisa uthe kule mpelasonto kuzoba nemihlangano ezifundeni lapho kuzogcotshwa khona amaziko asele. Uveze ukuthi ngoMsombuluko kuzoba nomhlangano womkhandlu kazwelonke kwi-IFP."Umkhandlu kazwelonke yiwona othatha izinqumo zokuthi kufanele noma akufanele yini kube nengqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi."Khonamanjalo, uHlabisa uveze ukuthi uzolumemezela maduze usuku lokhetho lohulumeni basekhaya. UHlabisa uyena ozomemezela ukhetho lohulumeni basekhaya njengoba enguNgqongqoshe wokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu. Ukhetho oluzayo luzokuba phakathi kukaNovemba noJanuwari. UHlabisa uthe uzolumemezela usuku ngaphambi kukaJuni."Sifuna ukuthi abantu bethi beyobhalisela ukuvota ngoJuni, bebe sebazi ukuthi bazobe bekuphi ngosuku lokhetho."UHlabisa uthe uzoziphothula maduze izingxoxo mayelana nokuqokwa kosuku lokhetho. "Siqedela izingxoxo noMengameli (uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa)."
IZIHLATHI zivakashele izindlebe kubafundi bezikole ezimbili zaseLamontville, eThekwini, benikelelwa ngamapheya ezicathulo.Isolezwe lijoyine abeNdabe Dignified Funerals kanjalo nabeDurban Solid Waste behambisa lo mnikelo izolo eBhekaphambili Primary kanjalo naseGijima Primary. Kwenzeka lokhu nje, Isolezwe ligubha iminyaka engu-24 lasungulwaUSihlalo weNdabe Dignified Funerals, uMnuz Ndabe Ngcobo, uthe lo mnikelo uyindlela yokubuyisela emphakathini kanjalo nokukhombisa ukuthi abafundi babalulekile. "Ngokuletha lo mnikelo, asigcini nje ngokufaka izicathulo ezinyaweni zabo kodwa sibanika ukuzethemba, isithunzi nokuziqhenya uma beshaya kancane beyongena emakilasini,” kusho uNgcobo.Uthe bahlose ukuthi benze umehluko, balethe ushintsho empilweni yengane ngayinye kancane kancane. "Ukwenza umehluko akuhlale kusho ukuthi kufanele ushintshe umhlaba wonke kanyekanye kodwa kuqala ngezenzo nje ezincane, eziletha umehluko,” kusho uNgcobo. Abafundi babonakale bekuthakasela ukunikelelwa ngezicathulo baphinde baphiwa nezinye izipho. Kuphinde kwatshalwa izihlahla nabakwa-DSW ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izikole zihlanzekile, futhi ziyanakekelwa. Lokhu kuzogqugquzela ukuthi banakekele imvelo.
UYISE wowesilisa waseWaterloo, eVerulam, owadutshulwa wabulawa yiphoyisa likaMasipala weTheku engenze lutho ngo-Agasti 2023, useveze ukuthi sekuzokwehla nobuthongo emuva kwesigwebo esitholwe yimantshi yesifunda.Lokhu kuza emva kokuthi ngoLwesithathu, iNkantolo yesiFunda saseThekwini, igixabeze ngeminyaka ngu-45 ebhadla ejele uMandlenkosi Gumbi (50), owayeyiphoyisa lomkhandlu ngesikhathi enza icala.Ubethweswe amacala amathathu okukhona kuwo elokubulala kanjalo namabili okuzama ukubulala. Ngosuku lwesigameko, uGumbi kuthiwa wadubula uMnuz Sanele Thembani (24) emgwaqweni u-M4 ngasePick n Pay Hyper, eDurban North. Ngokombiko wamaphoyisa, uGumbi wayeyingxenye yamaphoyisa ayenesivimbamgwaqo kule ndawo kodwa ngokwalaba ababehamba ngemoto umufi athulela kuyo, kwakunengozi yomgwaqo. Kuthiwa umnikazi we-double cab, umufi ayehleli kuyo nabanye esikhenkeni, wanquma ukujika aphindele emuva ebona ezinye izimoto zijika, zibona ingozi. Kuthiwa yilapho uGumbi adubula khona kathathu ebhekise evenini, inhlamvu yanemba uThembani. Uyise kamufi, uMnuz Mzomuhle Thembani, uthe kumjabulisile ukuthi ekugcineni umuntu owabulala indodana yakhe ngaphandle kwesizathu, ajeziswe."Sengizoke ngilale nobuthongo ngazi ukuthi nakuba ingane yami ingeke isavuka kodwa nomuntu owayibulala naye uvalelwe eziseleni ezimnyama. Ngizothi noma ngimcabanga umntanami, ngiduduzwe ukuthi naye umenzi wobubi usezikhindini,” kusho uThembani. Uthe kumjabulisile ukuthi uGumbi agcine egwetshiwe ngoba ngesikhathi kuqhubeka ukuqulwa kwecala, ubekhombisa ukudelela futhi enethemba lokuthi uzophunyula ngoba eyiphoyisa. Uqhube wathi neminyaka anikwe yona bajabule ngayo ngoba uthe uma embalela, wabona ukuthi uyophuma ejele eseyinganekwane. "Ngiyazi ukuthi kungenzeka angayihlali yonke iminyaka engu-45 kodwa ngiyazi ukuthi uyophuma eseyinto ongayazi,” kusho uThembani. Uthe uGumbi ugwetshwa nje, yena ubengasalubhadi enkantolo, esededela amanye amalungu omndeni ukuthi aqhubeke nokuthamela icala."Bengivele ngikhushukelwe umoya ngibe yinqaba, ikakhulukazi uma esekhuluma into ekhombisayo ukuthi akazisoli ngokubulala ingane yami futhi ezama ukuzithethelela,” usho kanje. Uthe bekungamkhathazi ukuhamba ngonyawo lonwabu kwalo icala ngoba abaphenyi be- Independent Police Investigative Directorate (IPID), babebathembisile ukuthi nakanjani lizomgojela ekugcineni. Uthe nemantshi ebilengamele icala iliphathe ngesinono, wathi ubezwa uma bembikela akade beyile ukuthi belungafakwa. Uveze ukuthi ngesikhathi ibulawa indodana yakhe, yase iphothule izifundo zazenyuvesi, isimatasa nokuthola izincwadi zokushayela."Ubulawa nje, wayesethole ngisho nosuku ayezoyohlolwa ngalo ukuze athole izincwadi zokushayela. Lawo maphepha ngisawabekile namanje emotweni yami, akuvumi ngiwalahle,” kusho uThembani, othe njalo uma eke wawabheka lawo maphepha, izinyembezi zivele zigcwale amehlo.Ngesikhathi imgweba imantshi, uNkk Sophie Reddy, ithe ithumela umyalezo oqinile wokuthi amaphoyisa akufanele asebenzise igunya lawo lobuphoyisa ukwenza okungafanele. Isole uGumbi ngokubulala umuntu owayengenze lutho, ngoba edinwa ukuthi umnikazi wemoto akamgqizanga qakala ekubeni ewumuntu womthetho.
USUQALILE umjaho wokuhola i-DA KwaZulu-Natal, njengoba ilungu lomkhandlu weNdlu yeziFundazwe ePhalamende, uMnuz Mzamo Billy, selimemezele ukuthi lizongenela umbango wokuhola leli qembu esifundazweni.I-DA izoba nengqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi besifundazwe ngenyanga ezayo futhi amalungu aseqalile ukuphakamisa amagama abantu afuna ukuthi bangenele izikhundla. Izolo uBilly umemezele ukwamukela ukuphakanyiswa kwegama lakhe ukuba lingenele umbango wokuhola isifundazwe. Ukusho lokhu embhalweni awufake ezinkundleni zokuxhumana."Kuyintokozo ukuba nginazise ukuthi ngivumile ukuba igama lami liphakanyiselwe emjahweni wokuhola i-DA KwaZulu-Natal. Ukuphakanyiswa kwegama lami kwenzeka ngesikhathi esimqoka. Ligaya ngomunye umhlathi lapha esifundazweni njengoba sibona kwanda ukuphatha ngokubambisana ezinhlakeni zikahulumeni. I-DA kufanele ingasali ngemuva." UBilly uthe umkhankaso wakhe uzogxila emaphuzwini amathathu."Ngifuna ukukhulisa i-DA ifinyelele nasezindaweni engekho kuzona. Ngifuna iKwaZulu-Natal ibe imbumba, lokhu kuzokwenza ngokudala ubumbano ezinhlakeni zeqembu. Ngifuna ukuthi i-DA kube iyona ephathayo ngesikhathi esizayo, kufanele i-DA ibe iqembu abantu abazolethemba ukuthi lingakwazi ukuphatha."Uthe uzohambela ezindaweni ezahlukene esifundazweni lapho ezobe exoxa khona nezithunywa eziya engqungqutheleni. UBilly ubeyikhansela kuMasipala waseThekwini ngaphambi kokuthi aye ePhalamende. Akukacaci ukuthi bangaki abazongenela umbango wokuhola i-DA esifundazweni.Igama elivelayo embangweni elephini lomholi we-DA esifundazweni, uMnuz Sithembiso Ngema. UNgema ubengakaphumeli obala ukuthi uzowungenela yini umjaho. Umholi okhona njengamanje, uMnuz Francois Rodgers, umemezele ukuthi usethi khumu.Khonamanjalo: I-DA izoqoka ubuholi bayo bukazwelonke engqungqutheleni engempelasonto. Kulindeleke ukuthi iMeya kaMasipala waseKapa, uMnuz Geordin Gwyn Hill-Lewis, izidlele amahlanga embangweni wokuhola i-DA.UHill-Lewis uzophonsela inselelo ikhansela lakuMasipala waseSedibeng, uMnuz Sibusiso Dyonase. Umholi ophethe njengamanje, uMnuz John Steenhuisen, wahoxa emjahweni wezikhundla.
UKWENZA izinto ngokungaphaphi kobuholi be-IFP, kungenye yezinto ezihehele kuleli qembu loyo olaxaze iMKP, uDkt Bongani Mncwango.UMncwango, omenyezelwe ngokusemthethweni njengelungu le-IFP izolo, uveze ukuthi maningi amaqembu abemshela. Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba. UMncwango owayengunobhala jikelele weMKP, uveze ukuthi ugcine eqome i-IFP emaqenjini amane abemfunisa okomsebenzi."Ngikhethe ukunika i-IFP ucu kula masoka abengeshela ngenxa yokubuka umlando wayo. I-IFP ineminyaka engu-51 futhi kunozinzo kuyo. Abaholi bayo bakhulile ngokomqondo. Izinto zakwi-IFP azenziwa ngokuphapha, ucabanga kabili ngaphambi kokuthi wenze into kwi-IFP. Engikuthandayo nge-IFP ukuthi inethuba lokukhula." UMncwango udilizwe esikhundleni sokuba unobhala jiekelele weMKP ngenyanga edlule kanti ubesahlale kulesi sikhundla isikhathi esingaphansi kwezinyanga eziyisikhombisa. Akazange afune ukwanda kakhulu ngokumenze washiya iMKP.Uthe uma umuntu ejoyina iqembu kuyaye kube nombono athenjiswa wona."Uma abaholi beqembu sekuba yibo abangasawulandeli loyo mbono, kuyaye kufanele ukuthi uthathe isinqumo sokuthi uyahlala noma uyahamba." Bekuqhilika izidlathi kuMncwango ngesikhathi ethulwa, ekhuza neziqubulo ze-IFP. Umholi we-IFP, uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa, uthe babambe ufishi omkhulu."Namhlanje usuku olukhethekile. Egameni le-IFP simemukela ngezandla ezivulekile nangezinhliziyo ezimhlophe. Sithobeka kakhulu ukujoyinwa nguMncwango onolwazi olunzulu njengoba eke waba yisikhulu esiphezulu ezinkampani ezizimele nezisebenza ukuvikela umphakathi. Kwezokuphatha unolwazi olunzulu. Siyazi ukuthi baningi abazokulandela, abakholelwa kuwena. I-IFP ikhaya labo bonke abantu. Ingakho sihlezi siwavulile amasango."UHlabisa uthe asikho isikhundla athenjiswe sona uMncwango. UHlabisa uthe amava kaMncwango azosiza ekukhuliseni iqembu kanjalo nasemkhankasweni wokhetho lohulumeni basekhaya oluzayo, wathi bafuna ukunqoba omasipala abaningi okhethweni oluzayo."Ngesikhathi kuza ukhetho lohulumeni basekhaya lwango-2021, sathi sifuna ukunqoba inqwaba yomasipala. Abantu bathi siyazikhohlisa. Namanje kunenqwaba yomasipala esifuna ukubanqoba. Kunomasipala abaphethwe ngokubambisana esifuna ukubanqoba futhi sifuna ukuqhubeka nokunqoba komasipala esiphethe kubo. Umgqigqo wethu muhle kakhulu njengoba sinqobe amawadi amaningi okhethweni lokuchibiyela lwakamuva."
WEHLULEKILE ukuzibamba, wasikhihla isililo umndeni wowesilisa obengusigaxamabhande kaMasipala weTheku izolo, iNkantolo yesiFunda eThekwini imgixabeza ngeminyaka engu-45 ngecala lokubulala namabili okuzama ukubulala.Owesilisa, uMandlenkosi Gumbi (50), ugwetshwe ngecala lokudubula, abulale uMnuz Sanele Thembani (24) esigamekweni esenzeka emgwaqweni uM4 ngasePick n Pay Hyper, eDurban North ngo-Agasti 2023. Abomndeni kaGumbi bakhale baze bakhishelwa ngaphandle enkantolo.Ngokobufakazi bamaphoyisa, uGumbi wayeyingxenye yamaphoyisa ayenesivimbamgwaqo kule ndawo, kodwa ngokwalaba ababehamba ngemoto umufi athulela kuyo, kwakunengozi yomgwaqo. Kuthiwa umnikazi we-double cab, umufi ayehleli kuyo nabanye esikhenkeni, wanquma ukujika aphindele emuva ebona ezinye izimoto zijika, zibona ingozi. Kuthiwa yilapho uGumbi adubula khona kathathu, ebhekise evenini, inhlamvu yanemba uThembani. Imgweba izolo iMantshi, uNkk Sophie Reddy, ithe imnika iminyaka engu-15 ebhadla ejele ngecala lokubulala, engu-15 icala ngalinye, kwamabili okuzama ukubulala. Ithe lezi zigwebo uzozidonsa kanyekanye, yathi lokhu kwenza ibe ngu-15 iminyaka uGumbi azoyidonsa ngaphakathi. Inqume nokuthi akumfanele ukuthi aphinde aphathe isibhamu. Ngesikhathi endlalela isigwebo uNkk Reddy, usole uGumbi ngokusebenzisa kabi amandla akhe obuphoyisa, wathi wayengenza kangcono kakhulu ngesipiliyoni sakhe seminyaka engu-30, kunokukhetha ukudubula. "Wena waba yiphoyisa elazizwa lideleleka, lingahlonishwa wumnikazi wemoto, wabe ususebenzisa igunya lakho ngokuthi udubule. Wawungenza kangcono kunokuthi uphoqe umthetho ngendlela engalungile,” kusho uNkk Reddy.UNkk Reddy uwashaye indiva amaphuzu abekwe wummeli kaGumbi, uNksz Ncube, obezama ukuncenga inkantolo ukuthi imnike isigwebo esincane kunaleso esibekelwe abenze amacala afana nelenziwe uGumbi.Phakathi kwamaphuzu akhe uthe uGumbi obehlala eMlaza, ungowesilisa oseneminyaka engu-50, wathi ngesikhathi enza icala wayeneminyaka engu-47. Wathi akanazo izingane, akashadile, kodwa wuye onakelela unina osehola impesheni, aphinde anakekele izingane zikadadewabo ezintathu. Uphinde wabalula nokuthi emaphoyiseni kaMasipala weTheku wajoyina ngo-1997, kanti ubeqala ukwenza icala. UNkk Reddy uthe lezi akuzona izizathu ezibambekayo ezingenza ukuthi uGumbi athanjiselwe isigwebo, wathi kulaba ababalile ukuthi uyabanakekela, ayikho into ephathekayo eveza ukuthi bancike kuye ngokusemthethweni. Umshushisi woMbuso, uMnuz Celani Dludla ngesikhathi ecindezela ukuthi inkantolo ingagudluki nakancane esigwebeni esinikwa abasuke benze amacala afuze leli, uthe akukho lapho uGumbi ake wakhombisa khona ukuzisola kusaqulwa icala."Okubonakele kuye ukukhombisa ukungazisoli lapho athe khona akakwamukeli ngokugcwele ukuthi wenze icala,” kusho uDludla othe okunye inkantolo okufanele izibuze imibuzo ngakho, yindlela ozakwabo ababezama ukumvikela ngayo." Uthe:"Umbuzo uthi ngabe bangaki abanye abantu ababalimazile, bakwazi ukuvikelana ngempumelelo. Lesi yisikhathi sokuthi inkantolo imnike isigwebo esizothumela umyalezo emphakathini, kuthi nalabo abahlale bekhala ngale ndlela yokuziphatha kwamaphoyisa, bagculiseke.” Uthe uphoxekile ngokuthi ngesikhathi kuqulwa icala, uGumbi wathi yena wayenza umsebenzi wakhe. "Ngesipiliyoni sakhe seminyaka ngeminyaka, kufanele ngabe wakwazi ukuzikhuza ngemigomo elawula ukusetshenziswa kwesibhamu, kunalokho wakhetha ukuqhubeka adubule,” usho kanje.Uphinde wagqamisa ukuthi njengoba umshayeli wemoto akhetha ukujika abuyele emuva, uGumbi wayengenaso isizathu sokudubula umuntu owayengumgibeli, owayengenzanga lutho.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi emva kophenyo lwangaphakathi emaphoyiseni, uGumbi akaxoshwanga kodwa wehliswa esikhundleni, wabekwa kwesingezansi, waqhubeka wasebenza, njengoba adedelwa ngebheyili kaR2 000 maphakathi no-2024, emva kokuboshwa kwakhe.
KUSENZIMA ukwamukela isimo emndenini wowesifazane waseSakhamkhanya, eDoringkop, KwaDukuza, okuthiwa ugwazwe wabulawa yisoka lakhe eqeda kubuya ePhasikeni ngeSonto.Kulesi sigameko kufe ngesihluku uNksz Happy Mthethwa (35), okuthiwa ubulawe umsolwa, ethi uyolanda izimpahla zakhe emzini abehlala kuwo, ukumkhombisa ukuthi akadlali uma ethi ucu alusahlangani.Ngokusho kukadadewabo kamufi, uNksz Kholeka Mthethwa, isigameko senzeke besanda kubuya enkonzweni yePhasika ababeye kuyo ngoLwesihlanu. "Sithe sibuya wahlala cishe imizuzu engu-30, wase ethi usaya kulo muzi umsolwa abehlala kuwo ngoba ewugada khona endaweni. Ngisale ngalala, ngamangala ukuthi akakabuyi ngesikhathi ngivuka kodwa ngangazitshela ukuthi kukhona osekumehlele,” kusho uNksz Mthethwa. Uthe bekuyizithuba zasemini ngesikhathi kufika umyalezo wokuthi abaphuthume kwamakhelwane walo muzi ngoba umufi ulimele."Ngithukile ukuthi ingabe uselinyazwa yini. Ngithe uma ngifika khona, besekugcwele nabantu, ngambona edindilizile kuveranda walo makhelwane othumele umyalezo. Bekukhombisa ukuthi akasekho kodwa ngendlela ebengiphanjanelwe ngayo yikhanda, ngiqhubekile ngafonela i-ambulensi,” kuchaza uNksz Mthethwa othe ngesikhathi efike ngaso i-ambulensi, ivele yaqinisekisa ukuthi umufi akasekho. Uthe bathole ukuthi umsolwa uqale ukumhlasela emzini womunye umakhelwane angumngani wakhe umufi. Uqhube wathi bathole ukuthi ubemshaya, emklinya kodwa kucaca ukuthi umufi uyamhlula ngamandla."Kulowo muzi sifice kumahliphihliphi, kulimele ngisho amawindi, kukhombisa ukuthi bekuliwa. Uma sithola, kuthiwa ukwazile ukuphunyuka uHappy, wabalekela kwamakhelwane wesibili, okuyilapho okuthiwa umsolwa umjahile wamfica khona, wase edonsa ummese awuthole eduze, wamgwaza ngawo,” kusho yena. Uveze ukuthi ngesikhathi besalinde amaphoyisa, umsolwa uqhamuke kulo muzi awugadayo eqimbile, wazishaya isifuba ethi njengoba edindilizile, wuye ombulele. "Ubegcwele igazi yonke indawo. Abesilisa abambalwa ebebekhona bazamile ukumjaha, emva kokumuzwa ekhuluma kanje, bathi ngeke phela akhulume kanjalo phambi kwabo, nokho ukwazile ukubaleka abashiye njengoba namanje engakaboshwa,” usho kanje.UNksz Mthethwa uveze ukuthi umsolwa nomufi bese bethandane cishe iminyaka emithathu, wathi muva nje, umufi ubesemala kodwa umsolwa ala aphethe. "Ubekwazi ukubekezela uHappy kodwa lona wesilisa engamhloniphi. Ubevele aqonywe, izintombi zakhe zifonele uHappy zimthuke. Ugcine esecikeka, esethi abuphele ubudlelwano kodwa umsolwa engafuni," kusho uNksz Mthethwa. Uveze ukuthi ngisho nangempelasonto yePhasika besenkonzweni, wayelokhu emfonela ngama-video call. Uthe njengoba umufi ebese efudukele eGoli ukuyozama amatoho, nabehlala nabo khona bakhala esifanayo sama-video call. Uveze ukuthi umsolwa ubulala umufi nje, unengane enamasonto amathathu izelwe, okuthiwa uyithole kowesifazane wakhona endaweni, wathi umsolwa ungowokuzalwa eNkwalini, eShowe. Uveze ukuthi bamfonele udadewabo bemazisa ngomonakalo umsolwa asewenzile, kwangathi uyazwelana nabo. "Simangele uma esefika namaphoyisa ngoMsombuluko, bezothatha izimpahla zikamsolwa. Kuvele kwasicacela ukuthi uye omthumile,” usho kanje. Uthe njengamanje abazi ukuthi umsolwa ukuziphi izinkalo kodwa batholile ukuthi uyaxhumana nomngani wakhe osendaweni, unina wengane yakhe encane kanjalo nodadewabo. Uveze ukuthi uma amaphoyisa engaphenya laba bobathathu, lingavela iqiniso lokuthi umsolwa ubhacephi.Umufi uneziqu zobuthisha azithole eNyuvesi yaseZululand. Ushiye izingane ezintathu, ezineminyaka ephakathi kweyisishiyagalolunye no-17. Kuthiwa ubulawa nje, ubehle ngoLwesine, esuka etohweni lakhe eGoli. Uveze ukuthi izimpahla abehlose ukuyozilanda, ubulawe engakazithathi.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa aKwaDukuza avule icala lokubulawa komuntu kulandela isigameko sokugwazwa abulawe ngumsolwa amaziyo ngeSonto.Uthe ngesikhathi amaphoyisa efika endaweni yesigameko, isidumbu sikamufi besinezibazi, kanjalo nenxeba lokugwazwa. Imbangela yokubulala uthe ibingakaziwa.

Indaba yenkulumo eqoshiwe vele ayikho,” kusho uMeyiwa. Uthe yena ufikelwa ukucasuka ukuthi uLongwe ampende kabi encwadini, wathi ubona emthatha kancane.
