Yibo laba abamangalelwa umndeni othi kufanele badedelwe ngoba abanacala.
ABALIMI bakamoba sebephumele obala bathi bafuna ukwazi ngekusasa labo enkampanini kashukela, iTongaat Hullets.Lokhu bakusho izolo njengoba bebenesiteleka ngaphandle kwamasango ale nkampani, nabanye babasebenzi abaqashwe abasebenza ezimobeni. Bathe manje sesifikile isikhathi sokuthi batshelwe ngekusasa labo njengoba konke kumile, kungekho inqubekela phambili ngokuthengwa kwemikhiqizo yabo, okwenza bangakhiphi isivuno sikamoba, futhi kungangeni mali nabasebenzi bangaholi.Omunye wabatshali bakamoba uMnuz Derrick Mkhize, othe uqashe abantu abangu-70 enkampanini yakhe, uthe okubuhlungu wukuthi selokhu kwavela izindaba zokuthi inkampani kashukela kungenzeka ivalwe, abasebenzi bakhe sekuyizinyanga ezimbili bengatholi amaholo aphelele njengoba ingekho imali engenayo."Lesi simo asithinti thina kuphela singabalimi bakamoba, kodwa miningi imindeni ethintekayo ngaso njengoba ithembele kithina kodwa nathi lokhu okwenzekayo sekungaphezu kwamandla ethu. Abasebenzi asazi ngempela ukuthi yini esizobatshela yona ngalesi simo ngoba nathi akukho okubambekayo esikuzwayo. Uthe "Uma inkampani ivala, konke esikusebenzele kanzima kuzofa kuphele nya, ngoba iTongaat Hullets iyithemba lethu. Siyacela ukuthi kube bahlangane nathi ukuze kuxoxwe ngento eya phambili, kuvikelele nokuthi isimo somnotho singabi sibi kakhulu kunalokhu esiyikho manje." Amalungu omphakathi abekhona kule mashi anxuse uhulumeni, abaholi emphakathini nasezinkampanini ezehlukene ezithintekauyo ukuthi bangenelele ukuze kuvikeleke imisebenzi yabo.IPhini likaNgqongqoshe waBesifazane nabantu abaPhila nokuKhubazeka uMmapaseka Steve Letsike, uphawulile ngalolu daba emsakazweni Igagasi FM, lapho eveze khona ukuthi uhulumeni lumkhathaze kakhulu lolu daba njengoba inkampani yakwaHullets inkulu. Uthe osomabhizinisi ikakhulukazi abancane yibona abebehlomula kakhulu kule nkampani, wathi kumele bakulwele ukuthi ingavalwa, iqhubeke nokuvula amathuba omsebenzi."Asikwazi ukuthi kube khona imisebenzi ephelayo kuleli, kukhona abantu besifazane abaningi abasebenza kule nkampani kanjalo nentsha. UMnyango obhekelele imisebenzi uphezu kwalo lolu daba, yingakho nathi siyilo Mnyango singeke sithule." Inkampani kashukela ayiphawulanga.
BEVILE ku-500 ngosuku abantu abangeniswa ezibhedlela ezizimele kuleli abakhokhelwa yiGovernment Employees Medical Scheme (GEMS). Lokhu kuvezwe nguNgqongqoshe weziSebenzi zikaHulumeni nokuPhatha, Inkosi uMzamo Buthelezi, ephendula imibuzo yelungu le-EFF ePhalamende.UButhelezi uthe ngosuku i-GEMS yamukela amalungu amasha angu-112. Uthe ikhokha cishe u-R182 milllion njalo ngosuku kanti ongoti bodokotela bakhokhelwa ngosuku u-R27 milion."Ngosuku i-GEMS ikhokhela izibhedlela ezizimele ngezingane ezingu-60, ezizalwa ngosuku. Zizalwa abantu abasuke besikiwe, abanye basuke bezibelethele. Bangu-593 abangeniswa ezibhedlela nsuku zonke," kusho uButhelezi. Ubechaza ngezinselelo ezibhekene ne-GEMS enyuse imali ngenxa yokunyuka kwezindleko. Sisuse umsindo isenzo se-GEMS sokunyusa imali ekuqaleni konyaka, okwenze izinyunyana zabasebenzi zamashela ukwehliswa kwemali. Okwamanje kusaqhubeka izingxoxo zokuzama ukufinyelela esivumelwaneni njengoba i-GEMS ikhale ngokunyuka kwezindleko okuyimbangela yokunyuswa kwemali ekhokhwa amalungu. Okunye i-GEMS ekhale ngakho yinkohlakalo edla lubi, njengoba amanye amalungu elalisa izihlobo zawo ezingeyona ingxenye ye-GEMS, bese kudingeka lesi sikhwama sikhokhe.Izinyunyana zikhale ngokuthi i-GEMS ibuye ingafuni ukukhokha. UButhelezi empendulweni, uthe i-GEMS iyakhokha uma kungukuthi kuyahambisana nemigomo ebekiwe ethinta ezempilo. "Uma kwenzeka i-GEMS inqaba ukukhokha, kusuke kufaka izinto ezehlukene okubalwa ukusebenzisa izibhedlela ezingeyona ingxenye yezikhungo ezikhokhelwa yilesi sikhwama. Kokunye kusuke kungazange kutholakale imvume ngaphambi kokuba ogulayo angeniswe esibhedlela."Uthe kokunye kusuke kunemininingwane engaphelele noma ezinye izinto okumele zikhokhelwe ezisuke zingekho ngaphansi ezikhavwe yilesi sikhwama.Uveze nokuthi nyakenye, i-GEMS ikhokhele izindleko ezibalelwa ku-R67 billion, ekubeni amalungu akhokha u-R65 billion. Ubalule nokuthi abalesi sikhwama basebenzisa u-R10 billion, ukukhava izindleko ukuze imali ezokhokhwa amalungu inganyuswa kakhulu. UButhelezi uthe ziyaqhubeka izingxoxo phakathi kwezinyunyana ezingaphansi komfelandawonye iCosatu neFedusa, ngokunyuswa kwemali.
KUNENHLANSI yethemba ngempi ebhekiswe kwi-HIV eNingizimu Afrika, njengoba sekufike umjovo ozosiza ukuvikela abangakasuleleki ngaleli gciwane. Lo mjovo, i-Lenacapavir, uzosiza ngokuvikela abangakahaqwa yigciwane ukuthi lingabe lisabangena. Abangakasuleleki bazojovwa kabili ngonyaka.UMnyango wezeMpilo umemezele ukuthi ifikile imijovo engu-37 920 ye-Lenacapavir kuleli. Okhulumela uMnyango, uMnuz Foster Mohale, uthe abantu bazojova kabili ngonyaka."Umuntu uzojova kanye ezinyangeni eziyisithupha, aphinde ajove ezinyangeni eziyisithupha ezilandelayo ukuze angasulelekile nge-HIV. Inhloso ukwehlisa abantu abahaqwa yileli gciwane." Uthe bahlose ukuvikela izingane ezincane zamantombazane, abesifazane abasebancane kanjalo nabesilisa abalala nabanye besilisa."Sihlose nokuvikela nabadayisa ngomzimba nabanye. Sifuna ukukucacisa ukuthi lo mjovo uzovikela abangakahaqeki, awulona ikhambi lokulapha ingculazi."Uthe maduzane bazowethula emphakathini lo mjovo kanti kulindeleke uthulwe ngumengameli wezwe. I-DA ikwamukele ukufika kwawo, yathi uzosiza kakhulu empini yeHIV kuleli. Ithe abangakahaqeki bazovikeleka ekutheni bangasuleleki ngaleli gciwane."Elakuleli linesibalo esiphezulu sabantu abane-HIV emhlabeni jikelele. Babalelwa ku-8 million abaphila ne-HIV kuleli. Babalelwa ku-6 million abadla imishanguzo ama-ARV. Lo mjovo uzoshintsha izinto kuleli."Leli qembu lithe lifuna uMnyango uvele ePhalamende ukuze uzothula uhlelo lokusabalalisa lo mjovo emphakathini ngokushesha.
UKHALE ngokuthi wayebuye abe nokuthikamezeka ekhanda ngesikhathi okwenzeka ngaso isehlakalo, umzukulu oqula elokushumpula ngesihluku ikhanda likaninakhulu, maqede waligendisa okwebhola. Ummangalelwa, uMnuz Thabo Nzimande (33), ukusho lokhu ngoLwesibili ngesikhathi evele eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini. Uthweswe icala lokubulala uNkk Beatrice de Lange (80), ngoJuni 7, 2024 ekhaya labo elisePinetown, lapho okuthiwa babehlala khona. UNzimande obehlonywa imibuzo, uthe yena akasakhumbuli lutho olwenzeka oluphathelene nokufa kukaninakhulu. Utshele inkantolo ukuthi yena ngosuku lwesigameko, wayephuze amaphilisi amahlanu okulala, waphinde wabhema nensangu, ezama ukuthola ubuthongo.Udalule ukuthi ngokujwayelekile, la maphilisi ayemdaka ingakapheli imizuzu engu-15 ewaphuzile. Nokho waveza ukuthi ngosuku lwesigameko, wawaphuza ngezikhathi ezehlukene, kanti ayengasebenzi. Lokhu kuvele kwashayisana nobufakazi bangesikhathi ehleli esibhedlela sabathikamezeke ngokomqondo, iFort Napier, lapho atshela khona udokotela ukuthi insangu imenza aphaphame futhi ajabule. Umshushisi woMbuso u-Advocate Nadira Moosa, umbuze ngengxabano aba nayo noNkk De Lange ngoMeyi, lapho ethe wamchapha khona ngenhlamba, embiza ngegama okuthukwa ngalo abesifazane abangenasimilo. UNzimande uphike walala ngomhlane, wathi yena wacela uninakhulu ukuthi aphinde ahlanganise imali yokuthi aphinde ayohlolelwa izidakamizwa okwesibili ngoba wayengenasiqiniseko sokuthi kwenzekeni ngemiphumela yokuhlolwa kokuqala. Uphinde wayiphika eyokuthi ubudlelwane babo base bumuncu, nokuthi babeke bezwakala bexabana ezinsukwini ezimbalwa ngaphambi kwesigameko. Kuvela ukuthi ingxabano yabo yangoMeyi, yayimayelana nokuthi ummangalelwa wayala ephetha ukuthamela uhlelo lokumsiza ezidakamizweni, esikhungweni esisiza abahlulwa yizidakamizwa. U-Adv Moosa uphinde wamvalela ekhoneni ngokungafani kobufakazi bakhe maqondana namazwi athi wayewezwa ngesikhathi umqondo wakhe uthikamezekile. UNzimande ube esephika ukuthi watshela umalume wakhe uMnuz John Ngcobo ukuthi amadlozi akhe amyalele ukuthi akabulale uninakhulu. Uthe yena wezwa izwi likanina ongasekho, ezwakalisa ukuziqhenya ngaye, wathi wayemvakashele, ehamba nomalume wakhe kanjalo nomkhulu wakhe, asebashona. U-Adv Moosa ube esebuza uNzimande ukuthi kungani ingafani inkulumo yakhe mayelana namazwi athi wayewezwa. "Wena ufike wathi wezwa izwi lithi uyakwazi okufanele ukwenze,” kusho u-Adv Moosa, uNzimande uphendule ngelithi yena akasakukhumbuli lokho. Uphinde wambuza ngenkulumo abanayo nomalume wakhe, uNgcobo (John) ngesikhathi ephethe ikhanda likaninakhulu."UNgcobo uthe ngesikhathi ephenya ikhethini, wakubona uphethe ikhanda likagogo wakho, wase uthi bekumele ngikwenze lokhu. Uthini ngalokho,” kubuza u-Adv Moosa, uNzimande waphendula ngelithi yena akasakukhumbuli lokho. Inkinga yakhe yokungakhumbuli ivele nakwezinye izingxenye zeziwombe ezibalulekile. Utshele inkantolo ukuthi akakhumbuli yena etshela iphoyisa elafika endaweni yesigameko, ukuthi uqeda kumbulala uninakhulu. "UConstable Chili uthe wakuzwa umemeza ukuthi uzwe amazwi amadlozi akho ethi bulala umuntu omthanda kakhulu. Wawuqamba amanga kuye?,” kubuza u-Adv Moosa. "Cishe ngangisadidekile, ngangisesiteshini samaphoyisa, ngitshelwa ukuthi kuqeda kwenzekani, angikholwanga. Angizikhumbuli ngikhipha lawo mazwi. Uma kwenzeka ukuthi ngawakhipha, okusho ukuthi ngangenziwa wukuthuka, ngithuswa amazwi engangiwezwa ezindlebeni,” kuphendula uNzimande.Icala lizobuyela enkantolo ngoJuni nonyaka.
AMAZWE alwayo, iMelika ne-Iran avumelane ngokubeka phansi izikhali okwesikhashana. La mazwe avumelene ngokumisa impi amasonto amabili ukuze kuqhubeke izingxoxo zokuqeda impi eyaqala ngenyanga edlule. Ukumiswa kwempi kumenyezelwe uMengameli waseMelika, uMnuz Donald Trump, ngoLwesibili ebusuku. UTrump unqume ukumisa impi ngenxa yokuthi i-Iran, ivume ukuvula umzila wemikhumbi, iStrait of Hormuz. I-Iran ibivimbile eStrait of Hormuz obekwenza ukuthi imikhumbi ethwele u-oyela oqhamuka emazweni aseMiddle East, ingakwazi ukudlula. UTrump ubesabise ngokuthi uzoqotha imbokodo nesisekelo e-Iran, uma iqhubeka nokuvimba eStrait of Hormuz. Ubenikeze i-Iran umnqamulajuqu wangoLwesibili ukuba ivulele imikhumbi. UTrump uveze ukuthi unxuswe abaholi basePakistan ukuba angangqongqisi ingqalasizinda kagesi i-Iran."Ngilimisile ibutho ebese lilungele ukuphuma uma i-Iran ingavumi ukuvula eStrait of Hormuz." UTrump uthe i-Iran imnikeze amaphuzu ayishumi efuna kuvunyelwane ngawo ngaphambi kokuthi ivume ukuqeda impi."Ngiwabukile la maphuzu, sizoxoxa ngawo."Womabili amazwe akuchaze njengokunqoba ukumiswa kwempi. Ukumiswa kwempi kwenze ukuthi kwehle inani lika-oyela izolo. Amanani ka-oyela anyuka kakhulu ngemuva kokuqubuka kwempi ngenyanga edlule.Ukunyuka kwamanani ka-oyela kuholele ekunyukeni kukaphethroli emazweni amaningi. Ine-touchstreen infotainment engu-12.3 inch ne-digital instrument cluster engu-8.0 inch.Ngemuva kwezihlalo zangaphambili kunama-tray ongakwazi ukubeka i-laptop nendawo yokufaka ingilazi yokuphuza amanzi noma udilinki. Inamandla angu-120kW ne-torque engu-250Nm.Kwezokuphepha ine-Active Yaw Control abathi isiza emakhoneni ngokubheka kancane ngaphakathi kwesondo langaphambili uma ujika. Enye ekhona ebalulekile ngeyokukhombisa ukwehla komoya emasondweni. IHill Start nezinye izinsiza zokuqinisekisa ukuphepha. IneLane Change Assist, Blind Spot, and Rear Cross Traffic Alert. Engxoxweni neSolezwe Ngempelasonto, uMqondisi weMitsubishi Motor South Africa, uTakalani Bruce Mukhola, uveze ukuthi iDestinator isimi ngomumo ukunqamula nemindeni ezinkalweni zonke zaseMzansi."Ngisho ungaya kuphi ngayo, odakeni ngeke ibenankinga. UHLABE wahlikiza okwenzeka KwaMaphumulo, lapho okunesizwe esizibiza ngaBafundi bakaJesu asebedele konke ezweni baze balaxaza nokudla imishanguzo yengculazi uSihlalo weKhomishini yaamaLungelo ezeNkolo, uNkk Thoko Mkhwanazi-Xaluva.Luyindaba egudwini udaba lwalesi sizwe njengoba sisanda kuphumela obala ngohlobo lwempilo esiyiphilayo.Umholi waso, uMfundisi Vusumuzi Sibiya, uveze ukuthi abantu abakhona sebeshiye amaphilisi ngoba bethemba uNkulunkulu ukuthi uyena ozobelapha. Usanda kuveza nokuthi abalubhadi ezibhedlela kunalokho umuntu bamkhulekela aze awuphonse umbalane. Okunye akuveza wukuthi kunabantu asebelaxaze imisebenzi, amabhizinisi bashiya nemindeni yabo.UNkk Mkhwanazi-Xaluva, uthe kungakuhle uma uMnyango wokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi KwaZulu-Natal, ungase ulusukumele lolu daba ngokushesha.Uthe okubuhlungu kakhulu wukuthi kulesi simo konaka;a nekusasa lezingane ezincane. Uveze ukuthi kuyamangaza ukuthi kuyekiswe nabafundi isikole. Ulimise ngesihloko elokuthi lena akusiyona inkolo eyamukelekile kuleli ngoba ilimaza abantu abathile kodwa abangaboni ukuthi bayalinyazwa.''Sizimisele ngokuthi kube khona okwenziwayo mayelana nesimo salaphaya. Leya nto ayamukelekile nhlobo,'' usho kanje.Ukhale ngokuthi kukhona nabantu asebeze bayekiswa nemishanguzo yokuthithibalisa igciwane lengculazi. ''Okubuhlungu kakhulu wukuthi abantu bayalalela njalo uma kukhona into ethinta inkolo yabo. Nalapha siyabona ukuthi laba bantu benza konke ngoba nakhu kwenziwa kusetshenziswa inkolo.''Ugcizelele ukuthi mkhulu umsebenzi okusamele wenziwe eNingizimu Afrika, ngenhloso yokubhekana ngqo nezimo zalolu hlobo. Uthe izinto zimapeketwane enkolweni ngenxa yokuthi awukho umkhandlu obhekelele konke okubi okwenziwa kusetshenziswa inkolo.''Asithandazele ukuthi kungabibikho okubi okwenzekayo kulaba bantu abagcinwe kuleya ndawo. Uma kungenzeka okungekuhle lokho kuyobe akwamukelekile.'' Uthe okwabantu abadala kuyamangaza kakhulu ukuthi yini le edala ukuthi bavume ukudela konke bese bekwamukela nje kalula kanjalo ukuthi bagcinwe endaweni eyodwa bengenzi lutho kodwa kuthiwa mabathembe uJesu kuphela.''Okubi wukuthi into enjengalena ayiphethi kahle isikhathi esiningi. Kuzofika isikhathi lapho laba bantu bebona ukuthi akukho lokhu abatshelwa khona kule ndawo abagcinwe kuyona.''Uthe abezinhlaka ezihlukene KwaZulu-Natal, kungakuhle uma bebhukula balusukumele lolu daba izinto zingakonakali kakhulu. Ukhale nangokuthi kuke kwaba nabantu ababeyalelwa ukuthi badle utshani, ngenxa yokuthi balandela inkolo."Kubuhlungu ukubona abantu bemukela konke okwenzeka kuetshenziswa inkolo."Nakuba esho kanje uNkk Mkhwanazi-Xaluva, kodwa umholi wale ndawo uSibiya uthe bamile kwabakwenzayo ngoba balalela uNkulunkulu obaholayo. Uthe abatatazeli futhi abesabi noma ngabe baningi kangakanani abantu ababasolayo ngalokhu. Uveze ukuthi ngeke bazihluphe kakhulu ngabantu abangambulelekile ngeqiniso lokwazana noNkulunkulu onamandla okunqoba konke.

''Konakele kakhulu, akucaci ukuthi kwenzekani mayelana nesihlalo sobukhosi njengoba kusanda kukhothama inkosi nje. Okubi kakhulu wukuthi kubonakala sengathi uma lolu daba lungaphathwa ngendlela efanele, luzogcina seluphuma lokhu okwangampela nje esandleni,'' kuchaza umthombo.Uqhuba uthe umphakathi usuhlalele ovalweni lokuthi kungezeka kuchitheke negazi uma kuba wukuthi lolu daba alusingathwa ngendlela efanele.''Asazi ukuthi kuzogcina kwenzekeni kodwa izinto zibonakala zingahambi nje kahle lokhu okwangempela. Uthe umhlangano uzokuba kusasa ntambama eMagcino, KwaMpokela.''Nenkosi le esanda kukhothama, kwaphuma endlini yalapha KwaMpokela, ukuthi kumele kube yiyo ehola isizwe,'' usho kanje.Uvumile ukuthi indodana yenkosi, uMnuz Mazwi Luthuli, ibhekene ngeziqu zamehlo nomfowabo wenkosi esanda kukhothama, uMnuz Busani Luthuli.''Kusezandleni zami ukunquma ukuthi ubani ozongena kulesi sikhundla,'' usho kanje.Uthe njengoba kuqhubeka ukuklwebhana phakathi kwalaba ababili, into azogcina eyenza wukuthi kungabibikho onikezwa isihlalo phakathi kwabo bobabili. Ugcizelele ukuthi abakuthandi ukuklwebhana osekukhona okuhambisana nomsindo ongenasidingo.
UMENGAMELI Cyril Ramaphosa, uthe usalucubungula udaba lukaKhomishana wamaPhoyisa obhekene necala, uGeneral Fannie Masemola.URamaphosa uthe uzokwenza isimemezelo uma eseqedile ukubheka. Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba abebehambele uhlelo lokudluliselwa koxhaso lokuvusa imizi eyacekelwa phansi ngesikhathi sobandlululo, eNdwedwe, izolo.UMasemola usengcupheni yokumiswa ngenxa yokuthi ubhekene necala elithinta ithenda kaR360 million, eyanikwa inkampani kasomabhizinisi obhekene noxhaxha lwamacala, uMnuz Vusumuzi 'Cat' Matlala. Amadokodo amahlanu awangempela, elilodwa yikhophi.UBrigadier Mathe uthe la madokodo atholwe endlini ewumkhukhu emzini kaNkosi."Wonke lawa macala avalwa ngenxa yokuthi akukho obekutholakala. Uphenyo luzobheka ukuthi ngabe umsolwa akazange yini abe nesandla ekuvalweni kwamacala. La madokodo bekufanele engabe agcinwe eziteshini zamaphoyisa. Amaphoyisa azophenya ukuthi afika kanjani kuyena." UBrigadier Mathe uthe baphinde bathola imfumba yemali emzini kaNkosi.UNkosi ubefuna ukuthi isicelo sakhe sebheyili silalelwe izolo kodwa uMbuso wacela ukunikezwa isikhathi sokuthi uqedele uphenyo. Abameli bakaNkosi bebefuna ukuthi adedelwe izolo, bekhala ngokuthi akaphephile ejele. Bathe uNkosi akadli ejele ngenxa yokwesaba ukuthi uzofakelwa ushevu.Bebefuna nokuthi ashintshelwe kwelinye ijele njengoba egcinwe eKgosi Mampuru II, kodwa imantshi yasichitha leso sicelo . Abezindaba banqatsheliwe ukuba bathwebule uNkosi ngesikhathi evele enkantolo.UNkosi usolwa ngokuba wubhululu wabantu abasolwa ngokuba yimigulukudu okukhona kubo osomabhizinisi ababhekene namacala, uMnuz Vusumuzi 'Cat' Matlala, noMnuz Katiso 'KT' Molefe. Ngesikhathi kuqhubeka iKhomishini eholwa yiJaji Mbuyiseli Madlanga, kwavela ukuthi uNkosi ubethola imali kuMatlala.UNkosi usebenzela uphiko olulwa nobugebengu obuhleliwe futhi usondelene noKhomishana wamaPhoyisa omisiwe, uLieutenant General Shadrack Sibiya.

Eqhuba uthe kusasa, umasipala uzokhipha isitatimende esigcwele lapho uzobe uchaza kabanzi ngalolu daba uphinde umemezele nozongena esikhundleni sikaVezi njengoba esasekhefini nje.Uthe nakubona njengoba bebhekelele ezokuxhumana nje, azikho izindaba zalolu hlobo esezike zafinyelela ezindlebeni zabo. Lesi siphithiphithi siza emva kokuba ezinkundleni zokuxhumana zisabalalise okumlilo wequbula izindaba ebeziyamanisa esinye sezikhulu zalo masipala nokuduka kwale mali. Yize kusabalale ngale ndlela ezinkundleni zokuxhumana kodwa lesi sikhulu naso siphumele obala saveza ukuthi simane sibhecwa ngobende nje inyama singazange siyidle. Sisole itulo lokungcoliswa kwegama laso ngabantu abathile abanezinhloso zabo ezaziwa yibona kuphela. Sibe sesiveza nokuthi alukho uqhekeko olukhona kulo masipala konke kuhamba kahle. "Akukho ukungaboni ngaso linye okukhona phakathi kumasipala,'' kucacisa lesi sikhulu esisolwa ngokuduka kwemali ngesikhathi sikhuluma neSolezwe. Kuvela ukuthi lolu daba selukhulunywe kakhulu nasemphakathini njengoba kuvela ukuthi umphakathi ufisa ukuthola umnyombo ngalo nanokwazi ukuthi luyiqiniso kangakanani.IMeya yakulo masipala, uNkk Sindisiwe Msomi uMaJobe, ithe seluqalile uphenyo mayelana nodaba. ''Asazi ukuthi luzothatha isikhathi esingakanani kodwa konke kuncike kakhulu ekutheni sitholani." UNkk Msomi uthe akathandi ukwanda kakhulu ngalo kuze kube kufika isikhathi sokuba kuphothulwa uphenyo, waveza ukuthi yize beshaqekile ngalo kodwa basaqhubeka nemisebenzi emihle yomphakathi okufaka phakathi ukwakhiwa kwemigwaqo, amahholo namabhuloho abahamba ngezinyawo.Uthe kusasa kuzohlala umkhandlu ebese kubekwa isikhulu esizobamba ngesikhathi kusaqhubeka uphenyo.

UMbalula uthe i-ANC iyaqhubeka nombhidlango wokulungisa omasipala, wathi lo mbhidlango usuqalile ukuthela izithelo ezinhle.Uthe uma abaholi be-ANC beqhubeka nalo mbhidlango, akakungabazi ukuthi bazokwenza kahle okhethweni lohulumeni basekhaya waze wathi ubona bezobuyisa uMasipala waseTshwane."Uma niqhubeka kanje, angikungabazi ukuthi sizowubuyisa lo masipala. Abantu abathathe lo mkhandlu abazange benze lutho ngesikhathi bephethe. Yingakho ngithi sizowubuyisa lo masipala. Thina into okufanele siyenze wukuigxila emkhankasweni wethu, singanaki ukuthi amanye amaqembu enzani. Kufanele senze izinto ezibonakalayo, singagcini ngokusho iziqubulo," kusho uMbalula. Uthe:"Abantu kufanele bayethembe i-ANC. Abantu bazoyethemba i-ANC uma abaholi bayo besebenza ngokuthembeka. Badlala ngesikhathi laba abathi sekuphelile nge-ANC. Ningaphikisani nawo la maxoki. Umuntu ozobulala i-ANC akakazalwa. U-Oliver Tambo wathi i-ANC ngeke ibulawe wumuntu, wathi iyozibulala yona."UMbalula uthe sekusele kancane ukuthi bakhiphe umkhombandlela ngodaba lobudlelwano babo nedlelandawonye labo elinqume ukungenela ukhetho, i-SACP. UMbalula uthe bazothatha isinqumo maduze, wathi kuzoshuba kakhulu. "Ngeke aphele amasonto amabili singawukhiphanga umkhombandlela. Kuzosha amadamu anamanzi. Kuzocaca ukuthi siyaphi. Le ndaba siyayixoxa nabo futhi bayawazi amaphutha abo." UMbalula uncome isibindi sikaMahlangu owayeyisosha lombutho wezempi kwi-ANC, uMkhonto weSizwe.UMahlangu walengiswa ngo-1979, eneminyaka engu-22."Sathatha isinqumo sokuthi kufanele silukhumbule minyaka yonke lolu suku. Lona wumlando okufanele uxoxelwe abasebancane. Kufanele sazi ukuthi asiyitholanga kalula inkululeko. UMahlangu wafela le nkululeko. Wabulawa emncane ebulawa ngesihluku wuhulumeni wobandlululo," kusho uMbalula.

BATHI bancamela ukuhlala emakhaya kunokuthi bagide ndawonye abafundi baseKhayelihle High School, eMbumbulu, ebebenza u-matric base bephindiswa kwaGrade 11.Laba bafundi bathi abasaqondi nqindi nasibhakela njengoba bebona sengathi sebephenduke ibhola labathile. Omunye walaba bafundi uthi bese befeyile uGrade 11 amahlandla amathathu eminyakeni eyedlule.Ngonyaka owedlule uthi bonke baphasile badluliselwa kwaGrade 12. Uthi kodwa kushintshile ukudla epuletini ngesikhathi kufika umhloli ebanikeza umyalelo wokuthi bonke laba bafundi abangu-11 kumele baphindele kwaGrade 11.''Asizange sikuthole ukuchazeleka kahle ukuthi kungani kushiwo kanjena. Esikutsheliwe nje ukuthi amagama ethu awaveli kubafundi bakulesi sikole abenza u-matric ngoba siwufeyilile uGrade 11. Le nto isiyasidida ukuthi yenzeka kanjani?,'' kusho omunye umfundi.Uthe kuyabaxaka ukuthi bangenza u-matric kusuka ngoJanuwari kuvula izikole kuze kube uMashi ebese kuzoqhamuka umuntu ezobatshela ukuthi mabaphindele kwaGrade 11. Lokhu bakubize ngembudane yoqobo.''Sesimane sacikeka sonke samane sathatha isinqumo sokuthi simane sisidube isikole ayikho phela le nto,'' echaza.Omunye walaba bafundi naye uhambe emazwini kazakwabo wathi badukuza ebumnyameni ukuthi ngampela kwenzakalani ngabo kulesi sikole. Uthe babone kungcono ukuba bamane baduve emakhaya kunokuthi badane bephendulwa iyoyo.Omunye osesigungwini sabazali, ocele ukuba kugodlwe igama lakhe uthe ulwazi kahle lolu daba, uthe sebezame kaningi ukululungisa kodwa kunalokho izinto zimane zingahlangani.''Ngangikhona, ngilwazi kahle udaba okhuluma ngalo. Laba bafundi beza bezokhalaza kuthishanhloko bezobuza ukuthi kungani befeyila ngendlela efanayo wonke amamaki abo efana,'' kuchaza ilungu lesigungu.Uthe abanye bothisha batshela abazali bezingane ukuthi bona badukuza ebumnyameni ngoba izingane beziphasile kodwa kwatshintshwa lokho.Uthi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi uthishomkhulu bahlangane naye ugcine esethi uyalibona iphutha uyaxolisa.Uthi baphinde baba nomunye umhlangano ngalolu daba behlangene nothishomkhulu kodwa nalapho akukho okusha abaphendule ngakho.''Sesibuya kulo umhlangano lo wesibili ushaye ungqimphothwe wathi ubone kahle, abekho abafundi okumele baphase kumele bavele babuyiselwe kwaGrade 11,'' echaza.Uthi lugcine lugobile uphondo kuthishomkhulu wavuma ukuba baye kwa-matric laba bafundi. ''Emva kwalokho sizwe sisemakhaya ukuthi kukhona abahloli okuyibona abathathe isinqumo sokuba babuyiselwe kwaGrade 11,''echaza.Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uMuzi Mahlambi, uthe isekethe ingasiguqula isinqumo sesikole mayelana nemiphumela yabafundi abaphasiswe okanye baphindiswe ikilasi. ''Kodwa-ke kulesi simo abafundi baphoqa uthishomkhulu ukuba abaphasise isekethe yase iyasiguqula leso sinqumo isebenzisa imigomo yayo,'' kuchaza uMahlambi.

INGCABHA isemphakathini ukuthi uphawule ngemigomo ethinta indlela okumele izikole zisingathe ngayo udaba lokukhulelwa kwabafundi besafunda.Le migomo esemthethweni iBasic Educations Laws Act (Bela), idedelwe nguNgqongqoshe woMnyango weMfundo eyisiSekelo, uNksz Siviwe Gwarube ukuze umphakathi uphawule ngayo.Uthe le migomo ivikela ilungelo lomfundi osuke ekhulelwe esasesikoleni."Iqinisekisa ukuthi umfundi okhulelwe, kumele asekwe yisikole ngesikhathi esakhulelwe. USOMABHIZINISI waseThekwini, uNksz Shauwn "MaMkhize" Mkhize, ulwa ngayo yonke indlela ukuvimba abe-South African Revenue Service (SARS), ukuthi badayise imizi yakhe.Lokhu kuza njengoba kulindeleke ukuthi kulalelwe isicelo esiphuthumayo sabe-SARS, njengoba uMaMkhize ehlulekile ukukhokha intela ebalelwa ku-R40 million. Izolo, abameli bakaMaMkhize batshele iNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini, ukuthi isicelo se-SARS sokuthi idayise imizi, kufanele sisuswe ohlwini lwamacala azolalelwa yinkantolo ngephuzu elithi udaba kaluphuthumi. I-SARS inikele enkantolo ukuyofuna imvume yokudayisa imizi, izwakalisa ukukhathazeka ngokuthi impahla kaMaMkhize iyawohloka futhi ilahlekelwa amandla ngokwentengo. Iveze ukuthi eminye yemizi engaphansi kweso likaMgcinimafa oqokiwe ayinakekelwa futhi inemali yentela engakhokhiwe, elokhu inyuka. Akuzange kucaciswe ukuthi ikuphi nendawo leyo mizi. U-Advocate Sinethemba Ndlovu obemele uMaMkhize nowayengumyeni wakhe uMnuz Sbu Mpisane, usole i-SARS ngokwehluleka ukubambelela kwimigomo elawula ezokufakwa kwesicelo eziphuthumayo. U-Adv Ndlovu uveze ukuthi udaba oluphuthumayo lulalelwa ezinyangeni ezintathu kulandela ukufakwa kwamaphepha. Uqhube wathi lesi sicelo kwakufanele sifakwe masinyane. "Sekuphele unyaka nezinyanga ezintathu uma ngikhumbula kahle,” kusho yena egcizelela eyokuthi udaba alusaphuthumi. Abameli bakaMaMkhize bathe le mizi i-SARS efuna ukuyidayisa ihlala amakhasimende akhe. Nokho iJaji uJacqueline Henriques, libuze ukuthi lokhu kwakungachazwanga ngani ezincwadini ezifungelwe? Lithe zine izincwadi ezifungelwe ezabhalwa, wathi kuzona akukho neyodwa eyaveza lokhu. U-Adv Hein Synman SC omele i-SARS ukuphikisile ukuthi abameli bakaMaMkhize bazame ukwenza izethulo ukuphendula obekubuzwa yijaji. Uthe i-SARS inecala eliqinile lokudayisa elethule phambi kwenkantolo. USynman ubeke iphuzu lokuthi ukuguqula imizi ibe yimali kuzosiza zombili izinhlangothi, olukaMaMkhize kanjalo ne-SARS. Uthe njengoba ama-akhawunti kaMaMkhize asemabhange evaliwe, akakwazi ukunakekela imizi futhi ne-SARS ngeke isebenzise imali yabakhokhi bentela ukuthi yenze lokhu. USynman uchaze eyokuthi yonke imali ezokwenziwa ngokudayiswa kwemizi, kuzobe kwenziwa ngaphansi kweso loMgcinimafa ka-SARS, kuze kuba ukuthi udaba lokukhokhwa kwentela luyaphothulwa. Uveze nokuthi uma kwenzeka ukuthi uMaMkhize ephuma phambili ecaleni, uyobe esebuyiselwa imali yakhe. UHenriques uphinde wabuza umbuzo obalulekile othi, kuyokwenziwa njani uma uMaMkhize ethi ufuna umuzi wakhe, hhayi imali?Ephendula uSynman, uthe uMaMkhize wayengazange ayitshele inkantolo ngokusemthethweni ukuthi kukhona imizi angafuni idayiswe ngoba ibalulekile. Ukwenza isibonelo; ngelithi mhlawumbe umuzi ungokanina. U-Advocate Coreth Naudé SC, owadutshulwa ngo-2024, ngesikhathi kunophenyo lokukhokhwa kwentela yendodana kaMaMkhize, u-Andile Mpisane, naye ubekhona enkantolo esiza uSynman.Inkantolo isigodlile isinqumo sayo kulolu daba.
UMASIPALA waseThekwini uhlongoza ukunyusa amanzi, ugesi, nemali yokuqoqwa kukadoti.Umasipala uhlongoza ukuthi ugesi unyuke ngo-10.5%, amanzi kuhlongozwa ukuthi anyuke ngo-16% kosomabhizinisi, bese kuthi emakhaya anyuke ngo-15%. Lesi siphakamiso siqukethwe esabelwenimali somkhandlu esihlongozwayo. Isabelomali somkhandlu esihlongozwayo sethulwe iMeya uMnuz Cyril Xaba, emhlanganweni womkhandlu, obuyizolo.Sisonke isabelomali esihlongozwayo singu-R74.7 billion. UXaba uthe ingxenye enkulu yale mali kuzolungiswa ngayo ingqalasizinda. Echaza ngesiphakamiso sokunyusa ugesi, uXaba uthe banqume ukuphakamisa ukuthi ugesi unyuke ngo-10.5%, ngenxa yokuthi inhlangano ehlinzeka ngogesi, i-Eskom, ihlongoza ukunyusa ugesi ngo-9%.UXaba uthe babeke eceleni u-R746 million ozolungisa ingqalasizinda kagesi kuphinde kwakhiwe iziteshi zikagesi ezintsha. Uthe inkampani ehlinzeka ngamanzi, uMngeni-uThukela Water, izonyusa amanzi ngo-13%. Uveze ukuthi imali abazothenga ngayo amanzi kunyaka wezimali ozayo, u-R11.1 billion."Lapho sibala no-R2.1 billion ozothenga amanzi esizowahlinzeka mahhala." UXaba uthe baphakamisa ukuthi imali yokuqoqwa kukadoti inyuke ngo-13% bese kuthi eyokuthuthwa kwendle inyuke ngo-14% kosomabhizinisi, emakhaya khona inyuke ngo-13%.Lesi sabelomali kusazobhungwa ngaso emihlanganweni yomphakathi ngaphambi kokuthi siphasiswe ngoJuni. Amaqembu ezepolitiki athe awahambisani nokunyuka kwemali yezidingo okuhlongozwayo.Ikhansela le-IFP, uMnuz Jonathan Annipen, lithe abantu abaningi abahlala eThekwini bayahluleka ukukhokhela izidingo zomkhandlu. "Akukhona ukuthi abafuni ukukhokhela izidingo kodwa iyona imali abangenayo. Iqiniso ukuthi isimo somnotho emhlabeni jikelele sibi. Abantu bathwele kanzima."Ikhansela le-DA uMnuz Andre Beetge, lithe abantu baseThekwini bazohluleka ukukhokhela izidingo uma zigcine zinyuswa ngale ndlela okuhlongozwa ukuthi zinyuswe ngayo."Kanti kuyoze kube nini abantu baseThekwini bethweswa umthwalo? Abantu bathwele kanzima."UBeetge ukhale ngokusetshenziswa budedengu kwezimoto zomkhandlu."Uphethroli uzonyuka kakhulu. Sihlezi sibona abantu betetemuka ngezimoto zomkhandlu ngezimpelasonto. Ngabe umkhandlu uzoqapha ukusebenza kwezimoto?"

KULE mpelasonto, ngaphezu kwezigidigidi ezimbili zamaKristu emhlabeni wonke azogubha iSonto lePhasika, ememezela ethi: "UKristu uvukile! Uvukile impela!". Kodwa kusho ukuthini ngempela lokhu, futhi kungani kubalulekile? Ngokulandisa kwamaVangeli, abesifazane beza ethuneni likaJesu ekuseni ngovivi bezogcoba isidumbu saKhe. Kunalokho, bathola itshe ligingqiwe lasuswa futhi ithuna lingenalutho. Ingelosi yathi: "Akakho lapha; uvukile." Yisona sisekelo lesi sokholo lobuKristu. Uvuko luyimpendulo kaNkulunkulu ekwesabeni okujulile kwesintu - ukufa. Kumemezela ukuthi ukufa akunamandla, ukufa kunqotshiwe, uthando luyayinqoba inzondo, nokuthi kukhona ukuphila ngale kwethuna. Ezweni eligubuzelwe ukulahlekelwa nosizi, iPhasika liletha ithemba elikhulu. ukufa kunqotshiwe. Igama elithi "Easter" lisuselwa kunkulunkulukazi wamaJalimane owayaziwa ngokuthi ngu "Ēostre" noma "Ostara," ohlotshaniswa nentwasahlobo nokuqhuma kwembewu egqitshwe emhlabathini. Kuthe uma amaJalimane esamukele iVangeli, kwabizwa umkhosi wokuVuka nokumenyezelwa kwempilo entsha kuKristu ngo-Easter. Njengalokhu intwasahlobo iguqula isomiso, uVuko luguqula yonke indalo. IBandla lasendulo alixakwanga yigama elithi Easter. Amandla eVangeli aguqula nobekungenankazimulo kuphenduke kube nencazelo nenjongo yaphakade. Cabanga ngesiphambano. Ngesikhathi kubusa amaRoma, ukubethelwa kwakuyindlela yokubulawa eyayihlazisa kakhulu, yenzelwe ukwehlisa isithunzi somuntu ojeziswayo. Akekho owayengabona inkazimulo kumuntu obethelwe — kuphela olahlwe ngabakubo noqalekisiwe. Nokho ngenxa yamandla oVuko, ithuluzi lokululaza laguquka laba uphawu lwensindiso yomhlaba wonke. Igama iPhasika lisuselwa kwelesiHebheru elithi "Pesach” okungukuthi "Passover" ngesiNgisi. Lokhu kusho ukwedlula noma ukweqa. Mhla kukhululwa u-Israyeli eGibhithe uSimakade wathi: "Igazi liyokuba wuphawu lwenu ezindlini lapho nihleli khona: uma ngibona igazi, ngiyokwedlula kini, ngeke ubhubhane lunibhubhise lapho ngishaya iGibhithe" (I-Eksodusi 12:13). KumaKristu, uJesu uyiWundlu lePhasika lokugcina, elikhulula isintu esonweni nasekufeni uqobo. I-Phasika likhumbula ukubethelwa, ukufa nokuvuka kwakhe emva kwezinsuku ezintathu. Ukholo lobuKristu lwaba yisisekelo esinqala ngezikhathi zobumnyama bobandlululo eNingizimu ye-Afrika. Ukholo loVuko luye lwanikeza ithemba kwabangenathemba namandla kwababeshushiswa. Lolu kholo lwaletha isiqinisekiso sokuthi ingcindezelo ngeke kugcine yona. Umphumela wokuVuka kukaKristu usaqhubeka nanamuhla. UNkulunkulu unamandla okuthatha okubonakala kungelutho noma sengathi kufile, akuguqule kube kuhle kuphile. Ubuhlobo nobudlelwano obulimele bungabuyiselwa. Izimpilo ezonakele zingakhiwa kabusha. Okubonakala sengathi kuyaphela kungaba yisiqalo esisha. Noma ngabe yini edinga uVuko empilweni yakho, noma ngabe ibonakala sengathi ifile noma ingaphezu kwethemba, iPhasika limemezela ukuthi akukho okungaphezu kwamandla kaNkulunkulu okuguqula. Isono nokufa kunqotshiwe. Konke okunye ukuhlulwa kungokwesikhashana nje. Sithi jabha kufa, washweba sathane, iqhawe lamaqhawe likwehlule. Haleluya, uKristu uvukile! Uvukile impela, Haleluya! Nkosi sikelel' iAfrika. UNkulunkulu anibusise. UMfundisi Sizwe Ngcobo ungu-Ashdikini wasePinetown noMphathi wesiFundaMpristi saseKloof ebandleni laseSheshi kwiDayosisi yaeNatali

UKHALELWE ngamasongo kaSigonyela owesilisa osolwa ngokuthathela umfowabo umshwalense wesigidi engazi.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi uMnuz Senzo Mthandeni Mthethwa (43), uboshelwe icala alivulelwe umfowabo. Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi ezinyangeni ezedlule Isolezwe labika kabanzi ngalolu daba lapho isisulu, uMnuz Nhlakanipho Mthethwa waseShowe ngokudabuka, ayevutha engabaselwe esola umfowabo oboshiwe ngokuthi wamthathela umshwalense wesigidi engazi futhi ngaphandle kwemvume yakhe.UMthethwa (Nhlakanipho) wathi usekhethe ukuba amane amvulele icala umfowabo ngesenzo sakhe athi samnenga futhi samshiya nemidlinzo. Njengoba eseboshiwe nje, uthe kulokoza inhlansi yethemba ngokuthi uzobuthola ubulungiswa ngaleli cala enkantolo. ''Ngifuna ukuthi ame phambi kwenkantolo achaze kahle ukuthi kungani enza le nto ayenzile. Ngiyabonga kakhulu ukuthi ekugcineni uze waboshwa. Phela akaqali ukwenza le nto lo muntu kubantu balapha ekhaya,''usho kanje.Elandisa, waveza ukuthi umshwalense wathathwa kwa-Old Mutual ngoMeyi 2024.Isolezwe linayo ikhophi yakwa-Old Mutual, eveza ukuthi ngempela umshwalense uvuliwe. UMthethwa uthe uthole ngalokhu ngesikhathi eye egatsheni lakwa-Old Mutual, kukhona ayokwenza kanti uzozithela kule nsumansumane. "Osebenza khona kwathi uma ebona izinto zami wangibuza ukuthi ngiyazi yini ngomshwalense wesigidi samarandi ovulwe egameni lami? Ngamtshela ukuthi angazi. Wavele wanginikeza amaphepha afakazela lokho nokuthi uvulwe wumfowethu.”Uthe noma ehamba usethuka izanya ngoba uyazi ukuthi kunomuntu okubheke ngabomvu ukuhlomula ngezindodla zemali uma kwenzeka yena edlula emhlabeni. UMthethwa uthe isenzo simcabangise izinto eziningi ngoba uyamazi umfowabo. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uConstable Thenjiswa Ngcobo, ukuqinisekisile ukuboshwa kwalo mlisa. Uthe amaphoyisa abophe owesilisa oneminyaka engu-43 nomunye oneminyaka engu-48, ngecala lokuthathela amalungu emindeni yabo imishwalense engazi.''La macala kuvela ukuthi enzeka eMpangeni kanye naseWentworth ngokuhlukana kwawo. Abasolwa bavelile enkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini, bazobuye babuyele ngoMeyi 19,'' usho kanje.
UMBHISHOBHI omkhulu wamaKhatholika eThekwini, u-Archbishop Mandla Jwara, usenze inhlabamkhosi eyibhekise emakholweni aleli bandla ekhuza ukuvunyelwa kokungena kobuqembuqembu phakathi kwamaKhatholika ewodwa.UMbhishobhi Jwara ubekhuluma emkhosini waminyaka yonke obuseNtshongweni, eThekwini, ngempelasonto edlule. Lo mkhosi waziwa ngeSiyonqamlezweni. Uxwayise imihlangano yebandla ukuba ingabi yindawo yokudala uqhekeko ebandleni lamaKhatholika.Lo mkhosi waqalwa inhlangano yomama eyaziwa ngo-Anna (St Anne) kanti usuke ubhulela amazolo impelasonto yePhasika okugujwa ngayo ukubethelwa, ukufa kanye nokuvuka kukaJesu. Bekuhlangene amalungu alinganiselwa ku-2500 kulo mbuthano owenzeke ngesikhathi lapho amakholwa amapherishi athile kade ebhekene nokuxokozela okuthinta ukushintshwa kofata. Wethula intshumayelo kulo mkhosi nje, uMbhishobhi uJwara ubesanda kubhekana nokugxijwa amanye amakholwa ePherishi yasePinetown naseMontclair ngokushintshwa kofata bakhona ngoba bekholelwa ekutheni yingoba engahambisani nendlela yabo yokukhonza okubikwa ukuthi bakusheba nobungoma. Inkonzo yaseNtshongweni ingenye yezibalulekile emhlanganweni ka-Anna kanti iye ilandelwe yinkonzo yeSidlo ephathwa nguye uMbhishobhi omkhulu njengoba enzile ngempelasonto lapho abehambisana nabaPristi abaningi beDayosi yaseThekwini. UMbhishobhi ucaphune isifundo sosuku esikuJeremiya, lapho lo mphrofethi wayebhala ngabaceba ukumenzakalisa. Ufanise lokhu nenzondo ebonakala yenzeka phakathi kwemihlangano eyahlukene ebandleni, okukhona kuyo inhlebo namanga aqanjwa ngabanye abantu. Wenabe ngokuthi kuba khona nomhobholo phakathi kwamalungu nokuqhudelana ebandleni, izindela nabefundisi uqobo, wabe esenxusa ukuba baqhele kulo mkhuba ongemuhle ongcolisa ibandla.
ZETHUKILE izikhulu kuMasipala uMdoni, eScottburgh, kulandela ukuvela kwezinsolo zokuthi inkabi ethelwe othulini ngamaphoyisa ezintatha zayizolo, ibihlela ukuyobulala ezinye zezikhulu.Lokhu kuvele ngesikhathi abesiteshi sezindaba zikamabonakude esikhokhelwayo, i-eNCA, beveza ukuthi umufi oneminyaka engu-41 obulawe ePinetown, ngesikhathi kukhona ukudubulana phakathi wakhe namaphoyisa, ubehlela ukuyosoconga izikhulu zalo masipala. "Sisathumele imenenja kamasipala ukuthi isixhumanele namaphoyisa ukuthola kabanzi ngalezi zinsolo esizibone ezinkundleni zokuxhumana. Uma ebuyisa impendulo ekhomba ukuthi kukhona izikhulu ezisengcupheni yokubulawa, sizoziqinisa ezokuphepha,” kusho uNkk Cele-Luthuli.Uthe bazoyiphenya eyalezi zinsolo ukuthi iqhamukaphi."Akekho obesabike ngokuthi kukhona izinsongo zokubulala noma zokusatshiswa,” isho kanje. Athe uma enikela khona, kube khona ukudubulana phakathi kwakhe namaphoyisa, wafa. Kutholwe isibhamu ezincane nezinkulu endaweni yesigameko," kusho uNetshiunda.
KUSENZIMA kwabe-SACP ukwamukela ukugqashuka kwegoda phakathi kwabo nedlelandawonye labo, i-ANC. Abaholi be-SACP abahambisani nokuthi abathembuzayo baphoqwe ukuthi bakhethe phakathi kokuhamba ne-ANC noma ukuhamba namaKhomanisi okhethweni oluzayo.Abaholi be-SACP bathe bafuna ukuba nezingxoxo nabe-ANC khona kuzokhulunywa ngalolu daba. Bakusho esitatimendeni abasikhiphe emva komhlangano wesigungu esiphezulu. Abaholi be-ANC okubalwa kubo uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa noNobhala Jikelele, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, bakhombise ngokusobala ukuthi kuzophela nya ukuthembuza.Ngesikhathi bekhuluma ngempelasonto bobabili bathe azozifaka obishini amalungu e-ANC azokhankasela i-SACP okhethweni oluzayo. URamaphosa noMbalula bathe umhlangano wesigungu esiphezulu kwi-ANC olandelayo, uzonikeza umkhombandlela ngalolu daba.Okhulumela i-SACP, uMnuz Mbulelo Mandlana, uthe bafuna ukuthi abanobulungu be-ANC nobe-SACP bavunyelwe ukuthembuza. UMandlana uthe imigomo ye-SACP neye-ANC ivumela amalungu ukuthi athembuze."Kufanelwe icaciswe kahle indaba yokuthi lizovikelwa kanjani ilungelo labantu abakhetha ukuba nobulungu be-SACP ne-ANC njengoba kuza ukhetho. Imigomo yawo omabili amaqembu iyawavumela amalungu ukuthi athembuze." Uthe: "Kuyasikhathaza ukuthi abanye abaholi be-ANC bakhombisa ukuzithwala, basongela abantu abathembuzayo. Okubi kakhulu ukuthi le nto yenziwa abaholi abanezikhundla eziphezulu kwi-ANC. Thina sifuna ukuthi lolu daba luxoxwe nje kahle. Abaholi be-ANC ibona abakhetha ukuvumela amalungu ayo ukuthi abe nobulungu be-SACP."Kuzokube kungokokuqala i-SACP ingenela ukhetho ngokuzimela njengoba ibiyaye ikhankasele i-ANC uma kunokhetho. UMandlana uthe bafuna ukuthi babonisane nabaholi be-ANC ukuthi bazosebenzisana kanjani njengoba bezokube bebanga okhethweni."Lezi zingxoxo kufanele sibe nazo maduze njengoba ukhetho seluseMome futhi nombango umkhulu kwezinye izindawo."I-SACP ivele isiqalile ukuzwa amanzi ngobhoko ngokungenela ukhetho lokuchibiyela. Nokho i-SACP ivamise ukuthola amavoti amancane okhethweni lokuchibiyela esike yalungenela. Yize kunjalo, uMandlana uncome isibindi nokuzimisela kwamalungu e-SACP ngesikhathi bengenele ukhetho lokuchibiyela ezifundazweni i-Eastern Cape neWestern Cape.

Emasontweni amabili ezayo sizolifulathela elase-Iran, sizokube sesiqedile. Sizowuqeda maduze umsebenzi." Uthe i-Iran ayisenazo izikhali zokulwa."Sesibanqobile. Abaholi base-Iran bonke babhubhile. Ingakho kukhona abaholi abasha. Kuzobathatha iminyaka engu-15 ukuthi baphinde bakhe izikhali zokulwa. Ngikhuluma nawe nje abanayo imikhumbi yezempi, abanawo amabhanoyi ezempi futhi abanayo nengqalasizinda yezokuxhumana." UTrump uthe kukhona izingxoxo zokuqeda impi eziqhubekayo."Siyaxoxa nabo manje. Kungenzeka sivumelane nabo ngaphambi kokuthi size sibaqede. Konke kuncike kubona. Uma singafinyeleli esivumelwaneni, sizoqeda ngabo."UTrump uthe okubajabulisayo ukuthi i-Iran ngeke iphinde ibe nezikhali zenuzi."Inhloso enkulu yokuhlasela kwakuyikho vele ukuvimba i-Iran ukuthi ibe nezikhali zenuzi." Nakuba uTrump ethi i-Iran isigobe inkani, abaholi base-Iran bathe bakulungele ukuqhubeka nempi noma ngabe izothatha izinyanga eziyisithupha ukuthi iphele. Impi eqhubekayo iholele ekunyukeni kukaphethroli emhlabeni jikelele.I-Iran namazwe angomakhelwano bayo, banothe kakhulu kuwoyela. Impi iphazamise ukuthunyelwa kukawoyela emazweni amaningi njengoba imikhumbi eminingi ingakwazi ukudlula ephasejini lasolwandle olubizwa nge-Strait of Hormuz. Lapha eNingizimu Afrika uphethroli unyuke ngo-R3.06, kwathi udizili wanyuka ngemali engaphezu kuka-R7.

Sabe sesithola usuku enkantolo kulandela ukwenza isicelo sokuthi lulalelwe ngokuphuthuma udaba,” kusho uMajola.Uthe kubajabulisile okunqunywe yinkantolo. Lokhu kusijabulisile ngoba yikho ebesikufuna futhi nabazali bajabule kakhulu ngoba bebevele belwela ukuthi angakhishwa,” usho kanje.Uthe selokhu luqalile ukukhulunywa nokususa umsindo olwamakhamera, bebelokhu bemile kwelithi awangakhishwa ngoba awusizo kubafundi nothisha kulesi sikole, okuthiwa sinenkinga yokungenelwa yizigebengu mihla namalanga.Uthe abanalo ulwazi lokuthi kuzokwenzekani ngenqwaba yothisha beSadtu abalaxaza ukufundisa. Labo thisha bafunga bagomela ukuthi ngeke babuye ukuzofundisa uma amakhamera engakakhishwa. "Asazi ke ukuthi bazokwenzenjani njengoba isinqumile inkantolo ukuthi awangakhishwa amakhamera,” usho kanje. "Esesikufisa ukuthi uMnyango ungenelele ekutheni kuqashwe ngokugcwele labo thisha ababambile njengamanje,” usho kanje.Kulesi sikole kugcine kumiswa uthishanhloko, uMnuz Ntokozo Ngobese, izinyanga ezintathu. SIMGCULISILE isigwebo sikadilikajele esinikwe umfowabo, owesilisa waseChesterville, eThekwini, kulandela ukulahlwa yicala lokuzama ukubulala indodana yakhe ngoba ethi uyamyala.USduduzo Mavundla (29), ugixabezwe ngodilikajele yiNkantolo yesiFunda saseThekwini ngoMsombuluko, elahlwa yicala lokuzama ukubulala uMpendulo Msweli, owayeneminyaka eyisishiyagalolunye ngesikhathi kwenzeka isigameko ngoJanuwari 2024.Uyise kaMpendulo, uMnuz Simingezwilenkosi Mavundla, uthe simjabulisile isigwebo, wathi unethemba lokuthi sizoyijabulisa nendodana yakhe. Sikhululwa wukuthi okungenani, njengoba evalelwe nje, uyophuma ejele ingane yami isikhulile,” kusho uMavundla.Ngosuku lwesigameko kuthiwa olahlwe yicala wayenga umgilwa, owayefike ngokuvakasha kubo kayise eChesterville, wathi abaye esitolo ayomthengela ama-chips. Kuthiwa wagcina ezibuyela yedwa emva kwesikhathi umgilwa engekho, kwathi uma ebuzwa ngaye, wathi yena umnike u-R2 ukuthi ayozithengela ama-chips esitolo, yena waqhubeka nenye indlela.Kuthiwa umgilwa wacingwa yonke indawo, engatholakali, kwaze kwabikelwa amaphoyisa. Kuvela ukuthi watholwa esesesibhedlela iVictoria Mxenge (King Edward), enenkebenkebe yengozi ebusweni. Kwavela ukuthi uSduduzo, owayekade esiza ngesikhathi kucingwa umgilwa nawo wonke umuntu, wuye owayemyengele ehlathini, lapho afika khona wamlimaza ngesikhali esithize, wamshiya ezitshela ukuthi ufile. Kuthiwa umgilwa waphaphama sekuhwalele, wagaqa, waze wayofika emgwaqweni okuyilapho athathwa khona abantu angabazi, bamphuthumisa esibhedlela. Zabe sezimkhalela ummangalelwa, umgilwa etshela amaphoyisa nezihlobo ukuthi uSduduzo omlimazile, ngelithi ufuna ukufundisa uyise isifundo. Emva kokugwetshwa kukaSduduzo, uyise kamgilwa utshele Isolezwe ukuthi umfowabo wayethi uzwisa yena ubuhlungu ngokuzama ukubulala indodana yakhe kwazise wayemkweleta imali. Uveze ukuthi yayila ku-R32 000 imali ayemkweleta yona umfowabo emalini eyayinguR61 000 ayemboleke yona ngasekuqaleni kuka-2022. "Wayephunyelwe yimali yesibili, kulandela ukushona kukanina ngo-2014. Sakhuluma, savumelana ngokuthi angiboleke uR50 000, engangizogcwalisela phezu kwawo ngithenge imoto yokwenza umsebenzi we-Uber. Wagcina engiboleka uR61 000, okwathi emva kokungifakela ebhange, washintsha, watshela umndeni ukuthi ngimphuzise uphuzo oludakayo, ngase ngintshontsha imali yakhe,” kusho uMavundla.Uthe ngokudinwa yisenzo sikamfowabo, wagcina eyisebenzisa budlabha imali, wangabe esayithenga imoto ayethi uzoyithenga. Uveze ukuthi umfowabo wagcina eya ebhange eyosho ukuthi imali engene ebhange likamfowabo, isuka kwelakhe yebiwe. Ibhange lakhetha ukuyivala, yangakwazi ukuphuma, kodwa futhi langayibuyisela kumnikazi.Uqhube wathi yayikuR35 000 imali agcina eyisebenzisa budlabha kuR61 000 ayewubolekiwe. Uveze ukuthi emva kwemihlangano embalwa yomndeni lapho okwakuzanywa khona ukuthi kulungiswe udaba babuyisane, bagcina beya emaphoyiseni beyofuna izincwadi ezifungelwe abazihambisa ebhange, ukuze lidedele imali engu-R26 500 eyayivalelekile. "Kwathi uma liyidedela ibhange, ngambuyisela uR20 000, engagcina ngithola ukuthi wasebenzisa uR15 000 wawo ukungithengela izinkabi ezazizongibulala,” kusho uMavundla, othe wasinda emlonyeni wengwenya ngokuthi angalubhadi eNanda lapho uSduduzo ayemyengela khona ophathe. Uthe yaqhubeka yabanjwa eminye imihlangano yomndeni ukuzama ukuza nesixazululo ngoba kwakubonakala ukuthi isimo siyaphuma endleleni kulandela ukuthi uSduduzo esedubele emotweni yomuntu ekhokhelwa ngebanga elihambile, uMavundla ayehamba ngayo.Uqhube wathi kwase kuvunyelwenwe ngokuthi ngoJanuwari 2024, uzoqala ayikhokhe kancane kancane aze ayiqede, okwagcina kungasenzekanga, uSduduzo esezama ukubulala umgilwa. Uthe yize ayemazi uSduduzo ukuthi unenhliziyo embi, kodwa wayengakaze akhombise ukuthi indodana yakhe uyicabangela okubi."Wayeyithanda ngale ndlela, kungekho okusolisayo ukuthi uzoyenzakalisa,” kusho uMavundla, othe ugculiseke kakhulu ngesigwebo ikakhulukazi ngoba wayezitshela ukuthi uzonikwa iminyaka eyisishiyagalombili kuya kweyishumi, ngokusho kwesisebenzi sasenkantolo athe sasibasayinisa iphepha elithize. USduduzo ugwetshwa nje, wabanjwa ngoDisemba 2025 eNorth West, emva kokubalekela ingalo yomthetho ngaboJuni 2024, kulandela ukudedelwa kwakhe ngebheyili. Isolezwe labhala udaba ngokuthi amaphoyisa ayamfuna, udaba lwafundwa yiphoyisa laseNorth West elalingumakhelwane wakhe, lathinta umphenyi waseCato Manor, lasho ukuthi: "Nangu la endaweni yokucima ukoma, uphuza utshwala, ubuka nebhola,” kwaba wukubanjwa kwakhe.
Kudutshulwe kwabulawa abasolwa ababili abebefunelwa amacala okubulala.La madoda amataniswa emacaleni amabili okubulala ahlukene enzeke ekuqaleni kwalo nyaka.Kuthiwa amaphoyisa alandele umkhondo wabasolwa emzini oseMhlasini, okuthe uma efika kwaduma izulu lezandla. Kutholakale izibhamu ezimbili endaweni yesigameko.
KUKHALA isicathulo sabokufika engxenyeni yedolobha eMgungundlovu, abantu asebeyiqambe ngokuthi kuseSomalia njengoba u-80% wamabhizinisi akule ngxenye yenhlokodolobha yaKwaZulu-Natal, uphethwe abantu bokufika.Ingxenye okugcwele kuyo abantu bokufika isengxenyeni esenhla nedolobha uMgungundlovu, emgwaqweni uPietertmaritz, phakathi kukaPine Street noWest Street. Lokhu kuvezwe yiPhini leMeya, uMnuz Mxolisi Mkhize, ngesikhathi kubhungwa ngokungcola kwedolobha.UMkhize uveze ukuthi u-80% wabantu abahlala kule ngxenye yedolobha bangabokufika."Kunzima ukwamukela lokho. Angisho ukuthi kukhona okubi ngalokho kodwa ngithi angikucacise khona sonke sizokwazi ukuthi kwenzakalani." UMkhize uthe iningi lamabhizinisi asezindaweni ezingagunyaziwe ukuba zibe amabhizinisi."Ufica abantu bokufika beqhuba amabhizinisi ezindaweni okugunyazwe ukuthi kube ezokuhlala abantu, azigunyaziwe ukuthi kuqhutshwe amabhizinisi kuzo."UMkhize uthe isimo esenzeka kule ngxenye yedolobha senza ukuthi abantu bacasukele izikhulu zomkhandlu."Abantu bakholelwa ukuthi asinendaba, siyekela abantu bokufika bezenzele umathanda." Owenze ucwaningo ngokungcola kwedolobha eMgungundlovu, uNksz Nokwethemba Khumalo, uthe abantu akhulume nabo ngesikhathi enza ucwaningo, babona sengathi umasipala uyadembesela ekuxosheni abokufika."Abantu bazwakalisa ukungenami ngabantu bangaphandle abakuleli ngokungemthetho, baphakamisa ukuthi bafuna ukuthi bakhishwe. Abantu babheke kakhulu umasipala ukuthi kube iwona osukumela udaba. Ngeshwa abantu abaqondi ukuthi lona wumsebenzi wezinhlaka ezahlukene okubalwa kuzo noMnyango wezaseKhaya."UNksz Khumalo uthe abanikazi bamabhilidi okuhlala kuwo abokufika abatholakali. Abebeyingxenye yengxoxo bathe ukungcola kwedolobha kuxosha osomabhizinisi neminyango kahulumeni. Bathe eminye iminyango kahulumeni igcine isiphoqeleka ukuthi ibe namahhovisi eThekwini ngenxa yokungabi khona kwengqalasizinda eMgungundlovu.Bakhale ngokuthi kubukeka sengathi umasipala awunalo iqhinga lokulungisa inkinga yokungcola kwedolobha.
NAKUBA kwehlile kancane ukudla ngenyanga eyedlule, kodwa abantu abaningi bayaqhubeka nokubhuqwabhuqwa yindlala. Izibalo zangoMashi, zikhombisa ukuthi ukudla okwanelisa umndeni kwehle ngo-R55.Inhlangano eyenza ucwaningo ngamanani okudla, i-Pietermaritzburg Economic Justice and Dignity Group (PMBEJD), ithe ukwehla kancane kokudla ngeke kwethule umthwalo ebantwini abadonsa kanzima."Ukwehla kancane kokudla ngeke kwenze mehluko. Iqiniso ukuthi izigidi zabantu azinayo imali eyanele yokuthenga ukudla okunempilo." Izibalo zikhombisa ukuthi ukudla komndeni okwejwayelekile kubiza u-R5 328. Le mali icishe ilingane nemali okucatshangelwa ukuthi itholwa umuntu ohola imali ebekwe uhulumeni ukuthi kungabi khona sisebenzi ohola ngaphansi kwayo."Le mali ayanele ukuthenga ukudla futhi kufanele yondle umndeni wonke. Kuphinde kube khona izindleko zokugibela kanye nemali kagesi."Ucwaningo belubheke amanani ezinhlobo zokudla ezingu-44. Amanani ezinhlobo zokudla ezingu-14 anyukile, angu-29, kwangaba khona ushintsho enani lenhlobo yokudla eyodwa. Phakathi kwanani anyukile kubalwa akatamatisi, aweklabishi, awesitambu nawezinkambi zetiye. Amanani okudla okuwumgogodla, impuphu, ilayisi no-flour, onke ehlile. Amakloza nawo azothola ukuphefumula kancane njengoba ehlile amanani enyama ebomvu kanye namawotwane.Lezi zibalo ziphuma nje, inhlangano iStatistics SA, isanda kuveza ukuthi indlala idla lubi lapha KwaZulu-Natal. Umbiko owethulwe nguMnuz Bongani Hadebe ngeledlule, uveza ukuthi umuntu oyedwa kwababili esifundazweni ubulawa yindlala.Ecaphuna ucwaningo olwenziwa ngo-2023, uRadebe uthe iKwaZulu-Natal iyona ehamba phambili ezibalweni zabantu abahlwempu njengoba u-49% wabantu bakulesi sifundazwe uxakekile.ENingizimu Afrika bangu-23.2 million abantu ababhuqwabhuqwa yindlala.
Kudutshulwe kwabulawa abalisa abane abasolwa ngokuba yizigebengu kwathi ababili baboshwa kulandela isigameko sokudubulana namaphoyisa eSoweto, eGoli ngoLwesithathu.Okhulumela oKlebe eGauteng, uColonel Katlego Mogale, uthe isigameko senzeke ngemuva kokuthi uphiko lwezobunhloli eModus Operandi Centre luveze ukuthi kunequlu elalihlela ukugebenga kuhlonyiwe ibhizinisi esiteshini iKwezi, eMofolo. UMogale uthe ithimba lezinhlaka eziningi ezihlanganisa amalungu oKlebe iTactical Operation Management Section, Badboyz Security, kanye neGauteng Highway Patrol balandele lo mbiko bahlonza nezimoto okuthiwa zihamba abasolwa eduze kwezakhiwo ababeqondiswe kuzo."Ithimba lilandele izimoto ebezichaziwe eduze kwalapho bekuzobanjwa khona inkunzi. Ngokubona kwamaphoyisa, abasolwa bahlukana phakathi ngesikhathi bebaleka ngezimoto zabo ezimbili amaphoyisa abajaha."Ngesikhathi kujahwa abasolwa, kube nokudubulana, kwalimala abasolwa abane, kwaboshwa ababili,” kusho uMogale.Abasolwa ababoshiwe kulindeleke ukuthi babhekane namacala okubalwa awokugebenga ibhizinisi, ukuzama ukubulala, nokutholakala nezibhamu ezingekho emthethweni. UMogale wengeze ngokuthi kuthungathwa umsolwa wesikhombisa obaleke ngezinyawo ngesikhathi bejahwa.[email protected]
AJABULE abuya nganeno amaqembu ezepolitiki nezinyunyana zabasebenzi ngokwehliswa kwentela kaphethroli ngo-R3, ngenxa yezinsolo zokuthi kungenzeka ukuthi uhulumeni ufihle induku emqubeni.Amaqembu ezepolitiki nezinyunyana bakushayele ihlombe ukwehliswa kwentela kodwa bathi akubaniki ukuthula ngoba uhulumeni awuzange uchaze ukuthi izokhokhwa ubani le mali ezolahlekela uhulumeni ngenxa yokwehliswa kwentela kaphethroli.Ukwehliswa kwentela kaphethroli kuthule abanikazi bezimoto umthwalo njengoba unganyukanga ngale ndlela obekulindeleke ukuthi unyuke ngayo. Isimemezelo sokwehliswa kwentela kaphethroli senziwe uNgqongqoshe wezeZimali, uMnuz Enoch Godongwana, ngokubambisana noNgqongqoshe wezokuMbiwayo kanye nePetroleum, uMnuz Gwede Mantashe.Intela kaphethroli izokwehliswa inyanga eyodwa kanti yehliswe ngenxa yokunyuka kakhulu kukaphethroli. Impi eqhubeka e-Iran iyona eyenze ukuthi uphethroli unyuke kakhulu namhlanje.Ukube akwehliswanga intela, izibalo bezikhombisa ukuthi uphethroli uzonyuka ngo-R6. Esitatimendeni, uGodongwana noMantashe bathe kwehliswe intela ngenhloso yokugwema ukunyuka kokudla nezindleko zokuthutha. Bathe ukwehliswa kwentela kuzokwenza ukuthi uhulumeni ulahlekelwe u-R6 billion."Uhulumeni uzoqhamuka nezindlela zokubuyisa le mali ezolahleka."UMantashe umemezele ukuthi uphethroli u-93 no-95 bazonyuka ngo-R3.06. Udizili uzonyuka ngo-R7.37 bese kuthi u-pharafini wona unyuke ngo-R11.67. UMantashe uqinisekise abantu ukuthi uphethroli awushodi kuleli. "Inkinga yokushoda kukaphethroli ezingxenyeni ezithile zezwe ebikwayo, idalwa nje izinkinga zokuthuthwa kukaphethroli kanye nabantu abawuthenga kakhulu ngoba nakhu besaba ukuthi uzophela."Unobhala jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, uthe ukwehliswa kwentela kaphethroli kuzogwema ukunyuka kokudla."Wenza kanjena ke uhulumeni onakekelayo kanye nosukumela izinkinga ezibhekene nabantu. Siyakwamukela ukusukuma ngokushesha kukahulumeni." Okhulumela i-DA kwezeZimali, uDkt Mark Burke, uthe bayakujabulela impela ukwehliswa kwentela kaphethroli kodwa wathi bafuna ukwazi ukuthi uhulumeni uzoyibuyisa kanjani imali ezomlahlekela."Kwayona nje lemali okunyuke ngayo uphethroli nodizili inkulu, abantu bazothwala kanzima. Sesimagange ukuzwa ukuthi uhulumeni uzoyibuyisa kanjani le mali. Akufanele ekugcineni kube abakhokhi bentela okubhekwe ukuthi kube yibo abakhokha le mali."Inyunyana iFEDUSA, ithe inethemba lokuthi uhulumeni awubekile unoxhaka ngokwehlisa intela."Akufanele kube ukuthi njengoba abasebenzi behliselwa umthwalo namhlanje, bese kuba ukuthi ngomuso kuzokuba nendlela yokuthi abasebenzi kube yibo abazokhokha le mali ezolahlekela uhulumeni."
ISICHITHE nezindleko iNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini, izolo, isicelo sikasomabhizini osematheni, uMnuz Calvin Mathibeli, sokudlulisela phambili icala. Ngokusho kokhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uMathibeli ubefake isicelo sokuphikisa isinqumo esakhishwa yinkantolo ngoFebhuwari 26 nonyaka.Ngalelo langa, inkantolo yayimyalele ukuthi asuse zonke izinkulumo zakhe ayeziphanyeke ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, ezazidicilela phansi igama likaKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi. "Inkantolo yayimnike amahora angu-24 ukuba enze lokho. Yayithe kufanele azikhiphe nakuma-website kanjalo nabakwezindaba ezi-online,” kusho uNetshiunda. Wabe eseyalelwa nokuthi angaphinde asole uMkhwanazi ngezinsolo ezingamampunge, wase eyalelwa ukuthi akhokhele zonke izindleko zabameli.UNetshiunda uthe izinsolo ezehlisa isithunzi ezenziwe uMathibeli, bezingasingcolisa isithunzi sikaMkhwanazi kanjalo nombutho wamaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal. Uthe uMkhwanazi uyasamukela isinqumo sakamumva senkantolo, wathi siyisifundo esibalulekile kulabo abavele badicilele phansi isithunzi sabantu ngaphandle kobufakazi. "Lokhu kunqoba okwezakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika eziwugcinayo umthetho, ezingayingeni eyobugebengu futhi eziphupha ngezwe elingenabugebengu. Nanoma ubani angasolwa kodwa ukwehlisa umuntu isithunzi akufanele kube yingxenye yempikiswano,” kusho yena.Uthe umthetho owawo wonke umuntu ngoba uyilungelo lawonke wonke, elikuMthethosisekelo okufanele lihlonishwe ngaso sonke isikhathi.
BAKHALA ubumayemaye abanikazi bamatekisi angaphansi kwenhlangano ethathwa njengenkulu kunazo zonke kuleli, iSouth African National Taxi Council (SANTACO) ngokunyuka kukaphethroli.Izinkomba zabeCentral Energy Fund (CEF), ziveza ukuthi uphethroli i-95 octane, ungahle unyuke ngo-R5,82 ilitha, kuthi i-93 octane inyuke ngo-R5,32. Zithi udizili wona ungahle unyuke ngo-R10,27 ilitha. Kuvela ukuthi lezi zibalo azikakayifaki intela ekhokhelwa uphethroli, i-fuel levy yona okuthiwa ingahle inyuke ngo-21c ilitha. USihlalo weSantaco KwaZulu-Natal uMnuz Boy Zondi, uthe abanikazi bezimoto bakhala ubumayemaye ngoba ayikaze yenzeke into efuze le emlandweni wokunyuka kukaphethroli eNingizimu Afrika."Siyaqala ukubhekana nento enje emlandweni. Ukunyuka kwawo ngale ndlela kuzokwenza ukuthi kube nzima kakhulu kubanikazi bezimoto kanjalo nakobasi bethu abangabagibeli,” kusho uZondi. Uthe akungatshazwa ukuthi kuzoba nzima kakhulu ukusebenza njengoba kwaziwa ukuthi kubhekwe kwimpelasonto yePhasika, lapho iningi labantu lisebenzisa izithuthi zomphakathi ukuthutheleka emakhaya kanjalo nasezinkonzweni. "SiyiSantaco ezingeni lesifundazwe, asikaphumi nesinqumo sokuthi imali yokugibela inyuswe masinyane njengoba kuzoba yimpelasonto yePhasika ukuzama ukubhekana nesimo. Ngakho ngokwethu ayizunyuka njengamanje imali yokugibela kodwa ngifuna ukukucacisa ukuthi ngeke sikunqande ukuthi kube khona abanye ososeshini ezindaweni ezehlukene abazoyinyusa manje,” kusho uZondi, othe yibo ososeshini abazobe bezwa ukuthi insimbi ishisa kangakanani.Nokho ukuvezile ukuthi banqume ukuthi babe nomhlangano ophuthumayo ngodaba lukaphethroli ngesonto elizayo, athe emva kwawo, nakanjani bazoyiyusa imali yokugibela. "Nakanjani sizoyinyusa imali yokugibela ngelizayo. Ngeke silinde uJulayi njengoba sihlale senza,” usho kanje. Ebhekise kubelungu babo, okungabagibeli, uthe ucela bakuqonde ukuthi nabo bengosomabhizinisi bemboni, babhekene nesimo esingaphezu kwamandla. "Besingeke siyinyuse imali yokugibela ukube akwenzekanga le mikhuba eyenzekayo. Besizolinda umhla ka-1 Julayi njengenhlalayenza,” kusho uZondi. UMengameli wezwe, uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa ethula inkulumo yokuvala ingqungquthela ye-ANC eLimpopo ngempelasonto, uxwayise ngobunzima obuzayo ngenxa yokunyuka kukaphethroli nodizili. Uthe useyalele ongqongqoshe ukuthi babhekane nezingqinamba ezizodalwa ukwenyuka kukaphethroli nodizili.Ukunyuka kakhulu kukaphethroli kudalwe yizinxushunxushu eziqhubekayo eMiddle East, eziholele ekutheni kunyuke intengo kawoyela, kwase kudala ingcindezi emandleni erandi lakuleli.Uwoyela ongahluziwe unyuke usuka ku-$69 waya ngaphezuku kuka-$115, kanti amandla erandi lehle esuka kuR15,85 aya kuR17,00 uma liqhathaniswa neDollar laseMelika.
IKOMITI elijuba abaholi ezikhundleni kwiNFP lisabisa ngokumangalela umholi weqembu, uMnuz Ivan Barnes, elimsola ngokudla umzila walo. Amalungu ekomitini athumele incwadi yabameli lapho ekhalaze ngokuthi uBarnes usewaphuce umsebenzi wawo wokujuba abaholi ezikhundleni. Encwadini ebhalwe abameli, iKhathi & Mkhize Attorneys, amalungu anganelisekile athe sekukaningi uBarnes eqokela ezikhundleni abaholi beqembu engabonisananga naleli komiti. Amalungu ekomitini athe lokhu okwenziwa uBarnes kuphambene nemigomo yeqembu, abe esemyalela ukuba achaze ukuthi uzowalungisa kanjani amaphutha awenzile. Asabise ngokuthatha izinyathelo zomthetho uma uBarnes engawanikezi impendulo egculisayo kulo mnqamulajuqu wezinsuku ezingu-14 anikwe wona. Incwadi ibhalwe usihlalo wekomiti elijuba abaholi ezikhundleni, uMnuz Thubalethu Thwala, uMnuz Khayelihle Khumalo ongumgqugquzeli wesigungu esiphezulu kwiNFP KwaZulu-Natal, noMnuz Sinomusa Mthembu, oyilungu le qembu. Abanganelisekile bathe imigomo yeqembu okwavunyelwana ngayo engqungqutheleni yeqembu yokuqala eyayingo-2011, inikeza ikomiti elijuba abaholi ezikhundleni amandla okuthi kube ilona elibheka labo okufanele bajutshwe kulezi zikhundla. Amalungu athe sekukaningi uBarnes efaka abantu ezikhundleni engabonisananga nekomiti. "NgoNovemba 28, uBarnes waqoka uMnuz Khulekani Hlatshwayo ukuba abe yikhansela kuMasipala waseBig 5 Hlabisa. UHlatshwayo wayengowesithathu ohlwini lweNFP, kweqiwa uMnuz Norman Nxumalo owayengowesibili ohlwini. UBarnes uhlezi ezama ukuxosha uMnuz Siphumule Ntombela, oyikhansela kuMasipala waseKurhuleni." Abanganelisekile bakhala nangohlelo olulandelwa iqembu ekuqokeni unobhala jikelele nephini likanobhala jikelele. I-NFP ihlela ukuvala izikhala ezavuleka emva kokuxoshwa kukanobhala jikelele, uMnuz Teddy Thwala nephini likanobhala, uNksz Sithembile Msomi.Njengamanje kubambe uMnuz Sunset Xaba kwesikaNobhala Jikelele, kwesephini likanobhala khona kubambe, uNksz Duduzile Nhlengethwa. Abazongena ngokugcwele kulezi zikhundla, bazoqokwa emhlanganweni wekomiti elibhekelele ukusebenza kwansuku zonke kwiNFP. Abanganelisekile bathe lokhu kuphambene nemigomo yeqembu. Bathe abazongena ezikhundleni kufanele bakhethwe engqungqutheleni. "Lesi sinqumo sisho ukuthi iqembu liphuca amagatsha ilungelo lawo lokuqoka abazongena ezikhundleni." UXaba uvumile ukuthi bayitholile incwadi yabameli kodwa wathi angakwazi ukuphawula ngayo uma sebebhungile ngayo."Besingakahlangani ngoba kwalona lelo komiti alizimele. Mhlawumbe uma sesixoxile ngayo incwadi siyobe sesiphawula kwabezindaba."UXaba uphinde waveza ukuthi asikaphumi isinqumo sekomiti ebeliqondisa ubugwegwe uMphathiswa wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi, uNksz Mbali Shinga. UNksz Shinga wabizelwa phambi kwekomiti eliqondisa ubugwegwe emva kokuba eshaye indiva umyalelo weqembu wokuba aseke isiphakamiso seMKP, sokungabeseki ubuholi bukandunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli.
ISHAYELWE ihlombe nayizinhlaka ezilwa nobugebengu emphakathini eyokuvuselelwa kwenkontileka kaKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi.Amaphoyisa akuqinisekisile ukuthi uMkhwanazi usenikezwe inkontileka yeminye iminyaka emihlanu esesikhundleni. Inkontileka yakhe ibiphela kusasa kanti entsha kulindeleke ukuthi iqale ngoLwesithathu. Amaphoyisa athe ukunikezwa kwakhe eyesibili kuze emva kwezingxoxo phakathi nobuholi bamaphoyisa ezingeni likazwelonke noNdunandlulu wesifundazwe, uMnuz Thami Ntuli. Bese kunesikhathi uNtuli aphumela obala ngelithi ufisa abuye ihlandla lesibili uMkhwanazi kulesi sikhundla. UNtuli wathi lokhu ukusho ngoba ebona ukuthi umsebenzi wokulwa nobugebengu kwamaphoyisa kwenzeka ngendlela encomekayo noMkhwanazi esezintanjeni. Emva kwesimemezelo sokubuya kukaMkhwanazi isibili, uNtuli uzwakalise ukujabula, wamhalalisela.UMnuz Andile Jali weThekwini Neighbourhood Watch okuyinhlangano elwa nobugebengu eNanda, Ntuzuma, KwaMashu, ephinde ikapakele nakwezinye izingxenye zesifundazwe, ukushayele ihlombe ukubuya kukaMkhwanazi.UJali echaza uMkhwanazi, uthe uzibonakalise ebuholini bakhe ukuthi akalona iphoyisa ejoyina umbutho ngoba nakhu lizifunela umsebenzi wokuxosha ikati eziko. "Into yobuphoyisa uMkhwanazi uyayiphila, akazenzisi. Ngenxa yokungabi bikho kwamathuba omsebenzi, abanye bangena emaphoyiseni ngoba bezifunela nje umsebenzi ukuze babeke ukudla phezu kwetafula. Iningi labo sibabona bebanjwa benza ubugebengu, besebenzisana nezigebengu noma bethatha imali yokufumbathiswa. Yena ufike waba yiphoyisa elizimisele ukulwa nobugebengu,” kusho uJali.Umncome ngokungabi umkhuzi wamaphoyisa ongawavikeli uma enze okubi kodwa ovele aqinisekise ukuthi athola isijeziso esiwafanele."Ngikhumbula efika lapho okwakubulawe khona izigebengu, kukhona namaphoyisa, kunokuthi alokhu edabuka, wavele wathi ibambe ngakho,” usho kanje. Uthe ubelidinga ithuba lesibili ngoba isifundazwe usasibambe kahle. "Siye sibone ngisho nasezinkundleni zomphakathi, abezinye izifundazwe, bethi bacela ukubolekwa uMkhwanazi azoqondisa isimo ezifundazweni zabo, baphendule abaKwaZulu-Natal bathi ngeke bakwazi ukuvuma noMkhwanazi. Sidinga abaholi okukhulunywa kanje ke ngabo. Uma bengaba baningi, izwe lethu lingaba yindawo engcono kakhulu,” kusho uJali. Uphinde wakhumbula ukwesekwa, athi bakuthola kuye ngo-2023, beyizinhlangano ezilwa nobugebengu eThekwini, ngesikhathi beqothwa yizigebengu. "Salwa kakhulu nobugebengu ngo-2022, lwabonakala ushintsho ngoba izigebengu sasingazinike thuba. Zakhetha ukusinombola, zisiqothe ngo-2023, wasondela uMkhwanazi, kwase kuthi ukuba ngcono,” kusho uJali.Uphinde wamncoma nangokuthi ukhumbuze amaphoyisa ukuthi angamaphoyisa, wathi isimo sizoya ngokuya sibuyela kokwakudala lapho iphoyisa lalihlonishwa khona.UNobhala webhodi leCommunity Policing Forum (CPF) KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Siyanda Biyela, uhalalisele uMkhwanazi, wathi njengoba isiqinisekisiwe eyokubuya kwakhe ihlandla lesibili, umshikashika uzoqhubeka. "Sisezinhlelweni zokumkhombisa uhlelo lwethu lokugcina ezokuphepha njengoba kuyiwa ePhasikeni. Uma kudlula lapho kufanele kubhungwe ngeyokhetho oluphephile ngoNovemba, uma kudlula ukhetho sibheke amaholidi okuphela konyaka,” kusho uBiyela.Uthe uMkhwanazi umchoma uphaphe lwegwalagwala ngokuba umholi oqotho, wathi lokhu uye akubone uma kuvela izinsolo zokuthi kukhona amaphoyisa aphule umthetho.NeMeya yeTheku uMnuz Cyril Xaba, ithe ibambe ngakho ngokubuyiselwa esikhundleni kukaMkhwanazi, yathi ufike ngesikhathi esihle belungiselela izinhlelo zamaholidi ePhasika.Ne-ActionSA ikwamukele ukubuyela kukaMkhwanazi yathi uyisithenjwa sabantu empini yobugebengu.
Sekuqinisekisiwe ukuthi uphethiloli uzokhuphuka ngamalini kusukela ngoLwesithathu ngomhla ka-1 Ephreli 2026. UMnyango wezimbiwa udalule ukuthi uphethroli uzonyuka mawala naphezu kokuhoxiswa kwentela ka-R3 okwesikhashana.Kusukela phakathi kwamabili, abashayeli bazokhokha lokhu okulandelayo:Uphethiloli 93 (ULP & LRP): unyuke ngo-R 3.06 ilitha Uphethiloli 95 (ULP &LRP) unyuke ngo-R 3.06 ilitha Udizili (0.05% sulphur) unyuke ngoR7.37 ilithaUdizili (0.005% sulphur) unyuke ngoR7.51 ilitha I-Illuminating Paraffin inyuke ngoR11.67 ilithaI-SMNRP ye-IP: inyuke ngoR15.60 ilithaNgemuva kwezinguquko ezizokwenzeka ngoLwesithathu, Ephreli 1, ilitha likaphethiloli i-95 Unleaded lizobiza u-R22.53 ezindaweni ezisogwini kanye no-R23.36 ezifundeni ezimaphakathi nezwe, lapho i-93 Unleaded izobiza u-R23.25. Intengo kadizili engu-50ppm izokhuphuka ifinyelele ku-R25.35 ogwini kube ngu-R26.11 eGauteng.
BALINGANISELWA ku-100 abantu asebethathe isinqumo sokushiya "konke okomhlaba bakhe amadokodo" eDabangu, KwaMaphumulo lapho bethi baphilela khona umbuso wezulu.Lo mphakathi, oya ngokwanda inyanga nenyanga, uzibiza ngokuthi ungabafundi bakaJesu. Bakhe endaweni ethe qekelele abayiqamba ngokuthi Ikhaya Labafundi. Ngesikhathi Isolezwe Ngempelasonto lihambele kule ndawo laba bantu bebeqhubeka nemisebenzi yabo yosuku. Kule ndlela asebeyikhethile bathi sebehlukene nezinto eziningi okubalwa kuzo ukulaxaza imisebenzi, bayeka amabhizinisi abo, bayeka nemishanguzo ama-ARV, nezingane zabo zayekiswa isikole ngoba sebelandela uJesu. Abanye abasenawo amaselula, kube nabazigqaja ngokuthi abasazihlanganisi nocansi.Banendawo enkulu enamasimu lapho betshale khona izinhlobo ezihlukene zezithelo, kukhona nemfuyo. Kwabakutshalile kukhona ubhatata, amadumbe, amagwava nokunye okuningi. Indawo yabo ibiyelwe ngocingo yavalwa ngesango, akulula ukuthi uzingenele nje. Kunezakhiwo ezihlukene ngaphakathi okuyizindlu abahlala kuzo.Ovulele izintatheli ubethole umyalelo kuMfundisi omkhulu, uMfu Vusimuzi Sibiya, othe makalivule isango abantu babizwe nguyena. Uma ungena ngaphakathi ukhangwa yibona "Abafundi bakaJesu" bephithizela benza imisebenzi ehlukene okubandakanya ukulima, ukugeza izintsha, ukuwasha izingubo, ukushanela igceke nokunye okuningi.Bonke uma bebingelela ngisho nengane encane bathi "Makabongwe uJesu, uyabusa uyiNkosi". Kulaba kukhona abantu beminyaka ehlukene, kusukela ezinganeni kuya kwabadala. Bonke bayazigqaja ngokuthi balaxaza okuthile ukuze balandele uJesu yena yedwa.UMfu Sibiya, ongumsunguli wale ndawo ulande kabanzi ngayo wathi naye wayeka impilo ayeyiphila wakhetha le ndlela entsha.Uveze ukuthi wayengusomabhizinisi kodwa wawavala amabhizinisi akhe wancamela ukulandela le mpilo entsha. Echaza uthe inhlosongqangi yakho konke lokhu ukufuna ukuthula emoyeni nasenhliziyweni.''Lapha sinabantu abehlukene abahlukana nezinto eziningi bakhetha ukulandela uJesu. Lapha sikhuluma ngosomabhizinisi ababephumelele empilweni kodwa bengenakho nhlobo ukuthula. Manje njengoba sebelapha banokuthula kwangunaphakade ngoba banoJesu phaqa,'' usho kanje.Uveze ukuthi abantu abathutheleka kule ndawo bavela ezingxenyeni ezehlukene zezwe. Abaningi uthe basuke behlatshwe yivangeli lokufuna ukuthula alishumayelayo nasezinkundleni zokuxhumana.''Isizwe lesi soMbuso kaNkulunkulu futhi esiphethwe ezulwini. Makwaziwe ukuthi kunabantu abangcwele abadele konke. Badele imisebenzi emihle besebenza kahle, bashiya imindeni yabo, kukhona nabashiye amaphilisi okuthithibalisa ingculazi, abanye baphume sebesemanyuvesi," usho kanje ekhuluma ebakhomba bananela ngehlombe elikhulu Abafundi bakaJesu.Uthe akekho obabizile laba bantu kodwa baqoqwe nguNkulunkulu uqobo. Uthe uNkulunkulu uyazakhela isizwe sakhe esinokuthula nobungcwele.Ngesikhathi esakhuluma nezintatheli endlini, kungene indodakazi yakhe ebilethe ukudla, wathi: ''Naye lona ngamkhipha esikoleni ku-Grade 11. Wayezitshela ukuthi uzofunda aze abe udokotela, kodwa ayenzekanga leyo nto,'' kusho yena.Isolezwe Ngempelasonto libe selikhuluma nabanye baBafundi bakaJesu abebebukeka bengenankinga ngempilo yabo entsha. UNksz Thandazile Mwelase othe usuka eMawoti, eNanda, uveze ukuthi uyazigqaja ngokuyeka ukudla amaphilisi okuthithibalisa igciwane lengculazi ama-ARV."Ama-ARV ngangiwasebenzisa kusukela ngo-2022 ngaze ngawayeka ngo-2024 ngikholwa wukuthi uJesu uyaphilisa. Izwi likaNkulunkulu nalo liyasho ukuthi ngemivimbo yaKhe saphiliswa. Uma ungumKristu kumele wazi ukuthi uphilisiwe. Ngidele konke, ngishiye umuzi wami kuhleli ingane yami kuwona. Kwayona ingane yami ngiyidelile. UJesu uthi ongithandayo makathabathe isiphambano sami, azidele, angilandele,'' usho kanjena.Uveze ukuthi sekuphele iminyaka eyisikhombisa engayi nhlobo ocansini ngoba usekholwa wukuthi ukuya ocansini ungashadile kuyisono. Udalule nokuthi ngisho umakhalekhukhwini akasenawo ngoba kwawona uwudelile. Nemali uthi akanandaba nayo.UNksz Sibongile Mkhwanazi othe udabuka esifundazweni iMpumalanga uthe naye ubephuza amaphilisi okuthithibalisa igciwane lengculazi.''Ngidele konke, bengiwaphuza ama-ARV kusukela ngo-2008 ngaze ngawayeka ngo-2024 ngemuva kokuba ngizwe iZwi likaNkulunkulu elithi ngiphilisiwe ngemivimbo yaKhe. Uthe akaninkinga nje uphila njengabantu bonke.UMnuz Ntokozo Mkhize waseMlaza uthe bese ethathiwe eNyuvesi yaseCape Town eyokwenza iComputer Engineering kodwa wakhetha ukuzophila eKhaya Labafundi.Lesi uthe yisinqumo esinobuhlakani kunazo zonke ake azithatha empilweni yakhe sokusabela uma ebizwa nguNkulunkulu.''Kuthe sengithathiwe sengithole nendawo yokuhlala, ngenhlanhla uNkulunkulu wangimbulela ukuthi kumele ngishiye konke ngilandele yena yedwa. Ekhaya bayazi, ngabachazela bakuqonda engikushoyo. Njengoba ngilapha ngizofunda ngoJesu yena yedwa,'' kuchaza yena.Uthe akasenayo nentombi ngoba akasiboni isidingo sayo empilweni yakhe nokuthi izomsiza ngani.Kune-video Isolezwe Ngempelasonto elinayo eveza abafundi asebehlala kule ndawo beshisa izitifiketi zabo zemfundo ngoba bethi ngeke zisabasebenzela abasazidingi.Enye ingane eneminyaka engu-15 ebihleli nonina ithe: ''Ngisiyekile isikole ngenxa yokuthi esikoleni abafundisi into eyayifundiswa uJesu kanti mina ngifuna ukwenza intando kaNkulunkulu.''
SITHOLE ukwesekwa isiphakamiso sikaNgqongqoshe weMfundo eyisiSekelo, uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, sokuthi kuphenywe impilo ephilwa yizikhulu nezisebenzi zoMnyango. UNksz Gwarube umeme uphiko oluphenya amacala enkohlakalo, i-Special Investigating Unit (SIU), ukuthi lwenze lolu phenyo eMnyangweni wakhe.Ukusho lokhu emva kokuba esolwe ngokuthi ufake unyawo lwedada wangenelela ohlelweni lokuqashwa kozokhulumela lo Mnyango kuzwelonke, kulandela ukuhamba kowayewukhulumela, uMnuz Elijah Mhlanga. Kuthiwa uNksz Gwarube kunomuntu ayemfuna angene esikhundleni, okuyinto ayichithayo.USihlalo wekomiti loMnyango weziSebenzi zikaHulumeni nokuPhatha ePhalamende, uMnuz Mr Jan de Villiers, uthe uyaweseka umbono kaNksz Gwarube, wokuthi kuphenywe impilo yezisebenzi boMnyango. Uthe kumele kuhlakazwe isidleke senkohlakalo eMnyangweni, wathi kumele iSIU ilwenze lolu phenyo."Sifuna uphenyo lugxile kwizisebenzi ezisezinhlakeni ezibalulekile. Yilapho okudlange khona inkohlakalo." Uthe bafuna kuphenywe nangokuqashwa kwezisebenzi eMnyangweni ngokufakwa kobhululu."Izinsiza zikahulumeni kumele ziye kubafundi, nakulabo abazidingayo, hhayi emaphaketheni abathile. Abafundi yibona abathwala kanzima uma bengazitholi izimfanelo zabo." Uthe bazimisele ukusebenzisana neSIU ekuphenyeni impilo ephilwa abasebenzi eMnyangweni."Sifuna uma sebebanjiwe abenza inkohlakalo, bavezwe obala. Sifuna bathathelwe nezinyathelo zokuqondiswa ubugwegwe. Sifuna baboshwe futhi labo abenza le nkohlakalo." Uthe bayayeseka yonke imizamo yokuqinisa ukusebenza kukahulumeni ngokulwa nenkohlakalo ukuze kuzuze abantu bakuleli. Inyunyana yothisha, iSadtu, ixwayise uNksz Gwarube ukuthi angasabisi izisebenzi ngokuthi ufuna iSIU iphenye impilo eziyiphilayo ekubeni zisebenza, zihola. Ixwayise ngokuthi ayeke ukufaka unyawo lwedada ohlelweni lokuqashwa kwezisebenzi nezikhulu eMnyangweni ngoba kunemithetho elandelwayo.
