UKUNYUKA mawala kukaphethroli kwenze inyunyana yabasebenzi bakahulumeni, iPublic Servants Union (PSA), yahlaba ikhwelo lokuthi kubuyiswe uhlelo oluvumela abasebenzi ukuthi basebenzele emakhaya ngenxa yokwesabela ukuthi imiholo yabasebenzi izophelela ezindlekweni zokugibela.I-PSA ithe kuyimanje abasebenzi basebenzisa u-40% wemiholo yabo ukugibela, yaxwayisa ngokuthi ukunyuka kukaphethroli kusasa, kungenza ukuthi abasebenzi bagcine sebesebenzisa imali engaphezu kuka-50% wemiholo ezindlekweni zokugibela. I-PSA ithe kulindeleke ukuthi imali yokugibela inyuke kula masonto ezayo ngenxa yokunyuka kukaphethroli."Baningi abantu abagibela amatekisi. Siyazi ukuthi abamatekisi bazophoqeleka ukuthi banyuse imali yokugibela. Kuzonyuka ukudla ngenxa yokunyuka kukadizili. Abantu bazothi besamangazwe ukunyuka kwemali yokugibela nokudla, baphinde futhi babhekane nokunyuka kukagesi. Abantu ngeke bakwazi ukumelana nokunyuka kukaphethroli, ukudla nogesi ngesikhathi esisodwa. Sinxusa uhulumeni ukuthi wehlise intela kaphethroli uphinde futhi unikeze abamatekisi isibonelelo sesikhashana. Uma abamatekisi benganikwa isibonelelo bazonyusa imali yokugibela." I-PSA inxuse iminyango kahulumeni nezinkampani ukuba zivumele abasebenzi abangakwazi ukusebenzela emakhaya ukuba basebenzele emakhaya njengoba kwakwenzeka ngesikhathi kuhlasele ubhubhane iCorona."Ukuvumela abantu ukuthi basebenzele emakhaya kunganciphisa isiminyaminya emigwaqweni nokungenza ukuthi abantu bonge uphethroli."Ngeledlule, uMnyango wezokuMbiwayo ukuchithile ukuthi wenze isiphakamiso sokuthi abasebenzi bavunyelwe ukusebenzela emakhaya. Ubuphendula emva kokuba esinye sezikhulu zoMnyango, uMnuz Robert Maake, sicashunwe ngabezindaba sithi ukusebenzela emakhaya kungathula abasebenzi umthwalo. Okhulumela uMnyango, uNksz Lerato Ntsoko, uthe isikhulu uMaake wayengenzi isiphakamiso kodwa wayephendula umbuzo womuntu owayebuze ukuthi kungabalekelela yini abasebenzi ukuthi bavunyelwe ukusebenzela emakhaya?"Akulungile ukuthi impendulo yakhe bese ithathwa njengombono woMnyango. Wayengenzi isiphakamiso futhi wayengakhiphi umyalelo kodwa wayephendula nje into eyayixoxwa."UNksz Ntsoko uthe ziyaqhubeka izingxoxo zokubuka ukuthi kungenziwa kanjani ukuthi ukunyuka kukaphethroli kungazweli kakhulu ebantwini.
UMENGAMELI Cyril Ramaphosa useveze ukuthi akasabuthi quthu ubuthongo ngenxa yezindaba zokuthi uphethroli uzonyuka kakhulu ngoLwesithathu.URamaphosa uthe ukunyuka mawala kukaphethroli kuzoshaya kuzwele kwabahlwempu ngenxa yokuthi kuzonyusa izindleko zempilo. Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma emcimbini wokuvala ingqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi be-ANC eLimpopo.Uphethroli kulindeleke ukuthi unyuke ngo-R5 ngoLwesithathu, udizili wona kulindeleke ukuthi unyuke ngo-R9 ilitha. Ukunyuka kukaphethroli kungenxa yempi eqhubeka e-Iran. URamaphosa uthe useyalele uNgqongqoshe wezeziMali, uMnuz Enoch Godongwana, ukuba aqhamuke nezindlela zokusiza abantu njengoba kuzonyuka uphethroli. "UGondongwana ungitshele ukuthi akasabuthi quthu ubuthongo. Ngimtshele ukuthi nami angisalali ngenxa yale nkinga. Ngimtshele ukuthi yena nozakwabo kufanele baqhamuke namaqhinga okuthi ukunyuka kukaphethroli kungazweli kakhulu ebantwini ngoba kuzonyusa izindleko zempilo."Ugxeke iMelika nelaKwa-Israel ngokuhlasela i-Iran."Thina asikholelwa empini futhi asikholelwa ukuthi amazwe ayizikhondlakhondla anelungelo lokucindezela amazwe amancane. Le mpi iphazamisa impilo yabantu abaningi." URamaphosa uhlukanise inhloko nesixhanti kumalungu e-ANC aphinde abe ngamalungu e-SACP. Uthe wonke amalungu kufanele akhankasele i-ANC, wathi azozithola esobishini lawo azokhankasela i-SACP."Isigungu esiphezulu sizothatha isinqumo sokuthi kuzokwenzakalani kulabo abangayikhankaseli i-ANC. Ngesikhathi ngivala ingqungquthela ye-ANC ngonyaka owedlule, ngathi wonke amalungu e-ANC kufanele akhankasele i-ANC. Uma sikubona ungakhankaseli i-ANC, ukhankasela elinye iqembu, uzozifaka enkingeni."Ngakolunye uhlangothi, uNobhala Jikelele we-SACP, uMnuz Solly Mapaila, unxuse abaholi be-ANC ukuba bahloniphe isinqumo samaKhomanisi sokungenela ukhetho ngokuzimela. UMapalia uthe akukho okuzobavimba ukuthi bangenele ukhetho ngokuzimela. Khonamanjalo: I-ANC ibimatasa kule mpalasonto njengoba ibihlele izingqungquthela zokukhetha ubuholi ezifundazweni iLimpopo, Mpumalanga ne-Eastern Cape. ELimpopo naseMpumalanga akuzange kube khona simanga njengoba oNdunankulu, uDkt Phophi Ramathuba, noMnuz Mandla Ndlovu, beqokwe ngo-elethu ukuba bahole i-ANC kulezi zifundazwe.Eyokukhetha ubuholi be-ANC e-Eastern Cape, yona ibhuntshile emuva kwesivimbelo senkantolo. Inkantolo inqume ukuthi ingaqhubeki ingqungquthela ngenxa yokuthi akuzange kulandelwe imigomo ngesikhathi ihlelwa.Umbango wokuhola i-ANC e-Eastern Cape uphakathi kukaNdunankulu, uMnuz Oscar Mabuyane, noNobhala, uMnuz Lulama Ngcukayitobi. NgoMgqibelo, uRamaphosa ubehambele KwaZulu-Natal, lapho ethule khona inkulumo esidlweni sakusihlwa.
IZINDABA zokuthunyelelwa amasamanisi kukaKhomishana kazwelonke wamaPhoyisa, uLieutenant General Fannie Masemola, ziqubule enkulu imvunge njengoba nozakwabo ababephambi kwakhe kulesi sikhundla baphuma sebehlehla nyovane, kungakafiki isikhathi sokuphela kwezinkontileka zabo. Kokhomishana abaphume singakapheli isikhathi sabo, kubalwa oke waba ngungqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa, uMnuz Bheki Cele, yiloyo owalahlwa amacala enkohlakalo, uMnuz Jackie Selebi, uNkk Riah Phiyega noGeneral Khehla Sitole. Bonke labo khomishana abazange bahambe kahle.Kubukeka sengathi noKhomishana wamaPhoyisa okhona, uMasemola, naye uzolandela ezinyathelweni zosigaxamabhande abebephambi kwakhe.UMasemola uzithola esoboshini njengoba esanda kuthola amasamanisi ambizela enkantolo mayelana necala elithinta ithenda ka-R360 million eyanikwa inkampani kasomabhizinisi obhekene noxhaxha lwamacala, uMnuz Vusumuzi "Cat" Matlala. UMasemola unukeka ngokwehluleka ukulandela imigomo eyengamele ukusetshenziswa kwemali yomphakathi. Ithenda yabuye yahoxiswa emva kwezinsolo zokungalandelwa kwemigomo ngesikhathi ikhishwa.UMasemola umangalelwe kanye namanye amaphoyisa angu-12 avele enkantolo kanye nezikhulu zenkampani kaMatlala ngoLwesithathu. Bangu-16 sebebonke abebevele enkantolo okubalwa kubo noMatlala.Zivele sezikhona izinkomba zokuthi uMasemola angase amiswe emsebenzini bese ebhekana nophenyo. Okhulumela iHhovisi likaMengameli, uMnuz Vincent Magwenya, uthe kuzokuba nzima ukuthi uMasemola aqhubeke esikhundleni ekubeni ehamba izinkantolo."Asikwazi ukuba nokhomishana wamaphoyisa ohamba icala. Kufanele silinde sibone ukuthi icala lihamba kanjani ezinkantolo. Ziningi izinto uMengameli okuzofanele ukuthi azibheke ngaphambi kokuthi athathe isinqumo."UMagwenya uthe uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, uthe usayifakela izibuko indaba yokuthweswa amacala kukaMasemola. Uphinde wathi uRamaphosa uzobhekana nalolu daba ngokulandela umthetho. "Ngokubambisana noNgqongqoshe wezamaPhoyisa (Cachalia), uRamaphosa uzoqinisekisa ukuthi akuphazamiseki ukusebenza kwamaphoyisa."UNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa obambile, uSolwazi Firoz Cachalia, uthe uRamaphosa umcele ukuba alethe umbiko ngalolu daba. "Ngibonane noMengameli emva komhlangano weKhabhinethi. Ungicele ukuba ngimnike umbiko wami namhlanje (izolo)."UCachalia akazange akuchithe ukuthi kungenzeka uMasemola amiswe emsebenzini. "Ekugcineni kuzofanele kuthathwe isinqumo esinzima, naye uMasemola kuzofanele anikezwe ithuba lokuthi aziphendulele."UCachalia uthe uma egcina emisiwe uMasemola kuzoqokwa umuntu ozobamba esikhundleni. Iqembu lezepolitiki elingelesibili ngobukhulu kuleli, i-DA, livele selihlabe ikhwelo lokuthi uMasemola amiswe emsebenzini. Okhulumela i-DA kwezamaphoyisa, uNksz Lisa Schickerling, uthe uMasemola akamiswe naye njengoba amisa iPhini likaKhomishana wamaPhoyisa elisolwa enkohlakalweni, uLieutenant General Shadrack Sibiya. "Le nto izokwenza ukuthi abantu bengabe besawathemba amaphoyisa."USihlalo wekomiti lasePhalamende elibhekelele ukusebenza kwamaPhoyisa, uMnuz Ian Cameron, uthe bafuna uMasemola ezochaza phambi kwekomiti ngokuthweswa kwakhe amacala. UMasemola waqokelwa kulesi sikhundla ngo-2022. Uma egcina emiswa kuzoqokwa ozobamba esikhundleni. Akwaziwa noma uRamaphosa uzobheka kwabangamaPhini kakhomishana wamaphoyisa noma uzobheka kwenye indawo uma kwenzeka eqoka ozobamba.AmaPhini kaKhomishana akhona; ngoLieutenant General Leneo Nkhuoa, Lieutenant General Hilda Senthumule noLieutenant General Tebello Mosikili. Umlando wokhomishana bamaphoyisa abedlule eNingizimu Afrika- UJackie Selebi waba ukhomishana wamaphoyisa omnyama wokuqala. Waqokelwa esikhundleni ngo-2000, wamiswa ngo-2008. USelebi walahlwa yicala lenkohlakalo ngo-2010, waboshelwa ukwamukela intshontsho kumuntu owayeshushumbisa izidakamizwa.- UBheki Cele waqokelwa esikhundleni ngo-2009, wamiswa ngo-2011, kulandela izinsolo zenkohlakalo ekuqashweni kwebhilidi elalizosetshenziswa amaphoyisa. UCele wadilizwa esikhundleni ngo-2012, emva kophenyo. UCele wayekade efike ngomfutho kulesi sikhundla, empeleni wayezakhele idumela ngesikhathi esenguMphathiswa wezokuPhepha koMphakathi KwaZulu-Natal. Emva kokudilizwa esikhundleni, uCele waqokelwa kwesePhini likangqongqoshe kuMnyango wezokuDoba naMahlathi. Waze wanyukelwa yizimendlela ngo-2018, lapho aqokelwa kwesikangqongqoshe wezamaPhoyisa.- Kwalandela uNkk Riah Phiyega. UNkk Phiyega waqokwa ngo-2012. Wamiswa emsebenzini ngo-2015, kulandela izincomo zeKhomishini eyayiphenya ngokubulawa kwabavukuzi emayini eMarikana, abadutshulwa amaphoyisa. Emva kokumiswa kukaNkk Phiyega, kwaqokwa uMnuz Khomotso Phahlane. UPhahlane wabamba kulesi sikhundla iminyaka emithathu, wabe esemiswa emva kwezinsolo zenkohlakalo. UPhahlane waxoshwa emaphoyiseni ngo-2020 emva kophenyo.- Ngaphambi kukaMasemola, ukhomishana kwakunguGeneral Khehla Sitole. USitole waqokelwa esikhundleni ngo-2017, inkontileka yakhe yanqanyulwa emva kokulahlwa yicala. Walahlwa yicala lokuphazamisa uphenyo lophiko oluqaphe ukusebenza kwamaphoyisa, i-Ipid, olaliphenya izinsolo zokuthi amaphoyisa athenga umshini owawuzosetshenziswa yizinhloli ukulalela izingcingo engqungqutheleni ye-ANC yango-2017. Lo mshini wathengwa ngo-R45 million. Kuningi okunye ukukhuluma okwalandela uSitole ngesikhathi engukhomishana wamaphoyisa. Okwashayela isipikili sokugcina ekusaseni lakhe, ukuthi wayeyinkukhu nempaka noCele owayengungqongqoshe wezamaPhoyisa ngaleso sikhathi, nokungabonakali kwakhe ngesikhathi kunezibhelu zokuzitapela KwaZulu-Natal naseGauteng ngo-2021.
SESIQUBULE imibuzo isenzo somnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal sokunikeza amakhosi izimoto zikanokusho.I-DA isibhalele uMphathiswa walo mnyango, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, ifuna ukwazi kabanzi ngalezi zimoto ezingu-30, ezimenyezelwe ngesikhathi kuvulwa indlu yobuholi bomdabu KwaZulu-Natal, ngeledlule. Okhulumela i-DA kwezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu esiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Marlaine Nair, uthe ukunikwa kwamakhosi izimoto kubashiye nemibuzo eminingi.UNkk Nair uthe abaphikisani nokuthi umnyango ulekelele amakhosi kodwa wathi bafuna nje ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umnyango ulandele yonke imigomo ngesikhathi uthenga izimoto. "Siyalihlonipha iqhaza elibalulekile elibanjwe amakhosi KwaZulu-Natal, futhi asiphikisani nokuthi kwesekwe amakhosi. Into nje eyenza ukuthi sibe nemibuzo ukuthi sifuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kulandelwe yonke imigomo." UNkk Nair uthe bafuna ukuthi uButhelezi achaze ukuthi zibize malini lezi zimoto, nokuthi ukuthengwa kwazo bekuvele kusezinhlelweni zomnyango."Ngabe akuzange kuthathwe imali ebihlelelwe okunye ngesikhathi kuthengwa izimoto? Yini eyenze ukuthi kukhethwe lolu hlobo lwezimoto? Ngabe umnyango uzokuba nayo imali yokuqhubeka nalolu hlelo?"UNkk Nair uthe bafuna ukwazi ukuthi ngabe izimoto lezi ngezamakhosi noma ngezemikhandlu yamakhosi."Ngabe uma kukhothama inkosi imoto izonikezwa ozolandela esihlalweni?" UNkk Nair uthe bafuna ukwazi ukuthi ngabe umnyango iwona ozolungisa lezi zimoto. "Ngabe umnyango iwona ozothwala izindleko zokulungisa izimoto, umshwalense kanye nokufaka uphethroli. Ngabe lezi zimoto azizukuphenduka umthwalo womnyango?"UButhelezi uthe ubengakayitholi imibuzo ye-DA. Ngokombhalo ofakwe umnyango ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, izimoto ezingu-30 zinikwe amakhosi ayingxenye yesigungu esiphezulu endlini yobuholi bomdabu KwaZulu-Natal. Kuphinde kwahlomula osihlalo namaphini osihlalo bezindlu zobuholi bomdabu ezifundeni. Umnyango uthe lezi zimoto zizokwenza ukuthi kube lula ukuba amakhosi enze umsebenzi wesizwe. Kuzona kukhona izingqovungqovu zohlobo lweSUV bese kuba namaveni anezicabha ezine, ama-double cabs.ISilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini, sizodlulisela ngokusemthethweni lezi zimoto emakhosini emhlanganweni ozoba ngoLwesine, esigodlweni eMashobeni. Umhlangano ubizelwe ukuzobhunga ngesikhwama esigade umhlaba kaZulu, iNgonyama Trust.
UCHAZWE njengomuntu obenezisombululo futhi ewusizo, u-Andile "DJ Boonu” Chili (40), enkonzweni yakhe yomngcwabo ebise-Olive Convention Centre, eThekwini, izolo.U-DJ Boonu uzakhele udumo engu-DJ weBig NUZ ngaphambi kokukhipha ezimele. Ushone engasagcini ngokuba nguDJ kodwa esengene shi nasemabhizinisini. Ulale wangavuka ngeledlule. Zonke izikhulumi ebezishiyelana inkundla, bezifakazelana ngokuba wusomaqhinga kanjalo nosizo. Umngani wakhe u-Arab, uthe ubemncane kunaye kodwa emdala ngezenzo. "Ubewumuntu wabantu, ekwazi ukungena lapho kungangenwa khona,” kusho u-Arab. Uthe noma yinini uba benenkinga bebefonela uBoonu. Uveze ukuthi ngenyanga edlule, uBoonu uke wangeniswa esibhedlela kodwa ebatshela ukuthi akanalutho, uyohlolwa nokho udokotela ukhethe ukumlalisa ukuze ezomhlolisisa.Uthe uBoonu ubebukela kakhulu kuBlack Coffee, abe nenhlanhla yokuchitha naye isikhathi ngoMsombuluko odlule. Omunye umngani, uMthunzi Buthelezi, uma ecabanga uthe akasitholi isizathu sokuthi kungani uNkulunkulu ethathe uBoonu. "Yingakho ngithi uNkulunkulu angimazi ukuthi ucabanga kanjani.” Emngcwabeni bekuqhuma umculo womdanso nowokholo. Phakathi kwabebeduduza enkonzweni ebiphethwe uLinda Sibiya, kubalwa uMalusi Mbokazi, Andile KaMajola noJumbo. Izethameli ebezikhona kubalwa umndeni wakwaGcaba, uDJ Boonu abesebenza nawo, owakubo komholi weMK Party, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, njengoba ebesebenza noMnuz Khulubuse Zuma, amaciko ahlukene, osomabhizinisi nabanye.UMnuz Wandile Gcaba uthe uBoonu ulime indima enkulu emndenini wakhe njengoba abafowabo sebeze bangena ngisho emabhizinisini asemkhakheni wokungcebeleka ngenxa yakhe."UMlazi Picnic ubambisane kakhulu nomfowethu uMfundo nakweminye imisebenzi. Uphinde futhi wabambisana nomfowethu uThembinkosi kwi-Executive Marquee kwiDurban July, uwena futhi obuphambili ukuhlela amaMetro Awards kanjalo neminye imisebenzi,” kusho uWandile.
UBUYELE ensimini uNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa osamisiwe, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, owenza imisebenzi yenhlangano yakhe, i-ANC. UMchunu oyilungu lesigungu esiphezulu se-ANC, uthe uqale ngeledlule ukwenza imisebenzi ye-ANC.Uthe ubhalele uNobhala Jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, emazisa ukuthi uyabuyela ekwenzeni imisebenzi yenhlangano."Ngimbhalele uMbalula ngimazisa ukuthi ngiyabuyela emsebenzini we-ANC kusuka ngoMashi 26. Sengiqalile ngenza imisebenzi yenhlangano kwamanje," kusho uMchunu ophinde abe yilungu lekomiti elibhekele ukusebenza kwansuku zonke kwenhlangano. Ukusho lokhu ekhuluma nabezindaba zakwa-SABC. UMchunu wamiswa emsebenzini kahulumeni, nguMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, kulandela izinsolo ezenziwa nguKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant-General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, zokugxambukela kosopolitiki emsebenzini wamaphoyisa kanjalo nokuhlakaza ithimba elaliphenya ukubulawa kosopolitiki, engazange akhulume noRamaphosa.URamaphosa wajuba ikhomishini ephenya lezi zinsolo zikaMkhwanazi.UMchunu ebuzwa ukuthi ngabe uMbalula umgunyazile yini ukuthi abuyele ekwenzeni imisebenzi ye-ANC, uthe ubemazisa njengoba naphambilini ezoma ekwenzeni imisebenzi yenhlangano, njengoba wambhalela emazisa ukuthi uzothi ukuma kancane njengoba kuqhubeka uphenyo."Ngimbhalele incwadi ngawo uMashi 26, ngimazisa ukuthi sengiyabuyela emsebenzini we-ANC," kusho uMchunu. Ukuqinisekisile ukuthi uyaqhubeka nomsebenzi we-ANC.Ngesikhathi azisa i-ANC ngokuma emsebenzini wenhlangano, uMbalula wathi bayakugunyaza ukuhlaba ikhefu kukaMchunu emsebenzini we-ANC. UMchunu uveze nokuthi usazobuyela kwikhomishini, eyokwenza izethulo zokugcina."Uma kusezinhlelweni zekhomishini ukuthi iphinde ingibize ngizokwenza izethulo, ngizobuyela kuyona. Ngisalinde yona ingazise ukuze ngivale isahluko kulolu daba. Selokhu ngahlaba ikhefu, angikaze ngikhulume noRamaphosa," usho kanje. Uphikile ukuthi unobudlelwano nemigulukudu wathi abukho ubufakazi obumyamanisa nenkohlakalo.Siye koshicilela i-ANC ingakaphefumuli ngokubuyela kukaMchunu emsebenzini yenhlangano.
UMASIPALA waseThekwini ulindele izivakashi ezingaphezu kuka-1.2 million kule mpelasonto yePhasika. IMeya yalo mkhandlu, uMnuz Cyril Xaba, ithe balindele ukuthi izivakashi zisebenzise u-R2.6 billion.Ikusho lokhu ngesikhathi ikhuluma nabezindaba izolo, lapho ibichaza khona ngamalungiselelo ePhasika. UXaba uthe balindele ukuthi kudaleke amathuba emisebenzi angu-16 000."Izindawo zokulala silindele ukuthi zibe ku-62% ukugcwala." UXaba uthe ubumnandi buzobe bubuzwa eThekwini, kule mpelasonto."Abantu abazobe bevakashile bazobhema bakholwe njengoba kunemicimbi eyahlukene okubalwa kuyo i-One Man Concert, Doek On Fleak, Sjava 10th Year Celebration Tour kanye neminye. Imindeni ezobe ivakashile izokwazi futhi ukuzitika ngezinhlelo zokujabulisa izingane eShaka Marine Theme Park nasemapaki okubalwa kuwo iMitchell Park Zoo neDurban Botanic Gardens. Lezi zinhlelo zenzelwe ukuthi izingane zijabule ziphinde futhi zithole izinto ezizozivula imiqondo ngesikhathi samaholidi."UXaba uthe okubajabulisayo ukuthi onke amabhisi avuliwe. "Onke amabhishi angu-23 avuliwe. Kulezi zinyanga ezedlule, amabhishi ethu abehlezi evuliwe. Ukuvulwa kwamabhishi kukhombisa ngokusobala ukuthi uyaqhubeka umsebenzi wethu wokulungisa ingqalasizinda yokuhanjiswa kwendle. Ngesikhathi kuhlelwa kabusha isabelomali ngenyanga eyedlule, kunemali engu-R1.2 billion eyabelwa ukulungisa ingqalasizinda yalokhu."UXaba uthe bazojuba abatshuzi abangu-200."Sinxusa abantu ukuthi bahloniphe imiyalelo yabatshuzi, babhukude ezindaweni okuvumeleke ukubhukuda kuzo. Abantu bagweme ukubhukuda bedle amanzi amponjwana." UXaba uthe zizokube ziqinile ezokuphepha."Angaphezu kuka-1 000 amaphoyisa azobe esebenza. Azobe ehamba ebheka isimo ezindaweni ezahlukene okubalwa nezindawo zobumnandi. Senyuse isibalo samaphoyisa omgwaqo. Izimoto ezingekho esimweni zizokhishwa emigwaqweni. Sizoba nezivimbamgwaqo ezingaphezu kuka-20."Uthe uma kunetha imvula, akabuthi quthu ubuthongo ngenxa yodaba lwezikhukhula."Isathe ukusixolela imvula edala umonakalo eThekwini. Angilali nhlobo uma kwenzeka linetha." Uthe imicimbi eba kuleli dolobha iletha inzuzo enkulu ohlangothini lwezokuvakasha."Siyalihlula ngisho idolobha iKapa ngezinto eziseThekwini, inkinga ngukuthi alimakethwa ngokwanele iTheku. Kunosomabhizinisi ophakamise ukuthi i-jazz ebiseKapa, ize kuleli dolobha, okuwumqondo omuhle. Siyazilungisa nezinto ezifana nokuvala imigodi emigwaqweni, siyalungisa sifake amalambu emigwaqweni nezinye izinto." Odabeni lwabokufika abakuleli ngokungemthetho, uthe kudingeka kubambisane zonke izinhlaka ukuze kuliwe nale nkinga ngoba noma bephindiselwa emazweni abo, baphinde babuye.
UMFUNDISI Vusumuzi Sibiya ongumsunguli wendawo yamakholwa asehlukene nakho konke akhetha impilo "eqondile" uthi amandla abo bawathola ngomkhuleko, yingakho abantu abahlala ebandleni lakhe eKhaya Labafundi bengayi esibhedlela uma bengaphilile. Kule ndawo abakuyo esigodini saseDabangu, balima izingadi zamadumbe, ubhatata nokunye okuningi okutshaliwe. Bafuyile, kunezinkomo, izingulube nezinkukhu. Bathi konke lokhu bayakwazi ukudayisa kuthi imali abayitholayo bayisebenzise ezidingweni zekhaya labo. Kulezi zidingo kukhona nokubiya, ukwakha, kukhona namathangi amanzi.Ukudla abakudlayo yikho lokhu abakutshalile futhi basapheka ngendlela yakudala yokubasa phansi basebenzise namabhodwe amilenze mithathu yize ukhona ugesi endaweni. Ezindlini akhona namafriji okugcina okudla.Ehanjelwe yiSolezwe Ngempelasonto kule ndawo ekwaMaphumulo, uSibiya uthe abakuvumeli ukusebezisa izibhedlela ngoba ukusinda kwabo bakuthola kuKrestu.''Leyo nto awusoze wayibona yenzeka kule ndawo yethu engcwele enoNkulunkulu. Lapha uma umuntu egula siyamthandazela lokhu okwangampela, hhayi indaba yokudlala. Simthandazela aze asinde,'' echaza.Ugcizelele ukuthi bakholwa ukuthi umkhuleko unamandla enele okuphulukisa umuntu, akukhathaleki noma ngabe usebambeke kangakanani noma ngabe uxinwe yisiphi isifo.''Asikho nesisodwa nje isifo okungathiwa sesidale ukuthi kukhulunywe indaba yokuthi kukhona omunye wethu ophuthunyiswe esibhedlela, lutho nje nhlobo,'' usho kanje ngokukhulu ukuzethemba lokhu.Wenze isibonelo ngabanye abayeke amaphilisi okuthithibalisa igciwane lengculazi wathi noma bangaxineka kangakanani bayabakhulekela nje baqale phansi baphile nje.Ugcizelele ukuthi bayisizwe esinomthelela omuhle nasemphakathini ngoba bayawuhambisa umkhuleko lapho okusuke kunesidingo khona sokuba benze kanjalo.''Uma kukhona indawo lapho okushonwe khona lapha endaweni siyawuhambisa umkhuleko," echaza.
Amaphoyisa asebenza ngokuBambisana nezikhulu eziqapha ezokuphepha ze-Airports Company South Africa (ACSA), babophe abesifazane baseNingizimu Afrika ngoMgqibelo, esikhumulweni sezindiza i-OR Tambo International Airport.Kuthiwa laba basolwa bezama ukushushumbisa izidakamizwa zenani elingaphezu kwezigidi ezinhlanu zamarandi ebezifihlwe emizimbeni yabo.Umbiko wokuqala uveza ukuthi abasolwa bebesendleleni ebheke eChina bezodlula eDubai. Ukusesha kuholele ekutholweni kwezidakamizwa ebezifihlwe ngaphakathi kwamateku, izingubo zangaphansi, nasezithweni zangasese.Abasolwa kulindeleke ukuba bavele ngaphambi kweNkantolo yeMantshi yaseKempton Park ngoLwesibili, Mashi ngamacala ahlobene nokushushumbisa izidakamizwa.
AMANDLA azowela koSomlomo bomasipala abazoqhubeka baqaphe ukusebenza kwemikhandlu, uma kusalindwe ukumenyezelwa ngokusemthethweni kwemiphumela yokhetho lohulumeni basekhaya. Lokhu kwenzelwa ukuthi omasipala baqhubeke nokusebenza kusalindwe le miphumela.Ngokomthetho, imiphumela yokhetho kumele imenyezelwe ngemuva kwezinsuku eziyisikhokmbisa, kudlule ukhetho. UMnuz Lance Joel wenhlangano i-South African Local Government Association (Salga), utshele oSomlomo bomasipala baKwaZulu-Natal, emhlanganweni obusesiShayamthetho sesifundazwe eMgungundlovu, ngoLwesihlanu, ukuthi oSomlomo bazoqhubeka nokusebenza kuze kumenyezelwe imiphumela yokhetho."Ningawubiza ngisho umhlangano wokhetho nangosuku lokhetho. Uma kwenzeka kuhlonzwa isimo senhlekelele ezweni, omasipala kumele baqhubeke nokuhambisa izidingo emphakathini, ngeke ume umsebenzi ngenxa yokuthi kunokhetho," usho kanje. Uveze ukuthi ihlandla lobuholi bomasipala kuleli, liphela ngoNovemba 3, 2026. Kulindeleke ukuthi ukhetho lubizwe phakathi kukaNovemba noJanuwari wangonyaka ozayo. Ngokwezinhlelo ezikhona zokhetho, amalungiselelo okhetho ayaqhubeka phezu kokuba usuku lungakamenyezelwa.UNgqongqoshe wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana nezindaba zoMdabu kuleli, uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa, uMengameli we-IFP, nguyena onamandla okumemezela usuku lokhetho. UJoel uthe okunye abakulungiselelayo wukuxoxa nawo wonke amakhansela ukuwalungiselela ukuthi abhekane nesimo uma engabuyeli ezikhundleni."Inqwaba yamakhansela angeke abuyele ezikhundleni zawo ngemuva kokhetho. Siyawalungiselela, kahle kahle sixoxa nawo wonke ukuze azilungiselele ukuthi kungenzeka angabuyi ngemuva kokhetho. Amanye awo kawazoba neholo ngoba azobe engasatohozi ngakho kumele akulungele lokhu," usho kanje. Uthe kunabanye abasebenzi komasipala, izinkontileka zabo ezincike ezikhulwini zemikhandlu, abangeke babuye ngemuva kokhetho."Yizona zonke izinto okumele zihlelelwe kusenesikhathi. Kunemibiko okumele yenziwe ngezinhlelo ezenziwe abaholi abakhona komasipala, ezodluliselwa ebuholini obuzongena ngemuva kokhetho," kusho uJoel.Uthe umhlangano wokuqala womasipala kumele uhlale ezinsukwini ezingu-14, ngemuva kokumenyezelwa kwemiphumela yokhetho. Ayisalanga indaba yokuthuthwa kwabantu abangahlali emawadini abo, bayovota kwamanye amawadi uma kunokhetho lokuchibiyela. Ihlale iyindaba egudwini emaqenjini ezombusazwe indaba yokuthuthwa kwabantu abangahlali kuleyo ndawo, bayovota kwenye indawo uma kunalolu khetho. Isikhulu sekhomishini yezokhetho esifundazweni, uDkt Khulekani Zulu, sithe ngaphambi kokhetho badedela uhlu lwabavoti kuleyo ndawo ukuze amaqembu akwazi ukukhalaza uma kukhona angakuboni kahle."Amaqembu analo ilungelo lokufaka isikhalazo ukuze sisibheke siyikhomishini uma kukhona abantu abangahlali kuleyo wadi. Kumele alethe nobufakazi balokhu ukuze sikwazi ukuphenya," kusho uZulu. Kuvele ukuthi ngo-Agasti, amaqembu kumele aqale uhlelo lokuqoka azofolosa ngabo okhethweni.
I-AFRIFORUM iqinise umbhidlango wayo wokuba kushushiswe uNobhala Jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, efuna ashushiselwe uhambo lwakhe lwaseDubai. Le nhlangano ithe izozishushisela mathupha uMbalula uma kuwukuthi uphiko lwezokushushisa, i-National Prosecuting Authority (NPA), luyaqhubeka nokuhudula izinyawo.I-AfriForum ifuna ukuthi uMbalula ashushiselwe uhambo luka-R600 000 aluthatha ngo-2016, ngesikhathi esangungqongqoshe wezeMidlalo. Uhambo lukaMbalula lwakhokhelwa yinkampani eyayinethenda enhlanganweni, i-SA Sports Confederation and Olympic Committe (Sascoc), iSedgars Sports.Lokhu kwaqubula imibuzo njengoba iSascoc ingaphansi koMnyango owawuphethwe uMbalula ngaleso sikhathi kepha uMbalula wathi wayeyitshelekile le mali. Izolo, i-AfriForum ikhiphe umqulu oqukethe umlando kanye nobufakazi kuleli cala. Oyinhloko yezokushushisa kwi-AfriForum, u-Advocate Gerrie Nel, uthe sekunesikhathi eside i-NPA idlala umacashelana ngalolu daba. Uthe sebebhalele umqondisi wezokushushisa omusha, u-Advocate Andy Mothibi, becela ukuba i-NPA ishushise uMbalula."Sinethemba lokuthi kukhona izinyathelo ezizothathwa yi-NPA. Siyazi ukuthi i-NPA inomphathi omusha othembisa ukuthi bazothatha izinqumo ngokushesha. Uma i-NPA ingathathi isinqumo ngokushesha, sizomshushisa ngasese uMbalula. Ngokomqulu sibona ukuthi bukhona ubufakazi obanele ukuthi uMbalula ashushiswe."Isikhulu esiphezulu kwi-AfriForum, uMnuz Kallie Kriel, sithe bafuna ukuthi nohulumeni waseMelika uthathele uMbalula izinyathelo."UMbalula ubudedengu ngempela. Ngapha thina sizama ukubhula umlilo yena ulibele ukuthuka inxusa laseMelika. Kuzohlukumezeka abantu uma iMelika inquma ukusintswinya. Abantu abazoshayeka kakhulu ilabo abahlwempu. UMbalula akanandaba nakho konke lokhu. Into nje anendaba nayo ukuqhuba umkhankaso wakhe wokuhola i-ANC. Ukhuluma noma yini ezosiza i-ANC okhethweni lohulumeni basekhaya oluzayo." UMbalula ne-ANC bathe i-AfriForum ithusa ngenyoka efile. Embhalweni awufake ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, uMbalula uchaze isimemezelo se-AfriForum njengehlaya."Bayathanda ukusebenzisa amagama amakhulu. Bathe bazokhipha umqulu onobufakazi. Bayawazi kodwa ukuthi yini umqulu onobufakazi?"Okhulumela i-ANC, uNkk Mahlengi Bhengu, uthe kusobala ukuthi i-AfriForum ilwisa uMbalula ngenxa yokuthi akahambisani nokugxambukela kwamazwe angaphandle ezindabeni zakuleli."Lesi sithangami sabo basenze emva kwemashi ye-ANC ebe impumelelo. Le mashi eyayibanjwe ngosuku lwamalungelo abantu itatazelisa i-AfriForum."

UNyhontso wathi unqume ukuhlakaza ibhodi ngenxa yokuthi sekusele isibalo esincane samalungu alo, kulandela ukusula kwenqwaba. Njengamanje kusele amalungu amane ebhodi, njengoba ayeyisishiyagalolunye.Amalungu asele anikela enkantolo ekhala ngokuthi uNyhontso akanawo amandla okuwahlakaza. IJaji uMarion linqume ukuthi amalungu ebhodi aqhubeke nokusebenza kuze kube kuphuma isinqumo esicelweni esiphonsela isinqumo sikaNyhontso sokuhlakaza ibhodi. Amalungu ebhodi athe isinqumo senkantolo sizobuyisa uzinzo. Esitatimendeni, amalungu ebhodi athe wona abevele esho ukuthi isinqumo sikaNyhontso siphambene nomthetho olawula iNgonyama Trust. "Sakuchaza lokhu ngesikhathi sikhuluma nabezindaba ngeledlule. Sizoqhubeka nomsebenzi wethu njengoba inkantolo isicacisile." IMbube ithe iyaqhubeka nomkhankaso wayo wokuba kushintshwe igama lesifundazwe, kube iKwaZulu. Imemezele ukuthi izofaka icala ngokushiswa kwesigodlo seSilo uDingani, uMgungundlovu. Uma sekufanele iNgonyama iyohlangana neNdlovukazi yamaNgisi, asikho isigodlo sokuthi ibike."

UKHALA ngezobulungiswa othi zihlinzela ezibini abagilwa bamacala okudlwengulwa asuke ebandakanya abasolwa abayizingane, umndeni wentombazanyana okuthiwa yehlelwa umuga ofanayo nyakenye njengoba kuhoxiswe icala ngesonto eledlule.Kulesi sigameko, okuthiwa senzeka eZwelibomvu KwaNdengezi, ngoSepthemba 4 nyakenye, umgilwa owayeneminyaka emithathu, kuthiwa wadlwengulwa wumsolwa owayeneminyaka engu-12.Kwavela ukuthi umndeni kamgilwa wezwa ngesehlakalo ngosuku okuthiwa senzeka ngalo. Kuthiwa umgilwa watshela isihlobo ukuthi ulimele esithweni sakhe sangasese ngoba umsolwa, okuthiwa wamgagula ngegama, ufake isitho sakhe sangasese kwesakhe. Kwavela ukuthi umsolwa, owayekade ewufihlele umndeni wakhe, wavuma esebuzwa ngesehlakalo, icala lagcina livulwe ngoba umndeni kamgilwa waya esikhungweni iThuthuzela, eChatsworth.Uyise kamgilwa ongeke adalulwe ukumvikela, utshele Isolezwe ukuthi igama lomphenyi wagcina ukulibona ngesikhathi ethunyelelwa umyalezo wokuthi icala liphethwe ubani."Akakaze angifonele, angikaze ngimbone, angikaze ngizwe lutho oluqhamuka kuye njengomphenyi wecala,” kusho uyise kamgilwa. Uthe yena ayekulindele wukuthi umphenyi asondele kubo njengabazali bakamgilwa, asho ukuthi icala lizohamba kanjani."Ngimangele sengithunyelelwa i-sms ethi icala selihoxisiwe. Ngizwe ngidinwa futhi ngibone umthetho ungangisizi njengomzali kamgilwa, ngacabanga nabanye abaesisimeni esifana nesami,” usho kanje.Uthe ngesikhathi elusukumela udaba kukhona iphoyisa laKwaNdengezi elamtshela ukuthi nakuba icala lenziwe umuntu oneminyaka engaphansi kwewu-18 kodwa lisuke likhona ithuba lokuthi umsolwa ashushiswe. "Wathi nakuba kusuke kuyingane kodwa ngesikhathi kwenziwa uphenyo, kuyabhekwa ukuthi iyayazi yini into ebiyenza ukuthi ayifanele. Uma yazi, amathuba okuthi libe yicala eliphathekayo, asuke emaningi,” kusho uyise kamgillwa.Uthe lelo phoyisa lenza isibonelo sokuthi uma umsolwa engazange ayithi vu into asuke eyenzile, lokho kusuke kungolunye lwezimpawu ezikhombisa ukuthi uyaqonda ngokuphelele ukuthi asuke ekwenzile akufanele.Udalule ukuthi akakholwa wukuthi konke lokhu kuke kwabhekelelwa kuleli cala, wathi ngenxa yalokho, ubona umthetho ubenzela phansi abagilwa bokudlwengulwa. "Njengamanje umsolwa uyazitshakadulela, konke kumnandi. Mina ngapha kufanele nginakekele ingane esihlala ithukile, eshintsha ebusweni uma ike yambona umsolwa edlula ngaphandle komuzi,” kusho uyise kamgilwa.Uthe sebeshintshe ngisho nendlela ingane edlala ngayo, wathi isikhathi esiningi isihlale idlala endlini. "Uma sizoba nohambo, oluphoqa ukuthi siyishiye, sesiyicelela emzini osebangeni elingamakhilomitha angu-400 ngoba sesiyasaba ukuyishiya komakhelwane abaseduze." Uveze nokuthi indodakazi yakhe ibiyingane eziphaphele kodwa manje isihlale indwazile nje, kokunye ivele ikhale."Iyona mpilo le ezomthetho ezifuna iphilwe abagilwa bokudlwengulwa nemindeni yabo? Kungani sibone sengathi umthetho ubeka phambili amalungelo abasolwa, bese awabagilwa uwashovela emuva?” usho kanje.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe abaphenyi bophiko lweFamily Violence Child Protection and Sexual Offences (FCS) eChatsworth, baavula icala lokudlwengula kulandela isigameko lapho okusolwa ukuthi intombazane (3) yadlwengulwa ngoSepthemba 4 nyakenye eZwelibomvu. "Icala lahoxiswa enkantolo,” kusho uNetshiunda.
BALAHLEKELWE yikho konke abanakho ebebakhe izithabathaba zemizi yabo emhlabeni okuthiwa ngoka-Eskom eThornville, eMgungundlovu, njengoba le nkampani ephehla ugesi ikhethe ukuzishaya phansi zonke izolo, isebenzisa incwadi yenkantolo eyivunayo.Kuvela ukuthi zingaphezu kuka-100 izindlu ezidiliziwe abeRed Ant Security Relocation & Eviction Services, ebebehlome nangezibhamu.Omunye wabakhahlanyezwe ilokhu, yiphoyisa elisebenzise indodana yayo enamasonto amathathu izelwe, ukuzama ukuzikhalela ukuthi indlu yalo ingadilizwa. Lithe abakwa-Eskom bavele babathelekela bengazelele. "Asazi lutho ngephepha elinomyalelo wasenkantolo, ukube besazi besingeke sichithe imali yethu yokugcina sakha umuzi,” kusho iphoyisa. Umkalo, naye ocele ukungadalulwa uthe: "Nginengane ezelwe engingazi ukuthi sizothi uma sisuka la nayo sizobhekaphi ukuze sithole indawo yokukhosela.” Kuvela ukuthi izakhamuzi zichithe imali ephakathi kuka-R15 000 kuya ku-R60 000 zithenga umhlaba kubadayisi ababezibiza ngabanini bawo. Abanye babagilwa bachithe imali ecela ku-R1 million ukwakha izithabathaba zabo. Esinye isakhamuzi sizwakale sibalisa ngokuthi indlu yaso okuthathe izinyanga eziyisithupha siyakha, ivele yaphenduka ize esikhathini esiyimizuzu emithathu. Kuthiwa abanikazi bemizi, iningi labo ebelisemsebenzini, babizwe ngabanye ngamaselula.Inkampani engaphansi kwe-Eskom, iNational Transmission Company South Africa (NTCSA), yathola incwadi yeNkantolo eNkulu yaseMgungundlovu nyakenye, ukuthi idilize izindlu ezakhiwe emhlabeni oseduze kwesiphehli sikagesi. Incwadi eyakhishwa ngoJulayi 14, 2025, yayazisa abahleli kulo mhlaba ngokungafanele ukuthi badilize izindlu zabo engakapheli amahora angu-48, emva kokunikezwa yona.Kuthiwa ngo-Agasti 29, 2025, incwadi eyayibhalwe ngesiLungu nangesiZulu, yahanjiswa kubagilwa, ibacacisela ukuthi uma behluleka ukwenza okushiwoyo, isikhonzi senkantolo sizoqala uhlelo lokubakhipha ngenkani.Lezi zakhamuzi zazihlalele ovalweni lokuthi zizoba noKhisimusi omuncu kulandela ukuthi isikhonzi senkantolo sizame ukuzikhipha ngoNovemba. Nokho kwabuye kwathi cwaka ohlangothini luka-Eskom nesikhonzi senkantolo, kanti bamatasa nokulungiselela lokhu kugcine kwenzeka izolo. Umholi womphakathi, onqabe negama lakhe, uthe izakhamuzi bekufanele zinikwe noma izinsuku ezingu-30 ukuthi ziphume endaweni, ngaphambi kokuthi kuqale ukudilizwa kwezindlu. "Kwaba khona izingxoxo no-Eskom, owathi usazobheka ukuthi obani abahleli emhlabeni wawo kodwa manje usuxhaphaza amandla awo kabi ukuthi udilize amakhaya abantu. Njengamanje sizoya enkantolo, sifuna ukuthi uzakhe lezi zindlu ozidilizile,” kusho umholi. Ngesikhathi kuthintwa ikhansela lendawo, uMnuz Vincent Maphumulo, lithe lisematasa kakhulu, ngeke likwazi ukukhuluma.Isikhulu sikaMasipala waseRichmond esingagunyaziwe ukukhuluma nabezindaba, sithe izakhamuzi zaxwayiswa ukuthi zingaqhubeki nokwakha endaweni ka-Eskom. "Baqhubeka yize babeze bakhonjiswa ngisho nencwadi eyayibaxwayisa ngokuthi baphume baphele kule ndawo. Kwabanjwa inqwaba yemihlangano lapho abaxwayiswa khona ngomlomo,” kusho isikhulu.Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kokhulumela u-Eskom, uDaphne Mokwena, ayiphumelelanga.
UFUNA amiswe uthisha bese kuqalwa uphenyo ngaye, umndeni womfundi kaGrade 12 eKhethimfundo High, eBhamshela, kulandela ukuzikhunga kwakhe ngoLwesine.UMongezi Shandu (22) utholwe wumndeni wakhe esebanda, ezilengise ngentambo egumbini lakhe lokulala.Umalume wakhe, uMnuz Nathi Santosi, uthe bathole engasekho umshana wakhe ukuthi bese kunesikhathi kukhona uthisha anenkinga naye esikoleni. Uveze ukuthi kusuka ngonyaka odlule, umshana wakhe ubengalenzi iphutha lokuya esikoleni engasifakile isifonyo.Uthe ubede embuza ukuthi esani isifonyo ngoba kudala yaphela iCovid-19, umufi aphendule ngelithi: "Lutho lume”."Sithole manje ngoba esezibulele ukuthi kukhona uthisha owathi kuye akamsize afake isifonyo uma eza esikoleni ngoba umlomo wakhe uyamnyanyisa,” kusho uSantosi. Udalule ukuthi kukhona okungahambi kahle ebebekwazi ngothisha ofanayo kodwa bengazi ukuthi kuzoholela ekutheni umshana azibulale.Uthe maphakathi noFebhuwari, bathole ukuthi lo thisha ugibele umufi ngamanqindi, kulandela ukuthi amdlalise ngendlela angayithandi."Sizwa kuthiwa lo thisha waqukula umshini wokugaya amaphepha (printer), umshana wamdlalisa ngelithi 'uyisigora Sir’. Kuthiwa wavele wabeka phansi umshini, wamngena ngezibhakela,” usho kanje. Uthe emva kwaleso sigameko, ekhaya labo kwafika uthishanhloko, ethi ezokhuluma ngodaba.Uveze ukuthi lwaphetha ngokuthi unina kamufi athi umufi akabuyele esikoleni, afike axolise kuthisha, nokuyinto umfundi okuthiwa wayenza.Nokho kuvela ukuthi ngoLwesihlanu olwandulela uLwesine, umfundi agcine ezibulala ngalo, uthisha wambizela ehhovisi, bangqumuza bobabili. "Asazi ukuthi yini le ayisho kuye njengoba sesithola ukuthi ngoMsombuluko nangoLwesibili wahlala emathoyilethi, wangalubhada ekilasini. NgoLwesithathu walova kanjalo nangoLwesine agcine ezibulala ngalo,” kusho uSantosi. Uthe akukho ncwadi noma myalezo abawubhalelwe umufi ngaphambi kokuba azibulale kodwa umyalezo abawuthole kwiselula, abewuthumelela umngani wakhe ethi: "Bafikile othisha ekhaya kwakhuluywa kodwa mina hhayi ngeke”.Uthe lokhu kubadwebele isithombe esigcwele sokuthi into eholele ekutheni umshana wakhe azibulale, yile mpi ebikhona phakathi kwakhe nothisha. "Sisola ukuthi kukhulu akukhuluma enganeni. Kodwa yangakuveza ngoba ibengesiyo ingane ekhonze ukukhuluma. UHLALELE ovalweni umphakathi wase-Area 2, eMhlasini, eVerulam, kulandela ukwanda kwezigameko zokudutshulwa kubulawe abantu ngesihluku kule ndawo. Lokhu kuza emva kwesigameko sangoLwesibili, sokudutshulwa kubulawe owesilisa noyise.Ngokusho komthombo ocele ukungadalulwa, abasolwa abangaziwa, bafike babhodloza isicabha salapho obekulala khona owesilisa (41), bangena ngaphakathi, bamdubula. "Kuthe uma uyise ephuma kwelakhe igumbi lokulala, ezobheka emva kokuzwa umsindo wokuqhuma kwesibhamu, abasolwa baphendukela kuye, naye bamdubula,” kusho umthombo oqinisekise eyokuthi bobabili baphelele endaweni yesigameko.Uthe kwenzeka lokhu nje ngenyanga edlule, bekudutshulwe abanye abane endaweni. Uqhuba, uthe kubona kwaphangalala ababili, kwathi abanye ababili balimala. "Asisazi ukuthi kwenzekani ngempela. Sesihlale sisaba ngoba kulezi zigameko, abantu balahlekelwa yimiphefumulo yabo,” kusho umthombo othe okubi, kabazi bewumphakathi ukuthi ababulawayo babulawelwani?Okhulumela abenkampani yonogada ebizelwe endaweni yesigameko ngomakhelwane, i-Reaction Unit South Africa (Rusa), uMnuz Prem Balram, uthe baqaphele ukuthi abafi bebedutshulwe emakhanda. "Badutshulelwe emagunjini amabili ahlukene ngaphakathi egcekeni. Kutholwe amagobolondo amane ezinhlamvu zohlobo lwe-9mm kwelinye igumbi, kwathi kwelinye kwatholwa amathathu ohlobo olufanayo,” kusho uBalram. Uthe omakhelwane bathe kabayazi imbangela yokubulala futhi kabababonanga abasolwa.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uCaptain Ntathu Ndlovu, uthe amaphoyisa aseVerulam, aphenya amacala amabili okubulala."Izidumbu zabafi abaneminyaka elinganiselwa ku-41 no-60, zitholwe ngaphakathi endlini eMhlasini, ngoLwesibili,” kusho uCapt Ndlovu, othe akukaboshwa muntu.

KUKHALWA ngokwanda kwezigameko zokucekelwa phansi kwengqalasizinda kagesi okushiya abantu bengenawo ugesi ezindaweni ezingaphansi koMasipala waseMhlathuze.Kule nyanga kucekelwe phansi iziteshi zikagesi ezimbili, okushiye izindawo eziningi zingenawo ugesi eduze nechweba eliyisizinda somnotho waKwaZulu-Natal, iRichard's Bay, kanye naseMpangeni. Umasipala unxuse amaphoyisa ukuba aphenye ngalezi zigameko.Kuleli sonto kucekelwe phansi isiteshi sikagesi i-Aquila, esiseRichard's Bay. Umasipala uthe umonakalo odaleke kulesi siteshi mkhulu, wathi awazi ukuthi uzolungiseka nini. Ukucekelwa phansi kwengqalasizinda kagesi kushiye kumnyama bhuqe endaweni yomtakabani, e-Arboretum. Emasontweni amabili edlule kwacekelwa phansi ingqalasizinda kagesi esiteshini sikagesi eVega. Ukucekelwa phansi kwale ngqalasizinda, kwaphazamisa ukuhlinzekwa kukagesi eMadlanzini, Birdswood naseVeldenvlei. Kwezinye izindawo ezaphazamiseka ugesi waze wabuya emva kwezinsuku ezine.Imeya kamasipala, uMnuz Xolani Ngwezi, ithe ukucekelwa phansi kwengqalasizinda kuyaqhubeka phezu kokuba sebeqinise ezokuphepha."Kusobala ukuthi kukhona abantu abazimisele ukucekela phansi ingqalasizinda, yize sesiqinise ezokuphepha eziteshini zikagesi. Sinxusa abantu ukuthi babike uma kukhona okusolisayo abakubona kwenzeka eziteshini zikagesi." UNgwezi unxuse amaphoyisa ukuthi asukumele lolu daba. "Kusobala lapha ukuthi kunabantu abaningi ababambisene kulobu gebengu. Lobu gebengu buphazamisa ukuhanjiswa kwezidingo futhi nje kuphazamisa abantu abakhele umkhandlu."Kule nyanga kuboshwe amadoda amathathu abanjwa nezintambo zikagesi khona eMhlathuze.
BAQALA emsebenzini ngenyanga ezayo, othisha abangu-500 abazofundisa uGrade R KwaZulu-Natal, abaqashwe nguMnyango wezeMfundo esifundazweni. Bese kunesikhathi ibangwa indaba yokuqashwa kothisha abafundisa leli banga kulesi sifundazwe.UMphathiswa woMnyango, uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka, uthe laba basebenzi baqala ngo-Ephreli 1, emsebenzini, wathi babaqasha ukuze baqinise isisekelo semfundo kulesi sifundazwe."UMnyango uzibophezele ekulandeleni umthetho wezikole iBela, okubeka kucace ukuthi uGrade R, usuyimpoqo kuleli. Siqinisekisa nokuthi othisha abafundisa leli banga, baneziqu ezifanele kanti abafundi sifuna bafundiswe ngabantu abazinikele," usho kanje. Uthe labo thisha bazokwehlisa nesibalo sabafundi emakilasini kulandelwa umkamo obekiwe wokuthi uthisha oyedwa ufundisa abafundi abangaki ekilasini."Ukuqinisa esisekelweni semfundo kuzokwenza ukuthi zibe zinhle izithelo emabangeni aphezulu, kubalwa no-matric. Labo thisha bazosiza kakhulu nasezindaweni zasemakhaya, lapho bezovulela khona iminyango abafundi abahlala kulezi zindawo." Uthe bahleli befuna ukuqikelela ukuthi umfundi oqala isikole, uthola imfundo esezingeni. Kwenzeka lokhu nje, kusanothisha abangaqashiwe abahlala bekhala ngokunqaba kwemisebenzi emnyangweni. Iningi labo lize liqhinqe emahhovisi oMnyango lifuna izikhulu zibaqashe. Leli qulu likhala ngosizi elibhekene nalo njengoba lafunda kodwa alikwazi ukuthola umsebenzi. UMnyango wesifundazwe ubhekene nengcindezi yokungakwazi ukuvala ezinye izikhala ngenxa yokungeneli kwesabelomali. Izikhala okubalwa ezabahloli, abaphathi bamasekethe oMnyango kanjalo nezabasebenza emahhovisi, azivaliwe ngenxa yokushoda kwemali.Inkinga yemali yenza lo Mnyango ungakwazi ukukhokhela ngesikhathi osonkontileka osebenza nabo. Abanye babo kubalwa inkampani esabalalisa izincwadi ezikoleni, okudingeka yenzele uMnyango isikweletu sokuthenga i-stationery nezincwadi ukuze abafundi baqhubeke nokufunda. Nezikole zithwala kanzima njengoba nemali yama-norms and standards, eyenza izinhlelo ezehlukene iphuza ukufakwa ngenxa yokushoda kwemali.
UNCAMELE ukuthi aze agwetshwe owesilisa waseShowe, engazange ayingene eyokuwavuma amacala okubulala abathathu bomndeni owodwa abebekwe wona.USicelo Dambayi Sikhakhane (31) waseMtilombo, eShowe, ugwetshwe odilikajele abathathu yiNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini, ngoLwesibili. Lo wesilisa kuthiwa wadubula wabulala amalungu amathathu omndeni wakwaMkhize ngo-Ephreli 2023. Isigwebo sakhe size emva kokuthi eyecala lakhe ingenelelwe uphiko lwamaphoyisa i-National Intervention Unit (NIU), kwazise wayesenza okungajwayelekile, efonela amaphoyisa esiteshi saseShowe, awasabise ekubeni ayesekubhaceni. USikhakhane kuthiwa wazama ukuwuqotha ngenhlamvu wonke umndeni wakwaMkhize ngosuku lwesigameko njengoba kwasinda abathathu abaphunyuka emlonyeni wengwenya, basinda.Kuthiwa ngosuku lwesigameko, uSikhakhane noNtuthuko Mthethwa, bavakashela umndeni wakwaMkhize eMtilombo, beyofuna ngodli isibhamu sakhe kumngani wakhe, uMnuz Nduduzo Mkhize. Kuvele ukuthi bamthatha bamyisa egumbini lokulala, okuyilapho abafika bamfuna khona isibhamu, bengasagayelwe mphako. Kuthiwa ngesikhathi engasikhiphi isibhamu, bavele bamdubula. Kuthiwa bathi besuka babe bevulela ngenhlamvu kuzo zonke izingxenye zomuzi, okuyilapho okwabe sekufa khona uNksz Nokuphiwa Mkhize nengane yomfana eyayineminyaka engu-14, uMuzikayise Mkhize. Kuthiwa uNksz Zanele Mkhize, Nksz Sinothile Mkhize noNksz Silindile Mkhize nabo badubuleka kodwa basinda. Emva kokwenza icala, uSikhakhane noMthethwa babaleka ngezinyawo.UMthethwa wagcina ekhalelwa amasongo kaSigonyela emva kokusuku olulodwa kudlule isigameko. Icala lakhe lathethwa yiNkantolo eNkulu yaseMthunzini, eyamgixabeza ngodilikajele abane. USikhakhane yena wagcina eboshwa yi-NIU ngoJulayi 2024. Kuthiwa i-NIU yamlandela emva kokuthi wayelokhu efonela amaphoyisa aseShowe ebe esekubhaceni, ewasabisa ngokuthi uzowaphambanisa nemvula uma eke azama ukuzombopha. Ngesikhathi limgweba iJaji uNokgere Masipa, lithe likuqaphele ukuthi uSikhakhane uwaphikile amacala amathathu okubulala namathathu okuzama ukubulala, wavuma kuphela elokutholakala nesibhamu esingekho emthethweni. UMasipa uphinde wathi ukuqaphele ukuthi uSikhakhane akazange akukhombise ukuzisola. "Ukuphika amacala bese ethi uzwelana nomndeni wakwaMkhize, akukhona ukuzisola lokho. Ummangalelwa akakaze nhlobo akukhombise ukuzisola,” kusho uMasipa. Ugcizelele eyokuthi wayeqondile ukwenza lawa macala, wakhombisa isihluku waphinde wahluleka wancama ukuthi anikeze incazelo ezwakalayo ngezenzo zakhe. "Ngesikhathi isibhamu sesiphelelwe yizinhlamvu, waphinde wasilayisha ezinye, waqhubeka wadubula,” kusho uMasipa.Uthe izimo zikaSikhakhane, okungokokuqala enza icala, ongubaba ezinganeni ezintathu, zingelinganiswe nesisindo secala alenza. Inkantolo yezwa ubufakazi balabo abasinda esigamekweni, abathi namanje sisabuya sinjengoba sinjalo isehlalo emiqondweni yabo, baveza nokuthi badonsa kanzima ukuzinakekela ngenxa yokulimala. Ngaphezu kodilikajele abathathu, uMasipa uphinde wamnika iminyaka engu-20 icala ngalinye kwamathathu okuzama ukubulala abasinda, waphinde wanikwa iminyaka engu-15 yokutholwa nesibhamu esingekho emthethweni, kwase kuba emihlanu yokutholakala nezinhlamvu. Uthe izigwebo zakhe uzozidonsa kanyekanye, wase enquma ukuthi akumfanele ukuphinde abe nesibhamu. Emva kwesigwebo, u-Advocate Phumelele Daniso ongummeli kammangalelwa wakwaLegal Aid South Africa, utshele inkantolo ukuthi Sikhakhane uhlela ukusiphonsela inselelo isinqumo senkantolo. Uthe isicelo sakhe sihlelelwe ukuthi silalelwe ngesonto elizayo.

Inenjini kaphethroli engu-1.5 litre engu-four cylinder edume ezimotweni eziningi zakwaSuzuki i-K15C. Isebenza ngebhethri engu-12V bese ikhipha amandla angu-76kW ne-torque engu-139Nm. U-gearbox uyi-5 speed manual okanye i-6 speed automatic. Ngenxa yokuthi isukile egadeni iwuhlobo lwemoto ekulungele ukuhamba ezindaweni ezakhele amadolobha kanjalo nakwezasemakhaya ezinjengakoLoskop, Nkandla, Bulwer, Mzimkhulu, naseBergville. Ingaphakathi le-GL AT, ethwala abantu abahlanu, linezihlalo ezigqize ngombala ompunga nomnyama. Ngaphambili kune-touchscreen infotainment engu-10.1 inch lapho uxhuma khona iselula nge-Apple CarPlay/Android Auto ngaphandle kwentambo. Emuva nangaphambili kunezimbobo ezimbili zokushaja ezifaka i-USB Type C.Ine-instrument cluster engu-10.2 ekwenza ubona kalula ukuthi awuyidlisi yini amagalane. Amabhathini amise okwawe-piano akhona ukulawula umoya obandayo noshisayo. Inezipikha ze-Infinity ezenza kube lula ukulalela izindaba noma umculo ozokwenza ungayizwa indlela. Kwezokuphepha igabe ngama-airbag ayisithupha kanti inekhamera ekubonisa ngqo lapho uhlehlela khona, ibe nama-sensor okugwema ukuthi ungayiklwebhi uma upaka. Inamabhuleki abamba athule du entabeni. Ine-cruise control, ABS, EBD ne-Electronic Stability Programme. Ibhuthi yeGL ivuleke kahle ngoba ayinaso isipikha esikhulu njengeGLX. Iphuma inesipele esingesiwona umncanyana. Irimu laso lingu-17 inch njengamasondo onke. Isinqe sayo esiyisishwapha sibhince amalambu e-SUV kanti nangaphambili ifolose ngawo. Ibhuthi iwu-347 litres.Osekubhekiwe wukuthi i-Across elame iGrand Vitara kuma-SUV izokwazi yini ukuba nogazi njengeSuzuki Swift esiphenduke intandokazi kwabaningi kuleli.I-SUZUKI GLX EFIKA NOKUNINGI KWEQOPHELO: Ngendlela eyakhiwe ngayo ngaphambili nangemuva iyakhombisa ukuthi yathintwa yizincushe, hhayi izimfundamakhwela ezithatha izindlela ezinqamulelayo. Lokhu kuyizinkomba zokuthi le nkampani yaseJapan, ebigubha iminyaka engu-100 ngo-2020 yasungulwa, ayizile eMzansi ukuzosinisa amahleza. Iphephile inama-airbag ayisithupha nezinsiza zokuphepha zesimanjemanje, okuyi-electronic stability control. Ayihlehli uma usuka endaweni enyukelayo. Igqize ngamakhamera angu-360 degrees, okuchaza ukuthi akhona ngemuva nangaphambili nangaphansi kwezibuko ukuze akubonise zonke izinhlangothi. Iyakusiza ukuthi ubone imoto esondela eduze kwakho. Ine-Adaptive cruise control ne-Automatic Emergency Braking ekusiza ukuthi ugweme ingozi. Iyakutshela uma usuya kumakhamera athwebula isivinini ohamba ngaso. Inamalambu eLED asiza uma kunenkungu. Ibhuthi yeGLX incane kuneyeGL ngenxa yokuthi ifakwe isipikha se-Infinity. Uma uthwele umthwalo awudingi ukuthi usebenzise ukhiye uma uvula ibhuthi umane udlalise unyawo ngaphansi ivuleke. Inezihlalo zesikhumba ezinezimbobo zokuphefumula kanti esomshayeli sisebenza ngogesi. Iyakutshela uma usuphuma emzileni.Inama-LED daytime running lights, amarimu ahlukile kunaweGL angu-17 inch bese iba ne-panoramic sunroof.Injini iyafana neyeGL umehluko wukuthi u-gearbox uyi-6 speed automatic kuphela.Intengo:Suzuki Across 1.5 Mild-Hybrid GL 5MT: R349,900Suzuki Across 1.5 Mild-Hybrid GL 6AT: R372,900Suzuki Across 1.5 Mild-Hybrid GLX 6AT: R464,900Ifika ne-service plan yeminyaka emine noma u-60 000km ne-warrantly yeminyaka emihlanu noma u-200 000km.

I-MKP ihlela ukubuyisa izinduku kwi-ANC, echayise isicelo sayo sezingxoxo ngokuphathwa kohulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal, njengoba ihlela ukukhiphela isibhongo kwi-ANC kuhulumeni waseGauteng.UNobhala Jikelele weMKP, uMnuz Sibonelo Nomvalo, uthe banqume ukungakuseki ukuphasiswa kwesabelomali saseGauteng ngenxa yokuthi i-ANC inqaba ukubambisana nabo KwaZulu-Natal.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba, izolo. I-MKP isembhidlangweni wokuketula uhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal oholwa i-IFP. I-ANC iyingxenye yohulumeni wokubambisana KwaZulu-Natal. EGauteng khona i-ANC ayinazo izihlalo ezanele ukubusa ngokuzimela, ithembela ekwesekweni yi-MKP ne-EFF uma idinga ukuphasisa isabelomali. UNomvalo uthe uNobhala Jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, wachayisa isicelo sabo somhlangano. UNomvalo uthe i-ANC izozibonela ukuthi izosiphasisa kanjani isabelomali sakulo nyaka saseGauteng."Sonke siyazi ukuthi iMKP iyona eyahamba phambili ngamavoti KwaZulu-Natal. Sanquma ukuyidedela i-ANC ukuba ibuse lapha eGauteng ngenxa yokuthi sasimethemba uPanyaza (uNdunankulu waseGauteng, uLesufi). Siyazi ukuthi yena akabesabi abelungu. Ngenxa yokungazi lutho kukaMbalula, wanquma ukuziba incwadi yethu. Akazange ayiphendule incwadi esambhalela yona. Ingakho sinqume ukuthi siphikisane nokuphasiswa kwesabelomali saseGauteng."Uthe bayazwelana noLesufi ofela izono zabazali."Yena wanqaba ukusebenzisana ne-DA kuhulumeni wakhe. Bazozibonela ukuthi basiphasisa kanjani isabelomali. Asikwazi ukusiza i-ANC eGauteng ekubeni yona ingafuni ukusisiza KwaZulu-Natal."UNomvalo uthe isenzo sikaMbalula sikhombise ukuthi unenzondo neMKP."Ngesikhathi kunezingxoxo zokubusa ngokubambisana, waxoxa ngisho namaqembu abulala abantu abamnyama ngesikhathi sobandlululo. Yini eyenza ukuthi angafuni ukukhuluma nathi, siyiqembu elilwela abantu abamnyama?" UNomvalo uthe ziyaqhubeka izingxoxo zokubusa ngokubambisana KwaZulu-Natal. I-MKP inezihlalo ezingu-37 kwezingu-80 esiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal.I-MKP yesekwa i-EFF enezihlalo ezimbili. Iphinde futhi yesekwe abaholi beqembu elingababeki benkosi kuhulumeni wesifundazwe, i-NFP, enesihlalo esisodwa. Kepha ilungu leNFP esiShayamthetho, uNksz Mbali Shinga, lona livota namaqembu abusa nokubambisana yize ubuholi beqembu kuzwelonke bamemezela ukuhoxa kuhulumeni wesifundazwe. UNksz Shinga uyaqhubeka nokuqhoqhobala isikhundla sokuba uMphathiswa wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi. Ubuholi beqembu bamyalela ukuthi ehle kulesi sikhundla ngonyaka owedlule.UNksz Shinga usanda kubhekana nekomiti eliqondisa ubugwegwe ngenxa yokuthi washaya indiva umyalelo wokuthi aseke isiphakamiso seMKP sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNtuli. Asikaphumi isinqumo sekomiti ebeliqondisa uNksz Shinga ubugwegwe.
KUYALWE amadoda nezinsizwa ezisakhula ngobuqotho nokuvikela abesifazane nezingane, emcimbini obuhlelwe yinhlalisuthi (izinsizwa zebandla lamaNazaretha eBuhleni), egida ezigcawini zeNjobo, KwesaKwaMthethwa. Le ndumezulu yomcimbi obuhanjelwe nayiMeya kaMasipala waseMfolozi, uMnuz Xolani Bhengu, beyisezinkundleni zemidlalo eMfaniso, KwesaKwaMthethwa, eMpangeni muva nje. Lo mcimbi obekungowokuqala ngqa, ubuhambisana nokahulumeni ogqugquzela amadoda ukuthi abe qotho, avikele abesifazane nezingane.Ekhuluma uMfundisi Thokozani Gumede waseMseni, eNkandla, obemenywe ngokukhethekile njengomsinisi weNjobo, uthe into ebalulekile uma izinsizwa zihlangene, kusuke kuyithuba elihle lokuba zigqugquzelwe ukuthi ziphathe imizi ngothando, ngokuthula nangenhlonipho. Uthe lokho kwenza nomsebenzi kahulumeni ube lula uma abantu bekwazi ukuhlalisana ngokuthula. Uthe izinsizwa ezingakaganwa ziyakhuthazwa ukuba zilobole ziganwe. UBhengu uthe kuyajabulisa ukubona amadoda ehlangene ngento enhle njengokugqugquzelana ukuthi avikele abesifazane, nezingane, kwazise sezaba yinsakavukela umchilo wesidwaba izigameko zokubulawa kwabesifazane, ikakhulu abasebancane kumasipala awuphethe. Uthembise ukulekelela izinsizwa ngokuzithengela izimbomu, izigubhu nokunye okulekelela uma kugidwa. "NaseBhayibhelini kulotshiwe ukuthi uNkulunkulu udunyiswa ngezigubhu, namacilongo, ngakho lokhu enikwenzayo kuyikho," kusho uBhengu. Umcimbi bewuzinyaziswe yizinduna zeNkosi yakwaMthethwa. Kubagcotshwa, kubalwa uMfundisi uMthiyane ophethe amabandla KwesaKwaMthethwa, uMvangeli uMdletshe waseBongani, uMvangeli uMkhize waseSikhaleni, eSibusisweni, abashumayeli abaningi bamathempeli, aKwesaKwaMthethwa, nezivakashi ebeziqhamuka eMtubatuba naseThekwini.
IZIGIDI zamarandi ezabelwe ukulungisa umonakalo odalwe yizikhukhula KwaZulu-Natal, zibuyele emuva ngenxa yokwehluleka komasipala ukuyisebenzisa. UMnyango wezeziMali kuzwelonke uveze ukuthi omasipala abahlanu, bahlulekile ukusebenzisa ngendlela imali eyabelwe ukulungisa umonakalo odalwe yizikhukhula.Isikhulu esibhekelele ukuqapha ukusebenzisa kwemali komasipala, uMnuz Sello Mashaba, sithe abanye omasipala bavele banquma ukugcina ezinye izidingo zabo ngale mali yokulungisa umonakalo odalwe izikhukhula.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi uMnyango uvele phambi kwekomiti lasesiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal. Ubephendula umbuzo welungu leMKP, uMnuz Sibongiseni Majola, elibuze ukuthi uMnyango unazo yini izinhlelo zokuqapha ukuthi imali eyabelwe omasipala isebenza ezinhlelweni ezifanele noma bagcina sebenza ezinye izidingo ngale mali?Kule minyaka eyedlule izikhukhula zihlasele kulandelana esifundazweni. Izikhukhula ezangadla kwezwela zahlasela ngo-2022, kwabuye kwalandela ezinye.UMashaba uveze ukuthi umasipala okhungethwe izinkinga, iMpendle, iwona obaphathise ngekhanda. Uthe lo masipala wabelwa u-R45 million kunyaka wezimali ka-2023/2024, waphinde wabelwa u-R15 million kunyaka wezimali ka-2024/2025."Bahluleka ukusebenzisa u-R45 million waleyo mali. Ngesikhathi becela ukuthi bavunyelwe ukuthi bangaphucwa imali, sathola ukuthi le mali ayikho kwi-akhawunti yasebhange yomkhandlu. Kungenzeka ukuthi leyo mali yabhubhudlwa noma umasipala wayisebenzisa ezintweni ezingahlangene nokulungisa umonakalo odalwe izikhukhula. Ngalokho umnyango wanquma ukuchitha isicelo somkhandlu sokuba ungaphucwa imali, wakhipha umyalelo wokuba ibuye yonke imali." UMasipala waseMpendle ubhekene nenkinga yemali osekuze kwaholela ekutheni uhluleke ukuholela abasebenzi. Wahluleka ukuholela abasebenzi ngesikhathi ngoDisemba nangoJanuwari, kuze kube manje abasebenzi abakaze bayithole imiholo yangenyanga edlule.UMashaba uthe njengamanje kuno-R38 million izikhulu zomkhandlu waseMpendle, ezihlulekayo ukuchaza ukuthi ushonephi."Lena kwakungeyona kuphela imali yokulungisa umonakalo odalwe izikhukhula kodwa kwakukhona nezinye izibonelelo ezinemibandela. Sinqume ukuthi umasipala ubuyise ingxenye yale mali ngoba asifuni ukuthi umasipala usale ungenalutho." Uthe abanye omasipala ababuyise imali iMpofana, Jozini, neNkosi Mtubatuba. Uveze ukuthi uMasipala waseThekwini nawo wahluleka ukusebenzisa u-R1.5 billion wokulungisa umonakalo odalwe izikhukhula ngonyaka wezimali ka-2022/2023.UMashaba uthe iTheku alizange liphucwe le mali ngenxa yokuthi lenza isicelo sokuthi lingaphucwa.
ADWEBE umugqa obomvu amaphoyisa izolo, athi akukho muntu ozoya eSouth Beach (Phoyinti), ekhalima ababhikishi be-March and March, abebefuna ukuya khona njengoba kugcwele abantu bokufika.Lokhu kuze emva kokuthi epopole ingozi yokuthi singahle singakwazi ukulawuleka isimo uma ababhikishi, abalwa neyabantu bokufika abakuleli ngokungemthetho, beya kuleya ndawo, esithathwa njengo-alubhadwa oyisizinda sabokufika eThekwini.Umsunguli we-March and March, ebiqeda unyaka yasungulwa izolo, uNkk Jacinta Ngobese-Zuma, uthe kabagculisekile ngokwenzekile. Uthe abakubonayo ukuthi izikhulu zikahulumeni kanjalo namaphoyisa bacabanga ukuthi bayazidlalela bona njengoba bebhikisha nje. "Angiboni ukuthi le nto esikhala ngayo bayayibona. Uma beyibona, banakho ukuthi vele ekugcineni kosuku, sizothobela umthetho wabo," kusho uNkk Ngobese-Zuma.Usole izikhulu zikahulumeni ngokungaphumeleli kwesifiso sabo sokuthi imashi yabo ihambe ngasePhoyinti, wathi zazibathembisile ezingxoxweni ukuthi uma bengayi kule ndawo, kuzofika uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa esifundazweni, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi azokhuluma nabo, asho ukuthi yini ezokwenziwa ngenkinga yabokufika abakuleli ngokungemthetho?"Sabanika imizila emine, yonke eyayizodlula ePhoyinti. Sasinesizathu salokho. Izidakamizwa zigcwele laphaya, ukudayiswa komzimba kubuzwa laphaya, abokufika abangene ngokungemthetho kuleli, bagcwele khona, ngisho nalabo abadelelayo bakhona," kusho uNkk Ngobese-Zuma.Uthe ngisho nezibhedlela kanjalo nezikole okuvela ukuthi zigcwele abokufika, zikuleya ndawo. "Ngesikhathi sikhuluma nabo, sasikubeke kwacaca ukuthi sifuna ukudlula laphaya. Kunezakhiwo ezikuleya ndawo ezithathwe yibo ngodli. Besifuna ukudlula ngakhona, sibakhumbuze ukuthi yizwe lethu leli," usho kanje.Uthe bayafisa ukwazi ukuthi yini le engaka evikelwa amaphoyisa kuleya ndawo? Uqhube wathi kubajabhisile ukuthi uMkhwanazi angabonwa, wakhala nangokuthi ngisho neMeya yedolobha, uMnuz Cyril Xaba, ibingabonwa. Umsunguli we-ActionSA, uMnuz Herman Mashaba, uthe indaba yabokufika abakuleli ngokungemthetho isinesikhathi ilimaza elakuleli, wathi okwenziwa yi-March and March kanjalo nezinye izinhlaka zomphakathi bakushayela elikhulu ihlombe. "Kwanele! Sanele! Abantu bethu bayahlupheka. Sinabethu abantu ababalelwa ku-12 million abangasebenzi, intsha yethu icekelwa phansi yizigebengu eziseqophelweni eliphezulu zokufika, ezabona ithuba lokwenza izwe lethu indawo yokudlalela," kusho uMashaba.Isishoshovu sokugcinwa kwezinto eziphathelene nesintu, uPhakelumthakathi, sithe bazokhumbuza uhulumeni ukuthi izakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika yizona izingane zakhe, hhayi abokufika."Sizolokhu simkhumbuze njalo. Yithi okufanele asinakekele kakhulu kunabantu bokufika," kusho uPhakel'umthakathi. Uthe kuletha elikhulu ithemba ukwanda kwabantu emibhikishweni ye-March and March, wathi nokusabalala kwayo ezindaweni ezehlukene, kushunyayelwa ivangeli elilodwa, kukhomba ukuthi iyogcina inqotshiwe eyabokufika. "Uhulumeni akasasilaleli ngoba sebebaningi kakhulu abantu bokufika. Siyabona ukuthi usecabanga ukuthi sebengamvotela, aphathe, kanti akazi ukuthi njengoba kade ephethe yonke le minyaka, ngeke esaphatha ngoba abantu sebebonile ukuthi akanendaba nabantu," usho kanje.Enza isibonelo sokuthi kubukeka uhulumeni elwa nabakuleli, uthe njengoba bebhikisha, kukhishwe inqwaba yamaphoyisa ukuthi izobagada, ekubeni ababoni kukhishwa isibalo esifanayo ukuyokhuculula yonke inhlobo yobugebengu athe benzeka ePhoyinti. "Abokufika badayisa izidakamizwa la, bashushumbisa abantu, beba izingane kodwa abenziwa lutho," kusho uPhakel'umthakathi, othe yizo zonke izinto abafuna ukuzivimba lezo.Uphinde wakhala ngabesifazane bakuleli, ababize ngodadewabo, wathi bashade nabantu abangabazi. "Silungisa lezo zinto ke. Sogcina siyinqobile. Uzophuma lo hulumeni okhona kungene abantu abazokhethwa umphakathi," kusho uPhakel'umthakathi, othe into ethi muntu wokufika, izohamba kuleli.

KWEMBULWE izipoki ezibhubhudla imali esikhwameni esixhasa izitshudeni ngemali yokufunda ezikhungweni zemfundo, i-National Students' Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS), ekubeni kuvela ukuthi sezafa.Lezi zipoki zivundululwe embikweni kaMcwaningi Mabhuku Jikelele, oveze ukuthi zingu-822 izipoki okutholakale ukuthi ziyahlomula kulesi sikhwama, ekubeni ulwazi lwaseMnyangweni wezaseKhaya, luveza ukuthi zendela koyisemkhulu.UNgqongqoshe weMfundo ePhakeme, uMnuz Buti Manamela, useyalele abalesi sikhwama ukuthi baqale uphenyo. Uthe kumele basebenzisane nophiko oluphenya amacala enkohlakalo, i-SIU ukuze kutholakale abenza lo mkhonyovu."Umbiko uveza ukuthi lezi zipoki ziyaqhubeka nokuxhaswa yi-NSFAS ekubeni zingaphili ngokoMnyango wezaseKhaya. Asifuni ngomuso kube nento efuze le yingakho kumele kuphenywe."Uthe lo mbiko ubuye waveza ukuthi kunezitshudeni ezevile ku-14 000, ezihlomula oxhasweni ngendlela engafanele. "Imindeni yalezi zitshudeni ihola imali engaphezu kwebekiwe ukuze uxhaswe. Kodwa nazo ziyaqhubeka nokuhlomula ngendlela engafanele."Uthe kuphinde kwatholwa nezitshudeni ezingu-321, ezihlomulayo ekubeni zihlomula nasesibonelelweni sabangasebenzi kuleli, esingu-R370 ngenyanga."Konke lokhu uhlelo lwe-NSFAS luhlulekile ukukubika ukuthi kunezitshudeni ezithola uxhaso kungafanele. Okunye kunabaxhasiwe ekubeni bafeyila, ekubeni umgomo we-NSFAS uthi uma ufeyila uphucwa uxhaso." Uthe imali ye-NSFAS ihlinzekwa abadonsa kanzima, hhayi uwonke wonke ongamele ayithole."Sifuna ukuqeda nya ngenkohlakalo nokudliwa kungafanele kwemali yabakhokhi bentela kuleli. Sethemba ukuthi uphenyo luzothola yonke into, sazi ukuthi ubani owenzeni." Uthe asikho isitshudeni esixhaswe ngendlela efanele okumele sitatazele ngenxa yalolu phenyo. Uqhube wathi bafuna ukubamba labo abaqamba amanga, abaletha ulwazi olungelona ngesikhathi befaka izicelo zoxhaso.
