NgoLwesibili kuboshwe abantu abangu-16 abasolwa ngokuba nesandla ekukhishweni kwale thenda. Abangu-12 babo bangamaphoyisa, baboshwe noMatlala. Abasolwa bavele kafushane eNkantolo yeMantshi ePitoli izolo lapho bededelwe ngebheyili. UMatlala yena akazange asifake isicelo sebheyili ngenxa yokuthi uboshelwe amanye amacala.Khonamanjalo, obhekene necala lokubulala ufakazi owethula ubufakazi phambi kwekhomishini kaMadlanga, uMnuz Matipandile Sotheni, uvele kafushane eNkantolo yeMantshi eBrakpan lapho ebhekene khona necala lokubulala uMnuz Marius Van Der Merwe. USotheni ucele ukuzikhulumela enkantolo, waveza ukuthi akamazi ummeli wakhe."Ngiqala ngisho ukumbona lo muntu futhi akakaze akhulume nami."USotheni uthe uboshelwa icala angalazi, icala lakhe lihlehliselwe uMeyi 14.
IMGIXABEZE ngodilikajele oneminyaka elengisiwe iNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini, owesilisa oneminyaka engu-21, kulandela ukulahlwa yicala lokubulala umshayeli wemoto ekhokhelwa ngebanga elihambile.ULuyanda Innocent Shozi ulahlwe yicala lokubulala uMnuz Zwakushiwo Dennis Zondi ngoDisemba 26, 2024, isidumbu sakhe esatholwa sishe sangqongqa. UShozi ugcine ewavuma wonke amacala abebekwe wona, okukhona kuwo elokubulala, elokuthumba nelokubamba inkunzi ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima. Encwadini yakhe efungelwe abevuma kuyo amacala, uShozi uthe walibamba iqhaza ekubulaleni uZondi. Ube eseveza ukuthi icala walenza noSiyabonga Xolani Mkhize, Ayanda Zulu, Lindani Shezi, Andile Mbhele, namawele o-Asande noWandile Shange.Utshele inkantolo ukuthi ngosuku lwesigameko, wayephuza utshwala noZulu, uMbhele, nabesifazane ababili (oMandisa noNonhlanhla), izibongo zabo ezingadalulwanga. Uveze ukuthi ngesikhathi utshwala sebuphelile, uZulu watshela uMbhele ukuthi uthole ucingo kumuntu owathi ufuna amhlanganisele imoto ehlala abantu abayisikhombisa (7seater).Uthe wab0e esemtshela ukuthi uzombiza ukuze alandwe yimoto ekhokhelwa ngebanga elihambile kaZondi, ayeke wayisebenzisa ngaphambilini. Kuthiwa ngesikhathi umufi esendleleni esuka KwaDabeka eze kubo, laba abesilisa abathathu baxoxa ngetulo labo lokuduna le moto. Uthe kwathi uma umufi efika, abagibeli bazihlela ngendlela ababezogibela ngayo, uZulu wahlala ngemuva komshayeli, uShozi wahlala esihlalweni esingemuva ngasohlangothini lomgibeli, uMbhele wahlala ngaphambili, kwathi abesifazane bahlala ngemuva kwabo.Ngesikhathi imoto isibheke e-Oakland, eMariannhill, uZondi wahlangabezana nomgwaqo ophelayo. UShozi uthe wabe esehla, engumuntu owayeyothatha imali kumuntu kaMbhele, okwaba wumzamo ongaphumelelanga.Kuthiwa kwathi esebuyile, uZondi esethi udumisa imoto, kwaqala lapho ukuhlaselwa kwakhe. Kuvela ukuthi uMbhele wagxavuna uZondi ngezandla, okwenza ukuthi uZulu akwazi ukumklinya kalula, kwaze kwaba uyaquleka. Kuvele ukuthi bobathathu babe sebebambisana uZondi, bambeka phansi ngemuva kwesihlalo somshayeli. Uvume eyokuthi wamcindezela ngezinyawo zombili uZondi emqaleni nasebusweni, emncisha umoya."UMbhele wayemcindezela naye umufi emzimbeni, esebenzisa izinyawo, kwaze kwaba ukuthi uyafa,” kuchaza uShozi. Uthe uMandisa noNonhlanhla bazama ukubaleka kodwa uZulu wabaphoqa ukuthi bahlale. Uthe emva kokuba esemklinyile umufi, uZulu wabe esephenduka umshayeli wemoto okwathi uma uMbhele embuza ukuthi kuyiwaphi, wathi baya eWaterloo, lapho azi khona abantu abazomlekelela alahle isidumbu.Uveze ukuthi uZulu wabe esebeka umbono wokuthi sishiswe isidumbu. Kuthiwa eWaterloo, uZulu wangena komunye umuzi, wabuya namawele akwaShange abajoyina, abayalela ihlathi lapho isidumbu esasizolahlwa khona, sishiswe.UShozi uveze ukuthi ngaleso sikhathi yena wasala emotweni. Kwathi sesishisiwe isidumbu, bahambisa uMandisa noNonhlanhla, ngaphambi kokuba baye endlini kaXolani Mkhize, lapho abafike bathenga khona utshwala, kwaphuzwa. Uvume ukuthi imoto, iToyota Rumion yapakwa eduze kwendlu kaMkhize, lapho amaphoyisa agcina eyithola khona."Ngiyavuma ukuthi ngabona ukuthi ukumcindezela kwami umufi ebusweni nasentanyeni ngisebenzisa zombili izinyawo, kwakuzoholela ekutheni ashone. Yize kunjalo ngaqhubeka nakho, ngambulala. Anginakho engingazithethelela ngakho esenzweni sami,” kusho uShozi. UShozi wayesebenza njengomuntu opakisha izimpahla, ehola u-R1 000 ngamasonto amabili. Kuvele ukuthi ungubaba ezinganeni ezimbili kanti uzoma njengofakazi woMbuso uma sekuqulwa icala elifanayo kuZulu noMkhize, abakhethe ukungalivumi icala. UShozi ugixabezwe ngeminyaka engu-15 ecaleni lokubamba inkunzi, eyisihlanu lokuthumba, kwase kuba engu-25 kwelokubulala. Eminyakeni engu-25 ayinikwe ngecala lokubulala, iJaji uRithy Singh, lithe lizomlengisela emithathu, lamdonsa ngendlebe ukuthi kufanele kuphele iminyaka emihlanu engatholwa ezibandakanya ezenzweni zodlame. Uthe izigwebo zakhe uzozidonsa kanye kanye. UShezi, uMbhele namawele akwaShange sebawavuma amacala, bagwetshwa. Nabo bazophenduka ofakazi boMbuso.
UMNYANGO wezokuHlunyeleliswa kweziMilo uchitha imali engaphezu kuka-R11 million ngosuku, ukuphakela iziboshwa zasemazweni angaphandle ezigcinwe emajele akuleli.UNgqongqoshe woMnyango, uDkt Pieter Groenewald, ufuna kuchibiyelwe umthetho ukuze iziboshwa zangaphandle zizobuyiselwa emazweni azo. Ukusho lokhu kwi-video ayifake ezinkundleni zokuxhumana.UGroenewald uthe kunenqwaba yeziboshwa zasemazweni angaphandle ezigcwele emajele akuleli. "Sineziboshwa ezibalelwa ku-26 000. Kulezi ziboshwa kubalwa neziboshwa esezigwetshiwe nalezo ezisalinde ukuqula amacala."UGroenewald uthe uMnyango usebenzisa izigidi zamarandi uphakela iziboshwa zakwamanye amazwe ezigqunywe emajele akuleli. "Abakhokhi bentela bakhokha u-R463 ukuphakela isiboshwa esisodwa ngosuku. Kubiza ngaphezu kuka-R11 million ngosuku ukuphakela iziboshwa eziqhamuka emazweni angaphandle." UGroenewald uthe ukuba kuya ngaye ngabe lezi ziboshwa zibuyiselwa emazweni akubo ziyoboshwa khona. Ukhale ngokuthi kunemithetho eyenza kungabilula ukuthi uMnyango ubuyisele iziboshwa zokufika emazweni azo.Uthe: "Kukhona imithetho esivimbayo ukuthi sikwazi ukubuyisela iziboshwa emazweni azo kodwa ke ngifuna ukuthi kuchibiyelwe umthetho. Kukhona uhlelo engiluqalile ngethemba lokuthi kothi kushaya unyaka ozayo kube sekunenqubekela phambili. Ngifuna babuyele emazweni abo."Inkulumo kaGroenewald ifika nje, kuvele kunesikhalazo esidala sokugcwala ngokweqile kwamajele akuleli. Impendulo kaGroenewald yasePhalamende yaveza ukuthi amajele akuleli agcwele ngokweqile. Le mpendulo yangoFebhuwari, yaveza ukuthi iziboshwa ezisemajele akuleli zingaphezulu ngo-50% wesibalo.Impendulo iveza ukuthi kuneziboshwa ezingu-168 672 esikhundleni seziboshwa ezingu-107 000. Lapha KwaZulu-Natal, kuneziboshwa ezingu-26 723 esikhundleni sezingu-17 854.Izifundazwe okugcwele kakhulu emajele kuzo i-Eastern Cape, Western Cape neGauteng. E-Eastern Cape kugcwele ngokweqile ngo-83%, eWestern Cape kugcwele ngokweqile ngo-71%, kanti eGauteng khona kugcwele ngokweqile ngo-70%.Kuphinde kube nesikhalazo ngokugcwala kakhulu kwabantu bokufika abakuleli ngokungemthetho. Miningi imikhankaso eqhubekayo evimba abokufika abakuleli ngokungemthetho ezikoleni, emtholampilo nasezindaweni zokusebenza.
UNDUNANKULU waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, uhole umkhankaso wokukhuza isihlava sokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane izolo eDundee, esifundeni uMzinyathi.
ANGEKE usaba khona umgubho omkhulu we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, obuzohanjelwa nguMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa wale nhlangano.Umcimbi we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal wokugubha usuku okwasungulwa ngalo inhlangano uhoxisiwe. Lesi simemezelo senziwe okhulumela i-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Fanle Sibisi, othe bahoxise umcimbi ngenxa yokuthi bafuna ukugxila emalungiselelweni okhetho lohulumeni basekhaya oluzayo.Umcimbi kwakufanele ube ngasekuqaleni kwenyanga kodwa wabuye wahlehliswa ngenxa yokuthi uRamaphosa wayeya emngcwabeni womfundisi waseMelika, uJesse Jackson. Bese kuhlelwe ukuthi umcimbi ube kule mpelasonto, eThekwini. USibisi uthe banqume ukuwuhoxisa umcimbi ngenxa yokuthi bafuna ukugxila ekulungiseleleni ukhetho."Ngenxa yokuthi i-Independent Electoral Commission imemezele ukuthi kuzokuba kubhaliselwa ukuvota ngo-Juni 20 kuya ku-21, sinqume ukusebenzisa lesi sikhathi ukuzihlela kahle emagatsheni, ukuze akwazi ukunxenxa abantu ukuthi babhalisele ukhetho."I-ANC kulindeleke ukuthi iqale ngenyanga ezayo imihlangano yokuqoka abazoyimela okhethweni lohulumeni basekhaya. UNobhala Jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, ukhiphe umyalelo wokuthi zonke izingqungquthela zokukhetha ubuholi zibanjwe kule nyanga, bese kuqala amalungiselelo okhetho lohulumeni basekhaya ngenyanga ezayo.KwaZulu-Natal bekufanele kube nengqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi besifundazwe nobezifunda. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma lezi zingqungquthela zigeje kule nyanga, seziyoze zibanjwe emva kokhetho.Khonamanjalo: UMbalula umemezele ukuthi izoqhubeka ingqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi be-ANC e-Eastern Cape, ezoba ngempelasonto.Kunamalungu e-ANC afake isicelo sokuba kumiswe ingqungquthela enkantolo, ekhala ngokungalandelwa kwemigomo kepha uMbalula uthe ingqungquthela izoqhubeka kumnyama kubomvu. "Ukuthi kunezikhalazo akusho ukuthi ingqungquthela ngeke iqhubeke. La bantu abakhulumayo nje bacasulwa ukuthi bahluliwe ingakho sebegijimela enkantolo. I-tsunami kuphela engavimba le ngqungquthela. Siyaphikisana nalesi sicelo esifakwe enkantolo. Ingqungquthela izoqhubeka njengoba kuhleliwe."Uthe: "Siyijwayele le nto. Uma kuzokuba nezingqungquthela kuhlezi kukhona abantu abagijimela ezinkantolo. I-ANC inezinhlaka zangaphakathi lapho abantu bekwazi khona ukudlulisa izikhalazo zabo. Kukhona abantu abafuna izikhundla. Asiphikisani nalokho kodwa phela abantu kufanele balandele imithetho. Abantu akufanele bathuswe umbango wezikhundla. Lena into eyejwayelekile."UMbalula uthe uSihlalo we-ANC kuzwelonke, uMnuz Gwede Mantashe, uzokwethula inkulumo yokuvula ingqungquthela. Umbango wokuhola i-ANC e-Eastern Cape uphakathi kukaSihlalo, uMnuz Oscar Mabuyane noNobhala uMnuz Lulama Ngcukayitobi. Abeseka uNgcukayitobi kuthiwa bafuna imiswe ingqungquthela.
KUYALWE abesilisa ukuthi bayeke ukuhambela kude nokuyohlolwa isifo sofuba iTB njengoba kuyibo abancane kwabahlolwayo.Leli khwelo lihlatshwe yiPhini likaMengameli wezwe uMnuz Paul Mashatile izolo, kugujwa usuku lweTB emhlabeni, eWestern Cape. Uthe lesi sifo siyalapheka kodwa sisabhubhisa inqwaba yabantu kuleli, nasemhlabeni jikelele."Sihlaba ikhwelo kwabesilisa ukuthi bahlolwe lesi sifo ngoba yibona abahambela kude nokuhlolwa. Ezinyangeni ezingu-11 ezedlule, izibalo zikhomba ukuthi bambalwa abesilisa abahlolwa lesi sifo ekubeni kuyibo esibahaqe kakhulu. Sinxusa nalabo asebedla imishanguzo yaso ukuthi bangayiyeki, kodwa bayidle baze bayiqede," usho kanje. Uthe lesi sifo sigadla kakhulu kwabahaqwe yiHIV/AIDS. Uveze nokuthi u-3.5 million wabantu abahlolwe lesi sifo selokhu kuqale umkhankaso wokuhlola nyakenye."Sifuna ukukhulisa isibalo sabantu abahlolwa leli gciwane ukuze silwe nokubhebhetheka kwalo. Kunenhlansi yethemba ngokuthi sizoyinqoba impi yalesi sifo. Yisibalo esikhulu esake saba naso ngonyaka sabantu abahlolwa iTB kuleli." Uthe abantu asebeke bahlangana nomuntu one-TB kumele bayohlolwa ukuze kutholakale ukuthi abathelelekanga ngaso. UNgqongqoshe wezeMpilo kuleli, uDkt Aaron Motsoaledi, uthe umkhankaso owathulwa nyakenye owokuhlola abantu abangu-5 million ngonyaka kulesi sifo. Uthe abantu bacabanga ukuthi lesi sifo sihambisana nesifuba kuphela kanti akunjalo."Sihlala noma yikuphi emzimbeni. Singahlala esibelethweni sowesifazane, nakwezinye izindawo emzimbeni," usho kanje.
KUNTWELA ezansi ngezikhalazo zabasebenzi bakahulumeni abafuna ukuvunyelwa ukuthi bajoyine noma iyiphi i-medical aid kuleli, bangaphoqwa ukuba yingxenye yeGovernment Employees Medical Scheme (GEMS) kuphela ukuze baxhaswe.Isikhalazo sabo sizobhungwa ezingeni likahulumeni, njengoba abaholi bezinyunyana zabasebenzi bekhalaze kwiPhini likaMengameli wezwe, uMnuz Paul Mashatile izolo, ngokubiza kuka-GEMS, ngesikhathi evula umhlangano weNational Economic Development and Labour Council (NEDLAC), ePitoli. Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi izinyunyana zamashela i-GEMS, zikhala ngokunyuswa kwemali ngo-9.5% kulo nyaka. Izinyunyana zifuna kwehliswe imali, kubuyekezwe kabusha ibhodi le-GEMS kuphinde kwenziwe uphenyo ngokusebenza kwemali kulesi sikhwama. "Abaholi bathe angiyithinte eyokunyuswa kwemali yi-GEMS. Asikayixoxi futhi asikasithathi isinqumo mayelana nodaba lwe-GEMS, lokuthi sivumele abasebenzi ukuthi bazikhethele. Bakhalile ngokuthi abasebenzi abasakwazi ukumelana nokunyuka kwemali yi-GEMS yingakho befuna ukuzikhethela," kusho uMashatile.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi abasebenzi uma bengewona amalungu ka-GEMS abalutholi uxhaso kuhulumeni njengoba lesi sikhwama sasungulelwa ukubahlinzeka ngosizo lwezempilo olungambi eqolo. Iningi labasebenzi lifuna ukuvunyelwa ukujoyina ezinye izinkampani zama-medical aids kuleli kodwa baqhubeke nokuxhaswa nguhulumeni, njengoba enza ku-GEMS.Uthe abamile bahlabela phambili neyokuqaliswa kweyomshwalense wezempilo kuleli, i-National Health Insurance. "I-NHI iwumthetho owadlula ePhalamende wasayinwa nanguMengameli. Kukhona abangeneme abayisa uhulumeni enkantolo, yinto esiyilwayo enkantolo kanti, asimile siyaqhubeka nayo."Odabeni oluthinta ukuhoxiswa koxhaso lwaseMelika, obelusiza empini yokulwa neHIV/AIDS kuleli, uveze ukuthi uhulumeni kaMnuz Donald Trump, awukayimisi unomphela imali oyifaka kulolu hlelo."Sibheka izinhlelo zokuthi sikwazi ukuzimela singathembeli kuhulumeni waseMelika ngalolu xhaso. Sifuna ukuthi uma sekufika isikhathi sokuthi lolu xhaso lunqanyulwe, sibe sesikwazi ukuzimela." Uveze nokuthi balwa nobugebengu kuleli njengoba kujutshwe namasosha ukusiza kule mpi ezifundazweni ezigubuzelwe wubugebengu.Uthe kutshalwe nemali ezinhlelweni zokuqinisa imingcele engenela kuleli, ukuvala izimpahla ezingena kuleli ngokungemthetho. Ukhulume nangendaba yokungasebenzi kwentsha, wathi akumele kube yinto ejwayelekayo ukuthi izinga lokungatohozi liphezulu."Kumele sihlale siyilwa eyezinga eliphezulu lentsha engasebenzi kuleli, kungabi yinto eyamukelekayo. Siyazi isimo asisihle, abanye abasebenzi abanaso isiqinisekiso ngekusasa labo lapho betohoza khona," kuqhuba uMashatile. Uncome neqhaza lezinyunyana ekulweleni abasebenzi, wathi kudingeka kubanjiswane ukulwa nesihlava sokushoda kwemisebenzi kuleli.
LUBHEKE enkantolo udaba lokuhlakazwa kwebhodi lesikhwama esigade umhlaba kaZulu, iNgonyama Trust. Ibhodi leNgonyama Trust linikele enkantolo liyophonsela inselelo isinqumo sikaNgqongqoshe wezoMhlaba, uMnuz Mzwanele Nyhontso, sokulihlakaza. Ibhodi leNgonyama Trust lifake isicelo esiphuthumayo enkantolo lapho liphonsela inselelo isinqumo sikaNyhontso.Lezi zindaba zivezwe yisikhulu esiphezulu kwiNgonyama Trust, uMnuz Siyamdumisa Vilakazi, ngesikhathi sikhuluma nabezindaba, ngoLwesihlanu. UNyhontso umemezele isinqumo sokuhlakaza ibhodi ngeledlule, wathi ibhodi uyihlakaza ngenxa yokuthi sekusule amalungu ebhodi amaningi njengoba sekusele amane kuphela.UNyhontso uthe la malungu ebhodi asele angaphansi kwesibalo samalungu adingekayo ukuze ibhodi likwazi ukusebenza kepha uVilakazi uthe isinqumo sikaNyhontso siphambene nomthetho olawula iNgonyama Trust. "Sizofaka amaphepha ethu enkantolo namhlanje (ngoLwesihlanu), sinethemba lokuthi udaba luzolalelwa ngoMsombuluko noma ngoLwesibili." UNyhontso wayalele amalungu ebhodi ukuba aqoqe konke okungokwawo bese ephuma eyaphela emahhovisi eNgonyama Trust ngoLwesine, kodwa ngoLwesihlanu, iPhini likaSihlalo webhodi, u-Advocate Linda Zama, belisaqhubeka nomsebenzi walo. UVilakazi uthe akukhona ukuthi bahlezi ngenkani emahhovisi kodwa wathi angeke bavumele ukuphulwa komthetho."Abameli basitshele ukuthi isinqumo sokuhlakazwa kwebhodi asikho emthethweni. Kuleli zwe kunemithetho okufanele ilandelwe."U-Advocate Zama uthe isinqumo sikaNyhontso siphazamisa ukusebenza kweNgonyama Trust. "Ukuhlakazwa kwebhodi kuzophazamisa izinhlelo zeNgonyama Trust futhi kuzokwenza ukuthi abantu basabe ukutshala imali ezindaweni ezingaphansi kweNgonyama Trust."Akukhona okokuqala uNyhontso eshayisana nebhodi leNgonyama Trust. Ngonyaka owedlule, uNyhontso wabhalela amalungu ebhodi ewabuza ukuthi kungani kufanele engawamisi emsebenzini? Amalungu ebhodi aphendula ngokuthi uNyhontso akanawo amandla okuwamisa. Amalungu ebhodi anyamanambana kuSihlalo webhodi, iSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini. IMbube isola amalungu ebhodi ukuthi awayihloniphi nokuthi awafuni ukuyamukela njengoSihlalo webhodi. Khonamanjalo: Seliqalile ukwenza umsebenzi walo ithimba eliqokwe iMbube ukuba linxenxe amaqembu ezepolitiki ukuba aseke isiphakamiso sayo sokuba kuchibiyelwe umthetho olawula iNgonyama Trust. IMbube ifuna ukunikwa amandla okuqoka amalungu ebhodi. Njengamanje amalungu ebhodi aqokwa nguNyhontso. Ithimba eliqokwe yiMbube seliqalile ukubhalela amaqembu ameleleke ePhalamende, licela ukuhlangana nobuholi bawo.Isolezwe libone izincwadi lapho ithimba leMbube licela ukuhlangana nobuholi be-DA nobe-EFF. Ethimbeni leMbube kukhona uNdunankulu kaZulu, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, iJaji eselathatha umhlalaphansi, uMjabuliseni Isaac Madondo, nommeli wasemajajini, u-Advocate Tembeka Ngcukaitobi.
UNOBHALA Jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, uthe amalungu eqembu aphinde abe amalungu e-SACP kufanele akhethe ukuthi ahamba naliphi iqembu okhethweni lohulumeni basekhaya.UMbalula uthe alikho ilungu elizovunyelwa ukuba liyishaye ngapha nangapha. Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma e-Eastern Cape, engqungqutheleni yokukhetha ubuholi beqembu esifundeni Amathole.UMbalula uveze ukuthi bazobamba umhlangano wesigungu esiphezulu oyisipesheli ingakapheli le nyanga, lapho bezothatha isinqumo ngodaba lokungenela kwe-SACP ukhetho."Sizohlangana sininikeze umkhombandlela. Nginethemba lokuthi emasontweni amabili ezayo sizokube sesisithathile isinqumo."UMbalula uthe nakuba bengakasithathi isinqumo, okusobala ukuthi amalungu kufanele akhethe iqembu elilodwa phakathi kwe-ANC ne-SACP."Asizokwazi ukusebenzisana. Awukwazi ukuba i-ANC uphinde ube iKhomanisi ngapha. Uma uyikhansela le-SACP kufanele siyifakele izibuko indaba yakho. Kufanele ukhethe okokukodwa. Sasho ukuthi lesi sinqumo sizophoqa amalungu ukuthi akhethe uhlangothi olulodwa. ELimpopo uNdunankulu wethu (Dkt Phophi Ramathuba) uyiPhini likaSihlalo we-SACP esifundazweni. Usebubhalele ubuholi be-SACP, washo ukuthi angeke abe yingxenye yomkhankaso wayo wokhetho, uzokhankasela i-ANC."UMbalula uthe akaboni ukuthi i-SACP izokwenza kahle okhethweni."Ayisithusi le nto yokuthi i-SACP ithole amavoti awu-75 uma kunokhetho lokuchibiyela. U-Irvin Jim (onguNobhala wenyunyana yabasebenzi iNumsa) waqala iqembu lezepolitiki wathi i-Socialist, akazange athole nesihlalo esisodwa. Indlela yabo izokuba nezinkinga. ANGAPHEZU kuka-3 400 amaphoyisa omgwaqo azotshalwa ezindaweni ezehlukene zesifundazwe ngamaholidi ePhasika.Lokhu kuvezwe wuMphathiswa wezokuThutha KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Siboniso Duma izolo, ngesikhathi ethula ngokusemthethweni imikhankaso yoMnyango yokuqinisekisa ezokuphepha ngamaholidi ePhasika.UDuma usho kanje esithangamini nabezindaba emgwaqweni uDumisani Makhaye, KwaMashu, lapho obekunesivimbamgwaqo esikhulu khona, okuvulwe ngaso imikhankaso. Ngaphambi kwalokho, uDuma ubehambele isikhungo seRoad Traffic Inspectorate (RTI) eMdloti, KwaDukuza.Ekhuluma nabezindaba, uDuma uthe angaphezu kuka-3 483 amaphoyisa omgwaqo alesi sifundazwe azotshalwa, wathi avela ezingeni likazwelonke azoba ngaphezuku kuka-105.Uthe bazibekele ukuthi zehle ngo-10% izingozi ezibulala abantu emgwaqweni ngempelasonto ende yePhasika. "NgePhasika langonyaka odlule, saqopha ukwehla okungu-38% esibalweni sabafe ezingozini zomgwaqo, uma kuqhathaniswa no-43% wango-2024. Sitshale amaphoyisa esifundazwe angaphezu kuka-3 483 nangaphezu kuka-105 awubamba ngendlela efanele umkhankaso kaNenzani La Ezweni,” kusho uDuma.Uthe amaphoyisa azosebenza amahora angu-24 izinsuku eziyisikhombisa zesonto kuze kube uMeyi 3, nonyaka. "Sizoba nezivimbamgwaqo ezingu-148 ezizobe zibheka izinto ezehlukene. Ezingu-80 zizobhekana nabashayela bephuzile,” kusho uDuma. Uthe ezindaweni ezithathwa njengezihlale zehlelwa yizingozi kanjalo nakulezo okujwayele ukuthutheleka khona izivakashi kanjalo nabakhonzayo, zizoba ngu-118 izindawo okuzotshalwa kuzo amaphoyisa azobe eqaphe isivinini izimoto ezihamba ngaso.Uqhube wathi izimoto ezingakufanele ukuba semgwaqweni, zizosuswa emgwaqweni. Uthe abazobhekana kuphela nabashayeli bezimoto kodwa bazophinde badlulele kubanikazi bazo. Abaphuza amanzi amponjwana bese begcwaneka emgwaqweni, uthe bazokhalelwa amasongo kaSigonyela. Emkhankasweni wayizolo, obuqale ngo-7 ekuseni, kuthe kushaya u-9 wasekuseni, bese kuhlolwe amabhasi angu-17 kanjalo namatekisi. Ngesikhathi esifanayo, bese zizine izithuthi zomphakathi ebese ziboshiwe.
UKUGQEKEZWA kwesikole uMkhumbane Secondary, eChesterville, kunike abazali isizathu esiqinile sokuthi angabe esathintwa ngempela amakhamera asuse umsindo ngenyanga edlule kulesi sikole.Lokhu kuvele ngesikhathi Isolezwe lixoxa nomunye wabazali, ukubheka ukuthi sihamba kanjani isimo selokhu kubuyelwe esikoleni, kulandela ukuphazamiseka kokufunda amasonto amathathu.Umzali, uNksz Xolile Buhlalu, uveze ukuthi sigqekeziwe isikole ngoMashi 10, kodwa abasolwa abathathu abavezwa amakhamera, bagcina bengathathanga lutho. "La makhamera angafunwa ngothisha beSadtu noMnyango wezeMfundo, yiwo aveze kahle ukuthi abasolwa babebathathu, kanti omunye wabo, sizwa kuthiwa abamaziyo sebeshilo ukuthi ungubani. Lokhu kusinikeze esinye isizathu esiqinile singabazali sokuthi bubaluleke ngani ubukhona bawo,” kusho uNksz Buhlalu.Uthe uthishanhloko obambile njengoba esamisiwe obekhona phambilini, ukuqonda ngokuphelele ukukhathazeka kwabazali ngobugebengu esikoleni.UNksz Buhlalu uthe ngaleso sizathu uthishanhloko ubalalele bengabazali uma bethi awangakhishwa. Uveze ukuthi ngoLwesithathu olwedlule, uMnyango uthumele uchwepheshe okuvele ukuthi ubezowakhipha. "Nokho uthole abazali bengangaye esangweni lesikole, basondela eduze ukuzwa ukuthi uzokwenzani, ngesikhathi engena ngaphakathi,” kusho uNksz Buhlalu, othe ugcine ehamba engawakhiphanga, emva kokubalalela ngokuthi awusizo emuva kokugqekezwa ezinsukwini ezimbalwa ezedlule. Uveze ukuthi ngokwabo isikole sisaqhubeka kahle ngothisha betoho. "Laba abalaxaza ukufundisa izingane zethu, abakabuyi. Basavuka bayovala amahhovisi ezemfundo eTruro. Izingane zethu zisafundiswa yilaba abakhokhelwa abazali. Sibona konke kuhamba kahle ngoba bazifundisa ngisho nangezimpelasonto ukuzama ukubuyisa isikhathi esilahlekile,” usho kanje. Uqhube wathi njengamanje baphezu kwezinhlelo zokucela uMnyango ukuthi usale usubaqasha ngokugcwele ngoba bayithathela phezulu imfundo yezingane zabo."Laba abakhetha ukuvele bazishiye esithubeni izingane zethu ngenxa yamakhamera ekubeni ekhona ezikoleni zabadla izambane likapondo lapho kufunda khona ezabo, asisabadingi esikoleni sethu,” usho kanje.Kusuke omkhulu umsindo kulesi sikole ngasekupheleni kukaJanuwari, othisha abangu-22 beSadtu belaxaza ukufundisa. Phakathi kwezikhalo zabo, kwakungukuthi bafuna akhishwe amakhamera abefakwe emakilasini. Kwavela ukuthi bakholwa wukuthi uthishanhloko - obekhona ngaleso sikhathi - uwafake ngoba efuna ukubabuka befundisa. Kwasuka esinamathambo abazali beshaya phansi ngonyawo, bethi awayi ndawo ngoba angelinye lamathuluzi isikole esiwasebenzisayo ukuqapha ubugebengu. Ngasekupheleni kukaFebhuwari, ugcine emiswa uthishanhloko obekhona. Nakuba abazali, ababewotha ubomvu, bakubeka kwacaca ukuthi uMnyango umumisa ngoba uthatha uhlangothi lothisha benhlangano eyamaniswa ne-ANC, iSadtu, uMnyango waveza ukuthi umiselwe okunye okungahlobene nodungunyane. Zintathu izinyanga azimisiwe uthishanhloko.

Izazi zithi lolu wuhlelo lokulawula izinqe ziyeke ukulithika ngokusebenzisa amafutha asuke ethathwe kwenye ingxenye yomzimba wakho. Lolu hlelo lubuye luvuselele izinqulu nesisu ukuze olwenzayo agcine ephenduka umnyovu.Kosaziwayo asebeke balwenza lolu hlelo kubalwa uDJ Sithelo Shezi wodumo lwengoma ethi Forever. Usaziwayo odume kakhulu ohlelweni lwe-TV iDiamond and Doll kwiShowmax, u-Inno Morolong, wathi yena wenza iBBL ne-liposuction ngo-2022. "Ngangiyisitufuza kodwa manje sengiwunodoli. Sengigqoka noma yini," wacashunwa esho kanje u-Inno.UNonkanyiso "Laconco" Conco, uphumele obala ngokunciphisa isisu emuva kokwenza i-liposuction ukuze abe nokhalo lomnyovu. Nakuba iningi belisola ukuthi lo saziwayo waseMgungundlovu wenze iBBL kodwa yena uphike walala ngomhlane, uthe usebenzise uhlelo lokususa amafutha.Odume kwiReal Housewives of Durban, uSiphiwokuhle "Londie London" Zulu, uke wasolwa ngokwenza iBBL ngenxa yokuba nezinqe kodwa yena uthi unje isidalo.Kwashaqeka abaningi umlingisi weGenerations The Legacy, uThulisile "Thuli P" Phongolo, eqhamuka esengumapakisha ngo-2023 ekubeni ayeyisilenda eminyakeni eyedlule. Nakuye kwasolwa lolu hlelo lweBBL.Umlingisi wodumo kwiMuvhango, uTebogo Thobejane, waphenduka ihlaya ngesikhathi eveza izithombe zakhe ezinkundleni zokuxhumana engcebeleka eMelika ngo-Agasti nyakenye. Kwaqashelwa ukuthi ama-curve akhe akhenikhiwe kodwa kwahlukana imibono.Yize abanye babemshayela ihlombe ngalokhu kubukeka kodwa iningi lamgxeka. UTebogo ubevele enezinqulu ezinkulu.Intokazi eyake yakhonjwa kuDkt Malusi Gigaba, uCindy Makhathini, yaveza ukuthi yonga uR100 000 ukuze yenze i-BBL. No-DJ wakuleli u-Eva Modika wahlukana no-R65 000 enza iBBL ne-liposuction eThe Clinique Instabul eTurkey ngo-2022. Iyini iBBL?Kulolu hlelo olusemfashinini kusuke kuhlinzwa umzimba ngenhloso yokuwudiya kabusha ngasezinqeni, zithi ukukhukhumala saludiyo. Odokotela abalwenzayo bathi kusetshenziswa amafutha athathwe kwenye ingxenye yomzimba. Lawo mafutha abe esefakwa kulezo zindawo ofuna zithi ukubuya ukuze zithi xaxa futhi zibe yindilinga eqoqekile. Yenzani i-liposuction?Uhlelo olwenziwa ngokuthi kususwe amafutha ndawana thize. Uma kwenziwa lolu hlelo, kufakwa umjovo omunca amafutha asuke enenkani ngesikhathi uzilolonga noma udla ngendlela ehlelekile. Kusuke kungahlosiwe ukunciphisa umzimba kodwa ukuguqula izingxenye zomzimba, okuyisisu, amathanga, izingalo nomhlane. Ngamanye amazwi kwi-liposuction kusuke kumuncwa mafutha ekubeni kwi-BBL kusuke kususwa amafutha kwenye ingxenye yomzimba ethuthelwa kwenye. Lezi zinhlelo zibiza malini?ENingizimu Afrika lezi zinhlelo zibiza imali ephakathi kuka-R75 000 kuya kuR100 000 ekubeni eTurkey kuphakathi kuka-R49 000 kuya ku-R70 000. Nakuba kunjalo kodwa udokotela waseGoli ongungoti emkhakheni wokuhlinzwa nokulungisa umzimba kuleli, uDkt Deon Weyers, uthe yena nge-360 Lipo ubiza imali ephakathi kuka-R115 000 noR125 000, kodwa kuya ngezidingo zofuna ukwenziwa nokuthi kumthathe isikhathi esingakanani. Nge-BBL uDkt Wyers uthe uhlelo lonke lubiza imali ephakathi kuka-R125 000 no-R135 000.Yibuphi ubungozi ongabhekana nabo?Ubuhlungu, ukuguquka kwesikhumba, ukutheleleka ngezifo, ukuphathwa yisifo samaphaphu nesenhliziyo uma lezi zinhlelo zenziwe odokotela abayimfundamakhwela.

INHLANGANO ekhokha izibonelelo i-South African Social Security Agency (Sassa), iveze ukuthi ayizikhokhi izibonelelo ngezimpelasonto, imiSombuluko noma ngamaholidi. Le nhlangano ithe ayizikhokhi futhi izibonelelo nangosuku lokuqala enyangeni.Ikusho lokhu ngemuva kokudedela uhlu lwezinsuku zokukhokhwa kwezibonelelo kuze kuphele lo nyaka, kulandela ukuvumelana noMnyango kaMgcinimafa. I-Sassa ithe ngaso sonke isikhathi ikhokha izibonelelo ngokwehlukana kwezinsuku."Kuqale kukhokhwe isibonelelo sabantu abadala, kulandele esabaphila nokukhubazeka, bese kugcina esesondlo sabantwana. Uma kwenzeka usuku lokukhokhwa kwesibonelelo lungempelasonto noma ngeholidi, imali iyoze ingene ngosuku olulandelayo," kusho i-Sassa. I-Sassa iveze lokhu njengoba ngenyanga ezayo kuzoba namaholidi ePhasika kuleli. Iveze ukuthi isibonelelo sabadala sizoholwa ngoLwesine, u-Ephreli 2, 2026. Esabaphila nokukhubazeka siholwe ngemuva kwePhasika, ngo-Ephreli 7. Kuzobe sekulandela esabantwana esidume ngeqolo esizoholwa ngo-Ephreli 8. I-Sassa imemezele nezindaba ezimnandi kwabahola izibonelelo njengoba zizonyuka kusuka ngenyanga ezayo. Ukunyuswa kwezibonelelo kumenyezelww nguNgqongqoshe wezeziMali, uMnuz Enoch Godongwana, ngesikhathi ethula isabelomali sezwe ngoFebhuwari, ePhalamende.Isibonelelo sabadala nesabaphila nokukhubazeka, sizonyuswa ngo-R80 siye ku-R2 400. Esamasosha sizonyuka siye ku-R2 420. I-Foster Care izonyuka ngo-R40, ibe ngu-R1 290, kanti imali yeqolo izonyuka ngo-R20, ibe ngu-R580. I-Sassa inxuse ukuthi abantu bangajahi ukuyokhipha imali ngoba uma isikhona ngeke isaya ndawo. Iyalele nalabo abazoba nenkinga yokungayitholi imali ukuthi bangalindi kodwa banikele emahhovisi alolu phiko ukuze bathole izizathu zokungaholi.Okunye okugcizelelwe ukuthi kumele baqikelele ukuthi imininingwane yabo iyiyona kanti bangashayela enombolweni ethi: 0800 60 10 11 ukuze basizakale.

Kwambiwa kungafanele amathambo abantu ukuze kuyobukiswa ngakho ezindaweni ezigcina amagugu kulawa mazwe. Siwafuna wonke la magugu ngoba ngawethu, abuyele kuleli ngoba angumlando oveza ubuthina," kusho uRamaphosa.Ukusho lokhu izolo, ngesikhathi kungcwatshwa kabusha amathambo abangu-63, besizwe samaKhoi namaSan, ababegcinwe ezikhungweni zemfundo ezehlukene kanjalo nasezindaweni zamagugu njengaseHunterian Museum, eNyuvesi yaseGlasgow eScotland, nakwiZiko Museum. La magugu afihlwe kabusha eKinderlê Monument, eSteinkopf, eNorthern Cape. "Umoya wabasuswa kuleli ngokungemthetho ubungakutholi ukuphumula ngoba bebegqunywe kwamanye amazwe. Bebengekho ezweni labo, eduzane nezihlobo kanjalo nezingane zabo. KwabaseScotland, ngifuna uma sebefika ezweni labo basho ukuthi ngiyaveva, ngifuna zonke izinto ezathathwa kuleli zibuyiswe. "Uthe ukufihlwa kabusha kwalawa mathambo kwenziwe ngokuhlanganyela koMnyango wezemiDlalo, ubuCiko namaSiko kanjalo ne-South African Heritage Resources Agency neZiko Museums."Inhloso yokwenza lokhu ukuhlonipha bonke abalwela amalungelo kuleli. Kumele sibahloniphe ngokuthi sibangcwabe ngendlela enenhlonipho. Lokhu sikwenza siqhakambisa nenyanga yamaLungelo aBantu." Uthe ababethatha amagugu akwamanye amazwe bawayise emazweni abo, babeqhutshwa nawubandlululo.Uveze nokuthi useyalele uNgqongqoshe wezemiDlalo, uMnuz Gayton McKenzie, ukuthi aqale uhlelo lokubuyisela emuva enye yezinyoni yaseZimbabwe."Kufike ithimba ebelivela eZimbabwe, lifuna enye yezinyoni okuthiwa yathathwa umholi owayevela eBritain, uMnuz Cecil John Rhodes (owayephethe iCape Colony), owashaqa le nyoni okuthiwa igcinwe eGroote Schuur. Le nyoni bathe yayiwuphawu lwabo njengabantu baseZimbabwe, kanti sebayayifuna ukuthi ibuyele ezweni labo. Ngiyalele uMcKenzie ukuthi asheshise uhlelo lokuthi ibuyiselwe emuva le nyoni ngoba zonke izinto ezingamagugu zakwamanye amazwe ezebiwa, kumele zibuyiselwe emuva." Uthe yingakho nabo befuna wonke amagugu ebiwa kuleli ngoba asho lukhulu kubantu bakuleli. USihlalo weSouth African Heritage Resources Agency, uNksz Elodie Tlhoaele, uthe kufihlwa kabusha amathambo ambiwa ngokungemthetho ayiswa kwamanye amazwe ukuze kuyokwenziwa ucwaningo."Sibuyisa isithunzi sabantu bakuleli lapho abebegcinwe khona besetshenziswa njengombukiso ezikhungweni zemfundo nakuma-museum. Sivikela wonke amagugu akuleli kanti siyawabuyisa ukuze afihlwe ngendlela enenhlonipho."

Ngokujwayelekile, imikhumbi edlula lapha isuka emazweni aseMiddle East nokuyisifunda esinothe kakhulu ngowoyela.I-Iran isivimba imikhumbi ehambisa uwoyela emazweni adlelana neMelika.UTrump ubekade enikeze i-Iran umnqamulajuqu wayizolo ukuba ivule e-Strait of Hormuz. Ubesabise ngokuhlasela izikhungo ezikhiqiza uwoyela uma i-Iran ishaya indiva umyalelo wakhe.Izolo, uTrump umemezele ukuthi uyakumisa kancane ukuhlasela, wathi unqume ukumisa ukuhlasela emva kwezingxoxo ezithembisayo."Sibe nezingxoxo zokuqeda impi eqhubeka eMiddle East. Ngenxa yokwethembisa kwezingxoxo sengiyalele umbutho wezempi kuleli ukuba umise ukuhlasela izikhungo zase-Iran. Izingxoxo zizoqhubeka ezinsukwini ezinhlanu ezilandelayo." Uhulumeni wase-Iran ubungakaphawuli ngezingxoxo uTrump athi ziyaqhubeka.UTrump wenza isimemezelo sokumisa impi nje, bezivele sezibonakala izinkomba zokuthi impi eqhubekayo kayilula.Ezinsukwini, uTrump uke wabalisela abaholi bamazwe ase-Europe, ekhala ngokuthi abafuni ukulekelela iMelika empini.Izindaba zokumisa kukaTrump ukuhlasela zibuyise uzinzo kwezezimakethe. Kwala noma i-ANC isikhiphe umyalelo wokuthi amalungu enhlangano engabe esaya ukuyoseka abaholi ababhekene namacala ezinkantolo. Alizange lisimame leli qembu nokwalandelwa wukuthi uShezi nomunye umsunguli weqembu, uMnuz Carl Niehaus, bajoyine i-EFF. Nakhona kwi-EFF uShezi akahlalanga isikhathi eside njengoba anquma ukujoyina iMKP. Ngeke sikhohlwe yimisebenzi ayenzile elwela ukuba kube nokulingana kanye noguquko kwezomnotho."Nasezinkundleni zokuxhumana abelokhu engene njalo amazwi enduduzo. UNiehaus, owayenoShezi ekwesekeni uZuma ezinkantolo, uthe uShezi bese efana nomfowabo."Anginaye umfowethu engizalwa naye, uShezi wasivala leso sikhala. Sidlule ezimpini eziningi kwipolitiki kodwa ukuzwana kwethu akukaze kuphazamiseke."Umholi wenhlangano elwela amalungelo abantu nabasebenzi, iLabour and Civic Organisation, uMnuz Mlungisi Zondi, uthe uShezi ubebaseka kakhulu emsebenzini abawenzayo."UShezi omunye wabaholi obeweseka kakhulu umsebenzi wethu. Ubefika emamashini ethu ezoseseka. Ngiqale ukumazi sisekwi-ANC sivumelana ngomgomo we-ANC iRET. Sahlangana eNkandla ngaleziya zikhathi."
UNDUNANKULU waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, uthe kuyomthokozisa ukutholwa kwentombazanyana eneminyaka eyisikhombisa, enyamalale ngasekupheleni kukaFebhuwari nonyaka, maqede kwasuka esinamathambo eKokstad.ULathitha Mtolo (7), obefunda uGrade 2 eXoloxolo Primary, kuthiwa waduka ngendlela engaqondakali ngoFebhuwari 26. Kuthiwa waphuma ewumuntu owayeyodlala nabangani bakhe emijondolo yaseMarikana, wangaphinde wabuya. Emva kwezinsuku engatholakali, umphakathi owawuvutha ungabaselwe - ugcine ungqongqisa ngomlilo imizi embalwa yalabo ebebesolwa ngokuba nolwazi ngokunyamalala kwakhe. Phakathi kwayo kukhona owakubo komlutha wewunga, okuthiwa waveza ukuthi uwona othathe uLathitha wayomnika owesifazane owayegane inyanga yaseKokstad. Lo mlutha kuthiwa wathi bamcwiye ephila umgilwa, base bembulala, isidumbu sakhe basiphonsa edamini elisendaweni. Umuzi wayo le nyanga kanjalo neyabanye abelaphi bendabuko endaweni ayisindanga njengoba umphakathi wavele wayingqongqisa ngomlilo, ngelithi awusafune belaphi bendabuko endaweni.UNtuli uqale ngokuhambela isiteshi samaphoyisa iKokstad ukuyothola umbiko ogcwele ngokulahleka kukamgilwa kanjalo nokwenziwa amaphoyisa ngesehlakalo. Ube esedlulela emndenini kamgilwa ukuyowumisa idolo, kwayima eyokwengamela umcimbi wokugujwa koSuku lwamaLungelo Abantu enkundleni yezemidlalo eRiverview, eKokstad. UNtuli uthe bakhathazeke kakhulu njengohulumeni ngokuqhubeka kwezigameko eziyamaniswa nokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane kule ndawo nasesifundazweni sonkana.Uthe lena akuyona nje inkinga eyamaniswa nobugebengu kuphela kodwa ithinta nokuhlukunyezwa kwamalungelo abantu. Uthe ukukhathazeka kwakhe kuqhamuke ngesikhathi ethola umbiko ngokulahleka kwezingane kule ndawo."Kungikhathazile okwenzeke ngoFebhuwari, ingane (7) okuthiwa ibidlala ibuye ize ekhaya, izodla, iphinde iphume, yagcina ingabuyanga. Kuze kube yinamuhla ayikaze iphinde itholakale,” kusho uNtuli. Uthe umthokozisile umbiko awuthole emaphoyiseni wokuthi enza konke okusemandleni ukuthungatha umgilwa, okufaka phakathi ukucinga kusetshenziswa kobuchwepheshe besimanje. "Ngithe emaphoyiseni ngilindele ukuzwa isiphetho esiyosithokozisa sonke ngoba ngifisa siyithole iphila, siyithole noma ingasaphili,” usho kanje.
