"Noma sigubha amalungelo abantu kodwa baningi abantu besifazane abangakujabuleli ukuthi sinomthetho onikeza amalungelo ngoba bayizisulu,” usho kanje.
UBUSATHI uzikhotha amanxeba ngesihlobo esibulawe ngesihluku, sabekwa endlini yaso yokugcina ngempelasonto edlule, umndeni wesaguga (84) esibulawe nomzukulu (13) eMkhelekehleni, KwaNgcolosi, ngoLwesibili olwedlule.Lokhu kuvele ngoMgqibelo, ngesikhathi Isolezwe likhuluma nesihlobo, uMnuz Hlelo Bhengu, kulandela ukuthi amaphoyisa esifundazweni ekhiphe isitatimende esithi "ambulele" umsolwa ezintatha.Ngokusho kokhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, umsolwa, Isolezwe elithole ukuthi unguMnuz Nqobani Bhengu (24), ubulawe nomunye ngesikhathi bekhetha ukuvulela ngenhlamvu emaphoyiseni abezobafuna. UBhengu ekhuluma neSolezwe, uthe uninakhulu, uNkk Thengani Bhengu (84) nomzukulu wakhe uZesuliwe Mbambo (13), babulawe ngokudutshulwa ngoLwesibili ebusuku."Izihlobo zesifazane ebezikhona egcekeni ngesikhathi kwenzeka isigameko, zithe umbulali udubule ephindelela ekameleni likagogo, emi ngaphandle. Kudubuleke ugogo nabazukulu ababili bamantombazane alala nabo,” kusho uBhengu.Uthe umzukulu wesibili, naye odubulekile uyelulama esibhedlela. "Kwenzeka lesi sigameko, umndeni ubusanda kufihla umalume, naye oshone ngokudutshulwa,” kusho uBhengu.Uthe umalume wakhe, uMnuz Zenzele Bhengu (57) wadutshulwa emasontweni amabili edlule, ebuya esontweni ebusuku."Abantu bezwa kuqhuma isibhamu kaningi, bathi uma bephuma beyobheka, njengoba isigameko senzeka phakathi kwemizi, bathola ukuthi usedutshulwe,” usho kanje. Uthe izihlobo ezingezesifazane, bese zithukile kulandela isigameko sakamumva."Bezingaqondi ukuthi kwenzekani, ukuthi kungani kubulawa umndeni ngesihluku? Bezihlalele ovalweni impela kwazise zingabantu besifazane,” kusho uBhengu.Ngokuthola kweSolezwe, umsolwa, uNqobani ubethinteka ekubulaweni kwesinye isihlobo, naso esabulawa ngesihluku emzini waso ngo-2024. Uthe nakuba uZesuliwe ayekhona endaweni yaleso sigameko kodwa ngeke alibeke ngesihloko elokuthi wasibona isigameko senzeka ukusuka nokuhlala, ngoba wabaleka wayocasha.Uthe okwamanje ngeke basho ukuthi banolwazi olugcwele ngokuthi lona wesilisa obulawe amaphoyisa nguye othintekayo ekubulawa kwezihlobo, kwazise amaphoyisa abengakabikeli ngalokho."Abengakasiniki thina umbiko ogcwele wokuthi njengoba ebulewe nje, ingoba ubethinteka ezehlakalweni zokubulawa komndeni wethu. Sisabhekene nokufihla ugogo nomzukulu, cishe uma sekudlulile, yilapho umuntu azozwa kahle emaphoyiseni ukuthi athini,” usho kanje.Uthe akukho okuphathekayo abanakho maqondana nokuthi umndeni wakhe ubulawelweni ngesihluku, wathi ngisho nesigameko sango-2024, bagcina uphenyo lwakhona lungayidalulanga imininingwane ngomsolwa. UNkk Bhengu noZesuliwe bafihlwe ngeSonto.UNetshiunda, esitatimendeni asithumelele abezindaba, uthe abasolwa ababili ebebefunelwa amacala amane okubulala endaweni yaseHillcrest, bafe ngesikhathi bedubulana namaphoyisa.Eqhubeka nokuchaza, uthe phakathi kwamacala okubulala ebebefunelwa wona, kukhona nawokubulala isaguga (84) nentombazane (13) ebebesanda kubabulala. Uthe amaphoyisa athole umkhondo wokuthi abasolwa babhace ekhaya elisemgwaqweni uMkhelekehleli, KwaNgcolosi."Athe uma egasela kulo muzi onendlu ewulawondi, ebilele abasolwa, bavele badubula bebhekise kuwona. Nawo abuyisele ngayo inhlamvu, badubuleka bafa,” kusho uNetshiunda.Uthe alikho iphoyisa elilimalile kulokhu kudubulana, waveza ukuthi kuvulwe amacala okuzama ukubulala amaphoyisa, asazophenywa.
KUYA kwelinye izinga ukungaboni ngaso linye phakathi kweNkosi yesizwe sakwaMpungose nenduna yakule ndawo eyaxoshwa esikhundleni sayo ngonyaka owedlule, isolwa ngokwenza umathanda.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi Inkosi uZakhe Mpungose kayeneme neze ngendlela, iNduna uMntukatshelwa Mpungose, eNkungumathe, eNkandla, eziphethe ngayo.Kuthiwa udweshu phakathi kwalaba lusuke ngemuva kokuba induna bese ingasayithathi imiyalelo yenkosi, yenza noma yikanjani kuze kube sengathi esizweni senkosi kukwamachangca, kwampunzi edla emini.Okhulumela umndeni wenkosi, uMnuz Lindelihle Mpungose, ukuqinisekisile ukungaboni ngaso linye komndeni nenduna. Uthe lokhu kwadala ukuthi induna beyenza noma yini ngesikhathi esithandwa yiyona futhi ingasalawuleki nje nhlobo. Lokhu uthe kugcine sekuyidalela amazinyo alushelelezi enkosini.Ngenxa yokungagculiseki ngendlela le nduna esebenza ngayo inkosi noMnyango wezokuBusa nokuBambisana KwaZulu-Natal, babe sebevumelana ngokuthi izinyawo mazigcwale udaka enduneni ngonyaka odlule.UMpungose uthe kusuka lapho abakaze baphinde bakuthole ukuphumula. Uthe lolu daba seluvese lwaphuma kakhulu esandleni njengoba kuboshwe izihlobo ezimbili zenkosi, zisolwa ngokukhomba ngesibhamu induna.Kugcine kuboshwa umnewabo wenkosi, uMnuz Mkhe Mpungose kanye noMnuz Mzeleni Mncube ongumzala wenkosi.UMpungose uthe induna ibabophele amanqina enyathi laba ngoba inengwa ukukhishwa kwayo esikhundleni ebisithanda kakhulu.''Le nduna ivele yahamba yayovula icala lokukhonjwa ngesibhamu. Lokhu yatshela amaphoyisa ukuthi kwenziwe yizona zombili lezi zihlobo zenkosi," usho kanjena.Uthe isizwe sakwaMpungose sizimisele ukuseka umndeni wenkosi kuze kuba yisekugcineni kuhlanzwe neqiniso ngomyombo wokuboshwa kabomndeni bebhecwa ngento abangayenzanga.Isolezwe litholile ukuthi noma kukuningi inkosi ebingakuthandi ngenduna kodwa bekuyicasula kakhulu ukudayisa kwayo izindawo ikwenza ngaphandle kokuxhumana nenkosi kuqala.Namhlanje izihlobo zenkosi ziyavela eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseNkandla. UMpungose uthe kuzobe kugcwele kakhulu enkantolo kukhona namabutho azobe ezokweseka umndeni wenkosi.Isolezwe litholile ukuthi lesi simo sesidale ukuthi sishube kakhulu isimo endaweni ngenxa yokuthi kukhona iningi eliseka inkosi, ebese kuba khona idlanzana eleseka induna exoshiwe.''Okubi nje ukuthi lolu daba lungagcina selidala ukuthi kube khona abathile abalimalayo," kusho omunye oseduze nenkosi.Induna ayitholakalanga ukuba iphawule ngezinsolo ezibhekiswe kuyo.
Izakhamuzi zasesigodini saseBuyaaya, eMawokota South Constituency, esifundeni saseMpigi zizithole zihleli ebumnyameni ngenxa yezombusazwe ngemuva kokuthi ilungu lePhalamende eliphumayo uYusuf Nsibambi likhiphe umyalelo wokuthi kunqanyulwe ugesi ngemuva nje kokulahlekelwa yisihlalo sakhe ePhalamende okhethweni lwangoJanuwari 15.Ukucinywa kukagesi, okuthathe izinsuku ezimbalwa kwaphazamisa imizi namabhizinisi amancane, kulandela ukukhethwa kukaSuzan Nakawuki weqembu elibusayo iNational Resistance Movement. UNsibambi, oybeilungu lesishayamthetho amahlandla amabili oqokwe ngethikithi leForum for Democratic Change, ubesebambe lesi sihlalo iminyaka eyishumi.Ngokubika kwephephandaba lase-Uganda, uParliament Watch, UNsibambi uyavuma ukuthi nguyena owaxhasa ngezimali ukufakwa kwengqalasizinda kagesi eBuyaaya, okuhlanganisa namalambu asemgwaqweni kanye ne-transformer, okuyi-investment athi idle imali elinganiselwa ku-UGX 135 million. Uthi ngenxa yokuthi lo msebenzi wawuxhaswe ephaketheni lakhe, usenalo ilungelo lokuwuhoxisa."Angisenaso isibopho ngalaba bantu. Lowo gesi akuyona impahla kahulumeni," kusho uNsibambi. "Ukube bebekwazisa engibenzele khona njengomuntu, bebezongivotela ukuthi ngibuye.”Uphinde waxwayisa ngokuthi uzohoxisa ukwesekaabafundi abangaphezu kwekhulu, njengoba esola izakhamuzi ngokungabongi nangokuchitha i-manifesto yakhe athe ukubeka phambili ukuqedwa kobubha nemfundo."Angifuni ukubonakala ngincintisana nomkhankaso ohlukile. Ngivumela ilungu lePhalamende elisha lisebenze ngendlela yayo," wengeza.
ZIZA zilakanyana izigwebo ezitholwa inkabi eboshwe neNkosi Simphiwe Erick Zuma, uThabo Mathonsi Chonco, njengoba ngoLwesihlanu, ithole isigwebo sesithathu selokhu kuqale unyaka futhi isengcupheni yokuthi ithole esinye ngenyanga ezayo. UChonco ugwetshwe iminyaka engu-20 ebhadla ejele yiNkantolo yesiFunda eMgungundlovu ngecala lokusoconga owayelwa nokudayiswa komhlaba, uMnuz Xolani Ntombela. NgoJanuwari, wagwetshwa odilikajele abahlanu ngecala lokusoconga umndeni waseBulwer. Ngenyanga eyedlule, wagwetshwa iminyaka engu-20 ngecala lokubulala owayengundunankulu wesizwe sakwaNxamalala, uMnuz Qalokunye Zuma. Angase athole esinye isigwebo ngenyanga ezayo, njengoba ehlela ukuvuma icala lokusoconga owayeyikhansela le-DA kuMasipala waseMngeni, uMnuz Nhlalayenza Ndlovu. UChonco usahlalelwe elinye icala lokusoconga umndeni wakwaMemela, eMbali, eMgungundlovu. UChonco umangalelwe neNkosi yakwaZuma ecaleni lokubulawa kukaNtombela nelokubulawa kukaNdlovu. UChonco ulivumile icala lokubulala uNtombela ngesikhathi evele enkantolo ngoLwesihlanu. Okuqaphelekayo ukuthi uChonco akazange ayibale iNkosi yakwaZuma kanye nomunye umsolwa ababoshwe naye, uMnuz Thembelani Mbatha, ngesikhathi evuma icala. Inkosi noMbatha bayaliphika icala. UChonco uthe wayethunywe yiNduna esiphenduke ufakazi wenkantolo, uMnuz Zwelithini Buthelezi, ukuba ayosoconga uNtombela. UChonco uthe uButhelezi wakhala ngokuthi uNtombela uphazamisa umshikashika wakhe wokudayisa umhlaba eMasosheni, eHowick. UNtombela waye akha izindlu. UChonco uthe bamfikela kwakhe uNtombela bazibuzisa ukuthi ubiza malini uma akha izindlu?"Sasifuna ukubona ukuthi akanaso yini isibhamu nokuthi kuzokuba lula yini ukumdubula."UChonco uthe babuya emva kwezinsuku sebezokwenza umsebenzi.Uthe akazange adubule yena, wasala emotweni, wathi kwadubula abangani bakhe ababili ayehamba nabo angazange awasho amagama abo. UChonco uthe uButhelezi wabakhokhela u-R30 000. Uchaze kabanzi ngobudlelwano bakhe noButhelezi. Uthe baqala ukwazana ngo-2020, ngesikhathi uButhelezi ezothenga izinsimbi zemoto, akazange achaze ukuthi wayezithathaphi lezi zinsimbi zemoto ababedayiselana zona."Wayelokhu ebuya ezothenga izinsimbi zemoto sagcina sijwayelana. Sagcina sidayiselana imfuyo ngaze ngagcina sengiyisethenjwa sakhe ekudayisweni komhlaba ezindaweni ezingaphansi kobukhosi bakwaNxamalala."Esitatimendeni esifundwe ummeli wakhe, uMnuz Zipho Khanyile, uChonco uchaze kafushane ngempilo yakhe.UChonco uthe uhlala KwaNyamazane, eMgungundlovu. Uveze ukuthi akaganiwe kodwa unezingane eziyisithupha. Ucele ukunganikwa isigwebo esiqinile, wathi unethemba lokuthi usengashintsha."Ngesikhathi ngenza icala ngangisemncane (wayeneminyaka engu-27). Ukuboshwa isikhathi eside ngeke kusize ngalutho."Imantshi uBemal Jaynarayan, iyalele ukuthi uChonco aphucwe imvume yokuba nesibhamu, aphinde aphucwe zonke izibhamu nezinhlamvu anazo.UChonco usabise izintatheli ebezizama ukumshutha emva kokuguqa kwenkantolo."Izokusho impama, phela ayisekho imantshi."UChonco uzophindela enkantolo ngo-Ephreli 24, lapho kulindeleke ukuthi avume icala lokubulala uNdlovu. Umshushisi omkhulu, uMnuz Elvis Gcweka, uveze ukuthi kusenezingxoxo ezingakaphothulwa ngodaba lokuvuma icala kukaChonco.UGcweka uthe uChonco ufuna ukuvuma icala ngaphansi kwesigaba 105 somthetho wokuvuma icala.Lesi sigaba sinikeza ovuma icala ilungelo lokuthi angabadaluli abantu ayenabo ngesikhathi enza icala.UKhanyile uthe uChonco uzovuma icala ngaphansi kwesigaba 112 uma zigcine zingaphumelelanga izingxoxo zokuthi avume icala ngaphansi kwesigaba 105.Kuleli cala uChonco umangalelwe neNkosi, uMbatha, Thobani Masobho Hlongwa noKhayelihle Shabalala. UShabalala naye uhlela ukulivuma icala.
SEKUQUBUKE imvunge ngokushaya ngonyawo lonwabu kwamalungiselelo okusingatha ingqungquthela yokuqoka ubuholi be-ANC esiFundeni iTheku.ITheku, okuyisona sifunda esinamalungu amaningi kwi-ANC, kufanele libe nengqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi kule nyanga kodwa amanye amalungu eqembu akhala ngokuthi izinhlelo zokusingatha ingqungquthela zishaya ngolonwabu.Ilungu elicele ukuba lingadalulwa igama lalo, lithe mancane amagatsha asebambe imihlangano yokuphakamisa amagama abantu abazobanga izikhundla engqungqutheleni.Ilungu lithe angaphansi kwangu-20 amagatsha asebe nemihlangano yokulungiselela ingqungquthela.Angu-111 amagatsha e-ANC esiFundeni iTheku."Umbiko wokugcina esawuthola wawukhombisa ukuthi amagatsha asebe nemihlangano abalelwa ku-15. Lokhu kushiya imibuzo eminingi. Umnqamulajuqu owawubekiwe ususondele, asazi ukuthi onke la magatsha azokwazi ukubamba imihlangano yawo kulesi sikhathi esincane esisele."Elinye ilungu lenze izinsolo zokuthi kukhona abasethimbeni lesikhashana elihola i-ANC eThekwini abangafuni ukuthi kube nengqungquthela.Ilungu lithe inhloso yalabo abangafuni kube nengqungquthela yingoba bafuna ukuthi kufike ukhetho lohulumeni basekhaya kuyibona abahola isifunda."Into yamasibomu lena. Bayazi ukuthi ukhetho lohulumeni basekhaya selusondele. Uma ingqungquthela ingase iphazamiseke manje, maningi amathuba okuthi isiyoze ibanjwe emva kokhetho. Uma kungayiwa okhethweni kuyibona abahola i-ANC esifundeni, bayazi ukuthi ibona abazoba nesandla ekuqokweni kwabantu abazokuba amakhansela nabazohola umasipala."Okhulumela i-ANC esiFundeni iTheku, uMnuz Thinta Cibane, ukuphikile ukuthi kukhona abazama ukuphazamisa ukuhlala kwengqungquthela.UCibane utshele iziko lezindaba elinguzakwabo weSolezwe, i-IOL, ukuthi ayaqhubeka amalungiselelo engqungquthela."Sinxusa amalungu eqembu ukuthi akugweme ukusabalalisa amampunge kanye nezinto ezidala uqhekeko, ikakhulu kulesi sikhathi lapho sibheke khona okhethweni lohulumeni basekhaya."Umbango wokuhola i-ANC eThekwini kulindeleke ukuthi ube phakathi kukaSomlomo womkhandlu, uMnuz Thabani Nyawose naloyo oke waba imeya yomkhandlu, uMnuz James Nxumalo.Ohlangothini lukaNyawose, kuvela obengumgcinimafa we-ANC eThekwini, uMnuz Ayanda Ndlovu, ogaqele isikhundla sikanobhala.Kuphinde kuvela nekhansela lakuMasipala waseThekwini, uMnuz Vusi Mngadi, lona eligaqele isikhundla sikamgcinimafa.Akucaci ngabagaqele ezinye izikhundla.
UNOBHALA Jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, uthe amalungu eqembu aphinde abe amalungu e-SACP kufanele akhethe ukuthi ahamba naliphi iqembu okhethweni lohulumeni basekhaya.UMbalula uthe alikho ilungu elizovunyelwa ukuba liyishaye ngapha nangapha. Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma e-Eastern Cape, engqungqutheleni yokukhetha ubuholi beqembu esifundeni Amathole.UMbalula uveze ukuthi bazobamba umhlangano wesigungu esiphezulu oyisipesheli ingakapheli le nyanga, lapho bezothatha isinqumo ngodaba lokungenela kwe-SACP ukhetho.
ABENGENA engenile amazwi enduduzo kulandela ukushona kwelungu leMKP ePhalamende elazakhela udumo ngokweseka umholi weqembu, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, ikakhulukazi ngo-2021 ngesikhathi enecala lokushaya indiva umyalelo weNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo.UMnuz Nkosentsha Shezi, obeseka kakhulu umbono wokuthi abantu abamnyama banikwe amathuba kwezomnotho owaziwa ngeRadical Economic Transformation (RET), ushone emva kokuxinwa wukugula okwamqala ngonyaka odlule.Izindaba zokushona kukaShezi ziqinisekiswe okhulumela iMKP, uMnuz Nhlamulo Ndhlela, othe bashayeke engeqiwa ntwala.UShezi ubengafuni lutho ngoZuma kusukela esikhathini bobabili besekwi-ANC.UShezi ubephambili ekwesekeni uZuma ezinkantolo. Kwala noma i-ANC isikhiphe umyalelo wokuthi amalungu enhlangano engabe esaya ukuyoseka abaholi ababhekene namacala ezinkantolo.
UKHOLELWA ukuthi ngeke busaba khona ubuchwephe obudlula lobu esiphila kubo manje uDkt Vusi Mvelase, waKwaMashu kwa-F, obhale incwadi ngobuchwepheshe bezesayensi obusetshenziswa manje, kuhlanganisa ne-AI (Artificial Intelligence).Incwadi i-Custodians of the Future, uDkt Mvelase uthe izoveza ngokusobala izinto manje okumele zenzeke ngayo kusuka kwezemfundo, ipolitiki, amasiko nokunye.Uthe yize ezobuchwepheshe sezifike ngaleli zinga kodwa le ncwadi iveza olunye uhlangothi impilo okumele ibhekwe ngalo. "Le ncwadi ibheka ukuguqula okwenzekile emhlabeni nobekwenzeka ezintweni ezihlukene ezithinta indlela okusetshenzwa ngayo, okuphilwa ngayo, indlela izikhungo ezishintshe ngayo, indlela ebejwayele ukusetshenziswa kudala kodwa ngenxa yobuchwepheshe obukhona manje esiguqukile yalandela indlela entsha. Ichaza kabanzi ngobuhlakani esikubo manje ukuthi akubona nje obenziwe umuntu oyedwa kodwa obemiqondo ehlukene. Lokhu bakwenza ukuze kuxazululwe izingqinamba esibhekana nazo futhi senze izinto ngendlela efanayo, yize siqhamuka ezindaweni nasemazweni ahlukene," kusho uMvelase.Uthe okunye akugcizelela kule ncwadi ukuthi abantu kumele bangazisabi izinguquko abazibonayo, kunalokho bazijwayele ngoba akusekho ukubheka emuva, njengoba i-AI ifike kwezwakala ezintweni eziningi."Ngikubeka kucace kule ncwadi ukuthi singazihlangabeza kanjani lezi zinguquko ngobuhlakani. Abaholi, othisha, abantu abathatha izinqumo nababhala imiyalelo okumele siphile ngayo nawo wonke umuntu emphakathini, kumele bazi ukuthi yini ezayo ukuze sikwazi ukuhlangabezana naleyo nto sinemiqondo evulekile. Iningi lizovuleka umqondo ngezinto esinazo manje uma lifunda incwadi yalolu hlobo nengithemba ukuthi ibingakabi bikho efana nayo," kuchaza yena.Uthe sekukaningi ebhala izincwadi ngezinto ezihlukene kodwa engazikhiphi emphakathini.Uveze ukuthi ngendlela acwaninga ngayo izinto, akubanga lula ukuthi akhiphe noma yini ayibhalayo kodwa ngenxa yokuba umuntu ocwaninga kakhulu, ubone ukuthi lolu lwazi alukhiphele emphakathini, ukuze kufundwe ngalo.Uthe imfundo iyona akholelwa kuyona kakhulu, njengoba ahlala iminyaka ekudingisweni ngenxa yezidubedube zobandlululo ngesikhathi esakhula.Uthe uhlale kakhulu emazweni okukhona kuwo iNigeria nasedolobheni iLusaka eZambia.Incwadi lena uthe uzoyethula emphakathini eThekwini, ngenyanga ezayo.
UKHOMISHANA wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, ufake igiya eliya phambili ngesikhathi evele phambi kwekomiti lasePhalamende elikhethekile izolo, lapho eneke khona ubufakazi obusha obungampintshela ekhoneni izikhulu ezingozakwabo esiphoyiseni.UMkhwanazi akasukile ezinsolweni zakhe zokuthi kunamaphoyisa asebenzisana nemigulukudu, kunalokho uthe uphethe amafayela anzima "ngokungcola kosigaxamabhande abalekelela ubugebengu obuhleliwe." Echitha izinsolo ezibhekiswe kuyena, okubalwa kuzo ezokuhlukumeza nokushaya abasolwa kanye nezokuphazamisa ukusebenza kwengalo yomthetho, uMkhwanazi uthe okuningi akwenekela ikomiti lasePhalamende neKhomishini eholwa yiJaji uMbuyiseli Madlanga, wakutshelwa usomabhizinisi, uMnuz Vusumuzi "Cat" Matlala qobo lwakhe.Ebufakazini bayizolo kuvele ukuthi uMatlala uyena kanye owakhinindela uMkhwanazi izinsolo zokuthi iPhini likaKhomishana wamaphoyisa elimisiwe, uLieutenant General Shadrack Sibiya, lemukela imali kubantu abasolwa ngokubugebengu.UMkhwanazi uthe uMatlala wamtshela ukuthi kunemali ayinika uSibiya nokuthi wamthengela ngisho izimpala. Uveze ukuthi wakhininda zonke lezi zindaba ngesikhathi behlangene eThekwini.Kulo mhlangano owawuseMhlanga, eThekwini, uthe kwakuzoxoxwa ngezinkinga uMatlala ayebhekene nazo ngodaba lwethenda ka-R360 million emaphoyiseni eyagcina inqanyulwa. UMkhwanazi uthe uMatlala waze wamtshela nokuthi uSibiya ukhangeza enye imali kuloyo osatshiswa okwenyoka, uMnuz Steve Motsumi.UMotsumi usatshwa ngisho omaqhuzu besiphoyisa njengoba uSibiya, inhloko yophiko olulwa nobugebengu obuhleliwe uMajor General Richard Shibiri, nenhloko yoKlebe KwaZulu-Natal uMajor General Lesetja Senona, bonke bathi bayasaba ukubiza igama lakhe ngesikhathi bevele phambi kweKhomishini kaMadlanga. UMkhwanazi uthe uMatlala wamtshela ukuthi uSibiya noMotsumi bayingozi."Kuyathusa ukuthi ngisho abantu abanezikhundla eziphezulu emaphoyiseni bayasaba ukubiza igama likaMotsumi.," kusho uMkhwanazi.Ecacisa ukuthi kungani ekusho manje lokhu, uthe akazange akhulume ngomhlangano wakhe ngesikhathi evele okokuqala phambi kwekomiti ngenxa yokuthi wayethembise uMatlala ukuthi angeke bayithi vu indaba yomhlangano wabo."UMatlala wayengicele ukuthi ngingayithi vu ngenxa yokuthi uyabasaba laba bantu akhuluma ngabo."UMkhwanazi uchaze kabanzi ukuthi lenzeka kanjani iphutha lokuthi athi uMatlala wayenika imali loyo owayenguNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa, uMnuz Bheki Cele.UMkhwanazi uthe efonini kaMatlala kunenombolo ecishe ifane nekaCele eyayibhalwe ukuthi "Bab' uNdosi".UMkhwanazi uthe bacabanga ukuthi uMatlala wayephambanisa le nombolo nekaCele ngoba wayeyithumela imali.Uthe ophenyweni lwabo bathola ukuthi lena inombolo yomuntu waseMpumalanga ongahlobene noCele.Uthe umnikazi wenombolo uvumile ukuthi wayethola imali kuMatlala, wabatshela ukuthi le mali wayiqhumuza nentombi yakhe."Uthe wayethola imiyalezo enombolweni angayazi imcela ukuthi alethe imininingwane yasebhange. Ngenxa yokuthanda imali naye wayeyithumela imiyalezo. UMatlala wabona ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ukuthi kuphambene izinombolo."UMkhwanazi wahoxisa izinsolo zakhe, waxolisa kuCele.UMkhwanazi uthe okwabenza besole ukuthi uCele uthola imali kuMatlala ukuthi uCele wazama ngakho konke okusemandleni akhe ukusiza uMatlala ezinkingeni abhekene nazo, wakhala ngokuqinisa ikhanda kukaNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa omisiwe, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, athe wanqaba ukuhlangana naye ukuze amtshele ngobubi bokuhlakazwa kwethimba lamaphoyisa eliphenya ukubulawa kosopolitiki KwaZulu-Natal."Ukube wavuma ukuhlangana nami ngangizombonisa ubungozi bale nto."UMkhwanazi uthe labo ababefuna kuhlakazwe ithimba babefuna ukuphazamisa ukuphenywa kwamacala okushushumbiswa kwezidakamizwa nawokubulawa kwabantu eGauteng.Uthe laba bantu babefuna nokuthi kuxoshwe uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa, uLieutenant General Fannie Masemola, bese esikhundleni sakhe kufakwa uSibiya.UMkhwanazi uthe umlisa oboshwe noMatlala ejele, uJamen Prinslo, ubhale incwadi lapho echaza khona ngokubudlelwano bakhe noMchunu.Kule ncwadi uPrinslo uthi uMatlala wamtshela ukuthi weseka umkhankaso kaMchunu wokuhola i-ANC.UMkhwanazi uveze ukuthi ube nesandla ekuboshweni komlisa osolwa ngokubulala ufakazi owathule ubufakazi ngokuyimfihlo kwiKhomishini kaMadlanga, uMnuz Marius Van Der Merwe, uMatipandile Sotheni.UMkhwanazi uthe uSotheni wayesebenza ngaphansi kwakhe ophikweni lwamaphoyisa olukhethekile i-Special Task Force.UMkhwanazi uthe wathintwa umnikazi wenkampani yonogada owamtshela ukuthi ucabanga ukuthi isibhamu esasetshenziswa uSotheni esenkampani yakhe."Usinikezile lesi sibhamu ukuthi siyohlolwa."UMkhwanazi uphinde wachaza kabanzi ngempi yamazwi ekhona phakathi kwakhe nosomabhizinisi uMnuz Calvin Mathibeli, wathi uMathibeli umfaka ezimpini zamatekisi angahlangene nazo.UMkhwanazi uthe ucabanga ukuthi uMathibeli waqala ukumzonda ngesikhathi kuboshwa onogada bakhe ababili abagasela emayini nosomatekisi waseNanda, uMnuz Thomas Getsemane."UGetsemane kunomndeni angezwani nawo embonini yamatekisi. Mhlawumbe yena wabona ngoba nakhu kuboshwa onogada ukuthi mhlawumbe nginenkinga noGetsemane nokuthi ngisebenzisana nalowo mndeni. Abekho mina abantu bamatekisi engisondelene nabo."
Amaphoyisa aseMpumalanga avule icala lokubulala kanye nedokodo lophenyo ukuze kuphenywe ngemuva kokuthi iphoyisa, 53, lidubule labulala umngani walo wesifazane, 39, ngaphambi kokuthi lizidubule ngesibhamu eGrootvlei, eMpumalanga ngoMgqibelo, Mashi 2026.Kubikwa ukuthi uKaputeni wamaphoyisa esiteshini saseBethal waya emzini womngani wakhe wesifazane eGrootvlei wamfica enodadewabo. Kuthe uma benqaba ukumvulela uKapteni wephula iwindi wangena endlini. Kuthiwa uqhubekile waxosha usisi wasala nomngani wesifazane.Udade wahamba wayofuna usizo kwabikelwa amaphoyisa. Ngesikhathi amaphoyisa efika afice uKapteni nomngani wakhe wesifazane bedindilizile benamanxeba okudutshulwa. Bobabili kuthiwa bashonele endaweni yesigameko. Kutholakale isibhamu somsebenzi okungesikapteni lo oseshonile.
UJABULELA ukuba yingxenye yengqungquthela ekhuthaza ukuhlanzeka kwamadolobha, uNkosikhona Ndabandaba odume ngelikaPhakelumthakathi.UPhakela ufulathele leli ngoLwesihlanu walibangisa eTaiwan eyoba yingxenye yengqungquthela ebizwa ngeSmart City. Le ngqungquthela ukuvezile ukuthi isenhlokodolobha yakuleliya zwe, iTaipei.Ukuvezile ukuthi ukuze abe yingxenye yayo kungenxa yeqhaza likasomabhizinisi uMnuz Gugulethu Xaba.Ekhuluma neSolezwe uthe uyakuthakasela kakhulu ukuthi abe yingxenye yalolu hlobo lwengqungquthela. Ingqungquthela izodonsa izinsuku ezine ezigcwele. Iqale ngoLwesibili izoze iphothulwe kusasa.''Kuyangijabulisa kakhulu ukuba yingxenye yalolu hlobo lwengqungquthela. Lokhu kusho lukhulu kimina," kuchaza yena.Enaba kabanzi uthe lolu hlobo lwengqungquthela lugxila kakhulu ekukhuthazeni ukuhlanzeka kwamadolobha.Uthe abasuke beyizithunywa kulindeleke ukuthi uma sebebuyela emazweni abo benze konke okusemandleni abo ukushumayela ivangeli lokubaluleka kokuhlanzeka emazweni abakuwona.Uthe naye uzimisele ngokuthi konke akufundayo kube wukuthi uyakusebenzisa uma esebuyele eNingizimu Afrika.''Lapha sikhuthazwa kakhulu ngokuthi sisukume kube khona esikwenzayo mayelana nodaba lokuhlanzeka kwamadolobha esivela kuwona. Sonke esikhona kulindeleke ukuthi uma sesibuyela emuva kube wukuthi siyakwenza ngempela lokhu esizobe sifunde ngakho," kuchaza yena.Uthe uzofingqa imikhono aqinisekise ukuthi ulwazi alutholile engqungqutheleni luthela izithelo ezinhle ezweni lonke.Yize engowaKwaZulu-Natal ngokudabuka, kodwa uthe kungaba yiphutha elikhulu uma ulwazi alutholayo kungakhulunywa indaba yokuthi luphelela kulesi sifundazwe kuphela.''Sizobona ukuthi senza kanjani ukuze ulwazi esiluzuzayo baluthole nabantu bakwenziye izifundazwe ngoba ngikholwa wukuthi lokho kumqoka kakhulu. Ngabe senza iphutha elikhulu uma lolu lwazi silugcina KwaZulu-Natal kuphela,'' kusho yena.Uthe batholile ukuthi ukuhlanzeka kwamadolobha kuklama indima enkulu kakhulu ekuheheni izivakashi kanjalo nasekuthuthukeni komnotho walelo dolobha okukhulunywa ngalo.UPhakela uhambela le ngqungquthela nje igama lakhe lisematheni kulezi zinsuku njengoba efuqa umbhidlango wakhe wokuxosha abantu bokufika amangenamaphepha edolobheni KwaNongoma.Usanda kuveza ukuthi lo mkhankaso wakhe ngeke uphelele nje KwaNongoma kuphela kodwa kunalokho uzobonakala ukapakela nakwezinye izingxenye zesifundazwe.
UNGENISWE esibhedlela ngenxa yokwethuka ngokweqile uthisha wesifazane wasesikoleni, oKumhlophe Secondary, kwaZ eMlaza, okungene amadoda amabili emagcekeni esikole amkhomba ngezibhamu emsola ngokudla imali yomhlaba waseNkandla.Lesi sigameko senzeke ngoLwesibili olwedlule. UNkk Ncamsile Gcwensa (57) uthe uzizwa engaphephile ngemuva kwalesi sigameko athi simshiye ethuka izanya futhi ethuthumela.Uma echaza kabanzi ngaso, uthe bekuyizikhathi zasekuseni eqeda ukungena nje ngemoto emagcekeni esikole.Uthe kuthe esangena nje, kwase kuqhamuka abafana ababili bamkhomba ngezibhamu. ''Omunye ubemi ngaphambili omunye emi ngemuva kwami. Ngivele ngaphelelwa ngamandla, ngangazi nokuthi ngithini kubona. Angikaze ngithuke kanjena empilweni yami selokhu ngazalwa ubaba nomama," usho kanjena.Uthe obengaphambi kwakhe udonse isibhamu abakede esifihlile futhi nongemuva kwakhe naye wakhipha esakhe."Kuvele kwaduma ikhanda kimina ngangazi nokuthi ngithini," echaza.Uthe kuthe esababaza lokho, wabezwa bekhuluma bethi bamsola ngokudla imali yomhlaba waseNkandla, wathi yilapho-ke ikhanda lakhe elivele laduma khona kakhulu kunakuqala ngoba yena ayikho into emhlanganisa nendawo yaseNkandla futhi akazani nendaba yokudayiswa komhlaba.''Ngemuva kokuba besho kanjena, yilapho engivele ngabona khona ukuthi nakanjani laba bantu bayangifanisa nje kwaphela. Ngivela ngaphelelwa nangamagama ngahluleka nawukabatshela ukuthi angiyazi yonke le nto abakhuluma ngayo mina," kusho yena.Uthe laba besilisa bebebonakala ebusweni ukuthi bacasuke kakhulu futhi bazimisele nje ngokuthi bamane baqede khona lapho ngempilo yakhe. Uthe kusize ukusondela kukathishomkhulu ngesikhathi esememeza.''Angazi ukuthi uthishomkhulu utheni kubona. Kodwa nakhona ngibezwe bemtshela ukuthi angazingeni izinto angazazi ngoba lo muntu abeze kuyena uyazi wenzani eNkandla," usho kanje.Uthe kodwa kusho ukuthi kukhona uthishomkhulu akushilo kubona ngoba ngemuva kwalokho baphume bahamba.Ngenxa yokuthuka kakhulu uthe ugcine esephuthunyiswa kudokotela ogunyaze ukuthi makaphuthunyiswe esibhedlela ngoba uthuke kakhulu.Ubekhuluma neSolezwe elele khona esibhedlela esingeke sisidalule ngenxa yezizathu zokuphepha. Ubalise ngokuthi useyesaba ukubuyela esikoleni ngenxa yokwesaba.''Kuyacaca phela manje ukuthi angiphephile nje nhlobo. Inkinga angazi ukuthi ngizothi uma ngingayi esikoleni ngithi ngizofundisaphi," echaza.Uveze ukuthi lesi simo sesidale elikhulu itwetwe leli nakwabanye othisha abathuka izanya selokhu kwenzeke lesi sigameko.''Bonke othisha manje bahlala bethukile ngoba abazi ukuthi kwenzekani. Okunye okudala ukuthi bathuke kakhulu ukuthi bayabona ukuthi abaphephile kangakanani uma besemagcekeni esikole," echaza.Ilungu lesigungu esengamele isikole, uNkk Zandile Fakazi , lithe ufikile umbiko omayelana nalolu daba kubona. UNkk Fakazi uthe bazoba nomhlangano nothishomkhulu ukubhunga kabanzi ngalo.Mayelana nokuphepha kulesi sikole, uthe bakholwa ukuthi kuphephe ngokwanele nezigameko ezethusayo uthe azenzeki.Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Muzi Mahlambi, akazange atholakale ukuphawula ngalolu daba.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uSergeant Thenjiswa Ngcobo, usiqinisekisile lesi sigameko. Uthe amaphoyisa aseBhekithemba aphenya icala elimayelana nokukhonjwa kukathisha ngesibhamu.''Kusolakala ukuthi amadoda amabili angene akhomba ngesibhamu owesifazane,'' kusho uSgt Ngcobo.
UKHWELE wadilika kwabazibiza ngamaDelangokubona ababemi endleleni yokuba kuphothulwe ukwakha eMenzi High School, eMlaza, uMphathiswa weMisebenzi yoMphakathi kanye neNgqalasizinda, KwaZulu Natal, uMartin Meyer.UMeyer ubekhuluma izolo ngesikhathi umnyango awuholayo udlulisela ngokusemthethweni amagumbi alesi sikole asephothuliwe.''Ngeke futhi asisoze sahlala phansi kwaba khona esikuxoxayo nezigebengu. Ukuphothulwa kwalesi sikole kuwubufakazi obusobala bokuthi ubugebengu singabunqoba. Futhi lokhu kuveza ngokusobala ukuthi amaDelangokubona anganqotshwa," usho kanjena.Uthe njengohulumeni abasoze bavuma ukuthi kube khona abantu abathile ababasabisayo ngisho noma ngabe besatshwa kangakanani. Uthe kulokhu abakushoyo abahlehli kodwa baya phambili.''Namhlanje sizojabulela ukuthi silwile sanqoba ngesikhathi kukhona abathile abafuna ukuphazamisa imfundo yabantwana bethu. Lokhu kuveza ngokusobala ukuthi uma silwa siyakwazi ukubhekana ngqo nobugebengu,'' uchaze kanje uMeyer.Eqhuba uthe nakwezinye izindawo lapho lo mnyango wakha khona ngeke baze bavume ukuthi kuqhamuke amaDelangokubona aphazamise umsebenzi wokwakha.Ushaye phansi ngonyawo wathi babengeke bathule nje bagoqe izandla babukele amaDelangokubona eqeda ngemfundo yabantwana ngaphandle kwesizathu esizwakalayo.''Phela lokhu abebekwenza babechaza ukuthi bamelene nemfundo yabantwaba bethu, okuyinto esingasoze sayivuma noma ngabe kunzima kangakanani,'' usho kanjena.UMeyer ukhuluma kanjena nje kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi kwaba yindaba egudwini ukuphazamiseka kohlelo lokwakhiwa kwalesi sikole ngenxa yokuthi kwakukhona abathile ababezibiza ngamaDelangokubona ababephazamisa umsebenzi bekhala ngokuthi bona basale ngaphandle.UMeyer uthe kwakungaba yiphutha elikhulu ukuvumela amaDelangokubona aphazamise ukwakhiwa kwesikole esinomlando omuhle njengalesi nesibonakala sikhiqiza imiphumela emihle minyaka yonke.Uthishomkhulu walesi sikole, uNkk Ndlanya, uthe bajabule kakhulu ngokuthi ukwakhiwa kwesikole kugcine kuphothuliwe.Ukuchaze njengento emqoka kakhulu ukubaluleka kokuba ibe sezingeni elihle ingqalasizinda yezikole.''Siyabonga kakhulu eMnyangweni weMisebenzi kanye neNgqalasizanda ngakho konke okuhle abakwenzile beqinisekisa ukuthi lo msebenzi omuhle kangaka uyaphothulwa,'' kuchaza yena.Lokhu uthe kuzokhuthaza kakhulu abafundi ukuba baqhubeke benze kahle ngenxa yokuthi bazobe befundela endaweni abakuthakaselayo kakhulu ukuba kuyona ngenxa yokwakheka kwayo.
UMHOLI we-EFF, uMnuz Julius Malema, ukhwele wadilika kuKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, amsole ngokuthanda ukubukwa. UMalema usole uMkhwanazi ngokumfaka ezimpini zakhe zamaphoyisa angahlangene nazo.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma emcimbini we-EFF wokugqugquzela abantu ukuthi babhalisele ukuvota.UMalema usole uMkhwanazi ngokufaka igama lakhe nele-EFF ezimpini zakhe zamaphoyisa.Uthe uMkhwanazi usebenzisa igama lakhe nele-EFF empini yakhe nePhini likaKhomishana wamaPhoyisa, uLieutenant General Shadrack Sibiya nasempini yakhe nephoyisa lezinhloli, uMajor General Feroz Khan.UMkhwanazi waveza ukuthi uKhan unokubonakala emcimbini ye-EFF esuke ihanjelwe yizicukuthwane."UMkhwanazi ulwa noGeneral Khan. Ngaso sonke isikhathi uma elwa noKhan uvele afake igama lami nele-EFF. Akahlukane nami ne-EFF. Thina asihlangene nalo mbhedo abawulwelayo lapha emaphoyiseni."UMalema usole uMkhwanazi ngokukhuluma indaba engaphelele ngaye ngesikhathi evele phambi kwekomiti lasePhalamende ngeledlule. UMkhwanazi watshela amalungu ekomitini ukuthi wezwa kuthiwa uMalema uhlela umhlangano wokubahlanganisa noSibiya."Into uMkhwanazi angazange ayisho ukuthi ngabe ngamfonela yini ngimcela ukuthi abe nomhlangano noSibiya? Into ayishoyo ukuthi wezwa ngomuntu othi wezwa ngoSibiya ukuthi mina ngizohlela umhlangano. Umbuzo obekufanele abuzwe wona ukuthi ngabe ngawuhlela yini loyo mhlangano? Akukho mhlangano engawuhlela futhi uSibiya akaze angicele ukuthi ngihlele umhlangano." UMalema uthe ukuba wayekhona emhlanganweni wayezombuza uMkhwanazi le nto, wathi akamesabi uMkhwanazi. Uthe uMkhwanazi kufanele anikeze ubufakazi ikomiti lasePhalamende neKhomishini eholwa yiJaji Mbuyiseli Madlanga ukuze baphenye izinsolo azenzile.UMalema uphinde wachitha izinsolo zokuthi wagxambukela ekukhishweni kwamathenda kuMasipala waseTshwane.Ubufakazi obethulwe kwiKhomishini kaMadlanga ngeledlule, buveze ukuthi uMalema wathunyelwa uhlu lwezinkampani okwakufanele aqinisekisa ukuthi yizona afuna ukuthi zithole amathenda.UMalema uthe akakaze athunyelwe uhlu lwezinkampani okufanele zithole amathenda."Ningavumi ukuchukuluzwa ngezinto ezingathi shu. Kuthiwa kwathiwa angithunyelelwe uhlu kodwa akekho obuzayo ukuthi ngathunyelwa ngempela yini uhlu nokuthi ngaphendula ngathini? Ngiyabona abanye sebejabule, izinja zitshikizisa imisila. Bacabanga ukuthi bangibambile. Angihlangene mina nezinto ezibheke eceleni. Igama lami alikaze litholakale ezintweni ezingalungile."
UNGOTI ucebise uNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa omisiwe, uMnuz Senzo, ukuthi akhohlwe yipolitiki, avele ayozilusela izinkomo emva kokuba uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, ehlabe isinqumo sokuhlakaza ithimba lamaphoyisa eliphenya amacala okubulawa kosopolitiki. Umhlaziyi wezepolitiki waseNyuvesi yaKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Zakhele Ndlovu, uthe ulibona lifiliza ikusasa likaMchunu kwezepolitiki emva kokuba uRamaphosa ezihlangulile esinqumweni sokuhlakazwa kwethimba.URamaphosa utshele ikomiti lasePhalamende eliphenya izinsolo ezenziwa uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, ukuthi uMchunu akazange abonisane naye ngaphambi kokuthi akhiphe umyalelo wokuhlakaza ithimba. URamaphosa uthe uMchunu wamtshela ngoFebhuwari ngonyaka odlule ngokuhlakazwa kwethimba. UMchunu wakhipha umyalelo wokuba kuhlakazwe ithimba ngoDisemba ngo-2024.URamaphosa uthe akahambisani nokuhlakazwa kwethimba. Uthe isinqumo sokuhlakaza ithimba kwakufanele sithathwe uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa kuzwelonke, uLieutenant General Fannie Masemola. UNdlovu uthe impendulo kaRamaphosa ishayelela isipikili sokugcina. "URamaphosa ungaphansi kwengcendezi. Ziningi izinto ezilokhu zivela kwiKhomishini kaMadlanga (ephenya izinsolo ezifanayo). Lo muntu uyahola ekubeni sekucacile ukuthi asisekho isidingo sokuthi aqhubeke aphathe isikhundla. Umbuzo esizibuza wona uthi yisiphi isinqumo esizothathwa uRamaphosa."UNdlovu uthe uRamaphosa uzikhiphe ekukhulumeni ngokuzihlangula esinqumweni sikaMchunu."Naye ibimgaxelisa le nto uRamaphosa njengoba bekunemibuzo yokuthi yiziphi izinyathelo azithathayo ngesikhathi uMchunu emazisa ngokuhlakazwa kwethimba. Namanje ngisasho ukuthi kufanele engabe uRamaphosa ubiziwe ukuba ayochaza kahle ngalolu daba ekomitini nakwikhomishini."UNdlovu uthe uMchunu kufanele amukele ukuthi limnyama ikusasa lakhe kwezepolitiki. "Sekufanele aphonse ithawula, ayozilusela izinkomo ekhaya."UNdlovu uthe akaboni ukuthi uMchunu uzovuma kalula ukuyodla endala. "UMchunu uyakhombisa ukuthi akazimisele ukuphonsa ithawula. Uma ubuka imithandazo yabamesekayo uyabona ngempela ukuthi ithemba akakalilahli. Usasifuna isikhundla sokuba umengameli we-ANC. Usenalo ithemba lokuthi usengakwazi ukuthola isikhundla sokuba umengameli noma iphini likamengameli. Uma ubheka vele lapha KwaZulu-Natal akekho umuntu osethubeni lokuqokwa ngoba uma noMkhize (Dkt Zweli) naye akucaci kahle ngaye. Unenkinga nale nto yeDigital Vibes."UNdlovu uthe izinsolo zikaMkhwanazi zanyomfa izinhlelo zikaMchunu zokukhankasela isikhundla kwi-ANC. "Ngaphambi kwesithangami sikaMkhwanazi igama likaMchunu belilihle. Akakaze alandelwe yiphunga lenkohlakalo ngesikhathi ekuhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal nangesikhathi ephethe iminyango ehlukene kuhulumeni kazwelonke."
I-IFP isihleli ngokunethezeka kuMasipala waKwaNongoma emva kokuzidlela amahlanga okhethweni lokuchibiyela obelungoLwesithathu. Ukuhlwitha kwe-IFP ama-ward amabili abephethwe yiNFP KwaNongoma kusho ukuthi isinezihlalo ezanele ukuthi iphathe ngokuzimela.Njengamanje i-IFP iphethe ngokubambisana ne-EFF neNAPF.Ukunqoba ukhetho lokuchibiyela lwangoLwesithathu kusho ukuthi i-IFP isinezihlalo ezingu-23 kwezingu-45 kuMasipala waKwaNongoma. Imiphumela isho ukuthi i-IFP isiphethe ngokuzimela omasipala abangu-19.Okhulumela i-IFP, uMnuz Mkhuleko Hlengwa, uthe ukunqoba ama-ward amabili KwaNongoma kuzobuyisa uzinzo emkhandlwini. I-IFP ithathe wonke ama-ward obekunokhetho lokuchibiyela kuwona KwaZulu-Natal njengoba iphinde yanqoba ku-ward 12 kuMasipala wasebaQulusini. Le ward ibphethwe yi-ANC, i-IFP ishoda ngesihlalo esisodwa ukuze ikwazi ukuphatha ngokuzimela uMasipala wasebaQulusini.I-IFP isinqobe ama-ward angu-47 okhethweni lokuchibiyela kusukela ngo-2021.UHlengwa uthe ukunqoba ama-ward kukhombisa ukukhula ngesivinini kweqembu."Kukhombisa nozinzo olukhulu ngaphakathi kanye nasezinhlakeni zeqembu. Imiphumela ikhombisa ngokusobala ukuthi abantu bayayithemba i-IFP njengeqembu elingaletha uzinzo nohulumeni onesithunzi. Sifisa ukudlulisa ukuthokoza kwethu kubaholi, amavolontiya nezinhlaka zeqembu ezisebenze ngokuzikhandla ukuze sithole le miphumela emihle kangaka. Sinxusa amakhansela ethu amasha ukuthi asebenze ngobuqotho nokuthembeka."UHlengwa uthe i-IFP ikhombisa ukukhula nakwezinye izifundazwe.I-IFP ibingenele ukhetho lokuchibiyela kuma-ward amabili nase-Eastern Cape, kuMasipala waseBuffalo City, nowaseWinnie Madikizela-Mandela."Nakuba singanqobanga kodwa ukukhula kokwesekwa kwethu kukhombisa ukukhula kwe-IFP ehlezi isezinhliziyweni zabantu baseNingizimu Afrika futhi abahlezi befisa ukuyeseka."UHlengwa uthe sebebheke kakhulu ukhetho lohulumeni basekhaya oluzayo."Sizoqinisekisa ukuthi umgqigqo wethu obheke okhethweni lohulumeni basekhaya oluzayo awuphazamiseki."Kuzwelonke, i-ANC ilahlekelwe enye i-ward okhethweni lokuchibiyela obelusesifundazweni i-Eastern Cape.I-ward ebiphethwe yi-ANC kuMasipala waseDkt Beyers Naude ithathwe yiPA.I-ANC inqobe ama-ward amabili kuMasipala waseBuffalo City nakuMasipala waseWinnie Madikizela-Mandela.
KUQUBUKE impi yamazwi phakathi kwamalungu eMKP naweDA esiShayamthetho KwaZulu-Natal ngesikhathi kuvotelwa ukuphasiswa kohlaka lokwabiwa kabusha kwemali. Amalungu eMKP naweDA ajikijelane ngamazwi ngesikhathi kunenkulumo mpikiswano ebiyandulela ukuvotela isabelomali. Uhlaka obeluvotelwa lwethulwe ngokusemthethweni wuMphathiswa wezeziMali oyilungu leDA, uMnuz Francois Rodgers. Phakathi kwezinto eziqukethwe ohlakeni ukwabiwa kwemali engu-R146 million yokukhokhela abasebenzi bakahulumeni abafuna ukusheshe bathathe umhlalaphansi kanye nemali yokulungisa umonakalo odalwe yizikhukhula. Amalungu eMKP aluhlabe aluhlikiza uhlu. Athe imali eyabelwe ukukhuthaza abasebenzi bakahulumeni ukuthi basheshe bethathe umhlalaphansi izodala ukuthi sinyuke isibalo sabantu abangasebenzi KwaZulu-Natal. Ilungu leMKP, uMnuz Sithembiso Magubane, lithe abasoze beseke into eqhamuka nohulumeni wokubambisana ophethe KwaZulu-Natal. "Abantu baKwaZulu-Natal bavotela iMKP. I-MKP iyona okufanele engabe iphethe KwaZulu-Natal. Asisoze seseka into eyenziwa uhulumeni ophethwe abantu okungafanele baphathe."UMagubane usole uRodgers ngokwehluleka ukuthatha izinyathelo ngezinsolo zenkohlakalo eMnyangweni wezeMfundo, owezeMpilo nowezokuThutha."URodgers uhlulekile ukufaka le minyango ngaphansi kweso lomlawuli. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi lo hulumeni awuzimisele ukulwa nenkohlakalo."URodgers usole amalungu eMKP ngokungaqondi ukuthi uhulumeni usebenza kanjani.URodgers uthe ukuphikisana kweMKP nokuphasiswa kokwabiwa kabusha kwemali kusho ukuthi iMKP ichaza ukuthi awungalungiswa umonakalo odalwe yizikhukhula. "Uma iMKP iphikisana nokwabiwa kwemali kusho ukuthi ayihambisani nokuthi uMnyango wezeMfundo unikezwe u-R22 million wokulungisa izikole?"URodgers uthe ukuthatha umhlalaphansi kwabasebenzi eminyangweni kahulumeni akuzukunyusa isibalo sabangasebenzi."Iminyango izophinde iqashe abanye abantu abazovala izikhala. Umehluko wukuthi abazoqashwa bazobe behola kancane ngenxa yokuthi bazobe besemazingeni aphansi. Ngaleyo ndlela uhulumeni uzokonga imali."Ngesikhathi sekuvotwa amaqembu aphikisayo aphinde akhala ngaphansi.Amalungu avotele ukuba kuphasiswe ukwabiwa kabusha kwemali abengu-40, kwathi angu-39 aphikisa.Amalungu aphikisile angu-37 eMKP kanye namabili e-EFF.
OWESIFAZANE wasemakhaya endaweni yaKwaNdaba, KwaMaphumulo, uMksz Thabile Mwandla, uqengqeleza phambili emqhudelwaneni wosomabhizinisi besifazane abavelele emphakathini iNorth Coast Business Woman of the Year.UNksz Mwandla oyiClinical Technologist - ongumcwaningi wamaphaphu futhi ongusosayensi ekukhiqizweni kwamakhambi, udlana imilala noCrystal Naidoo, Verushka Nair, Andile Pieterson, Sibongile Ntusi, Nonhle Ngubane, Simonia Marimuthoo noNtethe Ndaba emunxeni we-Inspirational Woman of the Year kulo mncintiswano ozobanjelwa eSimbithi Country Club eBallito. Isolezwe lithole ukuthi le ntokazi iqokwe ngenxa yokuba usomabhizinisi owenza umehluko emphakathini wakuleli. UNksz Mwandla, ongaphansi kwenkampani yakhe i-Onkwelo Pty Ltd, uthe ukujabulele kakhulu ukuqokwa kulo mqhudelwano ngoba kusho lukhulu kuye futhi kuyamgqugquzela ukusebenzela umphakathi engabheke nzuzo.Akaziwa kuleli kuphela kodwa nasemazweni angaphandle ayaziwa amagalelo akhe njengoba esebenza nezinkampani zamazwe angaphandle ukuthola amakhambi amasha okwelapha izifo ezihlukene.Useke wavelela njengomunye wochwepheshe abasebenze ukuhlola ikhambi lokuzivikela kwiHIV eliwumjovo (PreP) osujovwa kabili ngonyaka. Uphinde futhi abe umnikazi wama-salon avelele eBallito, iMthaniya Hair Studio neBrighter Kidz Salon lapho eqashe khona abantu abasha abangu-12, asebeshintshe impilo yabo.Ngaphezu kwalokho uphinde abe ngumnikazi wenkampani engenzi nzuzo, iKaMwandla Foundation, ayisungula ukwenza umehluko entsheni evela ezindaweni zasemakhaya.Uhambela izikole ezihlukene abuye asize abantwana ukukhetha imisebenzi abangayifundela ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme asize nezinkampani ezizimele, okubalwa kuzo iNyala Brand. Uphinde axhase abafundi ngemali yokubhalisa ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme nangezimpahla zokugqoka ngenxa yokuthi uyalwazi usizi lwezingane ezidabuka emakhaya aqhelelene namadolobha amakhulu. Uphinde futhi abe umhleli wemicimbi ngaphansi kwenkampani yakhe iKaMwandla Eventz, okubalwa umcimbi omkhulu iTshatha Music Festival.Ukuvotela abaqokiwe kwiNorth Coast Business Woman of the Year, kungenwa ku-www.sabeautymodelling.com/vote-ncbwa.
Ngemuva kwesiphepho esinamandla, esihlasele izindawo ezahlu kumasipala waseMngeni, imeya uChristoper Pappas iphume nethimba lezinhlekelele ukuhlola umonakalo. Umbiko wokuqala walo masipala uveza ukuthi umonakalo omkhulu wenzeke ezindlini ezifulelwe nge-asbestos, izindawo eziningi nazo zibika amafasitela aphukile."Umasipala usezinhlelweni zokuthola impahla efanele ukusiza izakhamuzi ezithintekile futhi uzohlinzeka ngosizo lapho ludingeka khona kakhulu, kusho lo masipala ngesitatimende.
Basale enkundleni abasolwa ababili abebefunelwa amacala amane okubulala, okuhlanganisa nelokubulala isalukazi esineminyaka engu-84 nentombazane eneminyaka engu-13 ubudala. Amaphoyisa aqoqe ulwazi lwezobunhloli mayelana nokuthi abasolwa bakuphi nokuthe uma befika emzini karondo obekulele kuwo abasolwa kuMkhelekehleni Road, KwaNgcolosi, ezintatha zangoMgqibelo. Ngokubika kwamaphoyisa, kube nokudubulana phakathi kwawo nabasolwa ngesikhathi ezibika okuholele ekufeni kwabasolwa ababili. Awekho amaphoyisa agile.
ZIYIKLAME ziyiklamile kwindumezulu yomqhudelwano wengoma yasePlayhouse eCurries Fountain Stadium, eThekwini, ngoMgqibelo kusukela ngo-9 ekuseni.Kulo mqhudelwano waminyaka yonke, iSishaya Ingoma Competition, kulindeleke amaqembu angu-42 nazobe eliqhamukisa kuzozonke izifunda zaKwaZulu-Natal, ukuba azodlana imilala. Ngokusho kwesitatimende esithunyelelwe abezindaba, iyisikhombisa iminxa okuzobe kuqhudelwana kuyo. Kubalwe Isigekle, Ushameni, Ingoma Yezinsizwa, Ingoma Yezintombi, Ingoma Sikhuze, Indlamu noMzansi.Siqhuba isitatimende, sithe umqhudelwano osuqede iminyaka ewu-12 wasungulwa kulo nyaka, sewukhule kakhulu kangangoba sewubalwa neminye imicimbi eqhakambisa ubuciko namasiko kulesi sifundazwe. "Lo mncintiswano awusagcini ngokunikeza amaqembu engoma inkundla yokuba aveze amakhono awo kuphela kodwa sewuklama indima ebalulekile ekugcineni nasekugqugquzeli amagugu endabuko." Sithe abantu abazohambela umcimbi walo nyaka bazobhema bakholwe ngoba wonke amaqembu azimisele ngokukhipha amangwevu.Abagqugquzeli banxenxe bonke abantu bakulesi sifundazwe nakwezinye ezingomakhelwane ukuba batheleke ngobuningi babo bezozitika mahhala ngobuhle bomqhudelwano wengoma kuze kulamule ukushona kwelanga.
ZIMAPEKETWANE izinto esizweni sakwaNyawo eNgwavuma, njengoba indodana ibhekene ngeziqu zamehlo noyise omncane kubangwa isihlalo sobukhosi.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi siya ngokuya siyashuba isimo phakathi kweNkosi esisihlalweni uZithulele Gagashe Nyawo (33) kanye noyise omncane, uMnuz Solomuzi Nyawo (53).Ngokusho kowomndeni, uNksz Gugu Nyawo, izinxushunxushu ngombango wesihlalo sobukhosi bakwaNyawo ziqale ngo-1993, ngesikhathi kukhothama inkosi uMbabane Nyawo owayenamakhosikazi angu-14.UNksz Nyawo uthe inkosi uMbabane yayinamadodana amaningi kodwa uDiliza noMvini bobabili abangasekho emhlabeni, yibo okwakubonakala bezobanga isihlalo sobukhosi. Seyikhotheme inkosi uMbabane, uthe kwangena uMvini esihlalweni sobukhosi, yilapho-ke athi kwaqala khona ukuphambana kwezinkomishi.Uthe uMvini kwakungafanele ukuba angene kwesobukhosi ngoba wayezalwa uMaMkhize owayeyinkosikazi yesibili (ikhohlwa) yeNkosi uMbabane.Ngakolunye uhlangothi, uthe uDiliza wayezalwa uMaKwesaba (iqadi) owayeyinkosikazi yesithathu yeNkosi uMbabane futhi elotsholwe yisizwe - okwakumenza kube nguyena ozala inkosi njengoba nebala athola, uDiliza.NgokwesiZulu, uthe iqadi yilona Ndlunkulu ezala inkosi.''Asazi-ke ukuthi uMnyango wezokuBusa wenza kanjani njengoba kwathi uma kukhothama inkosi uMbabane kwase kungena uMvini ngendlela engafanele ekubeni ekhona uDiliza,'' usho kanjena.Elandisa, uthe uMvini wathatha izintambo zobukhosi waze wakhothama ngo-2023, kwase kungena indodana yakhe le esesihlalweni njengamanje, uGagashe.''Usuyabona-ke ukuthi ngenxa yephutha elenzeka kudala namanje ubukhosi abukho esandleni esifanele. Le nto iyasilimaza kakhulu lesi sizwe futhi iyasiqeda nje nya," usho kanjena.Uthe Solomuzi yena ungumfowabo kaDiliza (lo okwakufanele kungene yena emva kokukhothama kukaMbabane) okumenza (uSolomuzi) ukuthi kube uyena okumele ngabe usesihlalweni sobukhosi ngoba uDiliza amadodana akhe amabili wawathola entombini ngenxa yalokho angeke akwazi ukuhlala esihlalweni. Ukhala ngokuthi lesi simo sesidale ukuthi kube khona ukubhekana ngeziqu zamehlo phakathi kwendodana noyise wayo omncane.Ethintwa uSolomuzi, uvumile ukuthi zimapeketwane izinto esizweni ngenxa yokuthi uphucwe isihlalo sakhe sobukhosi ngendlela engaqondakali.Uthe ngeke athule nje agoqe izandla ekubeni okungokwakhe kungekho kuyena."Yimina okumele ngabe ngisesihlalweni sobukhosi kodwa kakunjalo, kunalokho kuhlezi indodana. Lokhu akukho kuhle futhi kungiphatha kabi ngenye indlela," echaza.Eqhuba uthe okumphatha kabuhlungu kakhulu ukuthi inkosi esesihlalweni njengamanje kuningi ekwenza ikuhlanakezele okuyinto athi izosiqeda nya isizwe. Uthe uzoqhubeka alwe kuze kube kufika isikhathi sokuba okukaKhesari kubuyena kuyena.''Bobabili uMvini noDiliza bangabafowethu kodwa kwehluka omama. Mina ngisohlangothini lwamadodana azalwa yiqadi sinomfowethu uDiliza," echaza.Inkosi esesihlalweni ithe lolu udaba ngolubucayi, icela ukubuyela entathelini uma isinesikhathi sokuthi ikhulume kahle lapho okuzobe khona kungekho umsindo.
UNAKA usungaphakathi esiqiwini iHluhluwe-iMfolozi Park (HiP) ukuthi kwesinye isikhathi abantu bazama ukuvakashela umhlaba wonke kodwa ubuhle balapha ekhaya bengabazi. Akuzona izilwane kuphela ezikukhanga kule ndawo engaphansi kwesifunda uMkhanyakude, kodwa nomlando wendawo wenza ibe ngehlukile ebalazweni lomhlaba. Lesi siqiwi, esisebangeni elingamakhilomitha angu-280 uma usuka eThekwini, sidala kunazo zonke ezwenikazi i-Afrika njengoba sasungulwa ngo-1895. Singudedangendlale njengoba singamahektha angu-96 000.Sizakhele elikhulu igama emhlabeni ngokuba yiso sodwa esakwazi ukuhlenga ubhejane omhlophe ukuba ungashabalali. Umlando waso uyigugu ngoba lolu hlobo lukabhejane bese lubhekene nenselelo yokuthi lungase lube yinzwabethi ezizukulwaneni ezizayo. I-HiP iyikhaya lezinhlobonhlobo zezilwane zasendle, kodwa igabe kakhulu ngezilwane ezinhlanu ezaziwa ngele-Big Five - okuyibhubesi, ubhejane, indlovu, ingwe kanjalo nenyathi. Akuzona lezi zilwane kuphela ezikhanga amehlo esivakashi kule ndawo. Ubuhle bezintaba namathafa ambethe ingubo eluhlaza yezihlahla notshani ayiphendula iPharadisi lasemhlabeni, nomqondo ujubalale emoyeni wakhona opholile othakwe ngomsindo wezinyoni ezitshiloza zenanelana. Khona lapha enqulwini!Uma uhamba ngemoto ulibangise ezindaweni zokuphumula ezakhiwe kule ndawo, uhamba ukhangwa amadube eduze komgwaqo, agabe ngemibala yawo egqamile. Izintibane zikhishazela eduze kwezindlela ngoba kuthiwa zikhonze ukudla utshani obusonqenqemeni lomgwaqo ngoba obakhona abubude.Uma usufikile ngaphakathi kunezinhlobonhlobo zezinto izivakashi ezingazenza ukuzijabulisa, nokuthakasela imvelo.Phakathi kwazo kungaba ukuhamba ngemoto yakhona eyakhelwe ukwehla yenyuka emahlathini, ithwele izivakashi ezisuke zimagange ukubona iBig Five kanye nezinye izilwane zasendle. Ohambweni lwethu sibe nenhlanhla yokuwabona ngamehlo amabhubesi, esiwabhadame ekhwelana. Obesiphelezela ongungoti walapha, uSamora Xulu, uthe kuyinto eyivelakancane ezivakashini, njengoba uke uphele unyaka kwabona bengayibonanga.Uchaze ukuthi ibhubesi aliyona ingozi kubavakashi abasuke behamba ngezinyawo esiqiwini. Phakathi kwezinto athe akufanele umuntu azenze, uthe ukwethuka, ukubanga umsindo ngokukhuluma kanjalo nokuphenduka ubaleke uma ulibona. "Uma ubanga umsindo livele libone sengathi uyingozi kulona, bese liyakuhlasela. Uma futhi ubaleka, ulinika umqondo wokuthi uyinyamazane, ngakho livele libone into okufanele liyijahe, liyibambe, liyiqhobozele,” kusho uXulu. Uchaze ingwe njengesilwane esinamahloni, esingazwani nomsindo, wathi uma sizwa umsindo wabantu noma sibabonela kude, sivele sicashe. Uthe indaba yonakala uma kwenzekile kwahlangana amehlo phakathi kwayo nomuntu.Elanda ngobhejane uthe imvamisa awuboni kahle emehlweni kodwa uthembela ekuhogeleni kanjalo nasemoyeni ukupopola ingozi.Isiqiwi saseHluhluwe siyikhaya lazo zonke izilwane eziwuphawu lweNingizimu Afrika njengoba sibone amabhubesi, obhejane, izindlovu, izinyathi, izindlulamithi, amadube, izintibane, izimpala nokunye. UXulu uthe iningi lezilwane zasendle, okubalwa kuzona zonke lezi okuthiwa ziyingozi, njengayo iBig Five, ziba nolaka uma zizele, azifuni lutho olusondela kuzo nasemazinyaneni azo.Siphinde sabuka nefilimu, iWild Hope, eqophe yaphinde yagcina umlando wokususwa kobhejane izimpondo ukubavikela kulabo abasuke befuna ukubazingela, bababulale. Le filimu ichaza kabanzi ngokuthi kuhlangana baphi ochwepheshe uma ubhejane uzonqunywa uphondo, lokhu kubandakanya lowo owujovayo ukuze utubeke ungezwa lutho, udokotela wezilwane, onquma izimpondo nabanye. Kuphinde kuvele ukuthi ukwenza wonke lo msebenzi kuthatha imizuzu engu-20 ubhejane ngamunye. Iphinde iveze nokuthi luphinde lukhule ngokuphelele uphondo emuva kwezinyanga ezingu-18 lunqunyiwe. IVulamehlo Craft, okuyindawo lapho kudayiswa yonke inhlobo yomsebenzi wezandla ayisalanga ngaphandle ezindaweni esizihambele. Kuyona kukhona abesilisa bendawo ababaza izinto zokuhlobisa ezehlukene ngesikhathi abesifazane begabisa ngekhono labo lokwenza izinto ezehlukene ngobuhlalu nokunye okwelukwayo. Sibuye sahambela ne-Nerve Centre yezobunhloli, lapho kugadwa abangena esiqiwini ngokungemthetho. Kule ndawo kubhekwa ukusebenza kwamakhamera, indiza enophephela emhlane, ama-drone kanjalo nezinja ezifuna umkhondo ngephunga.Impela iHiP akuyona indawo ongazisola uma wena nomndeni wakho nizikhiphela kuyo. Ungabuya ubheme wakholwa ngobuhle besiqiwi, izilwane ezikuso, abasebenzi abanobungani, ukudla okwehla esiphundu nezindawo zokulala ezinhle.
UVUTHA engabaselwe umzali womfundi oshayiswe wuthisha ngemoto waphuka esemagcekeni esikole ngoMsombuluko ekuseni.UMnuz Mandla Khuzwayo uthi indodakazi yakhe eneminyaka engu-16 efunda uGrade 7, e-Avoca Primary, e-Avoca, eThekwini, ilinyazwe ngemoto wuthisha wesifazane oyishayise yaphuka yaphuthunyiswa emtholampilo ngaso leso sikhathi.UKhuzwayo uthe okubanenga kakhulu wukuthi lo thisha wesifazane akakaze akhombise nokuncane ukuzisola lokhu.''Akanandaba nokuthi ulimaze ingane encane lo muntu. Iyangithusa indlela enza ngayo ungathi akukho nhlobo okwenzekile,'' usho kanjena.Uthe abakutholile wukuthi uthisha uhlehlele kumfundi obengemuva kwemoto.''Okusixakayo wukuthi kungani pho uthisha engaxhumani nathi ukubuza ukuthi umfundi udingani njengoba elimele nje. Konke kumele kwenziwe yithina sengathi le ngane ilinyazwe yithina,'' kuchaza yena.Uveze ukuthi kuyabaxaka ukuthi umfundi angalimala ngoMsombuluko kodwa kuze kube yizolo lutho uthisha ukuxhumana nomndeni.Ngokusho kwakhe lokhu kuveza ngokusobala ukuthi uthisha ungumuntu onjani.''Kuyacaca manje ukuthi lapha sibhekene nomuntu ongenandaba nempilo yezingane zethu. Okubuhlungu wukuthi siyisa izingane zethu esikoleni sithi ziphephile futhi zinabazali uma zihleli nothisha. Kuyacaca kodwa manje ukuthi empeleni sisuke sizikhohlisa nje,'' kusho yena.Echaza ngendlela alimale ngayo umfundi uthe uphukile emlenzeni kuyimanje uhamba ngezinduku. Uncome uthishomkhulu wathi kuze kwaba uyena okhombisa ubuntu ngokuzwelana nabo.''Uyena uthishomkhulu oze waveza ukuthi umfundi bazomphasisa akame kancane angezi esikoleni kuze kuba uyalulama ngokugcwele,'' usho kanjena. Lokhu uKhuzwayo uthi kubasizile njengoba eveza ukuthi usezinhlungwini umfundi.Uthe okubakhathazayo wukuthi ubonakala ethukile kakhulu selokhu kwenzeke lesi sigameko. Uveze ukuthi udadewabo omncane womfundi olimele useyesaba manje ukuya esikoleni uthi usaba ukuthi uthisha uzomshayisa ngemoto naye.''Uyabona-ke ukuthi inkulu kangakanani inkinga asesifake kuyona lo thisha ongenanembeza,'' kuchaza yena.Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Muzi Mahlambi, uthe bazoxhumana nomhloli kanye nothishomkhulu ukuthola kabanzi ngomnyombo wodaba.Uthe kuyakhathaza ukulimala komfundi wathi kodwa abakholwa wukuthi uthisha lokhu ubengakwenza ngamabomu.''Akekho uthisha ongamane avuke ekuseni eze esikoleni esophe ukuthi kukhona umfundi oyedwa nje azomlimaza ngemoto," kusho yena.Esimeni esifana nalesi uthe baye bakhuthaze ukuthi uthisha axhumane nomndeni aphinde alekelele ngezinye izindleko uma engakwazi ukuthi enze kanjalo.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu Natal uLieutenant Colonel Paul Magwaza usiqinisekisile isigameko. Uthe amaphoyisa aseGreenwood Park aphenya icala lobudedengu ngemuva kokuba uthisha elimaze umfundi ngemoto esikoleni.
UMPHATHISWA woMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, uhlabe eyokungapheleli komlando ngemifuziselo emibili yabaholi be-ANC esanda kwembulwa eThekwini. UButhelezi usho lokhu ngesikhathi ethula inkulumo yakhe yomcimbi wokuklonyeliswa komasipala abenze kahle KwaZulu-Natal, eDurban International Convention Centre (ICC) ngoLwesihlanu. UButhelezi uthe kayiphelele le mifuziselo uma ungekho owoMntwana uMangosuthu Buthelezi ongasekho, owayengumsunguli we-IFP, aphinde abe nguNdunankulu wesizwe samaZulu. Ube esenza isiphakamiso sokuthi iTheku, elakhe le mifuziselo esuse umsindo, lakhe owesithathu woMntwana. Kule mifuziselo kukhona oka-Oliver Reginald Tambo oseNorth Beach, bese kuba okaNelson Mandela osenkundleni yemidlalo iMoses Mabhida. Yomibili yembulwe nguMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ngasekuqaleni kwale nyanga. UButhelezi uthe umlando wenkululeko yaseNingizimu Afrika ophelele noneqiniso kufanele umhloniphe njengamanye amaqhawe omzabalazo uMntwana waKwaPhindangene ngeqhaza naye alibamba emzabalazweni. "UMntwana waKwaPhindangenewaba yibhuloho phakathi komshoshaphansi we-ANC ka-Tambo eyayisekudingisweni kanjalo nenkululeko entsha kaMandela. UMntwana wenza isiqiniseko sokuthi umzabalazo uyaqhubeka eNingizimu Afrika ngesikhathi uhulumeni wobandlululo ubavale imilomo oTambo noMandela, waba yizwi labacindezelwe. Ngakho ke ayiphelele le mifuziselo eseThekwini uma ungekho owakhe,” kusho uButhezi.Ukhale ngokuthi umlando oxoxwa ngale mifuziselo awuphelele uma uMntwana engafakiwe, wathi ukuhlonishwa kwakhe kanye namanye amaqhawe omzabalazo kuyoqinisekisa ukuthi umlando oxoxwayo ngomzabalazo uyakuveza ukubambisana kwabaholi okwabumba isizwe. Umsindo usuke ngale mifuziselo emva kokuvela ukuthi yakhiwe ngo-R22 million. Ebebegxeka ukwakhiwa kwayo kukhona kubo izinhlangano ezifana neThekwini Ratepayers Protest Movement kanjalo namaqembu epolitiki. Bathe ukwakhiwa kwemifuziselo kuwukuchitha imali ebingenza omkhulu umehluko ekulethweni kwentuthuko emkhandlwini ohlale uhaqwe yizinkinga. Nokho iMeya kamasipala, uMnuz Cyril Xaba, eziphungela wathi ukufakwa kwayo kungenye yezindlela zokutshala kwezokuvakasha, wathi imali okwakhiwe ngayo imifuziselo ikwibhajethi yeminyakazimali edlule, ayithathwanga emalini yokulethwa kwezidingo emphakathini.
UFISA kube wukuthi bese lihlehliswa okokugcina yiNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini, icala lokubulawa kwephoyisa laseCato Manor, eMayville, umndeni walo, olokhu ugqigqe njalo enkantolo.Usho kanje ngaphandle kwenkantolo izolo kulandela ukuvela kwabane ababhekene necala lokugwaza, babulale uSergeant Mondli Gabisa (39) ngoNovemba 8 nyakenye. Isidumbu sikaGabisa kuthiwa saficwa amaphoyisa sidindilize ngaphandle kwamaflethi aseMayville, kwavela ukuthi ugwazwe, wabulawa, emva kwengxabano nabasolwa, kanti isibhamu sakhe somsebenzi satholwa endaweni yesigameko. Amaphoyisa abe esebopha uMnuz Thalenta Griffiths Cele (42), Mnuz Philani "Maphila" Mhlongo (29), umfundi ka-matric uMinenhle Amahle Cele (20) noNksz Nadia Shezi (25). Isolezwe lathola ukuthi uThalenta noMinenhle bayizelamani.UMshushisi woMbuso, uMnuz Calvin Govender, utshele inkantolo ukuthi idokodo lisahleli ehhovisi loMqondisi wezokuShushiswa koMphakathi esifundazweni ukuze anqume ukuthi icala lizoyoqulwa kuyiphi inkantolo.Uveze nokuthi umbiko wokuhlolwa kwesidumbu nawo usashoda ophenyweni, iMantshi, uMnuz Ashwin Singh ibe isinquma ukuthi icala lihlehliselwe uMashi 27 nonyaka ukuze kuqhutshekwe nalolu phenyo. Udadewabo kamufi, uNksz Thobile Gabisa ephawula ngamafuphi uthe: "Sesikhulekela ukuthi uma selihlala ngokuzayo kube wukuthi selizonikwa inkantolo elizoqulwa kuyo.” Nokho uthe bayakuqonda ukuthi kokunye, ezobulungiswa zibuye zingasheshi njengoba besuke befisa."Nokho sinalo ithemba lokuthi ubulungiswa buzogcina benzekile,” usho kanje. Kuleli cala umsolwa wokuqala, owesibili nowesithathu basolwa ngokubulala umufi bese kuthi owesine asolwe ngokushaya unkosikazi kamufi okuthiwa wayehamba naye ngosuku lwesigameko. Ngesikhathi befaka isicelo sebheyili nyakenye, abasolwa abathathu abangasekuqaleni, okungoCele, Mhlongo noMinenhle, banqatshelwa ibheyili, kwathi owesine, wadedelwa ngeka-R1000 eyayihambisana nemibandela yokuthi angalenzi iphutha lokuzama ukuxhumana nenkosikazi kamufi. Emva kokuboshwa kwabo nyakenye, kwavela ukuthi uMinenhle uboshwa nje ubefunda u-matric futhi ubebhala izivivinyo zokuphela konyaka. Wazama ukukubeka lokhu njengelinye lamaphuzu okuthi adedelwe ngebheyili, nokho inkantolo yakushaya indiva.
UKHALELA izimpendulo ezihlotsheni zikamsolwa, umndeni wowesifazane waseMabaleni, eMahlongwa, eMkhomazi, okuthiwa ubulawe ngesihluku uyise wezingane entathakusa ngeSonto.Kulesi sigameko okuthiwa senzeke kubo kamsolwa eGqolweni, kufe uNksz Zinhle Khomo (35) obedume ngelikaNeneh.Ngokusho kukadadewabo, uNksz Ngane Khomo, umndeni wabizelwa esigamekweni wumakhelwane, osazi ukusuka nokuhlala isehlakalo. Uthe bathola ucingo kumakhelwane, lungekho olwase lushaywe wumndeni kamsolwa.Uthe ngesikhathi bephuthuma esigamekweni, bazithela phezu kwezimoto zamaphoyisa kanjalo nomphakathi usubuthene khona."Indlu yomxhaso, eyayiyindawo yesehlo, yayisihenqwe nge-tape yamaphoyisa, asiyalela ukuthi asiyoma ngakolunye uhlangothi. Yilapho esaqaphela khona ukuthi umsolwa usephakathi evenini yamaphoyisa ezama ukucasha ngokuthi alale phansi ngesisu,” kusho uNksz Khomo. Uthe akubona ubuningi begazi abazithela kulo ngesikhathi sebengeniswa ngaphakathi endlini yesigameko."Igazi lalisihlangabeza emnyango. Kwathi uma singena ekamelweni, salibona lisaphazeke odongeni, emakhethinini, kukhombisa ukuthi ubengqinyuzwa khona,” kusho uNksz Khomo.Uthe basibona isidumbu sikadadewabo, sithe ja embhedeni, eshaya ngesudi yesele. Uveze ukuthi babona insimbi eyayiphansi igcwele igazi, intambo kagesi, kanjalo nenye eyayilenga ophahleni lwekamelo, kokubili kugcwele igazi. "Sisola ukuthi njengoba isidumbu sakhe sasiphezu kombhede, wabuye wasethula entanjeni njengoba yayinegazi futhi naso isidumbu sinomhuzuko entanyeni,” usho kanje.Uthe baqaphela ukuthi wayelimele kakhulu ekhanda, emzimbeni eluhlaza yonke indawo kanti ezinye izitho zomzimba zazinamanxeba avulekile, kukhombisa ukuthi ushaywe ngento ebimdebeza.Uthe esebalandisa umakhelwane wathi yena weza endaweni yesigameko ebusuku, ezwa kukhala ubudukluduklu, nomufi ememeza, ezikhalela. "Wathi ngesikhathi engqongqoza ewindini nasemnyango, umsolwa, wavula umnyango maqede wamkhahlela wayowa le kude. Esevuka lapho waqaphela ukuthi udadewethu uyahlaselwa futhi hhayi kancane kodwa wangaba nawo amandla okumsiza, kunalokho, wavele wathatha indodana (4) yabo eyayikhona endlini, wagoduka nayo.Kuvela ukuthi ngale kwale ngane eneminyaka emine, ikhona enye eneminyaka emibili, okuthiwa yayilele noninakhulu ngosuku lwesigameko.Udalule ukuthi umakhelwane ebalandisa wathi emva kwemizuzu engu-30 wezwa ngomsolwa engqongqoza kwakhe, wafike waziceba ukuthi usembulele, maqede waphindela kubo. "Umakhelwane uthe akabange esalandelela ngoba wazitshela ukuthi njengoba ezosho kuye, usewubikele nomndeni wakhe, nokwagcina kuvela ukuthi kwakungenjalo, walala nesidumbu waze waziceba ekuseni,” usho kanje.Kuthiwa ekuseni esezicebile, washo ukuthi usefuna ukubaleka njengoba esewabikele namaphoyisa ngesigameko, nokho afika esekhona."Sibheke ubulungiswa ngokubulala udadewethu ngesihluku. Emndenini wakhe sifuna izimpendulo zokuthi ubulawa kanjani umuntu egcekeni elinabantu, bangezwa, futhi bangenzi lutho,” kusho uNksz Khomo. Uthe uma umsindo wazwiwa wumakhelwane, akukwazi ukuthi umndeni usegcekeni awuzwanga lutho.Uthe uninakhulu womsolwa wakhala ngokuthi libalahlile, ngokuthi indodana yakhe ibulale umuntu egcekeni.Uveze ukuthi umsolwa ubehlale emshaya umufi kangangoba ubebuye amvulele icala emaphoyiseni, aze amenzele ngisho nezincwadi zezivimbelo zenkantolo, nokho kuthiwa ubebuye akusule konke, babonakale sebeqale phansi bethandana.
NgoLwesine, mhla ka-19 kwephezulu, iNkantolo eNkulu yaseMgungundlovu igwebe u-Andile Wonderboy Ngcobo, Andile Sabelo Shezi noMongezi Nyathi odilikajele abangu-14 kanye neminyaka engu-121 bebhadla ejele. Lokhu kulandela ukuthi laba bobathathu betholwe benecala lokuqothula umndeni wakwaKhumalo, ePlessislaer phakathi kuka-Okthoba 2021 no-Okthoba 2022. Ukuhlasela kwalaba abathathu kwaqala ngesikhathi bephuca owesilisa isibhamu sakhe eMgungundlovu ngomhla ka-3 Okthoba 2021. Ngemuva kwamasonto amabili izelamani ezintathu zakwaKhumalo zadutshulwa eMbali Unit J, ePlessislaer. Ababili kuzelamani bashonela endaweni yesigameko kwathi oyedwa wasinda. Abaseshi bophiko lweProvincial Serious and Violent Crime Unit balubambele mathupha uphenyo kwase kwaba wukuthi bebopha uNgcobo, Shezi noNyathi ngokutholakala nezibhamu ezintathu. Imibiko yeBallistic ihlobanisa izibhamu nezigameko zokubulawa kwezelamani zakwaKhumalo ezimbili basebebekwa amacala okubulala. Ngokuqhubeka kokuqulwa kwecala, isisulu sesithathu sezelamani zakwaKhumalo esasinda abuya sahlaselwa sinomngani badutshulwa bafa. Emva kosuku kwadutshulwa abafana bakwaKhumalo, abasolwa babuyela kulo mndeni babulala abazali bezelamani. Lokhu kuthiwa bakwenza ukuqeda ofakazi. Abagcinanga lapho ngoba babulala omunye ufakazi obengudadewabo wezelamani zakwaKhumalo. Yena ehlaselwa esemcimbini esehlakalweni lapho kwadubuleka abantu abathathu bafa eMaqeleni eMbali Unit J. Uphenyo lubuye lwaxhumanisa uNgcobo, uShezi noNyathi emacaleni ayishumi (10) okubulala phakathi kwamanye, okukhona kuwo elokuzama ukubulala, ukugebenga besebenzisa isihluku nokutholakala nezibhamu ezingekho emthethweni.

ATHOLE ukuthi kukhona ukushayisana phakathi kolwazi alutholile kanjalo nalokho okubhalwe phansi, amaphoyisa agasele ehhovisi likasomabhizinisi osematheni, uMnuz Calvin Mathibeli, iCalvin and Family Security Services, eDurban North. Ngaphansi kombhidlango i-Operation Buyisa, ehlela ukususa izibhamu ezingekho emthethweni emphakathini, uphinde uqinisekise ukuthi izinkampani zonogada ziyawugcina umthetho. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe kuningi okukhathazayo abakutholile.Phakathi kwakho ubalule i-register ebigcwaliswe ngendlela engafanele, izibhamu ezingaficwanga kuleli hhovisi. UNetshiunda uthe ngokomthetho, umuntu okufanele abhekele ezezibhamu, wumnikazi wenkampani kodwa enkampanini kaMathibeli bathole ukuthi akunjalo, kukhona oqashelwe ukuthi enze lokhu."Lo muntu usitshele ukuthi inkampani inezibhamu ezingu-815 emabhukwini ayo kanjalo nasezisefweni. Lokhu okwamanje akuhambisani nerekhodi amaphoyisa analo ngoba lona lithi inkampani inezibhamu ezingu-850,” kusho uNetshiunda. Ngesikhathi abenkampani beveza ukuthi izibhamu ezingu-11 zisesiteshini samaphoyisa eNanda, uNetshiunda uthe buzobhekwa ubuqiniso balokho.Omunye umthetho amaphoyisa athole ukuthi uphuliwe wukuthi kwi-register, bekusetshenziswe ipeni lomsizi, elingacishwa noma yinini, esikhundleni sokuthi kubhalwe ngepeni lika-inki. Ngesikhathi sokushicilelwa kwephepha, amaphoyisa abengakawuqedi umsebenzi wawo kule ndawo. Wexwayise ngokuthi uma lezi zibhamu zingatholakali eDurban North, uphenyo luzodlulela phambili kwamanye amahhovisi enkampani aseNewcatsle, Western Cape, Gauteng kanjalo naseLimpopo. Uthe udaba lwezibhamu baluthathela phezulu ngoba zisebenza ebugebengwini obubucayi obubandakanya obokubamba inkunzi izimoto ezithwala imali, ukubulala, nokunye. Ucacise eyokuthi bazohlolisisa isibhamu kanjalo nenhlamvu ngakunye abakutholile. Wathi uma kukhona okutholakala kunogcobho, kuzovulwa amacala, bese kuboshwa okuzotholakala ukuthi baphambane nengalo yomthetho. Lo mbhidlango uqhubeke yize uMathibeli ezame wahluleka ukufaka isicelo esiphuthumayo sokuvimba ukuthi lokhu kwenzeke eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini.

IGCAGCELE esokeni isitimela sempilo sakwaTransnet, iPhelophepha, sihambela indawo yaseMakhwezini, KwesakwaMthethwa, eMfolozi, ukuhambisa usizo lwezempilo oluhlukahlukene.Lesi sitimela esisuke sihlome ngodokotela bezifo ezehlukene, sihambela izindawo ezehlukene eNingizimu Afrika. Kusukela ngoMsombuluko sihambele kule ndawo kanti kulindeleke ukuthi size sihambe ngoLwesihlanu oluzayo.Phakathi kosizo esiluletha emphakathini olwezinkinga zamehlo, amazinyo, olokwelulekwa ngokomqondo kanjalo nezinye ezivame ukumba eqolo, uma ogulayo ethi uyofuna usizo ngazo kodokotela abazimele. Esinye isakhamuzi, uNkk Ngenzeni Majola sithe: "Sisizakele kakhulu ngokufika kwesitimela endaweni yethu. Silutholile usizo ebesiludinga. Njengoba sifikile endaweni sisizakele ngoba sivame ukusihambela uma sifuna usizo.”Umphathi wesitimela, uMnuz Bheki Mendlula, uthe ngesikaTransnet, wathi silekelela uMnyango wezeMpilo ngokuletha usizo lwezempilo emiphakathini ehlukene.Uthe leli yisonto lokuqala bekule ndawo, wathi bazoze bahambe ngoLwesihlanu oluzayo. "Sizobona abantu bakithi abasezindaweni zasemakhaya, abadinga ukusizwa ezifweni ezehlukene. Silekelela ngosizo lodokotela bengqondo, abamazinyo, abamehlo, siphinde sibe nabakhipha imithi,” kusho uMendlula.Uqhube wathi kusukela befikile ngoMsombuluko endaweni, baqaphele ukuthi isidingo esikhulu esezinkinga zamehlo."Sibona bebaningi abantu abafuna usizo lwezinkinga eziphathelene namehlo. Sizozama ngakho konke okusemandleni ukuthi sibone abaningi, yize singeke sikwazi ukubaqeda bonke kodwa sizozama ukuziphusha ukuthi sibone abaningi,” usho kanje. Uthe bayazikhipha izizibuko ngoxhaso abaluthola kwabakwa-Eskom kanjalo nabe-OneSight EssilorLuxottica Foundation. IMeya kaMasipala waseMfolozi, uMnuz Xolani Bhengu, ihambela isitimela ngoMsombuluko ukuzosamukela, ithe bazoqinisekisa ukuthi basizwa ngezinsiza zokulala, labo abasuke besuka ezindaweni ezikude, okuvela ukuthi bafika ngayizolo, ukusondezela ukuthi basheshe bavuke, bathole usizo."Siye sibone isasasa ababanalo uma kuthiwa isitimela sihambele eMpangeni esiteshini, uthole abantu sebeyolalela ngakhona. Siwutholile umbiko wokuthi bakhona abafikile kwayizolo bezolala eduze. Sizobona ukuthi sibalekelela kanjani ukuze bangagcini sebelala ezitulweni,” kusho uBhengu. UBhengu uthe ukuphuma kwabo ngobuningi, kukhomba ukuthi abantu baludinga kangakani usizo isitimela esiza nalo.Uphinde wakushayela ihlombe nokuthathwa kwezitshudeni zasemanyuvesi ehlukene, nazo ezinikwa ithuba lokuthi zizokwenza uhlelo lokuthwasela umsebenzi kulolu hlelo."Nentsha yendawo eneziqu zasemanyuvesi, icoshe amathuba omsebenzi wokutolika, itolikela abantu abadala,” kusho uBhengu.
SESIGXEKWE nawuMphathiswa woMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka, isigameko sokubanjwa inkunzi kothisha abafundisa esikoleni iZamokuhle Primary, KwaMashu.Ngokusho kukaHlomuka, lesi sigameko senzeke ngoLwesihlanu, kanti abasolwa kuthiwa babakhombe ngezibhamu othisha ngesikhathi sesigameko.Uthe ngosuku lwesigameko abasolwa bagasele esikoleni, behlomile, bavalela unogada, base beqhubekela phambili nokubamba othisha inkunzi, bebaphuca izimpahla zabo ezehlukene. Phakathi kwasebeke baphatha lesi sikhundla kubalwa uMnuz Floyd Shivambu, Arthur Zwane, Sihle Ngubane noDkt Sifiso Maseko. Ezinye izinguquko ezenziwe yiMKP ngeledlule zithinta ubuholi baKwaZulu-Natal. UNOBHALA jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, uhlela ukuhlomisa impi ayibhekise kuMengameli waseMelika, uDonald Trump. UMbalula uzohola imashi lapho ababhikishi behlela ukuzwakalisa ukuthi ngeke bavume ukuthi elakuleli lishayelwe umthetho yiMelika. Umbhikisho okuthiwa owokuvikela amalungelo akuleli uqondaniswe nosuku lokugubha uSuku lwamaLungelo, olungoMgqibelo.Imashi enkulu izoba seGoli, eGauteng, besekuba khona ezoba sezifundazweni iKwaZulu-Natal, Eastern Cape neWestern Cape.EyaKwaZulu-Natala izoba seThekwini.UMbalula uthe imashi ivuleleke kubona bonke abantu bakuleli. Ekhuluma nabezindaba, izolo, uMbalula uthe imashi eyokuzwakalisa ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika iyizwe elizimele nokuthi elakuleli ngeke litshelwe amanye amazwe ukuthi alishintshe imithetho eyashaywa emva kokhetho lwango-1994 okubalwa kuyo nemithetho okuhloswe ngayo ukuthuthukisa abantu abamnyama. UMbalula usho kanjena nje inxusa laseMelika, uMnuz Leo Brent Bozell III, lisanda kuveza ukuthi uTrump usephelelwe yisineke sokubekezelela uhulumeni wakuleli ongafuni ukuhlangabezana nemibandela emihlanu ayibekela lona. UBozell III wathi uhulumeni waseMelika wayalela uhulumeni wakuleli ukuba ubuyekeze umthetho wokuthathwa komhlaba kanye nomthetho okuhloswe ngawo ukuthuthukisa abantu abamnyama kwezomnotho, iBroad Based Black Economic Empowerment.UBozell III wathi bayalela uhulumeni wakuleli ukuba ugxeke ukuculwa kweculo elithi 'Kill the Boer', uphinde usukumele nokubulawa kwabalimi.UUMbalula uthe ngeke bazenze lezi zinto ezifunwa yiMelika. "UBozell III wafike wazikhulumela umathanda. Asikhohliwe ukuthi wayephikisana nokuthi elakuleli libuswe ngpokwentando yabantu. Ngeke sishayelwe umthetho yinxusa."UMbalula uthe ngeke bayilaxaze imithetho ethuthukisa abantu abamnyama. "Uma uthi asiyeke le mithetho kufana nokuthi uthi asihlakaze i-ANC."UMbalula uthe kungamampune ukuthi kubulawa abamhlophe kuleli. Uthe ngeke baphoqe abantu ukuthi bayeke ukucula ingoma ethi "Kill the Boer"."Thina kwi-ANC asiyiculi le ngoma. Asisho ukuthi kukhona okubi ngokuyicula kodwa sayiyeka nje ngenxa yesikhathi esiphila kuso."UMbalula uthe akukhona ukuthi bahlezi befuna ukuphikisana noTrump.Uthe okubaqhathayo wukuthi uTrump akawuhloniphi umthetho.

Walenza kanjani iphutha elinje," kubuza uMkhize.Umasipala wadlelwa i-akhawunti yasebhange emva kokuba wehlulekile ukugcina isivumelwano sokukhokhela inkampani iRASP Consulting.Umasipala ukweleta iRASP Consulting imali engaphezu kuka-R120 million.Ngokwesivumelwano umasipala kwakufanele ukhokhele iRASP Consulting u-R3 million njalo ngenyanga.Umasipala wehluleka ukugcina lesi sivumelwano ngoDisemba nokwaholelwa ekuvalweni kwe-akhawunti yomkhandlu yasebhange.INkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu isanda kunquma ukuthi umasipala awubuyiselwe i-akhawunti yawo.Izikhulu zomkhandlu zitshele amalungu ekomiti ukuthi akuzange kulandelwe imigomo ngesikhathi kunikezwa iRASP Consulting ithenda ngo-2021.Izikhulu zomkhandlu zithe abukho ubufakazi obukhombisa ukuthi iRASP Consulting yawenza ngempela umsebenzi efuna ukuba ikhokhelwe ngawo.Amalungu ekomiti aphakamise ukuthi kuphenywe ngendlela umasipala osingathe ngayo lolu daba.UMkhize uthe bafuna ukuthi udaba luphenywe wuMcwaningi mabhuku kanye noMnyango wezeziMali KwaZulu-Natal."Ngo-2023 kwaba nencwadi eyabhalwa owayeyimenenja kamasipala, lapho athi umasipala ungaphinde usebenzisane nale nkampani.
