ISIKHULU soMnyango wezaseKhaya KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Cyril Mncwabe, sesinxuse abashaya omazisi bagcina ngokungabalandi, ukuthi babalande njengoba beduve emahhovisi abo. UMncwabe uthe bevile ku-100 000 omazisi abangalandiwe emahhovisi ehlukene esifundazweni.Uthe bakhuluma nothishanhloko bezikole, kanjalo nezinhlaka ezehlukene ukuze bahlabe umkhosi wokuthi kulandwe omazisi abaduvile."Kusuka ngoDisemba 2025, bangu-105 878 omazisi abangalandiwe emahhovisi ethu. Sinemikhankaso ehlukene okubalwa nokuya emisakazweni, ukunxenxa abantu ukuthi balande omazisi," usho kanje muva nje ekhuluma ekomitini lasePhalamende. Kulo mhlangano kuvele ukuthi abaneminyaka engu-15 kuya ku-35, yibona abaningi kakhulu kwabangabalandile omazisi."Kumahhala kulabo abaqalayo ukushaya omazisi abakhokhi nhlobo. Kunomazisi abadala abaluhlaza nabo abangalandiwe kwamanye amahhovisi. Asisabashayi omazisi abadala kodwa bakhona abangalandiwe emahhovisi ethu." Ngokombiko othulwe emhlanganweni, babalelwa ku-5 000 omazisi abaluhlaza abangalandiwe emahhovisi ehlukene. UMncwabe uveze nokuthi basemkhankasweni wokuhambela izikole ukuze abafundi abaseminyakeni yokuthi bavote, bathole ithuba lokushayelwa omazisi."Kunamaloli ahambela izikole ukuze kushayelwe abafundi omazisi. Sisebenzisana noMasipala weTheku, lapho kuhlonzwa khona izikole ezinabafundi abadinga ukushayelwa omazisi. Abanye abafundi balethwa emahhovisi aseMngeni, njengoba kunamavolontiya aya emphakathini ahlonze abafundi abadinga omazisi," usho kanje.Uveze nokuthi kunamabhange abantu abangaya kuwona ukuyoshaya omazisi okuyibhange iFNB enxanxatheleni yezitolo iCornubia, Nedbank eDurban North kanjalo naseStandard Bank egatsheni iKingsmead, eThekwini. Kwenzeka lokhu nje ikhomishini yezokhetho izovula ithuba ngempelasonto yangoJuni 20 no-21, 2026, ukuze abantu babhalisele ukuvota okhethweni.Phezu kokuba lungakamenyezelwa usuku lokhetho, kodwa kulindeleke ukuthi lube phakathi kukaNovemba noJanuwari ngonyaka ozayo.Ikhomishini iveze ukuthi bangaphezu kuka-200 000 abantu ababhalisele ukuvota kusuka ngoMashi nyakenye kuya kuMashi kulo nyaka. Kulaba abangu-132 092 babhalise besebenzisa uhlelo lobuchwepheshe, kanti abangu-128 113 babhalise emahhovisi ekhomishini. Abantu abasha yibona abanesibalo esiphezulu sababhalisile ngalesi sikhathi.Ikhomishini inomkhankaso wokuhambela izikole, lapho ifundisa khona abafundi ngokuvota iphinde ibagqugquzele ukuthi bavote. Ayigcini ngokuhambela izikole kodwa ibuye ivakashele nasezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme, lapho inxenxa khona izitshudeni ukuthi zibhalisele ukuvota.
LINGASE linyuke ngo-R4 ilitre likaphethroli ngenxa yempi ese-Iran.Izibalo zakamumva ezikhishwe yiCentral Energy Fund (CEF) zikhombisa ukuthi zombili izinhlobo zikaphethroli zizonyuka kakhulu ngenyanga ezayo uma intengo kawoyela iqhubeka nokunyuka emhlabeni jikelele.Izibalo zamaphakathi nenyanga ziphinde zikhombise ukuthi nodizili uzokwenyuka.Selokhu kuqale impi ephakathi kwe-Iran neMelika intengo kawoyela inyukile kakhulu emhlabeni jikelele.Kubikwa ukuthi intengo kawoyela emhlabeni inyuke ngo-50% kusukela kwaqala impi. Njengoba impi iqhubeka amanye amazwe aseqalile ukushodelwa wuphethroli.Nokho alikho itwetwe lokuthi kungase kushode uphethroli eNingizimu Afrika, okuvelayo wukuthi uzonyuka kakhulu.Izibalo ziveza ukuthi uhlobo lukaphethroli i-93 luzonyuka ngo-R3.87, bese kuthi i-95 inyuke ngo-R4.27 uma kungabanga khona izinguquko ngentengo ka-oyela.Uma uphethroli unyuka ngale mali kungasho ukuthi uzobiza ngaphezu kuka-R24 ilitha, nokuyinto eyagcina ukwenzeka ngasekuqaleni kuka-2024.Udizili wona uzonyuka ngo-R7 bese kuthi uparaffin unyuke ngo-R8.99.Akuyona impi yokuqala lena ezokuba nomthelela ebantwini bakuleli. Uphethroli wanyuka kakhulu kuleli ngesikhathi kuqala impi phakathi kwe-Russia ne-Ukraine.Kwaze kwaphoqa ukuthi uhulumeni ehlise intela kaphethroli ngo-R1.50 ngenxa yokunyuka mawala kukawoyelaUngoti wezomnotho, uMnuz John Loss, uthe ukunyuka kukaphethroli kuzoshaya kakhulu abahola kancane.ULoss uthe ngesikhathi kunyuka uphethroli ngo-2022 kwakhuphuka izindleko zokuthutha kwaphinde kwanyuka nokudla. Uthe lokhu kwashaya kwezwela kakhulu kulabo abahola kancane."Abantu abahola kancane abanayo imali yokugada izimo ezidalwa wukwehla kwamandla emali. Imali abayiholayo yanele izindleko zabo zenyanga."ULoss uthe kuzozwela nakulabo abahola kangcono."Ngenxa yokuthi abantu abaningi lapha eNingizimu Afrika baqoka ukusebenzisa izimoto zabo, ukunyuka kukaphethroli kuyazwela kakhulu ebantwini abaningi."
LIHLEHLELE uLwesihlanu, ukuze afake isicelo sebheyili owesilisa osolwa ngecala lokudubula, abulale iphoyisa lophiko lwePresidential Protection Unit eNewtown A, eNanda, ngo-Ephreli nyakenye.Umufi, uSergeant Sanele Dlamini (37), wakuyo le ndawo, wadutshulwa, wabulawa abasolwa abangaziwa ngo-Ephreli 2025. Ngokusho kokhulumela oKlebe KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant Colonel Simphiwe Mhlongo, umsolwa wakamumva, uMnuz Kwanele Khatheni (27) uboshwe ngoLwesithathu, wavela eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseNtuzuma ngoLwesihlanu. Ngosuku lwesigameko, kuthiwa uDlamini owayengekho emsebenzini, ehamba ngemoto yakhe emgwaqweni uMafukuzela eNewtown A, wama eduze negaraji waya esitolo esingaphesheya."Ngesikhathi elinde ukuthenga, wahlaselwa abasolwa. Wakwazi ukukhipha isibhamu sakhe somsebenzi, wadubula ephindelela kubasolwa, oyedwa wabo naye wamdubula uDlamini, waphumelela ukumphuca isibhamu sakhe somsebenzi,” kusho uMhlongo. Uthe wabe esephuthunyiswa esibhedlela ngemoto yakhe kodwa kwatholwa ukuthi useshonile ngesikhathi efika. Uthe kwavulwa icala lokubulala esiteshini samaphoyisa saseNanda, ithimba loKlebe kwaba yilo eliya endaweni yesigameko."Kwavela ulwazi lokuthi oyedwa wabasolwa uyiswe emtholampilo wendawo, amaphoyisa ase enikela khona, nokuyilapho afike amfaka ngaphansi kweso lamaphoyisa, kwavela ukuthi unguMnuz Ntuthuko Nzama (27),” kusho uMhlongo.Uveze ukuthi wabe esevela eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseNtuzuma emva kwezinsuku ezimbalwa, nokuyilapho asaqhubeka nokuvela khona njengoba esagqunywe esitokisini. Uthe uphenyo lwamaphoyisa luhambe lahamba laveza ukuthi uNzama wayiswa emtholampilo uKhatheni, okuthiwa wafike wazibiza ngoSipho, nokwaholela ekutheni angasheshe aboshwe njengoba zigcine zimkhalela ngoLwesithathu. Uveze ukuthi ngesikhathi kulindeleke ukuthi uKhatheni afake isicelo sebheyili ngoLwesihlanu, uNzama yena uzovela enkantolo efanayo ngoLwesithathu njengoba kuzobe kuqhubeka ukuqulwa kwecala lakhe.
UKhomishana wamaPhoyisa e-KZN uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi uzoqhubeka nesikhundla sakhe sobuholi esifundazweni njengoba inkontileka yakhe isivuselelwe ngeminye iminyaka emihlanu.Ukwelulwa kukaMkhwanazi kuza njengoba inkontileka yakhe bekumele iphele ekupheleni kukaMashi. Esitatimendeni esicacise ngalesi simo, uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa uFannie Masemola uveze ukuthi imininingwane yokugcina yokuvuselelwa kwenkontileka iyasetshenzwa."Sisezinhlelweni zokuphothula leyo mininingwane, ngakho yebo, usazoba nguKhomishana wesiFundazwe e-KZN," kusho uMasemola."Sinobudlelwano obuhle bokusebenza, futhi uNdunankulu wavuma ukuvuselelwa kwenkontileka. Ngakho-ke, sisebenza nje ukulungisa," engeza.
IHLANGANISA izinyunyana zabasebenzi bakahulumeni, impi yokulwa nokunyuswa kwemali okwenziwe yi-Government Employees Medical Scheme (GEMS). Lezi zinyunyana zamashela i-GEMS ngokunyusa imali ngo-9.5% ekuqaleni konyaka. Abalesi sikhwama babala inkohlakalo, ukunyuka kwezindleko kanjalo nokukhokha imali ephezulu bekhokhela amalungu e-GEMS ngosizo lwezempilo, njengesizathu esenza banyusa imali. I-GEMS yaqala yanyusa imali ngo-9.8% ekuqaleni konyaka, yehla emuva kwezikhalazo zabasebenzi yaya ku-9.5%.Izinyunyana zifuna kwehliswe imali okunyuswe ngayo kuphinde kwakhiwe kabusha ibhodi lale nhlangano. UMnuz Simon Hlungwani osekomitini elilwa nokunyuswa kwemali ngaphansi komfelandawonye wezinyunyana iCosatu, uveze ukuthi bazitholile izimpendulo emva kokuhambisa uhlu lwezikhalazo emashini eyayibhekiswe kwi-GEMS."Simatasa sibhunga ngezithinta lezi zimpendulo nomnyakazo olandelayo esizowenza ukufaka ingcindezi yokuthi kwehliswe imali. I-GEMS ifuna ukuthi kube nomhlangano ekupheleni kwenyanga," usho kanje.Uthe omunye umnyakazo abawenzayo ngukuhlwaya izeluleko zomthetho ngokuphoqa i-GEMS ukuthi igobe uphondo."Abameli bethu baphezu kodaba, bayalusebenza kumanje. Sixhumana nezinye izinyunyana ezingekho ngaphansi kweCosatu mayelana nalolu daba," usho kanje. Unxuse amalungu ukuthi angadikibali kodwa aqhubeke aqinise impi ebhekiswe ekunyusweni kwemali.Ngeledlule i-GEMS idalulele iPhalamende ukuthi iphenya amacala evile ku-400 enkohlakalo avulelwe odokotela nabanye abahlinzeka ngosizo lwezempilo. La macala athinta ukusebenzisana kwamalungu alesi sikhwama nalaba abahlinzeka ngosizo lwezempilo.I-GEMS ikhale ngokuthi ngonyaka, ilahlekelwa phakathi kuka-R3 billion kuya ku-R9 billion ngenxa yenkohlakalo, ukuxhashazwa nokusetshenziswa budlabha kwe-medical aid. Isikhulu esibhekele inkohlakalo kwi-GEMS, uMnuz Ishmael Mohapi, sithe nyakenye baphenye abahlinzeka ngosizo lwezempilo abangu-399, abaxebule umkhoma imali engu-R1.3 billion kulesi sikhwama nyakenye uwodwa."Sivule amacala angu-413 emaphoyiseni eminyakeni edlule, uphenyo luhamba ngolonwabu. Sesikwaze ukubuyisa imali engu-R11.7 million ebuyele kulesi sikhwama," sisho kanje.Ngonyaka, i-GEMS ithe ichitha u-R67 billion ikhokhela izindleko ekubeni amalungu ekhokha ngonyaka u-R65 billion."Ziphezulu izindleko ezikhokhelwa odokotela, izibhedlela ezizimele kanjalo nongoti. Ngaleyo ndlela bekumele sinyuse imali ukuze sihlangabezane nezindleko ezinyukayo minyaka yonke," sisho kanje. UNgqongqoshe weziSebenzi zikaHulumeni nokuPhatha, Inkosi Mzamo Buthelezi, waveza ukuthi wakuchitha ukunyuswa kwemali okwenziwa yi-GEMS.UButhelezi wathi akuyena ogunyaza ukunyuswa kwemali kodwa kwenziwa yibhodi le-GEMS. I-GEMS iveze ukuthi ziyaqhubeka izingxoxo nezinyunyana zabasebenzi ngokunyuswa kwemali.
UKHALE ngezingozi zomgwaqo ezidlula nabantu abevile ku-12 000 minyaka yonke kuleli, uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, athe bafuna ukuzehlisa eminyakeni ezayo.URamaphosa okusho lokhu ngesikhathi evula ingqungquthela yezokuthutha eGoli, izolo, uthe uma kuphazamiseka imigwaqo kulahleka u-R1 billion emnothweni ngosuku."Sihlela ukulehlisa inani lezingozi ezidlula nabantu abevile ku-12 000 minyaka yonke. Sihlela ukuzehlisa ngohhafu lezi zingozi ngonyaka u-2030." Uthe imigwaqo iyona engenisa inzuzo njengoba izimpahla eziningi zihanjiswa ngayo."Imikhankaso efana nokujuba abezomthetho emigwaqweni emikhulu kuleli, ithela izithelo njengoba sesiqala ukwehla isibalo sezingozi. Ngonyaka odlule, sehlile isibalo sezingozi uma uqhathanisa neminyaka emihlanu edlule," usho kanje.Uphakamise ukuthi kusungulwe umkhandlu wezokuthutha njengoba u-69% wezimpahla kuleli, zithuthwa ngomgwaqo."Asidingi ukuthi silahlekelwe u-R1 billion ngosuku ngenxa yokuphazamiseka emigwaqweni. Sidinga ukuqinisa kwezinye izinto zokuthutha okubalwa amaguzu athwala impahla." Uthe umkhandlu uz0ohlanganisa zonke izinhlaka kubalwa uhulumeni, osomabhizinisi kanjalo nezinye izinhlaka."Kungaheha abatshalimali, kwehlise nezindleko zokwenza ibhizinisi uma sinezokuthutha ezithuthukisiwe. Ezokuthutha zibaluleke kakhulu emnothweni wezwe nakubantu jikelele." Uveze ukuthi kungakheka namathuba emisebenzi kuphinde kugqugquzele ezokuvakasha. "Abalimi bakwazi ukuhambisa imikhiqizo yabo besebenzisa ezokuthutha. Kuhanjiswa nezinto ezimbiwa phansi ziyiswe kwamanye amazwe kusetshenziswa ezokuthutha." Uveze ukuthi amanye amazwe atshala imali ekuthuthukiseni ezithinta izitimela ezithwala impahla kanjalo nezithinta amachweba."Izikhukhula nokuguquka kwesimo sezulu kucekela phansi ingqalasizinda yezokuthutha. Sidinga ukwakha ezokuthutha ezizohambisana nokuguquka kwesimo sezulu," kusho uRamaphosa.Uveze nokuthi imboni yamatekisi ithutha u-80% wabantu kuleli kanti iyona enkulu eyenganyelwe ngabantu abamnyama. "Sisebenzisana nemboni yamatekisi nababolekisa ngemali, ukuze abanikazi bamatekisi bakwazi ukubolekwa imali. Ezokuthutha kumele zifake uwonke wonke kuleli." Ubuye waveza nokuthi ezinye zezinto ezihanjiswayo kuleli zihamba olwandle wabuye wathi akumele ukuya kwamanye amazwe ase-Afrika, kuthathe isikhathi eside uma kuhanjwa ngamabhanoyi.
AMAPHOYISA akholelwa ukuthi umlisa oboshelwe icala lokubulala ufakazi owethula ubufakazi ngokuyimfihlo kwiKhomishini ephenya izinsolo ezenziwa uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, waqashelwa umsebenzi wokusoconga uMnuz Marius Van Der Merwe ngoba kwaziwa ukuthi uzoshaya ithulamsindo ngenxa yokuthi uke wasebenzela uphiko lwamaphoyisa olungageji ngenhlamvu.Okhulumela amaphoyisa, uBrigadier Athlenda Mathe, uthe abaqasha uMnuz Matopandile Sotheni, ukuba abulale uVan Der Merwe, bamlanda ngoba nakhu bazi ukuthi wathola ukuqeqeshwa okusezingeni eliphezulu ngesikhathi ejoyina uphiko lwamaphoyisa olukhethekile i-Special Task Force.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba, eNkantolo yeMantshi eBrakpan, lapho bekuvele uSotheni.Ummangalelwa uthweswe icala lokuhlela itulo lokubulala, elokubulala ngenhloso nawokuzama ukubulala unkosikazi nezingane zikaVan Der Merwe. UVan Der Merwe wasocongwa phambi komndeni wakhe. Wadutshulwa umuntu owayesemotweni eyayidlula, emva kokwethula ubufakazi phambi kweKhomishini eholwa yiJaji uMbuyiseli Madlanga.Ngesikhathi ethula ubufakazi, uVan Der Merwe waninda abantu abaningi okukhona kubo namaPhoyisa kaMasipala waseKurhuleni.Okhulumela amaphoyisa, uBrigadier Athlenda Mathe, uthe uSotheni wayesebenzela uphiko lwamaphoyisa olukhethekile phakathi kuka-2010 no-2019."Wadubula esemotweni. Umuntu ongakwazi ukwenza le nto umuntu osiqeqeshelwe ngempela isibhamu. Wadubula kabili kuphela, uVan Der Merwe wabulawa inhlamvu eyodwa. Lokhu kukutshela ukuthi kwaqashwa uSotheni ngoba babazi ukuthi uzoshaya ithulamsindo. Amaphoyisa angaphansi kophiko olukhethekile athola ukuqeqeshwa okusezingeni eliphezulu. Ingakho bamthemba uSotheni."UBrigadier Mathe uthe uphenyo luveza ukuthi uSotheni waqala ukulandela uVan Der Merwe ngoNovemba, waze wamdubula ngasekuqaleni kukaDisemba.UBrigadier Mathe uthe uSotheni wayehamba nomsolwa owazibulala, uMnuz Wiandre Pretorius, ngesikhathi esoconga uVan Der Merwe. "UPretorius uyena owayeshayela imoto. Empeleni uPretorius uyena owayengumsolwa wokuqala kuleli cala."UBrigadier Mathe uthe imoto eyasetshenziswa ngesikhathi kusocongwa uVan Der Merwe eyentombi kaSotheni.Uthe bazosiphikisa isicelo sebheyili sikaSotheni."Uyingozi emphakathini ingakho sizosiphikisa isicelo sakhe sebheyili."UBrigadier Mathe uthe uSotheni utholwe nenqwaba yezinhlamvu ngesikhathi eboshwa, wathi kungenzeka kuboshwe abanye ngecala lokubulawa kukaVan Der Merwe njengoba kusaqhubeka uphenyo.
UMAQHUZU we-SAPS uMajor-General Richard Shibiri okumanje umisiwe emsebenzini, ugile izimanga izolo ephikisa ubufakazi obushayisanayo nalobo abebethule phambilini ngo-Lieutenant General Shadrack Sibiya. Phambilini uShibiri ubethe kunohlangothi lwezikhulu zamaphoyisa ezisebenzisana nemigulukudu ebizwa nge-"Big 5" kodwa wala waphetha ukuveza amagama. Ebufakazini bayizolo kuhlale obala ukuthi kunoqhekeko ezikhulwini zamaphoyisa nokwenza ukuthi kube nzima ukuphenya ubugebengu obuhleliwe. UShibiri ungomunye wosigaxamabhande be-SAPS osekuvele ukuthi wathola intshontsho lemali ayibiza ngeyokubolekwa kusomabhizinisi obhekene noxhaxha lwamacala, uMnuz Vusimuzi "Cat" Matlala. Ekuqaleni kwesonto bekuphikiswana naye ngo-R70 000 awunikwa wuMatlala athi wayewubolekile ngoba exinwe yizindleko. Kuvela ukuthi kuzo izinsuku lezo wakhithiza izimpahla zikanokusho esitolo seGucci nesakwaLouis Vuitton eSandton.Okushiwo uShibiri kuqinise izimpawu ezifakazela izinsolo zokuthi iziphathimandla ze-SAPS ezisezikhundleni ezimqoka beziphakelwa wuMatlala, ogama lakhe liyamaniswa nethenda yamaphoyisa ka-R360 million.Kuleli sonto buqhubekile nokuvela ubufakazi bokuthi izikhulu zamaphoyisa bezikhangeza kuMatlala, okungaqondakali nokho wukuthi kungani lo somabhizinisi osebalwa nabasolwa abayingozi kuleli ebesondele kangaka kubantu abathenjwe ngokuthi bazolwa nobugebengu ezweni.Kuyavela ukuthi uMatlala wayephenywa wuphiko oluphethwe wuShibiri ngesikhathi kunokushintshana ngalo-R70 000. UShibiri utshele ikhomishini ukuthi lena kwakungeyona imali yokumgwazela ukuba avikele uMatlala ophenyweni.Okuqaphelekayo wukuthi le mali wayikhokha emva kokuba amaphoyisa egasele emzini kaMatlala lapho ayeqhuba khona uphenyo. Akuyena yedwa uShibiri owake wathola imali kuMatlala.Owayengungqongqoshe wamaphoyisa, uMnuz Bheki Cele, wazivumela yena ukuthi wake walala kwaze kwaba yizikhawu ezimbili emzini kanokusho kaMatlala ngesikhathi esePitoli. UMatlala wathi wakhokhela uCele u-R500 000, nokuyizinsolo uCele aziphikayo. UMatlala wathi wakhokhela uCele le mali ukuze amlekelele ezinkingeni abhekene nazo.IPhini likaKhomishana wamaPhoyisa elimisiwe, uLieutenant-General Shadrack Sibiya, nalo lisolwa ngokwamukela imali kaMatlala. Ngokwezinsolo, uMatlala waqala ukunikeza uSibiya izishaqane emva kokuthola le thenda ka-R360 million emaphoyiseni. Kuthiwa imali yayifika kuSibiya iphethwe ngezikhwama.Kunezinsolo zokuthi uMatlala wathengela uSibiya izimpahla. USibiya waziphika zonke lezi zinsolo. USibiya naye wenza izinsolo zokuthi iphini likakhomishana wamaphoyisa elibambile, uLieutenant General Hilda Senthumule, lahlomula kuMatlala.USibiya wathi uMatlala wakhokhela uhlelo lukaLieutenant General Senthumule lokutona izinqe olwaziwa ngokuthi iBrazilian Butt Lift (BBL). Nokho uLieutenant Senthumule uziphikile naye lezi zinsolo, wathi wazilungisela ngemali yakhe izinqe zakhe.Elinye iphoyisa okwavela ukuthi lalithola izipho kuMatlala, uBrigadier Rachel Matjeng. UBrigadier Matjeng wazivumela yena ukuthi wathola izipho nemali kuMatlala. Echaza ngalezi zipho, uBrigadier Matjeng wathi babesothandweni oluvutha amalangabi noMatlala.Nakuba zonke izikhulu ezithintekayo ziziphika izinsolo zokuthi zazigwazelwa uMatlala, kukhona umusi onephunga elifanayo. Umsebenzi ohlalele iKhomishini nabaphenyi owokuthi kungani osomaqhuzu bamaphoyisa babe yimikhovu ephakelwa usomabhizinisi oseyikazela izinsolo zamacala obugebengu kangaka?
KUQOPHEKE umlando usomabhizinisi, uDkt Bahle Zondo wenkampani yomshwalense, i-Amahle Benefits Scheme, enikelela osomabhizinisi abasafufusa ngo-R19 million ukuze bakwazi ukuzithuthukisa.Lokhu kwenzeke kwindumezulu yomcimbi wokugubha ukuhlanganisa iminyaka engu-19 kwale nkampani. Umcimbi bukade useCecil Emmet, eVryheid, ngoMgqibelo ntambama.Ekhuluma emcimbini uZondo, uthe uyakholelelwa ekufukulweni kosomabhizinisi abasafufusa. Uveze ukuthi unothando olujulile ngezolimo.Uthe yingakho kuzohlomula kakhulu abalimi abasafufusa kulolu xhaso.''Sibone kumqoka kakhulu ukuthi kube khona esikwenzayo ngenhloso yokulekelela abalimi. Sibone kungcono ukuthi sifake isandla ngenhloso yokuqinisekisa ukuthi kuba khona esikwenzayo ukufukula abalimi abamnyama," echaza.Uthe akanakho nokuncane ukungabaza lokhu ngokuthi lolu xhaso luzobonakala luhamba ibanga elide ekuthuthukisweni kwabalimi basemakhaya.''Iminyaka yethu engu-19 sithathe isinqumo sokuthi siyijabulele ngokuthi silekelele abalimi bakithi kanye nabanye osomabhizinisi abasafufusa ngosizo lokubaxhasa," usho kanjena.Inhlosongqangi yalolu hlelo uthe ukufukula abalimi abancane ukuze kuzohlomula nabantu abasezindaweni ezisemakhaya."Umnotho wasemakhaya ungabonakala ukhula uma banda osomabhizinisi ababonakala bedlondlobala," echaza.Uthe i-Amahle ngesikhathi eyisungula yayiwumbono wokulekelela abantu ngomasingcwabisane onentengo ephansi kodwa wabuye wabona isidingo sokuthi alethe olunye usizo ebantwini besaphila."Yilapho okuqhamuke khona ezinye izinhlangano ezifana neBZ Farming, i-Dkt Bahle Zondo Foundation neBursary Scheme,” kusho uZondo.Uthe maqondana neBZ Farming, ulekelela kakhulu abantu basemakhaya ukuze bakhule kwezolimo, wakhuthaza abantu abasha ukuba bangabi madolonzima ukungena kwezolimo ngoba bangakwazi ukuziphilisa baxoshe nekati eziko.Osomabhizinisi abahlomulile lapha babonge banconcoza ngalolu xhaso bathi abangabazi ukuthi luzoklama indima enkulu ekutheni bathuthuke.UNkk Victoria Ngobese ongomunye wabahlomulile, uthe bayabonga kakhulu kuZondo ngoba kuningi abafundisa khona mayelana nezolimo. Uthe uZondo uyena owadala ukuthi babe nothando olujulile lalo mkhakha.Kulo mcimbi bekukhona noNkk Nomfundo Mcoyi-Zondo weCebolethu.
ZIYAQONGA izinkinga ebandleni lamaRoma ezidalwa ukunyundelwa koFata baleli bandla abasolwa ngokuba nomoya wobungoma.OFata okukhulunywa ngabo nguFata Thembelani Ngcobo wePherishi yaseMontclair noFata Sifiso Ndlovu wePherishi yasePinetown.Amalungu ebandla lamaKhatholika kuleli sonto abhale incwadi eshubile eyibhekise ngqo koyiNhloko yebandla kwiDayosisi yaseThekwini, uMbhishobhi Mandla Jwara.Isolezwe lizibonele le ncwadi okuvela kuyo ukuthi ibhalwe ngomunye wabazalwane baleli bandla ezwakalisa ukukhathazeka kwakhe. Isihloko sencwadi sithi : ''SESIKHATHELE SINGAMAKHOLWA.''Maningi amagama ashubile abhalwe kule ncwadi. Kukhona lapho okufundeka khona kanjena. Abanye baze bayongcebeleka phesheya, besithule nje sibuka.'' Uma eqhubeka lo mzalwane ushaya phansi ngonyawo uthi akekho umuntu azomxosha ngoba yibona abenza leli bandla lime futhi libe nenqubekela phambili.Uma eqhubeka usola uMbhishobhi ngokuthatha izinqumo ngakuzwa ngabantu, umsola ngokuba ntekenteke njengoba ethi uyahluleka ukuzithathela ezakhe izinqumo.Uyaqhubeka enze isibonelo ngoFata Vezi ongasekho emhlabeni unaye okwakuthiwa unobungoma, uthi waze wahamba emhlabeni kodwa akekho umuntu owamxosha ebandleni lamaRoma."Ukusibukela phansi ukufaka abantu ekhefwini lempoqo ungasitshelile isizathu sokwenza njalo. Wena Mbhishobhi awusihloniphi. Asidlali la.''Kunencwadi lapho uMbhishobhi eziphendulela khona. Uqhuba athi ngeke futhi uMbhishobhi akhulume esidlangalaleni ngodaba lokushintshwa koFata.''Uma uthi anineme ngendlela abaxoshwe ngayo. Baxoshiwe? Baxoshwe ngubani? Ungakwazi ukuveza incwadi lapho okuvela khona ukuthi baxoshiwe,'' ubuza kanjena uMbhishobhi encwadini.Uqhuba utshela lo mzalwane ukuthi uma ebona sengathi kukhona lapho enze khona iphutha kulolu hlelo ucela aveze lapho eqe khona umthetho webandla.''Le ncwadi ngiyithola ingididisa kakhulu, ngaphezulu kwalokho ukhombise okukhulu ukuba luhlaza lokhu.''UMbhishobhi ubuye ezwakalise ukukhathazeka kwakhe ngegama elisetshenziswe obhalile uma ethi : HLANGANA ZULU. AMEN.''Phela lesi akusisona isiqubulo sebandla lamaRoma Akhatholika. Lesi siqubulo sikuveza ngokusobala ukuthi wena iPherishi yebandla esePinetown usuyiguqule wayenza ePherishi yamaZulu.''UMbhishobhi uphetha ngokukhuthaza lo mzalwane ukuthi njengoba sebesesontweni lesibili likaLente kungakuhle agxile kulokho.''Ngingakujabulela kakhulu ukuthola incwadi yakho yokuxolisa. UBUBOSHELWE icala lokuzama ukubulala umfowabo umgulukudu weqembu lezigelekeqe, iWest, okuthiwa ugcine ubulawa amaphoyisa esiteshini saseNtuzuma, kulandela ukuzama ukuwadubula.Kulesi sigameko okuthiwa senzeke ngezikhathi zasekuseni, kufe lona wesilisa oneminyaka engu-22. Umthombo weSolezwe olwazi ukusuka nokuhlala udaba, uthe umufi ubekade elandwe amaphoyisa kubo ngoMgqibelo ngecala lokuzama ukubulala umfowabo. "Uboshwe amaphoyisa kubo eNtuzuma, ngecala alenza khona,” kusho umthombo.Omunye umthombo nawo olwazi kahle udaba uthe amaphoyisa amathathu, obekukhona kuwo amabili esifazane, nelilodwa lesilisa ahlaselwe wumufi ngesikhathi emthatha izithupha esitokisini."Ngokuphazima kweso uvele wawahlasela. Uthathe isibhamu sephoyisa elilodwa, kwaba ukuthola kwakhe amandla,” kusho umthombo. Uqhube wathi yilapho ekwaze khona ukuwaphuca okhiye, wakhiyela wona esitokisini,” usho kanje.Uthe uzamile ukudubula ebhekise emaphoyiseni, kwasho ukuthi isicabha sesitokisi esensimbi.Uveze ukuthi ugcine enqotshwa amaphoyisa angene ngaphakathi esitokisini esebenzisa imigudu engabonakali esophahleni. "Ubevele elwa kwangoMgqibelo ngesikhathi eboshwa,” kusho umthombo. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uqinisekise isigameko, wathi umufi udutshulwe amaphoyisa, ambulala emva kokuthi ezame ukuwabulala. "Umufi ubeboshwe ngoMgqibelo ngecala lokuzama ukubulala. Udutshulwe amaphoyisa, ambulala emva kokuthi ezame ukuwabulala esitokisini esigcina iziboshwa izolo ekuseni,” kusho uNetshiunda. Echaza kabanzi ngabakutholile beyisifundazwe uthe amaphoyisa amabili abesesitokisini, ematasa nokwenziwayo uma umsolwa ebekwa icala. Uthe kuthe kusenjalo, umsolwa wawahlula ngamandla, waqala wawashaya, wawaphuca ukhiye womnyango omkhulu."Akwazile ukubiza amanye, ukuze alekelelwe. Kusondele amaphoyisa abengawugqokile umfaniswano, azobahlenga,” kusho uNetshiunda. Uthe umsolwa uphuce elilodwa lawo isibhamu, wabe esedubula, ewavalele esitokisini. "Athole indlela yokuvika ngobuchule, ngesikhathi elokhu eqhubeka edubula. Lesi simo siqhubeke imizuzu emningana ngaphambi kokuthi kufike amanye amathimba amaphoyisa, akwazi ukumgojela,” kusho uNetshiunda. Uqinisekise eyokuthi kulesi siwombe, kulimale amaphoyisa amabili, elesifazane nelesilisa.Uveze ukuthi wonke amaphoyisa abevinjezelwe wumufi azoke athi ukuma kancane emsebenzini, esahamba uhlelo lokwelulekwa ngokwengqondo.
UYAQINA umkhankaso wempi yokulwa nabantu bokufika abakuleli ngokungemthetho njengoba KwaZulu-Natal, abasePakistan nabaseMalawi kuyibona abanesibalo esiphezulu, abaphindiselwa emazweni abo.Lokhu kuvezwe yisikhulu esiphezulu eMnyangweni wezaseKhaya KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Cyril Mncwabe, otshele ikomiti lasePhalamende, ukuthi abavela kula mazwe yibona abanesibalo esiphezulu abababuyisela emazweni abo.UMncwabe uthe sevile ku-3 000 isibalo sabakuleli ngokungemthetho abababuyisele emazweni abo emakoteni amathathu edlule onyaka."Bangu-948 abakuleli ngokungemthetho esibathatha sibashiye emingceleni eyakhelene nesifundazwe, ukuze babuyele emazweni abo. Abangu-2 141 sibasusa eKZN, sibayise koLindela eGauteng, ukuze babuyiselwe emazweni abo," usho kanje. UNksz Hlengiwe Mkhaliphi ilungu lePhalamende elimele i-EFF, libuze ukuthi abakumaphi amazwe abantu ababuyiselwa emuva."Ngibuza ngoba ngifuna ukwazi ukuthi akugxilwa kuphela kubantu abamnyama, abanye bashiywe ngaphandle."UMncwabe ukuqinisekisile ukuthi isibalo esiningi sabababuyisela emuva, abadabuka ePakistan naseMalawi. Uveze nokuthi bazokwandisa isibalo sabasebenza ophikweni lwabokufika eMnyangweni. UMnuz Sihle Ngubane weMKP ufunde uhlu lwezikhalazo ezivela kubasebenzi besifazane abasebenza ophikweni olubhekele abokufika."Bakhala ngokuhlukumezeka, ukungahlinzekwa ngezinsiza ezifana nozankosi nama-pepper spray ekubeni besuke behambisa abokufika besilisa ezinkantolo. Bakhala ngokuthukwa, bahlukunyezwe nangakwezobulili baphinde bangaphephi uma behambisa laba besilisa abangokufika," usho kanje.UMncwabe uthe bakhona nabesilisa abane abasebenza kulolu phiko ehhovisi laseMngeni, eThekwini. "Sizokwandisa abasebenzi abangu-10 kulolu phiko, cishe ezinyangeni ezimbalwa ezizayo sizobe sesisandisile isibalo sabasebenzi ukuze kwehle umthwalo. Abokufika esibashiya emngceleni eyakhelene nesifundazwe, basuke bevela eLesotho naseSwaziland," kusho uMncwabe. Umqondisi jikelele eMnyangweni, uMnuz Tommy Makhode, uthe udaba lwezikhalazo zabasebenzi besifazane eMngeni, yinto abangayithatheli phansi bewuMnyango.Kulo mhlangano kubuye kwavela izikhalazo ngezinkinga emahhovisi ahlukene oMnyango. Phakathi kwezikhalo yindaba yokungabi sesimweni esihle sokusebenzela kulawa mahhovisi, abantu ababamba olayini eMnyango bashiswe yilanga baphinde banethwe yimvula, kanjalo nabahamba amabanga amade uma beyoshaya omazisi eJozini.Kuvele ukuthi amanye alawa mahhovisi okubalwa elisePinetown naseMgungundlovu, kunezinselelo osekuneminyaka zibikwa ngawo. EMgungundlovu kukhalwe ngokuthi abantu babamba olayini emnyango ngoba kushoda indawo. IPhini likaNgqongqoshe eMnyangweni, uMnuz Njabulo Nzuza, livumile ukuthi kunezinselelo eseziqede iminyaka zikhona kwamanye amahhovisi okubalwa nelasePinetown."Ngaziyela mathupha emahhovisi asePinetown, ngo-2021, sathenjiswa ukuthi maduzane azoyiswa kwesinye isakhiwo. Kwaba nezinkinga kwagcina kungenzekanga. Mhlawumbe sekumele sizifunele mathupha amahhovisi njengoMnyango, njengoba lo msebenzi wenziwa uMnyango wezemiSebenzi kaHulumeni," usho kanje.Uthe uMnyango wakhe iwona okhokha irenti emahhovisi aqashiwe, ayikhokhwa wuMnyango wezemiSebenzi kaHulumeni. Usihlalo wekomiti lezaseKhaya, uMnuz Mosa Chabane, ukhwele wadilika eMnyangweni wezemiSebenzi wathi akumele uthi uyazazi zonke izinkinga okukhalwa ngazo kodwa kumele uzilungise ngoba zineminyaka zibikwa.Uthe amanye amahhovisi ayingozi kubantu kanjalo nakubasebenzi ngenxa yokungabi sesimweni.Kugqugquzelwe ukuthi kusetshenziswe amabhilidi kahulumeni ngoba omastende abazimele bayagoloza ukulungisa amabhilidi aqashiwe.
UZIBHALELE esikoleni esingumakhelwane izivivinyo ngoLwesihlanu, u-matric wasesikoleni i-Webbstown Combined, eCabazi, eXobho, njengoba kuqhubeka umbhikisho wabazali abangeneme ngezinto ezehlukene ezenzeka esikoleni.Lokhu kuvezwe usihlalo wesigungu esilawula isikole (SGB), uMnuz Morgan Shezi, ngesikhathi ethintwa yiSolezwe ukuze aphawule ngobhikisho osuqhubeke isonto lonke kulesi sikole."Kuphoqile ukuthi u-matric ucelelelwe kwesinye isikole esikhona endaweni yaseXobho. Sikhathazekile,” kusho uShezi. Uvumile ukuthi kukhona izikhalo kubazali ababhikishayo, ezimayelana nothisha abathathu abangasezi esikoleni okukhona kubo nothishanhloko."Kuyiqiniso ukuthi abekho esikoleni. Kukhona uphenyo olwenziwe, thina ebesisalinde umphumela walo. Abazali bavele bahlukana phakathi, kukhona abalindile njengathi, bese kuba khona abavele bakhetha ukubhikisha,” kusho uShezi ongafunanga ukwanda kakhulu ngenkulumo, ngelithi kusalindwe umphumela wophenyo olwenziwe abahloli. Ngesikhathi Isolezwe lithola ngodaba ngomthombo, lixhunyaniswe nomunye wabazali ababhikishayo, othe abasamfuni uthishanhloko wesikole ngoba sekumhlule iminyaka ukusiphatha. Umzali uMnuz Mjabulisi Chiya uthe sekunesikhathi bebhalela uMnyango wezeMfundo ngezinkinga ezikhungethe isikole kodwa bengaphendulwa. Uthe sebedinga uMphathiswa wezeMfundo, uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka, noma iNhloko yoMnyango uMnuz Nkosinathi Ngcobo, ukuba basondele kubona.Utshele Isolezwe ukuthi kuningi okuqhubeka esikoleni abangeneme ngakho bengabazali. Phakathi kwakho kukhona othisha abazenzela umathanda esikoleni, abafika sekwedlule isikhathi, baphinde bahambe isikole singakaphumi ngale kokucacisa ukuthi basuke bebanjezelwe yini noma bephuthumaphi.Uphinde waveza ukuthi kukhona abafundi abanikwa umyalelo wokuthi bahlale emakhaya ngenxa yokungabi bikho kukathisha ozobafundisa."Abafundi abafunda uGrade 4 bahleli emakhaya selokhu kuqale unyaka. Ngokuvulwa kwezikole, babuya nomyalezo wokuthi esikoleni kuthiwe abangabe besaqhubeka nokuza ngoba akekho uthisha ozobafundisa,” kusho uChiya. UChiya uqhube wathi nasemabangeni aphezulu esikoleni kunenkinga efanayo njengoba kukhona izifundo ezintathu ezingafundwa ngenxa yokuthi othisha abekho. Uthe bakhathazekile ngemfundo yabafundi abenza uGrade 4, wathi bayazibuza nokuthi laba bezifundo ezingafundwa emabangeni aphakeme bazobhalani njengoba kuqalwa ukubhalwa kwezivivinyo zokuphela kwekota yokuqala sonyaka.Ubuye waveza nokuthi bengabazali bathola ukuthi isikole sikhokhela umshini wokugaya amaphepha osebenza ebhizinisini lamakhaza likathishanhloko. "Sathola ngalokhu ngo-2023, ngesikhathi kucutshungulwa izitatimende zokusetshenziswa kwemali yesikole. Kwavela ukuthi isikole sikhokhela imishini yokufothokhopha emibili ekubeni esikoleni kukhona owodwa. Kwathi uma sekuphenywa, kwavela ukuthi owesibili usebhizinisini lamakhaza likathishanhloko,” usho kanje.Uveze nokuthi kuneminikelo enikelwa yizinkampani ezizimele ngenhloso yokuthuthukisa isikole, okugcina kungaziwa ukuthi iphelelaphi."Umnikelo owanikelwa abakwaTransnet ukuthi isikole sakhelwe amathoyilethi owawungu-R100 000 akwaziwa ukuthi washonaphi, awazange akhiwe futhi akakaze aphendule ukuthi washonaphi,” kusho uChiya. Uqhube wathi kukhona omunye futhi ophinde walethwa yinkampani efanayo ukuthi kwakhiwe amakilasi, nawo phinde waphelela emoyeni.Uthe konke lokhu bakubikile ezincwadini abazibhalele uMnyango ezingeni lesifunda kanjalo nesifundazwe."Sesikhethe ukubhikisha ngoba siyabona ukuthi sibhala izincwadi ezingakaze ziphendulwe muntu. Sesifuna yena uHlomuka noma uNgcobo beze kithi bezochaza,” usho kanje. Uveze ukuthi okubenza bangahlaliseki, umthelela ovela emiphumeleni ka-matric njengoba isikole sibe semsileni ngo-60% ezikoleni zendawo ngonyaka odlule. Waphinde wathi bakhathazwa nawukuthi isibalo sabafundi siya ngokuya sehla njengoba abanye abazali bebonakale bezikhipha izingane zabo esikoleni, beziyisa kwezinye.Kushaye isikhathi sokushicilela uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal ungakaphefumuli ngalolu daba.
