Nokho umshushisi omkhulu ecaleni, u-Advocate Elvis Gcweka, ucele ukuthi icala lihlehliswe ngenxa yokuthi ummeli kaChonco ubengekho enkantolo. "Sicela kuhlehliswe ukuze ummeli kaChonco ezokuba khona lapha enkantolo lapho bezoqedela khona izinhlelo zokuvuma icala."UChonco wakuveza ngesikhathi icala lisaqulwa eNkantolo yeMantshi eHowick, ukuthi ufuna ukulivuma icala.Emasontweni amabili edlule omunye umsolwa, uMnuz Khayelihle Shabalala, naye uveze ukuthi uzolivuma icala.Lokhu kusho ukuthi abasolwa abaphika icala Inkosi uZuma noMnuz Thobani Masobho Hlongwa. Omunye umsolwa, uMnuz Zwelithini Buthelezi, yena usaphenduka ufakazi wenkantolo.UNdlovu uyisihlobo seNkosi yakwaZuma, wabulawa phambi komdeni wakhe ngo-2023, kuthiwa wabulawelwa ukuphikisana nokukokotelwa kukagesi nokudayiswa komhlaba kamasipala.Inkosi iphinde yavela kafushane enkantolo ngalo uLwesihlanu, lapho ibhekene khona namanye amacala amabili okubulala.Inkosi ibhekene necala lokubulala owayengundunankulu wesizwe sakwaNxamalala, uMnuz Qalokunye Zuma, kanye nelokubulala owayephikisana nokudayiswa komhlaba womasipala eMpophomeni, uMnuz Xolani Ntombela/Ndlovu.Ecaleni lokubulawa kukaNtombela/Ndlovu, Inkosi iboshwe noChonco noMnuz Thembelani Mbatha. Omabili la macala ahlehliselwe uLwesihlanu.Ukuhlehla kwala macala kusho ukuthi Inkosi isazoqhubeka nokubhadla ejele.Inkosi ilokhu yagqunywa ejele maphakathi nonyaka owedlule. Yaqala yadedelwa ngebheyili ecaleni lokubulala uQalokunye kodwa yabuye yaboshelwa ukubulala uNdlovu.Isicelo sebheyili senkosi sachithwa ecaleni lokubulawa kukaNdlovu, ibingakasifaki isicelo sebheyili ecaleni lokubulawa kukaNtombela/Ndlovu.
Luqale kabi usuku emaphoyiseni asesiteshini saseNtuzuma ejikelwa yisiboshwa esineminyaka engu-22 ubudala kungazelele muntu ngoMsombuluko ekuseni.Ngokusho kukaColonel Robert Netshiunda, umsolwa waboshwa ngoMgqibelo ngecala lokuzama ukubulala owomndeni ekhaya.ngemuva kokuthi isiboshwa okuthiwa sihlule iphoyisa ngamandla salibamba isibhamu sashiya inqwaba yamaphoyisa evaleleke ngaphakathi ebhilidini.Ngokusho kwabeReaction Unit South Africa (RUSA), isiboshwa sihlule iphoyisa ebelingaphakathi ezitokisini esiteshini samaphoyisa eNtuzuma ebelizomthatha limubeke icala ngokusemthethweni kwasukathuthuva."Kubikwe ukuthi isiboshwa sihlule iphoyisa ebelingaphakathi ezitokisini ngamandla saphuca iphoyisa izikhiye zasesitokisini,kusho Prem Balram okhulumela iRUSA.Okhulumela amaphoyisa uthi kufike amanye amaphoyisa ukuzohlola isimo ngemuva kokuzwa umsindo, isiboshwa lesi sagxuma sahlala sithathela iphoyisa isibhamu savulela ngenhlamvu khona lapho.Alikho iphoyisa elidubulekile ngesikhathi kwenzeka lokhu, kuze kwafika amanye amaphoyisa asinqoba ngenhlamvu isiboshwa. Ngokusho kukaGarrith Jamieson we-ALS Paramedics, umsolwa ubulawe ngesikhathi kudutshulwana namaphoyisa.Okhulumela amaphoyisa uRobert Nethsuinda uthe amaphoyisa amabili alimale kancane ngesikhathi kuqubuka ingxabano, kodwa awadubulekanga.Ubuye waveza ukuthi yize umsebenzi uqhubeka ngokujwayelekile esiteshini, amaphoyisa athintekile kulesi sehlo azotholelwa usizo lokwelulekwa ngokwengqondo.
UBUKEKA usekude ukuphela umdonsiswano wasezinkantolo wokumiswa ukushicilelwa kwemiphumela ka-matric emaphephandabeni. Lo mbango uphakathi koMnyango weMfundo eyisiSekelo nenhlangano i-Information Regulator (IR).I-IR iyaphikisana nokuthi kushicilelwe le miphumela emaphephandabeni, ekubeni uMnyango umile ekutheni uyaqhubeka nokushicilela imiphumela ngoba abanye abafundi basuke bekude nezikole uma kukhishwa imiphumela ekuqaleni konyaka.Kulindeleke ukuthi iNkantolo eNkulu yaseGoli, inqume kuleli sonto mayelana nokuthi iyavumelana ne-IR, ukuthi idlulise isinqumo senkantolo efanayo sanyakenye, esachitha isicelo sale nhlangano mayelana nokuthi le miphumela ingabe isashicilelwa emaphephandabeni. Muva nje, le nkantolo ilalele izethulo zabameli boMnyango nabe-IR ngalolu daba. I-IR ikhala ngokuthi ukushicilelwa kwemiphumela emaphephandabeni kubeka engcupheni ulwazi lwabafundi ngaphansi komthetho i-Protection of Personal Information (POPIA). Phezu kokuba uMnyango waveza ukuthi ushicilela le miphumela usebenzisa kuphela izinombolo zokubhala kwabafundi, hhayi amagama nezibongo zabo kodwa i-IR yathi lokhu kuyafana nokudalula ulwazi lwabafundi.I-IR ifuna ukuvunyelwa yile nkantolo ukuthi isidlulisele phambili isinqumo sayo sokuthi lolu daba luyolalelwa eNkantolo yezokuDluliswa kwamaCala. Uma le nkantolo igcina ivumile ukuthi i-IR isidlulisele phambili lesi sinqumo, lokho kuyosho ukuthi udaba oluthinta i-POPIA luzobhekwa kabusha yile nkantolo. Okwamanje isinqumo sokushicilelwa kwemiphumela emaphephandabeni simile. I-AfriForum yahlanganyela noMnyango enkantolo njengoba ihambisana nesinqumo sawo sokuthi uqhubeke nokushicilelelwa kwemiphumela emaphephandabeni.Sekuneminyaka kubangwa lolu daba lwemiphumela emaphephandabeni. Phambilini, kwakushicilelwa amagama nezibongo zabafundi emaphephandabeni kodwa kwagcina kushintshiwe emuva kwengcindezi yokuthi lokhu kwenza abanye babafundi bazibulale uma bengaziboni emaphepheni. Lokhu kwenza uMnyango wanquma ukuthi ugcine usushicilela izinombolo zokubhala zabafundi.
UNGQONGQOSHE wamaPhoyisa osamisiwe, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, uhlose ukubhalela i-ANC mayelana nesinqumo sakhe sokuhoxa emisebenzini yeqembu aqhubeke nemisebenzi yakhe yenhlangano.UMchunu useke wavela phambi kwekomiti lesikhashana lasePhalamende kanye nakwiKhomishini kaMadlanga, waziphendulela ngesinqumo sakhe sokuhlakaza i-Political Killings Task Team (PKTT) nokuphendula izinsolo zenkohlakalo, ikakhulukazi mayelana nobudlelwano nosomathenda kanye nokuphazamisa ukusebenza kwamaphoyisa.Lokhu kungemuva kokuthi uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant-General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, esole uMchunu ngokuyalela ukuthi kuhlakazwe i-PKTT ngoDisemba 31, 2024, ngaphandle kokubonisana nobuholi bamaphoyisa kuzwelonke, okuthiwa wakwenza ngoba evikela abathile. UMkhwanazi waveza nezinsolo ezithi uMchunu unobudlelwano namaqembu ezigebengu kanye nosomabhizinisi ongundabamlonyeni, uMnuz Vusimusi "Cat” Matlala.Eyokuthi uMchunu unqume ukulobela uNobhala Jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, iqinisekiswe ngumkhulumeli wakhe, uMnuz Sithembiso Mshengu, othe lokhu kulandela ukuhlaziya ukuvela kwakhe ekomitini lePhalamende nakwiKhomishini kaMadlanga yophenyo.UMshengu uthe uMchunu kungenzeka abhalele uNobhala Jikelele we-ANC, uMbalula, ecela imvume yokuqhubeka nomsebenzi wakhe wezepolitiki.Yize i-National Executive Committee (NEC) ye-ANC yasichitha isicelo sakhe sokuhoxa emsebenzini weqembu, uMchunu wagcizelela ukuthi uzithandela ukuthatha ikhefu emsebenzini wakhe kwi-NEC nakwi-National Working Committee (NWC) ukuze abhekane nalezi zinsolo ngokucacile.Yize kunjalo, i-ANC ikuqinisekisile ukuthi ubizelwe phambi kweKhomishini Yobuqotho yeqembu - uMshengu akuqinisekisile ukuthi uMchunu usevele kabili kuyona. Lokhu kulandele ukuba enikwe ikhefu angalicelanga emsebenzini wokuba nguNgqongqoshe wezamaPhoyisa.UMshengu uthe njengoba esephethile ngezethulo zakhe phambi kwekomiti lasePhalamende nangeKhomishini kaMadlanga, uMchunu ukholwa wukuthi usekulungele ukuqhubeka nomsebenzi wakhe kwi-ANC."Kwaba wuhlelo lwakhe ngokuzikhethela ukumisa ukuhlanganyela kwakhe ezinhlakeni ze-ANC ngencwadi ayibhalele uNobhala Jikelele we-ANC. Manje usesimweni lapho ekholwa ukuthi usekulungele ukuqhubeka nomsebenzi wakhe ngaphandle kokucindezelwa wukulungiswa kwezitatimende zobufakazi. Futhi yizona sisekelo lezo zokuthi afune ukubuyela emisebenzi ye-ANC," kusho uMshengu, wengeza ngokuthi uMchunu akakaze abekwe icala.UMshengu naye usho okufanayo ngesikhathi kunomkhuleko kaMchunu eThekwini, ngoMgqibelo.Alinganiselwa ku-32 amabandla aphuma ezifundeni ezehlukene eKZN, ahambele inkonzo yokweseka uMchunu obesekhefini eliyisipesheli kusukela ngoJulayi nyakenye.Umhlaziyi wezepolitiki, uMnuz Ntsikelelo Breakfast ekhuluma ne-IOL, uthe lokhu kuzoba nzima kuMchunu nakuKhongolose njengoba kunefu phezu kukaMchunu.Uthe ukuphawula kukaMchunu ngesikhathi evele ekomitini lasePhalamende kuzokwenza kube nzima ukuthi abuyele akhulume emibuthanweni ye-ANC."Kuzoba nzima kakhulu ngoba ziningi izinto azishilo uMkhwanazi okubalwa ubudlelwano (nosomabhizinisi uMatlala) kanye nezinsolo ngokusebenzisana nemigulukudu, nokuthi wasithatha kanjani isinqumo sokuhlakaza i-PKTT. Ezinye (zalezi zinsolo) sezisekwe ngobufakazi,” kusho uBreakfast, oveze ukuthi baningi ofakazi abaqinisekise ukuthi bayitholile imali kuMatlala njengoba kwasho uMkhwanazi.Omunye umhlaziyi wezepolitiki, uMnuz Sandile Swana ekhuluma ne-IOL, uthe lokhu kukhombisa ngokusobala ukuthi uMchunu akafuni ukubeka ikusasa lakhe kwezombusazwe ezandleni zabanye.Uthe lokhu kukhombisa nokuthi uMchunu akafuni ukuphuma ngaphandle kwezinhlaka ze-ANC okuhlanganisa ne-NEC ngoba angase alahlekelwe yithuba lokuhlenga ikusasa lakhe kwezepolitiki."Akakwenzi lokhu ngoba ekholelwa ngobuqotho ukuthi umsulwa kodwa uyazi ukuthi ukuba nesikhundla esinamandla ngaphakathi ku-ANC kuyingxenye yesikhali sokuzivikela kunoma yiziphi izinqubo zomthetho namacala,” kusho uSwana, wengeza ngokuthi uMchunu akakubheki ngempela okuhle kwesizwe noma kwe-ANC kodwa lokhu kuyisinyathelo sokusebenzisa i-ANC ukuze azivikele.
UKhomishana obhekelele ukusebenza kwemingcele uDkt Michael Masiapato, uveze izindaba zokuvalwa kwemingcele emibili iPafuri neGiriyondo Port of Entry ngenxa yokugcwala kwamanzi nasezindaweni ezizungezile.IPafuri umngcele ophakathi kweNingizimu Afrika neMozambique, osenyakatho yeKruger National Park. Isango lasePafuri livaliwe ngenxa yezikhukhula eziphezulu zamanzi.I-Giriyondo, iphakathi kweNingizimu Afrika neMozambique iyingxenye ebalulekile ye-Great Limpopo Transfrontier Park, enqamula iNingizimu Afrika yonke, iMozambique kanye neZimbabwe.NgeSonto emini, imibiko yabasebenzi baseKruger National Park abaqaphe le ndawo iveze ukuthi amanzi ebhulohwe lomfula iLuvuvhu anyuke cishe ngesigamu semitha uma kuqhathaniswa nangoMgqibelo. Izibuyekezo ezengeziwe ziphinde zaqinisekisa ukuthi imifula i-Klein Letaba kanye ne-Middlevlei igcwele iyachichima, kuyilapho ibhuloho iLetaba selizogcwala ngenxa yokuqhubeka kokungena kwamanzi amaningi.Uma kubhekwa ukuthi uMfula iLuvuvhu uncikene ne-Pafuri, amazinga amanzi akhuphuka ngokushesha abe yingozi kwezokuphepha kubasebenzi, abahambi, nengqalasizinda endaweni."Ngenhloso yokuqinisekisa ukuphepha kwabo bonke abathintekayo, isiphathimandla esilawula imingcele sithathe isinqumo sokumisa ukusebenza emingceleni ethintekile kuze kube yilapho izimo ziba ngcono..Bonke abasebenzi be-BMA, amalungu eKomidi Lokuphathwa Kwemingcele kanye nezimoto ezisebenza kule mingcele ethintekile zikhishwe njengesinyathelo sokuqapha ezokuphepha," kusho abeBMA ngesitatimendeAbahambi abahlose ukungena eSangweni lasePafuri balulekwa ukuthi basebenzise i-Punda Maria Gate njengendawo ephephile. IPunda Maria Gate itholakala cishe kumakhilomitha angu-65 ukusuka ePafuri.
KUPHENYWA amacala evile ku-400 enkohlakalo avulelwe odokotela nabanye abahlinzeka ngosizo lwezempilo ngabesikhwama esihlinzeka ngosizo lwezempilo kubasebenzi bahulumeni, i-Government Employees Medical Scheme (GEMS).La macala athinta ukusebenzisana kwamalungu alesi sikhwama nalaba abahlinzeka ngosizo lwezempilo.Lokhu kuvezwe yizikhulu zalesi sikhwama izolo, ngesikhathi zivele ngaphambi kwekomiti loMnyango weziSebenzi zikaHulumeni nokuPhatha, ePhalamende. I-GEMS ikhale ngokuthi ngonyaka, ilahlekelwa phakathi kuka-R3 billion kuya ku-R9 billion ngenxa yenkohlakalo, ukuxhashazwa nokusetshenziswa budlabha kwe-medical aid.Isikhulu esibhekele inkohlakalo kwi-GEMS, uMnuz Ishmael Mohapi, sithe nyakenye baphenye abahlinzeka ngosizo lwezempilo abangu-399, abaxebule umkhoma imali engu-R1.3 billion kulesi sikhwama nyakenye uwodwa."Sivule amacala angu-413 emaphoyiseni eminyakeni edlule, uphenyo luhamba ngolonwabu. Sesikwaze ukubuyisa imali engu-R11.7 million ebuyele kulesi sikhwama," sisho kanje. UMohapi uthe bayaqhubeka nokuvula amacala njengoba bebika abahlinzeka ngezempilo emikhandlwini ebalawulayo."Sisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe ukuze silwe nenkohlakalo ngoba kunzima ukuhlonza inkohlakalo njengoba kuba nokusebenzisana phakathi kwabezempilo namalungu e-GEMS. Sizofundisa namalungu ngendaba yenkohlakalo nokuxhaphaza i-medical aid."Isikhulu sezimali kulesi sikhwama, uNksz Karyna Van Lingen, sithe ukunyuka kwezindleko ezikhokhelwa amalungu alesi sikhwama yikhona okwenze kwanyuswa imali ekhokhwa amalungu yabangu-9.5%. Sithe ngonyaka, i-GEMS ichitha u-R67 billion ikhokhela izindleko ekubeni amalungu ekhokha ngonyaka u-R65 billion."Ziphezulu izindleko ezikhokhelwa odokotela, izibhedlela ezizimele kanjalo nongoti. Ngaleyo ndlela bekumele sinyuse imali ukuze sihlangabezane nezindleko ezinyukayo minyaka yonke," sisho kanje.Izinyunyana zabasebenzi bahulumeni zamashela i-GEMS zifuna yehlise ukunyuswa kwemali, kuxoshwe ibhodi lalesi sikhwama kuphinde kwenziwe uphenyo ngemali ekhokhwayo amalungu aleli bhodi. Amalungu ePhalamende azwelane nabasebenzi bahulumeni, abakhala ngokunyuka kwemali abayikhokhayo selokhu kuqale unyaka.UNksz Sixolise Gcilishe, ilungu lePhalamende, lithe kumele kukhonjwe indlela amalungu ebhodi ukuze kuqokwe azolalela abasebenzi."Kumele kufakwe ibhodi elisha elizolalela izikhalazo zabasebenzi. Aniwacabangeli amalungu ngokunyusa imali kangaka ekubeni abasebenzi bahulumeni benganyuselwa ngisho nomholo ngo-10%." Elinye ilungu, uNksz Gugulethu Mchunu, likhale ngokuthi amalungu ahlale ekhala ngokungagunyazwa ukuthi ayolala ezibhedlela ngoba imali kuthiwa kayikho.UNksz Reneilwe Pholwane, ilungu lePhalamende, lizwakalise ukucasuka ngokuthi i-GEMS inyuse imali."Iyangijulukisa indaba yokuthi ninyuse kangaka imali. Anibacabangeli abasebenzi abavele bathwele kanzima." UNgqongqoshe weziSebenzi zikaHulumeni nokuPhatha, Inkosi Mzamo Buthelezi, waveza ukuthi yakuchitha ukunyuswa kwemali okwenziwa yi-GEMS.UButhelezi wathi akuyena ogunyaza ukunyuswa kwemali kodwa kwenziwa yibhodi le-GEMS.I-GEMS iveze ukuthi ziyaqhubeka izingxoxo nezinyunyana zabasebenzi ngokunyuswa kwemali.
BAKHOLWA wukuthi zilahlwe elakubo , zabalekela endaweni ezingayijwayele izigebengu, okufe kuzo ezimbili, abazibonele ngawabo zifa kabuhlungu egaraji likaphethroli, i-Engen, ngaphandle kwenxanxathela yezitolo, iPavilion, eThekwini, izolo. Kulesi sigameko kufe ababili, kubona kukhona oyedwa ofe ngokudutshulwa, okuvela ukuthi ufele ngaphakathi emotweni, esihlalweni esiseduze kwesomshayeli. Kwathi owesibili, okuvela ukuthi uphume eyinhlamvu ezihlalweni ezingemuva, wathi uyabaleka, ujomba udonga olungemuva kwegaraji, kanti uzovele azithele phezu kokufa ngoba belushona phansi ngamamitha amade ngokwedlulele. Owesithathu, okuvela ukuthi ubengumshayeli usindile, nokho wakhalelwa amasongo kaSigonyela. Ngokusho komthombo, ocele ukungadalulwa, imoto ingene ngesivinini egaraji, igijinyiswa yimoto yenkampani yonogada. "Siqaphele ukuthi ibidubulekile njengoba ibinembobo emzimbeni, bekukhona ngisho newindi elifile,” kusho umthombo.Uthe ngesikhathi abenkampani yonogada belandisa amaphoyisa abesebizelwe endaweni yesigameko, ucoshe ukuthi abagilwa bebengabasolwa asebekhathazile ngokubamba inkunzi ezindaweni ezehlukene eThekwini."Sizwe umoya wokuthi onogada babagijimise bebasusa eMhlanga, nokuyilapho okugcine kuba khona ukudubulana phakathi kwabo njengoba kuvele ukuthi badubule kuqala bebhekisa konogada,” usho kanje. Uthe bezwe ukuthi abasolwa babamba abantu inkunzi, bese beyobakhiphisa imali emishinini yasemabhange. "Sisola ukuthi abantu ebebengayazi nhlobo indawo ngoba ukube bebeyazi, lona okhalakathele odongeni olude ubezokwazi ukuthi akufanele agxume lapho egxume khona. Okungenani ubezovele abaleke ashone phansi, ngoba kukhona ilokishi iChesterville eduzane, abengavele achushe phakathi kwemizi bese ephela emehlweni,” kusho umthombo. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa aphenya icala lokubulala nelokuzama ukubulala kulandela isigameko esenzeke egaraji likaphethroli. Elandisa ngesigameko uthe munye umsolwa otholwe esefile ngaphakathi emotweni emhlophe iBMW enamanxeba okudutshulwa. Kwathi owesibili watholwa efile emva kokuthi ephume emotweni efanayo, wazama ukugxuma odongeni olude (lwegaraji), kanti uzovele awe, ashone. "Imibiko iveza ukuthi iBMW emhlophe ebinabantu abathathu idlule igijima konogada ebebezihambela emgwaqweni u-M19. Kuthiwa bakhethe ukuyilandela nokuyilapho ebebekuyo, bevele bavulela ngenhlamvu konogada,” kusho uNetshiunda.Uthe yilapho okusuke khona esinamandla, onogada bebuyisela ngenhlamvu, bebeqhubeka nokubajaha ngemoto kwaze kwayofikwa egaraji. "Uphenyo lwamaphoyisa luthole ukuthi iBMW ibifakwe izinombolo okungezona ezayo. Umshayeli wayo uvele wazinikela emaphoyiseni, waboshwa,” kusho uNetshiunda, othe kutholwe nezibhamu ezimbili ngaphakathi kwiBMW.
UBHOKA uyakhahlela umphakathi wesizwe saKwaBhejane, eNseleni, eMpangeni, uthi sekuwumi emphinjeni manje ukubhunguka kweNkosi yesizwe uMkhanyisi kaPhiwayinkosi Khoza (25).Isolezwe lithole ngomthombo walo osemkhandlwini wenkosi ukuthi kume yonke into kulesi sizwe ngenxa yokuthi inkosi akwaziwa ukuthi yashonaphi.Kuvela ukuthi yanyamalala endaweni nyakenye kanye nonina, uNdlunkulu uKhoza owayeyibamba lenkosi esihlalweni iminyaka eyisikhombisa egcwele.Amalungu alesi sizwe akholwa wukuthi lesi simo sizodala ukuthi isizwe sigcine singalawuleki ngenxa yokuthi kasinankosi. Kuyimanje bakholwa wukuthi kulesi sizwe kukwamachanca kwampunzi edla emini.Omunye osesikhundleni esiphezulu emkhandlwini wenkosi uthe abasazi ukuthi kumele benze njani ngoba akukho abangakwenzanga bezama ukulungisa lesi simo kodwa kuvele kufane nokuthi bathela amanzi emhlane wedada.''Asinayo inkosi kule ndawo kubi konakele lokhu okukugcina ngci. Angikaze mina ngiyibone into enjengelana eyenzeka esizweni. Uma kukhulunywa ngechilo kusuke kushiwo nto enjengalena esiyibona yenzeka kulesi sizwe," kusho lo mholi.Uthe lesi senzo senkosi sibashiya nenqwaba yemibuzo ngoba kabasaqondi nqindi nasibhakela. ''Ngabe kungcono ukuba uyasho ukuthi akasakufuni nje nhlobo ukuhola isizwe ukuze sazi, kunale nto ayenzayo manje esingayazi ukuthi yini. Phela udlala ngathi lokhu okwangempela,'' usho kanjena.Uma ziqhubeka izinto zihamba ngalolu hlobo ngokusho kwaleli lungu kuningi kakhulu okuzokonakala esizweni. Omunye uveze ukuthi inkosi bagcina ukuyibona ngamehlo ngo-Agasti ngonyaka odlule ngesikhathi ibekwa ngokusemthethweni wuMnyango wokuBusa nokuBambisana kanye neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal.''Nakhona lapho yasukuma inkosi yezwakalisa ukujabula kwayo ngokubekwa ngokusemthethweni. Kodwa yatshela isizwe ukuthi izoke ithi ukunyamalala kancane ngenxa yokuthi kunezinto ezincane okumele iqale ngokuzilungisa ngaphambi kokuba iqale ihole kahle isizwe," kuchaza yena.Uthe ngale nkulumo isizwe sasala sisebumnyameni ngokuthi isho ukuthini futhi ichaza ukuthi sizoholwa wubani isizwe uma yona isanyamalele.''Ngikutshela ukuthi asiphindanga ke sayibona kusukela ngalolo suku. Okubuhlungu kakhulu wukuthi akwenzeki lutho esizweni njengoba inkosi kungaziwa ukuthi yaphuma yalibhekisa kuziphi izinkalo," kusho yena.UMnuz Sibonelo Dube ongumholi wekomiti labantu abasha elisebenzisana nomkhandlu uthe sebehlanze ngedela ukuthi kuyoke kwenzeke baphinde bayibone ngawabo amehlo inkosi.''Ukukutshela iqiniso nje, mina angisakholwa wukuthi lo muntu ongibuza ngaye uyoke aphinde abuye azohola isizwe sikayise. Akekho umuntu oyinkosi ongancamela ukushiya isizwe sikayise dengwane kanjena bese kukhulunywa indaba yokuthi unendaba naso futhi usazoke aphinde abuye azosihola ngabe kudlalwa ngathi. Eqinisweni nje lapha sikhuluma ngomuntu ongenandaba nabantu abaholayo," usho kanjena kuzwakala ukuthi ugcwele intukuthelo.Okhulumela uMnyango wokuBusa nokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Senzelwe Mzila, uthe bazoluphenya lolu daba.Inkosi ayitholakalanga ukuba iziphendulele ngezinsolo ezibekwayo.
UZOVELA enkantolo namhlanje osolwa ngokubulala ufakazi owethula ubufakazi ngokuyimfihlo kwiKhomishini ephenya izinsolo ezenziwa nguKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi.Umsolwa oboshelwe icala lokubulala uMnuz Marius Van Der Merwe uzovela eNkantolo yeMantshi eBrakpan eGauteng.Umsolwa uboshwe yithimba lamaphoyisa eliphenya amacala asuka ebufakazini obethulwa phambi kweKhomishini eholwa yiJaji uMbuyiseli Madlanga. UVan Der Merwe wasocongwa emva kokuba egeqe amagula ngezinsolo zenkohlakalo ophikweni lwamaPhoyisa kaMasipala waseKurhuleni.Ngesikhathi ethula ubufakazi ngonyaka owedlule, uVan Der Merwe waninda izikhulu zamaphoyisa kuMasipala waseKurhuleni ezisola ngokuba yingxenye emacaleni okukhona elokubulala kanye nelokuntshontsha.Okhulumela amaphoyisa, uBrigadier Athlenda Mathe, uthe umsolwa ukhalelwe amasongo kaSigonyela eseGauteng, ngoMgqibelo. UBrigadier Mathe uthe amaphoyisa ayaqhubeka nokuqoqa ubufakazi ezindaweni ezihlala umsolwa."Amaphoyisa agasele ezindaweni ezihlala umsolwa apekequla futhi aphinde ashaqa izinto acabanga ukuthi zingalekelela ophenyweni."UBrigadier Mathe uthe amaphoyisa aphinde ashaqa imoto eyasetshenziswa ngesikhathi kubulawa uVan Der Merwe. Omunye umsolwa owayenukeka ekufeni kukaVan Der Merwe, uMnuz Wiandre Pretorius, wazibulala ngenyanga eyedlule. UPretorius wayephinde athinteke ecaleni uVan Der Merwe, akhuluma ngalo ngesikhathi evele phambi kwekhomishini, nokuyicala lokubulawa kukaMnuz Emmanuel Mbhense.Isidumbu sikaMbhense esatholakala silahlwe emfuleni, kusolwa ukuthi washona emva kokushaywa amaphoyisa akwaMasipala waseKurhuleni kanye nabanye abantu ababesebenzela izinhlaka zokuphepha.Abantu abathinteka ecaleni lokufa kukaMbhense bangu-12, abathathu sebasocongwa.UBrigadier Mathe uthe uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa kuzwelonke, uLieutenant General Fannie Masemola, uncome ithimba lamaphoyisa elibophe umsolwa. Ithimba lisungulwe emva komyalelo kaMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa. URamaphosa wakhipha umyalelo wokuba kusungulwe ithimba emva kokuthola umbiko wokuqala weKhomishini kaMadlanga ezoqhubeka nokulalela ofakazi kuleli sonto.Ngeledlule ikhomishini ipheke ngebhodwe elincane inhloko yophiko elilwa nobugebengu obuhleliwe, uMajor General Richard Shibiri nosomabhizinisi oyilungu le-ANC, uMnuz Carrim Suleiman.UShibiri noSuleiman basolwa ngokusondelana nosomabhizinisi ababhekene noxhaxha lwamacala, uMnuz Vusimuzi "Cat" Matlala noMnuz Katiso "KT" Molefe.
KUNGASE kuthathe amasonto amabili ukuba kulungiswe ngokuphelele inkinga yamanzi eThekwini, ephazamise ukuhlinzekwa kwamanzi ezingxenyeni eziningi ezingaphansi kweTheku.Nakuba i-valve ebifile isilungisiwe, umasipala uthe kusazothatha isikhathi eside ukuthi amanzi aphume ngokwejwayelekile ezindaweni ezithintekile. I-valve esedamini iNagle, yabonakala ngoLwesithathu, ukuthi ifile.Ukufa kwe-valve kuphazamise ukuhanjiswa kwamanzi ezindaweni eziseningizimu, enyakatho nasentshonalanga yeTheku.Phakathi kwamalokishi athintekile kubalwa uMlaza, KwaMashu, Clermont, Ntuzuma, Inanda, KwaSanti namanye.Inkinga ishaye yaze yathinta nezindawo ezihlala omtakabani okubalwa kuzo uMhlanga, Westville nezinye.Umasipala umemezele ukuthi ukulungiswa kwe-valve kuphothulwe izolo.IMeya yeTheku, uMnuz Cyril Xaba, ithe inhlangano ebahlinzeka ngamanzi, Umngeni-uThukela Water, ibazise ukuthi iNagle Dam izoqala isebenze ngokugcwele namhlanje. UXaba uthe nokho kuzothatha isikhathi ukuthi abantu bathole amanzi ngokujwayelekile."Amanzi uma esuka kuleli damu ahamba ipayipi elingu-43 km ukuba afike lapho ehlanzwa khona. Uma esefikile lapho ehlanzwa khona abe esedlulela kwizigcinimanzi zethu. Kuzothatha isikhashana nokho njengoba sike sabika phambilini ukuthi izigcinimanzi zethu bese zome, zingesenalutho. Kuzothatha isikhathi ukuze amanzi agcwale ukuze abantu bawathole."UXaba uthe abakhe ezindaweni eziphansi bazosheshe bawathole amanzi."Kungathatha isonto noma amasonto amabili ukuthi labo abakhe ezindaweni eziphezulu bawathole amanzi."Unxuse abantu ukuba bonge amanzi."Sinxusa ukubambisana nomphakathi, abantu bawasebenzise ngokuwanakekela amanzi. Laba abachelelayo nabawasha izimoto, sicela bame kancane ngoba sifuna ukuthi amanzi otholwe yibo bonke abantu."UXaba uthe bazothumela izimoto zamanzi ezindaweni ezithintekile."Sizoqinisekisa ukuthi amanzi ayaya ezikoleni, ezibhedlela nasemtholampilo. Lezi izikhungo ezibalulekile okungafanele zingawatholi amanzi."UXaba uxwayise abashayeli bezimoto zamanzi ukuba bangalinge bezame ukudayisela abantu amanzi."Sinxusa ogalakajane abahlezi becuthile ukuba bangasebenzisi lesi sikhathi esinzima kangaka ukuqhuba izinhloso zabo."UXaba uveze ukuthi sebeqale uhlelo lokunciphisa amanzi. Amanzi awezukufika ngendlela eyejwayelekile."Abanye bazowathola ekuseni abuye anqamuke ngesikhathi sisaphuthuma laba abanye abasezindaweni ezithe ukuqhela. Lokhu kuzokwenzeka size isimo sibuyele kwesejwayelekile."Le nkinga yenzeka nje, avele amaqembu aphikisayo aweneme ngenkinga yamanzi ehlasele eThekwini.Iqembu eliphikisa ngokusemthethweni emkhandlwini, i-DA, libe nemibhikisho enokuthula ezingxenyeni ezahlukene zeTheku, ngeledlule, lapho khona likhale ngokuba kusukunyelwe inkinga yamanzi.IKhansela le-ActionSA, uMnuz Zwakele Mncwango, lithe kuyabakhathaza ukuqonga kwenkinga yamanzi eThekwini.UMncwango uthe abaholi bomkhandlu kufanele baphendule ngale nkinga yamanzi.
IBHOKA iyakhahlela inhlangano yamakholwa i-South African Church Defenders, ithi lingawa licoshwe yizinkukhu, ayisoze yavumela iKhomishini kaNkk Thoko Mkhwanazi-Xaluva ilawule amabandla, ngenxa yalokho ithi iphakamisa ukuba usihlalo wayo ashenxiswe esikhundleni ngokuphazima kweso izinto zingakabi mapeketwane kakhulu.Amalungu ale nhlangano ebakede emasha ekhala ngokulawulwa yile khomishini. Imashi ibikade isuka eKing Dinuzulu iya eCity Hall eThekwini, ngoLwesihlanu. Ngesikhathi ithulwa eminyakeni eyedlule, le khomishini umsebenzi wayo kwathiwa ngeyokuKhuthaza nokuVikela ezamaSiko, ezeNkolo neziLimi emiPhakathini (CRL Rights Commission) okuyizonto abefundisi abakholwa ukuthi seziphambene nokwenziwa usihlalo wayo.Amakholwa akhala ngomthetho uSection 22, ogunyazwe yile khomishini ngo-Okthoba ngonyaka owedlule. Lo mthetho uvuna ikhomishini ukuba ibheke konke okungahambi kahle ngaphakathi emabandleni.USihlalo wale nhlangano, uMfu Mpfariseni Mukhuba, enkulumeni yakhe uthe abakunqeni ukubhekana ngeziqu zamehlo nosihlalo weCRL, uNkk Thoko Mkhwanazi-Xaluva ebese kuyacaca ukuthi iyiphi eyogoba uphondo.Ulimise ngesihloko elokuthi uNkk MKhwanazi-Xaluva umelene nebandla likaNkulunkulu futhi unomcabango wokuthi angenza noma yini kulona ngesikhathi esithandwa nguyena, ngeshwa uthi lokho angeke kuze kwenzeke ngoba sebefingqe imikhono."Ngeke size silenze iphutha lokuba sithule nje sibukele umuntu edlala ngebandla likaNkulunkulu, akakhohlwe ke nje impela. Sizimisile ngokuthi senze konke okusemandleni ngenhloso yokulwela isithunzi sebandla likaNkulunkulu," usho kanjena.Eqhuba ubuze ukuthi kungenzeka kanjani ukuthi umbuso wobumnyama ulawule umbuso kaNkulunkulu, lokho ukufanise nenganekwane yoqobo.Uthe bafuna ukuhamba yonke imigudu efanele babone ukuthi bangenza kanjani ukuze ashenxiswe uNkk Mkhwanazi-Xaluva.''Kodwa ngaphambi kokuba ashenxiswe sifuna ukuba aphenywe, bese eyajeziswa ngendlela abonakala eziphatha ngayo uma kukhulunywa ngebandla likaNkulunkulu," usho kanjena.USolwazi Theophilus Mukhuba ongumyeni kaMfu Makhuba uthe uma uhulumeni kungekho okwenzayo mayelana nalolu dweshu oluphakathi kwebandla neKhomishini kaMKhwanazi-Xaluva kukhona okusina kuwujeqeza ngoba okuzolandela amakholwa azoligodla ivoti lawo.''Sinawo amandla nathi esinawo esingakhombisa ngawo uma sesicasukile. Okokuqala nje ukugodla ivoti. Lokhu kungazwela kwazise maningi kakhulu amaKhristu ezweni lonke," usho kanjena.Izikhalazo zabo zamukelwe nguChamplain waKwaZulu-Natal, uMphostoli Lungu M Magwaza, obethunywe nguNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli.Uthembise ukuthi iHhovisi likaNdunankulu lizozibheka ngokukhulu ukushesha izikhalazo zamakholwa ayingxenye yale nhlangano.UMbhishobhi Vusi Dube uthe akumele ibandla likaNkulunkulu lidembesele uma kukhona izinto eziphakanyiswa ngabathile okubonakala kuhloswe ngazo ukuqeda ngebandla likaNkulunkulu.Uthe kumele ibandla libonakale lima ngazo zombili ngoba akekho omunye ongalilwela ngaphandle kokuba lizilwele lona.Ebebemasha bebephethe izingqwembe ebezinemibhalo ehlukene ebingcofa uNkk MKhwanazi-Xaluva ngamagama ehlukene.UDube uthe nokho bayakuqonda ukuthi akulula ukuba kungamane kuse ekuseni nje kuthiwe useshenxile esikhundleni sakhe uNkk Mkhwanazi-Xaluva kodwa kunemigudu efanele okumele ilandelwe.UMbhishobhi Nathi Zondi naye uthe kumqoka ukuba ibandla likaNkulunkulu lisukume libe munye libhekane nazo zonke izinselelo ezithikameza inhlalakahle yalo.
LUMISE zonke izingqungquthela uphiko lwentsha lwe-ANCYL KwaZulu-Natal, njengoba lumatasa nezinhlelo zokulungiselela umgubho ozohanjelwa wuMengameli we-ANC nezwe, uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa.Lolu phiko luveze ukuthi lumatasa namalungiselelo okunxenxa intsha, ukuthi ihambele imashi ezoba ngempelasonto, yokuvikela inkululeko yakuleli. Esitatimendeni uVukayibambe uveze ukuthi umatasa nezinhlelo zomgubho weminyaka engu-114, kwasungulwa i-ANC, ozohanjelwa nguRamaphosa ozoba kulesi sifundazwe."Ngenxa yezinhlelo ezehlukene eziqhubekayo, kumiswa zonke izingqungquthela zezifunda ze-ANCYL esifundazweni. Zizomiswa kuze kube isigungu esiphezulu sesifundazwe, siyazanelisa ngokuthi sezingabanjwa izingqungquthela kuzona zonke izifunda," kusho isitatimende. Sinxuse ukuthi kube nokubambisana emalungwini ngenxa yalesi sinqumo. Kwenzeka lokhu nje akucaci ukuthi izohlala nini ingqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi be-ANC kulesi sifundazwe njengoba kunethimba lesikhashana elibhekele isifundazwe.UVukayibambe uveze nokuthi usuqale uphenyo ngokuziphatha kukanobhala wale nhlangano, uNksz Lulama Mabude. Uthe lesi sinqumo sathathwa emhlanganweni owawungoFebhuwari 21, 2026."Kulo mhlangano isigungu esiphezulu sanquma ukuthi kuphenywe ngendlela aziphatha ngayo uNksz Mabude, okubandakanya nokuphula imigomo yenhlangano. Isigungu sesifundazwe saphakamisa ukuthi amiswe esikhundleni kanti wanquma ukuzihoxela kulesi sikhundla kuze kuphothulwe uphenyo," kusho isitatimende. Isitatimende siveze ukuthi ihhovisi lePhini likaSihlalo, uNksz Phindile Mdanda, selimnikile uhlu lwamacala uNksz Mabude kanti uyalelwe ukuthi avele phambi kwekomiti lokuqondiswa ubugwegwe."Njengoba emisiwe nje, ngeke aze ayimele i-ANCYL kuze kukhishwe isinqumo. Siyakwamukela ukuthi uzihoxele ezintweni ezithinta inhlangano kuze kuphume isinqumo. Ukumiswa kwakhe akusho ukuthi yingoba enecala kodwa yindlela yokuthi kungabi nokuphazamiseka kophenyo."Le nhlangano iveze ukuthi uMnuz Siyabonga Mzenda, uzobamba esikhundleni sikanobhala. Ithe umsebenzi kule nhlangano uyaqhubeka.
UYABALISA umfundi oyintombazane (17) othi kuze kwaphoqeleka kuba ayeke isikole ngemuva kokuba eshayiswe kabi wuthisha ngemoto emagcekeni esikole esigamekweni esenzeka ngo-2024.Lo mfundi esiligodlile igama lakhe ngesikhathi sesigameko wayefunda uGrade 8 eSiphapheme High, eMzinto. Ngelanga lesigameko uthe wayehamba egcekeni kuyikhefu - uthisha wesifazane amgagule ngegama waphunyukwa yimoto yamlimaza kabi engena esikoleni ephuma ngaphandle.''Ngemuva kwalokho kwaphuma igazi esithweni sangasese. Kusukela lapho impilo yami ayiphindanga yafana njengoba namanje ngisagqigqa ezibhedlela," usho kanjena.Uveze ukuthi kwadingeka ukuba asiyeke isikole ngawo lowo nyaka ngenxa yokuthi ubesedane eya esibhedlela kwaze kwavunyelwana emndenini wakhe ukuthi kungcono asiyeke isikole ngoba uyaphazamiseka.''Okungiphatha kabuhlungu kakhulu wukuthi sengihlinzwe kwaze kwaba kathathu. Inzima kakhulu le mpilo engiyiphilayo. Ngifisa ngisho ukufa kunokuthi ngiphile le mpilo enzima kangaka," kuchaza yena.Uthe okubuhlungu kakhulu wukuthi uthisha owamshayisa akakaze nangelilodwa nje ilanga akhombise ukuzisola okanye amnikeze usizo ngokugqigqa ezibhedlela.''Ngabe kungcono kabi ukuba naye ubambisene nabazali bami ukuze ngisizakale, manje lutho akanandaba nje,''usho kanjena.Ubabaze unya kulo thisha wathi ungaphika ukuthi ungumuntu wesifazane."Iyethusa kakhulu indlela enza ngayo. Idala ukuthi ngizibuze ngiziphendule ukuthi kwakuwumuntu wesifazane onjani yena lo ongenalo ngalolu hlobo uzwelo,'' kuchaza yena.Uthe abazali bakhe bazame kaningi ukuxhumana naye ukuze aphonse itshe esivivaneni ngezindleko zasesibhedlela kodwa kumane kufane nokuthi bathela amanzi emhlane wedada."Loya muntu akanawo unembeza futhi akazenzisi nhlobo," usho kanjena.Uveze ukuthi esibhedlela bamtshela ukuthi ulimale kabi esibelethweni okuyindawo athi ibucayi kakhulu.''Odokotela bangitshela ukuthi ngilimale kabi esibelethweni. Lokhu namanje akuvumi ukuthi ngikwamukele," usho knajena.Udadewabo womfundi uthe bafisa ukuthola ubulungiswa ngokulinyazwa kabi kukadadewabo. Uthe namanje akuvumi ukuthi bakholwe wukuthi uthisha owenza lokhu akakaze akhombise nokuncane ukuzisola ngengozi.''Namanje lo thisha akanandaba nokuthi kwenzekani ngomuntu amlimaza. Kuyacaca ukuthi lana sibhekene nothisha onesihluku futhi ongenandaba nabanye abantu," usho kanjena.Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Muzi Mahlambi akayiphendulanga imibuzo ayithunyelelwe ngodaba.
KUSOLWA ithenda yezigidi zamarandi yokulungiswa komgwaqo u-P32 Helpmekaar waseMnambithi, ngokubulawa kosomabhizinisi ababili bakuyona le ndawo ngoMgqibelo ebusuku.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi oMnuz Lindokuhle Mkhwanazi (31) noMnuz Mndeni Nxumalo (43) badutshulwe besemotweni endaweni yaKwaMaqanda. Kubikwa ukuthi bebebathathu emotweni kodwa owesithathu wasinda ngokulambisa. Ikhansela lakule ndawo, uMnuz Ntuthuko Mbhense, likuqinisekisile ukubulawa kwalaba ababili. UMbhense uthe lolu wudaba olubucayi kakhulu, akathandi ukukhuluma kakhulu ngalo engazange athole igunya emindenini ethintekayo.Mayelana nodaba lwethenda, nalapho uthe akukho angakuphawula esho evalelisa evala nocingo.Isolezwe likhulume nomthombo osondelene nalaba ababili odalule ukuthi kusolwa ithenda yalo mgwaqo ngokubulawa kwabo. Uveze ukuthi awunaso isiqiniseko senani yethanda kodwa wathi elemali eshisiwe nje impela.Uthe laba yibona abayingxenye yokwakhiwa kwalo mgwaqo owakhiwa ngezindodla zemali, waveza ukuthi kunomunye obeyingxenye yokwakhiwa kwalo mgwaqo osanda kubulawa naye ngenxa yesizathu esifanayo. Naye futhi uthe ubulawe ngokudutshulwa.''Kubi mfowethu, sonke sisashaqekile kakhulu ngendlela laba ababulawe ngayo. Kodwa iqiniso ukuthi ikhulunyelwa phansi eyethenda yalo mgwaqo olungiswayo walapha endaweni," kusho umthombo.Uqhuba, uthe le thenda inezinkulumo eziningi kangangoba kuke kwakhona nabathile abathola ukusongelwa ngenxa yayo.Uthe kunabanye abafunga bagomela ukuthi kuyogobhoza igazi futhi kuyoqhuma nhlamvana ezinye ziyofekela uma ithenda ingaweli kwezabo izandla. Yize kunjalo, uthe okufike kuxake kakhulu ukuthi ukwakhiwa kwawo lo mgwaqo kumi ndawonye.Uthe uma engenza isibonelo nje sokuthi mngakanani umsebenzi osewenziwe angawulinganisela ku-5% nje kuphela. ''Uyabona-ke ukuthi mncane kangananani umsebenzi osewenziwe kulo mgwaqo," echaza.Kuvela nokuthi imindeni yabafi ithuka izanya, izizwa ingaphephile nje nhlobo ngemuva kokuba kwenzeke lesi sigameko. Laba ababili kuthiwa bebengahlukani.Kuvela ukuthi ukubulawa kwabo kushiye umphakathi uthuthumela, ubuzana ukuthi kwenzekani?Owomndeni kaMkhwanazi onqabile negama lakhe ukuqinisekisile ukubulawa kwakhe. Uthe namanje basathukile kakhulu, kunzima nokuthi bakwamukele okubehlele ngoba umufi ubengakaze angabatshela ukuthi kunezinsongo azitholayo.Ebuzwa mayelana nezinsolo zethenda yezigidi, uthe wabatshela ngokuthi uyingxenye yomsebenzi womgwaqo, wathi kodwa bathole esebulawe ukuthi indaba yethenda ibisize yafinyelela kuliphi izinga.Indodana kaNxumalo, uMnuz Lunga Nxumalo, ithe uyise azikho izinsolo ake wazithola, yathi bashaqekile ngokubulawa kwakhe. Mayelana nethenda, ithe bayazi ngayo ngoba bekumele baqale ukusebenza ngesonto elizayo.Bobabili bazofihlwa ngoMgqibelo ezindaweni ezahlukene. UMkhwanazi uzofihlwa emathuneni aseNdomba, ngemuva kwenkozo ezobe ibanjelwe ehholo laseMnambithi i-Acaciaville, bese kuthi uNxumalo eyakhe ibe seSteadville Area J, bese eyiswa emathuneni asePlazini Wasbank.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi laba ababili bebesondelene kakhulu nomunye uMphathiswa waKwaZulu-Natal, okuthiwa bekubenza bazitamuzele nje uma kunamathenda alolu hlobo.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uCaptain Ntathu Ndlovu, ukuqinisekisile ukubulawa kwalaba. Uthe amaphoyisa aseMnambithi, aphenya amacala amabili okubulala ngemuva kokubulawa kwabesilisa ababili ngoMgqibelo ebusuku. Elinye icala eliphenywawo elokuzama ukubulala.''Kusolakala ukuthi kube khona abadubule babulala abesilisa ababili, kwathi owesithathu yena wasinda waphuthunyiswa esibhedlela enamanxeba amabi okudutshulwa. Laba bebehamba endaweni yaseKuvukeni, ngesikhathi bedutshulwa. Isizathu sokudutshulwa kwabo besingakaziwa," usho kanjena.
BUBALWE njengobuhamba phambili ubugebengu obunobudlova nezibalo eziphezulu zamacala okudlwengulwa kwabesifazane KwaZulu-Natal ngenyanga edlule.Amaphoyisa esifundazwe athe abophe abasolwa abangu-11 757 ngobugebengu obehlukene ngesikhathi somkhankaso i-Operation Shanela kanye nemikhankaso yansuku zonke yamaphoyisa ngoFebhuwari. Athole izibhamu ezingu-278, okubalwa kuzo izibhamu ezingu-23 ezinkulu, ezokuzenzela (oqhwasha) ezingu-10 kanye nezinhlamvu ezingu-3 824 zezibhamu ezihlukene. Ubugebengu obubandakanya indluzula bube nesibalo esiphezulu sabantu ababoshwayo njengoba sebebonke abasolwa ababoshiwe bengu-3 568.Abangu-166 baboshelwe amacala okubulala, kanti abasolwa abangu-193 baboshelwe ukuzama ukubulala. Abasolwa abangu-190 baboshelwe izinhlobo ezahlukene zokugebenga, abangu-54 kubo baboshelwe ukugebenga besebenzisa isihluku, kanti abasolwa ngokugebenga abangu-75 nabanye abasolwa abangu-51 baboshelwe ukugqekeza izindlu nokugebenga amabhizinisi.Impi eqhubekayo yokulwa nodlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane nezingane iholele ekuboshweni kwabasolwa ngamacala okudlwengula abangu-208, abangu-16 ngokuzama ukudlwengula kanti abangu-46 baboshelwe ukuhlukumeza ngokocansi.Abangu-312 baboshelwe amacala ayamaniswa nokwephula umthetho wokuhlukunyezwa kwasekhaya (Domestic Violence Act).Abangu-1 655 baboshelwe ukushaya ngenhloso yokulimaza, kanti abangu-902 zibakhalele ngamacala okushaya.Emizamweni yawo yokufeza umsebenzi wawo wokuvikela impahla yezakhamizi zaKwaZulu-Natal, amaphoyisa abophe abasolwa abangu-214 ngokugqekeza ezindaweni okuhlalwa kuzo kanti abasolwa abangu-78 baboshwa ngamacala okugqekeza amabhizinisi.Abasolwa abangu-52 baboshelwe amacala okuntshontshwa kwemfuyo kanti imikhankaso eyahlukene iholele ekutholakaleni kwezinkomo okusolwa ukuthi zebiwe ezingu-24 nezimbuzi ezingu-51.Kutholwe nezindimbane zenyama okusolwa ukuthi ngeyezinkomo ezithathwe ngozwane.Abangu-1 704 baboshelwe amacala ahlobene nezidakamizwa, abashayeli bezimoto abangu-742 baboshelwe ukushayela beqhafile noma bedle izidakamizwa, kanti abangu-165 baboshelwe ukutholakala nezibhamu ezingekho emthethweni.Ukubopha okuningi kwenzeke ngokubambisana namalungu omphakathi. Amaphoyisa anxusa izakhamuzi ezigcina umthetho ukuthi ziqhubeke nokuwanikeza umkhondo nemibiko ngezigebengu ezihlukumeza imiphakathi.
KULINDELEKE izinkumbi zabantu ezizofika enkonzweni yokuphelezelwa kwenkosi yesizwe saseMathulini, Inkosi Phathisizwe Philbert Luthuli (64).Kuvela ukuthi inkosi ivele yawa phansi ngoMsombuluko ngabo-8 ebusuku. Lezi zindaba kuvela ukuthi ziwushaqisile kakhulu umphakathi waseMnini, eMgababa.Umfowabo kamufi, uMnuz Bhekuzalo Luthuli, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi inkosi izotshalwa ngeSonto.Uthe inkonzo yakhe izokuba senkundleni yezemidlalo yasesikoleni iMnini Primary. Uthe izobe isitshalwa emzini wayo okhona eMgababa.Uthe balindele izinkumbi zabantu abazoza enkonzweni yokuphelezela inkosi ngenxa yokuthi beyaziwa ngabantu abaningi kakhulu.Uthe yingakho beqashe itende elikwazi ukumumatha abantu abalinganiselwa ezinkulungwaneni ezimbili.''Silindele abantu abaningi abazofika enkonzweni yenkosi. Sicabanga ukuthi bazobe beqhamuka ezingxenyeni ezahlukene zezwe,'' usho kanjena.Uthe noma ngubani ozizwa enentshisekelo yokuzoyiphelezela wamukelekile ukuba enze kanjalo.Uveze ukuthi selokhu ikhotheme inkosi amazwi enduduzo angena elakanyana futhi baningi abafikayo emzini wayo bezobhonga emswanini. Lokho nje kukodwa uthe bayakubonga kakhulu futhi kubaqinisa idolo njengomndeni kamufi. Uthe bayasibonga sonke isizwe senkosi ngokukhombisa ukuweseka umndeni ngalesi sikhathi esinzima kangaka.Uveze nokuthi nezikhulu zikahulumeni sezinyathelile emagcekeni enkosi zilethe amazwi enduduzo ngomshophi ogubuzele umndeni.UMnyango wokuBusa nokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal udlulise amazwi enduduzo emndenini. Inkosi kuvele ukuthi ishiye emhlabeni izinganeezingaphezulu kuka-20 kanye nomkayo, uMaMsomi.Induna yaseMagcino, eMathulini, ephinde ibe yilungu lomndeni, uMnuz Msawakhe Luthuli, ithe bagqemeke engeqiwa ntwala ngokukhothama kwenkosi.Ichaze inkosi njengomuntu obesithanda kakhulu isizwe sakhe elwela ukuthi njalo asibone sithuthuka ngayo yonke indlela.''Inkosi ibingenza noma yini ukuqinisekisa ukuthi siyadlondlobala isizwe sayo futhi siba nenqubekelaphambili. Kuningi kakhulu okuhle esikufundile kuyona. Impela sife olwembiza ngokuhamba kwayo emhlabeni," usho kanjena.Umlando uveza ukuthi inkosi bese kuphele iminyaka engu-38 ihola isizwe saseMathulini.
UMPHATHISWA woMnyango wokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, umemezele ngokusemthethweni izinhlelo zokuba kwakhiwe itshe lesikhumbuzo elisezingeni likazwelonke ngenhloso yokuhlonipha uMntwana waKwaPhindangene, iNkosi Mangosuthu Buthelezi.Ekhuluma emcimbini wokuklomelisa omasipala abavelele kulesi sifundazwe kuma-2026 KZN Municipal Excellence Awards, eNkosi Albert Luthuli International Convention Centre eThekwini, uMphathiswa uthe uyadingeka umfuziselo wesithathu ukuphelelisa umlando womzabalazo wenkululeko yakuleli.Ubekhuluma ngomfuziselo wesithathu ngenxa yokuthi kuneminye esanda kuvulwa wuMengameli wezwe, okuhlonishwe ngayo owayenguMengameli we-ANC uMnuz Oliver Tambo noMengameli wokuqala kuhulumeni wentando yabantu, uDkt Nelson Mandela, engasebhishi laseThekwini.Enkulumweni yakhe uMphathiswa uchaze uMntwana wakwaPhindangene njengomuntu owaba yibhuloho ekuxhumaniseni i-ANC eyayisekudingisweni nasekuweliseni leli zwe kuhulumeni wentando yabantu. "UMntwana wenza umzabalazo wangalotha eNingzimu Afrika. Ngesikhathi uhulumeni wobandlululo evale umlomo kaTambo nokaMandela, uButhelezi wayeyizwi labacindezelwe."UMphathiswa ugcizelele ukuthi imifuziselo emibili eseThekwini ayisivezi isithombe esigqamile ngobuholi bokubambisana obaguqula iNingizimu Afrika. Uthe ukubekwa komfuziselo kaButhelezi eduze kokaMandela nokaTambo kuzoqinisekisa ukuxoxwa komlando ongahlanekezeliwe. "Imifuziselo emibili eseThekwini ayiphelele ngaphandle komfuziselo woMntwana uMangosuthu Buthelezi." Kulo mcimbi bezishiyana ngomshefezo, izinga lengqephu beliphezulu kangangoba bekungathi abahlonishwa bakwiDurban July. Bebedliselana ogageni, ubona ukuthi kuthungisiwe.
ISEYINDIDA eyokunyamalala kwezibhamu nenqwaba yezinhlamvu kuMasipala wasoKhahlamba. Basazibuza bayaziphendula ukuthi ngabe zishonephi izibhamu nezinhlamvu ezathengwa wumasipala njengoba zingekho lapho kufanele zigcinwe khona futhi engekho oveza ukuthi izinhlamvu zasetshenziswa kanjani uma kuwukuthi zasebenza.Namanje kusathungathwa inhlokohlela yesibhamu somkhandlu enyamalele nezinhlamvu ezingu-400.Kuphinde kube nesibhamu esincane esathengwa wumasipala kodwa esingazange sibhaliswe ngokusemthethweni.Ithumba ngokunyamalala kwezibhamu nezinhlamvu liqhumbuzwe abacwaningi mabhuku bangaphakathi kumasipala.Kuthe kusabatshazwa ukunyamalala kwezibhamu, kwaphinde kwatholakala inhlokohlela yesibhamu esingaziwa emahhovisi omkhandlu.Umasipala usezinhlelweni zokuvula icala njengoba kunokwesaba ukuthi izibhamu nezinhlamvu ezinyamalele kwenziwa ngazo ubugebengu.IMeya yasoKhahlamba, uMnuz Vikizitha Mlotshwa, ithe uphenyo lwangaphakathi luthole ukuthi zingu-400 izinhlamvu ezinyamalele."Abacwaningi bamabhuku bomkhandlu bathi uma bebheka, bathola ukuthi izinhlamvu ezingu-400 ezithengiwe kodwa azikho lapho kufanele zigcinwe khona. Akuveli ukuthi kukhona lapho lezi zinhlamvu ezasebenza khona kodwa futhi azikaze azitholakali uma zibhekwa lapho zigcinwa khona."UMlotshwa uthe esibalweni sezinhlamvu ezingekho, ezingu-100 kuzona ezesibhamu naso esingatholakali."Kuyasimangaza lokho kokuthi kunyamalale izinhlamvu zesibhamu naso esinyamalele."UMlotshwa uthe kunesibhamu esikhulu somkhandlu esingaziwa ukuthi sikuphi."Kunesibhamu esikhulu esathengwa umkhandlu, sabhaliswa futhi siyavela ohlwini lwezibhamu emaphoyiseni kodwa asitholakali."UMlotshwa uthe umasipala waphinde wathenga amavolovolo ayisishiyagalombili. Uthe okumangalisayo ukuthi kwabhaliswa amavolovo ayisikhombisa kuphela. Uthe - ngokuhamba kwesikhathi - libuye latholakala ivolovolo lesishiyagalombili."Inkinga ke manje asisazi ukuthi siqhamukaphi lesi bhamu nokuthi futhi besenzani?"UMlotshwa uthe ngesikhathi kuphenywa kutholakala inhlokohlela yesibhamu engaziwa ehhovisi lomsebenzi womkhandlu omisiwe."Akekho umuntu osivumayo lesi sibhamu. Ihlathi lesibhamu esingalazi ukuthi selibulele abantu abangaki. Kusabhekwa amakhamera ukuze kuzobonakala ukuthi safika kanjani emkhandlwini lesi sibhamu."UMlotshwa uthe basezinhlelweni zokuvula icala."Ngenxa yokuthi zonke lezi zinto ziphakamisa imibuzo, ngiyalele imenenja kamasipala nomqondisi obhekelele ezokuphepha, ukuba bayovula icala emaphoyiseni ukuze umkhandlu ungeke ungene enkingeni. Ngempela bayile esiteshini samaphoyisa kodwa bafike balulekwa ngokuthi umeluleki wezomthetho emkhandlwini abhale umbiko ngalolu daba, bese kuvulwa icala. Sisalinde umbiko bese bephindela beyovula icala."UMlotshwa uthe ufuna bathathelwe izinyathelo abathintekayo."Umuntu owathenga izinhlamvu ukhona futhi wazisayinela. Nomuntu owathenga izibhamu ukhona futhi wazisayinela. Kuzofanele bachaze."Ugcizelele ukuthi kuyabakhathaza ukuduka kwezibhamu nezinhlamvu ikakhulukazi njengoba kunenkinga yokubulawa kwabantu endaweni."Kuyasithusa njengomkhandlu ngoba kufe abantu abaningi eBergville, erenki, bedutshulwa. Bayishumi abantu ababulewe. Siyathandaza ngoba uma imibiko yokuhlolwa kwezibhamu nezinhlamvu ezisetshenziswe kula macala ingathola ukuthi kwasetshenziswa izibhamu noma izinhlamvu zomkhandlu, kungaba kubi."
BADONSWE ngendlebe omasipala baKwaZulu-Natal abahlulwa wukusebenzisa imali ize ibuyele emuva.UMphathiswa wokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, uthe omasipala kufanele baqikelele ukuthi basebenzisa yonke imali abasuke beyabelwe kusenesikhathi khona kungeke kube khona imali ebuyiselwa emuva.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma emhlanganweni obuhanjelwe yizikhulu zomasipala kanye namakhosi.Umhlangano wayizolo eThekwini ububizelwe ukubhunga ngesimo semikhandlu.UButhelezi uthe omasipala abahlulwa ukusebenzisa imali abasuke beyabelwe benza ukuthi abantu bangazitholi izidingo."Imali esuke yabiwe isinikeza ithuba lokuthi sishintshe impilo yabantu. Uma omasipala behluleka ukusebenzisa imali abasuke beyabelwe kuphazamiseka ukwakhiwa kwengqalasizinda, kuphazamiseke izinhlelo zentuthuko kanye nokukhula komnotho."UButhelezi uthe ukwehluleka komasipala ukusebenzisa imali kwenza impilo ibe nzima kubantu."Omasipala basekhaleni lokuhanjiswa kwezidingo. Yibona abasondelene kakhulu nabantu. Izidingo ezifana namanzi, ukuhanjiswa kwendle nodoti, akufanele ziphazamiseke."UButhelezi uthe kubalulekile ukuthi omasipala babhukule ikakhulukazi njengoba sekubhekwe okhethweni lohulumeni basekhaya.Uthe omasipala kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi bahlala besesimweni esihle emalini, wabagqugquzela ukuba baqinisekise ukuthi baqoqa imali eyanele.UButhelezi uthe omasipala kufanele babambisane nehlangano eyengamele ukhetho, i-Independent Electoral Commission (IEC), ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukhetho luba yimpumelelo.Uphinde wethula umbiko ngezinhlekelele ezihlasele KwaZulu-Natal kuleli hlobo.UMphathiswa uveze ukuthi bangu-35 abantu abashone ezinhlekeleleni ezenzeke kusukela ngoDisemba.Abantu abashonile bamuke nemifula, abanye bashaywa wumbani abanye basha.UButhelezi uthe kusathungathwa abantu abayisithupha abamuke nemifula."Amathimba ayaqhubeka nokubheka abadukile. Siyazwelana kakhulu nemindeni ethintekile. Sinxusa abantu ukuthi baqaphele uma lina bakugweme ukuwela imifula engenisayo. Izifunda ezithinteke kakhulu uMgungundlovu, Amajuba, uThukela, eThekwini, Ugu, Mzinyathi, Zululand, Mkhanyakude neLembe."UButhelezi uthe bazoqhamuka namaqhinga okugwema ukulahleka kwemiphefumulo uma kunezinhlekelele.Uthe sebeqalile ukulungiselela ukubhekana nezinhlekelele zasebusika."Sesiqalile ukulekelela omasipala, siqinisekisa ukuthi bakulungele ukubhekana nezinhlekelele zasebusika. Inhloso yethu wukuvikela impilo yabantu."
UKhomishana wamaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi uzokwengamela umhlangano oyisipesheli phakathi kososeshini abayizimbangi, iKwaMaphumulo Taxi Association kanye neKwaDukuza Taxi Association ngoMgqibelo. Inhloso yalo mhlangano ukuqeda ukungezwani okukhona phakathi kososeshini ababili ababanga imizila phakathi kokunye ukungezwani. Ukungezwani osekunesikhathi eside kuholele ekuphazamisekeni kokuhamba kwezimoto nodlame. UKhomishana WesiFundazwe uzozama ukuthola ababambiqhaza abathintekayo etafuleni ukuze baxazulule umsuka wenkinga futhi bathole izixazululo ezihlala njalo.
UMQONDISI jikelele eMnyangweni weMfundo eyisiSekelo, uMnuz Mathanzima Mweli, uhlabe ikhwelo ezikoleni ukuthi zabe othisha ngokwezifundo abagogode kuzona.UMweli uthe kunenkinga yokushoda kothisha ezifundweni ezithile kwezinye izikole, ekubeni kugcwele othisha abafundisa izifundo ezizodwa.Uthe kubalulekile ukuthi uma kwabiwa othisha, babiwe ngokwezifundo abagogode kuzona emanyuvesi."Uthola ukuthi kushoda uthisha ozofundisa isifundo sezolimo, kodwa isikole sigcwele othisha abafundisa izilimi. Lokhu kwenza ukuthi kugcine sekuthathwa omunye wothisha ongabe ufundisa izilimi, afakwe ukuthi afundise ezolimo ekubeni engenalwazi ngalesi sifundo," usho kanje. Ukusho lokhu ephendula amalungu ePhalamende, kulandela isikhalo sokuthi kunothisha abafundisa izifundo abangenalwazi ngazo.Usihlalo wekomiti lezemfundo, uNksz Joy Maimela, uthe bahambele izikole ezehlukene bafike bahlangabezana nenkinga yothisha abangazi lutho ngezifundo abazifundisa nsuku zonke.Uthe kwezinye izikole, bafice othishanhloko befundisa ngenxa yokushoda kothisha."Kwezinye zezikole imiphumela ibingemihle, uma sibuza satshelwa ukuthi yingoba akekho uthisha ogogodile ofundisa leso sifundo. Le nto yandile ezikoleni zethu, kanti umnyango kumele uyisukumele." Nelungu le-EFF uMnuz Mandla Shikwambana, lihambe emazwini kaNksz Maimela, lathi le nkinga yande kakhulu ezikoleni."Akukhona nje ukuthi othisha abagogodile ekutheni bangafundisa, inkinga wukuthi bafundisa izifundo abangazazi kwabona. Lokhu kudalela abafundi inkinga ngoba bafundiswa ngabantu kwabona abangazi." UMweli uthe bayazama ukuyixazulula le nkinga ngokuthi bajube othisha abafundiswa wuhulumeni, ngaphansi komfundaze iFunza Lushaka. Nokho ukhale ngenkinga yemali, eyenza bangakwazi ukubaqasha labo thisha."Sigcina sesibadedela ukuthi bahambe bayozifunela umsebenzi noma sibaxhase ngokubafundisa ngoba singenazo izikhala zokubaqasha. Ngokomthetho kumele ngabe siyabaqasha bonke kodwa asikwazi ngenxa yemali," kusho uMweli.Kulo mhlangano kuvele ukuthi babalelwa ku-10 000 othisha abafundiswa ngalo mfundaze, kodwa bangu-2 662 kuphela abaqashiwe. Okunye okuvelile wukuthi iminyango yezifundazwe ibhekene nenkinga enkulu yokungakwazi ukuvala izikhala zabasebenzi ngenxa yemali.Kuphinde kwanxuswa iminyango yezifundazwe ukuthi iyisebenzise yonke imali esuke yabelwe yona ikakhulu eyengqalasizinda ngoba izikole eziningi zisesimeni esingesihle.IPhini likaNgqongqoshe womnyango, uDkt Reginah Mhaule, likhale ngokwanda kwesibalo sabafundi minyaka yonke, eyenza kugcwale kuchichime emakilasini."EGauteng nje kulo nyaka, kufike abafundi ababalelwa ku-100 000 abasha, abebengekho nyakenye. Bekumele lo mnyango wakhe izikole ezicela ku-30, ukuze ukwazi ukwamukela lesi sibalo. Yinto engeke yenzeke le ngenxa yemali. Asikwazi ukungabamukeli laba bafundi nakuba kuzogcwala emakilasini."
KUZOPHELA amahlathi okucasha kubashushisi abafaka unyawo lwedada uma kushushiswa amacala njengoba inhloko yophiko lwezokushushisa, iNational Prosecuting Authority, u-Advocate Andy Mothibi, ithembise ukubhekana nabo.UMothibi obekhuluma okokuqala nabezindaba izolo selokhu aqokwa kulesi sikhundla, uthembise ukusiphula inkohlakalo kulolu phiko. Uthe uthole imibiko yokuthi kunabashushisi abangenelelayo baphazamise ukushushiswa kwamacala."Sifuna umphakathi ubuyelwe yithemba ophikweni lwezokushushisa. Abashushisi kumele bashushie amacala ngaphandle kokwesaba nokwenzelela," usho kanje. Uthe bazogcwalisa nezikhala ezibalulekile kulolu phiko ukuze kusheshiswe uhlelo lokushushiswa kwamacala."Sizosebenzisa nobuchwepheshe ukusheshisa amacala. Liphezulu izinga lobugebengu kuleli kodwa kuhamba kancane ukushushiswa kwamacala nokukhishwa kwezigwebo." Uveze nokuthi bazogxila emacaleni athinta inkohlakalo, ubugebengu obuhleliwe, nenzeka ngesikhathi sobandlululo kuleli. Ubalule nokuthi ufuna baqaphe ngelokhozi okwenzeka kumakhomishini ahlukene kuleli okubalwa nekaMadlanga, ukuze uma kuphuma izincomo bahlale izithonto kulabo okumele bashushiswe. Elinye icala athe balibheke ngelokhozi, elokubulawa kowayengunozinti we-Orlando Pirates neBafana Bafana, uSenzo Meyiwa, elisaqhubeka namanje enkantolo."Angu-292 amacala okungakakhishwa izigwebo kuwona. Yingakho siyibeke eqhulwini eyokuphothulwa ngokushesha kwamacala."UMothibi uthe ngeke bawashiye ngaphandle amacala okuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane."Njengoba lesi sihlava sesithathwa njengenhlekelele, sizofaka izinsiza ukushushisa amacala athinta ukuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane. Namacala okubulala, nawokudlwengula ngeke asale ngaphandle ezintweni eziseqhulwini." Uthe bafuna lolu phiko luzimele ngasemalini nangendlela olusebenza ngayo, wathi sebexoxile noNgqongqoshe wezobuLungiswa owesekayo lo mbono.Uveze ukuthi uma kususwa izibhamu ezingekho emthethweni, lokho kungasiza empini yokulwa nobugebengu obuhleliwe."Sihlanganile noKhomishana wamaphoyisa, ukuze izinhlelo zethu nezamaphoyisa zihambisane. Lezi zinhlelo zbandakanya ukuhlonza amacala ukuze asheshe ashushiswe." Uthe bazoqhubeka bathungathe ababalekela umthetho ukuze kubuyiswe imali edliwe kungafanele."Ngizokwenza umsebenzi wami ngokwethembeka, akukho okungivimbayo ukuthi ngenze lokhu."
KUNTWELA ezansi ngenkinga yokuhlinzekwa kwamanzi kuleli njengoba uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, ethembise ukuthi kuzophela le nyanga selibunjiwe ithimba elizobhekana nale nkinga.URamaphosa okusho lokhu ephendula imibuzo ePhalamende izolo, umemezele ukusungulwa kwethimba elizobhekana nenkinga yokuhlinzekwa kwemiphakathi ngamanzi, azoba ngusihlalo walo."Uyaqhubeka umsebenzi wokuqhamuka nohlelo oluzosetshenziswa ukubhekana nenkinga yamanzi nokubunjwa kwethimba elizobhekana nale nkinga. Lo msebenzi kulindeleke ukuthi uphothulwe ekupheleni kukaMashi, nonyaka," kusho uRamaphosa. Iseqhulwini kuRamaphosa eyokulungiswa kwenkinga yokugqoza kokuhanjiswa kwamanzi njengoba eveze nokuthi mkhulu umsebenzi osuwenziwe eThekwini ukulungisa le nkinga."Amapayipi ahambisa amanzi asemadala, kudingeka ilungiswe ingqalasizinda yamanzi. Asizosinisa mahleza, abahlulwa umsebenzi wokuhambisa amanzi ngeke sinanaze ukubakhomba indlela, sifake abantu abazokwenza umsebenzi," usho kanje, wathi kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi uthole amanzi.Uveze nokuthi ngeke kuvikelwe muntu ozokhonjwa ngokwenza okungafanele yiKhomishini kaMadlanga, ephenya izinsolo zenkohlakalo kwezobulungiswa kubalwa nasemaphoyiseni."Akukho ukwenzelela okuzoba khona kwabakhonjwe yikhomishini noma kungathiwa ngubani. Sifuna bashushiswe nalabo okuyotholakala ukuthi bayathinteka ezenzweni zenkohlakalo." Uthe wajuba ibamba likaNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa uSolwazi Firoz Cachalia, noKhomishana wamaPhoyisa uGeneral Fannie Masemola, ukuthi basungule ithimba elizophenya okuvela amagama abo kwikhomishini."Kungaba yingozi ukudedela umbiko wekhomishini njengoba isaqhubeka. Kumele sinike ithuba nofakazi abangakaveli kuyona futhi bangabi madolonzima ukuya kuyona," kusho uRamaphosa njengoba kunabakhala ngokuthi akakawudedeli umbiko wokuqala wekhomishini, awuthola ngoDisemba nyakenye.Ubalule nokuthi bayaqhubeka neyomshwalense wezempilo, iNational Health Insurance (NHI), phezu kokuba kukhona abaye enkantolo beyophikisana nalokhu. "Ezinye zezikhungo zezempilo azikho esimeni esihle, kudingeka zilungiswe. Asijiki ekutheni eyalo mshwalense kumele iqhubeke ngoba izosiza abantu bakuleli." Umholi we-EFF uMnuz Julius Malema, ubuze ukuthi ngabe uyakweseka yini ukuthi imitholampilo ivulwe ubusuku nemini."Ngiyavumelana nalesi siphakamiso, inkinga wukuthi kumele kube nabasebenzi okubalwa abahlengikazi nodokotela. Abantu bahlale bekhala ngokuthi lezi zikhungo azivulwa. Inkinga kuzoba yimali, okuyinto esizama ukuyilungisa."
INGWAZI yomculo wesintu, uDkt Sipho Sithole, ikhala ngokwehla kwesithunzi emculweni kamaskandi njengoba sekuqhakanjiswa kakhulu amagidangoma nobusaziwayo, hhayi umculo. USithole uthe kuyihlazo futhi kuyajabhisa ukubona abaculi abanegalelo elikhulu emculweni kamaskandi bebulala lo mculo. Uthe lo mculo awusafani njengoba sekuqhudelwana ngabalandeli, nokuthi ubani othenge imoto kanokusho edlula ekabani, nobucebi. USithole uthi ucabanga ukuthi abafazi balaba baculi baze babuze abayeni babo ukuthi kungani usudlulwa usibanibani osethenge imoto kanokusho. Uthe kunabadlali balo mculo abagcina ukubona imali uma beqashiwe uma kuqoshwa icwecwe kuphela."Emuva kwalokho ababe besadlala. Lokhu sekubangele ubuphofu kubadlali balo mculo ngenxa yokungaqashwa. Abanye abaculi abafana noSkhindi sabeSuthu, obedlala inkostini, noLahlumlenze, owaduma kakhulu ngokudlala i-accordion, bagcine beshonile, bebulawa yindlala." USithole ukhuluma kanjena nje uhlelele umphakathi waseMsinga idili lomculo wesintu iMsinga Folk & Indigenous Music Festival ezinkundleni zemidlalo zaseMzisho eTugela Ferry ngoMashi 21. Uthe ufuna izethameli zibuyele emakhaya zingawuvali umlomo njengoba izinsimbi ziyobe zidlalwa bukhoma. Uthe okunye okuzohluka kakhulu ngalo mcimbi wukuthi kuzobe kunandisa abaculi bakuleli nabasemazweni angaphandle. Kwabakuleli kuboshelwe uMntuyenziwa, Inkosi Yamagcokama, Simmy, Buhle Nhlangulela, Zakwe, Pomeroy Gordon Stars, Lwah Ndlunkulu, Soul Brothers, Big Zulu, Nkonzo, Felikhono, Thiwe nabanye. Kubabaculi bangaphandle kubalwe uKommanda Obbs (Lesotho), Bholoja (Swaziland) noPositive Black Soul (Senegal). USithole, ebambisene nowakwakhe uVelile Sithole, sebenamava kule ndima yokuhlelwa kwemicimbi eseqophelweni eliphezulu futhi abaqali njengoba bake baletha indodana kaBob Marley, uDamian Marley ngo-2017. Basebenze kakhulu emazweni angaphandle behambisa abaculi kuma-festival afana neWomad (eNgilandi, Australia, eNew Zealand), Atlantic Music Expo (Cape Verde), Doa Doa (Uganda), Azgo (Mozambique), Bushfire (Swatini), Africa Festival (Germany), Edinburgh Festivals (Scotland), Sacred Festival (India), Sakifo Festival (Reunion Island) neSakifo Music Festival (eThekwini). Bobabili bake baqokwa wuMnyango wezobuCiko namaSiko kuzwelonke ngo-2010 ukuba bahlele amakhonsathi onyaka wonke eChina, lapho babehambisa amaqembu amaningi ukuyokhombisa ubunono nokuhleleka komculo wamaciko akuleli.IMsinga Folk & Indigenous Music Festival yesekwe yiNational Arts Council, Presidential Employment Stimulas Programme, Umsinga Municipality, KZN Dept of Sports, Arts, and Culture, KZN Dept of Economic Development, Tourism and Environment, Amafa Research Institute, Msinga FM, neWonga Music, ezobe ilethe amanzi azophuzwa abaculi kanye nezihambeli. Amathikithi ayotholakala eTicketpro naseComputicket ngo-R150 (General), R550 (VIP), nango-R850 (VVIP). Ezitolo atholakala ePick n Pay, Shoprite, Jumbo, Spar, Checkers, Rhino Cash & Carry, USave, Power Fashion (Tugela Ferry), naseKhonzinkosi Spar (Tugela Ferry).
IZOGXILA kakhulu ekufukuleni abalimi abasafufusa inhlangano kamasingcwabisane, i-Amahle Benefits Scheme, njengoba izohlanganisa iminyaka engu-19 yasungulwa ngoMgqibelo ozayo.Lokhu kuvezwe wumsunguli wayo, ongusomabhizinisi odumile, uDkt Bahle Zondo enkulumweni abe nayo neSolezwe izolo. UZondo uthe njengoba bezoba nomcimbi wokugubha ukuzalwa kwale nkampani ehholo iCecil Emmett eVryheid, uzokwendlala izinhlelo ezintsha zokusiza imiphakathi, aphinde aveze ukuthi uhlele ukuthi zixhaswe ngamalini. Uthe i-Amahle ngesikhathi eyisungula yayiwumbono wokulekelela abantu ngomasingcwabisane onamanani aphansi kodwa wabuye wabona isidingo sokuthi alethe olunye usizo ebantwini besaphila."Yilapho okuqhamuke khona ezinye izimpiko ezifana neBZ Farming, i-Dkt Bahle Zondo Foundation neBursary Scheme,” kusho uZondo.Uthe maqondana neBZ Farming ulekelela kakhulu abantu basemakhaya ukuze bakhule kwezolimo, kuthi iBursary Scheme ixhase abafundi ngemifundaze yokufunda emanyuvesi, bese kuthi iDkt Bahle Zondo Foundation yenze iminikelo eyehlukene emphakathini. Uthe okusenhliziyweni yakhe kakhulu ngezolimo njengoba isalokhu iqhubeke njalo inkinga yendlala eNingizimu Afrika."Ukubacathulisa abantu ukuthi batshalele ukudayisa kanjalo nokuxosha ikati eziko kubalulekile ngoba ukudla kuyabiza, abantu abahlwempu abanayo imali eyanele yokuthenga ukudla,” kusho uZondo.Uthe okunye akuqaphele eminyakeni edlule, wukuthi uhulumeni uyababuyisela abantu umhlaba wokuthi benze amapulazi kodwa kusilele ekutheni balekelelwe ekutheni bakwenza kanjani lokhu ukuthi kube yimpumelelo. "Yilapho esingenelela khona sibacathulise kuzo zonke izigaba kwezolimo, okubandakanya ukutshala kuze kuyofika esigabeni lapho sibatholela khona imakethe yokudayisa imikhiqizo yabo,” usho kanje.Uveze ukuthi sebexhase imifelandwonye eyevile ku-30, eminye esize yakwazi ukuzimela ngokugcwele. Uphethe ngokuthi ngale kokulekelela abatshalayo, bayabalekelela nalabo abafuye izilwane ezifana nezimbuzi.
USIZWE ukulubika ekomkhulu lamaphoyisa esifundazweni udaba lwakhe owesifazane othandana nabantu abanobulili obufana nobakhe waseMpangeni, njengoba zigcine ziyikhalele Inkosi yesizwe esithile kule ndawo, okuthiwa yazama ukumdlwengula ngoDisemba nyakenye.Kulesi sigameko esenzeka ngasekupheleni kukaDisemba, inkosi (engeke idalulwe ngoba ayikabuzwa yinkantolo ukuthi iyalivuma noma iyaliphika yini icala) yazama ukumdlwengula owesifazane oneminyaka engu-40 kwenye yezindawo zokulala eMpangeni.Ngokusho kwesihlobo sikamgilwa, esingeke sidalulwe, isigameko senzeka emva kokuthi umsolwa, eshayele umgilwa ucingo, wathi ucela ukumbona, baxoxe. "Akazange axwaye kangako ngoba yinkosi yangakubo, wavuma ukuba ize ngalapho ayesebenza ngakhona. Bagcina behambisana beya emakhaya njengoba umgilwa wayevele enezinhlelo zokugoduka,” kusho umthombo.Nokho uveza ukuthi endleleni, inkosi yashaya imoto yaya endaweni yokulala, nalapho eyafika yacela ukuba bangene ngaphakathi, ukuze baxoxe kahle esithe, bengekho abaqaphi bayo eduzane."Sebengene ngaphakathi, umsolwa wavele wacela ukulala nomgilwa, owala waphetha. Umsolwa wabe esengena ethoyilethi wabuya esenqunu, esephulula ubuntu bakhe,” kusho umthombo. Uveze ukuthi nakuba waphunyuka umgilwa, wasizwa ukungena kocingo lowesifazane, owayebuza umsolwa ukuthi ukuphi ngoba usemhlanganisele amantombazane abewafunile.Udalule ukuthi umgilwa wawubikela umndeni wakhe ngesigameko, waphinde wavula necala emaphoyiseni, maqede kwathula kwathi du, ingaboshwa inkosi."Nakuba igcine iboshwa ngoLwesithathu, kusize ukuthi ezinsukwini, ushayele ekomkhulu lamaphoyisa, wabika ukuthi akabutholi ubulungiswa ecaleni alivulela inkosi ngoDisemba nyakenye,” kusho umthombo.Umthombo uthe abanasiqiniseko sokuthi yini eyaholela ekutheni inkosi ifune ukudlwengula umgilwa ngoba yayazi ukuthi uthandana nabanobulili obufana nobakhe."Asazi noma yayihlose ukumyala ngenxa yendlela aphila ngayo, noma ibisambambele igqubu ngoba wake wayigxeka ezinkundleni zokuxhumana." Inkosi engumsolwa lapha ihlale isolwa ngezigemegeme ezishiya abantu bebambe ongezansi.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe abaphenyi bophiko lwamaphoyisa iMpangeni Family Violence Child Protection and Sexual Offences Unit (FCS) babophe umsolwa (28) ngecala lokuzama ukudlwengula umgilwa ngoDisemba 23, 2025.Uthe umsolwa uvele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMpangeni ngoLweisthathu. Isolezwe lithole ukuthi icala lihlehliselwe uLwesithathu oluzayo ukuze umsolwa, otokile, afake isicelo sebheyili.
ZITHELA izithelo ezinhle izinhlelo ezehlukene zabezeMvelo KZN Wildlife, ezibandakanya ubuchwepheshe obusezingeni eliphezulu, ukuvimba ukubulawa kobhejane ngenhloso yokweba izimpondo zabo okuthiwa ziyinyama emazweni aphesheya, asezwenikazi i-Asia.Lokhu kuvezwe wuMphathiswa woMnyango wokuThuthukiswa koMnotho, ezokuVakasha nezeMvelo KwaZulu-Natal, uMfu Musa Zondi, eHilltop Camp, eHluhluwe-iMfolozi Park (HiP) ngoLwesibili.UZondi uveze ukuthi ngoJanuwari nonyaka, akubanga khona nowodwa ubhejane obulewe eziqiwini ezibhekwe abezeMvelo KZN Wildlife. "Lokhu akuvelanga kwazenzakalela nje kodwa kube wumsebenzi owenziwe ngokubambisana nangokuzimisela,” kusho uZondi.Ubalule ukuthi lokhu kube wumphumela womsebenzi wezobunhloli, okubandakanya ubuchwepheshe obuthuthukisiwe nobusezingeni eliphezulu."Kutshalwe inqwaba yonogada beziqiwi, kwafakwa imishini eqapha ngokobuchwepheshe, kwaphinde kwenziwa uhlelo lokususwa kwezimpondo kobhejane,” kusho uZondi. Uhlelo lokususwa kwezimpondo zobhejane luqale ngo-Ephreli 2024. Lwaba yisisombululo sokugcina abezeMvelo abafinyelela kuso, kulandela ukungalawuleki kwendlela ababebulawa ngayo. UZondi uthe kuphinde kwalekelela nokuqinisa ezobunhloli lapho kusetshenziswana khona nezinhlaka ezehlukene zomthetho.Uthe ukubambisana nemiphakathi akuzange kusale ngaphandle njengoba nakho kuklame indima ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ziyathikanyezwa izindlela zokuzingelwa kobhejane. "Sigudlukile ekutheni kube khona esikwenzayo ngoba nakhu sekukhona umonakalo owenzekile, sagxila ekutheni siqinise ekunqandeni umonakalo,” usho kanje.Uthe abezeMvelo KZN Wildlife batshengisile ukuthi lolu hlobo lobugebengu obuhleliwe lunganqotshwa uma kubanjiswana.Isikhulu esiphezelu sezeMvelo KZN Wildlife, uMnuz Sihle Mkhize, sithe eminyakeni emithathu edlule beliphezulu kakhulu izinga lokuzingelwa kobhejane. Uthe baqala ngokuthi bonke abasebenzi beziqiwi baphoqwe ukuba bahlolwe ngemishini yokubabamba uma beqamba amanga - kubhekwa ukuthi akukho yini abakwaziyo ngokubulawa kobhejane, abakwenza emva kokuxoxisana nezishoshovu zabasebenzi ngalolu hlelo.Uthe kwaqala yena phambili, walandelwa yibo bonke abasebenzi ababesekhaleni lokulwa nokubulawa kobhejane. "Abaningi baphuma phambili kulolu hlelo, kwathi abambalwa abafeyila, basuswa eziqiwini ezinobhejane,” kusho uMkhize, othe kwaba nomdonsiswano omkhulu ngalokhu. "Yonke le mizamo, yalekelela kakhulu ekutheni kuliwe nenkinga yokuzingelwa kobhejane,” usho kanje.Uthe kwabasiza kakhulu futhi nokusebenzisana nemiphakathi, okubandakanya amakhosi angu-10 akhele iziqiwi eziseHluhluwe namaphethelo, amalungu ebhodi, nokuyilapho kwavunyelwana khona ngezinye izinto ezibandakanya ukuthi imiphakathi kufanele ihlomule nayo ngesiqiwi."Eminye yemisebenzi, engadingi amakhono atheni, savumelana ngokuthi sizoya emphakathini, siqashe labo bantu,” kusho uMkhize. Uthe baphinde bavula ithuba lokuthi eminye imikhiqizo bayithenge emiphakathini eseduze, wabalula izinto ezifana namaqanda nokunye. Uthe baphinde babafundisa ukuthi baba kanjani osomabhizinisi abakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemikhiqizo esuke idingeka ngaphandle kwezinkinga.Phakathi kobuchwepheshe obulethwe eHiP, yisikhungo i-Nerve Centre ebhekele ukugadwa kwabangena esiqiwini ngendlela engafanele. Ukukha phezulu, lesi sikhungo sibheka ukusebenza koxhaxha lwamakhamera athukuswe ezindaweni ezehlukene esiqiwini. Njengonyazi, la makhamera akwazi ukuthwebula izithombe eziningana zabantu abasuke bedlula ngakuwo, aphinde athathe ne-video. Ngokuphazima kweso abe esekuthumela kulesi sikhungo, kuhanjiiswa umyalezo wokuthi kukhona ubungozi osebungaphakathi esiqiwini.Abakulesi sikhungo basuke sebezothatha izinyathelo ezifanele njengokuthumela ama-drone agijima ibanga elilinganiselwa ku-87km ngehora, ukuya ngalapho okusuke sekuvele khona ukuthi kukhona asebengene esiqiwini kungafanele. Nawo athwebula ezawo izithombe. Kukhona nezinja eziqeqeshiwe ezikwazi ukulandela umkhondo ngephunga, ezikwazi ukusifuna zize zisithole isigebengu. Kuphinde kube khona nendiza enophephela emhlane, nayo efika ngokuphazima kweso lapho okusuke sekunomonakalo khona.

IQEMBU elingababeki benkosi kuhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal, iNFP, lisengcupheni yokuphuthelwa ukhetho lohulumeni basekhaya oluzayo. Amalungu eNFP anganelisekile abhalele inhlangano eyengamele ukhetho, i-Independent Electoral Commission (IEC), ecela ukuba iqembu lingavunyelwa ukuba libe yingxenye yokhetho olubhekwe ngabomvu. La malungu afuna ukuthi i-IEC ingabumukeli ubuholi beNFP obukhona njengamanje obakhethwa engqungqutheleni eyayingo-2023.Kunamalungu eNFP aphonsela inselelo imiphumela yengqungquthela yango-2023. Ngokuthola kweSolezwe amalungu abhalele i-IEC angu-15.Isolezwe libone umyalezo kaNobhala Jikelele weNFP obambile, uMnuz Sunset Xaba, lapho ekhuza khona akubiza ngomhlola.Kulo myalezo obonwe yiSolezwe, uXaba uthe uphenyo lwabo lwesikhashana luveze ukuthi kulabo abafuna ukuthi iqembu lingalungeneli ukhetho kukhona labo abanganelisekile ngemiphumela yengqungquthela yango-2023, kanye nalabo abanganelisekile ngokuhlakazwa kobuholi obakhethwa ngo-2019.Ubuholi obakhethwa ngo-2019, bahlakazwa emva kokuba iNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu, yathola ukuthi akuzange kulandelwe imigomo ngesikhathi kunengqungquthela.Icala lahamba laze lafika eNkantolo yezoMthethosisekelo, nayo eyavumelana nesinqumo seNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu. Emyalezweni, uXaba uqhube athi abanye abafuna ukuthi iqembu lingavunyelwa ukungenela ukhetho basezinhlakeni zobuholi. "Uma besho bona bathi balwela iqembu kodwa iqiniso ukuthi basebenzisana nabantu abalwisa iqembu. Abanye babo baxoshwa eqenjini. Sikhathazekile ngezenzo zabo njengoba zibeka engcupheni ikusasa leqembu. Sizothatha izinyathelo ezifanele. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi sizowadalula amagama abantu abenze le nto."Eqhubeka emyalezweni, uXaba uthe bakwazile ukuyivika induku yabafuna iqembu lingavunyelwa ukungenela ukhetho. "Sinxusa amalungu eqembu ukuba ahlale eqaphile ngoba kusobala ukuthi laba bantu bazoqhubeka nemizamo yabo. Ziningi izinselelo esizinqobile ngaphambilini futhi ziningi esizozinqoba uma sizokuba imbumba."Ethintwa yiSolezwe, uXaba wenqabile ukuphawula ngalolu daba. "Bathe singakhulumi nani ngalolu ngoba nencwadi yabo (abafuna iqembu lingavunyelwa ukungenela ukhetho) asikayitholi. Kusho ukuthi sesingabuye nje sikhulume."Kuze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela engakayiphenduli imibuzo okhulumela i-IEC, uNksz Kate Bapela. I-NFP ike yaba nezinkinga ne-IEC ngenxa yawo njalo umbango wobuholi. Ngaphambi kwengqungquthela yango-2023, iNFP ibingasasitholi isibonelelo sayo esiqhamuka kwi-IEC ngenxa yokuthi bekunezinhlangothi ebezibanga.Ngaphambilini, iNFP isike yaphuthelwa ukhetho lohulumeni basekhaya.Ngo-2016, iqembu alizange lulungenele ukhetho lohulumeni basekhaya ngenxa yokwehluleka ukukhokha ngesikhathi imali yokulungenela.
UMNYANGO wokuMbiwayo uthi impi eqhubeka e-Iran izoholela ekunyukeni kukaphethroli eNingizimu Afrika wathi kodwa impi ngeke iholele ekutheni elakuleli lishodelwe wuphethroli. UMnyango uthe uphethroli uzonyuka kakhulu ngenyanga ezayo ngenxa yempi kodwa wathi elakuleli alikho engcupheni yokuweswela. Impi ephakathi kweMelika ne-Iran idale ukushoda kukaphethroli emhlabeni.Iran isemazweni ahamba phambili ekukhiqizeni u-oyela osetshenziswa uma kwakhiwa uphethroli futhi yakhelene namazwe akhiqiza u-oyela.Selokhu kuqale impi emasontweni amabili edlule amanani kaphethroli anyukile emhlabeni jikelele ngenxa yokwehla komkhiqizo.Okhulumela uMnyango wokuMbiwayo, uNksz Lerato Ntsoko, uthe ukunyuka kwentengo ka-oyela emhlabeni jikelele kuzoholela ekutheni kunyuke uphethroli kuleli."Intengo ka-oyela ilokhu inyuka kusukela kuqale impi. Sizoqhubeka nokuqapha isimo bese senza isimemezelo esisemthethweni ngokunyuka kukaphethroli ngo-Ephreli."UNksz Ntsoko uthe bazoqinisekisa ukuthi uphethroli awupheli kuleli. Uthe izinkampani zakuleli ezisebenzisa u-oyela oqhamuka emazweni abhekene nempi zizama ezinye izindlela zokuthola u-oyela."Siyaxoxa nezinkampani ezikhiqiza uphethroli. Sinethemba lokuthi impi izophela maduze."UNksz Ntsoko uthe kukhona nezinkampani zakuleli ezikhiqiza uphethroli ezisebenzisa u-oyela oqhamuka emazweni alapha e-Afrika. "Nakuba kukhona izindawo eziningi ezikhiqiza uphethroli ezavalwa lapha ezweni, zikhona ezimbili eziqhubekayo nokukhiqiza uphethroli.Kukhona iNATREF ne-Astron Energy. Indawo ye-Astron Energy isavaliwe okwesikhashana ngenxa yokuthi iyalungiswa kodwa banophethroli owanele abawuthenge emazweni angaphandle abazowusebenzisa ngesikhathi besalungisa indawo yabo."
IPHINI likaNobhala jikelele we-ANC lokuqala, uNkk Nomvula Mokonyane, lithi bebengambambele igqubu umsunguli wenhlangano eyafaka umkhokha kwi-ANC, iCope, uMnuz Mosiuoa Lekota.UNkk Mokonyane uthe abananxa nokuthi uLekota wahlubuka kwi-ANC wayoqala iCope ngo-2008.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma enkonzweni yokukhumbula uLekota, ebiseSoweto izolo.I-ANC yaqala ukwehlelwa amandla ngesikhathi kuhlubuka iCope.I-ANC iqhubekile nokwehla uma kunokhetho nokuze kwaholela ekutheni ihluleke ukunqoba ngamalengiso ukhetho lwango-2024.UNkk Mokonyane uthe abambeki cala uLekota."Yingakho uMengameli (uCyril Ramaphosa) ehloniphe uLekota ngomngcwabo kahulumeni. Okusisalele thina ukuba sisho umthandazo othi 'usithethelele amacala ethu njengoba nathi sibathethelela abanamacala kithi. Inkosi isimthethelele uLekota. Sengathi ukushona kwakhe kungadala ubumbano kithina sonke esisele."UNkk Mokonyane uthe nakuba uLekota ashiya kwi-ANC uthe ngeke kuphele ukuthi ikhaya lakhe elikhulu kwezepolitiki likwi-ANC."Sihlangene lapha ngenxa yokuthi nathi siyi-ANC siyingxenye yempilo kaLekota. Sibonga iqhaza alibamba ngesikhathi kuliwa nohulumeni wobandlululo. Abanye bangasho ukuthi ubeyilungu leCope kodwa nathi ngowethu."UNkk Mokonyane uthe uLekota ubengomunye wabaholi abebekholwa wukuthi abantu besifazane banikwe ithuba lokuphatha izikhundla.UNkk Mokonyane uthe kwadingeka ukuthi aqale anxenxwe kuqala uLekota ngaphambi kokuthi abone ukubaluleka kokunika abantu besifazane ithuba lokuphatha izikhundla."Sizomkhumbula kakhulu ngesikhathi kunengqungquthela yango-1991. ULekota, njengabanye abaholi abaningi besilisa, wayengahambisani nomkhankaso wabesifazane wokuthi imbokodo nayo iqokelwe ezikhundleni. Wayengayizwa lena yokuthi u-30% wabaqokelwa ezikhundleni kube abesifazane. Kwaze kwaphoqa ukuthi uMandela ambizele eceleni, amchazele ngokubaluleka kwabesifazane. Wagcina ekubonile ukubaluleka kwabesifazane. Wathi usekhanyiselekile. Wazisholo yena ukuthi abesifazane nabo bangabantu."ULekota uzongcwatshwa ngoMgqibelo, eFree State.Namhlanje kuzoba nenye inkonzo yokukhumbula eLekota ezoba seFree State.Uhlonishwe ngomngcwabo kahulumeni osesigabeni sesibili.Wayengungqongqoshe wezokuVikela, uke waba wundunankulu waseFree State.

UKHALA ngamaphoyisa awenzele phansi umndeni wengane yentombazane osekuphele amasonto amabili inyamalele emijondolo yaseMarikana, eKokstad. ULathitha Mtolo (7) ofunda uGrade 2 eXoloxolo Primary, waduka eyodlala nezinye izingane ngoFebhuwari 26, nonyaka. Ngokusho kwesihlobo sakhe, uNksz Nokulunga Mtolo, amaphoyisa ayekelele abayisihlanu okusolwa ukuthi banolwazi ngokulahleka kwengane. Elandisa ngodaba, uthe emva kwezinsuku ezimbili uLathitha enyamalele, umphakathi owawubafunisa yonke indawo kusukela kubonakala ukuthi ulahlekile, wazithela phezu kwephara phansi kwebhuloho, lihlubule ngezansi kanti izingubo zalo zazigcwele igazi. "Libuzwa ngegazi, laveza ukuthi like lagwazwa esikhathini esingangesonto esedlule. Umphakathi usola ukuthi ngeke ukuthi inxeba eselinesonto lisaphuma igazi, wabiza amaphoyisa afika athatha izingubo ezinegazi ngenhloso yokuthi ziyohlolwa ulibofuzo, kubhekwe ukuthi igazi aliyamene yini noLathitha,” kusho uNksz Mtolo. Uthe kuqhubeke izinsuku, umphakathi nomndeni ucinga ungatholi mkhondo, wavele wakhetha ukubuyela kulo futhi ukuyolihloma imibuzo. "Yilapho elagonyuluka khona ngokuthi linolwazi lukaLathitha. Lathi limthathile layomnika abesifazane ababili abayizangoma. Laveza ukuthi laba basebenzisana nabanye abesilisa ababili abacwiya izingane ziphila, bese beyazibulala, bayophonsa izidumbu zazo edamini eliseFranklin,” kusho uNksz Mtolo, othe laveza nokuthi kade laqala ukusebenzisana nabo futhi balikhokhela u-R4 000 ngengane eyodwa elibalethela yona. Uthe baphinde babiza amaphoyisa ukuthi azolibopha kulandela ingonyuluka yalo. Uthe baya nakuleli dami elikhulume ngalo, yacingwa ingane kodwa ayangatholakala. Esikhundleni salokho, uthe kwatholwa uplastiki omnyama owawugcwele inqwaba yamanabukeni ayenegazi. Uveze ukuthi amaphoyisa awathatha, ahamba nawo. Uthe babanethemba lokuthi buzokwenzeka ubulungiswa kuthathwe nalaba elibagagule ngamagama ukuze nabo bachaze ukuthi ingane iphi. Nokho uthe lokhu akuzange kwangenzeke. "NgoLwesithathu lwesonto eledlule, sasilindele ukuthi livele enkantolo kodwa sathola ukuthi selibuye ladedelwa ngoba amaphoyisa nenkantolo athi abukho ubufakazi obuphathekayo,” kuchaza uNksz Mtolo, othe lokhu kubashiye bedangele kakhulu. Uthe okubaphathe kabi ukuthi bonke laba bantu bavele bashaya utshani futhi akwaziwa ukuthi babaleke babhekaphi. Uveze ukuthi yiyo le nto evele yadina umphakathi, wangqongqisa imizi yabo ngomlilo. "Umphakathi uvele wadinwa washisa imizi yabo, neminye. Uthe awusafune belaphi bendabuko ngoba kunukeka bona ekulahlekeni kwengane,” usho kanje. Uveze ukuthi baphoxekile ngesenzo samaphoyisa, wathi bona ebebekulindele kuwona ukuthi aligcine ngaphakathi iphara, kuze kuba ukuthi kubuya imiphumela yolibofuzo lwegazi. "Uma kubuya imiphumela ithi akulona igazi likaLathitha, abezolidedela-ke. Kodwa uma kuyilo, bekuzofanele liqhubeke livalelwe bese likhipha iqiniso lokuthi uphi,” usho kanje. Uthe sebehambe nabantu abahlolayo ukubheka umkhondo, wathi abaye kubo babatshele ukuthi usaphila, uvalelwe endlini emnyama. Uthe babhekile lapho umkhondo bebewukhomba ngakhona kodwa babuya belambatha."Kuningi okuthusayo abakushoyo. Manje siyazibuza ukuthi uma ephila, ingabe uyanikwa yini ukudla? Uma sebembulele, sesikhalela ithambo lakhe,” usho kanje. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe abaphenyi bophiko lweFamily Violence, Child Protection and Sexual Offences (FCS) bayaqhubeka nophenyo ngokulahleka kwengane (7) eyagcina ukubonwa ngasekupheleni kukaFebhuwari, eMarikana, eKokstad. Uthe amathimba ababheki nabatakuli ayaqhubeka nokuyibheka. Ube eseqinisekisa ukuthi umphakathi uzibambele umuntu obumsola ngokuba nolwazi ngomgilwa. "Bavuke umbhejazane emva kokuba ededelwe yinkantolo yendawo. Amaphoyisa abembeke icala kodwa inkantolo yangalifaka ohlwini lwamacala, ithi idokodo alinabo ubufakazi obubambekayo,” kusho uNetshiunda. Uveze ukuthi umphakathi udinwe washisa umuzi wakubo kwakhe lona wesilisa kanjalo neminye, ebebesola ukuthi abanikazi bayo bebethume lona wesilisa. "Amaphoyisa alokhu ekanise kule ndawo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kukhona ukuthula noxolo,” kusho uNetshiunda.
