KUHLUKENE imibono emalungwini ePhalamende, ngesiphakamiso se-EFF sokuthi kujutshwe ikhomishini ezobhekana nenkinga yaminyaka yonke yokushoda kwezikhala zokufunda ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme.Leli qembu likhala ngokuthi izinkumbi zabafundi eziphase u-matric, zigcina sezibhuquza emakhaya ngenxa yokushoda kwezikhala.UMnuz Sihle Lonzi, ilungu le-EFF, ukhale ngokuthi bangaphezu kuka-600 000 abafundi abaphasa u-matric, kodwa amanyuvesi akwazi ukwamukela ababalelwa ku-235 000 kuphela. Uthe amakolishi amakhono amaTVET, akwazi ukwamukela ababalelwa ku-170 000 kuphela."Lokhu kusho ukuthi babalelwa ku-200 000, abagcina sebebhuquza emakhaya bengasenayo indawo yokufunda. Nango-2024 bangaphezu kuka-200 000 abafundi abangazitholanga izikhala zokufunda. Kucacile ukuthi eminyakeni emibili edlule, bacela ku-500 000 ababhuquza emakhaya ngenxa yokungazitholi izikhala," kusho uLonzi, ngesikhathi kubhungwa ngalesi siphakamiso ePhalamende.UMnuz Mnqobi Msezane weMKP, weseke i-EFF wathi abasuke bephase u-matric baphenduka ondingasithebeni minyaka yonke."Abanye bayazithola kodwa kunezinkinga zokuthi iNSFAS abayitholi ngesikhathi. Yingakho siyeseka eyokuthi iPhalamende lingenelele kule nkinga okucacayo ukuthi nangeminyaka ezayo, izoqhubeka ngoba abahlelelwa abaphase u-matric." UMnuz Sanele Zondo we-IFP, uthe abahambisani neyekhomishini hhayi ngoba zingekho izinselelo kodwa bafuna kwandiswe izikhungo zemfundo."Akufuqwe uhlelo lokufunda ngobuchwepheshe kusalungiswa inkinga yokushoda kwezindawo zokufundela kanjalo nezindawo zokuhlala ezikhungweni zemfundo. Mkhulu umthamo ophuma ku-matric minyaka yonke, uya ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme. Ziyashoda izikhala okwenza abasuke befuna izikhala bagcine sebejikiswa bengazitholile." UNGQONGQOSHE weziSebenzi zikaHulumeni nokuPhatha, Inkosi Mzamo Buthelezi, isiveze ukuthi yakuchitha ukunyuswa kwemali ekhokhelwa i-medical aid yabasebenzi bahulumeni, i-Government Employees Medical Scheme (GEMS).UButhelezi uthe wakuveza ezikhulwini ze-GEMS ukungahambisani kwakhe nokunyuswa kwemali ngo-9.8%."I-GEMS yazisa izinhlaka ezehlukene enkundleni i-Public Service Coordinating Bargaining Council (PSCBC) ngoDisemba nyakenye, ukuthi izonyusa imali. Kunomgomo wokuthi kumele kuvunyelwane ngaphambi kokunyuswa kwemali," kusho uButhelezi. Ukusho lokhu ephendula umbuzo welungu le-EFF ePhalamende, uMnuz Adil Nchabeleng, obuze ukuthi ngabe kwaba khona yini ukuphikisana nesinqumo se-GEMS, esasivela kwizinyunyana zabasebenzi ngokunyuswa kwemali? UButhelezi uthe akuyena ogunyaza ukunyuswa kwemali kodwa kwenziwa yibhodi le-GEMS."Zisaqhubeka izingxoxo phakathi kwami nebhodi le-GEMS mayelana nokwehliswa kwemali njengoba ezikhawini eziningi, ngabaxwayisa ngalokhu kunyuswa kwemali. Ukwehliswa kwemali isuka ku-9.8% iya ku-9.5%, akubanga namthelela okutheni emalini ekhokhwa abasebenzi," kusho uButhelezi. Muva nje, izinyunyana ezehlukene zabasebenzi bahulumeni zimashele i-GEMS zifuna kwehliswe imali. Zifuna nokuthi kwenziwe uphenyo mayelana nezikhulu ze-GEMS kuphinde kuchithwe nesikhulu sayo.Zanika i-GEMS izinsuku eziyisikhombisa ukuthi ziphendule izikhalazo zazo, zathi zisabheka nezinye izindlela ezingazisebenzisa, okubalwa nokuya enkantolo ukuze kuphoqwe i-GEMS ukuthi yehlise imali.Izinyunyana ezingaphansi kweFedusa, zilulele isikhathi i-GEMS ukuthi iphendule kwizikhalazo zayo. Le nyunyana ibhikishe ngoFebhuwari 21, ikhala ngokunyuswa kwemali. Nezinyunyana ezingaphansi kweCosatu zisho ngazwi linye ukuthi zifuna kwehliswe le mali. Zikhale nangokuthi iminyaka ilandelana, inyuswa kakhulu imali ekhokhwa abasebenzi ekubeni isheshe iphele nemali ezabelwa nonyaka ungakapheli.Izinyunyana zasabisa nangokuthi zizobamba ukhukhulelangoqo wesiteleka uma i-GEMS iqhubeka nokuqinisa ikhanda.I-GEMS yaveza ukuthi yanyusa imali ngenxa yokunyuka kwezindleko nemali eyikhokhile ngamalungu ayo. Yakhala nangenkohlakalo eyenzekayo njengoba yasola amanye amalungu ngokuthi alalisa izihlobo zawo ezibhedlela ezizimele, ezingekho ngaphansi kwe-GEMS.

BELIBA sematheni ngezinto eziningi igama leNkosi yaseMathulini ekhothame kungalindelekile, uPhathisizwe Philbert Luthuli (64).Kuvela ukuthi inkosi ivele yawa phansi ngoMsombuluko ngabo-8 ebusuku. Lezi zindaba kuvela ukuthi ziwushaqisile umphakathi waseMnini, eMgababa.Induna yaseMagcino, eMathulini ephinde ibe yilungu lomndeni, uMnuz Msawakhe Luthuli, ithe bagqemeke engeqiwa ntwala ngokukhothama kwenkosi.Ichaze inkosi njengomuntu obesithanda kakhulu isizwe sakhe elwela ukuthi njalo asibone sithuthuka ngayo yonke indlela.''Inkosi ibingenza noma yini ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi siyadlondlobala isizwe sayo futhi siba nenqubekela phambili. Kuningi kakhulu okuhle esikufundile kuyona. Impela sife olwembiza ngokuhamba kwayo emhlabeni," usho kanjena.Uncome kakhulu inkosi ngendima athe iyiklamile ekuthuthikiseni ezemfundo kule ndawo. Uthe inkosi ibizifela ngezemfundo. ''Ibingenza noma yini inkosi uma nje kukhulunywa ngodaba lwezikole zakule ndawo. Ibifuna ukuzibona zenza kahle futhi ziphumelela. Siyakubonga kakhulu ebikwenza isaphila," kuchaza induna.Ithe osekubathoba amanxeba wukuthi inkosi kukhulu ekwenzele isizwe sayo isadla anhlamvana. Iveze ukuthi bese kuphele isikhathi eside inkosi ihola isizwe saseMathulini.Ithe inkosi ibinabantwana abangaphezu kuka-20, ishiye emhlabeni uNdlunkulu uMaMsomi.Yize isho kanjena induna kodwa njengoba isiZulu sisho ukuthi akukho soka elingenasici, yinto efanayo nasenkosini njengoba igama layo like laba sematheni eminyakeni edlule ngezinto ezingezinhle.Kukhona isikhathi lapho isizwe sayo savuka umbhejazane siyisola ngokuqasha izingane zayo ezikhundleni zomkhandlu wayo.Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kuze kube khona uqhekeko olukhulu phakathi kwayo inkosi nesigungu sayo. Kukhona abathile ababelibeka ngembaba elokuthi inkosi iphambukile ngesenzo sayo.Okwakususa udweshu wukuthi kwakunezikhundla ezimbili ezazivulekile enkantolo yesizwe okwakungesikanobhala nesomuntu ohlanza inkantolo.Kuthiwa kwathi kusalindwe ukuthi umkhandlu ube nenhlolokhono inkosi yamemezela ukuthi sebekhona abantu ebaqashile, okwagcina kuvela ukuthi yizingane zayo zombili.Lokhu kwadala enkulu intukuthelo emphakathini usola inkosi ngokuzibeka yona phambili.Isolezwe labika kabanzi ngalolo daba laze lathinta nayo inkosi eyazwakalisa ukukhathazeka ibuza ukuthi ngobani abathuthe lolu daba baluyisa ephepheni."Selokhu ngaqala ukuba yinkosi angikaze ngizwe kuthiwa sekungaze kuyiswe udaba lokuqashwa kukamabhalane emaphephandabeni. Kuyilungelo lami ukuthi ngingamqasha umabhalane. Okunye okumele ukwazi wukuthi lolu daba akusilona olwamaphephandaba kungcono umane ungalubhali," yasho kanjena inkosi iphendula Isolezwe.Yona futhi Inkosi ngo-2018 laba sematheni futhi igama layo ngesikhathi umphakathi uyisola ngokuthi ihlale ibonakala ezindaweni zobumnandi ishaya amavosho. Umphakathi waphinde wasola inkosi ngokuthi idla imali yokudayiswa kwezindawo bese iyozitika ngobumnandi.Kwake kwasuka uthuli lwezichwe phakathi kwenkosi nosomabhizinisi wendawo, uMnuz Edward Mpeko owayenendawo yokulala kuyona le ndawo, inkosi kuthiwa yagcina imxosha imdingisa.UMpeko wafaka icala eNkantolo eNkulu yaseMgungundlovu waphuma phambili kwathiwa makakhokhelwe nezindleko zecala.Ngonyaka odlule libe sematheni futhi igama lenkosi ngesikhathi eMagcino kuvela ukuthi sekunezinduna ezimbili.Kwaba namalungu omphakathi asola inkosi ngokudala umsindo ngokubeka induna phezu kwenye.Isolezwe layithinta inkosi ngalokhu, yaveza ukuthi yona yazi ukuthi kunenduna eyodwa yathi enye iyisusile ngenxa yokuthi ibisiphenduke ihlongandlebe.Bese kuphele iminyaka engu-38 isesihlalweni inkosi njengoba yabekwa ngo-1988. BAHLELI ngesinqe esisodwa abelaphi bendabuko abakhele imijondolo yaseMarikana, eKokstad, kulandela ukushiswa kwemizi yabo wumphakathi odinwe wudaba lwengane elahlekile.Kuthiwa isiyisithupha imizi yabelaphi bendabuko eshisiwe kule ndawo kulandela ukulahleka komfundi kaGrade 2 eXoloxolo Primary, uLathitha Mtolo. Kuvela ukuthi uLathitha unyamalale kade edlala nabangani bakhe ngoFebhuwari 26. Umakhosi (umelaphi wendabuko), uNkk Sophazi Gwala, utshele Isolezwe ukuthi naye uhleli ngesinqe esisodwa njengoba umphakathi odinwe wathelwa ngamanzi usubuye izikhawu eziningana kwakhe, uzomhlasela.Uthe kuyena, ubevele abone umphakathi usukake umuzi, uthi akavule isango kucingwe ingane edukile. "NgoMgqibelo nje, utheleke la umphakathi. Ngathinta amaphoyisa, afika, angenisa abambalwa, athi ababheke. Bashiye indlu ibheke phezulu, bangayithola ingane, bahamba,” kusho uNkk Gwala.Uqhube wathi kuthi ezintatha zangeSonto, uphinde wabuya isibili umphakathi uthi uzocinga futhi ngoba isangoma esithize sesishaye umhlahlo sathi sikhona isidumbu sengane kwakhe, balungiselela ukuthi basithathe ngemoto, basibalekise baye naso ndawana thize."Baphinde bangena babheka bangathola lutho. Nalolu hlobo lwemoto abathi isangoma sithe izobalekiswa ngayo ingane, asinayo lapha ekhaya. Sihleli kabuhlungu ngento esingayazi futhi asazi ukuthi sizophepha nini njengoba umphakathi usabisile ngokuthi uzowushisa nowami umuzi,” usho kanje.Uthe bazamile ukuvula icala lokusatshiswa emaphoyiseni kodwa athi abangalivuli, azobagada olakeni lomphakathi.Ngokusho kukamakhosi wakhona eMarikana, ocele ukungadalulwa, imizi iqale ukushiswa emva kokudedelwa ngamaphoyisa komunye wabelaphi, okuthiwa bese zimkhalele ngoba enukwe yiphara ngokulahleka kwengane. "Iphara livele lanyamalala endaweni emva kokulahleka kwengane. Umphakathi obudinwe ukuthi sekuphele isonto ingane inyamalele, ulifune walithola, walibuza ukuthi yini eliyaziyo ngokunyamalala kwengane? Livele lakhomba umelaphi oyinyanga futhi onesonto,” kusho umakhosi.Uqhube wathi emva kokuba ligonyuluke ngokuthi layithatha ingane layihambisa kuye emva kokuthi eliyalele ukuthi liyilethe, ube esethathwa ngamaphoyisa ahamba naye."Abuye amdedela, ethi abukho ubufakazi obuphathekayo ngokuthi uyazana nokulahleka kwengane. Yilapho-ke umphakathi ovele washisa imizi yakhe emine ezindaweni ezehlukene. Umphakarthi odiniwe ubuye washisa eminye imizi yabanye abelaphi, uthi awusabadingi endaweni ngoba bangababulali,” usho kanje. Utshele Isolezwe ukuthi ilokhu iqhubeke njalo imibhikisho yomphakathi lapho ucula khona amaculo athi: "Phansi ngabelaphi bendabuko phansi!”"Sihleli lubhojozi. Asazi nokuthi senzenjani ngoba uma sicela umasipala ukuthi usilekelele sibe nomhlangano nabo bonke abelaphi kanjalo nomphakathi, usishaya indiva. Ngapha namaphoyisa awavumi ukusivulela amacala okuthi siyasatshiswa futhi sishiselwa nemizi,” kuchaza umakhosi.Usole amaphoyisa adedele umelaphi obese ekhonjwe yiphara, wathi bekufanele aqhubeke nokumhloma ngemibuzo kuze kuvele iqiniso. "Kunokuthi bamgcine, bavele bamdedela. Bangagcina lapho, baphinde bamlekelela ukuthi abaleke njengoba bemphelezele waya endaweni esingayazi, lapho okuthiwa uzophepha khona,” kusho umakhosi okhale ngokuthi sekuyibo bodwa asebebhekene nolaka lomphakathi. Owenhlangano yabelaphi bendabuko, iNational Unitary Professional Association for African Traditional Health Practitioners of South Africa, uMnuz Mlungisi Mlaba, usigxekile isenzo somelaphi okhombe umuzi womunye umelaphi, wathi ingane ikuyena."Indlela efanele yokwenza ukuthi uma usuvezelwe ukuthi into ekanjalo ikuphi, uyawutshela umndeni, bese uthi asambe siye emaphoyiseni, siyowacela asiphelezele, siyoyikhipha ingane lapho ebonakala khona,” kusho uMlaba. Uthe bekuyisenzo esingafanele ukuthi umelaphi oshaye umhlahlo akhombe uzakwabo, bese eshiya kanjalo."Uma umakhosi womhlahlo eya naye lapho athi into ithukuswe khona kusuke kwenzelwa ukuthi kuonakale ubuqiniso bomhlahlo wakhe. Ukuhamba kwakhe namaphoyisa kusuke kwenzelwa ukuthi akwazi ukukhalima ulaka lomndeni osuke ulahlekelwe uma kwenzeka itholakala ngempela into evele emhlahlweni,” kusho uMlaba othe indlela okwenzeke ngayo yiyo ezodala uthuthuva olungalawuleki, isidingo singekho.Kuze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela amaphoyisa engakatholakali ukuphawula ngalolu daba ngokunjalo nomndeni wengane edukile awutholakalanga.

Bakhala ngokuthi abawumboni umehluko kuhulumeni wokubambisana, futhi abaqondi ukuthi kungani iMKP ingawuphethe uhulumeni ekubeni yawina okhethweni," usho kanje. IsiShayamthetho sinezihlalo ezingu-80, iMKP yathola ezingu-37, i-IFP ezingu-15, i-ANC ezingu-14, i-DA ezingu-11, zimbili eze-EFF kanti iNFP yathola isihlalo esisodwa.UNkk Masinga ukhumbuze abantu ukuthi uma bengavoti, bazilimaza bona ngoba uma kukhona abavotile bazoyimemezela imiphumela noma ingahambisani nabangavotanga."Uma unganeme kungcono uhambe uyozwakalisa ukucasuka kwakho evotini. Uma uduba ukuvota abanye bevota, uzophathwa umuntu ongamfuni. IMKP iyona eyakhetha ukungabi yingxenye yokusebenzisana kwamaqembu, yingakho ingeyona ingxenye kahulumeni eKZN," usho kanje. Uveze ukuthi abanye abavoti baveza ilaka labo ngokuthi bapoyile amaphepha okuvota."Sike senza ucwaningo olubheka isizathu esenza abantu bapoyile ivoti labo. Kwavela ukuthi basuke beveza ilaka labo ngezinto abangazifuni, bese bepoyila ivoti labo ngosuku lokhetho," kusho uNkk Masinga.Uveze nokuthi abantu bokufika kuleli, abavumelekile ukuthi bangenele ukhetho njengamakhansela noma bavote. "Bekusabalele ezinkundleni zokuxhumana indaba yokuthi kukhona abokufika abazongenela ukhetho. Yinto engekho leyo ngoba abantu bokufika kuleli, abavumelekile ukuvota noma ukungenela ukhetho kuleli." Uveze nokuthi sibukeka sizokwanda isibalo sabazongenela ukhetho okubalwa nabangenela ukhetho ngokuzimela ngenxa yokwanda kwesibalo samaqembu abhaliswa nsuku zonke.I-IEC kuzwelonke iveze ukuthi izovula ithuba ngempelasonto kaJuni 20, kulo nyaka ukuthi abantu babhalisele ukuvota.Ikhomishini iveze ukuthi ilulungele ukhetho nakuba lungakamenyezelwa usuku lokhetho. Ukhetho kulindeleke ukuthi lubanjwe phakathi kukaNovemba noJanuwari ngonyaka ozayo.
KUBUYE ithemba ngesimo sezezimali kuhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal njengoba isabelomali sesifundazwe esethulwe izolo, sikhombisa uzinzo. UMphathiswa wezeziMali KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Francois Rodgers, uthe uzinzo olukhonjiswa isabelomali lumnikeza ithemba lokuthi isifundazwe sizovuka sizithathe ngakwezezimali.URodgers wethule isabelomali sesifundazwe esingu-R168 billion, esiShayamthetho izolo."Lesi sabelomali sikhombisa uzinzo ngemuva kokudideka, emuva kokubhekana nezinkinga nangemuva kwezikhathi ezinzima. Siqinisekisa ukuthi ngempela isifundazwe sethu sesiyelulama kwezezimali."URodgers uthe isabelomali sikhombisa ukukhula njengoba uMnyango wawukade ubona sengathi isabelomali sakulo nyaka sizokuba u-R139 billion. Uthe okwenze ukuthi isabelomali sakulo nyaka sikhule kakhulu ukuthi isifundazwe sithole uchatha ka-R6.9 billion kuhulumeni kazwelonke. "Uchatha obonakalayo uzokwehlisa umthwalo kwezezimali eMnyangweni wezeMfundo nowezeMpilo obudalwa, ikakhulukazi ukuncishiselwa imali obekulokhu kwenzeka."URodgers uthe nezibonelelo ezinemibandela ezitholwa iminyango kahulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal zizonyuka ngo-R3.9 billion kule minyaka emithathu ezayo."Okusikhuthazayo, sibona imali esiyiqoqayo izokweqa ngo-R220.6million ekupheleni konyaka. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi kulindeleke ukuthi kuqoqwe imali engaphezulu kwejwayelekile ngamalayisensi ezimoto eMnyangweni wezokuThutha, kanjalo nezimali ezibuyiswe ngu-SARS eMnyangweni wezeMfundo."Iqembu eliphikisayo, iMKP, lisihlabe lasihlikiza isabelomali esethulwe uRodgers.Ilungu leMKP, uMnuz Simphiwe Moyo, lithe isabelomali sikaRodgers sidukisa abantu."Benza sengathi yonke into ihamba kahle. Bafuna kubonakale sengathi uhulumeni wokubambisana uyasebenza. Iqiniso ukuthi abantu abasebenzi futhi babulawa yindlala. Akazange asho lutho ngalokho. Akakhulumanga ngezinto ezithinta abantu."Okhulumela i-DA kwezeziMali esiShayamthetho, uMnuz Tim Brauteseth, uthe isiqalile ukuthela izithelo imisebenzi kaRodgers yokugqugquzela ukuphathwa kahle kwemali."Lesi sabelomali sigxile kakhulu eminyangweni ebhekelele izidingo zabantu. Kuzohlomula kakhulu abafundi, othisha, osonhlalakahle namanesi."Yabelwe kanjani iminyango?UMnyango wezeMfundo iwona othole ingxenye enkulu yesabelomali njengoba ugixabezwe ngo-R71.1 billion.UMnyango wezeMpilo wabelwe u-R60.2 billion, kwathi uMnyango wezokuThutha wona wabelwa u-R13.9 billion.UMnyango wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi wabelwe u-R3.8 billion, uMnyango wezokuThuthukiswa koMnotho wabelwe u-R3.7 billion, kwathi owezokuHlaliswa kwaBantu wona wabelwa u-R3.2 billion.UMnyango wezoLimo wabelwe u-R2.8 billion, owezeMisebenzi yoMphakathi wabelwe u-R2.4 billion, kwathi owezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu wona wabelwa u-R2 billion.UMnyango wezeMidlalo wabelwe u-R1.6 billion, isiShayamthetho sabelwe u-R894.4 million, iHhovisi likaNdunankulu labelwe u-R856.2 million, kwathi uMnyango wezokuPhepha koMphakathi wona wabelwa u-R287.3 million.
UKHUZA ibuya ezinhlakeni zobuholi eNdlunkulu loyo owayekhulumela iSilo, uMntwana u-Africa Zulu.UMntwana u-Africa usezokuba ingxenye yesigungu esimqoka eNdlunkulu njengoba eqokelwe kwesokuba yiPhini likaShansela kaZulu neNdlunkulu.Ukuqokwa kwakhe kumenyezelwe uNdunankulu kaZulu, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi.UButhelezi uthe uMntwana u-Africa uzokuba yingxenye yesigungu okuyisona esithatha izinqumo ngokulandela imiyalelo yeSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini. UButhelezi uyena onguSihlalo wesigungu okukhona kuso iPhini likaNdunankulu kaZulu, Inkosi Phathisizwe Chiliza, uShansela kaZulu neNdlunkulu oyiso leSilo, uMalusi Zondi, okhulumela iSilo uMntwana uThulani kaGqikazi Zulu nomele iSilo endlini yobuholi bomdabu, uMntwana uNathi kaPhumanyova Zulu."Lesi sigungu yisona eseseka iSilo kwezokuphatha, ezokugcinwa kwamasiko, ukuthuthukiswa komphakathi nokuxhumana nezinhlaka zikahulumeni."UButhelezi uthe ukuqokwa koMntwana u-Africa kukhombisa ukuzinikela kweMbube ekuqiniseni izinhlaka ezisebenzela isizwe."UMntwana u-Africa unesipiliyoni esiningi ezinhlakeni zokuhola eNdlunkulu. Ulwazi aluthole ngesikhathi ephethe ezinye izikhundla lapha eNdlunkulu luzokwelekelela kakhulu. UMntwana u-Africa uzoqinisekisa ukuthi iHhovisi likaShansela kaZulu neNdlunkulu lisebenza kahle aphinde futhi aqinisekise ukusebenza kahle kwazo zonke izinhlaka zokuphatha. Siyamhalalisela uMntwana u-Africa futhi simfisela inhlanhla njengoba ezoqala umsebenzi omkhulu kangaka awunikezwe iSilo."UMntwana u-Africa uke wakhulumela iSilo ngaphambilini kodwa wadilizwa esikhundleni kwaze kwakabili.UMntwana u-Africa wadilizwa okokuqala esikhundleni emva kokushayisana nowayengundunankulu kaZulu ngaleso sikhathi, Inkosi Mangosuthu Buthelezi.UMntwana u-Africa wabuye wabuyela esikhundleni emva kokukhothama kweNkosi uMangosuthu.Waphinde wadilizwa esikhundleni ngo-2024.
UNGQONGQOSHE wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu, uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa, uthembise ukuthi zikhona izikhulu zikaMasipala wesiFunda uThukela ezizothathelwa izinyathelo ngodaba lokudliwa kwe-akhawunti yasebhange yomkhandlu.UHlabisa uthe ukuze lulungiseke kahle udaba lokudliwa kwe-akhawunti yomkhandlu kukhona okufanele bathathelwe izinyathelo.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma emhlanganweni obubizelwe ukuzobhunga ngale nsambatheka ebhekene nomkhandlu.I-akhawunti yasebhange ishaqwe ngenyanga eyedlule, emva kokuba umkhandlu uhluleke ukukhola isikweletu senkampani i-RASP Consulting.Umasipala ukweleta i-RASP Consulting izigidi zamarandi njengoba umsebenzi owawenziwa yi-RASP emkhandlwini ungoka-R137 million.Ngonyaka owedlule, umasipala wangena esivumelwananeni sokukhokhelana ne-RASP Consulting kulandela isinqumo senkantolo. Umasipala uhlulekile ukugcina isivumelwano nokwenze ukuthi kushaqwe i-akhawunti yasebhange.Ukusebenza komkhandlu kuphazamisekile ngenxa yokudliwa kwe-akhawunti yomkhandlu.Izinyunyana zabasebenzi iSamwu ne-Imatu, zinxuse uHlabisa ukuthi athathele izinyathelo labo abathintekayo. UHlabisa uvumelane nabaholi bezinyunyana ukuthi kukhona impela okufanele bathathelwe izinyathelo."Uma sifuna ukuthi kulungiswe isimo kumasipala kufanele kube khona abathathelwa izinyathelo."UHlabisa uveze ukuthi i-akhawunti yasebhange yomkhandlu izobuyiswa maduze, wathi babhale incwadi izolo, lapho benikeza khona inkampani eshaqe i-akhawunti yomkhandlu ukuba ibuyise i-akhawunti zingakapheli izinsuku ezimbili."Incwadi eyalela ukuba kubuyiswe i-akhawunti yomkhandlu nemali ephakathi siyibhale namhlanje ekuseni (izolo). Lokhu kuzonikeza umasipala ithuba lokuthi ukwazi ukuqhubeka nokusebenza. Zonke izinhlelo zomkhandlu ebezimisiwe sezizoqhubeka zisebenze ngokujwayelekile. Umasipala uzokwazi ukokhokha izikweletu futhi uphinde ukwazi ukukhokhela abasebenzi. Lokhu kuzoqeda itwetwe kubasebenzi. Sonke siyazi ukuthi abasebenzi abakwazi ukuya emsebenzini uma bengaholelwe."UHlabisa uthe osomabhizinisi bathembise ukuthi bazolekelela umkhandlu."Siyabonga ukuthi osomabhizinisi bazoselekelela ngonjiniyela. Sikhulumile nemenenja yomkhandlu. Sivumelene ukuthi kube nomhlangano zingakapheli izinsuku eziyisikhombisa lapho khona kuzokhulunywa ngalolu daba."UHlabisa uthe bazogxila kakhulu ekulungiseni inkinga yamanzi ekhungethe isifunda, wathi inkinga yamanzi yenza ukuthi umnotho ungakhuli esifundeni.
KUQALE ngaphandle kwezinkinga ukufunda izolo esikoleni esike saba nomsindo, uMkhumbane Secondary, eChesterville.Lokhu kwenzeka emva komhlangano wabazali wakamumva obe ngeSonto, lapho bevumelane khona ngokuthi ayikhishwe ingidi obese kuphele isonto kuvalwe ngayo esikoleni.Le ngidi yafakwa omunye wabazali ngeledlule, kulandela ukuvela kwezindaba zokumiswa isigubhukane kukathishanhloko, uMnuz Ntokozo Ngobese.UMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal ugcine uphumela obala ngoLwesihlanu ngokuthi uNgobese akamiselwe umsindo osuswe ukufakwa kwamakhamera angafunwa othisha beSadtu esikoleni.Bese kuphele amasonto amathathu kuphazamiseke ukufunda kulesi sikole, kulandela ukuthi othisha beSadtu bebeke phansi oshoki, bethi abafuni ukufundisa emakilasini afakwe amakhamera aqopha izithombe nomsindo.Kwasuka umsindo, befunga begomela ukuthi ngeke babuyele emakilasini amakhamera engakhishiwe. Ngesikhathi besho kanje, nabazali bebemi ngakuNgobese, bethi akukho makhamera azokhishwa ngoba yibo abavuma ukuthi afakwe, kulandela izigameko zokugqekezwa kwesikole maqede kuthathwe impahla.Kugcine kuqashwa othisha besikhashana okuthiwe bazobamba izikhala zalaba abanqaba ukuzofundisa nokuholele ekutheni abafundi bazame ukubhikisha, bethi bafuna othisha babo abalaxaze ukufundisa. Nokho abazali basivimba leso siteleka, bethi akukho ngane ezobhikishela othisha abangafuni ukusebenza.Izolo omunye wabazali, uNksz Xolile Buhlalu, utshele Isolezwe ukuthi emhlanganweni ababe nawo, bakhethe ukuthi bazidedele izingane zifunde."Sivumelane ngokuthi izingane ziqhubeke zifunde ngoba izivivinyo seziseduze. Sithe nakuba sizoqhubeka nokulwela esikufunayo singabazali, kodwa zona azingaphazamiseki,” kusho uNksz Buhlalu. Uthe basamile kwelokuthi amakhamera awayi ndawo. "Kunabazali abazibophezele ekutheni bazode bevuka beyonkanisa esikoleni ukuqinisekisa ukuthi akukho muntu ofikayo azowakhipha,” usho kanje. Uqhube wathi othisha abalaxaza ukufundisa abakabuyeli esikoleni, abafundi basazofundiswa abesikhashana, abazokhokhelwa abazali. Uveze ukuthi basazohlela imashi ezoya emnyangweni, lapho beyohambisa khona izikhalo zabo ngokuthi bafuna abuyiswe uthishanhloko omiswe isigubhukane, baphinde bacacise eyokuthi amakhamera afakwe esikoleni ayevunywe yibona bengabazali. Uthe njengamanje umuntu obambe kwesikathishanhloko yilowo obevele eyiphini lakhe.

ISIBALO esiphezulu ngokweqile sabafundi nokungeneli kwamagumbi okufundela kwenza ukuthi uhlelo lokufundisa lungahambi ngendlela ejwayelekile nefanele esikoleni samabanga aphansi iKhulani Junior Primary, eMaphephetheni, eNanda.Lokhu kudalulwe wumthombo othembekile nowazi konke okwenzeka kulesi sikole, okuvela ukuthi sinamagumbi amahlanu okufundela ekubeni sigcina kwa-Grade 4, okudala ukuthi kube nesinyokotho esingagculisi uma sekuyisikhathi sokufunda."Umthetho woMnyango wezeMfundo ukubeka ngokusobala ukuthi igumbi negumbi lokufundela kumele ukuthi libe nabafundi abawu-30 kuya ku-40 kuphela. Kepha okwalesi sikole kunzima kakhulu njengoba kunamagumbi anabafundi abangaphezu kuka-71, kuthi kwamanye babe ngaphezu kuka-90 imbala, okudala isiminyaminya,” kusho umthombo.Uqhuba, uthe okunye okwenza ukuthi umsebenzi wothisha ubenzima kakhulu wukuthi abakwazi ngisho ukhulululeka njengoba bengenalo igumbi labo, okuphoqa ukuthi bahlale emagumbini okufundela kusuka ekuseni kuze kuyoshona ilanga. "Kuyethusa nokuthi ngisho uthishomkhulu imbala akanalo ihhovisi lakhe, okuphoqa ukuthi asebenzise indlu kanogada engasesangweni lesikole ukwenza eminye imisebenzi yakhe yansuku zonke. Konke lokhu kuyasikhathaza kakhulu siwumphakathi, futhi nabo othisha akubagculisi ukusebenzela esimeni esinjena ikakhulu ngoba sekukaningi lolu daba lubikwa eMnyangweni wezeMfundo esifundazweni kepha awukho umehluko,” kulanda umthombo.Kubikwe nokuthi ngisho noma kunemihlangano yabazali, kuphoqeleka ukuthi uthishomkhulu afake itende elizokwanela bonke abazali ngenxa yokuthi amagumbi esikole ngeke abamumathe bonke njengoba lingekho futhi ihholo lokubhekela izinhlelo ezinjalo."Yisimo esibi nesingabekezeleleki, esifisa ukuthi kube khona okwenzekayo ngaso ngoba lesi sikole siwusizo kakhulu emphakathini ngoba sakhiwe eduze nomphakathi futhi senza ukuthi kube lula ebantwini ukufaka izingane zabo zifunde kusona,” usho kanje.Umthombo ukhale nangokuthi sekuyisikhathi eside kakhulu behlalele ethembeni lokuthi izinto zizolunga, njengoba sekuke kwenzeka kaningana phambilini ukuthi kufike abantu abasuke bezohlola isimo, bathembise ukubuya bezolungisa kodwa bangabe besabuya. Kuthintwa uNkk Nokukhanya Makhoba wakhona kule ndawo, noke waba sesigungwini esilawula ukusebenza kwesikole iminyaka engaphezu kwewu-10, uvumile ukuthi isimo sesikole siya ngokuya siba sibi kakhulu ikakhulu ngenxa yokuthi minyaka yonke kwanda abafundi abazofunda kusona, okusho ukwanda komthwalo nengcindezi kothisha."Sifisa ukuthi okungenani kutholakale amagumbi okufundela angomahambanendlwana ukuze kuphunguke umthwalo kothisha abanomthwalo wokufundisa inqwaba yezingane eziminyene endaweni eyodwa. Kanti kwalokho kukodwa nje kuyisimo esingaba yingozi empilweni yezingane ukuthi zibuthane endaweni ongakwazi nokuphefumula kahle kuyona ikakhulu njengoba nelanga lishisa kangaka kulezi zinsuku,” kusho uNkk Makhoba.Isolezwe lizame kaningi ukuxhumana nokhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Muzi Mahlambi, kepha ucingo lwakhe belungabanjwa kwaze kwaphela cishe izinsuku ezine engayiphenduli imiyalezo abethunyelelwe yona kwi-WhatsApp yakhe, ekubeni kubonakala ukuthi uyifundile.
UMSAKAZI wesiteshi esizimele i-702 futhi owumculi ne-podcaster, uRelebogile Mabotja, useziphosele inselelo entsha emculweni ethula ngokusemthethweni icwecwe lakhe lokuqala aselenze kabusha elisihloko sithi Still Me - Live, eliqale ukutholakala ezitolo ngoLwesihlanu.URelebogile (40) wasePitoli, kodwa osezinze eGoli wethule icwecwe lakhe eligabe ngezingoma ezine zesigqi sowokholo nese-soul emcimbini eSandton, khona kwaNdongaziyaduma, lapho abememe khona abangani, ozakwabo basemsebenzini, izihlobo nasondelene nabo kuphela.Usebenzise lo mcimbi futhi ukugubha uhambo lwakhe lobuciko obehlukene njengoba sekukuningi akwenzile, wabe esezwisa izethameli izingoma ezikulona bukhoma ezithi You’re The Only One, i-I Feel Nothing, iMmamogaoi’s Prayer ne-Stil Me. Ukuthi lo msebenzi uphume usuyile nto enhle kangaka manje kungikhombisile ukuthi sonke sidinga ukudlula ezimweni ezithile kuqala ukuze kube khona okuhle esikukhombayo emva kwazo,” kulanda yena."Ngibonga kakhulu umndeni wami ohlale ungeseka kukho konke okuhle engikwenzayo, kanjalo noNkulunkulu engikholwa wukuthi wuyena olawula indlela yami nokuhamba kwami ngomusa wakhe, okuhlale kungikhumbuza njalo ukuthi kungani ngenza lezi zinto ezinhle ezijabulisa abantu kangaka. Ngakho nge-Still In Me ngikhumbuza abantu ukuthi wonke umuntu unokuhle asakugcinile ngaphakahti kuyena,” usho kanje. IBANDLA lamaNazaretha lizigqaja ngokukhonza ngendlela encike osikweni lwesintu kodwa lokhu akusho ukuthi lithandwa abantu abathile. KwaShembe kunendidiyela yamakholwa aqhamuka emikhakheni nasemazingeni ahlukene empilo. Kulo 7 million wamalungu aleli bandla kunalo lonke uhlobo lomuntu. Abanye bangosaziwayo abazishaya isifuba ngokuthi balapho bekhona ngenxa yemisebenzi yoMphrofethi ongumsunguli waleli bandla elikhulukazi e-Afrika, u-Isaiah "Mqaliwendlela" Shembe. AmaNazaretha angahlukana ngezinhlangothi, njengoba kukhona elaseBuhleni eliholwa yinkosi uMduduzi "UnyazilweZulu" Shembe, elaseGinyezinye eliholwa yinkosi uSizwe "Mudliwamafa" Shembe, eKuphakameni eliholwa yinkosi uVukile "Incoyincoyi" Shembe, elaseThembezinhle eliholwa yinkosi uPhinda "Ukukhanya Kwelanga" Shembe nelaseGauteng eliholwa yinkosi uPhakama Shembe kodwa zonke lezi zinhlangothi zibambelele ezinkambisweni zomsunguli webandla, uMqali Wendlela. Kosaziwayo abakholelwa kuleli bandla kubalwa umrepha futhi ongumculi we-Afro Soul, uJabulani "Sjava" Hadebe. Ngaphandle kokucula uSjava ubuye abe ngumlingisi owaqala ukuduma edlala kwi-Zone 14. USjava usewole inqwaba yemiklomelo kuleli nasemazweni angaphandle kuma-BET Awards eMelika. Abaningi bazomkhumbula umlingisi wodumo kuDeliwe nakwiSivumelwano, uCynthia Shange (77), ongunina kaNonhle Thema. Waba ngumlingisi wokuqala omnyama wakuleli ukungenela umqhudelwano kaMiss World ngo-1972, emele iNingizimu Afrika. UCynthia ubuye walingisa iminyaka ecela ku-20 engunina kaThandaza (okuyindawo eyalingiswa wuSindi Dlathu). Umdidiyeli wemidlalo yeshashalazi ongasekho, uMbongeni Ngema, wayelandela inkonzo yobuNazaretha ayevame ukusho ukuthi wazalwa emuva kokuthi abazali bakhe babemcele khona. UMadlokovu wazakhela udumo ngokudidiyela iSarafina ne-The Zulu. Abalingisi abaningi abanjengoSomizi, Leleti Khumalo, Dumisani Dlamini, Sindi Dlathu, Wendy Mseleku nabanye, badlula esandleni saleli qhawe laseNhlwathi, kwaHlabisa. Umsakazi woKhozi FM uZimiphi "Zimdollar" Biyela, ungomunye wamaNazaretha angaphuthelwa yimikhosi yaleli bandla. UZimdollar ulingise emidlalweni eminingi enjengeDurban Gen, eHostela noZalo.UNgizwe "Zulu Charmer" Mchunu, naye uyakholelwa kule nkolo yobuNazaretha ngenxa yokuthi wacelelwa khona. Lo saziwayo, osebizwa ngomholi wamabhinca, waqala ukuzakhela udumo ngokulingisa emidlalweni yeshashalazi, wasakaza oKhozini futhi wethula uhlelo lomculo wesintu kuSABC 1, iRoots. UMike Mvelase owayenguKhaphela kwiGenerations uwe evuka naleli bandla lakwaShembe. Omunye usaziwayo osanda kuphumela obala ukuthi uyindodakazi yaseKuphakameni futhi ukhonza kuleli bandla uDawn Thandeka King, odume kakhulu enguMaNgcobo kuZalo. Eminyakeni eyedlule uSiyabonga Twala, obenguMpiyakhe Zungu kwiSibaya, ubengaphuthi emikhosini yaleli bandla ngaphambi kokuzalwa kabusha aphendukele kumaKristu.Owayeyinkosi ye-reggae kuleli, uLucky Dube, ubedume umhlaba wonke kodwa ubengakhohlwa wukuthi uyiNazaretha kangangoba waze waqamba ingoma etusa amagalelo aleli bandla, esihloko sithi Shembe Is The Way.Uphrojusa wezinhlelo oKhozini uThembeka Cele ungomunye wosaziwayo abakhuliswe ngobuNazaretha. Umsunguli nomgqugquzeli weMpucuzeko Maskandi Festival neNgoma Kazwelonke, uXolani Mcineka, naye uyiNazaretha. Owayengumsakazi weGagasi FM nomlingisi woZalo, uKini Shandu, ukhonza kwaShembe.Owayeyisihlabani emculweni kamaskandi, uMgqumeni "Idlamanzi" Khumalo, wayekhonza kwaShembe futhi waze waqamba ingoma ethi Inkonzoni. UMgqumeni wazakhela ugazi ngokusungula ushuni osadlisa namanje nokuyiwo ofudunyezwe ngabaculi abaningi. UMengameli weNkatha Freedom Party, uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa, uyiNazaretha benobeyiPhini likaMengameli wamaJaji eKZN, uMjabuliseni Madondo. OwayeyiMantshi kuleli uMthembeni Phineas Mpanza nobenguMphathi woKhozi FM, uBonga Mpanza, bangamaNazaretha. Ngakho uma ukhonza kwaShembe ungazinyezi, uzitshele ukuthi udukile. Unenqwaba yabantu ababalulekile abangamaNazaretha.
Inkosi Phathisizwe Luthuli (63) idlule emhlabeni ngoMsombuluko ebusuku ngemuva kokuquleka esemzini wayo eMgababa. ULuthuli ube esephuthunyiswa esibhedlela iKingsway, eManzimtoti, waqinisekiswa njengosekhotheme.Umthombo osondelene nomndeni ukuqinisekisile ukukhothama kwenkosi. Uthe isizwe sife olwembiza ngalo mshophi obehle ngaphezulu. Umphathiswa wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal (Cogta), uMfundisi Thulasizwe Buthelezi, udlulise amazwi enduduzo ngokudlula emhlabeni kweNkosi uPhathisizwe Luthuli yoMdabu waseMnini ngaphansi koMkhandlu weTheku. Inkosi uLuthuli, yathatha isihlalo ngo-1988, ikhunjulwa njengomthombo ongaguquki wokuqondisa, ikakhulukazi emakhosini asemancane, nokubamba iqhaza kwayo njalo ekuthuthukisweni komphakathi. Ukuzinikela kwakhe ekuqiniseni ukubusa kubonakale ngenyanga edlule ngesikhathi ephakathi kwamakhosi angama-47 aqede uHlelo lokuBusa nokuBusa kahle eNyuvesi yaKwaZulu-Natal.
Amaphoyisa akhiphe incwadi egunyaza ukuboshwa kwabasolwa abayisikhombisa mayelana necala lokubulawa kwabantu ngenxa yomshwalense ka-R10 million namuhla eLimpopo.Namhlanje kuboshwe abathathu, izelamani ezimbili nesangoma. Kulindeleke ukuthi kuboshwe abanye kungekudala. Bonke beyamaniswa necala lowayeyiphoyisa uSergeant Rachel Kutumela.Bonke abasolwa kukholakala ukuthi bathatha imishwalense yempilo neyomngcwabo kubantu abangu-10 ababulawa.UKutumela waboshwa ngo-Okthoba 2024 esemsebenzini. AZOZIHAMBISELA ngokwawo izikhalazo zawo kuMbhishobhi oMkhulu uMandla Jwara, ophethe iDayosisi yaseThekwini, esontweni lamaRoma aKhatholika, amalungu ePherish yasePinetown, iThe Immaculate Conception Church.Lokhu kuza emva kokuba kumenyezelwe emasontweni amathathu edlule, ukuthi uFata Sifiso Ndlovu onomoya wobungoma ushaywe ngesithende. Incwadi kuthiwa iwakhalise mi izinyembezi amalungu aleli pherishi kuvela ukuthi impelasonto yePhasika kuyobe kungeyokugcina uNdlovu esontisa kuleli bandla.Akuyena yedwa uNdlovu "ofakwa umgxala", njengoba kuvele amalungu epherishi yaseMontclair, akhala esifanayo ngoFata Thembelani Ngcobo, naye okuthiwa unomoya wobungoma, ogudluzwe ngendlela efanayo. Ilungu lepherishi elaziwa kakhulu kwezomculo, uThokozani "Tzozo" Zulu lithe emva kokufundwa kwencwadi ebandleni, eyayazisa amalungu ukuthi uzogcina maduze uFata, kube khona isikhalo esikhulu."Amalungu ebandla awazange azamukele kahle lezi zindaba. Siphatheke kabi ngoba sisuka kude noFata. Efika la eminyakeni emihlanu edlule, ibandla belinabantu abanela amabhentshi amabili kuphela. Namuhla ligcwele phama isonto ngenxa yakhe,” kusho uTzozo.Uthe uFata ungumholi ohlangabezana nomuntu lapho ekhona, wathi uma umuntu edinga ukwelashwa ngokomoya, uNdlovu uba yilokho. Uma umuntu edinga indlebe, uphinde amnike yona. "Yiyo le nto eyenze wangena kakhulu ezinhliziyweni zabantu ubona kukhathazeke wonke umuntu ngokumiswa kwakhe isigubhukane,” kusho uTzozo uthe ngeledlule, omama babekhala mi izinyembezi, betshelwa ukuthi akukho ibandla elingakwenza ukuguqula isinqumo soMbhishobhi oMkhulu.Ube esedalula ukuthi bazihambisile izikhalazo zabo esigungwini esiphezulu sepherishi, ngenhloso yokuthi zedluliselwe kwabaphezulu, kuqhanyukwe nesixazululo."Kuze kube yimanje asikazitholi izimpendulo. Yikho sihlele ukuthi sizihambise ngokwethu ehhovisi loMbhishobhi singamalungu ebandla,” kusho uTzozo, othe bahlela ukuthi lokho bakwenze ngoLwesithathu. Uthe yize bazi ukuthi izinqumo zithathwa uMbhishobhi oMkhulu ngokuthi uFata wenzenjani kodwa bake babone kwamanye amapherishi eqhubeka elulelwa isikhathi uFata uma amalungu ebandla ethi asamdinga.Uthe sebewuhoshile umoya kwamanye amalungu ebandla ukuthi athi azoyeka ukusonta uma uFata ehamba ngempela, wathi abanye bathi bazoshintsha ibandla, ngesikhathi amanye ethi azokuduba ukunikela njengoba umnikelo awenza nyanga zonke ubalelwa ku-R63 000.Uthe amalungu ebandla awakaze abe nenkinga nezinto "zobungoma” uFata azenza emaceleni. "Uma size endlini yokukhonza, akukho lapho okuvela khona ukuthi ungumuntu obuye enze izinto zesintu. Usontisa ngendlela esikhule kusontwa ngayo. Ingakho sithi asinayo inkinga nezinto azenza emaceleni, asiphazamiseki,” usho kanje.Nokho uveze ukuthi indaba yonakala ngesikhathi uFata esiza omunye webandla ngezinto zesintu."Sizwe kuthiwa kukhona owambiza ukuba azomsiza, wase emthwebula isithombe, wasithumela kwabakhulu,” kusho uTzozo. Uthe kungemva kwalokhu, lapho kwaqala khona ukukhuluma, nathe kwenzeke ngonyaka odlule. UTzozo uthe ubuKrestu ngesikhathi bufika kuleli, abushongo ukuthi akuyekwe ubu-Afrika, wathi kusuka bebancane bengamaRoma, ayikho into engenziwa emakubo. "Uma kungafanele ukwenza izinto zesintu, kungani kwenziwa iMisa labangasekho (ebandleni) ngoba ukuthi kubizwa ngeMisa noma ukuhlaba, kuyinto efanayo,” usho kanje. Ngesikhathi eshumayela uFata Ndlovu enkonzweni yayizolo, nakuba ebengaphumelanga obala kodwa intshumayelo ibikhombisa ukuthi ubhekene nezivunguvungu.Ukhulume ngokuthi abazalwane akufanele baphonse ithawula empilweni, wathi naye nje uma zimnetha, akaliphonsi ithawula ngoba uye azibuze ukuthi abantu abathembele kuye bazothini?Ushumayeze amakholwa kuthi noma ziwanetha aqhubeke ahambe endleleni."Nami anothi uma nihlangana nami lapho enizohlangana nami khona, anongitshela ukuthi qhubeka uhambe Fata,” usho kanje.Usihlalo wepherishi, uDikoni Magasela Mthembu, uthe inqubo yebandla ayibavumeli ukuthi baphawule ngezinto zebandla, nokho uthe angakuqinisekisa ukuthi izikhalazo zebandla bazithathile bazedlulisela kophezulu.
UTHOLE ubuthongo okokuqala ngqa ngoLwesihlanu, uyise womfundi owabulawa yisoka lakhe ngesihluku eSiqungeni, eMthwalume, ngoJulayi 2024, umbulali egixabezwa ngodilikajele.Lokhu kuze emva kokuthi iNkantolo yesiFunda saseScottburgh, imgwebe udilikajele uNtuthuko Sosibo (29) ngokushaya, abulale uNksz Mandisa Cele (20). Iphinde yanquma nokuthi akumfanele ukuba nesibhamu. Uyise kamufi, uMnuz Mzwandile Dlungele, utshele Isolezwe ukuthi ubengasabazi ubuthongo obuphelele kusukela kwabulawa indodakazi yakhe. "Bengilala cishe ngabo-8 ebusuku, phakathi namabili buphele ubuthongo, ngiqwashe kuze kucishe kuse. Uma icala liya enkantolo bekuvele kube nzima kakhulu,” kusho uDlungele.Uthe isigwebo inkantolo esinike umbulali sibagculisile bewumndeni. Uthe nakuba singeke simbuyise umntanakhe kodwa kuyabajabulisa ukuthi usazoke abhadle ejele ngobuhlungu abazwisa bona. "Isihlukumeze kakhulu into ayenza lo mfana kodwa isigwebo asinikiwe sisigculisile. Besivele sifuna ukuthi athole isigwebo esinzima,” kusho uDlungele. "Ngilale ubuthongo, into ebesengingasayazi. Bengihlale ngibikelwa njalo uma kuzoyiwa enkantolo. Ngizoke ngilale ngiphumule ngoba inkantolo igcine ibenzile ubulungiswa,” usho kanje.Uthe ngesikhathi bengaphakathi enkantolo umbulali engakagwetshwa, umndeni wakhe uke wahleka omunye wabo.Uveze ukuthi kuphenduke amatafula umbulali esegwetshiwe njengoba ebebehleka enkantolo, baphume sebedinda isililo sikaNandi. Uthe baze badidwa nawukuthi bebeyipakephi imoto ebebehamba ngayo, bantantatheka babheka kwenye indawo.Utshele iphephandaba ukuthi umbulali wayenodlame kumufi, wadalula eyokuthi waze wamyekisa kabili isikole, nokuholele ekutheni aphazamiseke ezifundweni zakhe."Kuthe esehlala emxhasweni kanina, nakhona ubefika azomhlukumeza. Ngelinye ilanga wake wabulala wonke amawindi endlu. Ngathi ngiyaya khona ngiyofuna ukuthi angichazele ukuthi uwabulaleleni, ngafica esebalekile,” usho kanje. Owenhlangano elwela abesifazane kule ndawo iWomen of uMthwalume, uNksz Nombuso Sibisi, uthe: "Sijabule kakhulu ngesigwebo asitholile nokho sidumele kakhulu ngokuthi kukhona abazali abeseka izingane zabo uma zenze into enje. Siphoxekile futhi nangendelelo ekhonjiswe ngumbulali enkantolo, enze icala elibi kangaka, bese eqhubeke nokudelela inkantolo, izintatheli namaphoyisa.”
BEBENESONTO elilodwa vo beqalile emsebenzini emapulazini eKranskop, abayisithupha abamuke namanzi emfuleni iNadi, eMabovini, eMsinga, ngoLwesine.Lokhu kwenzeke emva kokugasela kwezikhukhula kule ndawo ngezintambama zangoLwesine. Kwabaguguleke nemoto eyiveni, sekutholwe kubo izidumbu zabane kanti kubona bekukhona nowesifazane obenezinyanga ezimbili ezithwele. Kuthiwa bamuke namanzi ngesikhathi iveni ebebehamba ngalo lizama ukuwela ebhulohweni elifishane kulo mfula. Ngokusho kukaMnuz Mandlenkosi Malinga, ongumyeni kaNkk Nokwazi MaNdlovu Malinga (26), umshayeli weveni ubatshele ukuthi bebeyishumi sebebonke evenini, besuka eKranskop emsebenzini, belubangise emakhaya eMabovini.Uthe ngesikhathi besondela ebhulohweni, babone imoto encane iwela ngempumelelo ebhulohweni. "Uthe yilapho naye athathe khona isinqumo sokuthi awele kanti umfula uzovele ungenise besephakathi nebhuloho. Uthe iveni livele lagugulwa amanzi, labheka ezansi,” kusho uMalinga.Uthe lona wesilisa umtshele ukuthi kuthe uma iveni libhajwa yitshe, wabamba owesifazane abehleli naye ngaphambili, baphuma emanzini. "Uthe ngesikhathi eqalaza ngemumva evenini, uqaphele ukuthi i-canopy ayisekho futhi akusekho noyedwa kwabayisishiyagalombili ebebehleli ngemumva,” kusho uMalinga. Uthe umshayeli ugcine ethola ukuthi ababili bakwazile ukugxuma, baphuma ngesikhathi iqala iguguleka imoto kodwa kwathi abayisithupha behluleka, baguguleka namanzi. "Kubuhlungu kakhulu okusehlele. Mina nje ngithe sengitholile ukuthi kwenzeke umonakalo, ngihambe khona ebusuku (ngoLwesine) ngayocinga emaceleni omfula ngethemba lokuthi ngizomthola umkami. Ngithe uma ngibona indwangu, ngathi ngiyayiphakamisa, ngabona ukuthi isikibha abesigqokile, ngikhale kwaduma izihosha ngoba bese ngibona ukuthi lingishonele,” kusho uMalinga, othe nebala isidumbu somkakhe sigcine sitholwa amathimba abatakuli phakathi kweNkandla namaBomvu. Ngokusho koMnyango wezokubusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu, zine izidumbu zabagilwa esezitholakele kanti ukuthungathwa kwezimbili kusaqhubeka. UMphathiswa woMnyango, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, uthe izidumbu zabane zitholakale njengoba kusaqhubeka ukubhekwa kwabagilwa ngohlelo lwamathimba ezinhlekelele esifundazweni. "NgoLwesihlanu amathimba abecinga abagilwa, athole izidumbu ezimbili zabesifazane. Esokuqala sitholwe emfuleni iNadi, eMsinga kwathi esesibili satholakala emfuleni uThukela, eNkandla,” kusho uButhelezi.Uveze ukuthi oyedwa wabo ubekhulelwe, waqhuba wathi, ukucingwa kwabaminzile kuphinde kwaqhubeka nangoMgqibelo, kwaholela ekutholakaleni kwezinye izidumbu ezimbili. "Izidumbu ezimbili zitholwe emfuleni uThukela. Esowesifazane sitholwe endaweni engaphansi kukaMasipala waseMsinga kwathi esowesilisa satholakala eMakhabeleni, ngaphansi kukaMasipala waseMvoti,” usho kanje. Uqinisekise eyokuthi abagilwa abatholakele baneminyala ephakathi kuka-25 kuya ku-40. Ube esedlulisa amazwi enduduzo emindenini elahlekelwe, wancoma amathimba ngomsebenzi oncomekayo wokucisha abaminzile ukuze imindeni ithole ithambo labathandiweyo bayo. "Abesilisa ababili abakatholwa kanti amathimba asaqhubeka nokwenza konke okusemandleni ukubathungatha. UMnyango ngokubambisana noMasipala waseMsinga, ulokhu uxhumane njalo nemindeni ethintekile ukuyeseka ngalesi sikhathi esinzima,” usho kanje.

AMALUNGU eMKP angeneme afuna kumiswe ubuholi beqembu KwaZulu-Natal kanye nasezifundeni.Amalungu angenelisekile anikeze umholi weqembu, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, umnqamulajuqu wezinsuku eziyisikhombisa ukuba amise ubuholi besifundazwe nobezifunda.Isinqumo sokuthi kumiswe ubuholi sithathwe emhlanganweni wamalungu angenelisekile obuseThekwini, ngeledlule.Amalungu angenelisekile akhala ngokunganakwa, athi izikhundla zinikwa abantu abafike kamuva kwiMKP.Owayebhekelela ukuhlela ukusebenza kweMKP esifundeni iTheku, uMnuz Bongani Cele, uthe amalungu aphakamise ukuthi kumiswe ubuholi besifundazwe ngenxa yokuthi aweneme ngabanye abaholi abasezikhundleni."Akukhona ukuthi abajabule ngabo bonke abaholi besifundazwe kodwa kukhona labo abangeneme ngabo. Yingakho amalungu angeneme ephakamise ukuthi uZuma amise ubuholi besifundazwe nobezifunda kuze kuba kuxazululwe izinkinga ezikhona."UCele uthe umhlangano wangeledlule ubuhanjelwe amalungu eMKP aqhamuka ezifundeni ezingu-11 KwaZulu-Natal.UCele uthe abaholi abakhona abazisukumeli izikhalazo zamalungu.Uthe izikhalazo zabo bazidlulisele kuMnuz Bonginkosi Khanyile, obhekelele izinhlelo zokugqugquzela abantu ukuthi bajoyine iMKP."Ubekhona emhlanganweni, sabe sesimnikeza incwadi okufanele ayidlulisele kuMengameli. Silindele impendulo zingakapheli izinsuku eziyisikhombisa."UCele uthe iMKP izophazamiseka okhethweni lohulumeni basekhaya oluzayo uma zingalungiswa lezi nkinga abakhala ngazo.Inyanga edumile, u-Andile "Mzimb'ukhalimali" Dlamini, ithe bakhathele ukunganakwa kwabantu abayibamba ishisa ngesikhathi kusungulwa iMKP.UDlamini uthe izikhundla zinikwa abantu abafike kamumva kwiMKP ngoba nakhu sekumnandi."Kunabantu abasuka kwi-ANC nezinye izinhlangano asebephethe izikhundla. Laba bantu abanikwe izikhundla bafika emva kokhetho. Babengayijoyini ngani iMKP ngaphambi kokhetho? Abantu ababephambili ngaphambi kokhetho abasanakiwe. Sekuyilaba abafika mumva asebengo ngqa-phambili njengomchamo wasekuseni."Mina anginandaba nezikhundla ngoba ngimatasa. Okusikhathazayo ukushiywa ngaphandle kwabantu ababekhona ngesikhathi kuqalwa iMKP. Inhloso yethu ukwakha iqembu. Asifuni ukubhidliza, ingakho sithi akuxoxwe."UDlamini uthe walahlekelwa yinqwaba yamakhasimende ngenxa yokuthi waphumela obala wathi weseka iMKP."Njengomelaphi wendabuko kwakungafanele ngiphumele obala kodwa ngakwenza lokho ngoba ngangikholelwa ukuthi iMKP izoshintsha impilo yabantu. Amakhasimende ami ayi-ANC, IFP ne-DA angibalekela."UDlamini uthe akayedwa kule nkinga. Uthe nenye inyanga edumile, uBhongolethu "Khehlelezi" Mzozo, nayo yalahlekelwa inqwaba yamakhasimende ngenxa yokuthi yaphumela obala ngokweseka iMKP.UDlamini uthe uKhehlelezi waze wavala nendawo yakhe yobumnandi iMzo's Lifestyle ngenxa yokulahlekelwa amakhasimende."Bahlulwa nje ukuthi bambhekelele isikhundla abangamnika sona."Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kokhulumela iMKP, uMnuz Nhlamulo Ndhlela, ayizange iphumele.
UMHLAZIYI wezepolitiki usola sengathi impunyela, uMnuz Patrice Motsepe, isabe induku yase ihoxa embangweni wokuhola i-ANC. Umhlaziyi wezepolitiki waseNyuvesi yaKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Zakhele Ndlovu, uthe akakholwa ukuthi abantu abaqhuba umkhankaso kaMotsepe wokuhola i-ANC bavele baqala nje umkhankaso engakaze asho ukuthi uyasifuna isikhundla.UNdlovu ubephawula emva kokuba uMotsepe echithe amahlebezi okuthi ugaqele isikhundla sokuhola i-ANC. UMotsepe uthe akazi lutho ngomkhankaso wokuba aqokelwe kwesokuhola i-ANC engqungqutheleni yangonyaka ozayo. Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabanikazi bamasheya enkampanini yakhe i-African Rainbow Minerals.Kusanda kusungulwa i-website eqhakambisa uMotsepe ebizwa ngePM27 Savumelana. Phambilini, kuke kwavela nezikibha eziqhakambisa umkhankaso kaMotsepe. Ukuvela komkhankaso kaMotsepe akuzange kwehle kahle ebuholini be-ANC obakhala ngokuthi uzophazamisa umkhankaso wokhetho lohulumeni basekhaya.Amalungu e-ANC awakavunyelwa ukuba akhulume ngombango wezikhundla.UMotsepe uthe akazi lutho ngalo mkhankaso."Angazi ukuthi abantu abaqhuba lo mkhankaso bayithathaphi imali. Ngiyazi ukuthi azolokhu eqhubekile amahlebezi. Inhloso ukungcolisa igama lami. Bahlose ukungiveza njengomuntu ongayihloniphi imigomo ye-ANC. Bafuna ngivele njengomuntu ongenandaba nabantu abahlwempu."Kepha umhlaziyi, uNdlovu, uthe kungenzeka ukuthi uMotsepe ubuye washintsha umqondo ngokungenela umbango wokuhola i-ANC."Uma ngiyibuka kahle le nto, bebengeke bayiqale ekubeni engatshengisanga ukuthi uyasifuna isikhundla. Mhlawumbe ubuye wabona ukuthi le nto ngeke iphumelele, wabona ukuthi uzohlambalazeka. Mhlawumbe yilokho okumenze ukuthi ahlehle."UNdlovu uthe umkhankaso kaMotsepe ubuzokwesekwa kakhulu yilabo abeseka uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa."Osomabhizinisi bebezomthemba uMotsepe okuyinto edingwa iNingizimu Afrika. Iqiniso ukuthi osomabhizinisi abamthembi uMashatile (iPhini likaMengameli, uMnuz Paul)."UNdlovu uthe labo abeseka uRamaphosa kuzofanele bacinge omunye umuntu abazogadla ngaye, wathi ngeke kube lula ukuthola omunye umuntu abazogadla ngaye ngenxa yokushoda kwabaholi abathembekile kwi-ANC."Ngaphambilini (abaseka uRamaphosa), bake baphakamisa uSomlomo wasPhalamende (uNkk Thoko Didiza). Kufanele baphushe yena manje. Uyena kuphela engicabanga ukuthi angasekwa abantu nosomabhizinisi abaseka uRamaphosa. Futhi kungaba lula ukuqhuba umkhankaso wakhe njengoba kuhlezi kunezikhalazo zokuthi i-ANC ayikaze ibe nomholi wesifazane."

AYIZANGE ilandelwe imithetho ngesikhathi kukhishwa ithenda yezigidi zamarandi engundabamlonyeni yokufakwa kwamanzi kuMasipala waseMkhanyakude.Umbiko uthole ukuthi izikhulu zomkhandlu zaphula imigomo ngesikhathi zikhipha ithenda yemali engaphezu kuka-R100 million ngaphansi kohlelo iNondabuya Water Scheme. Umbiko uphakamisa ukuthi zivulelwe amacala izikhulu zomkhandlu ezithinteka enkohlakalweni yaleli thenda.Lo mbiko wethulwe yinkampani iQhubeka Business Solutions. Umbiko obonwe yiSolezwe uthole ukuthi umasipala wagcina ulahlekelwa u-R131 million ngenxa yokungalandelwa kwemithetho ngesikhathi kukhishwa ithenda. Uhlelo lokufakwa kwamanzi eJozini lwaqala ngo-2018. Inkampani eyathola ithenda, iMinathi Consulting Engineers, yagcina ifaka ompompi abangu-1 700, esikhundleni sabangaphezu kuka-2 500.Njengamanje amanzi aphuma kuphela kompompi ababalelwa ku-700 kulaba eyabafaka.Umbiko uthole ukuthi kuphambene nemigomo ukukhokhelwa kweMinathi Consulting Engineers nezinye izinkampani ezincane ezathola umsebenzi ngenxa yokuthi akulandelwanga imigomo ngesikhathi ziqokwa."Wonke u-R131 million owakhokhwa ngumasipala kulolu hlelo kwakungekho emthethweni ukukhokhwa kwawo."Umbiko uphakamisa ukuthi kuvulelwe icala isikhulu esasibambe njengemenenja yomkhandlu.Lesi sikhulu Isolezwe elinalo igama laso sesashiya emkhandlwini, simiselwe izinsolo zenkohlakalo komunye umasipala esasisebenza kuwona.Esinye isikhulu umbiko ophakamisa ukuthi sivulelwe icala sesashona.Umbiko uphinde uphakamise ukuthi kuphenywe izinsolo zokuthi iMinathi Consulting Engineers yayigwazela izikhulu ze-ANC u-10% wemali eyayikhokhwa wumasipala.Umbiko awuwasho amagama ezikhulu.Ubuholi bomkhandlu busolwa ngokuhlala phezu kwalo mbiko njengoba kungekho asebethathelwe izinyathelo kusukela umbiko waphothulwa ngo-Ephreli ngonyaka odlule.Kepha umholi womkhandlu ongagunyaziwe ukukhuluma nabezindaba uthe kungamampunge ukuthi abaholi bomkhandlu babaleka nalo mbiko.Umholi uthe lo mbiko uzodluliselwa ekomitini elibhekele ukusetshenziswa kwemali yomkhandlu ukuze kube yilona elithatha isinqumo."Miningi eminye imibiko ethinta ukusetshenziswa kwemali yomkhandlu esazokwethulwa phambi kwekomiti."Umasipala unikeziwe ithuba lokuphendula kodwa kuze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela ungaphendulile.Ojutshwe ukuba azolekelela emkhandlwini, uMnuz Bamba Ndwandwe, wavula icala emaphoyiseni efuna kuphenywe izinsolo zokugwazelwa kwabaholi be-ANC.Ekhuluma neSolezwe, uNdwandwe ukhale ngokuthi amaphoyisa ahudula izinyawo ekuphenyeni izinsolo."Amaphoyisa alokhu engiyisa le nalena, sengicabanga ukuludlulisela phambili lolu daba."
KUZOKUBA nezinkonzo zokukhumbula umsunguli weCope ohlonishwe ngomngcwabo kahulumeni, uMnuz Mosiuoa "Terror" Lekota. Kuzokuba nezinkonzo ezimbili zokukhumbula uLekota ezizokuba ngaphambi komngcwabo wakhe. Inkonzo yokuqala yokukhumbula uLekota izokuba ngoLwesithathu, eSoweto. Inkonzo yesibili izokuba ngoLwesine, esifundazweni azalelwa kuso, iFree State. Lezi zinhlelo zivezwe umndeni nobuholi beCope ngesikhathi bekhuluma nabezindaba. Umndeni nabaholi beCope bathe kuzokuba nenkonzo njalo ngo-6 ntambama emzini kaLekota kuze kufike usuku lomngcwabo.Umholi weCope obambile, uMnuz Pakes Dikgetsi, uthe balindele inqwaba yabaholi abazofika bezobhonga emswaneni kuleli sonto. UDikgetsi uthe phakathi kwabaholi abazofika kulindelwe nabaholi be-ANC. ULekota wahlubuka kwi-ANC ngo-2008, wabe esesungula iCope."Sikhulumile nabaholi be-ANC. Eqinisweni saqala ukukhuluma nabo ngesikhathi sibazisa ukuthi uLekota usesishiyile. Silindele ukuthi kube yibona abaholi be-ANC abasazisa ngezinhlelo zabo."UDikgetsi uthe kukhalwa nkalo zonke ngokushona kukaLekota."Sinethemba lokuthi ukushona kukaLekota kuzosigqugquzela ukuba sivuse iCope."ULekota uzongcwatshwa ngoMgqibelo, kanti uhlonishwe ngomngcwabo kahulumeni osesigabeni sesibili.Okhulumela umndeni kaLekota, uMnuz Pitso Sekhoto, uthe kungenzeka ukuthi uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, ahambele umngcwabo."Ngisekomitini elihlela umngcwabo. Into evelile ezingxoxweni ukuthi uMengameli unesifiso sokuza emngcwabeni. Indaba yokuthi uyeza ngempela yini izoqinisekiswa yizinhlaka ezifanele ngokuhamba kwesikhathi."Akucaci ukuthi uRamaphosa uzokube esebuyile yini kuleli ngoMgqibelo, njengoba ekade ehambele umngcwabo womfundisi owaziwa ngokulwela amalungelo abantu, uJesse Jackson, obuseMelika.URamaphosa usuke eMelika walibangisa eBrazil, lapho eyohlangana khona noMengameli uLuiz Inácio Lula da Silva.Uzophothula uhambo lwakhe lwaseBrazil kusasa.IHhovisi likaRamaphosa limemezele ukuhlonishwa kukaLekota ngomgcwabo kahulumeni. Okhulumela iHhovisi likaMengameli, uMnuz Vincent Magwenya, uthe uRamaphosa uyalele ukuba amafulengi andizele phansi.UMangwenya uthe uRamaphosa unqume ukuhlonipha uLekota ngomngcwabo kahulumeni ngenxa yeqhaza alibamba ngesikhathi kuliwa nohulumeni wobandlululo neqhaza alibamba kuhulumeni wentando yeningi."URamaphosa uncome kakhulu umsebenzi owenziwa uLekota ngesikhathi esangundunankulu waseFree State nomsebenzi omuhle awenza embuthweni wezokuvikela. Ziningi izincomo ezingenayo kusukela kuvele izindaba zokushona kukaLekota. Ingakho uMengameli enqume ukumhlonipha ngomngcwabo kahulumeni."
UGCINE uhlehle ngaphandle kokuqoka usihlalo, umhlangano wokuqala wekomiti lasePhalamende, elizoqapha ukusebenza kweHhovisi likaMengameli wezwe.Kulo mhlangano obusePhalamende izolo, bekumele kukhethwe usihlalo wekomiti elizoqapha ukusebenza kukamengameli nezikhulu zehhovisi lakhe. Okokuqala ngqa kuleli ukuthi kube nekomiti elifuze leli, njengoba umengameli nephini lakhe bechaza kuphela ngezinhlelo zabo uma bephendula imibuzo ePhalamende kanjalo naseMkhandlwini weziFundazwe.Ungqingetshe odale ukuthi usihlalo agcine engakhethwanga, udalwe wukuthi kunezinto okumele zicaciselwe amalungu aleli komiti, ngaphambi kokuba kuqhubeke uhlelo lokuqoka usihlalo. Mathathu amagama amalungu aphakanyisiwe ukuthi kukhethwe kuwona ozoba ngusihlalo wekomiti. I-DA ibivele ishaya amakhala ithi ayifuni ukuthi usihlalo wekomiti, avele ohlangothini lwe-ANC ngoba ngeke kube nobulungiswa.Ilungu le-DA uMnuz Baxolile Nodada, uphakamise uMnuz George Michalakis, uSotswebhu we-DA ekubeni usihlalo wekomiti. I-ANC iphakamise iphini likaSotswebhu, uNksz Doris Mpapane kulesi sikhundla, kwathi i-EFF yaphakamisa uSotswebhu omusha weMKP, uNkk Mmabatho Mokoena-Zondi.UNksz Mpapane uthole amavoti amahlanu, kwathi uNkk Mokoena-Zondi wathola amane kanti uMichalakis, uthole amavoti amabili. Okushayise amakhala wukuthi uMichalakis, weseke ukuphakanyiswa kwegama lakhe kulesi sikhundla, waphinde wazivotela. Amalungu ekomiti akhale ngokuthi akunankinga ukuthi azivotele kulesi sikhundla, kodwa eyokweseka ukuphakanyiswa kwegama lakhe, yikhona abangakuzwa kahle. Lokhu kwenze usihlalo wesikhashana, uMnuz Mvaba Dumezweni ukuthi acele ithuba lokuthi ayoxhumana nozakwabo mayelana nokuthi imigomo ithini ngalokhu.Ubuye wathi kunesidingo sokuthi athole eminye imibono ethinta imigomo ngaphambi kokuba kuqokwe usihlalo. Imiphumela yokuvota ugcine engayimemezelanga, wathembisa amalungu ukuthi uzobuye ubizwe ngolunye usuku umhlangano wokuqoka usihlalo, uma sebethole umbono ogcwele ngokuthinta imigomo.Amalungu agcizelele ukuthi lo mhlangano kumele uphinde uhlale lingakapheli leli sonto. UMichalakis uthe i-ActionSA, MKP, EFF ne-UAT, bavote ndawonye bangayeseka i-DA."La maqembu yiwona anikele ngesikhundla sikasihlalo kwi-ANC. Kuphakanyiswe igama lami kuqala ukuze sivimbe ukuthi lesi sikhundla, siwele ezandleni ze-ANC. La maqembu afuna ukunika i-MKP isikhundla, ekubeni kuyi-DA ebihlale ifaka ingcindezi yokuthi kube nekomiti elifuze leli ePhalamende," usho kanje.Usole iMKP ngokuthi ayinazo izinhlelo ezicacile ngaphandle kokuphazamisa ukusebenza kwePhalamende.Ezinye zezinto ezizokwenziwa yikomiti wukuthi uMqondisi jikelele ehhovisi likamengameli uzophendula ngezithinta isabelomali, umengameli nephini lakhe baphendule ngezinto ezithinta imigomo yezwe.
ISIKHWAMA esixhasa izitshudeni ngemali yokufunda ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme, iNational Students' Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS), sithi phansi amaphaphu komastende abaqashise izitshudeni ezixhasiwe njengoba bezokhokhelwa imali yabo ngelizayo.I-NSFAS ithembise omastende ukuthi izobakhokhela imali kaFebhuwari nekaMashi. Lokhu kuvezwe yisikhulu esiphezulu salesi sikhwama, uMnuz Waseem Carrim, sikhuluma nabezindaba. UCarrim uthe sebeyifakile ingxenye yemali emanyuvesi namakolishi amaTVET."NgoMashi 13, sizobe siqala ukukhokhela omastende imali yabo. Phansi amaphaphu njengoba le mali sizoyikhokha kusuka ngesonto elizayo. Sizokhokha imali kaFebhuwari nekaMashi," usho kanje.Uthe zibalelwa ngaphezu kuka-100 000 izitshudeni ebezichithwe yilesi sikhwama oxhasweni, ezifake izicelo zokuthi kubuyekezwe lesi sinqumo."Kulezi zicelo ezingu-22 000 zizoxhaswa kanti ezingu-18 000 zichithiwe. Ezingu-44 000 kuvalwe amabhuku kwaphela ngazo," usho kanje. Ukhumbuze abafake izicelo zokuthi kubuyekezwe kabusha isinqumo sokungaxhaswa ukuthi balethe ulwazi olusuke ludingeka zingakapheli izinsuku ezingu-30."Uma sekuke kwadlula izinsuku ezingu-30 lungalethwanga lolu lwazi, lezo zicelo ziyavalwa. Yingakho sinxusa labo okumele balethe olunye ulwazi, ukuthi basheshe bakwenze lokhu zingakapheli izinsuku ezingu-30," usho kanje.Uthe zingu-9 000 izicelo abasalinde ulwazi olwengeziwe ukuze zibuyekezwe."Siyazamukela izicelo zokuthi kubuyekezwe kabusha izicelo uma isitshudeni singaphasanga noma singazange sihlangabezane nemigomo yokuthi sixhaswe." Uveze ukuthi sebexhase izitshudeni ezintsha ezingu-692 000 nezingu-550 000 ebezivele zixhasiwe phambilini."Sizoboleka imali izitshudeni ezingu-1 500. Sisabhekene nenkinga yezimali kodwa siyaqinisekisa ukuthi siyabaxhasa okufanele baluthole uxhaso." Uthe sebekhokhele amanyuvesi ngaphezu kuka-R7 billion selokhu kuqale unyaka. Amakolishi sebewanike u-R680 million selokhu kuqale unyaka. Kwezithinta indawo yokuhlala, uthe bathole izicelo ezingu-224 000 kanti basaxhase abangu-148 000."Laba sebesayine izivumelwano nomastende. Sinxusa nabanye ukuthi basheshe basayine lezi zinkontileka nomastende ukuze sikwazi ukubakhokhela." Ukhale ngokuthi ngo-2025, bashoda ngo-R13 billion kodwa kwagcina sekwenziwe izaba ukuze kutholakale le mali."Nakulo nyaka njengoba indaba yokushoda kwemali iseyinkinga, uMnyango weMfundo ePhakeme wenza izaba zokuthi kungabikhona ozosala ngaphandle ekubeni edinga uxhaso. Simile ekutheni sixhasa abadonsa kanzima nabahlwempu."
LWETHULWE ngokusemthethweni uhlelo olugunyaza umphakathi waKwaDukuza ukuba uzibambele wona mathupha ezintweni ezimayelana nokulungiswa kwengqalasizinda.Lokhu kwenzeke njengoba iMeya yakule ndawo, uMnuz Siduduzo Gumede ekade ehlangene nomphakathi wakule ndawo ngenhloso yokuzokwethula lolu hlelo lokusebenzisana phakathi kukamasipala nomphakathi mayelana nezinto ezimayelana nengqalasiinda.Umsuka walolu hlelo, waqala ngesikhathi iMeya inembizo nalapho amalungu amabili omphakathi okunguNkk Mel Manson noNkk Bev Milehem beza phambili bathi bafisa ukusebenzisana nomasipala ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi izinto ezimayelana nokulungiswa kwemgqalasizinda bayabandakanyeka nabo kuzona.Baqala ngokucela ukuthi babe yingxenye yokuqinisekisa ukuthi iWillard Beach eseBalito bayigcina ihlanzekile ngaso sonke isikhathi. Lokhu bathi bakholwa ukuthi kungaheha izivakashi ezinigi.IMeya ibe seyiqinisekisa ukuthi nebala sekuzoba yibo laba besifazane ababhekelele ukuqinisekisa ukuthi iWillard Beach bayigcina ihlanzekile ngaso sonke isikhathi.Ngenxa yokwanda kwabanye abantu abangamalungu omphakathi nabo ebeze ngaphambili befuna ukuba yingxenye yalolu hlelo, iMeya ibe seyethula lolu hlelo oluhlabahlosile oluvumela umphakathi ukuba usebenzisane nomasipala ukugcina ingqalasizinda isemgangathweni.IMeya uGumede uthe kukhona abanye abeze ngaphambili bakuveza ukuthi bona bafuna ukuba yingxenye yohlelo lokulungiswa kwengqalasizinda yamahholo, imitapo yolwazo, imitholampilo kanye nezinkundla zezemidlalo.UGumede uthe njengomasipala bahlabeke kakhulu umxhwele ngalokhu kuzinikela komphakathi uma kukhulunywa ngodaba lokuqinisekisa ukuthi ingqalasizinda iba semgangathweni.''Sijabule kakhulu ngombono omuhle kangaka owaqhamuka nabantu abangangamlungu omphakathi. Sizimisele ngokuthi senze lobu budlelwane busebenze ngoba buyinto engajwayelekile nje impela,''usho kanjena.Uncome kakhulu ukukhula ngokomqondo kwabantu bakwaDukuza, uthe uma uya kwabanye omasipala abantu bakhona bayazihlalela nje phansi balinde ukuthi konke kubonakale kwenziwe umasipala.Mayelana nezinye izinhlelo abanazo uthe okuseqhulwini ukulungisa imigwaqo ebese beqiniselkisa nokuthi abantu bathola izindlu zokuhlala ezisemgangathweni.
WEHLISE amaphaphu ngobungozi bamaqakelo kuleli, uNgqongqoshe wezeMpilo uDkt Aaron Motsoaledi, othe abantu abangathuki.UMotsoaledi ukusho lokhu emuva kokuba kube nokusaba ngokuthi ngabe aphephile yini, njengoba ucwaningo olwenziwa yiNyuvesi yaseFree State, luveze ukuthi kunamakhemikhali atholakele kwamanye amaqakelo kuleli.Le khemikhali, i-endocrine-disrupting chemicals (EDCs) nama-pantyliners, kuvele ukuthi ayinabungozi ebudalayo kwabasebenzisa le mikhiqizo."Uma usaba umdlavuza saba kakhulu indaba yokubhenywa kukagwayi kunamaqakelo ngoba ukubhema yikhona okudala umdlavuza obulalayo. Noma ungabhemi kodwa uma kukhona ababhemayo osondelene nabo, nawe usengozini. Ugwayi unamakhemikhali angu-7 000, angu-70 awo adala umdlavuza," usho kanje ekhuluma esithangamini sabezindaba izolo, ehlisa amaphaphu ngobungozi okuthiwa busemaqakelweni. Ubalule nokuthi enye into edala umdlavuza wutshwala, kulandele noshukela obhubhudlwa nsuku zonke kuleli."Ushukela siwudla nsuku zonke, akufani namaqakelo asetshenziswa abathile ngezinsuku ezithile zenyanga. Ekudleni kwansuku zonke okubalwa nakomakhalekhukhwini ngisho emanzini asemabhodleleni esiwaphuzayo, akhona amakhemikhali." Ucwaningo lwenyuvesi luveza ukuthi kumaqakelo ahlolwa, kwatholakala okungenani amakhemikhali amabili, okuyi-phthalates, bisphenols (okubalwa i-BPA) ne-parabens. UMotsoaledi uveze ukuthi noma ucwaningo luveza ukuthi nakuba kukhona la makhemikhali, kodwa akusho ukuthi azolimaza lowo osuke esebenzisa le mikhiqizo."Akusho ukuthi la makhemikhali azolimaza umzimba womuntu osebenzisa imikhiqizo enawo. Lawa makhemikhali yinto esiphila nayo nsuku zonke njengoba etholakala ngisho ezintweni zokugeza izinwele ama-shampoo, ezintweni zasendlini okubalwa nokudla, izinto zokuziqhola nokuziphophotha, ezokugcoba okubalwa nokucwebezelisa umlomo, izingubo esizigqokayo, imithi yokugxubha nasezintweni zikagesi," kusho uMotsoaledi.Uthe la makhemikhali asetshenziswa kwezolimo kanti atholakala ngisho emhlabathini."Indaba yalawa makhemikhali yatholakala ngama-1920s, okusho ukuthi sekuneminyaka engu-106 yaziwa indaba yawo. Akuyona into entsha netholakale manje." Uveze nokuthi neSouth African Health Products Regulatory Authority (Sahpra), ayikaze ithole ubungozi kumaqakelo."Ne-World Health Organisation (WHO) ayikaze ibike ukuthi kukhona isehlakalo esake sabikwa noma ukuhoxiswa kwamaqakelo athile ngenxa yobungozi bamakhemikhali. Sihlanganise ososayensi, ongoti kanjalo nezinhlangano ezehlukene ukubheka kabanzi eyamaqakelo kodwa kwangatholwa bungozi."Ubalule ukuthi akekho ongakwazi ukususa la makhemikhali unomphela ezintweni ezisetshenziswa nsuku zonke.

URamaphosa uthe enye inkinga okufanele isukunyelwe eyezakhiwo ezinganakiwe, wathi mkhulu umsebenzi owenziwe ithimba. "Osomabhizinisi sebeyabuya edolobheni ngenxa yokuthi sebebuyelwe ithemba. Le nkinga kufanele isukunyelwe."Isikhulu sezokuvakasha, uNksz Samantha Croft, sithe ukuvalwa kwamabhishi ngenxa yokugeleza kwendle kwaziphazamisa kakhulu ezokuvakasha."Amabhishi avalwa isikhathi eside. UFUNA ubulungiswa owesilisa othi abazukulu bakhe bashaywe kanzima omunye umakhelwane eNew Hanover, eMshwathi, ngasekupheleni kwenyanga edlule.Kulesi sigameko kuthiwa kulimale kanzima ekhanda kanjalo nasemunweni umfundi oneminyaka engu-18 nonengu-16.Ngokusho kukamkhulu wabagilwa, uMnuz Joseph Luthuli, ngoFebhuwari 21, emzini wakhe, kugasele omakhelwane bakhe, befuna esinye isihlobo. "Ngaphuma ngasho ukuthi lo abamfunayo akekho, bathi akusale sekuza mina. Bangixhakathisa, baya nami emzini wabo. Bafika bangivalela, bangibuza ngamaselula nomazisi okulahlekile,” kusho uLuthuli.Uthe wayelokhu echaze njalo ukuthi akukho akwaziyo ngalezi zinto okuthiwa zilahlekile. Uthe kusenjalo, kwaqhamuka abazukulu bakhe bezobheka ukuthi kwenzekani, nokuyilapho abagcina sebehlaselwa khona."Abantu bakulo muzi babashaya abazukulu bami, omunye walimala ekhanda, omunye walimala emunweni. Kwaphoqa ukuthi baye esibhedlela nokuyilapho abafike balaliswa khona, batishwa,” usho kanje. Uqhube wathi balivulile icala esiteshini samaphoyisa iNew Hanover kodwa kwangaba bikho mnyakazo owenzekayo.Uthe kwathi sebelivulile icala, amaphoyisa abatshela ukuthi kufanele bathathe ifomu, iJ88 baliyise esibhedlela ukuze ligcwaliswe."Wawagwalisa udokotela lawo mafomu, kodwa wala ukubanika ukuthi bawahambise esiteshini samaphoyisa, wathi umthetho uthi awalandwe wumphenyi wecala,” usho kanje. Uthe umphenyi akazange azixake ngokuwalanda, kunalokho, wambiza ukuba ayokhomba abasolwa ngoLwesine olwedlule. Uthe omunye wabasolwa wabe eseshaqwa amaphoyisa, kodwa ngakusasa bambona esezithwabazela emphakathini."Sathi uma siya enkantolo ukuyobuza, umshushisi wathi icala likhishiwe ohlwini lwamacala ngoba belingenasisindo,” usho kanje.Uthe umshushisi wathi abasolwa kwakufanele bayokhonjwa abagilwa futhi namafomu (J88) eseka okushiwo yizitatimende awekho. "Manje thina sibuza ukuthi amaphoyisa kungani athatha mina ukuthi ngiyokhomba abasolwa esikhundleni sokuthi athathe abagilwa. Futhi sixakwa nawukuthi yiphutha likabani ukuthi ama-J88 awekho edokodweni ngoba umthetho waziwa yiwo amaphoyisa,” kusho uLuthuli.Uthe bafuna ubulungiswa ngecala njengoba abasolwa bebasabise ngokuthi abaqedile.Uthe kugcine kungacacanga ukuthi isihlobo ababesimemeza, beze begcina bethatha yena, yiso yini ababesisola ngokweba impahla abathi ilahlekile.
UNOBHALA weSadtu KwaZulu-Natal, uNksz Nomarashiya Caluza uthe uMnyango wezeMfundo esifundazweni awuphumele obala uchaze ukuthi uthini umthetho olawula ukusebenza kothishanhloko ezikoleni.UNksz Caluza usho kanje kulandela ukumiswa kukathishanhloko wasesikoleni uMkhumbane Secondary, eChesterville, uMnuz Ntokozo Ngobese, ngoLwesibili.Bese kuphele amasonto amabili kuthikamezeke ukufunda nokufundisa kulesi sikole kulandela ukuthi othisha abangu-22 benyunyana iSadtu, bengalubhadi esikoleni. Kuthiwa bafuna ukuthi kukhishwe amakhamera aqopha izithombe kanjalo nomsindo emakilasini. Bekusalindelwe ukuthi kube nomhlangano wabazali, umnyango nabo othisha ngesikhathi kuvela ukuthi umnyango usuthumele umhloli esikoleni ngoLwesibili.Kuvele ukuthi umhloli ubezonika uthishanhloko incwadi ebhalwe ukuthi uyamiswa esikoleni izinyanga ezintathu ngezinsolo zokungaziphathi kahle. Kuthiwa le ncwadi ayenabi ngokuthi yikuphi ukungaziphathi kahle asolwa ngakho namiselwa khona.UNksz Caluza ethintwa yiSolezwe Ngempelasonto uthe into ebhedise uhlelo kuyo yonke le nxushunxushu, ukungabi khona kokuxhumana."Tholani umnyango kuqala ukuze uchaze kabanzi ngenqubomgomo yawo nokusebenza kothisha. Uthishanhloko kwakufanele abonisane nothisha kuqala ngaphambi kokuthi afake amakhamera,” kusho uNksz Caluza. Ukhale ngokuthi amakhamera awaqophi izithombe kuphela, kodwa aqopha nomsindo."Asikwazi ukuthi sibe nomuntu ohleli ehhovisi lakhe, abe matasa nokubuka nokulalela othisha befundisa,” usho kanje.Uqhube wathi into ebe yinkinga enkulu ngalolu daba wukuthi akukhulunywanga nothisha, kodwa babone ngawo esefakiwe. Wenze isiphakamiso sokuthi abaholi bezikole ababahloniphe ozakwabo abangothisha ukuze kuhlale kunokuthula ezikoleni.UMengameli weNatu, uMnuz Sibusiso Malinga, ethintwa yintatheli ngoLwesithathu, uthe udaba lusha kubona, abalwazi.Uthe uma kukhona izinqumo ezithathwayo ngesikole, kufanele zibe khona zonke izinhlaka zesigungu esilawula ukuphathwa kwesikole. "Kulesi sigungu kukhona abamela abafundi, abazali kanjalo nothisha. Uma kukhona izinguquko ezenziwayo esikoleni, zenziwa emhlanganweni osuke wethanyelwe yilezi zinhlaka. Uma kungabazali abathi akufakwe amakhamera esikoleni, kufanele ukuthi lokho kuvele emaminithini omhlangano okwathathwa kuwo leso sinqumo,” kusho uMalinga.Uthe bona beyiNatu, bayakhathazeka uma kuthikamezeka ukufunda."Umnyango awungenelele, kungaphazamiseki ukufunda,” kusho uMalinga, othe okunye okungaba yisisombululo wukuthi amakhamera avulwe sekuphume isikole uma kukhalwa ngobugebengu bokwebiwa kwempahla. Uthe abanalwazi lokuthi uthishanhloko umiselweni, nokho wathi umthetho uthi azibalulwe izinsolo amiselwa zona encwadini esuke ithi akamiswe. Khonamanjalo, Isolezwe Ngempelasonto lithinte omunye wabazali, uNksz Xolile Buhlalu ngoLwesine, waveza ukuthi bahambe bayobhikisha ngaphandle kwesikole iBerea Primary lapho betshelwe ukuthi kuhlala khona abahloli.Uthe bafike balalelwa yilungu lePhalamende, elibatshele ukuthi linguRadebe. Uthe ubathembise ukuthi namuhla kuzofika uMphathiswa wezeMfundo uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka azolalela izikhalo zabo. Uveze eyokuthi esikoleni ingidi efakwe abazali isavalile, ukufunda nokufundisa akuqhubeki. Kumanje bahlela ukuthi ngesonto elizayo basivule isikole kuqhubeke ukufundisa kothisha besikhashana abazokhokhelwa abazali."Laba abalaxaze ukufunda, asisabadingi esikoleni sethu. Simile futhi kwelithi amakhamera awayi ndawo futhi nothishanhloko simdinga ebuyile,” usho kanje.Isolezwe Ngempelasonto lizamile ukuthola abakhulumela uMnyango, uMnuz Muzi Mahlambi noMnuz Mlungisi Mtshali, kodwa izingcingo zabo bezikhala zingabanjwa.
AKWAZIWA mbhantshi kujiya ngokuzokwenzeka ezinkonzweni zebandla lamaRoma aKhatholika ngeSonto kumaPherishi aholwa oFata abasolwa ngokuba nomoya wobungoma.Kuvela ukuthi simanzonzo isimo emaPherishi amabili aseThekwini selokhu kuphume uhlu lokushintshwa koFata olusha okuvele ukuthi kunoFata ababili abasolwa ngokuba nomoya wobungoma abashaywe ngesithende.OFata okukhulunywa ngabo nguFata Thembelani Ngcobo wePherishi yaseMontclair noFata Sifiso Ndlovu wePherishi yasePinetown.UFata Ngcobo waqala ukuzakhela udumo olukhulu ngezinkonzo zakhe ayezenza ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ngesikhathi sokhuvethe, iCovid 19. SIMANZONZO isimo eWeenen, ngaphansi kobukhosi beNkosi uSiphiwe Mvelase, ngenxa yokukhula mawala komkhuba wokwebiwa kwemfuyo.Lesi simo kuthiwa sesize saholela ekutheni kube khona ukusongelana phakathi kwezigodi ezihlukene ezingaphansi kwenkosi eyodwa. Isolezwe lithole ukuthi Inkosi uMvelase ihola izigodi ezintathu okuyiNomoya, Mashuka neNkaseni.Kuvela ukuthi ukwebiwa kwemfuyo kulezi zigodi kudla lubi kakhulu kangangoba kukhona nasebesabisa ngokuthi uma kuqhubeka kanjena kuzogcina sekugobhoza igazi. Kuvela ukuthi amasela amaningi abhace esigodini eManqomfini esakhelene nesizwe senkosi.Isolezwe likhulume nomunye osondelene nomkhandlu wenkosi kodwa ocele ukuba lingadalulwa igama lakhe. Uthe bakhathazekile kakhulu ngodaba lokwebiwa kwemfuyo okudla lubi kule ndawo.Uthe akukho abangazange bakwenze ngenhloso yokunqanda lolu dungunyane kodwa kunhlanga zimuka nomoya, wathi abasazi manje ukuthi yini engenziwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lo mkhuba uyaphela nya.''Okuyikhona osekuqala ukusithusa kakhulu wukuthi sibona sengathi le nto uma iqhubeka izogcina seyidala ukuthi kugcine sekugobhoza igazi kungenasidingo. Kungaba yinto ebuhlungu kabi ukubona kugobhoza igazi ngenxa nje yokwebiwa kwemfuyo okuyinto ebingakhulunywa ilunge," usho kanjena.Uveze ukuthi okuyikhona okuyinkinga wukuthi abaseManqomfini, bayazenzela bayacanasa kulezi zogodi zontathu zenkosi, bangena baphume ebusuku beba imfuyo.''Ngisho nayo inkosi seyiqala ukunengeka manje yile nto ebonakala iqhubeka kule ndawo. Okucacayo nje bha ukuthi bonke laba bantu abenza le nto bayenza ngenhloso futhi kabesabi muntu ngoba indlela abenza ngayo ifakazela khona ukuthi bazimisele ngokuthi noma ngabe kugcine kugobhoza igazi, bona ngeke babe nenkinga nalokho," usho kanjena.Omunye okhulume neSolezwe oyilungu lomphakathi ukhale ngokuthi abantu abeba imfuyo bayaziwa kodwa akekho noyedwa umuntu ozimisele ngokuthi abaqonde, lokhu uthe akazi ukuthi kudalwa yini.''Mfowethu, bayaziwa abantu abeba imfuyo ngisho ingane encane ingahamba ibakhombe. Iqiniso wukuthi sesikhathele manje yile nto eqhubekayo kule ndawo," kusho ilungu lomphakathi.Liqhuba, lithe sebesaba ukuthi kuzogcina kusuka impi enkulu uma lesi simo kungekho noyedwa ozama ukusilungisa.Osekususe umsindo omkhulu wukuhlawuliswa kwabasolwa ngokweba imfuyo abathathu izinkomo ezingu-39 umuntu emunye. Lokhu ngokusho komunye osondelene nobukhosi, kubonakala kuzogcina kudala udungunyane olukhulu. Kuthiwa kubizwe umhlangano obekukhona kuwo ubuholi bomphakathi kodwa ingekho inkosi, kwase kuphuma lesi sigwebo. Isolezwe lizame kaningi ukuxhumana nabasolwa ngokweba imfuyo okuthiwa bahlawulisiwe kepha izinombolo okuthiwa ngezamaselula abo bezingangeni.''Iqiniso wukuthi ziningi kakhulu lezi zinkomo okukhulunywa ngazo ukuthi kumele zihlawuliswe umuntu nakhona okusolakala ukuthi uyena bungekho nobufakazi. Angikholwa wukuthi laba bantu abasolwayo bazothula nje bagoqe izandla uma beqeda ukukhipha lezi zinkomo," usho kanjena.Uthe ubona kahle ukuthi kukhulu kuyeza kuyanyelela kule ndawo ngoba isimo siya ngokubhebhetheka kunokuba sidambe.Isolezwe likhulume nosebenza ehhovisi lenkosi (onqabe negama lakhe), wavuma ukuthi simbi isimo sokwebiwa kwemfuyo kule ndawo sesingaphezulu kwamandla abo.Kodwa wenqabile ukuxhumanisa Isolezwe nayo uqobo inkosi, wathi ikhala ngokuthi ayithandi ukuthi kube khona ekukhuluma nabezindaba mayelana nalolu daba.Amaphoyisa angagunyaziwe ukukhuluma nabezindaba, akuqinisekisile ukuthi kunoxhaxha lwamacala okwebiwa kwemfuyo kule ndawo.

"Kwakukhona imizwa komunye nomunye, kodwa abukho ubuhlobo obuqhubekayo. Angazi ngempela ukuthi ngingakuchaza kanjani. Bekungelona uhlobo lokuthi sitshelana ukuthi siyathandana futhi ngizokwenzela noma yini."U-Lekganyane uchaze le nto yabo ngokuthi "abangane abasizanayo". Kodwa obehola ofakazi uthe likhona igama lesimanje elisetshenziswayo elithi, 'situationship'.
Inkantolo yeSifunda KwaMaphumulo igwebe indoda eneminyaka ewu-25 udilikajele ngecala lokudlwengula ingane eneminyaka eyisishoyagalolunye endaweni ngo-2022. Umgilwa nommangalewa babazana njengoba ummangalelwa wayehlala nomndeni kamgilwa (amagama agodliwe ukuvikela isithunzi sikamgilwa).Ngosuku lwesigameko, unina kamgilwa waya edolobheni washiya ummangalelwa nomgilwa nezinye izingane ezincane. Ummangalelwa wabizela umgilwa endlini, watshela ezinye izingane ukuthi azihambe ziyodlala. Ummangalelwa wadlwengulwa umgilwa, waqeda wathi akageze. Unina kamgilwa wabuya edolobheni waqaphela ukuthi kukhona okungahambi kahle ngengane yakhe futhi ingubo yayo yayimanzi. Unina kamgilwa wayibuza indodakazi yakhe, yabhoboka yamchazela ngesigameko aveza ukuthi ummangalelwa ubengaqali ukwenza lokhu. Unina kamgilwa wabuza ummangalelwa kodwa waphika. Udaba lwabikwa emaphoyiseni, umgilwa wayiswa e-Stanger Thuthuzela Care Centre(TCC) wayothola usizo. Umgilwa wagcina eboshiwe. UMshushisi uBongani Sibisi ubize ofakazi okungumgilwa nonina owabikelwa kuqala. Kubizwe nodokotela owahlola umgilwa nye wafakaza. UMshushisi ekhonga isigwebo esiqinile, wethule isitatimende sikamgilwa asenze eluswe wuSifiso Nene oyi-Court Preparation Officer. Umgilwa uthe isigameko sishabalile isifiso sakhe sokuhamba umkhosi womhlanga. Uthe udonsa kanzima nasesikoleni Ngaphezu kwesigwebo sikadilikajele, inkantolo inqume ukuthi ummangalelwa akafanelwe wukuba nemvume yokuphatha isibhamu. Igama lakhe lizofakwa ohlwini lwabanukubeza ngokocansi. I-NPA iyasemukela isigwebo. Umkhankaso wokulwa nesihlava sodlame lobulili, ungene kwelinye igiya manje njengoba kwandiswe amaThuthuzela Care Centre(TCC) ezweni lonke esuka ku-55 ngo-2020 /2021 saya ku-66 manje. Lezi zikhungo ziwusizo kubagilwa bokunukubezwa ngokocansi.
