ABAZALI abebedinwe begane unwabu bafunge bagomela ukuthi ngeke sivulwe isikole, uMkhumbane Secondary esiseChesterville, eThekwini, engabuyisiwe uthishanhloko waso omiswe isigubhukane. Basho kanje izolo, emva kokuthi usihlalo wesigungu esilawula isikole (SGB), uMnuz Bongani Mokoena, ebazisa ngokwakamuva odabeni lwezinxushunxushu eziqhubekayo esikoleni.Kulesi sikole kuthikamezeke ukufunda esikhathini esingaphezudlwana kwamasonto amathathu, kulandela ukuthi othisha abayamaniswa neSadtu, bekulaxaze phansi ukufundisa bedinwa ukufakwa kwamakhamera emakilasini. Kube khona umdonsiswano phakathi kwabafundi, othisha kanjalo nabazali. Othisha abangu-22 bafunge bagomela ukuthi ngeke babuye esikoleni amakhamera engakhishiwe nothishanhloko, uMnuz Ntokozo Ngobese, engahambile. Abafundi bake bazama ukubhikishela ukuthi kubuyiswe othisha abalaxaze ukufunda, abazali bashaya phansi ngonyawo, bathi akukho mfundi ozobhikishela othisha abangafuni ngamabomu ukufundisa. Baphinde bakubeka kwacaca ukuthi amakhamera awayi ndawo futhi nothishanhloko bafuna aqhubeke nokuhola isikole. Umzali, uMnuz Smanga Mkhwanazi, ugxeke eyomhloli okhethe ukuthumela umyalezo ngesigungu sesikole (SGB), wathi ngesikhathi begcina ukukhuluma naye kwakuvunyelwane ngokuthi uzobuya msalofu azoletha izimpendulo kubona bengabazali.Ubasole ngokuthi bathathe isinqumo bodwa bengabazisile bona bengabazali, wathi bona bamile kwelokuthi amakhamera awaphumi futhi noNgobese bamdinga ebuyile. "Amakhamera awangakhishwa, akubuyiswe uNgobese. Uma kungenzeki lokho, isikole ngeke sivulwe. Okwesithathu uNgcobo (uMnuz Nkosinathi - oyinhloko yoMnyango wezeMfundo esifundazweni) noMsomi (umhloli) sibadinga la,” kusho uMkhwanazi.Uqhube wathi bathatha lezi zinqumo nje, ezabo izingane zifunda ezikoleni ezizimele ezinawo lawa makhamera kodwa bathi awakhishwe eMkhumbane Secondary.Omunye umzali, uNksz Nonhlanhla Magundu, uthe uMnyango ungasihlinzeka isikole ngezinsiza ezifana nothisha nokunye kodwa isikole ngesabazali nomphakathi. "Isikole ngesethu. Okusho ukuthi njengoba bemise uNgobese izinyanga ezintathu, nathi sizode sizoma la kuze kuphele lezo zinyanga, kuze kubuyiswe uNgobese,” usho kanje.Omunye umzali, uNksz Xolile Buhlungu, usabise ngokuthi uma uMnyango uqhubeka nokungabalaleli, bazovala uthelawayeka womgwaqo u-N2. Ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabazali, usihlalo ubatshele ukuthi umhloli ubatshele izinqumo ezintathu, athe ziphuma koyinhloko yoMnyango. Esokuqala esokuthi lungapheli uLwesibili amakhamera engakhishiwe, esesibili esokuthi aphume naye ngesango uthishanhloko omiswayo, bese abazali betshelwa ukuthi abakhiphe ingidi engaziwa abavale ngayo isikole. Ilungu le-SGB elicele ukungadalulwa lithe babona uMnyango usebenzisa udaba lwamakhamera ukujezisa uthishanhloko ngothisha osanda kubuyiswa owayexoshwe eminyakeni emithathu edlule ngenxa yokulibala izinkamba zikaFaro, engawenzi umsebenzi."Nakuba incwadi yokummisa ibhalwe ukuthi "akaziphathanga kahle” maqede yangachaza, ukhona umoya ovelayo ukuthi usejeziselwa lo thisha kodwa sekucashwa ngolwamakhamera,” lisho kanje.Lithe bahlela ukuluyisa enkantolo lolu daba njengoba sekunento ebhalwe phansi evela koyinhloko yoMnyango. Licacise eyokuthi isinqumo sokufakwa kwamakhamera senziwa ngabazali, hhayi uthishanhloko."Uma bethi awakhishwe, ubani ozokhokhela ukukhishwa kwawo? Abazali abanayo imali yokukhokhela ukukhishwa kwawo,” kuphetha ilungu.
IGCAGCELE esokeni kubabhali bezincwadi abasafisa ukuchuma kulandela isimemezelo senhlangano yababhali, uSiba Writer's Guild, sokuvukuza amakhono amasha kulo mkhakha. USiba, kuleli viki, lwethule isigungu esisha esesizosingatha zonke izinhlelo, nokuyisona esizwakalise ukuthi sifisa ukuthi kube nezithelo ezibonakalayo ukusebenzisana namaciko asafufusa.Umbhali osemnkantshubomvu uDkt Nakanjani Sibiya uqokwe njengoSihlalo woSiba, kwathi iPhini likaSihlalo kwaba uMnuz Muntomuhle Mcambi, uMgcinimafa uDkt Themba Qwabe, kwesikaNobhala kwaba uNksz Nompumelelo Khumalo, yena osekelwa uNksz Ntombenhle Dlamini. Amalungu okwengeza kube ngoMnuz Zwelihle Mkhize noMnuz Mandla Ndlovu.Engxoxweni neSolezwe Ngempelasonto, uSihlalo woSiba, uDkt Sibiya wodumo lwencwadi esihloko sithi Bengithi Lizokuna, udalule ukuthi bekungahlali kahle emoyeni wabo ukuthi le nhlangano isize yafika eminyakeni ewu-40 yaba khona kodwa kusalokhu kunzima ukuthi ifinyelele kubantu ngendlela abafisa ngayo."Ngenkathi kuqala le nhlangano ngo-1985 inhloso enkulu kwakuwukuthi ibambe iqhaza ekufukuleni nokuthuthukisa imisebenzi yababhali bezincwadi. Kuthe ngokuqhubeka kwesikhathi silokhu siyibambile kuyona - sagcina sibona ukuthi lokho akufezeki ngendlela efanele ngenxa yokuthi besizinze eThekwini kakhulu. Lokhu bekudala ukuthi kube nokuqhelelana nababhali abaningi, kungafinyeleleki kithi,” kusho uSibiya.Ngokwenqubo entsha, Usiba luzoba nezinhlaka ezifundeni ezahlukene okukhona kuzo Ugu oluzoholwa wuyena uSibiya, iLembe elizoholwa uMcambi, eThekwini okuzohola khona uNksz Khumalo, iHarry Gwala ezoholwa wuNksz Dlamini. EMzinyathi uQwabe ozoba yiso lakhona, eMgungundlovu kube wuNdlovu, iKing Cetshwayo iholwe uMkhize, kuthi oThukela, Amajuba, iZululand noMkhanyakude akukabi nammeli.USibiya udalule ukuthi kuzo zonke lezi zifunda bahlele ukuthi benze imicimbi yokuzethula kubantu ngoMashi wonke ukuze kuzokwazeka ukuthi sekunezinhlelo ezinjena eziqalayo, nabo bakwazi ukuthi baqale ubudlelwano nababhali."Sifuna nokuthi sisize ababhali abasafufusa ukusebenzisa igama namagalelo enhlangano Usiba ukuthola amathuba ehlukene okuthuthukisa imisebenzi yawo yobuciko, ngoba siyazi ukuthi ngeke kufane ukungqongqoza eminyangweni ethile uzihambela wedwa, nanoma usebenzisa igama le nhlangano eyaziwa nenedumela njengeyethu,” usho kanje.Udalule nokuthi kusukela manje futhi bazoqhubeka benze imicimbi nezinhlelo okwehlukene okuhambisana nemincintiswano yokubhala emikhakheni nangezindikimba ezahlukene zezincwadi."Sifisa nokugcina sisebenzisana namanye amaciko ukusebenzisa ubuciko bokubhala izincwadi ukungenisa nangezinye izindlela, sibala nokuthi sisize ababhali ukusebenzisa imisebenzi yabo yezincwadi engaguquleka ibe yimidlalo yakwithelevishini,” kusho yena.
INGENWA yiPhini likamengameli wezwe, uMnuz Paul Mashatile, eyezinkinga ezibhekene noMasipala waseMpendle.UMashatile uthe ubengakabikelwa ngezinkinga ezibhekene nalo masipala wathi uzothumela ithimba liyobheka izinkinga ezikhona."Bengingakezwa ngezinkinga ezibhekene noMasipala waseMpendle, KwaZulu-Natal. Ngizothumela ithimba ukuthi liyobheka okwenzeka kulowa masipala. Kubalulekile ukuthi singabashiyi ngaphandle omasipala basemakhaya," usho kanje. Ukusho lokhu ephendula imibuzo eMkhandlwini weziFundazwe ePhalamende.Ziyagibelana izinkinga kulo masipala njengoba muva nje kubhuntshe umhlangano womkhandlu omqoka emuva kokugasela kosomabhizinisi abathi bakweletwa wumkhandlu. Osomabhizinisi bangena nezicabha emhlanganweni, bathi umhlangano ngeke uqhubeke bengakayitholi imali yabo.Lo masipala ubhekene nenkinga yemali njengoba sekuphenduke insakavukela ukuthi abasebenzi bangaholi ngesikhathi. Imeya yalo mkhandlu nosomlomo baqhubeka nomsebenzi wabo, phezu kokuba bamiswa wubuholi besikhashana be-ANC esifundazweni. Uthe uMasipala waseMkhanyakude uyingxenye yomasipala abangu-33 okusaqhubeka umsebenzi wokulungisa isimo kubona."Abantu basemakhaya bazizwa sengathi uhulumeni ubakhohliwe. Sizojuba nethimba kumasipala waseMkhanyakude liyohlola isimo salo masipala. Sizosebenzisana nesifundazwe, ngeke simane siziyele ngaphandle kwesifundazwe," usho kanje emuva kokuba kukhalwe ngokuthi namanje abantu baseJozini basaphuza amanzi nezinkomo.UMashatile uveze nokuthi bangu-162 omasipala abasesimeni esibi semali kuleli."Kumele singenelele kulabo masipala ngoba uthola ukuthi izinkinga zimayelana nokungaphathwa kahle kwemali. Kwabanye omasipala, uthola ukuthi kunezinkinga zokungasebenzisani kahle kwabaholi, okuyizinto okumele zilungiswe," usho kanje. Uthe uMnyango wokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu, noMnyango kaMgcinimafa babeka amacala abakomasipala abahluleka wukwenza umsebenzi.Ukhale ngokushoda kwabasebenzi abanamakhono komasipala basemakhaya wathi abanamava bakhetha ukusebenza komasipala abasemadolobheni."Kudingeka siyibheke eyemihlomulo yabasebenzi ukuze baheheke ukuyosebenza komasipala basemakhaya. Ngaleyo ndlela sizokwazi ukuthola abantu abanamakhono namava omsebenzi," kusho uMashatile. Odabeni lwethimba elizobhekana ngqo nenkinga yamanzi ezweni, uthe bahlose ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bayawathola amanzi."Omasipala bayalelwe ukuthi balungise inkinga yokuvuza kwamanzi. Sibhekene nezinselelo ngezithinta amanzi osekuphenduke inhlekelele, yingakho kujutshwe ithimba elizobhekana ngqo nale nkinga." Uqhube wathi lapho kunezinkinga zokuhlinzekwa kwemiphakathi ngamanzi, uhulumeni kumele athenge amaloli ahambisa amanzi, kungasetshenziswa abazimele. "Abantu bayaxhashazwa ngenxa yabazimele abahlinzeka ngamanzi ngamathangi. Kunombiko esawuthola wokuthi laba abazimele bacekela phansi ingqalasizinda yamanzi, ukuze bathole umsebenzi wokuhambisa amanzi."Uthe bazotshala izinsiza ukuvuselela ezokuthutha kusetshenziswa amaguzu.Uveze ukuthi baphucula imizila yeTheku, iGoli, Queenstown, East London neCape Town .
KUTHIKAMEZEKE ukufunda nokufundisa izolo esikoleni iMkhumbane Secondary, eChesterville, eThekwini, abafundi bezama ukubhikisha, kulandela ukubeka phansi oshoki kothisha abadinwe wukufakwa kwamakhamera emakilasini.Ngokuthola kweSolezwe sekuphele amasonto amabili kuthikamezekile ukufunda kulesi sikole. Kuvela ukuthi isikole sithole othisha abayizitshudeni ukuba bazobamba, njengoba othisha abangu-21 besaqhubeka nokungayingeni eyokufundisa. Kuthiwa abafundi bebezimisele ngokubhikishela ukuthi kubuyiswe othisha abatelekile nokuthi abafuni ukufundiswa othisha abayizitshudeni. Abazali abathe bakhathazekile ngemfundo yezingane zabo, bavele bavuka bayonkanisa esangweni lesikole, bashaya phansi ngonyawo bathi akukho mfundi ozovimba isango ngombhikisho.Ngokusho komunye wabazali, uNksz Xolile Buhlalu, emhlanganweni wabazali kulandela ukusuka komsindo, othisha bathe abawadingi amakhamera kodwa bangazibeka izizathu. "Isikole sike sacekelwa phansi, kwebiwa izihlalo, kwafinyelelwa ekutheni kufakwe amakhamera,” kusho uNksz Buhlalu.Uthe bona bengabazali bayameseka uthishanhloko ngokufakwa kwamakhamera ngoba kuzolekelela ezintweni ezehlukene, okubandakanya yona eyobugebengu.Uthe basola ukuthi abafundi banxenxwe othisha abalaxaze ukufundisa ukuthi babhikishe."Okubuhlungu wukuthi izingane azifundile amasonto ababili wonke ekubeni sekuzobhalwa izivivinyo zethemu yokuqala. Esifuna umnyango ukuthi usenzele kona wukuthi uthole abanye othisha abazofundisa izingane, laba abangafuni ukufundisa, bahambe,” kusho uNksz Buhlalu. Uthe namanje basadidekile ukuthi yini lena engaka eyenza othisha bangawafuni amakhamera. "Abaphumeli obala ngezizathu, ezabo izingane zifunda ezikoleni ezizimele yikho benza kanje,” usho kanje.Kuke kwavela ukuthi othisha abadube umsebenzi bakhala ngokuthi uthishanhloko uhlekisa ngendlela abafundisa ngayo okuthiwa yinto abayibone iqoshwe amakhamera afakiwe.Omunye umzali, uNksz Londeka Ngobese, uthe kothisha abalaxaze ukufundisa kukhona abanxenxa abafundi ukuthi ababhikishe, bafune ukuthi babuyiswe. Unxuse uMnyango wezeMfundo ukuba usondele kulesi sikole ukuxazulula le nkinga, nezinye abathi bazizwe ngabafundi. Owesigungu esilawula isikole, obekhona esikoleni izolo, uMnuz Majola, uthe bakhona othisha abayizitshudeni abake babamba njengoba kuqhubeka isixakaxaka kodwa bayeka kulandela ukusatshiswa.Uveze ukuthi othisha abalaxaze ukufundisa bangaphezu kwengxenye njengoba singu-39 isibalo sothisha kulesi sikole."Njengoba kwenzeka konke lokhu, umnyango uthule du,” kusho uMajola. Uqinisekise eyokuthi abazali abayizwa eyesiteleka sabafundi futhi bayameseka uthishanhloko ngokufaka amakhamera."Bathi awayi ndawo, umnyango awusilethele othisha abazofuna ukufundisa, futhi abayingeni eyesiteleka,” kusho uMajola.Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo, uMnuz Mlungisi Mtshali, uthe bayazi ngalolu daba, nokho uthe abakafuni ukuphawula ngalo njengoba inhloko yomnyango isesemhlanganweni nobuholi besikole, ukuludingida.
KUNXUSWA abakuleli abasesifundeni esikhungethwe yizimpi, iMiddle East, ukuba babuyele ekhaya.UMnyango woBudlelwano naMazwe oMhlaba unxuse abantu bakuleli ukuthi basebenzise ithuba elincane elivelile lokuhamba kwamabhanoyi ukuba beze ekhaya.Umnyango uphinde wanxusa abantu bakuleli ukuba bakugweme ukuvakashela emazweni aseMiddle East.Kuthiwe kunabantu abangaphezu kuka-6 000 bakuleli ababhalise ukuthi basesifundeni iMiddle East. Isifunda iMiddle East sakhelwe amazwe achaphazelwe yimpi okubalwa kuwo i-Iran, United Arab Emirates, Qatar namanye. Impi iyaqhubeka nokududulana kulesi sifunda.IMelika ne-Israel bahlasela bephindelela e-Iran. I-Iran yona ihlasela ezikhungweni zombutho wokuvikela waseMelika ezisemazweni afana ne-United Arab Emirates neQatar.Impi iphazamise ukuhamba kwamabhanoyi njengoba bekungandizi lutho ngeSonto esifundeni.Okhulumela uMnyango woBudlelwano naMazwe oMhlaba, uMnuz Chrispin Phiri, unxuse abahambe ngezimo ezingaphuthumi ukuba babuyele ekhaya njengoba kusavulwe amabhanoyi."Sithanda ukwazisa abantu ukuthi akhona amabhanoyi ayisibalo esincane aseqalile ukusebenza. Sinxusa abantu ukuba basebenzise leli thuba elivelile njengoba kulindeleke ukuthi impi iqhubeke."UPhiri unxuse abafuna ukubuya ukuba baxhumane namahhovisi amanxusa akuleli ukuze bathole usizo."Lokhu kuzosisiza sikwazi ukuhlela ukubuyisa abantu bakuleli abasemazweni nasemadolobheni akhungethwe yizimpi uma sekuphephile ukuthi babuye."UPhiri unxuse amazwe alwayo ukuba ebeke phansi izikhali."INingizimu Afrika ithatha leli thuba ukuphinda ikhwelo lokuba zonke izinhlangothi ezithinteka empini ukuba zizithibe, zingenzi izinto eziphambene nomthetho. Sinxusa wonke amazwe ukuba ahloniphe imithetho ye-United Nations."Impi iqale ngempelasonto lapho iMelika igadle kwazwela, yabulala umholi wase-Iran, uMnuz Ayatollah Ali Khamenei.Lokhu kucasule kakhulu i-Iran, yagadla ezikhungweni zamasosha aseMelika.Izolo ibisaqhubeka impi idudulana.
UMENGAMELI Cyril Ramaphosa, uthi elakuleli likulungele ukungenelela empini ephakathi kwe-Iran neMelika.URamaphosa uthe elakuleli lizongenelela noma ingayiphi indlela uma licelwa yinhlangano yamazwe omhlaba, i-United Nations (UN), ukuba lilekelele.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba emva komhlangano i-Africa Energy Indaba, obuseCape Town."Sihlezi sikulungele ukubamba iqhaza. Kungaba wukuthi siba abaxazululi noma yiliphi iqhaza. Uma kuvela ithuba noma sicelwa ukuthi sibambe iqhaza siyaye senze lokho esisuke sicelwe ukuthi sikwenze. Siyingxenye yamazwe omhlaba, yingakho sibamba noma yiliphi iqhaza i-UN ecela ukuthi silibambe."Impi ephakathi kwe-Iran neMelika iqale ngempelasonto, iMelika ilekelelwa elakwa-Israel.IMelika igadle kwazwela njengoba impi idlule nomholi wase-Iran, uMnuz Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, kwafa nabantu abangaphezu kuka-700.I-Iran yona iziphindisele ngokugasela ezikhungweni zamasosha aseMelika ezisemazweni angomakhelwane okubalwa kuwo i-United Arab Emirates neQatar.URamaphosa uthe ufuna ukuthi iphele ngokushesha le mpi."Sikhiphe isitatimende lapho sikubeke kwacaca khona ukuthi sifuna iphele impi. Sifuna uphele lo msangano. UDonald Trump (uMengameli waseMelika) umatasa kakhulu njengoba kuqhubeka impi. Uma kwenzeka kuvela ithuba lokuxoxa naye sizomtshela ukuthi ayiphele impi. Indlela elula yokuqeda impi wukuhlala phansi kuxoxwe. Sifuna ukuthi impi iphele ngokushesha. Baningi abantu abafela into engenasidingo. Maningi amazwe achaphazelekile ngenxa yempi."URamaphosa uthe bazozama ukwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi iNingizimu Afrika ayiphelelwa wukudla neminye imikhiqizo eqhamuka emazweni achaphazelwe yimpi."Ngingakusho kugcwale umlomo ukuthi siphephile ngalapho, akukho okuzosiphelela."Impi iphazamise ukuhamba emazweni amaningi njengoba kuthikamezeke izindiza ezisuka eDubai.Izindiza eziningi ezisuka noma eziya emazweni amaningi aphesheya zidlula eDubai.URamaphosa uthe bayazama ukuxhumana nabantu bakuleli abavaleleke empini, wathi bazobahlinzeka ngosizo abaludingayo.IDubai ayiconsi phansi kosaziwayo bakuleli abajwayele ukuyivakashela.
UMNDENI womsunguli weCope, uMnuz Mosiuoa Lekota, uchaze ngobuhlungu obuzwile ngesikhathi ukugula kumqinisa kulezi zinyanga ezimbili ezedlule.Okhulumela umndeni, uMnuz Pitso Sekhoto, uthe ubuhlungu ababuzwile ngesikhathi egula benze ukuthi kungabe kusazwela kakhulu ngesikhathi eshona ngoLwesithathu.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba ngaphandle komuzi kaLekota oseFree State, izolo.USekhoto uthe kulezi zinyanga ezimbili ezedlule bekwembulwa kwembeswa."Yithina ebesimnakekela. Bekubuhlungu ukumbona esezinhlungwini. Yingakho uma uzobheka manje ubona ukuthi asikhali ngoba siyazi ukuthi usephumule yizinhlungu. Esikhundleni sokukhala sikhetha ukubungaza impilo kaLekota."ULekota ushonele eGoli, isidumbu sakhe sibuyiselwe esifundazweni azalwa kuso, iFree State, ngoLwesithathu ebusuku.USekhoto uveze ukuthi umngcwabo kaLekota uzokuba ngeSonto elizayo."Okwamanje sisikaza uLwesihlanu noma uMgqibelo. Sisalinde ukuthi kufike wonke amalungu omndeni ukuze siqedele amalungiselelo omngcwabo. Kube nomhlangano womndeni obe seGoli kodwa manje zonke izinto sezizokwenziwa lapha."USekhoto uthe bangajabula uma uLekota ehlonishwa ngomncwabo kahulumeni ngenxa yokuthi ubethandwa abantu abaningi."Sizohlangana nezikhulu zikahulumeni ukuzwa ukuthi uLekota angase anikwe umngcwabo kahulumeni wesigaba sesingaki. ULekota ubengumuntu wabantu. Ubethandwa yiwo wonke umuntu futhi naye ubebathanda abantu."Sisaqedela amalungiselelo ukuze sazi ukuthi obani abazoba yingxenye yomgcwabo. Njengoba sazi ukuthi uLekota ubengumuntu wabantu siyazi ukuthi umngcwabo wakhe kufanele uhanjelwe abantu abaningi."UMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, uthe bazozwa ngomndeni ukuthi yikuphi ofuna ukuthi uhulumeni ulekelele ngakho.ULekota wake waba undunankulu waseFree State, futhi uke waba ungqongqoshe wezokuvikela.Waba yilungu le-ANC isikhathi eside futhi waba usihlalo kazwelonke wale nhlangano iminyaka eyishumi. ULekota wahlubuka kwi-ANC ngo-2008, wabe eseqala iCope.
SEKUQUBULE omkhulu umsindo ebandleni lamaRoma aKhatholika ukunikezwa ikhefu abangalicelanga koFata ababili "abanomoya wobungoma".Isolezwe litholle ukuthi njalo ngemuva kwesikhathi esithile, leli bandla liye libe nohlelo lapho okusuke kushintshwa khona oFata beya kwamanye amaPherishi. Ngokujwayelekile lolu uhlelo lugunyaziwe futhi lungezinye zezinto eziyinqubomgomo yalo leli bandla. Ngokomthetho webandla, akuvumelekile ukuthi uFata angahola iPherishi eyodwa iminyaka ngeminyaka ngaphandle kokushintshwa.Muva nje, kwenzeke into efanayo njengoba leli bandla kade lishintsha oFata libayisa kwamanye amaPherishi. Nokho okuhlukile kulokhu wukuthi lolu hlelo seluholele ekutheni kuqubuke omkhulu umsindo ongapheli emakholweni njengoba kunenkolelo yokuthi lusetshenziswe ukukhipha inyumbazane oFata "abanomoya wobungoma".Lokhu kuza ngemuva kokuba oFata ababiili abayizangoma kuthiwa bayalelwe isigubhukane ukuba baye ekhefini abangalicelanga. Lokhu - amalungu ebandla azifelayo ngalabo Fata - akutolika njengokushaywa kwabo ngesithende.Kuthiwa lokhu sekuholele ekutheni amakholwa amaningi azifelayo ngabo acasuke kakhulu njengoba ethi afuna izimpendulo ebuholini bebandla ngokushaywa ngesithende kwabo.OFata okukhulunywa ngabo nguFata Thembelani Ngcobo wePherishi yaseMontclair noFata Sifiso Ndlovu wePherishi yasePinetown.Isolezwe likhulume nomunye wabazalwane abasePherishini yasePinetown, othe bona bayaxakeka ukuthi kungani enyundelwa uFata wabo ngoba ngisho iMisa uyalihlonipha, akwenzeki aveze izimpawu zobungoma uma esaqhuba lona?Bathe bajabhile kakhulu futhi bayaxakeka ukuthi kungani uFata wabo abamthanda kangaka ezwiswa ubuhlungu ngalolu hlobo?Kube yinto efanayo nakubazalwane bePherishi yaseMontclair, nabo abakhala ezimathonsi ngokusala ngaphandle kukaFata wabo kulolu hlelo.Bathi nabo bafuna izimpendulo ngokuthi yini kanti le edale ukuthi bashiywe ngaphandle ekubeni bona bekholwa ukuthi akukho okubi akwenzile?Elinye ilungu laleli bandla lithe muva nje, kubonakala sengathi uma unesiphiwo sabantu abadala usuke sewugadlile ebuholini bebandla okuyinto abathi yintsha, ebingekho ngaphambilini.Kumiswa labo Fata nje, kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi ezinyangeni ezimbalwa ezedlule, kuke kwasuka imvunge ebandleni ngesikhathi kuphuma incwadi eyayiveza ukuthi abantu abayizangoma abasavumelikile.Le ncwadi yayiqhubeka iveza ukuthi abazalwane baleli bandla nabo abavumelekile nje nhlobo ukuthi bangenza imicimbi yesintu, ikakhulu ethinta ukukhumbula abangasekho.Lokhu kwadala umsindo omkhulu ngaphakathi ebandleni, abazalwane bebuza ukuthi obani laba abaqhamuka manje bezobayekisa into eyisisekelo sempilo yabo futhi eyayenziwa ngokhokho babo?Abaningi bafunga bagomela bathi ngeke kuze kwenzeke lokho, bathi bancamela ukulishiya ibandla kunokuthi bahlukaniswe nezimpande zabo.Ngemuva kwalokhu, ubuholi obuphezulu bashaya ungqimphothwe bathi le ncwadi kayizange itolikwe ngendlela efanele.Incwadi eyayibhalwe ngoSepthemba 16, 2025, kwavela ukuthi enye into evaliwe wukuthi abazalwane bahambe izangoma, ukuhlaba izinkukhu, ukusetshenziswa kweziwasho, amakhandlela ayimibala, ukubusiswa kwamafutha, ukwenza amalathi nokunye.Incwadi yayisayinwe ngokubambisana nguMbhishobhi oMkhulu uSiegfried Mandla Jwara, Cardinal Wilfrid Napier, umqondisi wabaphostoli eShowe; uMbhishobhi Graham Rose waseDundee; uMbhishobhi Stan Dziuba weDiocese yaseMzimkhulu; uMbhishobhi Neil Frank weDiocese yaseMariannhill; uMbhishobhi Thulani Mbuyisa waseKokstad; uMbhishobhi Vusi Mazibuko, waseNgwavuma noMbhishobhi Elias Zondi weDiocese yaseThekwini.Kuze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela uMbhishobhi Mjwara oyiNhloko yeDayosisi yaseThekwini, engatholakalanga ukuba aphawule ngalolu daba lwakamuva.
UKUGULA kukaLindokuhle Ndlovu, ongomunye wabamangalelwa, kuholele ekutheni kuphinde kuhlehle ukugwetshwa kwakhe kanjalo nabanye abane okukhona kubo namaphoyisa amabili, eNkantolo yeMantshi yasePinetown ngoLwesibili. Balahlwa yicala lenkohlakalo nelokuphazamisa ukusebenza kwengalo yomthetho nyakenye. Amaphoyisa, uBonginkosi Dlamini noKhephu Ndlovu bafumbathiswa imali engu-R120 000 ngusingamama kaLindokuhle, uSibongile Ndlovu, naye olahlwe yileli cala, ukuze bathikameze ubufakazi ecaleni lokubulawa kukaMnuz Thulani Nxumalo ngo-2018. USibongile wayefuna ukuthi umyeni wakhe, naye olahlwe yicala elifanayo, uFelokwakhe Ndlovu aphume phambili ecaleni lokubulala uNxumalo. UNxumalo wayengumzala kaFelokwakhe kanti wayengumholi wegatsha le-ANC KwaNdengezi.Izinto azibange zisahamba ngokohlelo njengoba bavele baboshwa bonke yithimba elaliphenya ukubulawa kosopolitiki KwaZulu-Natal. INkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini, yamthola enecala lokubulala uFelokwakhe, yamgweba udilikajele ngoMeyi 2023. Ngaphambi kokuthi alahlwe yicala, kwavela ukuthi uNxumalo wayengahambisani nokudayisa kukaFelokwakhe umhlaba, okwakungekho emthethweni. Kulelo cala uDlamini wayengumphenyi kanti uKhephu wayesebenza njengomxhumanisi phakathi kukaDlamini, uSibongile noFelokwakhe. UKhephu wayeyiphoyisa eliphezulu ophikweni lwamaphoyisa iVisible Policing Unit esiteshini samaphoyisa iBhekithemba, eMlaza. Ukushintshisana ngemali yokufumbathisa kwenzeka esiteshini samaphoyisa iDurban Central. ULindokuhle walahlwa yicala lokufihla isibhamu esasetshenziswa kubulawa uNxumalo. NgoLwesibili, iNkantolo yesiFunda yasePinetown bekulindeleke ukuthi iqhubeke nokuwisa isigwebo kodwa umshushisi woMbuso u-Advocate Lawrence Gcaba, oyiPhini likaMqondisi wezokuShushiswa koMphakathi esifundazweni, watshela inkantolo ukuthi uLindokuhle ulaliswe esibhedlela ngaleyo ndlela ukuwiswa kwesigwebo ngeke kuqhubeke. "Okwesibili, bekunenkinga ngesikhathi kunesicelo sikammangalelwa wesine (uKhephu). AboMnyango wokuHlunyeleliswa kweziMilo bacele ukuthi inkantolo ikhiphe isinqumo salokho,” kusho uGcaba. Emva kokuthi belahlwe yicala ngoMashi nyakenye, kwabe sekuqala uhlelo lokuthi bagwetshwe. Kuthe kusenjalo, uKhephu wamxosha ummeli wakhe, u-Adv Andrew Matlamela. Wabe eseqasha u-Adv John-Paul Broster, ophinde abe ngummeli kaDlamini. Wabe eseveza ukuthi uzofakaza uma sekufike isikhathi sokuthi azicelele isigwebo esincane, wathi usalinde amarekhodi akhe ezempilo. UGcaba ucele ukuthi kuhlehliselwe u-Ephreli nonyaka ukuze isimo sikaLindokuhle sibengcono. IMantshi uMuntukayise Khumalo ibe isilihlehlisela u-Ephreli usaqala icala ukuze kuqhutshekwe nokuwiswa kwesigwebo.
UNGQONGQOSHE wezeMfundo ePhakeme, uMnuz Buti Manamela, useveze ukuthi sithele izithelo ezinhle isinqumo sakhe sokufaka ngaphansi kwabalawuli izinhlangano ezisebenzisana nabaqashi ukuhlinzeka ngamakhono kwizitshudeni ezisafunda, ama-Seta, kuleli.UManamela uthe kwakunesidingo sokuthi ezinye zalezi zinhlangano zifakwe ngaphansi kwabalawuli ngenxa yokungaphathwa kahle kwemali nezinye izinto.Wagxekwa uMnyango kaManamela ngokungathathi izinyathelo ezinqala kuma-Seta okwakhalwa ngokuthi afana nento osekuxetshulwa umkhoma kuyona, okwenziwa izikhulu zalezi zinhlangano. UMnyango wakhe wafaka ngaphansi kweso labalawuli, i-Construction Education and Training Authority (Ceta), Services Sector Education and Training Authority (Services Seta), neLocal Government Sector Education and Training Authority (LG Seta)."Akusona isinqumo esasithatha sixhamazela ukufaka lezi zinhlangano ngaphansi kwabalawuli. Kwakunesidingo futhi kubalulekile ukuthi sikwenze lokhu ukuze sibuyise uzinzo kulezi zinhlangano," usho kanje izolo, ekhuluma esithangamini sabezindaba ePitoli.Uthe bakwenza lokhu ukuvikela izitshudeni okuyizo ezizuzayo kulezi zinhlangano."Izitshudeni zithola isipiliyoni ngokuthola ulwazi kulezi zinhlangano ezixhaswa ngemali wuMnyango. Sajuba abalawuli ukuze kube nozinzo ekuphathweni kwemali," usho kanje. Uthe selokhu akwenza lokhu kunezithelo ezinhle ezibonakalayo."Besingeke sivumele ukuthi kusetshenziswe imali kahulumeni ngendlela engafanele, yingakho sangenelela. Sikwazile ukubuyisa enye imali eyasebenza ngendlela engafanele kwenye yama-Seta." Uveze ukuthi kwamanye ama-Seta kwakungalandelwa imigudu ebekiwe, kukhokhelwa abaqashi ekubeni izitshudeni zingakaqali ukuqeqeshwa. "Kwamanye, izikhulu zazingavezi ubudlelwano ezinabo nalabo abasuke bethole umsebenzi wokuqeqesha izitshudeni. Kokunye kwakuqashwa izikhulu ngendlela engafanele." Uthe bazoziqapha ngelokhozi lezi zinhlangano ukuthi zenza umsebenzi wazo ngendlela nokuthi kuqokwa abantu abanamava kuzona.
UDINGA izigidi zamarandi uMnyango weMfundo eyisiSekelo ukuze ulungise izinkinga zengqalasizinda ezibhekene nezikole zaseNingizimu Afrika.Lokhu kuvezwe nguNgqongqoshe woMnyango, uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, othe badinga u-R130 billion ukuze balungise ingqalasizinda ezikoleni zakuleli. Ingqalasizinda akhuluma ngayo ifaka ukwakha izikole, ukuzilungisa, ukwakha izindlu zangasese, ukubiya izikole nezinye izidingo.Uthe ikhona imali encane etholwa yizikole kodwa nayo kayenele ukubhekana nezidingo."Sidinga imali ukuze silungise yonke ingqalasizinda ukuze izikole zethu zibe sezingeni. Inkinga imali enikwa izikole ayenele, okwenza ezinye izidingo zingenziwa," usho kanje. Ukusho lokhu ekhuluma emhlanganweni wekomiti leMfundo eyisiSekelo ePhalamende.Ukhale ngokuthi ezinye zezikole aziwenzi umsebenzi omncane ofana nokulungisa amawindi afile, okugcina sekuba yinto enkulu uma sesanda isibalo samawindi afile."Uma inkinga yokufa kwewindi elilodwa ingasheshe ilungiswe, ngeke kube nezinkinga uma esemaningi afile, okwenza imali yokuwenza kanye kanye ingabikhona. Yingakho sigqugquzela izikole ukuthi zisheshe zikulungise ezingakwazi ukukulungisa ukuze ungandi umthwalo wezinto ezidinga ukulungiswa kanye kanye." Usho lokhu nje, kuhlale kunezikhalo ezikoleni ngokuthi ayifiki ngesikhathi imali evela eMnyangweni eyaziwa ngama-norms and standards. Le mali isiza ekukhokheleni ugesi, amanzi nokwenza ezinye zezidingo zezikole. Ezikoleni uMnyango oziphathela imali, kudingeka zilandele uhlelo olude lokufaka izicelo zokuthi zilungiselwe okuthile okusuke kufile, nakhona okuthatha isikhathi ngenxa yenkinga yemali.Amalungu ekomiti akhale ngokuthi umphakathi uhlala ukhala ngengqalasizinda engekho ezingeni uma beyivakashele. Usihlalo wekomiti, uNksz Joy Maimela, ushaye amakhala ngombiko othulwe wuMnyango oveza ukuthi iyalungiswa ingqalasizinda ezikoleni."Sithole umbiko woMnyango oveza ukuthi kusadingeka amakilasi angu-43 677 kuleli. Ezinye izikole azinawo ama-laboratory, imitapo yolwazi, igumbi lamakhompyutha nezinye izidingo ezisiza ekutheni kufundiseke kalula. UMnyango uveze ukuthi udinga cishe u-R57 billion ngonyaka, ukubhekana nenkinga yengqalasizinda," usho kanje. Uthe u-13% wezikole kwezingu-22 789 kuleli, usesimweni esibi kakhulu."Izikole ezisemakhaya zisesimweni esibi kakhulu. Abafundi basemakhaya ababhekelelwa kwezithinta ingqalasizinda." Ukhale nangokuthi kwezinye izikole kugcina sekuphela iminyaka kusetshenziswa amagumbi angomahamba nendlwana. "Kwezinye izikole, abafundi basebenzisa amakilasi okungakagunyazwa ukuthi bawasebenzise ngenxa yokushoda kwawo. Kugcwele emakilasini kwezinye izikole, abafundi bampintshana emadeskini," kuqhuba uNksz Maimela.UNksz Gwarube ubuye waveza ukuthi uhlelo lokudla ezikoleni, ngeke luphazanyiswe wukunqanyulwa kwesabelomali ngoba luhlinzekwe ngo-R10 billion.Uthe imali yalolu hlelo ayikwazi ukwenza ezinye izinto ngaphandle kokuphakela abafundi.
Owayeyilungu le-ANC ePhalamende uVincent Smith ugwetshwe iminyaka eyisikhombisa ebhadla ejele yiNkantolo eNkulu yaseGoli. Lokhu ngemuva kokuba uSmith abe nesivumelwano nombuso ngenqubo yesigwebo. Lokhu kuhlobene namacala enkohlakalo nokukhwabanisa enzeka esesikhundleni sakhe njengomqondisi oyedwa kanye nomnikazi we-Euroblitz 48, lapho ahluleka khona ukudalula ePhalamende ukuthi kukhona akutholayo enkampanini iBosasa.Ngokwemininingwane yecala kanye nemibiko yeKhomishana kaZondo kanye namacala abekwe wona, uVincent Smith owayevunjathiswa yiBosasa imali okuthiwa ingaphezudlwana kuka-R870,000. Lokhu bekuhlanganisa ukugwazelwa ngemali yanyanga zonke (ephakathi kuka-R45,000 kuya ku-R100,000), ukuthuthukiswa kwezokuphepha ekhaya lakhe (R200,000), kanye no-R600,000 wemali yendodakazi yakhe yasenyuvesi.

NgeSonto ntambama kube sekubulawa umkakhe, uNkk Nomalungelo Khumalo (54) naye okuthiwa uhlaselwe ngabantu abangaziwa esemzini wakhe.Udadewabo kamufi, uNksz Noluthando Nxumalo, uthe izigilamkhuba zimfice eyedwa umufi kwazise zombili izingane zakhe zifunda enyuvesi eThekwini.Ulandise wathi bathole ucingo lokuthi mabaphuthume ngoba sekonakele. Ubalisa ngokuthi kusekude kakhulu ukuba akulibale akufice endlini kamufi.''Sifice udadewethu edindilize phansi kabuhlungu kugcwele igazi endlini. Angisazi mina isihluku esinjeya. Abantu abanjani laba abakwazi ukubulala umuntu wesifazane ngaleya ndlela,'' usho kanjena.Uthe nakuba bengazi ukuthi ngobani abenze lokhu, kodwa ngabe kabaphilile ngokwanele emakhanda uma bengahlulwa wukubona ukuthi kusengabantu ababodwa laba ababulala umlamu wakhe abaphinde babulala udadewabo.Uthe bakhathazekile kakhulu ngokuthi kanti laba bantu bawufunani lo mndeni onokuthula okungaka.''Laba bantu bobabali angikhumbuli nje nangelilodwa ilanga leli kuthiwa kukhona abantu abaxabene nabo. Kodwa buka nje ukuthi bobabili abasekho emhlabeni bebulawa futhi ngendlela eyodwa enesihluku esikhulu ngale ndlela exakayo,'' usho kanjena.Uthe bebengakulindele nhlobo ukuhlaselwa kukadadewabo ngoba ngesikhathi kubulawa uKhumalo baba nomcabango wokuthi mhlawumbe kungenxa yodlame lwamatekisi base bevumelana ngokuthi kumele adayiswe wonke amatekisi kamufi kungakapheli nenyanga engcwatshiwe.''Lokhu sakwenza ngokuphazima kweso. Sasithi sizama ngakho konke okusemandleni ukuqinisekisa ukuthi sibalekela lokhu osekuvele kwenzekile manje. Kuyacaca ukuthi abantu ababulala la ekhaya banenzondo nje esingayazi kodwa engahlangene nendaba yamatekisi,'' kuchaza yena.Uthe kusho ukuthi babemane bedlala ngesikhathi sabo nje bedayisa amatekisi ekubeni ayengenisa imali eningi kulo mndeni.''Ukube sasazi sasizoweyeka amatekisi ngoba iqiniso wukuthi ayelekelela kakhulu ekutheni kungene imali,'' usho kanjena.Uthe okubuhlungu wukuthi kuze kubulawe udadewabo namanje kusacwebe iziziba ngababulala umyeni wakhe.''Kuyacaca ukuthi laba bantu baphinde babuya ngoba vele bayazi ukuthi ngeke baze babanjwe benza noma yini abayithandayo ngesikhathi esithandwa yibona,'' usho kanjena.Uthe noma kunjena kodwa bazoqhubeka balwele ukuthi kwenzeke ubulungiswa batholakale abenzi bobubi.Uthe okumnenga kakhulu wukuthi nakuyena udadewabo kukhona abathi babone iPolo empunga ingena egcekeni, wathi kuyacaca ukuthi abantu ababodwa ngempela laba abagadla bephindelela.Ubuze ukuthi bafunani ngalokhu abakwenzayo futhi bacabanga ukuthi yini abazoyizuza?Amaphoyisa aKwaZulu-Natal akuqinisekisile ukubulawa kukamufi. Athe kuyaphenywa ngokubulawa kwakhe.

KUHLEHLISELWE usuku lwanamuhla ukugwetshwa kowesilisa olahlwe yicala lolubulala ngesihluku unina wengane yakhe owayengumfundi, kulandela ukwala kwakhe aphethe ukubuya ebhokisini, ethi akuxoshwe izintatheli.UNtuthuko Sosibo (29) ulahlwe yicala lokubulala uMandisa Cele (20) waseSiqungeni, eMthwalume, ngoJanuwari nyakenye. Kuthiwa uSosibo washaya ephindelela uMandisa ngesitulo nange-ironing board, waphinde wamgqimuza kukhonkolo wethangi lamanzi kubo. Izolo, bekulindeleke ukuthi imgwebe iNkantolo yesiFunda saseScottburgh nokugcine kungenzekanga, esedlala umacashelana nenkantolo.Kade engene okokuqala, izintatheli zamaziko ehlukene zithole ithutshana lokumthwebula, nokuthe ngesikhathi icala liguqiswa isikhashana waziphakamisela umunwe ophakathi nendawo, ezithuka.Kuthe esephinda ebizwa emva kwekhefu elifishane, watshela iphoyisa elisebenza enkantolo ukuthi ngeke anyuke uma ezothwetshulwa yizintatheli. Kuphele imizuzu embalwa enganyuki ngempela, imantshi uNkk E Botha, yayalela izintatheli ukuthi zibeke phansi amakhamera. Kuthe sezenze njalo, ummeli wakhe uNksz Nzimande wacela ukwehla ayokhuluma naye. Ubuye nomyalezo othi uSosibo uthi ngeke anyuke uma izintatheli zisengaphakathi enkantolo. Azixoshwe!UNkk Botha akabange esakhipha myalelo ngaphandle kokuthi alihlehlisele usuku lwanamuhla icala.Esiwombeni sokuqala sokuvela kukaSosibo, umshushisi woMbuso, uMnuz Active Njapha, ubuze uyise kamufi, uMnuz Mzwandile Dlungele, ukuba atshele inkantolo ukuthi ukubulawa kukaNksz Cele kwabahlukumeza kangakanani bewumndeni. UDlungele utshele inkantolo ukuthi ingane (5) kamufi isihlala ezihlotsheni njengoba unina abulawa ngesihluku.Ukhale ngokunqanyulezwa kwempilo kamufi esabhekwe yikusasa eliqhakazile, njengoba eveze ukuthi wayengumuntu owayenamaphupho amakhulu.Ube esecela inkantolo ukuthi ibakhuzele udadewabo kaSosibo okhuluma amagama alumelayo kubona uma kuziwe ecaleni. "Ngokwedlule, sathi sizikhulumela siwumndeni, kukhona obuzayo ukuthi umndeni wabo wenzani uMandisa esebulewe, wayinqaka kuqala inkulumo, ngelithi basingcwabela ingane yethu, akazi ukuthi yini enye esiyifunayo emndenini wabo? Ukudelela kwakhe kuzongiyisa endaweni engingafuni ukuya kuyo,” kusho uDlungele.Nakuba engasikalanga isigwebo asifisela uSosibo ngaphakathi, esekhuluma nabezindaba ngaphandle, uthe ufuna adilikelwe yijele. Uqhube wathi akubajabulisanga okwenziwe uSosibo ngaphakathi enkantolo enqaba ukubuyela ebhokisini. "Inkantolo bekufanele imphoqe ukuthi abuyele ebhokisini,” usho kanje.Ekhumbula isigameko, uthe wafica isigazi emnyango eduze nethangi lamanzi, elinye lisendlini kanti wathi uma ethi uyamthinta umntanakhe, wezwa ikhanda libokozela sengathi kalinamathambo, emzimbeni eluhlaza cwe, ukushaywa.
ZIMKHALELE owesifazane waseThekwini obesebaqedile abesifazane athandana nabo ngokubaqola nokubantshontshela. Le ntokazi (32), esiligodlile igama layo ize ivele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini namhlanje, ikhalelwe ngamasongo kaSigonyela eThekwini izolo. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uSergeant Thenjiswa Ngcobo, ukuqinisekisile ukuboshwa komsolwa amaphoyisa aseDurban Central. Uthe owesifazane ophila impilo yokuthandana nabanye besifazane usolwa ngecala lenkohlakalo nelokweba. "Uzovela eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini ngoMashi 3, 2026," kuphetha uSergeant Ngcobo. Udaba ngokukhohlakala kukamsolwa luqale ukudalulwa kwiTikTok intokazi eyaziwa ngoNksz Alabaster "Cijimpi" Zwane. Wachaza umsolwa njengomuntu wesifazane obefike akhohlise abantu besifazane ngokuthi uyabathanda bese ebagila uma esefike ezindlini zabo. U-Alabaster uze wafaka i-video ebiveza umsolwa ekhipha umbhede emqashweni wentombi yakhe eHomii, eThekwini ngolunye usuku. "Amaqola lawa aseThekwini. U.... (emgagula ngegama), akadlali. Ngisho umbhede uyawuqukula. KwakuseHomii lana, enentombi athandana nayo. Wakwazi ukungena kanti amakhamera azomdividiya. Ngisho umbhede uyaphuma," kusho u-Alabaster eveza umsolwa eqiqinga umbhede nomatilasi."Indoda yomgunyathi. Ufike enze sengathi uyakuthanda bese eyakuqola - cellphone, mbhede, mali. Aphinde akubhonye, unesandla esilula."Isolezwe lithole ukuthi umsolwa wafunda eSithengile Senior Secondary eClermont. KwiFacebook uvela eswenke econsa futhi edla ezindaweni zokudla ezihanjwa ngomntakabani. U-Alabaster uthe umsolwa akayedwa eThekwini owenza lo mkhuba. Kukhona nomunye wesifazane amgagulile owayenguthisha kodwa wasula.U-Alabaster uthe umsolwa wesibili (55), naye othandana nabantu abanobulili obufana nobakhe, waqola obengumkakhe ngokuthi athi akamthathele u-R100 000 ebhange, wathembisa ukuthi uzoyikhokha kodwa wakhala amaphepha, wasala umkakhe encela izithupha nesikweletu.Uthe manje umsolwa wesibili usefuna ukudivosa umkakhe ukuze athole uhhafu emalini yamafa. "Amadoda omgunyathi afuna ukudla izithukuthuku zabanye abantu," kusho u-Alabaster.
KUPHINDE kwaphazamiseka ukufunda nokufundisa esikoleni, iMkhumbane Secondary, eChesterville, izolo, kulandela ukumiswa isigubhukane kukathishanhloko.Ngokusho komzali, obekhona ngaphakathi esikoleni, uNksz Xolile Buhlalu, uthishanhloko, uMnuz Ntokozo Ngobese, umiswe emva komhlangano abe nawo nomhloli okuthiwa ubethunywe uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal nesigungu esilawula isikole.UNksz Buhlalu uveze ukuthi emva kokumiswa kukaNgobese, abazali ebebedinwe begane unwabu, ebebenkanise ngaphandle kwesango lesikole, bavele basivala ngeketanga nangengidi isikole. "Abazali babafundi abafunda uGrade 12 bebebizelwe emhlanganweni ukuzodingida eziphathelene nesixakaxaka esiqhubekayo esikoleni ngenxa yokufakwa kwamakhamera. Kuthe umhlangano usaqhubeka, kwangena omunye uthisha othe awuhlakazeke umhlangano ngoba sekumiswe uthishanhloko,” kusho uNksz Buhlalu.Uqhube wathi yilapho bethole khona ukuthi umhloli obeze esikoleni, ubelethe incwadi yokumisa uthishanhloko.Uveze ukuthi abazali bayaveva ngalolu daba njengoba besola ukuthi kusetshenziswa izingane zabo ezimpini zothisha nokubangwa kwezikhundla. Udalule ukuthi namuhla abazali bahlele owabo umbhikisho ngaphandle kwesango lesikole, njengoba bengahambisani neyokumiswa kukathishanhloko. "Sifuna incazelo yokuthi eyani incwadi enikwe uthishomkhulu,” usho kanje.Ugcizelele eyokuthi abazali bathi amakhamera awayindawo futhi uthishanhloko bamdinga ebuyile.Owenhlangano engenzi nzuzo, enezinhlelo ezeseka ezemfundo, Ubhaqa Networks, uNksz Phumzile Kubheka, uthe kuyabakhathaza okuqhubeka esikoleni. "Izivivinyo ziyaqala ngoMashi 13. Sekuphele amasonto amabili izingane zithikamezekile ezifundweni zazo. Sikhathazekile ngokuthi yini ezizoyibhala ezivivinyweni osekusele izinsuku eziyishumi ukuthi ziqale,” kusho uNksz Kubheka.Ugcizelele eyokuthi akukho gcobho abawubona kuthishanhloko njengoba enerekhodi elihle ekuholeni isikole."Umatric wesikole usuthole o-100% iminyaka eyisishiyagalolunye ilandelana. Abazali bajabule ngothishanhloko nangobuholi bakhe,” kusho uNksz Kubheka. Usole othisha abathintekayo ngokuphusha eyabo i-"agenda", engahlangene namakhamera abathi yiwo asuse udweshu."Babizwe kaningi ukuthi abeze bazochaza ukuthi kungani bengawafuni, bangeza. Kuthe noma uNgobese esethi kulungile uzowakhipha, bangabuya. Into abayaziyo wukufika njalo ekuseni bayohlala ejoyintini eliseduze kwesikole lapho bedingida khona eyokuphazamisa ukufunda kwezingane,” usho kanje.Kulesi sikole othisha abangu-22, kwabangu-39, balaxaza ukufundisa bedinwa wukufakwa kwamakhamera emakilasini. Kuthiwa uthishanhloko wathi awafakwe ukuze kunqandeke ubugebengu obuqhubekayo esikoleni. Kuthiwa ukufakwa kwawo akuhlalanga kahle kothisha abatelekile njengoba baveza ukuthi afakelwe ukuthi kugadwe bona uma befundisa.Owesigungu esilawula isikole, uNksz Nomonde Matumtum, uthe akukho okuningi azokwazi ukukusho njengoba besazoba nowabo umhlangano. Nokho uthe angakuqinisekisa ukuthi uthishanhloko umisiwe.Abakhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo esifundazweni abathalakalanga njengenjwayelo.
USAZINWAYA amakhanda ngokuthi udalwe yini umlilo obhubhise izihlobo zawo, omunye wemindeni emithathu ebhujelwe abayisishiyagalombili ngoMgqibelo.Ezigamekweni ezimbili ezenzeke ezindaweni ezimbili ezehlukene esifundazweni, kushone abayisishiyagalombili bemindeni emithathu.Emndenini wakwaNoyila eShaka’s Head, KwaDukuza, kushone abayisihlanu. Kubona kukhona uNksz Asamkele Somtsewu (19), umzala wakhe uSonwabise Noyila (14), udadewabo u-Amila (3) kanye nezingane zakhe ezingamawele uSokhula (1) noSolulele (1). Inhloko yekhaya, enguyise ka-Asamkele, uMnuz Sivuyile Noyila, ithe umlilo ugasele ngezintatha kungazelele muntu.Uthe bebekade bezijabulele, kade bebuka ibhola base bedlala i-snooker, kudlalwa nomculo."Izingane nonina basheshe bayolala ngokwehlukana. Mina nabanye bendawo, sihlale kwaze kwashaya o-3 ekuseni, sasesihlukana sebegoduka. Ngithe ngisanda kuzumeka, ngezwa ngezingane zikhala, zingimemeza,” kusho uNoyila. Uthe yena nonina, baphume beyinhlamvu beyobheka ukuthi izingane zidliwa yini. Uthe bebezitshela ukuthi sekungene izigebengu."Sikhangwe umlilo obuvimbanise ngasemnyango. Unina uvele waphonseka phakathi, wabuya neyodwa (2), ayithole itholoza ngaphakathi ifuna indlela yokuphuma,” kusho uNoyila. Uthe lona wesifazane uthe uyabuyela ngaphakathi, umlilo wangabe usamvumela ukuthi acinge ezinye izingane. "Zishe zaze zaphela izingane zami, zibulawa umlilo namanje esingazi ukuthi udalwe yini,” kusho uNoyila.Uthe kubafi bekukhona izingane zakhe ezimbili, abazukulu bakhe abangamawele abazalwa umufi omdala, bese kuba ewumshana wakhe, ezalwa udadewabo. Uthe unina nengane angene wayidonsa emlilweni, baphuthunyiswe esibhedlela ukuyolashwa njengoba nabo beshile. Uveze ukuthi yena nalona wesifazane balala emjondolo ongemuva, kuthi izingane zilale kongaphambili.Uthe umlilo uqale ngasemnyango, wanyuka njalo, waze wayoshaya emsamo."Yiyo le nto eyenza sithi awuqalwanga izimpahla ezisebenza ngogesi. Namanje sisadidekile ukuthi ubangwe yini ngoba sibiyile nesango siyalivala,” usho kanje.
