Kulesi sigameko, kuthiwa umlilo ongaziwa wokhele imijondolo yabafi ngokulandelana. UMphathiswa woMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi ohambele imindeni yomibili izolo, uthe umnyango uzoyilekelela ngalo lonke usizo eludingayo, okufaka phakathi, izinhlelo zokungcwaba.UButhelezi ubuye waveza ukuthi izolekelelwa ngama-alamu akwazi ukusheshe abike uma kukhona intuthu evumbukayo, wathi lokhu kuzosiza ukuhlenga impilo. Uphinde wayalela izisebenzi zikahulumeni ukuba zibambisane, ziqinisekise ukuthi zilungiswe izidingo umphakathi okhale ngazo wathi zenza isimo sibe nzima kakhulu uma kwehla izigameko zalolu hlobo.Phakathi kwezinto ezibalwe umphakathi kukhona amanzi."Ubuhlungu obuzwiwe ile mindeni kukhulu kakhulu, sizoqinisekisa ukuthi asigcini nje ngokuzwelana nayo kodwa sizokwenza okuthile,” usho kanje.
ZIYAQONGA izinkinga zesikole saseMgababa, iMnganiwakhe High okuke kwavela ukuthi sibhekene noxhaxha lwezinkinga ezibandakanya isihlava sokulala kothisha nabafundi.Isolezwe ngeledlule libike kabanzi ngomhlangano ophuthumayo wabazali obubanjelwe emagcekeni alesi sikole wokubhunga ngale ngwadla.Umhlangano awuzange uphele njengoba abazali bawuduba bekhala ngokuthi uqhubeka kanjani uthishanhloko engabonwa kanye nosihlalo wesigungu esilawula isikole, uMnuz Lucky Makhathini, okwavela ukuthi akekho ngoba wahlaselwa wadubuleka engalweni kwashona umshayeli wakhe.Kwaba nemvunge kulo mhlangano abazali bekhala ngokuthi udaba abeze ngalo luyachizelwa ekubeni kuyilona abalubheke ngabomvu.Kodwa okuyikhona okunenga kakhulu abazali manje wukuthi kumile ukufunda esikoleni ngenxa yokuthi kunothisha abevile kwabayisihlanu abangalubhadi esikoleni ngenxa yokuthi babona bengaphephile.Phakathi kothisha abangabonwa kuvela labo ababoshwa amaphoyisa emagcekeni esikole besolwa ngokulala nabafundi, bese kuba yilabo izingane ezazimemeza amagama abo zibuza ukuthi bona basala ngaliphi, phezu kwalokho usanyamalele nothishomkhulu wesikole.Abazali abakhulume neSolezwe balimise ngesihloko elokuthi sebethanda ukunengeka kakhulu manje yizinto ezibonakala ziqhubeka esikoleni.Bathe sekuphele amasonto amabili manje kungafundwa ngenxa yokungabi bikho kwalabo thisha. ''Othisha abangekho iningi labo okuvele ukuthi banukwa ngokulala nabafundi. Abanye bathathwe amaphoyisa kodwa babuye badedelwa, abanye izingane zazimemeza amagama abo ngeledlule zithi nabo kumele baboshwe ngoba bonile. Ngakusasa ababange besabuya esikoleni bonke labo thisha kuze kube yimanje," kuchaza umzali.Abazali bathi ngenxa yokungabi bikho kwalabo thisha akufundwa esikoleni. Babalisa ngokuthi lokhu kuzogcina kuba nomthelela omubi kubafundi baka-matric ngasemaphethelweni onyaka."Sikhathazekile kakhulu ngokwenzeka esikoleni. Abafundi bethu kusho ukuthi bazofeyila phela kuyacaca ngoba njalo bayafika bese bephindiselwa emuva ngo-10 ekuseni ngenxa yokuthi abekho othisha abazobafundisa," kusho omunye umzali.Abazali bathe uma izinto ziqhubeka ngale ndlela kuyacaca ukuthi mkhulu umonakalo osazobonakala esikoleni.''Iqiniso wukuthi umhlangano wangesonto eledlule ayikho nje indaba yawo. Laphayana kwakuzodlalwa nje. Ungawubiza kanjani umhlangano uthishomkhulu engekho?" kubuza omunye umzali.Isolezwe litholile nokuthi abazali bahlongoza isiteleka bafuna ukuthi iphele nya indaba ''yomnikelo owu-R500 okhokhwa abazali njalo uma kuqala unyaka.''Sifuna iphele le nto yalo mnikelo wabo obhedayo esingawazi nokuthi usho ukuthini. Sikhathele sizobhikisha kuze kufike isikhathi sokuthi zilunge izinto esikoleni. Ukuthula kwethu yikhona kanye okuholele ekutheni izinto zigcine sezibhimba kakhulu kunakuqala," kugcizelela omunye umzali.Isolezwe litholile ukuthi zimapeketwane izinto kulesi sikole kangangoba kukhona nasebesongela abanye ngokubayisa kwagoqanyawo.''Kukhona banye asebethembisa ukubulala abanye uma beqhubeka nokungena izindaba zalapha esikoleni. Banamanga-ke, sincamela khona ukufa kunokuthi sibukele kuqedwa ikusasa lezingane zethu," kusho umzali.Phambilini okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Muzi Mahlambi, wathi bazokwenza uphenyo olunzulu ngoxhaxha lwezinkinga okuthiwa zigubuzele lisikole.
IQEMBU leNkatha Freedom Party (IFP) likhiphe isitatimende lidlulisa amazwi enduduzo ngokudlula emhlabeni kwengqalabutho eyayilwa nobandlululo, eyayiyisiboshwa sezombusazwe, futhi yaba ngumsunguli weCongress of the People (COPE), uMosioua Lekota.ULekota, ushonele esibhedlela eGoli ngemuva kokugula isikhathi eside."Iqembu leNkatha lidlulisa ukudabuka okukhulu emndenini wakwaLekota, amalungu e-COPE, kanye nabo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika athinte impilo yabo kuyo yonke le minyaka esebenzela umphakathi kanye nobuholi obunezimiso.UMnuz Lekota wayengumlweli wenkululeko ozinikele owabamba iqhaza elikhulu emzabalazweni wenkululeko waseNingizimu Afrika. Njengesishoshovu esimelene nobandlululo, wabekezelela ukuboshelwa izinkolelo zakhe zezombusazwe," kusho i-IFP ngesitatimende.Ngenkathi yentando yabantu, wasebenzela isizwe kakhulu, okuhlanganisa nokuba nguNgqongqoshe Wezokuvikela kusukela ngo-1999 kuya ku-2008, nanjengoNdunankulu wokuqala waseFree State kulandela ukuguquka kweNingizimu Afrika kuntando yabantu ngo-1994. Amanye amaqembu athumele imilayezo yenduduzo.Umlayezo ovela ku-ANC: "I-African National Congress iyadabuka ukuzwa ngokudlula emhlabeni kukaMnuz Mosioua Patrick Lekota, owayengumholi owasebenzela iNingizimu Afrika ezikhundleni ezehlukene ngesikhathi sangaphambi nangemuva kukahulumeni kwentando yabantu. Ukudlula kwakhe emhlabeni kuphawula ukuhamba komuntu ompilo yakhe yahlangana nezikhathi ezibalulekile emlandweni wezwe lethu kanye nomzabalazo wenkululeko." Umlayezo ovela kamengameli Cyril Ramaphosa: "Mina noMosiuoa Terror Lekota sinomlando omude kwezepolitiki. Ubengumuntu waseNingizimu Afrika ozinikele othanda izwe lakhe futhi ngizoqhubeka nokumhlonipha. Ngidlulusa ukuzwelana kwami okukhulu emndenini wakhe kanye nabathandiweyo bakhe.
ZITHOLWE zigqishwe ethoyilethi lomgodi ngeSonto, izidumbu zabesifazane ababili okusolwa ukuthi babulawe ngokuklinywa nangokugencwa eNdundumeni, eMakhabeleni, eKranskop.Kulesi sigameko okusolwa ukuthi senzeke ezintatha zangoMgqibelo, kubulawe uNksz Nonkasa Shezi (84) nendodakazi yakhe, uNksz Zama Majozi (47).Ngokusho kweNduna yesigodi, uMnuz Mboniseni Nala, engomunye wabafike endaweni yesigameko, ithe uthintwe omakhelwane abangaphesheya komfula ngalo iSonto, abamtshele ukuthi basola ukuthi kukhona okushaya amanzi kwaShezi. "Omunye wabo uthe ake kuyobhekwa kulo muzi njengoba ebona kulokhu kuvaliwe ezindlini, nezinkomo sekuphele izinsuku ezimbili zingakaze zikhishwe ukuya emadlelweni, ekubeni eke wezwa kukhala isaguga ezintatha zangoMgqibelo,” kusho uNala.Kuthiwa owesifazane ozwakale ekhala ubethi: "Ngisizeni ngengane yami”.Uveze ukuthi bavele banikela khona namalungu omphakathi, bathola izicabha zivaliwe, bathi uma belunguza ngamawindi bangabona lutho. "Sigcine sigqekeza umnyango nokuyilapho esibone khona ukuthi kukhona okwenzekile, njengoba bekunegazi kodwa kukhombisa ukuthi lihlanziwe,” usho kanje.Uthe amanye amalungu omphakathi abehlaziya igceke, aqaphele ukubhodloka kwethoyilethi okungaqondakali, ase engena phakathi."Azithele phezu kwengalo ebibonakala. Kwacaca ukuthi kukhona okubi okwenzekile, kwabizwa amaphoyisa,” kusho uNala. Uthe ngesikhathi sezitatululwa izidumbu, baqaphele ukuthi esesaguga sinezingozi ezimbi ekhanda, kwathi esikaNksz Majozi sinentambo ebivale umlomo."Sisola ukuthi isaguga sibulawe ngokugencwa kwathi lo omunye waklinywa,” kuchaza uNala.Uthe indwangu abasolwa abayisebenzisile ukusula igazi, bayishutheke ngaphansi kukamata, wathi basadidekile bewumphakathi ukuthi kungani abafi behlaseliwe. "Asazi noma kukhona okuthathiwe njengoba amaphoyisa engasivumelanga ukuthi sisondele ngaphakathi endlini kanti nezihlobo zabo azikafiki ukuzobheka,” kusho yona induna.Uthe nemfuyo abanaso isiqiniseko sokuthi abasolwa abayithathanga yini njengoba esibayeni bekukhona amathole, ezinye izinkomo eziningana zingekho."Njengoba zingekho, asazi noma zisemadlelweni noma zintshontshiwe. Kuzobonakala ngokuqhubeka kwesikhathi uma sekubhekwa kahle,” usho kanje. Uthe umphakathi usathukile, uzizwa ungaphephile njengoba kungaziwa ukuthi abenzi bobubi abasagcwelwe amathafa, bangobani futhi bakuphi.Umshana kaNksz Shezi, uMnuz Wandi Majozi, uthe bathole ucingo lubaphathele umyalezo ngoshophi ngeSonto.Uveze ukuthi basadidekile ngokuthi bahlaselelweni, babulawa ngesihluku njengoba bebengakaze bababikele ukuthi kukhona okubi abakusolayo. "Ngigcine ukukhuluma nabo ngoLwesithathu, bangabika lutho olubi. Asazi ukuthi lesi sitha sivela ngaphi,” kusho uMajozi. Uthe bebeqala abafi ukungenelwa abantu, bebengakaze bagetshengwe phambilini.Ukhale ngokuthi ufe olwembiza njengoba sekufanele athwale izindleko zomngcwabo wabantu ababili, ekubeni akazi ukuthi uzothathani ahlanganise nani. Uthe bayabufuna ubulungiswa ngesigameko ukuze kuphenduleke imibuzo abanayo kanti nenduna isho okufanayo, yathi umphakathi uhlalele ovalweni njengoba abasolwa besagcwele amathafa.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant Colonel Paul Magwaza, uthe amaphoyisa aseKrankop aphenya amacala amabili okubulala kulandela ukutholwa kwabesifazane ababili bebulewe.
Umsunguli weCongress of the People (COPE) nowayeyisishoshovu senkululeko uMosiuoa Lekota akasekho emhlabeni.Ngokubika kwe-IOL, uLekota oneminyaka engu-77 ubudala ushonele esibhedlela saseGoli ngezintatha zangoLwesithathu, kulandela ukugula isikhathi eside.Uzalelwe eKroonstad eFree State, ubushoshovu bukaLekota baqala eseyisitshudeni Waze waxoshwa -University of the North ngokubandakanyeka kwakhe kwezombusazwe zabafundi kanye neBlack Consciousness Movement.Njengomgqugquzeli weSouth African Students’ Organisation (SASO), waboshwa wathunyelwa eRobben Island ngo-1974. Wakhululwa ngo-1983, waphinde waboshwa ngesikhathi se-Delmas Treason Trial yango-1985. ULekota ngokuhamba kwesikhathi wasebenza njengoNdunankulu waseFree State kanye noNgqongqoshe Wezokuvikela, ngaphambi kokulaxaza i-ANC wasungula i-COPE ngo-2008.
Kudingeke ukuba kuvalwe uthelawayeka u-N2 obheke eningizimu eduze kwefemu yakwa-NPC Cement, eThekwini, kulandela isigameko sokugetshengwa kwemoto yemali ngoLwesithathu ekuseni.Ngokusho kwabe-ALS Paramedics, kudutshulwe onogada ababili, oyedwa wabo walimala kanzima. Indiza enophephela emhlane yakwaNetcare 911 iphuthumise lo nogadw esibhedlela.Okhulumela i-ALS Paramedics uGarrith Jamieson uthe umgwaqo u-N2 obheke eningizimu uvaliwe ukusuka ku-M7 ukuze abasebenzi bezimo eziphuthumayo bafinyelele endaweni yesigameko. "Ngingaluleka abashayeli bezimoto ukuthi bayigweme yonke le ndawo." Amaphoyisa asendaweni yesehlo.
UVELE eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini, owesilisa oneminyaka engu-42, oboshwe ngoLwesihlanu, eCornubia, eVerulam, ngecala lokufuna ngodli imali yokuvikela. Ngokusho kokhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant Colonel Paul Magwaza, bathathu abantu asebebulewe okuthiwa bebesebenza enkampanini yonogada, lona wesilisa abefuna kuyo ngenkani imali yokuvikela.Elandisa ngodaba uMagwaza, uthe kusolwa ukuthi ngoJanuwari nonyaka, umsolwa wahlaba ucingo walubhekisa kumnikazi wenkampani yonogada, wafuna ngodli isamba semali yokuvikela. Kuthiwa wabe esesabisa ngokuthi onogada benkampani yakhe bazophambana nemvula uma engayikhokhi le mali. "Umnikazi wenkampani waqale wangayingena eyokwenza okwakufunwa umsolwa, wavele wayobika udaba esiteshini samaphoyisa i-Durban Central,” kusho uMagwaza. Uqhube wathi ngenyanga efanayo, kwabe sekubulawa onogada abathathu abaqashwe yile nkampani. Uthe izingcingo ebezisabisa umnikazi wenkampani, nazo bezilokhu ziqhubeke njalo. "Lugcine lugoba uphondo, wayifaka ebhange imali ebifunwa kuye ngodli,” usho kanje. Uveze ukuthi ithimba le-Crime Intelligence libe selihlanganisa ulwazi lokuthi umsolwa ukuphi, lase lilwedlulisela kwi-Provincial Task Team kanjalo ne-Durban Metropolitan Police Tactical Team, ukuba basebenze ngalo. "Ithimba ligasele eCornubia (ngoLwesihlanu), zase zimkhalela. Ubekwe icala lokufuna ngodli imali yokuvikela,” kusho uMagwaza. Ube esedalula nokuthi uphenyo ngonogada abathathu ababulawa, luyaqhubeka.
BAKHOLELWA ukuthi uzokwenza omkhulu umehluko ekulweni nobugebengu umkhankaso wokusesha abafundi ezikoleni, abenhlangano eqapha ubugebengu i-eThekwini Neighbourhood Watch.Lokhu kushiwo umsunguli wayo, uMnuz Andile Jali muva nje, kulandela ukuhambela esinye sezikole.UJali uthe zevile eshumini izikole asebezihambele kusukela kuvulwe izikole emalokishini ehlukene enyakatho yeTheku. Phakathi kwezindawo abahambele izikole kuzo, iNanda, Ntuzuma, KwaMashu kanjalo nePhoenix. Phakathi kwezikole asebezihambele ubale iVuyiswa Mtolo High eKwaMashu, Mtapo High eseLindelani, Machobeni High yaseNanda, Delview esePhoenix nezinye.Uthe phakathi kwezinto abazitholayo uma besesha abafundi, inhlamvu yesibhamu esingabulali, izinhlobo ezehlukene zezidakamizwa, izikhali ezifana nemimese nezinto ezicijile."Inhlamvu yesibhamu esiqhumayo kodwa esingabulali sayithola eMzuvele High, KwaMashu. Sathi uma simbuza umfundi ukuthi ifunani inhlamvu esikhwameni sezincwadi, wathi ingene ngephutha,” kusho uJali. Uthe basala bezibuza ukuthi ingabe siphi isibhamu sayo nokuthi esakhe yini? Uthe komunye umfundi bathole isigqabo sezintombi, waveza ukuthi zikhona izingqinamba abazitholayo uma benza le mikhankaso ezifana nabafundi abahongayo, bengafuni ukuseshwa. Uthe kulabo bafundi kuze kusize ukuthi babaqinisele amehlo, ukubakhombisa ukuthi abezile ukuzodlala.Udalule ukuthi uma sebexoxisene nobuholi besikole, bavele bagasele ngezikhathi zokungena kwabafundi, bakanise esangweni, baseshe wonke umfundi ngaphambi kokuba angene esangweni. Amantombazane uthe aseshwa amalungu enhlangano esifazane, kuthi abafana baseshwe ngabesilisa."Kwesinye isikole sithole ukuthi kukhona umfundi obesabise uthisha ngokuthi uzombulala, uthisha waze wamenzela incwadi yokuvikela,” kusho uJali. Uveze ukuthi umfundi ubesexoshiwe esikoleni kodwa kwafika iqembu lepolitiki lazotshela isikole sokuthi asinalo ilungelo lokuxosha umfundi."Lokhu kusixakile ke ukuthi kungani likhulumele umfundi osabise uthisha ngokumbulala, kwaze kwaphoqa ukuthi amtholele incwadi yokuvikela? Sithole ukuthi lo thisha ufundisa kabuhlungu ngoba uyamsaba lo mfundi, okuthiwa usevele wamila izimpiko kakhulu njengoba elekelelwe yileli qembu ukuthi abuye ngenkani esikoleni,” usho kanje.Uthe kwesasePhoenix, abathole kuso umfundi ephethe ummese, bathe uma bembuza, wathi ubezowusebenzisa ukuzivikela njengoba exabane nomunye umfundi waseNanda, omsabise ngokuthi uzobiza igenge yakhe izomfundisa isifundo. Uveze ukuthi bayakholelwa ukuthi njengoba benza le mikhankaso nje, izothela izithelo ezinhle ekuncishisweni kobugebengu njengoba iTheku linenkinga yezingane ezijoyina amaqembu emigulukudu zincane, bese zenza ubugebengu obunyantisa igazi."Uma bazi ukuthi laba omalume bavele bafike esikoleni kungazelelwe, baseshe izikhwama, bazoba novalo lokuphatha izikhali nezidakamizwa esikoleni. Uma impi yobugebengu siyilwa nasezikoleni, umphumela wakhona uzobonakala nasemphakathini,” usho kanje.Uthe baye bakhethe izikole okuthiwa zinabafundi abangezwa, baye kuzo, wathi nokho emva kokuqala kwabo umkhankaso ngoJanuwari, bayazithola izicelo nakothishanhloko bezikole, ukuthi abeze ngoba sikhulu isidingo.Ubalule ukuthi njengoba besahambele inyakatho yeTheku kuphela okwamanje, basezinhlelweni zokusabalala nakwamanye amalokishi abangakafiki kuwona.
IKOMITI lasePhalamende lifuna bahlanze yonke imali abayidle kungafanele, abasebenzi bahulumeni okutholakale ukuthi bayizipoki.Leli komiti loMnyango weziSebenzi zikaHulumeni nokuPhatha lifuna kuqiniswe izinto eminyangweni kahulumeni, ukuze kuqedwe ngenkinga yabasebenzi abayizipoki.Usihlalo wekomiti, uMnuz Jan de Villiers, uthe bayawamukela umbiko odedelwe nguMnyango kaMgcinimafa, oveze ukuthi kuvundululwe abasebenzi ababalelwa ku-4 323, abayizipoki. Uthe lokhu kukhomba inkohlakalo ohlelweni lokukhokhelwa kwabasebenzi baseminyangweni kahulumeni."Besihlale sishaya ikhwelo lokuthi kwenziwe uphenyo ngezipoki kuhulumeni. Lokhu kuvundululwa kwezipoki ezingaka, kubuyisa ithemba futhi kuqinisa ukuqashwa kokusebenza kwezimali zomphakathi," usho kanje.Uthe bafuna laba basebenzi bahlanze yonke imali abayidlile ngenkohlakalo."Sifuna bangagcini nje ngokubuyisa imali kodwa baphinde baboshwe, bashushiswe ngamacala enkohlakalo. Sifuna bagwetshelwe la macala." Unxuse uMnyango kaMgcinimafa noweziSebenzi zikaHulumeni ukuthi isheshise iphothule uphenyo."Asifuni kube nokubambezeleka ngoba kungenzeka ukuthi kusekhona abanye abasekhona kuhulumeni. Imali eningi kwisabelomali iya emaholweni abasebenzi ngakho kumele inkohlakalo isiphulwe nezimpande zayo," usho kanje.Uthe abasebenzi abazohluleka ukuziveza ukuthi bakhona siqu uma kwenziwa ucwaningo, kumele bathathelwe izinyathelo ezinqala."Siyalujabulela nohlelo lokuthi kuphuculwe uhlelo lokukhokhela abasebenzi kuhulumeni ukuze kuqedwe inkohlakalo. Siyakubonga nokusebenzisana kweminyango, okubalwa nowezaseKhaya uma kwenziwa ucwaningo ngezipoki." Esabelwenimali sezwe muva nje, uNgqongqoshe wezeziMali, uMnuz Enoch Godongwana, uveze ukuthi balwa nempi yezipoki kuhulumeni.Uthe bafuna ukuphucula izinto ngokushintsha uhlelo lokukhokhela abasebenzi ukulwa nale nkohlakalo.UDe Villiers uthe bayamukela nemali ewu-R3.7 billion yokugqugquzela abasebenzi bahulumeni ukuthi basheshe bathathe umhlalaphansi. Ngale ndlela kwenziwa imizamo yokwehlisa isabelo esiphezulu sokukhokhelwa kwabasebenzi bahulumeni. "Sifuna ukwazi kodwa ukuthi ikuphi okuzokwenziwa ukuze kungagcini sekuhamba abantu abanesipiliyoni. Asifuni izikhala ezibalulekile zisale zingenamuntu onamava kulowo msebenzi." Iyindaba egudwini eyokugqugquzela abasebenzi asebezothatha umhlalaphansi ukuthi basheshe badede inkundla ukuze kuqashwe intsha engatohozi kuleli. Ngale ndlela kuzokwehliswa isibalo sentsha njengoba kuyibhomu elingase liqhume noma yinini ngenxa yokukhula kwesibalo sentsha engasebenzi kuleli.
AMALUNGU ekomitini lasePhalamende afuna ajeziswe umphenyi wamacala ozimele, uMnuz Paul O'Sullivan, owaphuma engakaqedi ukuphendula imibuzo ngesikhathi evele phambi kwekomiti ngeledlule. Amalungu ekomitini athe ukuvuma kuka-O'Sullivan ukubuya azoqedela ukuphendula imibuzo ngoLwesine akusho ukuthi sekufanele athethelelwe izono zakhe zangesonto eledlule.Akusho lokhu ngesikhathi ehlangene izolo. U-O'Sullivan washiya amalungu ekomiti eveva ngesikhathi ephuma emhlanganweni engagunyaziwe.U-O'Sullivan wathi uphuthuma ukuyogibela ibhanoyi. Ohola ubufakazi ekomitini, u-Advocate Norman Arendse, uthe u-O'Sullivan uvumile ukuvela phambi kwekomiti ngoLwesine lapho ezoqedela khona ukuphendula imibuzo. "Simyalele ukuba asinikeze incwadi azibophezela kuyo ukuthi uzovela ngempela phambi kwekomiti. Uma ehluleka ukwenza lokho sizomthumelela amasamanisi amphoqa ukuthi avele phambi kwekomiti."I-EFF ivele isivulele u-O'Sullivan icala emva kokuba eshiye umhlangano. Kepha umbono wabameli ofundelwe amalungu ekomiti izolo uveze ukuthi kuzokuba wumqansa ukuthathela u-O'Sullivan izinyathelo ngenxa yokuthi wayezifikele ngokuthanda kwakhe ekomitini, wayengathunyelwanga amasamanisi.Yize kunjalo amalungu ekomiti athe afuna kube khona izinyathelo ezithathelwa u-O'Sullivan. Ilungu le-ANC, uNksz Khusela Sangoni, lithe ukuvuma kuka-O'Sullivan ukuvela phambi kwekomiti ngoLwesine akusho ukuthi sekufanele angathathelwa izinyathelo. "Waphula umthetho ngesikhathi ephuma engaqedile ukuphendula imibuzo. Kufanele athathelwe izinyathelo."UNksz Sangoni uthe abavumelani nombono wommeli. "Sibona sengathi ummeli uyikha phezulu incazelo yomthetho uma ethi ngeke sikwazi ukumthathela izinyathelo ngenxa yokuthi wayengathunyelelwanga amasamanisi amphoqa ukuba avele phambi kwekomiti."Ilungu leMKP, uMnuz Sibonelo Nomvalo, lithe kufanele afundiswe isifundo u-O'Sullivan."Uma uvele phambi kwekomiti ulandela imiyalelo kasihlalo wekomiti, awenzi umathanda. Kufanele u-O'Sullivan akwazi lokho."Ilungu le-EFF, uNksz Leigh-Ann Mathys, lithe ngoba kukhona icala asebelivulile kungaba ngcono uma iPhalamende lingaletha incwadi efungelwe eyeseka icala abalifakile.Usihlalo wekomiti, uMnuz Soviet Lekganyane, uthe uzomazisa uSomlomo wePhalamende, uNkk Thoko Didiza, ukuthi amalungu ekomiti afuna athathelwe izinyathelo u-O'Sullivan."Ngizomtshela usomlomo ukuthi amalungu ekomiti awaneme futhi afuna ukuthi kube khona izinyathelo ezithathwayo. Ngizolindela impendulo kasomlomo bese siyabona ukuthi yiliphi igxathu elilandelayo esizolithatha."
UMENGAMELI Cyril Ramaphosa uzovula ngokusemthethweni imifuziselo yezigidi zamarandi esuse imvunge eThekwini.URamaphosa uzovula umfuziselo wowayengumengameli, uMnuz Nelson Mandela nowowayengumholi we-ANC, uMnuz Oliver Tambo, ngoLwesibili.Umfuziselo kaMandela usenkundleni yezemidlalo iMoses Mabhida, bese kuthi okaTambo wona useNorth Beach. Le mifuziselo bekufanele ivulwe ngoLwesihlanu, kodwa kwabuye kwashintshwa izinhlelo ngenxa yokuthi uRamaphosa uya emngcwabeni woMfundisi waseMelika, uJesse Jackson, ngempelasonto.Ukwakha le mifuziselo engu-9 wamamitha ubude kudle u-R22 million.Imali esetshenziswe ukwakha imifuziselo isidale imvunge ikakhulu emaqenjini aphikisayo emkhandlwini. Amaqembu aphikisayo akhala ngokuthi umkhandlu ubeka phambili izinto ezingenasidingo kodwa uyehluleka ukusukumela izinkinga okubalwa kuyo neyamazi ehlasele izindawo eziningi eThekwini.Omele i-DA embangweni wesikhundla semeya kuMasipala waseThekwini, uMnuz Haniff Hoosen, usanda kubhalela uRamaphosa incwadi emcela ukuba ayicabangisise indaba yokuvulwa kwemifuziselo.UHoosen ucele uRamaphosa ukuba azokhuluma ngenkinga yamanzi esikhundleni sokuzovula imifuziselo. Uphonsele inselelo uRamaphosa ukuba asebenzisele uhambo lwakhe ukuthola kabanzi ngezinkinga ezikhungethe umkhandlu."ITheku libhekene nenkinga yamanzi. Kulinganiselwa ukuthi u-60% wamanzi uphelela emhlabathini ngenxa yamapayipi amadala avuzayo. Kunenkinga yamapayipi athutha indle. Nginxusa ukuthi ubize umhlangano nobuholi bomkhandlu. Ukubizwa kwakho umhlangano kuzokhombisa ukuthi uyafuna ukuba kutholakale isixazululo kulezi zinkinga ezibhekene neTheku."IMeya yaseThekwini, uMnuz Cyril Xaba, yakuvikela ukusetshenziswa kwezigidi zamarandi kwenziwa imifuziselo. Ekhuluma nabezindaba ngeledlule, uXaba wathi imifuziselo izoheha izivakashi, wathi into eyenze ukuthi ibe nkulu imali esetshenzisiwe ukuthi imifuziselo yakhiwe eChina.Isitatimende esikhishwe yiHhovisi likaRamaphosa sikhombisa ukuthi akezukugcina ngokuvula imifuziselo ohambweni lwakhe lwaseThekwini. Okhulumela iHhovisi likaMengameli, uMnuz Vincent Magwenya, uthe uRamaphosa uzophinde ahlangane nethimba alijube ukuba lilekelele kuMasipala waseThekwini."Ithimba laqokwa ngo-2024, ukuba lilekelele odabeni lokuhanjiswa kwezidingo, ukulungiswa kwengqalasizinda, ukuthuthukisa umnotho nokuphathwa ngendlela kwemali yomkhandlu. Kulo mhlangano kuzokhulunywa ngebanga eselihanjiwe negxathu elilandelayo. Umhlangano uzohanjelwa abaholi abaqhamuka ezinhlakeni ezahlukene."
Kushone oyedwa kwathi omunye uphuthunyiswe esibhedlela kulandela ingozi enyantisayo eyenzeke ku-N2 ngaphandle kwase-Ermelo, ngaphambi kokuthi ufike eCamden.Abezimo eziphuthumayo kudingeke ukuthi basebenzise amasaha nemishini yokugaya ukuze bakhulule umuntu obevaleleke kule ngozi. Imizamo yabo yokuthola labo abathintekayo idale ukuphazamiseka okukhulu kwezimoto endaweni. Kwesinye isigameko, izimoto zishayisane ku-N2 eduze kwesango elingenela eMkhondo.Imbangela yengozi ibingakacaci okwamanje. Kunxuswa abashayeli ukuthi bashayele ngokucophelela
ISIVUNGUVUNGU esihlasele i-NFP esizindeni sayo, kwaNongoma, siqubula imibuzo ngokuthi ngabe seliya ngomutsha wendoda yini kuleli qembu elahlubuka kwi-IFP ngo-2011.Imiphumela yokhetho lokuchibiyela obelukuMasipala wakwaNongoma ifanele ukubakhathaza abaholi be-NFP abavele batutshwe yimibango yangaphakathi. I-NFP iye okhethweni lwangoLwesithathu ikhungethwe yizinkinga eHlalankosi kulandela ukusula ubuthaphuthaphu kwamakhansela aleli qembu. Igcine lilale isithathu kulolu khetho, yathola amavoti angu-192.I-NFP isale kude le kwi-IFP enqobe ukhetho ngamavoti angu-1 113. I-NFP inomlando kule ward, njengoba yanqoba ngo-2021 yize owayeyimele okhethweni, uMnuz Dumisani Qwabe, wayengasekho. UQwabe wasocongwa sekusondele ukhetho.Kwabe sekuba nokhetho lokuchibiyela, i-NFP yaphinde yanqoba ngamalengiso.Okhethweni lokuchibiyela lwango-2022 i-NFP yanqoba ngo-44.85%.Imiphumela yangoLwesithathu iqubule imibuzo yokuthi sebeshonephi laba bantu abavotela i-NFP ngo-2021 nango-2022.Leli qembu muva nje likhungethwe yizinxushunxushu ezisusa ungabazane ngokuthi kukhona yini elizobuya nakho okhethweni lohulumeni basekhaya oluzayo. Indawo yakwaNongoma iwumthambo wokuphila kwiNFP. Kulapho yacosha khona amavoti amaningi kakhulu ngokhetho lohulumeni basekhaya lwango-2021. Leli qembu elasungulwa uNkk Zanele Magwaza-Msibi laba namakhansela angu-14.Empeleni amavoti amaningi eNFP ngo-2021 aqhamuka esifundeni iZululand. Amanye amavoti aqhamuka kuMasipala waseDumbe, nokuwukuphela kukamasipala ewuphethe KwaZulu-Natal. NakuMasipala wasoLundi i-NFP yazama njengoba inamakhansela ayisikhombisa.Nangesikhathi iNFP iqala ukungenela ukhetho ngo-2011, yagila izimanga eZululand. Yanqoba umasipala wesifunda kanye noMasipala wakwaNongoma nowaseDumbe.Uma uzobuka imiphumela yokhetho lwango-2021 kwacishe kwavalwa ngehlahla kwi-NFP uma ungezukuwabala amavoti eyawathola komasipala abangaphansi kwesifunda iZululand.I-NFP yabuya ilambatha komasipala abangaphezu kuka-30.Le nhlangano yangena sekuvalwe amehlo komasipala abangaphansi kweshumi, lapho inamakhansela ngalinye. Le miphumela iveza ngokusobala ukubaluleka kweHlalankosi kanye nesifunda iZululand ekuphileni kwe-NFP.Akungabazeki ukuthi nakuba iNFP yathola isihlalo esiShayamthetho KwaZulu-Natal ngokhetho lwango-2024, kungenxa yamavoti aqhamuka esifundeni iZululand. Kodwa kulezi zinsuku kuxabene ubendle kwiNFP kwaNongoma nasesifundeni iZululand jikelele. Mahlanu amakhansela e-NFP asanda kwesula kwaNongoma. Ngeledlule kwesule amakhansela amabili. Abashiyile yiloyo owayeyimeya, uMnuz Mshangane Ndabandaba noMnuz Kaiser Dladla, abesule ngosuku olulodwa. Abapholisanga maseko oNdabandaba noDladla, bajoyina i-MKP ngeledlule.Laba baholi besula nje, iNFP ibivele isazikhotha amanxeba kwaNongoma kulandela ukwesula kwamakhansela amathathu okubalwa nekhansela laku-ward 17.Kusazoba nokhetho lokuchibiyela ku-ward 7 no-20 lapho kwesule khona amakhansela. Lolu shintsho lweneke obala impi yangaphakathi kwiNFP ebilokhu idudulana isinyelela.Ubuholi obukhona buqale bahlakaza izinhlaka zobuholi esifundeni iZululand. Buzame ukuxosha kaningi amakhansela okubalwa kuwo uNdabandaba nemeya kaMasipala waseDumbe, uMnuz Sibusiso Mkhabela. Ngaphambi kokuthi uNdabandaba esule esikhundleni iqembu belihlela ukumdiliza ekubeni yilungu lesigungu esiphezulu kuMasipala wakwaNongoma. Kunencwadi ebonwe yiSolezwe, lapho ubuholi besikhashana be-NFP kwaNongoma buphakamisa ukuthi kungene uMnuz Simphiwe Gazu. Izimpi kwiNFP azikho kwaNongoma kuphela. Iqembu like lazama ukuxosha iPhini leMeya kuMasipala waseThekwini, uNksz Zandile Myeni.Kulezi zinsuku uMphathiswa wokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi, uNksz Mbali Shinga, uhlezi ngesinqe esisodwa esiShayamthetho. UNksz Shinga usanda kubizelwa phambi kwekomiti lokuqondiswa ubugwegwe. Usolwa ngokushaya indiva umyalelo weqembu wokuba eseke isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli. Umlando weNFP uma kunokhetho I-NFP yafika kwezwakala ngesikhathi kunokhetho lohulumeni basekhaya lwango-2021.Kwakungokokuqala ukuba ingenele ukhetho kodwa yaphenduka ababeki benkosi njengoba lalingekho iqembu elaliphumelele ngamalengiso komasipala abaningi baKwaZulu-Natal. I-NFP yaqoma ukubambisana ne-ANC komasipala abangu-19 baKwaZulu-Natal. Emva kokhetho iNFP yaphatha omasipala ababalulekile kwi-IFP, uMasipala wesifunda iZululand kanye nowakwaNongoma.Okhethweni lukazwelonke lwango-2014 iNFP yathola izihlalo eziyisithupha ePhalamende. Umholi weqembu, uNkk Zanele Magwaza-Msibi, waqokelwa esikhundleni sokuba yiPhini likaNgqongqoshe wezeSayensi.Okhethweni lohulumeni basekhaya lwango-2016 iNFP yehlelwa yinhlekelele njengoba ingakwazanga ukungenela ukhetho ngenxa yokwehluleka ukukhokha ngesikhathi imali yokungenela. Okhethweni lukazwelonke lwango-2019 kwabhimba uhlelo yathola izihlalo ezimbili ePhalamende kanjalo nasesiShayamthetho KwaZulu-Natal. Okhethweni lohulumeni basekhaya lwango-2021 iNFP yanqoba uMasipala waseDumbe kuphela.Okhethweni lukazwelonke lwango-2024 iNFP yathola isihlalo esisodwa esiShayamthetho KwaZulu-Natal, ayitholanga lutho ePhalamende.
KUQALE phansi ukuqagela ngekusasa lobuholi be-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, emva kokugqigqa kulandelana esifundazweni kwethimba eliholwa uNobhala Jikelele wenhlangano, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula.Ithimba labaholi be-ANC kuzwelonke liphinde lahambela KwaZulu-Natal kule mpelasonto, lapho lihlangane khona nobuholi bezifunda.Leli thimba belihambele esifundazweni ngempelasonto yangoFebhuwari 21, lapho luqale khona ngokuhlangana nethimba lesikhashana elihola i-ANC eKZN. Okususe ukuqagela ngohambo lwabaholi be-ANC ukuthi uMbalula wayethe ithimba lizohlakazwa ngenyanga eyedlule. Wakusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma ngoDisemba, lapho aveza khona ukungenami kwakhe ngalo ithimba.UMbalula wakhala ngokuthi ithimba liyahluleka ukwenza umsebenzi walo waze walifanisa nemoto iTazz. Ithimba elikhona linamalungu angaphezu kuka-60. UMbalula walimisa ngesihloko elokuthi leli thimba lizohlakazwa kuphinde kuqokwe ithimba elincane okunelikhona.Okhulumela i-ANC kuzwelonke, uNkk Mahlengi Bhengu-Motsiri, akazange afune ukuphumela obala ngesikhathi ebuzwa ngekusasa lobuholi baKwaZulu-Natal.UNkk Bhengu-Motsiri uthe abakanqumi ukuthi lizohlakazwa yini ithimba."Okwamanje sisalalele izethulo ezenziwa abaholi be-ANC ezifundeni. Emva kokulalela izethulo, sizohambisa umbiko ozodingidwa ikomiti elibhekelele ukusebenza kwansuku zonke kwi-ANC nesigungu esiphezulu. Yebo, siyazi ukuthi sesiphelile isikhathi sethimba. Kungenzeka sinqume ukulula isikhathi salo. Ngabe ngiyagagamela uma ngingase ngivele ngilimise ngesihloko elokuthi ithimba lizohlakazwa ekubeni kukhona nethuba lokuthi kululwe isikhathi." Ithimba lalikade linikezwe izinyanga eziyisishiyagalolunye ukuba lihlele ingqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi besifundazwe kanye nezifunda.Ithimba lahluleka lancama ukuhlangabezana nalo mnqamulajuqu wangoNovemba, labe selilulelwa isikhathi kuze kube ile nyanga. Ithimba elikhona lihlela ukuba kube nezingqungquthela zokukhetha ubuholi ngenyanga ezayo.Kepha kunamahlebezi okuthi leli thimba lizohlakazwa zingakafiki izingqungquthela zokukhetha ubuholi nokungase kubambezele izingqungquthela. Umthombo weSolezwe kule nhlangano, uthe ukuqokwa kwethimba elisha kungasho ukuthi kufanele kuqalwe phansi izinhlelo zokulungiselela izingqungquthela."Uma ubheka kahle isikhathi sesidliwe yinja njengoba kunokhetho lohulumeni basekhaya kuwo lo nyaka. Ukuhlakazwa kwethimba elikhona kungasho ukuthi izingqungquthela seziyoze zibanjwe emva kokhetho lohulumeni basekhaya. Kufanele uqale maduze umkhankaso wokhetho. Ingqungquthela ingaphazamisa umkhankaso wokhetho ngenxa yokuthi amalungu e-ANC axabana wodwa uma kunezingqungquthela, abahlulwayo bajwayele ukuduba inhlangano."
KUGQAME eyokusilela emuva ekuhanjisweni kwezidingo kubantu, inkohlakalo edla lubi, inkemane ebhekene nemiphakathi ehlukene, ngesikhathi kugujwa uSuku lwamaLungelo Abantu ngempelasonto.Lolu suku lwasuselwa esigamekweni lapho kwabhubhiswa khona abamashi abangu-69 ababekhala ngomthetho wokuphathwa kwamapasi, abadutshulwa ngamaphoyisa kahulumeni wobandlululo, eSharpeville, eGauteng, ngoMashi 21, 1960.USihlalo weKhomishini yamaLungelo kuleli, i-South African Human Rights Commission, uMfundisi Chris Nissen, uhlabe ikhwelo kubantu ukuthi baqhubeke bazifune izidingo zabo kuhulumeni. Uthe lolu suku lugujwa ngesikhathi kukhunjulwa iminyaka engu-30, kwabhalwa uMthethosisekelo wezwe."Abantu kumele bawufunde baphinde bawazi uMthethosisekelo ukuze bafune izidingo zabo emakhanseleni, kwizimeya, kumalungu ePhalamende nakuhulumeni. Abantu kumele bazithole izidingo zabo, kuqedwe eyendlala njengoba umbiko uveza ukuthi baningi abantu abasabhuqwa yindlala. Baningi futhi abangazitholi izidingo okumele ngabe bayazithola okubalwa amanzi nezinye." UMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, ekhuluma emgubheni walolu suku eKimberley, eNorthern Cape, ukhale ngenkohlakalo wathi iphundla izidingo kubantu. Uxwayise ngokuthi labo abazibandakanya nenkohlakalo kukhona okusina kubajeqeza. "Abezomthetho basemkhankasweni wokulwa nenkohlakalo. Inkohlakalo isihlava okumele sisiqede ezweni ngoba siphuca abantu okungokwabo. Sisezithendeni zalabo abasaqhubeka nenkohlakalo," usho kanje.Uzwakalise ukukhathazeka ngezithinta indlala esabhuqa abantu kuleli kodwa wathi zikhona izinhlelo uhulumeni azenzayo ukulwa nale nkinga."Bevile ku-9 milion abafundi abadlayo nsuku zonke ezikoleni ngaphansi kohlelo lokuhlinzekwa ngokudla nguhulumeni. Babalelwa ku-29 million, abantu bakuleli abangasebenzi, abadala, abahlwempu, abaphila nokukhubazeka, abahlomula kwizibonelelo zikahulumeni," usho kanje. Uthe babalelwa ku-80% abantu abathola amanzi ahlanzekile, wathi baxhasa ngemali yokufunda mahhala izitshudeni ezevile ku-800 000 ngonyaka ezikhungweni zemfundo. Uveze ukuthi uhulumeni akakwazi ukwenza yonke into eyedwa ngakho udinga ukubambisana nomphakathi."Sidinga ukubambisana kwezinhlaka ezehlukene, kusuka kosomabhizinisi, abasebenzi ukwakha amathuba emisebenzi. Lokhu kuzosiza ekutheni abantu baphume ebubheni." Uphinde wanxusa nokubambisana empini yokulwa nobugebengu, udlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane kanjalo nokulwa nezidakamizwa. Umgqugquzeli we-PAC KwaZulu-Natal, egubhe lolu suku eMlaza, uNksz Nqobile Shongwe, unxuse intsha ukuthi ibe yingxenye yemigubho efuze le ukuze iqonde ibanga elihanjiwe ekuzuzweni kwenkululeko kuleli.Ukhumbuze abebehambele lo mgubho ukuthi abantu abaningi bashona ngenxa yokulwa nohulumeni wobandlululo, wathi intsha kumele iqhubeke nokuyibamba ishisa. I-MKP ithe lolu suku luyisikhumbuzo sezinto ezibuhlungu ezenziwa nguhulumeni wobandlululo, ubulala abantu ngoba bezwakalisa ukungahambisani nomthetho wangaleso sikhathi.
BAKHATHAZEKILE osihlalo bamakomiti emali ePhalamende, ngomthelela ozoba kuleli ngempi ephakwe yiMelika ne-Israel, e-Iran.Osihlalo bathe le mpi izoba nomthelela ekunyukeni kokudla, nezinto zokugibela.Usihlalo wekomiti lemali ePhalamende, uDkt Joe Maswanganyi, uthe: "Asikwazi ukuhlala sithule, sithi ngeke isithinte impi eseMiddle East ngoba nathi iyasithinta. Izoba nomthelela kwezithinta u-oyela, okuzonyusa imali yokugibela kanjalo nezinto zasendlini ezifana nokudla, nezinye." Uthe izoba nomthelela nasemnothweni kanjalo nakowamazwe ahweba nelakuleli.UDkt Mmusi Maimane weqembu iBOSA, uvumelene noMaswanganyi, wathi umthelela uzoba mkhulu kakhulu kuleli ngenxa yale mpi."Kumele kugxekwe ukuhlaselwa kwamazwe azimele. Kubalulekile ukuzimela kwezwe, lingacindezelwa amazwe amakhulu," kusho uMaimane.
ABASHAYELI bazovuka kusasa sebekhokha imali ethe xaxa ngokwetha izimoto zabo kulandela isimemezelo soMnyango wokuMbiwa Phansi sokuthi intengo kaphethroli nodizili iyanyuka.UMnyango umemezele ukuthi intengo yazo zombili izinhlobo zamalitha kaphethroli u-93 no-95 izonyuka ngo-20 cents.Intengo yelitha likadizili u-500ppm izonyuka ngo-62 cents kuthi eka-50ppm inyuke ngo-65 cents.Lokhu kuqeda injabulo kubashayeli njengoba ezinyangeni ezedlule intengo ibilokhu yehla ilitha likaphethroli laze laba ngaphansi kuka-R20 ezindaweni ezigudle ulwane.Ngo-Ephreli, kulindeleke ukuthi kungene uchatha entengweni kulandela isimemezelo sikaNgqongqoshe wezeziMali uMnuz Enoch Godongwana sokunyusa intela.Ngesikhathi ethula isabelomali sakhe ePhalamende eKapa, ngesonto eledlule, uGodongwana umemezele ukuthi intela ebizwa nge-general fuel levy, okuyimali efakwa esikhwameni sikaMgcinimafa, izonyuka ngo-9 cents ilitha likaphethroli no-8 cents kwelikadizili.Kusho ukuthi ekaphethroli isizoba ngu-R4.24 ilitha kuthi elitheni likadizili ibe ngu-R4.10.Uphinde wamemezela ukunyuka ngo-7 cents kwentela yesikhwama esinxephezela abalimala ezingozini zomgwaqo i-Road Accident Fund (RAF).Lokhu sekuzoyenza ibe ngu-R2.25.Njengoba kuqhubeka ukugadlana phakathi kwe-Israel, United States of America ne-Iran, kuthiwa lokhu kungase kunyuse intengo kawoyela nokungaba nomthelela kwekaphethroli.
ISHIYE kumapeketwane emazweni amaningi impi ephakathi kwe-Iran neMelika, yaze yathinta neNingizimu Afrika.Amazwe amaningi okubalwa kuyo neNingizimu Afrika, aphazamisekile ngenxa yempi eqhubekayo.Lapha eNingizimu Afrika kuphazamiseke ukuhamba kwamabhanoyi futhi kuvela ukuthi kunabantu bakuleli abavaleleke emazweni athelwe amachaphazelo empi, okubalwa nedolobha elijwayele ukuvakashelwa kakhulu abakuleli, iDubai. IMelika yesekwa elakwa-Israel kule mpi. Impi ephakathi kwe-Iran neMelika ithathe elinye igxathu kule mpelasonto njengoba kubulewe umholi wase-Iran, uMnuz Ayatollah Ali Khamenei.Izindaba zokushona kukaKhamenei, ziqinisekiswe izolo ekuseni.UKhamenei ushone emva kokuhlasela kweMelika ehhovisi lakhe.Ngaphambi kokuthi kubulawe uKhamenei, i-Iran ibikade ihlasele izikhungo zamasosha aseMelika ezisemazweni angomakhelwane bayo, okubalwa kuwo i-United Arab Emirates, Qatar, Saudi Arabia namanye. I-Iran imemezele ukuthi uKhamenei uzozilelwa izinsuku ezingu-40, yasonga ngokuziphindiselela.UMengameli waseMelika, uMnuz Donald Trump, uthe i-Iran izokubona okwagibeza ikati emthini uma ike yazama ukuziphindiselela.Inhlangano yezamazwe omhlaba, i-United Nations, iyigxekile impi eqhubekayo. Unobhala we-UN, uMnuz António Guterres, unxuse amazwe alwayo ukuba abeke phansi izikhali.UMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa naye ukhuze impi eqhubekayo.URamaphosa uthe impi eqhubekayo ibeka engcupheni impilo yabantu futhi ingase iphazamise nomnotho.
I-IFP ibona ezobhekana nomqansa amaqembu afuna ukugudluza uNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli.Ngakolunye uhlangothi, iqembu eliphambili emizamweni yokugudluza uNtuli iMKP, lona libona sekusele kancane ukuthi lo mholi asuke esikhundleni.La maqembu akusho lokhu ngesikhathi ephawula ngenkulumo ngesimo sesifundazwe eyethulwe uNtuli. I-IFP ithe inkulumo kaNtuli izokwenza lube umqansa uhambo lwabaphikisa ubuholi bakhe.Okhulumela i-IFP esiShayamthetho, uDkt Andile Biyela, uthe uNtuli uchaze kabanzi ukuthi usekephi nokufeza izethembiso ayezenze enkulumweni yangonyaka odlule."Wayekade ethe uzobhekana nodaba lwabantu bokufika abakuleli ngokungemthetho nodlame lwezobulili. Sibonile ukuthi lehlile izinga lobugebengu KwaZulu-Natal. Wayekade ethe uzofaka imali eningi kwezemfundo. Nangempela sibonile isifundazwe senza kahle emiphumelweni ka-matric. Ulethe umbiko ophelele ngasekwenzile nokuzokwenza ukuthi kube nzima kwabaphikisayo." Okhulumela iMKP esiShayamthetho, uMnuz Siphiwe Moyo, uthe bazophinde bafake isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNtuli, wathi inkulumo yakhe ibashiye bedumele."Ngesikhathi ngilalele inkulumo kaNdunankulu waseGauteng (uMnuz Panyaza Lesufi) ngezwa ebeka amaqhinga akhe. Angizange ngiwezwe amaqhinga ngesikhathi ngilalele inkulumo kaNtuli. Ingakho sizophinde sifake isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bakhe."UNtuli wethule inkulumo yakhe ngoLwesihlanu, eMgungundlovu. Uncome ukukhula komontho wesifundazwe. Uthe umnotho wesifundazwe ukhombisa ukudlondlobala kulandela ukuphazanyiswa izibhelu zokuzitapela zango-2021 kanye nokubheduka kobhubhane iCorona."Umnotho ukhule ngo-1.8%. Nakuba ungakhulanga ngendlela ebabazekayo kodwa ukukhula kwakamumva kusiqinisa idolo njengoba umnotho ubulokhu ungakhuli kahle."Uveze ukuthi abatshalimali bazibophezele ukutshala u-R100 billion esifundazweni. Uthe inqwaba amathuba emisebenzi adalekile kodwa wathi kusadingeka amathuba emisebenzi angu-400 000 ukuze kwehle izinga lokungasebenzi.Amaqembu abusa ngokubambisana ayishayele ihlombe inkulumo kaNtuli.Umholi we-DA esiShayamthetho, uMnuz Francois Rodgers, uthe lizokwehla izinga labantu abangasebenzi uma uhulumeni wesifundazwe uzoqhubeka ngegiya ohamba ngalo."Umnotho wesifundazwe uyaqhubeka nokukhula, asiyi emuva. Okungijabulisayo ukuthi ubeke amaqhinga okukhulisa umnotho okuwukwakhiwa kwengqalasizinda, umnotho wasolwandle nokusebenzisana nabatshalimali." Ilungu le-ANC, uMnuz Siboniso Duma, lithe inkulumo kaNtuli ithinte izihloko eziningi ezibalulekile okubalwa ukwakhiwa kwengqalasizinda, ukuqashwa ngokugcwele konompilo, ukuqashwa kosonhlalakahle nokuphuma phambili kwesifundazwe emiphumeleni ka-matric."Uyabona naye ukuthi akathathanga uhulumeni ofadabele, ezinye zezinto azificile zenziwa uhulumeni obuphethe. Iqiniso siyazi ukuthi sisuka kude. Ukwazile ukuthi akhulume ngeqiniso ukuthi simiphi njengesifundazwe."
UMPHATHISWA wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal, uMfundisi Thulasizwe Buthelezi, usethumele amathimba abhekelele izinhlekelele kuMasipala wasoPhongolo kulandela isiphepho esinamandla esihlasele izingxenye ezithile zale ndawo ntambama.Cishe ngo-16h00, izindawo zasoPhongolo, ikakhulukazi kuWadi 11, okuyindawo esedolobheni, zibe nemvula ehambisana nomoya onamandla. Lesi siphepho, esithathe imizuzu engaba ngu-30, siholele ezikhukhuleni zasendaweni, kwawa izihlahla futhi kwalimala nempahla yomphakathi. Imigwaqo eminingi ibivalwe isikhashana izihlahla eziwile, okuhlanganisa nomzila kazwelonke u-N2.Amathimba abhekelele izinhlekelele, esebenzisana noMasipala wendawo oPhongolo, asebenzise ngokuphazima kweso ukuze asuse imfucuza futhi avule imigwaqo ethintekile. Nakuba kusacutshungulwa ubukhulu bomonakalo ophelele, bekungakabikwa ngabantu akukho abashonile noma abalimele.
UKHIHLE isililo wacela uxolo nakugogo wakhe umfundi ka-matric ogixabezwe isigwebo seminyaka engu-20 ngecala lokubulala unina ngoba ebheke imali yefa.U-Amahle Ngcobo (18), obengummangalelwa wokuqala kuleli cala, ugwetshwe iminyaka engu-20 ebhadla jele kanye nommangalelwa wesibili ababekade bethandana naye ngesikhathi sesigameko, uNhlakanipho Shange (19). Ngesikhathi kusocongwa umama ka-Amahle, kuvelile ukuthi laba ababili babefunda u-matric.Kuthiwa babephambili ngesikhathi kubulawa umufi, uNkk Buhle Chiliza (52) esigamekweni esenzeka ngoNovemba 21, 2024, eFolweni.Kuvelile lukuthi umufi wayesebenza eqashwe ngokugcwele enkantolo yaseManzimtoti. Bazama ukufaka izicelo zebheyili kodwa inkantolo yabachitha.Enkantolo kuvele ukuthi u-Amahle walaxaza leli soka lakhe wase ejola nomunye wesilisa oyinyanga nomdala kunaye, uMnuz Sithembiso Kunene.Ezitatimendeni ezifundiwe, uKunene kuthiwa nguyena owakha itulo lokuba kubulawe umufi ukuze kutholakale imali yefa. Uyena futhi uKunene okuthiwa waqasha uShange nabanye ukuze bayobulala umufi.UKunene waboshwa wabuye wadedelwa ngenxa yokushoda kobufakazi obumyamanisa necala. Kuthiwa ngelanga lesigameko u-Amahle uyena owabavulela umnyango ebusuku ukuze bangene benzakalise unina. Sebengenile ngaphakathi, u-Amahle naye waba mdibimunye nabo begwaza bephindelela unina wasala nenqwaba yamanxeba amabi esifubeni.Ngemuva kwalokho kuthiwa bakhalelwa ngamasango kaSigonyela. Izolo enkantolo yaseChatsworth kufundwe izitatimende zika-Amahle noNhlakanipho ezifungelwe lapho bebezivumela khona ukuthi babulala umufi.Kuvelile ukuthi kube nesivumelwano esibe khona phakathi koMbuso kanye nabameli babamangalelwa ukuthi balivume icala ukuze kugwemeke isigwebo sikadilikajele.IMantshi uNkk Dlamini ilalele izitatimende ebezifundwa abameli babo ngakho konke okwenzeka ngosuku lwesigameko.Ngemuva kwalokho iMantshi ibe seyibabuza ngamunye ukuthi kuyiqiniso yini ukuthi izitatimende zenziwe yibona bavuma.Ibabuzile nokuthi abazange yini bazenze bengaphansi kwengcindezi ethile noma bephoqiwe, bathi akunjalo, kube yinto nje esuka ekujuleni kwezinhliziyo zabo.Ngemuva kwalokho iMantshi ithe akukho okuningi engakusho, iyavumelana nesigwebo abameli nohlangothi loMbuso abavumelane ngaso okuyiminyaka engu-20 bebhadla ejele ngecala lokubulala."Ngenxa yokuthi sekukhona isivumelewano esikhona phakathi kwalezi zinhlangothi, akukho okunye esingabuye sikwenze. Kodwa iqiniso lithi leli cala libucayi kakhulu futhi ngokujwayelekile liba udilikajele,'' kuchaza yona.Ichaze leli cala njengelinesisindo ngenxa yokuthi kukhona umphefumulo owaphuma womuntu ongenacala, yathi phezu kwalokho ebulawa yingane yakhe.Ngemuva kokuba iMantshi isikuqinisekisile ukugwetshwa kwabo uvele wakhihla isililo u-Amahle. Umndeni wakhe ubukhona enkantolo umphathele nokudla.Ngaphambi kokuba ehle eyoqala impilo yakhe entsha ezikhindini, ukhulume nogogo wakhe wezwakala ethi: "'Gogo ngiyaxolisa uyezwa, gogo ngiyazisola,''.Ubesho kanjena ehlanganise izandla ekhombisa ukuzisola.Ugogo uphendulile wathi: "Kulungile mzukulu, thula ungabe usakhala-ke manje, uyezwa.'' Bahlukane kanjalo wehla umzukulu, wasala ekhala naye ugogo obedondolozela ngenduku.Isolezwe licele ukukhuluma naye ugogo ka-Amahle wathi akathandi ukuphawula. Nokho ushilo ukuthi uyamthethelela umzukulu wakhe ngenhliziyo emhlophe ngephutha alenza.Kuvelile ukuthi uMbuso usezithendeni zomunye umsolwa ongungqondongqondo wetulo laleli cala eligwebe ababili.
BAVUTHA bengabaselwe abazali babafundi besikole saseMgababa, uMngani Wami High, bekhala ngedimoni lothisha abasolwa ngokuzitika ngocansi nabafundi.Bathi lokhu sekubami emphinjeni manje futhi kumele kuphele nje nya, ngale kwalokho basonge ngokuthi isikole sizovalwa thaqa singaphinde sisebenze.Laba bazali bakhulume neSolezwe, izolo, ngesikhathi behambele umhlangano obukade ubizwe kusona lesi sikole. Kuhlalukile ukuthi inhlosongqangi yawo bekungukuzobhunga kabanzi ngoxhaxha lwezinkinga ezisigubazele.''Sesikhathele manje yilo doti owenziwa ngothisha kulesi sikole. Lapha siletha izingane zethu bona bamane babone amakhosikazi abo. Sifuna iphele nje nya le nto manje," kubhoka omunye umzali.Kunanele omunye wabiza othisha abenza lokhu ngezichwensi, wathi bayefana nje nabadlwenguli. ''Kusho ukuthi impela izingane zethu uma zize lapha zisuke zizofundiswa ukuthi kuyiwa kanjani ocansini. Akukwazi phela ukuthi iminyaka eminingi kangaka singakhala ngento eyodwa kodwa kungenzeki lutho," usho kanjena.Ezinkundleni zokuxhumana alipheli igama lalesi sikole, kukhulunywa ngale nkiyankiya abazali abayifanisa nedimoni uqobo.''Asazi ngampela ukuthi liphumaphi leli dimoni. Abanye baze basabise izingane zethu ngokuthi zizofeyila uma zingalalanga nabo. Yinto enjani nje leyo?" usho kanjena umzali.Emhlanganweni wayizolo, kusukume iPhini likasihlalo wesigungu sesikole, uMnuz Sqongqwane Msomi, lachazela abazali ukuthi izinto zimapeketwane.UMsomi uthe esakhuluma bamhhahhameza abazali, bebuza ukuthi kungani uthishomkhulu nosihlalo wesigungu esilawula isikole bengabonwa emhlanganweni?Abanye abazali bebememeza betshela uMsomi ukuthi bona into abayizele lapha ukuthola ukuthi kungani othisha bezitika ngezingane?UMsomi ukhulume ngomunye uthisha okuthiwa umisiwe ngoba esolwa ngokulala nabafundi, waphazamiseka ngenkathi kutheleka abafundi iningi obekungamantombazane bememeza bethi uMsomi usenga ezimithiyo uthi zizele.Laba babafundi balimise ngesihloko elokuthi uthisha (omisiwe) ubhecwa ngobende inyama engayidlanga ngoba kunguyena ophambili ekukhuzeni othisha abasolwayo.Kuwona lo mhlangano kuvele ukuthi kunothisha ababili abakhalelwe ngamasongo kaSigonyela ngeledlule beboshelwa icala elimayelana nokulala nabafundi. Iphoyisa elingagunyaziwe ukukhuluma nabezindaba likuqinisekisile lokhu, lathi omunye uvele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMbumbulu, ngoMsombuluko.Isolezwe libe nengxoxo nabafundi abakuvumile ukuthi othisha bayalala nabo. Bapende isithombe esicacile bha sokuthi le nto ijwayelekile nje kulesi sikole.Abanye bebechaza okuningi nokulala nothisha kodwa bese bekuveza ukuthi lokhu bebekwenza ngoba bebona kahle ukuthi uma bengakwenzi bebengakutholi ukufunda ngokuthula.Ngeledlule, Isolezwe litholile ukuthi kube nemashi yabafundi bekhala ngalesi sihlava bekhononda nangokumiswa kukathisha abakholwa ukuthi kudlalwa ngaye ngoba elwela ukuthi uphele umkhuba wokulalwa kwabo.Abazali bawudubile umhlangano bekhala ngokuthi abawubizile babonakala bedukuza oswini.Abanye abafundi bahlebele Isolezwe ukuthi kunabanye abafundi abaduve emakhaya ngenxa yokuthi bancamela lokho kunokuba balale nothisha.Omunye walabo bafundi obhadle ekhaya, ukhulume neSolezwe esekhaya wakuqinisekisa ukuthi nebala usekhaya."Ngeke mina ngize ngiyivume le nto yokulala nothisha, kungamane kukhulunywe indaba yokuthi ngiyasishiya kwasona isikole," usho kanjena.Kuningi okunye okuvelile okunenga abazali njengoba bekhale nango-R500 abawukhokhiswayo obizwa ngokuthi umnikelo kulesi sikole.Abazali bebememeza amagama othisha okuthiwa balandwe ngamaphoyisa, bethi ababadingi ukuthi baphinde bababone emagcekeni esikole. Maphakathi nomhlangano bebememeza bebuza ukuthi baphi abanye othisha, kungani bengekho nabo emhlanganweni?Isolezwe litholile ukuthi usihlalo wesigungu esilawula isikole, uMnuz Lungani Makhathini, ubengabonwa kulo mhlangano ngoba udubulekile ngesikhathi kuhlaselwa imoto yakhe, kwashona umshayeli wakhe.Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Muzi Mahlambi, uthe bazoluphenya lolu daba. Ukhale nangokuthi kubuye kube lukhuni satshe ukubhekana nezimo zalolu hlobo ngenxa yokuthi othisha kuyenzeka bagijime bayogqiba abazali ngemali nangezimbuzi zenhlawulo.
USOLA ukuba phambili ekulweni nobugebengu njengomnyombo wokubulawa kwelungu lawo ngoLwesibili ebusuku umndeni waKwaSonyongwane, eMzimkhulu.Kuvela ukuthi umufi uMnuz Zakhele Thusi (45) uhlaselwe ngabantu abangaziwa esendleleni ebuyela ekhaya bamdubula esemotweni. Isolezwe lithole ukuthi umufi ubephambili njalo uma kuliwa udaba lobugebengu obehlukene kule ndawo.Umfowabo kamufi, uMnuz Zwelibanzi Thusi, uthe bafe olwembiza ngokubulawa komfowabo. Ubabaze isihluku njengoba ethe bebengakulindele ukuthi ngisho kuthiwa uyabulawa usengaze abulawe ngokudutshulwa pho."Ibuhlungu kakhulu le nto esehlele lapha ekhaya. Kusiphatha kabi kakhulu ukubulawa kukamfowethu ngale ndlela abulawe ngayo. Siyazibuza siyaziphendula ukuthi kungani bekhethe ukuthi bambulale," echaza.Udalule ukuthi umfowabo uzibangele amazinyo alushelelezi ngokuba yifolosi ekulweni nobugebengu obehlukene endaweni. Uthe wake wahlala naye phansi umufi wambonisa ngokuthi kumele kungabi nguyena ophambili ngoba lokho kungagcina kumdonsela amanzi ngomsele.Uthe ubenawo umuzwa wokuthi lokhu kuzogcina kwenzekile ngelinye ilanga. Uveze ukuthi yingakho wake wahlala phansi nomfawobao wambonisa kodwa kwefana nokuthi umane uthela amanzi emhlane wedada nje.''Ngeshwa elikhulu umfowethu ubengasiyena umuntu okulula ukuba umguqule umqondo ikakhulukazi uma leyo nto esesithathile isinqumo sokuba uyayenza. Ngakhuluma naye kwaze kwaba amahlandla amane kodwa kufana nje nokuthi ngizichithela isikhathi,''echaza.Eqhuba uthe kwala noma esekhuluma naye ngemuva kokuba esesinde kaningana edutshulwa kodwa kwefana nje umfowabo wamphendula ngokuthi isosha lifela emsebenzini walo. Uveze ukuthi nomfowabo omdala kunabo bonke wayenza imizamo yokuhlala phansi nomufi amkhombise ubungozi bento azifaka kuyona kodwa naye uthi wabuya echaya izandla ethi ugadle zephuka. ''Nomfowethu omdala naye wakhuluma naye kodwa naye wabuya wazongitshela ukuthi uhlulekile. Waze wathimisa amagama okuthi uyazisola nanokuthi uke waqalelani kwakhona ukukhuluma naye,''echaza.Mayelana nokuthi bakhona yini abantu ababasolayo ngokufa kukamfowabo uphendule ngokuthi abasoli bayazi ukuthi abambulele yilabo obekubanenga ukusukuma kukamfowabo elwela nobugebengu endaweni.Uthe kodwa bazofingqa imikhono benze konke okusemandleni ngenhloso yokuqinisekisa ukuthi bakhalelwa ngamasongio kaSigonyela abenzi bokubi. Uveze ukuthi ekuqaleni bekuke kwadlanga ubugebengu bokwebiwa kwemfuyo kwabuye kwadamba, nalapho uthe umufi wayephambili. Nokugqekezwa kwemizi nakhona uthe kuke kwadlanga.Amaphoyisa aKwaZulu-Natal akuqinisekisile ukubulawa kukaThusi. Athe amaphoyisa aseMzimkhulu aphenya icala lokubulawa komuntu ngokudutshulwa.
ZIVUTHA zingabaselwe izinduna zasoFafa, eXobho, ngodaba lweNkoisi yakule ndawo, uVela Dalicebo Ndlovu (35) eziyisola ngokuphenduka umlutha wezidakamizwa kanye nokuthunaza isithunzi sendawo ngokukipita.Isolezwe likhulume nezinduna zakule ndawo zalimisa ngesihloko elokuthi sezikhathele zona manje yindaba yenkosi. Zicele ukuba agodlwe amagama azo. Eyokuqala ithe iyichilo impilo ephilwa yinkosi.''Okusicasula kakhulu ngaphezu kwezinto zonke wukuthi inkosi sekuphele isikhathi eside kakhulu ikipitile kubo kwentombi. Abazali bentombi banele bashona nje ayiphindanga yaphuma emagcekeni akubo kwayo. Ubani nje ongama avezele umhlaba wonke ukuthi yena uholwa yinkosi ekipitile. Yihlazo leli futhi elikhulu kabi," kusho induna.Kunanele eyesibili yakuhlaba yakuhlikiza konke okwenziwa yinkosi. Eqhulwini ikhale ngokuthi seyiphenduke umuntu ohlale egqoke izingubo ezizodwa futhi inezimpawu zokungazinaki.''Kwaba yishwa elikhulu kabi ukuthi lapha kuthiwe lo muntu onjengalona uyinkosi yethu. Siswele wona impela nje umgodi wokucasha. Ayikho phela le nto," isho kanjena.Iqhuba ithe okubanenga kakhulu wukuthi ngenxa yempilo ephilwa yinkosi inkantolo yesizwe ayisakwazi ukuthetha amacala nokwenza eminye imisebenzi.''Kuyimanje maningi kabi amacala amile esingeke sikwazi ukuthi singaqhubeka nawo ekubeni inkosi ingasazihluphi nhlobo ngokuza emihlanganweni," kuchaza induna.Iqhuba uthe bagcina ukubona inkosi enkantolo yesizwe ngoJanuwari ngonyaka odlule. Emva kwalokho ithe bayayifunga njengoba kuthiwa iye ibonakale kubo kwentombi kodwa futhi emva kwalokho akekho owaziyo ukuthi inyamalala iyephi.''Mfowethu lapha ngikutshela mina ngomuntu oke ahlale erenki azibhemele nje kungabi ndaba zalutho. Abantu bakule ndawo abasamhloniphi bazibonela imihlola," usho kanjena.Isolezwe likhulume namanye amalungu omphakathi alimise ngesihloko elokuthi aseqala ukukhathazake kakhulu manje ngendlela izinto ezibonakala zihamba ngayo kule ndawo ngenxa yokuthi inkosi isigxile ekubhemeni nasotshwaleni.''Akusiyona nje nhlobo inkosi lena esinayo lapha umuntu nje ongazazi ukuthi ufuna ukwenzani ngabantu abaholayo. Kubuhlungu kakhulu ukuthi kume yonke into esizweni ngenxa yomholi okumele ngabe uyena kanye osinikeza umhlahlandlela kodwa yena ubonakala edidekile kakhulu," kusho ilungu lomphakathi.Abanye bakhale ngokuthi isitembu sesizwe inkosi yabambisa ngaso ukuze ithole okokubhema. ''Ngambuza ukuthi isitembu sesizwe siphi wathi wabambisa ngaso efuna ukuthola okokubhema," kuchaza omunye osemkhandlwini wayo inkosi ocele ukuba ligodlwe igama lakhe.Uthe bahlela ukuyosilanda isitembu sesizwe endaweni okudayiswa kuyona izidakamizwa edolobheni eXobho.Uthe bahlela ukuyosilanda ngendlovu iyangena."Sathola ukuthi ukuze kubuye lesi sitembu kumele inkosi iyikhokhe yonke imali eyikweletayo," echaza.Isolezwe likhulume nonina omdala wenkosi, uNkk Thokozile Ndlovu, owake wabamba isihlalo sobukhosi. Uvumile ukuthi indodana iyaphuza inenkinga yezidakamizwa wathi njengomzali kumphatha kabuhlungu kakhulu lokho.Mayelana nokukipita kwenkosi uthe akwaziyo wukuthi lapho inkosi ihlala khona akusikhona kubo. Okuningi uthe akathandi ukukhuluma ngakho.Ebuzwa ukuthi uyazi yini ngokubambezeleka kwamacala ngenxa yenkosi engasalubhadi enkantolo uthe akukho angakaphawula ngalokho. Inkosi kuvele ukuthi akulula ukuthi itholakale ngenxa yokuthi yalahla iselula.Okhulumela uMnyango wokuBusa nokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu Natal, uMnuz Senzelwe Mzila, uthe udaba bazoluphenya ukuze bathole umnyombo walo.

AMACIKO abhala futhi ahaye izinkondlo azothola ingqayizivele yethuba lokubhoboka ngakho konke okuwahlupha emoyeni nokwenza aphelelwe umdlandla - kangangokuthi amanye awo - agcine eshiya phansi ubuciko, agxile kweminye imikhakha.Lokho kuzokwenzeka embuthanweni ohlelelwe ukubhunga ngezinkinga ezihlupha amaciko nomphakathi jikelele obizwa ngokuthi Ikhefu With Mbali Malimela, ozoba ngeSonto, langoMashi 15, eSantosa Coffee eMorningside, eThekwini, kusukela ngo-10 ekuseni.Engxoxweni ekhethekile neSolezwe Ngempelasonto, umbhali futhi oyimbongi, uMbali Malimela waseDududu, uthe umcabango walo mbuthano wamfikela ngenkathi efake isiqeshana senkondlo yakhe esihloko sithi Ikhefu, okwathi ingangena kwiTikTok - kwanda abantu abakhala ngokukhathala, bezwakalisa nokuthi impilo ibakhathaza kangakanani. "Kwangikhathaza emoyeni ukuzwa abantu abaningi bekhala ngokukhathala, kangangokuthi kukhona nabebelibeka ngembaba elokuthi bafisa ngisho ukufa imbala ukuze baphumule nje ngokuthula. Lokhu kwenza ngakhumbula ukuthi nalana kwezobuciko sibheke nenkinga efanayo yozakwethu abagcina besala endleleni ngenxa yezimo ezihlukene ezithiya ukusebenza kwabo. Ngibe sengifisa ukuthi kube khona ukwakha isithangami lapho esizobhunga khona ngalezo zimo ezenza sizizwe kanjalo empilweni,” kusho uMbali. Eqhuba, uthe lo mcimbi uhlose ukusiza ngawo kakhulu amaciko esifazane ngoba ekholwa wukuthi yiwona abhekana nezimo eziningi ezenza ukuthi aphazamiseke endleleni yawo yobuckiko futhi usebone kaningi kuba yiwona okuthi uma ephazamisekile ngandlelathize kungabe kusaba lula ukubuya ngamandla, aqhubeke namakhono awo ezobuciko. "Ngenkathi ngifaka isicelo sokuxhaswa ngabesikhwama esixhasa imisebenzi yobuciko, iNational Arts Council, nokuyibona ababambe iqhaza elikhulu ekutheni lo mbono uqhubeke manje, ngakuveza ngokusobala ukuthi ngihlose ukusiza kakhulu amaciko esifazane ukuthi athole ithuba lokubhodla nokubhoboka ngezimo ezihlukene eziwahluphayo endimeni. "Nokho akuzukuphelela lapho futhi njengoba ngifisa nokuthi lo mbono uqhubeke ube wusizo nasebantwini nje emphakathini ngoba ngiyazi ukuthi sibaningi kakhulu esibhekene nezimo ezenza kube lula ukuthi umuntu aphose ithawula empilweni, engithemba ukuthi leli thuba lizokwenza umehluko wokunqanda ukudloba isimo sokudikibala esinaso,” kulandisa yena. Kulo mcimbi uMbali uzobe engahambi yedwa, njengoba kuzoba khona ozakwabo kule ndima okubalwa kubona imbongi uSindiswa Zulu, uLuleka Mhlanzi naye obhala futhi ahaye izinkondlo, kube wuDemima Nokusa Buthelezi ozobe enzisa futhi ecebisa izethameli izindlela zokukhulula nokusabalalisa umqondo, kube wumeluleki wezengqondo uTholinhlanhla Dlamini-Ngcoya, imbongi uMthuthu Ndebele nomculi uMandisa Cebekhulu. Leli ciko lidalule nokuthi okunye okuhlabahlosile okuzokwenzeka kulo mbuthano wukuthi lizokwethula ngokusemthethweni incwadi yalo yokuqala yezinkondlo zesiZulu esihloko sithi Ikhefu: Awulidingi Yini Ikhefu? - nayo equkethe umyalezo ohambisana nokuzobe kudingidwa.Lithe lilindele izithameli eziphakathi kwa-50 kuya ku-80 kulo mcimbi kanti abafisa ukuba khona bengathenga amathikithi eQuicket ngo-R300 lilinye no-R500 elihambisana nencwadi.Ngale kweKhefu, uMbali usezifake ezinhlizweni zabaningi abakhonze ubuciko ngomcimbi wakhe waminyaka wezinkondlo nomculo othi Poetry on The Lawn. Ngale kwalokho, waziwa nangenkondlo yakhe ethi Isibeletho futhi usesebenze namaciko ehlukene okubalwa kuwona uGubhela, Mzukulu, Nkosazana Daughter uNontokozo Mkhize neMalumz on Decks.

I-airspace ephethe izindaba zabagibeli abaningi bamazwe ngamazwe kunanoma iyiphi ihabhu emhlabeni ibe mnyama namhlanje ekuseni ngenza yokuhlasela kwezindiza zempi zase-Iran endiza phakathi kwayo. Abe-Emirates bakiphe umlayezo ophuthumayo beveza ukuthi umsebenzi usumisiwe akunyakazi lutho. Ezinye izinkampani ezimile ukusebenza yi-Etihad, iQatar Airways. Kumiswe zonke izindiza eziya noma ezibuya eDoha ngemuva kokuvalwa kwe-airport yaseQatari. I-Air India. Ayikho neyodwa indiza ehambela i-Middle East yonke. Kumiswe unomphela izindiza zaseTurkey. Izindiza ezimisiwe eziya e-Bahrain, Iraq, Iran, Jordan, Kuwait, Lebanon, Oman, Syria, Qatar, nase-UAE kuze kube okungenani ngoMashi 2. Lufthansa. I-Dubai imisiwe. Air France. I-Tel Aviv ne-Beirut zimisiwe. Wizz Air. I-Israel, i-Dubai, i-Abu Dhabi, ne-Amman imisiwe kuze kube nguMashi 7. I-British Airways. Abathintekile. I-Virgin Atlantic, Japan Airlines abathintekile. INorwegian Air, LOT Polish, Scandinavian Airlines, Aegean, Iberia, Air Arabia, PIA, Saudia, Air Algerie, wonke awathintekile.I-Dubai akusona nje isikhumulo sezindiza, iyona ndawo enkulu kunazo zonke emhlabeni esetshenziselwa ukuxhuma endaweni ase-Asia, i-Europe, i-Afrika kanye ne-Middle East. Zonke izindiza ezisuka eMumbai ziya eLondon, zisuka eSingapore ziya eFrankfurt, zisuka eNairobi ziya eNew York ezidlula eGulf manje sezikhanseliwe, ezinye zibambezelekile, noma zizosebenzisa uphethiloli owengeziwe ukushintsha imizila.
ZIVUNDULULE i-laboratory okukhiqizwa kuyo izidakamizwa eChatsworth, eThekwini, izinhlaka ezehlukene zamaphoyisa ngoLwesithathu.Ngokusho kwamaphoyisa, lezi zinhlaka zifaka phakathi oKlebe, Metro Police Drug Team kanjalo neSAPS KZN Crime Intelligence.Amaphoyisa aqinisekise ukuthi abophe umsolwa wesilisa oneminyaka engu-32 ngamacala ayamaniswa nokuhweba ngezidakamizwa, okuvela ukuthi ubhadanywe ngaphakathi kule ndawo. UWarrant Officer Sibu Ncane okhulume nephepha eliwuzakwabo weSolezwe, i-The Mercury endaweni yesigameko, uthe amaphoyisa abelokhu esola ukuthi le ndawo ine-laboratory ekhiqiza izidakamizwa. "I-laboratry ingasemuva kwendlu kanti inemishini emincane ekhombisayo ukuthi isetshenziswa ukukhiqiza izidakamizwa,” kusho uNcane.Uqhube wathi babuye bathola neminye imishini yokubala imali kanjalo nempahla yokupakisha izidakamizwa, waveza nokuthi phakathi kwezidakamizwa ezitholwe amaphoyisa kukhona ne-cocaine, wathi bebengakwazi ukubalula ukuthi izidakamizwa ezitholiwe ngezenani elingakanani. Amaphoyisa asola ukuthi kukhona ezinye izidakamizwa ezihanjiswe namanzi ethoyilethi.Kukholakala ukuthi lena enye yezindawo eziphethwe abantu abayiqoqo okusolwa ukuthi basabalalisa izidakamizwa ezindaweni ezifana noMhlanga, Pinetown kanjalo neChatsworth. Khonamanjalo: Amaphoyisa abophe abasolwa ababili abaneminyaka engu-38 no-55 eLamontville, izolo, ngecala lokutshala insangu nelokuhweba ngayo. Ngokusho kokhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant Colonel Paul Magwaza, lokhu kuze emva kokuthi abakwasidlodlo bebambe indawo ebhekene nesikole emgwaqweni uNgobese kule ndawo.UMagwaza uthe uphiko lwamaphoyisa, iLamontville Social Crime Prevention, olunohlelo lwalo lokuvakashela izikole, ngoLwesithathu luqaphele okusolisayo kule ndawo eseduze kwesikole."Bathe uma beyophenya, bathola ukuthi labo ebebekule ndawo bebedayisela abafundi izidakamizwa. Bathe uma beqhubeka nokuphenya, bathola ukuthi kule ndawo kunendawo okutshalwe kuyo insangu,” kusho uMagwaza. Uthe phakathi kwezinto ezitholwe ngamaphoyisa endaweni yesigameko, kube yizihlahla zensangu, imishini yokuhlanza umoya, ama-extractor fan, izitsha zokupakisha insangu kanjalo nebhodi elibhalwe imiyalelo.Uthe amaphoyisa abe esebiza ochwepheshe be-forensic ukuba basondele nganeno, ukuzosebenza indawo yesigameko.Uthe abasolwa bazovela eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini, namuhla.
USOMABHIZINISI waseThekwini, uMnuz Calvin Mojalefa Mathibeli, unqunyelwe ugwayi katiki ukuba angaphinde asabalalise ezinkundleni zokuxhumana izinsolo zokuthi uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uGeneral Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, ukhohlakele, uxhaphaza isikhundla sakhe futhi ubamba iqhaza ekubulaweni kwabantu okungekho umthethweni.Lokhu kuvele eNkantolo eNkulu yaKwaZulu-Natal ezinze eThekwini izolo ngesikhathi ikhipha incwadi evimbela uMathibeli ukuba angabe esasho lutho ngoMkhwanazi.Lesi sinqumo sikhishwe yiJaji J Hlatshwayo kulandela izitatimende ezenziwe nguMathibeli ezinkundleni zokuxhumana futhi nasengxoxweni abenayo kwiNewzroom Afrika lapho ebebheca khona uMkhwanazi ngokuthi wayalela ukuba abulawe ngoba enezinhloso ezithile afuna zifezeke.UMkhwanazi waya enkantolo ngokwakhe siqu, ephikisana nalezi zitatimende ethi zingamampunge, ziyamhlambalaza futhi zilimaze isithunzi sakhe emphakathini njengenhloko yamaphoyisa kulesi sifundazwe. Inkantolo ilalele ummeli kaMkhwanazi, u-Advocate Muzi Sikhakhane SC, yezwa nezethulo zakhe lapho ethi inkulumo kaMathibeli ibeka uMkhwanazi njengomuntu oyisigebengu futhi oyisisebenzi somphakathi okhohlakele oxhaphaza amandla.Inkantolo ivumile ukuthi umfundi noma umbuki walezi zitatimende engazihumusha njengezithinta ubugebengu, ukungathembeki nokubulala okungekho emthethweni.UMathibeli uvumile ukuthi wazenza lezi zitatimende kodwa waphika ukuthi wayeziqondise kuMkhwanazi, wathi kodwa ziyiqiniso, wayezenza ngoba zithinta umphakathi futhi ziqhumbusa ithumba.Ukuphikisile ukuthi lolu daba luyaphuthuma, waveza ezinye izinsolo ezithinta uMkhwanazi esezisabalele emphakathini. Inkantolo ikuchithile lokho, yathi ummangalelwa wehlulekile ukuveza ubufakazi obesekela izinsolo zakhe.Inkantolo ithe yizinsolo ezibucayi ezithinta inkohlakalo nokubulawa kwabantu ezenziwa ngaphandle kwesisekelo futhi ezilimaza isithunzi nokuzethemba emphakathini.
LIDUTSHULWE lafa ngesikhathi liqeda kufika kubo iphoyisa lesifazane okuthiwa belisebenza esiteshini samaphoyisa iPoint, eSouth Beach, eThekwini.Ngokusho kokhulumela iReaction Unit South Africa (Rusa), uMnuz Prem Balram, umufi, okuthiwa ubengumphenyi, ubulawe ngoyaba lwezinhlamvu esigamekweni esenzeke e-Oakford, eVerulam. Uthe abeRusa bathole ucingo lubabizela endaweni yesigameko, luthi sekudutshulwe iphoyisa leSouth African Police Service (SAPS). "Onogada banikele endaweni yesigameko. Ngesikhathi befika, bathole owesifazane osekhulile ehleli ngaphandle kwendlu ngasekhishini. Umakhelwane ubakhombe ngaphakathi endlini, bazithela kumufi edindilize phezu kwegazi phakathi kwekhishi negumbi lokuphumula,” kusho uBalram.Uqhube wathi ubenenqwaba yamanxeba okudutshulwa, kwatholwa inqwaba yamagobolondo ezinhlamvu zohlobo lwe-9mm endaweni yesigameko.Uthe ngokusho kwabazibonele, umufi ufike emzini kanina ehamba ngemoto iBMW 320D emhlophe emizuzwini embalwa ngaphambi kokuba kwenzeke isigameko. "Kuthiwa isicabha semoto ubesishiye sivuleke kancane njengoba ebehlisa igilosa, eyifaka ngaphakathi endlini. Kuvela ukuthi kuvele kwathushuka abesilisa ababili, bamlandela bangena endlini, emva kwalokho kuzwakale sekuqhuma isibhamu,” usho kanje.Uthe emva kwalokho, abasolwa babe sebephuma endlini, babaleka ngemoto eyi-SUV emhlophe. Kuthiwa unina wephoyisa, oveze ukuthi konke lokhu kwenzeke ephakathi endlini, utshele abeRusa ukuthi indodakazi yakhe ibisebenza esiteshini samaphoyisa esisePoint. "Lona wesifazane osemdala wehlulekile ukusho eminye imininingwane ngoba ubebukeka esethukile,” kusho uBalram.
EHLILE kancane amaphaphu emphakathini waseMzomusha, KwaBester, eNanda, kungatholakali muntu endlini obekusolwa ukuthi yambozwa amanzi inabantu phakathi ngesikhathi kunezikhukhula ngoLwesihlanu olwedlule.Lokhu kushiwo omunye wabakhahlamezekile, uNksz Slindile Ndumo, ngesikhathi ekhuluma neSolezwe izolo.UNksz Ndumo uthe nakuba bekungekho zidumbu ngaphakathi endlini, basakhathazekile ngabaniniyo njengoba namanje bengakaze baqhamuke. Sinovalo lokuthi kungenzeka ukuthi njengoba bengatholakele nje ngaphakathi endlini, mhlawumbe babambeke odakeni, njengoba bebengantanti nasemanzini ngesikhathi esavimbanisile,” kusho uNksz Ndumo.Uveze ukuthi akukho msebenzi wokutakula oqhubekile izolo njengoba kungekho basebenzi bakahulumeni abaifikile bezokhuculula udaka."Sasibatshelile ngokukhathazeka kwethu ngalaba esingababoni. Nayizolo (esho ngoLwesithathu) sibatshelile ngokukhathazeka kwethu kodwa akukho abakwenzile njengoba bevele bahamba emva kokukhipha wonke amanzi. Akukho-ke okunye esingakusho ngoba sibatshelile,” usho kanje. Uthe bahlela ukuzicingela abadukile ngokwabo bewumphakathi.Uveze ukuthi ikhansela lifikile lathembisa ukuthi bazothathwa bayohlaliswa eflethini elisenkabeni yeTheku ngesikhathi kusalungiswa eyokuthi kufakwe amanzi nogesi kolindela babo abaseTafuleni, eNanda. Nokho uthe bakhathazekile ukuthi kuzo zonke lezi zinhlelo, izothiwani eyezingane zesikole ezifunda ezikoleni ezikule ndawo. Uveze ukuthi namanje basaludinga usizo, abangazi ukuthi bazophendukela kubani ukuze baluthole."Asinakudla okutheni. Sagcina sithole lokhu okuncane esakuzanyelwa uNkk (Sibongile) Khawula. Sidinga ukudla, insipho yokukhuculula izindlu zethu nezimpahla ezingcoliswe amanzi, izinto zokugeza kanjalo nendawo yokuhlala njengoba sisacushiswe abantu abangakhahlamezekanga endaweni,” kusho uNksz Ndumo. UMphathiswa woMnyango wokuHlaliswa kwaBantu, uMnuz Siboniso Duma, uthe angaphezu kuka-230 000 amalitha amanzi ampontshwe kule ndawo.
