Isusiwe, amanzi ageleza,” kusho uDuma.Uthe bangu-47 abantu okukhona kubo nezingane, abakhahlanyezwe yilesi simo. Laba bayingxenye yemindeni eyisishiyagalolunye, ekhahlamezeke ngqo. "Baseqhulwini kithina njengoba abakwa-South African Weather Services (SAWS) beqagela ukuthi kuseza imvula enamandla ngoMashi nango-Ephreli,” kusho uDuma.Uthe baxoxile ngalolu daba noNgqongqoshe wokuHlaliswa kwaBantu kuzwelonke uNksz Thembi Simelane kanjalo neMeya yeTheku, uMnuz Cyril Xaba.Uthe phakathi kwezinto abafisa ukuzicacisa wukuthi imindeni emibili kuleyo ekhahlamezekile inazo izindlu ezakhelwe wumnyango, wathi le eminye eyisikhombisa, ayibona abanikazi bezindlu ezicekelwe phansi yizikhukhula. "Njengoba isazophinde ine imvula,abazimisele ngokususwa endaweni, bazoyiswa eTafuleni. Umasipala usheshisa eyokufaka ugesi, amanzi nengqalasizinda yokuhanjiswa kwendle kolindela,” usho kanje.
BAYAVEVA abasebenzi abangaphansi kwesikhwama i-Government Employees Medical Scheme (GEMS), abakhala ngokuthi lesi sikhwama sabashaya ngemfe iphindiwe ngesikhathi sifika njengoba sabathembisa izulu nomhlaba kanti siyabalutha.Lokhu kuvele embhikishweni obuseThekwini, obuholwa yizinyunyana eziyingxenye yomfelandawonye weCosatu obusemahhovisi e-GEMS kuleli dolobha. Nakuzwelonke lezi zinyunyana bezimasha zikhalaza ngokuthi azihambisani nokunyuswa kwemali yilesi sikhwama.UNobhala wenyunyana yothisha iSadtu esifundazweni, uNksz Nomarashiya Caluza, uthe abasebenzi babaxwayisa ngesikhathi kufika lesi sikhwama sigasela ezikoleni, ukuthi bangashiyi ama-medical aids ababeyingxenye yawo. Uthe i-GEMS yaheha abasebenzi ngokuthi bazokhokha imali encane futhi bazothola izinto ezikhala kahle."Manje i-GEMS ayenzi le nto eyayithembisa abasebenzi ngesikhathi iqala ukusebenza. Sasibaxwayisile abasebenzi ukuthi bangashiyi ama-medical aids abo, njengoba iSadtu ingazange isayine ukuthi iyayamukela i-GEMS," usho kanje.Uthe manje abasebenzi bakhala mihla namalanga ngokuthi lesi sikhwama sibabamba inkunzi."Uma ungase uye ekhemisi manje, ungafika utshelwe ukuthi imali yakho isiphelile kodwa kube kusaqala unyaka. Lezi ngezinye zezinto ezenza abasebenzi bakhale nge-GEMS." Uthe bafuna kubuyekezwe isinqumo sokunyusa imali ngo-9.8%, ekuqaleni konyaka. Ngenyanga edlule lesi sikhwama sehlise imali esinyuse ngayo isuka ku-9.8% yaya ku-9.5% kodwa abasebenzi bayayichitha le mali."Sifuna kubuyekezwe ibhodi lalesi sikhwama, kuphenywe nangemihlangano eminingi ebanjwe amalungu aleli bhodi ukuze azihlomulise. Inhloso yama-medical aids ukusiza amalungu, hhayi ukwenza inzuzo," kusho uNksz Caluza.Uthe uma abalesi sikhwama bengahlangabezani nezimfuno zabo, bazonxenxa amalungu ukuthi aye kwamanye ama-medical aids, uhulumeni aqhubeke nokuwaxhasa noma esephumile kulesi sikhwama."Lesi sikhwama sikhona ngenxa yethu, ngaphandle kwethu ngeke sibekhona. Ngakho kumele sibhekele abasebenzi futhi sihambisane nezimfuno zabo." UNksz Nandipha Mabandla owamukele uhlu lwezikhalazo zabasebenzi, uthe izikhalazo uzozidlulisela ezinhlakeni ezifanele zalesi sikhwama.Akuzona izinyunyana ezingaphansi kweCosatu kuphela ezilwa nokunyuswa kwe-GEMS kodwa nezingaphansi komfelandawonye iFEDUSA, zikhala esifanayo. Ne-PSA ihamba emazwini alezi zinyunyana, zonke zilwa impi eyodwa. I-FEDUSA neCosatu bathe bathola izeluleko zezomthetho ngokunyuswa kwemali ekhokhelwa le medical aid. Lezi zinyunyana zixwayise ngokuthi lukhulu luyeza luyanyelela uma abe-GEMS beqhubeka nokuqinisa amakhanda.Ngakolunye uhlangothi, i-GEMS igcina ukuphefumula ngalolu daba, yakhala ngokubhubhudlwa, ukuxhashazwa nenkohlalalo eyenziwa abasebenzi okwenze kwanyuka imali ye-medical aid.
ISUSE impikiswano imifuziselo yabaholi be-ANC ka-R22 million evulwe uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa eThekwini, izolo.Amaqembu aphikisayo abebhikisha, ezwakalisa ukungahambisani kwawo ngokwakhiwa kwemifuziselo yalaba ababengomengameli be-ANC, uMnuz Nelson Mandela noMnuz Oliver Tambo. URamaphosa nabaholi bomkhandlu weTheku bakuvikele ukwakhiwa kwezmifuziselo.Umfuziselo kaTambo useNorth Beach, okaMandela wona usenkundleni iMoses Mabhida.Amaqembu aphikisayo, iDA ne-ActionSA, abebhikisha ngesikhathi uRamaphosa ezovula imifuziselo. Abaholi bamaqembu bathe le mali bekufanele engabe isetshenziselwe ukulungisa izinkinga ezibhekene nomkhandlu.Iphini lomholi weDA KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Sithembiso Ngema, lithe le mali bekufanele kulungiswe ngayo inkinga yamanzi."Umbuzo esibuza wona wukuthi kungani uhulumeni unqume ukwakha imifuziselo ngo-R22 million ekubeni kunabantu baseNtuzuma, Nanda, KwaMashu, Mzinyathi naseMlaza abangawatholi amanzi. Njengoba sikhuluma nje kunezindawo eziningi ezingenawo amanzi."Usihlalo we-ActionSA KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Zwakele Mncwango, uthe ukwakhiwa kwemifuziselo ngo-R22 million kukhombisa ukuthi abaholi bomkhandlu abanendaba nabantu ababhekene nezinkinga. "Umasipala ubhekene nenkinga yemali. Umkhandlu kufanele engabe ubeka phambili ukulungisa inkinga yamanzi, ingqalasizinda nogesi. Njengoba sikhuluma nje kunezindawo ezingenawo ugesi."URamaphosa ukuvikele ukwakhiwa kwemifuziselo. UMengameli uthe uMandela noTambo bafanelwe ukuthi kuqhakanjiswe amagalelo abo."Vele yonke into eyenziwayo lapha eNingizimu Afrika ihlezi isusa umsindo. Abantu basho izinto ezihlukene. Labo abangabazayo abayicabange kahle le nto. Le nto esiyenze lapha ingaphezu kwalokhu abakucabangayo. Iqhaza elabanjwa yila maqhawe alisoze laqhathaniswa nemali esetshenziswe kwakhiwa imifuziselo. Likhulu iqhaza elabanjwa yilaba baholi."Imifuziselo yalolu hlobo ibalulekile ekugcineni umlando wethu. Le mifuziselo isikhumbuza lapho siqhamuka khona. Isikhumbuza amagalelo alaba baholi." URamaphosa uthe uMandela noTambo banomlando omude eThekwini."UMandela noTambo banomlando lapha eThekwini. UMandela walala lapha eThekwini ngaphambi kokuthi aboshwe amaphoyisa eHowick. Kulapha eThekwini lapho uMandela akhuluma khona ekhuza udlame emva kokuba esededelwe ejele. Kulapha futhi eThekwini lapho uTambo adlulisela khona izintambo zokubusa i-ANC kuMandela, ngo-1991."IMeya kaMasipala waseThekwini, uMnuz Cyril Xaba, ithe ukwakhiwa kwemifuziselo kuzothuthukisa ezokuvakasha."Ngithanda ukukubeka kucace ukuthi asithathanga imali obekufanele yenze izidingo. Siyidolobha elithandwa yizivakashi, ngakho kufanele sibe nezinhlelo eziheha izivakashi. Umkhandlu wanquma ukuba kwakhiwe imifuziselo ngo-2018."Umzukulu kaTambo, uMnuz Andile Tambo, uthe bayakujabulela ukuhlonishwa kukamkhulu wabo.Kepha u-Andile uthe abajabule ngabanye abaholi be-ANC."Akusiphathi kahle ukuthi abanye basebenzisa igama likaTambo uma bekhankasela izikhundla namavoti kodwa umndeni kaTambo awukaze uzuze lutho. Asikaze sithole ngisho imisebenzi. Kusiphatha kabuhlungu ukubona i-ANC yehla ngale ndlela eyehla ngayo, iphelelwa amandla. Abantu bayasihleka, bathi kanti ubaba wenu wayenzani."
BABONGA bayanconcoza kuMengameli waseRussia, uMnuz Vladimir Putin, ngokungenelela ekutheni kugcine kudedelwe abesilisa abangu-17 bakuleli, ababeluthwe ukuthi bayolwa impi ephakathi kweRussia ne-Ukraine.Lokhu kushiwo nguNgqongqoshe eHhovisi likaMengameli, uNksz Khumbudzo Ntshavheni, ngesikhathi ekhuluma ngokuphume emhlanganweni weKhabhinethi.Uthe uphenyo mayelana nokuthi laba baluthwa kanjani nokuthi obani ababeyingxenye yalokhu, luyaqhubeka. Bangu-15 okwamanje abasabuyele kuleli, abafike kuleli sonto."Uphenyo luzoveza zonke izinsolo ezikhona, okubalwa nendaba yokuthi kunemali ewu-R14 million eyakhokhelwa othile wakuleli ukuze laba besilisa bayolwa le mpi. Laba besilisa abaneminyaka engu-20 kuya ku-39, abazange basayine sivumelwano nezwe laseRussia, kodwa yinto abayenza nezinhlaka eziqapha ukuphepha, ezabaheha ukuthi bayolwa le mpi. Kumanje uNgqongqoshe wezobuDlelwano namaZwe oMhlaba, uMnuz Ronald Lamola, uKwaZulu-Natal, uhlangene nemindeni yalaba balisa, okuyiyona eyacela ukuthi uhulumeni angenelele ukuze babuyiswe ekhaya. Sibonga kuMengameli Putin ngokungenelela ekutheni laba bakwazi ukubuyela ekhaya," usho kanje. Uthe bayajabula ukuthi babuye bephephile, wathi oyedwa usasesibhedlela kuleliya lizwe kanti uzobuya uma esegunyazwe wodokotela ukuthi abuyele kuleli."Oyedwa kusalungiswa izinto zakhe ukuze akwazi ukubuyela kuleli. Kwaphulwa umthetho wezwe ngokuthi kujutshwe abantu ukuyolwa impi engagunyaziwe elakuleli, ngakho kuzothathwa izinyathelo ezinqala kwababandakanyekayo kulolu daba," kusho uNksz Ntshavheni othe uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa wafonela uPutin, emnxusa ukuba angenelele kulolu daba ngasekuqaleni kwale nyanga.Kulesi sehlakalo kusolakala nendodakazi yomholi weqembu iMKP, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, uNkk Duduzile Zuma-Sambudla owagcina esulile ePhalamende, ukuthi yaba neqhaza ekuluthweni kwalaba balisa, ukuyolwa le mpi. I-DA yamvulela necala ifuna kuphenywe iqhaza lakhe kulolu daba. UNksz Ntshavheni unxuse abanikazi bemfuyo ukuthi baqinisekise ukuthi izilwane ziyagonywa njengoba kubheduke isifo samatele."Uhlelo lokugonywa kwemfuyo luzokwenzeka izinyanga ezingu-12 nangaphezulu kanti ingu-28 million imigomo edingekayo ukwenza lo msebenzi. Ingu-2 million imigomo okuzoqala ngayo lolu hlelo kanti kudingeka kugonywe imfuyo engu-14 million."Uveze ukuthi iKhabhinethi isamukele isabelomali esilwa nobubha, wathi zibuyisa ithemba izibalo zakamuva zobugebengu, eziveza ukwehla kwamacala okubulala."Sikhathazekile ngokwanda kwezehlakalo zokubulawa kwamaphoyisa, njengoba ekoteni okukhishwe ngayo izibalo kuvele ukuthi angu-23 abulawa. U-80% wawo ufela emsebenzini." Uthe kubuyiswe nezigidi zemali eyalahleka ngesikhathi kukhona ababelawula uMbuso ngedlanzana, okwavela kwikhomishini weJaji uRaymond Zondo.Ubalule nokuthi kunenhlansi yethemba ngezinga lokungasebenzi kuleli yize umnotho ukhula kancane."Isibonelelo sabangasebenzi sizoqhubeka njengoba kuvele enkulumeni yesabelomali. Lesi sibonelelo kwakungesona esabangasebenzi,kodwa sasakhiwe ukusiza labo ababelambile ngesikhathi sobhubhane iCovid-19. Kusanezingxoxo kuleli ngezithinta isabelomali sabangasebenzi."
UMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal umatasa nophenyo mayelana nokuqashwa kothisha noma izikhulu zakwamanye amazwe kulandela imiphumela eshaqisayo yophiko oluphenya amacala ayisipesheli (SIU).Ngokubuka kwe-IOL, umbiko we-SIU udalule ukuthi kunabantu bangaphandle abanikezwa igunya lomthetho ngomgunyathi eNingizimu Afrika, okuphakamisa ukukhathazeka ngobuqotho benqubo esetshenziswayo yokuhlolwa wamaphepha abokufika abaqashwa njengabasebenzi emkhakheni wezemfundo.Umphathiswa wezeMfundo eKZN, uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka, uthe bayawuhlaziya umbiko we-SIU othole ukuthi abanye abantu bangaphandle bagunyazwa ngokusemthethweni eNingizimu Afrika.UHlomuka uthe kumanje umnyango usadingida ukuthi lolu hlelo luyawuthinta yini; ikakhulukazi, isidingo sokunquma ukuthi noma yimuphi wabasebenzi babo uyabandakanyeka. Umemezele inhloso yakhe yokuxoxisana nabaphathi abaphezulu ukuze kuhlolwe kabanzi bonke abantu bangaphandle abaqashiwe emnyangweni wakhe."Ukuze siphenye ukuthi labo thisha noma isiphi isikhulu esingaphakathi emnyangweni siqashwe ngendlela efanele yini, futhi silapha esifundazweni ngendlela efanele.”Uthe bakwenza ngoba kumele kuthathwe izinyathelo ezifanele ukuhlola abantu abaqashwe kususelwa emaphepheni omthetho angumkokotelo, noma ngabe lawo maphepha ayethathwa njengasemthethweni ngesikhathi sokuqashwa.
UKHATHAZEKA ngesibalo esiphezulu sabafana abalaxaza isikole, kusuka kwaGrade 10 kuya kwa-matric abagcina sebengene kumagenge.Lokhu kukhathazeka kuvezwe yiPhini likaNgqongqoshe eMnyangweni wezeMfundo eyisiSekelo, uDkt Reginah Mhaule, muva nje ngesikhathi izikhulu zomnyango zivele ngaphambi kwamakomiti asePhalamende.Uthe kusuka kwaGrade 1 kuya kwaGrade 10, sincane isibalo sabafundi abalaxaza isikole bangasiqedi, uma kuqhathaniswa nakwaGrade 10 kuya kwa-matric."Kudingeka seseke kakhulu izingane zabafana okuyizona ezishiya isikole zingasiqedi, ezinye zingene kumagenge. Phambilini izinhlelo zethu bezigxile kumantombazane, abelaxaza isikole ngoba esekhulelwe, manje sekumele sigxile ebafaneni," usho kanje.Uthe ngisho uhamba emphakathini ufica abafana bezihlalele bewuvanzi bengenzi lutho. Ufakazelwe nanguNksz Priscilla Ogunbanjo, umqondisi wezivivinyo emnyangweni, othe baningi abafundi abashiya isikole kusuka phakathi kukaGrade 10 no-matric.Uthe kwamanye amabanga okubalwa uGrade 4 namanye baningi abafundi abaphinda amakilasi ngenxa yokufeyila."Amanye amabanga okufeyilwa kuwona uGrade 8 no-10, lapho sibona sanda isibalo sabaphindayo. Nakwamanye amabanga kubalwa noGrade 11, zikhona izinselelo zokuphindwa kwamakilasi," usho kanje. Sekuke kwakhalwa ngesibalo sabafundi abaqala uGrade 1, abagcina bengafinyelelanga kwa-matric minyaka yonke. Lokhu kugqama kakhulu uma sekumenyezelwa imiphumela ka-matric, lapho okuhlaluka khona ukuthi inqwaba yabafundi ayisiphothuli isikole ngesikhathi esifanele.Minyaka yonke babalelwa ku-1 million, abafundi abaqala uGrade 1, kodwa kwa-matric uthole ukuthi babalelwa ku-700 000 ababhala izivivinyo. Okuke kuvezwe izikhulu zomnyango ngukuthi abanye abafundi bayashiya ezikoleni bayoqhuba izifundo zabo emakolishi amakhono ama-TVET. Abanye bayashona kanti abanye bagcina sebesiyeka isikole ngenxa yezimo ezehlukene, kubalwa nokukhulelwa. Umnyango wayalelwa ukuthi uthole ukuthi abafundi abangasiqedi isikole bashonaphi. UDkt Mhaule uthe noma abafundi beshiya isikole kodwa minyaka yonke siyanda isibalo sababhala u-matric.Okunye okuvelile kulo mhlangano wukuthi siyehla isibalo sabafundi ababhala ngasese u-matric okusho ukuthi baningi ababhala leli banga ngesikhathi esifanele."Ukwehla kwesibalo sababhala ngasese kuveza khona ukuthi umnyango ulivulile ithuba kulabo abangenawo u-matric, ukuthi babhale. Lokhu kukhomba ukuthi ivuliwe iminyango yezemfundo kuleli," kusho uNksz Ogunbanjo.
UNGQONGQOSHE wezeziMali, uMnuz Enoch Godongwana, ukhumbuze abantu ukuthi kubongwa okuncane kubongwe okukhulu ngesikhathi ethula isabelomali eKapa, izolo.Kufanele ukuthi bahleka bodwa abantu abangu-26.5 million abahola izibonelelo zikahulumeni njengoba zizonyuka kusuka ngo-Ephreli nonyaka. Kodwa abahola isibonelelo sabangasebenzi, bazojabha njengoba bengeke banyuselwe ngalutho kulo nyaka.UGodongwana uthe izibonelelo zidla uhulumeni u-R292.8 billion. "Isibonelelo sezaguga nesabakhubazekile sizonyuka ngo-R80 ngo-Ephreli, siye ku-R2 400 ngenyanga. Isibonelelo sababengamasosha, naso sizonyuka ngo-R80, sibe ngu-R2 420 ngenyanga. I-Foster Care yona izonyuka ngo-R40, ibengu-R1 290 ngenyanga. Ngo-Okthoba, lesi sibonelelo sizophinde sinyuke ngo-R10, sibengu-R1 300 ngenyanga," usho kanje. Isondlo sabantwana esaziwa ngemali yeqolo, sizonyuka ngo-R20, sibengu-R580 ngenyanga kusuka ngo-Epnreli. Imali okunyuswe ngayo ibukeka ingeke iwenze umehluko otheni ikakhulu esibonelelweni sezingane njengoba zimbalwa izinto ezingatholakala ngo-R20 ochathaziwe."Isibonelelo sabangasebenzi sona ngeke sinyuke njengoba sizoqhubeka sibe ngu-R370 kulo nyaka. Lesi sibonelelo sihlinzekwe ngesabelomali sika-R36.4 billion ukuze siqhubeke nokuholwa kuze kube uMashi 31 wangonyaka ozayo," usho kanje.Uveze ukuthi imali yoMnyango wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi izonyuswa ifinyelele ku-R466 billion ngonyakamali u-2028/2029. Udalule nokuthi ukuqiniswa kompompi okwenziwe yiSASSA, kongele uhulumeni u-R3 billion."Umkhankaso weSASSA wokubuyekeza izibonelelo, uthele izithelo njengoba kunqanyulwe izibonelelo ezingu-35 000, ebeziholwa ngabangafanele. Sifuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kukhokhelwa abantu abafanele ngaso sonke isikhathi, yingakho siweseka lo mkhankaso. Ngeke sikuvumele ukuthi kuxhashazwe imali yabakhokhi bentela," kubeka uGodongwana.I-SASSA yenza ucwaningo lwezibonelelo ezibalelwa ku-291 581 kusuka nyakenye. "Lokhu kwenziwa ngokubheka abantu abanama-akhawunti kanjalo nokubhekwa kuma-credit bureau, labo abahola izibonelelo ekubeni benenye imali ebangenela eceleni. Lolu hlelo lokuhlolwa abayiphilayo, luzoqhubeka nakulabo abaqalayo ukuhola izibonelelo ukuze kunqandwe inkohlakalo ekuholweni kwezibonelelo."Uhulumeni usemkhankasweni wokuhlola ukuthi kungagcina kwenzekile ukuthi abangasebenzi bathole isibonelelo sangunaphakade. Lokhu kwenziwa ukuze kuqedwe ububha, njengoba siphezulu nesibalo sabantu abangasebenzi, ikakhulu intsha.
AMALUNGU ePhalamende afuna incazelo ecacile kuhulumeni yokuthi uhlela ukuyixhasa kanjani ngemali, eyesihlava sodlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane nezingane, okuyinhlekelele kuleli.Lokhu kuvele ngesikhathi amakomiti amabili, okungelokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu, nelabesiFazane, iNtsha kanjalo nabaPhila nokuKhubazeka, ehlangene noNgqongqoshe bale minyango, kuleli sonto.USihlalo wekomiti labesiFazane, uNksz Liezl van der Merwe, uthe bayakwamukela ukusukunyelwa eyalesi sihlava kuleli wathi kodwa kudingeka kube nohlelo olucacile lokuthi kuzofakwa imali engakanani ukulwa nale nkinga."Siyakwamukela ukuhlonzwa kwale nkinga njengenhlekelele ukuze kuliwe nayo. Kodwa sifuna ukwazi ukuthi iminyango izoyixhasa kanjani eyale mpi." USihlalo wekomiti lezokuBusa ngokuBambisana, uDkt Zweli Mkhize, uthe azamukelekile izibalo eziphezulu zokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane kuleli."UMthethosisekelo ugqamisa amalungelo abantu ngakho kuyichilo ukuthi abesifazane bahlukunyezwa ngale ndlela. Siyakwamukela ukusukunyelwa kwale nkinga nguhulumeni." Kulo mhlangano kuvele ukuthi ngoJulayi kuya kuSepthemba 2024, bangu-957 abesifazane ababulawa kuleli. Amalungu agqamise eyokubaluleka ukuthi kuqiniswe ukusebenza kwamaphoyisa, kuqiniswe ukusebenza kwabashushisi nezinkantolo kuphinde kungadedelwa kalula abasuke benze amacala athinta ukuhlukumeza abesifazane.Ahlabe nekhwelo lokwandiswa kwezikhungo zokugcina abahlukunyeziwe amaThuthuzela, kuphinde kugxilwe nasezinganeni zabafana ezidinga ukufundiswa kabanzi ngodlame.Abamabandla abasalanga ngaphandle ekutheni nabo kumele babe yingxenye yemikhankaso yokulwa nalesi sihlava. Uphuzo oludakayo nezidakamizwa nazo ngezinye zezinto okuvele ukuthi zibhebhethekisa udlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane.UNgqongqoshe eHhovisi likaMengameli obhekele abesifazane, uNkk Sindisiwe Chikunga, uthe bazowandisa amaThuthuzela njengoba emancane.Uthe zikhona izinguquko ezenzekayo njengoba namaphoyisa engasavunyelwe ukunika ibheyili umuntu osuke esolwa ngecala lokuhlukumeza abesifazane, nezingane."Ibheyili ethinta amacala okuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane, isikhishwa ezinkantolo kuphela, hhayi eziteshini zamaphoyisa. Ziningi nezinto ezibhekwa uzakwethu, emnyangweni wezobuLungiswa njengokuthi amagama abantu asebeke balahlwa amacala okuhlukumeza, afakwe ohlwini ukuze umphakathi ubazi," usho kanje. UNgqongqoshe wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana, uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa, uthe uzobuyela kwiKhabhinethi mayelana nodaba lwemali ezofakwa kulesi sihlava.Uthe bavumelana ngo-elethu kwiKhabhinethi ukuthi le nkinga yokuhlukunyezwa nodlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane kumele ihlonzwe njengenhlekelele."Njengoba le nkinga isihlonzwe njengenhlekelele, sekukhona ukubambisana eminyangweni ehlukene ukulwa nalesi sihlava. Yingakho sizobuyela kwiKhabhinethi ngendaba yemali nangezinye izinto okusadingeka sizenze. Sizobuya nezimpendulo ngemuva kukaMashi ngoba noMnyango kaMgcinimafa uyazi ukuthi kudingeka ufake imali kule nkinga."
AZOFAKA isandla sijule ephaketheni amaxhwele nabaqhafi njengoba kunyuswe imali abazoyikhokha ngogwayi nangotshwala.UNgqongqoshe wezeziMali, uMnuz Enoch Godongwana, akazange awadabukele amaxhwele nabaqhafi njengoba enyuse intela otshwaleni nakusikilidi.Udalule ukuthi noma engazange ayinyuse intela kweminye imikhakha kodwa ubengeke angayinyusi ekagwayi notshwala. "Iphakethe likagwayi i-20 lizonyuka lisuka ku-R22.81 liye ku-R23.58. Inqawe izonyuka ngo-28 wamasenti, bese kuthi ugwayi unyuke ngo-87 wamasenti," kusho uGodongwana, ethula isabelomali izolo.Isigazu sona sizonyuka ngo-R4.56.Uma kuziwa ezinkambeni, uthe ikani elingu-340 wamamililitha lizonyuka ngo-8 wamasenti."Ibhodlela elingu-750 wamamililitha lewayini lizonyuka ngo-15 wamasenti. Kuthi ibhodlela elifanayo likagologo lizonyuka ngo-R3.20." Sekuphenduke insakavukela ukuthi minyaka yonke uma kwethulwa isabelomali, ayisali eyokunyuswa kukagwayi notshwala.UGodongwana unyuse lezi zinto nje, bekunekhwelo lokuthi angazinyusi kakhulu. Abotshwala bakhale ngokuthi uma kunyuswa kakhulu intela otshwaleni, kungabeka engcupheni imisebenzi kuphinde kwenze utshwala bubize kakhulu. Abalo mkhakha bakhale ngokuthi ukunyuswa kwentela, kungenza kwande utshwala obungumbombayi, obuvele busabalele futhi budlisela ogageni abaphisi botshwala abasemthethweni.UGodongwana uthe zizoqhubeka izingxoxo nabalo mkhakha kanti le ntela kulindeleke ukuthi iqale ukufakwa kusuka ngo-Ephreli, nonyaka.Phambilini, ibijwayele ukuqala ukufakwa uma isimenyezelwe kwisabelomali minyaka yonke.

Uthe kuno-R21.3 billion, wokukhokhela nokuqasha odokotela ezibhedlela ezehlukene. Ezempilo uzabele u-R334.3 billion.Uveze nokuthi kunezibhedlela ezizolungiswa okubalwa Inkosi Albert Luthuli kulesi sifundazwe nezinye kwezinye izindawo.Ezemfundo yizona ezithole isabelomali esikhulu njengoba ezabele u-R527.2 billion."Umkhakha i-Early Childhood Development wabelwe u-R9.9 billion ukuze kukhokhelwe abasebenzi. Uhlelo lokudla ezikoleni, okuhlomula abafundi abangu-9.9 million, lona lwabelwe u-R33.9 billion," usho kanje. Zizokwazi ukufunda ezikhungweni zemfundo. Imfundo ephakeme ithole u-R155.8 billion." Imfundo esemazingeni aphansi uyabele u-R358.6 billion.Okunye okuvelile ngukuthi kuhlonzwe abasebenzi bahulumeni abayizipoki abevile ku-4 000 eminyangweni ehlukene. Bahlonzwe emuva komkhankaso wokuhlonza abasebenzi abayizipoki abasohlelweni lokukhokhelwa kwabasebenzi bahulumeni, iPersal."Sihlonze abasebenzi abangu-4 323 abangazange baziveze kanti imiholo yabo izomiswa. Sikwenza lokhu ngokubambisana noMnyango wezeMfundo eyisiSekelo, owenza umkhankaso ofanayo wokuhlonza izipoki," usho kanje.Uthe bahlela nokuthi kube nohlelo lapho kuzosayina khona bonke abasebenzi bakahulumeni.Isike yavezwa eyezipoki kuhulumeni njengoba uMnyango weziSebenzi zikaHulumeni nokuPhatha, waqala lolu hlelo ukuze kuhlonzwe lezi zipoki, ezihola imali ekubeni zingekho.UGodongwana uthe ekugcineni bafuna ukwazi isibalo sabasebenzi bahulumeni ukuze bahlele kahle uma benza isabelomali.
LUGCINE lugobile uphondo, wamngcwaba uyise owesilisa waseCopesville, eMgungundlovu, kulandela ukushaya phansi ngonyawo isikhathi eside ethi ngeke amngcwabe.Umufi, uMnuz Khipha Chonco (72), ungcwatshwe ngesizotha izolo, emva kokungenelela kweSibiya Funeral Services.Kuthiwa uChonco ungcwatshwa nje, sekuphele izinsuku ezingu-52 ehleli emakhazeni njengoba ashonela esibhedlela iNorthdale, eMgungundlovu, ngoJanuwari 12. Sonke lesi sikhathi indodana yakhe, uMnuz Zakhele Cindi (43), ibilokhu igoloze njalo, ithi akukwazi ukuthi ingadingeka ngoba ikhehla selidlulile emhlabeni, kade lingamfuni lisadla anhlamvana.Phakathi kwezinto abezibalula ukuthi umufi akazange amondle njengoyise, wehluleka ukumenzela ngisho nomazisi futhi bebengahoshelani, waze wamenzela ngisho nencwadi yesivimbelo.Ekhuluma neSolezwe izolo, emva kwenkonzo yomngcwabo, uCindi uthe inhliziyo yakhe igcine ithamba emva kokuthembisa kwaboMnyango wezaseKhaya ukuthi bazoqinisekisa ukuthi uyawuthola umazisi. "Balethwe abeSibiya Funeral Service, ethembise ukuthi izozikhokhela zonke izindleko zomngcwabo. Ibe isithamba inhliziyo kimina, ngizwa ukuthi izinto zami zizolunga,” kusho uCindi.Uthe ngaphambi kokokungenela kwalaba, ubengakayiguquli inhliziyo yakhe ekutheni uyise ebengamdingi esaphila, akuqhubeke kube njalo ngisho esethule. "Isifiso sami bekuwukuthi ngimyeke aduve emakhazeni kuze kuba ukuthi ngiyawuthola umazisi. AboMnyango bathe bazongisiza ngisho esengcwatshiwe, iyonanto eyenze kwehla umoya kimi,” kusho uCindi. Ubonge abangcwabi ngokungenelela, wathi benze umsebenzi omkhulu ngoba ubengeke akwazi ukusingatha izindleko zomngcwabo ngokwakhe."Angisebenzi, bengingeke ngibe nayo imali yokumngcwaba,” usho kanje. Uthe usaludinga impela usizo njengoba enesifiso sokuvusa isitolo sakhe esawa, ukuze akwazi ukwenza imadlana yokuziphilisa. INGAKAKUSHIYA wedwa ehlathini imiphumela yokhetho lokuchibiyela uma uzothembela kakhulu kuyona ukubheka ukuthi yiliphi iqembu elingase lenze kahle okhethweni lohulumeni basekhaya oluzayo.Lapha KwaZulu-Natal sezibe ningana izinketho zokuchibiyela kanti kusekhona namanye amawadi azophinde achibiyele kungakafiki ukhetho lohulumeni basekhaya okulindeleke lube ngasekupheleni konyaka.Okuqaphelekayo wukuthi abantu sebeqalile ukusebenzisa imiphumela yokhetho lokuchibiyela lwakamuva ukubheka ukuthi amanzi angase agelezele ngakuphi okhethweni oluzayo. Iqiniso wukuthi ukhetho lokuchibiyela luhlezi lungezukufana nokhetho lohulumeni basekhaya. Okuqaphelekayo wukuthi bancane abavota uma kunokhetho lokuchibiyela. Okwenza ukhetho lokuchibiyela lungafani nokhetho lohulumeni basekhaya wukuthi kujwayele ukuthi babe bancane abantu abavota okhethweni lokuchibiyela. Isasasa lisuke liphansi uma kuwukhetho lokuchibiyela ngenxa yokuthi kusuke kubangwa i-ward eyodwa. Akufani nokhetho lohulumeni basekhaya lapho kusuke kubangwa khona ukuphathwa komasipala. Uma kunokhetho lohulumeni basekhaya amaqembu aba nemikhankaso emikhulu esuke iholwa abaholi abaqavile. Kuba nemicimbi kazwelonke yokwethula umqulu wezethembiso kanye nemicimbi yokusonga sekubhekwe okhethweni eyaziwa nge'Siyanqoba'.Okuqaphelekayo wukuthi nasokhethweni lokuchibiyela amaqembu aseyayiqinisa impela imikhankaso njengoba esethumela abaholi abaqavile, kusuke namalungu amaqembu akwezinye izindawo eyolekelela emikhankasweni.Nakuba kunjalo-ke kodwa ukhetho lohulumeni basekhaya alusoze lwalingana nokhetho nokuchibiyela, inkasa ayilingani nomfula.Okunye okwenza ukuthi babe bancane abantu abavota okhethweni lokuchibiyela wukuthi luvame ukuba ngoLwesithathu, okuba wusuku olungelona iholidi njengoba kwenzeka okhethweni olukhulu. Abantu abaningi basuke besemsebenzini, babuye emsebenzini ebusuku bekhathele bese kuba kude eziteshini zokuvota.Kuphinde kube nengcosana yabantu othola ukuthi ihlala kwenye indawo, mhlawumbe esesilungwini, kodwa umuntu uvota emakhaya lapho edabuka khona.Kuba nzima kumuntu okuleso simo ukuthi athole ithuba lokuyovota emakhaya uma kuchitshiyelwa.Okhulumela inhlangano eyengamele ukhetho KwaZulu-Natal, i-Independent Electoral Commission (IEC), uMnuz Thabani Ngwira, uthe bayaye benze konke okusemandleni abo ukugqugquzela abantu ukuthi bavote okhethweni lokuchibiyela kodwa isibalo sabavotayo sihlale siphansi."Sihlale sikhala ngokuthi abantu abavota okhethweni lukazwelonke abalingani nabantu abavota okhethweni lohulumeni basekhaya. Baba bancane kakhulu uma kuwukhetho lokuchibiyela. Ayikho into esingayenzi uma kuzoba nokhetho lokuchibiyela. Siyaye sihambele izindawo ezizokuba nokhetho lokuchibiyela. Sisuke sibambisene nesiShayamthetho kanye noMnyango wokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu. Kodwa kujike kufane nje." UKUNUKANA NGOMGUNYATHIOkunye okubuye kuvele kuba wukuthi ngokhetho lokuchibiyela ziyaqonga izinsolo zokuthi kunabantu abavota ezindaweni abangahlali kuzo.Kujwayelekile ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ukuthi kusabalale ama-video abantu okusuke kuthiwa bathuthwa kwezinye izindawo ukuze bayovota lapho bengahlali khona.Ezinye izinsolo zenziwa ngaphambi kokhetho lapho amaqembu eyaye ekhale ngohlu lwabasuke bebhalisele ukuvota.I-IFP yake yafaka isikhalo ngesikhathi kunokhetho lokuchibiyela ku-ward 99 kuMasipala waseThekwini, ngo-2022. Yakhala ngokuthi kunabantu abangu-150 okwakuvela ukuthi bahlala kwenye ndawo. Kwathi uma kubhekwa indawo ababhalise ukuthi bahlala kuyo kwatholakala ukuthi yindawo engenasakhiwo.Kunenye inqwaba eyayinamakheli afanayo okwathi uma sekubhekwa kwatholakala ukuthi amakheli ababhalise ukuthi bahlala kuwo akhomba isiteshi samaphoyisa, kwabanye izitolo eziseMkhomazi.I-ANC ike yakhala ngabantu abangu-135 ababenekheli elifanayo ngesikhathi kunokhetho lokuchibiyela ku-ward 110 kuMasipala waseThekwini. I-ANC yashaya amakhala yathi ikheli elendawo yokuhlala engeke ikwazi ukuhlalisa abantu abangu-135.Muva nje i-ANC ikhale ngenqwaba yabantu abanamakheli angaqinisekisiwe abebebhalisele ukuvota ngesikhathi kunokhetho lokuchibiyela ku-ward 23 kuMasipala wasebaQulusini. Abe-ANC baveza ukuthi kwathi uma beyobheka laba bantu emakheleni abawafakile kwathiwa abaziwa. Kodwa i-IEC iyaye izichithe lezi zinsolo.UNgwira uthe amaqembu ayanikezwa ithuba lokukhala uma esola ugcobho ohlwini lwabantu abasuke bebhalisele ukuvota.UNgwira uthe amaqembu angakwazi ngisho ukuya enkantolo eyophonsela inselelo imiphumela yokhetho uma kukhona noma ngabe umuntu oyedwa osuke evote endaweni angahlali kuyo.UNgwira uthe ikhona imiphumela emithathu yokhetho lokuchibiyela eyachithwa yiNkantolo yoKhetho emva kokuba kutholakale ukuthi kunabantu abavota lapho bengahlali khona."Kusuke kulele kuwona amaqembu ezepolitiki ukuba aveze ubufakazi bokuthi kunabantu abavote endaweni abangahlali kuyo."(SIDEBAR BELOW)Ukhetho lokuchibiyela lwakamumva lusitshelani?UKHETHO lokuchibiyela lwakamumva olube KwaZulu-Natal lukhombisa ukuthi i-IFP iyona ehamba phambili. Lokhu akumangazi ngoba vele i-IFP imandla komasipala baKwaZulu-Natal njengoba kuyiyo ephethe iningi lomasipala bakulesi sifundazwe.Ngeledlule i-IFP inqobe ukhetho lokuchibiyela obeluku-ward 13 kuMasipala waseMzumbe. NgoDisemba yavala unyaka ngokunqoba ukhetho lokuchibiyela olwaluku-ward 17 kuMasipala waseMfolozi.Kukhona amanye ama-ward amabili anqotshwa yi-IFP okhethweni lokuchibiyela olwalungonyaka odlule.NgoJulayi i-IFP yanqoba ukhetho lokuchibiyela ku-ward 23 kuMasipala wasebaQulusini, ngoFebhuwari yadla umhlanganiso okhethweni lokuchibiyela owaluku-ward 15 kuMasipala waKwaMhlabuyalingana.I-MKP nayo ibingazibekile phansi okhethweni lokuchibiyela obeluKwaZulu-Natal ngonyaka odlule. Yona yanqoba ukhetho lokuchibiyela olwalukuMasipala waseMandeni, yawina futhi olokuchibiyela ku-ward 10 kuMasipala waseThekwini, kwaba ukhetho lokuchibiyela owalukuMasipala waKwaDukuza nolwalukuMasipala waseRichmond.I-ANC yanqoba ukhetho lokuchibiyela ezindaweni ezimbili ngonyaka odlule, kuMasipala wasoPhongolo nakuMasipala waseMpofana.Zisazoshukana okhethweni lokuchibiyela KwaZulu-NatalAYIKAPHELI imijaho okhethweni lokuchibiyela KwaZulu-Natal ngaphambi kokuthi kufike ukhetho lohulumeni basekhaya.Ngesonto elizayo kuzokuba nokhetho lokuchibiyela ku-ward 17 kuMasipala wakwaNongoma kulandela ukusula kwekhansela le-NFP. Ngenyanga ezayo kuzokuba nokhetho lokuchibiyela ku-ward 12 kuMasipala wasebaQulusini.Kunolunye oluzokuba kuMasipala wakwaNongoma obekungakamenyezelwa ukuthi luzokuba nini.Ukhetho lohulumeni basekhaya luzokuba phakathi kukaNovemba noJanuwari.
UMPHAKATHI okhahlanyezwe yizikhukhula eMzomusha, KwaBester, eNanda, uthi usujahe ukuthi uma esempontshwe wonke amanzi kwaphela, ubheke komunye wemizi ukuthi abekho yini abavaleleke ngaphakathi.Usho lokhu izolo, kulandela ukuthi uMnyango wokuHlaliswa kwaBantu esifundazweni uthumele amaloli amoma amanzi kule ndawo ngezikhathi zasekuseni. Izikhukhula ezigasele kule ndawo ngoLwesihlanu nangoMgqibelo zishiye imindeni eyisishiyagalolunye ikhahlamezekile. Kuyona kukhona eyisikhombisa izindlu zayo ezimbozwe amanzi, kwaphoqa ukuthi ebebephakathi baphume ngesamagundane, nalokho abebekugqokile kuphela. Eminye imizi emibili, nakuba ingamboziwe amanzi kodwa imindeni ehlala phakathi ivalelekile ngoba indlela yokuphuma ibisagcwele amanzi. Omunye wabakhahlamezekile, uNksz Slindile Ndumo, uthe abalindele ukukubona wukuthi amanzi amonywe wonke, kusale komile ukuze bakwazi ukuyongena ezindlini."Sizoya nakwezethu siyobheka ubungako bomonakalo bese siyazihlanza izindlu kodwa esikujahile wukuthi sibheke ukuthi kule ndu esisola ukuthi inabantu phakathi bakhona ngempela yini,” kusho uNksz Ndumo.Ngesikhathi Isolezwe lihambele endaweni yesigameko lithole ukuthi laba okusolakala ukuthi bavaleleke kule ndlu, babeziphuzela amanzi amponjwana, bevalile, nokwenza umphakathi ucabange ukuthi ababange besakwazi ukuphuma, sekuvimbanise amanzi. UNksz Ndumo uthe emva kokumonywa kwamanzi bazobuyela ezindlini zabo uma sebethole usizo lwezingubo zokulala nokunye njengoba bazi kahle ukuthi konke obekungaphakathi kumoshwe yimvula."Asazi kahle ngendaba yokuyohlala kolindela ngoba bancane futhi abanagesi namanzi. Sibona sengathi sisazoqhubeka nokuhlala ezindlini zethu,” usho kanje.Uqhube wathi ebebefisa ukuthi kwakhiwe ngokushesha yibhuloho elizohamba ngaphansi komgwaqo, livuleke kakhudlwana ukuze amanzi ayochitheka ngaphesheya komgwaqo. "Njengoba umonakalo ungaka nje, yingoba amapayipi akhiwa kudalo, mancane, anomlomo ongangowebhakede elincane. Awasakwazi nhlobo ukumelana nomthambo wamanzi avele abe khona kule ndawo uma lina,” kusho uNksz Ndumo.UMphathiswa woMnyango wokuThutha nokuHlaliswa kwaBantu, uMnuz Siboniso Duma, esitatimendeni esithunyelelwe abezindaba, uthe ujube amathimba ukuba ayongenelela. "UMnyango wezokuThutha usebenzisa amaphampu odaka asezingeni eliphezulu, waphinde wahlanganisa nomshini wokukhipha amanzi ahlangene nemfucuza nodaka. Imfucuza yiyo evimbanisile, eyenza ukuthi amanzi angabe esakwazi ukuhamba ngokukhululeka nokuholele ekutheni izindlu zimbozwe amanzi,” kusho uDuma. Uqhube wathi umnyango usebenzisana noMasipala weTheku ukuqoqa imininingwane yemindeni ekhahlamezekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukungenelela okufanele. "Asifuni kube khona umuntu ozosala ngaphandle. Eminye imindeni ihleli ebanganini, kanti sizama indlela yokuthi bahlaliswa kuphi ngesikhathi kuphothulwa uhlelo lokuthi banikezwe izinsiza,” kusho uDuma.
SEZIMBILI izinkabi eziboshwe neNkosi Simphiwe Erick Zuma, ezifuna ukuvuma icala lokubulala owayeyikhansela le-DA kuMasipala waseMngeni, uMnuz Nhlalayenza Ndlovu.Umsolwa wesibili, uMnuz Khayelihle Shabalala, uveze ukuthi naye usefuna ukuvuma icala.Lokhu kuhlaluke ngesikhathi uShabalala evele kafushane kanye nasolwa nabo eNkantolo yesifunda eMgungundlovu, ngoLwesihlanu. Inkabi okuthiwa yahlela itulo lokubulala uNdlovu isejele, uThabo Dion Mathonsi Chonco, owaveza ukuthi uzolivuma icala lokubulala uNdlovu.Omunye owayesolwa kuleli cala, uMnuz Zwelithini Buthelezi, waphenduka ufakazi woMbuso.Lokhu kusho ukuthi abasolwa abaqhubeka nokuphika icala iNkosi uZuma kanye noMnuz Thobani Masobho Hlongwa.UNdlovu oyisihlobo seNkosi yakwaZuma, wabulawa phambi komndeni wakhe ngo-2023. UNdlovu kuthiwa wabulawelwa ukuphikisana nokukokotelwa kukagesi kanye nokudayiswa komhlaba kamasipala.Icala lihlehliselwe uMashi 13 nonyaka, lapho kulindeleke ukuthi uShabalala noChonco bavume ngokusemthethweni icala.Ngalolu suku kuzophinde kulalelwe nesicelo sabezindaba sokuqopha ukuqulwa kwecala. UMbuso nabameli babasolwa bathe bazosiphendula ngoMashi 13, isicelo sabezindaba sokuqopha ukuqulwa kwecala.Ngesikhathi icala liqulwa eNkantolo yeMantshi eHowick, abezindaba bebevumeleke ukuqopha kuphela uma abasolwa bengena noma sebephuma enkantolo.Njengoba icala selithuthelwe eNkantolo yesifunda, abezindaba abanalo igunya lokuqopha noma ukushutha okwenzeka enkantolo. INkosi iphinde yavela kafushane enkantolo ngalo uLwesihlanu lapho ibhekene khona namanye amacala amabili okubulala.Ibhekene necala lokubulala owayengundunankulu wesizwe sakwaNxamalala, uMnuz Qalokunye Zuma, kanye nelokubulala owayephikisana nokudayiswa komhlaba womasipala eMpophomeni, uMnuz Xolani Ntombela/Ndlovu.Ecaleni lokubulawa kukaNtombela/Ndlovu, iNkosi iboshwe kanye noChonco kanjalo noMnuz Thembelani Mbatha.Omabili la macala ahlehliselwe uMashi 13 nonyaka.
UMHOLI we-IFP omkantshubomvu, uMnuz Blessed Gwala, ukhuza umbango wezikhundla eqenjini.UGwala uthe umbango wezikhundla uphambene nezimfundiso zomsunguli we-IFP, Inkosi Mangosuthu kaMathole Buthelezi.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma esikhumbuzweni seNkosi uMhloleni Mthiyane. Isikhumbuzo seNkosi yaKwaSokhulu besibanjelwe eMfolozi, ngeSonto.UGwala usebe ebuholini obuphezulu be-IFP iminyaka eminingi.Uthe akakaze nangelilodwa ilanga ekhankasele izikhundla kwi-IFP, wathi ngesikhathi ejutshwa esiShayamthetho okokuqala, waphakanyiswa yiNkosi yaKwaSokhulu kanye neNkosi yaKwaBiyela."Khona abangazi ukuthi ngineminyaka engamashumi amahlanu ngiyilungu le-IFP. Khona abangazi futhi ukuthi ngiye ePhalamende ngineminyaka engu-37. Kule minyaka engu-37 ngeke nikholwe ukuthi babili abangamakhosi abangiphakamisa nginamazinyo angu-24. Nginamazinyo angu-36 manje. Kwakuqhuthana amadoda, kuqhuthana amadoda anezimpahla, anezinwele ezimhlophe. Bathi asibafuni laba ngoba bayalwa, sifuna le ngane. Njengoba ngingaka nje, angikaze ngizikhankasele. Akekho lana ongaphakamisa isandla athi ngake ngafika kuyena ngikhankasela isikhundla. "Ngafundiswa uMntwana waKwaPhindangene ukuthi ukufanele uhubhe isikhundla sokukhankasa njengenja. Kufanele kube abantu abakuphakamisayo. Le nto yokuzwa kuthiwa abantu bayagqumushelana ehholo, akuyona imfundiso ye-IFP. Ungakhethwa esikhundleni ngoba uye enyangeni kodwa isikhundla sikuphike ngoba awudalelwanga sona."UGwala uthe ngokhetho olwedlule wayengazi nanokuthi igama lakhe liphakanyiselwe ukuba abe yilungu lesiShayamthetho."Ngangikhankasela iqembu eLimpopo naseNorth West. Ngezwa sengibizwa nje kuthiwa angizosayina."UGwala uncome amagalelo eNkosi yaKwaSokhulu kwi-IFP."Amanye amakhosi ayaye ethi wona aphakathi nendawo. Izwe lasePrussia (Germany) laphela kanjalo ngoba kwakunenkosi. Kwathi uma kungena iqembu elingahambisani nobukhosi lase libuqeda kanjalo ubukhosi. Namanje nje iPrussia ngeke usayithola nasemlandweni."Inkosi yaKwaSokhulu ebusayo, uPhineus Mthiyane, ithe bakujabulele ukukhunjulwa kwamagalelo enkosi esiyakhothama."Wayeyilungu elikhulu le-IFP, esibona ukuthi ngabe yenze iphutha uma ingamshiya ngaphandle ezinhlelweni zayo. Namhlanje uhlelo lwakhe ukuba bamubungaze kanye nomama. Siyakuthokozela lokho okwenziwe yi-IFP. Sesiyabona ukuthi inkosi yayingalahlekile uma ikuleli qembu, sesiyawubona umphumela."
AMAPHOYISA KwaZulu-Natal aqinisekise ukuthi zizokube ziqinile ezokuphepha emcimbini wokuvulwa kwesiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe benze konke ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umcimbi wanamhlanje uba yimpumelelo.Umcimbi wokuvulwa kwesiShayamthetho uzokuba enkundleni iWoodburn Rugby Stadium, eMgungundlovu.ISilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini sizokwethula inkulumo yokuvula isiShayamthetho.UNetshiunda uthe amaphoyisa azokube eqaphe ngeso lokhozi, wakhumbuza izicukuthwane ezigadwa ngabaqaphi abazimele ukuthi ngeke bavunyelwe ukuba bangene nezibhamu endaweni yomcimbi."Amathimba amaphoyisa akhethekile yiwona azokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi zonke izicukuthwane ziphephile. Yonke indawo izokube igadwe amathimba amaphoyisa akhethekile. Abaqaphi abazimele bayanxuswa ukuba bahloniphe imithetho."UNetshiunda uthe ama-drone awavumelekile endaweni yomcimbi."Akuvumelekile okundizayo eduze naseWoodburn Rugby Stadium. Ama-drone amaphoyisa nawezinhloli kuphela azokwazi ukundiza. Labo abazondizisa ama-drone bengagunyaziwe bazobhekana nengalo yomthetho."UNetshiunda unxuse abashayeli ukuba babekezele njengoba kunemigwaqo ezokube ivaliwe.UNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, uzokwethula inkulumo ngesimo sesifundazwe kusasa.UNtuli uthembise ukuthi uzokhuluma ngodaba oluthinta abokufika.Esitatimendeni esikhishwe ihhovisi lakhe, uNtuli uthe uzokhuluma ngezinyathelo ezithathwe uhulumeni wesifundazwe ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abokufika bayayilandela imithetho, wathi uzothinta udaba lokwakhiwa nokunakekelwa kwengqalasizinda okubalwa kuyo imigwaqo, izikhungo zezempilo, izikole nengqalasizinda yamanzi."Ibalulekile ingqalasizinda ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabantu nomnotho."UNtuli uthe uzokwethula izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa komnotho."Inhloso yethu ukunciphisa isibalo sabantu besifazane netsha engasebenzi. Sizoqhamuka nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izimboni, ezolimo, ezokuvakasha, umnotho wasemalokishini nowasemakhaya. Sizonxenxa abatshalimali balapha eNingizimu Afrika nabangaphandle khona kuzokhula umnotho."Uthe uzophinde achaze nangebanga eselihanjiwe ekufezeni izethembiso ezenziwa ezinkulumweni zakhe ezedlule.Kuzokube kungokwesithathu uNtuli ethula inkulumo ngesimo sesifundazwe kusukela angena esikhundleni.
KULOKOZA inhlansi yethemba ngokukhula komnotho wakuleli kanye nokuncipha kwesikweletu esibhekene nezwe.UNgqongqoshe wezeziMali, uMnuz Enoch Godongwana, uthe umnotho wakuleli uzokhula kangcono futhi nesikweletu sezwe sizokwehla.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ethula isabelomali ePhalamende.UGodongwana uthe umnotho usuqala ukukhula kahle emva kweminyaka ukhula kancane ngenxa yenkohlakalo ebiyenzeka ngesikhathi kunezinsolo zokulawulwa koMbuso yidlanzana."Sibheke ukuthi umnotho ukhule ngo-1.6% kulo nyakamali. Umnotho ukhombise ukukhula uma uzoqhathanisa nokuthi umnotho wakhula ngo-1.4% ngonyaka owedlule."UGodongwana uthe balindele ukuthi umnotho uqhubeke nokukhula kule minyaka ezayo. "Silindele ukuthi ukukhula komnotho kulokhu kunyuka ngo-0.2%. Sibheke ukuthi umnotho ukhule ngo-2% ngo-2028."UGodongwana uthe into engaphazamisa ukukhula komnotho isiminyaminya esenzeka emachwebeni akuleli, ukungabi khona kwengqalasizinda esezingeni kanye nokubheduka kwesifo samatele.UGodongwa uthe kuzokube kungokokuqala eminyakeni engu-17 ukuba isikweletu sezwe sehle."Usuwehlile ushodi esabelwenimali sethu futhi le mali esiyisebenzisa ukukhokha izikweletu nayo yehlile."UGodongwana uthe uhulumeni wakuleli uzosebenzisa imali eningi ekulungiseni ingqalasizinda.Uthe uhulumeni uzosebenzisa u-R1 trillion ekulungiseni ingqalasizinda kulo nyakamali."U-R557.4 billion uzosetshenziswa uhulumeni kazwelonke, ohulumeni bezifundazwe bazosebenzisa u-R217.8 billion bese kuthi omasipala bona basebenzise u-R205.7 billion."Ungqongqoshe uphinde wamemezela u-R227 billion ozotholwa omasipala abakhuthalele ukulungisa ingqalasizinda. Uthe omasipala abaningi abayinakekeli ingqalasizinda."Omasipala baqoqa imali eningi kubantu kodwa incane kakhulu imali abayisebenzisa ukulungisa ingqalasizinda. Ingakho-ke kubambezeleka ukulungiswa kwengqalasizinda."UGodongwana uthe omasipala abakhulu okubalwa kubo neTheku ibona abangakwazi ukufaka izicelo zokunikwa le mali.Uthe omasipala banikwe u-R86 billion ukuze bakwazi ukubhekelela izinkinga.Uthe bakhathazekile ngezinkinga ezikhungethe omasipala, wathembisa izinguquko.
INHLANGANO iSouth African Liquor Brand Owners Association (SALBA) isiphakamise kuNgqongqoshe wezeziMali, uMnuz Enoch Godongwana, ukuthi abhekele abaqhafi ngokuthi anganyusi intela otshwaleni.Le nhlangano ithe, kunalokho akugxilwe ekulweni nenkinga yotshwala obuwumbombayi, okwenza inciphe imali engena emnothweni.Isitatimende sale nhlangano, sithe iyakwamukela ukugixabezwa kophiko oluqoqa intela kuleli, i-SARS ngo-R7.5 billion, ukuze kuliwe nenkinga yotshwala bomgunyathi."Ucwaningo olwenziwe yi-Euromonitor, luhlawumbisela ekutheni kwalahleka u-R16.5 billion, emnothweni ngenxa yotshwala obuwumbombayi ngo-2024. Umthelela wokwenyusa intela otshwaleni, uzodala ukuthi kwande utshwala obuwumbombayi," kusho le nhlangano njengoba uGodongwana ethula isabelomali sezwe, ePhalamende. Ithe ukwanda kotshwala nogwayi okuwumbombayi kubeka engcupheni impilo yabantu bakuleli."Minyaka yonke inkulu imali elahlekayo engabe iya emnothweni ngenxa yalezi zinto ezingumbombayi. Sizimisele ukubambisana nohulumeni ukuze kuliwe nalezi zinto ezingumbombayi."Namaqembu ahlukene ezepolitiki aveze akulindele enkulumweni kaGodongwana. I-IFP ithe ilindele isabelomali esizotakula abantu abahlwempu, sibuyise ithemba kubantu."Sibheke ukuthi kufakwe imali kwezemfundo, ezempilo, kwizibonelelo kanjalo nasekuphuculeni ingqalasizinda. Abantu bathwele kanzima, ukudla kuyabiza kanti kukhuphuka nezinto zokugibela. Akuqiniswe izinhlelo zomasipala zokuqoqa izikweletu, kuhanjiswe amanzi, ugesi nezinye izidingo kubantu." Ithe kumele kuqiniswe ezinhlelweni zokulwa nodlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane nezingane.Okhulumela i-DA kwezezimali, uDkt Mark Burke, ukhale ngokuthi abantu bakuleli bakhokha intela enkulu."Asikulindele ukuthi kunyuswe intela kubalwa ne-VAT. Kumele sazi ukuthi iyiphi intela ezokwehliswa," usho kanje. Uthe bakhathazekile ngesikweletu sezinkampani zikahulumeni wabala isikweletu seTransnet, esingu-R145.8 billion.Uveze ukuthi balindele ukuzwa ngebanga elihanjiwe ngezimemezelo ezenziwa nyakenye. Phakathi kwezinye, ubale indaba yabasebenzi abayizipoki kanjalo nokuthi bangaki ababekwe amacala, banqanyulelwa nomholo.I-Build One South Africa (BOSA), ithe balindele isabelomali esizokwakha amathuba emisebenzi, sehlise ububha obubhekene nabantu, sixhase ezemfundo, ezempilo nezokuphepha. "Abantu bathwele kanzima ngenxa yokunyuka kokudla, uphethroli, intela nezinye izinto. Sifuna kutshalwe u-R100 billion ukwakha amathuba emisebenzi kuphinde kwehliswe nesibalo soNgqongqoshe kwiKhabinethi." Iveze nokuthi kumele kuqedwe ngeminyango kahulumeni ehluleka ukuhambisa izidingo kubantu."Sifuna kuphele ngesibonelelo sabangatohozi. Akwandiswe amaphoyisa ukulwa nenkinga yobugebengu. Akuqashwe othisha nodokotela."
INGASE isheshe idedelwe imiphumela ka-matric njengoba uMnyango weMfundo ePhakeme, usezingxoxweni noweMfundo eyisiSekelo, ukuze le miphumela idedelwe ngaphambi kokuphela konyaka.Lokhu kuvezwe wuNgqongqoshe weMfundo ePhakeme uMnuz Buti Manamela, izolo ngesikhathi ethula inkulumo ePhalamende, ngokuvulwa kwezikhungo zemfundo ephakeme.UManamela uthe bafuna ukuthi isheshe idedelwe imiphumela ka-matric ukuze izikhungo zizilungiselele ukuvula kusenesikhathi."Sixoxa nomkhandlu Umalusi, ngokuthi imiphumela isheshe idedelwe ukuze kube nesikhathi esenele sokulungiselela ukuvulwa kwezikhungo. Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi phambilini, ngaphambi kokuhlasela kobhubhane iCovid-19, imiphumela ka-matric yayidedelwa ngaphambi kokuvalwa konyaka. Sifuna ukubuyela kulokhu ukuze kube nesikhathi esanele sokulungiselela ukuvulwa kwezikhungo," usho kanje. Sekube nezikhalo ikakhulu ngokuphuza ukudedelwa kwemiphumela ka-matric, esikhishwa esontweni lesibili kuJanuwari. Lokhu kwenza sibe sincane isikhathi sokuthi amanyuvesi ahlunge, abhalise aphinde aqale uhlelo lokufundisa.UManamela uveze ukuthi zibalelwa ku-300 000 izitshudeni ezingalutholanga uxhaso esikhwameni iNational Students' Financial Aid Scheme, ngenxa yezizathu ezehlukene.Udalule nokuthi sebenike amanyuvesi uR4 billion, ukuze axhase izitshudeni. Uhlabe ikhwelo kwabasebenzayo, abasakweleta lesi sikhwama ukuthi basikhokhele."Siyazi ukuthi kunabaneziqu kodwa abangasebenzi. Kulabo abasebenzayo, sithi ababuyise imali yeNSFAS ukuze isize abasadinga usizo lokufundiswa," usho kanje.Ilungu leMKP, uMnuz Mnqobi Msezane, likhale ngokuthi ziningi izitshudeni ezingafundi ngenxa yokulinda izimpendulo kwiNSFAS."Sekuyafundwa ezikhungweni zemfundo, kodwa uhluleka ukusitshela ukuthi abaningi abafundi ngoba basalinde ukuphendulwa ezicelweni zabo zokukhala ngokungaxhaswa. Kunezitshudeni eziphothule iziqu kodwa ezingakwazi ukuzithola ngoba zikweleta izikhungo zemfundo," usho kanje. UMnuz Sihle Lonzi we-EFF, ukhale ngezikhala ezingavaliwe emakolishi amakhono amaTVET."Bazoqeqeshwa kanjani onjiniyela, abenza ugesi neminye imikhakha uma kunezikhala ezingavaliwe. Umnyango ubuyisela imali emuva kuMgcinimafa ekubeni izitshudeni zilala emnyango ngoba zingaxhasiwe," usho kanje.Uthe bafuna amakolishi namanyuvesi abe nezindawo zokuhlala izitshudeni ukuze kuphele ngenkohlakalo edla lubi ezindaweni zokuhlala. UMnuz Sanele Zondo we-IFP, ukhale ngezinselelo ezibhekene neNSFAS engazixhasi ngesikhathi izitshudeni."Kumele ilungiswe eyokusheshe kukhishwe imali yokuxhasa izitshudeni. Ezinye izitshudeni zikhala ngendlala njengoba lesi sikhwama singasheshi ukudedela imali yoxhaso kulabo abahlala ezindaweni ezikhokhelwa yisikhwama." UMnuz Ashley Sauls we-PA, ukhale ngokukhetha iphela emasini ezikhungweni zemfundo ezikhetha ukuqasha abantu bokufika kuleli kunabakuleli."Ayibhekwe indaba yokuthi kubhekelwe abantu bokufika kuleli, kunabakuleli. Ayilungiswe ngokushesha indaba yokukhishwa koxhaso yiNSFAS."

ABAMELI bakaKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, basole usomabhizinisi uMnuz Calvin Mathibeli ngokuzivikela ngezinto ezingawenzi umqondo ezinsolweni zokudicilela phansi isithunzi sikaMkhwanazi.Lokhu kwenzeke eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini izolo.Abameli bakaMathibeli batshele inkantolo ukuthi uphindaphinda "izinhlamba" aseke wachashwa ngazo phambilini uMkhwanazi. UMkhwanazi unqume ukuya enkantolo emva kokuba uMathibeli, ongumnini wenkampani iCalvin & Family Security Services, ekhwele wadilika kuye, emsola ngokuba yibhoklolo elifuna ukumbulala. Unuke uMkhwanazi ngokusebenzisana nabezinkampani zonogada ezizimele kanjalo nosomatekisi abamfuna phansi (uMathibeli).UMkhwanazi ufake isicelo esiphuthumayo sokunqanda uMathibeli ukuthi aqhubeke nokukhuluma izinto ezidicilela phansi isithunzi sakhe.UMkhwanazi ufuna nokuthi uMathibeli ahoxise esidlangalaleni ezinkundleni ezifanayo nalezo akhulume kuzo, embiza ngesigebengu esisebenzisa isikhundla saso ngendlela engafanele. Encwadini yakhe efungelwe, ephikisa uMkhwanazi, uMathibeli uthe uMkhwanazi uzama ukumthulisa nokumnqanda ukuthi kungabi bikho akusho ngaye.Kodwa ngesikhathi kuqhubeka ukulalelwa kwalolu daba, u-Advocate Muzi Sikhakhane SC, obemele uMkhwanazi uthe isicelo esifakwe yikhasimende lakhe asisho ukuthi uMathibeli ngeke aphinde akwazi ukukhuluma. "Ayikho into ethi uMathibeli uma ebizwa ngaphambi kwanoma iyiphi inkundla yezobulungiswa, angekhulume,” kucacisa uSikhakhane. Uphinde wagcizelela ukuthi uMkhwanazi akasafuni ukuthi uMathibeli aqhubeke nokudicilela phansi igama lakhe. Uphinde wavumelana nenkantolo ukuthi uMathibeli akavinjelwe ukuthi akhulume nanoma yikuyiphi inkundla yezobulungiswa kodwa kungenzeka ahlawuliswe. Ngaphandle kwenkantolo uMkhwanazi uthe usale engenayo enye indlela ngaphandle kokuthi anikele enkantolo, ayonqanda uMathibeli. "Le nto imayelana nami ngqo, hhayi ngamaphoyisa yize uMathibeli ewabalula futhi engcolisa nesithunzi sawo kodwa yonke into ibhekiswe kumuntu ambize ngoNhlanhla Mkhwanazi, ungibalule ngegama,” kusho uMkhwanazi. Esiphakamisweni sikaMathibeli sokukhokha inhlawulo yemali, uMkhwanazi uphawule wathi: "Ngokwami le nto ayikho mayelana nemali. Sifuna ukuthi ayeke ukuhambe enza izitatimende ezingamampunge. Ukugijimela ekutheni uzimisele ngokukhokha, kumele asayine lelo sheke liye ezintandaneni ezingakujabulela ukusebenzisa leyo mali,” kusho uMkhwanazi.
USOMLOMO wesiShayamthetho KwaZulu-Natal, uNksz Nontembeko Boyce, unethemba lokuthi umcimbi wokuvulwa kwesiShayamthetho ngeke ube nesixakaxaka esenzeka ngesikhathi kulalelwe isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNdunankulu, uMnuz Thami Ntuli.UNksz Boyce uthe azojeziswa amalungu azozama ukunyomfa umcimbi wezinsuku ezimbili ozokuba seMgungundlovu. Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba eThekwini.Umcimbi uzoqala kusasa lapho iSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini sizovula ngokusemthethweni IsiShayamthetho. Kuyobe sekulandela inkulumo kaNtuli, ezoba ngoLwesihlanu.Kuzobe kungokokuqala ukuba amalungu esiShayamthetho ahlangane bukhoma emva kwesixakaxaka esasuka ngesikhathi kunesiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNtuli.Amalungu eMKP nawe-EFF avuka umbhejazane, aphazamisa umhlangano aze agcina elwa namaphoyisa ayebizelwe ukuzokhuza umsindo.Kwamiswa amalungu eMKP ne-EFF emva kwesixakaxaka esasuka emhlanganweni owawungoDisemba 15.Ebuzwa uNksz Boyce ukuthi kukhona yini izinyathelo abazozithatha ukuqinisekisa ukuthi akwenzeki okufanayo ngosuku lomcimbi, uthe unethemba lokuthi amalungu esiShayamthetho azoziphatha kahle."Ningikhumbuza enye into, bese ngikhohliwe wukuthi kwenzekani ngoDisemba 15. IsiShayamthetho yindawo yokuba kuphikiswane kodwa okwenzeka ngoDisemba 15 akuyona into esasiyilindele. Ngenxa yokuthi kunemithetho elawula isiShayamthetho nePhalamende sathatha izinyathelo. Sinethemba lokuthi ngeke kuphinde kwenzeke. Uma kuphinda kwenzeka sinethemba lokuthi imithetho izosebenza. Ngeke sithi sikuhlelele kodwa sinethemba lokuthi ngeke kwenzeke into efanayo."UNksz Boyce uthe kunemithetho ebekiwe echaza ngezinyathelo okufanele zithathelwe amalungu esiShayamthetho aphuma endleleni.UNksz Boyce uthe emva komhlangano owawulalele isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNtuli bahlala phansi babheka imithetho yesiShayamthetho."Yingakho sathatha izinyathelo esazithathayo. Namanje sithembele kuyo imithetho."UNksz Boyce uthe kwakuqala ukuba kube nesixakaxaka esinjeya esiShayamthetho. UNksz Boyce uthe amalungu esiShayamthetho ajwayele ukuziphatha kahle uma kuwumcimbi wokuvulwa kwesiShayamthetho."Mina nje selokhu ngaba wuSomlomo kukanye lapho kwadingeka ukuthi kuze kubizwe abezokuphepha ukuba bazokhipha amalungu ayehlupha. Amalungu ayazi ukuthi usuku lomcimbi wokuvula isiShayamthetho kusuke kungelona usuku lokulwa izimpi zepolitiki. ISilo sifike sivule isiShayamthetho, bese undunankulu ethula inkulumo yakhe. Emva kwenkulumo kandunankulu kuba nenkulumo mpikiswano. Kulapho amaqembu ezepolitiki ethola ithuba lokubeka uvo lwawo."

Angazi ngempela ukuthi yini le engenele lo mfana," kuchaza yena.Uthe namanje akuvumi ukuthi akholwe wukuthi uyena yedwa obengayazi le ndaba njengoba eveze ukuthi baningi abantu basendaweni abebazi ngayo.''Mina ngithole ngoba nakhu umntanami esegula kwaze kwadingeka ukuba aphuthunyiswe esibhedlela okuyilapho okuvele khona ukuthi kanti ukhulelwe," usho kanjena.Ngemuva kokuzwa lezi zindaba uthi uthuke woma ngoba lena yinto emehle ngaphezulu futhi ayifanisa nechilo.''Le nto akuvumi namanje ukuthi ngiyikholwe ukuthi iyenzeka ngempela. Uveze ukuthi lena yinyanga yesihlanu manje ikhulelwe indodakazi yakhe. Uthe kodwa bayothi beyondla ingane umenzi wokubi uyobe evalelwe nafana nabo ajele.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, usiqinisekisile lesi sigameko.Uthe amaphoyisa asePinetown abhekelele amacala okuhlukunyezwa kwabantwana ngokocansi abophe owesilisa ngecala lokudlwengula intombazane eneminyaka engu-14. Uthe owesilisa uzophinde avele enkantolo ngoLwesihlanu. Uveze ukuthi umsolwa uneminyaka engu-33.Kuvela lolu daba nje, ukukhulelwa kwentsha kuMasipala weTheku kuyinkinga enkulu yezempilo nenhlalonhle yomphakathi. Kubikwe ukukhulelwa kwentsha engu-7 627 phakathi kuka-Ephreli 2024 no-Ephreli 2025. Lesi sibalo sihlanganisa namantombazane angu-154 aneminyaka ephakathi kuka-10 no-14. Lezi zibalo zilama ezango-2023 ezashiya kubatshazwa njengoba kwavela ukuthi esifundazweni iKwaZulu-Natal ingu-26 500 intsha eyayikhulelwe. Kulezo zibalo kwathiwa ibalelwa ku-1 200 engaphansi kweminyaka engu-14 futhi okwathiwa iningi likhuleliswe ngabantu abadala kunayo.
UMASIPALA waseMsunduzi usola iMKP ngokuhamba kwamanzi okuphazamise ukusebenza kweNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu kanye namanye amahhovisi kahulumeni ngeledlule.Izikhulu zomkhandlu sezivule icala emaphoyiseni emva kokuba uphenyo luthole ukuthi kukhona abavale ngamabomu ama-valve amanzi ezingexenyeni zedolobha.Kuhlehliswe ukuqulwa kwamacala amaningi eNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu ngeledlule ngenxa yokungabi khona kwamanzi ezingxenyeni eziningi zedolobha.IPhini leMeya eMsunduzi, uMnuz Mxolisi Mkhize, linuke iMKP ngokuba nesandla ekuphazamiseni ukuhlinzekwa kwamanzi.UMkhize uthe abasebenzi bomkhandlu asebeshiye i-ANC bajoyina iMKP bamtshela emehlweni ukuthi bazokwenza noma yini ukuze bakhiphe i-ANC eMsunduzi."Lokhu kukutshela ukuthi kukhona inhlese yezepolitiki uma umuntu ethi uzokwenza noma yini ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bayasikhipha emandleni. Mina ngiyilungu le-ANC kusho ukuthi bachaza ukuthi bazokhipha i-ANC emandleni njengoba nabo sebasuka kithina bayokwakha iqembu labo lepolitiki okuyiMKP. Lokho abangifihlelanga, bebengitshela. Ngibe sengidlulisa umbiko unjengoba unjalo, ngabe sengithi ake sivule icala khona kuzophenywa."USihlalo weMKP KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Willies Mchunu, usifanise nobudedengu isenzo somkhandlu sokukhomba ngenjumbane iMKP ekubeni lungekho uphenyo olunzulu olwenziwe.UMchunu uthe ngabe kuyezwakala ukuba umasipala sewenze uphenyo wathola ukuthi yibaphi abantu abathintekayo futhi wabavulela necala."Kwesinye isikhathi kuyenzeka uma abantu behluleka bese befuna ukusulela ngabanye abantu."UMchunu uthe nabo bazoziphenya lezi zinsolo ukuthola ubuqiniso bazo."Angifuni ukuziphika noma ukuzivuma. Engingakusho wukuthi kuyicala ukuphazamisa ukuhlinzekwa kwamanzi. Umasipala kufanele uvule icala."IMeya, uMnuz Mzimkhulu Thebolla, ithe baqale bathola isikhalo sokuthi amanzi aphuma kancane edolobheni.UThebolla uthe bayilungisa ngokushesha le nkinga kodwa aqhubeka amanzi angaphuma ezindaweni eziningi.UThebolla uthe babe sebeqala uphenyo ukuthola ukuthi inkinga ikuphi."Ngesikhathi siphenya sathola ukuthi kukhona abaphazamisa ingqalasizinda yamanzi. Sathola ukuthi kuvalwe amapayipi ahambisa amanzi edolobheni ikakhulu enkantolo enkulu."UThebolla uthe bavule icala emaphoyiseni."Sisebenzisana nazo zonke izinhlaka eziphenyayo ngoba sifuna ukuthola ukuthi obani abaphazamisa ukuhlinzekwa kwamanzi. Sifuna ukuthola ukuthi ngabe abasebenzi bomkhandlu bayathinteka yini kule nto. Uma kuwukuthi abasebenzi bethu bayathinteka nabo sizobathathela izinyathelo. Asizukugcina nje ngokubathathela izinyathelo zokubaqondisa ubugwegwe kodwa bazophinde baboshwe."UThebolla uthe basola inhlese yezepolitiki ikakhulu njengoba kubhekwe okhethweni lohulumeni basekhaya."Ama-valve abevalwe ngenhloso. Laba abenza le nto bayazi ukuthi ukuvalwa kwamanzi kuzocasula abantu. Amanzi ayilungelo elikuMthethosisekelo."
INDLUNKULU kaZulu ithi akumangazi ukuzwa abeseka uMntwana uSimakade Jackson kaZwelithini bethi abasamukeli iSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini nakuba sivunwe yiNkantolo yezoMthethosisekelo. INdlunkulu ithe bekulindelekile ukuthi abeseka uMntwana uSimakade bangasheshi ukwamukela ngenxa yobuhlungu. Bakusho lokhu ngesikhathi bekhuluma nabezindaba izolo. Ngeledlule, iNkantolo yezoMthethosisekelo ichithe isicelo sikaMntwana uSimakade sokuphonsela inselelo isinqumo esivuna uMengameli uCyril Ramaphosa, ngokuvuma ukuqokwa kweSilo. Isinqumo senkantolo sisho ukuphela kombango wasenkantolo. Yize kunjalo, abeseka uMntwana uSimakade bathe abayamukeli iNdlulamithi yamakhosi. USihlalo woMkhandlu weSilo, Inkosi uZuzifa kaMangosuthu Buthelezi, uthe ngeke badikibaliswe ukuphikelela kwabeseka uMntwana uSimakade. "Kujwayelekile ukuthi abantu uma bezwa ubuhlungu benze kanje. Kulahleke izigidi zamarandi emacaleni abesezinkantolo. Miningi imizamo eyenziwe ngaphambilini yokuba kubuyiswane. Akuzukusidikibalisa ukuba senze imizamo njengamakhosi nendlunkulu, sizozama konke ukuba kubuyiswane."UNdunankulu kaZulu, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, uthe bazosebenzisa isinqumo senkantolo ukudala ubumbano eNdlunkulu. "Esikhundleni sokuba silwe nabaphikisayo, kufanele sisebenzise leli thuba ukuhlanganisa iNdlunkulu kaZulu. INdlunkulu kaZulu iwumsamo kaZulu wonkana. Sizosebenza ngokubambisana namakhosi kanye neNdlunkulu ukubuyisa uzinzo. Sinethemba lokuthi nabaphikisayo bazobona ukuthi akukho lapho abasangaya khona njengoba sebechithwe yiNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo."Okhulumela iSilo, uMntwana uThulani kaGqikazi Zulu, uthe iMbube iyohlezi izivulile izandla kwabaphikisayo."Ngizosebenzisa amagama aso iSilo lapho esake sathi khona izihlalo zabo abaNtwana, ziyohlezi zibalindile eNdlunkulu. Izandla ziyohlezi zivuliwe. Isiphetho asisho ubumnyama kwabaphikisayo ngoba bebengenzi into engakaze yenziwe. Akusho ukuphela kwempilo kulabo abebephikisa. Ngokwenkantolo sebefike kwangqingetshe. Sekufanele babuye kuzokhulunywa."UMntwana uThuthukani kaMcwayizeni Zulu, uthe akumnandi njengoba iNdlunkulu ihlukene phakathi. "Asithandi nathi uma abaNtwana baseNdlunkulu sibabukela kude, izihlalo zabo zikhona. Abafowabo nodadewabo beNgonyama abavundla esiswini esisodwa. Nathi nje siphelezela bona sizizwa silula uma bengekho. Imoto ayikaze ihambe singekho isitelingi. "Abantwana abangoyise bebuye, besondele enganeni yabo. Akukho lapho amaphutha engekho khona. Awukho umuzi ongashunqi ntuthu. AbeNkosi lapho bekhona siyabakhumbula. Siyohlala sizivulile izandla. Ababuye beze ekhaya. Siyakhuleka ukuthi izinhliziyo azithambe. Bebuye ngaphakathi esibayeni. Bese lapho bengathandi khona bese silungisa. Akekho obambele omunye igqubu. Okwenzekile kwenzeke ngesikhathi sakho."
KUSOLWA ukuthi uqale wabulala amadodakazi akhe amabili eneminyaka engu-4 nengu-7, owesilisa (37) waseVerulam, eThekwini, yena wase ezikhunga.Inkampani yonogada, iReaction Unit South Africa (RUSA), iveze ukuthi ibizwe endaweni yesigameko ngemuva kokuthola ucingo lokuthi izosiza ngoLwesibili ntambama.Ngesikhathi abakwaRUSA befika kulo muzi kanye nabezimo eziphuthumayo namaphoyisa, bazithele phezu kwesidumbu salona wesilisa silenga. Kuthe uma beqhubeka nokubheka endlini bazithela egumbini lokulala la bekukhona khona izidumbu zezingane.Bathe imininingwane ebucayi eholele ekutheni lezi zingane zibulawe bazoyigodla njengoba kusaqhubeka uphenyo.Eminye imithombo yabezindaba iveze ukuthi umakhelwane nguyena obike lolu daba ngemuva kokuthi ebememeza kulo muzi, njengoba ebejwayele ukubanika ukudla kodwa kwangasabela muntu.Nomalume wezingane, kuvela ukuthi ubembikelile unina wazo ukuthi akazitholanga ekuseni.Lona wesifazane kuvela ukuthi ubesanda kuhlukana noyise wezingane nokusolakala ukuthi yikho okuholele kulesi sigameko, njengoba bese zihlala ngokumvakashela.
KUKHONA nabasemazweni angaphandle ezinkulungwaneni ezinenkani yesele, ezihlala emgwaqweni yasedolobheni eThekwini.IMeya yoMasipala waseThekwini, uMnuz Cyril Xaba, iveze ukuthi kukhona nenqwaba yaseTanzania, kubantu abaphezu kuka-16 000 abahlala emgwaqweni.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba, izolo. Abahlala emigwaqweni sebegoloze kaningi besuswa. Umasipala ufike ubaxoshe kodwa akupheli ngisho isonto baqale phansi bakhe amadokodo abaqube kuwo.UXaba uthe bazozama ukuxhumana nehhovisi lenxusa laseTanzania, ukuze kuzobuyiselwa ekhaya labo abafuna ukubuyela emuva. Uthe bayazama ukuqhamuka nesisombululo enkingeni yabahlala emgwaqweni. Uveze ukuthi kunesikhungo abasakhayo esizokhoselisa abangenamakhaya."Kunesikhungo esihlalisa abangu-1 200 esisakhayo. Sizoqeda ukwakha lesikhungo ngasekupheleni konyaka. Kodwa lesikhungo asanele njengoba kunabantu abangaphezu kuka-16 000 emigwaqweni lapha eThekwini." Unxuse imindeni ukuba yemukele labo abafuna ukubuyela emakhaya."Esikujabulela kakhulu ilabo abathi bafuna ukuya emakhaya. Bakhona asebeqhamukile basho ukuthi bafuna ukuya emakhaya. Bashilo ukuthi banawo amakhaya futhi bayazi ukuthi bayafunwa emakhaya. Basicela ukuthi sibaxhumanise nemindeni yabo. Bakhona nje esibasizile bakwazi ukubuyela emakhaya."UXaba uphinde waveza ukuthi uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, uzokwethula ngokusemthethweni imifuziselo yabalwa nohulumeni wobandlululo, uMnuz Nelson Mandela, noMnuz Oliver Tambo.Umcimbi wokwethulwa kwemifuziselo uzoba ngoMashi 6. Imifuziselo ebiza u-R11 million umunye, izokuba phambi kwehholo ledolobha. UXaba ukuvikele ukusetshenziswa kuka-R22 million kwakhiwa le mifuziselo engu-9 wamamitha ubude."Ngiyezwa ukuthi abantu bayakhala ngemali esetshenziswe ukwakha imifuziselo. Ngizwile ukuthi abantu baqhathanisa imali eyasetshenziswa ngesikhathi kwakhiwa imifuziselo ese-Union Buildings, nemali esiyisebenzisile. Iqiniso ukuthi imifuziselo iyalingana ngobude kodwa ayifani. "Lena ese-Union Buildings ingu-3.5 tons, lena thina esiyakhile ingu-8 tons. Lena ese-Union Buildings yakhiwa ngo-2013, lena eyethu yakhiwa ngo-2021. Ese-Union Buildings yakhiwa khona lapha ekhaya kanti eyethu yakhiwa eChina. Ngakho ke ziningi izinto okufanele abantu bazibheke."Uthe izivakashi zizoyijabulela kakhulu imifuziselo.
ZINDALA zombili phakathi kwe-IFP neMKP ababukeka behamba phambili emjahweni wokunqoba ukhetho lokuchibiyela oluzokuba kuMasipala waKwaNongoma.Ukhetho lokuchibiyela luzokuba kuWard 17, ebikade iphethwe yiNFP.I-IFP neMKP yibona abakhiphe amangwevu ngesikhathi kukhankaselwa ukhetho.La maqembu yiwona anqobe amawadi amaningi KwaZulu-Natal ngonyaka owedlule, ngesikhathi kunokhetho lokuchibiyela futhi la maqembu ahlose ukuqhubeka nomgqigqo njengoba kubhekwe okhethweni lohulumeni basekhya.Umholi we-IFP, uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa nomholi weMKP, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, bashayele isipikili sokugcina ngesikhathi bekhankasela amaqembu abo ngempelasonto.UHlabisa ukhulume emcimbini Isiyanqoba, lapho emukele khona amalungu asuka kwamanye amaqembu, wathi bafuna ukudla umhlanganiso okhethweni lwakusasa kanye nakolunye ukhetho lokuchibiyela oluzokuba emawadini amabili akuMasipala waKwaNongoma.Kuzokuba nokhetho lokuchibiyela kuWard 7 no-20 kuMasipala waKwaNongoma, ngenyanga ezayo.Onke la mawadi abephethwe yiNFP. UHlabisa uthe ukunqoba kuwona womathathu kuzokwenza ukuthi bakwazi ukuphatha umasipala ngokuzimela.Njengamanje i-IFP iphethe ngokubambisana namanye amaqembu ngenxa yokungabi nezihlalo ezanele ukuthi ibuse ngokuzimela."Alukho uzinzo kulo masipala. Sibone kushintshwa ubuholi kaningi. Yingakho sifuna ukunqoba ukhetho lokuchibuyela ukuze kuzokuba nozinzo. Sinxusa abantu bakuWard 17, 7 no-20 ukuba bavotele i-IFP khona sizokwazi ukubanikeza izidingo ngokushesha."UHlabisa uthe bayazethemba ukuthi bazolunqoba ukhetho lokuchibiyela."Unyaka owedlule siwuvale kahle, sanqoba ukhetho lokuchibiyela obelukuMasipala waseMfolozi. Lo nyaka nawo siwuqale kahle njengoba sinqobe ukhetho lokuchibiyela kuMasipala waseMzumbe."UZuma yena wamukele inqwaba yamalungu aphuma kwamanye amaqembu.Phakathi kwalabo abamukelwe uZuma, kukhona naloyo oke waba imeya kaMasipala waKwaNongoma, uMnuz Mshangane Ndabandaba.UNdabandaba wesule kwiNFP kanye nasekubeni yikhansela ngeledlule.USihlalo weMKP KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Willies Mchunu, uthe bafuna ukunqoba kuwona omathathu amawadi."Noma ngabe asinqobanga kulolu khetho kodwa sinesiqiniseko sokuthi kuyothi kufika ukhetho lohulumeni basekhaya, iMKP ibe isindlondlobele lapha KwaNongoma, sidle umhlanganiso. Kuzokuba noshintsho lapha KwaNongoma oluyomangaza abantu."Abaholi beNFP abazange babonakale ngesikhathi somkhankaso.I-ANC yona ithumele amalungu esigungu esiphezulu okubalwa kuwo uDkt Zweli Mkhize, ukuba ayokhankasela ukhetho oluzayo.
IDILIZWE esikhundleni kungakapheli ngisho usuku iqokiwe iMeya kaMasipala waseDanhauser, uMnuz Sibusiso Kunene.UKunene uyalelwe yiqembu lakhe, i-IFP, ukuba asule esikhundleni ngosuku agaxwe ngalo amaketango obumeya.UKunene uqokwe emhlanganweni womkhandlu obungoMsombuluko kulandela ukuketulwa kobuholi be-ANC obebuphethe umkhandlu.Ngawo uMsombuluko isigungu esiphezulu kwi-IFP sithathe isinqumo sokuthi uKunene ehle esikhundleni.Encwadini ebhalwe wusihlalo wekomiti elijuba abaholi ezikhundleni kwi-IFP, uDkt Albert Mokoena, uKunene uyalelwe ukuba ehle esikhundleni ngawo uMsombuluko."Uyaziswa ukuthi isigungu esiphezulu sithathe isinqumo sokuba sikuyalele ukuba wehle esikhundleni ngokuphazima kweso, singakadluli isikhathi sokusebenza. Uyalelwa ukuba usayine incwadi ehambisana nalesi saziso, bese uyithumela ehhovisi likanobhala jikelele."UMokoena uthe iqembu liyalele uKunene ukuba asule esikhundleni ukuze lithole ithuba lokuqoka elizobajuba ezikhundleni kulo mkhandlu.Imizamo yokuthola uKunene ukuzwa ukuthi wesulile yini esikhundleni njengokuyalelwa yiqembu ayizange iphumelele izolo.UMasipala waseDanhauser ubuphethwe yi-ANC.Imeya ye-ANC, uMnuz Bongani Hadebe, yakhishwa ngevoti lokungabethembi ubuholi bayo.Bekungekhona okokuqala uKunene ethola isikhundla sobumeya.UKunene wagaxwa amaketango obumeya emva kokhetho lohulumeni basekhaya lwango-2021.Wabamba lesi sikhundla iminyaka emibili ngaphambi kokuthi akhishwe ngevoti lokungabethembi ubuholi bakhe.Ngesikhathi ekhishwa ngo-2023 kwangena uHadebe esikhundleni sakhe.Alikho iqembu elanqoba ngamalengiso ngesikhathi kunokhetho lohulumeni basekhaya lwango-2021.I-IFP ne-ANC banezihlalo eziyisishiyagalolunye iqembu ngalinye bese kuba namakhansela ayisikhombisa aqhamuka emaqenjini amancane i-EFF, ABC, DA, Community Freedom Front (CPF) neTeam Sugar SA.I-IFP ne-ANC bathembele emaqenjini amancane ukuphatha umkhandlu. Sekuze kwaba yizikhawu ezine kushintshwa izimeya, kuketulana i-IFP ne-ANC.Iqembu elijwayele ukushintsha izinto yiqembu elingenamlando otheni, iCPF.Leli qembu liyagxuma gxuma njengoba kwesinye isikhathi livota ne-IFP, kwesinye isikhathi livote ne-ANC.Ikhansela leCPF, uMnuz Sibusiso Myaka, like lagixabezwa ngesikhandlu sokuba usomlomo womkhandlu.
ZIHLELA ukumasha izinduna zaseMzimkhulu ezingaphezulu kuka-400 ezibalisa ngokubhuqwabhuqwa yinkemane ngenxa yokuwuzwa ngendaba umholo.Phambilini kwahlaluka ukuthi izinduna ezingaholi ezingaphansi kweNkosi uNtobeko Msingaphantsi kanye neNkosi uVelile Jozana.Okhulumela izinduna zaseMzimkhulu, uMnuz Bheki Dzanibe, utshele Isolezwe ukuthi ekuqaleni kwenyanga bahlela ukuba nemashi ezobe ibanjelwe edolobheni eMgungundlovu.Uveze ukuthi bagcine befinyelela kulesi sinqumo ngenxa yokuthi babona kahle ukuthi abezwakali nhlobo uma bekhuluma ngalolu daba.Uthe bakholwa wukuthi ukusukuma kwabo hleze kuzowenza umehluko kugcine kuzwakele ukukhala kwezinduna.''Le mashi sifuna ukuthi ingabibikho neyodwa induna yaseMzimkhulu engaholi esalayo kuyona. Zonke izinduna zizophuma ziye kuyona. Sifuna ukuthi kuzwakale ukukhala kwezinduna. Asikho esinye isikhathi esidlula lesi," usho kanjena.Eqhuba uthe ukholwa wukuthi sebekhale kwanele ngakho ke sesifikile isikhathi sokuba babonakalise ngezenzo ukuthi sebekhathele wukubona izinduna zaseMzimkhulu ziphila impilo enzima ngalolu hlobo.''Abantu abazi ukuthi mkhulu kangakanani umsebenzi owenziwa yizinduna emphakathini. Kodwa indlela okwenzeka ngayo kubonakala sengathi akekho onendaba nezinduna zaseMzimkhulu. Ibuhlungu kabi le nto ukuthi ukuze kuzwakale kumele obaba abadala kangaka abanemizi baze bagcine becabanga ukuphuma bashiye imizi yabo bangene emashini ngenxa nje yokuthi akekho noyedwa ozimisele ngokuzwa ukukhala kwabo," usho kanjena.Ufunge wagomela wathi ngeke baze bathule kodwa bazolwa kuze kube sekugcineni ukuze zigcine ziholile izinduna zaseMzimkhulu.Ukhombe ngenjumbane uMnyango wokuBasa ngokuBambisana noBuholi boMdabu oholwa wuMphathiswa uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi wathi yiwona kanye obonakala uzikhipha inyumbazane izinduna zaseMzimkhulu.''Kudela owaziyo ukuthi zenzani kubani izinduna zaseMzimkhulu njengoba zijeziswa kabuhlungu kangaka nje. Nokho manje ngeke sisalenza iphutha elikhulu lokuba sichithe isikhathi ngokukhuluma kodwa sizobonakala ngezenzo njengoba siqala nje ngale mashi ezobakhona kungekudala,''usho kanjena.Isolezwe like labika ngengwadla izinduna zaseMzimkhulu ezibhekene nayo yokungaholi. Ngesikhathi Inkosi uMsingaphantsi ikhuluma neSolezwe mayelana nalolu daba yezwakalisa okukhulu ukukhathazeka ngalesi simo.Yadalula ukuthi akukho abangakwenzanga bezama ukuthi zihole izinduna zaseMzimkhulu kodwa imizamo yabo kumane kufane nokuthi bathela amanzi nje emhlane wedada.Izinduna ezikhulume neSolezwe zacela ukuba kugodlwe amagama azo zithe nakanjani ziya phakathi emashini. Zithe kulokoza inhlansi yethemba ngokuthi lokhu kuzodala ukuthi kwazi wonke umuntu ngesimo sezinduna zaseMzimkhulu."Uyazi ukuthi kukhona abanye abantu abangazi ukuthi izinduna zaseMzimkhulu kaziwazi nje nhlobo umholo. Kwazi bani mhlawumpe kukhona okuhle okuzovela uma simasha. Sesikhathele manje wukuphila impilo enjengalena, siphila sengathi thina siyizingane zangaphandle," kuchaza enye induna.Kunanele enye yagcizelela ukuthi le mashi ezayo kuzoba ngeyokuqala nje. Ithe uma kudlula izinyanga ezimbalwa umehluko ungabonakali bazokwenza konke okusemandleni abo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bayaphindela futhi kuyona imashi.''Sifuna ukumasha kuze kutholakale esikufunayo. Sizimisele ngokulwa ngakho konke esinakho,'' isho kanjena.Phambilini uMfu Buthelezi ekhuluma ngalolu daba waveza ukuthi baphezu kwalo bazolulungisa. Wayekhuluma emcimbini owawuseMfulamhle ngoDisemba.
SESIDALULE ukuthi silahlekelwa yimali elinganiselwa ku-R2 million nyanga zonke isikhungo esibhekele abakhubazeke ngokwengqondo, iDurban And Coastal and Mental Health.Lokhu kudalulwe wuSihlalo webhodi lalesi sikhungo, uMnuz Sthandiwe Mkhize, ngesikhathi isikhungo sinomcimbi wokuzethula kabusha ebantwini. Umcimbi ubuseSherwood muva nje.Ekhuluma lapha uMkhize uthe kudinga imali eningi kakhulu ukugcina lolu hlobo lwesikhungo lusebenza ngendlela efanele futhi zonke izinto zenzeka kahle ngendlela efanele.Uthe yingakho benxenxa abanye osomabhizinisi abangaba nentshisekelo yokusebenzisana nabo ukuba basondele kusetshenziswane ukuze konke kuqhubeke kuhambe kehle.''Eqinisweni nje imali esilahlekelayo iyafinyelela ezigidini ezimbili. Kodwa nakuba kunjalo siyaqhubeka ngenxa yokuthi siyakuqonda kahle kamhlophe ukubaluleka kokugcinwa kwabantu abakulesi sikhungo,'' usho kanjena.Uveze ukuthi isikhungo sitholakala ezingxenyeni ezahlukene ezikhona eThekwini. Uthe kukhona abantu ababagcina bengaphakathi kusona abanye bangaphandle.Uchaze lesi sikhungo njengesiklama indima enkulu kakhulu ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi banakekelwa ngokusezingeni eliphezulu nelifanele abantu ababhekene nengwadla yenkinga yokukhubazeka ngokwengqondo.''Kwabanye konke kwakuhamba kahle empilweni kodwa bagcina bekulesi simo ngenxa yezimo ezinzima ababhekana nazo empilweni okuyizona ezagcina zibathatha zibabeka kule ndawo,'' usho kanjena.Uthe njengoba bezethule kabusha nje bafisa ukuthi isikhungo sigcine sesifinyelela nalapho ebesingakwazi ukuthi sifinyelele khona phambilini.Isikhulu esiphezulu sesikhungo, uMnuz Mbonisi Sibisi, sithe basembhidlangweni wokuqinisekisa ukuthi isikhungo sifinyelela kuwona wonke amazwe ase-Afrika kanjalo nasemazweni aphesheya kwezilwandle.Lokhu uthe akangabazi nakancane ukuthi kuzodala ukuthi kube lula kakhulu ukusebenza kwaso.Uveze ukuthi bayisikhungo esincike kakhulu eminikelweni ukuze siphile. Uveze ukuthi baye besekwe wuMnyango wokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi kwaZulu-Natal kanjalo noMnyango wezeMpilo.
IDALULE eyokugcwala kwezibhedlela kwisiFunda iLembe, iMeya yaKwaDukuza uMnuz Sduduzo Gumede.Lokhu ukuveze njengoba kade ekhuluma ngemuva kokuba kade kwamukelwa isitimela sezempilo sakwaTransnet, iPhelophepa 1.Lolu hlobo lwesitimela lugxila kakhulu kwezempilo. Asimi ndawonye sijwayele ukuhambela izingxenye ezahlukene zezwe.Bese kuhlangene iminyaka eyisikhombisa egcwele sagcina ukufika KwaDukuza.Ekhuluma lapha uGumede uthe bajabule kakhulu ngokubona lesi sitimela futhi emva kwesikhathi eside.Uthe siklama indima enkulu ekwehliseni umthwalo njengoba eveze ukuthi kugcwele vele ezibhedlela eziningi zakule ndawo."Kulusizo olukhulu ukuba khona kwalesi sitimela kuyawehlisa ngampela umthwalo obakhona ezibhedlela zethu zalapha," usho kanjena.Njengoba lesi sitimela sizoba khona amasonto amabili agcwele ubaphosele inselelo abantu baKwaDukuza ukuba baye kusona ukuze bezothola ukusizakala.Eqhubeka unxuse abantu besilisa ukuba babhukule bangabi madolonzima uma kukhulunywa ngodaba lokuya ezikhungweni zezempilo."Siyawadinga amadoda akukhuthalele ukuya ezikhungweni zezempilo kusanesikhathi," usho kanjena.Uthe uhlabeke umxhwele ngenxa yobudlelwane obuhle athe bukhona phakathi kukamasipala noTrasnsnet.Lobu budlelwano uthe buhlomulisa umphakathi ngezindlela ezahlukene.UMnuz Bheki Mendlula wakwaTransnet uthe bajabule ngokubuya kwalesi sitimela KwaDukuza emva kwesikhathi eside kakhulu sagcina.Uveze ukuthi lesi sitimela sesilekelele iziguli ezilinganiselwa ku19 million selokhu sasungulwa ngo1994.Lokhu uthe bayazigqaja kakhulu ngakho ngoba sekwenze umehluko kubantu abaningi.Uthe ukholwa ukuthi baningi abantu abangasizakala ngalolu hlelo inqobo nje uma bezozimisela ngokuthi baziyele bona ezikhungweni zezeMpilo.Ukuchithe ngazo zombili ukuthi lolu hlobo lwezitimela yilapho khona abantu bokufika abakwazi ukuthi bathole ukunakekeleka kahle.Wathi kungamampunge ukuthi isitimela sabo sikubeka eqhulwini ukunakekela kwabakofika.Umphakathi ukushayele ihlombe ukubuya kwalolu hlelo. Elinye ilungu lomphakathi uNklk Ntombikayise Nxumalo lithe bahlabeke umxhwele ngokubuya kwalesi sitimela.Lithe bakholwa ukuthi baningi kakhulu abazothola ukusizakala ezifweni ezahlukene ababhekene nazo.
UJoachim "G6” Chivayo - owaziwa kakhulu ezinkundleni zokuxhumana eZimbabwe ngokuphila impilo yobukhazikhazi, ufunwa uthuli yiDirectorate for Priority Crime Investigation (Hawks) eNingizimu Afrika ngemuva kokuhluleka ukuvela enkantolo.Lo macaphuna-kusale uJoachim Chivayo (33) ongowokudabuka eZimbabwe no-Ayanda Brian Gungwa (20) waseNingizimu Afrika baboshwa ngo26 Novemba 2024, eHelderwyk Estate, eEastrand, yithimba loKlebe eliphenya ngobugebengu obuhleliwe. Icala libhaliswe esiteshini samaphoyisa eBrakpan. Laba bobabili bavela okokuqala enkantolo yeMantshi eBrakpan, 27 Novemba 2024. Ngomhla ka-28 Novemba 2024, bobabili abasolwa banikezwe ibheyili ka-R20 000 umuntu ngamunye enemibandela yokuthi umsolwa ngamunye akumele baphume eGauteng noma bafulathele leli lizwe kuze kuphothulwe udaba.Kwakufanele ukuthi bobabili abasolwa baye esiteshini samaphoyisa eBrakpan kanye ngesonto kusukela mhla zingu-01/12/24. Icala labo lahlehliselwa ukubuyela enkantolo mhla Febhruwari 2025 kuqhutshekwe nophenyo. Kukhishwe izincwadi ezigunyaza ukuboshwa kwabo bobabili abasolwa, izithombe zasatshalaliswa njengabasolwa abafunwayo.

Sithi dudu emndenini kaDlamini nasemphakathini wonke othintekile. Sizoqhubeka nokubeka emkhulekweni labo abalimele."Amaphoyisa abengakaphawuli ngalesi sigameko.
