UQINISEKISE iPhalamende uNgqongqoshe wezeMpilo, uDkt Aaron Motsoaledi, ukuthi kawashodi ama-ARV's eNingizimu Afrika futhi ngeke kuphazamiseke ukusatshalaliswa kwawo. Ukusho lokhu emva kokuba ezinye zezinkampani eziwasabalalisayo, kuvele ukuthi zisenkingeni njengoba zidinga ukutakulwa ngokohlelo lwebhizinisi.UMotsoaledi uphefumule kanje ekhuluma emhlanganweni wekomiti lezeMpilo ePhalamende izolo. Ikomiti belifuna incazelo ngokuthi akuzoba nezinselelo ekuhanjisweni kwemishanguzo ngenxa yezinkinga ezibhekene nezinkampani ezimbili eziwakhiqizayo?"Sinemishanguzo engathatha izinyanga ezintathu ihanjiswa kwabayidingayo ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka. Akukho zinkinga noma izinselelo ekusatshalalisweni kwama-ARV's kuleli, phezu kokuba lezi zinkampani zifuna usizo lokutakulwa." Uthe yingakho umsebenzi wokusabalalisa le mishanguzo kanjalo neminye imithi eyiswa ezibhedlela, yanikwa izinkampani ezehlukene ukuze ingashodi."Uma inkampani eyodwa ihluleka ukusabalalisa imithi nemishanguzo, siya kwenye ezokwazi ukuyisabalalisa. Akukho kuphazamiseka ekuhanjisweni kwemithi kuleli."Uthe banazo izinhlelo zokunqanda ukushoda kwemishanguzo njengoba bekwazi ukubona lapho ishoda khona."Iminyango yezifundazwe inemishanguzo eyenele ukuyisabalalisa kubantu. Sikubeke eqhulwini ekutheni ingashodi imishanguzo kuleli ngoba siyazi kungaba inkinga engakanani uma ingase ishode." Uveze nokuthi babalelwa ku-6 million abantu abadla ama-ARV's kuleli.Amalungu ePhalamende afune ukwazi ukuthi bamephi ekutheni kube nenkampani ezokhiqiza le mishanguzo kuleli?UMotsoaledi uthe u-70% wama-ARV athengwa kuleli. Kulo mhlangano kuvele ukuthi lo msebenzi wokusabalalisa ama-ARV wanikwa izinkampani ezingu-15. Lezi zinkampani zinikwe isikalo okumele zisisabalalise. Okunye okuvelile ukuthi izinkampani ezimbili ebezifune ukutakulwa ngokwebhizinisi, sezisesimweni esikahle ngasezimalini kanti ziqashwe ngelokhozi ukuthi azihluleki ukwenza lo msebenzi.UMotsoaledi uthe uma kwenzeka kuba nezinselelo zokuthi abantu bathole imishanguzo, kuzobe kungahlangene nokuthi uMnyango wakhe uhluleke ukuwahambisa."Kungaba ezinye izinkinga ezingenza abantu bangawatholi ama-ARV's kodwa hhayi ukuthi ingoba kunezinkinga ngasohlangothini loMnyango. Imishanguzo ayishodi, yanele. Abantu abangathuki! Phansi amaphaphu, sinezinhlelo zokuqinisekisa ukuthi akuphazamiseki ukuhanjiswa kwale mishanguzo," kugcizelela uMotsoaledi.
ISUKUNYELWA yisikhwama esixhasa izitshudeni ngemali yokufunda ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme, i-National Student Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS), inkinga yokugembula ehlasele kulezi zikhungo.Lesi sikhwama sibambisene neNational Gambling Board (NGB), sizophuma umkhankaso wokuhambela izikhungo, kuxwayiswa izitshudeni ngobungozi bokugembula.Ibamba lesikhulu esiphezulu seNSFAS, uMnuz Waseem Carrim, sithe basukumela lesi sihlava emva kokukhathazeka ngenkinga ye-online gambling. UCarrim uthe ezinye izitshudeni ezijovwe yilo mkhuba, zisebenzisa imali eziyinikwa wuhulumeni ukugembula."Ucwaningo luveza ukuthi ukwanda kwezikhangiso zokugembula nengcindezi ebhekene nezitshudeni yokufuna imali, kwenza ukuthi intsha ingene ogibeni lokugembula. Sizibophezele ekwesekeni izitshudeni kwezemfundo kanti ukugembula kungenza abangene shi kulo mkhuba, bagcine sebengenzi kahle ezifundweni zabo, bacekele phansi ikusasa labo. Sizoqwashisa izitshudeni ukuthi zicabangisise kahle ngaphambi kokungena kulolu gibe," usho kanje.Ibamba lesikhulu esiphezulu se-NGB, uMnuz Lungile Dukwana, sithe ngalo mkhankaso bahlose ukuvikela intsha ukuthi ingene isinolwazi ngengozi yokugembula. "Sizogxila ekuqwashiseni ngokugembula kusetshenziswa i-online kanjalo neyezikhangiso zokugembula ezande kakhulu ezinkundleni zokuxhumana. Sisamile ekutheni ukugembula kumele kuhambisane nemithetho yezwe kanti kumele kuvikelwe izingane nabantu abalutheka kalula." Lezi zinhlaka maduzane zizosayina isivumelwano sokusebenzisana ukuze kugqugquzelwe izitshudeni ukuthi zingasebenzisi imali yeNSFAS, ukugembula. Kuzokwakhiwa nezinhlelo zokuvimba ukuthi izitshudeni zasemanyuvesi nasemakolishi, zingalutheki ekutheni zingene ekugembuleni.Akuqali ukuthi kube nokukhathazeka ngenkinga yokugembula kuleli, ikakhulu esihlasele intsha. Kwakhalwa ngenkinga yokwanda kakhulu kwezikhangiso, njengembangela yokuthi abantu baheheke ukuthi bagembule.'Nyakenye iPhalamende liyibhunge kabanzi indaba yokugembula nomthelela onakho kubantu bakuleli. Imibiko iveza ukuthi kuleli kusuka ngo-2023 kuya ku-2024, abantu bakuleli bachithe izigidi begembula. Ukugembula okuhamba phambili wukubhejela ezemidlalo, kanti abesilisa abasebasha yibona okuthiwa bamandla ekugembuleni.Akuzona izitshudeni kuphela okwavela ukuthi zimandla ekugembuleni, kodwa nabahola izibonelelo zikahulumeni ikakhulu imali yesondlo sabantwana edume ngemali yeqolo, nesibonelelo sabangatohozi, kwavela ukuthi bangene shi kulo mkhuba.
IYASHUBA impi ebhekiswe esikhwameni iGovernment Employees Medical Scheme (Gems), njengoba izinyunyana zabasebenzi bahulumeni sezifake isicelo sokuya esitelekeni esisemthethweni uma izingxoxo zokubuyekeza isinqumo sokunyusa imali salesi sikhwama, ziphunza. Lokhu kuvezwe ngumfelandawonye wezinyunyana iFedusa, efake isicelo kwiNedlac, sokuthi igunyaze izinyunyana ukuthi ziye esitelekeni uma izingxoxo eziqhubekayo zokuchitha ukunyuswa kwemali ngo-9.5%, zigcina zingafinyelelanga esivumelwaneni.Ngempelasonto le nyunyana kanjalo nenyunyana iPSA, zimashele emahhovisi ahlukene akwa-Gems, lapho zizwakalise ukungenami ngokunyuswa kwemali ngale ndlela. Lezi zinyunyana zifuna kwenziwe nocwaningo ngokusebenza kwezimali kulesi sikhwama. Isitatimende seFedusa, sithe sithola nezeluleko zomthetho ngokunyuswa kwemali ekhokhelwa le medical aid."Sifuna ukuya esitelekeni uma kungukuthi izingxoxo azitheli zithelo. Asihambisani nokunyuswa ngale ndlela kwemali njengoba nanyakenye yanyuswa kakhulu," kusho isitatimende.Sithe ibiyisiqalo kokukhulu okuzayo imibhikisho ebingempelasonto ezifundazweni ezehlukene. "Lesi sikhwama sasisungulelwe ukusiza abasebenzi bahulumeni. Yingakho sizoyiqinisa imikhankaso yokulwa nokunyuswa kwemali," usho kanje.Kwenzeka lokhu nje izinyunyana eziyingxenye yeCosatu, zinesithangami sabezindaba namhlanje ngomnyakazo wazo okuleli sonto, mayelana nokunyuswa kwemali nguGems. Nalezi zinyunyana zisho ngazwi linye ukuthi akuchithwe ibhodi leGems kuphinde kubuyekezwe isinqumo sokunyusa imali.Kusasa izinyunyana ezikwiCosatu zizobhikisha zizwakalisa ukungenami ngokunyuswa kwemali, bese ngoLwesine umbhikisho ubhekiswe ekomkhulu lalesi sikhwama ePitoli. I-Principal Officer yakwaGems, uDkt Stanley Moloabi, yakhala ngokubhubhudlwa, ukuxhashazwa nenkohlalalo eyenziwa abasebenzi okwenze kwanyuka imali ye-medical aid.Yaveza ukuthi abanye babasebenzi basebenzisa ngendlela engafanele i- medical aid, balalise ezibhedlela ezizimele izihlobo zabo ezingakhaviwe ngaphansi kwesikhwama."Minyaka yonke siyayinyusa mali njengoba kwenzeka nakwamanye ama-medical aid. Sikhokhe imali ephindiwe kunale esasiyihlelile nyakenye ngenxa yokunyuka kakhulu kwezindleko zalabo esibakhavile. Abasebenzi bayayixhaphaza i-medical aid kanti abanye benza nenkohlakalo," yasho kanje.
ISISHOSHOVU esilwela ukuthi abokufika abaseNingizimu Afrika ngokungemthetho, baphume baphele kuleli, esingaphansi kwenhlangano yaso iMarch and March, uNkk Jacinta Ngobese-Zuma, sesiveze ukuthi abantu kumele bakuyeke ukuseyamanisa namaqembu ahlukene ezepolitiki.Lokhu kulandela ukuthi uNkk Ngobese-Zuma ebonakale emcimbini obuwenziwe yiqembu lezepolitiki, i-Action SA, eGoli, ngoMgqibelo, lapho elimemezele uMengameli walo, uMnuz Herman Mashaba, njengozoba sembangweni wesobumeya kulo masipala.Uthe ubengomunye wezikhulumi kulo mcimbi, okube nemvunge ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ngaye, njengoba abanye bethi useyingxenye yaleli qembu. Ekhuluma neSolezwe, uveze ukuthi sekukaningi ekuveza ukuthi alikho iqembu lezepolitiki azoba yingxenye yalo, yena akwenzayo ukuthi alwele ukuthi abangaphandle bahambe kuleli lizwe."Mina angisazi ukuthi kumele ngikuchaze ngithini, ipolitiki yobuqembu angeke ngibe yingxenye yayo ngoba ngiyakwazi engikufunayo ngenhlangano iMarch and March. Ngeke ngiphike ukuthi amaqembu amaningi aseke anginxenxa ukuthi ngiwajoyine, ngaphandle kwe-ANC ne-EFF kodwa amanye aseke aba nemihlangano nami futhi ngangavuma. Ngiye emcimbini wangoMgqibelo, ngoba bengimenyiwe futhi i-Action SA, isiseseke kakhulu uma simashela abokufika. UMnuz Zwakele Mncwango ngomunye umholi wayo, olokhu aba nathi sisaqala kuze kube yimanje ngakho nami uma bengibiza ngizoya ezintweni zabo futhi ngifike ngikhulume ngesikufisayo ngezwe lethu," kusho uNkk Ngobese-Zuma.Uthe nakweminye imicimbi yamanye amaqembu uma ebizwa, uzoya futhi afike akhulume ngezifiso zabo kuze kube ziyezwakala. "Ukuhambela imicimbi ehlukene yezepolitiki kwenza njengenhlangano sihlangane nabaholi abasePhalamende, abazothatha lokhu esikushoyo bakudlulisele phambili kubantu okumele basukumele izikhalo zethu. Ngakho basazongibona nje emicimbini yamaqembu ahlukene uma engibiza," kusho yena.Izinkundla zokuxhumana, uthe yizona ezibhebhethekisa izinto ezingekho okumele abantu baziqaphele.
ITHI seyakhuluma nezinhlaka zikahulumeni kwaze koma amathe, imindeni eyisishiyagalolunye yaseMzomusha, KwaBester, eNanda, ngomhosha ovele ugcwale amanzi, kumbozeke izindlu uma kuke kwana imvula enamandla.Le mindeni isho kanje izolo, ngesikhathi Isolezwe lihambele le ndawo, kulandela imvula enamandla eyidlive ngoLwesihlanu nangoMgqibelo.Ziyisikhombisa izindlu ezivaleleke ngaphansi kwamanzi kule ndawo, kuzona kukhona ezimbalwa ezivela kancane ngophahla ngesikhathi ezinye zingaveli nangokhalo. Kuphinde kube khona ezinye ezimbili, ezingasavikelekile emanzini, imindeni ehleli phakathi ivalelekile njengoba amanzi esavimbanisile endleleni okuhanjwa kuyo. Le mindeni esiphenduke ondingasithebeni, itshele leli phephandaba ukuthi alukho usizo esalutholile kuhulumeni kusukela ngoLwesihlanu. Iphinde yaveza ukuthi ikhathazwa nawukuthi kunokwenzeka ukuthi kukhona abantu abavaleleke ngaphansi kwamanzi njengoba ikhansela lendawo noMasipala weTheku, beqhubeka nokuhambela kude nendawo yesehlakalo."Sinovalo lokuthi kukhona esingababoni, abebephuza (utshwala) ngesikhathi kuhlasela imvula enamandla. Kuze kube yimanje asibaboni ngoba siyazana phela njengoba singebaningi. Nasezingcingweni asibatholi. Sifikelwa umcabango obuhlungu wokuthi cishe basavalelekile emanzini,” kusho uNkk Fikile Mahlangu. Uqhube wathi yena nowakhe umndeni, baphuma nababekugqokile kuphela, bevuswa esinye isihlobo, esasesibonile ukuthi amanzi eza ngamandla.Uveze ukuthi into edala ukuba bakhahlamezeke ukuthi imizi yabo iseduze komhosha okuchithekela kuwo amanzi asuke ehla ngamaphaseji emizini eyakhiwe ezinhlangothini ezimbili ezihlukaniswa umhosha."Njalo uma kunalawo manzi avele agcwale ezindlini zethu. Akukhona okokuqala sibhekana nale nkinga, sekuyiminyaka ngeminyaka,” usho kanje. Uthe zikhona izindlu ezingolindela abase bethenjiswe ukongena kuzo eTafuleni, eNanda. Uveze ukuthi njalo uma sekufanele bathuthwe bayiswe khona, ikhansela livele libike imbiba nebuzi."NgoLwesithathu, kwakufanele sithuthwe nezimpahla zethu, nakhona lakhala ngokuthi abantu abaphelele. Ukube lasithutha ngabe wonke lo monakalo awusificanga,” kusho uNkk Mahlangu.Ukhale ngokuthi uma kufanele bayovota, osopolitiki bangena umuzi nomuzi, bebanxenxa ukuba bayovota, uma sebesenkingeni ekanje, bahambela kude. Esinye isakhamuzi, uMnuz Lungani Mdluli, sithe into ababekade bekhala ngayo ukuthi kufakwe amapayipi amakhulu azokwazi ukumelana nomthamo wamathantala amanzi abakhahlameza njalo uma linile."Ukube bayasilalela bawafake la mapayipi esiwashoyo ngabe ayikho yonke le nkinga. Ngabe amanzi angena epayipini, ayophumela ngaphesheya komgwaqo lapho okungekho zindlu khona,” kusho uMdluli.Ikhansela le ndawo, uMnuz Themba Mnguni liziphendulela, lithe abakhahlamezekile babuye babe nokungabambisani kahle nabezinhlaka zikahulumeni."Udaba ludala, lwaqala ngisho nami ngingakabi yikhansela. Ngokubona ukuthi sekujwayelekile ukuthi kwenzeke inkinga efanayo, ngibize zonke izinhlaka zikahulumeni, nganxusa ukuthi zingenelele," kusho uMnguni. Uthe bagcine beyokhuluma neNkosi yamaQadi, uMnuz Mqoqi Ngcobo, yabanika indawo yokwakha izindlu zesikhashana eTafuleni. "Kuthe sekufanele bayongena kuzo, bakhala ngokuthi zinamagumbi amancane (4 room), bona imizi yabo mikhulu (6 room)," kusho uMnguni, othe nangeledlule ngesikhathi sekuhlelwe ukuthi bazothuthwa, kuvele kwaba khona imindeni emithathu kuphela, abanye kwathiwa abekho."Kubuye kube nzima ukulungisa isimo salolu hlobo. Izolo (ngoMgqibelo) ngizamile ukuyoxoxa nabo kodwa ngishiye phakathi, sebehlasela umshayeli wami, bemshaya. Nokho ke ngeke siphele amandla, sizoqhubeka sixoxe nabo," kusho uMnguni othe usezinhlelweni zokubiza omunye umhlangano, iphinde ixoxwe eyokulekelela umphakathi ngale nkinga. Uthe ikhona iprojekthi eqhubekayo yokuzama ukubheka udaba lomhosha kanjalo namapayipi ahambisa amanzi kule ndawo. Ngesikhathi ithimba laleli phephandaba lifika endaweni yesigameko, lifikisane noNkk Sibongile Khawula, oyilungu lasePhalamende le-EFF obesebuya okwesibili, elethe umnikelo wokudla kulabo abakhahlamezekile. Uthe ubone umonakalo ngesikhathi edlula ngemoto ngoMgqibelo, wama, okuyilapho ethole khona kabanzi ngesimo."Okubuhlungu ukuthi uma sithinta ikhansela, lisitshela eyokuthi abantu kufanele ingabe abasekho la. La elithi kufanele ingabe baye khona, awukho ugesi namanzi,” kusho uNkk Khawula.Uthe into emxakayo ukuthi umphakathi ungobasi babo. "Kungani bengezi kubantu uma bevelelwe yinkinga njengoba nami ngenzile?” ubuze kanje.Uthe bacele ngoMgqibelo, ukuthi kuze iloli likamasipala elizomunca wonke amanzi, ukuze bakwazi ukungena babheke ukuthi abekho yini abavaleleke ezindlini.
UMNDENI wowesifazane waseGlencoe, ukhomba ngenjumbane ubuholi besibhedlela iDundee Provincial, eDundee, ngobudedengu osola ukuthi buholele ekushoneni kwelungu lawo, uNkk Martha Mlangeni.Lokhu kushiwo yindodana kaNkk Mlangeni (71), uMnuz Siphiwe Dube, okhala ngokuthi impatho nesimo esingesihle kulesi sibhedlela ngesinye sezizathu abona ukuthi siholele ekutheni kushone unina, odlule emhlabeni esesekhaya ngoMsombuluko.Elandisa ngokushona kukanina, uDube uthe "intombi emzalayo” yangeniswa kulesi sibhedlela ngoFebhuwari 5 ixinwe wukugula okweyamene nezinso, okuthe isingaphakathi kwangaba kuhle neze ngenxa yokuthi isimo sesibhedlela asigculisi sinenkinga yokuthi asinawo amanzi, okwenza ukuthi amathoyilethi angasebenziseki."Umama ukhale kakhulu nangomiyane abagcwele emawodini esibhedlela okuhambisana nokuthi kwenile kakhulu emagcekeni esibhedlela, futhi kubukeka kungekho muntu ozimisile ngokuthi asukumele leyo nkinga. "Leso simo siphoqe ukuthi umama aze acele ukudedelwa izinsukwana ayolulamela ekhaya ngoFebhuwari 13 ngoba engasakwazi ukubekezela, kanti kuzothi esesekhaya ashone. Bekumele abuyele esibhedlela ngoLwesibili, usho kanje.Eqhuba, uthe ukholwa wukuthi ukube isimo sesibhedlela besigculisa ngabe mhlawumbe unina akafanga, ngoba ubengeke acele ukuthi adedelwe ayolulamela ekhaya izinsukwana ukuba konke bekuhamba kahle esibhedlela."Okunye okungiphatha kabi kakhulu wukuthi ngenkathi umama esalulamela ekhaya ngizamile kaningi ukuxhumana nabesibhedlela. Bengizama ukuthola ukuthi kungani isimo esinjena bengasisukumeli ngoba phela sibeka engcupheni impilo yeziguli - kepha bavika ngokuthi abanayo imali yokulungisa izinto ezonakele esibhedlela. Lokho kukhombe ngokusobala ukuthi abayikhathalele impilo yeziguli,” kusho uDube.Uthe kuyadumaza ukuthi isibhedlela esikhulu nesidala kangaka futhi esiwusizo emphakathini waseDundee, Glencoe, Newcastle nakwezinye izindawo ezakhele iDundee - kubukeka singenandaba nenhlalonhle, ukuphepha nokuhlanzeka okubalulekile ezigulini ezelashelwa khona."Ngifisa ukuthi kube nezinyathelo ezithathwayo ngalesi simo ngoba asikwazi ukuqhubeka sisebenzise isibhedlela esisesimeni esishayisa amahloni ngale ndlela. Lesi simo senza ukuthi singakhululeki ukuyisa abathandiweyo bethu bayokwelashelwa kusona,” usho kanje.Kuthintwa okhulumela uMnyango wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Nathi Olifant, ukuzwa ukuphawula kwabo ngalolu daba, ushaye ngezimfishane wathi uMnyango awukwazi ukuphawula ngodaba oluthinta isiguli esishonele ekhaya, hhayi esibhedlela. Ebuzwa ngesimo sesibhedlela, uthe bewuMnyango abakwazi ukuphawula ngalokho.
KUPHAZAMISEKE uhlelo lokufunda nokufundisa esezikoleni uMkhumbane Secondary, eMayville, eThekwini, ngenxa yesenzo sothisha abawu-20 bakulesi sikole abadube umsebenzi bekhala ngokufakwa kwamakhamera - okusolwa ukuthi afakwe wuthishanhloko wakulesi sikole emagunjini okufundela ukuze kuqine ezokuphepha.Umthombo ozazi zonke ezenzeka kulesi sikole ongathandanga ukudalulwa ukuze uvikeleke, udalule ukuthi isisusa sale nkinga kube wukuthi uthishanhloko, uMnuz Ntokozo Ngobese, wafaka la makhamera phecelezi ama-CCTV maphakathi nonyaka nyakenye, evumelana nesigungu esilawula ukusebenza kwesikole, ngoba enzela ukuthi kuphephe."Lokho wayekwenza ngoba enzela ukuthi kunciphe noma kunqamuke izigameko ebese zidla lubi esikoleni zokuntshontshelana kwabafundi izinto zabo ezimqoka okubandakanya imifaniswano (okungamajezi), izikhaftini zokudla kwekhefu, ama-calculator nokunye - kwase kuvunyelwana ngokuthi lesi sinyathelo singasiza kubhekwe phambili,” kusho umthombo.Kuvele ukuthi kuthe ngoMsombuluko nangoLwesibili, labo thisha ababalelwa ku-20 banqume ukungalubhadi emsebenzini bekhala ngesenzo sikathishanhloko, okuvela nokuthi sebefuna nokuthi amiswe noma axoshwe emsebenzini ngoba abahambisani nesenzo sakhe, abakhala ngokuthi kwakumele ukuthi abonisane nabo kuqala andukuba kwenziwe lokho.Kuthiwa okwenza ukuthi isimo singalungiseki kalula, yize udaba seluhambe lwaze lwafika nakwaboMnyango wezeMfundo - wukuthi isigungu esilawula ukusebenza kwesikole simi nothishomkhulu kulokhu, okudala ukuthi kube nokungqubuzana okukhulu nalabo thisha.NgoLwesithathu ntambama, kusabalale incwadi yomhlangano ophuthumayo wabazali, abebebizelwe ukuthi kuzobhungwa ngalolu daba izolo, ngenhloso yokuzama ukuthola isisombululo sokuthi uhlelo lokufunda nokufundisa luqhubeke ngendlela ejwayelekile.Leli phephandaba lizame kaningi ukuxhumana nomunye wamalungu esigungu esilawula ukusebenza kwesikole, uNksz Nomonde Matumtum, obethembise ukuthi uzolilandisa ngakho konke okwenzekayo nokuzokwenzeka ukulungisa lesi simo.Nokho lize lashona elayizolo uNksz Matumtum engasifezanga isithembiso sakhe, obekuthi uma elokhu ezanywa ngocingo nangemiyalezo kwiWhatsApp wakhe - akhale ngokuthi usabambeke emhlanganweni wesibili wokubhunga ngalo lolu daba.UMnyango wezeMfundo awutholakalanga ukuze ucacise ngenqubo yamakhamera ezikoleni.
I-SABC ikuchithile ukuthi ukunyamalala komsakazi wohlelo lwasekuseni kwiRadio 2000, uSbusiso "DJ Sbu" Leope, kuhlangene nokuvela kwegama lakhe kwiKhomishini kaMadlanga.U-DJ Sbu ubengazwakali emoyeni kusukela ekuqaleni kwesonto esiphuma kulo. Oyinhloko yezokuXhumana kwa-SABC, uMmoni Ngubane, uthe bayakuqinisekisa ukuthi uDJ Sbu ubengekho emoyeni kusukela ngoLwesibili.Nakuba engacacisanga ukuthi yini ebangele ukuthi engazwakali emoyeni kodwa uthe ukunyamalala kwakhe emoyeni akuhlangene nokwenzeka kwikhomishini."Iziphathimandla zingakuqinisekisa ukuthi uDJ Sbu uzobuyela emoyeni ngoMsombuluko (esho owanamhlanje)," kuphetha uMmoni. Ukungazwakali kwephimbo lalesi silomo kwi-Big Breakfast Show (BBS) with DJ Sbu, kwenze abanye abalaleli bashaya amakhala, basola ukuthi izikhulu zeRadio 2000 zimmisile emuva kokuba igama lakhe lithinteke enkohlakalweni. U-DJ Sbu uzichithile izinsolo ezimyamanisa nenkohlakalo kuMasipala waseKurhuleni ezenziwe yiNhloko yezoMthetho emisiwe kulo masipala, u-Advocate Kemi Behari, ngesikhathi ivele kwiKhomishini kaMadlanga ngoMsombuluko odlule.UBehari ubethula ubufakazi ngokugxambukela kosopolitiki ecaleni lokuqondisa ubugwegwe kowayeyisikhulu esiphezulu, uLesiba Mojapelo. Uthe uDJ Sbu nowayenguzakwabo kwiTS Records futhi oyilungu le-ANC, uThembinkosi "TK” Nciza, bahlomula esambeni sika-R100 million.Esitatimendeni sakhe uDJ Sbu, uthe lezi zinsolo zingamanga, zingcolisa igama lakhe futhi azinasisekelo. Uthe kusukela aqala emsebenzini wokusakaza nowokophatha amabhizinisi kanye nokusebenzela umphakathi, usebenza ngokwethembeka nangokuzihlonipha.U-DJ Sbu usabise ngokubathathela izinyathelo zomthetho abaqhubeka nokungcolisa igama lakhe futhi wazibophezela ekusebenzisaneni nengalo yomthetho ephenya ngalezi zinsolo.
KUNETWETWE lokuthi bengase bangaholi abasebenzi kuphinde kuphazamiseke nokusebenza kukaMasipala wesiFunda uThukela ngenxa yokudliwa kwe-akhawunti yasebhange yomkhandlu.I-akhawunti yasebhange ishaqwe emva kokuba umkhandlu uhluleke ukukhola isikweletu senkampani i-RASP Consulting.Umasipala ukweleta i-RASP Consulting izigidi zamarandi kodwa umsebenzi owawenziwa yi-RASP emkhandlwini oka-R137 million.Ngonyaka owedlule umasipala wangena esivumelwananeni sokukhokhelana ne-RASP Consulting kulandela isinqumo senkantolo.Umasipala uhlulekile ukugcina isivumelwano nokwenze ukuthi kushaqwe i-akhawunti yasebhange.Okhulumela umasipala, uMnuz Jabulani Mkhonza, uthe bazonikela enkantolo ngokushesha beyozama ukumisa kokushaqwa kwe-akhawunti."Sizokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi akuphazamiseki ukuhanjiswa kwezidingo." UMkhonza uthe bawazisile uMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu noMnyango wezeziMali ngalesi simo."Nasemkhandlwini bekunomhlangano wesigungu esiphezulu, kwaphinde kwaba nomhlangano womkhandlu lapho amakhansela aziswe khona ngokushaqwa kwe-akhawunti yomkhandlu."Amaqembu aphikisayo awotha ubomvu. Ikhansela le-DA, uMnuz Thys Janse van Rensburg, lithe lifuna ukwazi ukuthi kungani umasipala ungazange ukhokhe njengokwesivumelwano?UVan Rensburg uthe isitatimende sasebhange sikhombisa ukuthi umasipala wawunemali ewu-R13 million kwi-akhawunti yawo, ngoDisemba.Uthe kuyabaxaka ukuthi kungani umasipala ungazange uwukhokhe u-R3 million okwakufanele uwukhokhe ngoDisemba."Manje-ke sekunenzalo elinganiselwa ku-R31 million umkhandlu okufanele uyikhokhe."Uvan Rensburg uthe bafuna kuxoshwe imenenja yomkhandlu, uMnuz Langelihle Jili."UJili kufanele achaze ngokwehluleka kwakhe ukwenza umsebenzi."UVan Rensburg uthe bafuna kube nomhlangano womkhandlu oyisipesheli lapho kuzokhulunywa khona ngalolu daba."Sifuna ukuthi kumenywe uMphathiswa wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu (uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi) noMphathiswa wezeziMali (uMnuz Francois Rodgers) ukuba babe yingxenye yomhlangano okhethekile. Sifuna kukhulunywe indaba yokuthi umkhandlu ufakwe ngaphansi kweso lomlawuli."USotswebhu Sandile Dlungwane uthe kuningi okuzophazamiseka ngenxa yokudliwa kwe-akhawunti okubalwa kukho nokuhlinzekwa kwamanzi."Umkhandlu awukwazi kwenza lutho. I-akhawunti ikhokhela udizili wezimoto ukuze ziyosiza abantu, ikhokhela ugesi ukuze iziphehli zamanzi zikwazi ukusebenza, ikhokhela amakhemikhali afakwa emanzini ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi amanzi esiwanika abantu ahlanzekile. I-akhawunti iyona futhi ekhokhela abasebenzi. Abantu ngeke basizakale njengoba kudliwe i-akhawunti yasebhange. Akukhulunywe nabasebenzi."UDlungwane uthe bafuna nokuthi kuthathelwe izinyathelo amakhansela e-IFP aphume ashiya umhlangano obubizelwe ukuzobhunga ngalolu daba.
IBAMBA likaNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa, uSolwazi Firoz Cachalia, lidalule ukuthi izinga lokubulawa kwabantu ezweni lehle ngo-8.7% ekoteni yesithathu ka-2025, kwathi izibalo zobugebengu ngokwehlukana kwakho sezizonke zona zehla ngo-6.7% ngaleso sikhathi.UCachalia ubekhuluma esithangamini nabezindaba ngoLwesihlanu ezokwethula umbiko ngobugebengu ezigamekweni ezibikiwe phakathi kuka-Okthoba 1 kuya kuDisemba 31, 2025.UNgqongqoshe uthe isinqumo sokushicilela izibalo zobugebengu ezweni ngamakota siyindlela kahulumeni yokuzibophezela ukubeka obala konke okuthinta ubugebengu, nakho konke okwenziwayo ukuzama ukulungisa isimo."Kudingeka ukuthi abantu bakithi bazi ukuthi zingaki izigameko zobugebengu ezibikwayo emaphoyiseni nsuku zonke, nokuthi kubonakale ukuthi ukhona yini umehluko - okungaba ubungcono noma ukonakala kwesimo. Futhi senzela nokuthi umphakathi, abamabhizinisi nabantu bonke, bakuqonde okwenzekayo ezindaweni abakuzo,” usho kanje.Uthe nakuba amacala amaningi obugebengu okubulala, ukudlwengula, ukuphanga nokugqekeza eqhubeka nokwehla, kodwa akwamukelekile ukuthi asaqhubeka nokuba wuhlupho kubantu nsuku zonke.Udalule ukuthi amacala okubulala akhombise ukwehla kakhulu, njengoba ehlile futhi ngonyaka wezimali ngo-2023/24. Kulokho ehle ngo-8.7% okusho ukuthi ehle ngezigameko eziwu-602.Ubugebengu bubonke bona behle ngo-6.7% okusho ukuthi izigameko zabo zehle ngeziwu-12 682, okwenze ukuthi kule minyaka emibili edlule sebubonke ubugebengu behle ngo-8.3%, okusho ukwehla ngezigameko eziwu-15 763."Nokho kumqoka ukucacisa ukuthi nakuba lezi zibalo zokwehla kobugebengu kanjena ziwumehluko omuhle, kodwa futhi akukalungi nhlobo njengoba kusenenqwaba yezindawo ezahlukene lapho kukhomba ukwanda khona ubugebengu,” usho kanje.Eqhuba, uthe kubathokozisile ukwehla kakhudlwana kwezigameko zobugebengu bokubulala ezifundazweni ezinhlanu okuyiKwaZulu-Natal, Gauteng, Mpumalanga, Free State neNorth West. NaseWestern Cape ne-Eastern Cape kuthe ukwehla; kwakhuphuka kancane eLimpopo naseNorthern Cape.UCachalia uzwakalise ukukhathazeka ngokwanda kwezigameko zokubulawa kwamaphoyisa, okuvele ukuthi u-80% wazo owamaphoyisa abulawe engekho emsebenzini."Lena yinkinga enkulu nesenginqume ukuthi ngibambisane nophiko lwamaphoyisa ukuzama ukunqanda ukubhebhetheka kwazo. Okunye okusikhathaza kakhulu yizibhamu ezisetshenziselwa ukubulala, ukuphanga nokwenza ubugebengu obuhleliwe. Yingakho sizothatha izinyathelo zokuthi lezo zibhamu zitholakale futhi kugwenywe ukuthi ziwelele ezandleni ezingafanele,” kusho uCachalia.Mayelana nezigameko zokuhlukumeza okweyamene nobulili nokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane, osekuvele kumenyezelwe ukuthi kuyinhlekelele ezweni - uCachalia uthe sekuvele kunemizamo abaphezu kwayo yokuthi kulungiswe futhi kugwenywe ukubhebhetheka kwakho.Udalule nokuthi ngoMashi 6 bazoba nomhlangano nezinhlaka ezahlukene ezibhekele ubugebengu ezweni ukuze kubhungwe ngezinye izindlela zokunqanda ubugebengu ezweni."Luselude uhambo okumele siluhambe ukulwa nalesi simo, futhi siyathembisa nokuthi ngeke siliphose ithawula kuze kube wukuthi siyayinqoba le mpi ezweni ngoba inhloso yethu wukuthi iNingizimu Afrika kugcine kuyizwe okuphephile ukuba kulona,” kusho yena.
UNDUNANKULU waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, ubona ikusasa elingcono lesifundazwe lilele ekutheni uhulumeni wokubambisa usinde ezembeni.UNtuli uthe kuningi okuhle okuzokwenzeka KwaZulu-Natal uma uhulumeni wokubambisana unikezwa ithuba lokuqhubeka uphathe isifundazwe.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ethula inkulumo yokuvula umhlangano weKhabhinethi KwaZulu-Natal, ilekgotla.Umhlangano ubizelwe ukuzolungiselela inkulumo ngesimo sesifundazwe ezokwethulwa wuNtuli ngesonto elizayo.UNtuli uzokwethula inkulumo yakhe ngoLwesihlanu, kuzoqala iSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini sivule ngokusemthethweni isiShayamthetho ngoLwesine.Kuyiwa kule nkulumo nje kukhona amaqembu aqhubekayo nokulolela izembe uhulumeni wokubambisana.Iqembu elingababeki benkosi esifundazweni, iNFP, lisanda kuveza ukuthi lizokweseka umzamo wesibili wokuchitha uNtuli kanye nohulumeni wokubambisana.UNtuli uthe kuningi okungonakala uma kuchithwa uhulumeni wokubambisana."Sesike sabona lapha KwaZulu-Natal ukuthi kuba nzima kanjani uma lungekho uzinzo. Sazibonela sonke into eyenzeka ngesikhathi kunezibhelu zokuzitapela. Abantu balahlekelwa yimisebenzi. Abantu basebephila ngokwesaba futhi nabatshali mali base behambela kude nesifundazwe."UNtuli uthe kuningi okuhle okuzokwenzeka uma uhulumeni wokubambisana unikwa ithuba."Uhulumeni wokubambisana iyona nqola ezosiyisa entuthukweni. Uma sibambene sizokwazi ukuxazulula izinkinga ezibhekene nesifundazwe. Singakwazi ukulwa nobubha, sidale amathuba emisebenzi siphinde futhi sakhe nengqalasizinda."Ezintweni uNtuli athe ziseqhulwini, wudaba lokuvalwa kwenkampani iHullets, ukulwa namatele kanye nokwakhiwa kwesitimela esigijimayo esizosuka eThekwini siye eGoli.UNtuli uthe uhulumeni wesifundazwe kanye nokazwelonke basemizameni yokuvimba ukuthi kuvalwe iHullets."Akukhona ukuthi iyavalwa manje kodwa izinkomba zikhomba ubuthakatha obungase budale ukuthi ize igcine ivaleka. Manje ke kufanele silwe sonke ukuze ingavalwa." UNtuli uthe kuyabakhathaza ukungafiki ngokushesha komgomo wamatele.UNtuli uthe inkinga enkulu wukuthi uhulumeni kazwelonke awukakuhlonzi njengenhlekelele ukubheduka kwamatele."Sasifuna ukuthi udaba lubekwe njengenhlekelele kodwa kwase kuthiwa umthetho uthi kufanele kube uhulumeni kazwelonke olumemezela njengenhlenkelele nathi bese siyalandela ke ngoba wudaba oluthinta izifundazwe eziningi."UNtuli uthe bameme izikhulu zePrasa neTransnet ukuba zizochaza ukuthi sizoqala nini ukusebenza isitimela esigijimayo."Sagcina kuthiwa kwenziwa ucwaningo nokuthi kunemali ebekwe eceleni. Sifuna ukwazi ukuthi siyosibona nini ngamehlo sesigijima."
Ucwaningo, olushicilelwe ku-Science of the Total Environment, luthole ukuthi yonke inhlobo yamaqakelo abawahlolile okungama-sanitary pad kanye ne-pantyliner aqukethe okungenani amakhemikhali amabili aphazamisa i-endocrine (EDCs). Abacwaningi bahlaziye izinhlobo ezingu-16 zama-sanitary pads kanye nezinhlobo eziyisishiyagalombili zama-pantyliner athengiswa ezitolo ezidumile zaseNingizimu Afrika, ahlanganisa amanani entengo futhi okuhlanganisa nemikhiqizo ekhangiswa "njengesebenzisa izithako zemvelo”, "ezisekelwe ezitshalweni” noma "ezingenawo amakhemikhali ayingozi”. Okutholakele kubonise ukungcoliswa okusabalele kuyo yonke imikhiqizo ehloliwe. Abacwaninhi bahlole amakilasi amathathu amakhulu ama-EDC - ama-phthalates, ama-bisphenols (okubandakanya i-bisphenol A, noma i-BPA) nama-parabens. Iphedi ne-panty liner ngalinye bekuqukethe okungenani amakhemikhali amabili."Ama-EDC, afana nama-phthalates, ama-bisphenols nama-parabens, asetshenziswa kakhulu emikhiqizweni yabathengi futhi ahlotshaniswa nobuthi bokuzala, ukuphazamiseka kokulingana kwama-hormon kanye nomdlavuza," kuphawula ucwaningo. "Imikhiqizo yokuya esikhathini imelela into engase ibe khona kodwa engaziwa kangako. ENingizimu Afrika, izinhlobo eziningi zikhangisa ngokuthi azinawo amakhemikhali ayingozi, kodwa ucwaningo oluncane luqinisekise ukuthi imithombo ye-EDC engaba khona."
Amaphoyisa ophiko lwe-Anti-Corruption Unit KwaZulu-Natal abophe amaphoyisa amabili osayitsheni ngecala lokuqola eNanda ngoLwesihlanu, zingama-20 kuNhlolanja wezi-2026.OSayitsheni ababili, oyedwa esiteshini samaphoyisa eNanda omunye eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseNtuzuma, kubikwa ukuthi bebeqola imali yalabo abebeqhuba amashibhi angekho emthethweni kanye nalabo abebedayisa ugwayi ongekho emthethweni endaweni yase-Amaoti.Kwase kuphele izinyanga ezimbalwa abasolwa ababili beya kuzisulu, baziveze njengamaphoyisa baphinde baveze amakhadi oqobo amaphoyisa kanye nezibhamu ngaphambi kokuthi bafune imali kwabashonile ukuze bangababophi. Ngomhla ka-14 kuJanuwari 2026, umphakathi wase-Amaoti wahlangana wabamba abasolwa ababili, wabaphuca izikhali wabayisa esiteshini samaphoyisa esise-Amaoti. Amaphoyisa abesebenza esiteshini samaphoyisa aqondise amalungu omphakathi esiteshini samaphoyisa eNanda ukuyovula amacala.Amaphoyisa afanayo kubikwa ukuthi aphuma esiteshini nala maphoyisa abanjwe ngemuva evenini yamaphoyisa.Ngesikhathi umphakathi ufika esiteshini samaphoyisa eNanda uphithene ikhanda lapho uthola ukuthi amaphoyisa amabili awazange alethwe esiteshini futhi akekho noyedwa umuntu waseCommunity Service Centre onolwazi ngezinsolo zokuqola nokuboshwa kwamaphoyisa. Amalungu eProvincial Anti-Corruption Unit athathe uphenyo oluholele ekuboshweni kosayitsheni ababili ngoLwesihlanu.Abasolwa bazovela eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseNtuzuma ngoMsombuluko, zingama-23 kuNhlolanja wezi-2026 ngamacala amane okukhwabanisa, kanti kungase kwengezwe amanye amacala njengoba kunezisulu ezizayo futhi zivulela amaphoyisa amabili amacala. Uphenyo lwezobulungiswa selusezingeni eliphezulu ngokumelene namaphoyisa okuthiwa ahlulekile ukuvula icala asize ozakwabo ukuba beqe esiteshini samaphoyisa e-Amaoti.UKhomishana wamaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi uthe ukuze amaphoyisa akwazi ukulwa nobugebengu ngendlela efanele kumele aqale azihlanze."Bambalwa abantu abangcolisa igama lamaphoyisa ngakho kumele sibhekane nabo ngaphakathi sibaqede nya. Asikwazi ukuba namaphoyisa ahambisana nezigebengu, nalabo abatholakala bethinteka kunoma yiluphi uhlobo lobugebengu kumele baboshwe babhekane nezigwegwe zangaphakathi. Sibonga umphakathi wase-Amaoti ngokuhlonipha umthetho ngokungawuthatheli umthetho ezandleni zabo kodwa sibaxolise. thina siniphoxile nidedele abasolwa, nokho ulaka lomthetho luzothatha indawo yawo futhi ubulungiswa bube khona,” kusho uLieutenant General Mkhwanazi.
KUNZIMA kowesifazane nezingane zakhe ezintathu abakhishwe ngoshova wumphakathi kolindela abaseLamontville, ababizwa ngokuthi kuseMathinini.UNksz Lungelwa Ndlela usehamba equba emva kokuba amalungu omphakathi emkhiphe ngoshova kulindela wakhe ngoMsombuluko ebusuku kanti ubesehlale kuwona kusukela ngo-2009, elinde indlu yomxhaso.Uthe uhlaselwe yiqulu labantu elimyalele ukuba aphume aphele kolindela, lasabisa ngokuthumba izingane zakhe uma engafuni ukuphuma, wathi iqulu lithe lifuna athuthe endaweni ngenxa yokuthi ingane kadadewabo yalimaza enye ingane yasendaweni.UNksz Ndlela uthe akazi ukuthi kungani ejeziselwa izono zengane kadadewabo ngoba ingane iboshiwe, kwaphinde kwaxoshwa nodadewabo."Ngikhuluma nje, ingane iseWestville (ejele), udadewethu naye uxoshiwe. Izingane zami azisayi esikoleni ngenxa yokuthi ngiswele indawo yokuhlala. Enye bekufanele iye esibhedlela. Inenkinga yokungezwa endlebeni. Bekufanele iyohlinzwa, ifakwe okuzoyisiza ukuba izwe. Ayibange isaya ngenxa yesimo."Uthe usehamba ehlala, wathi ngoMsombuluko, walala emnyango."Sifuna indawo yokuhlala asiyitholi, nalana engicuphe khona kugcwele. Ngisizwe nje umuntu ongijwayele wangibekisa izimpahla zami."UNksz Ndlela uthe kade zazimphutha izindlu zomxhaso."Kade ngahlala lapha kolindela. Izindlu zitholwa abantu abafika emva kwethu, thina sisale."Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa aphenya icala lokucekela phansi impahla.UNetshiunda uthe uNksz Ndlela uhlaselwe amadoda afika alahla izimpahla zakhe emnyango.Ikhansela le-DA kuMasipala waseThekwini, uMnuz Sithembiso Ngema, lithe kuwumkhuba owajwayelekile ukuthi kuxoshwe abantu kolindela uma kunohlelo lokwakhiwa kwezindlu oluzayo."Abantu bajwayele ukuvele basuse umsindo, bakhiphe abantu kolindela bese befaka abangani nezihlobo zabo. Basuke benzela ukuthi uma sekubhaliswa izindlu, abantu abasuke bebhalisa bafice izihlobo zabo kolindela. Izihlobo zabo zisuke sezigwevile kolindela kugcine kuphutha abantu abafanelwe ukuthola izindlu."Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kukasihlalo wekomiti lezokuHlaliswa kwaBantu kuMasipala waseThekwini, uMnuz Themba Mvubu, ayiphumelelanga.
ILENGELWA yizembe imenenja kaMasipala waseMpendle, uMnuz Zakhele Tshabalala, njengoba umkhandlu usuyibekele izinsuku eziyisikhombisa ukuba ichaze ukuthi kungani kufanele ingamiswa emsebenzini?Umhlangano womkhandlu uthathe isinqumo sokubhalela uTshabalala incwadi izolo, njengoba esolwa ngokwehluleka ukwenza umsebenzi wakhe.Phakathi kwezinto okufanele aziphendulele kuzo; ukungaholi kwabasebenzi, ukwehluleka komkhandlu ukusebenzisa imali egcine ibuyela emumva nezinsolo zokuthi uTshabalala wasebenzisa incwadi ewumgunyathi ngesikhathi eyofuna imali ebhange.IMeya, uMnuz Kwenzakufani "Kho" Dlamini, ikuqinisekisile ukunikwa kukaTshabalala incwadi."Kuzofanele aphendule kulezi zinto ngoba uma ubheka vele zithinta umsebenzi wakhe. Uyena okufanele enze isiqiniseko sokuthi abasebenzi bayahola aphinde enze isiqiniseko sokuthi umasipala usebenzisa yonke imali osuke uyabeliwe ukuze agweme ukuthi igcine isiphendela emuva."Isolezwe lithole ukuthi uTshabalala unikwa incwadi nje, naye ubekade enikeze izikhulu ezimbili zomkhandlu izincwadi zokuzimisa emsebenzini.Lezi zikhulu ezimbili Isolezwe elinazo amagama azo, kuthiwa zinikezwe izincwadi zokuzimisa ngoLwesibili ebusuku.UDlamini uthe ubengakabikelwa ngokumiswa kwazo.Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kukaTshabalala ayizange iphumelele njengoba ucingo lwakhe belukhala lungabanjwa. Amaqembu ezepolitiki ahlukene phakathi ngokumiswa kukaTshabalala.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi ngisho namakhansela e-ANC imbala abehlukene phakathi ngalolu daba.Kuthiwa amakhansela amane i-ANC eyamemezela ukuthi iyawamisa emsebenzini, iwona abeseka ukuba uTshabalala abhalelwe incwadi.Loyo owayeyimeya, uMnuz Buyisani Mlaba naloyo i-ANC eyayifuna ukuba aqokelwe kwesobumeya, uNksz Nonjabulo Ndlovu, kuthiwa bona bebengahambisani nokuthi uTshabalala abhalelwe incwadi.Ikhansela le-IFP, uMnuz Sadewu Ngubane, lithe bayakwamukelwa ukubhalelwa kukaTshabalala incwadi."Sikuthokozele kakhulu ukuthi uTshabalala anikwe ithuba lokuthi aphendule ngale zinto ngoba asikwazi ukuthula kube engathi akwenzekile lutho. Umkhandlu usenkingeni enkulu. Umkhandlu wethu uguqe ngedolo, awusakwazi ukwenza umsebenzi wawo. Sikulolu bishi esikulo nje ngenxa yokuthi besingazitholi izimpendulo ezicacile."Ikhansela le-EFF, uMnuz Sifiso Zuma, lithe abanankinga nokuthi uTshabalala athathelwe izinyathelo kodwa lakhala ngokungathathelwa kwabanye izinyathelo.UZuma uthe ziningi ezinye izikhulu namakhansela asolakala enkohlakalweni."Manje kuzokuba inkinga uma bezojaha ukumisa uTshabalala yedwa. Kufanele bathathelwe bonke izinyathelo."
BELIKHAFULA umlilo iPhini likaKhomishana wamaPhoyisa, uLieutenant General Shadrack Sibiya, ngesikhathi livele phambi kwekhomishini ephenya izinsolo ezenziwa wuKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi.USibiya usole umphathi wakhe, uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa kuzwelonke, uLieutenant General Fannie Masemola, ngokuba yixoki.USibiya uphinde wagadla ephindelela kuMkhwanazi naseqenjini lezombusazwe iMKP.USibiya ubenikezwe inkululeko yokuba aziphendulele ezinsolweni abhekene nazo izolo njengoba bekuwusuku lokuqala evele phambi kwekhomishini.USibiya usole uMasemola ngokuba mbaxambili odabeni lokuhlakazwa kwethimba lamaphoyisa eliphenya ukubulawa kosopolitiki KwaZulu-Natal. USibiya uthe uMasemola wavuma ukuba kuhlakazwe ithimba, wathi kepha wayenza sengathi akahambisani nokuhlakazwa kwethimba uma ekhuluma nabantu abangahambisani nokuhlakazwa kwalo okubalwa kubo noMkhwanazi."Ngangizitshela ukuthi siyahambisana noMasemola kanti angibuzanga elangeni. UMasemola wayeyishaya emuva aphinde ayishaye phambili. Wayefuna ukuba muhle kuzo zonke izinhlangothi. Kahle hle mina ngangingahlangene nale nto yokuhlakazwa kwethimba. UMasemola owangifaka kuyona. Uyena owangibhalela umyalezo othi akulandelwe umyalelo kaMchunu (uNqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa omisiwe, uMnuz Senzo) wokuba kuhlakazwe ithimba. Angazi ukuthi lo myalezo wayengawuthumeli ngani kuKhumalo ngqo. Mina ngifela ukuthi ngadlulisela umyalezo kuKhumalo."USibiya uthe amacala amaningi ayephenywa yithimba ayengenanqubekela phambili."Iningi lamacala lalingaphenywa. Amanye ayegcine ukuphenywa ngo-2023. Ngokwamadokodo u-18% kuphela wamacala akhombisa ukuthi ayephenywa ngo-2025. Angu-22% akhombisa ukuthi ayegcine ukuphenywa ngo-2024. Amanye ayegcine ukuphenywa ngo-2019 nango-2018."USibiya uthe akukho okumhlanganisa nosomabhizinisi obhekene namacala, uMnuz Vusumuzi 'Cat' Matalala.USibiya uthe izingxoxo ezavezwa wuMkhwanazi zikubeka kucace ukuthi akukho lapho uMatlala ayekhuluma naye."Angikaze ngikhulume noMatlala kodwa ke into evelayo wukuthi yena uMatlala wayekhuluma ngegama lami. Kuyabonakala vele nakulezi zingxoxo ukuthi akukho lapho mina ngathumela umyalezo. Abantu ababexoxa wuMatlala nomuntu okuthiwa uBrown Mogotsi. Ngiyaphika ukuthi uMatlala ungumngani wami."USibiya ukhale ngabantu abakhuluma kabi ngaye ezinkundleni zokuxhumana.USibiya uthe uMkhwanazi kuhlezi kukhulunywa kahle ngaye ezinkundleni zokuxhumana.Wenze izinsolo zokuthi uMkhwanazi uyingxenye yabantu ababhala ezinkundleni zokuxhumana.Ubuzwe ukuthi unabo yini ubufakazi balokho wathi cha.USibiya usole amalungu eMKP ngokufuqa umkhankaso wokuthi axoshwe esikhundleni.USibiya uthe iMKP yayihola imibhikisho yokweseka uMkhwanazi, wathi yaze yamvulela ngisho icala."Ngathi ngizihlalele nje ehhovisi ngezwa umsindo wabantu ababebhikisha ngaphandle. Ngangithola imiyalezo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana eyayithi ngizoyikhotha imbenge yomile uma ngike ngathinta uMkhwanazi."USibiya uthe nangesikhathi exoshwa emaphoyiseni usihlalo weMKP, uMnuz Nathi Nhleko, uyena owayengungqongqoshe wamaphoyisa.Uthe umholi weMKP, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, wayengumengameli wezwe ngesikhathi exoshwa emaphoyiseni.USibiya uzoqhubeka nokwethula ubufakazi namhlanje lapho ezobe esephekwa khona ngemibuzo.
UVUTHA ungabaselwe umphakathi waku-Ward 1, KwaXimba, osola ikhansela lakule ndawo eliyilungu eliqavile le-ANC, uMnuz Thembo Ntuli, ngokugqoza kwentuthuko njengoba usugcine ngokulibiza ngonodoli wokudlala odado.Lo mphakathi obucasuke kakhulu, uvuke ekuseni izolo, wavala umgwaqo kwaphazamiseka namatekisi abethutha abantu, ukhala ngenkinga yamanzi nogesi. Umphakathi ubulimisa ngesihloko elokuthi usukhathele yikhansela lekule ndawo olisola ngokuthi lingunodoli ohlobisile esikhundleni.Umphakathi obukade udinwe uthelwe ngezibonkolo, ubukade uphethe izikhali okufaka phakathi izando, ocelemba, izimbazo nokunye okuningi. Emgwaqweni bekunenqwaba yamabhodlela, imfucuza nezihlahla futhi kushiswa nomlilo.Isolezwe lifike kume izimoto phakathi nomgwaqo omkhulu, kukhona nabebesagawula izihlahla beziphonsa phakathi nomgwaqo. Abanye bebememeza igama likaNtuli maqede bamchaphe ngenhlamba.Kubona lobo mnyama kukhona abebebuza ukuthi kambe ubani ikhansela lakule ndawo, kubonakala ukuthi bayabhinqa."Wena uyalazi ikhansela laku-Ward 1?'' kubuza omunye sakubhinqa. Kuphendula omunye: "Omunye nje unodoli ohola mahhala."Bacele ukukhuluma neSolezwe bezifihle amagama abo. Omunye wabo ulimise ngesihloko elokuthi baqalekiswa ngokuthi ikhansela labo kube nguNtuli kule ndawo.''Uma ekhona uNkulunkulu angazi ukuthi wakuvuma kanjani ukuthi lo muntu kube nguyena ikhansela lethu kule ndawo. Ibuhlungu kabi impilo lo muntu asiphilisa yona. Siyaqala ukuthi kule ndawo ikhansela kube unodoli onje,'' usho kanjena.Kunanele omunye wathi bona abasazi ukuthi yini abangayenza ukuze ikhansela lizihluphe ngezidingo zabo."Omunye umuntu lo owabekwa waba yikhansela kule ndawo. Sengiqala nokungabaza ukuthi wake wasicabangela,'' usho kanjena.Laba ebebebhikisha babuye bakhala ngokuboshwa kukaMnuz Sizwe ''Bee" Khanyile, bemchaza njengoMsamariya olungileyo okwaziyo ukubatakula njalo uma kunezinkinga.Bathe kodwa njengoba eboshiwe nje, unqindwe amandla kwathiwa njengoba esephume ngebheyili makangazihlanganisi nezinto zomphakathi. Nakulona futhi lolu daba lokuboshwa kwakhe, basole uNtuli bathi nguyena ongemuva kwetulo lakho ngoba ebona ukuthi uzombhincisela nxanye uma sekusondela ukhetho lohulumeni basekhaya.Ethintwa uNtuli uveze ukuthi usebuya khona kulaba ebebebhikisha bevale umgwaqo."Sengibuya kubona ngakhuluma nabo. Okungixakayo ukuthi laba bantu kade sinomhlangano nabo - kungekudala - sikhuluma ngalo lolu daba,'' echaza. Uthe akanankinga nalaba abambiza ngonodoli ngoba wonke umuntu abantu bambiza ngamagama uma esefulathele.Mayelana nodaba lwenkinga yamanzi nogesi, uthe emasontweni amabili edlule uke waba nomhlangano namalungu omphakathi kuzobhungwa ngayo inkinga yamanzi lapho athe bekukade kufike khona esinye sezikhulu zamanzi kuMasipala waseThekwini.Uzishaye isifuba ngokuthi akukho angakwenzi uma kukhulunywa ngezidingo zomphakathi. Uthe abambiza ngonodoli bamane bayazisholo nje. Mayelana nezinsolo zokuthi uyena obophise uKhanyile, uthe kungamampunge lokho, wathi labo bamane bayazihhumela nje.Uthe yena akadingi ukuthi kuze kube khona abantu ababophisayo ukuze anqobe ukhetho, wathi uyazethemba nje selokhu azalwa uyise nonina.Ebuzwa ukuthi uyazi yini ngokuboshwa kukaKhanyile, uphendule ngokuthi ugcine ngokubona nje ezinkundleni zokuxhumana abalandeli bakhe bethukuthele bekhala ngokuboshwa kwakhe. Ugcizelele ukuthi akukho angakubanga noKhanyile ngoba uyena ikhansela lakule ndawo, hhayi omunye umuntu. Nakuba ekhuluma kanjena uNtuli kodwa kukhona omunye okhale waze wazibhongqa phansi ebiza igama likaKhanyile, ebuza ukuthi ukephi izinto zibheda nje?Ethintwa uKhanyile, uthe akukho azokusho mayelana nezinto ezithinta igama lakhe eziqhubeka KwaXimba.Sekuwumlando ukuthi kuhlale kunomsindo KwaXimba uma sekusondele ukhetho lwamakhansela. UNtuli ungene esikhundleni emva kokubanga noMnuz Musa Mkhize ogcine eseqembukela kwiMKP. UMkhize wangena esikhundleni ngemuva kombango owawushisa phansi phakathi kwakhe noMnuz Susimpi Ngubane owayeyikhansela phambilini.Kuvele ukuthi ngenxa yesiteleka, abantu abaningi KwaXimba namaphethelo bagcine bengakwazanga ukufinyelela emsebenzini. Kuthiwa abanye basebenzise izindlela ezijikelezayo ezinqamula kwezinye izigodi ezakhelene nale ndawo ebuswa yiNkosi uNgaye Mlaba.
OWESILISA waseCopesville, eMgungundlovu, ushaya phansi ngonyawo uthi ngeke amngcwabe uyise ngoba akazange amondle futhi akazange amphathe kahle esadla anhlamvana.UMnuz Zakhele Cindi (43) utshele Isolezwe ukuthi akafuni nokuyizwa nje into ezomhlanganisa nokuthi kumele angcwabe uyise ongasekho, uMnuz Khipha Chonco (72).Usola uyise ngokuthi esadla anhlamvana wahluleke wancama ukuba ubaba oqotho empilweni yakhe.Uthe kuyimanje sekuphele inyanga golokoqo siduve emakhazeni kahulumeni isidumbu sikayise. Uthe lokhu kudalwa wukuthi bekubhekwe ukuthi njengoba kunguyena omdala kubo kube khona akwenzayo ukuze afihlwe ngesizotha.Uthe wumsangano wento lowo, ngeke ayenze noma ngabe kuthiwani kuyena. Uthe akakholwa wukuthi kukhona umuntu ongaqhamuka amguqule umqondo, wathi ngisho umuntu ovela ezulwini ngeke akwazi ukumenza acabange ngenye indlela.''Angifuni nokuyizwa nje indaba yokuthi kumele mina ngingcwabe le ndoda. Ngingangcwaba umuntu ongenzeleni nje esaphila. Ngingamngcwabelani nje ngempela umuntu ohlulekile wukubona ukuthi unendodana esaphila. Kuzothi ke manje ngoba nakhu engasekho bese kulindeleka okuhle okuvela kimina ekubeni yena engazange akulethe okuhle okuza kimina esaphila. Lutho ngeke kwenzeke lokho,'' kugcizelela uCindi.Uveze ukuthi indlela isimo ebesibucayi ngayo phakathi kwakhe noyise kuze kwafika lapho uyise enza khona incwadi yesivimbelo.''Lo muntu wahamba wayokwenza incwadi yokuthi ngingalinge ngisondele kuyena. Yini ke pho ezodala ukuthi ngisondele manje ngoba engasekho. Ngeke kuze kwenzeke kanjalo namanje ke angikwazi ukusondela kuyena njengoba naye ayekade efisa esaphila,''usho kanjena.Eqhuba uthe uyise akukho nokukodwa nje obekukhombisa ukuthi unendodana endala.''Sengize ngaba mdala ngaba mngaka ngiyindoda manje lo muntu angikhumbuli nje eba ngubaba kimina. Kodwa manje sekufanele ngibe yindodana enhle kuyena,'' usho kanjena.Uveze ukuthi uyise ubengasasebenzi esephila ngemali yesibonelelo sikahulumeni ngoba wahlaselwa yisifo sohlangothi.''Angikhathali ngisho noma kungaphela isikhathi esingakanani eduve emakhazeni akukho nje lapho engingathi ngiyathinteka khona ngabe ngiqamba amanga aluhlaza, empeleni nje akukho okungihlanganisa nalolu daba lokuhamba kwakhe emhlabeni,'' kuchaza yena.Uveze ukuthi uyise akamondlanga futhi akazange azihluphe nangokuthi babe nobudlelwane bukababa nendodana.''Lo muntu ubengenandaba nokuthi ngikhona. Indlela abengenandaba ngayo kwamina ibibuye ingithuse lokhu okwangempela futhi,'' kusho yena.Uveze ukuthi ngaphambi kokuba ashone uyise uke waxoxa naye embuza ukuthi kungani engabuyi emqashweni azohlala nomndeni wakhe.''Akazange angiphendule ngempendulo eqondile, kodwa wawubona nje ukuthi kufana nokuthi ngiyadlala uma ngimtshela lokho,'' kuchaza yena.Uveze ukuthi uyise ubephila ngokuhamba eqasha nje engumantuntanendishi angafuni ukuhlala nezingane zakhe azinze.Udalule ukuthi uyena omdala kodwa zikhona nezinye izingane abenazo. Uthe zona wayebuye azilekelele ngezinye izinto ezincane.Ugcizelele ukuthi uyokhohlwa efile ukuthi wazalwa yindoda engenandaba nezingane zayo. Uveze ukuthi akanawo nomazisi ngoba uyise akazange amenzele. Uthe uziphilisa ngokulima bese edayisa.Ngokwakhe ukube uyise wenza umsebenzi kababa ngabe kukhulunywa ukuthi uzofihlwa ngesizotha futhi isidumbu sakhe besingeke siduve emakhazeni inyanga yonke.Uphethe ngokuthi kodwa akukho okungenziwa akaqhubeke aduve emakhazeni kuyobonakala isigcino.Ngokukahulumeni, ezingeni lomasipala, umuntu ongenabani uye angcwatshwe ngokohlelo oluyisipesheli uma engaziwa wumuntu. Kwenzeka lokhu nje, kusanda kuvela ukuthi kunenqwaba yezidumbu eziduve emakhazeni ahlukene kahulumeni.
INKANTOLO eNkulu yaseMgungundlovu, izolo, ibagixabeze ngodilikajele abesilisa ababili abebethweswe wuMbuso icala lokusoconga uthishomkhulu wasesikoleni saseHammarsdale, iSikhethuxolo High.UMnuz Busani Khomo (57) wadutshulwa wafa engaphandle kwesikole ngoDisemba 5, 2024.Kuthiwa ababulali baqala bakhuluma naye kwathi emva kwalokho bavulela ngenhlamvu baze bamqedela ngisho eselele phansi.Phambilini, kwavela ukuthi umufi wayezifela nge-ANC futhi eyilungu lokuqina lenyunyana yothisha, iSadtu.UBheki ''Mabhiza'' Dube (28) noSibonelo Sibiya (27) babonakale bebhocobala ngesikhathi iJaji uNontuthuzelo Mlaba limemezela ukuthi libagixabeza ngesigwebo sikadilikajele umuntu ngayedwa.IJaji likhale kakhulu ngesihluku esakhonjiswa yilaba ngesikhathi besoconga umufi, labalula nokuthi laba ababili abazange bakhombise ukuzisola ngesikhathi kuqhubeka icala. Liqhubeka iJaji, libasole ngokugweva nolwazi olumayelana nofishi omkhulu elithe uyena ngqondongqondo wetulo lokusocongwa kukamufi.''Ukuthula kwenu kuze kube kufika lesi sikhathi kuveza ngokusobala ukuthi aninendaba kangakanani nomndeni futhi nikhethe ukufihla ulwazi olubalulekile nize nigwetshwe," kusho ijaji.Lithe izigwebo zalolu hlobo zimqoka kakhulu ngoba zinikeza isithombe esigcwele nesisobala sokuthi izinkantolo ziyakwazi ukubajezisa labo abenza okubi, bephuca abanye ilungelo labo lokuphila. Inkantolo isebenzise kakhulu ubufakazi obethulwa ngumfanyana omncane owakhipha ingonyuluka, egeqa amagula enkantolo ngokusuka nokuhlala kwesigameko, ethi wababona ababulali bemdubula uthishomkhulu etshela nenkantolo ukuthi futhi wabezwa bekhuluma.Enkantolo kuvelile ukuthi benza lo msebenzi besakhokhelwe ingxenye yenkokhelo ewu-R50 000. Kuvelile ukuthi ikhona enye imali ababesazoyithola ngomsebenzi wabo.Umfowabo kamufi omdala, uMnuz Mvunge Khomo, uthe bajabule ngesigwebo esinikezwe ababulali."Sijabule ukuthi inkantolo ikhethe ukumane ibagixabeze ngesigwebo sikadilikajele. Lokhu kusiduduzile njengomndeni,'' usho kanjena.Uthe kodwa namanje akukaveli ukuthi wobani ababathuma, wathi bakhathazekile kakhulu ngokuthi ubhongoza akakatholakali.''Kumele sithole ukuthi ngubani owabathuma, uma kungenzeka lokho konke ngabe kugcwalisekile,'' usho kanjena.Phambilini ekhuluma neSolezwe, uKhomo wababaza ukulunga kukamufi wamchaza njengenjini yomndeni wakwaKhomo."Wayelungile loya muntu futhi esiza bonke abantu. Angazi ngempela ukuthi umuntu onjengaloya ubulawa kanjani?'' washo kanjena.Wamncoma ngendlela eyeyazisa ngayo imfundo wathi wayekhipha amangwevu njalo efuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bashaya into ecokeme abafundi bakaGrade 12 bakulesi sikole.Esanda kushona ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, abafundi abaningi abake bafunda kulesi sikole bebebabaza ukulunga kwakhe bencoma nendima ayiklamile ekuthuthukiseni ezemfundo.Babelimisa ngesihloko elokuthi ufe olwembiza umphakathi waseHammarsdale ngokubulawa kukaKhomo.

Ngokusho kwabe-ALS Paramedics, indawo yesigameko isimenyezelwe njengendawo yobugebengu, kanti kubikwe inqwaba yabantu abalimele. Kusolakala ukuthi amaphoyisa abelandela umkhondo wabasolwa ngaphambi kwengozi. Akukho kudubula okubikiwe. Kunxuswa abashayeli banxuswa ukuthi bayigweme le ndawo.
