INKANDLA enhle ngokuziholela isiphinde yapheka elinye ijongo emculweni kaMaskandi. Kulokhu sikhuluma noMnotho Majola (21) okulindeleke ukuthi adedele umsebenzi wakhe wokuqala ngoLwesihlanu emcimbini ozobanjelwa e-Albert Park, eThekwini. Leli ciko elingaphansi kwenkampani, uMbuso wamaCiko lithi likuthakasile kakhulu ukudedela i-albhamu yayo yokuqala osihloko sayo sithi, Stop and Go, ebunjwe ngezingoma ezingu-12.Uthe usebenze ngokuzikhandla epheka lomsebenzi futhi ubeseqalile nokuzakhela igama ngenhloso yokuzuza inhliziyo yabathandi bomculo kaMaskandi ezinkundleni zokuxhumana. Uthe akanakho nokuncane ukungabaza ngokuthi abalandeli bazobhema bakholwe.''Ngizinikeze isikhathi esanele ngiyipheka. Lokhu ngikwenze ngoba bengihlose ukuthi ngingalenzi iphutha lokuba ngiphoxe abalandeli abathanda umculo kamaskanda. Ngifuna ukuthi uma bephuma beyothenga ezitolo bangabi nokuncane nje ukuzisola ngale albhamu,''usho kanjena.Nakuba kuyi-Album yakhe yokuqala lena, uthe uke wakhipha i-EP enezingoma ezingu-7 ekupheleni kuka-2024. Uthe kulokhu ubone kungcono ukuba amane enze i-album ephelele.Uyazifela ngalolu hlobo lomculo wathi ujabule ngoba seliyafezeka iphupho lakhe lokuba ngomunye wabaculi bakaMaskandi.''Ukucula lolu hlobo lomculo kuyinto engizifelayo kakhulu ngayo. Kimina kusho lukhulu kabi nje ukuthi ngampela sengiyangena ngiba uyena umculi kamaskandi, Ngibonga kakhulu uNkulunkulu naboMbuso wamaCiko ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi liyafezeka ngampela iphupho lami,'' kuqhubeka yena.Uveze ukuthi eminyakeni eyisihlanu kuya kweyishumi kusuka manje ufuna kukhulunywe indaba yokuthi usekhule ngokwanele emculweni. Lokhu uthe ukholwa ukuthi nakanjani kuzokwenzeka inqobo nje uma eqhubeka nokuzikhandla ngaso sonke isikhathi.Ufisa ukubona ihamba ezitolo i-album yakhe ngenxa yokuthi abantu bazobe bekhombisa ukuyithakasela okukhulu.''Mina ngikholwa ukuthi uma ungumculi kumele usebenze kanzima ukuze wenze lokhu abantu abakubhekile kuwena. Akumele ubaphoxe abantu abangabalandeli balolu hlobo lomculo, yingakho nje nami ngenze konke okusemandleni ami,''usho kanjena.Uveze ukuthi zikhona nezinye izingoma ezikhona azifelayo ngazo kule-album okufaka phakathi ethi : "SMS AFTER SMS.''
UKUBHUBHUDLA, ukuxhaphaza nenkohlakalo eyenziwa abasebenzi bakahulumeni yikhona okwenze kwanyuka imali abayikhokhela i-medical aid, i-Government Employees Medical Scheme (GEMS).Abanye babasebenzi kuthiwa bayisebezisa ngendlela engafanele i- medical aid, balalise ezibhedlela ezizimele izihlobo zabo ezingakhaviwe ngaphansi kwesikhwama.Lokhu kuvezwe yiPrincipal Officer yakwaGEMS, uDkt Stanley Moloabi, emuva kwezikhalo zezinyunyana zabasebenzi bakahulumeni, ezichitha ukunyuswa kwemali ekhokhwa abasebenzi. Ekhuluma neNewzroom Afrika izolo, uMoloabi ubale ukuxhashazwa ngokweqile kwe-medical aid okwenziwa abasebenzi njengenye yezinto ezenza ukuthi banyuse imali. Ngo-2025 iGEMS yanyusa imali ngo-13.4%, kanti kulo nyaka inyuke ngo-9.8% kusuka ngoJanuwari."Minyaka yonke siyayinyusa imali njengoba kwenzeka nakwamanye ama-medical aid. Sikhokhe imali ephindiwe kunale esasiyihlelile nyakenye ngenxa yokunyuka kakhulu kwezindleko zalabo esibakhavile. Abasebenzi bayayixhaphaza i-medical aid kanti abanye benza nenkohlakalo," usho kanje.Uthe ngeledlule uthole ucingo luvela kwesinye isibhedlela esizimele, mayelana nenkohlakalo eyenziwe omunye okhavwe yiGEMS."Abakulesi sibhedlela baveze ukuthi ilungu lethu, lilalise ilungu lomndeni walo elingakhaviwe nge-medical aid yalo. Ngebhadi leli lungu lishonile, kwaqala inkinga ngokuthi alikhaviwe. Ziningi nezinye izinto esingazibala ezenziwa amalungu ethu asebenzisa budedengu i-medical aid, okungezinye zezinto ezenza sinyuse imali," kuqhuba uMoloabi. Ubale nemishanguzo yezifo ezithile ebizayo athe iyona eyenza banyuse imali."Kunemishanguzo yomdlavuza, engabiza cishe isigidi ngonyaka umuntu ngamunye esiyihlinzeka amanye amalungu ethu. Lokhu ngezinye zezinto ezenza ukuthi sinyuse imali ngoba iyabiza kakhulu. Siphinde sakhokha imali engaphezulu ngo-R2.4 billion, kunaleyo ebesiyihlelile ngenxa yokunyuka kakhulu kwezindleko ngonyaka odlule. Uma singanyusi imali ekhokhwa abasebenzi, lesi sikhwama sizowa bhu." Uthe bayazwelana nabasebenzi kodwa abanayo enye indlela ngaphandle kokuthi banyuse imali. "Uma usiqhathanisa namanye ama-medical aid akuleli, sisashibhe kakhulu kunawo. Njengoba sihlale senza siluxoxe nezinyunyana ngonyaka odlule olokunyuswa kwemali, nangoDisemba besihlangana ngalolu daba ngoba yinto edingeka ukuthi siyenze ngokomthetho. Asikwazi ukuyiziba, singayinyusi imali." Uthe baqala banyusa imali ngo-9.8% ngoJanuwari, base beyehlisa kusuka kule nyanga yaya ku-9.5%."Imali izonyuswa ngo-9.5%, izinyanga ezingu-11, yinye kuphela inyanga okuwuJanuwari lapho abasebenzi bekhokhe khona u-9.8%. Siye nasemkhandlwini wama-medical aid, iCouncil for Medical Schemes, siyowazisa ngokuthi sizokwehlisa imali emva kwezikhalo zezinyunyana," usho kanje. Uthe ziyaqhubeka izingxoxo nezinyunyana mayelana nokunyuswa kwemali. Ngakolunye uhlangothi izinyunyana ziphaka impi ziyibhekise kwiGEMS njengoba zifuna yehliswe le mali.Lezo ezingaphansi komfelandawonye iCosatu, zizozwakalisa ilaka lazo ngombhikisho emahhovisi eGEMS ezifundazweni ngoFebhuwari 24. NgoFebhuwari 26, 2026, kuzoba nombhikisho obheke ekomkhulu lamahhovisi e-GEMS ePitoli.Lezo ezingaphansi kweFedusa, ayizikhokheli ezinye izinto kanjalo nemishanguzo ezibhedlela ezehlukene. Kanti nabanye abasebenzi basolwa ngokuxhaphaza i-medical aid ngokuthenga ezinye izinto okungeyona imithi nemishanguzo kwamanye amakhemisi.
PHEZU kokuba sinyukile isibalo sabantu abasebenzayo kuleli kodwa siphinde sanda isibalo sabantu asebelahle ithemba lokuthi bayoke basebenze.Lokhu kuvezwe yiStatistician-general, uMnuz Risenga Maluleke, izolo ngenkathi ekhipha izibalo zekota yesine yonyaka, zezinga lokungasebenzi kuleli.UMaluleke uveze ukuthi izinga lokungasebenzi lehlile laya ku-31.4% lisuka ku-31.9%, ezinyangeni ezintathu zokugcina zangonyaka odlule, okuyikota yesine."Sinyuke ngo-44 000 isibalo sabantu abasebenzayo kuleli ekoteni yesine yonyaka. Sebengu-17.1 million, abantu abasebenzayo. Isibalo sabalahle ithemba ngokuthi bazowuthola umsebenzi sinyuke ngo-233 000, okusho ukuthi sebengu-3.7 million," usho kanje. Uthe kodwa kunenhlansi yethemba njengoba kancane kancane sinyuka isibalo sabasebenzayo.Uveze ukuthi nyakenye, izinga lokungasebenzi linyuke ekoteni yokuqala lapho abantu abangu-29 000, balahlekelwa wumsebenzi."Iyasikhathaza eyezinga eliphezulu lentsha engasebenzi. Umsebenzi usatholwa abantu abadala kunentsha. Intsha eneminyaka engu-15 kuya ku-34, kusenzima ukuthi ithole umsebenzi uma uqhathanisa nabantu abakhulile. Kumele kwaziwe ukuthi uma sekwanda abantu abasha abasebenzayo, lokho kuyobe sekusho ukuthi izinto seziqala ukulunga," usho kanje. UMaluleke uthe linyuke laya ku-43.8% izinga lentsha engasebenzi kuleli. Izibalo ziveze ukuthi umkhakha okuqashwe kuwona abantu abaningi owezokwakha ngabangu-35 000 nowemali ngo-32 000.Izinga lehle emkhakheni wezohwebo nezezimayini."Izifundazwe okukhule isibalo sabasebenzayo yiseWestern Cape ngabangu-93 000, iMpumalanga ngabangu-37 000, iNorth West ngabangu-36 000 neNorthern Cape ngabangu-17 000. Izinga lehle eGauteng ngabangu-54 000, KwaZulu-Natal ngabangu-41 000 ne-Eastern Cape ngabangu-32 000." UMaluleke uqhathanise ikota yesine yango-2015 neyango-2025, eveze ukuthi isibalo sabantu abangasebenzi sikhule sisuka ku-5.2 million, saya ku-7.8 million."Intsha engu-3.5 million kwengu-10.3 million eneminyaka engu-15 kuya ku-24, ayisebenzi futhi ayifundi, okuseyinselelo izwe elibhekene nayo."
UMDIDIYELI we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Jeff Radebe, uthi inhlangano izophinde ingenzi kahle komasipala basesifundazweni okhethweni lohulumeni basekhaya lakulo nyaka, uma abaholi bayo bengafuni ukufunda emaphutheni abo.URadebe uthe kuzobaphinda okwabehlela okhethweni lukazwelonke lwango-2024 nasokhethweni lohulumeni basekhaya lwango-2021, uma abaholi bengalungisi amaphutha enza ukuthi abantu bakhethe ukungayivoteli i-ANC kulezi zinketho.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma emhlanganweni wezinsuku ezimbili, iLekgotla, obanjelwe eThekwini. Kwabhimba izinto okhethweni lukazwelonke kwi-ANC njengoba yalahlekelwa isifundazwe iKwaZulu-Natal.Izinkinga ze-ANC KwaZulu-Natal zaqala ngokhetho lohulumeni basekhaya lwango-2021, lapho yalahlekelwa inqwaba yomasipala.URadebe uthe abantu baKwaZulu-Natal bebethumela umyalezo ngokulaxaza i-ANC kulezi zinketho."Abantu bakhetha ukungayivoteli i-ANC ngenxa yokucasulwa ukwehluleka komasipala ukuhambisa izidingo. Abantu abahlala ezindaweni lapho kungahanjiswa khona izidingo, bakhetha ukujezisa i-ANC. Abantu abahlala ezindaweni lapho ezaziphethwe amakhansela angawenzi nahlulwa umsebenzi, lapho khona kunezinhlelo zentuthuko ezimile, lapho kunezinsolo zenkohlakalo, bakhetha ukungayivoteli i-ANC. Akukhona ukuthi abantu abasazifuni lezi zinto ezilwelwa yi-ANC, inkinga ukuthi nje abantu kabajabule ngendlela i-ANC eyenza ngayo." URadebe uthe kubalulekile ukuthi abaholi be-ANC bawuhumushe kahle umyalezo abawuthunyelwa abantu ezinkethweni ezedlule."Uma sihluleka ukufunda kahle lo myalezo, sizophinda iphutha. Uma siwufunde kahle umyalezo, sizokwazi ukuvuka sizithathe."URadebe uthe kufanele bakwamukele okwenzeka okhethweni lwango-2024, lapho balahlekelwa khona isifundazwe. Njengamanje i-ANC iyingxenye yohulumeni wokubambisana owakhiwe amaqembu amane.URadebe uthe akuqali manje ukuba kube nohulumeni wokubambisana, wathi bona into okufanele bayilwele ukuthi uhulumeni wesifundazwe usebenzele abantu.URadebe uthe bayazi ukuthi uhulumeni okhona uzolokhu uvivinywa ngenxa yokuthi uphethe ngencacamezela. Amaqembu aphethe ngokubambisana anezihlalo ezingu-41 kwezingu-80 esiShayamthetho uma kubalwa nesihlalo seqembu elingababeki benkosi elisanda kumemezela ukuhoxa kuhulumeni wesifundazwe, iNFP.Uma igcina ihoxile iNFP, amaqembu abusa ngokubambisana azokuba nezihlalo ezingu-40, bese kuthi amaqembu aphikisayo nawo abe nezihlalo ezingu-40.Iqembu eliphikisayo, iMKP, selike lafaka isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNdunankulu, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, nokho isiphakamiso asizange siphumelele.URadebe uthe bayazi ukuthi iMKP isazophinde izame futhi ukuketula uhulumeni wesifundazwe."Kwakungekhona okokugcina bezama, basazophinde bazame futhi. Thina okwethu ukuthi sihlale sibalindile. Kufanele sibeke phansi umoya."
AYALWE ngengozi yamanzi amponjwana kanye nomjolo amakhosi angu-50 aKwaZulu-Natal athweswe iziqu zemfundo ephakeme.Amakhosi athweswe iziqu ayalwe ukuba agweme izilingo ezifana nezidakamizwa notshwala.Umcimbi wokuthweswa kwamakhosi iziqu ubuseThekwini izolo.Amakhosi abeqeqeshwa ngaphansi kohlelo lokuqeqeshwa loMnyango wokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu, obubambisene neNyuvesi yaKwaZulu-Natal.Inkosi Bhekizwe Biyela, ithe amakhosi kufanele aziphathe kahle ukuze ahlonipheke ezizweni zawo."Inkosi kufanele ikugweme ukutholakala ezindaweni ezingafanele, igade izilingo ezifana nezidakamizwa, uphuzo oludakayo, isifazane, isilisa uma kungamakhosi esifazane."Inkosi uBiyela ithe amakhosi kufanele ahlezi emele iqiniso, ahloniphe nezihlalo ahlezi kuzo."Amakhosi kufanele ahlale ekhumbula ukuthi izihlalo ahleli kuzo ezoyisemkhulu. Kufanele abanikazi besihlalo bahlezi bejabula ngomsebenzi owenziwa amakhosi. Ziyaketulana lezi zihlalo. Namhlanje ukhona, kusasa awukho."Amakhosi afundiswe ngokuphatha, ukuthuthukiswa komnotho wasemakhaya, ukuphathwa komhlaba nomcebo ombiwa phansi kanye nezifundo ngomnotho.UMphathiswa wokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, uthe izifundo zizothuthukisa izizwe zamakhosi."Le nto ayizukusiza amakhosi kuphela kodwa izosiza nabantu. Senze le nto ngoba sazi ukuthi ngeke sikwazi ukuthuthukisa imiphakathi ngaphandle kokuthi sithuthukise amakhosi. Ukuze isifundazwe sibe nekusasa eliqhakazile kufanele siqale sithuthukise abahola isifundazwe. Ulwazi luzolekelela amakhosi ukuba athathe izinqumo. Amakhosi azokwazi ukubamba iqhaza ezintweni ezithinta ohulumeni basekhaya."UButhelezi uthe bazoqhubeka nokuthuthukisa amakhosi."Siyazibophezela ekuqhubekeni nokweseka amakhosi. Isakhiwo sobukhosi lapha KwaZulu-Natal sike sanganakwa isikhathi eside, amakhosi asilela ngemuva. Siyazi ukuthi amakhosi anobuhlakani bokuzalwa. Namhlanje sithuthukisa ubuhlakani bokuzalwa amakhosi azobuyela ezizweni zawo esecijwe kakhulu."UButhelezi uthe nangonyaka ozayo kukhona amanye amakhosi azoqeqeshwa.Usihlalo wendlu yobuholi bomdabu KwaZulu-Natal, Inkosi Sifiso Shinga, ithe kubalulekile ukuthi amakhosi azithuthukise ngemfundo ngoba abantu abaphethwe amakhosi bafundile."Akufanele amakhosi egcine esesalela ngemumva."
KUTHIWA azohlomulisa kakhulu abafuna imisebenzi aphinde aphungule umthwalo obhekene namaphoyisa amandla anikezwe amakhosi aKwaZulu-Natal, okuqinisekisa ama-copy omazisi nezitifiketi.UNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli noKhomishana wamaPhoyisa esifundazweni, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, bathe amandla anikezwe amakhosi asho ukuthi asisekho isidingo sokuthi abantu bahambe amabanga amade beya emadolobheni beyofuna ukuba kuqinisekiswe (certify) ama-copy omazisi nezitifiketi zemfundo.Bathe amaphoyisa nawo azophinde athole isikhathi esanele sokulwa nobugebengu ngenxa yokuthi isizoncipha imigqa emide yabantu abafuna kuqinisekiswe ama-copy eziteshini zawo.Bakusho lokhu emcimbini okuqinisekiswe kuwo amakhosi aKwaZulu-Natal angu-288 ukuthi asengakwazi ukufakazela ama-copy omazisi nokunye.Umcimbi ububanjelwe eThekwini. UNtuli uthe abantu sebezokwazi ukuqinisekisa ama-copy abo ezinkantolo zamakhosi."Usuku luwumlando, amakhosi azokwazi ukulekelela abantu abafuna umsebenzi nabo bonke abantu bomphakathi abasuke befuna ukuthi izitifiketi zabo zifakazelwe ukuthi zisemthethweni ngempela. Abasezukuhamba amabanga amade beya emadolobheni kodwa sebezokuya ezinkantolo zamakhosi. Amakhosi iwona azofike abenzele."Siyazi ukuthi abantu bakithi abafuna amathuba emisebenzi abanamali. Nabasuke behanjelwe izihlobo zabo basuke bengenamali. Kwesinye isikhathi abanye basuke befuna ukufaka izicelo zokukhokhelwa omasingcwabisane, bese kudingeka ukuthi kufakazelwe ukuthi le copy abayiphethe iyiyona ngempela yini. Amakhosi ke manje asenikezwe lawo mandla esifundazweni ukuba akwazi ukwelekelela abantu bawo."UNtuli uthe uhlelo luzophinde lwehlise umthwalo emaphoyiseni."Eziteshini zamaphoyisa uyaye uthole kugcwele abantu abasuke bezofuna ukuba kufakazelwe izitifiketi zabo. Manje amaphoyisa asezokwazi ukubhekana nomsebenzi wawo wokulwa nobugebengu. Bazoncipha olayini babantu abafuna ukuthi kufakazelwe amacopy abasuke."UMkhwanazi naye uhambe emazwini kaNtuli, wathi amaphoyisa abezithola echitha isikhathi esiningi eqinisekisa ama-copy, azobhekana ngqo nomsebenzi wokulwa nobugebengu."Siyalujabulela lolu hlelo njengoba sazi ukuthi uMthethosisekelo uthi amaphoyisa kufanele abhekane nobugebengu, aphenye amacala, avikele umphakathi. Kodwa esizithola sikweza singamaphoyisa eziteshini ilokhu okungabhalwanga emabhukwini amakhulu ukuthi kufanele sikwenze. Njengakho ukuthi sihambe sigxiviza amaphepha ezitifiketi zabantu. Uhulumeni unikeze imvume, wanikeza umsebenzi uNgqongqoshe wezoBulungiswa ukuthi kube uyena okhipha izincwadi ezigunyaza abathile ukuthi kube yibona abagxiviza izitifiketi zabantu. Sebebaningi ke abangaphansi kohlelo okubalwa kubo namakhansela."UMkhwanazi uthe bazoncipha olayini eziteshini zamaphoyisa kuphinde kusizakale nabantu abakude namadolobha."Abantu abaqhamuka ezindaweni zasemakhaya bakhe kude neziteshi zamaphoyisa. Manje asisezukuba khona isidingo sokuthi abantu bahambe amabanga amade beyogxiviza izitifiketi zabo. Kuzoncipha nabantu eziteshini zamaphoyisa nokusho ukuthi amaphoyisa asezokwazi ukwenza umsebenzi wawo."
IQEMBU elingababeki benkosi kuhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal, iNFP, lithi lizoweseka umzamo wesibili wokuketula uNdunankulu wesifundazwe, uMnuz Thami Ntuli.UNobhala weNFP obambile, uMnuz Sunset Xaba, uthe basamile esinqumweni sabo sokuhoxa kuhulumeni wesifundazwe.UXaba uveze ukuthi asikho isivumelwano abafinyelele kusona namaqembu abusa ngokubambisana abezama ukubancenga ukuthi bahlale kuhulumeni wokubambisana, wathi bazokweseka isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNtuli esizofakwa amaqembu afuna ukuqumba phansi uhulumeni wesifundazwe, iMKP ne-EFF.Isiphakamiso sokuqala sokugudluza uNtuli asizange siphumelele ngenxa yokuthi ilungu leNFP, uNksz Mbali Shinga, lashaya indiva umyalelo weqembu wokuba leseke isiphakamiso esasifakwe yiMKP.UXaba uthe bahlanganile nobuholi beMKP nobe-EFF lapho kuvunyelwene khona ngokuthi kuphinde kufakwe esinye isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNtuli."Sivumile ukuthi sizoseseka isiphakamiso sesibili esizofakwa. Imininingwane egcwele yezinto esivumelene ngazo sizoyidalula ngokuhamba kwesikhathi."Ukweseka kweNFP isiphakamiso sokungabuthembi ubuholi bukaNtuli kungadala ungqingetshe njengoba kuzokwenza ukuthi amaqembu aphikisayo abe nezihlalo ezilingana nezamaqembu abusa ngokubambisana.Ubuholi beNFP kade buhlangene nobuholi beqembu elihola uhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal, i-IFP, ngeSonto.Ngaphambi kwalokho, ubuholi beNFP bube nemihlangano nobuholi bamanye amaqembu ayingxenye yohulumeni wokubambisana i-ANC ne-DA.UXaba uthe abazange bathembise lutho kule mihlangano, wathi basazoqhubeka nokuxoxa nala maqembu yize besamile esinqumweni sokuhoxa kuhulumeni wesifundazwe."Njengoba ngikhuluma nawe nje, asiyona ingxenye yohulumeni wokubambisana. Sizimisele ngokuba yiqembu eliphikisayo. Asikho isibophezelo noma isethembiso esesenzile ngesikhathi sihlangene namaqembu abusa ngokubambisana. Silindele ukuthi kuphinde kube nezinye izingxoxo. Amaqembu abusa ngokubambisana athembisa ukuthi azobuye aziphendule izinto esikhulume ngazo."Nakuba ubuholi beNFP kuzwelonke bumile ekutheni abuseyona ingxenye kahulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal, okuqaphelekayo ukuthi uNksz Shinga uyaqhubeka nokuvota namaqembu abusa ngokubambisana.Kuleli sonto, uNksz Shinga uvote namaqembu abusa ngokubambisana ngesikhathi kuvotelwa isiphakamiso sokuba kunyuselwe uNtuli umholo.UNksz Shinga wayekade eyalelwe ubuholi beNFP ngonyaka owedlule ukuba ehle esikhundleni sokuba uMphathiswa wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi.Kuze kube namhlanje, uNksz Shinga uyaqhubeka nokuqhoqhobala lesi sikhundla.
UZOHLEKA yedwa uNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, njengoba ezonyuselwa umholo.Umholo kaNtuli uzonyuka ube ngaphezu kuka-R2.6 million ngonyaka.Isinqumo sokunyusa umholo kaNtuli sithathwe emhlanganweni obusesiShayamthetho KwaZulu-Natal.Umholo kaNtuli uzokwenyuka uma kuqala unyakamali omusha ngo-Ephreli.UNtuli unyuselwe umholo emva kokuba uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, enqume ukuthi ondunankulu kanye nabanye abaholi bezepolitiki abaphethe izikhundla kuhulumeni banyuselwe imiholo ngo-3.8%.Inhlangano enquma imiholo yabaholi abajutshwe ezikhundleni kuhulumeni, iCommission for the Remuneration of Public Office Bearers, yayikade iphakamise ukuthi abaholi banyuselwe imiholo ngo-4.1%.Kepha ngenyanga edlule uRamaphosa unqume ukuthi abaholi banyuselwe ngo-3.8%.Isiphakamiso sokuthi kunyuselwe uNtuli umholo senziwe wuSotswebhu omkhulu esiShayamthetho, uMnuz Blessed Gwala.Esiphakamisweni sakhe, uGwala uthe uNtuli kufanele anyuselwe umholo njengokunquma kukaRamaphosa."Isinqumo sikaRamaphosa esingunombolo 7005, esishicilelwe kwi-gazzette 53965 ngoJanuwari 16 sinquma umholo kandunankulu. NjengesiShayamthetho kufanele sithathe isinqumo sokunyusa umholo kanye neminye imihlomulo etholwa undunankulu silandela umthetho wango-1998 olawula imiholo yabaholi abasezikhundleni kuhulumeni."Ngiphakamisa ukuthi umholo kandunankulu ube ngu-R2 635 562 ngokuhambisana nomthetho olawula imiholo yabaholi abaphethe izikhundla kuhulumeni kanye nokuhambisana nesinqumo sikamengameli sangoJanuwari 16."Amaqembu abusa ngokubambisana aphinde adlula ngehubo ngesikhathi kuvotelwa isiphakamiso.Kuhlezi kubanjwe umoya uma kuvotwa esiShayamthetho kulezi zinsuku kulandela isimemezelo seqembu elingababeki benkosi kuhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal, iNFP, sokuhoxa kuhulumeni wesifundazwe owakhiwe amaqembu amane.Ukuhoxa kweNFP kungenza ukuthi kube nongqingetshe uma kuvotwa esiShayamthetho ngenxa yokuthi izihlalo zamaqembu abusa ngokubambisana zizolingana nezamaqembu aphikisayo.Kepha izolo isiphakamiso sidlule kalula ngenxa yokuthi ilungu leNFP, uNksz Mbali Shinga, liphinde lavota namaqembu abusa ngokubambisana.UNksz Shinga onguMphathiswa wokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi, wawushaya indiva umyalelo weqembu wokuba asule kulesi sikhundla.Amalungu angu-40 avotele ukuba kunyuswe umholo kaNtuli.Amalungu eMKP angu-34 kuphela aphikisane nesiphakamiso sikaGwala, amalungu eMKP abengaphelele ngesikhathi kuvotwa.Amalungu amabili eqembu elivota neMKP, i-EFF, nawo abengekho ngesikhathi kuvotwa.USomlomo, uNksz Nontembeko Boyce, uthe noma kanjani uzonyuka umholo kaNtuli njengoba iningi lamalungu leseke isiphakamiso.UNksz Boyce uthe akuyena yedwa uNtuli ozonyuselwa umholo, waveza ukuthi nawo amalungu esiShayamthetho asanda kunyuselwa imiholo.
AMAZWI enduduzo alokhu engene njalo kulandela ukudlula kwesishoshovu somzabalazo sase-United States of America (USA), uMfu Jesse Jackson, esidlule emhlabeni sino-84. Lesi sishoshovu se-American Civil Rights Movement, sabamba iqhaza emzabalazweni wamalungelo. Izindaba zokushona kukaJackson zidalulwe wumndeni ngesitatimende osenze eChicago, Illinois. Isitatimende sithe uJackson ushonele phambi komndeni waso ngoLwesibili. Umndeni uchaze uJackson njengeqhawe ebeliyinyoni kayiphumuli elalwela ubulungiswa, ukulingina namalungelo abantu. UJackson uchazwe njengomuntu owayekhulumela abavalwe umlomo. Ushiye emhlabeni umkakhe, uJacqueline, izingane zakhe oSantita, Jesse Jr, Jonathan Yusef, Jacqueline nendodakazi, u-Ashley Jackson nezizukulwane. UMengameli waseNingizimu Afrika, uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa, ungomunye wabadlulise amazwi enduduzo, wathi amagalelo kaJackson ekulwiseni uhulumeni wobandlululo nasemzabalazweni wenkululeko yakuleli, akasoze alibaleka.
KULELI sonto eliphelayo ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme eziningi ezweni bekusongwa uhlelo lwe-orientation, lapho okusuke kufundiswa futhi kucetshiswa izitshudeni zonyaka wokuqala ngokumele zikwazi noma zikulindele ezikhungweni zemfundo ezibhalise kuzo.Lokho kusho ukuthi kusukela ngoMsombuluko luyasuka ushikishi lokuqala kohlelo lokufunda emanyuvesi ohulumeni, emakolishi okuqeqeshelwa amakhono nasezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme ezizimele ezweni lonke.Omunye wabaholi besikhungo semfundo ephakeme esizimele iRosebank College, uMnuz Dingaan Moropane, uthe lesi kuvame ukuba yisikhathi esiyinselelo ezitshudenini zonyaka wokuqala ngenxa yokuthi okuningi zisuke zikweshama. Uthe wukuthi zisuke ziyiqabuka indlela yokufunda ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme - ehlukile kweyasezikoleni zamabanga aphezulu naphansi. Uthe okunye okwenza ukuthi kube nzinyana wukuthi izitshudeni zisuke sezizoqala impilo entsha yokuzimela nokuzenzela yonke into ngokwazo futhi engekho osezozilandela ngokwenza umsebenzi wesikole, owasendlini noma ekhaya - konke kubheke zona."Yilapho okuqala khona kuzwele ukugqilazwa wukubhekana nayo yonke into ngokwazo izitshudeni ezisuke zizokwenza unyaka wokuqala. Lokhu kufakazelwa yizibalo zocwaningo ezikhomba ukuthi u-35% wezitshudeni eziqala imfundo yazo ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme ziyashiya phakathi zingakaziphothuli izifundo zazo. Kanti-ke konke lokho kusuke kuqale lapho izitshudeni zinganaki izinto ezibalulekile,” kusho uMoropane.Eqhuba, uthe izitshudeni kumele zazi futhi zikuqonde ukuthi inyuvesi ifana nomjaho we-marathon, ongadingi ijubane elikhulu. "Ukusheshe ubone izinto ezingakuphazamisa kusenesikhathi bese uyazigwema kungakusiza kakhulu ezifundweni zakho, bese usebenzisa lezo zinselelo ozobe unqwamana nazo nsuku zonke ukuzikhuthaza ukwenza kahle emfundweni yakho,” usho kanje.UMoropane uxwayise ngala maphutha okumele agwenywe yizitshudeni:Ukuya emagumbini okufundela ngesikhathi sokufunda uma kuthanda wena: Izitshudeni eziningi uma zifika ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme zivame ukududuna ngokuthi umuntu aye emagumbini okufunda ngesikhathi sokufunda uma kuthanda yena, zikhohlwe wukuthi ukwenza lokho kunomthelela omubi kangakanani ezifundweni zazo, njengoba kwenza ukuthi kube lula ukusalela emuva kokufundwayo. Kumele ukuthi ulove esikoleni uma kunesizathu esinqala kuphela, futhi wenze kube wumsebenzi wakho ukuzihlupha ngokuthola obekufundwa ngenkathi ungekho.Ukungahleli kahle isikhathi sakho nokuhlehlisa izinto okumele uzenze: Inkinga wukuthi ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme akukho nsimbi ekhalayo ukukukhumbuza ukuthi uye kofunda, ngakho uma ungahleli kahle isikhathi sakho uzoba nenkinga ezokwenza ukuthi ukufunda kwakho kungahleleki futhi kube lula nokuthi usalele emuva kwezinye izinto ezimqoka. Ngakho qinisekisa ukuthi uhlelo lwakho lokufunda aluphazanyiswa yizinto eziseceleni ezingahlangene nemfundo.Ukuba yinkomo edla yodwa nokungazwani namuntu: Amahloni, ukuzivalela ekhoneni nokungakhi ubudlelwano nozakwenu ofunda nohlala nabo kungenza ukuthi ukufunda kwakho kube nzima kakhulu kunobekungaba yikhona. Ngakho lokho kugweme ngokuthi ujwayele ukuhlale ukhona esikhungweni semfundo ephakeme, futhi unganqeni ukuhambela imicimbi nemibuthano eyenziwa khona, bese futhi ujoyina noma yiqembu elilodwa lokuhle okwenziwa yizitshdeni ukuze usheshe ujwayele.Ukubuswa yinjabulo nezinto ezingale kokufunda: Ukungalali ngokwanele, ukugxila kakhulu ekudleni okunempilo nokuhlale ungekho endlini ngesikhatjh sokulala, kungagcina kuba nomthelela omubi empilweni yakho nasezifundweni zakho. Kungenza ukuthi ungabe usakwazi ukugxilisa umqondo wakho kahle ezifundweni, ungabi namdlandla wokwenza izinto. Ngakho zijwayeze ukulala ngokwanele, okungenani amahora ayisishiyagalombili, udle ukudla okunempilo bese uzijwayeza nokuzivocavoca ukuze uhlale uphile saka.Ukushalazela usizo olungakulekelela ezifundweni zakho: Uma ubona ukuthi uthwele kanzima, funa usizo ngokushesha kungaze konakale kakhulu. Izikhungo eziningi zihlale zinazo izinhlelo zokusiza izitshudeni kwezikudingayo, ngakho sebenzisa lezo zinsiza kulokho okukuhluphayo ngoba ukungafuni usizo ekubeni kucaca futhi kubonakala ukuthi usenkingeni, kungenza ukuthi ukufunda kwakho kufane nse nokunyuka intaba yaseTanzania iMount Kilimanjaro.
UBUHOLI bezikole ezingaphansi kwesekhethi yaseNtuzuma, bukhala ngenkinga yamanzi obuthi iphazamisa ukufunda nokufundisa ngoba iphoqa ukuthi izingane zisheshe zidedelwe.Lokhu kuvele emcimbini wokuklomelisa othisha bezikole eziwu-11 ezikule sekhethe ezibe nabafundi abaphase kahle ku-matric ngonyaka odlule. Umcimbi ubuseJohn Langalibalele Dube High KwaMashu, ngoLwesihlanu.Izikole ezikule sekhethe ngezaseLindelani, Machobeni, Nanda Newtown A naseNtuzuma. Obambe njengemenenja yesekhethi, uMnuz Lungisa Khumalo, uthe kubajabulisa kakhulu ukuthi bakwazile ukunyusa izinga lokuphasa."Ngo-2024, sathola u-92%. Kulo nyaka besizibophezele ngokuthi sizothola u-95%. Ngenhlanhla-ke kaJehova nokusebenza kanzima sathola u-96.3%, okuyigxathu elihle kakhulu neliya phambili,” kusho uKhumalo.Ubonge othishanhloko nothisha wathi abalali emakhaya besebenza nabafundi bakwa-Grade 12."Kunezikole ezithole o-100%. Isekhethi yethu inezikole zamabanga aphakeme ezingu-11. Zonke zithole ngaphezulu kuka-90% bese kuthi esisodwa sithole u-84.6% kodwa zonke ziphase kahle,” kusho uKhumalo. Uthe inkinga enkulu abanayo ngeyokushoda kwamanzi, ephoqa ukuthi kudedelwe abanye abafundi kusale abakwa-Grade 12 kuphela nabo abaziphathela amanzi."Kunezikole nje engingazibalula njengeSithandimfundo neMachobeni Secondary - izikole ezingenawo nhlobo amanzi. Kube oGugulabasha noPhembisizwe izikole zaseNtuzuma, azinawo amanzi nje jikelele. Kunezinye eziseLindelani nazo bezisihlupha kakhulu ngendaba yamanzi. Angithi siyazi ukuthi ngendaba yenhlanzeko asikwazi ukuthi sigcine izingane ezikoleni, kuyaphoqa ukuthi ziphume emuva kokuthi sezidlile ngo-11.30, okuyinkinga enkulu,” kusho uKhumalo.Uthe okwenza izikole ziphumelele yingoba uyazazi zonke izingqinamba zazo, wathi kulo nyaka izikole zizibophezele ukuthi zizothola u-100%.. UMnuz Sithembiso Lushozi ongumhloli omkhulu esiyingini iDurban North West, uthe ukuphasa kahle kwesekhethe yaseNtuzuma, kudlale indima enkulu yokuthi iKwaZulu-Natal iphase ngo-90.6% futhi ihambe phambili ezweni.Ufakazele uKhumalo ngenkinga yamanzi ezikoleni."Kuyimanje ngikhuluma nawe kunezikole osekuphele amasonto amathathu zingenawo amanzi. Lokho kusho ukuthi izingane kumele zisheshe ziphume. Kusho ukuthi othisha abakwazi ukufundisa isikhathi esengeziwe.” Umcimbi wemiklomelo ubuxhaswe yinhlangano engenzinzuzo iSesimiphi NPC ephethwe wuMnuz Sibusiso Mjwara, othe ukubone kukuhle ukuthi aklomelise izikole."Isikhathi esiningi la kwi-Ink (Inanda, Ntuzuma, KwaMashu), ibidume ngobugebengu ngakho uma sekwenzeka into enhle njengalena, kuyafuna ukuthi njengezinhlangano ezincane sisondele sizoxhasa izikole sigqugquzele izingane nothisha,” kusho uMjwara.Uthe maphakathi nonyaka uhambela izikole anikele ngezicathulo nemifaniswano, wathi inhlangano yakhe isiza umphakathi kunoma yingani njengoba eNanda Stop 8, inekhishi eliphakela abampofu abangaphezu kuka-250 nsukuzonke.

Cishe bebela ko-20 laba bantu. Abanye basale ezimotweni. Bebenezinhlamba, abanye futhi bebesisongela. Bathe kungamane kufe umuntu impela." Usihlalo wenhlangano yosomabhizinisi, Impendle Business Forum, uMnuz Andile Madlala, uthe umasipala ubakweleta imali enkulu.Uthe kukhona osomabhizinisi bendawo abayisithupha abakweletwa imali ephakathi kuka-R400 000 no-R800 000.UMadlala uthe babekade besebenza ngesikhathi kulungiswa imigwaqo. Thina sesihlale unyaka wonke silinde ukukhokhelwa."UMadlala uthe izikhulu zomkhandlu zibatshele ukuthi ayikho imali yokubakhokhela."Bathe abakwazi ukukhuluma amanga, bathi imali ayikho. Nathi ke sithe ayikho ke into ezokwenzeka." Kwenzeka konke lokhu nje, nabasebenzi bebebhikisha ngaphandle komkhandlu, befuna imiholo yabo. Uthe imali ekweletwa osomabhizinisi yabuyela emuva eMnyangweni wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu."Imali eyayikade ingasebenzanga, umasipala awuyitholanga imvume yokuthi uyigcine le mali."Ikhansela le-IFP, uMnuz Sadewu Ngubane, lithe bebengazi ukuthi umkhandlu ukweleta osomabhizinisi. KUNUKA isiteleka sabasebenzi bahulumeni ngokunyuka kwemali ye-medical aid, yi-Government Employees Medical Scheme (GEMS), ngo-9.8% ekuqaleni konyaka.Izinyunyana ezingaphansi komfelandawonye weCosatu neFedusa zixwayise ngenyakanyaka yombhikisho ngenxa yokuthi iGEMS, ayisenzi eyayisungulelwe khona.Izolo, izinyunyana ezingaphansi kweFedusa okubalwa iSAPU, SAOU nezinye, zigxeke ukunyuswa kwemali yi-GEMS, zathi abasebenzi badonsa kanzima ngenxa yokunyuswa kwale mali. Okhulumela iFedusa, uNksz Betty Moleya, uthe lesi sinyathelo siza ngesikhathi lapho abasebenzi bebhekene nobunzima ngasezimalini."Kunyuke yonke into kanjalo nezikweletu kanti ne-GEMS isiphinde inyusa imali ye-medical aid. Lokhu kunomthelela omubi kubasebenzi kuphinde kubeke engcupheni ukuhanjiswa kwezidingo kubantu," usho kanje.UMnuz Paul Sauer we-SAOU, uthe sekuphele iminyaka i-GEMS ibaziba, wathi abanayo enye indlela abangayisebenzisa manje."Asinayo enye indlela ngaphandle kokuba sibhikishe ukuze i-GEMS izolungisa noma ihoxise lesi sinyathelo sokunyusa kangaka imali. Sifuna i-GEMS ixoxe nezinyunyana ukuze kuthi uma kunyuswa imali kungalimali abasebenzi." Izinyunyana ezingaphansi kweCosatu; okuyiSadtu, Nehawu, Denosa, Popcru, Pawusa nezinye, zishaqekile ngokuthi i-GEMS iqhubeke yanyusa imali ye-medical aid ekubeni namaholo enyuke kancane.Zithe lokhu kuwukuhlasela abasebenzi asebezohola imali encane."I-GEMS yasungulelwa ukuthi ihlinzeke ngosizo lwezempilo ngemali ezokwenza abasebenzi bangalimali. Siyamangala manje uma kungukuthi abalesi sikhwama sebebona intuba yokuzicebisa ngosizi labasebenzi," kusho lezi zinyunyana esitatimendini. Zithe imizamo yokuxoxa nebhodi lalesi sikhwama ayithelanga zithelo."Ngenxa yokuthi yonke imizamo iphunzile, sikhuluma namalungu ethu ukuthi enze umnyakazo wokuchitha ukunyuswa kwemali. Sizoqala ngokuveza ilaka lethu emahhovisi ahlukene e-GEMS ezifundazweni ngoFebhuwari 24. NgoFebhuwari 26, 2026, sizobe sisekomkhulu lamahhovisi e-GEMS ePitoli."Izinyunyana zithe zifuna kwenziwe uphenyo oluthinta ezezimali kwa-GEMS. "Uma i-GEMS ihluleka ukuhlangabezana nezikhalazo zethu, sizoya enkundleni okubhungwa kuyona amaholo abasebenzi, siphakamise ukuthi amalungu azikhethele enye i-medical aid azoyisebenzisa, aqhubeke nokuxhaswa uhulumeni. I-GEMS yasungulelwa ukusiza abasebenzi ngakho ngaphandle kwabo ayilutho." Izinyunyana ziqale ukushaya amakhala ngonyaka odlule ngesinqumo se-GEMS sokuthi izonyusa imali kulo nyaka. Ngenyanga edlule, i-GEMS yatshela izinyunyana ukuthi ayikwazi ukumane yehlise imali ngaphandle kokugunyazwa yi-Council for Medical Schemes.

Konakele kakhulu, kuyacaca nje ukuthi laba abantu abangesenabo nje nhlobo onembeza," usho kanjena.Mayelana nesigameko sokuthunjwa kukamufi, uthe kwafika abesilisa kubo kukamufi kade elungiselela ukuya enkonzweni, bamfaka emotweni base bashaya bachitha naye.Kuthiwa umufi kade ethunjiwe wakhishiswa ebhange imali ephakathi kuka-R50 000 no-R100 000. UNkk Dlamini wayekade enguthishanhloko kwesinye sezikole eHammarsdale, kanti kuthiwa ubesanda kuthatha umhlalaphansi.Kushaye isikhathi sokushicilela amaphoyisa engakaphawuli.
KUSOLWA iziqashi ngokunqunywa uqhoqhoqho kukamastende wesifazane waseShayamoya, eBergville, esigamekweni esishiye amalungu omphakathi ethuthumela.Kuvela ukuthi lo wesifazane kutholakale isidumbu sakhe sesinqunywe uqhoqhoqho esigamekweni esenzeke ngoMsombuluko ngezithuba zasemini.Umufi, uNkk Ntshengisani Dlamini, kuvela ukuthi bese kuphele isikhathi eside engumastende kule ndawo eqashisa abantu abehlukene okufaka phakathi othisha nabafundi.Ikhansela lakule ndawo kuward 8, uMnuz Mndeni Mavundla, lithe liyile emndenini ukuyobhonga emswaneni. Uthe kuyakhathaza ukuthi kunabantu abanesihluku esinjengalesi kule ndawo.Uthe ukuze babanjwe kusize ikhamera yakwamakhelwane ekwazile ukubaveza kanti abantu bendawo bayabazi.''Kubuhlungu ukuthi umuntu wesifazane angabulawa ngesihluku esinjena engenacala. Lokhu kukuveza ngokusobala ukuthi abantu besifazane abaphephile kangakanani,'' usho kanjena.Uthi abesilisa bafike bacela ukungena ngaphakathi wabavumela umufi ngoba kungabantu abaziyo futhi abake baqasha kuyena ngaphambilini. Uthe umufi ubengazi ukuthi laba bazomenza isilo sengubo. "Ubavumelile bangena engazi ukuthi kanti bazomenzakalisa,''echaza.Kusolwa ukuthi iziqashi zakhe nazo ziphakathi kuleli tulo kwazise ngaphambi kokuba asocongwe umufi kuqale kwasuswa amakhamera.Umthombo uthi lokhu kubanikeza isithombe esicacile nje bha sokuthi umuntu owenze lokhu ubenolwazi olujulile ngakho konke okuqhubekayo kule ndawo.''Sisola zona kanye iziqashi zakhe ngendlela okwenzeke ngayo. Kuyabonakala ukuthi laba bantu abebehlela yonke lento ngabantu abayiziqashi zakhe futhi abazi konke ngalezi zindlu,'' kuchaza umthombo.Umthombo uthi amakhamera akwamakhelwane ayabaveza ngokucacile abasolwa ababili bengena ngaphakathi egcekeni aphinde abaveze noma sebephuma becela empunzini.Uqhuba uthi kakucaci ukuthi laba kungani bebulele umastende ngoba ayikho ingxabano ebike yabikwa phakathi kwabo naye ngaphambilini.Laba ababili kuthiwa bakhalelwe ngamasongo kaSigonyela sebebaleke baze bafika eFree State. ''Kube ngcono basheshe bababamba. Lokhu kuzodala ukuthi kubelula ukuthola kubona ukuthi kungani benze into enesihluku esinjena,''usho kanjena.UMnuz Alfred Dlamini uthe bafe olwembiza ngokubulawa kwelungu lomndeni wabo. Uthe kuhlasele abafana bambulala.''Sisadidekile sonke asazi ukuthi kungani bembulele ngale ndlela ebuhlungu kangaka,'' usho kanjena.Kuze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela amaphoyisa engaphendulile.
Ngemuva nje kwamabili i-IPSS Medical Rescue ithole imibiko ngengozi yemoto ku-N2 ngaseShakas Head.Ngesikhathi befika abezimo eziphuthumayo kutholakale ukuthi izimoto ezimbili ebezihamba ohlangothini olulodwa zishayisane, zakhiphana emgwaqweni. Ngokudabukisayo, umshayeli wemoto eyodwa kutholakale ukuthi ulimele kabi kanti kuthiwa ushonele endaweni yesigameko.Umshayeli wemoto yesibili utholwe elimele kabi, abosizo lokuqala be-IPSS Medical Rescue Advanced Life Support bazamile ukuhlenga impilo yakhe ngaphambi kokuba aphuthunyiswe esibhedlela ukuze athole ukunakekelwa okwengeziwe.
BATHELWE othulini amaphoyisa eMatikwe, eNanda ngoLwesibili, abasolwa abane ebebefunelwa amacala abucayi. Kutholwe izibhamu ezine nenqwaba yezinhlamvu,” kusho uNetshiunda. Uthe alikho iphoyisa elilimele esigamekweni.Ezinkundleni zokuxhumana kusabalale imibiko ethi abasolwa bebesanda kubamba inkunzi uKimu Mngomezulu, odume ezinkundleni zokuxhumana.
INKANTOLO eNkulu yaseMgungundlovu izolo ibalahle ngecala abesilisa ababili abebethweswe wuMbuso icala lokusoconga uthishanhloko wasesikoleni saseHammarsdale, iSikhethuxolo High.Umufi uMnuz Busani Khomo (57) kuvela ukuthi wadutshulwa wafa engaphandle kwesikole ngoDisemba 5, 2024.Kuthiwa baqala bakhuluma naye kwathi emva kwalokho bavulela ngenhlamvu baze bamqedela ngisho eselele phansi.Phambilini kwavela ukuthi umufi wayezifela nge-ANC futhi eyilungu lokuqina lenyunyana yothisha, iSadtu.Abalahlwe yicala nguSibonelo Sibiya odume ngelikaBhongo kanye nomngani wakhe uMabhiza Dube. Uthe bakhathazekile kakhulu ngokuthi ubhongoza akakatholakali.''Kumele sithole ukuthi ngubani owabathuma. Uma kungenzeka lokho konke ngabe kugcwalisekile,'' usho kanjena.Phambilini ekhuluma neSolezwe uKhomo wababaza ukulunga kukamufi wamchaza njengenjini yomndeni wakwaKhomo."Wayelungile loya muntu futhi esiza bonke abantu. Namhlanje kulindeleke ukuthi inkantolo eNkulu yaseMgungundlovu ibagwebe ababili.
UPHUME eNkantolo yesiFunda eThekwini ngoLwesibili, izihlathi zivakashela izindlebe umndeni wowesilisa owabulawa yiphoyisa likaMasipala weTheku, imantshi ililahla ngecala.Kuleso sigameko, okuthiwa senzeka ngo-Agasti 2023, olahlwe yicala, uMandlenkosi Gumbi wadubula wabulala uMnuz Sanele Thembani (24) waseWaterloo, eVerulam.Kuthiwa ngosuku lwesigameko umufi nabanye babehamba ngemoto emgwaqweni u-M4, ngesikhathi edutshulwa wuGumbi ngasePick n Pay Hyper, eDurban North. Waphinde wathi kukhona lapho uGumbi abuye wathi yena wayezidlulela ngasendaweni yesigameko, wayengesiyo ingxenye yamaphoyisa ayejikisa izimoto, nalokho, kuthiwa inkantolo yavele yakuchitha. Yena wakhetha ukumbulala,” usho kanje.Uthe uma esegwetshwa, akubhekile wukuthi imantshi imgixabeze ngodilikajele, nathe yiwo kuphela abona umfanele. Okhulumela amaphoyisa kaMasipala weTheku uColonel Boysie Zungu uthe uGumbi wabekwa icala emaphoyiseni."Watholwa enecala wase eyehliswa esikhundleni ngenxa yesigameko sokudubula," kusho uZungu. UNOVALO lokuthi mhlawumbe isiyoba nenkinga unomphelo ingane yakhe, owesifazane waseFolweni, kulandela ukuphulwa enye esikoleni.Umgilwa, uMelokuhle Phethiso (5) ofunda uGrade 1 esikoleni iMasuku Primary, eFolweni, ulinyazwe omunye umfundi ocishe alingane naye ngoLwesibili.Ngokusho kukanina, uNksz Asiphe Phethiso, bezwe ngesigameko sekuphume isikole, ngesikhathi uyise eyolanda umgilwa nomfowabo (7) njengenjwayelo. Uthe umfice ethwishike phansi, engakwazi ukuhamba noma ukuma."Othisha bathe akamphuthumise emtholampilo ngoba ulinyazwe enye ingane,” kusho uNksz Phethiso.Uqhube wathi uyise kamgilwa uphuthume ekhaya eyolanda ikhadi lasemtholampilo likamgilwa kanjalo nonina. Uthe babuyele esikoleni, bathola othisha sebemphuthumise bona emtholampilo umgilwa."Sithe uma sifika, base besishiya, sekukhona nonina womsolwa,” kusho uNksz Phethiso, othe abahlengikazi bamnike incwadi yokuthi amyise esibhedlela umgilwa. "Kuvele ukuthi ithambo leqakala lapho okuhlangana khona umlenze nonyawo lisontekile,” usho kanje.Uthe umgilwa bagcine bemfaka ukhonkolo esibhedlela, ngethemba lokuthi inkinga izolungiseka."Nginovalo lokuthi ingane yami ingase ibe nenkinga unomphelo uma kuthiwa ithambo lihlehlile kwelinye,” usho kanje. Uthe ngesikhathi ebuza ukuthi kwenzekeni, othisha ababanga nazo izimpendulo ezigcwele njengoba isigameko senzeke sekuphuma isikole."Engikuzwe ngomfowabo wukuthi bebedlala bobabili ngesikhathi sekhefu lokudla, umsolwa efuna ukudlala nabo ngenkani, umgilwa engavumi. Kuthiwa ube esemsabisa ngokuthi uzombamba uma sekuphuma isikole,” kusho uNksz Phethiso.Uqhube wathi, kuthe sekuphuma isikole, umsolwa wamkhahlela kabi onyaweni umgilwa, wayowela emgodini. "Usukume lapho kungasahambeki, futhi kungasameki, nokuyilapho kubonakale khona ukuthi ulimele,” kusho uNksz Phethiso.Uzwakalise ukungenami ngendlela unina womsolwa aziphathe ngayo, wathi ngesikhathi abomtholampilo sebebayalela ukuthi mabaye esibhedlela, uvele wavalelisa esefika ngaphandle kwesango.Uthe ufuna azikhokhe izindleko zokuya kwabo esibhedlela. Emva kokuthintwa yiSolezwe, uSihlalo wesigungu esilawula isikole, uMnuz Mkhize uthe akanalo ulwazi ngodaba, wacela ukunikwa isikhathi ukuze athinte uthishanhloko wesikole. Isolezwe kuthe selibuyela kuye, wathi uthishanhloko uthi asikho isigameko esinjalo esenzekile.
KULINDELEKE ukuthi bagwetshwe ngoLwesibili oluzayo abesilisa ababili abalahlwe yicala lokudubula, babulale owayenguthishanhloko obambile esikoleni iSikhethuxolo High eMpumalanga, eHammarsdale. Uthe ukukhahlamezeka ngokubulawa kukamfowabo babekubona ngisho nakuye unina (94), owayengasabuthu quthu ubuthongo, agcine esekhuluma yedwa ebusuku, ebuza ukuthi ababulali babona kungcono babulale eyakhe ingane. Uveze ukuthi nakuba bengakaze balubone unyembezi luqathaka emehlweni ayo kodwa bezwa ngabangani bayo ukuthi emva kokubulawa kukayise, yavele yayothenga isibhamu esiyithoyizi, ngale kokwazisa umndeni. "Sathola ukuthi uthi usithengele ukuzivikela,” usho kanje.Uveze ukuthi abanye abafowabo, abezi nakuza enkantolo, ngoba bayahluleka ukubhekana nababulali. UKHATHAZEKILE uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ngokuthi iziboshwa ezevile ku-18 000, ezadedelwa ngoshwele eminyakeni emithathu edlule, ziphinde zabuyela ekhulukuthu.Uthe ezinye zalezi ziboshwa zazenze amacala abucayi athinta nokubulala."Kuyakhathaza ukuthi iziboshwa ezingaka ezadedelwa ngoshwele ziphinde zaboshwa futhi ngokwenza amanye amacala. Abadedelwa ngoshwele babhekana nezinselelo eziningi emuva kokuphuma ejele, babekwa izici emphakathini. Abanye abakwazi ukuthola umsebenzi, abanye basuke bengalashiwe izifo ezithinta ingqondo nezidakamizwa, kuba nzima nokwakha ubudlelwano nemindeni yabo, okwenza bagcine sebebuyele ejele," usho kanje. Uthe babuyela emajele ngoba iyona ndawo abayijwayele."Abanye baqhubeka nokuba amalungu amagenge noma sebengaphandle. Asikwazi ukukhuluma ngenkinga yokulwa nobugebengu kuleli, singayithinti indaba yokuhlunyeleliswa kwezimilo kwabagqunywe emajele." Uthe abantu bakhathele wubugebengu, iningi lithi ababoshiwe abagqunywe unomphela emajele, kulahlwe okhiye."Bathwala kanzima abasebenza emajele. Basebenza engozini yamagenge angabalimaza noma yinini kodwa bayaqhubeka nokwenza umsebenzi oncomekayo behlumelelisa izimilo. Kunanenkinga enkulu yokugcwala kwamajele kuleli," usho kanje izolo evula ngokusemthethweni isikhungo i-Nelson Mandela Rules Training Academy, ejele iDrakenstein, eKapa. Leli jele elalaziwa nge-Victor Verster, linomlando ojulile kuleli njengoba kwakugqunywe khona umengameli wokuqala wentando yabantu, uMnuz Nelson Mandela, ngaphambi kokuba adedelwe, UMandela wadedelwa kuleli jele ngoFebhuwari 10, 1990. "Lesi sikhungo esokuqala kuleli nase-Afrika yonkana kanti sifundisa ngamakhono ahlukene futhi sigqugquzela ukugcinwa kwamalungelo abantu. Ifenisha ekulesi sikhungo, imidwebo nezinye izinto kwenziwe yiziboshwa," kusho uRamaphosa. UNgqongqoshe wokuHlunyeleliswa kweziMilo, uDkt Pieter Groenewald, ukhale esifanayo noRamaphosa ngeziboshwa ezidedelwa bese ziphinde zibuyela emajele sezenze amacala."Iyasikhathaza kakhulu eyalezi ziboshwa, esizihlumelelisa izimilo bese zibuyela ebugebengwini. kuyasikhathaza futhi nokulinyazwa kwabasebenzi, belinyazwa amagenge emajele." Uthe baqeqesha iziboshwa ngamakhono ahlukene ukuze zikwazi ukwenza umehluko uma sezidedelwe. Uveze ukuthi kulesi sikhungo kufundiswa nangokuxazulula izinkinga nezindlela ezehlukene zokuhlumelelisa izimilo.URamaphosa uthe kubuyisa ithemba ukuthi kunezinhlelo zokuthi iziboshwa zizithungele umfaniswano wazo, zizakhele ifenisha, zikhiqize ukudla ngoba isimo somnotho asisihle ezweni.Uthe bazoqhubeka nokusebenzisana ne-United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime (UNODC).
AMAQEMBU aphikisayo akhale ngokuthi uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa uphinde izinto ahlezi ezithembisa angazifezi ngesikhathi ethula inkulumo yakhe.Iqembu eliphikisa ngokusemthethweni, iMKP kanye ne-EFF, bathe akukho okusha okushiwo uRamaphosa.Ilungu leMKP ePhalamende, uMnuz Mzwanele Manyi, lithe bebelindele ukuthi uRamaphosa asho ukuthi yiliphi ibanga aselihambile ekufezeni izinto ayezithembisile ngonyaka odlule.UManyi uthe uvele wamangala uma uRamaphosa esephinda izinto ahlezi ezisho."Umoshiwe nje lo R7 million (osetshenziswe kuhlelwa inkulumo). Ngabe uvele wethula nje inkulumo esehhovisi lakhe. Besingekho isidingo sokuthi asibizele ukuzosiphindela into ahlezi esitshela yona."UManyi uthe umholi weMKP, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, ukhethe ukungalubhadi ePhalamende ngenxa yakho ukuthi ubazi ukuthi ayikho into entsha ezokhulunywa uRamaphosa.Umholi we-EFF, uMnuz Julius Malema, uthe izethembiso ezenziwe uRamaphosa izolo ubengaqali ukuzenza."Umehluko nje wukuthi kulokhu ubekhuluma ngokuzethemba. Kade aqala ukukhuluma ngale zinto. Kungani namanje esalokhu ephinda le nto yokuthi kuzotshalwa izigidi zamaRandi ekulungiseni ingqalasizinda yamanzi? Kade ayelokhu esibelesela ngale nto. Kwatshalwa imali ohlelweni lwamanzi eGiyani kodwa namanje amanzi awaphumi. Le nto ikutshela khona ukuthi uhulumeni uhlulekile wukulungisa udaba lwamanzi."Amaqembu abusa ngokubambisana ayishayele ihlombe inkulumo kaRamaphosa, ancoma isinqumo sakhe sokujuba amasosha ezindaweni ezikhungethwe wubugebengu.Okhulumema i-IFP, uMnuz Mkhuleko Hlengwa, uthe nakuba kuyinto enhle ukujutshwa kwamasosha, kodwa lesi sinqumo sikhombisa ukuthi amaphoyisa ayahluleka ukulwa nobugebengu."Siyakujabulela ukujutshwa kwamasosha kodwa kukhombisa ngokusobala ukuthi amaphoyisa ayahluleka ukwenza umsebenzi wawo. Kufanele kuqalwe uhlelo lokulungisa umonakalo osemaphoyiseni."Iphini likanobhala jikelele we-ANC lokuqala, uNkk Nomvula Mokonyane, lithe uRamaphosa ukhulume ngezinto ezibambekayo."Izinto akhulume ngazo zithinta abantu kakhulu. Indaba yokulungiswa komasipala, ukulwa nobugebengu kanye nokuthuthukiswa komnotho. Siyazi ukuthi abantu abaningi bahlezi lubhojozi ngenxa yobugebengu. Siyakujabulela ukujutshwa kwamasosha ukuba ayolekelela ekulweni nobugebengu."UMholi weDA ophinde abe wuNgqongqoshe wezoLimo, uMnuz John Steenhuisen, uncome ukuhlonzwa kwamatele njengenhlekelele.USteenhuisen uthe ukuhlonzwa kokubheduka kwamatele njengenhlekelele kuzolekelela umnyango awuholayo ukuba ukwazi ukuphuthumisa uhlelo lokugoma imfuyo.Uthe kuzoqala maduze ukugonywa kwemfuyo, wathi kuzophinde kuqiniswe nemithetho elawula ukuthuthwa kwemfuyo.
INGENWA nguhulumeni kazwelonke inkinga yokungawatholi amanzi kwemiphakathi ehlukene, ebhikisha nsuku zaphuma ikhala ngokungaphumi lutho kompompi.Kuzotshalwa izigidigidi ukulungisa ingqalasizinda yamanzi kuphinde kuthathelwe izinyathelo ezinqala, omasipala kanjalo nabaphathi bemikhandlu abahlulwa umsebenzi wokuhlinzeka abantu ngamanzi.Lokhu kuvezwe nguMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa izolo ebusuku, ngesikhathi ethula inkulumo abeyibhekise esizweni eCity Hall, eKapa. URamaphosa uthe kuzotshalwa u-R156 billion ukulungisa ingqalasizinda yamanzi kuleli."Inkinga yamanzi ekhona manje idalwa wukunganakwa kwengqalasizinda yamanzi womasipala abahlukene. Abantu bezwa ubuhlungu ngokungawatholi amanzi kompompi. Yingakho sesijube ikomiti elizobhekana ngqo nale nkinga yamanzi, elizobe liholwa yimina," usho kanje.Uthe bazojuba ongoti kwezamanzi abazobhekana ngqo nale nkinga wathi sebeqalile ukuvulela amacala omasipala abahluleka ukuhlinzeka amanzi."Bangu-56 omasipala esibavulele amacala okuhluleka ukuhlinzeka amanzi. Sesinqume ukuthi sesizovulela icala nabaphathi bemikhandlu, abahlulwa umsebenzi wokuqinisekisa ukuthi umphakathi uthola amanzi," usho kanje. Komasipala abakhulu abangamaMetro, uthe bazotshala enye imali engu-R54 billion, yokulungisa ingqalasizinda yamanzi okubalwa amapayipi, kanjalo nengqalasizinda kagesi.URamaphosa ukhale ngokuthi omasipala bajuba abantu abangenamava ngezithinta amanzi kunokuthi kujutshwe ongoti."Sifuna ukuqeda ngokuthi kufakwe abantu abangazi lutho ngezithinta amanzi. Asisakwazi ukusonga izandla silinde omasipala bazilungisele le nkinga yamanzi yingakho singenelela," usho kanje. Muva nje kunemibhikisho ezindaweni ezehlukene ngezinkinga zamanzi kuleli.URamaphosa umemezele nokuthi kuzogxilwa empini yokulwa nobugebengu, kusetshenziswa ubuchwepheshe besimanje."Sizojuba amasosha ezindaweni ezihlaselwe wubugebengu bamagenge, eWestern Cape. Sizojuba amasosha naseGoli, lapho kuzoliwa nenkinga yamaZamaZama. Ngiyalele uNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa ukuthi bakhe uhlelo noMbutho wezokuVikela ukulwa nalezi zinselelo esibhekene nazo." Uveze nokuthi kuzokwandiswa isibalo samaphoyisa ukulwa nobugebengu obuhleliwe kuleli."Sizoqasha amaphoyisa angu-5 500, azokwengeza esibalweni samaphoyisa angu-20 000, esamemezela ukuthi sizowengeza. Sibhekene ngqo nempi yobugebengu kuleli. Sizobheka nempilo ephilwa izikhulu zamaphoyisa, ukulwa nenkohlakalo." Ukhale ngenkinga yophuzo oludakayo kuleli wathi baneziphakamiso abazenzayo ukuze kuliwe nalesi sihlava."Sibheka izindlela zokunqanda ukukhangiswa kophuzo oludakayo." Uthe isibonelelo sabangasebenzi kuleli, sizoqhubeka nangomuso ukuze siqhubeke nokutakula abahlwempu."Imali yesibonelelo ithenga ukudla iphinde isebenze ekutheni abantu bagibele. Yingakho lesi sibonelelo sisibuyekeza ukuze siqhubeke nokweseka abahlwempu." Uveze ukuthi bazojova imfuyo engu-14 million, ukuyivikela esifweni samatele njengoba kuzothengwa imijovo engu-28 million. Kwezemfundo, uthe bazovula amathuba entsheni ukuthi ikwazi ukungena ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme."Ngiyalele uNgqongqoshe wezeMfundo ePhakeme ukuthi asebenzisane nozakwabo kwezeziMali, ukuqhamuka nesiphakamiso sokuthi kwandiswe amanyuvesi namakolishi ama-TVET."Odabeni lwabokufika abakuleli ngokungemthetho, uthe bazoqinisa imingcele wathi abaqashi abaqashe abangenawo amaphepha okuba kuleli, bazobhekana nomthetho."Sizokwandisa nesibalo sabahloli abangu-10 000, abazobheka izinkampani ukuthi aziqashi abangenawo amaphepha." Uthe ngeke bakuvume ukuchukuluzwa amanye amazwe ngoba elakuleli yizwe elinemithetho.Uqale inkulumo yakhe ngokubala izinto ezenziwe nguhulumeni wokubambisana kwamaqembu, iGNU. Ubale eyokubanjwa ngempumelelo komhlangano wamazwe akwi-G20 nyakenye, eyokwehlisa isikweletu sikahulumeni ngokwehlisa inzalo ekhokhelwa lesi sikweletu, ukuqedwa kwenkinga yokucishwa kukagesi, waphinde wabala neyokukhuliswa komnotho ukuze bakwazi ukubhekana nezidingo zabantu ezifana nokungasebenzi kwentsha.
UBUHOLI be-ANC KwaZulu-Natal sebuqalile ukukhangisa umcimbi wesifundazwe wokugubha usuku lokuzalwa kwe-ANC okuzokhuluma kuwo uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa.Ubuholi be-ANC bufake ezinkundleni zokuxhumana imibhalo ekhombisa ukuthi umcimbi owaziwa ngeJanuwari 8, uzoba seThekwini, ngoMashi 7.IJanuwari 8 ye-ANC kuzwelonke yayisesifundazweni iNorth West, ngenyanga eyedlule. Abantu babengagcwele enkundleni iMorulong Stadium, emumatha abantu abangu-25 000.Ubuholi benhlangano bakhala ngelanga elalikhipha umkhovu etsheni nesiminyaminya ukuthi yikhona okwenze uRamaphosa, egcine esethula inkulumo enkundleni ebingagcwele. Ezinye izifundazwe ziqalile ukuba neJanuwari 8 yazo ngeledlule.IJanuwari 8 yaKwaZulu-Natal ibanjezelwe yimicimbi kahulumeni okubalwa kuyo nenkulumo uRamaphosa azoyethula ePhalamende namhlanje.Umcimbi uzoba senkundleni yezemidlalo iTiils Crescent Sports Ground, e-Overport.Esitatimendeni, umgqugquzeli wethimba elihola i-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Mike Mabuyakhulu, uthe benza umkhuba ojwayelekile kwi-ANC."Kuwumkhuba ojwayelekile kwi-ANC ukuthi emva kweJanuwari 8 kazwelonke, bese isifundazwe senza eyaso iJanuwari 8. Lo mcimbi ubalulekile njengoba uhlanganisa abantu nezinhlaka ezalwela inkululeko."UMabuyakhulu uthe uRamaphosa uzokwethula inkulumo yosuku phambi kwamalungu eqembu azohambela umcimbi.Ngosuku olwandulela umcimbi kuzoba nesidlo sakusihlwa, esizohanjelwa osomabhizinisi kanye nezinye izinhlaka zomphakathi.Umcimbi wangenyanga ezayo uzobanjwa ngesikhathi esimatasa kwi-ANC KwaZulu-Natal.I-ANC ihlela ukubamba izingqungquthela zokukhetha ubuholi bezifunda ezingu-11 ngaphambi kokuthi kubanjwe ingqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi besifundazwe.Ingqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi besifundazwe kulindeleke ukuthi ibe ngasekupheleni kwenyanga ezayo.Isifundazwe sesihlale isikhathi eside singenabo ubuholi obukhethwe engqungqutheleni kulandela ukuhlakazwa kobuholi maphakathi nonyaka odlule.Ingqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi besifundazwe kwakuhlelwe ukuthi ibe sekupheleni konyaka odlule, kodwa kwangenzeka.Ukungabi khona kwengqungquthela kwathukuthelisa uNobhala jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, owaze wasabisa ngokuhlakaza ithimba elifanisa nemoto edume ngokungabi naso isivinini iTazz.UMbalula wayekade esabise ngokuthi ithimba elihola i-ANC esifundazweni lizohlakazwa kule nyanga.Akucaci noma i-ANC isazoqhubeka yini nokulihlakaza njengoba seliqale amalungiselelo engqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi.
YEHLISIWE imali ebekelwe umcimbi wokuvulwa kwePhalamende, ohambisana nenkulumo kaMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, ayibhekise esizweni azoyethula eKapa namhlanje ebusuku.Kulo nyaka lo mcimbi osuke uhambisana nengqephu ezimenyweni ezisuke ziwuhambele, kubekwe isabelomali sika-R7 million. Nyakenye umcimbi wawuhlinzekwe ngo-R15 million, kodwa kwagcina kusebenze u-R12.3 million.Lokhu kuvele izolo ngesikhathi izikhulu zePhalamende, zikhuluma nabezindaba ngamalungiselelo omcimbi ozoba sehholo ledolobha iCity Hall, eKapa. UNobhala wePhalamende, uMnuz Xolile George, uthe nyakenye into eyadla imali eningi wukuqashwa kwezinto zobuchwepheshe bokuqopha.Uthe lobu buxhakaxhaka badla u-R9.1 million bubodwa, wathi kulo nyaka bahlela ukuyehlisa kakhulu imali ezosebenza emcimbini."Kumele zehle izindleko ezihambisana nomcimbi wokuvulwa kwePhalamende. Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi nyakenye kwaqashwa ne-ICC ngoba kwakukhona ababehlaliswe khona, kanti kulokhu kuzoba nobhazabhaza wetende elikhulu ozoba ngaphandle kwehholo ozosetshenziselwa ukuhlalisa abathamele umcimbi," usho kanje. USomlomo wePhalamende, uNkk Thoko Didiza, uthe konke sekumi ngomumo ngalo mcimbi njengoba kuzobe kunezimenywa ezivela emikhakheni ehlukene.Uthe kumenywe nababengomengameli bezwe kanjalo nababengabaholi basePhalamende naseMkhandlwini weziFundazwe."Ababengomengameli, oMnuz Jacob Zuma noKgalema Motlanthe, baqinisekisile ukuthi bazoba yingxenye yomcimbi. UMnuz Thabo Mbeki yena uxolisile wathi ngeke aphumelele. Asilinde kuze kufike usuku lomcimbi ukuze sibone ukuthi obani abazobakhona nabazobe bengekho," usho kanje. Uthe eCity Hall kuzobe kunezimenywa, amalungu ePhalamende naweNdlu yoMkhandlu weziFundazwe kanti le ndawo imumatha abangu-490."Sithole nezicelo ezingu-1 400 ezivela kwabezindaba abafuna ukuba yingxenye yomcimbi, oba minyaka yonke. Sethemba ukuthi kuzoba okokugcina umcimbi ubanjelwa eCity Hall, njengoba zilungiswa izindlu zePhalamende ezashiswa," usho kanje.Uthe ngoFebhuwari 17 no-18, kuzoba nenkulumo mpikiswano ngenkulumo kaRamaphosa. Uzobe esephendula kule nkulumompikiswano ngoFebhuwari 19. UNkk Didiza uthe umnyango kaMgcinimafa, uveze ukuthi inkulumo yesabelomali elandela ukwethulwa kwenkulumo kamengameli ebhekiswe esizweni, izoba setendeni elisePhalamende hhayi eCity Hall.I-National Joint Operational and Intelligence Structure (NATJOINTS), ithe zizobe ziqinile ezokuphepha kulo mcimbi.Okhulumela uphiko lwamaphoyisa i-SAPS, uBrigadier Athlenda Mathe, uthe iNATJOINTS ihlangana njalo kulungiselelwa lo mcimbi osuke uhanjelwe nangamajaji.Uthe kulandwe zonke izinsiza ezidingekayo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umcimbi uba yimpumelelo.
ASOLANA ngezinsolo ezibucayi amadodana abhekene ngeziqu zamehlo kubangwa isihlalo sobukhosi baKwaNodunga, eMvoti. Izolo icala lombango beliseNkantolo eNkulu yaseMgungundlovu.Umbango oshisa phansi uphakathi kwenkosi esesihlalweni njengamanje, uNkanyiso Zulu (28) nomfowabo omdala, uMntwana uMlungisi Zulu (45). Uhlangothi olweseka uMntwana olwela isihlalo lukholwa wukuthi akumele ngabe usesihlalweni umfowabo (uNkanyiso). Lukhala ngokuthi kwaba khona ubudedengu eMnyangweni wokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal wavumela ukuthi kubekwe inkosi ebusayo njengamanje, ebekwe ngo-2021.Laba ababili kuyavela ukuthi bangamadodana enkosi eyakhothama ngo-2016, uQedisono Zulu. Ngemuva kwalokho kuthiwa kwangena ibambabukhosi elisadla anhlamvana, uMnuz Mphamandla Zulu naye obekhona enkantolo.UMntwana uMlungisi utshele Isolezwe ukuthi akumele engabe usesihlalweni umfowabo omncane. Uthe usazibuza uyaziphendula ukuthi lokhu kwenzeka kanjani?Uveze izinsolo ezibucayi zokuthi umfowabo wahamba noyise kwayiwa eThekwini ethi uyamvikela ngoba kukhona abantu abamakhela uzungu abakha itulo lokumsoconga.''Ubaba emva kwalokho asizange saphinde sambona. Wafika eThekwini wagula waze washona. Nakhona lapho uma eseshonile umfowethu akangitshelanga lutho kunalokho wenza imizamo yokuthi amfihle ubaba ngaphandle kokungazisa. Waqamba amanga eMnyangweni wokuBusa ngokuBambisana wathi mina angiyingeni eyokufihla ubaba," kuchaza yena.Uthe yena waze wazi ngokushona kukayise ngemuva kwesikhathi esingangenyanga. ''Yinto enjani nje leyo uyabona ukuthi wayefisa ukumfihlela eThekwini ubaba ngaphandle kwesizathu," usho kanjena.Uthe umngcwabo kayise wawungeke uqhubeke engekho ngoba njengendodana endala kwakumele enze usiko lokuphatha umkhonto phambi kwesizwe.Eqhuba uveze ukuthi inkosi esesihlalweni uyishiya ngeminyaka eminingi futhi ayimelami nokumelama njengoba yena elanywa yintombazane.Mayelana nencwadi, lolu olunye uhlangothi oluthi yashiywa yinkosi ngaphambi kokuba ikhothame, uthe leyo ncwadi inkantolo yayichitha ngoba yayingasayiniwe.Uthe kwathi sekwenziwa ucwaningo kwatholakala ukuthi ayibhalwangwa ngumufi. Ingwevu endala yaKwaNodunga, uMnuz Thabani Zulu, ithe kwaba nephutha ukuba kubekwe inkosi esesihlalweni ekhona uMntwana uMlungisi. Uthe lokhu abakwenza babekwenza benenhloso yabo ethile.Ngakolunye uhlangothi abeseka inkosi esesihlalweni bathi ibambe ngakho vele kumele ngabe iyona esesihlalweni ngoba lokho kwakuyisifiso sikayise ngaphambi kokuba akhothame.Induna yesizwe, uMnuz Clerment Mhlaba ilibeke ngembaba elokuthi inkosi ekhona njengamanje yagunyazwa yinkosi eyakhothama ngencwadi eyayibhala isadla anhlamvana.Leyo ncwadi kuthiwa inkosi yayishiya kuMnuz Bongumusa Zulu okuqinisekisile kwiSolezwe ukuthi nebala leyo ncwadi inkosi yayibhala yayishiya kuyena. Uthe inkosi kuleyo ncwadi yayigunyaza ukuba inkosi esesihlalweni manje kube iyona eyengamela isizwe uma seyikhotheme.Kuthiwa incwadi efanayo inkosi yaphinde yayibhala yayishiya kummeli ngeshwa osewalala kobandayo.Lolu hlangothi luthe inkosi eyakhothama yayingeke ibeke indodana endala ekubeni kwaba khona ukungaboni ngaso linye phakathi kwabo.Lokhu lolu hlangothi luthi kwadalwa wukuthi indodana endala yazama ukulala nomunye wamakhosikazi enkosi eyakhothama.Inkosi yalile ukukhuluma yathi akukho engakusho okwamanje ngalolu daba. Ngaphakathi enkantolo ummeli wohlangothi lwendodana endala, u-Advocate Michael Naidoo kuningi athe ufuna ukuba kubhekisiswe mayelana naleli cala.Icala liyobuyela enkantolo efanayo ngo-Ephreli 21.
UKUBA muncu kwesimo okwakuvame ukwenzeka kuNkk Phindile Dimba nomyeni wakhe, bebanga ukuthi akabe esafuna kuzwa lutho uma sekuyisikhathi sebhola likanobhutshuzwayo, kugcine kujika izinto futhi kwakhulisa nothando lwezemidlalo kuyena.Manje uNkk Dimba, waseMpola, eDassenhoek, eThekwini, akaconsi phansi kubalandeli bebhola likanobhutshuzwayo ikakhulu abe-Orlando Pirates. Manje ungumlandeli weZimnyama ongezwa mshini ngezakhe, futhi usedume kakhulu kuTikTok lapho enabalandeli khona abangaphezu kuka-47 000, nama-likes angaphezu kwa-1.2 million kumavidiyo awafaka khona njalo.Elandisa ngohambo lwakhe njengomlandeli, uNkk Dimba uthe ubengenankinga nalo mdlalo, kepha inkinga ebiba khona wukuthi bekuba wukuthi uma kudlala ibhola lezinyawo, ikakhulu iKaizer Chiefs elandelwa wumyeni wakhe, kube muncu emzini wabo ngenxa yokuthi owakwakhe akabe esezwa lutho uma sekudlala ezikaShintsha Guluva."Le nto yenze ngaze ngabona ukuthi ayikho into engingayenza ngalesi simo ngoba phela umyeni wami ulizwa ngaphakathi ibhola. Ngabona kumele ngibe nendlela nje engingayisebenzisa ukumeseka embonweni wakhe, kepha ngingafuni ukuthi ngihambisane naye kukhona konke okuthinta ibhola likanobhutshuzwayo. "Ngiiqale kanjalo-ke ukulandelela kakhulu Amabhakabhaka, ngoba ngazi ukuthi yena akawafuni njengoba ewumlandeli waMakhosi. Ngaqala ngenza ama-video njalo uma kudlala iPirates noma uma inqobile, noma kudliwe iChiefs - bese ngiwafaka ekhasini lezinkundla zokuxhumana ngenhloso yokuthi ngihlabekise labo abangasifuni,” kulanda uNkk Dimba.Eqhuba, uthe ikhasi lakhe liqale ukukhula kakhulu kumasizini amabili kuya kwamathathu edlule ngenkathi eZimnyama zisaqeqeshwa wuJose "The Spanish Guitar” Riveiro, ngoba yilapho ebese zibhaxabula kwasani futhi ziwola izinkomishi amahlandla alandelanayo."Khona kubuye kube nalokho kokubheka izinto ezishiwo ngabantu abangahambisani nezinto engizishoyo nengizifaka ekhasini lami, kodwa ngiyaye ngingakunaki kakhulu ngoba mina ngiyazi ukuthi ngisopheni ngalolu hlobo lwama-video engiwenzayo njalo,” kusho yena.Uthe ufisa ukuthi nabanye abantu besifazane, abangawuqondi nabangawulandeli lo mdlalo kanobhutshuzwayo, baqale manje ukuwulandela nokuwuqonda ukuthi ukanjani ukuze kungabi bikho izingxabano ezingenasidingo phakathi kwabo nabantu abathandana nabo."Kanjalo nabesilisa ngiyabakhuthaza ukuthi bengabavaleli ngaphandle abantu abathandana nabo uma sekuyisikhathi sabo sokubuka ibhola, kepha ababajwayeze lo mdlalo futhi nje bakhuthale ukuhamba nezithandwa zabo ukuyobuka ibhola ezinkundleni ezahlukene ukusiza ukuqinisa ukuzwana nobudlelwano babo bothando,” kucebisa yena.Mayelana nezinhlelo zengomuso, uNkk Dimba uthe ufisa ukuthi agcine enohlelo kuYouTube lapho ezoxoxa khona ngebhola lezinyawo nabangani bakhe, abomndeni nezihlobo abanothando lwebhola nabaliqondayo ukuthi lihamba kanjani.
IBHANGE, iFirst National Bank (FNB), selwethule uhlelo olusha noluzokwenza kube ngcono indlela yokuvula i-akhawunti yestokofela sangaphakathi kuleli bhange, njengoba manje amakhasimende esezokwazi ukuwavula esebenzisa i-app nohlelo lobuchwepheshe.Lokhu kuhlaluke emcimbini obuwenziwe yi-FNB eMega City, eMlaza, lapho okuvele khona ukuthi sekuzoba lula emakhasimende ukwenza lokhu njengoba esikhathini esiphambilini bekudingeka ukuthi aziyele ebhange mathupha ukuze asizakale.Isikhulu esiphezulu sophiko olubhekele ukutshala imali eFNB, uMnuz Hilmal Parbhoo, sithe lokhu kusho lukhulu kubona, futhi kuyisinyathelo esimqoka nesizoba wusizo kakhulu emakhasimendeni abo afuna ukuvula nokusebenzisa lolu hlobo lwe-akhawunti."Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi kube lula emakhasimendeni ethu ukusebenzisa nokulawula lama akhawunti ngokwawo ngaphandle kokudinga ukuthi aze avakashele ebhange ngqo ukuze asizakale kwasuke efuna ukukwenza ngawo,” kusho uParbhoo.Isikhulu esiphezulu sophiko olubhekele izikhalo nezidingo zamakhasimende eFNB, uNksz Lynatia Johnson, sithe banqume ukuqala lolu hlelo ngenhlso yokusiza amakhasimende abo asezindaweni zasemakhaya, obekuvame ukuba yinkinga kuwona ukuzifikela mathupha ebhange."Lesi yisixazululo esizoba wusizo kakhulu ebantwini, kanti futhi sizobe sisabasiza nalabo abafuna ukuzizela mathupha ebhange, kodwa nje sijabulela ukuthi lelo nalelo khasimende lizozikhethela ngokwalo ukuthi lifuna ukusizakala kanjani kulokhu,” kusho uNksz Johnson.UParbhoo uthe lolu hlelo balwenze ngesikhathi esihle impela njengoba kusuka ngoJanuwari kuya kuMashi kuyilapho amakhasimende amaningi enza khona kakhulu lolu hlobo lwama-akhawunti ngenhloso yokuzijwayeza ukubeka nokonga imali.Ukuvula lolu hlelo lwe-akhawunti ngobuchwepheshe u-download i-app yaseFNB noma ungene kwi-website yabo ethi: www.fnb.co.za
BAKHALA ngamaphoyisa kaMasipala weTheku, akhishwa inkani yimilutha yewunga, bese ezokhiphela kubo isibhongo, abadayisa emigwaqweni esenkabeni yedolobha nakwezinye izindawo.Basho lokhu kulandela ukuthi amaphoyisa etshele iphepha elinguzakwabo weSolezwe, iDaily News ngeledlule ukuthi impi yemilutha yewunga isiwehlule. Okhulumela amaphoyisa kaMasipala weTheku, uColonel Boysie Zungu, utshele iDaily News ukuthi banenkinga yokuthi imilutha iyabuya njalo uma kade beyixoshile. Uthe ukungabi bikho kwezikhungo zokugcina abangenamakhaya, yikhona okuyinkinga.Le milutha sekuphele izinyanga eziyisihlanu ingenise emgwaqweni uChe Guevera, owawaziwa ngoMoore Road. Imilutha ivale umzila owodwa walo mgwaqo ngamatende okuzakhela. Ihlala kuwona ubusuku nemini, ilokhu izulazula kule ndawo. Ngeledlule kusabalale i-video ikhombisa imilutha ibamba inkunzi imoto ebidlula kulo mgwaqo. Omunye wabadayisi, uNksz Thabo Ngcobo wenhlangano yabadayisa iphinifa eThekwini, iPhinifa neDuku Association, uthe emgwaqweni uVictoria enkabeni yeTheku, ukugasela kwamaphoyisa, yisinkwa semihla ngemihla. "Thina sihlala nawo amaphoyisa kuVictoria. Afika nsuku zonke ezosiphuca impahla yethu. Noma ungaguqa ngamadolo, uzincengele, awezwa mshini,” kusho uNksz Ngcobo. Uthe ayayithatha impahla bese ebanika amathikithi enhlawulo ka-R600. Uthe uma umuntu efuna ukuthi impahla yakhe ibuye, kusuke kufanele avuke ngakusasa ayokhokha lo R600."Sizwa ubuhlungu uma amaphoyisa evuma ukuthi iyawahlula impi yamaphara ngoba le ayibhekise kithi, ayiwahluli,” kusho uNksz Ngcobo.Uthe ngabe bayajabula ukuba amaphoyisa kamasipala ahlale ebahlukumeza ngokubathathela impahla, asebenzisa umfutho ofanayo ukuyojaha imilutha yewunga. Uthe nakuba bazi ukuthi kuthiwa baphula umthetho kodwa bondla imindeni ngemali yokudayisa emgwaqweni. "Imilutha yewunga yona ihlukumeza abantu, ibabambe nenkunzi. Yibona bantu okufanele engabe banomdlandla wokulwa nabo, hhayi thina,” usho kanje.Ekhuluma neSolezwe uZungu izolo uthe bengamaphoyisa baqinisekisa ukugcinwa kwayo yonke imithetho kamasipala. Uthe abadayisa emgwaqweni bazi kahle ukuthi kudingeka ukuthi babe nezimvume zokudayisa ukuze baqhube amabhizinisi ezitaladini zeTheku. "Asilwi nabo, siqinisekisa ukugcinwa kwemithetho kamasipala,” kusho uZungu. Ube eseveza ukuthi neyabahlala emgwaqweni bayayilwa cishe nsuku zonke."Sisemkhankasweni wokukhuculula iTheku futhi siyanqoba,” usho kanje."Akulona iqiniso ukuthi asilwi nabahlala emgwaqweni,” kusho uZungu.
ISIZWE sakwaMkhwanazi sizifanise nengane edlebelekile yachachaza ekhanda likayise ngesikhathi sihambele esigodlweni seSilo eMashobeni, oPhongolo, ngoMsombuluko.Inhlosongqangi yalo mhlangano bekuwukuthi abakwaMkhwanazi bafongqe isigqoko bacele uxolo ngomsindo owabheduka kubangwa ukubekwa kweSo leSilo esizweni sabo.UNdunankulu wesizwe sakwaMkhwanazi, uMntwana uNtuthuko Mkhwanazi, uthe bayavuma ukuthi bathatha ngenhliziyo bakhuluma baze beqisa ngesikhathi kusuka lolu dungunyane.Uthe kwakungamele bakuvumele lokho ukuba kwenzeke noma ngabe izinhliziyo zabo zazihluthuke kangakanani. ''Kwaba khona ukukhuluma esakukhuluma ngemuva kokukhuluma okwashiwo yiMbube ngokuthi kukhona ingxenye ethile yesizwe sethu esizoba neso lomnuzane thizeni. Lokho akuzange kusenelise, sakhuluma saze seqisa. Uma-ke uyingane ukhulume waze weqise kuyihlo, kumele kube nendlela yokukhombisa ukuzisola,'' usho kanjena.Uvumile ukuthi ngalokhu abakwenza babemane behlulwa yintukuthelo nje."Akekho lapha kwaZulu ongangeSilo, kwakungamele sikhulume ngaleya ndlela. Noma sikhala kwakumele kube ukuthi sikhala siya kubaba kodwa thina samane senza iphutha elikhulu, sakhala njengezimpangele, sakhala saqonda esihlahleni," kusho yena.Uthe bafikile eSilweni ngenhloso yokukhombisa okukhulu ukuzisola ngemuva kokuba bekuqaphelile ukuthi bagcina sebenza okungafanele."Sihlale sahlala inkosi yesizwe yasiqoqa yathi masize sizozilahla. Bayede, sizozilahla ngoba vele kusekhaya lethu lapha," usho kanjena.Uthe bathakasile kakhulu ukuthi bahambe kahle bemukelwa esigodlweni."Sijabule ukuthi sifikile sazolungisa lokhu obekumele sikulungise lapha namhlanje. Lokhu kusho lukhulu kabi kuthina njengesizwe sabaKhwanazi," usho kanjena.UMntwana uThulani Zulu uthe bayakwamukelwa ukuxolisa kwesizwe sabaKhwanazi."Kwaba khona ukukhuluma okungekuhle okwakuvela kubaKhwanazi. Maningi kakhulu amagama angemahle ayevela KwaMpukunyoni ebhekiswe eSilweni. Kwakungafanele bakhombise ukungahloniphi ngoba lokho akuzange kunambithisiseke kahle," kusho yena.Uthe yonke imizi inabo abantu abaphuma eceleni, wathi yingakho belwamukela uxolo oluvela kwabakwaMkhwanazi.''Siyazi sonke ukuthi udadewabo weSilo saKwaNodwengu, uNtikili, uyena owadla umuzi waKwaMpukunyoni wase ezala amakhosi khona. Sithi makube kuhle kube nokuthula. Siyajabula ukuthi abakwaMkhwanazi baligezile igama labo namhlanje," usho kanje.Uthe kakade vele Inkosi yabaKhwanazi iphethe egameni leNgonyama isizwe sabaKhwanazi.Eqhuba lokhu, uthe kuzokuba yisibonelo sokuthi lapho okukhona khona abantu abagcwanekayo bagcina bebuya bezocela uxolo. AbakwaMkhwanazi bashiye amaguqa amane njengophawu lokucela uxolo.AbakwaMkhwanazi bafike ekuseni, bahlale isikhathi eside. Ngokuhamba kosuku ngezithuba zehora lesihlanu, ziphume zilandelana izimoto zonke ebezisegcekeni ziya ngemuva okuyilapho okuthiwa bekukhona iSilo khona.AbakwaMkhwanazi bebekade beholwa yiNkosi yesizwe uNtokozo Mkhwanazi.
ZITHUKUTHELE maqede zabhikisha izolo ngaphandle kwesikhungo semfundo ephakeme, iCoastal KZN TVET College, kwa-V, eMlaza, izitshudeni ezinqaba ukuhlaliswa ezindaweni ezingazifuni.Ngokusho kwesinye sezitshudeni ebezibhikisha, esicele ukungadalulwa ngenxa yokubona singaphephile, abazifuni izindawo ezihlala ezitshudeni abaphoqelelwa ukuthi bazisebenzise.Siveze izinsolo zokuthi lezi zindawo ziselokishini eMlaza, kanti ezelungu elaziwayo, abaligagule ngegama lenhlangano, iDelangokubona. IDelangokubona ayitholakalanga ukuba iphawule ngokuyamaniswa kwalo somabhizinisi nayo. "Esontweni elandulela eledlule, lo baba utheleke emagcekeni esikhungo ehlome ngesibhamu. Ufike wakhomba ngesibhamu isisebenzi sesikhungo esijutshwe ukuthi sibhekelele ukuhlaliswa kwezitshudeni. Usitshele ukuthi asiqinisekise ukuthi izitshudeni zihlaliswa ezindaweni zakhe, hhayi kwezinye izindawo,” kusho isitshudeni.Siveze ukuthi azikho izinyathelo ezithathwe abaphathi besikhungo ezifana nokuvulela owesilisa icala. "Kuyicala ukukhiphela umuntu isibhamu, umkhombe ngaso. Sifuna ukwazi ukuthi isikhungo sihlaleleni singamvulele lo baba icala,” kusho isitshudeni. Siqhube sathi, esikhundleni sokuthi isikhungo sivulele owesilisa icala, sitshele izitshudeni ukuthi ngoba usekhulumile "ubhuti omdala”, kufanele kwenzeke lokhu akufunayo.Kuze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela isikhungo singakaphefumuli ngezinsolo ezibekwayo."Asizifuni izindawo zokuhlala zalo muntu siyizitshudeni. Inqwaba yabebehlala kuzo ibe noxhaxha lwenkinga ngonyaka odlule. Bekuphela amanzi, ugesi, i-Wi-fi, kuthi uma umnikazi ebikelwa, azikhiphele isibhamu izitshudeni,” kusho isitshudeni.Sithe abafuni ukuhlala ezindaweni zomuntu abamsabayo, okuthi uma kuvela izinkinga, esikhundleni sokuthi azilungise, akhethe ukubajijimeza ngesibhamu. Ziphinde zakhala ngezokuphepha ezindaweni zakhe, zathi akukho ngisho onogada, nokwenza zizizwe zingaphephile."Lezi zindawo esifuna ukuyohlala kuzo thina, ezisenkabeni yeTheku, zinonogada, ubusuku nemini. Sizizwa siphephile uma sihleli kuzo,” sisho kanje.Siphinde sathi izitshudeni zinelungelo lokuyohlala noma kuphi lapho ezifisa ukuhlala khona, ngaphandle kokusatshiswa nokuphoqwa ukuthi ziyohlala endaweni ezingayifuni. Sithe bazoqhubeka nombhikisho wabo, kuze kulalelwe izikhalo zabo. Sithe bayazi ukuthi owesilisa uthumela abathile ukuthi baqalaze ngisho nasemaqoqweni kaWhatsApp lapho bekhuluma khona ukuze azi amagama alabo abaphikisa eyokuthi izitshudeni zihlale ezindaweni zakhe. Usomabhizinisi wezindawo okuthiwa uyathinteka uzanywe kaningi ocingweni okuthiwe ngolwakhe, lwangaphendulwa.

Kepha u-O'Sullivan uthe le mali yayingaqhamuki esikhwameni sezinhloli.U-O'Sullivan uthe yayiphuma esikhwameni senhlangano yezokushushisa, iNational Prosecuting Authority (NPA).U-O'Sullivan uthe kule mali wayekhokhelwa izindleko zakhe zokulekelela ophenyweni olwaluqhutshwa iNPA.UNksz James uthe bazovulela u-O'Sullivan icala lokuqamba amanga efungile. KULINDELEKE ukuthi ufike kuleli sonto umgomo wesifo esidlange KwaZulu-Natal, amatele.UNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, uthe balindele ukuthi kufike imigomo ewu-1.5 million.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ehlangene nomphakathi waKwaXimba, eThekwini, lapho ebeyoxwayisa khona ngokubheduka kwamatele.UNtuli uthe isifundazwe iKwaZulu-Natal yisona esizothola ingxenye enkulu yemigomo ezofika kuleli sonto."Amatele abhoke kakhulu lapha KwaZulu-Natal, futhi yithina esinemfuyo eningi. Thina sinemfuyo elinganiselwa ku-2.4 million. Silindele ukuthi ijovwe le mfuyo."UNtuli uthe uma isifikile imigomo bazoqala uhlelo lokugoma imfuyo, wathi bazohambela zonke izingxenye zesifundazwe uma sekuqale uhlelo lokugoma.
