Kwesinye isikhathi uma imfuyo isihlabekile, kufanele iqale ivalelwe yodwa ngaphambi kokuthi ithole incwadi yokuthi isingahamba iye kwenye indawo. Sesishaye umthetho wokuthi asifuni kube khona imfuyo ezosuka kwesinye isifunda, iye kwesinye isifunda ngenxa yokuthi sigwema khona ukusabalala kwamatele."Abaphathiswa beminyango ehlukene bebehambele ezifundeni ezahlukene zesifundazwe izolo, beqwashisangamatele.
BATHI abadala "ithi ingaba nkulu ingabe isazekeka" njengoba kunzima ukuchaza umdonsiswano wobuholi oqhubeka kuMasipala waseMpendle.Lo mdonsiswano ulahlisa ngethemba futhi kubukeka sisekude ukutholakala isixazululo njengoba i-ANC ivukelana yodwa.Belilikhulu ithemba lokuthi zizoxazululeka izinkinga ezibhekene nomasipala ngesikhathi kubizwa umhlangano wokuqoka imeya nosomlomo, ngoLwesihlanu.Umasipala ubusuhlale izinyanga eziyisithupha ungenayo imeya kulandelwa ukukhishwa kukaMnuz Buyisani Mlaba owakhishwa ngoJulayi wangonyaka owedlule.Ukungabi khona kobuholi kudale izinkinga eziningi okubalwa kuzo ukungaholi kwabasebenzi kanye nokuvalwa kwamahhovisi omkhandlu. Kuze kube abasebenzi abakaze bayithole imiholo yabo yangenyanga eyedlule.Ithemba lokuthi zizoxazululeka izinkinga ezikhungethe umasipala lisheshe lashabalala ngesikhathi i-ANC imemezela ukumiswa kweMeya entsha uMnuz Kwenzakufani Dlamini, uSomlomo uMnuz Zibuse Dlamini, uSotswebhu uMnuz Thabani Makhaya noNksz Nokuvela Ndlovu.La makhansela amiselwe izinsolo zokushaya indiva umyalelo weqembu wokuba avotele uNksz Nonjabulo Ndlovu, ngesikhathi kukhethwa imeya entsha.Okwenza kube nzima ukuthi nawo la makhansela akuphonsela inselelo ukumiswa kwawo, nokusho ukuthi kungase kube nomdonsiswano wasenkantolo.Amakhansela athe i-ANC ayinawo amandla okuwamisa emsebenzini, athi umkhandlu kuphela onamandla okuthatha isinqumo sokuwamisa.Akulula ukuxosha ikhansela elishaya indiva umyalelo weqembu. Amakhansela ajwayele ukuya ezinkantolo, amacala avamise ukuthatha isikhathi eside equlwa ezinkantolo.Isibonelo nje, amaqembu iNFP, ABC neTeam Sugar, ake azama ukuxosha amakhansela.La maqembu azokutshela kahle ukuthi namanje asaqula amacala amakhansela amanye angena ezinkantolo ngo-2021, njengoba seliphela nje ihlandla lokubusa kwawo.Kusobala ukuthi ukusebenza komkhandlu kuzophazamiseka ngesikhathi kusedonsiswana ezinkantolo.Kungakuhle uma izinhlangothi ezithintekayo zingahlala phansi, zithole isixazululo, zigweme umdonsiswano wasezinkantolo.
AKUZANGE kuhambe ngendlela abehlele ngayo umphenyi wamacala ozimele, uMnuz Paul O'Sullivan, ngesikhathi evele phambi kwekomiti lasePhalamende eliphenya izinsolo ezenziwa uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi.U-O'Sullivan akazange alithole ithuba lokudedela amabhomu abethembise ukuwaqhumisa ngesikhathi evele phambi kwekomiti izolo.U-O'Sullivan ubekade ethembise ukuthi uzombula izinqe uMkhwanazi, uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa kuzwelonke, uLieutenant General Fanni Masemola, nenhloko yezinhloli, uLieutenant General Dumisani Khumalo.Osukwini lokuqala u-O'Sullivan uphekwe ngebhodwe elincane, ebuzwa ngomlando wakhe.Imibuzo eminingi ibigxile ekutheni u-O'Sullivan wafika kanjani kuleli, nokuthi yini ayeyenza kuleli ngesikhathi sobandlululo.U-O'Sullivan uzamile ukuyivimba imibuzo ethinta ayekwenza ngesikhathi sobandlululo, ethi akafuni ukuyiphendula ngenxa yezokuphepha.Kepha lokhu akuzange kumsebenzele njengoba amalungu ekomiti eqhubekile ngokumbuza ngokufika kwakhe kuleli.U-O'Sullivan, ongowokuzalwa e-Ireland, waqala ukufika kuleli evakasha ngeminyaka yo-1980 ngesikhathi sobandlululo. Uthe wafike walithanda elakuleli, wabe esecela ukunikezwa ubuzwe.Amalungu ekomiti abuze u-O'Sullivan ngencwadi emcelela ubuzwe kuleli.Incwadi yabhalwa owayengungqongqoshe wezokuthutha eNatal, uMnuz Watterson.Kule ncwadi uWatterson wathi u-O'Sullivan uzokuba wusizo ebelungwini.Ohola ubufakazi, u-Advocate Norman Arendse, uthe u-O'Sullivan wayencengelwa ngisho nangabantu ababengamaphoyisa ngaphansi kukahulumeni wobandlululo ukuba anikezwe ubuzwe bakuleli.U-Arendse ufune ukwazi ukuthi ngabe u-O'Sullivan wayehambisana yini nokwakwenziwa wuhulumeni wobandlululo.USotswebhu omkhulu ePhalamende, uMnuz Mdumiseni Ntuli, uthe ayigculisi impendulo ka-O'Sullivan yokuthi wayengazi ngezinye izinto ezazenzeka kuleli."Wawuneminyaka engaphezu kuka-20 ngesikhathi uvakasha kuleli. Umuntu oneminyaka engaphezu kuka-20 usuke esazi ukuthi kwenzekani emhlabeni."Umholi we-EFF, uMnuz Julius Malema, uthe umhlaba wonke wawazi ngokwakwenzeka eNingizimu Afrika."Kwakunomkhankaso omkhulu wokuba kukhululwe uMandela. Wena ufuna ukungitshela ukuthi wawungazi ngalowo mkhankaso?"U-O'Sullivan uveze ukuthi uke wasebenzela amaphoyisa akuleli, eyi-reservist.Uthe uke futhi waqeqesha amaphoyisa angama-reservist, wathi waqeqesha ngisho noMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa."Ngangimkhonzile uRamaphosa ngoba wayengumfundi owayelalela."
INkantolo eNkulu yasePitoli iyichithile imizamo kaThabo Bester yokususwa esikhungweni iBongweni Super Maximum Correctional. UBester ufake isicelo esiphuthumayo ephikisana nokudluliselwa kwakhe ejele laseKokstad, ethi ukubekwa kwakhe kuleli jele kukhinyabeza kakhulu ukuzivikela kwakhe. Ummeli kaBester, uMoafrika wa Maila, uthe ukususwa ejele iKgosi Mampuru sekudale "ukuhlupheka” kwethimba lakhe lezomthetho. Njengoba sekusele inyanga eyodwa ngaphambi kokuthi kuqale ukuqulwa kwecala lakhe lokweqa esikhungweni sokuhlunyeleliswa kwezimilo eMangaung, uMaila ukhale ngokuthi leli banga lenza ukusebenzisana noBester kube nzima kakhulu. IJaji uMamoloko Kubushi lisichithile isicelo sikaBester, linqume ukuthi lolu daba aluhlangabezani nezidingo zohlu oluphuthumayo.
UMFOWABO kaDkt Nandipha Magudumana, uNkosinathi Sekeleni, uthweswe icala lokuzama ukubulala.USekeleni uvele ngaphambi kweNkantolo yeMantshi yaseRandburg ekuqaleni kwaleli sonto ehamba namanye amadoda amabili.Laba bobathathu basolwa ngokushaya owesilisa okuthiwa ubezama ukubagebenga ngempelasonto.Ngokwemibiko, amacala anyuswe kusuka kwelokushaya laba ngelokuzama ukubulala ngenxa yokulimala komgilwa.Okhulumela amaphoyisa, uTintswalo Sibeko, uthe abamangalelwa badedelwe ngesexwayiso."Icala lenzeke ngezintatha zangoMgqibelo, ngesikhathi abamangalelwa beshaya umgilwa bemsola ngokuzama ukubagebenga," kusho uSibeko.Icala labo lizobuyela enkantolo ngomhla ka-17 Mashi 2026.
IPHINI likaMengameli wezwe, uMnuz Paul Mashatile, lithi abasabuthi quthu ubuthongo kuhulumeni ngoba bakhathazekile ngesibalo esiphezulu sentsha engasebenzi kuleli.UMashatile uthe zikhona izinhlelo zokulungisa le nkinga njengoba kukhona nezenziwa wuphiko olweseka intsha kwezamabhizinisi, i-NYDA."Iyasikhathaza indaba yabantu abangasebenzi, ikakhulu intsha okuyiyona enesibalo esiphezulu sabangasebenzi. Zikhona izinhlelo zokuzama ukusiza intsha sisebenzisana ne-NYDA," usho kanje. Ukusho lokhu, ekhuluma nentsha emcimbini yokuyazisa ngezinhlelo zikahulumeni zokuyifukula eKhayelitsha, eKapa, njengoba kulungiselelwa inkulumo kaMengameli ebhekiswe ezweni.Okuvelile kulo mcimbi ukuthi intsha eneziqu ayikwazi ukuqasheka ngenxa yokuthi kuthiwa ifunde kakhulu.Intsha ikhale ngokunqaba kwamathuba emisebenzi, yathi yinto uhulumeni okudingeka ayisukumele ngokushesha. UNgqongqoshe eHhovisi likaMengameli, uNkk Sindy Chikunga, ukhale ngokuthi intsha eneziqu isala ngaphandle uma kumele iqashwe ezikhundleni eziphezulu kuhulumeni."Uthola ukuthi intsha eneziqu ze-masters ize iqambe amanga uma ifaka izicelo ingazivezi lezi ziqu ngoba kuthiwa ifunde kakhulu, bese ingaqashwa. Uma ifaka izicelo zemisebenzi edinga i-masters, kuthiwa ayinaso isipiliyoni esidingekayo. Yingakho sifuna iqedwe eyokufunwa isipiliyoni kwabanama-masters uma befaka izicelo zomsebenzi kuhulumeni," usho kanje.Kuhlukene imibono ngokulindwe kule nkulumo kaMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa azoyethula kusasa, eKapa, njengoba kukhona abathi ababheke lutho kuyona ngoba kuzophindwa izethembiso asebeke bazizwa. Inhlangano yomasipala i-South African Local Government Association (SALGA), ithe ilindele ukuthi igqame eyokufukulwa komasipala."Sifuna kubhekelwe indaba yengqalasizinda komasipala, ukuncipha kwesabelomali okunqinda ukuhanjiswa kwezidingo, ukulungiswa kwemigwaqo, ukuhlinzekwa kukagesi namanzi kubantu. Abantu bafuna ukubona umehluko ikakhulu njengoba kubhekwe okhethweni lohulumeni basekhaya." I-DA ithe ilindele ukuthi igqame eyokonga imali kuhulumeni ngokuthi ayeke ukuqasha amabhilidi kodwa kusetshenziswe akahulumeni."Sifuna ivele eyokuvuselelwa kwamadolobha, kulungiswe izinkambi zamasosha kuphinde kwakhiwe amathuba emisebenzi." Umholi we-BOSA, uDkt Mmusi Maimane, uthe abalindele ukuphindwa kwezethembiso ezindala ngoba abantu sebekhathele izinto ezingenzeki.I-Board of Healthcare Funders (BHF) ilindele eyezinguquko emkhakheni wezempilo, ikakhulu njengoba kunabaphikisana neyomshwalense wezempilo kuleli, i-National Health Insurance Act.Inhlangano i-Organisation Undoing Tax Abuse (OUTA), ithe ayilindele lutho kule nkulumo ngoba ngeke ize nezixazululo ezinkingeni ezibhekene nezwe."Silindele inkulumo nje engathi shu ngoba izinkinga zezwe zibhokile kodwa akwenziwa lutho ngazo. Awukho umehluko obonakalayo ekubeni minyaka yonke kuchithwa enkulu imali ngale nkulumo engezi namnyakazo."
BATHUNYELWE kwagoqanyawo abasolwa abane okuthiwa bebefunelwa amacala amaningi okubalwa kuwo okubulala, ukuzama ukubulala nokugebenga.Laba basolwa batholwe emjondolo oseMatikwe, eNanda, ngoLwesibili ebusuku.Ngokwesitatimende samaphoyisa, alandele umkhondo wabasolwa obaholele kulo mjondolo onamagumbi amabili. "Amaphoyisa athe efika kwaqala uthuthuva lokudubulana phakathi kwawo nabasolwa. Ngeshwa abasolwa abane badutshulwe bafa,' kusho uColonel Robert Netshiunda okhulumela amaphoyisa aKwaZulu-Natal.Kutholakale izibhamu ezine nenqwaba yezinhlamvu. Awekho amaphoyisa alimele.
IMINDENI ibonga ayiphezi kumuntu owaqopha i-video yabane ngesikhathi besaphila, belaliswe phansi ngamaphoyisa, abagcina ngokubabulawa emgwaqweni uDumisani Makhaye, KwaMashu, ngoMashi nyakenye. Lokhu kuza emva kokuba abe-Independent Police Investigative Directorate (Ipid) sebeveze ukuthi iwathole enecala ophenyweni lwayo amaphoyisa adubula babulala abane kulesi sigameko esenzeka ngoMashi 20, 2025. Kusona kwafa uMnuz Nathi Biyela (40) isihlobo sakhe uMnuz Nicolas Biyela (41), Mnuz Sanele Ntuli (25) isihlobo sakhe uMnuz Nhlakanipho Ntuli (31). Okhulumela i-Ipid, uPhaladi Shuping, uchaze kafishane ukuthi sebelidlulisele ehhovisi lomqondisi wezokuShushiswa koMphakathi KwaZulu-Natal, idokodo ukuze athathe isinqumo. "I-Ipid izokwazi ukuphawula kahle ngodaba uma isitholile ngesinqumo,” kusho uShuping. Emva kwesigameko, amaphoyisa athumela isitatimende esasithi abafi babesolwa ngamacala okuphanga, ukubulala nokufuna imali yokuvikela ngodli. Sasiqhuba sithi, ababulawa bavulela ngenhlamvu ngesikhathi bebona amaphoyisa, nawo aphoqeleka ukuthi abuyisele ngayo, kwase kusala bona enkundleni. Isihlobo esicele ukungadalulwa sithe beyimindeni yababulawa, babuye babone sengathi abambongi ngokwanele umuntu owaqopha i-video."Simbonga kakhulu ngoba uye owasilekelela ekutheni libonakale iqiniso lokuthi akukho akwakushiwo ngamaphoyisa uma ethi badubule kuqala,” kusho isihlobo. Emva kokusabalala kwale video, kwasala imibuzo ngesitatimende samaphoyisa, abantu befuna izimpendulo zokuthi kwenzeke kanjani ukuthi kuthiwe abafi badubule kuqala, kube kukhona i-video ekhombisa ukuthi bawulalela umyalelo wamaphoyisa, wokumisa imoto ababehamba ngayo, behla, baze balala naphansi. Uthe bathola ukuthi yize lona owathatha i-video wayengazi ukuthi obani laba abalaliswe phansi ngamaphoyisa ngaleso sikhathi, wathola emva kwendaba ukuthi abadutshulwa yize kade sebelaliswe phansi abantu abaziyo.Uveze ukuthi abe-Ipid babatshele ngoDisemba nyakenye, ukuthi uphenyo lwabo sebeluphothulile. "Basitshela nokuthi ngesikhathi bephenya bathola nokuthi babengathinteki nakancane emacaleni okubulala, ukubamba inkunzi kanjalo nokufuna ngodli imali yokuvikela, amaphoyisa ayethe basolwa kuwo,” kusho isihlobo.Isihlobo sithe imindeni isibheke ngabomvu isinqumo somqondisi njengoba isabufuna ubulungiswa ngezihlobo zayo "ezabulawelwa into engekho". Sigcizelele eyokuthi babevele beshilo ukuthi ukubulawa kwabo kwakuyamene nezimpi zepolitiki zangaphakathi ehostela KwaMashu. "UNhlakanipho nje, wayengusihlalo weCPF, aphinde abe yiPhini likaSihlalo we-IFP ehostela. Izinsolo zokuthi amaphoyisa aze abadubula ngoba ayesenesikhathi ebafuna, bebaleka, zazingamampunge ngoba wayehlala kuyo yonke imihlangano yeqembu neyokulwa nobugebengu esiteshini samaphoyisa KwaMashu. Uma ayezimisele ngokumbopha, ayezomthola kuleyo mihlangano,” usho kanje.Uthe buqale phansi ubuhlungu uma uphenyo lwe-Ipid lubakhipha phambili ababulawa ngoba kubuye usizi lokuthi babulawelwa into engakho, izingane zabo ezisencane zasala dengwane.
BAHLABE ikhwelo eMnyangweni weMfundo ePhakeme nokuQeqesha, ukuthi usheshise izinhlelo zokuqalwa kwezifundo ezintsha, emakolishi amaTechnical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET).Lokhu kushiwo nguSihlalo weKomiti leMfundo ePhakeme ePhalamende, uMnuz Tebogo Letsie, njengoba kunomkhankaso wokuthi kushintshwe izifundo ezingathi shu kulezi zikhungo, kufakwe ezihambisana nomnotho nesimo samanje.Umnyango usemkhankasweni wokuqeda ngezifundo i-N4 kuya ku-N6."Asikwazi ukuchitha imali ezinhlelweni ezingathi shu, ezingasizi ngalutho uma kuza emnothweni wezwe okudingeka ukhule. Kunezinhlelo ezingasadingeki, ezenza intsha ingayitholi imisebenzi," usho kanje. Ukhale ngokuthi kulawa makolishi, kugcwele kakhulu emikhakheni yokusebenza emahhovisi."Kugcwele emkhakheni i-marketing odinga ukuthi uqedwe ngokushesha. Uma sivakashele amakolishi, sihlangabezana nenkinga yokugcwala kule mikhakha engathi shu," usho kanje.Uthe bakuthatha njengokusetshenziswa kwemali budedengu uma kuqhutshekwa nemikhakha engathi shu."Kumele kube nokusebenzisana phakathi komnyango, nesikhwama esixhasa ngemali yokufunda iNational Student Financial Aid Scheme, ukuze amakolishi enzise imikhakha edingwa abaqashi. Uma kunobudlelwano nabaqashi, kuzokwaziwa ukuthi yikuphi abakulindele ngezitshudeni eziqeqeshwa emakolishi." Imikhakha emisha ezofundwa nedingeka kakhulu kuleli kubalwa i-Electrician, Plumber, Auto Mechanic, Boiler Maker, Welder, Millwright, Mechanical Fitter, Tooling Machinist, Pipe-Fitter, Rigger.Kwezithinta amabhizinisi kuzofundwa i-Office Administration, Management Assistant, Human Resource Officer, Sales Representative, Retail Chain Store Manager, Retail Buyer, Supply Chain Practitioner.Kwezokuphepha kuzofundwa i-Safety, Health and Environment Practitioner, Occupational Health and Safety Officer, Early Childhood Development Practitioner, Basic Counselling Skills, Social Auxiliary Work nokunye.Eminye ezofundwa ethinta izimboni kubalwa i-Crane or Hoist Operator, Loader Operator, Dump Truck Operator, Mining Technician (Surveyor/Strata Control), Chemical Plant Operator, Gas Practitioner.
UKUSHODA kwemisebenzi, ububha obusahlasele eNingizimu Afrika, ubugebengu nenkohlakalo edla lubi, ngezinye zezinto ezibhekwe ngabomvu, enkulumweni kaMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, ayibhekise esizweni.Lokhu kuvezwe nguMnuz Matthew Parks womfelandawonye wezinyunyana zabasebenzi iCosatu, njengoba uRamaphosa ezothula le nkulumo ngoLwesine ebusuku, eKapa.UParks uthe balindele ukuzwa ukuthi uRamaphosa uzothini ngezingqinamba ezibhekene nabasebenzi."Sikhathazekile ngezinga eliphezulu labangasebenzi, ukukhula kancane komnotho, ukungalingani, ubugebengu nenkohlakalo. Silindele ukuzwa ukuthi uMengameli uzothini ngalezi zinselelo ezisabhekene nezwe." Uncome umsebenzi owenziwe yi-ANC, ukuqeda ngenkinga yokucishwa kukagesi kuleli. "Sifuna ugesi ushibhe ngoba umba eqolo. Sifuna abantu bafakelwe ugesi we-prepaid kuphinde kubhekwane nezikweletu komasipala." Ukhale ngenkinga yokwehliswa kwesabelomali seminyango kahulumeni okwenza ingakwazi ukusebenza ngendlela."Lokhu kwehliswa kwesabelomali kukhubaza ukuhanjiswa izidingo emphakathini. Sifuna kwesekwe ukusebenza kweSARS ukuze lolu phiko luqoqe imali ezokwazi ukuxhasa izinhlelo zikahulumeni." Uveze ukuthi bafuna kusheshiswe ukuqala komshwalense wezempilo i-National Health Insurance."Sifuna kususwe abaholi abakhohlakele komasipala ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abasebenzi bayawuthola umholo wabo. Ababoshwe abakhohlakele, kuqiniswe ukusebenza kwezinhlaka ezifana nophiko lwezokushushisa kuleli, amaphoyisa kanjalo nezobulungiswa." Uthe kumele kunyuswe isibonelelo sabangatohozi ukuze seseke abadonsa kanzima."Abaqashi kumele baphoqwe ukuthi bakhokhele abasebenzi eyeholo eliphilisayo, i-National Minimum Wage. Sifuna kubuyekezwe nezithinta isinxephezelo sabadiliziwe emsebenzini i-UIF kuphinde kuqine ukusebenza kwe-CCMA ukuvikela abasebenzi abaxhashazwa abaqashi." UNgqongqoshe eHhovisi likaMengameli obhekele ukuhlela, uNksz Maropene Ramokgopa, usanda kuveza ukuthi umnotho utshengisa ukusimama muva nje.Uthe kuningi uhulumeni akwenzela abantu njengoba bengaphezu kuka-19 million abahlomula ngezibonelelo. "Zibalelwa ku-1.3 million izingane ezisezikhungweni ama-early childhood development (ECD). Kunezinhlelo zokulungisa izikole ezinezindlu zangasese eziyimigodi."Kwezempilo uthe abahaqwe yi-HIV bahlomula ngemishanguzo yokuthithibalisa leli gciwane."Kuningi uMengameli azokuveza uma esethula inkulumo ayibhekise esizweni. Indaba yokushoda kwemisebenzi, umnotho nezinye zizoba seqhulwini kule nkulumo."
INKANTOLO eNkulu yasePitoli isichithile isicelo sokubuyekezwa kwesinqumo sebheyili somholi we-International Pentecost Holiness Church, uBhekumuzi Mike Sandlana (64). Lesi sikhalo silandela isicelo sikaSandlana sebheyili esingaphumelelanga, esachithwa yiPretoria Specialised Commercial Crimes Court ngomhla ka-22 Disemba 2025. USandlana ubhekene namacala angu-19 enkohlakalo.Kusolwa ukuthi phakathi kuka-2021 no-2022, uSandlana wakhokha imali elinganiselwa ku-R2.4 million kuma-akhawunti ahlukene asebhange ukuze kusizakale iJaji uPhahlane, ngenhloso yokuthi engamele udaba lwakhe oluqhubekayo eNkantolo eNkulu futhi akhiphe isinqumo esivuna yena.Esicelweni sakhe sebheyili, uSandlana uthe imantshi yenza iphutha ngokuthola ukuthi wehlulekile ukwanelisa inkantolo ukuthi ubulungiswa buvumela ukuthi adedelwe ngebheyili. Ithimba lakhe labameli liveze ukuthi ukutholakala kwakhe nomazisi abaningi kwabangelwa yimizamo yokulungisa amaphutha enziwa umnyango okwakufanelwe alungiswe. Baphinde bathi uSandlana akayona ingozi yokubaleka, beveza ukuthi isonto lakhe, linobunikazi bezindawo eziningi kanye nobudlelwano obuqinile neNingizimu Afrika.Kodwa-ke, abashushisi bombuso uPhumla Dwane noWillem van Zyl basiphikisa isicelo sakhe, bethi uSandlana uzibeka engcupheni yokundiza ngenxa yokuba nomazisi abaningi kanye nokukwazi kwakhe ukuhamba ngaphandle kwezwe ngaphandle kokusebenzisa ipasi. Baphinde bathi uSandlana kusolwa ukuthi wawenza amacala ngesikhathi engaphandle ngebheyili kwelinye icala elisenkantolo yeMantshi yasePitoli.INkantolo eNkulu yavumelana nezethulo zoMbuso futhi yathola ukuthi uSandlana wehlulekile ukwanelisa inkantolo ukuthi ukukhululwa kwakhe ngebheyili kwakuzozuzisa ubulungisa. Ngenxa yalokho, isicelo sebheyili siphinde sachithwa.Icala elithinta uSandlana nabasolwa abane lizobuyela eNkantolo yamaCala akhethekile ezohwebo ePitoli mhla ka-6 Mashi 2026.
I-DURBAN University of Technology (DUT) iyaziqhelelanisa nesikhungo esisiza abafundi baphucule imiphumela ka-matric sowayengumsakazi woKhozi FM ongasekho, uBheka Mchunu, iKwaZulu-Natal Matric Excellence. Lokhu kuza emva kokuthi kusabalale i-video eveza ukuthi lesi sikhungo sisebenza ngokubambisana neDUT. Okhulumela iDUT, uMnuz Alan Khan, uthe iDUT ayinabudlelwano, ayihlangene futhi ayisebenzisani neKwaZulu-Natal Matric Excellence. "I-DUT ayizibandakanyi nalutho oluthinta lesi sikhungo. Abazali, abafundi, abaxhasi kanjalo nomphakathi wonkana, bayayalwa ukuba baqaphele,” kusho uKhan.Uqhube wathi bayanxuswa nokuthi baqale benze konke ukuqinisekisa nanoma yisiphi isikhungo esithi sisebenzisana neDUT, ngaphambi kokuba bazihlanganise naso, baqale ukufunda noma ukukhokha imali. Uthe kufikile ezindlebeni zabo ukuthi labo abayamaniswa nalesi sikhungo, basebenzisa uphawu lwaseDUT ngaphandle kwemvume. Uqhube wathi ixoxa nezinhlaka ezifanele ukudingida eyokusetshenziswa kwegama layo ngendlela engafanele. "I-DUT inalo ilungelo lokufaka icala nanoma ubani noma inhlangano esebenzisa igama lesikhungo sayo, ukuzicebisa,” usho kanje.Udonse umphakathi ngendlebe, wathi awuthembele ezinkundleni zokuxhumana zalesi sikhungo angu-ngqo, uma efuna ulwazi oluyilo.Phakathi kwawo ubale i-website yesikhungo kanjalo nezinkundla zokuxhumana eziqinisekisiwe.

SEBENGAPHEZU kuka-27.7 million abasohlwini lokuvota okhethweni lohulumeni basekhaya, okulindeleke ukuthi lubanjwe kulo nyaka.Lokhu kuvezwe yiKhomishini yezoKhetho eZimele kuleli, i-Independent Electoral Commission (IEC).Ibamba lesikhulu esiphezulu se-IEC, uMnuz George Mahlangu, lithe siyakhula isibalo sabasohlwini lokuvota kuleli, njengoba uthela izithelo umkhankaso wokubhalisela ukuvota kusetshenziswa ubuchwepheshe."Sinomkhankaso wokunxenxa abantu ukuthi babhalisele ukuvota kuleli okwenze kwabhalisa abangu-26 743 selokhu kuqale unyaka. Abanye babheka ukuthi imininingwane yabo isavela kwikhomishini," lisho kanje. UMahlangu uthe abantu bayaluthakasela lolu hlelo lokubhalisa nge-internet (online) abaluqala ngo-2021."Intsha okuyiyona esiyifuna ibhalisile isingu-7.7 million. Sisayinxusa enye ukuthi ibhalise njengoba kuza ukhetho. Sifuna ibambe iqhaza entandweni yeningi." Uthe intsha eyabhalisa ayibheke ukuthi ulwazi eyalufaka - okubalwa ikheli nolunye - luseyilo yini, wakhumbuza abantu ukuthi babhalise lapho behlala khona."Okhethweni lwalo nyaka umuntu uvota lapho ehlala khona. Yingakho sinxusa ukuthi abantu bazibheke ukuthi babhalise lapho behlala khona. Ngeke ukwazi ukuvota endaweni ongabhalisile kuyona." Uthe kulolu khetho kuzobe kukhethwa abantu abazosebenzela umphakathi emawadini, waveza ukuthi abaneminyaka engu-16 nangaphezulu abanomazisi, bangabhalisela ukuvota."Siyaqhubeka nemikhankaso yokuya ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme ukunxenxa izitshudeni ukuthi zibhalisele ukuvota. Kuyilungelo lazo ukuthi zibambe iqhaza entandweni yeningi," usho kanje.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi njengoba usuku lokhetho lungakanqunywa, uNgqongqoshe wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu, uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa, wathi luzoba phakathi kukaNovemba nonyaka noJanuwari wangonyaka ozayo.UHlabisa okunguyena ozomemezela usuku lokhetho, wathi basabheka izinto eziningi njengoba lezi zinyanga zisuke zimatasa kuleli. Wabalula ukuthi kusuke kubhalwa izivivinyo zika-matric ngoNovemba, ngoDisemba kusuke sekungamaholidi kanti ngoJanuwari kusuke kuvulwa izikole.Abafuna ukubhalisa nokubheka ulwazi lwabo ukuthi lusekhona bangaya ku:www.registertovote.elections.org.za.

Uveze ukuthi uRamaphosa uzothula inkulumo ayibhekise esizweni eCity Hall, bese ngesonto elizayo kubanjwe kuleli tende inkulumo-mpikiswano.Kubanjelwa imihlangano kuleli tende emva kokushiswa kwePhalamende ngo-2022.UMacph­er­son uthe ongoti eMnyangweni wakhe basebenza ngamandla ukuqinisekisa ukuthi leli tende lilungela ukubamba imihlangano. Uthe bekudla u-R1 million ngosuku ukubamba umhlangano wePhalamende eCape Town Inter­na­tional Con­ven­tion Centre (CTICC)."Sikwazile ukwehlisa imali engabe iyachithwa ukubamba imihlangano yePhalamende. Noma seyakhiwe kabusha ingxenye yePhalamende elashiswa, sizoligcina leli tende ukwenza eminye imicimbi ukuze lenzele uhulumeni inzuzo," usho kanje.Uthe bazoxoxa nabahlela imicimbi ngeminye imisebenzi nemicimbi engabanjelwa kuleli tende uma iPhalamende liguqile."Ziyashoda izindawo zokubamba imicimbi eKapa, yingakho ngixoxa nabakwamasipala ukuze leli tende lisebenze ukubamba eminye imicimbi." Uthe bekunesidingo ukuthi lilungiswe kahle ngenxa yokuguquka kwesimo sezulu eKapa.Impikiswano ngenkulumo kaRamaphosa izoba ngoFebhuwari 17 no-18. Uzobe esephendula kule nkulumo mpikiswano ngoFebhuwari 19. UNkk Didiza uthe bahlele ukusebenzisa u-R7 million ngenkulumo kaRamaphosa. Ngalolu suku kusuke kuhlangane amalungu ePhalamende nawoMkhandlu weziFundazwe. Ingqephu isuke idida unwabu kumalungu alezi zindlu kanjalo nasezimenyweni. Kusuke kukhona namajaji akuleli, kubizwe nababengomengameli bezwe, nababengosomlomo bePhalamende phambilini.Umbutho wezokuvikela usuke uviliyela.
NGOKWEZIGIGABA zokubulawa kwabantu yizinkabi kuleli, kungenzeka ukuthi uThabo Deon Sjava Mathonsi Chonco ubalwa nongqaphambili kubasocongi noma ngokuhlelwa kwalo msebenzi. Kumanje lo mlisa obhadla ejele vele, ubhekene namanye amacala okuqotha imbokodo nesisekelo ezindaweni eziningi maphakathi neKwaZulu-Natal. Nguye futhi oboshwe neNkosi Simphiwe Erick Zuma, ecaleni lokubulawa kowayeyikhansela le-DA kuMasipala waseMngeni, uMnuz Nhlalayenza Ndlovu.Akugcini lapho, uhamba inkantolo nje uvele uyindoda eyikazela ngomhlobiso ongavamile woxhaxha lwamacala okubulala. Amanye ala macala kuthiwa uChonco wawahlela esejele.UChonco usanda kugwetshwa odilikajele abahlanu ngecala lokuqotha abantu abahlanu eBulwer. INkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu yezwa ukuthi uChonco wayengabazi nokubazi laba bantu abaqotha.Kuthiwa wayethunywe wumzala wakhe owaziwa ngelikaSwarez ngenxa yombango womndeni. USwarez washona edubulana namaphoyisa ngo-2023.UChonco ugqigqe waze wamfishane ezinkantolo kuleli sonto lapho ebebhekene khona namacala ahlukene, futhi usazoqhubeka nokuvela ezinkantolo njengoba ebhekene namacala amathathu okubulala phezu kwecala lokuqotha abantu abahlanu elisanda kumgojela.Kuleli sonto uChonco uvele eNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu, ngoMsombuluko nangoLwesithathu, lapho ebebhekene khona necala lokuqotha abantu bakwaMemela abayishumi.Leli cala lizoqala ukuqulwa ngo-Agasti 24, kuze kube uSepthemba 18.UChonco usolwa ngokuba iyngxenye yabantu abaqotha umndeni wakwaMemela, ngo-2023, eMbali, eMgungundlovu.Waboshwa endaweni eyibangana uma usuka kwaMemela, eyogeza enyangeni yaseSwatini.Itulo lokubulawa kwabakwaMemela kuthiwa lalihlelwe wuSwarezUSwarez kuthiwa wayesekhathazile eMgungundlovu, ikakhulukazi elokishini eMbali.Umndeni wakwaMemela uqothwa nje kusolwa ukuthi wawuxabene nomunye umndeni endaweni, kwaze kwavulelwana necala lokushaya.Kuthiwa kwaqala kwabulawa owakwaMemela owayengufakazi ecaleni lokushaya, ngaphambi kokuthi kuqothwe abayishumi.Ukuqulwa kwecala sekubambezeleke isikhathi eside ngenxa yokuthi uChonco ubelokhu eshintsha abameli.UChonco uboshwe noMnuz Thembelani Mbatha, ophinde abhekane necala lokubulala uNdlovu.IJaji Nontuthuzelo Mlaba lizwakalise ukukhathazeka ngokubambezeleka kwecala, lanqumela uChonco noMbatha ugwayi katiki."Kufanele siqede ukuqula icala. Uma kukhona izinto okufanele nizixoxe nabameli benu kufanele nizixoxe manje yikhona kungeke kubambezeleke ukuqulwa kwecala."Isolezwe lithole ukuthi uChonco usefuna ukulivuma icala kodwa ubengakavumelani nommeli wakhe.NgoMsombuluko waphinde wavela eNkantolo yeSifunda eMgungundlovu, lapho ebebhekene khona necala lokubulala uNdlovu kanye nelokubulala owayelwa nokudayiswa komhlaba eMpophomeni, uMnuz Xolani Ntombela/Ndlovu.Uzophinde abuyele enkantolo ngoFebhuwari 20.UChonco uvele usekuvezile ukuthi ufuna ukulivuma icala lokubulawa kukaNdlovu.Okuqaphelekayo wukuthi uChonco ubizwa ngezibongo ezahlukene njengoba kwesinye isikhathi ebizwa ngoMathonsi. Isolezwe alikayitholi incazelo ngalezi zibongo, noma esinye sazo siyigama.Ubebonakala engathukile ngesikhathi evele enkantolo, ubelokhu exoxa nabasolwa aboshwe nabo.
UBENUKEKA ekusocongweni kukafakazi owethula ubufakazi ngokuyimfihlo (Witness D) kwiKhomishini ephenya izinsolo ezenziwa uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, umlisa ozibulele, uMnuz Wiandre Pretorius.UPretorius ozibulale ngoMgqibelo, ubesolakala ekufeni kukaMnuz Marius Van Der Merwe owasocongwa emva kokuthula ubufakazi phambi kweKhomishini eholwa yiJaji Mbuyiseli Madlanga, ngasekupheleni konyaka odlule. Ethula ubufakazi esithe, uVan Der Merwe waninda uPretorius nabanye abangamaphoyisa kaMasipala waseKurhuleni ngokufa kukaMnuz Emmanuel Mbhense, owashona emva kokushaywa ngamaphoyisa omkhandlu.Isidumbu sikaMbhense satholakala silahlwe ehlathini.NgoMgqibelo, uPretorius uzidubule ekhanda emva kwengxabano nengoduso yakhe eyiphoyisa kanti ngeledlule uPretorius usinde edutshulwa ngoyaba lwezinhlamvu. Okhulumela amaphoyisa, uBrigadier Athlenda Mathe, uthe uPretorius waphekwa ngemibuzo emva kokusocongwa kukaVan Der Merwe."Babili abantu ababephenyelwa ukubulawa kukaVan Der Merwe. UPretorius uyena muntu wokuqala esampheka ngemibuzo emva kokushona kukaVan Der Merwe. Amaphoyisa ashaqa izibhamu, izinhlamvu namafoni kaPretorius njengengxenye yophenyo lwawo ngokufa kukaVan Der Merwe."UBrigadier Mathe uthe uPretorius noVan Der Merwe bebephenyelwa ukubulawa kukaMbhense. Uphenyo beluqhutshwa uphiko oluqaphe ukusebenza kwamaphoyisa, i-Ipid.UBrigadier Mathe uthe i-Ipid isiluphothulile uphenyo lwayo, wathi abantu abane abathinteka ophenyweni lwe-Ipid badutshulwe babulawa ngesikhathi kuqhubeka uphenyo."Bangu-12 abantu abebephenyelwa ukufa kukaMbhense. UPretorius naye ubephenywa noVan Der Merwe. Umuntu wokuqala othinteka ecaleni lokubulawa kukaMbhense, wadutshulwa ngo-Mashi wango-2023. Umuntu wesibili wadutshulwa ngo-Okthoba wango-2025. Kwabe sekulandela yena uVan Der Merwe njengoba sekufe uPretorius." UBrigadier Mathe uthe kungenzeka ukuthi abantu abathinteka ekufeni kukaMbhense baqothana bodwa, wathi bazoqala bathathelwe izinyathelo maduze abantu abathinteka ekufeni kukaMbhense."Njengoba i-Ipid isidlulisele umbiko wayo ngokusemthethweni, kukhona izinyathelo ezizothathwa kulona leli sonto noma ngesonto elizayo."
INkantolo yesiFunda yaseMokopane igwebe uYvonne Maja iminyaka engu-18 ngecala lokuzama ukubulala neminyaka emibili ngecala lokuhlasela ngekhemikhali enobungozi. Lokhu kumayelana necala alenza ehlasela umnakwabo uMmapeu Hlanga nge-acid ngesikhathi kunengxabano ethinta isoka labo uKgotlelelo Phasha, eMogoto Village, eZebediela ngomhla ka-13 Okthoba 2024.Ngesikhathi kuqulwa icala, kwavela ukuthi ummangalelwa wayethukuthele egane unwabu engafuni ukwaliwa. I-video evezwe wumgilwa enkantolo ibonisa ingxabano eshisayo phakathi kukammangalelwa, umgilwa nesoka labo. Ummangalelwa uzwakala ebasabisa ngokuthi uzosabalalisa izithombe zabo zangasese futhi ezishaya isifuba ngokuthi wenze umgilwa waphelelwa wumsebenzi.Le video iphinde yaveza ummangalelwa evula isikhwama sakhe sokudla, ethi womiwe futhi ufuna ukuthatha ibhodlela esikhwameni sakhe ayesishiye endlini.Leli yibhodlela lamanzi le-Tupperware elijwayelekile, lalisetshenziswe njengesitsha se-acid.Wabe esehamba kancane esondela kumgilwa, sengathi ukhuluma naye, ngaphambi kokumthela nge-acid esebhodleleni.Ngesikhathi kuqhubeka icala, ummeli kammangalelwa uzame ukubeka isenzo sakhe njengento ayengayihlosile. Nokho, ubufakazi be-video bakhombisa ngokusobala ukuthi konke akwenza wayekuhlelile.Ngemuva kokucubungula kahle ubufakazi, iMantshi yakhipha isinqumo, yathola ummangalelwa enecala lokuzama ukubulala.
BANGU-236 887 ababoshwe amaphoyisa emikhankasweni yawo ehlukene ezweni lonke ngesikhathi samaholidi kaKhisimusi.Lokhu kuvezwe uKhomisana wamaPhoyisa kuzwelonke, uGeneral Fannie Masemola, esithangamini sabezindaba eTshidimosetso House ePitoli, ngoLwesihlanu.UMasemola oncome umsebenzi wokuzikhandla kwamaphoyisa - esebenza ubusuku nemini - uveze ukuthi imikhankaso eminingi iqale ngo-Okthoba nyakenye, yaze yaphothulwa ngenyanga edlule. "Kusukela ngesikhathi yethulwa le mikhankaso nyakenye, amaphoyisa asebenze ngokuzikhandla, ezama ngakho konke okusemandleni ukuthi avimbe ubugebengu, alwe nabo aphinde abuphenye,” kusho uMasemola.Uthe lokhu kuholele ekutheni bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika, bahambe kahle beya ezindaweni ezehlukene, badumisa, bazijabulisa baphinde benza amabhizinisi bezizwa bephephile ngesikhathi esiye sibe ngesimatasa onyakeni.Ecacisa ngemikhankaso yabo, uthe ihlanganise ukutshalwa kwamaphoyisa ezindaweni ezingu-7 726, ezineziminyaminya eziphezulu, wathi kuphinde kwaseshwa izakhiwo eziwu-116 434 kanjalo kwaba nezivimbamgwaqo eziwu-4 854 . "Izindawo zokucima ukoma nazo azisalanga ngaphandle njengoba kubhekwe ezingu-106 715, kwavalwa ezingu-7 682 ebezisebenza ngokungekho emthethweni,” kusho uMasemola.Eveza kabanzi ngezibalo zababoshiwe, uthe bangu-4 029 ababoshelwe amacala okubulala nawokuzama ukubulala, wathi bangu-2 693 ababoshelwe amacala okudlwengula nokuzama ukudlwengula. "Bangu-33 397 ababoshelwe ukutholwa nezidakamizwa, bangu-4 281 ababoshelwe amacala okuhweba ngazo. Kuboshwe abangu-15 075 ngokushayela bephuzile, kwathi abangu-2 498 baboshelwa ukudayisa utshwala ngaphandle kwemvume,” kusho uMasemola.Uthe lo mkhankaso ububuye ubheke nezibhamu ezingekho emthethweni, kwaqoqwa ezingu-2 000 ezweni lonke. Uveze ukuthi iKwaZulu-Natal, yiyo eqoqe izibhamu eziningi njengoba zibe ngu-753, yalandelwa iWestern Cape ngezingu-607 kwase kuba yi-Eastern Cape ngezingu-343.Uveze nokuthi imikhankaso yabo ibuye yasiza ekutheni kugwetshwe abangu-2 738, okukhona kubo nabangu-199, abathole odilikajele.
UHLEHLISELWE usuku olungaziwa umhlangano weNFP neMKP, obubizelwe ukuzobhunga ngekusasa likahulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal.Umhlangano obekufanele ube ngoMgqibelo, eThekwini, uhlehliswe ngemizuzu yokugcina.Kulo mhlangano bekulindeleke ukuthi kubhungwe eyokufaka kabusha isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli.UNobhala Jikelele weNFP obambile, uMnuz Sunset Xaba, akazange afune ukuchaza isizathu sokuhlehla komhlangano."Asikanqumi ukuthi sizophinde sihlangane nini." I-NFP ingababeki benkosi kuhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal kanti iMKP yona igaqele ukuphatha isifundazwe.Isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNtuli esasifakwe yiMKP, sabhuntsha ngonyaka odlule.Amalungu eMKP nawe-EFF, avele aphazamisa umhlangano ngesikhathi sekucacile ukuthi iNFP ngeke iseseke isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNtuli.Incwadi yeMKP ebimemela iNFP emhlanganweni wangoMgqibelo, ibiveza ukuthi kuzokhulunywa eyokufaka kabusha isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNtuli. Incwadi ebhalwe yiPhini likaMengameli lesibili leMKP, uMnuz Tony Yengeni, iveze ukuthi emhlanganweni bekuzobhungwa ngamaqhinga okunxenxa amanye amaqembu anemigomo efanayo ukuba ahlangane, akhe uhulumeni wesifundazwe.I-MKP inezihlalo ezingu-37 kwezingu-80 esiShayamthetho, yesekwa yi-EFF enezihlalo ezimbili esiShayamthetho. Lokhu kwenza ukuthi isihlalo seNFP esisodwa sibaluleke.Isihlalo seNFP sibanjwe uMphathiswa wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi, uNksz Mbali Shinga, obhekene nekomiti lokuqondiswa ubugwegwe ngenxa yokuthi usolwa ngokushaya indiva umyalelo wokuba aseke isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNtuli. UNksz Shinga wawushaya indiva umyalelo wobuholi beNFP wokuba asule esikhundleni.Khonamanjalo: I-NFP iyaqhubeka nokubamba imihlangano namaqembu ameleleke esiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal.UXaba uqinisekise ukuthi bazohlangana neqembu elihola uhulumeni wesifundazwe, i-IFP ngeSonto. "Uma uzokhumbula, abaholi be-IFP babekade becele ukuthi sihlangane ngoMsombuluko wanamhlanje noma lona ozayo. Ngenxa yezinhlelo zeNFP, sicele ukuthi umhlangano ube ngeSonto."Ubuholi beNFP busanda kunqaba isimemo somhlangano wamaqembu abusa ngokubambisana, bukhala ngokuthi bufuna ukuqale buhlangane nobuholi be-IFP eceleni ngaphambi kokuthi kube nomhlangano ozohanjelwa abaholi bawo wonke amaqembu abusa ngokubambisana.Ubuholi beNFP buvele sebuke babamba imihlangano namanye amaqembu abusa ngokubambisana KwaZulu-Natal, i-ANC neDA.Kwenzeka sonke lesi siphithiphithi nje, uNtuli kulindeleke ukuthi ethule inkulumo ngesimo sesifundazwe ngasekupheleni kwenyanga.

KUXABENE ubendle kuMasipala waseMpendle, okumiswe kuwo amakhansela amane okukhona kuwo imeya nosomlomo abasanda kukhethwa.Kubukeka zisekude ukuphela izinkinga ezikhungethe lo mkhandlu ohlulwa ukuholela abasebenzi njengoba i-ANC inqume ukumisa amakhansela amane, asolwa ngokushaya indiva umyalelo wenhlangano.Amakhansela amiswe emva kokuba i-ANC, iphenduke inhlekisa emhlanganweni wokuqoka imeya entsha obungoLwesihlanu. Amakhansela amane e-ANC ashaye indiva bukhoma umyalelo wokuba aqoke uNksz Nonjabulo Ndlovu, kwesobumeya.UNksz Ndlovu uphuthe ethembile ngesikhathi ejikelwa amakhansela e-ANC, aqoka uMnuz Malcom Dlamini, njengeMeya yoMkhandlu.Abaholi be-ANC okukhona kubo umdidiyeli weqembu esifundazweni, uMnuz Jeff Radebe, baphume emhlanganweni wangoLwesihlanu, bethukuthele beqhuma. Kube sekubizwa umhlangano ophuthumayo wethimba lesikhashana elihola i-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, lapho kuthathwe khona isinqumo sokumisa amakhansela athintekayo.Ubuholi be-ANC bebufuna ukuthi uNksz Ndlovu, kube uyena ogaxwa amaketanga obumeya.Amakhansela amisiwe uDlamini, kube uSomlomo uMnuz Zibuse Dlamini, uNksz Nokuvela Ngcobo, noMnuz Thabani Makhaye. I-ANC inamakhansela ayisithupha kulo mkhandlu onamakhansela ayishumi. Amakhansela amisiwe aphethe amawadi amane kwamahlanu kuMasipala waseMpendle.Amakhansela amabili e-ANC awudubile umhlangano kwathi amabili e-IFP, namabili e-EFF wona angavota.Okhulumela i-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Fanle Sibisi, uthe la makhansela awavumelekile ukwenza noma yini ethinta inhlangano noma umasipala njengoba kumiswe ubulungu bawo. Umkhandlu ubusuhlale izinyanga eziyisithupha ungenayo imeya kulandela ukukhishwa kukaMnuz Buyisani Mlaba.USibisi uthe bayazi impela ukuthi ukungabi khona kwemeya isikhathi eside eMpendle, kudale ukuthi umkhandlu ungene ezinkingeni okubalwa kuzo ukwehluleka ukukhokhela abasebenzi."Kodwa ke iqiniso ukuthi akekho umuntu ozovunyelwa ukuba azenzele umathanda. Sithanda ukwazisa abantu bakuWard 2, 3, 4 no-5 ukuthi lesi sinqumo esisithathile siyingxenye yokwakha kabusha inhlangano." Amalungu e-ANC angahambisani nokuqokwa kukaNksz Ndlovu abebhikisha ngaphandle kwalapho obekubanjwe khona umhlangano.Amaqembu aphikisayo athe ukumiswa kwamakhansela kuzophazamisa ukusebenza komkhandlu.Ikhansela le-IFP, uMnuz Sadewu Ngubane, lithe izinkinga zangaphakathi kwi-ANC ziphazamisa ukusebenza komkhandlu."I-ANC iyona enamakhansela amaningi lapha emkhandlwini. Kusicacele emhlanganweni wangoLwesihlanu ukuthi i-ANC ihlukene phakathi. Sinxusa ubuholi be-ANC ukuba buyisukumele le ndaba ngoba ukungabi khona kobuholi kuphazamisa ukusebenza komkhandlu. Kuyasikhathaza ukungabambisani kwamakhansela e-ANC. Nathi besinikiwe umyalelo wokuthi sivote kanjani emhlanganweni kodwa ngenxa yezinkinga zangaphakathi kwi-ANC, kugcine kwenzeka ngale ndlela." UNgubane uthe bebenethemba lokuthi ukuqokwa kwemeya entsha kuzokelekelela ekuxazululeni izinkinga.Ikhansela le-EFF, uMnuz Sifiso Zuma, lithe ukumiswa kwamakhansela amane kuzophazamisa ukusebenza komkhandlu."Amakhansela amisiwe angosihlalo bamakomiti asemkhandlwini. Ukumiswa kwabo kusho ukuthi ngeke ihlale imihlangano yamakomiti. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi umkhandlu ungasebenzi kahle. Imibiko efika lapha emhlanganweni womkhandlu isuke iqale emakomitini. La makhansela futhi aphethe amawadi. Kusho ukuthi amawadi azokube engamelelekile." UZuma uthe i-ANC bekufanele isale isiwaxolela la makhansela noma eshaye indiva umyalelo wenhlangano."Sizophazamiseka impela, kuyimanje sinenkinga yabasebenzi abangaholile. Amahhovisi omkhandlu avaliwe ngenxa yokuthi abasebenzi abasezi emsebenzini. Sincane isikhathi esisele ngaphambi kokhetho. Kunezinhlelo zentuthuko ezimile."Okhulumela uMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Senzelwe Mzila, uthe abakezukuphawula ngalolu daba.
UNDUNANKULU waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, uveze eyokuthi luyalungiswa olokusebenza kwezitimela esifundazweni. UNtuli usho kanje enkundleni yezemidlalo, iMawombe, KwaMbonambi, izolo, ngesikhathi ekhuluma nezinkumbi zabantu ebezihambele umngcwabo wabayisithupha bomndeni wakwaMnyango, ababhubhe engozini ngeledlule.Kule ngozi enyantisa igazi ebibandakanya iloli nemoto ebihamba ababhubhile, yenzeke emgwaqweni uN2, uma udlula eManandini, eMtubatuba, ngoJanuwari 30 nonyaka. Kuyona kushone uMnuz Vuyani Gcaleka (43), uNkk Nokuphakama Mnyango (85), uNksz Nkosingiphile Mnyango (53), uNksz Senamile Buthelezi (29), ingane yentombazane u-Ayanda Mthembu (12) nengane yomfana uLubanzi Buthelezi (5).Kuvela ukuthi behlelwe yingozi nje, bebesuka ekhaya elikhulu eCinci, KwaMbonambi, belibangise kwelinye eliseMtubatuba, lapho okwakuzoba khona netiye.UNtuli uthe izinhlelo ngokusebenza kwezitimela, seziqoshiwe phansi futhi zicace bha. Lokhu kuza emva kwesikhalo sesikhathi eside sokuthi ukwanda kwamaloli athutha impahla emigwaqweni, yikho okunomthelela weziphihli zezingozi eziye zidlule nenqwaba yemiphefumulo. "Sesixoxile noNgqongqoshe wezokuThutha kuzwelonke ukuthi kulo nyaka ozayo kuzobe kwenzekani, kanjalo nalo olandela lowo,” kusho uNtuli.Uthe usexoxe ngisho nanezimeya ezindaweni ezehlukene maqondana nokulungiswa kojantshi. "Sivumelene ngokuthi udaba lwezitimela kufanele lulungiswe ukuze kuncishiswe isiminyaminya emgwaqweni,” usho kanje. Uqhube wathi okunye abakuhlelayo ukuthi babe nenguyazana nabanikazi bamaloli, ukudingida eyokuqeqeshwa kwabashayeli bawo emqwaqweni. "Kofanele sisondele kubanikazi bamaloli, ke-sizungeze itafula, sixoxe nabo ukuthi bangasilekelela kanjani ukuthi baqeqeshe abashayeli babo ukuthi uma bebona enye imoto, bakwazi ukugwema ingozi,” kusho uNtuli. Uqhube wathi okubakhathaza kakhulu ngezingozi ezisuke zibandakanya amaloli, ukuthi zidlula nemiphefumulo yabantu abaningi. Ubuye wathi okunye okufanele kwenziwe ukuthi kuqwashiswe abantu ukuthi uma umuntu engena emgwaqweni, kufanele akhumbule ukuthi uhamba izimoto ezibulalayo. UNtuli uthe kuyenzeka uthi uzihambela kahle, kuqhamuke enye imoto izongena kuwe. Ukhalise umndeni wakwaMnyango, wathi ubuhlungu kakhulu ngokuthi engozini kuhambe nogogo, athe abantu abadala bayizinsika zamakhaya, kuba nzima kwabakhula ogogo bengasekho emhlabeni.
UMENGAMELI Cyril Ramaphosa usebhalele uNobhala Jikelele weNhlangano yeZizwe, i-United Nations (UN), uMnuz Antonio Guterres, emazisa ngesinqumo sokuhoxiswa kwamasosha aseDemocratic Republic of Congo.La masosha afaka isandla ngaphansi kohlelo lwe-UN i-MONUSCO ukuze kube nozinzo kuleliya lizwe. Elakuleli lingamanye lamazwe awu-10, afaka isandla ukuze kube nozinzo eDRC. Abalelwa ku-700 amasosha akuleli ajutshwe eDRC.Okhulumela uRamaphosa, uMnuz Vincent Magwenya, uthe uMengameli ushayele ucingo uGuterres ngoJanuwari 12, 2026, emazisa ngesinqumo sikahulumeni sokuhoxisa amasosha agcine ukuthula eDRC. I-MONUSCO yasungulwa yi-UN Security Council ngo-1999, ukusiza ngesikhathi kunesivumelwano sokubeka phansi izikhali, iLusaka Ceasefire."Njengoba bekulokhu kuqhubeka udweshu eDRC, kube sekushintshwa sekuvikelwa abantu bakuleliya lizwe, okubalwa nababhekele amalungelo abantu. Elakuleli lizosebenzisana ne-UN, mayelana nokuthi amasosha azohoxiswa nini kanti lokhu kuzokwenzeka ungakapheli lo nyaka." Uthe uGuterres ubonge kakhulu uRamaphosa ngosizo elakuleli elilihlinzeke eDRC."Elakuleli limile ekutheni lizoqhubeka nezingxoxo nezwe iDRC nokweseka izinhlelo zeSouthern African Development Community (SADC), i-African Union (AU), kanjalo ne-UN, zokuletha uzinzo nokuthula eDRC.
UMETHULI wohlelo lomculo wamaZayoni nezingxoxo oluthi ApoZion kwiSoweto TV, uNompumelelo Mbhele, usephosele ubuholi namalungu amabandla amaZayoni ahlukene ezweni ukuthi abeke eceleni ukuncintisana okungenasidingo, bese ebeka eqhulwini ukubambisana nokufunda komunye komunye ukuze ezothuthuka.UNompumelelo waseThekwini, kodwa osezinze eGoli, uthe kufanele ngabe amabandla amaningi aseZayoni asethuthuke kakhulu manje kodwa abuyela emuva futhi amiswe ndawonye wukuthi awazinaki izinto ezimqoka nezingawasiza ukugqama nokuthuthuka."Silinyazwa wukuthi asizihluphi ngolwazi lokuthi singaya kanjani phambili, yingakho ubona umculo wethu nokunye esikwenzayo kungakafiki ezingeni okumele ngabe sesikulona manje, engicabanga ukuthi uma singaqala manje sizihluphe ngokuthi sisekane futhi sisizane ekwenzeni izinto ezinhle, kuningi kakhulu esingakwenza ndawonye.” .Eqhuba uthe kuningi okungafundiswana khona uma amabandla aseZayoni engazijwayeza ukuqala manje enze izinhlelo zokuhlangana kuzocetshiswana ngolwazi lokuya phambili, bese kuyekwa ukuklwebhana, ukuqhoshelana nokulwa - kubangwa izikhundla nokuphathana. "EZayoni yinqwaba amabandla amadala nahlonishwayo ngokuhle asekwenzile engicabanga ukuthi kuningi okuhle nolwazi olusemqoka abaholi bawo abangakwazi ukukweluleka ngakho labo abeza ngemuva, kuphela nje uma kuzoba yinhlonipho ehamba phambili.” Uthe nakuba izinhlelo ezinjenge-Apozion zisiza ukusabalalisa ubuhle bomsebenzi owenziwa ngamabandla aseZayoni, kepha akwanele ngoba kuba ngesikhathi esithile kuphela. Ngakho ziyadingeka ezinye izinhlelo ezizoqondana namaZayoni nje nezizoveza ubuhle bezinto eziye zenzeke khona nezenziwa ngabantu abathile abakhonza emabandleni ahlukene akhona."Ngakho mhlawumbe kungasiza nokuthi kube khona ezinye izinhlelo ezizoveza ukuthi iZayoni sezikhule futhi zaphucuzeka kanjani nangakanani, kepha futhi lokho kuyofana nokuthela amanzi emhlane wedada uma kusifica singakabumbani sisodwa.” Ngale kokwethula lolu hlelo, uNompumelelo uneziqu zobumeli bese eba wumthungi enkampanini abambisene kuyona nonina iNelly’s Tailoring Studio. Ubuye abe sekhwayeni lamaZayoni elihlanganiswe ngabantu abasha bamabandla ehlukene, Imbewu Yethemba Mass Choir, bese ekhonza ebandleni elingelinye lamadala eZayoni, i-Believers in Christ.

UKUTHUTHELEKA kwabantu abaningi beze emzini wakhe bezombuza izinto eziningi ngezinye zezinto eziwumnyombo wokuba wuMengameli woMkhonto Wesizwe Party (MKP), kwenze uMnuz Jacob Zuma wathatha isinqumo sokusungula ikomiti elizomlekelela ezintweni ezahlukene zeqembu.Lokhu uZuma ukudalule esithangamini nabezindaba ebesiseCoastland Hotel, eMhlanga Ridge, eThekwini izolo ngesikhathi kumenyezelwa ikomiti okuvele ukuthi lizomlekelela emisebenzini yaleli qembu.''Uma lifika eNkandla leli komiti lizokwazi ukuthi lingenelele lapho engizobona khona kunesidingo sokuba lilekelele,'' usho kanjena.Eqhuba uZuma uthe ukholwa wukuthi ikomiti lizokhathula indima enkulu ekwenzeni izinto kangcono kuleli qembu.''Sengizokwazi ukucela abanye abakuleli komiti ukuba benze lokho engibona ukuthi kufanele bakwenze. Uma ngithola umyalezo ngokuthile okwenzeka endaweni ethile sengizokwazi manje ukucela omunye wabo ukuba ahambe ayobheka khona,'' kuchaza uZuma.Owaba yikhansela lokuqala ngqa le-MKP, uMnuz Sibonelo Maphumulo umemezele abakhethiwe kuleli komiti. Kubona kuvele negama lendodana kaZuma, uMnuz Duduzane Zuma.Abanye ababalile ngoMnuz Vusimuzi Mkhize, SD Malunga, Nkk Zandile Mahlophe Mkhwanazi, Kaputeni Dladla, Siphamandla Vilakazi, Andrew Mbazo nabanye.UMaphumulo uthe inhlosongqangi ngokubunjwa kwekomiti wukuqinisekisa ukuthi leli qembu libonakala lidlondlobala kakhulu. Uthe bahlose nokuqinisekisa ukuthi uMkhonto uphakama okwangempela ukwazi ukwenza izinto ngendlela efanele.''Ngalokhu esikwenzayo sihlose ukuthi sithi ukuwuqinisa kancane umbutho wethu. Ngokubumba leli komiti sifuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ngempela kuyenzeka lokhu esikufunayo ngeqembu lethu.''Utshele amalungu aleli qembu abekhona ukuthi angalenzi iphutha akulibale ukuthi inhloso enkulu yaleli qembu wukubuyisela leli zwe ezandleni zabantu abamnyama.Lokhu uthe ukuze leli qembu likwazi ukukwenza kumele nakanjani likwazi ukuzihlela kahle ngendlela ezodala ukuthi konke kwenzeke kalula ngaphandle kwenkinga.Ugcizelele ukuthi kuningi kakhulu okuzobonakala kwenzeka njengoba seliqokiwe ikomiti. "Bonke bazobonakala bengenelela lapho umengameli ezobe edinga khona usizo. Siyinhlangano enkulu, kuningi esikwenzayo, yingakho-ke besilidinga ikomiti elifana naleli,'' usho kanjena.Uthe ikomiti lizoqikekela ukuthi izinto zihamba kahle kuleli qembu lokho likwenza lilekelela uZuma.

LONGE u-R44 million ngenyanga uhlelo lweSASSA lokubuyekeza izibonelelo eziholwa kuleli njengoba sekumiswe nezibonelelo ezingu-70 000, emva kokubuyekezwa.Lokhu kuvezwe yisikhulu esiphezulu seSASSA uMnuz Themba Matlou, izolo ekhuluma nabezindaba eKapa, ngezinhlelo zeSASSA zokuqinisa imigomo nokuvala ompompi kwabaqola lolu phiko behola kungafanele.Uthe basemkhankasweni wokubuyekeza izibonelelo yingakho bonge u-R44 million ngenyanga ngenxa yabahluleke wukuphothula uhlelo lokubuyekezwa kwezibonelelo zabo."Sifuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi sikhokhela abantu abafanele. Yingakho sibuyekeza izibonelelo ezingu-420 000, onyakenimali u-2025/2026. Sisabuyekeze izibonelelo ezingu-240 000, sakwazi ukumisa ezingu-70 000, zalabo abahlulekile ukuphothula uhlelo lokubuyekeza," usho kanje. Uthe ngonyaka bonga cishe u-R500 million ngenxa yalolu hlelo."Sinxusa abathintekayo ukuthi beze emahhovisi ukuze siqhubeke nohlelo lokubuyekeza izibonelelo zabo. Sisebenzisana nezinhlaka ezehlukene ukuthola imininingwane ngalabo esisuke sibuyekeza izibonelelo zabo."Ubale ama-credit bureau, amabhange, iSARS, iNSFAS nezinye izikhungo abasebenzisana nazo ukuthola imininingwane ngabasuke bebuyekeza izibonelelo zabo."Ngokusebenzisana neSARS, sihlonze abangu-495 296 abahola izibonelelo esithole ukuthi kumele siyifakele izibuko indaba yabo, ngoba imali evela ngaphansi kwabo ingaphezu kwesikalo esibekiwe ukuze umuntu ahlomule ngesibonelelo sikahulumeni. Iningi labo selazisiwe ukuthi malize ukuze sibuyekeze izibonelelo zabo," usho kanje. Uthe abangu-162 574 bathole imininingwane ngabo kwiNSFAS, kwathi abangu-291 581 bathola ngabo ohlelweni lukahulumeni lokukhokha amaholo."Siyayimisa imali yabahluleka wukuza kithina nemininingwane esisuke siyidinga. Sibanika izinsuku ezingu-90 ukuba beze kithina sibuyekeze indaba yabo ngoba asimane simise imali yabo."Uthe bakwenza lokhu ngoba befuna ukwehlisa inkohlakalo nokuxhashazwa kwemali yomphakathi."Silawulwa wumthetho ukuthi sibuyekeze izibonelelo yingakho abaholayo kumele basibikele uma sekukhona izinguquko empilweni yabo. Kumele babike uma kushintsha isimo sabo semali, kubalwa noma sebeshadile."
UMFOWABO weSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini, uMntwana uNhlanganiso kaZwelithini, unxuse amadoda amadala ukuba ayeke umkhuba wokulala nezingane ezincane.UMntwana uNhlanganiso uthe amadoda amadala azitika ngocansi nezingane ezincane abulala ikusasa lentsha.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma ePhalamende lamadoda ebelisingethwe esiShayamthetho KwaZulu-Natal izolo.UMntwana uNhlanganiso, ongowasesigodlweni KwaDlamahlahla, uthe ufuna uphele umkhuba wamadoda alala nezingane."Yekelani izingane ezincane ezinganeni. Tholani ontangayenu."UMntwana uNhlanganiso uhlabe abasaqhubeka nomkhuba wokuthwala.Uthe ukuthwala akusilona isiko, wathi futhi kuphambene nomthetho."Alikho isiko lenkani. "UMntwana uNhlanganiso unxuse amadoda ukuba ayeke ukuhlukumeza abantu besifazane ikakhulukazi phambi kwezingane."Ngababuza abadala ukuthi nake nalibona yini iqhude lijaha amatshwele? Uma sizokwenza izinto ezingalungile phambi kwezingane nazo zizokwenza okungalungile. Inkalankala ibukela kubazali bayo ukuthi kuhanjwa kanjani."UMntwana uNhlanganiso unxuse amabhungu ukuba angajahi ukuzalisa.UMntwana uNhlanganiso uthe izobambezeleka empilweni injejane uma ishesha ukuzalisa."Awukwazi ukuthi ungathi uyingane wondliwa ekhaya, nawe bese uba nengane. Ngihlezi ngisho ukuthi into ebambezela amadoda empilweni wukuthola izingane eseyizingane. Kufanele nilinde isikhathi sibe kahle. Mina ngaba nengane yami yokuqala ngineminyaka engu-40. Ngiyisibonelo esihle kinina."UMntwana uNhlanganiso unxuse injejane ukuba yamukele uma kwenzeka yehlelwa yishobolo lokwaliwa."Iyekeni le nto yokuthi analiwa. Ibizwa ngani le nto yokuthi abantu banqabe ukwaliwa? Uma waliwa esikoleni, usuyamshaya? Iyekeni leyo nto."Iphini loMphathiswa wokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi, uMnuz Ganief Hendricks, likhale kakhulu ngesibalo esiphezulu samacala enziwa abafundi ezikoleni.UHendricks uthe izibalo zamacala enziwe abafundi ezikoleni kulezi zinyanga eziyisithupha ezedlule ziyashaqisa."Kunabafundi abangu-104 abadlwengulwa abanye abafundi, ezikoleni. Kunabafundi abangu-20 ababulewe ezikoleni, bebulawa abanye abafundi. Konke lokhu kwenzeke ezinyangeni eziyisithupha. Izikhungo zethu zigcwele izingane ezineminyaka engaphansi kuka-18 ezilahlwe amacala ahlukene. Lezi zingane zigcinwe ezikhungweni zethu ngenxa yokuthi kubalekelwa ukuba zifakwe emajele."
IQEMBU elihola uhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal, i-IFP, ligcine lipaqaze isigqoko lacela umhlangano neqembu elingababeki benkosi kuhulumeni wesifundazwe, iNFP.Ubuholi be-IFP bubhalele ubuholi beNFP bucela ukuba nomhlangano ngoFebhuwari 9 noma ngoFebhuwari 16.Lezi zindaba ziqinisekiswe ngumholi weNFP ongagunyaziwe ukukhuluma nabezindaba.Umhlangano ocelwa abaholi be-IFP uzobhunga ngesinqumo seNFP sokuhoxa kuhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal, nokuyisinqumo esibeka engcupheni uhulumeni wesifundazwe.Encwadini ebonwe Isolezwe, usihlalo we-IFP ophinde abe uSotswebhu omkhulu esiShayamthetho, uMnuz Blessed Gwala, ucele abaholi beNFP ukuba basho ukuthi iluphi usuku abazokwazi ukuhlangana ngalo nabo kulezi zinsuku ezimbili ezihlongoziwe."Ithimba elihola izingxoxo kwi-IFP licela ukuba nomhlangano nabaholi beNFP ukuze sizokhuluma ngezindaba ezithinta uhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal."Kuqhamuka le ncwadi nje, ubuholi beNFP busanda kunqaba isimemo somhlangano wamaqembu abusa ngokubambisana, bukhala ngokuthi bufuna ukuthi buqale buhlangane nobuholi be-IFP eceleni ngaphambi kokuthi buhlangane nobuholi bawo wonke amaqembu abusa ngokubambisana.Ubuholi beNFP bahlangana nobuholi bamanye amaqembu abusa ngokubambisana, i-ANC neDA, kwasala i-IFP.UNobhala Jikelele weNFP obambile, uMnuz Sunset Xaba, wathi kukhona izinto abafuna ukuqale bazixoxe nobuholi be-IFP ngaphambi kokuthi bahlangane sebebonke.Khonamanjalo: Kulindeleke ukuthi ubuholi beNFP bubambe umhlangano neqembu eligaqele ukuphatha uhulumeni wesifundazwe, iMKP.Umhlangano kuhlelwe ukuthi ube kusasa. Isolezwe libonwe incwadi ebhalwe uXaba ebhekiswe ePhinini lesibili lomholi weMKP, uMnuz Tony yengeni, lapho uXaba ehlongoza usuku lwakusasa.I-MKP inethemba lokuketula uhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal uma ithola ukwesekwa iNFP, njengoba inezihlalo ezingu-37 kwezingu-80 esiShayamthetho, yesekwa i-EFF enezihlalo ezimbili.Isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, sasifakwe iMKP sabhuntsha.Amalungu eMKP nawe-EFF avele aphazamisa ngesikhathi sekucacile ukuthi isiphakamiso sawo sizohluleka ngenxa yokuthi ilungu leNFP, uNksz Mbali Shinga, lase lizwakalise ukuthi lizovota namaqembu abusa ngokubambisana.UNksz Shinga onguMphathiswa wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi, wawushaya indiva umyalelo weqembu wokuba asule kulesi sikhundla, njengoba ubhekene nekomiti lokuqondiswa ubugwegwe, njengoba esolwa ngokushaya indiva umyalelo weqembu wokuba aseke isiphakamiso seMKP.
UMNDENI wowesilisa waseMgababa, okuthiwa ushone ngendlela engaqondakali esikhungweni esisiza imilutha yezidakamizwa, iDiscipline Boot Camp SA, usudalule izinsolo ezishaqisayo ngokuthiwa kwenzeke ngaphambi kokuba umufi ashone.Umufi, uMnuz Mduduzi Luthuli (23) kuthiwa washona ngoJanuwari 22, 2026, emva kokuba yena nabanye ababili, ayezama ukweqa nabo, beshaywe kanzima abasebenza egatsheni laseRichmond, lapho okwakungeniswe khona umufi.Isihlobo, uNksz Kwenzekile Luthuli, sitshele Isolezwe ukuthi bathole ucingo luqhamuka komunye obengeniswe kulesi sikhungo. UNksz Luthuli uveze ukuthi owesilisa ubatshele ukuthi zinzima izimo abaphiliswa ngaphansi kwazo kulesi sikhungo, wathi okuvezwa ezinkundleni zokuxhumana akulutho."Uthe ekuseni bavuswa ngo-4, benziswe ama-push up awu-1 000 umuntu ngamunye. Kuthiwa uma uhluleka udliwa yinduku. Isidlo sasekuseni kuba yipalishi elimhlophe, esasemini kube yizambane elicobhozwe kusawoti, ebusuku balale ngamanqina enkukhu amabili. Uma kuyisikhathi sokugeza, kuyiwa emfuleni oseduze, kuyogezwa ngamanzi abandayo,” kusho uNksz Luthuli.Uthe iningi lemilutha eyiswa yimindeni yayo kulesi sikhungo, ikuthola kunzima ukumelana nazo zonke lezi zimo, yikho umufi nabanye ababili, babhunga ngeyokuzama ukweqa ngesikhathi beyogeza emfuleni. "Uthe babehlele ukuthi beqe ngoJanuwari 20, kodwa imizamo yabo yangaphumelela. Babethi bazovele babaleke, baphonseke emgwaqweni oseduze, bacele ukugitsheliswa yizimoto ezidlulayo, bahambe,” usho kanje.Uthe itulo alibange lisenzeka njengoba kukhona oyedwa wemilutha, owabezwa, maqede wayobampimpa. Uveze ukuthi kwathi sekubuyelwa esikhungweni bafike bavalelwa egunjini elithize, bafakwa induku. "Kuthiwa baze bagaxwa namathayi kagandaganda. Kuyacaca ukuthi baze baphelelwa amandla,” usho kanje. Uthe bagcina sebechama igazi, bathi noma bethi bayayibika leyo, basolwa ngokuthi bayazenzisa. Kuthiwa lona wesilisa uveze ukuthi ukuhlukunyezwa okufanayo kwaqhubeka nangoJanuwari 21 kanjalo nangoJanuwari 22, nokuyilapho okuthiwa uLuthuli wagcina ewa, maqede waphuma uketshezi oluthile ngomlomo nangamakhala. "Kuthiwa wabe esephuthunyiswa esibhedlela nokwavela ukuthi ufike khona esevele eseshonile, njengoba bathathwa esikhungweni ngeveni sekuxhamazelwa, kubonakala ukuthi akasanyakazi,” kusho uNksz Luthuli.Uthe izisebenzi ezazimyise esibhedlela kwathi uma sezibuya ngaphandle kwakhe zathi, kwenzekile, okwenzekile, uMdu useshonile, impilo ayiqhubeke.Uthe lona wesilisa kukhona lapho aveze khona ukuthi kukhona abake baphelelwa khona amandla, bangakwazi nokusukuma, kade sebephuziswe umuthi othile, nakhona kwathi uma bebika, baphendulwa ngokuthi bayazenzisa. Uthe bathole ukuthi azikho izisebenzi zezempilo ezibhekelela abagula ngesikhathi besohambweni lwabo lokuphuma ekusebenziseni izidakamizwa."Nosonhlalakahle abekho, kanjalo nalabo abeluleka ngokwengqondo,” usho kanje. Uthe iyabathusa indlela abesikhungo abaziphethe ngayo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana njengoba belokhu bebalula ukuthi baphatheke kabi ngokufa kukaLuthuli, ekubeni umnikazi wesikhungo engakaze afike ukuzohlanganisa amehlo nabo. "Nayo le yokusabisa ababuza imibuzo ngokufa kukaMdu ezinkundleni zokuxhumana iyasimangaza. Baziphathisa okwabantu abazi okuthile esingakwazi thina, yize bethi wayezivocavoca,” usho kanje.Isolezwe liwubonile umbiko wokuhlolwa kwesidumbu oveza ukuthi umufi wafa ngenxa yokushaywa kanjalo nengozi eyayisekhanda. Ethintwa ngeledlule umnikazi wesikhungo uMnuz King Madlokovu ucele ukungaphawuli kakhulu, wathi ukusho lokhu ngoba kusaqhubeka uphenyo lwamaphoyisa.
IPHAKAMISE ukuthi kwakhiwe izikhungo zokucijwa kwamakhono abantu abasha oPhongolo iMeya yekule ndawo, uMnuz Bheki Thwala.Ubekhuluma emcimbini wakamuva wokuklonyeliswa kwabafundi abenze kahle ku-matric ngonyaka odlule.UThwala uthe kuyakhathaza ukuthi zincane izikhungo zamakhono ezisezindaweni ezisemakhaya. Uthe ukwanda kwalezi zikhungo kungaba yisixazululo esikhulu ukubhekana nengwadla yesibalo esikhulu sabafundi ababonakala beduva emakhaya njalo uma beqede u-matric.UThwala uthe uzoxhumana nezinhlaka ezihlukene ngenhloso yokubhunga kabanzi ngale nkinga athe kumele isukunyelwe ngokuphazima kweso.''Ngikholwa wukuthi ayikho into engeke yenzeke inqobo nje uma sonke sibambisana. Le nto yesikhungo samakhono ingaba yigxathu elimqoka kakhulu kubantu abasha bakule ndawo," usho kanjena.Eqhubeka uthe uzokwenza konke okusemandleni ukuqinisekisa ukuthi leli phupho ligcina lifezeka noma kanjani."Kumele senze konke okusemandleni ukuze isikhungo sigcine sikhona oPhongolo," usho kanjena.Uthe inhlosongqangi yalokhu wukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abasha abaphenduki ondingasithebeni uma sebephothule uGrade 12.''Abantu abasha kule ndawo kumele siqinisekise ukuthi bayaya ezikhungweni zokucijwa ngamakhono. Lokho ngikholwa wukuthi kungabalekelela ngayo yonke indlela. Iningi labo lingagcina selithola namanye amathuba," kusho uThwala.Mayelana nokwenza kahle kwezikole ezingaphansi kwalo masipala uthe lokhu kukuveza ngokusobala ukuthi mukhulu umsebenzi owenziwe othisha ngokubambisana nabafundi.Uthe badinga ukushayelwa elikhulu ihlombe bonke abantu abenze konke okusemandleni ukuze kutholakale imiphumela emihle ngalolu hlobo.''Kuyinto esijabulisile ukubona izikole eziningi zendawo zenza kahle ngale ndlela. Lokhu kwenza sibone ukuthi eminyakeni ezayo kuyobe kukhulunywa indaba yokuthi zonke izikole zenze kahle,'' kuchaza yena.Uncome abazali nabafundi wathi nabo bayadinga ukushayelwa ihlombe ngoba inkulu indima abayiklamayo ukuze kugcine kutholakala imiphumela emihle ngalolu hlobo.Umcimbi uphothulwe ngokuthi kuklonyeliswe abafundi abenze kahle kanye nezikole ezithole imiphumela emihle.
USAKHALELA izimpendulo kanjalo nobulungiswa umndeni wowesifazane waseKuphumeleleni, KwaSanti, okuthiwa wahamba ekhaya ngoDisemba 2018, evakashela umkhwenyana, wangaphinde wabuya. Ngokusho kukaNksz Mbali Cele oyisihlobo, uNksz Andile Cele (27) wasuka ekhaya ngoDisemba 22, 2018, walibangisa kubo kamkhwenyana wakhe eMatimatolo, eGreytown.Uthe wayethembise ukuthi ngeke alenze iphutha angabuyi ngoDisemba 28, 2018, kwazise wayethe ufuna ukuhlukanisa unyaka ekhaya nendodakazi (8) yakhe kanjalo nomndeni. "Saqala sathuswa imiyalezo ayeyiphanyeke kuma-status ka-WhatsApp wakhe ngoKhisimusi, esaze sayibona ngakusasa ekuseni,” kusho uMbali.Uthe asawukhumbula owawuthi: "Lokhu kuwukuphela komendo wami”, wathi bathi uma bezama ukumfonela ukuze bambuze ngale miyalezo, bathola ukuthi ucingo lwakhe kalusangeni. Uveze ukuthi kwahamba izinsuku, kwathi uma bembona engabuyi ngosuku ayethembise ukubuya ngalo, bahlaba ucingo balubhekisa kumkhwenyana, bembuza ukuthi uphi."Wasitshela ukuthi akekho uhambile, weza ekhaya ngoDisemba 26,” kusho uNksz Cele. Uthe ngoJanuwari 1, 2019, banikela emaphoyiseni eMariannhill, bayobika umuntu odukile, bavulelwa idokodo abayalelwa ukuthi lizodluliselwa esiteshini saseMatimatolo, ngoba ulahleke kade eye khona. "Nathi basiyalela ukuthi siye esiteshini sakhona ukuze sizosizakala kangcono,” usho kanje. Esinye isihlobo esaba yingxenye yohambo lokuya eMatimatolo, uNksz Gugu Mbatha, sithe umkhenyana wakhuluma izinkulumo ezingafani ngokunyamalala kuka-Andile ngalolo suku."Ngesikhathi simfonela, wasitshela ukuthi u-Andile ukhona, usekhaya kubo. Kwathi uma esebuzwa amaphoyisa sesifike nawo kubo, washintsha wakhuluma eyokuthi wahamba weza ekhaya ngoDisemba 26,” kusho uNksz Mbatha. Uthe babethi uma bembuza ukuthi kungani akhulume izinto ezingafani, abasole ngokumninda ngecala angalazi, athi kobaphoqa ukuthi bamgeze uma sekutholakala ukuthi u-Andile uyaphila. Uthe luningi nolunye ulwazi olwalubuye luphutshuzwe wumndeni wakhe, baluyise kumphenyi kodwa bangaboni kuthathwa zinyathelo ngalo.Kulona, uthe kukhona nolukamfowabo kamkhwenyana, owabatshela ukuthi yena wamuzwa u-Andile ekhala ebusuku bangoKhisimusi. "Emva kwalokhu kukhala, akekho egcekeni owaphinde wambona. Ngisho nangesikhathi 'esehamba' njengokusho komkhwenyana, akekho othi wambona,” kubeka uNksz Mbatha. Uqhube wathi kwabuye kwaba khona ingane yasemndenini eyayineminyaka ebalelwa ku-12 ngo-2019, eyayilokhu ikhuluma noyedwa womndeni ka-Andile, ithi yona iyazi ukuthi ubaba omdala wamenzani umama omdala. "Saphinda salusa lolu lwazi kuphenyi. Sathi uma sesibuza ukuthi wenzeni ngalo, wathi uyile kulo muzi ethi uyophonsa ingane imibuzo, wafike watshelwa ukuthi seyathutha yayohlala eJozini,” usho kanje, wathi baxakwa ukuthi yayingekho yini indlela yokuthi kuyiwe lapho, ukuze izosho ekwaziyo. Uthe okunye ababuye bakuqaphela ngesikhathi bepequlula endlini kamkhwenyana ukuthi nakuba zazisekhona ezinye izimpahla zika-Andile kodwa kukhona okwakuthimulisa. "Isikhwama sakhe esikhulu ayengasishiyi uma ehamba nayesuke naso ekhaya ngesikhathi eya khona, sasikhona. Umbuzo wethu, ongaphendulekanga, wawuthi uma ehambe wabuyela ekhaya, uzipakishephi izimpahla zakhe ayehambe nazo?” kusho uNksz Mbatha. Uthe okunye abakuqaphela ukuthi iselula yakhe kanjalo nesikhwama sakhe semali esasinezinto ezifana namakhadi asebhange, umazisi kanjalo nelayisensi, sasingekho. Bathe ngokwabo yonke iminwe ikhomba lona wesilisa, bathi bafuna ihhovisi lamaphoyisa esifundazweni likhiphe umyalelo wokuthi liphinde livulwe idokodo eselavalwa, luqalwe phansi uphenyo, kuphenyisiswe umkhwenyana ukuze akhiphe izimpendulo."Wuye owayevakashwelwe, nguye owaba umuntu wokugcina ukumbona, nguye okhuluma izinto ezingefani. Akaphenyisiswe, akhiphe lonke iqiniso, asho nokuthi isidumbu sakhe wasigqibaphi, bese eyaboshwa,” kusho uNksz Cele. BALUBIKELE uNkulunkulu udaba lwengwadla yezingozi zomgwaqo ezibonakala zidla lubi kakhulu kulezi zinsuku ezingxenyeni ezahlukene zezwe. Lokhu kwenzeke kwindumezulu yenkonzo ebiseHambanathi, oThongathi.Le nkonzo beyihlelwe ngokubambisana ngabefundisi bamabandla ahlukene kanye nenhlangano yomalume abathutha izingane zesikole ebizwa ngeSiqalokuhle Association.UMphostoli Njabulo Mfeka oyilungu lale nhlangano uthe babone kumqoka kakhulu ukuba bahlele lo mkhuleko ngenxa yokubona ukuthi lezi zingozi seziphenduke insakavukela muva nje.Uthe nakuba kule ndawo zingakabibikho izehlakalo zalolu hlobo ezibikiwe kodwa babona kumqoka ukuthi banxuse uNkulunkulu ukuba angenelele ngokushesha kulesi simo agcizelele ukuthi siyethusa kakhulu.Ukhale kakhulu ngokuthi lezi zingozi zibonakala zidlula kakhulu nemiphefumulo yezingane zesikole.''Ngabe senza iphutha elikhulu uma sikuziba lokhu esikubona kwenzeka ezinganeni zethu. Sinxusa uNkulunkulu ukuba angenelele kule nkinga engaka esikhungethe,'' usho kanjena.Ugcizelele kakhulu ukubaluleka kokuphepha kwabantwana njalo uma beya ezikoleni. UMphostoli Mduduzi Mashiyane weHouse of Sacrifices uthe okugqama kakhulu wukuthi usathane uhlasela esebenzisa izingozi ezibandakanya abantwana besikole.Uthe kuyakhathaza kakhulu ukubona sanda isibalo sezingane zesikole ezihamba emhlabeni ngenxa yalesi simo.''Njengabaholi bezenkolo kumele sikhuleke kakhulu simnxuse uNkulunkulu ukuba angenelele kulesi simo. Indlela okwenzeka ngayo ayiyinhle nje nhlobo futhi iyethusa,'' usho kanjena.Uthe okuqaphelekayo kakhulu yizikhathi lezi zingozi ezenzeka ngazo. Uthe kuphakathi kokuba zenzeka ekuseni abantwana besaya esikoleni noma sebebuya khona. ''Lokhu kukuveza ngokusobala ukuthi impela inkulu impi ekhona manje ebhekiswe ebantwaneni bethu. Uma-ke singadembesela singamxusi uNkulunkulu ukuba angenelele kuzokonakala kakhulu,'' usho kanjena.Uthe wumkhuleko kuphela onamandla okunqoba lesi simo esingesihle nathe siletha ukwethuka okukhulu kubazali.Lo mkhuleko wenziwa ke nje ezinsukwini ezedlule sekubikwe kaningi ngezingozi zomgwaqo ezinyantisa igazi nezibandakanya izingane zesikole. Phakathi kwezinye zalezi zingozi kukhona neyenzeke eMgungundlovu nakhona kwalimala abafundi.Kuthe kusabatshazwa lokho kwaba nenye futhi ingozi ebandakanya abafundi eGoli. Muva nje kube nenye ingozi eLotus Park ngaseSiphingo lapho okugcine kudlula khona abantu abangu-11 obekukhona kubo nomfundi oneminyaka engu-13.
IKHULUNYELWA emakhoneni eZwelisha, eBergville, eyephoyisa elisinde ngokulambisa nesihlobo salo kade bedutshulwa ngemuva kokuba bebhadanywe egcekeni kusolwa ukuthi bebekade bezama ukweba izimbuzi.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi iphoyisa nesihlobo salo baphuthunyiswe esibhedlela isimo sibucayi kakhulu. Kuvela ukuthi kukhona owesithathu naye olimale kabi kodwa yena ongahlobene nephoyisa.Umsolwa wesine kuvela ukuthi ugcwele amathafa futhi akazange athelwe amachaphazelo.
