Uqhube wathi kuthe uma umphakathi sewuzama ukubabamba abasolwa bavele badubula bebhekise emphakathini.''Abasolwa ababili balimale kabi ngesikhathi umphakathi usuphindisela. Babe sebedluliselwa esibhedlela lapho bengaphansi kweso lamaphoyisa,'' usho kanjena.
KUMAPEKETWANE esikhungweni esigcina abadala eMlaza, i-Ekhanana Old Age Home, osekuphele inyanga sicishelwe ugesi ngenxa yesikweletu sika-R4 million.Isolezwe lihambele kule ndawo lakhuluma noMnuz Jabulani Kunene oyisikhulu esiphezulu kulesi sikhungo, oveze ukuthi izinto zimapeketwane selokhu umasipala ucishe ugesi ngenxa yesikweletu.Uthe sesiphezulu kakhulu isikweletu ababhekene naso, wathi abasazi ukuthi nabo bathatheni bahlanganise nani ukuze bezokwazi kuthi bavale umgodi ovulekile.Uveze ukuthi banezaguga ezingu-46 ezihlala ngaphakathi kulesi sikhungo ebese kuba nezinye ezifikayo kodwa ezingahlali khona ngokugcwele.UKunene uthe ukucishelwa kwabo ugesi kudala ukuthi izinto zimane zibe lukhuni satshe, wathi kufike abantu bawucisha ugesi babatshela ukuthi inkinga bakweleta imali enkulu.''Sona sesisikhulu kakhulu isikweletu esikhona manje. Okubuhlungu ukuthi nathi asazi ukuthi sizokwazi kanjani ukuthi sisikhokhe," usho kanjena.Uthe okubuhlungu ukuthi abantu abadala bayawa embhedeni ngenxa yokuthi ugesi awukho, kuba mnyama kanti ababoni emehlweni.''Sibhekene nenkinga enkulu njengoba abantu abadala bewa (begingqika phansi) emibhedeni nsuku zonke ngenxa yokungabi bikho kukagesi. Le nto imbi kakhulu futhi ingagcina isidala ukuthi kube khona abanye babo sebelimala ngenxa yalesi simo," usho kanjena.Uveze ukuthi okunye okubi ngalesi simo ukuthi kukhona nezinye izinsiza ezingasebenziseki ngenxa yokuthi ugesi awukho. Uthe uhlalele ovalweni ngale nkinga ngoba akazi ukuthi kuzogcina kwenzekeni uma kuqhubeka ukucishwa kukagesi.Ukhulume nangokuthi abanayo imoto yokuthutha izaguga uma kufanele baye ezibhedlela, waveza nokuthi babhekene nanenkinga yamanzi kule ndawo.''Ngikhuluma nje, izingubo ziwashwa ngezandla namanzi atholakala kanzima," echaza. Udalule ukuthi bakulesi simo nje kungenxa yokuthi vele babhekene nenkinga yezezimali. Ukugcizelile ukuthi lesi sikhungo sibhekene nengwadla yokweswela imali.Uveze ukuthi uMasipala weTheku ubayalele ukuthi okungenani mabanciphise lesi sikweletu ngokuthi bakhokhe nyanga zonke. Uthe batshelwe ukuthi okungenani bangakhokha imali ewu-R200 000 nyanga zonke.Lena ke yimali uKunene akholwa ukuthi inkulu njengoba ethe bona bayisikhungo esingenzi nzuzo, akulula ukuba bangakhona ukukhokha imali engaka nyanga zonke.''Iqiniso ukuthi asinayo imali eyanele ngoba ukube sinayo ngabe siyakwazi ukuthi sikhokhele ugesi siphinde sikwazi ukuthi sixazulule nezinye izinkinga eziningi ezikhona lapha ngaphakathi,'' usho kanjena.Okhulumela uMasipala weTheku, uGugu Sisilana, uthe umasipala ulindele ukuthi zonke izikhungo zikhokhe ziqede zonke izikweletu zikagesi.Uthe lapho okunesikweletu khona nakanjani ugesi uyacishwa ngoba lokhu umasipala ukwenza ngaphansi kohlelo lwabo olubizwa ngokuthi yiMunicipality's Credit Control and Debit Collection Policy. Lokhu uthe bakwenza ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imali kagesi ikhokhwa ngendlela efanele.
UVELE avukwe usizi uyise wowesifazane waKwaSonyongwane, eMzimkhulu, okuthiwa ubulawe yisoka lakhe kade limsola ngokuthi useyajola.UMnuz Zakhele Sithole unguyise kamufi, uNksz Zandile Sithole (34), okusolakala ukuthi ubulawe ngesihluku yisoka lakhe okuthiwa ligcwele amathafa. Isolezwe linalo igama likamsolwa kodwa elingeke lilidalule engakaveli enkantolo.USithole utshele Isolezwe ukuthi indodakazi yakhe ibikade ivakashele isoka kanti bazofike baxabane, isoka lase limgwaza maqede labaleka.''Ubekade elivakashele isoka lakhe okuyinto ebengingenankinga nayo ngoba vele usemdala futhi bengingeke ngimtshele ukuthi akahlukane nalo. Kodwa okubuhlungu ukuthi le nto igcine seyiphetha kabuhlungu kangaka,''echaza. Uthe kube nokuphambana ngenkulumo phakathi kwalaba kwathi uma indodakazi izama ukuphuma ibaleke wayifica egcekeni wayigwaza wase ecela empunzini.''Okungiphethe kabi kakhulu nje ukuthi ingane yami ibulawe phambi komndeni onabantu abaningi kangaka. Ngikholwa ukuthi bahlulekile ukulekelela ingane yami. Ibuhlungu kakhulu le nto eyenzekile enganeni yami," usho kanjena.Uthi ukhulumile noyise kamsolwa waxolisa wathi bebevule ithelevishini ngesikhathi kusuka uthuli lwezichwe phakathi kwalaba kwazise umsolwa ubenendlu yakhe ngaphakathi egcekeni.''Ngizizwa ngihlukumezekile nje kakhulu ngendlela yonke le nto eyenzeke ngayo. Namanje akuvumi ngikholwe ukuthi indodakazi yami kayisekho ngampela emhlabeni," usho kanjena. Uthe usazoke ahlale phansi nomndeni lapho obekuqome khona indodakazi yakhe babhunge ukuthi kwenziwa njani uma kunjena.''Angazi mina mhlawumpe yibona abazonginikeza uhlahlandlela wokuthi ngempela kwenziwa kanjani uma kunjena. Mina ngizizwa ngiphelelwa ngamagama,''echaza.Uthe okumphatha kabi kakhulu ukuthi unina kamufi ongasekho emhlabeni wayengeve eyithanda indodakazi yakhe.''Unina esezoshona wangidonsa ngendlebe ukuba ngenze konke okusemandleni ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ngiyayinakekela indodakazi yakhe. Ngizizwa ngiyisahluleki ngoba ngihlulekile ukwenza into engangikade ngicelwe ukuba ngiyenze," echaza. Uthe njengamanje amehlo abo athe njo kwabengalo yomthetho ukuthi bazohamba ibanga elingakanani ngaleli cala. Uthe abakufisayo njengomndeni ukubona ubulungiswa benzeka.''Kukodwa nje okungasithoba amanxeba njengomndeni ukubanjwa kukamsolwa ebese kuqulwa icala ebese eyavalelwa. Ngeke phela kulunge ukuthi kubulawe indodakazi yami ebese kuphela nje kanjalo. Kumele ajeze loyo okumele ajeze," usho kanjena.Utshele Isolezwe ukuthi yize engenaso isiqiniseko kodwa bese kuphele iminyake ecela kwemihlanu laba bethandana.''Angikaze ngicabage ukuthi lo mfana angenza into enjena ngoba nakhu esola indodakazi yami ngokujola. Ubengamane ngani ayishiye athole enye intombi uma ebesehluleka ukuba nayo," echaza. Uthe ngabe uqamba amanga aluhlaza uma engathi ubeke wezwa kukhulunywa indaba yokuthi kukhona ukuhilizisana okuye kube khona phakathi kwendodakazi nesoka. "Yize ngingeke ngazi kodwa angikhumbuli ngithola ukuthi kukhona okungahambi kahle phakathi kwalaba ababili. Yingakho kungimangazile kakhulu ukuthola ngalokhu okwenzekile," echaza.Amaphoyisa aKwaZulu-Natala akuqinisekisile ukubulawa kowesifazane. Athe amaphoyisa aseMzimkhulu aphenya icala lokubulala.
SISESIBI namanje isimo kunkosikazi wephoyisa lasesiteshini saseCato Manor, eThekwini, elabulawa ngesihluku ngasekupheleni konyaka odlule.Lokhu kuvezwe wudadewabo kamufi, uNksz Thobile Gabisa, ngaphandle kweNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini izolo kulandela ukuvela kwabane ababoshwa ngecala lokubulala.USergeant Mondli Gabisa (39) wagwazwa wafa eMayville ngoNovemba 8 isidumbu sakhe saficwa ngamaphoyisa sidindilize ngaphandle kwamaflethi akule ndawo emva kwesigameko. Emva kokubulawa kwakhe, kwaboshwa abasolwa abane, oMnuz Thalente Griffiths Cele (42), Philani Maphila Mhlongo (29), Nksz Minenhle Amahle Cele (20) noNksz Nadia Shezi (25). UNksz Gabisa utshele Isolezwe ukuthi unkosikazi kamufi akukavumi amukele ukuthi umyeni wakhe akasekho emhlabeni."Uvele wakhala ekuseni ngikhuluma naye ngokuthi namuhla usuku lwecala,” kusho uNksz Gabisa. Uveze ukuthi umufi ushona nje, bekungakapheli zinyanga ezitheni bethole umntwana omncane, kanti bavele banomunye naye osemncane."Lo omncane unonyaka owodwa ezelwe. Kuthi lo omunye abe neminyaka cishe eyisihlanu. Sinzima isimo. Ukubulawa kukamfowethu, kumphoqe ukuthi abhekane nokukhulisa izingane ezincane yedwa,” usho kanje.Uthe selokhu liqalile ukuya enkantolo icala lona wesifazane akanawo amandla okuyozibonela ngawakhe okwenzeka khona. Ngaphakathi enkantolo, uMshushisi woMbuso, uMnuz Calvin Gavender, utshele inkantolo ukuthi udaba seluhanjisiwe ehhovisi loMqondisi wezokuShushiswa koMphakathi."Inhloso wukuthi anqume ukuthi icala likufanele yini ukuba liyoqulwa eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini,” kusho uGovender.Uveze ukuthi umqondisi uzothatha isinqumo ngalokhu uma sekuphothulwe lonke uphenyo. Uveze ukuthi phakathi kophenyo olusashoda kukhona umbiko wendawo yesigameko kanjalo nombiko wokuhlolwa kwesidumbu. IMantshi uNkk Vaehed ilihlehlisele uMashi 17 icala ukuze kuqhubeke uphenyo.Emva kokuboshwa kwabasolwa nyakenye kwavela ukuthi uNksz Cele uboshwa nje ubefunda u-matric, ebhala izivivinyo zakhe zokuphela konyaka. Bafaka isicelo sebheyili, kusona kwaphumelela umsolwa wesine kuphela, uNksz Shezi, owadedelwa ngebheyili ka-R1 000. Kuleli cala umsolwa wokuqala (uMnuz Cele), owesibili (uMnuz Mhlongo) nowesithathu (uNksz Cele) basolwa ngecala lokubulala umufi bese kuthi owesine (uNksz Shezi) asolwe ngelokushaya unkosikazi kamufi okuthiwa wayehamba naye ngosuku lwesigameko.
ZIYIME emthumeni emndenini waseBergville, othi unqatshelwa wumlungu ukuba ungcwabe ilungu lawo endaweni eyipulazi, isizukulwane sawo esazalelwa kulona.Isolezwe likhulume nowomndeni, uMnuz Mndeni Mavundla, walandisa ngomshophi obehlele wokudlula emhlabeni kukamfowabo omcane, uMnuz Sakhile Mavundla (35), adalule ukuthi uqalwe ukugula ngoNovemba, kwase kuyamanela muva nje.Uveze ukuthi igama laleli pulazi libizwa ngokuthi yiDelta, wathi kuduma amakhanda kubona njengoba umlungu owengamele leli pulazi eshaya phansi ngonyawo, ethi awukho umngcwabo ozoqhuheka endaweni yakhe.Uthe lokhu kuqubula inqwaba yemibuzo nokudideka kubona njengomndeni ngoba bona bazalelwa kuyona le ndawo futhi kunjalo nje banendawo engamathuna abafihla kuyona.''Baningi kakhulu abantu balapha ekhaya esesabafihla lapha epulazini. Siyadideka-ke uma namhlanje sekuqhamuka umuntu ezositshela ukuthi ngeke sikwazi ukuthi singcwabe endaweni esaqala kudala ukuthuna kuyona, kwayena lo mlungu engakafiki," usho kanjena.Uveze ukuthi sekuphele isikhashana manje beduve nesidumbu njengoba kuduma amakhanda ngokuthi bazothathani bahlanganise nani ukuze baphume kulesi simo abazithola bebhekene naso.''Kumile yonke into. Asazi ukuthi kumele senzenjani. Le nto isidale ukuthi kume yonke into ngenxa yalesi simo esibhekene naso," echaza.Uthe sebezamile amahlandla amabalwa ukukhuluma nomlungu kodwa kufana nokuthi bagqoma idwala.Uthe emhlanganweni wokuqala, umlungu ubatshele ukuthi mabalinde kukhona omunye okumele abe khona uma sekubhungwa ngokungcwatshwa kuleli pulazi. Uthe namanje basahlezi balinde umnyama ongenafu.Uchaze lesi simo njengesifana nje ncimishi nesifaka usawoti esilondeni."Njengamanje kumele ngabe kukhulunywa indaba yokuthi sesiyawaphothula amalungiselelo okufihla okanye sesiqedile. Kodwa lutho, izinto zimile nje akunyakazi lutho ngenxa yalesi simo," kusho yena.Uthe basabela ukuthi uma siqhubeka lesi simo izogcina seyiphezulu kakhulu imali okuzomele bayikhokhele amakhaza alapho kugcinwe khona umufi.''Kumele isixazululo sale nto sitholakale ngokukhulu ukushesha lokhu. Ngale kwalokho kuzonokala izinto eziningi kakhulu," usho kanjena.Uthe bona abazimisele ukuthi uphondo lungagoba ngakubona ekubeni okhokho babo kanye nomkhulu bafihlwa kuyona le ndawo, wathi bagcine ukufihla endaweni ngo-1998 ngesikhathi befihla ugogo wabo.''Samfihla kahle kabi ngaphandle kwenkinga, akekho nomuntu owaqhamuka wasitshela le nto esesiyitshelwa yilo mlungu manje," echaza.Uthe kumele babhukule balwe nayo le nto ngoba kuyacaca ukuthi neminye imindeni ezoshonelwa izozithola seyibhekene nenkiyankiya.Isolezwe limshayele ucingo umlungu okukhulunywa ngaye ozibize ngokuthi unguJanie. Uvumile ukuthi uyalwazi udaba lokuduva kwesidumbu selungu lomndeni othile emakhazeni. Uthe ngeshwa akukho angalekelela ngakho ngoba umthetho usuyabanqabela ukuthi abantu bangafihla epulazini.''Ngikhuluma nawe nje sebeyitholile incwadi evela enkantolo ebibazisa ukuthi ngeke bakwazi ukufihla epulazini. Manje sekusezandleni zabo-ke ukuthi bazothatha siphi isinqumo," usho kanje.Ukuze kufinyelelwe esisombululweni salolu daba, Isolezwe lizamile ukuxhumana nehhovisi lokuBuyiswa koMhlaba nokuThuthukiswa kweziNdawo zasemaKhaya kodwa alangaphendula.
UMHOLI we-EFF, uMnuz Julius Malema, ufuna iqembu lesizwe, iBafana Bafana, kanye namanye amazwe ukuba adube iNdebe yoMhlaba ezodlalelwa eMelika.UMalema ukhale ngokuthi amazwe amaningi azokube eyingxenye yomqhudelwano asohlwini lamazwe iMelika eqinise kuwo imigomo yokuthola izimvume zokungena ezweni, wathi abalandeli bebhola bengazithola bephenduka isilo sengubo uma bengaphokophela nokuya eMelika.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba eGoli, izolo.INdebe yoMhlaba yakulo nyaka izosingathwa ngokubambisana iMelika, Canada neMexico.IBafana yagcina ukudlala emqhudelwaneni weyoMhlaba eyayidlalelwa kuleli, ngo-2010. Yayingene ngengxaphephe yokuthi iyona esingethe umqhudelwano wango-2010.UMalema uthe akuthi shu ukuthi iBafana kade yagcina ukudlala eNdebeni yoMhlaba uma ukuqhathanisa nokuthi uhulumeni waseMelika ubulala abantu abangenacala."Noma ngabe ubaluleke kangakanani lo mqhudelwano kwiBafana, iqiniso ukuthi awubalulekile ukudlula impilo yabantu ababulawayo. Ziningi izingane ezishonayo ngenxa yeMelika. INingizimu Afrika yayingavunyelwe ngenxa ukuba ingxenye yemiqhudelwano yezemidlalo ngesikhathi sobandlululo ngenxa yokuthi kwakubulawa abantu. Lena into efanayo njengoba nohulumeni waseMelika unesandla ekubulaweni kwabantu. Buka into eyenzeka ePalestine naseVenezuela. Inkulu kakhulu impi esiyilwayo lana njengoba ithinta ukuhlukunyezwa kwamalungelo abantu."UMalema uthe amazwe amaningi ayingxenye yeNdebe yoMhlaba asohlwini lamazwe iMelika engafuni ukuthi abantu bakuwo banikwe izimvume zokungena.Kula mazwe uMalema ubale iBrazil, Colombia, Ghana, Senegal, Tunisia, Algeria namanye.UMalema uthe lokhu kuzobeka engcupheni impilo yabantu abafuna ukuyobuka ibhola."Akuphephile neze eMelika. Kukhona abantu abazozama ukuya eMelika bengenazo izimvume. Bazovike bathwayize emigwaqweni laphana bese beba nenkinga. Bengazithola beboshwa, behlukumezeka. Asibagqugquzeli abantu ukuthi baye eMelika."UMalema uthe kukhona izinhlangano zamalungelo abantu ezikhalaza ngokuhlukunyezwa kwabantu bangaphandle eMelika."Sinxusa ukuba iSafa kanye nezinkakha ukuba zijoyine umbhidlango wethu wokunxenxa amazwe ukuba adube iNdebe yoMhlaba."UMalema ukhuluma kanjena nje, vele ubudlelwano bakuleli neMelika abubuhle.Uhulumeni kaDonald Trump usola iNingizimu Afrika ngokuhlukumeza amalungelo abantu abamhlophe.
BABHEKENE nengwadla abafundi abevile ku-150 000 KwaZulu-Natal, abaswele izinto zokubathutha nsuku zonke zibayise ezikoleni ngenxa yezinkinga zemali ezibhekene noMnyango wezeMfundo esifundazweni.Lesi sikhalo sivezwe amalungu ePhalamende kulandela ukudedelwa kwezibalo zabafundi abaswele izinto zokubathutha.Embikweni othulelwe ikomiti leMfundo eyisiSekelo ePhalamende kuleli sonto, kuvele ukuthi bangu-233 000 abafundi abadinga izinto zokubathutha esifundazweni."Kodwa bangu-76 598 kuphela abafundi abahlomula ohlelweni lwezokuthutha esifundazweni. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abangu-156 402, abanazo izinto zokubayisa ezikoleni," kusho iPhini loMqondisi jikelele emnyangweni, uNksz Simone Geyer. Uthe inkinga yemali ebhekene nesifundazwe sebenesikhathi beyiveza njengengqinamba eyenza singandi isibalo sabafundi abathuthwayo.Ilungu le-DA ePhalamende, uNksz Ms Ciska Jordaan, likhale ngokuthi sincane isibalo sabafundi abathuthwayo esifundazweni.Lizwakalise ukukhathazeka ikakhulu emva kwengozi eyenzeke ngenyanga edlule eVaal, eGoli lapho kwashona khona abafundi abangu-13, ngesikhathi itekisi ababehamba ngayo ishayisana mahlanze neloli. Le ngozi yashaqisa noMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, kwahlatshwa nekhwelo lokuthi kuqiniswe imigomo ethinta ukuthuthwa kwabafundi.UNgqongqoshe womnyango, uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, ukhale ngesimo semali saseKZN esenze bangakwazi ukwandisa isibalo sabafundi abathuthwayo."Siyazi ngezinkinga ezibhekene nohlelo lokuthuthwa kwabafundi eKZN ngoba kudingeka silungiswe lesi simo kwandiswe isibalo sabafundi abathuthwayo. Sesike sayibika indaba yaseKZN, saze sangenelela saya khona ukuzama ukulungisa isimo," usho kanje. Iqembu i-Build One South Africa, linxuse uhulumeni ukuthi alungise izinkinga ukuze kwandiswe isibalo sabafundi abathuthwayo.Izikhulu zomnyango esifundazweni, zihlale zikucacisa ukuthi ukube imali ikhona ngabe baningi abafundi abahlomula ohlelweni lokuthutha.Khonamanjalo ikomiti lezemfundo esiShayamthetho, lisemkhankasweni wokuhlola izinto ezithutha abafundi. Leli komiti lihambele ezindaweni ezehlukene eNquthu, ukuhlola isimo samabhasi athwala abafundi.Ibamba likasihlalo wekomiti, uNksz Hlengiwe Mavimbela, lithe:"Sikhathazekile ngezingozi ezibandakanya abafundi yingakho sifuna ukubona uhlelo lokuthuthwa kwabafundi. Sibheka nesimo samabhasi athwala abafundi nsuku zonke."
UBENOMLANDO wokumhlukumeza umufi, owesilisa waseLovu, eThekwini osagcwele amathafa, osolwa ngokumbulala ngesihluku ngoLwesihlanu. Esigamekweni okuthiwa senzeke emqashweni kamufi, kugwazwe kwabulawa uNksz Snenhlanhla Mnqayi (26) waseNseleni, KwaMbonambi. Ngokusho kwesihlobo, uNksz Ntombi Cele, bezwe ngesigameko emva kokuthi umastende kamufi ehlabe umkhosi, wabiza umphakathi, izihlobo namaphoyisa. "Isigameko senzeke phambi kwengane kamufi yentombazane eneminyaka eyisihlanu, abehlala nayo,” kusho uNksz Cele.Uthe umufi ubenamanxeba amabili emahlombe nelilodwa esifubeni.Uthe esandleni isidumbu sakhe besisabambe iselula, kukhombisa ukuthi inombolo yokugcina abelokhu eyifonela umlibe eyamaphoyisa, nokuwakha isithombe sokuthi ufe ezama ukuthola usizo lwawo. Uthe bezwe ngomastende ukuthi ingxabano yabo ibiqale ngezikhathi zasemini, kwabuye kwaba sengathi iyaphela.Uthe bezwe ukuthi kuke kwezwakala kancane umsindo kodwa wabuye wathula, umsolwa wabonakala esephuma ngesango ehamba."Kuthiwa ubuye wabuya emva kwesikhathi, wama esangweni, wancenga uSne eside isikhathi ethi akamvulele, wagcina emvulela, kwaba wukuthi usephethe ummese amgwaze ngawo,” kusho uNksz Cele. Udalule ukuthi ubudlelwano bukamufi nomsolwa buqale phambi kwakhe ngo-2024, umsolwa elokhu efika endaweni (kaNksz Cele) yokucima ukoma, lapho ayeqashe khona umufi.Uthe zathi zibekwa nje, waba nodlame umsolwa kumufi."Wayevele amashaye nje kalula. Behlale bexabana, emshaya kuze kufe ngisho amawindi,” usho kanje. Uthe bese kukaningi bekhuluma nodadewabo, bezama ukumbonisa ukuthi lobu budlelwano buyingozi."Ubevele athi uyamthanda, akakwazi ukuhlukana naye. Bese ethi usazoshintsha,” usho kanje.Uthe ngesikhathi umndeni usubheka izingxoxo zabo kwiselula kamufi, nakhona kuvele ukuthi bebehlale bexabana. "Kokunye bebebanga ukungathembeki kukamsolwa, uSne kuthi uma embuza, amthembise ukumbhonya,” kusho uNksz Cele.Uqhube wathi kokunye bebebuye babange ukuthi ufuna umufi akhulelwe, yena (umufi) engayizwa kahle ngoba ebona ukuthi isimo emalini asihambi kahle. Uveze nokuthi umndeni ubuye wabona nokuthi umsolwa ubebuye afune ukuthi umufi amsize ngemali ngenkani, njengoba ebengumuntu obehlale ewathola amatoho.
BEKUZISHUBELE enkantolo izinkabi eziboshwe neNkosi Simphiwe Erick Zuma ecaleni lokubulawa kwekhansela le-DA kuMasipala waseMngeni, uMnuz Nhlalayenza Ndlovu, ngesikhathi zivelele elinye icala lokuqotha abantu abangu-10.UThabo Mathonsi Chonco noMnuz Thembelani Mbatha basolwe ngokubambezela ukuqulwa kwecala labo lokusoconga abantu bakwaMemela.Ijaji linqumele uChonco noMbatha ugwayi katiki ngesikhathi bevele eNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu, njengoba baboshelwa icala lokubulawa kwabantu bakwaMemela ababulawa elokishini eMbali, ngo-2023.UChonco noMbatha baboshwa eminyakeni emithathu eyedlule kepha ukuqulwa kwecala kulokhu kubambezeleka. Bekulindelwe ukuthi liqulwe kuleli sonto kodwa labuye lahlehliswa ngenxa yokuthi uChonco ucele isikhathi sokuba axoxe nabameli bakhe.Ngokuthola kweSolezwe, uChonco ubefuna ukulivuma icala kodwa kungathi ugcine engavumelananga nabameli bakhe.UChonco kuthiwa washintsha umqondo wafuna ukuvuma icala emva kokuba egwetshwe odilikajele kwelinye icala lokubulala abantu abahlanu kanti uvele usakuveza ukuthi uzolivuma icala lokubulala uNdlovu. Izolo uMbuso uzwakalise ukukhathazeka ngokubambezeleka kwecala.Umshushisi, uMnuz Attie Trutor, uthe bafuna ukuthi icala liqulwe ngokushesha."Kade sawaqala amalungiselelo ecala. Ngo-2024, kwaba nomhlangano lapho savumelana sonke ukuthi sesikulungele ukuqala kokuqulwa kwecala. Kuze kube namhlanje kulokhu kubambezeleka ukuqulwa kwecala. Kuningi okonakalayo ngokungaqulwa kwecala. Sinofakazi abangaphansi kohlelo lokuvikelwa okufanele silokhu siqhubekile nokubavikela. Lokhu kumosha imali."IJaji uNontuthuzelo Mlaba liyalele uChonco noMbatha ukuba balungise izinto zabo."Kufanele siqede ukuqula icala. Uma kukhona izinto okufanele nezixoxe nabameli benu kufanele nizixoxe manje khona kungeke kubambezeleke ukuqulwa kwecala."Icala lihlehliselwe u-Agasti 24, kuhlelwe ukuthi liqulwe kuze kube uSepthemba 18.Abameli bakaChonco noMbatha bathe bazokube sebekulungele ukuqulwa kwecala ngalezi zinsuku ezibekwe inkantolo.
ZIPHINDE zamphika izinto owayengumengameli, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, nenkampani yezikhali yaseFrance, iThales, emizamweni yabo yokuthi kuhoxiswe icala lenkohlakalo ababhekene nalo.UZuma neThales baphinde bahlangabezana nenye imbibizane yezomthetho izolo, ngesikhathi iNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu ichitha isicelo sabo sokuphonsela inselelo isinqumo senkantolo esachitha isicelo sabo sokuba kuhoxiswe icala.UZuma neThales bebefake isicelo sokuba banikwe imvume yokuphonsela inselelo isinqumo sangonyaka odlule, lapho inkantolo yanqaba ukuba kuhoxiswe icala labo elisukela esivumelwaneni sango-1999 sokuthengwa kwezikhali.UZuma neThales bafuna kuchithwe icala bekhala ngokuthi selibambezeleke isikhathi eside, kwaze kwashona nofakazi. Bebefuna ukuthi inkantolo ibanike imvume yokuthi baye eNkantolo yamaCala aDlulisiwe, lapho bebezofike baphonsele khona isinqumo senkantolo inselelo.IJaji Nkosinathi Chili lisichithile isicelo sikaZuma neThales.UChili uthe mancane amathuba okuthi isicelo sikaZuma neThales siphumelele eNkantolo yamaCala aDlulisiwe."Uma ngininikeza imvume yokuba nidlulisele phambili icala kufanele ngibheke ukuthi mangakanani amathuba okuthi enye inkantolo ifinyelele esinqumweni esehlukile. Emva kokulalela izethulo, kusobala ukuthi awekho amathuba okuthi isicelo sizofike siphumelele enkantolo elandelayo. Kulezi zathu enizibekile ngesikhathi nicela imvume yokudlulisa icala, asikho ngisho esisodwa esingenze ngabona kunesidingo sokuthi ngininike imvume."Kubukeka sengathi uZuma uzoqhubeka anikele eNkantolo yamaCala aDlulisiwe yize enqatshelwe imvume.Ummeli kaZuma, u-Advocate Nqaba Buthelezi, ucele ukuba banikezwe isinqumo senkantolo esinesigxivizo."Phambilini sike saba nenkinga uma sifika nesinqumo senkantolo esingenaso isigxivizo eNkantolo yamaCala aDlulisiwe."UChili usigodlile isinqumo esicelweni soMbuso sokuba icala liqhubeke noma kukhona izinqumo zenkantolo uZuma asaziphonsela inselelo.UChili uthe kukhona isicelo esifakwe eNkantolo yamaCala aDlulisiwe okufanele alinde isinqumo kusona ngaphambi kokuthi anqume kulolu daba.Icala libe selihlehliselwa u-Ephreli 24.Leli cala selibambezeleke iminyaka ecela kwengu-20.UZuma wamangalelwa okokuqala kuleli cala ngo-2006 kodwa labuye lahoxiswa.Ngo-2016 inkantolo yachitha isinqumo sango-2009 sokuhoxiswa kwamacala kaZuma.Kwabe sekuqala umdonsiswano wezomthetho okubalwa nemizamo kaZuma yokuba kuhoxiswe icala kanye neyokuhoxisa umshushisi omkhulu, u-Advocate Billy Downer.UZuma usolwa ngokwamukela intshontsho kwiThales eyahlomula ngesikhathi kuthengwa izikhali.
KUSHAYISANA imibono ngokuhoxa komholi we-DA embangweni wokuhola leli qembu engqungqutheleni ezoba ngo-Ephreli, kulo nyaka.Kukhona abamncomile ngokuthi ukwazile ukukhulisa iqembu uMnuz John Steenhuisen, omemezele ngokusemthethweni, ukuthi ngeke awungenele lo mbango, kwakhona abathi liphume nobomvu. Ekhuluma esithangamini sabezindaba eThekwini, uthe konke kufeziwe. Uthe ngeke angenele umbango wokuhola leli qembu ngoba ufuna ukugxila ekusizeni abalimi balwe nalesi samatele."Ngizofuqa umkhankaso wokugoma izilwane emuva kwalo mbhedukazwe. Kudingeka ngigxile kulo msebenzi odinga sonke isikhathi sami sonke ngakho ngeke ngikwazi ukugxila ekutheni ngilungiselele ukhetho lohulumeni basekhaya," usho kanje. Uzishaya isifuba ngemisebenzi ayenzile kuqokwa oNgqongqoshe namaPhini abo kuhulumeni wokubambisana kwamaqembu, i-GNU."Sikwazile ukubuyisa ukwesekwa kwe-DA emuva kokuba owayengumholi ashiya iqembu. Sikhulile nesibalo sabavoti sathola abangu-3.5 million, obekungokokuqala emlandweni we-DA." IMeya yedolobha iKapa, uMnuz Geordin Hill-Lewis oyimfivilithi ukuthi athathe isikhundla sikaSteenhuisen, umncomile ngomsebenzi omuhle nomlando awushiya kwi-DA.I-DA imbongile ngomsebenzi omuhle nomlando awushiyile.Okhulumela i-DA, uMnuz Jan de Villiers, uthe uzikhandlile lo mholi efaka i-DA kwi-GNU."I-DA ikhulile ngaphansi kobuholi bakhe. Ushiya nje ukuze agxile emsebenzini wakhe kahulumeni njengoba eseMnyangweni wezoLimo."Ne-DA KwaZulu-Natal okuyisifundazwe uSteenhusein aqhamuka kusona, ithe usebenzile lo mholi kusuka esahola ikhokhasi yaleli qembu kuMasipala weTheku."Ubelokhu eqhubeka nokukhankasela leli qembu ezindaweni ezehlukene esifundazweni. Siyaziqhenya ngaye nangomsebenzi omuhle awenzile," kusho i-DA esifundazweni.Nabanye abaholi okubalwa iMeya kaMasipala uMngeni, uMnuz Chris Pappas, bamthulele isigqoko uSteenhuisen. UDkt Dion George obeyinkukhu nempaka noSteenhuisen kuleli qembu, owasula esikhundleni sikaNgqongqoshe wezeMvelo, amaHlathi nokuDoba, uthe liphume nobomvu ngokuhamba kwalo mholi.UGeorge owasula eqenjini ngaphambi kokuba aqondise ubugwegwe ngokuthunaza isithunzi seqembu, uthe uSteenhuisen kumele asule nakuhulumeni ngoba uhlulwe umsebenzi.Nesikhulu esiphezulu se-AfriForum, uMnuz Kallie Kriel, sigxeke uSteenhuisen ngokuzibandakanya ne-ANC, alaxaze amaBhunu.UKriel ukhale ngokuthi uphambukile emigomweni ye-DA ezintweni ezithinta umthetho wezikole iBela kanjalo nangendlela asingethe ngayo udaba lwesifo samatele. "USteenhuisen udinga ukuhlonishwa ngomsebenzi omuhle awenzile eminyakeni eyisithupha edlule ehola leli qembu. Wathatha izintambo zokuhola esikhathini esasinzima, wakwazi ukubuyisa ukwesekwa kwe-DA. Wahlanganisa amaqembu aphikisayo emuva kokhetho lwango-2024, wawafaka kuhulumeni weGNU. Ushiya i-DA esimweni esihle kunangesikhathi ethatha izintambo ngo-2019," usho kanje ku-X. Wathatha izintambo kuDkt Mmusi Maimane, owasula kuleli qembu.
SITHUKA izanya isihlobo sababili okuthiwa babulawe ngesihluku abantu abangaziwa eMabedlana, KwaNyuswa, eHillcrest, ngeSonto.Kulesi sigameko kudutshulwe kwafa uNkk Cashile Majola (64) nedodana yakhe encane, uMnuz Lindokuhle Majola (31) besekhaya.Ngokusho komthombo ocele ukungadalulwa, izidumbu zabo zitholwe zidindilize egaraji, ngaphakathi endlini bekungagqekeziwe futhi kwangathathwa lutho. Uthe kukhombisa ukuthi abahlaseli bagasele abagilwa bengayivalile iminyango. Uveze ukuthi kukhombise ukuthi uNkk Majola ubewasha egaraji, indodana yakhe kubonakala sengathi ibilele egumbini layo kodwa kuvela ukuthi bayihudulile bayibulalela egaraji. Umthombo uqhuba uthe ngesikhathi kwenzeka isigameko, enye indodana kaNkk Majola, ibisesitolo sasekhaya esibude buduze nekhaya."Ufonelwe omakhelwane, abezwe kuduma izulu lezandla. Uphuthume khona esikhathini esingangemizuzu engu-10, wafica umndeni wakhe ubulewe ngesihluku, sekukhona nomphakathi,” kusho umthombo.Uqhube wathi ngesikhathi amaphoyisa esenze uphenyo endaweni yesigameko athole amagobolondo ezinhlamvu angu-18. UNkk Majola ubenamanxeba okudutshulwa amabili, kukhona inxeba elikwesingenhla kanjalo nasethangeni. Kwathi indodana yakhe yadutshulwa ekhanda, esifubeni nakwezinye izingxenye zomzimba ngezinhlamvu ezibalelwa kweziyisishiyagalombili. Umthombo udalule ukuthi ukhona abamsolayo ngesigameko, okuthiwa wasongela isihlobo esisindile ngesikhathi kunomhlangano ngokwebiwa kwezimbuzi endaweni ngoDisemba.Kuthiwa umhlangano waba khona emuva kokuthi kubanjwe abesilisa ababili ebese beziqedile izimbuzi zabantu endaweni. Kuvela ukuthi ngesikhathi umphakathi usabisa ngokubenzakalisa, bazikhalela ngelithi "malume khuluma iqiniso” bebhekise esihlotsheni sabo, okwavela ukuthi yiso esibathuma ukuthi bayokweba."Lona osindile wagcina eshaywa wuye lo malume, waphindiselela naye, kwathi sebelanyulwa, wasonga ngelithi ayiphelile,” kusho umthombo. Uthe wuye yedwa lona wesilisa ebebazi ukuthi unenkinga nalona osindile nomndeni wakhe.Uveze ukuthi okwenza bakhushukelwa wumoya emhlanganweni wukuthi nabo base bentshontshelwe izimbuzi ezibalelwa ku-25."Owesilisa uthukile ngokwenzekile, akazi ukuthi yena uphephe kangakanani njengoba abasolwa besagcwele amathafa. Uthuka kufanele ngoba kubulawe izihlobo zakhe, kwangathathwa ngisho nemali ebiphezu kwetafula, kukhombisa ukuthi bebefuna imiphefumulo yabafi kuphela,” kusho umthombo.

Isitatimende siqhuba sithi, ngesikhathi kwenzeka isigameko, umnikazi wesikhungo ubengekho, wagcina exhumana nomndeni ngocingo. "Ngokujwayelekile uma kwenzeke into efana nale, amaphoyisa aye enze uphenyo, bese eletha umbiko,” kusho isitatimende, esiqhube sathi uma sekuphothulwe uphenyo, kwaqedwa ngombiko wochwepheshe (forensic), yilapho isikhungo esizovumeleka khona ukuthi sisho ukuthi kwenzekeni. "Sicela ukunikwa ithuba njengoba sisosizini nomndeni,” sisho kanje isitatimende. Ngeledlule umthombo oyisihlobo esiseduze nodaba, uveze ukuthi umndeni ukubeke kwacaca ukuthi isidumbu sikamufi sasikhombisa ukuthi ushaywe ngezikhali ezithize. Uthe ekhanda ubethungiwe kukhombisa ukuthi ubenengozi evulekile, wadalula nokuthi emzimbeni wayenemivimbo ekhombisa ukuthi ubetalajwa. Utshele Isolezwe ukuthi kukhona isisebenzi sesikhungo esatshela umndeni ukuthi bashayiwe kade bezama ukweqa, yena wase eyashona. Waphinde waveza neyokuthi ngesikhathi unina kamufi ebizelwa esibhedlela okwakuthiwa umufi uphuthunyiswe kuso, abahlengikazi bamtshela ukuthi ufike esibhedlela esevele esethule.Umndeni awutholakalanga ukuba uphawule ngokushiwo yisitatimende sesikhungo.Amaphoyisa awakaze aphawule ngalolu daba phezu kokuba ayethunyeleliwe imibuzo.
IQEMBU elingababeki benkosi kuhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal, iNFP, lichithe isicelo somhlangano wawo wonke amaqembu ayingxenye kahulumeni wesifundazwe obizelwe ukuzobhunga ngodaba lokuhoxa kwayo iNFP kulo hulumeni owakhiwe amaqembu amane.I-NFP ithe ngeke ilubhade emhlanganweni ngenxa yokuthi kumenywe neqembu elihola uhulumeni wesifundazwe, i-IFP. Umhlangano obekuhlelwe ukuthi ube ngempelasonto, ubucelwe ubuholi be-DA.Ubuholi be-DA bebufuna ukuthi umhlangano uhanjelwe ngabaholi bawo onke amaqembu abusa ngokubambisana, i-IFP, ANC ne-NFP.Ubuholi be-DA bucele ukuba nalo mhlangano emva kokuhlangana nobuholi be-NFP emasontweni amabili edlule, lapho buxoxwe kabanzi ngesinqumo se-NFP sokuhoxa kuhulumeni wesifundazwe.I-NFP yahlala ne-ANC lapho kwakuxoxwa khona ngodaba olufanayo kodwa ayikaze ihlangane nobuholi be-IFP.UNobhala we-NFP obambile, uMnuz Sunset Xaba, uthe ngeke balubhade kulo mhlangano uma kuzokube kukhona nobuholi be-IFP.Lokhu ukusho encwadini lapho ebephendula khona isimemo se-DA.Kule ncwadi ebonwe yiSolezwe, uXaba uthe akubaphethe kahle ukuthi abaholi be-IFP abakaze bahlangane nabo yize sebehlanganile nabaholi bamanye amaqembu abusa ngokubambisana, wathi okunye okubakhathazayo ukuthi ubuholi be-IFP baveza ukuthi bufuna ukubamba umhlangano ne-EFF, ngenhloso yokuthi nayo ijoyine uhulumeni wesifundazwe."Ngesikhathi bekhuluma kwabezindaba, abaholi be-IFP bakhombisa ukuyithatha kancane indaba yokuhoxa kwe-NFP kuhulumeni wesifundazwe. Babeka sengathi ukuhoxa kwe-NFP akuwubeki engcupheni uhulumeni wesifundazwe. Izinkulumo zabo zikhombisa ukuthi basithatha kancane."Ngabe sikhombisa ukuthi asizazi ukuthi sifunani uma singase sivume ukuba ingxenye yomhlangano lapho kuzokube kukhona ubuholi be-IFP ekubeni singakaze sihlangane nabo eceleni abaholi be-IFP. Ingakho-ke sithathe isinqumo sokuthi ngeke size emhlanganweni ohlongozwayo."I-NFP ithathe isinqumo sokuhoxa kuhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal, ngenyanga eyedlule.Ubuholi be-NFP buphinde bayalela nelungu leqembu, uNksz Mbali Shinga, ukuba lisule esikhundleni sokuba uMphathiswa wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi.Kuze kube namhlanje uNksz Shinga akakaze asule esikhundleni.UNksz Shinga ubhekene nekomiti lokuqondiswa ubugwegwe.Ubizelwe phambi kwekomiti lokuqondiswa ubugwegwe emva kokuba eshaye indiva umyalelo weqembu wokuba aseke isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli.
UBUHOLI be-ANC KwaZulu-Natal abuhambisani nesiphakamiso seSilo, uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini, sokuba kushintshwe igama lesifundazwe iKwaZulu-Natal. Umgqugquzeli wethimba lesikhashana elihola i-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Mike Mabuyakhulu, uthe abasiboni isidingo sokuthi isifundazwe sibizwe ngeKwaZulu njengokuphakamisa kweMbube.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba eThekwini, izolo.IMbube isanda kuveza ukuthi isemkhankasweni wokuthi kushintshwe igama lesifundazwe.Yakuveza lokhu ngesikhathi yethula inkulumo eMkhosini waseSandlwana ngenyanga edlule.Amaqembu ezepolitiki, i-IFP neMKP, avele asephumele obala azwakalisa ukweseka isiphakamiso sokuba kushintshwe igama lesifundazwe.Kepha uMabuyakhulu uthe bona abasiboni isidingo sokuthi kushintshwe igama lesifundazwe."Thina njenge-ANC asinayo inkinga negama elikhona ngoba siyazi ukuthi kwavunyelwana ngalo ngesikhathi kunezingxoxo."UMabuyakhulu uthe udaba lokushintshwa kwesifundazwe ludinga ukuba kulandelwe umthetho."Akuqali ukuthi kube nesiphakamiso esinje. Udaba lolu oluthinta umthetho. Ngeke ukwazi ukushintsha igama lesifundazwe ngaphandle kokulandela umthetho. Thina umbono wethu ukuthi noma ngabe ubani ofuna ukuba kushintshwe igama lesifundazwe kufanele alandele imithetho. Ukushintshwa kwegama lesifundazwe akuyona into engenzeka ngenxa yokuthi kusho othile ukuthi ayenzeke. Uma kukhona owenza isiphakamiso sokuthi kushintshwe igama lesifundazwe elandela imigomo ebekiwe, siyoluxoxa lapho lolu daba."UMabuyakhulu unxuse ukuba kungasetshenziswa lolu daba ukuhlukanisa abantu."Siyazi ukuthi lolu udaba olunyakazisa abantu. Sinxusa abantu ukuthi bangasebenzisi lolu daba ukugovuza abantu. Thina sifisa ukuthi kuxoxwe ngezinto ezihlanganisa abantu, siyeke ukudlala ngemizwa yabantu."UMabuyakhulu usho kanjena nje, iMbube iveze ukuthi ayijiki esiphakamisweni sokuba kushintshwe igama lesifundazwe.Ikhuluma ngesikhathi kuphothulwa uMkhosi woSelwa ngoMsombuluko, iMbube ithe isamile ekutheni ifuna lishintshwe igama lesifundazwe.Isiphakamiso sokuthi kushintshwe igama lesifundazwe saqala senziwa yiSilo uGoodwill Zwelithini kaBhekuzulu ngo-2006.Kwaze kwaqoka ithimba longoti elalizoqhuba lolu daba kodwa isiphakamiso sagcina siphelela emoyeni.Ngaphambi kokhetho lokuqala olukhululekile ngo-1994, i-IFP yayivele ifuna ukuthi isifundazwe sibizwe ngeKwaZulu.Kodwa kwagcina kuvunyelwana ngoKwaZulu-Natal ngesikhathi kunezingxoxo.

Kunendlela esengiyitholile esingaphila ngayo ngaphandle kokuthi kumbiwe umhlabathi wethu."Isinqumo seSilo sibeka engcupheni ikusasa lenqwaba yezimayini ezisebenzela kwelikaMthaniya.Lapha KwaZulu-Natal kunenqwaba yezimayini ezisezindaweni ezingaphansi kwesikhwama esigade umhlaba kaZulu, iNgonyama Trust.Izimayini ezisengxenyeni zesifundazwe kubalwa uMtubatuba, Richard's Bay, Melmoth, Nongoma, Vryheid, nezinye.INdlulamithi yamaKhosi ithe iqhinga layo lizokwelekelela wonke uZulu."Ngiyanithembisa Zulu ukuthi ngesikhathi sami nizophila kangcono futhi nizophumelela."IMbube ithe kunobungozi ebubonayo obunyonyobela uZulu."Kukhona okungathi kuyasinyonyobela noma kuyanyelela. Angisabulali ubuthongo. Kufanele sivule amehlo. Angeke sisayilwa ngomkhonto manje. Kunendlela yesimanje esizoyolivikela ngayo leli lizwe."IMbube ithe izimisele ukuyilwa eyezimayini."Njengoba sikade sikhuluma nje eSandlwana indaba yokuthi ake kususwe uNatal, besikhuluma izindaba zaKwaZulu. Izwe laKwaZulu leli. Sizoyibamba lapho nina beSilo, sibambisane. Isikhathi sethu lesi sokuthi silungise. Makhosi qinani kakhulu kunakuqala. Bambelelani kimi, ngiyingelosi ethunyelwe lapha ukuba izogada impilo yenu."ISilo siphinde sancoma ukuhamba kahle koMkhosi woSelwa.Umkhosi waqala ngonyaka owedlule njengoba uze waphothulwa ngoMsombuluko ebusuku.IMbube ithe umkhosi uphumelele yize bekukhona abebebophe izibopho, befuna umkhosi ungaphumeleli."Lo msebenzi ubungelula neze. Kuyenzeka kwesinye isikhathi abantu babophe amafindo ukuze ungaphumeleli. Ukungaphumeleli kwawo kusho ukucima kweNgonyama, lokhu esingakudingi. Kusihambele kahle, umkhuleko uhambe kahle."IMbube ithe kuningi ezokhuluma ngakho njengoba usudlulile umkhosi."Sesingaqala ke manje ukusebenza. Siyasebenza manje, ayisekho ingubo esivale umlomo. Umbhedo, umbhedo manje."
UMUSA Mseleku useveze ukuthi wonke umuntu uzovela obala ngokuthi wayehloseni ngokwakha umndeni wakhe kwisizini entsha yohlelo, uThando Nesithembu eqale izolo.Ababukeli bohlelo bese bemagange ngokuqala kwalo njengoba lisuke lahlala ngesizini entsha ezokhonjiswa kabili ngesonto, ngoLwesithathu nangoLwesine ngo-8 ebusuku.Ekhuluma neSolezwe, uMseleku uthe kule sizini umuntu ngamunye kuzobonakala ukuthi yini abeyicabanga yonke le minyaka ngokwakha umuzi wakwaMseleku."Kuzocaca bha kulezi ziqephu ezizayo ukuthi wonke umuntu umiphi ngekusasa lakhe emndenini wakwaMseleku. Yisizini lena abantu abazoqhubeka bayijabulele ngenxa yokuthi iyaqhubeka nokuveza izingqinamba umuntu abhekane nazo. Mina ngiyaziqhenya ngokuhlanganisa umndeni wami senze lolu hlelo, ngoba siveze ukuthi siphila kanjani. Abantu okumele bakwazi uma befuna ukwenza izinhlelo zethelevishini wukuthi akumele bagqamise impilo ephezulu abayiphilayo kodwa abaveze okwenzeka emindenini yabo bayeke nokujaha udumo," kusho uMseleku.Uthe ngalolu hlelo babengazi ukuthi bazofinyelela lapho bekhona manje, kodwa ngenxa yothando lwabantu bakuleli bafinyelele emaphusheni abo."Siyathobeka kakhulu ngothando abantu abasikhombise lona. Noma zingekho izindondo esisazitholile ngohlelo, kodwa nje ukuthi sifinyelele kwisizini yesishiyagalombili mina engangicabanga ukuthi amathathu ayoba maningi, kumina nje lokho kuwumhlomulo omkhulu. Akugcini lapho ngoba noMzansi Magic ubalalelile abantu uma befuna ukuthi zande iziqephu ezikhonjiswa ngesonto njengoba sekuqalile ukwenzeka lokho, nokukhombisa ukuthi nabo bayabalalela abantu," kuchaza yena.Uthe okunye abalandeli abazokubona wukuthi ukuphi nesimo sempilo yakhe, eke yacikizela yaphinde yamkhombisa ukuthi uma engasekho umuzi wakhe uyosala ube njani.Uthe abantu bamkhombise uthando olukhulu egula nabengacabangi ukuthi uthinte abantu abangakanani ngempilo yakhe nabona kuyinto emsebenzele.Ebuzwa ukuthi uphokophelephi ngokuqhubeka ekhiqiza izinhlelo zethelevishini njengoba ngaphandle kwezomndeni wakhe usanda kuba wuphrojusa wohlelo olubheka umndeni wakwaXaba, nalo oluthandwa abaningi, uMseleku uthe uzimisele ngokusebenza nabantu inqobo nje uma bezoveza lokhu akholelwa wukuthi kuzodonsa amehlo abantu, kungajahwa udumo nemali."Ababukeli bafuna ukubona izinto ezenzeka ngempela emindenini ehlukene kuleli, ngakho uma befuna ukuya kwithelevishini abangagqamisi impilo ephezulu abayiphilayo, abasinike izinto ezihlukene ababhekana nazo ezinhle nezimbi," kusho yena.
IZOQHWAKELA esihlalweni ngoLwesihlanu, iMeya kaMasipala waseMpendle, obusuhlale izinyanga eziyisithupha ungenayo imeya.Lezi zindaba zimenyezelwe umgqugquzeli wethimba lesikhashana elihola i-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Mike Mabuyakhulu.UMasipala waseMpendle usuhlale isikhathi eside ungenayo imeya kulandelwa ukususwa kukaMnuz Buyisani Mlaba, owakhishwa ngevoti lokungabethembi ubuholi bakhe.Imizamo yokuqoka imeya entsha yabhuntsha ngenxa yombango wangaphakathi kwi-ANC.UMabuyakhulu uveze ukuthi sebevumelene ngokuthi kufanele kuqokwe imeya entsha ngoLwesihlanu."Sibheke ukuthi imenenja yomkhandlu ibize umhlangano oyisipesheli, lapho kuzokhethwa khona imeya entsha kanye nosomlomo."UMabuyakhulu uveze ukuthi uSomlomo womkhandlu, uMnuz Sizwe Ndlela, naye wesulile esikhundleni.UNdlela usule esikhundleni ukuze aphendlele isikhala imeya entsha. Imeya entsha ayilona ikhansela, nokuphoqe ukuba kube khona ikhansela elisulayo ukuze izokwazi ukungena.UMabuyakhulu uxolisile ebantwini baseMpendle ngokuthatha isikhathi eside kohlelo lokuqokwa kwemeya entsha."Bekungafanele ukuba kuthathe isikhathi eside kangaka ukuba kuqokwe imeya entsha."Amagama amathathu abesembangweni wesikhundla sobumeya; elaloyo owalahlwa amacala okubulala amalungu e-IFP, uMnuz Russel Ngubo; owayeyimeya yomkhandlu, uNksz Sizakele Makhaye noNksz Nonjabulo Ndlovu.UMabuyakhulu uphide washayela ihlombe isinqumo senkantolo esichithe ukuqokwa kweMeya kaMasipala wesiFunda Amajuba, uMnuz Thembelihle Mthembu.INkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu ngeledlule ichithe umhlangano okwaqokwa kuwo uMthembu.UMabuyakhulu uthe kade babesho ukuthi akuzange kulandelwe imigomo ngesikhathi kubanjwe umhlangano okwagaxwa kuwo uMthembu amaketango obumeya.Isinqumo senkantolo sisho ukuthi uMthembu uzobuyela esikhundleni sokuba iPhini lemeya abekade evele esiphethe.Umasipala uthe uMthembu uzobamba kwesobumeya kuze kube kuqokwa imeya entsha.
UBESANDA kuphuma ejele ngoshwele ngecala lokubulala ayegwetshelwe owesilisa okuthiwa uklabhe wabulala izelamani ezintathu eLulwane, eManguzi, ngoMgqibelo.Lona wesilisa kuthiwa uboshwe ngeSonto ntambama, emuva kokubaleka eqeda ukwenza lesi sigameko esinyantisa igazi. Ababulewe ngesihluku esisabekayo ngoKwanele Gumede (15), Ayabonga Khumalo (7) no-Amanda Khumalo (9).Ngokusho kukamkhulu walezi zingane, uMnuz Jobe Khumalo - noma kungacaci ukuthi bekubangwani - impi ibiphakathi kukababa wazo nomsolwa. "Okwamanje akucaci ukuthi ngempela bekubangwani, akekho ofuna ukusitshela njengomndeni ukuthi yini eholele kulesi sigameko. Umnakwabo kayise wezingane owenze lesi sigameko, baqonywe yizingane zandawonye ezilamanayo. Akwenzile kusizwise ubuhlungu obukhulu njengoba endlini la alimazele khona izingane igazi belikhiwa ngendishi ngendlela ebeliliningi ngayo. Zonke izimpahla bezigcwele igazi, abantu besaba nokungena endlini ngenxa yesimo izingane ebesiyizona," kusho uKhumalo.Uveze ukuthi unina walezi zingane uhlukumezeke kakhulu ngalesi sigameko, nabo bengumndeni basadinga izimpendulo. "Kwayena siyafuna ukukhuluma naye ukuzwa ukuthi bekwenzenjani? Umama wezingane naye akukho okutheni akuchazayo njengoba esho ukuthi wayengekho eyobheka ibhizinisi lakhe elincane alenzayo, izingane wazishiya zodwa. Kuthe uma ebuya kula azithele khona phezu kwezingane sezishonile. Ukube ubaficile abazali balezi zingane asingabazi ukuthi nabo ngabe ubenze isilo sengubo. Ubulala izingane nje, ingoba ubefuna ukubazwisa ubuhlungu, hhayi ngoba ebefuna zona," kubeka uKhumalo.IMeya yaseMkhanyakude, uMnuz Sphile Mdaka, ihambele kulo mndeni nala iveze khona ukuthi izigameko ezifana nalezi, kumele zisheshe zisukunyelwe njengoba kusaqhubeka khona ukuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane. Uthe amaphoyisa awaqinise ingalo yomthetho, usheshe ubabophe abantu abenze izigameko ezifana nalezi."Lo muntu owenze lesi sihluku nginemibuzo ukuthi uqale wakwenza kanjani lokhu, uzibulale kanjani zonke ebuka, yena wangaba nozwela? Elinjani leli dimoni ebelimngenile? Sizwa ubuhlungu kakhulu kungakho silana njengobuholi bonke ukuzohlanganisa amehlo nomndeni njengoba usidinga. Siyacela ukuthi amaphoyisa aqaphe umphakathi njengoba sesitholile ukuthi umuzi womsolwa nawo ushisiwe," kusho uMdaka.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe umsolwa uboshiwe wavela enkantolo izolo.
KUYAYISHUBELA iNhloko yoKlebe KwaZulu-Natal, uMajor General Lesetja Senona, esolwa ngokusebenzisana nosomabhizinisi obhekene noxhaxha lwamacala, uMnuz Vusimizi "Cat" Matlala, okuvela ukuthi ukhishwe ngoshova ehhovisi.Imibiko yabezindaba iveze ukuthi uSenona ukhishwe ngoshova ehhovisi lakhe, waphucwa iselula yakhe nezinye izinsiza zezobuchwepheshe.Imibiko ithe uSenona uphucwe izinsiza zakhe ngamaphoyisa aKwaZulu-Natal.Kuthiwa uSenona utshelwe ukuthi angabe eseza ehhovisi lakhe ngenxa yokuthi uyaphenywa, lo myalelo kuthiwa ukhishwe nguKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe uSenona uzicelele yena ukuhamba ehhovisi.UNetshiunda uthe uSenona ucele ukuhamba ehhovisi emva kokuba amaphoyisa embuze ngezinto ezisolisayo afike wazenza enhloko yamahhovisi amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal.USenona onehhovisi ekomkhulu lamaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uNetshiunda uveze ukuthi unendawo yakhe yokupaka engaphakathi emahhovisi.UNetshiunda uveze ukuthi ngesikhathi uSenona efika emahhovisi ngoMgqibelo, ufike wamisa imoto ngaphandle, wangayipaka ngaphakathi endaweni yakhe. Uthe uNetshiunda wafike waxoxa isikhathi esilinganiselwa emizuzwini engu-45 nelinye iphoyisa emotweni.UNetshiunda uthe uSenona uze wangena ngesikade ehhovisi, wafike akangasayina ngesikhathi engena esangweni."Umthetho uthi bonke abangenayo ehhovisi ngempelasonto, kufanele basayine."UNetshiunda uthe amaphoyisa abe esebikela uMkhwanazi ngale zinto ezisolisayo ezenziwe uSenona.UNetshiunda uthe uMkhwanazi ube esejuba amaphoyisa ukuba ayombuza uSenona."Uyena okhethe ukuhamba."UNetshiunda uthe umphathi kaSenona utsheliwe ukuba athumele umuntu ozolanda okhiye abashiye emaphoyiseni abethunywe ukuba azompheka ngemibuzo.USenona uzwakalise ukukhathazeka ngokuthi atshelwe ukuba engabe eseza emsebenzini ekubeni engakaze ayithole incwadi emumisayo, wathi usabela impilo yakhe.OKlebe bathe uSenona akamisiwe emsebenzini. Ngedlule uSenona uveze ukuthi kunezinhlelo zokuthi amiswe emsebenzini.USenona uthe abaphathi bakhe bambhalele incwadi bemazisa ukuthi uzothathelwa izinyathelo nokuthi uzoshintshelwa kwesinye isikhundla. Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi evele phambi kwekhomishini ephenya izinsolo ezenziwa uMkhwanazi.Ngesikhathi evele phambi kwekhomishini, uSenona uphekwe ngebhodwe elincane, ebuzwa ngobudlelwano bakhe noMatlala.Imiyalezo evezwe phambi kwekhomishini iveze ukuthi uSenona noMatlala bebexhumana kakhulu, ethumela uMatlala imininingwane ebucayi. Phakathi kwezinto uSenona azithumela uMatlala, kubalwa umbiko onemininingwane kaMkhwanazi namanye amaphoyisa ayephenya uMatlala.UMatlala naye wayebuye athumele uSenona imininingwane ebucayi okukhona kuyo enemininingwane kaMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa nekaNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa omisiwe, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu. Kuphinde kwavela nokuthi indodana kaSenona, uMnuz Thato Senona, isebenzisana noMatlala kwezamabhizinisi.USenona uthe wayengazi ukuthi uMatlala uthinteka emacaleni abucayi, wathi ubesefuna ukuziqhelelanisa naye njengoba bese kuvele ukuthi uthinteka emacaleni amaningi.
AKUMELE luphathwe ngokuxhamazela udaba lwabafundi bangaphandle kwaseNingizimu Afrika abafunda ezikoleni zakuleli kodwa kunalokho kumele luphathwe ngobukhulu ubunono lobu.Lokhu kushiwo yiPhini likaNgqongqoshe loMnyango wezeMisebenzi yoMphakathi neNgqalasizinda kuleli, uMnuz Sihle Zikalala.Ubekade eyisikhulumi sosuku emcimbini omkhulu wokuklonyeliswa kwabafundi abenze kahle kakhulu ka-matric wanyakenye, esifundeni iLembe. Umcimbi ubukade usehholo lomphakathi laKwaMaphumulo ngempelasonto.UZikalala uthe ukubonile ukuxokozela obekwenzeka esikoleni i-Addington eThekwini, wathi lolu udaba lubucayi okumele lusingathwe ngokucophelela okukhulu ukuze kungeke kuze konakale izinto eziningi.''Ngikholwa ukuthi lolu akulona udaba olungavele lukhulunywe nje luphele ngosuku olulodwa. Ludinga ukuba luphathwe ngokukhulu ukucophelela lokhu ukuze kungeke kube khona izinto ezonakalayo," usho kanjena.UZikalala ukhuluma kanjena nje, kuke kwashuba kulesi sikole njengoba bekunemibhikisho ngaphandle kwaso, abaseNingizimu Afrika bebhodla umlilo bekhala ngokusala ngaphandle kwezingane zabo ekubeni ezokufika zibe zizitholile izikhala zokufunda. Lo mbhikisho oqhubeke izinsuku, ubuholwa ngabeMarch in March abaholwa nguNkk Jacinta Ngobese-Zuma. UNkk Ngobese-Zuma ekhuluma nabezindaba, ukuzwakalise kaningi ukuthi abaneme ngokuvalelwa ngaphandle kwezingane zakuleli, wathembisa ukuthi bazokwenza konke okusemandleni abo ngenhloso yokuqinisekisa ukuthi siyatholakala isixazululo sale ngwadla. Nebala bagcine benqobile njengoba kuze kwahambela uMphathiswa wezeMfundo eKZN, uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka, ofike kulesi sikole ngeledlule abafundi abebeshiywe ngaphandle bathola izikhala.Mayelana nokwenza kahle kwesifunda iLembe emiphumeleni ka-matric, uZikalala uthe uyaziqhenya kakhulu ngendlela abafundi bakulezi zikole abenze kahle ngakhona.''Kuyinto ejabulisayo kakhulu ukubona abafundi bethu benza kahle kangaka. Siyafuna ukubona isifunda iLembe sidlondlobala kakhulu uma kukhulunywa ngodaba lwezemfundo,'' usho kanjena.Uthe badinga ukuchonywa uphaphe lwegwalagwala bonke othisha bezikole abenze isiqiniseko sokuthi konke kubonakala kuhamba ngendlela efanele emiphumeleni ka-matric ka-2025.IMeya yeLembe, uMnuz Thobani Shandu, ithe bahlabeke umxhwele ngendlela lesi sifunda esenze kahle ngayo. Lokhu uthe bayazigqaja kakhulu ngakho.Lo mcimbi uphethe ngokuthi kuklonyeliswe bonke abafundi bakulesi sifunda abenze kahle ezifundweni zabo.
UNGOTI ubona sengathi ingebhe yokuvaleka kompompi benkohlakalo iyona eyenza ukuthi abaholi bomasipala bagoloze uma uhulumeni wesifundazwe uzama ukungenelela.Umhlaziyi wezepolitiki waseNyuvesi yaKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Zakhele Ndlovu, uthe abaholi bomasipala basuke benqaba ukungenelela kukahulumeni wesifundazwe ngoba nakhu besabela ukuthi bazophazamiseka ekukhwabaniseni imali yemikhandlu.UMphathiswa wezeziMali KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Francois Rodgers, usanda kubalisa ngokuthi omasipala abaningi abakhungethwe izinkinga bayalunqaba usizo loMnyango wakhe.URodgers uthe omasipala okukhona kubo abeziFunda; uMkhanyakude, Amajuba noGu, basanda kunqaba ukungenelela koMnyango nokwaphoqa ukuthi kuze kuhoxiswe amathimba.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi kuke kwanomsindo ngesikhathi uMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana kanye neziNdaba zoMdabu uzama ukungenelela koMasipala okubalwa kubo iTheku noMsunduzi.UNdlovu uthe laba abanqaba ukungenelela kukahulumeni wesifundazwe bayabona ukuthi liyabashonela."Inkinga enkulu abantu bayabona ukuthi le nto yokuntshontsha nokuganga isiya ngasekugcineni, sebebona engathi siyaphela isikhathi sokuntshontsha. Ingakho begoloza uma kungenelela uhulumeni wesifundazwe ngoba bayabona ukuthi bazophazamiseka. Abantu bayabona ukuthi ithuba lokugcina lokuntshontsha ngeke besalithola elinye, ikakhulukazi njengoba kuza nokhetho lohulumeni basekhaya. Akekho umuntu onesiqiniseko sokuthi uzobuyela esikhundleni emva kokhetho."UNdlovu uthe okunye okutatazelisa abaholi bemikhandlu ukuthi uMnyango wezeziMali lapha esifundazweni uphethwe yi-DA, wathi lokhu kwenza ukuthi abaholi bemikhandlu bengafuni nokuthi izikhulu zoMnyango zize zisondele eduze."Abantu babuka ukuthi lo mlungu engathi unokuyigada kakhulu imali. Ingakho bavele bagxume kakhulu uma uMnyango kaRodgers usondela."UNdlovu uthe kwesinye isikhathi kuba ukuthi izikhulu zomasipala zisuke zibuke ukuthi iminyango kahulumeni ezama ukungenelela iphethwe wumholi oqhamuka eqenjini eliyizimbangi.Iminyango ejwayele ukungenelela uma kunezinkinga owezeziMali nowezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu. OwezeziMali uphethwe yilungu le-DA kanti owezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu wona uphethwe yilungu le-IFP, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi."UButhelezi uke wazama ukungenelela komasipala abaphethwe yi-ANC, kwasuka umsindo. Abaholi bomasipala bayanqaba uma kungenelela uMnyango ophethwe umuntu oqhamuka kwelinye iqembu ngoba basuke benenkolelo yokuthi uzobacekela phansi. Into exakayo ukuthi la maqembu aphethe ngokubambisana kuhulumeni wesifundazwe."
IBIPHUMA ingena ezinkantolo izolo inkabi eboshwe neNkosi Simphiwe Erick Zuma ecaleni lokubulawa kowayeyikhansela le-DA kuMasipala waseMngeni, uMnuz Nhlalayenza Ndlovu.Umsocongi, uThabo Chonco, okuthiwa wakha itulo lokuqeda ngoNdlovu esejele, uvele ezinkantolo ezimbili izolo lapho ebebhekene namacala amathathu okubulala.UChonco uqale wavela kafishane eNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu lapho ebebhekene necala lokubulala abantu abangu-10.Kuleli cala uChonco usolwa ngokuba ungqondongqondo ecaleni lokubulawa kwabantu bakwaMemela.Abantu bakwaMemela babulawa ngo-2023, elokishini eMbali, eMgungundlovu.Leli cala lihlehliselwe ikusasa.Uphinde wadlulela eNkantolo yesiFunda eMgungundlovu, lapho ebhekene khona necala lokubulala uNdlovu kanye nelinye lokubulala owayelwa nokudayiswa komhlaba eMpophomeni, uMnuz Xolani Ntombela/Ndlovu.Amacala amabili abhekene noChonco abequlwa eNkantolo yeMantshi eHowick, adluliselwe kweyesifunda ngeledlule.Ngesikhathi evele eHowick, uChonco wakuveza ukuthi ufuna ukulivuma icala lokubulala uNdlovu.Bekungokokuqala ukuba avele enkantolo yesifunda. Amacala ahlehliselwe uFebhuwari 20.UChonco usanda kugwetshwa odilikajele abahlanu ngecala lokuqotha abantu eBulwer.Waphinde wagwetshwa iminyaka engu-15 ebhadla ejele ngecala lokubamba inkunzi.Izolo uChonco ufike enkantolo ekinatelwe ngozankosi kanye namaketango elinye ebeliboshelwe okhalweni. Ubekakwe ojele abebehlome bephelele.Inkosi nayo ivele kafishane enkantolo yesifunda izolo.Amacala ayo ahlehliselwe uFebhuwari 20.Inkosi ibhekene namacala amathathu. Imangalelwe noChonco ecaleni lokubulawa kukaNdlovu kanye nelokubulawa kukaNtombela/Ndlovu.Inkosi iphinde ibhekane necala lokubulala owayengundunankulu wesizwe sakwaNxamalala, uMnuz Qalokunye Zuma.Inkosi yanqatshelwa ibheyili ecaleni lokubulawa kukaNdlovu, isihlale ezikhindini isikhathi esingaphezu kwezinyanga eziyisithupha.Bekugcwele phama enkantolo izolo, abantu befuna ukuzozibonela ukuqhubeka kwecala.Abantu abebesenkantolo abomndeni wakwaNdlovu, abakwaZuma kanye namalungu eDA.Abanye abasolwa ababoshwe kanye nenkosi abazange babonakale enkantolo izolo.Inkosi iboshwe noMnuz Thobani Masobho Hlongwa, noKhayelihle Shabalala ecaleni lokubulawa kukaNdlovu.Iboshwe noMnuz Thembelani Mbatha ecaleni lokubulawa kukaNtombela/Ndlovu.
ZIPHINDE zaqala phansi zagcwala amehlo izinyembezi emndenini wowesilisa KwaNzimakwe, ePort Shepstone, okuthiwa wabulawa ngesihluku ngo-Okthoba nyakenye, kulandela ukuboshwa kwabesilisa ababili abaziwayo eGoli, abasolwa ngokumbulala. UMlondi Jula (23) owayegcine ukubonwa ephila ngesikhathi ehamba nabasolwa ngo-Okthoba 22 2025, watholwa eCentocow, eCreighton, eduze komfula uMzimkhulu ngo-Okthoba 29 2025. Eduze kwesidumbu sakhe kwakukhona izimbuzi ezimbili nazo ezazibulewe, kanjalo namakhandlela. Isidumbu sakhe sasigcwele amanxeba okugwazwa umzimba wonke, sinanezindawo ezikhombisa ukuthi ucwiyiwe. Ngesikhathi ehamba ekhaya, wayetshele umndeni wakhe ukuthi usaphelezela omakhelwane, ababefuna imoto eyayizobahambisa emfuleni ukuyogeza. Emva kwalokho, akabange esabuya ekhaya, nabo abasolwa akabange besabuya endaweni, bebeka izaba ezehlukene. Imoto kamufi yagcina itholwa emuntwini wendawo ngasemfuleni ngaphambi kokuthi kutholwe isidumbu. Lowo muntu wendawo wathi ubizwe ngabasolwa bethi akazobadonsisa yona ngoba ibhajwe kade beyogeza. Ngaleso sikhathi abazange bayiphathe eyokuthi imoto ngekamufi. Kwathi sekubhekisiswa ngasemfuleni, satholakala isidumbu sakhe. Udadewabo kamufi, uNksz Noluthando "Thuwe” Jula ekhuluma neSolezwe izolo, uthe bajabule uhhafu ngokuboshwa kwabasolwa njengoba kubuyise usizi kwabanye bomndeni."Ngithe ngimbikela ubaba ukuthi amaphoyisa athi sebeboshiwe abasolwa, wathi mntanami ngizwa kugcwala izinyembezi emehlweni,” kusho uNksz Jula.Uthe bajabule ngokuthi abasolwa bagcine beboshiwe lapho bese bebhace khona, wathi nokho bona bafisa ukuthi bake banikwe isikhathi sokuthi bahlale nabo phansi, bagonyuluke ngokuthi kungani bakhetha ukumenzakalisa ngesihluku esinje ekubeni bengomakhelwane? "Okusizwisa ubuhlungu ngayo yonke le nto ukuthi akubona abantu esingabazi, abantu abakhulele phambi kwethu, siyabazi. Okudale ukuthi bambulale ngesihluku esinje namanje asikwazi. Siyafisa basichazele. Ukuma kwabo ebhokisini enkantolo, bephendula leyo mibuzo embalwa ngeke kwanele kithina ukuthi sithobeke amanxeba,” kusho uNksz Jula.Udalule ukuthi kwenzeka konke lokhu nje, unina sewaphila ngamaphilisi okhwantalala kulandela ukuhluleka ukumelana nokudlula kwendodana yakhe ngesihlungu.Uthe banethemba lokuthi njengoba sebebanjiwe, umthetho uzosebenza, umndeni ubuthole ubulungiswa. KUBE wusizi emndenini wakwaMnyango eCinci, eMfolozi, injabulo yokuthi kuzoba nomcimbi omcncane ekhaya, iphenduka imvula yezinyembezi njengoba kubhubhe izihlobo eziyisithupha engozini yomgwaqo.Le ngozi ebiphakathi kweloli nemoto ebihamba abagilwa yenzeke emgwaqweni uN2, uma udlula eManandini, eMtubatuba, ngoLwesihlanu ebusuku.Bayisihlanu abadlulele esigamekweni, kwathi owesithupha wadlulela esibhedlela KwaHlabisa. Kwababhubhile kukhona uMnuz Vuyani Gcaleka (43), Nkk Nokuphakama Mnyango (85), Nksz Nkosingiphile Mnyango (53), Nksz Senamile Buthelezi (29), ingane yentombazane u-Ayanda Mthembu (12) nengane yomfana uLubanzi Buthelezi (5). U-Ayanda wuye oshonele esibhedlela abephuthunyiswe kuso. Isolezwe lithole ukuthi enye ingane, uSibani Buthelezi (11) abephuthunyiswe naye kulesi sibhedlela, yedluliselwe kwesaseNgwelezane. Umfowabo kaVuyani, uMnuz Lindani Gcaleka, uthe ingozi yehle abakubo besuka ekhaya elikhulu eCinci, belibangise eMfekayi, lapho unina ebezokwenza khona itiye. "Basuke ekhaya elikhulu behamba ngezimoto ezimbili, beshiyana. Eyehlelwe yingozi ibishayelwa uVuyani, kuthi ebone umonakalo, ishayelwa umkakhe,” kusho uGcaleka, othe lezi zimoto bezishiyana ngebanga elinde, kwazise bekungekho ukukhathazeka kokuthi kukhona ongayazi indlela yalapho obekuyiwa khona.Uthe imoto yesibili iyibonile ingozi ebinyantisa igazi eyidlule eManandini kodwa ebebephakathi banganaka."Baqale ukwethuka uma sebefonela ekhaya lapho obekuyiwa khona, bebuza ukuthi sebefikile yini oVuyani, kwathiwa abakafiki. Bethukile, becabanga ukuthi akukwazi ukuthi ngabe namanje abakafiki ekhaya abantu ebebebashiya ngebanga elide kangaka,” kusho uGcaleka. Uthe babe sebethatha isinqumo sokuthi bajike babuyele emuva, bayobheka le ngozi abayedlule eManandini, nebala bathola ukuthi impela yibo. Uthe ingozi ibabulele bephila bewumndeni, wathi ibehle ngaphezulu njengoba kudlule inqwaba engaka ekubeni umndeni ubuzimisele ngokuyojabula, uhlangana etiyeni.Ukhale ngokuthi bafe olwembiza ngazo zonke izihlobo ezidlulile, waveza ukuthi uVuyani ubeyinsika yomndeni, evuse ikhaya kukubi. "Silimele kakhulu siwumndeni,” kusho uGcaleka obezwakala ukuthi akukhulumeki.Uthe kabanawo amandla okuthwala wonke umsebenzi wokufihla ngesizotha abantu abaningi kangaka bewumndeni, wathi nanoma iluphi usizo abangaluthola, lungenza omkhulu umehluko.Kwenzeka le ngozi nje, ngoLwesine, bekukade kubatshazwa enye enyantisa igazi eyenzeke phakathi kwetekisi neloli, eLotus Park, eSipingo, eThekwini. Kuyona kudlule abangu-14, kwalimala kanzima abayisishiyagalombili. UMnyango wezokuThutha KwaZulu-Natal nethimba elithunyelwe nguMphathiswa uMnuz Siboniso Duma, lihambe layohlanganisa amehlo nomndeni izolo.
UMREPHA wodumo lwengoma ethi Imali Eningi, uSiyabonga "Big Zulu" Nene, ukhuza udlambedlu kubaculi bakamaskandi kulandela ukuvela kwengxabano eyaqubuka phakathi kwabo ngo-2023.Kuleli sonto kuvele okushaqisayo ngokwaholela ekubhidlikeni kweqembu lebhola labaculi bakamaskandi, iMaskandi FC. Kukhona abadalule ukuthi ngesikhathi omaskanda bekhishwa emqhudelwaneni weJammin To Soccer ezinkundleni zaseTsakane ngoJulayi 2024, bafika ezindlini zokushintshela baxabana kabi kangangoba kwaze kwathukwana, kwanukwana futhi kwakhishelwana nezibhamu. Kubuye kwavela nezindaba zokuthi umculi kamaskandi uKhwezi "Smomoza" Mkhize wayeyinkukhu nempaka noMalahle Sibiya emuva kokuba elale no"mfazi" wakhe. UBig Zulu uqale ngokuxolisa ngokugxambukela ezindabeni zeqembu lebhola likamaskandi ekubeni yena ekwele-hip hop maqede wathi kufanele abantu bazi ukuthi ebholeni kuyenzeka abantu banyukelwe wumoya enkundleni. "Kuyenzeka ukuthi kuphakame umoya enkundleni, ningaboni ngaso linye. Yinto ekhona, nami ngaphambana nabanye abadlali njengomfwethu uDumi (Mkokstad) kodwa ngoba kwakuyinto yebhola, ngabuye ngaxolisa. Impilo iyaqhubeka." UBig Zulu uthe kusuke kungeyona inzondo yeqiniso. "Bafowethu ibiyinhle kakhulu into ebeniyenzile, ukubambisana kudlalwe kube mnandi. Ngane zakwethu ayehle imimoya, sibuye sibambisane. Sibuyele enkundleni sidlale. Asingajabulisi izitha. Thina singabalandeli bakamaskandi sikhona sizoneseka njengoba nani nisekana nje isikhathi esiningi." UBig Zulu uthe uma ngabe oyedwa womaskanda enento ayenzayo bazoyeseka. "Ngithi awehle umoya, zinsizwa sicela ukunipha umdlalo wobumbano kube yi-Hip Hop vs Maskandi. Siyacela," kuphetha uBig Zulu. Ngokusho kukaSmomoza, ingxabano yashisa phansi kubaculi bakamaskandi kangangoba kwacishe kwabanjwana ngezandla. Uthe kukhona abaze banuka abanye ngokufuna ukuthwebula izinhlanhla zabo futhi kwabakhona ababizwa ngaphansi kweziketi zonina. USmomoza uthe abaculi ababengobhongoza nguSenzo "Ntencane" Zondi nosonkondlo ongumlingisi wemidlalo yethelevishini, uKwazi Nsele.Eziphendulela uNtencane uvele washiya angalazi kuSmomoza. Uthe uSmomoza uyabasanganela futhi ugqwaba udumo ngabo."Yiliphi ibhola olifunayo ngoba wena ubungayi emidlalweni, ubalekela amanyala owawenza ulala nomfazi womuntu esasidlala naye eqenjini. Mina noKwazi, laba osubadakelwa manje, yithi owawucasha ngathi eMpangeni uthi sikugade ngoba awuphephile. Belukuphi lolo thando lwebhola ngaleso sikhathi?"

UMCULI kamaskandi oqengqeleza phambili ngokudayisa kwengoma yakhe kuma-Official SA Charts (kwi-local Top 10 nakwi-International Top 20), uFeza Langa, ukhuthaze abafundi ngokubaluleka kwesikole. Uthe noma ngabe unaliphi ikhono kodwa kusemqoka ukuba ulishebe nesicucu semfundo.NgoLwesihlanu, uFeza (29) - oshisa izikhotha kulezi zinsuku ngenoni elithi Umaqondana - ubekhuluma nabafundi abaphumelele ngamalengiso izifundo ezisemqoka nabebezenza ngaphansi kohlelo olubizwa ngeSteam (Science,Technology, Engineering and Mathematics) eMfolozi TVET College eNkandla. Lo mculi uthe yena uqale waphothula iziqu zobuthishela kwiFoundation Phase e-University of Free State nyakenye, ngaphambi kokugxila emculweni lapho efike wakhonya khona. "Okunye engicabanga ukuthi kubalulekile ukuba ngabelane ngakho nani ukuthi u-matric ngake ngawufeyila. Kodwa lokho akwenzanga ukuthi ngiyeke. Ngaya koqala phansi kaGrade 11 kwesinye isikole futhi ngagcina ngiwuphase kahle u-matric wami." Unxuse abafundi ukuba babekezele ngoba zikhona izinto ezizobakhuba kule ndlela asebeyithathile kodwa bangaliphonsi ithawula. UFeza waseNgwetshana, eNquthu, ugila izimanga ngengoma ayicaphune kwicwecwe eliyi-EP elisihloko sithi Inkanyezi. Ngokudayisa ezitolo, le ngoma esihloko sithi Umaqondana, ihudula izingoma ezifana nekaSam Deep ethi Shela, ekaShebeshxt ethi Rato Laka, ekaJazzworkx ethi Uvalo, ekaDJ Maphorisa ethi Abantwana Bakho nekaNkeshemba ethi Ngixolele Mntanami. Lo mcimbi bewenziwe yinhlangano engenzinzuzo yaseNkandla, iNkungumathe NPO. Umfundi uNhlanhla Mkhize obefunda eNkandla High kodwa oseyokwenza i-Actuarial Science e-University of Johannesburg, uthe basizakale kakhulu kwiSteam ngenxa yokuthi bekufika othisha abangongoti kwiScience neMaths base-Unisa. Nozakwabo uThabisile Mchunu, uthe uhlelo lweSteam lumsize kakhulu ekuxazululeni izinkinga abehlangabezana nazo kwiMaths neScience. Uthe kulo nyaka uyokwenza izifundo zobudokotela e-University of KwaZulu-Natal. U-Amahle Mchunu obeseThala High, uthe ukube uhlelo lweSteam belungekho ngabe akawuphumelelanga u-matric. USihlalo weNkungumathe NPO, uMnuz Mthokozi Mchunu, uthe okumjabulise kakhulu ukuthi izikole ebebezisekela ngalolu hlelo zikwazile ukuphasa u-matric ngamalengiso. Uthe bona bahambisana nombono wokuthi kufanele kusizwe izingane ukuze kushaye u-2030 kunabafundi abangaphezu kuka-450 abangena emanyuvesi ngoba bephase ngamalengiso ezifundweni ezingaphansi kweSteam. INduna yesizwe sakwaMpungose, uMnuz Vakashela Mahaye, ilishayele elikhulu ihlombe lolu hlelo.

ZIFUNA ubulungiswa izihlobo zowesilisa waseDanganya, eMgababa, kulandela ukushaywa kwakhe aze ashone esikhungweni esisiza imilutha yezidakamizwa. Ngokuthola kweSolezwe, uMnuz Mduduzi Luthuli (23), ushaywe waze washona, ekade ezama ukweqa esikhungweni iDiscipline Boot Camp SA ngoJanuwari 22. Ngokusho kwesihlobo esikhathazekile esicele ukungadalulwa, unina kamufi wathola ucingo ngalolu suku, luthi umufi akekho esimeni esikahle, ngakho akalunge, kuzofika imoto imthathe, banikele esibhedlela. Isihlobo sithe nebala unina kamufi nabanye bomndeni banikela esibhedlela iRichmond, nokuyilapho befike bezwa khona ngomhlengikazi ukuthi othandiweyo wabo akasekho emhlabeni."Wabatshela ukuthi ababange besavuma nokuthi angene ngaphakathi esibhedlela njengoba bethole ukuthi abesikhungo, bamlethe esevele engasekho," kusho isihlobo. Siveze ukuthi umndeni uzwe ngesinye isisebenzi sesikhungo ukuthi umufi ufa nje, ubeshaywa, emva kokubanjwa ezama ukweqa. Sithe ngesikhathi umndeni usuya emakhazeni kahulumeni eMgungundlovu, lapho isidumbu sikamufi siyiswe khona, bathole ukuthi ulimele kanzima."Ekhanda utishiwe, okukhombisa ukuthi ubenenxeba elivulekile. Ubuso bebuvuvukele, enemivimbo umzimba wonke," kuchaza isihlobo. Sithe okubaphatha kabi wukuthi kuze kube yimanje umnikazi wesikhungo akakaze abachazele ukuthi kwenzekeni umufi eze eshona. Sithe ufone kanye ethembisa ukuthi uzoza emndenini, nokungenzekanga, kwathi uma esefonelwa, ebhekwa, wakhala ngokuthi useCape Town.Ukhale ngokuthi abantu balesi sikhungo abawuphathanga kahle umndeni kamufi njengoba phezu kokungazitholi izincazelo ngokufa kwakhe, nezingubo zakhe, bahlangatshezwa ngazo endleleni, beyozilanda."Ungathi babengafuni nokuthi unina kamufi aze asondele esikhungweni, yikho ahlangatshezwa yimoto, eyamnika izingubo, okwathi uma ezibheka, wathola ukuthi aziphelele,” kusho isihlobo. "Sifuna izimpendulo zokuthi obani abamshaye waze wafa. Uma sebevelile, sifuna bathathelwe izinyathelo ngecala lokumbulala ngesihluku," usho kanje. Uveze ukuthi umufi ubehanjiswe khona ngoJanuwari 10 nonyaka ngenhloso yokuthi alekelelwe ayeke izidakamizwa. Uthe yena ubesakhiphe u-R3 500 ngokuya kukamufi esikhungweni, waveza ukuthi ukuhlala kuso kuba wu-R2 500 ngeviki. Kuvela ukuthi unina ukhethe ukumyisa khona ezama ukusheshe amnqande ezidakamizweni abesenovalo lokuthi zizomenza aphume esandleni.Umsunguli we-boot camp, uMnuz Lucky "King Madlokovu" Mngadi ethintwa yiSolezwe uthe uma kwenzeka into enje kuye kube khona umseshi, ngakho okwamanje akakwazi ukuphawula."Ngike ngaxhumana nonina (kamufi), ngisazoya futhi khona ngiyohlangana nabo ngibaduduze. Ngeke ngikwazi ukuphawula kakhulu ngoba kusafanele ngithole udaba olugcwele kuzo zombili izinhlangothi njengoba lwenzeke ngingekho. Kube yishwa nje ukuthi kwenzeke into enje,” kusho uMngadi.Police comment...
INKANTOLO yeSifunda eMtubatuba igwebe uVusumuzi Jetro Thabethe (45) iminyaka ewu-15 ngokubulala umuntu ethaveni.UThabethe wayeyiphoyisa eliwu-Sergeant embuthweni we-South African Police Service (SAPS) ngesikhathi sesigameko.Ngo-29 September 2024 ntambama, uThabethe owayengekho emsebenzini, waya ethaveni yendawo. Wafica umufi uSanele Sihlongonyane (40) ehleli etafuleni ephuza nabangani bakhe. UThabethe noSihlongonyane babazana kahle. Etafuleni likamufi kwakukhona ibhakede, nokwathi uma uThabethe efika walithatha. USihlongonyane wasukuma wamlandela efuna ibhakede lakhe. Balandelana baze bafika phandle bafika baxabana bebanga ibhakede. Ummangalelwa washaya umufi ngequpha kwasuka isidumo kwaliwa, wahosha isibhamu somsebenzi wadubula phansi. Umufi wambuza ukuthi kungani edubula kodwa yena waqhubeka wamdubula ebusweni. UThabethe wangena emotweni wadubula emoyeni washaya wachitha. Abantu ababekhona baphuthumisa uSihlongonyane esibhedlela kwafika kwathiwa useshonile.Washaya imoto waya emaphoyiseni eNgwavuma wayozinikela khona washo ukuthi usedubule umuntu. UThabethe waboshwa khona lapho. Enkantolo, uMshushisi uPhumlani Thembalethu Khoza ubize ofakazi ababili abazibonela nodokotela owahlola isidumbu sikamufi. Kwabizwa nesazi sezibhamu owaqinisekisa ukuthi isibhamu esadubula yisona impela esasiphethwe wuThabethe.UThabethe ulahlwe ngecala ngaphansi kuka-Section 51(2) of the Criminal Law Amendment Act 105 0f 1997 okuhambisna nesigwebo seminyaka ewu-15. Inkantolo ithe ummangalewa akafanelwe wukuba nemvume yokuphatha isibhamu. Ummangalelwa wayeyiphoyisa, bekufanele ahloniphe umthetho.

ZIGAYA ngomunye umhlathi izinto ecaleni lokubulawa kwekhansela elibhekene neNkosi Simphiwe Erick Zuma, njengoba selidluliselwe enkantolo yesifunda futhi kulindeleke ukuthi inkabi eboshwe nenkosi ivume icala.Inkabi eboshwe nenkosi, uMnuz Thabo Mathonsi Chonco, kulindeleke ukuthi ilivume icala lokusoconga owayeyikhansela le-DA kuMasipala waseMngeni, uMnuz Nhlalayenza Ndlovu, uma isivela eNkantolo yesiFunda eMgungundlovu, ngoMsombuluko. Icala lokubulawa kukaNdlovu lisuswe eNkantolo yeMantshi eHowick, labe selidluliselwa eNkantolo yesiFunda eMgungundlovu. Inkosi noChonco baboshwe kanye noMnuz Thobani Masobho Hlongwa noKhayelihle Shabalala kuleli cala. Omunye umsolwa, uMnuz Zwelithini Buthelezi, owayeyinduna yenkosi, osephenduke ufakazi woMbuso. UChonco kuthiwa uyena owahlela itulo lokusoconga uNdlovu nokuyitulo okuthiwa walicija esejele. Kuvele ukuthi uChonco uzolivuma icala. Isolezwe lithole ukuthi uChonco ngeke alifake igama lenkosi uma esevuma icala.Umthombo osondelene nophenyo, uthe uChonco uzokhomba uButhelezi njengomuntu okuwuye owabathuma ukuba basoconge uNdlovu.Ummeli kaChonco, uMnuz Khanyile, uthe uzophawula kahle ngoMsombuluko uma uChonco esevelile enkantolo. UChonco usanda kulahlwa yicala lokusoconga umndeni waseBulwer.INkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu igwebe uChonco odilikajele abahlanu.UChonco uphinde abhekane necala lokuqothwa kwamalungu omndeni wakwaMemela eMbali, eMgungundlovu.Umholi we-DA KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Francois Rodgers, uthe kubaqinisa idolo ukudluliselwa kwecala enkantolo yesifunda."Lokhu kuyakhombisa ukuthi leli icala elibucayi, ingakho lisusiwe enkantolo yemantshi layiswa enkantolo yesifunda."URodgers uthe bafuna ukuzwa ukuthi uChonco uzothini uma esevuma icala."Sifuna ukubona ukuthi uMbuso uzobusebenzisa kanjani ubufakazi bukaChonco. Into eyinkinga ngomuntu osuke evume icala ukuthi kusuke kusangenzeka ukuthi anqabe ukufakaza uma sekuqulwa icala."URodgers uthe kuyabakhathaza ukushaya ngolonwabu kwaleli cala."Sizoqhubeka nokuqapha ukuqulwa kwecala. Amalungu omphakathi nomndeni wakwaNdlovu akufanele uvumele leli cala ukuba liphelele emoyeni."Inkosi ilokhu yahlala ejele ngoJulayi, njengoba sachithwa isicelo sebheyili kanti ibibukeka idangele ngesikhathi ivele enkantolo izolo.Inkosi iphinde ibhekane namanye amacala amabili okubulala.Ibhekene necala lokubulawa kowayengundunankulu wesizwe sakwaNxamalala, uMnuz Qalokunye Zuma nelokubulawa kowayelwa nokudayiswa komhlaba kamasipala, uMnuz Xolani Ntombela/Ndlovu.Nawo la macala adluliselwe enkantolo yesifunda.
