BAVUTHA bengabaselwe abefundisi bamahlelo ehlukene benhlangano, iReformed Independent Church Association (RICA) abasola isandla semfene ngokugqunywa ejele kukaMbhishobhi Michael Sandlwana webandla i-International Pentecostal Holiness Church (IPHC).Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi lwaba yindaba egudwini udaba lukaMbhishobhi Sandlwana owakhalelwa ngamasongo kaSigonyela ngo-2021, ngemuva kokuba ezinikele yena emaphoyiseni.Nokho uphinde waphuma wase ephinde eboshwa ngoNovemba wonyaka owedlule, ngecala lokugwazela iJaji laseNkantolo eNkulu yasePitoli, uPortia Phahlane, ngemali elinganiselwa ku-R2.4 million eyifaka kuma-akhawunti asemabhange ehlukene. Kusolakala ukuthi lokhu kwenzeka phakathi kuka-2021 no-2022.Ngokwezinsolo, lokhu kuthiwa uMbhishobhi Sandlwana wakwenza ngenhloso yokuthi inkantolo ikhiphe isinqumo esivuna uhlangothi lwakhe ecaleni lombango webandla. Ngemuva kokuvela kwalezi zinsolo ezibucayi, uphiko loKlebe ngoNovemba 5, lubophe uMbhishobhi Sandlwana, iJaji uPhahlane, Mnuz Vusi Ndala noKagiso Phahlane oyindodana yejaji.Laba abanye uMbhishobhi aboshwe nabo bangaphandle ngebheyili. Kodwa bonke abathintekayo kuleli cala kulindeleke ukuba bavele eNkantolo eNkulu yasePitoli, ngoMashi 6.Wayekade evulelwe amacala enkohlakalo ngamalungu ebandla lakhe ayekade emsola ngokusebenzisa budedengu imali yebandla. Kwahlaluka ukuthi ibandla lihlukene pahakathi, icala lona walivulelwa wuhlangothi olweseka umfowabo omncane.Ekhuluma eLight House Church KwaMashu esithangamini sabezindaba, uMbhishobhi uSandile Ndlela ukhale ngokuthi bafuna ukubona ubulungiswa ngendlela elisingathwa ngalo icala likaSandlwana.Uthe le nhlangano inomuzwa wokuthi uyacindezelwa uSandlwana ekubeni kungafanele kwenzeke kanjalo ngoba phela akakalahlwa yicala futhi akakagwetshwa.''Akwenziwe ubulungiswa, asiphathe wonke umuntu ngokulingana. Akungabi bikho umuntu ozophathwa kube sengathi uselahlwe yicala ekubeni kungenjalo. Sikhuluma nje into eyodwa yokuthi makwenziwe ubulungiswa,'' echaza.Eqhuba uthe izinkantolo kumele zazi ukuthi indaba yokuholwa kwebandla ibucayi futhi kwesinye isikhathi nazo izinkantolo ziyehluleka ukwenza into efanele, kunalokho ziqhubekezela phambili udweshu.Wenze isibonelo ngokungenelela kwenkantolo yaseThekwini nezinye ezindabeni zobuholi bebandla lakwaShembe, wathi zehluleka, kunalokho zaqhubekezela phambili udweshu.''Udaba lokuholwa kwebandla yinto engelula nje nhlobo. Sikholwa ukuthi kumele kube yinto ephathwa ngobunono nangokucophelela okukhulu,'' usho kanjena.Uthe bona abafuni ukubonakala njengabantu abathatha uhlangothi oluthize, wathi noma kunjalo kodwa kuyabakhathaza kakhulu indlela ababona sengathi ucindezelwa ngakhona uSandlwana.Ngokusho kukaNdlela, ngabe benza elikhulu iphutha leli uma bengase bakushaye indiva abakubona kwenzeke komunye wabo ebese bemane bayadembesela nje, kunalokho uthe bazobhukula kuze kufezeke abakufunayo. "Ukunqatshelwa kukaSandlwana ibheyili ekubeni beyitholile abekwe nabo icala nakho lokho kukuveza ngokusobala ukungabi bikho kobulungana kuleli cala.”Uthe uma kusho ukuthi basuke KwaZulu-Natal baze bafinyelele lapho okuqhubeka khona icala, lokho abanqeni ukukwenza inqobo nje uma izwi labo nokukhalaza kwabo kuzogcina kufinyelelile lapho okumele kufike khona."Thina asingeni kakhulu kulokhu kumbango kodwa singena endleleni esibona sengathi ayihambi kahle uma kukhulunywa ngokuphathwa kukaSandlwana. Akumele umuntu aphathwe sakujeziswa isinqumo senkantolo sungakaphumi,'' echaza.Uveze ukuthi nakuba bengeke baze bagxambukele ekuholweni kwaleli bandla kodwa bayazi ukuthi umuntu omdala uyena okumele angene uma umholi engasekho. Udalule ukuthi leli bandla liholwa ngokomndeni. Kulesi simo uthe wonke umuntu uyazi ukuthi uSandlwana uyena omdala kunomfowabo.UMbhishobhi Mambo Mkhize naye ukhale ngento efanayo ethi kubonakala bungekho nje nhlobo ubulungiswa endleleni aphethwe ngayo uSandlwana. Uthe izwe likhululekile manje kumqoka ukuba bonke abantu baphathwe ngendlela efanayo, kungabi bikho ozobonakala ecindezelwa kumbe ekhishwa inyumbazane.''Sifuna ukuthi ukukhononda kwethu kufinyelele bakuzwe ukuze izoshintsha indlela abomthetho abenza ngayo izinto,'' usho kanjena.Enkantolo kwaphinde kwavela nezinsolo ezithi uSandlwana usebenzisa omazisi abathathu. Kwavela nokuthi usolwa ngemizamo yokuzithathela imali yomkakhe bengavumelene.Isolezwe litholile ukuthi zimapeketwane izinto kuleli bandla njengoba lihlukene kabili kukhona abeseka uSandlwana kukhona abeseka umfowabo omncane.
INHLOKO yoKlebe KwaZulu-Natal, uMajor General Lesetja Senona, iyingxenye yamaphoyisa amahlanu uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, afuna ukuthi aphenywe.Igama likaSenona livela ohlwini lwamaphoyisa uRamaphosa aphakamise ukuthi aphenyelwe izinsolo zokusebenzisana nemigulukudu.USenona usolwa ngokusondelana nosomabhizinisi obhekene noxhaxha lwamacala, uMnuz Vusimuzi "Cat" Matlala.URamaphosa uphakamise ukuthi amaphoyisa amahlanu aphenywe emva kokucubungula umbiko awunikwa ikhomishini ephenya izinsolo ezenziwa uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi.Amanye amaphoyisa uRamaphosa afuna aphenywe uMajor General Richard Shibiri, Brigadier Mbangwa Nkhwashu, Brigadier Rachel Matjeng noSergeant Fannie Nkosi.Onke la maphoyisa asolwa ngokusebenzisana nemigulukudu.URamaphosa uyalele uNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa obambile, uSolwazi Firoz Cachalia, ukuba asungule ithimba elizophenya izinto ezivela kwikhomishini.URamaphosa uphinde wayalela ukuba kuthathelwe izinyathelo amaphoyisa kuMasipala wase-Ekurhuleni, okukhona kuwo nesikhulu samaphoyisa kamasipala esimisiwe, uBrigadier Julius Mkhwanazi.Kube nemibuzo igama likaNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa omisiwe, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, lingaveli ohlwini lwabantu okufanele baphenywe.Okhulumela uRamaphosa, uMnuz Vincent Magwenya, uthe uRamaphosa ufuna ukunika uMchunu ithuba lokuba ayoziphendulela phambi kwekhomishini ngaphambi kokuthi amthathele izinyathelo.Khonamanjalo, ikhomishini eholwa iJaji Mbuyiseli Madlanga iqhubekile izolo nokupheka ngebhodwe elincane uSenona.Ikhomishini ifune ukwazi ukuthi kungani uSenona engazange ayohlolwa emshinini okwazi ukubona umuntu oqamba emva kokulahleka kwezidakamizwa zezigidi zamarandi ezazigcinwe oKlebe.USenona utshele ikhomishini ukuthi onke amaphoyisa ayesebenza ngesikhathi oKlebe beshaqa izidakamizwa zika-R200 million, aya kohlolwa umshini. Lezi zidakamizwa zantshontshwa zigcinwe oKlebe ePort Shepstone.USenona uthe onke amaphoyisa ahlolwa kwatholakala ukuthi awazi lutho ngokulahleka kwezidakamizwa. Ubuzwe ukuthi kungani yena engahlolwanga, wathi umphathi wakhe akashongo ukuthi kufanele naye ahlolwe."Angicabanganga ngaleso sikhathi ukuthi nami ngicele ukuba nami ngihlolwe. Umuntu ongiphethe uyena okwakufanele asho ukuthi angiye kohlolwa nami. Mhlawumbe kufanele engabe ngacela nami ukuthi ngihlolwe. Emhlabeni siyafunda zonke izinsuku. Kukhona isifundo engisitholile nami. Isifundo engisitholile sizongisiza kakhulu ngomuso."USenona ubuzwe ukuthi engavuma yini uma kungase kushiwo manje ukuthi akayohlolwa, wathi akasiboni isidingo sokuthi ahlolwe manje."Ngabe uzama ukusho ukuthi kufanele nami ngiyohlolwa? Sesidlulile isikhathi salokho."
KUHAYIZE owomndeni eNkantolo yesiFunda yaseNtuzuma, ngesikhathi abemhambele elahlwa ngecala lokubulala umuntu ayesebenza naye, owaqala ngokusula igazi lakhe ngesigqoko sikamufi ngaphambi kokuba ambulale.Ummangalelwa kuleli cala, uVuyani Ngubane (23) kuvela ukuthi wadubula wabulala uMnuz Xolani Stanley Mkhize (21) esigamekweni esenzeka ebhusha iCicephu eNanda, ngoJulayi 30, 2023.Udweshu kuthiwa lwaqala ngesikathi uNgubane ephumela emnyango eqhumisa phezulu isibhamu sakubukisa amahlandla amaningana nje impela kanti uzolimala kabuhlungu esandleni.Kuthiwa kwathi esebuyela ngaphakathi ebhusha isandla sakhe sasesivuza igazi, kwala noma esezama ukulisula ngethishu. Kuthiwa kwathi uma ebona ukuthi igazi liyaqhubeka nokuvuza wamane waqonda nje ngqo kumufi owayehlezi eyedwa wafika kuyena wamhlithwa isigqoko sakhe ayekade esithwele, wabe esesula ngaso igazi maqede wambuyisela.Lokhu kuthiwa kwamnenga kakhulu umufi kodwa wabuye wehlisa umoya. Ngemuva kwesikhashana, uMkhize waphumela emnyango eyobamba ucingo lwakhe kanti uNgubane nabangani bakhe bazomlandela.Esephandle umufi, kuthiwa omunye wabangani bakammangalelwa akachithanga sikhathi, wamphuca iselula yakhe ngemuva kwalokho uNgubane wase evele emdubula ebusweni kubuka wonke umuntu.Umufi waphuthunyiswa emtholampilo waseNewtown C, eNanda, ngoba wayesaphefumula. Nokho kuthiwa kwafike kwamenela esefike khona.Ngemuva kwalokho, kuthiwa uNgubane wagcwala amathafa amaphoyisa ayesezithendeni zakhe agcina embamba njengoba akhalelwa ngamasongo kaSigonyela ngoSepthemba 30, ngawo u-2023, emva kokuba kutholwe umkhondo wakhe ase enikela khona emaChobeni, eNanda. Izolo inkantolo ikhiphe isinqumo ngaleli cala. IMantshi yesiFunda uMotala iqale ngokusola ummangalelwa ngokukhombisa okukhulu ukungazisoli ngesikhathi kuqhubeka icala. Ithe kunalokho, uvele wakhetha ukuhhubhuza akabhejane.''Konke obukutshela inkantolo ubumane uziqambela amanga njengoba nakhu bewenzela ukuthi uphunyuke. Indlela owenze ngayo ikhombisile ukuthi awunandaba nesenzo sakho futhi akukho nokuncane nje ukuzisola onakho,'' kusho imantshi yesifunda ikhuluma ibhekise kuyena ummangalelwa.Iqhubeka imantshi yesifunda, income kakhulu ofakazi ababili okuyibona abethula ubufakazi kuleli cala. Ikhulume nange-video eyadlalwa enkantolo lapho eyayiveza khona konke okwenzeka ngesigameko. Ithe le video yalekelela kakhulu ngoba iyona eyaveza ngokusobala ukuthi ngampela ofakazi bakhuluma okuyikho ngoba nabo bayabonakala kwi- video bekubona okwenzekayo.Ummangalelwa ubekade ebekwe yinkantolo amacala amathathu, kuwona wonke utholwe engekho msulwa. Ubebekwe icala lokuphuca umufi iselula, elokubulala kanjalo nelokutholakala nesibhamu esingekho emthethweni futhi esixikizwe izinombolo.Womathathu lawa macala ummangalelwa wawaphika. Ubonakale edangala ummangalelwa ngesikhathi imantshi yesifunda imtshela ukuthi iyamlahla ngecala.''Noma ungathini nawe uyazi ukuthi ngampela unalo icala yingakho nenkantolo ikuthola unalo,'' echaza.Imantshi uMotala ithe bekumqoka kakhulu ukuba ikhiphe isinqumo okuyisona ukuze kuzocaca ukuthi izinkantolo ziyakwazi ukwenza umsebenzi wazo.Umndeni kammangalelwa usale udangele waphuma unxapha enkantolo, kubonakala ukuthi kulukhuni satshe ukuba ukwamukele lokhu okwenzeka enkantolo.Ngemuva kokuba imantshi ikhiphe isinqumo, omunye wesilisa okukholakala ukuthi ungowomndeni uhlulekile ukuzibamba, wamane wahayiza kakhulu enkantolo. Kuze kwadingeka ukuba omunye ahambe naye amkhiphele ngaphandle kwenkantolo.Omunye womndeni kamufi uzwakale ethi: ''Nakhuya, nazoke! Siyoshisa inyama namhlanje.''Kulindeleke ukuthi uNgubane agwetshwe ngesonto elizayo.

UMASIPALA waseMsunduzi uyaqhubeka nokuvikela isinqumo sawo sokuxhasa ngezigidi zamaRandi iqembu lebhola elaliphethwe yimpunyela, uShauwn Mkhize.IMeya yomkhandlu, uMnuz Mzimkulu Thebolla, ithe akukho phutha abalenza ngesikhathi bethatha isinqumo sokuxhasa iRoyal AM ngo-R27 million.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ephendula imibuzo yamalungu amakomiti asePhalamende, elibhekele ukusebenza koMnyango wokuBusa ngokuBambisana, kanye nelibhekele ukusetshenziswa kwemali yomphakathi.UMasipala waseMsunduzi wathatha isinqumo sokuxhasa iRoyal AM ukuze idlalele imidlalo yayo yasekhaya enkundleni eseMgungundlovu, iHarry Gwala Stadium.Isivumelwano kwakungeseminyaka emithathu lapho iRoyal AM yayizothola u-R9 million njalo ngonyaka.IRoyal AM yehluleka ukuqeda imidlalo yayo ngenxa yenkinga yemali.Amalungu amakomiti afune ukwazi ukuthi ngabe kukhona yini izikhulu zomkhandlu ezikufundile kulokhu.UThebolla uthe alikho iphutha abalenza ngokuxhasa iRoyal AM, wathi baba nebhadi nje lokuthi iRoyal AM ikhungathwe yizinkinga ezenza ukuthi ingabe isakwazi ukuqhubeka nemidlalo yayo yasekhaya."Sanquma ukuxhasa iRoyal AM emva kokudliwa yizembe kweMaritzburg eyayidlalela imidlalo yayo yasekhaya eMgungundlovu. Sabe sineminyaka eyishumi sixhasa iMaritzburg United. Sayibekela imibandela iRoyal AM ngesikhathi sivuma ukuyixhasa. Ngebhadi ke iRoyal AM yaba nezinkinga zemali okubalwa kuzo neSars (SA Revenue Services). Sabe sesiphela kanjalo ke isivumelwano ngoba base behluleka ukugcina imibandela esasibabekele yona."Amalungu ekomiti abuzile ukuthi ngabe kukhona yini okwazuzwa wumasipala ngalesi sivumelwano, uThebolla wathi kukhona."Ngokwesivumelwano ayikho imali eyayizoza kumasipala ngqo. Kodwa ke baningi abahlomula ngesikhathi iRoyal AM idlalela imidlalo yayo yasekhaya lapha. UFUNA ukuba zingawakhokhi ama-rates (intela yomhlaba kamasipala) izikole zabaphila nokukhubazeka luMphathiswa woMnyango weMisebenzi yoMphakathi neNgqalasizinda KwaZulu- Natal, uMnuz Martin Meyer.UMeyer wenze lesi siphakamiso izolo ehambele isikole sabaphila nokhubazeka esiseManzimtoti, iDurban School for the Hearing Impaired.Ukhale kakhulu ngokuthi kumele ngabe kade lwaxoxwa udaba lwama-rates nezikole zabaphila nokukhubazeka. Uthe esikhundleni sokuba lezi zikole zikhokhe ama-rates leyo mali kufanele ngabe ziyisebenzisela ukubhekana noxhaxha lwezinkinga athe zibonakala zigubuzele lezi zikole.Uthembise ukuthi uzoxhumana neSalga kanye noMnyango wokuBusa nokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal ngenhloso yokubhunga kabanzi ngenqubekela phambili kulolu daba.''Kuyakhathza kakhulu ukubona izikole zabaphila nokhubazeka zishoda ngezinto eziningi kangaka kodwa futhi khona lapho kumele zikhokhele ama-rates. Lesi simo asamukelekile nje nhlobo. Ngikholwa wukuthi sesifikile manje isikhathi sokuthi kuhlalwe phansi kubhungwe kabanzi mayelana nokuthi akukho yini okungenziwa ngenhloso yokubhekana ngqo nalolu daba,” usho kanjena.Ukhulume kakhulu ngodaba lokukhahlamezeka kwengqalasizinda yesikole abesihambele. Uthe kuyakhathaza kakhulu ukuthi izikole zabaphila nokukhubazeka iningi lazo lizithola libhekene nenkinga efanayo.Kulo nyaka oqalayo uthembise ukuthi umnyango wakhe uzobhukula wenze konke okusemandleni ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ziyaxazululwa izinkinga ezibhekene nezikole zabaphila nokukhubazeka ikakhulukazi lezo ezimayelana nokukhahlamezeka kwengqalasuzinda."Kuyinto engamukelekile nje nhlobo ukubona izikole zabaphlia nokhubazeka zibhekene nenkinga yokukhahlamezeka kwengqalasizinda ngalolu hlobo. Sizohlala phansi sibone ukuthi yikuphi okungenziwa ukuze kuxazululwe le nkinga,” usho kanjena.Uthe bazimisele ngokusebenzisana noMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal oholwa uMphathiswa uSipho Hlomuka ukuze kubonakale ukuthi yini engenziwa ukuze kulekelelwe izikole zabaphla nokukhubazeka ezibhekene nengwadla yengqalasizinda kanye nezinye nje izingqinamba ezigcina zithikameza ukufunda nokufundisa.Uthe okwamanje basamatasa baqedela ukwakhiwa kwesikole saseMlaza, iMenzi wathi emva kwalokho bazoqala babhekane ngqo nohlelo lokwenziwa ngcono kwengqalasizinda yezikole zabaphila nokukhubazeka.UMeyer unikele ngezipho ezinhlobonhlobo kubafundi bakulesi sikole.Uthishanhloko wesikole, uNkk Phumlile Ngcobo, ugonyuluke ngezinselelo ezahlukene athe basebenza ngaphansi kwazo. Eqhulwini ukhale kakhulu ngokuthi abanabo abahlengikazi okumele ngabe bakhona bahlola impilo yabafundi bakulesi sikole.Uthe ukungabi bikho kwabahlengikazi kudala umsebenzi ophindiwe kothisha ekubeni kulindeleke ukuthi bafundise ngendlela efanele.''Kubuhlungu kakhulu ukuthi isikole salolu hlobo asinabo nje nhlobo abahlengikazi. Lokhu kusiphatha kabi thina njengothisha futhi kudala ukuthi ube mningi kakhulu umsebenzi okumele wenziwe othisha," kuchaza yena.Mayelana nenkinga yengqalasizinda uthe kufanele ngoba lesi sikole sakhiwa kudala ngakho akuthusi ukuthi isakhiwo saso asisekho esimeni esamukelekile.UMeyer uthe inhlangano yezikole zabaphila nokukhubazeka KwaZulu-Natal, iSouth African National Association for Special Education (Sanase) ike yaba nemashi nyakenye ikhala ngezinkinga eziningi ezikoleni zabaphila nokukhubazeka.Amalungu ale nhlangano amasha esuka eMarket Square, eMgungundlovu, aze ayofika emahhovisii kandunankulu ekhala ngezinkinga. Akhala nangokuthi aseke axhumana noMnyango wezeMfundo ngalolu daba kodwa kwafana nokuthi athela amanzi emhlane wedada.

UKHATHAZEKILE umndeni wowesilisa waKwaMaqumbi, KwaMaphumulo, kulandela ukunyamalala kwakhe, kade ethumele imiyalezo ethusayo.UMnuz Qhawe Ndumiso Zulu (34) obehlala eCanelands, eVerulam, ugcine ukubonwa ngoMgqibelo, kwenye yama-warehouse aseHezelmere, lapho abesebenza khona eyimenenja.Ngokusho kwesihlobo, esizwakalise ukukhathazeka, uMnuz Lucky Zulu, uQhawe ufikile emsebenzini ehamba ngemoto yakhe yohlobo lweToyota Etios emhlophe. "Sithole umbiko wokuthi ozakwabo baqale ukuqaphela ngezikhathi zasemini, sekubuywa ekhefini lokudla ukuthi akekho,” kusho uZulu.Uthe ucingwe yonke indawo, kwacaca ukuthi akekho, waphinde kwaqapheleka ukuthi nemoto yakhe ayikho. Uthe yilapho okuvele khona ukuthi kukhona imiyalezo ethusayo ayithumele asondelene nabo ngezikhathi zasekuseni ngosuku olufanayo. Phakathi kwayo uthe ubebalula ukuthi impilo imehlule, waveza neyokuxinwa yizikweletu.UZulu uveze ukuthi umndeni uthole ukuthi ubenenkinga yokugembula ngokweqile, abehlala ahlale azame ukukuyeka, kodwa kuphinde kutholakale esebuyele.Uthe umndeni ukhathazekile ngokungatholakali kwakhe. "Umndeni ubikile ngokuduka kwakhe emaphoyiseni aseVerulam ngeSonto. Kucingiwe emahlathini, edamini nakwezinye izindawo, wangatholakala,” usho kanje.Uthe kusaqhubeka namanje ukucingwa kwakhe, wanxusa ukuthi ongaba nolwazi alekelele ngokuthinta amaphoyisa. "Sikhathazeke kakhulu ngokunyamalala kwakhe. Uma kukhala ucingo, siba nethemba lokuthi luza nomyalezo omuhle, kodwa kungabi njalo,” kusho uZulu. Uthe okubakhathaza kakhulu ukuthi umndeni unabantu asebekhulile, abangahle bahlaselwe ukugula okuyamaniswa nokucabanga kakhulu, njengoba kuhamba izinsuku ungekho umkhondo ovelayo ngokuthi uphelelephi.Uveze nokuthi nemoto anyamalale ehamba ngayo, nayo ayikatholakali, wathi ayikho indlela yokuthi icingwe njengoba kuvele ukuthi i-tracker yayo ibinenkinga.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant Colonel Paul Magwaza, uthe amaphoyisa aseVerulam avule idokodo lomuntu olahlekile ukuze liphenywe."Kunxuswa nanoma ngubani ongaba nolwazi lokuthi lona wesilisa uphi, athinte amaphoyisa aseVerulam enombolweni ethi 032 541 5231 noma ashayele eyamaphoyisa ejwayelekile ethi 08600 10111," kusho uMagwaza.

"Ngosuku lwesigameko ubeyojima enkundleni yebhola kwa-C, ngamshayela ucingo ngimthuma ukuthi ayongithengela izimpahla ezithize ePlaza, bese eyangiphathisela zona. Wenze njengoba ngisho, wase esala esedlula emqashweni wabazala bakhe. Ulinyazwa nje, ubesanda kuphuma kuwona, esegoduka,” kusho uMlangeni. Uthe ngoba ubengakahambi ibanga elide, owesifazane obembonile ephuma emqashweni wabazala bakhe, wuye ombone ehlaselwa, wagijima wazobabikela ukuthi nangu egwazwa amaphara."Banikele endaweni yesigameko, bangishayela nocingo bengazisa. Ngishayele abama-ambulensi, baze afika emva kwehora,” usho kanje.Uthe abazala nomphakathi osheshe wafika esigamekweni, bamfice esaphila ezama ukuphakama kodwa kukhombisa ukuthi uphelelwa amandla. "Abama-ambulensi bafike sekonakele, sebeqinisekisa ukuthi akasekho,” usho kanje.Ukhale ngokuthi udaba lwamaphara ludala, wathi kufanele ingabe kukhona obese kwenziwe ngawo ukugwema izigameko zalolu hlobo."Kudala ikhulunywa indaba yawo, kushiwo ukuthi sebephelile abantu ebagwaza. Mhlawumbe ukube kukhona obekwenziwa, ngabe akusehlelanga lokhu. Ingathi ingasukunyelwa le nto,” kusho uMlangeni. Uchaze indodana yakhe njengomuntu obesithanda isikole, ezimisela, ehlonipha futhi ewuthanda umndeni, wathi bagqemeke engeqiwa ntwala ngokubulawa kwakhe. USotswebhu weNFP eZululand, uMnuz Siphamandla Ntombela, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi side isikhathi kunenkinga yamaphara abulala abantu kule ndawo."Cishe isiphelile iminyaka emine ehlala kujantshi wesitimela. Siyafisa umasipala, amaphoyisa neziphathimandla zakwaloliwe zilusukumele lolu daba ngoba sekunesikhathi eside amaphara ewuhlupho ngobugebengu bokubulala abantu,” kusho uNtombela. Kuze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela amaphoyisa engakaphenduli ngalolu daba.
UMSUNGULI wenhlangano iMarch and March, elwa udaba lwabokufika abakuleli ngokungemthetho, uNkk Jacinta Ngobese-Zuma, uthi akukho okuzoba namandla ukubaphuca ilungelo labo lokubhikisha.UNkk Ngobese-Zuma ubekhuluma ngaphandle kwesiteshi samaphoyisa, iPoint, eSouth Beach, eThekwini, lapho obekuthiwa akazinikele khona izolo, kulandela ukuvulelwa icala lokuphehla udweshu emphakathini.Lokhu kuza emva kwemibhikisho ebiholwa yiMarch and March kanjalo nezinye izinhlangano ezinomuzwa ofanayo ezifana ne-Operation Dudula kanjalo neMKP ngaphandle kwesikole, i-Addington Primary ngeledlule. Imibhikisho ibimayelana nesikhalazo sokuthi kukhona inqwaba yezingane zakuleli ezingazitholanga izikhala zokufunda kulesi sikole okuthiwa sigcwele inqwaba yezingane zabokufika.UNkk Ngobese-Zuma utshele abezindaba ukuthi ukubhikisha kungelinye lamalungelo abantu futhi akekho ongabaphuca lona."Asikho isitatimende samaphoyisa esingasivimba. Akukho kusatshiswa ngamaphoyisa okungasivimba. Akukho nokukodwa okungasiphuca lelo lungelo lokuthi siphume siye laphaya, sifike sibhikishele ukuthi izingane zabakuleli zifakwe esikoleni sakuleli,” usho kanje. Uveze ukuthi uthe uma efika ngaphakathi esiteshini samaphoyisa, uthole umphenyi omtshele ukuthi ufuna isitatimende kubona (March and March).Uthe ngokuboniswa abameli bakhe, bakhethe ukuthi bazinike isikhathi ukusibhala ngoba akuyena yedwa obekwa icala kodwa kukhona ne-Operation Dudulu kanjalo neMKP ngombhikisho ababanawo ngoLwesithathu olwedlule. Uthe basebumnyameni ngokuthi elani ngempela icala ababekwa lona. "Uma sibekwa icala, kungani singabekwanga lona ngalolo suku? Kwakunenqwaba yamaphoyisa laphayana, kanjalo namaveni awo. Uma kwakukhona ababekubona ukuthi akukho emthethweni, kwakufanele sibekwe icala khona lapho,” usho kanje.Umkhankaso weMarch and March uqale ngoMashi nyakenye, kanti ulwa nabokufika abakuleli ngokungemthetho.Ubonakele uba mandla esibhedlela i-Addington, eSouth Beach nyakenye, lapho amalungu enhlangano ebekanisa ngaphandle kwesibhedlela afune ukubona amaphepha avumela abokufika ukuthi babe kuleli ngaphambi kokuba bangene ngaphakathi. Ubonakele nakwezinye izindawo KwaZulu-Natal kanjalo nakwezinye izifundazwe. Ngesikhathi kuvulwa izikole, amalungu enhlangano, okufaka phakathi naye uNkk Ngobese-Zuma, banikele esikoleni i-Addington, kulandela ukuthola isikhalazo sokuthi kukhona izingane zabakuleli ezingu-66 ezingathathwanga yilesi sikole.
KUKHALWA ngesihlava sokucwaswa kwabathandana nabantu abanobulili obufana nobabo KwaXimba, eCato Ridge, kulandela ukubulawa ngesihluku komunye wabo.UMnuz Sbongimpilo "Shanah" Mzobe (19) waseNumber 9, kuthiwa ubulawe ngendlela engaqondakali ngeSonto. Isidumbu sakhe ebesihleshulwe isitho sangasese sitholwe sintanta emfuleni ongezansi kwakubo. Umufi ubegcine ukubonwa ephila wumndeni wakhe emahoreni ambalwa ngaphambi kokutholwa kwesidumbu.Kuvele ukuthi ngale kokulinyazwa kwesitho sangasese, ingalo eyodwa ibisontekile, kwathi enye yaba nomhuzuko, okukhombisa ukuthi wahudulwa phansi ngaphambi kokuba aphoswe emfuleni. Kuvele nokuthi ubephuma igazi emehlweni, emlonyeni ekhihliza amagwebu. Isishoshovu senhlangano iLGBTQ+ Community KwaZulu-Natal, uNksz Hlengiwe Buthelezi, siveze ukuthi KwaXimba kusagcwele inqwaba yabantu abangayizwa eyabantu abathandana nabobulili obufana nobabo."Leya ndawo isenabantu abasancike kakhulu emasikweni esintu nezindlela zakudala zokuphila nokwenza kube nzima ukuthi bamukele, baphinde bayijwayele indaba yabantu abathandana nabanobulili obufana nobabo,” kusho uNksz Buthelezi.Uthe lokhu kuyisimo esilukhuni ikakhulukazi uma kubhekwa iqiniso lokuthi wonke umuntu unelungelo lokuphila impilo yakhe ngendlela afisa ngayo. Uveze ukuthi nakuba umufi etholakale engxenyeni yesizwe sakwaMdluli, esakhelene nesaKwaXimba, bake basebenzisana nesizwe sakwaMdluli, eside isikhathi beyiLGBTQ+, ngenhloso yokuqeda ngalesi sihlava.Uveze ukuthi ngesikhathi beqala lowo mkhankaso eminyakeni embalwa edlule, zaziyinsakavukela izigameko zokuhlukunyezwa kwabathandana nabanobulili obufana nobabo.Enza isibonelo uthe, kukhona isigameko sowesifazane owake washaywa kanzima uyise wengane yomunye wesifazane ayethandana naye phambilini. Uthe unina wengane wayesahlukana noyise wayo kodwa kwathi uma esethola ukuthi uthandana nomunye wesifazane, wamshaya lowo wesifazane ngelinye ilanga. Uveze ukuthi owesilisa ngesikhathi eshaya owesifazane, wayekhipha amagama athi: "Zilwele ngoba uthi uyindoda”.UNksz Buthelezi uthe ziyabathikameza izigameko zokubulawa kwabo ngoba zikhombisa ukuthi kuningi okusafanele kwenziwe ngesihlava.Unxuse izinhlaka zomphakathi ezehlukene ukuthi zisukume, zibambisane ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bayafundiseka ngabathandana nabanobulili obufana nobabo nokuthi izigameko ezifuze esikaShanah azenzeki. Ngesikhathi Isolezwe libhala udaba lokufa kukaShanah, umndeni waveza izinsolo zokuthi ubulawe umuntu wendawo futhi amaziyo njengoba asabela ngendlela ekhombisa ukuthi umuntu owayembizela ngaphandle, uyamazi. Lokhu kuthiwa kwenzeka entathakusa, emahoreni ambalwa ngaphambi kokuba atholwe ebulewe.
BAMSOLA ngokuthi uzama ukudlala umacashelana nenkantolo owesilisa waseKoffie Farm, KwaNdengezi, okuvele eyokuthi uzoyohlolwa isimo sengqondo njengoba eboshelwe icala lokubulala umakhelwane.UMnuz Sibongiseni Mbhele nabanye, oMnuz Bongumusa Mkhonto noMnuz Sboniso Phungula - asolwa nabo ecaleni lokubulala umakhelwane ngesihluku - bebevele eNkantolo yeMantshi yasePinetown, izolo.Basolwa ngecala lokubulala uMnuz Kholwani Cele (34) okuthiwa wabulawa ngo-Okthoba 23, 2025, maqede wabelethiswa itshe, waphonswa emfuleni uMngeni. UCele ubelokhu ethathwa njengodukile kusukela ngaleso sikhathi kwaze kwaba uMbhele - ongumsolwa wokuqala - uyagonyuluka ngokumbulala esizana nasolwa nabo. Ngaphakathi enkantolo ummeli wakhe ozimele, wenze isicelo sokuthi ahlolwe ingqondo njengoba enomlando wokuthikamezeka komqondo.Owomndeni kamufi, uMnuz Sbonelo Cele, uthe babona sengathi uzama ukudlala umqondo umsolwa uma eveza eyokuthikamezeka komqondo."Uyazenzisa nesikholwa ukuthi kuhambisana neqhinga lakhe ngakwenzile. Ufuna ukuthi kubambezeleke icala, lize lisuke emehlweni omphakathi,” kusho uCele. Uthe kungamampunge ukuthi unomlando wokuthikamezeka ngokomqondo, waveza eyokuthi uwumuntu ohlakaniphile futhi ozinike isikhathi ehlela eyokubulala umufi."Waqala ukuzenza omkhulu umngani kaKholwani ezinyangeni ezimbili ngaphambi kokuba ambulale. Ubewumuntu ongaphuzi kodwa wabuqala enzela ukuthi basondelane ngoba uKholwani ubephuza,” kusho uCele.Uthe wayesefika njalo kubo, eze kumufi, baphuze utshwala ndawonye. "Wayeze afike ewuphethe ubhiya, bawuphuze. Lokhu kukhomba ukuthi wayeyihlela kahle eyokumbulala. Kangangoba sisola ukuthi nangosuku ambulala ngalo ubafo, asikholwa ukuthi wamthatha ngenkani, wambiza nje kahle, naye waya ngoba engamxwayi,” usho kanje.Ngesikhathi kuqhubeka icala enkantolo, bobabili abameli babasolwa batshele inkantolo ukuthi abasolwa bayasilaxaza isicelo sebheyili. UMbhele ubemelwe ozimele, kuthi uMkhonto noPhungula bemelwe okahulumeni.UCele uthe bayasemukela isinqumo sabasolwa ngoba bekuzoba nzima ukuphinde babhekane nabo endaweni kulandela into abayenzile. "Sibona sengathi bebebona nabo ukuthi umphakathi awusabadingi. Besisasho nje ukuthi asazi ukuthi sizohlala kanjani nabo uma kungenzeka bededelwa ngebheyili. Besingafuni bayithole ngoba asazi bebezohlalaphi uma bededelwa,” kusho uCele. Uthe bebekhathazeke ngokuthi ngeke bakwazi ukulawula umphakathi odiniwe. "Ukuphuma kwabo bekuzosifaka ekukhulumeni siwumndeni,” usho kanje.Uqhube wathi abakholwa ukuthi yiso ngempela lesi sizathu asitshele amaphoyisa, esenze wabulala umufi.UMbhele ngesikhathi egonyuluka emaphoyiseni, wawatshela ukuthi umufi umbulalele ukuthi ubethandana nomkakhe. UCele uthe: "Asikholwa ukuthi yisona sizathu lesi. Sisola ukuthi sikhona esinye asifihle ngale, okuyisona sona.” Uthe lokhu ukusho ngoba bobabili umufi nomkamsolwa, ababukeki bengabantu ebebengaganga emakhoneni. Imantshi, uNkk Wendolyn Robinson ilihlehlisele uMashi 4, icala ukuze kuqhutshekwe nophenyo, nokuthi kwenziwe uhlelo lokuthi uMbhele ayohlolwa ingqondo.Enkantolo bekugcwele kuvalwe ngomuntu emnyango. Kuphoqe ukuthi kusale inqwaba ngaphandle, ingasekho indawo yokuhlala. Selisongiwe icala, umphakathi obuwotha ubomvu, wenze umbhikisho ngaphandle kwenkantolo, usola umsolwa wokuqala ngokuzenzisa kulandela ukuvela kokuthi kufanele ayohlolwa ingqondo.
Usomabhizinisi uVusimuzi "Cat” Matlala nabasolwa abane bavele kafushane enkantolo eNkulu yaseGoli ngoxhaxha lwamacala.Lokhu kungokokuqala uMatlala evele enkantolo selokhu uMnyango wokuHlunyeleliswa kweziMilo wamsusa eKgosi Mampuru II Correctional Facility wamyisa eBongweni, okuyijele eliqine kakhulu kwezokuphepha ezweni.UMatlala, unkosikazi wakhe uTsakane Matlala naboshwe nabo abathathu babhekene namacala okwakha itulo lokubulala, ukushushumbisa imali nokukhwabanisa.Wonke amadokodo abekwe endaweni eyodwa njengoba icala lasuswa eNkantolo yeMantshi yase-Alexandra ngomhla ka-27 Okthoba 2025.Ngesikhathi kuqhubeka icala, ummeli kaMatlala u-Advocate Annelene Van den Heever utshele inkantolo ukuthi kukhona amaphepha asele okwenza kube nzima ukulungiselela.Icala lizobuyela enkantolo ngoLwesihlanu mhla ka-6 Febhuwari 2026.
UMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa uyalele uNgqongqoshe wezamaPhoyisa obambile, uSolwazi Firoz Cachalia, kanye noKhomishana wamaPhoyisa - uGeneral Fannie Masemola, ukuba babumbe ithimba elizophenya bonke abachaphazelekayo kwiKhomishini kaMadlanga.Lokhu kulandela isimemezelo sangoJulayi 13, lapho uRamaphosa amemezela ukusungulwa kwekhomishini okuyimanje iphenya ngobugebengu, ukugxambukela kosopolitiki emsebenzini wamaphoyisa besenzisana nemigulukudu.Izinsolo ezibucayi ezenziwa nguKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi ngoJulayi 6.IKhomishini, eholwa yiJaji leNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo eselithathe umhlalaphansi uMbuyiseli Madlanga, elekelelwa u-Advocate Sesi Baloyi SC no-Advocate Sandile Khumalo SC, yethule umbiko wayo wesikhashana ngoDisemba 17 ngokuhambisana nesikhathi esasinqunywe umengameli. URamaphosa usewuhlolisisile umbiko wesikhashana futhi wazamukela izincomo zawo.Kuvele ukuthi uRamaphosa ulindele ukuthi zonke izikhungo eziqinisekisa ukuthotshelwa komthetho kanye nezobulungiswa zisebenzisane ngokushesha ekufezekiseni izincomo zombiko wesikhashana weKhomishini kaMadlanga. Ikhomishini ithe kunobufakazi obuqand’ikhanda bokwenza okungalungile, iye yadlulisela amacala ukuze kuphenywe yizikhulu ezifanele zophiko lweSAPS, Independent Police Investigative Directorate (IPID) noma uMasipala wase-Ekurhuleni.Lokhu kuthinta nalezi zikhulu ezilandelayo zakwaSAPS: Major General Lesetja Senona Major General Richard Shibiri Brigadier Mbangwa Nkhwashu Brigadier Rachel Matjeng Sergeant Fannie NkosiUbufakazi obusobala bokuphulwa komthetho buphinde batholwa yikhomishini mayelana nalaba basebenzi abalandelayo bamanje nabake besebenza kuMasipala wase-Ekurhuleni: IPhini leKhomishana yamaPhoyisa e-EMPD uBrigadier Julius Mkhwanazi Isikhulu se-EMPD uBafana Twala Isikhulu se-EMPD u-Aiden McKenzie Isikhulu se-EMPD uKershia Leigh Stols Owayeyimenenja yoMkhandlu wase-Ekurhuleni uDkt Imogen Mashazi Umphathi wezimoto kuMasipala wase-Ekurhuleni uMnuz Chris Steyn Inhloko yomnyango wezabasebenzi kuMasipala wase-Ekurhuleni uNksz Linda Gxasheka Inhloko yezomthetho kuMasipala wase-Ekurhuleni u-Adv Kemi Behari UMnuz Etienne van der Walt
OMASIPALA baKwaZulu-Natal abathola ingxenye enkulu yesabelomali, iTheku noMsunduzi, bamdibi munye nemikhandlu yakulesi sifundazwe esengcupheni yokuphelelwa yimali.ITheku noMsunduzi basohlwini lwemikhandlu yaKwaZulu-Natal engenayo imali eyanele ukubhekana nezindleko zansuku zonke.Lokhu kuvezwe wuMphathiswa wokuBusa ngokuBambisana kanye neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, obekhuluma emhlanganweni wamakomiti asePhalamende, elibhekele ukusebenza koMnyango wokuBusa ngokuBambisana kanye neziNdaba zoMdabu kanye nelibhekele ukusebenza kwemali yomphakathi. La makomiti ahambele KwaZulu-Natal ukuzobhunga ngezinkinga ezikhungethe omasipala.ITheku noMsunduzi iyona mikhandlu ethola iqatha elinonile uma kwabiwa imali. ITheku linesabelomali esingu-R70 billion, uMsunduzi uthola isabelomali esingu-R18 billion. UButhelezi uthe iTheku, uMsunduzi nabanye omasipala baKwaZulu-Natal abangu-15 ngeke bakwazi ukukhokhela izindleko zabo uma bengase bangazitholi izabelo eziqhamuka kuhulumeni wesifundazwe nokazwelonke. Ngokwemigomo ebekelwe omasipala, kufanele babe nemali engakhokhela izindleko zabo zesikhathi esiphakathi kwenyanga nezinyanga ezintathu."Iyakhathaza le nto esiyibonayo emikhandlwini. Omasipala kufanele babe nemali eyanele ukubhekana nezindleko zanyanga zonke."UButhelezi uthe abanye omasipala abamqwashisa ngisho ebusuku yiMpendle, Mpofana, aBaqulusi kanye nomasipala wesifunda uMkhanyakude.UButhelezi uthe isimo sibi kakhulu kuMasipala waseMpendle."NgoDisemba abasebenzi abaholanga ngesikhathi. Ngokolwazi esilutholile, nakule nyanga kungenzeka into efanayo."UButhelezi uthe izinkinga kuMasipala waseMpendle zaqala ngesikhathi kukhishwa imeya, uMnuz Buyisani Mlaba, ngevoti lokungabethembi ubuholi bakhe."Sekuze kwaphela izinyanga eziyisithupha ingakhethiwe imeya entsha. Ingxabano yezepolitiki isiphazamisa ukusebenza komkhandlu."UButhelezi uzoba nomhlangano namakhansela aseMpendle namhlanje.UButhelezi uthe uMasipala waseMpendle wawusele nemali engu-R1.9 million ebhange, ngoDisemba.UMphathiswa wezeziMali KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Francois Rodgers, uthe inkinga enkulu wukuthi abaholi bemikhandlu bayanqaba ukusebenzisana nezikhulu zomnyango ezisuke zijutshwe ukuba ziyolekelela imikhandlu ekhungethwe yizinkinga."Inkinga enkulu wukuthi awukho umthetho osinika amandla okuba singenelele komasipala. Uma sifika komasipala sithi sizolekelela ngoba sibona ukuthi babhekene nezinkinga, abaholi bemikhandlu bafike bangafuni ukubambisana nezikhulu ezisuke zijutshwe wumnyango. Esikhathini esiningi uthola ukuthi imenenja kamasipala isuke isho ukuthi umkhandlu uyaludinga usizo kodwa abaholi bezepolitiki kube yibona abanqaba usizo.URodgers uthe imikhandlu esike yanqaba usizo lomnyango owesifunda uMkhanyakude, Ugu nesifunda Amajuba."Esifundeni Ugu baqale balwamukela usizo, kwathi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi babuye bathi abasaludingi."
Ikomidi lesikhashana ePhalamende linqume ukufaka isicelo enkantolo usomabhizinisi waseNorth West uBrown Mogotsi ngemuva kokuthi enqabile ukuhambisana nesicelo sokuvela phambi kwalo.Ikomidi kulindeleke ukuthi lilalele ubufakazi bukaPaul O'Sullivan noMogotsi kuleli sonto.UMogotsi ufune iPhalamende ukuthi lixhase abaqaphi bakhe bezokuphepha, nokuholele ekutheni kube nohide lokukhathazeka ngenqubo kumalungu ekomiti.Ebika ekomidini, uNobhala uVhonani Ramaano uthe uMogotsi uqale wacela ukuvikeleka ophikweni lwezokuphepha ePhalamende. Nokho, ngesikhathi kwenziwa isicelo sokumhlangabeza nokumphelezela uma efika, uMogotsi ubuye washintsha. URamaano uqhube wathi naphezu kwemizamo yokuhlelela uMogotsi izindiza nezindawo zokulala, lo somabhizinisi uphikelele ekutheni asebenzise onogada bakhe abazimele wathi iPhalamende limxhase izinsuku eziyisikhombisa."Ngimthintile izolo ukuze ngihlele uhambo kodwa wangitshela ukuthi ngeke anginike inombolo kamazisi wakhe ngaphandle kokuthi izidingo zakhe zokuphepha zifezeke,” kusho uRamaano.Ukwenqaba lokhu kudale ukungezwani phakathi kwamalungu ekomidi, abanye bephakamisa ukuthi kuthathwe izinyathelo ezinqala. Usihlalo wekomidi u-Soviet Lekganyane uzwakalise ukungenami kwakhe ngokwenqaba kukaMogotsi ukulandela izinqubo zekomidi, ebiza izimfuno zakhe 'ngeziyinhlekisa futhi nezingamukeleki.""Ufuna abakhe onogada kodwa futhi ucela iPhalamende ukuthi limkhokhele izinsuku eziyisikhombisa. Asikwazi ukwamukela lezi zidingo. IPhalamende alikwazi ukumnika uhlobo lokuvikelwa alucelayo," esho.Ilungu leMK Party ephalamende uSibonelo Nomvalo, kalizange lisinise amahleza uma lithi ikomidi akufanele limoshe isikhathi lidingida lolu daba."Lena akuyona into edinga umhlangano. Ithimba labameli kumele limbize ngokushesha. Ngeke sivumele uMogotsi abukele phansi igunya laleli komidi," esho.
USIZI luzwa olunye kuMasipala waseMpendle osekuyinto eyaziwayo ukuthi ubhekene nenkinga yemali.Kuvela ukuthi abasebenzi balo masipala sebephindwe yinduku efanayo neyangoKhisimusi njengoba bengakakhokhelwa imiholo yabo kaJanuwari.Esitatimendeni esikhishwe wumasipala, uveza ukuthi izobambezeleka imiholo yabasebenzi kule nyanga.Lapha umasipala ubalula ukuthi lokhu kungenxa yezizathu ezihlukene okuyizona eziwumnyombo wale ngwadla.Uveza ukuthi ukweletwa yiminyango ehlukene kahulumeni kanye nomasipala wesifunda uMgungundlovu.Uthe isiyonke imali abakweletwa yona ilinganiselwa ku-R20 million. Uveza ukuthi uxoxisana noMnyango weMisebenzi yoMphakathi neNgqalasizinda kanye nomasipala wesifunda uMgungundlovu ukuthola ukuthi bangakhokhelwa kanjani imali abakweletwa yona.Uveze nokuthi baxhumana noMphathiswa wokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi ukubona ukuthi yini engenziwa. Kuvele nokuthi kunezingxoxo eziqhubekayo noMnyango kaMgcinimafa kazwelonke ngalolu daba.Siqhuba isitatimende siveze ukuthi umasipala uzokwenza konke okusemandleni ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amaholo abasebenzi bayawathola ngoLwesihlanu.Abasebenzi nezinhlangano ezibamele kuthiwa bazisiwe ngakho konke okuqhubekayo mayelana namaholo.Abasebenzi bakulo masipala kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi babe noKhisimusi omnyama ngenxa yokungaholi.Ikhansela le-IFP eMpendle, uMnuz Sadewu Ngubane, lakhala ngokuthi indala inkinga yemali kulo masipala.Wadalula ukuthi umasipala uphila ngokuboleka imali ukuze uholele abasebenzi.Waveza ukuthi umasipala usugqigqe wonke amabhange ufaka izicelo zokubolekwa imali kodwa kwanhlanga zimuka nomoya."Inkinga iqale ngesikhathi umasipala ungasakwazi ukuholela abasebenzi ngaphandle kokuboleka," kusho uNgubane.
UMNTWANA waseNdlunkulu kaZulu ubona isinqumo seNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo esithinta imishado sizokwenza ukuthi abantu babe manqika ukushada umshado wesintu.UMntwana omkhulu wasoNkweni, u-Africa Zulu, uthe isinqumo senkantolo sangeledlule senza kubukeke sengathi kuyingozi ukushada umgcagco wesintu, uthi lokho kudala itwetwe nongabazane.Inkantolo inqume ukuthi abantu abagcagce ngokwesintu bafana nabashade umshado ohlanganisa amafa, akukhathaleki noma ngabe kuthiwa babuye bashada umshado wephepha ohlukanisa amafa emva komgcagco.Ngokwesinqumo senkantolo ukukhokhwa kwelobolo kusho ukuthi nisuke senishade umshado ohlanganisa amafa.Inkantolo ibihlulela ecaleni lezithandani ezaqala ngomgcagco wesintu, ngaphambi kokuthi zishade umshado ohlukanisa amafa. Inkantolo ithe umgcagco wesintu yiwona esemthethweni ngoba izithandani zaqala ngawo. UMntwana u-Africa uthe ukukhishwa kwelobolo kusuke kungasho ukuthi sekuqedwe konke okuthinta umshado."Kusuke nje kuseyisiqalo lesi lapho umkhwenyana ekhombisa izinhloso zakhe. Kuningi okusuke kusazolandela lapho imindeni yakha ubuhlobo."UMntwana u-Africa uthe baningi abathuswe yisinqumo sangeledlule."Akufanele sisithathe kancane lesi sinqumo ngoba asithinti nje kuphela abantu abebeyingxenye yecala kodwa sithinta abantu jikelele. Akukuhle uma inkantolo izokhipha isinqumo esikhombisa ukuthi kuyingozi ukushada umshado wesintu. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi abantu abaningi babe manqika ukushada umshado wesintu. Abantu abasha bazowubalekela umgcagco wesintu."UMntwana u-Africa uthe akufanele kugxekwe izinkantolo ngesinqumo wathi kodwa kufanele kugxekwe iPhalamende."Izinkantolo azishayi imithetho kodwa zona zihumusha imithetho. IPhalamende yilona elishaya imithetho. Kufanele sizibuze ukuthi ngabe abantu abasePhalamende bawenza ngendlela yini umsebenzi wabo. Imithetho kufanele ihambisane nendlela abantu abaphila ngayo. Imithetho eminingi ayihambisani nendlela yokuphila nokwenza sizibuze ukuthi ngabe abantu abashaya imithetho bayayazi yini into abayenzayo."UMntwana u-Africa uthe miningi imithetho eshaywa yiPhalamende engahambisani nabantu."Kuningi esikubukayo okungahambisani nesintu. Kufana nomthetho ovumela indoda ukuba ithathe isibongo sikankosikazi. Noma ngabe ulubuka kanjani lolu daba kodwa iqiniso wukuthi lokhu akuhambisani nesiko. IPhalamende kufanele lixhumane kahle nemiphakathi ngaphambi kokushaya imithetho."
ILENGELWA yizembe iNhloko yoKlebe KwaZulu-Natal, uMajor General Lesetja Senona, esolwa ngokuba wubhululu kasomabhizinisi obhekene noxhaxha lwamacala, uMnuz Vusumuzi "Cat" Matlala. USenona uthole incwadi emazisa ukuthi uzoqondiswa ubugwegwe, aphinde ashintshelwe kwesinye isikhundla ngenxa yokuvela kwezinsolo zokuthi wayeputshuzela uMatlala ulwazi oluyimfihlo lwasemaphoyiseni.Lokhu kuvezwe uSenona izolo, ngesikhathi evele phambi kweKhomishini eholwa yiJaji uMbuyiseli Madlanga. Izinsolo zokuthi uSenona usondelene noMatlala zenziwa wuKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi. UMkhwanazi wathi indodana kaSenona, uThato Senona, isebenzisana noMatlala kwezamabhizinisi. USenona uvumile ukuthi bayazana noMatlala kodwa waphika ukuthi wayemputshuzela ulwazi oluyimfihlo.USenona uthe uthole incwadi emazisa ukuthi kuzophenywa izinsolo zokungaziphathi kahle kwakhe. "Lena yimizamo nje yokungisabisa. Namanje ngisazibuza ukuthi kungani le ncwadi ngiyithunyelelwe manje ngoba sekufanele ngizovela phambi kwekhomishini? Ngabe bonke abantu okubalulwe amagama abo kule khomishini nabo benziwa le nto engenziwa yona?"USenona uthe bahlangana noMatlala emshadweni, bagcina sebengabangani emthatha njengomfowabo. Uthe babengaxoxi ngezinto ezithinta umsebenzi. Uthe wayengazi ukuthi uMatlala uphenywa amaphoyisa, wathi waqala ukuhlehla kuMatlala ngesikhathi kuvela imibiko yokuthi uphenywa amaphoyisa. USenona uthe wayengazi ukuthi indodana yakhe isebenzisana noMatlala kwezamabhizinisi. "Ngathuka ngelinye ilanga engibuza ukuthi ngiyamazi yini uThato. Ngaphendula ngasho ukuthi ngiyamazi, uyindodana yami. Wabe esengitshela ukuthi usebenzisana naye kwezamabhizinisi."USenona uveze ukuthi wake waphelezela uMatlala eyohlangana noMkhwanazi. Uthe umhlangano wawuhlelwe owayengungqongqoshe wamaphoyisa, uMnuz Bheki Cele. Ngaleso sikhathi kwakuyokhulunywa ngethenda eyayitholwe uMatlala emaphoyiseni. USenona uthe uMkhwanazi wagcina ethembisa ukwelekelela uMatlala uma engamnika ulwazi olwalungaholela ekuboshweni kwePhini likaKhomishana wamaPhoyisa, uLieutenant General Shadrack Sibiya.USenona uthe uMkhwanazi wathembisa nokuthi amaphoyisa azomisa uphenyo ecaleni lokuzama ukubulala umlingisi owayeyisinqandamathe sikaMatlala, uTeboho Thobejane. USenona uthe uMkhwanazi umthumelela imiyalezo emsabisayo.Omunye umyalezo ofundiwe izolo, uMkhwanazi utshela uSenona ngezinto azofike akhulume ngazo emhlanganweni wasePhalamende.Kulo myalezo, uMkhwanazi uveza ukuthi uzofike atshele ikomiti lasePhalamende ngezinsolo zokuthi uSibiya unikwa ngusomabhizinisi thizeni imali nokuthi wathengelwa ngusomabhizinisi thizeni umuzi kanye nepulazi.UMkhwanazi uqhuba athi unethemba lokuthi ukuveza kwakhe lobu bufakazi angeke kufake uMatlala enkingeni.
ISINQUMO sokuthi uMnuz Bonginkosi Khanyile athumelele uNkk uDuduzile Sambudla-Zuma, oyindodakazi kaMengameli weMKP, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, ama-video asiziqondanelanga nje, babekhulume kaningi ngokwakwenzeka ngezibhelu zango-2021 konke kwiWhatsApp.Lokhu kushiwo wuKhanyile izolo ngesikhathi ethula ubufakazi bakhe eNkantolo yesifunda yaseThekwini. UKhanyile usolwa ngokugqugquzela izibhelu ezaqala ngoJulayi 9, 2021. Wayefuna ukuba kudedelwe uZuma owayeboshelwe ukuziba umyalelo wenkantolo mayelana nokungaveli kwakhe kwikhomishini eyayiphenya ngokulawulwa koMbuso yidlanzana. Utshele inkantolo ukuthi isinqumo sokuthi athumele ama-video akhe enxenxa abantu ukuthi baqhubeke bashise izwe kuNkk Zuma-Sambudla ngoJulayi 10, 2021, awamananga aziqondanela. UMshushisi woMbuso, u-Advocate Yuri Gangai ubuze uKhanyile ngezinsuku okwaqoshwa ngazo ama-video abonakala kuwo enxenxa umphakathi ukuthi uqhubeke ushise izwe, uvale imigwaqo kuze kube wukuthi uZuma uyadedelwa.Uphendule ngokuthi aqoshwa phakathi kukaJulayi 18 kuya ku-26, 2021. UGangai ukhumbuze uKhanyile ukuthi ngesikhatih ethula ubufakazi bakhe eholwa wuMbuso wayekubeke kwacaca ukuthi aqoshwa ngoJulayi 26, 2021. UKhanyile utshele uGangai ukuthi kwakukulezo zinsuku, ngeke akwazi ukusho usuku oluqondile. "Ngifuna ukukutshela njengamanje ukuthi udukisa inkantolo ngamabomu,” kusho uGangai.UKhanyile umphendule ngelithi uvumelekile ukuthi abeke umbono wakhe, njengoba naye uGangai evumelekile ukuthi enze okufanayo. UGangai uqhubekile nokumcindezela kakhulu uKhanyile, embuza ukuthi kungani phambilini akwazi ukukhumbula ukuthi ama-video athathwa ngoJulayi 26. UKhanyile uthe wakhumbula ngoba badla inyama emva kokuthi eseqedile ukukhuluma, banikwa inyama yamahhala wumuntu odayisa inhloko emgwaqweni. "Manje usuyakhumbula ukuthi kwakunguJulayi 26?” kubuza uGangai. UKhanyile uphendule ngelithi kungenzeka kube olunye lwalezo zinsuku.Ebuzwa ngemiyalezo ayithumelela uNkk Duduzile Zuma-Sambudla ngoJulayi 10, uKhanyile uthe akuvelanga kwaziqondanela nje, babekukhulume konke nendodakazi kaZuma, uNkk Zuma-Sambudla. Ngokobufakazi obusenkantolo, uKhanyile wayethumela ama-video kuNkk Zuma-Sambudla, awalandelise ngombhalo. UGangai umyalele ukuthi afunde umyalezo kaWhatsApp awuthumela kuNkk Zuma-Sambudla mayelana nama-video akhe ekhuluma nezihlwele. "Enye yaserenki yamatekisi eMlaza, iyeza. Ngiyayithumela. Abantu bami noMengameli Zuma, khululeka,” kufundeka umyalezo. Icala liyaqhubeka.
USOLA ukuthi umsolwa wumuntu owaziwayo umndeni wowesilisa obethandana nabantu abanobulili obufana nobakhe, okuthiwa ubulawe ngesihluku eNumber 9, KwaXimba, ngeSonto. Isidumbu sikaMnuz Sbongimpilo Mzobe (19) obedume ngelikaShanah sitholwe amalungu omphakathi sintanta emfuleni athinta amaphoyisa.Ngokusho kukanina, uNksz Nelisiwe Mzobe, ubuntu bendodana yakhe bebuhleshulwe ngento ethize, amehlo ephuma igazi, ikhihliza amagwebu ngomlomo, ingalo isontekile, enye ihuzukile, kukhombisa ukuthi ibihudulwa. Utshele Isolezwe ukuthi indodana yakhe ibulawa nje ibisibuyile ebumnandini futhi likhona nelungu lomndeni ekhulume nalo ngesikhathi ifika ekhaya."Ubuye ngabo-3 ekuseni, wangena endlini elala wonke umuntu, washintsha izingubo abezigqokile, wafaka iphinifa likaninakhulu,” kusho uNksz Mzobe.Uthe ukuxoxaxoxa noninakhulu, emi ngasemnyango, kwase kuba khona omumemezayo.Uthe uphendule ngelithi: "Ngiyeza hawu”, okudwebe isithombe sokuthi uyamazi umuntu obememeza. Uninakhulu uvuke sekusile wayombheka kwenye indlu ajwayela ukubuya alale kuyo uma ekade eye ebumnandini, wathola kukhala ibhungane."Kuthe uma ephuma khona, waqaphela ukuthi kukhona umphakathi namaphoyisa ebebebuthene ebhulohweni lomfula ongezansi komuzi. Kube sekuqhamuka umakhelwane embuza ukuthi uyabona yini ukuthi kwenzekani, bathathana baya khona,” usho kanje.Uthe yilapho abafike bathola khona ukuthi umshophi ubhekene nabo. Uveze ukuthi baqaphele ukuthi isidumbu sisongwe ngokusangubo abevame ukulala ngayo kule ndlu engaphandle, ophisi bephinifa bebegaxeke ebhulohweni, kukhombisa ukuthi ubehudulwa. "Sisola ukuthi ungenile endlini abevame ukulala kuyo, walala, lo muntu wamhlaselela khona, ngaphambi kokuba amsonge ngengubo, amhudule, ayomphonsa emfuleni,” kusho uNksz Mzobe.Uthe basola ukuthi umenzi wobubi wumuntu amaziyo umufi, angazange amxwaye, wathi basola lo obememeza, asabele kuye ngendlela ekhombisa ukuthi bayazana."Ubeyigwala kabi. Ukube bekungumuntu angamazi, ubezohayiza, abalekele endlini enomndeni,” usho kanje.Uthe kukhona nemiyalezo abayibone kwiselula yakhe, ikhombisa ukuthi kukhona umuntu abexoxa naye kwiFacebook kusuka ngoNovemba, ede embizela khona ebhulohweni. "Ubephendula ngokuthi akeze yena ekhaya lo muntu, emtshela ukuthi uyasaba ukuthi kube wuye oya ebhulohweni ngoba mhlawumbe uzomdubula isitho sangasese. Manje sesizibuza imibuzo njengoba egcine elinyazwa kusona isitho sangasese,” kusho uNksz Mzobe.Uthe isithombe esifakwe yilo muntu, asibukhombisi ubuso kodwa sinomfaniswano wesikole sendawo nokwenza ziqine izinsolo zokuthi umsolwa wumuntu okhona endaweni.Uthe bafuna abanjwe khona ezochaza ukuthi umbulaleleni. Udalule ukuthi umufi ubethandwa kakhulu abesifazane endaweni, abesilisa bebebuye bamthuke abaphendule ngokuthi: "Njalo niyangithuka emini, kodwa ebusuku niyangifuna”. Kushaye isikhathi sokushicilela amaphoyisa engakaphefumuli ngodaba.
KUVELE okushaqisayo ngokwaholela ekubhidlikeni kweqembu lebhola labaculi bakamaskandi, iMaskandi FC.Ngaphambi kokuba leli qembu libe yinhlakanhlaka kukhona abanukwa ngokuthwala nangokuthwebula izinhlanhla zabanye, abanye babizwa ngaphansi kweziketi zonina, abanye bacishe babambana ngezandla, kwakhona ukufelana ngamathe futhi kwakhonjwana nangezibhamu.Akugcinanga lapho, kukhona osolwa ngokuzitika ngocansi nomfazi womunye wabaculi beMaskandi FC. Uthe uSmomoza uyabasanganela futhi ugqwaba udumo ngabo."Yiliphi ibhola olifunayo ngoba wena ubungayi emidlalweni, ubalekela amanyala owawenza ulala nomfazi womuntu esasidlala naye eqenjini. Uthe iqembu ladlala kwi-activation yeGcwalisa Spring Picnic ngo-Okthoba 2024."IMaskandi FC yadlala ngoJanuwari 2025, eWema. Ubukuphi wena? Yadlala eGoli ngoMashi 2025, kwi-activation yeCarnival City, ubukuphi wena?" UNtencane usole uSmomoza ngokufuna ukwakhela i-albhamu azoyikhipha isigcwagcwa emphakathini. IQEMBU i-Economic Freedom Fighters lithi kube yingcindezi eliyifakile ukuthi i-Independent Communications Authority of South Africa (Icasa) igcine inquma ukuthi i-airtime ne-data engasebenzanga ingaphelelwa yisikhathi.NgoLwesihlanu uSihlalo we-Icasa, uMothibi Ramusi, ushicilele kusomqulu kahulumeni izinguquko ezizoqala ezinyangeni ezingu-12 zikhishiwe.Phakathi kokubaluliwe wukuthi izinkampani zama-network kumele zithumele izikhumbuzo ngeSMS uma i-data, i-airtime noma amaSMS (ama-bundles) kuphela kusasele uhhafu noma sekusebenze u-80% noma sekuphele nya.Umnikazi usengazikhethela ukuthi uyazifuna yini noma cha izikhumbuzo.Uma ama-bundles engaphelanga ngesikhathi abekalelwe sona kumele angaboli, ngokwe-Icasa, ngaphandle uma kuyilawo ezinsuku eziyisikhombisa.Izinkampani ziyalelwe ukuthi zisebenzise ama-bundles anesikhathi esesizophela kuqala ngaphambi kokungenela amanye.I-Icasa ithe umuntu usezokwazi ukudlulisela komunye ama-bundles noma ingcosana ngemigomo nemibandela efanayo nawathenge ngayo.I-EFF esitatimendeni ithe ibihlale imile ekutheni i-data ne-airtime akuzona izinto ezibolayo ngakho akumele ziphelelwe yisikhathi."Le mpumelelo iwumphumela womkhankaso we-EFF ePhalamende nangaphandle. I-EFF ibilokhu iyiphakamisa le ndaba kusuka ngo-2024 ekomitini lezokuxhumana lapho ibhekane khona ngqo ne-Icasa nehhovisi likangqongqoshe ngemithetho engenabulungiswa yokuphelelwa yisikhathi kwalokhu."Ithe iphinde yaxhumana nezinkampani okubalwa kuzo iMTN, Vodacom nezinye yakubeka kwacaca ukuthi indlela yokusebenza ayihambisani noMthethosisekelo.
