UMNYANGO wezeMpilo usuwehlise amaphaphu abantu bakuleli abadla imishanguzo yokuthithibalisa i-HIV, ama-ARV, ukuthi bazoqhubeka bayithole ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka.Okhulumela owezeMpilo, uMnuz Foster Mohale, uthe ngeke kube nokuphaziseka kokusatshalaliswa kwale mishanguzo kuleli ngenxa yokuthi izinkampani ezenza lo msebenzi zibhekene nezingqinamba zokuthi zingase zivalwe.Uthe ikhona le mishanguzo ngakho ngeke kwenzeke kube nokuphazamiseka."Umsebenzi wokusabalalisa ama-ARV wanikwa izinkampani ezehlukene ukuze iqhubeke nokusatshalaliswa ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka. Siyazi izinkampani ezimbili ezathola lo msebenzi zinezinselelo ngakho zingase zivalwe. Yingakho sihlale sinayo imishanguzo enqolobaneni ngakho ngeke sibe nenkinga yokuthi iphele," usho kanje. Uthe sebekhulume nezinye izinkampani abasebenzisana nazo ukuthi zinyuse isibalo semishanguzo eziyihambisayo ukuze kuvaleke isikhala esidalwe yilezi zinkampani ezibhekene nenkinga."Sinemishanguzo ezokhava izinyanga eziyisithupha kanti siyaqhubeka nokuqapha ngelokhozi ukuhanjiswa kwayo. Lokhu sikwenza ngoba singafuni kube nokubambezeleka." Uthe bayazi umthelela ongabakhona uma ngase baphelelwe yile mishanguzo."Abadla imishanguzo abaqhubeke bayilande njengokujwayelekile ezikhungweni zabo. Kuseqhulwini eMnyangweni ukuthi kungabi nokuphazamiseka ekuhanjisweni kwayo." Bangaphezu kuka-6 million abantu bakuleli abadla ama-ARV, kubantu ababalelwa ku-8 million abahaqwe yileli gciwane.I-DA ifuna uNgqongqoshe wezeMpilo, uDkt Aaron Motsoaledi, avele ngaphambi kwePhalamende azochazela isizwe ngale nkinga.Ithe ifuna kwazeke ukuthi bayilungisa kanjani njengoba lezi zinkampani zisenkingeni yezezimali okungenza kuphazamise ukuhanjiswa kwale mishanguzo kubantu abayidlayo.Kwenzeka lokhu nje, uMnyango usemkhankasweni wokufuna abantu abalaxaza le mishanguzo ngezizathu ezehlukene kuleli. Uhambela izindawo ezehlukene okubalwa nalapho kuhlanganyela khona abesilisa, okuyibona abanesibalo esiphezulu sabantu abayeka imishanguzo ukuze babuyiselwe ohlelweni lokuthi bayidle futhi.
UNGOTI wezemfundo kuleli, uSolwazi Mary Metcalfe, uphakamise ukuthi kuqiniswe kakhulu emazingeni aphansi emfundo ngokuthi kwehliswe ukugcwala kwamakilasi okwenza othisha bathwale kanzima.USolwazi Metcalfe uthe akusizi ukugxila emazingeni aphezulu ekubeni kuntenga emazingeni aphansi ngoba nocwaningo luyaveza ukuthi abafundi abakuqondi abakufundayo."Agcwele kakhulu amakilasi emazingeni aphansi uma uqhathanisa namazinga aphezulu. Kumele kushintshe lokhu uma sifuna ukuphucula izinga lemfundo sehlise ukugcwala kakhulu kwamakilasi ukuze uthisha akwazi ukufundisa isibalo esifanele," usho kanje ngesikhathi ephakamisa izinto abona ukuthi kumele zenziwe kulo mkhakha. Ukusho lokhu emva kwengqungquthela ebingeledlule eGauteng, lapho bekubhekwa imfundo eyisisekelo. Ingqungquthela yayithanyelwe nanguMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, owakhala ngokuthi kumele kuqiniswe emazingeni aphansi ukuze abafundi baqonde abakufundayo.USolwazi Metcalfe uthe uyahambisana nokuthi kubuyekezwe uhlelo lokwabiwa kothisha ezikoleni zakuleli kusetshenziswa isibalo sabafundi.UMnyango weMfundo eyisiSekelo usebenzisa uhlelo lwePost-Provisioning Norms (PPN), ukwaba othisha ngokwesibalo sabafundi. Uma kwehla isibalo sabafundi, othisha bayasuswa bayiswe ezikoleni okwanda kuzona abafundi kusetshenziswa lolu hlelo. "Siyazi ukuthi ikomiti elajutshwa nguNgqongqoshe womnyango, (Nksz Siviwe Gwarube), limatasa nomsebenzi wokubuyekeza indaba yePPN. Siyahambisana nokubuyekezwa kwalolu hlelo ngoba kumele sandise isibalo emazingeni aphansi ukuze sinqande izinkinga ezikhona kwezemfundo zisuka amadaka," usho kanje.Okunye leli thimba elikwenzayo wukubuyekeza indaba yokukleliswa kwezikole ngokwama-Quintile.Izikole kuleli zikleliswe ngokwama-Quintile amahlanu. U-Quintile 1 kuya ku-3 yizikole okungakhokhwa kuzona imali yokufunda, ezithengelwa wuhulumeni izincwadi ne-stationery kanti zihlomula nasohlelweni lokudla nsuku zonke. Iningi lalezi zikole lisemakhaya nasemalokishini. U-Quintile 4 no-5 yizikole ezisemadolobheni iningi lazo okukhokhwa imali yesikole kanti ezinye azihlomuli ngezinsiza ezifana nokudla. Umnyango uxhasa lezi zikole ngemali encane uma kuqhathaniswa nokungakhokhwa nhlobo kuzona.Sikhulu isikhalo ngokukleliswa kwezikole ngale ndlela njengoba nezinyunyana zothisha zihlale zikhala ngokuthi izikole ziba ngomakhelwane, kodwa uthole ukuthi aziklelisiwe ngokufana ngokwama-Quintile. UNksz Gwarube wathi ujube ikomiti afuna limluleke ngezinto ezehlukene kwezemfundo okuhlale kukhalwa ngazo.
AMAPHOYISA atshelwa ngetulo lokubulawa kowayengunobhala jikelele we-ANC Youth League, uMnuz Sindiso Magaqa, kusasele amasonto amabili asocongwe.Izikhulu zamaphoyisa kuthiwa azizange zilusukumele lolu daba nokwaholela ekutheni uMagaqa abulawe.Lokhu kuhlaluke ngesikhathi kuqhubeka ikhomishini ephenya izinsolo ezenziwa wuKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi. Ufakazi oyiphoyisa utshele ikhomishini eholwa yiJaji uMbuyiseli Madlanga ukuthi waluma indlebe izikhulu zamaphoyisa ngetulo lokusoconga.Ufakazi ofihliwe uthe ulwazi ngetulo lokubulawa kukaMagaqa waluthola komunye owayeyilungu leqembu lemigulukudu eyayibamba inkunzi izimoto zemali.Ufakazi ofihliwe uthe leli lungu leqembu lezigebengu lase liphenduke ingede yakhe."Ilungu leqembu lezigebengu langitshela ukuthi bathengiwe ukuba babulale umuntu."Ufakazi uthe wayazi ngisho namagama abaholi be-ANC ababakha itulo. Ufakazi uthe laba baholi be-ANC babehlangene namaphoyisa ophiko lwezinhloli."Imoto eyasetshenziswa laphaya kanye nesibhamu okwamaphoyisa ophikweni lwezinhloli."UMagaqa wadutshulwa wabulawa ngo-2017.Inkabi eyavuma icala lokubulala uMagaqa, uSibusiso Ncengwa, yagwetshwa iminyaka engu-85.Abalisa abathathu, uMnuz Sibonelo Myeza, Mbulelo Mpofana, kanye nowayeyimenenja kaMasipala waseMzimkhulu, uMnuz Zweliphansi Sikhosana, babhekene necala lokubulala uMagaqa.Ufakazi utshele inkantolo ukuthi wafonelwa wuNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa omisiwe, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, embuza ngaleli cala.Ufakazi uthe uMchunu wayefuna ukwazi ukuthi owayenguNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa, uMnuz Bheki Cele, kanye nomholi wethimba lamaphoyisa eliphenya amacala okubulawa kosopolitiki KwaZulu-Natal ophinde abe wumholi wezinhloli, uLieutenant General Dumisani Khumalo, abathinteki yini etulweni lokusocongwa kukaMagaqa."Ngamchazela ukuthi uKhumalo akathinteki kulokhu. Ngesikhathi kubulawa uMagaqa, uKhumalo wayengakabi sophikweni lwezinhloli. Ngamchazela nakuCele ukuthi wayengakabi ungqongqoshe ngesikhathi kubulawa uMagaqa."Ufakazi uthe uMchunu wazama ukumncenga ukuba asho izinto ezinhle ngaye uma esethula ubufakazi phambi kwekhomishini.Uthe wayefuna ukuthi asho izinto ezimbi ngethimba lamaphoyisa eliphenya ukubulawa kosopolitiki KwaZulu-Natal."Wayefuna ukuthi ngimtholele bonke abantu abahlukunyezwa yithimba, futhi ngibhale isitatimende esenza izinsolo zokuthi ithimba lathenga izimoto zikanokusho."Ufakazi uthe uMchunu wayemfonela ngezinombolo ezihlukene.Uthe uMchunu wamthembisa ukuthi uzophila kahle uma engase amnikeze isitatimende esisho izinto ezivuna yena.Ekuseni kuqale kwafakaza iPhini likaKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal elibambile, uMajor General Anthony Gopaul.UGopaul uthe uMchunu wake wafika esiteshini samaphoyisa efuna ukwazi ukuthi kungani engaboshiwe amadodana omuntu owayemele iMKP okhethweni lokuchibiyela olwalukuMasipala waKwaDukuza.UGopaul uthe uMchunu wafika efake umfaniswano we-ANC, wafuna ukwazi ukuthi kungani amaphoyisa engawabophi amadodana kaMnuz Doeshiee Govender.UGopaul uthe uMchunu wayekade ezokhankasela i-ANC okhethweni lokuchibiyela okwagcina kunqoba kulo uGovender.UGovender wayekade ehlubuke kuyo i-ANC. UGopaul uthe amacala athinta amadodana kaGovender ayemadala."Amanye enzeka ngo-2016. Ngazibuza ukuthi kungani isikhalo sesiqhamuka manje ngoba nakhu sekubhekwe okhethweni lokuchibiyela. Akekho futhi umuntu owabuye wakhala ngalamacala emva kokhetho."UGopaul uthe uMchunu wayefuna nokwazi nokwakuqhubeka ngecala lokubulawa kwekhansela le-ANC kuMasipala waseMandeni, uMnuz Phendukani Mabhida.UGopaul uthe uMchunu wakhombisa ukungakujabuleli ukuthi leli cala laliphenywa yithimba lamaphoyisa eliphenya ukubulawa kosopolitiki KwaZulu-Natal ngenxa yokuthi wayesekhiphe umyalelo wokuthi lihlakazwe ithimba.
KUHLUKENE imibono kongoti mayelana nomkhankaso oqalwe yiSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini wokushintsha igama lesifundazwe iKwaZulu-Natal.Ungoti wezamasiko uncome umkhankaso weMbube wokuba kususwe igama uNatal egameni lesifundazwe, sibizwe ngeKwaZulu, kanti umhlaziyi wezepolitiki yena ukhombise ukungahambisani nalolu shintsho.INdlulamithi yamakhosi yenze isimemezelo ngalo mkhankaso ngesikhathi ikhuluma eMkhosini waseSandlwana, ngeledlule.IMbube ithe uNatal kufanele ukhishwe ngoba ayiwazi ukuthi uqhamukaphi."KuKwaZulu la, lo Natal iwona osidalela izinkinga."ISilo uGoodwill Zwelithini kaZwelithini sake saqala umkhankaso ofanayo ngo-2006 kodwa wagcina uphelela emoyeni.Ungoti wezamasiko waseNyuvesi yaKwaZulu-Natal, uSolwazi Sihawu Ngubane, uthe uNatal kwakuvele kuyigama elaqhamuka nabamhlophe ngesikhathi befika lapha.UNgubane uthe kufanele luqalwe ngokushesha uhlelo lokushintshwa kwegama lesifundazwe."Njengoba iSilo sesikhulumile ukuthi ukuba negama nesibongo kwesifundazwe kwenza ukuthi abantu bengahlangani, akuqalwe uhlelo ngokushesha. Udaba olusingathwa yiPhalamende, ikomiti lokuqanjwa kwamagama alingeni kulolu daba. Kufanele kube khona ozokwenza isethulo ePhalamende ukuze kuqale uhlelo."UNgubane uthe ziningi ezinye izifundazwe okufanele ziqanjwe kabusha njengoba kwenzeka ngo-2002, ngesikhathi kuqanjwa kabusha iLimpopo, eyayibizwa ngeNorthern Province."Kukhona oNorthern Cape, North West, abangaqanjiwe. Bonke laba o-Eastern Cape nabo kufanele baqanjwe kabusha. Mningi kakhulu umsebenzi okusafanele wenziwe."Umhlaziyi wezepolitiki waseNyuvesi yaKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Zakhele Ndlovu, uthe akasiboni isidingo sokuba kushintshwe igama lesifundazwe."Lapha eNingizimu Afrika sekushintshwe amagama emigwaqo, awamabhilidi nawezikhumulo zezindiza. Lokho kusisize ngani?"UNdlovu uthe ukuqanjwa kwesifundazwe sibizwe ngeKwaZulu kungenza abanye bebone sengathi uZulu uphuma ibhodwe lawo, uba izwe elizimele."Izoshiya imibuzo eminingi le nto uma kuzokuba nesifundazwe lapha eNingizimu Afrika okuthiwa iKwaZulu. Siyazi ukuthi kunezwe iLesotho okungelabeSuthu, kube neSwatini okuyizwe lamaSwati. Abanye bengabuza ukuthi ngabe iKwaZulu nayo izokuba izwe elizimele?"UNdlovu uthe kungenzeka kube nezinhlangano zezepolitiki ezizokweseka ikhwelo leSilo ngenxa yokuthi zifuna ukuvotelwa amaZulu.
UWOTHA ubomvu uNobhala jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, ngokuvela kwemikhankaso omunye oseka yena, noweseka usomabhizinisi, uMnuz Patrice Motsepe, embangweni wokuhola i-ANC.UMbalula uthe bazothathelwa izinyathelo labo asebeqale ukukhuluma ngombango wezikhundla. Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba abebehambele umhlangano we-ANC, iLekgotla.I-ANC izokuba nengqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi ngonyaka ozayo.Yize i-ANC ingakaluvuli uhlelo lokuphakanyiswa kwabazongenela umbango wezikhundla, isiqalile imikhankaso yabagaqele izikhundla.Ngeledlule, kuvele ukuthi kukhona abakhiqiza izikibha ezizosetshenziswa emikhankasweni kaMotsepe.Kuthe kusabatshazwa lokho, kwavela ingoma eyeseka umkhankaso kaMbalula wokuhola i-ANC. UMbalula uthe bazothathelwa izinyathelo abenze le mikhankaso uma beke batholakala.
IZINTOKAZI ezazakhela ugazi kuma-Idols SA ngo-2019, uViggy noVirginia Qwabe, zibuye ngenkani emculweni we-Afro pop. La matshitshi asahamba uMkhosi woMhlanga futhi asezibiza ngamaQ Twins azokhipha i-albhamu yawo yesibili esihloko sithi Imicabango ngoJanuwari 30. Ngokubambisana la mawele aKwaDukuza, ameme abathandi bobumnandi ukuba baphelele ngobuningi babo emcimbini oyisendlalelo wokwethulwa kwaleli cwecwe (listening session) eThe Villa eWaterfront, ku-98 Mahatma Gandhi Road eThekwini, namhlanje ngo-7 ebusuku. Banxuse izithameli ukuba ziswenke ngezingubo ezimhlophe. Kuleli cwecwe kuboshelwe abaculi abahlukahlukene okubalwa kubo uNomfundo Moh engomeni ethi Ezinkingeni, uMawhoo engomeni ethi Ukuthula, uMjolisi noZamambo abapikwe engomeni ethi Baphi, uShandesh noBlaq Major bapikwe engomeni ethi Bekumnandi, uNaledi Aphiwe engomeni ethi Uthando, uBeast RSA, Dladla Mshunqisi noDJ Fuzeh baboshelwe engomeni ethi Impilo. Lezi zintokazi ziphinde zapika u-Exclusive Drumz noTee Jay eculweni elithi Imali.
KUDUMALE abantu abaningi umculi kamaskandi, uMenzi Mabizela, ememezela ukuthi usehoxa unomphela emiqhudelwaneni. Uthe okumenze wathatha isinqumo sokuhosha imfe ekuncintisaneni nabanye ukuphoxeka ahlangabezana nakho komunye umqhudelwano nyakenye. Ekhuluma kwiBhanyazile TV, uthe akalwi nemincintiswano nabagqugquzeli bayo kodwa wenqena ukuxoveka umoya. Nakuba kunjalo, uthe uyayemukela imiklomelo ayithola emiqhudelwaneni okusuke kungavotwa kuyo njengendondo asanda kuyihlomula kwaYouTube ngenxa yokuba nabalandeli (subscribers) abangaphezu kuka-100 000. "Izinto lezi ozithola zingenawo umsindo ngisho omncane. Imincintiswano okuvotwa kuyo igcina imibono seyiba miningi. Uma nisebenza niba baningi kuyenzeka ugcine sewubamba phezu kwesandla somunye, adinwe. Ezintweni ezinjengalezo ngathatha isinqumo sokuthi ngingasazingeni emuva kokulimala enhliziyweni yami komunye umncintiswano." Uthe yena akazongenela ngisho owodwa umncintiswano, noma ngabe kuvotwa ngoshingamu, wathi kukhona ebesebeqalile bephakamisa igama lakhe nelikaMzukulu neNkosi Yamagcokama kwiMother Of All Maskandi Festival, okungumncintiswano kaZimdollar. UMenzi uthe unxuse ukuba itekisi iye kwiNkosi Yamagcokama ngoba seyindala endimeni. Uthe uqale ukuhoxa emncintiswaneni ngesikhathi eqokwa kwiTshatha Music Festival. "Angisakwazi ukubuyela emicimbini okuqhudelwanayo kuyo ngoba sekuke kwakhona omunye abathe uma bengifonela becela ukungifaka kuwo, ngacela ukungafakwa. Ngagcina ngingafakwanga futhi basihlonipha isicelo sami. Ngakho angikwazi ukungenela omunye umqhudelwano ngoba lokho kungasho ukuthi ngiyamdelela engiwunqabile owakhe." Unxuse abalandeli abamthanda ngeqiniso ukuba bengamfaki emincintiswaneni ngenxa yokusabela umsebenzi awenzela bona. Uthe imincintiswano igcina seyimenza agcine esecula ngenhliziyo embi ngenxa yobuhlungu. "Mina ngiyeneliseka ngoxhaso abanginikeza lona ko-Apple Music, Spotify nakwiYouTube." Uthe ukukhombisa ukuthi akanankinga nemincintiswano, uzoqhubeka nokuyojabulisa abantu emicimbini. UMenzi waqala ukumemezela ukuthi usezohoxa emincintiswaneni ngesikhathi besahubhana nozakwabo uLimit Nala kwiMother Of All Maskandi Festival nyakenye, bebanga iQuantum. Sekungumlando ukuthi lelo tekisi lagcina liwelele eNkandla, emuva kokunqotshwa wuLimit. Yize kwavela ukuthi uLimit wavotelwa kakhulu yizintokazi zaseLadies House (ikhasi elikwiFacebook) emuva kokuba uMenzi esolwe ngokweseka izinkulumo zikaTamara, kodwa uMenzi wathi ngamampunge lawo. Kwenzeka lokhu nje, nango-2024 akubanga kuhle nakubalandeli bomculi waseMzimkhulu, uSolwazi, emuva kokuba iQuantum liwinwe wumculi wasoPhongolo, uGatsheni.
UMSOLWA oneminyaka engu-19, obhekene namacala ayisishiyagalolunye okubulala nelilodwa lokuzama ukubulala, uvele kafushane eNkantolo yeMantshi yase-Athlone, ngoMsombuluko.Umsolwa uboshelwe icala elenzeke ngezintatha zangoMgqibelo, 17 Januwari nonyaka, eshibhini emijondolo yaseMarikana, ePhilippi East, lapho oshayasibhamu bavulela ngenhlamvu bebhekise kubathengi abebengaphakathi emjondolo. Kushone amadoda ayisishiyagalombili nowesifazane oyedwa, kwathi omunye walimala kanzima.Okhulumela amaphoyisa e-SAPS eWestern Cape, uBrigadier Novela Potelwa, ukuqinisekisile ukuboshwa kwalo msolwa, kulandela uphenyo olunzulu olwenziwe ophikweni lwamaphoyisa ayisipesheli. Umsolwa uboshwe ngoLwesihlanu, eZweletemba, eWorcester."Njengengxenye yophenyo oluqhubekayo, abaseshi besifundazwe bavulele umsolwa oyedwa icala," kusho uPotelwa.Imibiko yamaphoyisa iveza ukuthi abasolwa abathathu bangene eshibhini ngemuva nje kuka-12 phakathi kwamabili, bavulela ngenhlamvu bengaphakathi. Abantu abayisithupha bashonele endaweni yesigameko, isisulu esisodwa sashona ngesikhathi siphuthunyiswa esibhedlela. Kuthe ngemuva kwezinsuku ezimbalwa, kwashona umuntu wesishiyagalolunye owalimala kanzima. Omunye wabashonile ngowesifazane okukholakala ukuthi ubengumnikazi weshibhi.Icala lihlehliselwe umhlaka-2 Febhuwari 2026, ukuze umsolwa afake isicelo sebheyili.
UVictor Mthethwa Majola, osolwa ngokuhlela ukubulawa kukaWarrick "DJ Warras” Stock, unqatshelwe ibheyili yiNkantolo yeMantshi eGoli.UMajola, 44, ubhekene namacala okubulala, ukubulala ehlosile kanye nelokwakha itulo lokubulala kulandela ukudutshulwa kuka-DJ odumile, umsakazi nosomabhizinisi ngaphandle kwefulethi iZambesi Building enkabeni yedolobha laseGoli ngoDisemba nyakenye.U-DJ Warras, naye owayengumsunguli wenkampani yokuvikela i-VIP, udutshulwe izikhathi eziningi uMbuso uthi bekuhleliwe. Ukubulawa kwakhe kudale ukushaqeka okusabalele embonini yezokuzijabulisa kanye naphakathi kwabalandeli bakhe. Ngesikhathi kuqhubeka isicelo sebheyili, uMajola utshele inkantolo ukuthi kumele adedelwe njengoba kusaqhubeka ukuphenywa kwecala, egcizelela ukuthi akayona ingozi yokubaleka futhi akanasizathu sokubalekela ubulungisa. Uveze ukuthi ungumnikazi wamatekisi ozisebenzayo onempahla, nobudlelwane obuqinile nomphakathi, futhi uyakuphika ukuthi uyathinteka kuleli cala.UMajola uqhube wathi icala abhekene nalo lintekenteke futhi lisekelwe ekuqagelenii. Uphinde wazama ukuphoqa uMbuso ukuthi ulethe ama-video akholelwa ukuthi angasiza ecaleni lakhe.Ngesikhathi umbuso uphikisa ibheyili, uthi uMajola ubeka engcupheni ezobulungiswa futhi angaphazamisa ofakazi uma ededelwa. Abashushisi batshele inkantolo ukuthi kunobufakazi obumhlanganisa nokuhlelwa kwetulo lokubulala, okuhlanganisa nezithombe zeCCTV nezitatimende zofakazi ezimbeka eduze kwendawo yesigameko ngosuku lowesehlo.
BATHATHU abasolwa ngamacala abucayi, okuthiwa bathelwe othulini amaphoyisa ngale mpelasonto.Lokhu kuqinisekiswe okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, izolo. Esigamekweni esenzeke eNanda, ngoMgqibelo, uNetshiunda uthe amaphoyisa abefuna abasolwa ebebefunelwa icala lokubulala okuthiwa balenza eNanda, ngo-Okthoba 2024. Uthe abasolwa abafanayo bebebuye bafunelwe namanye amacala abucayi. "Badutshulwe babulawa ngesikhathi betholana phezulu namaphoyisa ngoMgqibelo,” kusho uNetshiunda. Uthe amaphoyisa abelandela umkhondo owaholele komunye wemizi eMzinyathi. Uthe ngesikhathi efika amaphoyisa, ahlangatshezwe yinganono, abasolwa bewadubula, nawo abuyisela ngayo. Uveze ukuthi kubasolwa abafile bekukhona oneminyaka engu-22 nonengu-24. Uthe kukhona abanye ababili abasezithendeni zabo njengoba bekwazile ukuphunyula ngembobo yenalithi. "Bobabili bebehlomile, omunye ephethe iphistoli, ngesikhathi omunye ephethe esikhulu (rifle),” usho kanje.Uthe esigamekweni esenzeke izolo, umsolwa obefunelwa amacala amathathu okubulala, okuthiwa wawenza eHighflats ngo-Okthoba 2024, waphinde wenza amanye ngo-Okthoba nangoNovemba nyakenye, udutshulwe wabulawa amaphoyisa eBellair, eThekwini. Uthe umsolwa ubonwe amaphoyisa eshayela imoto kuthelawayeka u-N2. "Azame ukummisa, wangama, wavele wadubula ebhekise emaphoyiseni. Nawo abuyisela, waphelela endaweni yesigameko,” kusho uNetshiunda.
UKHOMBA ngenjumbane uMbhishobhi webandla laseChibini, kwiSekethe yaseGcuwa ngenjumbane, umndeni wowesilisa owanyamalala kade ebizwe wumholi waleli bandla ukuba ayofundisa amanye amalungu ebhendi yebandla icilongo.UNkk Ntombi Khoza ukhomba ngenjumbane, umholi waleli bandla, uMbhishobhi uMjekula ngokuthi bazithola bekulesi simo njengomndeni ngenxa yakhe.Uma elandisa uNkk Khoza uthi kwakungu-2021 ngesikhathi uMbhishobhi Mjekula ecela abantwana abazoyofundisa ibhendi yaleli bandla icilongo. Uthi ngoba kwakucela inhloko yebandla akazange abe nayo inkinga.Uveze ukuthi indodana yakhe yahamba nomunye umngani wayo igama lakhe okunguSiyanda. ''Kodwa kwathi sekumele abuye umfana wami wangishayela ucingo engitshela ukuthi uMbhishobhi uMjekula uthe angakhululeka uSiyanda kodwa yena ucela ukuba asale angaqale ahambe,''usho kanjena.Uqhuba athi akazange abe nayo nje nhlobo inkinga ngalokho ngoba wayecabanga ukuthi indodana yakhe isezandleni eziphephile uma ikanye nomholi webandla. ''Nebala yaqhubeka yahlala khona indodana yami,'' kuchaza yena.Uthi inkinga iqale ngesikhathi inkosikazi kaMjekula isishayela ucingo unina womfana imbuza ukuthi usefikile yini uMsizi ekhaya ngoba usuke eGcuwa ethi uphindela ekhaya KwaZulu-Natal.''Ngamtshela ukuthi indodana yami ayikafiki ekhaya, ''usho kanjena. Uthi kwathi uma beqhubeka bekhuluma nonkosikazi kaMjekula wathi bona bazi ukuthi usesekhaya njengoba ehambe ebatshele lokho.Okubakhathaza kakhulu uthi yindlela uMbhishobhi Mjekula adembesela ngayo ngoba akakaze azihluphe nakanye ngokuphinde abuze ukuthi indodana yabo ngabe seyabuya yini ekhaya.Uthe kuyaxaka ukuthi kungani uMjekula ezithela ngabandayo esimeni okufanele ngabe uyabhukula wenza konke okusemandleni ukuze kutholakale uMsizi.Uyihlabe wayihlikiza indlela uMjekula aziphethe ngayo uma kukhulunywa ngalolu daba wathi ukhombisa okukhulu ukungabi nandaba lokhu. ''Ngiyazibuza ngiyaziphendula ukuthi umholi onjani ongazihluphi kangaka kube kukhulunywa indaba emayelana nokuduka komuntu. Angiphathike umuntu oduke kade ecelwe nguyena ukuba ezolekelela ibhendi ngecilongo,'' usho kanjena ekhuluma ebuye abhekise ikhanda phansi ehlengezela izinyembezi.Ngenxa yokuthi bakuqaphela ukuthi uMjekula akakugqizi qakala ukuduka kwendodana yakhe uthi bathumele abanye besilisa ukuba bahambe baze bayofinyelela esakhiweni sebandla ukuyokhuluma kabanzi naye uMjekula mayelana nalolu daba.Uthi ngampela lokho kwenzeka. Uthi nabo laba besilisa bahamba ekamabuyaze njengoba kungekho okubambekayo uMjekula abatshela khona futhi wakhombisa ukungafuni ukubambisana nabo.Eqhuba uthe indodana yakhe wagcina ukukhuluma nayo ngomhla ka-18 Disemba 2021 ngesikhathi imazisa ukuthi isiyasuka kubo kwentombi yayo isibuyela esontweni. Uthi bathola futhi ukuthi igcine ibuyelile esontweni.Isolezwe likhulume nabo laba besilisa nabo ebebekhona egcekeni ngesikhathi lizifikele mathupha eClermont kubo kamfana owaduka.Laba besilisa bathe basebenzela inhlangano iSenzakahle Youth Development, nakuba bengamalungu ebandla laseChibini bathe kodwa bekhuluma noMjekula abazange bakudalule lokho.UMnuz Luvuyo Namba uthe ukuhambela kwabo eGcuwa akuzange kubasize ngalutho njengoba bekhala ngokuthi babona umholi ongenandaba nokuthi kwenzekeni kangangoba kukhona izikhawu lapho ayemane akhushukelwe khona wumoya kubonakale nje ukuthi usho ukubadla luhlaza.''Ngesikhathi sesifikile khona uMjekula wabiza ikomiti lebandla lakhe ukuba lizomlalelisa lokhu okukhulunywayo. Maphakathi nengxoxo sakuqaphela ukuthi inkulumo ayihlangani njengoba wayephika izinto eziningi,'' usho kanjena.Uqhube wathi uMjekula wabatshela ukuthi indodana bayigcina ithi iphindela emuva ekhaya KwaZulu- Natal. Wabatshela ukuthi bahamba bayolubika udaba emaphoyiseni kodwa icala langavulwa.Lokhu uthi kwabashiya nenqwaba yemibuzo ngoba yibona abaze basuka KwaZulu-Natal bafike bavula icala lokuduka komuntu esiteshini samaphoyisa saseMsobomvu.Uveze ukuthi ngesikhathi besendlini kaMjekula kwafika amaphoyisa amphonsa imibuzo embalwa kwaze kwaba khona elinye iphoyisa elatshela uMjekula ukuthi akusikhona okokuqala kuba nezimo ezingezinhle ezibikwayo ngebandla.Uthe leli phoyisa lamtshela emehlweni uMjekula ukuthi umuntu owayedukile watholakala ezilengise ehlathini elibude buduze nesakhiwo sebandla, omunye watholakala kuthiwa ushayiswe yimoto washona.Uveze ukuthi ngesikhathi beseGcuwa kulezo zinsuku babehla benyuka bebheka uMsizi kodwa kwanhlanga zimuka nomoya lutho umkhondo kwala noma bekhombisa abantu isithombe sakhe kodwa bonke babelandula kodwa bevuma ukuthi bayamazi.ISolezwe likhulume naye uMjekula wavuma ukuthi uyalwazi udaba lokuduka kukaMsizi. Wathi abalali bayakhuleka mihla namalanga ukuba uNkulunkulu enze umusa atholakale.''Siyambeka njalo emkhulekweni ukuba makatholakale ngoba lokhu siyazi ukuthi kumqoka kangakanani nasemndenini wakhe,''echaza.Uthe akazi ukuthi bachaza ukuthini abomndebni kaMsizi uma bethi ukhombisa ukungabi nandaba nokuduka kwakhe. Uphendule ngokuthi yena usekhulile ngokweminyaka engeke aze akwazi ukuthi aphilele ukubheka uMsizi nsuku zonke.Ebuzwa ukuthi ngabe uMsizi wayishiya yini ifoni ngesikhathi esegoduka eya KwaZulu Natal uthe akasakhumbuli. Intatheli imtshelile ukuthi abesilisa abebeze kuyena baveze ukuthi yena uMjekula waveza ukuthi ifoni isisetshenziswa yindodana yakhe, uphendule ngokuthi akasazi kahle ngeke esakhumbula yonke into ngoba usemdala kakhulu ngokweminyaka.Intatheli ayizange ilibalule igama lendodana kaMjekula okuthiwa yiyona eyayisebenzisa ifoni kaMsizi, kodwa uMjekula gwiqiqi ugcine esethi : "Kwayena ke loyo mfana othi wayesebenbzisa ifoni kaMsizi akasekho emhlabeni ushone ngonyaka owedlule.'''Kuthe uma intatheli imbuza ukuthi wazi ngani ukuthi kukhulunywa ngayiphi indodana waphendula ngokuthi akathandi ukugxila entweni yezingane ngoba akukuningi akwaziyo ngazo.
BABALISA ngokugwaziswa abafundi abebeshaye ujenge izolo, ngaphandle kwesikhungo semfundo ephakeme, iDurban University of Technology (DUT) esekhampasini yaseThekwini.Abafundi ebebeshaye ujenge bezofuna izikhala, batshele Isolezwe ukuthi kuyabanenga ukuthi bagwaziswe ukuze bathole izikhala zokufunda.Bathe kunemali okuthiwa iyadingeka ukuze bathole izikhala. Bathe le mali kuthiwa mabangene ngaphakathi sebeyiphethe.Omunye walaba bafundi uthe le nto iyabacasula. "Kuyasicasula kakhulu lokhu okwenzekayo kulesi sikhungo ngoba bakhombisa ngokusobala ukuthi kabanendaba nekusasa lethu kodwa bona bacabanga inzuzo,” usho kanjena.Omunye umfundi uthe lokhu kudala ukuthi kuphele nje kubona ukusethemba lesi sikhungo."Ungasithemba kanjani isikhungo esifuna ukuba abafundi bakhokhe imali ukuze bathole izikhala?” kubuza lo mfundi.Isolezwe lithe lisakhuluma noSihlalo we-EFF Youth Command khona eDUT, uWise Ndlovu, kwaqhamuka omunye ezobikela yena usihlalo ukuthi makaphuthume sekukhona omunye futhi umfundi osegiliwe, kwathathwa imali kuyena.UNdlovu utshele Isolezwe ukuthi baphila le mpilo yokulwa belwela ukuthi kuphele nje nya ngale nto yokuthi abafundi bagwaziswe ngoba kabahambisani nhlobo nayo.''Le nto siyayilwa ngayo yonke indlela, asifuni nokuyizwa nje kodwa kukhona abaqhubekayo nokuthi bayenze,'' echaza.Ubuye wakhala nangokuthi abafundi nabo babuye bengathembeki ngoba abanye babo babuye sebezokhala uma sebebona ukuthi kuyabhimba kodwa uma kugcina ngokuthi kuhambe kahle bathathwe, kababuyi bezosho ukuthi bakhokhisiwe ukuze bathole izikhala.Isolezwe libuye lathola ngengwadla yohlelo olusha lokubhalisa olusetshenziswayo kulesi sikhungo.UNdlovu uthe bathole ukuthi lesi sikhungo sesisebenzisa uhlelo olusha lokubhalisa olubizwa ngokuthi yi-Peoples Software belaxaza oludala abafundi abakholwa ukuthi belula obelubizwa ngokuthi yi-ITS.Ukhale ngokuthi lolu hlelo lunobuhixihixi ngoba luhamba ngonyawo lonwabu futhi luyehluleka ukulekelela abafundi ngendlela efanele.Uthe kuyaqala nje ngqa, akuyona yonke le minyaka eyedlule ukuthi uhlelo lokubhalisa kwabafundi kulesi sikhungo lubonakale luhamba ngonyawo lonwabu ngalolu hlobo, wathi sebebambe inqwaba yemihlangano mayelana nale nkinga yalolu hlobo olusha lokubhaliswa olusetshenziswa yisikhungo kodwa akukho okubonakala kulunga.Lapha uthe ukhuluma ngabafundi abathathiwe kodwa okulukhuni satshe ukuba babhalisele izifundo zabo ngenxa yalolu hlelo athe seluphenduke isithiyo emfundweni yabantwana."Asisazi manje ukuthi le nto izokwenziwa njani uma injena. Phela inkulu le nkinga esibhekene nayo lapha eDUT. Okufike kube yinkinga kakhulu ukuthi abafundi uma bethi bayabhalisa kubhaliseka izifundo ezimbalwa ezinye zingabhaliseki. Inkinga enkulu ngalokhu ukuthi kuzoholela ekutheni abafundi ezinye zezifundo kugcine kuthiwe mabazikhokhele ngeyabo imali,” usho kanjena.Uthe badangele ngenxa yalolu hlelo aluchaze njengengqinamba enkulu."Ukukhuluma iqiniso nje, ayikho nje le nto yalolu hlelo imbudane yoqobo. Uke uzwe uma kukhulunya ngento engekho, kusuke impela kushiwo lena esibhekene nayo kulesi sikhungo,” usho kanjena.Uthe selokhu luqalile uhlelo lokubhaliswa kulesi sikhungo, bangu-500 kuphela abafundi abasabhalisiwe. ''Uyabona-ke ukuthi lolu hlelo lubehlula kangakanani uma kusakhulunywa indaba yokuthi kuze kube yimanje bancane kangaka abafundi abasabhalisiwe,'' kusho yena.Nabafundi ebebezobhalisa kulesi sikhungo bakhale ngokushonelwa yilanga bemi ndawonye. Abamele izitshudeni baveze ukuthi okubaxakayo ukuthi abakaze batshelwe ukuthi kungani kanti lesi sikhungo sikhethe ukumane siguqule lolu hlelo isigubhukane ngaphandle kokuxhumana nabo.Bakhale nangokuthi kubangelwa yini ukuba lolu helo lufakwe ngesikhathi esibucayi kangaka lapho khona abafundi befuna ukubhalisa. Lokhu bakuchaze njengobudedengu ohlangothini lwesikhungo.UZama Nhleko oyisitshudeni uveze ukuthi kunezinye izifundo angakawazanga ukuzibhalisela ngenxa yokuthi uhlelo olusha belumchitha.Uthe akasazi manje ukuthi enze njani ngoba nayizolo ufikile kwaba yinkinga efanayo. ''Okusixakayo ukuthi labo okumele basisize khona ngaphakathi bavele bathi asihambe siyoziqhubekela emakhaya, uma sifika khona nakanjani kuzolunga. Kwala noma sibatshela ukuthi ayikho into elungayo. Iqiniso ukuthi lolu hlelo kwabona abaqeqeshelwe, luyabehlula lokhu okwangempela futhi,” echaza.Omunye umfundi uNksz Noluthando Magubane uthe naye ubhekane nenkinga efanayo kwaba khona izifundo ezibhalisekayo, kwezinye kwabhajwa ithendele.Uthe akayazi into enjengalena. Ukhale ngokuthi akasiboni lesi sikhungo sithola isisombululo sale nkinga esibhekene naso ngaphandle kokuba kubuyelwe ohlelweni oludala lona obelungahluphi.UNobhala we-EFF Student Command, uScofield Thabede, ukhale ngenkinga yohlelo olusha lokubhalisa nenkinga enkulu yokugwaziswa kwabafundi.Abafundi bale baphetha ukudalula imali abagwaziswa yona, bathi bayasaba.DUT comment.....
USEVULE icala futhi uvutha engabaselwe owesilisa waseShowe, othi uvulelwe ngumfowabo angamethembi umshwalense wesigidi samarandi engazi.UMnuz Nhlakanipho Mthethwa (54) uthe usekhethe ukuba amane amvulele icala umfowabo ngesenzo sakhe athi simnengile kakhulu futhi simshiye nemidlinzo. Uma elandisa, uveza ukuthi lo mshwalense uvulwe kwa-Old Mutual ngoMeyi 2024.Isolezwe linayo ikhophi yase-Old Mutual eveza ukuthi ngempela lo mshwalense uvuliwe. UMthethwa uthe uthole ngalokhu ngesikhathi eye egatsheni lakwa-Old Mutual, kukhona ayokwenza kanti uzozithela kule mpicabadala yensumansumane."Osebenza khona kwathi uma ebona izinto zami wase eyangibuza ukuthi ngiyazi yini ngomshwalense wesigidi samarandi ovulwe egameni lami? Ngamtshela ukuthi kangazi. Uvele wanginikeza amaphepha avezayo nokuthi uvulwe ngumfowethu.”Uthe noma ehamba usethuka izanya ngoba uyazi ukuthi kunomuntu okubheke ngabomvu ukuhlomula ngezindodla zemali uma kwenzeka yena edlula emhlabeni."'Angikaze ngizihluphe nangokumbuza ngoba saxabana kudala naye eqala eveza ukuthi ungumuntu onjani. Akanalo nje ulwazi lokuthi ngiyazi ngomshwalense angivulele wona,” usho kanjena.UMthethwa uthe isenzo simcabangise izinto eziningi kakhulu ngoba uyamazi umfowabo ukuthi uyiluphi uhlobo lukapende. "Uyabona mfowethu, lo muntu wafa ngo-2015 wavuka ngo-2023,'' echaza ebheke phansi enikina nekhanda.Ecelwa ukuba acacise kabanzi ngalokhu, wenze izinsolo zokuthi umfowabo wenza umkhonyovu wafaka amaphepha okuthi ushonile ukuze umkakhe wangaleso sikhathi, Isolezwe elinalo igama lakhe, khona ezothola isamba esithile semali ''ngokushona'' kwakhe.Isolezwe linawo amaphepha aveza lo wesifazane njengomfelokazi aqinisekisa ukufa komyeni.''Uyabona-ke ukuthi lapha sibhekene noxamu kavinjelwa? Uyinkinga umfowethu, usebenzisana nenqwaba yabantu abasezikhundleni ezihlukene yingakho ekwazi ukuganga kangaka nje,” usho kanjena.Eqhuba uthe bona bewumndeni babengazi ukuthi umfowabo wakhetha ''ukuzibulala'' ukuze kukhokhe umshwalense kodwa indaba yabhadlazwa ngunina ngaphambi kokuba adlule emhlabeni."Ngaphambi kokuba umama adlule emhlabeni wabiza mina nomunye umfowethu wasitshela wathi 'umfowenu akasekho emhlabeni nimbona nje’. Wathi uma sekwenzekena eshona okwangempela siyozibonela thina ukuthi simngcwaba kanjani ungumuntu okade ashona. Umama akazange asitshele ukuthi lokhu wakuthola kanjani,” echaza.Uthe umfowabo esevukile ngo-2023, wafika kubona eShowe ezobachomela ukuthi usevukile kwabafileyo, useqale phansi wathola nomazisi omusha uzokwazi ukuthi "enze izinto zenzeke”."Wenza konke lokhu nje, uhlala eThekwini. Ngesikhathi esazisa ngokuvuka kwakhe waze wafika ekhaya wasipha u-R10 000, ethi unemali eningi,” echaza.Ingwadla ekhona manje akhala ngayo kakhulu uMthethwa ukuthi kunomunye umfowabo owenzelwa yilo mfowabo amaphepha okuthi akasekho emhlabeni, enzela khona njalo ukuba athole imali yomshwalense. Nalawo maphepha futhi Isolezwe liwabonile.Amaphepha aveza ukuthi umufi washona wase eyolala emakhazeni aseThekwini. Aqhuba aveza ukuthi isidumbu sathathwa sayofihlwa e-Eastern Cape.Lokhu uMthethwa uthe kuyindida ngoba phela kukhona umuntu owayesemakhazeni futhi okwakhishwa isidumbu sakhe sayongcwatshwa. Uthe umbuzo omkhulu ukuthi ngesikani leso sidumbu?''Ubani lo owabizwa ngegama likamfowethu walaliswa emakhazeni? Akusiyena umuntu ongaziwa kodwa abambulala? Sizani nakhu umuntu wasekhaya egila izimanga sibhekile!”Uveze ukuthi nokho lo mshwalense ugcine ungakhokhanga ngoba kwatholakala ukuthi usadla anhlamvana lo muntu okubhaliswe ngaye igama lesidumbu esafihlwa e-Eastern Cape.Eqhubeka udalule igama likamfowabo omncane, uMnuz Samkelo Mthethwa, athe wadutshulwa ngabantu abangaziwa eMlaza ngo-2023. Uthe ngesikhathi ebulawa umfowabo wayengumuntu owayeyohlangana nesihlobo."Kwathi esefihlwa umufi, umfowethu wasitshela ukuthi umufi ubekade emthathele umshwalense ngakho asikhululeke, uzozithwala izindleko zomngcwabo.”Uthe umfowabo kuthiwa wadutshulwa ngamadoda angaziwa ehla emotweni eyiPolo, waphelela khona lapho.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu Natal, uSergeant Thenjiswa Ngcobo, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi kunowesilisa ovule icala lokukhwabanisa esiteshini samaphoyisa eMpangeni.''Lona wesilisa uvule leli cala ngemuva kokuba kunesihlobo sakhe athola ukuthi simthathele umshwalense ngaphandle kokumazisa,” echaza.
Kugwilize abantu ababili eMtubatuba, enyakatho yeKwaZulu-Natal, ngemuva kokuzama ukuhlinza imvubu efe emfuleni iMfolozi.Esitatimendeni esikhishwe ngokuhlanganyela ngeSonto, abeZemvelo KZN Wildlife kanye neSimangaliso Wetlands Park Authority bathe lesi sigameko silandela ukutholakala kwemvubu ebilimeie ibhajwe kanzima ogibeni emfuleni uMfolozi ngaseMonzi ngoLwesihlanu.Ngokusho kweziphathimandla, izikhulu ze-Zemvelo zifike endaweni yesigameko ngoLwesihlanu, nokuyilapho zifice isilwane sisosizini nenqwaba yamalungu omphakathi ehlangene osebeni lomfula. Ngemva kokuhlola isimo, izikhulu zinqume ukuthi ngeke kwenzeke ukuhlenga imvubu ngenxa yodaka nezimo eziyingozi kakhulu ezibangelwa umfula odla izindwani. Zixhumane nodokotela bezilwane kwavunyelwana ukuthi asibulawe isilwane bese kuthathwa izitho zomzimba ezibalulekile njengekhanda nemilenze, kwase kushiywa umzimba ngesizathu sokuthi bazobuye benze imizamo yokuwulanda.Kuthe kusenjalo, umphakathi wazama indlela yokufinyelela kulesi silwane ukuze sihlinzwe kuthathwe inyama, ngeshwa, kuminze umuntu oyedwa kulesi siphithiphithi. Kuthiwa osewibili umuntu uminze ezama ukutakula lo owokuqala.
UBESOLA umufi ngokuntshontshana nomkakhe umakhelwane ozinikele emaphoyiseni ngoLwesihlanu, ngelokubulala owesilisa waseCoffee Farm, KwaNdengezi, owaduka ngasekupheleni konyaka odlule.Umufi, uMnuz Kholwani Cele (34) waduka ebuya emsebenzini kwaClover, eNorthdene, eQueensburgh, ngasekupheleni kuka-Okthoba nyakenye.Kuthiwa umsolwa, ongumakhelwane, uzinikele emaphoyiseni aseMariannhill, ngoLwesihlanu, wagonyuluka ngokumbulala wase emphonsa emfuleni, uMngeni. Ngokusho kukamfowabo, uMnuz Sbonelo Cele, bashayelwe ucingo umphenyi, ebatshela ngensumansumane kamakhelwane osefike wavuma icala lokubulala uKholwani."Kuthiwa uthe umbulalele ukuthi uthandana nomkakhe. Kuthiwa uveze nokuthi wayengeyedwa embulala, kukhona abanye besilisa ababili esibaziyo bendawo ayesizana nabo,” kusho uCele.Uthe kubashaqisile lokhu ngoba umsolwa ungumuntu ongubaba ebebezwana naye njengomakhelwane. "Ubefika ekhaya axoxe nathi sonke, ngisho naye uKholwani, bebejwayelene nje impela,” usho kanje.Ushaye amakhala ngezinsolo zikamsolwa, wathi akakholwa ukuthi ziyiqiniso."Ubafo ubewumuntu ongenazimfihlo. Ubesixoxela singabafowabo ngempilo yakhe yezothando, ngisho ngabe into iyihlazo elinjani. Asikholwa ukuthi uma ibikhona eyokuthandana nonkosikazi kamsolwa, ubengehlebele ngisho noyedwa wethu,” usho kanje. Uthe nakuba bebengakaze basolele ngakumsolwa kodwa kukhona osekwenza umqondo manje njengoba esevele wazinikela emaphoyiseni."Emva kwezinsukwana kusabalale eyokuthi umfowethu ulahlekile, naye wavele wanyamalala. Umndeni wakhe waze wavula icala lokulahlekelwa nawo. Nakuba kwasixaka ukuthi naye alahleke kodwa savele saba nokuthi mhlawumbe naye wehlelwe umshophi ofana nowehlele ubafo,” kusho uCele.Ukuvezile nokho ukuthi umndeni kamsolwa ubungakhombisi ukukhathazeka okungango ngokuthi isihlobo sabo sinyamalele. Uthe umufi ubewumuntu obebajwayele kakhulu abesifazane bendawo, njengoba ebethenga imikhiqizo yobisi efemini yakhe ngamanani eliphansi, abuye azobadayisela ngemadlana encane nabo."Ngakho-ke iningi labesifazane belimjwayele kakhulu njengoba belithengela izingane zalo nemindeni yalo imikhiqizo efana nama-danone no-cheese,” kubeka uCele othe nenkosikazi kamsolwa ibiyithenga njengabanye besifazane le mikhiqizo.Uthe umseshi ubatshele ukuthi umsolwa uthe ngesikhathi sebembulele umufi, bambelethisa itshe, base bemphosa emfuleni uMngeni ngaseSpringfield. Ekhuluma neSolezwe izolo, uCele uthe basendleleni eya endaweni yesigameko njengoba umsolwa ebeyokhomba lapho abamphonsa khona umufi.Uthe baphoxekile ngomsolwa. "Ubaba nje lona obesijwayele kakhulu futhi simethemba. Besingakaze sicabange ukuthi angasenza into ebuhlungu kanje,” kusho uSbonelo.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa aseMariannhill abophe owesilisa ambeka icala lokubulala kulandela ukuthi egonyuluke ngokubulala umuntu obebikwe njengodukile ngo-Okthoba nyakenye."Kuzolandelwa imigudu efanele efaka phakathi ukukhomba indawo yesigameko nalapho okwalahlwa khona isidumbu. Umsolwa uzobe esevela enkantolo uma konke lokhu sekwenzekile," kusho uNetshiunda.
LIQHAMUKE nokusha kulo nyaka ibutho laseMbumbulu, elidume ngeloMhlabuhlangene, liqala umkhankaso wokukhuculula izikhungo zomphakathi. UMnuz Ntokozo Ndlovu ongomunye walo, utshele Isolezwe ukuthi bakhethe ukuthi kusukela kulo nyaka, bashaye ngonyawo olusha ngokuthi kube khona okuhle abakwenzela umphakathi wendawo."Abaningi basazi ngokuthi sishaya ingoma, sibe yingxenye yemicimbi eyehlukene, siqhakambisa le nto yobunsizwa kodwa ngonyaka odlule sihlale phansi sabonisana ngokuthi sidinga ukwenza okungaphezu kwalokho ukuletha ushintsho emphakathini,” usho kanje. Uthe yilapho abaqhamuke khona nombono wokuthi baqale bahambele izikhungo zomphakathi ezifana nezikole, imitholampilo, isiteshi samaphoyisa, inkantolo nezinye.Uthe bafika bacele ukuvulelwa amasango ngezimpelasonto, bangene bahlanze igceke. Njengoba beqalile ngempelasonto edlule, bakhuculule esikoleni iTobi Primary, base bedlulela nasesiteshini samaphoyisa saseMbumbulu.Uthe basithole sisibi isimo esiteshini, ibhodi elikhombisa ukuthi kunesiteshi samaphoyisa lisithwe yizihlahla ezinkulu. "Kulabo abahamba ngezinyawo ukuyofuna usizo esiteshini samaphoyisa, bese beba madolo nzima ngenxa yesikhotha esivimbanisile,” usho kanje.Uthe kuningi okusemgodleni wabo njengoba kungesikhona ukukhuculula lezi zikhungo kuphela abahlele ukukwenza.Uthe phakathi kokunye, kukhona "Isibaya Samabhungu” lapho abazohlanganisa khona zonke izingane zabafana, bazidodise. "Lokhu sizokwenza ngoba siyabona ukuthi izinga labangasebenzi likhulu futhi nelobugebengu linyuka mihla namalanga. Sikholelwa ekutheni kungalekelela ukuthi sixoxe nazo izingane zabafana zisakhula, sizifundise indlela efanele,” kusho uNdlovu.Uthe lokhu bazobe bekwenza nangokubuka ukuthi indawo yabo isinobugebengu obubi futhi babona nesibalo semilutha yewunga sanda, nokuyinto ebakhathazayo ngoba kade ingekho endaweni, wathi abazogcina lapho njengoba bezophinde baqoke amalungu abo asebenza emikhakheni eyehlukene ukuthi alekelele ngokunikezela ulwazi ngemikhakha yawo entsheni. Uthe lokhu kuzolekelela ekutheni labo abafuna ukuthi uma beqeda isikole balandele leyo mikhakha, bayilandele benolwazi olugcwele ngayo."Sizogqugquzela nokufunda ngemitapoyolwazi ukuze intsha ikhule yazi ukuthi kubalulekile ukuzithuthukisa ngolwazi,” usho kanje.Uthe ngale mpelasonto, bazoyoqedela ukukhuculula isiteshi samaphoyisa njengoba bengaqedanga ngeledlule.
I-AFRICAN National Congress (ANC) isobishini njengoba seyize yafakwa eNkantolo eNkulu yaseGoli ngenxa yezinsolo zokugweva nemali yamaciko ewu-R423 228, 75. Isolezwe lithole ukuthi le nhlangano ezinze eLuthuli House eGoli igqigqiswa kule nkantolo yinhlangano eqoqa imali ngomculo osuke udlalwe emisakazweni naseziteshini zethelevishini iSouth African Music Rights Organisation (Samro) ngenxa yomculo owadlalwa kwiSiyanqoba Rally eyayiseFNB Stadium ngo-2024. Ukunqwaha kwale nhlangano nalesi samba esicishe sibe yingxenye yesigidi kuphoqe abaholi beSamro ukuba bafake amaphepha enkantolo ngenhloso yokuphoqa i-ANC ukuba ikhokhe isikweletu. Ebuzwa yiSolezwe ngalezi zindaba, okhulumela i-ANC kuzwelonke, uMahlengi Bhengu Motsiri, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi asefikile amaphepha asenkantolo ekomkhulu lale nhlangano. Uvele washaya ngezimfishane wathi basasifunda isinqumo senkantolo. "Sizobe sesichaza kabanzi ngesinyathelo esizothathwa emuva kwalokho." Isolezwe libuye lathola ukuthi kufakwana enkantolo nje kungenxa yesivumelwano esenziwa yisikhulu seSamro uKarabo Senna nemenenja jikelele ye-ANC uPatrick Flusk ngoJuni 24, 2024. Lesi sivumelwano esibhalwe phansi sasigunyaza i-ANC ukuba idlale ngokukhululeka umculo oqanjwe amaciko angamalungu eSamro kunoma yikuphi lapho kuhlangene khona amalungu kaKhongolose. Nebala kwiSiyanqoba Rally zaqhululwa izingoma zamaciko anganyelwe yiSamro. Emuva kwalokho abakwaSamro babe sebethumela i-invoice emahhovisi ale nhlangano ngenhloso yokuba bakhokhelwe imali. Esikhundleni senkokhelo kuthiwa ubuholi bale nhlangano sebubhala buyacisha, bubamba buyayeka, budla amazambane ashisayo. Phezu koxhaxha lwezincwadi esezibhalelwe i-ANC kodwa kunhlanga zimuka nomoya. Oyisikhulu ophikweni lwezokuxhumana kwaSamro, uNthabiseng Motsei, ucashunwe ekuqinisekisa ukuthi umacashelana abawudlaliswa yi-ANC sewubame emphinjeni. Uthe le mali abayifuneli bona kodwa bafuna ukuyidlulisela emacikweni okwadlalwa izingoma zawo eralini ye-ANC. Isolezwe like labika ukuthi iSamro ayisakugunyazi ukuba kudlalwe umculo wamalungu ayo emicimbini ehlanganisa abantu kungekho sivumelwano nabagqugquzeli. Sekudingeka umgqugquzeli womcimbi abathumelele uhlu lwezingoma ezidlaliwe njengoba kwenziwa emsakazweni.
OWAYEYISIKHULU sophiko oluqaphe ukusebenza kwamaphoyisa, i-Ipid, uMnuz Robert McBride, uchaze ukuthi kungani bakhetha ukuya emzini kaNgqongqoshe wezamaPhoyisa omisiwe, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, esikhundleni sokuba bambizele emahhovisi e-Ipid ngesikhathi beqhuba uphenyo ngecala lokubulala elathinta umqaphi kaMchunu.UMcBride uthe kwakuzokwehlisa uMchunu isithunzi ukumbizela emahhovisi e-Ipid.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ethula ubufakazi phambi kwekomiti lasePhalamende eliphenya izinsolo ezenziwa uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi.Ngokobufakazi obethulwa uMkhwanazi, uMcBride nenhloko yezisebenzi ehhovisi likaMchunu emisiwe, uMnuz Cedric Nkabinde, baya emzini kaMchunu ngesikhathi beqhuba uphenyo ngecala lokubulala elalithinta umuntu owayengumqaphi kaMchunu ngesikhathi esengundunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal.Ngaleso sikhathi uMcBride noNkabinde babesebenzela i-Ipid, uMchunu yena wayeseshiyile kwesikandunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal.Ngokusho kukaMkhwanazi, uMchunu wazama ukuphazamisa uphenyo.UMchunu yena wathi wayecele umhlangano nezikhulu ze-Ipid ngenxa yokuthi wayefuna ukudlulisa ukungenami kwakhe ngokugxambukela kwamaphoyisa asophikweni loKlebe odabeni.Ebuzwa uMcBride ukuthi kungani banquma ukuya emzini kaMchunu esikhundleni sokuba bahlangane kunoma isiphi isikhungo sikahulumeni, uMcBride uthe kwakufanele baye emzini kaMchunu."Njengoba eke waba undunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal uMchunu, uwumholi oqavile. Kwakungabe ngikhombisa ukungamhloniphi ukube ngambizela emahhovisi ethu. Kwakufanele siye kwakhe. Lena indlela engenza ngayo. Uma kukhona into engifuna ukukubuza yona ngiyaye ngifike kwakho."Ilungu leMKP, uMnuz Sibonelo Nomvalo, lihlabe lahlikiza okushiwo uMcBride ngokungayi kukaMkhwanazi emngcwabeni womphenyi we-Ipid, uMnuz Mandlakayise Mahlangu.UMahlangu, owayengumngani kaMkhwanazi, wadutshulwa wabulawa ngesikhathi ephenya izinsolo zenkohlakalo ekuthengweni kwamavesti amaphoyisa okuvikela izinhlamvu.UMcBride uthe kushayisa amakhala ukuthi uMkhwanazi uyena owafika kuqala endaweni okwabulawelwa kuyona uMahlangu.UMcBride uthe kuyasolisa nokuthi uMkhwanazi akayanga emngcwabeni kaMahlangu.Kepha uNomvalo uthe uMkhwanazi wafonelwa umfowabo kaMahlangu, uMnuz William Mahlangu, emcela ukuba aphuthume ayobheka lapho kubulawelwe khona uMahlangu."Umfowabo wayesebenzela oKlebe esifundazweni iMpumalanga ngaleso sikhathi. Empeleni uWilliam uyena owayengumngani omkhulu kaMKhwanazi."Ikomiti lizoqhubeka namhlanje nokulalela ofakazi.
UHLABE ikhwelo lokuthi zithi zisuka amadaka emabangeni aphansi abafundi bafuqwe izifundo iMaths neSayensi ukuze kuphele uvalo ngalezi zifundo.Lesi siphakamiso senziwe nguNgqongqoshe wezeSayensi, uSolwazi Blade Nzimande, ekhuluma engqungqutheleni ebheka ezemfundo eyisiSekelo eGoli.UNzimande uthe lusekhona uvalo kubafundi abamnyama abasaba ukuthi lezi zifundo zinzima."Ukuze singayibambi ekugcineni kwa-matric, sikhale ngokuthi bancane abenza iMaths kunabenza iMaths Literacy, kumele iMaths neSayensi iqiniswe kubafundi zisuka nje kwaGrade 1 kuya ku-3," usho kanje. Uthe ngale ndlela abafundi bazozijwayela lezi zifundo ukuthi ziyingxenye yemfundo yabo."Kwangikhathaza ngesikhathi kukhishwa imiphumela ka-matric, kuvela ukuthi u-34% kuphela wabafundi ababhale iMaths. Iningi lenze iMaths Literacy kanti kulaba abenza iMaths, ngiyazibuza ukuthi bangaki abaphasa ngo-60%, odingeka emanyuvesi uma ufuna ukwenza iziqu zobudokotela noma ezobunjiniyela," kusho uNzimande.Evula le ngqungquthela esongwa kusasa, uNgqongqoshe wezeMfundo eyisiSekelo, uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, uthe umphathisa ngekhanda umkhakha wamabanga aphansi ngoba abanye abafundi abakuqondi abakufundayo. Uthe lokhu kungaqondi abakufundayo kuyinhlekelele edinga ukusukunyelwa ngokushesha."Yingakho kumele siqinise kakhulu zisuka amadaka ukuze sithi sifika emazingeni aphezulu, isimo sibe sesingcono. Silinde ngabomvu iziphakamiso ezizophuma kule ngqungquthela ukuze sikwazi ukusheshe singenelele, silungise," usho kanje.Uzwakalise ukukhathazeka ngesikhathi ememezela eka-matric ngeledlule, lapho ekhale ngesibalo esincane sabafundi abenza iMaths, wathi kudingeka sinyuswe lesi sibalo ikakhulu ngoba lezi zifundo zibalulekile. Uveze nokuthi ezinye zeziphakamiso ezaphuma kulo mhlangano sebeqalile ukuzenza."Ezinye zazo zithinta izikhalazo zokuthi kumele kwehliswe umsebenzi wasemahhovisi owenziwa ngothisha kuleli, ukuze bagxile ekufundiseni. Lokhu ngezinye zezinto esiqalile ukuzisebenza ukuze othisha bafundise kuphela," kusho uNksz Gwarube.Othisha bebehlale bekhala ngokuthi babhekana nomsebenzi omningi wokwenza ama-rejista neminye imisebenzi okudla isikhathi sabo esiningi. Bafuna ukuncishiselwa umsebenzi ukuze bakwazi ukugxila emakilasini. Uveze nokuthi othisha yibona abawumgogodla wezemfundo ngakho kumele njalo bafundise izinto ezidingwa ngumnotho nesimo samanje."Ukuqeqeshwa kothisha kubalulekile ukuze bafundise okuhambisana nesikhathi samanje. Kudlange ubuchwepheshe ngakho ngeke bashiywe ngaphandle ekutheni ukuqeqeshwa kwabo kuhambisane nokudingekayo." Uthe bazoqhubeka nohlelo lokuthi kufundiswe ngezilimi abafundi abaziqondayo okubalwa ulimi abaluncela ebeleni kanjalo nolokufundisa kuleli, ezikoleni eziningi okuyisiNgisi.UNzimande uphakamise nokuthi ibhekisiswe eyokuthi ngabe isabasiza yini eyabafundi abachibiyela u-matric eyokuthi babhale lezi zivivinyo ngonyaka olandelayo.
UKHATHAZEKILE uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, ngabafundi abalaxaza isikole bengafinyelelanga ku-matric.URamaphosa ukhale ngokuthi minyaka yonke abafundi abevile ku-1 million, baqala uGrade 1 kodwa ku-matric kufinyelela kuphela uhhafu walesi sibalo.Uthe kumele kwaziwe ukuthi laba bafundi bashonaphi."Iyangikhathaza eyokuthi uhhafu wabafundi abasuke beqale isikole, abafiki ku-matric. Kumele kutholakale izizathu ezenza ukuthi balaxaze isikole kuGrade 10 no-11. Kumele sibagqugquzele abafundi ukuthi baphothule isikole," kusho uRamaphosa izolo, ekhuluma engqungqutheleni yemfundo eyisisekelo, eGauteng. Uthe kumele abazali nothisha baluse abafundi ukuze bathole izinselelo ababhekene nazo."Othisha kumele baye emakhaya abafundi, bayobabheka uma kuphela izinsuku bengabanoni ezikoleni. Umzali naye kumele achaze uma umfundi eselove isikhathi eside, ukuze bazi othisha ukuthi umfundi ukuphi," kuqhuba uRamaphosa.Uthe kumele zaziwe izizathu zokushiya phakathi isikole kwabafundi."Ziningi izinto ezibhekene nabafundi. Abanye bayasaba ukuya esikoleni ngoba behlukunyezwa abanye abafundi. Abanye banenkinga yesimo somqondo badinga ukwelulekwa kanti abanye basuke benenkinga yokuthi ekhaya isimo semali asisihle, bese bengakwazi ukuya esikoleni. Yizona zonke izinto okumele zaziwe ngomfundi osuke elaxaze isikole," kusho uRamaphosa. Ihlale iyindaba egudwini eyabafundi abaqala uGrade 1, kodwa bagcine bengafinyelelanga ku-matric.Uveze nokuthi eyobaba abangeyona ingxenye yokukhula kwezingane zabo, ingaba nomthelela kubafundi."Kokunye abafundi bahlulwa yisikole bese beshiya phakathi izifundo. Nokuphinda kaningi ikilasi kuyawuqeda umdlandla kubafundi bese beyeka isikole." Wenze isibonelo ngenkukhu athe uma inamachwane ayiwalahli, iwa ivuka nawo."Inkukhu ivikela amachwane ayo ngale ndlela yokuthi ngisho ihamba iyawafukamela. Uma usondela ngakuwona ifuna ukukungqofa. Abafundi kumele sibathathise okwamachwane, sibafukamele zikhathi zonke."Uhlabe ikhwelo lokuthi kuqiniswe kakhulu emazingeni aphansi ezemfundo, kungagxilwa ku-matric."Kuyasijabulisa ukuthi kuqopheke umlando ezweni okokuqala ngqa, ngokuthi imiphumela ka-matric ibe ngu-88%. Baningi abafundi abaphase ngamaBachelor, abaqhamuka ezikoleni okungakhokhwa kuzona. Noma lezi zibalo zizinhle kodwa kumele sigxile esisekelweni semfundo ukuze abafundi bakuqonde abakufundayo," usho kanje.Uthe zisuka amadaka abafundi kumele bafundiswe ukubala nokubhala.
SAMUKELWE yikomiti lasePhalamende isinqumo sikaMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, sokuqoka iPhini loMvikeli woMphakathi, u-Advocate Dinkie Portia Dube.USihlalo wekomiti lezobuLungiswa nokuThuthukiswa koMthethosisekelo, uMnuz Xola Nqola, uhalalisele u-Advocate Dube, ngokuqokwa kulesi sikhundla.Uthe uzohlala kulesi sikhundla iminyaka eyisikhombisa."Uzoqala kulesi sikhundla ngoFebhuwari 1, 2026, kanti uqokwe kulandela umthetho iPublic Protector Act," usho kanje. Uthe u-Advocate Dube unesipiliyoni seminyaka eyevile ku-20, kwezithinta uhulumeni, uphenyo nezikhalo.Ungene kulesi sikhundla emuva kokuvuleka kwesikhala kulandela ukuqokwa kowayesiphethe, osenguMvikeli woMphakathi, u-Advocate Kholeka Gcaleka."U-Advocate Dube wesekwa amalungu ekomiti avela emaqenjini ahlukene. La malungu achazeka ngesikhathi ephonswa imibuzo ngonyaka odlule. Wabashaya bonke ayenabo ohlelweni lwemibuzo futhi watshengisa ukuzethemba nokuba namava ngendlela ayephendula ngayo," usho kanje. Uthe ikomiti laphakamisa igama lakhe kuRamaphosa, ukuthi amqoke. Uveze ukuthi bazoqhubeka nokuqapha ukusebenza kwehhovisi loMvikeli woMphakathi.URamaphosa uthe uqoke u-Advocate Dube ngenxa yamava akhe."Ungumqondisi jikelele wePublic Service Commission. Ngaphambi kokuba kulesi sikhundla, ubengumqondisi ehhovisi i-military ombud. Phakathi kuka-2011 no-2014, u-Advocate Dube wayengumqondisi ehhovisi lomvikeli womphakathi eGauteng," kusho uRamaphosa. Uthe unamava ekuxazululeni izikhalo njengoba asebenza ehhovisi lezohwebo nezimboni ophikweni oluvikela abathengi waphinde wasebenza njengommeli kwiSouth African Human Rights Commission.Nyakenye i-ACDP yaseka ukuphakanyiswa kwegama lika-Advocate Dube, njengephini lomvikeli womphakathi.
KUXWAYISWA amaNazaretha aseBuhleni, ngaphansi kweNkosi uMduduzi "Unyazilwezulu” Shembe ukuthi angajahi ukuvalwa komhlangano kaJanuwari kepha alinde izwi lomholi webandla.Lesi sexwayiso sikhishwe ngumkhulumeli webandla uMnuz Thokozani Mncwabe, othe alikaphumi izwi lokuthi umhlangano uyavalwa ngale mpelasonto."Sonke silinde izwi lomholi naye olinde izwi elizomtshela ukuthi umhlangano uvalwa nini. Abantu abangazicabangeli ukuthi umhlangano uyavalwa bese behlela ukwenza noma ukuthinta izinto eziziliwe njengoba kusemhlanganweni ngoba lokho kuzobahlubula.”Uqhube ngokuthi kwake kwenzeka eminyakeni eyedlule umhlangano wavalwa sekuthwase inyanga entsha.Uthe nakulokhu njengoba amaNazaretha ebuye eNtabeni eNgcwele iKhenana, eNdwedwe, ngoMsombuluko abuyela eBuhleni, eNanda, azitshela ukuthi umhlangano uyavalwa kanti kumele alinde izwi."Akwaziwa, sizokuzwa ngenkosi seyisho. UPHUMELE obala wezwakalisa okukhulu ukukhathazeka kwakhe lokhu uNdunankulu waKwaZulu- Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli ngegebe lamakhono nezemfundo athe libonakala likhona phakathi kwabantwana baseNingizimu Afrika uma beqhathaniswa nabaseChina.UNtuli ubekhuluma ese-ICC, eThekwini izolo emini ngesikhathi eyisikhulumi sosuku emcimbini wokuhalaliselwa kwabafundi abenze kahle baseMenzi High School eMlaza.UNtuli uthe uyafisa ukubona izinga lemfundo yaseNingizimu Afrika likhula minyaka yonke lize lifinyelele esigabeni lapho okuthiwa aliselikhulu igebe uma liqhathaniswa neChina. "Umbuzo omkhulu uthi ngabe sisele kangakanani ngokwezinga lemfundo kanjalo nangokwamakhono uma izwe lethu liqhathaniswa neChina.Kungadingeka sisebenze isikhathi esingakanani ukuze kukhulunywe eyokuthi leli gebe sesilivalile," usho kanjena. Nokho uthe kulokoza inhlansi yethemba ngokuthi kukhona okuhle okubonakalayo uma kusekhona isikole esikwazi ukuthi sikhiqize imiphumela emihle ka-matric minyaka yonke njengoba kubonakala iMenzi yenza.Lokhu uthe kukuveza ngokusobala ukuthi uma nje iNingizimu Afrika ingaqinisa amabhawodi ibhukule kwezemfundo kungagcina kukhanya. "Iqiniso ukuthi kube kuhle kakhulu ukusebenza kwabafundi bethu baKwaZulu Natal ku-matric wangonyaka odlule,," usho kanjena. Ube eseyishayela elikhulu ihlombe iMenzi ngokuphinda iphumelele ngo-100% ku-matric nyakenye.Uthe badinga ukwethulelwa isigqoko abafundi bakulesi sikole, othisha nabazali abathintekayo emfundweni yabantwana."Kudingeka ukuba zonke izinhlaka zibandakanyeke ukuze kubonakale imiphumela emihle kangaka. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kuyenzeka eMenzi," kuchaza yena. Ngalolu suku isikole sikhumbule ingqalabutho yaso eyayinguthishanhloko kusona engasekho emhlabeni, uMnuz Felix Mshololo. Bekunesithombe sakhe emnyango wase-ICC osibona ngaphambi kokuba ungene ngaphakathi.Uthishanhloko waseMenzi uNksz Ndlanzi uthe bahlabeke umxhwele ngendlela abafundi bakulesi sikole abasebenze ngayo. Uthe konke kungumphumela wokusebenza ngokuzikhandla kothisha nabafundi.Uthe njalo banomthwalo wokuqikekela ukuthi iMenzi ayilehlisi izinga kodwa iyaqhubeka nokuba yisibani esihle uma kukhulunywa ngezeMfundo. Ubashayele ihlombe othisha wathi minyaka yonke basebenza ngokuzikhandla ngoba bayakuqonda ukuthi kumqoka kangakanani ukuthi lesi sikole senze kahle minyaka yonke.Lo mcimbi ubuxhaswe yiSolwazi Zulu Foundation okuyinhlangano engenzi nzuzo kaMntwana uQedukwazi Zulu naye obekhona kuwona. UMntwana uZulu naye ubashayele ihlombe abafundi bakulesi sikole ngokwenza kahle kwabo.Uphinde wancoma kakhulu nothisha ngendima abayiklamayo ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi isikole sihlale sisebalazweni ngokwenza kahle. Lona bese kuwunyaka ka-14 isikole sigila izimanga siphumelela ngo-100%. Abafundi abenze kahle baklonyeliswe ngezinto ezahlukene. Kuvelile ukuthi iningi labo selithole izikhala ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme.Sishayelwe elikhulu ihlombe ngale ngqophamlando. Izikhulumi eziningi bezichaza lesi sikole njengesesiphenduke isibani emfundweni yaKwaZulu-Natal namaphethelo. Umcimbi ubuzinyaziswe yizihambeli ebezivela ezinhlakeni ezahlukene. Bekukhona nabaholi bezenkolo okubandakanya uMbhishobhi Linda Mandindi webandla lamaWeseli noMbhishobhi omkhulu uThabo Magkopa webandla lamaSheshi.
BABHEKENE nengwadla abafundi abaphase ngama-Bachelor ku-matric njengoba uNgqongqoshe weMfundo ePhakeme, uMnuz Buti Manamela, ethi noma bangaphasa ngale ndlela kodwa akusho ukuthi bazongena emanyuvesi.UManamela, obekhuluma nabezindaba izolo njengoba kuqale ukubhalisa ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme, uthe akubona bonke abaphase ngama-Bachelor abazokwamukelwa emanyuvesi.Zintathu izindlela zokuphasa u-matric kuleli. IBachelor okwazi ukungena ngayo enyuvesi, iDiploma okwazi ukungena ngayo ema-Universities of Technology noma iHigher Certificate. "Zncane izikhala ezikhona emanyuvesi akuleli kanti noma ungaphasa ngeBachelor, akusho ukuthi uzongena ugijima kulezi zikhungo. Sizongcweka kulo nyaka noMnyango weMfundo eyisiSekelo ngenxa yokuthi uma uthi umuntu uphase ngeBachelor, ufikelwa umqondo wokuthi uzokwazi ukungena enyuvesi. Kumele sibachazele abafundi nabazali ukuthi ukuphasa kanje akusho ukuthi nakanjani usuthathiwe enyuvesi," usho kanje. Uthe sifaka ingcindezi emkhakheni wemfundo ephakeme isibalo sabaphase u-matric nyakenye.Lo mnyango uveze ukuthi zingu-230 206 izikhala ezikhona emanyuvesi ekubeni bengaphezu kuka-650 000 abaphase u-matric.Ukhale ngesibalo esincane sabafundi abenza izifundo iMaths, iSayensi nobuChwepheshe."Siyakhula isibalo sabenza iMaths Literacy kuneMaths, okuvalela ngaphandle abafundi emikhakheni efana nowezobunjiniyela. Kumele bahlele ngendlela izifundo abazozenza ezizokwazi ukubafaka kule mikhakha," kusho uManamela. Uthe akukhona ukuphela komhlaba kulabo abangathathwa emanyuvesi."Kumele siphume emqondweni wokuthi kumele siye emanyuvesi uma siphothula u-matric ngoba zikhona ezinye izinhlelo. Akhona amakolishi amakhono amaTVET namanye amakolishi."Uveze ukuthi isikhwama esixhasa ngemali yokufunda iNational Student Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS), sizoxhasa izitshudeni eziyisigidi kulo nyaka. "Zingu-626 935 izitshudeni ezenza unyaka wokuqala ezizoxhaswa kulo nyaka. Zingu-427 144 ebezivele zifunda, ezizoxhaswa. Ama-SETA azoxhasa izitshudeni ezevile ku-15 000 ngemifundaze." Uzwakalise ithemba lokuthi kuzoba nokuthula kulo nyaka njengoba beba nemihlangano ehlukene ukuzama ukuxazulula izinkinga ezikhona.Uxwayise nalabo abathi izikhungo kumele zibekele abendawo izikhala zokufunda."Asicabangi ukuthi lokhu kuyasiza. Sixwayisa nomastende abahlukumeza izitshudeni ukuthi abakuyeke lokhu. Izitshudeni kumele zizikhethele zona ukuthi zifuna ukuhla kuphi." Uveze ukuthi iNSFAS yisikhwama sikahulumeni ngakho akukho zinhlelo zokuivala lesi sikhwama.
ISIKHULU samaphoyisa kuMasipala waseKurhuleni esimisiwe, uKhomishana Julius Mkhwanazi, sithi sesisaba ngisho ukuphumela emnyango ngenxa yokuthi kukhona abasinuka ngokushona kowethula ubufakazi kwiKhomishini yeJaji uMadlanga. UMkhwanazi uthe kumphatha kabuhlungu ukuyamaniswa nokufaka kukaMnuz Marius Van Der Merwe (owaduma kwikhomishini ngoWitness D), owabulawa emva kokuba ethule ubufakazi phambi kwale khomishini. Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi evele phambi kwekomiti lasePhalamende elikhethekile izolo. UVan Der Merwe - owayefihliwe - wenza izinsolo eziningi ezishaqisayo ngoMkhwanazi ngesikhathi ethula ubufakazi.UMkhwanazi uthe akamazi kwakumazi uVan Der Merwe. "Angimazi futhi naye wayengangazi. Kubuhlungu ukusolwa ngokubulala. Angisakwazi ngisho ukuphumela emnyango ngoba abantu babona umbulali."UMkhwanazi ubuzwe ngobudlelwano bakhe nosomabhizinisi obhekene noxhaxha lwamacala, uMnuz Vusimuzi "Cat" Matlala. UMkhwanazi uthe waqala ukwazana noMatlala ngesikhathi babelungiselela umcimbi lapho imeya yayizokwethula inkulumo ngesimo somkhandlu. Ngaleso sikhathi umasipala wawuphethwe yi-DA emva kokhetho lohulumeni basekhaya lwango-2021. "Ngaleso sikhathi kwakunamahlebezi okuthi amalungu e-ANC ahlela ukuphazamisa inkulumo yemeya. Kwakungokokuqala ukuba i-ANC ilahlekelwe wumkhandlu. Ngatshelwa ukuthi abantu abasebenzela uMatlala baseqophelweni eliphezulu. Ngabe sengicela ukuba nomhlangano noMatlala. UMatlala wazifikela mathupha emhlanganweni futhi wangethula ethimbeni lakhe, wabuza ukuthi sizomkhokhela malini? Ngamtshela ukuthi akumina ohlela isabelomali kodwa wathembisa ukuthi uzosisiza ngokuhlinzeka abaqaphi, wangasho ukuthi uzosinika abangaki. Kwaphinde kwaba nomhlangano wesibili."UMkhwanazi uncome ithimba labaqaphi elalisebenzela inkampani kaMatlala."Ngahlabeka umxhwele ngethimba likaMatlala. Laligcwele abantu ababekade besebenzela uphiko lwamaphoyisa olukhethekile (SAPS Special Task Force). Ukuba nganginayo imali yokubaholela ngangizobaqasha bonke."UMkhwanazi uthe ekuqaleni babexoxa ngezinto zomsebenzi noMatlala kodwa bagcina sebekhuluma nangezinto ezithinta impilo yabo ngenxa yokuthi base befana nezingane zandawonye.Uthe babengakaze baxoxe ngezithinta ipolitiki. "UMatlala akakhulumi ngezinto ezithinta ipolitiki, ukhuluma kuphela ngezinto ezithinta ibhizinisi."UMkhwanazi uphikile ukuthi wagunyaza ukufakwa kwezimoto zikaMatlala amalambu aluhlaza. "Izimoto zikaMatlala azizange zifakwe amalambu aluhlaza. Umuntu onegunya lokufaka izimoto amalambu aluhlaza uChris Steyn. Ithimba lamaphoyisa kuzwelonke lazifikela mathupha emahhovisi ngesikhathi liphenya lolu daba. Lafike lafuna ngoshova ukukhuluma noSteyn owawachazela ukuthi akukho zimoto ezafakwa amalambu aluhlaza."UMkhwanazi uthe kuze kube namhlanje akakaze anikezwe izizathu zokumiswa kwakhe emsebenzini.
UMHOLI we-ANC, uDkt Ntuthuko Mahlaba, uyamaniswa nemoto eyathengela ukudla izinkabi ezabulala ufakazi ecaleni lokubulala ayebhekene nalo. Icala lokubulala lagcina lihoxiswa emva kokubulawa kukafakazi. Kuvele ukuthi imoto eyabonakala ithengela izinkabi okuya ngasethunjini ngosuku olwandulela usuku okwabulawa ngalo ufakazi woMbuso, uMnuz Martin Sithole, yayitshelekwe nguMahlaba komunye umholi we-ANC oqavile esifundeni iMbuso Kubheka.Lokhu kuhlaluke eNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu izolo, ngesikhathi kulalelwe icala lokubulawa kukaSithole nomngani wakhe, uMnuz Buthanani Shange.USithole wabulawa ngo-2019.UMahlaba oyilungu lesiShayamthetho KwaZulu-Natal, uke waba wumphathiswa wokuHlaliswa kwaBantu KwaZulu-Natal, waba wumphathiswa wezeMidlalo, ezobuCiko namaSiko, waba umgcinimafa we-ANC esifundazweni.Ngesikhathi eboshelwa icala lokubulala uNgobeni ngo-2019, wayeyimeya kaMasipala waseNewcastle, wayephinde abe usihlalo we-ANC esifundeni iMbuso Kubheka. USithole wayengufakazi ecaleni lokubulawa kowayengumholi we-ANC Youth League esifundeni iMbuso Kubheka, uMnuz Wandile Ngubeni.Ukubulawa kukaSithole kwaholela ekuhoxisweni kwecala lokubulala elalibhekene noMahlaba.Imoto eyabonakala ithengela izinkabi ukudla ngeyekhansela elisethimbeni lesikhashana elihola i-ANC esifundeni iMbuso Kubheka, uMnuz Ally Khoza.Abalisa abathathu, uMnuz Philani Thwala, Phakama Radebe noMmeli Nxumalo, babhekene necala lokubulala uSithole noShange. Umshushisi omkhulu, u-Advocate Lawrence Gcaba, uvezele inkantolo izithombe ezikhombisa imoto eyayitshelekwe nguuMahlaba ishayelwa uThwala ngosuku olwandulela usuku okwabulawa ngalo uSithole.Imoto yafike yathenga ukudla egaraji eliseNewcastle, ebusuku. I-slip sokudla okwathengwa yile moto satholakala endlini okwakulele kuyo izinkabi ezabulala uSithole.UKhoza utshele inkantolo ukuthi imoto yakhe ewuhlobo lweveni yayitshelekwe nguMahlaba ngesikhathi okwabulawa ngaso uSithole, wathi uMahlaba waboleka imoto yakhe ngesikhathi kubhekwe okhethweni lukazwelonke olwalungawo u-2019."Wathi angimboleke imoto yami ngoba iphakeme, wanginika eyakhe mina ngasebenzisa yona."UKhoza uthe uMahlaba akazange ambuyisele imoto yakhe nangemva kokuthi esethenge elakhe iveni.Uthe kunalokho, imoto yakhe wayeke ayibone ishayelwa uRadebe kanye nabanye.UKhoza uthe akakaze anikeze uThwala igunya lokuthi ashayele imoto, wathi futhi wayengamazi nokumazi. UKhoza uthe washaqeka ngesikhathi amaphoyisa emkhombisa izithombe zikaThwala eshayela imoto yakhe. Ngaleso sikhathi uKhoza wayephekwa ngemibuzo amaphoyisa mayelana nokubulawa kukaSithole, wathi watshelwa ukuthi uThwala wanikezwa imoto yakhe ukuba ayothenga ukudla.Abasolwa bayaliphika icala.Ukulalelwa kwecala kuzoqhubeka namhlanje.
UMHOLI we-EFF, uMnuz Julius Malema, udonse ngendlebe osomatekisi ukuba bashintshe indlela abenza ngayo ngoba basuke bethwele ikusasa leNingizimu Afrika. UMalema ukhulume kanje ngaphandle kweNkantolo eNkulu yase-East London e-Eastern Cape ngoLwesihlanu.UMalema ubeduduza imindeni yabafundi abangu-14 abashone engozini yemoto eyenzeke eVanderbijlpark, eGoli ngoMsombuluko. Uthe abashayeli abathutha izingane kufanele bazi ukuthi bathwele abantu hhayi iamasaka amazambane. "Kufanele nazi ukuthi uma kufa ingane kuleyo tekisi kusuke kufa ikhanda elingashintsha usizi lomndeni. Kufanele nazi ukuthi nibulale ikusasa nethemba lomndeni." Uthe le ngozi beyingagwemeka. Ugqugquzele abalandeli be-EFF ukuba bangapheli amandla . "Noma ngabe isinqumo semantshi sithini kodwa ningapheli amandla." Uthe i-EFF yinhlangano ethwele amathemba abantu.Uthe noma kungenzekani kuyena kodwa akasoze athobela abantu abamhlophe. Ubonge izinhlangano zepolitiki ezibeke eceleni ukungaboni ngaso linye ne-EFF, njengeMK Party, kodwa zazokweseka i-EFF. Ukulalelwa kwesigwebo sikaMalema kuhlehliselwe umhla ka-15 no-16 Ephreli. UMalema watholakala enecala lokuba nesibhamu esingenamvume nezinhlambu, ukudubula esidlangalaleni, ukuhluleka ukucophelela kanye nokuba budedengu kubantu nasempahleni. UMalema wadubula embhiyozweni waleli qembu owawuseSisa Dukashe Stadium eMdantsane ngoJulayi 2018. NgoLwesihlanu uMbuso uthe ufuna uMalema agqunywe ejele. Nakuba kunjalo abameli bakaMalema bayavuma ukuthi noma aba budedengu ngokudubula kodwa wayengakhombe muntu ngesibhamu. Bathe inhlawulo kuphela okudingeka inikezwe uMalema. Abalandeli be-EFF bebephume ngobuningi babo ukuthamela icala. Abaholi be-EFF bebegqoke izikibha ebezibhalwe ukuthi "Akuhlukwane no-CIC." Iningi labo belichapha ngenhlamba i-AfriForum, uMengameli wase-USA uDonald Trump noMengameli wakuleli uCyril Ramaphosa. Leli cala bekufanele lihlalelwe eNkantolo yeMantshi yase-East London kodwa kwashintshelwa kwenkulu ngenxa yobuncane bendawo ehlala izithameli ngaphakathi.
INissan iqede ukuqagela ngekusasa lefemu yayo eseRossyln ePitoli imemezela ukuthi isiyidayisele iChery South Africa. Le femu ikhiqiza iveni iNavara. INissan ithe ngokwesivumelwano, abebenzi abaningi bazonikezwa umsebenzi kwaChery ngemigomo efanayo nabasebenza ngayo. Isikhulu sakwaNissan Africa uJordi Vila sithe bese kunesikhathi befuna isisombululo esizovuna abasebenzi, amakhasimende nababambisene nabo. "Ngalesi sivumelwano siyakwazi ukugcina imisebenzi yabasebenzi abaningi kanjalo namathuba kwabasihlinzeka ngamaphathi. Leli gxathu liqinisekisa ukuthi indawo yaseRosslyn iyaqhubeka nokufaka isandla embonini yezimoto eNingizimu Afrika.”INissan ithe izoqhubeka nokudayisa izimoto kuleli futhi izokwethula ezintsha nonyaka okubalwa kuzo iTekton nePatrol. Ngonyaka odlule iNissan yaveza ukuthi izovala amafemu ayisikhombisa emhlabeni jikelele eminyakeni emibili ezayo ngenxa yokuzama ukunciphisa izindleko.
UKUSWELA imisebenzi kubenza bagcine sebephila impilo yabo engcupheni abahlali basemijondolo eyakhiwe eweni elingaku-Alpine Road, Springfield, eThekwini.Isolezwe lihambele kule ndawo izolo, lafike laxoxa nabahlali abadalule uxhaxha lwezinkinga ababhekene nazo kodwa base bethi bancamela ukubeka impilo yabo engcupheni ngoba befuna ukuguqula isimo. UMnuz Mlungisi Chiliza waseMkhomazi ngokuzalwa, uveze ukuthi sekuphele iminyaka eyisithupha ehlezi kule ndawo. Uchaze le ndawo njengegubazelwe wusizi olungapheli.''Akukho okuhamba kahle kule ndawo. Simane sihlezi nje phela ngoba akukho lapho esingaya khona. Kubi mfowethu, siswele imisebenzi ukuze nathi sithole imiqasho engcono kunalena esizithola sihlezi kuyona njengamanje,” usho kanjena.Eqhulwini ubalise ngokuthi bafake ugesi wezinyokanyoka, athe sewuke wakhipha izidumbu amahlandla amaningana.''Uyabona nje, kunengane encane elinyazwe yiwona lo gesi ngonyaka owedlule. Kukhona nomunye futhi naye owalinyazwa yiwona ngawo unyaka owedlule. Lesi simo sinzima kakhulu,” usho kanjena.Uthe ulapha eThekwini ngoba esondelela amathuba omsebenzi, wathi kodwa kuyabhimba kwesinye isikhathi kuye kwenzeke balale bengadlile. Uthe akakholwa ukuthi kukhona abantu abaphila lolu hlobo lwempilo abayiphilayo.UNksz Thobekile Mthembu omunye umhlali, uthe sekuphele iminyaka emine egcwele eqube kule ndawo. Uthe kuyona uhlala nosana nomunye umntwana oneminyeka engu-10."Kumele njalo ngihlale ngiqaphile ukuthi lo oneminyaka engu-10 akaphumeli phandle yedwa ngoba uma kungenzeka iphutha elincane nje, ngingamthola esephonseke eweni. Ibuhlungu kakhulu le mpilo esizithola sibhekene nayo lapha,” usho kanjena.Naye ubalise ngengwadla yokuntuleka kwamathuba omsebenzi, wathi yiwona mnyombo odala ukuthi baqhubeke nokuhlala kule ndawo phezu kokuba bebona ukuthi impela indawo kayiphephile nje nhlobo. UMnuz Senzo Mncwabe uthe sekuphele iminyaka emine naye ehlala kule ndawo. Uthe uphila ngokutohoza isikhashana lapho asuke ebizwe khona. Ubalise ngokuthi kuningi okubuhlungu abakubona kwenzeka endaweni abakuyo.Phakathi kokunye, uthe kukhona nabantu abaphukayo balimale kanzima ngenxa yobubi bendawo."'Kukhona nje osanda kuphuka umlenze kulesi siwa ngenxa nje yendawo esihlala kuyona. Kubi kakhulu. Sifisa ukuthola usizo oluphuthumayo uma kungenzeka,” usho kanjena.UMnuz Kwanele Nsundwane ongowaseLusikisiki, e-Eastern Cape, uthe sekuphele iminyaka ecuphe kule ndawo. Uqale ngokubalisa ngezinga eliphezulu lokushisa athe likhona ngaphakathi emijondolo."Kubi, angikaze ngikuzwe ukushisa okunjena mina empilweni yami. Umuntu kuhle nje alivume iqiniso, akuyona indawo engaphila abantu lena kodwa umuntu umane uyabekezela nje ngenxa yosizi lokuswela imisebenzi. Akekho umuntu osebenza kahle ongavuma ukuhlala endaweni enjengalena,” usho kanjena kucweba izinyembezi.Ubalise kakhulu nangezindlu zangasese, wathi azikho nje nhlobo esimweni esifanele ukuthi zingasetshenziswa abantu."Kubuhlungu kakhulu ukuphila endaweni enezindlu zangasese zalolu hlobo. Lena yimpilo engeke iphilwe nayisilwane lesi sasehlane,” echaza ekhulumela phansi.Utshele Isolezwe ukuthi bayafisa ukuthi bathole usizo oluphuthumayo kule nkinga abazithola bebhekene nayo. "Bhala bhuti utshele abantu ukuthi siyahlupheka, silala singadlile futhi siswele imisebenzi,” esho enikina ikhanda ebheka phansi. Udalule nokuthi babhekene nenkinga yamanzi njengoba bewathola endaweni ebuqamama. Uthe kunzima nokuwathutha njengoba abanye behlale endaweni etshekile okungahambeki kalula kuyona.Bakhale nangokuthi akukho ukuthula kule ndawo njengoba kuba nabantu abalwayo njalo uma sebephuzile baze balimazane bodwa.Bakholwa nawukuthi izakhiwo zabo kazisaphephile nje nhlobo ngoba sezindala kakhulu. Bathe ngeke bamangele uma ngelinye ilanga kunomoya omkhulu, kungathiwa zidilikile kwase kwalimala kabi abantu abaningi, badalula nokuthi balinganiselwa ku-500 sebebonke abantu abahlala kule mijondolo. Basikaze ukuthi abasebenzayo balinganiselwa ku-100 nje kuphela. Okudala ukuthi baphile, uthe yikhona ukuthi ongenakho ukudla uyanana komunye.Bathe balala obenyoni ikakhulukazi uma kunemvula enkulu ngoba bayazi ukuthi bangahamba noma yinini emhlabeni. Baveze nokuthi ngo-2021, le mijondolo yake yasha yaphela kodwa baqala phansi bayakha ngoba kungekho okunye abangakwenza.Esikhulume nabo batshele Isolezwe ukuthi njengoba bekhuluma nalo nje, abadlile esiswini base becela ukuthi iphele ingxoxo ngoba bekhala ngokuthi sekozobumbana ihora lokuqala emini okuyisikhathi abadingeka ngaso kwenye indawo lapho abaphiwa khona izinkwa nsuku zonke.Baveze nokuthi kunenkampani esizame kaningi ukubasusa kule ndawo yayo kodwa bayenqaba ukusuka ngoba nabo kabazi ukuthi uma kungathiwa bayasuka bangabheka kuziphi izinkalo. Isimo esificwe yiSolezwe lapha siveza usizi olunakashele abantu eNingizimu Afrika. Ukuba woqhibukhowe kwemijondolo eThekwini, yinto engasathusi. Kukhona nesibike ngayo ngonyaka odlule eyakhiwe phezu kwendawo engamathuna asavalwa. Kwezinye izindawo, abahlali bathwala kanzima uma like lana ngenxa yodaka. Cishe bonke abantu abaqube emijondolo, basho into eyodwa yokuthi bazohlwaya amathuba angcono ngoba baxoshwa yinkemane ezindaweni eziqhelelene namadolobha amakhulu.Abasemagunyeni bahlale bethembisa ukuguqula isimo kepha kubukeka bethembisa into engekho nabahlulekayo wukuyilawula ngoba bathi bekhipha abanye emijondolo kube kusala kungena abanye.
SISHAYA amakhala isazi sezomthetho, uMnuz Mpumelelo Zikalala, ngalabo ebebebanjwa benza okungafanele emigwaqweni bese bethwetshulwa izithombe nama-video okuphanyekwe ezinkundleni zokuxhumana wuMnyango wezokuThutha KwaZulu-Natal. Uthe lokhu kuphambene nomthetho, futhi kunyathela amalungelo abasolwa.Umnyango ubusembhidlangweni wokunciphisa izingozi zomgwaqo ngamaholidi, nokuvele ukuthi kube yimpumelelo ngokwezibalo ezikhishwe muva nje. Umnyango ubuphake inqwaba yamaphoyisa omgwaqo, abenza izivimbamgwaqo ezindaweni ezehlukene esifundazweni ngaphansi komkhankaso othi #NenzaniLaEzweni. Amaphoyisa eRoad Traffic Inspectorate (RTI) esebenzisana naweSAPS kanye nawomasipala abehlala amagqozo kulabo abebabamba ukuthi baphula umthetho okubandakanya abashayela bedle amanzi amponjwana, abebehamba ngesivinini esiphezulu, abebesebenzisa izimoto ezingekho esimeni esikahle kanjalo nalabo abangenamalayisensi okushayela nokunye. Kodwa kubukeke umkhankaso uqonde kakhulu abebeshayela bephuzile ngoba njalo emva kwezimbamgwaqo bekhukhishwa izibalo zabo futhi kuchazwe nangemisebenzi eyenziwa ababoshiwe. Belibhubha ngokuboshwa kwamasosha, amaphoyisa, othisha nabahlengikazi. Kuke kwavela kabili nokuthi kubalwa nabefundisi kwabakhalelwe ngamasongo kaSigonyela. Umnyango ububuye uziphanyeke enkundleni yokuxhumana iFacebook izithombe zabanye balabo ababanjwe bephula umthetho. Kokunye ububuye uphanyeke ama-video uma kube nesigameko njengokuthi obeboshwa uzame ukubaleka okanye obegolozela amaphoyisa.UZikalala uzwakalise ukuthi ngokomthetho akuvumelekile ukuphanyekwa kwezithombe zalaba. Uthe njengoba kwaziwa ukuthi akuvumelekile ukuveza umuntu osolwa ngecala elithize engakaveli enkantolo, ukuthwetshulwa kwabo nakho akuvumelekile uma kwenziwa ngenhloso yobupigogo bokubukisa ngabo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana. Nokho uthe ngokubuka kwakhe abe-RTI bebenobuchule uma bethwebula njengoba abebusitha ubuso. "Amalungelo abo bebewanyathela ngoba bebesengabasolwa emacaleni okuthiwa bawenzile, kodwa ngakolunye uhlangothi abomnyango bangazivikela ngelithi bebengabuvezi ubuso,” kusho uZikalala, othe nakuba kunjalo, abantu abamaziyo umuntu, bayabona ukuthi ngubani osesithombeni okanye kwi-video. Isolezwe libone kwamanye ama-video ezinkundleni zokuxhumana buvezwa ubuso babasolwa njengasesigamekweni somlisa mumbe obanjwe nenqwaba yezibhamu eMariannhill Toll Plaza, ePinetown. Nomfokazi okinatelwe eMlaza ngempelasonto okuthiwe nguMthembu, obeboshwa amaphoyisa amabili okuthiwe anesibongo esifana nesakhe, naye uvezwe engafihliwe ngoba i-video beyiqoshwa bukhoma.UZikalala uqhube wathi abathwetshuliwe bangakwazi ukukulwa lokhu ngenkantolo, ngokuthi bavule amacala okudicilela phansi isithunzi. Uthe uma bethukiwe ngesikhathi bethwetshulwa, bangalengeza necala lokuhlanjalazwa. Uveze ukuthi ukufaka enkantolo icala ngalezi zithombe noma ama-video kungenzeka ukuthi kube nomdonsiswano omude njengoba abameli bomnyango bengalwa ngephuzu elithi "kodwa ubuso negama umnyango awukuvezanga” bese kuyezwakala ukuthi abalowo ofake icala babeka maphi amaphuzu. Uthe uma kungenzeka othwetshuliwe ephuma phambili ecaleni, angaba nelungelo lokuthi enze isicelo sokuthi uhulumeni umnxephezele ngokwehliswa kwakhe isithunzi. Okhulumela umnyango, uMnuz Ndabezinhle Sibiya, akangenanga kwabekubuziwe kodwa uthe bayasamukela isimemezelo sokuncipha kwesibalo sababhubhe ezingozini zomgwaqo."Lokhu kube ngenxa yomkhankaso i#NenzaniLaEzweni obuthe chithisaka, ubheka abashayela bephuzile. Sizoqhubeka nokubasusa emigwaqweni yethu abashayela budedengu ngaphambi kokuthi babulale abanye abantu abasebenzisa umgwaqo,” kusho uSibiya. Uthe emigwaqweni, benza umsebenzi wabo beqondiswa yimigomo ethize yokusebenza.
KULINDELEKE ukuthi bavele namuhla eNkantolo yeMantshi yasePinetown abasolwa ababili abebengakaboshwa ecaleni lokubulawa kowesilisa waseCoffee Farm, KwaNdengezi. Kulesi sigameko esenzeka ngo-Okthoba 23 nyakenye, kwabulawa uMnuz Kholwani Cele (34), esolwa ngokuthandana nenkosikazi kamakhelwane wakhe.Umakhelwane, uMnuz Sibongiseni Johannes Mbhele, ongumsolwa wokuqala, ubevele enkantolo efanayo ngoMsombuluko kulandela ukuzinikela emaphoyiseni ngoLwesihlanu, wagonyuluka ngesigameko. Ngokuthola kweSolezwe ngomthombo izolo, abasolwa ababili abebesele, baboshwe bebhace ezihlotsheni khona KwaNdengezi ngoMsombuluko.Babevezwe uMbhele ngesikhathi egonyuluka ngokuthi bambulala, base bembelethisa itshe, maqede bamphonsa emfuleni uMngeni ngaseSpringfield. UCele ubelokhu ethathwa njengomuntu odukile njengoba umndeni wakhe wabikela amaphoyisa ngokunyamalala kwakhe engabuyi emsebenzini ngosuku lwesigameko. Umzala wakhe, uMnuz Sbonelo Cele, uthe bajabule bengumndeni ngesivinini samaphoyisa aseMariannhill asebenza ngaso ukubopha abasolwa ngecala. "Besihleli ebumnyameni isikhathi eside kodwa manje sijabule ngendlela okuqhubeka ngayo umsebenzi wamaphoyisa,” kusho uCele. Uveze ukuthi asitholakalanga isidumbu ngeSonto njengoba amaphoyisa ayebabizele endaweni yesigameko lapho uMbhele ayeyowakhombisa ukuthi basijikijelaphi."Kodwa kukhona okuthembisayo njengoba umndeni usuqale uhlelo lokuhamba namaphoyisa ukuya emakhazeni kahulumeni asePhoenix ukuyohlonza izidumbu zabayiswa khona bengaziwa ukuthi bangobani,” kusho uCele. Uthe likhona ithemba njengoba amaphoyisa ebatshele ukuthi ngokophenyo lwawo kuyavela ukuthi sikhona isidumbu esatholwa ngasemfuleni ofanayo, okuthe uma sichazwa, kwakhona okukhomba ukuthi esikaCele. Uthe cishe namuhla bazobe sebenakho okuphathekayo ngokuthi umufi utholakele ngempela nokuzobanika umhlahlandlela wokuthi baqale amalungiselelo omngcwabo.Uthe okwamanje abasakwenzile bewumndeni ukuzotha, kodwa njengoba bengakasiqinisekisi isidumbu sikamufi bebengakaluqali uhlelo lokubasa ikhandlela. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe abasolwa ababili baboshwe amaphoyisa aseMariannhill ngoMsombuluko."Bazovela enkantolo maduze,” kusho uNetshiunda.
ISILO samabandla onke, uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini, sibabaza ubuthatha ezintombini zakuleli ezikhetha ukuqoma abokufika.IMbube ithe ukuqoma kwezintombi zakuleli abantu bokufika yikhona okuholele ekutheni abakuleli begcine sebebhekana ngeziqu zamehlo nabokufika esikoleni samabanga aphansi, i-Addington Primary, kubangwa izikhala zokufunda.Ikusho lokhu ngesikhathi yethula inkulumo eMkhosini waseSandlwana.Sishubile isimo e-Addington Primary School njengoba izinhlangano eziphikisana nabokufika, iMarch and March ne-Operation Dudula ziba nemibhikisho ngaphandle kwesikole zikhala ngokuthi izingane zabantu bakuleli ziswele izikhala zokufunda ekubeni kulesi sikole kugcwele izingane zabantu bokufika abangenawo amaphepha okuba kuleli.IMbube ithe akukuhle okwenzeka e-Addington Primary."Lokhu okwenzeka lapha e-Addington, eyi siyalimala lapha kodadewethu. Kothiwani ngoba phela sekukhona abashana bethu."INdlulamithi yamakhosi ithe kusafanele luhlalelwe phansi lolu daba."Kufanele sikhulume ukuthi sikuthini lokhu ngoba noma ngabe umshana wami uzalwa umuntu wokufika, akahambe asale umshana wami, uma kumele kube njalo."IMbube ithe izinsizwa zikaZulu nazo kufanele ziqonywe kwezinye izizwe."Zulu omnyama siyakudinga ukuthi sakhe ubuhlobo nezinye izizwe siwuZulu, singalwi. Ake niyoqonywa nje butho likaZulu, niyoqonywa amaVenda khona la ekhaya. NaseZimbabwe kwelikaMzilikazi, bangamaZulu, ningakukhohlwa lokho. Singawulimazi umlando. OSoshangane, eSwatini.
