Sithe abanezikhalo kufanele beze kusona."Ngiyanithembisa ukuthi ayikho impi esizoyiqala. Sizokhuluma nje nabo ukuthi sukani la. Hheyi akekho umuntu ongenalo ikubo."IMbube ithe izokhuluma kahle ngalolu daba uma sekuqedwe yonke imikhuba egcinwayo ehambisana noMkhosi woSelwa.IMbube iphinde yakhuza ukungena ngomkhono nesiphanga kweminyango kahulumeni emikhosini yaseNdlunkulu."Lo mcimbi esikuwo namhlanje akuwona umcimbi kahulumeni. Wayengekho uhulumeni ngesikhathi uJininindi ephaka le mpi. Kwakukhona uZulu la. Manje uhulumeni akangagagxeli ngoba nakhu ephethe imali, thina singenamali."
"ANGIKAWUTHATHI umhlalaphansi, okufunwa ngabantu ngisengakwenza.'' Lena yindlela uDkt Zweli Mkhize aphendule ngayo ngesikhathi ebuzwa ukuthi kusengenzeka yini ukuba aphinde abonakale kuvela igama lakhe engqungqutheleni yokukhetha ubuholi kwi-ANC okulindeleke ukuthi ibe ngoDisemba 2027.UMkhize ubekade enenkulumo ekhethekile neSolezwe ngesikhathi enohlelo oluhlabahlosile lokuhambela izikole ezahlukene oPhongola. Uthe usekhona lokho kusho ukuthi noma yini isengenzeka.Mayelana nokhetho lohulumeni basemakhaya uthe likhona ithuba lokuthi i-ANC isengenza kahle inqobo nje uma iqala phansi izihlele kahle. ''Ngesikhathi sethu bekuthi njalo uma siya okhethweni ungabi bikho umqondo wokuthi siyakhona ngokuthi vele siyonqoba. Kodwa besiya khona sizimisele, silangazelele ukunqoba,” usho kanjena.Uthe okumqoka kakhulu wukubona i-ANC isondela ebantwini, ikhulume nabo futhi iphinde ibachazele ngamaphutha enzekile. Uthe lokhu kuyinto emqoka kakhulu ukuba yenziwe.Uphinde wahalalisela iKwaZulu-Natal ngokwenza kahle iziqwaqwade zonke izifundazwe eNingizimu Afrika emiphumeleni ka-matric. "Lokhu kwenze saziqhenya kakhulu thina njengabaholi abadala KwaZulu-Natal.”Uthe lokhu kudinga ukushayelwa elikhulu ihlombe leli kwazise kukhona isikhathi lapho okwakubonakala khona ukuthi ziyabhimba impela izinto ikakhulukazi kwisiFunda uMkhanyakude."Ngikhumbula kahle ukuthi kunesikhathi lapho uMkhanyakude wawuphume khona unombolo 11. Lokho kwaba yinto engeyinhle. Siyabonga kakhulu uma izinto seziguquke ngale ndlela.”Mayelana nohlelo lokuhambela izikole ezahlukene oPhongolo uthe lokhu yinto ajwayele ukuyenza minyaka yonke. Inhlosongqangi yalokhu uthe kusuke kungukubheka kabanzi ukuthi yiziphi izinselelo lezo zikole ezibhekene nazo ukuze babuyele emuva kubaphathi bezemfundo babazise ngalokho.Uqale ngokuhambela eDwaleni High eNcotshana ku-ward 2. Usithulele isigqoko lesi sikole ngokuhlomula ngo-99% emiphumeleni ka-matric yangonyaka odlule. Uthe kuyajabulisa ukubona izikole zasemakhaya zenza kahle kangaka phezu kokuba kukhona izinselelo ezibhekene nazo. Uveze ukuthi lesi sikole sikwazile ukuthi senze lokhu phezu kokuba othisha bebhekene nengwadla yokufundisa emagumbini okufundisa kuminyene. "Uyabona nje abafundi bakulesi sikole bangu-1 700 sebebonke. Kodwa amagumbi okufundela angu-21. Eqinisweni uma ubuka isibalo sabafundi kumele ngabe sikhuluma indaba yokuthi amagumbi okufundela angu-42 esewonke kodwa akunjalo kulesi sikole,” kuchaza yena.Uthe uhlabeke umxhwele njengoba lesi sikole siphinde sakhiqiza oBachelor abaningi. "Lokhu kukuveza ngokusobala ukuthi basebenze ngokuzikhandla okungakanani othisha nabafundi bakulesi sikole.”Udlulele esikoleni, iMagutshwa High esiKwaShoba ku-ward 15. UKhabazela uzwakalise okukhulu ukukhathazeka ngalesi sokole kangangoba uveze ukuthi ube nomhlangano odonsile impela nothishanhloko waso. Uveze ukuthi lesi sikole siphumelele ngo-53% ngonyaka odlule, sisuka ku-63% wango-2024, ekubeni eminyakeni eyedlule sike sahlomula ngo-74%. Uthe lokhu kuveza ngokusobala inkinga ekhona kulesi sikole."Ziningi izinkinga ezigubuzele lesi sikole. Kukhona inkinga yamanzi. Kuphinde kuzoba khona nenkinga yombango wezikhundla.” Noma zimapeketwane zinjalo izinto kulesi sikole uthembise ukuthi kukhona abazokwenza ngenhloso yokuqinisekisa ukuthi kutholakala izixazululo ngoxhaxha lwezinkinga zesikole."Kumele nakanjani kube khona okwenziwayo ukuze izinto zilunge kulesi silkole,” usho kanjena.Ubuye waba nomhlangano nabaholi bezenkolo obusesakhiweni sebandla iDikapoli ku-ward 9. Namhlanje uzoqhubeka nohambo lwakhe njengoba ezohambela isikole iSiqalakubona High esisoPhondwane ku-ward 8 bese edlulela eMpindiso High ku-ward 8.Ugcizelele ukuthi imfundo iyisikhali esimqoka, konke kuqala kuyona wathi ngenxa yalokho kumqoka kakhulu ukuthi kwenziwe konke okusemandleni ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imfundo iphathiswa okwezikhali zamaNtungwa.UMkhize onguqolothakamango kuhulumeni nakwi-ANC, manje unguSihlalo wekomiti loMnyango wokuBusa ngokuBambisana nobuHoli boMdabu ePhalamende.
I-DURBAN University of Technology (DUT) ikhiphe isexwayiso ngokuthi kukhona abangasebenzisa igama lesikhungo ukuqola izitshudeni. Lokhu kulandela ukusabalala kwemibiko yokuthi kukhona abebegwazisa abebeshaye ujenga befuna ukubhalisa ekhampasini yaseThekwini izolo. Abebelinde ukubhalisa bathe kunemali okuthiwa iyadingeka ukuze bathole izikhala. Bathe le mali kuthiwa mabangene ngaphakathi sebeyiphethe. Isikhungo sitheabenza lo mkhuba bavamise ukubheka labo bafundi okubonakalayo ukuthi luncane ulwazi abanalo mayelana nohlelo lwesikhungo lokubhalisa.Sithe siyabaxwayisa abafundi ngabantu abangabashayela izingcingo bebatshela ngezikhala ezikhona kulesi sikhungo baze badlulele babatshele ngendaba yenkokhelo.Isolezwe libuye lathola ngengwadla yohlelo olusha lwezobuchwepheshe lokubhalisa olusetshenziswayo kulesi sikhungo okuthiwa lunezinkingaAbamele izitshudeni bathe luhamba ngonyawo lonwabu futhi luyehluleka ukulekelela ababhalisayo.Mayelana nalokhu iDUT ithe isikhungo sisungule lolu hlelo olusha lokubhalisa ngoba sikholwa wukuthi luyashesha. Sithe kuyinto elindelekile ukuthi vele kube khona ubuhixihixi njengoba kuwuhlelo olusha. Sibe sesinxusa abafundi ukuba babe nesineke bazifundise ukubekezela.

U-Ayanda Dludla (22) uvele ngaphambi kweNkantolo yeMantshi yaseVanderbijlpark.UDludla ubhekene namacala angu-14 okubulala ngokungenhloso, 3 okuzama ukubulala, elokushayela ngaphandle kwemvume yokushayela egunyaziwe, elokushayela imoto engenayo ilayisensi kanye nelobudedengu.Lokhu kumayelana nengozi eyenzeke ngesikhathi itekisi ayehamba ngalo lishayisane neloli ku-Droste Road, eVanderbijlpark ngoMsombuluko 19 Januwari 2026. Umbiko wokuqala waveza ukuthi bangu12 abafundi abashone ngalo usuku lwengozi kodwa, isibalo sinyukile ngoLwesine amaphoyisa eveza ukuthi kushone abanye ababili abebesesibhedlela.Amaphoyisa athi laba bafundi ababili bashonele esibhedlela ezintatha zangoLwesine.UDludla ushalazele indaba yebheyili icala lakhe lihlehlele umhla ka-5 Mashi.
Abanye abafundi ababili abaphuthunyiswa esibhedlela ngemuva kwengozi eyenzeke eVaal ngoMsombuluko banqotshwe wukufa. Lokhu kunyuse isibalo sabashonile safinyelela ku-14. Amaphoyisa athi laba bafundi ababili bashonele esibhedlela ezintatha zangoLwesine. Lokhu kusho ukuthi umshayeli wetekisi elalilayishe laba abafundi usebhekene namanye amacala okubulala ngokungenhloso, kanye namacala okushayela budedengu.Umsolwa oneminyaka engu-22 ubudala uboshwe ngemuva kokuphuma esibhedlela kanti kulindeleke ukuthi avele okokuqala eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseVanderbijlpark ngoLwesine. Okhulumela amaphoyisa uColonel Mavela Masondo uthe uphenyo ngale ngozi luyaqhubeka. "Lo mshayeli oneminyaka engu-22 ubudala usebhekene namacala angu-14 okubulala ngokungenhloso kanye nokushayela budedengu.”
ABESIBHEDLELA iPrince Mshiyeni Memorial, eMlaza, eningizimu yeTheku, sebehlabe ikhwelo lokukhuthaza abantu besifazane ukunikela ngobisi lwebele ukuze kusizakale izingane ezincane ikakhulu ezitetwe kungakabi yisikhathi.Lokhu kushiwo yi-dietician yakulesi sibhedlela, uNksz Nicole Govender, odalule ukuthi okwenza baqhubeke nalo myalezo wukubona kwanda izingane ezizalwa kungakabi yisikhathi esifanele esibhedlela sabo, nokuba nenkinga yokuzikhulisa ngendlela efanele."Sifuna ukusiza ukunqanda ukudloba kwale nkinga ngenxa yokuthi isikhathi esiningi uma umuntu wesifazane etete ingane kungakabi yisikhathi esifanele, akabi nawo amandla okuncelisa umntwana wakhe. Lokhu kwenza ukuthi umntwana angakhuli ngendlela efanele nokumbeka engcupheni yokugula noma afe nokufa ngoba uma ezalwe kuleso simo usuke edinga ubisi lwangempela futhi olunomsoco ukuze akhule kahle nangokushesha,” kusho uNksz Govender. Eqhuba uthe kusukela beqala lolu hlelo ngo-2017, abalubiza ngokuthi yiPrince Mshiyeni Memorial’s Human Milk Bank, sebesize izingane ezingaphezu kuka-107, ngosizo lwabesifazane abawu-96 abasukumele phezulu bazonikela ngobisi lwabo lwebele, okwenze ukuthi isibhedlela sibe namalitha awu-77 obisi lwebele olusiza izingane."Kodwa lokhu akwanele njengoba sisadinga ukuthi kube khona abanye besifazane abasukumela phezulu ukweseka umbono wethu ukuze sihlenge izingane eziningi ezisuke zizalwe ngale ndlela, ngoba ngale kokuthi abazali bazo basuke bengenawo amandla okuncelisa lezo zingane, kwesinye isikhathi bavinjwa yizimo zempilo."Siyakuqinisekisa nokuthi akubi nabungozi ekwenzeni kwethu lokhu njengoba sihlale senza isiqiniseko sokuthi wonke umuntu wesifazane ofuna ukunikela siyamhlola futhi siqinisekise ukuthi isimo sempilo yakhe siyavuma yini ukuthi enze lokho. Sifisa ukuthi abantu bazi ukuthi akunabungozi njengoba ngisho usunikele ngobisi lwakho lwebele, uyaqhubeka futhi ukwazi ukulukhiqiza ngendlela ejwayelekile,” kusho uNksz Govender.Ukhuthaze abafisa ukweseka umbono wabo ukuthi babathinte ku-031 907 8754, waveza nokuthi isifiso sabo esikhulu wukunabela ezindaweni eziningi KwaZulu-Natal yonkana, kungabi wukuthi basiza abantu abakhele uMlaza namaphethelo njengoba kunjalo okwamanje.
I-UNIVERSITY of KwaZulu-Natal (UKZN) isihlabe yahlikiza umbiko okhishwe ngabenkampani iGravitas ngemvume yeProperty Point, obudalule ukuthi ibambisene nale nyuvesi ukwakha izindlu ezizohlala izitshudeni.I-UKZN ikhiphe isitatimende lapho idalule khona ukuthi umbiko awulona iqiniso futhi uyadukisa ngenxa yokuthi yona ayazi lutho futhi ayihlangene nohlelo lokwakhiwa kwalezi zindlu, futhi ayinabudlelwano nenkampani ezakhayo."Inyuvesi ayihlanganise lutho nomuntu obambe iqhaza ekwakhiweni kwalezo zindlu, futhi ukuthi lezo zindlu zakhiwe eduze kophiko lwenyuvesi iHoward akusho lutho njengoba ingahlanganise lutho nazo nakho konke okuqhubekayo ngohlelo lokwakhiwa kwazo."Ngakho ukuthi lolo hlelo ngolwe-UKZN noma uphiko lwayo iHoward akulona iqiniso futhi kuwumbiko odukisayo nongelona iqiniso ngoba akukho budlelwano, ukusebenzisana noma isivumelwano sokusebenzisana phakathi kwenyuvesi nabaqhuba lolo hlelo lokwakha,” kucacisa isitatimende se-UKZN.Siqhuba, sidalule ukuthi i-UKZN ayikaze ithintwe noma yaziswe ngakho konke lokho okuqhubekayo ngalolu daba, yakuhlaba yakuhlikiza ukuthi kuthiwe iyingxenye yalolu hlelo okuvele ukuthi luzodla imali engaphezu kuka-R449 million, futhi lwakhe amathuba omsebenzi angu-1 200 bese lufukula nomnotho wendawo."Siphoxekile ngokuthi asithintwanga ukuze siphawule ngalokhu andukuba kushicilelwe udaba oluthinta igama lenyuvesi, futhi sizothatha izinyathelo zokuqondisa lo mbiko emphakathini ukuze sigweme isimo esinjena ngokuzayo,” basho kanje.
OWAYEYISIKHULU sophiko oluqaphe ukusebenza kwamaphoyisa, i-Ipid, uMnuz Robert McBride, usenemibuzo eminingi ngokungayi emngcwabeni kukaKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, emngcwabeni womphenyi we-Ipid owayengumngani wakhe.UMcBride uthe namanje usazibuza ukuthi kungani uMkhwanazi engazange aye emngcwabeni kaMnuz Mandlakayise Mahlangu, owabulawa ngo-2020?Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi evele phambi kwekomiti lasePhalamende eliphenya izinsolo ezenziwa uMkhwanazi.UMcBride uthe uMahlangu wayengumngani omkhulu kaMkhwanazi, wabulawa ngesikhathi ephenya izinsolo zenkohlakalo ekuthengweni kwamavesti amaphoyisa avikela izinhlamvu nezinsolo zenkohlakalo ezazibhekiswe kowayebambe kwesikaKhomishana wamaPhoyisa, uLieutenant General Khomotso Phahlane.UMcBride uthe uMkhwanazi waba umuntu wokuqala ukufika lapho okwadutshulelwa khona uMahlangu."Okuxakayo ukuthi uMkhwanazi wayengeyena umphenyi ngaleso sikhathi, wayesebenza ophikweni lokuqashwa kwabantu khona emaphoyiseni. Okungithusayo ke ukuthi uMkhwanazi akazange aye emngcwabeni. Kungani engayanga emngcwabeni womuntu owumngani wakhe?"UMcBride uvele wangena ezintangeni ngesikhathi amalungu ekomiti embuza ukuthi ngabe uzama ukuveza ukuthi uMkhwanazi waba nesandla ekubulaweni kukaMahlangu?"Angazi kodwa engingakusho ukuthi kukhona okushaya amanzi lana futhi kufanele kuphenywe."UMcBride uthe bakhona abalisa abagwetshelwa icala lokubulala uMahlangu."Izinkabi zathi zathunywa yiphoyisa ukuba zibulale uMahlangu. Zathi zahlangana nephoyisa erenki, lazinika imali nemininingwane yomuntu okwakufanele zimbulale. Kuningi nje okudidayo ngaleli cala."UMcBride uthe uMkhwanazi wayesondelene kakhulu noPhahlane futhi wayemvikela, wathi uMkhwanazi wayelokhu ephazamisa uphenyo olwalubhekene noPhahlane.Ohola ubufakazi, u-Advocate Norman Arendse, ufunde incwadi efungelwe ebhalwe wumphenyi we-Ipid.Le ncwadi iveza ukuthi uMkhwanazi wayehambe efuna noma ibuphi ubufakazi obungagaxelisa uMcBride nomphenyi wamacala ozimele, uMnuz Paul O'Sullivan.Incwadi iveza ukuthi uMkhwanazi wathembisa umphenyi we-Ipid isikhundla esiphezulu uma engafika nobufakazi obuzogaxelisa uMcBride no-O'Sullivan.
UMPHENYI wamacala othinteka ezinsolweni ezenziwa wuKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, uMnuz Paul O'Sullivan, uyaqhubeka nokugolozela amalungu ekomiti lasePhalamende njengoba enqaba ukuzifikela mathupha futhi ethi ngeke avume ukuhlohlwa ngemibuzo ngamanye amalungu ekomiti awabize ngezigebengu.U-O'Sullivan uthe usamile ekutheni ngeke azifikele mathupha ePhalamende kodwa uzovela esebenzisa ezokuxhumana.Uphinde futhi athi ngeke ayiphendule imibuzo yamanye amalungu ePhalamende aqhamuka emaqenjini ezepolitiki athe agcwele izigebengu.Lokhu kuhlaluke ngesikhathi kunomhlangano wekomiti, izolo.Usihlalo wekomiti, uMnuz Soviet Lekganyane, uthe u-O'Sullivan ubabhalele incwadi ebazisa ukuthi ngeke ekwazi ukuzifikela mathupha ngenxa yokubona engaphephile nokuthi akekho kuleli.ULekganyane uthe u-O'Sullivan uthe uvakasheile eLondon, wathi uyoze abuye ikomiti seliwuqedile umsebenzi walo okufanele liwuphothule ekupheleni kwenyanga ezayo."Uthe uhambo lwakhe waluhlela ngaphambi kokuthi kusungulwe ikomiti."ULekganyane uthe u-O'Sullivan uthe ngeke ayiphendule imibuzo yamalungu eMKP, EFF, nawe-ActionSA."U-O'Sullivan uyasithuka, uthi iPhalamende ligcwele izigebengu. Wenza izinsolo ezibucayi lapho esola khona amalungu ePhalamende ngokuthi asebenzisana nabantu abafuna ukumbulala."Amalungu ekomiti athe kufanele u-O'Sullivan aphoqwe ukuba azifikele mathupha.USotswebhu omkhulu ePhalamende, uMnuz Mdumiseni Ntuli, uthe akufanele ukuthi u-O'Sullivan avunyelwe ukuba azenzele umathanda."Izinto azishoyo zikhombisa ngokusobala ukuthi akalihloniphi iPhalamende lo muntu. Akufanele simvumele ukuthi azenzele umathanda. Zonke lezi zinto azishoyo ziwumbhedo. Kubalulekile ukuthi azifikele lana. Igama lakhe livela kaningi ezinsolweni. Ofakazi abaningi abavelile phambi kwekomiti bakhuluma ngegama lakhe. Kubalulekile ukuthi afike lapha azoziphendulela."Ilungu leMKP, uMnuz Sibonelo Nomvalo, lithe u-O'Sullivan kufanele athunyelwe amasamanisi amphoqa ukuba avele phambi kwekomiti ngokushesha."Abameli kufanele balusukumele ngokushesha lolu daba ngoba usekhombisile ukuthi akanandaba nokuthi ungcono kunabanye abebebizwa yikomiti."Ilungu leDA, u-Advocate Glynnis Breytenbach, lithe kufanele amalungu ekomiti alusingathe ngobunono lolu daba.U-Advocate Breytenbach uthe amalungu ekomiti angazithola sekufanele aphendule imibuzo angayazi uma kungenzeka ukuthi u-O'Sullivan abulawe emva kokuba emphoqe ukuthi azifikele mathupha ePhalamende.Ukuhlangana kwekomiti kuzoqhubeka namhlanje lapho kuzovela khona owayeyisikhulu sophiko oluqaphe ukusebenza kwamaphoyisa, i-Ipid, uMnuz Robert McBride.
I-MKP ifuna owayengumengameli, uMnuz Thabo Mbeki, axolise ebantwini baKwaZulu-Natal ngenkulumo yakhe abathe icwasa ngokobuhlanga abantu basesifundazweni iphinde igqugquzele udlame.UMbeki uzithintele ngokuthi enze izinsolo zokuthi iMKP yasungulwa yizinhlaka zezokuphepha ezazisetshenziswa uhulumeni wobandlululo ukuxova abantu ababelwa nobandlululo ngesikhathi somzabalazo wenkululeko.Ubuholi beMKP busole uMbeki ngokudukisa, baze bamvusela ngisho amaphutha akhe amadala.UMbeki wenze izinsolo eziningi ngokusungulwa kweMKP ngesikhathi ekhuluma engqungqutheleni yokukhetha ubuholi bophiko lomakadebona kwi-ANC, i-Umkhonto weSizwe Liberations War Veterans.UMbeki uthe abantu kufanele bazibuze ukuthi kungani iMKP yathola amavoti amaningi kakhulu KwaZulu-Natal, yaphinde yenza kahle nasemahostela aseGauteng."Lezi nhlaka (zikahulumeni wobandlululo) azikaze zihlakazwe kuze kube namhlanje. Ngayikhuluma kaningi le nto."UMbeki uthe abantu kufanele bezibuze ukuthi yini eyenze ukuthi abaningi abahlala emahostela eGauteng, bavotele iMKP okhethweni lwango-2024?"Abantu bakula mahostela babevotela i-IFP ngesikhathi kusenodlame lwezepolitiki. Into eyenza ukuthi bavotele iMKP kulokhu ingoba balawulwa yizinhlaka ezilawula iMKP."UMbeki uthe akulona iqiniso ukuthi izibhelu zokuzitapela zango-2021 zasuswa ukuboshwa komholi weMKP, uMnuz Jacob Zuma."Leya nto yayihleliwe nje abantu ababefuna ukuzizwa amandla. Babefuna ukubona ukuthi bangakwazi yini ukuphazamisa ukusebenza kwezwe."UMbeki uphinde wathi izikhulu ze-Eskom zenza ngamasibomu ukuthi kube nokucishwa kukagesi, wathi izikhulu ze-Eskom zaziba isexwayiso sango-2007 sokuthi kunengozi yokuthi ugesi ungase ushode ezweni.Okhulumela iMK, uMnuz Nhlamulo Ndhlela, uthe inkulumo kaMbeki iyadukisa futhi iyaqhatha.UNdhlela uthe uMbeki kufanele amukele nje ukuthi abantu sebekhathele yi-ANC."Lezi zinsolo azenzayo azinabufakazi futhi ziyingozi. Okuyingozi kakhulu ukuthi enkulumweni yakhe uphinde wacwasa ngokobuhlanga abantu abathile baKwaZulu-Natal naseGauteng. Abantu baseWestern Cape abayivoteli i-ANC kodwa asikazwe sizwe kushiwo kubo izinto ezicwasa ngokobuhlanga. Kungani singahlonishwa isinqumo sabantu baKwaZulu-Natal nabaseGauteng abavotela iMKP?"UNdhlela uthe bafuna ukuthi uMbeki ahoxise inkulumo yakhe aphinde axolise futhi kubantu baKwaZulu-Natal."Inkulumo yakhe iphehla udlame futhi ibeka engcupheni abantu abavotela iMKP. Inkulumo yakhe iqhatha abantu abavotela iMKP namakadebona e-ANC ababelwa nohulumeni wobandlululo. UMbeki kuzofanele axolise kubantu baKwaZulu-Natal."UNdhlela uthe vele uMbeki uyaziwa ngokuba budedengu, wathi wakhombisa ubudedengu ngesikhathi ephika ukuthi igciwane iHIV lidala umbulalazwe, i-AIDS."Ukuphika kwakhe ucwaningo longoti kwenza ukuba kubambezeleke ukukhishwa kwemishanguzo. Ngokwezibalo, bangaphezu kuka-330 000 abantu abashonayo ngenxa yokubambezeleka kokusabalaliswa kwemishanguzo."
UMHOLI we-EFF, uMnuz Julius Malema, usamile kwelokuthi umsulwa ecaleni lokuqhumisa isibhamu.UMalema uzobuyela eNkantolo yeMantshi e-East London, ngoLwesihlanu, lapho kulindeleke ukuthi kuphume isigwebo ecaleni lakhe lokuqhumisa isibhamu.Inkantolo yalahla uMalema ngecala lokuqhumisa isibhamu esidlangalaleni ngonyaka owedlule.UMalema usolwa ngokuqhumisa isibhamu emcimbini we-EFF owawungo-2018. Icala lafakwa yinhlangano i-AfriForum kanti uthe akathukile nakancane njengoba ephindela enkantolo ngoLwesihlanu. Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma kwi-podcast ye-EFF.UMalema uthe uzosidlulisela phambili isinqumo senkantolo, wathi uyazi ukuthi enye inkantolo izomthola emsulwa, wenza izinsolo zokugxambukela kwezepolitiki ecaleni lakhe."Awuzange ulandelwe umthetho ngesikhathi kuqulwa icala, abantu basebenzisa imizwa. Ayikho into engingathi ngiyifundile kubantu abasebenzisa inzondo nabazilwela izimpi zezepolitiki."UMalema uthe kuyamdida ukuthi inkantolo imthole enecala lokuqhumisa isibhamu kodwa isibhamu okuthiwa wasiqhumisa asiyona ingxenye yobufakazi obuthulwe enkantolo.Isibhamu okuthiwa uMalema wasiqhumisa kwakungesikaMnuz Adriaan Snyman, owayengumqaphi wakhe.USnyman watholakala engenacala. UMalema uthe isibhamu saphindiselwa kuSnyman."Ngizogwetshelwa ukuthi ngaqhumisa isibhamu esingagciniwe wuMbuso. Kufanele uma ugwetshwelwa ukuqhumisa isibhamu kube ukuthi leso sibhamu sigcinwe uMbuso. Kwelami icala isibhamu kasigciniwe wuMbuso."UMalema ukhale ngokuthi kuze kube namhlanje inkantolo ayikaze imnikeze isinqumo esibhalwe phansi esimlahla ngecala.Isinqumo senkantolo sethulwa ngo-Okthoba, wangonyaka owedlule."Le nto yokuthi nginganikezwa isinqumo esibhalwe phansi ikhombisa ngokusobala ukuthi inkantolo yenze izinto ngokuxhamazela ngoba nakhu yesaba labo abafake icala, yakhohlwa ukulandela umthetho."UMalema uthe njengengxenye yokulungiselela ukukhishwa kwesigwebo, kade ehlangene nosonhlalakahle.UMalema uthe umbiko kasonhlalakahle uveza ukuthi akazisoli ngokuqhumisa isibhamu.I-EFF imemezele ukuthi uMalema angeke ayihambele imihlangano yekomiti lasePhalamende eliphenya izinsolo ezenziwa uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, kuleli sonto, njengoba ezokube elungiselela ukuyovela enkantolo.Amalungu e-EFF kulindeleke ukuthi abhikishe ngaphandle kwenkantolo ngoLwesihlanu.
NJENGOBA iNingizimu Afrika isajabulela futhi ihalalisela abafundi baka-matric wangonyaka odlule abaphase ngo-88%, kukhuthazwa ukuthi abafundi basukumele eyokubheka ezinye izindlela abangazisebenzisa ukuqhuba impilo, kubalwa ukugxila ekuthuthukiseni amakhono abo ezamabhizinisi ukuze bakwazi ukuzimela.Lokho kushiwo wuMnuz Shawn Theunissen, umnikazi weProperty Point and Entrepreneurship to the Point (ETTP), ejobelela ngokuthi nakuba le miphumela ka-matric iwuphawu lokuphumelela, kepha futhi iyisikhumbuzo sokuqala kobunzima bempilo obuzobhekana naasebephothule leli banga."Siyaziqhenya kakhulu ngabafundi bethu nothisha ngomsebenzi wabo neqhaza elibanjwe wumphakathi ukuze izingane zethu ziphase kahle kanjena. Kodwa-ke kuhle futhi ukuthi sibhekane neqiniso lokuthi ukuphasa kwabo akwanele uma kuhamba kodwa. Kusekhona inselelo yokuthi bazokwenza kanjani ukuthi ukuphasa kwabo kuthele izithelo ezinhle nezibonakalayo ezizosiza ukufukula umnotho wezwe,” kusho uTheunissen.Eqhuba, uthe kulo 88% ophasile kubafundi abawu-900 000 ababhalele ukuhlolwa kuka-matric nyakenye, bayingcosana abazothola ithuba lokuqhubeka nemfundo ezingeni lemfundo ephakeme. Uthe iningi labo lizobe lizihlupha ngokufuna umsebenzi, libheka futhi amakhono elingase liphephele kuwona ukuqhubeka nempilo, okuyinto engelula neze. "Ekusebenzeni kwethu nosomabhizinisi abasebasha nabasafufusa ezweni, sesibonile ukuthi abafundi abaningi abaphothule u-matric basuke sebefuna ukuthi kube khona into abagxila kuyona yokuzimela. Lokhu kugcina kungenzeki ngenxa yokuswela ulwazi, amathuba, abeluleki nemakethe yokufukula nokuthuthukisa lokho osuke usukuqalile,” usho kanje.UTheunissen uxwayise ngokuthi kuyingozi kakhulu ukukhuthaza abafundi abaphothule u-matric ukuthi bancike ekutheni baqhubeke nemfundo emazingeni aphakeme kuphela. Uthe kwenza abanye bakhohlwe amakhono nemisebenzi yezandla abangagxila kuyona futhi lokho kubasebenzele."Kuhle ukufunda nokuqhubeka nemfundo ezingeni eliphakeme kodwa kumele singakubalekeli ukuthi sinentsha enamakhono nenothando lwezamabhizinisi ezweni lethu, futhi engachuma iye kude nempilo uma ikhuthazwa ukuthi inamathele ezintweni ezinjalo. Kumele kutshalwe nemali eyanele ezinhlakeni nasezinhlelweni ezinjalo ukuze kwenzeke kalula, bese kusiza ukufukula umnotho, kuliwe nanendlala yamathuba emisebenzi,” kucebisa yena.Uphonse inselelo yokuthi kwandiswe futhi kwesekwe izinhlelo zokweseka nokufukula osomabhizinisi abasafufusa, futhi kubekwe eqhulwini ngenxa yobumqoka bakho."Asijabulele impumelelo ka-88% wabafundi baka-matric, kodwa futhi sizibuze ukuthi sizokwenza kanjani ukuthi u-100% wabantu abasha ube neqhaza olibambayo emnothweni kungakhathalekile ukuthi ulandele luphi uhlelo lokuqhubeka nempilo emva kuka -matric. Ilele lapho nje ukuze sakhe izwe elinenqubekela phambili,” kusho uTheunissen.
BEKUNGESIKHO okokuqala uMbhishobhi wamaSheshi eZululand, i-Anglican Church of South Africa, esinda ebhekene nombhobho wesibhamu njengoba ephinde wadunwa imoto ngoLwesihlanu.Kuhlaluka ukuthi eminyakeni edlule, uMbhishobhi Victor Mnculwane, ngesikhathi esenguMfundisi Ekuvukeni, KwaMashu, wavinjezelwa yizinswelaboya ezazimphuca imoto, zamdubula amahlandla amaningi.Kumphindile futhi lokhu njengoba ephinde wakhonjwa ngesibhamu kanti ibandla ngomlomo kaNobhala weDiocese yaseZululand, uMfundisi Mondli Nkosi, libonga ukusinda komphefumulo njengoba ephume engenamyocu kulandela isehlakalo sokudunwa imoto iToyota Fortuner emhlophe.Uthe umgilwa bamvimbezele eNdlangubo, emgwaqweni ophakathi kweShowe neMpangeni. "Ubehamba yedwa esuka eGarden Clinic, eMpangeni, esebuyela ekhaya eShowe. Bamvimbezele behamba ngenye imoto. Bathe uma bephumelela ukumsabisa ngesibhambu, bamfaka ebhuthini, base behamba naye,” kusho uMfu Nkosi.UNkosi uthe baze bayomlahla phakathi ehlathini elikhulu eliseMasangweni, eMpangeni, wathi bathathe zonke izinto zakhe ezibalulekile okukhona kuzo amaselula kanjalo nemali. "Emva kwesikhathi, ube eselibhadula ngonyawo ehlathini lendawo angayazi, waze waphumela emgwaqweni, lapho atholane khona nabesilisa bendawo, abatshele ngosekumehlele,” kusho uMfu Nkosi. Uthe laba besilisa bamyise enduneni yendawo ebikelwe ngodaba maqede kwazanywa imizamo yokuthi ayiswe ekhaya, kwavulwa necala, wathi ngalesi sigameko basola nje ubugebengu obejwayelekile bokudunwa kwabantu izimoto kanti bathi abakholwa ukuthi bekuyisigameko ebesibhekiswe kumgilwa siqu.Nakuba sibethusile isigameko kodwa babonga ukuthi abasolwa abamenzanga lutho. "Ngoba kokunye, kuye kube kubi kakhulu, bayithathe imoto kodwa futhi baphinde bakubulale. Sibonge ukuthi lokho akwenzekanga kuyena,” kusho uMfu Nkosi othe namanje imoto ayikatholakali, wathi umgilwa uyazama ukuqina kulandela okumehlele. "Sibonga ukuthi impilo yakhe ihlengekile. Sifisa ukuthi thina bantu baseNingizimu Afrika silwele ukuphathana kahle, izigameko ezifuze lezi ziphele,” usho kanje.Uthe abantu badalelwe ukwenza intando kaNkulunkulu, ukwenzakalisa omunye umuntu kuphambene nentando kaNkulunkulu."Sibonga ukuthi isihluku singabi sikhulu kangako ngoba akabulawanga,” usho kanje. UMfu Nkosi uthe umgilwa unguMbhishobhi weDiocese yaseZululand enamagatsha angu-54. I-voicenote ezungeza ezinkundleni zokuxhumana iveza ukuthi uphucwe iselula, amakhadi asebhange, base bemfuna imininingwane ye-tracker. "Bamkhiphe ehlathini bazama ukumgada. Kube khona abakwenzayo emakhadini akhe ngaphambi kokuba bawabuyise nomazisi. Aphelile amahora amathathu bezama ukulwa into ye-tracker," kusho i-voicenote. Iqhuba ithi ngenhlanhla abamshayanga ngoba uzamile ukulwa, waze waphoseka emfuleni uMhlathuze kodwa wahlengwa yibo futhi ukuthi angamuki namanzi."Baze bambuza ukuthi wenzani baba, ulwelani ngoba thina asifuni ukukulimaza?" kusho i-voicenote, ethi bagcine behamba nayo imoto, yena wathi ukuhoba kancane isikhathi esingangehora, kwaba yima ezama ukuhamba ayofuna usizo.Kushaye isikhathi sokushicilela amaphoyisa engakaphefumuli ngodaba.

"Abantu badiniwe, bakhala ngokuthi ubewubaba othembekile emphakathini kodwa wenza isenzo esiwubulwane,” kusho uCele.Ngesikhathi libizwa igama lakhe (umsolwa), engena ebhokisini, umphakathi obuhleli ngaphandle, ugaleleke ngaphakathi. Isolezwe lithole ukuthi lo mculi, wodumo lwengoma ethi Seduce Me nethi Menemene, uziqhathe noMalema ngokungalubhadi emcimbini obusendaweni yokucima ukoma eseSeshego eLimpopo iSlageng Lounge ngoMgqibelo.Yize kuthiwa le ndawo ngekaMalema kodwa abazaziyo bathi ufolosa ngomfowabo, uTshepo Malema. Iningi labathandi bobumnandi ebelimagange ngokuzozibonela lo mculi, libuyele emakhaya selidumele, belihamba lineka izandla ngenxa yokuphoxeka.Emuva kwenhlamba kaMalema, abantu bahlukane phakathi ezinkundleni zokuxhumana. Abanye basigxekile isenzo sikaMalema njengomholi womphakathi kodwa abanye bathi wenza kahle ngoba iyacika indaba yabaculi abaxhaphaza abahleli bemicimbi nabathandi bobumnandi.Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kukaDaliwonga ayiphumelelanga kwaze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela. KUXWAYISWE abafundi abangamabhoklolo abahlupha abanye ezikoleni nalabo abadala udlame ukuthi kukhona okusina kubajeqeza.Lesi sexwayiso sikhishwe nguNgqongqoshe weMfundo eyisiSekelo, uNksz Siviwe Gwarube izolo, kwethulwa umkhankaso wokulwa nabafundi abahlupha nabahlukumeza abanye ezikoleni.Kulo mkhankaso kuno-R95 million otshalwe yi-European Union kanti wethulwe e-Eldorado Secondary, eGoli."Inhloso yalo mkhankaso wukulwa nenkinga yokuhlukumezeka kwabafundi, okwenziwa abanye ezikoleni zakuleli. Silwa nenkinga yokuhlukunyezwa kwabafundi ngokobulili nakho okwenzeka ezikoleni. Sixwayisa abaqhubeka nokwenza izinto ezifuze le ezikoleni ukuthi kukhona okusina kubajeqeza," usho kanje. Uthe izikole yindawo yokuthi abafundi bazizwe bephephile futhi bekhululekile nsuku zonke."Le mali izosiza ezinhlelweni zokufundisa, ukweluleka kanjalo nokweseka abahlukunyeziwe. Sibeka phambili ukuphepha kwabafundi ezikoleni zethu. Lo mkhankaso awuzogcina lapha, kodwa uzodlulela nakwezinye izindawo," usho kanje.Uthe ukuhlukunyezwa kwabafundi okwenziwa amabhoklolo, kushiya izibazi eziphuzayo ukuphola kumgilwa."Akumele abafundi basabe uma kumele baye esikoleni. Kumele bajabule, balangazelele ukuya khona nsuku zonke, hhayi ukwesaba ngoba kukhona ababahlukumezayo." Ukufanise nodlame ukuhlukumeza omunye umfundi wathi othisha nabaphathi bezikole bayazenza izaba zokuthi abafundi baphephe."Sidinga wonke umuntu abe yingxenye yokuvikelwa kwabafundi. Sidinga nezinhlaka zokuphepha ukuze izikole zethu ziphephe."Ugqugquzele abahlukunyezwayo ukuthi babike bangafeli ngaphakathi."Akubona ubugwala ukuthi uyahlukunyezwa. Kumele ubike ungafeli ngaphakathi uma kwenzeka uhlukumezeka. Ngaleyo ndlela kuzoba lula ukuthola usizo kuphinde kuthathelwe izinyathelo labo abahlukumezayo," kusho uNksz Gwarube. Ugxeke nalabo abasuke bebukela bengenzi lutho uma kukhona umfundi ohlukunyezwayo."Abangathi vu uma kukhona ohlukunyezwayo bavikela umhlukumezi, hhayi umgilwa. Yingakho kumele ningathuli uma kunezehlakalo ezifuze lezi," kuqhuba uNksz Gwarube.Ngesikhathi ememezela imiphumela ka-matric ngeledlule, uNksz Gwarube wakuveza ukuthi kulo nyaka bazogxila emkhankasweni wokulwa namabhoklolo ezikoleni.Okunye okuhlale kukhulunywa ngakho yindaba y lothisha abaqhubeka nokulala nabafundi, abanye baze babakhulelise. Laba bakhonjwa indlela, basulwe nasemkhandlwini obhalisa othisha uma belahlwe amacala.

Kusengenye yezindlela zokuhlumelelisa izimilo kulabo abasuke begcinwe ezikhungweni zethu," usho kanje izolo, ededela imiphumela yasemajele eGoodwood Correctional Facility, eWestern Cape.Uthe noma begqunywe emajele kodwa kubalulekile ukuthi uma bededelwa, kube kukhona abakuphethe."Asigcini ngokuthi sibagqugquzele ngakwezemfundo, kodwa sibuye sibafundise ukuthi babuyelwe yithemba nokuzethemba. Ukuboshwa akusho ukuthi kusuke sekuphelile ngawe." Isikhungo i-Baviaanspoort esiseGoli yisona esilale endaweni yesibili ngokwenza kahle kuleli banga.UGroenewald uveze ukuthi izinga lokuphasa ezikhungweni zabo libe ngu-94.4%, ladlula nezinga lokuphasa ku-matric kuzwelonke elibe ngu-88%.Sinyukile nesibalo sababhalile kulezi zikhungo saya ku-180, sisuka ku-171 wango-2024. Zingu-15 izikhungo okuphaswe kuzona ngo-100%, ezikhungweni ezingu-18 kuleli. Bebonke bangu-132 o-A abatholwe abebebhala. "Kumele siqinisekise ukuthi bathi bephuma la, bebe sebengabantu abangcono, nabashintshile. Sinxusa umphakathi ukuthi ubamukele uma sebephuma ezikhungweni zethu ngoba basuke sebewabonile amaphutha abo." Uveze nokuthi uma kubhalwa izivivinyo kusuke kuqashwe ngelokhozi ukuthi akukotshelwa nokuthi akubi nokuputshuka kwamaphepha."Kubalulekile ukuthi abafundayo benze nezifundo okubalwa iMaths, njengoba sikhula isibalo sabafunda iMaths Literacy. Siyazi ukuthi bangenza kahle uma bezokwesekwa abafunda iMaths."Uzwakalise ukukhathazeka ngokuthi abesilisa yibona abaningi abazikhandla ngokuthi bafunde kunabesifazane. Ubonge abaphethe amajele ngomsebenzi abawenzayo nsuku zonke behlumelelisa izimilo. "Sibonga abafundisayo, abazali kanjalo nezihloblo zabasuke begqunywe emajele ababagqugquzela ukuthi bafunde, baphase noma behleli ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima. Sibonga nokubambisana noMnyango weMfundo eyisiSekelo ngokuthi ababoshiwe bangalilahli ithemba," usho kanje.

ZIBHODLA umlilo izinyunyana zabasebenzi bahulumeni ngesinqumo seGovernment Employees’ Medical Scheme (GEMS), sokuhlabela phambili sinyuse imali ye-medical aid, ekubeni uhulumeni ezonyusa lo mhlomulo ngenyanga ezayo.Izinyunyana zikhala ngokuthi iGEMS inyuse imali ngo-9.8%, ekubeni zazikuchithile ukunyuswa kwale mali ngonyaka odlule, zathi kunyuswe le mali nje, uhulumeni umemezele ukuthi uzoze awufake ngo-Febhuwari 2026, umhlomulo we-medical aid ka-4.5%. I-Public Servants Association (PSA) ithe ixoxa nabameli bayo ngokuthi iziphi izinyathelo engazithathela iGEMS, ngokunyusa imali ngenkani.UMnuz Mlungisi Ndlovu, ibamba lemenenja lePSA kuzwelonke, uthe basamile ekutheni abahambisani nesinyathelo sokunyuswa kwale mali."Simatasa sixoxa nethimba labameli ngoba sikholwa ngukuthi inyuswe kakhulu imali. Sizoqhubeka silwe nokunyuswa kwemali nokuqinisa ikhanda kweGEMS." Uthe emhlanganweni wangonyaka odlule, iGEMS yabuya nesiphakamiso sokuthi ingehla ifinyelele ku-9.5%, isuka ku-9.8%."Yathi ngeke ikwazi ukwehla ngaphansi kwalo-9.5%. Sakuchitha nalokhu ngoba kuzoshaya abasebenzi ngasezimalini," usho kanje.NeSadtu ithe abasebenzi bashayekile njengoba uhulumeni engazange ayinyuse imali ye-medical aid kule nyanga. UNobhala Jikelele weSadtu, uDkt Mugwena Maluleke, uthe umqashi uveze ukuthi uzokhokha u-4.5% ngoFebhuwari 1, 2026, bese ephinde ekhokha enye ingxenye kusuka ngo-Ephreli."U-4.5% uzokhokhwa usuka kuJanuwari 1, 2026 kuya kuMashi 31, 2026. Kuzobe sekwengezwa u-0.5% kusuka ngo-Ephreli 1 kuya kuMashi 31, 2027," usho kanje.Ukhale ngokuthi sekuphenduke insakavukela ukuthi uhulumeni angayinyusi imali uma kuqala unyaka, wathi bafuna kuphele lokhu."Savumelana emhlanganweni wesigungu esiphezulu seSadtu ngoDisemba nyakenye, ukuthi kuzomele sihlangane noNgqongqoshe woMnyango weziSebenzi zikaHulumeni nokuPhatha, Inkosi Mzamo Buthelezi, ngalezi zikhalazo. "Sifuna imali ifakwe njalo ngoJanuwari, uma kuqala unyaka. UJanuwari inyanga enzima, esuke idinga imali ngakho sifuna abasebenzi bathole okungokwabo ngesikhathi esifanele." Uthe basaqhubeka nokubheka ezinye izindlela zokuqinisekisa ukuthi uyehliswa lo 9.8%."Sibheka nezinye izinto okubalwa nokuthi abasebenzi baye kwezinye izinkampani zama-medical aid kodwa baqhubeke nokuthola imali efanayo kuhulumeni. Kakade iSadtu ayikaze isayine ihambisane nesiphakamiso sango-2006, sokuthi kusungulwe iGEMS emkhandlwini wokubhunga ngamaholo abasebenzi bahulumeni," kusho uMaluleke.Uthe iGEMS yayingasungulelwanga ukuthi yenze inzuzo ngoba kuyaphambana nombono wokusungulwa kwalesi sikhwama nguhulumeni. Nyakenye nezinye izinyunyana zakuchitha ukunyuswa kwemali yilesi sikhwama.
KUYALWE abaxhaswe yisikhwana iNational Students' Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS), ukuthi bangalinge bavume ukukhokhiswa imali yediphozithi yizikhungo zemfundo noma omastende ngoba lokhu kuphambene nemigomo.Lesi sexwayiso sikhishwe ngusihlalo wekomiti lezeMfundo ePhakeme nokuQeqesha ePhalamende, uMnuz Tebogo Letsie, njengoba izitshudeni zibhalisa ezikhungweni zemfundo.ULetsie uthe bayazi ukuthi kukhona izikhungo ezifuna imali yediphozithi kwizitshudeni ezisuke zisalinde imali evela kulesi sikhwama."Kukhishwe umyalelo wokuthi umuntu oxhaswe yilesi sikhwama, akumele akhokhe ngisho isenti ezikhungweni zemfundo. Siyazi kukhona labo abafuna ukuthi kukhokhwe imali yediphozithi okubalwa nomastende yize besuke bezokhokhelwa. Abakhokhiswa imali yediphozithi abasibikele siyikomiti ngokushesha ukuze singenelele," usho kanje. Uthe bavumelene nanenhlangano emele amanyuvesi kuleli, i-Universities South Africa, ngokuthi akukho nyuvesi ezofuna le mali kwizitshudeni ezixhaswe yiNSFAS.Kwenzeka lokhu nje, izikhungo zemfundo zimatasa nohlelo lokubhalisa emva kokuba ngeledlule ziphendule abebelinde izimpendulo zokwamukelwa bezokwenza unyaka wokuqala.Izinhlaka ezehlukene kwezemfundo ephakeme bezihlangene ngempelasonto, zibhunga ngezinhlelo zokuqinisekisa ukuthi izinto zihamba kahle njengoba kubhaliswa. Sekuphenduke insakavukela ukuthi minyaka yonke uma kuvulwa izikhungo zemfundo, kuba nemibhikisho ngendaba yoxhaso lweNSFAS nezindawo zokuhlala.Kukhishwe umyalelo wokuthi izitshudeni zingayi ezikhungweni zemfundo ngaphambi kokuba zithole izimpendulo zokuthi zithathiwe nokuthi ziyitholile nendawo yokuhlala, kulabo abazohlala ngaphakathi.Lokhu kwenzelwa ukuthi zingabi ondingasithebeni, ezinye zigcine sezilala endle ngoba zibambe olayini zifuna izindawo zokuhlala. Nezikhungo eziningi zemfundo azibemukeli abazifikela qathatha bezofuna izikhala. UNgqongqoshe wezeMfundo ePhakeme, uMnuz Buti Manamela, uzotshela abezindaba esithangamini esikusasa, ngokuphume kulo mhlangano.Ebhala ekhasini lo Mnyango kwiFacebook, uManamela uveze ukuthi abafundi ababalelwa ku-100 000, abaphase ngendlela yokuthi bazokwazi ukuya emanyuvesi, ngeke bazithole izikhala zokufunda ngoba ezikhona zibalelwa ku-230 000."Bangu-345 000 abaphase u-matric ngeBachelor, abangakwazi ukufunda emanyuvesi. Inkinga ngukuthi izikhala ezikhona emanyuvesi zingu-230 000 kuphela, kulabo abazokwenza unyaka wokuqala, okusho ukuthi baningi esingeke sikwazi ukubamukela," usho kanje.Ukhale ngokuthi liphezulu izinga lentsha engasebenzi kuleli emhlabeni jikelele."Iyakhula nengcindezi yezimali kuhulumeni njengoba sinyuka isibalo sabafundi abaphasa minyaka yonke. Uhulumeni ukubeke kwacaca ukuthi akekho okumele ancishwe imfundo ngoba entula," usho kanje.Uveze nokuthi amakolishi amaTVET anezitshudeni ezevile ku-500 000.
INDABA yokuthi umaskandi wumculo weziqhaza - abantu abangafundile - sekuyinto yayizolo. Kulo mculo sekugcwele izifundiswa. Phakathi kwazo kubalwa no-Okuhle "Matshikiza" Ngubane.U-Okuhle (17) owaqala ukuzakhela udumo emculweni ngokuba wumaskanda wokuqala ukuqopha ingoma eneminyaka emithathu njengoba esephumelele uGrade 12 ngeBachelor. Lo mculi ubenza u-matric eLinpark High, eMgungundlovu, futhi enza izifundo iTechnical Mathematics, English Home Language, IsiZulu First Additional Language, Engineering Graphics, Mechanical Technology (Fitting and Machine) neTechnical Science. U-Okuhle uthe uhlela ukuyokwenza izifundo zeChemical Fitting Engineering e-Atholl Munday Training Centre eManzimtoti. Uthe usizwe ukuhlaba ikhefu emculweni wagxila kakhulu ezifundweni zakhe zika-matric. Lo maskanda waqala eyimbongi ngaphambi kokungena emculweni ngenxa yokubukela kuMjik'jelwa "Ichalaha LikaShafuza" Ngubane. Wayeshiyelana inkundla nezingwazi ezinjengoHlegiwe Mhlaba no-AKA ngengoma ayehlonipha ngayo amaqhawe kamaskandi uMtshengiseni noMgqumeni ethi Bayajabula.UTira wagezeka ubebebe yikhono lika-Okuhle kangangoba waze wamfaka nakwi-video yengoma yakhe ethi Malume. Nomsunguli wamaSouth African Traditional Music Achievement (Satma) Awards, uDumisani Goba, waze wamxhasa ngemvunulo.Ngaphandle kukamaskandi, u-Okuhle ubuye aziwe ngelikaTinana emculweni wamapiano futhi usanda kukhipha ingoma esihloko sithi The Bread. Kule ngoma uthi ucela "isinkwa” - okusho amathuba okusebenza - njengoba eseqedile u-matric."Ngiyacela ningangishayi indiva, ngifuna ukusebenza, ngifuna ukufunda, ngifuna ikusasa elingcono ngithengele nomama wami umuzi,” kusho u-Okuhle."Ngiyabonga kubo bonke abangisekelayo futhi ngiyathemba ukuthi uhambo lwami luzogqugquzela nabanye abasakhula.”
IPHASE ngamalengiso intokazi egeze ubebebe womrepha uBig Zulu nezithameli kwiLast Dance Music Experience eRoyal Showgrounds eMgungundlovu, ngoNcibijane, u-Akhona Msimango.Le ntokazi edabuka esigodini saseNkululeko, KwaSwayimani, izakhele udumo ngokucula noBig Zulu ingoma esihloko sithi Amacala Othando, ivala isikhala sika-Azana owayengekho kulo mcimbi.Okuchaze nabantu abaningi ukuthi u-Akhona ubecashunwe engazelele ezihlweleni. Ebuzwa ukuthi uzokwenzenjani ngekhono lokucula, uthe okwamanje akakazi noma uzothatha ikhefu kuwo agxile emsebenzini wesikole noma uzoncelisa amawele. Kulo nyaka iDurban University of Technology (DUT) igubha ngokuziqhenya iminyaka engu-21 ngamagalelo ayo emfundweni ephakeme eNingizimu Afrika.Kusukela yasungulwa ngo-2002, ngokuhlanganiswa kwe-ML Sultan Technikon ne-Technikon Natal, i-DUT isidlondlobale yaba yivulandlela kwezokucwaninga nasekufundiseni. Inamakhampasi ayisikhombisa eThekwini naseMgungundlovu.I-DUT ihlinzeka ngezinhlelo ezehlukene eminyangweni eyisithupha: Accounting and Informatics, Applied Sciences, Arts and Design, Engineering and the Built Environment, Health Sciences nowe-Management Sciences.I-DUT Business School, eyingxenye yeFaculty of Management Sciences, igunyazwe ngumkhandlu - iCouncil for Higher Education (CHE) futhi iyilungu leSouth African Business School Association (SABSA).Ikharikhulamu esetshenziswayo yakhelwe ukukhiqiza abaholi bamabhizinisi ababeka eqhulwini izidingo zemiphakathi.Isisekelo se-DUT ukuzibophezela okujulile ekusunguleni izinto ezintsha kanye nocwaningo olusezingeni eliphezulu.Njengoba sigxile ezindaweni ezingu-20 zocwaningo, kusukela kwi-biotechnology kuya ekusimamiseni ezamandla, inyuvesi isaqhubeka nokuhlonishwa ezweni lonke nasemhlabeni jikelele, okuhlanganisa nendondo iFocused Research Advancement Award eyithole kwi-National Research Foundation (NRF).Ngokusebenza ngohlaka lwamasu lwe-ENVISION2030, olwaqalwa ngo-2020, i-DUT ibumba umphakathi wezemfundo onobuchule, osomabhizinisi nezifundiswa ezingomabizwasabele ezinselelweni zomhlaba.Lelisu liveza umbono ogqamile wokuguqula impilo nezindlela zokuziphilisa ngemfundo, ukusungula izinto ezintsha ngokuxhumana nemimphakathi.Isiqubulo senyuvesi esithi "Ukudala. UNDUNANKULU kaZulu, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, uchithe incwadi emdalele amazinyo abushelelezi kubaNtwana baseNdlunkulu.UButhelezi uthe iwumbombayi incwadi ebhekiswe eminyangweni kahulumeni eyehlukene ethi abaNtwana baseNdlunkulu kabavumelekile ukuba bakhulume nezinhlaka zikahulumeni bengagunyaziwe yiHhovisi leSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini.Le ncwadi esabalale ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, ithi zonke izinhlaka zikahulumeni kufanele zixhumane noNobhala eHhovisi leSilo langasese, uMnuz Squire Anorld Nododile, uma kukhona ezifuna ukukudlulisa.Le ncwadi ithunyelwe iminyango kahulumeni eyahlukene, iveza ukuthi isayinwe nguButhelezi ezansi kepha uButhelezi uthe ibhalwe abantu abazama ukuqhatha."Le ncwadi ingumgunyathi. Isilo samaBandla noNdunankulu weSilo kabayazi le ncwadi. Abanikazi bale ncwadi-mbumbulu bahlose ukudunga ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kweSilo nabaNtwana baseNdlunkulu."Ukusabalala kwencwadi kucasule abaNtwana baseNdlunkulu abakhale ngokuthi baphucwa amalungelo abo.Oke wakhulumela iSilo ngaphambili, uMntwana u-Africa Zulu wasoNkweni, uthe kubukeka kunomkhankaso owumshoshaphansi wokubhozomela uMbuso kaZulu.UMntwana u-Africa uthe umsebenzi weHhovisi leSilo langasese ukweseka iMbube emisebenzini eyenzayo, hhayi ukushaya imithetho. UMntwana u-Africa uthe ukunikwa amandla amaningi kweHhovisi leSilo langasese kunobungozi, wathi abaNtwana kufanele bavunyelwe ukuba bakhulume nezinhlaka zikahulumeni uma kuneziphakamiso abanazo.UMntwana u-Africa uthe uyamkholwa uButhelezi uma ethi akayazi incwadi."UButhelezi usebenzela ihhovisi elifungelwe njengoba enguMphathiswa nje, uma ethi akayazi incwadi, ngiyamkholwa. Kufanele sonke simkholwe uma ethi akayazi incwadi."UMntwana uChris Zulu waseGazini, uthe le ncwadi ibaphuca amalungelo abo njengabaNtwana baseNdlunkulu."Kukhona umgoqo obekwayo lana, kuthiwa ukuthi akusenzeki. Iyasidida yonke into eyenzekayo futhi kusha konke lokhu okwenzekayo. Ngabe le nto ayizukulimaza yini amalungelo ethu njengabaNtwana baseNdlunkulu? Sibona sengathi siphucwa amalungelo ethu okuzalwa eNdlunkulu. Ithina esiwubukhosi, ubukhosi abukho ngaphandle kweNdlunkulu."UMntwana uChris uthe akazi ukuthi ubani onelungelo lokubhala incwadi ekanje engakhulumanga neNdlunkulu."Bekufanele uma kuwukuthi asisavumelekile ukukhuluma nezinhlaka zikahulumeni sibizwe, sitshwele."UMntwana uGugu Zulu waseMatheni, uthe abahambisani nokushiwo yincwadi."Imbudane lena, asihambisani nayo futhi angeke yenzeke le nto. Lo muntu okhuluma le nto akazalwa eNdlunkulu. Ngisho uMntwana waKwaPhindangene owayezalwa eNdlunkulu, wayengeke ayisho le nto."
KUWASHELE amakhansela e-ANC angovilavoco njengoba uNobhala wenhlangano, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, ethi ngeke azinuke izikhundla okhethweni lohulumeni basekhaya oluzayo.UMbalula uthe bafuna ukugadla ngamakhansela anogazi nakhuthele okhethweni lakulo nyaka. Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma esifundazweni iFree State, emcimbini wokugubha usuku okwasungulwa ngalo i-ANC owaziwa ngokuthi iJanuwari 8.Izinto aziyihambeli kahle i-ANC ezinkethweni zakumumva njengoba isanda kuhluleka ukuwina ngamalengiso ukhetho lukazwelonke lwango-2024, lapho yalahlekelwa khona isifundazwe iKwaZulu-Natal, yaphinde yahluleka ukuwina ngamalengiso esifundazweni iGauteng.UMbalula uthe imigomo izokube iqine kakhulu uma sebeqoka abazobamela okhethweni lakulo nyaka."Sizokhetha amakhansela athandwa abantu, asebenzela abantu. Asizukukhetha abangani bethu kodwa sizokhetha amakhansela asebenzela abantu. Uma usebenza ngokuzikhandla ungathuki ngoba uzokhethwa ukuthi ube ikhansela. Uma uyivila vele ukhohlwe ngoba ngeke ukhethwe."UMbalula uthe asikho isidingo sokuthi belokhu bebalisa ngokuhluleka kwabo ukunqoba ngamalengiso ukhetho olwedlule, wathi kufanele bavuke bazithathe, balungiselele ukhetho oluzayo."Akufanele nathi silingise umuntu ongenalo ithemba, olokhu edinda isililo. Kufanele sikhombise ukuthi thina sinalo ithemba."UMbalula uthe kulo nyaka ngeke belokhu bekhuluma kakhulu kodwa bazolungisa zonke izinkinga abathembise ukuzilungisa."Ziyisithupha izinto esifuna ukuzilungisa. Sakhuluma ngale zinto ngesikhathi kuneJanuwari 8. Sisebenza kanzima ukuze abantu basethembe. Sifuna ukusondelana nabantu. Kubalulekile kuthina ukuthi sibe nobudlelwano obuhle nezinhlaka zomphakathi. Akukhona nje ukuthi siya kubantu ngoba nakhu sifuna amavoti kodwa sifuna ukuhlezi siseduze nabantu. Kufanele kube ithina esixazulula izinkinga ezibhekene nabantu."Ngesikhathi kuneJanuwari 8, sazibophezela ukuthi sizolungisa izinkinga ezibhekene nomasipala siphinde sithuthukise umnotho. Akufanele silokhu sikhuluma ngenkinga yomigwaqo egcwele imigodi nenkinga yamanzi. Kufanele sizilungise lezi nkinga, singagcini ngokukhuluma kuphela. Lona unyaka wokuthi silungise zonke izinkinga ezibhekene nomasipala."UMbalula uthe banomqulu wamaqhinga okuxazulula izinkinga ezibhekene nomasipala abavumelana ngawo ngonyaka owedlule."Kuzokuba lula ukuthi sixazulula izinkinga ezibhekene nomasipala ngoba sinomqulu esavumelana ngawo ngonyaka owedlule."

LIZOPHUMA namuhla ibutho likaZulu eliyokhempa entabeni iSandlwana, eNquthu, lapho kuzokuba nomkhosi wokukhumbula ingqophamlando yempi yango-1879, lapho uZulu anqoba amaNgisi.ISilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini sizokhipha ibutho elizolibangisa eSandlwana, namhlanje, oLundi.Lesi isigaba esibalulekile emalungiselelweni omkhosi njengoba kusuke kuphindwa okwenziwa yiSilo uCetshwayo ngesikhathi sikhipha ibutho elanqoba amaNgisi.UMkhosi waseSandlwana uzokuba ngoLwesine.Okhulumela iSilo, uMntwana uThulani kaGqikazi Zulu, uthe ibutho elizokhishwa yiSilo namhlanje liqhamuke esifundeni iZululand, wathi lizofike lihlangane namabutho aqhamuka kwezinye izindawo eSandlwana."Kunzima njengamanje ukusho isibalo sebutho elizophuma kusasa (namhlanje) ngoba kukhona abazokube besuka khona eNquthu, abazofike bahlangane nebutho elizokube lisuka eZululand. Ibutho lizofike likhempe khona eSandlwana njengoba kuqhubeka imicimbi eyandulela uMkhosi waseSandlwana. Kuningi okuzokwenzeka khona eSandlwana kulo leli sonto ngaphambi kokuthi kufike umkhosi. NgoLwesithathu sizokube siseShiyane, ngoba nakhona siyazi ukuthi kunomlando okhona. Sizokube siyokhumbula loyo mlando." UMntwana uThulani uthe iSilo sizokwethula inkulumo eMkhosini waseSandlwana, ngoLwesine, lapho kulindeleke khona izinkumbi zabantu.UMntwana uThulani uthe ihambe kahle imicimbi eyandulela uMkhosi waseSandlwana ebingesonto eledlule.Imicimbi eyandulela umkhosi ibisesiFundeni iKing Cetshwayo, iqale ngoLwesine yaze yaphothulwa ngoLwesihlanu."Siqale ngoLwesine saya eSikhaleni seNkosi, ePort Durnford, lapho iSilo uCetshwayo sagibelela khona umkhumbi ngesikhathi siya kwelamaNgisi. Sabe sesidlulela eShowe, lapho kwaphumela khona umphefumulo weNgonyama. NgoLwesihlanu besiseNkandla, edlinzeni leSilo uCetshwayo lapho sibe khona nomthandazo. Konke kuhambe kahle kakhulu njengoba bekukhona abaNtwana, amakhosi namabutho."Imicimbi ehambisana noMkhosi waseSandlwana izoze iphothulwe ngoLwesihlanu, eRorkes Drift, lapho kuzobekwa izimbali emalibeni amabutho kaZulu nawamaNgisi aguqa kule mpi ka-1879.
UMUNWE liwukhombe enyangeni yasendaweni ithwasa elibanjwe oqotsheni leba amaphenti kulayini eMnhlonhlweni, eNanda, ngoLwesithathu emini.Leli thwasa Isolezwe elinalo igama lalo, kuvela ukuthi ngoLwesithathu, bese lizifikele qathatha komunye umuzi lizokweba amaphenti kulayini kanti ngeshwa lalo lizobhadanywa ngabesifazane bakuloyo muzi.Kuthiwa kuthe uma belibhadama base bebiza umphakathi, olithembise ukuthi uma lingawakhombi amanye amaphenti ukuthi akuphi - njengoba bese kunesikhathi elahleka - lizowukhonza umuzi onotshwala. Kuthiwa abesilisa bendawo bebevutha bengabaselwe, bewafuna amaphenti abantu babo. Kuthiwa ithwasa alichithanga sikhathi, libe selicela ukuba umphakathi ulilandele laze layofika komunye umuzi okukholakala ukuthi ngowenyanga eyaziwayo kodwa ebingekho. Isibongo senyanga Isolezwe linaso, kuthiwa isatshiswa okwenyoka kule ndawo.Kuthe uma lifika emagcekeni ithwasa langena ngaphakathi endlini, lase liphuma noplastiki abakhulu abathathu abamnyama okuyilapho ebelitatulila khona inqwaba yamaphenti kubuka bonke abantu besifazane. Abeyizinhlobo ezehlukene.Kwi-video ethunyelelwe Isolezwe ngesigameko, kunabesifazane ebebememeza besawabona amaphenti abo, bebabaza ukuthi kanti abelokhu eduka nje abethuthelwa emzini wenyanga. Kuvela kwi-video ithwasa limi phambi kwabesifazane bepetulula inqwaba yamaphenti bewabheka. Kukhona otatululayo bese kuba khona awathathayo awafake kuplastiki omncane awugodle ngengalo okukholakala ukuthi ngawakhe. Kuzwakala omunye ememeza ethi bonke abalahlekelwe amaphenti eDube Village, abaze bazocinga.Bebelibuza ithwasa ukuthi lingubani igama nesibongo, liyalisho ebese liyankwankwaza uma laba besifazane sebelibuza isibongo salo. Ezindaweni eziyizakhiwo njengaseNanda, izinto zangaphansi azinekwa ezindlini kepha zikhishelwa phandle ukuze zitholwe yilanga nomoya.Omunye wesifazane okhulume neSolezwe, uNksz Zandile Mngoma, uthe bese kuphele isikhathi eside kakhulu bephila nale nkinga yokwebiwa kwamaphenti abo enekiwe kulayini.UNksz Mngoma uthe: ''Mina nje sengithathelwe amaphenti angaphezuliu kuka-10 kulayini. Bengizibuza nje ukuthi ngubani lona owenza into embi kangaka kanti kunomuntu nje osebenzisana nenyanga ukuthi enze le nto.”Uthe basale bekhungathekile uma bebona ukuthi kanti le nto ibandakanya ithwasa nenyanga. Omunye, uNksz Zama Khumalo, uthe bese kuphela isikhathi eside kakhulu bephila nale nkinga.''Angisazi nokwazi ukuthi mangakhi amaphenti ami aduke ngiwanekile. Kodwa kuyacaca ukuthi bayazi bona ukuthi kungani bebewathatha. Okusixaka kakhulu ukuthi kungani bewagcinile noma kukhona abawagcinela khona, impela asazi, yibona kuphela abaziyo ukuthi bawenzani amaphenti,'' echaza.UNksz Slindile Mbanjwa uthe naye sebemqedile bemthathela amaphenti kulayini. Uthe ubehlale njalo ezibuza ukuthi ngubani lo owathathayo uma ewanekile kulayini kodwa engabi nazo izimpendulo zalokho.''Manje kodwa sesiyazi ukuthi lapha endaweni siphila nabantu abayingozi kangakanani abamane babone kukuhle ukuthi bebe amaphenti abantu besifazane ngenhloso yokuthi bafezekise izinhloso zabo,'' usho kanjena.Kunomunye wesifazane wakuyona le ndawo ocele ukuba maligodlwe igama lakhe, odalule ukuthi selokhu kwebiwa iphenti lakhe lokuqala ngonyaka owedlule, unenkinga yokopha engaqedi. ''Ngizizwa ngifikelwa usizi olukhulu kabi uma ngibona ukuthi kanti umuntu usenkingeni engaka nje kungenxa yabantu besilisa abahlangene, ababona ukuthi abantu besifazane bangamane benziwe noma yino nje,” usho kanjena. Omunye, uNksz Nonhlanhla Khumalo, uthe naye unenkinga efanayo njengoba selokhu kwebiwa iphenti lakhe, usengena kabili ezinsukwini zakhe ngenyanga. ''Lokhu ngaphuza ukukuqaphela. Empeleni nje ngaze ngatshelwa omunye umthandazi engangiye kuyena ukuthi indaba yonakala ngokwebiwa kwephenti lami kulayini, engitshela into vele nami engiyaziyo,” echaza.Omunye wesifazane utshele Isolezwe ukuthi akazange achithe sikhathi ngesikhathi efica amaphenti akhe engekho kulayini, wavele wanikela kubo kwayo inyanga, wafika wawathola ngoba vele kwase kukhona amahebezi okuthi le nyanga yiyona ethuma abantu ukuba bathathe amaphenti uma enekiwe kolayini.''Ngampela futhi ngawacela banginikeza ngase ngiyahamba, akekho owangilwisa,” usho kanjena.Abesifazane bazwakale kwi-video bethi ngeke bawabikele amaphoyisa ngalolu daba ngoba umsolwa ubukeka ewumuntu odidekile.Ngokwezempilo, kuthiwa kunesimo sabesilisa abathola injabulo yezocansi ngokubuka izinto zangaphansi zabesifazane. Kuthiwa abanye abanalesi simo bagcina sebezintshontsha uma zinekiwe ngoba besaba ukuzithenga ezitolo futhi basuke befuna esezike zasetshenziswa.
KUSALOKHU kunzima ukuthola ukuthula emoyeni emndenini womfundi obefunda esikoleni sabanezidingo ezengenziwe nabakhubazekile iKhulangolwazi Special School, eMontclair, eThekwini, ngenxa yokuhamba kwesikhathi kungenzeki lutho ngothisha osolwa ngokushaya lo mfundi ngaphakathi emagcekeni alesi sikole ngo-2024, ongakaze aboshwe futhi osafundisa khona.Lokhu kushiwo wunina walo mfundi waseFolweni, eningizimu yeTheku, esiligodlile igama lakhe nelendodana yakhe ukuze bavikeleke, okhala ngokuthi indodana (14) yashaywa yilo thisha ekupheleni kwa-2024, yalimala kabi ebusweni.Elandisa ngesigameko, unina womfundi udalule ukuthi namanje akucaci kahle ukuthi ingane yakhe yayoneni kuthisha ize ishaywe kabuhlungu kangaka. Uthe isehlakalo sayihlukumeza kakhulu, waze wabona kungcono ukuthi ayishintshise isikole njengoba manje isifunda uGrade 8 esikoleni sayo esisha esiseThekwini."Lesi sigameko senzeke ngo-Okthoba ngo-2024, lapho engithole khona ukuthi izingane zazihleli zizidlalela kuverandi wesikole ngenkathi kuqhamuka uthisha wazithethisa, ebuza ukuthi zenzani phandle ngesikhathi sokufunda. Kepha okwangixaka futhi kwangiphatha kabi kakhulu wukuthi kungani kwashaywa ingane yami kuphela kulezo eyayihleli nazo phandle, nokuthi noma ngabe yayone kangakani, kungani ayishaya ngezandla?” kubuza umzali.Eqhuba, uthe okunye okumphatha kabi wukuthi kwala ngisho esevula icala esiteshini samaphoyisa eMontclair, kuze kube yimanje akakaze aboshwe lo thisha, okumanje usaqhubeka uyafundisa kulesi sikole."Kwathi sengivule icala, umseshi wecala wangitshela ukuthi kumele sizame ukuhlangana nalo thisha nothishanhloko, sibonisane ukuthi kungenziwanjani ukuxazulula lolu daba ngale kokuthi kuze kube khona umuntu oboshwayo. "Ngizame kaningi ukusukumela lolu daba. Ngaze ngalwedlulisela nakumhloli ophethe isekethi isikole esingaphansi kwayo, kepha kwanhlanga zimuka nomoya. Sihlanganile nomhloli, isigungu esilawula ukusebenza kwesikole nothishanhloko ukubhunga ngalolu daba, nalapho bazama ukungincenga ukuthi ngihoxise icala, kepha ngala ngaphetha ngisho sekukhona othembisa ukungifumbathisa imali ukuze ngivalwe umlomo,” kulanda umzali.Uthe enye into ebuhlungu nemphatha kabi kakhulu ngalesi simo wukuthi ingane yakhe useyiyise kosonhlalakahle ukuthi bayeluleke, njengoba kubonakala ukuthi lesi simo siyihlukumeze kakhulu kangakanani kodwa inolaka ngisho kwezinye izingane."Ngize ngiyikhipha kulesi sikole nje nyakenye, bese kukaningi ngihlale ngibhula umlilo wamacala okuthi isishaye ezinye izingane efunda nazo, okukhombisa ukuthi lesi simo siyihluhlukumeze kangakanani. Kuyenzeka futhi ingibuze ukuthi yashayelwani yilo thisha, ngingabi nazo izimpendulo ngoba nami angazi okwangempela. Ngiyafisa ukuthi kube khona okwenzekayo ngalolu daba ukuze nami ngibe nokuthula emoyeni wami,” usho kanje.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uCol Robert Netshiunda uthe amaphoyisa aseMontclair aphenya isigameko sokushaywa komfundi ona-14, okusolakala ukuthi kwenziwa ngumuntu amaziyo. Uthe idokodo lalolu daba lathathwa ladluliselwa kumshushisi ukuthi kube nguye onqumayo ngokuzokwenzeka ngalo.Kuthintwa inhloko yezokuxhumana eMnyangweni wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Muzi Mahlambi ucele imininingwane yengane neyomzali, kepha kwaze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela engakabuyi nempendulo entathelini.
Umsolwa wesilisa, 33, udutshulwe wabulawa ngamaphoyisa endaweni yakwaMbutho ngoLwesihlanu, mhlaka-16 Januwari 2026, ngabo-19:00, ngesikhathi amaphoyisa ephenya icala lokuthumba.Amaphoyisa akuTsolo athole umbiko wokuthunjwa kowesifazane oneminyaka engu-24 ubudala esuka eLibode kuthiwa wayenga umsolwa ezinkundleni zokuxhumana. Bobabili bahlangane eMthatha ngoLwesine, Januwari, badlulela kuTsolo ngetekisi. Ngesikhathi beya endaweni kamsolwa kwaMbutho ngezinyawo, umsolwa wesilisa usabise isisulu ngommese wasidlwengula endaweni eyisikhotha. Ngemuva kwalokho baqhubekela endlini kamsolwa lapho afike adlwengulela khona futhi. Kuthiwa umsolwa uzumekile, owesifazane ukwazile ukubikela izihlobo zakhe ngocingo.Udaba lubikelwe amaphoyisa aphuthume anikela khona, kwathi uma efika, umsolwa uzame ukuwahlasela ngommese. Umsolwa udutshulwe washona.Uphenyo lokuqala luveze ukuthi abesifazane abathathu abaneminyaka ephakathi kuka-25 no-29 kubikwe ukuthi badukile esiteshini samaphoyisa kuTsolo kusukela ngomhlaka-24 Disemba 2025 kwaze kwaba ngu-15 Januwari 2026 futhi bonke batholakala beshonile ezigangeni. Amaphoyisa athole amarekhodi eselula alo msolwa ukuphenya olwabagilwa abathathu okugcine kuvela ukuthi bonke abagilwa bagcina ukuxhumana naye ngaphambi kokushona kwabo. Kuvulwe idokodo lophenyo ngamacala okudlwengula, ukuthumba, ukwenqaba ukuboshwa nokuhlasela amaphoyisa, kanti olunye uphenyo ludluliselwe kwa-IPID.
BABIKA usizi othisha abangasebenzi uma bechaza ngesimo abazithola bebhekene naso sokuphela kwesikhathi eside bengaqasheki.Labo thisha bakhulume neSolezwe bengaphandle kwamahhovisi oMnyango wezeMfundo aseMgungundlovu.Izolo, bese kuwusuku lwesithathu olugcwele bevuka njalo ebese beyoqhinqa ngaphandle kwamahhovisi.Batshele Isolezwe ukuthi banencwadi enohlu lwezikhalazo zabo abafuna ukuthi igcine seyamukelwe aboMnyango.Omunye walabo thisha, uNksz Nkosingiphile Xulu (28) ongowaseNkandla ngokudabuka, ulimise ngesihloko elokuthi sebekhathele bona manje ukubhuquza emakhaya nezitifiketi zabo abazizuza kanzima ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme."Namhlanje wusuku lwesithathu sihlezi lapha ngaphandle futhi kasiyi ndawo. Sifuna kuze kube khona ozimisele ngokuzosibona sidlulise izikhalazo zethu kuyena. Kodwa uma kusenjengoba kunjena engekho ozimisele ngokuthi asibone - asinankinga thina - yokuvuka njalo ekuseni sizoqhinqa lapha ngaphandla kwalawa mahhovisi. Ngeke phela, sesikhathele lokhu okwangempela ke manje,'' usho kanjena kuzwakala ukuthi usenyukelwa nawumoya.Uveze ukuthi uneziqu zobuthishela azizuza eNyuvesi yaKwaZulu Natal. ''Sekuphele iminyaka eyisithupha manje ngiduve ekhaya ngingasebenzi. Hheyi yaze yabuhlungu nansi into esibhekene nayo singothisha," usho kanjena.UMnuz Nkosinathi Shezi (35) waseMzinyathi ngokudabuka, uthe akukho abangakwenzanga kodwa yonke imizamo yabo imane iphelele ezeni kuhle okwezithukuthu zenja. Uthe kukaningi befaka izicelo kodwa kumane kufane - kube sengathi kabenzanga lutho. Uthe yingakho sebelungabaza uhlelo lokuqashwa kothisha KwaZulu-Natal.Uthe kune-database abatshelwa ngayo uMnyango wezeMfundo waKwaZulu-Natal ukuba kumele basebenzise yona ukufaka izicelo, nalokho uthi bakwenza kodwa namanje kusacwebe iziziba.''Sesifuna ukwazi-ke manje ukuthi kanti kuqhubekani? Yini le thina okumele siyenze kanti ukuze kukhulunywe indaba yokuthi sesiyasebenza nathi njegabanye? Le nto isiqala ukusihlukumeza lokhu okwangampela. Kunzima ukuphila ngale ndlela esiphila ngayo, akusenzeki lutho,'' usho kanjena.Uveze ukuthi uneziqu zobuthishela azizuza eDurban University of Technology (DUT) kanti sekuphele iminyaka engu-5 lutho ukuqashwa. ''Uke uzwe uma kuthiwa kumnyama? Kusuke kukhulunywa ngento enjengalena ke. Impela kumnyama sikhona. Liphelile manje ithemba,'' kusho yena.UNksz Vamisile Buthelezi (38) waKwaDukuza, uthe sebelwe baze baphelelwa yiwona amandla. Ngokusho kwakhe kukhona okushaya amanzi ngohlelo lokuqashwa kothisha KwaZulu-Natal.''Ngeke phela kwenzeke izinto ezinjena sibuka. Kwesinye isikhathi uthola umuntu oqede manje enyuvesi kodwa athole umsebenzi ngokushesha. Uvele uzibuze ukuthi kanti kwenzekani?'' usho kanjena.Uthe kungcono khona ukuthi umuntu amane ahlale emgwaqweni kunokuthi aphile ngokudla imali yesalukazi yempesheni. ''Kuye kube buhlungu ukubona ingane yakho iphuma iya esikoleni ivalelisa ithi isiyahamba, ufise ukuyipha imali kodwa akukho ongakwenza ngoba usuke ungenalo nesenti elimnyama leli."UNksz Nokuzola Radebe (30) waKwaMashu, uthe useliphonsile ithawula ngokuthi kuyoke kukhanye ngendlela okubonakala kubhimba ngakhona. Uthe yingakho manje bebone kungcono ukuba bamane bavuke njalo bezoqhinqa ngaphandle kwamahhovisi oMnyango.Uthe ngokwenza kanjalo mhlawumbe uzocaca umyalezo abahlose ukuwudlulisa kwizikhulu zoMnyango wezeMfundo zaKwaZulu-Natal. Uthe sekuphele iminyaka eyisithupha engasebenzi, wathi manje sekuyazwela futhi kakhulu. Uveze ukuthi uneziqu zobuthishla azithola e-Unisa.Wenze izinsolo ezibucayi zokuthi baninngi abafika kubona babatshele ngo-R30 000 okumele ukhokhwe ukuze kuzokhanya. ''Kusho ukuthi kukhanya ngampela ngoba bonke abawutholayo loyo R30 000 bayasebenza sikhuluma nje,'' echaza.Ukhale esifanayo noMnuz Thuleleni Ngwazi (36) ongowaseNanda, wathi impela izinto zimapeketwane. Uthe uneziqu zobuthishela azithola e-Unisa, wathi lona ngunyaka wesine ehlezi ekhaya, lutho ukuthola umsebenzi awufundele.UNksz Zamile Ngcobo (34) uvele wakhihla isililo wehlukela ukukhuluma, wathi kungcono nokufa kunale nto eyenzeka kubona. Uthe uneziqu azithola eNyuvesi yaseZululand kanti sekuphele iminyaka eyisishiyagalombili engasebenzi.Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Muzi Mahlambi, uthe ngeke kuze kubasize ngalutho labo thisha ukuvuka njalo bayoqhinqa ngaphandle kwamahhovisi. Uthe futhi akukho kuhle ukuba nothisha abaneziqu abenza ngale ndlela.''Othisha baqashwa ngalokho okusuke kudingeka ngaleso sikhathi uma futhi kuvela leso simo. Abanye bothisha ebebeqhinqa kanjalo ngaphandle sebeyasebenza. Iqiniso ukuthi lokhu abakwenzayo ngeke kubalekelele ekutheni beqe abanye,'' usho kanjena.
ZIVULWE ngebatha ezinye zezikole KwaZulu-Natal njengoba uMnyango wezeMfundo ungayifakanga imali yama-norms and standards, kushoda othisha kwezinye izikole, kanti nabaphakela izikole basakweletwa imali yangonyaka odlule.Abaphakela izikole kuthiwa kudingeke ukuthi baye komashonisa bayoboleka imali ukuze bakwazi ukuthenga ukudla abazokuyisa ezikoleni. Ezinye zezikole yima bezithola i-stationery kulezo ezithengelwa nguhulumeni lezi zinsiza ngenxa yokuthi umnyango waphuza ukusithenga nyakenye. Ezinye zezikole ezaphephuka nyakenye, okubalwa eziseMgungundlovu, kuthiwa azikalungiswa ngenxa yokuthi imali ayikho.Okhulumela i-DA kwezemfundo esifundazweni, uMnuz Sakhile Mngadi, ukhale ngokuthi izikole zivulwe ngaphandle kwemali efakwa ngumnyango eyaziwa ngama-norms and standards. Uthe ne-stationery asifikile kwezinye zezikole ngoba ezinye izikole ziyazithengela, kanti nalezo ezithengelwa nguhulumeni, akuzona zonke ezisasitholile."Umnyango uhluleke wukukhokhela abaphakela izikole. Siyakuchitha ukuthi izinkinga zomnyango zenziwa wukuthi uMnyango kaMgcinimafa, uhlulekile ukufaka imali. Le nkinga eyeminyaka emnyangweni wezemfundo njengoba ubuwenza izinkontileka ekubeni imali ingekho, bese uba nezikweletu. Imali ibingaphethwe kahle kulo mnyango," usho kanje.Uthe nakuba ibe mihle imiphumela ka-matric kodwa ngeke bakuvume ukuthi izingane zithwale kanzima. Omunye wabaphakela izikole ocele ukungavezwa, uthe abazange bakhokhelwe imali yangoNovemba nyakenye."Ngenxa yokuthi sicabangela izingane, siye komashonisa siyoboleka imali ukuze sikwazi ukuthenga ukudla, sikuhambise. Umnyango awuthi vu ngokuthi uzosikhokhela nini imali yangonyaka odlule njengoba siye komashonisa nje ekubeni usikweleta," usho kanje.Emhlanganweni wothishanhloko beSadtu ngempelasonto, baveze ukuthi kwezinye izikole kunezikhala zothisha ezingavaliwe kusuka nyakenye. Baveze ukuthi akusebenzeki ngenxa yokuthi abatholi zimpendulo emnyangweni kusuka nyakenye. Esikoleni i-Addington Primary eThekwini, inhlangano i-March and March, ibhekane ngeziqu zamehlo nabanye babahlali abahlanganisa nabokufika kuleli, abahlala kule ndawo kubangwa indaba yezingane zabokufika ezifunda kulesi sikole.Umnyango wakuveza ukuthi ayikho ingane okumele icwaswe ngoba ingeyokufika noma ingenazo izimfanelo ezifana nesitifiketi sokuzalwa, namaphepha okuba kuleli. Wathi kumele zifunde bese othishanhloko benza imizamo yokusiza abazali ukuthi bathole amaphepha aqondile.Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kokhulumela umnyango uMnuz Muzi Mahlambi, ayiphumelalanga izolo.UNgqongqoshe weMfundo eyisiSekelo, uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, ekhuluma nabezindaba ngemuva kokuvakashela izikole eNorth West izolo, uthe bayayilungisa inkinga yemali ebhekene nomnyango wesifundazwe.Uthe awukho umbiko wokuphazamiseka abawutholile ovela esifundazweni.
IDolobha laseKurhuleni likuqinisekisile ukuthi ikhansela lalo mkhandlu emnyangweni wezeMigwaqo nezokuThutha, uMnuz Andile Mngwevu, udukile emuva kokuthi imoto abehamba ngayo imuka nezikhukhula eChokwe, eningizimu yeMozambique.UMngwevu ubeyingxenye yethimba elisemthethweni ebelivakashele eMozambique ngesikhathi kugadla izikhukhula kule ndawo. Ngokusho kukamasipala imoto ebimthwele ibanjwe amanzi egijima yaguguleka.Imisebenzi yokuthungatha nokuhlenga isaqhubeka, iziphathimandla zaseMozambique kanye nabezimo eziphuthumayo basebenzela ukuthola uMngwevu kanye nabanye okungenzeka ukuthi bakhahlamezekile kulesi sigameko.IDolobha lase-Ekurhuleni lithe likhathazeke kakhulu futhi lisaqhubeka nokuxoxisana neziphathimandla. I-SABC ibike ukuthi amalungu omndeni kaMngwevu ahambele eMozambique ukuyokweseka imizamo yokuthungatha.Ngaphezu kwalokho, Umbutho Wezokuvikela WaseNingizimu Afrika (i-SANDF) kanye Nombutho Wezokuvikela wase-Mozambique baqale umkhankaso ngokuhlanganyela wokuthola i-MMC elahlekile kanye nalabo abehamba nabo.
UKHUNGATHEKILE umndeni wowesifazane wasoPhongolo okuthiwa ubulawe evakashele umngani wakhe abengamathe nolimi naye.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi umufi, uNksz Zabanguni Mnguni (34) ubulawe ngoMsombuluko emini kade evakashele umngani wakhe. Isihlobo sikamufi, uMnuz Zamani Mnguni sitshele Isolezwe ukuthi umufi ubesuke kubo eyovakashela umngani wakhe njengenjwayelo.Uveze ukuthi imizi yale mindeni ayiqhelelene kangako kangangoba akupheli nemizuzu emihlanu uma omunye eya komunye.Echaza uthe bathole ukuthi umufi ube nengxabano eshunqa phansi nomunye wesilisa, naye obevakashele kulo muzi.''Kuthiwa bahilizisane kakhulu asazi kodwa ukuthi yini lena abebephikisana ngayo. Kodwa sithole ukuthi owesilisa ucikwe wukuthi umufi ubemphendula noma yikanjani kanti uzocasuka bese eyamgwaza amanxeba amathathu kubuka bonke abantu ebebekhona ngaphakathi endlini,'' usho kanjena.Uthe bona babizwe sekuthiwa mabaphuthume kumele aphuthunyiswe esibhedlela udadewabo, ngeshwa bafike esethule. ''Mhlawumbe ubezosinda kodwa inkinga kusuke kwaba wukuthi ubemgwaze endaweni embi kakhulu njengoba emgwaze esifubeni nasekhanda,” kuchaza isihlobo.Ebuzwa ukuthi uyamazi yini owesilisa uthe abanye bathe bayamazi ungowakhona endaweni, wathi kodwa yena ngabe uhubhuza aluhlaza uma ethi uyamazi, kumbe wake wambona.''Okusiphatha kabi kakhulu ngaphezulu kwezinto zonke wukuthi udadewethu ubulawe engekho ekhaya kodwa ekamngani wakhe. Kodwa ayikho into esingayisho ngoba siyazi ukuthi bebezwana kangakanani nomngani,'' usho kanjena kuzwakala nje ukuthi ukhungathekile.Uthe bazolwa kuze kube sekugcineni bathole ubulungiswa ukuze umenzi wobubi ajeze ngakwenzile. Uveze ukuthi umenzi wobubi kuthiwa ucele empunzini ngemuva kwesigameko kodwa wasala egcekeni ummese abegwaze ngawo umufi. Uthe namanje umsolwa usagcwele amathafa.''Kubuhlungu kakhulu lokhu okuvelele udadewethu ngoba ubengumuntu olungile futhi engakujwayele nokuxabana nabantu. Sikhulekela ukuthi umbulali abanjwe avalelwe bese eyasichazela njengomndeni ukuthi kungani ekhethe ukwenza into enesihluku ngalolu hlobo,'' usho kanjena.Uthe ngabe benza iphutha elikhulu uma bengathi bayamsola umngani kamufi.''Laba bantu bebezwana ngale ndlela exakile futhi babefunda ndawonye emazingeni aphansi baze baphinde bafunda ndawonye nasemazingeni aphezulu,'' kuchaza yena.Ukhale ngomkhokha athe ubalandele kuleli khaya njengoba ngo-2022 kunomunye emndenini owashona ekade evakashele umngani wakhe eShowe.''Asazi noma kumayelana nokuthi kukhona esingakwenzanga yini ngesikhathi kwenzeka okokuqala noma yinto nje eyenzeke ngoba kuziqondanele,'' usho kanjena.Ubalise ngokuthi bagqemeke engeqiwa ntwala ngokufa kukadadewabo ngale ndlela. "Kunzima nokutshela izingane zakhe ukuthi ngeke ziphinde zimbone unina,'' kusho yena.Amaphoyisa aKwaZulu-Natal akuqinisekisile ukubulawa kukamufi. Athe kuphenywa ngokufa kowesifazane okusolakala ukuthi ubulawe ngokugwazwa.
UGIXATSHEZWE ngodilikajele owesilisa owalahlwa yicala lokubulala iphoyisa lomgwaqo. INkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini imgwebe udilkajele uPhilakahle Dladla (27) ngecala lokusocongwa kukaSenior Superintendent Arumugam Marimuthoo.Esigamekweni esenzeka ngoNovemba 4 ngo-2024, ngezithuba zokugamanxa kwehora lesithupha ntambama, uSenior Superintendent Marimuthoo waqaphela ukuthi kunemoto eyayikade ipake maphakathi nomgwaqo eGroutville ngendlela eyayisolisa.Wabe esebuza umshayeli ukuthi kwenzekani, nowaphendula ngokuthi babanjwe inkunzi. Ngesikhathi uMarimuthoo esehlehlisa imoto kubikwa ukuthi uDladla wavele waqala wavulela ngenhlamvu edubula ebhekise ngqo ephoyiseni. Kubikwa ukuthi wamdubula amahlandla amaningi nje impela.Ngemuva kwalokho kuthiwa uDladla wabe eseshayela itekisi ebheke ngaselokishini eThembeni linabagibeli ngaphakathi. Abagibeli nabo kuthiwa uDladla wababamba inkunzi ebaphuca izinto zabo wabe esebaleka ngezinyawo wagcwala amathafa.USenior Superintendent Marimuthoo waphelela endaweni yesigameko, kwabe sekuvulwa icala lokubulala nelokubanjwa kwenkunzi, KwaDukuza. Idokodo labe selidluliselwa oPhikweni loKlebe lwaseThekwini oluphenya amacala abucayi.Ngemuva kwezinsuku eziyisikhombisa oKlebe bathola imininingwane ngokuthi ukuphi nendawo uDladla. Babe sebeya eMelmoth okuyilapho abafike bambopha khona.UDladla waya namaphoyisa KwaMashu lapho okwakugcinwe khona izibhamu ezasetshenziselwa ukubulala umufi.Wabe esebekwa icala ngokusemthethweni waqala ukugqigqa enkantolo lapho bekuqulwa khona icala. Isicelo sakhe sebheyili sanqatshwa njengoba uMbuso wasiphikisa wabe esegcinwa ngaphakathi esitokisini sonke lesi sikhathi. NgoNovemba 7 ngonyaka odlule iNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini yamthola enecala.UDladla ugixatshezwe ngesigwebo sikadilikajele ngecala lokubulala umufi, wagixatshezwa ngeminyaka engu-15 ngecala lokubamba inkunzi abagibeli, iminyaka emihlanu ngokutholakala nesibhamu esingekho emthethweni neminye iminyaka emihlanu ngecala lokutholakala nezinhlamvu.Enkantolo kuvele ukuthi zonke lezi zigwebo uDladla uzozidonsa kanye kanye. Kugwetshwa uDladla nje ngecala lokubulala iphoyisa lomgwaqo ngonyaka odlule kwagwetshwa udilikajele omunye wesilisa waKwaDukuza naye owayelahlwe yicala lokubulala iphoyisa lomgwaqo.
UHLONGOZA ukuthi kuphele nya ngomthetho ovumela ukuthi kube khona iphesenti elithathwa njengelamukelekile egazini lomshayeli uNgqongqoshe wezokuThutha eNingizimu Afrika, uNkk Barbara Creecy. UNkk Creecy ukusho lokhu izolo ethula izibalo zabafe ezingozini emigwaqweni yakuleli ngesikhathi samaholidi okuphela kuka-2025. Uthe lo mthetho owasungulwa eminyakeni eminingi edlule awusenandawo kule Ningizimu Afrika yanamuhla. "Akwamukelekile nhlobo ukuthi kungathiwa kukhona umthetho ovumela abantu ukuthi bagoxe utshwala bese beyashayela,” kusho uNkk Creecy. Uthe akazi ukuthi angaqala ngaphi echazela umuntu olahlekelwe abathandiweyo bakhe engozini yomgwaqo ukuthi kukhona inani lotshwala elivumelekile egazini lomshayeli. "Sesifikile isikhathi sokuthi siwushintshe lo mthetho ukuze sibe nento ecacile ethi ukushayela uphuzile akuvumelekile,” usho kanje. Maqondana nezibalo zezingozi kanjalo nalabo abafe ngazo ngesikhathi samaholidi, uNkk Creecy uthe, zehle ngo-5% uma kuqhathaniswa nezamaholidi okuphela kuka-2024. Uthe babe ngu-1 427 abashone ezingozini ezingu-1 172. Uthe zinhlanu izifundazwe ezinezibalo ezikhombise ukwehla kwabafe ezingozini. Uthe phambili ziholwa yi-Eastern Cape, ilandelwe yi-Free State. "Zine izifundazwe ezikhombise ukunyukelwa yisibalo sabashone ezingozini. Zona ziholwa yiGauteng, ilandelwe yiWestern Cape, kuze iMpumalanga bese kuba yiNorthern Cape,” kusho uCreecy. Uthe abakuqaphelile wukuthi u-40% wezingozi ezenzeke ngamaholidi wenzeke phakathi kukaDisemba 15 kuya ku-28.Uthe lokhu kuqinisekisa abahlale bekusho ukuthi izingozi eziningi azenzeki ngesikhathi abantu begoduka beya ezindaweni lapho abasuke beyochitha khona amaholidi kodwa zenzeka sebefikile kulezo zindawo, sebezibandakanya emibhiyozweni ehlukene yamaholidi. "Umbiko ukhombisa ukuthi izingozi eziningi zenzeka ebusuku phakathi kuka-7 no-9, bese zilokhu ziqhubeka kize kushaye u-1 entathakusa,” usho kanje. Uthe isifundazwe iKwaZulu-Natal yiso esizidlule zonke ngokuba nomshayeli obadlule bonke ngokuba nenani eliphezulu lotshwala egazini ngesikhathi ebanjwa amaphoyisa eshayela ephuzile. "Kuthe uma efuthiswa, kwatholakala ukuthi liphindaphindeke ka-14 izinga lotshwala elithathwa njengelamukelekile egazini kakhe,” kusho uNkk Creecy. Uthe obaqwaqwade emakhanda ngokubanjwa ehamba ngesivinini esiphezulu, wavinjwa amaphoyisa eNorthern Cape. "Wabanjwa ehamba ngo-220km/h endaweni ka-120km/h,” usho kanje. Uthe u-55% wezingozi udalwe yizimoto ezincane, kuthi u-20% udalwe ezithutha impahla (light delivery vehicles), amatekisi adale ezingu-7%, kwathi amaloli adala ezingu-6%. Uthe zibe ngu-1632 izivimbamgwaqo abazenzile ezweni lonke lapho kumiswe khona izimoto ezingu-1,8 million kwabhekwa ukuthi zisesimeni esifanele ukuba semgwaqweni, abashayeli bakulungele yini ukushayela kanjalo nokuthi amalayisensi akahle. "Kukhishwe amathikithi angaphezu kuka-450, kwaboshwa abangu-525 ngokushayela ngesivinini esiphezulu,” kusho uNkk Creecy. Uveze ukuthi bangu-173 000 abashayeli abahlolwe ukuthi abanabo yini utshwala egazini, wathi kubona abangu-8561 batholwe benabo, zabakhalela. Uthe lesi sibalo sikhombisa ukwenyuka ngo-144% uma besiqhathanisa nesikhathi esifanayo ngo-2024. Ubonge zonke izinhlaka ezithintekayo, wathi wukusebenza kwazo ngokuzikhandla okuholele ekutheni kwehle izibalo zezingozi nesibalo sabadlule kuzona.

SIZISHAYA isifuba ngokuvelela kuka-matric waso wokuqala ngqa isikole, i-Anton Lambede Mathematics, Science and Technology Academy School of Innovation and Leadership esiseLa Mercy. Lesi sikole u-matric waso wokuqala ugile izimanga njengoba uhlomule ngo-100% kuphasa bonke abafundi baso. Asigcinanga lapho ngoba sithole inqwaba yamaBachelor okuyinto uthishanhloko waso, uMnuz Dumisani Sibaya, azishaya isifuba ngayo kakhulu.Ekhuluma neSolezwe Ngempelasonto ngokuphumelela kwesikole, uSibaya uncome kakhulu ukuzikhandla kwabo bonke othisha bakulesi sikole. USibaya uthe isikole sigxila kakhulu kwiMathematics nakwiScience. Uthe bazishaya isifuba ngendlela abafundi babo abenze ngayo.Uthe bayazigqaja ngokuthi bagcine behlomula ngo-A abangu-474 sebebonke. ''Lokhu kukuvezela ngokusobala ukuthi sisebenze kahle kangakanani. Sijabule kakhulu ngendlela esenze ngayo," kuchaza yena. Uthe okunye okubahlaba umxhwele wukuthi zonke izifundo abafundi bebeziphasa kusuka ku-80% kuya phezulu. ''Lokhu kukuveza ngokusobala ukuthi bebezimisele kangakanani. Indlela abebesebenza ngayo ibikuveza ukuthi bazinikele kangakanani,''usho kanjena.Uthe kukhona ngisho abafundi abagcine behlomula ngo-A abangu-10 okuyinto athe ayijwayelekile. ''Kunabafundi abakhetha ukwenza izifundo ezingu-10 sabavumela ukuba bakwenze lokho. Sijabule ukuthi phezu komthwalo ongaka abebebhekene nawo kodwa benze kahle kakhulu," 'kuchaza yena. Uthe kuningi okudale ukuthi bagcine bethola imiphumela emihle kangaka, okunye kwakho uthe kubandakanya ukuthi abafundi ababathathayo yilabo abasuke bezolala khona esikoleni.''Kulesi sikole sinabafundi abahlala ngaphakathi esikoleni ngokugcwele. Lokhu kusilekelele kakhulu ngoba othisha bebebafundisa noma yinini,'' usho kanjena. Uveze ukuthi bathatha nesinqumo sokuthi babe nabafundi abaningi abenza i-Information Technology (IT).Uthe nakusona lesi sifundo abafundi babo benze kahle kakhulu okuyinto athe bayithandile kakhulu. Imfihlo yabo uthe wukuthi abafundi abasuka nabo kwaGrade 8 yibona kanye labo ebebefunda uGrade 12 ngonyaka odlule.''Bonke abafundi abangu-109 esiqale nabo kwaGrade 8 yibona laba abenze kahle kakhulu. Siyaziqhenya ngokuthi akekho noyedwa phakathi kwabo ogcine esesala endleleni kodwa bonke babekezela kwaze kwafika lesi sikhathi,'' kuchaza uSibaya.Othisha bakulesi sikole bancome abafundi ngendlela abebezinikele ngayo bathi yikhona kanye okuvele kwenza ukuthi izinto ziibe lula nje. USibaya uthe kulesi sikole banothisha abangakhulile kangako ngokweminyaka, lokhu uthe ukholwa wukuthi kuyabasebenzela kakhulu. Isikole savulwa ngokusemthethweni ngoFebhuwari 15, 2021 sivulwa owayenguNdunankulu waKwaZulu- Natal ngaleso sikhathi, uMnuz Sihle Zikalala.
KUDUMALE abaningi kuhlehla ingqophamlando yomcimbi womlingisi wodumo kuMkhokha The Curse, uMbuso Khoza, iBattle of Isandlwana Commemoration ebizoba seConstitution Hill eBraamfontein, eGoli ngoJanuwari 25.
