I-IFP izoqala umkhankaso wokukhuculula amaziko ngaphambi kokuba iqale uhlelo lokuqoka abazoyimela okhethweni lohulumeni basekhaya.Umholi we-IFP, uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa, uthe bafuna ukwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi bonke abazomela iqembu okhethweni oluzayo bazoqokwa amaziko asemthethweni.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma emcimbini wokusonga umgubho weminyaka engu-50 kwasungulwa i-IFP obuseNgwavuma, ngoMgqibelo.Imicimbi yokugubha iminyaka engu-50 kwasungulwa i-IFP yaqala ngoMashi.I-IFP yasungulwa yinkosi Mangosuthu Buthelezi, ngo-1975, KwaNzimela, eMelmoth.UHlabisa uthe isigungu esiphezulu se-IFP sithathe isinqumo sokuba sihambele onke amaziko eqembu ngaphambi kokuba kuqale uhlelo lokuqokwa kwabazongenela ukhetho lohulumeni basekhaya."Onke amaziko, ngenxa yokuthi kunomsindo nokuxokozela kuwona, sizowadlulisa edibheni, ayobalwa onke. Sifuna ukuthi uma sekuyophakanyiswa abazomela iqembu, amakhansela azomela i-IFP sifuna ukuthi sihambe namaziko esaziyo ukuthi angamaziko esiwadlulise edibheni, adipha, sawathola ukuthi alungile. Sifuna ukuhamba namaziko esaziyo ukuthi azokwazi ukuhola umkhankaso ozosisiza ukuthi sinqobe ukhetho."UHlabisa ugqugquzele amalungu eqembu ukuba aqinise ekwakheni amaziko azolekelela iqembu okhethweni oluzayo."Hambani niyokwakha amaziko azokwenza i-IFP iphile, hambani niyokwakha iziyingi ezizokwenza ukuthi i-IFP inqobe ukhetho lomasipala ngonyaka ozayo."UHlabisa ukhuze izimpi zangaphakathi eqenjini."Iqembu lezombusazwe elivumela ukwehlukana, kuba isihlava okuthi noma selizama noma yini ukusikhipha, kube nhlanga zimuka nomoya. Asakheni udonga oluzokwenza ukuthi singangeni lesi sihlava esisibona komakhelwane. Asivuse izidonga, sibiyele iqembu lingangenwa ilesi sihlava."UHlabisa uthe bafuna ukwenza kahle okhethweni lohulumeni basekhaya.I-IFP iphethe komasipala abawu-27 KwaZulu-Natal. UHlabisa uthe omasipala abaphethwe yi-IFP bahamba phambili ekuphathweni kwemali."Siyajabula ukuthi omasipala abaningi abaphethwe yi-IFP bathola imibiko engenagcobho. Kuwumlando esiwukhandayo ukuthi lapha KwaZulu-Natal omasipala abaningi abathola imibiko engenagcobho baphethwe i-IFP."UHlabisa uthe imiphumela yakamumva yokhetho ikhombisa ukuthi i-IFP iyaqhubeka nokukhula yize engasekho uButhelezi.I-IFP iye okhethweni okokuqala engasekho uButhelezi ngonyaka owedlule. Emva kwalo, i-IFP yajoyina uhulumeni wokubambisana ophethe kuzwelonke, njengoba kuyiyona ehola uhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal.
OYINHLOKO yeCrime Intelligence, uLieutenant General Dumisani Khumalo, udalule ukuthi izinkinga zeKwaZulu-Natal Political Task Team (PKTT) zaqala ngesikhathi ibopha uMnuz Katiso Molefe, ngoDisemba 6, 2024.UKhumalo usho lokhu izolo, ngesikhathi ethula ubufakazi bakhe ngaphambi kweKomiti lePhalamende eliphenya ngezinsolo zenkohlakalo emaphoyiseni. Uthe umbhidlango wokubopha uMolefe wawungelula, wathi kodwa ukucelwa kwabo ukuthi bafake isandla, kwaba yisinqumo esibalulekile. "Ukube asisondelanga eduze, ngiyakuqinisekisa ukuthi uKatiso Molefe ngabe akaboshiwe kuze kube inamhlanje,” kusho uKhumalo. Uthe babona ukuthi izinsiza kumbe amaphoyisa asendaweni (local resources) ayengeke akwazi ukubhekana nale ngcindezi ebhekene nePKTT, wathi bambopha ngempumelelo uMolefe yize babephazanyiswa izinhlaka ezehlukene zamaphoyisa. "Saba nesiqiniseko sokuthi amaphoyisa asezikhundleni eziphezulu asebenzisana nabasolwa, njengoba sase sigculisekile ngokuthi kukhona ukugxambukela kwawo embhidlangweni osemthethweni,” usho kanje.Uveze nokuthi ngesikhathi bembopha uMolefe kukhona umshayeli owaqhamuka maqede wababuza ukuthi bayazi yini ukuthi njengoba bembopha oMolefe, uwumngani nongqongqoshe? Uthe esigamekweni esenzeka ngezintambama ngosuku olufanayo, ngesikhathi sebesemzini kaCat Matlala, naye wakhala ngokuthi bayambambezela ngoba ubehlele umhlangano nongqongqoshe. Uthe umuzi kaMatlala bawusesha ngaphandle kwencwadi egunyaza lokho, ngoba sebethole ulwazi olubucayi lokuthi kunobufakazi obusengcupheni yokunyamalala uma benganyakazi ngokushesha. "Lolo lwazi lwalumayelana nokuthunjwa kukaJerry Boshoga. Ithimba laliphenya lelo cala,” kusho uKhumalo.Uthe ingaleso sikhathi okwatholakala ngaso ukuthi uMatlala akayigcinile imigomo ehambelana nokuphathwa kwezibhamu nokuyilapho okwathathwa khona izibhamu zakhe namaselula.
ITHI bebesendaweni engafanele ngesikhathi esingafanele, imindeni yabathathu okuthiwa badutshulwe bafa ngabantu abangaziwa oHlange, eNanda, ngoMgqibelo.Kulesi sigameko esenzeke esitolo sendawo, kushone ngesihluku uMnuz Sanele "Tonqo" Shezi (28), Mnuz Malibongwe Jele noMnuz Kwanele Nzuza (20). Kuthiwa badutshulwe amadoda amane, okuthiwa abonakale ethushuka esikhaleni, adedela inhlamvu, ase ebaleka engena emotweni ebiwalinde ebangeni elifishane. Isihlobo soyedwa wababulewe - esicele ukungadalulwa - sithe bezwe ngandlebenye ukuthi umuntu obefunwa ngowesilisa wendawo oshayela izimoto ezikhokhelwa ngebanga ezilihambile, ophume ngembobo yenaliti ngenkathi kudutshulwa."Yena udubuleke engalweni nasonyaweni kodwa wakwazi ukubaleka ephila. Kuthiwa wuye obefunwa ngabahlaseli,” kusho isihlobo.Sithe bezwe kuthiwa ngale ngokushayela lezi zimoto, lona wesilisa ubebuye azibandakanye ebugebengwini. "Sikholelwa ukuthi bekufunwa yena kahle hle njengoba kusabalale lawo mahlebezi endaweni kanti naye wavele wanyamalala emva kwesigameko,” usho kanje. Isihlobo sikaShezi - naso esicele ukungadalulwa - sithe ubephume ekhaya ethunywe unina ukuthi ayomshintshela imali esitolo."Ufike walibala njengoba efice uMalibongwe, awumngani naye. Kube yishwa ukuthi ngesikhathi sebethi bayahamba, kuvele kwaqhamuka amadoda amane angaziwa, adubula ebhekise kubo,” kusho isihlobo. Sikhale ngokuthi indawo yasoHlange nayo, njengezinye izindawo eziseNanda, yenganywe izehlakalo zobugebengu obuhlasimulisa igazi.Sithe bayafisa ukuthi babanjwe abenzi bobubi ukuze bezothola ubulungiswa ngokubulawa kwabafi. Kwenzeka lesi sigameko nje, amaphoyisa asanda kuqotha abasolwa abayisihlanu KwaBester, ngesikhathi kuba khona ukudubulana phakathi kwawo nabo. Emva kokuduma kwezulu lezandla, amaphoyisa athi uma esesesha indawo yesigameko, athola izibhamu ezine ezingekho emthethweni.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uColonel Robert Netshiunda uthe amaphoyisa aseNanda avule amacala okubulala amathathu nelilodwa lokuzama ukubulala.
BAKHALA ngothishanhloko abamsola ngokuba nenhliziyo eyitshe abazali babafundi baka-matric abakweleta imali yesikole eHillgrove Secondary, eNewlands West, bebanjelwa izitatimende zemiphumela.Laba bazali bathi izingane zabo ebezeqiwe yinjabulo ngoLwesibili ngenxa yokuphasa u-matric, zibuye esikoleni zidangele, zingazitholanga izitatimende zemiphumela yazo.Bathi zithe uthishanhloko uzitshele ukuthi ngeke zizinuke izitatimende, zingayikhokhile imali yesikole eziyikweletayo. Omunye wabazali, uNksz Nozipho Hlongwa, uthe ujanyelwe yingqondo njengoba ebuka ikusasa lendodakazi yakhe u-Olwami Hlongwane lilimala ngenxa yale nkinga."Ngiyazi ukuthi nginecala lokuthi ngikweleta imali yesikole kodwa ngiphatheka kabi uma ingane yami ingeke isakwazi ukuphuthumisa imiphumela yayo enyuvesi ukuze ithathwe ngenxa yokuthi mina angikwazanga ukukhokha imali yesikole,” kusho uNksz Hlongwa.Uthe okubuhlungu ukuthi ngoSepthemba nyakenye uthishanhloko uthathe uhla lwabazali abangakhokhile, waluyisa enkampanini eqoqa izikweletu ukuze imbaselele imali yesikole abangayikhokhile. "Nsuku zonke abale nkampani bayasifonela bafuna imali yesikole. Uthishanhloko wasitshela ukuthi ngalokhu amagama ethu azofakwa ohlwini lwabantu abahlulekayo ukukhokha izikweletu. Manje kubuhlungu ukuthi amagama ethu asehanjiswe lapho kodwa futhi ngapha, ubamba izitatimende zezingane zethu,” usho kanje.Uthe nakuba uthishanhloko ebehlale ebathumelela imiyalezo engapheli yokuthi imali yesikole iyafuneka, kodwa ubengazange wabaxwayisa ukuthi ukungakhokhi kwabo kuzoholela ekutheni izingane zabo zibanjelwe izitatimende. "Ngisho ngoMsombuluko, kuthunyelwa umyalezo wokuthi azivuke ngoLwesibili ziyolanda izitatimende izingane, akayiphathanga eyokuthi ezikweleta imali yesikole zizobuya zilambatha,” usho kanje. Uthe bafisa kudedelwe izitatimende zezingane zabo, ukuze zizoqhubeka nezinhlelo zokofunda ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme, ngesikhathi kutholwa enye indlela okungabhekwana nayo ngabo bengabazali abakweletayo. Echaza ngesakhe isikweletu uthe sisuka ku-2022, indodakazi yakhe ifunda uGrade 9. Uthe besilokhu sinezeleka isikweletu, ingane yakhe ifunda kabuhlungu."Ayilitholanga iriphothi lakwaGrade 9. KwaGrade 10 yaya ngoba uthisha wakwaGrade 9 wayitshela ukuthi iphasile. Ibilokhu iqhubeka kanjalo, yaze yafika kwaGrade 12,” kusho uNksz Hlongwa. Uthe singu-R8 000 sesiphelele isikweletu sakhe, wathi akazi uzosikhokha ngani njengoba alahlekelwa umsebenzi ngo-2020 ngesikhathi kugadla iCovid 19 kuleli. "Ngo-2021 ngakwazi ukuzama, ngasihlanganisa kodwa ngo-2022, kwanqaba isimo. Ngaze ngathutha eNewlands ngayohlala eLindelani ngenxa yoshintsho olwaluze neCovid 19,” usho kanje.Isolezwe liphinde laxhumana ngomunye umzali ocele ukungadalilwa, othe okwehlele laba bazali, kwamehlela naye ngo-2022, ingane yakhe iqede u-matric. "Wala waphetha nezitatimende zezingane nangalowo nyaka. Ngendlela okwakubuhlungu ngayo ngavele ngasidinda isililo esikoleni. Ngaze ngadatshukelwa omunye uthisha osewashona, wathi uzongintshontshela isitatimende sengane yami, asifothokhophe, anginike ikhophi,” kusho umzali.Uthe nakuba yenza unyaka wesine ingane yakhe enyuvesi kulo nyaka, ubonga lowo thisha, owaba nesihe embona ekhala, wamenzela ikhophi, ingane yakhe eyakwazi ukuqhubeka nezinhlelo zokubhalisa enyuvesi isebenzisa yona.Isolezwe lizamile ukufonela isikole esithintekayo kodwa lathola ukuthi ucingo lwaso seluvaliwe. UMnuz Mlungisi Mtshali woMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal uthe usazolubheka udaba bese eyaphendula.
LIYAVEVA ikomiti loMnyango weMfundo eyisiSekelo ePhalamende, ngezikhalo zabazali ngezikole ezibaphoqa ukuthi bathenge i-stationery bakhokhe nemali yesikole ekubeni kufundwa mahhala.Ikomiti lithe kwezinye izikole izigungu zezikole zigunyaza ukubanjwa kwemiphumela yabafundi ngoba bengakhokhile.USihlalo wekomiti uNksz Joy Maimela, uthe bathole inqwaba yezikhalo ngezikole ezenza okuphambene nomthetho ekubeni kufundwa mahhala kuzona."Izikole okufundwa mahhala okungakhokhwa kuzona imali yesikole, ziqale umkhuba omusha wokufuna i-stationery kubazali. Ezinye zifuna nemali ezithi eyomnikelo, okuphoqwa abazali ukuthi bayikhokhe ekubeni kufundwa mahhala. Lokhu kuthunaza ilungelo lengane," usho kanje izolo ekhuluma nabezindaba njengoba kuvulwe izikole kuleli sonto. Uthe uma kuthiwa abazali abakhiphe umnikelo kumele ungabi yimpoqo kodwa usuke enhliziyweni."Abafundi akumele bapanishwe ngokuthi abazali babo bahluleke wukukhokha umnikelo. Isimo semali kubazali asifani, ngakho akumele baphoqwe. Lezi ngezinye izinto esizozifaka uma sesihlangene nomnyango," usho kanje.Usho lokhu nje ezikoleni eziningi abafundi baphoqwa ukuthi balethe iphepha lokwenza amakhophi, elisetshenziswa yizikole umnyango olihambisayo ezikoleni. Abanye baletha ama-toilet paper, kuthiwe abakhokhe imali ukuze babhalise baphinde bathole i-stationery. UNksz Maimela uthe bayayilwa nendaba yokungafakwa ngesikhathi kwemali yezikole, eyaziwa ngama-norms and standards."Ziningi izikhalo mayelana nemali yezikole engafakwa ngesikhathi ezikoleni. Abanye bakhala ngokuthi ifakwa izikhawu, abanye bathi kanye, abanye bathi bagcina bengayitholi le mali. Sifuna ibuyekezwe indaba yayo, umnyango usichazele ukuthi ifakwa kanjani, noma uma kwenzenjani," usho kanje.Ihlale iyindaba egudwini eyale mali KwaZulu-Natal, njengoba izikole nezinyunyana zothisha zihlale zikhala ngokuthi ayifakiwe. Njengoba kuvulwe izikole esifundazweni le mali ayifakiwe ukuze izikole zikwazi ukuthenga izinsiza kusebenza. Le mali isiza ukuthenga i-stationery ezikoleni ezizithengela izincwadi, ikhokhela amanzi nogesi ezikoleni. Iphinde isize ekulungiseni izinto ezonakele ezikoleni.Ubuye wazwakalisa ukukhathazeka ngokubambezeleka ekuhanjisweni kwe-stationery ezikoleni.Kunezikole namanje esingakafiki i-stationery ngenxa yokuthi umnyango waphuza ukufaka i-oda nyakenye lokuthi sithengwe ngenxa yezinkinga zemali. Kunezikole ezivule ngaphandle kwalezi zinsiza kanti izincwadi azithengwangwa nhlobo ngoba imali kayikho.Uhlabe ikhwelo lokuthi umnyango kumele uhlele izinto kusenesikhathi ukuze kuhanjiswe i-stationery, kungaphazamiseki abafundi.
UNGQONGQOSHE weMfundo ePhakeme, uMnuz Buti Manamela, usenxuse abangazitholi izikhala zokufunda emanyuvesi ukuthi babheke kwezinye izikhungo kunokuthi bamane balahle ithemba badube nokufunda.UManamela ubagqugquzele ukuthi babheke nasemakolishi amakhono amaTVET nama-Community Education and Training Colleges, kuma-bridging course kanjalo nakuma-learnerships."Ngeke zanele izikhala zokufunda emanyuvesi ngenxa yokuthi baningi abaphase u-matric. Yingakho sithi abangathathwanga abangalilahli ithemba kodwa babheke nakwezinye izinhlelo," usho kanje. Usho lokhu nje, ngesikhathi kuhleli iPhalamende ngoLwesibili ebusuku, ilungu le-EFF uMnuz Sihle Lonzi, libuze uManamela ukuthi izikhungo zizokwazi ukwamukela bonke abafuna izikhala."Bebebhiyoza abaqede u-matric bejabulela ukuphasa bethi bayoqhuba izifundo zabo. Kungaba yihlazo ukuthi bagcine bonke bengasathathwa ezikhungweni zemfundo ngoba lokho kuyosho ukuthi bekuyizeleze ukujabula kwabo. Ngabe bazokwamukelwa bonke yini abaphase u-matric njengoba ababalelwa ku-130 000 bengeke babe nendawo yokufunda?"UManamela uthe noma bethanda ukubamukela bonke kodwa ngeke kwenzeke. Unxuse labo abafuna usizo ukuthi basebenzise uhlaka loMnyango, i-Central Application Service (CAS). Uveze ukuthi eminyakeni edlule bebesebenzisa i-Central Applications Clearing House (CACH), kulabo abebesuke bengazitholanga izikhala ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme."Kusuka kulo nyaka ngeke sisayisebenzisa i-CACH ngoba uMnyango usune-CAS ezoba nazo zonke izikhungo ezisanezikhala nemikhakha engagcwele ezikhungweni. Asifuni abafundi bagcine sebeya ezikhungweni ezingombombayi ngoba bazolahlekelwa yimali." Uveze nokuthi kunemifundaze ehlinzekwa ama-SETA engu-15 000 kulabo abangalutholanga uxhaso esikhwameni i-National Student Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS).Ubuye wahlaba ikhwelo kubazali nakubafundi ukuthi bathembe ulwazi oluvela ezinhlakeni ezingungqo, ukuze bangaqolwa osomathuba."Abalinde izimpendulo ababheke ama-emails, imiqhafazo kanjalo nemininingwane evela ezikhungweni zabo. Ngaso sonke isikhathi abagcine i-reference number," usho kanje.Babalelwa ku-927 000 ababhale u-matric nyakenye, kwaphasa abangu-760 000. Abangu-345 000 kulaba, baphase ngama-Bachelor. Izikhungo zemfundo ephakeme zizokwazi ukwamukela ababalelwa ku-230 000 kulo nyaka abazokwenza unyaka wokuqala. UManamela uthe abafundi abalinde imiyalezo ezosho ukuthi bathathiwe ngaphambi kokuya ezikhungweni."Ningayi ezikhungweni niyofuna izikhala ningayitholanga imiyalezo eshoyo ukuthi nithathiwe. Kanjalo nalabo abafake izicelo zendawo yokuhlala, bangayi uma bengakasitholi isiqinisekiso sokuthi bathathiwe ngoba bangazibona sebelala endle," usho kanje.Uthe izikhungo azibamukeli abazozifikela mathupha bezofuna izikhala.Abafuna usizo kwi-CAS bangaya kuWhatsApp Chat enombolweni ethi: 081 308 4196. BASABISA ngokuduba Impucuzeko Maskandi Festival abangeneme ngokuhoxa komsakazi woKhozi FM, uKhathide "Tshatha" Ngobe kule ndumezulu yomcimbi. Ukumemezela kukaTshatha ukuthi usethi khumu kulo mcimbi, akwehlanga kahle emabhinceni amaningi kangangoba amanye aze anxusa ngisho umdidiyeli wamabutho KwaMandlakazi nongumlingisi kwiShaka Ilembe, uNkosikhona "Phakelumthakathi" Ndabandaba, ukuba angenelele.Kukhona abalibeke ngembaba elokuthi bona bebeseka lo mcimbi ngenxa yalo msakazi wohlelo lwantambama ngakho bathe uma ehosha imfe kuwona, nabo bazowugabisela ngezithende. NgoMsombuluko, uTshatha umemezele ukuthi useyashiya kulo mcimbi emuva kweminyaka engaphezu kwamashumi amabili ewa evuka nawo kodwa wangayiveza imbangela. Yize uTshatha ephumele obala kulo nyaka kodwa abalandeli bese beqalile ukushaya amakhala ngobudlelwano balezi zinsizwa. Abasondelene nazo bathi kusukela ngoJulayi nyakenye, bese uqalile umfantu ebudlelwaneni babo kangangoba uTshatha akabonakalanga nangokhalo kulo mcimbi.Okuxakayo ukuthi uMcineka wabhala incwadi evulelekile encoma ukuzwana noTshatha. Waze wathi kwakungafanele bazwane ngoba basezinkolweni ezishayisanayo. Kucace bha okwenkukhu emhlophe ohlungwini ngesikhathi uMcineka eyonikela kubo kaKhuzani.UTshatha ufake isithombe enabantu abathathwa njengezitha zikaMcineka, uGeh Ngcobo noPapa G Gumede ezindlini zokusakaza oKhozini. Abanye babuye baqaphela ukuthi uMcineka ubengathi vu ngomcimbi ngeTshatha Music Festival.Nakuba kungacaci ukuthi lezi zinsizwa ziqhathwe yini kodwa kunamahlebezi athi uMcineka waba nesandla sokungafiki kweziqumama ngesikhathi umngani kaTshatha eyombesa ekhweni lakhe eNquthu. Kwakulindeleke ukuba omacaphunakusale bashaye indishi, okusho ukudlalwa kwemali okwenziwa ngabasuke behambele lo mcimbi. Ngalolo suku, uMcineka wayesemgcagcweni weNkosi yesizwe sakwaMpungose, uZakhe.Ezinye izimpukane eziluhlaza zisola ukuthi lezi zinsizwa zibanga imali. Selokhu ekhulume kanje, uTshatha kodwa uMcineka usawuhlabe inhlali. Akathi vu. Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kwakhe igcine iphunzile.Impucuzeko wumcimbi ongungqaphambili emculweni kamaskandi kangangoba waze wateketiswa ngeleWorld Cup yomaskanda. Abalandeli bebehlale beswenka ngemifaniswano emisha futhi iTheku belima nse ngosuku lweMpucuzeko. Nabaculi bebehlale beqhamuka nezinto ezintsha ebebesuke bedlisela ngazo ogageni izimbangi. Kungashona ilanga uma kungachazwa izigameko ebezenzeka esiteji.Abaningi bazokhumbula uKhuzani ekhahlela inja waze waziqhatha neSPCA, uDlubheke wangena esiteji nengulube ethi iyona inkosi yomaskandi. Indidane yilapho yavelela khona kangangoba yayiya kwiMpucuzeko ngisho ingaphathekile kahle emzimbeni. Kwake kwakhalwa ngocansi olwaluqhunyiswa ngabalandeli ezimotweni ngesikhathi zibuya esiteji.
UBUHOLI be-IFP buphika buma ngentaba ukuthi bathembisa umholi weNFP, uMnuz Ivan Barnes, isikhundla sobumeya kuMasipala waseZululand ngesikhathi kunezingxoxo zokubusa ngokubambisana esifundazweni iKwaZulu-Natal. Okhulumela i-IFP, uMnuz Mkhuleko Hlengwa, uthe kungamampunge ukuthi babambisa uBarnes udonga maqeda bamjikela uma sebethole isifundazwe. Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba eThekwini, izolo. Ubuholi beNFP busanda kuthatha isinqumo sokuhoxa kuhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal oholwa yi-IFP. Esinye sezizathu ezibekwa ubuholi beNFP ukuthi ubuholi be-IFP abuzange busigcine isithembiso sokuthi amaqembu azobambisana nakomasipala uma esebambisene esifundazweni. I-NFP yayifuna uBarnes anikezwe esobumeya eZululand. Ngaleso sikhathi yayingekho imeya kulo mkhandlu kulandela ukusula kukaMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, awayeseqokelwe kwesikaMphathiswa wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu. UHlengwa uvumile ukuthi abaholi beNFP bayikhuluma eyokubambisana eZululand, kodwa wathi ayikho into okwavunyelwana ngayo noma isethembiso esenziwa abaholi be-IFP. UHlengwa uthe izingxoxo zokuphathwa kukahulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal, zazingahlangene nokuphathwa komasipala. UHlengwa uthe abaholi beNFP baphinde babacela ukuba babakhulumele noMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ukuba abanikeze isikhundla kuzwelonke.I-NFP ayinaso isihlalo ePhalamende kodwa umthetho uyamvumela uMengameli ukuba engaqoka ongqongqoshe ababili abangesiwona amalungu ePhalamende. UHlengwa uthe naso lesi sicelo asizange siphumelele. UHlengwa ukuphikile ukuthi ukuxoxa nabaholi beNFP. UHlengwa uthe ubuholi be-IFP KwaZulu-Natal buyaqhubeka nokuba nezingxoxo nobuholi beNFP esifundazweni. "Akulona iqiniso ukuthi siphakeme, asifuni ukuxoxa neNFP. Ubuholi be-IFP KwaZulu-Natal buyaqhubeka nokuxoxa nobuholi beNFP KwaZulu-Natal. Ayikho into kufanele sixoxe nobuholi bukazwelonke. Kodwa ke asinankinga nokuxoxa nabo uma befuna ukukhuluma nathi."UHlengwa uthe uhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal usasebenza kahle.Uxwayise amaqembu ababambisene nawo ukuba angavumi ukudukiswa yiMKP."Inkinga esinayo la ukuthi iMKP iswele into ezoyenza. Angithi bona abayona ingxenye yohulumeni, ababhekene nomsebenzi wokuhambisa izidingo kubantu. Into ebahlalele nje ukuthi baphikise konke okwenziwa uhulumeni wesifundazwe. Nami ngingathuka uma bengase bayeke ukuphikisa izinto ezenziwa uhulumeni. Amaqembu esibambisene nawo kufanele aqaphele angadukiswa abantu abaswele into abazoyenza."UHlengwa uthe angeke bavume ukuthi isifundazwe siphathwe yiMKP. "Kuningi okungonakala uma isifundazwe singase siwele ezandleni zeMKP. Awucabange nje ngabe useshintshwe kangaki uNdunankulu ukube siphethwe yiMKP? Angazi bangaki onobhala jikelele asebexoshiwe kwiMKP. Abaholi baxoshwa njalo kwiMKP, umholi wayo kuphela ongakhishwa esikhundleni."
Amaphoyisa ayaphenya ngowesifazane oshone ngemuva kokumuka namanzi ngasemfuleni iWhite River endaweni yaseMsholozi, eMpumalanga.Ngokwemibiko, lesi sigameko senzeke ngezithuba zabo-21:00 ngesikhathi iqulu labantu lizama ukuwela umfudlana ngoLwesithathu mhla ka-14 kwephezulu. Abazibonele babikele amaphoyisa ukuthi umufi, u-Esther Amina Mathenjwa (44), ube ngowokuqala ukuwela ngesikhathi ethathwa wumoya onamandla. Eminye imininingwane iveze ukuthi umufi ubengumdayisi esikoleni sendawo eMsholozi. Ngesikhathi kwenzeka lesi sigameko ubephethe ibhakede lamagwinya awadayisa esikoleni.Kuthiwa ngesikhathi ewela umfudlana ibhakede lakhe limuke namanzi, ubezama ukulikhipha ngesikhathi emuka. Amalungu omphakathi ahlale ubusuku bonke ezama ukumthungatha, nokho, abaphumelelanga.NgoLwesine, ithimba lamaphoyisa angabatshuzi, lihlangene namalungu omphakathi, lathola isidumbu sikamufi cishe amakhilomitha amahlanu kusuka lapho amuke khona.
LUHLALE obala uqhekeko eqenjini elingababeki benkosi kuhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal, iNFP, amalungu eqembu angahambisani nesinqumo sokuhoxa kuhulumeni echapha ngenhlamba ephinde futhi efuna ukubamba ngezandla umholi weqembu, uMnuz Ivan Barnes.Lokhu kuhambisane nokuthi abanye abaholi beNFP baphumele obala batshela abezindaba ukuthi abahambisani nesinqumo sokuhoxa kuhulumeni wesifundazwe. Bucishe bachitheka bugayiwe eThekwini, kusuka isixakaxaka phakathi kwabaholi beqembu namalungu alo abezokweseka uMphathiswa wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi KwaZulu-Natal, uNksz Mbali Shinga, obizelwe phambi kwesigcawu sokuqondisa ubugwegwe. Kulanyulwe kukubi amalungu eqembu egibela uBarnes ngezinhlamba, emthembisa noswazi. Abeseka uNksz Shinga bebebambe umbhikisho eThekwini, ngaphandle kwalapho obekubanjelwe khona isigcawu sokuqondisa ubugwegwe. La malungu abecula izingoma ezithi awayifuni iMKP. Amalungu athe awasabuthembi ubuholi bukaBarnes.Ubuholi beNFP kuzwelonke bufuna iqembu libambisane neMKP kuhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal. Emva kwesixakaxaka, kube sekulandela isithangami nabezindaba ebesibizwe abaholi beqembu abangahambisani nesinqumo sokuhoxa kuhulumeni wesifundazwe. Obehola isithangami uSihlalo weNFP kuzwelonke, uMnuz Sibusiso Mkhabela. UMkhabela uthe abahambisani nesinqumo sokuhoxa kuhulumeni wesifundazwe. "Siwushayela ihlombe lo hulumeni okhona. Ubugebengu behlile. Isinqumo sikaNdunankulu sokufaka uMnyango wezokuPhepha ngaphansi kwehhovisi lakhe kwenze ukuba nocabanga ukwenza ubugebengu asabe. Asifune muntu ozophazamisa uhulumeni okhona. Izinqumo ezithathwe emakameleni asingeni kuzona. Thina sifuna ukuthi uhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal uqhubeke nokuhambisa izidingo kubantu."UMkhabela uthe abahambisani nesinqumo sokuba kuthathelwe uNksz Shinga izinyathelo zokuqondiswa ubugwegwe, wathi ubuholi beqembu kuzwelonke abunawo amandla okuthathela uNksz Shinga izinyathelo zokuqondiswa ubugwegwe."Asikaze silibone leli shobolo kuleli qembu selokhu lasungulwa uVZ. Sizokhuza lo mhlola. Namhlanje sizokhuza lo mhlola, sizowukhomba ngomunwe. Thina kwiNFP sazi ukuthi uma kunezinkinga siya lapha kwagogo, sikhulume. Aliphume lihambe leli shobolo."UMkhabela uthe isinqumo sokuhoxa kuhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal, kufanele sithathwe ubuholi beqembu esiShayamthetho."Ubuholi bukazwelonke kufanele bazi ukuthi kunezinhlaka zeqembu ezakhethwa ezingqungqutheleni. Lapha KwaZulu-Natal sinobuholi obakhethwa engqungqutheleni eyayiseNewcastle. Ubuholi bukazwelonke kufanele buhloniphe ubuholi besifundazwe. Ubuholi bukazwelonke akufanele bugxambukele ezindabeni ezithinta isifundazwe."UMkhabela uthe uBarnes kuzomele ashiye esikhundleni uma kuwukuthi sekumehlule ukuhola iqembu. "Besikwethemba, buyisela into yabantu kubantu ebafanele. Noma ngabe uyafuna uthi ufuna ukuphatha izwe, izwe aliphathwa ngokuphapha. Akuyona insangu ukuphatha izwe."UMkhabela ukhale ngokuthi uBarnes usekhohliwe iNFP, ubukeka esekhulumela kakhulu iMKP.Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kukaBarnes ayizange iphumelele njengoba ucingo lwakhe belukhala lungabanjwa.
ULieutenant General Dumisani Khumalo kulindeleke ukuthi ethule ubufakazi namuhla phambi kwekomidi lePhalamende eliphenya ngezinsolo zokungena ngobugebengu, inkohlakalo kanye nokugxambukela kwezombusazwe ohlelweni lwezobulungiswa.Ukuvela kwakhe kulandela ubufakazi obushaqisayo bowayeyibamba likaKhomishana wamaPhoyisa kuzwelonke uGeneral Khomotso Phahlane, oqinisekise izinsolo zetulo lokuvimba ukuqokwa kwakhe ngokugcwele.UPhahlane usola ukuthi umkhankaso wenkulumo-ze othinta abantu abazimele, ababeyizikhulu esiphoyiseni nezinhlaka zabezindaba ezasetshenziswa ukungcolisa igama lakhe nokuholele ekutheni amiswe emsebenzini. UPhahlane uphinde wenza izinsolo kuleli komidi ukuthi ngemuva kuka-2007, inqubo ebalulekile yokuqashwa emaphoyiseni ayisalandeli imigudu efanele yeKhabhinethi.
IZIGAMEKO zakamuva esiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal, ziphambene kakhulu nengqikithi yesikhathi sikaKhisimusi. Lesi yisikhathi sethemba, ukuthula, injabulo nothando, ikakhulukazi njengoba silungisa izinhliziyo zethu ukwamukela iNkosi Yokuthula. Ukuhlaselwa kukaSomlomo, uNontembeko Boyce, nodlame oluqhamuke esigungwini sesifundazwe kufanele kuzwele kuwo wonke umuntu ononembeza. Lolu dlame lwenzeke ezinsukwini ezimbalwa nje ngemuva kokuphela kwezinsuku eziyishumi nesithupha zokulwa nodlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane nezingane. Lo mkhankaso uhloselwe ukuvusa unembeza wethu sonke ngobubi bodlame olusabalele ezweni lethu. Akukuhle ukuthi kade simemezela ukuthi udlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane alwamukelekile, bese kuba khona umholi wesifazane ehlaselwa esikhungweni esihloselwe ukuvikela intando-yeningi, yethu uqobo. Inhloso kaNkulunkulu ngesintu ukubuyisana, ukubusa nobuholi obungenalo udlame kodwa okunobulungiswa nokulunga, ikakhulukazi kwabampofu, ababuthakathaka nabangenamandla. Nokho esikubonile esiShayamthetho sethu kube yikho kanye okuphambene nalo mbono. La obekufanele kube khona ukuhleleka, kube khona isiphithiphithi. La obekufanele kube khona inhlonipho nenqubo yentando yeningi nesithunzi somuntu, kube khona ukusetshenziswa kwamandla nokwesabisa. La obekufanele kube khona amandla okwamukela umphumela ngokuzithoba, kube khona ubuthakathaka obuphethe ngokuphendukela odlameni. Lokhu kubonakalisa ngokusobala ukuthi sisekude kangakanani nombuso wokuthula owabonwa ngu-Izaya uMphrofethi, nokuthi udlame selungene lwajula kangakanani - hhayi nje emakhaya nasezitaladini zethu - kodwa nasezindleleni zethu zokuxoxa ngezepolitiki nokuxazulula izingxabano. Lokhu kuphambana kujule kakhulu kunezepolitiki noma ubulungu bamaqembu. Kuveza inkinga enkulu yokomoya ezweni lethu, ukwehluleka okuyisisekelo ukubona umfanekiso kaNkulunkulu kumuntu ngamunye. Udlame - kunoma yisiphi isimo futhi lubhekiswe kunoma ngubani - luyisihluku esiqondene nesithunzi sobuntu uqobo. Futhi lapho lolu dlame lubhekiswe kwabesifazane, luba nesisindo esengeziwe ezweni lapho udlame olubhekiswe ebulilini selufinyelele ezingeni lobhubhane, lapho abesifazane nezingane behlala ngokwesaba nezibalo zokuhlukunyezwa nokubulawa kwabantu besifazane zisihlaza phambi komhlaba. Umlayezo kaKhisimusi ovela esethembisweni sika-Izaya (35:1), umisa isibindi labo abasekudingisweni, nabakwaziyo ukuthi kusho ukuthini ukuphila ezindaweni ezidicilela phansi isithunzi somuntu. Kubo umprofethi umemezela athi: "Kuyakuthokoza ihlane nendawo eyomileyo, kujabule ugwadule luqhakaze njengentebe.” Lesi akusona isithembiso senjabulo esiza kuphela ngemva kokuba siphumile ehlane. Kuyisithembiso sokuthi ihlane uqobo luyoguqulwa, ukuthi injabulo ingavela nasendaweni yosizi. Kodwa ukuguqulwa kudinga ukuphenduka kweqiniso, hhayi ukuzisola nje. UJohane uMbhabhadisi, ozwi lakhe liyagcizelela ngalesi sikhathi sokuza, lithi. "Ngakho-ke vezani izithelo ezifanele ukuphenduka” (Mathewu 3:8) Lokhu kusho okungaphezu kokuzizwa unecala noma ukuxolisa ngemva kwesikhathi. Kusho uguquko endleleni yokuziphatha, izindlela ezintsha zokudlelana nabanye nokuguqulwa okuyisisekelo kwendlela esiqonda ngayo futhi esisebenzisa ngayo amandla, nalapho kukhona khona ukungavumelani nokudumazeka. Njengezakhamuzi zaKwaZulu-Natal, kufanele sizibuze sithi: "Kusho ukuthini ukulungisa indlela yeNkosi Yokuthula esifundazweni sethu namuhla? Okokuqala nje; kusho ukuyenqaba indlela yodlame okuyindlela yokusetshenziswa kabi kwamandla, kunoma yiliphi izinga - emakhaya, kwezepolitiki, noma ezikhungweni."Kusho ukuliphila ivangeli esilishumayelayo nombuso wokuthula esiwumemezela ngezindebe zethu, emindenini yethu, nasemiphakathini yethu. Kusho ukuba yisibonelo esihle ezinganeni zethu ukuthi amandla awaboniswa ngodlame kodwa ngokwehlela ngezansi ngisho noma sizizwa siphatheke kabi noma sidumele. Kulesi sikhathi sikaKhisimusi, njengoba silindele ukuzalwa kweNkosi Yokuthula emhlabeni, masizibophezele ekwakheni lowo mbuso wokuthula, hhayi ngemikhuleko nezintshumayelo zethu kuphela kodwa nasezenzweni zethu zansuku zonke nasempilweni yethu yezepolitiki. Imizi yethu makube yizindawo zokuphepha. Izindawo zethu zokusebenza zibonise inhlonipho. Izikhungo zethu zezombusazwe zibonise ukuthi intando yeningi ingasebenza ngaphandle kwesiphithiphithi nokuthi singaphikisana ngaphandle kokuphendukela emandleni. UMfundisi Sizwe Ngcobo Ungumphathi webandla laseSheshi, St Agnes eKloof, kwiDayosisi yaseNatali, eyenganyelwe nguMbhishobhi uNkosinathi Ndwandwe
KUSOLWA umdonsiswano wokulawula izigidi zamarandi ngokuxoshwa kukamgcinimafa weMKP, uMnuz Mpiyakhe Limba.Kunamahlebezi okuthi uLimba ubesembangweni nabathile eqenjini wokulawula ukuphathwa kwezigidi zamarandi ezitholwa yiqembu.Kuthiwa labo abebebangisa uLimba bebemsola ngokuhluleka ukuphatha ngendlela imali yeqembu kanti naye uLimba kuthiwa ubenezinsolo zokuthi kukhona abaholi abehlisa ngemilenze imali yeqembu.Kuthiwa uLimba uxoshwe eseqoke ngisho inkampani ebizophenya ngokunyamalala kwemali yeqembu.ULimba ukhonjwe indlela ezinguqukweni ezimenyezelwe yiqembu ngoMsombuluko. Isikhundla sikaMgcinimafa sinikezwe owayeyisikhulu seTranset, uMnuz Brian Molefe.I-MKP ayizange isidalule isizathu sokuxosha uLimba kepha Isolezwe libone incwadi ebhalwe ngumholi weqembu, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, eveza izizathu zokuxoshwa kukaLimba.Kule ncwadi uZuma ukhale ngokusetshenziswa budedengu kwemali yeqembu athe kwenza ukuthi iqembu lisheshe liphelelwe yimali. Uphinde aveze ukuthi uLimba ubeseqoke inkampani ebizophenya izinsolo zokubhubhudlwa kwemali yeqembu nokuyinto uZuma athe iphambene nemithetho yeqembu.UZuma uthe ukuphathwa kwemali yeqembu indaba yangaphakathi okungafanele inekezwe inkampani yangaphandle.I-MKP iphinde yenza izinguquko ePhalamende, yadiliza esikhundleni usotswebhu, uNkk Colleen Makhubele. Kuqokwe uNkk Mmabatho Mokoena-Zondi ukuba abambe lesi sikhundla.UNkk Makhubele akaqali ukuxoshwa kulesi sikhundla njengoba eke waxoshwa ngonyaka owedlule kodwa wabuye wabuyiselwa esikhundleni ngokushesha.Ukuxoshwa kukaNkk Makhubele ngonyaka owedlule kwaholela ekumisweni komholi weqembu ePhalamende, uDkt John Hlophe, obhekene nophenyo lwangaphakathi. UHlophe wazidalela amazinyo abushelelezi ngokuthatha isinqumo sokudiliza uNkk Makhubele engamtshelanga uZuma.Abahlaziyi bezepolitiki bathe izinguquko ezenziwa kulandelana zenza ibukeke njengeqembu elingakakulungeli ukuphatha.USolwazi Musa Xulu uthe ukungahleleki kweMKP kukhombisa ngokusobala ukuthi leli qembu alikulungele ukuphatha.USolwazi Sipho Seepe uthe okubi ukuthi iMKP ikhombisa ukungahleleki ngesikhathi esibi lapho kubhekwe okhethweni.Umhlaziyi wezepolitiki ozimele, uMnuz Thabani Khumalo, uthe kubukeka sengathi iMKP isikhohliwe ukuthi kungani abantu bavotela yona okhethweni olwedlule."Abantu abavotelanga iMKP ngoba nakhu bethanda imigomo yabo kodwa bayivotela ngoba nakhu sebekhathele amaqembu akhona."Okhulumela iMKP, uMnuz Nhlamulo Ndhlela, uthe basazoqhubeka nokwenza izinguquko.UNdhlela uthe kwiMKP akekho umuntu onesikhundla esingunaphakade.
INDODAKAZI yomsakazi woKhozi FM, uKhathide "Tshatha" Ngobe, ephase u-matric ngo-A ababili, ifakazele isisho esithi ukuhlehla kwenqama akusho ukubaleka kodwa isuke iyolanda amandla kulandela ukubuyela kuGrade 11 kade ingenzanga kahle ngokudlule.UTshatha usakaza yedwa uhlelo iWoza Nabangani Bakho ngo-3 kuya ku-6 ntambama phakathi nesonto.Utshele leli phephandaba ukuthi bayaziqhenya ngendodakazi yakhe u-Amahle Gcabashe, ebiza isibongo sasekhaya konina. Uthe u-Amahle, obefunda ePhambili High, eThekwini, uthole o-A kwiLife Orientation neTourism waphasa ngeBachelor's Pass."Isijabulisile kakhulu ingane mfowethu," kusho uTshatha ngokukhulu ukuziqhenya."Empeleni ubesewuphinda ngoba akaphasanga kahle ngokwedlule. Wayeseqala phansi njengoba esesebenza kahle kangaka nje. Siyaziqhenya kakhulu ngokuzimisela kwakhe nangokungadikibali ngenkathi engaphasanga kahle, qede wayoqala phansi kuGrade 11 wayesebuya ngamandla." Uthe usacabanga ukuthi uzomenzelani ukumjabulisa.Omunye usaziwayo, uNonku Williams wodumo lohlelo iReal Housewives of Durban uveze ukuziqhenya kwakhe ngokuphasa kwendodakazi yakhe uNothile.UNothile, uyindodakazi yomculi wokholo ongasekho uS'fiso Ncwane, uthole u-A ababili waphumelela ngeBachelor's Pass."Lonke udumo luya kuNkulunkulu. Ngaye, konke kuyenzeka. Ukweluswa Nguye kwenze lolu hambo lwaba luhle," kubhala uNonku.
IZETHENJWA zikaMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa zisembangweni wokuhola i-ANC esifundazweni i-Eastern Cape.UNobhala we-ANC esifundazweni, uMnuz Lulama Ngcukaitobi, angase aphonsele inselelo uNdunankulu wase-Eastern Cape, uMnuz Oscar Mabuyane, emjahweni wokuhola i-ANC esifundazweni. UNgcukaitobi noMabuyane baziwa ngokweseka uRamaphosa.Ingqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi besifundazwe izokuba ngoMashi.UMabuyane ufuna ukubuya ihlandla lesithathu kanti kukhona abanxenxa uNgcukaitobi ukuba angenele umbango wesikhundla. UNgcukaitobi uthe usezwile ngomkhankaso wokuba angenele umbango wesikhundla sikasihlalo we-ANC esifundazweni."Ngiyazi ngomkhankaso futhi kukhona abantu asebeke bakhuluma nami benginxenxa ukuthi ngingenele umbango wesikhundla. Angifuna ukuyinaka kakhulu indaba yabantu abakhuluma ngombango wezikhundla ngoba simatasa kakhulu, silungiselela ingqungquthela ezokuba ngo-Mashi."UNgcukaitobi uthe uma enganikezwa ithuba engabeka eqhulwini udaba lokulungiswa kwengqalasizinda."Udaba lokulungiswa kwengqalasizinda luhamba phambili lapha e-Eastern Cape, ilona engingaqala ngalo."Ukungenela kukaNgcukaitobi umbango wesikhundla kungase kube nomthelela embangweni wezikhundla engqungqutheleni ye-ANC kazwelonke ezokuba ngonyaka ozayo.UMabuyane kukholakala ukuthi uzophinde azame ukungenela umbango wesikhundla engqungqutheleni yangonyaka ozayo. Engqungqutheleni yokukhetha ubuholi be-ANC kuzwelonke yango-2022, uMabuyane wazama ukungenela umbango wesikhundla sephini likamengameli, kukholakala ukuthi uzophinde azame inhlanhla embangweni walesi sikhundla nangonyaka ozayo.Angase aye engqungqutheleni yangonyaka ozayo exhugela uMabuyane uma engahlulwa kweyase-Eastern Cape.
I-NFP isifana nenyama yohlobo lwekhethelo emaqenjini abusa ngokubambisana KwaZulu-Natal nakulawo afuna ukuphatha isifundazwe. Ubuholi beNFP buzobamba imihlangano namaqembu amathathu ngoMgqibelo, lapho kuzokhulunywa khona ngekusasa lokuphathwa kwesifundazwe.Amaqembu amabili azohlangana neNFP ngoMgqibelo, akuhulumeni wokubambisana, bese kuthi elinye lona kube yiqembu elifuna ukuphatha isifundazwe. Iqembu lesithathu elicele umhlangano ebuholi beNFP yi-DA.Ubuholi be-DA KwaZulu-Natal bubhalele ubuholi beNFP bucela umhlangano lapho kuzodingidwa khona ezithinta ukuphathwa kwesifundazwe.Incwadi ye-DA ingena nje, ubuholi beNFP busanda kuthola izincwadi eziqhamuka emaqenjini iMKP ne-ANC, nawo anesicelo esifana nese-DA.I-NFP ingababeki benkosi kuhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal futhi isanda kuthatha isinqumo sokuhoxa kuhulumeni wokubambisana, nokuvulela iMKP intuba yokuba ithathe izintambo zoMbuso.Ubuholi beNFP busole amaqembu aphethe ngokubambisana ngokwehluleka ukubusa isifundazwe, bukhala nangenkohlakalo.Encwadini ebonwe yiSolezwe, ubuholi be-DA KwaZulu-Natal buthe bufisa ukuba ubuholi beNFP buchaze kabanzi ngalezi zikhalazo.USihlalo we-DA KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Dean Macpherson, uthe umhlangano uzobanika ithuba elikahle ukuba baxoxe kabanzi ngalezi zikhalazo."Singahlangana noma ingasiphi isikhathi enizosiqoka."UMacpherson uthe udaba lokubuswa kwesifundazwe lubalulekile kakhulu. "Sesike sabambisana namaqembu amaningi ehlukene komasipala, ezifundazweni nakuzwelonke. Ingakho sikuqonda ukuthi kubalulekile ukuthi abaholi bamaqembu abambisene bunikane ithuba lokuxoxa uma kunezinkinga, buphinde buxazulule izinkinga. Siyazi ukuthi onke amaqembu abusa ngokubambisana kuneqhaza okufanele alibambe kulesi sikhathi esikuso. I-NFP ngelinye lamaqembu esibambisene nawo kuhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal futhi sisebenzisana kahle."UNobhala Jikelele weNFP obambile, uMnuz Sunset Xaba, uthe bazohlangana nabaholi be-DA, MKP ne-ANC ngoMgqibelo."Bengingakabaphenduli abaholi be-DA ngenxa yokuba matasa kodwa nabo sizobabona ngoMgqibelo."Iqembu elihola uhulumeni wesifundazwe, i-IFP, lizokuba nesithangami nabezindaba namhlanje, lapho lizokhuluma khona ngokuhoxa kweNFP kuhulumeni wesifundazwe.Khonamanjalo: Luzoqhubeka namhlanje uhlelo lokuqondisa ubugwegwe uMphathiswa wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi KwaZulu-Natal, uNksz Mbali Shinga.Ubuholi beNFP babizela uNksz Shinga phambi kwekomiti lokuqondisa ubugwegwe emva kokuba ashaya indiva umyalelo weqembu wokuba aseke isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli.
KUZOBANJWA uxhaxha lwemicimbi eyandulela uMkhosi waseSandlwana wakulo nyaka.Imicimbi eyandulela uMkhosi waseSandlwana izoqala kuleli sonto ize iyophela emva komkhosi ozobanjelwa eNquthu, ngoJanuwari 22.Imicimbi eyandulela uMkhosi waseSandlwana izobanjelwa ezifundeni iKing Cetshwayo, Zululand, bese iphothulwa esiFundeni uMzinyathi.Lemicimbi imenyezelwe okhulumela iSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini, uMntwana uThulani kaGqikazi Zulu, kanye nomasipala abathintekayo.Imicimbi izoqala esifundeni iKing Cetshwayo.Isitatimende esikhishwe umkhandlu siveze ukuthi imicimbi izoqala ngoLwesine. Ngalolu suku kuzoyiwa eSikhaleni seNkosi, ePort Durnford.Lapha kulapho iSilo uCetshwayo saphumela khona ngesikhathi sigibela umkhumbi, silibhekisa kwelamaNgisi siyisiboshwa.UMntwana uThulani uthe ngalolu suku bazokube bexoxa okwenzeka ngosuku okwaboshwa ngalo iSilo sasoNdini."Bazokhumbula abanye ukuthi kwathi uma iNkosi isifakiwe emkhunjini, umkhumbi wangavuma ukuduma. Bathi uma bebheka ochwepheshe ukuthi kungani umkhumbi ungavumi ukuduma, yathi iNkosi ingoba ayibikanga. Babengayikholwa, babuza ukuthi izobikaphi njengoba noLundi base belushisile. Kwenzeka isimanga ngoba bathi uma beyidedela ngempela iNkosi ukuba iyobika, ngempela umkhumbi waduma yase iyiswa eCape Town. Siyokube sikhuluma lokho."UMntwana uThulani uthe bazokube sebedlulela emzini weSilo oseShowe, kwaGqikazi, lapho okwaphangalela khona iSilo uCetshwayo."Sizofike sihloniphe lapho, sibe nokuhuba. Azokube ekhona amabutho, inyosi yeSilo kanye namakhosi."Kuyokube sekudlulelwa eShowe, eFort Nonqayi, lapho kuzokuba khona nesifundo ngempilo yeSilo sasoNdini.NgoLwesihlanu, kuzoyiwa edlinzeni likaJininindi omnyama eliseNkandla."Sizokuba nomkhuleko ngoba siyazi ukuthi njengoba siya emkhosini omkhulu kangaka kufuneka sibe nomkhuleko."UMntwana uThulani uthe ngomhlaka-19, iSilo sizokhipha ibutho laseZululand, elizolibhekisa eSandlwana, bese kuqala umlindelo."UMasipala waseMzinyathi uthe kuzokuba nemidlalo eminingi ezokuba khona ezodlalwa ngisho amaButho."Kothi ngomhlaka 20 ibutho lizokube seliseSandlwana, likhempile. Ngangomhlaka 21 ibutho lizokube likhempile. Kanti ngawo umhlaka 21 lapha eShiyane, siyazi ukuthi kunomlando ongemuhle lapho athi amabutho esenqobile eSandlwana, afike ahlulwa."UMntwana uThulani uthe ngomhlaka 22 kuzokuba usuku lomkhosi lapho kulindeleke ukuthi iSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini sethule inkulumo yosuku.UMasipala wesiFunda uMzinyathi uthe imicimbi izoze ivalwe ngomhlaka-23."ERorkes Drift, yilapho kuzobekwa izimbali emalibeni amabutho kaZulu nawamaNgisi aguqa kule mpi ka-1879."
IMELIKA ingase ivuselele isivumelwano esizohlomulisa iNingizimu Afrika kanye namanye amazwe asezwenikazi i-Afrika esaziwa nge-African Growth and Opportunity Act (Agoa).Indlu yabaholi baseMelika iphasise isiphakamiso sokuthi kululwe isivumelwano se-Agoa ngeminyaka emithathu.Amalungu endlu angu-340 avotele isiphakamiso sokuba kuvuselelwe isivumelwano, kwathi angu-54 aphikisana nokuvuselelwa kwaso.Manje sekusele kwisiShayamthetho saseMelika, i-Senate, ukuba siphasise isivumelwano esisha.Isivumelwano se-Agoa saphela ngoSepthemba, kanti isivumelwano esisha sona sizophela ngo-2028.I-Agoa ivumela impahla esuka emazweni ase-Afrika eyiswa eMelika, ukuba ingakhokhi intela.Bekunongabazane ngokuvuselelwa kwesivumelwano kusukela kwangena uMengameli waseMelika, uMnuz Donald Trump.Ngaphansi kobuholi bukaTrump, uhulumeni waseMelika usanda kunyusa intela ekhokhwa yizinkampani zasemazweni ase-Afrika ngezimpahla ezithunyelwa eMelika.Yize emaningi amathuba okuthi isivumelwano sizovuselelwa, iNingizimu Afrika ibambe umoya.Kukhona abaholi baseMelika abafuna ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika ishiywe ngaphandle esivumelwaneni esisha.INingizimu Afrika ibilokhu ihlomula kulesi sivumelwane eminyakeni engu-25 eyedlule kodwa kubukeka sengathi izinto zizoshintsha manje.INingizimu Afrika inyamanambana ebuholi bukaTrump.Ubuholi bukaTrump busola uhulumeni wakuleli ngokuhlukumeza amaBhunu, uphinde ukhale ngesinqumo sikahulumeni wakuleli sokumangalela izwe elisondelene neMelika, i-Israel, eNkantolo yaMazwe oMhlaba.Okunye okuqhatha iNingizimu Afrika neMelika ubudlelwano bayo namazwe abhekene ngeziqu zamehlo neMelika, iRussia, China, India ne-Iran.I-Iran isanda kuthatha isinqumo sokuhoxa emibukisweni yemikhumbi yezempi kuleli.I-Iran ihoxe ngemizuzu yokugcina ngenxa yezinsongo zeMelika, ebisabisa ngokuthathela iNingizimu Afrika izinyathelo ezinqala uma iqhubeka nokuvumelana ne-Iran ukuba ibambe iqhaza.
Ziyashukana eqenjini elingababeki beNkosi kuhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal, iNFP. Amalungu eNFP azwelana noMphathiswa wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi KwaZulu-Natal, uNksz Mbali Shinga, ayabhikisha ngaphandle kwendawo okubanjelwe kuyo isigcawu sokumqondisa ubugwegwe.Isigcawu sokuqondisa uNksz Shinga ubugwegwe sibanjelwe eThekwini. Amalungu eqembu anganelisekile afuna kumiswe isigcawu, athi uNksz Shinga uboshelwa amanqina enyathi.UNksz Shinga wabizelwa phambi kwesigcawu sokuqondisa ubugwegwe emva kokuba eshaye indiva umyalelo weqembu wokuba aseke isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukandunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli. Khonamanjalo olunye uhlangothi olungahambisani nesinqumo sokushushiswa kukaNksz Shinga, kanye nabanye abaholi beqembu abangamakhansela, luzokuba nesithangami nabezindaba, namhlanje. Isithangami sizoholwa usihlalo weqembu kuzwelonke, uMnuz Sibusiso Mkhabela, oyimeya yoMasipala waseDumbe.
BAZOTHOLA ithuba lokubuka amaphepha abawabhalile noma bamakelwe kabusha abangeneme ngemiphumela yabo ka-matric.NgokoMnyango wezeMfundo eyisiSekelo, abangazibonanga emaphephandabeni abaye ezikhungweni abebebhalela kuzona izivivinyo ukuze bathole izitatimende zemiphumela.Imiphumela yabo bazokwazi nokuyithola kwi-website yoMnyango kusuka ngo-6 ekuseni namhlanje. UNgqongqoshe woMnyango weMfundo eyisiSekelo, uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, umemezele izinga lokuphasa lika-matric lango-2025, emcimbini obuyizolo ebusuku.Kwabangaphumelelanga, uke wakuveza ukuthi kuzobe kungekhona ukuphela komhlaba njengoba benezinhlelo zokubasiza."Abanezikhalazo ngemiphumela yabo bangacela ukuthi kwenziwe uphenyo, lokhu kumele bakwenze zingakapheli izinsuku ezingu-13 kukhishwe imiphumela. Sinxusa abathole izitatimende zabo ukuthi baqikelele ukuthi amagama nenombolo kamazisi kuyikhona ukuze bafake isicelo sokuthi balungiselwe uma kube nephutha. Bangakwenza lokhu ungakashayi uFebhuwari 20, 2026," kusho uMnyango. UMnyango uveze ukuthi ngemuva kwesitatimende, kunemininingwane enalo lonke ulwazi kulabo abafuna ukuphinde bamakelwe kabusha."Abafuna ukuphinde bamakelwe bafaka isicelo esikhungweni ababhalele kusona noma emahhovisi ezifunda zoMnyango. Kuvulwa namhlanje kuze kuvalwe ngoJanuwari 27, 2026. Kubiza u-R120 ukuphinde umakelwe kabusha, ukubheka iphepha olibhalile kubiza u-R30," kusho uMnyango.UMnyango uveze ukuthi izokhishwa ngoMashi 13, 2026, imiphumela yalabo abafake izicelo zokumakelwa kabusha. Ubalule nokuthi labo abafeyilile bangakwazi ukufaka izicelo zokuthi baphinde babhale ngoMeyi/Juni nonyaka."Kuvalwa ngoFebhuwari 6, 2026, ukufaka isicelo sokubhala izivivinyo zokuchibiyela. Abebengekho ngesikhathi kubhalwa izivivinyo nyakenye ngoba kwakunesifo, noma bengaphilile bangakwazi ukuphinde babhale ngoJuni. Kanjalo nalabo abafuna ukuphucula imiphumela yabo bazothola ithuba lokuphinde babhale," kubeka uMnyango.Okunye okuvezwe nguMnyango ukuthi labo abasabanjelwe imiphumela yabo ngenxa yokuthi kuphenywa ukubandakanyeka kwabo ekukopeleni, banganikwa ithuba lokuthi baphinde uma kungukuthi seluphothuliwe lolu phenyo.
INyuvesi yaKwaZulu-Natali (UKZN) ihalalisela Ikilasi likaMatric lika-2025 ngempumelelo yalo futhi libheke ngabomvu ukwamukela izitshudeni ezintsha ezithathwe kuleli klasi ngonyaka wezefundo ka-2026.INyuvesi incoma izinkulungwane zabafundi, othisha, abazali kanye nabanakekeli ezweni lonkana ngokuzibophezela kwabo nomzamo wabo kube nomthelela ezingeni eliphezulu lokuphasa ku-matric likazwelonke elirekhodiwe kuze kube manje. Siyaziqhenya kakhulu ngempumelelo yesifundazwe sakithi futhi sihalalisela iKwaZulu-Natal ngokufinyelela izinga eliphezulu lokuphasa umatikuletsheni kuzwelonke.Njengoba imiphumela ka-matric isikhishwe ngokusemthethweni, i-UKZN izoqala ukukhipha izaziso ze-SMS mayelana nezicelo eziqinisekisiwe zabathole izikhala kusasa ekuseni (ngoLwesithathu, 14 January). Imilayezo yabathole izikhala izokhishwa ngokwezigaba ezahlukene ezinsukwini ezizayo kuze kube yilapho sezigcwaliswe zonke izikhala ezingu-9 124 zabafundi abaqala ngqa ukungena ngaphansi kweziqu zabo.Abafakizicelo abazothola le milayezo, banikezwe isikhathi esingamahora angama-72 (izinsuku ezintathu) ukuba bazamukele ngokusemthethweni. Abazohluleka ukuzamukela ngalesi sikhathi, zizobhuntsha izikhala zabo zinikezwe abanye abafundi. Ngakho-ke abafakizicelo bayakhuthazwa ukuthi baqaphe imilayezo yabo ngokucophelela futhi baphendule ngesikhathi esinqunyiwe.
ZIZOVULWA kumapeketwane ezinye zezikole KwaZulu-Natal, ezingenaso i-stationery kanjalo nemali eqhamuka eMnyangweni wezeMfundo esifundazweni, eyaziwa ngama-norms and standards.Lokhu kwenze inyunyana yothisha iSadtu yanquma ukuya enkantolo ukuze iphoqe uMnyango wezeMfundo nokaMgcinimafa ukuthi ihlinzeke izikole ngezinsiza. Le nkinga isiyenze abanye othishanhloko ezikoleni okungakhokhwa nhlobo kuzona imali yesikole, baphula umthetho ngokuthi banxenxe abazali ukuthi bakhokhe umnikelo wemali, baphinde bathenge ne-stationery ukuze izikole zikwazi ukusebenza ngenxa yokuthi kubheda uhlelo eMnyangweni.UNobhala weSadtu esifundazweni, uNksz Nomarashiya Caluza, uthe baya enkantolo ngoba bafuna kube nesinqumo esizophoqa uMnyango ukuthi ubeke phambili izikole. Ekhuluma nothishanhloko beSadtu enkundleni iFacebook ngoMgqibelo ebusuku, uthe abafuni ukungena emgwaqweni njengoba behlale benza ngoba bawina impi yesikhashana."Siyazi bebesilindele ukuthi ngoba kuqala unyaka sizobhikisha njengoba sihlale senza, sikhale ngokuthi ayifakiwe imali yezikole kanjalo nokungabi khona kwezincwadi zokufunda nokunye. Kodwa manje sinqume ukuthi siqhamuke ngelinye igiya ukuze kube nesinqumo esizophoqa uMnyango ukuthi uhloniphe umyalelo wenkantolo," kusho uNksz Caluza.Uchazele othishanhloko ukuthi emhlanganweni ababe nawo nezikhulu zoMnyango, zikuvezile ukuthi ayifakiwe imali yama-norms and standards. Uthe uMnyango kaMgcinimafa uphuzile ukugunyaza uMnyango wezeMfundo, ukuthi uthenge i-stationery ezikoleni ezithengelwa nguMnyango."Kujwayele ukuthi i-stationery nezincwadi zithengwe ngoMeyi, kodwa nyakenye kuze kwathengwa ngo-Okthoba. Kwakhona kuthengwa i-stationery kuphela, azikho izincwadi ngenxa yokuthi ayikho imali. Yingakho sikule nhlekelele esibhekene nayo yokuthi i-stationery yima sisahanjiswa ezikoleni eziningi," usho kanje.Uthe cishe zibalelwa ku-1 900 izikole ezisathole i-stationery, kwasona esingaphelele."Zingu-3 700 izikole ezithengelwa nguMnyango i-stationery, ezingu-1 400 azikasitholi nhlobo ngokwezibalo esizinikwe yizikhulu zoMnyango ngempelasonto. Izikhulu zoMnyango ziveze ukuthi kwezinye izikole kuyoze kushaye inyanga ezayo kusahanjiswa izincwadi. Hambani nitshele abazali ukuthi sikule nkinga nje, nguMnyango kaMgcinimafa esifundazweni, okuyiwo okushaywa kuwona indesheni ukuze uMnyango wezeMfundo ukwazi ukuthenga izinsiza," usho kanje. Uthe ezikoleni ezizithengela izincwadi ne-stationery, ayifakiwe imali yama-norms ukuze zikwazi ukuthenga lezi zinsiza."Kahle kahle kunenhlekelele eKZN. Zizovulwa ngezinkinga izikole. Yekani ukwenza icala ngokuthi nithi abazali abathenge izinsiza ekubeni isikole singakhokhisi imali yokufunda," kusho uNksz Caluza.Othishanhloko bebesina bededelana, bethi njengoba kuvulwa izikole ngoLwesithathu, abazi bazothini kubazali."Kumele sibe nemihlangano nabazali sinike nabafundi i-stationery. Sizobanikani njengoba singafikile? Ayikho imali yokubhusha ezikoleni, ayifakiwe. UMnyango usakweleta abanye osonkontileka abasiza bathenga izincwadi ngemali yabo ngonyaka odlule, namanje abakakhokhelwa," kusho othishanhloko. Baveze ukuthi sebethuka izanya ngoba bajahwa omashonisa kanjalo nosonkontileka ababakweletayo."Sizimisele nokuya emgwaqweni uma kungukuthi uhlelo lwasenkantolo luhamba kancane. Sikhathele ukuphatha izikole ngemali yethu." Bakhale nangokuthi uMnyango uyihlaba inhlali, awuchazeli umphakathi ngezinselelo onazo, uqhatha bona nabazali.Njalo uma zivela emakomitini asesiShayamthetho, uMphathiswa woMnyango uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka neNhloko yoMnyango uMnuz Nathi Ngcobo, bahlale bekhala ngesimo semali ababhekene naso nokuthi i-stationery sizophuza ukufika ezikoleni ngoba siphuzwe ukuthengwa.Isolezwe lithole nokuthi kwankampani esabalalisa lezi zincwadi, ayikhokhelwe. Kuvela lokhu nje ngesonto eledlule, uMnyango ubuqinisekise ukuthi kuzovulwa izinsiza sezikhona ezikoleni kepha osekuhlaluka ukuthi bekungelona iqiniso.
UKUFANISA nesibusiso okumehlele umfundi waseVelangaye Secondary eNkandla, uMboniseni Nkomonde (19), ophumelele ngamalengiso u-matric wakhe, ekubeni eke wagula wahlala unyaka wonke ekhaya engafundi.UMboniseni waseNhlungwane, oLundi, uthe ngo-2024 kwadingeka ukuthi ayeke isikole emuva kwamasonto amabili eqale u-matric, ngenxa yokugula.Uthe kwadingeka awuhlale ekhaya wonke u-2024 egula waze waba ngcono, wabuyela esikoleni ngo-2025."Angazi ukuthi ngingathini ngoba ngaphambi kokugula, ngangiphasa nje njengabo bonke abafundi. Ngibona ukuthi ngibuyele nyakanye ku-matric umqondo wami usuthe thuthu. Ngisebenze kanzima kanti ngiyazazi ukuthi ngifunani," usho kanje. UMboniseni ungomunye wabafundi abahlonishwe yizikhulu zoMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, emcimbini ose-Inkosi Albert Luthuli Convention Centre (ICC) eThekwini, ngokwenza kahle kuleli banga."Abazali bami abangatohozi, yibona abanquma ukuthi ngiyofunda eNkandla ngenxa yokwenza kahle kweVelangaye. Ngisizwa abafowethu ngemali, kwabona babamba amatoho siphinde siphile ngemali yesibonelelo sikahulumeni njengoba abazali bengasebenzi. Ngibonga kakhulu kubafowethu nakubazali ngokungeseka ezifundweni zami." Ubenza izifundo isiZulu, English, Life Orientation, Maths, Physical Science, Life Sciences, Mechanical Technology ne-Engineering Graphics and Design (EGD)."Ngifuna ukwenza i-Mechanical Engineering eNyuvesi yaKwaZulu-Natal. Okwamanje angikathathwa njengoba bengisalinde imiphumela yami," usho kanje.UMboniseni ongowesine ezinganeni zakwabo, uthe uthanda ukudlala ibhola kanjalo ne-volley ball.Esikoleni unconywa ngokwenza kahle kwi-EGD nakwi-Mechanical Technology. Uqale ukufunda eVelangaye eyokwenza uGrade 8."Ngihlose ukuvula inkampani yami, ngiqashe abantu ngakhe amathuba emisebenzi. Ngifuna ukusiza ekhaya uma sengisebenza ngiphinde ngibe wusizo nasemphakathini."
ABELULEKI bezengqondo sebephose inselelo kubazali nasemphakathini ukuthi bakubeke emahlombe abo ukuzwela nokuqinisa abafundi abebenza u-matric nyakenye, abazothola ukuthi akubahambelanga kahle uma sekuphuma imiphumela yabo namhlanje ekuseni.Omunye wabeluleki bezengqondo ozimele, uNkk Tholinhlanhla Dlamini-Ngcoya, uthe lesi kuba yisikhathi esinzima kakhulu kubafundi njengoba basuke bebhekene nengcindezi yokuthatha bebeka futhi bekhathazeke ngokuthi abazi ukuthi impilo izoqhubeka kanjani."Ngakho abazali nomphakathi jikelele kumele bagqugquzele izingane ukuthi zilungise lapho ozokube kungahamba kahle khona, hhayi ukuthi baqale phansi bazisole ngokuthi kungani zingenzaka kahle ezifundweni ezithile ezenze ukuthi zifeyile. Okunye futhi abazali okumele bakuqaphele futhi bakwamukele wukuthi akuwona wonke umntwana ozokhula aphumelele ngemfundo ngakho kungasiza kakhulu futhi ukuthi izingane zilekelelwe ukuthi zilandele amakhono nemisebenzi yezandla ezikwazi ukuyenza,” kucebisa uNkk Dlamini-Ngcoya. Eqhuba, uthe okunye okusiza kakhulu ngalesi sikhathi wukuthi abantwana balulekwe ngokomqondo ukuze basheshe basamukele isimo ababhekene naso, okuzokwenza ukuthi bakwazi ukuqhubeka nempilo yabo ngokushesha futhi balungise lapho okubhimbe khona.UMnuz Siyabonga Ntshangase, naye ongumeluleki wezengqondo ozimele, yena uthe labo okungezukubahambela kahle kumele babuke lesi simo ngokuthi asiqali ngabo nanokuthi baqonde ukuthi ukuphoxeka kuyingxenye yempilo ukuze bengezukugqilazeka kakhulu."Ukusheshe uzitshele lokho kusiza ukuthi ukwamukela kungabi lukhuni kakhulu nanokuthi uma uzizwa ucindezelekile ngenxa yesimo obhekene naso, kuyasiza kakhulu ukuthi ungafeli ngaphakathi kepha ubhoboke ebantwini obathembayo noma uxhumane nabe-Sadag ngoba bona baqeqeshelwe ukusiza ezimweni ezinje,” kusho uNtshangase. UNkk Noxolo Mahlaba ongumeluleki wezengqondo ozimele, yena ugcizelele kakhulu ubumqoka bokungafeli ngaphakathi, athi kusiza ukwehlisa umthwalo uma uzizwa sengathi umthwalo obhekene nawo usumkhulu futhi ungaphezu kwamandla akho."Lesi yisimo sesikhashana okungamele ukuthi sibe nomthelela omkhulu kakhulu empilweni yakho ngakho kungasiza ukuthi usebenzise sona ukufunda okuningi ngawe uqobo nokuthi yikuphi ongakwazanga ukukwenza kahle - bese wakhela phezu kwakho ukwenza kahle nakangcono kakhulu, kubhekwe phambili ngoba uzobe usuwazi kahle ukuthi yikuphi okumele ukwenze ngendlela ehlukile ukuqhubeka nempilo yakho,” kusho uNkk Mahlaba.Udonse abazali nomphakathi ngendlebe ukuthi uma sekuphume imiphumela yabafundi, bengalokhu bebaxina ngemibuzo eminingi engenza ukuthi bazizwe becindezelekile kepha ababeseke kuleso naleso simo ababhekene naso.
UBHEKE ukuthi izethulo zocwaningo alwenzile ziphonsele uhulumeni inselelo yokuphuthumisa uhlelo lokuphucula ingqalasizinda yasemalokishini, ukuze abantu bakhona ikakhulukazi osomabhizinisi abasafufusa bathole ithuba lokuchuma, benze nomehluko emiphakathini.Lowo wuDkt Kholekile Ntsobi, osanda kuphothula ucwaningo lwakhe lwezifundo zobudokotela olusihloko sithi Developing An Intervention Framework, To Accelerate Key Programs For Economic Growth In South African Townships: A Study of Hammarsdale, aluphothule eDa Vince Insitute, eGoli nyakenye.Elandisa ngalokhu, uDkt Ntsobi odabuka eDutywa, e-Eastern Cape, kodwa osezinze eThekwini, uthe umcabango walolu cwaningo wamfikela ngo-2019 esanda kuthenga umhlaba ayefuna ukwakha kuwona elokishini iHammarsdale, entshonalanga yeTheku, lapho afike wavuleka amehlo khona ngezinselelo ezibhekene nabantu elokishini."Ngafika khona kwahlaluka ngokuphelele ukuthi enye yezinto ezenza abantu basemalokishini bame ndawonye empilweni wukuswela izinsizakusebenza nengqalasizinda efanele ukuze bakwazi ukwenza izinto abafuna ukuchuma ngazo empilweni, okwenza kube lula ukuthi balahle ithemba empilweni ngoba bebona kungalungi abakuzamayo. "Enye into ebingikhathaza wukubona osomabhizinisi baselokishini bethwala kanzima bezama ukusimamisa amabhizinisi abo ngenxa yokuthi kunzima ukuthi baxhaseke noma basekwe emizamweni yabo yansuku zonke. Ngabona kukuhle ukuthi kube khona engikwenzayo ukucwaninga ngamasu angasiza kukho konke lokho,” kulanda uNtsobi.Uthe lolu cwaningo lumthathe cishe iminyaka emihlanu ukulwenza aluphothule. Wakhuluma nabantu abangaphezu kuka-200 eqoqa ulwazi ngalo. Wayegxile kakhulu ekutholeni ukuthi ubuholi bomphakathi, izinhlaka zohulumeni nomphakathi kungabambisana kanjani ukuthuthukisa ingqalasizinda yomphakathi, nokusiza ngezinhlelo zamathuba okulekelela abantu basemalokishini ikakhulu osomabhizinisi bachume ngokuhle abakwenzayo."Ngithemba ukuthi lokhu kuzofaka ingcindezi ebuholini bohulumeni emazingeni ehlukene ikakhulu abasemakhaya ukuthi baphuthumise izinhlelo ezinjalo ukuze kusizakale umphakathi, futhi kuphucuzeke inhlalo nesimo sasemalokishini,” kusho yena.Ngale kwalokho, uDkt Ntsobi uneziqu ze-Diploma in Emergency Care ne-BTech in Emergency Care kwase-University of Johannesburg, kube yi-BTech in Education Post-School yase-University of South Africa, i-Master’s in Public Administration and Governance yaseNorth West University ne-Master’s in Business Administration yaseMancosa.
UKUBEKEZELA nokusebenza kanzima yikhona okusize ongqeqe abamele iKwaZulu-Natal kuzwelonke, baphasa u-matric ngamalengiso.Labo ngqeqe bahlonishwe nguNgqongqoshe weMfundo eyisiSekelo, uNksz Siviwe Gwarube izolo ebusuku emcimbini wokumemezela imiphumela ka-matric 2025, eGoli.Bagile izimanga emikhakheni ehlukene kanti babonge ukwesekwa yimindeni yabo kanjalo nothisha ngendlela abaphase ngayo. U-Asanda Ndlela (17) waseMasibumbane High, oLundi, uthe ukubekezela yikhona okumsebenzele kakhulu njengoba enze kahle.Uthe udabuka eMondlo kanti waya kofunda kulesi sikole ngenxa yokuthi senza kahle kakhulu ku-matric."Umndeni wami ubungigqugquzela ukuthi ngenze kahle ku-matric. Ngifuna ukwenza iziqu zobunjiniyela ngoba ngibukela kubabekazi wami obengigqugquzela," usho kanje. Phakathi kwezifundo abezenza kukhona iTechnical Maths neScience, EGD, Mechanical Technology, isiZulu, Life Orientation nezinye.Uthe ufuna ukwenza iziqu zeMechanical Engineering enyuvesi i-UJ.U-Olwethu Dladla (18) waseTugela Secondary, eMandeni okwabahlonishwe nguNksz Gwarube, uthe ufuna ukusiza umphakathi aqhamuka kuwona KwaHlomendlini, uma esephothule iziqu zakhe. Ubonge uyise owamgqugquzela esemncane ngokuthi athande imfundo."Ubaba waqala ukusigqugquzela ekhaya ngisafunda enkulisa. Wayehlale ekubeka ukubaluleka kwemfundo nokubekezela uma wenza into. Namhlanje ngiyajabula ngokwenza kahle ezifundweni zami." Uthe ufuna ukwenza iziqu ze-Actuarial Science enyuvesi yaseKapa."Ngithembele esikhwameni iNSFAS ngoxhaso lwemali yokufunda. Nakhona angingabazi ukuthi ngizokwenza kahle." Ubenza iMaths, isiZulu, English, Life Orientation, iSayensi, Geography neLife Science.USimesihle Khuzwayo (17) obefunda eKing Bhekuzulu High, KwaNongoma, uhambe emazwini okubekezela athe kumsize ekutheni enze kahle ku-matric.Uthe ufuna ukwenza iziqu zobudokotela e-UCT kanti usenawo umfundaze ozomqhuba."Ngiwumuntu okuthandayo ukufunda. Bengisebenzisa izindlela ezehlukene ukufunda okubandakanya nokubuka ama-video kwi-YouTube. Bengisebenzisa namaphepha amadala ka-matric," usho kanje. Unxuse abafundi ukuthi bafunde ngoba ayikho into eza kalula.USimesihle waKwaNongoma, uthe unina noyise kanjalo nothisha bakhe yibona abebemgqugquzela ukuthi afunde.Ezifundweni abezenza kubalwa ne-Agricultural Sciences, Maths, Economics nezinye.Namhlanje uzohlonishwa nasemcimbini womnyango oseThekwini ngokwenza kahle ku-matric.
USALE nemibuzo umndeni wowesifazane waseNgisana, Dundee, okuthiwa ubulawe yisoka lakhe kubo kwayo intombi, kuthiwa belicikwa wukuthi ubedansa into engapheli ekubeni isoka selifuna ukuba bahambe beyolala.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi uNksz Nomasonto Buthelezi (40) udutshulwe wafa yisoka lakhe (57) elingeke lize lidalulwe lingakaveli enkantolo. Lesi sigameko okuthiwa sishiye umphakathi ushaqekile, senzeke ngoJanuwari 3. Lo wesifazane kade efihlwa ngoMgqibelo.Owomndeni kamufi, uMnuz Sibusiso Buthelezi, uthe basakhungathekile kakhulu ngokwenziwe ngusbali wabo phambi kwabo.Uthe usbali ubekade efikile ezovakasha kubo kwentombi kumnandi kudelile kushiswa nenyama, wathi kuthe sekuhwalele usbali wabe esetshela umufi ukuthi mabahambe manje bayolala ngoba sekuhlwile. ''Umufi uphendule ngokuthi ngeke yena aze aye kolala okwamanje, usazijabulisa ngokudansa. Lo wesilisa ongowaseMtubatuba, uthulile wase eya endlini, watshela umufi ukuthi kulungile uzobona ngaye ke uma esebuya eze kuyena ekameleni,'' usho kanjena.Ngokusho kwakhe, kudlule isikhashana nje, wabuya usbali engasadle nkobe zamuntu, wabuza umufi ukuthi kungani kanti yena engasaqedi ukudansa ukuze kuzolalwa kusanesikhathi?Uthe ngesikhathi ebuza lokhu umsolwa ubesephethe isibhamu ngesandla, wangachitha sikhathi wamane wadubula amahlandla amathathu.''Le nto uyenze kubo kwentombi, akanahloni futhi uyenza sonke sikhona siyabuka. Nathi usibulale siphila. Asikaze thina siyibone into enjengalena ukuthi umuntu angabulala intombi phambi kwabantu bakubo kunguyena ovakashile nokwenza?'' usho kanjena.Eqhuba uthe abazange bapholise maseko babe sebemphuthumisa esibhedlela umufi okuyilapo okufike kwamenela khona. ''Sivele saphelelwa ngamandla sesizwa ukuthi ufike esibhedlela washona. Namanje akuvumi ukuthi siyikholwe le nto esiyibone yenzeka kuleli gceke lakithi, into embi. Okubuhlungu ukuthi le nto yenziwe ngumuntu ebesingacabangi nje nhlobo ukuthi ngelinye ilanga angase enze into efana nalena,'' usho kanjena.Uveze ukuthi abantu nomphakathi badinwe bagana unwabu bangabuza nyaka, bamane bamngenela ngenduku umsolwa walimala kabi."Kuyimanje usesibhedlela sakhona eDundee. Isimo sakhe sibi kodwa uqashwe ngamaphoyisa ukuze uma ephaphama ezoboshwa ngenxa yento embi enesihluku ayenze kubuka wonke umuntu futhi wakhombisa ukungabi nandaba nje nakancane ngalokhu,'' kusho uButhelezi.Eqhuba uthe le nto ibahlukumezile kakhulu njengomndeni, akuvumi nokuthi bakholwe ukuthi yenzeke ngempela into enjengalena phambi kwamehlo abo.''Asazi ngempela ukuthi le nto yenzeke kanjani. Esikwaziyo nje kunye ukuthi ibuhlungu into esiyibuke yenzeka ngomuntu wasekhaya ebulawa engenacala futhi kungekho nokubi esingakukhomba sonke sithi nakhu ngempela ukwenzile,” echaza.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uCaptain Ntathu Ndlovu, usiqinisekisile lesi sigameko. Uthe amaphoyisa aseDundee, aphenya icala lokubulala elenzeke esigodini saseNgisana, eDundee.''Ngesikhathi amaphoyisa efika endaweni yesigameko atshelwe ukuthi kunabantu ababili asebephuthunyiswe esibhedlela okungumuntu wesilisa kanye nowesifazane abalimele kabi,'' kusho yena.Uthe kuvela ukuthi kube nengxabano enkulu ebe khona phakathi kwalaba okuyiyona egcine iwumnyombo walesi simo esingesihle. ''Kuvela ukuthi ngesikhathi salesi sigameko kuze kwaphoqa ukuthi kugcine sekungenelela amalungu omphakathi okuholele ekutheni owesilisa agcine eselimala kabi. Kulindeleke ukuthi umsolwa avele enkantolo uma eseluleme ngokugcwele,'' usho kanjena.Ikhansela le-IFP kule ndawo, uMnuz Xolani Msezane, lizwakalise okukhulu ukushaqeka ngalesi simo. Lithe badangele kakhulu ngokuzwa ngesehlakalo esifuze lesi kule ndawo. Lithe balishumayela njalo kule ndawo ivangeli lokunakekelwa kwabantu besifazane nezingane kodwa noma kunjalo kukhona amadoda anesibindi esikhulu kangaka sokubulala ngesihluku umuntu wesifazane embulalela into engekho futhi engezwakali nje nhlobo.

KUSIZE isangoma esihlabe umkhosi ngowesilisa ositshele ngokufa kwentombazane ebidukile, efuna ukugezwa ngenkani, maqede atholakala ngempela amathambo ayo emhosheni ePhezukomkhono, eMbumbulu, ngoLwesine.UNhlalwenhle Magwaza (7) okwabikwa ukuthi waduka ebuya esitolo sendawo ngoNovemba 23, 2025, amathambo akhe atholwe emhosheni obonakalayo uma umi egcekeni kubo ngoLwesine. Lokhu kuze emva kokuthi isihlobo sakhe esiwumsolwa, sinikele esangomeni ekuqaleni kwesonto eledlule, siyofuna ukugezwa sisuswe amathunzi, sikhala ngokungalali ngenxa yokuhlushwa nguyena. Ngokusho kwesihlobo, esicele ukungadalulwa, unina kamufi uthole ucingo emaphoyiseni ngoLwesine. "Amyalele ukuba ehle aye emhosheni namalungu omndeni ambalwa ngoba ingane isitholakele,” kusho isihlobo. Sithe ngesikhathi befika lapho abebebizelwe khona, bakhangwe esisodwa sezicathulo, umufi anyamalala ezigqokile. Siveze ukuthi babe sebekhonjiswa amathambo abengasenazicubu."Abecakazeke yonke indawo. Ikhanda lile, izingalo, izimbambo nemilenze, kule nale. Kubukeka sengathi yagencwa ingane,” kusho isihlobo esithe basazolinda imiphumela yokuhlolwa kwawo, ukuze baphenduleke ukuthi ingane yabulawa kanjani.Siveze ukuthi bathole ukuthi umsolwa abahlobene naye ngokozalo lomndeni ohlala endaweni, unikele esangomeni. "Kuthiwa ufike wasikhiphela ummese, wasiyalela ukuthi simgeze ngenkani ngoba usekhathele yena ukuhlushwa umufi,” kusho isihlobo. Sithe yilapho egonyuluke khona ngokuthi isidumbu sikamufi sisemhosheni. Siveze ukuthi isangoma, yize besisabela impilo yaso, sehlulekile ukuthula nodaba, saluxoxela umndeni ogcine usuxhumana noyise kamsolwa."Kuhlangane imindeni, satshelwa ukuthi ngeke sikwazi ukuthula nento engaka, asihambe siyoyibika emaphoyiseni, kwaba libhoboka kanjalo ke ithumbu,” sisho kanje.Sithe umndeni usamangele ngakho konke okwenzekile. Saveza ukuthi nakuba etholakele amathambo kamufi lapho obekukhombe khona umsolwa, uqhubekile nokuphika ukuthi nguye owambulala umufi. "Kuningi okusididayo, asikholwa ukuthi akathinteki futhi asikholwa ukuthi konke lokhu ukwenze eyedwa. Sinomuzwa wokuthi bakhona abanye abebambisene nabo,” kusho isihlobo.Sithe lokhu bakusho ngoba kukhona ebebenza izinto ezingaqondakali emphakathini, abanye babo, bebafonela besho izinto ezikhombisa ukuthi lukhona ulwazi abanalo ngokunyamalala kwengane."Sifisa aqhubeke nengonyuluka yakhe, abakhiphe bonke asebenzisane nabo, bese ethola isijeziso esimfanele ngoba akumfanele ukuba semphakathini,” sisho kanje. Sithe okunye okudidayo ukuthi uma usekhaya kubo kamufi, kuyabonakala emhosheni okutholwe kuwo amathambo, sathi lokhu kusho ukuthi babezobona uma kukhona umuntu oshona khona nomufi."Sisola ukuthi waya khona eseyolahla izinsalela zakhe, akambulalelanga khona futhi sisola ukuthi wamlahla khona emva kwesikhathi eside ngoba amaphoyisa ayehamba nezinja, acinga nangakhona kodwa angathola kutho, okusho ukuthi wayengakabekwa,” kusho isihlobo.Sichaze umsolwa njengomuntu onesibindi, obengakwenza ukuthi ambulale ngesihluku umufi. Sikhumbule isigameko lapho abulala khona ngesando izinja ezaziwuhlupho emphakathini, zidla izinkukhu. Nokho sithe basadidekile ngokuthi yini edale ukuthi abulale umufi ngoba ubengenanxa nomndeni wakhe, sathi ungomunye wabantu ebebehlala bahlale bakhulume ngokunyamalala kukamufi ngendlela engaqondakali.Police comment…
UQOPHE umlando uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uqwaqwada eminye imiNyango yezeMfundo kuzwelonke emiphumelweni ka-matric yango-2025.Lesi sifundazwe silale endaweni yokuqala, saqopha umlando sithola ngaphezu kuka-90%. Lesi sifundazwe senze kahle kakhulu phezu kwezinselelo esibhekene nazo zemali.Ememezela imiphumela yalo nyaka ka-matric, uNgqongqoshe wezeMfundo eyisiSekelo, uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, emcimbini obuseGauteng, uncome iKZN ngokushaya amakhanda ezinye izifundazwe. Uthe lesi sifundazwe senze kahle phezu kwezinselelo ezikhona.Uveze ukuthi lesi sifundazwe sithole u-90.6%, okusho ukuthi silale endaweni yokuqala, sashaya ezinye izifundazwe. Nyakenye iKZN yalala endaweni yesibili ka-matric ngo-89.5%. I-Free State yiyona eyayilele endaweni yokuqala ngo-91.0%. I-Gauteng yona yayilele endaweni yesithathu.Ukunyuka kwezinga lokuphasa kubuyise ithemba kulesi sifundazwe esibhekene nezinselelo zemali. Kunongabazane ukuthi izikole zizovulwa ngempumelelo eKZN ngenxa yezingqinamba ezibhekene noMnyango wokungayifaki imali yezikole ukuze zikwazi ukuthenga izincwadi zokufunda ne-stationery. Kwalezo zikole ezihanjiselwa nguMnyango i-stationery, asikafiki sonke ngenxa yokuthi siphuzile ukuthengwa ngenxa yokuthi imali kayisho.UMphathiswa woMnyango esifundazweni, uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka, uhlale ekuveza ukukhathazeka kwakhe ngenkinga ebhekene noMnyango yezeziMali.Nyakenye kuze kwehla uNksz Gwarube nomqondisi jikelele, uMnuz Mathanzima Mweli, ukuzama ukuzolungisa isimo esithinta imali eMnyangweni.Isifaniswa nenhlekelele eyokungabi namali koMnyango njengoba osonkontileka bengakhokhelwa ngesikhathi esifundazweni. ISadtu esifundazweni iya ngisho enkantolo ifuna kuphoqwe uMnyango wezeMfundo nokaMgcinimafa, ukuthi ikhokhele izikole.UHlomuka ubehleli emile ekutheni yize kunezinselelo kodwa kumele linyuke izinga lokuphasa kwabafundi. I-KZN iphinde inconywe ngokukhiqiza inqwaba yabafundi abaphasa ngamaBachelor kunabaphasa ngamaDiploma ka-matric.
