UMENGAMELI wezwe uMnuz Cryil Ramaphosa usezwakalise ukukhathazeka kwakhe ngesibalo esiphezulu sabantu abangasebenzi ezweni, adalule nokuthi siyamqwashisa - senze angakwazi nokulala ubuthongo ngenxa yokukhathazeka kwakhe ngaso.URamaphosa usho njalo ekhuluma esithangamini nabezindaba ebesiseRusternburg, eNorth West phakathi naleli sonto, nebesiyingxenye yamalungiselelo omgumbo weminyaka ewu-114 kwasungulwa iqembu lezepolitiki aliholayo i-African National Congress (ANC).Enkulumweni yakhe uvumile ukuthi izwe libhekene nezinselelo eziningi zansuku zonke nezidinga ukulungiswa kubalwa inkinga yokudlanga kobugebengu, ukuphangwa kombuso, nezinye izinselelo ezikhona - kepha ubeke phambili eyokusweleka kwamathuba omsebenzi ngokuthi iyona nselelo enkulu izwe elibhekene nayo okwamanje."Leyo yinkinga esihlukumezayo sonke ezweni neyenza ukuthi singakhululeki, kangangokuthi kwanami uqobo yenza ngingakwazi nokulala ebusuku - ngilwa namasu okuthola isixazululo sokuyinqoba,” usho kanje. Inkulumo kaRamaphosa iza emva kwezinsukwana kusuke umsindo ngenkulumo kasihlalo we-ANC uMnuz Gwede Mantashe, osole abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ngokuba ngamavila afuna ukwenzelwa yonke into wuhulumeni.UMantashe ukhale ngokuthi abantu bakhonze ukuhlala phansi dekle, bese belindela ukuthi uhulumeni ubenzele yonke into, ubalethele lapho bekhona."I-ANC ininikile udobo lokuzizamela ukudla, manje nina senifuna nokuthi inilethele iznhlanzi ezobe isinidobele zona. Mina sengineminyaka engaphezu kuka-70 manje, kodwa angikaze ngifune umsebenzi nakanye, kunalokho ngilapha engikhona manje ngenxa yokuthi uhulumeni wethu uyasebenza, inkinga nje ekhona wukuthi abantu balindele ukuthi ubafunele imisebenzi abangazixaki nakancane ngokuzifunela yona ngokwabo,” kusho uMantashe.UMengameli uthe inkinga yendlala yamathuba omsebenzi idinga ukuthi kuthathwe izinyathelo ngokushesha, futhi kubanjiswane nezinhlaka zohulumeni ezahlukene ukuyinqoba."Kade ngikhuluma nanoNgqongqoshe woMnyango wezeziMali uMnuz Enoch Godongwana, ngamtshela ukuthi sidinga ukufaka imali eningi ekutheni kwakhiwe amathuba emisebenzi azosiza abantu abasha ezweni lethu, nokuthi ekwenzeni kwethu lokhu kumele sibambisane nezinhlaka ezizimele ukuze kufezeke kahle,” kusho uRamaphosa.Ugcizelele ukuthi likhulu iqhaza okumele libanjwe yizinkampani nezinhlaka ezizimele, njengoba kuyizona ezilawula u-75% womnotho wezwe, ngakho kuningi ezingakwenza ukuze kutholakale isixazululo kule ngwadla yenkinga ebhekene nezwe.Uthe nakuba kuwumsebenzi wohulumeni ukulungisa izinkinga ezifuze lena, kepha futhi wukubambisana nezinhlaka ezizimele okungasiza ukuphuthumisa usizo nezixazululo.
Abafundi abayisishiyagalombili base-KZN bebephakathi nontanga yabo bezinye izifundazwe njengoba behlonishwe ngesidlo sasekuseni esiyisipesheli, uNgqongqoshe wezeMfundo eyisiSekelo, uSiviwe Gwarube, kulungiselelwa ukukhishwa kwemiphumela yokuhlolwa kuka-matric.Phakathi kwabafundi abenze kahle eKZN abahlonishiwe kubalwa uSimesihle Khuzwayo waseBhekuzulu High School, eZululand, u-Amahle Ngidi wase-St. Martin, noThobane Shezi ofunda KwaThintwa School for the Deaf.Kuphinde kwahlonishwa noNonduduzo Mkhize waseFulton School for the Deaf, Olwethu Dladla waseTugela Secondary School, Asanda Ndlela waseMasibumbane High School, Ethan Naicker wasePort Shepstone Secondary, noSenamile Tabate waseMathubesizwe Secondary School.
UNGQONGQOSHE wezeMfundo eyisiSekelo uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, usencome abafundi basezikoleni ezidonsa kanzima, wathi minyaka yonke benza kahle.Uthe lezi zikole ezingo-Quintile 1 kuya ku-3, zihlale zikhiqiza iziqengqe zabafundi ungqongqoshe abahlonipha ngokwenza kahle."Nisebenze kanzima, nivuka ekuseni niphinde nilale ebusuku nifunda. Niyibambe kushisa kwaze kwaba sekugcineni. Namhlanje nidla izithelo zokusebenza kanzima," kusho uNksz Gwarube.Ukusho lokhu esidlweni sasekuseni nabafundi abenze kahle ka-matric, emcimbini obuseGoli. Uncome nabafundi abaphila nokukhubazeka, athe benza kahle kakhulu nakuba bebhekene nobunzima."Siyabancoma kakhulu nabafundi abaphila nokukhubazeka ngoba bayithemba elikhulu kuthina. Noma bedonsa kanzima kodwa bayakwazi ukudabula ezifundweni zabo," usho kanje.Ubonge nabazali abaseka abafundi ezifundweni zabo."Nenze okukhulu, nadela konke ukweseka izingane zenu. Benizigqugquzela ukuthi zifunde. Nihlale nabo ngesikhathi benokhwantalala lezivivinyo. Siyabonga ngomsebenzi omuhle eniwenzayo." UNdunankulu waseGauteng, uMnuz Panyaza Lesufi, uthe kumele kufakwe imali ethe xaxa kwezemfundo."Ezemfundo nezempiilo yiyona minyango okumele ithole imali ethe xaxa esabelweni mali. Abaphathiswa beminyango uma bethula isabelomali kumina, ngilinda ukuzwa kwezemfundo ukuthi kunamalini ngoba yizona eziyikusasa lesizwe," usho kanje.UNksz Gwarube unxuse abafundi ukuthi bangakhethi kuphela amanyuvesi."Wakhetheni namakolishi amakhono, ningawashalazeli niye emanyuvesi. Zikhona izikhala emkhakheni wemfundo ephekeme," usho kanje.Uthe siyakhula nesibalo sabafundi ababhala u-matric minyaka yonke.
I-Independent Examinations Board (IEB) imemezele izinga lokuphasa lilonke elingu-98.31% ezivivinyweni zeNational Senior Certificate zango-2025.Izinga lokuphasa neminye imininingwane ikhishwe ngoMsombuluko. Bonke abafundi bafanelekele ukuqhubeka nezifundo zabo.Imiphumela imi kanje:89.12% uphumelele ukwenza iziqu ezingama-degree, uma kuqhathaniswa no-89.37% ka2024.7.83% uphumelele ukwenza i-diploma, uma kuqhathaniswa no-7.56% ka-2024.1.34% uphumelele ukwenza i-Higher Certificate, uma kuqhathaniswa no-1.53% ka-2024. Ephawula ngokwehla kancane kwezinga lokuphasa lifinyelele ku-98.31% lisuka ku-98.47% ngo-2024, u-Confidence Dikgole, i-CEO ye-IEB, uthe: "Njengoba i-IEB iqhubeka nokukhula - ukwamukela izikole ezintsha, ukwanda ngokwezindawo, kanye nokuhlola iqoqo elikhulu nelihluke kakhulu ngokwezibalo ezibhekiwe ngokwezibalo zamazwe ngamazwe - kokubili okulindeleke ukuthi kuphasiswe ngokwezibalo ezincane. Izinhlelo zokuhlola ezizinzile Okubalulekile ukuthi izinga lokusebenza lihlale liphezulu, nokuyinto egcinwayo, futhi ukufinyelela ezifundweni zeziqu kuhlala kuphezulu.”Imiphumela yezifundazwe imi kanje:1.Kwazulu Natal- 99,98% 2. Free state-98,99% 3.Eastern Cape- 89,99% 4.North West- 97,77% 5.Gauteng-80,09% 6.Mpumalanga- 80,07% 7.Northern Cape-80.07% 8.Limpompo-80.02% 9.Western Cape-79.99%
Abafundi baseNingizimu Afrika abaphumelele u-matric ngo-2025 banqobe izinselele zabo ukuze bathole indawo phakathi kwabaphumelele kakhulu esizweni.UNgqongqoshe wezeMfundo eyisiSekelo, uSiviwe Gwarube, ukhulume esidlweni sasekuseni sikangqongqoshe nabafundi abaphumelele u-matric abangu-40 ngaphambi kokukhishwa ngokusemthethweni kwemiphumela ngoMsombuluko kusihlwa.Omunye wabafundi abaphumelele ekilasini lika-2025, uNgazibini Ntungwa wase-Eastern Cape, utshele i-IOL ukuthi ubengalindele ukuthi aqokwe phakathi kwabafundi abangu-40 abahamba phambili kuzwelonke.Nokho, uthe ukulahlekelwa uyise esemncane nokukhulela ekhaya elinomzali oyedwa kwamkhuthaza ukuba asebenzise imfundo ukuze aguqule isimo somndeni wakhe.Ufunde eSikhoba Nombewu Technical Senior Secondary School."Ngangingalindele ukuthi ngizofakwa ohlwini lwabangu-40 ngoba ngibe nobunzima ngesikhathi ngibhala izivivinyo zami. Ngangigula ngaleso sikhathi, ngakho ngishaqekile... ngiyabonga ngokuthi ngikwazile ukulwa nakho futhi ngisebenze kanzima ukuze ngibe lapha," kusho yena.Omunye ophumelele, uThabo Mathake, 18, ophuma emakhaya aseBurgersfort, eLimpopo, ubefunda eLeolo Technical High School, uthe uyazethemba ngomsebenzi wakhe."Ngijabule ngokudla isidlo sasekuseni nongqongqoshe ngoba ngiyazi ukuthi ngenze kahle. Ngisebenze kanzima unyaka wonke," esho.
Amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal akhiphe isitatimende eveza ukuthi asebophe owesilisa osolwa ngokushaya ephindelela intombi yakhe.Lesi sitatimende samaphoyisa silandela umsindo omkhulu osuke ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ngemuva kokuthi umgilwa, ongusomabhizinisi osemncane uSnenhlanhla Nenezana Mthembu enekele izwe lonke ubuhlungu abhekene nabo ngaphansi kwesandla sesoka lakhe. Kulawa manyundululu avezwe yile ntokazi, yizithombe ezihlasimulisa umzimba ezibonisa ukulimala kwakhe ngenxa yokushaywa kanzima. Okunye okuthuse abaningi wukuthi le ntokazi ifake nobufakazi bezinombolo zamacala ake wawavula phambilini ewavulela isoka leli elimshayayo, kodwa wonke lawo macala abuya nemilayezo wokuthi asevaliwe umsolwa engakaze abhekane nokushushiswa.Esitatimendeni sawo, amaphoyisa athi aqaphele umsindo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ngowesifazane osola amaphoyisa ngokungenzi lutho ngemuva kokubika icala lokushaya ngenhloso yokulimaza isoka lakhe esiteshini samaphoyisa eMlaza, ngoLwesihlanu, 9 Januwari 2026."Cishe ngemuva kwamahora angu-48 kubikwe icala, ngoMsombuluko, 12 Januwari 2026, amaphoyisa abophe umsolwa oneminyaka engu-24 ngecala lokushaya intombi yakhe eneminyaka engu-31 ubudala nokulimaza imoto yayo ngesikhathi sesigameko esihlobene nodlame lwasekhaya esigcemeni sakwa-V eMlaza ngoLwesihlanu."Kubikwa ukuthi umsolwa wabizela isisulu endlini yakhe ukuze silande izimpahla zaso. Ngesikhathi sifika isisulu, kuthiwa umsolwa usishaye ngepayipi wasiluma ngamazinyo, waphinde wasishaya nangezandla. Kuthiwa isisulu sibaleke sabuyela emotweni , kodwa umsolwa wasilandela walimaza iwindi elingemuva lemoto."Uphenyo lwamaphoyisa luphinde lwaveza ukuthi kumanje lo wesimame usesibhedlela ngenxa yamanxeba okushiswa okusolakala ukuthi uwathole ngesikhathi eshisa imoto yesoka lakhe ayishise yaba umlotha. Uma esephumile esibhedlela, uzobhekana necala lokushaya nokulimaza impahla," kusho amaphoyisa ngesitatimende.Amaphoyisa aqhubeke athi laba bobabili banomlando wokuvulelana amacala. Lawo macala afakwe aphantshe enkantolo.Amaphoyisa akhuthaza abantu abasebudlelwaneni banoma yiluphi uhlobo ukuthi baxazulule ukungaboni ngaso linye kwabo ngokuthula noma bacele usizo kulabo ababathembayo ukuze bangabi nodlame.
UPHIKO olulawula ukugunyazwa kokusebenza kwezikhungo zemfundo ephakeme kule lizwe i-South African Qualification Authority (SAQA) isixwayise bonke abafundi abebefunda u-matric nyakenye kanjalo nabazali babo ukuthi baqaphele uma sebebhalisela ukufunda ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme, ukusiza ukugwema ukubhalisa kweziwombombayi. Lesi sixwayiso siza nje imimoya iphezulu njengoba kulindeleke ukuthi kuphume imiphumela yabaka-matric ngoLwesibili ekuseni, nokubhekwe ukuthi uma isiphumile - abafundi bankanise zinkalo zonke befuna izikhala zokuqhubeka nemfundo yabo emikhakheni ehlukene, lapho okuvame ukwenzeka khona ukuthi abanye baqolwe yizikhungo ezingamawuwa.Isikhulu esiphezulu esisabambile seSAQA uDkt Makhapa Makhafula sixwayise ngokuthi lesi yisikhathi lapho abazali nabafundi kudingeka ukuthi babe mehlomane ukuze bangalutheki yilezi zikhungo ezihlose ukubaqola imali ngento engekho, ngoba zibona futhi zazi ukuthi izingane zisuke zilambele ukuqhubeka nemfundo emazingeni emfundo ephakeme."Nakuba kulesi sikhathi imimoya isuke iphezulu, iphezulu nenjabulo yokushisekela ukuqhubekela phambili nemfundo, kepha futhi yilapho abazali nezingane belutheka kalula khona ngalaba bantu bezikhungo ezingekho emthethweni ezisuke zifuna ukubaqola imali ngokubathembisa amathuba okufunda, nakho okungagunyaziwe kuhulumeni,” kuxwayisa uDkt Makhafola.Eqhuba, uthe abazali nabafundi kumele baqikelele ukuqala ngokubheka ukuthi leso naleso sikhungo sibhalisiwe futhi sigunyaziwe yini ukufundisa imfundo ephakeme ngokomgomo woMnyango weMfundo ePhakeme nokuQeqesha ngaphambi kokuthi baze bafake izicelo zokufunda kuzona nokukhokhela izindleko zokufunda zakhona."Abafundi sibeluleka ukuthi baqaphele izinto ezinjalo ukusiza ukuthi bengangeni ogibeni olungagwemeka, nokuthi abakhuthalele ukungena kule website ethi: www.dhet.co.za ukuthola konke ngezikhungo zemfundo ezisebenza ngokusemthethweni,” usho kanje.UDkt Makhafola uxwayise ngokuthi abafundi abagcina bengene ogibeni lokufunda ezikhungweni zemfundo ezingekho emthethweni balengela engozini yokulahlekelwa yimali yabo ngobala, nokuthola izicucu zemfundo ezingeke zibasebenzele ukuqashwa nokuziphilisa, yingakho kumqoka ukulandela yonke imiyalelo yokugwema lokho.
KUPHAZAMISE icala ukutokiswa ejele eBhongweni eKokstad, kwezelamani zakwaNdimande. Izolo izelamani, uMnuz uSiyabonga Gezani Ndimande noMnuz Malusi Dave Ndimande, bezivele kafishane bukhoma zisejele eBhongweni.Beziboshelwe ejele laseSwatini zibhekene necala lokubulala isihlabani somculi waseNingizimu Afrika, uKiernan ÁKA" Forbes nomngani wakhe uTabello "'Tibz" Motsoane.UTibs no-AKA babulawa besendaweni yobumnandi, iWish ekuFlorida, eThekwini esigamekweni esenzeka ngoFebhuwari 10, 2023. Babuyiselwe eNingizimu Afrika ngasekupheleni konyaka odlule ngoNovemba.Abameli babo bazwakalise ukungenami kwabo ngokutokiswa kwabo eKokstad bekhala ngokuthi lokhu kudala ukuthi bangakwazi ukuxhumana nabo kahle ukuze bakwazi ukubhunga ngezinto ezimqoka kakhulu ezimayelana necala..Ummeli wabo, u-Advocate Simphiwe Mlotshwa utshele inkantolo ukuthi bathole ukuthi badluliselwe eKokstad ngoJanuwari 2 ekuqaleni kwalo nyaka.Lokhu uthe bakuthole ngesikhathi benza imizamo yokuthi baxhumane nabo.''Sisafuna ukuthola izimpendulo ezigcwele eMnyangweni wokuHlunyeleliswa kwezimilo ukuthola kahle ukuthi kwenzekeni beze begcina beyiswa kuleli jele,'' usho kanjena.Uphakamise ukuthi leli cala lihlehliselwe olunye usuku ukuze kubonakale ukuthi yini engenziwa ukuze baxhumane kahle nezelamani. ''Akulula ukuthi sixhumane nabo uma bekuleliya jele. Okokuqala nje kunomthetho wemizuzu engu-30 nje kuphela engasetshenziselwa ukuxhumana nababoshiwe,'' kuchaza uMlotshwa okhale nangokuthi azibonwa iziboshwa uma zisejele eBhongweni.Unxuse inkantolo ukuba ikubuyekeze ukuhanjiswa kwezelamani eBhongweni. Kuvelile izolo ukuthi bonke ababandakanyeka kuleli cala bayiswe eKokstad, okungoLindokuhle Thabani Mkhwanazi, Lindani Zenzele Ndimande, Siyabonga Eddie Myeza, Mziwethemba Harvey Gwabeni, kanye noLindokuhle Lindo Ndimande. Omele uhlangothi loMbuso u-Advoace Elvis Gcweka ukuqinisekisile ukuthi bonke ababandakanyeka ecaleni badluliselwe kuleli jele.Uthe noma benalo lolo lwazi kodwa kabazi ukuthi kufinyelelwe kanjani kuleso sinqumo. ''Okwamanje asazi ukuthi kungani bethathiwe bayiswa kuleliya jele, alukho ulwazi esisalutholile olumayelana nalokho okwamanje.Yingakho sigcine sesihlala phansi nabamele abasolwa ukuze sibone ukuthi yini esingavumelana ngayo bese liphinde lihlehliswa icala,'' usho kanjena.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi leli cala libe sematheni kakhulu ngesikhathi besanda kuqala ukuvela enkantolo abasolwa laze lahanjelwa nayilowo owayenguNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa eNingizimu Afrika ngaleso sikhathi, uMnuz Bheki Cele kanye noKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu Natal, uLietenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi.Uyise ka-AKA, uMnuz Tonny Forbes ubejwayele ukuba yingxenye yecala, kodwa akasabonakali muva nje. IMantshi, u-Irfaan Khalil, wonke amacala iwahlehlisele uMashi 4 kuwona lo nyaka. Kukhulunywa ngaleli jele laseKokstad nje livele lisematheni kulezi zinsuku njengoba noCat Matlala ethuthelwe kulo esuka eKgosi Mapuru, ePitoli.Kwelinye icala elihlukile uSiyabonga Gezani uthweswe icala lokubulala, elokuzama ukubulala, ukushayela budedengu nelokucekela phansi impahla, ukutholakala nezibhamu ezingekho emthethweni nezinhlamvu.

KUQALA unyaka omusha, omdala udlulile futhi siyazi ukuthi abanye akubahambelanga kahle kwezothando kangangoba abanye bagcine beyekile baze bafunga bagomela ukuthi ngeke baphinde bazihlanganise nothando. Abanye siyazi ukuthi bebengaqondile ukusho lokho kodwa bakusho ngenxa yezinkinga nokuhlukumezeka okubahaqile othandweni.Namhlanje ngifisa ukukhuluma nawo wonke umuntu ozimisele ukuqala kabusha kwezothando. Ngiyazi ukuthi uthando alusiwo umdlalo olula kodwa kulona kudingeka abadlali abajime ngokwanele ukuze bakwazi ukungena enkundleni futhi bakwazi nokubhekana nezinkinga zakhona.Ngifisa ukuthi dadewethu okanye mfowethu uma kungukuthi usuhlele kahle ukuthi kulo nyaka ufuna ukuqala kabusha impilo yakho ufuna ukuthola umuntu ozomnika uthando naye akunike uthando. Kuhle uthole umuntu osezimisele njengawe umuntu enizoba nomlando naye kusasa umuntu enizowa nivuka naye nibambisane noma kunzima.Umuntu okuzothi noma ningaboni ngasolinye nikwazi ukuhlala phansi nilungise lokho okungahambi kahle, ngikhuluma ngomuntu ozoziqhenya ngaye kusasa okuzothi uma umbheka ubone ukuthi lo muntu ngingawakha naye umuzi. Isikhathi sihambile ngane zakwethu angikholwa wukuthi kukhona umuntu osafuna ukudlala umdlalo kamagcogcoma othandweni, angikholwa wukuthi kukhona umuntu osafuna ukubizwa ngesikhokho ukuthi yena ushintsha amantombazane okanye amadoda.Wena ukhula nini ngempela kusuka ngo 2012 wawuzenza isikhokho namanje ingqondo yakho isame lapho ekubeni kini balindele umakoti noma umkhwenyana. Ake nizakhele umlando wenu othandweni, ningavumi ukuhlulwa yinto engakhulumi.Njengoba lo nyaka uqalile ngifisa ukuthola izimemo abantu belobola/belotsholwa noma beshada/ beshadelwa. Ngifisa ukunizwa nithi MaGumede iziyalo zakho zisisebenzele nowakwami, ngifisa ukubona abantu bejabule othandweni. Ngiphinde ngibongele labo abakwazi ukuyibamba ishisa abawa bevuka nophathina babo noma kunzima kanjani ngoba othandweni into ebalulekile yinhlonipho, ukuthembana, ukubambisana, ukuxhumana nokubekezelelana nibonisane angabikhona ozenza usiyazi nondlovu kayiphikiswa. Lapho-ke uthando luyakhula luye phambili.Ngifisa konke esizokwenza ukuqala kwalo nyaka othandweni kube nomehluko kukhombise ukuthi sesikhulile, sithandane sithokozele ucansi kube mnandi uthando luye phambili bese singakhohlwa wukusebenzisa ijazi lomkhwenyana.
UHLAKA olugunyaza imiphumela yabafundi baka-matric ezweni Umalusi luzwakalise ukukhathazeka ngothisha nabagada abafundi uma bebhalela ukuhlolwa kwabo kokugcina ngesenzo sokubalekelela ukuthi bakopele ngenkathi kubhalwa.Lokhu kushiwo yisikhulu esiphezulu ku-Umalusi, uDkt Mafu Rakometsi esithangamini nabezindaba ngoLwesihlanu, onhloso yaso bekuwukuzoqinisekisa ukuthi konke sekumi ngomumo ngemiphumela yabafundi baka-matric wanyakenye, ezophuma ngoLwesibili.UDkt Rakometsi uthe nakuba begculisekile ngezingabunjalo lemiphumela yabafundi, kepha kuyabakhathaza ukuthi nakulokhu kukhona abafundi okutholakale ugcobho emiphumeleni yabo"Kulokhu bawu-40 abafundi okutholakale ugcobho emiphumeleni yabo ngenxa yokuthi baphule eminye yemithetho ngenkathi kubhalwa, kanti futhi njengoba sekuqalile ukuphenya ngalokho - abazukuyithola imiphumela yabo ka-matric kuze kube wukuthi sekuphothulwe uhlelo lokuphenya bese bethathelwa izinyathelo ezifanele. "Kuyasikhathaza futhi ukuthi kulezi zenzo zokukopela kukhona othisha nababegada abafundi ngenkathi kubhalwa ababambe iqhaza ekutheni labo bafundi bakopele, kuze kukhonjiswane ngezimpendulo okuyisenzo esingesihle neze - esesiqalile futhi ukuphenya ngaso ukuze nabo bathathelwe izinyathelo ezifanele,” kulanda uDkt Rakometsi.Uthe nakuba kube khona lezo zingqinamba ezibe yizithiyo lapho nalapho, kepha uyaqinisekisa ukuthi imiphumela yabafundi okungatholwanga gcobho kubona izophuma isezingeni elifanele nelizobagculisa uma isiphuma ngokusemthethweni ngoLwesibili."Sibafisela inhlanhla beqhubeka nempilo yabo, futhi sithemba ukuthi lokhu kuzoba yisendlalelo sempilo enhle nekusasa eliqhakazile kubona bonke,” kusho yena.
BEBEHLALISE umphakathi lubhojozi, bewukhokhisa imali yokuvikela njalo ngesonto abayisihlanu abathelwe othulini amaphoyisa e-Area 10, KwaBester, eThekwini, izolo.Lokhu kuvezwe wumsunguli wenhlangano eqapha ubugebengu, iThekwini Neighbourhood Watch, uMnuz Andile Jali, kulandela isigameko. "Bebengena umuzi nomuzi bafune o-R50 njalo ngesonto, bathi yimali yokuvikela. Imizi eminingi ibiyikhipha le mali kodwa kungabi namehluko ngoba bebephinde babuye futhi bona laba bafana bazongena ebusuku, bathathe impahla,” kusho uJali.Uthe sekunenqwaba yemizi ethuthile ngoba yehluleka ukubhekana nalesi simo, wathi umuzi ebese bewubonile ukuthi kuthuthiwe kuwo, bekungenisa bona bahlale, njengoba beyiqembu elikhulu lemigulukudu."Kokunye bebebavimba abantu abazama ukuthutha, babahlalise phansi ngenkani. Bekuze kusize ukuthi babize amaphoyisa azoqapha ngesikhathi bebopha imithwalo bethutha,” usho kanje. Uveze nokuthi bayingxenye yabasolwa abadubule babulala abantu ababili ebebehamba ngemoto iToyota Rumion KwaJina, eNanda, ngoLwesibili.Uthe omunye wababulelwe ngaphambi kokuthi ashonele esigamekweni, uthinte umalume wakhe osezinhlakeni zokuqapha ubugebengu, wamtshela ukuthi obani ababahlasele.Uveze ukuthi lona wesilisa ushonele esigamekweni, kwathi abehamba naye washonela esibhedlela. "Ulwazi ludluliselwe emaphoyiseni, alandela umkhondo. I-tracker yemoto ethathiwe igcine ikhomba ukuthi iphelele KwaBester,” kusho uJali.Uthe umphakathi uzoke ushaywe wumoya njengoba amaphoyisa ebulale laba, wathi njalo uma kukhona ababulewe, ozakwabo abasadla anhlamvana baye bathuke, babaleke nasendaweni, umphakathi uthole ukuphefumula.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe abasolwa bebefunelwa amacala okubulala, ukuzama ukubulala, okubandakanya nokuzama ukubulala amaphoyisa kanjalo nokubamba inkunzi. "Abasolwa bebehlalise lubhojozi umphakathi waseNanda namaphethelo. Ekupheleni kukaNovemba nyakenye bazame ukubulala amaphoyisa, bewadubula. Bebelokhu bephunyuka kusukela lapho,” kusho uNetshiunda. Uthe izolo ekuseni, amaphoyisa athole umkhondo wokuthi baphi, awulandela. Uthe athe efika, abasolwa bavele bawadubula, nawo abuyisele ngenhlamvu ukuzivikela kanjalo nemizi eseduzane, kwasala abayisihlanu enkundleni.Uthe amaphoyisa athole izibhamu ezine endaweni yesigameko, wathi akukho phoyisa alilimele.
UDIDEKILE umndeni wengane okuthiwa idlwengulwe enye eGroutville, KwaDukuza, umndeni kamsolwa okuthiwa ucela ukukhipha isamba semali esihambisana nenkomo nembuzi ngesigameko.Isigameko sokudlwengula kuthiwa senzeke maphakathi nenyanga edlule, umsolwa oneminyaka engu-17, "edlwengula" umgilwa oneminyaka engu-8.Ngokuthola kweSolezwe ngaleso sikhathi, isigameko senzeke kubo kamsolwa ngesikhathi umgilwa evakashele ezinye izingane ezingontanga yakhe. Sikhuluma ngokwenzeke kamumva isihlobo sikamgilwa, esingeke sidalulwe ukuvikela isithunzi sakhe, bekunguJanuwari 2 nonyaka, umndeni uthola ucingo lwekhansela, lithi lithunywa umndeni kamsolwa."Lithe bathi akababuzele ukuthi bangafuna malini ngesigameko, lathi bathe leyo mali bazoyiletha kanye nenkomo nembuzi,” kusho isihlobo.Sithe bathi bacela ukukhipha konke lokhu ngoba bona benza izinto ngamasiko esintu ngakho bafuna ukuhambisa izinto ngesintu. Sithe umndeni wabuza ukuthi bebethandana yini umgilwa nomsolwa kuze kuhanjiswe izinto ngesintu?Siveza ukuthi bona bayibuka le nto ngeso lokuthi lokhu kuyimizamo yokubavala umlomo ukuze basule icala eliqhubekayo enkantolo, sathi kwenzeka lokhu nje, ngayizolo ngezikhathi zasekuseni, umphakathi wavuswa umlilo, kusha umuzi wakubo kamsolwa.Sithe umndeni waphuma walunguza, wabona kusha, sekusondele nabanye omakhelwane, bezobhula. Siveza ukuthi kwathi uma kufika amalungu omndeni kamsolwa, amanye ademelayisa ethi: "Azikhale-ke manje ngoba lo muzi oshiswayo akuwona owengane, owabantu abadala”."Umndeni wethu wakuthatha njengokuthi cishe basola thina ngokusha komuzi wabo nokuyinto esingayazi,” kusho isihlobo. Siqhube sathi babe sebethola amahebezi okuthi umndeni kamsolwa wenza imizamo yokuthi badingiswe endaweni njengoba ubasola ngokuthi yibo abashise umuzi.Uthe isimo sikamgilwa sisesibi njengoba ehlala ahlale ophe ngaphambili nangemumva. Uthe odokotela bathi kwenziwa ukuthi walimala kakhulu. Uthe icala libuyela eNkantolo yeMantshi yaKwaDukuza, ngoLwesibili.Lithintwa ikhansela ngalokhu, uNkk Nkitimeng Mpanza, likuqinisekisile ukuthi udaba liyalwazi, labikelwa ngalo, kusanda kwenzeka. UNkk Mpanza uthe nakho konke okuthe kwenzeka kamumva unalo ulwazi ngakho."Lishisiwe ikamelo lomuzi wakubo kamsolwa, bangibikela ngakho. Ngibayalele ukuthi udaba balubike emaphoyiseni, kanti sebevele bawabikele,” kusho uNkk Mpanza.Uthe ukhulumile nomndeni kamgilwa, othe awazi lutho ngesigameko, wase egxeka eyokuzithathela umthetho ngezandla, wasola nalabo abangase basebenzise isigameko sokudlwengula ukubhebhethekisa ukungezwani kule mindeni. Mayelana nokukhokhwa kwemali, inkomo nembuzi, uthe umndeni kamsolwa uzile kuyena uzoyikhuluma."Ngiyedlulisele emndenini kamgilwa ngathola ukuthi awuyithandi, ngabuyisela impendulo kokamsolwa, ngase nginxusa ukuthi kuyekwe konke ezandleni zomthetho,” usho kanje. Ethintwa unina kamsolwa ngalokhu, unele wezwa ukuthi ukhuluma nentatheli, wabhoka ngolaka, wayibuza: "Angithi uwumZulu wena? Awuyazi into yokuhlawula igceke? Thina besithi senza isintu, sihlawula igceke kodwa sesishiye kanjalo ngoba sizwile ukuthi lokho abakufuni.” Uthe ngesikhathi umndeni wakhe uhlongoza eyokukhokha okuthile kokamgilwa, ubungazami ukuwuthenga ukuze usule icala kodwa ubufuna ukuthi kugezwe umshophi ovelele umgilwa ukuze ungaphinde wenzeke ngomuso. Ube eseveza ukuthi nabo bashiselwe umuzi kodwa wathi akekho asebemkhombe ngomunwe ngokubehlele, wathi bathembele emaphoyiseni ngophenyo.Uvale ucingo intatheli isafuna ukumbuza ngokudemelayisa kwezihlobo zakhe ngesikhathi zifika indlu isha, kanjalo nangamahebezi okuthi bafuna udingiswe endaweni umndeni kamgilwa.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi ofakazi abakabuyi namanje endaweni njengoba bathutha emva kokuveza eyokuthi umsolwa udlwengule umgilwa.

AMANAZARETHA ohlangothini lwaseBuhleni aholwa yinkosi, uMduduzi ''uNyazilwezulu'' Shembe azokubeka eqhulwini ukukhulekelwa kwesihlava sokubulawa kwabantu besifazane nezingane njengoba esentabeni iKhenana.Lokhu kudalulwe yiloyo okhulumela leli bandla, uMnuz Thokozani Mcwabe, ngesikhathi enenkulumo ekhethekile neSolezwe mayelana nohambo lwabo lwakulo nyaka athi luhambe kahle kakhulu.Uveze ukuthi inhlosongqangi yalolu hambo kusuke kungukukhulekela ukuthi unyaka ibandla liwuqale kahle konke kuhambe kahle.Kodwa uthe ngenxa yezimo eziningi esezenzeka ezweni nezibonakala zikhinyabeza inhlalonhle yabantu ibandla seliye likubeke eqhulwini ngaso sonke isikhathi ukubaluleka kokukhulekelwa kwezimo ezahlukene ezingezinhle.Kulokhu uthe kuzoba seqhulwini ukukhulekelwa kwesihlava sokubulawa kwabantu besifazane nezingane athe sibonakale sesiphenduke insakavukela ezingxenyeni ezahlukene zezwe.Uthe lo mkhuleko bazowenza ngoba bayakuqonda ukuthi ibandla lamaNazaretha liyingxenye yomphakathi, wathi okwenzeka emphakathini kuyalithinta ibandla. Ugcizelele ukuthi nabo njengebandla kumqoka kakhulu ukuthi kube khona abakwenzayo ngalesi sihlava athe sibonakala siphuma esandleni.''Sizokukhulekela nje kakhulu ukuthi iphele manje le ndaba yokubulawa kwabantu besifazane nezingane. Kungaba yiphutha elikhulu kabi uma kungathiwa njengebandla sikhuphukela entabeni ebese singabe sisayikhulekela inkinga enkulu kangaka,'' usho kanjena.Uthe bayakholelwa kakhulu ekutheni umkhuleko unamandla okuguqula izinto ezahlukene noma ngabe leso simo sibukeka silukhuni satshe kangakakanani.Uveze ukuthi bazophinde bakhulekele ukuthi kwehle ukuphuzwa kwezimbiza zikaFaru njengoba ethe nazo ziwumnyombo wezinkinga eziningi izwe elizithola libhekene nazo.''Uma umuntu esephuzile iqinisio ukuthi akabe esecabanga kahle. Akanqeni umuntu ukuthi amane abulale aphinde adlwengule enze into abangeke aze ayenze nje nhlobo ukube ubengabuthintanga utshwala,''usho kanjena.Uthe ayikho into emqoka njengokukhulekela ukuthula ngoba lokho kungumgogodla omkhulu wokuphila kwezwe lonkana. Lokhu uthe bakholwa ukuthi kuyisibopho esikhulu sebandla lamaNazaretha wonkana.Ukushayele ihlombe elikhulu okwenziwe yinhlangano uBumbano athe lukubeke emahlombe alo ukulungisa umgwaqo oya eKhenana.''Le nhlangano yenze konke ilungisa umgwaqo. Siyabonga kakhulu kuyona ngendlela ekhombise ngayo ukuba nesineke namaNazaretha,''usho kanjena.Uveze ukuthi uBumbano yinhlangano ebunjwe ngamaNazaretha. Ugonyuluke nangokuthi akuyona into elula ukunyuka intaba ngezinyawo kukhona amatashe, nelanga lishisa.''Ngabe sinamanga uma singathi kusuke kuyinto elula,kodwa kuyenzeka ngenxa yokuthi sisuke sethembe uNyazi Lwezulu okuyilona olusiholayo kukhona konke esisuke sikwenza,''usho kanjena.UMnuz Sandile Goba wenhlangano uBumbano uthe le nhlangano igxile kakhulu ekubhekeleleni izidingo zomphakathi ngezindlela ezahlukene. Uthe bahlala phansi babona kumqoka kakhulu ukuthi kube khona abakwenzayo mayelana nokulekelelwa kwamaNzaretha ukuze abe nohambo oluphephile nolungenazo izihibe oluya entabeni, eKhenana nonyaka.Leli bandla likhuluma ngeyokukhulekela ukubulawa kwabesifazane kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi noNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli ukugcizelele kaningi ukuthi kubhukulwe kunqandwe lesi sihlava.
Izangoma zezulu zixwayisa izakhamuzi zaKwaZulu-Natal ukuba ziphephe njengoba kukhishwe isexwayiso sesigaba sesine sanamhoanje ebusuku.Izindawo ezithintekayo: Abaqulusi, Big Five Hlabisa (Hlabisa & Hluhluwe), eDumbe, eMadlangeni, Jozini, Mandeni, Mthonjaneni, Mtubatuba, Nkandla, Nongoma, Nquthu, Ulundi, uMhlabuyalingana, uMlalazi, noPhongolo.Umthelela ongaba khona:• Ukukhukhuleka kwemigwaqo, amabhuloho, nezindawo zokuhlala.•Ukuphazamiseka okukhulu kwezohambo kanye nokulimala kwengqalasizinda ngenxa yesichotho.• Umlilo ongabangwa umbani.Okumele ukwenze ukuze uphephe:• Hlala endlini futhi ungahambi emigwaqweni uma kungenzeka.• Gwema ukuwela imifula noma imifudlana lapho amanzi engaphezulu kobude bamaqakala.• Hambisa izinto ezibalulekile endaweni ephephile ngaphezu kwamazinga ezikhukhula alindelekile.• Gwema ukusondela eduze kwezinto eziyinsimbi, izihlahla ezinde, noma izindawo ezivulekile ngesikhathi kunombani.

UYATHIMULA umndeni wowesifazane waseMandeni, otholakale eseshonile otshanini kade ephume nabangani kukuhle kuyiwa emcimbini obungeSonto.Umndeni kamufi, uNksz Ayanda Ndlovu (32), usola abangani bakhe ababili ngokufa kwakhe.Owomndeni kamufi, uNksz Zama Ndlovu, utshele Isolezwe ukuthi kukhona okushaya amanzi ngokufa kukadadewabo.Ulandise wathi udadewabo ulandwe ngabangani bakhe ababili kade ehlezi kubo, wathi bakujwayele vele ukufika bazomlanda ekhaya. "Nakulokhu kube yinto efanayo, bafikile bamlanda bahamba naye. Nathi lapha ekhaya asibaxwayi ngoba bajwayele vele ukuthi bamlande. Kulokhu bashilo ukuthi baya emcimbini womunye wesifazane abamjwayele obebungaza usuku lwakhe lokuzalwa," usho kanjena.Uthe baphume bobathathu egcekeni kumnandi kuqhuma nohleko phezulu, belimisa ngesihloko elokuthi bayozicika ngeziphuzo ezidakayo, wathi kuze kwasa ngakusasa, lutho ukubuya umufi okuyinto athe ibamangazile kakhulu."Lokhu kusixakile kakhulu ekhaya ngoba siyamazi ukuthi noma ethanda ukuhamba kodwa njalo wenza isiqiniseko sokuthi ulala ekhaya ngoba uthanda kakhulu abantwana bakhe. Kodwa-ke kulokhu kube yinto ehlukile," usho kanje.Uthe bashaye ucingo ekuseni befonela laba besifazane ababaphendule ngokuthi umufi ubashiye emcimbini wathi usebuyela ekhaya."Simane sasanganelwa amakhanda, saqala sabona ukuthi kukhona okungahambi kahle kule nto. Sibabuzile ukuthi kwenziwa yini bahambe nomuntu ebese bemvumela ukuba abuye yedwa ebusuku ekubeni kungaphephile? Abaphendulanga, bavele baxolisa base bethembisa ukuthi bazombheka futhi bazomthola udadewethu," kubeka uNksz Ndlovu.Uthe baqalile bemthungatha bebuza nabantu kodwa bonke bemlandula, wathi ngoMsombuluko, babizwe wumakhelwane ezobatshela ukuthi babona umufi edindilize kabuhlungu otshanini ngasehlathini elibuqamama nakubo, base benikela khona, nebala bakhangwa udadewabo esethule."Ubesagqoke izinto ahambe ezifakile kodwa izicathulo newashi bekungekho. Emqaleni ubenezimpawu zokuthi ubeklinywa. Alikho inxeba esilibonile emzimbeni wakhe," echaza.Uthe umakhalekhukhwini wakhe nawo ubungekho. "Kukhona okungalungile okwenzekile kudadewethu, angeke aphume nabantu kodwa bona babuye bephila yena atholakale engasekho. Siyazibuza ukuthi lokho kwenzeke kanjani?" esho.Uthe babazisile abangani bakamufi ngokutholakala kwakhe eseshonile."Angazi noma ngiyadlinza yini kodwa bamane bagcina ngokumangala nje bangakhala nokukhala," echaza.Udadewabo kamufi uqhube wathi bafisa ukuthola izimpendulo kubona abangani ukuthi kwenzekeni ngampela?Uthe inkukhu iyawusola umgqakazo kwazise uthe umufi ezinyangeni ezedlule uke waba nokungaboni ngaso linye nalaba besifazane kade bemsola ngokuthi webe imali yabo engu-R10 000.Uthe akazi ukuthi le nkinga bagcine beyixazulule kanjani kodwa umufi wabatshela ukuthi bagcine bebonile ukuthi akusiyena owebe leyo mali."Asithembe ukuthi akusibona laba abenze le nto ngoba ngiyakhumbula ukuthi bamsongela ngokumbulala ngenxa yale mali," kusho yena.Uthe umndeni ufuna ubulungiswa ngokufa kwelunga lawo futhi uzolwa kuze kube isekugcineni ukuze babanjwe abenzi bokubi.Usonge ngokuthi akukho zinyane lemvubu ladliwa zingwenya maqede kucwebe iziziba. Amaphoyisa aKwaZulu-Natal akuqinisekisile ukubulawa kukamufi. Athe kuphenywa icala lokubulawa komuntu.
UYIHLABE wayihlikiza indaba kahulumeni obusa ngokubambisana KwaZulu Natal, iProvincial Government of Unity (GPU), loyo onguMengameli weNational Freedom Party (NFP), uMnuz Ivan Barnes. Ngokusho kwaleli qembu lolu hlobo lukahulumeni lufile ezingeni lesifundazwe kanjalo nasezingeni lomasipala ngokuhluka kwabo.Leli qembu lithi inkohlakalo idla lubi kulolu hlobo lukahulumeni kwathi izidingo zabantu zathathwa zabekwa emuva ngoba akekho noyedwa onendaba nazo.Ekhuluma esithangami nabezindaba ebesingoLwesihlanu, eThekwini uBarnes usole amaqembu abumbe lolu hlobo lukahulumeni, okuyi i-IFP, ANC, iDA nayo i-NFP ngokubeka eqhulwini okudingwa yiwona kunokufunwa wumphakathi. Lokhu ke uthe akwamukelekile nhlobo ngoba ngabantu okumele babe seqhulwini uma kukhulunywa ngohulumeni walolu hlobo.Ubekhwela edilika kulolu hlobo lukahulumeni ethi akukho okubonakala kuza nalo. Uthe kuyichilo ukuthi lawa maqembu enza lokhu aze akhohlwe wukuthi lolu hlobo lukahulumeni lwalubunjelwe ukusiza abantu hhayi ukuhlomulisa idlanzana nje kuphela.Leli qembu belikade libize isithangami nabezindaba ngemuva kokuba likhiphe isitatimende liveza ukuthi liyahoxa ekubeni yingxenye yamaqembu abambisene KwaZulu-Natal.Uthe ubufakazi bokuthi lawa maqembu abeka phambili inkohlakalo wukubhuntsha kwemizamo yokugudluza uNdunankulu waKwaZulu Natal esikhundleni, uMnuz Thami Ntuli ngevoti lokungabethembi ubuholi bakhe. Uchaze ubuholi bamanje kulo hulumeni njengobuphambanayo nokufunwa ngabantu baKwaZulu-Natal. Ukhale kakhulu ngokuthi intuthuko abantu baKwaZulu-Natal bayizwa ngendaba, wakhala nangokufadabala kwengqalasizinda ezingxenyeni ezahlukene. Konke lokhu uthe kubonakala kwenzeka ezandleni zalo lolu hlobo lukahulumeni olubunjwe ngokubambisana kwalawa maqembu. "'Sibuswa ngabantu abangenandaba nabanye abantu,'' kusho uBarnes.Uthe kubuhlungu kakhulu ukubona abaholi be-IFP, ANC nabeDA bebeka eqhulwini amandla kunezidingo zabantu baKwaZulu-Natal. Uphume iqhubu noSiboniso Duma, Francois Rodgers noNdunankulu uThami Ntuli ngakubize ngokuthi yibona ababukeka bephambili ekukhinyabezweni kwekusasa lesizukulwane esilandelayo.Eqhuba usole ukusebenzisana kwe-ANC ne-IFP njengento ewumshado wenkohliso ongeke ubalekelele ngalutho abantu baKwaZulu-Natal. Wenze isethembiso sokuthi iNFP izoqhubeka nokuqinisekisa ukuthi bahlala obala abangenzi kahle kulolu hlobo lukahulumeni.Uthe ngeke balenze iphutha lokugoqa izandla nje babukele kube konakala. "Kulesi sifundazwe abamnyama bayavota kodwa abakwazi ukuphatha. Ilungelo labo liyagxotshwa,'' kuchaza yena.Uthe lolu hlobo lukahulumeni luyingozi kakhulu ngoba luphethe ngesandla sensimbi kodwa lube lumamatheka. Uthe lungondlovukayiphikiswa kodwa okungelula ukuba babonakale. Uthe okubuhlungu kakhulu wukubona amalungelo abantu ezitshwa kube sengathi ayinto engekho nje.Ugcizelele kakhulu ukuthi iNFP imile nje nabantu ngeke futhi ize ilenze iphutha lokuthi ibonakale igudluka kulokho ekholwa wukuthi kuyikhona. ''I-NFP imi nabantu isohlangothini lwabo ngokugcwele. Lokhu futhi sikwenza ngaphandle kokwesaba futhi ngeke sixolise kumuntu simile nje kulokhu esikholelwa kukhona," kusho yena. Uthe ukulwa kwabo akumayelana nezihlalo esiShayamthetho kodwa kumayelana nokumele kuzuzwe ngabantu baKwaZulu-Natal.
INDODANA kaSaliwa, ongomunye wabaculi bakamaskandi abangaconsi phansi kule ndima, isizakhele ugazi nedumela ebantwini ikakhulu kwabasebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumana - ngama-vidiyo afakwa wuyise nabomndeni wakhe, lapho bekhombisa khona uthando lwayo lwesintu nokunye okuhambisana nakho, ilingisela uyise ngokukwenza.Lowo wuNtelezi Zibuse Ndunakazi, ovame ukuvela ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ngama-vidiyo egiya, ezibongela futhi eshaya ingoma, okuyinto esibe nedumela kakhulu ebantwini abalandela uSaliwa nabomndeni wakhe oGqizile noNdoni.Kujabule abantu abaningi futhi ngenkathi uNtelezi (2) evela okokuqala emphakathini, engena noyise e-steji emcimbini kazakwabo emculweni, iGcokama Elisha, iMthandeni Summer Experince, obuseMkhaliphi Stadium, eMdletsheni ngempelasonto. Ethintwa uSaliwa ukuzwa kabanzi ngomcabango walokhu, uthe okudale ukuthi indodana yakhe igqame kanjena ezinkundleni zokuxhumana wukuthi ibe nenhlanhla yokukhulela kubo, okwenza ukuthi uma bematasa bezilolongela imicimbi abamenywe kuyona indodana yakhe ibone ukuthi benzani."Konke lokhu okubonakala manje kungenxa yokuthi ukhulele ekhaya, ngakho kuthi uma sihlangene nezinsizwa engisebenzisana nazo, abe khona abone senza umsebenzi wethu, okuqhubeke kwaze kwafika lapho ekhombisa khona izimpawu zokuthanda le nto esiyenzayo, waqala lapho esilingisela ekhombisa ukujabulela ubuciko nesintu,” usho kanje. Eqhuba, uthe nakuba indodana yakhe - esinezibongo ezithi "Intelezi yamahwanqa asehostela KwaMashu, o-DVD umfo kaGwala, uSiye umfo kaButhelezi noMpetuzi umfo kaDladla - izoqhubeka ivele kuma-vidiyo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, kepha futhi bazoqaphela ukuthi ayitholakali yonke indawo lapho benandisa khona."Besimane simveza nje eMdletsheni ngoba bekuwumcimbi obuseduze nasekhaya eMpangeni futhi nganandisa kungakahlwa kakhulu, kepha futhi abantu bazoqhubeka bambone ezinkundleni zokuxhumana kuze kube wukuthi usekhule ngokwanele ukuthi azimele futhi enze izinto ngendlela yakhe esezazi ukuthi ufunani,” kusho uSaliwa. Ukhuthaze nabanye abazali ukuthi bakhulise izingane zabo ngendlela efanele kulandelwe imithetho yasemakhaya ukuze zikhule zivikelekile, futhi bazikhuthaze ukuthanda imfundo."Lokho ngibona kuzosiza ukuthi izingane zikhule zivikelekile futhi kungabi lula ukuthi ziwele ogibeni lwezinto eziningi ezingezinhle esizibona zenzeka emphakathini,” kusho yena.
ENYE yamanyuvesi asesifundazweni futhi ahlonishwayo ngenxa yezinga lemfundo yawo i-University of KwaZulu-Natal isimemezele ukuthi ihlela ukuthatha izitshudeni ezingaphezu kuka-9 000 ukuzokwenza unyaka wokuqala uma sekuqala uhlelo lokufunda nonyaka.Lokhu kushiwo wuMqondisi woPhiko lwezobudlelwano kule nyuvesi uNksz Normah Zondo, lapho edalule khona ukuthi bazoqala ngesonto elizayo ukuphendula abafundi abamukelwa noma abachitha izicelo zabo, uma sekuphume imiphumela ka-matric wangonyaka odlule, ezophuma ngoLwesibili.UNksz Zondo udalule ukuthi i-UKZN ithole izicelo ezingaphezulu kuka-326 546 zabafundi abafuna ukuzofunda kuyona, wathi nokho bazokwazi ukwamukela abangaphezudlwana kuka-9 000 ukuzofunda kubona ngenxa yokuthi abanawo umthamo wokuthatha wonke umuntu.Uthe kulezo zicelo eziningi ngezabafuna ukufundela ubuhlengikazi njengoba bengaphezu kuka-27 763 abafake izicelo, kube ngabawu-25 826 abafake ezobuthishela nabawu-25 231 abafake izicelo zokufundela ubumeli.Uhlelo lokubhalisa ngohlelo lobuchwepheshe besimanje kwizitshudeni ezizoqhubeka nokufunda kule nyuvesi lona luvulwe ngoJanuwari 6, kanti luzoqhubeka luze luvalwe ngoLwesihlanu lwangoFebhuwari 13. Abonyaka wokuqala bona bazoqala ukubhaliswa ngoFebhuwari 2 kuya ku-7.UNksz Zondo uthe babheke ukuthi uhlelo lokubhalisa luqhubeke ngaphandle kwezihibe, futhi waqinisekisa nokuthi inyuvesi ngeke ize imeme izitshudeni ukuzobhalisa ezimpikweni ezinhlanu zala manyuvesi njengoba konke kuzokwenziwa ngohlelo lobuchwepheshe."Lonke uhlelo lokubhalisa, kubandakanya nolokwamukela umkhakha osuke unikwa ithuba lokuthi uzowufundela noma ushintsha umqondo ngomkhakha ofuna ukuwufundela, konke kuzokwenziwa ngohlelo lobuchwepheshe ukuze kungabi nasiphithiphithi."Kanti futhi bazothathelwa izinyathelo zomthetho bonke labo abasebenzisa igama lenyuvesi ukuqola noma ukulutha izitshudeni ngento engekho,” kuxwayisa uNksz Zondo.,Unxuse nokuthi abafuna imininingwane egcwele bangene kwi-website ye-UKZN ethi: www.ukzn.ac.za noma babheke amakhasi ayo ezinkundla zokuxhumana, wase edalula nokuthi uhlelo lokufunda luzoqala ngoMsombuluko wangoFebhuwari 9.

Ngebhadi sibathole sebeshonile. Leli yicala lokuthumba, ngebhadi ngeke ngenabe kabanzi ngemininingwane. Bengifuna nje ukwazisa wonke umuntu. Nilale ngoxolo bantase size sibonane futhi." UNGQONGQOSHE weMfundo eyiSisekelo, uNksz Siviwe Gwarube usedalule izindaba zokuthi ithimba ebeliphenya ngomkhonyovu wokwephula imithetho yokuhlolwa kokugcina kuka-matric, iNational Investigative Task Team (NITT) ithole ukuthi bangabasezikoleni zaseTshwane, eGauteng abafundi abawu-40 abaphule imithetho yokuhlolwa kokugcina.UNksz Gwarube usho njalo ekhuluma esithangamini nabezindaba ngoLwesihlanu, onhloso yaso bekuwukucacisa ngebanga eselihanjiwe ukuphenya ngakho konke okungahambanga kahle ngenkathi abafundi baka-matric wanyakenye beqhubeka nokuhlolwa kwabo.UNgqongqoshe uthe nakuba bezothathelwa izinyathelo bonke abafundi okutholakale ukuthi baphule umthetho, kepha amacala azoba ngawabo kuphela hhayi othisha bezikole zabo, nokuthi abafundi abangathinteki kulokhu bazoyithola bona imiphumela yabo."Kodwa futhi sizobhekana ngqo nalaba bafundi okutholakale ukuthi baphule imithetho yokuhlolwa kokugcina, kangangokuthi imiphumela yabo izogodlwa okwesikhashana kuze kube wukuthi seluphothuliwe uhlelo lokuphenya ngezinselo zomkhonyovu owenzekile wokuputshuka kwamaphepha ezivivinyo nokukopela ngenkathi kubhalwa,” usho kanje.Eqhuba, uthe ithimba le-NITT lithole ukuthi amaphepha ayisikhombisa aputshuka ngenkathi kubhalwa ngaweMathematics, elesiNgisi nelePhysical Sciences, wase edalula ukuthi abazukuzidalula izikole zabafundi abathinteka kulo mkhonyovu ukuze bavikeleke."Sithole ukuthi lo mkhonyovu wokuputshuzelana amaphepha ezivivinyo wenziwa ngamaselula, futhi kwathunyelelwana nangama-USB - futhi siyazi ukuthi kukhona nabasebenzi bomnyango abathintekayo kulo mkhonyovu, esibheke ukuthi nabo baphenywe bese beqondiswa ubugwegwe ngendlela efanele, nabomthetho bazisiwe ngakho konke okuqhubekayo ukuze sisizakale uma kwenzeka sibadinga,” kusho uNksz Gwarube.Uthe bazoqhubeka baqinise ezokuphepha nokuvikela ukuputshuka kwamaphepha okuhlola abafundi ukuze kugwemeke izigameko ezifuze lezi ngokuzayo, nokuthi uma kukhona ababanjwa bephula umthetho bazoqondiswa ubugwegwe ngendlela efanele."Siyabonga kakhulu umsebenzi omuhle owenziwe yi-NITT, kanjalo nokubambisana kubasebenzi boMnyango weMfundo. Bese sibongela nabo bonke abafundi baka-matric wanyakenye ngokuzikhandla kwabo, kanti kulabo abazothola ukuthi akuhambanga kahle sibakhuthaza ukuthi bangaphosi ithawula, baqhubeke bazame ngokuzayo,” usho kanje.
Uphiko lwamaphoyisa kaMasipala weTheku seluqalile uhlelo lokuqasha ngo-2026 njengoba kuzohlolwa isimo somzimba eLahee Park, ePinetown ngezigaba ezahlukene ngenxa yobuningi balabo abafake izicelo. Isigaba sokuqala siqale kuleli sonto kusukela ngoMsombuluko kuze kube yizolo kanti ingxenye yesibili izohlolwa mhla zi-5 kuNhlolanja wezi-2026. Izicelo ezingaphezu kuka-62 000 zamukelwe, zacutshungulwa, zahlungwa futhi zakhethelwa ukuhlolwa kokuqina komzimba., okungenye yezinto ezidingekayo ohlelweni lokuqashwa kwamaphoyisa kaMasipala waseThekwini.
UMELWE yingqondo umndeni wowesifazane othandana nabantu abanobulili obufana nobakhe kulandela ukutholwa kwesidumbu sakhe sesonakele ekotishi lowesilisa osagcwele amathafa eZakhiweni, ePort Shepstone. UNksz Asithande Mkhuba (18) waseMkholombe, khona ePort Shepstone, utholwe ngeSonto ebulewe, wambozwa ngengubo yokulala ekotishi. Ngokusho kukanina, uNksz Nomfundo Mkhuba, babegcine ukumbona ephila ngoLwesine, ethi usaya kubangani bakhe. Kuphele izinsuku engabuyi, kwaze kwaba bathola ucingo ngoMsombuluko, luthi abaphuthume emakhazeni bayobheka ngoba kutholwe isidumbu sowesifazane okusolakala ukuthi yindodakazi yakhe."Sifike saqinisekisa ukuthi wuye. Sisola ukuthi uqale wadlwengulwa ngaphambi kokuba abulawe ngoba ibhulukwe lakhe nesikhindi sangaphansi bekusezinyaweni,” kusho uNksz Mkhuba. Uthe babuzwile ubuhlungu ngokubulawa kwendodakazi yakhe ngesihluku. "Bayibulale ngesihluku ingane yami. Bayishiya kanjalo. Itholwe isiphuma izilwane. Kubuhlungu. Ngimelwe yingqondo,” usho kanje. Uthe bazwile ukuthi kukhona othathwe amaphoyisa, wathi bafuna alihlanze lonke iqiniso, akhiphe nabanye uma indodakazi yakhe bayibulala bebaningi. Umholi wohlaka olulwa nobugebengu endaweni, uMnuz Bhakabhaka Somhlaba, uthe bathole ucingo lubazisa ngekotishi elivaliwe kodwa okuthaphuka iphunga elingabekezeleleki kulona. Uthe bayalele ebebefona ukuthi balunguze ngewindi babheke ukuthi akulengi muntu yini ngentambo, babuyisa impendulo ethi babona sengathi kukhona olele embhedeni."Sinikele khona, sagqekeza, nebala sazithela phezu kowesifazane elele embhedeni, eshonile,” kusho uSomhlaba, othe babe sebebiza amaphoyisa. Uthe kwathi uma beyobuza emaphareni endawo abake babona umufi ehleli nawo, kwabakhona elithi wayehleli nawo ngoJanuwari 1 kodwa wabuye wahamba nomunye wesilisa. "Kwaphinde kwaba khona elinye elithi lahlangana naye ebanjwe ngengalo owesilisa ahamba naye, ephethe ubhushu, ethi uyombulala ngosuku olufanayo,” kusho uSomhlaba. Uveze ukuthi iphara libatshele ukuthi into eyadala ukuthi linganaki ngaleso sikhathi wukuthi kwakungabonakalisi ukuthi umufi uxabene nowesilisa, futhi ngesikhathi ekhuluma kanje, umufi akazange asho lutho ukukhombisa ukuthi impilo yakhe isengcupheni. Uthe ikotishi okutholwe kulo isidumbu sikamufi, elakhe lona wesilisa okuthiwa wabonwa ehamba naye kanti usagcwele amathafa. Uveze ukuthi amaphoyisa alithathile iphara ayolihloma imibuzo njengoba libuye laveza eyokuthi nalo belithandana nomufi futhi lamshiya endlini yowesilisa ngoJanuwari 1, liyomthengela ukudla."Amaphoyisa avele ahamba nalo selihlulwa wukuchaza ukuthi layishiya kanjani intombi yalo endlini yomunye umuntu nokuthi pho lahamba lagcinaphi liyomfunela ukudla. Sisola ukuthi bambulala ngokubambisana,” usho kanje. Okhulumela inhlangano elwela ukuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane, iWomen of uMthwalume, uNksz Nombuso Sibisi, uthe bashaqekile ngesihluku esenzeke kuleya ndawo. "Amadoda awahloniphe abantu besimame, abesimame abagweme ukuphuza nokubhema namadoda, izwe libi,” kusho uNksz Sibisi. Kushaye isikhathi sokushicilela amaphoyisa engakayiphenduli imibuzo ngodaba.
Bebengena umuzi nomuzi bafune o-R50 njalo ngesonto, bathi yimali yokuvikela. Imizi eminingi ibiyikhipha le mali kodwa kungabi namehluko ngoba bebephinde babuye futhi bona laba bafana bazongena ebusuku, bathathe impahla.Kuvela nokuthi bayingxenye yabasolwa abadubule babulala abantu ababili ebebehamba ngemoto iToyota Rumion KwaJina, eNanda, ngoLwesibili.Uthe omunye wababulelwe ngaphambi kokuthi ashonele esigamekweni, uthinte umalume wakhe osezinhlakeni zokuqapha ubugebengu, wamtshela ukuthi obani ababahlasele. KUTHIWA ubefuna ngodli ifa likamalume wakhe okuthiwa udubule wabulala umalumekazi eBhukhanana, eMpangeni, ngoLwesihlanu.Kulesi sigameko, okuthiwa senzeke ekhaya, kufe ngesihluku uNkk Zethu Mzelemu, kwaphinde kwalimala umzukulu wakhe, okuthiwa udubuleke ehlombe.Ngokusho kwesihlobo, uMnuz Zenzele Mzelemu, umsolwa (32) ongumshana kumufi, ubevele engamhlalisile kahle umufi kulandela ukufa komyeni wakhe (ongumalume kumsolwa) ngo-2022. "Abebesondelene nomufi bathi umshana ubehlala ahlale amxakazise, athi ufuna ifa alinikwa umalume wakhe ngaphambi kokuba ashone,” kusho uMzelemu. Elandisa uthe kulona kukhona izindlu zemiqasho, izinkomo kanjalo nomuzi obekuhlala kuwo laba ababeganene, nokuyiwo agcine ebulalela kuwo umufi.Uthe abakhumbuli ikhona incwadi yefa eyayicacisa obekushiwo umsolwa futhi akekho nokhumbulayo umyeni kamufi ethi umsolwa akonikezwa lezi zinto esikhundleni sokuthi zithathwe umkakhe. "Yinto esingazi ukuthi iyinkulumo eqhamukaphi,” usho kanje.Uqhube wathi kwenzeka isigameko nje, bese kunesikhashana umsolwa eviliyela ngesibhamu egcekeni, njengoba naye ebehlala kuwo lo muzi, esabisa ngokuthi yena "uzodubula umuntu”."Kuthiwa uqale ukwenza le nto sekusondele uKhisimusi kodwa banganaka. Kuthe uma sekwenzeka kanje, sezwa ubuhlungu bokuthi ukube savele sayibika le ndlela yakhe yokuhlupha emaphoyiseni, mhlawumbe ngabe usaphila umakoti ngoba abezomphuca isibhamu,” kubalisa uMzelemu. Udalule ukuthi ngosuku lwesigameko, bekuhleli umhlangano emini phakathi kukamufi, umsolwa namanye amalungu omndeni, yize ebengaphelele."Inhloso bekuwukuthi kubhungwe ngalo lolu daba, nokho sithole ukuthi lo mhlangano awuzange uphethe kahle njengoba kuvele kwashuba ingxabano phakathi kukamsolwa nomufi. Nakhona lapho kuthiwa uphinde wawakhipha amazwi okuthi yena uzodubula umuntu kanti uzovele akwenze ngempela ebusuku,” kusho uMzelemu.Uthe bathole ukuthi umsolwa ungene ngewindi, wayobheka umufi ekameleni lakhe. Kwathi uma engamfici, wedlulela kwelezingane nokuyilapho amfice khona elele nezimbili, wavele wavulela ngenhlamvu, umufi wathulela khona lapho, eyodwa yadubuleka, yaphuthunyiswa esibhedlela, enye yaphuma ingenamyocu. Kuvela ukuthi umsolwa zimkhalele ngoMgqibelo, kulandela ukubhadanywa kwakhe ngamaphoyisa emva kokuthathwa kwesidumbu, ezulazula egcekeni ethi ucinga izinhlamvu zakhe ezilahlekile."Uthe ulahlekelwe yizinhlamvu eziyisithupha. Kanti amaphoyisa aselutholile ulwazi lokuthi ngesikhathi kwenzeka isigameko udubule izikhawu eziyisithupha. Amthathe khona lapho ayomhloma ngemibuzo, kwaphetha ngokuthi avalelwe,” usho kanje. Uveze ukuthi ngaphambi kwalokho, umsolwa ubesetshele amaphoyisa ukuthi umufi uhlaselwe ngabasolwa abangaziwa kodwa futhi kwaba nguye kuqala okhombisa abantu ukuthi isidumbu sikamufi singakuphi.Uthe bewumndeni balinde ukubona kwenzeka ubulungiswa ngoba abakaze bayibone into enje selokhu bazalwa. "Umuntu abulale igazi lakhe? Asikaze siyizwe into enje,” kubabaza uMzelemu othe balindele ukuthi umthetho udlale indima yawo.Uthe umsolwa ubesebenza njengonogada ngaphambi kokuba alahlekelwe umsebenzi ngasekupheleni konyaka odlule, wase eba umuntu ozihlalela ekhaya. Uthe isibhamu abulale ngaso umufi esakhe esisemthethweni. Kushaye isikhathi sokushicilela amaphoyisa engakayiphenduli imibuzo ngalolu daba.
UZWAKALISE ukukhathazeka ngefu elimnyama eligubuzele indawo yaseMzumbe ngezigameko zokubulawa kwabantu ngesihluku uMphathiswa wokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi, uNksz Mbali Shinga. UNksz Shinga usho lokhu ngoMsombuluko ngesikhathi eyohlanganisa amehlo nemindeni emibili edlulelwe yizihlobo eziyisithupha ezigamekweni ezehlukene. KwesaKwaDweshula esenzeke ngoDisemba 31, kubulawe amalungu omndeni amane. Kuthiwa abasolwa abane abangaziwa bakhahlele isicabha sendlu engurawondi, bafica owesifazane ehleli nomyeni wakhe. Kuthiwa abathathu bebephethe izibhamu, oyedwa ephethe ubhushu. Kuvela ukuthi bafune imali ngodli, nokuthe uma betshelwa ukuthi ayikho, badubula owesilisa (45), wafa. Kuthiwa babe sebeyalela owesifazane ukuthi abakhombise ukuthi amanye amalungu omndeni akuphi. Kuthiwa ubaphelezele wabayisa endlini enkulu nokuyilapho befice khona owesifazane nezingane zakhe ezimbili, babadubula bobathathu, base bebaleka namaselula. KwesakwaBangibizo, eMthwalume, kudutshulwe, kwabulawa uMnuz Siboniso Mteshane (31) nomzala wakhe uMnuz Kwanele Gumede (33).Kuthiwa badutshulwe wumuntu obehilizisane noGumede emgwaqweni, emva kokuthi eshayise esinye isihlobo kubuywa embondweni wesihlobo. Kuvele ukuthi umsolwa usongele uGumede ngokuthi uzomdubula nokuthe sekuhlwile wabuya wazomdubula ngempela. UNksz Shinga ohambele le mindeni uthe: "Kuyasikhathaza ukwanda kwezigameko zalolu hlobo esifundeni uGu, ngaphansi kukaMasipala waseMzumbe. Le ndawo igubuzelwe yifu elimnyama ngezigameko zalolu hlobo. Lokhu kudala ukuthi umphakathi wonke ube sosizini.” Uthe ukwanda kwezigameko sekuholele ekutheni umphakathi wonke uhlalele ovalweni. Uthe bewumnyango bathumele osonhlalakahle ukuthi basize ngokweluleka imindeni yabafi ngokwengqondo, baphinde bathathe imininingwane yabo ukuze kubhekwe ukuthi yiluphi olunye usizo abanganikezwa lona ngokuqhubeka kwesikhathi.
INHLANGANO engenzinzuzo ebhekele inhlalakahle yomphakathi iGatekeepers South Africa ihlabe ikhwelo kuhulumeni lokuthi kunyuswe iminyaka yabantu abavumeleke ukuthenga utshwala isuke ku-18, iye ku-23 ukuzama ukunqanda ukubhebhetheka kwesihlava sezingane nabantu abasha abacwile ezinkanjini zikaFaro.Umqondisi wale nhlangano, uNksz Lizelle Maurice, uthe esinye sezizathu ezenze ukuthi bahlabe leli khwelo wukubona okuningi konakala ezweni njengoba belokhu bande njalo abantu abaphuza utshwala ngokungenamkhawulo emphakathini."Konke lokhu kunomthelela omubi emphakathini njengoba sonke sazi futhi sibona kahle ukuthi ukuphuza kwabantu utshwala ngokweqile ngesinye sezizathu eziholela ekutheni kwande izingozi ezilimaza futhi zibulale abantu emigwaqweni mihla namalanga, futhi singekushalazele ukuthi utshwala buneqhaza ezenzweni zodlame esizibona zenzeka nsuku zonke emphakathini kulabo abahlulwa wukuzilawula,” kusho uNksz Maurice.Eqhuba, uthe leli khwelo labo babona lizosiza ngokuthi kulawuleke indlela abantu abathenga utshwala ngayo njengoba kuzovimbela ukuthi utshwala bungathengwa yinoma wubani ngoba abanye abantu abana-18 basuke besengabafundi ezikoleni zamabanga aphezulu."Vele ngisho noma ucwaninga ngomzimba womuntu nokukhula kwawo, kuyavela ukuthi umuntu nomuntu uthuthuka futhi agcwale kahle emzimbeni nasemqondweni wakhe uma eseneminyaka ewu-25, ngakho lokho kuthi sithi okungenani akube wu-23 iminyaka okuvumeleka abantu ukuthenga utshwalangayo,” usho kanje.Uthe bafuna nokuthi kuvalwe ukukhangiswa kotshwala, okungaba yisemisakazweni, kwithelevishini nakwezinye izinhlelo zokukhangisa - abakholwa wukuthi kubhebhethekisa inkinga yokuphuza utshwala ngokweqile ngoba kuheha izingane zibone sengathi yinto enhle."Konke lokhu okwenzekayo manje kubhebhethekisa le nkinga, njengoba sike sibone ukuthi manje abantu abasakwazi ukujabula kahle ngaphandle kokuphuza utshwala, kangangokuthi ngisho nezingane ezincane imbala sekulula ukuthi zilutheke ngokuphuza utshwala. Kuyasikhathaza futhi ukuthi kunenqwaba yezingane nabantu besifazane abanukubezwayo emphakathini ngenxa yokuthi basuke sebephuze ngokweqile bengaboni lutho,” kusho yena.UNksz Maurice ugcizelele nokuthi kumele kuqiniswe umthetho ebantwini nasezinkampanini ezidayisa utshwala, ukusiza ukuthi kungabi lula ukuthi baphule umthetho ngokudayisela izingane ezincane utshwala, nangokudayisa utshwala ngokungemthetho.

UMNYANGO wezokuThutha kuzwelonke usamukele isinqumo seNkantolo eNkulu yaseNorth Gauteng sokuhoxisa ithenda yokuthengwa komshini omusha wokugaya amalayisensi okushayela.Ngonyaka odlule umnyango wamemezela inkampani i-IDEMIA njengethole ithenda eyayikhangiswe ngo-2023.Umbiko woMcwaningimabhuku Jikelele owaphuma ngasekuqaleni konyaka odlule waveza ukuthi kunokuningi okungalandelwanga kahle ngethenda nokwenza ukuthi umnyango uye enkantolo.Imibiko yangaleso sikhathi yathi okunye okwakhalwa ngakho wukuthi ithimba elathunyelwa ukuthi liyobuka umshini owawuzothengwa labuka okungewona owawuzothengwa futhi lalisezweni elingafanele.Umnyango wawulinganisele ukuthi ithenda izodla u-R486 million kodwa zonke izinkampani ezafaka zazibiza imali engaphezulu. Kwagcina kugunyazwe eye-IDEMIA ka-R898 million.Esitatimendeni izolo, uNgqongqoshe uBarbara Creecy nePhini lakhe uMnuz Mkhuleko Hlengwa basamukele isinqumo senkantolo esikhishwe ngoLwesibili.Bathe inkantolo inqume ukuthi ithenda iyahoxiswa futhi umnyango uyalelwe ukuthi ukhiphe isikhangiso esisha zingakapheli izinsuku ezingu-30. Umnyango uvunyelwe ukuthi usebenzise uMnyango wezaseKhaya ukugaya amalayisensi ngesikhathi kusalindwe ukuthi kuqokwe inkampani entsha.Umshini wokugaya amalayisensi usuneminyaka ukhona futhi uhlale ufa kugcine kunokubambezeleka ekukhipheni amasha.Umnyango, emuva kokuthi umshini ukade ufile ngoFebhuwari kuya kuMeyi nyakenye, wakwazi ukugaya owawusilele ngawo ngemuva kwagaywa angu-2 239 456 phakatthi kukaMeyi 8 noDisemba 8.Uveze ukuthi aphasisiwe amakhadi amasha futhi sekuzoqala uhlelo lokuthi agunyazwe yikhabhinethi.

Sanele isikhathi esimnikeze sona, engakwazi ukubuya ezokwethula ubufakazi kuleli. Uma ubheka izinsolo abhekene nazo angazi ukuthi yini lena emenza ukuthi asabe ukuvela phambi kwekomiti. Kufanele sithumele umyalezo oqinile lapha ukuthi akekho umuntu ongaphezu komthetho. Naye kufanele azi ukuthi akayilutho. NoMogotsi naye akufanele simncenge. Kufanele sithumele inqola edonswa izimbongolo, iyomlanda. Ucabanga ukuthi siyadlala lana. Ucabanga ukuthi singabangani bakhe laba adlala nabo."Ilungu leMKP, uMnuz Vusi Shongwe, lithe u-O'Sullivan kufanele aphucwe i-passport khona engeke ekwazi ukubalekela amacala akhe."Ngike ngasho ukuthi uzobaleka lo baba njengoba manje sesitshelwa ukuthi useLondon."Imihlangano yekomiti izoqala ngesonto elizayo. Phakathi kwabantu abazobizwa, kubalwa owayengukhomishana wamaphoyisa, uLieutenant General Khomotso Phahlane, isikhulu sezinhloni uLieutenant General Dumisani Khumalo nesikhulu samaPhoyisa kuMasipala waseKurhuleni, uBrigadier Julius Mkhwanazi.
KUHLEHLE isigcawu sokuqondisa ubugwegwe uMphathiswa wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi KwaZulu-Natal, uNksz Mbali Shinga, oshushiselwa ukushaya indiva umyalelo weqembu wokuba aseke isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli.Isigcawu sokuqondisa uNksz Shinga obekufanele siqale izolo, sihlehliswe emva kokuba abameli bakhe becele ukuhlinzekwa ngamanye amadokodo. Isigcawu sizoqhubeka namhlanje, eThekwini.UNobhala weNFP obambile, uMnuz Sunset Xaba, uthe abameli bakaNksz Shinga bebefuna ukuthi isigcawu sihlehliselwe isonto elizayo."Bebecele ukuthi sihlehliselwe uJanuwari 15, kodwa ummeli wethu wanqaba. Usihlalo wesigcawu ube esenquma ukuthi isigcawu siqhubeke kusasa (namhlanje)."UXaba uthe usole abameli bakaNksz Shinga ngokuzama ukubambezela ukuhlala kwesigcawu."Ummeli wethu wayekade ebabuzile ukuthi abezukuwadinga yini la madokodo, bathi angeke bawadinge. Simangalile uma sebefika phambi kwesigcawu sebethi bafuna ukunikezwa wona."UXaba uthe bazobiza isithangami sabezindaba uma sekuphothulwe isigcawu, lapho bezomemezela isinqumo sabo.UNksz Shinga ubizelwe phambi kwesigcawu sokuqondiswa ubugwegwe emva kokuba aphikisa isiphakamiso seMKP sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNtuli esasilalelwe esiShayamthetho, ngeyedlule.UMengameli weNFP, uMnuz Ivan Barnes, wayekade ethe bazoseseka isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNtuli nokwanikeza iMKP amathemba okuthi isiphakamiso sayo sizophumelela njengoba iNFP ingababeki benkosi kuhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal.Kwashintsha ukudla epuletini ngesikhathi sekulalelwe isiphakamiso, lapho khona uNksz Shinga aveze ukungahambisani naso.Iqembu labe selithatha isinqumo sokumumisa, laphinde lazama nokumkhipha esiShayamthetho.Ubuholi beNFP busanda kuyalela uNksz Shinga ukuba asule esikhundleni sokuba uMphathiswa kanti bufuna iqembu lihoxe kuhulumeni wokubambisana ophethe KwaZulu-Natal, bese livota neMK.I-NFP iyona engaba beki benkosi kuhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal.
SEKUQUBE uvalo ebantwini baseMzimkhulu abangamaBhaca ngemuva kokuba kwethulwe enye inkosi ekubeni ikhona inkosi ebusa endaweni.NgoDisemba 30, kube nendumezulu yembizo lapho khona uMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal, obuzokwethula khona ngokusemthethweni uMnuz uXolani Zulu njengeNkosi yaseMfulamhle, okuyindawo engaphansi koMzimkhulu.Le mbizo iqhubeke ngaphezulu kokuba amaBhaca asekuveze kaningi ukuthi kawahambisani nokubekwa kukaZulu njengenkosi yakule ndawo.Esithangami sabezindaba esabizwa yiNkosi yamaBhaca yaseMzimkhulu, uNtobeko Msingaphantsi, yezwakalisa ukuphoxeka kwayo okukhulu ngezindaba zokuthi uZulu uzobekwa abe yinkosi eMfulamhle.UMsingaphantsi wachaza lokhu njengento eyimbudane wase ehlaba ehlikiza uMphathiswa woMnyango wezokuBusa, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, wathi uyena odala uqhekeko esizweni samaBhaca.UMnyango waziphendulela ngalezi zinsolo uzichitha kodwa wathi uyazi ngodaba lwaseMfulamhle, eMzimkhulu. Kwakuphawula uMnuz Senzelwe Mzila okhulumela lo Mnyango.Nokho njengoba ukwethulwa kukaZulu kugcine kwenzekile, umphakathi uvutha ungabaselwe njengoba ukholwa ukuthi uyachwenswa futhi usola uMnyango wezokuBusa ngemizamo yokudla ngodli isizwe samaBhaca. Inkosi uMsingaphantsi ikhuluma neSolezwe izolo, ifunge yagomela yathi lokhu okwenzekayo manje kuzodala ukuthi kube noqhekeko esizweni samaBhaca, kungagcini lapho aphinde aqothane wodwa.UMsingaphantsi uthe uyafunga, angeke aze agcotshwe uZulu yena esadla anhlamvana, wathi angamane anikele ngeyakhe impilo. Uthe uma evumela lokhu abantu bayobuza yena ukuthi wathula wathini kuhlakazwa amaBhaca aseMzimkhulu?''Okubuhlungu ukuthi amaBhaca aqhathwa ngumuntu okuhulumeni. Inkinga ukuthi uzowaqhatha ebese eshiya kanjalo kugobhoza igazi ebese eyaqhela emva kwalokho,'' usho kanjena ezwakala ukuthi ugcwele intukuthelo.Uthe kuyamxaka ukuthi uZulu angabekwa kanjani njengenkosi endaweni yenkosi futhi ngokuzalwa ebe engowaKwaNokweja, eXobho? ''Angiyazi le nto mina futhi uma kukhulunywa ngayo ngivele ngizizwe ngithuthumela kakhulu kunakuqala ngoba iyangicasula futhi kakhulu kabi. Okungicika kakhulu ukuthi uButhelezi wasibiza ezositshela ngoZulu samchitha, kodwa uyaphikelela ngoba unezinhloso anazo,'' usho kanje.Uveze ukuthi ngelanga lokubekwa kukaZulu, uyena owawanqanda amabutho amaBhaca ayethukuthele egane unwabu sekusele kancane ukuba agasele emcimbini.''Yimina lo owanqanda amabutho ngathi mawabuye. Ukube angizange ngikwenze lokho, awungitshele nje ukuthi kwakuyokwenzekani? Ngeke yini ligobhoze igazi uma kunjena, ngiyabuza?”Uthi ngesikhathi uButhelezi ebatshela ngoZulu wathi kuyaphoqa ukuba abekwe njengenkosi ngoba uyise ongasekho wayengamathe nolimu neSilo esesabuza uMdlokombane.''Thina siyakweshwama nje ukuthi umuntu unikwa ubukhosi ngoba nakhu uyise wayezwana neSilo. Umsangano muni nje lona ngempela?”Eqhuba uthe okumcike kakhulu ukuthi ezikhangisweni zoMnyango ngaphambi komcimbi, bekuvela sengathi uButhelezi uzokwenza umcimbi kaKhisimusi wezaguga, gwiqiqi sekwethulwa uZulu njengeNkosi yaseMfulamhle.''Kusho ukuthi uButhelezi ubazi kahle ukuthi ubezokwenzani laphaya eMfulamhle,” kusho uMsingaphantsi."Namhlanje sizogcina usiko njengoba inkosi yenu iye eNdlunkulu kaZulu yayothela amanzi lapho bekuyohlanjululwa khona isihlalo sikayise ihamba nomndeni. Inkosi beyingeyodwa ngesikhathi kwenziwa lolu siko, bekukhona amanye amakhosi amahlanu. Usiko lokuthela amanzi kalwenziwa unoma ngubani ngoba yilona olucacisayo ukuthi iNgonyama iyayemukela inkosi yaphinde yangeniswa esibayeni yathelwa ngenyongo,'' kusho uButhelezi ekhuluma emcimbini wokubeka uZulu.UMntwana uThulani Thulu okhulumela iSilo uMisuzulu kaZwelithini naye ekhuluma kulo mcimbi, ukwamukele ukubekwa kukaZulu. "Uyise wenkosi esihlangene ngayo lapha oqale ukubuyisela ubudlelwano neNdlunkulu kaZulu nangaphambi kokuba uMzimkhulu ubuyiselwe ngaphansi kwesifundazwe. Ubukhosi balapha eMfulamhle buphelele, kabushodi ngalutho njengoba bukwazi nokuzenzela uMkhosi wokweShwama. Njengoba neNkosi uXolani enzelwe nosiko lokuthela amanzi kusho ukuthi ubukhosi balapha ekhaya buphelele” kuchaza uMntwana uThulani.Okhulumela uMnyango wezokuBusa neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu Natal, uMnuz Senzelwe Mzila, uthe uMnyango usamile kowakusho ngaphambilini, okuthi kalikho iphutha ekubekweni kukaZulu njengeNkosi yaseMfulamhle.
KUMSHUBELE uMphathiswa wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi KwaZulu-Natal, uNksz Mbali Shinga, njengoba eyalelwe wubuholi beqembu ukuthi asule esikhundleni futhi ezophinde avele phambi kwesigcawu sokuqondiswa ubugwegwe.Ubuholi beNFP bunqumele uNksz Shinga umnqamulajuqu wakusasa ukuba ashiye esikhundleni, bathatha isinqumo sokuthi iqembu lihoxe ngokusemthethweni kuhulumeni wokubambisana ophethe KwaZulu-Natal. Isinqumo sithathwe emhlanganweni wesigungu esiphezulu kwiNFP ebesiwubambe ngokuhlanganyela nobuholi benhlangano KwaZulu-Natal. Isolezwe libone incwadi ebhalwe nguNobhala Jikelele weNFP obambile, uMnuz Sunset Xaba, eqinisekisa isinqumo esithathwe emhlanganweni wangoMsombuluko.Le ncwadi ibhekiswe kuSihlalo weNFP KwaZulu-Natal obambile, uNksz Zoe Mtshali. UXaba unqabile ukuphawula ngalolu daba ngesikhathi ethintwa yiSolezwe."Sicela nike nithi ukusimela kancane ke silunguse lolu daba ngaphakathi. Sizokhipha isitatimende esizothunyelwa onke amaziko ezindaba uma sesiluqedile."UNksz Shinga uzovela phambi kwesigcawu sokuqondiswa ubugwegwe namhlanje, lapho eshushiselwa ukushaya indiva umyalelo weqembu lakhe iNFP wokuba aseke isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli.Isigcawu sokuqondisa uNksz Shinga ubugwegwe sibekelwe izinsuku ezintathu, kusuka namuhla.UNksz Shinga ubizelwe phambi kwesigcawu sokuqondiswa ubugwegwe emva kokuba aphikisa isiphakamiso seMK sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNtuli esasilalelwe esiShayamthetho, ngeyedlule.UMengameli weNFP, uMnuz Ivan Barnes, wayekade ethe bazoseseka isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNtuli nokwanikeza iMK amathemba okuthi isiphakamiso sayo sizophumelela njengoba iNFP ingababeki benkosi kuhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal.Kwashintsha ukudla epuletini ngesikhathi sekulalelwe isiphakamiso, lapho khona uNksz Shinga aveze ukungahambisani naso.Iqembu labe selithatha isinqumo sokumumisa, laphinde lazama nokumkhipha esiShayamthetho.UXaba Ukuqinisekisile ukuthi sizoqhubeka isigcawu.Umthombo uthe uNksz Shinga usamile ekutheni isigungu esiphezulu eqenjini asinawo amandla okumthathela izinyathelo kodwa wathi abameli bakhe bazokuya ukuyovela phambi kwesigcawu."Abameli bazokuya ngenxa yokuthi wenzela ukuthi uma udaba luya enkantolo kungashiwo ukuthi akazange aye ukuyoziphendulela phambi kobuholi beqembu. Kodwa namanje usasho ukuthi ubuholi beqembu abunawo amandla okumthathela izinyathelo. Asikho isigaba somthetho weqembu esinika isigungu esiphezulu amandla okuba sithathele ilungu izinyathelo zokuqondiswa ubugwegwe."Akukhona okokuqala uNksz Shinga, onguSihlalo weNFP KwaZulu-Natal, etholana phezulu nobuholi beqembu.Ubuholi beqembu buke bazama ukumkhipha esiShayamthetho ngoJuni, kodwa behluleka.Buphinde bazama ukumthathela izinyathelo zokuqondiswa ubugwegwe ngawo unyaka owedlule kepha uNksz Shinga wathola isivimbelo senkantolo esanqanda ukuthathelwa kwakhe izinyathelo.

AKANAVALO lokuthi iMelika ingahlasela elakuleli, uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, njengoba muva nje uhulumeni kaMengameli Donald Trump, uhlasela amazwe ahlukene.URamaphosa obekhuluma nabezindaba ngemuva kwesikhumbuzo somholi weSACP ongasekho uMnuz Joe Slovo izolo, eSoweto, uthe akanavalo lokuthi iMelika ingase ihlasele elakuleli kulandela ukugasela eVenezuela, lapho ishaqe uMengameli wakhona, uMnuz Nicolas Maduro, yabopha nowakwakhe."Angithukile ukuthi uhulumeni kaMengameli Donald Trump ungasihlasela. Asihambisani nakwenze eVenezuela, akudedelwe ngokushesha umengameli wakhona nowakwakhe," usho kanje.Kuyaziwa ukuthi uTrump akayiziswisi kahle indaba yakuleli, kulandela izinsolo zokuthi kuhlukunyezwa abalimi abamhlophe okuthathwa umhlaba wabo ngendlakadla. Lucace bha uqhekeko kulesi sikhumbuzo ngesikhathi isigejana samalungu amaKhomanisi, ecula ingoma ethi awayifuni iGNU, ngesikhathi sekuzokhuluma uRamaphosa.Kudingeke ukuthi iPhini likaSihlalo wamaKhomanisi, uMnuz Thulas Nxesi, lincenge lesi sigejana ukuthi noma singayifuni iGNU kodwa asivumele uRamaphosa akhulume."Noma ningayifuni iGNU, yekelani uMengameli we-ANC ukuthi athule inkulumo. Ningenzi into eniyibona yenziwa kwezinye izinhlangano," kunxusa uNxesi.Kube sekuba nelinye iqulu elihlabelele ingoma eyeseka uRamaphosa, ethi bayamthanda futhi bayameseka. URamaphosa, esethula inkulumo kulo mcimbi obusemalibeni okufihlwe kuwona amaqhawe, i-Heroes’ Acre, Avalon Cemetery, uthe kuzoba yiphutha elikhulu emlandweni ukuthi amaKhomanisi angenele ukhetho ngokuzimela."Siyasihlonipha isinqumo sokuthi amaKhomanisi azimele okhethweni kodwa asihambisani naso. Lesi sinyathelo sizontengisa amadlelandawonye, sizodida nabantu abangeke bazi ukuthi bazovotela bani. Sizosibeka engcupheni yokuthi silahlekelwe amandla ombuso," usho kanje.Uthe bazoqhubeka baxoxe neSACP ngalesi sinyathelo ngoba kudingeka kubunjwane."Siyayimema iSACP ukuthi ibe yingxenye yomgubho we-ANC iJanuwari 8 ngempelasonto. Phumani ngobuningi benu nize emgubhweni we-ANC, njengoba nathi siphume ngobuningi ukuzothamela isikhumbuzo sikaSlovo." URamaphosa uthe kumele balwele into eyodwa ukuthi bakhulule abantu ebubheni.UNobhala Jikelele weSACP, uMnuz Solly Mapaila, uxolisile kuRamaphosa ngokwenzekile ngaphambi kokuba athule inkulumo, wathi usehhewulwe izikhawu eziningi yiziwengu ze-ANC selokhu bamemezela ukuthi bazongenela ukhetho.Uveze ukuthi abajiki, bahlabela phambili nesinqumo sokungenela ukhetho."Asidali qhekeko ngalesi sinqumo sokungenela ukhetho sodwa. Sihlale sifuna kube nobumbano kumadlelandawonye. Asizondi noma asiqonde muntu ngalesi sinqumo sokuzimela okhethweni," usho kanje. Uchithe nokuthi ufuqa umkhankaso wokuzimela okhethweni ngoba efuna ukujutshelwa kuhulumeni."Angifune kuya kuhulumeni mina. Baningi abanye omengameli ababenginxenxa ukuthi ngibe yingxenye yeKhabhinethi kodwa nginqabe. NamaKhomanisi aseke ayiphakamisa eyokuthi ngiye kuhulumeni kodwa ngiwachithe ngoba yinto engingayiboni ngiyenza okwamanje. Mhlawumbe ngomuso yinto engingayenza kodwa hhayi manje."Uthe amadlelandawonye abhekene nezingqinamba okumele zilungiswe."Sizoba yingxenye yomgubho we-ANC, mengameli, ngempelasonto. Siyohleli siyingxenye yamadlelandawonye, noma singenela ukhetho," usho kanje.

UKHUNGATHEKILE umndeni wowesilisa waseXobho ngemuva kokuba edutshulwe wafa emva kokusongelwa ngokuthi ngeke aze awubone unyaka omusha ngisho esethanda.Umufi, uMnuz Zwakele Gumbi (43), Isolezwe lithole ukuthi udutshulwe ngabantu abangaziwa esegcekeni lakubo ntambama ngosuku lokuqala onyakeni.Kuvela ukuthi umufi ubenendlu yakhe yedwa kubo abamhlasele ezihlalele kuyona. UNksz Zama Gumbi ongudadewabo kamufi uthe kungene abesilisa ababili egcekeni begijima baqonda ngqo endlini kamufi bafike bamdubula.Uthe bamfice kahle elele evule umnyango. "Umfowethu ubekuthanda ukulala evule umnyango kwesinye isikhathi, umama ubeke amkhuze amtshele ukuthi akovala umnyango uma eselala. Kodwa ubeqhubeka akwenze lokho ngoba bekuyinto ebethanda nje ukuyenza,” usho kanjena.Eqhuba uthe bezwe sekuzamula inganono nje amahlandla amathathu base bebona abesilisa bephuma bebaleka bebheke ngasesangweni elikhulu.''Laba besilisa baphume sebegijima izibhamu beziphethe ngezandla. Kuthe uma siphuma siyobheka umfowethu samfica eselele phezu kwegazi phansi. Bamdubule kabi esiphongweni nasesifubeni,” kuchaza yena.Uthe akukho abakuthathile endlini okufakazela khona ukuthi bebefuna umphefumulo wakhe nje kuphela.Uthe ngabe uqamba amanga uma engathi bayabazi abenzi bobubi, bebeqala ukubabona. Uthe bashaqekile kakhulu ngendlela okwenzeke ngayo.''Besingakulindele ukuthi umfowethu angamane abulawe nje kalula kanjalo kube sengathi kunqunywa inkukhu nje. Impela abanye abantu bayakwazi ukwenza into yabo futhi kabasenanembeza sebemane bakhiphe umphefumulo womuntu nje kube sengathi bakhipha umphefumulo wegundane,” kusho yena.Utshele Isolezwe ukuthi umfowabo yize ebengumuntu wokuthula noxolo kodwa uke wabatshela ukuthi kukhona abathile abamsongela ngokuthi ngeke aze awubone unyaka omusha.''BekunguNovemba umfowethu esitshela ekhaya ukuthi kunabathile abasonga ngokuthi bazombulala ngeke aze awufice unyaka omusha. Waze wahlengezela izinyembezi ngesikhathi esitshela lokhu,” kuchaza yena.Uqhube wathi kodwa umfowabo wala waphetha ukubatshela uma bembuza ukuthi ngobani labo futhi ubangani nabo.''Wamane wasiphendula ngokuthi kwenele ukuthi usitshelile iqiniso ukuze singathuki uma kwenzeka ehamba emhlabeni. Nathi akubanga lula nhlobo ukuthi siqhubeke nokuthi simbuze imibuzo eminingi ngoba isimo sakhe sasithusa kakhulu,” kuchaza yena.Uthe yize abatshela lokhu umufi kodwa belikhona ithemba lokuthi mhlawumbe yinto engeke yenzeke wayemane ezisholo nje."Yize asitshela sakhuluma ngakho sisodwa kodwa sacabanga ukuthi yinto edlulayo futhi ezogcina ingazange yenzeke nhlobo. Sasingazi ukuthi simane siyazikhohlisa nje ingane yakwethu ngampela kabadlali uma bethi ngeke iwubone unyaka omusha,” usho kanjena.Uthe okubuhlungu kakhulu wukuthi kuyimanje badukuza ebumnyameni ngokuthi ngobani abambulele. Uthe bafisa ukuthi ngabe bamphoqa umufi ukuba agonyuluke ngakho konke ukuze babe nesithombe esigcwele sokuthi kwenzekani?"Manje akusasizi ukuthi sibalise ngokuthi asizange simphoqe ngoba vele selidume lamthatha,” kuchaza yena.Uveze ukuthi umfowabo ubeneziqu zobuthishela kodwa ubengakaze abe nenhlanhla yokuthola umsebenzi. Uthe ubeziphilisa ngesitolo ebesikhona egcekeni asiqala eminyakeni emine eyedlule.''Isitolo sakhe besenza kahle ngoba nathi besibona ukuthi unabo abathengi futhi nenzuzo iyabonakala. Ngabe sisola sona kodwa asikhumbuli esixoxela ukuthi kukhona abanganeme ngenxa yaso,” kuchaza yena.Uthe nomphakathi ubesebenzisana nawo kahle kakhulu njengoba ebephinde abakweletele abangenayo imali. "Ubekwazi umfowethu ukusebenzisana nabathengi bakhe yingakho nje nabo bebengapheli bezothenga kuyena,” kusho yena.Uthe sebethembe amaphoyisa ukuthi athole abenzi bobubi bese bebhadla ijele. Amaphoyisa aKwaZulu-Natal akuqinisekisile ukuthi kunowesilisa odutshulwe wafa eXobho. Athe kuphenywa icala lokubulala futhi kuthungathwa abasolwa.
BABEKELWE umnqamulajuqu wangelizayo, ababhekene nengwadla yokuchithwa yisikhwama iNational Student Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS) ngokuxhaswa kulo nyaka.Bayalelwe ukuthi babe sebefake izicelo zokuthi kubuyekezwe lesi sinqumo, ngoJanuwari 14, 2026.UDkt Mugwena Maluleke, ibamba likaSihlalo walesi sikhwama, uthe abachithwe yilesi sikhwama, abasheshe bafake izimangalo ungakashayi uJanuwari 14. Bacela ku-50 000 abachithwe ukuthi bathole uxhaso ngoba abazali babo behola imali engaphezu kuka-R350 000, ngonyaka."Livuliwe ithuba lokuthi kufakwe izimangalo kulabo abachithwe ekutholeni uxhaso. Sizokhipha isinqumo sokuthi izicelo zabo zihambe kanjani ngoFebhuwari 16, 2026," usho kanje ekhuluma nabezindaba esithangamini ebesisePitoli izolo. Uthe kumele balethe zonke izimfanelo zabo abachithwe ekutholeni uxhaso.Uveze ukuthi bazojuba abasebenzi abazosiza ezikhungweni zemfundo kusuka ngoJanuwari 13 kuya ekupheleni kukaMashi."Sizoqala sifake imali ezikhungweni ekupheleni kwale nyanga ukuze ixhase izitshudeni ngezinto ezehlukene. Asifuni kube nezitshudeni ezizoba omantunta nendishi, ezinye ezizolala endle ngoba kuthiwa imali ayifakiwe," kuqhuba uMaluleke.Uveze nokuthi abangu-520 000 abaxhasiwe abahola imali yesibonelelo sakwaSASSA."Babalelwa ku-25 000 abaphila nokukhubazeka abaxhasiwe. Isibalo esikhulu sabaxhasiwe abesifazane, okusho khona ukuthi yibona abaningi emfundweni ephakeme. Abaningi abaxhasiwe yintsha eneminyaka engu-20. Abanye abaneminyaka engu-30." usho kanje. UMaluleke udalule nokuthi kunabangu-621 abaneminyaka engu-50 kuya phezulu abaxhasiwe kulo nyaka.UMnuz Waseem Carrim, isikhulu esiphezulu seNSFAS, uthe kunokukhuluma okuningi okukhona okuthinta nendaba yokuthi sikhona yini isidingo salesi sikhwama njengoba umsebenzi esasungulelwa wona sewenziwa ngezinye izinkampani ezizimele.Uthe okunye ukukhuluma kuveza ukuthi kumele amanyuvesi aziphathele imali ukuze kube yiwo axhasa ngqo izitshudeni."Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi kwawona amanyuvesi awamsulwa ekuphathweni kwemali. Amanye abuyisela izigidi kwiNSFAS ngakho ngibona lesi sikhwama sisabaluleke kakhulu emsebenzini wokuxhasa izitshudeni," usho kanje. Usho lokhu nje uNgqongqoshe wezeziMali uMnuz Enoch Godongwana, wathi ngeke ananaze ukuvala lesi sikhwama uma enikwa imvume.Wakhala ngokuthi asisawenzi umsebenzi esasungulelwa wona ngoba sesiwudlulisele ezinkampanini ezizimele. Waveza nokuthi isikhulu esiphezulu salesi sikhwama sihola ngaphezulu kukamengameli wezwe.UCarrim uthe abafuni zihlupheke kakhulu izitshudeni ezixhaswa yilesi sikhwama ngendawo yokuhlala.Kuhlale kuba nezikhalo njalo uma kuqala unyaka izitshudeni zilale endle ngoba zisuke zingakhokhelwe yiNSFAS. Omastende bagcina sebezijikijela emnyango befuna ukukhokhelwa.
UNOBHALA Jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, uthe uyazi ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika ngeke ilibone elidlalayo uma iMelika ingase inqume ukugasela.UMbalula uthe alikho izwe elingamelana neMelika kwezempi kodwa wathi ukuba namandla kweMelika kwezempi ngeke kwenze ukuthi bayocasha ngezidwaba.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba ephawula ngokugasela kweMelika eVenezuela.UMbalula uthe abahambisani nesenzo seMelika sokubopha uMengameli waseVenezuela, uNicolás Maduro nonkosikazi wakhe, uCilia Flores.INingizimu Afrika nayo inyamanambana kwiMelika selokhu kwangena uMengameli Donald Trump, osola elakuleli ngokuhlukumeza amaBhunu.Ebuzwa ukuthi umbutho wakuleli ukulungele yini ukubhekana neMelika uma inquma ukugasela kuleli, uMbalula uthe iMelika ayinantanga kwezempi."Okokuqala okufanele ngikusho wukuthi asihambisani nezimpi. Iqiniso wukuthi iMelika iyisikhondlakhondla uma kuza kwezempi. Uma iMelika ingase inqume ukugasela noma kuliphi izwe manje, ingagasela kungabi ndaba zalutho. Alikho izwe elingamelana nayo."UMbalula uthe ukuba namandla kweMelika kwezempi akusho ukuthi kufanele izenzele umathanda."Ngeke size sithule uma sibona iMelika iphula imigomo. Asiqali manje ukugxeka amazwe aphula imigomo futhi asigcini manje. Uma kuwukuthi uTrump (uMengameli waseMelika) ufuna ukusijezisela ukuthi sishaya imithetho ethuthukisa abantu abamnyama, asizimisele impela ukushintsha kulokhu esikwenzayo."Ngibonile nje abanye abantu bethi bafisa ukuthi uTrump enze le nto ayenze kuMaduro lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Bayisho kanjani into enje? Kungani begqugquzela ukuthi uTrump agasele ezweni eliphethwe ngokwentando yabantu? Lapha sihlalisene kahle, kuphethe uhulumeni wokubambisana."UMbalula uthe bazoqala umkhankaso wokugqugquzela zonke izinhlangano ezikhona emhlabeni jikelele ukuba zizwakalise ukungahambisani kwazo nesenzo seMelika.UMbalula uthe iMelika ayihloniphi ngisho inhlangano yezizwe, i-United Nations, wathi kusobala ukuthi iMelika ifuna ukuzitamuzela uwoyela eVenezuela. Uveze nokuthi ayiqali ukuhlasela amazwe anothe ngowoyela.Uthe ukuhlasela kweMelika e-Iraq nase-Afghanistan akuzange kusize ngalutho."Nakula mazwe babezifunela uwoyela. Kunamhlanje kumapeketwane kula mazwe ngenxa yokuhlasela kweMelika."Khonamanjalo: UMaduro uvele enkantolo eseMelika izolo, lapho ebhekene khona namacala okubalwa kuwo awokushushumbisa izidakamizwa.UMaduro uwaphikile wonke amacala athweswe wona.

Ngesikhathi bebavimba abasolwa kuthiwa bavulele ngenhlamvu bebhekise emaphoyiseni. Uqinisekise abasafunda ukuthi abalumisile unomphela lolu hlelo ngoba uMnyango usemkhankasweni wokuhlwaya imali.Uveze ukuthi bazobabeka eqhulwini laba basebenzi uma sekuvela imali.Izinyunyana i-National Education, Health and Allied Workers’ Union (Nehawu) nePublic Servants Association of South Africa (PSA) zithe zizoxoxa noMnyango ngalolu daba. UNobhala weNehawu, uMnuz Ayanda Zulu, uthe abahambisani nesinqumo soMnyango."Sizoxoxa noMnyango mayelana nalaba abasafunda abebezoqeqeshelwa lo msebenzi okumisiwe. Yingakho uma uNgqongqoshe wezeziMali esethula isabelomali sezwe ngenyanga ezayo, sizobhikisha ngaphandle kwesiShayamthetho sifuna kuvalwe zonke izikhala ngenxa yokuthi kunenhlekelele kwezempilo." UMnuz Nkosinathi Thwala wePSA uthe nabo abahambisani nesinqumo soMnyango."Lesi sinqumo silimaza abantu abasha abachithe isikhathi sabo befunda ekubeni belindele ukuthi bazoqeqeshwa besebenza. Izwe libhekene nenkinga yentsha engasebenzi."Ukhale ngokuthi uMnyango uyayiziba eyabasebenzi asebegugile."Uhulumeni uqhamuke nohlelo lokunxenxa abantu ukuthi basheshe bathathe umhlalaphansi. Baningi abazoshiya maduzane yingakho kubalulekile ukuthi kuqeqeshwe abasebancane."Uthe bafuna uMnyango usibuyekeze ngokushesha lesi sinqumo."Sifuna uMnyango ukhulume namaSector Education and Training Authorities (SETAs), ukuze kuxhaswe izinhlelo zentsha. Umsebenzi walezi zinhlangano ukuxhasa abantu abasha banikwe amathuba omsebenzi."

Ababhala ngasese abanye babo basuke bengafundi ngokugcwele ezikoleni. Ibhekwe ngabomvu imiphumela ka-matric ezomenyezelwa ngelizayo njengoba uNksz Gwarube kumele amemezele nezinyathelo ezizothathelwa abakopele u-matric.
