BANGAPHEZU kuka-1 million abazoxhaswa yisikhwama, iNational Students Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS), ukuqhuba izifundo zabo ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme kulo nyaka.Kulaba kubalwa nabangu-600 000 abazobe beqala ukungena ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme.Lokhu kuvezwe yisitatimende seNSFAS ngesikhathi ikhipha izibalo zabathole uxhaso kulesi sikhwama.Kuvele ukuthi bangu-893 847 abafake izicelo zoxhaso kulo nyaka kulesi sikhwama."Bangu-49 538 abangazange bahlangabezane nemibandela yokuthola uxhaso. Kunabangu-218 043 okusalindwe ukuthi balethe eminye imininingwane, ukuze kubhekwe ukuthi bayaluthola noma abalutholi uxhaso," kusho iNSFAS. Ithe abangu-16 863 bahoxise izicelo zokufuna uxhaso."Banikwe izinsuku ezingu-30, ukuthi balethe eminye imininingwane kulabo okusalindwe zonke izimfanelo zabo. Kwabaqalayo ukuthola uxhaso kumele bathole nezimpendulo ezivela ezikhungweni zemfundo ukuthi bamukelwe, uma sekukhishwe imiphumela ka-matric," kusho iNSFAS.Imiphumela ka-matric izokhishwa ngoJanuwari 13. UNgqongqoshe weMfundo eyisiSekelo, uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, uzomemezela imiphumela ka-matric ngoJanuwari 12, ebusuku.I-NSFAS iveze nokuthi bangu-416 668 abebevele bexhasiwe nyakenye, abaphinde baluthola uxhaso."Kunabangu-129 264 abebexhasiwe nyakenye, abangeke baluthole uxhaso ngenxa yokuthi abazange baphase. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abahlangabezananga nemigomo ebekiwe yokuthi bangaphinde baxhaswe." I-NSFAS ithe labo abakhale ngaphansi bangaluthola uxhaso bangafaka izicelo zokuthi kubuyekezwe lesi sinqumo.Iveze nokuthi izomemezela izibalo zabazoxhaswa kwabebefunda emakolishi amakhono ama-TVET, uma sekuphume imiphumela ngoJanuwari 13.Mayelana nomastende abebengakakhokhelwa kuze kube yimanje, abalesi sikhwama banxuse ukuthi balethe izimfanelo zabo eziveza ukuthi bayakweletwa. 'Sizimisele ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke omastende bakhokhelwe. Labo abangakhokhelwe abalethe izimfanelo zabo besebenzisa izinhlelo ezibekiwe."I-NSFAS iveze nokuthi iyazi bamagange abafundi abebenza u-matric, abalinde ngabomvu imiphumela yabo."Sifisela inhlanhla kubona bonke abafundi abebenza u-matric, abalinde imiphumela yabo. Siyazi ukuthi isikhathi esinzima lesi esihambisana novalo nethemba njengoba nilinde le miphumela. Sime ngomumo ukweseka labo abaqala ikhasi elisha empilweni lokuya ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme." UNgqongqoshe weMfundo ePhakeme, uMnuz Buti Manamela uhlale enxenxa abafundi ukuthi bakhethe namaTVET bangagxili kuphela emanyuvesi.

Kuthiwa uMnuz Siboniso Mteshane (31) nomzala wakhe uMnuz Kwanele Gumede (33), badutshulelwe ekhaya, bashona ngumsolwa owaziwayo nosezinikele emaphoyiseni.Owomndeni, ocele ukungavezwa ngoba umsolwa engowasendaweni, uthe umsolwa udubula laba nje, ubekade esuse umsindo ngokuthambana kwelanga, eshayisa ngesibuko semoto umshana woyedwa wababulewe emgwaqweni. "Bebeqeda ukwehliswa amatekisi abebahambise ePort Shepstone, embondweni welungu lomndeni, sebehamba ngezinyawo, bebuya beza ekhaya,” kusho owomndeni. Uthe uKwanele umbuzile lona wesilisa - okuthiwa ubehamba ngeveni athutha ngalo izingane zesikole - ukuthi uyabona yini ukuthi useshayise umshana wakhe, waveza nokuthi lona wesilisa esikhundleni sokuthi alibone iphutha lakhe, uvele wachapha uKwanele ngenkulu inhlamba. "Ube esemsongela ethi uzobuya azomdubula,” kusho yena.Uthe uKwanele akazange azinake lezi zinsongo kanti umsolwa uzobuya ngempela azomdubula.Uveze ukuthi umndeni uvuswe yizigi zomuntu obehamba emnyango kanjalo nokuqhuma kwesibhamu. "Umfowethu omdala uvuke wabuza ukuthi kwenzekani, ingane yentombazane iphume kuqala yayobheka emjondolo obekulele kuwo ababulewe, yabafica bedutshuliwe,” usho kanje.Uthe uSiboniso ubesembhedeni equma (ngenxa yezinhlungu), opha, yathi uma iqhubeka nokuqalaza ngaphakathi endlini, yazithela kuKwanele, ehleli phansi, egebise ikhanda, engasanyakazi, naye opha."USiboniso uphuthunyiswe esibhedlela okuyilapho afike washonela khona. UKwanele yena kubonakale khona endaweni yesigameko ukuthi usethule.” Uthe bayabona ukuthi umsolwa ubehlose ukubabulala ngoba badutshulwe ezindaweni ezibucayi, waveza ukuthi bayabona nokuthi umuntu abemfuna uKwanele njengoba ebe nengxabano naye kodwa wasale esedubula noSiboniso ngoba ebafice ndawonye.Uthe bagqemeke udume lwengozi ngokwehlelwa umshophi kade bejabulele ukuphuma kombondo ekhaya."Sisathukile. Abantu abahloniphi nhlobo ngoba umsolwa wenze lokhu azi kahle ukuthi lapha ekhaya kukhona iphoyisa. Umthetho sifuna uthathe indawo yawo ukuze siphole.” Uthe babuhlungu ngoba bebesabheke lukhulu kwababulewe kanti futhi bashiye izingane ezisencane.Okhulumela amaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant Colonel Paul Magwaza, uthe amaphoyisa aseHibberdene, aphenya icala lokubulawa kwababili kulandela isigameko esenzeke ngoMgqibelo."Kuthiwa ababulewe badutshulwe ekhaya, belele endlini engaphandle. Umsolwa (31) ugcine ngokuzinikela emaphoyiseni nesibhamu sakhe esisemthethweni. Uzovela eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMzumbe, kusasa (namhlanje)," kusho uMagwaza, othe amaphoyisa asaqhubeka nophenyo.
UMNYANGO weMfundo eyisiSekelo usuchithe ukuthi siyehla isithunzi sesitifiketi sika-matric kuleli, ngenxa yezehlakalo zokuputshuka kwamaphepha minyaka yonke.UMnyango usugxeke iqembu i-Freedom Front Plus (VF Plus), ethe liyehla izinga lalesi sitifiketi emva kokuputshuka kwamaphepha ezifundo okubalwa iMaths, Sayensi ne-English kwezinye zezikole ePitoli. Uthe bayalwa nokuputshuka kwamaphepha njengoba bejube nethimba eliyisipesheli, eliphenya lezi zinsolo."Sivule amacala emaphoyiseni ukuze kuphenywe lezi zinsolo. UMnyango okwazi ukubamba indaba yokuthi kunamaphepha aputshukile, sazisa nesizwe ngezinhlelo nezinyathelo esizozithatha. Ukuputshuka kwamaphepha akwenzeki kuphela emfundweni eyenganyelwe nguhulumeni kodwa neyezikole ezizimele kuyenzeka."Uthe isitifiketi sakuleli sihambisana nezinye zakwamanye amazwe."Ngisho nakwamanye amazwe kuyavela ukuthi amaphepha ayaputshuka, okusuke kuhlanganisa nothisha kanjalo nezikhulu. Yizinselelo ezibhekene nazo zonke izikhungo ezibhalisa izivivinyo," kusho uMweli. Uthe kuleli izikole ezizimele zibhala izivivinyo ngaphansi kwebhodi i-Independent Examinations Board (IEB), neSouth African Comprehensive Assessment Institute (SACAI)."Abafundi abangu-29 632 basezikoleni ezingu-579 ezizimele, babhale izivivinyo zikahulumeni kwathi abangu-17 427 babhala ngaphansi kwe-IEB. Bangu-903 561 abafundi ababhale izivivinyo ezisethwe nguhulumeni ka-matric ngo-2025."Uthe lokhu kuveza ngokusobala ukuthi baningi abathembele ezivivinyweni ezisethwe nguhulumeni kuleli."Ngakho izehlakalo ezimbalwa zokuputshuka kwamaphepha ngeke sivume ukuthi zingcolise zonke izivivinyo kuleli. Amanyuvesi nabaqashi bayaqhubeka nokuthemba izivivinyo zakuleli." UMweli uthe akulona iqiniso ukuthi liyehla izinga lika-matric kuleli ngenxa yokuthi kuputshuke amaphepha ezikoleni ezimbalwa."Siyaqhubeka nokuqapha ngelokhozi nokuqinisekisa ukuthi u-matric usezingeni lomhlaba. Siyakuchitha okushiwo osomathuba abangezi nento ephathekayo ezinsolweni abazenzayo ngo-matric wakuleli."Kulindeleke ukuthi uNgqongqoshe walo mnyango, uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, amemezele izinyathelo ezizothathelwa abafundi abasolwa ngokukopela.Lokhu kulindeleke ukuthi akwenze uma esememezela izinga lokuphasa lika-matric, ngoMsombuluko ozayo.NgoLwesibili, ngoJanuwari 13, imiphumela ka-matric izobe isikhishwa ezifundazweni ukuze abafundi bakwazi ukuyilanda.
UMFELANDAWONYE wezinhlangano zabangcwabi sezixwayise abantu ukuthi baqikelele ukufundisisa imigomo nemibandela uma bejoyina omasingcwabisane ukuze bazi ukuthi umuntu ukhokhelwa uma kunjani.USihlalo walo mfelandawonye i-Unification Task Team, uMnuz Muzi Hlengwa, uthe abantu bakushaya indiva ukufundisisa yonke imigomo bese bekhala uma sebethola ukuthi ezinye izinto azikhaviwe ngaphansi komasingcwabisane.UHlengwa usho lokhu kulandela ukugxekwa kwenkampani kamasingcwabisane, Icebolethu Group, okuthiwa inqabe ukukhokhela isicelo sokungcwatshelwa umufi okuthiwa ufe ezibandakanya ebugebengwini. NgokweCebolethu, umufi ufe ngesikhathi kukhona ukudubulana phakathi kwabantu ebebesemotweni abehamba ngayo namaphoyisa. Le nkampami idalule nokuthi kuleyo moto bekukhona umuntu obethunjiwe, elayishwe ebhuthini, yathi ngokombiko wamaphoyisa, nomufi obephakathi emotweni, ubeyingxenye yalobu bugebengu. Ecacisa lokhu uHlengwa, uthe akukho okungafanele okwenziwe yiCebolethu. Uthe izinkampani zomasingcwabisane njengoba zisuke zamukela amalungu ngaphansi kwazo, zingena esivumelwaneni sokuthi zizokhokha noma zizongcwaba uma umuntu eseshonile, nazo zisuke zijoyine ezinkampanini zemishwalense."Lezo zinkampani zemishwalense zinemigomo nemibandela. Zinohla lwemibandela ezinquma ukuthi ngeke zikhokhe uma umuntu efe ngaphansi kwaleyo mibandela. Uma umngcwabi esefaka ke isicelo sokuthi inkampani yomshwalense ikhokhe, inqaba, naye usuke engeke akwazi ukungcwaba umufi,” kusho uHlengwa.Uthe bekuke kwenzeke abanye abangcwabi babenze ubuntu, bashaye ephaketheni labo, bamngcwabe umufi uma kwehle lowo mshophi. "Kodwa manje sekuvele kube nzima ngoba izicelo ezichithwayo ngenxa yalokhu sezivele zibe ningi. Ngeke ke ulokhu ukhokha ngephakethe lakho nsuku zonke,” usho kanje. Uthe bayafuna ukucacisa ukuthi akukhona ukuthi isigebengu abasingcwabi kodwa umuntu ofe enza ubugebengu abangamngcwabi."Uma isigebengu sifa ngokugula siyasingcwaba kodwa uma sifa sizibandakanya ebugebengwini, asisingcwabi uma singaphansi kukamasingcwabisane,” kusho uHlengwa. Uphinde waveza ukuthi akuyena kuphela umuntu ofa enza ukugebengu, njengoba kukhona nabanye abafa maqede bangabangcwabi."Isosha elisuke linomasingcwabisane, uma lifela empini, umasingcwabisane awukhokhi ngoba yilo elisuke likhethe ukuyozibeka engcupheni. Umuntu okusuke sekufanele angenelele lapho uhulumeni, osuke elithumile,” kusho uHlengwa.Uphinde wenza isibonelo sokuthi nalabo abadlala umdlalo wokungcweka ngenduku, uma kunamadili ezindaweni zasekhaya, abangcwatshelwa uma umuntu efe lapho. "Kusuke kuwuye ozifake engcupheni ngokudlala umdlalo oyingozi. Kubhaliwe emigomeni nemibandela ukuthi ngeke angcwatshwe,” kusho uHlengwa. Uthe imali ebikhokhwa nyanga zonke ngalowo muntu nayo ayibuyi ngoba ubudlelwano besivumelwano busuke bungonakele kuze kuba uyafa."Bonakaliswa wuye esezibandakanya ezenzweni ezizodala ukuthi isicelo sokungcwatshwa singaphasi,” usho kanje. Intatheli imbuza ukuthi eyakhe inkampani yamngcwaba uMnqobi Nzimande, owafa edubulana namaphoyisa njengoba ayeyilungu legenge ehluphayo eNanda, waphendula ngokuthi abasondelene naye bashaya ephaketheni ukuze angcwatshwe. "Uma umndeni uthi uzokhokha ukheshi, siyawungcwabela,” kusho uHlengwa othe basazoqhubeka nokufundisa abantu ngokubaluleka kokufundisisa imigomo nemibandela ukuze bagcine beyiqondisisa ngokugcwele.

UKUGASELA kukahulumeni waseMelika ezweni elingumakhelwane wayo, iVenezuela, kwenze abanye bakuleli basabela ukuthi kungenzeka ngelinye ilanga iMelika igadle kuleli.Uhulumeni wakuleli, amaqembu ezepolitiki kanye nenhlangano yezizwe, i-United Nations (UN), akugxekile ukugasela kombutho waseMelika, eVenezuela.Amasosha aseMelika agasele eVenezuela ngempelasonto, afike ashaqa uMengameli wakuleliya lizwe, uMnuz Nicolás Maduro nonkosikazi wakhe, uNkk Cilia Florez. UMaduro noNkk Florez bathathwe bayogcinwa eMelika, lapho bezobhekana khona namacala okubalwa kuwo elokushushumbisa izidakamizwa okuthiwa zigcina ziphelela eMelika. Kulindeleke ukuthi bavele enkantolo yaseMelika namhlanje.UMengameli waseMelika, uMnuz Donald Trump, umemezele ukuthi iMelika izophatha izintambo zokubusa eVenezuela, kuze kube kuqokwa uhulumeni omusha.UTrump uveze nokuthi izinkampani zikawoyela zaseMelika, zizoqala ukusebenza eVenezuela.IVenezuela ingelinye la mazwe ahamba phambili ekukhiqizeni uwoyela. Uhulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika uthe ukugasela kweMelika kuphambene nemigomo ye-UN elawula ukuziphatha kwamazwe.Okhulumela uMnyango wezoBudlelwano naMazwe aNgaphandle, uMnuz Chris Phiri, uthe imigomo ye-UN inqanda amazwe ukuba agxambukele noma angene ngomkhono nesiphanga kwamanye amazwe."Imigomo ayivumi ukuthi elinye izwe lithumele umbutho wezempi ukuba uyongenelela odabeni olwenzeka kwelinye izwe. Sesike sabona kaningi emlandweni ukuthi ukugxambukela kwemibutho yezempi kwamanye amazwe akusizi ngalutho kepha kudala izinkinga nje kuphela." UPhiri uthe bafuna ukuthi i-UN ibize umhlangano ophuthumayo wezokuphepha lapho kuzokhulunywa khona ngalolu daba.Okhulumela i-UN, uMnuz Stéphane Dujarric, uthe kubizwe umhlangano ophuthumayo wezokuphepha ozokuba namhlanje, eNew York.UDujarric uthe bakhathazekile ngokuqhubeka eVenezuela, wathi kukhona imithetho ephuliwe."IMelika iyingxenye yamazwe asayina imigomo ye-UN. Onke amazwe aphoqelekile ukuba ayihloniphe imigomo ayisayina." Amaqembu ezepolitiki akugxekile ukugasela kweMelika.Okhulumela e-ANC kwezithinta ezobudlelwano namazwe angaphandle ePhalamende, uNksz Andisiwe Kumbaca, unxuse amazwe omhlaba ukuba azwakalise ukungahambisani kwawo nokugasela kweMelika.UNksz Kumbaca usole iMelika ngokufuna ukudla ifa leVenezuela."Yonke le nto imayelana nokuthi iMelika ifuna ukulawula iVenezuela, bazifunela umcebo waseVenezuela. Njengenhlangano eyalwela inkululeko, siyabeseka abantu baseVenezuela nohulumeni wakhona owaqokwa ngokwentando yeningi." Okhulumela iMK, uMnuz Nhlamulo Ndhlela, uthe kusobala ukuthi iMelika ifuna ukudla amandla eVenezuela."Alikho izwe elinelungelo lokujuba amasosha ukuba agasele kwelinye izwe, abophe umengameli owakhethwa ngentando yeningi, bese lihlakaza nezinhlaka zokuphatha. Kusobala ukuthi badla amandla. UTrump uthe kuzophatha uhulumeni waseMelika kuze kuba kuqokwa omunye uhulumeni eVenezuela. Lokhu kuphambene nemigomo ye-UN."Okhulumela i-EFF, uMnuz Sinawo Thambo, uthe uma engakhuzwa uTrump iNingizimu Afrika ingase izithole nayo ihlaselwa uTrump. Ubudlelwano beNingizimu Afrika neMelika abubuhle kusukela kwangena uTrump osola uhulumeni wakuleli ngokuhlukumeza amaBhunu."Uma abaholi bamazwe omhlaba bengamkhuzi uTrump uzoqhubeka ahlasele elinye izwe. Kwazi bani mhlawumbe ngelinye ilanga uRamaphosa (uMengameli wakuleli) engazithola ehlaselwa ngenxa yala manga okuthi kubulawa abantu abamhlophe kuleli. Singazithola sihlaselelwa ukuthi seseka iPalestine."Nabanye abantu abebephawula ezinkundleni zokuxhumana bazwakalise ukwesabela ukuthi kungenzeka uTrump agadle kuleli. Abanye baze banxusa uhulumeni wakuleli ukuba ungayithu vu eyokugasela kweMelika eVenezuela ngoba besaba ukucasula uTrump.UTrump waqala ukungawuzwisisi kahle uhulumeni wakuleli emva kokuba umangalele izwe elidlelana neMelika, i-Israel, ulisola ngodlame oluqhubeka ePalestine.IMelika isanda kuhlasela eNigeria, ikhala ngokubulawa kwabantu abangamaKristu.
USIHLALO kazwelonke kwi-ANC, uMnuz Gwede Mantashe, uthi ukuphikelela kweSACP nokungenela ukhetho lohulumeni basekhaya oluzayo ngokuzimela kufana nodlala ngegeja kuziliwe ngoba kungase sisho ukuphela kwale nhlangano.Ukusho lokhu kuSABC News, lapho ebekhuluma khona ngamalungiselelo omgubho wosuku okwasungulwa ngayo i-ANC, iJanuwari 8. I-SACP ebikade yeseka i-ANC ezinkethweni ezedlule, izongenela ukhetho oluzayo ngokuzimela.UMantashe uthe iSACP igagamelile ngokuphuma ibhodwe layo."Iphutha elikhulu leli elenziwa yiSACP. Zwana ngami, iphutha leli. Ngiyilungu lokuqina leSACP. Ngajoyina iSACP ngeminyaka yama-80. Iphutha elikhulu leli lokuthi iSACP inqume ukuhambela kude namadlelandawonye esikhundleni sokuba ilethe ubuchule bayo lapha kwi-ANC. Iphutha elikhulu leli. Lesi sinqumo kungenzeka siyelekelele iSACP futhi kungenzeka ukuthi siyingcwabe. Ingakho ngithi bagembula ngekusasa labo." UMantashe uthe abaholi beSACP bekufanele basebenzise izinhlaka zangaphakathi kwi-ANC uma kukhona izinto abangajabule ngazo, wathi kusukela kudala vele amalungu eSACP abeba nesandla ekuthathweni kwezinqumo kwi-ANC.Uthe ayikho into abazoyenza njengoba sebehlulekile ukunxenxa iSACP ukuba ingaqhubeki nokungenela ukhetho."Ekugcineni kosuku iSACP nayo iyiqembu elizimele, nathi siyiqembu elizimele. Asikwazi ukubathathela izinqumo."UNobhala Jikelele weSACP uMnuz Solly Mapaila, obekhuluma ohlelweni olufanayo, uchithe okushiwo uMantashe."Sihlabela phambili ekungeneleni ukhetho. Akusona isinqumo sami kodwa ngesathathwa ingqungquthela." IJanuwari 8 yakulo nyaka izobanjelwa esifundazweni iNorth West, lapho i-ANC izogubha iminyaka engu-114 yasungulwa kanti uMengameli uCyril Ramaphosa, uzokwethula inkulumo yosuku.I-ANC izobamba umhlangano wesigungu esiphezulu namhlanje, lapho izokhuluma khona ngamalungiselelo omgubho. UMantashe uthe iJanuwari 8 ibanikeza ithuba lokuba babuke ibanga asebelihambile baphinde bacabe indlela eya phambili.UMantashe uthe kuningi okwenziwe uhulumeni oholwa i-ANC kule minyaka eyedlule."Inkinga ukuthi akukhulunywa kakhulu ngezinto ezinhle ezenziwe uhulumeni we-ANC. Abantu bakhuluma kakhulu ngezinto ezimbi. Uma ngenza isibonelo nje abantu bayathanda ukukhuluma ngokungcola edolobheni eGoli, kodwa akekho okhuluma ngemigwaqo emihle exhumanisa iGoli kanye namanye amadolobha afana nePitoli. Uhulumeni oholwa i-ANC wakhe imigwaqo esezingeni futhi kunabafundi abaningi abathole uxhaso lokuqhuba izifundo zabo."
ISILO uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini siphume emgonqweni ngesikhathi uMkhosi woSelwa ufika kuvuthondaba.IMbube ibonakale okokuqala izolo, kulandela ukugonqa eyakuqala ngesikhathi kungena uMkhosi woSelwa, ngonyaka odlule.INdlulamithi yamaKhosi iphume emgonqweni ivunule ngamashoba, okuyiwo asebenza kakhulu uma kuwuMkhosi woSelwa.UMkhosi woSelwa ubanjelwe esigodlweni eMashobeni, oPhongolo. NgoMgqibelo, umkhosi ubuhanjelwe abaNtwana baseNdlunkulu nabaholi abaqavile. Phakathi kwabaholi abaqavile ababonakale ngoMgqibelo, kubalwa loyo owayengumengameli wezwe uMnuz Jacob Zuma, uNdunankulu kaZulu uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, uSihlalo womkhandlu weSilo, iNkosi Zuzifa kaMangosuthu Buthelezi, okhulumela iSilo, uMntwana uThulani kaGqikazi Zulu kanye nabanye.Ibutho elincane beliphume nezinkani emkhosini. Kulo mkhosi ibutho elincane libamba iqhaza elikhulu njengoba lifike esigodlweni ngeledlule, laphuma layogawula usekwane, laphica inhlambeko.Nakuba iMbube iphumile emgonqweni ayikakazukubonakala emphakathi kuze kube kuphothulwa umkhosi.Umkhosi uzophothulwa ngokuthi kushiswe uthi ngosuku olungakamenyezelwa.
SIQALILE isiminyaminya emingceleni yakuleli njengoba beqhubeka nokubuya abantu basemazweni angaphandle, abebevakashele emazweni abo ngesikhathi samaholidi.Inhlangano egade imingcele yakuleli, iBorder Management Authority (BMA), ithe abantu abafuna ukungena kuleli baqale ukwanda ngempelasonto.UKhomishana weBMA, uDkt Michael Masiapato, uthe abantu abaningi abafuna ukungena kuleli baqhamuka emazweni iZimbabwe, Malawi, neZambia. UMasiapato uthe ngoMgqibelo kungene abantu abangaphezu kuka-20 000, wathi nayizolo bebelindele ukuthi kungene isibalo sabantu abangaphezu kuka-20 000."Kumatasa kakhulu lapha, amabhasi agcwele abantu abafuna ukungena kuleli afika kanye kanye. Izolo mhlawumbe kufike amabhasi angu-50. Ukufika kwamabhasi kanye kanye kwenza ukuthi kube nesiminyaminya ngoba kuthatha isikhathi ukuthi sikwazi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abantu abasemabhasini banamaphepha afanele abagunyaza ukuba babe kuleli. Ngaphandle kwamabhasi kuphinde kube nenqwaba yezimoto nazo ezilayishe abantu."UMasiapato uthe bayazama ukunciphisa isikhathi abantu abasihlala emingceleni belinde ukuba bavunyelwe ukuba bangene kuleli."Ngeke ngikuphike ukuthi sinayo inkinga yengqalasizinda kodwa ke siyazama ukuqhamuka namaqhinga okunciphisa isiminyaminya. Sivule izindawo eziningi lapho sibheka khona ukuthi abantu banawo yini amaphepha abagunyaza ukuba bangene kuleli." UMasiapato uthe umngcele okumatasa kakhulu kuwona iloyo ohlukanisa elakuleli kanye neZimbabwe, iBeitbridge.Uthe balindele ukuthi senyuke kakhulu isibalo sabafuna ukungena kuleli kule mpelasonto nokuyimpelasonto yokugcina yamaholidi ezolandelwa ukuvulwa kwezikole."Ngokubuka kwethu iyona mpelasonto ezokuba matasa lena ngenxa yokuthi bonke abantu bazokube bebuyela emsebenzini." UMasiapato uthe kukhona abantu ababanjwe bezama ukungena kuleli ngamaphepha awumgunyathi.NgoLwesine nangoLwesihlanu bangaphezu kuka-540 abantu ababanjwe bezama ukungena kuleli ngokungemthetho.UMasiapato uthe bazoqhubeka nokuqinisekisa ukuthi abekho abantu abazofohla.Uthe bazobambisana nezinye izinhlaka okubalwa abombutho wezokuvikela kanye namaphoyisa.
Amaphoyisa angaphansi kweWelkom Public Order Police (POP) alandele umkhondo abopha indoda eneminyaka engu-40 ubudala ebifunwa uthuli ngokugwaza unkosikazi wayo (31) kanye nosbali wayo (34).Lokhu kulandela isigameko esenzeke ngoLwesihlanu mhlaka-19 Disemba 2025.Umsolwa kusolakala ukuthi wagwaza usbali wakhe ngommese omkhulu ngaphambi kokuba agwaze umkakhe ekhanda. Usole unkosikazi wakhe ngokujola wathi umfowabo uyena obemvikela udadewabo.Kusolwa ukuthi umsolwa wabalekela eLesotho emuva kwalesi sigameko wabe esefunwa ngamaphoyisa. NgeSonto, mhla ka-4 kuJanuwari 2026 amaphoyisa athole imininingwane ngokubuya kwakhe nokuthi ukuphi umsolwa. Kusolakala ukuthi ngesikhathi ebuya umsolwa wathumela umyalezo kumkakhe. Kulo myalezo kuthiwa wabikela isisulu sesifazane ukuthi uzombulala aqedele akuqalile.Umsolwa utholwe endaweni eseThabong. Ngesikhathi amaphoyisa efika endlini, umsolwa uzame ukubaleka ebona amaphoyisa. Amjaha ngezinyawo, wabe eseboshwa.Kulindeleke avele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseWelkom maduze ngecala lokuzama ukubulala.
Ngokusa kwangoMsombuluko abasolwa ababili badutshulwe bafa babhekene namaphoyisa endaweni yase-Uvongo kwatholakala nezibhamu ezinhlanu ezingekho emthethweni okubalwa kuzo nezibhamu ezimbili zohlobo lwe-AK47. Amaphoyisa abesebenza ngokobunhloli ngabantu abaphethe izibhamu ezingekho emthethweni. Amaphoyisa asondele kulo muzi obekuhloswe kuwo abika ukuthi akhona kodwa kwangaba nampendulo ngaphakathi. La malungu angena endlini abingelelwa abantu ababili abebengaphakathi endlini badubula bebhekise emaphoyiseni. Amaphoyisa aphindisele ngenhlamvu kwalimala abasolwa ababili. Kutholwe izibhamu ezimbili zohlobo lwe-AK 47 kanye namavolovolo amathathu. Alikho iphoyisa elilimale ngesikhathi sokudubulana.
Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bangalindela ukwehla kwentengo kaphethiloli kuleli sonto, njengoba ukuqina kwerandi kanye nentengo ephansi kawoyela wamazwe ngamazwe kuholele ekwehleni okukhulu kukaphethiloli nodizili.Imininingwane yokuphela kwenyanga evela eSikhwameni Samandla Esikhulu (i-CEF) ikhomba ekwehleni kwentengo kaphethiloli phakathi kwamasenti angu-62 ilitha ku-93 Unleaded kanye no-66 cents ku-95 Unleaded.Udizili ufuna ukwehliswa kwentengo ngo-R1.36 ngo-500ppm no-R1.49 ngo-50ppm. Lokhu kuncipha kuzoletha amanani asogwini e-95 Unleaded kanye no-50ppm kadizili emazingeni azo aphansi kakhulu kusukela ngoFebhuwari 2022.Ilitha ye-95 Unleaded kulindeleke ukuthi ibize u-R19.92 ogwini kusukela ngoLwesithathu, okuyibeka ngaphansi kuka-R20 okokuqala ngqa cishe eminyakeni emine.Abasezifundeni ezimaphakathi nezwe bazokhokha u-R20.75 nge-95 ULP kanye no-R20.64 ngo-93 ULP.
IMelika ihlasele iVenezuela ngoMgqibelo ekuseni, "yathumba" umengameli wakhona, uNicolás Maduro, nonkosikazi wakhe - yabakhipha ngaphandle kwezwe.UMaduro ubekwe icala lokusolwa ngobushokobezi bezidakamizwa namanye. "Uzobhekana nezobulungiswa eMelika emhlabathini waseMelika," kusho umshushisi omkhulu eMelika, uPam Bondi.Umengameli waseMelika, uDonald Trump, ebuzwa ukuthi ngubani ozohola iVenezuela, utshele iFox News ukuthi: "Okwamanje sisazobheka."UTrump uphinde wathi ulindele ukuthi i-US "ingene ngomkhono nesiphanga" esikhathini esizayo embonini kawoyela eVenezuela.Ummeli-jikelele waseVenezuela uthe kubulawe izakhamuzi ezingenacala ekugaseleni kwamasosha ezikhungweni eziningi eCaracas nasezindaweni eziseduze nayo.Sekuphele izinyanga i-US ilokhu ikhuphula ingcindezi eVenezuela, okuhlanganisa ukunkanisa kwamasosha ayo eCaribbean, yahlasela futhi yabulala inqwaba isola ukuthi amathangi obekuthiwa anowoyela agcwele izidakamizwa. Umhlaba uyavungama ngokwenzekayo ngokuhlasela kwe-US eVenezuela.
ABAZAKHELE udumo ohlelweni lwempilo yangempela kwiMoja Love, Umndeni, baphendulane kabuhlungu ezinkundleni zokuxhumana.UMahlalentabeni Maseko noDabula sebephenduke inkukhu nempaka emuva kokuba uDabula nomyeni wakhe, uMaseko, baveza ukuthi bona baphatheke kahle kakhulu kwiMoja Love ekubeni uDabula noNkanyezi Hlatshwayo badalula ukuthi bahlukumezekile kulolu hlelo.UMahlalentabeni wabe eseveza ukuthi kufanele uDabula ancome iMoja Love yingoba akanalo ipasi. Manje kufanele ayincome ukuze alale edlile. Indaba iqale phansi emuva kokuba uMahlalentabeni, okuqale kwathiwa akasekho emhlabeni, ekhuluma emuva kokusinda kade ezama ukuzibulala. Uthe ubefuna ukuzibulala ngenxa yokuthi ubengenayo imali yokuthengela umndeni wakhe izinto ebezidingeka ngoKhisimusi. Uze wathi namanje akazi ukuthi uzothathani ahlanganise nani njengoba kufanele ahambise izingane ezikoleni.UDabula ubuyile wathi uMahlalentabeni ubezibulaleni ngoba wathi yena uyingwenya. Umnxuse ukuba ahlukane negama lakhe kodwa anake izinkinga zakhe ngoba yena unethezekile kwiMoha Love. Nakuba kunjalo kodwa abantu bamgxekile uDabula ngokulwa nomuntu osasinda ekuguleni. Babuye bagxeka nokuphula kwakhe isiNgisi esikhundleni sokukhuluma ulimi lwebele.Ukungahosehlani kwalaba ebebesithenjeni sikaMaseko kuqale ngesikhathi uMahlalentabeni noNkanyezi besabisa ngokuphenya izinqe lesi siteshi esikhonjiswa kwiDStv Channel 157 uma kuwukuthi abakhokhelwa imali abayikweletwayo. Kwaqala uMahlalentabeni, ongumamkhulu kulolu hlelo, wathi inkinga yaqala ngesikhathi ebazisa ukuthi ugulelwa abomndeni wakhe. Wathi wabe esecela abadidiyeli ukuba bamnikeze imali esele ukuze anakekele abantu bakubo.Eqhuba uMahlalentabeni wathi wathuka kwaphela nokusozwaneni efakelwa u-R40 000 kuphela. Wathi yena ukube wayazi ukuthi bazoholelwa amakinati wayengeke esavuma ukushutha. UNkanyezi wathi baningi "abaxhashazwe yiMoja Love" kangangoba abanye baze bashona bekhala. Wathi iningi belingakwazi ukukhuluma ngoba belisatshiswa.Wathi yena wangena ngenxa yengane yakhe, ugobela wakhe nesoka lakhe ngoba enethemba lokuthi bazokhokhelwa kodwa bagcina benganikezwanga nendibilishi. UNkanyezi wathi ukukhala kwakhe kwenza wagcina esenyamanambana kubadidiyeli kangangoba waze wancishiselwa nezindawo abebonakala kuzo. Wathi wanikezwa indawo encane, okusho ukuthi nomholo wawuzoncipha. Eqhuba wathi kunesikhathi lapho aqopha khona iziqephu eziningi kodwa kwithelevishini kwavezwa ezincane.Wathi washaqeka ebona iMoja Love iyonikelela imindeni efelwe yizingane ngo-R150 000 ekubeni bona bebulawa yindlala. Ethintwa okhulumela iMoja Love, uNonzwakazi Cekethe, wavuma ukuthi usebenze nabakulolu hlelo iminyaka eyisithupha.Wathi baqala belekelela obeqavile ohlelweni kodwa bagcina sebenikwa izindawo eziqavile, "okuwubufakazi bokuthi i-channel isebenza kanjani ukubacija futhi ibeseka yonke le minyaka. Ngebhadi bakhethe ukuya kwiTikTok ekubeni i-channel ihlale ineminyango evuliwe futhi ibixhumana nabo. Isibonelo nje, omunye wabebesohlelweni kuthe enesimo esiphuthumayo esiqondene naye, isiteshi senza konke okusemandleni ukumsiza ngenxa yobudlelwano obuhle esinabo naye futhi samlekelela nangemali."UNonzwakazi uthe kube noxhaxha lwemihlangano lapho abasohlelweni bechazelwe kabanzi ngezivumelwano ngolimi nangendlela abazoyiqonda maqede benza imisebenzi yabo ngendlela."Kuyashaqisa ukuthi bakhethe le ndlela ehlanekezela iqiniso, edicilela phansi isithunzi nokuhlasela okungenasidingo. Isiteshi sihlale siyivulile iminyango yokuxoxa," kuphetha uNonzwakazi.Nomakunjalo kodwa uMahlalentabeni noNkanyezi bathi bazame kaningi ukuxhumana nabadidiyeli bohlelo kanye nezikhulu zalesi siteshi ngalolu daba kodwa beyingaphendulwa imiyalezo yabo futhi bagcine sebe-blockwa. Bathe yingakho begcine bephoqelekile ukuba bayokhuluma kwiTikTok. Baze basabisa ngokuthi bebesakha phezulu kodwa basazogeqa amagula kuma-podcast abasazowahambela.
Kuboshwe owesilisa oneminyaka engu-19 okhulelise kanye kanye amantombazane aneminyaka engu-14 nena-15 eMarapong, eLimpopo ngoLwesibili.Umsolwa ubhekene namacala okudlwengula amantombazane amancane.Okhulumela amaphoyisa aseLimpopo, uColonel Malesela Ledwaba, esitatimendeni, uthe intombazane ena-14 iye emtholampilo iyohlolwa ngoDisemba 18 kwafike kwatholakala ukuthi izithwele."Ngalo lolo suku, intombazane eneminyaka engu-15 yasendaweni efanayo iye esikhungweni sezempilo yafika yatholwa ngabezempilo ukuthi izithwele,” kusho uLedwaba. UJATSHULISWA ukuthi kuze kwafika isikhathi sokuthi athathe umhlalaphansi esadla anhlamvana umasiteshi waKwaMashu, obevaleliswa ehhotela i-Octavia, eNanda, ngeSonto. UBrigadier Richard Zakhele Nzama (60) usezibeke phansi izintambo emaphoyiseni, kulandela ukuyibamba iminyaka engu-38. Ekhuluma neSolezwe, uthe uzibala namaphoyisa anenhlanhla, eficwa yisikhathi sempesheni esaphila. "Abaningi ozakwethu ebengibazi, ngibajwayele behlelwa umshophi wokubulawa besemsebenzini. Ngithe uma ngibuka ubude bendlela, ngificwa yilesi sikhathi ngisaphila, ngazizwa ngifikelwa ukubonga,” kusho uNzama. Uthe amaphoyisa abhekene nengwadla yokuthi ngesikhathi enza konke okusemandleni ukuqapha ubugebengu, nezigebengu ziphuma inqina, ziwasoconge, wathi eminyakeni ayisebenzile emaphoyiseni kusuka ejoyina umbutho ngo-1988, ufunde ukuthi ukukwazi ukusebenzisana nabantu, inhlonipho nokuthobeka kuyamsebenzela umnikazi. "Ngisebenzise khona kakhulu ngo-2006 ngesikhathi ngiyoba umasiteshi KwaDabeka. Leya ndawo yayinenkinga enkulu yezepolitiki. Owayephethe ngaphambi kwami akahlalanga kahle ngenxa yayo ipolitiki, kwaphoqa ukuthi ahambe. Mina ngakwazi ukuthi ngihlale iminyaka embalwa ngaphambi kokuthi ngiyojoyina esaKwaMashu ngo-2011,” usho kanje.Uthe ngalezi zinto zontathu ubefika esiteshini endaweni akwazi ukusebenzisana nozakwabo kanjalo nomphakathi ukulwa eyobugebengu."Lokhu ngifike ngakwenza ngisho nakhona KwaMashu. Ayikho indawo ebinzima ukuyisebenza njengehostela kodwa ngakwazi ukuthi kulunge ngokubambisana nozakwethu ebengibahola, salenza langcono ihostela,” kusho uNzama. Uthe wayevele asondeze eduze izinduna zama-block, amakhosi endawo nalawo alapho okuvela khona abahlali, kwaba yiqhinga elisebenzayo."UMashu wonkana, awusemubi ngale ndlela obumubi ngayo phambilini,” usho kanje.Ephawula ngeyokujoyina umbutho, uthe yayikade ingekho ezinhlelweni zakhe, njengoba yena ayezifunela ukuba wummeli. "Ngajikwa umqondo omunye umngani wami, wathi asingene emaphoyiseni. Into ebuhlungu eyenzeka ukuthi sazifaka sobabili izicelo, ngathathwa mina, yena wangathathwa. Kwabe ngingene kanjalo-ke emaphoyiseni,” kukhumbula uNzama. Uthe njengoba esethathe impesheni, akanazinhloso zokungena kwezamabhizinisi."Lesi kuzoba yisikhathi sami nomndeni wami. Ngisebenze iminyaka ngibancisha isikhathi sokuthi basichithe nami. Njengamanje sengizobheka bona ke ngithole isikhathi sokuhlala nabazukulu, ngibahambise nasesikoleni,” kusho uNzama.Umcimbi wakhe ubuhanjelwe woSimphiwe Majozi (Sbu) noMasoja Msiza (Nkunzi) boZalo, Dladla Mshunqisi noBabo Ngcobo.Bekukhona neNkosi yamaQadi, uMqoqi Ngcobo, neyakwesaKwaBiyela eMpangeni.
UFUNA izimpendulo umndeni wasoPhongolo, wowesifazane obulawe evakashele isoka lakhe esigamekweni esenzeke ngeSonto.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi umufi, uNksz Nomaswazi Ngidi (35), ufe evakashele isoka lakhe elingeke lidalulwe igama lalo okwamanje.Udadewabo kamufi, uNksz Zothiwe Ngidi, uthe bathole ukuthi umufi ube nokuhilizisana nowesilisa ongumakhelwane walapho abekade evakashele khona.Uthe batshelwe ukuthi lo wesilisa - obekade edle amankwebevu - usole umufi ngokuthi uyena owebe izingubo zakhe ebezikade zinekiwe kulayini."Kuthiwa baxabane kakhulu lo wesilisa waze wazifikela mathupha kudadewethu, wamgwaza amanxeba amabili emqaleni. Kuthiwa uphelele khona lapho endaweni yesigameko," kusho uNksz Ngidi.Eqhuba uthe udadewabo ubekujwayele vele ukuyovakashela isoka lakhe, kuthi noma lihamba limshiye endlini okuyinto eyenzekile nangosuku lwesigameko, wathi bakhungathekile njengomndeni ngalo mshophi athi ubehle ngaphezulu. Ukhale ngokuthi umenzi wokubi - igama lakhe eligodliwe - usagcwele amathafa."Kuthiwa umbulale wangabe esaya kubo, wabaleka wanqamula ehlathini akaphindanga wabonakala emva kwalokho. Sikhathazekile kakhulu ngokwehlele udadewethu. Siyazibuza siyaziphendula ukuthi kungani lo wesilisa kumane kwaba lula nje kuyena ukuba ambulale?" Ugcizelele kakhulu ukuthi bafuna izimpendulo ngakho konke okwenzekile ngalolu suku, wakhala ngokuthi udadewabo ushiye emhlabeni izingane ezimbili okuyimanje uthe kulukhuni nokuthi bazibheke emehlweni."Owokuqala uneminyaka engu-13, owesibili uneminyaka engu-11. Sibatshelile ngokwehlele unina kodwa uyababona nje ukuthi badidekile futhi kabakakholwa yile nto esibatshele yona ukuthi yenzekile ngampela," usho kanje.Uthe bakhulumile nesoka likadadewabo, wathi kodwa akukuningi abakukhulumile nalo njengoba ethe lizwakale lididekile kakhulu.Isolezwe likhulume nalo isoka lacela ukuba lingabhalwa igama lalo. Likuqinisekisile ukuthi ngempela senzekile isigameko.Lithe yize lingathandi ukwanda ngalolu daba kodwa liyamazi umenzi wokubi."Angazi ukuthi ubekade engenelwe yini ngoba ngimazi engenalo udlame. Angikhumbuli kuthiwa kukhona axabene naye kodwa-ke ngeke sazi ukuthi kwenzekeni," kusho isoka.Uthe okumkhathazayo ukuthi ucele empunzini ngemuva kwalokhu akwenzile, wathi uyazisola ngokubulawa kukamufi ngoba ngabe usadla anhlamvana ukube akazange amvakashele.Amaphoyisa aKwaZulu-Natal akuqinisekisile ukubulawa kukamufi. Athe kuvulwe icala lokubulala.Kwenzeka lesi sigameko nje, ngonyaka owedlule, Isolezwe like labika ngomunye wesifazane naye owabulawa evakashele isoka.Okwakhe kwakuhlukile njengoba azithola eba umhlatshelo ngoba wabulawa ngabantu ababekade bezogqekeza kubo kwesoka, ngeshwa bafica yena lingekho isoka.
UMPHATHISWA wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi KwaZulu-Natal, osehlule kaningi exoshwa, uNksz Mbali Shinga, uvule izandla kulabo abafuna ukumketula esikhundleni. UNksz Shinga unxuse abaholi beNFP ukuba bayeke ukulwa bodwa, wathi izimpi zangaphakathi zizophazamisa ukusebenza kweqembu.Ukusho lokhu esitatimendeni asikhiphe emva kokubhuntsha komzamo wesibili wokumxosha ekumeleni iNFP esiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal. USomlomo wesiShayamthetho, uNksz Nontembeko Boyce, uchithe isicelo sobuholi beNFP sokuba kukhishwe uNksz Shinga esiShayamthetho. Ubuholi beNFP bebufuna ukuthi uNksz Shinga akhishwe esiShayamthetho ngenxa yokuthi umisiwe eqenjini, wamiswa emva kokuba eshaye indiva umyalelo weqembu wokuba aseke isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, esasifakwe iMKP. UNksz Boyce uthe bekufanele lolu daba baluxazulule ngaphakathi kwiNFP, lungaze lufike esiShayamthetho. "Kungokwesibili manje kuba nomzamo wokungikhipha esiShayamthetho. Indlela abazama ngayo ukungikhipha esiShayamthetho ayikho emthethweni futhi ishiya imibuzo eminingi. IsiShayamthetho lesi silandela uMthethosisekelo kuyo yonke into esiyenzayo. Le nto bekungafanele ize ifike esiShayamthetho. Akufanele sithathe izinqumo ezizolimaza iqembu. Ngiyibonile incwadi kaSomlomo futhi ngeke ngigiye ngayo. Impendulo kaSomlomo ayisho ukunqoba kumina kodwa iyisikhumbuzo nje sokuba kuhlonishwe umthetho."UNksz Shinga uthe uyabuhlonipha impela ubuholi beNFP kodwa wathi angeke asonge izandla uma ebona bungayilandeli imigomo yeqembu. "Angifuni kudicilileke phansi isithunzi seqembu. Engikukhalelayo ukuba kulandelwe imigomo yeqembu."UNksz Shinga uthe uzimisele ukusebenza nabo bonke abaholi beqembu. "Njengoba ngivula izandla nje, akukhona ukuthi ingoba ngiyigwala kodwa ingoba ngifuna kulungiswe izinto. Asikwazi ukulwa sodwa ikakhulukazi ngale sikhathi lapho khona abantu baseNingizimu Afrika belidinga iqembu. Ukhetho lohulumeni basekhaya seluseMome, kufanele sibambane."Ngiyacela ukuba sonke sizinuke amakhwapha. Ngiyazi ukuthi kohlezi kukhona ukungaboni ngaso linye emaqenjini ezepolitiki. Kufanele sithole indlela elungile yokuxazulula izinkinga. Mina nje ngikulungele ukuba sibonisane."UNksz Shinga uphinde abe usihlalo weNFP KwaZulu-Natal.NgoJuni, ubuholi beNFP buke bazama ukukhipha uNksz Shinga esiShayamthetho kodwa isicelo sabo sachithwa.Umdonsiswano kaNksz Shinga nobuholi beqembu sebuqubule kwabathile umbono wokuthi angaba wumholi weqembu esicongweni njengomsunguli walo, uNkk Zanele kaMagwaza Msibi, ongasekho.
UBUKEKA usekude ukuphela umdonsiswano wokulwa nokushicilelwa kwemiphumela ka-matric emaphephandabeni njengoba i-Information Regulator (IR), iphikisana nesinqumo seNkantolo eNkulu yasePitoli, sokuchitha isicelo sayo sokuthi ingashicilelwa le miphumela emaphephandabeni ngonyaka ozayo.Le nkantolo yavuna uMnyango wezeMfundo eyisiSekelo, yawugunyaza ukuthi uqhubeke 'nesiko' lokushicilela le miphumela emaphephandabeni njengoba kuhlale kwenzeka phambilini.Manje i-IR imile ekutheni ayihambisani nokuthi le miphumela ishicilelwe ngoba kuphambana nomthetho othinta imininingwane yabantu. UNksz Nomzamo Zondi, okhulumela i-IR, uthe babuyele enkantolo enkulu yasePitoli, befuna ukuthi ibuyekeze isinqumo sayo mayelana nalolu daba."Sisalinde ukuthi ivume noma isichithe ekutheni kubuyekezwe lesi sinqumo sayo ngaphambi kokuba sidlulele eNkantolo yezokuDluliswa kwamaCala kuleli," usho kanje eshaya ngamafuphi.Le nkantolo igunyaze ukuthi umnyango uqhubeke nokukhipha imiphumela yaka-matric ngohlelo olujwayelekile, okulindeleke ukuthi idedelwe ngoJanuwari 13, 2026. Ijaji Mark Morgan, likhipha isinqumo esivuna umnyango, lathi ukushicilelwa kwemiphumela emaphephandabeni, akuphazamisi izinto ezithinta ulwazi lo mfundi. Umnyango nezinhlangano zomphakathi zimile ekutheni kubalulekile ukuthi le miphumela ishicilelwe emaphephandabeni ukuze abafundi bayithole kanye kanye.Okunye okwavezwa ngukuthi abanye abafundi basuke bengekho ezifundazweni zabo, ngakho ngeke bakwazi ukulanda imiphumela yabo ngosuku ekhishwa ngalo. UNgqongqoshe wezeMfundo eyisiSekelo uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, uyomemezela imiphumela ka-matric, emcimbini ozoba ngoJanuwari 12, 2026.Kulo mcimbi kusuke kumenyezelwa izinga lokuphasa, abafundi abadabule ngamalengiso kanjalo nokuthi izifunda zenze kanjani. Kuphinde kumenyezelwe nokuthi mangaki ama-Bachelor atholwe ngabafundi. Iminyango yezifundazwe ijwayele ukwenza imicimbi yokumemezela imiphumela ngakusasa, ngemuva komcimbi kazwelonke.I-IR ifuna abafundi balande imiphumela yabo ezikoleni njengoba kwenzeka kwamanye amabanga, njengoba ingashicilelwa emaphephandabeni.Nanyakenye i-IR ikhale ngaphansi enkantolo eyavuna umnyango ukuthi uqhubeke nokushicilela imiphumela emaphephandabeni. Nakulo nyaka sizobhekwa ngabomvu ukuthi isinqumo kulolu daba sizothini njengoba usubuyela enkantolo lo mdonsiswano.
Abezimo eziphuthumayo basebenza nabaqaphi basolwandle ukuzama ukuhlenga umuntu okuthiwa uminze ebhukuda eThompson Beach, eBallito ngoLwesihlanu ekuseni.Kubikwa ukuthi lo muntu ubonakalise ukuba nenkinga emanzini ngemuva-nje kokugamanxa kwehora lesihlanu ekuseni.Kwenzeka lokhu abezimo eziphuthumayo ngaphansi kwenkampani i-IPSS Medical Rescue, basendleleni ebheke ePennington Beach, oGwini oluseNingizimu lapho bezoqhubeka khona ngemizamo yokumthungatha abantu ababili abagcine bengatholakalanga ngoLwesine ebusuku."NgoLwesine ntambama, sibizelwe ePennington Main Beach ogwini oluseNingizimu, kulandela imibiko ethi okungenani abantu abahlanu bathathwe wulwandle. Abaqaphi basolwandle bakwazile ukukhipha umuntu oyedwa esesimweni esikahle," kusho abe-IPSS Medical Rescue medics.Ngeshwa, omunye wesilisa osekhulile okutholakele ukuthi useshonile. Ngabo ubusuku bangoLwesine, kutholwa esinye isidumbu esikhafulwe amanzi olwandle."Kulindeleke ukuthi uqhubeke namhlanje umsebenzi wokuthungatha ababili abangakatholakali."
Amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal aphenya icala lokubulala ngemuva kokubulawa kwamalungu amane omndeni ngoLwesithathu ebusuku, eMehlomnyama, eMdweshule. Ngokusho kukafakazi, abesilisa abane abangaziwa bakhahlele isicabha sendlu abekuyo nomkhwenyana wakhe. Abesilisa abathathu bebephethe izibhamu, oyedwa ephethe ubhushu. Abasolwa bafune imali, kuthe uma betshelwa ukuthi imali ayikho, bavele badubula bebhekise kumkhwenyana wakhe, 45, ngebhadi bamshiya eshonile. Abasolwa babe sebemyalela ukuthi abakhombise amanye amalungu omndeni, wakwenza lokho. Ngesikhathi befika endlini enkulu, badubula babulala umama namadodakazi akhe amabili aneminyaka ephakathi kuka-31 no-67. Abasolwa babe sebebaleka endaweni yesigameko, behamba namaselula amabili.
UBUSAMANGAZWE eyokuhlaselwa kwakhe ngumuntu ongaziwa, ogasele ekhaya maqede wamdubula ngasekupheleni kukaNovemba, umndeni wowesilisa waseLinda Area, KwaNdengezi, oduke ngendlela engaqondakali ekuqaleni kukaDisemba. UMnu Thabani Linda (40) kuthiwa wagcinwa ukubonwa wumndeni wakhe ngoDisemba 1, ephuma ehamba ekhaya samuntu ozobuye abuye.Isihlobo esicele ukungadalulwa, sithe uLinda unyamalala nje, ubesanda kudutshulwa umuntu ongaziwa."Ulahleka ngoDisemba 1 nje, ubekade edutshulwe ngoNovemba 26, njengoba kwafika umuntu ongaziwa ngabo-7.30 ebusuku, wamdubulela egcekeni," kusho isihlobo.Sithe nhlanhla leyo uLinda akazange ashone kodwa waphuthunyiswa esibhedlela lapho athola khona usizo lwezempilo maqede wadedelwa emva kwezinsuku ezimbili, sathi ngesikhathi ephuma ehamba ekhaya, kwakukhona esinye isihlobo egcekeni."Sithi waphuma nje wahamba njengenjwayelo njengoba ewumuntu wesilisa. Kwacatshangwa ukuthi uzobuya kodwa kwaze kwalalwa engabuyile, kwasa ngakusasa, lutho," sisho kanje.Sithe ubengasebenzi, ebamba amatoho uma ethuke aqhamuka, sathi ubekhonzile ukuziphuzela."Ocingweni akatholakali, asazi ukuthi kwenzekani. Sithukile futhi sididekile, ikakhulukazi ngoba lokhu kwenzeke kungakapheli sikhathi esingakanani edutshuliwe," kusho isihlobo.Siveze ukuthi bekungakaze kube khona akuphefumulayo kubona ngokuthi uyazi yini ukuthi ubani lo obemfuna efile, sathi abanaso isiqiniseko sokuthi kukhona yini ukulahleka komuntu okubhalwe phansi emaphoyiseni aKwaNdengezi."Kusukela enyamalele, besilokhu sigqigqa khona kodwa ebeka amathizethize. Kuze kwaba ingoDisemba 16, lapho unina akwaze khona ukubhalisa isitatimende maqede watshelwa ukuthi inombolo yombiko ngomuntu odukile izolandela nge-SMS," kusho isihlobo. Sithe kuhambe izinsuku ingafiki le nombolo, unina kalona wesilisa waze wabuyela khona esiteshini samaphoyisa."Yilapho ethole khona ngamanye amaphoyisa ukuthi akukho lutho oluvelayo olukhombisa ukuthi ukhona umuntu onegama likalona wesilisa odukile oseke wabikwa esiteshini," kusho isihlobo, esithe nayizolo unina uphindele emaphoyiseni ukuyobheka, wathola ukuthi akukaveli lutho ngendodana yakhe.Abangaba nolwazi ngodukile bacelwa ukuba bathinte amaphoyisa aseduzane.
UMNYANGO wezeMphilo KwaZulu-Natal unxuse intsha ukuba ingalenzi iphutha ishalazele iLena, ezokuba wusizo empilweni.Lokhu kushiwo uMphathiswa walo mnyango, uNksz Nomagugu Simelane izolo ngesikhathi esemphakathini waseLister Farm, eNewcastle, eyokwethula iLena.I-Lena yigama elinqanyuliwe likaLinacapavir, okuwumjovo, ojovwa kabili ngonyaka ukugwema ukusuleleka ngeHIV.UNksz Simelane uthe kuyiqiniso elingephikiswe ukuthi iHIV ne-AIDS kuseyinkinga eNingizimu Afrika, wathi namanje izinkumbi zabantu zisasuleleka ngegciwane unyaka nonyaka."I-Lena wumjovo wabantu abangakasuleleki ngegciwane futhi abafuna ukuzigcina benjalo," kusho uNksz Simelane.Uthe lo mjovo awuzile ukungena endaweni yephilisi lokuvika lesi sifo ebelivele likhona. "Uyindlela eyengeziwe, ezosiza labo abehlulekayo ukuphuza iphilisi zonke izinsuku. Abanye bayakhohlwa ukuliphuza, abanye basaba ukucwaswa, kuthi abanye bagcina bekhathala ukuwaphuza zonke izinsuku. I-Lena inika labo bantu endlela yesibili elula," usho kanje.Uthe ukwethulwa kwalo mjovo kusho ukwandiswa kwezindlela zokuzivikela, nokusho ukuncipha kwesibalo sabantu abasha abazosuleleka ngegciwane. Uthe iLena izoqala ukutholakala kuyo yonke imitholampilo nezibhedlela ngoFebhuwari 2026. Uxwayise abantu ukuthi iLena ivikela ukwesuleleka ngeHIV kuphela hhayi ezinye izifo ezithathelana ngokocansi futhi ayikuviki ukukhulelwa. "Amajazi omkhwenyana asabalulekile njengoba wona ekwazi ukukuvika konke," kusho uNksz Simelane, othe basazoqhubeka nokwenza imikhankaso ezindaweni ezehlukene ukukhuthaza abantu ukuba bayisebenzise iLena.

Muva nje, uhlelo lududulwe ngempumelelo uKhathide "Tshathugodo" Ngobe ebambisene noLungisani "Selbeyonce" Mkhize, abafike bayibeka induku ebandla.Nyakenye, Isolezwe lakhuluma noMr Magic noMalakoane ukuzwa uvo lwabo. Ngo-2012, kwaphinde kwashaywa amakhala ngokuthi unyaka uhlukaniswe yingoma ka-DJ Tira eyayithi Summertime, esikhundleni seka-DJ Vetkoek & Mahoota eyayithi Via Orlando (Remake) ngo-2012. APHUME enxapha amalungu omphakathi aseMbumbulu, ngesikhathi ededelwa ngebheyili owesilisa ohamba ngesihlalo esinamasondo abakholwa ukuthi sekuphele isikhathi eside kakhulu ebahlalise lubhojozi kule ndawo.Kuthiwa uMnuz Skhumbuzo Dube okhalelwe ngamasongo kaSigonyela ngosuku olwandulela uKhisimusi, ngecala lokubulawa kowesilisa waseMlaza, owadutshulwa ngonyaka owedlule.UDube usolwa ngamalungu omphakathi aseMbumbulu, ngokuthi ubekade emdibimunye nenkabi ebisatshiswa okwenyoka kule ndawo egcine ibulawa ngamaphoyisa kuwona lo nyaka, uQha Dlamini.UDlamini kwagasela amaphoyisa ekwakhe ezombopha, kwathiwa yena wavele wavulela ngenhlamvu ewadubula nge-AK47. Lwagoba uphondo kuyena ngesikhathi amaphoyisa esedubula nawo ebhekise kuyena.Ukubulawa kukaDlamini kwadala inhlokomo enkulu kule ndawo, abantu bejabulela ukubulawa kwakhe. Iningi labo lalikholwa ukuthi kuzoke kube nokuthula, kume nokufa kwabantu kule ndawo.Iningi labantu lalikholwa ukuthi ubaqedile abantu eMbumbulu esebenzisana noDube lo odedelwe ngebheyili.Abakhulume neSolezwe bathe uDube bambona esehamba ngesihlalo esinamasondo nje, kwathiwa ulimele ngokudutshulwa kodwa kabazi ukuthi wadutshulwa ngubani futhi nini.Izolo, iNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMbumbulu, imnikeze ibheyili ka-R1 000. Uzobuyela kule nkantolo ngenyanga ezayo.Kulo nyaka zibe ziningi kakhulu izigameko ezibe khona zokubulawa kwabantu. Bonke bebefa ngokudutshulwa behlaselwa besezindlini zabo. Abanye bebedutshulwa besendleleni beya emisebenzini. Kukhona nabanye abaze bakhetha ukuthi bayifulathele indawo yaseMbumbulu, bakhala ngokuthi sebelala bevule iso elilodwa.Phakathi kwezinye izigameko ezashiya umphakathi wakule ndawo uthuthumela kufaka phakathi ukusocongwa kweNduna uMsweli kwase kulandela nendodana yakhe.Kwadutshulwa kwabulawa nabanye abahlanu ababekade bengaphandle komuzi. Namanje akwaziwa ukuthi ngobani ababulala laba. Kwaphinde kwabulawa noMnuz Alfred Masinga owadutshulwa wabulawa esemzini wakhe.Kukhona isikhathi lapho khona umphakathi wakule ndawo owawucabanga ukuthi izigameko zokubulawa kwabantu ziwumnyombo wokwebiwa kwemfuyo okuwumkhuba owawusuphenduke insakavukela.Nokho babuye bashaya ungqimphothwe, sebethi kabasaqondi ukuthi abanjani abantu ababulawayo nokuthi kungani bebulawa.

KUDONSWE ngendlebe amalungu eSikebhe (inhlangano elwa nokwebiwa kwemfuyo KwaZulu-Natal) ukuba aze angalokothi asukumele icala elingabikiwe emaphoyiseni ngoba azobe ezidonsela amanzi ngomsele kungenasidingo.Lo myalelo ushiwo ngumengameli wale nhlangano, uMnuz Sibangani Manyathi, emcimbini wokuphethwa konyaka esigodini saseMatini, endaweni yaKwaMamba, phakathi kwaseShowe naseNkandla. UManyathi ubuye wadonsa ngendlebe amalungu ukuba aze angalokothi abhonye abantu abasolwayo ngezagila ngoba kuphambene noMthethosisekelo wabo.Ukhalaze kakhulu ngokungabi bikho kokubambisana phakathi kwamalungu eSikebhe, amaphoyisa neminyango kahulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal. UManyathi ubuye wanxusa amalungu abo ukuba aziqhelanise nepolitiki ngoba bona basebenza nawo wonke amaqembu futhi wanxusa osihlalo ukuba bahlukane nokugxambukela ezindabeni zemindeni nemibango esemakhosini. Ukhombe umnyango thizeni kahulumeni ngokungafuni ukubambisana neSikebhe."Kunezikebhe eziphethwe wumnyango, okuthi uma sekonakele kuthiwe yiSikebhe esethu. Akube kusashiwo ukuthi yilesi sikebhe esiphethwe wumnyango. Thina siba nomhlangano omkhulu lapho siwubiza khona umnyango kodwa ungezi kodwa uma sekonakele uyasithinta. Asinakho nje ukubambisana nomnyango."UManyathi ubuye wahlaba kakhulu amaphoyisa asebenzisana nezigebengu. Uthe amanye amaphoyisa afike ahlasele emizini yosihlalo azofuna izibhamu, emuva kwalokho ozihlalo batholakala bebulwe yizigebengu.Lo mcimbi bewuhanjelwe yizikhulu zamaphoyisa ezizivumele ukuthi ziyahambisana nokusebenza kweSikebhe. Lezi zikhulu zinxuse amalungu eSikebhe ukuba anganqeni ukufaka izikhalazo zazo ezinhlakeni ezifanele zamaphoyisa. Iphini likamengameli weSikebhe, uMnuz Zakhele Mncube, ligxeke ukushaywa kwabantu abagangayo ngaphansi kwezinyawo.UMncube ukhale kakhulu ngokubulawa kozihlalo beSikebhe ngamaqembu omphakathi noma ngamaphoyisa. Uthe kuzofika lapho nabo becikeka khona kangangoba baze bazijezisele abasolwa."Akekho ushameni esizobulawelwa yena. Uma kubulwa ushameni ngenxa yamaphoyisa noma yiqeqebana labantu abathize, ngeke kuthuleke," kusho uMncube.Inkosi yaseMgazini, uXolani Ntshangase, ithe samukelekile iSikebhe endaweni yayo kodwa yakhala ngabantu abanemfuyo ewumvanzi emigwaqweni yakule ndawo. UNtshangase unxuse abanikazi bemfuyo ukuba bayiqoqe ngoba igcina seyidala iziphihli zezingozi.
SIBHEKENE nengwadla yenkinga yamanzi isibhedlela sesifunda, iChurch of Scotland, esiseMsinga, okuthiwa sesidonse isikhathi eside kakhulu kungaphumi ngisho iconsi kompompi.Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Ntokozo Maphisa, uthe bayalwazi udaba lwenkinga yamanzi kulesi sibhedlela.Echaza ngalokhu uthe: "Kuliqiniso ukuthi amanzi endaweni sekunesikhashana engekho nokuwudaba olusetshenzwa ngumasipala wendawo. Nathi lokhu ukungabi bikho kwamanzi endaweni kuyasithinta kakhulu. Kodwa umnyango wenza konke okusemandleni ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kunamanzi esibhedlela.''Eqhuba uthe zikhona ezinye izindlela abazenzayo ngenhloso yokubhekana ngqo nale nkinga ekhinyabeza ukusebenza kwesibhedlela.''Sikhuluma nje, sinalo ipitsi elisebenzayo bese kuthi amanye amane sisohlelweni lokuwalungisa ukuze nawo akwazi ukunezelela ngamanzi. Kuphinde kube khona amathangi amanzi umasipala ofaka kuwo amanzi uma ekhona,'' usho kanjena.Uveze ukuthi banayo nemoto ethwala amanzi yomnyango okuyiyona elekelelayo uma sekukubi kakhulu, wathi angeke bakushaya indiva ukuthi inkulu kakhulu inkinga yamanzi kulesi siya sifunda sikaMasipala uMzinyathi.''Lena yinkinga endala nekapakela esikhungweni sethu, yize noma umnyango uhlale uqinisekisa ukuthi esikhungweni awapheli nya amanzi,'' kusho yena.Yize lesi khulu sikhulume kanje kepha Isolezwe lithole ukuthi iziguli eziseduzane kuyenzeka zitotobe ziyogeza amakhaya, bese ziphinde zibuyele esibhedlela ngenxa yayo inkinga yamanzi.Sikhulu kakhulu isikhala emphakathini kangangoba abanye sebeze baphakamise ukuthi ngabe kungcono uma singavele sivalwe lesi sibhedlela esiphakathi koMvoti neDundee."Ngabe kungcono uma singamane sivalwe simane sazi ukuthi asinaso isibhedlela kule ndawo kunokuphila le mpilo esiyiphilayo njalo uma kunezihlobo zethu ezingaphakathi,'' kusho ilungu lomphakathi ngokukhathazeka.Omunye okhulume neSolezwe onesiguli sakubo esingaphakathi kuyimanje, uthe lena yinkinga esifana nento engathusi kulesi sibhedlela esinemibhede yokulalisa iziguli ebalelwa ku-350.''Ngikutshela ukuthi kungumsebenzi wethu ukuqinisekisa ukuthi siyamlethela amanzi njalo ngosuku. Le mpilo inzima kakhulu nathi njengomndeni isiqala ukusikhathaza kakhulu. Ngikhuluma nawe nje, sekuphele izinyanga ezintathu senza lo msebenzi njengoba ilungu lethu selinesikhashana lingaphakathi. Awungitshele-ke ukuthi ubani okumele amele ukuhambisa amanzi esibhedlela njalo ngosuku?” usho kanjena kuzwakala ukuthi unokukhathazeka.Isolezwe likhulume nomunye onesihlobo esingaphakathi naye ocele ukuba ligodlwe igama lakhe. Uthe njengomphakathi sebehlanze ngedela ngendaba yokuthi siyoke sibe khona isixazululo senkinga yamanzi esibhedlela, wathi ayikho into abangayenzanga njengomphakathi bezama ukuqinisekisa ukuthi lolu daba luyafinyelela lapho okumele lufike khona kodwa uthe kumane kufane nje nokuthi bathela amanzi emhlane wedada."Isiyadabukisa manje inkinga yamanzi kulesi sibhedlela, yinto njengomphakathi esesimane savuma nje ukuthi siyophila nayo ingunaphakade. Ngimdala ngimngaka angikaze mina ngibone inkinga engenaso isixazululo nendonsa isikhathi eside njengalena esikhuluma ngayo lapha. Iqiniso ukuthi sibi kakhulu isimo kulesi sibhedlela futhi sesimane samukela ukuthi ngeke size siluthole ndawo usizo ngale nkinga,'' usho kanjena. Omunye umthombo uveze ukuthi inkinga okukhulunywa ngayo icishe ibe neminyaka ebheke kwemine.UMnuz Zakhele Makhathini oyisakhamuzi, uthe akasazi nokwazi ukuthi le nkinga yaqala nini. Uthe eminyakeni emithathu eyedlule nabo babeqiqinga amanzi behambisela owomndeni wabo owagcina edlulile emhlabeni.Uchaze lesi simo njengento eyichilo neveza ngokusobala ukuthi uhulumeni uhluleka kangakanani ukuxazulula izinkinga zezidingongqangi emphakathini. Ubuze ukuthi yini abangathi bayayivotela kule ndawo ekubeni kunenkinga yamanzi esidonse isikhathi eside kangaka?Uthe bake bahlongoza nemashi eya khona esibhedlela kodwa babuye bayihoxisa ngoba bebona ukuthi nalokho ngeke kuze kubasize ngalutho.Esinye isiguli ebesisanda kuphuma ngaphakathi, sithe impilo inzima kakhulu kulesi sibhedlela njengoba sibalise ngenkinga yamathoyilethi angcolile.Sithe kukhona amathoyilethi ashaywayo, sathi abanye bawasebenzisa enjalo, bese kungcina kuba nephunga elingabekezeleleki kanye nokungcola, sathi abanye uma beya kuwoba basizwa ukuphatha izigujana ezincane abasuke beziphathelwe yizihlobo zabo uma zizobabona.

Yize izinkundla zokuxhumana ziseyithuluzi elinamandla lokuthungatha abasolwa abafunwayo, kubalulekile ukuthi kubhaliswe amacala asemthethweni. EBEBEHAMBELE umcimbi i-Itsoseng Delicious eLooks Lounge (Spring Wave) eLooks Lounge, eMabopane, ePitoli, ngesonto eledlule, babuyele emakhaya bephoxekile emuva kokungayiboni intandokazi yomculo wamapiano uBabalwa M Mavuso. Esitatimendeni esisatshalaliswe ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, iziphathimandla zeLooks Lounge zikuqinisekisile ukuthi uBabalwa M ugcine enganandisanga yize egcine efikile emcimbini. "Iciko laqashwa ukuba lizocula ngo-5 ntambama kodwa lafika isikhathi sesidlule ngehora nemizuzu ewu-30 kwekwakuvunyelwene ngaso. Nakuba kunjalo kodwa abagqugquzeli bomcimbi baqhubeka namalungiselelo okuthi umculi anandise njengoba nezihlwele zase zimagange ngalo."Siqhuba isitatimende, sithe amathe abuyele kwasifuba kubahleli sekufanele umculi angene esteji ngoba uvele waqhamuka nezinye izimfuno okwakungavunyelwananga ngazo ngaphambi kokuba eze emcimbini.Abahleli bathi phezu kwebhodlela leHennessy VS neleHennessy VSOP, okwayingxenye yezimfuno, uBabalwa M wathi akangeni esteji engawatholile amabhodlela amabili otshwala iVeuve Clicquot, okuyishampeni ebiza phakathi kuka-R739 no-R5 670 ezitolo zakuleli - kuya ngohlobo. "Imizamo yenziwe ukuxazulula lolu daba ngokuthula kodwa umculi washaya phansi ngonyawo ngokuqhubeka nokunandisa kungahlangabezwananga nezimfuno zakhe."Isitatimende sithi ebona uBabalwa M ukuthi akanikezwa amabhodlela, wabe esekuhoxisa ukunandisa. Bebona nabagqugquzeli ukuthi kunhlanga zimuka nomoya, babe sebeyifuna njengoba injalo imali abebemkhokhele yona. Nebala naye akabahluphanga kodwa uvele wababuyisela yona yonke ingashodi nangesenti.Abagqugquzeli babe sebexolisa kwebebehambele lo mcimbi, ikakhulukazi ebebemagange ukuzibonela le ntokazi esanda kukhipha i-albhamu ethi Acquiesce.Eziphendulela uBabalwa M uthe kungangamanga ukuthi akaculanga ngoba ecikwa ukunganikwa ibhodlela leshampeni kodwa ubhecwa ngobende ekubeni inyama engayithanga mbibi. Uthe empeleni ubengeke esakwazi ukuqhubeka emuva kokuchashwa ngenhlamba, aze abizwe nangohlanya ngomunye wabahleli bomcimbi. Uthe ngaphansi kwalezi zimo bekungeselula ukuba aqhubeke nokunandisa. Ubuye waveza ukuthi akabizanga imali egcwele kanti nebhodlela okukhulunywa ngalo ubelinikezwe wuDJ. UBabalwa M uthe abahleli bahlulwe nawukumnikeza amanzi yena nozakwabo. "Njengomculi ngikholelwa ekutheni ukuhloniphana akuxoxiswano ngakho. Njenganoma wubani, akekho ongaqhubeka nokuthenga esitolo aphathwa kabi kuso, nami angiqhubekanga nokunandisa ngenxa yokungahlonipheki." Uthe uzoqhubeka nokuzihlonipha nokujabulisa abathandi bomculo wakhe. Ube esexolisa kakhulu kulabo angabange esakwazi ukubanandisela.

INHLANGANO yodokotela, iSouth African Medical Association (SAMA), ikhala ngokwanda komthamo womsebenzi ngenxa yezigameko eziyamaniswa nophuzo oludakayo ngesikhathi samaholidi.IPhini likaSihlalo weSAMA, uDkt Zanele Bikitsha, lithe izigameko ezandile ngezabantu abalimele nabadonswa igazi ngoba beboshelwe ukushayela bephuzile."Yizigameko zokugwazwa, ukudutshulwa, izingozi zomgwaqo nodlame lwasekhaya. Yizigameko ezinjalo esizibona kakhulu ngesikhathi esimatasa sikaDisemba. Ngebhadi ngenxa yalokhu, abantu beza ngalezi zizathu kuphela bese bengezi ngezinsuku okuvunyelwane ngazo ukuthi bezohlolelwa ukugula kwabo okungamahlalakhona ngoDisemba,” kusho uBikitsha. UBikitsha obekhuluma esiteshini sezindaba iSABC, uthe ngoDisemba kufika kakhulu abantu bedinga usizo oluphuthumayo, wathi lokhu kudala inkinga yokuthi kushoda odokotela nabahlengikazi nongoti ezibhedlela zikahulumeni."Lokhu kufaka ingcindezi kwabakhona ukuthi bakwazi ukumelana nezigameko ezinyukayo ngoDisemba. Ngakho ukuthutha iziguli ezindaweni zesigameko ziya esibhedlela kuletha enkulu ingcindezi ngoba kuyashoda,” kusho uBikitsha.Uthe enye ingcindezi ngeyokuthi abanye balimele ngendlela edinga ongoti njengokuthi umuntu egwazeke kuthinteke imithambo. Eqhuba uthe awukwazi ukuhlinza umuntu noma yikuphi."Sinenkulu ingcindezi ngoDisemba ngokushoda kwabasebenzi nengqalasizinda.”Uthe izikhungo zempilo zigcina zinabasebenzi abakhathele futhi ezinye izibhedlela azibavumeli abanye abasebenzi ukuthi bahlabe ikhefu ngemuva kukaDisemba 15 ngoba kuzoshoda kakhulu.

Baboshwa ngoLwesithathu mhlaka-24 kuDisemba, ngesikhathi kunomkhankaso owawuholwa onogada basezimayini abethungatha amazamazama ahlomile asebenza endaweni yaseWestonaria.Abasolwa batholwe nesibhamu i-AK-47, izibhamu ezine, nenqwaba yezinhlamvu. Abasolwa abayisishiyagalombili kulaba baboshwe bengaphakathi ezindlini ezimbili ngemuva kokuthi onogada begasele kule ndawo. Kutholwe izibhamu ezintathu ezingekho emthethweni ebezigcwele omagazini, kanye nebhodlela okusolwa ukuthi line-mercury. Kuboshwe abanye abasolwa ababili emigwaqweni eseduze bephethe i-AK-47 nezinhlamvu ezingu-31 nesibhamu esinezinhlamvu ezine.Umsolwa weshumi nanye, oyisakhamuzi saseNingizimu Afrika, uboshelwe ukugcina abokufika ngokungemthetho kanye nokwephula umthetho. Amaphoyisa athe uphenyo lokuqala luveze ukuthi abanye balaba bokufika babeyiziqashi zomsolwa waseNingizimu Afrika, nokuholele ekuboshweni kwakhe. Izibhamu ezishaqiwe zizoyiswa kohlolwa ukuze kutholakale ukuthi azikaze yini zasetshenziswa kwamanye amacala abucayi, okuhlanganisa nesigameko sokudubula ethaveni yase-Bekkersdal ngomhla ka-21 kwephezulu.
PHEZU kokuthibelana phakathi kwe-ANC neSACP ngesinqumo samaKhomanisi sokuzimela okhethweni ngonyaka ozayo, kodwa iSACP ithe izowuhambela umgubho waminyaka yonke kaKhongolose owaziwa ngeJanuwari 8. Lo mgubho weminyaka engu-114 kwabunjwa le nhlangano, uzobanjelwa enkundleni yemidlalo iMoruleng, eNorth West, ngoJanuwari 10, 2026.Ubanjwa minyaka yonke kanti umengameli wale nhlangano usuke enaba ngomhlahlandlela wezinto le nhlangano ezozenza kulowo nyaka. Njengoba ngonyaka ozayo kuzoba nokhetho lohulumeni basekhaya, akungabazeki ukuthi umengameli we-ANC nezwe uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa, uzogxila kakhulu kwezithinta lolu khetho.I-SACP yanquma ukuzimela okhethweni ikhala ngezinto eziningi ezinye zazo ukungabuyekezwa kweyamadlelandawonye. Sekuhlule ngisho umhlangano wakamuva phakathi kwe-ANC neSACP, wokuzama ukuxazulula ungqingetshe okhona kodwa kwanhlanga zimuka nomoya.Okhulumela iSACP uMnuz Mbulelo Mandlana, utshele Isolezwe ukuthi bazoba yingxenye yalo mgubho."I-SACP iyingxenye yezinhlelo ezenziwa amadlelandawonye ukuzama ukwakha ubumbano. Ngaleyo ndlela azoba yingxenye yomgubho we-ANC owaziwa ngeJanuwari 8," usho kanje. Uthe bayaqhubeka nokuxoxa ne-ANC ngodaba lokuthi amalungu eSACP, angabe esaba yingxenye yeminye imihlangano ebalulekile kaKhongolose, ikakhulu esuke izobhunga ngamasu athinta ukhetho."Udaba lobulungu be-ANC neSACP ngenye yezinto esisaqhubeka nokuyixoxa noKhongolose. Lolu daba selusingethwe yithimba elajutshwa ukubheka indaba yokubhekana ngeziqu zamehlo phakathi kwethu ne-ANC," usho kanje.URamaphosa utshele umhlangano weNational General Council (NGC), muva nje ukuthi amalungu eSACP kumele azihoxele emihlanganweni ye-ANC ethinta ezokhetho kuze kuxazululeke ungqingetshe okhona. Isuse udweshu eyokuzimela kweSACP njengoba kusuka ngo-1994, le nhlangano ihlale yeseka i-ANC okhethweni.I-SACP imile ekutheni ayikwazi ukuguqula lesi sinqumo ngoba sathathwa engqungqutheleni. Ithi ingqungquthela engaguqula lesi sinqumo.I-Cosatu engenye yamadlelandawonye ne-ANC, ithe izowuhambela umgubho we-ANC ngoba sisamile isinqumo sokweseka uKhongolose okhethweni.Lo mfelandawonye wakuveza ukuthi awukwazi ukuguquka kulesi sinqumo ngaphandle kokuthi kunqume ingqungquthela. ISadtu engenye yezinyunyana ezinkulu ngaphansi kweCosatu, isanda kuveza ukuthi kuyodingeka ibize ingqungquthela eyisipesheli ezonquma ngokuthi izoseka bani phakathi kweSACP ne-ANC.Okwamanje nayo imile ekutheni iseka i-ANC njengoba kwakunqunywe kanjalo phambilini.Isinqumo seSACP sokuzimela okhethweni asidalanga uqhekeko phakathi kwale nhlangano ne-ANC kuphela kodwa nangaphakathi kumaKhomanisi ikakhulu KwaZulu-Natal.Kuhlakazwe ubuholi bakulesi sifundazwe ngezinkolelo zokuthi abuhambisani nesinqumo sokuzimela kweSACP okhethweni. I-SACP yajuba ubuholi besikhashana eKZN kanti ubuholi obuhlakaziwe busashaya amakhala buthi yibona obusemandleni. Buyalwa nalesi sinqumo sokuhlakazwa bukhala ngokuthi akulandelwanga imigudu efanele.

Sinxusa umphakathi namalungu e-ANC ukuthi aseke umndeni kaNksz Magadzi, bawubeke emthandazweni ngalesi sikhathi usemanzini." Uveze ukuthi bazomemezela izinhlelo zenkonzo yokumkhumbula kanjalo neyomngcwabo njengoba kumatasa namalungiselelo.

KUDONSWE ngendlebe izinkumbi zabafundi ezilinde imiphumela ka-matric ukuthi ziqaphele izikhungo kanjalo neziqu ezingombombayi ngoba zizobaqola imali.Laba bafundi bamagange balinde ngabomvu imiphumela yabo ezophuma ngonyaka ozayo. Esithangamini esihlanganyele sabezindaba sezinhlaka ezibhekele iziqu ezikhishwa yizikhungo kuleli, okuyiQuality Council for Trades and Occupations (QCTO), Council on Higher Education (CHE), Umalusi kanjalo neSouth African Qualifications Authority (SAQA), zixwayise abazali nabafundi ukuthi baqaphele izikhungo ezingombombayi.Isikhulu esiphezulu somkhandlu obhekele izingabunjalo lika-matric, Umalusi, uDkt Mafu Rakometsi, uthe asikho isikhungo okumele sikhiphe iziqu noma sisebenze ngaphandle kokugunyazwa. URakometsi uthe kunezikhungo ezithembisa abafundi izitifiketi zika-matric."Isikhungo esibhaliswe eMnyangweni wezeMfundo esigunyazwe Umalusi, esikwazi ukukhipha isitifiketi sika-matric. Ziningi ezinye izikhungo ezingoqhibukhowe ezifundisa abasuke bephinda u-matric ngakho kumele ziqashelwe."Uthe zisuke zazi ukuthi abafundi baphansi phezulu bafuna isitifiketi sika-matric bese zidlala ngabo, zibaqole. Uveze nokuthi imiphumela ka-matric iyomenyezelwa nguNgqongqoshe wezeMfundo eyisiSekelo uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, ngoJanuwari 12, 2025.Nesikhulu esiphezulu seQCTO uMnuz Vijayen Naidoo, sikhiphe isexwayiso esifanayo ngezikhungo zamakhono eziqola abafundi."Lezi zikhungo zithembisa abafundi izitifiketi ekubeni zingagunyaziwe. Abavule amehlo abafundi nabazali ukuze bangalahlekelwa yimali." Isikhulu esiphezulu se-CHE uDkt Whitfield Green, sithe abafundi abangayi noma yikuphi ngenxa yokuthi abathathwanga emanyuvesi noma emakolishi.Usho lokhu nje bevile ku-850 000 abafundi ababhale u-matric, kanti babalelwa ku-200 000 abazokwamukelwa amanyuvesi."Iziqu zezikhungo zemfundo ephakeme zigunyazwa yi-CHE futhi kumele zibhaliswe yiNational Qualifications Framework. Kunamanyuvesi angu-26 kuleli nezikhungo zemfundo ezingu-145. Izikhungo ezingabhalisiwe zifana nento engekho, uma ufunda kusona usuke ulahla imali." Ibamba lesikhulu seSAQA uDkt Makhapa Makhafola, uthe bamatasa banemikhankaso yokuxwayisa nokuvula amehlo imiphakathi ehlukene ngezikhungo ezingombombayi.UMakhafola uthe zixhaphakile lezi zikhungo kanti zigxile emadolobheni amakhulu."Zigcwele emadolobheni okubalwa iGoli, eThekwini, Pretoria, Cape Town namanye amadolobha. Abafundi abaqaphele bangabhalisi uma bebona ukuthi isikhungo asikho emthethweni." NoMnyango wezeMfundo ePhakeme uhlale uxwayisa abafundi ukuthi baqaphele uma beyofunda ezikhungweni zemfundo. Lo mnyango uze uphume umkhankaso wokuvala lezi zikhungo ezingombombayi.Abafundi banxuswe ukuba baqale bazibheke ukuthi zibhalisiwe izikhungo ngaphambi kokubhalisa kuzona. Bangaya ku:www.umalusi.org.za noma ku:www.qcto.org.za.
LIZOGAYA ngomunye umhlathi kwabagaqele ukuba amakhansela ngemuva kokhetho lohulumeni basekhaya lwangonyaka ozayo, njengoba bezoshaywa ngesithende abangancwadile. Lokhu kuvezwe nguNgqongqoshe wokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu, uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa, oveze ukuthi bavumelene bengamaqembu akuhulumeni wokubambisana i-GNU, ukuthi kumele kujutshwe abantu abancwadile, abazokwazi ukuhlaziya izinto ezifana nemibiko ethulwa komasipala."Sifuna kuphele ngendaba yokuthi kujutshwe abantu abangazi lutho komasipala. Sivumelene namanye amaqembu akwi-GNU, ukuthi kufakwe abantu abancwadile, abazokwazi ukuhlaziya imibiko yoMcwaningimabhuku jikelele neminye. UHlabisa obekhuluma ngesikhathi ibhodi eliklama imingcele lidlulisa uhlu lwamawadi abuyekeziwe kuleli sonto kwikhomishini yezokhetho i-IEC, uthe lokhu kuzofukula indlela imikhandlu esebenza ngayo.I-ANC iyona nhlangano eyaphumela obala yathi kuzojutshwa abantu abano-matric kuya phezulu abazoba amakhansela. Kwabazoba yizimeya nosomlomo kudingeka iziqu kanjalo nesipiliyoni esibandakanya ukuthi abantu asebeke baba sesiShayamthetho nasePhalamende.UHlabisa unxuse abaholi bomdabu, amakhansela, abamaqembu ezombusazwe ukuthi beseke imingcele emisha. Uthe akumele kusuke izibhelu ngenxa yale mingcele emisha wathi ukhetho kumele kube olukhululekile. Uveze ukuthi sinyukile isibalo samawadi kuleli emuva kokuklanywa kabusha esuka ku-4 468 aya ku-4 488."Amawadi asiza ekutheni abantu bazi ukuthi ubani ikhansela labo nokuthi bavota kuphi. Kulolu khetho abantu bavota lapho behlala khona, siyabagqugquzela ukuthi babhalise ukuze bavote." Uveze ukuthi lolu khetho luzoba nzima kakhulu njengoba kuzobe kuwukheth' ukhethu. Isikhulu se-IEC uMnuz Sy Mamabolo, sithe balindele ukuthi sizonyuka isibalo sabazongenela ukhetho ngonyaka ozayo.Uthe balindele abantu abevile ku-120 000 abazongenela ukhetho oluzayo."Okhethweni lwango-2021, bangu-100 000 abangenela ukhetho bebanga izihlalo ezingu-10 000 emikhandlwini ehlukene. Nakulolu khetho silindele ukuthi sinyuke isibalo sabazongenela ukhetho njengoba sanda nesibalo samaqembu ezepolitiki," usho kanje. Uthe bahlela ukuthi kube nezimpelasonto ezimbili zokubhalisela ukuvota ngaphambi kokhetho."Sizohambela nemiphakathi esingaphansi kwamanye amawadi ukuze siyibhalise emawadini amasha. Asifuni kube nabazosala ngaphandle ngenxa yokushintsha kwemingcele. Abantu ababheke ukuthi amawadi abo awashintshile, bese bebhalisela ukuvota," kusho uMamabolo.Kuvele ukuthi komasipala abane KwaZulu-Natal, kunamacala asenkantolo abaphikisana nokuklanywa kwemingcele. Labo masipala yiseThekwini, Mkhambathini, Alfred Duma naseNkosi Langalibalele.

Esibhedlela i-Niemeyer Memorial, kulimale uphahla lwegumbi lweziguli (OPD)/Ihhovisi Labalimele kanye nehhovisi elamukela iziguli, okubangele ukuthi lingene amanzi kulezi zindawo ezibucayi.Ngesitatimende esithunyelwe kwabezindaba, umnyango uthe: "Amathimba ethu aphethe ingqalasizinda kanye nezinsiza azohlola ngokugcwele izinga lomonakalo. Kodwa uma kubhekwa ubukhulu bomonakalo, silindele ukuphazamiseka okuthile ezinsizeni zezempilo zansuku zonke ezikhungweni ezithintekile. Lo monakalo uyakhathaza, futhi umnyango uzosebenzisa izinhlelo zezimo eziphuthumayo ngemuva kokuhlolwa okuphelele ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza zezempilo eziphuthumayo ziyaqhubeka nokusebenza ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka okuncane. Sicela umphakathi usibekezelele kulesi sikhathi esinzima."

Abantu abadala abahlanu kanye nezingane ezimbili abalimele baphuthunyiswe esibhedlela sendawo ukuze bathole ukwelashwa. INKOSI yasendaweni yaKwaChwezi, eNkandla, uHerbert Mbongiseni Phumlani Sibisi, igqugquzele isizwe sayo ukuba sikhuthalele ukulima ukuze sixoshe ikati eziko. Inkosi ikhulume kanje ngesikhathi inhlangano engenzi inzuzo yenzele izaguga uKhisimusi endaweni yaKwaChwezi, ngoLwesihlanu. Ithe ububha bubhokile kule ndawo ekubeni amasimu engodedangendlale. Inkosi ithe kunenqwaba yamasimu asephenduke ondingasithebeni ngenxa yokuswela abantu abazowalima. Nakuba kunjalo kodwa inkosi ibuye yaphonsela inselelo uhulumeni, umasipala nosomabhizinisi ukuba baphonse itshe esivivaneni ngokuba baxhase isizwe ngogandaganda abambalwa ukuze silime ngabo ngenxa yokuthi ezinye izindawo sezingumqansa. USibisi ushayele elikhulu ihlombe inhlangano iNkungumathe NPO ngokunikelela ngocingo olubiye amanye amasimu anganyelwe ngamalungu omphakathi. Ubuye wayitusa nangokwenzela izaguga uKhisimusi. Iningi lazo libuyele emakhaya liqiqinge wena rayisi, nyama, mafutha okupheka, Rama, nsipho nokunye okuningi. Omunye wezaguga, uNkk Thabisile Mthethwa (64) KwaPhambana, uthe lokhu kudla kumlamulele endlaleni ebizomququda ngalo Khisimusi ngenxa yokuthi ubengazi uzothathani ahlanganise nani ukuze abeke ibhodwe eziko. Uthe indlala beyizomququda nabantwana bakhe abayisikhombisa abakhulisa kanzima. Uthe ukuntula kumphoqe ukuba angasidlali nesitokofela. Usihlalo weNkungumathe, uMnuz Mthokozi Mchunu, uthe wenzele izaguga ngoba ekholelwa ekwabeleni abampofu."Ungajabuli ngoKhisimusi ekubeni umakhelwane wakho elambile."Kulo mcimbi kunandise uMenzi, Falabo, uNkeshemba nabanye.

UMPHAKATHI waseNew Jersey, e-USA usathuthumela ngesihluku okubulawe ngaso umlingisi wodumo kwiThe Lion King, u-Imani Dia Smith. Le ntokazi, eyayilingisa indawo yebhubesi elinguNala omncane kulo mdlalo olingiswa ngamaphimbo kuphela, igwazwe yabulawa esehlakelweni okusolwa kuso isoka layo, uJordan D Jackson-Small (35). Lesi sigameko senzeke e-Edison, ngeSonto. UJordan wazama ukuphuthumisa u-Imani esibhedlela kodwa washona nje eqeda kufika khona. Umsolwa, obhekene namacala amane, usatoke esitokisini iMiddlesex County Adult Correctional Centre. UJordan usolwa ngecala lokubulala, elokubeka impilo yengane engcupheni, elokuba nesikhali ngenhloso yokusosebenzisela into engekho emthethweni nokuba nesikhali ngendlela engekho emthethweni.Umufi ushiye emhlabeni ingane eneminyaka emithathu futhi ezibonele ngamehlo unina ebulawa phambi kwayo.
Angase abhekane necala lokushaya, umsakazi weGagasi FM, owenza uhlelo lwasekuseni phakathi nezinsuku, ngemuva kokufika ekhaya kubo kamngani wenkosikazi yakhe ethi uzofuna izingane zakhe.Lo msakazi kuvela ukuthi unkosikazi wakhe uqoqe amasaka akhe emzini wabo, wahamba ngemuva kokuthi ehambe wayolobola unkosikazi wesibili.NgoLwesithathu izintatha kuthiwe ufike kubo kamngani kankosikazi wakhe, edle amanzi aponjwana nala evuke ulaka, washaya umsizi wasengadini, waxabana namalungu omndeni la unkosikazi wakhe akade ekhona ethi abamnike izingane zakhe.Umthombo weSolezwe, ngumngani kankosikazi walo msakazi, uveze ukuthi bawudle kabi uKhisimuzi ngenxa yodlame olwenziwe ilo msakazo."UNkosikazi wakhe uhambile ngemuva kokuthi kade eyolobola ngempelasonto edlule. Uthathe isinqumo sokungayi ekhaya kubo kodwa waya kamngani wakhe wafike wadala umsindo esingakaze siwubone. Ubethuka wonke umuntu egcekeni ethi ufuna izingane zakhe, uze washaya umsizi wasengadini namanje esifuna ukuthi ahambe ayomvulela icala ngalesi senzo," kusho umthombo.Uthe isimo besisibi kakhulu ngendlela yokuthi abomndeni baze babiza amaphoyisa ukuzobhekana isimo futhi bamxoshe ahambe.Umngani kankosikazi walo msakazi, naye uyiqhophile iVideo, echaza ngendlela abahlukumezeke ngayo okwenziwe ilo msakazi.Uthe okubuhlungu ukuthi lo msakazi athuke uMama wakhe, aze akhiphe amazwi okuthi yena ngeke bamenze lutho ngoba kulo muzi akade eye kuwo akukho ndoda, engamvimba kwakwenzayo.
