Amaphoyisa asola ukuthi lokhu kuhlobene nokuziphindiselela noma ukuzama ukuqeda ubufakazi.Akekho osaboshiwe, amaphoyisa ayaphenya ngalesi sigameko.
UBUHLE bokukholwa, wubumqoka bokuthemba uNkulunkulu nomyalezo wokungaphonsi ithawula empilweni - yizona zindikimba ezihamba phambili ecwecweni elisha lekwaya yebandla lamaZayoni iBethlehem Church In Zion: Ikhaya Lendumiso, eliphume ngesonto elidlule.Lokho kushiwo wumholi wekwaya yaleli bandla uMnuz Zama Ntombela, engxoxweni ekhethekile neSolezwe malungana nale albhamu yabo yesithupha esihloko sithi Kukhona Ongithintile, okudidiyelwe izingoma eziwu-18 kuyona.UNtombela uthe baqale ukusebenzela ekuphekeni izingoma abazifake kuyona ngabo-Agasti, base beya ukuyoqopha e-studio se-Indoni Media, esiseGoli - abakuqondanisa nempelasonto yenkonzo yabo yesivuno ebingoSepthemba, benzela ukuphelela kahle kwabebezodingeka embhobheni. "Wumsebenzi esidlulisa ngawo umyalezo wentshumayelo yeZwi likaNkulunkulu, esikholwa wukuthi abantu bayadinga ukuwuzwa, nokubuyisa ithemba ebantwini ngoba siqonda ukuthi kuningi kakhulu ababhekana nakho empilweni okwenza baze baphose ithawula,” kusho uNtombela.Uthe kulo msebenzi ubambisane nabhala nabo izingoma oMnuz Sabelo Lukhele ongumholi wabantu abasha, kube wumDikhoni webandla uMnuz Jabulani Nhleko, kube nacula naye ezinye izingoma uMnuz Velaphi Gumede - nabesifazane abacula phambili ezingomeni oNksz Nozipho Mdluli, uNksz Nqobile Hadebe, uNksz Nokwazi Mbuyisa noNksz Sne noThobile Mbuyazi."Kanti ngibheke kakhulu izingoma ezithi Samukela Okuhle - esondelene kakhulu nenhliziyo yami ngenxa yomyalezo wayo ojulile wokukhuthaza abantu ukwamukela zonke izimo nje ababhekana nazo empilweni yabo ngoba sikholelwa ekutheni konke okwenzekayo kuyintando kaThixo. "Ikhona futhi enye ingoma ethi Asibambene Negazi - eveza ukuthi emhlabeni kunezimo zomoya kaSathane esibhekena nazo ezihlose ukuzamazamisa ukholo lwethu, bese kuba nenye futhi ethi Uyangazi - yona eqinisa abantu isibindi ukungaphonsi ithawula empilweni,” kulanda yena.Uthe akufisa kakhulu wukuthi lo msebenzi abawenzayo ungabi ngowokuzidumisa kuphela, kepha kube ngowokufeza inhloso yokuqhakambisa ubuhle namandla kaNkulunkulu ebantwini.Kuthintwa omunye wabaholi baleli bandla uMnuz Richard Mbuyazi, yena uthe kuhlale kuyinselelo ukwenza umsebenzi onjena ebandleni ikakhulu ngoba uma uhola ibandla, kudingeka ukuthi ukwazi ukubonisana namalungu alo, futhi uhlale uzoba nobuhlakani bokuxazulula izinselelo zokuphambana kwemibono ngendlela eyakhayo, nengezukubhidlisa enisuke senikwakhile. "Ibandla lethu like laba nezinselelo eziningi ebezenza ukuthi singakhiphi i-albhamu iminyaka emihlanu yonke sisazama ukuzilungisa, kanti manje sesibheke ukuthi njengoba sesibuyile nje siqhubeke nendlela ebesivame ukusebenza ngayo yokujabulisa abantu ngomculo, bese futhi sinabela ezindaweni ezahlukene ezweni lonke ngomsebenzi omuhle,” kusho uMbuyazi.I-Bethlehem ineminyaka ewu-88 ikhona, kanti okwamanje inamagatsha ayisikhombisa koMzingazi, eNseleni, yiKwaSikhemelele, eGoli, eMseleni naseMbazwana - lapho idabuka khona. Le albhamu yelama ayisihlanu okuqala athi Sisebenzise Jehova, Ikhanda LikaJohane, Indlu Yaphakade, Xola Moya Wami nabazibula ngayo ngo-2007 ethi Mhla Lifika Ivangeli.
NJENGOBA unyaka usuya emaphethwelweni, abantu abaningi basebenzisa lesi sikhathi ukucabanga ukuthi yini abafuna ukuyenza, ukuyishintsha nokuyifeza onyakeni omusha ozayo.Nokho ngaphambi kwalokho kusemqoka ukuqale ume kancane, uzibuze ukuthi lokho ofuna ukukwenza nokukufeza kuyahambisana yini nohlobo lwempilo ofuna ukuyiphila uma kuqala unyaka omusha.Lokho kushiwo wumqondisi wophiko lakwandaba zabantu lwenkampani yezokuxhumana iPenguin, uNksz Annemie Burger, ecebisa abantu ngezinto okumele baziqaphele njengoba kwazeka ukuthi baningi abakholelwa ekuhleleni abazokwenza ngonyaka olandelayo."Siphila esikhathini lapho abantu bekholelwa ekutheni kumele basebenze kanzima ukusiza ukuthi bafeze abakufunayo nabakufisayo ngempilo yabo, kodwa lokho akwenzeki kuphela ngalokho kepha kudinga ukuthi uzibuze imibuzo efanele, nezokuba wumhlahlandlela wozokwenza,” kucebisa uNksz Burger.Unikezele ngale mibuzo abona ingaba wumhlandlandlela osizayo:1. Yini engiyifunde kulo nyaka ophelayo?Ngaphambi kokubheka phambili kokufunayo, qala ngokubheka emuva ucabange okuningi odlule kukho, wokufundile ngakho, nokuthi yikuphi ongafisa ukukwenza ngendlela ehlukile kubhekwe phambili. Lokho kusiza ukuthi uthi uhlabela phambili usuqonda ngokuphelele okumele ukugweme.2. Umfutho wakho uwusebenzise kuphi futhi kanjani, kwakusiza ngani?Ekupheleni konyaka abantu bavame ukuzizwa bekhathele kepha bengenaso isiqiniseko sokuthi umuntu ukhathazwe yini, ngakho ukuzibuza ukuthi umfutho nesikhathi sakho esiningi ukusebenzise kanjani kungasiza ukuqonda ukuthi yini ekugqilazile, ukwazi nokwenza kangcono ngokuzayo, ugweme okudinga ukugwenywa.3. Iyini impumelelo kuwena?Kulula ukuziqhathanisa nabanye abantu noma ukugijimisa amaphupho abukeka emahle emehlweni akho, kodwa akuyona into okumele ugxile kuyona leyo ngoba ingakufakela ingcindezi enkulu nengenasidingo. Ngakho kungakusiza ukuthi wenze impumelelo ibe yinto eqondene nawe ngqo, wehlise umoya futhi ungazibekeli imigomo eniningi nezokufakela ingcindezi ongayidingi.4. Yini ofuna ukukhula nayo?Abantu ohlala nabo isikhathi eside baba nomthelela ekutheni ucabanga kanjani, wenza kanjani ezimweni ezithile nokunye okweyamene nalokho. Cabanga ngakho konke okukuphakamisile noma kwakufundisa izinto ezithile kulo nyaka, bese uzibuza ukuthi yikuphi okuhle okufundile kukho. Yini ekwenze ukuthi wazibona uwumuntu obalulekile nohloniphekile, bese uqikekela ukugudluza konke obona kungaba yisithiyo sempumelelo yakho onyakeni omusha.5. Yini ozoyenza ngokwehlukile ngokuzayo?Ukukhula kwangempela empilweni kwenzeka uma ushintsha ukwenza ezintweni ezithile zempilo yakho, ngakho kusemqoka ukuthi esikhundleni sokuphonsa ithawula kulokho obona kungafezeki, zibuze ukuthi yikuphi mhlawumbe okumele ukuguqule noma ukwenze ngendlela ehlukile ukuze uthole umehluko ofanele.
Kudutshulwe kwabulawa uDJ ocime umculo sekuvalwa ethaveni eMganduzweni Trust, eMasoyi, eMpumalanga ngoLwesithathu ebusuku. Ngokusho kwesitatimende samaphoyisa, isigameko senzeke ngabo-11.30 ebusuku saphetha ngokuthi umsolwa naye azidubule afe.Okhulumela amaphoyisa aseMpumalanga, uBrigadier Donald Mdhluli, uthe amaphoyisa aseMasoyi abezungeza egade ubugebengu ngesikhathi ebona iqulu labantu liphuma ethaveni. "Amalungu ethu abe esema kwathi uma ephenya athola ukuthi kube nesigameko sokudubula esenzeke ngaphakatthi endaweni. Ngebhadi kutholakale izidumbu zabesilisa ababili zilimele. Kubizwe abezempilo abafike baqinisekisa ukuthi bobabili bafile,” kusho uMdhluli.Uthe imibiko ithi uDJ obedlala ethaveni, okuvela ukuthi ibinemvume yokusebenza, uvale umculo wase eqoqa imishini yakhe."Abebephakathi bathe akaqhubeke nokudlala ngoba isikhathi sikaKhisimuzi. U-DJ kuthiwa ube esesho ukuthi sekuyisikhathi sokuthi itthaveni ivalwe. Ngaphezu kwemizamo yakhe yokuchaza imimoya ivele yaphakama. Omunye wabebesethaveni oneminyaka engu-28 kuthiwa udonse isibhamu wadubula uDJ ngaphambi kokusiphendulela ngakuye isibhamu.” Amaphoyisa avule idokodo lophenyo futhi isibhamu asikatholakali.Obambe njengoKhomishana wamaphoyisa eMpumalanga, uMajor General (Dkt) Zeph Mkhwanazi, usigxekile lesi sigameko. Uthe kumele kuphenyisiswe ukuthi isibhamu singene kanjani ethaveni ngoba izikhali ezindaweni ezinje azivumelekile.
OWOMNDENI womholi weqembu uMkhonto Wesizwe (MKP) uMnuz Jacob Zuma, ohlala eNkandla uthi udangele ngesenzo asola ngaso uNkk Duduzile Zuma-Sambudla sokuthi waba neqhaza ekutheni amadodana akhe amabili nomzukulu wakhe bathunyelwe eRussia, kanti bangena shi empini yaleli zwe nabase-Ukraine.Owesifazane, ocele ukuthi igama lakhe lingadalulwa, wayeshade nomfowabo kaZuma ongasekho emhlabeni. Uthe izingane zakhe ziyingxenye yabangu-17 abathunyelwa eRussia kuthiwa bayoqeqeshelwa ezempi.Ukhale ngokuthi usehlalele ovalweni ngenxa yokwesaba ukuthi kungenzeka ukuthi izingane zakhe zibulawe kunokuthi ziqeqeshelwe ukuba onogada njengokomyalelo we-MKP, njengoba ekholwa wukuthi kwashintsha uhlelo phambili zafakwa ebuthweni elilwela iRussia, etholene phezulu ne-Ukraine.Uthe uNkk Zuma-Sambudla waba nesandla ekuhambeni kwezingane zakhe nalaba abanye abawu-14 beyoqeqeshwa eRussia. Kuthiwa babetshelwe ukuthi kwakuzothatha izinyanga eziyisithupha, bese bebuya bezoba sophikweni lwezokuphepha lwe-MKP.Kwenzeka lokhu nje, ngoLwesihlanu kuvele ukuthi uNkk Zuma-Sambudla uhambise incwadi efungelwe ecacisa iqhaza alibambile nakwaziyo ngalolu daba.Esithangamini nabezindaba ebesibizwe wubuholi beMK Party eThekwini, ngalo uLwesihlanu - kumenyezelwe izindaba zokuthi uNkk Zuma-Sambudla useqoke ukuthi asule ekwenzeni imisebenzi yaleli qembu, kubalwa nowokuba yilungu lalo ePhalamende, ukuze agxile ngokuphelele ekusizeni abesilisa ukuthi babuyele emindenini yabo bephephile.Isihlobo sikaZuma sithe konke lokho akusho lutho kusona. "Ukuphela kwento engifuna ukuyizwa wukuthi izingane zami zibuyela nini ekhaya, hhayi ukuthi uNkk Zuma-Sambudla wenzani ngalokho, ngoba into emqoka kimina wukubuyela kwabantwana bami ekhaya," kusho sona.Sithe kwabesilisa abawu-17 abathunyelwa eRussia, kukhona amadodana aso amabili nomzukulu oyedwa. Sithe: "Kukhona nabanye futhi abahlanu abazalwa wumlamu wami uMaMzobe."Uthe ngenkathi izingane zakhe zihamba nalaba abanye bathenjiswa ukuthi babezoqeqeshelwa ukuba onogada eRussia."Ngenkathi behamba ngangisele no-R2000 kuphela ebhange, engawuthumela kubona ngingafuni ukuthi bahambe belambatha bengaphethe lutho," kukhononda isihlobo.Uthe wayevele engafuni ukuthi abantwana bakhe baye eRussia ngoba wayesola khona ukuthi kungase kubafake engozini yempi nabase-Ukraine."Sabona ukuthi kwakuzoba yithuba elihle leli lokuthi bathole umsebenzi njengoba kwase kuyisikhathi eside bengasebenzi. Sabona kungaba yithuba elihle lokuthi baziphilise, esasithemba ukuthi bekuzoshaya uDisemba sebebuyile, babuye baphindele futhi kuze kushaye uJulayi obekumele kuphele ngawo isikhathi sokuqeqeshwa kwabo," kulanda yena.Ukhale nangokuthi ngokwazi kwakhe babewu-19 sebebonke abesilisa ababebuthwe ukuyoqeqeshwa eRussia, okwenza adideke ukuthi kwenzeka kanjani ukuthi manje kuvele ukuthi bawu-17 okumshiya nombuzo wokuthi kwenzekeni ngalaba abanye ababili?
ELAKULELI lisale ngaphandle ngesikhathi iMelika inikeza uxhaso lwezigidi zamadola emazweni asezwenikazi i-Afrika. INingizimu Afrika ayitholanga lutho ngesikhathi iMelika isayina izivumelwano zokusebenzisa namazwe ase-Afrika. Lezi zivumelwano zizokwelekelela empini yokulwa nezifo ezithathelanayo e-Afrika. INingizimu Afrika iyona ehamba phambili ngesibalo sabantu abahaqwe yingculaza e-Afrika. IMelika isanda kunqamula uxhaso lwayo lwezinhlelo zokulwa nengculaza eNingizimu Afrika. Uxhaso lwanqanyulwa emva kokufungiswa kukaMengameli Donald Trump. Uxhaso obelutholwa yiNingizimu Afrika ezinhlelweni zokulwa nengculaza lulinganiselwa ku-R400 million ngonyaka.Uhulumeni wakuleli unyamanambana kuhulumeni kaTrump, njengoba esola uhulumeni wakuleli ngokuhlukumeza amaBhunu nokuwaphuca umhlaba wawo.Okuphinde kufakele uhulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika isigcwagcwa kuhulumeni kaTrump isinqumo sakuleli sokumangalela elaKwa-Israel ngempi eqhubeka eGaza.Icala elifakwe elakuleli lithethwa eNkantolo yaMacala aMazwe oMhlaba.Mumva nje, uTrump usanda kumemezela ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika ayamukelekile emhlanganweni wamazwe angaphansi kweG20 ozobanjelwa eMelika, ngonyaka ozayo. UTrump akazange alubhade emhlanganweni weG20 owawubanjelwe kuleli.Ngesikhathi uTrump ehoxisa uxhaso alunika iNingizimu Afrika, maningi amanye amazwe ase-Afrika athelwa amachaphazelo, nawo aphucwa uxhaso.UTrump useqalile ukuwasondeza amanye amazwe answinywa kanye neNingizimu Afrika njengoba esayine izivumelwano zokusebenzisana nawo ezintsha.Phakathi kwamazwe ahlomulile kubalwa iNigeria, Kenya, Rwanda, Cameroon, eSwatini namanye.Izivumelwano ezintsha zikhombisa ukuthi amazwe ahlomulile azoyihlangabeza iMelika.IMelika izokhipha u-8 billion wamadola bese kuthi amazwe ahlomulile wona akhiphe u-$5 billion.IHhovisi likaTrump lithe isivumelwano esisha sikhombisa ukuzinikela kweMelika ekulweni nezifo ezithathelanayo."Ingqophamlando lena. IMelika izoqhubeka nokuxhasa izinhlelo zokulwa nezifo ezithathelanayo, iphinde futhi iqhubeke nokuqinisa ubudelwano bayo namanye amazwe."Isivumelwano esisha sithi iMelika izokelekelela ekuthengweni kwemithi nemishanguzo yokulwa nokusabalala kwezifo, ukuholela abasebenzi kanye nokuqoqa ulwazi.Isivumelwano siphinde siveze ukuthi mazwe azokwenza kahle azothola uchatha.
ASHAYWE ngoswazi oluncane amalungu eMKP asolwa ngokususa udweshu esiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal, ngesikhathi kulalelwe isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNdunankulu wesifundazwe, uMnuz Thami Ntuli. Amalungu eMKP angu-35 amisiwe emsebenzini futhi awezukuhola kulesi sikhathi asimisiwe, awezukuvunyelwa nokuhamba imihlangano emihlanu yokuhlala kwesiShayamthetho. Lokhu kuvele ezincwadini ezibhalwe nguSomlomo esiShayamthetho, uNksz Nontembeko Boyce.Amalungu eMKP avuka umbhejazane ngesikhathi uNksz Boyce enqaba isicelo sokuba kuvotwe ngokuyimfihlo esiphakamisweni sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNtuli. Amalungu eMKP atholana phezulu namaphoyisa, awajikijela ngezigubhu zamanzi. Amalungu eMKP aphinde abamba uNksz Boyce ngesidlozane, amnqabela ukuthi aphume lapho okwakubanjelwe khona umhlangano. UNksz Boyce uthe okwenziwa ngamalungu eMKP kuphambene nesigaba sesine somthetho olawulwa ukuphathwa kwePhalamende neziShayamthetho. "Ukwephula lesi sigaba somthetho kuyicala elibomvu, ungaboshwa ngisho nokuboshwa. Uma ulahlwe ileli cala ungabhadla ejele noma uhlawuliswe." USotswebhu weMKP esiShayamthetho, uMnuz Bonginkosi Mngadi, uthe bazosiphonsela inselelo isinqumo sikaNksz Boyce. "Sesibazisile ubuholi beqembu ngalesi sinqumo sikaNksz Boyce. Sizokuba nomhlangano maduze lapho sizoxoxa khona kabanzi ngalolu daba."UMngadi uthe uNksz Boyce kufanele azisole yena ngodweshu olwasuka esiShayamthetho. "Uyena owadala ukuthi kusuke umsindo. Ukube wavuma ukuthi kuvotwe ngokuyimfihlo wawungeke usuke lo msindo."Isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNtuli sachithwa.Onke amaqembu abusa ngokubambisana, i-IFP, ANC, DA ne-NFP aphikisana nesiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNtuli. La maqembu anezihlalo ezingu-41 kwezingu-80 esiShayamthetho. Ngamalungu e-EFF amabili kuphela aseka isiphakamiso seMKP.
BEKUWUMUNYU wodwa emngcwabeni kaWarric Stock (40), odume ngelikaDJ Warras, odutshulwe ngesonto eledlule, eGoli. UWarras ufihlwe izolo, ngemuva kwenkonzo ebiseBandleni lamaKhatolika, eRosebank, eGoli. Ngemuva kwenkonzo kuvele ukuthi uzolothiswa.Abomndeni bahluleke nokuzibamba kufika isidumbu sakhe njengoba babanye bephume ayombona nokube umzuzu onzima kuwona wonke umuntu obekhona, nobebukele ezinkundleni ezihlukene. Abomndeni baveze ukuthi bazohlala bemkhumbula njengeqhawe ebelilwela ukuthi abakuleli bahlale kahle ezweni labo. Enkonzweni yakhe belungekho uhlelo olude. Bekukhethwe abantu abambalwa okukhona kubo owomndeni, umngani nowenkonzo abafunde akade bekubhalile ngabakukhumbula ngoWarras, esaphila. Bonke bamchaze njengeqhawe abathe ngeke baze balilibale, wachazwa njengomuntu obethanda izingane zakhe.UNomalanga Shozi usaziwayo osebenze nalo DJ, uthe ilahlekelwe kakhulu indima yezokusakaza nekaqedisizungu. Uthe uWarras uyohlala emkhumbula ngokuthanda abantu bakuleli kanjalo nokuthanda umsebenzi wakhe. U-DJ Sabby odabuka naye eVryheid, lapho uWarras ekhulele khona, uveze ukuthi bahlanganiswa yikho ukuthi baqhamuka edolobheni elilodwa nokuyinto eyabenza basondelana nakakhulu. "Wangamukela ngezandla zombili ngifika eYFM, ngimncane ngingazi lutho. Kodwa ngakhula ngaphansi kwesandla sakhe. Ubudlelwano bethu baqina uma sesithola ukuthi sizalwa edolobheni elilodwa. Ngizomkhumbula ngokuthanda izingane zakhe, nokungakhulumi ngokwesaba into uma engayithandi," kusho uDJ Sabby. Ngemuva kwenkonzo, umndeni ube usumemezela ukuthi uzoya kolothiswa, nokuzoba inkonzo okuzovumeleka kuyo umndeni kuphela. NgoMsombuluko, amaphoyisa akuqinisekisile ukuthi babili besilisa ababoshwe ehostela, eSoweto ngokudutshulwa kukaWarras. UBrigadiere Athlenda Mathe uthe laba besilisa baboshwe ngemuva wezithombe zeCCTV abanazo. Laba basolwa kulindeleke ukuthi bavele enkantolo namhlanje.
KWENZEKE okungajwayelekile ngeSonto, usoseshini wamatekisi ahambela eVerulam, Ndwedwe, Thekwini, Thongathi naKwaDukuza, uklomelisa abashayeli abawuphatha ngesinono umsebenzi wokuthutha abagibeli.Kulo mcimbi obuseVerulam, kuklonyeliswe abaphumelele ngokuvotelwa abagibeli, ngezindondo, izitifiketi nango-R1 000 umunxa ngamunye, ukuze abaphume phambili bajabule. UNkk Thandeka Luthuli weZamukulungisa Taxi Association uthe le miklomelo baqale ukuyenza nyakenye, ukuzama ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abashayeli bawuphatha kahle umsebenzi, babagqugquzela ukuthi bahlanzeke, bahloniphe abagibeli, bazithande bese beziphatha kahle. "Mihlanu iminxa ebibekiwe. Kuyona kukhona owomshayeli ohlanzekile, imoto ehlanzekile, umshayeli ohloniphayo, imenenja yaserenki ehlanzekile kanjalo nemenenja ewuphatha kahle umsebenzi,” kusho uNkk Luthuli. Uthe njengoba sekuwunyaka wesibili beklomelisa labo abaphume phambili bahlose ukuthi lokhu kugcine kuba yinto enkulu ngokuthi babaklomelise ngezinto ezinkulu, baphinde babacije ngamanye amakhono njengokukhanda izimoto ukuze bathuthuke, wathi abaphume phambili bakhethwe abagibeli njengoba emasontweni amathathu edlule befake ekhasini labo leFacebook ukuthi abavote. "Naserenki besibeke ibhokisi lapho bebephosa khona amagama abashayeli abababona befanelwe ukuhlomula,” usho kanje.Umshayeli okhale wemuka noklomelo wokuhlanzeka kanjalo nemoto ehlanzekile uMnuz Buya Ntuli waseMthebeni, eNdwedwe, othe kumjabulisile ukubona obasi babo bebaklomelisa. "Kuyasigqugquzela ukuthi umsebenzi siwuthande, siwuhloniphe,” usho kanje. Uthe waqala ukushayela amatekisi ngo-2010, wathi le ayishayela manje wayiqala ngo-2014. "Siyafisa ukuthi iqhubeke eyemiklomelo. Kuzokwenza nabanye abashayeli bawuhloniphe umsebenzi, bazi ukuthi bazohlomula okuthile,” kusho uNtuli.Abanye abahlomulile uMnuz Siya Mbambo ohlomule kowokuhlonipha noMnuz Nkosinathi Madlanduna ohlomule kowokuba yimenenja yaserenke ehlanzekile nesebenza ngokuzimisela.
UHLOSE ukuthi bangasaleli emuva kwezobuchwepheshe abafundi abafunda ezikoleni zikahulumeni owesifazane waseHluhluwe, esungula umncintiswano werobhothi eliwuthisha owethulwe eMhlanga, izolo.UNksz Thando Gumede waseMnqobokazi, unguchwepheshe kwezeCoding and Robotics, kulandela ukukhala emuke nesicoco sikaMiss Tech Universe eThailand, nyakenye, eqwaqwada abanye ompetha bamazwe avile ku-50. Leli robhothi - elidume ngelika-Iris - ulethule ebantwini ngo-Agasti nonyaka, kanti likwazi ukufundisa izifundo zasezikoleni zamabanga aphansi, athe thuthu kanjano nasezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme. U-Iris usebenza njengothisha, uyalekelela ngokufundisa, ukumaka nokucubungula ulwazi. UNksz Gumede uthe emuva kokubona ukuthi u-Iris uthengwa kakhulu yizikole ezizimele, ubone kukuhle ukuthi enze umncintiswano wokuthi nezikahulumeni izikole zihlomule ngaye. "Kulo mncintiswano, abantu bazoqoka izikole abafisa zihlomule bese ziyavotelwa, ezizothola amavoti amaningi, yizo, ezizokhala zemuke no-Iris bazo,” kusho uNksz Gumede. Uthe ngaphandle kokuthi izikole zivotelwe, kuvuleke nohlelo lokuthi labo abathanda ukuxhasa ngemali ekutheni izikole abazoziqoka, zihlomule, kuzoba njalo."Sizobheka ukuthi iminikelo ibe yimalini, bese sinika lezo zikole ezinikelelwe abaxhasi. Uxhaso oluzosala lapho, sizobe sesilunikezela kulezo zikole eziqokiwe ukuze kuhlomule izikole eziningana,” usho kanje.Uthe uhlelo lokuqoka seluvele luqalile, abafuna ukuqoka izikole bangathumela imininigwane yezikole enombolweni ethi 062 640 2403, wathi lokhu kuzovalwa ngoJanuwari 31, 2026. Uthe ufaka u 12033124# ukuvotela lezo abafuna ziwine, usebenzisa inombolo eyimfihlo pzoyithola uma uthunyelwa uma uqoka izikole. Uveze ukuthi sekucacela noma ubani ukuthi isikhathi okuphilwa kuso manje sibheke ebuxhakaxhakeni bezobuchwepheshe."Siyathanda asithandi lobu buxhakaxhaka esibubona sebudlondlobele kwamanye amazwe, buyeza nasezweni lethu. Ongafuni ukuqala azilungiselele, uyozithola esenkingeni,” kusho uNksz Gumede. Uthe leli robhothi akalisungulelanga ukuthi lizoqeda umsebenzi wothisha kodwa walisungulela ukuthi lizokwenza umsebenzi wabo ube lula."U-Iris uma sebebhalile i-test abafundi, ukwazi ukubamakela ngomzuzu owodwa aqede asheshe akwazi nokuhlaziya ukuthi yimuphi umbuzo obahlulile. Lokhu kuyamlekelela uthisha ukuthi asheshe abone lapho okufanele aqinise ngakhona,” usho kanje.Uthe u-Iris wazi izilimi ezingaphezu kuka-7 000 kanti kumanje usebenza emazweni ehlukene emhlabeni wonke. I-Iris ubiza u-R250 000 uma eyedwa kodwa uma eza ne-lab kanjalo nama-tablet, kubiza u-R600 000. Uveze ukuthi izikole ezizohlomula ngaye akufanele zikhathazeke kangako ngokuphepha kwakhe njengoba wakhiwe ngendlela yokuthi uyakwazi ukufonela abaphathi bezikole uma kukhona umuntu ogqekela i-lab abekwe kuyo.
UFIKELE ebantwini abawudinga ngempela uKhisimusi wezihlalo ezihamba ngamasondo kanjalo namabhakede egilosa, okunikelwe yinhlangano engenzi nzuzo KwaMashu, izolo.Inhlangano engenzi nzuzo, iRenew Home Foundation, eyasungulwa yiphoyisa lasesiteshini saseNtuzuma, uSergeant Slindile Njilo nowakwakhe, uKhumbuzile Njilo, inikele ngezihlalo eziyisithupha kwabaphila nokukhubazeka nangamabhakede angu-20 emindenini ehlwempu. USgt Njilo uthe benze lo mnikelo ngoba bahlale bekujabulela ukwelula isandla wabasuke bedinga. "Usizo engilwedlulisele emphakathini ngiluthole emva kokuhambe ngingqongqoza eminyangweni ehlukene, ngilucela, kwaba khona othintekayo, welula isandla,” kusho uSgt Njilo.Uthe umnikelo wezihlalo ezihamba ngamasondo uwuqale ngoLwesine, ngesikhathi enikelela uMnuz Mvelo Shangase (24) wakwa-F, kwathi ayisihlanu wawadlulisela ekhanseleni lakwa-C ukuze linike abasohlwini lwabawudingayo ewadini. "Ayikho into emnandi njengokuba wusizo emphakathini. Siye sifikelwe inqwaba yabantu bezofuna usizo enhlanganweni yethu. Siyaselula isandla lapho esikwazi ukufinyelela khona. Kulokhu nje siyajabula ukuthi esibanikelele bazoba noKhisimuzi omuhle,” kusho uSgt Njilo. Uthe ukhule ethanda ukwelula isandla njengoba unina owamkhulisa ngayedwana wayeshumayela lelo vangeli. Ngasohlangothini lomyeni wakhe, into yokupha naye uyifunde ekhaya njengoba ezalwa usomabhizinisi owake waba yiMeya yaseMsunduzi, uMnuz Themba Njilo, naye ohlale enikela emiphakathini. Amabhakede agcwaliswe izidlo zikaKhisimusi, wona uthe basendleleni yokuwahambisa eSiyanda naseRichmond Farm, izolo ntambama. Nakhona uthe bazokhetha imindeni ehlwempu ukuze ingasali isiba noKhisimusi omnyama ngempela. Inhlangano bayisungula emva kwesigameko lapho uSgt Njilo waba undabuzekwayo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ngoMeyi nyakenye, ebonakala ebelethe usana egqoke umfaniswano wamaphoyisa. Lokhu kwenzeka emva kokuthi owesilisa waseNtuzuma, waluletha esiteshini luhlubule. Kuthiwa emzini walona wesilisa kwafika owesifazane owayeluphethe, wacela ukungeniswa endlini encane, ethi uxinekile. Kuthiwa wabe eselubeka phansi, wangena endlini encane samuntu oyoyisebenzisa, kanti uzophuma ngewindi, ziye, elushiya nalona wesilisa owabe eseluhambisa emaphoyiseni emva kokubona ukuthi unina, ubezolulaxaza. USgt Njilo kuthiwa waluthatha walugeza, wayoluthengela izimpahla. Ozakwabo bamthwebula izithombe, okwathi uma zingena ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, abantu bababaza ubuntu kuye.Unina kaShangase onikelelwe ngesihlalo, uNksz Thenjiwe Shangase, uthe besinzima isimo kwindodana yakhe eyazalwa inokukhubazeka."Le abekade enayo (wheelchair), yayihamba ngamalahle, aphela. Ngathi ngizama ukuyowathenga, ngathola ukuthi awu-R4 800, ngangaba nawo amandla okuwathenga ngoba angisebenzi, siphila ngempesheni yakhe yokukhubazeka,” kusho uNksz Shangase. Uthe kwenzeka lokhu nje, ubesalinde abefake isicelo sayo emtholampilo ePoly."Ibisiphuke nokuphuka, athi uma ehleli kuyo, imlimaze ethangeni. Ngijabule kakhulu ngosizo esilutholile,” usho kanje, wathi wabona abenhlangano befakile ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ukuthi bafuna ukusiza abadinga izihlalo.

Ongoti esibhedlela sethu basaxoxisana nomndeni mayelana noqeqesho lokusetshenziswa kwesihlalo esinamasondo ngaphambi kokuthi isiguli sidedelwe siye ekhaya,” kusho uMaphisa.
YIZE ukwesula kukaNkk Duduzile Zuma-Sambudla eqenjini uMkhonto Wesizwe Party (MKP) kubonakale njengengcindezi edalwe yizinkinga abhekene nazo mayelana nabakuleli abashushumbiselwa eRussia, ubuholi baleli qembu buthe akaphoqwanga ukuthi asule eqenjini nasekuilimeleni ePhalamendeLokho kuhlaluke esithangamini nabezindaba eThekwini, lapho kumenyezelwe khona izindaba zokuthi uNkk Zuma-Sambudla uthumele incwadi yokwesula eqenjini.Ekhuluma kulesi sithangami uMnuz Magasela Mzobe, oyinhloko ehhovisi likamengameli waleli qembu, uthe uNkk Zuma-Sambudla akaphoqwanga ukwesula emsebenzini wakhe, kepha lesi yisinqumo asithathe yena ngokwakhe ukuze agxile ekutheni asize abantu bakuleli ababalelwa ku-17 okusolwa ukuthi bathunyelwa eRussia, kepha bagcina sebeba sekhaleni lempi yeRussia ne-Ukraine."Ufake isicelo sakhe sokwesula khona ngoba ubengeke akwazi ukuvele agxile kwezinye izinto engakakhulumi nobuholi beqembu, nokuthi athole imvume yalokho," kusho uMzobe.Eqhuba, uMzobe uthe ukwesula esikhundleni kukaNkk Zuma-Sambudla akuqondene nalutho olungasho ukuthi uphule umthetho, noma yikuphi okunye okweyamene nalokho."Uyilungu leqembu eliziphethe kahle nomholi obonile ukuthi kunenkinga enkulu ngempilo yalaba bantu abasha okudingeka ukuthi babuye bephephile ezweni, wase ecela ukuthi akhululwe emisebenzini yeqembu ukuze enze konke okusemandleni akhe ukuthola iqiniso ngalabo bantu bethu, nokusiza ukuthi babuye bephephile," kucacisa uMzobe. Lokhu kwenzeka kulandela izinsolo ezibhekiswe kuNkk Zuma-Sambudla owagxekwa kakhulu ngokuthi ube neqhaza ekuthumeni laba bantu bakuleli zwe baye eRussisa, okuthe sebefike khona - bafakwa ebuthweni lempi yabaseRussia ne-Ukraine.USihlalo we-MKP, uMnuz Nkosinathi Nhleko, uthe bathole umbiko ogcwele kuNkk Zuma-Sambudla mayelana nodaba lwabantu okuvela ukuthi bathunyelwa eRussia bagcina bengena ogibeni lwempi."Uzibophezele ukuthi abambisane nezinhlaka zomthetho ukuthi kuqhubeke ngendlela efanele ukuphenya ngalolu daba, yingakho ekhululiwe ukuthi adede emisebenzini yeqembu ukuze agxile ngokugcwele nangokuphelele kulokho. Nokho siyakugcizelela ukuthi akahlangene nalezo zinsolo zokushushumbiswa kwabantu basezweni lethu," usho kanje.UNhleko udalule nokuthi manje sebezoqhubeka nezinhlelo zokuxhumana nemindeni yabathintekayo kulolu daba, futhi babalekelele ngabangabalekelela ngakho ukusiza ukuthi kubuye abathandiweyo bayo bephephile. Ucele nomphakathi ukuthi usingathe lolu daba ngendlela ekhombisa ukuzwelana nabathintekayo kulona.Kulesi sithangami nabezindaba, uMzobe ukubeke ngokusobala ukuthi uNkk Zuma-Sambudla akazukuthatha noma aphendule noma yiluphi uhlobo lwemibuzo ebhekiswe kuyena, wathi uma sekukhona okumele akuphawule kuyobizwa esinye isithangami.

USATHUTHUMELA umndeni wetshitshi laseMbabane, eMsinga, okuthiwa libulawe yisihlobo ngeSonto, lilungiselela ukungena emgonqweni womemulo.Kulesi sigameko kudutshulwe ngesihluku uSamantha "Sammy" Dlamini (24) ngaphandle kwesango lakubo.Ngokusho kukadadewabo, uNkk Lebo Ngubane, uSammy ubulawe ngabo-7.30 ebusuku, ngesikhathi yena nezimpelesi zakhe bephumele ngaphandle kwesango. Uthe bebenza isiko lokugcotshwa kwebomvu, ukuze bangene ngaphakathi ekhaya eseyohlala emgonqweni. "Umemulo wakhe ubuzoba ngeSonto (Disemba 28). Besekuthengwe yonke into, ngisho imvunulo abezoyigqoka, inkomo ebizohlatshwa ngomemulo wakhe, konke bese kukhokhelwe,” kusho uNkk Ngubane.Uthe isigameko senzeka nje, ngisho nezimbuzi ezihlatshwa uma itshitshi lizongena emgonqweni, bese zize zaphekwa, sekusele ukuthi zidliwe.Elandisa ngokwenzekile, uthe umsolwa ongeke adalulwe kuze kuba uvela enkantolo, uqhamuke ngeveni, ehamba nomngani wakhe obephethe isibhamu. Uthe emva kokumisa imoto khona lapho ngasesangweni, umsolwa ubonakale ethatha isibhamu somngani wakhe, elokhu esishwiba emoyeni."Abantu bamkhuzile, bembuza ukuthi uhlolani, eviliyela ngesibhamu kube kujatshulwe. Uvele wasuka, wachusha phakathi kwesixuku sezintombi ezibalelwa ku-30, waze wayofika kuSammy phambili, wambula ingubo abemboze ngayo, wamdubula,” kulandisa uNkk Ngubane.Uthe isibhamu siqhume kabili kodwa iyodwa inhlamvu engene esiphongweni kuSammy, wawa phansi. Uthe nakuba zikhona izihlobo ezizame izaba zokuthi aphuthunyiswe esibhedlela kodwa bekubonakala ukuthi akulula asinde. Uthe umsolwa wenze isigameko maqede waphela emehlweni, kwaze kwaba uyazinikela emaphoyiseni ngoMsombuluko. Echaza ngobudlelwano babo naye, uthe bebubuhle kakhulu."Bebezwana noSammy, kungekho lapho abake baxabana khona. USammy njengoba ebesenza i-internship yakhe eTugela Ferry, ubethi uma embona endleleni, njengoba ebeneveni (umsolwa), ubengamdluli, ubethatha ayombeka khona,” usho kanje. Uthe badidekile ukuthi ubengenwe yini eze embulala. Uveze ukuthi izihlobo ezihambe zayombona esitokisini ngoMsombuluko, zimfice eqhaqhazela, zathi uma zimbuza ukuthi umbulaleleni umufi, wathi yena ubethi uyamdlalisa.Uveze ukuthi uwumuntu obuphuzayo utshwala, wathi akazi noma ubephuzile yini ngesikhathi enza isiga. Uchaze uSammy njengengane ebizimisele empilweni njengoba ebesephothula izifundo zakhe zeFinancila Manangement eMajuba College. "Ubehlonipha, ethanda ukuhleka, ungeke umbone ediniwe. Sibuhlungu ngokuthi ahambe kanje, sekusele izinsuku ezimbalwa umndeni ummulise, okuwuphawu lokumbonga ngokuziphatha kahle,” kusho uNkk Ngubane. Uthe amalungiselelo omemulo aqala ngoMashi nonyaka, kanti wonke umuntu emndenini ubelubheke ngabomvu lolu suku. Ubalule ukuthi ngaphambi kokwenzeka lesi sigameko, kuqhamuke inyoka esithubeni, yachusha esixukwini yaze yayoma phambi kwakhe umufi."Asazi ukuthi lokhu bekuchazani, noma bekubika wona lo mhlola ogcine wenzekile,” kusho uNkk Ngubane. Umsolwa kulindeleke ukuthi avele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMsinga ngoLwesibili,” kusho uConst Ngcobo.
SIWUNUKA eduze umkhuba isihlobo zentombazanyana osekuphele inyanga inyamalele ePhezukomkhono, eMbumbulu.UNhlalwenhle Magwaza (7) kuthiwa wanyamalala phakathi kwemizi yomakhelwane, ebuya esitolo sendawo ngoNovemba 23.Ngokusho kwesihlobo, esicele ukungadalulwa, umgilwa waphuma ekhaya eya esitolo. Kuthiwa wahambisana nomalumekazi bakhe ababili, ababeya ezihlotsheni kwesinye isigodi. Kuvela ukuthi bamkhapha, wathenga amaswidi nama-chips, base bemphelezela, bambeka sekukufushane ekhaya."Cishe wayesezodlula imizi emine, engagqagqene, afike ekhaya kodwa akazange afike,” kusho isihlobo.Sithe lokhu kwabadida ngoba nonina kamgilwa, okuthiwa wazizwa eshiywa yigazi, waphuma ethi uyamhlangabeza kodwa naye wahamba waze wayofika esitolo, wangamthola. "Noma zingeke zisakhumbuleka izikhathi ukuthi zashiyana ngemizuzu emingaki kodwa waphuma ethi uyamhlangabeza kodwa wangahlangana naye, waze wayofika esitolo,” kubeka isihlobo.Sithe esitolo bamtshela ukuthi umgilwa nomalumekazi bakhe banesikhashana behambile. Siveza ukuthi umndeni wabe usubuza komakhelwane ukuthi abambonanga yini umntwana, abanye balandula, abanye babashaya indiva. Sithe emva kokuthi bewabikele amaphoyisa, afika azobacingisa kodwa umntwana wangatholakala, saveza ukuthi ukhona umuzi abasola ukuthi kungenzeka ukuthi uyathinteka ekunyamalaleni kukamgilwa. "Ababhekani nonina kamgilwa, kulandela ukuvulela owesilisa wakhona icala kulandela isigameko sokuzama ukumdlwengula eminyakeni embalwa edlule,” kusho isihlobo. Siveze ukuthi kuleso sigameko, lona wesilisa wadonsela unina kamgilwa endlini, wazama ukumdlwengula. Sithe unina kamgilwa wathi uma ezama ukuphunyula, lona wesilisa wamklinya."Kwavuleka isicabha, kwangena unina kalona wesilisa, naye wamhlasela, elekelela indodana yakhe. Kwasiza umzukulu wakhona, owathi uma ebona ukuthi unina kamgilwa uyahlanganyelwa, wahamba wayobiza omakhelwane, nakuba wakwazi ukuphunyuka,” kusho isihlobo.Sidalule ukuthi unina kamgilwa walivula icala emaphoyiseni kodwa wabuye walisula ngenxa yokusatshiswa. Siveza ukuthi kusukela lapho, le mindeni yaba yinkukhu nempaka. Siqhube ngokuthi bekukhona inkulumo endaweni ethi lona wesilisa uhambe ethi ngabe kungcono ukuthi wambulala, wamba umgodi, amgqibe, afake usimende ngaphezulu.Siphinde saveza nokuthi emva kwalokho, unina kamgilwa uke waphithanelwa yikhanda waze wayokwelashwa esontweni laseChibini, lapho ahlale khona unyaka wonke."Umgilwa ulahleka nje, kusaphele izinyanga ezimbili kuphela unina ebuyile ekhaya,” kusho isihlobo. Sithi okubadidayo ukuthi lona wesilisa, osephenduke isidakwa, uvele acule amaculo okujabula uma kwenzekile wahlangana nonina kamgilwa endleleni."Sifuna ayiphenye yonke le nto amaphoyisa ngoba thina iyasisolisa,” kusho isihlobo, esiveze ukuthi konke lokhu kwabikelwa amaphoyisa ukulekelela ophenyweni.Okhulumela inhlangano elwela ukuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane iWomen of uMthwalume, esisabalale nakwezinye izindawo, uNksz Nombuso Sibisi, uthe kabajabulile neze ngamaphoyisa aseMbumbulu. "Ngifisa nomphakathi wakuleya ndawo ubambisane nonina kamgilwa ngoba okwenzeke kuye kungenzeka nakomunye kusasa. Bese ngicela othathe ingane ayiveze, noma ngabe useyibulele,” kusho uNksz Sibisi. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uConstable Thenjiswa Ngcobo, uthe uphiko lwamaphoyisa iFamily Violence, Child Protection and Sexual Offences eMlaza, luphenya icala lokuthumba nelokufuna imali kulandela isigameko sokuthunjwa kwentombazane (7) ngumuntu ongaziwa."Emva kokulahleka kwentombazanyana endaweni, udaba lwabikwa emaphoyiseni aseMbumbulu, ukuze aphenye. Emva kwalokho, unina kamgilwa wathola ucingo emuntwini angamazi emfuna imali,” kusho uConst Ngcobo.
IBALISA ngobuhlungu ezithola ibhekene nabo imindeni yezihlobo ezidlule emhlabeni ngesikhathi kunezikhukhula muva nje, eningizimu yeKwaZulu-Natal.Le mindeni ithi ife olwembiza ngokulahlekelwa ngabathandiweyo bayo ngenxa yalesi simo. Ibalisa nangokuthi lesi simo siyehle ngaphezulu futhi kulukhuni satshe nokusamukela.Umndeni kamufi, uMnuz Bheki Mazibuko (oshone eManzimtoti), uthe namanje akuvumi ukuba ukholwe ukuthi ilungu lawo alisekho emhlabeni ngenxa nje yezikhukhula. Udadewabo kamufi omdala, uNksz Thule Mazibuko, uthe umfowabo uvelelwe yilo mshophi esendleleni ebheke ekhaya eLovu.Uthe ubesemotweni ngeshwa imoto yangcina ingena emfuleni waseManzimtoti. Uthe lesi simo sibashiye bekhathazekile kakhulu futhi siyisilonda esisazobhibha isikhathi eside kakhulu."Kubuhlungu kakhulu lokhu okwenzekile kubhuti wethu. Angazi ukuthi ngampela le nto uNkulunkulu uyivumele kanjani ukuba yenzeke. Kwaze kwanzima ukwamukela nasi isimo," usho kanjena.Uthe okubuhlungu kakhulu ukuthi umufi ushiye emhlabeni izingane kanye nomkakhe abemthanda kakhulu."Umakoti wakhe kunzima kakhulu okwakhe, akuvumi ukuthi akwamukele okwenzekile. Asazi ukuthi sizodlula kanjani kulesi simo esinzima kangaka," echaza.Eqhuba, uchaze umufi njengomuntu obenothando ebazisa abanye abantu futhi engenanxa namuntu."Uma kukhulunywa ngomuntu olungile kukhulunywa ngalo esikhuluma ngaye njengamanje," echaza.Ukhale ngokuthi uzosokola umndeni wakhe njengoba umufi ebekade ewondla.Noma kubuhlungu kunjalo kodwa uthe bayambonga uNkulunkulu ngoba elabo ithambo selitholakele.Bakhala isililo esifanayo nasemndenini kamufi uMnuz Siyabonga Gumede. UGumede naye ubesemotweni ngesikhathi eficwa yizikhukhula imoto yakhe yangena emfuleni ofanayo eManzimtoti.Umkakhe, uNkk Luyanda Gumede, ukhulume neSolezwe wezwakalisa ukudumala okukhulu ngomshophi obehlele.Uthe akuvumi ukuthi bakholwe nokuthi akwamukele lokhu esekwenzekile kumyeni wakhe."Akuvumi nokuthi ngikhulume ngale nto, ibuhlungu kakhulu," usho kanjena.Ngaphandle kwalaba, nomndeni wakwaCele ePort Shepstone nawo ugubazelwe yifu elimnyama ngemuva kokuba ilungu lawo, uNkk Cele, edilikelwe udonga lwendlu lashona lisemcimbini ngesikhathi sezikhukhula.UNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, uthembise ukuthi izokuthola ukwesekwa imindeni yezisulu zezikhukhula. Uzwakalise ukukhathazeka kwakhe ngezikhukhula athe zikhinyabeza ezokuvakasha.
UDUKUZA ebumnyameni umndeni wakwaXulu eNyamazane, KwaMaphumulo, ngemuva kokuba uhlaselwe ngabantu abangaziwa ngoMsombuluko ebusuku.Kulesi sigameko kudutshulwe kwafa uMnuz Mzwamandla Xulu (57) kwalimala kabi nendodana yakhe, uMnuz Mthokozisi Xulu (24) ophuthunyiswe esibhedlela kukubi.UNksz Smangele Xulu oyindodakazi kamufi uthe basadukuza ebumnyameni mayelana nesigameko.Elandisa, uthe bebesegcekeni kushiswa inyama ngesikhathi kuthushuka amadoda amabili avele adubula ephindelela kuyise."Ubaba uphelele endaweni yesigameko ngoba bamdubule nasekhanda. Badubule nomfowethu kodwa wakwazi ukubaleka. Ngaleso sikhathi mina ngibone konke obekwenzeka ngoba bengizongena esangweni elincane kanti ngizozithela kule nto," echaza.Uthe ababulali bebepake imoto yabo ngaphezulu kwakubo."Babaleke bayongena emotweni bobabili," echaza. Uthe sebehambile, baphuthumise umfowabo esibhedlela."Sididekile, asazi ngampela ukuthi ngobani laba abasicabangela into ebuhlungu kangaka," echaza.Uthe uyise abekho abantu abaziyo abexabene nabo, waveza ukuthi uyise wayesembonini yamatekisi kodwa sekuphele iminyaka engu-10 aphuma kuyona."Ubaba waphuma kudala ebhizinisini lamatekisi. Umama wayesaphila ngaleso sikhathi, uyena futhi owaphoqa ubaba ukuba aphume kulona ekhala ngokuthi akalithandi ," esho.Uveze ukuthi uyise unezindlu zemiqasho ezingu-104 eziseThekwini. Uthe bayethemba ukuthi kuyoba ngozi makhaza awuphonse umbalane umfowabo."Asazi ukuthi sizokwenzanjani emva komngcwabo. Sicabanga nokuthutha okungcono siye kwenye indawo, phela lapha silwa nabantu esingabazi ukuthi bangobani nokuthi bahloseni futhi bafunani," echaza.Uthe amathemba abo sebewabeke emaphoyiseni ukuze kutholakale umnyombo ngabahlasele kubo."Sifuna ukwazi ukuthi ngobani laba abenze into ebuhlungu kangaka ekhaya," echaza.Uthe angeke bakuthole ukuphumula bengabutholanga ubulungiswa ngalesi sigameko."Siyophumula mhla baboshwa laba abenze le nto," esho.Amaphoyisa aKwaZulu-Natal akuqinisekisile ukubulawa kukaXulu nokudutshulwa kwendodana yakhe. Athe kuvulwe icala lokubulala nelokuzama ukubulala.

Mncane impela kodwa wenze ubulwane, abulale othandiweyo wethu ngesihluku esinje, maqede abe namandla okugqiba ubufakazi cishe inyanga yonke,” usho kanje. OWAYENGUMENGAMELI, uMnuz Thabo Mbeki, ubona iNingizimu Afrika ilengela eweni elibi.UMbeki uthe izwe libhekene nenkinga enkulu, wathi okubi ukuthi akasiboni isixazululo.Ukusho lokhu ekhuluma emngcwabeni waloyo owayengumeluleki wakhe, uMnuz Titus Mafolo, oshone ngeledlule. UMafolo ubeyisishoshovu se-ANC aphinde abe usomabhizinisi odumile.UMbeki utshele abebehambele umngcwabo kaMafolo ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika isengcupheni yokuphonseka eweni, wathi idinga amadoda afana noMafolo ukuze ikwazi ukuphuma kule nkinga elengela kuyo."UTitus ushone ngesikhathi esibi lapho i-ANC ibhekene khona nezinkinga eziningi. Izwe libhekene nenkinga enkulu."UMbeki uthe limfiliba ikusasa lezwe."Angazi ngani kodwa mina angiboni ukuthi libhekephi leli zwe. Angazi ukuthi lizokube likuphi kusasa leli zwe. Sibhekephi ngempela? Sizozixazulula kanjani lezi zinkinga esibhekene nazo? Lana ngikhuluma ngobugebengu, ezomnotho, isibalo esiphezulu sabantu abangasebenzi kanye nezinye izinkinga. Sizophuma kanjani kulezi zinkinga? Sidinga abantu abafana noTitus Mafolo ukuze bezosikhipha kule nkinga esikuyona."UMbeki uthe uMafolo wabamba iqhaza elikhulu ekuthuthukiseni elakuleli ngesikhathi kungena uhulumeni wentando yeningi."Lana ngikhuluma ngomuntu owasebenza ngokuzikhandla elwela ukuba kube nomehluko phakathi kwesimo izwe esalifica likuse. Izwe salishiya lingaphansi kwesimo esehlukile kunaleso esalifica likuso ngesikhathi sesishiya. Saba nenhlanhla yokuzitholela umuntu ozinikele emsebenzi wakhe."UMbeki unxuse ukuba abasebenzi bakahulumeni bahambe ezinyathelweni zikaMafolo."Njengoba engasekho, indlela eningamhlonipha ngayo ukuba nilandele ezinyathelweni zakhe. Indlela eningamhlonipha ngayo yilena yokuthi nilwele ukuxazulula izinkinga ezibhekene nezwe."UMbeki waba umengameli wakuleli phakathi emva kokhetho lwango-1999 kwaze kwaba i-ANC imtshela ukuthi ashenxe sekusele unyaka owodwa ukuthi aqede ihlandla lakhe lesibili.Kusukela i-ANC yamkhipha esikhundleni ubudlelwano bayo noMbeki abuphindanga baba buhle.UMbeki uke wangabonakala ezintweni ezithinta i-ANC isikhathi eside, uze waqala ukubonakala ngoba sekuphume owayengumengameli emva kwakhe, uMnuz Jacob Zuma.
BANGASE behleke bodwa ongqongqoshe bakuleli ngonyaka ozayo uma siphumelela isiphakamiso sokuba banyuselwe imiholo.Inhlangano enquma imiholo yabaholi abanezikhundla kuhulumeni, i-Independent Commission for the Remuneration Public Office Bearers, iphakamise ukuthi abaphethe izikhundla kuhulumeni banyuselwe imiholo ngo-4.1% kunyakamali ozayo.Lesi siphakamiso siqukethwe kwi-gazette eshicilelwe ngeledlule. Igazette iphakamisa ukuthi umholo kaMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, unyuke ngo-R137 000, nokusho ukuthi uzohola u-R3.4 million ngonyaka.IPhini likaMengameli, uMnuz Paul Mashatile, kuphakanyiswa linyuselwe ngo-R130 000, nokusho ukuthi lizohola u-R3.1 million ngonyaka.Ongqongqoshe bona kuphakanyiswa ukuba bakhushulelwe ngo-R110 000, nokusho ukuthi bazohola u-R2.8 million ngonyaka.IKhabhinethi kaRamaphosa inongqongqoshe abangu-32. Amaphini ongqongqoshe wona azohola imali engaphezu kuka-R2.3 million ngonyaka.Kunamaphini ongqongqoshe angaphezu kuka-40 kuleli. Kwabanye abazonyuselwa imiholo kubalwa nondunankulu kanye namajaji.ICosatu ithe ayihambisani nokunyuselwa kwabaholi bezepolitiki imiholo.Okhulumela iCosatu ePhalamende, uMnuz Matthew Parks, uthe izwe licwile ezikweletini."Sebekhohliwe yini ukuthi ekuqaleni konyaka bona osopolitiki bebefuna ukuthi kunyuswe intela ngo-2% ngoba nakhu bethi izwe alinayo imali? UNgqongqoshe wezeziMali (uMnuz Enoch Godongwana) usanda kwenza isexwayiso sokuthi kungase kwenzeke iphinde inyuswe intela. Kungani kufanele kunyuselwe osopolitiki imiholo ekubeni abanye abantu bethwele kanzima?"UParks ubuze ukuthi yini lena engaka eyenziwa osopolitiki ukuba sebengaze benyuselwe imiholo ngemali engaka."Uma sikhuluma ngosopolitiki lana sikhuluma ngongqongqoshe abathola izinto eziningi mahhala. Banikwa izindlu zamahhala, bayakhokhelwa izindleko zokuhamba. Uma sikhuluma ngosopolitiki sikhuluma ngezimeya eziphethe omasipala abahluleka ukuhambisa izidingo kubantu. Siyazi ukuthi bakhona osopolitiki abenza umsebenzi oncomekayo kodwa iningi labo bayahluleka ukwenza umsebenzi wabo. Asikho isidingo sokuthi kunyuselwe osopolitiki imali. Le mali ngabe isetshenziselwa ukuqasha odokotela. Okubuhlungu ukuthi uma abasebenzi bakahulumeni befuna ukunyuselwa imiholo kuthiwa imali ayikho."UParks uthe abaphikisani nokuthi amajaji nezimantshi banyuselwe imiholo."Amajaji nezimantshi abaholi imali eyanele ingakho abanye babo bewushiya umsebenzi."UParks unxuse uRamaphosa ukuba angavumi ukuba kunyuselwe osopolitiki imiholo.

Ngo-2019, wasakaza noNomalanga Shozi uhlelo lwantambama kwiGagasi FM.Uhambe emhlabeni esathula uhlelo oluthi Ngicel' iVisa kuMzansi Magic ngoLwesibili ngo-8 ebusuku, kusukela ngo-Okthoba 7. OMUNYE wabaholi bebandla lamaZayoni uMnuz Mfanafuthi Magwaza, webandla Isiqalo Sokuthula Kwama Krestu Church of God in Zion, usephosele ozakwabo inselelo yokuthi bakhuthalele ukuzihlupha ngolwazi lwemfundo yobuholi ukuze babe ngabaholi abaqotho.UMagwaza (54) usho njalo ekhuluma emva komcimbi wakhe wokuthweswa iziqu zokuba wuMfundisi ngokusemthethweni esikhungweni abefunda kusona i-United Ministries Bible School, obuseDennis Hurley Centre, eThekwini ngoMgqibelo odlule.Lezi ziqu athweswe zona, azifundele iminyaka emithathu - yi-Advanced Leadership Training Course, okusho ukuthi usenolwazi olunzulu lokuhlaziya iBhayibheli, ukweluleka abazalwane, ukufundisa inkulisa yebandla, ukuqeqesha abanye ukuhamba ezinyathelweni zakhe, ukushumayeli ivangeli nokunye okuningi okweyamene nalokho. Elandisa ngalokho, uMagwaza uthe lokhu akwenzile ufisa ukuthi kuphosele nabanye abaholi inselelo yokuthi bahambe ezinyathelweni zakhe ukusiza ukuthi bangasaleli emuva ngolwazi olumqoka nolungabasiza ukuthi bahole ibandla likaNkulunkulu ngendlela efanele."Ukuma ngobizo lokuhola abazalwane nakho kubalulekile ngokwakho, kepha futhi kusemqoka ukuthi lowo nalowo mholi afunde ngalo msebenzi ukuze angagcini enza izinto ngokwazi nokucabanga kwakhe kuphela, kepha kube ngokwezimiso zikaNkulunkulu. "Nangale kwalokho, ukugaba ngemfundo enjena kusiza ukuthi kuthi uma sewumi phambi kwabantu obaholayo, ubafundise futhi ubahole ngendlela efanele, engicabanga ukuthi uma nabanye abaholi benza kanjengoba ngenzile sizokwazi ukuqhuba umsebenzi kaNkulunkulu ngendlela efanele nezoyisa ibandla phambili futhi kulithuthukise,” kulanda uMagwaza.Uthe lokhu akuzuzile manje akwanele futhi akusona isiphetho sohambo lwakhe lemfundo, njengoba edalule nokuthi kusuka manje kubhekwe phambili - usebheke ukuthi afinyelele esigabeni sobudokotela bezeNkolo ukugaba ngolwazi olwanele lokuhola ngobuqotho.
UMHOLI weqembu elingababeki benkosi esiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Ivan Barnes, uthi uNdunankulu wesifundazwe, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, akufanele asheshe ukujabulele ukuphunyuka esiphakamisweni sokungabethembi ubuholi bakhe ebesifakwe yiMK.UBarnes uthe iqembu lakhe lizophinde lifake isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNtuli.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma namalungu eNFP eMtubatuba, kuleli sonto.UNtuli uphunyuke esiphakamisweni sokungabethembi ubuholi bakhe ebesilalelwe esiShayamthetho, ngoMsombuluko.Amalungu amaqembu abusa ngokubambisana IFP, ANC, DA neNFP aphikisane nesiphakamiso seMK nokwenza ukuthi sichithwe.Amalungu e-EFF amabili kuphela abeseka isiphakamiso seMK enezihlalo ezingu-37 kwezingu-80 esiShayamthetho.UBarnes uthe ngeke baphele amandla, wathi bazoqhubeka nemizamo yokukhipha uNtuli, wathi bafuna ukuthi uhlakazwe uhulumeni wokubambisana ophethe isifundazwe."Njengoba sithe sifuna ukuguqula uhulumeni wesifundazwe ngoba bahlangene ngenkohlakalo, le miphumela yangoMsombuluko, imiphumela yesikhashana. Injabulo yesikhashana. Nangonyaka ozayo sizofaka isiphakamiso sokukhipha iNkatha ne-ANC. Injabulo yesikhashana ayihlali injengomlilo wamaphepha."Okuqaphelekile ukuthi ilungu leNFP, uNksz Mbali Shinga, liphikise umyalelo weqembu wokuba leseke isiphakamiso seMK.I-NFP yayikade iyalele uNksz Shinga ukuthi aseke isiphakamiso sokuthi kuchithwe uNtuli.Ivoti likaNksz Shinga ilona elisindise uNtuli.UBarnes uthe uzothathelwa izinyathelo uNksz Shinga."Akukho muntu wadelela iNFP kwacweba iziziba."UNksz Shinga unguMphathiswa wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi, iNFP isike yazama ukumkhipha esikhundleni.Maphakathi nonyaka, ubuholi beNFP babhalela usomlomo, uNksz Nontembeko Boyce, bucela ukuba kukhishwe uNksz Shinga ekubeni yilungu lesiShayamthetho bese kufakwa uBarnes.UNksz Boyce wasichitha isicelo seNFP ngenxa yokuthi sasingahambisani nemithetho eyengamele ukushintshwa kwamalungu esiShayamthetho. Emva kwalokho, iNFP yabizela uNksz Shinga phambi kwekomiti eliqondisa ubugwegwe, uNksz Shinga wathola isivimbelo esinqanda ukuba iqembu limthathele izinyathelo.Kwasuka uthuthuva emhlanganweni wangoMsombuluko, ngesikhathi amalungu eMK nawe-EFF efuna ukuba kuvotwe ngokuyimfihlo.Amalungu eMK nawe-EFF azama ukuphazamisa umhlangano, agcine etholana phezulu namaphoyisa ayebizelwe ukuba azolawula isimo.Wathwala kanzima uNksz Boyce ngesikhathi evinjwa ngamalungu eMK nawe-EFF ayemnqabela ukuthi aphume esiShayamthetho.KuMasipala waseThekwini, iNFP isebenzisana ne-ANC njengoba uNksz Zandile Myeni weNFP eyiPhini leMeya kulo mkhandlu.
BAZOLASHWA emoyeni, balulekwe ngokwengqondo, bese beqeqeshwa emakhonweni abo ehlukene abagilwa abazogcinwa esikhungweni sokubeseka nokubanakekela esisha esivulwe ngokusemthethweni izolo, i-VZ KaMagwaza-Msibi Khuseleka One Stop Centre esiseBluff, eningizimu yedolobha iTheku.Lokho kudalulwe wuMphathiswa woMnyango wokuThuthukisa uMphakathi KwaZulu-Natal, uNksz Mbali Shinga, ngenkathi ethula inkulumo yakhe yokuvula ngokusemthethweni lesi sikhungo esinamagumbi awu-19 okuhlanganisa awokulala, awokuphumula, awokuphekela nalawo ahlelelwe ukwenza izinhlelo zokululeka ngokomqondo labo abasuke bedinga khona.UNksz Shinga uthe lesi sinyathelo soMnyango awuholayo nezinye izinhlaka zikahulumeni nezizimele ezibambe iqhaza kusona, siwumzamo wokuthi kunqotshwe isihlava esidlangile ezweni sezigameko zokuhlukumeza ngokobulili, ikakhulu kwabesifazane nezingane. "Nangale kwalokho, bekuyindlela esilandela ngayo ikhwelo likaMengameli wezwe, uMnuz uCyril Ramaphosa, lokuthi isifundazwe nesifundazwe kumele sibe nesikhungo esinjena sokusiza nokweseka abagilwa bezenzo zokuhlukumeza okweyamene nocansi, yingakho namhlanje sethula ngokusemthethweni lo msebenzi omuhle kangaka esesiwenzile."Okunye okusiphushe kakhulu yizibalo ezishaqisayo eziphume kwikota yokuqala yalo nyaka eziveze ukuthi zibalelwa ku-42 569 izigameko ezibikwe kwabomthehtho zokuhlukumezana okweyamene nezobulili, okusokole futhi kwathinteka kakhulu abesifazane nezingane kuzo. Yingakho sibone kusemqoka ukuthi singahlali dekle kepha kube khona esikwenzayo ukuthi sibambe iqhaza ukulungisa lesi simo esibhekene naso ezweni,” kulanda uNksz Shinga. Eqhuba, uthe lesi sikhungo asizukusiza abantu besifazane nezingane kuphela kepha sizobhekela nabesilisa ngoba bayazi ukuthi nabo bayahlukumezeka ngezindlela ezahlukene ngakho bafisa ukuthi lowo nalowo ozoza kusona asizakale ngokungachemile ngokobulili."Sifuna ukuthi bonke abantu abazokwelashwa kulesi sikhungo izinyanga ezintathu kuya kweziyisithupha njengoba kuhlelwe ukuthi kube kanjalo, baphume sebengcono kakhulu kunesimo abafike beyisona. Yingakho senze nokuthi kube nanezinhlelo zokubasiza ukuthi kucijeke amakhono abo ehlukene ukuze baphume bakwazi ukuzimela,” kusho yena.Udalule nokuthi okwenze ukuthi lesi sikhungo saqanjwa ngomsunguli weqembu lezepolitiki iNational Freedom Party (NFP), uNkk Zanele KaMagwaza-Msibi (ongasekho emhlabeni), wukuthi bebehlose ukumhlonipha ngamagalelo akhe okulwela inhlalakahle yomphakathi nentuthuko yabantu bonke, ikakhulu abesifazane akhule becindezelekile emphakathini."Kuyindlela yokuqinisekisa ukuthi igama lakhe nemisebenzi ayenzile esaphila akushabalali kodwa ngale kwalokho, lesi sikhungo sivuleleke kuwona wonke umuntu waseKZN, asikhethi ngokuthi ulandela liphi iqembu lezepolitiki ngakho sigcizelela ukuthi abantu bakithi bangabi nokudideka kulokho ngoba inhloso yethu wukusiza umphakathi esifundazweni,” usho kanje.Umlingisi wodumo lakuZalo futhi oyindodakazi kaNkk KaMagwaza Msibi, uNksz Gugu Gumede, uthe bajabule kakhulu bewumndeni ngokuthi kube khona into enhle kanjena ezosiza ukuthi igama likanina nemisebenzi yakhe emihle ayenzile kungashabalali. "Nanokuthi kuhle futhi kuyasijabulisa ukuthi igama lakhe leyamaniswe nombono ozosiza kulesi sihlava esibhekene naso ezweni lethu, esaziyo ukuthi ngisho esaphila wayehlale elwela ukuthi bonke abantu besifazane babe nempilo enhle nengenazihibe. Siyanxusa nokuthi abantu bakithi basinakekele futhi basivikele njalo lesi sikhungo ukuze kungabi nazithiyo ezizophazamisa ukusebenza kwaso kusuka manje kuya phambili,” usho kanje. IPhini leMeya kaMasipala weTheku, uNksz Zandile Myeni, nalo belikhona kulo mbuthano, lithe bayaweseka kakhulu lo mbono owenziwe wuMnyango wokuThuthukisa uMphakathi eKZN, njengoba uhambisana nowabo wokuthi kuvikelwe abagilwa bezenzo zokuhlukumeza okweyamene nobulili, nokuzama ukunqanda ukubhebhetheka kwalesi sihlava emphakathini.
UNOBHALA Jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, useyalele uphiko lwentsha lwale nhlangano i-ANC Youth League, ukuthi imashele ubuholi be-ANC uma sebunhlanhlatha.Uthe lolu phiko akumele lube amavaka kodwa kumele luyimele into elukholelwa kuyona.UMbalula uthe kabalindele ukuthi lolu phiko lusabe ukukhuluma nabaholi be-ANC njengoba bona sebebadala."Thina sesibadala, sibuye sicabangele indaba yokuthi sinemindeni, sinezingane ngakho asisakwazi ukuthatha izinqumo ezithile. Nina njengabantu abasha nicabangela ikusasa, aniyicabangi eyezingane, amakhosikazi kanjalo nezingane. Sithembele kunina ukuthi nisibuyise uma sesinhlanhlatha," kusho uMbalula izolo, ethula inkulumo kuvalwa ingqungquthela yalolu phiko eLimpopo. Ukhumbuze lolu phiko ukuthi luhloniphe izinhlaka, lungabi imidlwembe uma luphakamisa imibono."Sesithembele kunina ngokusinika umhlahlandlela wezinto ezithinta intsha okumele sizenze. Le nhlangano kumele ibekhona futhi ezinkundleni lapho kugcwele khona abantu abasha."Uthe abantu abasha abagcwele kuphela emasontweni, yingakho lolu phiko kumele lusabalele kuyona yonke indawo."Intsha yakuleli iphephezelisa ifulegi lakuleli emazweni omhlaba. Kulalelwa umculo wama-piano emhlabeni jikelele." Uveze nokuthi kumele kuchithwe ondlovukayiphikiswa abafuna ukuzabalazala bahlale emandleni oMbuso noma sebebadala."Kumele intsha ivukele uMbuso uma kukhona ondlovukayiphikiswa e-Afrika. Abantu bakhathele abantu abafuna ukufela emandleni. Kumele siyeke ukuncenga amanye amazwe afana noMelika. Sinamandla siyizwekazi i-Afrika, ngakho akumele sivumele uMengameli Donald Trump (waseMelika), asikhiphe inyumbazane, kumele silwe."Uthe ukholelwa ngukuthi i-ANC izobuyela emandleni ibuyiselwa yi-ANCYL."Sithembe i-ANCYL ukuthi izosibuyisela emandleni. Isikhathi sentsha manje njengoba sibheke okhethweni." Uncome ingqungquthela yalolu phiko okukhethwe bonke abaholi ngaphandle kokuphikiswa, wathi i-ANC kumele ifunde lukhulu kulolu phiko."Akubanga nazingqinamba kule ngqungquthela. Abekho abakhale ngokuthi kukhishwe imali kuthengwa ingqungquthela. I-ANC kumele ifunde kwi-ANCYL ngoba le ngqungquthela ihambe kahle kakhulu," kusho uMbalula.Uveze ukuthi intsha iyona okumele ihambe phambili empini yokulwa nezinga eliphezulu lentsha engasebenzi kuleli."Impi enkulu ngeyentsha engasebenzi okumele nisipheshe ngayo, ningayikhohlwa. Intsha kumele ithole amathuba omsebenzi."Uthe labo abangakhethwanga abeze kwi-ANC bezosebenzela le nhlangano ngoba abalahlekanga.

SELIPHINDE lembula ingubo langena kuMphathiswa wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi, uNksz Mbali Shinga, onqunyelwe ugwayi katiki yiqembu elimjube esiShayamthetho.I-NFP ifuna uNksz Shinga achaze ukuthi kungani eshaye indiva umyalelo weqembu wokuba aseke isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli?Lo myalelo uqukethwe encwadini eshubile ebhalelwe uNksz Shinga.Kule ncwadi ebonwe yiSolezwe, uNksz Shinga uyalelwe ukuba achaze ukuthi kungani kungafanele athathelwe izinyathelo?Incwadi eqhamuka kuNobhala Jikelele weNFP obambile, uMnuz Sunset Xaba, ibinike uNksz Shinga umnqamulajuqu wayizolo ukuba alethe impendulo.UNksz Shinga washabalalisa onke amathemba eMK okukhipha uNtuli esikhundleni ngesikhathi ezwakalisa ukuthi ngeke aseseke isiphakamiso sayo.I-MK yayidinga okungenani isihlalo esisodwa ukuze ikwazi ukunqoba esiphakamisweni sayo esasilalelwe esiShayamthetho ngoMsombuluko.Ngaphambi komhlangano, umholi weNFP, uMnuz Ivan Barnes, wayekade ethe bazoseseka isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNtuli.UXaba uveze ukuthi kwabizwa umhlangano wesigungu esiphezulu ophuthumayo emva kwengwijikhwebu eyashaywa nguNksz Shinga ngesikhathi esho okuphambene nomyalelo weqembu."Emhlanganweni wesigungu esiphezulu sinqume ukuba sikuyalele ukuba ulethe umbiko ogcwele ngalokhu owakusho ngesikhathi kunempikiswano ngesiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNtuli, kulo mbiko sifuna usilethele nenkulumo owayethulayo.""Uyalelwa ukuba ulethe omunye umbiko ogcwele lapho uzoziphendulela khona ezinsolweni zokushaya indiva umyalelo weqembu, uphinde futhi achaze ukuthi kungani kungafanele uthathelwe izinyathelo ngokwesigaba 3.5.1.2 somthetho weqembu? Ngalokhu sifisa ukuvikela isithunzi seqembu, siqinisekise ukuhlonishwa kwemigomo yeqembu, siphinde senze isiqiniseko sokuthi bonke abajutshwe ezikhundleni bayayihlonipha imiyalelo yeqembu."Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kukaNksz Shinga ayizange iphumelele.Ithimba likaNksz Shinga libanqabelile abezindaba ukuba babuze ngalolu daba ngesikhathi eyovula isikhungo sabahlukunyezwa udlame lwezobulili eThekwini, izolo.Akukhona okokuqala uNksz Shinga ethathelwa izinyathelo yiqembu lakhe.NgoJuni nonyaka, iNFP ike yazama ukumkhipha esikhundleni nasekumeleni iqemu esiShayamthetho kodwa yangaphumelela.Ike yazama nokumthathela izinyathelo zokuqondiswa ubugwegwe kodwa yavinjwa yisinqumo senkantolo.
UKHALA ngesibhedlela iMontebello esiwuzwise ubuhlungu phezu kobunye umndeni waseMission, eNdwedwe, kulandela ukuphanjaniswa kwezidumbu emakhazeni ngeledlule.Ngokusho kwesihlobo, uNkk Nelisiwe Bhungu, oshonile uNksz Nokuthula Zungu ongumakoti wakwakhe, ushonele esibhedlela ngoDisemba 4.Uthe yize kunjalo, umndeni uze wathola ucingo lwesibhedlela sibazisa ngokushona kwakhe ngoDisemba 12. "Batshele umndeni ukuthi awuze esibhedlela ngoMsombuluko (Disemba 15) nomazisi kamufi ukuze uzokhipha isidumbu emakhazeni esibhedlela. Umndeni uthe usufika uzithele phezu kwensumansumane yokuthi isidumbu asibonwa," kusho uNkk Bhengu.Uthe batshelwe ukuthi ngokwamarekhodi abhalwe phansi, kuvela ukuthi sinikwe umndeni wakwaNzama eNsuze, ngoDisemba 11."Okusho ukuthi ngesikhathi umndeni ufonelwa ngoDisemba 12, isidumbu bese sivele singasekho, sesinikwe omunye umndeni," kusho yena. Uthe lokhu kukodwa kubashiya nemibuzo yokuthi nakuba bekungenzeka ukuthi umndeni ungabonisisi kahle, uzitshele ukuthi yisihlobo sawo nawo kodwa isibhedlela sisidedele kanjani amagama nezinombolo zikamazisi kungafani?"Ngoba phela kucaca ukuthi umndeni wakwaNzama uze nomazisi obhalwe amagama nesibongo sawo. Manje bawunike kanjani isidumbu somuntu okubhaliwe ukuthi owakwaZungu?" kusho uNkk Bhengu othe bazibuza nokuthi ingabe isitifiketi sokushona senziwe kanjani ngoba umazisi kamufi ungakubona?Uthe namanje basadunguza ebumnyameni ngenqubekela phambili njengoba umndeni uphume esibhedlela wanikela emaphoyiseni aseNsuze, abakhombe kwawaseNdwedwe, nawo abakhomba enkantolo. Uthe awaseNdwedwe athe wona azongenelela uma sekukhona incwadi yasenkantolo ethi awahambe ayomba isidumbu lapho esesingcwatshwe khona. "Uyile umndeni enkantolo izolo (esho ngoLwesithathu) wabuya nempendulo ethi ake uyohlala ekhaya, uzobuye ubizwe. Uphinde wabizwa namuhla, nesingazi ke ukuthi inkulumo iphethe kanjani njengoba uyise kamufi esaye khona," usho kanje.Uthe abakaze baxhumane nalo mndeni ongcwabe isihlobo sabo, kabawazi."Isihlukumezile le nto. Izingane zikamufi esezikhulakhulile azikwazi ukumelana nesimo. Zivele zidinde esikaNandi, zicabanga eyokuthi unina akabange esabuya esibhedlela, ushonile kodwa futhi manje isidumbu sakhe sesivele salahleka," kubalisa uNkk Bhengu.Uveze ukuthi umufi wayengeniswe esibhedlela ngo-Agasti nonyaka, exinwe isifo samathambo.Kushaye isikhathi sokushicilela uMnyango wezeMpilo ungakaphefumuli ngalolu daba.
Umbuzo.SAWUBONA sisi MaGumede. nginenkinga sisi wami. Ngiyibhungu nginomama wengane yize singasathandani kodwa siyaxhumana ngenxa yomntwana futhi ngiyamondla ngoba kuyenzeka ngibambe amatoho abhedayo abuye aphele.Inkinga enginayo manje wukuthi umama wengane useyanqaba ukuthi ingane ivakashele ekhaya uthi kubo sebeyanqaba bathi angiqale ngizokhokha ngihlawule yikhona ingane izovakasha kahle.Uthi uyise uthi ayikho ingane ezomela ukuvakasha ngingakhokhile. Inkinga njengoba sengishilo angisebenzi into esile kanti nasekhaya akekho ongangisiza ukuthi ngiyikhokhele. Ngiyafisa nami ukuyohlawula kubo kodwa ngiphoqwa yisimo.Ngiyayithanda ingane yami futhi naye uyakwazi lokho nengicabanga ukuthi yingakho esengincikisela ngoba uyabona ukuthi ngiyithanda kanjani. Ngicela ungisize ungibonise MaGumede ngenzenjani kule simo engibhekene naso?Impendulo. Sawubona bhuti wami, ngixakwa wukuthi ngoba ingane yakho uyayondla nje uma uthole amatoho yini pho edala ukuthi umama wengane angabe esavuma nengane ngoba phela awuyiphikanga futhi awushongo ukuthi ngeke uyihlawule wukuthi nje yiwona amandla ongakabi nawo.Ngiyazi ukuthi kunzima bhuti wami ukunqatshelwa ukubona ingane yakho ekubeni uyithanda. Ngicela uke uzame ukukhuluma nomama wengane yakho ubonisane naye umtshele akuncengele abantu bakubo okungenani ingane ivakashe noma yikanye-ke nje ukuze nawe ujabule.Lokho kuzokwenza ukuthi ungaphelelwa nawuthando lokuyondla. Ngicela nawe uzame ukuqongelela ubeke isenti phezu kwelinye ucele nabakini bakulekelele upatanise uyokhipha noma okuncane kubo kamama wengane yikhona bezobona ukuthi uzimisele kangakanani ngokuba ubaba oqotho enganeni yakho.
LIKHULU isasasa esizweni saMabomvu eMsinga ngemayini yamalahle ehlongozwa endaweni.Inkosi Musawenkosi Ngubane ithe uma iphumelela imayini ehlongozwa kuzodaleka inqwaba yamathuba emisebenzi.Inkosi ithe sekulindwe izikhulu zoMnyango wezokuMbiwayo ukuba zizohlola indawo. INkosi ithe indawo ehlongozwayo isentabeni esesigodini kwaMbhono."Amalahle akhona abonakala ngamehlo ngoba asendaweni ephezulu. Sengixhumanile nezikhulu zoMnyango wezokuMbiwayo. Nginethemba lokuthi izophumelela imayini."Inkosi ithe kade yaqala ukukhulunywa indaba yemayini kodwa yabuye yaphelela endleleni ngenxa yombango wobukhosi obukhungethe aMabomvu.Umbango wesihlalo udonse iminyaka emihlanu, Inkosi uMusawenkosi ize yangena esihlalweni ngoMeyi emva kokuxazululeka kombango wesihlalo."Indaba yaqala ukukhulunywa ngesikhathi ingakakhothami inkosi endala kodwa kwabuye kwangalandeleleka. Manje-ke sengiyayivuselela leyo mizamo yokuba kube nemayini."Inkosi ithe ukuphumelela kwemayini kungenza kusize ekwehliseni isibalo sabantu baseMsinga abashonela emadolobheni amakhulu afana neGoli.Ithe uma imayini isisebenza sizokwehla isibalo sabantu abazokuya kofuna imisebenzi emadolobheni amakhulu, nokunganciphisa isibalo sabashonela emadolobheni."Isifiso sami esikhulu ukuthi kunciphe isibalo sabantu abaya kofuna amatoho koGoli. Njengamanje sinenkinga yokuthi kunenqwaba yabantu baseMsinga abashonela eGoli. Abantu bafike eGoli benze izinto ezingalungile. Konke lokhu basuke bekwenziswa yindlala. Uma sekunemayini abantu abaningi bazobuya emadolobheni. Imayini izokwazi ukuqasha inqwaba yabantu. Nami ngike ngasebenza ezimayini ngaphambi kokuthi ngingene esihlalweni sobaba mkhulu. Kuyongijabulisa kakhulu ukwakhiwa kwemayini njengoba koqopha umlando omusha."Inkosi iphethe izigodi ezingu-17, ithe ifisa ukubona isizwe sayo sithuthuka.Ithe ifisa ukuthi kwakhiwe inxanxathela yezitolo endaweni."Ngike ngakhuluma nabaphathi benkampani eyakha iLiberty Mall (inxanxathela yezitolo eseMgungundlovu), bathe impendulo bazoyibuyisa ngoJuni. Abantu bathwele kanzima njengoba uma befuna ukuyothenga kufanele baye endaweni okuthiwa kusoThukela lapho bethola khona izitolo."Inkosi ithe ifuna nokuthi abantu baseMabomvini baqinise kakhulu ekulimeni."Ngike ngakhuluma noMphathiswa wezoLimo (uNkk Thembeni kaMadlopha-Mthethwa), wathembisa ukuthi uzoselekelela ngoba sinawo amasimu maningi. Ngifuna ukuthi kube luhlaza kuwo wonke amasimu ngoba sinawo."
SEKUSEZANDLENI zikaMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ukusayina uMthethosivivinywa i-Immigration Amendment Bill, ethinta abakokufika kuleli ngokungemthetho ezibakhalele, abalinde ukubuyiselwa emazweni abo.Ngokwalo Mthethosivivinywa, laba kumele bavele enkantolo engakapheli amahora angu-48 zibakhalele.UMkhandlu weNdlu yeziFundazwe ePhalamende uphasise lo Mthethosivivinywa, kanti uzodluliselwa kuRamaphosa ukuze awusayine ube ngumthetho.Okhulumela iPhalamende, uMnuz Moloto Mothapo, uthe lo Mthethosivivinywa uphasiswe ngesikhathi somhlangano wokugcina wonyaka woMkhandlu weziFundazwe. Uthe usayinwe ukuze uhambisane nomyalelo weNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo yango-2017, eyathi iPhalamende kumele libuyekeze umthetho i-Immigration Act ngenxa yokuthi kunezinye zezigaba eziphambana noMthethosisekelo wezwe.Le nkantolo yathi abasuke belinde ukubuyiselwa emazweni abo, abafundelwa amalungelo abo ikakhulu ilungelo lokuba nommeli othandwa yibona noma banikwe ummeli nguhulumeni."Lo Mthethosivivinywa uyalela ababhekele ukubuyisela emuva abakuleli ngokungemthetho, izinto okumele bazenze kanjalo nezinto izinkantolo ekumele izibheke uma ikhipha isinqumo. Ugqamisa amalungelo alowo osuke ezokubuyiselwa ezweni lakhe," kusho uMothapo. Uthe ikomiti elibhekele ezokuPhepha nezobuLungiswa eMkhandlwini weziFundazwe, libe nezigcawu zomphakathi ngo-Okthoba nonyaka. Amalungu alo mkhandlu angu-60, avote ukweseka lo Mthethosisekelo, amahlanu awuchitha.Inkosi Mwelo Nonkonyana we-ANC ithe wonke umuntu ongena nophumayo kuleli kumele abe nezincwadi eziqondile.Ilungu le-DA, uMnuz Mzamo Billy, liwushayele izandla lo Mthethosisekelo lathi uqinisa umthetho wokuhambela kuleli.Ilungu le-IFP, uMnuz Les Govender, lithe lo Mthethosivivinywa uzonika umkhombandlela kwabezomthetho ngezinto ezithinta abangena kuleli ngokungemthetho. Lithe izophela nendaba yokuthi balinde isikhathi eside bengabuyiselwa emazweni abo."Akulungile ukuthi abakuleli ngokungemthetho ababoshiwe ukuthi balinde umnyama ongenafu ngokuthi bahanjiswa nini emazweni abo, okudala izinkinga zomthetho nasemajele."Kunezinhlangano ezingayizwa indaba yabantu bakwamanye amazwe abakuleli ngokungemthetho. NoNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, unomkhankaso wokuphuma engena ezindaweni ezehlukene ebheka abaqashwe kulezi zindawo abangokufika abangenawo amaphepha aqondile. Lo mkhankaso uwubiza ngokuthi "engangeni ngesango iyafohla", kanti abatholwa kulezi zindawo bengenawo amaphepha aqondile, ziyabakhalela.Izinhlangano ezifana ne-Operation Dudula neMarch and March zichitha abokufika abangenawo amaphepha okuba kuleli. Zivimba ezikhungweni zezempilo lapho zisuke zala ukhasha zifune baveze ukuthi bakuleli ngokusemthethweni noma bangalutholi usizo lwezempilo.
KUZOCACISA ingqungquthela eyisipesheli yenyunyana yothisha iSadtu ukuthi izoqhubeka nokweseka i-ANC okhethweni lwangonyaka ozayo lohulumeni basekhaya noma isizohamba namaKhomanisi, azongenela ukhetho ngokuzimela.Lezi ngezinye zezinto ezibhungwe emhlanganweni wokugcina wonyaka, wesigungu esiphezulu sale nyunyana muva nje.Isitatimende esikhishwe yile nyunyana, siveze ukuthi ixoxiwe eyesinqumo seSACP sokuzimela okhethweni, ingaseki i-ANC. Sithe lesi sinyathelo sizoba nomthelela kumadlelandawonye ahlanganisa i-ANC, SACP, Cosatu neSanco."Simile ekutheni sizobiza ingqungquthela eyisipesheli ngo-2026, ngaphambi kokuba kube nengqungquthela yeCosatu, ukuze siphume nomkhombandlela ngesizomeseka okhethweni. Sasivele sishilo ukuthi uma kwenzeka i-SACP ithi izongenela ukhetho, sizobiza le ngqungquthela eyisipesheli."Sithe okwamanje le nyunyana yeseka i-ANC okhethweni, okuyisinqumo esathathwa ezingqungqutheleni zale nyunyana. I-Sadtu ithe ubumbano lwamadlelandawonye lubaluleke kakhulu kanti kumele luqiniswe."Siyahambisana nombono wokuthi kubizwe umhlangano wawo wonke amadlelandawonye ukuze kubhungwe ngokubhekana ngeziqu zamehlo kwe-ANC ne-SACP. Siyahambisana nombono we-ANC wokuthi kumele buqiniswe ubudlelwano bamadlelandawonye." Idale uqhekeko eyokuzimela kweSACP okhethweni njengoba kunokushayisana phakathi kwalezi zinhlangano ngalesi sinqumo. I-SACP imile ekutheni ihlabela phambili nalesi sinqumo sokuzimela ngoba sathathwa engqungqutheleni yale nhlangano. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, i-ANC isanethemba lokuthi mhlawumbe izinto zingahle zishintshe, buqhubeke ubudlelwano bokusebenzisana phakathi kwalezi zinhlangano.I-ANC ike yakuveza ukuthi lesi sinyathelo samaKhomanisi sizoba nomthelela ongemuhle okhethweni njengoba uKhongolose ebhekene nezinselelo zokwehlelwa ukwesekwa kuleli.UNobhala Jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, uveze ukuthi sebebeke ithemba labo ophikweni lwentsha lale nhlangano ukuthi buzosebenza ngamandla kubuye ukwesekwa kwe-ANC njengoba kubhekwe okhethweni. UMbalula uyalele i-ANCYL ukuthi ihambele ezindaweni lapho kugcwele khona abantu abasha ukuze yesekwe.ISadtu engenye yezinyunyana ezinkulu ngaphansi kweCosatu, ibhekene nengwadla yokuthi ikhethe phakathi kwe-SACP ne-ANC, njengoba abanye abaholi bale nyunyana baphinde babe ngabaholi kwi-SACP. Abanye abaholi beSadtu bajutshwe ezikhundleni eziphezulu yi-ANC.UNobhala Jikelele weSadtu, uDkt Mugwena Maluleke, ujutshwe nguNgqongqoshe weMfundo ePhakeme, uMnuz Buti Manamela, oke wahola uphiko lwentsha lweSACP, ukuba yibamba likasihlalo esikhwameni esixhasa ngemali yokufunda ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme, iNational Students' Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS).
YIZE umlingisi uRonnie Nyakale edlale emidlalweni yethelevishini nasemafilimini amaningi kodwa uthi iGenerations: The Legacy iyohlale isenhliziyweni yakhe. URonnie ulingise kwiYizo Yizo 1, Blood Diamond, Machine Gun Preacher nakwiGangster's Paradise: Jerusalema.Ekhuluma kwi-Radio 702, uRonnie uthe iGenerations: The Legacy iklame enkulu indima empilweni yakhe. Uthe uke waphila impilo emnandi, ekhomba ngophakathi ngenxa yokulingisa indawo kaCosmo Diale kulo mdlalo okhonjiswa kwiSABC 1 phakathi nezinsuku ngo-8 ebusuku.URonnie (52) uthe abadidiyeli beGenerations: The Legacy bamtakula kakhulu ngesikhathi elahlekelwe yindodakazi yakhe, uKagiso. Uthe uKagiso wazibulala eseneminyaka ewu-18 emuva kokuqeda ukubhala izivivinyo zikamatikuletsheni."NgoJanuwari sekumenyezelwa imiphumela, ngathola ukuthi wayephumelele izifundo zakhe ngamalengiso."Uthe abeGenerations: The Legacy babamba elikhulu iqhaza ekungcwabeni indodakazi yakhe ngesizotha. "Ukubizwa kwiGenerations nokusebenza kwaBolt kwangisiza ngoba ngangithola ithuba lokuxoxa nabantu. Ukukhuluma nabantu kwangilapha. Ukube yayingekho iGenerations angazi ngangiyoba yini. Ngisho ngoba bengithi uma ngingenzi lutho, bengingangadli futhi ngingagezi ngenxa yokuzilela umntwana wami."Uthe uyazisola ngokuzibulala komntwana wakhe ngoba uzibuza ukuthi wayekuphi ngesikhathi indodakazi ithatha lesi sinqumo."Ngifana nomuntu owahluleka ukusiza ingane yami ngesikhathi ingidinga."URonnie uchaze uKagiso njengengane eyayingakaze yahlupha futhi nasesikoleni wayengakaze wabikelwa okubi ngayo."Abantu abazi ukuthi kungani iGenerations isenhliziyweni yami. Yingoba ingilwele izimpi zami. Nokushona kwendodakazi yami ngenye yalezo zimpi. Yangingcwabela umntwana wami. Yingakho ngizohlale ngiyikweleta."Okunye athe bekungaziwa ngabantu ukuthi unenkinga yokuzwa emadlebeni kangangoba ubelokhu ecele ukuphindelwa imibuzo. Echaza uthe eseyingane wawa esihlahleni ngesikhathi babentshontsha izithelo i-apricot.Eqhuba, uthe ubengenandaba nale nkinga kwaze kwaba abadidiyeli beGenerations: The Legacy bayayiqaphela futhi bamyisa kudokotela. Uthe yinkinga lena athule nayo kwaze kwaba yimanje. URonnie uthe le nkinga yenza nabantu bamhlebe ngisho ebabona ngoba basuke bazi ukuthi unayo."Anginankinga nalokho ngoba uNkulunkulu usuke engafuni ngizwe into esuke izongiphatha kabi. Kwesinye isikhathi leyo nto ingenza ngigcine sengiduka lapho ngiqonde khona empilweni."
USOLWA ngokubalekisa ofakazi bengakazibhalisi izitatimende unina womfana okuthiwa udlwengule ingane yentombazane eGroutville, KwaDukuza, ngoMgqibelo.Kulesi sigameko kuthiwa umsolwa (17) ongumakhelwane udlwengule umgilwa (8) engaqali, maqede wafuna imali yokugibela kunina isigubhukane, wabaleka, waya kubo kayise eMtubatuba. Ngokusho kwesihlobo sikamgilwa esingeke sidalulwe ukumvikela, umndeni uthole ngesigameko ntambama ngosuku esenzeke ngalo. "Izingane zakubo kamsolwa nazo ezisencane zisitshele ukuthi umsolwa udlwengule umgilwa maqede waziwashisa izingubo ezazinobufakazi bokuthi kade emnyukubeza,” kusho isihlobo.Sithe bezwa lokho, baphuthume bayokwazisa unina kamgilwa, ovele wamphikela, ethi "uyenze kanjani loyo nto ebe engekho"."Izingane zimtshelile ukuthi ukwenze engakahambi, nokuyilapho aveze khona ukuthi kanti ubemshusha ngemali yokugibela aye kubo yingoba ubebalekela umonakalo asewenzile,” kusho isihlobo. Siveze ukuthi bahambe bonke baya eMtubatuba ukuyomlanda, bamnikela emaphoyiseni.Nokho ukhale ngokuthi athe ngeke aboshwe kodwa uzodedelwa ngaphansi kwesandla sikanina, ngoba useyingane, akayazi into abeyenza. Uthe bagcine betshelwa ukuthi ugcine ekhaya lezingane ngoba ngeke ayiswe ejele lezingane."Aseneme thina ngalokhu ngoba kukhombisa ukuthi kubhekelelwa yena kakhulu engumsolwa esikhundleni sokuthi kucatshangelwe umgilwa,” kusho isihlobo. Isihlobo siveze ukuthi kubo kamsolwa sekukhala ibhungezi. "Abekho bonke nezingane okuyizo ezasibikela ngesigameko. Akusiphathi kahle lokhu ngoba kusho ukuthi unina kamsolwa usezibalekisile ekubeni sigcine zingakathathwa izitatimende zazo emaphoyiseni,” kusho isihlobo.Sithe bezwe ngandlebenye ukuthi lona wesifazane utshele amaphoyisa ukuthi bazizwa bengaphephile ngoba umphakathi kade usuzungeze umuzi wakhe ufuna ukuwungqongqisa ngomlilo. "Akulona iqiniso leli ngoba udaba selokhu lwenzekile asikaze sixoxele muntu ngalo. Abantu abalwaziyo yimindeni yomibili,” usho kanje.Udalule ukuthi lona wesifazane uke wahlongoza eyokubakhokhela, ukuze udaba luphelele phakathi kwemindeni, lungayi emaphoyiseni. Uphinde wadalula ukuthi nasezinganeni zakubo kamsolwa bayasola ukuthi useke wazinyukubeza nazo ngoba bezithi uma zibuzwa, zivele zihlengezele izinyembezi. Uthe umgilwa ubatsele ukuthi ubengaqali umsolwa ukukwenza lokhu. Uveze nokuthi umndeni wakubo kamsolwa uneminyaka emibili ufikile endaweni, wathi bathole ukuthi lapho obuvela khona wahanjiswa indaba yakhe umsolwa enukubeza izingane endaweni. "Sifuna ubulungiswa, ajezele amacala akhe. Ukudlwengula kwakhe, maqede abaleke aye kubo kayise kukhombisa ukuthi ubeyazi kahle into ayenzile ukuthi iyicala,” kusho isihlobo.Kuthiwa isigameko senzeke ekamelweni lomsolwa elisendlini enkulu, unina engekho esemsebenzini. Ubesele nezingane ezineminyaka ephakathi kwemihlanu kuya kwengu-10. Kuthiwa umgilwa ujwayele ukuvakasha kulo muzi njengoba kukhona kuwo ontanga yakhe. Ngokombiko wasesibhedlela, kuvela ukuthi umsolwa umdlwengule ngaphambili nangemumva umgilwa. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uCaptain Ntathu Ndlovu, uthe ngoDisemba 14, 2025 owesifazane ulethe indodana (17) yakhe emaphoyiseni aKwaDukuza, yabekwa icala lokudlwengula intombazane (8)."Lokhu kuze emva kokuthi omakhelwane bembikele ukuthi umsolwa uhlale ebonakala nomgilwa osemncane. Umgilwa uyiswe esibhedlela lapho okufike kwaqinisekiswa khona ukuthi unukubeziwe,” kusho uNdlovu.Uthe umsolwa uvelile eNkantolo yeMantshi yaKwaDukuza ngoDisemba 15, 2025, wabuye wabuyiselwa esitokisini. "Icala lihlehlisiwe ukuze kuqhutshekwe nophenyo,” kusho uNdlovu.
Ngemuva nje kuka-07:30 ebusuku ngoLwesine bezimo eziphuthumayo bakwa-ALS babizelwe kuShepstone Road eduze noHendred Road eNew Germany, ePinetown eNtshonalanga yeTheku ngemibiko yokugetshengwa kwemoto yemali. Bafike endaweni yesehlo balinda i-SAPS ukuthi ivikele indawo ngaphambi kokusebenza.Imibiko yokuqala iveza ukuthi iqulu lamadoda elihlasele imoto yemali livulele ngenhlamvu libhekise kuyo kwalimala nabanye abantu ebebedlula ngezimoto zabo. Abezimo eziphuthumayo bathole ukuthi kulimale abantu abayisithupha, owesilisa oyedwa okukholakala ukuthi ungumgibeli emotweni ebidlula ubenamanxeba amabili okudutshulwa esiswini futhi usesimweni esibucayi.
