KUSOLWA ukungaziphathi kahle kowesifazane okuthiwa ugwaze isoka lakhe lafa eCato Crest, eMayville, ngoLwesihlanu.Kulesi sigameko kubulawe ngesihluku uMnuz Thalente Ngcobo (36), okuthiwa ugwazwe ngesikele yisinqamdamathe (29) sakhe esingeke sidalulwe njengoba singakaveli phambi kwenkantolo.Udadewabo kamufi, uNksz Ntombenhle Ngcobo, elandisa ngesigameko uthe ngosuku lwesehlo umfowabo unikele emqashweni kamsolwa, bafike bahilizisana. Uthe umufi wayenengwa ukuthi kwase kusebusuku kodwa umsolwa esahleli nabangani bakhe, kuphuzwa, bengazi nanyaka."Umsolwa kuthiwa wayephuza, eqaqa omunye umngani wakhe ikhanda ngesikele,” kusho uNksz Ngcobo.Uthe akwaziwa ukuthi yini eyabangwa kodwa umsolwa wabonakala ehlala izithonto kumufi, emklinya. "Okwalandela lapho kuthiwa kube ukumgwaza ephindelela, ngisho esebaleka, waqhubeka wamgwaza ngisho emhlane,” usho kanje.Uthe bewumndeni ubuye ubafikele umcabango wokuthi mhlawumbe umsolwa akakwenzanga yedwa lokho."Siyafisa ukuthi asitshele iqiniso lokuthi yini le engaka eyayingasalungiseki kangangoba waze wabona kugcono ukuthi ambulale,” kusho uNksz Ngcobo. Uthe bathole ngesigameko ngomshayeli wemoto ekhokhelwa ngebanga elihambile ongumakhelwane wabo."Esegwaziwe, bafaka isicelo emotweni ekhokhelwa ngebanga elihambile kanti kuzovele kuze imoto kamakhelwane wethu. Wabaphuthumisa esibhedlela eKing Edward (Victoria Mxenge) nokuyilapho okwafike kwathiwa useshonile,” kusho uNksz Ngcobo.Uthe lona wesilisa wabazisa ukuthi abahambe bayobheka ngoba kade ebiziwe ukuthi ahambise umuntu esibhedlela, wathola ukuthi umakhelwane wakhe. Uveze ukuthi bathe uma bebheka izingxoxo zikamufi nomsolwa, bathola ukuthi bebehlale bexabana, kukhona ukungathembani.Uphinde waveza ukuthi batshelwe omunye umngani kamufi ukuthi wake wambamba umsolwa ukuthi unelinye isoka. "Uthe emva kwalo lokho kwaba khona ukungathembani, waqala lapho umfowethu ukuphila ngokumgada umsolwa,” kusho uNksz Ngcobo. Uthe ngokwamanye amalungu omndeni, ubudlelwano balezi zithandani bebunezinyanga ezibalelwa kweziyisithupha bukhona, kanti ubeke avakashe ekhaya kubo.Uthe nokho bebengakaze bakubone ngamehlo ukuxabana kwabo.Uveze ukuthi umufi unezingane ezisencane eziphakathi konyaka owodwa nengu-14. Uthe wathola ukuthi umsolwa ungowokuzalwa eBergville. Uthe bafisa ukuthola ubulungiswa, umsolwa ake agonyuluke ngokuthi yini eholele ekutheni enze isenzo esibi kangaka. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uColonel Robert Netshiunda uthe amaphoyisa aseCato Manor asebophe owesifazane oneminyaka engu-28 ngecala lokugwaza isoka (36) lakhe laze lafa esigamekweni esenzeke emgwaqweni uCoronia, eCato Crest, ngoLwesihlanu. "Imibiko ithi laba ababili babe nengxabano yezithandani ephethe ngokuthi owesifazane agwaze owesilisa ephindelela esebenzisa isikele,” kusho uNetshiunda, othe umsolwa kulindeleke ukuthi avele enkantolo maduzane.
KUKHALWA ngendlala ebulala iziboshwa ezisahamba amacala ejele laseWestville, eThekwini. Ngokuthola kweSolezwe ngomthombo, lesi simo siqale emasontweni ambalwa edlule kanti kuze kube yimanje asikaxazululeki.Ngokomthombo, iziboshwa ezisahamba amacala ezigqunywe kuleli jele, zidla kanye ngosuku, uma kwenzekile zadla kabili, zidla sekudlule isikhathi. "NgeSonto kwashaya ihora lokuqala emini zingakaze zikuthi mbibi ukudla,” kusho umthombo.Uqhube wathi lezi ziboshwa zithe uma zibuza ukuthi kungani zingadlile kuze kushaye lesi sikhathi, ojele bazitshela ukuthi kufe umshini wokupheka izinkwa."Okuxakayo ukuthi zithole ngozakwabo asebegwetshiwe ukuthi lokho akulona iqiniso ngoba bona badle ngesikhathi esejwayelekile,” kusho umthombo. Uthe bathole ukuthi lezi ziboshwa kuke kwenzeka zathola impendulo kojele ethi azikakabi umthwalo woMnyango wezoBulungiswa ngokugcwele njengoba zisahamba amacala."Zithi ojele bathi indaba yazo yokungabi bikho kokudla ilukhuni ngoba zingabantu abanyawo lwabo olulodwa lungaphakathi, ngesikhathi olunye lungaphandle, njengoba amacala azo esaqulwa,” kusho umthombo.Uthe ziveze ukuthi kokunye zibuye zindle ngabo-7 ebusuku. Uqhuba, uthe okubuhlungu ukuthi labo abanemindeni ehlala kude, efika kanye emva kwesikhathi eside, bashayeka kakhulu."Ngoba ukudla okungena ngaphakathi kukaliwe. Imindeni ifika nokudla okuningi ngethemba lokuthi kuzongena konke ukuze kubaqhube isikhashana, ojele babaphindisele nakho emumva, bethi kuningi. Manje umbuzo uthi bazoyithathaphi imali yokuthi balokhu begqigqa ejele zonke zinsuku ukuze izihlobo zabo zingabulawa yindlala,” kusho umthombo, onxuse iziphathimandla ukuba zilusukumele lolu daba.Okhulumela lo mnyango KwaZulu-Natal uMnuz Thulani Mdluli uthunyelelwe imibuzo, wangaphendula.
KUVELA ukuthi ayikho imvume ebikhishwe yiziphathimandla ukuthi kuqhubeke ukwakhiwa kwesakhiwo sesonto esidilike eRedcliff, eVerulam, ngeledlule, kwafa abahlanu.Lokhu kuvezwe nguNgqongqoshe wezemiSebenzi yoMphakathi neNgqalasizinda, uMnuz Dean Mcpherson, esithangamini sabezindaba eMayfair, eThekwini.UMcpherson ubekhashwe nguMphathiswa woMnyango wezemiSebenzi yoMphakathi neNgqalasizinda, uMnuz Martin Meyer, iMeya yeTheku uMnuz Cyril Xaba nezinye izikhulu zikahulumeni. Kulesi sithangami bebezokwethula umbiko wesikhashana ngodaba lokudilika kwalesi sakhiwo. UMcpherson uthe kuyabakhathaza ukuthi ezinhlakeni ezithintekayo uma kukhona isakhiwo esizokwakhiwa, akuveli lutho olukhombisa ukuthi lesi esidilikile, sasiphasisiwe ukuba sakhiwe. "Akuveli sicelo samapulani okwakha esasifakiwe futhi akuveli mvume yokwakha eyakhishwa. Njengoba lolu lwazi lungaveli, kusho ukuthi izinhlaka ezithintekayo zancishwa ithuba lokuthi ziyihlole le ndawo obekwakhiwe kuyo, ziyiqaphe ziphinde zingenelele ngesikhathi kuqhubeka ukwakha,” kusho uMcpherson. Kuvele ukuthi umsebenzi wokwakha leli thempeli ebelinezitezi ezine waqala ngoMashi nonyaka. Uphinde wathi uphenyo lwesikhashana luveze ukuthi ukhonkolo osetshenzisiwe kwakhiwa isakhiwo ushiya imibuzo njengoba kuthe selidilikile, kwaba nenqwaba yemvuthu (impuqumpuqu).Ugcizelele ukuthi kuzofanele kuphenywe ukuthi wathengwaphi nokuthi labo abawudayisayo bawenza ngani? Uthe izinhlaka ezehlukene eziphenya ngalolu daba, ezifaka phakathi iCouncil for the Built Environment (CBE), zenze izincomo ezimbalwa ezibalulekile."Kuzona kukhona esokuthi kutholwe ngazo zonke izakhiwo ezakhiwa ngokungemthetho komasipala abehlukene ezweni lonke. Ukuphoqa zonke izindawo ezidayisa ukhonkolo osulungele ukusebenza ukuthi zibikele izinhlaka ezibhekelela ezokwakha uma kukhona abawuthenga ngesibalo esikhulu, kwenzele ukuthi kwazeke ngomsebenzi wokwakha osuke uqhubeka,” usho kanje.Uphinde wathi bazongena embhidlangweni kazwelonke emiphakathini, bafundise abantu ngokubaluleka kokuqale bathole izimvume zokwakha ngaphambi kokuqala komsebenzi ukuqinisekiisa ezokuphepha. Uthe udaba lwale nhlekelele ulubikile kuMengameli wezwe, uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa, ozwakalise okukhulu ukukhathazeka ngesigameko, ezwelana nabagilwa kanjalo nemindeni yabo. Uthe naye uthunyelelwe umbiko wesikhashana, wezwakalisa ukuthi uyakweseka konke osekwenziwe ukusuka ngesikhathi kwenzeka isigameko kuze kuba manje. Ube eseveza ukuthi ubhalele uNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa kuzwelonke, uSolwazi Firoz Cachalia, ecela ukuba angenelele ngokuthi ahlanganise ithimba lamaphoyisa avela ezifundazweni ezehlukene ukuba aphenye lolu daba.Uthe ucele uCachalia ukuba afake phakathi ithimba lamaphoyisa ayephenya ngokudilika kwesakhiwo saseGeorge, eWestern Cape, ngoJulayi nyakenye, lapho okwafa khona abantu abangu-34, kwalimala abangu-28. Uthe uyakholelwa ukuthi leli thimba linamava angaba wusizo ophenyweni lokudilika kwethembepi. Kwabashonile, abane bangcwatshwe ngoLwesibili, ngesikhathi oyedwa ungakaqhamuki umndeni wakhe ukuzothatha isidumbu.

LIZOQHUBEKA "isiko" lokushicilelwa kwemiphumela ka-matric emaphepheni ngonyaka ozayo emuva kokuba iNkantolo eNkulu ePitoli, ichithe isicelo ebesifakwe yi-Information Regulator, ebifuna ingashicilelwa.Ayiqali ukuthi ikhale ngaphansi i-Information Regulator ekutheni ifuna inkantolo imise ukushicilelwa kwale miphumela ikhala ngokuthi kumele ivikelwe imiphumela yabafundi ngoba ukukhishwa kwayo akuhambisani nomthetho i-Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA).Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo eyisiSekelo, uMnuz Terence Khala, uthe bayasamukela isinqumo senkantolo enkulu, sokuthi baqhubeke nokushicilela le miphumela emaphepheni. Uthe sekufana nesiko ukushicilela le miphumela emaphepheni ngakho lesi sinqumo sivale isahluko."Isinqumo senkantolo sicacisa ungabazane obelukhona kubafundi nakubazali mayelana nokushicilelwa kwemiphumela emaphepheni. Inkantolo ikuchithile ukuthi kukhona okungahambisani nomthetho ukushicilelwa kwemiphumela," usho kanje.Uthe lokhu kukhishwa kwemiphumela ngale ndlela kwenza abafundi bakwazi ukuyithola ngosuku olulodwa."Sizimisele ukuqhubeka sisebenzisane ne-Information Regulator ukubeka phambili amalungelo abafundi silandele nomthetho. Lolu hlaka luneqhaza elibalulekile ekuvikeleni ulwazi lwabantu kuleli," kusho uKhala. Umnyango waveza ukuthi ezinye zezizathu owenza uqhubeka nokushicilela imiphumela emaphepheni ngukuthi abanye abafundi basuke bengekho ezifundazweni ababhalele kuzona, okungenza bangakwazi ukuthola imiphumela yabo ngesikhathi. Waveza ukuthi abanye basuke besemaholidini ngakho ukudedela imiphumela emaphephabeni kwenza bakwazi ukuthola kanye kanye imiphumela uma isikhishwa.Kukhona ababeshaya amakhala, bethi imiphumela kumele bayilande ezikoleni ngoba kwamanye amabanga bayilanda ezikoleni. Kodwa umnyango waveza ukuthi awusakhiphi lonke ulwazi lomfundi njengegama nesibongo sakhe kodwa ukhipha inombolo abhala ngayo izivivinyo.Phambilini, kwakukhishwa imininingwane yomfundi kanjalo nesikole abefunda kusona. Kodwa manje sekukhishwa igama lesikole nenombolo yokubhala. Kwabuye kwaba nokukhala ngokuthi noma imininingwane ingasakhishwa kodwa ngenxa yokuthi abanye abafundi osuke ufunda nabo bayayazi inombolo yokubhala yomunye umfundi uma zilandelana, kuba lula ukubona ophasile nongaphasanga ephepheni.Imiphumela ka-matric izomenyezelwa nguNgqongqoshe weMfundo eyisiSekelo uNksz Siviwe Gwarube ngoJanuwari 12, 2026, bese ikhishwa emaphepheni ngakusasa kanti abafundi bazokwazi ukuyilanda ezikoleni.
UMENGAMELI Cyril Ramaphosa usekhwele wadilika kwabapenda kabi izwe, abakhuluma ngezinto ezimbi abathi ziyenzeka ekubeni besenga ezimithiyo.Uthe abenza lokhu bafuna izwe libukeke kabi futhi abafuni ukuthi lithuthuke."Kunabasemkhankasweni wokudicilela phansi izwe, abakhuluma izinto ezingekho ngezwe lethu. Baqamba amanga ngezinto eziningi ngoba abafuni izwe liye phambili. Bathi kuleli kubulawa abalimi abamhlophe, kudliwa umhlaba wabo ngejozi ekubeni behubhuza amanga. Kumele siqhubeke sibumbane simnyama noma simhlophe ngoba lezi zinto abazishoyo azikho," usho kanje. Ukusho lokhu izolo ethula inkulumo yosuku ngesikhathi kugujwa uSuku lokuBuyisana eNcome Museum eNquthu, KwaZulu-Natal. UMengameli waseMelika, uMnuz Donald Trump, ungomunye wabaholi abathi kwenzeka izinto ezimbi kuleli njengoba kubulawa abalimi kuthathwe nomhlaba wabo. Kwahlula ngisho uRamaphosa esehambe nethimba lakhe baya eMelika eyozama ukuyochazela uTrump ukuthi lezi zinto ezikhulunywa ngelakuleli azikho kodwa kwanhlanga zimuka nomoya. URamaphosa uthe abakhuluma izinto ezimbi basuke befuna abantu bavukelane, baphemba impi nokwehlukana."Abakhuluma amanga ngezwe abasho lutho ngezingane zabamhlophe ezikhuluma isiZulu phaqa. Abasho lutho futhi ngezingane zamaBhunu ezidansela umculo wama-piano odume umhlaba wonke. Lezi ngezinye zezinto ezinhle ezenzeka kuleli kodwa abasikhuluma kabi abangazivezi." Unxuse umphakathi ukuthi uqhubeke ubumbane kuliwe nezinselelo ezibhekene nezwe."Zikhona izinselelo izwe elibhekene nazo okuwubugebengu, izinga eliphezulu labangasebenzi, inhlupheko, udlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane nezingane nezinye. Lezi zinto siyazilungisa kanti kudingeka sibambisane." Uthe kumele lezi zinselelo kuxoxwe nangazo uma sekunezinkundla zokubhunga ngesimo sezwe."Lezi zingxoxo ngesimo sezwe kumele sizisebenzise ukubumbana, ukulwa nezinselelo izwe elibhekene nazo. Kumele siphume kulezi zingxoxo sibumbene kunakuqala," kusho uRamaphosa. Uveze nokuthi elakuleli yilona lizwe alaziyo elineculo lesizwe elihlanganisa izilimi eziningi."Angilazi izwe elineculo lesizwe elihlanganisa izilimi ezehlukene. Lokhu kuyizinkomba zokuthi siyizwe elingacwasi, elibumbene."Uthe izingane zezinhlanga ezehlukene zifunda ndawonye ezikoleni zakuleli, azinalo ubandlululo.Unxuse ukuthi lungaphinde luqubuke udlame njengoba kulesi sifundazwe kwakushubile ibambene phakathi kwe-ANC ne-IFP. UNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, unxuse ukuthi kuphele ngezimpi zezigodi esifundazweni."Asibumbane, kuphele ngezimpi zezigodi esifundazweni. Asibumbane sakhe izwe singabantu baseKZN."UNgqongqoshe wezeMidlalo, ubuCiko namaSiko kuleli, uMnuz Gayton McKenzie, uncome uRamaphosa ngeqhaza lakhe ekuhlanganiseni amaqembu ahlukene ayingxenye kahulumeni wokubambisana, iGNU.Uthe bebeyizitha neDA kodwa ngenxa kaRamaphosa, sebebuyisene."URamaphosa akayi ndawo, uzophatha kuze kuphele ihlandla lakhe. Ufana nobaba kithina ngokusibumba kwiGNU. Abantu bahlale bethi ngikhuluma kahle ngoRamaphosa, kufanele ngoba wangenza ungqongqoshe ekubeni babengibiza ngebhantinti."
AKUKACACI ngesigwebo esizonikezwa obengumsakazi woKhozi FM, uSiyabonga "Siya" Mhlongo, emuva kokuba abameli bakhe ngoMsombuluko benxuse iNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini ukuba ibavumele bafake esinye isicelo ngokuthize. Nebala inkantolo isamukele isicelo sabameli bakaSiya, yabe seyinquma ukuba basifake kusasa. Empeleni uSiya kwakufanele agwetshwe ngoNovemba 27 kodwa imantshi, uMnuz Mhlonipheni Sibiya, yakuhlehlisela uMsombuluko esibuya kuwo njengoba nakuwo kubuye kwahlehliswa ngenxa yesicelo sabameli bakammangalelwa.NgoNovemba 5, uSiya (42) walahlwa yicala lokushaya ngenhloso yokulimaza owesilisa owayeyisinqandamathe sakhe, uNjabulo Duma (30). USibiya wathola uSiya enecala lokushaya uNjabulo ezinzulwini zobusuku ngoSepthemba 1, 2024. Lesi sigameko saphoqa abaphathi boKhozi FM ukuba bagcine bemkhombe indlela uSiya ngokuthi bangasivuseleli isivumelwano abebenaso nale nsizwa eyayisakaza uhlelo, Ubusuku Obuhle.Kwenzeka lokhu nje, uSiya uhluleke wancama ukunxenxa inkantolo ukuba ichithe ubufakazi bommangali ngoba "buntekenteke futhi bungesebenziseke enkantolo".Le mizamo kaSiya kwafana nokuthi wayethela amanzi emhlane wedada njengoba inkantolo yaphikisa isicelo ayesifakile.Abameli bakaSiya babekhala ngokuthi kukhona lapho ummangali athi khona akazange ambone uSiya emjikijela ngebhodlela ngoba wayesabheke phansi wezwa ngalo selimshaya. Bathi kuyona le nkantolo waphinde wathi wambona uSiya emjikijela ngebhodlela. Okunye abakhala ngakho abameli bakaSiya wukuthi kungani inkantolo ithembe ubufakazi obethulwa umuntu okwenzeka isigameko ecwile ezinkambeni zikaFaro.Bakhala nangokuthi ummangali wathi waklinywa ekubeni udokotela owamhlola wafika enkantolo wathi zazingekho izimpawu zokuthi ngempela waklinywa. Nakuba kunjalo imantshi yamchitha uSiya.
BANINGI osaziwayo abaphoxekile ngomqhudelwano wezindondo obubanjelwe eGallagher Convention Centre, eGoli, ngoMgqibelo, amaSouth African Music Awards (Samas). Amakhala aqale ukushaywa ngalo usuku lomcimbi lapho iningi labaculi abawinile belingabonwa nangokhalo. Kuke kwaba wumzukuzuku kulindwe uKhuzani ukuba azolanda indondo yeBest Maskandi. Nezindondo ezisemqoka eziwinwe nguMthandeni SK, iBest Record of the Year neBest Music Video of the Year, nezithathwe yimenenja yakhe. UGoldmax wodumo kwiDestruction Boyz, uhlabane ngeBest Album, Best Gqom neBest Male kodwa akazilandelanga lezi zindondo. Kanjalo noKabza De Small,Dlala Thukzin noKevin Momo bebengabonwa nangokhalo. Akugcinanga lapho, ukuwina kukaThandiswa Mazwai indondo yeBest Female Artist kushayise amakhala. Iningi lithe bekufanele inikezwe umculi wamapiano uZee Nxumalo ngenxa yokuthi ushisa izikhotha kulezi zinsuku. Naye uThandiswa uthe bekufanele lendondo ithathwe wuZee Nxumalo ngenxa yamagalelo akhe kulo nyaka. UZakes Bantwini ukhwele wadilika kulo mqhudelwano obusuwenzeka okwesi-31, wathi awusafani nakuqala futhi sewehlelwe yisasasa kangangoba ubengazi nokuthi bewenzeka ngesonto eledlule."Ngiwumculi kodwa bengangingazi lutho ngawo. Akukhona ukuthi ngibudedengu kodwa yilapho sesikhona. AmaSama abesho lukhulu futhi eyiyona yonke into. Manje? Iningi lethu esisendimeni yomculo besingazi ukuthi abenzeka. Sidinga ukukhuluma ngokuthi sifike kanjani lapha."UZakes uthe akufanele ngabe abantu abaqokwe kumaSama baya konandisa kweminye imicimbi ngoba kufanele ngabe asesezingeni lomqhudelwano wezindondo wase-USA, amaGrammy Awards. Uthe abaculi nabalandeli baqala ukuwangabaza amaSama ngesikhathi sekuwina nanoma wubani, ngisho enengoma engaziwa. Ubuye wathi akungagxekwa amajaji nabahleli balo mqhudelwano kuphela kodwa nabaculi abazinuke amakhwapha ngoba akukuhle ukungafiki kwabaculi ekubeni beqokiwe. Abanye osaziwayo abashiye abangalazi ngomdidiyeli wezingoma ohlonishwayo ngokuvumbulula uBerita noKwesta, uNhlamulo "Nota" Baloyi, umculi we-Afro soul u-Enzo kanye nomethuli wezemidlalo kwiSABC 1 u-Andile Ncube. Kubuye kwakhalwa nangabebephethe uhlelo uSiyabonga Ngwekazi noPamela Mtanga. Izinkinga kumaSama aziqali manje, sekunesikhathi zenzeka. Abaculi bakamaskandi uBhekumuzi Luthuli noThokozani Langa bake bahlula kaningi izingwazi zombhaqanga iSoul Brothers kwiBest Mbhaqanga Album ngamacwecwe kamaskandi. Umculi wekwaito uZwai Bala wake wahlabana ngeBest Rap Single ngo-2001 ngomucu wokholo iLifted. Namanje kusakhalwa ngaleyo ndondo. Kuze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela kungakatholakali ukuphawula kwabamaSama.
ASENGCUPHENI yokuvalwa amakolishi amathathu azimele, emuva kokuhluleka ukuhlinzeka uMnyango weMfundo ePhakeme, ngolwazi olumqoka oluthinta nokusebenza kwalezi zikhungo.UNgqongqoshe walo mnyango, uMnuz Buti Manamela, usikaza ukuvala la makolishi amathathu, okuyiDamelin, City Varsity ne-ICESA City Campus. Akuqali ukuthi umnyango usikaze ukuvala la makolishi azimele nanomlando kuleli, njengoba naphambilini ahluleka ukuletha lolu lwazi kwaze kwadingeka ukuthi alulelwe isikhathi sokululetha. Agcine ehlulekile ukululetha phezu kokuba alulelwa isikhathi ngonyaka.Phakathi kolwazi olufunwa ngumnyango kubalwa umbiko wonyaka wokusebenza kwalezi zikhungo, umbiko ngokusebenza kwemali nezitifiketi zentela ezivela kuphiko oluqoqa intela kuleli, iSARS. Okhulumela uManamela, uNksz Matshepo Seedat, uthe lezi zikhungo zihluleke ukuletha ulwazi nakuba zalulelwa isikhathi kusuka ngoJuni 2024.Uthe zaphinde zanikwa omunye umnqamulajuqu wokuthi zilethe ulwazi oludingekayo, owawungoJuni 6, kulo nyaka, nakhona zahluleka ukuhlangabezana nalo mnqamulajuqu."Bese kunesikhathi lezi zikhungo zihluleka ukuletha ulwazi oludingekayo njengezikhungo ezihlinzeka imfundo ephakeme kuleli nangokuyalela komthetho olawula imfundo ephakeme kanjalo nethinta ukubhaliswa kwezikhungo ezizimele. Lesi sinqumo sizothathwa ukuvikela izitshudeni nesithunzi sezemfundo ephakeme." Uthe umnyango unesibophezelo sokuqinisekisa ukuthi izikhungo ezizimele zihlinzeka imfundo esezingeni."Lezi zikhungo zihluleke ngisho ukuletha ulwazi oluthinta ezokuphepha lapho kufundelwa nalapho kusetshenzelwa khona. Umnyango uthole ulwazi lokuthi izikhungo ezimbili, i-City Varsity ne-ICESA City Campus, azisasebenzi, okusho ukuthi azisayihlinzeki imfundo. Sizokhipha isimemezelo sokuthi sihlose ukuzivala emqulwini kahulumeni, i-Government Gazette, silandela umthetho olawula imfundo ephakeme."Uveze ukuthi bazozinika ithuba lezi zikhungo ukuthi zilethe izethulo njengokuyalela komthetho. "Sizoqinisekisa ukuthi izitshudeni ziyavikeleka ngokuthi zihlinzekwe ngemfundo. Azikwazi ukuqhubeka zisebenze izikhungo ezehluleka ukuhambisana nemigomo ebekiwe elawula ezemfundo kuleli ngoba zibeka engcupheni ikusasa lezingane." Uthe izikhungo kumele zisebenze ngendlela esemthethweni. La makolishi asabalele ezweni lonke, anomlando njengoba eneminyaka ehlinzeka imfundo kuleli.
Kushaqeke abantu abaningi kuvela izindaba zokubulawa kukaDJ odumile ngaseCarlton Centre enkabeni yedolobha eGoli. Kubikwa ukuthi uDJ Warras udutshulwe wabulawa ngesikhathi ehamba edolobheni ehlola amabhilidi asetshenzwa onogada bakhe njengoba enomsebenzi wokuqapha amabhilidi ambalwa kuleli dolobha.Imibiko evela endaweni yesehlo uthi umsolwa ubecuthe ekhoneni waqonda kuWarras ngesikhathi ephuma ebhilidini eliqondene neCarlton Centre wamdubula Kanye ngaphambi kokuba adle phansi.U-Warras ubephethe inkampani i-JT VIP: Elite Guarding & VIP Protection Services, esebenza ukuqapha imicimbi esezingeni eliphezulu kanye nokuqapha izakhiwo ezidunwe yizigebengu kanye nezenzo zobugebengu enkabeni yedolobha iGoli.UWarras ogama lakhe langempela uWarrick Stock (40), ungowokuzalwa eThekwini kodwa wakhulela eGoli, usebenze emisakazweni efana 5FM, YFM neGagasi FM, njengamanje wethula uhlelo iNgicel' Ivisa kuMzansi Magic.UWarras ozibiza ngoShady Lurk ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ushiya emhlabeni izingane ezintathu.
NgoMsombuluko, kudutshulwe kwabulawa umsolwa obefunelwa amacala amaningi abucayi nanodlame eMaydon Wharf.Umsolwa ubefunelwa uxhaxha lwamacala okuhlanganisa awokubulala nelokuzama ukubulala enziwa eSawoti ekuqaleni kwale nyanga. Uphinde wamataniswa necala laseMbumbulu lapho kwabulawa ngesihluku abantu abane (4).Ngaphezu kwalokho, umsolwa ubefunelwa nezinsolo zokubandakanyeka ecaleni lokugetshengwa kwemoto yemali elenzeke eMlazi ngoLwesihlanu, mhla ka-5 Kwephezulu. Amaphoyisa athole ngophiko lwezobunhloli ukuthi umsolwa obehlomile ulibangise eThekwini.Itekisi abehamba ngayo umsolwa ibonwe ngamaphoyisa, kodwa ngaphambi kokuthi ayivimbe, itekisi isuke iqonde emaphoyiseni umsolwa edubula. Amaphoyisa aphindisele ngenhlamvu, umsolwa udutshulwe wafa.Kutholwe izibhamu ezimbili (2) endaweni yesigameko. Isibhamu esisodwa sitholwa kumsolwa, kwathi esinye satholwa ngaphakathi etekisini.Icala lokuzama ukubulala amaphoyisa libhaliswe esiteshini samaphoyisa eMaydon Wharf.
Kudutshulwe kwabulawa abasolwa ababili okusolwa ukuthi bayingxenye yemigulukudu yamalambu aluhlaza ngeSonto, kulandela ukudubulana namaphoyisa eParys, eFree State.Kubikwa ukuthi ithimba lezinhlaka ezahlukene zamaphoyisa aseGauteng okuhlanganisa, iTactical Response Team, Traffic Airwing, Detectives Tracking Team, Head Office Counter Intelligence kanye nezinkampani zonogada ezizimele zisebenze imininingwane yezobunhloli ngemoto yohlobo lwe-VW Golf 7 ebandakanyeka ezigebengwini zamalambu aluhlaza. Ithimba lilandele umkhondo wayo imoto yabonakala ihamba emgwaqeni u-R59 ifakwe amalambu aluhlaza. Ngesikhathi amaphoyisa ezama ukuyimisa, imoto isuke ngesivinini kwaholela ekutheni abasolwa badubulane namaphoyisa. Lokhu kuholele ekutheni abasolwa bahluleke ukuyilawula yashayisa uthango endaweni yaseParys.Abasolwa ababili abebegqoke umfaniswano wamaphoyisa batholwe beshonile emotweni. Ithimba liphinde lathola izibhamu ezimbili ezingekho emthethweni ezinezinhlamvu, umfaniswano we-SAPS onezimpawu, amalambu aluhlaza, izinhlabamkhosi kanye nezinombolo zokubhalisa ezingelona iqiniso.Uphenyo lokuqala lukhomba ukuthi, abasolwa bayabandakanyeka ezigamekweni zokugebenga ezenzeke ku-R59 nakweminye imigwaqo ephakathi kwezifundazwe iGauteng neFree State. Kuthiwa baduna izimoto futhi bathumbe izisulu amahora amaningi ngesikhathi bekhipha isamba semali kuma-akhawunti azo asebhange.Ibamba likaKhomishana wamaPhoyisa eGauteng uFrans Kekana lithi kunabasolwa ababili abathungathwa amaphoyisa ngemuva kokucela empunzini ngesikhathi kudutshulwana."Laba babaleke ngezinyawo ngemuva kokudutshulwa kwabulawa ababehamba nabo ngesikhathi bedubulana namaphoyisa eParys, eFree State," kusho yena.
AZOPHELA amahlathi okucasha kubashayeli bamatekisi nakubo bonke abaphula imithetho yomgwaqo bephindelela uma kuqala ukusebenza kohlelo i-Administrative Adjudication of Road Traffic Offences (AARTO) ngokuphelele ngonyaka ozayo.Abashayeli abaphula imithetho bangazithola sekuhoxiswa izincwadi zabo zokushayela okanye baphoqeleke ukuthi bafunde kabusha ukushayela ukuze bathobele imithetho.Iziphathimandla zezokuthutha, zithi ngaphansi komthetho omusha, noma yikuphi ukuphulwa komthetho okuzokwenziwa wumshayeli, igama lakhe lizofakwa kwirejista ya-online lapho kuzogcinwa khona wonke amarekhodi abashayeli abaphambana nehlombe. Amaphoyisa azokwazi ukubheka noma yinini kulolu hlelo uma emisa umshayeli emgwaqweni onoma yikuphi ezweni.UMnuz Collen Msibi woMnyango wezokuThutha uthe uhlelo lwe-AARTO kuhloswe ukuthuthukisa ezokuphepha emigwaqweni yakuleli."Kuzofakwa yonke imininingwane nomlando wabashayeli abaphula imithetho futhi asebeke bathola izinhlawulo. Akusikho ukuthi kuzophunywa iqhubu nabantu abathile kuphela, kepha wonke umuntu uzovela. Uma uke waphula umthetho wathola ithikithi igama lakho lizovela. Kuzotholakala yonke imininingwane yomuntu owumshayeli,” kusho uMsibi.Yize lesi sikhulu sikhuluma kanjena kepha seziqalile izinkulumo zokuthi abashayeli bamatekisi yibo abazogqilazeka kakhulu kulolu hlelo. Njengoba kuyibo abachitha isikhathi esiningi besemigwaqweni yibo futhi abanamathuba amaningi okwephula umthetho. Emadolobheni amaningi amakhulu bayaziwa ngokuziphatha ngendlela ehlukile kunabanye abashayeli - befuna ukudlova okuhambisana nokwephulwa komthetho. Isikhathi esiningi basuke bebangisana ngokuthola abagibeli okubenza bagcine bengasaqikeleli ukuthobela imithetho. Kuthiwa kuyenzeka ngenyanga eyodwa umshayeli wetekisi abuthe amathikithi omgwaqo amathathu noma ngaphezulu. Kodwa kuyavela nokuthi akusibo bonke abashayeli bamatekisi abanomkhuba wokungaziphathi kahle emigwaqweni. Lokhu kuhambisana nezinhlelo zokuklomelisa labo abaziphatha kahle. Uhlelo lwe-AARTO luzokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi kubhekwana ngendlela efanayo nabashayeli abaphula imithetho ezweni lonke. Seluqalile ukusebenza eTshwane naseJohannesburg kanti kuhlelwe ukuthi lube selusebenza yonke indawo ezweni ngoJulayi wonyaka ozayo. Bekumele luqale kulo nyaka kodwa kwavela ukuthi abanye omasipala bebengakulungeli ukusebenza kwalo."Uhlelo we-AARTO lusho ukuthi abantu ngeke besabekwa amacala ngokuphula imithetho yomgwaqo bese beyoquliswa ezinkantolo, kepha bazobanjwa uma sebefuna ukuvuselela izincwadi zokushayela okanye bethelela izimoto,” kuchaza uMsibi.Lokhu kusho ukuthi umuntu oziphilisa ngokushayela itekisi ngeke akwazi ukuvuselela izincwadi uma enamarekhodi okuphula imithetho yomgwaqo - okungasho ukuphela kwephalishi. Kuzokwenzeka futhi kumiswe izincwadi zomshayeli oziphatha budlabha.UMsibi uthe uhlelo olusha luza nezinguquko njengokuthi uma ukhokhela ithikithi lomgwaqo ezinsukwini ezingu-32 uzothola isaphulelo sika-50%. Uma ugejwe yilesi sikhathi uzokube sewukhokha isamba esiphelele."Kuzokuba nohlaka lwe-AARTO oluzolalela izikhalo esikhundleni sokuthi abantu bayiswe ezinkantolo.” Esinye isigaba sohlelo kuzoba wukuthi abashayeli abanamathikithi ngeke bakwazi kwenza lutho ngaphambi kokuba bakhokhe yonke imali yezinhlawulo abazinikwe amaphoyisa."Wonke umshayeli unamaphuzu angu-15, azolokhu enconzuka kancane uma ephule umthetho. Uma esewabhubhudle wonke, izincwadi zakhe zizomiswa izinyanga ezintathu.”Uma izincwadi sezike zamiswa kwaze kwaba yikathathu, lowo mshayeli esethathwa njengomuntu okusegazini kuye ukuphula imithetho - ilayisensi yakhe iyasulwa bese kudingeka aqale phansi afake isicelo sayo kabusha ukuze ahlunyeleliswe isimilo. "Kunohlelo lokufundisa nokuhlomisa abashayeli asebehlule ngokuthi yini okungafanele bayenze emigwaqweni. Kuwuhlelo lokuhlala phansi, lapho sikweluleka ngezindaba ezikwenze wafinyelela ekutheni uphucwe ilayisensi futhi sikusize ukuthi uthathe ilayisensi yakho kabusha,” kusho uMsibi.Kuthulwa lolu hlelo nje, kunokukhathazeka nangokwanda kwabantu ababoshwa bezama ukugwazela amaphoyisa emigwaqweni."NgePhasika eledlule nangoDisemba, bekunenqwaba yabantu ababoshelwe ukuzama ukugwazela amaphoyisa. Ngakho sizama ukuqinisa umthetho. Asisho ukuthi amazambane abolile awekho, kodwa kukhona abantu abazimisele ngomsebenzi wabo futhi bazobopha labo abazama ukugwazisa nokugwazela. Njengoba amaphoyisa eqinisa umthetho, sikholwa wukuthi abantu bazothuka benze okufanele," usho njalo.I-AARTO yethulwa okokuqala ngo-1998 futhi kuhloswe ngayo ukukhuthaza ukuphepha emigwaqweni, ukunqanda ukuphulwa kwemithetho yomgwaqo kanye nokwethula uhlelo lukazwelonke lwamaphuzu ukubhekana nabaphula imithetho.Khonamanjalo, iziphathimandla zomgwaqo ziqinise isandla emigwaqweni yakuleli njengoba kuqala amaholidi kaDisemba. Abashayeli abanezinhlawulo ezisasele baxwayiswa ngokuthi bakhokhe.Njengamanje zingu-32 million izinhlawulo ezingakhokhiwe eNingizimu Afrika, ezifinyelela ezigidini zamarandi, ngokusho kweFINES SA, okuyinkampani esiza abashayeli maqondana nezinhlawulo ezingakhokhiwe.UMasipala weTheku uthe ukwehluleka kwabashayeli ukukhokha izinhlawulo kuba nomthelela omubi ekuqoqweni kwemali wumkhandlu.
Amaphoyisa abophe iphini likathishanhloko wesikole mayelana necala lokugebenga nokubulala. Amaphoyisa aseqinisekise isigameko esishaqisayo sokubulawa kukathishanhloko (61) waseTembisa, obulawe esemzini wakhe ngeSonto. IPhini likaKhomishana wamaPhoyisa eGauteng uFred Kekana uthi omunye wabasolwa ababoshwe ngoMsombuluko, uyiphini likathishanhloko esikoleni esifanayo. Uthishanhloko wesikole ezizimele iSamit Christian Academy udutshulwe wabulawa esemzini wakhe emuva kokuthi amadoda angaziwa egqekeze esebenzise imbazo. Abahlaseli bashaye unkosikazi wakhe nendodana base beba amaselula, ama-laptop nemali ngaphambi kokubaleka. UKekana uthi uphenyo lusaqhubeka. "Kusungulwe ithimba elilandele ulwazi lokuqala oluveziwe ngokushesha ngesikhathi liqala uphenyo. Ekugcineni, ithimba likwazile ukubopha iphini likathishanhloko wakusona lesi sikole kanti uzovela eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseTembisa, ngoLwesithathu," kwengeza uKekana.Umnyango wezeMfundo eGauteng udlulise amazwi enduduzo emndenini kathishanhloko.
IZINSOLO zenkohlakalo zimlandela egodini umlingisi, uPresley Chweneyagae, njengoba iSpecial Investigating Unit (SIU) ithole igunya lokugcina umuzi wakhe okuthiwa wawuthenga ngemali yeNational Lotteries Commission (NLC) ngokungemthetho.UPresley, wodumo lwefilimu iTsotsi, washona ngoMeyi, nonyaka.Ngesikhathi eshona, iSIU yase iqale uphenyo ngoxhaso olwatholwa yinhlangano engenzi inzuzo iSouthern African Youth Movement.Le nhlangano emelwe ngu-Alfred Muzwakhe Sigudla, yathola uxhaso luka-R15 million kwiNLC lokwenza izinhlelo zabantu abasha zezobuciko.Imali yagcina ingena enkampanini kaPresley, iDomestic Baboon (Pty) Ltd kaPresley. Kusolwa ukuthi wathenga ngayo umuzi ePitoli, ngemali elinganiselwa ku-R889 000.Ngokwencwadi etholwe yiSIU kwiSpecial Tribunal, iJaji uM Victor, liyalele umfelokazi kaPresley, uCharlaine Christinah Chweneyagae, ukuthi angawudayisi noma aqashise ngalo muzi kuze kuba kusongwa uhlelo lokubuyisa imali ezinsukwini ezingu-60.Uzakwabo owayelingisa indawo ephambili, uTerry Phetho, wadlelwa umuzi eBryanston, iSIU eyathi wathenga umhlaba wase eyawakha ngemali eyatholwa inhlangano engenzi inzuzo kwiNLC.
KUMNYAMA eNkosini ebhekene namacala okubulala, uSimphiwe Erick Zuma, njengoba izodlela uKhisimusi ejele, emva kokushabalala kwamathemba okuthi iwudlele ngaphandle ngesikhathi kuhlehliswa amacala okubulala ebhekene nawo okukhona kuwo amabili okusoconga izihlobo.Amacala amathathu okubulala abhekene noZuma ahlehliselwe unyaka ozayo. UZuma ubevele kafushane eNkantolo yeMantshi eHowick.Bekulindeleke ukuthi afake isicelo sebheyili ecaleni lesithathu abhekene nalo bese kuphinde kudluliselwa amacala eNkantolo eNkulu yaseMgungundlovu. Amacala ahlehlisiwe ngenxa yokungafiki kwabameli okuthiwa baphambanise izinsuku zokuhlala kwecala.Icala libe selihlehliselwa uJanuwari 12. UZuma uchithe isikhathi esiningi kulo nyaka esejele emva kokuboshwa okokuqala ngoJuni. Uboshelwe icala lokubulala undunankulu wesizwe asiphethe sakwaNxamalala eMpendle, uMnuz Qalokunye Zuma.Wadedelwa ngebheyili ka-R25 000 kuleli cala kodwa wabuye waboshelwa elokubulala ikhansela eliyisihlobo sakhe, uMnuz Nhlalayenza Ndlovu, engakaqedi ngisho inyanga ephumile.Inkantolo yasichitha isicelo sakhe sebheyili ecaleni lokubulawa kukaNdlovu owayeyikhansela le-DA kuMasipala waseMngeni.UZuma ukuphonsela inselelo ukunqatshelwa kwakhe ibheyili. Ngesikhathi eboshelwe ukubulala uNdlovu, waphinde waboshelwa icala lokubulala owayelwa nokudayiswa komhlaba eMpophomeni, uMnuz Xolani Ndlovu-Ntombela. UZuma ubengakasifaki isicelo sebheyili kuleli cala, bekulindeleke ukuthi acacise izolo ukuthi uzosifaka yini.UZuma uboshwe kanye nabanye abalisa abane kula macala.Ecaleni lokubulawa kukaNdlovu uboshwe kanye noMnuz Thobani Hlongwa, Khayelihle Shabalala, noThabo Mathonsi Chonco.UChonco uphinde aboshwe kanye noZuma ecaleni lokubulawa kukaNdlovu-Ntombela lapho beboshwe noMnuz Thembelani Mbatha.Umholi we-DA KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Francois Rodgers, uthe baphoxekile ukuthi icala lokubulawa kukaNdlovu alibange lisadluliselwa enkantolo enkulu."Sidumele, uMbuso ubulokhu ubambe uyeka, ubeka izaba. UMbuso uthe omunye wabameli ubezitshela ukuthi icala lizolalelwa ngoDisemba 14, okuyiSonto. Lokhu kusenza sizibuze ukuthi kanti yini lena eyenza ukuthi uMbuso ungafuni ukuthi leli cala lidlulele enkantolo enkulu."
AKWAZIWA ukuthi kuzogcina bani esiphakamisweni sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, esifakwe yiMK Party eholwa owayengumengameli, uMnuz Jacob Zuma.Kuzophela amaphupho uma amalungu esiShayamthetho esevotela isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNtuli, namhlanje.Akwaziwa mbhantshi kujiya njengoba umehluko phakathi kwamaqembu aseka isiphakamiso seMK nalawo asiphikisayo umncane kakhulu.I-MK inezihlalo ezingu-37 kwezingu-80 esiShayamthetho, isiphakamiso sayo sesekwa yiqembu elinezihlalo ezimbili, i-EFF.Amaqembu asephumele obala aveza ukuthi azophikisa isiphakamiso seMK yi-IFP, ANC ne-DA, anezihlalo ezingu-40 uma ehlangene.Akucaci ukuthi iqembu elingababeki benkosi, iNFP, ukuthi lizovota kanjani lona.Ubuholi beNFP kuzwelonke buyaseseka isiphakamiso seMK kanti ubuholi beqembu KwaZulu-Natal buyaphikisana nesiphakamiso. Umhlaziyi wezepolitiki waseNyuvesi yaKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Zakhele Ndlovu, uthe konke kuzoncika ekutheni iNFP ivota kanjani."Sonke siyazi ukuthi umholi weNFP (uMnuz Ivan Barnes) uyaseseka isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNtuli kodwa ilungu leNFP elijutshwe esiShayamthetho (uNksz Mbali Shinga) aliseseki isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNtuli. Asazi ukuthi uNksz Shinga uzogcina evote kanjani."I-MK yayikade icele kuSomlomo, uNksz Nontembeko Boyce, ukuba kuvotwe ngokuyimfihlo.UNdlovu uthe kungenzeka noma yini uma uNksz Boyce engase avume ukuba kuvotwe ngokuyimfihlo."Kungenzeka kube khona amalungu e-ANC azovotela isiphakamiso seMK. Uma kuvotwa ngokuyimfihlo kuba nzima ukuphoqa amalungu ukuba alandele umyalelo weqembu."UNdlovu uthe kungase kuphoqe ukuba kuqalwe phansi ukhetho KwaZulu-Natal uma iNFP ingase ivote neMK."Lokho kuzokusho ukuthi bangu-40 abeseka isiphakamiso seMK, babe ngu-40 abangaseseki. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi uhulumeni wesifundazwe ungakwazi ukusebenza kahle."Kulindeleke ukuthi impi yabafuna kukhishwe uNtuli nabamesekayo inqwamane ngaphakathi kanye nangaphandle kwesiShayamthetho.Amalungu eMK nawe-IFP azoqhudelana ngemibhikisho ezobanjelwa ngaphandle kwesiShayamthetho.I-DA nayo izokuba nawayo umbhikisho bude buduze nesiShayamthetho, e-Alexandra Park, lapho izozwakalisa ukuphikisana kwayo nesiphakamiso seMK.I-MK ifake isiphakamiso isola uNtuli ngokwehluleka ukuthathela izinyathelo abaphathiswa abasoleka enkohlakalweni.I-MK inxenxe amalungu ayo ukuba aphume ngobuningi bayo azokweseka isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNtuli.Umholi wophiko lwentsha kwi-MK, uMnuz Qiniso Cibane, uthe bafuna ukuthi lishone elanamhlanje iKwaZulu-Natal isiphethwe yiMK."Abantu baKwaZulu-Natal bavotela ngobuningi iMK ngoba befuna kube iyona ebaphathayo, ayi lo hulumeni kaNtuli."Umholi wenhlangano edlelana neMK, iMK Labour and Civic Organization (MK Laco), uMlungisi Zondi, uthe iKwaZulu-Natal kufanele engabe iphethwe yiMK."Asiphume sonke siyolwela iKwaZulu-Natal. Njengoba abantu abaningi KwaZulu-Natal bavotela iMK, kusho ukuthi iyona okufanele iphathe."Isiphakamiso seMK siyinyathele emsileni i-IFP, abaholi be-IFP besihlaba basihlikiza isiphakamiso sanamhlanje.USihlalo we-IFP kuzwelonke, uMnuz Blessed Gwala, uqhamuke nesiqubo esithi "Sigulelwa uMkhonto, uMkhonto udinga udokotela".Umholi we-IFP, uMnuz Velenkosi Hlabisa, uthe kuzophazamiseka umsebenzi omuhle owenziwa uhulumeni ophethe uma singase siphumelele isiphakamiso seMK."Inhloso yabo ukubuyisela emumva isifundazwe iKwaZulu-Natal. Kusukela ngokhetho lwangonyaka owedlule uhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal oholwa i-IFP usuwenze umehluko omkhulu. Sinxusa onke amaqembu ezombuswazwe afuna ukubona inqubekela phambili ukuba aphikise isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNtuli."UNtuli uzichithile izinsolo ezibekwa yiMK, wathi kusukela kwasekuqaleni vele iMK ne-EFF ayikaze ikwamukele ukuqokwa kwakhe, wathi mhla eqokwa iMK ne-EFF bavotela umholi weMK esiShayamthetho, iNkosi Phathisizwe Chiliza, ayebanga naye."Ngesikhathi ngiqokwa bathi lo hulumeni wokubambisana ngeke uziqede izinyanga ezintathu. Emva kwalokho, bathi angeke uwuqede unyaka ngakho-ke akuthusi lokhu abakwenzayo."UNtuli uthe maningi amathuba emisebenzi adalekile kusukela angena esikhundleni, wathi ziningi nezinhlelo zokulwa nobugebengu aqhamuke nazo.
I-IFP isitshele iqembu elifuna ukuketula uNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, ukuba linake izindaba zalo.I-IFP iyalele iMK ukuba ifake izikhalazo ezinhlakeni ezifanele uma kuwukuthi kayeneme ngobuholi bukaNtuli.I-MK ifake isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNtuli esizolalelwa esiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal, ngoMsombuluko.Esiphakamisweni sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNtuli, iMK isola lo Ndunankulu ngokuqamba amanga ngesikhathi ebuzwa ngezindleko zohambo lwakhe lwaseMelika, iphinde imsole ngokwahluleka ukuthathela izinyathelo abaphathiswa abasolwa enkohlakalweni.I-IFP ibhunge ngesiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNtuli emhlanganweni wesigungu esiphezulu obungoMsombuluko.Okhulumela i-IFP, uMnuz Mkhuleko Hlengwa, uthe banqume ukuthi bazomeseka uNtuli.UHlengwa uthe uNtuli usawenza kahle umsebenzi wakhe, wathi isiphakamiso seMK asinasisekelo."Lena imizamo nje yokuphazamisa ukusebenza kukahulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal oholwa uNtuli. Kuningi okuhle esikubonile kwenzeka ngaphansi kobuholi bukaNtuli, okubalwa kukho ukutshwala kwemali engu-R100 billion. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi abatshalimali bayawuthemba uhulumeni wesifundazwe."UHlengwa uthe iMK izifunela ukubukwa."Ukube bakhathazekile okwangempela bebezobhalela izinhlaka ezigade ukusebenza kukahulumeni. I-MK kufanele ifake umfutho ekuxazululeni izinkinga esifakwe kuzo yiyona okubalwa kuzo abantu abavaleleke empini ephakathi kweRussia ne-Ukraine. Laba bantu baluthwa lapha kwathiwa bayoqeqeshelwa ukuba abaqaphi."I-MK inezihlalo ezingu-37 kwezingu-80 esiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal.Onke amaqembu ameleleke esiShayamthetho avele asephumele obala, asho ukuthi ngeke aseseke isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNtuli.Amaqembu abusa ngokubambisana, i-IFP, ANC neNFP anezihlalo ezingu-41 uma ehlanganisiwe.Kulindeleke ukuthi kube ncane indawo ngaphandle kwesiShayamthetho uma sekulalelwe isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNtuli.Amalungu eMK nawe i-IFP azokuba nemibhikisho ngaphandle kwesiShayamthetho.
UMHOLI we-EFF, uMnuz Julius Malema, ushubise isimo kuhulumeni wokubambisana ophethe KwaZulu-Natal, njengoba eyalele amalungu e-EFF esiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal ukuba avotele isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNdunankulu wesifundazwe, uMnuz Thami Ntuli. Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba izolo.Isiphakamiso esokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNtuli sifakwe yiMK, sizolalelwa ngoMsombuluko. Ngaphambilini, i-EFF yayikade ithe ngeke iseseke isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNtuli ngenxa yokuthi ayifune lutho oluzoyihlanganisa neMK.Kodwa izolo, uMalema uveze ukuthi bafuna uNtuli aphume esikhundleni.UMalema uthe ukweseka kwabo isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNtuli akusho ukuthi baseka iMK."Saseka isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaZuma (umholi weMK) ePhalamende esasifakwe yi-DA. Nonke niyazi ukuthi asihambisani ne-DA kodwa saseka isiphakamiso sayo ngoba sasingahambisani noZuma. Ukweseka isiphakamiso akusho ukuthi usuke usuhambisana neqembu elisifakile."UMalema uthe okwenza beseke isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNtuli ukuthi iMK iyona efanelwe ukuhola uhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal."I-MK iyona eyathola amavoti amaningi KwaZulu-Natal. Kufanele inikezwe ithuba lokuphatha KwaZulu-Natal. Asinendaba nokuthi iMK inabo yini abaholi abafanelwe izikhundla. Iqiniso ukuthi abantu baKwaZulu-Natal bayithanda inje iMK."UMalema unxuse uZuma ukuba abe ingxenye yezingxoxo zamaqembu afuna ukukhipha uNtuli, wathi bona bajube uNobhala Jikelele, uMnuz Marshall Dlamini, ukuba abe yingxenye yezingxoxo."Inkinga ngeMK ukuthi nifike nixoxe kahle nabayimele, bese kuba inkinga ukuthi bathole uZuma ukuze kuqedelwe izingxoxo. Kuze kuphele amasonto amabili kusalindwe uZuma. Uma kuwukuthi bazimisele ngempela ngesiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNtuli kuzofanele uZuma azifikele mathupha ezingxoxweni ezizokuba ngempelasonto."UMalema uthe bazonxenxa i-ANC ukuba yeseke isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNtuli."Uma abaholi be-ANC bengafuni ukukhuluma nathi ayikho into esivimba ukuthi sizikhulumele eceleni namalungu ajutshwe yi-ANC esiShayamthetho."I-MK inezihlalo ezingu-37 kwezingu-80 esiShayamthetho, i-EFF yona inezimbili.Amaqembu anezihlalo ezingu-40 uma ehlangene, i-IFP, ANC neDA, aphumele obala athi angeke aseseke isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNtuli.Akucaci ukuthi iNFP - enesihlalo esisodwa - ukuthi izovota kanjani yona.Amaqembu amathathu iMK, IFP ne-DA, azokuba nemibhikisho ngaphandle kwesiShayamthetho ngoMsombuluko.
UMGQUGQUZELI we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Mike Mabuyakhulu, uziphendulele kuNobhala Jikelele wenhlangano, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, obaphendule inhlekisa ngokubafanisa nohlobo lwemoto endala, iTazz.UMabuyakhulu uthe akakuboni okubi ngokuthi bafaniswe neTazz ngoba uhlobo lwemoto eyinqokonqoko.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma esifundweni ngempilo yowayengunobhala jikelele we-ANC Youth League, uMnuz Sindiso Magaqa, ebiseMzimkhulu, izolo.UMbalula uphendule ithimba elihola i-ANC KwaZulu-Natal inhlekisa ezweni ngesikhathi eliqhathanisa neTazz, wathi ngesikhathi beqoka ithimba lesikhashana babezitshela ukuthi baletha uhlobo oluphambili lwemoto, iFerrari.UMabuyakhulu ukhombise ukukwamukela ukufaniswa neTazz, wathi selike latakula abaningi ezinkingeni ezahlukene."Angikaze ngiyibone iFerrari, ngiyigcina ezithombeni. IFerrari imoto nje ebizayo, bambalwa abantu abanayo. Ayikwazi ukuhamba emgwaqweni oyimbuqu, imfishane kakhulu. Ayikwazi ukuhamba emigwaqweni yaselokishini enemigodi, iyabiza le moto. Ayikwazi ukuphuma emigwaqweni emikhulu ingene emigwaqweni emincane."Kodwa-ke iTazz ilona esiyaziyo. Yilona esilijwayele ngoba ayilayishi abantu ababili kuphela kodwa ilayisha umndeni wonke. Abantu kabayazi iFerrari. Singafisa ukuba neFerrari kodwa iqiniso ukuthi imoto esiyaziyo iTazz. Lena imoto esike yasisiza sisezinkingeni eziningi." UMabuyakhulu uncome amalungu e-ANC esifundeni iHarry Gwala ngokuqhubeka nokuthembeka kwi-ANC.Yize i-ANC ingenzanga kahle KwaZulu-Natal okhethweni lwangonyaka owedlule, akuzange kube kubi esifundeni iHarry Gwala."Ukuhlangana kwethu kulo mkhandlu kubaluleke kakhulu ngoba ukuba ukhetho olwedlule kwakungukhetho lohulumeni basekhaya, sasizosala nomasipala ababili kuphela. Omunye wabo kwakuyoba ilona walapha eMzimkhulu, ngiyafisa ukuba nizishayele ihlombe ngoba i-ANC iyakubona ukusebenza kwenu kanzima. Omunye umasipala esasosala nawo ulapha eHarry Gwala. Angiyikhulumi eyabanye omasipala, kwakuyoxoxwa."Limfiliba ikusasa lethimba lesikhashana elihola i-ANC KwaZulu-Natal.UMbalula uveze ukuthi bazoqoka abantu abasha ukuthi bahole i-ANC KwaZulu-Natal ngonyaka ozayo.Ithimba elikhona laqokwa ngasekuqaleni konyaka kulandela ukuhlakazwa kobuholi besifundazwe.
KUKHALWA nxazonke ngokubulawa ngesihluku kobengumdidiyeli wamabutho kaZulu esiFundeni saseKing Cetshwayo, uSeziwanjani Xulu, ngoLwesine ntambama.Okhulumela amaphoyisa aKwaZulu-Natal, uCaptain Ntathu Ndlovu, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi uXulu (64) akasekho emhlabeni emuva kokudutshulwa emgwaqweni uR34 ngaseMaguzulu Park."Uphenyo lwamaphoyisa lukhomba ukuthi umufi ubepake imoto yakhe emgwaqweni ngesikhathi abasolwa ababili abangaziwa, ebebehlome beyizingovolo, besondele kuye maqede bamdubula amahlandla amaningi, base bebaleka ngezinyawo endaweni yesigameko," kusho uCapt Ndlovu othe bekungakaboshwa muntu futhi nembangela beyingakaziwa. Ebuzwa ngokwenza waxosha uNgizwe kulo mcimbi, uXulu wathi wayemphephisa emabuthweni ayefuna ukumudla amfele emuva kokuba egxeke amakhosi akhonza ebandleni lakwaShembe.Umlingisi weShaka Ilembe futhi ongumdidiyeli wamabutho KwaMandlakazi, uNkosikhona "Phakelumthakathi" Ndabandaba, ungomunye wabadlulise amazwi ngokudlula emhlabeni kukazakwabo. "Kodwa bafowethu lezi zibhamu zikhanda liphi izwe ngempela? Ubulala indoda endala kangaka ngesibhamu kubhekwe kuKhisimusi, kuyisikhathi semindeni nenjabulo. AbakwaXulu kuzofanele beyilwele le nto, bethole umyombo," kuphawula uPhakelumthakathi. Ngaphandle kokuba umdidiyeli wamabutho, uXulu ubebuye abe yisishoshovu samalungelo ezinduna ezinsizwa nabadidiyeli bamabutho. Kwenzeka lokhu nje, uXulu ubengomunye wabadidiyeli bamabutho kaZulu abebevakashele uKhuzani Mpungose ngoDisemba 4, ukuzozwa ngezinhlelo zodwendwe lwakhe olunamhlanje.
Uyaqhubeka umsebenzi wokuthungatha abasebenzi besakhiwo saseVerulam esiwe ngoLwesihlanu.NgoLwesihlanu emini, amathimba ezinhlekelele nabezimo eziphuthumayo baphuthume eVerula, lapho kwakhiwa khona ithempeli ngemuva kokuthola imibiko yokuwa kwalesi sakhiwo. Imibiko yokuqala iveze ukuthi kunabantu abaningi abavaleleke ngaphansi kwemfucumfucu, kanye nalabo abavaleleke kuvulandi. Ngesikhathi efika, amathimba e-IPSS Search & Rescue, eMnyangweni Wezomlilo eThekwini, Netcare911, Durban Metro Police SAR kanye ne-SAPS Search & Rescue, ahlole isimo ngokushesha. Kuthathwe isinqumo sokuhlenga labo abebevaleleke, abebethole imihuzukwana nje. Ithimba labe seliqala umsebenzi wokuzama ukufinyelela labo abavaleleke. Umsebenzi uqhubeke kwaze kwaba sebusuku ngoLwesihlanu, kwaze kwathathwa isinqumo sokumisa ukuthungatha. Ngehora lesihlanu ekuseni ngoMgqibelo ekuseni, amathimba e-IPSS Search & Rescue, SAPS SAR, Durban Metro Police SAR, SARZA nomnyango wezomlilo eThekwini, abuyile aqhubeka nokuthungatha. Kutholakale izidumbu ezine sabantu besilisa. Ntambama ngoMgqibelo, kuphoqeleke ukuba kumiswe ukusebenza ngenxa yesimo sezulu. Bazophinde babuyele kule ndawo ngeSonto ekuseni, njengoba esaqhubeka nokusebenza wokufuna isidumbu sesihlanu.

UKWESEKWA nokuthandwa kakhulu kwengoma yeqembu lomculo wamaZayoni elibunjwe yiziitshudeni zase-University of Zululand i-Association For Tertiary Zion Students (ATZES) Unizulu kulikhuthaze ukuqhubeka lapho elaligcine khona ukukhipha umculo wamaZayoni.Lokho kushiwo omunye wabaholi baleli qembu uSithabiso Mazibuko, exoxa neSolezwe Ngempelasonto nge-albhamu yabo entsha yesine esihloko sithi Ngizocasha Edwaleni, eqale ukutholakala ezitolo zomculo kwi-internet ngoLwesibili odlule. UMazibuko uthe kuze kufika kulesi sigaba nje bekungelula neze njengoba umgqigqo wabo wathikamezeka ngenkathi kubhoka iCovid-19 ezweni ngo-2020, okwenza ukuthi bagcine ukuqopha nokukhipha umculo wabo ngo-2018 kungahlanganeki ukuze basebenze ngendlela abajwayele ngayo ngenxa yemithetho eyayiqinile ezweni ngaleso sikhathi."Yingakho kuthe sesibona ukuthi idumela lethu ebantwini libuya ngamandla ngabo-2022, saqala lapho ukusebenzela ukuthi sikhiphe umsebenzi omkhulu kangaka, nesiqale ukuwupheka nyakenye njengoba size siwukhipha manje ebantwini," usho kanje. Eqhuba uMazibuko, okhonza ebandleni iZion Apostolic Church yasoLundi, enyakatho yeKwaZulu-Natal, uthe konke lokhu akubanga lula neze njengoba ngokuhlela kwabo kwasekuqaleni babefisa ukuthi le albhamu iphume ngoJuni nonyaka, kepha kwangenzeka."Kuningi obekuphazamisa ukusebenza kwethu, sibala izindleko zemali enkulu yokuthwala wonke lo msebenzi, nokuthi uma nisebenza niyiqembu labantu abaningi kubuye kube khona izinto nezimo ezizamazamisa ukusebenza kwenu, okudinga ukuthi nibeke eqhulwini inhloso yokuhlangana kwenu ukuze ningawiswa yizinto ebezingagwemeka," kulanda uMazibuko."Ngiyakhumbula nokuthi kwathi sesihlele konke ngokuyela e-studio kwashonelwa uzakwethu owayeneqhaza elimqoka kakhulu ekhwayeni, nokwaphoqa ukuthi sithole omunye ngokushesha ukuvala leso sikhala sakhe. Konke lokho bekuthiya ukusebenza kwethu, kodwa ngoba besinenhloso eyodwa saqhubeka njengoba sekukuhle kanjena," usho kanje.INgizocasha Edwaleni ididiyele izingoma eziwu-12, kanti iqoshwe enkampanini Indoni Productions, eseRandburg, eGoli. Ingeyesine kuma-albhamu e-ATEZS UNIZULU; njengoba yelama amathathu okuqala athi Uyisihlobo Esihle yango-2016, Akekh' Ofana Naye yango-2018 nabazibula ngayo ngo-2012 esihloko sithi Masingahlulelani.Kulena yamanje kucula phambili yena uMazibuko - okunguye futhi obhale zonke izingoma, alekelelwe wuZama Xulu, Thalente Dube, Melokuhle Buthelezi namalungu ekhwaya angu-42.
BAZOJEZA kanzima ababandakanyeka enkohlakalweni yokulahleka kwezigidi zamarandi kumasipala waKwaDukuza kanye nabanye abangamazambane abolile kulo masipala.Lokhu kudalulwe yiMeya yakulo masipala, uMnuz Siduduzo Gumede, izolo ikhuluma eBallito ngesikhathi kuhlangana izinsuku eziyikhulu ingenile ehhovisi.UGumede uveze ukuthi kunecala elivuliwe elimayelana nesigameko semali engu-R35.7 million okwavela ukuthi inyamalele kwi-akhawunti kamasipala yakwa-Absa.Le ndaba kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi kwakhulunywa kakhulu ngayo njengoba kwahlaluka ukuthi yanyamalala ngendlela engaqondakali. Ngokombiko waleli bhange elawuthumelela umasipala, imali yakhishwa amahlandla amabili ngoJanuwari 31 nonyaka.Kwavela ukuthi eminye imizamo yokuqhubeka nokukhipha enye imali kamasipala yagcina iphunza ngemuva kokuba uphiko lokukhwabanisa lwangaphakathi ebhange lwabuza kumasipala ukuthi unalo yini ulwazi ngale mali ekhishwayo.UGumede uthe : "Luyaqhubeka uphenyo mayelana nalesi sigameko. Kulokoza inhlansi yethemba ngokuthi kuzogcina kuvelile okwenzeka," echaza.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi kule mali kukhona ingxenye eyagcina ibuyiselwe emuva kodwa ikhona enye namanje engakabuyeli. Ukhale ngokuthi inkohlakalo ikhinyabeza ukusebenza kukamasipala futhi kubambezela nentuthuko okumele iye kubantu.''Kuye kuthiwe sithule akukho esikwenzayo mayelana nenkohlakalo lutho akunjalo. Sifuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi nakanjani bayajeza labo bantu ababandakanyeka kwinkohlakalo,'' usho kanjena.Ngaphandle kwaleli cala elaba yindaba egudwini uveze ukuthi kukhona namanye amacala aphathalene nenkohlakalo nawo aphenywayo."Sifuna ukuthi abantu bazi ukuthi ayikho indawo yenkohlakalo kulo masipala. Sithumela umyalezo ocacile wokuthi kulo masipala siyabophana, asidlali. Lokhu kuzosiza ukuze abantu bazi ukuthi lena akusiyona indawo yokudlala,''usho kanjena.Uveze nokuthi kunamanye amathenda aphenywayo ukuthi labo abawathola bawathola kanjani. Ubalule nethenda lokwakhiwa kwenxanxathela yezitolo iKwaDukuza Mall."Nalolu daba luyaphenywa, siyethemba ukuthi konke kuzovela ekugcineni," echaza.Ugcizelele ukuthi bafuna ukuthi uMasipala waKwaDukuza waziwe njengobeka eqhulwini intuthuko hhayi okunye okuseceleni.Unxuse ukuthi kube nokubekezelelana njengoba bematasa nawo wonke lawa macala ukuze konke kuzohamba kahle futhi kungabi bikho ukuphazamiseka kophenyo.''Asingayibambi isavele ngekhanda, kumele sizifundise ukulinda ukuze kuzovela obala kahle konke,''echaza.Mayelana nodaba lokungabi bikho kwePhini leMeya kulo masipala uthe kuyezwela khona ukuthi namanje alikaqokwa. Noma kunjalo kodwa uthe lolu wudaba lwalabo abangaphezulu kwakhe ngokwamandla.Ugonyuluke nangengwadla kagesi wathi bahlanganisa amakhanda ukuze kutholakale isixazululo. Yethula inkulumo yosuku kulesi sithangami, imenenja jikelele yase-Avis, uNksz Yanela Mtati, idalule ukuthi nonyaka beze nomkhankaso abawubiza nge-4-for-3, okusho ukuthi lelo nalelo khasimende elizoqasha imoto izinsuku ezintathu, lizogixabezwa ngosuku lwesine ngaphezulu mahhala. "Lokhu sikwenzele ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amakhasimende ethu awajabulela ngokuphelele amaholidi okuphela konyaka, nokuthi uma befuna ukujabula nokungcebeleka izinsuku ezingaphezu kwezintathu lokho bakwenze kalula nangendlela ezokwehlisa umthwalo,” usho kanje.Eqhuba udalule nokuthi ngaphezu kwalokho sebenyuse izinga lobuchwepheshe ababubiza ngokuthi yiSafe Drive, okuzofakwa emotweni esuke iqashwe yikhasimende ngenani elithile, ngenhloso yokuthi kube lula ukuthola usizo lwezokuphepha nokunye okunjalo ngokushesha."Nalokho futhi kusengenye yezindlela esibheke ukuzisebenzisela ukuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu ozosebenzisana nathi kusuka manje kuya phambili uyagculiseka ngendlela esizomphatha ngayo, futhi siqikelele ukuthi amakhasimende ethu aphepha ngayo yonke indlela ngoba siyazi ukuthi njengoba kuza amaholidi, injabulo isuke inkulu nokwenza ukuthi kube khona izinto ezonakalayo ngenxa yenjabulo,” kusho uNksz Mtati. Uthe sebekubheke ngabomvu ukuthi basebenzisane namakhasimende abo ngendlela ezowajabulisa ngalesi sikhathi njengoba futhi benezinhlelo zokuqashisa ngemoto isonto lonke, inyanga yonke nangaphezu kwalokho - ukusiza abakhonze ukungcebeleka."Sinanohlelo lwe-game drive, lapho sibolekisa khona ngohlobo lwezimoto ezithile ezilungele ukuqwala izintaba nokungcebeleka ezindaweni ezinjengaseziqiwini nokunye. Kukhona futhi uhlelo lokuqashisa ngezimoto ezithile kwabaqopha imidlalo yethelevishini,” kusho yena.Amagalelo e-Avis angengatshazwe kule mboni, okufakazelwa wukuthi isinamagatsha ayo angaphezu kuka-60 ezweni lonke, okuhlanganisa awu-16 aKwaZulu-Natal.

Abalimele AbaqinisekisiweAbantu abayishumi nanye (abesifazane ababili nabesilisa abayisishiyagalolunye) bahlengwe ngempumelelo futhi baphuthunyiswa esibhedlela ukuze bathole usizo lwezokwelashwa. Okubuhlungu ukuthi sekushone umuntu oyedwa. Imizamo yokucinga nokuhlenga iyaqhubeka ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abekho abantu abengeziwe abasala bevaleleke.
Isikhungo esibhekelele izinhlekelele KwaZulu-Natal sesikuqinisekisile ukuthi kutshalwe ithimba lezimo eziphuthumayo lapho kudilika khona isakhiwo eRedcliffe, eVerulam enyakatho yeTheku.Imibiko yokuqala iveza ukuthi ibhilidi elinezitezi ezine ebelisakhiwa liwile, lavalela inqwaba yabasebenzi abebekule ndawo ngesikhathi sesigameko.Lusaqhubeka utakulo sisasebenza futhi sizwela kakhulu, abasebenzi bezempilo bezimo eziphuthumayo banakekela abalimele kuyilapho amathimba akhethekile okusesha kanye nokuhlenga esebenza ngokuzikhandla ukuze afinyelele labo abasavaleleke ngaphansi kwemfucumfucu.Wonke amaphrothokholi afanelekile okulawulwa kwezinhlekelele asevuliwe, futhi ama-ejensi amaningi, okuhlanganisa abezokwelashwa kwezimo eziphuthumayo, iyunithi yomlilo neyokutakula, kanye nokugcinwa komthetho, akhona ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusabela okuhlelekile.Njengamanje asikaqinisekiswa isibalo sabasebenzi abavalelekile njengoba ithimba labatakuli abezimo eziphuthumayo besasebenza.

UBUHOLI be-ANC buzoqhubeka nombhidlango wokwakha kabusha inhlangano KwaZulu-Natal.Okhulumela i-ANC, uNkk Mahlengi Bhengu-Motsiri, uthe bazoqinisa ubuholi benhlangano esifundazweni.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba abebehambele ingqungquthela yenhlangano, iNational General Council (NGC), eqhubeka eGauteng.I-ANC yanquma ukuhlakaza ubuholi bayo KwaZulu-Natal emva kokwenza kabi okhethweni lukazwelonke lwangonyaka owedlule.I-ANC yasuka ekutholeni u-54% okhethweni lwango-2019, yathola u-17% okhethweni olwedlule.Yize kunethimba elisha elaqokwa ukuba lihole i-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, le nhlangano iyaqhubeka nokuhlulwa ezinkethweni zokuchibiyela.UNkk Bhengu-Motsiri uthe bazoqhubeka nombhidlango wokwakha kabusha izinhlaka ze-ANC KwaZulu-Natal."Asihlehli, siyaqhubeka nalowo msebenzi. Kukhona lapho sizoqinisa khona. Uma ngingenza isibonelo nje, sizoqinisa lapha ebantwini esibajube esifundazweni. Kuningi esizokwenza esifundazweni."UNkk Bhengu-Motsiri uthe isimo se-ANC KwaZulu-Natal sidinga ukusukunyelwa."Sesibonile ukuthi yini okufanele siyenze nokuthi ikuphi okusibeka engozini. Kufanele sisho ke nokuthi sijabule ngomsebenzi owenziwa abaholi abajutshwe ezikhundleni KwaZulu-Natal."Ingqungquthela ye-ANC ingene osukwini lwesibili izolo, lapho khona kuqale amakhomishini abhunga ngezihloko ezahlukene.Phakathi kwezihloko okuzokhulunywa ngazo kubalwa isinqumo sedlelandawonye, iSACP, sokungenela ukhetho ngokuzimela, ubudlelwano be-ANC namaqembu ebambisene nawo kuhulumeni wokubambisana nesimo sezezimali.Umhlangano wesigungu esiphezulu kwi-ANC uthathe isinqumo sokuthi amalungu e-ANC engabe esavunyelwa ukuba abe nobulungu be-SACP.Phambilini, amalungu e-ANC abevumelekile ukuba abe nobulungu beSACP ngoba amaKhomanisi abekhankasela i-ANC ezinkethweni.UNobhala Jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, uthe amalungu esigungu esiphezulu anqume ukuthi kuhlukane inhloko nesixhanti."Asikwazi ukuhlala nabantu abazobuye basijikele kusasa uma sekukhankaselwa ukhetho."Amalungu e-ANC awaboni ngaso linye ngodaba lukahulumeni wokubambisana njengoba kukhona aphikisana nokufakwa kwe-DA.I-ANC iphinde ibhekane nenkinga yezezimali njengoba ihlulekile ukuholela abasebenzi.UNkk Bhengu-Motsiri uthe inkinga yemali ababhekene nayo ikhombisa ngokusobala ukuthi i-ANC ayikhohlakele."Ukube kuthiwa i-ANC inhlangano ekhohlakele ngabe sesitape imali kahulumeni sakhokhela abasebenzi. Le nto iyakhombisa ukuthi akuyona inhlangano ekhohlakele kodwa abantu nje abathize abakhohlakele."
ZIPHUNYUKE emlonyweni wengwenya izisebenzi zohlaka oluklama imingcele kuleli, iMunicipal Demarcation Board (MDB), ebezigcinwe ngaphandle kokuthanda kwazo, zasatshiswa ngokuthelwa induku ngesikhathi kunezigcawu zomphakathi lapho bezichaza khona ngohlelo lokuklanywa kabusha kwemingcele yamawadi kuleli.Lolu hlaka belimatasa nohlelo lwemingcele njengoba kulungiselelwa ukhetho lohulumeni basekhaya olungonyaka ozayo.Ilungu leMDB, uNkk Gabi Gumbi-Masilela, lithe babonga ukuthi luphothuliwe uhlelo njengoba bethwale kanzima ngesikhathi bematasa nalo msebenzi. UNkk Gumbi-Masilela uthe ngendlela izinto ebezishube ngayo kwezinye izindawo abebevalelwe kuzona wumphakathi bebengacabangi ukuthi bazophuma bephila."Abantu abaningi bebefuna ukwazi kabanzi ngalolu hlelo lokuklanywa kwemingcele. Abanye bebengenalwazi, abanye bebesisabisa ngokuthi bazosishaya," usho kanje,Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi leli bhodi lidlulisela umbiko kwikhomishini yezokhetho kuleli, i-IEC ngomsebenzi eliwenzile ngesikhathi liklama kabusha imingcele emcimbini obuseGoli, izolo. USihlalo weMDB, uMnuz Thabo Manyoni, ukhale esifanayo wathi lolu hambo lokuklama kabusha imingcele belunzima.Uthe bebevalelwa kwezinye izindawo kunenqwaba yezingqinamba kodwa lokhu kuyingxenye yentando yeningi."Kwezinye izifundazwe njengaKwaZulu-Natal, sisalinde ukuthi izinkantolo zinqume ngaphambi kokuba siqhubeke nokubheka kabusha imingcele kumawadi athintekayo. Sibonga izisebenzi eziyibambe ishisa umphakathi ulwa," usho kanje. Uthe kubalulekile ukuthi abantu babhalisele ukuvota kulolu khetho oluzayo ngoba bazovota lapho behlala khona.USihlalo we-IEC, uMnuz Mosotho Moepya, uthe bazoya emphakathini okushintshwe kuyona amawadi abebevota kuwona ngaphambi kokuklanywa kabusha kwemingcele ukuze bayisize ibhalise kabusha ukuze ivote.Uthe lo msebenzi owenziwe yibhodi ubaluleke kakhulu nakuba kwezinye izindawo ushiya abantu bekhala ngoba sebeshintshe iwadi abebekulona phambilini."Ngeke silinde kuze kube nohlelo lokuthi kuvulwe ithuba lokuthi abantu babhalisele ukuvota kuleli njengoba sizoya emiphakathini ethintekile ngokushintshwa kwemingcele. Asifuni kube nomuntu ozosala ngaphandle athole ukuthi akasakwazi ukuvota ngoba sekushintshe imingcele." UNgqongqoshe wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu kuzwelonke, uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa, uthe ukhetho kumele lube phakathi kukaNovemba 2026 kuya kuJanuwari 2027.UHlabisa okunguyena ozomemezela usuku lokhetho, uthe uyazi ukuthi lolu hlelo ludala izikhalazo emphakathini njengoba lolu hlaka belibhekene nezingqinamba."Uma sibamba ukhetho ngoNovemba, kuzophazamiseka izivivinyo zika-matric, ngoDisemba kumatasa kakhulu. NangoJanuwari, kunezingqinamba ezikhona ngale nyanga. Simatasa siqhathanisa amakhalenda noMnyango weMfundo eyisiSekelo noweMfundo ePhakeme," kusho uHlabisa.
UNOBHALA Jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, ukhwele wadilika ethimbeni lesikhashana elihola inhlangano KwaZulu-Natal. UMbalula uveze ukuthi bazokwenza izinguquko kuleli thimba elaqokwa ngasekuqaleni kwalo nyaka. Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba lapho kuqhubeka khona ingqungquthela iNational General Council (NGC).UMbalula uthe ithimba elaqokwa emva kokuhlakazwa kobuholi besifundazwe lihlulekile ukwenza umsebenzi walo, wathi abaholi abaqokwa balibele ukulwa izimpi zangaphakathi esikhundleni sokwakha kabusha izinhlaka zeqembu."Buyasiphoxa ubuholi be-ANC KwaZulu-Natal. Ngesikhathi sibaqoka sasizitshela ukuthi silande iFerrari (uhlobo lwemoto ephambili) kodwa manje kusobala ukuthi salanda i-tazz." Ithimba lesikhashana linabantu abangu-66. UMbalula uthe bazolinciphisa ithimba."Sizoqoka abanye abantu, sifuna ukuba nethimba elincane."Ithimba elikhona lalikade linikezwe izinyanga eziyisishagalolunye ukuba lihlele izingqungquthela zokukhetha ubuholi besifundazwe nobezifunda.Lihluleke lancama ukwenza lokho kwaze kwaba kuphela isikhathi elalinekwe sona.Umnqamulajuqu uphele ngenyanga eyedlule kodwa ithimba libuye lalulelwa isikhathi sokusebenza ngezinyanga ezintathu.UMbalula uthe kubalulekile ukuba i-ANC ivuke izithathe KwaZulu-Natal, wathi uma i-ANC ingase ikwazi ukuvuka izithathe KwaZulu-Natal naseGauteng, ingakwazi ukunqoba ngamalengiso ukhetho.Okhethweni olwedlule i-ANC yathola u-40% kuzwelonke ngenxa yokungenzi kahle KwaZulu-Natal naseGauteng.KwaZulu-Natal yathola u-17%, kwathi eGauteng khona yathola u-33%. Khonamanjalo: UMbalula uchithe eyokuthi ugaqele isikhundla sokuba iphini likamengameli we-ANC. "Amahlebezi okuthi ngigaqele isikhundla sokuba iphini likamengameli angazi niwathathaphi. Ziningi izinto ebezikhulunywa ngaphambi kokuthi kuqale iNGC. Kukhona abebethi kuzoketulwa uMengameli (uCyril Ramaphosa). Nganitshela ukuthi angeke yenzeke leyo nto. Nakhu ngempela iyaqhubeka iNGC, akekho osazame ukuketula umengameli."Ingqungquthela ye-ANC izovalwa namhlanje ebusuku.URamaphosa uzokwethula inkulumo yokuvala, ngaphambi kwakhe osihlalo bamakomiti e-ANC bazomemezela izinqumo ezithathiwe.Eqhulwini wudaba lwesinqumo seSACP sokungenela ukhetho ngokuzimela, uhulumeni wokubambisana kanye namalungiselelo okhetho lohulumeni basekhaya.

KUZOPHELA ukulinda iminyaka engu-10 ngaphambi kokuba kusulwe umlando wokulahlwa amacala (criminal record), njengoba kunezinhlelo zokubuyekeza umthetho kuleli.Lokhu kuvezwe yibamba likaMqondisi jikelele eMnyangweni wezobuLungiswa nokuThuthukiswa koMthethosisekelo, uNksz Kalayvani Pillay, oveze ukuthi basemkhankasweni wokubuyekeza umthetho ukuze kwehliswe iminyaka abantu abayilindayo ukuze baphume kulolu luhlu. Uthe lokhu kwehliswa kweminyaka kuzokwenzeka kulabo abalahlwa amacala angatheni, angenayo indlakadla. Uveze ukuthi ziningi izicelo abazitholayo zabantu abasuke befuna kucishwe lo mlando wokuba sohlwini lwabalahlwa amacala. "Kunomnyakazo wokuthi kubuyekezwe indaba yale minyaka umuntu okumele ayilinde ukuze kusulwe umlando wokuthi wake walahlwa amacala. Kulabo abake balahlwa amacala angatheni okubalwa elokweba ezitolo, elokungena lapho kungafanele khona namanye, kubhekwe ukuthi yehliswe iminyaka. Sibheke ukuthi yehliswe iminyaka ibe ngu-5 yokuthi ube semabhukwini abantu abanomlando wokulahlwa amacala," usho kanje.Usho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma esithangamini sabezindaba eGoli ngempelasonto, lapho uNgqongqoshe walo mnyango uNksz Mmamoloko Kubayi, ebekhuluma ngezinhlelo zokuvikela ofakazi abasuke behlabe umkhosi ngezinto ezithinta inkohlakalo. UNksz Pillay uthe le ndaba yokubuyekezwa kweminyaka umuntu ayihlala emabhukwini abantu asebeke balahlwa amacala, ihambisana nokubuyekezwa komthetho iCriminal Procedure. Ukuze ucishwe kubantu asebeke balahlwa amacala ufaka isicelo emnyangweni wezobuLungiswa, kumele kube ngukuthi awukaze ulahlwe amacala okuhlukumeza ngokocansi noma amanye anendlakadla.Kumele kube ngukuthi awuzake ulahlwe icala eminyakeni engu-10, futhi awukho kubantu amagama abo abhaliswe ohlwini lwabake bahlukumeza izingane iNational Register for Sex Offenders noma kwi-National Child Protection Register. Ukuba nomlando wokulahlwa amacala kuyakuvimba kwezinye izindawo ungawutholi umsebenzi ngenxa yalo mlando.
ISIKHWAMA esixhasa ngemali yokufunda ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme iNational Students' Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS), sixwayise ngabaqola abasuke befuna usizo babafune imali ukuthi akumele bakhiphe ngisho isenti.Abalesi sikhwama bathe yonke into ethinta uxhaso imahhala ayikhokhelwa, ngakho akumele kubekhona ozokhokhelwa noma kungathiwa uqashwe yilesi sikhwama.I-NSFAS ithe ilwa nenkohlakalo ukuze kuboshwe abenzi benkohlakalo. Isitatimende esikhishwe nguMnuz Anele Ntswayi, wezokuxhumana kulesi sikhwama, sixwayise abafaka izicelo ukuthi akumele bakhokhe ukuze bathole usizo."Asikho isisebenzi okumele sikhokhelwe ukuze sisize abafaka izicelo. Kanjalo akukho mali okumele ikhokhelwe labo abathi bazosiza ekutheni bakubhekele ukuthi kuhamba kanjani ngesicelo osifakile," usho kanje.Uthe abafake izicelo akumele banike omunye ulwazi lwabo okubalwa namalungu e-SRC."Noma kungathiwa umuntu ukwi-SRC, akumele umnike ulwazi lwakho ngoba ethi uzokusiza. Unganiki ngisho uzakwenu ofunda naye, kungaba nabafundisayo." Uxwayise abafundi ukuthi bangayi kuma-website azenza iNSFAS azodinga ukuthi bafake ulwazi lwabo."Uma kukhona okusolisayo, bika emaphoyiseni noma ulethe ulwazi ophikweni olulwa nenkohlakalo usebenzise i-email ethi:[email protected]. Ulwazi lwakho lugcine luyimfihlo ngaso sonke isikhathi ukuze silwe nenkohlakalo."Kwenzeka lokhu nje inqwaba yabafundi ilinde izimpendulo ngezithinta uxhaso lwangonyaka ozayo. Muva nje ibamba lesikhulu esiphezulu salesi sikhwama uMnuz Waseem Carrim, saveza ePhalamende ukuthi bahlela ukumemezela abathole uxhaso kusuka ngoDisemba 15, 2025. Wabalula ukuthi basebenzisana nophiko oluphenya inkohlakalo i-Special Investigating Unit (SIU), ezintweni ezithinta inkohlakalo.Wathi kunemali esiqalile ukubuyiselwa kulesi sikhwama emva kophenyo lwalolu phiko.Okunye akusho ngukuthi bamatasa bafuna kubuyiswe imali ekweletwa abathola uxhaso, asebesebenza abagoloza ukukhokha.
UNKSZ Nonkululeko Shibula (34) waKwaNgoni, KwaMaphumulo, ungusonhlalakahle onikele ngempilo yakhe ekusizeni ngokomphefumulo abazali abanganywe wusizi lokushonelwa abantwana ngaphambi kokuba bazalwe. Le ntokazi ingene kulo msebenzi esiwuthatha njengobizo ngemuva kokuphuphunyelwa yisisu ngenkathi yenza izifundo zeVisual Arts eDurban University of Technology (DUT) ngo-2010. UNksz Shibula uthe into eyamehlela yamshiya ehlukumeze kakhulu emphefumulweni."Kwakubuhlungu kakhulu ukulahlekelwa wumntwana engakazalwa ngisho ukuzalwa, ngase ngibona ukuthi ngidinga usizo, ukwesekwa, nokuthi ngazi ukuthi angingedwa. Kusukela lapho ngazimisela ukusiza abanye abazali abahlangabezana nalesi simo,” kusho uNksz Shibula.Uthe usebenze isikhathi eside endaweni yokweseka abesifazane abakhulelwe ebizwa nge-Doula Pregnancy Support, okuyilapho aqala khona ukufaka isandla ekunikezeni ukwelulekwa ngokomqondo, ukukhipha izipho ezincane zokududuza, nezinsiza ebantwini abalahlekelwe yizingane zabo ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa noma bebelethe ngaphambi kwesikhathi. Ngonyaka odlule, uNksz Shibula ubekwabamele iNingizimu Afrika engqungqutheleni iCouncil of International Neonatal Nurses (COINN) ebiseZambia, njengelungu lebhodi le-International Stillbirth Alliance (ISA). Kule ngqungquthela wethule inkulumo enika ugqozi lokuthi i-Afrika akufanele ihlushwe yizinto ezinjengokulahlekelwa yizingane nokwesekwa kwemindeni ngemuva kokulahlekelwa yingane."Ngifunde ukuthi i-Afrika isendaweni yesibili emhlabeni ngemuva kweNdiya uma kukhulunywa ngokulahlekelwa yizingane ezingakazalwa noma ezizalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi. Lokhu kwangishaya enhliziyweni, ngathatha isinqumo sokwenza konke okusemandleni ami ukusiza,” kuchaza yena.Ngaphezu kwalokho, uNksz Shibula uzamile ukwethula izinguquko ezinhlelweni zezibhedlela, ikakhulu umthetho othi abesifazane abaya kobeletha bavunyelwe ukuba nabantu abaseduze nabo ababathembayo.Lesi siphakamiso samukelwe okokuqala yiSt Mary’s Hospital eKwaZulu-Natal, lapho ebambisene kahle kakhulu nabasebenzi bakhona abemesekayo."Ukubambisana neSt Mary’s kungisize kakhulu. Abasebenzi bakhona basamukela ngezandla ezifudumele isicelo sami sokubasiza. Ngiyabonga kakhulu ngokuthi bayakwazi ukulalela izidingo zabazali.” Ngaphezu kwemisebenzi yakhe emihle, uNksz Shibula uthe usebhekene nenkinga enkulu yokuntuleka kwezinsiza futhi usesemkhankasweni wokufuna uxhaso ukuze aqhubeke nokuphakamisa izwi labaphuphunyelwe yizisu umhlaba wonke. Iningi labantu abasebenzisana naye basebenza ngaphansi kwenhlangano yakhe engenzi nzuzo, uMzanyana ezinze eChatsworth, futhi unesifiso sokuthi lokhu kwandiswe emiphakathini eminingi. Omunye umqansa abhekene nawo wukuthi ezibhedlela eziningi nezikhungo zezempilo azikabazisi abasebenzi ngokuphelele ngohlelo lwakhe, okwenza ukuthi uma kuvele usizi lokulahlekelwa ingane, ingathunyelwa imininingwane eqondile kuye noma enhlanganweni yakhe.Ugcizelele ukuthi kufanele kube nokuhlukaniswa kwabantu abadinga ukwelulakwa ngokomqondo ezibhedlela. Uthe lokhu kungasiza ukuthi banakekelwe ngokuyikho futhi nangendlela ehloniphekile.Uphinde wagcizelela ukuthi yize ezinye izinkolo noma amasiko zikholelwa ukuthi ukuzila noma ukukhumbula ingane engazalwanga kungaholela ekulahlekelweni futhi, wathi lokhu akulona iqiniso."Lokho kudala ukwesaba okungekho okungenasidingo. Ukuzila kuyingxenye yokuphila. Akufanele sizisole noma sizifihle uma sivelelwe yizinkinga." Uqhube ngokuthi ubhala incwadi futhi uzokuba neqophamlando mayelana nomsebenzi wakhe ukuze izizukulwane ezizayo zifunde."Ngifisa ukuthola uxhaso oluthe xaxa ukuze ngikwazi ukuqhubeka nomsebenzi. Kubi ukubona abantu beswele usizo ngoba singekho lapho ngesikhathi esifanele.”

LUZOQASHWA ngelokhozi uphiko olukhipha amathenda eMnyangweni wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, kuphinde kuqondiswe ubugwegwe abasebenzi abathinteka enkohlakalweni kaR2.5 million, yethenda yamathoyilethi angomahamba nendlwana asebenzisa amakhemikhali ayiswa ezikoleni.Lokhu kulandela umbiko wohlaka oluphenya inkohlakalo kuhulumeni, iSpecial Investigating Unit (SIU), oluyalele uMphathishwa walo mnyango esifundazweni, uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka, ukuthi aqondise ubugwegwe abasebenzi abangu-16, abathinteka ekukhishweni kwale thenda kungalandelwanga imugudu efanele.UHlomuka uthe bayazamukela iziphakamiso ze-SIU ngodaba lwale thenda eyakhishwa abasebenzi basesifundeni iPinetown. Uthe bayazamukela zonke izinhlelo zokuvundulula inkohlakalo emnyangweni nokuvikela imali yomphakathi."Ngiyalele inhloko yomnyango ukuthi iqinisekise ukuthi okushiwo yi-SIU kuyenzeka ngaphandle kokubambezeleka. Lokhu kuzokwenzeka kulandelwa umthetho, kanti siyaweseka umsebenzi we-SIU nokuthi kubuyiswe yonke imali eyalahleka," usho kanje.Uthe kuzoqashwa ngelokhozi ukusebenza kohlaka olukhipha amathenda, kuqiniswe uhlelo lokucwaninga amabhuku lwangaphakathi kuphinde kuqeqeshwe abasebenzi ukuze baqonde okulindeleke kubona."Ngikhiphe umyalelo wokuthi njalo ngekota ngithole umbiko ngophenyo olwenziwa yi-SIU emnyangweni. Ngeke siyibekezelele inkohlakalo noma ubudedengu obuzobeka engcupheni imali yomphakathi engabe iphucula izinsiza iphinde ifinyelele ezikoleni." I-SIU iyalele ukuthi imali yenzalo eyenziwe inkampani eyayithole le thenda, ibuyiselwe emnyangweni.Khonamanjalo, iqembu i-DA esifundazweni liwamukele umbiko we-SIU nomyalelo onikwe uHlomuka ngalaba basebenzi.UMnuz Sakhile Mngadi okhulumela i-DA kwezemfundo esifundazweni, uthe bakhathazekile ukuthi inkampani eyayithole le thenda, yabiza inzalo engaphezu kuka-100%.Uthe bayalwamukela uphenyo lwe-SIU wathi umthetho kumele uthathe indawo yawo."Sinxusa inhloko yomnyango ukuthi iqondise ubugwegwe abathintekayo ngaphandle kokusaba futhi kusheshiswe uhlelo. Uma kunesidingo abamiswe kusaqhubeka isigcawu sangaphakathi. Akubuyiswe nemali eyasebenza kungafanele, bese kuboshwa abantu." Uthe abafundi bayaqhubeka nokuthwala kanzima ngenxa yokugqoza kwengqalasizinda ezikoleni."Abafundi abaningi bafundela emakilasini angaphephile ekubeni izigidi zisetshenziswa ngendlela engafanele. Lokhu kufana nokukhaphela izingane nabakhokhi bentela abalindele lukhulu kuhulumeni," usho kanje.Uthe bazoluqapha ngelokhozi uhlelo lokuqondiswa ubugwegwe kwabathintekayo."Asifuni kube nokubambezeleka ekutheni lolu daba lufinyelele esiphethweni. Sizofaka ingcindezi nangasohlangothini lwesiShayamthetho. Sifuna bathathelwe izinyathelo abeba imali yezemfundo."
Sekuqalwe uphenyo ngokuputshuka kwamaphepha akwa-matric, afaka iphepha lesiNgisi, iMaths kanjalo nelePhysical Science. KUSHAQWE inqwaba yempahla engumbombayi ebishushumbiswa ingeniswa emingceleni yakuleli, kuyona okukhona no-cream bokukhanyisa isikhumba, amaphilisi okuvikela ukukhulelwa, okokuhlola ukukhulelwa, izidakamizwa nezinye izinto.Lokhu kuvezwe wuphiko oluqapha imingcele iBorder Management Authority (BMA), exwayise ngokuthi bazobhekana nomthetho abazozama ukungena kuleli ngokungemthetho. Kuxwayiswe nabazozama ukwenza ubugebengu, ukuthi amahlathi aphelile kubona. Isikhulu salolu phiko uDkt Michael Masiapato, sithe ezokuphepha ziqine kakhulu emingceleni njengoba bebambe inqwaba yezinto ezingombombayi, ebezingeniswa kuleli. Ubale nezingubo zokugqoka kanjalo nezimoto ezebiwe. Uthe kuboshwe nabantu abangu-8 000, abebezama ukungena kuleli ngokungemthetho besuka emazweni akhele elakuleli. "Konke lokhu kwenzeke ekoteni yesibili yalo nyaka. Ngale ndlela sizama ukuxwayisa abazothatha amashansi ukuthi sizobe singasineki. Izobe iqashwe ngelokhozi yonke imingcele engenela kuleli. Sikhathazekile ngabavela kwamanye amazwe abazama ukungena kuleli ngokungemthetho," usho kanje ekhuluma esithangamini sabezindaba izolo ePitoli, ngezinhlelo zalolu phiko ngamaholidi. Uthe inqwaba yababoshiwe bezama ukufohla bebeqhamuka eLesotho."Balandelwa abavela eMozambique kanjalo nabaseZimbabwe. Sisebenzisana nanophiko iNational Joint Operations and Intelligence Structures (NATJOINTS)kanjalo nolwezifundazwe iprovincial joint operations (PROVJOINTS) njengoba kungamaholidi." Uthe abasuke bezama ukuthatha amashansi bangene ngokufohla kuleli, bande e-OR Tambo International Airport, Beit Bridge, Lebombo, Ficksburg, Maseru Bridge, Cape Town International Airport, Oshoek, naseBotswana. Uthe bazobe besebenzisa ubuchwepheshe emigceleni okubalwa ama-drones, kanjalo namakhamera asemzimbeni azobe efakwe abasebenzi."Ngamakhamera sihlose ukubona konke okwenzekayo. Kuzobe kuvela bamukela ama-passports baphinde bawabuyisele emuva ukuze kungangeni abantu okungafanele ukuthi babe kuleli." Ubalule nokuthi balindele ukuthi bande abavakashi abazoza kuleli."Silindele ukuthi bande abazovakashela kuleli ngalesi sikhathi. Ngonyaka mali u-2023/2024, emigceleni yethu kwaba nabantu abangu-5 million okuhlanganisa abangu-78% abangabokufika nabangu-22% bakuleli abadlule emingceleni. Ngonyaka mali u-2024/2025, bangu-4.5 million abantu abadlule emingceleni. Ekoteni yesibili yonyaka sinyuke kakhulu isibalo sabadlule emingceleni yakuleli njengoba bengu-9.2 million ngenxa yemicimbi ebikuleli okubalwa nomhlangano weG20." Uthe kulo nyaka balindele ukuthi sinyuke kakhulu isibalo sabazodlula emingceleni."Bazohlolwa yithimba lezempilo abazongena emingceleni yakuleli. Kuzobhekwa kakhulu nabazama ukungena nezidakamizwa, izimoto ezebiwe nabahaqwe yizifo ezithathelanayo okubalwa nabanomkhuhlane."
NgoLwesibili amaphoyisa aKwaZulu-Natal abophe abasolwa abahlanu abaneminyaka ephakathi kuka-34 no-70 ubudala ngokutholakala nezibhamu nezinhlamvu okungekho emthethweni.Laba baboshwe ngesikhathi kunemikhankaso ebiqhutshwa eMelmoth naseNkandla.Umkhankaso wobunhloli ubuqhutshwa ngamaphoyisa oLundi Public Order Policing (POP) endaweni yaseThubalethu, eMelmoth. Lokhu kuze ngemuva kokuba kuqoqwe ulwazi ngabantu ababili okusolwa ukuthi banezibhamu ezingekho emthethweni.Ithimba lamaphoyisa linikele emzini oseThubalethu lapho lithe lisesha lathola isibhamu sikhishiwe izinombolo. Umsolwa oneminyaka engu-35 ubudala, ongowokufika kuleli nobesendlini, akakwazanga ukuveza izincwadi ezimvumela ukuthi abe nalesi sibhamu.Ube eseboshwa wabekwa icala lokutholakala nesibhamu esingekho emthethweni.Amaphoyisa aqhubekele emzini olandelayo lapho ebophe khona umsolwa oneminyaka engu-34 ubudala ngemuva kokutholakala kuye izibhamu ezimbili, esinye sazo sinemiphongolo emibili. Zonke izibhamu ezitholiwe zizohlolwa ukuze kutholakale ukuthi azizange zisetshenziswe yini ekwenzeni noma yibuphi ubugebengu.

UMHOLI webandla lamaZayoni Isiqalo Sokuthula KwamaKhrestu Church of God in Zion, uMbhishobhi Mbongiseleni Clifford Mpungose nowakwakhe uMbhishobhikazi Monica Velisiwe Mpungose baphosele abazalwane ababaholayo inselelo yokuthi babumbane ukusiza ukuze umsebenzi webandla labo uye phambili futhi ungathiywa yilutho.Lokho kwenzeke enkonzweni yokubagcoba ngokusemthethweni ukuba ngabaholi baleli bandla ngokusemthethweni ebiseMbuyiselo High, eZiyendane, eNdulinde, eMandeni, enyakatho yeKwaZulu-Natal ngoMgqibelo ebusuku.Inkonzo yokubagcoba ukuba bahole leli bandla eselineminyaka ewu-19 lasungulwa beyenganyelwe wu-Archibishop Gladys Sthembile Mhlongo; kanti futhi kuyona bekubuthene abazalwane abangaphezu kuka-150 bamagatsha amathathu aleli bandla okungelaseNtuzuma kwa-E, elaseNewtown A nelakhona eNdulinde - lapho ibandla lidabuka khona. Engxoxweni ekhethekile neSolezwe Ngempelasonto emva kokugcotshwa, uMbhishobhi uMpungose uthe kumthokozisile ukuthi kuze kufike kulesi sigaba lapho esenikwe khona ngokusemthethweni amandla negunya lokuqhuba umsebenzi kaNkulunkulu, akholwa wukuthi kuzolisiza ibandla. "Into engiyifisa kakhulu wukuthi umsebenzi kaNkulunkulu uqhubeke ngendlela efanele, futhi ngiphosela abazalwane inselelo yokuthi baqhubeke nokubambisana futhi babumbane kunoma yini esihlanganela ukuyenza ukusiza ukuthi zingabi bikho izinselelo ezizohlakaza ibandla. "Okunye engifisa ukuthi siqhubeke sikwenze wukubeka eqhulwini umsebenzi kaNkulunkulu, nokukhulisa ibandla linabele ezindaweni eziningi ezweni lonke, bese futhi siba nobuntu nothando lukaKristu okuzosisiza ukufeza inhloso yakhe," kulanda uMbhishobhi. U-Archbishop Mhlongo uthe lokhu kugcotshwa kuwuphawu lokuthi laba baholi sebenegunya eliphelele lokuqhuba umsebenzi kaNkulunkulu, owokuphatha ibandla, bakhulekele abantu abagulayo ngethemba lokuthi basinde, futhi babuyise ithemba kwabadangele. "Ngibafisela ukuthi baqhubeke bahole ibandla ngeqiniso nangobuqotho, futhi babambe iqhaza elibonakalayo lokulikhulisa nokuthi bakwazi ukupheka abanye abaholi abazohamba ezinyathelweni zabo kusuka manjekuze kube sekugcineni," kusho u-Archibishop Mhlongo.

Ngokusho koMkhandlu, lezi zimoto ziboshwe ngamaphoyisa e-EMPD edolobheni lonke ngamacala ahlukene futhi azilandwa naphezu kwemizamo yawo yokuxhumana nabanikazi. Uhlu lwezimoto eziboshiwe lumi ku-173 futhi luhlanganisa izimoto, izithuthuthu, izimoto ezishile, ama-trailer namakharavani. Esitatimendeni esikhishwe ngoLwesibili, iDolobha lithe uma ufuna imoto, abanikazi noma abaqoqi abagunyaziwe kumele banikeze ubufakazi bobunikazi, okuhlanganisa nezincwadi zokubhaliswa kwemoto, umazisi womnikazi noma oqoqayo, kanye nesithombe esisemthethweni. Umnikazi noma umqoqi kumele akhokhe imali esele yokuvala, ukudonsa, ukugcinwa, kanye nezindleko zokuphathwa kwempahla.
