KUCISHE kwavalwa ngehlahla emndenini wakwaKhanyile eJokweni, eNkandla, kudutshulwa inqwaba esigamekweni esenzeke ehostela iSaulsville, ePitoli, ngoMgqibelo.Kulesi sigameko umndeni wakwaKhanyile ushonelwe yizihlobo ezintathu ezisencane, kwalimala kanzima abadala abayisithupha. Ezihlotsheni zalo mndeni ezishonile, kukhona intombazane u-Elihle Khanyile (16), umfana uBonga Khanyile (15) nomfana oneminyaka emithathu igama lakhe elingatholakalanga. Isihlobo, uNksz Nikeziwe Manqele, sithe lapho okwenzeke khona isigameko bekuhlala izihlobo zakhe, esisodwa sibuye sidayisele utshwala ngaphakathi."Yikho bekuhlangenwe khona, abanye bephuza, kuphinde kube khona nezingane ngoba bezihlala khona nazo,” kusho uNksz Manqele.Uthe ngokuthola kwabo esihlotsheni obekuyindawo yaso le okwenzeke kuyo isigameko, abanaso isiqiniseko sokuthi bebebangaki abahlaseli njengoba abanye bephelele lapho obekukhona khona abantu abaningi, kwathi oyedwa wadlulela ekamelweni. "Lo odlulele ekamelweni wuye odubule udadewethu ongumnikazi wendawo ngoba bese elele embhedeni. Uphinde wadubula kwafa izingane ebezicashe ngaphansi kombhede,” kusho uNksz Manqele.Uthe u-Elihle noBonga, umsolwa ubacinge khona ngaphansi kombhede lapho ebebethi bazama ukucasha khona."Oyedwa wabo kuthe ethi uzama ukudonsela ingane (3) ngaphansi kombhede, lona wesilisa wabuza ukuthi yini ayidonsela yona, wavele wayidubula nayo,” kusho uNksz Manqele. Uthe uma ebalandisa udadewabo uthe yena uvuswe wukuqhuma kwezibhamu obekwenzeka egunjini obekuphuzelwa kulo, wasukuma wahlala ngesinqe."Yilapho okungene khona lona wesilisa wathi bayaxolisa kahle hle abafuni bona, esho edubula,” usho kanje.Uthe udadewabo uze wambuza owesilisa ukuthi uma engafuni bona pho kungani eqhubeka ebadubula nokho kuthiwa akazange esaphendula, uvele waqhubeka nokudubula. Uthe njengoba bengabokudabuka eNkandla, bonke baseGauteng ngokwamatoho ngoba abazali abasekho. Uqhube wathi bazokwehla baye khona njengoba umngcwabo uzobanjelwa khona eNkandla. Uthe namanje basadidekile ukuthi yini izihlobo zakhe ezihlaselelwe yona njengoba abasolwa bengazange bachaze lutho.Uthe nodadewabo onendawo yokuphuza uveze ukuthi azikho izitha azaziyo ebezingafuna ukumcekela phansi ngalolu hlobo. Uthe uzwakalise eyokuthi uma ephuma esibhedlela, angahle athuthe unomphelo, abhekise amabombo ekhaya eNkandla. Uphinde waveza nokuthi bamvulele icala nomnikazi wendawo njengoba ebedayisa utshwala ngaphandle kwemvume. "Sisaphenya imbangela yesehlo, kukhona esikusolayo ukuthi kungahle kube yikho okuholele esigamekweni kodwa ezobunhloli zisaqoqa yonke imininingwane,” kusho uMasemola, othe bazobabamba abasolwa esikhathini esifishane. IYASHUBA ingxabano phakathi komsakazi woKhozi FM, uZimiphi "Zimdollar" Biyela nentokazi abanga nayo amakhasimende, uNombuso (isibongo esingatholakalanga). Ekuqaleni kwaleli sonto, kuke kwashoda ozogadla phakathi kukaZimdollar noNombuso ngesikhathi behlaselana ebhilidini elisenkabeni yeTheku, lapho bedayisela khona imikhiqozo ehlukene.Indaba yaqala ngesikhathi uZimdollar edalula ukuthi uNombuso umphuca amakhasimende futhi uzibiza ngaye kuwo. NgoMsombuluko, uZimdollar uvele ezinkundleni zokuxhumana exabana noNombuso, ethi ufuna abantu bambone umuntu omphuca amakhasimende. Ubebuza uNombuso ukuthi kungani ezenza yena ekubeni emubi?UZimdollar uthe uNombuso usindele ukuthi ungumsakazi woKhozi, ukube ubengesiye ubezombhonya kanzima, wathi uNombuso uzenza yena kangangoba useze agqoke izingubo ezifana nezakhe.Eziphendulela uNombuso, uthe benoZimdollar babanga amakhasimende.Uchaze uZimdollar njengomuntu onomona ngenxa yempumelelo yakhe. Uthe yena waqala ukudayisa ngo-2013, ekubeni uZimdollar eqale ngo-2024. Ubuze ukuthi wayekuphi uZimdollar yena ethenga izimoto nemizi? UNombuso uthe uZimdollar owamfica edayisa kangangoba waze wabika uZimdollar kumasitende."Waze watshela umasitende ukuthi yena uzohamba kuleli bhilidi ngoJanuwari 2026."UNombuso uthe akunamakhasimende awantshontsha kuZimdollar kodwa wuZimdollar ohlulwa ukumelana nenselelo ngoba amakhasimende athenga kuZimdollar, abuye athenge nemikhiqizo yakhe. "Lo sisi othi ngintshontsha amakhasiemdne akhe uyahlukumeza. Uhlezi njalo efuna sonke sizwe ngaye."UNombuso uthe uZimdollar wake wamsabisa, wathi ngamanga ukuthi uzenza uZimdollar njengoba yena kade aqala ukuswenka ngoba uyintokazi eyiqhathanzipho.UNombuso uthe konke okwenziwa wuZimdollar kuye uhlale ebatshela abaphathi bebhilidi ngakho ngoba akusiye obiza amakhasimende kaZimdollar kodwa azizela wona.
BATHENJISWE ukuthi kuzoshaya uKhisimusi, sebekhokhelwe abamakela u-matric KwaZulu-Natal.Lokhu kuqinisekiswe yisikhulu esibhekele izivivinyo eMnyangweni wezeMfundo eKZN, uDkt Ray Penniston, ngesikhathi ehambele izikhungo okumakelwa kuzona u-matric.UPenniston uthembise laba basebenzi abadube amaholidi, bayomaka ezikhungweni ezingu-32 ezisabalele isifundazwe, ukuthi kuzothi kushaya uKhisimusi babe sebekhokhelwe."Abamakayo bazokhokhelwa ngoDisemba 23, 2025," usho kanje. NoMqondisi jikelele eMnyangweni weweMfundo kazwelonke, uMnuz Mathanzima Mweli, obehambele kulezi zikhungo esifundazweni, ubonge abamakayo abadele yonke into basabela ekhweleni lokuyomakela u-matric.Uthe benza umsebenzi obaluleke kakhulu esizweni njengoba imiphumela yaleli banga ilindwe ngabomvu ngonyaka ozayo."Sibonga ukuthi nishiye yonke into eniyithandayo, nazosebenza umsebenzi wesizwe wokumakela abafundi. Ibambeni kuze kube sekugcineni," usho kanje. Umnyango esifundazweni ubhekene nezinselelo zemali kanti kuhlale kubanjwe umoya ngokukhokhelwa ngesikhathi kwabamakela leli banga ngenxa yokuthi umnyango uhluleka ukukhokhela osonkontileka ngesikhathi.Phakathi kwabantu abangakhokhelwa ngesikhathi inkampani esabalalisa i-stationery nezincwadi ezikoleni zesifundazwe iNdabase. Lo mnyango awunayo imali yokuthenga izincwadi zangonyaka ozayo, usathenge kuphela i-stationery. Bangu-179 751 abafundi ababhale ngokugcwele u-matric esifundazweni, abangu-16,148 babhale ngasese. Babalelwa ku-7 889 abamakayo kanti lo msebenzi kulindeleke ukuthi uphothulwe kuleli sonto.Phambilini uMphathiswa wezeMfundo, uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka, wayethembisile ukuthi bazokhokelwa ngesikhathi abamakayo.Waveza ukuthi basebenzisana noMnyango kaMgcinimafa esifundazweni, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bayakhokhelwa ngaphandle kokubambezeleka.Izikhulu zomnyango zihlale zihlaba ikhwelo lokuthi kwengezwe isabelomali ukuze umnyango ukwazi ukusebenza ngendlela njengoba usengcupheni yokuguqa ngamadolo ngenxa yokwehliswa kwesabelomali.

ABAPHATHI besitolo sakwaCheckrite, bathi babhekelela ukusiza kakhulu umphakathi njengoba belokhu beqhubekile nokuvula amagatsha ezitolo emadolobheni ahlukene kuleli.Lokhu bakusho ngeledlule bevula igatsha labo lesi-93 eGingindlovu.Omunye wabaphathi, uMnuz Mohammed Ameen, uthe kuyabajabulisa ukuthi balokhu beqhubekile nokusiza emiphakathini ehlukene kuleli okungagcini nje ngokuthi bayilethele ukudla okusezingeni kodwa bavula amathuba emisebenzi."Wonke umsebenzi ombona lapha, owakhona lapha eGingindlovu. Akekho oqhamuka kude noma esithi sisuke naye kwenye indawo ukuze azosebenza lapha. Sifike safuna abantu khona lapha eduzane sabaqeqesha, base bethola umsebenzi. Kuyasijabulisa ukuqhubeka nokuvula izitolo zalolu hlobo ezindaweni ezihlukene. Asimile sibheke phambili njengoba sihlela ukuya nakwamanye amadolobha, indlela intsha ebhekene nezinselelo ngayo sifuna ukukushintsha lokho," kusho u-Ameen. UNkk Queen Xulu oyiMeya yaseMlalazi, uthe ujabula nabantu baseGingindlovu ngokuthi bavulelwe isitolo salolu hlobo kubo esisezingeni eliphezulu futhi elizosiza imindeni eminingi ukuxosha ikati eziko."Nawe uyabona ukuthi isitolo esihle esihlanzekile futhi nokudla okukhona phakathi kuyabukeka, ngakho lokho thina njengabantu esibhekelele umphakathi kuyasijabulisa. Okunye okusijabulisayo ukuthi intsha iyona eqashwe kakhulu uma kuziwa emathubeni omsebenzi, siyabonga kubaphathi balesi sitolo," kusho uNkk Xulu.Kulo mcimbi umphakathi ubusuvive ngezinqola phandle ufuna ukungena bazitapele ukudla okuhlukene njengoba bekunendali enkulu.
KUKHALWA ngabazishaya indiva izexwayiso ezisuke zikhishwe abesimo sezulu, kumuka owesifazane ngesikhathi kunezikhukhula eFrance, eNdumeni, ngaseDundee, ngoMgqibelo.Kulesi sigameko okuthiwa senzeke sekuhwalala, kumuke owesifazane waselokishini laseMzomusha, engena esitamukokweni.Lona wesifazane, ongeke adalulwe njengoba umndeni wakhe ungakatholakali, kuthiwa wehlelwe yilo mshophi ngesikhathi ebuya kophuza amanzi amponjwana nabangani bakhe endaweni. Ngokusho kwekhansela likaMasipala waseNdumeni, uMnuz Xolani Msezana, lona wesifazane ubehamba nabangani bakhe, sekugodukwa ngesikhathi kwenzeka isigameko.Uveze ukuthi abebehamba nalona wesifazane babatshele ukuthi bebelokhu bemkhuza, ethi yena ufuna ukubhukuda."Kuthiwa bebeze bambambe, kodwa abalume,” kusho uMsezana othe okubuhlungu ukuthi akasekho manje emhlabeni, umndeni usuzoba sezinhlungwini zokudlulelwa othandiweyo. Uthe kuyabakhathaza ukuthi abantu bavame ukungazinaki izexwayiso ezikhishwa uMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu. "Asizilalele izexwayiso ezikhishwa yihhovisi likaMphathiswa uMfundisi Thulasizwe Buthelezi. Uma ubona izulu lijika, phuthuma ngasekhaya. Uma lungekho uhambo oluphoqayo, hlala phansi, ungaze uvelelwe yinkinga,” kusho uMsezana.Uthe bayakhuza bengabaholi ukuthi abantu abalalele ngoba izexwayiso ezikhishwayo azize zingashaya eceleni. Uthe kusaqhubeka ukucingwa kwalona wesifazane.Uveze ukuthi bathole ukuthi ngesikhathi liqala lihloma izilu, lona wesifazane ubezihlalele endaweni yokucima ukoma, bephuza. Uthe bathole ukuthi baze bahamba sekuntambama kakhulu njengoba ehlelwe yisigameko ngabo-18.30 ntambama.Uthe abebehamba naye bathi abazi ukuthi ushelele manini wangena esitamukokweni, kwase kuba ukumuka kwakhe njalo. Uthe ngale kwalesi sigameko ukhona omunye umonakalo owenzekile njengoba kulimale ingqalasizinda yemigwaqo kwaphinde kwadilika izindlu kwamanye ama-ward. Khonamanjalo, isitatimende esikhishwe umnyango siveza ukuthi nakuMasipala waseMlalazi, umuntu ushaywe umbani wezulu maqede waphuthunyiswa esibhedlela. Uthe kulesi sigameko senzeke e-ward 8 kanti owehlelwe umshophi uthola usizo lwezemphilo kulandela ukuphuthunyiswa esibhedlela emva kwesigameko. Uthe ngale kwalesi sigameko, lo masipala unama-ward amathathu akhahlamezekile, kuwona ubale i-16, 21 kanjalo no-14. Uthe imvula ene kulo masipala ibiphelezelwa umoya kanjalo nokuduma kwezulu okukhulu. Uveze ukuthi sebethumele amathimba ezinhlekelele ukuba ayonikezela ngosizo ezindaweni esehlukene esifundazweni ezikhahlanyezwe yisimo sezulu esibi.Uthe ukucingwa kwalona wesifazane kuyaqhubeka kanti nohlelo lokukhucululwa kwendawo nakho kuyaqhubeka. Uphinde wanxusa izakhamizi ezakhele isifundawe ukuthi ziqaphele njengoba kulindeleke ukuthi zijwayele izimo zezulu ezifuze lesi kwazise intwasahlobo nehlobo zivame ukuba nenqwaba yemvula. "Imiphakathi ayizijwayeze ukuthi ibuke ulwazi olusuke lukhishiwe ngezixwayiso zesimo sezulu bese benza yonke into ngokuqaphela ukuhlenga izimpilo kanjalo nezakhiwo,” kusho uButhelezi.
UBENGAPHANDLE ngoshwele ecaleni lokubulala owesilisa okuthiwa ugwaze, wabulala abantu abayisihlanu eMalangeni, eMzinto, ngoMgqibelo, naye wase ezihenga.Kulesi sigameko kufe ngesihluku kuqala uNksz Nokwanda Mbili obeyisinqandamathe sikamsolwa, uMnuz Lungisani Shabane, kwase kubulawa omakhelwane abane besilisa abebethi bazozama ukulamula.Elandisa ngesigameko umshana kaNksz Mbili, uMnuz Talent Khumalo (18) uthe umsolwa, obevele ehlala egcekeni, ungene ngabo-8 ebuya ebanganini, wafica umufi e-ayina ijoyini yesonto njengoba ebelungiselela ukuya emvuselelweni yaseZayoni endaweni. "Uvele wavala umnyango ngaphakathi, wadonsa umalumekazi, wamgwaza, phambi kwendodakazi yakhe eneminyaka engu-11,” kusho uKhumalo.Uthe bezwe ngomufi esekhala ecela usizo, bathi bayozama ukuvula isicabha sangavuleka. Uveze ukuthi baphuthume bayobiza omakhelwane ukuthi bazolekelela, babuya esevulile, esala ukhasha olusondela noludlula ngakuye. "Yilapho okulimale khona laba abane, ebagwaza,” kusho uKhumalo, othe ababili babo bafele endaweni yesigameko, kwathi abanye kwabenela esibhedlela abaphuthunyiswe kuso, iScottburgh. Uveze ukuthi bese kuphele iminyaka emibili umalumekazi wabo ethandana nomsolwa, futhi ehlala nabo. Uthe ubeziphilisa ngokwakha izindlu, kuthi uma engenzi lutho, ahambe ayohlala nabangani bakhe, kuphuzwe njengoba kwenzekile ngosuku lwesigameko."Yena ubenalo udlame ngoba ubehlale emshaya. Mina nomfowethu (21) ubengasifuni ngoba ubethi uma ekwenza sikhona, sisukume sizame ukumvikela umalumekazi. Nayizolo umuntu abemfuna uthuli uye umfowethu, kwasho ukuthi ukwazile ukuphunyuka abaleke,” kusho uKhumalo. Ukuqinisekisile ukuthi umsolwa wake waboshwa phambilini."Noma besingazi ukuthi icala kwakungelani kodwa besazi ukuthi likhona icala ake aba nalo. Amaphoyisa abehlale efika ekhaya ezomsayinisa,” kusho uKhumalo.Ukuqinisekisile ukuthi umsolwa ugcine etholwa elenga esihlahleni esingekho kude nekhaya. IPhini leMeya kaMasipala uMdoni, uMnuz Phila Thabethe, lithe: "Kuthiwa lo mlisa wabulala umuntu ngakubo KwaQoloqolo. Waphuma wazohlala ngapha, njengoba esenza le nhlekelele."UThabethe uthe iyakhathaza eyabadedelwa ngoshwele ngoba kuvamise ukuthi baphinde benze amanye amacala adlulele. Uthembise ukuthi umasipala uzosifaka isandla ezinhlelweni zokufihla laba abadlule ngale nhlekelele.Kuze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela amaphoyisa engaphenduli ngesigameko.
KULULWE isikhathi sokusebenza emahhovisi oMnyango wezaseKhaya ukuze abantu bashaye ama-passport kanjalo nomazisi.Kusuka izolo kuze kube uDisemba 19, 2025, kululwe isikhathi sokuvalwa kwamahhovisi kusuka ngo-4 ntambama kuya ku-6 ntambama.NangoJanuwari ngonyaka ozayo lo mnyango uzophinde ulule isikhathi sokusebenza ukuze abafundi abalinde imiphumela ka-matric, benze omazisi. UNgqongqoshe wezaseKhaya, uDkt Leon Schreiber, uthe balule amahora okuvala, ukuze abavakashi bashaye ama-passport.Uthe bafuna ukwehlisa umthwalo wokugcwala emahhovisi njengoba kungamaholidi."Kusuka ngoJanuwari 5 kuya kuJanuwari 16, 2026, sizophinde silule isikhathi sokusebenza njengoba kuzovalwa ngo-6 ntambama. Sethemba ukuthi amahora okusebenza engeziwe azosiza kakhulu." Ugqugquzele abafuna ukushaya omazisi nama-passport ukuthi babekise isikhathi sokuza ngokohlelo olukhona iBranch Appointment Booking System (BABS). Bangaya kwi-website yomnyango ukubekisa izikhathi."Sizobamukela kodwa nabantu abazozifikela qathatha bengazange babekise izikhathi. Asifuni abantu bangabi nezimfanelo eziqondile uma befuna ukuvakashela kwamanye amazwe, yingakho silule isikhathi sokusebenza." Ubonge nabasebenzi abazinikele ngokusebenza isikhathi esengeziwe ngamaholidi. "Sicela abafaka izicelo zomazisi nama-passport ukuthi basheshe bakulande. Sinezindawo ezisiza kuphela abazolanda omazisi nama-passport. Sifuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola izinto zakhe ngesikhathi," usho kanje.Phambilini abalo mnyango bake bakhala ngokugqoza kokulandwa komazisi emahhovisi. Babekhala ngokuthi inqwaba yomazisi abaduvile abangalandiwe kanti babenxusa abantu ukuthi babalande.Sekuyinto ejwayelekile ukuthi umnyango ulule amahora okusebenza uma kunamaholidi njengoba ukwenza lokho noma kuzoba yiPhasika ukuze abantu bathole izimfanelo zabo.
UPHIKO oluphenya inkohlakalo kuhulumeni iSpecial Investigating Unit (SIU), luyalele uMphathiswa wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka, ukuthi aqale ngokushesha uhlelo lokuqondisa ubugwegwe, izisebenzi zomnyango ezithinteka ekukhishweni kwethenda ka-R2.5 million, yamathoyilethi angomahamba nendlwana ezikoleni.UHlomuka uyalelwe yiSpecial Tribunal ukuthi aqondise ubugwegwe lezi zisebenzi ezingu-16, Isolezwe elinemininingwane yazo.Okhulumela i-SIU, uMnuz Kaizer Kganyago, uthe bayasamukela isinqumo seTribunal (uphiko olungaphansi kwe-SIU olubhekana namacala asuke ephenywa yi-SIU), sokuthi kuthathelwe izinyathelo abasebenzi ngoba bese kunesikhathi kuphenywa. Uthe iTribunal iphinde yanquma nokuthi inkontileka eyanikwa inkampani ayigagule ngegama, ithathwa njengento engekho."Siyajabula ukuthi iTribunal, iyalele umuntu owengamele umnyango ukuthi aqinisekise ukuthi lo myalelo uyalandelwa. ITribunal iphinde yanquma ukuthi kushaqwe nenzuzo eyenziwe yile nkampani, eyithole ngale nkontileka. Inkampani iyalelwe nokuthi ilethe isitatimende sasebhange se-akhawunti ezinsukwini ezingu-30, ukuze imali ezobuyiswa iye eMnyangweni wezeMfundo," usho kanje.Uveze ukuthi baphenya ngamathoyilethi angu-72, asebenzisa amakhemikhali athengwa ngumnyango ngoJuni, 2020."Uphenyo lwathola ukuthi ithenda ka-R2.5 million, yanikwa inkampani kungalandelwanga uhlelo lwezokuncintisana. Lokhu kuwukuphula isigaba u-217 soMthethosisekelo, umthetho iPublic Finance Management kanjalo nemigomo ebekwe ngumnyango kaMgcinimafa." Uphenyo lwe-SIU lwathola ukuthi laba basebenzi abazange bayilandele imigomo ebekiwe ethinta ukuthengwa kwempahla."Uphenyo lwaphinde lwathola ukuthi inkampani yathintwa ukuthiwa ilethe okudingekayo ngaphambi kokuqokwa ngokusemthethweni. Yaphinde yanyusa amanani ngo-100 wamaphesenti. Le nkampani yafuna ukukhokhelwa ngezinto engazange izenze."Uthe bathola nokuthi inkontileka yalulwa ngaphandle kokulandela imigudu."Sizoqhubeka nokuphenya inkohlakalo eminyangweni kahulumeni ukuze sivikele imali yabakhokhi bentela. Umengameli wagunyaza ukuthi siphenye izinto ezithinta ukuthengwa kwama-PPE kanjalo nokuziphatha kwabasebenzi. Sinamandla okuthi siyise abathinteka enkohlakalweni enkantolo kanjalo nasophikweni lwezokushushisa iNational Prosecuting Authority."Kwenzeka lokhu nje lo mnyango uhlale ukhala ngokungabi nesabelomali esanele sokwenza izinhlelo ezehlukene. Uhluleka nawukubakhokhela ngesikhathi osonkontileka abanamathenda.
KUBHUNTSHE umhlangano wezinsuku ezintathu wesikhwama esigade umhlaba kaZulu, iNgonyama Trust, emva kokuvela kokuthi iSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini, esingusihlalo webhodi leNgonyama Trust, besingawubusisanga.Amakhosi, izinduna kanye nezikhulu zoMnyango wezoMhlaba kanye nokuThuthukiswa kweziNdawo zaseMakhaya ziwushiye phakathi umhlangano ngosuku lokuqala emva kokuba kuvele ukuthi iMbube ayizange yaziswe ngalo mhlangano obuseNkosi Albert Luthuli Convention Centre izolo.UNdunankulu kaZulu, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, uthe iMbube kanye noNgqongqoshe wezoMhlaba kanye nokuThuthukiswa kweziNdawo zaseMakhaya, uMnuz Mzwanele Nyhontso, bebengatshelwanga ngomhlangano wayizolo. Sekungangenwa kukhulunywe ngezindaba ezinkulu kangaka, kukhulunywe ngekusasa leNgonyama Trust, amakhosi engakaze anikezwe ithuba lokuba aphawule ukuthi athini ngalezi zinto ebezilokhu zivezwa yiNgonyama."UButhelezi uthe namanje abazi ukuthi ibhodi leNgonyama Trust liwuhlele kanjani umhlangano lingakhulumile neMbube."Ukube iSilo besihlonishwa njengekhanda leNgonyama Trust, ngabe kuxhunywane kahle, ngabe umoya wokuzwana ukhona, ngabe sizokhuluma izindaba ezithinta amakhosi ngendlela eya phambili. Manje sizokwakhela phezu kwamabibi."UButhelezi uthe uNyhontso uyalele zonke izisebenzi zomnyango wakhe ukuba ziwushiye umhlangano."Ngixhumene nongqongqoshe namhlanje ekuseni, sikwazile ukukhuluma imizuzu engamashumi amabili nambili. Ungqongqoshe uthe lo mhlangano olapha akawazi wabe esengicela ukuthi ngikusho uma sengethula amagama eSilo ukuthi yena lo mhlangano akawazi."UButhelezi uthe uNyhontso ufuna ukuqala uphenyo ngokusebenza kwebhodi.UButhelezi uthe uNyhontso uhlela ukuwanikeza ikhefu elikhethekile amalungu ebhodi uma sekuqale uphenyo oluzoholwa uqweqwe lommeli, u-Advocate Marumo Moerane."Kuyasijabulisa ukuthi uNyhontso uyazisukumela izikhalo zamakhosi. IMbube ibilokhu ikhala ngokusebenza kwebhodi kule minyaka emine eyedlule. Sinethemba lokuthi lolu phenyo luzokwelekelela ekutholeni iqiniso."Amakhosi nezinduna ebezihambele umhlangano ziwushiye, zathi ngeke ziqhubeke nokubamba umhlangano ongabusiswanga iMbube.Okhulumela ibhodi leNgonyama Trust, uMnuz Simphiwe Mxakaza, uthe basazohlanganisa amakhanda.
INTOKAZI yaseThekwini edle umhlanganiso emncintiswaneni wokumodela waminyaka yonke kaMiss KZN Queen 2025/26, uNelisa Khumalo, isithembise ukusebenzisa amandla alesi sicoco namathuba azoza naso ukushumayela ivangeli lokulwa nokufela ngaphakathi ebantwini abasha abasuke benezinkinga nokubahluphayo emoyeni. UNelisa (21), owenza izifundo zeBachelor of Psychology e-University of Johannesburg, usho njalo emva kokuhlabana ngalesi sicoco emcimbini womncintiswano obuse-Austerville Community Hall, eWentworth, eThekwini, ngoMgqibelo.Uthe okuhle nakuthokozela kakhulu ngalesi sicoco wukuthi sivele siqhakambisa ubumqoka bokukhuluma ngezinto nezimo eziphazamisa ukusebenza komqondo, kwaqondana nanokuthi kweyamene nezifundo zomkhakha awufundelayo kumanje. "Manje sengibheke ukusebenzisa igama namandla ale nhlangano yokumodela ukuthi ngihambele ezikoleni ezahlukene ezweni lonke, ukukhuthaza izingane ukuthi zingafeli ngaphakathi uma kukhona okungaziphethe kahle. "Lokho ngizokwenza ngoba ngikholwa wukuthi ukuqala ezinganeni zisencane, zifundiswe ngobumqoka bokwenza lokhu, kungayiqeda nya inkinga yabantu abagcina beguliswa noma bebulawa wukuthi kuningi okubahluphayo abakuvalele ngaphakathi,” kusho uNelisa othathe lesi sicoco kuNoluthando Mngadi, owasinqoba nyakenye.Eqhuba, uNelisa odle nesicoco sikaMiss Personality kuwo lo mncintiswano, udalule nokuthi lokhu uzokwenza nangenhlangano yakhe engenzinzuzo iHow To Heal with Nelisa, nayo evele inezinhlelo ezifana nezalo mncintiswano okungukukhuthaza abantu ukuba babhoboke ngokubahluphayo.Endaweni yesibili kulo mncintiswano kungene uNokuzithemba Duma, kwaba wuThandeka Ngobese kweyesithathu, Akhona Cele kweyesine noMendy Mbatha kweyesihlanu. Kwabaneminyaka engaphansi kuka-18 kunqobe uNaledi Shezi (16) noSinethmba Majozi kweyesibili.Ngale kwezicoco ezinkulu zosuku; kuklonyeliswe nabanye abenze kahle kokunye okuqondene nomncintiswano okukhona kukho uMiss Charity onqotshwe wuZusiphe Nhlupheko, Top Model enqotshwe wuSinethemba Majozi noMiss Ambassador onqotshwe wuMihla Tshazi. Lo mncintiswano waqalwa wuZime Msweli ngo-2018; kanti eminyakeni edlule sewake wanqotshwa yizintokazi esingabala kuzona oKholeka Dlamini, Philasanda Ngcamu, Sithabile Mnyandu no-Ayanda Thabethe oseke wagqama naku-Miss South Africa, ephuma isibili ngo-2022.
UMENGAMELI we-ANC, uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa, uthi azoziphumela wona amasela kule nhlangano njengoba beqale uhlelo lokuyakha kabusha.URamaphosa uthe izinhlelo zokwakha kabusha i-ANC zizobakhafulisa okolwandle labo abenza okungalungile.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ethula inkulumo yokuvula ingqungquthela iNational General Council (NGC), eGoli, izolo.URamaphosa uthe baqala umbhidlango wokwakha kabusha i-ANC ngoba nakhu befuna ukukhiphela ngaphandle labo abenza okungalungile.URamaphosa uthe umbhidlango usuqalile ukuthela izithelo, wathi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi i-ANC izosala nabaholi abaqotho kuphela."Njengoba sasho ngesikhathi kunomgubho weJanuwari 8 ukuthi kufanele sihehe abaholi abaqotho futhi abafuna ukusebenzela abantu. Saqhubeka sasho ukuthi kufanele siqinise imithetho elandelwayo uma ufuna ukujoyina i-ANC noma uma ufuna ukukhethelwa esikhundleni. Lokhu kuzosisiza ukuba sikhiphe amasela. I-ANC eyakhiwe kabusha izokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi bathathelwa izinyathelo abaphula imithetho. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi azoziphumela wona amasela, labo abathanda imali kanye nalabo abagovuza imibango yezikhundla."URamaphosa uthe bafuna ukulwa nenkohlakalo.Uthe unethemba lokuthi ikhomishini kanye nekomiti lasePhalamende eliphenya izinsolo ezenziwa uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, lizoqhamuka nezincomo ezizosiza ekulweni nenkohlakalo.URamaphosa uthe izithunywa kuzofanele ziqhamuke namasu okunqoba ukhetho lohulumeni basekhaya oluzayo.I-ANC yahlangana nezimbila zithutha okhethweni lukazwelonke lwangonyaka owedlule njengoba yathola u-40%.URamaphosa uthe abazange bakhankase ngokwanele."Uma sizokhuluma iqiniso asizange sikhankase ngokwanele ingakho abantu abaningi bengazange bavote. Abantu bakhetha ukuzihlalela emakhaya ngosuku lokhetho ngenxa yokuthi asiyanga kubona ukuyobanxenxa ukuba basivotele. Njengoba siya okhethweni oluzayo kufanele sizame ukuqinisa umkhankaso wethu. Kufanele sibuyele endleleni ebesenza ngayo yokungenela abantu emakhaya."URamaphosa uthe isinqumo sedlelandawonye iSACP, sokungenela ukhetho ngokuzimela, sizolimaza i-ANC okhethweni oluzayo."Izinketho zokuchibiyela zakamumva zikhombise ngokusobala ukuthi ukungenela kokhetho kwethu ngokwahlukana kusibeka engcupheni yokuhlulwa okhethweni njengoba lokhu kudida abantu."Ngaphandle kwalapho obekubanjelwe khona ingqungquthela abasebenzi be-ANC abangaholile bebenombhikisho.Abasebenzi abangaholile bathe basabela ukuthi bangase bebe noKhisimuzi omnyama.Ingqungquthela izophela ngoLwesine.
INkantolo yesiFunda eMtubatuba igwebe owesifazane oneminyaka engu-21 ubudala, iminyaka engu-12 ebhadla ejele kulandela ukulahlwa yicala lokubulala usana lwakhe olusanda kuzalwa.Lesi sigameko senzeka ngo-Agasti 2024 endaweni yaseHluhluwe. Lapho igweba lona wesifazane, inkantolo ichezuke ekumgwebeni udilikajele, ibheka iminyaka yakhe, kanye neqiniso lokuthi unengane encane.Umsolwa wayekhulelwe kanti ngosuku lwesigameko wayelokhu eya endlini yangasese yomgodi ngaphandle izikhathi eziningi. Kwesinye isikhathi unina wabona ukuthi (umsolwa) uyopha, wambuza ukuthi kwenzenjani. Nokho, wakuchitha ukukhathazeka kukamama wakhe. Unina wabe esehlela ukuthi aphuthunyiswe esibhedlela. Ngesikhathi ummangalelwa esesibhedlela amalungu omndeni ayesekhaya ezwa imisindo evela endlini yangasese, kodwa acabanga ukuthi ngesinye sezilwane ezifuyiwe ngaphandle.Isibhedlela sibe sesithinta umndeni kammangalelwa sabacela ukuthi ubheke endlini ukuze uthole ukuthi umsolwa uyishiye kuphi ingane, njengoba ingane ibingekho esibhedlela. Umndeni udilize ithoyilethi lomgodi wafica ingane ingaphakathi. Sekuqulwa icala, uMshushisi uI-National Prosecuting Authority (NPA) inethemba lokuthi isigwebo sizoxwayisa nabanye.

BAZOVUMELEKA kusuka ngoLwesine abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukufaka izicelo zokuthola amathikithi okuthamela imidlalo yeNdebe yoMhlaba eseMelika ngonyaka ozayo.IBafana ifakwe kuGroup A eqoqweni elineMexico engabanye bosokhaya bale midlalo eqala ngoJuni 11, 2026 okuyisikhathi esiyiminyaka engu-16 kusuka la mazwe adudulana kweyeNdebe yoMhlaba eyayikuleli ngo-2010.Ingxenye yokuqala yamathikithi angu-2 million iqale ukudayisa ngoSepthemba 10, kanti amanye alawo mathikithi awathengwanga okuzokwenza ukuba aphinde afakwe endalini. Njengoba amaqembu eseqhathiwe kulindeleke ukuthi ukuthengwa kwamathikithi kuhambe ngesivinini. Ngokwenkundla yamathikithi, iStubHub, kusele amathikithi angu-2% kuphela omdlalo wokuvula ozoba phakathi kweMexico neBafana. Ithikithi elibiza kancane kunawo wonke litholakala ngo-R73 623. Amanye amathikithi alapho kuzodlala khona iBafana e-Estadio Azteca eMexico City abiza u-R95 938.Kulindeleke ukuthi ishintshe le ntengo ithi "ukuluma" kancane uma sekusondele imidlalo.Kubalandeli abafuna izihlalo ezisendaweni ephambili enkundleni kufanele bakhokhe imali elinganiselwa ku-R1.3 million ngethikithi lilinye. Kepha nalapho kumele abasafuna la mathikithi basukumele phezulu njengoba ngokweStubHub kusele inkeshezana.Inkundla yamathikithi esemthethweni yeFifa izovulwa ngoDisemba 15.Njengawo wonke umuntu, abantu baseNingizimu Afrika basenalo ithuba lokuthola amathikithi azobahlalisa izindaweni ezibizayo enkundleni uma sekuvulwa futhi ukudayiswa kwawo.Njengoba iBafana izovula lo mqhudelwano kwenye yezinkundla ezinohlonze ebholeni, kuzokhuphuka ukufunwa kwamathikithi. Kubalandeli abafuna ukuzibonela mathupha umdlalo wokuvula, kumele baqinisekisike ukuthi ababuhuqi ubuthongo futhi bazimisele ngokufaka izandla zidephe emaphaketheni abo.
ABANGANI bakaDJ Warras ayefunda nabo esikoleni samaKhatholika, iNardine Convent, bamchaze njengomuntu owayeyisiqengqe kangangoba waze wahlabana ngo-A abathathu ezivivinyweni zika-matric. Lokhu kuvele ngesikhathi ithimba lakwaSABC lihambele endaweni uDJ Warras (40) akhulela kuyo iLakeside, eVryheid. Omunye wabangani bakhe, uMnuz Rene Baeta, uthe umazi kahle uWarras ngoba waqala naye emabangeni aphansi baze bafinyelela esikhungweni semfundo ephakeme futhi babekhonza ebandleni elilodwa. Uthe nakuba ayebuye abambe iqhaza kwezemidlalo kodwa imfundo yayingungqaphambili. "Sasenza konke okuhle okwenziwa yizingane. Kwakubamnandi ukuba naye, ekhonze amancoko nokuxoxa izindaba." URene uthe uWarras waphenduka iqhawe nesibani esihle entsheni yakule ndawo ngokuphazima kweso emuva kokusebenza njengomsakazi nomethuli wezinhlelo zethelevishini. Uthe okwakwenza uWarras abe yisibonelo esihle futhi abantu abaningi babukele kuye ukuthi akekho owayeyizitshela ukuthi endaweni enjengeLakeside kungaphuma usaziwayo ovelele njengoWarras. Yize umndeni wakhe bewusufudukele eGoli, kodwa uRene uthe uWarras ubebuya eVryheid ezobona izihlobo nabangani bakhe. URene uthe umkhumbula ngesiqubulo ayevame ukusisho uma esevalelisa ohlelweni lwethelevishini kwiSABC iLive Amp esithi "Take It Easy. And If It's Easy. Take It Home." Isolezwe libuye lathola ukuthi ukuthi uWarras ukhuliswe ngugogo nomkhulu wakhe eVryheid, ngenxa yokuthi uyise wamshiya emhlabeni ngo-1994. Wabulawa ngokudutshulwa ngenxa yokuthi wayeyisigebengu. Ekubeni unina wayesebenza ebhange thizeni. Ngenxa yokuthi unina wayengakunameli ukusebenza kukaWarras emkhakheni wezokungcebeleka, umufi wabe esenza izifundo zeB Com emkhakheni we-Investment Management e-University of Johannesburg ngoba efuna ukugcina esesebenza njengeStockbroker kodwa wahluleka esenza unyaka wesibili kulezi zifundo ngenxa yempilo yobumnandi ayeseyiqomile. Ukudabuka emapulazini wathi yikho okwenza wadidwa kalula wukhazikhazi beGoli, okuyinto unina eyamcasula kakhulu. Nakuba kunjalo, wayekunyanya ukuswenka ngesudi nothayi, asebenze endaweni eyodwa ngoba ethi lokho kwenza uhlale ugwilikisa omunye umuntu. Ngaphandle kokuba wuDJ, uWarras ubebuye abe nenkampani yonogada iJT VIP: Elite Guarding & VIP Protection Services. Eminye yemisebenzi emikhulu eke wayenza ukuqapha ekhonsathini kaChris Brown ebiseFNB Stadium nyakenye. Umufi uhambe emhlabeni ngokudutshulwa ngaphandle kwaseCarlton Centre, eGoli, ngoLwesibili.
INkantolo eNkulu yaseGauteng, eGoli, isichithile isicelo esiphuthumayo seBlack Rock Mining kanye nomtshalizimali u-Errol Elson sokulondoloza u-40% wenkokhelo ka-"Please Call Me” kaNkosana Kenneth Makate yakwaVodacom.Le nkampani iphendukele enkantolo ukuthi imali ifakwe kwi-trust, kusalindwe elinye icala, njengoba ithi ixhase izinyathelo zomthetho zikaMakate ezithathe isikhathi eside futhi inelungelo lokunqanyulwa.Kodwa iJaji elibambile uDon Mahon ngoMsombuluko lithe ekwahluleleni kwalo isicelo sale nkampani asiphuthumi, njengoba singekho isizathu sokukholelwa ukuthi uMakate uzoyisebenzisa le mali, ngakho asikho isizathu sokuvikela imali ngokushesha. Le nkampani ithe yenza isivumelwano noMakate ngo-2011 sokumkhokhela imali tempi yakhe ende yezomthetho noVodacom ukuze athole isinxephezelo mayelana nobunikazi bePlease Call Me.Ngesikhathi uVodacom efinyelela esivumelwaneni esiyimfihlo noMakate, okunamahlebezi ukuthi silinganiselwa ku-R700-million, u-Elson wafuna ukuba anqunyelwe elake iqatha. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, uMakate uthe le nkampani yagcina ukumkhokhela ngo-2014 futhi yehlulekile ukugcina izivumelwan zenkontileka.Ngokwesivumelwano, inkampani izoxhasa icala likaMakate noVodacom ukuze ithole u-40% wanoma iyiphi imali etholwa uMakate. Ubudlelwano phakathi kwabo, nokho, bonakala ngasekupheleni kuka-2014 ngenxa yezinsolo zokwephulwa kwesivumelwano soxhaso. Ngo-2015, abameli bakaMakate basesula isivumelwano, inkantolo yatshelwa.

Uyedwa osephonswe imibuzo njengoba uphenyo lwamaphoyisa lusaqhubeka.UMasemola usho lokhu esithangamini nabezindaba esibanjelwe ngaphandle kwehhostela iSaulsville ePitoli.UVan der Merwe wadutshulwa wabulawa ngoLwesihlanu mhla zi-5 kuZibandlela ngabantu abangaziwa ngaphandle komuzi wakhe eBrakpan, eGauteng. Ubeyilungu lamaphoyisa kamasipala waseKurhuleni (EMPD). Usanda kwethula ubufakazi kwikhomishini kaMadlanga ngezinsolo zobugebengu nenkohlakalo ku-EMPD nakuMasipala waseKurhuleni. Nakuba ubuyena bafihlwa ngesikhathi enikeza ubufakazi, izwi lakhe alizange licashiswe.UVan der Merwe ubenanenkampani eqopha ezokuphepha i-QRF Task Force ebiqhuba umsebenzi wokulwa nokumbiwa kwezimayini ezingekho emthethweni.Imibiko iveza ukuthi ngaphambi nje kokubulawa kwakhe, waveza inhloso yakhe yokudalula izikhulu zombuso okuthiwa zithinteka ezimayini ezingekho emthethweni.Ethula umbiko wakhe, uGen Masemola uthe: ngophenyo luka-Marius van der Merwe "Siyazethemba ukuthi maduze sizothatha igxathu eliya phambili njengoba amaphoyisa asebenza ngokuzikhandla ukuqoqa ulwazi olubalulekile.""I-NATJOINTS, ngokubambisana nekhomishini kaMadlanga, bahlangane futhi benza uhlelo lokuqinisa nokuqinisa ezokuphepha ezikhulwini nofakazi abaxhumene nekhomishini."
SESIZOGCINA kwa-matric isikole esizimele saseMaphaya, eJozini, enyakatho yaKwaZulu-Natal iJoy House Private, njengoba sesixhaswe ngo-R24.2 million ngabesikhwama sikahulumeni esixhasa amabhizinisi nezinhlelo ezithuthukisa umphakathi iNational Empowerment Fund (NEF).Lokho kuhlaluke emcimbini wokwethulwa kabusha lesi sikole emphakathini obuwenziwe kusona izolo, lapho obekubuthene ubuholi beNEF, ingxenye yabafundi bakhona abawu-470, kube wothisha abafundisa kusona abawu-22, nomphathi fuhti owumsunguli waso uNkk Jabulile Nyawo.Exoxa neSolezwe emva komcimbi, uNkk Nyawo wakhona eJozini, uthe kuyamjabulisa kakhulu ukubona umbono wakhe ngalesi sikole asiqala ngo-2014 uphumelela. Uthe saqala siseyinkulisa kuphela ngaleso sikhathi, saya ngokuya sikhula kwaze kwaba uqala ukuxhaswa yiNEF kusuka ngo-2017. "Kuyangijabulisa ukubona umbono wami ukhula futhi uthuthuka ngale ndlela ikakhulu ngoba size sifika kulesi sigaba nje, yingoba ngangiphushwa wukuthi sengiqede u-matric wami ngaba nenkinga yokungakwazi ukuqhubeka nempilo ngendlela engangifisa ngayo. Kwaba nzima ukuthola ezinye izinto ngenxa yezinga eliphansi lemfundo engalithola ngenkathi ngisafunda."Isifiso sami bekuwukusiza bafundi abeza emva kwami ukuthi bangathwali kanzima njengoba kwenzeka kimina, kepha bakwazi ukuthola imfundo yezinga eliphezulu nezosiza ukuthi uma sebeqede ukufunda bathole amathuba okuchuma ngemfundo," kulanda uNkk Nyawo.Eqhuba, uthe ngale kwezinga eliphezulu elitholakala esikoleni sakhe, okunye okuhle futhi asekuzuzile wukuthi siqashe abasebenzi abawu-44, kuhlanganisa othisha abaqashwe ngokugcwele abawu-22, nezinga eliphezulu lesikole kuhlanganisa amagumbi okufundela enziwe ngezinga elicokeme, yinkulisa yabafundi baGrade R, ne-swimming pool yokubhukuda izingane. "Ngiyazibongela kakhulu kwabeNEF njengoba ukungisiza kwabo kuzoyisa umbono wami phambili. Kusukela ngonyaka ozayo siyaqala ukufundisa abafundi u-matric. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi sibe nabafundi abangaphezu kuka-530. Sibheke nokuthi siqhubeke samukele abafundi abaqhamuka nakwezinye izifundazwe ukuzofunda esikoleni sethu," usho kanje.Isikhulu esiphezulu seNEF, uMnuz Mziwabantu Dayimani, sithe nabo bajabule kakhulu ngokuthi usizo lwabo lwenze umehluko omkhulu kangaka kulesi sikole, ababheke ukuthi siqhubeke sibe wusizo lokukhiqiza izingane ezizokhula zibe nekusasa eliqhakazile ngemfundo yazo. "Okunye okusihlabe umxhwele ngabo wukuthi uNkk Nyawo akalindanga uhulumeni. Sibafice bevele sebeqalile nomsebenzi omuhle abawenzayo. Sikhuthaza nabanye ukuthi bakhuthalele ukwenza izinhlelo ezinjena ezizoba wusizo lokuthi kuthuthuke umphakathi ikakhulu wezindawo zasemakhaya njengalapha," kusho uDayimani.Omunye wabazali bezingane ezifunda eJoy House, uNkk Dudu Mawela, uthe enye yezinto ezenza bajabule ngalesi sikole wukuthi siyasiza ukuphucula indawo yasemakhaya nanokuthi senza kube lula ukufaka izingane zabo kuso, bangaze baziyise kude nasemakhya ukuthola imfundo engcono.UNdumiso Dlangalala, owafika ezofunda uGrade R kulesi sikole, noyofunda u-matric kusona ngonyaka ozayo, uthe uyaziqhenya kakhulu ngoba waba khona sisanda kuqala njengoba manje sesithuthuke futhi saba kuleli zinga esikusona. Uthe wethemba ukuthi sizoqhubeka sifundise futhi sicije nabanye ozakwabo abeza emva kwakhe kusuka manje kubhekwe phambili.

Lokho kusho ukuthi nizophuthwa yinqwaba yamathuba abenganisiza ukuqhubekela phambili, kepha eningeke nawathola nhlobo ngoba akekho umuntu ongakhuthalela ukutshala imali yakhe entweni engathembekile," usho kanje. OMUNYE wabaholi bebandla lamaZayoni iDamaseku Church of Christ uMfu Senzo Dlamini usephonsele abaholi bamahlelo ehlukene amabandla obuKristu inselelo yokukhuthalela ukuzithuthukisa ngolwazi lwemfundo ebuholini okuzosiza bahole amabandla abo ngobuqotho.UMfu Dlamini usho njalo ekhuluma enkonzweni yokumhalalisela ngempumelelo yakhe yemfundo ebisemzini wakhe oseMantungwini, eMandeni, enyakatho yaKwaZulu-Natal, obungeSonto - lapho abememe khona abazalwane akhonza nabo ukuzomhalalisela ngokuthi usethweswe iziqu zezifundo zobufundisi azenze eZion Bible School (ZEBS)."Okuhle kakhulu ngalezi zifundo wukuthi azigcini ngokuthi zikunike ulwazi lweBhayibheli nokunye okweyamene nalo, kepha zisiza nangokuthi uqonde futhi wazi ukuthi uma umi phambi kwabazalwane kumele ukhulume kanjani, futhi ubahole ngayiphi indlela. "Yizifundo ezinikana amasu okuthi abazalwane baholwa kanjani, nokuthi uma benezinkinga ezahlukene zempilo jikelele wenza kanjani ukubasiza ukuze bangaphelelwa yithemba empilweni, yingakho ngikhuthaza nabanye abaholi ukuthi bakhuthale ukwenza izifundo ezinjena okuzosiza ngokuthi umsebenzi kaNkulunkulu siwenze ngobuqotho," kusho uDlamini.Omunye futhi umholi wamaDamaseku obekhona emcimbini, uMfu Manzokuphila Zwane uthe kubajabulise kakhulu bewubuholi bebandla ukuthi omunye umholi abambisene naye ebandleni afike esigabeni lapho ezuza khona izithelo zemfundo yakhe. "Ngibona kuwumkhuba omuhle kakhulu lokhu akwenzile nengifisa ukuthi nabanye babonele kuyena ngoba lokhu kusiza ngokuthi uma simi phambi kwabantu esibaholayo, sibadlise into ephilayo. Ngisho ubheka eBhayibhelini, buyavela ubumqoka bokufunda ukuze ukwazi ukuba wumholi oqotho, ngakho kungakuhle ukuthi nabanye abaholi bangami ngobizo lobuholi kuphela kepha bengenalo ulwazi lokuqhuba lowo msebenzi ebandleni," kusho uZwane.Kulo mcimbi uMfu Dlamini ubevakashelwe nawozakwabo asebenza nabo, izihlobo, abangani, omakhelwane nomndeni wakhe kuhlanganisa nonkosikazi wakhe uNkk Ntombifuthi Dlamini namadodakazi amathathu.

BAKHONJWE indlela othisha abangu-60, abebehobe ezikoleni befundisa kodwa obekungaziwa ukuthi basemabhukwini abantu asebeke balahlwa amacala okuhlukumeza izingane.Lokhu kuvezwe nguNgqongqoshe weMfundo eyisiSekelo, uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, ephendula imibuzo yamalungu ePhalamende, ngabakwenzayo ukuvikela abafundi ezikoleni.Uthe amagama alabo thisha bawavundulule emabhukwini agcinwa nguMnyango wezobuLungiswa, anamagama abantu asebeke bahlukumeza izingane."Siyaqhubeka nokukhuculula othisha abahlukumeza izingane ezikoleni zethu. Muva nje sixoshe labo thisha emva kokuvundulula amagama abo ohlwini lwabantu asebeke balahlwa amacala okuhlukumeza izingane," usho kanje kodwa wangachaza ukuthi bavela kuziphi izifundazwe. Uthe basebenzisana noMnyango wezobuLungiswa ngoba yiwona ogcina wonke amagama abantu asebeke bahlukumeza izingane."Asithi nsi kulabo abahlukumeza izingane zethu ngoba ukuphepha kwazo sikubeka phambili. Uma sithola ukuthi uke wahlukumeza ingane, usuke ungasakulungele ukusebenza nezingane ngakho siyakuxosha, asinanazi," usho kanje.Uthe kubalulekile ukuthi ngaso sonke isikhathi umqulu onabantu abahlukumeza izingane uhlale ubuyekezwa."Sinezinhlelo zokuthi abafundisa i-Early Childhood Development (ECD), bakwazi ukuhlonza ingane ehlukumezekayo." "Abazali nabo kumele basisize ngeke le mpi siyinqobe sisodwa. Nabo kumele baqinisekise ukuthi izingane azihlukumezeki,"Umkhandlu olawula othisha awuthi nsi ngothisha abahlukumeza izingane.Othisha abasha endimeni kubhekwa amagama abo emqulwini wabantu abake bahlukumeza izingane ngaphambi kokuba lo mkhandlu ubanike isitifiketi sokuthi bangakwazi ukuqashwa ezikoleni zakuleli. Othisha abalahlwa amacala okuhlukumeza izingane bakhonjwa indlela bangaphinde basebenze ezikoleni zakuleli.Nomthetho wezikole iBela uyakubalula ukuthi othisha kumele babike uma kunengane ekhulelwe isencane ezikoleni.Umthetho ubeka lo mthwalo emahlombe othisha, abahlengikazi nodokotela ukuthi uma kukhulelwe ingane engaphansi kuka-16, kubikwe ukukhulelwa kwayo ukuze iphonswe imibuzo kutholakale oyikhulelisile. Uma emdala kumele abekwe icala lokudlwengula ingane.Laba basebenzi bangazibona beboshwa uma behluleka ukubika izingane ezikhulelwe.

Ubhuti ubekade ezobheka intombi yakhe njengoba ebejwayele ukwenza. Laba bantu baqale ngokubabuza ukuthi kukuphi kwaNxumalo. Baphendule ngokuthi kabazi. Laba besilisa behlile emotweni base dedubula bephindelela bebhekise kudadewethu," usho kanjena.Uthe lesi sigameko simhlukumezile kakhulu ngoba senzeke ebuka."Bengikade ngiyothenga esitolo esiseduze ngesikhathi kuqhamuka le moto ipaka eduze kwabo. Bese nijika futhi nikhala ngami nithi ukube iNgonyama ayizange ilehlise ilobolo ngabe lesi sigebengu asizange singithole. Kubuhlungu kimi ukubusa isizwe sontanga yethu abangaganiwe. Siyoba yisizwe esinjani kusasa? Siyalimala." ISilo sithe sizoqhamuka nezinhlelo zokwakha amadoda.UNyazi luthe abahlukumeza abesifazane abasiwona amadoda angempela, bangabantu nje besilisa ngegama.UNyazi lunxuse amadoda ukuba ayeke ukuhlukumeza abantu besifazane."Inkosikazi noma intombi yakho, uma uthola ukuthi ifebile, uboyishiya. Uma umuntu umfica esephutheni, ubobonga."UNyazi luphinde lwakhuza ukucwila kwentsha ophuzweni oludakayo.IMbube noNyazi baphinde babusisa isakhiwo semicimbi esiseNyokeni.Lesi sakhiwo sezigidi zamaRandi sasakhelwe ukuba sisetshenziswe uma kunoMkhosi woMhlanga kepha umkhosi usuthuthelwe esigodlweni esisha, eMashobeni.Okhulumela iSilo, uMntwana uThulani kaGqikazi Zulu, uthe lesi sakhiwo ngeke simile imbuya, wathi sizosingatha imicimbi ehlukene.Kulindeleke ukuthi iMbube ingene emgonqweni emva kwenkonzo njengoba isizoqala amalungiselelo oMkhosi wokweShwama.

OBEYISOKA likaSiyabonga "Siya" Mhlongo, uNjabulo Duma, ugeqe amagula ngempilo yale nsizwa ebisakaza kuKhozi neMetro FM. USiya (40) usanda kulahlwa yiNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini ngecala lokushaya ngenhloso yokulimaza uNjabulo. NgoDisemba 15 kulindeleke ukuba agwetshwe. Ekhuluma kwi-Engineer Your Life with Lungelo KM, uNjabulo uthe uSiya wayengaqali ukuboshelwa icala lokushaya ngoba ngo-2018 wake washaya isoka lakhe kwaze kwaphoqeleka ukuba ahlawulelwe wunina ngemali yempesheni.Uthe nabanye abathandana nabanobulili obufana nobakhe babuye bamtshela ukuthi uSiya waziwa ngokuba nodlame kwathandana nabo. UNjabulo waseMlaza uthe ubudlelwano bakhe noSiya baqala esenza unyaka wokuqala ezifundweni zeBachelor of Arts in Philosophy, Politics, and Professional Law e-University of KwaZulu-Natal eMgungundlovu, ngo-2020.Uthe ngaleso sikhathi yena wayeneminyaka engu-25 ekubeni uSiya ayeneminyaka engu-36. Eqhuba uNjabulo uthe bahlangana komunye umcimbi lapho uSiya acela kuye izinombolo ne-handle ye-Instagram.Uthe emuva kokushelana inyanga nesigamu, bagcina sebesothandweni oluvutha amalangabi futhi ubudlelwano babo busaqala kwakumnandi kangangoba wayengazitsheli ukuthi bayoke bahlukane. Uthe babamnandi kakhulu ngesikhathi somvalelandlini weCovid-19. "Ngachitha amasonto amabili noma amathathu naye endlini." Uthe emuva kwalokho babexhumana ngokufonelana futhi babuye bachithe izinsuku ezintathu noma ezine ndawonye ngenxa yobumnandi bothando ababekubo. Uthe isimo saqala ukuba muncu emuva kwezinyanga eziyisithupha ngenxa yokuthi uSiya wayehlale emcefezela ngowesilisa ayethandana naye phambilini, esho konke okubi ayekwenze kuye. "Kwagcina sekungime emphinjeni ukulokhu sixoxa ngobeyisoka lakhe." UNjabulo uthe uSiya wagcina esecikwa nayizinto ezincane futhi esenolaka, edinwa nawukuthi uNjabulo akaluphendulanga ucingo ngokushesha futhi esehlale efuna ukwazi ukuthi ukuphi, wenzani futhi nobani. Uthe uSiya wayesemlawula ngenxa yokuthi wayenemali ekubeni yena wayesafunda. Igoda phakathi kwabo lagqabuka ngoFebhuwari 2021.Uthe yilapho uSiya avuka khona indlobane, wagaklaza izicabha, wambiza ngawowonke amagama, ekhala nangemali ayimoshe emondla. Uthe wakhala ubusuku bonke, wavuka ekuseni egcwele izinyembezi, wamthatha wamyisa erenki yamatekisi. Uthe bake bazama ukubuyisana kodwa babuye balwa kangangoba uSiya wabuye wabalisa ngokuthi wakhokhela izindleko zokusokwa kukaNjabulo. UNjabulo ubuye waveza ukuthi uSiya wake wamsola ngokuthi wake wazibandakanya nocansi loquqaba (orgy). Nakuba kunjalo uNjabulo uthe uSiya ubelokhu emnxenxa ukuba babuyelane. Uthe uyazisola ngokuya emcimbini kaSiya njengoba ayengamenyiwe eMhlanga. Uthe uyena owazicelela ukumenywa. UNjabulo uthe basuka eMhlanga badlulela kuFlorida Road eThekwini lapho bafike bahlala etafuleni, kwaba mnandi kwanjeya.Uthe indaba yonakala sebehamba ngoba kunowesilisa ongumngani kaSiya owathi mncwa mncwa kuye. Uthe endleleni uSiya wabhoka ngolaka, wamphihliza ngebhodlela leSavanna, wamsakaza ngempama futhi wamklinya. UNjabulo uthe emuva kwesigameko wathola inqwaba yezingcingo zimncenga ukuba angalivuli icala kodwa waqhubeka walivula.
UBAMBELELE ngezidindi uNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa omisiwe, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, ngesikhathi ebuzwa ukuthi kungani engazange abonisane noKhomishana wamaPhoyisa, uLieutenant General Fannie Masemola, ngaphambi kokuthi akhiphe umyalelo wokuba kuhlakazwe ithimba lamaphoyisa eliphenya amacala okubulawa kosopolitiki KwaZulu-Natal. UMchunu uvumile ukuthi umuntu owayengamnika izeluleko ezinhle ngokuhlakazwa kwethimba nguMasemola, kodwa wavele wangena ezintangeni esebuzwa ukuthi kungani engazange amthinte uMasemola. UMchunu ubevele phambi kwekhomishini ephenya izinsolo ezenziwa wuKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi. Usihlalo wekhomishini, iJaji Mbuyiseli Madlanga, uvalele uMchunu ekhoneni waze wavuma ukuthi kwakufanele engabe wabonisana noMasemola ngaphambi kokuthi akhiphe umyalelo othi akuhlazwe ithimba. UMchunu uvele wacasha ngesithupha esebuzwa ukuthi kungani-ke engamthintanga uMasemola. Uthe wayenethemba lokuthi kusazoxoxwa ngomyalelo wakhe wokuhlakaza ithimba. "Njengoba ngangishilo ngesikhathi ngikhipha umyalelo, ngacela ukuba uMasemola anginikeze umyalelo wesikhashana futhi kwakusazoba nezingxoxo. Nganginethemba lokuthi izikhulu zamaphoyisa zizobeka imibono yazo uma sesibonisana."UMadlanga uthe imibono yezikhulu zamaphoyisa yayingeke isasiza ngoba uMchunu wayesenqumile ukuthi alihlakazwe ithimba. UMchunu uqhubekile nokuvikela isinqumo sakhe. Uthe sasingasekho isidingo sokuba ithimba liqhubeke nokusebenza ngoba zase zehlile izigameko zokubulawa kosopolitiki KwaZulu-Natal. UMchunu uthe ithimba lalisebenzisa imali eningi kakhulu ekubeni laliphenya amacala nje athinta ukubulawa kosopolitiki esifundazweni esisodwa."Akufanele kube sengathi sibeka phambili amacala okubulawa kosopolitiki kuphela. Baningi abantu ababulawayo."UMchunu ukhale nangokushaya ngolonwabu kwamacala abantu ababoshwa yithimba. Uthe akekho umuntu osagwetshiwe ecaleni elenza ukuthi kusungulwe ithimba.Lelo yicala lokubulawa kwelungu le-ANC eMgungundlovu, uMnuz Musawenkosi "Qashana" Mchunu, elabulawa ngo-2018.UMengameli, uCyril Ramaphosa, wamemezela ukusungulwa kwethimba emva kokuyohlanganisa amehlo nomndeni kaQashana. "Kusekude phambili kuleli cala. Icala lenzeka eminyakeni eyisishiyagalombili eyedlule kodwa akekho osegwetshiwe. Ngiyakhuluma nomndeni kaQashana. Bahlanu abantu ababoshiwe. Abane babhekene necala lokwakha itulo lokubulala, munye obhekene necala lokubulala. Leli cala lenzeka ngo-2018."UMchunu uzoqhubeka nokwethula ubufakazi namhlanje. Ngaphambi kokuthi kuvele uMchunu izolo, kuqale isikhulu samaphoyisa kuMasipala waseKurhuleni esimisiwe, uBrigadier Julius Mkhwanazi. UJulius usolwa ngokuthi wafaka izimoto zikasomabhizinisi obhekene noxhaxha lwamacala, uMnuz Vusimuzi "Cat" Matlala, amalambu aluhlaza waphinde wazibhalisa ngaphansi kwezimoto zomkhandlu. UJulius uvume ukuthi kukhona imali ake ayithola kuMatlala. Uthe imali wayemnikeza yona ngesikhathi emisiwe emsebenzini. UJulius uthe uMatlala wayemthengela ukudla futhi wafaka isandla ngesikhathi eshonelwe.UJulius uthe imali enkulu ayikhumbulayo u-R20 000, wathi lena enye kwakuba yimali encane. UJulius uzobuya ngonyaka ozayo ezoqedela ukwethula ubufakazi. Kusuke igidigidi ngaye eqala ukwethula ubufakazi ngoLwesithathu ebukeka enovalo, wahlekwa nangokuphuza inqwaba yamanzi futhi emfoma wumjuluko.
UPHIKO lwentsha kwi-ANC kanye nolwabesifazane lusho ngazwi linye ukuthi uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, ngeke akhishwe esikhundleni.I-ANC Youth League (ANCYL) ne-ANC Women's League (ANCWL) bathe abakhohlwe labo abakha itulo lokuketula uRamaphosa.I-ANCYL ne-ANCWL bebephefumula emva kwemibiko eveza ukuthi kukhona ngaphakathi kwi-ANC abakha itulo lokuchitha uRamaphosa.I-ANC izoba nengqungquthela iNational General Council (NGC), ngesonto elizayo.I-ANCYL ne-ANCWL bakuphikile ukuthi kunetulo lokuketula uRamaphosa.UNobhala we-ANCYL, uMnuz Mntuwoxolo Ngudle, uthe amampunge okuthi uRamaphosa ulengelwa yizembe asatshalaliswa abantu abazama ukuphazamisa amalungiselelo eNGC. "I-ANC ibumbene futhi sonke siyameseka uRamaphosa. Amagwala nje lawa ahambe esabalalisa amampunge okuthi kunetulo lokuketula uRamaphosa. Laba bantu bazifihlile, abafuni ukuphumela obala. Sizobhekana nabo ngoba asibasabi. Inhloso yabo wukuphazmisa amalungiselelo eNGC lapho sizobuka khona ibanga esilihambile, siphinde siqhamuke namaqhinga okuya phambili."UNgudle uthe basajabule ngobuholi bukaRamaphosa."Ngaphansi kobuholi bukaRamaphosa sibone uhulumeni uvuselela imizamo yokuba kuhlomule wonke umuntu emnothweni wakuleli, kwaphinde kwabekwa eqhulwini eyokuphathwa ngendlela kwemali yingakho ke simeseka uRamaphosa. Ngeke sivume ukudukiswa abantu abacashile. Siphonsela inselelo abahambe befafaza amanga ukuba baphumele obala, musani ukukhuluma nicashile."Unobhala we-ANCWL, uNkk Nokuthula Nqaba, uthe kwi-ANC kunendlela okwenziwa ngayo izinto."Kuyishwa ukuthi kukhona abaholi abangayihloniphi imigomo ye-ANC. Bahlulwa yini ukukhuluma ezinhlakeni ze-ANC uma bengajabule ngomengameli? Yini eyenza ukuthi baye koqamba amanga kwabezindaba?"UNkk Nqaba uthe basajabule ngobuholi bukaRamaphosa, wancoma isinqumo sikahulumeni sakamumva sokuhlonza ukuhlukunyezwa kwabantu besifazane nezingane njengenhlekelele ebhekene nezwe.UNkk Nqaba uthe kuningi okuhle okwenzeke ebuholini bukaRamaphosa okubalwa kukho ukusingathwa ngempumelelo komhlangano wamazwe angaphansi kweG20 obukuleli ngeledlule, kanye nokulwa nenkohlakalo."Sonke siyazi ukuthi uRamaphosa ulwa nenkohlakalo futhi iningi imali yoMbuso eyayintshontshiwe esiyibone ibuyiswa njengoba sekuphethe uRamaphosa."Izolo i-ANC ibinomhlangano wesigungu esiphezulu okhethekile lapho ibilungiselela iNGC.
UPHUME unxapha eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseNtuzuma izolo umndeni wowesifazane owabulawa yisoka lakhe elingumpheki ngonyaka odlule.Umufi, uNksz Mbali Mokokone (29) wabulawa yisoka lakhe uMnuz Zimisele Dlulisa (39) esigamekweni esenzeka eMaoti, eNanda, ngonyaka odlule.Lesi sigameko saba yindaba egudwini njengoba kwavela ukuthi uDlulisa wamklinya umufi waphinde wamgwaza njengoba wayenenxeba elilodwa lokugwazwa entanyeni.Eceleni kwesidumbu kwatholakala isitini esasigcwele igazi. Kwavela ukuthi bahilizisana kwashuba ingxabano.UDlulisa kwavela ukuthi wayenga umufi ngokuthi akeze kwakhe lapho ehlala khona eNanda ukuze bezojabulela usuku lukamufi lokuzalwa.Esembulele kuthiwa waphaka ukudla uDlulisa wadla eceleni kwesidumbu. Kwahlaluka nokuthi izingane zikamufi ezimbili zakubona konke okwakwenzeka ngosuku lwesigameko.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi uDlulisa wafaka isicelo sebheyili kodwa inkantolo yamchitha kulokho.Eqhulwini wagcizelela ukuthi kumele aphumele ngaphandle ngoba izingane zisele dengwane azinabazali. Laqulwa icala kwaze kwaba liyamgojela.Izolo inkantolo imgwebe iminyaka engu-18 ebhadla ejele.Lesi yisigwebo umndeni kamufi okholwa wukuthi sifana noswazi oluncane nje okushaywa ngalo ingane encane uma ikade iganga.Udadewabo kamufi, uNksz Bongekile Makokone, uthe bayazibuza ukuthi inkantolo ifinyelele kanjani kulesi sinqumo.Uthe bakhungathekile njengomndeni, bayazibuza bayaziphendula ukuthi umuntu owone kangaka ekhipha umphefumulo womuntu ongenacala kungani engagixabezwanga ngodilikajele."Angifuni ukuqamba amanga, asigculisekile futhi kakhulu kabi ngalesi sinqumo. Ibuhlungu kabi le nto eyenziwe yile nkantolo yokuthi ikhiphe isigwebo esingathi shu," kuchaza yena.Ubuze ukuthi kanti isigwebo sikadilikajele sitholwa ngabantu abanjani uma kuya ngokuthi abasitholi nabakhipha umphefumulo wabesifazane abangenacala."Angazi ngempela ukuthi inkantolo icabangeni ize igcine isifinyelele kulesi sinqumo esifana nalesi. Lesi yisigwebo esijabhise umndeni wonke," usho kanjena.Uthe ngeke bathule bamane bagoqe izandla nje bazosukuma ngoba bakholwa wukuthi lesi sigwebo sicindezela umndeni kamufi."Kwaze kwadlalwa ngathi sibuka. Ayikho phela le nto. Umuntu angenza icala elibucayi elinjengaleli kodwa axolelwe ngesigwebo esilula kanjena," usho kanjena.Ngaphambi kokuba agwetshwe uDlulisa utshele inkantolo ukuthi babubuhle kakhulu ubudlelwano ayenabo nomufi futhi bezithanda izingane zabo.Ukuphikile ukuthi kwase kuyinsakavukela ukusuka kothuli lwezichwe phakathi kwakhe nomufi.Lokhu kuyashayisana nokushiwo wumndeni kamufi ochaza ubudlelwano babo njengobebungenayo inqubekela phambili kodwa bephila ngokuklwebhana mihla namalanga.Okunye umndeni kamufi oshaya amakhala ngakho wukuthi lize laphothulwa icala kungekho fakazi ohlangothini lwabo obiziwe.Imantshi elingatholakalanga igama layo ikugxekile ukubulawa kwabesifazane ngesihluku.Ithe lokhu kumele kunqandwe ngoba kukhinyabeza inhlalonhle yabesifazane ethe iningi labo seliphila ngokuthuka izanya.
UNDUNANKULU waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, ukufanise nokuhlasela ezokuphepha kanjalo nozinzo esifundazweni ukubulawa kwabasezinhlakeni eziqapha ubugebengu emiphakathini. UNtuli ukhulume kanje eMlaba Village, eHammarsdale, ngoMgqibelo, lapho ebethamele khona inkonzo yomngcwabo kaMnuz Muzi Mbongwa obeyilungu le-Community Policing Structure (CPS) ebelisebenza ngokuzikhandla kule ndawo.UMbongwa kuthiwa wadutshulwa ngentululwane yezinhlamvu ngeledlule, ehlaselwa kuyo le ndawo abantu abangaziwa. Ekhuluma nezethameli emngcwabeni uNtuli uthe iyamkhathaza eyesibalo esilokhu sikhule njalo sokubulawa kwamaphoyisa nabasezinhlakeni zemiphakathi ezilwa nobugebengu. Uthe okukhathaza kakhulu wukuthi abafi babulawa bematasa nomsebenzi wokulwa nobugebengu. "Lezi zehlakalo azihlukile nokuthi kuhlaselwa ezokuphepha kanjalo nozinzo esifundazweni,” kusho uNtuli. Ugcizelele eyokuthi ukuncishiswa kobugebengu kubalulekile, wathi kuyalekelela ekutheni abatshalimali babuyelwe yithemba bese betshala imali esifundazweni."Ngaleyo ndlela kube sekudaleka amathuba omsebenzi bese kukhula umnotho wesifundazwe,” kusho uNtuli.Utshele izethameli ukuthi ngeke baphumule kuze kube wukuthi yonke imiphakathi esifundazweni iphephile. "Esikufunayo wukuthi sibe nesifundazwe esingenabugebengu, lapho abantu bephila khona ngokukhululeka, abamabhizinisi bephumelela namathuba ekhula,” usho kanje. Edlulisa amazwi enduduzo emndenini kaMbongwa uthe uyabonga ukuthi ube nesibindi, ezikhandla futhi enza konke okusemandleni ukulwa nobugebengu endaweni.Ube esegcizelela ukuthi impi yobugebengu kufanele kubanjiswanwe kuyo, wathi izinhlaka ezihlukene ezibandakanya imiphakathi, ubuholi bomdabu kanjalo namaphoyisa kufanele zizibophezele ngokusebenzisana. Uthembise umphakathi wakule ndawo ukuthi uzoxoxisana noKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, ukuthi kuqiniswe ezokuphepha eHammarsdale, amaphoyisa abonakale ehambahamba endaweni, bese kuphinde kuqiniswa neminye imibhidlango yokulwa nobugebengu kulandela izigameko zokudubula endaweni. "Nginxusa ukuthi izakhamuzi zime namaphoyisa ngokuthi zizibike emaphoyiseni izigebengu ezaziwayo bese zizibandakanya embhidlangweni wokulwa nobugebengu,” kusho uNtuli.Uthembise ukuthi uzoqinisa imikhankaso yokuletha ukuthula emphakathini.Ngesikhathi kwenziwa isikhumbuzo saminyaka yonke samaphoyisa abulawa esemsebenzini ezindlini zoMbuso ekuqaleni kukaSepthemba, kwavela ukuthi angu-27 amaphoyisa abulawe kulo nyakamali.
UKHALA ngokulokhu equlela izindodla zemali emgodini ongagcwali owesifazane wakwa-Z, eMlaza, oseze wazaca waba ngangothi lokuvungula ngenxa yombango wokudayiswa kwendlu. UNksz Slindile Mdabe othe wathenga indlu ngo-R500 000 ngoMashi 2017, utshele Isolezwe ukuthi eminyakeni edlule uzithole esekhokha u-R630 000 ngaphezulu ngendlu efanayo.Elandisa Isolezwe uthe indlu wayithenga kuMnuz Sphelele Ngubo ngo-R500 000 awukhokha ngebhange lakhe. "Emva kokumkhokhela ekupheleni kukaMashi 2017, ngangena endlini ekuqaleni kuka-Ephreli 2017 ngokwesivumelwano sethu. Emva kokukhokha u-R15 000 wama-transfers okuthi kushintshwe itayitela ekupheleni kuka-Ephreli, kwaqala izinkinga,” kusho uNksz Mdabe.Uthe akazange alithole itayitela kuNgubo, nokwathi uma kuphela izinyanga, wagcina esethola abameli ekuqaleni kuka-2018, ukuthi bamphenyele ukuthi kwenzekani."Yilapho engathola khona ukuthi kukhona owesilisa womdabu waseNdiya ovelayo etayiteleni. Kwavela ukuthi ngeke ngilithole ngoba uthi uNgubo umkweleta u-R350 000 manje ufuna kuqale kukhokhwe wona ngaphambi kokuthi adedele itayitela,” kusho uNksz Mdabe. Uthe akaqondanga ukuthi konke lokhu kwenzeka kanjani, kwathi uma ebuyela kuNgubo, wamtshela ukuthi owesilisa akahlukane naye (uNksz Mdabe), abhekane naye (uNgubo) ngqo.Uthe ugcine esezithola engene shi embangweni walaba ababili, lona okweletwa u-R350 000 esemsabisa ngesikhonzi senkantolo."Besivele sifike nencwadi ethi ngiyakhishwa endlini. Ngo-2023, ngaze ngagcina ngizithola sengivuma ukuthi ngimkhokhele le mali athi uyikweletwa wuNgubo. Yilapho athi khona ayisewona u-R350 000, isizele isingu-R500 000, ngawuzama, ngawuthola, ngamkhokhela,” kusho uNksz Mdabe. Uthe ngesikhatih enza lokhu wayezama ukuqeda umsindo ukuze athole itayitela.Uveze ukuthi akazange alithole itayitela kunalokho owesilisa wathula izinyanga ezithile wase ephinde emhlohloloza ngesikhonzi senkantolo, ethi usefuna uR130 000, oyizindleko zabameli, ababesebenza udaba eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini."Ngahamba ngaya ebhange ngayowuboleka, ngamnika ngommeli wami maphakathi nonyaka odlule,” kusho uNksz Mdabe. Udalule ukuthi owesilisa uke wathi ukuthula njengoba evumbuke ngo-Okthoba nonyaka nenye incwadi ethi usefuna esinye isamba semali."Usengisabise ngokuthi uma ngingamniki le mali, uzongikhipha endlini ngoLwesithathu oluzayo,” kusho uNksz Mdabe.Uthe ayikho into emhlukumeza njengalolu daba. "Sengiphelelwe yilolonke isenti enginalo, ngingene nasezikweletini engingazi ukuthi ngizozikhokha ngani. Emzimbeni sengizace ngalingana nothi, sengihlala ngigula ngenxa yokhwantalala,” usho kanje.Uthe akubonayo wukuthi lona wesilisa usedlala ngaye ngoba ngokomthetho sasingekho isidingo sokuthi kube khona imali amnika yona kwasekuqaleni."Ngamkhokhela ngoba ngizama ukuqeda umsindo futhi ngifuna itayitela, kodwa kuze kube imanje angilitholi, kunalokho ngilokhu ngifunwa izindodla zemali,” kusho uNksz Mdabe, othe ufuna ubulungiswa ngalolu daba. Uthe ufuna kuphele ukusatshiswa ngokukhishwa endlini athe usechithe inqwaba yemali eyilungisa. Uthe ufuna nokubuyiselwa ingxenye yemali ayikhokhele owesilisa ngoba ukholwa wukuthi kwakungafanele amkhokhele yona kwasekuqaleni.Isolezwe likhulume nomthombo olwazi ukusuka nokuhlala udaba, ocele ukungadalulwa. Uthe uNgubo owadayisela uNksz Mdabe umuzi wayesebenzisana nalona womdabu waseNdiya, bethenga izindlu emalokishini, bazilungise bese bezidayisa ukuthola inzuzo. "UNgubo wenza okungafanele, eyodayisela uNksz Mdabe umuzi ekubeni itayitela lawo libiza owaseNdiya. Kuthe sekuvela ukuthi uwudayisile, kwadingeka akhokhele lo mlisa u-R350 000 umuzi owawuthengwe ngawo,” kusho umthombo.Uthe udaba lwagcina lungena enkantolo nokwanqunywa ukuthi uNgubo akhokhele owesilisa imali yakhe, nokuyinto engazange yenzeke."Kuthe uma owesilisa ebona kuhamba isikhathi uNgubo engayikhokhi imali yakhe, wavele wawufaka endalini umuzi ukuze athole imali yakhe. Yilapho okwabe sekungena khona uNksz Mdabe ngoba kwabe sekufanele aphume endlini,” usho kanje. Uthe uNksz Mdabe wabe esekhona u-R350 000 uhambisana nenzalo ka-R150 000 ezama ukuthi angakhishwa endlini."Owesilisa ugcine esenza ubugebengu engasalikhiphi itayitela ngisho esekhokhelwe le mali, kunalokho wafuna u-R130 000 ngaphezulu. UNksz Mdabe nommeli wakhe bayikhokha le mali,” kusho umthombo.Uthe nalapho lona wesilisa akamnikanga itayitela, kunalokho wafuna u-R80 000 futhi, ethi owezindleko zabameli ababelwa udaba enkantolo ngesikhathi kuqala izinxushunxushu phakathi kwakhe noNgubo. "Umbuzo uthi uNksz Mdabe ungena kanjani lapho? Usedlala ngaye,” kusho umthombo othe abameli basenzinhlelweni zokulufaka enkantolo lolu daba ngoba amalungelo kaNksz Mdabe ayanyathelwa kungafanele.Lona wesilisa, uMnuz Mohammed Osman, uthe: "Lolu daba sekuneminyaka lusenkantolo. Ngokolwazi onalo, kukhombisa ukuthi awulazi iqiniso. Kungakuhle ukuthi uthinte ummeli ukuze akutshele iqiniso ngecala.”Ummeli ka-Osman, uNkk Jameela Sayed, utshele intatheli ukuthi ulwazi elunikiwe alulona iqiniso, wahlongoza ukuthi intatheli ize emahhovisi abo ukuze ayikhombise lonke ulwazi olusefayeleni lecala.

ITHIMBA lesikhashana elihola i-ANC KwaZulu-Natal lisengcupheni yokuphuthelwa yingqungquthela ebhekwe ngamehlo abomvu, iNational General Council (NGC), ezokuba ngesonto elizayo.UNobhala jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, utshele ithimba lesikhashana elihola i-ANC esifundazweni ukuthi lizoyizwa ngendaba ingqungquthela uma lihluleka ukulandela imiyalelo yakhe.Lokhu ukusho encwadini ayibhalele umgqugquzeli wethimba lesikhashana, uMnuz Mike Mabuyakhulu.Kule ncwadi ebonwe yiSolezwe uMbalula uyalela ubuholi be-ANC KwaZulu-Natal ukuba buqale phansi umhlangano wokulungiselela iNGC, buphinde buqale phansi nohlelo lokuqoka izithunywa ezizoba yingxenye yeNGC ezoba seGoli.Umhlangano wobuholi baKwaZulu-Natal wokulungiselela iNGC, iProvincial General Council (PGC), ubuseThekwini, ngoMgqibelo.Kube nezikhalo kwamanye amalungu amagatsha ekhala ngokuthi akuzange kulandelwe imigomo ngesikhathi kuqokwa izithunywa ebezihambele umhlangano wangoMgqibelo.UMbalula uyalele ubuholi besifundazwe ukuba buqale phansi uhlelo lokukhetha izithunywa."Ngiyazi ukuthi kunamagatsha ahluleka ukuhlangabezana nomnqamulajuqu wokuthi abe nemihlangano yokukhetha izithunywa. Nginilulele isikhathi sokuba nibe nemihlangano yokuqoka izithunywa kulawo magatsha abengakabi nemihlangano." UMbalula ubekele ubuholi baKwaZulu-Natal umnqamulajuqu wakusasa ukuba bube nomhlangano wokulungiselela iNGC.Udonse ngendlele ubuholi besifundazwe ukuba benze isiqiniseko sokuthi umhlangano uzohanjelwa yizithunywa ezikhethwe ngendlela esemthethweni.Okhulumela i-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Fanle Sibisi, uthe bayitholile incwadi kaMbalula.USibisi akazange afune ukuphumela obala ngesikhathi ebuzwa ukuthi bazohlangabezana yini nomnqamulajuqu kaMbalula."Uma uyifunda kahle incwadi uzobona ukuthi ikhipha imiyalelo ecacile, akukho ukudideka lapha, kunemiyalelo okuchazwayo ukuthi kufanele ilandelwe."Isolezwe lithole ukuthi ubuholi besifundazwe buqale khona izolo ukuzama ukuhlela imihlangano yamagatsha.Khonamanjalo, i-ANC iphinde yalulela ubuholi baKwaZulu-Natal isikhathi sokusebenza.Isikhathi sobuholi obukhona saphela ngenyanga edlule.Ubuholi besikhashana baqokwa ngasekuqaleni konyaka kulandela ukuhlakazwa kobuholi besifundazwe.Lobu buholi babunikezwe izinyanga eziyisishiyagalolunye ukuba buhlele izingqungquthela zokukhetha ubuholi besifundazwe nobezifunda.Azizange zibe khona izingqungquthela obekufanele zibe ngenyanga edlule.Umhlangano wesigungu esiphezulu kwi-ANC uthathe isinqumo sokululela ubuholi obukhona ngezinyanga ezintathu.Kulezi zinyanga ezintathu kubhekwe ukuthi kube nezingqungquthela zokukhetha ubuholi.
SIPHEKWE ngebhodwe elincane saze savuma izono zaso isikhulu samaphoyisa akuMasipala waseKurhuleni esimisiwe, uBrigadier Julius Mkhwanazi, esisolwa ngokuba sephaketheni likasomabhizinisi obhekene noxhaxha lwamacala, uMnuz Vusumuzi "Cat" Matlala.UMkhwanazi uvumile ukuthi washelelela ngesikhathi esayina isivumelwano sokusebenzisana nenkampani kaMatlala esenza ukuthi izimoto zikaMatlala zifakwe amalambu aluhlaza.UMkhwanazi uthe ukufakwa kwezimoto zikaMatlala amalambu aluhlaza kuphambene nomthetho.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi evele phambi kwekhomishini eholwa yiJaji Mbuyiseli Madlanga.UMkhwanazi wasayina isivumelwano sokuba umkhandlu usebenzisane nezinkampani ezimbili zikaMatlala, iCat VIP Protection neMedicare24.Njengengxenye yesivumelwano izimoto zeCAT VIP Protection zazizofakwa amalambu aluhlaza bese kuthi ezeMedicare24 zona zifakwa amalambu abomvu afakwa izimoto ezihlinzeka ngosizo lwezempilo.UMkhwanazi uthe akazange alibone iphutha lakhe ngesikhathi esayina isivumelwano."Lixhoshwa libhekile. Ngesikhathi ngisayina angizange ngilibone iphutha kodwa emva kokubona izikhalo zabantu nami ngalibona iphutha lami. Umthetho awuyivumi le nto."Izikhulu eziphethe uMkhwanazi azizange zisisayine isivumelwano sokusebenzisana nezinkampani zikaMatlala.UMkhwanazi uthe ngenxa yokuthi yena wayengenalo izwi lokugcina wayenethemba lokuthi labo abamphethe bazokusho uma kukhona okuphambene nomthetho."Njengoba ngangisayinile isivumelwano, ukuze isivumelwano sibe semthethweni kwakufanele kusayine abanye ababili abaphathi abangaphezu kwami. Le nto yayisaxoxwa, ngakho nganginethemba uma kukhona okuphambene nomthetho babezokusho."UMkhwanazi uthe akusiyena owafaka amalambu aluhlaza ezimotweni zikaMatlala."Angikaze ngizibone nokuzibona lezo zimoto."UMkhwanazi uthe isivumelwano sokusebenzisana nenkampani kaMatlala sasizohlomulisa umkhandlu.UMkhwanazi uthe inkampani kaMatlala yayizonikela ngezimoto ezazizosetshenziswa uphiko lwamaphoyisa.UMkhwanazi uthe iMedicare24 yayizophinde ihlinzeke usizo lwezempilo emaphoyiseni omkhandlu."Sasingenawo ama-ambulensi emkhandlwini. Amaphoyisa ayalimala emsebenzini, ahlale isikhathi eside elinde usizo lwezempilo. Kwakuzokwelekelela kakhulu ukuthi sisebenzisane neMedicare24."UMkhwanazi uthe izinkampani zikaMatlala zazingezukuzuza lutho ngokwelekelela umkhandlu."Bona into nje ababeyifuna ukuzikhangisa ebantwini."UMkhwanazi uthe waqala ukwazana noMatlala ngesikhathi sobhubhane i-corona ngo-2020.UMkhwanazi ubebonakala ukuthi uthukile ngesikhathi evele phambi kwekhomishini.Ujuluke wamanzi ngesikhathi ephekwa ngemibuzo, elokhu ephuza amanzi.UMkhwanazi ubelokhu ecela ukunikwa ikhefu ukuze ezokuya endlini encane.Kuke kwaba khona isikhathi lapho khona uMkhwanazi ephakamelwe umoya, wasola owayeyisikhulu samaphoyisa kuMasipala waseKurhuleni, uMnuz Revo Spies, ngokuqamba amanga.USpies wenza izinsolo ezishaqisayo ngoMkhwanazi ngesikhathi evele phambi kwekhomishini.Namhlanje ikhomishini izoqhubeka nokulalela ubufakazi bukaNgqongqoshe wezamaPhoyisa omisiwe, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu.UMchunu uqale ukwethula ubufakazi ngoLwesibili, kulindeleke ukuthi aqhubeke nakusasa.
SICHITHWE yiPhalamende isiphakamiso somholi weBuild One SA (Bosa), uDkt Mmusi Maimane sokunyusa izinga lokuphasa kwa-matric, liye ku-50%, lisuka ku-30%.Lokhu kulandela ukuthi amaqembu amahlanu okubalwa i-ANC ne-DA, echithe lesi siphakamiso emva kokuba kwaba nenkulumo mpikiswano ngeledlule ngalolu daba.Lesi siphakamiso bekumele sesekwe noma sichithwe kukhona ingxenye eningi yamalungu ePhalamende, okuyinto eyenzeke ngoLwesibili ebusuku. UMaimane wayekhale ngokuthi kumele linyuswe izinga ngenxa yokuthi liphansi kakhulu futhi lehluleka nokulungiselela abafundi ukuya ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme.Ebhala enkundleni i-X emva kokukhala ngaphansi, uMaimane uthe amaqembu amahlanu okuyi-ANC, DA, Patriotic Alliance, Freedom Front Plus, ne-Al Jama-Ah, asichithile lesi siphakamiso.Uthe: "La maqembu avotele ukugcina izinga lokuphasa elabekwa yiBantu Education. Sihlulekile ukuchitha indaba yokuphasa ngo-30% emfundweni yakuleli." Amaqembu aseke isiphakamiso yi-MK Party, EFF, IFP, Action SA, ATM, ACDP, ne-ATM. I-EFF ithe ayifuni kwakhiwe izidomu yingakho ihambisana nokuthi kunyuswe izinga lokuphasa. Ngikholwa wukuthi ukunyusa izinga akusho ukuthi kumele kufeyile izingane," kusho uMaimane. Wakhala ngokuthi baningi abafundi abalaxaza isikole bangafinyeleli ku-matric uma ubala isibalo sabasale endleleni ababeqale uGrade 1.UNksz Gwarube wakuchitha ukuthi kuphaswa ngo-30% kwa-matric wathi akulona iqiniso.Wathi kudingeka ezinye izifundo uziphase ngo-40% okubalwa nolimi lwebele kanjalo nezinye ezimbili.Wathi kubafundi abangu-724 000 ababhale u-matric ngo-2024, bangu-189 kuphela abathola u-30% ezifundweni zabo wathi sincane kakhulu lesi sibalo njengoba inqwaba yaphasa ngaphezu kwaleli maki.I-Bosa ithe ayiphelile le mpi izoqhubeka nokuyilwa indaba yokuthi linyuswe izinga lokuphasa.
