"Ngaleso sizathu angizange ngibabone ukuthi babebukeka kanjani ebusweni,” kusho uSnethemba.Uphinde watshela inkantolo ukuthi akakwazanga ngisho nokuwafanisa amazwi abo yize bayiphimisela inkulumo ethi: "Vulani umnyango, uphi umkhulu wenu?”Enza isicelo uKarrim uthe: "Ngizofaka isicelo sokuthi ikhasimende lami likhishwe kuleli cala ngoba akukho okulihlanganisa nalo.” Isicelo sikaKarrim size emva kokuthi iMantshi uNkk Mazibuko-Dlamini eshaye amakhala ngobufakazi bukaWarrant Officer Sifiso Longuane, ongumphenyi wecala.Umphenyi ngesikhathi ethula ubufakazi eholwa umshushisi woMbuso onqabile negama lakhe, utshele inkantolo ukuthi abasolwa ababili baboshwa ngaphandle kokuthi abagilwa babakhombe.Uphinde waveza ukuthi ngesikhathi beboshwa yena asikho isitatimende ayesesithathile ku-Amahle. Uveze ukuthi yena wanikwa icala emva kokuthi umndeni wabagilwa uhambe wayokhalaza ekomkhulu lamaphoyisa esifundazwe."Idokodo ngalithatha ngoDisemba 20, 2021, abasolwa bababoshwa ngoDisemba 28, 2021,” kusho umphenyi othe ngesikhathi beboshwa wayekhona.Utshele inkantolo ukuthi ukuboshwa kwabo kwenzeka njengoba ayelandela umyalelo wabaphathi bakhe ababemnike idokodo. "Lalinomyalelo owawuthi angibophe ababegagulwe edokodweni,” kusho umphenyi.Uqhube wathi ngesikhathi beboshwa wayengekho u-Amahle ukuze kwenziwe uhlelo lokukhomba."Ngayizwakalisa kumphathi wami uColonel Ngcobo eyokuthi ngikhathazekile ngokuthi abasolwa baboshwe ngaphandle kokuthi kwenziwe lolu hlelo. Nokho wathi ngeke kuchithwe izinsiza zikahulumeni ukuyokhomba abasolwa ngoba izingane (abagilwa) ziyabazi,” kusho umphenyi. Uthe akabange esaqhubeka nalo ngoba kwakusobala ukuthi kwakuzofanele ashaye iphakethe lakhe ngoba wayengeke ayinikwe imali uma uNgcobo esekhulume kanje. Ngesikhathi iMantshi uNkk Mazibuko-Dlamini emhloma imibuzo ngokuthi kwenzeka ukubopha ekubeni abasolwa bengakhonjwanga abagilwa, uthe naye wayekhathazekile ngalokhu. "Ngokwami, kwakufanele lwenziwe uhlelo lokukhomba ngoba uma umgilwa ethi ngidutshulwe usibanibani, kufanele ayomkhomba ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi nguyena ngempela ngoba kungenzeka babe baningi abantu abanegama nesibongo okufanayo,” usho kanje. UNkk Mazibuko-Dlamini uphinde wazwakalisa ukungayizwa kahle eyokuthi waze wabopha engazange asithathe isitatimende ku-Amahle.Uthe noma eveza ukuthi wake wazama ukuthi amhlome imibuzo u-Amahle kodwa watshelwa ukuthi nakuba ayesephumile esibhedlela kodwa usasesimweni esibucayi, ngeke akwazi ukukhuluma.UNkk Mazibuko-Dlamini ukhale ngokuthi umphenyi wahluleka ukuthatha isitatimende ukusuka ngaleso sikhathi kuze kuba kusongwa konke ukuqoqwa kobufakazi, icala liqala ukuqulwa enkantolo ngoJulayi 2022. "U-Amahle wahlala esibhedlela ngoSepthemba no-Okthoba 2021. Ngesikhathi unikwa idokodo ngoDisemba 2021, wayesephumile esibhedlela kodwa awuzange usibone isidingo sokuthi wenze olwakho uphenyo kuye yize ayesephumile esibhedlela,” kubuza uNkk Mazibuko-Dlamini.Umphenyi wathi kuningi okwakuyizingqinamba ngecala, okufaka phakathi ukuthi kwayethatha imiyelelo kubaphathi bakhe, kokunye eyayibuye imnqinde amandla, waze wacela ukuthi lisuswe ohlwini lwamadokodo ayenikwe ukuthi awaphenye.Umthombo ocele ukungadalulwa uzwakalise ukubadabukela abagilwa wathi kubukeka bengeke babuthole nhlobo ubulungiswa njengoba uthe ukuboshwa kukamsolwa ophambi kwenkantolo njengamanje kanjalo nalowo owayeyikhansela owabulawa, kwakungafanele. Uthe ukulimala kwabagilwa kuyamene nezingxabano zomndeni wabo nomunye umndeni osendaweni."UNganono noMnqobi bazithola begaxela kuleli cala ngoba babephusha eyokuthi kuboshwe amalungu ale mindeni yomibili njengoba yayikhathaza ngobugebengu bokubulawa kwabantu eMid-Illovo.Udalule ukuthi uMnqobi njengoba ehamba leli cala, kukhona amanye ayisithupha okukhona kuwo awokubulala nawokuzama ukubulala aphume phambili kuwo. "Ubevele afakwe nje kulawo macala, ekubeni ingekho into emhlanganisa nawo, lithi uma seliqhubeka enkantolo, limkhiphe phambili. Nakuleli, kwenzeka okufanayo,” kusho umthombo.Uthe basola ukuthi kukhona abantu abakhokhela amaphoyisa ukuze kuvikelwe abasolwa bangempela, bangaboshwa.Ubalule nokuthi uyise woyedwa wabagilwa uphila ngokucasha njengoba efunwa ngamaphoyisa ngamanye amacala abucayi. Uthe kubukeka abagilwa bengeke babuthole ubulungiswa ngoba amaphoyisa alonile icala.
KUNOLUNYE uphenyo olusaqhubeka mayelana necala labomndeni abathathu abathweswe icala lokubulala isihlobo besisola ngokweba isibhamu.Kuleli cala kuboshwe abasolwa abathathu okunguMnuz Sibongiseni Kunene (51), yindodana yakhe uMnuz Siyabonga Mhlongo (31) nendodakazi yakhe uNksz Amanda Mhlongo (28).Bobathathu basolwa ngokubulala uMnuz Sphiwe "Mapi" Ndlanzi (39), esigamekweni esenzeka kwaK KwaMashu ezinyangeni ezedlule.Kuthiwa babemsola ngokweba isibhamu sikakuNene, okwabuye kwavela ukuthi wayekade esibambise umnikazi wendawo yokucima ukona, ebona ukuthi "usedle kakhulu amanzi amponjwana".Izolo eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseNtuzuma kuvele ukuthi kusekhona olunye uphenyo oluqhubekayo ngaleli cala.UMshushisi kuleli cala uNksz B Mncwango uthe kusaphenywa, kwabe sekuvunyelwana ngokuthi lihlehliselwe uDisemba 15.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi laba bangaphakathi ngemuva kokuba le nkantolo yabachitha esicelweni sabo sebheyili.Imantshi yabeka izizathu ezihlukene eyathi yizona ezibuyekezile yase ibona kumqoka kakhulu ukuba laba bagcinwe ngaphakathi.Phakathi kokunye yasola laba abathathu ngokuhubhuza akabhejane ngesikhathi benza izicelo zabo zebheyili. Yabasola ngokuthi kuningi abakusho okwakungamampunge ngoba nakhu befuna ukuthola ibheyili.Yathi baqamba amanga ngokuba nezifo ezingamahlalakhona ngoba behluleka ukuvezela inkantolo ubufakazi balokho.Yaphinde yabasola nangokuthi behluleka ukulethela inkantolo ubufakazi obuphathekayo bokuthi kukhona lapho abasebenza khona.Yaveza nokuthi kungenzeka kuholele ekutheni kube nodungunyane emphakathini ukudedelwa kwabo. Yagcizelela ukuthi umphakathi unengekile, kungenzeka ufune ukubadla luhlaza uma bededelwa ngebheyili.Ngenxa yalokho yathi ikhetha ukuthi iphephise impilo yabo ngokubagcina ngaphakathi.IMantshi yalichithitha iphuzu labo lokuthi basezikhindini nje yingoba bawumhlatshelo wodungunyane ababethi lukhona phakathi kwe-ANC neMKP KwaMashu.Yathi lokhu ukukhuluma okungenasisekelo futhi okungenayo incazelo egcwele."Niqamba amanga nithi nilapha nje kungenxa yokuthi kusaqhubeka ukungaboni ngasolinye phakathi kwalawa maqembu womabili. Uma kuya ngokuthi lokho kuyiqiniso pho kungani kuhlangene abantu bawo womabili enkantolo?" kwasho imantshi.Njengenjwayelo nayizolo ubukhona umphakathi ubhikisha ngaphandle kwenkantolo.
AKUCACI ukuthi lusazokhuza ibuya ngonyaka ozayo yini, uhlelo loMnyango weMfundo eyisiSekelo lwabebesiza ezikoleni zakuleli. Lolu hlelo olwaba wumbono kaMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, beluhlanganisa iminyango ehlukene okubalwa owezabaSebenzi, okaMgcinimafa, neminye. Izinkontileka zabebesiza ziphele ngenyanga edlule kanti kuthiwa ngeke zilulwe.Lokhu kuvezwe nguNkk Lala Maje, umqondisi walolu hlelo eMnyangweni weMfundo eyisiSekelo, ochithe ukuthi izinkontileka zizolulwa.Uthe kungamampunge ukuthi izinkontileka zabasizi zizolulwa."Sazisa abasizi ukuthi bangalaleli abantu ababatshela amanga ukuthi izinkontileka zabo zizolulwa kuze kube wuDisemba. Ziphele ngenyanga edlule lezi zinkontileka kanti okwamanje akucaci ukuthi ngonyaka ozayo luzobakhona yini lolu hlelo. Asikatholi siqinisekiso esivela kuMgcinimafa ukuthi izobakhona imali yokuluxhasa uhlelo ngonyaka ozayo," usho kanje. Lolu hlelo obekuyihlandla lesihlanu lukhona, luhlomise ngolwazi intsha eyevile ku-200 000, ecijwe ngamakhono izinyanga eziyisithupha. Luqale ngoJuni kulo nyaka.UNgqongqoshe weMfundo eyisiSekelo, uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, uthe kuhlomule inqwaba yentsha yesifazane, ezikoleni ezevile ku-20 000 kulolu hlelo.Uthe zinyanga zonke bekukhokhwa u-R795 million, okuyimali ebisiza kakhulu intsha ebingatohozi."Kusuka ngo-2020 lolu hlelo lwaqala, luhlomulise intsha ngesipiliyoni nangamathuba omsebenzi. nabafundi bazuze kakhulu ngokuba nalaba basizi abebenza imisebenzi ehlukene ezikoleni." Abanye babasizi bebegxile ezinhlelweni zokuqinisekisa ukuthi abafundi bayakwazi ukuqonda abakufundayo.Uveze ukuthi bamatasa nombiko oveza ukuthi lolu hlelo lube nomthelela ongakanani ezikoleni."Sethemba ukuthi ngomuso lo mbiko uzosiza ekutheni sazi lapho okumele siqinise khona kwezemfundo. Kanjalo nentsha ethole ithuba lokuba yingxenye yohlelo sethemba ukuthi ulwazi elutholile izokwazi ukulusebenzisa lapho iya khona." Lolu hlelo luke lwagajwa yizinkinga ebeziphathisa izikhulu zomnyango ngekhanda. Bezihlale zikuveza ePhalamende ukuthi izinselelo ekukhokheni ngesikhathi, kuziphathisa ngekhanda.Abanye abasizi bakhala ngokuthi abaholanga ngenxa yokuthi kwakubambezeleke ukuthi kubhekwe ama-rejista, ayeveza ukuthi bebeya emsebenzini nsuku zonke.Intsha ebisiza kulolu hlelo iyalelwe ukuthi iye esikhwameni esinxephezela abebesebenza ukuze iyothola imali kapoyinandi, ebibanjwa zinyanga zonke.
UNOBHALA jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, uthi ingqungquthela yenhlangano ezokuba ngelizayo, iNational General Council (NGC), ayibizelwe ukuzoketula uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa.UMbalula uphike ukuthi kunetulo lokuketula uRamaphosa.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba ngemva komhlangano wesigungu esiphezulu okhethekile.Umhlangano okhethekile ububizelwe ukuzoxoxa ngamalungiselelo engqungquthela.UMbalula uthe bayameseka uRamaphosa okuvela ukuthi kunetulo lokumkhipha esikhundleni."Awukho nakancane umbango wezikhundla lapha kwi-ANC. Akukho mbango lapha, sibumbene. Amampunge nje lawa aqanjwa abantu abangaphakathi kanye nabangaphandle kwe-ANC abafuna ukuhlakaza inhlangano. Okubalulekile kuthina ukwakha kabusha i-ANC. Abantu abanendaba nombango wezikhundla. Lesi akusona isikhathi sokukhuluma ngombango wezikhundla. Asikwazi ukulibala ukubanga izikhundla ekubeni sibhekene nezinkinga ezingaka."UMbalula uthe amahlebezi etulo awamphazamisi nakancane uRamaphosa emsebenzini wakhe."Uyaqhubeka nokwenza umsebenzi awunikiwe wokuhola i-ANC. Uyawazi umsebenzi awuqokelwe."UMbalula uthe ingqungquthela izobheka ibanga eselihanjiwe ekufezeni okwakuvunyelwene ngakho engqungqutheleni yokukhetha ubuholi eyayingo-2022."I-NGC iyithuba lokucobelelana ngolwazi. Ngempelasonto izifundazwe bezinemihlangano yokulungiselela iNGC. Into egqame kakhulu ugqozi lokwakha kabusha i-ANC. Into ehamba phambili ukuba sibuyisele i-ANC emandleni. Zonke izithunywa zizonikwa ithuba lokuba zilethe imibono futhi nalabo abanemibono eyehlukile nabo bazonikwa ithuba lokuba bakhulume."UMbalula uphinde waveza ukuthi sebeliphosile ithawula emizamweni yabo yokunxenxa idlelandawonye layo, iSACP, ukuba lingalingeneli ukhetho ngokuzimela.UMbalula uthe abaholi beSACP babatshele emehlweni ukuthi abaguquki esinqumweni sabo sokungenela ukhetho lohulumeni basekhaya ngokuzimela."Bayinhlangano ezimele, lesi yisinqumo abazithathele sona. Uma besho bathi isinqumo sabo asisho ukuthi abaseyona ingxenye yamadlelandawonye. Thina into esizoyenza sizoqhubeka nezinhlelo zethu zokungenela ukhetho."UMbalula uthe isinqumo seSACP sizodala indida kulabo abanobulungu be-ANC kanye nobamaKhomanisi."Lolu daba aluthinti nje i-ANC kuphela kodwa luthinta amadlelandawonye. Lesi sinqumo sisho izinto eziningi. Kufanele silubheke kabanzi lolu daba. Sizokwethula umbiko ozochaza kabanzi ngesimo samadlelandawonye ikakhulukazi isinqumo seSACP sokungenela ukhetho ngokuzimela."
UNGQONGQOSHE wezamaPhoyisa omisiwe, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, ulaxazwe ithimba labameli ayegadla ngalo ngesikhathi enethwa yimvula phambi kwekomiti lasePhalamende eliphenya izinsolo ezenziwa uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi.UMchunu ufike nethimba labameli abasha ngesikhathi evele phambi kweKhomishini kaMadlanga ephenya izinsolo ezifanayo, izolo.Ithimba likaMchunu elisha liholwa ummeli odumile, u-Advocate Tembeka Ngcukaitobi.UMchunu wathwala kanzima ngesikhathi evele phambi kwekomiti lasePhalamende.Kwaba khona izikhawu lapho khona amalungu ePhalamende asola abameli bakaMchunu ngokumhlinzela ezibini.Kwagcina kugxekwa abameli bakaMchunu emva kokuba elethe umbiko ongamampunge owawuthi kwadutshulwa kwabulawa owayengusomlomo kuMasipala wase-OR Tambo, uMnuz Xolile Nkompela. UNkompela usahla anhlamvana.UMchunu uqale ukwethula ubufakazi emini, uthathe isikhathi esicishe sibe ngamahora amabili.Uqhubekile nokuvikela isinqumo sakhe sokukhipha umyalelo wokuba kuhlakazwe ithimba lamaphoyisa eliphenya ukubulawa kosopolitiki KwaZulu-Natal.UMchunu uthe ithimba elasungulwa ngo-2018 emva kokunyuka kwezigameko zokubulawa kosopolitiki KwaZulu-Natal lalingadalelwe ukuba lisebenze ungunaphakade.UMchunu utshele ikhomishini eholwa iJaji Mbuyiseli Madlanga ukuthi kufanele engabe ithimba lagcina ukusebenza ngo-2022."Kwakungashiwongo ukuthi ithimba selizokuba uhlaka lwamaphoyisa olungungunaphakade. Ithimba kwakufanele lisebenze unyaka owodwa kodwa lalilokhu lilulelwa isikhathi sokusebenza ngonyaka. Ngo-2022 akuzange kube khona isicelo sokuba kululwe isikhathi sokusebenza kwethimba. Ithimba laqhubeka lasebenza iminyaka emibili yonke ekubeni yayingekho into eyayiligunyaza ukuthi liqhubeke nokusebenza."UMchunu uthe ukuqhubeka kwethimba labelwe imali emva kuka-2022 kuphambene nemigomo ebekelwe ukusebenza kwemali njengoba lalingagunyaziwe ukuthi liqhubeke nokusebenza.Uthe isinqumo sokuhlakaza ithimba kwakufanele sithathwe nguyena ngoba isinqumo sokuthi lisungulwe sasithathwe abaholi bezepolitiki."Ithimba lasungulwa emva kwesinqumo esathathwa abaholi bezepolitiki, kwakungesona isinqumo sezikhulu zamaphoyisa. Ukhomishana wamaphoyisa unawo amandla okusungula ithimba kodwa leli lalingasungulwanga wuyena."UMchunu uthe sasingekho isidingo sokuthi ithimba liqhubeke nokusebenza ngoba kwakunezinhlelo zokuthi kusungulwe izinhlaka zamaphoyisa ezikhethekile ezazizophenya amacala ahlukene."Sasingekho isidingo sokuthi ithimba liqhubeke nokusebenza ngoba lenza umsebenzi ofanayo nolunye lwalezinhlaka ezazizosungulwa."UMchunu uthe wayengajabule ngendlela ithimba elalisebenzisa ngayo izigidi zamaRandi elalizabelwa.UMchunu uthe yayingekho indlela yokulandelela ukuthi ithimba liyisebenzisa kanjani imali elaliyabelwa.UMchunu uthe kwakungamphethe kahle ukuthi umholi wethimba, uLieutenant General Dumisani Khumalo, wayephethe izikhundla ezimbili.UKhumalo uphinde abe yisikhulu sezinhloli."Ngayikhuluma lena. Ngibona sengathi kwaba yiphutha ukuthi anikezwe izikhundla ezimbili."

ISILO uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini sesiphinde saqoka uMphathiswa wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana kanye neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, ukuba abe undunankulu kaZulu. "UMendlula akekho enkantolo, uveza ukuthi kukhona isifo emndenini. Akekho isonto lonke," esho.

NgoLwesibili, amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal abophe umsolwa oneminyaka engu-35 ubudala eVerulam ngokutholakala nempahla okusolakala ukuthi yebiwe kanye nelokutholakala nezibhamu ezingekho emthethweni.Ngezithuba zabo-11:00 ngoLwesibili, inkampani elandela umkhondo wezimoto icoshe uphawu lwemoto eyebiwe iphuma eMlaza ilibangise enyakatho ihamba ku-N2.Le nkampani ijahe le moto izama ukuyivimba kwangenelela amaphoyisa. Kuthe sekungenelela inkampani yonogada ezimele eVerulam izama ukumisa le moto, umgibeli obengaphakathi uvulele ngenhlamvu ebhekise konogada kwalimala unogada oyedwa emlenzeni. Abasolwa baqhubekile nokubaleka kodwa bagcine bebanjwe eClerence Park ngamalungu eProvincial Task Team kanjalo neDurban K9. Abasolwa bashiye imoto babaleka ngezinyawo bangena ehlathini.Ukuhlolisiswa kwemoto eshiyiwe kuholele ekutholakaleni kwesibhamu esisodwa (1) esinezinhlamvu ezingaphezu kwekhulu (100). Amalungu e-K9 angene ehlathini ethungatha abasolwa. Ngesikhathi kuseshwa, kuboshwe umsolwa oyedwa obephethe isibhamu sohlobo lwe-AK47 nezinhlamvu ezingamashumi ayisithupha (60). Umsolwa oboshiwe uzothweswa icala lokutholakala nesibhamu esingekho emthethweni kanye nokutholakala nempahla okusolakala ukuthi yebiwe. Uzovela eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseVerulam ngoLwesithathu, 3 November 2025. Amaphoyisa asathungatha umsolwa wesibili.

Uthe umnyango uzoqhubela nokuqapha isimo sikanogada olinyaziwe, wathi ngemicabango nangemikhuleko bakanye nomndeni wakhe ngalesi sikhathi esinzima.
KUZOQHILIKA izihlathi ebantwini abebeke imali yabo ebhange likahulumeni eselavalwa Ithala, kulandela ukuthi uMgcinimafa esekhulule isamba semali yabo elinganiselwa ku-R2.2 billion.Lokho kudalulwe nguNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thamsanqa Ntuli, esithangamini sabezindaba abesenzele eThekwini, izolo. Uqinisekise ukuthi abantu bazobuyiselwa imali yabo ngaphambi kukaKhisimuzi wanonyaka.Bangaphezu kwa-250 000 abantu abebelinde imali eThala kusukela ngo-2023, ngenkathi uphiko lweBhange loMbuso iPrudential Authority (PA) lunquma ukuvala wonke ama-akhawunti abo, kwanqunywa nokuthi leli bhange liyavalwa.UNtuli uthe ukukhululwa kwale mali kusho ukuthi wonke amakhasimende abegcine imali yabo eThala azonikwa okungokwawo. "Kuyintokozo enkulu ukumemezela ukuthi sesifike esigabeni lapho osekuphethwe khona zonke izivumelwano malungana nalolu daba okuzokwenza ukuthi kuqale uhlelo lokubuyisela abantu imali yabo. Lokhu kuzokwehlisa umthwalo ebantwini nakuhulumeni uqobo, bese futhi kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bathola imali yabo ungakashayi uKhisimuzi," usho kanje.UNdunankulu uxolisile ebantwini, isemabhizinisini nakubona bonke abathikanyezwe yilesi simo, wase ethembisa ukuthi uhulumeni uzoqinisekisa ukuthi into enjena ayiphinde yenzeke.Uchaze Ithala ngokuthi bekungelona ibhange elifana namanye, kepha ebeliwusizo kakhulu esifundazweni ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bagcina futhi batshale imali yabo ngendlela efanele, nobekusiza ukukhulisa umnotho.Uthe Ithala liyohlale linomlando osemqoka weqhaza elilibambile ukweseka osomabhizinisi abaziwayo, abasafufusa nomphakathi nje wonkana ngezezimali.UMphathiswa woMnyango wezeziMali, uMnuz Francois Rodgers, yena uthe ngale kwale mali ezobuyiselwa ebantwni, Ithala belinemali ewu-R1 billion engeyalo, kube wu-R1.9 billion osemabhukwini ezikweletu no-R3.5 billion wempahla yalo.Izinkinga zeThala ziqale ngo-2022 ngenkathi iPA imemezela ukuthi yayingeke isayivuselela inkontileka yokusebenza kwalo, eyayivumela ukuthi likwazi ukusebenza njengebhange elizimele libe lingenazo izincwadi ezigunyaza lokho.Kuthe ngenkathi lezo zincwadi zokugunyaza lokho ziphelelwa yisikhathi ngo-2023, kwacaca ukuthi lase lisebenza ngokungengemthetho, okwaholela ekutheni kubanjwe yonke imali ebibekwe kulona, kwangavunyelwa muntu ukuyifaka noma ukuyikhipha.Isimemezelo sikaNtuli kulindeleke ukuthi sijabulise abantu abaningi abagcine imali yabo eThala abebehlale beshayela Isolezwe bebuba ngokusingathwa kodaba lwaleli bhange. Iningi belihlale likhala ngokuthi impilo imile ngoba alikwazi ukuthola imali eliyilondolozile. Nosomabhizinisi abancane nabakhulu bakhihla esikaNandi ngokungakwazi ukuqhubeka nokuboleka imali eThala njengoba belaziwa ngokubabhekelela.

KUJIKA izinto emkhakheni wezemfundo kuleli njengoba kutshalwe imali yokufukula imfundo esemazingeni aphansi ukuze kuqedwe ngenkinga yabafundi abafika emazingeni aphezulu, bengazi lutho.Lokhu kulandela ukwethulwa kwesikhwama esizoxhasa abafundi be-Early Childhood Development (ECD), ngengqalasizinda esezingeni, ukucijwa kwabafundisa lo mkhakha kanjalo nangezinye izinsiza.UNgqongqoshe wezeMfundo, uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, umemezele ukuthi lesi sikhwama sixhaswe ngo-R496 million, emcimbini obuseGoli izolo. "Ngakho njengoba kunjena nje ezweni lethu, lapho sibona kuqhubeka kwanda izigameko zokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane nsuku zonke, ngifisa ukuthi sakhele phezu kwalokho komasipala enibaholayo. Abaguqulwe babe sesimeni esizokwenza ukuthi bonke abesifazane nezingane bazizwe bephephile, futhi bengenakwesaba," kusho yena. Eqhuba, uthe bewuhulumeni bayalibona iqhaza elibanjwa yiSALGA ukuqinisekisa inhlalakahle nentuthuko yomphakathi, nathe nokho kusekhona okudingeka ukuthi kwenziwe ukufeza inhloso yokwakha umphakathi obumbene nonengqubekelaphambili. "Okunye okumqoka wukunciphisa igebe elikhona phakathi kwabaholi bomphakathi nabantu bomphakathi ababaholayo ngoba yilokho okunqinda ukuthi kuyiwe phambili. Sikholwa wukuthi uma kungaqina ubudlelwano kulezi zinhlaka zombili kungaba lula ukulungisa ezinye izinto nezimo ezihlale zikhalisa abantu emiphakathini," kusho uMashatile. Udalule nokuthi bewuhulumeni bayakweseka ukuthi kuphuthunyiswe uhlelo lokuqeqeshwa kwamakhansela nabanye abaholi bohulumeni basemakhaya ukusiza ukugwema izingqinamba ezidalwa wukuthi baswele ulwazi lwezinto nezimo ezithile ezidinga imfundo."Njengoba sesidlule eminyakeni ewu-30 sathola inkululeko, kumele siqale futhi manje sisebenzele ukuthi eminyakeni ewu-30 ezayo kusukela manje kube sekukuningi kakhulu okuhle esiyobe sesikwenzile nesiziqhenyayo ngakho," kukhuthaza uMashatile. Kule ngqungquthela eba khona njalo uma sekusondele isikhathi sokuqoka ubuholi obusha bohulumeni basemakhaya, okuzoqokwa ngonyaka ozayo - bekuhlangene abaholi bomasipala abawu-257 bezindawo ezingaphezu kuka-500 ukubhunga ngezinto nezimo ezithikameza ukusebenza komasipala, nokuthi yikuphi okumele kwenziwe ukuletha uguquko nentuthuko emphakathini. Indikimba yayo yanonyaka ibithi Empowering Municipalities To Drive South Africa's Growth Agenda Through Economic Resillence and Sustainable Service Delivery, okusho ukuthi bekubhekwe kakhulu ukucebisana ngamasu okufukula umnotho, nokunikezela ngezidingo zomphakathi ngendlela egculisayo newufanele.
KUSINDA kwehlela kwi-MK efuna ukuketula uNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, njengoba i-ANC isiphumele obala yathi ngeke iseseke isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNtuli.Umgqugquzeli wethimba lesikhashana elihola i-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Mike Mabuyakhulu, uthe basazohlala kuhulumeni wesifundazwe oholwa yi-IFP.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabeSABC kunomhlangano wokulungiselela ingqungquthela ye-ANC kazwelonke, iNational General Council (NGC), ezokuba kule nyanga.Umhlangano we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal ubungoMgqibelo, eThekwini.I-MK ifake isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNtuli esizolalelwa ngoDisemba 15. I-MK inezihlalo ezingu-37 kwezingu-80 esiShayamthetho.Ukuze siphase isiphakamiso sayo idinga ukwesekwa elilodwa lamaqembu akuhulumeni wokubambisana kanti iqembu elingekho kuhulumeni wokubambisana, i-EFF, selishilo ukuthi ngeke liseseke isiphakamiso sokukhipha uNtuli.Amanye amaqembu ayingxenye kahulumeni wokubambisana yiDA neNFP. I-DA ayiseseki isiphakamiso sokukhipha uNtuli kanti iNFP ihlukene phakathi.I-ANC ike yakhombisa ukuba manqika ukuqhubeka nokuhlala kuhulumeni wokubambisana ngesikhathi i-IFP iketula imeya yesifunda uMkhanyakude, uMnuz Siphile Mdaka.Kepha manje kubukeka i-ANC ne-IFP sebekulungisile "ukukhuluma kwegceke" njengoba uMdaka esebuyiselwe esikhundleni.UMabuyakhulu uthe abazimisele ukushiya kuhulumeni wesifundazwe."Kunezizathu ezasenza sangena kuhulumeni wesifundazwe, futhi kunezivumelwano esazisayina ngesikhathi singena. Izizathu ezasenza sangena kuhulumeni wesifundazwe azikashintshi nanamhlanje. Yingakho sisazoqhubeka sibe yingxenye kahulumeni wesifundazwe. Sizoqhubeka nokuhlonipha izivumelwano esazenza ngesikhathi singena kuhulumeni wesifundazwe."Kulindeleke ukuthi kume yonke into emigwaqweni eseduze nesiShayamthetho uma sekulalelwa isiphakamiso seMK.Ngeledlule amalungu eMK nawe-IFP ayeqhudelana ngemibhikisho ngaphandle kwesiShayamthetho.Amalungu eMK ayenombhikisho lapho ayefaka khona ingcindezi yokuba kuxoshwe uNtuli.Amalungu e-IFP nawo ayenowawo umbhikisho ngaphesheya komgwaqo lapho ayefunga egomela ethi uNtuli ngeke aphume esikhundleni.Kwasiza amaphoyisa alamula amalungu alamaqembu ayesefuna ukubambana ngezandla.
UMENGAMELI Cyril Ramaphosa uthi ushaye phansi kwashunqa uthuli uMengameli waseMelika, uDonald Trump, osanda kumemezela ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika ayamukelekile emhlanganweni wamazwe angaphansi kweG20 ozobanjelwa eMelika ngonyaka ozayo. URamaphosa uthe akukho okuzovimba iNingizimu Afrika ukuthi ibe yingxenye yeG20 elandelayo.Ukusho lokhu enkulumeni abeyibhekise esizweni izolo ebusuku. UTrump usanda kumemezela ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika ngeke imenywe emhlanganweni weG20 ekhala ngokuthi leli zwe liphuca amabhunu umhlaba. IMelika yawuduba umhlangano weG20 obuseNingizimu Afrika, nakhona yakhala ngokunyathelwa kwamalungelo amabhunu. URamaphosa uthe kungamampunge ukuthi kubulawa noma kuphucwa amabhunu umhlaba wawo.URamaphosa uthe iNingizimu Afrika izoba yingxenye yeG20 elandelayo."Kufanele bazi ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika isemazweni asungula iG20. Njengamanje siyilungu leG20. Sizoqhubeka nokuba yingxenye yeG20, akukho okuzovimba ukuthi sibe yayo. Nakuba sinezinkinga noTrump kodwa lokho akukushintshi ukuthi sinobuhlobo neMelika. Sisuka kude neMelika futhi sizoqhubeka sisebenzisane nayo."URamaphosa uthe umhlangano weG20 obukuleli ngeledlule ube yimpumelelo."Abantu abawuvali umlomo. Izincomo eziqhamuka kubaholi basemazweni ahlukene zilokhu zingene njalo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana. Abantu abebehambele iG20 bancoma abantu bakuleli ngokukhombisa ubuntu. Ngiyanibonga bantu baseNingizimu Afrika ngokuphatha kahle izivakashi zethu."URamaphosa uthe ukubanjelwa kweG20 kuleli kuzothuthukisa abantu . "Sithathe izinqumo ezizothuthukisa impilo yabantu. Sithathe izinqumo zokubhekana nezinto ezivimba ukukhula kwamazwe kwezomnotho. Enye inkinga enkulu evimba ukudlondlobala kwamazwe wudaba lwezikweletu. Amazwe amaningi acwile ezikweletwini, kuthatha isikhathi eside ukuthi akwazi ukukhokhela izikweletu ngenxa yenzalo enkulu."
Abasolwa abathathu badutshulwe balimala kabi kwalimala abanye abathathu ngesikhathi bedubulana namaphoyisa endaweni yasePhelandaba eManguzi ngeSonto.Amaphoyisa abethungatha abasolwa abebefunelwa amacala amathathu okubulala enziwa eManguzi ngo-2023 nelinye elokubulala elenzeka eNgwavuma ngo-Okthoba 2025.Amaphoyisa athole umbiko wezobunhloli ukuthi abasolwa abebefuneka basePhelandaba okuthe uma amaphoyisa efika kubo abasolwa badubula bebhekise emaphoyiseni.Ukuze azivikele bona nezinye izakhamuzi ezingenacala, amaphoyisa aphendule ngenhlamvu kwase kuba nokudubulana.Ngesikhathi sokudubulana, abasolwa ababili badutshulwe bafa endaweni yesigameko. Abasolwa abane baphuthunyiswe esikhungweni sezempilo esiseduzane lapho kutholwe khona umsolwa oyedwa eshonile.Kutholwe izibhamu ezimbili kubasolwa. Esinye sazo sadalulwa kancane kwathi uphenyo lokuqala luveza ukuthi esinye isibhamu samaphoyisa okwabikwa ukuthi esalahleka eNewlands East ngo-April 2009.Amarekhodi amaphoyisa aphinde aveza ukuthi sona leso sibhamu satholwa esiteshini samaphoyisa eNhlanhleni ngo-2010 kanti uphenyo lusaqhubeka ukuze kutholakale ukuthi lesi sibhamu saphinde satholakala kanjani.Labo abazotholakala benecala ngobudedengu nanoma yisiphi isenzo sobugebengu bazobhekana nengalo yomthetho.
PHEZU kokuba kuhambe kahle ukubhalwa kwezivivinyo zika-matric kuleli, kodwa uMnyango weMfundo eyisiSekelo ukhathazekile ngokwanda kwesibalo sabafundi abebegula ngesikhathi kubhalwa, abanye bebenokhwantalala.Lokhu kuvezwe nguNgqongqoshe walo mnyango, uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, njengoba kuphothulwe ukubhalwa kwalezi zivivinyo. Izolo abafundi abambalwa abangakwazanga ukubhala iComputer ne-Information Technology, banikwe elinye ithuba lokuphinde babhale lezi zifundo.KwaZulu-Natal kubikwe izehlakalo ezimbalwa okubalwa imibhikisho yomphakathi owawukhala ngezidingo, ukushiswa kwesikole iMpolweni Secondary, umfundi owaba sengozini yemoto wagcina engabhalanga, umfundi owashisa omunye ngamanzi kubangwa isoka okwenza isisulu sangakwazi ukuqhubeka sibhale. UNksz Gwarube uthe phezu kwezingqinamba ezibekhona kodwa izivivinyo ziqedwe ngaphandle kwezinkinga."Kube nezinhlelo zokululeka abafundi abebenokhwantalala, bagcina bekwazile ukubhala. Abanye babhalele ezibhedlela kanti abanye banxuse ukubhalela kwezinye izindawo ngenxa yezinkinga. Sikhathazekile ngezehlakalo zobugebengu abafundi babanjwa inkunzi beyofunda ebusuku nemibhikisho yomphakathi kwezinye izindawo," usho kanje.UMphathiswa wezeMfundo esifundazweni uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka, uthe noma zibekhona izehlakalo ezenzekile ngesikhathi kubhalwa, kodwa aziphazamisanga ukubhala."Noma zibekhona izehlakalo ezimbalwa ezibikiwe esifundazweni, kodwa akuzange kuphazamiseke ukubhalwa kwezivivinyo. Abangazange babhale bazophinde banikwe elinye ithuba lokubhala ezivivinyweni zangoJuni, ngonyaka ozayo," usho kanje. Uthe ukumaka kuzoqala ezikhungweni ezingu-32 ngesonto elizayo."Ukumaka kuqala ngoDisemba 2, kuphothulwa ngoDisemba 12. Bangu-7 889 abamakayo kanti kukhona nabasiza ngesikhathi sokumaka. Angu-1 578 ama-Senior Markers, abengu-835 ama-Chief Markers."Kuzwelonke bangu-52 000 abamakayo.UHlomuka ukhale ngabebelovile kubhalwa wathi bangu-2%. Bangu-195 592 abafundi ababhalisele leli banga. Kulaba abangu-180 454 bebebhala ngokugcwele, abangu-15 047 bebhala ngasese.Kunxuswe abakwa-matric ukuthi bangaqale babhiyoze njengoba kusalindwe imiphumela. Ababhekene nokhwantalala, umnyango uthe kunosizo lokubeluleka ngokwengqondo. Abalinde imiphumela baphinde banxuswa ukuthi bangawenzi amaphathi okubhiyozela ukuphothula ukubhala, adume ngama-pens down.
UBUHOLI bomasipala basemakhaya buphonselwe inselelo yokuthi bubambisane nezinhlaka zohulumeni ikakhulu uMnyango wezeziMali okuzosiza ngokuthi ukusebenza kwabo kungabi nazihibe futhi kube ngokufanele nokubeka phambili inhlalakahle yomphakathi.Lokho kushiwo wuNgqongqoshe woMnyango wezeziMali, uMnuz Enock Godongwana, ekhuluma kwesinye sezigcawu esenzeke osukwini lwesibili lwengqungquthela yobuholi bomasipala basemakhaya ehlelwa wuhlaka iSouth African Local Government Association ebise-ICC, eThekwini izolo, nezosongwa namhlanje ntambama.Kule ngqungquthela eba khona njalo uma sekusondele isikhathi sokuqoka ubuholi obusha bohulumeni wasemakhaya okuzoba ngonyaka ozayo, kubhungwa ngezinto nezimo ezihlukene ezithiya ukusebenza komasipala basemakhaya. Lokhu kufakazelwa yindikimba yawo yanonyaka ethi Empowering Municipalities To Drive South Africa's Growth Agenda Through Economic Resillience and Sustainable Service Delivery. UGodongwana uphonsele omasipala inselelo yokuthi babambisane nomnyango awuholayo wezezimali nezinye izinhlaka zohulumeni ukusiza ukwehlisa umthwalo wokulindeleke kubona."Lokho kumele bakwenze ngokuqikelela ukuthi ingqalasizinda esisiza ngayo kubona bayisebenzisa ngobuchule nangokucophelela. Lokhu kungasiza ukuthi singabuyeli emuva njalo emsebenzini esiwenzayo naseqhazeni esihlale silibamba ukubalekelela. Kuyasikhathaza ukuthi njalo sihlale sinikezela ngosizo lwezezimali kubona, kepha futhi akwenzeki kungabi bikho lapho okuba nongcobo khona endleleni abayisebenzisa ngayo," usho kanje.Inhloko yophiko lwezezimali lweDurban Chamber of Commerce, uMnuz Mike Raftery, ithe kudingeka kube nohlelo lwemithetho ezokwenza ukuthi kube seqhulwini ukutshala imali ezokwenza kwakheke amathuba emisebenzi emphakathini. Ithe okunye okumqoka wukuxhaswa kosomabhizinisi abasafufusa emphakathini okuzosiza ngokuthi abantu bakwazi ukuzimela."Ngaleyo ndlela kuzoba lula kosomabhizinisi abasafufusa ukuthola amathuba okuchuma, nokuthi kubekwe eqhulwini ubumqoka bokuthuthukisa imboni yezokuvakasha. Lezi ngezinye zezinto esibona ukuthi zingasiza ukwehlisa umthwalo kwabahola omasipala," kusho uRaftery.IPhini likaNgqongqoshe woMnyango wokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zaboMdabu, uDkt Namane Dickson, libeke umbono wokuthi makuqiniswe uhlelo lokukhuthaza amakhansela nabaholi bomphakathi komasipala basemakhaya ukuthi bagxile emfundweni."Ukwenza njalo kuzosiza ukuthi lowo nalowo msebenzi kamasipala awuqonde ngokugcwele nangokuphelele umsebenzi asuke eqashelwe wona. Kuzosiza nangokunqanda inkinga yabasebenzi bomasipala okusobala ukuthi abawazi umsebenzi abawuqashelwe," kusho yena.
UNGQONGQOSHE woMnyango wokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu, uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa, usenqumele ugwayi katiki iminyango ehlukene yohulumeni wathi mayiphuthumise ukukhokhela bonke omasipala basemakhaya imali ebakweleta yona ukusiza ukugwema ukuthiyeka kokusebenza kwayo kwansuku zonke. UHlabisa usho njalo ethula inkulumo esigcawini sokusonga ingqungquthela yobuholi bohulumeni basemakhaya ehlelwa wuhlaka olulawula ukusebenza kwabo iSouth African Local Government Association (SALGA), esongwe e-ICC, eThekwini ngoLwesine."Lokho sizimisele ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kuyenzeka njengoba sesivele sihlalile nekhabinethi sabeka umbandela wokuthi lokhu esikushoyo kube sekwenzekile ngoJanuwari wonyaka ozayo, okuzothi uma kungenzeki kanjalo - senze indlela yokuthi omasipala abakweletwa yileyo minyango bazithathele ngokwabo leyo mali," kusho uHlabisa.Eqhuba, ungqongqoshe uthe wethemba ukuthi konke okubhungwe engqungqutheleni kuzosiza ukuthi wonke amacebo nemibono okuvele kuyona kusebenzele omasipala basemakhaya abawu-257 ukuze basebenzele umphakathi ngendlela efanele."Siyalibona igalelo lomasipala lokuphucula umphakathi, futhi siyakubonga ukusebenza ngokuzikhandla kwabo bonke abasebenzi bakhona. Nokho kumqoka futhi ukuveza ukuthi sikhathazekile ngenqwaba yomasipala abatholwe benogcobho, njengoba embikweni wonyakamali wango-2023/24 bewu-41% kuphela omasipala abathole umbiko ongenagcobho, kanjalo nokuthi bawu-140 okutholakale ukuthi basebenza bengenahlelo oluqondile lokusebenza, okungezinye zezinkinga ezidinga ukusukunyelwa," usho kanje.UHlabisa uthe babheke ukuthi kushaye uMashi ngonyaka ozayo sekunomehluko obonakalayo kuzona zonke lezo zinkinga ezinqinda ukusebenza komasipala basemakhaya ngendlela efanele, kubalwa nokunganikezelwa ngendlela efanele kwengqalasizinda."Sibheke ukusebenzisa konke esibonisane ngakho lana, kuhlanganiswe namaphuzu avele embuthanweni wabaholi bamazwe omhlaba iG20, esisanda kuba nawo kuleli zwe, nesikholwa wukuthi esikufundile futhi kwacetshiswana ngakho kuzolisiza kakhulu izwe lethu ukuthi lithuthuke futhi lidlondlobale kuneliyikho manje," kusho ungqongqoshe.Indikimba yengqungquthela yanonyaka ibithi Empowering Municipalities To Drive South Africa's Growth Agenda Through Economic Resillence and Sustainable Service Delivery, okusho ukuthi bekubhekwe kakhulu ukucebisana ngamasu okufukula umnotho, nokunikezela ngezidingo zomphakathi ngendlela egculisayo nefanele.
KUKHONA nomfundisi kwabakhalelwe ngamasongo kaSigonyela njengoba amaphoyisa eRoad Traffic Inspectorate (RTI) abenesivimbamgwaqo ezindaweni ezifaka iMpangeni, Sikhaleni naseRichards Bay. Ngokwesitatimende soMnyango wezokuThutha KwaZulu-Natal, bangu-226 sebebonke ababoshwe embhidlangweni wamaphoyisa kulezi zindawo. "ERichards Bay kuboshwe abangu-114, eSikhaleni baba ngu-58, baba ngu-55 eMpangeni," kusho isitatimende.Siqhube sathi kwababoshiwe kukhona umfundisi, yiphoyisa, udokotela, ujele, isicishamlilo, umshayeli weloli, othisha ababili nesitshudeni okuvela ukuthi sishaye iphoyisa lomgwaqo. Kwababoshiwe, kuphinde kube khona abangu-15 abangabokufika abangenamaphepha.Kwisivimbamgwaqo saseSikhaleni, owesilisa ukhihle isililo, eboshwa emva kokubanjwa ishayela iphuzile. Ngokusho kwesitatimende, kule ndawo ngoMgqibelo ebusuku, kumiswe imoto evele yakhala amaphepha, amaphoyisa ayilandela, aze ayivimba. "Amaphoyisa ayihubhe ayibamba indoda ebaleke imiswa, kwatholwa ukuthi ishayela iphuzile yakhalelwa ngamasongo kaSigonyela. Kuyimanje isezikhindini,” kusho isitatimende soMnyango wezokuThutha.Isitatimende somnyango besihambisana ne-video yendoda ebisevenini yamaphoyisa izwakala idinda isililo, ithi iyaxolisa. Ibilokho isho ngempongo, ithi iyaxolisa ngeke iphinde. Bekungaqali ukuthi kubanjwe umuntu akhihle isililo njengoba nangenyanga edlule, kwenzeke okufanayo ePort Shepstone. Khona kuboshwe owesifazane owayesolwa ngokushayela ephuzile ehamba nezingane. Naye waphenduka inhlekisa esehayiza waze wanesibibithwane esiteshini samaphoyisa ngenkathi sekusa ngokunye, esebona evalelwa ngempela. ERichards Bay ngoLwesihlanu, kubanjwe indoda engeyokudabuka eNigeria nezidakamizwa. Kuthiwa lo mlisa uzame ukuncenga amaphoyisa kepha amchitha walala ebaliwe. Kuthiwa amaphoyisa athe nxa esesha imoto yakhe athola izidakamizwa, wase ezama ukuqala inkulumo yokufuna ukugwaza kodwa waboshwa.Omunye umshayeli ubanjwe ephethe isibhamu esingekho emthethweni. Kuboshwe nomshayeli wetekisi obenesikali esiphezulu sotshwala egazini.Amaphoyisa eRTI abesebuya isibili eMpangeni, njengoba abekhona ngomkhankaso woMnyango wezokuThutha othi #NenzaniLaEzweni, okuboshwe kuwo ababalelwa ku-156 emasontweni amabili edlule.Emasontweni amabili edlule, eMtshezi, kuboshwe inqwaba ngokushayela iphuzile lapho okwabanjwa khona nephoyisa le-SAPS, okuthiwa laboshwa kabili izinsuku zilandelana ngokushayela liqhuba imbuzi.Kwahlaluka ukuthi inqwaba eyaboshwa eMtshezi, ngabantu besifazane. Kwavela ukuthi abanye besifazane bebeshayela bephuzile behamba nezingane ezimotweni. UMphathiswa wezokuThutha, uMnuz Siboniso Duma, uhlale eshumayela ivangeli lokuthi alufakwa emaphoyiseni eRTI, abantu mabangasho ukuthi abaxwayiswanga - ikakhulu njengoba kubhekwe esikhathini senjabulo yamaholidi okuphela konyaka. UDuma uhlale egcizelela ukuthi inhloso yabo enkulu wukunciphisa izingozi zomgwaqo ezidalwa abantu abashayela bethinte izinkamba.

Ngifuna lengezwe naleli cala bese ewajezela wonke,” usho kanje. Ulandise intatheli ngeziwombe ezinzima umndeni owabhekana nazo emva kokuba umgilwa ephume esibhedlela iNkosi Albert Luthuli Central, ahlala kuso izinyanga ezintathu."Ingane yayingakwazi ukuzibamba ize iyofika ethoyilethi uma iphisiwe. Yayivele izingcolisele. Sathi uma silandelela esibhedlela, sathola ubufakazi ngokwenzeka,” kusho uNkk Msweli.Ngosuku lwesigameko kuthiwa umgilwa okhulela kubo kanina wayevakashele kubo kayise ngesikhathi umsolwa emyenga ngokuyomthengela ama-chips esitolo. Kuthiwa sebesendleleni, wamjikela, wamkhomba ehlathini lapho afike wamnukubeza khona, wamklinya wase emshaya ngesikhali esingaziwa ebusweni, wamshiya ethi ufile. Umgilwa kuthiwa wabuye waphaphama ebusuku, wadwanguza, waze wayophumela emgwaqweni lapho athola khona abantu abamphuthumisa esibhedlela iKing Edward esiyaziwa ngeVictoria Mxenge, yona eyamdlulisela eNkosi Albert Luthuli Central.Kuthiwa ngesikhathi umsolwa ehlasela umgilwa wayemtshela ukuthi uyise (kamgilwa, ongumfowabo womsolwa) umjwayela kabi futhi ufuna ukumfundisa isifundo.Kunezinsolo ezingaqinisekisiwe ezithi wayemkweleta imali.
BAKHOMBA ngenjumbane uMasipala weTheku ngokubakweleta imali engaphezu kuka-R18.4 million, ababesebenza emadepho amabhasi amane alo mkhandlu eminyakeni eminingi eyedlule.Ngokusho kwabo, zingaphezu kuka-1 120 izisebenzi ezalahlekelwa wumsebenzi ngo-2003 ngesikhathi kushintshwa ukuphathwa kwezokuthutha zikamasipala, zinikwa inkampani ezimele. Laba basebenzi babengabashayeli bamabhasi, abezobuchwepheshe, omabhalane kanjalo nezimenenja. Babesebenza edepho esenkabeni yeTheku, Ntuzuma, uMlaza kanjalo neRossburgh. USihlalo we-Ebhodwe Transport Services, uMnuz Vusi Maduna, utshele Isolezwe ukuthi ngesikhathi kwenzeka lolu guquko, bona babefuna ukuqhubeka nomsebenzi ngaphansi kwenkampani entsha.Nokho uthe izikhulu zehhovisi lezokuthutha kumasipala zabeluleka ngokuthi bavume ukudilizwa ukuze babe sethubeni lokuba wosonkontileka abancane, abazosebenzisana nomasipala ngaphansi kwenkampani entsha eyayisizophatha ezokuthutha. Uthe kwabe sekuqokwa inkampani iRemant Alton Consortium ukuthi kube yiyo ephatha umsebenzi, yayizothola u-60% wemali, kuthi bona bathole u-30% bese osomatekisi bethola u-10%. "Ukuze sikwazi ukuba yingxenye kwakufanele siqongelele imali engu-R6.5 million. Kwaba abangu-329 kuphela esibalweni sika-1 120 abakhombisa ukulangazelela, bafaka u-R20 000 umuntu ngamunye,” kulandisa uMaduna.Uthe yilapho okwabe sekubhaliswa khona inkampani i-Ebhodwe Transport Services, yaba nabaninimasheya abangu-329.Uthe laba abanye abasebenzi ababesale ngaphandle kulo 329, baba nezikhalo, udaba lwagcina lungena enkantolo, bemelwe yiTheku Services Trust. Uthe kwagcina kwenziwa isivumelwano sangaphandle kwenkantolo esasithi i-Ebhodwe izodedela u-30% kwiTheku Services Trust, bese kuthi iRemant Alton Consortium ivumelana ne-Ebhodwe ukuthi linikwe umsebenzi wokukhanda amabhasi njengenkontileka encane. Uthe esinye isinqumo senkantolo esathathwa ngo-2006, esokuthi kusungulwe iDurban Transport Employees Trust entsha, eyayizohlomula u-30% womsebenzi, ifake bonke abasebenzi (1 120)."Abe-Ebhodwe neRamant Alton bangena esivumelwaneni sokubambisa ngomsebenzi wokunakekelwa kwamabhasi ngo-2007. Umasipala wawuyalelwe ukuthi ugade ukusebenza kwalesi sivumelwano. Kuze kube manje abasebenzi abakaze bathole ngisho isenti,” kusho uMaduna. Uthe bathi bayezwa, kwathiwa umasipala usuphinde wathenga amabhasi enkampanini iRamant Alton ngo-R405 million ngo-2008. Kwathi ngo-2009, kwamenyezelwa ukuthi inkampani iRamant Alton isivaliwe ngenxa yezinkinga zemali."Lokhu kwaba yisimemezelo esisimangazayo ngoba kwathi uma sibheka kuzo zonke izinkantolo, sasingekho isicelo esasifakiwe sokuthi ivalwe,” usho kanje. "Umasipala wehluleka ukujezisa inkampani ngokungazihloniphi izivumelwano zenkontileka yokusebenzisana. Abasebenzi bangathola lutho, ababonelelwanga ngalutho ngisho isivalwa le nkampani,” usho kanje.Uqhube wathi umasipala wathi usuka waqoka inkampani iMohamed Paruk neTansnat Bus Services ukuthi babheke umsebenzi wamabhasi.Uthe kwenzeka lokhu nje, i-Ebhodwe yayisenenkontileka yokusebenza eyayizophela ngo-2010. "Kusuka ngalesi sikhathi silokhu silwa lolu daba kodwa singaphumeleli. Izikhulu zikamasipala kanjalo nosopolitiki abayingeni eyethu,” kusho uMaduna.Uthe emhlanganweni wonyaka ngo-2022, abaninimasheya babedinwe beqhuma, ngenxa yokuthi babengakaze bathole mali eminyakeni engu-10 edlule. "Kwaqashwa inkampani ezimele ukuthi iphenye amabhuku kusuka ku-2020 kuya ku-2022. Bathola ukuthi kube khona inkohlakalo, ukweba, ukushintshisana ngemali, ukukhwabanisa, nokungaphathwa ngendlela kwemali,” usho kanje.Uthe ngoDisemba 2023, umasipala wase uvumile ukubakhokhela imali engu-R13 million yomsebenzi ababewenzile. Ngokuphela kukaMashi 2024 umasipala kwakufanele ubakhokhele u-R5.4 million."Asikaze siyithole yonke le mali engu-R18.4 million. Sifuna ukukhokhelwa. Iningi lethu alisenamali, siyahlupheka, asikwazi ukunakekela imindeni yethu,” kusho uMaduna.UMasipala ubuziwe ngalolu daba kodwa wacela ukuthunyelelwa wonke amaphepha anobufakazi ukuze uphendule.
USUHAMBE ibanga elide kakhulu uMasipala waKwaDukuza ngenhloso yokuqinisekisa ukuthi akukhinyabezeki ukulethwa kwentuthuko ngenxa yamaDelangokubona.Lokhu kudalulwe yiMeya yaKwaDukuza, uMnuz Siduduzo Gumede, ngesikhathi ikhuluma engqungqutheleni enkulu yokubhunga kabanzi ngezokwakha ebiseBandla Hotel, eBallito, ngoLwesithathu.Inhlosongqangi yale ngqungquthela kuhlalukile ukuthi bekungukuhlanganisa ochwepheshe emkhakheni wezokwakha ukuze kuqhanyukwe namasu okuqinisa ingqalasizinda ukubhekela izinguquko zesimo sezulu futhi kuthuthukiswe umkhakha wezokwakha.Le ngqungquthela uMasipala waKwaDukuza ubukade uyenza ngokubambisana nenhlangano, iNational Regulator for Compulsory Specifications (NRCS) ebhekele ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imikhiqizo nezinto zokwakha ezisetshenziswayo iphephile futhi ihambisana nemigomo esemthethweni yokuqinisekisa ukuvikeleka kwabantu ezakhiweni.UGumede uthe njengoba kukhulunywa ngezokwakha okufanele zibe sesimeni esikahle lokho kuqala ekudalekeni kwamathuba omsebenzi ngoba izakhiwo kumele kube khona abazakhayo.Uthe sebehambe ibanga elide ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi amaDelangokubona awakuphazamisi ukwakhiwa lwezakhiwo athe kusuke kuyintuthuko eya ebantwini. "Sesibe nemisebenzi eminingi emikhulu edla izindodla zemali. Kodwa yonke ihambe kahle kwangaba bikho abazibiza ngamaDelangokubona abaphazamisa uhlelo lokwakha," usho kanjena. Uthe lokhu kwenzeka kalula ngenxa yokuthi baye baqale bahlale phansi kuxoxiswane nabafisa ukubandakanyeka ezinhlelweni zokwakhiwa kwengqalasizinda."Lokhu kuyasilekelela kakhulu ngoba bagcina sebekwazi ukwabelana ngemisebenzi ngaphandle kokuthi kube khona udungunyane. Lokhu kubambisana okuhle siyakukhuthaza kakhulu ukuthi makuqhubeke kubonakale ukuze kungathikamezeki intuthuko lapha KwaDukuza," usho kanjena.Uthe kuseqhulwini kubona ukwenza konke okusemandleni ukuqinisekisa ukuthi intuthuko iya ebantwini ngaphandle kwenkinga.Ugcizelele kakhulu ukuthi kwakhiwe izakhiwo okungeke kube lula ukuthi zikhahlanyezwe wukuguquguquka kwesimo sezulu.Esinye sezikhulu zeNRCS, uMnuz Duncan Mutengwa, sithe okwabo wukubheka ngeso elibanzi ukuthi ngabe ikulungele yini ukusebenza imikhiqizo esetshenziselwa ukwakha.Lokhu uthe kumqoka kakhulu ngoba kugwema izinhlekelele eziye zenzeke uma kuya ngokuthi kukhona okungahambanga kahle esigabeni esithile sokwakha.

IZOSETSHENZISELWA izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izwe, ukwehlisa intela ekhokhwa abasebenzi, ukwehlisa isikweletu sezwe, ukuxhasa ezemfundo nezempilo kanjalo nezinye izinto imali ezongeniswa uma kuphasa isiphakamiso sokunyusa intela kwabagembulayo kuleli.Ngokukahulumeni uhlela ukufaka intela engu-20%, ngaphezu kwentela ebizwa yizifundazwe ezehlukene kuleli ezinkampanini zokugembula.Inhloso ngukwehlisa umdlandla kwabagembulayo njengoba uhulumeni enza minyaka yonke ngokunyusa intela eshaya abaqhafi kanjalo namaxhwele. UMnuz Christopher Axelson, inhloko yezentela emnyangweni kaMgcinimafa kuleli, uthe ngale ntela bafuna kwehle nesibalo sabagembulayo ngokufaka le ntela kwabagembula ngobuchwepheshe (online gambling)."Kuhlukene imibono njengoba silindele ukuthi kube nemvunge ngalesi siphakamiso, abanye bathi izinkampani zizoshiya ziye kwamanye amazwe ngenxa yale ntela. Sithole ukuthi nakwamanye amazwe iyafakwa le ntela, kwamanye le ntela ingaphezu kuka-20%. Inkulu imali ezongena emnothweni wakuleli ngokukhokhisa le ntela," usho kanje.Uthe ngale mali bahlose ukwenza izinto eziningi njengoba kuhlale kukhalwa ngesabelomali esinciphayo minyaka yonke."Sizoyifaka ezinhlelweni zokuthuthukisa izwe. Izoya ezinhlelweni ezifana nezemfundo, ezokuphepha, ezempilo nakwezinye izinhlelo. Uma kwanda imali asizoyinyusa intela ekhokhwa abasebenzi, mhlawumbe nentela ekhokhwa uma uthenga impahla okuyiVAT. Ngaleyo ndlela izosiza kwehle umthwalo obhekene nezwe," kusho u-Axelson, ekhuluma neNewzroom Afrika izolo. Uthe baningi abantu abaphumele obala bekhala ngokuthi balahlekelwe yikho konke abebenakho ngenxa yokugembula."Yingakho sifuna ukuzwa imibono yomphakathi mayelana nendaba yokufaka le ntela. Asikwazi ukuhlala singenzi lutho kukhona abakhala ngomonakalo odalwa wukugembula." Uthe basazobuka izinto eziningi ezithinta umthelela odalwa wukugembula wathi uma kunesidingo, bazoyinyusa intela ekugembuleni."Sifuna abagembulayo bayeke ngoba bayalimala. Uma beqhubeka nokugembula bazokhokha imali eningi. Izwe ligajwe wububha yingakho sifuna ukunxenxa abagembulayo ukuthi bayeke," usho kanje. Kwenzeka lokhu nje kuyakhalwa ngokwanda kwale nkinga kuleli njengoba abanye kuthiwa bagembula ngisho imali yokugcina. Nezitshudeni zingene zagamanxa kulolu gibe njengoba ezinye kuthiwa zigembula ngisho nemali eziyithola esikhwameni soxhaso ezikhungweni zemfundo, iNational Students Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS).Abafuna ukuphawula ngalesi siphakamiso sentela ekugembuleni bangaya kwi-website yoMnyango kaMgcinimafa ethi:www.treasury.gov.za: Bangathumela ukuphawula ku:[email protected]. Kumele baphawule ungakashayi uJanuwari 30, 2026.
ACISHE abambana ngezandla amalungu eMK nawe-IFP esiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal kubangwa isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNdunankulu, uMnuz Thami Ntuli.Amaphoyisa athwale kanzima ezama ukuhlukanisa amalungu eMK nawe-IFP abefuna ukufikisana emandleni ngesikhathi eqhudelana ngemibhikisho abeyibambe ngaphandle kwesiShayamthetho, eMgungundlovu, izolo.Amalungu eMK nawe-IFP abebhikisha emgwaqweni ophambi kwesiShayamthetho, ehlukaniswe amaphoyisa.Ngesikhathi bebhikisha bekunomhlangano ngaphakathi esiShayamthetho.I-MK ifuna kukhishwe uNtuli kanti i-IFP ayifuni nokuyizwa eyokukhishwa kwakhe.Isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNtuli esifakwe yiMK sizolalelwa esiShayamthetho ngoDisemba 15.Kuke kwaba nemibiko yokuthi isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNtuli sizolalelwa izolo kepha uSomlomo, uNksz Nontembeko Boyce, wabuye wacacisa ukuthi isiphakamiso sizolalelwa ngenyanga ezayo.UNksz Boyce unikeze le ncazelo emva kombuzo kaSotswebhu weMK esiShayamthetho, uMnuz Bonginkosi Mngadi, ofune ukwazi ukuthi sizolalelwa nini isiphakamiso sabo.IMK yasifaka ngenyanga edlule okokuqala isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNtuli.UNksz Boyce wasichitha isiphakamiso sayo, wakhala ngokuthi asihambisani nemigomo yesiShayamthetho.UMngadi uphinde wasifaka kabusha isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNtuli ngesikhathi kunomhlangano wesiShayamthetho, ngoLwesibili.Izolo uMngadi ufune ukwazi ukuthi kuqhubekani ngesiphakamiso abasifakile njengoba besingekho ohlwini lwezindaba ebezizodingidwa.UNksz Boyce utshele uMngadi ukuthi usuku olubekelwe ukulalelwa kwesiphakamiso nguDisemba 15.IMK isola uNtuli ngokudukisa isiShayamthetho ngesikhathi ebuzwa ngezindleko zohambo lwakhe lwaseNew York lapho ayehambele khona ingqungquthela okwakuxoxwa kuyona ngokuguquguquka kwesimo sezulu.UNtuli wathi wasebenzisa u-R750 000 kulolo hambo, iMK yona ithi wasebenzisa u-R950 000.IMK inezihlalo ezingu-37 kwezingu-80 esiShayamthetho, amaqembu abusa ngokubambisana, i-IFP, ANC, DA neNFP anezihlalo ezingu-41.I-EFF inezihlalo ezimbili, ithe ngeke iseseke isiphakamiso seMK. Nakuba kubukeka izibalo zingayivumi iMK, hodwa uMnuz Bonginkosi Khanyile, onesikhundla eqenjini, uthe uNtuli uzophuma esikhundleni.Ekhuluma namalungu eMK ngaphandle kwesiShayamthetho, uKhanyile uthe bamfuna ephumile esikhundleni uNtuli.
KUBATSHAZWA unya owesilisa waseNsimbini, eCato Manor, eThekwini, engena impi yabesifazane okuthiwa bebelwa bebanga isinemfu, wagwaza oyedwa wafa, ngoLwesibili.Kulesi sigameko, kufe uNksz Andiswa Nkosa (32) wakuyo le ndawo, emva kokuba umsolwa emgwaze ngohalakasha lommese esifubeni. Umsolwa kuthiwa uyisoka lowesifazane obelwa nomufi. Isidumbu sikamufi okuthiwa ubulawe ephethe ingane yakhe enonyaka, kuthiwa sificwe ephaseji eliseduze kwalapho okwenzeke khona isigameko. Nakuba umndeni kamufi ungazange uyiqinisekise imbangela yengxabano kodwa imithombo ithe bebebanga isinemfu, esidume ngentsu.Ngokusho kwelungu lomndeni kamufi, uNksz Nelisiwe Dladla, babizelwe endaweni yesigameko phakathi kwamabili. Uthe bamfice esebanda umufi, kukhombisa ukuthi isigameko kade senzekile. Uthe abakutholile wukuthi lapho kwenzeke khona isigameko yikubo komunye wesifazane obekuphuzwa naye. Kuthiwa bekuhlangenwe kuphuzwa. Kwabebekhona kubalwa umufi, owesifazane agcine eselwa naye, isoka lakhe lona wesifazane, umfowabo (wowesifazane) nomfowabo wesoka. Uthe abakubona wukuthi indawo yesigameko ithikanyeziwe."Owesifazane abebephuza naye, efika ekhaya, ufike wasitshela ukuthi ushiye umufi bemgwaza kubo. Kodwa uma sesifika thina isidumbu sakhe bese sibekwe ephaseji,” kusho uNksz Dladla. Uthe abazibonele kwenzeka isehlo babatshele ukuthi umufi ugwazelwe ngaphakathi egcekeni."Sisola ukuthi bamhudulile esebulewe bayombeka ngaphandle,” usho kanje. Uthe okunye okubaxakile wukuthi bafike lingekho igazi kumufi, kodwa zimanzi izingubo abezigqokile. "Kukhombise ukuthi ligeziwe inxeba, wase eyobekwa ephaseji. Nasegcekeni sibona sengathi baligezile igazi ngoba bekunamanzi nakhona, kungekho machaphazelo egazi,” kusho uNksz Dladla. Uthe ngisho nommese okusolwa ukuthi usetshenzisiwe uficiwe endaweni yesigameko kodwa nawo ususulwe igazi."Siphatheke kabi ngokwenzekile. Sizwa kuthiwa ngaphambi kokuba alinyazwe, balwile nalo wesifazane, yangenwa umfowabo (wowesifazane), washaya umufi ngempama. Kuthe besalanyulwa, isoka lowesifazane laya endlini layothatha uhalakasha lommese, lagwaza umufi,” usho kanje. Uthe ngesikhathi sempi phakathi kwabesifazane, umsolwa utshele umufi ukuthi: "Akehlise ingane emhlane, balwe ngoba bayafunana.”Ilungu lomphakathi elingeke lidalulwe ngoba abathintekayo basagcwele amathafa lithe umsolwa uwumuntu obukhali ekugwazeni abantu."Omunye wamgwaza waze wakhubazeka,” lisho kanje. Elinye lifakazele ukuthi unezidumbu phansi, futhi uyasatshwa.Okhulumela amaphoyisa kwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant Colonel Paul Magwaza, uthe amaphoyisa aseCato Manor aphenya icala lokubulala kulandela isigameko. Uthe imbangela yokubulawa kukamufi ayikaziwa.
KUBUKEKA sengathi unguphunyuka bemphethe usomabhizinisi obhekene noxhaxha lwamacala, uMnuz Vusumuzi "Cat" Matlala, njengoba esagwetshwe ngecala elilodwa kwangaphezu kweshumi aseke wawaboshelwa.Uxhaxha lwamacala aseke abhekana noMatlala lufundwe ngesikhathi evele phambi kwekomiti lasePhalamende eliphenya izinsolo ezenziwa wuKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi.Uhlu lwamacala olufundwe yilungu leDA, u-Advocate Glynnis Breytenbach, luveze ukuthi phakathi kuka-2000 no-2018 uMatlala waboshwa kwaze kwaba yizikhawu ezingu-13.Oxhaxheni lwamacala aboshelwa wona kukhona awokubamba inkunzi kuhleliwe, owokuntshontsha izimoto, awokugqekeza, elokushaya, nelokutholakala nempahla entshontshiwe.Linye icala elamgweba uMatlala, okungelokutholakala nempahla entshontshiwe.Kukhona futhi lapho uMatlala akhishwa phambili kuhoxiswa wonke amacala.U-Advocate Breytenbach, ufune ukwazi ukuthi kungani lilinye kuphela icala agwetshwa ngalo uMatlala."Kuyamangaza ukuthi kule nqwaba yamacala osuke wabhekana nawo linye kuphela elakulahla."UMatlala uthe akayiboni into esolisayo ngokuhoxiswa kwamanye amacala."Ngabe kwakufanele ngigwetshwe kulawa amanye amacala? Ukuhoxiswa kwamacala kusho ukuthi ngimsulwa."U-Advocate Breytenbach utshele uMatlala emehlweni ukuthi uyisigebengu."Awuyena usomabhizinisi kodwa uyisigebengu esintshontsha imali okufanele engabe isiza abantu abahlwempu. Kufanele uzenyeze ngale nto oyenzayo."UMatlala akafunanga ukuphawula kulokho."Ngeke ngisho lutho ngalokhu okushoyo."UMatlala uphike ezinye zezingxoxo zikaWhatsApp okuthiwa zatholakala kwiselula yakhe.UMatlala uthe okunye okukulezo zingxoxo uyakwazi kodwa wathi okunye kunongiwe.Lezi zingxoxo ziphakathi kwakhe nosomabhizinisi, uMnuz Brown Mogotsi. Kubuye kungene negama likaNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa omisiwe, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu.Kukhona ingxenye lapho bekhuluma ngokuxhasa ngemali umkhankaso kaMchunu wokuhola i-ANC.UMatlala ukuphikile ukuthi unomazisi waseSwatini lapho ezibiza khona ngoDlamini."Anginawo umazisi waseSwatini. Anginawo umndeni eSwatini. Le nto yakhandwa nje abantu abathile ababefuna ukuthi nginganikwa ibheyili. ESwatini ngaya nje ngesikhathi kunomcimbi wokugubha usuku lokuzalwa kweNgonyama, ngazana neNdlovukazi."UMatlala uvumile ukuthi ubuye azibize ngoDlamini nathe yisibongo sikagogo wakhe ongowokuzalwa KwaZulu-Natal.Kube muncu ngesikhathi uMatlala eveza ukuthi wakhulela emgwaqweni emva kokuduka kukanina owayenebala elimhlophe.UMatlala uthe unina waduka emva kokudlwengulwa wumuntu owayenenkolelo yokuthi ukulala nomuntu onebala elimhlophe kwelapha yonke inhlobo yesifo.
OBENGUMSAKAZI woKhozi FM, uSiyabonga "Siya" Mhlongo, uphunyuke okwesikhashana eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini lapho ebhekene khona necala lokushaya ngenhloso yokulimaza owesilisa owayeyisinqandamathe sakhe uMnuz Njabulo Duma (30) ngoSepthemba. Izolo bekulindeleke ukuthi iMantshi, uMnuz Mhlonipheni Sibiya, ikhiphe isigwebo kodwa yabuye yashaya ungqimphothwe yakuhlehlisa lokho. USibiya uthe uSiya (42) uzokwazi ngoDisemba 15 ukuthi ugixabezwa ngasiphi isigwebo. Okwenze uSibiya wakulibazisa ukugwetshwa kukaSiya yingoba ifuna ukucubungula isicelo sommeli kaSiya, u-Advocate Simphiwe Mlotshwa, onxuse ukuba umsolwa ashaywe ngoswazi oluncane. UMlotshwa unxuse inkantolo ukuba inikeze uSiya isigwebo esimisiwe, akhokhiswe inhlawulo noma anikezwe umsebenzi kodwa angakhokhelwa. Uthe uSiya wayengeke alenze leli cala ukube wayengaphuzile. Uchaze uSiya njengomuntu oyimvu yeNkosi ebiqala ukwenza icala. UMlotshwa uthe uSiya usebenze njengomsakazi oKhozini, kwiGagasi nakwiMetro iminyaka ewu-20 engumsakazi futhi kuleyo minyaka, ewu-15 uyichithe esakaza izinhlelo zezenkolo. Udalule ukuthi uSiya ubehola uR45 000 oKhozini futhi ondla ngenyanga unina onesifo somdlavuza nodadewabo onesifo sengqondo ngoR5000.Ngaphezu kwalokho uSiya ulahlekelwe wumsebenzi futhi wahlukumezeka ngokwengqondo njengoba kungekho mali abeyihola. Emuva kwalesi sigameko uSiya wanxusa abaphathi ukuba bammise emsebenzini kuze kudlule leli cala. Kulo nyaka abaphathi balo msakazo bathathe isinqumo sokungabe besamubuyisela emoyeni uSiya ohlelweni, Ubusuku Obuhle kwathi esikhundleni sakhe kwafakwa uNkosinathi Mshengu. Efika enkantolo uSiya ubeswenke ngesudi emnyama, ihembe elimnyama, izibuko ezidimile nezicathulo ezimnyama. Kwebezomeseka kubalwa obengumphathi wezinhlelo kuKhozi FM uZandile Tembe, obenza ezemfashini kulo msakazo uMthokozisi "Swenka" Chili, umhleli wemicimbi uPhindile "Pru" Zulu, umculi uClive Gumede nabanye.
NJENGOBA bekulindeleke ukuthi kugwetshwe obengumsakazi woKhozi FM, uSiyabonga "Siya" Mhlongo ngoLwesine, iNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini ishaye ingqimphothwe. Esikhundleni sokumenyezelwa kwesigwebo, iMantshi, uMnuz Mhlonipheni Sibiya, ikuhlehlisela uDisemba15 ukugwetshwa kukaSiya. Ithe uSiya uzoqhubeka abe ngaphandle ngebheyili ka-R1000. NgoNovemba 5, uSiya (42) ulahlwe yicala lokushaya ngenhloso yokulimaza owesilisa owayeyisinqandamathe sakhe, uNjabulo Duma (30). USibiya wathola uSiya enecala lokushaya uNjabulo ezinzulwini zobusuku ngoSepthemba 1, 2024. Lesi sigameko saphoqa abaphathi boKhozi FM ukuba bagcine bemkhombe indlela uSiya ngokuthi bangasivuseleli isivumelwano ebebenaso nale nsizwa eyayisakaza, Ubusuku Obuhle.Kwenzeka lokhu nje uSiya uhluleke wancama ukunxenxa inkantolo ukuba ichithe ubufakazi bommangali ngoba "buntekenteke futhi bungesebenziseke enkantolo".Le mizamo kaSiya kwamane kwafana nokuthi wayemane ethela amanzi emhlane wedada njengoba inkantolo yaphikisa isicelo ayesifakile.Abameli bakaSiya babekhala ngokuthi kukhona lapho ummangali athi khona akazange ambone uSiya emjikijela ngebhodlela ngoba wayesabheke phansi wezwa ngalo selimshaya. Bathi kuyona le nkantolo waphinde wathi wambona uSiya emjikijela ngebhodlela. Okunye abakhala ngakho abameli bakaSiya wukuthi kungani inkantolo ithembe ubufakazi obethulwa umuntu okwenzeka isigameko ecwile ezinkambeni zikaFaro.Bakhala nangokuthi ummangali wathi waklinywa ekubeni udokotela owamhlola wafika enkantolo wathi zazingekho izimpawu zokuthi ngempela waklinywa. Nakuba kunjalo imantshi yamchitha uSiya nabameli bakhe.

U-LIEUTENANT General Puleng Dimpane, oyiChief Financial Officer yeSAPS, udalule ukuthi ithimba iPolitical Killings Task Team (PKTT) selixhaswe ngemali engu-R435 million kusuka lasungulwa.Lesi sikhulu samaphoyisa besifakaza ekomitini lesikhashana lasePhalamende eliphenya izinsolo zokugxambukela kosopolitiki nokusebenzisana kwamaphoyisa nezigebengu.Ikomiti elilalela ubufakazi lisungulwe emva kwezinsolo ezenziwa nguKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, ngoJulayi 6.UMkhwanazi wasola uNgqongqoshe wezamaPhoyisa omisiswe, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, ngokuhlakaza iPKTT ngoDisemba 31, 2024, ngoba evikela imigulukudu engobhululu bosopolitki namaphoyisa.Ethula ubufakazi bakhe izolo uLieutenant General Dimpane uthe njengamanje amaphoyisa anamathimba ayisipesheli angu-11 okubalwa nePKTT.Ecelwa umholi wobufakazi u-Advocate Lerato Zikalala ukuthi anikeze incazelo yokuthi imali ye-PKTT isetshenziswe kanjani eminyakeni eyehlukene edlule, uLieutenant General Dimpane uthe:"Izinto ezisetshenziswayo ezirekhodiwe ngamathimba ajutshiwe zikhomba izindleko eziqondile, ezilawulekayo esizikhiphela imali. Kusukela onyakenimali u-2018/19 kuze kube uSepthemba walo nyaka, izindleko ezinkulu ePKTT zibe yisikhathi esengeziwe, ukuhamba, nokudla, ikakhulukazi indawo yokulala.""Amalungu avame ukuvela ezifundazweni ezihlukene, hhayi lapho asebenzela khona, ngakho kufanele siwanikeze indawo yokuhlala nokudla. Umsebenzi wesikhathi esengeziwe uvamile, okwenza lezi zinto ezimbili zibe yinto ejwayelekile kule minyaka edlule."ULieutenant General Dimpane uphinde waphawula ukuthi ezinye izindleko ezibekwe ngaphansi kwezingavamile noma ukuhamba ngendiza kwenzeka ngezikhathi ezithile lapho amalungu kudingeka aphuthume ukuze enze imisebenzi.Uveze ukuthi izindleko zesikhathi esengeziwe ezirekhodiwe zonyaka ka-2025/26 bezingakabi khona."Lokhu akusho ukuthi ithimba belingasebenzanga. Izicelo zalo zesikhathi esengeziwe zisacutshungulwa, futhi zizofakwa kumarekhodi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Ithimba liyaqhubeka nokusebenza futhi nginesiqiniseko sokuthi lezo zindleko zisabhekisiswa ngaphambi kokuba kukhokhwe."Enxuswa ukuba enabe ngezindleko zokuhamba uthe: "Ithimba litshalwa ezindaweni ezehlukene uma kunesidingo. Kuyenzeka kusetshenziswe amaphoyisa aseduzane, kodwa kuvame ukuthi kwengezwe ngawo amaphoyisa asethimbeni lePKTT ukuze kusheshe kulawuleke isimo. Amalungu ethimba asuke eqhamuka ezindaweni ezehlukene ngakho kuye kuqale ngokuthi kugunyazwe abaphethe ukutshalwa kwawo."Badinga indawo yokuhlala, ukudla, nokusekelwa ngenkathi besebenza kude nasemakhaya. Amathimba esikhashana ajutshwayo, asuke esungulwe ukuze afeze izinjongo ezithile, ngokungafani namathimba amaphoyisa asebenza ngokugcwele. Uxhaso lwawo lwemali kwesinye isikhathi kuba yinto yesikhashana."Mayelana nokuthi izindlela ezisetshenziswayo njengamanje zijwayelekile yini, uLieutenant General Dimpane uthe: "Ukube amathimba abengamalungu eSAPS ajwayelekile, izindleko zendawo yokuhlala nokudla bezizoba phansi kakhulu ngoba amalungu abezobe ehlala emakhaya awo.”Wanezele ngokuthi: "Izindleko zokuhamba zivela ngezikhathi ezithile kuphela uma uphenyo ludinga ukuthuthela ngaphandle kwesiteshi okuvulwe kuso idokodo. Ngakho-ke, kuyinto evamile ukuthi amathimba esikhashana abhekane nezindleko zokulala eziphezulu nezokuziphilisa."ULieutenant General Dimpane ucacise indima yomnyango wakhe ekuphathweni kwemali wathi iwukuqinisekisa ukutholakala kwenkece nokuthi (umnyango wakhe) awunalo igunya lokugunyaza noma lokuphika izicelo zokusebenza kwamathimba.
KUZOCACA namuhla ukuthi umculi kamaskandi, uBukelani "Dlubheke" Khuzwayo, uyayithola yini ibheyili noma uqhubeka nokubhadla esitokisini saseWestville, eThekwini. UDlubheke uzobuyela eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseNquthu namhlanje ngenhloso yokufaka isicelo sebheyili okwesibili. Ngenyanga eyedlule uDlubheke (31) uhlangabezane nembibizane eyofaka isicelo sebheyili okokuqala ethola ukuthi emacaleni amane abhekene nawo sekwengezwe amanye amabili okubulala aphenywa ngamaphoyisa aseGauteng. Isolezwe lathola ngephoyisa elingagunyaziwe ukukhuluma nabezindaba ukuthi uDlubheke usesolwa nangokubulala owesilisa oseyibhungu eGoli, okuthiwa kwenzeka ngoJanuwari 1, 2022 nenye indoda yaseKatlehong, ngoNovemba 27, 2024. Ngakho amacala asebekwe uDlubheke aseyisithupha. "Amaphoyisa ayehla ayanyuka naye ngenxa yokuthi akubonakali kungalunga uma engatoka eNcome noma eVryheid, ngenxa yamacala abhekene nawo. Njalo enkantolo ufika namaphoyisa avale ubuso, okuyiwona ehla nawo njalo uma eza ecaleni," kusho umthombo. Kuvela ukuthi kusacutshungulwa ukuthi la macala uzowaqula ngaziphi izinsuku njengoba esezinkantolo ezahlukene.Lo mculi uqale ukubingelela inkantolo ngo-Okthoba, emuva kokuzinikela emaphoyiseni aseDurban North, eThekwini, ngenxa yokuthinteka emacaleni amabili okubulala namanye amabili okuzama ukubulala. Imithombo yathi wazinikela emuva kokulunywa indlebe ngokuthi uphiko lwamaphoyisa i-NIU lumfuna phansi phezulu.Kuthiwa okwamthusa kakhulu ukuzwa ukuthi amaphoyisa aseGauteng asedubule abulala uZamani Ngila Ximba waseQhudeni, esigamekweni esenzeke eDuduza, Ekurhuleni, ngoSephthemba, ngo-12 ebusuku. UXimba ubesolwa ngokubhuqabhuqa ngenhlamvu abantu, okukhona kubo nowayeyilungu elimele i-IFP ePhalamende, uMnuz Khethamabala Petros Sithole (67).Isitatimende samaphoyisa aKwaZulu-Natal, sithe ukuboshwa kukaDlubheke kumayelana nesigameko esenzeka ngoNovemba 12, 2023, sokuhlaselwa kwamadoda amane akwaSithole eQhudeni, ayesemotweni emhlophe eliqhamukisa eNtinini, eBabanango, elibangise emakhaya.Siqhuba isitatimende, sithe abagilwa ababili basindiswa ukubaleka endaweni yesigameko, kwathi abanye bagcina bedlulile emhlabeni ngenxa yokulimala kabi. Kwenzeka lokhu nje, uDlubheke ubesanda kuveza ukuthi usephilisa okwenyamazane ngenxa yokubona engaphephile. Le nsizwa yakhala ngokudeze iyamaniswa nezigameko zokubulawa kwabantu, kokunye ize iboshwe kodwa kungenzeki igcine ibekwe icala. Ekhuluma kwiClean Governance Podcast, uDlubheke wasola abantu bangakubo athi bamqhatha nabaseMsinga naseTembisa. Wathi useke wakhalelwa ngamasongo kaSigonyela ngoba esolwa ekubulaweni kwabantu abangaphezu kweshumi.
UMNUZ Blessing Khoza uyindoda esolwa ngokujuba abesilisa abangu-22 bakuleli ukuba babuthwe ukuba ngamasosha akhokhelwayo e-Ukraine. Lokhu kushiwo ngamadodakazi kaMnuz Jacob Zuma, uNkk Dududzile Zuma-Sambudla noNkk Nkosazana Zuma-Mncube. Laba besifazane bavulele uKhoza amacala,okubalwa kuwo elenkohlakalo, elokushushumbisa abantu ngenhloso yokubaxhaphaza nelokuhanjiswa kwabakuleli ngokungemthetho beyiswa endaweni enezinxushunxushu. UNkk Zuma-Mncube uvule amacala esiteshini samaphoyisa esiseSandton eGoli ngempelasonto, esola uKhoza, uNksz Siphokazi Xuma nodadewabo uNkk Zuma-Sambudla ngabakwenza beholela amadoda Ophathe, amanye ayizihlobo, kuthiwa ayiswa eRussia kanti ayoba yingxenye yamabutho alwayo e-Ukraine. Kubikwa ukuthi la madoda asayiniswa amaphepha ayengawaqondi ngaphambi kokuyiswa empumalanga ye-Ukraine. UNkk Zuma-Sambudla uziphendulele ngoMsombuluko, wazichitha izinsolo zokuthi wabutha amalungu omndeni wakhe nabanye ukuba bayoba ngamasosha akhokhelwayo e-Ukraine. Leli lungu lephalamande lithe nalo lakhohliswa wuKhoza owayethe kunabantu abaziyo abanohlelo lokuqeqeshwa kwamasosha eRussia. UNkk Zuma-Sambudla uthe wabe esezibandakanya nalolo hlelo futhi walibangisa eRussia ukuze acijelwe ubusosha, okuwuhlelo olwathatha inyanga. Uthe ngaleso sikhathi akukho okwakumhlanganisa nokulwa noma ukuqeqeshelwa ezempi. Esekhona uNkk Zuma-Sambudla uthe wathola ukuthi lolu hlelo lungakwazi ukubandakanya abantu abaningi. Uthe wabe esephakamisa ukuthi kulandwe abanye abangu-22 ukubamba iqhaza ohlelweni ayekulo. "Ukuxhumana kwethu kwaqala ngoba wanginxenxa, hhayi lokhu okushiwoyo. Ngathemba imininingwane ayenginike yona, njengoba sasingekho isizathu, ngaleso sikhathi, sokusola inkohlakalo nokuholelwa Ophathe," kusho uNkk Zuma-Sambudla ngokuxhumana kwakhe noKhoza. Uqobele phansi konke akwaziyo ukusuka nokuhlala kulolu daba encwadini efungelwe ebonwe yiphephandaba elinguzakwabo waleli, iDaily News futhi avulele ngayo amacala uKhoza embuthweni wamaphoyisa akuleli. Umbutho wamaphoyisa owaziwa ngamaHawks noma ngeDirectorate for Priority Crime Investigations, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi uphenya udaba lwamadoda okusolwa ukuthi abuthelwe ukuba ngamasosha akhokhelwayo e-Ukraine.Okhulumela oKlebe, uBrigadier Thandi Mbambo, uthe udaba luzodluliselwa kuMqondisi woPhiko lokuShushiswa koMphakathi njengoba sekuqala uphenyo. "Uphenyo luyaqhubeka njengamanje futhi lubandakanya ofakazi, imithombo nokunye okumqoka ekutholeni ubufakazi. Uma bonke ubufakazi sebuqoqiwe futhi nezinyathelo zophenyo seziphothuliwe, udaba luzodluliselwa kuMqondisi woPhiko lokuShushiswa koMphakathi ukuze anqume ngalo," kusho uBrigadier Mbambo.
KUNYOMFEKE izinhlelo zekhomishini ephenya izinsolo ezenziwa wuKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi ngesikhathi izikhulu ezisezinhlakeni zokuphepha ezisolwa ngokusondelana nosomabhizinisi obhekene noxhaxha lwamacala, uMnuz Vusumuzi 'Cat' Matlala, zicela ukululelwa isikhathi.Ikhomishini eholwa yiJaji Mbuyiseli Madlanga isheshe yaguqa izolo, futhi ngeke ihlale namhlanje ngenxa yokuthi ufakazi wayizolo kanye nobezovela namhlanje bacele ukululelwa isikhathi.Bobabili ofakazi basolwa ngokusondelana noMatlala.
