Ngikhipha umyalelo wokuba uSenona ahlinzeke ikhomishini ngesitatimende sakhe ungakadluli uJanuwari 16. Kulesi sitatimende kufanele aphendule izinsolo eziqukethwe encwadini embizela phambi kwekhomishini esamthumelela yona ngoNovemba 13."Namhlanje bekufanele kuvele isikhulu samaphoyisa kuMasipala waseKurhuleni esimisiwe, uBrigadier Julius Mkhwanazi.UJulius ubhekene nezinsolo eziningi okubalwa kuzo ukubhalisa izimoto zikaMatlala ngaphansi komkhandlu kanye nokuzifaka amalambu aluhlaza.UJulius uphinde asolwe ngenkohlakalo, ukweba kanye nokufihla ubufakazi ecaleni lokubulawa komuntu.Ohola ubufakazi, u-Advocate Matthew Chaskalson, uthe uJulius ucele ukululelwa isikhathi, wathi usezovela ngesonto elizayo.Kusasa ikhomishini izolalela ubufakazi bephoyisa elingaphansi kophiko lwamaphoyisa kuMasipala waseKurhuleni.
USOMABHIZINISI obhekene noxhaxha lwamacala, uMnuz Vusumuzi "Cat" Matlala, uninde owayenguNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa, uMnuz Bheki Cele, noKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, ngesikhathi evele phambi kwekomiti lasePhalamende eliphenya izinsolo ezenziwa wuMkhwanazi.UMatlala uveze ukuthi uCele wayemfuna imali kangangokuba wagcina engasazibambi izingcingo zakhe, waveza nokuthi uCele waqamba amanga ngesikhathi evele phambi kwekomiti.UMatlala uthe uMkhwanazi yena wayefuna ukuba amsize amkhulumele nomuntu owayemvulele icala lokushaya elaliphenywa wuphiko oluqapha ukusebenza kwamaphoyisa, i-Ipid.UMatlala uthe waboshwa emva kokuba eyekile ukunika uCele imali waphinde futhi wahluleka wukusiza uMkhwanazi ukuba kusulwe icala ayebhekene nalo.Lokhu ukusho ngesikhathi evele phambi kwekomiti, izolo.UMatlala uthe wanikeza uCele imali engu-R500 000 kanye nezinye izipho."Okokuqala ngamnikeza u-R300 000, okwesibili ngamnikeza u-R200 000. Yonke le mali ngamnikeza esandleni ingukheshi."UMatlala uthe wanikeza uCele le mali emva kokuba emsizile ukuphebeza ithimba lamaphoyisa eliphenya ukubulawa kosopolitiki KwaZulu-Natal.UMatlala uthe umuntu owamxhumanisa noCele nguMnuz Bongani Mpungose oyindodana kasomatekisi ongasekho, uMnuz Sputla Mpungose.UMatlala uthe emva komhlangano wakhe noCele kwabonakala sengathi ziyashabalala izinkinga zakhe namaphoyisa njengoba abuyiselwa nezibhamu zakhe ezazishaqiwe. UMatlala uthe uCele waze wamhlelela umhlangano noMkhwanazi, nathe kulapho-ke uMkhwanazi amcela ukuthi amsize amkhulumele nomuntu omvulele icala.UMatlala uthe umuntu owayevulele uMkhwanazi icala wanqaba ukulisula.Uthe wagcina engasazibambi izingcingo zikaCele ngenxa yokuthi wayemfuna imali."Wayelokhu eqhubeka engifonela. Uma uzobheka ngosuku engaboshwa ngalo mhlawumbe wazama ukungifonela kawu-20."UMatlala uthe uCele wamtshela ukuthi kwakunetulo lokubopha uNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa omisiwe, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu.UMatlala uthe leli tulo laliphekwa yithimba eliphenya ukubulawa kwamaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal.UMatlala uthe uCele wamgqugquzela ukuba aqhubeke nokuxoxa nokuthiwa usondelene noMchunu, uMnuz Brown Mogotsi, ngethemba lokuthi kungenzeka aphahluke ngento eyayingabophisa uMchunu.UMatlala uveze ukuthi akamazi uMchunu kodwa wathi uMogotsi wasebenzisa igama likaMchunu ngesikhathi emcela imali."Ngokubona kwami uMogotsi wayecelwe wuMchunu ukuba amfunele uxhaso. Nami ngingomunye wabantu amcela uxhaso."UMatlala uveze ukuthi wanika uMogotsi imali engu-R150 000 ngesikhathi kunomgubho we-ANC iJanuwari 8.UMatlala uchaze uMogotsi njengomuntu oyiqola.Uthe ngesikhathi eqala ukumfonela wathi usebenza ehhovisi likaMchunu, wathembisa ukumlekelela ekuphenyeni isigameko sokuhlukunyezwa kwakhe amaphoyisa aphenya ukubulawa kosopolitiki KwaZulu-Natal."Emva kwalokho wabe eseqala engicela imali. Ngabuza ukuthi kungani kufanele ngikhokhe ngoba phela yena usebenza ehhovisi likangqongqoshe? Ngabuza ukuthi kungani kufanele ngikhokhele amaphoyisa ukuba enze umsebenzi wawo."UMatlala obefakaza esejele iKgosi Mampuru, ubeswenke econsa futhi egaxwe ozankosi.Uzoqhubeka nokwethula ubufakazi namhlanje.
IKHULUNYELWA phansi ebandleni lamaRoma aKhatholika eyabazalwane baleli bandla okuthiwa babulale uFata "ngephutha" kade bemgxingxa utshwala nezidakamizwa befuna ukweba umnikelo webandla.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi uFata Mthokozisi Innocent Khanyile (43) obekade engumelusi wePherishi yaseMbumbulu, iSt Marumba, ushone ngeSonto ebusuku.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uConstable Thenjiswa Ngcobo ukuqinisekisile ukufa kukaFata Khanyile. Uthe amaphoyisa aseMbumbulu aphenya icala ngemuva kokuba kutholakale isidumbu sowesilisa singenamanxeba.Kuvela ngemithombo ukuthi abesifazane abangamalungu aleli bandla bamgxingxe utshwala nezidakamizwa ukuze adakwe alale angazi nanyaka bese bethola nentuba yokuthatha imali yomnikelo.Umthombo uthe kuthe sebebona ukuthi useshonile uFata bethuka koma nasozwaneni kodwa basale sebeqhubeka nokweba imali yebandla."Baqhubekile bayithatha imali yebandla njengoba bebevele behlose khona lokho. Kodwa yiqiniso ukuthi kuphume isidumbu ngenxa yabantu ebebefuna ukweba imali yebandla," kuchaza umthombo ongaphakathi ebandleni.Uqhuba uthe badangele kakhulu ngalesi senzo esize saholela ekutheni kuphume umphefumulo."Sithole ukuthi isidakamizwa abasisebenzisile siyingozi futhi sijwayele ukuxutshwa kakhulu nensangu,’’ kuchaza umthombo. Kokwa-ke ibingakaphumi imiphumela yokuhlolwa kwesidumbu ukufakazela okushiwo umthombo ngesidakamizwa.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi abazalwane abenze lokhu bebekujwayele vele ukuhlala noFata kube mnandi kuphuzwe iziphuzo ezinhlobonhlobo.Kune-voicenote yomunye okusolakala ukuthi ubeyingxenye yalokhu Isolezwe elinayo. Kuyona kuzwakala owesifazane ethi: "Angithi nje u…..(egagula igama lomzalwane) ubekade emgxingxa ngotshwala wase emnikeza nalesi sidakamizwa esidliwa nensangu. Nami ngiyizwile yangihlula ngayizwa ukuthi ayikho kahle ngashaywa yinzululwane. Ngibe sengibashiya bodwa ezansi ngaya phezulu ngafike ngaphuza amanzi amaningi. U…… ubelokhu emthelela utshwala. Ngaleso sikhathi uFata bese evevezela.’’ Udaba lokudlula emhlabeni kukaFata Khanyile lufinyelele kwiDayosisi yaseMariannhill abekade engaphansi kwayo. Lokhu kufakazelwe wukuthi neNhloko yaleli bandla kule Dayosisi, uMbhishobhi Neil Frank (OMI), isibhonge emswaneni ngalo mshophi.Ngaphambi kokuba aye kwiPherishi yaseMbumbulu uFata Khanyile ubekade ehola iPherishi yaseDassenhoek, iFrancis Xavier, kusuka ngo-2021 kuya ku-2025. Uke wasebenza futhi nakwiDayosisi yaseDundee.Lolu daba kuvela ukuthi aluhlalanga kahle kubazalwane ebehlukene bebandla njengoba kuthiwa banemibuzo eminingi. Kuthiwa abanye babuza ukuthi kanti kuvumelekile yini ukuthi oFata bazitike ngotshwala nabazalwane?
IBHANGE iFirst National Bank (FNB) seliqagele ukuthi lilindele ukuthi yenyuke imali ezosetshenziswa ngabathengi ngale mpelasonto yemititilizo yaminyaka yonke yeBlack Friday, njengoba kulokhu kuthuthuka njalo izinga lezokuthenga ngobuchwepheshe besimanje, nokuzokwenza ukuthi ifinyelele ku-R3.3 billion imali engase isetshenziswe.Lokhu kususelwa ekutheni silokhu sanda nsuku zonke isibalo sabathengi abahlale bethenga besebenzisa ubuchwepheshe besimanje, kangangokuthi abanye abasavamile ukuzihlupha kangako ngokuthenga izinto ezithile ezitolo, njengoba sebekwazi ukwenza lokho umuntu ezihlalele ekhaya.Izibalo zokuqagela kweFNB kanjena, zisukela nasekutheni nyakenye yaba ngaphezu kwa-R5.4 billion imali eyasetshenziswa ngabathengi ngemishini yaleli bhange ngale mpelasonto yale mititilizo eba kanye njalo ngalesi sikhathi. Kanti uma kubhekwa futhi indlela izinto ezenzeka ngayo ezimakethe nakulo nyaka, i-FNB ibona emaningi amathuba okuthi kwenzeke okufanayo. Kuvele nokuthi ukuthumelana imali ngohlelo lwe-eWallet nokuthenga usebenzisa usebenzisa imininingwane yekhadi lakho lasebhange, kulokhu kukhule njalo - kube kwehla isibalo sabantu abasebenzisa imali ngqo. Okunye futhi okwenza ukuthi kuqagelwe ngale ndlela wukuthi abantu abaningi bayenqena ukwehla benyuka beyothenga, njengoba sebencamela ukwenza konke besemakhaya.Inhloko yophiko olubhekele ukuthenga ngesikweletu nokunye okweyamene nakho eFNB, uMnuz Akshay Bhayroo, uthe indlela abathengi abenza ngayo kule minyaka ikhombisa ukuthi basuke benenhloso ethile ngokuthi bathenga ini, nini futhi kanjani. "Yingakho nangalesi sikhathi sibheke ukuthi izinhlelo zokuthenga ngobuchwepheshe besimanje zibe neqhaza elikhulu ezizolibamba ekutheni amakhasimende athenga kanjani futhi kangakanani ngale mpelasonto esiya kuyona, kuqhubekela kwindlela okwenzeke into efanayo ngayo ngonyaka odlule," kusho uBhayroo.Eqhuba, uthe babheke ukuthi abantu baqalele kusemanje ukuthenga imikhiqizo nezinto eziningi njengoba seyiqalile imititilizo yamanani aphansi ezitolo ezahlukene, okubhekwe ukuthi baqinise kakhulu ekudleni, izimpahla zokugqoka nokunye kokuzijabulisa, bese futhi kubhekwa nokuthi lokhu kunothise kakhulu imboni yezimpahla neyezokuvakasha."Konke lokhu kufakazela futhi kukhomba ukuthi amakhasimende athanda ukuthenga ngendlela ezokwenza ukuthi akhululeke futhi angakhathazeki ngezinto eziningi futhi kucacisa ngokusobala ukuthi afuna ukwenza izinto ngendlela ezoba lula nengezukudala ukuthi aphoqeke ukwehla enyuka ukuthola into ayidingayo," kulandisa uBhayroo.
BABALELWA ku-465 abantu abakhahlanyezwe yizikhukhula ezigasele ngeSonto eNew Hanover kuMasipala waseMshwathi, ngaseMgungundlovu. Lokhu kuvezwe wuMphathiswa woMnyango wokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, ngesikhathi ehambele le ndawo izolo ekhashwe yiMeya yendawo, uMnuz Mandla Zondi.UButhelezi ubeyohlola umonakalo aphinde anikeze abakhahlamezekile usizo kwesikhashana. Uthe zingu-117 izindlu ezicekeleke phansi. Kuzona kukhona ezingu-50 eziphele nya, bese kuba khona ezingu-67 ezithintekile."Bangu-79 abasale dengwane. Ngeshwa munye osekuqinisekiswe ukuthi ushonile, kuthi ababili basathathwa njengabasadukile,” kusho uButhelezi. Ubuye waba nomhlangano nethimba labatakuli abasaqhubeka nokubheka abadukile. Siyazwelana nemindeni yabo njengoba ibhekene nesikhathi esinzima sokulahlekelwa yizihlobo,” kusho uButhelezi. Uncome ithimba labatakuli nabezimo eziphuthumayo, wathi banesibindi. "Sikushayela ihlombe ukusebenza kwabo ngokuzikhandla ngalesi sikhathi esinzima futhi sikhulekela ukuthi abadukile batholakale ngokushesha,” kusho uButhelezi. Ubonge izinhlaka ezihlukene ezisondele ngokushesha nosizo kulabo abakhahlamezekile. Kubona ubalule iminyango ehlukene kahulumeni, Red Cross, Themba Njilo Foundation, Alimdaat Foundation kanjalo neGift of the Givers. Phakathi kosizo olutholwa abakhahlamezekile kubalwa ukudla okushisayo, izingubo zokulala, izipontshi, izinto zokugeza kanjalo nophahla lokufihla ikhanda. Uthe usuqalile umsebenzi wokukhucululwa kwendawo njengoba abakhahlamezekile bezoqala uhlelo olunzima lokuqala kabusha impilo.Ephawula ngowesifazane okutakulwe isidumbu sakhe ngoMsombuluko uthe asebekutholile wukuthi uneminyaka engu-53 kanti ungowokudabuka eMatatiele, e-Eastern Cape. Wathi ngokuhlonipha umndeni, igama lakhe lisazogodlwa okwamanje.Uveze ukuthi umnyango kanjalo nomasipala bebezohlangana nomndeni kamufi khona izolo, bawunike konke ukwesekwa okudingayo. Uthe njengoba iseningi imvula elindelwe ezingxenyeni ezehlukene zesifundazwe, kunxuswa imiphakathi ukuthi ihlale iqaphile. "Mazihlonishwe zonke izexwayiso ezikhiswa abeSouth African Weather Service," kusho uButhelezi. Uthe unxusa omasipala ukuthi baqinise imithetho, bavimbe abantu ukuthi bakhe ezindaweni ezisondelene nemifula kanjalo nalezo ezingabeka impilo yabo engcupheni. "Lokhu kuzosiza ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi impilo yabantu iyahlengwa,” usho kanje. Ezindaweni ezikhahlanyezwe yizikhukhula kubalwa iShiyabazali eseNew Hanover, Mishani, Dalton ebuye yaziwe ngeCool Air, ngaphansi kwayo kukhona izindawo ezifana neLoliwe, Sphothom, Mkhushwa neKamelhoek.
IToyota South Africa Motors (TSAM) ivuselela isimemezelo sayo sokubuyiswa kwezimoto ziyolungiswa ama-airbag ngomkhankaso obizwa ngeTakata Airbag Recall ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi Ungazifaki Engozini, Lungisa (Don't Risk It, Fix It) - okuwumkhankaso kazwelonke okhuthaza abanikazi bezimoto ezithintekayo zakwaToyota, Lexus nezwakwaHino ukuba babhukhele ukushintshelwa mahhala ama-airbag abo ngokushesha. Lona akuwona umkhankaso omusha. Inkinga ngama-airbag eTakata iqale kusukela ngo-2015 futhi namanje lona kusewumkhankaso omkhulu kunayo yonke emlandweni wezokuthutha, wokuqwashisa ngezokuphepha futhi othinta izigidi zezimoto ezinkampanini ezihlukahlukene emhlabeni jikelele. Okusha wumkhankaso osuqinisiwe wakwaToyota ukuzama ukufinyelela kubanikazi bezimoto abangakazihambisi izimoto zabo ukuba ziyolungiswa mahhala ukuze ziphephe. Inkinga ebucayi engaphelile. Phezu kweminyaka eminingi kunxuswa abanikazi bezimoto ukuba bahambise izimoto zabo ukuba ziyolungiswa kabusha ama-airbag, u-39% wezimoto ezithintekayo eNingizimu Afrika awukakalungiswa. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izinkulungwane zabashayeli, abagibeli nemindeni zisengcupheni yokulimala noma yokufa uma kwenzeka kuqhuma mawala i-airbag enephutha. Uhla lwezimoto ezithintekayo lubanzi futhi luhlanganisa ezindala nezintsha:EzakwaToyota: Corolla (2002–2017) RAV4 (2003–2005) Fortuner (2005–2015) Hilux (2004–2015) Yaris (2005–2017) Avensis (2006–2008) Auris (2007–2013) RunX (2002–2007)EzakwaLexus: IS (2006–2012) SC (2008) RX (2016)EzakwaHino: 300 Series (2011–2017)UMengameli ophinde abe yiCEO yeTSAM, u-Andrew Kirby, uthi ngalo mkhankaso omusha bahlose ukuqeda le nkinga futhi bakwenze lokho kube lula kubo bonke abanikazi bezimoto. "Sinxusa yonke imiphakathi ukuthi Ingazibeki Engozini, ILungise (Don't Risk It, Fix It). Lona wumzamo osuthuthukisiwe wokuqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izimoto ezithintekayo ziyalungiswa. Sifuna ukukwenza lokhu ngendlela elula nefinyelela kalula kubanikazi bezimoto - mahhala." Okwenziwa uToyota okuhlukileUmkhankaso oqinisiwe othi Ungazifaki Engozini, Lungisa uzosatshalaliswa yonke indawo, ufinyelele kubantu abaningi kalula ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi akekho umnikazi wemoto ozophinde angawuboni umlayezo. ISIKHATHI sokuphela konyaka yilapho abantu abaningi besisebenzisa khona ukuthi bazijabulise nemindeni yabo, okungaba nangokusebenzisa imali betitiliza izinto nemikhiqizo ehlukene yokudla, okokugqoka nokunye.Yingaleso sikhathi inhloko yophiko olubhekele ukunqanda izigameko zokuqolwa kwabantu yaseStandard Bank, u-Adv Athaly Khan, esexwayise abathengi ukuthi babe mehlo mane ngalesi sikhathi kunoma yini abayithengayo ukusiza ukugwema ukugilwa amaqola.U-Adv Khan uxwayise ngokuthi njengoba sekusondele impelasonto yemititilizo yeBlack Friday yilapho amaqola azobe enkanise ngandlela zonke ukuthi abaqole ngokuthi amanye awo azenze abantu noma izitolo eziza nezaphulelo ezithile, okwenza kube lula ukudidiseka - bese uqoleka kalula kanjalo."Uma sekuyilesi sikhathi, zanda lapho izigameko zamaqola asebenzisa ukuthi abathengi basuke bemagange ngalesi sikhathi futhi bethenga bejahile. Abanye basuke bephushwa nayilukuluku lokugajwa yinjabulo - okwenza ukuthi kube lula ukuluthwa wubala," kuxwayisa u-Adv Khan. Ucebise abathengi ukuqapha izindlela ezahlukene ezisetshenziswa ngamaqola ukubadoba ikakhulu ngalesi sikhathi. Nazi ezinye zalezo zindlela ezivame ukusetshenziswa ngamaqola: Ukukuqola ngokufuna imininingwane yakho yasebhange uma uthenga: Amaqola enza lokho ngokuthi enze ama-website awumbombayi afana nse nawezitolo ezikhona nezaziwayo, bese ekuqola ngokuthi akuluthe ukufaka imininingwane yakho yasebhange ukuthenga okubalwa kuyona inombolo yekhadi lakho lasebhange, wukuthi lizophelela yisikhathi nini nenombolo eyimfihlo ebhalwe kulona, bese ihamba kanjalo imali yakho. Yingakho kusemqoka ukuhlale uqinisekisa ubunjalo baleyo website ukuthi ayiwona yini umbombayi, bese ugwema ukuhlale ucindezela ama-link asolisayo avela kwiselula yakho, bese futhi ubika ebhange lakho konke okusolisayo ukuze ugweme ukuqolwa. Amaqola ezimpahla ozithenga zigcine zingafikanga kuwena: Ngenxa yokuthi kuyaziwa ukuthi abathengi bayawathanda amanani aphansi, amaqola avame ukufaka imikhiqizo yamanani aphansi lokhu okwethusayo enzela ukukulutha ngawo. Abathengi badotshwa ngokuthi isitoko esikhona sincane futhi sizosheshe siphele, okuthi ungakhokha imali - ulinde umlibe igcine ingafikanga kuwena leyo mpahla obuzitshela ukuthi uyayithenga. Ngakho uma kuwukuthi awukaze wathenga kuleso sitolo phambili, kusemqoka ukuqapha ngokweqile ngaphambi kokuthi ufake imali yakho, bese icwila kalula kanjalo ungasakutholanga obukufuna. Abadayisi abasemthethweni baba nemininingwane yabo yocingo, eye-email neyendawo abatholakala kuyona. Ngakho uma kungekho okunye kwalokho, baleka ngezinyawo zombili. Imiyalezo ongayazi nobungayilindele: Amanye amaqola asebenzisa ukuthola izinombolo zabathengi, bese ethumela imiqhafazo enama-link nemiyalezo okusolisayo kokuthi ngena kukhona uma ufuna imininingwane ebanzi. Lokho basuke bekwenza ngenhloso yokukuluthela ukukuqola ngokweba imininingwane yakho esemqoka, ngakho ngaphambi kokuthi uze ungene kulowo noxhaka, zibuze ukuthi kungani leyo mininingwane ithunyelwa kuwena ube ungakaze uyicele?
IKOMITI lasePhalamende lifuna uphenyo lwamaphoyisa luveze ukuthi baluthwa kanjani abantu bakuleli abangu-17 abavaleleke eDonbas, emngceleni wase-Ukraine naseRussia, okuthiwa balwa impi ephakathi kwala mazwe.USihlalo wekomiti lobuDlelwano namaZwe oMhlaba, uMnuz Supra Mahumapelo, uthe kumele kuvele ukuthi banxenxwa ngubani ukuthi bayosiza amasosha aseRussia kule mpi."Siyajabula ukuthi amaphoyisa azophenya ukusuka nokuhlala ngokwenzeka kususwa abantu kuleli beyiswa kwamanye amazwe beyolwa impi. Sizofuna nencazelo egcwele eMnyangweni wobuDlelwano namaZwe ngokuthi kwenzekani njengoba nawo wenza olwawo uphenyo." Unxuse abantu ukuthi behlise umoya njengoba kuqhubekauphenyo."UMnyango wobuDlelwano namazwe yiwona omele umengameli wezwe ezintweni ezithinta ubudlelwano namanye amazwe. Umgomo wezwe wukuthi kumele kube nokuxoxisana uma kukhona ukungezwani emazweni ehlukene." Uthe uma kukhona izinhlaka zomshoshaphansi ezisebenza ezweni, kumele zivezwe obala."Uma zikhona izinhlaka eziphambana nemigomo kahulumeni wakuleli, kumele ziphenywe ibheshu," kusho uMahumapelo.Usho lokhu nje lolu daba seluphenywa oKlebe emva kokuba indodakazi endala yomholi weMK, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, uNkk Nkosazana Bonganini Zuma-Mncube, ivulele udadewabo icala, uNkk Duduzile Sambudla-Zuma nabanye ababili oNksz Siphokazi Xuma noMnuz Blessing Khoza. Ibasola ngokulutha abesilisa abangu-17 ukuba bayolwa impi. Esitatimendeni sikaNkk Zuma-Mncube ubavulele amacala athinta ukushushumbiswa kwabantu, awokusiza umbutho wezempi wakwamanye amazwe nelenkohlakalo.Ukwenze lokhu ngoba kulaba besilisa abangu-17, abayisishiyagalombili bangamalungu omndeni wakhe. Uveze ukuthi babengazi futhi abazange bavume ukuyolwa impi ekulawa mazwe. UNgqongqoshe woBudlelwano namaZwe omhlaba, uMnuz Ronald Lamola, uthe uhulumeni wakuleli uxoxa nohulumeni wase-Ukraine nowaseRussia, ukusiza ngalolu daba.Uthe wudaba olungelula lolu ngoba basesizindeni sempi eqhubekayo."Sifuna noma ngubani oyingxenye yokuluthwa kwabantu aboshwe. Siyalusebenza lolu daba ngoba abantu bakuleli okumele babuyele emindenini yabo,” kusho uLamola.I-MK ayikaze ithi vu ngalolu daba. Sekube nemibiko eveza ukuthi babalelwa ku-1 436 abantu bakuleli nabangu-36 abavela kwamanye amazwe okuthiwa bayingxenye yamasosha aseRussia, abalwa le mpi. Imindeni yalaba besilisa kuthiwa ifuna babuyiselwe kuleli.
I-Road Traffic Management Corporation (RTMC) inxusa abanikazi bezimoto ukuthi basebenzise amabhonasi abo okuphela konyaka kanye nezinkokhelo zamakilabhu okonga noma izitokofela ukuze balungise izimoto zabo futhi bavuselele amalayisensi ezimoto ngaphambi kohambo lwamaholide.Njengoba isikhathi samaholidi sisondela ngokushesha abantu abaningi baphothula izinhlelo zabo zohambo. Kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imoto yakho isesimweni esihle ngaphambi kokushayisa umgwaqo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukulungisa noma yiziphi izici okungenzeka azinakwa phakathi nonyaka njengokushintsha amathayi angafanele ukuba semgwaqweni nama-windscreen aphukile, ukulungisa amabhuleki, ukulungisa amalambu nokushintsha ama-wiper.Lezi yizingxenye ezibalulekile kwezokuphepha ikakhulukazi kubantu abazohamba ngesikhathi lina futhi nesimo sezulu singesihle.Ngesikhathi samaholidi nyakenye, izimo zezimoto zaba nomthelela ongu-6.9% wezingozi ezadlula nemiphefumulo ezweni, u-65.7% walezi zibangelwa ukuqhuma kwamasondo kanye no-11.4% ngenxa yamabhuleki angasebenzi. Amalambu angakhanyi (okuholele ekutheni izimoto ezisondelayo zingabonakali kahle) abe negalelo elingu-9.5%. Abanikazi bezimoto bayakhunjuzwa futhi ukuthi baqinisekise ukuthi amalayisensi ezimoto zabo asemthethweni futhi bawavuselele ngaphambi kokuba baqale uhambo lwabo.Amarekhodi e-RTMC akhombisa ukuthi amalayisensi ezimoto ayi-1 060 382 azophelelwa yisikhathi ekupheleni kukaNovemba. Iningi lalezi zimoto liseGauteng, okuyizi-416 828 sezizonke ezizovuselelwa ekupheleni kwenyanga, kulandele iWestern Cape enamalayisense ezimoto angu-197 797 okumele avuselelwe kanye neKwaZulu-Natal ezizovuselelwa ezingu-143 293.Ukuvuselelwa kwamalayisensi ezimoto kwezinye izifundazwe kumi kanje: Mpumalanga 66 446, Eastern Cape 63 263, Limpopo 58 551, Free State 47 572, North West 44 871, and Northern Cape 21 763.
UMNDENI wendoda eboshelwe icala lokubulala, usola umphenyi wecala ngokuyicindezela ngoba ehlulekile wukuthi igwetshwe kwamanye amacala achithwe yizinkantolo ngenxa yokuba ntekenteke kobufakazi. Ngokusho kwesihlobo esicele ukungadalulwa, uMnuz Phelo Mazingolo (36) waseClydesdale, eMzimkhulu, oke waba unogada wesinye sezikhulu kuMasipala waseMzimkhulu, uboshwe ngo-Agasti nonyaka, kulandena isigameko sokudubulana lapho okwagcina kufa khona umuntu oyedwa.Silandisa ngaleso sigameko sithe umsolwa, owayeseyi-bouncer endaweni yokucima ukoma, wanqanda ikhasimende ukuthi lingene nesibhamu ngaphakathi. "Emva kokuthi ikhasimende selishiye isibhamu, kwatheleka amaphoyisa aseKokstad ezohlola ukuthi imithetho igcinwa ngendlela efanele yini, azithela phezu kwesibhamu,” kusho isihlobo.Sithe emva kokuba ewachazele ukuthi isibhamu esekhasimende, usigcine ngoba kungavumelekile ukuthi kungenwe nezikhali ngaphakathi, asithatha amaphoyisa."Amtshela ukuthi akotshela umnikazi waso ukuthi uma esifuna akosilanda esiteshini samaphoyisa eMzimkhulu. Nebala umsolwa waya emaphoyiseni nomnikazi wesibhamu emva kwesikhathi ngosuku olufanayo,” kusho isihlobo. Sithe kwathi uma umnikazi efunwa ilayisensi yaso, wangundaza kodwa amaphoyisa agcina eyalela umsolwa ukuthi akabuyele emuva, amshiye ngemumva umnikazi wesibhamu."Emva kwesikhathi emshiyile, wambona esetheleka nabangani bakhe, baxakazisa umsolwa, bembuza ukuthi ubezama ukwenzani embophisa? Base beqala bedubula bebhekise kuye,” sisho kanje.Sithe umsolwa owavele wabaleka, zazimgeja izinhlamvu. Sithe kwathi engazelele, oyedwa wabahlaseli wayesephambi kwakhe edubula ebhekise ngakuye, naye wabuyisela ngenhlamvu, kanti uzomnemba, ashonele endaweni yesigameko. "Wabiza amaphoyisa, wawatshela osekwenzekile. Kwathi uma efika, leli elingumphenyi, labonakala lixoxa nababedubula umsolwa, maqede kwaboshwa yena,” kusho isihlobo.Sithe laba besilisa ababalelwa kwabane kuya kwabayisihlanu ababoshwanga, kanti babempiklele umsolwa ngesikhathi kubuywa ukolanda isibhamu bathi: "amaphoyisa aseMzimkhulu ngabangani babo.”Sithe egcina ukuvela enkanotolo ngenyanga edlule umsolwa uveze ukuthi njengoba sekuphele izinyanga ezimbili eboshiwe umphenyi akakaze amgingqise izithupha nokwenza ukuboshwa kwakhe kungabi okusemthethweni. "Imantshi yathi lokhu akufanele futhi ukube yiyo eboshiwe nayo ibisizonqaba ukugingqiswa izithupha ngoba isikhathi sesidlule kakhulu,” kusho isihlobo.Sithe okwavela wukuthi ngesikhathi esanda kuboshwa, kwakuphele u-ink esiteshini, wagcina engagingqanga.Siveze ukuthi umsolwa ugcine ala ephetha ukugingqiswa ngelithi akamthembi umphenyi anomlando omubi naye. "Njengoba eboshwe ngo-Agasti, kukhona amanye amacala amabili agcina ehoxiswa enkantolo kuvela ukuthi umphenyi ofanayo akanabo ubufakazi obuphathekayo,” kusho isihlobo.Sithe elokuqala, lalimayelana nokufa kowesifazane ayesehlukene naye owashona engozini yemoto ebuya kuye ngo-2023."Owesifazane wafika kumsolwa ebusuku, waxosha owesifazane ayenaye bahlala. Owesifazane wayelokhu ephuza utshwala. Kwathi esehamba, wehlelwa yingozi yemoto, washona. Kwaboshwa uMazingolo kuthiwa nguye ombulele ngoba nguye owagcina enaye,” kusho isihlobo. Sithe leli cala lagcina lihoxiswa emuva kwezinyanga eziyithupha eboshiwe, kuvela ukuthi amanxeba ayebukeka sengathi awokugwazwa, kwakungawokuhlatshwa amabhodlela amawindi emoto. Siqhube sathi kwenzeka lokhu nje, kwakukhona umdonsiswano phakathi kwakhe nomufi, bebanga imoto ayemdayisele yona kodwa engasafuni ukumnika amaphepha ayo yize ayeseqedile ukuyikhokhela. "Umufi wadayisela uMazingolo imoto, wakhokha idiphozithi, wase emnika yona. Wayelokhu ekhokha imali eyayisele njalo ngenyanga yaze yaphela. Isiphelile, owesifazane wangabe esafuna ukumnika i-logbook,” kusho isihlobo. Sithe kwenzeka ingozi nje babekade bebuya enkantolo lapho okwanqunywa khona ukuthi akamnike i-logbook, uma ehluleka ambuyisele imali yakhe."Eseboshiwe, umyeni wowesifazane (umufi), ephethe i-logbook, waziyela enkantolo ngokwakhe ethi akulandwe imoto ngoba ibikuMazingolo ngokungemthetho, inkantolo yavuma ukuthi ayithathe,” kusho isihlobo.Sithe leyo moto yagcina ithathwa amaphoyisa kumyeni kamufi, sekuvela ukuthi naye uyithathe ngokungemthetho njengoba enye inkantolo yase inqume ukuthi uMazingolo okufanele anikwe i-logbook. Sithe ngesikhathi ededelwa, kuthiwa icala lokufa kowesifazane akulona elokubulala, waphuma wayofuna imoto yakhe emaphoyiseni."Wayifica isesimeni esibi, kubonakala ukuthi kade isebenza. Kwathi uma ebuza ukuthi kungani imoto yakhe inje, umphenyi ofanayo wamthumelela ngamaphoyisa avele ambopha ethi ubewasabisa ngommese. Nalo leli cala lafike lamchitha, inkantolo yathi akalethe ummese umsolwa ayesabisa ngawo amaphoyisa maqede wathi akawutholi, walahleka,” kusho isihlobo.Sithe yiwo wonke lo mlando owenza umsolwa nabo bakholelwe ekutheni umphenyi kufanele ashintshwe ngoba yena nomsolwa baneziwombe zokushayisana. Uveze ukuthi kukhona lapho umphenyi ake wamtshela khona kwezikabhoqo ukuthi uma engafuni ukubambisana naye, agingqe izithupha, uzokwenza impilo yakhe ibe nzima ngokuthi alokhu ethi usaqoqa ubufakazi, ukuze lihlehliswe icala.Uthe basola ukuthi udinwa wukuthi amacala aphambilini abemhlula enkantolo ngoba ubufakazi bungekho bese eyadedelwa umsolwa.

The AVBOB Group delivered a solid business performance for the reporting year. With another successful year behind it, AVBOB remains encouraged by its shared value model which has guided the business for 107 years.The bonus allocation of R15 billion to members, in the form of the 65Alive cash benefit, follows an equally substantial declaration to qualifying members announced in the previous year. Over the past two years, AVBOB has allocated a total of R28,1 billion to members in 65Alive cash benefits. AVBOB members are entitled to share in the profit of the business through bonus allocations and member benefits, which are available over and above the policy benefits. The 65Alive cash benefit can be claimed when the policyholder turns 65 year and your policy that has been in force for at least 10 years. As of June 2025, close to R100 million has been paid to members who received their 65Alive cash benefit. At AVBOB’s 74th Annual General Meeting, held at the Group’s head office in Irene Link, Chairperson of the Board, Jannie Venter, described the historic bonus declaration as a demonstration of staying true to the founding principles of the business’s shared value model. The Board of Directors remains dedicated to enhancing member benefits and continually shape growth plans for the business to positively impact communities it serves.Venter explains that the "organisation’s existence and growth is built on a people-first philosophy, and that socio-economic challenges and growing inequality demand that the organisation do more to help mitigate the challenges of poverty and unemployment”. CREATING VALUE AND GROWTHDespite a challenging and shifting global economic environment in which the Group operated, Venter emphasised that the business remains relevant in a fast changing and competitive landscape by investing in capability and pursuing measured growth.The Group delivered strong results for the 2025 financial year, with total assets increasing to R48,4 billion. Demonstrating agility in a dynamic and challenging operating environment, AVBOB introduced a micro-lending product currently being rolled out to members through a phased approach alongside innovative digital solutions designed to enhance service delivery and ensure a member-centric experience. These initiatives remain firmly guided by the Group’s shared value philosophy and dedication to sustainable growth for our members.AVBOB maintained its Level 1 B-BBEE rating, strengthening its commitment to transformation and inclusive growth. With approximately 2.9 million policyholders and more than 9.7 million lives assured, the Group continues to uphold its legacy as a trusted household brand for millions of South Africans. The 2025 financial year highlightsIn the financial year ended 30 June 2025, AVBOB achieved the following:The Group paid R3,3 billion in contract benefits and claims. The national footprint of funeral service, insurance and client service offices increased to a total of 385 offices.Through AVBOB Funeral Service, members received R529,1 million in FREE funeral benefits.AVBOB Member Rewards shared over R170 million and achieved an enrolment of 556 363 members.As part of its investment in literacy and education, AVBOB refurbished 12 container libraries and donated 1 000 trolley libraries to underserved schools and education NPOs across the country. Uveze ukuthi lona ngumbono abaqhamuka nawo ngoJanuwari 2023, baqala bayowethula emakhosini endawo, awuthakasela. Uthe badlulela KwaPhindangene beyocela isibusiso. "Samukelwa ngezandla ezimhlophe. Sabe sesidlulela endlunkulu siyowethula. Nakhona kwaba okufanayo,” kusho uShabalala.Uthe okwenze umcimbi wenziwa ngalolu suku wukuthi yilona okunesiqiniseko sokuthi wadlula ngalo emhlabeni, njengoba lungaziwa kahle azalwa ngalo."Lena yindlela yethu yokumkhumbula,” kusho uShabalala. Uthe angu-130 amabutho abawahlanganise emakhosini ayishumi akhele iNquthu. Uthe inkosi ngayinye ibiletha iqoqo labangu-13. Obehlanganisa ibutho elicija ngamahubo yiciko uMbuso Khoza othe kungaba wumqondo omuhle uma abanye omasipala benza okufanayo. "Kube wukuthi kuyabhekwa ukuthi amakhosi alowo masipala mangaki, kuhlaliswe phansi amabutho, aqeqeshwe njengabaculi ukuze ingenzeki le nto yokuthi abantu badle amazambane uma kunemicimbi, bangezwakali ukuthi bathini,” kusho uKhoza. Uqhube wathi lokhu kuzolekelela ekutheni kugwemeke ukuthi amakhorasi agcine esethatha indawo yamahubo uma kunemicimbi. LIPHINDE lagixabezwa ngesinye isihlalo esibalulekile eNdlunkulu, iSo leSilo uMisuzulu kaZwelithini, iNkosi Malusi Zondi yaseMzinyathi, eNanda, njengoba ngoMgqibelo, iSilo silinike isikhundla sokuhamba amazwe ahlukene egameni leNdlunkulu kaZulu.ISilo lokhu sikumemezele emcimbinini obuseMzinto, la bekugcotshwa khona iNkosi uMbuso Ngcobo, saveza nokuthi lesi sikhala bese kunesikhathi singenamuntu.Ekuqaleni kwalo nyaka, lesi sikhundla sanikwa usomabhizinisi uSbongiseni Mbambo odume ngelikaMageza. UMbambo obesekunesikhathi engabonakali ngisho emicimbini yaseNdlunkulu njengoba bekujwayeleke ukwenzeka, akucaci ukuthi kwenzakaleni kuye.INdlulamithi yamakhosi ithe ibeka uZondi ukuze amakhosi axhumane naye uma kukhona akudingayo kwamanye amazwe, njengoba esezoba umlomo wawo uma ehambile."Ngithanda ukuthi namhlanje ngisukumise oyiSo lami iNkosi uZondi ukuthi kube nguye ozothatha izintambo ekutheni axhumanise iNdlunkulu kaZulu nezinye iziNdlunkulu emazweni ehlukene. Amakhosi uzoba umlomo wami kula mazwe azobe ewahambela uma kukhona enikufunayo kuye nimtshele uzohambe enifunela emazweni azohamba kuwo,” kusho uNdlulamithi.Ithe manje izimisele ukuhamba iqhubeka ibeka amakhosi noma angu-10 ngonyaka ngoba lokhu kwenza isizwe sithuthuke ezintweni eziningi."Ngisho intuthuko iyama uma inkosi ingabekiwe ngokusemthethweni ngakho ngiyanxusa ukuthi abe maningi amakhosi abekwayo, ukuze isizwe sizothuthuka,” kubeka Isilo.UZondi uthe uyasamukela isikhundla anikwa sona futhi uzosiphatha ngezandla zombili. UZondi uhlube udlubu ekhasini ekhuluma nobuholi bendabuko engqungqutheleni yeG20 ngempalsonto.ISilo izolo, sidlulele eMgababa la bekunembizo khona ebihlelwe yiNkosi uPhathizwe Luthuli.
Ikhansela, 34, lasePienaar, uDumsane Christopher Gonrover Masilela, livele ngoMsombuluko ngaphambi kweNkantolo yaKaNyamazane ngamacala amabili okuzama ukubulala. Icala lihlehliselwe uLwesibili ukuze kuqhutshekwe nesicelo sakhe sebheyili. Phambilini i-IOL ike yabika ukuthi uMasilela uboshwe ngesonto eledlule ngemuva kwezinsolo zokuthi uvulele ngenhlamvu ngesikhathi kunengxabano ehlobene nokushona kwentombazane. Okhulumela amaphoyisa esifundazweni uLieutenant Colonel Jabu Ndubane uthe indaba yaqala ngoLwesine, lapho ubaba wasendaweni yasePienaar exoxisana nendodakazi yakhe eneminyaka engu-16 ubudala ngemuva kokubona ukuthi ibibonakala icindezelekile futhi ihlale ikhala.Kuthiwa le ntombazane imtshele ukuthi kunomfana esikoleni oyihlukumezayo. UNdubane uthe ubaba wahamba nendodakazi yakhe beya lapho kuhlala khona umfana eyokhomba umsolwa, kodwa umfana wayengekho ekhaya. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi washiya indodakazi yakhe. Wabuya ekhaya ngokuhamba kwesikhathi wathola indodakazi yakhe izibulele. Wanqamula intambo eyayizilengise ngayo wayiphuthumisa emtholampilo oseduze nalapho kwatholakala ukuthi ishonile. Kwathi ngabo-7.30 ebusuku ubaba esekhaya wezwa umsindo egumbini lokuphumula. Wathi uma eyophenya wafica izihlobo zomkakhe ongasekho zingaphakathi endlini zithetha, zikhala ngokuthi akabazisanga ngokufa kwendodakazi."Kuqubuke ingxabano, ikhansela laku-Ward 29 - elisondelene nomndeni kanina wentombazane - kusolwa ukuthi lalizama ukulamula lakhipha isibhamu. "Ikhansela kuthiwa lidubule lalimaza ubaba kamufi kanjalo nomakhelwane obezama ukunqanda impi,” kusho uNdubane. Zombili izisulu ziphuthunyiswe esibhedlela.
UKHATHAZEKILE umndeni womfana okuthiwa wagwazwa waklinywa uyise omncane ngonyaka odlule, owagcwala amathafa emva kokudedelwa ngebheyili. Kulesi sigameko esenzeka ePhola, eChesterville, eThekwini, ngoJanuwari 3, 2024, umsolwa uMnuz Sduduzo Mavundla (29) wahlasela, walimaza uMpendulo Msweli (9), wamshiya ethi ufile.Ugogo kamgilwa ngasohlangothini lukanina, uNkk Veronica Msweli, uthe kahle hle umgilwa uhlala eNtuzuma, kodwa isigameko senzeka eChesterville, umgilwa evakashele umkhulu ohlangothini lukayise. "Uyise wakhe omncane wamyenga ngokuthi abahambe ayomthengela ama-chips esitolo. Sebesendleleni, wamjikela wamfaka ehlathini lapho amshaya khona, wagwazwa ngesikhali esingazi ukuthi sasiyini kodwa okukhombisa ukuthi sasinamazinyo wase emklinya, wamshiya ethi ufile,” kusho uNkk Msweli.Uqhube wathi umgilwa wabuye waphaphama sekuhwalele, wadwanguza, waze wafika ngasemgwaqweni, lapho asizwa khona umuntu wendawo ahlangana naye.Uveze ukuthi lo muntu wamphuthumisa esibhedlela iKing Edward, yona eyamdlulisela eNkosi Albert Luthuli Central. "Wahlala esibhedlala izinyanga ezintathu. Esesilandisa ngesehlo wasitshela ukuthi uyise omncane ngesikhathi emhlasela wayethi uyise (kamgilwa) umjwayela kabi, ufuna ukumfundisa isifundo,” usho kanje. Uthe nakuba bengakaze baluthole ulwazi olugcwele ngokuthi kwakuyini imbangela yokuthi ahlasele umgilwa kodwa bezwa kuthiwa uyise (kamgilwa) wayemkweleta imali umfowabo."Asazi noma wayihlaselela lokho yini ingane,” kusho uNkk Msweli. Uthe kuningi okwenzeke ecaleni okwenza babone sengathi ezobulungiswa zibenzela phansi.Phakathi kokunye uthe, bamangala bezwa ukuthi umsolwa wadedelwa ngebheyili ngawo uJanuwari 2024 nathe yinto abayizwa emva kwezinyanga ezintathu yenzekile."Kwathi uma siyobuza enkantolo kumshushisi, wasichazela into esingayizwa. Kwathi uma sibuza ngenqubekela phambili yecala, nakhona wathi asikho isidingo sokuthi silokhu siza enkantolo,” kusho uNkk Msweli. Uthe umshushisi wabatshela ukuthi abeze ngosuku oluthile ngoSepthemba nyakenye, nokwathi uma sebeya, batshelwa ukuthi bekuwusuku olungafanele."Sagcina sithole ukuthi wayevela ngalelo langa kodwa akafikanga. Uma sithola, kuthiwa akazange eze enkantolo, selokhu abaleka lokho lokho,” kusho uNkk Msweli.Uthe basola ukuthi wabaleka wayobhaca eGoli lapho kuzalwa khona unina. Uveze ukuthi udaba luwukhathaza wonke umndeni ngoba abazi ukuthi umsolwa uphi nokuthi umndeni uphephe kangakanani njengoba egcwele amathafa nje.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa acela ukulekelelwa wumphakathi kutholwe umsolwa ofunelwa icala lokuzama ukubulala umgilwa. Ngokusho kwakhe, umsolwa watshela umgilwa ngosuku lwesigameko ukuthi uyise akamhloniphi ngakho ke uzomfundisa isifundo. "Emva kokwenza isigameko, umsolwa wakhohlisa umndeni (eChesterville) wathi umgilwa udukile ngakho akuphuthunywe kuyobikwa emaphoyiseni esiteshini saseCato Manor,” kusho uNetshiunda. Uthe emva kophenyo umsolwa waboshwa, kodwa wabuye wadedelwa ngebheyili, kwabe bayamgcina enkantolo."Incwadi egunyaza ukuboshwa kwakhe yakhishwa ngoSepthemba nyakenye, kanti amaphoyisa alokhu emcinga kusukela lapho,” kusho uNetshiunda othe noma ubani ongaba nolwazi lokuthi umsolwa ubhacephi angathinta umphenyi wecala uCaptain Ndlovu wasesiteshini samaphoyisa eCato Manor noma ashayele inombolo yamaphoyisa engakhokhelwa ethi 08600 10111.
INKOSI uZuzifa Buthelezi wabamba iqhaza ekutheni iciko, uMbuso Khoza, lingabe lisaqhubeka nomcabango wokuzibulala.Lokhu kuvele ngoLwesihlanu, eNcome Museum, eNquthu, ngesikhathi kuqhubeka umcimbi wokuqala wokuvuselelwa kwamahubo ayehutshwa uMntwana uMagogo Buthelezi, iMntwana Magogo Musical Amahubo Development.UButhelezi uveze lokhu, ebonga umbono kaMasipala waseNquthu wokuthi kuvuselelwe lawa amahubo ayehutshwa nguninakhulu ngaphambi kokuba ashone ngo-1984. Lo masipala ulande uKhoza ngenyanga edlule, ukuba acije kahle ibutho lendawo ngenhloso yokuthi likhiphe uthulamsindo wamahubo.UButhelezi uveze ukuthi uKhoza wakhuluma naye nokwaba wusizo."Wathi uma ekhuluma nami, ngamkhuza kulowo mcabango,” kusho uButhelezi. Ubuze uKhoza phambi kwezihlwele wathi: "Ngabe senzenjani-ke namhlanje ukube awusekho?”Umfanise negula, ngolwazi lwakhe lomlando nokuthanda ukuzibandakanya ezintweni ezithinta umlando.UKhoza wake waluveza udaba lwakhe lokuzama ukuzibulala ekhuluma kwiPodcast kaMacG, lapho aveza khona ukuthi ngo-2018, wayekweleta imenenja yakhe uVusi Zuma imali engango-R300 000. "Loya muntu wangisiza kakhulu, wayenginika u-R10 000 njalo ngenyanga. Ngathi uma ngibuka iminyaka ihamba, ngabona ukuthi ngimkweleta u-R300 000. Ngazibuza ukuthi ngizoyikhokha kanjani yonke le mali,” kusho uKhoza kwiPodcast. Watshela uMacG ukuthi wathi esuka wabe ethenga amaphilisi amaningi emakhemisi ehlukene ukuze kungasolisi."Ngabe sengithumela umyalezo endodakazini kaMntwana waKwaPhindangene, kuyena uMntwana, unina wengane yami nabanye abaseduze nami,” kusho uKhoza kwiPodcast. Echaza, wathi umcabango wokuzibulala wamfikela yize uZuma ayengakaze amfake ingcindezi yokuthi abuyise imali. Watshela uMacG ukuthi uyingqwele uma kuziwa ngasekuzameni ukuzibulala, waveza ukuthi cishe usekwenze izikhawu eziyisishiyagalolunye, waveza ukuthi ngeke asho ukuthi sewakunqoba ukucabanga ukuzibulala kodwa kuyinto ahlala ahlale ayichilize uma kwenzeka imfikela.
AMALUNGU omphakathi waseMbumbulu athi ncinci kaMjoli ngokubulawa kowesilisa obesolwa ngokuba yinkabi abakholwa ukuthi nguye obeqotha imbokodo nesisekelo, ebulala abantu kule ndawo.Kuvela ukuthi umufi, uMnuz Qha Dlamini (31), udutshulwe wafa ezintathakusa zayizolo kade etholene phezulu namaphoyisa eFolweni.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, ukuqinisekisile ukubulawa kukaDlamini.Uthe uDlamini ufe etholene phezulu namaphoyisa eFolweni, wathi amaphoyisa abekade emfuna phansi phezulu ngoxhaxha lwamacala okubulala ezindaweni ezihlukene."Amaphoyisa abekade emcinga aze athola umkhondo owaholele eFolweni. Ngesikhathi ebona amaphoyisa efika, uvele waqala wawadubula," usho kanjena.UNetshiunda uthe lo wesilisa uze waphuma ngewindi waqhubeka nokudubula ebhekise emaphoyiseni."Amaphoyisa nawo awalenzanga iphutha, avele adubula wase eshona endaweni yesigameko," usho kanjena.Uthe uDlamini utholakale ne-AK 47 nezibhamu ezimbili ezincane. Uthe amaphoyisa awabanga namyocu kulokhu kudubulana yize umufi ebewadubula ngesibhamu esikhulu.UNdunankulu wesizwe sakwaMakhanya, uMnuz Mbongeni Makhanya, uthe umphakathi ulimise ngesihloko elokuthi liphume nobovu ngokuthi lugobe uphondo kuDlamini obewuhlalise ngesinqe esisodwa umphakathi waseDidini.Uveze ukuthi uDlamini ubewuhlupho kakhulu oDidini, lapho okukhona abakwaHlengwa, Maphumulo nabakwaMkhize.Amalungu omphakathi akhulume neSolezwe, ajabulise okwezingane ezincane zibona amaswidi ngokubulawa kukaDlamini.Acele ukuba agodlwe amagama abo. "Lo muntu ubaqedile abantu lapha eMbumbulu. Kuzoke kushaye umoya njengoba esebulewe," kusho omunye wabahlali.Omunye uthe bebehleli lubhojozi ngenxa kamufi."Baphelile abantu uDlamini. Kwesinye isikhathi ubebatshela abomndeni ukuthi uyena obulele," echaza.Laba bebekhuluma neSolezwe kunomsindo kujatshulwa. Esikhathini esifishane balinganiselwa ku-28 abantu ababulewe ngokudutshulwa eMbumbulu.Ngaphambilini, kwake kwasabalala ukuthi umnyombo wokubulawa kwabantu kule ndawo kungenxa yengwadla yokwebiwa kwemfuyo.Nokho umphakathi wabuye washaya ingqimphothwe kulokhu njengoba kwase kubulawa nabantu abangenayo imfuyo. Abaningi bekungacaci ukuthi babulawa ngoba bedleni kabani.Phakathi kwabantu asebebulewe kufaka ukubalwa kwenduna yaseMbumbulu, uMnuz Sphiwe Msweli, eyadutshulwa ivala esitolo sayo ngonyaka odlule.Ngemuva kwezinyanga ezimbalwa, nendodana yayo, uMnuz Mhlengi Msweli, bayithela othulini, wasala uthuthumela umphakathi.Kukaningi kugobhoza igazi kule ndawo. Kuke kwabulawa noMnuz Skhumbuzo Ndlovu owahlaselwa ekwakhe, obulawe maphakathi nalo nyaka. UNdlovu wabulawa kungakapholi maseko kade kudutshulwe kwafa uMnuz Mduduzi Ngcongo.UNgcongo wadutshulwa eFolweni, esemotweni yakhe. Kwabulawa noMnuz Mzwandile Nxumalo owahlaselwa esemzini wakhe edutshulwa ngoyaba lwezinhlamvu waphelela endaweni yesigameko.Kwasocongwa nabesilisa abahlanu esigamekweni esashiya umphakathi wakule ndawo uthuthumela futhi unenqwaba yemibuzo.Kwasabalala nendaba yemoto iToyota Etios ebomvu, okwakuthiwa uma kuke kwabonakala yona izulazula ebusuku, nakanjani kusa nesidumbu. Kwake kwavela nokuthi kunabesifazane akade belala emahlathini ngenxa yokwesabela ukwenzakaliswa.Isolezwe lake lathunyelelwa inkulumo eyayiphakathi kwendodana yenyanga eyayihanjwa uDlamini, igonyuluka ngokuthi uyise akasathandi ukuqinisa uDlamini kodwa lokhu usekwenza ngoba ephoqiwe (uyise).UNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli ephawula ngesimo saseMbumbulu, wathi ubengazi lutho ngaso kodwa kukhona izaba azozenza uma esethole kahle ngokuqhubeka kule ndawo. UNtuli wayebuzwa ngalokhu kunembizo yokulwa nobugebengu eGlebelands, eMlaza, ezinyangeni ezibalwa ezedlule.
UKHUNGATHEKILE umndeni wakwa-C,eMlaza ngemuva kokuba kudutshulwe kwabulawa umfana ngabantu abangaziwa ebebemphanga umakhalekhukhwini. Kuvela ukuthi umufi uThabiso Dlamini (15) udutshulwe ngowesilisa owehle emotweni emhlophe wamyalela ukuba amnikeze umakhalekhukhwini."Kuthe uma enqaba nawo owesilisa wavele wamdubula kanye ngenhlamvu esiswini yaze yaphumela emhlane. Ubulawe ngesihluku ngenxa nje kamakhalekhukhwini," kuchaza ilungu lomndeni uNksz Ayanda Dlamini.Uveze ukuthi umufi ubephuma endlini eya esitolo ngesikhathi kuthushuka le moto.Ngokusho kwakhe bathole ukuthi bakhona nabanye ebebengaphakathi emotweni ngesikhathi omunye ehilizisana nomufi. "Okubuhlungu kakhulu wukuthi udutshulwe phambi komngani wakhe ebuka. Angazi ngempela ukuthi yishwa lani leli elisivelele," kuchaza yena. Uthe kuyabaxaka ukuthi sekungaze kuphume isidumbu ngenxa kamakhalekhukhwini."UThabiso unqabile ngesikhathi kuthiwa akawulethe umakhalekhukhwini. Kusho ukuthi kumcasulile lokho umsolwa wamane wamdubula washonela esibhedlela," kuchaza yena. Eqhuba uthe bagqemeke engeqiwa ntwala ngokubulawa kukaThabiso.Ukhale ngokuthi lokhu sekuthanda ukuba wumkhokha njengoba lo mndeni kade ugqigqa ezinkantolo ngemuva kokuba kwadutshulwa kwabulawa uMnuz Smanga "Katsande" Khumalo (21) owayehlobene nomndeni owayehamba ngesihlalo esinamasondo. Naye wadutshulwa ephangwa umakhalekhukhwini.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi icala likaKatsande laba yindaba egudwini ngemuva kokuba kwavela ukuthi libandakanya owesilisa owayekhiphe umyalelo wokubulawa kwakhe esejele. Kungumlando manje ukuthi ababulala uKhumalo bakhalelwa ngamasongo kaSigonyela balahlwa yicala bagwetshwa.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu Natal uColonel Robert Netshiunda ukuqinisekisile ukubulawa kukaThabiso. "Amaphoyisa aseMlaza aphenya icala lokubulala ngemuva kokudutshulwa komfana oneminyaka engu-15," usho kanjena.
INHLANGANO yabantu abasha iYouth4You Foundation yethule umkhankaso wokukhuliswa ngendlela kwezingane zabafana eSilweni samabandla onke, uMisuzulu kaZwelithini esigodlweni eMashobeni, oPhongolo. Abasunguli bale nhlangano bathe baye eSilweni ngenhloso yokuthola izibusiso kuso. Bathe okubagqugquzelile wukubona izingane zamantombazane zigqugquzelwa ngohlelo loMkhosi woMhlanga ekubeni intsha yesilisa ingenziwa lutho.UNksz Siphindile Khawula uthe ONgangezwe Lakhe uzwakalise ukujabula okukhulu ngokubambisana ne-Youth4You Foundation ezinhlelweni ezahlukene okuhloswe ngazo ukuthuthukisa intsha."ISilo uMisuzulu KaZwelithini sigcizelele ukubaluleka kokusebenzisana nabaholi abasebasha saphawula ukuthi yibona abazogcina ubuholi besizwe sakithi. Lo mhlangano ubudingida ngezinhlelo zeYouth4You Foundation zokweseka ukukhuliswa kwabafana kanye nokuvuselelwa kokusokwa kwabesilisa KwaZulu."UNksz Khawula uthe ngo-2013, iNgonyama eseyabuza, uZwelithini kaBhekuzulu, yazama ukuvuselela leli siko kodwa ayizange iphumelele ngenxa yokuntula ukwesekwa yizinhlangano."I-Youth4You Foundation izibophezele ngokuthi izokweseka Ingonyama ekhona njengamanje ekuvuseleleni ukusokwa kwabesilisa KwaZulu, kanti kuzokwenziwa izinhlelo ezahlukene ukufeza lo mgomo.I-Youth4You Foundation izoba nekamu ngoDisemba 15, elizofundisa abafana abancane ngokubaluleka kokusoka nangocansi."Uthe ikamu lihlose ukulungiselela abafana ukuthi basokwe, babe nezindlela zokubhekana nokukhathazeka nokunye."Ikamu lizophinde libhekane nezindaba zomphakathi ezifana nokusebenzisa izidakamizwa, ubugebengu, nodlame olusekelwe ebulilini. Kuzodlalwa umculo wesintu wesiZulu. Abafana bazobamba iqhaza eMkhosini Wokweshwama ngoJanuwari nomcimbi wesintu wokubungaza 'ukukhula' kwabo."Uthe iSilo sabona isidingo sokuvuselela uMkhosi Wokweshwama, onganakiwe uma uqhathaniswa noMkhosi woMhlanga.
AZIWUVALI umlomo izaguga zenhlangano yabantu abadala baseNkungumathe, eNkandla, iZamokuhle Luncheon Club, emuva kokuyopepenyeka eGauteng. Unobhala wale nhlangano, uMnuz Busani Mhlongo, uthe babheme bakholwa kulolu hambo ngoba bathole isikhathi sokukhohlwa kancane amahlalakhona, bashaywa wumoya.Uthe yize le nhlangano inamalungu angu-100 kodwa kuhambe izaguga ezingu-55 ezisakwazi ukuzihambela. Uze wathembisa ukusivakashela ngoDisemba ezosinikeza izipho zikaKhisimusi," kusho uMhlongo.Usihlalo weNkungumathe NPO, uMnuz Mthokozi Mchunu, uthe bahambe nezaguga ngesonto eledlule ngenhloso yokuba ziyobona izindawo ezingamaguga nezimqoka eGauteng. Uthe zivakashele izindlu zoMbuso ePitoli, zaya emzini kaDkt Nelson Mandela nokaMbhishobhi Desmond Tutu eSoweto, zadlulela eHartis Boots seziyongcebeleka."Zisuke lapho zavakshela eSouth Gate Mall."UMchunu uthe basungula le kilabhu ngenhloso yokuthi njalo ngezinsuku ezinhlanu esontweni kube nezinto ezenziwa yizaguga zakule ndawo. Zivamise ukudingida ngezihloko ezithinta impilo yakudala, ziyiqhathanisa neyamanje," kuphetha uMchunu.
UMNUZ Sbu Mpisane, owayengumyeni wempunyela uNksz Shauwn Mkhize, ukhwele wadilika kuShauwn ngokwephula umgomo wesehlukaniso sabo, owawuyalela uShauwn ukuba amnikeze ingxenye yamasheya ezimpahleni zabo, njengoba umshado wabo wawuhlanganisa amafa. UMpisane ukhathazekile ngezimpahla zabo ezihlukahlukene kanye nesamba semali ekwi-akhawunti kaShauwn, njengoba incipha ngenxa yokuthi inkampani eqoqa intela iSars idla kwasani ethinta uShauwn emuva kokwephula imithetho yokukhokhwa kwentela. Ngokusho komthombo, uMpisane, owaduma ngokuvela komshado wakhe noShauwn, udliwa wukhwantalala lokuthi uShauwn uziba imiyalelo yeNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini ngemigomo yesahlukaniso esaphothulwa ngoNovemba 18 nyakenye. "UMaMkhize (okuyigama okuteketiswa ngalo uShauwn), akatholakali njengoba engawuhloniphi umyalelo wenkantolo. Lokho kwenza ingxenye okufanele itholwe wuMpisane igcine seyidliwa yiSars futhi kudayiswe nezimpahla zabo abazithola besashadile," kusho umthombo osondelene noMpisane kodwa onqabile ukudalulwa. Kuze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela uShauwn engakayiphenduli imibuzo athunyelelwe yona kanti nommeli wakhe unqabile ukuphendula imibuzo. Kubikwa ukuthi ngesikhathi abakwaSars beyopequlula emizini kaShauwn eThekwini, eMgungundlovu naseGoli, kwashaqwa inqwaba yezimpahla ezimba eqolo ngenhloso yokukhokhelwa kwentela ebalelwa kuR40 million. Iqembu likaShauwn ebeligijima kwiPremier Soccer League iRoyal AM FC lafakwa nalo lapho maqede ladayiswa. UShauwn wakhokha uR50 million ethenga iBloemfontein Celtic, eyagcina isibizwa ngeRoyal AM.Ngesikhathi kuhlaselwa inkambu yeRoyal AM nalapho iziqeqeshela khona eRoyal Ranch eMgungundlovu, kwathathwa amaloli nefenisha kushaqwa izimpahla.Amaloli athwala impahla encane nenkulu atheleka ezoshaqa izimoto zikaShauwn, okubalwa kuzo ezisebenza enkontilakeni yakhe nezinye iziqukathi. Phakathi kwezimoto ezashaqwa kukhona iLamborghini, Rolls-Royce, Mercedes-Benz Maybach, BMW X6, Mercedes-Benz-AMG G63, Toyota Hilux Legend 50 neMercedes-Benz S-Class. Kubikwa ukuthi ama-akhawunti kaShauwn avaliwe. Ngokwe-bscholarly.com/richest-women-in-south-africa, uShauwn wayebhekene nezinkinga zentela ngo-2024 ekubeni ayekleliswe kunombolo 12 ohlwini lwabesifazane abayizinjinga kuleli futhi kwathiwa unempahla ebiza u-$300 million, okuyimali elingana no-R51 billion ngokwemali yakuleli. Umshado kaMpisane noShauwn wawungo-1991 kodwa ngaleso sikhathi uMpisane wayeyiphoyisa lomgwaqo eThekwini ekhomba ngophakathi. IMercury enguzakwabo weSolezwe yabika ukuthi uMpisane wayehola uR15 000 ngenyanga ngo-2008 kuMasipala waseThekwini kodwa ehamba ngeLamborghini uma eya emsebenzini ephuma emzini kaR17 million eDurban North. Kwavela ukuthi le mpilo yomntakabani uMpisane wayeyiphiliswa yimali yamathenda uShauwn ayewathola ngenkampani yakhe yokwakha iZikhulise. Kuthiwa uMpisane akakwazanga ukuxhumana nobengumkakhe mayelana nengxenye yamasheya akhe. Usezame kaningi ukuxhumana noShauwn ukuze baphothule eyesehlukaniso kodwa akatholakali "Kubikwa ukuthi (uShauwn) wabonakala eSwatini, lapho kuthiwa ubambe iqhaza eqenjini lebhola," kusho umlingani kaMpisane.Emuva kokuphucwa iRoyal AM, uShawun wavumbuka esenguMengameli weqembu laseSwatini iMbabane Highlands FC. Umthombo uthe uMpisane uhlela ukufaka lolu daba enkantolo ukuze athole umkhombandlela ngesinyathelo okufanele asithathe njengoba uShauwn eziba imiyalelo yenkantolo. "Isehlukaniso sesiphothuliwe,hodwa owasifaka ngo-2018,akatholakali ukuze aqedele konke akuqala."Ethintwa uMpisane, uthe akakwazi ukuphawula ngoba akuyena owafaka isicelo sesehlukaniso. "Okungcono thinta uMaMkhize owafaka isicelo sesehlukaniso futhi uyena okufanele aphendule le mibuzo," kushaya uMpisane ngezinqamulelayo.

KUNABANTU abaqoma bengakapholi futhi bengakakhohlwa yizithandwa zabo, umuntu aqome ngoba ethi uzama ukupholisa amanxeba okuthi waliwe okanye uhlukumezekile lapho ephuma khona, bese eqome/aqonywe esadiniwe ngoba inhliziyo isasele emumva bese ezama ukubasela lona aphuma kuye. Omunye afune ngisho ukuthandana nomuntu ocishe afane nalona asuka kuye, aze azame ngisho ukumshintshisa indlela agqoka ngayo ngoba efuna afane nalona asuka kuye.Akugcini lapho ngoba le nto iyabhebhetheka igcine seyona "uthando" esingazi noma lusuke lukade lukhona yini, agcine umuntu eseqhathanisa athi" usibanibani wayengcono kabi kunawe, usibanibani wayengakwenzi ukuthi nokuthi, ngenkathi ngisathandana nosibanibani ngangingayidli into ethile". Lapho uyabona ke ukuthi umuntu useyaziveza ukuthi kahle hle inhliziyo yakhe ayikho othandweni lwenu kodwa isasemumva lapho esuka khona.Namhlanje ngifisa abantu bazifundise ukwelapheka/ukuphola ngaphambi kokungena emjolweni olandelayo ngoba ukungena nenhliziyo ebuhlungu kuyalumosha uthando kuphinde kuhlukumeze lo muntu osuke ekuthanda ngempela, omunye umuntu ugcina eselahlekelwa wumuntu omthanda ngempela ngenxa yokuqhathanisa.Ngiyazi ukuthi uma usanda kuphuma emjolweni usuke uphithene ikhanda ufisa sengathi kungenzeka umlingo ukuze lo muntu okuhlukumezile ezwe ubuhlungu, omunye ugcina eseqoma noma wubani ngoba inhliziyo isuke ibuhlungu ethi uzama ukuphola.Engingakusho wukuthi ungaqhathanisi umuntu othandana naye nabantu osudlule kubo, ungangeni emjolweni ngelukuluku, hlala phansi bese uyageza uphithizele wenze into ezokwenza ungacabangi kakhulu. Uzothi usulaphekile bese uyamthola umuntu ongeke umqhathanise kodwa ozomamukela enjengoba enjalo, ngaleyo ndlela awuzohamba uphatha kabi abantu abasuke bekuthanda ngeqiniso.

ISIKHULU esiphezulu se-Ezemvelo KZN Wildlife, uMnuz Sihle Mkhize, situse abasebenzi balesi sikhungo iHluhluwe-Imfolozi Park esibhekele ukuphepha nokuvikela imvelo nezilwane KwaZulu-Natal, ngeqhaza abalibambayo besebenza okubonakala kuthela izithelo ezinhle.UMkhize usho njalo ekhuluma embuthanweni abewuhlelele ukutusa umsebenzi omuhle wethimba lakhe, lapho encome khona ukuzikhandla kwalo ukuqikelela ukuthi kuvikeleka izilwane zaseziqiwini ikakhulu obhejane, okuhlale kuba nezigameko zokunqunywa kwezimpondo zabo ngenhloso yokuhweba ngazo ngokungemthetho."Sizimisele ngokuqhubeka senze konke okusemandleni ethu ukuqikelela ukuthi abasebenzi bethu abenza lo msebenzi bavikeleka njalo ukuze bakhuthalele ukuqhubeka nomsebenzi wabo ngobuqotho nangeqiniso," usho kanje.Uthe kuhle futhi kuyajabulisa ukuthi ukuzikhandla kwabasebenzi bakhe kuthela izithelo ezinhle nezibonakalayo njengoba kulo nyaka kusabulawe obhejane abawu-86 kuphela, okungumehluko omkhulu nomuhle uma kuqhathaniswa nabawu-218 abase bebulewe ngalesi sikhathi nyakenye.Kuwo lo mbuthano, bekukhona noNksz Laura Fynn, obhekele ukucwaninga ngezinhlelo ezahlukene ze-Ezemvelo, ochaze ngohlelo oluqhubekayo i-Anti-Poaching Strategy, olwaziwa nangokuthi yi-tea and coffee."Lolu hlelo lubandakanya nokuvakashelwa kwabasolwa ngokwenza lo mkhuba abasuke bengaphandle ngebheyili emacaleni abo, ukubakhumbuza nokubacacisela ukuthi amacala abo awakaboli nokuthi bazi ukuthi kuzokwenziwa konke okusemandleni ukuthi babhekane nomthetho," usho kanje..UNksz Fynn udalule nokuthi kulolu hlelo lwabo, Ezemvelo sezivundulule amaqembu amane aziwayo ngokwenza lobu bugebengu, okuzosiza ukuthi kubhekwane nawo ngqo.
INHLANZI izoshelwa ngamanzi kubasebenzi abayizipoki eMnyangweni wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, njengoba bezobhekana namacala enkohlakalo.Kuzobabhedela nalabo basebenzi abenza umkhonyovu wokubhalisa laba basebenzi ohlelweni lokuthi bahole kuhulumeni njengoba bezolandwa nasemakhaya uma sebathatha umhlalaphansi.Lokhu kushiwo yinhloko yomnyango, uMnuz Nathi Ngcobo, njengoba lolu hlelo lokubheka abasebenzi abayizipoki liqalile kuleli sonto. UNgcobo uthe kabazosinisa mahleza kulabo abayizipoki kanjalo nakulabo okuyibona abababhalisa."Sizovula amacala enkohlakalo kulabo abayizipoki kanjalo nalabo abangena ohlelweni lokukhokha iPersal, babafaka ohlelweni lokuthi bakhokhelwe. Lolu hlelo lokukhokha lusebenzisa inombolo ethile umuntu angena ngayo, ukuze abhalise lowo msebenzi yingakho kuzoba lula ukubamba labo ababafaka ohlelweni lokuthi bakhokhelwe." Uthe uma sebedla endala bazobalanda emakhaya ukuze bazobhekana namacala abo."Sizobathungatha noma ikuphi lapho bekhona ngoba sifuna babhekane nezono zabo. Ukuthi umuntu akasebenzi emnyangweni, akusho lutho lokho ngoba sizomlanda," kusho uNgcobo. Uhlelo lokubheka abasebenzi abayizipoki lusingethwe ngumnyango kazwelonke kanti kusetshenziswa inkampani ezimele.Inhloso yokwenza lolu phenyo ukubheka ukuthi azikho izipoki zabasebenzi ezibhubhudla imali kahulumeni. Kunethemba lokuthi lolu hlelo luzokwehlisa nengcindezi yemali ebhekene nomnyango njengoba ingxenye enkulu yemali, iya emaholweni abasebenzi.Ekhuluma emhlanganweni wekomiti lezezimali esiShayamthetho, uNgcobo uthe seluyaphothulwa uhlelo lokubheka othisha abayizipoki. Uthe luzodlulela nakwabanye abasebenzi bomnyango bese luya nakubafundi."Sifuna ukuthola ukuthi sikhokhela abantu abakhona nokuthi bangaki abafundi abayizipoki. Sinabafundi abangenazo izitifiketi zokuzalwa kodwa abakuleli. Sinalabo abavela nakwamanye amazwe," kusho uNgcobo.Phambilini, othishanhloko babekhala ngokuthi babekwa amacala ngumnyango, besolwa ngokuthi bakhulisa isibalo sabafundi ukuze bathole uxhaso oluthe xaxa, uma befaka nalabo abangenazo izitifiketi zokuzalwa kanjalo nabafundi bangaphandle. Uma unesibalo esiphezulu sabafundi wandiselwa isibalo sothisha, nemali etholwa isikole ithi xaxa okubalwa nohlelo lokudla.Lolu hlelo lokubheka abasebenzi abayizipoki selwenabele nakweminye iminyango eyayalelwa ukuthi ilwenze nguMnyango weziSebenzi zikaHulumeni nokuPhatha, ukunqanda le nkinga kuleli.

BANQUNYELWE ugwayi katiki abesikhwama esibhekele iNdlunkulu kaZulu neSilo njengoba besolwe ngokuhluleka wukuzimela ngokwemali, batshelwa ukuba bashintshe ukwenza okanye sivalwe.Amalungu eKomiti lezeziMali esiShayamthetho azwakalise ukunengeka nokungagculiseki ngalolu hlaka ngenkathi lwethula umbiko wokusebenza kwalo muva nje. Abesikhwama batshele ikomiti ngomsebenzi asebewenzile ukuze iNdlunkulu kaZulu ikwazi ukuzimela base bethi kudingeka uxhaso luka-R10 million ukuze kufezwe lokho. Lesi sikhwama sisungulwe ngo-2018, kwathiwa ngaso kumele iNdlunkulu kaZulu ikwazi ukuzimela ngokwemali.Kodwa-ke kubukeka sengathi lolu hlaka lwahluleka wukusungula izinhlelo ezizongenisa inkece.Muva nje abesikhwama baqhamuke nombono wokuqala izakhiwo zokuhlalisa izitshudeni nokho okubonakale njengento ezothatha isikhathi ngaphambi kokungenisa imali ebonakalayo.Ngaphezu kwalokho kunkankanywe nohlelo lokukhiqizwa kwenyama yenkomo ukuzama ukugaya imali.Abesikhwama bagcizelele ukuthi uhlelo lwenyama yenkomo bayathemba ukuthi luzophumelela nakanjani.UMphathiswa wezeziMali, uMnuz Francois Rodgers, usanda kuhlangana neSilo uMisuzulu kaZwelithini ngaleli bhizinisi.Isikhulu esiphezulu seRoyal Household Trust, uMnuz Sipho Buthelezi, sithe: "Kunohlelo olufuze lolu lwenyama yenkomo oluqhubeka ngempumelelo e-Eastern Cape, sizovakashela khona ukuze sithole ithuba lokufunda. Ngingasho ukuthi lona wumsebenzi sonke esifuna ukuwubona uphumelela ngemuva kokuthi sizame okuningi okungazange kulunge.”UButhelezi ugcizelele ukuthi kulo nyakamali badinga ukwesekwa wuhulumeni ukuze bakwazi ukwenza okudingekayo."Besilokhu sithi kufanele kubuyekezwe isabelomali ukuze kubhekwe izinguquko, kwangenzeka lokho, yingakho njalo ngonyaka, sicela ukuthi kubuyekezwe isabelomali, kungenjalo sizophoqeleka ukuthi simise okunye ukwesekwa kweNdlunkulu neSilo esikunikezayo,” usho kanje.Isikhulu semali eHhovisi likaNdunankulu, uMnuz Sthembiso Ntombela, sithe isikhwama seNdlunkulu kaZulu sidonsa kanzima ngenxa yokwanda kwabahlomulayo kuso ngokunjalo nezindleko zezomthetho.Ilungu lekomiti, uNksz Celiwe Madlopha lishaye amakhala ngokusebenza kwesikhwama.UNksz Madlopha uthe ukube isikhwama besiwenza umsebenzi waso wokungenisa imali ngabe asikho isidingo sokufuna ukutakulwa ngo-R10 million."Angicabangi ukuthi ukungeniswa kwemali kuyenzeka, (uma kungenjalo) beningeke nize lapha nizocela enye imali. Ukufakwa kwemali yikhona kuphela okwasungulelwa lolu hlaka njengoba uhulumeni engakwazi ukungenisa imali."Ubuze ukuthi ngabe isikhwama siyoke sikwazi ukwenza umsebenzi esisungulelwe wona."Ngokwami uhlelo lokungenisa imali alusebenzi futhi kalusoze, ngakho asikho isidingo salolu hlaka. Ngibona kanjalo yize kuzwakala sengathi ngiqinisa amazwi,” kusho uNksz Madlopha."Lolo phiko lwaluseHhovisi likaNdunankulu phambilini, kwathiwa ukuze luvumeleke ukuqoqa imali, kumele lube yisikhwama, kodwa manje akunazithelo. "Angiboni nqubekela phambili, yonke into iqala bese iphelela endleleni. Kuqalwa izinhlelo bese kuba nenkinga, ziyekwe. Emahlandleni ohulumeni abehlukene angikaze ngibone lutho oluphathekayo. Ngabe singakwazi ukuma sithi kunekusasa eliqhakazile mayelana nokungenisa imali?” kubuza uNksz Madlopha.Elinye ilungu lekomiti, uMnuz Lourens De Klerk, lithe inhlosongqangi yesikhwama wukungenisa inkece, hhayi ukukhangeza."Sekunesikhathi sicela izinhlelo, silokhu sithola izimpendulo ezingacacile kokunye ezifikisela amahloni - akukho lutho olubonisa uhlelo noma isikhathi esimisiwe sokulindela impumelelo. Kuphela sithenjiswa ukuthi kukhona okuzokwenzeka. Konke lokhu kulahlisa ngethemba. Ukucela kwenu u-R10 million kuyizinkomba zokuthi niyehluleka,” kusho uDe Klerk.Kubuye uButhelezi wagcizelela ukuthi ikhona inhlansi yethemba ngoba bazokwesekwa nguMnyango wezoLimo.Uthe banethemba lokuthi bazoqala maduze nje ngohlelo lwezolimo kodwa waveza ukuthi isikhwama sishoda ngo-R16 million ukuze siqale lolu hlelo. "Ipulazi lidinga imali engu-R20 million, manje sinemali elinganiselwa ku-R3.6 million, siphezu kwezinhlelo zokuqoqa imali."
UYATHUTHUMELA uyise wentombazane (14) yaseNdwedwe Mission, othi idlwengulwe ngezinye endlini encane ngoLwesithathu olwedlule.Lo wesilisa eligodliwe igama lakhe ukuvikela umgilwa, uthe namanje akuvumi ukuthi akholwe yinto eyehlele indodakazi yakhe.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant Colonel Paul Magwaza, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi kunesigameko sokudlwengulwa kwentombazane okubikwe ngaso ophikweni lwaKwaDukuza lwamacala athinta ucansi.Ukuqinisekisile ukuthi kunamabhobhodleyana amabili aneminyaka engu-16 akhalelwe ngamasongo kaSigonyela ngoLwesine olwedlule, ngecala lokudlwengula."Kuvela ukuthi umgilwa ubekade eya kubo ngesikhathi kuqhamuka laba ababili bamdonsela endlini encane eseduze komgwaqo, maqede bamdlwengula futhi bekwenza belekelelana," usho kanjena.Uthe okumzwisa ubuhlungu kakhulu ukuthi lokhu kwenziwe ngabantu abangomakhelwane bakhe."Kungiphatha kabuhlungu kakhulu ukuthi ingane yami yentombazane ivelelwe yinto ebuhlungu kanjena kodwa kuyangiqedela ukwazi ukuthi lokhu kwenziwe ngabantu abangomakhelwane bengane yami," kusho yena.Udalule ukuthi kwale noma sebeshaywa ngabadala abenzi bobubi kodwa baqhubeka nokudlwengula, wathi kuze kwadingeka ukuba ingane iphuthunyiselwe usizo losonhlalakahle ngenxa yokuthi isimo sayo besibonakala sisibi kakhulu."Ngiyazibuza nje ukuthi ingane iyoke ilapheke nini emoyeni ngemuva kwalesi sigameko. Ngiyibonile selokhu ivelelwe yile nkinga, akusiyona le ngane ebengiyazi," echaza.Uthe ngeke aze akuthole ukuphumula bungakenzeki ubulungiswa ngengane yakhe."Ngizimisele ngokuthi ngilwe kuze kube sekugcineni. Angeke ngithule nje ngigoqe izandla kube konakala," kusho yena.Uthe okumnengayo ukuthi abazali babasolwa beseka izingane zabo, kabaliboni iphutha lomonakalo eziwenzile.
KUPHENYEKE ibheshu, izinqe zahlala obala kusomabhizinisi waseNorth West, ozibiza ngenhloli, uMnuz Brown Mogotsi, abeKhomishini kaMadlanga besina bededelana ngaye, bemkhombisa ukuthi ubufakazi bakhe bubathimulisa bengadle gudu.Lokhu kwenzeke izolo, njengoba ebesaqhubeka nokwethula ubufakazi bakhe kule khomishini ephenya ngezinsolo zokugxambukela kosopolitiki, inkohlakalo nobugebengu obenzeka emaphoyseni. Ngezikhathi zantambama, u-Advocate Matthew Chaskalson SC ubuze uMogotsi ukuthi kwenzeka kanjani ukuthi abe nolwazi ekupheleni kukaDisemba 2024, ukuthi iPolitical Killings Task Team (PKTT) yayizohlakazwa? Lo mbuzo ubewususela emyalezweni uMogotsi awuthumelela usomabhizinisi olandelwa yizinkulumo, uMnuz Vusumuzi "Cat" Matlala.UMogotsi uphendule ngokuthi wayeluhoshe ezinkundleni zokuxhumana lolu lwazi njengoba yase iqalile izungeza incwadi yokuhlakazwa kwaleli thimba, okuthiwa yabhalwa nguNgqongqoshe wezamaPhoyisa osamisiwe, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu. UChaskalson ube esembuza ukuthi yini eyadala ukuthi ikhophi yencwadi aze ayithumelele uMatlala ngakusasa, waphendula ngelithi wayesafuna ukuqale abe nesiqiniseko sokuthi ayiwona umbombayi.Kuvele ukuthi ngoJanuwari 2, uMogotsi waphinde watshela uMatlala ukuthi wonke amadokodo abephenywa yileli thimba azoyiswa ehhovisi lePhini likaKhomishana wamaPhoyisa kuzwelonke osamisiwe, uLieutenant General Shadrack Sibiya. Ngokobufakazi obuqinisekisiwe obuvele ngaphambi kwale khomishini, amadokodo aze aya ehhovisi likaSibiya ngoMashi 28, nonyaka. "Wena wase uluthathaphi ulwazi lokuthi amadokodo azoya ehhovisi likaSibiya ngoJanuwari 2, njengoba wase utshela uMatlala lokho?” kubuza uChaskalson.UMogotsi uphendule ngokuthi ngokwazi kwakhe kwakuwulwazi olujwayelekile ukuthi amadokodo ayezoya ehhovisi likaSibiya njengoba "wonke amadokodo obugebengu (eNingizimu Afrika) esingathwa yileli hhovisi".UChaskalson utshele uMogotsi kwezikabhoqo ukuthi lokho akulona iqiniso ngoba uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, ethula ubufakazi obungasho kanjalo phambilini. "UMkhwanazi simbuza ukuthi ukube lahlakazwa ngempela leli thimba, amadokodo ayezoyaphi, wasitshela ukuthi umthetho uthi kwakuzofanele abuyiselwe eziteshini zamaphoyisa lapho okwakuvulwe khona amacala kwasekuqaleni. Manje wena ulwazi lokuthi ayezoyiswa ehhovisi likaSibiya wase uluthathaphi ngoba kwagcina kuba yinto eyenzeka ngoMashi, kodwa wena wase unolwazi lwayo ngoJanuwari?” kubuza uChaskalson. Ubuye waqinisa umbuzo wakhe ngokuthi nomunye ufakazi waveza okufanayo nokukaMkhwanazi. UMogotsi uvele washaya ungqimphothwe esitatimendeni sakhe sangaphambilini, ethi wayecabanga kanjalo njengoba wake wezwa phambilini ukuthi likhona idokodo (likaLushaba) elake layiswa ehhovisi likaSibiya. "Ngaleso sizathu mina ngase ngicabanga ukuthi ihhovisi likaSibiya libhekelela wonke amadokodo,” kusho uMogotsi. Ngaphambi kwalokho, ziphinde zamubamba izintambo zolwembu uMogotsi ngesikhathi u-Adv Sesi Baloyi SC embuza ukuthi yini eyayenza acabange ukuthi uMchunu wayengathathela uLieutenant General (Dumisani) Khumalo izinyathelo ekubeni engungqongqoshe? UMogotsi uziphungele ngelithi ngaleso sikhathi wayengenalo lolo lwazi. Ubuye wambuza ukuthi wayeqonde ukuthi uma ethi: "njengamanje sesinento ephathekayo ngaye”, okuwumyalezo uMogotsi awuthumela uMatlala emva kokuvela kokuthi uKhumalo ubekwe amacala. Uphinde wambuza ukuthi kungani athumelela uMatlala umyalezo ngalokhu?Uthe yingoba wayazi ukuthi kwakungaba yizindaba ezazizokwehla kamnandi kuMatlala kwazise yayimhlukumezile iPKTT, njengoba "yashaya umkakhe kwesinye isiwombe igasele emzini wabo". U-Adv Sandile Khumalo uke wapheka uMogotsi ngemibuzo, embuza ukuthi wayeqonde ukuthini ngesikhathi ethumela uMatlala umyalezo othi: "Namuhla elamanqamu" ngoDisemba 31, 2024, nokwaba wusuku uMchunu aveza ngalo ukuthi iPKTT iyahlakazwa?"Lowo mcabango uphambukile. Ngesikhathi ngithi namuhla elamanqamu, ngangikhuluma ngamalungiselelo esasikhulume ngawo phambilini, ahlangane nemigubho kaJanuwari 8 ye-ANC. Lo myalezo wawungahlanganise lutho nodaba lokuhlakazwa kwePKTT," kuphendula uMogotsi. Uphinde wasola uMogotsi ngokugxambukela ekusebenzeni kwamaphoyisa ngekhathi ebonisa uMchunu ngokuthi phakathi kwakhe noSibiya, kukhona okufanele athathele uKhumalo izinyathelo. UMogotsi uthe njengesakhamuzi saseNingizimu Afrika unalo ilungelo nokubeka umbono ngezobugebengu kunoma wubani. Ngezikhathi zasekuseni, iJaji uMbuyiseli Madlanga, lisole uMogotsi ngokungakugqizi qakala ukubaluleka kokuhlonipha isifungo.UMadlanga utshele Mogotsi ukuthi esitatimendeni sakhe wathi usebenza ehhovisi likaMchunu kodwa kwathi esethula ubufakazi bakhe ubuso nobuso, wathi uyi-state agent. UMogotsi uthe enye ingxenye yalo msebenzi wakhe (state agent) iyamvumela ukuthi abuye aqambe amanga lapha nalaphaya. Usole okhomishana ngokumcindezela, bamphintshele ekhoneni waze wabatshela ukuthi phela naye akekho ngcwele. Uthe esuka wababuza ukuthi sisekhona yini isidingo sokuthi aqhubeke nokwethula ubufakazi phambi kwekhomishini njengoba beshintshana ngokumsola ngokuba umqambimanga osezingeni eliphezulu nangokuba wufakazi ofakaza ngezinto angakwazi ukuzeseka ngobufakazi obuphathekayo? Kungenelele uMadlanga, wamtshela ukuthi kusesekuseni ukuthi angazibona njengofakazi ongasafanele ukuqhubeka nokwethula ubufakazi phambi kwekhomishini njengoba nabo bengakafinyeleli esiphethweni sokuthi ikhomishini iyabamukela noma iyabuchitha ubufakazi bakhe. Ngesikhathi iguqa ikhomishini ntambama, aziswa ukuthi usazophinde abuye futhi, uvele wakhexa, waphimisa amazwi okuthi yena usekhathele.
BAPHUZISWE iqiniso libaba linjalo abesilisa abebehambele umcimbi wabo bodwa onhloso yawo wukubacebisa ngokumele bakwenze nokumele bakugweme ukuze babe ngamadoda aqotho i-Men's Conference ebiyenziwe yiGagasi FM eWiseman Carwash & Shisanyama, KwaMashu, enyakatho yeTheku ngoLwesithathu.Lo mcimbi, obukhuza ibuya ihlandla lesibili nonyaka bekubuthene abesilisa abangaphezu kwa-50, becetshiswa futhi bedodiswa ngezihloko ezahlukene ezithinta impilo yabo ngqo, ohlelweni obeluphethwe ngabasakazi beGagasi GM oDJ Sonic noKhulekani Mbambo.Esinye sezikhulumu zosuku, udokotela oweluleka ngezocansi uDkt Nkosinathi Shabalala, weluleke ngokuthi abesilisa kumele basukumele ubudoda babo, futhi bayeke ukushalazela ukunaka izimo zempilo yabo ezenza ukuthi behlelwe yisithunzi uma sebesekamelweni."Into enilimazayo wukuqinisela ngoba nesaba ukuthi uma nibonakala nikhathalela impilo yenu nizokwehlelwa yisithunzi, okuyinto eyenza ukuthi impilo yenu ingahambi kahle nje ngezinto eziningi. Ukuqala manje sitshale imali, siyibeke kungasisiza kakhulu ngomuso," kusho uKhambule.Omunye wabaphathi beGagasi FM u-Alex Mthiyane uthe izincomo zabantu ngalo mcimbi yizo ezenze ukuthi bawubuyisa kulo nyaka, abathemba ukuthi uzoqhubeka nokuthi ube wusizo emphakathini ngenxa yezimfundiso ezinhle ezitholakala kuwona minyaka yonke.

ABASHAYELI bezimoto kumele babeke isabelomali esengeziwe ukubhekela izindlela abazozithatha ngesikhathi samaholidi njengoba kuzokhuphuka uphethroli nodizili ngenyanga ezayo.Nakuba u-2025 bekuwunyaka omuhle ngokwentengo kaphethroli, kubukeka uzophea ngokuphoxa abathengi.Imininingwane yakamuva evela kwiCentral Energy Fund (CEF) ikhomba ukuthi uphethroli ungase wenyuke ngo-30c bese kuthi udizili ukhuphuke ube phakathi kuka-70c no-85c.NgokweCEP uphethroli oyi-Unleaded 95 ungase ukhuphuke ngo-23c kepha izibalo zikhomba ukuthi uhlobo lwe-93 lungase lukhuphuke ngo-47c ngasekupheleni kwenyanga.Uma i-95 Unleaded igcine ikhuphuka ngo-30c ezindaweni ezisogwini kusho ukuthi ilitha lingabiza u-R20.59 kuthi ezindaweni eziqhelelene nogu njengaseGauteng libize u-R21.42, bese kuthi i-93 Unleaded ibize u-21.27.Ngakolunye uhlangothi, uphethroli usazobiza kancane kunasekuqaleni kuka-2025, lapho u-95 ULP ububiza u-R20.80 ogwini.Izinkomba zithi udizili uzonyuka ufinyelele ku-19.28 ilitha. NgoJanuwari ilitha likadizili belibiza u-18.68 lase likhuphukela ku-R19.69 ngoFebhuwari.Ukwenyuka kwentengo kaphethroli okucatshangwayo ngoDisemba kudalwe wukunyuka kwezindleko zokwenza imikhiqizo emhlabeni jikelele. Yize kunalesi simo ukusimama kwerandi kuyalekelela ekutheni umthwalo ungasindi kakhulu kuleli.Amanani entengo kadizili abhekane nengcindezi ngasekupheleni konyaka njengoba isimo sezulu esibandayo esisenyakatho nenkabazwe sinyusa isidingo sokusetshenziswa kukawoyela ongahluziwe.
ITHIBELENE phakathi kwabaholi beSACP njengoba ubuholi baKwaZulu-Natal, obusanda kuhlakazwa buthi yibona obusemthethweni esifundazweni.Ubuholi obuhlakaziwe buchitha nabaqokwe okwesikhashana, okuthiwa bazokwengamela isifundazwe kuze kuqokwe abaholi abasha.UMnuz Themba Mthembu, obengunobhala ebuholini obuhlakaziwe, uthe ngokwabo yibona abasemthethweni esifundazweni, ababazi abanye abaqokiwe."Asisamukeli isinqumo sokuhlakazwa nokuqokwa kwethimba lesikhashana eliqokwe wubuholi bukazwelonke. Sifuna kubhungwe kabanzi ngalesi sinqumo, sicutshungulwe bese simenyezelwa ngokusemthethweni yiCentral Committee (CC)," kusho uMthembu. Uthe baba nomhlangano nethimba elalivela kwi-CC ngo-Agasti nonyaka, ngezikhalo zesifundazwe ezinye zazo ezisuka ku-2023."Kulowo mhlangano sahambisa uhlu lwezikhalo, kwavunyelwana ngokuthi sinike i-CC isikhathi sokuthi izibheke kabanzi. Besisalindele ukuthi lezo zikhalo zizothulwa ngokusemthethweni emhlanganweni we-CC, ozoba ngoNovemba 28 kuya kuNovemba 30, 2025."Uthe bathuka bezwa ngabezindaba ekuqaleni kwale nyanga, ukuthi bahlakaziwe."Izintatheli zazifuna siphawule emva kokutshelwa ukuthi ikomiti iPolitburo (PB) lisihlakazile. Safuna incazelo ebuholini bukazwelonke, obabiza umhlangano ngohlelo lwe-Zoom. Ngenxa yokuthi isikhathi sasingenele, akubanga namalungu anele ayezothamela umhlangano ukuze ube khona." Uthe babe sebethola incwadi evela kuNobhala jikelele, uMnuz Solly Mapaila, ebazisa ukuthi sebehlakaziwe. Wathi lisinqumo sithathwe yikomiti i-PB. "Sishaqekile sekumenyezelwa ukuthi sekuqokwe ithimba lesikhashana ekubeni umhlangano okwakumele ubekhona, wagcina ubhuntshile ngenxa yokuphazamiseka. Kodwa siyakwamukela ukuhoxa kwamalungu amaningi abemenyezelwe kuleli thimba."Lo mhlangano bekumele ube ngempelasonto edlule kodwa wagcina ungabanga khona kanti ngokobuholi obuphezulu kwakungowokuchazela amalungu ngesinqumo sokuhlakaza isifundazwe.UMthembu uthe:"Siyibona njengemizamo yokudala uqhekeko eyokuqokwa kwethimba lesikhashana kanjalo nemizamo yokuntengisa iKZN. Sifuna uMapaila azokhuluma namalungu akulesi sifundazwe ukuze awacacisele izinto eziningi." Uhlabe ikhwelo lokuthi akuqiniswe amadlelandawonye ikakhulu ngalesi sikhathi."Amalungu awabumbane ukulwa nezinhlelo zabafuna ukudala uqhekeko," kusho uMthembu.Kuhlukene ukukhuluma ngesinqumo sokuhlakaza iKZN, njengoba ubuholi obuphezulu buthe yingoba bufuna ukuqinisa isifundazwe. Ngakolunye uhlangothi kuthiwa isinqumo sithathwe ngoba iKZN ingahambisani nesinqumo sokuthi iSACP, ingenele ukhetho ngokuzimela ngaphandle kwe-ANC.Isinqumo sokungenela ukhetho kuthiwa sesidale ukwehlukana njengoba kunamalungu akwiKhabhinethi kaMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa.
UMENGAMELI Cyril Ramaphosa usexwayise ngokuthi ngeke akuvumele ukuthi amazwe ayizikhondlakhondla achukuluze asathuthuka.Uthe ngeke bakumele ukuchukuluzwa ngoba kuyalinganwa futhi ngeke bathule bebona lokhu kwenzeka."Siyalingana sonke, akumele kube nezwe elizibona lilikhulu kunamanye amazwe bese lizikhukhumeza. Noma uyisikhondlakhondla awukwazi ukubukela phansi amanye amazwe," kusho uRamaphosa evala umhlangano weG20 Social Summit eGoli, ngoLwesine. Uthe ngeke bavumele ukubukelwa phansi ngamanye amazwe.Noma engalibizanga ngegama izwe laseMelika, kodwa kucacele noma ngubani ukuthi ukhuluma ngaleli lizwe, elidube ukuza emhlanganweni weG20 okuleli, ozohanjelwa abaholi bamazwe kusasa nangeSonto. UMengameli waseMelika, uMnuz Donald Trump, uthe abezi kuleli ngenxa yokuthi kubulawa abalimi abamhlophe kuphinde kuthathwe umhlaba wabo ngejozi. Njalo uma uTrump evula umlomo ekhuluma ngelakuleli, ukhwela adilike athi kwenzeka izinto ezingalungile.Muva nje, usanda kunxenxa amazwe ukuthi angazamukeli iziphakamiso ezizophuma ngeSonto, kulo mhlangano ngenxa yezinto ezenzeka kuleli.URamaphosa obamukela iziphakamiso, uthe zibalulekile ukuze zethulwe phambi kwabaholi bomhlaba."Ukungalingani ngezinye zezinto okumele zibhungwe emhlanganweni weG20. Ziningi izinto ezinhle ezenzeka kuleli. Wonke amazwe anelungelo lokuthi kulalelwe umbono wawo ngoba kuyalinganwa."
UMASIPALA wesiFunda iLembe uhlose ukusabela kwikhwelo likaMengameli wezwe uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa ngokubhukula ube namasu okulwa nezinhlekelele.Lokhu kudalulwe yiMeya yesiFunda uMnuz Thobani Shandu obekhuluma engqungqutheleni yokubhunga kabanzi ngamasu okunqanda izinhlekelele ebikade iqhubeka eBandla Hotel, eBallito.UShandu uqale ngokuveza ukuthi ilinganiselwa kuR5 million isiyonke imali ezosetshenziselwa ukubhekana nezimo zezinhlekelele.Uveze ukuthi bonke omasipala abane abangaphansi kwesiFunda bake bazithola bekhahlamezeka yizinhlekelele eminyakeni eyedlule.Omasipala abangaphansi kwalesiFunda kufaka phakathi iMandeni, iKwaDukuza, iNdwedwe kanye noMaphumulo."Kuyishwa elikhulu ukuthi bonke labo masipala bake bazithola bebhekana nale nkinga. Iqiniso ukuthi izinhlekelele zivamise ukusilimaza kakhulu ," usho kanjena.Uthe KwaDukuza izinhlekelele zishiywe kukhalwa eminyakeni eyedlule kwaguguleka imigwaqo kwakhahlamezeka nezindlu.Uthe kwaba yinto efanayo futhi naKwaDukuza. Uthe kumele kusetshenziswane ukuze kubhekwane nje ngqo nalesi simo."Kumele sisukume sonke kube khona esikwenzayo ngenhloso yokunqanda lesi simo,"echaza.Uthe kulokoza inhlansi yethemba ngokuthi le mali ebekiwe izobonakala yenza umehluko omkhulu.Uthe ngalokhu abakwenzayo basabela kwikhwelo likaMengameli owanikeza omasipala umyalelo wokuba babhukule kube khona abakwenzayo uma kukhulunywa ngezimo zezinhlekelele."Kuyasiphoqa ukuthi sikwenze nakanjani lokhu esakuyalelwa uMengameli wethu," usho kanjena.Uveze nokuthi kunezinhlelo ezihlabahlosile abanazo zokufundisa umphakathi kabanzi ngokuthi ungazinqanda kanjani izinhlekelele.Abezinhlaka ezahlukene baveze ukuthi bazibophezele ekutheni basebenzisane nomasipala besifunda ukubhekana nezinhlekelele.Kube nesikhalazo sokuthi izinhlekelele ziholela ekutheni intuthuko igcine seyihamba ngolonwabu ngoba kusetshenziswa imali ebikade ibekelwe esinye isidingo ukuphesha umonakalo wezinhlekelele.IMeya yaKwaDukuza uMnuz Siduduzo Gumede uphumele obala ekhala ngomonakalo owashiywa yizinhlekelele kulo masipala.

Ngonyaka olandelayo, waqwaqwada emakhanda abasakazi beziteshi zomphakathi kumaSouth African Traditional Music Achievement Awards.Ikhono likaMdonso lagcina lihehe abaphathi boKhozi FM. Ngo-2018, waqala ukusakaza kuSigiya Ngengoma noZimiphi "Zimdollar" Biyela.
