UBENGUMSHAYELI wezimoto ezikhokhelwa ngebanga ezilihambile oyedwa okusolwa ukuthi ukwabane ababulewe ngesihluku eMatata, eMaphephetheni, eNanda, ngoMgqibelo, besolwa ngokweba imfuyo.Kulesi sigameko kuthiwa oyedwa ushiselwe emotweni eyiveni, iNissan NP200, kwathi abathathu bashiselwa emotweni ethwala abantu abayisikhombisa, iToyota Rumion. Ngesikhathi kusabalala indaba yesigameko, kwavela ukuthi abafi babanjwa nenyama okwakusolwa ukuthi ngeyezinkomo abazibulale, bazihlinza, bazihlahlela base behamba nenyama. Nokho ngoMsombuluko Isolezwe lixoxe nesihlobo sikaMnuz Wandile Zaca okuthiwa wayeshayela iRumion etholakele ishisiwe. Isihlobo esicele ukungadalulwa sithe asifuni ukuvela njengoba abazali bomshayeli we-uber besathukutheliswe yisithombe esidwebeke ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ukuthi uZaca ubeyisela lezinkomo. "UWandile ubezishayelela imoto eyi-uber, ubengelona isela lezinkomo,” kusho isihlobo. Sithe bese kunesikhathi uZaca eshayela imoto ekhokhelwa ngebanga elihambile.Sithe ngosuku olwandulela isigameko, bathola ukuthi wayethole isicelo sabantu abafuna ukuhanjiswa eNanda. "Okuvelayo wukuthi wasamukela isicelo, wabahambisa abantu eNanda nokuvela ukuthi kwaba yilona hambo lwakhe lokugcina lolo,” kusho isihlobo. Sithe umndeni uzwe ngesigameko usutshelwa ngumnikazi wemoto."Umnikazi wemoto washayelwa ucingo ngabe-tracker ngoMgqibelo entathakusa, bemazisa ukuthi kubukeka sengathi imoto inenkinga,” kusho isihlobo.Sithe umnikazi wemoto wakhetha ukulandela umkhondo we-tracker owawukhombisa ukuthi igcine ukuthatha uhambo lwaseNanda. "Kwathi uma efika lapho umkhondo uphelela khona, wazithela phezu kwemoto yakhe, ishisiwe inabantu phakathi,” kusho isihlobo.Sithe nakuba kwathi uma kulunguzwa phakathi kwavela ukuthi kwabathathu abashiselwa kule moto, sasingekho isidumbu esisesihlalweni somshayeli kodwa banalo uvalo lokuthi uZaca ukhona kwabashiswa. "Kuze kube yimanje asimtholi ocingweni. Yebo siyezwa kuthiwa kukhona abaphunyuka kodwa ukungatholakali kwakhe kwenza ziqine izinsolo zokuthi naye ukwabashisiwe,” kusho isihlobo. Sithe umndeni uzolinda imiphumela yolibofuzo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kwabashisiwe ukhona yini noZaca.Sehlulekile ukuchaza ukuthi uma uZaca engabandakanyeki ezinsolweni zokwebiwa kwemfuyo, yini eyadala ukuthi imoto abehamba ngayo yehlelwe wumshophi entathakusa ngoMgqibelo endaweni yesigameko ekubeni yena isicelo sokuya khona asithola ngoLwesihlanu. "Sesithembele ophenyweni lwamaphoyisa ukuthi lucacise kabanzi kulokho kodwa thina uWandile asimazi njengomuntu obebandakanyeka ezenzweni zobugebengu,” kusho isihlobo. Ngesikhathi Isolezwe likhuluma nomthombo ngeSonto, emva kwesigameko, wathi umphakathi bese ukhathele amasela abulala izinkomo, azihlinze bese ekhala amaphepha nenyama. Ulandisa ngesehlakalo wathi amalungu omphakathi abhadama abafi ababili neveni endaweni yesigameko.Waveza ukuthi babuzwa ukuthi yini le abamatasa ngayo endaweni ekubeni kusempondo zankomo, bahluleka wukuphendula. Kuthiwa athi uma ehlola iveni, athola ukuthi ligcwele inyama okubonakayo ukuthi yayiqeda kuhlahlelwa, angabe esabadedela. Kuvela ukuthi kwathi kusenjalo, kwaqhamuka iRumion eyayihamba abantu abane, maqede baqhumisa isibhamu. Yilapho okuthiwa amalungu omphakathi avele abashisa khona nezimoto. Kuthiwa munye owashiswa evenini kwathi abathathu bashiswa neRumion. Kwavela ukuthi ababili baphunyuka babaleka.
KUKHUZWA abazogcwaneka emhlanganweni omkhulu wamazwe omhlaba ayingxenye yeG20, kuleli, ngempelasonto, ukuthi bazoyikhotha imbenge yomile.Lesi sexwayiso sikhishwe yizinhlaka zokuphepha ezweni, njengoba kulungiselelwa umhlangano omkhulu ngoMgqibelo nangeSonto, wabaholi bamazwe akwiG20 abazotheleka eNasrec, eGoli.UKhomishana wamaPhoyisa, uGeneral Fannie Masemola, uxwayise abazozama ukuthatha amashansi ukuthi bazobhekana nengalo yomthetho."Amaphoyisa azobe engathi nsi kwabazozama ukuphazamisa nokumosha lo mhlangano. Ababhikishayo kumele balandele imithetho ebekiwe ezweni. Ningavumi ukucasuka nigcine senisebenzisa indlakadla kodwa niqinise umthetho. Noma umuntu kungathiwa unesikhundla esiphezulu ezweni kodwa uma engenazo izimfanelo ningamvumeli," kusho uMasemola. Ukusho lokhu izolo, ekhuluma namathimba ahlukene ezokuphepha ezweni ajutshwe ukuqapha isimo kulo mhlangano.USolwazi Firoz Cachalia, ibamba likaNgqongqoshe wezamaPhoyisa, uthe amehlo omhlaba azobe ethe njo kuleli ngakho kumele abaholi abazobe bekuleli, baphephe.Uthe noma zikhona izinselelo ezweni njengawonke wonke amazwe kodwa ziyalungiswa futhi lo mhlangano uzoba yimpumelelo."Yonke into isimi ngomumo ukwamukela abaholi bamazwe. Mkhulu umsebenzi owenziwe ukulungiselela lo mhlangano, njengoba zikhona izigcawu eziqhubekayo zokuhlangana kwezinhlaka ezehlukene ezisuka kwamanye amazwe," usho kanje. UNgqongqoshe wezoBulungiswa nokuThuthukiswa koMthethosisekelo, uNksz Mmamoloko Kubayi, uyalele izinhlaka zomthetho ukuthi ziyibambe iqine kuze kudlule lo mhlangano obhekwe umhlaba wonke."Siyazi ngeke nisidumaze, ibambeni ishisa. Akuvikelwe abavakashi kanjalo nabantu bakuleli," usho kanje.Kunezinhlangano ezihlele ukuthi zibhikishe zikhala ngezinto ezehlukene. Ezinye zazo zifuna ukuthi ukubulawa kwabesifazane kuthathwe njengesihlava kuleli. Kunombhikisho ozobe usezifundazweni ezehlukene lapho iWoman for Change, inxenxe abesifazane ukuthi bagodle amandla bangasebenzi kusasa. Ifuna ukuthi ngo-12 emini bebade, balale phansi imizuzu ewu-15, ngenhloso yokukhumbula abesifazane ababulawa kuleli. Kuhlukene imibono kubantu bakuleli njengoba kukhona abakhala ngokuthi intuthuko bayibona ngoba kuza imihlangano emikhulu kuleli. Abakhalayo bathi babone kulungiswa emadolobheni ahlukene ngenxa yokuthi kunalo mhlangano.Bathe bathemba ukuthi amaphoyisa azoqhubeka abonakale noma lo mhlangano usuphelile ukuze abantu baphephe.Okunye okuvelile ngukuthi uma kunesidingo sokuthi kuqiniswe kakhulu ezokuphepha, kuzolandwa namasosha ukuzofaka isandla.

"Yikulowo mhlangano lapho ungqongqoshe anginikeza khona imininingwane kaMnuz Mogotsi waseNorth West, futhi wathi ngimcele ukuba afike nabaholi bendawo ukuze bamtshele ukuthi ngesimo sakhona ngaphambi kokuba avakashele khona." "Mina angiwuthamelanga lowo mhlangano ngakho angikwazi ukuqinisekisa okwakudingidwa kuwo." Uthe wayeqala futhi egcina ukuhlangana noMogotsi ngo-Okthoba, nyakenye. UNkabinde uthe uMogotsi akakaze wavakashela emahhovisi kaMchunu selokhu kwaba nomhlangano nyakenye. UNkabinde ubesevela okwesibili ePhalamende njengoba ngesonto eledlule ehoxisiwe emuva kwezinsolo zokuqamba amanga efungile.Efakaza uNkabinde, uchaze usuku afonelwa ngalo nguMkhwanazi embuza ngoMogotsi. Uthe wayengekho ngesikhathi uMchunu ebhala incwadi yokuhlakaza ithimba elaliphenya ngamacala okubulawa kosopolitiki.
USOLWE ngokwenza izinsolo ezibucayi ngamagama abantu maqede angakwazi ukuzeseka ngobufakazi obuphathekayo uMnuz Brown Mogotsi, ngesikhathi evele kwiKhomishini kaMadlanga izolo. Lokhu kwenzeke ngesikhathi engena osukwini lwesibili uMogotsi - ozibiza ngosebenzela ezobunhloli - ethula ubufakazi bakhe phambi kwale khomishini ephenya ngezinsolo zokugxambukela kosopolitiki, inkohlakalo kanjalo nobugebengu obenzeka emaphoyiseni. Le khomishini isungulwe nguMengameli wezwe, uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa, emva kokuba uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, enza izinsolo ezibucayi ngosopolitiki kanjalo nezikhulu zamaphoyisa ezisebenzisana nezigebengu ngasekuqaleni kukaJulayi nonyaka. UMogotsi ubesaqhubeka nokwethula ubufakazi bakhe bezinye zezinto athe wazitshelwa ngusomathenda osematheni, uMnuz Vusumuzi "Cat" Matlala. Ubesanda kuqeda ukufakaza ngokuthi uMatlala wamtshela ukuthi walahlekelwa yinqwaba yemali ekhokhela osopolitiki abafana nowayengungqongqoshe wezamaPhoyisa kuzwelonke, uMnuz Bheki Cele kanjalo noKhomishana wamaPhoyisa kuzwelonke, uGeneral Fannie Masemola.Kungenelele u-Advocate Sesi Baloyi SC, wambuza ukuthi uyabona yini kodwa ukuthi ulokhu eqhubeke njalo nokutshela ikhomishini ukuthi wayenoMatlala, wamtshela ukuthi nokuthi kodwa akukho akuletha ngaphambili ukweseka lokho. "Siwumzimba onhloso yawo ukuthola amaqiniso. Uyisiza kanjani ikhomishini ukuthi iqinisekisa lobu bufakazi obushoyo?” kubuza u-Adv Baloyi SC. Wenze isibonelo ngakushoyo, phambilini bakhonjisiwe imiyalezo ebiphakathi kwakhe uMogotsi noMotlala. Uthe uMogotsi njengoba elokhu enza izinsolo akakaze aziphelezele ngobufakazi obuphathekayo njengalobu ababukhonjisiwe bemiyalezo. "Utshele ikhomishini ukuthi uCele noMasemola banikwa nguMatlala isamba semali ngamunye kodwa akukho okuvezayo ukusekela lokho,” kusho u-Adv Baloyi SC. UMogotsi uphendule ngelithi akanaso isizathu sokuqambela ikhomishini amanga."Engikushoyo ilokhu engikwaziyo, lokhu angitshela khona,” kusho uMogotsi. Uqhube wathi kunomshini obizwa ngeCellebrite, osetshenziswa yizinkampani ezizimele ukubeka nganxanye imiyalezo esuke ifunwa umuntu."Ingaleyo ndlela okwatholakala ngayo izingxoxo ezifana nezami, Cat Matlala, Senzo Mchunu nabanye,” kusho uMogotsi. Uqhube wathi ufakazi, umeli washo ukuthi iselula kaMatlala yathintwa, kwasuswa eminye imiyalezo ngokungemthetho. Uzwakalise ukungagculiseki ngokuthi kuze kube yimanje abukaze buvezwe ubufakazi obuphathekayo ngokuthi uMchunu usebenzisana nongqondongqondo bobugebengu bokuhweba ngezidakamizwa. Ubuye waveza nokuthi nguMatlala owayenguJohn Wick waseMamelodi. UWick waba wundabuzekwayo ngo-2021, ngesikhathi kuthiwa ungumuntu ongaziwa owayeqotha amalungu eqembu lemigulukudu elalibizwa ngeBoko Haram eMamelodi. Ethula ubufakazi bakhe izolo, uMogotsi uthe uphenyo lweCrime Intelligence lwavundulula isithombe somuntu owayengemuva kwaleli gama kanjalo nenombolo yakhe kamazisi."Lesi sithombe kwakungesikaMatlala. Yingakho ngithi uma uCele ethi waqala ukuhlangana noMatlala okokuqala ngqa nyakenye, kufanele ukuba umqondo wakhe wabuya, wakhumbula ukuthi lobu buso obalo muntu okwatholwa ukuthi uJohn Wick,” kusho uMogotsi. Uphinde watshela ikhomishini ukuthi waqala ukwazana noNgqongqoshe wezamaPhoyisa osamisiwe, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu ngo-2017, ezintweni ze-ANC. Uthe ngesikhathi uMchunu emphika elala ngomhlane, ebuzwa ngaye okokuqala, yingoba wayekhonjiswe isithombe somuntu angamazi, kwathiwa uyamazi yini lo muntu, wase ephendula ngokuthi: "Angimazi lowo muntu”."Kwathi uma sengichazwa kahle, wase eveza ukuthi uyangazi njenge-comrade kwi-ANC,” kusho uMogotsi.Ephendula ngokwazana noyisikhulu sezisebenzi ehhovisi likaMchunu, uMnuz Cedric Nkabinde, uthe ubekhuluma naye kuphela uma ethe uthinta uMchunu wangamthola. Nokho lolu lwazi luyashayisana nokushiwo uNkabinde ekomitini lasePhalamende njengoba yena eveze ukuthi bebexhumana behlela imihlangano ethile. Uthe kuyammangaza nokuthi uMatlala aqhamuke esevezwa njengomuntu oyisigebengu esiyingozi ekubeni esenesikhathi eside ehlomula ngamathenda emaphoyiseni."Ohlelweni lokutholwa kwamathenda emaphoyiseni abantu bayabhekisiswa. Umbuzo uthi kwaphasa kanjani kulolo hlelo uma sekuthiwa mubi kangaka?” kubuza uMogotsi.Utshele ikhomishini ukuthi angase adinge usizo lokugadwa uma eqeda ukwethula ubufakazi bakhe.

I-ANC ichithe ukuthi kunamalungu aphakamise ukuthi uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, ehle esikhundleni emhlanganweni wesigungu esiphezulu, obungempelasonto.Lokhu kushiwo nguNobhala jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, othe ngamampunge ukuthi kunabaphakamise lokhu.Uthe uRamaphosa uveze ukuthi uzwile ukuthi kukhona abathi akahoxe abakhuluma emakhoneni."Kunabantu namanje abangamfuni uRamaphosa ngoba bahlulwa ezingqungqutheleni ze-ANC. Ihlandla lobuholi liphela ngo-2027." Uthe abasho lokhu bacabanga ukuthi le ndaba izoxoxwa emhlanganweni iNational General Council (NGC), wale nhlangano, ongenyanga ezayo eGoli. UBHEKENE nengwadla uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, ngokungazi noma zizohanjiswa yini izinsiza kufundisa ezikoleni, ngenxa yokuthi abazihambisayo bangase bangavumi ukuzihambisa ngaphandle kokukhokhelwa.Lo mqansa udalwa wukuthi akukho mali esakhishiwe ukukhokhela lezi zinsiza. Inkampani enikwe umsebenzi wokuzithenga bese izihambisa ezikoleni iNdabase, inikwe igunya lokuthi iqhubeke izithenge kodwa imali yokwenza lokhu ayifakiwe.Enye inkinga ebhekene nomnyango wukuthi awazi ukuthi uzoyithola nini imvume yokuthi usungakwazi uku-oda izincwadi ngenxa yokuthi kudingeka uthole imvume eMnyangweni kaMgcinimafa esifundazweni. Inhloko yomnyango uMnuz Nathi Ngcobo, iveze ukuthi babhekene nengwadla ngoba abazi noma lezi zinsiza ziyogcina zifinyelele yini ezikoleni.UNgcobo uthe basathole imvume yokuthi bathenge i-stationery sangonyaka ozayo kodwa hhayi izincwadi zokufunda."Le nkinga izokwenza ukuthi kuvulwe ezikoleni ngaphandle kwezincwadi. Sinemvume yokuthi sithenge i-stationery kuphela, kwasona esizofika emva kwesikhathi ezikoleni. Ingwadla enkulu ngukuthi noma siyitholile imvume yokwenza lokhu, sibhekene nengqinamba yokuthi labo abaziyisa ezikoleni bangase bangavumi ukuzihambisa bengeke basheshe bakhokhelwe. Udaba esilokhu sihlangana nalo noMgcinimafa ngoba ngisho noma zingathengwa, inkinga enkulu wukufinyelela kwazo ezikoleni," usho kanje izolo ekhuluma emhlanganweni wekomiti lezeziMali esiShayamthetho. Amalungu ekomiti akhale kakhulu ngokuthi abafundi bazovula ngaphandle kwezinsiza zokufunda okuyinto ewumgogodla. Ilungu le-DA uNksz Marlaine Nair, lithe yinkinga enkulu le ebhekene nomnyango."Kuyadingeka ukuthi kubekhona umhlangano wale minyango yomibili ngoba yinhlekelele le." NoSihlalo wekomiti uMnuz Mthandeni Dlungwana, ukhale ngokuthi uMnyango kaMgcinimafa awukho ukuzochaza kabanzi ngokuzokwenzeka ngoba kushaywa indesheni kuwona ukuze ugunyaze umnyango wezemfundo ukuthi ukwazi ukuthenga izinsiza. UDEDELWE ngebheyili ka-R1 000 umsolwa wesine ecaleni lokubulawa kwephoyisa laseCato Manor, eThekwini, ngeledlule.Lokhu kwenzeke eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini ngoLwesibili ngesikhathi abasolwa bevela enkantolo ngenhloso yokuzwa ukuthi bangeyithole yini ibheyili. Abasolwa uMnuz Thalenta Griffiths Cele (42), Mnuz Philani Maphila Mhlongo (29), umfundi ka-matric uMinenhle Amahle Cele (20) noNksz Nadia Shezi (25) basolwa ngokubulala uSergeant Mondli Gabisa (39). UGabisa obesesebenze iminyaka esiteshini samaphoyisa eCato Manor, wagwazwa emaflethini akule ndawo ngoNovemba 8. Isidumbu sakhe satholwa amaphoyisa sidindilizile ngaphandle kwamaflethi. Kuleli cala umsolwa wokuqala, owesibili nowesithathu basolwa ngecala lokubulala umufi bese kuthi owesine asolwe ngelokushaya unkosikazi kamufi owayehamba naye ngosuku lwesigameko. UMshushisi uMnuz Calvin Govender, utshele inkantolo ukuthi uMbuso uzosiphikisa isicelo sebheyili somsolwa wokuqala, owesibili nowesithathu ngoba babhekene necala elibi, okungelokubulala. Maqondana nomsolwa wesine uthe, uMbuso awunazinhlelo zokuphikisa isicelo sebheyili ngoba icala lakhe elokushaya, alilibi kangako. Elandisa ngesigameko uthe ngosuku lwesigameko, umsolwa wesine washaya ngempama unkosikazi kamufi kodwa naye washawa. UMantshi uMnuz Defrietas ibuzisise ukuthi ubani owashaya umsolwa wesine, uGovender waphendula ngokuthi owashaya umsolwa wesine umufi. Wenabe wathi ingxabano yaqala phakathi kukankosikazi kamufi nowesifazane, yagcina isingenwa umufi eshaya, wagcina esegwazwa, ebulawa. "Kubalulekile ukusho ukuthi utshwala babandakanyeka esigamekweni,” kusho uGovender. UDefrietas ededela umsolwa wesine ngebheyili ka-R1 000, ugcizelele eyokuthi akavumelekile ukuxhumana nommangali (unkosikazi kamufi). "Awuvumelekile ukukhuluma naye ubuso nobuso, ukumfonela, ukumthinta ngoFacebook noma ngoWhatsapp, awuvumelekile nhlobo ukuthi uxhumane naye,” kusho uDefrietas.Ube eselihlehlisela uNovemba 28 nonyaka icala ukuze umsolwa wokuqala, owesibili nowesithathu bafake isicelo sabo sebheyili. Uthe nomsolwa wesine kuzofanele eze enkantolo ngalolu suku. Umufi kulindeleke ukuthi afihlwe emva kwenkonzo yomngcwabo lapho edabuka khona eSeaview e-Eastern Cape ngoMgqibelo.

Ngisho nesitatimende sabezindaba asifunda ngosuku lwesithangami, sabhalwa ekolishi,” kusho uMogotsi, othe unolwazi olungamaphesenti angu-80 ngalokhu, wathi ngisho nekhompyutha okwabhalwa ngayo lesi sitatimende useyayazi.Efakaza ngoCele, uthe kwakungunyaka ka-2024 ngesikhathi ethola ulwazi lokuthi uyathinteka emabhizinisini kaMatlala. USULINDE imiphumela yolibofuzo umndeni wowesifazane waseMkhobose, eMpangeni, owagcina ukubonwa ephila eyohlangana nomngani weminyaka enxanxatheleni yezitolo eSikhaleni, ngasekupheleni kuka-Okthoba.Isidumbu sikaNkk Lungile "MaMkhize" Mkhwanazi (43) sitholwe sintanta ngesaka ebesigxishwe kulo emfuleni uMlalazi, ngaseMthunzini, ngoLwesihlanu. Ngokusho kukamfowabo kamufi, uMnuz Nkosikhona Mkhize, isidumbu sitholwe ngabesilisa abebeyodoba, babikela umphakathi namaphoyisa. "Izihlobo ezihambile zayosibheka isidumbu namuhla (esho izolo), zibuye zithi uye. Kukhona izitho zomzimba ezibone ngazo ukuthi uyena,” kusho uMkhize.Nokho uthe ngoba isidumbu bese sonakele kakhulu, amaphoyisa athe kufanele kwenziwe ulibofuzo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi banikwa isidumbu okungesihlobo sabo ngempela. Uthe namanje basabukhalela ubulungiswa ngecala njengoba benomuzwa wokuthi amaphoyisa aseSikhaleni enzelela umsolwa owaziwayo. "Ngesikhathi uLungi ephuma ekhaya ngasekupheleni kuka-Okthoba, washo ukuthi usayohlangana nomngani enxanxatheleni yezitolo amgagula ngegama. Kwathi uma engasabuyi, sekuyobikwa umuntu odukile emaphoyiseni, kwayobhekwa amakhamera enxanxathela, amveza uLungi engena emotweni yalona wesifazane,” kusho uMkhize.Uthe lona wesifazane uke washaqwa ngamaphoyisa kodwa abuye amdedela engazange avele ngisho nasenkantolo, wathi kuvela ukuthi wabuzwa ukuthi uphi uNkk Mkhwanazi kodwa lona wesifazane waphika walala ngomhlane ukuthi bake bahlangana. "Uphika nje, amakhamera ayakhombisa ukuthi lokhu akushoyo kungamanga. Yikho sithi thina wuye owazi konke ngokuthi kwenzekeni kuLungi,” usho kanje. Uveze ukuthi bewumndeni bayakhala ngokusebenza kwamaphoyisa ngoba bakholelwa ekuthi kunobufakazi obuqinile bokuthi umngani uyazi ngokubulawa kukamufi, wathi bezwe ngandlebenye ukuthi lona wesifazane uthandana nephoyisa elingaphakathi kulesi siteshi okwenza bakholelwe ekutheni yikho enzelelwa. Uthe abukho ubutha ebebebazi phakathi kukamufi nomsolwa njengoba bebengamathe nolimi kusukela befunda isikole."Nokho sisola ukuthi umbulalele isamba semali ebesingene ebhange likaLungi njengoba ephunyelwe yimali yomyeni oboshiwe obeyiphoyisa,” kusho uMkhize.Uthe iphoyisa eliwumyeni kamufi, lesula emsebenzini ngaphambi kokuba likhalelwe amasongo kaSigonyela. "Leyo mali ikhishwe kuso lesi sikhathi uLungi enyamalele. Sisola yena umngani wakhe ukuthi wuye obekhipha le mali. Kungenzeka ukuthi wayemxoxele ukuthi ulinde imali yomyeni wakhe, wase ebona ukuthi akamenzakalise,” kusho uMkhize.Udalule ukuthi umsolwa unobugebengu njengoba nomyeni wakhe wabulawa ngendlela engaqondakali maqede kwasolwa yena. Uthe bayabufuna ubulungiswa ngokubulawa kukadadewabo ngesihluku.

ZIZOTHATHA umbhikisho wazo wamaholo amancane ziwuyise ngaphandle kwesikhungo okuzobanjelwa kuso ingqungquthela yamazwe ngamazwe, iG20, eGoli, izimantshi ezikhala ngokuhola amakinati.Lokhu kuvezwe ngeyaseNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini, uMnuz Scelo Zuma, kulandela omunye umbhikisho owenziwe yizimantshi kule nkantolo izolo ekuseni. UZuma omele umengameli wenhlangano ebhekelela izidingo zezimantshi, iJudicial Officers Association of South Africa (Joasa), uthe bathatha leli gxathu emva kokubona ukuthi kawuzweli umkhizo ejazini kulabo okufanele baphendule ezikhalweni zabo. "Emva kombhikisho wethu wokuqala kanjalo nalowo esawenza eNkantolo yezoMthethosisekelo, sibonile ukuthi lokhu esikhala ngakho abakwenzi, yikho sesithi asithathe umbhikisho wethu siwuyise lapho okuzobe kubanjwe khona iG20,” kusho uZuma.Uthe njengoba babebeke umnqamulajuqu wezinsuku ezithize ukuthi baphendulwe ngazo, bathola impendulo yokuthi izikhalo zabo zizolungiswa ungakapheli uFebhuwari, wonyaka ozayo, wathi kabafuni nakuyizwa leyo, bona bafuna izikhalo zabo zisukunyelwe njengamanje. "Asazi ukuthi okwani ukubambezela abakushoyo ngoba thina sifuna izikhalo zethu zilungiswe kuwo lo nyaka esikuwo,” usho kanje. Izolo, kuphazamisekile ukusebenza kwezinkantolo okwejwayelekile njengoba izimantshi zibeke phansi amathuluzi zabhikisha ngesikhathi sokusebenza."Izimantshi ebeziqhubeka nokusebenza ilezo ezingamatoho. Lezo eziqashwe ngokugcwele beziwabeke phansi amathuluzi,” kusho uZuma, othe izolo bebejoyinwe ezinye izifundazwe okufaka phakathi iMpumalanga, Limpopo neGauteng. Uthe nakwezinye izinkantolo - okufaka phakathi ezase-Eastern Cape nezaseWestern Cape - bezineyazo imibhikisho ezindaweni zazo. Udalule ukuthi lokhu kudideka ababenakho ngaphambi kokuqala kwemibhikisho kokuthi bangena ngaphansi kwaluphi uhlaka, namanje kusekhona.Uthe lokhu kuze emva kokuthola imbibizane koyinhloko yamajaji ngesikhathi beyobhikisha eNkantolo yezoMthethosisekelo. Uthe noNgqongqoshe wezoBulungiswa, ohlangane nabo, ukubeke kwacaca ukuthi abekho ngaphansi komnyango wakhe."Lokho kusho ukuthi namanje asizazi thina siyizimantshi ukuthi singena ngaphansi kukabani,” kubeka uZuma. Ngesikhathi Isolezwe liqala ukubhala ngalolu daba, uZuma waveza ukuthi iphelile iminyaka ewu-17 belwela ukwenyuka kwemiholo yezimantshi, wathi uma ekhumbula kahle, zagcina ukunyuselwa imiholo ngo-2007. Waveza izimo ezishaqisayo ezifana nokuthi ezinye zezimantshi eNingizimu Afrika zibanga nomphakathi amatekisi nezibhedlela zikahulumeni ngenxa yokungakwazi ukwenza zonke izidingo zazo ngomholo omncane eziwuholayo. Waveza ukuthi isimo sibi ngendlela yokuthi abanye babo uma behlelwa isimo sokugula balala ezibhedlela zikahulumeni. Abanye baya emsebenzini ngamatekisi, wathi lesi yisimo esibeka impilo yabo engcupheni njengoba umsebenzi abawenzayo uyingozi. Wakhala ngokuthi bathatha izinqumo ezingehli kahle kwabanye abantu, waveza nokuthi ukulala ezibhedlela zikahulumeni nokugibela amatekisi, kubeka impilo engcupheni.Wadalula ukuthi abafuna kwenziwe ukuthi kwenyuswe imiholo yabo njengoba unyaka nonyaka kuhlale kuphuma izincomo zokuthi kwenzeke lokho, wathi bafuna nokuthi bathole nemihlomulo efana ne-medical aid, isibonelelo sendlu, esemoto kanjalo nekhadi likaphethroli, okuyinto athi bayizwa ngendaba.
LIZOGAYA ngomunye umhlathi kwabafuna ukuba amakhansela kwi-ANC njengoba bebekelwe imigomo eqinile, ebandakanya ukuba no-matric nesipiliyoni. Abafuna ukuba yizimeya, osomlomo kanjalo nosotswebhu komasipala, kudingeka babe neziqu zasezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme, kuphinde kubhekelwe intsha. Abazokhankasa ngemali batshelwe ukuthi bazoxoshwa enhlanganweni. Le migomo nesexwayiso imenyezelwe nguSihlalo wekomiti lezokhetho kwi-ANC, uMnuz Kgalema Motlanthe, esithangamini nabezindaba ngoMsombuluko eGoli. "Uma uzoba yikhansela sidinga u-matric nesipiliyoni ukuze uwenze ngendlela efanele umsebenzi. Asibafuni abake balahlwa amacala okubalwa nathinta ipolitiki. Nalabo abake balahlwa amacala yikomiti eliqondisa ubugwegwe ngeke bavunyelwe ukuthi bakhethelwe ekubeni amakhansela," usho kanje.Uthe abesifazane kumele babe ngu-50% kuya phezulu. Uveze nokuthi kumele bazi nomlando kaKhongolose, babe nolwazi ngezithinta uhulumeni nokuthuthukiswa komnotho."Amagatsha e-ANC kumele abambe iqhaza uma sekuphakanyiswa abantu abane abazoba amakhansela. Uhlelo lokuphakamisa abazoba amakhansela kumele luqale ngoFebhuwari, ngonyaka ozayo," kusho uMotlanthe.Uthe abaphakanyiswe amagatsha kumele bethule abaphakanyisiwe emhlanganweni womphakathi, bese igatsha likhetha ozoba yikhansela lewadi."Abafuna ukuba yizimeya nezinye izikhundla komasipala kumele babe nesipiliyoni seminyaka emithathu sokuba amalungu eziShayamthetho, amalungu ePhalamende noma amakhansela. Izimeya zomasipala abakhulu abaziwa ngamaMetro kanjalo nabanye omasipala abasemadolobheni amakhulu, zizoqokwa abaholi abaphezulu be-ANC emva kokubheka emagameni abantu abathathu okuzohlungwa kubona. Indaba yobulili izobhekwa." Uveze nokuthi ezimeyeni zomasipala abancane, ubuholi bezifunda buzophakamisa amagama abantu abathathu, buwayise ebuholini besifundazwe."Oke waba yimeya amahlandla amabili ngeke avunyelwe ukungenela umbango. Emagameni aphakanyisiwe, amabili awo kumele kube awabantu besifazane. Ngaphambi kokuba abaholi besifundazwe nabazwelonke banqume ngabazobathatha, kumele babe sebephonswe imibuzo yikomiti elihlanganisa amalungu esigungu esiphezulu esifundazweni nakuzwelonke." Intsha ayisalanga ngaphandle njengoba u-30% kumele kube abaphakathi kweminyaka engu-25 no-35. Abaneminyaka engu-36 kuya ku-40, kumele babe ngu-10%. UMotlanthe uthe abantu abaphila nokukhubazeka nabathandana nobulili obufana nobabo kumele bangashiywa ngaphandle kulolu hlelo.Uveze nokuthi abakhankasayo bangasebenzisa izinkundla ezehlukene zokwenza lokhu okubalwa nezinkundla zokuxhumana kodwa bangangcofi ozakwabo abasembangweni nabo ngoba bazochithwa. "Akuvumelekile ukuthi kugaywe izikibha noma kube nezingqwembe ezinobuso bokhankasayo.
UMPHATHISWA wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, uyalichitha kwesobukhosi iso leSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini, uMnuz Qiniso Ncube.UButhelezi uthe uNcube akasiyona inkosi, wathi iMbube ayikaze imnikeze uNcube ubukhosi.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma embizweni ebibizelwe ukuzokhuza umsindo odalwe ukuqokwa kukaNcube njengeso leSilo endaweni ezingaphansi kobukhosi baKwaMpukunyoni, kwaMkhwanazi, eMtubatuba.UNcube uqokwe iMbube ukuba abe iso layo ezindaweni okubalwa kuso nedolobha eliqanjwe ngenkosi yakwaMkhwanazi endala, uMtubatuba.Kusukela uNcube eqokiwe yiMbube ubesezibiza ngenkosi. UButhelezi uthe uNcube akakaze abe yinkosi."Kukhona nje abafike lapha kimi ekuseni bathi bathunywe yinkosi uNcube. Ayikho into enjalo. Asikaze iSilo sibeke uNcube njengenkosi. Bengikhona mina eMashobeni, asikaze iSilo sibeke uNcube njengenkosi. Ngakho-ke uma kukhona umuntu ozibiza ngenkosi azi ukuthi akekho emthethweni. ISilo asikaze simemezele enye inkosi phezu kwenye inkosi. Ngiyafisa ukuthi kuphele ukudideka."UButhelezi uthe uNcube kuzomele apheze ukuhamba ebiza imihlangano."Uma uqokwe yiSilo, uyalinda. Awuvele uxhomondele, uhambe uzibiza ngenkosi, uhambe ukhulekelwa njengenkosi. Ozohamba ezibiza ngenkosi akabhasobhe, ngoba icala lelo. Esifundeni iMajuba kukhona owaboshwa. Awukwazi ukuvuka ekuseni usuyinkosi ekubeni umkhulu wakho engakaze abe yinkosi."UButhelezi uthe izigodi ezibangwayo, iDukuduku, Zwenelisha neKhulanomathiya zingaphansi kobukhosi bakwaMkhwanazi.UButhelezi uthe izigcinalwazi zomnyango zikhombisa ukuthi lezi zigodi zontathu zingaphansi kobukhosi bakwaMkhwanazi."Ovukelwa isilungulela sokuthi ufuna ukuphatha abantu kuzofanele aqale abheke ngoba isizwe nesizwe silawulwa yimingcele. Leli zwe esimi kulo elabaKhwanazi."UButhelezi unxuse ukuba kube nokuthula, wanxusa abaKhwanazi ukuba bapheze ukuthuka iSilo."Lo msindo obukhona umsindo obekungafanalele ube khona. Kuvuke nje umuntu wazibiza ngenkosi kungafanele. Ayi inkinga ekhona. Akumele sixakwe yinto okungamele isixake."UKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, unxuse ukuba lolu daba luxazululwe ngokuthula.UMkhwanazi ukhuze labo abasabisa ngokuvala umgwaqo onguthelawayeka u-N2."Ningayikhulumi ngemikhonto, xoxisanani indaba yenu lena. Uma ungajabule ngokubhalwe phansi zikhona izindlelo zokulwa nalokho. Zikhona izinkantolo. Ningabhalela ongqongqoshe nibatshele ukuthi awushintshwe umthetho. Uma ningajabule ngendlela obhalwe ngayo umthetho hambani niyovota, nifake abantu abazowushintsha umthetho."UMkhwanazi uthe ithimba lamaphoyisa eliphenya amacala okubulala aphenya amacala amahlanu okubulala abantu basebukhosini bakwaMkhwanazi.Phakathi kwalaba bantu ababulawa, kukhona loyo owayeyikhansela le-IFP, uMnuz Innocent "Killer" Mkhwanazi nenduna eyayisondelene naye.
KUYENYUKELA koyiphini lomholi weMK elimisiwe, uDkt John Hlophe, osekuqokwe ithimba labameli ukuba limphenye kwaphinde kwaqokwa nomuntu ozobamba isikhundla sakhe ePhalamende. I-MK imemezele ukuqokwa kwethimba labameli elizophenya uHlophe, yaphinde yamemezela ukuqokwa komuntu ozobamba isikhundla sokuba umholi weqembu ePhalamende. Lezi zinqumo zimenyezelwe emva komhlangano womholi weMK, uMnuz Jacob Zuma namalungu eqembu ePhalamende. UHlophe wamiswa kwesokuba yiphini lomholi weMK nakwesokuba umholi weqembu ePhalamende emasontweni amabili edlule. UHlophe wamiselwa ukudiliza uSotswebhu oMkhulu weqembu ePhalamende, uNkk Colleen Makhubele. Kuthiwa uHlophe akazange abonisane nabaholi be-MK ngaphambi kokuthi axoshe uNkk Makhubele. Ngesikhathi kwenzeka konke lokhu, uZuma ubengekho kuleli njengoba ayesohambweni lwaseBurkina Faso.Uthe uma ebuya uZuma, kwabe sekumiswa uHlophe kwabuyiselwa uNkk Makhubele esikhundleni. Okhulumela iMK, uMnuz Nhlamulo Ndhlela, uthe uZuma ukugcizelelile ukuthi abaholi abajutshwe ePhalamende abakwazi ukuzithathela izinqumo. "Ngesikhathi ebuya eBurkina Faso, uZuma watshelwa ngezinguquko ezenziwe ePhalamende. Lezi zinguquko zenziwa ngaphandle kokuba kwaziswe yena noma abanye abaholi beqembu. Lokhu kuphambene nemigomo yeqembu. "UNdhlela uthe uZuma ukugcizelelile ukuthi uHlophe umisiwe eqenjini. "UHlophe uzomiswa kuze kuba kuphothulwa uphenyo olusemthethweni. Kuqokwe ithimba labameli elizokwenza uphenyo ngokushesha."UNdhlela uthe uHlophe useyilo ilungu leMK nelePhalamende. Selokhu kumenyezelwe ukumiswa kwakhe uHlophe akakaze abonakale ePhalamende. UNdhlela uthe uMnuz Des Van Rooyen, uyena ozobamba isikhundla sokuba umholi weqembu ePhalamende. UVan Rooyen wayeqokwe uHlophe ukuba abe ngusotswebhu ngesikhathi ediliza uNkk Makhubele. Ukubuyiselwa kukaNkk Makhubele esikhundleni, kusho ukudilizwa kukaVan Rooyen obekusaphele usuku eqokiwe."Ukuqokwa kukaVan Rooyen ukuba abambe isikhundla kuzokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi uyaqhubeka umsebenzi weqembu ePhalamende. UNkk Makhubele naye uzoqhubeka esikhundleni sikasotswebhu. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi ungaphazamiseki umsebenzi weqembu."UNdhlela uthe baqoke ithimba labaholi elizobamba izingxoxo namalungu ePhalamende ukwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi awuphazamiseki umsebenzi weqembu.Kuleli thimba kukhona iphini lesibili lomholi weMK, uMnuz Tony Yengeni, uSihlalo weMK uMnuz Nathi Nhleko noMnuz Magasela Mzobe, oyinhloko yehhovisi lomholi weMK."Sithanda ukuqinisekisa abantu ukuthi iqembu liyaqhubeka nomsebenzi walo."
KUXWAYISWE abafundi abazophothula ukubhala izivivinyo zika-matric, ukuthi bangalinge bahambele imicimbi yokujabulela ukuqeda ukubhala, eyaziwa ngama-pens down.Lesi sexwayiso sikhishwe nguMphathiswa wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka, njengoba iningi labafundi abenza u-matric, liphothula lezi zivivinyo kuleli sonto. Idlanzana lizophothula ukubhala ngelizayo ngezifundo iMaritime Sciences ne-Agricultural Management.UHlomuka ugagule uhlobo lwale micimbi, wathi luyaphazamisa."La maphathi adala ukuphuzwa kotshwala, ukucekelwa phansi kwempahla nokuziphatha budlabha kwabafundi. Abanye badabula babhale imifaniswano yabo, bangazihloniphi," kusho uHlomuka. Uthe noma ekuqonda ukuthi abafundi basuke bevala esinye isahluko empilweni yabo kodwa kubalulekile ukuziphatha ngendlela efanele."Kula maphathi kujwayele ukuthi kube nezehlakalo ezingezinhle ezidala usizi lwangunaphakade. Yingakho sinxusa abafundi ukuthi bagawule babheke, babeke phambili ukuphepha." Unxuse abafundi ukuthi bayibeke imifaniswano yabo ukuze banikele ngayo kwabayidingayo."Sihlaba ikhwelo lokuthi bayigcine ikahle, bayiyise ezikoleni uma sebeyolanda imiphumela yabo ka-matric ngonyaka ozayo. Izitatimende zabo bazozilanda ezikoleni ngoJanuwari 13, 2026. Sicela nabazali ukuthi basize ekutheni le mifaniswano igcinwe isesimweni ukuze kunikelwe ngayo," kuqhuba uHlomuka. Uthe bafuna ukuphothula unyaka ngaphandle kwezehlakalo ezimbi njengoba okwamanje izinto zisahamba kahle.NoKhomishana wamaPhoyisa esifundazweni, uLieutenant-General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, uxwayise abafundi ukuthi bangazibandakanyi nala maphathi ngoba bazobhekana nengalo yomthetho.Ekhuluma muva nje kwethulwa izinhlelo zokuphepha ngamaholidi kaDisemba, uMkhwanazi uthe amaphoyisa azobe ematasa ngalesi sikhathi engathi nsi kwabaphula umthetho.Wakhala ngokuthi le micimbi kayipheli kahle njengoba kuphuzwa utshwala, kudliwe izidakamizwa bese kokunye kuphume izidumbu. Uxwayise abazali ukuthi bagade izingane zabo zingaphambani nomthetho ngoba amaphoyisa azobe elandela umthetho.
UVEZA ukuthi ubusuphelile amasela eba imfuyo umphakathi waseMatata, eMaphephetheni, eNanda, kulandela ukubulawa ngesihluku kwabane abasolwa ngokweba imfuyo ngoMgqibelo.Kulesi sigameko okuthiwa senzeke kusempondo zankomo ngoMgqibelo, kushiswe abane ezimotweni ezimbili okusolwa ukuthi kuthwalwa ngazo inyama yezinkomo ezebiwe. Ngokuthola kweSolezwe, abathathu bashiselwe emotweni eyi-7 seater, kwathi oyedwa washiselwa evenini. Umthombo weSolezwe ofike endaweni yesigameko sesenzekile, uthe batshelwe ukuthi kukhona ababhadame iveni endaweni yesigameko, linabesilisa ababili."Kuthiwa babavimbezele lapho, bebabuza ukuthi benzani kule ndawo ekuseni kangaka futhi bangobani, abavela kuphi?” kulanda umthombo. Uthe laba besilisa bavele bankwankwaza, abasolwa base besesha iveni, bazithela phezu kwenyama yenkomo ilayishwe phakathi. "Yilapho kuthiwa kusuke khona esinamathambo, abasolwa kubacacela ukuthi ngamasela ezinkomo lawa,” kusho umthombo.Uthe akuqondakali ukuthi laba ababili bababize nini ozakwabo njengoba kuvele kwaqhamuka i-7 seater ebinabesilisa abane, abavele baqhumisa isibhamu. "Asazi kwenzekeni ngoba igcine ishiswa imoto nabanye phakathi,” kusho umthombo. Uthe bezwe kuthiwa babili abagcine bekwazi ukuphunyula babaleke njengoba kugcine kushiswa abane.Umthombo ukhale ngokuthi buningi kakhulu ubugebengu bokwebiwa kwezinkomo, zibulawe bese kuthathwa inyama. "Le nkinga iqale eminyakeni edlule. Izinkomo beziyiswa emadlelweni, kuthi uma seziyolandwa, kuficwe ngezikhumba zodwa namanqina, sezibulewe, yathathwa yonke inyama,” kusho uthombo. Utshele iphephandaba ukuthi akuzona zodwa izinkomo ezebiwayo kule ndawo njengoba nezimbuzi zabantu seziphelile amasela. "Okwazo ke kunzima kakhulu ngoba bavele bazifake emotweni zibe yinqwaba, bayishaye izule,” kusho umthombo. Uthe ababulewe ngabantu abangaziwa endaweni. Uqhube ngokuthi okwamanje ubengakaqhamuki umuntu wendawo othi untshontshelwe izinkomo eziyamaniswa nesigameko sakamumva. Ikhansela lendawo, uMnuz Makhosini Luthuli, lithe sibathusile isigameko.ULuthuli uthe indawo ike yaba nayo inkinga yokwebiwa kwemfuyo phambilini. "Kodwa bese kwehlile, zingaseningi izigameko zokwebiwa kwayo,” kusho uLuthuli.Uthe basola ukuthi into eyenza buqale phansi lobu bugebengu ukuthi sekusondela amaholidi kaKhisimusi."Noma ukuba khona kwemakethe yezindawo ezishisa inyama ngoba siyezwa ukuthi - ezinye zazo - zithenga inyama ebantwini abafana nalaba,” kusho uLuthuli. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa aphansi phezulu athungatha abasolwa ngokushisa ababulewe."Amaphoyisa aphenya amacala amane okubulala kulandela ukutholakala kwabane beshiswe ezimotweni ezimbili eMatata, eNanda, ngoMgqibelo,” kusho uNetshiunda. Uthe amaphoyisa athole umbiko, uwabizela endaweni yesigameko, kwathi uma efika athola oyedwa eshiselwe emotweni iNissan NP200, kwathi izidumbu zabathathu zatholwa kwiTiyota Rumion, nazo zishe zangqongqa. "Amaphoyisa athole izikhumba zezinkomo ezintathu eduze kweNP200,” kusho uNetshiunda.Uthe imbangela yokubulala ayikaziwa kodwa amaphoyisa ayasola ukuthi ihlangene nobugebengu bokwebiwa kwezinkomo. Uthe uhlelo lokuqinisekisa abagilwa luyaqhubeka kanjalo nolokucingwa kwabasolwa.
UKHALELWE amasongo kaSigonyela ngoLwesine, umfundi wasesikoleni iSiphondweni High, eJozini, osolwa ngokushisa ngamanzi abilayo omunye, ekhwelezela isoka elinguthisha.Lokhu kuvezwe wumndeni kamgilwa ngoLwesihlanu. Kulesi sigameko, kuthiwa umfundi ka-matric, u-Andiswa Jobe (18) wabhunyelwa ngamanzi abilayo ngomunye umfundi abefunda naye ngoNovemba 6. Kuthiwa umsolwa wayesola umgilwa ngokuthi uthandana nothisha ofundisa kuso lesi sikole oyisoka lakhe. Umgilwa, ophazamiseke ekubhaleni izivivinyo zakhe, kuthiwa usaqhubeka nokulashwa esibhedlela iNgwelezane. Umalume kamgilwa, uMnuz Sphiwe Vilane, uthe nakuba bekujabulele ukuthi umsolwa ushaqwe ngamaphoyisa kodwa basakhala ngokuthi umuntu oshayeke kakhulu ngesigameko umgilwa. "Okokuqala; uphazamiseke unomphelo ezifundweni zakhe. Njengoba kukhona izifundo angasazibhalanga, kusho ukuthi lo nyaka ufane neze leze kuyena ngoba ufundele ubala,” kusho uVilane.Uqhube wathi okunye okunzima ukuthi umgilwa usalokhu esezinhlungwini esibhedlela.Uthe ukwedluliselwa kwakhe kulesi sibhedlela asekuso, kulandela ukubona kwesibhedlela sendawo ukuthi isimo sibucayi, kukhomba ukuthi wayelimele kakhulu. "Ngakolunye uhlangothi, umsolwa yena ubeqhubeka nokubhala ezakhe izivivinyo emva kwesigameko. Siyazi ukuthi njengoba eboshiwe, uphinde akwazi ukuqhubeka nokubhala ngisho esevalelwe. Okusho ukuthi eyakhe imfundo kayithikamezekanga ngalutho,” usho kanje.Udalule ukuthi umsolwa uke wathwala kanzima esikoleni kulandela isigameko.Uthe emva kokuthi isikole singamthathelanga zinyathelo, abafundi bavele bamngenela ngenduku, bethi ngeke bakwazi ukufunda nomfundi owenzakalise omunye. "Kuze kwaphoqa ukuthi angabe esaqhubeka nokukhempa nabanye abafundi ngaphakathi esikoleni njengoba kuqhubeka ukuzilolongela izivivinyo,” kusho uVilane.Uthe isikole siphinde samcelela ukuthi izivivinyo zakhe azibhalele kwesinye isikole esingumakhelwane, wathi kwenzeka lokhu nje, nomphakathi ubuvutha ungabaselwe ungayekile ukubhikisha ngaphandle kwesango lesikole, uzwakalisa ilaka lawo, njengoba ubufuna isikole simthathele izinyathelo umsolwa. Uthe basamile nasekutheni bafuna uMnyango wezeMfundo umthathele izinyathelo uthisha oyimbangela yesigameko."Umthetho uthi othisha abangabi nobudlelwano bezothando nabafundi. Lona ufike esikoleni sethu wamosha. Ngale kokuthandana nomsolwa, kunenqwaba yabafundi athandana nayo, abanye waze wabakhulelisa,” usho kanje.Uthe emva kwesigameko, bathole ukuthi uthisha waqale wafundisa ngakubo KwaNongoma kodwa wahanjiswa yinkinga efanayo. Uthe ngaseJozini, usefundise ezikoleni ezimbalwa ngaphambi kokuza kulesi, wathi nakuzo ubehanjiswa yikho "ukudoba kubhasikidi". Ngosuku lwesigameko, kuthiwa umgilwa wayesalele ngesikhathi umsolwa embilisela amanzi ngeketelo, maqede wamthela ngawo. Kuvela ukuthi washa ezindaweni ezibucayi.

KUZOGUGA iphakethe kwabazokuya emcimbini wesidlo sasebusuku weqembu eliholwa uMnuz Floyd Shivambu, i-Afrika Mayibuye Movement.Ithikithi elibiza kunawo wonke lingu-R2 million. Leli thikithi lizokwenza ukuthi ukwazi ukuhlala etafuleni okuzokube kuhleli kulo uShivambu, okuyimali elingana neyakhokhwa ababehlezi eduze komholi weMK, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, ngesikhathi iqembu lakhe (MK) linomcimbi wokugubha unyaka lasungulwa.Uma ufuna ukuhlala eduze kwephini lomholi weqembu, uMnuz Robert Nwedo, uzokhokha u-R1.5 million. Kule mali uzothola ukudla okuhlukene izigaba ezintathu. Umcimbi we-Afrika Mayibuye Movement uzokuba ngoNovemba 28, ehhotela eliphambili elisendaweni yamtakabani, eSandton, eGoli.Imali ezoqoqwa kulo mcimbi izosetshenziselwa ukuhlela ingqungquthela yokuqala ye-Afrika Mayibuye Movement.I-Afrika Mayibuye Movement ingomafikizolo kwezepolitiki yakuleli, isungulwe emva kokuchithwa kukaShivambu kwiMK. Esitatimendeni, i-Afrika Mayibuye Movement, ithe ihlela ukuhlanganisa abantu abaqhamuka emikhakheni eyahlukene okuyibo abazothenga amathikithi omcimbi wasebusuku."Umcimbi uzohlanganisa osomabhizinisi, abaSamariya abalungileyo, abasebenza emikhakheni eyahlukene nezishoshovu. Sihlanganiswe ukulwela ukubuyiswa kwesithunzi, amandla ezomnotho nobuholi obuqotho. Sifisa ukubambisana nabantu abaqhamuka emikhakheni eyahlukene embhidlangweni wethu wokuthuthukisa abesifazane nentsha."I-Afrika Mayibuye Movement imemezele ingqungquthela yayo yokuqala ezokuba ngoDisemba, eGoli."Le ngqungquthela iyisigaba esibalulekile emzabalazweni wokukhulula abantu abamnyama. Lana sikhuluma ngenkululeko yangempela, ephelele. Ingqungquthela yethu izohlanganisa abaholi bomdabu, abaholi bamabandla, izifundiswa, abaholi bomphakathi nabaholi bezinyunyana. Sizokuba nezithunywa eziqhumuka ezifundazweni ezihlukene ezizokube zimele abantu abasha, abesifazane nabafundi. Sizokhuluma ngezwi elilodwa lapha. Sizobuka kabusha imiqulu yethu siphinde sicabe nendlela ebheke phambili." I-Afrika Mayibuye Movement isanda kusungulwa kodwa isike yabhekana nezinkinga zobuholi.Obeyiphini lomholi, uNksz Nolubabalo Mgcina, wamiswa esikhundleni emva kwenzinsolo zokuthi wabamba umhlangano noZuma.UNksz Mgcina usanda kuveza ukuthi usebuyele kwiMK kodwa wathi akashiyile nakwi-Afrika Mayibuye Movement.I-Afrika Mayibuye Movement isiyaqoka uNwedo ukuba athathe isikhundla ebesiphethwe uNksz Mgcina.
Owesifazane owayeyiphoyisa ugwetshwe iminyaka eyisishiyagalombili ejele yiNkantolo eNkulu yaseMiddelburg ngecala lokunukubeza ngokocansi indodana yakhe wayiqopha ngoba eyalelwa wumelaphi wendabuko owayethembise ukumelapha.Lona wesifazane (42) kuthiwa wayebhekene nezinkinga wase efuna usizo kumelaphi wendabuko ngo-2020."Umelaphi wamyalela ukuthi ageze indodana yakhe eneminyaka engu-12 ngomuthi bese eya nayo ocansini okuthiwa kwakuyindlela yokukhipha imimoya emibi,” kusho okhulumela iNPA eMpumalanga, uMonica Nyuswa. Uthe umelaphi wamyalela ukuthi akuqophe ayekwenza bese emthumelela i-video.Emuva kwalokho umelaphi wazama ukuqola imali lona wesifazane esabisa ngokuthi uzodedela i-video."Ngo-2023 umsolwa watshelwa ukuthi uvulelwe icala emuva kokubonakala kwe-video ezinkundleni zokuxhumana. Enkantolo umsolwa uvume icala wenza isivumelwano sesigwemo noMbuso ngokwesigaba 105A seCriminal Procedure Act 51 ka-1977. Wathi akazange amnukubeze umgilwa kodwa kwaba wumfanekiso njengokuyalelwa wumelaphi.”Ngesikhathi egwetshwa, inkantolo ibheke ukuthi uvume icala, ubambisane namaphoyisa njengoba azinikela yena, wakhipha ingonyuluka futhi ubesetoke iminyaka emibili elinde icala. Ulahlwe ngamacala amathathu okuwukuhlukumeza ngokocansi, ukukhiqiza izithombe nama-video ocansi olubandakanya ingane nokuthokakala nemifanekiso yocansi ehlanganisa ingane.Ube esenikezwa iminyaka engu-10 ngecala lokuqala, iminyaka emibili yalengiswa iminayaka emihlanu uma engatholakali esephutheni elifanayo.Ecaleni lesibili ugwetshwe iminyaka emibili kwathi kwelesithathu wagwetshwa emibili. Izigwebo emacaleni esibili nelesithathu uyalelwe ukuthi azidonse kanyekanye nesokuqala okwenze wathola iminyaka eyisishiyagalombili ejele. Kuthiwa akasavumelekile ukuphatha isibhamu.

UGIXATSHEZWE ngesigwebo sikadilikajele owesifazane waKwaMashu ngecala lokubulala indodakazi yakhe eyayineminyaka engu-14.Inkantolo yesiFunda yaseNtuzuma imgixabeze ngodilikajele uNksz Ncamisile Evarista Hlophe ngecala lokubulala indodakazi yakhe, uLuvuyo Tafadzwe.Ngokwesitatimende samaphoyisa lesi sigameko kuvela ukuthi senzeka kwaD KwaMashu ngoJulayi ngonyaka odlule futhi sashiya umphakathi uthuthumela. Ngakusasa ekuseni owesifazane watshela amaphoyisa ukuthi indodakazi yakhe ibixinwe kabi yikhanda yaphuza imithi ngaphambi kokuba ilale.Umufi kuvela ukuthi watholakala edindilize phezu kwedamu legazi futhi enenxeba ngemuva ekhanda.Unina wathi wamfica eseshonile ekuseni ngesikhathi ethi uyomvusa ukuze aye esikoleni. Watshela amaphoyisa ukuthi umufi uzilimaze yena kabi ngesikhathi ewa phansi embhedeni. Ngesikhathi kuhlolwa isidumbu kwatholakala ukuthi akushoyo kuyaphambana futhi akusilona iqiniso.Amaphoyisa ayekhuluma nomakhelwane athi bawatshela ukuthi bamuzwa umufi encenga unina ukuba angambulali.Uphenyo lwaveza ukuthi unina wayethathe imishwalense eminingi nje impela egameni likamufi. Ngaphambi kokuba abulale umntanakhe kuthiwa waqale waxhumana nabemishwalense ebheka ukuthi ngabe seyivuthiwe yini nokuthi usengahlomula yini kuyona uma kwenzeka ishona indodakazi yakhe. Wagcina esekhalelwa ngamasongo kaSigonyela ngemuva kophenyo olunzulu lwamaphoyisa.Enkantolo owesifazane wagcina esegonyuluka wavuma ukuthi wayibulala indodakazi yakhe ngenxa yemishwalense.Ngesikhathi kuqhubeka icala umphakathi ubujwayele ukufika ubhikishe ngaphandle kwenkantolo. Inkantolo yakwamukela ukuvuma kwakhe icala. UMshushisi uSibongiseni Goodenough Mtetwa waletha uyise kamufi ukuba azothula ubufakazi enkantolo. Watshela inkantolo ukuthi lona bekunguzinyobulala wabo. INPA ikwamukele ukugwetshwa kowesifazane.Kugwetshwa owesifazane nje sengathi usuyanda manje umkhuba wabesifazane abagwetshwa belahlwe amacala okubulala izihlobo ngenxa yemali yomshwalense.
LUFUNA banganikwa ibheyili ababhekene namacala okuhlukumeza nokubulala abesifazane uphiko lwabesifazane lukaKhongolose, i-ANC Womens League.Lolu phiko lufuna kuqiniswe imithetho ukuze kuqedwe ngesihlava esidlangile sodlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane nezingane kuleli.Lokhu kushiwo nguNobhala Jikelele walolu phiko, uNksz Nokuthula Nqaba, ekhuluma nabezindaba ngeSonto, ngesikhathi kuqhubeka umhlangano wesigungu esiphezulu sale nhlangano eGoli. Uthe bafuna ukuveza ilaka labo ngokuthi kuqiniswe isandla kwabenza la macala, ikakhulu njengoba kuzoba nomhlangano wabaholi bamazwe omhlaba iG20. Umhlangano wabaholi ungempelasonto, eGoli."Asifuni banikwe ibheyili ababhekene namacala okuhlukumeza. Sifuna kuqeqeshwe abezomthetho ukuze bakwazi ukubhekana namacala athinta ukuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane. Sifuna babhekana nezigwebo ezinzima abalahlwa amacala afuze lawa," usho kanje.Uthe bakhathazekile ngezehlakalo zokuhlukunyezwa nokubulawa kwabesifazane nsuku zonke kuleli."Sifuna kuqiniswe imithetho kulabo abalahlwa amacala okudlwengula abantu besifazane kanjalo nabababulalayo. Kuhamba ngelonwabu eyokulwa nalesi sihlava esibhekene nabesifazane kuleli." Uthe bafuna umthetho uvikele izisulu zokuhlukunyezwa.Kunombhikisho omkhulu wokulwa nale nkinga ozoba ngoLwesihlanu, ngaphambi kokuqala koweG20.I-ANC Womens League iveze ukuthi kuzoba namamashi okukhalaza ngalesi sihlava esibhekiswe kwabesifazane.
SEKUYALUNGA ngenkinga yamanzi kuMasipala waseThekwini kulandela ukutholwa kwembangela yokugqoza kwamanzi ezindaweni ezakhele leli dolobha.Lokhu kuvele ngesikhathi uphiko olubhekene namanzi nokuhanjiswa kwendle kulo masipala lubonisana nomphakathi waseThekwini, ngezindlela ezingasetshenziswa ekusheshiseni uhlelo lokulethwa kwentuthuko ebantwini.Lolu hlelo lokuqinisa ubudlelwano, ukuthembana nokuvulelana izifuba, phakathi kwalolu phiko nezakhamuzi, luhambe kahle kakhulu ngoLwesine. Lolu phiko beluhlanganise umphakathi ngenhloso yokuwazisa ngezingqinamba nenqubekela phambili ngenkinga yamanzi.Ekhuluma emhlanganweni, ongumqondisi ophezulu osabambile kulolu phiko, uMnuz Ednick Msweli, uthe ukusetshenziswa kwamaqhinga amasha ukuxazulula le nzukazikeyi yamanzi ekhungethe omasipala abaningi KwaZulu-Natal, sekuqala ukuthela izithelo emuva kokutholwa kwezimbangela.Uthe bathole izindawo ezidinga ukunakekelwa nokushintshwa kwengqalasizinda kuzo. Eqhuba uthe kunamapayipi afuna ukushintshwa nokuthuthukiswa kwabusha ukuze akwazi ukumelana nomthamo wamanzi ukuze kugwenye ukuxhaxhaza kwamanzi nokuqhuma kwamapayipi osekuyinsakavukela umchilo wesidwaba ezindaweni eziningi zakulo masipala.Emisebenzini emikhulu ezokwenziwa kubalwa ukuthuthukiswa kwesiteshi samanzi esiseNtuzuma nengqalasizinda esoGunjini. UMnyango wezeziMali kuleli ubeke eceleni isamba sika-R356 million ukuxhasa izinhlelo zophiko lwamanzi nokuhanjiswa kwendle eThekwini namaphethelo.
KUGUQE umhlangano wekomiti lasePhalamende kushayisana ubufakazi besikhulu sezisebenzi ehhovisi likaNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa, uMnuz Cedric Nkabinde.Umhlangano wekomiti uchithwe emva kokuba ikomiti libambe uNkabinde ukuthi uqambe amanga ngobudlelwano bakhe nosomabhizinisi osematheni, uMnuz Brown Mogotsi.UNkabinde utshele amalungu ekomiti ukuthi waqala ukwazana noMogotsi phakathi kuka-Okthoba noNovemba wangonyaka owedlule, wathi inombolo kaMogotsi wayinikwa uNgqongqoshe omisiwe, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, emcela ukuba amhlelele umhlangano. Ilungu leMK, uMnuz Sibonelo Nomvalo, lithe lokhu kuyashayisana nokusencwadini efungelwe elethwe uNkabinde phambi kwekomiti.UNomvalo uthe encwadini efungelwe, uNkabinde uveze ukuthi ngoSeptemba wangonyaka owedlule, wayevele esenayo inombolo kaMogotsi.UNomvalo uthe kunengxenye lapho khona uNkabinde aveza ukuthi uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, wambuza ngoMogotsi ngoSeptemba wangonyaka owedlule. "Lapha esitatimendeni uthi wamphendula uMkhwanazi ngokuthi uMogotsi usondelene noMchunu, waze wathumela ngisho nenombolo yakhe ukuqinisekisa. Le ngxoxo yenu yayingoSepthemba. Manje ususitshela ukuthi waqala ukuba nenombolo kaMogotsi ngoNovemba. Iyadida le nto."UNkabinde uthe ezinye izinto akasazikhumbuli kahle, wakhala ngokuthi amaphoyisa ashaqa zonke izinsiza zakhe zezokuxhumana.Amalungu ekomiti ayalele uNkabinde ukuba abuyele ekhaya ayoqala phansi isitatimende sakhe.I-EFF ithe izovulela uNkabinde icala lokudukisa iPhalamende.
Amaphoyisa aKwaZulu-Natal aphenya amacala okubulala kulandela ukutholakala kwabantu abane beshiswe bafa ezimotweni ezimbili eMatata, eNanda, ngoMgqibelo.Okhulumela amaphoyisa, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe babizwe endaweni yesigameko lapho bethole khona isidumbu esisodwa sishe kungabonakali nokuthi ngesikabani kwiNissan NP300."Ezinye izidumbu ezintathu zitholakale kwiToyota Rumion nazo zishe zangqongqa. Amaphoyisa aphinde athola nezinsalela zezinkomo ezintathu eduze kweNP200,” kusho uNetshiunda.Uthe imbangela yokubulawa ayikaziwa kodwa amaphoyisa asola ukuthi kuhlobene nokwebiwa kwemfuyo.Uthe kuqale uhlelo lokuhlonza izidumbu nokuthungatha abasolwa.
KUYIHLAZO ukuthi uyinsizwa okanye intombi yakwenu uma uthi uyadlula eduze kwabantu, basale beshaya amakhala ngenxa yephunga othe uyadlula lasala. Kwesinye isikhathi uthi uyahlala eduze kwabantu basukume bakubalekele ngenxa yeququ.Yingakho namhlanje ngibone kungcono ukuthi ngikhumbuze abantu ngokubaluleka kokuzithanda nenhlanzeko. Ngiyathemba ukuthi akekho umuntu ongaboni ukuthi kusehlobo manje kuyashisa ngakho-ke ngicela sizwane namanzi, sigcobe kahle lokhu kokushefa. Ungathi uyahlala eduze kwabantu ekhumbini bavele bashintshe ubuso. Uma-ke sigqugquzela ukuthi abantu bazithande, asikhulumi ngokugeza kuphela kodwa ngibala ukubaluleka kokushefa iziboya ngaphansi nasemakhwapheni.Sikhuluma ngokuhlanzeka komuntu uqobo kanye nendlu ahlala kuyona. Ngifisa nabantu besilisa bagezisise bo, bangasho ukuthi bona abanuki ngoba amankwahla akeve enuka. Izikhindi zangaphansi kubalulekile ukuthi zihlanzeke, zinganuki isishiqolo nje. Uma unenkinga yokujuluka njalo uma kushisa, qinisekisa ukuthi awulali nje ungagezile ngoba ukoma kwaloyo mjuluko kungadala inkinga emzimbeni wakho. Ikhwapha iyona ndawo ebucayi kakhulu, uma uzazi ukuthi unenkinga yekhwapha elinukayo gcobisa izinto zakhona. Ungabulali abantu ngekhwapha emotweni ngoba ninjalo ave nithanda ukupaquza.Ngifisa abantu bazijwayeze nje ukusebenzisa iziqholo ezinuka kahle noma ngabe awunayo imali yokuthenga kodwa phela ungakhohlwa ukugcoba insipho emakhwapheni uma ngabe kade uqeda ukugeza.Uma ngabe unomzimba omkhulu kumele impela uqinisekise ukuthi mugeza ungena kuwo wonke amakhona,noma usugcoba futhi akube njalo. Gwema ukuhlala iskhathi eside ungagezile, kubalulekile ukukwazi ukuzizwa uma kukhona iphunga ongalijwayele emzimbeni wakho. Kungasiza ekutheni usheshe uzame ukuligwema ungaze uphumele kubantu,Ngaphambi kokuthi nizijabulise gezani ukuze ningaxakwa iphunga nisazijabulisa. Noma seniqedile futhi gezani bakwethu ngoba kuyashisa manje, iphunga liyashesha nokusabalala.Abantu besifazane ngicela bagezisise ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezicashile, niqinise nasezinqeni kushaye umoya, nizwane nokufaka ipenty-liner ukuze ungaphoxwa iphunga lenkomo ekuhambeni.Bese kubakhona laba abephunga labo elingayindawo, zamani phela okokudambisa iphunga ngesikhathi nisazama ukuthola usizo. Asizinakekeleni bakwethu, ungathi la odlule khona kusale kukhulunywa ngawe ngenxa yephunga olishiyile.Kwesinye isikhathi ubudlelwano buyaphela ngenxa yokuthi khona uphathina oyinuku onephunga elihlale linukisa okwesimuncwana nje, omunye uthole ukuthi uhlula ngisho esembona umuntu wakhe egeza kodwa kuyena kungadikizi nobhozo.Inono ke alikwazi ukumela iphunga lenuku. Ngicela sizithande, sizwane namanzi njengoba kushisa nje, sikhumbule ukuthi iphunga linukela wonke umuntu. Bantu besifazane niyazi ke, uma kade siqeda ukuchama siyasula, asithintithi ukuze phela sigweme amaconsi omchamo angigcina esedala iphunga elibi elingaqhamuka kwesingezansi.
KUGQUGQUZELWE abazali ukuba bafundise izingane ukuthi udoti uyibhizinisi ukuze zikwazi ukondla imindeni yazo ngawo. Lokhu kuvele ngesikhathi abaziphilisa ngokuqoqa udoti behlomula ngezinsiza zokusebenza emhlanganweni obusehholo likaMasipala waseMfolozi ngoLwesine. Abaqoqa udoti ezindaweni ezakhele uMasipala bafundiswe ngamathuba okwenza imali asembonini yokushintsha udoti bawenze izinto ezingasebenza. UMnyango wezeMvelo nokuPhathwa kukaDoti kuMasipala waseMfolozi ubambisene nenhlangano iPolyco babe nesithangami sokucobelelana ngolwazi nabaqoqa udoti. Kulesi sithangami bafundiswe ngokwehluka kukadoti nokuthi yimuphi abangakwazi ukwenza ngawo imali. IMeya yaseMfolozi, uMnuz uXolani Bhengu, ithe mukhulu umsebenzi owenziwa abaziphilisa ngokuqoqa udoti, ngakho bangawubukeli phansi. UBhengu uthe sengathi nabanye bangawubona lo msebenzi bangene kuwo bondle imindeni yabo. Abebesemhlanganweni banxuswe ukuba babhalise izinkampani ikakhulukazi ngezingane ukuze bathole uxhaso ngoba bayadingeka abantu abasebasha. Iminyango ehlukene esebenza ngodoti ichazele abaqoqa udoti ngemigudu efanele ukuze amabhizinisi abo ahambisane nomthetho.
UMEYA waseMkhanyakude uMnuz Comfort Khumalo useveze ukuthi yena akawathandi amaloli aletha amanzi emphakathini, njengoba enezinqinamba ezihlukene.Ukusho lokhu ethula uhlelo lwesabelo esididiyelwe esingaphezu kukaR1 billion, KwaSomkhele, eMtubatuba.UKhumalo uthi akufunayo ukusebenza kanzima ukuze amanzi ahambe namapayipi afinyelele noma yikuphi la befuna khona. Uthi uhlelo lwamaloli lunezinqinamba eziningi okukhona kuzo ukudla imali enkulu nokungaba ngcono uma bezithengela awabo.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ehambise uhlelo lwesabelo esididiyelwe obeluhlanganisa uMasipala waseMkhanyakude nowaseMtubatuba.UKhumalo uthe ingqinamba yamanzi iyona enkulu kakhulu futhi bamatasa nayo manje."Amaloli mina angiwathandi futhi ngizosebenza kanzima ukuthi siyawaqeda lawa aqashwayo sizithengele awethu, ngoba ayabiza futhi awawahambisi kahle amanzi emphakathini. Sizimisele ukuthi sikhande uhlelo olizohambisa amanzi ngamapayipi emphakathini singagcini lapho senze nohlelo lokuwagubha phansi ukuze abantu bakithi bayeke ukuhlupheka kangaka, " kusho uKhumalo.Uthe olunye uhlelo oluzodla imali engaphezu kukaR90 million elokwakha indawo ekuzochithwa kuyo indle nokuvelayo ukuthi iyadingeka."Ziningi izindawo eziyosiza ukulekelela ohlelweni lwendle ngokwakhiwa kwale ndawo. Esikunxusayo kodwa kakhulu ukuthi abantu abakhokhele izikweletu zabo zamanzi ukuze sizosombulula inkinga yamanzi esibhekene nayo. Abantu esizobayeka abahola impesheni nabangasebezi, kodwa laba abakuyeka ngamabomu lokhu ake sibambisane nabo, okunye abantu abayeke ukuzoxhumela amanzi ngoba lokhu kudala ukuthi angafinyeleli kwabanye, " kuchaza yena.Uthe njengoba kubhekwe esikhathini samaholidi uyazi abantu bazozitika ngophuzo oludakayo nokwenza kwande izingozi zomgwaqo nesihlava sokubulalana kwabantu abathandanayo."Ngicela nehlise etshwaleni mphakathi wakithi, izigameko ezikhathazayo ezivelayo ngalesi sikhathi zisishiya simangele kakhulu. Ngiyacela ukuthi ke kwehliswe etshwaleni ikakhulukazi abesifazane abasebancane, kulo nyaka asilindele zigameko ezinyantisayo kanjalo nezingozi zomgwaqo, " kuphetha uKhumalo.
LUQALE ngegiya eliphezulu uhlelo lukaMasipala waseNewcastle, lokuqoqa izikweletu emalokishini, kosomabhizinisi kanjalo nezikhungo zikahulumeni ezikuleli dolobha.Lolu hlelo beluholwa uMeya uMnuz Xolani Dube, noveze ukuthi bakhethe ukuzifikela mathupha emphakathini bezoqoqa imali yezikweletu.UDube uthe bachithe izinsuku ezintathu behambela izindawo ezahlukene bexoxa nemphakathi, osomabhizinisi ezindaweni ezahlukene bebatshela ukuthi abaqale bakhokhe izikweletu zabo zikaMasipala. "UMasipala ukweletwa imali engango R2.3 billion, nokwenza kube nzisa ukuthi siqhubeke sisebenze ngendlela njengohulumeni. Abantu badinga izinsiza emphakathini kodwa konke lokhu akwenzeki ngenxa yokuthi imali asinayo futhi izikweletu zikagesi, amanzi nokunye okusetshenziwa emphakathini akusakhokhwa. Siqale elokishini laseMadadeni ezigcemeni ezimbili nala sibona khona ukuthi lo mkhuba uyanda njengoba abantu abaningi khona bengazixaki ngokukhokhela izinsiza abazisebenzisayo. Ukuze konke kuhambe ngohlelo futhi siphinde silungise nezinye izinsiza ezisiza umphakathi kumele sibambisane," kusho uDube.Uthe babhekene nobunzima njengoMasipala, kungakho bekhethe ukuthi basukumele uhlelo olufana nalolu olungeke lushiye muntu ngaphandle."Siyanxusa kubona bonke abantu abakhele uMasipala wethu ukuthi bakuthathe njengento esisiza sonke lokhu esikwenzayo, siyacela babe nesandla ekutheni uMasipala usebenza kahle ukuze uzokwazi ukukhulisa umnotho nedolobha likhule njengamanye. Ukukhokhela kwabo izidingo kuzokwenza ukuthi nathi sikwazi ukuhambisa izidingo emphakathini futhi ingqalasizinda yonke esinayo isebenze kahle ngoba izobe inakekelwa," kusho uDube.Uthe kukhona uhlelo abaluqalile lokusiza abakweletayo ukuthi bakwazi ukukhokha ngendlela evumelana nabo, nabazothola usizo lwayo uma befika amahhovisi abo ahlukene amanye asedolobheni eNewcastle, Madadeni eSection 1 nase-4 nasoSizweni.
UMLOBI wesifazane, okwabahlonishwayo kulo mkhakha, udonsa abesifazane ngendlebe ukuba bangalinge bazibethele ngenxa yezimo ezibuhlungu abadlule kuzo, kunalokho abaqinise abanye abalimele. UMaNyambose uthe ukwethulwa kwale ncwadi, ezaleke ngesikhathi epholisa ubuhlungu adlule kubo, kuhambisana nesithangami sokucobelelana ngolwazi esibizwa ngeBreaking The Silence Seminar. Kuthe uma ngethula incwadi yokuqala ethi Divorce Breaking The Silence ngo-2017, ngathola iningi labesifazane ebelidlule esimeni esifanayo, ebelidinga ukwelulekwa.Uthe yazaleka kanjalo iBreaking The Silence Seminar, okuzoba ngeyesithupha nonyaka.Uveze ukuthi izicelo zokwelulekwa kwabesifazane zingene zilakanyana, okwenze wagcina ebona isidingo salezi zithangami."Balimele abesifazane ikakhulukazi kwezothando. Inkinga enkulu wukuthi bayasaba ukukhuluma ngoba bazokwahlulelwa, babukeke njengezahluleki. Nakimina bekungelula ngiqala lezi zithangami, ngibhala nencwadi. Abanye babengithuka bethi ngifafaza umoya wedivosi.” Ufanisa lokhu akwenzayo njengobizo njengoba futhi engumzalwane oyisisebenzi nasebandleni. Uthe ufisa ukuthi lezi zithangami zikhule, zigcine seziwuchungechunge oluzungeza zonke izindawo. Uthe uhlelo luzophathwa ngumsakazi weVibe FM, uNozipho Nzimande.Ngo-2021 uMaNyambose uke wawenza umbuthano walolu hlobo eWitbank, eMpumalanga, kanti ngonyaka ozayo uhlela ukuwubambela kwelinye idolobha. UMNUZ Cedric Nkabinde oyisikhulu sabasebenzi ehhovisi likaNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa osamisiwe, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, uzidonsele amanzi ngomsele ebanjwa ngunoxhaka ngesikhathi ethula ubufakazi ekomitini lasePhalamende elikhethekile.Ikomiti lasePhalamende lingase lithathele uNkabinde izinyathelo zomthetho emva kokuba kuvele ukuthi uqambe amanga efungile ngesikhathi evele phambi kwalo izolo. Usihlalo wekomiti, uMnuz Soviet Lekganyane, uthe balindele ukuthi ithimba labameli libatshele ukuthi yiziphi izinyathelo abangazithatha.I-EFF ivele isishilo ukuthi izovulela uNkabinde icala lokuqamba amanga efungile.UNkabinde, oqale ngomfutho, usheshe wahluleka wukubambelela emajikeni.Inkinga iqale ngesikhathi kuvela ukuthi ubufakazi bukaNkabinde buyashayisana nokubhalwe phansi encwadini yakhe efungelwe ngobudlelwano bakhe nosomabhizinisi osematheni, uMnuz Brown Mogotsi. Iyadida le nto."UNkabinde uthe ezinye izinto akasazikhumbuli kahle, wakhala ngokuthi amaphoyisa ashaqa zonke izinsiza zakhe zokuxhumana.Amalungu ekomiti abethukuthele egane unwabu ayalele uNkabinde ukuba ayoqala phansi azilungiselele kabusha.ULekganyane uthe kusobala ukuthi uNkabinde ucasha ngesithupha uma ekhala ngokuthi bezingekho kuyena izinsiza zokuxhumana ngesikhathi elungiselela umhlangano."Ubengakwazi ukuthola imininingwane kwabanye abantu asebenza nabo. Uqambe amanga ngamabomu nje. Ubengakwazi ukuthola ukuthi uMchunu waya nini eLusikisiki. Le nto igcwele embikweni wezindaba. Ufike lapha wafunga ukuthi konke azokukhuluma kuyiqiniso. Abameli kufanele baseluleke ukuthi yiziphi izinyathelo esingazithatha." Ilungu le-EFF, uNksz Leigh-Ann Mathys, lithe bazovulela uNkabinde icala."Kufanele aboshwe lo muntu. Akenzanga nje iphutha elincane kodwa uqambe amanga ngamabomu."Ilungu le-PA, uMnuz Ashley Sauls, lisole amalungu ekomiti ngokuqinisa isandla kuNkabinde.USauls uthe noMkhwanazi kukhona okungelona iqiniso akusho ngesikhathi evele ekomitini, waze wakuhoxisa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi.UMkhwanazi wayekade ethe owayengungqongqoshe wamaphoyisa, uMnuz Bheki Cele, wathola imali kusomabhizinisi obhekene noxhaxha lwamacala, uMnuz Vusumuzi "Cat" Matlala.Wabuye wazihoxisa lezi zinsolo, waxolisa.Ngasekuqaleni kobufakazi bakhe uNkabinde uchaze kabanzi ngobudlelwano bakhe noMkhwanazi.UNkabinde uthe bangabangani abakhulu noMkhwanazi, wathi unezimfihlo ngoMkhwanazi ayoze angene nazo egodini.UNkabinde uthe kwamumangaza ukuzwa uMkhwanazi ekhuluma kabi ngaye."Okwangifikela nje wukuthi umngani wami ungidinelwe. Wayecasulwe wukuthi ngaqopha inkulumo yethu efonini. Umngani wami wayengeke athi anginazo iziqu ekubeni kunguye owangisiza ukuba ngithole umsebenzi. Uyazi ukuthi nginaziphi iziqu, saze sahleka sobabili ngesikhathi sibona ukuthi sineziqu zemfundo ezifanayo. Ngakho-ke umngani wami wayecasukile nje, wayezama ukungcolisa igama lami. Sisazoyikhuluma le nto naye. Namanje usewumngani wami."
UPHITHENE amakhanda umndeni wakwa-H, eMlaza, kulandela ukuthola ukuthi kunyamalale nonina wowesifazane otholwe ebulewe ngesihluku ngempelasonto.Isidumbu sikaNksz Noluthando Ntshangase (22) sitholwe sidindilize esikhotheni esingasesikoleni iZindongeni Primary, esigcemeni sakwa-M kuleli lokishi ngoMgqibelo.Sitholwe sinqunu, izingubo zakhe ziwumfunzana eceleni, kukhona ne-tissue, nokwaqinisa izinsolo zokuthi waqale wadlwengulwa ngaphambi kokubulawa. Kusolwa ukuthi ubulawe ngokuklinywa ngentambo yamateki njengoba ificwe imthandele ithe nsi entanyeni.Ilungu lomndeni, uNksz Mpume Ntshangase, lithe kubaphithanise amakhanda ukungatholakali kukaNksz Sindisiwe Ntshangase (41), ongunina kamufi."Thina sihlala eNewlands West. ULuthando nonina bebehlala ekhaya kwa-H. Isigameko sokubulawa kwakhe besizungeza ezinkundleni zokuxhumana njengoba isithombe sakhe edindilizile besivezwa. Nathi sathintwa omunye umakhelwane wethu wakhona kwa-H ngawo uMgqibelo ethi asiphuthume endaweni yesigameko ngoba kutholakale intombazane ibulewe ebukeka ifana nesihlobo sethu," kusho uNksz Ntshangase. Uthe banikela khona nokho bathola ukuthi isidumbu sesithathwe amaphoyisa asiyisa emakhazeni kahulumenj ePark Ryne, eScottburgh.Uthe baze bayosibona ngoMsombuluko nokuyilapho befike baqinisekisa khona ukuthi umufi otholakele yisihlobo sabo.Uthe kusukela lapho, bebelokhu bezitshela ukuthi bazombona unina kamufi engena ngomnyango kodwa lutho. "Uwumuntu oke ahambe izinsukwana avakashele umuntu ahlekisana naye, kodwa abuye. Manje sithuswa wukuthi sibona sekuyophela isonto engabuyi," kusho uNksz Ntshangase.Uthe okwenza bathuke kakhulu wukuthi izungeze kakhulu ezinkundleni zokuxhumana eyokubulawa kukaLuthando ngesihluku."Akukwazi ukuthi akakezwa namanje ukuthi umntwana ushonile. Kufanele ngabe usebuyile ekhaya kwazise kufanele kuqhubeke izinhlelo zomngcwabo," kusho uNksz Ntshangase. Uqhube wathi bazamile ukumthinta enombolweni yakhe yeselula kodwa bathola kuthi ayingeni.Uthe baphinde babheka nakowesilisa abagcina ehlekisana naye ukuthi uphi, ngeshwa ubatshele ukuthi sebahlukana."Sididekile siwumndeni ukuthi ngabe uphi noma wehlelwe yini ngoba akufani naye ukuthi angavele aduke kanje," kusho uNksz Ntshangase. Uthe babikile emaphoyiseni ukuthi udukile, abhalisa umbiko womuntu odukile.Uthe okwamanje umndeni ubungakafiki esinqumeni sokuthi uqhubeke nokungcwaba nakuba engabuyile unina kamufi.Uthe bakhulekela ukuthi abuye ukuze kqhubeke izinhlelo zokufihla umufi naye ekhona.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa aseMlaza avule icala lokubulala kulandela isigameko lapho owesifazane etholwe efile ngoNovemba 8, 2025 kuleli lokishi."Imbangela yokubulala ayikaziwa," kusho uNetshiunda.
UKHWELE wadilika esikhwameni esixhasa izitshudeni ngemali yokufunda ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme, iNSFAS uNgqongqoshe wezeziMali, uMnuz Enoch Godongwana, ekhala ngokuthi asiwenzi umsebenzi esasungulelwa wona.UGodongwana uthe ngeke ananaze ukusivala lesi sikhwama uma kungase kube nesiphakamiso esifuze lesi."Ngeke ngicabange ngisho kabili ukusivala, kungasa ngakusasa sengiyivalile iNSFAS. Ayisawenzi umsebenzi eyasungulelwa wona. Yasungulelwa ukudlulisa imali yezitshudeni iye emanyuvesi isuka eMnyangweni weMfundo ePhakeme. Lowo msebenzi isiwudlulisele ezinkampanini ezine eziqashile ukuthi ziwenze," usho kanje. Uthe ngalokhu ayisakwenzi eyayisungulelwe khona ngoba akunzima ukudlulisa imali esuka emnyangweni iya emanyuvesi. "Ngiyazi ukuthi kungasuka umsindo uma ngingase ngithi ngiyayivala. Izitshudeni zingabhikisha umlibe ngoba kukhona abangabe sebezivukuzile ukuthi zibhikishe ngoba sivala lesi sikhwama. Bengitshela noMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ukuthi nesikhulu esiphezulu seNSFAS sihola ngaphezu kwakhe. Lesi sikhulu sihola u-R4 million," usho kanje ekhuluma esidlweni sasekuseni emva kwesabelomali esibuyekeziwe asethule ePhalamende ngoLwesithathu. Usho lokhu nje, lesi sikhwama sihlale sinezinkinga njengoba izitshudeni nomastende behlale bekhala ngaso. Minyaka yonke izitshudeni zihlale zikhala ngokungaxhaswa ngesikhathi, ukuphucwa uxhaso sezithembile, ukukhishwa lapho zihlala khona ngoba zingakhokhile kanjalo nangezinye izinkinga ezidala ukuthi zize ziteleke, kushiswe nempahla kwezinye izikhungo.Izitshudeni sezike zakhala ngalezi zinkampani zithi zifuna imali ingene ngqo kuzona, iyeke ukudlula kwenye indawo. Nomastende bahlale bekhala ngokuthi imali yabo ayifiki, okwenza baze baxoshe abasuke bengakhokhelwe.Izinkinga azipheli kulesi sikhwama njengoba kusanda kusula obengusihlalo webhodi, ekhala ngokucwaswa ngokwebala, ukusatshiswa nangobuhlathi obukhona kulesi sikhwama. Kuhlale kushintshwa abaholi njengoba lesi sikhwama sifakwa nangaphansi kwabalawuli abasuke bezama ukulungisa isimo. Kwenzeka lokhu nje, kusasa wusuku lokugcina lokuthi kufakwe izicelo kulabo abafuna ukuxhaswa ngonyaka ozayo. Abafundi banxuswe ukuthi bangalindi umnyama ongenafu kodwa bafake izicelo zoxhaso kulesi sikhwama.I-NSFAS ixhaswa cishe ngo-R50 billion, kanti le mali ayenele njengoba kubuye kwadingeka ukuthi kwengezwe enye imali ngenxa yokuthi akuzona zonke izitshudeni ezixhasiwe.
AKUDIKIZI nqulu kuhulumeni futhi ngeke kuphazamise lutho ukuduba kweMelika ukuthamela umhlangano wamazwe ayingxenye yeG20 ozoba kuleli, phezu kokuba izothatha izintambo zokwengamela lo mhlangano ngonyaka ozayo.Lokhu kuvezwe nguNgqongqoshe ehhovisi likamengameli, uNksz Khumbudzo Ntshavheni, izolo ekhuluma ngamalungiselelo alo mhlangano osekubalwa izinsuku ube kuleli.Ekhuluma nabezindaba emva komhlangano weKhabhinethi eKapa, uthe akumele bakhathazeke abantu bakuleli ngokuduba kweMelika ukuhambela kuleli."Akuthi diki ukuthi iMelika ayizi kulo mhlangano. Uthe konke sekumi ngomumo mayelana nomhlangano njengoba uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, ezohambela eNasrec, eGoli namhlanje lapho kuzobanjelwa khona umhlangano eyohlola ukuthi izinto zihamba kanjani."Ibalelwa ku-130 imihlangano ethinta iG20 esibekhona ezifundazweni ezehlukene kuleli. UNksz Ntshavheni uncome iBiovac noMnyango wezeSayensi nobuChwepheshe, ngokuqopha umlando ngokwethula umshanguzo owakhiwe kuleli wokunqanda isifo sohudo, i-cholera.Uthe ngokokuqala ukuthi kwakhiwe umshanguzo ofuze lo kuleli wathi uzosiza enkingeni yesifo sohudo esike sihlasele namanye amazwe."Ukukhiqizwa kwalo mshanguzo kusho ukuthi elakuleli selidlulele kwelinye izinga kwezithinta umkhakha wezesayensi. IKhabhinethi inethemba lokuthi lo mshanguzo uzosiza ezwenikazi i-Afrika njengoba lesi sifo sihlale sibheduka khona." Babalelwa ku-21 000 kuya ku-143 000 abashonayo ngenxa yayo," usho kanje. Uthe kusuka eminyakeni yawo-1970 besibheduka lesi sifo kanti besisuke sihambisana nezinhlekelele."Isehlakalo sokuqala esabikwa sasingo-1974, kwase kulandela nakweminye iminyaka kusuka ngo-1980 kuya ku-1987 lapho kwashona khona abantu abangu-348, kwahaqeka abangu-25 000."Uthe ukwakhiwa kwalo mshanguzo kuleli kuzodala amathuba emisebenzi, kwehlise imali yokuthengwa kwemishanguzo kwamanye amazwe, kwakhe namakhono.

AYASHAQISA amacala abhekene nothisha abadlwengula abafundi KwaZulu-Natal kulo nyaka njengoba elinye lithinta uthisha owagxisha umfundi utshwala wase elala naye.Angu-71 amacala abikwe emnyangweni esifundazweni kulo nyaka, ngokombiko othulwe ePhalamende. Kulawa, angu-30 athinta othisha abalala nabafundi abangaphansi kweminyaka engu-16, okuthathwa ngokuthi babadlwengula.Emacaleni adalulwe yisikhulu soMnyango wezeMfundo esifundazweni, u-Adv Bheki Masuku, ekomitini leMfundo eyisiSekelo ePhalamende, ebelibhunga ngesihlava sokudlwengulwa kwabafundi nokungabikwa kwabafundi abangaphansi kuka-16 abakhulelwe ezikoleni, kuvele ukuthi othisha bayaqhubeka nokugila imikhuba yokudlwengula abafundi, abanye abakwenzela ngisho ezikoleni. Elinye lamacala aphenywa ngumnyango, elikathisha owanukubeza umfundi ofunda uGrade 5, oneminyaka engu-11 ngendlela esingenakuyichaza ephepheni ngoba iyashaqisa nakwabanye kwenziwa izinto ezihlasimulisa umzimba .UMasuku uthe bayaphenya uma sebebikelwe ngesehlakalo bese bemumisa uthisha othintekayo."Kube sekuba nezinhlelo zokuqondiswa ubugwegwe. Amanye amacala abikiwe elikathisha odlwengule ingane eneminyaka engu-10, omunye enengu-13 okungamacala afakwa ohlwini lwabantu abadlwengule izingane ezingaphansi kuka-16," usho kanje. Uthe izikole zibhekana nengwadla yokuthi abanye abafundi abafuni ukubika amacala afuze lawa ukuze kuphenywe."Ezinye zezikole azibanakekeli abafundi, zigxila ekufundiseni. Ezinye zivikela isithunzi sesikole kanti kokunye izikole zibikela abazali ngoba zikholwa wukuthi yibona okumele bavule amacala," kusho uMasuku.Kulo mhlangano izinyunyana zothisha zikhale ngokuthi azikho izinhlelo ezicacile zokubika amacala afuze lawa. Zithe kudingeka kuqeqeshwe othisha ngezinto okumele bazenze uma behlangabezana nesimo sabafundi abakhulelwe nabadlwenguliwe.Kugqame ukuthi lezi zinhlelo ziyaphuthuma ikakhulu njengoba uGrade R, kanjalo nabafundi bakuma-Early Childhood Development (ECD), sebengaphansi kowezeMfundo.Kuphakanyiswe nokuthi kube nosonhlalakahle cishe kuzona zonke izikole ngoba bona baqeqeshelwe lo msebenzi. Kukhalwe nangamaphoyisa ukuthi kokunye awafuni ukuthi amacala avulwe abanye abantu afuna avulwe abagilwa.UNgqongqoshe weMfundo eyisiSekelo uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, uthe kungaba kuhle ukuba nosonhlalakahle kuzona zonke izikole kodwa lokhu ngeke kwenzeke. Uveze ukuthi osonhlalakahle baba semahhovisi ezifunda lapho besiza inqwaba yezikole kuleso sifunda.Uthe zikhona izinhlelo ezikoleni zokuthi kubikwe kanti nomthetho wezikole iBela, uyakubalula ukuthi kuwumsebenzi wothisha ukubika ngabafundi abakhulelwe uma bengaphansi kuka-16, ukuze kubhekwe ukuthi abadlwengulwanga yini abantu abadala kunabo.

ITHI isibeke amathemba ayo kuNkulunkulu ingwevu yaseNdlunkulu ehlaliswe lubhojozi wumlilo ongaziwa ukuthi udalwa yini ongqongqisa izindlu emzini wayo.UMntwana uPhilemon kaTshelendoda kaDinuzulu uthe sekumcacele ukuthi ubhekene nempi yobumnyama.Ukusho lokhu emva kokuba umlilo ungqongqise indlu yakhe enamagumbi ayisikhombisa emzini wakhe osoSuthu.Bese kungokwesikhombisa kulo nyaka kuhlasela umlilo ongaqondakali emzini woMntwana uPhilemon.UMntwana uPhilemon, wayethe ngeke athuthe endaweni ngesikhathi eqala ukuhlaselwa wumlilo, kodwa manje uthi usuyamfikela umcabango wokuthutha."Bengingakucabangi nhlobo ukuhanjiswa yisitha ngalolu hlobo endaweni, sengithembe uNkulunkulu ozongikhanyisela ukuthi yikuphi okudalekayo, okuzwokwenza inhliziyo yami nomoya wami uthole ukuphumula. Kodwa- ke ngiyamethemba uNkulunkulu ngoba yena akahluleki, uyayiphendula imithandazo."UMntwana uPhilemon uthe ufana nomuntu olele entabeni emva komlilo wangoMsombuluko."Njengamanje ngicuphe endlini yezingane. Eyami indlu ishe yaphela. Okwanamhlanje sengathi kudlula okunye. Indlu enamagumbi ayisikhombisa ishe yonke. Akuzange kuphume lutho phakathi. Bekuba ngcono kulokhu okunye ngoba bekuyaye kube khona okukhishwayo uma kusha lezi ezinye izindlu. Kulokhu akuzange kuphume lutho. Ngiphelile nje, angisele nalutho. Angisenazo ngisho nezinto zokugqoka."UMntwana uPhilemon uthe umlilo wangoMsombuluko uhlule ngisho abezicishamlilo."Ngiyabona kubathiyile abezicishamlilo ngoba indlu ishe yaze yaphela phambi kwabo. Nami ngifonelwe ngiya edolobheni (KwaNongoma). Ngifike ngabuka, indlu ishe yaze yaphelela phambi kwami. Bekungasangeneki endlini. Indlu ineminyango emibili. Bekungangeneki kuyona yomibili iminyango ngendlela ilangabi ebelilikhulu ngayo. Abebekhona ekhaya bathi ababonanga ukuthi uqale kanjani, nabo bezwe sebemenyezwa, kuthiwa nanku umlilo. Asazi ukuthi sizoyithini indaba yalo mlilo ovele uqhamuke nje esithubeni."UMntwana uPhilemon uthe uselala obenyoni ngoba akazi ukuthi umlilo uzophinde ugadle nini."Awukwazi ukuhlupheka engibhekene nakho. Selokhu kwasukela ngoFebhuwari ngidlala ukuhlupheka. Kuhlezi kuthengwa impahla yasendlini bese kuthi emva kwezinyangana nje bese kuphinde kuyasha. Izindlu sezishe zaphela lapha ekhaya. Nazo izindlu ezisele azinalutho phakathi, sekwasha yonke into eyayikhona."

Uthe lo mkhankaso ngeke uphelele e-Eastern Cape kuphela kodwa kunalokho uzobonakala ukapakela nakwezinye izifundazwe ezikhona ezweni lonke.Kuyimanje uthe bamatasa nefilimi iRhythm of the Street nenye ezophuma ngonyaka ozayo ebizwa nge-The Vigilante.

Lokho kuzokwenza ukuthi abantu bangacindezelwa yizikweleti. Lokhu kuzokhulisa umnotho kudale namathuba emisebenzi."Usotswebhu we-IFP, uMnuz Nhlanhla Hadebe, uthe sisonke isabelomali sikaGodongwana sibuyisa ithemba."Sijabule kakhulu ngalesi sabelomali. Kusobala ukuthi usayibambe ngakho uhulumeni ophethe. Into nje esifuna ukuyigcizelela yilena yokuphathwa kahle kwemali. Ukungaphathwa kahle kwemali kungaphazamisa lezi zinhlelo ezinhle kangaka esizibonayo."Umholi we-EFF, uMnuz Julius Malema, uthe isimemezelo sikaGodongwana sizokwenza ukuthi babe baningi abantu abazofuna ukuboleka imali ngenxa yokuthi izobe isinciphile imali ezobe ikhokhwa abanezikweleti."Sonke-ke siyazi ukuthi lokho kuzolimaza abantu. Le nto nje uGodongwana uyitshelwe abantu abatshala imali, phela uzwa ngabo abatshalimali."I-MK iyihlabe yayihlikiza inkulumo kaGodongwana. Ilungu leMK, uMnuz Thulani Gamede, lithe uGodongwana akazange asho lutho ngezinto ezithinta abantu."Yihlazo leli. UGodongwana akazange asho lutho ngodaba lokuntuleka kwamathuba emisebenzi, indlala kanye nokungalingani. Akashongo lutho ngodaba lokubuyiswa komhlaba. Le nto ikutshela ukuthi la bantu abanandaba. Abantu bahlaliswe lubhojozi wubugebengu, abantu abasha abasebenzi."
