KUBHIMBA uhlelo kubafundi bakwaGrade 1 kuya kuGrade 3 kuleli, njengoba ucwaningo loMnyango weMfundo eyisiSekelo luveze ukuthi ingxenye eningi yalaba bafundi ayikwazi ukufunda isheshe.Ucwaningo oluvele ohlelweni iFunda Uphumelele olwethulwe nguNgqongqoshe woMnyango, uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, luveze ukuthi u-70% wabafundi abakulamabanga ababhekene nale nkinga.Owenza ucwaningo emnyangweni, uDkt Nompumelelo Nyathi-Mohohlwane, uthe abafundi abathathu kwabangu-10, abakuGrade 1 no-3, yibona abakwazi ukufunda ngendlela elindelekile. Uthe ngalo mbiko wocwaningo bahlose ukuphucula indlela abafundi abenza ngayo."Sifuna ukusheshe singenelele enkingeni yokungakwazi ukufunda kwezingane zisuka amadaka. Asifuni ukuyibamba ekugcineni sekuvele konakele."Uthe bafuna ukusheshe bahlonze nabafundi abadinga usizo zisuka nje. Ekhuluma ePitoli emva kokwethulwa kombiko, uNksz Gwarube, uthe sebenesithombe esigcwele sokukwazi ukufunda kwabafundi bakuleli ngazo zonke izilimi ezingu-11.Uthe ucwaningo luzosiza ngoba bazokwazi ukusheshe balungise izinkinga zokungakwazi ukufunda kuleli."Sekunesikhathi sazi ukuthi abafundi abaningi abakuqondi abakufundayo kwa-Grade 3. Kodwa besingazi ukuthi lokhu kudalwa yini. Manje sesiyazi ukuthi inkinga ngukuthi abakwazi ukubona izinhlamvu okwenza bangakwazi ukufunda basheshe futhi bangakuqondi abakufundayo," usho kanje. Uthe bagxile emazingeni amathathu okuqala ngoba yilapho behlose ukuqinisa khona, esisekelweni semfundo."Sifuna ukuthi bathi befika kwaGrade 4, babe sebeqonda abakufundayo. Uma singakwenzi lokhu siyokhala emazingeni aphezulu ekubeni singazange sinake lapho inkinga iqala khona," kuqhuba uNksz Gwarube.Uveze ukuthi kubalulekile ukuthi abafundi bafunde nangolimi lwebele. "Uma befunda ngolimi lwebele, bayakwazi ukuhlanganisa izinto kalula. Bayakwazi nokucabanga bese beqonda ukuthi kwenzekani. Uma befunda ngezinye izilimi abangazikhulumi emakhaya kuba nzima kakhulu."Uthe kuningi okuhle okungaphuma uma bonke abafundi bengaqonda abakufundayo uma bephothula uGrade 3. UNksz Gwarube uhlale ekuveza ukuthi akakhathazekile kakhulu ngemiphumela ka-matric, okunalokho ufuna ukuphucula ukufunda emazingeni aphansi.
UBONA sekuntwela ezansi ngecala lokubulawa kommeli ngesihluku umndeni njengoba selibheke eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini.Ummeli, uNkk Thandokuhle Sishi (48) waseMontclair, eThekwini, kuthiwa wagwazwa, wabulawa wumyeni wakhe, oyiphoyisa likaMasipala weTheku, uSenior Constable Qiniso Sishi ngasekupheleni kukaJulayi nonyaka. Umsolwa, owasilaxaza isicelo sakhe sebheyili ngesikhathi esanda kuboshwa ngo-Agasti, ubevele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini ngoMsombuluko. Imantshi ilihlehlisele uNovemba 27 icala, yathi ngalelo langa liyobe selingena eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini.Uma icala selidluliselwa enkantolo enkulu, kusuke sekuphothulwe lonke uphenyo, icala selikulungele ukuqulwa. Udadewabo kamufi, uNksz Khumbuzile Mkhize utshele Isolezwe ukuthi bagculisekile ngokushesha kwecala. "Sijatshuliswa wukuthi seliya enkantolo enkulu. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuhamba kwalo ngokushesha. Sesilinde ukubona-ke ukuthi khona kuzothiwani,” kusho uNksz Mkhize. Uveze ukuthi bakhathazekile kancane ngemiphumela yendodakazi kamufi, okumanje ibhala izivivinyo zika-matric."Yamlimaza kakhulu into yokubulawa kukanina. Yena uyingane ehlakaniphile kodwa sinalo uvalo lokuthi isigameko kungenzeka simthikameze ezifundweni zakhe,” kusho uNksz Mkhize. Uthe yena uyazama ukuqhubeka nokutadisha ngokuzikhandla kodwa ngeke bazi ukuthi ubunzima abhekene nabo bungakanani njengoba ayengacabangi ukuthi kungafika lezi zivivinyo unina engasekho emhlabeni.Uthe uyaqhubeka nokuya kudokotela oweluleka ngokomqondo njalo ngezimpelasonto, yize bengazi ke ukuthi kuzothatha isikhathi esingakanani ukuthi isimo sakhe somqondo sibuyele kwesijwayelekile.Uthe nomsolwa sebeqaphela ukuthi akasabahleki usulu uma evela enkantolo njengoba ayenza phambilini. "Usevele angene abheke phansi, aqonde ebhokisini. Uma esephuma, uphinde enze okufanayo, ayosithela emgodini,” usho kanje.Ngosuku lwesigameko, abashadile babezikhiphe nabangani ngokwehlukana. Kuthiwa umufi wabuya kuqala, walandelwa wumsolwa okuthiwa wafika wamvusa, bahilizisana, maqede wamgwaza, wambulala.Emva kwesigameko kwavela ukuthi umsolwa unelinye icala lokubulala owesifazane endaweni yobumnandi alenza eminyakeni embalwa edlule, okungacaci ukuthi laphelelaphi. Kuthiwa emva kwaleso sigameko umasipala wamphuca isibhamu somsebenzi.
KUGXEKWE abasebenza ngezingane kuleli okungothisha, abahlengikazi, osonhlalakahle nodokoteka, okubekwe ijoka emahlombe abo ukuthi babikele abezomthetho ukuze kuvulwe amacala uma bethola ukuthi kunezingane ezingaphansi kuka-16, ezikhulelwe.Lezi zingane zithathwa njengezidlwenguliwe ikakhulu uma zikhuleliswe ngumuntu omdala kunazo. Nabazali abangabiki uma kukhulelwe izingane ezingaphansi kwale minyaka, abasalanga ngaphandle njengoba abanye kuvele ukuthi abafuni ukubika ngoba basuke befuna ukukhokhelwa.Lokhu kugqame izolo ngesikhathi ikomiti loMnyango wezabesiFazane, iNtsha nabaPhila nokuKhubazeka ePhalamende, lihlangane nezinhlangano ezehlukene ezibhekele izingane kuleli. Bekubhungwa ngendaba yokudlanga kwesihlava sokudlwengulwa kwezingane ezingaphansi kuka-16, nokuthi ingaqiniswa kanjani imigomo ekhona ukuze kuvalelwe abalala nalezi zingane. Lesi sihlava kuthiwa sandile kuleli njengoba nezibalo zeStats SA ziveza nokuthi kukhulelwa inqwaba yezingane ezinye ezineminyaka engu-10.Izinhlangano ezethule umbiko ePhalamende okubalwa i-Commission for Gender Equality (CGE), South African Human Rights Commission (SAHRC), Lifeline PMB, zisho ngazwi linye ukuthi abasebenzi bakahulumeni abasebenza ngezingane, yibona okumele bagxekwe ngokungabikwa kwalezi zehlakalo. Othisha okuyibona abahlala nezingane nsuku zonke, kuthiwa kumele ngabe bayabika uma kunengane engaphansi kuka-16, ekhulelwe esikoleni. Abahlengikazi kuthiwa kumele babike uma sekufika izingane ezincane zizobeletha noma zifuna ukukhipha izisu.USihlalo wekomiti, uNksz Liezl van der Merwe, uthe bazohlanganisa umbiko wesikhashana bese bewuthula ePhalamende ingakapheli le nyanga ngenkinga abayibiza ngokudlwengulwa kwezingane ezingaphansi kuka-16 kuleli.Uthe umbiko abawuthole emphakathini abebenezigcawu nawo eGauteng nase-Eastern Cape, uveze ukuthi kumele kuqiniswe ukubikwa kwamacala afuze lawa uma kukhulelwa izingane."Abanye abakwazi ukubika ngoba besaba imindeni yezisulu kuthiwa bazifaka ezindabeni ezingabafuni. Ezinye izingane ziziphathele amakhaya abekho abadala kanti ezinye zisuke zondliwa abasolwa ngakho ngeke zisayithola imali uma beboshwa." Uthe bafuna kuliwe nalesi sihlava ngoba silimaza izingane ezincane ezigcina zingasasiqedi nesikole. UNksz Naledi Selebano weCGE, uthe abanye abazali abafuni ukuvula amacala okudlwengulwa kwezingane ngoba basuke bezozuza emalini."Kweminye imizi kuyichilo nje ukukhuluma ngezindaba ezithinta ucansi, akuthiwa vu ngalo. Abanye abafundi ababe besabuyela esikoleni beyoqhubeka nezifundo zabo uma sebeke bashiya ngoba beyobeletha," usho kanje. Uthe akumele kugxilwe ezinganeni zamantombazane kushiywe ngaphandle ezabafana.UKhomishana weSAHRC uNomahlubi Khwinana, uthe zonke izingane kumele zivikeleke zingadlwengulwa yingakho kumele kubikwe uma kunezingaphansi kuka-16, ezikhulelwe.Ukhale ngabasebenzi bakahulumeni athe ababiki ekubeni kumele kulandelwe umthetho.ILifeline iveze ukuthi kunomkhuba omusha owenziwa yizingane zabafana ezineminyaka engu-14, ezibuka izinto eziveza ucansi, bese zifuna ukuyokwenza lokhu ebezikubuka ezinganeni ezineminyaka engu-9, ukuze zingakhulelwa.Amalungu ePhalamende athe kumele kufane nomuntu ofika esibhedlela ezolashelwa inxeba lokudutshulwa, ongadedelwa engafikanga amaphoyisa ezophenya ukuthi akathinteki yini ebugebengwini eze edubuleka nje.
BAFUNA kungenelele uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal odabeni lomfundi ka-matric ophazamiseke ezivivinyweni zokuphela konyaka, kulandela ukushiswa ngamanzi abilayo ngomunye obekhwelezela isoka elinguthisha.Umfundi, u-Andiswa Jobe (18) waseSiphondweni High, eJozini, uthwele kanzima esibhedlela saseNgwelezane.Ngokusho kukaninalume, uMnuz Sphiwe Vilane, uphuthunyiswe esibhedlela iManguzi ngoLwesine ekuseni, kulandela isigameko. Uthe ngokubona ubucayi besimo, isibhedlela iManguzi simdlulisele eNgwelezane Elandisa ngesigameko uVilane, uthe umsolwa wamthola kahle umshana wakhe esalele ngezikhathi zasekuseni."Njengoba kubhalwa izivivinyo abafundi bahlala ngaphakathi esikoleni benzela ukuthi kube lula ukuzilungiselela okuthe xaxa, emva kwamahora esikole. Umsolwa nomgilwa bebeyingxenye yalaba bafundi abahlala ngaphakathi njengoba ekwaze ukumhlasela,” kusho uVilane. Uthe bathole ukuthi umsolwa uvuke kuqala, wabilisa amanzi ngeketelo, maqede wabhunyela umgilwa obesalele."Ubemsola ngokuthi uthandana nothisha wakulesi isikole oyisoka lakhe (umsolwa),” kusho uVilane. Uthe bathole ukuthi uthisha okukhulunywa ngaye ubemshela umgilwa, abathandani. Udalule nokuthi emva kwesigameko bathole ukuthi uthisha uwumuntu ozenzela umathanda kubafundi, uthandana nabo, alale nabo, abanye baze bakhulelwe, bese ekhokha inhlawulo emindenini. "Thina sidinwa wukuthi umshana usephazamiseke ezivivinyweni zakhe ezibalulekile njengoba elaliswe esibhedlela. Sifuna ubulungiswa ngalokhu ngoba kuthikameza ikusasa lakhe,” kusho uVilane.Ecacisa uthe kufanele kube khona izinyathelo ezithathelwa umsolwa kanjalo nothisha osolwa ngokucekela phansi ikusasa labafundi ngokuthandana nabo. Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo, uMnuz Mlungisi Mtshali, uthe bebengakabikelwa ngesehlakalo, wathi uzothinta ihhovisi lesifunda ukuze ezwe kabanzi ngaso.Ngokomthetho woMnyango wezeMfundo, uthisha akavumelekile ukuthandana nomfundi.
UYADLONDLOBALA umkhankaso ogqugquzela abesifazane nabomphakathi we-LGBTQI+ ukuthi bagodle amandla abo ngoLwesihlanu, ukuze kuzobonakale ukubaluleka kwabo emphakathini kuphele nokuhlukunyezwa kwabo.Lo mkhankaso uqalwe yinhlangano iWomen for Change elwela amalungelo abesifazane nawezingane. Ezinkundleni zokuxhumana abantu abawesekayo bakhiphe izithombe zabo bafaka umbala obukhwebezane (purple). Phakathi kosaziwayo asebekhombise ukweseka lo mkhankaso kubalwa kubo uZakes Bantwini, umsakazi uSthandwa Nzuza, Sithelo Shozi nabanye abaningi.Izolo emini, iphethishini - efuna ukuthi ukuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nokubulawa kwabo ngenxa yobulili ukuthi kuthathwe njengenhlekelele - ibisisayinwe ngabantu abangaphansi kancane kuka-700 000.Inhlangano ithe eNingizimu Afrika kubulawa abesifazane abalinganiselwa ku-15 ngosuku futhi abangu-117 babika amacala okudlwengula. "NjengeWomen for Change sesibona lesi sihluku usuku nokusuku sibambisana nemindeni ehlukunyezwa ukubulawa kwamalungu ayo futhi sikhulumela nodadewethu abahlukunyezwe kanzima noma badlwengulwa," kusho inhlangano.Ithe sekuyisikhathi sokuthi kubhekwane nalokhu ngoba izigameko eziningi zenziwa ngabantu abagilwa ababaziyo, yathi ifuna ukuthi ukuhlukunyezwa nokubulawa kwabesifazane nezingane kuthathwe njengenhlekelele ukuze kuzokwengezwa izinsiza zikahulumeni. "Uphiko lokushushisa umphakathi kumele njalo luhlale luphikisa izicelo zebheyili emacaleni okuhlukunyezwa ngokocansi kwezingane, ukudlwengula, udlame lwasekhaya, ukuzama ukubulala nokubulala lapho kunobufakazi obanele. Kusemqoka ukugwema abenza bobubi ukuthi baphinde."Inhlangano iqhube yathi kumele abatholwa necala bagwetshwe udilikajele, bangawutholi ushwele, yathi kumele kube nezifundo ezikoleni ezifundisa ngokuhlukunyezwa ngokobulili nezinye izikhalo.Abesifazane abeseka umkhankaso nabe-LGBTQI+ bagqugquzelwe ukuthi bagodle amandla bangayi emsebenzini, ezikoleni bengasebenzi emakhaya nasemiphakathini ngoLwesihlanu, ukukhombisa ukubaluleka kwabo. Bagqugquzelwe ukungasebenzisi mali futhi bagqoke okumnyama.Abangeke bakwazi ukungasebenzi banxuswe ukuthi bashiye phansi konke imizuzu engu-15 kusuka ngo-12 emini ukuhlonipha nokukhumbula abesifazane abangu-15 ababulawa eNingizimu Afrika njalo ngosuku.Oyisishoshovu samalungelo kwiWomen for Change, uMichael Benevolent Masina, ekhuluma kwiSAfm ekuseni, uthe benze ngamabomu ukuthi bakhethe usuku olwandulela ukuqala kwengqungquthela yeG20 ezoba seGoli, ngempelasonto, nokulindeleke ukuthi ithanyelwe ngabaholi bamazwe ahlukene.
KUBHEKWE ukuthi atakule iminyango kahulumeni edonsa kanzima ngasemalininuNgqongqoshe wezeziMali, uMnuz Enoch Godongwana, uma esethula isabelomali esibuyekeziwe ePhalamende ngoLwesithathu.Iminyango okubalwa oweMfundo eyisiSekelo nowezeMpilo, iyona ehlale ikhala ngezinselelo zemali.Umfelandawonye wezinyunyana zabasebenzi, iCosatu, uveze ukuthi ubheke lukhulu esabelweni sikaGodongwana. UMnuz Matthew Parks weCosatu, uthe balindele ukuthi kumenyezelwe izinhlelo ezingeke zigxile ekunqamuleni isabelomali seminyango kahulumeni ngoba ivele idonsa kanzima.Uthe balindele ukuthi isabelomali sikhulume ngezithinta ukukhuliswa komnotho, ukuqinisa iSARS ukuze ikwazi ukuqoqa intela eyenele ezosiza ezweni kanjalo nezinye izinto."Kumele kukhuliswe umnotho njengoba linyuka nezinga labangasebenzi kuleli eseliku-42.9%. Akugxilwe ekulweni nobubha, ubugebengu kanjalo nenkohlakalo edlangile ezweni." Uthe kumele kuvalwe nezikhala ezivulekile zodokotela, abahlengikazi, othisha, amaphoyisa kanjalo nezabanye abasebenzi abenza imisebenzi ebalulekile ezweni."Sifuna kuqiniswe nokusebenza komasipala futhi kuliwe nemikhandlu ehluleka ukukhokhela abasebenzi ngesikhathi. Akuqiniswe ukuhanjiswa kwezidingo emphakathini."Ubalule nokuthi kumele kuqiniswe ukusebenza koPhiko lwezokuShushiswa koMphakathi, ukuze kuliwe nenkohlakalo."Amaphoyisa adinga izinsiza kusebenza okuyizimoto kanjalo nezinye izinto ukuze alwe nobugebengu. Siyajabula ukuthi akukho mali elokhu ifakwa ukutakula izinkampani zikahulumeni eziwayo." UDkt Mark Burke we-DA, uthe balindele ukuthi ingamenyezelwa indaba yokunyuswa kwentela efakwa uma kuthengwa impahla iVAT, intela kubasebenzi ngoba abantu bakhokha kakhulu kumanje. Ike yasusa umsindo i-DA yaze yaya enkantolo ilwa nokunyuswa kwentela. Kwadingeka ukuthi igcine isilaxazwa eyokunyuswa kweVAT ngenxa yokuthi namanye amaqembu ePhalamende ayeyichitha eyokunyuswa kwayo.Uthe bafuna ukubona izinhlelo zokuqeda ngabasebenzi abayizipoki eminyangweni ehlukene kahulumeni."Asilindele isabelomali esingathi shu, ekubeni isimo sezwe singesihle. Sifuna kube nezinhlelo ezizokwenza abantu baphume ebubheni, bathole imisebenzi kuphinde kukhule nomnotho," kusho uBurke. Uhulumeni usemkhankasweni wokonga imali ngokuthi aphenye ngabasebenzi abayizipoki. Okunye ngukugqugquzela abasebenzi asebezothatha umhlalaphansi ukuthi basheshe badede inkundla, bavulele intsha ithuba lokuthi ithole imisebenzi.Lokhu kwenziwa ngokuthi kungabi nemali enkulu yentela ezokhokhwa abasheshe bathathe umhlalaphansi. Ngale ndlela uhulumeni uzama ukuthi wehlise izindleko njengoba kuhlale kukhalwa ngokuthi isabelomali asenele ekubeni ziziningi izidingo zomphakathi.

IYAWAPHIKA amacala ebekwe wona indodakazi yowayengumengameli wezwe, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, uNkk Duduzile Zuma-Sambudla (43).Lokhu kwenzeke kuqala ukuqulwa kwecala eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini izolo.UNkk Zuma-Sambudla ubekwe wuMbuso amacala okubhebhethekisa udlame ngesikhathi somtapo ngo-2021. UMnuz, Jean Roux weForensic Research Lab, wathi imibhalo kaNkk Zuma-Sambudla yayikhombisa ukuthi ukushayela ihlombe ayekubona kwenzeka.Izigameko zokutapa ezitolo zenzeka kakhulu KwaZulu-Natal naseGauteng ngemuva kokuba uyise ekhalelwe ngamasongo kaSigonyela. Uyise ubekhona enkantolo ezomeseka.UMshushisi kuleli cala, u-Advocate Yuri Gangai, uthe leli akusilona icala elijwayelekile kodwa ngelithinta amandla okushiwo ngumuntu. Uthe njengoMbuso bazimisele ngokuveza ngokusobala ukuthi umsolwa wasebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumana ngenhloso yokukhuthaza udlame ezweni. Nebala uMbuso uwavezile amanye amaqoqo ukuthi ayebizwa kanjani. Phakathi kwawo ubale iqoqo elalibizwa nge-EThekwini Shutdown elalinabantu abangu-316 elasungulwa ngoJulayi 8. Elinye iqoqo uMbuso uthe lalibizwa ngokuthi yi-INK Shutdown elalinabantu abangu-84 libunjwe ngabantu baseNanda, Ntuzuma naKwaMashu. Lona lasungulwa ngoJulayi 7. Elinye iqoqo uMbuso okhulume ngalo lalibizwa ngeZuma Coordinators elalinabantu abangu-204 nelasungulwa ngoJulayi 8.Elinye lalibizwa ngokuthi yiZuma Real Activist elalinabantu abangu-334 elasungulwa eGoli.Kusenjalo, abeJacob Zuma Foundation baphumele obala basola inhlese yezepolitiki kuleli cala. Ummeli uSinenhlanhla Mnguni uthe bakholwa wukuthi iStemela & Lubbe kungenzeka ingayabi ngendlela imali kwiBlack Rock.Encwadini ebonwe yi-IOL, uMnguni ucele ukuthi iVodacom ikuqinisekise ukuthi ngabe isikugunyazile yini ukufakwa kwemali kwiStemela & Lubbe futhi yaxwayisa ngokuthii iBlack Rock izimisele ngokuthathela uMakate izinyathelo zomthetho uma imali iphuma engaphendulanga ngezikhalo zayo.Ibeke umnqamulajuqu wangoMsombuluko yathi uma udlula izoya enkantolo iyofuna incwadi evimba ukuthi kuphume imali.
ISUKUNYELWA yizinhlaka ezehlukene eyokukhulelwa kwezingane ezincane ezisafunda isikole kuleli njengoba KwaZulu-Natal kubelethe ezingu-438 ezineminyaka engu-10 kuya ku-14, kusuka ngoJanuwari 1, 2024 kuya kuFebhuwari 28, 2025. Ngesikhathi esifanayo eKZN kubelethe ezingu-24 532 ezineminyaka engu-15 kuya ku-19.Le nkinga yokubeletha kwezingane ezincane, yenze kwahlatshwa ikhwelo lokuthi kuphenywe eyokuthi bangakanani ngokweminyaka abasuke bezikhulelisile njengoba ukukhulelisa ingane engaphansi kuka-16 kuleli kuyicala kanti abenza lokhu bebadala kumele babekwe amacala okudlwengula.UNkk Shontel de Boer we-DA esiShayamthetho sesifundazwe, uzwakalise ukukhathazeka ngokuthi izibalo zakamuva zeStatistics South Africa (Stats SA), ziveza ukuthi esifundazweni kubelethe izingane ezisencane ezineminyaka engu-10 kuya ku-14. "Izingane zinelungelo lokuthi zibe yizingane, zingahlukumezeki. Sinxusa uhulumeni aqinisekise ukuthi zisuke zingadlwengulwanga zonke izingane ezibeletha zisencane ngona sifuna baboshwe abenzi bobubi," usho kanje.Ikomiti elibhekele abesiFazane, iNtsha nabaPhila nokuKhubazeka ePhalamende, limatasa libhunga nezinhlaka ezihlukene okubalwa neminyango kahulumeni, eyokubheka ukuthi kungaliwa kanjani nale nkinga.USihlalo waleli komiti uNksz Liezl van der Merwe, uthe babe nezithangami zomphakathi eGauteng nase-East London, lapho bekubhekwa ngokungenziwa ukuxazulula lesi simo. Uthe okuvelile ezindaweni ezehlukene ngumthelela wokushoda kosonhlalakahle ekwandeni kwalesi sihlava."Baningi osonhlalakahle abaqeqeshiwe kodwa ababhuquza emakhaya ngenxa yokuswela umsebenzi. Okunye okuvelile ngukuthi othisha ababiki uma kunabafundi abancane abakhulelwe ezikoleni," usho kanje ekhuluma neNewzroom Afrika.Uthe kuleli sonto bazoba nezigcawu nezinhlangano ezifaka eyamalungelo abantu, iminyango kahulumeni ehlukene okubalwa noMnyango wezeMfundo eyisiSekelo."Kumele siqhamuke nombiko wesikhashana ngasekupheleni kukaNovemba ngalesi sihlava. Asifuni kube nokujivazeka kwamalungelo ezingane kuleli ngoba ukukhulelisa ingane eneminyaka engaphansi kuka-16 kuleli, kufana nokudlwengula futhi yicala." Ukhale ngokuthi akukho ukubambisana eminyangweni kahulumeni uma kuziwa kule nkinga kodwa izisebenzela ngayodwana.Uveze ukuthi izibhedlela kuleli ziveze ukuthi kwabeletha izingane ezevile ku-180 000 ezineminyaka engu-19 kuya phansi kusuka ngonyaka odlule kuza kulo nyaka. Kulezi ezingu-2 700 ezineminyaka engu-10 kuya ku-14."Sibheka igebe elikhona emthethweni nokuthi sihlulekaphi ukuxazulula inkinga yokuthi kubikwe labo abakhulelisa izingane ezincane. Uma kuvela eyokuthi kuchitshiyelwe umthetho, kuzobe sekulandelwa imigudu efanele ngokwePhalamende."
KUKHONA nomfundi ka-matric kwabane abasolwa ngokugwaza babulale iphoyisa ebelisebenza esiteshini saseCato Manor, eThekwini.Lokhu kuvele ngesikhathi abasolwa bevela eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini, kulandela ukuboshwa.USergeant Mondli Gabisa (39) ugwazwe wafa, isidumbu sakhe satholwa amaphoyisa ngaphandle kwamaflethi akule ndawo. Kubasolwa abavele enkantolo babili besilisa bese kuba ababili besifazane. Ngokulandelana kwabo kusuka kowokuqala, uMnuz Thalenta Griffiths Cele (42), Mnuz Philani Maphila Mhlongo (29), Nksz Minenhle Amahle Cele (20) noNksz Nadia Shezi (25). Ngokwamaphepha asenkantolo mabili amacala ababhekene nawo. Elokuqala, elokubulala uGabisa, okuvele ukuthi libhekene nomsolwa wokuqala kuya kowesithathu. Bese kuba elokushaya unkosikazi kamufi, uNkk Simphiwe Gabisa, okuvele ukuthi libhekene nomsolwa wesithathu nowesine. Ngesikhathi bevela enkantolo, uMshushisi woMbuso, uMnuz Calvin Govender uveze ukuthi umsolwa wesithathu, okunguye omncane kunabo bonke, uboshwe ebhala izivivinyo zika-matric. "Kodwa lukhona uhlelo lokuthi akwazi ukubhala ngaphakathi ejele laseWestville,” kusho uGovender.Emphendulela ummeli wakhe wakwaLegal Aid, uNksz Nonkululeko Ndlovu uthe akunjalo."Abafundi abakwazi ukuhlomula kulolo hlelo yilabo ababoshwa ngaphambi kokuthi kuqale ukubhalwa kwezivivinyo. Ababoshwa sekuqalile ababe besakwazi ukungena ngaphansi kwalolo hlelo,” kucacisa uNksz Ndlovu. Bekunesikhalo sokuthi njengoba eboshiwe u-Amahle, uyasala ezivivinyweni. UGovender uveze ukuthi icala lizoyiswa ehhovisi loMqondisi wezokuShushiswa koMphakathi ukuze licubungule ukuthi likufanele yini ukuyoqulwa eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini.Wengeze ngelithi uma kwenzeka abasolwa befaka isicelo sebheyili, uMbuso uzosiphikisa. Imantshi ilihlehlisile icala ukuze kuqinisekiswe imininingwane yabasolwa uma kwenzeka befaka isicelo sebheyili.Isolezwe lithole ngomthombo wendawo ukuthi umufi owahamba wayohlasela abasolwa emaflethini akule ndawo, esuka endaweni yokucima ukoma."Yiphoyisa elenza okungafanele. Lasuka lapho elalikhona, layohlasela abantu belele. Lazidalela inkinga,” kusho umthombo. Uthe umufi wafika emaflethini sekwedlule u-11 ebusuku, wavusa abantu belele, ebaxakazisa."Wayephethe isibhamu, wasiqhumisa kaningi, kwase kuqala isixakaxaka,” kusho umthombo.Isolezwe libuye lathola ngomunye umthombo ukuthi lokhu kwenzeka emva kokuthi othile obesondelene nomufi ekhombe umsolwa wokuqala wathi "nangu lo mfana owangidlwengula”. Umthombo uthe akubanga khona kuxakazisana ngaleso sikhathi lowesifazane ekhomba umsolwa wokuqala, nokho umsindo wasuka emva kokuthi umufi ekhethe ukuyohlasela kubo kalona wesilisa. "Leso sigameko sokudlwengula kuthiwa senzeka eminyakeni eminingi edlule,” kulandisa umthombo.Uthe akazi ukuthi licala lokudlwengula elalivuliwe laphelelaphi. Echaza umsolwa wokuqala uthe ungowesilisa ozithulelayo, futhi okahle."Sisathukile ukuthi nguye owenze into enje. Kwenzeka lesi sigameko nje, ubeqeda kugqoka izivatho zesonto,” kusho umthombo.
UKUPHAMBANA ngenkulumo okuthiwa akuthathanga sikhathi esingakanani phakathi kowesifazane nephoyisa laseCato Manor, eThekwini, ebelingekho emsebenzi iphethe ngokuphela kwempilo yephoyisa ngoMgqibelo.Kulesi sigameko, okuthiwa senzeke eduze kweshisanyama, KwaZaba, eCato Manor, kugwazwe kwafa uSergeant Mondli Gabisa. Ngokusho komthombo, umufi ubehleli kule ndawo nomkakhe nabanye abangani bezijabulele ngesikhathi kusuka ingxabano phakathi kwakhe nomunye wesifazane. "Lona wesifazane uhambe wayobiza umfowabo njengoba kubo kuseduzane nalapho obekuhleliwe khona. Lona wesilisa ufike ehlome ngommese, wamehlula umufi ngamandla, wamgwaza ephindelela,” kusho umthombo.Uthe kuphele imizuzu elinganiselwa ku-20 umufi esaphefumula, wase eyashona."Umsolwa nodadewabo babanjiwe, baboshwa khona lapho,” kusho umthombo. Udadewabo kamufi, uNksz Mpho Gabisa oseGoli ngokuhlala uthe bawutholile umyalezo ngokubulawa kukamfowabo."Njengamanje silibangise eThekwini ukuyohlangana nezihlobo namaphoyisa ukuze sithole umbiko ogcwele ngokwenzekile,” usho kanje.UGabisa ubulawa nje ubesanda kusinelwa uNkk Simphiwe Gabisa. Kwenzeka lesi sigameko nje, umndeni ubusazikhotha amanxeba ngokudutshulwa kubulawe udadewabo kamufi, uNksz Zizipho "Ntuntu" Gabisa (29) owadutshulwa wafa nomngani, uNksz Anele Mbokazi (30) eKenville, eThekwini, ngo-Agasti nyakenye.Laba ababili babulawa uMnuz Lungani Mthethwa owayebakhiphile kuyiwe ebumnandini. Icala lagcina ligojela uMthethwa yedwa, wanikwa udilikajele, kwathi umngani wakhe, uMnuz Sandile Chili, waphuma ngembobo yenaliti kulandela ukucula enkantolo ngokwenzeka ngosuku lwesigameko. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa aseCato Manor abophe abasolwa ababili ngecala lokubulala iphoyisa lakulesi siteshi ebelingekho emsebenzini."Umufi ugwazwe, wafa emgwaqweni uSPCA Access Road ngoMgqibelo ebusuku,” kusho uNetshiunda. Uthe amaphoyisa abesebenza abeqapha ubugebengu endaweni njengokwejwayelekile ngesikhathi ebikelwa ngowesilisa osegwazwe wafa. "Athe uma efika endaweni yesigameko athola umufi enamanxeba amaningi okugwazwa. Isibhamu sakhe (okungesona esomsebenzi) sitholwe emhlane wakhe singenazinhlamvu,” kusho uNetshiunda. Uthe abasolwa bazovela enkantolo maduze.
KUGQAME eyokungahleleki nokungaxhumani kahle ezinsikeni ezeseke ubukhosi bukaZulu ngesikhathi kugcagcelwa iSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini.Udwendwe lweMbube noNdlunkulu uNomzamo Myeni lukhuphuke kunongabazane ngenxa yokuthi aluzange lumenyezelwe yizinhlaka eziseke isihlalo sobukhosi.Okhulumela iSilo uMntwana uThulani kaGqikazi Zulu, nePhini likaNdunankulu kaZulu, Inkosi Phathisizwe Chiliza, abazange balumemezele lolu dwendwe obelusesigodlweni KwaKhangelamankengane izolo. Udwendwe lwamenyezelwa umkhongi, uMntwana uGibizizwe Zulu.AbaNtwana abaningi okubalwa kubo nabazalwa kanye neNgonyama esigodlweni KwaKhangelamankengane, kanye noNdlunkulu beSilo uGoodwill Zwelithini kaBhekuzulu, bebengabonwa nangokhalo emgcagcweni.Kwaba isimo esifanayo nangoLwesihlanu ngesikhathi iMbube ikhehla uNdlunkulu.UMntwana uGibizizwe uthe uma kukhona abanezikhalo ngamalungiselelo odwendwe bangaxhumana naye, abachazele. "Umgcagco ubuhlelwa abasemsamo. Kuhlukene kabili. Kukhona abasemsamo okufanele ukuthi izindaba zabo bazihlele, basicacisele ukuthi kuzolunga. Njengoba ngangishilo ukuthi uma kukhona abanezikhalo bangangithinta emva kwamasonto amabili, ngibachazele."UMntwana uGibizizwe uwuchaze njengengqophamlando umgcagco weSilo.Okhulumela uNdlunkulu, uMnuz Vuyo Sibiya, uvumile ukuthi bekunezinselelo ngesikhathi kuhlelwa umgcagco.USibiya uthe ngesikhathi kuqhubeka amalungiselelo kube khona abasabalalisa imibhalo engamampunge ethi umgcagco uhlehlile.Uthe okubajabulisayo ukuthi umgcagco ugcine ube yimpumelelo. Oke waba umdidiyeli wamabutho, uMntwana uVanana Zulu, uthe kukhona abaseNdlunkulu abazame ukuphazamisa umgcagco.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma emkhehlweni.IMbube yemukele abasekhweni layo ngenkomo.Ikhuluma esibayeni, ithe kuyijabulisile ukufika kwabasekhweni layo.UZulu walugcina ngo-2014 udwendwe lweMbube, ngesikhathi uMdlokombane egcagcelwa uNdlunkulu uZola Mafu Zulu.Umgcagco wawusenkundleni yezemidlalo oLundi, kwakuphume nesinedolo.Ungoti wezamasiko, uSolwazi Sihawu Ngubane, uthe bekufanele ube mkhulu umgcagco weNdlulamithi yamakhosi njengoba bekungokokuqala ukuba isinelwe selokhu yangena esihlalweni.UNgubane uthe kwakufanele lumenyezelwe kusenesikhathi udwendwe."Mhlawumbe kwenziwa ikhona ukuthi akekho uNdunankulu kaZulu, ingakho kungenziwanga isimemezelo esifanele. Kungenzeka ukuthi abantu baba nesasasa ngoJanuwari, base beyadikibala ngesikhathi seluhlehla." Umgcagco ubuhanjelwe abaholi bezepolitiki abaqavile okubalwa kuzo umholi we-EFF, uMnuz Julius Malema, uNgqongqoshe eHhovisi likaMenangameli, uNkk Sindisiwe Chikunga, uMphathiswa wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, noNdunankulu waseGauteng, uMnuz Panyaza Lesufi.Udwendwe beluphethwe abenkonzo yamaNazaretha. INdlulamithi yamakhosi noNdlunkulu bangamaNazaretha.
UMNYANGO wezeMfundo eyisiSekelo usuqinisekise abafundi nabazali ukuthi amaphepha ka-matric asethwa ngendlela elandela imigomo ebekiwe ohlelweni lokufunda nokufundisa.Umnyango uthe wonke amaphepha asuke equkethe izinto ezifundiwe nezithinta ukuphendula imibuzo edinga isisombululo.Lokhu kuvezwe nguMnuz Terence Khala, wezokuxhumana emnyangweni kulandela izikhalazo zokuthi amaphepha eMathematics abhalwe ezivivinyweni zika-matric, abenzima."Kunezikhalo emphakathini zokuthi iphepha lokuqala nelesibili abhalwe kulo nyaka kwa-matric leMaths, abenzima. Sifisa ukwazisa abafundi nabazali ukuthi amaphepha asethwa kufakwa izinto ezifundiwe," usho kanje. Uthe uma umkhandlu oqinisekisa izingabunjalo lika-matric, Umalusi, usuwenza uhlelo lokubheka zonke izifundo ezibhaliwe ukuthi bezisezingeni elifanele, uyazibheka izinto ezifuze lezi okukhalwa ngazo."Uma kungukuthi bukhona ubuqiniso bokuthi iphepha belinzima kunalokhu obekulindelekile, uhlelo luka-Umalusi luqinisekisa ukuthi akekho umfundi ozoba yisisulu ngenxa yobunzima bephepha. Ngaso sonke isikhathi abafundi babekwa phambili," kusho uKhala.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi wonke amaphepha asebhaliwe, ayacutshungulwa amathimba ongoti emnyangweni kazwelonke.Lokhu kufaka amaphepha abenzima nalawo okuthiwa abelula kanti kuqhathaniswa nalawo abhalwe ngonyaka odlule. UKhala uveze ukuthi azikho izigameko ezinkulu ezibikiwe eziphazamise izivivinyo selokhu ziqalile."Zimbalwa izehlakalo ezibikiwe nakuba sekubhalwe cishe uhhafu wezivivinyo kwa-matric. Kuba nokungenela ngokushesha kuxazululwe izinkinga uma kwenzeka kuqubuka okubonakala sengathi kungaphazamisa izivivinyo." Uthe abafundi abevile ku-920 000 bayaqhubeka nokubhala ezikhungweni ezibalelwa ku-6 800."Abagada uma kubhalwa kanjalo nothisha bazimisele kakhulu ekutheni lezi zivivinyo zibe yimpumelelo kuzona zonke izifundazwe. Sisalokhu sihlabe ikhwelo emiphakathini ukuthi iqinisekise ukungaphazamiseki ukubhalwa kwalezi zivivinyo." Ululeke abafundi ngokuthi baphumule ngokwanele, badle ngendlela baphinde bahlabe ikhefu uma befunda."Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuthi bangazigxishi ngomsebenzi baze bakhathale kanti sebezofika kuMaliyethe. Sinethemba ukuthi lezi zivivinyo zizophothulwa ngaphandle kwezingqinamba."
I-ANC inqabe isicelo sikaNgqongqoshe wezamaPhoyisa osolwa ngokusondelana nemigulukudu, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, sokushenxa ezikhundleni anazo enhlanganweni. I-ANC ithe uMchunu usazoqhubeka nomsebenzi wakhe wangaphakathi enhlanganweni.UMchunu uyilungu lesigungu esiphezulu kwi-ANC, aphinde abe yilungu lekomiti elibhekelele ukusebenza kwansuku zonke enhlanganweni. Igama likaMchunu liphezulu kwikhomishini kanye nasekomitini lasePhalamende eliphenya izinsolo ezenziwa uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi.UMchunu usolwa ngokusondelana nezigebengu eziphazamisa ukusebenza kwengalo yomthetho. Kunezinsolo zokuthi usomabhizinisi obhekene noxhaxha lwamacala, uMnuz Vusumuzi 'Cat' Matlala, uxhasa umkhankaso kaMchunu wokuhola i-ANC.NgoLwesihlanu uMchunu uveze ukuthi wacela ukuthi ashenxe esikhundleni emva kokuba ehlangane nekomiti lezobuqotho kwi-ANC, i-intergrity commission, lapho achaza khona ngezinsolo abhekene nazo. UMchunu uthe isicelo sakhe sachithwa yisigungu esiphezulu kwi-ANC.Okhulumela i-ANC, uNkk Mahlengi Bhengu-Motsiri, uvumile ukuthi basichitha isicelo sikaMchunu sokushenxa.UNkk Bhengu-Motsiri uthe uMchunu wenza isicelo sokuba ashenxe esikhundleni emva kokuba uMengameli, uCyril Ramaphosa, ememezele ukusungulwa kwekhomishini eholwa iJaji Mbuyiseli Madlanga. "Esikuqaphelayo ukuthi uMchunu uyaqhubeka nokubambisana neKhomishini kaMadlanga kanye ne-intergrity commission. Indlela enza ngayo iyahambisana nemigomo ye-ANC yobuqotho kanye nokuhlonipha izinhlaka ezijutshwe ukuba ziphenye. Udaba lukaMchunu sakhuluma ngalo emhlanganweni wesigungu esiphezulu. Savumelana nokuthi aqhubeke nomsebenzi wakhe kwi-ANC yize esashenxile ekubeni ungqongqoshe."UNkk Bhengu-Motsiri uthe ukungashenxi kukaMchunu akuphambene nomgomo othi abaholi abasolwa enkohlakalweni abashenxe ezikhundleni."Njengenhlangano ezibophezele ekuzakheni kabusha kanye nasebuholini obuqotho. Sinomgomo othi abaholi abathweswe amacala kufanele bashenxe ezikhundleni. Abaholi abathweswe amacala bazishenxela bona ezikhundleni, abaphoqwa. I-ANC kuphela enalo mgomo nokukhombisa ngokusobala ukuthi sizimisele kangakanani ukulwa nenkohlakalo." UNkk Bhengu-Motsiri uthe kusengenzeka babuye bajike kulesi sinqumo, bayalele uMchunu ukuba ashenxe."Siyaqhubeka nokuqapha isimo sikaMchunu. Uma kukhona okusha, isigungu esiphezulu sizophinde futhi sibhunge ngodaba. Uma kukhona isidingo siyosibuyekeza isinqumo sethu."Khonamanjalo, iKhomishini kaMadlanga kanye nekomiti lasePhalamende bazoqhubeka nokulalela ubufakazi.Ikomiti lasePhalamende lizopheka ngemibuzo umqondisi wezokushushisa, u-Advocate Shamila Batohi, kusasa.
KUQHUME isililo emagcekeni aseMakhutha Comprehensive High, ngoLwesihlanu ekuseni ngesikhathi uthisha wakulesi sikole eshayisa abafundi ababili.Isolezwe lithole ngomthombo walo ukuthi luthisha elingeke lidalulwe igama lakhe ubesanda kuthola izincwadi zokushayela.Kuvela ukuthi uhlehlele kubona bobabili abafundi omunye wanqamuka umlenze kwathi omunye walimala kanzima ngemuva kokuba yena embhangqe nodonga. Umthombo uqhuba uthi lesi simo siholelele ekutheni kube khona abathile abangothisha abasole uzakwabo ngokuba budedengu ngokushayela enganaki ekubeni azi kahle ukuthi kukhona abafundi egcekeni."Angiyazi leya nto mina eyenzekile. Umuntu wazilimaza emini kwabha izingane zabantu. Isibhicongo lesiya futhi namanje ekuvumi ukuthi ngikholwe ukuthi ngempela yenzekile into efana nalena,'' kuqhuba umthombo.Uqhuba uthi ngemuva kwesigameko uthisha ubedinda isililo angazi nokuthi kumele athatheni ahlanganise nani. Uqhuba uthi uthisha akakholwanga ebona umlenze womfundi usundize wayohlala kwenye indawo.''Ibuhlungu into eyenzeke kulesi sikole,'' kugcizelela umthombo. Uqhuba uthi uthisha ubonakale sengathi uhanjelwa nayingqondo ngemuva kwesigameko. "Ubebonakala nje ukuthi udidekile kakhulu ucabanga nokuthi mhlawumpe ulele uyaphupha kanti kakunjalo ngempela uzilimazile uzingane zabantu,'' usho kanjena.Isolezwe lishayele ucingo uthishanhloko wakulesi sikole, uMnuz Mduduzi Ngidi, limbuza ngalesi sigameko wavuma ukuthi uyazi ngaso kodwa wathi akukho okutheni angakusho ngaso ngoba senzeke kabi engekho yena esikoleni.Isolezwe litholile ukuthi abazali kabaneme nje nhlobo ngalesi sigameko bakhala kakhulu ngokuthi besiyinto ebingagwemeka. Omunye wabazali okhulume neSolezwe wacela ukuba kugodlwe igama lakhe ukhale kakhulu ngalesi sigameko wathi sibi futhi sizodala nokuthi abazali balahlekelwe ukubethemba othisha.''Siyazibuza siyaziphendula nje ukuthi isigameko salolu hlobo senzeke kanjani phambi kothisha bebuka. Uma umfundi ezolimala kabuhlungu kangaka phambi kothisha sizoqhubeka kanjani nokubethembe thina,' 'kubuza umzali egcizelela ukuthi lingadalulwa igama lakhe.Phambilini lesi sikole kuke kwavela ukuthi abafundi bakhona bayakotsheliswa uma kubhalwa izivivinyo zika-matric zokuphela konyaka. Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Muzi Mahlambi uthe batsheliwe ngalesi sigameko ekuseni. Uthe bayadabuka ngokwehlelehlele abafundi. Uthe nothisha usesibhedlela ngenxa yokwethuka.''Uthisha uthuke kakhulu ngalesi sigameko esimehlele. Kumphathe kabi kakhulu ukuthi alimaze kabi abantu ababiza ngokuthi bangamakilayenti akhe,'' úsho kanjena.

BAZOTHI ncinci kamjoli abantu abakhele uMasipala wesifunda iKing Cetshwayo, njengoba iMeya uMnuz Sikhumbuzo Dlamini iveze ukuthi ezinye izindawo ezingaphansi kwabo kuzoshaya uKhisimusi amanzi esephuma.UDlamini ongowokuzalwa eNkandla nowaba yiMeya yokuqala eNkandla, ukusho lokhu enenkulumo ekhethekile neSolezwe Ngempelasonto, njengoba ebehambele emahhovisi aleli phephandaba, ezoxoxa ngohambo lwakhe lokungena kwipolitiki athi lwaqala esawuthisha futhi eyikhansela nokwakuvumelekile eminyakeni edlule.Uthe ngesikhathi bethatha uMasipala njenge-IFP, bazifica izingqinamba eziningi kodwa ngokungena kwabo baqhubeka nezinhlelo iqembu elaliphethe elase lizenzile."Amanzi thina siyazenzela, akukho la siwadonsa khona. Nami ngavumelana nabo ngoba kwezinye izindawo yize amanzi bese siwafakile kodwa bengigcizelela ukuthi ompompi laba abagwedlwayo, bangalinge bakhishwe ngoba bayosiza uma kuqhuma amapayipi," kuchaza yena.Uthe ohlelweni abayolwethula eNkandla ingu-4000 imizi ezokwazi ukuthola amanzi."Siyazi ukuthi abantu bayanda imihla namalanga emiphakathini, nokungagcina kwenza lolu hlelo selunganelisi umphakathi thina esiwuhlinzekele manje. Kodwa uma sakha izindawo zokugcina amanzi siyaqinisekisa ukuthi asenzi isibalo esilingana imizi ekhona siyasinyusa kancane senzele ukwanda kwabantu emakhaya nasemiphakathini esikuyona," kuchaza yena.Uthe kuMasipala waseMthonjaneni naseMfolozi yizona zindawo abasasebenzisa khona amaloli kakhulu ngenxa yezindawo abasematasa ngazo, abasazakha."EMfolozi inkinga yakhona wukuthi amadamu abanawo, ngakho sike sacela ukuthi iJozini isisize kwangenzeka. Udaba lwamaloli khona lusagcwele kakhulu futhi nalo lunezinkinga zalo ezithinta abashayeli bamaloli abangafuni ukusebenza ngendlela esifisa ngayo abanye amanzi bawahambisa emphakathini ngendlela engagculisi," kuchaza yena.Uthe njengoMasipala bamatasa manje balungisa udaba lwabasebenzi abangu-600 abamiswa emsebenzini kungena inkampani uMngeni Water, izosebenza ohlelweni lwabo lwamanzi.Abanye balaba basebenzi uthe sebebuyelile basebenza njengoba sebezibambele emsebenzini wamanzi kungasekho nkampani ebasizayo lokho okuyinto ebibadla imali enkulu.
BAVUBA impi abayibhekise eMnyangweni wezoHwebo neziMboni kuleli, ukuze ufake imigomo eqinile ezolawula ukugembula kuleli.Lokhu kugqame ngesikhathi kunempikiswano ePhalamende, lapho amaqembu ezombusazwe evumelene ngo-elethu, ukuthi kumele kuqiniswe imigomo yezokugembula ngenxa yokucwila kwabantu bakuleli, ogibeni lokugembula.UMnuz Makashule Gana oyilungu lePhalamende elimele iRise Mzansi, okunguye ophakamise ukuthi kubhungwe ngeyokugembula kuleli, uthe isifana nesihlava esihlasele ezweni eyokugembula kwabantu. Uthe abantu sebegembula kwamali abangenayo njengoba abanye besebenzisa isikweletu, abanye besebenzisa nama-overdraft."Sifuna kube nemigomo eqinile ezoshaywa ngumnyango ngendaba yokugembula. Sinamaphuzu esiphusha ngawo lo mkhankaso ngoba abantu bakithi bacwile kule nkinga," usho kanje.Ukhale ngokuthi abantu bakuleli bachithe u-R1.5 trillion ekugembuleni nyakenye.Uveze nokuthi ucwaningo luveza ukuthi nezitshudeni kanjalo nabafundi bangene shi ekugembuleni njengoba sebegembula nemali yeNSFAS, abanye bagembula ngemali yesondlo sabantwana esidume ngeqolo. "Sifuna kuncishiswe izikhangiso ezithinta ukugembula, kunyuswe intela ezinkampanini zokugembula, kutshalwe imali ethe xaxa ezinhlelweni ezigqugquzela abantu ukuthi bagembule ngendlela esemthethweni. Kumele kuqiniswe imigomo, kungavunyelwa ukugembula ngesikweletu, kuvalwe izinkampani ezingenayo imvume yokugembula kuphinde kubekwe neminye imigomo kosaziwayo abasetshenziswa ukukhangisa ukugembula kanjalo nokuxhaswa kwezemidlalo. Lawa ngamanye amaphuzu esiyowaphakamisa emnyangweni ngoNovemba 14, 2025," usho kanje.Uthe bazoqale baye engqungqutheleni ethinta ukugembula lapho beyotshela ezikabhoqo izinkampani zokugembula ngezinto okumele zizenze kuleli, waveza ukuthi lezi zinkampani zichitha enkulu imali zikhangisa ukugembula okwenza ngisho izingane ezincane zihlale zibukana nalezi zikhangiso."Iyakhathaza ukuthi nsuku zonke uthi uvula iselula uzithele ezikhangisweni zokugembula. Ngisho ubuka ithelevishini noma usesikhumulweni sezindiza, yiso leso." UMnuz Visvin Reddy weMK uthe ukhathazekile ngabagembula imali yempesheni ngokuya ema-casino bafike badliwe."Nemali eningi eyenziwa yizinkampani ngokugembula iya kwamanye amazwe, okwenza kucebe abantu bakwamanye amazwe ngosizi lwabakuleli. Siyazigxeka nezikhangiso ezigcwele ngisho ezikhumulweni sezindiza kuleli." UMnuz Sinawo Thambo we-EFF, ugxeke amanye amaqembu asePhalamende axhaswa ngabantu abayingxenye yezinkampani ezigembulayo. Uthe la maqembu agcina esevikela laba baxhasi ngoba ahlomula ngemali kubona.UMnuz Nqabayomzi Kwankwa we-UDM, ugxeke uhulumeni ngokuhluleka ukuvuselela umnotho ukuze abantu bangahlupheki, wathi kunosopolitiki abahlomulayo abangafuni kube nemigomo eqinile. UNkk Nobuntu Hlazo-Webster weBosa, uthe izwe libhekene nesihlava ngakho kumele kunyuswe intela ethinta ukugembula."Kumele kuvalwe izikhangiso ezithinta ukugembula ngaphambi kokuthi kushaye u-10 ebusuku. Asifuni lezi zikhangiso zibonwe yizingane." UMnuz Mzwandile Masina we-ANC, ukhale ngokuthi amanye amaqembu avimba ukuthi kube nezichibiyelo emigomweni ethinta ukugembula.Uthe bayahambisana nokuthi kumele kulawulwe izikhangiso ezithinta ukugembula.
UMPHATHISWA wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal, uNksz Nomagugu Simelane, usekhuze abazali wathi mabayeke ukuvumela izingane ezincane ukuthi ziphuze ngoKhisimusi.UNksz Simelane uzwakalise ukukhathazeka ngokuthi abanye abazali, bayazivumela izingane ukuthi ziphuze ngoba kungamaholidi."Akumele kuvunyelwe ingane eneminyaka engu-14, umfana noma intombazane ukuthi iye emathaveni. Umzali kumele azibuze ukuthi izingane zakhe zikuphi uma sekushaye u-6 ntambama. Akuyekwe nokuthi ngoKhisimusi ingane iyekwe iphuze utshwala," kusho uNksz Simelane. Uthe uma ingane iyekwa iphuze utshwala ngoba kuwuKhisimusi, ifakwa emgudwini okungaziwa ukuthi uyophelelaphi."Abazali akumele bayekele yonke into yenziwe wuhulumeni. Umsebenzi wabo ukuthi bakhulise izingane zabo ngendlela," kuqhuba uNksz Simelane, ngesikhathi ekhuluma ohlelweni lwamasonto onke lomnyango, ezinkundleni zokuxhumana.Usho lokhu nje ngoKhisimusi ezindaweni ezehlukene wandile umkhuba wokubona izingane zihamba ziwumshungu, ezinye ziphuza utshwala. Unxuse abazali ukuthi bazifundise izingane zabo ukuthi zigeze izitsha emva kokudla njalo ntambama.Ubuye wakhuluma nangephilisi elisiza ingane engakwazi ukuhlala izinze, okwaziwa nge-Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD), okuthiwa liyashoda kuleli. Uthe abanayo inkinga yokuphelelwa yimithi esifundazweni."Sibhalelwe nguMnyango kazwelonke wathi leli philisi alikho, ngakho kudingeka ukuthi kuhlanganiswe athile ukuze abantu baqhubeke basizakale. Nangonyaka odlule akhona amaphilisi abeshoda ezingeni likazwelonke kodwa manje asekhona," kuqhuba uNksz Simelane. UNksz Simelane ubuye waveza ukuthi kudingeka uwonke wonke empini yokulwa nokukhulelwa kwezingane.Uthe amaphoyisa kudingeka abe yingxenye yempi, umnyango wezeNhlalakahle nawo uyadingeka ukuze kube nosonhlalakahle."Sinezinhlelo singumnyango zokuthi kunqandwe ukukhulelwa kwezingane. Sinohlelo lokuhlela umndeni olusiza ngokuthi izingane zingakhulelwa. Abanye abazali bayakhala uma sikhuluma ngodaba lokuhlela umndeni, bathi sifuna izingane zabo zizibandakanye nocansi," kusho uNksz Simelane. Uthe badinga nabazali ukuthi babe yingxenye yohlelo lokugqugquzela izingane ukuthi zihlele umndeni ukuze zigweme ukukhulelwa.Ethula umkhankaso wokulwa nokukhulelwa kwezingane esifundazweni ngeledlule, uNdunankulu uMnuz Thami Ntuli, wakhala ngokuthi izingane zikhulelwa zineminyaka engu-12.Wathi abesilisa abalala nezingane ezingaphansi kuka-16,kumele babekwe amacala okudlwengula.Wagxeka nabagijimela ukuyokhokha inhlawulo uma sebekhulelise izingane.
NAMHLANJE sibondwe sashiywa nephini eThekwini njengoba ubumnandi buzobe bubuzwa kuleli dolobha. Yize umcimbi obhekwe ngamehlo abomvu kuyiGcwalisa Spring Picnic: All White, eseKings Park Stadium, kodwa kukhona ne-Africa Is Not A Jungle eBotanic Gardens.Yomibili le micimbi iqala ngo-12 emini. IGcwalisa Spring Picnic: All White igabe ngoKhuzani, Vusi Nova, Nkosazana Daughter, Somizi, DJ Tira, Eemoh, Felix Hlophe, Betusile, AmaLegend (okunguSomnandi, Igeza LakwaMgube noShwi), uMafikizolo, Imithente, Izingane Zoma, Thandeka Radebe, Dkt Buselaphi nabanye.Kwi-Africa Is Not A Jungle kuboshelwe uBlack Coffee, 2wobunnies, Asvnte, Babalwa M, Breetz, Ciza, De Rocka, Dlala Thukzin, Jordan Arts, Man Q, Major League DJz, Oscar Mbo, Stanky Deejay, Tirhani nabanye. NaseMax's Lifestyle eMlazi zizobe ziphenduka njengoba kuneHeineken SA Luxe Experience. Kulo mcimbi kuzobe kunandisa uBabalwa M, Fisto, Siyanda 031,Kai Kai, Famsoul, Leemza RsbudhaDJ noSnake. Omunye wabagqugquzeli beGcwalisa Spring Picnic: All White, uMthokozisi Zuma, uthe konke sekumi ngomumo.Ugquguzele abazohambela lo mcimbi ukuba basheshe bafike bangasindwa yizinyawo ngenxa yokuthi iciko lokuqala lizobhula amazolo ngo-12 emini. Mayelana nesiminyaminya esilindeleke eduze kwenkundla okuzobanjelwa kuyo iGcwalisa njengoba kunomdlalo we-Orlando Pirates neRichards Bay eMoses Mabhida Stadium, uZuma uthe ngeke baphazamiseke abantu abeza kwiGcwalisa."Ezinkundleni zokuxhumana sizomemezela ukuthi basebenzise miphi imigwaqo ukuze bafinyelele kalula enkundleni. Besinomhlangano nezikhulu zamaphoyisa kaMasipala weTheku nawomgwaqo kwavunyelwana ngokuthi amaphoyisa azobe enkanise kuyona yonke imigwaqo esondelene nalezi zinkundla zombili azoqinisekisa ukuthi asikho isiminyaminya," kusho uZuma.Uveze ukuthi amathikithi abangakawatholi asatholakala futhi bangalinge bakhathazeke ngesimo sezulu njengoba kuzobe kushisa.Amathikithi asatholakala eComputicket ngo-R150, R250 no-R1 500 i-VIP.
WENZE isethembiso sokungenelela ngenhloso yokuxazulula uxhaxha lwezinkinga eziyizithiyo embonini yotshwala uNgqongqoshe wokuThuthukiswa koMnotho, ezokuVakasha nezeMvelo KwaZulu-Natal, uMfu Musa Zondi.UZondi ubeyisikhulumi sosuku kwiGala dinner yokuvala unyaka ebihlelwe yinhlangano ebunjwe ngabanikazi bezitolo ezidayisa utshwala, iSisonke Liqour Traders, e-Edward Hotel, eThekwini.UZondi wenze isibophezelo sokuthi uzokwenza konke okusemandleni ngenhloso yokubuyekeza imali emba eqolo ekhokhwa ngabahweba ngotshwala njalo uma kufanele bavuselele izncwadi zokusebenza kwabo.''Lolu daba ngiyathembisa ukuthi sizohlala phansi silubheke ngeso elibanzi bese sithola nekhambi lakhona. Akufanele engabe nikhala ngemali eningi eniyikhiphayo ngalokhu,''usho kanjena.Ukhulume nangengwadla yamabhange amakhulu aye abe madolonzima njalo uma kukhulunywa udaba lokuxhasa ngemali abahweba ngotshwala. ''Abamabhange amakhulu kumele bazi ukuthi likhulu iqhaza elibanjwe yimboni yotshwala ekuthuthukisweni komnotho waKwaZulu-Natal,'' usho kanjena.Okunye uZondi athe ukubona kuyinkinga wukuthi abahwebi botshwala bebala elimnyama kusalukhuni satshe ukuthi ukusebenza kwabo kukapakele nasezindaweni ezisedolobheni. Uthe kuyiphutha ukuthi laba bahwebi baphelela emalokishini kuphela ekubeni bengakwazi ukuthi basebenze nasedolobheni.''Namhlanje ngithanda ukuhlaba lelo khwelo lokuthi asihlangane siyilungise nale nkinga yokuthi ukusebenza kwenu kusamile nje emalokishini. Akumele engabe kunjalo kumele ngabe kukhulunywa indaba yokuthi naphakathi emadolobheni seningenile. Kumele siqale manje sixoxe ngokuthi ningena kanjani emadolobheni,'' usho kanjena.Eqhuba uthe bangalenzi iphutha lokuzibukela phansi ngoba akukho lapho abangeke bekwazi ukuhweba khona. Okunye athembise ukukubheka ngeso elibanzi wudaba lokuthi abahwenbi abansundu izitolo zabo zivalwa kusakhanya ekubeni ezongxiwankulu ziphuza ukuvalwa. ''Akumele kube khona izitolo zotshwala okumele zisheshe zivalwe kunezinye,'' kuchaza yena.Ukhulume nangemithetho eminingi athe idinga ukubuyekezwa nathe igcine seyisetshenziselwa ukuvimba abanye abanentshisekelo yokungena nabo baziphilise kule mboni yotshwala.''Enye inkinga okumele ixazululwe wudaba lokuthi kunenzincwadi zokuhweba ezanikezwa abantu baseNingizimu Afrika kodwa eseziwele ezandleni zabokufika. Lokhu kumele kubhekwane nakho nje ngqo,'' usho kanjena.Usike elijikayo ekhuluma ngenkinga yamazambane abolile adayisa ngotshwala obungagunyaziwe.USihlalo wale nhlangano uMnuz Brush Mncadi uthe bayajabula kakhulu ngokwesekwa wuNgqongqoshe. Ukuvumile ukuthi ziningi izinselelo ababhekene nazo kule mboni.Uthe kodwa kulokoza inhlansi yethemba uma bethola ukwesekwa abakudingayo. Ugcizelele kakhulu ukuthi okuseqhulwini kubona wukuqinisekisa ukuthi le mboni ibonakala idlondlobala minyaka yonke.''Abantu kumele bayihloniphe le mboni bazi ukuthi ineqhaza elikhulu kangakanani ekuthuthukisweni komphakathi ngezindlela ezahlukene,'' kusho uMncadi.
LUSELUDE ukhalo ngempi yokuqedwa inkinga yemilutha yewunga enkabeni yeTheku. Lokhu kuza emva kokuvimbanisa kwayo emgwaqweni uChe Guevara - owawaziwa ngoMoore Road - ngemijondolo kaseyili noplastiki.Sekuphele amasonto amathathu le milutha elinganiselwa ku-200 edle owodwa wemizila yalo mgwaqo. Kuwona yakhe imijondolo, ethikameza abashayeli bezimoto, abaphoqeleke ukuthi basebenzise eminye. Phakathi kokunye okuthikameza abashayeli abasuke bezojoyina lo mgwaqo besuka emgwaqweni u-M4, ukuthi eminye yale milutha inkanisa ngaserobhothini, nokwenza kube nzima ukuthi abashayeli bamele irobhothi uma livaliwe ngenxa yovalo lokushaywa kwamawindi ezimoto, bese bebanjwa inkunzi. Okhulumela amaphoyisa kaMasipala weTheku, uColonel Boysie Zungu, uthe njengoba selulethiwe ezindlebeni zabo udaba lokuvalwa komgwaqo, bazalusukumela."Sizotshala amaphoyisa ukuthi abhekane nabo,” kusho uZungu. Nokho ukhale ngenkinga yokuthi amaphara bahlale bewasusa ngapha, avumbuke ngapha."Sisuka kude nawo. Uzokhumbula ukuthi ake aba se-Albert Park, ku-M4. Uwajaha ngapha, bahlakazeke bahambe, ngakusasa bahlangane kwenye indawo,” kusho uZungu.Uthe umasipala uphezu kwayo imizamo yesixazululo sesikhathi eside. "Umasipala wayithola indawo ngapha eningizimu yeTheku, kumanje kuyaqhubeka ukwakha kuleyo ndawo. Siyacabanga ukuthi uma sekuphothuliwe ukwakhiwa kwaleso sakhiwo siyobe sesikhona isisombululo,” usho kanje.Ubalule ukuthi inkinga yamaphara idinga ukubambisana kwezinhlaka ezehlukene okukhona khona imindeni lapho kuvela khona laba bantu abagcina behlala emgwaqweni, uMnyango wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi nezinye. Maphakathi nalo nyaka, Isolezwe like labhala udaba ngesikhungo sokugcina imilutha yewunga esakhiwayo eLower Ilovu, ngaseManzimtoti. Nokho udaba lwakhona lwalumayelana nokuthi umphakathi wakule ndawo wawubhikisha, uthi awukufuni ukwakhiwa kwalesi sikhungo endaweni yawo. Wawukhala ngokuthi kuzonyuka izinga lobugebengu endaweni uma imilutha yewunga izogcinwa endaweni yawo. Ngokombiko kamasipala, le ndawo kwathiwa izoba nemibhede ebalelwa ku-450.
Kufe amadoda amabili okuhlanganisa nephoyisa esigamekweni okusolwa kuso ingxabano eBlue Lagoon, eThekwini ngezithuba zabo-02:30 ekuseni ngoMgqibelo ekuseni.Abezimo eziphuthumayo ngaphansi kwenkampani i-ALS baphuthume endaweni yesehlo bethola umbiko ngokulimala kwabantu ngasePublic Pools, ngaseBlue Lagoon.Abezimo eziphuthumayo bafike endaweni yesigameko bathola amaphoyisa akwa-SAPS namaphoyisa kaMasipala asevele ekhona base bakhonjwa ngokushesha lapho kutholwe khona amadoda amabili, okuthe Uma kuhlolwa isimo sawo atholakala enamanxeba amaningi okudutshulwa emzimbeni. Owesilisa oyedwa okukholakala ukuthi useminyakeni engamashumi amathathu ubudala akakhombisanga zimpawu zokuthi uyaphila. Owesibili wesilisa okukholakala ukuthi uyiphoyisa likaMasipala naye oneminyaka engamashumi amathathu ubudala utholwe esesimweni esibucayi. Abe-Advanced Life Support Paramedics bazamile ukuhlenga impilo yakhe endaweni yesigameko ngaphambi kokumphuthumisa esibhedlela esiseduze. Ngeshwa ngemuva kwesikhashana efikile esibhedlela umelwe yinhliziyo washonela khona lapho.Okwamanje izehlakalo eziholela kulesi sehlo azikaziwa nokho abeSAPS namaphoyisa kaMasipala abekhona ukuphenya kabanzi.
LIYAFILIZA ikusasa lomholi weMK ePhalamende, uDkt John Hlophe, omiselwe ukwenza izinguquko ebuholini beqembu ePhalamende. Isikhuni sibuyele ngomkhwezeli kuHlophe ngesikhathi emiselwa ukudiliza uSotswebhu oMkhulu weqembu ePhalamende, uNkk Colleen Makhubele. UNkk Makhubele ususwe esikhundleni ngoLwesibili, kwabe sekuqokwa uMnuz Des Van Rooyen ukuba abambe lesi sikhundla esishisayo.Kushintshe ukudla epuletini ngoLwesithathu, ngesikhathi umholi weMK, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, enquma ukumisa uHlophe.UZuma uthe uHlophe, ophinde abe yiphini lomholi weMK, akabonisananga namuntu osebuholini beMK ngaphambi kokuthi athathe isinqumo sokudiliza uNkk Makhubele. UNkk Makhubele udilizwe uZuma engekho kuleli eseBurkina Faso. Ekubuyeni kwakhe uZuma akazange esahlala ngisho phansi, uvele wabiza umhlangano wobuholi beMK ukuzobabaza eyokuxoshwa kukaNkk Makhubele. Inhloko yehhovisi likaZuma, uMnuz Magasela Mzobe, ithe uZuma unqume ukumisa uHlophe kuzona zombili izikhundla. "Uzomiswa kuze kube kuphothulwa uphenyo ngokuziphatha kwakhe. Inhloso lapha ukuthumela umyalezo oqinile. Amalungu eMK kufanele azi ukuthi akekho umholi onelungelo lokuzithathela izinqumo, kuyaboniswana. Ubuholi beMK bubumbene futhi buyayihlonipha imigomo yeqembu."UMzobe uphinde waveza ukuhoxiswa kwesinqumo sokudilizwa kukaNkk Makhubele kanye nesokuqokwa kukaVan Rooyen. Ayiqali ukumehlela uVan Rooyen lena yokuhlala esikhundleni isikhathi esincane .Ngesikhathi uZuma esewumengameli, wake wasuswa esikhundleni sokuba ungqongqoshe wezeziMali emva kwezinsuku ezine eqokiwe.UNkk Makhubele wayekade eqokwe nguyena uHlophe ngoJuni. Ngesikhathi eqokwa uNkk Makhubele, uHlophe wathi kukhala isicathulo sakhe kwiMK ePhalamende. UHlophe wathi nguyena othatha izinqumo, wathi uZuma uyamazisa nje uma esezithathile izinqumo. Kumiswa uHlophe nje, bekuvele kunemibuzo ngekusasa lakhe kulandela ukuqokwa kukaMnuz Tony Yengeni, njengephini lesibili lomholi weMK. UYengeni uqokwe ngenyanga eyedlule, isikhundla aqokelwe kusona sisha kwiMK.Ukuqokwa kwakhe kushiye abanye bezibuza ukuthi ngabe uHlophe usendleleni ephumayo yini kuleli qembu?
OWAYEYISILOMO soKhozi FM, uSbu Buthelezi, uthe umatasatasa ulungiselela uhlelo olusha azolusakaza khona maduze. Ekhuluma ekhasini lakhe likaFacebook, uSbu (52) waseNquthu uthe lolu hlelo luzobe luyingxenye yohlelo alubiza ngeThe Return.Kulolu hlelo uthe kukhona iThe Return Musical, iThe Return Spoken Word neThe Return Business Expo. Uthe uhlelo azobe esakaza kulo lungaphansi kweThe Return Spoken Word. USbu uthe okwamanje akazosho ukuthi lolu hlelo luzobe lusakazwa kuphi, yini engalindelwa kulo nokuthi luzoqala nini.Akukhe phezulu wukuthi kulolu hlelo kuzozwakala abanye abethuli bezinkulumo ezakhayo abakhethekile ngenhloso yokukhuthaza umphakathi wasezindaweni abazozihambela. Ngaphansi kweThe Return Musical, uSbu uthe uzobe ecija amaciko abambe iqhaza emkhakheni womculo wokholo."Eminyakeni ewu-16 yokusakaza kwami, bengisakaza izinhlelo zomculo wokholo kusukela ngiqala kwiGagasi FM ngo-2007. Ngajoyina Ukhozi ngo-2008 kwaze kwafika isikhathi sokushiya kuKhozi. Yonke iminyaka yami yokusakaza bengenza umculo. Ngicabanga ukuthi ngenxa yolwazi, amava nokuqonda kwami umkhakha womculo, ngibone ngingasiza kakhulu abaculi bowokholo nophrojusa bomculo wokholo..."Uthe iThe Return Musical izobe igxile kulokho. Eqhuba uSbu uthe ngeThe Return Business Expo uzobe ehambela umphakathi esiza osomabhizinisi abasacathula ukuze bakwazi ukukhangisa ngemikhiqizo yabo. Akukhona okokuqala uSbu ememezela izinhlelo azoqhamuka nazo.NgoSepthemba nyakenye wamemezela ukuthi uzosungula isiteshi somsakazo esizosakaza ngezokuxhumana namaYouTube Channels, iListen To My Story nebizwa ngo-Uhambo Podcast. Wabuye wathi uzoshicilela incwadi esihloko sithi The Greatest Version of Me:My Last 60 Days vs My Last 14 Years on Ukhozi FM.Kuze kube yimanje ubengakasho lutho ngalezi zinhlelo. USbu wakhonjwa indlela oKhozini ngo-2022 ngenxa yabantu ababekhala ngokuthi wabawaka izizumbulu zemali. Abanye baze bambika kwiSkebhe sangakubo eNquthu, 'esathi ukuxoxaxoxa naye.'Ngo-2009 wake wadutshulwa amahlandla ayisithupha eMgungundlovu kodwa yagcina ingazekanga imbangela yokudutshulwa kwakhe.
BABHADANYWE nempahla yesikole eyebiwe abasolwa abane, abaphakathi kweminyaka engu-17 no-19, ababoshelwe icala lokugqekeza nokushisa isikole iMpolweni Secondary.Laba basolwa babanjwe nezinto okubalwa isitembu sesikole, amaketelo kanjalo nezinye izinto ezibalulekile zakulesi sikole.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe abasolwa abane baboshiwe ngesehlakalo sokugqekeza amakilasi amane akulesi sikole. Uthe bashise namahhovisi amabili esehlakalweni esenzeke ngoLwesithathu."Babekwe amacala okucekela phansi impahla nokugqekeza. Kulindeleke ukuthi bavele enkantolo yaseNew Hanover maduzane," usho kanje. UMphathiswa wezeMfundo eKZN, uMnuz Sipho Homuka, ukwamukele ukuboshwa kwabasolwa. Uthe sibashaqisile isenzo sokushisa isikole nomonakalo odalekile."Babanjwe nempahla yesikole okubalwa nesitembu sesikole kanjalo nezinye izinto. Sibonga ukusukumela phezulu kwabezomthetho ukubamba abenzi bobubi." Uncome ukubambisana komphakathi namaphoyisa wathi kuthele izithelo ezinhle."Izikole yizikhungo okumele siqhubeke nokuzivikela. Akungavunyelwa izigebengu zicekele phansi ikusasa lezingane. Siyaqhubeka nokubambisana nezinhlaka zokuphepha ukuze ukufunda nokufundisa kungaphazamiseki." Uthe ukuboshwa kwabasolwa kuthumela umyalezo wokuthi abeba baphinde bacekele phansi impahla kahulumeni, bazobhekana nengalo yomthetho.UNksz Hlengiwe Mavimbela, ibamba likaSihlalo wekomiti lezeMfundo esiShayamthetho, uthe ushaqekile ngokuthungelwa kwesikole.Uthe bafuna babhekane nengalo yomthetho abasolwa ngokwenzekile."Sizolinda umbiko ogcwele ovela esifundeni uMgungundlovu ngokwenzekile. Sifuna umthetho usebenze."
UMNYANGO weMfundo eyisiSekelo usuchithe imibiko engamampunge esabalele yokuhi kudingeka kukhokhwe imali ohlelweni lokuhlonza abasebenzi abayizipoki.Lo mnyango usemkhankasweni wokuthola othisha abayizipoki ukuze kwehliswe umthwalo wemali ekhokhelwa abasebenzi. Akuhlonzwa kuphela abasebenzi ikakhulu othisha, kodwa nabafundi.UMnuz Terence Khala wezokuxhumana emnyangweni, uthe kunemiyalezo esabalele eveza ukuthi othisha kudingeka bakhokhe u-R350, ukuze babhekwe ngaphansi kwalolu hlelo. Uthe le mibiko ayilona iqiniso wathi ihlose ukudukisa abantu."Ihlose nokuqola abasebenzi abanganakile ikakhulu othisha. Sifuna ukulibeka ngembaba elokuthi akukhokhwa nhlobo ukuze kubhekwe ukuthi uqashwe ngokusemthethweni emnyangweni." Uthe uhlelo lokuhlonza abasebenzi lwenziwa ukuze kubhekwe ukuthi kukhokhelwa abantu abafanele yini."Abafuna imali kumele babikwe ngokushesha ukuze baboshwe. Uhlelo lokuhlonza abasebenzi lwenziwa ezifundazweni." Uthe basebenzisana nezinhlaka ezehlukene ukuzama ukuthola abafafaza izinto ezingelona iqiniso."Sinxusa nomphakathi ukuthi uqale uyibheke into oyisabalalisayo ngoba kungenzeka ukuthi ayilona iqiniso. Asifuni baphazamiseke abasebenzi emsebenzini abawenzayo wesizwe." Khonamanjalo uKhala ubuye wachitha nendaba yokuthi kuzolulwa isikhathi sokusebenza kwabasizi bothisha ezikoleni zakuleli. Uthe izinkontileka zabasizi ziphela ekupheleni kwale nyanga."Asikho isinqumo esithathiwe sokuthi kululwe izinkontileka zabasizi bothisha ezikoleni. Izinkontileka zabo ziphela ekupheleni kukaNovemba," usho kanje.Ubonge umsebenzi omuhle owenziwa abasizi nsuku zonke ezikoleni."Basize ngokwehlisa umthwalo kothisha, banika nabafundi ulwazi oluthe thuthu. Sibonga asiphezi ngomsebenzi wabo." PHEZU kokuba ubuholi beSACP kuzwelonke sebuveze kwabezindaba ukuthi sebuhlakaze ubuholi baKwaZulu-Natal ngenhloso yokubuqinisa, kodwa abaholi bakulesi sifundazwe bathi akukho abasakutholile okuvela ekomkhulu okukhomba ukuthi sebuhlakaziwe.Lokhu kushiwo ngobengunobhala weSACP esifundazweni, uMnuz Themba Mthembu, othe kusanezingxoxo eziqhubekayo.Usho lokhu nje uDkt Alex Mashilo, ilungu leCentral Committee yeSACP, utshele abezindaba bethelevishini kwaSABC, ukuthi babuhlakazile ubuholi baseKZN. Uthe umhlangano wesigungu esiphezulu esithatha izinqumo kwiSACP, iPolitburo, unqume ukuthi buhlakazwe ubuholi.Uveze ukuthi kulo mhlangano baxoxe nangezinye izinto ezehlukene ezithinta umnotho, ezombusazwe kanjalo nezithinta le nhlangano."Sibone ukuthi kukhona lapho kuntenga khona ebuholini baseKZN, kwase kunqunywa ukuthi buhlakazwe ubuholi ukuze buqiniswe. Kuthathwe lesi sinqumo ngemuva kokubheka ukuthi kungaqiniswa kuphi enhlanganweni okuyinto eyenzeka kuzona zonke izifundazwe," kusho uMashilo. Uthe yingakho bebone ukuthi kumele babuhlakaze ubuholi baseMoses Mabhida (okuyiKZN)."Sinezinhlelo ezikhona njengoba kulungiselelwa iProvincial General Council nengqungquthela yesifundazwe," kusho uMashilo.UMthembu utshele Isolezwe ukuthi bazobiza isithangami nabezindaba maduzane, lapho bezokhuluma kabanzi khona. Kuke kwavela imibiko yokuthi ubuholi baseKZN beSACP buhlakazwe ngoba kuthiwa bushaya amakhala ngesinqumo sokuthi kulaxazwe i-ANC okhethweni, njengoba iSACP izolungenela ngokuzimela.Selokhu le nhlangano yamemezela eyokungenela ukhetho ngokuzimela, kunokubhekana ngeziqu zamehlo njengoba amanye amalungu eSACP ekhala ngokukhishwa inyumbazane amalungu e-ANC.Ekhuluma ngesikhathi kwethulwa umkhankaso i-Red October eNorth West ngeSonto, uNobhala jikelele weSACP, uMnuz Solly Mapaila, uthe abajiki futhi bayaqhubeka nokungenela ukhetho ngokuzimela. UMapaila ucacise ukuthi lesi sinqumo akusona esakhe kodwa esenhlangano.Uveze nokuthi akekho umholi weSACP ongaguqula isinqumo ngaphandle kwengqungquthela ezoba ngo-2027.ISACP yanquma ukuphuma ibhodwe layo ikhala ngokuthi kuze kube yimanje ayibuyekeziwe eyamandlelandawonye ahlanganisa ne-ANC.Yaphinde yakhala nangokuthi ayizange ifakwe ezingxoxweni ngesikhathi i-ANC inquma ukuthi kube nohulumeni wokubambisana kwamaqembu iGNU, emuva kokubhacaza okhethweni njengoba ingayizwa eyokusebenzisana ne-DA. UNobhala jikelele we-ANC uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, wathi kuzocaca kungakapheli unyaka ukuthi bazokwenzenjani ngeSACP ezongenela ukhetho ngokuzimela.UMbalula lapho ehlala ekhuluma khona uyakuveza ukuthi i-SACP ayinamandla okuwina ukhetho njengoba ngisho okhethweni lokuchibiyela ingatholi amavoti amaningi.Okunye ahlale ekuveza ngukuthi yize kunjalo kodwa bayayidinga ikakhulu ngalesi sikhathi esinzima behlelwa wukwesekwa.
UMENGAMELI Cyril Ramaphosa usekhombe ngenjumbane abaqashi abaqasha abantu bokufika abangenawo amaphepha afanele okuba kuleli, wathi abawuyeke lo mkhuba.Uthe abantu bakuleli bacasukile ngalesi senzo ngoba bakholwa ngukuthi yibona okumele ngabe benza le misebenzi."Siyabaxwayisa abaqashi ukuthi balandele umthetho, bayeke ukuqasha abantu abangenawo amaphepha afanele. Hhayi ngoba silwa nabantu bokufika kodwa sifuna babe kuleli ngokusemthethweni. Abantu bakuleli abakwazi ukumane baye kwamanye amazwe bayofuna imisebenzi bengenazo izimvume zokuba kulelo lizwe," usho kanje. Uthe abaqashi abenza lokhu bangazibona beboshwa noma bakhokhe inhlawulo."Abantu bakuleli bacasuka bebona engozini yebhasi okwashona abantu ababeya eMalawi, kugcwele imithi abayithatha kuleli beya kwamanye amazwe. Abantu bokufika abangenawo amaphepha banciphisa izinsiza zezwe," kusho uRamaphosa ephendula imibuzo ePhalamende.Uhlabe ikhwelo lokuthi mabangahlaselwa abantu bokufika kuleli ngoba ikhona imikhankaso yokulwa nokufohla kwabo futhi babuyiselwa emazweni abo. Uveze nokuthi kuzothulwa umkhankaso wokulwa nesihlava sezimpi zamagenge ezigcina ngokuthi kufe inqwaba yabantu okuyinto ekhathaza kakhulu uhulumeni.Uthe bakhathazekile ngale nkinga yamagenge wathi uhlelo abeza nalo luhlose ukuqeda ngayo."Amaphoyisa amatasa akha uhlelo lokulwa nale nkinga yamagenge. Sikhathazekile ngezifundazwe okudlange kuzona le nkinga okuyiseWestern Cape, Eastern Cape, Gauteng naKwaZulu-Natal," kusho uRamaphosa. Uthe ngeke bazishiye ngaphandle nezinye izifundazwe kodwa bazogxila kwazibalile ngoba inkinga yokufunwa ngodli imali kosomabhizinisi okwenziwa amagenge ezigebengu, idlange kakhulu kulezi zifundazwe."Sizosebenzisa nobuchwepheshe ukulwa nale nkinga. Amanye amazwe alwe nale nkinga ngempumelelo, nathi sihlose ukusiqeda lesi sihlava. Sinxusa ukuthi kube nokubambisana ukuze abantu baphephe." Uthe amaphoyisa awakwazi ukulwa le mpi ewodwa."Kwesinye isikhathi silindela ukuthi amaphoyisa enze imilingo. Muningi umsebenzi osezandleni zawo ekubeni umphakathi usuke wazi ngobugebengu obenzekayo lapho uhlala khona," kusho uRamaphosa. Uthe basemkhankasweni wokuvala izikhala ezivulekile eziteshini zamaphoyisa."Sihlose ukwandisa amaphoyisa azolwa nobugebengu, hhayi azohlala emahhovisi. Kuke kwaba nesikhalo ngokuthi mancane amaphoyisa ekubeni sanda isibalo sabantu."
UMBUSO ushubisele inkosi ebhekene noxhaxha lwamacala okubulala, uSimphiwe Erick Zuma. UMbuso ufake isicelo sokuba kuhoxiswe ibheyili ka-R25 000 eyanikezwa uZuma ecaleni lokusoconga owayengundunankulu wesizwe sakwaNxamalala, uMnuz Qalokunye Zuma. Lesi sicelo besilalelwe eNkantolo yeMantshi eHowick izolo. Umshushisi, uMnuz Zokwakha Nzama, uthe uZuma waphula imibandela yebheyili. UNzama uthe uZuma waxhumana izikhawu eziningi nofakazi woMbuso, uMnuz Khulekani Buthelezi. UNzama uthe ubufakazi bokuxhumana kukaZuma noButhelezi babuthola kumakhalekhukhwini owashaqwa kuZuma ngesikhathi esejele. "Ngesikhathi uZuma esejele sathola ukuthi uneselula ayisebenzisayo. Sabikela izikhulu zejele. Ngesikhathi kupeqululwa ejele, watholakala ngempela umakhalekhukhwini. Ulwazi esaluthola kule selula lukhombisa ukuxhumana kukaZuma noButhelezi. Babexhumana kakhulu ngeWhatsApp. Uyiphulile imibandela yebheyili futhi naye akaphiki ukuthi waxhumana nofakazi woMbuso."Ummeli kaZuma, u-Advocate Mduduzi Nkomo, uthe uZuma wayengazi ukuthi uButhelezi uwufakazi woMbuso. UNkomo uthe uZuma noButhelezi babengakhulumi ngezinto ezithinta icala."UButhelezi uyinduna, uphinde futhi agade ukusebenza kwamatekisi kaZuma. Izinto abasuke bezixoxa zithinta umkhandlu wenkosi kanye namatekisi. UButhelezi uyena owafonela kuqala uZuma. Uyena futhi owafika wazomvakashela ejele. Nalapha enkantolo uyafika ezokweseka uZuma. UButhelezi wathi akazi ukuthi yena uwufakazi woMbuso."UNkomo usole uMbuso ngokubambelela ngezidindi, wawusola ngokucasulwa wukuthi uZuma wanikwa ibheyili."Emva kokuba enikwe ibheyili uMbuso wenza izinsolo zokuthi wagwazela imantshi. Kuze kube namhlanje ayikaze iboshwe imantshi eyamnika ibheyili, nomuntu okuthiwa wagwazela imantshi akakaze aboshwe. UMbuso waphinde wenza izinsolo zokuthi uZuma wazama ukwakha itulo lokusoconga umuntu. Namhlanje uMbuso awusasho lutho ngalokhu ngoba awunabo ubufakazi bento owawuyisho."Isinqumo sizokhishwa ngoNovemba 20. UZuma uvele utholoza ezikhindini ngenxa yokuthi wanqatshelwa ibheyili ecaleni lokubulala owayeyikhansela leDA kuMasipala waseMngeni, uMnuz Nhlalayenza Ndlovu.UZuma usafake isicelo lapho ephonsela khona inselelo ukunqatshelwa ibheyili.Uphinde abhekane necala lokubulala owayelwa nokudayiswa komhlaba womasipala, uMnuz Xolani Ntombela/Ndlovu.
INGODUSO yeSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini, uNksz Nomzamo Myeni, icele uZulu ukuba uphelele wonke uzozibonela kukhuphuka udwendwe lwayo neMbube.UNksz Myeni uqinisekise ukuthi udwendwe luzosinela esigodlweni kwaKhangelamankengane, ngeSonto. Kuke kwaba nokudideka njengoba ihhovisi leSilo belilokhu lithi alazi lutho ngomgcagco.Isimemezelo somgcagco senziwa umkhongi omkhulu, uMntwana uGibizizwe Zulu, kepha okhulumela iSilo, uMntwana uThulani kaGqikazi Zulu, wathi akazi lutho ngodwendwe.Izolo, uNksz Myeni uthe luzoqhubeka udwendwe njengoba kwamemezela uMntwana uGibizizwe. Ukusho lokhu esitatimendeni esikhishwe inhlangano yakhe engenzi nzuzo, iSizowakha okaZulu Foundation. "Ngithi angichaze kancane nge-video kaMntwana uGibizizwe onguyise weNgonyama, noMntwana uMenzi, lapho bekhuluma khona ngodwendwe. Ngithi angikuqinisekise ukuthi uMntwana uGibizizwe wayegunyaziwe ukuba amemezele udwendwe. Lesi isimemo kuwo wonke uZulu ukuba uzozibonela umgcagco weSilo."Kuzoqala kube nomkhehlo namhlanje, eJozini Stadium. UNksz Myeni uthe kuzokube kukuhle kudelile kule micimbi."UZulu uyanxuswa ukuba uzozibonela lo mgcagco oyinqophamlando njengokwesimemezelo sikaMntwana uGibizizwe, owagunyazwa iNdlunkulu kaZulu ukuba enze isimemezelo."Ihhovisi leSilo alikaze liwumemezele umgcagco. Umgcagco kaNksz Myeni kwakufanele ube ngasekuqaleni kwalo nyaka kodwa wabuye wabhuntsha.Ngesikhathi ubhuntsha kwavela incwadi eyayiyalela ukuba kuhoxiswe imihlumulo etholwa uNksz Myeni kuhulumeni. UNksz Myeni ungowesithathu eSilweni, ababili abangaphambi kwakhe kabasinile. IMbube iganwe uNkk Ntokozo Mayisela Zulu ozinze KwaNkomonye.ISilo nokaMayisela babopha ifindo likasofa silahlane enkantolo ngo-2021, nokwalandelwa ukuthi bese iSilo sizishaye zonke siphinde simbese abesekhweni laso eNewcastle.Kuze kube namhlanje uNdlunkulu uKaMayisela akakaze agcagce.ISilo siganwe uNksz Nozizwe Mulela, oyisikhulu sebhange eSwatini.UNksz Mulela ubekwe esigodlweni okuzalwa kuso iSilo, KwaKhangelamankengane. Yena walotsholwa ngo-2022, akakaze asine.Emva kwaMaMyeni, kukhona uNksz Sihle Mdhluli wasesigodlweni eMashobeni. UNksz Mdhluli uzalwa ebukhosini bakwaNdwandwe, eMpumalanga.IMbube yathumela abakhongi kuwo lo nyaka yaphinde yathembisa uNksz Mdhluli ngesikhathi kunoMkhosi woMhlanga waseSwatini.
UMASIPALA weTheku ubhekene nengwadla ngenxa yamakhansela nabasebenzi bawo abakweleta imali elinganiselwa ku-R80.9 million wezindleko zabo zanyanga zonke okubalwa ugesi, izindawo abahlala kuzona, amanzi nokunye.Lokho kuvele embikweni wangoSepthemba, osanda kwethulwa emhlanganweni womkhandlu, lapho ikomiti lezezimali eThekwini, lidalule ukuthi isikweletu sesisonke siwu-R41 billion, okusho ukuthi senyuke ngo-R3.5 billion uma uqhathanisa nombiko wangoSepthemba, wanyakanye.Lo mbiko uveze ukuthi isikweleti samanzi sithathe u-40% wemali ekweletwayo, kuthi izindleko zama-rates nezikagesi zona zathatha u-24% no-15% ngokwehlukana kwazo.Umasipala udalule ukuthi lezi zikweleti zeyamene nenkinga yobubha, indlala yamathuba omsebenzi, ukungangeni ngesikhathi esifanele kwezinkokhelo ezivela kuhulumeni nokungabi bikho kohlelo lokusebenzisa ugesi owuthengile kuphela, okwenza ukuthi kube nemizi ezixhumela ugesi ngokungemthetho.Kulesi sikweletu sabasebenzi bakamasipala sangoSepthemba, wanonyaka, kuno-R2.3 million obhalwe egameni lamakhansela awu-47, bese kuba ngabasebenzi bakamasipala abenza imisebenzi ehlukene abangu-4 449 abakweleta u-R78 million. Ngokwesizindalwazi sikamasipala, sebebonke abasebenzi bomkhandlu balinganiselwa ku-24 000. Lokhu kusho ukuthi cishe ikota yabasebenzi iyehluleka wukukhokhela izidingongqangi. Esewonke amakhansela eThekwini angu-222, okusho ukuthi awumthamo obhekile abishe ezikweletwini njengoba engu-47 akweletayo.Lo masipala ophethwe yiMeya uCyril Xaba, udalule nokuthi abasebenzi namakhansela abakweletayo bafakwe ohlelweni lokuthi kulungiswe lokho - olubandakanya ukuthi bacishelwe ugesi namanzi, kwalandelwa nezinyathelo ezithile zomthetho futhi bacetshiswa ngokuthi basebenzise izinsuku zabo zokuphumula emsebenzini ukuzama ukunciphisa noma ukwesula izikweleti zabo.Ikhansela laku-ward 23 eThekwini, uNksz Alicia Kisson, lithe lo mbiko wezikweleti uyisexwayiso nenkomba yokubhimba kohlelo lwezezimali."Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi kuphele ukwethenjwa kwethu emphakathini futhi lo mbiko uqinisekisa lokho ngoba asibajezisi abantu abangasebenzi nabathwele kanzima ukuthi bakhokhe imali abayikweletayo," usho kanje.Usihlalo weThekwini Ratepayers Protest Movement, uMnuz Asad Gaffar, uthe enye yezinto abacabanga ukuthi ziholele kule nkinga wukumba eqolo kwezindleko zanyanga zonke, okwenza ukuthi abasebenzi bakamasipala bathwale kanzima ukuzikhokha."Okunye futhi wukuthi abasebenzi namakhansela abanendaba nokukhokhela izindleko futhi abazi nokuthi kuba njani uma bengazikhokhanga - bese kuba ukuthi vele akukho zinyathelo ezitheni abathathelwa zona ngalokhu,” kusho uGaffar.Kuthintwa ikhansela leDemocratic Alliance, uMnuz Thabani Mthethwa, lithe likholelwa ekutheni akumele kube khona abasebenzi namakhansela abakweleta umasipala ekubeni kuyibona futhi abashaya le mithetho."Yiphutha elikhulu ukuthi abantu abashaya umthetho kube yibona futhi abawephula kuqala, ngakho akuqiniswe umthetho kakhulu kulabo abephula umthetho ukuze bezofunda ukuba ngabaholi abaqotho,” kusho uMthethwa.USihlalo we-Action SA KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Zwakele Mncwango, ukhombe umunwe kusotshwebhu kamasipala ukuthi wuyena okumele aqikelele ukuthi izinto ezinjena azenzeki kubhekwe phambili."Kuwumsebenzi wakhe nabambisene nabo ukuqikelela ukuthi izinto ezinjena azilokhu zenzeka ngoba kuyihlazo ukuthi kuhujwe abantu ukuthi bakhokhe izindleko zabo zanyanga zonke ekubeni kwabona uqobo besahluleka ukwenza lokho,” kusho uMncwango.Kuhlaluka ukuthi inkinga enkulu wuhlulelo lukamasipala lokuqagelwa kwezikweleti nxa abantu bekhokhiselwa izidingo. Kuthiwa kuyenzeka abantu bakhokhiswe kakhulu kungafanele, kokunye bakhokhiswe imali encane esikhundleni senkulu. Lokhu kudala ukudideka nokukhathazeka ebantwini ngoba bathi kade bekhokhiswa kancane kuvele kuqhanyukwe sekuthiwa bakweleta imali eshisiwe, abasuke bengenayo. Yize zikhona izinhlelo zokuthi kukhokhwe kancane izikweleti zezidingongqangi kumasipala kepha abantu bakhala ngokuthi ziyabacindezela.

ISIHLABANI somculo kamaskandi sodumo lwengoma eshisa izikhotha kulezi zinsuku ethi Uyoncengwa Unyoko, uLethukuthula "Umafikizolo" Mhlongo, sithi siphezu kwamalungiselelo okugcwalisa mfi iMoses Mabhida Stadium ngenhloso yokugubha impumelelo yale ngoma. Engxoxweni ekhethekile neSolezwe, Umafikizolo uthe le ngoma seyigile izimanga kakhulu futhi yamqophela umlando. UMafikizolo (25) waKwaBasi, eWasbank, ukhulume kanjena nje, le ngoma isanda kuqopha umlando ngokuba yingoba yokuqala kamaskandi ukuqengqeleza phambili kuMhlobo Wenene FM. "Ukuyibona seyidlalwa kakhulu nayiziteshi ezingekho eKZN, kuyangijabulisa ngoba lokho kukhombisa ukuthi umculo wami nakwezinye izifundazwe bawusekela ngendlela eseqophelweni eliphezulu uma sewuqashelwa nayisiteshi esikhulu kangaka. Le ngoma ingenzela izinto ezinhle kakhulu kangangoba ngihlela nokuyenzela umcimbi, hhayi omncane kodwa omkhulu eMoses Mabhida Stadium." Leli culo selike ladlalwa nakwiMetro FM nakwiGagasi FM, okuyiziteshi ezingavamisile ukudlala izingoma zikamaskandi. Uthe okumenza acabange iMoses Mabhida Stadium ukuthi le ngoma seyiphenduke ihubo lesizwe ngisho emidlalweni yebhola. "Ngiyibonile idlalwa kuwina iKaizer Chiefs, yadlalwa kuwina iBanyana Banyana, yadlalwa kuwina iBafana Bafana nasemidlalweni yeLamontville Golden Arrows iyadlalwa." Uthe ufisa ukugcwalisa bonke abalandeli bomculo abahlukahlukene bese emema nozakwabo. "Ngiyabonga kakhulu kubathandi bomculo wami ngoba ukube babengekho ngabe le ngoma ayikho kuleli zinga. Kwahlula ngisho sebeyigxeka, bethi inenhlamba kodwa bakwazi ukuchazela abantu ukuthi unyoko igama lesiZulu," kusho uMafikizolo ozovela nakuMalanga Awafani kwiSABC1. Yize sekusele inyanga kuhlukaniswe unyaka kodwa osaziwayo abaningi sebephumele obala bathi bahamba nengoma kaMafikizolo.UMafikizolo uthe ngesikhathi enza le ngoma wayekulindele ukuthi ithakaselwe kakhulu ukwedlula ezinye. Uthe okwenza lokho wukuthi uwumuntu ohlale efuna ukuqhamuka nento ehlukile kweyabanye futhi ugxile emculweni wothando.
OMUNYE ukhomba omunye, bese kuthi omunye evikela iso lakhe kwabebeganene iminyaka engaphezu kuka-15, ngenxa yombango wokuthi kumele kubuyekezwe imibandela yencwadi yesehlukaniso sabo.Labo ngoNksz Rejoice Xulu waseMbongolwane, eShowe, noMnuz Mandlakayise Zulu waKwaSeme, KwaNongoma. UZulu owayeyiphoyisa leSAPS eThekwini usola obengumkakhe ngokungafuni ukuthi kubuyekezwe eminye yemibandela yokwehlukanisa kwabo, amsola nangokuthi kwenzeka "ngomkhoshosho".Engxoxweni neSolezwe, uZulu uthe yena noNksz Xulu bashada ngo-1999, base behlukanisa ngo-2015, isinqumo athi wayengazimisele ngaso - kepha usola ukuthi umkakhe waba nesandla ekutheni afinyelele kusona."Mina ngangingenahlelo lokwehlukanisa naye, kepha izinto eziningi zaqala ukushintsha emva kokuthi ngibe sengozini yemoto ngo-2001, eyenza ukuthi impilo yami ingabe isafana nasekuqaleni, njengoba kwaphoqeleka ukuthi ngigcine ngihamba ngesihlalo esinamasondo."Ngisola ukuthi ukuguquka kwempilo yami ngaleyo ndlela yikhona okwenza ukuthi angabe esangiphatha ngendlela efanele nayejwayele ukungiphatha ngayo, okuthe uma isimo sami siba sibi kakhulu ngabo-2015, ngezwa esethi ufuna ukuthi sihlukanise. Khona lapho futhi ngabona sekunencwadi yokwehlukanisa, esinemibandela ethile - esengibona manje ukuthi angihambisani nayo, nengingazi ukuthi ngayisayina kanjani ngaleso sikhathi ngoba ngangigula," usho kanje.Eqhuba uthe okumphatha kabi kakhulu ngendlela abahlukanisa ngayo nomkakhe wukuthi imibandela yokwehlukanisa kwabo yashaya yena kakhulu ephaketheni, waze walahlekelwa yimali engaphezu kuka-R1 million okwahlomula kuwona uNksz Xulu, kepha yena namanje akukho angakukhomba ukuthi wakuhlomula njengokwencwadi yesehlukaniso sabo."Into ebuhlungu wukuthi ngawo u-2015 ngaphoqeka ukuthatha umhlalaphansi emsebenzini ngoba kungasasebenzeki nhlobo, nakhu futhi sekuba yile nto yesehlukaniso eze yaphethwa ngo-2017, ngasala ngincela isithupha - njengoba kumanje nje ngikhala ngingashayiwe. Sengizame kaningi ukuxhumana nabameli ukuthi kubuyekezwe indaba yalesi sehlukaniso kepha kunhlanga zimuka nomoya, yingakho ngize ngisole ukuthi kukhona isandla semfene sokuqikelela ukuthi ngilokhu ngicindezeleke njalo kulesi simo engikusona," kusho uZulu.Kuthintwa uNksz Xulu ukuze aziphendulele kulolu daba uthe kungamampunge ukuthi kunogcobho othile ngendlela okwasingathwa ngayo indaba yesehlukaniso sakhe noZulu, anezingane ezintathu naye."Nginabo bonke ubufakazi basenkantolo obufakazela ukuthi savumelana naye ngayo yonke imibandela yokwehlukanisa kwethu. Into enkulu esiyibangayo wukuthi ngokwesivumelwano sethu, yena uzothola ingxenye yemali yami yempesheni, okuzoze kwenzeke kuphela uma sengithathe umhlalaphansi emsebenzini. Yilokho yena asehlulwa wukukwamukela manje njengoba eselokhu enza ukuthi indaba yethu ibe nomsindo ngale ndlela," kusho uNksz Xulu.Eqhuba, uveze izinsolo zokuthi uZulu ubewumuntu ongawukhathalele umndeni wakhe ngisho esasebenza, edla imali ebumnandini aze akhohlwe nawukuthi uzele. Uthe bekwala ngisho esehleli phansi emva kokukhubazeka engozini, kepha engabambeki - kunalokho eba nolaka kuyena futhi emhlukumeza ngokomoya, engakhombisi ukujabulela indlela ayemnakekela ngayo, futhi emenzela yonke into ayidingayo."Yizo zonke izinto lezo ezenza ukuthi ngize ngifune ukuthi sihlukanise naye, futhi savumelana naye ukwenza lokho, manje ngiyaxakeka ukuthi kungani esebanga umsindo kwabezindaba ngalokhu ekubeni elazi lonke iqiniso ngokwenzeka," kusho uNksz Xulu.Kuthintwa isazi sezomthetho, uMnuz Mpumelelo Zikalala ukuphawula ngalolu daba, uthe inkinga ngesimo esinjena wukuthi uma nenze isivumelwano ngemibandela yokwehlukanisa kwenu akube kusenzeka ukuthi kuguqulwe into eseniyisayinele phansi."Khona ungasifaka nje isicelo sokuzama ukuphikisa okuthile noma ukufuna ukuthi kuchitshiyelwe imibandela ethize esivumelwaneni senu, kepha kusuke kungeke kuguquke lutho ngoba inkantolo isuke ibalekela yona le nto yokuthi umuntu uzobona ukuthi useyasindwa yimibandela ethile azisayinela yona bese efuna ukuthi kushintshwe," kusho uZikalala.
