AKUZOPHAZAMISEKA ukubhalwa kwezivivinyo zika-matric esikoleni esigqekezwe kwaphinde kwashiswa amanye amagumbi okufundela, iMpolweni Secondary, esifundeni uMgungundlovu izolo ekuseni. UMphathiswa wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka, usigxeke kakhulu lesi sehlakalo njengoba senzeke ngesikhathi abafundi bematasa nezivivinyo zabo okubalwa nezika-matric.UHlomuka uthe umbiko abawutholile ngukuthi kugqekezwe kwebiwa izinto kwase kushiswa amanye amakilasi."Kugqekezwe emahhovisi kwebiwa kwase kucekelwa phansi impahla. Kushiswe namanye amakilasi kanti siyasigxeka lesi senzo sobugebengu esifana nokuhlasela ikusasa labafundi," usho kanje. Uthe ihholo lesikole alithintekanga wathi abafundi bazoqhubeka babhalele kulona izivivinyo zika-matric."Azikho izigameko ezizosivimba ekutheni siqhubeke nezivivinyo ezikoleni zethu. Yihlazo elenziwe abacekele phansi isikole ngokuthi basishise ikakhulu ngesikhathi kubhalwa."Uthe lesi sehlakalo siphuca abafundi izinsiza ezimbalwa abanazo kanti siphinde sifake umnyango ezinkingeni zemali."Sinxusa abezinhlaka zokuphepha ukuthi babambe abenzi bobubi. Sifuna babhekane nengalo yomthetho baphinde baphoqwe ukuthi bakhokhiswe imali ngomonakalo abawenzile." Uveze ukuthi basebenzisana namaphoyisa baqinisa ezokuphepha ezikoleni."Sinxusa nemiphakathi okubalwa nabaholi bomdabu ukuthi bayisukumele eyokuphepha kwezikole ngokuthi kuboshwe abacekela phansi izikole. Ababoshwe abasemkhankasweni wokucekela ingqalasizinda yezemfundo," kusho uHlomuka.Uthe imiphakathi ayiyeke ukuthula ivikele izigebengu ezenza izinto ezifuze lezi."Uma wazi owenze lokhu kodwa ukhethe ukuthula, uyafana nomunye wabantu abacekela phansi ikusasa lezingane. Phumela obala uma wazi ukuze kubanjwe izigebengu." Kwenzeka lokhu nje, namhlanje abafundi baka-matric babhala iphepha lesibili lesiZulu ekuseni kuthi ntambama babhale iphepha lokuqala leBusiness Studies.Izolo u-matric ubhale iReligion Studies neMechanical Technology.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa aseNew Hanover aphenya icala lokugqekezwa kwesikole.Uthe umbiko abawutholile ngukuthi abasolwa basuse baphinde bacekela phansi i-ceiling board, bangena ngaphakathi base beba izinto. Uveze ukuthi basaphenya ngalesi sehlakalo kanti akukaboshwa muntu.
BAFUNA ziqhubeke izinhlelo zokushushisa okanye ukuphenya othisha abasolwa ngokulala nabafundi ngisho noma kuthiwa abazali babafundi sebethole inhlawulo kosolwayo.Lokhu kushiwo amalungu ekomiti loMnyango weMfundo eyisiSekelo ePhalamende, azwakalise ukukhathazeka ngokuthi abanye abasuke begile le mikhuba, bagcina sebephunyuka ogibeni lomthetho ngoba sebekhokhile.Emhlanganweni obusePhalamende obuhlanganisa umkhandlu olawula othisha kuleli, iSouth African Council for Educators, nomkhandlu okubhungwa kuwona izindaba zothisha i-Education Labour Relations Council (ELRC), kuvele ukuthi abanye abazali bayawahoxisa amacala ngoba kusuke kukhona abakutholile. Amalungu athe kumele lo mkhuba uqedwe ngoba yizingane eziyizisulu.Usihlalo wekomiti, uNksz Joy Maimela, uthe kumele kuqiniswe imizamo yokulwa nesihlava sothisha abalala nabafundi.Uthe embikweni abawutholile kuvele ukuthi awu-469 amacala athinta othisha abalala nabafundi, ayesezandleni ze-ELRC kusuka ngonyakamali u-2018 kuya ku-2024. Kulawa bangu-176 othisha abalahlwa amacala, amagama abo ayiswa eMnyangweni wezeNhlalakahle nakwi-SACE ukuze bafakwe ohlwini lwabantu asebeke bahlukumeza izingane."I-SACE iyona ebe isinquma mayelana nokuthi umuntu afakwe ngaphansi kohlu lokuthi angaphinde asebenze kowezemfundo kuleli. Kunabanye othola ukuthi phezu kokuba sebefakwe ohlwini kodwa bavumbuka kwezinye izifundazwe," usho kanje.Uzwakalise ukudumala ngokuthi abanye abazali "badayisa ngezingane zabo" njengoba bamukela imali bese bephoqa ukuthi amacala ahoxiswe. "Yingakho amalungu ethe kumele noma abazali sebehoxisa amacala kodwa izinhlaka zomthetho ziqhubeke nophenyo kanjalo nokushushiswa kothintekayo ngisho noma bengavumi abazali. Lokhu sikuphakamisa ngoba asifuni abagilwa bahlukumezeke ngoba bengabutholi ubulungiswa," usho kanje.UNksz Ella Mokgalane oyisikhulu esiphezulu seSACE, uthe bayabahlola othisha ngaphambi kokubanika imvume yokusebenza kuleli, wathi babheka ukuthi abakaze balahlwe amacala nokuthi abekho ohlwini lwabantu abake balahlwa amacala okuhlukumeza izingane. UNobhala Jikelele we-ELRC, uNksz Cindy Foca, uthe imiNyango yezeMfundo ezifundazweni yiyona eqondisa ubugwegwe othisha abaphuma endleleni.Uthe umnyango kazwelonke awunawo amandla okwenza lokhu ngoba othisha baqashwe yizifundazwe.Amalungu athe kumele ibhekisiswe indaba yokuthi babekwe amacala othisha abalala nabafundi ngoba basuke bebancane.UNksz Maimela uthe izisulu zabafundi yizona okumele zibekwe phambili futhi zivikelwe nguhulumeni yingakho kumele kuqiniswe imithetho ekhona ukuze bavikeleke.
KUSUKA ngo-Ephreli 30, 2026, ngeke zisavalwa izikhala zamakhansela emawadini kuleli uma kwenzeka esula ezikhundleni noma edlula emhlabeni ngenxa yokuthi kuzobe sekulungiselelwa ukhetho.Lokhu kusho ukuthi lezo zikhala zizohlala kanjalo kuze kube kubanjwa ukhetho, oluzoba phakathi kukaNovemba 2026 noJanuwari 2027.UMnuz Masego Sheburi, ibamba lesikhulu esiphezulu seKhomishini yezoKhetho kuleli, uthe kusuka ngo-Ephreli kulo nyaka, sebebe nokhetho lokuchibiyela ezweni lonke emawadini angu-57. Uthe isibalo esiphezulu sibe se-Eastern Cape naseGauteng."Umthetho uthi kumele sibambe ukhetho lokuchibiyela ezinsukwini ezingu-90, kuvuleke isikhala ewadini. Kodwa ngenxa yokuthi kuzoba nokhetho lohulumeni basekhaya, lokhu kusho ukuthi ngeke sisakwazi ukuba nokhetho lokuchibiyela uma kwenzeka kuvuleka izikhala kusuka ngo-Ephreli 30, 2026," usho kanje.Uthe kodwa amakhansela ama-PR, wona alukho usuku olubekiwe lokuthi zingavalwa izikhala zawo njengoba kuzoba nokhetho."Izikhala zamakhansela angama-PR zingavalwa kuze kubanjwe ukhetho. Kusuka ngo-Ephreli kulo nyaka kuya ku-Okthoba, sekuvalwe izikhala zamakhansela angama-PR ezingu-183. Ngonyaka ikhomishini ivala izikhala zamakhansela angama-PR ezingu-377." Uveze nokuthi kuneziphakamiso abazenzile abazozethula ekomitini loMnyango wezaseKhaya ePhalamende ingakapheli le nyanga.Ezinye zeziphakamiso ezokuthi kuchitshiyelwe umthetho wezokhetho abazozenza, ngukuthi kukhishwe ohlwini lwamaqembu abhalisiwe uma ehluleka ukwazisa ikhomishini kusanesikhathi ukuthi ayaqhubeka nokubhaliswa.USheburi uveze nokuthi bathole umbiko kwiMunicipal Demarcation Board (MDB), mayelana nokuhlelwa kabusha kwamawadi ngaphambi kokhetho."Uhlu lokugcina lwamawadi luzomenyezelwa emcimbini ozoba ngenyanga ezayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi ikhomishini ikwazi ukuhlabela phambili nezinhlelo zokuhlelela ngendlela ukhetho. Kubalulekile ukuthi abavoti bazibheke ukuthi imininingwane yabo ayishintshile ethinta amawadi uma esebuyekeziwe," usho kanje.Uthe lokhu kubuyekezwa kwamawadi kungaba nomthelela kubavoti abazozithola ukuthi sebengene ngaphansi kwenye iwadi kunale abebekuyona phambilini.
LIMGOJELILE owesilisa obebekwe wuMbuso icala lokudlwengula nokubulala owesifazane owayekhulelwe amawele.Ummangalelwa, uMnuz Ndabenhle Lindokuhle Majola, ubekade ebekwe amacala amabili elokudlwengula nelokubulala uNksz Inam Tshakeni (20).Izolo, iNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini, imlahle ngawo womabili amacala uMajola. Kuvela ukuthi umufi wayekade ehambele indawo yobumnandi eseReservoir Hills, eThekwini, ngoJulayi 13, wonyaka owedlule.Kuvela ukuthi kwathi umufi uma efika kule ndawo, wase ehlangana noMajola. Kuthiwa noMajola wagcina ebonakala ephuma ehamba naye umufi emfaka emotweni yakhe iFord Ranger.Ngemuva kwezinsuku eziyisikhombisa, kwatholakala isidumbu sikaNksz Tshakeni silahliwe eCanelands, eVerulam, siphuke sakufahlaka izingalo nezinyawo.UMajola wakhalelwa ngamasongo kaSigonyela ngemuva kokuba efike kule ndawo yobumnandi ngemuva kokuba sekutholwe isidumbu. Kuthiwa kwathi uma efika, umnikazi wendawo waqaphela ukuthi uyilo mlisa ambone kwikhamera yendawo yebhizinisi ehamba noNksz Tshakeni.Kuthiwa wavala amasango wangena ngaphakathi wase ebiza amaphoyisa.Izolo, iJaji uBrenda Sibiya, lisebenzise ubufakazi obehlukene ukulahla ngamacala uMajola. Eqhulwini, ijaji lisole uMajola ngokuhhubhuza amanga enkantolo ngokuthi athi babekade bevumelene nomufi ngokuthi bazitike ngocansi emotweni.''Ungasho kanjani ukuthi nanivumelene nomuntu ngokuthi nizitike ngocansi ekubeni ingxenye yomzimba wakhe wawulimele? Lokho kuveza ngokusobala ukuthi kwabe kuwucansi lwendluzula," lisho kanjena.Liqhubekile ilaji, lasola uMajola ngokuthi ushaye ungqimphothwe wavuma ukuthi walala nomufi ngemuva kokuba esebonile ukuthi kunobufakazi obuphathekayo enkantolo bolibofuzo."Ukube wena awuzange uzwe ukuthi izinto ziyakubhedela ngokuphika ukulala nomufi namanje ngabe usaphika. Kodwa ugcine uvuma ngoba nakhu usubona ukuthi uMbuso unobufakazi obuphathekayo bokuthi walala nomufi," kusho ijaji.Liqhubekile, lasola uMajola ngemizamo yokwakha isithombe-mqondo sokuthi umufi nguyena owazicelela ukuhamba naye.''Kukhona konke okukhulumile inkantolo, ikuqaphelile ukuthi ubumane uzisholo nje ngoba nakhu ubuwenza imizamo yokuzivikela kuleli cala," lisho kanjena.Lithula isinqumo, ijaji likhulume labhekisa kuMajola lathi: "Ngenxa yobufakazi boMbuso obuphathekayo uma buqhathaniswa nobakho ozakhele bona, ngikulahla ngawo womabili amacala."Ngaleso sikhathi bekungathi akudikizi lutho kuMajola futhi ebonakala engathukile nje nhlobo."Ngiyavuma ukuthi salala nomufi kodwa lokho sasikade sikwenze sivumelene," washo kanjena ngaphambilini uMajola.Ijaji libuye labuyekeza nobufakazi obethulwa ngudokotela owahlola isidumbu sikamufi owaqinisekisa ukuthi wayekhulelwe futhi walinyazwa kanzima.Unina kamufi, uNkk Asande Tshakeni, uthe yize ingeke isabuya indodakazi yakhe kodwa uthobeke amanxeba ngokuthi uMajola ulahlwe yicala.''Kuyangijabulisa ukuthi ekugcineni kuzokwenzeka ubulungiswa ngokubulawa kwendodakazi yami," echaza.UMajola ulahlwa yicala nje, ummeli wakhe, uMnuz Patrick Mkhumbuzi, ugawule zephuka kwasho khona ukuthi ubufakazi buyamgojela.
IKHULUNYELWA emakhoneni eyowesilisa waseNtshawini, KwaDukuza, okuthiwa ugwaze ephindelela unina wezingane zakhe abehlala naye emqashweni, wambulala enengwa ukuthi kade ewasha izingubo zengane yowesilisa ongumakhelwane wakhe.Isolezwe lithole ngomthombo walo ukuthi umufi, uNksz Princess Mthethwa (31), ugwazwe kabuhlungu yisoka lakhe ngoMgqibelo okuthiwa livele lavuka indlobane limbuza ngokuwasha kwakhe izingubo zengane yowesilisa ongumakhelwane.Kuthiwa umsolwa ngemuva kwalokho uzinikele emaphoyiseni. Kuvela ukuthi inyantisa igazi indlela umufi abulawe ngayo.UMnuz Siboniso Msomi, ongumfowabo kamufi, uthe bayathuthumela kakhulu ngokwenziwe ngumlamu wakhe.Uthe bathole ukuthi umsolwa ugwaze umufi amanxeba angu-10 umzimba wonke."Bekukhona amanxeba ezingalweni okukhombisa ukuthi ubezama ukuvika udadewethu ngesikhathi emgwaza. Bekukhona namanye amanxeba ajulile," echaza.Uthe ummese abewushiye emqaleni kumufi uze wakhishwa ngamaphoyisa esefikile endaweni yesigameko. Kuthiwa ngenkathi esembulele uphume egijima egcekeni egcwele igazi, kwathi uma ehlangana nomunye embuza ukuthi kwenzekanjani wagcwala igazi waphendula ngokuthi akazwani nabantu abachwensayo.Eqhuba uMsomi uthe lesi simo sibashiye bekhungathekile kakhulu ngenxa yokuthi bebemethemba kakhulu lo wesilisa futhi esefana nelungu lomndeni."Usbari ubefika lapha ekhaya uma sinemicimbi. Ubesefana nje nomuntu walapha ekhaya. Asikaze sicabange nje ukuthi ngelinye ilanga angagcina enza into eyisihluku esinjena enganeni yakwethu," usho kanjena.Uveze ukuthi laba bese kuphele isikhathi eside bethandana futhi banezingane ezine. Ukhale ngesihluku athe sikhonjiswe yilo wesilisa.Uthe okubazwise ubuhlungu kakhulu ukufica ingane engumagcina wabo yomfana eneminyaka emine ihlezi eduze nesidumbu isigcwele igazi idane ivusa unina icabanga ukuthi ulele uzovuka."Ingane ibidane imvusa ingazi ukuthi lo muntu emvusayo useshonile," usho kanjena.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi ingxabano yalezi zithandani kube wukuthi owesifazane athole itoho lokuwasha izimpahla zengane encane yakwamakhelwane. Okwamanje asikaziwa isizathu sokubulawa kwakhe. Lo wesilisa kulindeleke ukuthi avele enkantolo yaKwaDukuza maduzane nje ngaleli cala," usho kanjena.

INHLOKO yezobunhloli, uLieutenant General Dumisani Khumalo, idedele ezinye izigaxa ezishaqisayo ngePhini likaKhomishana wamaPhoyisa elisamisiwe elisolwa ngokusebenzisana nemigulukudu, uLieutenant General Shadrack Sibiya.UKhumalo uveze ukuthi uSibiya uhamba ngemoto kamashiyakukhalwa oseziqedile izimoto zabantu eThekwini.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ethula ubufakazi phambi kwekhomishini ephenya izinsolo ezenziwa uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi.UKhumalo utshele iKhomishini eholwa yiJaji uMbuyiseli Madlanga ukuthi uSibiya akahambi ngemoto ayinikwa ngamaphoyisa kodwa uhamba ngemoto yomuntu owalahlwa uxhaxha lwamacala.UKhumalo uthe uSibiya unokubonakala ehamba ngemoto yomqaphi wakhe, uStuart James Scharnick, wathi uScharnick lona unoxhaxha lwamacala, iningi lamacala wawenza KwaZulu-Natal."Sithe uma sibheka ukuthi ekabani le moto ajwayele ukuhamba uSibiya sathola ukuthi ekaJames. UJames lona unamacala awu-34. Awu-18 amlahla, awu-11 ahoxiswa, kwathi kwamahlanu watholwa engenacala."UKhumalo uthe basazoke babheke ukuthi uScharnick ikhona yini iminyaka ayidonse ejele njengoba enamacala angaka amlahlile, wathi uScharnick ndini lo ubukeka eyisethenjwa sikaSibiya njengoba ayemqaphile namhla eyovela phambi kwekomiti lasePhalamende elikhethekile eliphenya izinsolo ezifanayo.UKhumalo uphinde waveza ukuthi elinye iphoyisa elisondelene noSibiya laya emzini kasomabhizinisi obhekene noxhaxha lwamacala, uMnuz Katiso "KT" Molefe, laphuma seliphethe uplastiki okungaqondakali ukuthi wawunani, wathi iphoyisa elisondelene noSibiya, uSergeant Nkosi, laya emzini kaMolefe kusele izinsuku eziyishumi aboshelwe icala lokubulala unjiniyela, uMnuz Armand Swart.UKhumalo uthe uNkosi wayehamba ngemoto yamaphoyisa ebhaliswe ngaphansi kwehhovisi likaSibiya. Uveze i-video (CCTV) ekhombisa uNkosi esemzini kaMolefe."Njengoba sibona lapha engena, kuyabonakala ukuthi akaphethe lutho. Uma esephuma ubonakala ephethe uplastiki omhlophe esandleni sakhe. Akucaci ukuthi yini lena ephakathi kodwa yona ibukeka ilula."UKhumalo uthe uNkosi usondelene kakhulu noSibiya, wathi lokhu kuxhumanisa uSibiya namaqembu emigulukudu.UKhumalo uzoqhubeka nokwethula ubufakazi namhlanje.Khonamanjalo: Liqhubekile ikomiti lasePhalamende elikhethekile eliphenya izinsolo ezifanayo nokulalela ubufakazi.Izolo, bekuvele iPhini likaNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa, uDkt Polly Boshielo.UDkt Boshielo utshele amalungu ekomiti ukuthi akazange aziswe ngokuhlakazwa kwethimba eliphenya amacala okubulawa kosopolitiki KwaZulu-Natal (iPKTT)."Nami le nto ngayibona ezinkundleni zokuxhumana."Umyalelo wokuthi kuhlakazwe ithimba wakhishwa uNgqongqoshe wezamaPhoyisa omisiwe, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu.Ikomiti lizoqhubeka nokulalela ubufakazi namhlanje.
Amaphoyisa aseBityi e-Eastern Cape acela noma ngubani ongaba nolwazi olungasiza ekuthungatheni abasolwa abadubule babulala unogada wesifazane, 28. Uzakwabo wesifazane, 48, usindile kulesi sigameko kodwa usesimweni esibucayi esibhedlela.Isigameko senzeke ngase-Xhwili Clinic ngeSonto, 02 November 2025 ngabo-23:50, onogada bebesemsebenzini emtholampilo. Imininingwane etholakala emaphoyiseni iqinisekisa ukuthi onogada besifazane ababili bathunjwe egunjini lokusebenzela badutshulwa ngemuva komtholampilo endaweni evulekile.Isidumbu sikamufi sitholwe sinqunu sinezinhlamvu ezimbili ekhanda ngesikhathi uzakwabo ephuthunyiswa esibhedlela ngemuva kwalokho.Kuvulwe icala lokubulala, ukuzama ukubulala nelokudlwengula esiteshini samaphoyisa eBityi.Noma ngubani ongaba nolwazi olungaholela ekuboshweni nokushushiswa komsolwa ngempumelelo kumele athinte iNhloko yabaseshi baseBityi, uDetective Warrant Officer Mlilo ku-083 688 6571 noma inombolo ethi #CrimeStop 08600 10111 noma athinte isiteshi samaphoyisa esiseduze.
Iqembu loMkhonto weSizwe (MK) selixoshe uSotswebhu walo ePhalamende, uColleen Makhubele. Esikhundleni sakhe, kwafakwa ilungu lePhalamende u-Des van Rooyen. Isitatimende esisemthethweni se-MK asizibalulanga izizathu zokuxoshwa kukaMakhubele. Kodwa-ke, umthombo wangaphakathi eqenjini utshele i-IOL ukuthi lesi sinqumo silandela umbiko wangaphakathi oncoma ukumiswa kwakhe. "Umbiko wangaphakathi omayelana noColleen uphakamise ukuthi amiswe emsebenzini kuze kuphenywe. Kodwa sase sinabo bonke ubufakazi - sasingekho isidingo sokuphenya. Amaqiniso ayekhona ngakho kumele ahambe," kusho umthombo. Isitatimende ngokuqokwa kukaVan Rooyen, sithi: "Iqembu le-MK linethemba eligcwele lokuthi ngaphansi kobuholi bakhe njengoSotswebhu Omkhulu, iKhokhasi yasePhalamende izoqiniswa, iqondiswe izigwegwe futhi ihambisane nomgomo oyingqopha-mlando weqembu wokuletha inkululeko ephelele yabantu baseNingizimu Afrika.” Iqhube yathi: "Iqembu liqinisekisa abalandeli balo kanye nomphakathi wonkana ukuthi ubuholi obusha ePhalamende buzonothisa umsebenzi wekhokhasi, bucije ukugxila kwezepolitiki futhi bukhulise amandla ayo okumela intando yabantu ngaphandle kokuyekethisa.”
UMNDENI wakwaMbatha oZwathini, ngaseNdwedwe, ufuna ukuthi babhadle ejele abesifazane abathathu abangamanesi kwesinye sezibhedlela zakule ndawo, abasolwa ngokusebenzisa imininingwane yowayelaliswe esibhedlela, bazicebisa ngayo ngemishwalense ebahlomulise ngemali.Owomndeni ongathandanga ukudalulwa ukumvikela, utshele Isolezwe ukuthi okwaholela kulokhu wukuthi kwagula ingane yomfana, uNduduzo Mbatha (24), owayengena ephuma esibhedlela sikahulumeni i-Appelsbosch, nokwagcina kumenele ngoNovemba, wonyaka odlule."Kuthe ngenyanga edlule, unina womfana wathintwa yizinkampani zemishwalense eyahlukene, zimbuza ngabesifazane abathile abasebenza kulesi sibhedlela, zase zimazisa ukuthi kusetshenziswe imininingwane yendodana yakhe ukwenza futhi kuhlonyulwe emishwalenseni ngaphandle kwemvume yakhe nangokungemthetho," usho kanje.Eqhuba, udalule ukuthi laba basebenzi bakulesi sibhedlela bahlomula ngemishwalense, okwathi sekushone umufi - owedwa wabo wathola u-R50 000, omunye wahlomula u-R54 000, kwathi owesithathu wakhokhelwa u-R58 000. Kanti futhi kukhona nomunye wesine, okuvela ukuthi owakhe umshwalense umchithile, wabuyiselwa u-R119 ayewujoyine ngawo."Lokhu kusiphathe kabi sonke siwumndeni ukuthi kube nabantu abanesibindi esingaka sokuthi basebenzise ukugula nokufa kwelungu lomndeni wethu ukuzicebisa bona, ikakhulu ngoba bangabantu esibaziyo nabasebenzela uhulumeni," kukhononda owomndeni.Kuthintwa unina kamufi, uNkk Bongiwe Mbatha, uvumile ukuthi yiqiniso ukuthi kwasetshenziswa imininingwane yendodana yakhe ukuzicebisa ngemishwalenge, isimo athi siwuphazamise kakhulu umoya wakhe.Uthe okubuhlungu kakhulu nokumphatha kabi ngalesi simo wukuthi senziwe ngabantu abesebenza nabo futhi bejwayelene nangale kokuhlanganiswa wumsebenzi."Okukhombisa ngempela ukuthi bayenzile le nto nokuthi bayenze ngenhloso wukuthi kuthe sengivule icala ngalokho, bavele besula bonke emsebenzini - okudweba isithombe esicacile sokuthi bashaywa yisazelo sobubi besenzo sabo," kusho uNkk Mbatha.Eqhuba, uthe okunye futhi okumphatha kabi wukuthi usanda kuthola ukuthi lona leli fayela lendodana yakhe elisetshenziswe ukugila imikhuba kalaziwa muntu manje ukuthi likuphi, okwenza akhathazeke ukuthi kuzokwenzekani uma kwenzeka lidingeka ngokuqhubeka kwecala."Nokho isifiso sami wukuthi kuqhubeke kuphenywe kanzulu ngalesi simo ukuze kutholakale yonke imininingwane ezokwenza ukuthi bafunde isifundo ngale nto abayenzile," usho kanje.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi udaba selubikiwe esibhedlela, kanti iziphathimandla ezingagunyaziwe ukukhuluma nabezindaba zikuqinisekisile lokho, zathi kuyaphenywa. Kuvele ukuthi azikemukelwa ngokusemthethweni izincwadi zokusula emsebenzini kwamanesi ngoba kusolwa ukuthi abalekela isikhalo esifakiwe ngawo.Kushaye isikhathi sokushicilela amaphoyisa engakaqinisekisi ukuvulwa kwecala ngalolu daba.
KUKHALWE ngomdlandla owehlile emaphoyiseni, ukwanda kwesihlava sokubulawa kwamaphoyisa, ukushoda kwezinsiza kanjalo nesibalo esingenele samaphoyisa ngesikhathi kunomhlangano wasePhalamende.Kulo mhlangano izinyunyana zamaphoyisa iSapu nePopcru, zitshele amalungu ekomiti lamaphoyisa ukuthi sibi isimo embuthweni.Zithe amaphoyisa ayaqhubeka nokuzibulala osekuze kwadlulela nasekutheni abulale ozakwabo ngenxa yokhwantalala. UMengameli wePopcru, uMnuz Thulani Ngwenya, uthe ziningi izinto angazibala ezihlupha amaphoyisa nsuku zonke.Ubale nodaba lokungakhushulwa kwama-rank emaphoyiseni, okwenza amaphoyisa ahlale kwi-rank eyodwa iminyaka."Amaphoyisa abalelwa ku-160 000, ekubeni umphakathi wakuleli ungu-64 million. Amaphoyisa asebenzela ezindaweni ezingekho esimweni eziteshini. Kwezinye awakwazi ngisho ukuyozikhulula ngenxa yokuthi namanzi awekho. Ngonyaka, angu-6 000 amaphoyisa ashiya embuthweni, ekubeni kuthiwa kuqashwa angu-10 000," usho kanje. Uthe amaphoyisa anokhwantalala kanti athwele bonke abantu bakuleli."Ayisukunyelwa ngendlela indaba yokufa kwamaphoyisa kuleli. Kumele ngabe yicala elikhulu leli kodwa kunakwa indaba yokuthi kwahlakazwa ithimba elalilwa nokubulawa kosopolitiki. Bonke abantu babalulekile kodwa kubukeka sengathi kubekwa phambili osopolitiki," usho kanje.Uthe zikhona izindlela ezazisetshenziswa ukulwa nobugebengu obuhleliwe kuleli."Akumele kwehliswe isabelomali esithinta ukuphepha ngoba lokhu kushaya ngqo abantu abahluphekayo. Azikho izimoto zokuthi amaphoyisa aye emphakathini ayolwa nobugebengu kodwa kulokhu kwehliswa isabelomali," kusho uNgwenya. UMnuz Peter Ntsime, iPhini lesibili likaMengameli weSapu, ukhale ngomdlandla ophansi emaphoyiseni.Ubalule ukuthi ezinye izikhala zokhomishana bamaphoyisa kwezinye izifundazwe kazivaliwe, kunabantu ababambile kuzona."Bancane abantu abathemba amaphoyisa kuleli. Sibi kakhulu isimo embuthweni, kanjalo nendaba yezinsiza kusebenza yizona zinto esihlale sikhala ngazo," usho kanje.UKhomishana wamaPhoyisa kuzwelonke, uGeneral Fannie Masemola, utshele amalungu ePhalamende, ukuthi bakwazile ukwehlisa ubugebengu phezu kwezinselelo ezikhona embuthweni.Ubale izinto eziningi ezenziwe ngamaphoyisa kubalwa ukuhlakazwa kwezidleke zezidakamizwa ezifundazweni ezehlukene, ukubopha inqwaba yezigebengu ebezifunelwa amacala abucayi kanjalo nezinye izinto ezinhle ezenziwe amaphoyisa.USolwazi Firoz Cachalia oyiibamba likaNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa, uthe izinto okukhalwe ngazo ziyalungiswa.Ukhale ngokulahleka kwezibhamu emaphoyiseni athe zigcina zisetshenziswa ekwenzeni ubugebengu.

"Thina simi ngomumo mayelana nokhetho nakuba lungakamenyezelwa usuku oluzobanjwa ngalo. Ngaphambi kokuba kumenyezelwe usuku lokhetho, kuzobhekwa izinto eziningi okubalwa nokuthi alushayisani nezivivinyo zasezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme nezika-matric."Uthe banobudlelwano obuhle noMnyango kaMgcinimafa uma kwenzeka bedinga imali ethe xaxa ukube kubanjwe ukhetho."Siyazi ziningi izinto ezidinga imali ezweni kodwa sithemba ukuthi sizowuthola uchatha uma kuvela isidingo."
BAZOHLAWULISWA abashayeli abangawashintshile ama-number plate ezimoto zabo KwaZulu-Natal, njengoba uMnyango wezokuThutha, usubeke umnqamlajuqu wokuthi bakwenze lokho ingakapheli le nyanga.Lokhu kuvezwe wuMphathiswa walo mnyango uMnuz Siboniso Duma enkulumeni abenayo emsakazweni uKhozi FM izolo ekuseni.UDuma uveze ukuthi abashayeli abasashayela ngezinombolo ezindala ezimotweni zabo kumele bakusukumele ngokushesha ukuthi bazishintshe."Wuhlelo lolu esathi siqala ukulwethula sabika ukuthi kuzothatha izinyanga ezingu-24 ukuthi wonke umshayeli ashintshe i-number plate yakhe emotweni ukuze sifane nezinye izifundazwe, okukade zaluqala lolu hlelo. I-KZN bese kuyiyona kuphela kuleli esebenzisa uhlelo oludala kodwa ngesikhathi lwethulwa abaningi bakhombisa ukuluthakasela, bancane kakhulu abangakalusukumeli ngakho sibeke umnqamulajuqu manje wokuthi abangakazenzi izinguquko kumele baphuthume," kusho uDuma.Uthe ngalolu hlelo ziningi izinguquko ezenzekile, ikakhulu ezithinta ubugebengu bokudunwa kwezimoto emalokishini amakhulu esifundazweni."Ukwenza lolu hlobo lwezinombolo kwehlise kakhulu izinga lokudunwa kwezimoto emalokishini okukhona kuwo uMlaza namanye emadolobheni amakhulu, ngakho ngalo sijabule kakhulu kungakho sinxusa ukuthi abashayeli balusukumele kusemanje. Okunye esikhuthaza abashayeli ukuthi bakwenze wukuthi babikele izinkampani zemishwalense namabhange abawasebenzisayo ukuze azi uma sekwenziwe izinguquko ezimotweni zabo," kusho yena.
UMPHATHISWA wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana noBuholi boMdabu KwaZulu-Natal, uMfundisi uThulasizwe Buthelezi, usenxuse abantu baseJozini ukuthi basuke ezindaweni ezingaholela ekutheni babe sebungozini yokudilikelwa yizakhiwo ezisesimweni esingesihle.Lokhu kulandela imvula ebihambisana nesiphepho esihlasele kule ndawo ngempelasonto.UButhelezi uveze ukuthi imvula ebihambisana nomoya, zidale umonakalo kwalimala ingqalasizinda nemizi ezindaweni ezehlukene."Kubikwa ukuthi ezindaweni eziningi izigxobo zikagesi zilele phansi, nokuletha ingozi enkulu emphakathini. Izigxobo ezisiza ekudonseni i-network kumaselula nazo kubikwa ukuthi zilimale kabi futhi iningi labantu abatholakali, kunzima ukuthi kube khona ukuxhumana okujwayelekile. Okwamanje abahola ithimba lezinhlekelele basemphakathini ukubheka ukuthi isimo sibi kangakanani. Okusijabulisayo ukuthi kuze kube yimanje ayikho imibiko ethi kukhona abadlulile emhlabeni futhi nosizo abaludingayo lusendleleni," kuchaza uButhelezi.Uthe umnyango usebenzisana nomasipala nakule ndawo, inkampani kagesi i-Eskom nezinye izinhlaka ukubuyisela isimo kwesijwayelekile."Isimo sezulu esihlasela manje siyasikhathaza kakhulu kodwa njengohulumeni sizibophezele ekutheni sisheshe sisisukumele isimo esifana nalesi sokunika uxhaso emphakathini elahlekelwe. Ukubhekelela ukuphepha nokuhlala kahle kwabantu yikhona esikubeka eqhulwini, siyabonga kuwona wonke amathimba ethu asebenza ngokuzimisela. Sinxusa ukuthi imiphakathi ihlale iphephile ikakhulukazi ezintweni ezithinta ugesi, ingalinge isondele eduzane kwazo, izibike eziphathimandleni ezibhekele leyo ngqalasizinda," kuchaza uButhelezi. Abezimo eziphuthumayo bakwaSouth African Weather Service - ngasekupheleni kwesonto eledlule - bakhiphe izexwayiso ngesimo sezulu esingesihle. Kuthiwe isishingishane sizogasela ezindaweni ezihlukene enhla kwesifundazwe.Izindawo okukhona kuzo uNongoma, Vryheid naseNquthu - kule mpelasonto - bezihlaselwe imvula enamandla ebihambisana namakhaza.
Amaphoyisa akuqinisekisile ukuthi aphenya icala lokuzama ukubulala kulandela ukuhlaselwa kukasomabhizinisi uBrown Mogotsi eVosloorus, empumalanga yeGoli.Okhulumela i-SAPS kuzwelonke uBrigadier Athlenda Mathe uthe ukuhlasela kwenzeke ngoMsombuluko ebusuku ngezithuba zabo-10:00."Ngezithuba zabo-10 ebusuku, sibizwe unogada ongaphansi kwenkampani ezimele, esibikela ngokuthi kunesigameko sokudubula endaweni. Sithumele ithimba lamaphoyisa, sathi sifika sathola unogada noMnuz Brown Mogotsi, obike ukuthi ubehlaselwa abantu abebehamba ngeveni elimhlophe kudutshulwa imoto yakhe,” kusho uMathe.Uqhube wathi uMogotsi ukhuthazwe ukuthi avule icala kodwa utshele amaphoyisa ukuthi usahlukumezeke kakhulu."Uthe ubezizwa engaphephile. Usithembise ukuthi ngehora lesi-8 ekuseni uzoziveza esiteshini samaphoyisa eVosloorus ukuze avule icala ngokusemthethweni," kusho uMathe."Siphenya icala lokuzama ukubulala okwamanje, kanti sesiyithathile imoto. Ngesikhathi sithola umbiko ngezithuba zabo-10 ebusuku, sithumele ithimba longoti bezobunhloli ukuthi liqoqe ubufakazi obuphathekayo obuzosisiza ukuthi sixazulule leli cala nokuthi empeleni kwenzekeni lapha," kusho uMathe.
USOBISHINI usigagxamabhande wophiko loKlebe owabanjwa eqamba amanga phambi kwekhomishini ephenya izinsolo ezenziwa uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi.IKhomishini yeJaji uMbuyiseli Madlanga imfunisa okomsebenzi uBrigadier Lesiba Mokoena owabanjwa eqamba amanga ngesikhathi evele phambi kwekhomishini ngeledlule.UMadlanga uthe bafuna ukuthi uMokoena aphinde azophekwa ngemibuzo phambi kwekhomishini. Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi kuqhubeka ukulalelwa kobufakazi.UMokoena uyingxenye yamaphoyisa ophiko loKlebe asolwa ngokuzama ukuphazamisa ukuboshwa kukasomabhizinisi obhekene noxhaxha lwamacala, uMnuz Katiso "KT" Molefe, kanti wakhipha umyalelo wokuba amaphoyisa angaphansi kophiko loKlebe aye emzini kaMolefe ngosuku aboshwa ngalo eboshelwa icala lokubulala unjiniyela, uMnuz Armand Swart.Ngesikhathi evele phambi kwekhomishini ngeledlule, uMokoena wabuzwa ngomyalezo awubhala eqoqweni likaWhatsApp okwakuxoxa kulo amaphoyisa ophiko loKlebe ayejutshwe emzini kaMolefe.UMokoena waphika ukuthi ukhona umbhalo awufaka kuleli qoqo kodwa ikhomishini yamvalela ekhoneni, yamkhombisa imibhalo ayifaka.UMokoena wagcina evumile ukuthi kukhona akubhala kuleli qoqo. Izolo, uMadlanga uthe bafuna ukuthi uMokoena abuye."Mangakanani amathuba okuthi singakwazi ukumthola maduze?"Ohola ofakazi, u-Advocate Lee Segeels-Ncube, uthe bake bazama ukumthola uMokoena kodwa wabhala wacisha."Usitshele ukuthi akakwazi ukuvela phambi kwekhomishini okwamanje, usalinde ukuxoxa nabameli bakhe. Uthe akaqondi kahle ukuthi njengoba sifuna ukuthi abuye ngabe usewumsolwa yini?"Izolo, ikhomishini iqhubekile nokupheka ngemibuzo amaphoyisa angaphansi kophiko loKlebe.UWarrant Officer Sabelo Nkosi uthe sasingekho isidingo sokuba bajutshwe emzini kaMolefe.UNkosi uthe kwakungathunyelwa amaphoyisa asesiteshini esiseduze nomuzi kaMolefe."Ngesikhathi ngifonelwa kwakufanele siye kokwenza uphenyo eNorth West. Ngangikude kakhulu mina nomuzi kaMolefe ngesikhathi ngitshelwa ukuthi angijike. Mhlawumbe ngangikude ngebanga elingu-60km. Angikholwa ukuthi isiteshi esiseduze sikude ngebanga elingu-20km."Khonamanjalo: Lizoqhubeka namhlanje ikomiti lasePhalamende eliphenya izinsolo ezifanayo.Phakathi kwabantu abazokwethula ubufakazi kuleli sonto, yiPhini likaNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa, uNkk Polly Bhoshielo noNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa obambile, uSolwazi Firoz Cachalia.
UYISE womrepha ongasekho, uKiernan "AKA" Forbes, ugonyuluke ngobuhlungu abuzwiswa yinkulumo yobenguNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa kuleli, uGeneral Bheki Cele ngesikhathi evele ekomitini lasePhalamende emasontweni adlule.Ekhuluma kwiSMWX YouTube Channel, uTony Forbes uthe inkulumo kaCele yathunuka umndeni ka-AKA isilonda ebesisabhibha. UCele watshela ikomiti, eliphenya ngenkohlakalo edla lubi emaphoyiseni nokugxambukela kwamaphoyisa, ukuthi amaphoyisa akholwa wukuthi owayeyintombi yalo mrepha, u-Anele "Nellie" Tembe, wabulawa nokuthi wazama kangaki ukuba leli cala libuyele enkantolo.UCele wathi amaphoyisa aphenya kabanzi futhi aya kaningi kumshushisi efuna icala liqulwe kodwa kwaba nhlanga zimuka nomoya. Wathi aze afuna isitifiketi ukuze icala liqulwe ngasese, kodwa kwangenzeka. Kwahluleka ngisho esexhumana nomengameli wezwe. Waze wagcizelela ukuthi uyafuna ukwazi ukuthi kungani leli cala lingaqulwa enkantolo.Nakuba uCele esho kanje kodwa uForbes uthe uCele wabahlukumeza ngale nkulumo yakhe. Uthe amazwi kaCele abuhlungu ngoba ubheca u-AKA njengombulali. UForbes uthe amazwi enza abanye abantu ezinkundleni zokuxhumana bathi babevele besola ukuthi u-AKA wabulala uNellie ngo-2021.UNellie, owayeneminyaka ewu-22, washona emuva kokuwa esuka estezi seshumi ehhotela laseCape Town ekubeni u-AKA wabulawa ngokudutshulwa ngaphandle kwendawo yokudlela eThekwini ngoFebhuwari 10, 2023. UForbes uthe okumphathe kabuhlungu ngenkulumo kaCele wukuthi udaba lokufa kukaNellie lusaphenywa, yingakho aphoxeka uma aboPhiko lwezokuShushisa eWestern Cape bengakhiphanga isitatimende esiphikisa uCele. Utuse kakhulu amaphoyisa aKwaZulu-Natal ngokusukumela icala lokubulawa kuka-AKA.

USOLA ukuthi kwahlelwa ngaphambi kosuku lwesigameko ukubulawa kowesilisa waseWoza, KwaNzimakwe, eMargate, umndeni wakhe kulandela ukutholwa kwesidumbu sakhe sesonakele ngeledlule.Isidumbu sikaMnuz Mlondi Jula (23) obenamanxeba okugwazwa ezindaweni ezibucayi emzimbeni, sitholwe wumphakathi namaphoyisa eCentocow, eCreighton, eduze komfula uMzimkhulu ngoLwesithathu ntambama.Lapho esitholwe khona kuthiwa bekukhona nezimbuzi ezimbili ezibulewe, umswani wazo, amakhandlela ayimibalabala anezinaliti namabhayi ezangoma. Umufi wagcina ukubonwa ephila ngo-Okthoba 22, ekhapha abesilisa abangontanga yakhe abaziwayo, okukhona kubo nongumakhelwane, ukuyogeza ngembuzi emfuleni uMzimkhulu.Udadewabo kamufi, uNksz Noluthando "Thuwe” Jula elandisa ngokutholakala kwakhe, uthe amaphoyisa asesiteshini iCreighton abe wusizo olukhulu ekutheni bakwazi ukugcina bethole ithambo likamfowabo.Uthe emva kokubona ukuthi kuhamba izinsuku engatholakali, banikele kubo kwentombi yoyedwa wabasolwa ukuba ibaphelezele kuyiwe kubo, kuyobhekwa ukuthi akekho khona, uma engatholakali, kwaziswe abazali bakhe ukuthi bahambe nomuntu maqede wangabuya, nabo banyamalala. Uthe ngeshwa babuya kungekho okuphathekayo abakuthola ngaphandle kokuthi basizwe amaphoyisa aseCreighton athatha imininingwanee yabo ukuze abasize uma kukhona umkhondo ovelayo."Ngikhethe ukuthi ngibhale ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ukuthi silahlekelwe umfowethu, ngachaza indlela ahambe ngayo ekhaya, ngafaka isithombe sakhe, esabasolwa nesemoto,” kusho uNksz Jula.Uthe bekungoLwesithathu ngesikhathi ethintwa nguSergeant Cebisa, athe nguye obe wusizo kakhulu emtshela ukuthi kukhona umkhondo othembisayo, abasondele nganeno. "Nakuba sathatha isikhathi ukufika kodwa amaphoyisa kanjalo nabemoto yezidumbu, benza ubuntu, basilinda saze safika ngaphambi kokuba kuthathwe isidumbu. Ngenxa yokwethuka kakhulu, angisondelanga eduze kodwa abanye bomndeni bahamba bayobheka, baqinisekisa ukuthi nguyena ngempela,” kuchaza uNksz Jula.Uthe isidumbu sitholwa nje, ngunina wowesilisa ongumngani woyedwa wabasolwa, olume amaphoyisa indlebe ethi le moto okuthiwa kufunwa umnikazi oduke nayo, isegcekeni lakwakhe."Uma echaza, uthi indodana yakhe yathintwa ngabasolwa ngo-Okthoba 23, bethi ayibasize bayolanda imoto ebhajwe ngayizolo ngasemfuleni. Indodana yalona wesifazane yafuna omunye wesilisa wendawo ukuthi alekelele ngemoto yakhe ukuze iyodonswa,” kusho uNksz Jula. Uthe lona wesilisa wabasiza ukudonsa imoto kodwa waba nemibuzo yokuthi ibize ibhajwe emfuleni nje bekwenziwani, nakuba engagculisekanga ngencazelo yabo kodwa bamtshela ukuthi bebeyogeza. Unina womngani wabasolwa uqhubekile, wathi isidonsiwe imoto, bebelokhu behamba ngayo endaweni izinsukwana, kwaze kwaba ingoLwesibili olwedlule, lapho abacele khona lona wesilisa (indodana yalona wesifazane) ukuthi akabaphuthumise eMargate, ukuyobamba ibhasi eliya eGoli. Inombolo yendodana ewumngani wabasolwa kayitholakalanga."Bamshiye nayo imoto, bamyalela ukuthi athuthe ngayo izingane zesikole bese imali eyiletha kubo. Unina usebikela amaphoyisa ngoba ebona ukuthi le moto eshiywe endodaneni yakhe iyafana nale ezungeza ezinkundleni zokuxhumana okuvela ukuthi umnikazi wayo unyamalele, nayo ayaziwa ukuthi iphi,” kusho uNksz Jula. UNksz Jula uthe akakholwa ukuthi baye eGoli ngempela abasolwa njengoba bebuye baveza ukuthi ibhasi eliya khona sebezoligibelela ePinetown."Ngisola ukuthi badukisa umkhondo, cishe basekhona lana esifundazweni,” usho kanje.Uthe kubangcwabe bephila ukubulawa kukamfowabo, athe ubengesiye umuntu obeba nenxa nomuntu. Umchaze njengomuntu obehlale ezikhululekele. "Ukubulawa kwakhe sisola ukuthi yinto abayihlela ngaphambi kokuba kuhanjwe. Bebazi ukuthi bayokwenza imikhuba emfuleni, base bekhetha ukuthi kube wuye umhlatshelo,” kusho uNksz Jula.USihlalo weKwaZulu-Natal Traditional Healers Association (KZNTHA), uMnuz Thandonjani Hlongwane, uthe isenzo sabasolwa asihlanganise lutho nokugezwa kwabantu okujwayelekile, kodwa siwubuthakathi."Akubulawa muntu uma uyogeza emfuleni ngoba usuke uyokhipha isinyama noma uyozihlambulula amathunzi. Entweni ekanje, lapho kubulawa khona umuntu, kusuke kwenziwa imikhuba yokuganga kokunye efaka phakathi nokuthwala,” kusho uHlongwane.

KUBI ehhovisi leSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini, njengoba lithumele imiyalezo eshayisanayo ngenkulumo yeMbube okuthiwa izokuba namhlanje esigodlweni KwaKhangelamankengane.Umabhalane ehhovisi leSilo, uMnuz Arnold Ndamase, ukhiphe umyalezo othi iMbube izokwethula umyalezo ewubhekise esizweni.Emva kwamahora, okhulumela iSilo, uMntwana uThulani kaGqikazi Zulu, uthumele umyalezo othi ihoxisiwe inkulumo yeSilo. Ngokuhamba kesikhathi, kubuye kwangena othi kungamampunge ukuthi ihoxisiwe inkulumo yeSilo.Kwenzeka konke lokhu nje, kunamahlebezi okuthi uMntwana uThulani usexoshiwe esikhundleni nakuba kungekho isimemezelo esisemthethweni esenziwe.Imibiko yokuxoshwa kukaMntwana uThulani iqale ukusabalala ngeledlule, iMbube yaze yaphawula ngala mahlebezi. Ngesikhathi iMbube iphawula ngamahlebezi ikhombise ukuthi ngeke imxoshe uMntwana uThulani.Khonamanjalo: Ayaqhubeka amalungiselelo omgcagco weSilo noNksz Nomzamo Myeni.Ngokwesimemo esisabalale ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, udwedwe lweMbube luzokhuphuka ngeSonto.INdlunkulu kaZulu ibingakalumemezeli ngokusemthethweni udwendwe kodwa omunye walabo abaluhlelayo uthe ayaqhubeka amalungiselelo.Isimemo siveza ukuthi udwendwe luzokuba sesigodlweni KwaKhangelamankengane, siphinde siveze ukuthi kuzoqala kube nomkhehlo ngoLwesihlanu, eJozini Stadium.Omunye wabantu ababhalwe esimemweni sodwendwe uthe bayaqhubeka nokuthatha uhlu lwezimenywa.Uyalele Isolezwe ukuba lixhumane nabaseNdlunkulu kaZulu uma lifuna ukuthola ngamalungiselelo."Thina kasigunyaziwe ukukhuluma nezintatheli, abaNtwana yibona abanelungelo lokukhuluma nezintatheli."UMntwana uThulani uthe ubengakezwa lutho ngalo mgcagco.UMaMyeni ungowesithathu eSilweni, iMbube yambeka esigodlweni eMachobeni, eNgwavuma. Udwendwe kwakufanele lukhuphuke ngoJanuwari, kodwa lwabuye lwahlehla. Kwaba nesidididi ngesikhathi kuhlehla udwendwe njengoba kwaphuma nencwadi eyayiyalela ukuba kuhoxiswe nemihlomulo etholwa uMaMyeni.IMbube iganwe nguNdlunkulu Ntokozo Mayisela Zulu, ozinze KwaNkomonye. ISilo noNdlunkulu uKaMayisela babopha ifindo likasofa silahlane enkantolo ngo-2021, nokwalandelwa ukuthi bese iSilo sizishaye zonke siphinde simbese abesekhweni laso eNewcastle.Kuze kube namhlanje uNdlunkulu uKaMayisela akakaze agcagce. Umendo wakhe usuke wabhekana nezivunguvungu njengoba ngasekuqaleni konyaka iMbube yafaka isicelo sokwehlukanisa.Emaphepheni asenkantolo, iMbube yathi umshado wayo naye angeke usalungiseka. Nokho iMbube yagcina isihoxisa isicelo sayo.Kunengoduso yeSilo uNksz Nozizwe Mulela, oyisikhulu sebhange eSwatini.UKaMulela ubekwe esigodlweni okuzalwa kuso iSilo KwaKhangelamankengane, kanti walotsholwa ngo-2022, kodwa akakaze asine. Uke wanyamalala engabonakali emikhosini yaseNdlunkulu kwaze kwanemibiko ethi ucu alusahlangani.Ngasekuqaleni konyaka wakhipha isitatimende lapho ayesho khona ukuthi akakawushiyi umendo. Muva nje, useyabonakala emikhosini yaseNdlunkulu.Kunengoduso uNksz Sihle Mdhluli wasesigodlweni eMashobeni, ezalwa ebukhosini bakwaNdwandwe, eMpumalanga. Kulezi zinsuku uyena obonakala kakhulu eseduze kweSilo emikhosini yaseNdlunkulu.Noma iSilo siya phesheya, sijwayele ukuhamba naye. IMbube yathumela abakhongi ngasekuqaleni kwalo nyaka, yathembisa ngesikhathi kunoMkhosi woMhlanga waseSwatini wakulo nyaka.

Uma kukhona uguquko olungaba khona siyomemezela kwabezindaba nasemphakathini, okwamanje kusahamba kahle kakhulu ukusebenza kukandunankulu nabaphathiswa bakhe bonke."Iqembu elingababeki benkosi kuhulumeni wesifundazwe, iNFP, liyaqhubeka nalo ukuncikiselela amaqembu elibambisene nawo.Leli qembu elinesihlalo esisodwa esiShayamthetho, lifuna ukuthi i-IFP ne-ANC baxoshe abaholi elithi kalisabuthembi ubuholi babo.I-NFP ifuna i-IFP ixoshe uNtuli, bese ukuthi i-ANC yona ixoshe uMphathiswa wezeMpilo, uNksz Nomagugu Simelane noMphathiswa wezeMfundo, uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka.UNksz Simelane noHlomuka bake balandelwa yizinsolo zenkohlakalo kepha umbiko wophenyo olwenziwa uNtuli wabakhipha phambili.UMengameli weNFP, uMnuz Ivan Barnes, usabise ngokuthi bazophuma kuhulumeni wokubambisana uma kungaxoshwa laba baholi.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba ngoMgqibelo.UBarnes uthe abasabuthembi ubuholi bukaNtuli, waveza nokuthi kunezingxoxo abazibamba neMK.I-NFP ihlukene phakathi ngokuhoxa kuhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal.Kukhona amalungu eqembu angafuni nokuyizwa eyokuthi iqembu lihoxe kuhulumeni wesifundazwe.

Wakwazi ukusinda njengoba agcina engaxoshwanga. Okhulumela amaphoyisa esifundazweni saseNorth West, uColonel Adéle Myburgh, uthe amaphoyisa ophiko olukhethekile - okuhlanganisa iProvincial Anti-Gang Unit, Drug Task Team, Tactical Response Team (TRT) Klerksdorp, Johannesburg K9, Carletonville Detectives, Gauteng West Rand District Rural Safety kanye nezinkampani zonogada ezizimele - ahlangane ngemuva kokuthola umbiko ngokudunwa kwamaloli."Ithimba lizithele phezu kwabasolwa ngemuva kokuthi iloli lidunwe ngabo-07:45 emgwaqeni u-R559 lashaqa iloli ebelilayishe inyama, amaphoyisa aphinde ashaqa izimoto ezintathu okusolakala ukuthi zisetshenziswe ukwenza lobu bugebengu," kusho amaphoyisa ngesitatimende. Abasolwa kulindeleke ukuba bavele ngaphambi kweNkantolo yeMantshi yaseCarletonville ngoMsombuluko ngamacala okuduna imoto nokuthumba, kusho amaphoyisa.

Uthe bathola ngoLwesihlanu ukuthi umfowabo wagibela imoto nomunye uzakwabo ayeshayise naye ngesikhathi esifanayo."Kuthiwa lowo zakwabo wehla kuqala, yena wehla kamumva esitobhini sebhasi esingaseBimbos, egaraji lokuthela uphethroli eliKwaSanti,” kusho uSbonelo.Uthe umnikazi wemoto, kuthe uma bembuza, waqinisekisa ukuthi wamshiya kulesi sitobhi, nokuyinto abangazi noma yenzeka ngempela yini. Uthe bahambe inqwaba yezibhedlela eziseThekwini, okukhona kuzo iSt Mary's, RK Khan, Dkt Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial."Sibheke emawodini kanjalo nasemakhazeni azo lezi zibhedlela,” kusho uSbonelo. Uthe baphinde banikela nasemakhazeni kahulumeni asePinetown, Phoenix nasePark Rynie ukuyolahlela, nakhona babuya belambatha. Uthe banovalo ngokulahleka kwakhe."Ngisho nasemsebenzini wakhe basifonela ngoLwesihlanu, bebuza ukuthi uphi ngoba engafikanga emsebenzini nokuyinto angakaze ayenze,” usho kanje.
UBALISA ngokumiswa komntwana wakhe esikoleni unina womfundi waseMtapo High okuthiwa wadlwengulwa nguthisha waze wamkhulelisa. Lo mfundi kwavela ngaphambilini ukuthi wayekade eyintombi esahlolwa. Umsolwa kuleli cala, uMnuz Nhlakanipho Zulu, ubekade evele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseNtuzuma, izolo, icala lahlehliselwa uNovemba 12, njengoba kusakhona ubufakazi obusaqoqwa.Ekhuluma neSolezwe ngaphandle kwenkantolo, unina womgilwa uthe kuze kwadingeka ukuba umntwana wakhe - owenza uGrade 10 - amiswe esikoleni.Uthe lokhu kubangelwe ukuthi kukhona abafundi ebebemgcona ngesimo esamehlela sokudlwengulwa aze agcine esekhulelwa.''Kuze kwathiwa umntwana wami makame kancane ukuza esikoleni kuze kudlule lesi simo. Lokhu kungiphathe kabi njengomzali wakhe. Ngiyazibuza ngiyaziphendula nje ukuthi ngempela kwenzekani ngempilo yomntwana wami?" kanjena.Uthe uzamile nokuthi axhumane noMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal kodwa akukho asizakale ngakho, wathi okumthunuka kakhhulu amanxeba ukwazi ukuthi umntwana wakhe wadlwengulwa izikhawu eziningi.Ukhale ngokuthi abaphephile abantwana abakulesi sikole uma nje kusekhona lo thisha. UGIXABEZWE ngesigwebo esinzima owesilisa obebekwe wuMbuso amacala abucayi okubulala.INkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini igixabeze uSiphamandla Gumede (31) odilikajele abangu-5 yambhansela ngeminyaka engu-40 ngaphezulu ngokulahlwa amacala okubulala, ukuphanga namanye.Lawa macala kuvele ukuthi uGumede wawenza eMlaza eningizimu yeTheku, ngoNovemba 2023. Ababulawa kuleli cala ngoNonthlomelo Golumbiza, Nandipha Ndabeni, Nkosinathi Phutheni, Cebolenkosi Zwane noMbongeni Nkwanyana.Kuthiwa ngoNovemba 13, 2023 uGumede nabanye ayehlome nabo ngezibhamu baya lapho okwakuhlala khona uGolumbiza noNdabeni.UPhutheni wayekade ebavakashele ngesikhathi sesigameko. Kuvela ukuthi uGumede nabanye badubula bephindelela bantshontsha nezinto ezahlukene. Kuzona kwakukhona amaTV, omakhalekhukhwini nokunye.UGolumbiza, Ndabeni noPhutheni baphelela khona lapho. UGumede nabanye basuka endaweni yesigameko baya endlini eseduze lapho okwakukhona uZwane noNkwanyana. Bafika bangachitha sikhathi badubula uZwane noNkwanyana bephindelela bababulala.Ngemva kwalokho uGumede nayenabo baya endlini kaMantengu bafike bamdubula naye bathatha nomakhalekhukhwini wakhe.UMantengu waphuthunyiswa esibhedlela kwabangozi makhaza. UGumede wabe esekhalelwa ngamasongo kaSigonyela.Enkantolo uMshushisi uGugu Xulu, unikeze ithuba ofakazi abazibonela isigameko kwafundwa nezitatimende zemindeni yabafi.UGumede ugwetshwe udilikajele ngecala ngalinye lokubulala, iminyaka engu-10 ngelokuzama ukubulala neminyaka engu-15 ngelokuphanga.Zonke lezi zigwebo uzozidonsa kanye kanye. Kuthe angagwetshwa uGumede wafaka isicelo sokuphikisa isigwebo kwafana nokuthi uthela amanzi emhlane wedada inkantolo yakuphikisa lokho. Okhulumela iNPA, uNatasha Ramkisson-Kara ukwamukele ukugwetshwa kukaGumede.
INDLUNKULU kaZulu ithi ayikakhulunywa eyemigcagco yeSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini.Yize iMbube inondlunkulu abane abalotsholiwe, bonke abakaze bagcagce.IMbube yaqala ukulobola ngo-2021 kodwa kuze kube namhlanje akekho undlunkulu osesinile.Ngasekuqaleni konyaka luke lwakhonjwa eduze udwendwe lweSilo nomunye wondlunkulu kodwa lwagcina lungakhuphukanga.Okhulumela iSilo, uMntwana uThulani Zulu, uthe ayikakhulunywa eyemigcagco."Angifuni nokuthi ngize ngithi ngiyaqala ngiyakuphendula ngoba le nto asikaze siyikhulume nokuyikhuluma. Noma kungathiwa kukhona induku efihlwe emqubeni, ngabe leyo nduku ifihlelwa ngisho nathi balapha ekhaya?"IMbube iganwe nguNdlunkulu Ntokozo Mayisela Zulu, ozinze kwaNkomonye.ISilo noNdlunkulu ukaMayisela babopha ifindo likasofa silahlane enkantolo ngo-2021, nokwalandelwa wukuthi iSilo sizishaye zonke siphinde sembese abesekhweni laso eNewcastle.Kuze kube namhlanje uNdlunkulu ukaMayisela akakaze agcagce.Umendo kaNdlunkulu uke wabhekana nezivunguvungu njengoba ngasekuqaleni konyaka iMbube yafaka isicelo sokwehlukanisa.Emaphepheni asenkantolo, iMbube yathi umshado wayo noNdlunkulu ngeke usalungiseka.Nokho iMbube yagcina isihoxisa isicelo sayo.UNdlunkulu weSilo wesibili nguNozizwe Mulela, oyisikhulu sebhange eSwatini.UNdlunkulu Mulela ubekwe esigodlweni okuzalwa kuso iSilo, kwaKhangelamankengane.UNdlunkulu Mulela walotsholwa ngo-2022, akakaze asine.Uke wanyamalala engabonakali emikhosini yaseNdlunkulu kwaze kwaba nemibiko ethi ucu alusahlangani.Ngasekuqaleni konyaka wakhipha isitatimende lapho ayesho khona ukuthi akakawushiyi umendo, mumva nje useyabonakala emikhosini yaseNdlunkulu.UNdlunkulu wesithathu weSilo uNomzamo Myeni, wasesigodlweni eMachobeni.IMbube yacela isihlobo esihle kwaMyeni, eJozini, ngo-2024.Ngasekuqaleni konyaka kwabikwa ukuthi iMbube izokuya kokwembesa ekhweni layo, bese ziyawushaya.Kwase kubekwe ngisho usuku kodwa lwabuye lwabhuntsha udwendwe.Kuze kube namhlanje akukacaci ukuthi luzokuba nini udwendwe lukaNdlunkulu.UNdlunkulu weSilo wesine uSihle Mdhluli wasesigodlweni eMashobeni.UNdlunkulu uzalwa ebukhosini bakwaNdwandwe, eMpumalanga.Kulezi zinsuku uyena uNdlunkulu obonakala kakhulu eseduze kweSilo emikhosini yaseNdlunkulu.Noma iSilo siya phesheya sijwayele ukuhamba naye.IMbube yathumela abakhongi ngasekuqaleni kwalo nyaka, yathembisa uNdlunkulu ngesikhathi kunoMkhosi woMhlanga waseSwatini.

INkosi uNtombela, ebiphethe izinkomo ezingu-49 nezipho ezinhlobonhlobo futhi iphelezelwa ngamabutho, ithe bebeze kulo mkhosi ngenhloso yokwenza isiko lokuhlambulula isihlalo esishiywe nguyise iNkosi uSiphamandla Ntombela eminyakeni eyedlule.Ithe inethemba lokuthi njengoba sekwenzeke leli siko, konke sekuzohamba kahle esizweni sayo. Sifuna ukwaziswa ukuthi kuqhubekani ngophenyo futhi sifuna kube khona ababoshwayo."UNksz Khulu uthe namanje zisankenketha izinhliziyo ngokubulawa kwabafowabo."Noma ngabe yini abebeyenzile bebengafanelwe ukubulawa ngesihluku esingaka."Uthe abafowabo kabanawo umlando wokuhlupha endaweni."Bebengabantu abebezibambela amatoho nje. Ukhona obebuye abheme lezi zinto zabo kodwa naye ubengantshontshi."Eqhuba, uthe abafowabo bake baba semsindweni emva kokulahleka kwemvu yakwamakhelwane, wathi umakhelwane wanuka abafowabo ngokulahleka kwemvu. Uthe abafowabo baziphika izinsolo."Kwaba nomhlangano lapho khona abafowethu basho ukuthi abazani nemvu elahlekile. Naye umakhelwane wagcina esekhuluma izinto eziningi."Uthe umakhelwane wagcina esesongela izelemani."Umakhelwane owayelahlekelwe yimvu wagcina ethi abahambe endaweni ngoba uzobathumelela ngabafana bakhe. Banqaba ukusuka endaweni. Bathi uma besuka endaweni kuzobonakala sengathi ibona ngempela abebe imvu."Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant Colonel Paul Magwaza, uthe izelamani zitholwe zinamanxeba okudutshulwa."Amaphoyisa asoSizweni aphenya amacala amabili okubulala, imbangela yokubulala ibingakaziwa."
UNgqongqoshe wezoBulungiswa nokuThuthukiswa koMthethosisekelo uMamoloko Kubayi uthi umnyango wakhe uyasicubungula isinqumo seNkantolo eNkulu yaseMalawi mayelana nozibiza ngomprofethi uShepherd Bushiri nomkakhe uMary. INkantolo eNkulu yaseMalawi iwubekele eceleni umyalelo wangaphambilini weNkantolo yeMantshi yaseLilongwe owawuyalela ukuthi laba bashadikazi babuyiselwe eNingizimu Afrika ukuze baquliswe amacala amaningi, ahlanganisa ukukhwabanisa, ukudlwengula, kanye nokushushumbisa imali. Ephendula lesi sinqumo, uKubayi uthe umnyango uzonquma izinyathelo zomthetho ezilandelayo uma sekuphothuliwe ukuhlolwa okuphelele kwesinqumo. Uphinde waqinisekisa ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika isazibophezele ekulandeleni zonke izindlela ezikhona zomthetho ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ubulungiswa buyenzeka. Badedelwa ngebheyili kodwa bagcina bephule imibandela yebheyili base bebaleka kuleli, kodwa balandelwa ukuthi bafike eMalawi nokuyilapho abagcine khona.

Inhloko yoKlebe esifundazweni uMajor General Mboiki Obed Ngwenya uncome amaphoyisa ngomsebenzi wawo. "Sizibophezele ekuhlakazeni amanethiwekhi obugebengu obuhleliwe axhaphaza abantu abasengozini."

Akukhishwe izimvume zokusebenza eziduve ebhodini." UNkk Dudu Nzama we-MK, naye uhambe emazwini kazakwabo wathi ziyadayiswa izimvume zokusebenza yingakho abafaka izicelo namanje besazilindile.Ukhale ngokuboshwa kwamatekisi okudinga kukhishwe enkulu imali uma esededelwa."Amatekisi esifundazweni kuthiwa angu-52 000. Izimvume zokusebenza kuthiwa zingu-27 422. Kuthiwa kunezinye izimvume eziduve emnyangweni ezingu-3 419. Asazi zingaki okuthiwa aziphumile kuze kube yimanje," usho kanje. UNksz Riona Gokool we-DA, uthe le nkinga yamatekisi ihlukumeza izigidi zabantu abawasebenzisayo.Uthe abaphikisani nezikhalo zansuku zonke zosomatekisi ngoba ziyazwakala wathi kudingeka kube nesixazululo kule nkinga."Noma sizeseka izikhalo zosomatekisi kodwa akumele babe ngaphezu komthetho. Sebelinde isikhathi eside bengazitholi izimvume zokusebenza. Bayabizwa kuthiwe abeze bezozilanda, bafike bangazitholii. Bayiswa le nale ekubeni izimoto zabo zishaqwa amaphoyisa," usho kanje. Uphakamise ukuthi kwenziwe ucwaningo ngokuthi zingaki izimvume ezisalinde ukukhishwa bese kwethulwa umbiko esiShayamthetho.UMnuz Mongezi Thwala we-EFF, uthe akumele umnyango ugweve nezimvume bese uthumela amaphoyisa ayobopha amatekisi."Akukhishwe izimvume ukuze kuboshwe abangawulandeli umthetho. Amatekisi aneqhaza elibaluleke kakhulu, atakula izwe amabhasi nezitimela kungekho," usho kanje. UNksz Mbali Shinga weNFP, uthe uma kushaqwa amatekisi abashayeli abaholi, osomatekisi balahlekelwa yimali."Akuphele ukubambezeleka kokukhishwa kwezimvume, kuxegiswe imigoqo eyenza lezi zimvume zingasheshi ukuphuma. Isiteleka samatekisi ahamba amabanga amade ngoMeyi sashiya abagibeli besele dengwane." UMphathiswa wezokuThutha, uMnuz Sboniso Duma, uthe kunezinhlelo ezilandelwayo ngaphambi kokufaka isicelo sokuthola imvume.Ubalule indaba yokuya kusoseshini uyobheka ukuthi sikhona yini isikhala uphinde uye nakumasipala uyokwenza okufanayo bese uya emnyangweni."Siyasebenzisana nenhlangano iSantaco, nososeshini abahlukene esifundazweni. Siyoke sifike sizochaza ngezinye zezinto njengoba kuba namathimba akhiwayo ukuze kulungiswe izinkinga ezikhona. Omasipala bakhala nangesimo sama-renki ukuthi amanye awekho esimeni njengoba uthola ukuthi namathoyilethi awekho esimeni esihle. Kokunye nendawo ayenele yokuthi kupake amatekisi," kusho uDuma. Ukhale nangabanye omalume, abathutha izingane zesikole, abasebenzisa izikwele ukuthi abayilandeli imigudu efanele.
I-SOUTH African Social Security Agency (Sassa), ikhathazekile ngemibiko engelona iqiniso yokuthi bazoyiphinda kabili imali abahola izibonelelo. Le nhlangano ithe le mibiko ingamampunge njengoba kungekho simemezelo esenziwe sokuthi kuzoholwa kabili.Okhulumela iSassa, uMnuz Paseka Letsatsi, unxuse abantu ukuthi bangathumeli imibiko engelona iqiniso ngoba idukisa abantu.Unxuse abahola izibonelelo ukuthi bathembele olwazini oluphuma kwaSassa kuphela."Sinxusa abantu ukuthi ngaphambi kokuba bathumele ulwazi abalubona ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, ukuqinisekisa ubuqiniso balolo lwazi. Ulwazi olungelona iqiniso lufaka ukhwantalala kwabahola izibonelelo," usho kanje. Uthe ulwazi olungu-ngqo baluthumela emakhasini abo asezinkundleni zokuxhumana."Bangu-19 million abantu abahola izibonelelo kuleli ngakho ukuthumela ulwazi olungamampunge, kwenza izigidi zabaholayo bathuke," usho kanje.Uxwayise nabantu ukuthi bayibhekisise into abayibona ezinkundleni zokuxhumana. Le nhlangano ihlale iphunga izindaba ezingelona iqiniso ezisuke zisatshalaliswe emphakathini kusetshenziswa izinkundla zokuxhumana.ULetsatsi uthe abafuna ukuthola ulwazi ngokuthile bangabashayela ukuze bathole ubuqiniso kwaSassa.Bangashayela enombolweni yamahhala ethi: 0800 60 10 11, noma bathumele i-email ku: [email protected], noma baye emakhasini akwaSassa ezinkundleni zokuxhumana.
KUGCINE kuvunyelwene ngemigomo ezolandelwa ukuxazulula ungqingetshe kuhulumeni wokubambisana kwamaqembu ahlukene i-Government of National Unity (GNU).Lokhu kuvezwe esitatimendeni esikhishwe nguSihlalo wekomiti elibhekene nokuxazulula ungqingetshe othinta imigomo kulo hulumeni, uMnuz Paul Mashatile, iPhini likamengameli wezwe.Le migomo kuvunyelwane ngayo emva konyaka njengoba bekunemigomo yesikhashana obekusetshenzwa ngayo. UMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa wajuba leli thimba ukuthi libhekele ungqingetshe obakhona kulo hulumeni njengoba kube nokungaboni ngaso linye ngomthetho wezikole iBasic Education Laws Amendment Act. Umsindo wasuka ngesikhathi kusewumthetho sivivinywa, kukhona izinto amaqembu afana ne-DA, ayengahambisani nazo.Lokhu kwenza noNgqongqoshe weMfundo eyisiSekelo, uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, waduba umcimbi wokusayinwa kwalo mthetho, okwasusa umsindo abanye bethi akaxoshwe esikhundleni.UMashatile uthe bavumelene ngokuthi le migomo izothulwa emkhandlwini wabaholi bamaqembu ahlukene ukuze kubekhona okuzokwengezwa uma kunesidingo."Sivumelene ngokuthi lolu hlaka lokuxazulula ungqingetshe akulona oluthatha izinqumo ezingujuqu kwiGNU. Sivumelene ngokuthi sizohlangana njalo ngenyanga. Okunye okuphakanyisiwe ngukuthi uma kukhona izinto okungavunyelwana ngazo, zizodluliselwa emkhandlwini wabaholi bamaqembu hhayi kumemgameli," usho kanje. Uthe bavumelene ngokuthi kuzoba khona ukungaboni ngaso linye ezingxoxweni.Uqhube wathi njengoba bebengavumelani baze balanda ungoti wezomthetho ukuthi azoxazulula ezinye zezinto ababengavumelani ngazo."Amaqembu afana ne-DA, GOOD Party, UDM ne-Al Jama-Ah, aletha iziphakamiso ngezinye zezinto okumele zibe semigomeni. Uhulumeni weGNU nomkhandlu wabaholi, yibona abanezwi lokugcina." Ubalule nokuthi izinto ezithinta ohulumeni bezifundazwe kanjalo nohulumeni basekhaya azizoba yingxenye yale nkundla. Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi ezifundazweni ezifana neKwaZulu-Natal, kunohulumeni wokubambisana kwamaqembu okuyi-ANC, IFP, DA neNFP.
UTHANDO lokufunda izincwadi nokubhala seluqalile ukuthela izifundo kwintombazanyana yaKwaMpumuza, eMgungundlovu, njengoba isanda kwethula ngokusemthethweni izincwadi zayo ezimbili ezibhale, zashicilelwa ngesiNgisi.Lowo wu-Asithandile Meyiwa ofunda uGrade 10 e-Edendale Technical High, okhiphe izincwadi ezimbili ngesikhathi esisodwa ezisihloko sithi I Want To Be A Model nethi Luminary, azethule emcimbini obuseBessie Head Library, eMgungundlovu, kule nyanga.Exoxa neSolezwe ngalokhu, u-Asithandile (15) uthe ukuthanda ukufunda izincwadi nentshisekelo yokuxoxa izindaba ngokubhala kusukela eminyakeni emithathu edlule, yikhona okumkhuthaze ukuthi aze afike kulesi sigaba ebe esemncane kangaka ngeminyaka. "Incwadi yami yokuqala ixoxa indaba yentombazane esuke inephupho lokumodela kepha ingakhoni ukulifeza ngenxa yezinselelo zenkinga yebhoklolo ebhekana nalo esikoleni efunda kusona, bese kuthi lena ethi Luminary yona ixoxa indaba yentombazane ebhekene nenkinga yokuthi kumele ibambisise isikole futhi yenze nemizamo yokusiza ekhaya ngenxa yokuthi ikhuliswa wumzali ongakhathaleli inhlalakahle nempilo enhle yomndeni wakhe," usho kanje.Uthe lezi zincwadi zibiza u-R170 ngayinye, kanti futhi zizotholakala maduze emtapweni wolwazi wangakubo iBessie Head Libary. Ngale kwalokho, uthe ufisa ukuqhubeka abhale ezinye izincwadi, futhi aqinise nasesikoleni - ngethemba lokuchuma ngakho kokubili.Umama ka-Asithandile, uNksz Xoliswa Ngcoya, uthe lokho okwenzeka manje ngendodakazi yakhe akumethusi njengoba kusukela isencane kunalokhu ibivele yehlukile kwezinye izingane. Uthe bekuthi ontanga bayo bedlala imidlalo ejwayelekile, yona isuke izivalele egunjini layo lokulala ibhala, noma imatasa ngokufunda incwadi ethile."Kusaqala, kwakubuye kungiphathe kabi ukuthi kungani ehlale ezivalele egunjini lakhe lokulala, ngize ngimthethise ngenxa yemfuhlumfuhlu yamaphepha anemibhalo ebengihlale ngiwafica uma ngingena lapho elala khona. Nokho kuthe sesihlangane nomunye wabashicileli bezincwadi uNksz Nelly Shozana, wenza ngabona ukuthi sihlezi phezu kwegolide lana futhi wasisiza ukuthi sishicilele eminye yale misebenzi aseyibhalile. Manje ngibheke ukuthi aqhubeke nobuciko bakhe futhi ngizimisele ukumeseka kukho kokubili nesikole ukuze aphumelele ngakho kubhekwe phambili," kusho uNksz Ngcoya.
KUSOLWA ukuthi ubengafuni ukwaliwa owesilisa waseCato Manor, eThekwini, okuthiwa udubule, wabulala owesifazane wasePort Shepstone, obeqashe kule ndawo.Kulesi sigameko esenzeke ngeSonto, kubulawe ngesihluku uNksz Nthabiseng Ncanane (34), edutshulwa kaningi obeyisoka lakhe, ekotishini abeqashe kulo.Ngesikhathi Isolezwe lihambele indawo yesigameko izolo, emva kokuzwa ngesigameko lifice umastende, uNkk Makhosi Nkosi, ezinyaziswe amalungu ambalwa omphakathi. Utshele Isolezwe ukuthi ubekhona ekhaya ngesikhathi kwenzeka isigameko, yize engawuzwanga umsindo wokuqhuma kwesibhamu."Ngzwe ngaso ngesikhathi ngithunyelwa umyalezo yisiqashi esihlala ekotishini elisondelene nelikamufi, sithi sizwa umuntu ekhala, kuqhuma nesibhamu,” kusho uNkk Nkosi.Uthe ube esehamba eyobheka, wangqongqoza kuzo zonke izindlu kodwa kwangasabela muntu. Uthe uze wamthumelela umyalezo umufi kodwa wangawuphendula. "Ngithe ngisuka ngangijikela ewindini elingemumva, ngalunguza, nokuyilapho engibone khona uNthabi elele kabuhlungu phansi, ingalo igaxeke kabuhlungu embhedeni,” usho kanje.Uthe ubize abesilisa ababe nesibindi sokungena babona ukuthi udutshulwe, wafa.Omunye walabo besilisa, uMnuz Sabelo Nzama, uthe bakubona masinyane ukuthi enye inhlamvu yayingene esandleni, enye ingene okhakhayini. "Kwathi uma esemphendula amaphoyisa, sabona ukuthi ezinye ezimbili zingene esifubeni. Sisola ukuthi mhlawumbe esandleni wadubuleka ethi uyasibamba isibhamu, wagoba, enye yangena ekhanda, kwathi uma ewa, wabe esemdubula ngezimbili esifubeni,” kusho uNzama.Uthe ngesikhathi isixoxwa indaba endaweni, bakhona abaveza ukuthi bambonile umsolwa ehla ngomgwaqo, egqoke izingubo ezigcwele igazi, eya emotweni kanina abeyisebenzisa. "Baze bathi bambuza ukuthi indoda iyibambene kuphi impi, khona bezoyilekelela, bembona egqoke izimpahla ezigcwele igazi. Kuthiwa waphendula wathi abangakhathazeki ngoba inkinga ebikhona usezilungisele,” usho kanje. Kuvela ukuthi umsolwa wabaleka wayocasha eSouth Beach emva kwesigameko, waze wayozinikela emaphoyiseni aseDurban Central ngakusasa. UNzama uthe babuye bezwa ngamalungu omphakathi ukuthi owesilisa kungenzeka ukuthi wayehlose ukumbulala ebusuku ngoMgqibelo umufi njengoba wayenkanise ngemoto ubusuku bonke, emcuthele. "Okusho ukuthi idlozi likamufi lasebenza ngoba ukube wayekhona endlini ngoMgqibelo, wayezombulala, maqede kungaboni muntu,” kusho uNzama. Isolezwe lithole ngemithombo yalo ukuthi umufi ubeke axoxe ngokuthi usemalile umsolwa ngoba akasamfuni, kodwa akezwa mshini.Omunye umthombo uveze ukuthi ngoMgqibelo ntambama umufi wayehleli emotweni eyiPolo ngaphandle kwasemqashweni, nokwathi uma edlula umsolwa, banyusa amawindi."Wahamba wayongena endlini umsolwa ngethemba lokuthi umufi uzomlandela, nokho kwangenzeka lokho,” kusho umthombo.Uqhube wathi umsolwa wabe esehamba, umufi wasala wangena emqashweni wakhe. "Akwaziwa ukuthi wahamba nini ngoba akalalanga emqashweni wakhe. Yilapho okwafika khona umsolwa-ke, wangena, wahlala ngaphakathi, wakhempela umufi owaze wabuya ngakusasa,” kusho umthombo. UNzama uthe bona abangena ngaphakathi endaweni yesigameko, babona ukuthi kwakuliwa ngoba izinto zazimapeketwane.UNkk Nkosi uthe abambonanga umsolwa ephuma ebaleka. Uthe umufi bese kuphele iminyaka emine eyisiqashi sakhe futhi engowesifazane othobekile. "Naye umsolwa ubengakaze akhombise ukuthi ungumuntu onolaka. Njalo uma uhlangana naye ubebingelela ebheke phansi, angakubuki nhlobo emehlweni,” kusho uNkk Nkosi, othe akakhumbuli ebona lezi zithandani zixabana.Uthe sibathusile isigameko, wathi ezinye iziqashi zakhe namanje azikabuyeli emakotishini azo, selokhu zavakashela ezihlotsheni emva kwesigameko.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi izithandani zaqala ukuthandana ngoFebhuwari nyakenye. Lathola nokuthi umufi ubengowesifazane obesephothule izifundo zobuthishela. Kuthiwa ubewusizo ezinganeni zendawo ezichushisa kwiMathematics. Kuvela nokuthi bese ethole umsebenzi phesheya, ezofulathela elakuleli ngoJanuwari ngonyaka ozayo.Umndeni kamufi ufikile endaweni yesigameko uzolanda umphefumulo wakhe ngehlahla. Lithe uma licela ukukhuluma nawo Isolezwe, umalume wakhe othe unguMnuz Nkosinathi Ndovela, obebonakala ukuthi ulusizi, wathi akukho abazokuphawula. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uConstable Thenjiswa Ngcobo, uthe amaphoyisa aseCato Manor abophe owesilisa oneminyaka engu-41 kulandela isigameko sokubulawa kowesifazane oneminyaka engu-34 eCato Manor."Owesifazane udutshulwe wafa ngeSonto,” kusho uConst Ngcobo, othe umsolwa bekulindeleke ukuthi avele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini kuleli sonto.
KUTHIWA beziyinkukhu nempaka izihlobo zakwa-K, KwaMashu, okuvele izolo, ukuthi ukungezwani kwazo kugcine kukhipha isidumbulu ngendlela enesihluku. Isidumbu sikaNksz Slindile Mkhize (33), ebesingenalo ikhanda, sitholwe phezu kombhede ekamelweni lakhe ngesikhathi kubhulwa umlilo endlini okuthiwa ibishiswe ngumsolwa.Ngokusho kukadadewabo kamufi, uNkk Smangele Mgwaba, umuntu ogile lo mhlola ngumzala wabo okuthiwa uvele washaqwa ngamaphoyisa. Elandisa ngesigameko, uthe bathole inqwaba yezingcingo zivela komakhelwane, bebatshela ukuthi abaphuthume ekhaya ngoba kuyasha."Ngaleso sikhathi omakhelwane bese bevele bekhona ekhaya, bematasa bezama ukucisha umlilo ngamanzi besebenzisa amabhakede,” kusho uNkk Mgwaba. Uthe bona bafike omakhelwane sebebize abezicisha mlilo kanjalo namaphoyisa. Uthe bese zikhona izinsolo zokuthi indlu isha nje inomufi ungaphakathi, wathi ngaleso sikhathi umsolwa naye ubezama ukuzenza samuntu olekelelayo ngokucisha umlilo kodwa ebonakala ukuthi uhudula izinyawo."Ubuziwe ukuthi uphi ukhiye wasendlini ebisha, wathi akanawo. Kwabuzwa owasemjondolo wakhe alala kuwo, ongaphandle, wathi umdukele,” kuchaza uNkk Mgwaba. Uthe kuthe ngesikhathi ekhuthuzwa emaphaketheni, watholakala ukhiye."Kuphuthunywe ngaphakathi endlini enkulu, watholakala eshonile uSli. Kuthe abanye besamangazwe yilokho, bengakaboni nakahle ukuthi ikhanda alikho, abanye bavele bathola ibhakede emjondolo kamsolwa, ebelinento egungquzayo phakathi. Bathi uma belivula, bazithela phezu kwekhanda likaSli,” usho kanje.Uthe njengoba amaphoyisa ebesevele ekhona endaweni yesigameko, zivele zamkhalela khona lapho. Uveze ukuthi umuzi owomndeni kodwa izihlobo ezindala okukhona kuzo naye uqobo, bezingahlali khona, njengoba zonke sezagana, zihlala emizini yazo."Kahle hle basele bathathu kulo muzi. Lona owesithathu uphila ngezidakamizwa ngakho uhlale engekho ekhaya. Bese laba-ke bavame ukusala bobabili,” kulandisa uNkk Mgwaba.Udalule ukuthi kwenzeka lesi sigameko nje, bese kuphele amasonto amathathu umufi etholele umsolwa incwadi yesivimbelo kulandela ukumbeka isandla, bexabana. "Bebengazwani impela, baze bahlala ngokuhlukana, umufi ehlala endlini enkulu, bese umsolwa ahlale emjondolo ongaphandle,” kusho uNksz Mgwaba. Uthe basola ukuthi umbulale ngoLwesithathu, kwathi izolo washisa indlu ngoba ezama ukugqiba ubufakazi, wathi basola nokuthi zikhona izidakamizwa ebezisetshenziswa umsolwa uma bebuka isihluku abulale ngaso umufi. "Siyaqala ukubona into enje. Okusehlele kunzima, asikwazi nokukhuluma,” kusho uNkk Mgwaba. Isolezwe lithole ukuthi ingxabano yalaba bazala ibihlale imayelana nendlu egcine ishiswa umsolwa. Kuthiwa umsolwa ubehlale ethi indlu ngeyakhe, wayishiyelwa nguninakhulu osashona, ngesikhathi umufi naye ethi ngeyakhe, naye wayishiyelwa ngunina ongasekho emhlabeni. Kuvela ukuthi bagcina behlala ngokuhlukana, umufi wahlala kuyona le ndlu, ngesikhathi umsolwa ehlala emjondolo ongaphandle.Kuthiwa bebehlale belwa-ke bebanga lokhu babuye babuyisane, kuphele isikhashana babuye basusane.UNkk Mgwaba, obezwakala elusizi, akaziqinisekanga lezi zinsolo. USOLA isandla semfene umndeni wowesifazane wasekuThuleni, eBhamshela, okuthiwa utholwe ngoLwesithathu ebulawe ngesihluku nozakwabo wasemsebenzini enkampanini kashukela eWartburg. Kulesi sigameko esihlasimulisa umzimba kubulawe uNksz Zamile Makhanya (49) nozakwabo uMnuz Simo Khanyile. Izidumbu zabafi, okuthiwa bahambisana ngemoto eyodwa ngoMsombuluko bephuma emsebenzini, zitholwe esimobeni esiseduze kwesibhedlela iMontebello ngoLwesithathu. Kuthiwa zitholwe zishe zangqongqa, zigqishwe ebhuthini yemoto kaKhanyile ebisashunqa intuthu. Kuthiwa amaphoyisa athole amagobolondo ezinhlamvu alinganiselwa ku-24 endaweni yesigameko, okudwebe isithombe sokuthi bafe ngokudutshulwa.Isolezwe lithole udaba maqede lathinta isihlobo sikaNksz Makhanya, esikhulume sacela ukungadalulwa.Sithe baqale ukuqaphela ukuthi kukhona okonakele ngesikhathi uNksz Makhanya engabuyi emsebenzini. Uthe bahambe bayobika emaphoyiseni, alandela umkhondo wemoto eyayihamba abafi."Kuvele ukuthi ihambe yaze yayofika esimobeni lapho betholakale khona bengasekho. Ibisashunqa. Asazi ukuthi njengoba ibishunqa nje, ibishiswe nini, bona babulawe nini,” kusho isihlobo.Sithe bezwe ngandlebenye ukuthi abafi badunwe imoto, sebezofika ngasekhaya, wathi lezi zinsolo abazikholwa. "Asikholwa wukuthi inhlosongqangi bekuwukuduna imoto, ngoba uma uduna imoto, usuke unenhloso yokuyithatha. Njengoba begcine beshiselwa kuyo, lokho kusho ukuthi abasolwa bebengafuni yona imoto kodwa bebefuna abafi befile,” kusho isihlobo. "Sisola isandla semfene ngokubulawa kwabo ngesihluku. Umuntu owenza nje, usuke enenzondo embi ngalabo ababulala kanje,” usho kanje.Umthombo wangaphakathi kule nkampani kashukela uthe bezikhona izinsongo ebezitholwa wuNksz Makhanya komunye uzakwabo, okungacaci ukuthi bebebangani ephathekayo. "Lo zakwabo ngenyanga edlule waze wayokhuluma nodadewabo kamufi, obesebenza nabo ethi akazi ukuthi umufi umhlukumezelani. Waze wamtshela ukuthi into azoyenza uzogcina emshaya bese ephelelwa wumsebenzi,” kusho umthombo.Uthe lona wesifazane watshela udadewabo kamufi ukuthi umufi angacabangi ukuthi uyosala kamnandi enkampanini uma yena kwenzeka exoshwa."Kuthiwa wamtshela ukuthi bayohamba bobabili noma kuyoduma izulu,” kusho umthombo. Uthe lolu daba bese lwaziwa ngisho nawumphathi wabo, okuthiwa wake wazama ukuxazulula kodwa kwanhlanga zimuka nomoya. "Asazi ke uma lona wesifazane esebulawa ngesihluku esinje ehamba nozakwabo,” kusho umthombo.Omunye umthombo uveze ukuthi ngosuku lwesigameko uNksz Makhanya wayesebenza i-shift eyayizomkhipa ebusuku kakhulu. Uthe njengoba bebehanjiswa yimoto yangaphakathi emsebenzini, watshela umshayeli ukuthi angazikhathazi ngokumlinda njengoba ayesezosebenza i-overtime."Wamtshela ukuthi umuntu owayezomshintsha, wayeseveze ukuthi ngeke eseza. Nokho kuthiwa wabuye wacishe waphenduka undingasithebeni, lo zakwabo esebuye efika, kwaphoqqa ukuthi agoduke,” kusho umthombo wesibili.Uveze ukuthi yilapho okwavela khona uKhanyile nosizo lwemoto, njengoba naye wayezoshayisa ngesikhathi esithe ukudlula kancane kuleso okushayisa ngaso uNksz Makhanya."Wamlinda, bahambisana, engumuntu ozodlula amshiye ekhaya kanti sebezokwehlelwa wumshophi ke,” kuchaza umthombo wesibili.

KUBAHLWELE emini ababanjwe "nomphako" bekopela ngesikhathi bebhala izivivinyo zika-matric. Akubodwa laba kuphela abazoshushiswa kulandelwa imigomo ethinta ukukopela kodwa nalabo ababanjwe besebenzisa omakhalekhukhwini ngesikhathi kubhalwa.Umqondisi jikelele eMnyangweni wezeMfundo eyisiSekelo, uMnuz Mathanzima Mweli, uthe izivivinyo zika-matric zisahamba kahle ngaphandle kwezehlakalo ezimbalwa zababanjwe behlinza imbuzi.Uthe kubanjwe nabebesebenzisa omakhalekhukhwini kubhalwa, nabo abazobhekana nabo kulandelwa imigomo ethinta ukukopela uma kubhalwa."Sinemigomo ebekiwe ethinta izinto ezizokwenzeka kulabo ababanjwe bekopela. Kanjalo nomakhalekhukhwini abavumelekile uma kubhalwa izivivinyo," kusho uMweli. Ngokujwayelekile uma ulahlwe icala lokukopela, imiphumela yalelo phepha ithathwa njengento engekho. Umiswa iminyaka embalwa ungakwazi ukubhala leso sifundo.Kwenzeka lokhu nje, uMweli noNgqongqoshe walo mnyango, uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, kanjalo nomkhandlu olawula izingabunjalo lemiphumela, Umalusi, baxwayisa abafundi ukuthi bangazibandakanyi nokukopela ngoba bazibeka engcupheni yokubanjelwa imiphumela yabo.Kujwayelekile ukuthi kube nezehlakalo zokukopela okusuke kuhlanganisa abafundi abakopela beyiqoqo, noma labo abasuke begadile uma kubhalwa babanike izimpendulo. UMweli uthe kunabafundi ababhalela ezibhedlela noma ezikhungweni zezempilo ngenxa yokungaphili."Asifuni kube nomfundi ongeke abhale ngoba engaphilile. Yingakho sisiza nabagulayo ukuthi babhalele lapho bekhona." Uveze nokuthi kunokukhathazeka ngokulova kwalabo ababhala ngasese."Iminyango yezifundazwe imatasa iqoqa ulwazi mayelana nokungafiki kwababhala ngasese. Silwa nanenkinga yezikhungo ezingabhalisiwe eziqola abafundi ikakhulu abasuke bephucula u-matric wabo," kusho uMweli. Ubonge imiphakathi evikela ukubhalwa kwezivivinyo ngokuthi ingaphazamisi ababhalayo."Asiqhubeke nokweseka abafundi ababhalayo, babhale ngokuthula. Asingakhipheli ukudinwa kwethu kubafundi sibaphazamise." UMweli uthe ingxenye eningi yamaphepha isibhaliwe kwa-matric. Uthe amaphepha afana neMaths nesiNgisi, iHistory ayaphothulwa kuleli sonto."Selokhu ziqalile izivivinyo, alikho iphepha elibhalwe sekudlule isikhathi. Sibonga othisha nezikhulu zomnyango ngokuqhubeka ziyibambe kuze kuphothulwe izivivinyo." Namhlanje kubhalwa iphepha lokuqala leMaths, Maths Literacy kanjalo neTechnical Maths.
IPHINI likaMengameli, uMnuz Paul Mashatile, seligqugquzele abesilisa ukuthi bangahambeli kude nemishanguzo yokuthithibalisa iHIV/Aids kodwa bayilande baphinde bayidle.UMashatile uthe kunomkhankaso wokunxenxa abesilisa ukuthi badle le mishanguzo."Sihlose ukwehlisa isibalo sabahaqwe yiHIV kuleli. Yingakho sigxile emkhankasweni wokuthi siye kwabesilisa ukuze balande baphinde badle imishanguzo yabo," kusho uMashatile.Ukusho lokhu izolo ephendula imibuzo yamalungu ePhalamende. Ukhale ngabesilisa abadala abaheha amantombazane asemancane ngemali ukuze balale nawo."Sikhathazekile ngabesilisa abaheha izingane ezincane ukuze balale nazo ngokuzinika imali. Nazo zikwenza lokhu ngoba zisuke ziswele," usho kanje.Uthe uMnyango weMfundo eyisiSekelo, unomkhankaso wokugcina amantombazane esezikoleni."Ngalo mkhankaso kuhlelwe ukwehlisa isibalo sabesifazane abatheleleka ngesandulela ngculazi. Sifuna intsha iphile isikhathi eside njengoba kunanemishanguzo yokuthithibalisa iHIV/Aids," kusho uMashatile. Uveze ukuthi kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezizofundisa intsha ngobungozi beHIV/Aids.Amalungu ePhalamende afune ukwazi ngezinhlelo zethelevishini ezaziqwashisa ngeHIV eminyakeni edlule ezifana neSoul City."Lezi zinhlelo kubalulekile ukuthi ziqhubeke ziqwashise abantu ngegciwane. Asikaxoxi noNgqongqoshe wezeMpilo kuleli mayelana nezinhlelo ezithinta umjovo wokugwema iHIV kwabangahaqekile kuleli." Elakuleli libe yizwe lokuqala e-Afrika, ukugunyaza ukuthi kusetshenziswe umjovo i-lenacapavir, ezothathwa kabili ngonyaka evikela abangahaqekile ukuze bangatheleleki ngeHIV/Aids.Lo mjovo kulindeleke ukuthi uqale ukusebenza ngonyaka ozayo kuleli kanti uyanconywa ngokuthi uyabavikela abantu ukuthi batheleleke.UMashatile ubuye waveza nokuthi kumele kukhucululwe amazambane abolile emaphoyiseni"Sesiqalile ukwenza okuthile ngamaphoyisa angamazambane abolile. Abantu bazothemba amaphoyisa uma bebona ukuthi siwuhulumeni siyawasusa amazambane abolile emaphoyiseni," kusho uMashatile. Uthe yinto abayixoxa nebamba likangqongqoshe wamaphoyisa, ukuze abantu babone ukuthi amaphoyisa asebenzela bona.Ukhale ngokuthi omasipala bakweleta inkampani ehlinzeka ngogesi kuleli, i-Eskom, ngaphezu kuka-R102 billion."Le mali ekweletwa ngomasipala inyuke kakhulu njengoba ngo-2019, yayingu-R20 billion. Omasipala babhekene nengwadla yokuqoqa izikweletu emabhizinisini kanjalo nakubantu abakweletayo," usho kanje. Uthe basebenzisana nomasipala ukubasiza ukuze baqoqe izikweletu kulabo abakwaziyo ukukhokha."Siyazi ukuthi abantu abayifuni i-prepaid, kodwa iyona ndlela elula ukuze abantu bakhokhele into abayisebenzisayo. Sinenkinga enkulu futhi yezinyokanyoka, ugesi oxhunywa ngendlela engafanele emphakathini," kusho uMashatile.
