INKINGA yokugembula ingenye yezinselelo ezilokhu zikhathaza njalo eNingizimu Afrika, okubukeka sengathi ikapakela cishe kuzona zonke izindlela zokugembula kusuka kuma-casino kuze kufinyelele ekugembuleni usebenzisa iselula nama-website.Lokhu kubukeka sekudale enkulu inkinga nenselelo ezweni ikakhulu kwabesifazane ababhekana nengcindezi yokuswela imali, ukucindelwa wukuthi kunabantu abalindele ukuthi baphile noma benze izinto ngendlela ethize emphakathini, okwenza bazizwe becindezelekile emqondweni.Ucwaningo olushicilelwe yisikhungo esicwaninga ngezimo ezahlukene emhlabeni, iFrontiers, ludalule ukuthi abantu besifazane abagembulayo kuvame ukuthi babukwe ngendlela ethize, kube sengathi bona akubafanele ukwenza lokho, babukwe njengokuthi bawomama abangekho qotho. Lolu cwaningo luthi lezo zinkoleloze ngalabo besifazane zandisa umthwalo kulabo asebebishe kule nkinga, kwenze ukuthi bengabe besakwazi ukuphunyuka.Eminyakeni eminingi edlule, inkinga yokugembula kwabesifazane yande kakhulu, njengoba abanye babo bese beyisebenzisa njengendlela yokubhekana nezinkinga zokuswela imali.Umbiko weNational Gambling Board (NGB) uthole ukuthi okunye okudale ukuthi inkinga yokugembula yande wukuthi isiyamukelwe njengokuthi yinto ejwayelekile nefanele, kwaba wukuthi abantu abambalwa kakhulu abasakhathazwa wukudloba kwayo.Umbiko we-NGB uxwayise nangokuthi kumele kube khona okwenziwayo ukulawula le nkinga futhi kulawulwe nendlela abantu abakwazi ukugembula ngayo ukusiza ukuthi kungabi lula ukuthi noma ngubani avele agembule noma yinini, nanoma yikanjani.Ngale kwezibalo nocwaningo ngale nkinga, ziningi nezindaba ezixoxwayo nesezike zaxoxwa zabantu besifazane abanenkinga yokugembula ngokweqile.Enye yalezo zindaba ngeyowesifazane oneminyaka engu-63 waseKapa, owaqala ukungena kulo mkhuba eseneminyaka engu-38. Uthe engena kule nkinga wafakwa ngumngani wakhe, owambiza, ezomkhombisa ukuthi kugenjulwa kanjani. Uthe esaqala wajabula kakhulu njengoba u-R100 adlala ngawo wamwinela u-R1 000, kwaya ngokuya wawina u-R2 000 no-R2 500. "Ulutheka kanjalo-ke ekuqaleni ngoba uvele uwine, bese uzitshela ukuthi kuzohlale kunjalo. Kuthi noma usulokhu ushaya uceleni, uhlalele ethembeni lokuthi usazowina futhi maduze. Kuthi uma usuwina mhlawumbe uthole u-R40 000, unganaki futhi ungabali ukuthi ubusulahlekelwe yimalini ecwile kulezi zikhawu eziningi ongawinanga kuzona," kusho lona wesifazane. Eqhuba, udalule ukuthi ngenkathi esanale nkinga waqaphela ukuthi abantu abaningi besifazane abaluthwa wukugembula yilabo abasuke sebahlukanisa nabantu abebeshade nabo, nalabo abasuke bezizwa bengenamuntu empilweni yabo."Lokho ngikwazi nangami uqobo ngoba ngingomunye wababenaleyo nkinga; ngangihlale ngizizwa sengathi anginamuntu empilweni yami, bese ngihamba ngiyozihlalela endaweni yokugembula cishe usuku lonke. Inkinga iqala lapho-ke uma usuzohlale udliwa nje, ungasawini njengasekuqaleni, bese lokho kuyakugqilaza emqondweni," usho kanje.UNksz Louise Swart weCape Addiction Recovery Specialist, uthe inkinga yokugembula kwabesifazane ingaphezu kokugijimisa imali nje kuphela."Ukugembula ngokweqile kufana nokuba wumlutha wezimo ezithile ezahlukene empilweni nezenza ukuthi umqondo wakho ungakwazi ukusuka kalula kuzona uma usungenile futhi wazejwayele, njengokuthanda ukubuka ama-video ocansi, esaziyo ukuthi bayinqwaba kangakanani abantu abanaleyo nkinga ezweni lethu," kusho uNksz Swart.Eqhuba, uthe ebantwini abaningi besifazane abanale nkinga idalwa wukuhlukumezeka ngenxa yezimo ezahlukene, ezinye zazo ezenzeka besakhula, kanjalo nokuba nomuzwa wokuzizwa sengathi abanamuntu obanakile nobakhathalele."Ngakho umshini wokugembula uphenduka ube wumngani wabo omkhulu ngoba awubalawuli futhi awubahlukumezi ngalutho. Nokho inkinga enkulu yilokho kokuthi kukho konke lokho kusuke kuphela leyo ngcosana yemali abanayo," usho kanje.Uthe babalelwa ku-30% kuya ku-50% kuphela abantu besifazane abagcina becela usizo lokwelashwa kule nkinga yokugembula abasuke bebhekene nayo, bese kuzoba nenqwaba engafuni ukuphumela obala ngoba ibona sengathi izophoxeka ngalokho. Kwabadinga usizo lokulwa nenkinga yokugembula, bangashayela iThe South African Responsible Gambling Foundation enombolweni yabo yamahhala ethi: 080 000 6008 noma bathumele umqhafazo noma umyalezo kaWhatsApp enombolweni ethi: 076 675 0710, noma i-email ku: [email protected].
USIHLALO we-Alexandra Randburg Midrand Taxi Association (ARMTA), uVictor Molefe Moekeletsi, udutshulwe wabulawa ehamba nonogada bakhe eMarlboro.Unogada wakhe naye ushonele endaweni yesigameko, omunye unogada nomshayeli wemoto baphuthunyiswe esibhedlela ngemuva kokuthola amanxeba okudutshulwa.Kuthiwa laba bavinjezelwe abantu abangaziwa eduze namahhovisi e-Alexandra Taxi Association.Kubikwa ukuthi imoto ebihamba abasolwa utholwe ngaseSetjwetla inegazi ngaphakathi. Lesi sigameko senzeke ngemuva kwenyanga lapho abaphathi bamatekisi kule ndawo bememezele ukuthi seziphelile izimpi zamatekisi eseziqhube isikhathi eside, emcimbini wokuthula owawungomhla ka-19 kuMandulo (September) enkundleni yemidlalo Kwa-Bhekilanga, e-Alexandra. Eminyakeni embalwa eyedlule, amatekisi lo sihlalo washiselwa amatekisi angaphezu kweshumi eshiswa izigebengu ezazihlomile ekhaya lakhe eMarlboro.
Iziphathimandla zomgwaqo eFree State zidalule ukuthi itekisi ebandakanyeke engozini eyenzeke ngoLwesine ekuseni ku-N3 phakathi kweVan Reenen’s Pass neMontrose iphaphalaze yaphuma emzileni wayo ngaphambi kokuba ishayisane mahlanze neloli. USihlalo weRoad Incident Management Systems, uSipho Towa, uthe itekisi belibheke eThekwini, kubukeka sengathi lingene emzileni okungewona ngaphambi kokuba ishayisane neloli, ngezithuba zabo-05:00. "Sibikelwe sekusele imizuzu engu-20 ngaphambi kwehora lesihlanu ngengozi eyenzeke ku-N3 phakathi kweVan Reenen's Pass neMontrose," kusho uTowa engxoxweni abe nayo neNewzroom Afrika. "Ngesikhathi ithimba lifika endaweni yesehlo, kutholwe ukuthi bekuyitekisi eshayisane neloli elithwala impahla, ngeshwa abantu abangu-8 kuthiwa bashonile endaweni yesigameko,0 abayisithupha baphuthunyiswe esibhedlela iThebe, eHarrismith belimele kancane."UTowa uthe amaphoyisa azama ukuxhumana nemindeni nabalimele nabashonile"Esikwaziyo ukuthi itekisi ibisuka eVirginia eFree State ilibangise eThekwini. Okhulumela amaphoyisa aseFree State uCaptain Loraine Earle ukuqinisekisile ukuthi kushone abantu abayisishiyagalombili kule ngozi, kwathi abanye abaningi bathola imihuzuko baphuthunyiswa esibhedlela. Kuvulwe icala lokubulala ngokungenhloso, kanti uphenyo ngembangela yengozi luyaqhubeka.
Ufakazi C oyilungu lePKTT wethula ubufakazi kwikhomishana kaMadlanga echaza kabanzi ngokuboshwa kukaVusimuzi Cat Matlala. UMatlala waboshwa ngomhla ka-14 Meyi. Kuvela ukuthi waboshwa ophuma emzini walowo owayenguKhomishana wamaphoyisa uRea Phiyega."Sasimlandela ephuma kulo muzi kodwa esakuqaphela wukuthi imoto yakhe nezonogada bakhe zazihamba ngesivinini esikhulu kakhulu okwakwenza kube nzima sizimise. Kwasiza ukuthi imoto yakhe iphonseke emgodini, nokuyinto ephoqe ukuthi ame eceleni kulungiswe isondo le moto," kusho ufakazi.Ufakazi Uveza ukuthi ephekwa ngemibuzo, uMatlala wavezela amaphoyisa ukuthi esondelene nezikhulu zasemaphoyiseni.Lo fakazi uveze ukuthi uMnuz Cat Matlala wafaka u-R500 000 kuNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa uMnuz Senzo Mchunu eseka umkhankaso wakhe wokuba ngumengameli. Kuthiwa uMatlala wayeyifaka ebhange yebhizinisi likaBrown Mogotsi bese uMogotsi kube uyena oyidlulisela kuMchunu. Ngemuva kwalokho uzothumela ubufakazi kuMatlala ukubonisa ukuthi useyihambisile.Kuthiwa uMatlala waphoxeka ngokungatholi ukwesekwa kungqongqoshe ngemuva kokuthi amaphoyisa agasele emzini wakhe ngo-Disemba nokuthi ungqongqoshe usenqamule inkontileka yakhe nomnyango. Yilokhu okwamholela ekubeni nomhlangano nowayengungqongqoshe uMnuz Bheki Cele emtshele ngakho konke obekwenzeka nokuthi auseyalelwe ukuba avulele uLT General Dumisani Khumalo icala lokweba iwashi lakhe likanakusho.Lokhu kuhambisana nobufakazi bukaCele abenza phambi kwekomidi lePhalamende lapho aveza khona ukuthi wahlangana noCat Matlala exhunyaniswa usomabhizinisi ongasekho emhlabeni uMabonga Mpungose. UCele uthi bahlangana ehhotela iBeverly Hills eThekwini wayendlala inkinga yakhe yokuthi uSenzo Mchunu benoBrown Mogotsi bayamsebenzisa ukuze axhase umkhankaso kaMchunu wokuhola i-ANC naye uzosizakala Uma kunesidingo.Njengamanje kulindeleke ukuba kulalelwe inkulumo eqoshiwe kaMatlala nephoyisa.
ISILO uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini sithi asikaxoli 'ngokuqanjelwa amanga' kweNdlovukazi uShiyiwe Mantfombi Dlamini Zulu, ngesikhathi kuqhubeka icala elithinta umbango weSihlalo sobuKhosi bukaZulu.IMbube ithe nakuba isikudlulisile okombango wesihlalo, ithe asikapholi isilonda esadaleka ngokuqanjelwa kwendlovukazi amanga ngesikhathi kuqulwa icala.Ikusho lokhu ngesikhathi ikhuluma emhlanganweni wokubuyisana obusesigodlweni eMashobeni, izolo.Umhlangano ububizelwe ukuzokwazisa iNdlunkulu kaZulu nesizwe ngesinqumo senkantolo esivuna ukuqokwa kweSilo.Ekuqaleni kwenyanga, iNkantolo yamaCala aDlulisiwe yanquma ukuthi uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, walandela yonke imigomo ngesikhathi evuma ukuqokwa kweSilo.Ngesikhathi kuqulwa icala, uMntwana uSimakade kaZwelithini waveza ukuthi wafakwa esiswini sendlovukazi, wathi ukufakwa esiswini seNdlovukazi kumenza afanelwe ukuhlala eSihlalweni sobuKhosi bukaZulu.ISilo sibabaze ibhadi, sathi asikaze siyizwe ndawo le nto eyashiwo uMntwana uSimakade."Kubuhlungu ngoba umama ongizalayo, osazithulela, ku0qanjwe amanga amakhulu ngaye esezithulele, esedlinzeni lapho elele khona. Yake yenzeka kanjani into enjalo? Uma ubheka kukhulunywa lapha enkantolo abameli babaNtwana, bebethi kuyalingwana. Yeyi lam MaKomanisi? Uyabona nje ukuthi bese kuphonswa nje amagabade. Ngiyakuxolela konke okwenzekile kodwa lokhu obekubhekiswe endlovukazini, isazilalela, angikuxoleli ngingakatholi isiphetho sakho. Ngiyafisa ukwazi inhloso. Niyamazi obesho lokho, ngeke ngimusho."INkosi uBiyela, ithe badidekile labo abaphikisa ukuqokwa kweSilo."Asijiki, simile lapha. Khula Silo ube ngamagquma nezintaba zakho. Silo esikhulu akukho okungangawe lapha. Kubuhlungu njengoba bengekho abanye. Kubuhlungu ngoba abekho lana nje yingoba badidwa isibusiso sokuthi ngesikhathi beza lapha emhlabeni, beza kukhona uNomthebe wesizwe. Yayikhona inkosi eyayibusa. Uma kukhona othunyiwe lana ukuthi akezokuzwa ukuthi kuthiwani, akahambe ebatshele ukuthi badukile. Akofike abatshele ukuthi balahlekile."
BASAGCWELE amathafa abasolwa ngokubulala ngesihluku umsakazi wodumo kwiMbokodo FM nakuMgungundlovu FM, uDumisani "Dumi Bee" Miya. Isolezwe lithole ukuthi uDumi Bee, obengomunye wabaculi bokholo, udutshulwe phambi komndeni wakhe, engena emzini wakhe osendaweni yaKwaMachibisa, eMgungundlovu ngoLwesibili.Ushonele endleleni ephuthunyiswa esibhedlela sendawo iHarry Gwala Hospital, ebiyaziwa nge-Edendale eminyakeni eyedlule.Ubulawa nje umufi ubeduduza ngomculo umndeni obushonelwe eWillowfountain, eMgungundlovu ngoMgqibelo.Emasontweni adlule ubematasatasa elekelela ngesikhathi kulungiselelwa umcimbi wasesikoleni Mthethomusha Primary eMgungundlovu. Luyeza udaba oluphelele.
UMNDENI wowesilisa waKwaWoza, KwaNzimakwe, eMargate, okuthiwa unyamalale ngendlela engaqondakali ngeledlule, usola abangani ayebaphelezele ukuyogeza ngembuzi emfuleni uMzimkhulu.UMnuz Mlondi Jula (23) kuthiwa wagcina ukubonwa ngoLwesithathu olwedlule, ehamba nabangani ababili, omunye wabo ongumakhelwane.Udadewabo walona wesilisa, uNksz Noluthando Thuwe Jula, utshele Isolezwe ukuthi ngosuku ababagcina ngalo, abangani ababili babekade bethenge imbuzi kubo (kwaJula). Uthe babe sebecela uMlondi ukuthi abahambise emfuleni lapho umakhelwane ayeyogeza khona, wathi ngakusasa, umshana kaMlondi wathola umyalezo owawuthunyelwe ngeselula yakhe. Uveze ukuthi lo myalezo wawuyalela umshana ukuthi athumele inombolo yakhe kamazisi, ukuze uMlondi, owayevule ikhadi lakhe lasebhange esebenzisa imininingwane kamshana, alungise kabusha inombolo eyimfihlo. "Umshana wayithumela inombolo yakhe kamazisi. Akuphelanga sikhathi esingakanani, kwafona umakhelwane, wambuza ukuthi ugcine nini ukukhuluma noMlondi ngoba akamtholi ocingweni,” kusho uNksz Jula.Uthe umakhelwane wabuye wabuza ukuthi umthumele yini inombolo yakhe kamazisi njengoba ebeyifuna uMlondi?"Wamtshela ukuthi umthumele,” usho kanje. Uthe kwabuye kwangena omunye umyalezo ovela enombolweni kaMlondi kwiselula kamshana uthi: "Le nto yakho ayifuni ukulunga, ifuna ubuso bakho (selfie), ngilungisele wena, ungayithinti leyo mali ngoba ngiyayazi ukuthi iyimalini.”Uthe ngezikhathi zantambama bebona engabuyi uMlondi, babe sebemfonela, befuna ukuzwa ukuthi ukuphi, bathola ucingo lwakhe luvaliwe, kukhombisa nakwiWhatsApp ukuthi ugcine ngezikhathi zasemini. Uveze ukuthi bese kungoLwesihlanu ngesikhathi bemfonela lo makhelwane, bebuza ukuthi uphi uMlondi, wabatshela ukuthi wababeka emfuleni, baphuma emanzini esebashiyele umyalezo efonini othi usehambile uya eKokstad, wabuye wathi uya kwisinqandamathe eThekwini. "Ngathi uma ngithi akangithumelele i-screenshot esifakazela lokhu, wathumela imiyalezo yakudala enenkulumo engafani ncamashi nale abeyisho, wabuye washintsha wathi useyakhumbula ukuthi akathumelanga umyalezo kodwa ushaye ucingo,” kuchaza uNksz Jula.Uveze ukuthi umuntu abamaziyo wuye lo makhelwane ngoba kwamakhelwane ikubo kayise, wathi bezwa kuthiwa kubo kanina kuseGauteng, waveza nokuthi bebona ukuthi kukhona okushaya amanzi, banikele emaphoyiseni asePort Edward, bayobika ukuthi balahlekelwe yisihlobo. Uthe lo makhelwane ubelokhu ebabambisa udonga ethi uyabuya kodwa wagcina eshintsha ngempelasonto, ethi yena ngeke esabuya ngoba usesebhasini eliya kubo kanina eGauteng. Lo omunye, ayehamba naye, yena uthe uma ethintwa walibeka ngembaba elithi ngeke esabuya ngoba vele yena wayeze endaweni ngoba ekhaphe umngani wakhe (lo othi usebuyele eGauteng).Uthe yena bezwa kuthiwa owaseNquthu kodwa kabanaso isiqiniseko salokho. Uthe umyalezo wokugcina owathunyelwa umakhelwane uthi: "Aniqondi. Le nto imayelana nezinkabi", wathi abazi ukuthi le nkulumo yayisho ukuthini kodwa baphendula ngelithi bacela babuyise ithambo lakhe ngoba kusobala ukuthi bambulele."Asisabatholi ezingcingweni. Abasazibambi uma sibafonela,” usho kanje. "Sicabanga ukuthi bayalazi iqiniso, kuphakathi kokuthi bamthumbile noma bambulele. Besilindele ukuthi bazositshela uma behlelwa yinkinga ngalelo langa,” kusho uNksz Jula.Uthe umfula uqhele ngamahora amabili ukusuka ekhaya labo, wathi okubi ukuthi abakwazi nokulandelela imoto nge-tracker njengoba uMlondi ayeyithenge kumuntu owase ehlulwa ukuyikhokhela, nokusho ukuthi imininingwane ye-tracker yayo yaziwa wuye lowo muntu."Siphatheke kabi ngalokhu futhi sididekile ukuthi kwenzekani. Sifisa ukuthola iqiniso, sithole ithambo lakhe uma kuwukuthi bambulala,” usho kanje.Kushaye isikhathi sokushicilela amaphoyisa engakayiphenduli imibuzo ngalolu daba.
YIZE uJames "God'olulala amankankane" Mthembu abengawazi umubombo kathisha kodwa ubebalwa nezinyanga ezikhomba ngophakathi. UGod'olulala amankankane (61) wasesigodini sasePhelandaba, eManguzi, KwaMhlabuyalingana, uhambe emhlabeni ngoLwesihlanu ebusuku, emuva kokuthelwa ngoyaba lwezinhlamvu kade ezithokozisa nomndeni wakhe.Umufi waqala ukuzakhela ugazi emphakathini ngesikhathi ebophisa intombazane eyayizama ukumdayisela ingane ephila nebala elimhlophe eneminyaka ewu-11 ngo-2016. Lo wesifazane, owagwetshwa iminyaka ewu-20 ebhadla ejele, wabuye wafuna ukudayisela umufi izingane ezintathu eziphila nebala elimhlophe ngo-R100 000. UGod'olulala amankankane yinyanga ebizishaya isifuba ngokuthwalisa abantu ukuze bagwilike futhi eziqhenya ngokuthi ubekwazi ukugqihisa umuntu angadubuleki ngaphandle kokusebenzisa izicubu zabantu. Ubengakholelwa ukuthi kunomuthi wenhlanhla ongakhandwa ngezicubu zomuntu.Umlando omfishane kaGod'olulala amankankaneUmufi uzalelwe esigodini saKwaMamshudu, ngaphansi kweNkosi uMabhudu Tembe. Ubeyingane yesibili ebantwaneni abawu-11 kunina noyise, okungamantombazane amathathu nabafana abawu-8. Ushona nje umufi, ubese esele nabafowabo ababili kuphela emhlabeni.Ngesikhathi ontangayakhe befunda esikoleni, umufi wayefunda ukuthaka imithi emuva kokungenwa umkhulu ozala uyise owayeyinyanga, uGod'olulala amankankane. Nakuba engamficanga umkhulu wakhe emhlabeni kodwa wavukela kuye.Yingakho agcina esezibiza ngoGod'olulala amankankane. Wabe eseyothwasa kabanzi ngobunyanga kuPhineas Sibiya waKwaThelizolo, ngeminyaka yo-1990. Ngenxa yokufuna ukuba nolwazi oluthe thuthu, wabe eseyokhuphula umsebenzi wokwelapha enyangeni yasendaweni yaseSikheleni, eMozambique, uShinda. Yilapho afike afunda kabanzi ngokuthakwa kwezigubhu ezinhlobonhlobo futhi ekwazi ukuzicisha esezihlupha imindeni yabantu abafe bethwele.Akagcinanga lapho, wangena ephuma kogobela abahlukahlukene baseMozambique, waze wadlulela nakwabaseMalawi. Ubuyile esezokwelapha abantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Ubehlonishwa kakhulu emkhakheni wokwelapha nasekulweleni abantu abaphila nebala elimhlophe. Amagalelo akhe obunyanga enza wahlonishwa ngesinye isikhungo semfundo ephakeme ngeziqu zobudokotela nezobusolwazi.Ubenayo imithi eyingozi njengoba bemsola ngokuthi ubengabhedelwa. Ubeganwe ngamakhosikazi angu-15 futhi ebusiswe ngezingane ezibalelwa ku-65 kodwa yadlula eyodwa kwasala ezingu-64. Ubekukhonzile ukuhlaba izinkomo ezimbili kwakhe enzela ukujabulisa umndeni wakhe. Ubesuke ecaphuna kusale njengoba enomhlambi wezinkomo ezingaphezu kuka-200 nezimbuzi ezingangoZulu ey'eMakheni. Yize ebenemndeni omkhulu kodwa ubengakwazi ukulala ebusuku uma kunemindeni elambile nengenalo uphahla.Ubengaziphilisi ngobunyanga kuphela kodwa enebhizinisi lokukhiqiza insipho yokugeza, eyokuwasha, eyokuwasha izimoto, neyokuhlanza izitsha namakha.UGod'olulala amankankane uhambe emhlabeni esethwasise omunye wamakhosikazi uMaZungu okuwuye ebesale enza yonke imisebenzi afundiswe yona umyeni wakhe. Uyena obeya kogeza abantu besifazane futhi esebenza ezigodlweni zomyeni wakhe. Indodana kamufi, uMandla Mthembu, ithe bebesahlanganisa mayelana namalungiselelo omngcwabo kayise.Ubeziveza ukuthi ungumacaphunakusale ngokuphilisa umndeni wakhe ntofontofo enendlu ehlale igcwele ukudla. Kuthiwa uma eyothenga ukudla namakhosikazi akhe ubewola inqwaba asebenzise imali eshiwe nyangazonke.Olunye ulwazi lucashunwe kwi-Ayanda Msweli TV nakwiNamba News.
INHLANGANO evikela isithunzi namalungelo amabandla kuleli, iSouth African Church Defenders (SACD), seyinqumele abeMultiChoice nabeMoja Love ugwayi katiki ithi akakhonjwe indlela umethuli wohlelo iFake Pastors kwiMoja Love, uSihle Sibisi, bese bebuyekeza nalolu hlelo ngaphambi kokuba ihlohle amakholwa ukuba adube izinhlelo futhi alaxaze iDStv (okuyiyo esingethe iMoja Love).Ngokwencwadi ebhalelwe izikhulu zeMultiChoice futhi ebonwe yiSolezwe, amakholwa abona lolu hlelo njengomkhankaso wokujivaza inkolo nezinceku zeNkosi. Incwadi iyakuveza ukuthi ubudlelwano bukaMbhishobhi ongasekho, uTB Joshua noSihle, kwenza lolu hlelo lubukeke njengenkundla lapho uSihle eziphindiselela kubefundisi emuva kokunukubezwa nguJoshua."Siyaphoqeleka ukuba sikhulume ngoba okusakazelwa umphakathi kwiMoja Love kuqhubezela ukuhlaselwa kwenkolo yobuKhrestu esidlangaleni."Iqhuba incwadi ithi indlela uhlelo olwethulwa ngayo isidweba sigqame isithombe sokuthi inhloso yalo, akukhona ukwazisa nokuvikela umphakathi kodwa sekuwukuhlekisa ngesonto nokuxabanisa abazalwane. Ithi lolu hlelo alusavezi abefundisi abangombombayi kodwa seluqhamuka nehaba."Isibonelo nje, izikhangiso ezingamanqampunqampu ezivezwa kwiChannel 157, umethuli wohlelo uSihle Sibisi negama lohlelo iFake Pastors, kuvezwa isithombe esiholela ababukeli ophathe ngoba sibenza babhangqe ngabhande linye inkolo yobuKhrestu nenkohlakalo kanye nokuqolwa kwabantu. Siyawuqaphela nombhalo osezinkundleni zokuxhumana lapho umethuli ezichaza njengomuntu owasinda ngokulambisa kumbhishobhi ongasekho emhlabeni, umufi uTB Joshua."Ithi le ncwadi ayikafinyeleli esinqumeni sokuthi kudutshwe ukubukwa kwezinhlelo zeMoja Love nokulaxaza ukukhokhela iDStv kodwa isanxusa abeMultiChoice neMoja Love ukuthi bakubuyekeze okusakazwa kulolu hlelo ngoba amakholwa akakwazi ukuqhubeka akhokhele ukubuka into ewahlambalazayo."Sifuna uhlelo iFake Pastors lumiswe ngokushesha kuze kuqedwe ukubuyekeza kwangaphakathi futhi nokuqashwa kukaNksz Sihle Sibisi kucutshungulwe kabusha ngenxa yokuqhubeka kwakhe nokuchema."Seyiphetha lincwadi inqumele abeMultichoice ugwayi katiki futhi yabasabisa ngokuthi uma beqhubeka nokusakaza uhlelo, iSACD izophoqeleka ukuba iyalele amakholwa wonke jikelele ukuba aphume aphele kwiDStv.Kuze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela abeMultiChoice neMoja Love bengakakuqinisekisi ukuthi sezifikile yini ezindlebeni zabo izimfuno zale nhlangano.
AMAPHOYISA ayebopha usomabhizinisi obhekene noxhaxha lwamacala, uMnuz Katiso "KT" Molefe, atshelwa ukuthi lo somabhizinisi ungumngani kaNgqongqoshe wezamaPhoyisa omisiwe, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu.Lokhu kuvezwe elinye lamaphoyisa abopha uMolefe, uCaptain Maxwell Wanda.UWanda uthe umqaphi kaMolefe wabatshela ukuthi lo somabhizinisi ushomene noMchunu.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ethula ubufakazi phambi kwekhomishini ephenya izinsolo ezenziwa uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi.UWanda uyingxenye yethimba lamaphoyisa eliphenya amacala okubulawa kosopolitiki KwaZulu-Natal.Wayeyingxenye yamaphoyisa abopha uMolefe ecaleni lokubulawa kukanjiniyela, uMnuz Armand Swart."Wabuza (umqaphi) ukuthi sizokwenzanjani ngoba lo muntu ungumngani kangqongqoshe. Ngabuza ukuthi yimuphi lowo ngqongqoshe awumngani naye? Waphendula wathi uNgqongqoshe wezamaPhoyisa. Ngabe sengibuza ukuthi usho uMchunu yini, wathi yebo."UWanda uthe emva kwalokho, wabe esechazela umqaphi ngohlelo oluyaye lulandelwe uma kuboshwa umuntu. UWanda uthe amaphoyisa angaphansi kophiko loKlebe azama ukuphazamisa ukuboshwa kukaMolefe, wathi afika emzini kaMolefe, abahlohla imibuzo."Bafika beyimpi, besihlohla ngemibuzo. Ngakuthatha njengokugxambukela le nto ababeyenza. Akufanele amaphoyisa aphazanyiswe uma enza umsebenzi wawo. Leli yicala elikhulu kakhulu uma ubheka izinsolo ezibhekene nomsolwa. Yingakho kwangidumaza ukugxambukela kwabanye abantu."Iphoyisa eliyilungu loKlebe, uCaptain Barry Kruger, likuchithile ukuthi bazama ukugxambukela ekuboshweni kukaMolefe.UKruger uthe baphuthuma emzini kaMolefe emva kokuba betshelwe ukuthi kunabantu abazenza oKlebe abazama ukubopha uMolefe."Kwasiphoqa ukuthi siphuthume khona ukuze sizoqinisekisa ukuthi ngabe laba bantu bangamalungu oKlebe ngempela yini. Sasingeke singayisukumeli le nto ngoba kuyenzeka ukuthi abantu babanjwe inkunzi yizigebengu ezizenza amaphoyisa."UKruger ubuzwe ukuthi kungani bengacelanga amaphoyisa asesiteshini esiseduze nomuzi kaMolefe ukuba ayobheka ukuthi ngabe laba bantu abasemzini kaMolefe bangamaphoyisa angempela yini?UKruger uphendule ngokuthi sasikhona isidingo sokuthi nabo njengoKlebe baye kozibonela.Ubuzwe ukuthi kungani bengahambanga ngokushesha emzini kaMolefe emva kokuba sebetholile ukuthi amaphoyisa angempela futhi konke ayekwenza kwakusemthethweni?"Noma sasesitholile ukuthi amaphoyisa angempela kodwa kuningi okwakusafanele sikuqinisekise. Kwakungelula ukuthi sivele sishiye."

IZINGWAZI zomculo wombhaqanga, iSoul Brothers, zizogubha ukuqeda iminyaka ewu-50 ziyibambile insimbi ishisa kule ndima ngokukhumbula ozakwabo abangasekho emhlabeni. Ngokusho komunye wabasunguli boGandaganda baseNingizimu Afrika, okuyigama okuteketiswa ngalo iSoul Brothers, uMoses "Black Mose" Ngwenya, abaculi abazokhunjulwa ngamagalelo abo kuleli qembu elasungulwa ngo-1975, ngoDavid "Mdavu" Masondo, Themba "American" Zulu, Tuza Mthethwa noZenzele "Zakes" Mchunu, okungabanye babasunguli.Uthe bazobakhumbula nge-albhamu esihloko sithi 50 Years of Ogandaganda equkethe ngisho izingoma ezaqoshwa besadla anhlamvana eminyakeni eyedlule futhi nakwikhava kuzovela izithombe zalezi zinsizwa ezinhlanu zisengamabhungu."Okukhethekile ngaleli cwecwe ukuthi abalandeli bethu bazokuzwa okokugcina iphimbo lobengumholi waleli qembu, uDavid Masondo. Ngale albhamu sithulela yena isigqoko nabanye ozakwethu abaklame indima emlandweni wethu."Uthe amanye amalungu abawahloniphayo ngoJapan Sidoyi, Sipho Bhengu, Mpompi Sosibo, Lawrence Mathoa, Vusi Mabuza, Mbongeleni Dladla, Javas Magubane, Lemmy "Special" Mabaso, Thomas Phale, Maxwell "Mafuthenkukhu" Mngadi, Sicelo Ndlela, Sifiso Nyoka noJuly Nhlabane. Uthe okunye okuyingqophamlando ngale albhamu ukuthi babophele neciko laphesheya kwezilwandle elizakhele udumo ngokudlala i-organ yomlomo, u-Adam Glezzer."U-Adam wasivakashela sisaqopha ngolunye usuku, sabe sesithatha isinqumo sokumpika kwelinye lamaculo ethu."UBlack Mose uthe isinqumo sokuhlonipha sokugubha ngale ndlela uthe samfikela emuva kokukhipha i-albhamu yabo ethi Hamba Naye ngo-2023."Umqondo wangifikela ekuqaleni kuka-2024. Ngabe sengivumbulula imisebenzi yethu emidala kusukela ekuqaleni. Ngabe sengizithela ezingomeni esaziqopha kodwa sangazikhipha ngenxa yokuthi zazingafinyeleli ezingeni lethu kodwa ngangazi ukuthi zazimnandi."Uthe ube esezididiyela kabusha ngosizo lwe-AI ukuze zihambisane nesigqi somculo samanje. Eqhuba uthe kukhona akuthuntuthile futhi wazivuselela kabusha ukuze zihambisane nesigqi seSoul Brothers samanje. Nakuba kunjalo kodwa uthe akawuguqulanga umongo nomyalezo wazo. Ngaphandle kwale albhamu, uBlack Moses uthe bahlele uchungechunge lwamakhonsathi ngenhloso yokugubha nabalandeli ebebewa bevuka neSoul Brothers kule minyaka ewu-50 yasungulwa. Uthe ikhonsathi yokuqala izoba sePiet Retief Town Hall, eMpumalanga, ngo-Okthoba 30, naseMpangeni Town Hall, ngoNovemba 1.Esephetha uBlack Mose, uthe basazozimemezela nezinye izindawo abasazozihambela nezinsuku zakhona. ISoul Brothers yaqalwa ngokuthi ibhendi eyayikhiwe yizinsizwa zaKwaZulu-Natal, uZakes owayengumdlali wesigingci sebhesi, uMdavu owayengumdlali wama-drums noTuza owayengumdlali wesigingci esijwayelekile. Yize zahlangana eHammarsdale kodwa uMdavu wayebuya kwaZenzele, eHowick. Zazizibiza ngeGroovy Boys ngaphambi kokuzibiza ngeYoung Brothers. Ngaleso sikhathi zazidlala izinsimbi kuphela, kungaculi muntu. Zabe sesifudukela eGoli lapho zafike zahlangana khona nomdlali we-organ uBlack Mose ukuze kusunguleke iSoul Brothers ngo-1975.UMdavu wabe esecula phambili.Ukuhlangano komzwilili wezwi likaMdavu nobumnandi be-organ kaBlack Mose okwenza iSoul Brothers yahluka emaqenjini amaningi. Leli qembu laqhamuka nesigqi esiyame ohlobeni lomculo wase-USA, iSoul Music. Yingakho bazibiza ngeSoul Brothers futhi begqokisa okwabaculi abenza lolu hlobo lomculo abanjengoJames Brown.Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi leli qembu lashiya kwiSoul Music lagxila kumbhaqanga noma umgxobanyawo. Nesigqi sashintsha kanye nendlela yokugqoka. I-albhamu eyamenza bavelela eyayisihloko sithi Mshoza Wami ngo-1976. Kusukela lapho leli qembu alibange lisabheka emuva. Umsakazi owalibeka ezingeni eliphezulu kwakunguCyril Bongani "Kansas City" Mchunu weRadio Zulu (osekuwuKhozi FM). Ema-albhamini angaphezu kuka-45, ashisa kakhulu izikhotha ngathi Mantombazane (1978),Isicelo (1983),Xola (1987) nethi Impimpi (1998).NgoKhisimusi umuzi nomuzi wawuhlale une-albhamu yaleli qembu. Nakuba kwakukhona abanye abaculi abanjengoBangani, Abakhwenyana, Babsy Mlangeni, Pat Shange, Thisha Nzuza kodwa iSoul Brothers yayizintandokazi kunabo bonke. Laliwola inqwaba yemiklomelo ngapha nangapha.Imitshotshovu ayithandwanga kuleli kuphela kodwa beyingasaconsi phansi nasemazweni angomakhelwane anjengoZimbabwe. Yake yazungeza i-Europe, ishiya abantu besahalela impinda ngomdanso wayo onenkosi phakathi. Yilo qembu elathatha umculo wombhaqanga lawubeka ebalazweni lomhlaba. Kwathi kusemnandi kunjalo, waqala umshophi wokushona kwamlungu aleli qembu. Kwaqala kwahamba uTuza namanye amalungu amathathu ngengozi yemoto ngo-1979. Kwathi ngo-1984 kwalandela uZakes.U-American wahamba emhlabeni engaselona ilungu laleli qembu. Nakuba kunjalo uMdavu noBlack Mose bayibamba insimbi ishisa kwaze kwaba kuhamba emhlabeni uMdavu okunguye obecula zonke izindlela ngo-2015. Umculi kamaskandi Ihhashi Elimhlophe noMbongeni Ngema bake basebenza ngaphansi kwaleli qembu.Njengamanje sekucula phambili uNkosinathi Ngwenya noThokozani Hadebe.Sekukhona nendodana kaMdavu, uSphamandla Masondo obecula phambili koGuluva. Amanye amaqembu abengaphansi kweSoul Brothers yiMitshotshovu (osekuyiMpumelelo).

Abafundi bakaMatikuletsheni abangaphezu kuka-800,000 eNingizimu Afrika balungiselela ukuhlolwa kweNational Senior Certificate mhlaka-21 kuMfumfu (October). KwaSappi siyaneseka futhi siyaziqhenya ngani. Lesi sigaba sempilo esenikuso siwumphumela wobuqotho, ukuzinikela kwenu, kothisha, imindeni kanye nemiphakathi yenu. KwaSappi sizinikele ekuthuthukiseni ezemfundo ekusukela emazingeni aphansi. Sisebenzisana nabakwa-TREE, sesiqeqeshe abafundisi besezinkulisa (ECD) abangaphezu kuka-175, ngaloluqeqesho sebeyakwazi ukulekelela izinkulungwane zezingane ezindaweni zasemakhaya ezifana noMandeni, KwaDukuza, Ixopo, Nhlamvini, kanye naseMkhomazi esifundazweni iKwaZulu Natal. Ekuqaleni kwalo nyaka, iSappi inikele ngamathani angaphezu kwama-40 ephepha le-Typek ezikoleni ezingaphezu kuka-120, izikhungo ze-ECD, (izinkulisa) kanye nezinhlangano ezizimele eziseduze kwaseSaiccor, eStanger, neTugela. Leli akulona nje iphepha kepha umkhiqizo wethu owenziwe ngezinsalela zikashukela ezivuselelekayo okuwuphawu lokuzinikela kwethu. I-Matric Excellence Campaign yethu iyaqhubeka nokubungaza abafundi abaphumelele ngamalengiso ngokubaklomelisa ngemifundaze (bursaries), kanye nezinye izinsiza-kufunda. Lolu hlelo siluqondanise nolwe-Back to School olwenziwa uMnyango Wezemfundo (Department of Education). "Ukweseka ezemfundo emiphakathini yethu kuyisibusiso. Siyakholelwa ekutheni imfundo iyisisekelo semiphakathi echumayo ne phumelelayo. Sinifisela okuhle bafundi baka Matric Class ka-2025, lesi isiqalo sohambo lwenu,” kusho uTebele Makhetha, iHead of Corporate Affairs eSappi SA.
BAFUNA kuqiniswe isandla eziboshweni ezisemajele akuleli, ezibanjwa nezinto okungamele zibe semajele okubalwa namaselula. Kwizisebenzi zasemajele ezishushumbisa lezi zinto, bafuna zivulelwe amacala ukuze ziboshwe.Lokhu kushiwo usihlalo wekomiti lezokuHlunyeleliswa kweziMilo ePhalamende ,uNksz Kgomotso Ramolobeng, okhale ngokuthi omakhalekhukhwini yibona abahlale bebanjwa eziboshweni ezisemajele.Uthe bake baphakamisa nendaba yokuthi kube nezinto ezizojema ukusebenza komakhalekhukhwini emajele."Sike sayifaka indaba yokuthi kube nezinto ezijema ukusebenza komakhalekhukhwini emnyangweni. Kumele kubhekwe izinto eziningi ngenxa yokuthi kusuke kunabantu abasuke behlala emajele abangaboshiwe ngakho nabo bangashayeka uma kungukuthi izinto ezijema ukusebenza komakhalekhukhwini ziyafakwa. Nendaba yezokuphepha akumele ishiywe ngaphandle kugcine kungasasebenzeki yingakho ziningi izinto okumele zibhekwe. Silinde umnyango ukuthi uzosazisa ibanga olihambile kulesi siphakamiso," usho kanje izolo, ekhuluma nezintatheli ePhalamende. Uthe bagqugquzela nomnyango ukuthi ugasele kungazelele emajele ukuze kukhucululwe izinto ezingafanele emajele."Kwamanye amajele uma kuke kwagaselwa kuwona, ngakusasa iziboshwa zidubela kojele zibagwaze. Umnyango uveze ukuthi unezinhlelo zokuthi ufuqe imikhankaso yokugasela kungazelele emajele, uyosesha," usho kanje.Ukhale ngokuthi agcwele amajele njengoba zingaphezu kuka-166 000 iziboshwa ezigcinwe kuwona."Ezingu-61 891 ezisatokile ezisalinde kuqulwe amacala azo, ezingu-107 170 ezigwetshiwe. Zingu-25 445 iziboshwa ezivela kwamanye amazwe. Kulesi sibalo ezingu-13 000, zigwetshiwe," usho kanje. Uveze nokuthi ezingu-4 012 ezitokile ezihluleka ukukhokha imali yebheyili engaphansi ngisho kuka-R1 000."Kwelinye ijele sifice isiboshwa sesifazane esitokile osekuphele iminyaka eyisikhombisa icala laso lingaphothulwa. Sesitoke kusuka ngo-2019, kanti namanje icala laso lilokhu lihlehla nje," usho kanje.Uthe kuvunyelwene ngokuthi yehle intengo yesinkwa ebizwa emajele ngoba yiyona nto edliwa kakhulu iziboshwa."Siyajabula ukuthi indaba yokubiza kwesinkwa izolokhu ibuyekezwa njalo. Kukhaliwe ngokuthi intengo yesinkwa iphezulu kakhulu. Ibihluka imali ebizwa ngesinkwa emajele ahlukene, amanye ebiza u-R20 ngesinkwa esisodwa, kwamanye sibiza ngaphansi kwale mali kanti kwamanye amajele sibiza cishe u-R25 ngesinkwa esisodwa."
ISISEZITHEBENI zePhalamende eyesihlava sokugembula esihlasele entsheni yakuleli, okubalwa izitshudeni nezingane ezisafunda isikole.Amaqembu ahlukene ePhalamende azobhunga ngalesi sihlava ngokuba nenkulumo mpikiswano ngokuthi yikuphi okumele kwenziwe ngenxa yokudlanga kwale nkinga entsheni.Kuthiwa ezinye zezitshudeni sezigembula ngemali yokufunda neyokukhokhela izindawo zokuhlala ezikhungweni zemfundo ekhishwa yisikhwama, iNational Students' Financial Aid Scheme.Ilungu lePhalamende, uMnuz Makashule Gana weRise Mzansi, eliphusha umkhankaso wokulwa nesihlava sokugembula kuleli, okuyilona elifake lesi siphakamiso ePhalamende, lithe sizobhungwa ngoLwesihlanu. UGana uthe kudingeka kube nemigomo ecacile ezolawula imboni yokugembula kuphinde kuvikelwe nabantu bakuleli.Uthe amaqembu ahlukene azobe ephefumula ngalesi sihlava njengoba kuzoba nanengqungquthela yezokugembula."Ingqungquthela yokugembula kulindeleke ukuthi ibe ngoNovemba 13 no-14, 2025 kanti ibizwe abeSouth African Responsible Gambling Foundation (SARGF), eGoli. Sifuna kwehliswe izinga okukhangiswa ngalo ukugembula njengoba kwenzeka kwehliswa eyokukhangiswa kotshwala ezweni elifana nelethu. Siyibheke ngabomvu le nkulumo yasePhalamende ngale nkinga." Ukhale ngokuthi sekusetshenziswa osaziwayo ukuze bahehe abantu ngokuthi bafake ama-code aveza ukuthi sebebhejile. "Phambilini ukugembula bekungathi yinto yokuzijabulisa kodwa manje sebesebenzisa imali abangenayo. Indaba yezitshudeni ezisebenzisa imali yeNSFAS kanjalo nezingane zesikole ezigembulayo, yinto esikhathazayo. Uma ingekho imigomo ecacile ethinta indaba yokugembula online, kusho ukuthi sakha isizwe esizobisha emgodini wokugembula njengoba sikhula isibalo sabagembulayo kwabaneninyaka engu-25 kuya ku-35," usho kanje.Kukhalwe ngokuthi ngendlela eziningi ngayo izikhangiso, zimane zivumbuke nje komakhalekhukhwini ukuze uheheke. Umbiko weNational Gambling Board (NGB), uveza ukuthi abantu bakuleli bagembule ngo-R1.5 trillion, nyakenye. Lokhu kuthiwa kwenziwe ama-online betting site njengoba sinyukile isibalo sabagembuli saya ku-65.7%, kusuka ngo-2017. Ngakolunye uhlangothi umbiko weStats SA, okhishwe ngenyanga edlule, uveze ukuthi linyukile izinga lokugembula kuleli. Lo mbiko udalule ukuthi ukubhetha kudlule ukuvakashela kwabantu ema-casino beyogembula ikakhulu ngesikhathi sobhubhane iCovid-19.Ziwuchithi saka izinkundla zokugembula kuleli okubalwa ezokubhejela ezemidlalo, enye eyibhanoyi elandisa imali okuthi uma liphahlazeka kungqwambe nemali yakho yonke. Inyunyana yabasebenzi iPublic Servants Association (PSA), ikhathazekile ngenkinga yokugembula ebhekene nezitshudeni.Ithe kudingeka kube nokungenelela ngoba isimo siyaphuma endleleni."Kudingeka kube nezinhlelo ezikhungweni zemfundo zokululeka ngokuphathwa kwemali. Kumele kuvinjwe ukugembula ngemali yeNSFAS. Azilulekwe ngokwengqondo izitshudeni ezinenkinga yokugembula nezicwile ezikweletini. Akuhlangane izinhlaka ezehlukene zisize izitshudeni kule nkinga," kusho iPSA.

UMNDENI wephoyisa okuthiwa langqoklozwa elinye ngenhlamvu lafa, ukhala ngokudluliselwa kwedokodo laleli cala ophikweni eliphenya izenzo zamaphoyisa i-Independent Police Investigative Directorate (Ipid).Lokhu kushiwo udadewabo kamufi, uNksz Nombuso Ngidi, obekade ekhuluma ngemuva kokuba cala lihlehliselwe uNovemba 10, izolo, eNkantolo yeMantshi yasePinetown.Esigamekweni esenzeke ngo-Okthoba 10, uConstable Andile Philani Zulu (40) usolwa ngokudubula ephindelela uConstable Sbonelo Ngidi (29) komunye yemigwaqo yaseMariannhill, ePinetown.Enkantolo kuvele ukuthi leli cala alisaphenywa oKlebe kodwa selidluliselwe kwi-Ipid."Asigculisekile ngokuthi icala selidluliselwe kwi-Ipid. Sikholwa ukuthi bekulunge liphenywa oKlebe," kusho lo womndeni.Enkantolo kuvele ukuthi mane amacala umsolwa abhekene nawo. Kuwona kukhona elokubulala umufi, elokuzama ukubulala owesilisa owayehamba nomufi, elokushayela budedengu nelokuphatha isibhamu edle amanzi amponjwana.Kuthiwa umsolwa obesebenza esiteshini samaphoyisa esiseduze kwesiteshi sikaloliwe i-Escombe, eScottburgh, wapaka imoto yakhe i-VW Polo emhlophe, phakathi nomgwaqo, wehla wachama.Kuvela ukuthi umufi owayevinjwe yile moto, wabuza umsolwa, owehla maqede wabonakala ukuthi kukhona isibhamu enqulwini, ukuthi: "Bafo kungani ungivimba emgwaqweni?”Kuthiwa umsolwa waphendula ngokuthi athi: "Yima ngisachama”. Kuthiwa umufi wambuza ukuthi lokhu akwenzayo, ukwenza ngoba nakhu ephethe isibhamu yini?Umsolwa kuthiwa waphendula ngokuthi: "Yini ufuna ngisifake kuwena yini? Ngilinde-ke ngiqede ukuchama.” Eseqedile ukuchama kuthiwa wamdubula ngoyaba lwezinhlamvu ephindelela.Ngaphambilini, umfowabo kamufi, uMnuz Siya Ngidi, wathi basola ukuthi umsolwa wayenezinye izinhloso ngokubulala umfowabo."Uyiphoyisa, uyawazi umthetho. Uma ethi wayemdubule ngephutha ngoba edakiwe, kwakufanele azinikele emaphoyiseni masinyane uma sekudamuke utshwala,” washo kanjena.Wagcizelela ukuthi ukulinda kwakhe kuze kuphele izinsuku eziyisikhombisa, ngaphambi kokuba azinikele, nakhona ngoba esezwa ukuthi useyafunwa amaphoyisa vele, kudweba esinye isithombe.Waveza nokushisa kwakhe imoto ayehamba ngayo, emva kwesigameko, ezama ukucisha ubufakazi kwakukhomba ukuthi wayekade enenhloso ngayekwenza ngalolu suku.
UPHITHENE amakhanda ukuthi ngabe isitha sivela ngakuphi umndeni wenyanga edumile yaKwaMhlabuyalingana edutshulwe yabulawa ngoyaba lwezinhlamvu emzini wayo ngoLwesihlanu. UMnuz James "Godolulala Amankankane" Mthembu (61) kuthiwa uhlaselwe ngabesilisa ababili abangaziwa, abagasele ekhaya lakhe ePhelandaba, eManguzi, emva kwehora lesishiyagalombili ebusuku, bambulala phambi komndeni wakhe ngesihluku. Indodana yakhe, uMnuz Mandla Mthembu, ilandisa Isolezwe ithe isigameko senzeke kungazelele muntu, umndeni ubuthene, kujatshulwe. "Ngabo-3 ntambama, ubaba uthe akuyiwe eMbazwana, kuyothengwa inyama kosiwe, sijabule. Ubuye nayo igcwele iveni, nebala kwaphekwa ipapa, kosiwa kwajatshulwa, siwumndeni nomakhelwane,” kusho uMthembu.Uthe kwayena uyise ayikho into embikezele ukuthi uzokwehlelwa umshophi, ngendlela abezijabulele ngayo. "Ngabo-7, uze wasipha sonke siyizingane zakhe ebesikhona o-R200 umuntu ngamunye, kumnandi,” kusho uMthembu. Uthe ngesikhathi behlasela abasolwa, bangene egcekeni kunganake muntu ngoba kuhlale kuphithizela izingane zikamufi, kwazise ziningi kanjalo nalabo abasuke bezofuna usizo lwesintu."Bamnombole ngokuthi baqale bamfonele, nokuthe uma ephakamisa ucingo, ethi uyaluphendula, base bemdubula bobabili,” kusho uMthembu.Uthe bamhlasele phansi kwesihlahla egcekeni lapho bekosiwa khona, ehleli nezinye izihlobo. Uthe bezwe ngoyise ebuza ethi: "Awu sekwenzenjani manje?” Uthe abahlaseli bebengakhulumi lutho ngesikhathi bedubula uyise, wathi abakuqaphelile ukuthi ziphelile izinhlamvu zokuqala ebebezithulula kuyise, baphinde bafaka ezinye."Baze bashintsha omagazini, bafaka abanye, bemdubula. Zingaphezu kuka-30 izinhlamvu abamdubule ngazo,” kuchaza uMthembu. Uthe bamkhuthuzile umufi, bathathe isamba semali elinganiselwa ku-R15 000, iselula, ophaqa abebagqokile nokhiye wemoto, wathi babuye badubula amasondo ezimoto eziyisikhombisa ebezisegcekeni ngenhloso yokuthi umndeni ungakwazi ukusheshe unyakaze uyofuna usizo.Uqhube ngokuthii babuye badubula bebhekise kwenye yezindlu eseduze kwendawo yesigameko. Uthe namanje basazibuza bayaziphendula ukuthi esingubani lesi sitha ebesifuna uyise efile?"Emphakathini ubengumuntu wabantu ubaba. Nakuba ebenakho konke kodwa ubengamkhohlwa omunye umuntu, amnike usizo uma eludinga, adle naye kulokho anakho futhi ebahlonipha kakhulu abantu,” kusho uMthembu.Kwezobunyanga, athe uyise waqala kuzo ngo-1990 eseyinsizwa, nakhona asikho isitha abamazela sona. "Akanasitha kwabanye ebebenza umsebenzi ofanayo, ngisho nasemakhasimendeni akhe imbala, awekho abeke abuye, azwakalise ukungagculiseki ngomsebenzi wakhe,” usho kanje.Ematekisini ngaphansi kukasoseshini waseManguzi, athe ujoyine kuwo ngo-2017, asikho isitha abasaziyo nakhona. "Ubengavamile nokuya kwayiserenki lapho, ubethuka nje eyovela emva kweside isikhathi. Futhi usoseshini waseManguzi unokuthula, azikaze zibe khona izinxushunxushu esiye sizibone kwabanye ososeshini,” kusho uMthembu. Uthe uyise ushiya ngemumva amakhosikazi angu-15 nezingane ezingaphezu kuka-60, wathi bayabufuna ubulungiswa ngokubulawa kukayise ngesihluku, wathi bagqemeke udume lwengozi.UGodolulala Amankankane waba sematheni ngo-2016, ngesikhathi ebophisa owesifazane waKwaMhlabuyalingana ngokuzama ukumdayisela ingane (11) enebala elimhlophe. Kuthiwa lona wesifazane wafika kuye wathi ufuna ukumdayisela izingane ezintathu ezinebala, wathi uzombiza u-R100 000 ingane ngayinye. Umufi, kuthiwa wavumela phezulu, wakhomba usuku lapho lona wesifazane kwakufanele alethe ngalo lezi zingane. Kwathi esefika neyodwa yazo, okwavela ukuthi yayingeyesihlobo sakhe lona wesifazane, wazithela phezu kwamaphoyisa, ayesebizwe umufi, zamkhalela kanjalo. Wagcina egwentshwa iminyaka engu-20 lona wesifazane ngecala lokushushumbisa umuntu. Ephawula ngalokhu umufi kwabezindaba, wathi ugeza igama lezinyanga eziqotho, ngelithi izinyanga zangempela azizisebenzisi izicubu zabantu uma zithaka imithi.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, utshele abezindaba ukuthi amaphoyisa aseManguzi aphenya icala lokubulala kulandela isehlo. Uthe imbangela yokubulala ayikakaziwa, wathi amaphoyisa aphume inqina athungatha ababulali.

BAVELE bamameza babhiyozwa kwangathi bathelwa ngezibonkolo abantu abebebhikisha ngaphandlwe kwesakhiwo samafulethi iHomii eThekwini, izolo, ngesikhathi kuvela ukuthi kunesinye isidumbu esesike saphuma kuleli fulethi kodwa udaba lwanyathelwa.Embhikishweni bekuhlangene i-MK Labour Desk, EFF, March and March nabe-ANC. Kuhlaluke ukuthi inhloso yombhikisho wukufuna ubulungiswa ngokulimala kwamawele akwaDlamini esigamekweni esibe yindaba egudwini esenzeke ngeledlule.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi isigameko sokulimala kwamawele sithuse abantu abaningi kwakhulunywa kakhulu ngaso nasezinkundleni zokuxhumana. Kuvele ukuthi akhalakathela kwi-lift engasebenzi. Iwele elilodwa lashona elinye namanje kuvele ukuthi isimo salo sibucayi esibhedlela. Izolo, kube khona omunye wesifazane okuvele ukuthi ungowaseMgungundlovu ogunyuleke ngokuthi umntwana wakhe womfana washona khona eHomii.UNksz Nontuthuko Mantshongo uthe lesi sigameko senzeka ngoFebhuwari 16, 2023. Elandisa, uthe wathola ucingo olwaluvela emaphoyiseni olwalumazisa ukuthi kumele aphuthume eThekwini, ngoba sekuvele umshophi. Uthe lolu cingo lwamazisa ukuthi kumayelana nengane yakhe, u-Andiswa Mantshongo (20) owayefunda eNyuvesi yaKwaZulu-Natal."Kwathi uma ngifika lapho okuhlala khona umntwana wami ngaziswa ngokushona kwakhe. Ngatshelwa ukuthi ushibilikile wawa esuka kwesinye isitezi waze wayodinsika kwesinye esingezansi. Yilokhu nje kuphela engatshelwa kona," usho kanjena ehlengezela izinyembezi.Eqhubeka echaza, ulile kakhulu ngabaphathi bale ndawo, wathi akukho nokukodwa abamsiza ngakho futhi abazange bambuze nokuthi kukhona yini angathanda ukuba alekelelwe ngakho."Bamane bazibukela nje. Akekho noyedwa owaba nendaba ngokuthi kuphume umphefumulo. Kuyacaca ukuthi le ndawo kayiphephile nje nhlobo," usho kanjena.Ngesikhathi eqhubeka ekhuluma bese umkhulu umsindo kuzwakala nje ukuthi abantu sebenengekile futhi abanye sebethelwe ngezibonkolo. Kube khona abanye ebebememeza bebuza ukuthi kayishiswa ngani le ndawo, kulindwe u-new year yini?Kube nezikhawu lapho amaphoyisa ebebonakala ethwale kanzima ukuvimba ababhikishi, bengasalawuleki.Uyise wamawele, uMnuz Khaya Dlamini, uthe ngeke aze athule nje agoqe izandla kodwa ufuna ukubona kwenzeka ubulungiswa ngokulimala kwezingane zakhe.Ukhale kakhulu ngokuthi abaseHomii abakhombisi nje ukuzwelana nabo bewumndeni.Uzwakalise nokunengeka njengoba eveze ukuthi akagculisekile ngendlela amaphoyisa alusingathe ngayo udaba. UJacinta Ngobese-Zuma wenhlangano iMarch and March uthe babone kumqoka kakhulu ukuba balusukumele udaba lwamawele.Uthe kuyakhathaza kakhulu ukuthi kungenzeka into enjengalena, yomshophi wamawele, maqede kucwebe iziziba. Ukhale kakhulu ngamabhilidi aseThekwini wathi kawaphephile, phezu kwalokho wathi asegcwele kakhulu abantu bokufika - iningi elisezweni ngaphandle kwamagunya.Ulimise ngesihloko elokuthi lokhu akwamukelekile nhlobo, wagcizelela ukuthi kukhona okumele kwenziwe ngamabhilidi kuleli dolobha eliphethwe yiMeya uCyril Xaba.Khona izolo kuhlaluke ukuthi bekukade kuwusuku lokuzalwa kwamawele.Umphathi waseHomii, uMmuz Michael Turl, uthe bayaxolisa emdenini wakwaDlamini ngokuwehlele.

IDLE ugwayi ezikoleni ezinyusa isibalo sabafundi ukuze zithole imali ethe xaxa okuhlanganisa nezinsiza kanjalo nothisha njengoba kulindeleke ukuthi luphothulwe maduzane uhlelo lokubheka abasebenzi abayizipoki eMnyangweni weMfundo eyisiSekelo.Lolu hlelo alugcini kuphela ngothisha kodwa luzofaka nabafundi.UNgqongqoshe wezeMfundo eyisiSekelo, uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, uthe kunezikole ezinyusa izibalo zabafundi ukuze zithole imali ethe xaxa. Ngokuba nesibalo esiphezulu sabafundi, uthola nesibalo esithe xaxa sothisha, kwengezwa nezinsiza kufundisa ezifana nezincwadi ne-stationery, kanjalo nasohlelweni lokudla kulethwa okuthe xaxa."Siyazi ngezikole ezenza lo mkhuba ukuze zithole imali eyengeziwe. Uhlelo lokuhlola abasebenzi nabafundi abayizipoki, luzosisiza kakhulu emnyangweni ukuthi songe imali. Sinenkinga yemali cishe kuzona zonke izifundazwe kodwa KwaZulu-Natal, yibona abashayeke kakhulu," usho kanje ekhuluma emhlanganweni wasePhalamende.Uhlelo lokuhlola izipoki lwenziwa umkhandlu i-Education Labour Relations Council, ukusiza kwehliswe isabelomali kwezemfundo. Amalungu ePhalamende akhale ngokuthi kwezinye izikole othisha abangeni emakilasini kodwa bekhona ezikoleni. Akhale nangokuthi abanye uthola ukuthi abasayi ezikoleni ngoba belinde ukuthi bahlinzekwe ngempesheni yokugula.Umqondisi jikelele emnyangweni, uMnuz Mathanzima Mweli, uvumile ukuthi abanye othisha abafundisi ekubeni bekhona esikoleni."Abayi emakilasini ekubeni kodwa bekhona ezikoleni. Abanye uhlangana nabo bakukhalele ngokuthi umuntu uhleli ekhaya iminyaka elinde ukuthi anikwe impesheni yokugula. Le ndaba yalolu phenyo ngezipoki izosisiza kakhulu kule nkinga ngoba sizobazi abakhona nabangekho," usho kanje. Uthe kulula ukuthi kube nezipoki zothisha ngoba babalelwa ku-460 000 kuleli."Basithembise ukuthi lolu hlelo lwezipoki luzophothulwa maduzane. Izikole eziningi sezilulethile ulwazi oluthinta abasebenzi, kanti sizochaza ePhalamende ngesikutholile," kusho uMweli.UMcwaningi Mabhuku Jikelele uke wayiveza eyokuthi kumele kwenziwe ucwaningo ngezipoki emnyangweni. UDkt Reginah Mhaule, iPhini likaNgqongqoshe kwezeMfundo, ukhale ngokuthi usufana nento ewile, uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal ngenxa yenkinga yemali.Uthe uma ngase kuwe bhu izinto eKZN kungabheda isimo kuzwelonke ngoba yiwona mnyango onesibalo esiphezulu sabafundi."Kubalulekile ukuthi kulungiswe isimo eKZN, kwenziwe nocwaningo lwezipoki ukuze kongeke imali. Sibi kakhulu isimo sezezimali eKZN, yingakho kwaze kwayiwa kulesi sifundazwe ukuzozanywa izixazululo," usho kanje.
Ungoti wophiko lokuhlolwa kwezinhlamvu nezibhamu emaphoyiseni uBrigadier Mishak Mkhabela, udalule ukuthi alinganiselwa ku-41 846 amacala obugebengu asabhajwe esigcawini sabo, amaningi ancike ebufakazini obubucayi ngenxa yokuntuleka kwabasebenzi, kanti izinkantolo zisaqhubeka nokukhipha izincwadi ezigunyaza ukuboshwa.Ethula ubufakazi phambi kweKhomishana kaMadlanga ngoMsombuluko, uMkhabela udwebe isithombe sokudonsa kanzima kwezinhlelo - ekhutshazwa ukushoda kwabasebenzi, ukushoda kwezinsizakusebenza kanye nokugcwala ngokweqile kwezindawo zokugcina ubufakazi."Siphinde sahlela kabusha umnyuziyamu, futhi nawo ugcwele," esho, ebhekisa ezinyathelweni ezinzima ezithathiwe ukugcina izibhamu ezibanjiwe kubasolwa."Kwiseyifu yethu, sinezibhamu ezilinde ukuhlolwa ezingaphezu kuka-29,000 zonke ezibandakanyeka emacaleni okubulala, kunjalo-nje sinabahlaziyi abangu-42 kuphela."Ngokusho kukaMkhabela, angu-41 846 amacala asalinde ukuhlolwa okuhlanganisa angu-29 385 asuka ehhovisi likazwelonke. Uthe athe azopequlula umuzi ngamacala okukhona kuwo elokushushumbiswa kwabantu, izidakamizwa, ukushintshisana ngemali okungekho emthethweni, kanjalo nezibhamu ezingekho emthethweni. Ethintwa uMpumelelo, usiqinisekisile isigameko kodwa wase exhumanisa intatheli nommeli wakhe njengoba eveze ukuthi kukhona icala elivuliwe ngalesi sigameko kanti uhlela nokulusukumela ngezinkantolo.Ummeli, uMnuz Thabani Mpungose, naye ongafunanga ukwanda kakhulu ngamazwi, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi abeMpungose Attorneys bayalusebenza lolu daba.Yize bekuqinisekisile ukuthi likhona icala elivulwe esiteshini samaphoyisa eDurban Central, kodwa kuze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela amaphoyisa engakuqinisekisanga lokhu.
