Sikhona esisivalile KwaZulu-Natal, kanti sizoqhubeka sizivale nezinye. Sisemkhankasweni wokuzivala lezi zikole, kuphelile ukusinisa amahleza," usho kanje.Uthe kumele kubunjwe ithimba elizohlanganisa amaphoyisa, iPhalamende nomnyango ukulwa nale nkinga."Sifuna kuvulwe inombolo yocingo lapho zizobikwa khona lezi zikole. Ngaleyo ndlela abantu bazokwazi ukuzibika," usho kanje. UNksz Gwarube uvumelane noMkhize wathi kumele zivalwe izikole eziwaka abafundi."Ngiyahambisana kakhulu nombono wokuthi kusetshenziswane ukuze kuvalwe lezi zikole. Umqondo omuhle futhi ukuthi kube nenombolo yocingo lapho zizobikwa ezweni lonke," usho kanje.Isikhulu esiphezulu somkhandlu olawula izingabunjalo lika-matric Umalusi, uDkt Mafu Rakometsi, sikhale ngodaba lwezikole ezifundisa online, esithe abakwazi ukuzilawula. URakometsi uthe umphakathi ukhathazekile ngalezi zikole wathi abakwazi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zisezingeni lokuthi zifundise konke okudingwa ngabafundi."Miningi imibuzo mayelana nazo okubalwa indaba yokuthi abafundi bafundiswa kanjani. Into okusamele ibhekwe kabanzi." Nangesikhathi lo mkhandlu umemezela ukulungela ukubhalwa kuka-matric, ukhale ngokuthi abafundi badinga ukuhlangana nabanye badlale ukuze bakhule ngendlela efanele. Wabuza ukuthi ezikoleni ezifundisa online, abafundi bahlangana nini badlale okanye baxoxe? Wagcizelela ukuthi ukufunda ndawonye kwenza ukuthi wakhe ubungani nomuntu owafunda naye, kungaba emazingeni aphansi noma emazingeni aphezulu.Kwenzeka lokhu nje, namhlanje abafundi baka-matric babhala iphepha lesithathu lesiZulu ekuseni, ntambama babhala iphepha lokuqala le-Accounting.
INTATHELI YESOLEZWEKUVELA okushaqisayo ngezibalo zokuzibulala kwamaphoyisa eNingizimu Afrika, njengoba ezocwaningo lwakamuva, zithi masonto wonke kunephoyisa elizibulalayo okuyingwadla okungakhulunywa ngayo.Ochwepheshe baxwayisa ngokuthi inkinga yezempilo yengqondo emaphoyiseni, kwabezimo eziphuthumayo, kubahlengikazi begumbi lezimo eziphuthumayo, odokotela nezicishamlilo, isifinyelele esimweni sokufaniswa "nebhomu elingaqhuma noma yinini”.Laba ngabantu abahlenga impilo yabanye kepha abangakwazi ukuvikela eyabo - bayazibulala noma bacwile otshwaleni."Lesi yisimo esisobala kodwa esishalazelwayo,” kusho uDkt Alicia Porter oyilungu lebhodi yeSouth African Society of Psychiatrists.Uthe abasebenzi abasekhaleni lokubhekana nobugebengu, udlame lwasekhaya, izingozi zomgwaqo ezinkulu, izimo eziphuthumayo zezempilo nezinhlekelele zemvelo, basengozini yokhwantalala, ukudangala nokuzibulala."Inkinga ukuthi bangase babe nezimo zempilo yengqondo ezazivele zikhona ngaphambili kodwa uhlobo lomsebenzi luhluke kakhulu ngoba indawo abasebenzela kuyo ibachaya ezingozini eziphindaphindiwe. Iphinde ibabeke ezimweni ezicindezela ingqondo kakhulu neziyingozi kubona."Ukuzibulala kwabantu yinto ekhona. Ngicabanga ukuthi kuyefana nesifo sikashukela okanye somfutho wegazi ophezulu. Umehluko wukuthi siyakhuluma ngalezi ezinye izifo kepha kasisho lutho ngenkinga yokuzibulala.”Uthe ukwesekwa kwezempilo yengqondo kufanele kwenziwe into ehlale iyisidingo kunokuba kuhlinzekwe ngezikhathi zobunzima kuphela. Uqhube ngokuthi kufanele abasebenza imisebenzi ebucayi bakwenze umkhuba wabo ukuhlale becela ukubhekwa izimo zengqondo."Siyaya njalo kodokotela siyohlola ezinye izimo zempilo, pho kungani singazihloli isimo sengqondo?”Wengeze ngokuthi kufanele izimenenja nabanye ababhekele inhlalonhle yabasebenzi baqeqeshelwe ukukwazi ukubona ngokushesha nxa abasebenzi benezingqinamba, ukuze kuphuthunyiswe usizo ngale kokunanaza.Uthe izibalo zakamuva zikhomba ukuthi amaphoyisa nabezimo eziphuthumayo abangu-47.3% banezimo ezithile zengqondo ezihambelana nokhwantalala nengcindezi.Kuvele ukuthi u-30% wabezimo eziphuthumayo eWestern Cape, uhlukumezekile ngenxa yezimo obhekane nazo emsebenzini.Unyaka nonyaka, ukuzibulala kwamaphoyisa kuyadlonga; iningi lizibulala ngezibhamu zomsebenzi. Esigamekweni sakamuva, uSergeant oneminyaka engu-53 waseRiba Cross eBurgersfort, okusolwa ukuthi uyingxenye yophiko lokuvikela umengameli ePitoli, ubulale uzakwabo wesifazane walimaza umkakhe, ngaphambi kokuba abhekise isibhamu kuye, azibulale.Ngo-Agasti nyakenye, iphoyisa elabandakanyeka esigamekweni sokushayisa umuntu ngemoto libaleke ePhoenix, laphetha ngokuzibulala. NgoJuni 2023, okungenani amaphoyisa angu-10 azibulala, okuhlanganisa no-constable ovela ophikweni iFlying eMthatha.Ngo-2022, iphoyisa lasechwebeni laseThekwini, lasebenzisa isibhamu salo ukubulala isoka lalo, maqede lazinikela.UMnuz Mpho Mpogeng owezimo eziphuthumayo aphinde abe ngumengameli weSouth African Emergency Personnel Union, uthe emkhakheni wabo babhekana nezimo ezishaqisayo bese bezinikela otshwaleni."Asinabo abantu abaningi abazibulalayo kodwa abezimo eziphuthumayo abayisishiyagalolunye kwabangu-10 baphuza utshwala ezindaweni zabo futhi abanye baya ngisho nasemsebenzini beqhafile” usho kanje.Uqhube kanje: "Uthola ukwelulekwa ngokwengqondo kodwa lingakapheli isonto uhlangabezana nesinye isimo sizokubuyisela emuva ekucindezelekeni komqondo. Ugcina ungalali futhi sonke siyazi ukuthi ukungalali kungaholela kalula kanjani ekutheni ube nomkhwantalala."UNkk Theresa Geldenhuys ongumengameli weSouthern African Emergency Services Institute, oseneminyaka engu-34 eyisicishamlilo, uthe njengabezimo eziphuthumayo, izicishamlilo eziningi ziphendukela otshwaleni njengendlela yokubhekana nengcindezi. "Uma uphuma ekhaya ekuseni, uyavalelisa, ungazi noma uzobuya usaphila yini."Uthe izicishamlilo zibhekana nezimo abanye abazibalekelayo - abantu abashe ngendlela enyantisa igazi, zihlenge abavaleleke emalangabini omlilo ezakhiweni noma ezimotweni. Inhlangano iSouth African Depression and Anxiety Group (Sadag) ibika ukuthi wenyukile umthamo wezingcingo zabafuna usizo lokululekwa ngokwengqondo. Kuthiwa iningi liyazifihla.NgokweSadag, izinselelo zempilo yengqondo ezingalashwa azigcini nje ngokulimaza ezibakhungethe kodwa futhi zithinta ikhono labo lokusebenzela nokuvikela abanye.UNksz Megan Gonsalves oyimenenja eNetcare Akeso's 24-hour Crisis Line, uthe ukucwaswa kwabanezinselelo zezimo zengqondo kusalokhu kuyisithiyo esikhulu ekufuneni usizo. "Inselelo enkulu yisihlava esihambelana nendlela okubukwa ngayo abantu abanezinselelo zezimo zengqondo okwenza abantu bangaphumi ngobuningi ukuyofuna usizo nxa benezinkinga okuphetha ngokuthi kwenzeke into ezingezinhle njengokuzibulala.”
UBHEKENE nesinye isivunguvungu uhulumeni wokubambisana ophethe KwaZulu-Natal njengoba iqembu elingababeki benkosi, i-NFP, lithi alisabuthembi ubuholi bukaNdunankulu, uMnuz Thami Ntuli.I-NFP ithe isibona kungcono ukuthi kuthathe i-MK kuhulumeni wesifundazwe.Inkulumo yokuhoxa kwe-NFP iqhamuka kungakapheli isikhathi esingakanani i-ANC Youth League inxenxe i-ANC ukuba ishiye kuhulumeni wokubambisana.I-NFP inesihlalo esisodwa esiShayamthetho, okwenza amaqembu abusa ngokubambisana abe nezihlalo ezingu-41 kwezingu-80 esiShayamthetho.Isihlalo se-NFP yisona esenza ukuba kuphathe uhulumeni wokubambisana oholwa i-IFP esikhundleni sikahulumeni owawuzoholwa i-MK.I-IFP ibambisene ne-ANC ne-DA, i-MK yona yayivota ne-EFF ngesikhathi kuqokwa undunankulu.I-MK, enezihlalo ezingu-37 esiShayamthetho, isanda kufaka isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNtuli. I-MK imatasa inxenxa amanye amaqembu ukuba aseke isiphakamiso sayo.Ngokuthola kweSolezwe, bahlukene phakathi abeNFP njengoba kukhona abangahambisani neyokuthi iqembu lihoxe kuhulumeni wokubambisana.UMengameli we-NFP, uMnuz Ivan Barnes, uthe babona kungaba ngcono uma kungathatha yona i-MK ngoba vele iyona eyathola amavoti amaningi KwaZulu-Natal ngesikhathi kunokhetho.UBarnes uthe uhulumeni wokubambisana uhluleke wancama ukufeza izethembiso owazenza."Ngesikhathi kusungulwa uhulumeni wokubambisana kwavunyelwana ngokuthi sizosebenza ngokuthemba, sibeke eqhulwini ukuhanjiswa kwezidingo nokuheha abatshalimali. Uhulumeni wokubambisana wathembisa ukuthi omasipala bazosondela kakhulu ebantwini. Ngeshwa into esiyibona yenzeka, iphambene kakhulu naleyo eyathenjiswa mhla kusungulwa uhulumeni wokubambisana."Akukaze kube khona imihlangano lapho sibheka khona ukuthi benza kahle yini abantu abajutshwe yiwo wonke amaqembu aphethe ezikhundleni. Into esiyibonayo nje lana ukumoshwa kwemali, nokungalandelwa kwemigomo ebekelwe ukusetshenziswa kwemali. Undunankulu (Ntuli) uhambela amazwe angaphandle kungenasidingo. Ingakho singasemethembi."UBarnes uthe amaqembu aphethe ngokubambisana adlana izithende."Ngesikhathi kwakhiwa uhulumeni wokubambisana kwavunyelwana ngokuthi amaqembu azosebenzisana kodwa into esiyibona yenzeka komasipala ikhombisa ukungahloniphani nokungabambisani kwamaqembu abusayo. Ukungabambisani kwamaqembu abusayo kuphazamisa ukusebenza kukahulumeni. Le nto ilimaza kakhulu abantu okuyibona abalindele izidingo."Umholi onesikhundla esiqavile kwi-NFP ukuchithile okushiwo uBarnes.Lo mholi ocele ukuba igama lakhe lingadalulwa, uthe i-NFP ngeke iphume kuhulumeni wokubambisana."Lena yinto yomuntu oyedwa. UBarnes usazilwela impi yakhe yokuthi i-IFP yanqaba ukumnika isikhundla sobumeya kuMasipala iZululand. I-NFP isazoqhubeka ibe yingxenye kahulumeni wokubambisana."I-NFP igubuzelwe yizinkinga zangaphakathi.Leli qembu like lazama lehluleka ukuxosha ilungu lalo esiShayamthetho, uNksz Mbali Shinga.
USOMABHIZINISI osematheni uVusimuzi "Cat” Matlala, unqatshelwe ibheyili yiNkantolo eNkulu yaseGoli ecaleni lokuzama ukubulala owayeyintombi yakhe umlingisi uTebogo Thobejane.UMatlala uvele eNkantolo eNkulu ngoMsombuluko odlule ukuze adlulise icala lokunqatshelwa kwakhe ibheyili ngemuva kokunqatshelwa ukukhululwa ngenyanga edlule inkantolo yeMantshi e-Alexandra.Ubhekene necala lokuzama ukubulala uThobejane kulandela isigameko sokudubula emgwaqeni onguthelawayeka u-N1 ngaseSandton ngo-2023. Uphinde abhekane namacala okwakha itulo lokubulala nokushushumbisa imali.UThobejane obedume ngokulingisa kuMuvhango kuthiwa wadutshulwa onyaweni ngesikhathi ehlaselwa. UMatlala wenqatshelwa ibheyili ngoSepthemba eNkantolo yeMantshi yase-Alexandra ngemuva kokuthi iMantshi uSyta Prinsloo ikhiphe isinqumo sokuthi wehlulekile ukuveza izimo ezibalulekile zokudedelwa kwakhe wathola ukuthi angahle abaleke kwelakuleli njengoba kuvele enkantolo ukuthi unomazisi ongumbombayi waseSwazini.
ISOLEZWE ngeMpelasonto lixoxe nokhulumela abeseka uMntwana uSimakade kaZwelithini embangweni wesihlalo sobukhosi bukaZulu, uMntwana uThokozani. UMntwana uThokozani uchaze kabanzi ngokwenza beseke uZondamagwala wachaza nangezinhlelo zabo.Kafushane ngezizathu ezenza weseke uZondamagwala?Mangiqale ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi kanginxenxwanga muntu ukuba ngiqoke iNgonyama uZondamagwala bese ngiyeseka. Isisekelo sesinqumo sami sokuqoka nokweseka iNgonyama uZondamagwala kuze kube manje, wukuqonda kwami isiko nomlando wobukhosi bukaZulu, ukuqonda ukuthi siyini isihlalo sobukhosi bukaZulu, nokuqonda ukuthi iNdlunkulu kaZulu iluphawu lwani esizweni sikaPhunga noMageba.Ngisaqhubeka ngiyeseke iNgonyama ngenxa yokuthi yaqokwa ngokosiko lokufakwa esizweni nangokuba yikhanda leSilo uMdlokombane. Kumqoka ukuveza ukuthi ukufakwa esiswini sikaMntanenkosi kwanika iNgonyama isigaba.Kangifisi ukungena emlandweni wokuthi kwakwenzenjani ukuze uZondamagwala afakwe esiswini sikaMntanenkosi. Kakuqali ngeNgonyama uZondamagwala ukuba kufakwe esiswini lowo ogcina eyiNgonyama. Kwenzeka eSilweni sasOndini sifakwa esiswini seNdlovukazi okaNsiyane, uSanguza wakwaQwabe.Isigaba sobukhosi bakwaQwabe siyaziwa ngokomlando, uQwabe owayelanywa nguZulu, bezalwa nguMalandela. Ngokuqonda kwami, iNdlunkulu kaZulu iyisiqongo sokuvikelwa kanye nokugcinwa kosiko lukaZulu. Ngaleyo ndlela, kuseNdlunkulu lapho konke kudingeka ukuba konke kuhambe kahle ngokosiko ukuze izizwe zamakhosi zilandele uholo lweNdlunkulu oluzinze ezisekelweni eziyizo.Ngiyaqhubeka ngiyameseka uZondamagwala ngoba waqokwa ngendlela efanele futhi uyabuqonda ubungcwele besihlalo sobukhosi bukaZulu.UZondamagwala nimbiza ngeSilo ekubeni kukhona iSilo esihleli esihlalweni, akulona yini icala leli?Akusilona icala. Kasiboshiwe ngani pho kuyo yonke le minyaka? Besingazi-ke ukuthi sekulicala ukumelana namanga nobuqili phezu kwesihlalo sobukhosi. Thina njengeNdlunkulu samqoka uZondandagwala ngokosiko, silandela imigudu efaneleyo. NjengeNkosana, waluhola lonke usiko mayelana neSilo okubandakanya nokuhola ihlambo liphumela esigodlweni uMdlokombane aphumela kuso.Konke lokhu kwaqokothiswa ngokumfaka esibayeni eside, ngokwenkambo kaMdlokombane. Okudumazayo nokuxakayo wukuthi owahlonzwa ngumndeni ngokwesiko, uhulumeni uyamphika ngenxa yokungenelela kwepolitiki, amanga nobuqili.Zingaki izindlu, noma amakhanda ezindlu zaseNdlunkulu ezeseka uZondamagwala?Kuyangikhathaza ukuthi selokhu kwathi nhlo kukhulunywa lolu daba, seluthathwe lwaphendulwa ipolitiki. Kangazi okwezindlu ezeseka iNgonyama kungena kuphi. Ngokosiko imibuzo efanele ngethi: "Owabiza umhlangano wokuhlonza uMntwana uMisuzulu wayenalo yini lona igunya ngokosiko, hhayi ngokwepolitiki namanga". Indlu kaBhusha yayikhona yini kulowo mhlangano.Nxa kungekho lokho akusiyo iNdlunkulu kaZulu leyo. Okuxakayo wukuthi naye uMntwana uThulani waseZibindini wazisholo yena ukuthi ukhalo lukaBhusha luzalwa yisihlalo, futhi luyisisekelo sobukhosi. Manje-ke, buyaxaka lobu bumbaxa nokuxhomondela abasaqhubeka nabo. Yebo, zikhona izindlu ezeseka ukuqokwa kweNgonyama uZondamagwala. Imiqingo yeKomiti likaMacingwane eliyingxenye yamadokodo aseNkantolo, ikuveza kahle ukumeleleka kwezindlu.Akhona yini amakhosi eseka uZondamagwala?Ameseka ukuthi unjani? Ngiyathemba ukuthi lo mbuzo kawusophile ukuthi nxa engekho amakhosi eseka iNgonyama uZondamagwala, ngaleyo ndlela kasiyo iNgonyama ngokupheleleyo. INgonyama iqokwa ngumndeni, uholwa ngabafaneleyo, bese yethulwa esizweni, eqhulwini lesizwe ngamakhosi aluhlaka olweseka umbuso wobukhosi bukaZulu.Nxa ukhuluma ngolimi lwepolitiki, esingazi ukuthi lungena kanjani udaba lobuholi, yebo akhona. Maningi. Ayaxhumana futhi neNgonyama ngendlela kaNikhodimu waseBhayibhelini. Yikho-ke ukuthi angaphansi kwengcindezi kahulumeni namaqembu awo ezepolitiki.Izindleko zasenkantolo ziphezulu, iqhamukaphi imali yokukhokhela abameli?Kuliqiniso ukuthi izindleko ziphezulu. Kuliqiniso nokuthi asinabo abaxhasi abadla izambane likapondo. Kepha ngenxa yokuthi le mpi yethu kakusiyo eyenyama, ngekamoya futhi kusukela kuqalwa iholwa ngabaniniyo; abanikazi besihlalo, nathi siye sibone sesiliwelile izibuko, singazi nokwazi ukuthi siliwele kanjani.Luthini uhlelo uma nigcina ningaphumeleli ezinkantolo?Kasikwazi ukuwela ibhuloho singakafiki kulo. Kungafana nesiphicaphicwano senkukhu neqanda. Esikwaziyo wukuthi ekugcineni sizonqoba. Ubumnyama abukwazi ukunqoba ukukhanya. Kanjalo namazolo kawamelani nelanga. Abanikazi besihlalo kabakaze babe ngabaqambi manga. Siyazi ukuthi kabasoze basiholela Ophathe. Ngiyakholwa wukuthi nakulokhu basophe ukusikhumbuza ukuthi le mpi ingeyabo. Nalapho inqotshwa masingazishayi isifuba.Kukhona abaphakamisa uMntwana uBuzabazi, kuthini ukuphawula kwakho?Kanginakho ukuphawula ngalokho. Hleze kungakuhle lo mbuzo uqondiswe kwabakhuluma ngebizo lakhe. Kulula kimi ukukhuluma ngokuhlonzwa kukaZondamagwala ngoba ngikuqonda kahle ukuthi wahlonzwa kanjani ngokwesiko.Njengamanje yisiphi isigodlo uZondamagwala akuso "njengombusi wesizwe"?UZondamagwala uzobusela kusiphi isigodlo ngoba umhlaba wonke uyazi ukuthi mhla ka-16 Septhemba 2022 iNgonyama yaphuma ngentuba ngenxa yethimba lamaphoyisa ayekhishwe nguhulumeni ukuba izosocongwa? Nanamuhla abaphaki baleyo mpi ababehlangene nabalapha egcekeni kabakezi ukuzogeza isigodlo?Kuye lesi kakusona isikhathi sokubusa nokutamasa. Yisikhathi sosizi nokuzila ngenxa yengcuphe yokushabalala kobukhosi bukaZulu kanye nefagugu lakhe. Kakuqali-ke ngoZondamagwala. Ngo-1879 kuyophela u-Agasti, iSilo sasOndini sabanjwa sisemgedeni ehlathini laseNgome sesiyiswa ekudingisweni. Ngemumva kwaso, iSilo uDinuzulu saphumela eNqabeni, ehlathini KwaCeza siyonqoba uZibhebhu KwaNdunu siyothatha ubunsizwa kuZibhebhu.Akhona amathuba okuba nishintshe ukucabanga uma nithola isimemo esize ngqo, siphuma eSilweni, somhlangano oseMashobeni mhla ka-29?Nxa kutholakala isimemo esize ngqo eNgonyameni uZondamagwala, lokho kuyovula intuba yokuba iveze ilaka layo ngqo, ngokomgudu. Sifisa ukuba izinto zenzeke ngendlela efanele nangokwesiko. Kungenzeka kanjani ukuthi siqhamuke sesiyohlangana embizweni ezamagula zingakhulunyiwe khona emaguleni. Kungenzeka kanjani ukuthi singaqale sikhulume njengendlu, ngaphambi kokuphuma siye kwiNdlunkulu yonke, sesitholebene thina njengokwendlu?Nxa siya embizweni siyokwenzani, siyokhulekela lowo esingamhlonzanga njengeNdlunkulu, bese kuthiwa sesimkhulekele, sesimamukele? Kasikwazi ukuzihlanganisa nento engahlelekile ngokosikompilo. Kwake kwakuphi lapho nxa kunamaphuzu athinta umndeni engakhulunywa emaguleni kuqala? Angithi nangesikhathi besifunza yena uMntwana benza ngale ndlela.UZulu usuyihlaya kwezinye izizwe ngenxa yalo mbango. Akukuhluphi lokhu? Kuyangihlupha kakhulu, ubusuku nemini, ikakhulukazi nxa ngicabanga ukuthi sifike kanjani lapha sikhona. Kepha kasikwazi ukuthi sithi sibalekela ukuba lihlaya, bese sakhela phezu kwamabibi. Isizathu esisibeke kuleso simo sokuba lihlaya ngesobuqili nokuxhomondela kwezepolitiki ezindabeni zesihlalo. Umsuka wokuba lihlaya siwutholile kuMntwana uThulani waseZibindini nxa eveza ukuthi konke lokhu abakwenzayo kungenxa yokuthi ukhalo lweSilo saKwaKhetha uBhusha, kaluhlangene futhi kalunabuhlakani. Kepha akulona iqiniso eliphelele ukuthi uZulu usulihlaya ngenxa yombango wodwa. Esinye sezizathu wukwenza nokuziphatha kukaMntwana uMisuzulu nokungaphela inqwaba yamakhasi nxa ngingakubala lapha.
BAKHOMBA abafundi ngenjumbane othisha bakuleli njengembangela yokuthi yibona abenza babe nokhwantalala.Ngaphezu kwalokhu labo thisha bathwele umthwalo wokufundisa amahora amaningi kanjalo nomsebenzi okumele bawenze nsuku zonke ezikoleni.Lokhu kuvele embikweni iTeaching and Learning International Survey (TALIS) ka-2024, othulwe nguNgqongqoshe weMfundo eyisiSekelo, uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, eMpumalanga. Uthe abafundi yibona okuvele ukuthi bahlukumeza othisha ngokukhuluma noma yikanjani nabo."Othisha bakuleli bathwele kakhulu njengoba besebenza amahora abalelwa ku-26.6 ngesonto. Kwamanye amazwe basebenza angu-21.1 ngesonto. Kudingeka bamake amaphepha, baphinde benze umsebenzi wasehhovisi kanti baveze ukuthi ukuziphatha kwabafundi yikhona okubafakela ingcindezi. Umbiko uveze ukuthi u-59% wothisha no-58% wothishanhloko, banengcindezi yomsebenzi."Uthe yingakho basayina isivumelwano sokusebenzisana namaphoyisa ukuze kuphephe ezikoleni."Kunezindawo esiziqaphe ngelokhozi okuyiNanda, KwaZulu-Natal, Mthatha e-Eastern Cape, Emfuleni naseManenburg eWestern Cape. Kumele izikole zethu ziphephe." Udalule nokuthi ithela izithelo imizamo yomnyango yokuheha intsha ekutheni ingene emkhakheni wokufundisa njengoba umbiko uveze nokuthi siyanda isibalo sothisha abancane.Uthe lo mbiko uveza ukuthi yehlile iminyaka yothisha abasezikoleni isuka ku-43 ngo-2018, yaya ku-41 ngo-2024.Uthe kwamanye amazwe iminyaka yothisha ingu-45."Lezi yizinkomba zokuthi siyakwazi ukuheha intsha ekutheni iyofundisa. U-23% wothisha bakuleli, ungaphansi kweminyaka engu-30. Izingane zethu sezifundiswa abantu abasha, abakwazi ukushintshela ezintweni ezithinta ubuchwepheshe," kusho uNksz Gwarube. Uthe umbiko uveza ukuthi u-62% wothisha babevele befuna ukufundisa."Kumele siqhubeke nokwenza lo mkhakha uhehe entsheni. Kodwa kumele siqikelele ukuthi bayaphepha." Udalule ukuthi u-62% wothisha ngabesifazane, kodwa bangu-32% abangothishanhloko."Kumele bangene ezikhundleni eziphezulu abesifazane ezikoleni zethu." Uveze nokuthi u-65% wezikole ukhuluma olunye ulimi ngaphandle kwalolo lokufunda nokufundisa."Uhhafu wothisha uveze ukuthi abafundi badonsa kanzima ngasolimini lokufunda nokufundisa. U-56% wabafundi uqhamuka emakhaya adonsa kanzima," usho kanje.Uthe yingakho bezoqinisa esisekelweni semfundo ukuze abafundi bangathwali kanzima uma sebesemazingeni aphezulu."Okunye okuletha ithemba ngalo mbiko wukuthi uhhafu wothisha ususebenzisa ubuchwepheshe besimanje, i-AI ukufundisa. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi bazimisele ukuhambisana nokuguquka kwesimo emhlabeni jikelele. Abangabusebenzisi ubuchwepheshe baveze ukuthi yingoba bengenawo amakhono kanjalo nengqalasizinda."
ABASOLWA ababili ababoshwe neNkosi Simphiwe Erick Zuma, babhekene namanye amacala okubulala aqulwa eNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu.Ngaphandle kokuhamba amacala ababoshwe kuwo noZuma, uMnuz Thabo Mathonsi Chonco noMnuz Thembelani Mbatha, baphinde begqigqe ezinkantolo ngamanye amacala okuqotha abantu.UChonco noMbatha bavele kafushane eNkantolo yeMantshi eHowick, ngoLwesine.UChonco uqale wavela ecaleni lokubulawa kowayeyikhansela leDA kuMasipala waseMngeni.Kuthiwa uChonco walihlangansa esejele itulo lokubulawa kukaNdlovu.UChonco uphinde wavela kafushane ngecala lokubulala owayelwa nokudayiswa komhlaba kamasipala eMpophomeni, uMnuz Xolani Ndlovu/Ntombela.Kuleli cala uboshwe noMbatha. Womabili amacala ahlehliselwe uNovemba 6.UChonco benoMbatha bahamba icala lokuqothwa kwamalungu omndeni wakwaMemela.Amalungu omndeni wakwaMemela ayishumi aqothwa ngonyaka odlule elokishini Imbali Unit 14, ngonyaka odlule.Emalungwini adutshulwa ekuseni kwakukhona nezingane ezinhlanu.UChonco uphinde ahambe icala lokuqotha amalungu amahlanu omndeni waseBulwer.Kuleli cala uselinde isigwebo njengoba selimlahlile.UMbatha uphinde abhekane necala lokubulala owayeyikhansela le-ANC, uMnuz Mabhungu Mkhize. UMkhize wabulawa ngo-2023, elokishini Imbali Unit 14.Nabanye abasolwa ababoshwe noZuma, uMnuz Thobani Masobho Hlongwa noMnuz Khayelihle Shabalala, basolwa ngokuba yingxenye yeqembu lemigulukudu elihlalise lubhojozi abantu eMgungundlovu.Nakuba engekho amanye amacala ahanjwa wuHlongwa noShabalala, uMbuso wenza izinsolo zokuthi bayingxenye yeqembu lemigulukudu. Lezi zinsolo zenziwa wuMbuso ngesikhathi uphikisa isicelo sokuthi badedelwe ngebheyili.Umsolwa osephenduke ufakazi woMbuso, uMnuz Zwelithini Buthelezi naye unezigemegeme zakhe. UButhelezi uphinde abe wumsolwa ecaleni lokubulawa kukaQalokunye.Uke waboshelwa icala lokutholakala nesiphehlimandla sikagesi esintshontshiwe.Ngaphambi kokuthi aboshwe uke wadlala umacashelana namaphoyisa kwaze kwaphela unyaka.
OWAYENGUMENGAMELI, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, ukhalima labo asebeqale umkhankaso wokumqoqela imali yokukhokha isikweletu sezigidi zamarandi.UZuma unxuse labo abahambe bemshayela indesheni ukuba babambe amatomu njengoba engakanqumi ukuthi uzosikhokha yini isikweletu sika-R28.9 million sezindleko zabameli ababemumela oxhaxheni lwamacala abhekana nawo ngesikhathi esengumengameli.Ukusho lokhu esitatimendeni esikhishweni inhlangano yakhe engenzi nzuzo, iJacob G Zuma Foundation.Ngeledlule, uZuma uhlangabezane nembibizane emva kokuba iNkantolo eNkulu ePitoli imyalele ukuba akhokhe lesi samba semali.Icala lafakwa iHhovisi likaMengameli likhala ngokuthi uMbuso kwakungafanele ukuba ukhokhele izindleko zabameli kaZuma emacaleni abhekana nawo ngesikhathi esengumengameli okubalwa kuwo necala lenkohlakalo elithinta ithenda yokuthengwa kwezikhali.Inkantolo inqumele uZuma izinsuku ezingu-60 ukuba akhokhe lesi sikweletu, yanikeza uMbuso igunya lokudla impahla yakhe uma ehluleka ukuhlangabezana nalo mnqamulajuqu.Phakathi kwempahla kaZuma engadliwa uma engakhokhi, kubalwa nemali yakhe yempesheni.Lesi simo senze ukuthi kube khona abashayela uZuma indesheni ezinkundleni zokuxhumana.Okhulumela iJacob G Zuma Foundation, uMnuz Mzwanele Manyi, uthe abagunyaziwe laba bantu abahambe becelela uZuma imali."Siyibonile imibhalo esabalele ezinkundleni zokuxhumana lapho khona abantu becelela uZuma imali yezindleko zabameli. Nakuba laba abenza njalo benezinhloso ezinhle zokwelekelela, sithi asisho ukuthi abagunyaziwe yinhlangano ukuba behambe becela imali."UManyi uthe uZuma ubengakanqumi ukuthi uzoyikhokha yini le mali."Njengoba sasishilo ukuthi sisaxoxa nabameli. Sizokwenza isimemezelo uma sesiqedile ukuxoxa nabameli. Yilapho siyomemezela khona izinyathelo esizozithatha."UManyi unxuse abantu ukuba bangayikhokhi imali abacelwa ukuba bayikhiphe."Sinxusa abantu ukuthi balinde isimemezelo esisemthethweni esizokwenziwa yinhlangano kaZuma emva kokuphothula izingxoxo nabameli. Sithanda nokuxwayisa abantu ukuba bapheze ukusebenzisa uphawu lwenhlangano kaZuma ngaphandle kwemvume. Ukwenza lokhu kwenza ukuthi abantu badideke."Maningi amathuba okuthi uZuma asidlulisele phambili isinqumo sangeledlule njengoba evamisile ukwenza uma elahlwe yicala.Onke amacala aseke alahla uZuma uwaphonsela inselelo aze ayofika eNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo, okuyiyo ethathatha isinqumo esiwujuqu.
AKUKACACI namanje ukuthi bazokhululeka futhi bakuthole nini okungokwabo abantu abalinde izizumbulu zemali yabo ababeyigcine ebhange eselavalwa Ithala, njengoba namanje kungakabi bikho sisombululo nambiko ngokwenzekayo.Lokhu kuqinisekiswe ngomunye wabantu abagcine imali yabo eThala, okwaphuma umbiko wokuthi seliyavalwa ngonyaka odlule, okuze kube yimanje kunenqwaba yabantu abalinde ukuthi babuyiselwe imali abebeyigcina iminyakanyaka kuleli bhange.Leli lungu (70) lomphakathi elixoxe neSolezwe, nelilidonse ngendlebe ukuthi lingadalulwa igama lalo, lithe likhathazekile futhi alinakuthula emoyeni njengoba lisebantwini abebebeka imali yabo eThala kusukela liqala ukusebenza eminyakeni ewu-25 edlule."Bengihlale ngibeka imali yami khona yonke le minyaka kwaze kwaba ngithatha umhlalaphansi ngo-2020. Bekuba wukuthi ngiyayibeka, bese ngiyikhipha uma kusuke kukhona engiyidingayo ngaleso sikhathi bese ngiyayibuyisela futhi. Nokho kwathi sekuvela izindaba zokuthi leli bhange liyavalwa, lavala kabi kungqwamba nemali yami engaphezu kuka-R10 000, engilokhu ngilinde ukuthi ngibuyiselwe yona, namanje lutho," lisho kanje.Liqhuba ikhasimende, lithe okubuhlungu nokuliphatha kabi kakhulu wukuthi akukho mbiko noma saziso abasitholayo ukuthi kuzokwenzekani ngemali yabo, nokuthi izofika kanjani kubona ukuze bayisebenzisele ukuziphilisa noma bayigcine kwamanye amabhange uma besafisa ukwenza lokho."Lesi simo sibuhlungu kakhulu njengoba abanye bethu behleli emakhaya, behlupheka ekubeni benemali engabe iyabasiza ukulungisa ezinye izidingo zempilo yabo. Konke lokhu kuyasigqilaza nasemiqondweni njengoba sekwaze kwaba khona nabantu engibaziyo asebadlula emhlabeni belinde ukuthola imali yabo," kusho ilungu lomphakathi.Ngesikhathi kusanda kuvalwa ukuthi imali ifakwe noma ikhishwe kuleli bhange, baningi ababekhihla isililo - abanye baeveza nokuthi abakwazi ukungcwaba izihlobo zabo ngendlela enesizotha ngenxa yokuvaleleka kwemali yabo. Kuthintwa uMnuz Lindelani Mbatha, okhulumela ihhovisi likaNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, okuyilona elibhekele izindaba ezithinta iThala, wathembisa ukubuya nempendulo, kwaze kwaphela isonto lonke, obekuthi uma ekhunjuzwa ngalokho, athi uzoyasiza intatheli uma sekukhona imininingwane angayinika yona mayelana nalolu daba.UNdunankulu Thami Ntuli wayegcine ecashunwe ethembisa ukuthi bayayisukumela inkinga yeThala futhi sebexhumane noMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ukuba ilungiswe.
UMCULI kamaskandi, uBukelani "Dlubheke" Khuzwayo, uhlangabezane nembibizane kade eyofaka isicelo sebheyili eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseNquthu, izolo. Lo mculi (31) wodumo lwengoma ethi Impi Yamatekisi nethi Siqhathwe eNquthu, uthole ukuthi emacaleni amane sekwengezwe amabili okubulala aphenywa ngamaphoyisa aseGauteng. Isolezwe lithole ngephoyisa elingagunyaziwe ukukhuluma nabezindaba ukuthi uDlubheke usesolwa nangokubulala owesilisa oseyibhungu eGoli, ngoJanuwari 1, 2022 nenye indoda yaseKatlehong, ngoNovemba 27, 2024. Ngakho amacala asebhekene noDlubheke aseyisithupha esewonke. Usabhadle esitokisini saseThekwini."Amaphoyisa ayehla ayanyuka naye ngenxa yokuthi akubonakali kungalunga uma engatoka eNcome noma eVryheid, ngenxa yamacala abhekene nawo. Ufika namaphoyisa avale ubuso okuyiwona ehla nawo njalo uma eza ecaleni," kusho umthombo.UDlubheke ubuyela enkantolo ngoNovemba 27, njengoba kusacutshungulwa ukuthi la macala uzowathamela ngaziphi izinsuku njengoba esezinkantolo ezahlukene.Lo mculi uqale ukubingelela inkantolo ngoMsombuluko, emuva kokuzinikela emaphoyiseni aseDurban North, eThekwini, ngenxa yokuthinteka emacaleni amabili okubulala namanye amabili okuzama ukubulala. Imithombo yathi wazinikela emuva kokwelunywa indlebe ngokuthi uphiko lwamaphoyisa i-NIU lumfuna phansi phezulu.Kuthiwa okwamthusa kakhulu ukuzwa ukuthi amaphoyisa aseGauteng asedubule abulala uZamani Ngila Ximba waseQhudeni, esigamekweni esenzeke eDuduza, Ekurhuleni, ngoLwesine olwedlule, ngo-12 ebusuku. UXimba ubesolwa ngokubhuqabhuqa ngenhlamvu abantu, okukhona kubo nowayeyilungu elimele iNkatha ePhalamende, uMnuz Khethamabala Petros Sithole (67). USithole wabulawa ngokudutshulwa ehostela iBuyafuthi, eKatlehong, ngoMeyi, eyokhuza ukubulalana kwabantu baseQhudeni. Ekuqaleni kwesonto, isitatimende samaphoyisa aKwaZulu-Natal, sithe ukuboshwa kukaDlubheke kumayelana nesigameko esenzeka ngoNovemba 12, 2023, sokuhlaselwa kwamadoda amane akwaSithole eQhudeni, ayesemotweni emhlophe eliqhamukisa eNtinini, eBabanango, elibangise emakhaya."Ngesikhathi edlula eMpukunyoni, kusolwa ukuthi avinjwa wumsolwa, ababekhuluma naye ngesikhathi besendleleni. Ngesikhathi imoto seyizokuma, umsolwa waqala wavulela ngenhlamvu, ebhekise kubagilwa, kwathi umshayeli wahluleka ukulawula imoto yagcina seyiphaphalaza."Siqhuba isitatimende, sithe abagilwa ababili basindiswa ukubaleka endaweni yesigameko, kwathi abanye bagcina bedlulile emhlabeni ngenxa yokulimala kabi. Kwenzeka lokhu nje, uDlubheke ubesanda kuveza ukuthi usephilisa okwenyamazane ngenxa yokubona engaphephile. Le nsizwa yakhala ngokudeze iyamaniswa nezigameko zokubulawa kwabantu, kokunye ize iboshwe kodwa kungenzeki igcine ibekwe icala. Ekhuluma kwiClean Governance Podcast, uDlubheke wasola abantu bangakubo athi bamqhatha nabaseMsinga naseTembisa. Uthe useke wakhalelwa ngamasongo kaSigonyela ngoba esolwa ekubulaweni kwabantu abangaphezu kweshumi.Echaza, wathi udaba lwaqala ngo-Okthoba 2023, njengoba esebona kufanele agonyuluke. Uthe kubantu abangu-11 asebebulewe uyedwa kuphela okungasolwa yena ekufeni kwakhe, wathi okumxakayo sebaboshwa abantu abathinteka ekufeni kwabantu kodwa iminwe isalokhu ibheke kuye kangangoba sekuhlaselwe kubo amahlandla amaningi, kwaze kwadutshulwa noyise, uShobeni Khuzwayo weZingane Zoma futhi kwashiswa imoto. UDlubheke wathi ngolunye usuku evakashele abafowabo eVosloorus, eGauteng, wahlaselwa ngabantu bangakubo angaxabene nabo kodwa wasinda ngokulambisa.Uqhube wathi babuya namaphoyisa amgquma izinyanga ezintathu esitokisini saseBoksburg. Uthe akugcinanga lapho, kodwa kwabuye kwafika amaphoyisa namanye amacala aseTembisa, waboshwa wadedelwa. Yize udlame lwaKwaNgqulu selwakhuzwa kodwa uthe kusalokhu kukhonjwa yena uma kufa umuntu njengababulawe eFaraday.Wadalula ukuthi usebuye wakhonjwa ekubulaweni kukaSithole ehostela eBuyafuthi, eKatlehong, kangangoba amaphoyisa aseke ahlasela epulazini likayise, kanjalo nakubo ngoba emsola ngokuthi ufihle omunye umsolwa.Waveza ukuthi nakulesi sigameko ubhecwa ngobende ngoba senzeka yena eyozingela eMpumalanga futhi kunobufakazi.
UKUQONDA ubunzima besimo akhule kuso sakubo nokushisekela ukuthi ngelinye ilanga sibe ngcono kakhulu kunakhule siyikhona, yizona zinto ezikhuthaze umculi kamaskandi uMahostela97 ukuqinisa futhi wabekezela emfundweni, waze wathola iziqu zobuthishela.UMahostela97 (28) wodumo lwengoma ethi Ngikheth' Utshwala, ayishaya noShenge waseHlalankosi, ungesinye sezitshudeni ezithweswe iziqu e-University of South Africa (Unisa) kuleli sonto, emva kweminyaka eyisikhombisa ecijwa khona.Engxoxweni neSolezwe ngalokho, lo mculi odabuka eMatholamnyama, eNdwedwe, ogama lakhe lokuzalwa wuSiphesihle Thobelani Busani, uthe lokho kusho lukhulu kuyena njengoba kusukela esasemncane impilo yakhe ibingelula neze, okuphoqe ukuthi abekezele nalapho kubonakala sengathi izinto ziyabhimba kuphela empilweni yakhe. "Ngiqede u-matric wami ngo-2016, ePhuzulwani Secondary ngangakwazi ukuqhubeka nemfundo ezingeni eliphakeme ngenxa yokungalutholi usizo lweNSFAS, okuthe sekulunga ngo-2018, ngaqala ngokwenza isitifiketi sami sokwendlalela izifundo zobuthishela, ngenzela ukuthi uma sengifundile ngibe wusizo ekhaya njengoba kuyimi omdala ezinganeni zikamama."Yilokho futhi okwenze ukuthi ngawo u-2018, nganquma ukuthatha imadlana enganginayo ngayocijelwa ngayo ukuba wunogada ngoba ngenzela ukuthi ngishebe isikole nomsebenzi ukusiza ukuthi ngibe wusizo ekhaya futhi ngikwazi ukuzenzela ezinye izinto, ngingahlale ngicela yonke into ekubeni kube kubhekwe mina kokuningi," kulanda uMahostela97. Eqhuba, uthe kube nzima sekumele aqede izifundo zakhe ngo-2022, ngenxa yokuthi yilapho eqale khona ukungenisa ngomculo, okwenze ukuthi waphazamiseka kancane ezifundweni zakhe njengoba futhi ebebhekwe wumsebenzi wansuku zonke wokuba wunogada, asakwenza namanje."Lokho kwenza ukuthi ngangakwazi ukuphothula izifundo zami ngesikhathi esifanele, yingakho ngize ngigcina ngiphothula izifundo zami manje, emva kweminyaka eyisikhombisa ngaqala ukufunda e-Unisa. Nokho kungijabulisile ukuthi ekugcineni ngakufeza lokho engangizibekele khona, engithemba ukuthi kuzovula eminye iminyango yezinto ezinhle kubhekwe phambili, ngikwazi ukushintsha isimo sasekhaya," kusho uMahostela97.
KUBHEKWE ukuthi imboni yezamafilimu KwaZulu-Natal ingene ebalazweni lomhlaba njengoba uphiko lwezamafilimu nezokuvakasha esifundazweni iKwaZulu-Natal Tourism and Film Authority selwethule isikhathi sokuqhakambisa amafilimu avutshelwe eKZN, nokuzothatha izinyanga ezimbili ukuwaqhakambisa, ukugqamisa nokuveza izindaba ezixoxwe kulesi sifundazwe.Kulo nyaka lolu hlelo lwesekwe ngemali engaphezu kuka-R2.5 million wokulumaketha, ukulugqamisa nokuluxhasa ukuze lube yimpumelelo kusukela kule nyanga kuze kuyophela inyanga ezayo, lapho okuzobe kugqanyiswe khona amafilimu avutshelwe eKZN, akhonjiswe ezweni lonke nasemazweni ehlukene omhlaba.Lolu hlelo luzoqala ngokuthi kwenziwe ama-festival ehlukene ezamafilimu azoba seMlaza, eMgungundlovu nakuMasipala wesiFunda Amajuba, lapho kuzokhonjiswa inqwaba yamafilimu ebantwini babone ubuhle bethalente lokulingisa esifundazweni.Isikhulu esiphezulu esibambile eKZN Tourism & Film Authority, uMnuz Sibusiso Gumbi, sithe imboni yamafilimu ikwezimqoka nezinamandla okuqhakambisa ubuhle bethalente lamaciko aseKZN nasezweni lonke, futhi kubamba iqhaza elikhulu ekuthuthukiseni umnotho, yingakho bebone kumqoka ukutshala imali engaka ukusiza ukufeza lowo mbono wabo."Njengoba kuyilesi sikhathi lapho sihlale siqhakambisa khona amafilimu avutshelwe eKZN, sibheke ukuthi sisize amaciko akithi ukwakha amathuba omsebenzi. Lama festivali esizowenza azosiza ukuhlanganisa abantu bethu, babone ubuhle bobuciko bethu, kube futhi kusiza nokuthi ukubambisana kwethu nezinhlaka zobuciko zasemazweni omhlaba, kusilekelele ukuqhakambisa ubuciko bethu kwamanye amazwe. Lokhu kuzosisiza nangokuvuselela uthando lokubuka amafilimu ebantwini, bese kuthuthuka imboni yethu ngalokho," usho kanje.Ingxenye yala mafilimu ayizukugcina ngokukhonjiswa eKZN kuphela, njengoba kuhlelwe nokuthi akhonjiswe kuma festivali azoba se-Finland, India naseNetherlands. Enye yalawo mafilimu ngethi 6SENSE, eyiqophamlando elididiyelwe wuChris Kets no-Amical Patel, kanjalo nethi And She Didn't Die, ezokhonjiswa kwi-International Documentary Film Festival ezoba se-Amsterdam, eNetherlands kusuka ngoNovemba 13 kuya ku-23, bese kuthi abanye abakhiqizi bamafilimu bathole ithuba lokumela izwe kwi-International Film Festival eGoa, e-India ngoNovemba 20 kuya ku-28.Kuleli zwe lawo mafilimu namanye azokhonjiswa kwi-Umlazi International Film Festival ezoba seMangosuthu University of Technology, kube UMgungundlovu Film Festival, Amajuba Film Festival akhuza ibuya ihlandla lesihlanu nonyaka.Kanti futhi akuzukugcina ngokuthi kujatshulelwe ukubuka amafilimu kuphela, njengoba kulama festivali kuzoba khona izigcawu zokucobelelana ngolwazi, okuzobe kukhona kuzona amaciko asenamava kule ndawo ukuzohlomiisa ngolwazi amaciko asafufusa nafisa ukugqama kule ndima."Konke lokho sikwenzele ukuhlomisa ngolwazi amaciko akithi asafika kule ndima, ukusiza ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amathuba anjengaleli awapheleli eThekwini kuphela, kepha asiza nabantu bakwezinye izindawo ezahlukene ezakhele isifundazwe sethu," kusho uGumbi.Ukuthola uhla oluphelele lwezinsuku zalama festivali neminye imininingwane ngawo, ungangena kwi-website ethi: www.visitkznsa.com noma ulandele iKZN Tourism and Film Authority ezinkundleni zokuxhamana ezahlukene.
Kuphenywe icala lokubulala ngemuva kokudutshulwa kubulawa owesilisa esemotweni yakhe emgwaqweni u-Bamboo Lane, ePhayindane.Abezimo eziphuthumayo bafike endaweni yesigameko bathola amaphoyisa asevele ekhona umgwaqo uvaliwe. Abezimo eziphuthumayo bakhonjiswe owesilisa odutshulwe amanxeba amaningi eceleni komgwaqo, bahlole le ndoda okukholakala ukuthi iseminyakeni yama-50 nokho akakhombisanga zimpawu zokuthi uyaphila, wahlonzwa njengoshonele endaweni yesehlo.
Umelwe yinhliziyo ethola usizo lokuqala owesifazane obeveleleke emotweni.Ngemuva kwehora lesihlanu ekuseni abezimo eziphuthumayo bakwa-ALS babizelwe engozini enkulu eyenzeke kuHans Detman Highway noWiltshire Road endaweni yaseShallcross eNtshonalanga yeTheku.Abezimo eziphuthumayo bafike bathola isibhicongo njengoba befice izimoto ezimbili ebezilimele kabi emgwaqweni. Bahlole indawo yesigameko bathola ukuthi omunye wabashayeli ubevaleleke kanzima emotweni esesimweni esibucayi. Kudingeke ukuba uphiko lwezeMlilo lukhiphe isicishamlilo ukuba uzosiza ngesikhathi abe-Advanced Life Support Paramedics bezama ukusimamisa lo wesifazane emotweni. Ngeshwa ngesikhathi ezama ukukhulula lo wesifazane okukholakala ukuthi uneminyaka engamashumi amahlanu ubudala umelwe yinhliziyo. Phezu kwayo yonke imizamo yokuhlenga impilo yakhe kuthiwa ugcine eshonele endaweni yesigameko.Umshayeli wesibili owesilisa oneminyaka eko-40 ubelimele kodwa abe-Advanced Life Support Paramedics bakwazile ukumenza azinze wase ephuthunyiswa esibhedlela esiseduze ukuze athole ukunakekelwa okwengeziwe abekudinga.Okwamanje izehlakalo ezaholela engozini azaziwa kodwa amaphoyisa asazophenya kabanzi.

Ngafisa ukwazi kabanzi ngokuba yi-missionary, kanti sengizothola inhlangano i-YWAM, esengifunda kuyo." UBEVUTHA engabaselwe, eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseNtuzuma, umshushisi ecaleni lokubulawa kowesilisa owayesolwa ngokweba isibhamu - okwabuye kwavela ukuthi umnikazi ubesilibale otshwaleni.Kuleli cala kuboshwe abasolwa abathathu okunguMnuz Sibongiseni Kunene (51), yindodana yakhe uMnuz Siyabonga Mhlongo (31) nendodakazi yakhe uNksz Amanda Mhlongo (28). Basolwa ngokubulala uMnuz Sphiwe "Mapi'' Ndlanzi (39) ngesonto eledlule. Kuthiwa umufi uyisihlobo sabasolwa.Kuthiwa babemsolwa ngokweba isibhamu sikaKunene, okwabuye kwavela ukuthi wayesibambise umnikazi wendawo yokucima ukoma, ebona ukuthi usedle kakhulu amanzi amponjwana.Izolo enkantolo, uMshushisi uNksz B Mncwango, ubevutha ebhoka ekhahlela ephikisa konke okusezitatimendeni zabasolwa ebebezincengela ngazo ukuba bathole ibheyili.Eqhulwini, uqale wahlaba wahlikiza iphuzu labasolwa lokuthi bakinatelwe ngenxa yodungunyane lokungaboni ngaso linye phakathi kwe-MK ne-ANC kwa-K KwaMashu. Leli phuzu umshushisi uthe alinasisindo futhi kaliwenzi nhlobo umqondo."Niqamba amanga uma nithi nilapha nje kungenxa yokuthi kuqhubeka ukungaboni ngasolinye phakathi kwala maqembu, nina-ke seniphenduke izisulu zalokho. Uma kuya ngokuthi lokho kuyiqiniso, pho kungani lapha emnyango kuhlangene abantu bawo womabili amaqembu bonke besho ngazwi linye, bethi nina kumele ningaphumi lapha? Niyabona-ke ukuthi leli phuzu lenu kalinaso ngempela isisindo?" usho kanjena.Eqhuba umshushisi, ukuhlabe wakuhlikiza nokuthi laba ezitatimendeni zabo bathe banamahlalakhona, yingakho kumqoka ukuba badedelwe."Pho kungani ningabizi odokotela benu bezofakaza ngamahlakhona enu lapha enkantolo? Niqamba amanga nina, niphile saka,'' usho kanjena.Uqhuba, uthe siyamxaka isitatimende somsolwa wesithathu sokuthi usazolethela inkantolo ubufakazi obuphathekayo bokuthi ngempela yena ngosuku lwesigameko wayengekho."Pho ulindeni lobo bufakazi ungabulethi manje? Angithi ufuna ukuthola ibheyili bese uyodlala kahle amakhadi akho. Nginxusa inkantolo ukuba ingakunikezi lelo thuba lokuthi wenze lokho ngokukuncisha ibheyili," echaza.Umshushisi ugcizelele ukuthi akakholwa ukuthi kungaba yisinqumo esifanele ukudedelwa kwalaba ngebheyili."Uma nigcinwa ngaphakathi sinesiqiniseko esiphelele sokuthi ngeke nilibalekele icala. Kodwa uma nidedelwa ngebheyili asinaso isiqiniseko sokuthi ngeke nibaleke," usho kanjena.Ummeli wabasolwa ubekade ekhulume kuqala eveza wonke amaphuzu abekade egadla ngawo enxusela abasolwa ukuba bakhishwe ngebheyili.Elinye iphuzu alishilo elokuthi kulesi sigaba secala akukaveli ukuthi libe yini iqhaza lomsolwa ngamunye.Uthe ngenxa yalokho, abukho ubufakazi obuphathekayo bokuthi nebala yibona abenzi bokubi, wathi kufanele bakhululwe ngoba kuyilungelo labo.Imantshi enqabe negama layo igcine ingasikhiphanga isinqumo yathi idinga ukubuyekeza wonke amaphuzu ngaphambi kokuba inqume. Ithe icala lihlehliselwa u-Okthoba 29, lapho okuyophuma khona isinqumo sokuthi laba bayayithola yini ibheyili noma cha.

UMENGAMELI wamaJaji osabambile eNkantolo eNkulu yaseGoli, uAubrey Phago Ledwaba, usolwe ngokuchema ngesikhathi ededela ngebheyili usomabhizinisi osematheni osolwa ngokubulala, uMnuz Katiso "KT" Molefe. Lokhu kuvele kwiKhomishana kaMadlanga ngesikhathi kufakazi ofihliwe ngokwesabela ukuphepha kwakhe, ongumphenyi wethimba elaziwa ngeSAPS Gauteng Organised Crime Unit.Lo fakazi uphenya icala lokubulawa kukaMnuz Armand Swart, owayengunjiniyela waseVereeniging, owadutshulwa wabulawa ngo-Ephreli 17, 2024. UMolefe ubekwe icala lokubulala uSwart kanye nezinye izinkabi ezintathu okungoWarrant Officer Michael Pule Tau, Mnuz Musa Kekana noMnuz Tiego Floyd Mabusela. Ufakazi utshele ikhomishana ukuthi isinqumo sikaLedwaba besihleliwe. "NgoJuni 2025, lolu daba lwalalelwa eNkantolo eNkulu yaseNorth Gauteng, ePitoli. Owayengamele udaba, bekuyiJaji elibambile uMengameli Ledwaba. Ngesikhathi lolu daba luqhubeka, ngangingeneme ngokwakuhlaluka, ngabona sengathi ijaji seluluhlele kahle udaba,” kusho ufakazi. Uqhube wathi kuyena kwadwebeka isithombe sokuthi wayezimisele ngokunika uMolefe, owayesolwa ngamacala abucayi, ibheyili ehambisana nemibandela ethambile.Ubalule okubili, athe kwamgqamela. "Ummeli kaMolefe wacela ukuthi akwazi ukunyakaza esifundazweni saseGauteng noma aboshelwe ekhaya. Ijaji ngokwalo, labuza ukuthi ngeke yini kube umbandena oqine kakhulu ukuthi ukuboshelwa endlini njengoba enamabhizinisi kwezinye izifundazwe,” kusho ufakazi. Uthe ummeli kaMolefe waphendula wathi impela unenqwaba yamabhizinisi amenza ukuthi ahambele izindawo ezehlukene. "Wathi lokho kuyobikwa, bese kulindwa imvume ebhalwe phansi yomphenyi,” kusho ufakazi.Uqhube wathi ijaji labuye laphakamisa eyokuthi uMolefe unentombi nengane abahlala KwaZulu-Natal, nokuyinto ummeli owaphendula wathi kungaba yibo abahambayo ukuyobona uMolefe. Uthe yize ummeli wayezimisele ngokwamukela umbandela oqinile (webheyili), ijaji labalula ukuthi "ibheyili akufanele ibe yisijeziso"."Ummangalelwa uye owayefaka isicelo sebheyili futhi eseshilo ukuthi uzimisele ukwamukela imibandela eqinile yebheyili kodwa ijaji labona sengathi iwukumcindezela kakhulu,” usho kanje. Uthe kwaba buhlungu kuyena ukuhlala enkantolo alale konke lokhu, uthe waze wafonela abaphathi bakhe wabatshela ukuthi ucela ukuhoxa kulolu phenyo. NgoMsombuluko nangoLwesibili, ufakazi wokuqala ukufihlwa kule khomishini, onguzakwabo kalo ofakaze izolo, wafakaza ukuthi abanolwazi bamtshela ngaphambi kokufakwa kwesicelo sebheyili ukuthi uMolefe uzodedelwa ngebheyili kanti ukhokhe u-R2.5 million ukuze athole le nkululeko. Uthe ngokwejwayelekile, babukhona ubufakazi obabungenza uMolefe angayitholi ibheyili, njengokuthi unecala alenza e-United Kingdom ngo-2004. Uthe futhi unezincwadi zokuya kwamanye amazwe azibhalise ngaphansi kwegama elithi David Teboho Lebetsa.
WEHLULEKILE ukuzibamba umfowabo kamufi enkantolo, wasukuma wachaya izandla, edemelayisa, waze wakhishwa ngaphandle, izihlobo ezisolwa ngokubulala zifaka isicelo sebheyili.Lokhu kwenzeke eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseNtuzuma izolo, kuvela uMnuz Sibongiseni Kunene (51), indodana yakhe uMnuz Siyabonga Mhlongo (31) kanjalo nendodakazi, uNksz Amanda Mhlongo (28).Basolwa ngecala lokuthumba nokubulala uMnuz Sphiwe "Mapi" Ndlanzi (39) ngeSonto eledlule. Kuthiwa babemsola ngokweba isibhamu sikaKunene, okwabuye kwavela ukuthi wayesibambise umnikazi wendawo yokucima ukoma, ezibona ukuthi usedle kakhulu amanzi amponjwana. Umfowabo kamufi, uMnuz Xolani Mazibuko, unengekile ngesikhathi ummeli wabasolwa esefunda incwadi efungelwe kaSiyabonga, abezicelela ngayo ukudedelwa ngebheyili.Ummeli unele wafunda umugqa othi: "Umsolwa uzimisele ngokuveza ubumsulwa bakhe.” UMazibuko, obese kunesikhathi evele enxapha yedwa, aphinde anikine nekhanda, usukume wabuza ukuthi yibona buphi ubumsulwa okukhulunywa ngabo ngoba umfowabo bambulala?"UMapi akekho namhlanje ngenxa yabo laba,” esho ebakhomba ngezandla."Ibona buphi ubumsulwa abathi bazobuveza ngoba uMapi bambulele?” kubuza uMazibuko. Ujoyinwe omunye wesilisa, okuvele ukuthi naye uyisihlobo, bawukhuza bededelana "umhlola". Kuphoqe ukuthi iphoyisa nomshushisi woMbuso ukuthi basukume babakhiphele phandle, bengasalawuleki ngenxa yokudinwa.Encwadini efungelwe kaKunene, kuvele ukuthi usebenzela uMasipala weTheku, uganiwe, unezingane ezintathu, okukhona kuzo lezi aboshwe nazo kanjalo nenye, okuvele ukuthi ineminyaka engu-17. Ezikhalela ngokuthi adedelwe, uthe akuwona nje kuphela umndeni wakhe othembele kuye kodwa kukhona nezinye izihlobo, kanjalo namalungu omphakathi awondlayo. Kuvele ukuthi unesifo esingamahlalakhona.USiyabonga yena uveze ukuthi unengoduso, ingane esencane, uqashwe njengetoho eMnyangweni wezoBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu. Naye kuthiwa unesifo esingamahlalakhona. U-Amanda yena kuvele ukuthi lapho esebenza khona uyisisebenzi esejwayelekile (general worker), wathi uzimisele ngokuveza ukuthi umsulwa. Bonke kuvele ukuthi abanawo amacala ake abalahla phambilini, awekho abawahambayo ngaphandle kwaleli, azikho izincwadi ezikhishelwe ukuthi baboshwe, azikho ezesivimbelo futhi abanazo izincwadi zokuya kwamanye amazwe. Baphinde baveza ukuthi bangakwazi ukukhokha ibheyili ka-R1 000 umuntu emunye. Umshushisi woMbuso, uNksz B Mncwango, uthe umbuso uyasiphikisa isicelo sebheyili. Wathi ngokomphenyi wecala, ngabe inkantolo ayibenzi ubulungiswa uma ingadedela abasolwa."Kungathumela umyalezo ongemuhle ngokusebenza kwezinkantolo emphakathini. Kwabona abasolwa abaphephile uma bengadedelwa ngoba umphakathi udiniwe kakhulu,” kusho uNksz Mncwango.Uphinde waveza nokuthi kukhona i-petition enamagama abantu abangaphezu kuka-100, abathe abangadedelwa ngebheyili. Ngosuku lwesigameko, kuthiwa umufi wayesanda kubuya emngcwabeni, lapho ayephethe uhlelo.Kuthiwa esebuyile, waphuma kubo wayozihlalela nabangani bakhe ngaphandle kwakubo. Kuvela ukuthi uKunene wadlula ngemoto ngakubo, bathi ukuncokola kancane, wase ehamba. Kuvela ukuthi wabuye wabuya engasagayelwe mphako, ebuza umufi ukuthi siphi isibhamu sakhe? Kuthiwa wathi uma esiphika, bamlayisha emotweni, bahamba naye, bayomshayela kubo. Kuthiwa sebemshayile, bamsonga ngengubo, bayomlahla ngasemtholampilo iPoly. Kuvela ukuthi watholwa onogada, bamfaka ngaphakathi, wagonyuluka ngakho konke okumehlele ngaphambi kokuba shone. Icala lihlehlele usuku lwanamuhla ukuze uMbuso nommeli baphikisane ngamaphuzu, bese inkantolo ikhipha isinqumo.
UFUNA ubulungiswa owesilisa oshonelwe yingane eyiwele ngoMgqibelo, kwathi elinye laphuthunyiswa esibhedlela kulandela isigameko sokuthi ekhalakathele emhhumeni we-lift ebinenkinga efulethini lakwaHomii Lifestyle, elisekhoneni lomgwaqo uJoe Slovo (Field) no-Anton Lembede (Smith).Isolezwe lithole ukuthi yiwele lomfana, u-Aphelele Dlamini (8) elishonele endaweni yesigameko, kanti elentombazane lisesimeni esibucayi esibhedlela. Uthe ifulethi linama-lift amabili, eyodwa yawo ayisebenzi."Le engasebenzi ivuleka njengayo le esebenzayo. Ayinalutho olukhombisayo ukuthi ayisebenzi. Umnyango wayo uma uwuphusha, uhlehlela ngaphakathi kuyo, ngakho izingane ziwuhlehlisile, zase zikhalakathela ngaphakathi,” kusho uDlamini.Usole abanikazi bebhilidi ngokungakhombisi ukuzwelana naye, wathi selokhu kwenzeke isigameko, abakaze bakuthole ukwesekwa okuphelele. Uthe bafone kanye, bathi bayazwelana naye, bathi uma kukhona abakudingayo mabasho."Angifunanga ukuthi ngikufake ekhanda lokho ngoba ngisematasa nalo osesibhedlela,” kusho uDlamini.Echaza ngesimo sosesibhedlela, uthe ulimele kakhulu ekhanda, nasemgogodleni futhi uphuke nakwamanye amalunga omzimba. Ebhala ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, uthe ufuna kuhlale obala ukuthi abaleli bhilidi abanandaba kangakanani nomndeni wakhe kulandela isigameko. Uthe ufuna abomthetho basebenze, athole ubulungiswa ngezingane zakhe. AbeHomii Lifestyle, eyengamele ibhilidi okwenzeke kulo isigameko, bakuqinisekisile ngesitatimende ukuthi isigameko senzekile ngempelasonto. Bathe uphenyo olugcwele ngesigameko luyaqhubeka. "Sibambisene ngokugcwele nezinhlaka zomthetho futhi siyazibophezela ekutheni sizoqhubeka nokwenza njalo kuze kube wukuthi luyaphothulwa uphenyo,” kusho isitatimende.Bathe badlulisa okukhulu ukudabuka kanjalo namazwi enduduzo emndenini kamufi, bathi bafisela osasesibhedlela ukululama okusheshayo. Baveze ukuthi ithimba labo langaphakathi lizimisele ngokubanika usizo lokwelulekwa ngokwengqondo abakhahlanyezwe yisigameko, bathi bayaxhumana nomndeni owehlelwe wumshophi. Bengeze ngokuthi ukuphepha kwabahlali kanjalo nomphakathi kubaluleke kakhulu kubona. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi amaphoyisa aseDurban Central, avule idokodo lokufa komuntu kulandela isigameko.

OWAYENGUNGQONGQOSHE wezamaPhoyisa, uMnuz Bheki Cele, uvume eyokwazana nosomathenda osematheni, uMnuz Vusimuzi "Cat" Matlala. Ubevele ePhalamende izolo, phambi kwekomiti eliphenya izinsolo ezenziwa uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi. UCele utshele leli komiti ukuthi uyahlambuluka ukuthi usehlangane kaningi noMatlala ezindaweni ezehlukene, kuzona ubale ihhotela laseThekwini iBeverly Hills, Ballito naseSandton. Uthe ngesikhathi evakashela imizi kaMatlala izikhawu ezimbili, wayeseyisakhamuzi esijwayelekile, wathi konke lokhu kwavela odabeni olwabhalwa yintatheli. Uthe wacacisa ukuthi akasiye umngani noma uphathina kaMatlala kwezamabhizinisi."Ngachaza ukuthi ngiyamazi ngoba kunezinto esixoxa ngazo kodwa asibambisene kwezamabhizinisi futhi asibona abangani,” kusho uCele.Ngaphambi kwalokho, uCele uthe wahlangana noMatlala okokuqala ngqa ngoDisemba 2024."Sahlangana ehhotela iBeverly Hills eThekwini,” kusho uCele othe uMatlala wafika nendodana kasomabhizinisi waKwaNongoma amaziyo. Uveze ukuthi uMatlala wathi ufune ukuhlangana naye ngoba kunezinto ezimbili ezingamhleli kahle. "Eyokuqala; wathi uzithola ehlukumezekile futhi esetshenziswa emidlalweni angayiqondi yezepolitiki, njengoba uMchunu (Senzo) noMogotsi (Brown) befuna atshale imali kwi-projekthi yokuthi uMchunu abe umengameli noma yiphini likamengameli (wezwe). Wangitshela ukuthi ubona lokhu kwenzeka ngoba esanda kuthola ithenda ka-R360 million,” kusho uCele.Uthe inkinga yesibili uMatlala ayethula; eyokuthi kwagasela amaphoyisa kwakhe ngoDisemba 6, 2024, ngezinsolo zokubandakanyeka emshikashikeni wezidakamizwa."Yilapho engathola khona ngokuthi iPKTT isifudukele eGoli, ukuyolekelela khona,” kusho uCele. Uthe wabe eseveza nokuthi uLieutenant General Shadrack Sibiya umyalele ukuthi abhale incwadi efungelwe, athi amaphoyisa agasela emzini wakhe, ebe iwashi leRolex kanjalo nobucwebe bomkakhe."Wangazisa ukuthi uSibiya umyalele ukuthi enze kanje khona uMajor-General Khumalo (Jabulani) ezoboshelwa leli cala, avele enkantolo, bese naye ekwazi ukumbeka kahle icala ngaphakathi emaphoyiseni,” kusho uCele othe ngokuzwa kwakhe ukwebiwa kwalezi zinto kwakungazange kwenzeke nhlobo. Ngaphambi kwalokho, ukhuculule phansi ngoNgqongqoshe wezamaPhoyisa omisiwe, uMchunu, echitha eyokuhlakaza kwakhe ithimba eliphenya ngezigameko zokubulawa kosopolitiki KwaZulu-Natal, iPolitical Killings Task Team (PKTT). Uthe washaya eceleni. Uthe okokuqala, ungqongqoshe akanawo amandla okubumba noma awokuhlakaza ithimba."Ngikhuluma ngethimba noma lwaluphi uhlobo. Leli-ke (esho iPKTT), lalilikhulu kakhulu ngoba lamenyezelwa uMengameli (Cyril Ramaphosa) futhi libandakanya iminyango ehlukene,” kusho uCele.Ebeka izizathu, uthe ngesikhathi libunjwa, lafaka ongqongqoshe beminyango ehlukene, kuyona kukhona owamaPhoyisa, owezokuVikela, owezamaJele, uPhiko lwezokuShushiswa koMphakathi kanjalo nowezobuNhloli."Njengoba labunjwa wongqongqoshe abehlukene, kwakufanele uma selihlakazwa, kwenziwe ngendlela efanayo. UMchunu wayengenawo amandla okuthi yena yedwa, athi akuhlakazwe iPKTT ngoba yayingafaki phakathi umnyango wakhe yedwa,” kusho uCele. Uphinde wenza umzekelo wokuthi ngesikhathi uMchunu ethi alihlakazwe ithimba, bekukhona amacala abucayi ebephenywa. Wenza isibonelo ngelokubulawa kwekhansela laKwaNongoma, lapho okwaboshwa khona imeya, iphini layo nemenenja kamasipala."Uma uhlakaza leli thimba uthi akwenzekeni emacaleni afana naleli laKwaNongoma?” kusbuza uCele. Ubuye wathi akufanele kube yisizathu esizwakalayo ukuthi iPKTT imosha imali."I-PKTT ayilona lodwa ithimba elikhona elasungulwa. Kukhona nelinye eliseWestern Cape okuthiwa i-Operation Thunder, elasungulwa ngesikhathi esicishe sifane nesePKTT. Alishibhile. Ezinyangeni ezingu-25 lisunguliwe, kwase kukhishwe u-R116 million,” kusho uCele. Wenze umzekelo wokuthi lelo thimba alishoyo lalinamalungu angu-200 avela ezifundazweni ezehlukene, elaliswa emahhotela lapho ilungu lilinye likhokhelwa u-R800, ngobusuku obubodwa."Ungazibalela-ke ukuthi imali esichithiwe (ngamahhotela ewodwa) kusuka ngo-2018 kuze kube yimanje,” usho kanje.Ebuzwa ngokuthi uyamazi yini uMnuz Brown Mogotsi, uCele uthe akamazi, akakaze ahlangane naye ubuso nobuso. "Ngisanda kumazi njengoba esedunyiswe abezindaba mumva nje,” kuphendula uCele. Uvumile ukuthi useke walala kabili emzini kaMatlala, wathi wayemfida ngolwazi.Ephawula ngokwashiwo uMkhwanazi ngoSibiya, uthe kwammangaza ukuthi ambize ngesigebengu."Kodwa ngaba nokuthi angisilo iphoyisa ngakho ngeke ngibe nalwazi lokuthi yini engenza iphoyisa libize elinye ngesigebengu. Ngaba nomuzwa wokuthi konke akushilo kudinga ukuthi kuphenywe,” kusho uCele.Ephawula ngoMkhwanazi, uthe uyiphoyisa eliqotho kakhulu kodwa lokho akusho ukuthi akanamaphutha.
IKHALA ngengwadla yokushoda kwezindawo zokungcwaba inhlangano yabangcwabi, iSouth African Funeral Parlour Association (Safpa). Le nhlangano ithi ziyaphela nya izindawo zokungcwaba abantu kuleli zwe.Iqhuba ithi inxusa ukuthi kube khona okwenziwayo ngokushesha ngenhloso yokuthi kutholakale isixazululo kule nkinga. Le nhlangano inxusa ukuthi kube khona ukungenelela okuphuthumayo kukahulumeni kulolu daba olubucayi.Le nhlangano ithe le ngwadla idla lubi kakhulu ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemadolobheni. USihlalo wale nhlangano, uDkt Nomfundo Mcoyi-Zondo uthe le nkinga isithanda ukuba ngaphezulu kwabo ngoba iyakhula kunokuba inciphe."Asifuni ukulinda kuze kufike isikhathi lapho uthola ukuthi imindeni ijikiswa seyifikile emathuneni kuthiwe ayikho indawo yokungcwaba,'' kusho uDkt Mcoiyi-Zondo.Eqhuba uthe ukungcwaba ngenye yezinto ezimqoka kakhulu wathi kodwa uma sekunesimo esifuze lesi kumele kusukunyelwe phezulu. Uthe uma kungenjalo kumele kuqale kuqhanyukwe nezinye izindlela zokubhekana nale nkinga okubandakanya ukulothiswa kwabantu.Eqhuba uthe emindenini eminingi ukungcwaba akusilona nje isiko kodwa yinto ethinta imimoya.Ngokwemibiko evela edolobheni iJohannesburg izindawo zabo zokungcwaba sezigcwele ngamaphesenti angu-90%. Eqhuba uveze ukuthi isiqala ukumba eqolo nemigodi, wenza isibonelo ngokuthi kwesinye isikhathi isiqala ku-R10 000 kuya ku-R15 000.Uthe ukuthuthuka kwezindawo zasemadolobheni kuza nengcindezi yokushoda kwezindawo zokungcwaba.Ngenhloso yokubhekana ngqo nale ngwadla uthe inhlangano izocebisa abantu ngezinye izindlela zokungcwaba ezibandakanya nokulothiswa kwabantu. Uthe bazokhuluma nomasipala abehlukene ukuze kutholakale umhlaba ongasetshenziswa.

Uthe awaziwa umnyombo wengxabano yabo.''Sibone ngabo sebedudulana ngequpha nje, singazi ukuthi babangani. Kodwa isiphetho sikhomba ukuthi inkulu into abebeyibanga. Bebelwa bethukana kodwa singezwa ukuthi yini ebangwayo," kusho umthombo.Uqhuba, uthe ngemuva kwesikhashana belanyuliwe, baqale phansi baba nokuhilizisana kodwa sebexabana ngaphandle kwegceke lalapho ebekwenziwa khona umcimbi.Umthombo uthe umsolwa ubonakale emqongqotha ngesidunu sesibhamu umufi, kwathi kusabatshazwa lokho wamngenela ngommese wamgwaza ephindelela, uKhumalo waphelela khona lapho.''Isihlukumezile kakhulu into esiyibonile. Okubuhlungu kakhulu ukuthi le nto yenzeke emzini womuntu kunomcimbi obalulekile. Lo mlisa ukhombise ukuba nesihluku esikhulu kabi. Okubi nje ukuthi namanje akakaboshwa," usho kanjena.Owomndeni kamufi, uNksz Slindile Khumalo, uthe badumele kakhulu ngokwehlele umfowabo.UNksz Khumalo uthe bayazibuza bayaziphendula ukuthi yini le engaka abibangwa ebingaze igcine seyiholele ekutheni kugcine kuphuma isidumbu.''Le nto isiphethe kabi ukuthi umuntu angaya emcimbini ebese ebuya eseyisidumbu, maqede kuphele nje kanjalo. Le nto isiphethe kabi kakhulu kodwa siyathemba ukuthi kuzovela ukuthi ngempela kwenzekeni kuloya mcimbi abekade ewuhambele,'' echaza.Eqhuba uthe bafuna ubulungiswa nezimpendulo ngokwenzekile.Isolezwe likhulume nowomndeni walapho obekwenziwe khona umcimbi, uMnuz Mzwandile Mkhwanazi, elivumile ukuthi kuphume isidumbu emcimbini.Kodwa uthe ngabe uqamba amanga aluhlaza uma engathi uyazi ukuthi laba bebebangani. Uzwakalise okukhulu ukukhathazeka ngendlela le nto eyenzeke ngayo. Uveze ukuthi laba ababilili akakhumbuli kuthiwa bayinkukhu nempaka.Kuze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela amaphoyisa engakayiphenduli imibuzo ngalolu daba.
Owayengungqongqoshe wamaphoyisa kuleli, uhlabe wahlukisa uSenzo Mchunu ngesinqumo sakhe sokuhlakaza iPKTT. Uthi incwadi eyabhalwa uMchunu yayinemininingwane engafanele nengelona iqiniso. UCele uthi wazama ukukhuluma noSenzo Mchunu ngoJanuwari efuna babukisane udaba lwencwadi ayibhala ukuze asizakale njengoba yayinezto ezingelona iqiniso, kodwa kwanhlanga zimuka nomoyaUBheki Cele uthi isinqumo sokudubula kwePKTT senziwa ngesiphakamiso sikamengameli yasetshenzwa ngokulawulwa ongqongqoshe abebhekelele ezomthetho nobulungiswa.Uthi akukwazi ukuthi ihlakazwe umuntu oyedwa nje engabonisananga namuntu, uma ebengazi ubengaxhumana nomengameli ayobuza ukuthi ukhuluma nobani uma efuna ukuthatha isinqumo esifana nalesi.UBheki Cele uthi umazi kahle uCat Matlala, uthi waqala ukumazi ngoDisemba 2024 ngemuva kokuthi amaphoyisa agasele kwakhe bexhunyaniswa uMabonga Mpungose owacela ukuthi babe nomhlangano ehhotela iBeverly Hills. UMatlala wayefuna usizo lwakhe ngenkiyankiya ayezithola engene kuyona enxuswa uGeneral Sibiya ukuba avulele uMajor General Khumalo icala lokweba iwashi lakhe likanokusho nobucwebe bukankosikazi wakhe."UMatlala wayenezikhalo ezimbili, esokuqala wukuthi uzithola ebhukuda esizibeni angasiqondisisi kahle. Ngezwa ngoMatlala ukuthi wahlangana noBrown Mogotsi noSenzo Mchunu kukhulunywa ngokuthi axhase umkhankaso kaMchunu wokuba umengameli wezwe, inqobo-nje uma engeke asondeze yena (uCele), noJacob Zuma."Esinye isicelo sikaMatlala okuxazulula udaba lokuvulela uKhumalo icala lokweba."USibiya wathi angibhale incwadi efungelwe esola uKhumalo ngokweba iwashi nobucwebe kodwa akafuni ukwenza lokho ngoba kuzophazamisa ubudlelwane bakhe namaphoyisa kwazise wayenethenda."
ISIPHINDE yahlangabezana nenye imbibizane i-ABC ne-ANC abazama ukuketula ubuholi be-IFP kuMasipala waseMvoti.UMnyango wokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu uchithe umhlangano okwathathwa kuwo isinqumo sokuketula imeya, uMnuz Zamani Malembe, nephini lemeya, uMnuz Mbongiseni "Bhojasi" Dlamini.Isinqumo sokukhipha uMalembe noDlamini sathathwa emhlanganweni owawungoLwesihlanu.Lo mhlangano wawuhanjelwe amakhansela e-ABC ne-ANC. Amakhansela ayesemhlanganweni aqoka ikhansela le-ABC, uMnuz Mfundo Masondo, njengemeya entsha, kwathi ikhansela le-ANC, uNksz Nomvula Masikane, laqokelwa kwesephini lemeya.Umhlangano wangeledlule ubizwe emva kokubhuntsha komhlangano owawubizwe emasontweni amabili edlule ukuba kuzobhungwa ngesiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaMalembe noDlamini.Umhlangano wabhuntsha ngenxa yokungafiki kwamakhansela ayisibalo esanele ukuba kube nomhlangano.UMphathiswa wokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, uthe awukho emthethweni umhlangano wangeledlule.UButhelezi uthe umhlangano kwakungafanele ube khona ngenxa yokuthi nakuwona amakhansela afika ayengesona isibalo esanele ukuba kube noumhlangano.Ukusho lokhu encwadini ayibhalele uSomlomo, uNkk Ntombi Ngubane.Ngokuthola kweSolezwe kwafika amakhansela angu-13 kuphela emhlanganweni wangeledlule.UMasipala waseMvoti unezihlalo ezingu-27, okusho ukuthi kufanele kufike amakhansela angu-14 ukuze kube nomhlangano.Umthombo uthe amakhansela e-IFP ayengekho wonke emhlanganweni, kanti amabili e-ANC nawo ayengekho."Elinye (ikhansela le-ANC) lathi alikho lapha KwaZulu-Natal. Elinye lakhala ngokuthi lidukelwe yizinkomo zalo, lalisemahlathini lizibhekela izinkomo zalo ngosuku lomhlangano."UButhelezi uthe kwakungafanele siqhubeke isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaMalembe noDlamini ngoba ikhansela elafaka isiphakamiso, uMasondo, selaxoshwa yiqembu lalo i-ABC.UMasondo kanye nelinye ikhansela le-ABC, uMnuz Siyabonga Zondi, bathola izincwadi ezibaxoshayo ngaphambi komhlangano owabhuntshayo emasontweni amabili edlule."Ngiyakuqaphela ukuthi kuMasipala waseMvoti kunezikhala zamakhansela amathathu. Kulezikhala zamakhansela kubalwa nezikhala ezivuleke emva kokuxoshwa kowafaka isiphakamiso, uMasondo, kanye naloyo oweseka isiphakamiso, uZondi. Umthetho ukubeka kucace ukuthi uma kuxoshwa umuntu ofake isiphakamiso, isiphakamiso siyachithwa."Umholi we-ABC, uMnuz Philani Mavundla, uzame ukuphonsela inselelo ukuxoshwa kukaMasondo noZondi kodwa isicelo sakhe sahoxiswa ohlwini lwamacala aphuthumayo eNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu.Okhulumela uMnyango wokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Senzelwe Mzila, uthe uMalembe useyiyona imeya yomkhandlu."Uma kukhona omunye ozenza imeya, kuyobe uzididekele noma uzama ukudukisa umphakathi."Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kukaNkk Ngubane ayizange iphumelele njengoba ucingo lwakhe belukhala lungabanjwa futhi engazange ayiphendule imibuzo ayithunyelelwe.
UNGQONGQOSHE wezamaPhoyisa omisiwe, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, uthi ngeke buphinde bufane ubudlelwano bakhe nosomabhizinisi osolwa ngokuhamba emshayela indesheni ezigebengwini, uMnuz Brown Mogotsi.UMchunu uthe izinto ezishiwo ngoMogotsi zenza ukuthi ambuke ngenye indlela. Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi eqhubeka nokuphendula imibuzo yamalungu ekomiti lasePhalamende elikhethekile eliphenya izinsolo ezenziwa uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi.UMogotsi usolwa ngokucela imali kusomabhizinisi oboshelwe uxhaxha lwamacala, uMnuz Vusumuzi "Cat" Matlala.Enye imali eyayicelwa uMogotsi kusolwa ukuthi yayisetshenziselwa ukuxhasa umkhankaso kaMchunu wokuhola i-ANC.UMchunu wachaza uMogotsi njengeqabane lakhe. Igama likaMogotsi liphinde livele nakwiKhomishini eholwa yiJaji uMbuyiseli Madlanga, ephenya izinsolo ezifanayo.USotswebhu omkhulu ePhalamende, uMnuz Mdumiseni Ntuli, uthe uMogotsi ungene wathi shi kulezi zinsolo ezenze ukuthi kusungulwe ikomiti lasePhalamende. Ube esebuza uMchunu zonke lezi zinto ezishiwo nguMogotsi ukuthi zizoshintsha ubudlelwano abanabo kanjani?UMchunu uthe buzoshintsha impela ubudlelwano babo."Izoshintsha indlela engimbheka ngayo. Bengimbona njengamanye amalungu e-ANC. Ngesikhathi ngizwa kuthiwa buphelile ubulungu bakhe kwi-ANC, angizange ngimbuze. Njengoba kuvela zonke lezi zinto manje kwiKhomishini kaMadlanga, buzoshintsha ubudlelwano bethu."UMchunu uthe wake wezwa ukuthi uMogotsi uhambe ecela imali ngegama lakhe."Ngasekuqaleni kwalo nyaka, ngake ngatshelwa ukuthi uhambe esebenzisa igama lami kodwa waphika ngesikhathi ngimbuza."UMchunu uthe akekho umuntu ake amthuma ukuba ayomcelela imali, waphika nokuthi uMatlala uxhasa ngemali umkhankaso wakhe wokuhola i-ANC, waphika nokuthi usondelene nezigebengu ezishushumbisa izidakamizwa.UMchunu uthe akazisoli ngokukhipha umayalelo wokuba kuhlakazwe ithimba lamaphoyisa eliphenya ukubulawa kosopolitiki KwaZulu-Natal, wathi uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa kuzwelonke, uLieutenant General Fannie Masemola, wayevumelana nesinqumo sokuhlakazwa kwethimba."UMasemola wangijikela endleleni. Waqale wavumelana nokuhlakazwa kwethimba. Wayeze eqhamuke impela namaqhinga okuthi sizolihlakaza kanjani ithimba. Waqala ukushintsha ngoMashi. UMkhwanazi yena wayengafuni nokuyizwa eyokuhlakazwa kwethimba."UMchunu uthe ubemethemba kakhulu uMasemola."Bengihlezi ngimtshela ukuthi ngisabuthemba ubuholi bakhe. Bengimtshela ukuthi ukushintsha kukangqongqoshe akusho ukuthi sekufanele kushintshwe nokhomishana wamaphoyisa. Angazi nokuthi siphela nini isikhathi sakhe."UMchunu wenqabile ukuphendula umbuzo wokuthi akasiboni yini isidingo sokuthi ehle esikhundleni.UMchunu uthe akazelanga ukuzophendula ngalokho.Kuke kwaphakama imimoya ngesikhathi kususana umholi we-EFF, uMnuz Julius Malema, nelungu le-MK.UMalema noNomvalo bajikijelane ngamazwi kwaba ncane indawo. Umsindo ususwe ukuthi uMalema usole ilungu le-MK, uMnuz David Skosana, ngokuhema. UNomvalo uthe ngeke batshelwe umuntu ovuza amafinyila.Bekungekhona okokuqala behilizisana emhlanganweni wekomiti.Namhlanje kulindeleke ukuthi kuvele owayengungqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa, uMnuz Bheki Cele, phambi kwekomiti.
IZIKHULU zamaphoyisa bezigwazelwa wosomabhizinisi ababoshelwe uxhaxha lwamacala, uMnuz Vusimuzi "Cat" Matlala noMnuz Katiso "KT" Molefe.Ikhomishini ephenya izinsolo ezenziwa uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, itshelwe kabanzi ngokugwazelwa kwamaphoyisa ngesikhathi ilalele ubufakazi izolo.IKhomishini yeJaji uMbuyiseli Madlanga izwe ukuthi umphathi wabaphenyi eGauteng, uMajor General Richard Shibiri, wayethola imali kuMatlala.Lokhu kuvezwe umphenyi wecala oyingxenye yamaphoyisa avusa inyamazane ecaleni elaholela ekuboshweni kukaMatlala noMolefe. "Ngabuya ngathola ukuthi ubudlelwano babo bujule ngendlela emangalisayo njengoba bebuye benikane imali. Ngabe sengiyabona ukuthi kungani uShibiri ebenza zonke lezi zinto abezenza, okubalwa kuzo nokuthi athi asithathe izimvilophu."Ufakazi uphinde waveza ukuthi esinye isikhulu samaphoyisa salethela uMolefe izibiliboco nezingubo zokugqoka ngesikhathi esejele.Ufakazi uthe watshelwa ukuthi umphathi wamaphoyisa esifundeni iSedibeng, eGauteng, uBrigadier Mbangwa Nkhwashu, walethela uMolefe ukudla ejele ngesikhathi eboshelwe icala lokubulala unjiniyela okwakusolwa ukuthi nguyena owabika inkohlakalo eyayenzeka eTransnet, uMnuz Armand Swart."Umphathi wejele wangitshela ukuthi uNkhwashu kade efikile ejele ezolethela uMolefe ukudla nezimpahla zokugqoka."Ufakazi uthe uNkhwashu wafika ejele ehamba ngemoto engenayo i-number plate."Akazange avunyelwe ukuba ayobona uMolefe. Ngatshelwa ukuthi nakho ukudla lokho nezingubo zokugqoka azizange zifike kuMolefe." Ufakazi uthe uNkhwashu wazama ukuphazamisa uphenyo ecaleni likaMolefe.Uthe uNkhwashu waqala wafuna ukunikwa idokodo lecala likaMolefe kodwa akangalithola ngenxa yokuthi lase lidluliselwe kumshushisi wecala."Kwafika uzakwethu ezongitshela ukuthi uNkhwashu ufuna ukuthi singasiphikisi isicelo sebheyili ecaleni likaMolefe. Lokhu akuzange kwehle kahle kumina. Kwaze kwaphoqa ukuthi sihlinzekwe ngabaqaphi. Kwase kufana nokuthi sisejele njengoba sasihlezi sigadiwe ubusuku nemini."Ikhomishini izoqhubeka namhlanje.
KUPHELILE ukuqagela ngama-18th Crown Gospel Music Awards njengoba sekuqinisekisiwe ukuthi azobanjelwa eNkosi Albert Luthuli ICC, eThekwini, ngoNovemba 23, kusukela ngo-7 ebusuku. Esephetha, uthe abaculi abaqokiwe bazomenyezelwa ekupheleni kuka-Okthoba. AmaCrown asingulwa nguZanele ngo-2008, ngenhloso yokubungaza nokuqhakambisa abaculi bokholo bakuleli.
