UMLINGISI wodumo kwiShaka Ilembe neSibaya, uNomzamo Mbatha, usaqhubeka nokufukula, ukukhuthaza nokubungaza abantu besifazane ababambe iqhaza emkhakheni wamabhizinisi.Lokhu uNomzamo waKwaMashu, ukwenza ngokugqugquzela umqhudelwano wezindondo obizwa nge-EmpoweringHER Seminar & Business Awards. Lo mncintiswano wenziwa ngokubambisana phakathi kwenhlangano engenzi nzuzo kaNomzamo, iNomzamo Lighthouse Foundation neHollywood Foundation.Ngokusho kwesitatimende esithunyelelwe imithombo yezindaba, lo mqhudelwano, ozobe sewenziwa okwesihlanu, uzobanjelwa e-Inanda Club, eGoli, ngoNovemba 15, phakathi kuka-9 ekuseni no-5 ntambama. UNomzamo, ongumgqugquzeli walo mqhudelwano, uthe lo nyaka usemqoka kakhulu njengoba sebefinyelele esicongweni, iThe Power of 50."Selokhu saqala ukuhlangana, sesihloniphe abantu besifazane abangamavulandlela abangu-40. Ngo-2025, samukela abanye abanwu-10 kule ngqophamlando, okwenza isibalo sifinyelele kwabahlanu abantu besifazane abaguqula isimo sezwe lethu nomhlaba."Ongumxhumanisi weHollywood Foundation, uVuyisile Ngobese, uthe bayaziqhenya kakhulu ukufinyelela kule minyaka asebeyihambile nalo mqhudelwano selokhu baba yingxenye yawo. Uthe isiqubulo sabo esithi Power of 50 siyisahluko esiqhakambisa abantu besifazane abanesibindi nobuciko bokuqhubeka nokufukula abantu baseNingizimu Afrika kwinhlalakahle nasemnothweni."Ngokubambisana neNomzamo Lighthouse Foundation, siguqula i-EmpoweringHer emgubheni wosuku olulodwa kodwa kube uhambo olude lokufukula, ukuletha ithemba, ukwakha ithuba nokuqinisa umzila lapho besifazane bezothuthuka khona," kusho uVuyisile.Emazwibeleni ezinto ezizobe zenzeka kuma-2025 EmpoweringHER Seminar & Awards akulo nyaka, kubalwa ingxoxo ezobe idingidwa ngabanye osomabhizinisi asebengoqolothakamango emkhakheni wokuhola nokufukulana. Kulindeleke ukuba inkulumo yosuku kube ezogqugquzela futhi ikhuthaze izithameli. Balishumi abesifazane okulindeleke ukuba bachonywe uphaphe lwegwalagwala. Uthe kuzobe kungewona umcimbi nje kodwa inkundla yokunikeza abesifazane ithuba, umbhobho nenhlonipho ebafanele. "Ithimba lethu (lamajaji) nezikhulumi eziqavile zizobe zivutha umlilo, ulwazi nenkuthalo. Lo mqhudelwano wezindondo uthulela isigqoko abesifazane abanekhono lokuhola ngombono, isibindi nokushiya umsizelo." Selokhu lo mqhudelwano uqalile, ngenxa yokwesekwa iNomzamo Lighthouse Foundation neHollywood Foundtion, usuxhase ngemali engu-R3.2 million, ukhipha imali elinganiselwa ku-R800 000 ngonyaka. Amathikithi okuthamela lo mcimbi abiza imali esukela ku-R950 no-R1 200.Osomabhizinisi abafuna ukungenela lomqhudelwano bengangena kule-webiste: https://hollywoodfoundation.co.za/empoweringher-2025/
UMNDENI wabasolwa abathathu kwabane bakwa-E eNtuzuma, ukhala ngokujikelwa amaphoyisa esiswini njengotshwala, emva kokuthi bebekwe icala lokubulala "iphara".Abasolwa, okukhona kubo inhloko yekhaya, amadodana amabili nomakhelwane, bebevele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseNtuzuma, ngoMsombuluko, ngecala lokubulala umufi obedume ngelikaNqo.Basolwa ngecala lokubulala owesilisa wasemijondolo engaphesheya kwaka-E, eyaziwa ngokuthi yiseSoweto, okuthiwa washaywa kanzima wumphakathi owawusukhathele ukuhlushwa wuye ngenyanga edlule. Kuthiwa umufi washonela emtholampilo aphuthunyiswa kuwo emva kwesigameko. Abasolwa, oMnuz Sbusiso Jali (64), Siyabonga Jali (27), Nkanyiso Jali (25) noSandile Dlamini, ababoshwe ngoLwesine, bebevele okokuqala kule nkantolo ngoMsombuluko.Badedelwe ngebheyili ka-R1 500 umuntu emunye, icala lahlehliselwa uDisemba 10. Silandisa ngesigameko isihlobo sabasolwa, uNksz Maxoli Jali, sithe ngosuku lwesigameko umufi wayesengene kathathu endlini yakubo yokugcina amasiko engulawondi, weba impahla. Uthe okokuqala, weba ngempumelelo ikesi likabhiya nebhodlela likagologo. Uthe wabuya isibili, wathatha ama-battery emoto. "Kuthe esebuya isithathu, esezokweba okunye, ngeshwa wakhiyeleka ngaphakathi, wangabe esakwazi ukuphuma,” kusho uNksz Jali.Uthe kwaze kwaqhamuka asebeboshiwe, bavula, bamkhiphela ngaphandle, maqede kwatheleka umphakathi owawudinwe uthelwa ngamanzi. "Ebona ubaba ukuthi badiniwe futhi bafuna ukumudla luhlaza abantu, wabacela ukuthi abamkhiphele ngaphandle kwakwakhe, wabanxusa ukuthi bangamthinti,” kusho yena.Uthe kwaba nhlanga zimuka nomoya njengoba kwase kuphele izinyanga umphakathi ukhala ngokuhlushwa umufi ngobugebengu. Uveze ukuthi umphakathi wasina wazibethela kuye ngezinduku nangokunye. Uthe uyise wazama ukushayela ucingo amaphoyisa, ewabiza ukuba azongenelela."Ebona ukuthi akaphumeleli, wavele wanikela khona msalofu esiteshini samaphoyisa. Wabuya edangele, ethola impendulo ethi, awayingeni indaba yamaphara wona,” kusho uNksz Jali.Uthe bathola ukuthi ugcine eshonela emtholampilo umufi. Uthe kuke kwathi ukuthuleka, kwaze kwaba ukuthi umndeni kamufi uyasukuma ngesigameko, kwase kuba ukuthi umthetho usujikela umndeni wakhe. "Bezobopha ubaba, abafowethu nomakhelwane, bathi bababopha ngoba yibona ababa wumsusa wokuthi umufi agcine eshaywa ebulawa, yize babengekho ngesikhathi esehlaselwa umphakathi,” usho kanje.Uthe baphatheke kabi ngokwehlele umndeni wakhe njengoba ethi bazizwa bengabantu abajikelwe ingalo yomthetho esiswini njengotshwala. "Ukube amlalela ubaba ngesikhathi ewabiza, ebika ukuthi nanku uphakathi ufuna ukuhlasela umufi, ngabe asikho la ngoba ayezofika, akhuze umphakathi bese ethatha umufi, amvalele esitokisini,” usho kanje.Uthe okunye okubaphatha kabi ukuthi kunoxhaxha lwamacala avulwe amalungu omphakathi ngokwehlukana, ebika iziwombe zobugebengu lapho abehlushwa khona umufi kodwa kungenziwa lutho."Umphakathi uze waphoqeleka nokuthi ufake amakhamera ezitaladini zelokishi, kuwona umufi uvela kaningi eba izinto zomphakthi kodwa amaphoyisa awakaze amthathele izinyathelo,” kusho uNksz Jali. Enkantolo kuqapheleke ukuthi bekugcwele amalungu omphakathi, abezokweseka abasolwa. Imizamo yokuthola umndeni kamufi ayiphumelelanga.
INKANTOLO yeMantshi yaseVerulam imgixabeza ngesigwebo esinzima owesilisa olahlwe amacala amabili okuthiwa wawenza kwisinqandamathe sakhe, okukhona kuwo nelokuzama ukusibulala.Olahlwe yicala, uSbusiso Mkhize (45), ubevele phambi kwale nkantolo ngecala lokugwaza ephindelela uNksz Slindile Hlophe ngoDisemba 25, 2024, nelesibili lokumshaya okuthiwa lenzeka ngoNovemba 3, 2024.Imantshi uMnuz Sanele Hlatshwayo imgixabeze ngeminyaka engu-22 kwelokuzama ukubulala, yase imnika izinyanga ezingu-12 kwelokushaya. UHlatshwayo unqume ukuthi uMkhize azidonse kanyekanye izigwebo, waphinde wanquma nokuthi angaphinde abe nemvume yokuphatha isibhamu noma ukuba naso.Kuvele ukuthi wawenza ngezinsuku ezihlukene uMkhize amacala emva kokwaliwa umgilwa ngo-Okthoba 2024.Kuthiwa ngoNovemba 3, 2024, uMkhize wanikela lapho okwakuhlala khona ummangali, wafike wamklinya, wamkhiphela nommese, wamsabisa ngokuthi uzomkhipha amehlo futhi uzombulala. Kuthiwa umgilwa wamvulela icala ummangalelwa, waboshwa. Kuvele ukuthi wadedelwa ngebheyili eyayinemibandela enzima. Phakathi kwayo, kwakukhona nothi akufanele asondele kumgilwa. Nokho ngoKhisimusi, ummangalelwa wacathamela ummangali, wamgwaza ezindaweni ezibucayi ephindelela, waze wamphula umlenze. Kuvele ukuthi wagwaza ekhanda, ebeleni langakwesobunxele nangemumva.UHlatshwayo ngaphambi kokuba athule isigwebo uthe ummangalelwa ukhombise ngokusobala ukuthi akakugqizi qakala ukusebenza kwengalo yomthetho."Ukhombise okukhulu ukungayihloniphi ingalo yomthetho. Wenze icala lokuqala, inkantolo yakudedela ngebheyili. Esikhundleni sokuhlonipha imibandela owanikwa yona, wavele wahamba wayokwenza elinye icala elibi kakhulu kunelokuqala,” kusho uHlatshwayo. Unikwa lesi sigwebo nje, umgilwa ngesikhathi engene ebhokisini lofakazi uthe ufisa athole udikikajele."Ngingajabula uma enganikwa udilikajele ngoba angifuni ukuphinde ngimbone. Ngiyasaba,” kusho uNksz Hlophe.Uthe isigameko samlimaza kakhulu njengoba kwaphela izinyanga ezimbili engakwazi ukuhamba, wahlala engayi emsebenzini lapho angunogada khona.Uveze ukuthi ngesikhathi ehleli ekhaya wayengaholi ngakho wakhahlamezeka kakhulu ezimalini. Uveze nokuthi namanje akakalulami kahle njengoba esahlushwa yikhanda, izibazi zibuye zilume nomlenze ubuye ube buhlungu. Uthe akazange akuthole ukwelulekwa ngokomqondo njengoba namanje esabuye aqwashe ebusuku, azizwe enovalo lokuthi umsolwa uzophinde adlubulundele, azomenzakalisa."Angilwamukeli nhlobo uxolo lwakhe ngoba wayekuhlelile lokhu,” kusho uNksz Hlophe, oveze ukuthi base bethandane noMkhize iminyaka emithathu nohhafu.Ezicelela isigwebo esincane uMkhize, phakathi kokunye, ukhale ngezingane zakhe ezine, ezineminyaka ephakathi kweyisishiyagalombili no-15, athe zisencane, bezisamdinga ukuthi azinakelele njengobaba. "Eyodwa ibihlala nami, kuthi lezi ezinye zihlala nonina. Bengizondla ngemali ephakathi kuka-R300 kuya ku-R500 ingane ngayinye,” kusho uMkhize, othe ubeziphilisa ngomsebenzi wokwakha.Uthe izihlobo ezimvakashela ejele ziyamtshela ngokuthi kuvuleke isikhala ezinganeni njengoba engaphakathi, wathi ufisa ukuxolisa kakhulu kumgilwa, umndeni wakhe kanjalo nowakhe."Ngiyalivuma icala ngenxa yomthetho. Ngangozama ukuzivikela ngesikhathi kwenzeka isigameko. Ngiyakwamukela ukuthi ummangali akasangifuni. Kulandela konke okwenzekile, sengiyabona ukuthi kwakungafanele sibe ndawonye kwasekuqaleni,” kusho uMkhize. Uthe njengoba eseboshiwe, ubuyelwe yingqondo, wacabanga ukuthi usekhulile, kufanele ingabe usenomuzi nomfazi, anakekele izingane nomndeni wakhe."Ngiyaxolisa kakhulu kuyena. Uwumuntu ongazi kangcono, kuningi esikuhlanganisile ndawonye, wazi kahle ukuthi yini eyabangela lesi sigameko,” kusho uMkhize, othe uyazisola kakhulu ngaso.Ummeli wakhe, uMnuz Danver, unxuse inkantolo ukuthi imnike isigwebo esincane, wathi ayikucabange ukuthi uMkhize ubeqala ngqa ukwephula umthetho ngalawa macala, uyazisola futhi isigameko senzeka eyozama ukumncenga ukuthi babuyelane.Umshushisi woMbuso, uMnuz Ntuthuko Mngadi, uthe inkantolo ayimnike isigwebo esibekelwe abenze amacala afanayo ngoba akakhombisi nhlobo ukuzisola. "Uzisola ngoba usenkingeni, hhayi ngoba uyalibona iphutha lakho. Ukumhlasela kwakho isibili ngoDisemba, usudedelwe ngebheyili emva kokumhlasela okokuqala, kukhombisa ukuthi awuwuhloniphi umthetho,” kusho uMngadi.UHlatshwayo ethula isigwebo uthe ngokomthetho icala lokuzama ukubulala linesigwebo sikadilikajele nokho wathi uzothi ukwehla kancane lapho."Ngesizathu sokuthi ubuqala ukuphambana nengalo yomthetho eminyakeni yakho engu-45,” kusho uHlatshwayo.Nokho ubuye wathi isigwebo kufanele sithumele umyalezo kuye umenzi wobubi, abanye abacabanga njengaye, ababona befanelwe ukuzama ukubulala abesifazane abangenamandla okuzivikela. Uthe uyayichitha eyokuthi wayezama ukuzivikela njengoba bungekho ubufakazi obeseka lokhu, wathi okwesibili ummangalelwa akalimalanga ngendlela yokuthi wayesesimweni sokulwela impilo yakhe.Umfowabo kamgilwa, uMnuz Sbonelo Hlophe, obekhashwe amalungu eMK ngaphandle kwenkantolo uthe: "Siyasamukela isigwebo anikwe sona. Akakhombisanga ukuzisola kodwa ubelokhu ethi wayezivikela, ekubeni sazi kahle ukuthi udadewethu ubengawuphathi ngisho ummese.”Uthe bakholelwa ukuthi wayehlose ukumbulala udadewabo nokho wanqandwa ukuphuka kommese ayemhlasela ngawo."Sijabule ngesigwebo ngoba ukube awuphukanga ummese ngabe samngcwaba thina udadewethu,” usho kanje.
UBUHOLI obusha kuMasipala waseMkhanyakude buthi kuningi okumele kushintshe njengoba kukhona abantu abaphethe izikhundla eziphezulu yize bengenazo iziqu ezifanele.Lokhu kuvezwe yiMeya entsha, uMnuz Comfort Khumalo, engene esikhundleni ngokubambisana kwe-IFP neNFP emva kokuketulwa kwe-ANC.UKhumalo uthe okumele baqale bakulungise yindlela obekuphethwe ngayo imali kulo masipala, wubuholi obuphumile.Uthe babeke eqhulwini ukuqoqwa kwetshe lemali umasipala oyikweletwa yizakhamuzi, wathi bazosukumela indaba yezimenenja ezisezikhundleni yize "zincwade kancane" bese kuba wudaba lwabasebenzi abaxebula umkhoma ngokusebenza isikhathi esengeziwe ngendlela engaqondakali."Okusikhathazayo yindlela imali ebisebenza ngayo ebuholini baphambilini. Kodwa njengoba sesingenile manje sizolungisa indaba yabasebenzi abebezitapela imali ngokusebenza isikhathi esengeziwe okuyinto ebiyenzeka ngendlela oengafanele. Ngeke umsebenzi athole imali yesikhathi esengeziwe edlula umholo wakhe. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi kukhona inkinga ebikhona."Okunye sifuna ukulungisa indaba yabasebenzi abasezikhundleni eziphezulu kodwa beneziqu ezingafanele. Kunabantu lana abano-matric kodwa baphethe abantu abaneziqu ezifanele nokuyinto engahambisi kahle umsebenzi. Sizophinde sihlangane namalungu omphakathi njengoba sifuna ukuthi kukhokhwe izikweletu abazikweleta umasipala ezingaphezu kuka-R300 million. Njengoba singenile kungasijabulisa ukuqoqa imali engu-R100 million njengoba isiningi kakhulu esiyikweletwayo," kusho uKhumalo.Uthe okukhulu ngaphansi kwalo masipala yindaba yamanzi, eyezimoto ezihambisa amanzi emphakathini nayo abazoyibheka.Uveze ukuthi njalo ngesonto bazimisele ukuthi baye emphakathini bayokwethula intuthuko ukuze kuxazululeke izingqinamba eziningi ezikhona."Udaba lwamanzi lana eMkhanyakude yilona esizolubheka kakhulu kusuka manje. Sizimisele ukuhlangana nomphakathi siwethulele intuthuko, ukuze sibone ukuthi siya kanjani phambili, sizolungisa isimo manje siyise emphakathini okudingekayo," kuchaza yena.Siyabonga kuNtuli obambe eseMenenja kulo Masipala, othe bazothola indlela yokuthi umasipala ungenise imali bangahlali basonge izandla bathi imali ayikho."Inkinga esiyibonile lana eMkhanyakude wukuthi njalo unyaka ubuphela sekuvalwe amehlo, isimo semali sesingesihle. Kodwa manje sekumele sibheke ukuthi siya kanjani phambili ukuze sishintshe isimo sikamasipala. Isimo asisihle kodwa sizokwenza konke okusemandleni ukubuyisa ithemba ebantwini sibahambisele intuthuko," kuchaza yena.Uthe okwamanje ngenxa yesimo semali akulula ukuthi abantu bathole amanzi bonke kompompi, kodwa bazokulungisa konke lokho.

KUBHIMBE izinto, ngesikhathi umqaphi wePhini leMeya kaMasipala waKwaMhlabuyalingana, elahla phansi ngenhlamvu abasolwa ababili ebebezama ukumduna imoto yohlobo lweFortuner esigodini saKwaShemula, KwaMhlabuyalingana, ngoMgqibelo. "Lo msolwa wesibhamu, ongoyedwa kwabathathu abese ebabonile, umfune imoto ngenkani. Ngokucabanga ngokushesha, uvele wakhokha isibhamu ngesandla sakhe sobunxele, wabadubula. Lona wesibhamu uwele khona lapho, kwathi laba abanye ababili babaleka,” kusho uNkk Mtshali.Uqhube wathi isidumbu sowesibili sitholwe amaphoyisa izolo, ehlathini eliseduze.Uthe kwenzeka konke lokhu, bese benakho ukusola ukuthi kukhona okungahle kwenzeke njengoba bethe uma behamba ngendlela ejwayelekile ukusuka kwakhe, beya lapho behlala khona, babona izimoto ezingaqondakali zime sakuvimba lapho abajwayele ukujika khona, bengenela endaweni abahlala kuyo. UMNDENI wephoyisa okuthiwa lingqoklozwe elinye ngenhlamvu lafa, uthi usola ukuthi kukhona okunye okungale kwekhethini ngokubulawa kothandiweyo wawo.Usho lokhu ngaphandle kweNkantolo yeMantshi yasePinetown, izolo, kulandela ukuvela kukamsolwa, ezimkhalele ngoLwesihlanu.Esigamekweni esenzeke ngo-Okthoba 10, uConstable Andile Philani Zulu (40) udubule ephindelela uConstable Sbonelo Ngidi (29) komunye yemigwaqo yaseMariannhill, ePinetown. Kuthiwa umsolwa obesebenza esiteshini samaphoyisa esiseduze kwesiteshi sikaloliwe i-Escombe, eScottburgh, upake imoto yakhe yohlobo lweVW Polo emhlophe, phakathi nomgwaqo, wehla eyochama.Kuvela ukuthi umufi obevinjwe yile moto, ubuze umsolwa, owehle maqede wabonakala ukuthi kukhona isibhamu enqulwini, ukuthi: "Bafo kungani ungivimba emgwaqweni?”Kuvela ukuthi umsolwa waphendula ngethi: "Yima ngisachama”. Kuthiwa umufi wambuza ukuthi lokhu akwenzayo, ukwenza ngoba nakhu ephethe isibhamu yini, umsolwa kuthiwa waphendula ngokuthi: "Yini ufuna ngisifake kuwena yini? Ngilinde-ke ngiqede ukuchama.” Nebala kuthiwa wathi uma ebuya, wamdubula ngempela ephindelela. Enkantolo kuvele ukuthi mane amacala umsolwa abhekene nawo. Kuwona kukhona elokubulala umufi, elokuzama ukubulala owesilisa owayehamba nomufi, elokushayela budedengu nelokuphatha isibhamu edle amanzi amponjwana. Umfowabo kamufi, uMnuz Siya Ngidi, uthe basola ukuthi umsolwa wayenezinye izinhloso ngokubulala umfowabo. "Uyiphoyisa, uyawazi umthetho. Uma ethi wayemdubule ngephutha ngoba edakiwe, kwakufanele azinikele emaphoyiseni masinyane uma sekudamuke utshwala,” kusho uNgidi.Uthe ukulinda kwakhe kuze kuphele izinsuku eziyisikhombisa, ngaphambi kokuba azinikele, nakhona ngoba esezwa ukuthi useyafunwa amaphoyisa vele, kudweba esinye isithombe. Uveze ukuthi nanokushisa kwakhe imoto ayehamba ngayo, emva kwesigameko, ezama ukucisha ubufakazi kwakukhomba ukuthi wayephezu komqondo futhi ekwazi kahle akwenzile. Udadewabo kamufi, uNksz Nombuso Ngidi, uthe bayabufuna ubulungiswa ngecala ngoba balimele kakhulu bewumndeni ngomfowabo obulawe emcane. "Besisabheke okuningi kuye. Ubenezingane ezisencane ezintathu nabazali asebebadala. Abazali basuke belinde ukuthi yizingane zabo ezizobangcwaba,” kusho uNksz Ngidi.Uthe bafuna umthetho udlale indima yawo, bathole nesizathu sokuthi kungani umsolwa ebulale umfowabo ngesihluku? "Yayingekho enye indlela okwakungenzeka ngayo ngaphandle kokuthi ambulale?” kubuza uNksz Ngidi, oveze ukuthi bahlalele ovalweni, abazi ukuthi le nto isuka kuphi, wathi uma engadedelwa ngebheyili, bayasaba ukuthi angeza kubo azobenzakalisa. Uthe kubamangazile ukuthola ukuthi umsolwa uyiphoyisa, wathi bona bazi ukuthi umuntu oyiphoyisa kufanele ngabe wuye ovikela umphakathi. Uthe ngesikhathi bembona enkantolo, baqaphele ukuthi ukhombisa ukungazisoli. "Indlela abesibuka ngayo, ngathi uyasinyanya. Sibone ukuthi akazisoli, wayenenhloso ngakwenzile. Umthetho awenze ubulungiswa,” usho kanje. Umshushisi woMbuso, uMnuz Cameron Roode, uthe ucela icala lihlehliswe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ikheli umsolwa angaphuma ayohlala kulo, kuphinde kwenziwe nohlelo lokuthi akhonjwe. Imantshi, uNkk Wendolyn Robinson, ilihlehlisele u-Okthoba 27, nonyaka, icala ukuze umsolwa afake isicelo sebheyili.Umufi kuthiwa ushona nje, ubeneminyaka eyisithupha eqashwe ngokugcwele emaphoyiseni. Kuthiwa waqala evolontiya kusuka ngo-2014.
BAMVALELE ekhoneni waze waxolisa uNgqongqoshe wezamaPhoyisa omisiwe, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, ngesikhathi evele phambi kwekomiti lasePhalamende elikhethekile eliphenya izinsolo ezenziwa uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi.Amalungu ekomiti apheke uMchunu ngebhodwe elincane ngesikhathi enikwa ithuba lokuba abuze imibuzo.UMchunu ugcine esexolisa emva kokuba ecindezelwe ngokuletha umbiko ongesilo iqiniso othi kwabulawa owayengusomlomo komunye umasipala osesifundazweni i-Eastern Cape.Umbiko olethwe uMchunu ubhalwe inhlangano iGlobal Initiative.Lo mbiko uveza ukuthi kwabulawa owayengusomlomo kuMasipala wase-OR Tambo, uMnuz Xolile Nkompela, ngaphambi kokhetho lohulumeni basekhaya lwango-2021.Ilungu le-ANC, uNkk Thokozile Sokhanyile, bekuthi alimqede uMchunu ngesikhathi limtshela ukuthi uNkompela usadla anhlamvana."Lo mbiko ukhuluma ngamakhansela abulawa ngaphambi kokhetho lohulumeni basekhaya lwango-2021. Umbiko uthi elinye lamakhansela elabulawa ngo-2021, uXolile Nkompela. Umbiko uthi wadutshulwa wabulawa ebuya ukuyokhankasela i-ANC kuTsolo. UNkompela ngiyamazi, ngasebenza naye. Ngangiyimeya yena engusomlomo. Namanje usadla enhlamvana. Angazi ukuthi uzothini yena uNkompela uma ebona lo mbiko."UMchunu uthe umbiko ubhalwe abameli bakhe kodwa lokho akuzange kumenelise uNkk Sokhanyile, oyalele uMchunu ukuba axolise kuNkompela nasemndenini wakhe.Usihlalo wekomiti, uMnuz Soviet Lekganyane, uyalele uMchunu ukuba angaviki ngabameli bakhe.UMchunu ugcine ehlela ngezansi."Ngiyavuma ukuthi kunephutha kulo mbiko weGlobal Initiative. Ngiyaxolisa kuyena nasemndenini wakhe." Elinye ilungu le-ANC, uMnuz Xola Nqola, libuze uMchunu ngenkulumo eqoshiwe athi kuzwakala kuyo uMkhwanazi emsongela.UMchunu wayekade eyalelwe ukuba abuya nale ngxenye yenkulumo kodwa ugcine ehlulekile ukuyithola.Lokhu kucasule ilungu le-EFF, uMnuz Julius Malema, elithe ukungafiki kukaMchunu nenkulumo kusho ukuthi wayesenga ezimithiyo uma ethi wasongelwa uMkhwanazi."UMchunu wasitshela ukuthi kunenkulumo lapho khona esongelwa. Samcela ukuthi alethe le nkulumo ngoba besifuna ukuyizwa. Manje kusho ukuthi ayikho le ngxoxo."Ohola ofakazi, u-Advocate Norman Arendse, ubuze uMchunu ngobudlelwano bakhe nosomabhizinisi oboshelwe uxhaxha lwamacala, uMnuz Vusumuzi "Cat" Matlala.UMchunu uyamphika uMatlala kepha u-Arendse uthe kunofakazi ozovela phambi kwesigcawu ozochaza ngobudlelwano bukaMchunu noMatlala."Ufakazi uzofike aveze ukuthi uyazana noMatlala. Ufakazi uzoveza ukuthi uMatlala ukunika imali futhi uxhasa umkhankaso wakho wokuhola i-ANC."UMchunu uthe akazi ngisho isenti likaMatlala.UMchunu ufike nencwadi efungelwe kaMatlala eqinisekisa ukuthi abazani.U-Arendse ubuze ukuthi besikuphi isidingo sokuthi uMchunu athumele abameli bakhe ukuba bayofuna incwadi efungelwe kumuntu athi akamazi.UMchunu uthe abameli bakhe bazithathele bona isinqumo sokuyofuna incwadi efungelwe kuMatlala.UMchunu uzoqhubeka nokuphendula imibuzo yamalungu ePhalamende namhlanje.
SELIMBULE ingubo langena kumholi we-EFF, uMnuz Julius Malema, okuvele igama lakhe kwiKhomishini kaMadlanga ephenya izinsolo ezenziwa uKhomishana wezamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi.IKhomishini yeJaji uMbuyiseli Madlanga izwe ukuthi uMalema uwubhululu wePhini likaKhomishana wamaPhoyisa elisolwa ngokusebenza nemiguluku, uLieutenant General Shadrack Sibiya.Lokhu kuvele izolo, ngesikhathi kufakaza elinye lamaphoyisa avusa inyamazane ngezinsolo zokusebenzisana kwezigebengu namaphoyisa nosopolitiki.Iphoyisa igama lalo eligodliwe lithe latshelwa umphathi wabaphenyi eGauteng, uMajor General Richard Shibiri, ukuthi uMalema uzwana noSibiya.Uthe ingxoxo yaqala emva kokungena kwegama lomlisa okuthiwa uMnuz Zee Nxumalo, okuthiwa uwumngani kaMalema."UShibiri, wangitshela ukuthi enye insizwa yomZulu ende, uZee Nxumalo ingumngani omkhulu kaMalema, wathi uMalema yena uwumngani noGeneral Sibiya."Ufakazi akazange anabe ngobudlelwano bukaMalema noSibiya.Okuqaphelekayo ukuthi uMalema akazange alubhade ePhalamende ngesikhathi uSibiya ayevele phambi kwekomiti elikhethekile eliphenya izinsolo zikaMkhwanazi.UMalema uyingxenye yekomiti lasePhalamende eliphenya izinsolo zikaMkhwanazi.USibiya wavela phambi kwekomiti izinsuku ezimbili, uMalema akazange afike kuzona zombili lezi zinsuku, wabhala ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ukuthi ngeke abe bikho ePhalamende kodwa akangazibeka izizathu zokungafiki kwakhe.Ufakazi uphinde waveza ukuthi uSibiya wayehlezi ebabuza ngokuqhubeka kophenyo ecaleni likasomabhizinisi oboshelwe uxhaxha lwamacala okukhona kuwo nawokubulala, uMnuz Katiso "KT" Molefe.Ufakazi uthe batshelwa ukuthi uMolefe usondelene nezikhulu eziphezulu emaphoyiseni.UMolefe waboshelwa icala lokusoconga unjiniyela okusolwa ukuthi wayeveza inkohlakalo eyayenzeka eTransnet, uMnuz Armand Swart.Inkampani kaMolefe yayithola amathenda kwaTransnet. UMolefe wagcina eseyamaniswa namanye amacala, njengamanje ungaphandle ngebheyili.Ufakazi uveze ukuthi uMolefe wagwaza ukuze athole ibheyili. Uphinde waveza ukuthi izikhulu zamaphoyisa zazama ukuphazamisa uphenyo ecaleni likaMolefe.Ikhomishini izoqhubeka namhlanje.
OZAKHELE igama embonini yamatekisi KwaZulu Natal, uMnuz Sifiso Shangase, uphonsela amadoda inselelo yokuba abhoboke ngezinkinga eziwahlalise lubhojozi.UShangase uthe uxhaxha lwezinkinga ezikhungethe amadoda yisona sizathu esiholele ekutheni ahlele ingqungquthela yawo ngenhloso yokubhunga kabanzi ngalokhu.Le ngqungquthela uthe yethiwe ngokuthi yiMan Up Conference. Izokuba ngoNovemba 15, eGreenleaf Estate, eMgungundlovu.Isiqubulo sayo uthe sithi: "Sibumba amadoda avikelayo, anakekelayo futhi abuyisa ithemba.''Phakathi kwezinye zezinto athe amadoda ayesaba ukuphumela obala ngazo kubalwa nezinkinga zasekamelweni.''Ayikho inkinga indoda okumele ithule nayo unomphela. Kumele amadoda afundiswe ukuphumela obala ngezinkinga asuke ebhekene nazo empilweni yawo. Lokhu nawo kungawalekelela ngezindlela ezahlukene,'' kuchaza yena.Uthe amanye amadoda abhekana nenkinga ngenxa yokuthi akhule ngaphandle kwabazali bobabili. "Umbuzo omkhulu uthi ingane yomfana ekhuliswe ngumama wayo kuphela ithola konke okufanele yini? Lokhu kugcina kudale ukuthi lo mfana kube khona okuthile angakuzuzi okumele ngabe kuvela kuyise,'' kusho yena.Okunye athe kuzobhungwa ngakho kabanzi ngezamabhizinisi nendoda."Kumele ukuba amadoda afundiswe kabanzi ngezamabhizinisi. Lokhu kuyawalekelela ekutheni akwazi ukuqhuba amabhizinisi awo ngendlela ekahle," kusho uShangase..Olunye udaba olubucayi athe ngeke balenze iphutha lokulushiya ngaphandle oluthinta izikweletu. Uthe sesifikile manje isikhathi sokuthi amadoda afundiswe izindlela ezingcono zokuthi kubhekwana kanjani nezezimali.Le ngqungquthela uthe ihlome kakhulu ngezinkhulumi ezihlabahlosile okukhona kuzona usomabhizinisi osenokhakhayi oluqinile, uMnuz Boy Zondi, izinyane leSilo uNhlanganiso Zulu, uNdabe Myeza nabanye abaningi.Uthe bayamenywa nabafana ukuba bafike kule ngqungquthela wathi bazoncela kogwansile.
OKHULUMELA iSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini, uMntwana uThulani Zulu, uthi kuzokuba nzima ukubuyisana eNdlunkulu kaZulu uma abeseka uMntwana uSimakade kaZwelithini embangweni wesihlalo bengase baphonsele inselelo isinqumo esivuna ukuqokwa kweSilo.UMntwana uThulani uthe nakuba abeseka uMntwana uSimakade benelungelo elikuMthethosisekelo lokudlulisa icala, kodwa kuyofana nokuthi baziphonse eweni abeseka uMntwana uSimakade uma begcine besiphonsela inselelo isinqumo seNkantolo yamaCala aDlulisiwe.Ubephawula emva kokuba abeseka uMntwana uSimakade bethe abasamukeli isinqumo seNkantolo yamaCala aDlulisiwe esithi uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, walandela yonke imigomo ngesikhathi evuma ukuqokwa kweSilo.Abeseka uMntwana uSimakade bathe basaxoxa nabameli babo, bathi kungenzeka baludlulisele phambili udaba.UMntwana uThulani uthe lesi bekuyisikhathi sokuthi iNdlunkulu yamukele isinqumo senkantolo, bese kuba nokubuyisana."Asinanxa nokuthi abaNtwana badlulise isinqumo senkantolo, ngoba njengezakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika banelungelo lokwenza lokho. Siyazi ukuthi ikhona iNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo okuyiyona ekhipha isinqumo esiwumnqamulajuqu. Kepha besingazitsheli ukuthi abaNtwana bangaze baye lapho ngoba lokho kusho ukuthi umbango wabo usungaphezu nje kombango wesihlalo owejwayelekile. Umbango wesihlalo awuqali, siyazi sonke. Inkantolo yokugcina isiyokwenza ukuthi kube nzima ukubuyisana."UMntwana uThulani uthe ukungamukeli kwabaphikisa ukuqokwa kweSilo akusho uqhekeko eNdlunkulu njengoba ethe bancane abangafuni ukwamukela ukuqokwa kweSilo."Sonke siyazi ukuthi abaNtwana abangakanani. Empeleni abaNtwana abasembangweni kakhulu bane nje ebaNtwaneni bakaBhusha (iSilo uCyprian Bhekuzulu kaSolomon), kanti kwabona futhi ababoni ngaso linye. Manje ngiyadabuka ngoba abaNtwana bebengaba yisisekelo esihle sobukhosi njengoba bezalwa vele yisihlalo. Kodwa-ke uma beziqhelisa ngibona ukuthi baya esiweni esijulile, okuyishwa ngoba emva kokuhluleka kwabo eNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo akusezukuba lula ukubuyisana."UMntwana uThulani uthe abaphikisa ukuqokwa kweSilo ngeke baziqhathanise neNdlulamithi yamakhosi."Ngeke nje abaNtwana ngobuncane babo, nokungangeni kwabo esizweni babize imbizo enkulu, evulelekile engangalena emenyezelwa yiSilo uMisuzulu yango-Okthoba 29. Abanawo amandla okwenza lokho futhi mhlawumbe sebezamile, bahluleka. Asikho nesisodwa isigodlo abangabizela kuso imbizo ngoba phela zonke izigodlo ezenkosana, okuyiSilo uMisuzulu kaZwelithini."UMntwana uThulani uthe bayazama ukuxhumana nabaphikisa ukuqokwa kweSilo."Noma sebebikele isizwe ukuthi abamukeli, ngingasho nje ukuthi izandla zeNdlulamithi neNdlunkulu zisavulekile bengakaziphonsi abaNtwana eweni elijulile. Isenzo sabo sisho ukuthi bayaziqhelisa ekuhlanganeni neNdlunkulu."
UZOPHUMA ngenyanga ezayo umkhombandlela wokuthi yikuphi i-ANC ezokwenza ngeSACP enqume ukungenela ukhetho ngokuzimela.Lo mkhombandlela uzophuma emhlanganweni wesigungu esiphezulu sale nhlangano njengoba abaholi abaphezulu be-ANC behlangana neCosatu.UNobhala Jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, uthe bazobe sebehlangana neSACP, emuva kokuhlangana neCosatu. Uthe bazobikela isigungu esiphezulu ngenyanga ezayo, ngokuthi ikuphi okuphume emhlanganweni wabo neSACP."Sisemahlukana ndlela neSACP. Isigungu esiphezulu sasiyalela ukuthi sihlangane neSACP, sixoxe ngodaba lokuthi amaKhomanisi azongenela ukhetho ngokuzimela. Siyazi amalungu e-ANC amagange, afuna kucace manje ukuthi ikuphi esizokwenza ngeSACP engajiki ekutheni kumnyama kubomvu ingenela ukhetho ngaphandle kwe-ANC. Umhlangano wesigungu esiphezulu wangenyanga ezayo, yiwona ozonquma ngesizokwenza. Sizoya emagatsheni siyochazela amalungu ngokumele akwenze," kusho uMbalula.Usho lokhu ekhuluma engqungqutheleni iProvincial General Council eMpumalanga, ngempelasonto. Uthe ayibahluphi indaba yokuthi amaKhomanisi angenela ukhetho ngokuzimela ngoba vele awatholi amavoti amaningi."Okhethweni lokuchibiyela bathola amavoti ambalwa. Vele amaKhomanisi ayengasungulelwe ukuthi angenele ukhetho ngokuzimela, ngaphandle kwe-ANC. I-ANC iyona enezibalo, ngisho enhlanganweni amaKhomanisi awafiki ngisho namavoti amaningi," usho kanje.Uthe amalungu e-ANC awalinde, angajahi ukuxosha noma ukuhhewula amaKhomanisi."Ehlisani umoya, niphuze amanzi noma nizizwa ukuthi ninyukelwa ushukela. Akusithusi okwenziwa amaKhomanisi. Ziphatheni ngendlela efanele ngoba niyi-ANC. Ningathuswa wukugxekwa amaKhomanisi. Uma benigxeka, babuyiseni nibatshele okuyikhona." Uthe basafuna ukuthi iSACP ibe yingxenye yamadlelandawonye ahlanganisa iCosatu neSanco. "AmaKhomanisi ayaziwa ngokuthi anobuchule kodwa awanazo izinombolo zokuthi awine. Sisayidinga iSACP, ikakhulu ngalesi sikhathi esinzima esibhekene naso. Abaholi asebahamba kwi-ANC, ibona abangazange baqedele inkulumo namaKhomanisi ngendaba yokubuyekezwa kwamadlelandawonye. Thina asingeni lapho, sizosilungisa isimo," kusho uMbalula.Unxuse amalungu ukuthi angasheshi aphonse ithawula ngodaba lweSACP. Uthe kumele bakwazi ukuchazela izizukulwane ezizayo ukuthi bahluka kanjani neSACP, uma kungukuthi sekufike leso sikhathi."Umzabalazo udinga ukuthi sithandane. Kodwa uma uthando seluphelile, luphelile. Akukho esingakwenza. Umuntu ohlala naye uyambekezelela ngoba uyamazi uma ediniwe ukuthi uthintwaphi. Kodwa uma sekufike la ukhathala khona, akukho okungenziwa." AmaKhomanisi amile ekutheni noma kuthiwani, azongenela ukhetho ngokuzimela. Akhala ngokuthi namanje awakwazi ukulokhu elandela i-ANC, encetheza, afuna kulungiswe indaba yokubuyekezwa kwamadlelandawonye.AmaKhomanisi agxeka ne-ANC ngendaba yokuthi ayizange iwafake ezintweni ezithinta ukubunjwa kukahulumeni wokubambisana kwamaqembu, njengoba engayifuni nakuyibona i-DA, esebenzisana ne-ANC.
BAZIBOPHEZELE ekutheni ngeke bakopele abafundi abaqala izivivinyo zika-matric ezweni lonke, ngesikhathi benza izifungo zokuthi bazothembeka uma sekubhalwa.Kanjalo nalabo abazobe beqaphe ababhalayo, bayalelwe ukuthi bangalinge balingeke ngokuthi bafune ukusiza ababhalayo ngezimpendulo ngoba bazongena enkingeni.Lokhu kuvele emicimbini ehlukene ezweni lonke lapho bekufungiswa khona ababhalayo ngoLwesihlanu.UNgqongqoshe weMfundo eyisiSekelo, uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, ushumayele ivangeli kwababhalayo ukuthi bathembeke. Ubakhumbuze ukuthi noma kuthiwa ababonwa ngumuntu, kumele ngaso sonke isikhathi benze okufanele."Ubuqotho yinto ebaluleke kakhulu kumuntu. Kubalulekile ukuthembeka emsebenzini wakho, ungakopeli noma kuthiwa akekho okubonayo. Uma ufunga usuke ungenzeli nje abantu kodwa uyazibophezela ekutheni imiphumela ozoyithola izobe ivela ezithukuthukwini zakho," kusho uNksz Gwarube.Uthe ukungathembeki uma ubhala akubeki engcupheni ikusasa lobhalayo kodwa kubeka engcupheni isithunzi sezivivinyo."Uma sivumela ukukopela, sibeka engcupheni izivivinyo. Silimaza isithunzi sesitifiketi sezinkumbi zabafundi ababhale ngobuqotho. Senza ukuthi umphakathi ungaluthembi uhlelo lwezemfundo," kuqhuba uNksz Gwarube. Usho lokhu nje, nenyunyana yothisha iSadtu KwaZulu-Natal, inxuse abazogada ababhalayo ukuthi bathembeke, bangavumeli abazokopela."Abafundi abazethembe ngalesi sikhathi, bangakopeli. Nabazobe begadile abangasizi ngokuthi babanike izimpendulo ngoba lokho kubeka engcupheni isithunzi sezivivinyo," kusho iSadtu.Nomkhandlu olawula izingabunjalo lika-matric, Umalusi, ushumayele ivangeli lokuthi kungakotshelwa ngoba kuzobe kungasiniswa mahleza uma sekubhalwa. Umalusi uveze ukuthi uzojuba abazozinza ezikhungweni zokubhalela, abazobe bengathi nsi ngoba ukhathazekile ngokuthi minyaka yonke kuvela indaba yokuthi kusuke kunabakopelile.Amabandla ehlukene, izolo akhulekele ukubhala okuhle okungenazihibe esifundazweni, njengoba uMnyango wezeMfundo, wanxusa amabandla ahlukene ukuthi abeke emkhulekweni ababhalayo.Khonamanjalo: UNksz Gwarube uzokhuluma nabezindaba namhlanje ngamalungiselelo okubhalwa kwalezi zivivinyo. Isithangami sabezindaba sisesifundazweni iMpumalanga.
IYAQHUBEKA i-DA nokuchitha uhlelo lokufukula osomabhizinisi abamnyama i-Black Economic Empowerment (BEE), phezu kokuba uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, eshaya phansi ngonyawo ethi aluyi ndawo.I-DA ithi lolu hlelo luyibulele imisebenzi futhi luhlomulisa abantu abambalwa, abazuza ngenkohlakalo.UMnuz Mat Cuthbert, inhloko yemigomo kwi-DA, ekhuluma nabezindaba eGoli izolo, uthe kumele iqedwe indaba ye-BEE, okunalokho kufakwe uhlelo oluzovuselela umnotho. Uthe kunohlelo lwe-DA i-Economic Inclusion for All Bill, abahlose ngalo ukususa i-BEE eyinqola ye-ANC eshiye inqwaba yabantu ingasebenzi."Indaba ye-BEE ishiye abantu abaningi bengenathemba. Ihlomulisa kuphela amaqabane e-ANC. Ijivaza ngokwebala, icebisa abazana nabaholi be-ANC," usho kanje.Uthe osomabhizinisi bashiywe ngaphandle wathi ngomgomo wabo bahlose ukukhulisa umnotho."Kumele kube nenye indlela ezosetshenziswa ukuhlomulisa abathile ngezinkontileka. Kumele kunikwe abantu abavezayo ukuthi bawuthuthukisa kanjani umnotho nokuthi kumele bangabizi kakhulu." Uthe labo okuyotholakala ukuthi benza inkohlakalo, kumele basuswe ngokushesha ohlwini lwabazohlomula.URamaphosa uhlale eluvikela lolu hlelo kanti uthi aluyi ndawo ngoba lufukula osomabhizinisi abamnyama ababencishwe amathuba phambilini.UMnuz Ivan Meyer we-DA, uthe uMthethosisekelo wezwe, ubalula ukuthi uhulumeni kumele asebenzise uhlelo olulinganayo noluvulelekile uma ehlomulisa abantu ngomsebenzi.Uthe i-BEE ayihambisani nemigomo yoMthethosisekelo yingakho uhulumeni waseWestern Cape, uye enkantolo yoMthethosisekelo uyophikisana nezinye izigatshana emthethweni wokuthenga impahla. UCuthbert uthe abantu abevile ku-44 million babhuqwa yindlala kanti ababalelwa ku-12 million, abasebenzi."Uhlelo lwe-BEE lwenze izinto zaba nzima kakhulu kunakuqala. Lolu hlelo olwaqala ngo-2003, lunyuse izinga lokungasebenzi kwabamnyama laya ku-36%. Abantu i-ANC ethi ibamele, yibona abalambile sikhuluma nje."Uthe ukuthi bayingxenye kahulumeni wokubambisana akusho ukuthi bazothula bavumele imithetho elambisa abantu."Singabambisana kuhulumeni kodwa lokho akusho ukuthi sizovumelana ngezinto esizibonayo ukuthi azihambi ngendlela. Sikuhulumeni ngoba simele abantu bakuleli, ngeke sihlehlele emuva."Uthe uhulumeni uhluleke wancama ukusiphula izimpande zenkohlakalo.Ubalule nokuthi ngaphansi kwemigomo abayiphakamisayo ngukuthi kumele kubekwe phambili osomabhizinisi abancane, kufukulwe abesifazane, kube nezinhlelo zokuphakelwa kwabahlwempu, kube nemifundaze kuphinde kuthuthukiswe umkhakha wemfundo eyisisekelo.
KUMFANELE uMengameli, Cyril Ramaphosa, abizwe ukuba azochaza akwaziyo phambi kwekhomishini ephenya izinsolo zokugxambukela kosopolitiki emsebenzini wamaphoyisa, kanye nasekomitini lasePhalamende elikhethekile eliphenya izinsolo ezifanayo.Ukukhuluma kulokhu kumzungeze njalo uRamaphosa kwikhomishini kaMadlanga kanye nasekomitini lasePhalamende njengoba kuqhubeka ukulalelwa kobufakazi.Ofakazi basho izinto ezahlukene, nokusishiya nemibuzo. Kungcono naye uRamaphosa anikwe ithuba lokuzikhulumela, angakhulunyelwa.Phakathi kwezinto okusobala ukuthi uRamaphosa kufanele aphumele obala kuzo wukuthi ngabe wavuma yini ukuba kuhlakazwe ithimba lamaphoyisa eliphenya ukubulawa kosopolitiki KwaZulu-Natal. Kuhle ukuba uRamaphosa azikhulumele yena ngoba ofakazi basho izinto ezahlukene.Ubufakazi bukaNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa omisiwe, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, buveza ukuthi uRamaphosa wavuma ukuthi lihlakazwe ithimba.UKhomishana wamaPhoyisa kuzwelonke, uLieutenant General Fannie Masemola, watshela ikhomishini kaMadlanga nekomiti lasePhalamende ukuthi ngesikhathi ebikela uRamaphosa ngomyalelo kaMchunu wokuba kuhlakazwe ithimba, uRamaphosa waqale wakhombisa ukungahambisani nokuthi kuhlakazwe ithimba.UMasemola wathi uRamaphosa wathembisa ukuthi uzokhuluma noMchunu ngalolu daba.Eqhubeka nokulandisa, uMasemola wathi uRamaphosa wabuye wamazisa ukuthi sebexoxile noMchunu kodwa wangasho ukuthi bavumelane ngokuthini.Ngapha uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, unenkolelo yokuthi uRamaphosa akazange avume ukuthi kuhlakazwe ithimba.UMkhwanazi wathi uRamaphosa wawuncoma umsebenzi wethimba ngesikhathi ebuzwa abezindaba ngasekuqaleni kwalo nyaka emva kokuba uMchunu ekhiphe umyalelo wokuba lihlakazwe.Kubalulekile ukuthi uRamaphosa aziphendulele ikakhulukazi ngoba ithimba lasungulwa emva komyalelo wakhe.Ithimba lasungulwa emva kokubulawa kwesishoshovu se-ANC saseMgungundlovu esaseseka uRamaphosa, uMnuz Musawenkosi 'Qashana' Mchunu.Emva kokuhambela umndeni kaQashana, ngo-2018, uRamaphosa wamemezela ukuthi uzohlanganisa ithimba longqongqoshe elizobhekana nokubulawa kosopolitiki KwaZulu-Natal.Okunye ukukhuluma okuzungeza uRamaphosa yizinsolo zokuthi unezinombolo zomazisi ezintathu ezahlukene.Lezi zinsolo zivele kwiKhomishini kaMadlanga ngesikhathi kufundwa imiyalezo eyathathwa efonini kasomabhizinisi oboshelwe uxhaxha lwamacala, uMnuz Vusumuzi 'Cat' Matlala.Ufakazi ofihliwe waveza umyalezo owathunyelwa uMatlala, ewuthumelela inhloko yoKlebe KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Lesetja Senona.Kulo myalezo kuvela idokodo elinezinombolo zomazisi ezintathu ezahlukene.Zonke lezi zinombolo kuthiwa ezikaRamaphosa.Izinsolo eziphenywa yikomiti lasePhalamende nekhomishini kaMadlanga zibucayi kakhulu.Kubalulekile ukuthi lezi zinhlaka zingashiyi lutho uma seziphenya, zibize bonke abantu okuvela amagama abo khona kungeke kube khona okuzosala kulenga.Ikhomishini kaMadlanga ibingakacacisi ukuthi izombiza yini uRamaphosa.Ikomiti lasePhalamende lona selike layikhuluma ekaRamaphosa.Emhlanganweni obungoLwesithathu, igama likaRamaphosa livelile ohlwini lwamagama abantu abangase babizwe.Umeluleki wezomthetho ePhalamende, u-Advocate Maria Mokhoaetsi, uthe abakanqumi ukuthi uRamaphosa uzogcina ebiziwe yini."Ukhona ohlwini kodwa okwamanje esisavumelane ngakho wukuthi akathunyelelwe imibuzo sicele achaze ngokwaxoxwa emhlanganweni wakhe noMasemola kanye noMchunu. Ubufakazi bukaMchunu bukhombisa ukuthi uRamaphosa wavuma ukuthi kuhlakazwe ithimba, uMasemola usho okuhlukile. Okwamanje sifuna nje ukuthi asinike ulwazi. Sifuna nokuthi asitshele ngomhlangano wakhe noMchunu kanye nomhlangano awubamba nowayenguNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa, uMnuz Bheki Cele."Umholi we-EFF, uMnuz Julius Malema, ukhombise ukungasinambithisisi kahle lesi sinqumo.UMalema uthe ukuthunyelelwa kukaRamaphosa imibuzo kukhombisa ukuthi uphethwe ngendlela eyehlukile kwabanye ofakazi ababizelwe ukuba bazophendula phambi kwekomiti.Okhulumela uRamaphosa, uMnuz Vincent Mugwenya, uvele usekuqinisekisile ukuthi ihhovisi likaRamaphosa lizoziphendulela phambi kwekhomishini naphambi kwekomiti lasePhalamende."Sikuqaphe ngelokhozi okwenzeka kwikhomishini. Sizokuya koziphendulela njengehhovisi likamengameli kulokhu okusithintayo. Sizokubeka kucace ukuthi akukho lapho thina esike sagxambukela khona ekusebenzeni kwezinhlaka zokuphepha."UMugwenya uthe akakwazi ukusho ukuthi uRamaphosa uzovuma noma uzonqaba yini uma ebizwa ukuba azokwethula ubufakazi. UMugwenya uthe okwamanje abukho ubufakazi obuqondiswe kuRamaphosa."Izinsolo ezenziwe okwamanje zibhekiswe ehhovisi likamengameli, akukho okusashiwo okuthinta umengameli ngqo. Angazi noma ikomiti lasePhalamende lizombiza noma cha. URamaphosa akasiyona indoda ejwayele ukubalekela amakhomishini. Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi waya kovela phambi kwekhomishini eyayiholwa yiJaji Raymond Zondo, eyayiphenya izinsolo zokulawulwa koMbuso yidlanzana. URamaphosa waze wavela kabili phambi kwale khomishini. Wavela izinsuku ezimbili lapho ayebizwe ukuba azophendula imibuzo njengomholi we-ANC. Imibuzo eminingi lapha yayigxile eqhazeni alibamba ngesikhathi eyiphini likamengameli we-ANC. Ngesikhathi eyiphini likamengameli, uRamaphosa wayengusihlalo wekomiti le-ANC elaliqoka abazojutshwa ezikhundleni ezinhlakeni zikahulumeni. Waphinde waphekwa ngebhodwe elincane izinsuku ezimbili futhi khona ayefake isigqoko sakhe sokuba ngumengameli wezwe, waphinde wabuzwa nangezinto ezenzeka ngesikhathi eseyiphini likamengameli wezwe.
ANUNUSELWA ngemali amaphoyisa angabavusi benyamazane ekuboshweni kosomabhizinisi abasolwa ngokuba yingxenye yeqembu lemigulukudu, uMnuz Vusimuzi "Cat" Matlala, noMnuz Katiso "KT" Molefe.Iphoyisa elaliphenya icala eladonsela uMatlala noMolefe amanzi ngomsele liveze ukuthi kwaba nemizamo yokubagwazela ukuze bayeke uphenyo. Likusho lokhu ngesikhathi lithula ubufakazi kwikhomishini ephenya izinsolo ezenziwa wuKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi.Iphoyisa igama lalo eligodliwe, lichaze kabanzi ngobunzima ababhekana nabo ngesikhathi bephenya icala elagcina libaholela kuMatlala noMolefe.Iphoyisa lithe icala ababeliphenya elokubulawa kukanjiniyela okwakusolwa ukuthi wabhobosa ithumba ngenkohlakalo eyayenzeka eTransnet, uMnuz Armand Swart.Uphenyo lokubulawa kukaSwart lwaholela ekuboshweni kwephoyisa, uDetective Michael Pule Tau, noMnuz Musa Kekana.Emva kwabo kwabuye kwaboshwa uMolefe.Ufakazi uthe babizelwa ehhotela eliphambili eliseGoli lapho bafike bathenjiswa imali. Ufakazi uthe le mali bayithenjiswa wuMajor General Richard Shibiri, ophethe abaphenyi eGauteng."Wathi kithina kukhona izimvilophu ezintathu esingazithola uma siqhamuka neqhinga lokuthi abasolwa banikezwe ibheyili. Noma engazange alimise ngesihloko kodwa sabona ukuthi ukhuluma ngemali uma ethi kunezimvilophu esizozithola. Wayengafuni ukuba siqhubeke nophenyo. Wasitshela ukuthi abasolwa bayingozi, baxhumene nomuntu onesikhundla esiphezulu koKlebe."Ufakazi wenkantolo uthe kwaba nemizamo eminingi yokuphazamisa uphenyo olwaholela ekuboshweni kwalaba."Sathola izinsongo nokwaholela ekutheni abanye abaphenyi begcine behoxa ecaleni. Sasikade sibahlanu ngesikhathi siqala uphenyo kodwa sagcina sisala siba babili."Ufakazi uthe uMolefe noTau bagwazela izimantshi ukuze bathole ibheyili.Ufakazi uthe watshelwa wumuntu osondelene noMolefe, uMnuz Vusi Ndala, ukuthi uTau uzodedelwa ngebheyili."Isicelo sebheyili kaTau sokuqala sachithwa. Wafaka isicelo sesibili lapho ayesekhala ngokuthi uphethwe wushukela, wathi isimo sakhe sidinga ukuthi alashwe esibhedlela esingaphandle kwejele. UNdala wangitshela ukuthi uTau uzonikezwa ibheyili, ngamphikisa ngoba ngangazi ukuthi sinobufakazi obuqinile."UNdala wangitshela ukuthi uTau uzophuma ngoba ukhiphe intshontsho. Wangitshela ukuthi uma enganikwa ibheyili uzokweqa, uma kuhlula lokho uzobulala abantu abaphenya icala. Inkantolo yagcina idedela uTau ngebheyili."Ufakazi uzoqhubeka nomhlanje.
UNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa osamisiwe, uSenzo Mchunu, uhlulekile ukwethula ingosi yezingcingo lapho uKhomishana wamaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLt General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, abemsabisa khona. UMchunu utshele ikomidi lasePhalamende ukuthi uyalele isikhulu sakhe uCedric Nkabinde ukuthi aqophe inkulumo yakhe noMkhwanazi wathi uzokhipha irekhodi elifanele ngesikhathi evela ngoLwesibili. USihlalo uSoviet Lekganyane uveze ukuthi abaholi bobufakazi balandele uMchunu mayelana nenkulumo eqoshiwe athembisa ukufika nayo njengobufakazi phambi kwekomiti kodwa abakwazanga ukukuthola."Leso siqephu asikadluliswa kithina ngakho-ke akuthina, nguyena owasho ngesonto eledlule ukuthi ubefuna sizwe leso siqephu kodwa besingekho lapho kuqoshwa khona,” kusho uLekganyane. Uphinde wagqamisa ukuthi umholi we-Economic Freedom Fighters (EFF) uJulius Malema ukugcizelele ukuthi bonke ubufakazi afuna ukubuveza kufanele butholakale kodwa lokhu okuqoshiwe akukaze kwenzeke. Dlala Ividiyo "Njengoba kumanje, ikomiti lesikhashana alinayo leyo ngxenye enathembisa ukuthi izotholakala,” kusho uLekganyane.Eziphendulela uMchunu uthe kungenzeka ukuthi inkulumo yaqoshwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi inkulumo isidlulile. "Bengicabanga ukuthi kurekhodiwe, kanti cha, bekuyinkulumo edlulayo," kusho uMchunu.Uqhubeke wathi akuhluphi ngoba uyeza uNkabinde naye uzomfakazela kulokhu, ngakhoke inkulumo eqoshiwe okuyona yodwa okumele kuthenjelwe kuyona, udaba aluphelile.
Kudutshulwe kwabulawa abasolwa ababili abaneminyaka engu-27 no-30 ubudala ngesikhathi bedubulana namaphoyisa ehostela iGlebelands.Amaphoyisa abelandela umkhondo wabasolwa abebefunelwa icala lokuduna imoto, elenzeke eHarding ngoLwesihlanu, 19 September 2025, kwadunwa khona iveni ebihamba amadoda amahlanu ekhonjwe ngezibhamu. Kube sekuboshwa umsolwa oyedwa ngecala lokuduna imoto, kanti amaphoyisa athungatha abasolwa abangakaboshwa.Iminingwane ngomunye umsolwa etholakele, iveze ukuthi umsolwa ubebhace ehostela iGlebelands, eMlaza. Kwahlelwa umsebenzi, kwathi ngoMsombuluko ebusuku, amalungu adlulela ehostela laseGlebelands. Ekufikeni kwawo amaphoyisa angqongqoza ekamelweni eliqondiswe kubo azimemezele. Impendulo yalowo obengaphakathi kube ukudubula ebhekise kumalungu. Kwaqubuka impi yezibhamu, kwalimala abasolwa ababili. Amaphoyisa athole izibhamu ezimbili ezingekho emthethweni kanye nezinhlamvu eziyisithupha.
ELINYE lamabhange akuleli zwe iStandard bank selikhiphe umbiko walo ebeliqala ukucwaninga ngawo nonyaka iTownship Informal Economy Report, odalule ukuthi abalelwa ku-80% amabhizinisi asemalokishini aseNingizimu Afrika angabhalisiwe ngokusemthethweni.Ngokwe-Statistics South Africa (StatsSA), amabhizinisi angabhalisiwe yilawo asebenza ngendlela yokuthi angalandeli imigomo nemithetho yokukhokha intela, imithetho yezabasebenzi nokunye kwemicikilisho yezentela. Lawo mabhizinisi asebenza ngaleyo ndlela aba nenkinga yokungakwazi ukuhlomula ezintweni ezithile njengokuthola imali yokuxhaswa nokunye okungenza ukuthi akhule futhi athuthukiswe.Nakuba kunjalo, umnotho waselokishini ukwemqoka kakhulu kwezomnotho eNingizimu Afrika, njengoba ubambe iqhaza ku-19.5% wemisebenzi ekhiqizeke engxenyeni yokuqala ka-2024. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imibiko esanda kuphuma ibalule ukuthi umnotho wasemalokishini ubalelwa ku-R1 trillion. Lolu cwaningo lweStandard Bank lwenziwe eGauteng, KwaZulu-Natal, Western Cape, Limpopo naseNorth West, futhi belubheka kakhulu amabhizinisi enza imali ebalelwa ku-R100 000 kuya ku-R50 milllion ngonyaka. Nakhu okunye okutholwe wucwaningo lweStandard Bank:- La mabhizinisi awu-80% angabhalisiwe aphuthelwa wusizo lwezezimali namanye amathuba okuwathuthukisa.- Angaphansi kuka-9% kuwona awakwazi ukubolekwa imali emabhange, okwenza ukuthi ancike emalini ayibolekwa ngabangani nemindeni.- Kukhona nenkinga yokuthi osomabhizinisi abaningi benza amabhizinisi ezinto ezifanayo.- Nakuba imali esandleni isasebenza, kepha amabhizinisi angaphezu kuka-56% athanda ukuthi abantu bakhokhe ngamakhadi asebhange ukulungisela ukuhambisana nesikhathi.- U-49% wala mabhizinisi usebenzela emagaraji noma emakhaya, kube wu-11% kuphela onezindawo eziqondile zokusebenzela.Inhloko yophiko lokuthuthukisa amabhizinisi eStandard Bank, uNksz Naledzani Mosomane, ithe lolu cwaningo luveza ngokusobala izinto okusamele zilungiswe wosomabhizinisi basemalokishini ukuze kuchume amabhizinisi abo."Amabhizinisi asemalokishini abamba iqhaza elimqoka emphakathini, ngakho lezi zinselelo eziwayisa emuva kumele abhekane nazo ngokushesha. Yingakho nathi sizibophezele ukungenelela lapho singangenelela khona ukuze asizakale," usho kanje.
ISIHAMBE yaze yayofika enkantolo eyombango wokudayisa kwamaphinifa enkabeni yeTheku.Lo mbango osuthathe iminyaka, usha phansi phakathi kwabathungi bamaphinifa baseNingizimu Afrika kanjalo nalabo abangabokufika kuleli abangenamaphepha. Ekhuluma neSolezwe, umsunguli wePhinifa neDuku Association, okuyinhlangano yabathungi bamaphinifa bakuleli, uNksz Thabo Ngcobo, uthe lo mbango osungene enkantolo, usuneminyaka ukhona. Uthe uma ekhumbula, waqala emva kuka-2018, kulandela ukuthi abanye babo bejikelwa abokufika esiswini njengotshwala."Ngaleso sikhathi umsebenzi wawumningi, isasanda kungenisa eyokuswenka ngamaphinifa. Abanye omama baqasha abokufika ukuthi babathungele amaphonifa ukuze kube lula ukuthi bamelane nomthamo wama-oda amaphinifa,” kusho uNksz Ngcobo.Uveze ukuthi kuthe bengazelele, abokufika baqala bawudla umsebenzi wabo, baziqalela ukuthunga amaphinifa endaweni ehlukile, bawadayisa ngemali eyawubulala yawuqeda umsebenzi wabo. "Thina amaphinifa siwadayisa ngo-R150 lilinye, bona bavele balidayise u-R75, okuyinto esiqedela amakhasimende. Abantu abasathengi kithi, sebevele bagijime bayothenga kubo,” usho kanje.Uthe into eyenza kube nzima kakhulu ukuthi ama-design, indwangu kanjalo ne-quality kuyafana, ngakho amakhasimende bavele bawawole wonke."Kubona uyabagculisa lo R75 ngoba uma befika nawo emazweni abo, ufike ube yimali enkulu. Ngapha ngakuthina, kunzima ukuthi singawehlisa amaphinifa siwabize imali efanayo ngoba lokho ngabe kusho ukuthi sisebenzela ize,” kusho uNksz Ngcobo. Uthe bazamile ukuyilwa kahle le nto kodwa kwanhlanga zimuka nomoya, kwaze kwaba basungula inhlangano yabo kulo nyaka.Uthe inamalungu abalelwa ku-800, kanti bebehlose ngayo ukulwa nale nkinga.UNgcobo uveze ukuthi bahambile bayoyethula kuMasipala weTheku, basho nokuthi bahloseni ngayo, bacela nokwesekwa ezinhlosweni zayo. Uthe bekungasekuqaleni kwenyanga edlule, lapho bethole khona ukuthi kukhona owesifazane osaqhubeka nokusebenzisana nabokufika enkabeni yeTheku.Uveze ukuthi bathe uma beyobika kuMasipala weTheku bangaluthola sizo, base benikela etafuleni elidayisa lona wesifazane.Uthe bafica owokufika, kwasuka umsindo owagcina ubophisa bona. "Lona wesifazane wavula icala, wathi sithathe amaphinifa akhe esamba sika-R130 000. Wabuye washintsha wathi bekungawa-R13 000,” kusho uNksz Ngcobo.Uthe kugcine kuboshwa amalungu abo ayisithupha ahamba inkantolo njengamanje, wathi batshelwe ukuthi kusashoda abanye abayisishiyagalolunye.Leli cala liyaqhubeka eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini, lizophinde libuyele ngo-Okthoba 29.
SINYUKILE isibalo sabafundi ababhala u-matric kuleli njengoba sinyuke ngo-39 000, uma kuqhathaniswa nesangonyaka odlule.Bangaphezu kuka-900 000 abafundi ababhala u-matric kulo nyaka, kulaba abangu-766 000 babhala ngokugcwele, kuthi abangu-137 000 babhala ngasese.Ememezela izinhlelo zokulungela ukubhalwa kwalezi zivivinyo eziqala namhlanje ngephepha le-Computer, uNgqongqoshe weMfundo eyisiSekelo, uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, uthe konke sekumi ngomumo. Uthe ukunyuka kwesibalo sababhalayo kukhomba ukuthi baningi abathola imfundo kuleli."Ukunyuka kwesibalo sababhalayo kukhomba ukuthi siyehla isibalo sabaphindayo, okusho ukuthi bayaphasa. Kukhomba nokuthi baningi abathola ithuba lokufunda uma uqhathanisa namanye amazwe."Uthe izinhlelo ezifana nolokudla ezikoleni, lwenza abafundi beze njalo ezikoleni."Kanjalo nendaba yokungakhokhwa kwemali yesikole kwenza babe baningi abathola imfundo. Siqinisa emazingeni aphansi ukuze kuthi uma sekuziwa emazingeni aphezulu babe sebekulungele," kuqhuba uNksz Gwarube. Uthe yonke into isimi ngomumo mayelana nalezi zivivinyo."Zonke izinhlelo zimi ngononina njengoba singafuni kube nezithiyo ekubhaleni. Kunezinhlelo ezenziwe uma kwenzeka kucima ugesi, kuzosetshenziswa ama-generator. Kwenziwe nezinhlelo futhi uma kwenzeka kuba nemvula nezinye izinto ezingaphazamisa izivivinyo. Sinxusa imiphakathi ukuthi ingaphazamisi izivivinyo uma kukhona engeneme ngakho," kusho uNksz Gwarube esithangamini nabezindaba eMpumalanga.Uhlabe ikhwelo kubafundi nothisha ukuthi bangazihlanganisi nezinto ezifaka ukukopela ngoba babeka ikusasa labo engcupheni. Uveze nokuthi izivivinyo ziphothulwa ngoNovemba 27, bese kulungiselelwa ukumaka okuzoqala ngoDisemba 2.UDkt Rufus Poliah obhekele izivivinyo emnyangweni, uveze ukuthi sinyukile nesibalo sabafundi ababhala izifundo ezehlukene.Uthe kumele kushaye uDisemba 16, wonke amamaki abe esefakwe emakhompyutheni abo."Mkhulu umsebenzi owenziwe kulezi zivivinyo. Yonke into isimi ngomumo, sekusele kubafundi ukuthi babhale," usho kanje. UDkt Regina Mhaule, iPhini likaNgqongqoshe emnyangweni, unxuse abafundi ukuthi bangahlali emakhaya kodwa baye ezikoleni bayofuna usizo kothisha."Izikole zivuliwe kuze kuphele unyaka. Abafundi abadinga usizo abaye ezikoleni ngoba othisha bakhona. Abangahlali emakhaya ekubeni kukhona izinto abangaziqondi njengoba bezobhala," usho kanje. Uyalele abazali ukuthi behlisele ababhalayo umsebenzi wasekhaya baze baphothule izivivinyo.Amaqembu ezepolitiki kanjalo nohulumeni wakuleli bafisele abafundi ababhalayo ukubhala okuhle.Kunconywe othisha ngomsebenzi omuhle abawenzile nokuzikhandla kwabo ngokusebenza ngezimpelasonto nangamaholidi befundisa abaka-matric.
BANGASALA bengenathisha abafundi basezikoleni ezisemakhaya nezingenayo imali uma bedilizwa noma kuncishiswa isibalo sothisha eMnyangweni wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, ngenxa yenkinga yokushoda kwemali.Lokhu kuvezwe yinhloko yomnyango, uMnuz Nkosinathi Ngcobo, iphendula imibuzo yamalungu ekomiti elibhekele ukusebenza kwezezimali, iStanding Committee on Public Accounts (Scopa), esiShayamthetho eMgungundlovu.UNgcobo uthe badinga ukufakelwa uchatha esabelweni somnyango ukuze bakwazi ukubhekana nazo zonke izidingo."Uma sinciphisa othisha noma sibadiliza, kunezifundo ezingeke zifundwe. Izikole ezimi kahle zingakwazi ukuqasha abanye othisha uma sibanciphisa. Ezidonsa kanzima nezisemakhaya, zingasala zingenabo othisha ngenxa yokuthi azinayo enye indlela yokuthola imali," kusho uNgcobo. Uthe minyaka yonke siyanda isibalo sabafundi ekubeni esothisha isibalo sisami kanjalo.Ubalule ukuthi abakwazi ukudiliza noma ukwehlisa isibalo sothisha ngoba kungadala enkulu inkinga."Sisami esibalweni sothisha abangu-90 057 kusuka ngo-2008 emnyangweni. Abafundi bakhula minyaka yonke, kushintsha nezifundo kungena ezintsha kodwa asinyuki isibalo sothisha. Kumele ngabe sinabasebenzi abangu-15 000 basemahhovisi kodwa abakhona bangu-9 000, okusho ukuthi sishoda ngabalelwa ku-6 000," kusho uNgcobo. Kwayona eyokungehliswa kwesibalo sothisha kwenziwa ngukuthi zala ukhasha izinyunyana zothisha zithi lingawa licoshwe zinkukhu ukuthi kungancishiswa noma kudilizwe abasebenzi. Ukhale ngokuthi inkulu imali eyehliswe esabelweni sabo eminyakeni edlule."Uma sibala eminyakeni emithathu edlule, sesibanjelwe u-R26 billion esabelweni. Sidinga ukuthi ibuye enye imali kule mali, asisho ukuthi ayibuye yonke kodwa akuye noma ingxenye ukuze singasebenzisi ngokweqile imali." Uthe vele ingxenye enkulu yemali yomnyango iya emaholweni abasebenzi, iningi labo okungothisha. Uveze nokuthi kunezifundo okumele ngabe bazifuqa ngokugcwele ezikoleni kodwa abakwazi ngenxa yezinselelo zemali."Kunezifundo iCoding and Robotics esingakwazi ukuzifuqa ngendlela esithanda ngayo ngoba zidinga ingcosana yabafundi. Imali kayikho ngakho asikwazi ukusifuqa ngendlela esithanda ngayo," kusho uNgcobo.Indaba yokungafuqwa kwalesi sifundo ngendlela efanele ikhalise nelungu leqembu uMkhonto weSizwe, uMnuz Mervyn Dirks. Uthe iyamkhathaza eyokuthi kwezinye izikole ezinezinsiza ziyakwazi ukufundisa lezi zifundo ngempumelelo kodwa kwezishoda ngezinsiza kunzima."Lokhu kusho ukuthi akukho ukulingana kwabafundi kwezemfundo esifundazweni ngenxa yokuthi abanye abafundi bayakwazi ukufunda noma yiziphi izifundo, abanye abakwazi. Kumele umnyango usazise ukuthi singawusiza kanjani siyiScopa." UNgcobo uthe babeke isimo njengoba sinjalo kuleli komiti ngoba abafuni kube khona okuthiwa bayakufihla.Amalungu ekomiti aveze ukuthi ayazwelana nomnyango ngalezi zinselelo obhekene nazo.
UMHOLI we-IFP, uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa, uthi akhalela ubala amalungu e-ANC akhonondela ukuphucwa uMasipala wesiFunda uMkhanyakude.UHlabisa uthe kwasekuqaleni, kwaba yiphutha ukuthi i-ANC iphathe lo mkhandlu ngoba kwanqoba i-IFP ngesikhathi kunokhetho lohulumeni basekhaya olwedlule.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba abebehambele umcimbi wokugubha iminyaka engu-50 kwasungulwa i-IFP obuseGoli, ngoMgqibelo. I-IFP isanda kukhipha ubuholi be-ANC obese buphathe eMkhanyakude iminyaka emine.Imeya ye-ANC, uMnuz Siphile Mdaka, nosomlomo, uMnuz Solomon Mkhombo, bakhishwe ngevoti lokungabethembi ubuholi babo maqede kwangena amakhansela e-IFP ezikhundleni, uMnuz Comfort Khumalo noMnuz Pat Madlopha.Ukukhishwa kobuholi be-ANC kudunge ubudlelwano be-IFP ne-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, kangangoba i-ANC ize yabuyisa izinduku ngokweseka isiphakamiso se-ABC sokukhipha ubuholi be-IFP kuMasipala waseMvoti.Kunekhwelo elenziwe i-ANC Youth League, lokuba i-ANC ihoxe kuhulumeni wokubambisna ophethe iKwaZulu-Natal.Kwenzeka konke lokhu nje, iqembu eliphikisayo esiShayamthetho, i-MK, lifake isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNdunankulu, uMnuz Thami Ntuli.Kepha uHlabisa unxuse abe-ANC ukuba beze etafuleni lezingxoxo uma kukhona abangakuboni kahle. "Uma nishadile nomuntu vele kuyenzeka kube nezinkinga. Into ebalulekile ukuthi uma kunezinkinga nixoxe. Sinaso isixazululo kule nto. Ayikho into okufanele abantu bakhathazeke ngayo. Kunezingxoxo eziqhubekayo ngodaba laKwaZulu-Natal."UHlabisa uthe bekuyiphutha ukungaphathi kwe-IFP eMkhanyakude ekubeni kuyiyo eyathola amavoti amaningi okhethweni olwedlule."Sonke siyazi ukuthi eMkhanyakude kwanqoba i-IFP ngo-2016. Ngebhadi umasipala waphathwa i-ANC iminyaka emihlanu yonke. Ngokhetho lwango-2021, kwaphinda kwanqoba i-IFP eMkhanyakude. Kwenzeka into embi ngesikhathi kubalwa kuMasipala waseMtubatuba. Leli phutha laholela ekutheni kuphathe i-ANC eMkhanyakude. Ubuholi be-ANC nabo buyazi ukuthi kwanqoba i-IFP eMkhanyakude. Akubona ubulungiswa uma umasipala uzoqhubeka uphethwe i-ANC. Lokhu kuphambene nentando yeningi. Ngokwentando yeningi iqembu elithole amavoti amaningi yilona okufanele liphathe."UHlabisa uthe bazoqhubeka nemigubho yeminyaka ewu-50 kwasungulwa i-IFP ngomcimbi ozokuba ngoDisemba 13.UHlabisa uthe emva kwalo mcimbi, bazokube sebeqala amalungiselelo okhetho lohulumeni basekhaya, wathi i-IFP izophinde izidlele amahlanga komasipala baKwaZulu-Natal.Uthe akubakhathazi ukwenza kahle kwe-MK KwaZulu-Natal okhethweni lukazwelonke lwangonyaka owedlule.

IYAQINA imikhankaso yokulwa nokusabalala kwegciwane i-HIV kuleli njengoba sekunomjovo ozovikela ukutheleleka ngaleli gciwane.Lo mjovo, i-Lenacapavir, uzojovwa ngawo kabili ngonyaka, okusho ukuthi njalo ezinyangeni eziyisithupha kumele ujove.UNgqongqoshe eHhovisi likaMengameli, uNksz Khumbudzo Ntshavheni, uthe iKhabhinethi ithole umbiko mayelana nezinhlelo zokusabalalisa lo mjovo, okulindeleke ukuthi uqale ukutholalaka kusuka ngoMashi noma u-Ephreli, ngonyaka ozayo."Lo mjovo i-Lenacapavir, uzosatshalaliswa ezifundeni ezingu-23, ezihaqeke kakhulu kuleli. Lezi zifunda zisezifundazweni eziyisithupha kanti uzotholakala emitholampilo engu-360," kusho uNksz Ntshavheni, ekhuluma esithangamini nabezindaba ePitoli izolo. Izifunda ezihaqeke kakhulu KwaZulu-Natal kubalwa Amajuba, eThekwini, iLembe, King Cetshwayo, Ugu naseMgungundlovu.Lo mjovo kuthiwa usuqalile ukusebenza emazweni afana neMelika, Europe naseCanada.UNgqongqoshe wezeMpilo kuleli uDkt Aaron Motsoaledi, ekhuluma neNewzroom Afrika, uveze ukuthi umjovo akuwona owokuthithibalisa i-HIV/AIDS, kwabahaqekile. Uthe asebehaqekile bazoqhubeka nokudla imishanguzo yabo ama-ARV."Lo mjovo owokusiza ukuthi ungatheleleki nge-HIV uma ungakabi nayo. Umjovo ufana ne-PrEP, okumanje iyiphilisi eliphuzwa njalo. Sihlose ukuvikela abangenayo iHIV, izingane zamantombazane ezisencane ezisengozini, abesifazane abakhulelwe kanjalo namadoda alala namanye," usho kanje. Uthe ibalelwa ku-480 000 imijovo ezosatshalaliswa kuleli."Sizophuma sifundise abantu ukuze bangadideki ngendaba yomjovo. Umgomo ngukuthi kumele ujove kanye ezinyangeni eziyisithupha, uma ungajovi emva kwalokho uzoba sengozini yokutheleleka ngeHIV."Uthe inhloso ngukuthi kwehliswe isibalo sabantu abahaqwa yiHIV kuleli minyaka yonke."Okusikhathazayo ngukuthi ngo-2023, abantu abangu-140 000 batheleleka ngeHIV. Siyanda isibalo sabatheleleka ngaleli gciwane," usho kanje. Ugxeke nokutholakala kwemfumba yama-ARV, engozini eyenzeke eLimpopo ngeledlule lapho kushone khona abantu abangu-43 baseZimbabwe naseMalawi. Ibhasi yayisuka eGqeberha, iya kula mazwe. "Lolu daba siluxoxile kwiKhabhinethi. Wubugebengu nje lobu akuvumelekile ukuthi kuphume imishanguzo engaka iye kwamanye amazwe."UNksz Ntshavheni, uthe kuqalwe uphenyo ngokutholakala kwale mishanguzo kule ngozi."Ukwebiwa kwama-ARV kubukela phansi impi yokulwa neHIV kuleli. Abantu abayeke ukusebenzisa imithi eyebiwe ngoba lokho kuyicala elibomvu," usho kanje.

Uthe bazimisele ngokusebenzisana nabezomlilo."Ayikho into emqoka njengokusebenzisana uma kukhulunywa ngezimo ezifuze lezi,'' kusho uGumede.Ukugcizelele ukuthi kuseqhulwini ukuthi kube khona okwenziwayo ukuze umphakathi uthole ukuvikeleka ezinhlekeleleni. Ugcizelele ukuthi samkhathaza kakhulu isimo esabonakala kule ndawo ngenxa yokuguquka kwesimo sezulu. "Uyabona kusuke sekunzima kakhulu uma sekucekeleka namabhuloho kanjalo nemizi yabantu. Yingakho sikholwa wukuthi kumele sibhukule ngenhloso yokubhekana nalesi simo,'' kusho uGumede.Uthe okubi wukuthi kuye kudingeke kuqalwe phansi kuphume imali okumele isetshenziselwe ukulungisa kabusha okonakele. Ukhulume nangokubaluleka kokuqoqwa kwemfucuza wathi nakho kubuye kube neqhaza ekudalekeni kwezinhlekelele kungenasidingo. UNksz Xoli Dube obhekele uPhiko lweziNhlekelele kwaSalga uthe kulolu phiko beseka kakhulu omasipala abehlukene uma bebhekene nenkinga yezinhlekelele.Uthe ngaphambi kwalokho baye baqale babahlomise ngolwazi olumqoka mayelana nokugwema izinhlekelele. ''Sihambela kakhulu imiphakathi ikakhulukazi le esijwayele ukuthi ihlaselwe yinkinga yezinhlekelele. Namhlanje sithe asize lapha siqale sifundise nabafundi ngoba siyazi ukuthi uma sifundisa abafundi lokho kusho ukuthi lokhu kuzogwemeka ngokuhamba kwesikhathi,'' kuchaza yena.Uthe bafuqa umbhidlango wokuhambela izingxenye ezahlukene ngenhloso yokufundisa kabanzi ngenkinga yezinhlekelele ezidalwa wukuguquka kwesimo sezulu.Uveze ukuthi u-Okthoba bahlose ukuwusebenzisela kakhulu ukufuqa umbhidlango wokufundisa imiphakathi ngezinhlekelele ezahlukene.Uthishanhloko wakulesi sikole, uMnuz Thando Ndebele, uthe kumqoka kakhulu ukuba uhlelo lokufundisa ngezinhlekelele nokuguquka kwesimo sezulu lufuqwe nasezikoleni kufundiswe abantwana..

Iqale yagwaza uyise kuthe uma ibona ukuthi useshonile uyise yaqonda ngqo kunina naye yamgwaza kabi washonela esibhedlela,'' kusho umthombo.Uqhuba uthe indodana yenze okungajwayelekile ngoba kuthe seyiqede ukugwaza abazali bayo yangabaleka kunalokho yavele yagibela phezu komuzi ithi ilinde amaphoyisa ukuba afike azoyibopha.''Afikile ngempela amaphoyisa ayibopha futhi nayo ibingenayo inkinga. Ngesikhathi iboshwa ayizange inqabe. Ngikhuluma nawe nje isesitokisini,'' kuchaza umthombo.Uqhuba uthe lesi sigameko siwashiye ebambe ongezansi amalungu omphakathi wakule ndawo amanye ebuzana imibuzoi engenazimpendulo ngasoo.Amalungu omphakathi athi afe olwembiza ngokubulawa kwenduna ngoba iklame indima enkulu iqinisekisa ukuthi umphakathi wakule ndawo uyathuthuka.''Kule ndawo sinezikole, izinkundla zebhola lezinyawo namahholo ngenxa yokusebenza ngokuzikhandla kukaNombela,'' kusho elinye ilungu lomphakathi.Amalungu omphakathi amaningi abekhala ngokulunga kwenduna nomkayo. Abelimisa ngesihloko elokuthi kuyadumaza ukuthi bagcine bebulawa ngesihluku esinjena."Eyi mfowethu sidumele kabi ngale nto eyenzeke enduneni nomkayo. Laba bantu bebephila bebazisa abantu futhi bewuhlonipha kabi umphakathi abakuwona. Kubuhlungu ke ukuthi namhlanje kukhulunywe indaba yokuthi babulawe yingane yabo abayizalayo. Namanje akuvumi ukuthi ngiyikholwe le nto mina,'' kusho omunye womakhelwane.Indodana endala yabafi, uMnuz Sakhile Nombela, ikuqinisekisile ukuthi babulewe abazali bayo. Kodwa ithe ayithandi ukukhuluma lngaolu daba nezintatheli. Ngemuva kwalokho ivale ucingo.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu Natal, uLieutanant Colonel Paul Magwaza, usiqinisekisile isigameko. Uthe amaphoyisa aseBhekithemba, eMlaza abophe owesilisa waseNgonyameni oneminyaka engu-34 ngecala lokubulala abazali bakhe.''Owesilisa kusolakala ukuthi ugwaze uyise washonela khona ekhaya. Wenze okufanayo nakunina kodwa yena ushonele esibhedlela. Inhloso yokubulala ibingakaziwa,'' usho kanjena.
KUZOCACA ngoMsombuluko ngekusasa lomculi kamaskandi, uBukelani "Dlubheke" Khuzwayo, njengoba ezofaka isicelo sebheyili eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseNquthu. Lo mculi wodumo lwengoma ethi Impi Yamatekisi ubevele kule nkantolo ngoMsombuluko ngamacala amabili okubulala namanye amabili okuzama ukubulala. Isolezwe Ngempelasonto lathola ukuthi uDlubheke wazinikela yena emaphoyiseni aseDurban North, ngoLwesihlanu olwedlule, ngoba eselunywe indlebe ngokuthi uphiko lwamaphoyisa i-NIU lumfuna phansi phezulu.Uthungathwa nje uDlubheke, amaphoyisa aseGauteng abekade edubule abulala uZamani Ngila Ximba waseQhudeni, esigamekweni esenzeke eDuduza, Ekurhuleni, ngoLwesine olwedlule, ngo-12 ebusuku. UXimba ubesolwa ngokubhuqabhuqa ngenhlamvu abantu, okukhona kubo nowayeyilungu elimele iNkatha ePhalamende, uMnuz Khethamabala Petros Sithole (67). USithole wabulawa ngokudutshulwa ehostela iBuyafuthi, eKatlehong, ngoMeyi, eyokhuza ukubulalana kwabantu baseQhudeni. Ekuqaleni kwesonto, isitatimende samaphoyisa aKwaZulu-Natal, sithe ukuboshwa kukaDlubheke kumayelana nesigameko esenzeka ngoNovemba 12, 2023, sokuhlaselwa kwamadoda amane akwaSithole eQhudeni, ayesemotweni emhlophe eliqhamukisa eNtinini, eBabanango, elibangise emakhaya."Ngesikhathi edlula eMpukunyoni, kusolwa ukuthi avinjwa wumsolwa, ababekhuluma naye ngesikhathi besendleleni. Ngesikhathi imoto seyizokuma, umsolwa waqala wavulela ngenhlamvu, ebhekise kubagilwa, kwathi umshayeli wahluleka ukulawula imoto yagcina seyiphaphalaza."Siqhuba isitatimende, sithe abagilwa ababili basindiswa ukubaleka endaweni yesigameko, kwathi abanye bagcina bedlulile emhlabeni ngenxa yokulimala kabi. Kwenzeka lokhu nje, uDlubheke ubesanda kuveza ukuthi usephilisa okwenyamazane ngenxa yokubona engaphephile. Le nsizwa yakhala ngokudeze iyamaniswa nezigameko zokubulawa kwabantu, kokunye ize iboshwe kodwa kungenzeki igcine ibekwe icala. Ekhuluma kwiClean Governance Podcast, uDlubheke wasola abantu bangakubo athi bamqhatha nabaseMsinga naseTembisa. Uthe useke wakhalelwa ngamasongo kaSigonyela ngoba esolwa ekubulaweni kwabantu abangaphezu kweshumi.Echaza, wathi udaba lwaqala ngo-Okthoba 2023, njengoba esefika kulesi sinqumo. "Sasihleli nje esitolo siziphuzela. Mina ngiwumuntu obuye azishayele otshwaleni. Sasiphuza negenge yakhona endaweni nomzala. Sasila ko-5, siphuza etafuleni lethu. Kwangena ucingo ngabo-6 ntambama."Uthe kukhona owashaya ucingo wathi akuvalwe esitolo futhi kutshelwe yena noLolo Sibiya ukuba basuke ngoba bazohlaselwa. Uqhube wathi wahamba noSibiya kodwa yena wangaya ekhaya, kwathi uSibiya waya kubo ngoba wayefuna ukuyolala ekhaya."Wathi uma engena ebaleni sasuka isidumo. Wathi edutshulwa lapho uSibiya wabaleka wangena endlini. Kwabulawa umkakhe nezingane zakhe ezimbili ngokulamana kwazo."UDlubheke uthe uSibiya wasinda kuleso sibhicongo. Uthe emuva kwesonto, kwathiwa nguye owaletha abantu abavala ngehlahla emndenini kaSibiya."Okuyilapho kuqale khona inkinga KwaNgqulu, ngoba kwalimala (kwashona) abantu abangu-11. Kulaba bantu abawu-11 ngumzala kuphela engingabalwanga ukuthi ubulawe yimi. Bonke laba bantu, kwakuhlangene amadoda endawo athize, akhanda le nto ukuthi yonke le nto ayifuculelwe kwaKhuzwayo."Wathi wakhonjwa ngomunwe ebusweni kwathiwa nguye uDlubheke obulale izingane. "Ngenhlanhla leyo, amaphoyisa azibamba zonke izigebengu ezibulale lezo zingane. Aliveli nangomfantu igama lami kulezi zigebengu. Omunye wazo usegwetshiwe, abanye basahamba icala."Uthe nakuba kunjalo, kusathiwa nguye owabulala laba bantu kangangoba sekuhlaselwe kubo amahlandla amaningi, kwaze kwadutshulwa noyise, uShobeni Khuzwayo weZingane Zoma futhi kwashiswa imoto. UDlubheke wathi ngolunye usuku evakashele abafowabo eVosloorus, eGauteng, wahlaselwa ngabantu bangakubo angaxabene nabo kodwa wasinda ngokulambisa."Babuya sebengibamba ngamaphoyisa khona lapho. Bangigxoba namaphoyisa kwajika ilanga. Amaphoyisa ayengithathe ngecala lokuthi ngabulala omunye umuntu wakwaNgcobo. Ngathi lo muntu ngangizwana naye kodwa wabulawa ngiseMobeni Heights, eThekwini."Wathi waboshwa wagqunywa izinyanga ezintathu esitokisini saseBoksburg. Uthe akugcinanga lapho kodwa kwabuye kwafika amaphoyisa namanye amacala aseTembisa, waboshwa wadedelwa. Yize udlame lwaKwaNgqulu selwakhuzwa kodwa uthe kusalokhu kukhonjwa yena uma kufa umuntu njengababulawe eFaraday.Wathi usebuye wakhonjwa ekubulaweni kukaSithole ehostela eBuyafuthi, eKatlehong, kangangoba amaphoyisa aseke ahlasela epulazini likayise, kanjalo nakubo ngoba emsola ngokuthi ufihle omunye umsolwa.Wathi nakulesi sigameko ubhecwa ngobende ngoba senzeka yena eyozingela eMpumalanga, futhi kunobufakazi.
KUPHELA amaphupho kubafundi abaqala izivivinyo zabo zakwa-matric ezweni lonke. Laba bafundi bazovuna abebekutshala eminyakeni engu-12, befunda.Babalelwa ngaphezu kuka-900 000 abafundi ababhala lezi zivivinyo kuzwelonke, KwaZulu-Natal bangu-195 899. Izivivinyo ziqala ngephepha leComputer Applications Technology kanti abafundi abaningi bazoze babhale ngoLwesine, i-English Paper 3. Izivivinyo ziphothulwa ngasekupheleni kwenyanga ezayo, okusho ukuthi bazobhala inyanga yonke.NgokoMnyango weMfundo eyisiSekelo, yonke into isimi ngononina, othisha bawenzile umsebenzi wabo manje ingcabha ikubafundi. Abazali banxuswe ukuthi baseke abafundi ngalesi sikhathi esinzima, esidinga ukuthi behliselwe neminye imisebenzi yasemakhaya abebeyenza, ukuze bagxile ekubhaleni. Ababhalayo kanjalo nalabo abazobe bebagadile, badonswe ngendlebe ukuthi bangalinge bangene esilingweni sokuzama izindlela ezinqamulelayo zokuphasa, ngokuthi bakopele. Uma bebanjwa bekopela, imiphumela yabo iyothathwa njengento engekho, baphinde bamiswe ekubhaleni izivivinyo iminyaka ecela kwemibili. Kuthiwa lizobe lingafakwa njengoba izivivinyo zizoqashwa ngelokhozi abazozinza zisuka ezikoleni ezithile zize ziyophothulwa.Imiphakathi nayo iyalelwe ukuba ingalinge ibhodlele ezivivinyweni uma kungukuthi ayeneme ngezinto ezithile ezingathinta ukuhanjiswa kwezidingo. Noma kuvela izinhlekelele, kunezinhlelo ezenziwe ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amaphepha ayafinyelela ezikhungweni zokubhalela. Ababhalayo balulekwe ngokuthi babeke phansi umoya bangatatazeli bafunde, bakhulume nabazali nezihlobo uma bethukile, badube okwesikhashana amafoni ukuze bangaphazamiseki.Sifisela okuhle kodwa ababhalayo. Kwabangeke benze kahle, lisekhona elinye ithuba lokuthi baphinde bazame nangonyaka ozayo. Kunezivivinyo zokuchibiyela ezibhalwa ngoJuni, minyaka yonke. Kwabaya kofuna amatoho, sibafisela inhlanhla.

"Akucaci ukuthi kubulawa umuntu owenzeni, kubani. Yingakho ngibona ukuthi nami angimane ngizihambele ngingaze ngithelwe amathonsi,'' echaza.Omunye uthe yena asisekho isidingo sokuba angafuduka ngoba egcekeni kubo sekukhishwe izidumbu ezimbili ngenhlamvu. Uthe namanje akukaboshwa muntu futhi abakaze bathole nomkhondo.Kwenzeka lokhu nje, Isolezwe lisanda kubika ngokubulawa kukaMnuz Zwelibanzi Mchunu (44) waseNtinyane, eMbumbulu, okuthiwa udutshulwe wabulawa esemzini wakhe ngoLwesibili olwedlule.Kuhlaluke ukuthi uMchunu uhlaselwe ngowesilisa ongaziwa ongabuza lutho, wamdubula washonela khona lapho.Indodakazi kamufi, uNksz Slindile Mchunu, ikhuluma neSolezwe ngesigameko, izwakalise ukushaqeka ngesihluku okubulawe ngaso uyise.Kuthiwa bangaphezulu kwabangu-20 abantu baseMbumbulu ababulawe ngokudutshulwa esikhathini esingangonyaka.Ngenxa yokudideka kuke kwaba nesikhathi lapho abantu bakule ndawo babecabanga ukuthi izigameko zokugobhoza kwegazi zimayelana nokwebiwa kwemfuyo. Kodwa-ke ngokuhamba kwesikhathi kuchithiwe lokho.Phambilini, kuke kwaduma ukuthi bonke abendiselwa koyisemkhulu bathola imiyalezo ebasongelayo ngaphambi kokuba basocongwe. Nokho-ke akubikwanga okufanayo odabeni lukaKhomo obulawe ngoMgqibelo.
BAZOLUBIKELA uNkulunkulu usizi ababhekene nalo abesifazane abasembonini yokungcwaba. Lokhu kuzokwenzeka kwindumezulu yomkhuleko abazokuba nawo ngo-Okthoba 28, ehholo elikwa-G, KwaMashu, enyakatho yeTheku.Inhlosongqangi yalolu hlobo lomkhuleko kuhlalukile ukuthi ukuzobikela uNkulunkulu ngezingqinamba ezahlukene abesifazane abakule mboni ababhekene nazo. Umhleli walo mkhuleko nguNksz Busisiwe Zondi webandla iBantu Methodist Church of Southern Africa ngaphansi kwesiFunda iBMC KwaZulu-Natal Coastal. Utshele Isolezwe ukuthi ufikelwe umbono ojulile wokuba kuhlelwe lolu hlobo lo mkhuleko.''Ngifikelwe umbono wokuba bahlanganiswe bonke abesifazane abasembonini yokungcwaba, bese sibikela uNkulunkulu ngazo zonke izingqinamba ababhekana nazo kulo msebenzi abawenzayo. Lokhu kwangifikela ngemuva kokuba ngangikade nginabo komunye umcimbi base bezwakalisa izinkinga abaye bebe nazo kulo mkhakha abakuwona,''echaza.Eqhuba uthe empeleni wayekade ehambele isigcawu semboni yabangcwabi esasihlanganisa nabo abesifazane abakule mboni. ''Ngesikhathi kuqhubeka lesi sigcawu ngakuqaphela kakhulu ubuhlungu abesifazane abazithola bebhekana nabo ngaso sonke isikhathi,'' echaza.Phakathi kokunye athe wakuthola futhi wakuqaphela ukuthi iningi lalaba besifazane bazithola bebhekene nengwadla kwezezimali. Uthi wathola nokuthi ukungcwaba abantu abehlukene njalo ngezimpelasonto kugcina kubagqilaza nabo ngokwesimo somqondo."Ngathola ukuthi laba besifazane abanabo abantu abakwazi ukuhlala nabo phansi bababikele ngosizi ababhekene nalo kule mboni. Khumbula phela ukuthi lapha sikhuluma ngabantu besifazane kodwa abenza umsebenzi obucayi ngalolu hlobo, angeke ke kungazweli kubona,'' usho kanjena.Uthe wabe esebona kumqoka kakhulu ukuba kwenziwe lo mkhuleko ngethemba elikhulu lokuthi bazokuthola ukulapheka ngokomphefumulo ngemuva kwale nkonzo."Sihlose ukuthi lo mkhuleko ubelaphe amanxeba. Ngokwethemba uNkulunkulu siyazi ukuthi nakanjani lokho kuzokwenzeka,''echaza.Yize ke lona kungumkhuleko wabesifazane abasembonini yokungcwaba kodwa uthe bakubhekile nokuthi babe khona nabesifazane abasemabhizinisini ehlukile. Uveze ukuthi umkhuleko uzobe ubusiswe ukubakhona kwabesifazane abanohlonze abazokwethula izinkulumo baphinde bashumayela iZwi likaNkulunkulu.Phakathi kwabo ubalule igama likaMfu Thabile Nkosana webandla i-Apostolic Faith Mission of Southern Africa (AFMSA), uMfu Siwe Ndlovu kanye neNdlovukazi uMapule Mchunu. Lo mkhuleko uthe bawethe elokuthi yiWomen in Funeral Business Prayer.

KULINDELEKE ukuthi kusebenze imali engaphezu kukaR110 million ngokulungisa isakhiwo sesiShayamthetho esisoLundi, enyakatho yeKwaZulu-Natal, okwathikamezeka ukusebenza kwaso ngenkathi sicekelwa phansi yisiphepho esahlasela esifundazweni.Lokho kudalulwe nguNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal uMnuz Thami Ntuli esithangamini nabezindaba ebesikuso lesi siShayamthetho ngoLwesihlanu, lapho yena nethimba abambisene nalo eliholwa nguMphathiswa woMnyango wemiSebenzi kaHulumeni noKwakha uMnuz Martin Meyer noMphathiswa woMnyango wokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, bethule ngokusemthethweni usonkontileka ozokwengamela ukulungisa lesi sakhiwo.UNdunankulu uthe kumanje sebevele banayo imali engaphezudlwana kukaR20 million, ezosetshenziswa ukulungisa uphahla lwesakhiwo ukusiza ukuthi sivikeleke emvuleni, kulungiswe nezinye izinto, nomsebenzi uqhubeke kahle. "Sibheke ukuthi lokho kube sekuqediwe ngoMeyi ngonyaka ozayo, bese kuqhubeka ezinye izinhlelo zokulungisa omunye umonakalo owadaleka ngenkathi sicekeleka phansi, esibheke ukuthi uma konke kuhambe kahle kube sekuqediwe ukusilungisa ekupheleni konyaka ozayo, bese kuqhubeka umsebenzi wokusebenza kwaso njengoba siwusizo kakhulu uma kuhlangana izinhlaka zikahulumeni iminyango yazo ewu-13 ukuqhuba umsebenzi wokubeka eqhulwini inhlakalakahle nentuthuko yomphakathi esibhekele ukuwuhola,” kusho uNdunankulu.Eqhuba, ukhale ngomphakathi wakule ndawo ngesenzo sokuthi ungasinaki isiShayamthetho, futhi ube nesandla ekusicekeleni phansi kakhulu kunalokho esiyikhona manje."Ngakho siyakhuza ukuthi umphakathi uyeke okungalungile okwenzayo njengokuthi uvumele imfuyo ingene emagcekeni esakhiwo, ingcolise igceke laso nokunye okukhona kuso, ngoba lokho kusibuyisela emuva futhi kwenza sithikamezeke ohlelweni lwethu. Ngakho siyanxusa ukuthi umphakathi ukhuzane ezimeni ezinjalo ukuze nathi sikhuthale ukuqhubeka siwubeke eqhulwini ngokuwuthuthukisa,” usho kanje.UMphathiswa woMnyango wemiSebenzi kaHulumeni noKwakha, uMnuz Martin Meyer, uthe enye yezinto ezenze babona kumqoka ukuthi balungise isakhiwo wukuthi bayaqonda ukuthi sineqhaza elingakanani emphakathini, nomlando waso."Lesi sakhiwo sineminyaka engu-42 sikhona ngakho bekusiphatha kabi ukusibona singasebenzi emva kokucekeleka phansi, yingakho sibone kumqoka ukuthi senze uhlelo olunjena lokusilungisa noluzosiza ukuthi siqhubeke sisebenze ngendlela efanele, futhi kulondolozeke nomlando waso omqoka ezweni lethu,” kusho uMeyer.

OWESILISA obhekene necala lokudlwengula nokubulala owesifazane owayekhulelwe amawele uyakuvuma ukuthi walala naye lo wesifazane.Ummangalelwa, uMnuz Ndabenhle Lindokuhle Majola, usolwa ngokudlwengula abulale umufi, uNksz Inam Tshakeni (20).Kuvela ukuthi umufi wayekade ehambele indawo yobumnandi eseReservoir Hills, ngoJulayi 13, wonyaka owedlule.Kuvela ukuthi kwathi umufi uma efika kule ndawo wase ehlangana nommangalelwa. Kuthiwa ummangalelwa wagcina ebonakala ephuma ehamba naye umufi emfaka emotweni yakhe iFord Ranger.Ngemuva kwezinsuku eziyisikhombisa, kuthiwa kwatholakala isidumbu sikaNksz Tshakeni silahliwe eCanelands, eVerulam, siphuke sakufahlaka izingalo nezinyawo. UMajola wakhalelwa ngamasongo kaSigonyela ngemuva kokuba ezifikele mathupha kule ndawo yobumnandi ngemuva kokuba sekutholwe isidumbu.Kuthiwa kwathi uma efika, umnikazi wendawo waqaphela ukuthi uyilo mlisa ambone kwikhamera yendawo yebhizinisi ehamba noNksz Tshakeni. Kuthiwa wavala amasango wangena ngaphakathi wase ebiza amaphoyisa. UMajola ungaphakathi njengoba inkantolo yamnqabela ibheyili.Izolo, eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini, kufundwe isitatimende sikammangalelwa. Kusona uyavuma ukuthi walala nomufi kodwa uyakuphika okocansi lwendluzula. Uthe baya ocansini ngokuvumelana, bezitika ngalo emotweni."Ngiyavuma ukuthi salala nomufi kodwa ngiyakuphika ukuthi ngamdlwengula,'' usho kanjena esitatimendeni.Kulindeleke ukuthi uMajola athule ubufakazi bakhe kusasa, lapho okubhekwe ukuba achaze kabanzi ngokwenzeka ngelanga lesigameko.Ummangalelwa ucele iJaji uBrenda Sibiya ukuba limnikeze ithuba lokuthi kube khona akubuyekezayo nommeli wakhe ngaphambi kokuba angene ebhokisini lofakazi.UMajola wenze lesi sicelo ngemuva kokuba bekukade kulindeleke ukuthi angene ebhokisini khona izolo, nokho washaya ungqimphothwe ekhala ngokuthi akakulungele, ufisa ukuqala akhulume nommeli wakhe.Ijaji lithe kumele lifinyelele emaphethelweni manje leli cala, kuphume nesinqumo. Libe selimdonsa ngendlebe uMajola limtshela ukuthi ngeke lisaphinde limnikeze elinye ithuba.''Leli yithuba lokugcina ngci engikunikeza lona manje. Kufanele ungene ebhokisini ukhulume okwaziyo. Ngizokunikeza igunya okwamanje ukuthi ungangeni namhlanje kodwa lokhu makugcine namhlanje," kusho iJaji.Ngaleso sikhathi ummangalelwa ubebonakala njengomuntu odidekile. Ubedane ebonakala ekhuluma nommeli wakhe, uMnuz Patrick Mkhumbuzi. Umshushisi uMacdonalds uveze ukuthi ohlangothini loMbuso sebeqedile, sebezolinda isinqumo senkantolo.
