UShangase (33) waboshwa nomngani wakhe uThalente Mkhize (36) babekwa uxhaxha lwamacala. Phambilini kuyona le nkantolo kwavela inqwaba yamagama abantu okusolakala ukuthi babulawa yilaba ababili.Emacaleni angu-28 kwavela ukuthi babhekene nangu-15 okubulala. Phakathi kwezigameko abasolwa ngokuba ongqondongqondo kuzona kubalwa ukubulawa kwabantu abayisithupha esigamekweni esenzeka eMawoti, eNanda ngo-2022.Kuleso sigameko kwadutshulwa kwabulawa uWandile Fanaphi (17), Qaphelani Mkhovu (20), Mlondi Getane (22), Mlondi Kunene (25) Phillip Hansa (25) kanye noLindo Sphambo (22).UFanaphi noMkhovu ngesikhathi bedutshulwa babefunda umatric. Lezi zinkabi ziphinde zisolwe ngokusocongwa kukasomabhizinisi wase-Overport, uMnuz Zeyn Moideen owadutshulwa emgwaqweni uBrickfield ngo-2022.Basolwa nangokuthi baphinde badubula babulala umakhelwane walo somabhizinisi, uShaheed Moodel nokuthiwa kwenzeka ngaphambi kokuba kusocongwe usomabhizinisi. Ngosuku olufanayo basolwa nangokuthi bazama ukubulala owesilisa wakwaSibisi ohlala eNtuzuma. Kuvela nokuthi ngo-2021 bathumba uMnuz Phakamani Cwele bamsusa eNanda baze bayombulalela oLwandle Drive KwaDabeka.Basolwa nangokuthi yibona ababulala uMnuz Nhlanhla Goge eNanda ngo-Agasti 7, 2021. Yibona futhi abasolwa ngokuba ongqondongqondo ekubulaweni kukaMnuz Njabulo Bongani Shongwe noMnuz Zolani Goodman Mbuthuma nakho okwenzeka eNanda ngoSepthemba 2 ngo-2021.Kuthiwa basolwa nangokuzama ukubulala ngesikhathi bezama ukubamba inkunzi kuhlonyiwe endaweni yobumnandi eThekwini ngo-2022. Kuleso sigameko kuvela ukuthi baphuca abesilisa ababili izibhamu zohlobo lweNorinco Piston neDeashprod Rifle. Bantshontsha nezinhlamvu ezingu-66. Kuvela nokuthi kunelinye icala lapho uShangase ayehamba khona yedwa, wathatha imali angu-R140 000 esebenzisa indluzula. Ngesikhathi uShangase ekhalelwa ngamaSango kaSigonyela watholakala nezibhamu nezinhlamvu ezingu-90.
UFELE ukuthi uke waba yiphara phambilini owesilisa wakwa-K, KwaMashu, okuthiwa ushonele emtholampilo ngoMsombuluko, emva kokushaywa kanzima yizihlobo zakhe ngeSonto, zimfuna isibhamu "esebiwe". UMnuz Sphiwe "Mapi" Ndlanzi (39) kuthiwa ushonele emtholampilo iPoly, emva kokungeniswa khona onogada, abazithele phezu kwakhe esongwe ngengubo yokulala emgwaqweni oseduze nalesi sikhungo. Ngokusho kukadadewabo, uNksz Nomaswazi Ndlanzi, umufi uhlaselwe wumzala wakhe nezingane zakhe ezimbili, abanomuzi esigcemeni esifanayo. Elandisa ngesigameko, uthe umufi wayekade eziyele emngcwabeni lapho ayephethe khona uhlelo lomngcwabo, wabuya wayoxoxa nabangani bakhe ngaphandle komuzi.Uthe bathi besahleli lapho, kwaqhamuka umzala wakhe ngemoto, wayimisa bancokola kancane nomufi, wase esuka ehamba. "Emva kwesikhathi wabuya eseshunqa, ebuza uMapi ukuthi siphi isibhamu sakhe? Kuthiwa wathi uma emtshela ukuthi akasazi, bamshova emotweni, bahamba naye,” kusho uNksz Ndlanzi. Uthe konke lokhu kwenzeka nabo bayayizwa inkulumo ngoba konke lokhu kwenzeka ebangeni elingaqhelile nekhaya, wathi bathola ukuthi baya naye ekhaya labo, bafike bamkhumulisa, base bemshaya ngezikhali ezehlukene.Kuzona ubale ifosholo, insimbi yokujima, induku yegalofu, imvubu, baphinde bamvala ubuso ngo-plastiki. "Ngenxa yokushaywa, wagcina ethi usinike udadewethu omdala isibhamu, owabe esebizelwa endaweni yesigameko ukuzochaza,” kusho yena.Uthe udadewabo wafike washo ukuthi akulona iqiniso okushiwo umufi, maqede abasolwa bangavuma ukuthi aqhubeke ahlale, wathi lona wesifazane wabe esefonela esinye isihlobo sesilisa ukuba sihambe siyokhuza, nathe saya, samfica eselimele kakhulu kunakuqala umufi. "Kusona kuthiwa wathi usifake kwi-suit cover, sathi uma simbuzisisa kahle, wathi usemane uyasivuma nje isibhamu ngoba ezama ukuhlenga impilo yakhe. Lesi sihlobo sagcina sihamba naso njengoba kuthiwa base bejikela sona abasolwa,” usho kanje. Ubalule nokuthi nabangani bakhe abangena kancane endaweni yesigameko, bethi bayolamula, behluleka, baphuma behlehla bebona ukuthi abasolwa kabamnike thuba umufi, wathi phakathi kwalaba abaya endaweni yesigameko bakhona abathinta amaphoyisa kodwa agcina engafikanga. "Sithole ukuthi bathi uma sebebona ukuthi sebemlimaze kakhulu, bamsonga ngoblankethi, bayomlahla emgwaqweni ongasePoly khona ebusuku. Kuthiwa labonakala iPolo (imoto) loyedwa wabasolwa lidlula ngakhona ligijima kodwa wangaba bikho onakisisayo ngaleso sikhathi,” kusho uNksz Ndlanzi.Uthe umfowabo waze watholwa onogada ekuseni ngezikhathi zokungena nokuphuma kwabanye emsebenzini kulesi sikhungo.Bamngenisa ngaphakathi ukuze athole usizo, nokho kwamenela ngezithuba zasemini. Uthe wayephuke inqwaba yamalungu omzimba, ikhanda libokozela laze laba nembobo namazinyo ephume wonke, waveza nokuthi ngesikhathi udadewabo omdala efonela umzala ngakusasa ekuseni, embuza ukuthi uphelelephi uMapi, waphendula ngelithi uthathwe ngamaphoyisa amyisa emtholampilo. "Siyazi ukuthi akulona iqiniso leli ngoba amaphoyisa ayengeke athathe umuntu olimele kanjeyana ayomtshinga eduze komtholampilo esikhundleni sokumngenisa phakathi,” usho kanje. Uqhube wathi kumangale wonke umuntu, sekuvela umnikazi weshibhi ebuza ukuthi yisiphi isibhamu umzala abemshayela sona uMapi ngoba nasi isibhamu sakhe kuyena, wasithatha ngeSonto, ngesikhathi ethi akambekele sona ngoba yena uzibona esephuze kakhulu. Uthe basola ukuthi nakuba ebeseshintshile umufi, engaselona iphara, abasolwa bebesambona eyilo.Echaza ngomlando kamufi nezidakamizwa, uthe ubesezisebenzise cishe iminyaka engu-18, wathi kodwa ngoMashi nonyaka, uqale uhambo lokushintsha ngohlelo lwebandla, iPrayer Assembly. "Uhlale ngaphakathi esontweni, bemkhuculula izidakamizwa kusuka ngoMashi, waze waphuma ekupheleni kukaJuni, wabuyela ekhaya. Kusukela lapho, ubesengumuntu oshintshile, eseshabasheka emsebenzini wokulekelela abanye abanenkinga efanayo ngohlelo lwesonto,” kubeka uNksz Ndlanzi.Uthe abaningi ebebembona okokuqala esephendukile, bebephika balale ngomhlane uma betshelwa ukuthi ubuya ekubeni yiphara. Ubengasabonakali. "Ubuhlungu esibuzwayo siwumndeni abuchazeki, umphakathi nawo awukholwa ukuthi ubulawe ngesihluku futhi udiniwe. Wonke umuntu ubuza ukuthi usebulawa ngesihluku ngesikhathi lapho eseshintshile nje, yini? Siphucwe ithuba lokuhlala naye esewumuntu ongcono,” usho kanje. Uthe nangesikhathi eseyiphara ubengahluphi ngobugebengu obunendluzula kodwa ubenolimi olukwazi ukukhohlisa umuntu, azikhiphele yena imali ephaketheni, wathi abukho ubutha obebukhona phakathi komndeni wabo nowabasolwa, kangangokuthi ngesikhathi beshonelwe unina ngo-2019, umzala wuye owayephethe uhlelo lomngcwabo."Abantu babuza ukuthi useyibulala kanjani ingane yalowo muntu,” kukhala uNksz Ndlanzi. Uthe abakubheke ngecala ubulungiswa, abasolwa athe baboshwe ngoLwesibili, bajeze ngesenzo sabo, bangayitholi nebheyili. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uCaptain Ntathu Ndlovu, uthe amaphoyisa aKwaMashu aphenya icala lokubulala kulandela isigameko lapho owesilisa (39) eshonele emtholampilo ngoMsombuluko. "Umufi kuthiwa wathathwa ngabantu abangaziwa, bamyisa emtholampilo elimele, wagcina ngokushona. Uphenyo luveza ukuthi ngaphambi kokuba ashone umufi ushaywe kanzima abantu abangaziwa emgwaqweni uNkankane kwa-K, KwaMashu,” kusho uCapt Ndlovu. Uqhube wathi imbangela yokushaya ayikaziwa okwamanje.
LIHLEHLELE uNovemba 27 nonyaka icala lowesifazane osolwa ngokubulala ngesihluku ingane yakwamakhelwane wakhe kwa-Q, eMlaza efuna u-R60 000. Umsolwa, uNksz Sibongile Ngwadla (39), ubevele izolo eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMlaza ngecala lokubulala ingane yomfana, uNtobeko Xaba (5).UNksz Ngwadla, kuthiwa wenza umuga wokusonta umufi intamo aze ashone ehlala emjondolo oseduze kwakubo (kamufi). Kuthiwa usonta umufi intamo nje, wayekade ethumele umyalezo kunina wathi akamfakele u-R60 000 uma efuna ingane yakhe ibuye iphila. Kwavela ukuthi wayenezihlobo eMalukazi, okwavela ukuthi waqale wabalekela kuzo emva kokwenza isigameko, kwayima ebalekela lapho adabuka khona eMzimkhulu, nokuyilapho amaphoyisa ambhadama khona. IMantshi uKheswa, ihlehlise icala emva kokuthi uMshushisi woMbuso, uMnuz Lungelo Mkhithi, eveze ukuthi kusekhona ubufakazi obusashoda.Phakathi kwabo uthe kusashoda umbiko wokuhlolwa kwesidumbu kanjalo nezinye izitatimende. Kulesi sigameko umsolwa kuthiwa waqale wamthumba umufi ngo-Agasti 22, 2025. Kuthiwa wambulala ngakusasa, wase eyomlahla emhosheni ongaphansi kwebhuloho eliphakathi kwesigceme sakwa-Q no-U. Isidumbu sakhe esase sonakele, saze satholwa ngo-Agasti 28, 2025 emva kokuthi umsolwa esikhombe eqhutshwa amaphoyisa.
ABEKHOMISHINI kaMadlanga sebezomemezela kusasele izinsuku ezintathu uma bezobiza ufakazi ozokwethula ubufakazi bakhe esithe.Lokhu kushiwo u-Advocate Matthew Chaskalson SC, emva kokuba kuvele ukuthi abemithombo yezindaba ngeke besaqhubeka nokuphikisa ukuthi ufakazi ethule ubufakazi bakhe esithe.Ngasekuqaleni kwesonto, abemithombo yezindaba abambalwa, bafake isicelo sokuthi ufakazi obizwa ngo-X abethule esidlangalaleni ubufakazi bakhe ukuze bulalelwe yiwo wonke umuntu. Nokho ikhomishini ibinombono ohlukile kunalona, njengoba ithe lo fakazi uphethe ubufakazi obubucayi okungabeka impilo yakhe engcupheni uma ezofakaza esidlangalaleni. Iphinde yabeka ukuthi ubufakazi bakhe buyingxenye yophenyo olungakayi phambi kwenkantolo nokungaphazamisa uphenyo lwamaphoyisa uma luvezwa esidlangalaleni. Ekhuluma izolo ekuseni, uChaskalson uthe uphenyo lwamaphoyisa oluthinta ufakazi u-X selusesigabeni esiphezulu nokwenza kube nzima ukuthi banganeka lolo lwazi esidlangalaleni. "Uma senza lokho sizobe sibeka engcupheni uphenyo lwamaphoyisa oluqhubekayo,” kusho uChaskalson.Uthe lo fakazi kulindeleke ukuthi athule ubufakazi bakhe esithe nanamuhla, wathembisa ukuthi njengoba ikhomishini isaqhubeka, ngeke besalenza iphutha lokuthi basho sekusele isikhathi esifishane ngaphambi kokuthi aqale ukwethula ubufakazi bakhe ufakazi ukuthi uzobethula esithe. "Sizokubika lokhu kusasele amahora angu-72 ngaphambi kokuthi ufakazi eze azofakaza. Sithemba ukuthi lokho kuzoba umbono omuhle kuwo wonke umuntu,” usho kanje. Uthembise ukuthi uma sekudlulisile uphenyo lwamaphoyisa, kungasekho ukukhathazeka kokuthi ukuvezwa kobufakazi kuzophazamisa uphenyo lwamaphoyisa, konke okuzovezwa ilo fakazi kwikhomishini kuzovezwa esidlangalaleni.
UMBIKO woMcwaningi Mabhuku Jikelele, uNksz Tsakani Maluleke, uveze ukuthi u-95% wesabelomali saKwaZulu-Natal, usezandleni ezingaphephile njengoba uphethwe iminyango ehlulekayo ukulandela imigomo ebekelwe ukusebenza kwemali yomphakathi.Umbiko uveze ukuthi iminyango kahulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal eyabelwa u-95% wesabelomali sesifundazwe esingu-R158 billion yehlulekile ukuthola imibiko engenagcobho ngesikhathi kucwaningwa amabhuku angonyakamali owedlule.Umbiko kaNksz Maluleke owethulwe esiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal, izolo, udwebe isithombe esingesihle ngokuphathwa kwenkece esifundazweni njengoba sehlile isibalo seminyango ethole imibiko engenagcobho.UNksz Maluleke uthe iminyango ethole imibiko engenagcobho yabelwa u-5% wesabelomali sesifundazwe."Lokhu kusho ukuthi imali eningi iphethwe iminyango ehlulekayo ukulandela imigomo ebekelwe ukusetshenziswa kwemali. Lena yiminyango ehlulekayo ukusebenza ngokwethembeka."UNksz Maluleke uthe iminyango ethola u-75% wesabelomali, owezeMpilo, nowezeMfundo, iyaqhubeka nokuphefumula ngenxeba."Le minyango iyehluleka ukulandela imigomo ebekelwe ukusebenza kwemali. Sekuneminyaka uMnyango wezeMfundo uthola imibiko engemihle. Lo mnyango ubhekene nenkinga yemali, usebenzise isabelo sawo ngokweqile ngo-R500 million."UMnyango wezeMpilo nawo uthole umbiko ongemuhle. Umnyango uyehluleka ukulandela imigomo ebekelwe ukusebenzisa imali futhi umnyango uyahluleka ukunakekela impahla nengqalasizinda yawo."UNksz Maluleke uthe uMnyango wezokuThutha nokuHlaliswa kwaBantu, uyehluleka ukugcina izethembiso ozenza ekuqaleni konyakamali, wathi ukungalandelwa kwemithetho yokusebenza kwemali ikhona okuholela ekutheni lo mnyango ugcine uhluleka ukufeza izethembiso."Ukwehluleka komnyango ukulandela imigomo kwenza ukuthi umnyango ulahlekelwe imali. Umnyango uyahluleka ukugcina izethembiso osuke uzenze ekuqaleni konyaka wezimali."UMphathiswa wezeziMali KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Francois Rodgers, uthe kufanele bathathelwe izinyathelo labo abangayilandeli imithetho.URodgers uthe umnyango wakhe usuqhamuke nohlelo lezobuchwepheshe lokukhishwa kwamathenda."Inkinga enkulu ilapha emathendeni. Le nkinga ihlasele iminyango eminingi kanye nezinye izifundazwe. Yingakho siqhamuka nohlelo lwezobuchwepheshe lokukhipha amathenda. Yonke into izokwenziwa ngezobuchwepheshe. Lokhu kuzonciphisa inkohlakalo njengoba kuzokube kungesebona abantu abazokube beqoka izinkampani ezizonikwa amathenda."Ilungu le-MK, uMnuz Sthembiso Magubane, lithe kufanele kuqhanyukwe nezindlela zokunqanda osopolitiki ukuba bagxambukele ekukhishweni kwamathenda."Inkinga enkulu idalwa ukugxambukela kosopolitiki. Osopolitiki yibona abalawulayo, abashoyo ukuthi amathenda kufanele anikezwe ziphi izinkampani. Izikhulu ziyasaba ukuphikisana nosopolitiki ngoba ziyazi ukuthi zizoxoshwa emsebenzini."
UNGQONGQOSHE wezamaPhoyisa omisiwe, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, ubhakele wathi walichitha ngokusemthethweni ithimba lamaphoyisa eliphenya ukubulawa kosopolitiki KwaZulu-Natal, hhayi ngezizathu zokukhohlakala. UMchunu uchithe izinsolo zokuthi akanawo amandla okuhlakaza ithimba, nokuthi wathi akuhlakazwe ithimba ngoba nakhu evikela abantu asondelene nabo ababephenywa yithimba. Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi evele phambi kwekomiti lasePhalamende elikhethekile, izolo.UMchunu uthe walandela umthetho ngesikhathi ethatha isinqumo sokuhlakaza ithimba, wathi umthetho uyamgunyaza ukuba akhiphe umyalelo wokuba kuhlakazwe. UKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, wayamanisa uMchunu nosomabhizinisi oboshelwe uxhaxha lwamacala, uMnuz Vusumuzi "Cat" Matlala. Kepha uMchunu uthe akasiyena umngani wezigebengu.Ubufakazi bukhombisa ukuthi uMatlala uxhumana naloyo uMchunu amchaza njengeqabane lakhe, uMnuz Brown Mogotsi. UMogotsi kuthiwa wathumela uMatlala incwadi kaMchunu ekhipha umyalelo wokuba kuhlakazwe ithimba. UMchunu akazi ukuthi uMogotsi wayithola kanjani le ncwadi."Angikaze ngikhulume noMogotsi ngokuhlakazwa kwethimba. Angazi ukuthi wayithola kanjani le ncwadi lapho khona ngangikhipha umyalelo wokuba kuhlakazwe ithimba. Uyena okufanele achaze ngale nto. Iyangikhathaza le nto. Le ncwadi kwakungafanele ukuba iputshuke."UMchunu utshele amalungu ekomiti ukuthi ithimba belisebenza ngokungekho emthethweni, wathi ithimba kufanele engabe lagcina ukusebenza ngo-2022.UMchunu uthe ngesikhathi ithimba lisungulwa kwakuhlelwe ukuthi lisebenze izinyanga eziyisithupha kuphela.Uthe ithimba lalilokhu lilulelwa isikhathi sokusebenza kwaze kwaba u-2022, wathi emva kwalokho asibange sisalulwa isikhathi sokusebenza kwethimba."Into ebeyenzeka ukuthi kwakufika izicelo zokuthi ithimba labelwe enye imali kodwa akukho okwakusho ukuthi ithimba lilulelwe isikhathi. Le nto iphambene nomthetho wokuphathwa kwemali iPFMA (Public Finance Management Act). Awukwazi ukuqhubeka unikeze imali ithimba njengoba ingekho into elilulela isikhathi. Ingakuqhatha ikuqede le nto uma ungase ubizwe ukuthi uzoyichaza phambi kweScopa (ikomiti elibhekelele ukusebenza kwemali yomphakathi), iStanding Committee on Public Accounts."UMchunu uthe wanquma ukuthi ithimba lihlakazwe ngenxa yokuthi kwase kunohlelo lokuba kusungulwe uphiko oluzophenya onke amacala okubulawa kwabantu kuzwelonke.UMchunu uthe nakuba ithimba lalenza umsebenzi oncomekayo inkinga ukuthi laliphenya amacala okubulawa kosopolitiki namakhosi kuphela futhi laliphenya amacala enzeka esifundazweni esisodwa."Abantu bayafa nakwezinye izingxenye zezwe. Asikwazi ukugxila ekubulaweni kosopolitiki namakhosi kuphela. Yingakho kwakunohlelo lokuthi sibe nophiko oluzovikela bonke abantu. Angilidleli umona ithimba kodwa iqiniso ukuthi abantu bayabulawa kulo lonke izwe. Angisalali ngisho ebusuku ngenxa yobugebengu."UMchunu uthe ngokwezibalo zokubulawa kwabantu akusibona osopolitiki ababulawa kwakhulu."Izibalo zikhombisa ukuthi abantu ababulawa kakhulu bangaphansi kwesigaba sokubulawa okuhleliwe. Isibalo sabo u-35%, bese kuthi ukubulawa kwabamatekisi khona kube u-34%. Ukubulawa kosopolitiki khona kungu-24%."UMchunu uthe ngesikhathi eqokwa njengongqongqoshe womnyango ngonyaka owedlule, kwakuvele kunocwaningo olwaluphakamisa ukuthi ithimba lihlakakzwe.UMchunu uthe lolu cwaningo lwenziwa ngo-2019."Kwasekuqaleni vele ithimba kwakuyinto yesikhashana. Kwakungafanele ithimba lihlale unomphela, kwakufanele lihlakazwe uma seliwenzile umsebenzi walo."UMchunu uthe ukugcinwa kwethimba bekudla umnyango izigidi zamarandi."Iqiniso ukuthi izakhiwo eziningi eziteshini zamaphoyisa zishayisa ngamahloni. Kuyinto embi ukuthi izigidi zamarandi zilokhu zabelwa ithimba ekubeni iziteshi zamaphoyisa zingalungiswa."UMchunu uthe ngesikhathi eqokwa wathola izikhalazo kubantu abaningi abacela ukuthi kuhlakazwe ithimba.Uthe phakathi kwabantu abambhalela umhlaziyi wobugebengu, uSolwazi Mary De Haas nojwayele ukubhala ngenkohlakalo eyenzeka emaphoyiseni, uNksz Patricia Mashele.UMchunu uthe ababembhalela babekhalaza ngokusebenza kwethimba.Bekungokokuqala uMchunu ethola ithuba lokuziphendulela.UMchunu ukhombise ukuba magange ukuziphendulela engafuni nokuthi amalungu athathe ikhefu lokulula izinyawo. Utshele amalungu ekomiti ukuthi kade alulinda lolu suku."Selokhu uMkhwanazi enza izinsolo, mina nginuka uMkhwanazi. Nezimpahla engizigqokile zinuka uMkhwanazi. Kuningi uMkhwanazi akushilo ngami. Ingakho nami ngifuna ukulisebenzisa leli thuba engilinikiwe ukuba ngiziphendulele."UMchunu uzoqhubeka nokuthula ubufakazi namuhla.
Umsolwa oneminyaka engu-20 ubudala obefunelwa icala lokubulala owesilisa owadutshulwa wabulawa ebhulohweni elikuSiyanda Road eWiggins ngomhlaka-12 Okthoba 2025 udutshulwe walimala kabi ngesikhathi sokudubulana namaphoyisa ngoLwesine ntambama. Amaphoyisa enze umkhankaso wobunhloli owaholele endaweni ehlala abantu kuDark Road, eWiggins, eCato Manor, lapho kukholakala ukuthi umsolwa obefunwa uthuli ubecashe khona. Ngesikhathi amaphoyisa esezongena emagcekeni, umsolwa uvulele ngenhlamvu ebhekise emaphoyiseni amaphoyisa aphindisela ngenhlamvu, kwaqubuka uthuthuva. Ngesikhathi kudutshulwana umsolwa udutshulwe wafa. Umsolwa utholwe nesibhamu nezinhlamvu ezine. Ngaphandle kwecala lokubulala uWiggins, umsolwa ubefunelwa uxhaxha lwamacala okugebenga izindlu namabhizinisi okusolakala ukuthi uwenza endaweni yaseCato Manor. Phambilini uke waboshelwa amacala okutholakala nesibhamu esingekho emthethweni ngo-2024 nelokuzama ukubulala ngo-2023. Umsolwa oshonile uke walahlwa yicala lokushaya ngenhloso yokulimaza. Alikho iphoyisa elilimale ngesikhathi sokudubulana.
IZIKHULU zeminyango kahulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal ezithatha ngozwane emalini yokuhambisa izidingo zehlise ngemilenze izigidi zamarandi kunyakamali owedlule.Umbiko wePublic Service Commission (PSC) uveze ukuthi izikhulu zeminyango ezixebula umkhoma emalini kahulumeni zibhubhudle u-R556 million kunyakamali u-2024/2025.Lo mbiko wethulwe emhlanganweni wekomiti elibhekele ukusebenza kwemali yomphakathi esiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal, iStanding Committee on Public Accounts (Scopa), izolo.Iphini lomqondisi wePSC KwaZulu-Natal, uNksz Yoliswa Mtshali, lithe kunezikhulu zeminyango ehlukene KwaZulu-Natal ezingu-74 ezibhekene namacala okusetshenziswa kwemali ngendlela engafanele."Esikhathini esiningi imbangela yokuba iminyango igcine isilahlekelwa yimali engaka wubudedengu kubasebenzi. Kwesinye isikhathi kuba nje wukukhohlakala, ukweba kanye nokusetshenziswa budedengu kwempahla kahulumeni. La macala asho ukuthi imali obekufanele ukuba isetshenziselwe ukuhambisana izidingo kubantu yehliswa ngemilenze. Inkulu kakhulu imali elahlekile. Awukho umnyango osukwazile ukubuyisa imali elahlekile."UNksz Mtshali uthe bakuqaphelile ukuthi kuneminyango engazange izithathele izinyathelo izikhulu ezithinteka ekusetshenzisweni kwemali ngaphandle kokulandela imigomo."Kuneminyango eveze emibikweni yayo ukuthi kunemali esebenze ngaphandle kokulandelwa kwemigomo kodwa uma ubheka abekho abantu abathathelwe izinyathelo. Lokhu kuphambene nokushiwo wumthetho olawula ukuphathwa kwemali iPFMA (Public Finance Management Act)."UNksz Mtshali uthe bakhathazekile nangokwanda kwezikhulu ezihlala isikhathi eside emakhaya ngenxa yokumiswa emsebenzini.UNksz Mtshali uthe izigidi zamaRandi ziphuma kuholelwa izikhulu eseziphenduke ojika nelanga.Uthe umbiko wakamumva abawutholile ukhombisa ukuthi kunezikhulu ezingu-77 KwaZulu-Natal ezimisiwe emsebenzini.Uthe imali eholelwe abantu abahleli ekhaya ingu-R43 million.UNksz Mtshali uthe udaba sebelubike kuNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, lapho bezwakalise ukungenami kwabo."Undunankulu usitshele ukuthi uwudlulisile umyalezo kubo bonke abaphethe iminyango ethintekayo, wathi uselinde umbiko. Uthembisile ukuthi izinhlelo zokuqondisa ubugwegwe zizosheshiswa. Sizogada ukuthi ikhona yini inqubekela phambili kulolu daba."UNksz Mtshali uthe bafuna ukuthi iminyango ingagijimeli ukumisa abasebenzi bese behlala isikhathi eside ekhaya."Siyaye siyigqugquzele iminyango ukuba isebenzise eminye imigudu khona kungeke kuphazamiseke ukuhanjiswa kwezidingo. Enye yezinto iminyango engayenza wukuthi umsebenzi obhekene necala ayosebenzela kwenye indawo esikhundleni sokuba amiswe. Iyinkinga eyokumiswa kwabasebenzi isikhathi eside ngoba kwesinye isikhathi iminyango igcina seyenza izinto eziphambene nemigomo."
IMBUZE ukuthi uma ingamdedela ngebheyili ikephi lapho azophuma ayohlala khona njengoba engafunwa ngisho nawumndeni, imnqabela ibheyili imantshi, owesilisa osolwa ngokubulala ngesihluku umfowabo.Umsolwa, uMnuz Mlondi Sanele Nzama (25), okuthiwa uneziqu ze-Engineering zaseMangosuthu University of Technology (MUT), ubefaka isicelo sebheyili eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMlaza, izolo. Usolwa ngokugwaza ephindelela umfowabo, uMnuz Mzamo Lungani Nzama (35), ngoSepthemba 9, nonyaka. Lesi sigameko kuthiwa senzeka ekhaya lalezi zelamani kwa-F, eMlaza.Ummeli kamsolwa obesevela okwesithathu, uNksz Dlamini, uveze ukuthi usebuye washintsha umqondo, wafuna ukufaka isicelo sebheyili.Uveze ukuthi usenalo elinye ikheli laseMzinyathi, eNanda, angaphuma ayohlala kulo uma kungenzeka adedelwe ngebheyili.Kuvele ukuthi leli kheli elalapho okuhlala khona unina obazalayo. Umshushisi, uMnuz Lungelo Mkhithi, ngesikhathi ebeka awakhe amaphuzu okuphikisa isicelo sebheyili, ubuzisise ukuthi leli kheli elishiwo nguNksz Dlamini, kungabe elalapho okuhlala khona unina wezelamani ongafune kuzwa lutho ngomsolwa?"Unina kamsolwa wayekhihla isililo ngesikhathi umsolwa egcina ukuvela enkantolo. Walibeka ngesihloko elokuthi akafune lutho oluzomhlanganisa nomsolwa, wathi ngeke akwazi ukuhlala nomsolwa emzini wakhe. Ngabe ilona lelo kheli umsolwa akhuluma ngalo?” kubuza uMkhithi.UNksz Dlamini uphendule ngokuthi unina kamsolwa angabizwa njengofakazi kulesi sicelo sebheyili, wakhuza ibhadi uMkhithi. UMkhithi ugcizelele eyokuthi ngokophenyo lwamaphoyisa, umsolwa akanalo ikheli angaphuma ayohlala kulo uma engadedelwa."Ngoba nakwelakwa-F ngeke ayohlala kulo, linofakazi, abazibonela ngawabo egwaza umufi njengoba amgwaza emini kwabha,” kusho uMkhithi.Ushayele isipikili sokugcina ebuza ukuthi uma imdedela ngebheyili inkantolo, ngabe ihlose ukudweba siphi isithombe emndenini, kofakazi nasemphakathini?Imantshi uMnuz Kheswa igcine imnqabela ibheyili. "Leli cala libucayi. Angazi kungani wakhetha ukugwaza umfowenu. Awufuneki kwa-F lapho obuhlala khona, nomama wakho oseMzinyathi, uziqhelelanisile nawe. Ngiyakunqabela ibheyili ngoba angazi uzotholakala kanjani uma usufuneka,” kusho uKheswa. Ngesikhathi uMkhithi efuna isitatimende esifungelwe esibhalwe umphenyi wecala, kuvele ukuthi ngosuku lwesigameko umufi wayehleli nabangani bakhe egcekeni ngesikhathi kufika umsolwa.Kuthiwa umufi wayekhiyile endlini njengoba umsolwa ayesanda kuntshontsha i-battery yemoto kamngani wakhe. Kuthiwa wamtshela ukuthi endlini uvalele leso sizathu. "Umsolwa akazange azihluphe ngokuphendula, wavele wahamba waya kamakhelwane, wabuya esephethe ummese, wangenela ngawo umufi,” kusho isitatimende.Kuvele ukuthi waqhubeka nokumgwaza ngisho esebaleka, kwavela nokuthi isigameko senzeka phambi kwabantu njengoba umufi wayehleli nabangani bakhe.Umufi kuthiwa washonela esibhedlela. Icala lihlehliselwe uNovemba 27.
UTHISHANHLOKO osolwa ngecala lokugwaza abulale unkosikazi wakhe ngesihluku emzini wabo oseMalvern, eThekwini, ushintshe abameli.Lokhu kuvele ngesikhathi umsolwa, uMnuz Khayelihle Dhlomo (53) evela eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini. UDhlomo usolwa ngokugwaza abulale umkakhe, naye owayenguthisha, uNkk Khanyisile Dhlomo. Izolo, kuvele ukuthi uDhlomo usezomelwa ummeli omusha, uMnuz Duma. Abameli ebebemele uDhlomo, ongumshana kasihlalo wekomiti lezeMpilo ePhalamende, uDkt Sibongiseni Dhlomo, phambilini bamlekelela efaka isicelo sebheyili. Lona wesilisa okuthiwa unguthishanhloko esikoleni iSithembile Primary, eLindelani, eThekwini, wadedelwa ngebheyili ka-R5 000. Izolo, kuvele ukuthi inkantolo ilinde ihhovisi likamqondisi wezokuShushiswa koMphakathi ukuthi lithathe isinqumo sokuthi lizoqulwa kuyiphi inkantolo. Imantshi, uMnuz Scelo Zuma, ibe isilihlehlisela uJanuwari 16, 2025, icala. Isigameko kuthiwa senzeka ngoSepthemba 2022, emzini wabo. Emva kokwenzeka kwaso, kuthiwa umsolwa watshela umndeni, izihlobo, omakhelwane namaphoyisa ukuthi umufi uzibulele ngenxa yokhwantalala. Kuthiwa umndeni wawulokhu uwashaye njalo amakhala ngalokhu, kwazise umufi wayenamanxeba angaphezu kwelilodwa. Kuthiwa wawulokhu ubuze njalo ukuthi kwenzeka kanjani ukuthi umuntu ozibulele abenamanxeba amaningi?Umsolwa ugcine ekhalelwa amasongo kaSigonyela ngoJulayi nonyaka, kulandela ukuthi idokodo lokufa kukamufi lithathwe ngolunye uphiko lwamaphoyisa olwehlukile. Kuthiwa emva kophenyo olunzulu lwaleli thimba, idokodo lokufa komuntu laguqulwa kwaba elokubulawa komuntu, maqede waboshwa umsolwa.
BANGAPHEZU kuka-100 000 abahola izibonelelo zikahulumeni KwaZulu-Natal, okusaqhubeka uhlelo lokucubungula ukuthi kumele baqhubeke yini bazihlomule noma isimo sabo sezezimali sesishintshile, akusamele bahole.Lokhu kuvezwe yikomiti loMnyango wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi ePhalamende, elivakashele kulesi sifundazwe kuleli sonto.Usihlalo wekomiti, uNksz Bridget Masango, uthe bathole umbiko ngezinto ezehlukene njengoba behambele esifundazweni. Uthe omunye wayo owophenyo oluqhubekayo lokubuyekezwa kwabangu-184, 828 abahola izibonelelo zakwaSassa esifundazweni."Sithole ukuthi kusaphothulwe uphenyo ngabangu-77, 287 kanti kusasilele abangu-107, 541. Kulolu phenyo kukhona namagama avela ohlwini lwama-credit bureau, oluveza ukuthi banezikweletu. Manje kubhekwa ukuthi ngabe isimo sabo esithinta ezezimali kasishintshile selokhu baqala ukuhola izibonelelo?" usho kanje.I-Sassa yenza lolu cwaningo nje, kwavela ukuthi abanye abahola izibonelelo bavela njengabantu abanezikweletu. Abanye bayingxenye yabantu abakuma-credit bureau, okusho ukuthi kungenzeka sebeyasebenza kodwa bayaqhubeka nokutamuza imali kahulumeni, ehlose ukusiza abahlwempu."Kutshalwe abasebenzi abangu-38 esikhungweni esigcina ulwazi ukuze babhekelele la macala alabo okubhekwa indaba yezibonelelo zabo," usho kanje.UNksz Masango, uthe bathole nombiko mayelana nokushintshwa kwendlela yokubhaliswa kwabahola izibonelelo kusetshenziswa ubuchwepheshe. "Inhloso ngukuthi yonke into kumele ihambisane nesikhathi nobuchwepheshe besimanje. Yingakho kunezinhlelo eziqhubekayo zokuthi kubhaliswe abantu kusetshenziswa ubuchwepheshe." Uveze nokuthi sekuqeqeshwe nabasebenzi ababalelwa ku-900, ohlelweni lwezobuchwepheshe emahhovisi eSassa. Namhlanje, ikomiti lihambele eThekwini lapho liqhubeka nomsebenzi walo wokuhlola isimo esifundazweni nokuzwa izikhalazo zabantu ngezithinta izibonelelo.
ISIKU-R4.4 million intengo yempahla yezinga eliphezulu yesiqumama, uNksz Shawun Mkhize, ebifakwe endalini ukuthi ithengwe ngabazizwa benamandla okubeka etafuleni imali eningi nenkulu yokuyithenga ngokushesha.Lokho kudalulwe nguMnuz Pieter Geldenhuys, umqondisi weBidders Choice, inkampani eyengamele uhlelo lokudayisa le mpahla okukhona kuyona izikhwama ezimba eqolo, ubucwebe bezinga eliphezulu nohuntshu lwemoto yohlobo iLamborghini."Kuthe kuvulwa uhlelo, zangena zilekanyana izicelo zabantu abafuna ukuthenga le mpahla," usho kanje.Uhlelo lokudayiswa kwale mpahla kaMaMakhize luza emva kwesinyathelo sophiko lwabezentela ezweni lokudla impahla yakhe ngenxa yezinsolo zokungakhokhi intela.Kuke kwaba namahemuhemu okuthi okunye kwale mpahla kaMaMkhize kuwumbombayi kepha akubanga njalo ngenkathi sekufakwa endalini, njengoba inqwaba igxume yahlala ifuna ukuthenga ubuthaphuthaphu. Sekuyisikhathi eside kuqhubeka "izinkinga" zikaMaMkhize, njengoba ebe nenkinga futhi eqenjini lakhe lebhola lezinyawo iRoyal AM, nayo okwatholakala ukuthi akaliphethe ngendlela esemthethweni ngenxa yesikweletu sika-R40 million wentela, okwaze kwaholela ekutheni likhishwe ohlwini lwamaqembu esigaba esiphezulu sebhola iPremier Soccer League.Kulindeleke ukuthi ukudayiswa kwayo yonke le mpahla kugcine kufinyelele ku-R5 million ozosetshenziswa ukukhokha ingxenye yesikweletu sentela.Izolo ekuseni bekumi kanjena intengo yempahla ebithengiswa;- Imoto i-Lamborghini Urus yango-2021 ibihleli ku-R4.3 million, kanti futhi isenganyuka ize ifinyelele ku-R8 million.- Isikhwama se-Louis Vuitton ebese sibiza u-R20 500.- Ama-suitcase amabili eLouis Vuitton Zephyr abiza u-R46 000 womabili.- Isikhwamaa seGucci Floral Ophidisa esibiza u-R11 000, esingagcina sinyukela ku-R19 000.- Isikhwama sabesifazane seSaint Laurent Icare Maxi esibizwa u-R29 000. - Isikhwama sabesifazane seGoyard Red Villette French Bulldog esibiza u-R14 000. "Sesithathe zonke izikhwama ezifakwe endalini ukuzihlola nokubheka ukuthi konke kusesimweni esifanele yini ngazo andukuba zidayiswe kulaba abazifunayo abaqhamuka ezweni lonke ngisho nakoRustenburg naseBloemfontein," kusho uGeldenhuys.
KUBE nomuzwa wenjabulo emndenini wowayengumphathi siteshi samaphoyisa eNdwedwe, ukuzwa ukuthi oyedwa wabasolwa abathelwe othulini ngesikhathi idudulana namaphoyisa eWaterfall, eHillcrest, izolo, ngowayethinteka ekubulaweni kukamufi. Isigameko sokubulawa kukamphathi siteshi, uLieutenant Colonel Jabulani Ndawonde (56), senzeka ngoMeyi 2021. Wahlaselwa abantu ababehamba ngeloli elincane lokuthwala impahla, okuthiwa ababephakathi bavele bavulela ngenhlamvu bebhekise emotweni kamufi ngesikhathi bedlula eduze kwayo ihamba ngaserenki yamatekisi eBhamshela. Kuthiwa umufi wayeshayela imoto yakhe ngabo-6.30 sekuhwalala, ephuma emsebenzini ebheke ekhaya. Waphelela endaweni yesigameko. Ephawula ngalokhu umfowabo, uMnuz Mbuso Ndawonde, uthe uthole ucingo emaphoyiseni emazisa ngalokhu ngabo-2 ekuseni."Kufezeke isisho ethi 'inyoni indiza phezulu kodwa amanzi iwaphuza phansi'. Salahlekelwa kakhulu ngomfowethu. Uma sekuphethe kanje, siyajabula," kusho uNdawonde. Uqhube wathi inxeba elavuleka emndenini ngokubulawa kukamfowabo, belilokhu lopha."Ezinganeni zakhe lusekhona usizi lokuthi uyise akasekho. Njalo uma kade ngiyozibheka izingane, ngibuya ngidangele ngenxa yokucabanga ukuthi yize zingasokole ngokwezidingo kodwa kuyabonakala ukuthi sikhona isikhala sokukhumbula uyise," kusho uNdawonde. Uthe nakuyena siqu, uselusizi ngokubulawa komfowabo, waveza ukuthi kubo bebeyizelamani zesilisa ezine, bonke bengamaphoyisa. "Sebehambe bonke, sengisele ngedwa. Ekhaya kithi, kufakwe izithombe zethu sonke odongeni, uma ngifika ngizibheka, ngizwa ubuhlungu ngoba abasekho bonke," usho kanje.UKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabesiteshi sezindaba sethelevishini, i-eNCA endaweni yesigameko, uqinisekise ukuthi oyedwa wabasolwa ubefunelwa uxhaxha lwamacala.Kuthiwa abasolwa babulawe emva kokuthi bedubule kuqala bebhekise emaphoyiseni ngesikhathi egasela endaweni yesigameko elandela umkhondo ngabo. Uthe bebesolwa ngamacala okubamba inkunzi okufaka phakathi ngokubanjwa kwezimoto ezithwala imali. Kuthiwa endaweni yesigameko, amaphoyisa athole neziqhumane okuthiwa zisetshenziswa abagilwa uma bebamba lezi zimoto. Ngokusho kukaMkhwanazi, oyedwa wabasolwa ubefunelwa uxhaxha lwamacala okubulala.Uthe abalelwa kwangu-15 amacala okubulala abefunelwa wona, aphinde afunelwe nawokuzama ukubulala abalelwa ku-10. "Kuwona kukhona nelokubulala umphathi siteshi wasesiteshini samaphoyisa saseNdwedwe kanjalo nelokubulawa kwephoyisa lophiko lwezobunhloli,” kusho uMkhwanazi. Ekha phezulu nangezinye izingameko umsolwa athe uthinteka kuzona, uMkhwanazi ubale nokuthi kukhona ngisho nesokubulawa kwengane encane.Uveze ukuthi ubemandla endaweni yaseBhamshela, waze wathi bazoke bathole ukuphumula abantu bakule ndawo. Enza isibonelo ngesinye sezigameko, uthe wabulala umndeni ongumakhelwane, ebashisa nendlu, edinwe ukuthi imfuyo yakhona idlubulundele yangena emzini wakhe. Umchaze njengomsolwa obengenanembeza, waveza ukuthi nakuba ake aboshwa, wabuye wadedelwa kulandela ukuthi ahlanganise ukubulawa kwabo bonke ofakazi ecaleni lakhe khona engaphakathi ejele. "Wazama ngisho nokubulala umphenyi wecala,” kusho uMkhwanazi.Uveze ukuthi ngale kwalokho, ubebuye abe yinkabi eqashwa ukuthi isoconge abantu, waveza nokuthi esikhathini esifishane esidlule, yena nozakwabo baqhumise imoto yemali, bantshontsha izibhamu.
BAZOBA senkingeni othishanhloko abasebenzisana nabahloli abavimba abafundi bakwa-matric, ukuthi babhale zonke izifundo zabo ngoba befuna izikole zingehlelwa yizinga lokuphasa.Labo thishanhloko bafuna izikole zabo zihlale zinconywa ngokuthi zithola imiphumela emihle kwa-matric ekubeni bevimba abafundi abasuke bengabathembi ukuthi babhale zonke izifundo.Isexwayiso sikhishwe ngumkhandlu oqinisekisa izingabunjalo lemiphumela kuleli okubalwa neka-matric, Umalusi esithangamini nabezindaba izolo njengoba kuqala izivivinyo zaleli banga ngesonto elizayo. UDkt Mafu Rakometsi, isikhulu esiphezulu salo mkhandlu, uxwayise abenza lo mkhuba wokuvimba abafundi ukuthi babhale ukuthi bagawule babheke. "Yicala elibomvu ukuthi ungavimba abafundi ukuthi babhale ngoba ufuna ukuthi isikole sakho sihlale sithola imiphumela emihle. Abapheze othishanhloko ukuvimba abafundi besebenzisana nabahloli ukuze izikole zabo zihlale zinconywa," usho kanje.Uthe abenza lokhu kumele babikwe emnyangweni, ukuze bathathelwe izinyathelo ezinqala."Abazali nabafundi kumele bababike emahhovisi aseduzane omnyango. Uma bengasizakali kumele baye ehhovisi lesifundazwe, nakhona uma bengalutholi usizo baye kuzwelonke. Akumele kuvinjwe umfundi ukubhala ngoba kuthiwa uzokwehlisa izinga lokuphasa esikoleni." Uthe okunalokho othishanhloko kumele bameseke lowo mfundi ngokuthi bamfundise ukuze aphase kahle.Ukhuze nemiphakathi enganeme ngokuthile ukuthi ingadubeli ezivivinyweni zika-matric."Kuwumsebenzi wethu sonke ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abafundi abaphazamiseki uma sebebhala. Kuyawulimaza umqondo womfundi ozimisele ngokubhala ukuthola kuvutha ithayi, kuvalwe umgwaqo kuthiwe ngeke abhale ngenxa yesiteleka." Uxwayise nabafundi abazobhala ukuthi bangalinge bazibandakanye nezinto ezingalungile ezifaka nokukopela."Ukukopela kubeka engcupheni izinga lezivivinyo. Sixwayisa abafundi ukuthi bangalingeki bese bekopela. Sithanda ukuxwayisa nabanye othisha, ukuthi mabayeke umkhuba wokusiza abafundi ngezimpendulo uma sekubhalwa."Uthe bazojuba abamele lo mkhandlu ukuyoqapha ezikoleni uma sekubhalwa."Kunezikole esizoziqapha ngelokhozi ngoba kuyaziwa ukuthi zingase zikopele. Sizojuba abantu abangenabudlelwano naleso sikole ukuyoqapha izivivinyo. Asifuni kube nento ezobeka engcupheni izinga lika-matric. Ukukopela noma ukukopelisa abafundi yicala elibi kabi," usho kanje. UDkt Mary-Antoinette Dliwayo, isikhulu esiphezulu salo mkhandlu, uveze ukuthi bangu-766,543 abafundi abazobhala izivivinyo ngokugcwele ngaphansi komnyango weMfundo eyisiSekelo.Bangu-17,896 abafundi abafunda ezikoleni ezizimele abazobhala."Bangu-137,018 ababhala ngasese u-matric. Sebebonke abazobhala ngokugcwele nangasese ngaphansi komnyango weMfundo eyisiSekelo bangu-903,561. Bonke laba bafundi sebezitholile izincwadi zabo eziveza ukuthi bazobhala."Uveze ukuthi kunalabo abazobhala uN3 ngaphansi koMnyango weMfundo ePhakeme esingakaziwa isibalo sabo.
WONKE amehlo azokube ethe njo kuNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa omisiwe, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, ozothola ithuba lokuqala lokuziphendulela ezinsolweni zokuthi usondelene nezigebengu eziphazamisa ukusebenza kwamaphoyisa.UMchunu uzothola ithuba lokuziphendulela namhlanje uma esevela phambi kwekomiti elikhethekile lasePhalamende eliphenya izinsolo ezenziwa uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi.Usihlalo wekomiti, uMnuz Soviet Lekganyane, uthe uMchunu uzovela phambi kwekomiti izinsuku ezimbili."Uzokube ephendula imibuzo yohola ofakazi (u-Advocate Norman Arendse). Ngosuku olulandelayo uzokube esephendula imibuzo yamalungu ekomiti."UMchunu kulindeleke ukuthi aphendule izinsolo zokuthi kukhona imali ayithola kusomabhizinisi obhekene noxhaxha lwamacala, uMnuz Vusumuzi "Cat" Matlala.Kubhekwe ukuthi abuzwe ngobudlelwano bakhe nomuntu amchaza njengeqabane lakhe, uMnuz Brown Mogotsi, okuthiwa unobudlelwano noMatlala.UMchunu kubhekwe ukuthi aphinde abuzwe nangokuhlakazwa kwethimba lamaphoyisa eliphenya ukubulawa kosopolitiki KwaZulu-Natal.UKhomishana wamaPhoyisa kuzwelonke, uLieutenant General Fannie Masemola noMkhwanazi bahlaba bahlikiza isinqumo sikaMchunu sokuhlakaza ithimba ngesikhathi bevele phambi kwekomiti.UMasemola noMkhwanazi bathi uMchunu akanawo amandla okuhlakaza ithimba, bakhala nangokuthi sasingekho isidingo sokuthi kuhlakazwe ithimba ngenxa yokuthi belenza umsebenzi oncomekayo njengoba bebaningi abantu ababoshwe yithimba.Ngesikhathi epheka uMasemola noMkhwanazi ngemibuzo, u-Arendse waveza ukuthi uMchunu uzotshela ikomiti ukuthi wakhipha umyalelo wokuba kuhlakazwe ithimba ngenxa yokuthi wathola izikhalo ngokusebenza kwalo.U-Arendse uveze ukuthi uMchunu ugabe ngencwadi ayithola kumhlaziyi wobugebengu, uSolwazi Mary De Haas. Uthe uMchunu uzophinde akhale ngokuthi ukuba khona kwethimba bekudla umnyango izigidi zamarandi.IPhini likaKhomishana wamaPhoyisa kuzwelonke, uLieutenant Shadrack Sibiya, nalo likhale ngokuthi iningi imali ebisetshenziswa yithimba. Likusho lokhu ngesikhathi livele phambi kwekomiti.Izolo, amalungu ekomiti abambe umhlangano lapho khona abebonisana ukuthi ibaphi abanye ofakazi okufanele babizwe ukuba bazophendula imibuzo.Kulo mhlangano obusebusuku, amalungu ekomiti abezophinde athulelwe umbono wommeli ngodaba lokuthi kufanele yini ilungu le-MK, uMnuz David Skosana, livunyelwe ukuba lipheke uMchunu ngemibuzo.Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi uSkosana wavulela uMchunu icala lokudukisa iPhalamende.
UMNYANGO weMfundo eyisiSekelo umile ekutheni kuyilungelo elikuMthethosisekelo ukuthi bonke abafundi kumele bamukelwe ezikoleni benezitifiketi zokuzalwa noma bengenazo.Umnyango uthi kanjalo nabafundi abahlala kuleli kodwa bevela kwamanye amazwe, banelungelo lokuthi bathole imfundo ngisho noma kuthiwa abanawo amaphepha aqondile okuba kuleli.UMnuz Lukhanyo Vangqa wezokuxhumana emnyangweni, uthe kunemibiko esabalele engamampunge, eveza sengathi bachitha abafundi, ikakhulu abangenazo izitifiketi zokuzalwa noma abakuleli bevela kwamanye amazwe abangenawo amaphepha aqondile. Uthe le mibiko ithi kubafundi bakwamanye amazwe kudingeka isitifiketi sokuzalwa salapho bevela khona noma i-passport."Asikubeke kucace ukuthi akekho okumele angavunyelwa ukufunda ngenxa yokuthi akanazo lezi zimfanelo. Umthetho wezikole ukubeka kucace ukuthi othishanhloko yibona okumele basize abafundi bakwazi ukuthola lezi zimfanelo besebenzisana nabazali babo kodwa kumele bamukelwe ezikoleni," usho kanje.Uthe bazimisele ukuvikela abafundi bengumnyango ukuthi baphephe ezikoleni zakuleli."Akekho umfundi okumele ahlukunyezwe noma akhishwe inyumbazane ngoba engenazo izimfanelo. Kungamanga ukuthi ngeke bamukelwe abangenazo izimfanelo zokuba kuleli." Uthe ngisho isigatshana 5 (1), somthetho wezikole siyakucacisa ukuthi bonke abafundi kumele bathole imfundo ngisho noma kuthiwa abazikhiphanga izimfanelo ezifana namakhadi omgomo, izitifiketi zokuzalwa noma omazisi.Uthe abasabalalisa ulwazi olungekho bazama ukuvimba abafundi abakuleli ngokungemthetho.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi izinhlangano ezifana ne-Operation Dudula, zilwa nokuthi abantu bokufika abakuleli ngokungemthetho bathole usizo ezikhungweni zezempilo, ikakhulu eGauteng. NaKwaZulu-Natal kunenhlangano iMarch and March, nayo engahambisani nokuthi abakuleli ngokungemthetho bathole usizo kulezi zikhungo.Ngonyaka ozayo, uma sekuvulwa izikole kunokwesaba ukuthi mhlawumbe lezi zinhlangano zizogasela ezikoleni, ziyolwa nokwamukelwa kwabafundi abakuleli ngokungemthetho.Kwenzeka lokhu nje, iminyango ehlukene kahulumeni okubalwa owezeMfundo nowezeMpilo ihlale ikhala ngokushoda kwesabelomali.Kwezemfundo abafunda ezikoleni okungakhokhwa kuzona imali yokufunda bathola izincwadi ne-stationery mahhala. Bahlomula nasohlelweni lokudla kwansuku zonke ezikoleni. Kunokukhala kwezinye izinhlaka zomphakathi ukuthi kumele izinsiza zakuleli zitholwe abantu bakuleli ngoba ziyashoda.
INkantolo Ephakeme yaseNingizimu Afrika ehlezi eMbombela namuhla igwebe u-Clara Masinga (37), odabuka eMozambique, iminyaka engu-23 ebhadla ejele ngokubulala ngesihluku indodakazi yakhe angayizali, Jennifer Gumbi (11). UMasinga ulivumile icala lokubulala ehlosile wagwetshwa ngokufanele. UMasinga ubethandana noyise kamufi, uRodgers Gumbi, behlala naye KwaMhlushwa, esigcemeni sasePhosaville, eMalelane. Ngomhla ka-21 kuNdasa 2015, uMasinga wathumela umngane kamufi ukuba ayomlanda ekhaya ngesikhathi elinde kude. Lapho amantombazane ebuya, uMasinga wacela uJennifer ukuba amphelezele aye kwakhe, ethi kukhona umuntu amaziyo owayefisa ukumthengela izingubo. Ngesikhathi efika uMasinga washayela ucingo owayesebenzisana naye owasala nengane ngesikhathi eya esotolo esiseduze eyothenga ice cream noshevu wamagundane (Rattex). UMasinga nabehamba naye babe sebegaya ushevu bawuhlanganisa no-ayisikhilimu ngaphambi kokuwunikeza ingane. U-Jennifer washona kamuva ngemva kokudla u-ayisikhilimu onoshevu, futhi isidumbu sakhe esifile satholwa silahlwe emgodini ongashoni eduze nomfula uMlumati. Uphenyo olunzulu lwamaphoyisa luholele ekuboshweni kukaMasinga. Enkantolo, uMasinga uvumile ukuthi ukuziphatha kwakhe kuphambene nomthetho futhi umthetho unesijeziso. Ungene esivumelwaneni seSigaba 105A sesigwebo noMbuso, esamukelwe. Esitatimendeni sakhe sokuncenga, udalule ukuthi inhloso yakhe ngokubulala ingane kwakuwukuthi isoka linganaki umama ozala isisulu. Ngesikhathi kuqhubeka ukuqulwa kwesigwebo, u-Advocate woMbuso uSenzo Zindela uveze ukuthi ummangalelwa wabulala ingane engenacala ethonywe omunye umuntu futhi waphinde wangcolisa isidumbu ngokusithela ngamanzi abilisiwe ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi inhloso yakhe iyaphumelela. Unxuse inkantolo ukuthi ikhiphe isigwebo esikhombisa ubunzima becala. Lapho ekhipha isigwebo, Ijaji uVukeya ugxeke ukwanda kwezigameko zodlame lwasekhaya nokubulawa kwabesifazane nezingane eNingizimu Afrika. IJaji liphawule ukuthi ummangalelwa wabulala ingane engenacala ngenxa yokuzonda unina futhi asikho isigwebo esingabuyisa umphefumulo olahlekile. Kodwa-ke, inkantolo ithole ukuthi kunezimo eziphoqelelayo ukuthi kugwenywe isigwebo esincane esinqunyiwe ngenxa yalokho yamgixabeza iminyaka engu-23 ejele ngokuqondile. Umsolwa kuthiwe akafaneleki ukuba nesibhamu.

OwayenguNdunankulu waseKenya uRaila Odinga ushone eneminyaka engu-80 ubudala, kusho imithombo yomndeni etshele abeBBC. U-Odinga ushone ngoLwesithathu ngesikhathi elashwa esibhedlela eNdiya. Amaphoyisa aseNdiya atshele abezindaba ukuthi ubehamba namalungu omndeni kanye nodokotela "ngesikhathi ewa engazelele". Ube esephuthunyiswa esibhedlela esiseduzane nokuyilapho okuthiwe useshonile. Emasontweni adlule, bekunokuqagela ngempilo yakhe, yize amalungu omndeni kanye nabasekeli bezepolitiki beyichithile imibiko eveza ukuthi ugula kakhulu. Ukengameli uWilliam Ruto, uNobhala weKhabhinethi uMusalia Mudavadi, kanye noMbusi waseHoma Bay uGladys Wanga basemzini kaMama u-Ida Odinga eKaren ukuhlanganisa amehlo nomndeni ngemuva kokuzwa izindaba zokudlula emhlabeni kukaRaila Odinga.USihlalo Wekhomishini Yenhlangano Yezizwe Zase-Afrika (i-AUC), u-H.E. UMahmoud Ali Youssouf, uzwakalise ubuhlungu obukhulu ngokudlula emhlabeni kuka-H.E. U-Raila Amolo Odinga, owayenguNdunankulu weRiphabhulikhi yaseKenya, kanye nesikhulu sezwekazi lase-Afrika. "U-H.E. Raila Odinga wayengumuntu ovelele kwezepolitiki yaseKenya futhi engumlweli ongaguquki wentando yeningi, ukubusa okuhle, kanye nentuthuko egxile kubantu. Ukuzibophezela kwakhe iminyaka eminingi kwezobulungiswa, kanye nezinguquko zentando yeningi kwashiya uphawu olungenakucimeka hhayi eKenya kuphela kodwa kulo lonke izwekazi lase-Afrika,” kusho uSihlalo we-AUC.Osopolitiki nabanye abaholi abahlukene okuhlanganisa noNdunankulu wase-Ethiopia u-Abiy Ahmed benikele ezinkundleni zokuxhumana bedlulisa amazwi enduduzo.
IKHOMISHINI ephenya izinsolo zokusebenzisana kwamaphoyisa, izigebengu kanye nosopolitiki ivezelwe imiyalezo ekhombisa ukuxhumana kwenhloko yoKlebe KwaZulu-Natal, uMajor General Lesetja Senona nosomabhizinisi oboshelwe uxhaxha lwamacala, uMnuz Vusumuzi 'Cat' Matlala.Ubufakazi obethulwe phambi kwekhomishini eholwa yiJaji uMbuyiseli Madlanga buveze ukuthi uMatlala usebenzisana nendodana kaSenona kwezamabhizinisi, uMnuz Thato Senona.Imiyalezo eyamanisa uSenona noMatlala yethulwe ufakazi ofihliwe ovele phambi kwekhomishini, izolo.Ufakazi ubekhuluma esendaweni engadalulwanga ngenxa yokwesabela ukuphepha kwakhe."USenona unobudlelwano obumhlomulisayo nosomabhizinisi osolwa enkohlakalweni. Imiyalezo ikhombisa imizamo yokuhlela imihlangano phakathi kukaSenona noMatlala."Ufakazi ufunde imiyalezo eyatholaka efonini kaMatlala.Imiyalezo iveza lapho khona uSenona noMatlala bekhuluma ngezinto ezithinta amaphoyisa kanye nezamabhizinisi.Kwenye ingxoxo kuvela lapho khona uMatlala noThato bekhuluma ngokuthenga indlu.Umyalezo uqala ngokuthi uSenona abuze uMatlala ukuthi ubeseke waxoxa yini noThato.UMatlala uphendula ngokuthi uzoxoxa noThato ngakusasa, aphinde alandelise ngomunye umyalezo lapho khona eveza ukuthi usalinde ukuba enze isicelo sokuthenga indlu.Imiyalezo iveza lapho khona uMatlala ecela uThato ukuba amthumelele imininingwane yakhe khona ezothenga indlu. Omunye umyalezo iveza lapho khona uSenona egqugquzela uMatlala ukuba aphonsele inselelo ukunqanyulwa kwethenda ka-R360 million ayeyithole emaphoyiseni.Ithenda kaMatlala yahoxiswa emva kwezinsolo zenkohlakalo.Kuqale kuvele lapho khona uSenona ezwakalisa ukukhathazeka kwakhe ngemibiko yabezindaba eveza izinsolo zenkohlakalo kule thenda.Uma kuqhubeka imiyalezo, uMatlala etshela uSenona ukuthi uhlelo ukuphonselela isinqumo ukuhoxiswa kwethenda. USenona uphendula sakuhlohla uMatlala."Bakhombise ukuthi ungubani mfowethu."Ithenda yahoxiswa ngaphambi kokuthi uMatlala aboshwe, akabange esakuphonsela inselelo ukuhoxiswa kwethenda.Kunengxoxo ekhombisa lapho khona uSenona noMatlala bekhuluma ngokuhlakazwa kwethimba lamaphoyisa eliphenya ukubulawa kosopolitiki KwaZulu-Natal."Kubukeka sengathi uSenona noMatlala babenenkolelo yokuthi ithimba laliphenya uMatlala." Izinsolo zokuxhumana kukaSenona noMatlala zaqala ukuvezwa isikhulu sezinhloli esihola ithimba eliphenya amacala okubulawa kosopolitiki KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Dumisani Khumalo.UKhumalo wagula ephakathi nobufakazi bakhe, akukacaci ukuthi uzobuyela nini ukuyoqedela ubufakazi bakhe phambi kwekhomishini.Ikhomishini izoqhubeka namhlanje.
KUBHUNNTSHE umhlangano obubizelwe ukuzolalela isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi be-IFP kuMasipala waseMvoti.Umhlangano obuzolalela isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bemeya, uMnuz Zamani Malembe, iphini lemeya, uMnuz Bongumusa "Bhojasi" Dlamini, kanye nosihlalo wekomiti elibhekele ukusebenza kwemali yomphakathi, uMnuz Vusumuzi Zondi, ugcine uchithwa ngenxa yokungafiki kwamakhansela abefuna kukhishwe laba baholi abangamakhansela e-IFP.Isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bamakhansela besifakwe amakhansela eqembu elike lawuphatha uMasipala waseMvoti, i-ABC.Usomlomo, uNkk Ntombi Ngubane, ugcine ewuchitha umhlangano ngenxa yokungahlangani kwesibalo esanele samakhansela emhlanganweni wayizolo.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi abaholi be-ABC bavele baxabana bodwa ngaphambi komhlangano.Umthombo utshele Isolezwe ukuthi ngaphambi komhlangano kuxoshwe amakhansela amabili e-ABC.Amakhansela axoshiwe yiloyo obegaqele isikhundla sobumeya, uMnuz Mfundo Masondo, kanye noMnuz Siyabonga Zondi."Kuvele kwaphazamiseka yonke into ngesikhathi kuxoshwa amakhansela amabili ngaphambi kokuthi kuqale umhlangano."UMasondo noZondi kuthiwa baxoshwe wuhlangothi oluphikisana nomsunguli weqembu, uMnuz Philani Mavundla.Kunombango osezinkantolo ngodaba lobuholi be-ABC njengoba kunohlangothi olungahambisani noMavundla oluthi yilona oluphethe iqembu ngokusemthethweni."Izimpi zidla lubi kwi-ABC. Mhlawumbe abahambisana noMavundla bazoya enkantolo, asazi."Umthombo uthe okunye okwenze umhlangano wayizolo ugcine ubhuntsha wukungavumelani kwe-ABC ne-ANC ngodaba lwesikhundla sobumeya.Alikho iqembu elinezihlalo ezanele ukuba lingabusa ngokuzimela kuMasipala waseMvoti.I-ABC ibinethemba lokuthi izokwesekwa yi-ANC esiphakamisweni sayo.Umthombo uthe abemaningi amathuba okuthi i-ANC yeseke isiphakamiso se-ABC ngenxa yokuthi ifuna ukubuyisa izinduku kwi-IFP.I-IFP isanda kuketula ubuholi be-ANC kuMasipala wesifunda uMkhanyakude."I-ANC ifuna ukuzwisa i-IFP ubuhlungu ebuzwile nayo ngesikhathi ikhishwa eMkhanyakude."Umthombo uthe inkinga wukuthi kube nokungavumelani phakathi kwe-ANC ne-ABC ngokwabiwa kwezikhundla.Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kukanobhala jikelele we-ABC, uNkk Phumelele Phahla, ayizange iphumelele njengoba ucingo lwakhe belukhala lungabanjwa."I-ANC nayo ibisifuna isikhundla sobumeya. Bagcine bengavumelananga, kwabuye kwaphazamisa nale nto yezimpi zangaphakathi kwi-ABC," kusho umthombo.I-ABC ike yawuphatha phambilini lo mkhandlu lapho uMavundla ayeyimeya, uMasondo wayengusomlomo.Ubuholi be-ABC bakhishwa ngonyaka odlule kulandela isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi babo.

UMSAKAZI woKhozi FM, uZimiphi "Zimdollar" Biyela, uthukuthele uyaveva ngenxa kazakwabo omumise kabi lapho edayisela khona enkabeni yeTheku.UZimdollar, osakaza uhlelo lwaphakathi nezinsuku ngokuhlanganyela noKing Sifiso iDankie 1223, uthe lapho edayisela khona kunentombazane emxhaphazayo. Echaza ngalolu daba uZimdollar uthe uqale ukusebenzela kuleli bhilidi nyakenye futhi wafica abesifazane bezichathela abantu."Angazi babechathana benzani. Ngafika ngazidayisela izinto ezahlukahlukene, ngaqala ngamaphinifa namaduku. Ngeza ngesaluni. Ngeza nazo zonke izinto ezingamakhambi ahlukahlukene."Uthe wathi ebona kamakhelwane nabo basebedayisa izinto ezifana nezidayiswa wuZimdollar."Anginayo inkinga mina yokuthi badayisa izinto engizidayisayo. Inkinga wukuthi bakhangisa ngama-video ami. Bahlangabeza amakhasimende ami eliftini, bathi yikhona kwaZimdollar, bazibize ngoZimdollar. Bathathe amakhasimende ami."Uthe okubi kakhulu wukuthi izimbangi zakhe zinezinto abangazidayisi."Umuntu uyafika athi unenkinga yezinso bamnikeze into yabo bathi nansi. Babuye banqabe ukubuyisela abantu imali yezinto abazithengile. Inkinga lana kwaZimdollar, yikwa-UKM. Uma ungamboni u-UKM, akusikho e-UKM."Uthe akazi ukuthi yini inkinga yalaba bantu besifazane asebembangisa. "Ngazama ukukhuluma naye lo sisi ekuqaleni, ngaze ngathi ngizombika kwabaphethe ebhilidini. Wavele wagijima wangimpimpa kuqala."Uthe wabikela abaphathi ukuthi kunowesifazane omphuca amakhasimende akhe, awalande emaliftini. Uthe akusabayo wukuthi uzosuke ayishaye le ntombazane, ngoba yena uyawagxoba amantombazane, bese ekhalelwa ngamasongo kaSigonyela."Ngizoboshwa. Khona maduze nizozwa kuthiwa sengisezikhindini."Ucele abantu ukuba bamkhulekise ngoba usekhathele wukukhuluma into eyodwa nembangi yakhe.
IZOBEKWA ezithebeni zePhalamende eyabasebenzi abayizipoki KwaZulu-Natal, njengoba ikomiti loMnyango weziSebenzi zikaHulumeni nokuPhatha, lihambele kulesi sifundazwe ukuzothola kabanzi ngokwenziwa nguhulumeni wesifundazwe, ukukhuculula ezabasebenzi.Amalungu aleli komiti atheleke esifundazweni kusuka namhlanje kanti azohlala kuze kube uLwesihlanu.Usihlalo wekomiti, uMnuz Jan de Villiers, uthe bafuna ukuthola kabanzi ngale nkinga yalaba basebenzi kuhulumeni wesifundazwe. Uthe ngaso sonke isikhathi bahlale befuna kube nokuphathwa okuqotho kuhulumeni yingakho befuna ixazululeke le nkinga."Kulolu hambo sizohlangana neminyango ehlukene kahulumeni kanjalo nePublic Service Commission. Sizophinde sihlangane noNdunankulu wesifundazwe (uMnuz Thami Ntuli), ukuthola kabanzi ukuthi uhulumeni ubhekene kanjani nenkinga yezipoki zabasebenzi. Sifuna ukwazi ukuthi izipoki zinomthelela ongakanani esabelwenimali sesifundazwe," usho kanje. Iyindaba egudwini eyabasebenzi bahulumeni abayizipoki esifundazweni. Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi uMnyango wezeMfundo eKZN, uqala uhlelo lokubheka abasebenzi abayizipoki, ikakhulu kwezeMfundo. Lokhu kwenziwa ngenxa yezinselelo zemali ezibhekene nalo mnyango.Lolu phenyo ngezipoki lwesekwa ngisho nawuNtuli, uMnyango kaMgcinimafa esifundazweni kanjalo noMnyango weMfundo eyisiSekelo esifundazweni. Kuzokhucululwa i-persal ukuze kuphume labo okungamele bakhokhelwe. Okunye okuzobhekwa kulolu cwaningo lomnyango, abafundi abayizipoki ngenhloso yokwehlisa izindleko ezibhekene nowezeMfundo.Uthe bafuna ukuthola ukuthi lukhona yini uzinzo eminyangweni ehlukene nokuthi lukhona yini uhlelo lokubheka ukuthi abasebenzi bayazikhandla emsebenzini wabo."Uhlelo lokubheka ukusebenza ngokuzikhandla kwabasebenzi lusingethwe yizinhloko zeminyango. Sizobheka nezinhlelo ezikhona zokubhekana namacala okuqondiswa ubugwegwe kwabasebenzi, nendaba ethinta ukuphenya impilo ewubukhazikhazi ephilwa abasebenzi bahulumeni." Okunye leli komiti elizokuthola kuNtuli ngukuthi zihamba kanjani izinhlelo zezinguquko kusetshenziswa ubuchwepheshe kuhulumeni."Sizohambela nezinye izindawo ama-Thusong Service Centres eMpendle naseMnini, ukuze sithole ukuthi ziyahambisana nemigomo yokubeka phambili abantu, iBatho Pele. Sizohlola nendaba yolayini abade kulezi zindawo." Ihlale ikhulunywa indaba yokuthi kubhekwe indlela abaphila ngayo abasebenzi bahulumeni, abanye abasolwa ngokuthi bathola amathenda kuhulumeni.

OKUSHAQISAYO kuvela ukuthi ezinye zezimantshi eNingizimu Afrika zibanga nomphakathi amatekisi nezibhedlela zikahulumeni.Lokhu kuvele ngesikhathi izimantshi zinombhikisho onokuthula ngaphandle kweNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini izolo ngesikhathi sekhefu lokudla emini.Ngokusho kweMantshi uMnuz Scelo Zuma, obemele umengameli wenhlangano ebhekela izidingo zezimantshi, iJudicial Officers Association of South Africa (Joasa) sibi isimo izimantshi ezibhekene naso ngenxa yokuhola amakinati. Utshele abezindaba ukuthi bagcine bekhetha ukuthatha igxathu lombhikisho ngoba sekuyiminyaka izikhalo zabo ziwela ezindlebeni ezingezwa. Uthe iphelile iminyaka engu-17 belwela ukwenyuka kwemiholo yezimantshi, wathi uma ekhumbula kahle, zagcina ukunyuselwa imiholo ngo-2007."Isimo sibi ngendlela yokuthi abanye bethu uma begula balala ezibhedlela zikahulumeni. Abanye beza emsebenzini ngamatekisi,” kusho uZuma. Uthe lesi yisimo esibeka impilo yabo engcupheni njengoba umsebenzi abawenzayo uyingozi."Sithatha izinqumo ezingehli kahle kwabanye abantu. Ukulala ezibhedlela zikahulumeni nokugibela amatekisi, kubeka impilo engcupheni,” usho kanje.Uthe njengoba imiholo yabo imincane, nemihlomulo ebalulekile abayitholi. Kuyona ubale yona i-medical aid, isibonelelo sendlu, esemoto kanjalo nekhadi likaphethroli. "Siphila ngomholo omncane kuphela nawo okufanele siwunwebe ukubhekela zonke izidingo zethu, okubandakanya nokuphepha kwethu,” usho kanje.Uthe okunzima wukuthi ngale komsebenzi omningi abawenza phakathi nezinsuku, kuphinde kube khona ezinye izikhathi lapho bephoqeleka ukuthi basebenze nangezimpelasonto, nokuphenduka ize leze njengoba engekho noyedwa okuqaphelayo ukuzikhandla kwabo.Ukhale ngokuthi sekuneminyaka kukhishwa imibiko unyaka nonyaka enezincomo zokuthi kufanele imiholo yabo inyuswe njalo ngonyaka kodwa kungenzeki. Uthe okunye abafuna kulungiswe wuhlaka lwezobulungiswa, kwazeke ukuthi luyabasebenzela nabo beyizimantshi."Izimantshi zishiyeka eceleni. Kungaqondakali ukuthi zingena ngaphansi kwaluphi uhlaka ngoba uma siya ehhovisi leNhloko yamaJaji, sikhonjwa kwelikaNgqongqoshe wezoBulungiswa. Uma sesiya khona, siphinde sikhonjwe emumva. Ihhovisi likamengameli wezwe, sifuna liyilungise le nto,” kusho uZuma. Wenze isibonelo sokuthi amajaji ahola imiholo ephezulu kakhulu kuneyabo ekubeni benza umsebenzi omningi kunowawo, kokunye benze ofanayo. "Izimantshi ezisebenza ezinkantolo zesifunda, ziyabakhipha odilikajele, ziyawengamela amacala okubulala, awokudlwengula nawokubanjwa kwenkunzi kodwa igebe likhulu kakhulu,” usho kanje. Ubalule nokuthi izimo ababuye basebenze ngaphansi kwazo zinzima. Enza isibonelo uthe, yena izolo usebenze engenalo ihhovisi."Kuphoqeleke ukuthi ngisebenzise ithoyilethi elisetshenziswa wumphakathi, okuyinto eyehlisa isithunzi ukuthi imantshi itholakale intaza emaphaseji, ingazi nokuthi isikhwama izosibekaphi. Sithembe ukuthi nabaphethe bazokubona ukuthi kube kubi kangakanani ukuthi babeke imantshi kulesi simo engizithole ngikuso,” kusho uZuma. Enye iMantshi ezwakalise ukukhathazeka kwayo nguMnuz Mondli Nhlangulela othe abakwazi ngisho nokukhokhela izingane emanyuvesi. "Uma ukhokhele umuzi nemoto, kusuke sekuphelile. Awusakwazi ukukhokhela ezinye izindleko zokuphila,” kusho uNhlangulela.Uthe iholo eligcina liza kubo libalelwa kuR42 000 ngesikhathi elamajaji liphindwaphindwa kabili kwelabo. Udalule ukuthi ezinye izimantshi yikho zizgcina sezingaphansi kwengcindezi yokwamukela intshontsho ngoba azivumelekile ukuba nelinye ihoto eceleni ukuze zibhekele izidingo zazo.Bathe isazosabalala iNingizimu Afrika yonke imibhikisho yabo njengoba nabanye ozakwabo beveze ukuthi bazobajoyina ngezikhalo ezifanayo.

IPHINI likaKhomishana wamaPhoyisa, uLieutenant General Shadrack Sibiya, livikele isinqumo sokuhlakazwa kwethimba eliphenya ukubulawa kosopolitiki KwaZulu-Natal, iPolitical Killings Task Team (PKTT).USibiya uthe akulungile ukuthi kube yiKwaZulu-Natal kuphela enethimba ekubeni bebulawa osopolitiki nakwezinye izifundazwe.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi evele phambi kwekomiti lasePhalamende elikhethekile.Ngesikhathi evele phambi kwekomiti uSibiya ubhoboke ngezinsolo zokuthi usebenzisana nezigebengu, waphinde wachaza kabanzi ngobudlelwano bakhe noKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, athe badungeka emva kokuboshwa kwabantu ababesolwa ecaleni lokubulawa komrepha u-AKA. USibiya uvume eyokuba nobudlelwano nosomabhizinisi oboshelwe uxhaxha lwamacala, uMnuz Vusumuzi "Cat" Matlala, kanye nesishoshovu esisematheni ngokucela uMatlala imali, uMnuz Brown Mogotsi.UMkhwanazi kanye noKhomishana wamaPhoyisa kuzwelonke, uLieutenant General Fannie Masemola, benza izinsolo zokuthi uSibiya wayephambili emizameni yokuhlakaza ithimba. UKHALA ngokusala ngaphandle ezinhlelweni zentuthuko ngenxa yokwakhela ipulazi elinomsindo umphakathi wezigodi ezimbalwa ezingaphansi kobukhosi bakwaNdelu, eMthwalume.Phakathi kwalezi zigodi kukhona esaseNyunyana, Fokiseni neBombo, kanti ubukhosi ezingaphansi kwabo buholwa yiNkosi Sifiso Shinga obuye abe wuSihlalo weNdlu yamaKhosi KwaZulu-Natal. Lichaza kabanzi ngalokhu ilungu lomphakathi elicele ukungadalulwa, lithe lo mhlaba wawuthathwe ngendluzula koyisemkhulu ngeminyaka yawo-1913. Lithe ngokuhamba kweminyaka, uShinga wahola umbhidlango wokuthi ipulazi libuyiselwe ebantwini, okwenzeke ngabo-2000, maqede labhaliswa ngaphansi kweNdelu Community Trust. Liveze ukuthi ithwele kanzima imindeni ephakathi kuka-150 kuya ku-200 elakhele njengoba iyizwa ngendaba intuthuko."Into esatholwe umphakathi amathoyilethi nogesi ngoba wona ufakwa ngemali. Enye intuthuko efana nezindlu zemixhaso, uyibukela kude, ezigodini ezingomakhelwane bepulazi,” kusho lo mthombo, othe ngisho namanzi ayivela kancane. Umthombo uveze ukuthi okunye okubakhathazayo ukuthi kunanezindawo ezinamahlathi nomoba kuleli pulazi okukhiqiza itshe lemali."Njalo ngonyaka, kuhlala imihlangano lapho amalungu ebhodi le-trust enza izethulo zokuthi lenze malini. Sihlale sizwa ukuthi lenza imali ebalelwa ku-R2 million, esala njengenzuzo uma sekukhokhelwe zonke izindleko zokusebenza kwalo kwansuku zonke,” kusho wona.Uthe lokhu kuwuphatha kabi umphakathi ngoba ukholelwa ukuthi kufanele engabe nawo uyahlomula kulesi samba. "Esikuzwayo nje ukuthi le mali icebisa yona inkosi, umndeni wayo nabanye abasondelene nayo,” usho kanje. Uthe lokhu kusho ukuthi imindeni eyasayina ukuthi ibuyiselwe lo mhlaba yalwela ize leze, wathi umphakathi uke wazama ukulusukumela lolu daba kusukela eminyakeni emihlanu edlule. Uthe phakathi kwamahhovisi abaphathiswa kuwo; eloMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu, elikaNdunankulu, elilawula ezamafa (Master of the High Court), eloMvikeli woMphakathi kanjalo nelamaLungelo aBantu. Uthe bebengakaze bakuthole ukusizakala. "Sifuna ukuthi uMnyango wazokuThuthukiswa koMhlaba (Land Reform) ubuyekeze ukuthi ngobani abafanelwe ukuhlomula ngepulazi, ihhovisi lezamafa aliphenye nge-trust, lithole ukuthi ngobani abenza ubugebengu bese beyaboshwa futhi kubekwe umlawuli ozimele ukubheka ukusebenza kwe-trust, ozokhethwa ngendlela ezogculisa umphakathi,” usho kanje.Ufanise okwehlela lo mphakathi njengokushawa ngempama ngapha nangapha njengoba ungahlomuli ngepulazi uphinde ungayitholi nanentuthuko.Ikhansela lendawo, uMnuz Bhekani Mngoma, livumile ukuthi ezinye izingxenye zomphakathi othintekayo zingaphansi kwewadi yakhe. UMngoma uthe nakuba elwazi udaba lomsindo wepulazi umphakathi okhuluma ngalo, ucela ukungandi kakhulu ngamazwi ngoba udaba oluthinta inkosi. "Angifuni ukutholakala ngingena ngigamanxa kulona ngoba anginalo ulwazi olugcwele lokuthi kwenzekani,” kusho uMngoma.Nokho ukuvezile ukuthi kuyiqiniso ukuthi umsindo ngaleli pulazi uthikameza ukulethwa kwentuthuko emphakathini. "Intuthuko esuke idingwa kakhulu umphakathi ohlwempu, izindlu zomxhaso. Sibhekene nenkinga-ke yokuthi uMnyango wezokuHlaliswa kwaBantu awuze ungafuna ukuletha lolu hlobo lwentuthuko endaweni esuke inomsindo ofuze lo,” kusho uMngoma.Uthe umnyango usuke ubalekela ukulahlekelwa yimali ngokwakha imixhaso endaweni onobunikazi obungaqondakali. Ngalokho usuke ugwema ukuthi - ngelinye ilanga kuthiwa - uyidilizwe imixhaso, bese usizo lwawo lokuhlinzeka umphakathi ohlwempu ngendawo yokufihla ikhanda uphenduke ize leze. Ithintwa iNkosi Sifiso Shinga iveze ukuthi umndeni wayo usemanzini kulezi zinsuku, yathi badlulelwe umfowabo. "Siluzwile lolo daba. Sithintwe wuMaster of the High Court, esibuza imibuzo ngalo. Ngizocela ukuthi niphinde ningithinte uma kudlula umsebenzi wokufihla umfowethu ukuze ngikwazi ukuphawula kahle ngalo,” kusho uShinga.

Ekhuluma neSolezwe izolo, umfowabo uMnuz Thando Nonhlanga, uthe ngesikhathi bebizelwa endaweni yesigameko, bafice umsolwa ehla enyuka nommese, umufi esevele esethule. "Ummese wakhe ubelokhu ewuphethe ngesandla, ehla enyuka eduze kwesidumbu. Uze wawubeka phansi ngesikhathi sekufika amaphoyisa, emyalela ukuthi awubeke phansi,” kusho uNonhlanga. Uthe bathole ukuthi emva kokwenza isigameko, uvele wayalela zonke iziqashi ukuthi ziphumele ngaphandle komuzi, wase esala yedwa nesidumbu. "Besidindilize eduze kwegumbi lakhe aliqashile njengoba behlala bodwa beyiziqashi endaweni yesigameko,” kusho uNonhlanga. Uthe bebuza ukuthi bekwenzenjani, batshelwe ukuthi umsolwa, umufi nentombi yakhe bebehleli emnyango, bephuza. "Kuthiwa umfowethu uxabane nalona wesifazane, wagcina eselwa nomsolwa, okuthiwa ubezama ukubalamula,” usho kanje.Uveze ukuthi kuthiwa bagcina bengena emiqashweni yabo ngokwehlukana, akwazeki ke ukuthi babuye baphuma nini futhi njengoba umsolwa egcine esegwaza umufi inqwaba yamanxeba, embulala. Uthe okubaxakile ukuthi ngesikhathi izihlobo kanjalo namaphoyisa efika endaweni yesigameko, lona wesifazane okuthiwa ingxabano isuke ngaye ubengasabonwa nangokhalo."Asiyificanga thina intombazane, bese sizwa nje ngendaba ukuthi ibikhona,” kusho uNonhlanga, othe bewumndeni abamazi nokumazi lona wesifazane. Uthe abangakusho okwamanje ukuthi bashaqekile futhi kusenzima ukukholwa okwenzekile. Uthe abakazophawula ngokuthi hlobo luni lobulungiswa olungabathoba amanxeba. Uthe umufi ubewumsizi womshayeli embonini yamatekisi, waveza ukuthi wafika eThekwini, ngo-2019, esuka eBizana, ukuzozama amatoho. Uthe kusukela afika, ubelokhu ehlala eVerulam.Enkundleni yokuxhumana iFacebook, abantu bebebabaza isihluku esenziwe umsolwa okuthiwa wenze umuga "elamula".Iningi lizwakalise ukuthi ubevele enezinhloso zokumbulala umufi ngoba akekho umuntu ongagwaza umuntu amanxeba amaningi kangaka, uma inhloso bekuwukulamula kuphela. Basole ukuthi ubevele ewumngani ongalungile, onento ecashile ayizondela umufi, elinde ithuba ukuze amenzakalise. Babaze nesihluku sakhe, bethi ubehlose ukumqeda njengoba bekusabonakala isicubu senyama yomzimba kamufi ngasesiphathweni sommese, bebabaza ukuthi kukhombisa ukuthi ubewufaka wonke enyameni kumufi.Babuye bababaza nokuthi wenza wonke lo monakalo ekubeni engumuntu okholwayo. Owesilisa owalahlwa yicala lokudlwengula owayengunkosikazi wakhe uphume ejele ngemuva kokuthi iNkantolo eNkulu yaseNorth West ithole ukuthi ubesolwa ngamanga.Umlisa ohlonzwe njengo-PS walahlwa yicala lokuthumba, ukusabisa, nokudlwengula yiNkantolo yesiFunda ePotchefstroom wabe esegwetshwa iminyaka eyishumi. Ngesikhathi kwenzeka lesi sigameko, uPS nowayengunkosikazi wakhe bebeshadile kodwa behlala ngokuhlukana, behlala emakubo. Waya kubo kankosikazi edilini lesintu ngemva kokuba emmemile.Ngemuva komcimbi, unkosikazi ucele u-PS ukuthi ahambise izihlobo emakhaya esebenzisa imoto yakhe. Wamphelezela lapho ehambisa isihlobo sokugcina.Ngesikhathi bebodwa emotweni, u-PS wazama ukuxoxa ngokulungisa umshado wabo. Nokho lo wesifazane wayengazimisele ngokubuyelana futhi waveza ukuthi useqhubeke nomunye umuntu.Ngokwamaphepha asenkantolo kuvela ukuthi i-PS waphendula kabi kule nkulumo, okwaholela ezenzweni ezahlukene ezihlanganisa ukusatshiswa, ukuthumba, nokudlwengula. Kuthe uma ededelwa ngakusasa unkosikazi wagoduka wayobikela unina ngesigameko. Baya esiteshini samaphoyisa ukuyobika lolu daba; nokho, ukuhlolwa kwezokwelapha akuzange kuveze ukulimala okubonakalayo noma okungavamile kwezifo zabesifazane. Enkantolo, imantshi yathola isisulu singufakazi othembekile ongenaso isizathu sokusola umyeni waso ngamanga. Isinqumo semantshi siphume phezu kobufakazi bukadadewabo kaPS othole umyalezo ocingweni lukankosikazi lapho eveze khona ukuthi unenhloso yokuvulela owayengumyeni wakhe icala elingelona iqiniso. Imantshi yabushaya indiva ubufakazi obuthi udade uhlobene nendoda, yaveza ukuthi ayimthandi unkosikazi. U-PS usidlulisile lesi sigwebo, ethi inkantolo yehlulekile ukusebenzisa kahle isinqumo sokuxwayisa ebufakazini bofakazi oyedwa, nokuthi kutholwe ukwethembeka kunkosikazi. IJaji uRonald Hendricks usingathe isicelo sokudlulisa icala futhi laphawula ukungahambisani phakathi kwesisulu nobufakazi bukanina. Akazange akhulume ngegazi esithweni sakhe sangaphansi kunina, nokho unina wafakaza ukuthi ulibonile. Ukuhlolwa kodokotela akuzange kuveze igazi esithweni sangaphansi. Lobu bufakazi bushaywe indiva imantshi eyaveza ukuthi kungenzeka ukuthi umama wenze iphutha. "Akumenzi ufakazi ongathembekile. Kungenzeka ukuthi kwaba yiphutha kuyena ngemuva kokuzwa ngendodakazi yakhe ukuthi idlwenguliwe...Uhlabe umxhwele iNkantolo njengomuntu okufanele kukholwelwe ubufakazi bakhe futhi iNkantolo iyakukholelwa lokho," kusho imantshi ngaleso sikhathi.

Udaba lolu oluthinta wonke umuntu."Uthe kule albhamu kunengoma abeyenze ngokubambisana nomsakazi u-Unathi Nkayi ethi Ixilongo nehlekisayo yothando ethi Juju (Love potion/Charm). Abagcinanga lapho, babuye benza nezikhumbuza abantu ngezigigaba zomzabalazo eNingizimu Afrika zeminyaka engaphambi neyamuva kuka-1994. Isihloko seyokuqala sithi Pamberi kanti eyesibili ithi Chimurenga. Ungengoma ethi Africa Ni Moja, ugqugquzela ubumbano kubantu base-Afrika namaphethelo.IStimela yibhendi eyasungulwa ngeminyaka yo-1970 ngesikhathi uRay owayezifundise ukudlala isigingci ehlangana nomdlali wama-drums uMnca, umdlali ka-keyboard uLloyd nomdlali wesigingci sebhesi uJabu Sibumbe.URay noMnca babeqale eqenjini elalibizwa ngeThe Cannibals ekubeni uJabu noLloyd babeyibambe kwiThe Movers, okungamaqembu ayedumile ngaleso sikhathi. IThe Cannibals yaqala iyibhendi eyayidlala izinsimbi kuphela ngaphambi kokufudukela kwi-Afro soul seyijoyinwe wuJacob "Mpharanyana" Radebe ngo-1975. Yaqhubeka isebenza naye kwaze kwaba uyadlula emhlabeni.Yilapho kwashintshwa khona igama kwaba iStimela sekujoyine uJabu noLloyd. Bazibiza ngeStimela nje yisigameko sokusala dengwane eMaputo izinyanga ezintathu, baze baphoqeleka ukuba badayise izimpahla zabo ukuze babuyele ekhaya ngesitimela. SebeyiStimela babe sebejoyinwa wuThapelo Khomo, uNtokozo Zungu, uCharlie Ndlovu noNana Coyote. Babuye bajoyinwa wuSandile Ngema noBafana.Kusukela lapho, ababange besabheka emuva njengoba qopha ama-albhamu ayeshisa izikhotha anjengo-Fire, Passion and Ecstasy, Look, Listen and Decide, Shadows, Fear and Pain, Go On Living Your Life ne-See the World Through The Eyes of the Child. Ingoma engasoze yabuna ngeyavalwa emisakazweni yakwaSABC eyayithi Whispers in the Deep (Phinda Mzala).

NJENGOBA u-Okthoba uyinyanga yokuqwashisa ngomdlavuza webele, abePinkdrive bashintshe umshovo ngendlela abafinyelela ngayo kubantu ngolwazi ngalesi sifo okubikwa ukuthi sigadla siphindelela ikakhulukazi kubantu besifazane abansundu abasebancane.Ukuqwashisa ngomdlavuza wamabele kugxile ekufundiseni umphakathi ngezimpawu zalesi sifo, izici eziyingozi, nezindlela zokuzivikela. Izinyathelo ezibalulekile zokuqwashisa zihlanganisa ukuhlola ukuze umdlavuza utholwe kusenesikhathi, ukwenza ama-mammograms, ukunciphisa ubungozi ngokugcina isisindo sikahle, ukwenza ucwaningo noxhaso lwezokwelapha olungcono nokwesekwa kwesiguli. Inhloso yePinkdrive ngemikhankaso eyahlukene yokuqwashisa ngomdlavuza webele wukuzuza lokhu:Ukutholwa kusenesikhathi: Ukuthola umdlavuza webele kusenesikhathi kuphucula ukusebenza kahle kokwelashwa futhi kwandisa amathuba okusinda.Ukucwaswa okuncishisiwe: Ukuxoxa ngokukhululekile ngomdlavuza webele kusiza ekwehliseni ukucwaswa okuhambisana nalesi sifo futhi kukhuthaza abantu ukuba bafune usizo.Ukunikezwa amandla: Imfundo inika abantu amandla okuthatha izinqumo ezikahle ngempilo yabo futhi bathathe izinyathelo ezisheshayo zokwehlisa ubungozi baso.Ukwesekwa okujulile: Imikhankaso iqwashisa ngokubaluleka kokweseka iziguli nabasindile futhi ixhase ucwaningo olubalulekile lokwelashwa okushaNgoMgqibelo ekuseni, mhla ka-25 Okthoba, i-PinkDrive izoba ne-Hope Blooms High Tea eRadisson Blu, uMhlanga Conference Hall. Leli dili kuhloswe ngalo ukugubha intwasahlobo kanye nokuqoqwa kwemali ezosiza abahlaselwe yilo mdlavuza. I-Pinkdrive yinhlangano engenzi nzuzo esebenzisa imitholampilo engomahambanendlwana - ehambela izindawo zasemakhaya nasemalokishini ukuze bahlinzekwe ngokuhlolwa okubalulekile labo abantulayo noma abangakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizeni zezempilo. Izibalo zakamuva zigqamisa isidingo esiphuthumayo sokungenelela nokuqwashisa ngalesi sifo. Esontweni elilodwa nje KwaZulu-Natal, kuhlinzekwa ngezinsiza zezempilo ezingu-2.251, okuhlanganisa nama-mammograms angu-146 kanye nokuhlolwa kwamabele kwabangu-141. Zonke izibalo zixoxa indaba kamama, indodakazi, noma udade impilo yakhe engashintsha ngokutholwa komdlavuza kusenesikhathi.

Nakhona uthe itshe limi ngothi njengoba uthisha eyedwa ebhekene nomthwalo wokufundisa abafundi abaningi.''Ibuhlungu kabi le nto yasezikoleni. Siyacela nakhona ukuthi mabaqashwe phela othisha ngoba uma kungenjalo othisha bezogcina sebewenza ngendlela engafanele umsebenzi ngenxa yokuthi basuke sebekhathele phela nabo," echaza.Elinye iphuzu athe bafuna ukuba libhekwe kakhulu ngelokufa kwabasebenzi ezikhungweni ezahlukene."Iqiniso ukuthi ziyonakala izinto, abasebenzi bayafa ekubeni kukhona indlela abangalekelelwa ngayo. Bafowethu kubuhlungu ukubona abasebenzi befela emsebenzi ngenxa nje yokuthi bebesebenzela endaweni engekho sesimweni esikahle," echaza.UNobhala weCosatu, uMnuz Edwin Mkhize, uthe kunezinkinga abasebenzi abasenza komasipala abehlukene abaye bazithole bebhekene nazo kodwa bamane bengazi ukuthi benze njani.Uphonsele uMasipala weTheku inselelo yokuthi kube khona okwenzwayo ngele nkinga. Uthe kunabasebenzi bakulo masipala abamiswa kungafanele emsebenzini, wathi kumele mababuyiswe.Uthe yinto efanayo futhi nakuMasipala waseRay Nkonyeni, wathi bafuna babuyiswe abasebenzi abaxoshwa kungafanele.Izikhalo ebeziphethwe yiCosatu zamekelwe uMphathiswa wezeMidlalo nobuCiko, KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Mntomuhle Khawula obethunywe nguNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli.
