LIVELE lagcwala umoya ibhantshi kuthisha osolwa ngokuba budedengu enkulisa okwashona kuyo ingane eneminyaka emithathu ngenyanga edlule. Lokhu kuze emva komhlangano wabaphathi bezinkulisa obuseThekwini izolo. Esigamekweni esenzeka ekuqaleni kusaSepthemba eNomafu Early Childhood Development (ECD) Centre, eNkwali, eLovu, eThekwini, kwashona ingane yentombazane, u-Owethu Mbambo. Emva kwaleso sigameko, umndeni watshelwa ukuthi umufi wahhukeka ngejakhethi, yamklinya waze washona edlala umshushuluzo nezinye izingane ngesikhathi sekhefu lokudla emini yasekuseni.Isolezwe likhuluma nomnikazi wenkulisa, uNksz Zandile Hlongwa izolo, uthe isinqumo esithathwe emhlanganweni esokuthi akumiswe uthisha oyedwa. "Kumiswe owayejutshwe ukuthi agade izingane ngesikhathi zidlala emnyango ngalelo langa,” kusho uNksz Hlongwa. Ucacise eyokuthi bayisihlanu ababekhona ngelanga lesigameko, kubona wathi kwakukhona othisha ababili abadala, kube khona ababili abasaqeqeshwa bese kuba khona ophekayo ekhishini."Laba abasaqeqeshwa akubona abantu esihlale sinabo, bafika nje uma bezofunda umsebenzi. Nakuba babekhona kodwa okulindeleke ukuthi benze umsebenzi wabo yilaba abadala abasebenza ngokugcwele,” kuchaza uNksz Hlongwa.Uveze ukuthi nakuba bethathe isinqumo sokungamxoshi lo owesibili njengoba yena ayematasa ngaphakathi emakilasini kodwa uvele waziyekela yena. "Ungithumele umyalezo izolo (esho ngoLwesibili), ebika ukuthi uyayeka ukusebenza. Ugcizelele ukuthi uma kwenzeka edingeka ukuzocacisa okuthize ngesigameko, uyoza,” kusho uNksz Hlongwa.Uthe lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele athole abanye othisha masinyane abazobamba kuze kusongwe unyaka ngesikhathi kuqhubeka uhlelo lokuthi kuqashwe abanye kahle ekuqaleni konyaka ozayo.Ethintwa unina kamufi, uNksz Lindiwe Mbambo ngalokhu uthe akanankinga nokuthi kukhona oxoshiwe kuphinde kubekhona othe akasabuyi. "Ngoba angazi ukuthi nguyena bani phakathi kwabo owaba nephutha. Yize ingasangithinti kangako le nto ngoba eyami ingane ayisekho, kodwa bekufanele bahambe vele, (uNksz Hlongwa) aqale kabusha inkulisa ngothisha abasha,” kusho uNksz Mbambo.Uphinde wakhala ngamaphoyisa, ethi umndeni uye esiteshini saseManzimtoti ngoLwesibili uyobuza ngenqubekela phambili yophenyo wafike watshelwa ukuthi kusekhona izitatimende ezisashoda njengoba kungakabi yibo bonke othisha asebefikile ukuzozibhala.Ubuze ukuthi umthetho awusho yini ukuthi amaphoyisa, wona anezinsizakusebenza, kufanele kube yiwo aya kubantu ukuyoqoqa ubufakazi?"Okusho ukuthi uma kuphela izinyanga eziyisithupha bengenayo imali yokugibela baye esiteshini, necala lizoma," kusho uNksz Mbambo.
NGENHLOSO yokubhekana ngqo nenselelo yokufunda inkampani yezimoto, iHyundai Automotive South Africa, seyakhe ubudlelwano obumqoka kakhulu nesikole saseKurhuleni, iThembimfundo Primary School.OnguMqondisi omkhulu ehhovisi likaNdabazabantu enkampanini iHyundai Automotive South Africa, uNksz Christine Masinga, uthe imhlosongqangi yalo mbhidlango abawufuqayo wukukhuthaza ukuthi kube nesikhathi esanele sokufunda kubafundi. Uthe kumqoka ukuthi abafundi bazijwayeze ukufunda, lokho bakwenze besesikoleni kumbe ke uma besemakhaya: "Inhloso enkulu yalokhu wukuthi sifuna ukwenza ukufunda kube wumkhuba wansuku zonke kungabi nje yinto eyenzeka ngezikhathi ezithile kuphela. Eqhuba uMasinga uthe bazibophezele ekutheni basebenzisane nalesi sikole ezintweni ezahlukene.Uveze ukuthi abakwenzayo nalesi sikole kuyafana ncamashi nokuhlwanyela imbewu enhle. Uthe bazimisele ngokweseka ukwakhiwa kwemitapo yolwazi kanye nokwesekwa ukukhuthaza ukufunda. Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi le nkampani yethula ngokusemthethweni umtapowolwazi wakulesi sikole ngoFebhuwari 2023.Ngokusho kukaMasinga ukufunda kunomthelela omuhle kakhulu futhi kusiza nasekufundiseni ukuxhumana namanye amakhono ehlukile. "Kumele senze konke okusemandleni ethu ngenhloso yokukhuthaza usikompilo lokufunda ebantwaneni. Kumele lube khona uthando lokufunda kubafundi.'' Uthe kulokoza inhlansi yethemba ngokuthi umbhidlango wabo uzokapakela ezikoleni ezahlukene ezikhona KwaZulu-Natal. Uveze ukuthi inkampani yabo kusuka ngo-2013 seyikwazile ukwakha imitapoyolwazi engu-22. Kuzothi ngoNovemba 5 le nkampani yethule omunye umtapowolwazi osezingeni.Esinye isikole le nkampani ezosebenzisana naso ithe yi-Erasmus Monareng esiseVosloorus. Imitapo yolwazi le nkampani esuke inikela ngayo isuke inezinsiza zeqophelo eliphezulu okubandakanya ama-computer nokunye okuningi. Umsebenzi wokwakhiwa kwemitapoyolwazi usudale indathane yamathuba omsebenzi.
UBEKADE ethole izinsongo owesilisa waseNtinyane, eMbumbulu, okuthiwa udutshulwe wabulawa esemzini wakhe ngoLwesibili.UMnuz Zwelibanzi Mchunu (44) kuvela ukuthi uhlaselwe ngamadoda angaziwa angabuza lutho, amdubula washonela khona lapho.Isolezwe likhulume nowomndeni okuyindodakazi kamufi, uNksz Slindile Mchunu, ozwakalise ukushaqeka ngesihluku okubulawe ngaso uyise.Uthe badidekile ukuthi kungani ebulewe ngoba ubengenanxa namuntu futhi engazibandakanyi nezinto ezingalungile zasemphakathini, wathi uyise ubesanda kuqala ibhizinisi lamakhaza ngemali ayithole eyeka umsebenzi angathandanga ukuwudalula.Uveze ukuthi bekuyizithuba zehora lesishiyagalombili ebusuku ngesikhathi kupaka imoto eyi-VW Polo emnyango."Asizange sicabange ukuthi le moto izokwenza into embi kubaba. Lo muntu ungqongqozile endlini wathi ubaba masimvulele. Esengaphakathi, akakhulumanga lutho, udubule wabhekisa nje ngqo kubaba amahlandla amaningi," kuchaza indodakazi.Iqhuba, ithe okuxakayo ukuthi lo wesilisa ubehamba yedwa futhi engazifihlile nasebusweni. Utshele Isolezwe ukuthi ubeqala ngqa ukumbona lo wesilisa."Ubekade efake ikepisi elimnyama nje kuphela. Akabingelelanga futhi akashongo lutho," echaza.Uthe uphume ngesivinini endlini babange besabona nokuthi ishonaphi imoto ngoba unele waqala ukudubula nje base bayabelaka bengena emakameleni abo."Sinele sambona ekhipha isibhamu sase singena emakameleni. Bekukhona mina nobhuti wami njengoba umama engasekho emhlabeni," echaza.Kubulawa uMchunu nje, sezibonakala ziyinsakavukela izigameko zokubulawa kwabantu kule ndawo.Esikhathini esingangonyaka, bangaphezulu kwabangu-20 abantu baseMbumbulu ababulawe ngokudutshulwa.Kuke kwaba nesikhathi lapho abantu bakule ndawo babecabanga ukuthi izigameko zokugobhoza kwegazi zimayelana nokweb iwa kwemfuyo kodwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi bacula elinye iculo sebethi kakucaci ukuthi kungani bebulawa abantu.Okuqaphelekayo ukuthi bonke njengoMchunu bathola imiyalezo ngaphambi kokuba basocongwe.Kukhona omunye okhulume neSolezwe, ebalisa ngokuthi usethuka izanya njengoba naye esethole umyalezo wokuthi uzulelwa ngamanqe, sezimphelele izinsuku zakhe emhlabeni.Uthe ukhungathekile ngoba akazi uxabene nobani njengoba ethole ucingo obelumazisa ukuthi uKhisimuzi angeke aze awudle. Ngaphambilini, uNdunakulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, wathembisa ukuthi uzolifakela izibuko udaba lokugobhoza kwegazi okungami kule ndawo.Amaphoyisa aKwaZulu-Natal asiqinisekisile lesi sigameko.
BATHI sekubami emphinjeni manje eyokufunwa imali yokubagwazisa ukuze beqiswe ulayini uma befuna usizo eMnyangweni wazaseKhaya enkabeni yedolobha iTheku.Iningi labantu abasuke beshaye ujenge beze kula mahhovisi bathi inkohlakalo yokugwaziswa sekungathi yinto esemthethweni.Baveze ukuthi akukhathaleki noma ungavuka ngasikhathisini uma ungayikhokhile imali yokweqiswa, uphenduka unodoli nje oma ndawonye liphuma ilanga lize liyoshona ungasizakele. Abakhulume neSolezwe, abavela ezindaweni ezehlukene ezakhele iTheku, bathe lokhu sekubami emphinjeni ngoba sebekhathele wukugqigqa emahhovisi bengasizakali ngalutho."Uma ufika kuba khona abathile abeza kuwena bakubuze ukuthi ufisa ukungena ngokushesha noma ufuna ukuqhubeka nokuma ulayini omude? Uma umtshela loyo muntu ukuthi ufuna kusheshe ukuphendula ngokuthi uphi pho u-R300 wokusheshisa ulayini?" kuchaza obemile esiligodlile igama lakhe nongowaseLamontville ngokuhlala.Eqhuba uthe yena usegqigqe amasonto amabili agcwele kodwa lutho ukusizakala ngenxa yokuthi akawukhiphi u-R300 wokujombiswa ulayini."Abantu abafika ntambama ngo-2 bangena ngaphakathi baphume manje ngoba bakhipha le mali. Ibuhlungu le nto eyenziwayo lapha," echaza.Omunye ongowaseMlaza uthe kuboliwe kula mahhovisi, wathi ngeledlule uze wakhokha le mali ukuze umagcino wakubo athole ithuba lokungena enze umazisi."Namanje ngabe kusamile nje. Kubi konakele laphaya," echaza.Uthe manje ziyime emthumeni njengoba engenayo imali yokuphinde akhokhe ukuze kusheshe nakumshana wakhe."Sengimtshelile naye ukuthi akayeke ukudane evuka ngoba uchitha isikhathi sakhe eyoma ulayini omude ekubeni engeke asizakale. Ngithe akalinde ngihlanganise le mali ebese siyaphindela," echaza.Omunye waKwaMashu obesenengekile, uthe usegqigqe amasonto amathathu, lutho ukungena ngaphakathi."Uyabona nje kukhona abafike manje phambi kwami sengikulayini, kodwa sebephinda emuva ngenxa yokuthi bakhokhile," kusho yena.Ngesikhathi intatheli ifika kube khona owesilisa oze kuyona wayitshela ukuthi mayilungise u-R300 ukuze isheshe isizakale. Kuthe uma intatheli imbuza ukuthi kukhokhwa kubani, wathi kuyena. Ukhombise ukunengeka nxa intatheli imbuza ukuthi sikhona yini isiqiniseko sokuthi uma seyikhokhile izosizakala?Akabange esaphendula lo wesilisa, wakhala ngokuthi akathandi ukubuzwa ipasi nesipesheli ngomsebenzi wakhe awaziyo.Omunye ongumfundi owenza uGrade 11 eMzikazi High uthe uphatheke kabi ngoba umazisi usiyadingeka esikoleni. Uthe usegqigqe kakhulu kula mahhovisi kodwa dololo usizo.Kukhona abanye ebebethetha bakhala ngokuthi kudlalwa ngabo bayaxhashazwa.Nasedolobheni, iPietermarizburg, abahlala khona bake bashayela leli phephandaba bekhala ngonogada ohlangene nabanye abasebenzi ababafuna imali ukuze basizakale ngokushesha.UMnuz David Shabane okhulumela uMnyango wezaseKhaya, uthembise ukubuya nempendulo egcwele mayelana nalolu daba, kepha kuze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela kusacwebe isiziba.
SITSHELE ezinye izitshudeni ebusuku ngeSonto, ukuthi mhlawumbe zizovuka zizwe okunye, isitshudeni saseNyuvesi yaKwaZulu-Natal, i-UKZN, esitholwe silenga egumbini lokugeza endaweni ezimele ehlala izitshudeni, iStratford, emakethe, enkabeni yeTheku ngoMsombuluko.USboniso Ndlovu (21) ongowokudabuka eZibayeni, eHluhluwe, obenza unyaka wokugcina ezifundweni zobuthishela utholwe elenga ngekhothenge. Ngokusho kukayise, uMnuz Thokozani Zungu, okhulume neSolezwe izolo, ngesikhathi befika kule ndawo bathole ukuthi ngobusuku umufi agcinwe ukubonwa ngabo ephila, wayekade ebuka umdlalo yendebe yomhlaba phakathi kweNingizimu Afrika, Amajita ne-USA. "Bathi wabashiya ngesikhathi sekhefu, wathi useyolala. Kuthiwa wabatshela ukuthi mhlawumbe kusasa bazozwa okunye, wase ehleka kancane, wahamba,” kusho uZungu othe izitshudeni azizange zicabangele ekutheni usho ukuthi uzozikhunga. Uthe badunguza ebumnyameni ngembangela yokuzibulala kwendodana yakhe."Akukho ngisho incwadi ayibhalile echazayo ukuthi yini le ebese imkhathaze umoya ngale ndlela. Siyazibuza siyaziphendula ngoba nasocingweni lwakhe akukho esikutholayo,” usho kanje. Uveze ukuthi isitshudeni adabuka naso eZibayeni, esifunda eFree State, abehlekisana naso sibatshele ukuthi besikhuluma naye ocingweni ubusuku bonke emva kokusithi halamuzi ngokuthi uzozibulala."Bahlale ocingweni kwaze kwashaya u-4 wasekuseni ngoMsombuluko, imncenga intombi yakhe ukuthi akagonyuluke ngalokho afuna ukuzibulalela kona kodwa akazange, wathi uma esho izosuke imthathe kancane,” kusho uZungu.Uthe lesi sitshudeni siphinde samzama ocingweni ngo-6 khona ekuseni, nokuyilapho bese lukhala lodwa, engasaluphenduli, kanti usezibulele. Uveze ukuthi bengabazali bakhe bebemgcine ngasekupheleni kukaSepthemba, ebavakashele emzini wabo oseMatikwe, eNanda, nakhona akashongo ukuthi kukhona okumkhathazayo futhi wayebukeka esesimweni esikahle. "Sihluleka nawukwamukela ukuthi akasekho ngendlela okubuhlungu ngayo,” kusho uZungu.Uthe kulabo abafisa ukuphumelela enkonzweni yakhe yokugcina, izoba sekhaya eZibayeni, eHluhluwe. Isitshudeni esihlala endaweni yabafundi okwenzeke kuyo isigameko, esicele ukungadalulwa sithe indawo inezakhiwo ezimbili, esinye sihlala izitshudeni zesilisa, elinye lihlale izitshudeni zesifazane.Siveze ukuthi umufi uzibulalele egumbini lokugeza abesifazane, ebhilidini lawo. "Ngezikhathi zasekuseni, izitshudeni bezifuna ukuyogeza, zizilungiselela ukuya enyuvesi, ziqaphele ukuthi kulokhu kuvaliwe egumbini lokugeza. Zaqale zazitshela ukuthi kukhona isitshudeni (sesifazane) esigezayo ngaphakathi kodwa zaxakwa ukuthi pho kungani singaqedi,” kusho isitshudeni. Sithe izitshudeni zesifazane zigcine zibhekana zodwa ukuthi ngabe ngubani lo ozibambezela kangaka egumbini lokugeza, zamangazwa ukuthi zonke ziphelele."Kube sekugibela esisodwa, salunguza ngewindi sazithela phezu kwakhe elenga,” kusho isitshudeni esithe sicabanga ukuthi umufi ukhethe ukuzozibulalela ebhilidini lezitshudeni zesifazane ngoba lona livame ukuba nokuthula, kanti elezesilisa, akulalwa, ngaleyo ndlela ubezothikamezeka esenzweni sakhe. Ubuholi bezitshudeni eNyuvesi yaKwaZulu-Natal, buthe bukhathazekile ngezehlakalo zokuzibulala kwezitshudeni ezindaweni ezizimele ezihlala izitshudeni. UMengameli wophiko olumele izitshudeni, iStudent Representative Council (SRC), uSimphiwe Mlondo, uthe nakuba bengakawutholi umbiko ogcwele ngesigameko kodwa kuyabakhathaza ukuthi ziningi izitshudeni ezizibulalayo ezihlala kulezi zindawo."Ngonyaka odlule, zingu-11 izitshudeni ezizibulele e-UKZN. Iningi lazo zihlala kulezi zindawo ezingekho ngaphansi kwenyuvezi. Lokhu kuyasikhathaza ngoba ikhona imibiko ebesike siyithole ethi inhlalo ayikho esimweni esikahle kwezinye zazo,” kusho uMlondo.Usheshe wacacisa ukuthi nokho akasho ukuthi nakulesi sigameko kunjalo. Uqhube wathi bese bejabula bethi zithe ukuncipha lezi zigameko."Njengoba ngonyaka odlule zabalelwa ku-11 izitshudeni ezazibulala, kulo nyaka besithi isimo sesingcono ngoba azizange zibe ningi izigameko zalolu hlobo. Ngicabanga ukuthi lesi esesithathu uma ngingaphazami,” usho kanje.Uthe abafundi babanayo ingcindezi, wathi phakathi kokunye kuye kube ukufeyila, kulabo abenza imikhakha esengcupheni, wathi nakuba eminye imikhakha ikwazi ukuvumela ukuthi izitshudeni ezisuke zifeyilile zikwazi ukuvuka zizithathe onyakeni ofanayo. Eminye ayikuvumeli nokwenza ukuthi bazithole bengaphansi kwengcindezi abafundi abaye bafeyile izivivinyo ezithize. Uphinde waveza ukuthi ngokwejwayelekile, izitshudeni ezizibulalayo kusuke kuyamene noxhaso lokufunda oluhlale lunobuhixihixi ekubeni izitshudeni zithembele kulo.Okhulumela inyuvesi, uNksz Normah Zondo, uthe bathole izindaba ezibuhlungu zokudlula emhlabeni komunye wezitshudeni endaweni ehlala izitshudeni engekho ngaphansi kweso lenyuvesi."Izimo ezibandakanya ukuzibulala kwesitshudeni ziyingxenye yophenyo lwamaphoyisa. Inyuvesi ngeke iqagele ngemininingwane eholele kulesi sigameko,” kusho uNksz Zondo. Uthe yize le ndawo ehlala izitshudeni isebenza ngokuzimela, usizo lokwesekwa kwezitshudeni ezikhahlamezekile okufana nokwelulekwa ngokomqondo kanjalo nokunye okuphathelene nesimo somqondo, luyanikezelwa. "Sibuhlungu kakhulu ngalesi sigameko futhi sidlulisa okukhulu ukudabuka emndenini wesitshudeni, abangani kanjalo nozakwabo,” kusho uNksz Zondo.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uConstable Thenjiswa Ngcobo, uthe amaphoyisa aseThekwini aphenya idokodo lokufa komuntu kulandela isigameko lapho okutholwe khona owesilisa oneminyaka engu-21 ezilengisile."Ubelenga egunjini lokugezela. Imbangela yesigameko iyaphenywa amaphoyisa,” kusho uConst Ngcobo.
KAZENEME ngemiholo engagculisi eholwa yizimantshi eNingizimu Afrika, izimantshi ezizobamba umbhikisho onokuthula ngaphandle kweNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini, namuhla. Imantshi ezoba yingxenye yombhikisho ecele ukungadalulwa, ikhuluma neSolezwe izolo, ithe isingu-17 iminyaka izimantshi zihola imali engagculisi.Ithe ngendlela izimantshi ezihola imali encane ngayo, zidlulwa ngisho nangabanye ezisebenza nabo ezingeni elifanayo."Sifuna kubuyekezwe imiholo yezimantshi ezweni lonkana. Sekuphele iminyaka engu-17 izimantshi zihola imiholo engagculisi. Phezu kwaleyo miholo emincane, asinikwa ngisho nanemihlomulo yokuqashwa ekubeni namahhovisi esisebenza kuwo, awekho esimweni esigculisayo,” kusho umthombo.Udweba isithombe sokuthi isimo sibi kangakanani uthe abanayo ngisho ne-medical aid, housing subsidy, car allowance futhi abekho ngaphansi kwesikhwama sempesheni yabasebenzi bakahulumeni, iGovernment Employees Pension Fund. Uthe babona sengathi abantu abahola imiholo egculisayo, amajaji, ekubeni benza umsebenzi ofanayo kanti kwezinye izikhathi uba mningi kunalowo owenziwa amajaji."Izimantshi esisebenza ezinkantolo zesifunda, ziyawengamela nazo amacala anjengawokubulala njengoba kwenza amajaji ezinkantolo ezinkulu. Umsebenzi uyafana kodwa uma kuziwa emaholweni, kukhona umehluko omkhulu,” kusho umthombo, othe amajaji ayithola yonke imihlomulo efana nama-medical aid nokunye okuningi.Uveze ukuthi sesiside isikhathi belwa nalokhu kodwa kungekho mnyakazo.Umthombo uthe okuyinkinga ukuthi akucaci ukuthi izimantshi kahle hle zingena ngaphansi kwaliphi ihhovisi. "Sithi uma siya kwelenhloko yamaJaji, sitshelwe ukuthi singena ngaphansi kwelikangqongqoshe wezoBulungiswa. Uma siya khona, sibuyiselwe kwelenhloko yamaJaji. Sigcine singasazi ke ukuthi kanti ikuphi la esingena ngakhona,” usho kanje. Ukhale ngokuthi kuzo zombili lezi zinhlaka akekho ofuna ukuthatha umthwalo, wadalula nokuthi nangonyaka odlule, kwaphoqa ukuthi baye enkantolo ukuze bathole uthasi waminyaka yonke obizwa ngokuthi yi-annual cost of living.Echaza ngombhikisho, uthe uzobe unokuthula ngaphandle kweNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini, wathi kuzobe kukhona izimantshi ezivela kwezinye izinkantolo ezakhele iTheku.Phakathi kwazo ubale iTheku, Point (esingatha amacala ezemindeni), Pinetown, Chatsworth neVerulam.Uthe izimantshi ezivela kulezi zinkantolo ezizoba yingxenye yombhikisho ozobanjwa ngesikhathi sekhefu lasemini. Uveze ukuthi izimantshi zakwesinye izinkantolo esifundazweni sonke zinomuzwa ofanayo futhi zizowujoyina umbhikisho ngokuqhubeka kwesikhathi.Wexwayise ngokuthi uma kuze kushaya uDisemba 15, kulo nyaka izikhalazo zabo zingalungiswa, bazowabeka phansi amathuluzi, izinkantolo zezimantshi zingasebenzi nhlobo. Uthe balindele ukuthi iHhovisi likaMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa lilusukumele ngokukhulu ukushesha lolu daba.
NAMHLANJE kulindeleke izinkumbi zabantu bakuleli ezingamalungu eMarch and March ne-Operation Dudula, ukuba zibhikishe ngaphandle kweNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini njengoba kuvela usaziwayo obengumsakazi weVuma FM neGagasi FM, uJacinta Ngobese-Zuma.IKhomishini yamaLungelo aBantu kuleli ifake umsunguli womkhankaso obizwa ngeMarch and March uJacinta nabanye abaholi enkantolo ngenxa yezinsolo zokuvinjwa komunye umuntu wesifazane owayekhulelwe ukuba angaxilongwa esibhedlela saseThekwini ngenxa yokuthi ukuleli ngokungemthetho.Abanye okuvela ukuthi babizelwe enkantolo yikhomishini, ngokwamaphepha abonwe yiSolezwe, uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa kuZwelonke, uKhomishana waMaphoyisa eKZN, uNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa kuzwelonke, uMphathiswa wamaPhoyisa eKZN, uKhomanda wamaPhoyisa esiteshini sasePoint, eThekwini, uNgqonqgoshe wamaPhoyisa kuzwelonke, yiNhloko yasesibhedlela saseThekwini i-Addington, uNgqongqoshe woMnyango weziNdaba zaseKhaya, uTeresa Notje noXolani Zuma beMarch and March kanye namalungu e-Operation Dudula uNhlanhla Mqadi kaMngoma noScelo Mlaba. SIMAZONZO isimo ebukhosini baKwaBhidla, eBulwer, kulandela ukungaboni ngaso linye kweNkosi uThulabezwe Dlamini nenduna yaseMqulela, uMnuz Kufakwezwe Sosibo.Umsindo ususwe ukungaholi kukaSosibo ekubeni ezinye izinduna zaKwaBhidla, aqokwa kanye nazo, zona zaqala ukuhola ngoFebhuwari. USosibo waqokwa ngo-2022, kuze kube namhlanje akakaze ahole.Kukhona abasola uDlamini ngokuba nesandla ekungaholini kukaSosibo.Ilungu lomphakathi - elicele ukuba igama lalo lingadalulwa - lithe uDlamini ufuna uSosibo adikile isikhundla khona kuzongena umuntu owahlulwa ngesikhathi kukhethwa induna."Inkosi yayifuna ukuba kuqokwe omunye umuntu. Lo muntu owayefunwa yinkosi wahlulwa kakhulu, hhayi kancane. USosibo wathola amavoti angu-68, lo muntu owayefunwa yinkosi wathola amavoti angaphansi kuka-10. Umphakathi washo kahle ukuthi awumfuni lo muntu ofunwa yinkosi."Uqhuba umthombo, uthe abantu abaningi baseka uSosibo njengoba kunokungaboni ngaso linye."Isimo sishubile impela ngoba abantu basola ukuthi inkosi ibophela induna amanqina enyathi."USosibo uvumile ukuthi asisihle isimo phakathi kwakhe noDlamini.USosibo uthe isimo siqale ukushuba ngesikhathi ebuza ukuthi kungani yena engaholile ekubeni ezinye izinduna aqokwa kanye nazo seziqalile ukuhola."Ngafonelwa ezinye izinduna esaqokwa kanye nazo zijabule, zingitshela ukuthi imali yazo ingenile. Lezi zinduna zaya enkosini, ziyobonga. Nami ngaya enkosini ngiyokusho ukuthi angizange ngiyithole into yokuhleka. Inkosi yathi nayo ayazi ukuthi yini ngingaholanga."USosibo uthe wabe esenikela emahhovisi oMnyango weokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu, eyobheka ukuthi kubambephi."Angizange ngiyithole impendulo eqondile. Emva kwalokho, inkosi yabe isingitshela ukuthi isiyangisusa esikhundleni ngoba sengiyihambele phambili, ngaya emabhilidini amakhulu."USosibo uthe amalungu omphakathi ashaya phansi ngonyawo, awafuni nokuyizwa eyokuxoshwa kwakhe."Umkhandlu wenduna waya khona esigodlweni senkosi, uyobuza ngale nto. Inkosi yazivalela, yathi ngeke ikhulume nawo."USosibo uthe uyaqhubeka nokwenza umsebenzi wakhe."Lona ofunwa yinkosi uke wazama ukubiza umhlangano kodwa abantu bangaya lapho. Ngiyaqhubeka nokwenza umsebenzi wami yize ngaxoshwa emkhandlwini."Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kukaDlamini ayizange iphumele. Ngesikhathi eshayelwa ukhale ngokuthi usemhlanganweni, wacela ukubuye athintwe emva kwamahora amabili.Akabange esalubamba ucingo ngesikhathi esephinde eshayelwa.Okhulumela uMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Senzelwe Mzila, uthe basazoluphenya udaba lukaSosibo.
AYAVEVA amalungu ePhalamende ngamacala othisha abalala, abadlwengula nabakhulelisa abafundi ezikoleni zakuleli.La malungu akhala ngokuthi othisha bafana nabazali kubafundi ngoba bachitha nabo isikhathi eside nsuku zonke, kodwa yibona ababahlukumezayo ekubeni nasezweni kunenkinga yesihlava sokuhlukunyezwa kwezingane.Akhale emva kokuba umkhandlu olawula othisha kuleli, iSouth African Council for Educators (SACE), wethule umbiko oveza ukuthi angu-606 amacala ahlukene asabikiwe kulo mkhandlu onyakenimali u-2024/2025. Emacaleni abikiwe angu-127 athinta othisha abalala nabafundi.UNksz Ella Mokgalane, isikhulu esiphezulu seSACE, uthe kunamacala angu-257 abikiwe othisha abashaya abafundi. Angu-26 othisha abashaya ozakwabo."Sikhathazekile ngoba sisazokwanda isibalo samacala abikwayo, uma okwamanje esengu-606 esewonke. Sikhathazekile ngokuthi angu-127 amacala abikiwe othisha abasalala nabafundi. Uma labo thisha betholwa benamacala, bayasuswa ohlwini lokufundisa kuleli," kusho uNksz Mokgalane. Uthe kube nokubambezeleka ekuphenyweni kwamacala ngoba izinsiza ziyashoda. "Angu-379 amacala asuka eminyakeni edlule asaphenywa, angakaphothulwa. Amanye asuka onyakeni u-2022. Onyakenimali u-2024/2025, bangu-36 othisha esibasuse ohlwini lokufundisa kuleli," usho kanje.USihlalo wekomiti leMfundo eyisiSekelo ePhalamende, uNksz Joy Maimela, ukhale ngokuthi asehli isihlava sothisha abasagila imikhuba ezikoleni. Ubuze ukuthi yiziphi ezinye izinto umnyango ozenzayo kanjalo neSACE kulabo abalahlwe amacala okuhlukumeza abafundi ukuze bangaphinde basebenze nezingane.UNksz Mokgalane uthe amagama afakwa ohlwini lwabantu abangeke besasebenza nabafundi ngomuso."Labo abasuke befakwa kulolu luhlu, abadlwengula abafundi, ababakhulelisayo nabashaya ngenhloso yokulimaza abafundi," usho kanje. Kulo mhlangano kudalulwe ukuthi mabili amacala aphenywa yiSACE othisha abadlwengula abafundi, elilodwa elikathisha owalala nomfundi esikoleni, awokweshela abafundi namanye okukhulelisa abafundi. Uveze nokukhathazeka ngothisha abasasebenzisa induku ekubeni yavalwa ngeminyaka yo-1990."Sizofuqa umkhankaso wokuthi othisha baziphathe ngendlela ngoba sikhathazekile ngokuthi basashaya abafundi. Abanye basebenzisa ulimi olungafanele kubafundi, nakozakwabo," usho kanje. Udalule nokuthi kunamanye amacala abawaphenyayo okubalwa awokukhwabanisa imali ezikoleni.UDkt Reginah Mhaule, iPhini likaNgqongqoshe wezeMfundo, ukhale ngokuthi nabafana bayadlwengulwa, akuwona amantombazane kuphela ehlelwa yile nkinga.Uthe kunomthetho wezikole iBela obeka kucace ukuthi induku yavalwa kodwa abanye othisha basaqhubeka nokushaya.Kuvele nokuthi isifundazwe iWestern Caoe yisona esibike amacala amaningi, kulandele iGauteng kuthi endaweni yesithathu kube yiKwaZulu-Natal.
KUBASHUBELE abasebenzi boMnyango weMfundo eyisiSekelo, abadale inkinga yokuthi kubambezeleke ukukhokhelwa kwabasizi bothisha ababalelwa ku-150 000 kuleli.UNgqongqoshe walo mnyango, uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, useyalele ukuthi bafunwe baze batholakale laba basebenzi, ukuze baqondiswe ubugwegwe. Lokhu kulandela izikhalo nomsindo ngokuthi laba basizi abakhokhelwanga ekupheleni kwenyanga edlule.Ekhuluma nabezindaba esithangamini ePitoli izolo, uNksz Gwarube, uthe ukubambezeleka ukufika kwamanye amafayela anemininingwane yabasizi abebeya ezikoleni, yikhona okwenze kwabambezeleka ukukhokhelwa kwabo. Uthembise ukuthi abanye baqalile ukuyithola imali yabo izolo, kanti abanye kuzoshona elanamhlanje sebeyitholile."Siyaxolisa ngokwenzekile. Siyayazi inkinga esiyidalile ngokuthi singabaholeli ngesikhathi. Bekudingeka ukuthi senze ucwaningo ngokuthi bangaki abaya ezikoleni kulaba basizi nabangayi. Besidinga ukuthi sithole ama-rejista ezikoleni ukuze sikwazi ukubona," usho kanje.Uthe iminyango yezifundazwe iyona obekumele ilethe ama-rejista kanti uphenyo luveza ukuthi amanye awazange alethwe ngesikhathi ebesibekiwe. "Siyazi ukuthi kunenkohlakalo yingakho besifuna ukubona ukuthi sikhokhela abantu abakhona. Sizobathathela izinyathelo abadale le nkinga emnyangweni," usho kanje.UMnuz Jomo Sibiya, iPhini likaNgqongqoshe emnyangweni wezabaSebenzi, uthe bebefuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abakhokheli izipoki ngemali kahulumeni yingakho bekudingeka ukuthi kwenziwe ucwaningo.Uthe lolu hlelo lusiza izinkumbi zentsha efaka isandla ezikoleni wathi bekubakhathaza ukuthi ayikhokhelwe ngesikhathi."Siyaxolisa kakhulu ngokwenzekile bengayitholi imali yabo ngesikhathi. Besilandela umthetho ngoba ngoJuni luqala lolu hlelo, sibakhokhele kahle bonke abasizi. Bekumele silwenze ucwaningo kulokhu. Bese sikhokha ihlandla lesithathu," usho kanje. Ibamba likaMqondisi jikelele eMnyangweni weMfundo eyisiSekelo uDkt Granville Whittle, lithe babalelwa ku-34 000 abasizi bothisha abathintekile KwaZulu-Natal.Lithe laba basizi bahola u-R4 000 ngenyanga lathi kwenzeke iphutha elikhulu ngokuthi kubambezeleke ukukhokhelwa kwabo."Siyaxolisa kakhulu ngokwenzekile. Siyalivuma iphutha lethu ngoba ama-rejista aphuzile ukufika kithina emnyangweni, bangakwazi ukukhokhelwa." UNksz Gwarube uzibophezele ekutheni leli phutha ngeke liphinde lenzeke."Sizosebenzisana siyizinhlaka ezehlukene ukuze le nkinga ingaphinde yenzeke." Ezinkundleni zokuxhumana bebeveva laba basizi bethi abazi ukuthi bazohola nini. Bese besabise ngokuthi ngeke balubhade ezikoleni ngesonto elizayo uma sezivulwa ngoba kusho ukuthi bazobe benikela.
UKHOMISHANA wamaPhoyisa kuzwelonke, uLieutenant General Fannie Masemola, uthe iphini likaKhomishana wamaPhoyisa, uLieutenant General Shadrack Sibiya, kanye noMnuz Cedric Nkabinde obephethe abasebenzi ehhovisi likaNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa omisiwe, babephambili embhidlangweni wokuba kuhlakazwe ithimba lamaphoyisa eliphenya amacala okubulawa kosopolitiki KwaZulu-Natal.UMasemola uthe uSibiya noNkabinde yibona ababephikelela nokuthi kuqhutshekwe nokulandela umyalelo kaNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa omisiwe, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, wokuba kuhlakazwe ithimba yize kwakunezikhalo ngalo myalelo kaMchunu.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ethula ubufakazi phambi kwekomiti lasePhalamende elikhethekile.UMasemola uthe baba nemihlangano lapho babezama ukuncenga uMchunu ukuba lingahlakazwa ithimba, bamchazela kabanzi ngomsebenzi oncomekayo owenziwa yithimba."Kuleyo mihlangano kwaba nguSibiya noNkabinde abakhombisa ukuphikisana nokuthi ithimba liqhubeke nokusebenza."UMasemola uthe uSibiya noNkabinde babengafuni nokuyizwa eyokuba amadokodo angu-21 ayephenywa yithimba abuyiselwe KwaZulu-Natal.UMasemola uthe kwamumangaza ukuthi uMchunu akhiphe umyalelo wokuba kuhlakazwe ithimba ngoba wayengakaze asho ukuthi akagculisekile ngomsebenzi walo."Ngamangala nje ukuthi kungani le ncwadi yathunyelwa ngosuku okwakuzohlukana ngalo unyaka. Okunye okumangazayo wukuthi uMchunu wayengakaze asho ukuthi akanelisekile ngomsebenzi owenziwa yithimba. Nganginaye usuku lonke ngoDisemba 28, ngaphambi kokuthi akhiphe umyalelo wokuthi kuhlakazwe ithimba ngoDisemba 31. Akazange asho lutho ngethimba."UMasemola uthe uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, kanye nowayenguNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa, uMnuz Bheki Cele, babejabule kakhulu ngomsebenzi owenziwa yithimba.UMasemola uthe umhlangano wokugcina ababa nawo noRamaphosa noCele wawungaphambi kokhetho lwangonyaka owedlule."Bakhombisa ukuwujabulela umsebenzi owenziwa yithimba."UMasemola uthe isimo asisafani nalokhu esasiyikho ngaphambi kwesithangami nabezindaba esenziwa nguMkhwanazi.UMasemola uthe mkhulu umehluko abawubonayo kusukela uMkhwanazi enza izinsolo zokuphazanyiswa kokusebenza kwengalo yomthetho."Mkhulu umehluko esiwubonayo. Maningi amacala esiwabona engena ezinkantolo. Phambilini bekuthatha isikhathi eside ukuba amacala angene ezinkantolo. Manje sekushintshile. Yebo zikhona izinkinga kodwa siyazama ukuzixazulula."UMasemola uthe uyazi ukuthi kukhona abafuna aphume esikhundleni."Ngingafisa ukuqhubeka ngenze umsebenzi wami kuze kuphele isikhathi sami. Kodwa ngiyazi ukuthi kuhlezi kukhona izigebengu ezakha itulo emakhoneni, ezifuna ngikhishwe. Yingakho bonke okhomishana bamaphoyisa bephuma singakapheli isikhathi sabo. Le nto iphazamisa umbhidlango wokulwa nobugebengu ngoba manje uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa kufanele elokhu eqalaza la bantu abazama ukumxoshisa esikhundleni sokulwa nobugebengu."
Ekhuluma nabezindaba ngamaphoyisa agasele emzini wakhe ezintatha zangoLwesine, uGeneral Shadrack Sibiya uthi uyafisa sengathi ozakwabo bangaba nozwelo ezinganeni zakhe ngoba azinacala, indlela ahlezi egadwe ngayo ayimnandi kuzo. Uhlezi ebona indiza enophephela emhlani ezulazula ngakwakhe, futhi kunezimoto ezihlezi ziqaphe umuzi.Uthi usenesikhathi ewalindile amaphoyisa ubecabanga ukuthi iziboshwa namhlanje, kulandela inkulumo kaLt General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi ngoLwesithathu, kodwa amaphoyisa afike afuna amaselula, ne-laptop (uthi akunalutho kuleyo laptop azobona nawo amaphoyisa).Uthi unikezwe incwadi yokuvela phambi kwekomidi eliqondisa ubugwegwe emsebenzini futhi kumele avele phambi kwekomishana kaMadlanga. Uthi akasenayo iselula, akazi ukuthi uzozilungiselela ngani."Wonke amaphoyisa afikile angawaseKZN, iyangidida le ndlela yokusebenza, ukuthi singaphatwa ngale ndlela isifundazwe esisodwa. Ngizizwa njengoJosefa owakhashelwa abafowabo. Bengingakulindele lokhu kuzakwethu uMasemula bengimthemba, angazi kushintshe nini phakathi kwethu ngoba besizwana mina naye," kusho yena esesangweni lakwakhe emi eduze kommeli wakhe. Ummeli kaSibiya uqinisekise ukuthi banikezwe incwadi egunyaza ukuseshwa komuzi wakhe engamakhasi ayisithupha futhi kukhona namacala abhaliwe, okuthiwa uzobekwa wona. Uthi uma amaphoyisa afuna ukumbopha awafike kahle ilanga lisemome, hhay ezintatha ngoba angaze amubulale aqambe amanga athi ubezama ukukhipha isibhamu.Uthi wake wathola umbiko othi impilo yakhe isengcupheni, watholela onogada bophiko lweNIU ukuze bamqaphe."Ngiyazi ukuthi kwakungabhekelelwa impilo yami ngokutholelwa onogada, kodwa kwakufuneka abantu abazongiqapha eduze, baqaphe konke ukunyakaza kwami," kusho yena.

Sizokhulekela ubunye, ubumbano kwiziNyandezulu ezingabanikazi besihlalo, siphinde sihlahle indlela ebheke phambili ukusukela esikhathini samanje."Izicelo eziphonsela inselelo ukuqokwa kweSilo zazifakwe izinhlangothi ezimbili ezisembangweni wesihlalo sobukhosi.Isicelo sokuqala sasifakwe abeseka uMntwana uSimakade kaZwelithini, esesibili sasifakwe abeseka uMntwana uBuzabazi kaZwelithini.Isicelo sabeseka uMntwana uBuzabazi sasifakwe abaseNdlunkulu okukhona kubo nabaNtwana beSilo saKwaKhethomthandayo, uCyprian Bhekuzulu kaSolomon, uMntwana uMbonisi, Mathubesizwe noVulindlela.Umbango weSihlalo sobuKhosi bukaZulu waqala emva kokukhothama kweSilo uGoodwill Zwelithini kaBhekuzulu ngo-2021.
UKHOMISHANA wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, uyalele uNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa omisiwe, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, ukuba akhiphe ingonyuluka yokuthi ngubani owabhala incwadi eyayiyalela ukuba kuhlakazwe ithimba lamaphoyisa elaliphenya ukubulawa kosopolitiki KwaZulu-Natal.UMkhwanazi uthe unenkolelo yokuthi incwadi yangoDisemba 31 ayizange ibhalwe nguMchunu.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi evele phambi kwekomiti lasePhalamende elikhethekile izolo.UMkhwanazi uthe ukholwa wukuthi uMchunu waqhamuka esesayina incwadi."Ngifisa ukuthi uMchunu eze lapha phambi kwekomiti ezokusho ukuthi incwadi ayibhalwanga nguyena. Uma eqhubeka nokuthi incwadi yabhalwa nguye ngiyathemba ukuthi ngeke azisole ekugcineni uma uphenyo lwethu seluveza ukuthi ngempela incwadi ayibhalwanga uyena."UMkhwanazi uthe ukholwa wukuthi incwadi yabhalwa wumuntu ongaphakathi emaphoyiseni.UMkhwanazi uthe incwadi inamaphutha amaningi."Uma iqala nje incwadi ithi ithimba lasungulwa ngo-2019 emva kwezincomo zekhomishini eyayiphenya ukubulawa kosopolitiki KwaZulu-Natal. Ubani ongazi ukuthi ithimba lasungulwa ngo-2018. UMengameli (uCyril Ramaphosa) wenza isimemezelo emva kokuba ehambele umndeni wesishoshovu se-ANC esasibulewe, uMnuz Msawenkosi "Qashana" Mchunu."UMkhwanazi uthe kunecala lokuphazamisa ukusebenza kwengalo yomthetho alivulele uMchunu nabanye abathintekayo ekuhlakazweni kwethimba.UMkhwanazi uthe ufisa ukuthi kushaye uKhisimusi sebeboshiwe abantu abathintekayo."Uphenyo luqhubeka kahle kakhulu. Emasontweni amabili edlule ngithole umbiko ongijabulisile kakhulu."UMkhwanazi uthe uMchunu usenga ezimithiyo uma ethi uRamaphosa wayengajabule ngomsebenzi owenziwa yithimba.UMkhwanazi uthe uRamaphosa wazisholo ngokwakhe ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba ngoJulayi ukuthi ithimba lenza umsebenzi oncomekayo.UMkhwanazi uveze ukuthi amaphoyisa aba nesandla ekusocongweni kowayengunobhala jikelele we-ANC Youth League, uMnuz Sindiso Magaqa. Uthe amaphoyisa ophiko lwezinhloli ayejutshwe echwebeni laseThekwini.Imoto nesibhamu esasebenza ngesikhathi kusocongwa uMagaqa kwathengwa ngemali yesikhwama sezinhloli."Amaphoyisa ayejutshwe ukuba alwe nokubanjwa kwenkunzi. Agcina esebamba iqhaza ekubulaweni kukaMagaqa."UMkhwanazi uphinde waveza ukuthi ukubulawa kwabaculi abadumile eGoli kuyamene nombango wezidakamizwa.UMkhwanazi uthe abaculi abadumile kusolwa ukuthi usomabhizinisi, uMnuz Vusimuzi "Cat" Matlala, unesandla ekufeni kwabo ngenxa yombango wezidakamizwa."Nabo laba bantu ababulawa abekho msulwa. Uzozwa kahle uma sekuthethwa amacala enkantolo. Uzozwa ukuthi kukhona oweyezenza ungqesta, wantshontsha izidakamizwa zomunye."Namhlanje phambi kwekomiti lasePhalamende kuzovela uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa kuzwelonke, uLieutenant General Fannie Masemola, okubhekwe ukuthi abuzwe kakhulu ngodaba lokuhlakazwa kwethimba eliphenya ukubulawa kosopolitiki KwaZulu-Natal.
NJENGOBA kubhekwe ukubuya kwesidumbu senxusa laluleli eFrance uMnuz Nkosinathi Mthethwa okubikwa ukuthi washona ngesonto eledlule ewa esitezi sesi-22 ehhotela eliseParis, ukhomishana wamaphoyisa wenze izinguquko ngethimba obekuhlelwe ukuthi lithunyelwe eFrance.UNgqongqoshe wezamaphoyisa ngoLwesihlanu wamemezela ukuthi kuzothunyelwa ithimba labaphenyi eFrance. USolwazi Firoz Cachalia, welulekwe nguKhomishana wamaphoyisa kazwelonke, uJenene Fannie Masemola, kwathathwa isinqumo sokuthumela ithimba amaphoyisa amahlanu angomakadebona aye eFrance.Bekuhlelwe ukuthi ithimba lizoholwa uMajor General Maqhashalala, iPhini likaKhomishana wezifundazwe iWestern Cape kwezobunhloli, lizosebenzisana kakhulu neziphathimandla zomthetho zaseFrance ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kuphenywa kahle nangendlela esobala izimo ezenzeka ngokufa kwenxusa uMthethwa.Izinguquko zivezwe yikhomishana yamaphoyisa kuzwelonke ngesikhathi sokwethulwa komkhankaso weSafer Festive Season weSouth African Police Service (SAPS) eBloemfontein, eFree State. UFannie Masemola uthe sekuzothunyelwa isikhulu esisodwa esizoxhumana nozakwabo baseFrance. "Mayelana nokuthumela ithimba eFrance, sisebenzela ukubambisana phakathi kwamaphoyisa. Sinaso isikhulu esiphezulu esisebenza kulelo zwe," esho. Umseshi kulindeleke ukuthi alifulathele leli ngoLwesibili."Bazobuyekeza inqubo ngokwemisebenzi kanye nokuthi ukuphi uma esefikile,” usho kanje.Indima yesikhulu akukhona ukwenza uphenyo olusemthethweni, kodwa kunalokho ukuthola umbiko ngokuqondile kuziphathimandla zaseFrance.Kubuye kwavela nokuthi umbiko mayelana nokuhlolwa kwesidumbu ukuze kucace imbangela yokufa kukaMthethwa ngeke usakazelwe umphakathi, kuzoba wumbiko ozonikezwa umndeni kuphela uphelele kuwo.
KUVELA okushaqisayo ngabadayiselana ekhasini leFacebook, iLadies House, usana olugcine lutholakala lushonile ezandleni zomthengi.Abasolwa okungoNksz Nonhlakanipho Mbatha (31) noNksz Anele Mbhele (29) bavele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseNtuzuma.Unina wengane, okusolwa ukuthi wayidayisa, uNksz Mbhele, ubhekene necala lokuphula imibandela yomthetho wezokuhushulwa kwezisu. Kuthi uNksz Nonhlakanipho Mbatha (31) osolwa ngokuthenga abe mane amacala abhekene nawo. Kuwona kukhona elokuthumba, elokweba, elokukhwabanisa kanjalo nelokuvimbela ukusebenza kwengalo yomthetho. Imantshi, uMnuz S Cadir, imdedele ngebheyili ka-R500 uNksz Mbhele okuvele ukuthi ngowaseMlaza, yala yaphetha ukumdedela uNksz Mbatha. Ibalule ukuthi kungaba yingozi ecaleni ukumdedela ngebheyili njengoba ingacaci kahle indaba yekheli laseThekwini, ekubeni amacala abhekene nawo emaningi futhi ebucayi. Iqhube yathi ikheli lesibili alinikezele, eliseNkandla nokuyilapho azalwa khona, liqhelile naseThekwini. Yize laba ababili bebezofaka izicelo zebheyili kodwa amacala abo angene ngokwehlukana kwazise baboshwa kanjalo. Kuqale uNksz Mbatha, waveza ulwazi oluthile ngaye ngesikhathi engene ebhokisini lofakazi eholwa ummeli wakhe, uMnuz Makholose. "Nginezingane ezintathu. Zihlala noninakhulu eNkandla. Angisebenzi, ngiziphilisa ngokubamba amatoho okuwasha izingubo nokuhlanza indlu uma kukhona onginikayo,” kusho uNksz Mbatha. Uvese ukuthi ubesanezinyanga ezimbili ehlala ekhelini lakwa-D, KwaMashu, wathi kwelaphambilini eliseSiyanda, uhlale izinyanga ezintathu. "Bengicushisiwe khona ngoba ngingenayo imali yokurenta. Nginezinyanga eziyisihlanu kuphela ngifikile eThekwini, ngisuka eNkandla,” usho kanje.Ulungise izinsolo zoMbuso zokuthi akanawo umazisi ngokuveza ukuthi uke waba nawo kodwa walahleka ngoJulayi, kulo nyaka. "Ngisenzile isicelo somunye. Nginowesikhashana okwamanje,” usho kanje, eveza nokuthi awekho amacala ake amlahla phambilini, awekho awahamba enkantolo futhi ayikho incwadi yesivimbelo ake wakhishelwa yona.Umshushisi woMbuso, uNkk Govendor, uthe uyaphikisana nokuthi adedelwe ngebheyili ngoba angalibalekela icala. "Waqamba amanga ngokukhulelwa. Wahamba nengane efile. Futhi uwuhlobo lomuntu ohambe ehlala,” kusho uNkk Govendor.Nakuba uMakholose ezame ukucacisa ukuthi ikheli laseNkandla liqondile, imantshi seyethula isinqumo sokungamniki ibheyili ithe: "Lona wesifazane akanalo ikheli eliqondile eThekwini. Ubhekene namacala abucayi amaningi, ngaleso sizathu angimdedeli ngebheyili.”EsikaNksz Mbhele isicelo sebheyili asithathanga sikhathi njengoba uMbuso uvele wathi awuphikisani nokuthi adedelwe ngebheyili, imantshi yabe isimnika eka-R500. Laba besifazane bazophinde babuye enkantolo ngoDisemba 4 kulo, nyaka. Isigameko abathinteka kuso senzeke ngo-Agasti 20, 2025, ngesikhathi uNksz Mbatha ekhohlisa umngani wakhe, okuthiwa wamshayela ucingo wamtshela ukuthi usehlelwe umshophi, wazitetisa ingane emqashweni, maqede yashona. Kuthiwa lo mngani, owathuka wacishe woma, wabikela isoka likaNksz Mbatha ukuthi nangu emxoxela insumansumane. Kuvela ukuthi isoka lashaya imoto, layothatha umngani, kwanikelwa emqashweni kaNksz Mbatha, abamfica elugeza usana, ethi akayiswe kubo eNkandla, ukuze luyongcwatshwa ngesizotha. Nokho kuvela ukuthi lokhu kwagcina kungenzekanga njengoba isoka lagcina limyisa esibhedlela iKing Dinuzulu, eSydenham, nalapho okuvele khona ukuthi akakaze akhulelwe. Emva kwezinsukwana kwenzeke isigameko, uNksz Mbatha wenziwa ulibofuzo, imiphumela yakhona yabuya ngasekupheleni kukaSepthemba, ithi akahlobene nengane. Wabe eseboshwa, kwadlula izinsukwana kwaboshwa nonina wosana wangempela. Kwavela ukuthi unina wosana wayebhale enkundleni yokuxhumana, iLadies House, ukuthi ufuna ulwazi ngokuhushula isisu. Kuthiwa uNksz Mbatha wabe esemthumelela umyalezo eceleni, ethi akangayikhiphi kodwa akomnika yona uma esetetile, uzozikhulisela. Bekungakahlaluki enkantolo ukuthi ingane yafa kuphi, nini, kanjani.Izihlobo zikaNksz Mbhele ebezisenkantolo, zale zaphetha ukukhuluma nentatheli.
ISATHIKAMEZEKILE namanje emoyeni imindeni yabesifazane ababulawa ngesihluku ngabesilisa ababaziyo ezigamekweni ezelukene eMthwalume.Lokhu kuvele engxoxweni Isolezwe elibe nayo neminye yemindeni.Kusuka ngonyaka odlule, uMthwalume ulokhu uqhubeke njalo nokuba nezigameko ezinyantisa igazi lapho abesifazane bebulawa ngamasoka abo, kokunye benzakaliswe ngomakhelwane babo. Phakathi kwezinye zezigameko, uNksz Mbali Ndaba (38) waKwaQwabe Location, waxhimfwa ngetshe, waklinywa, wayophonswa emhosheni wumsolwa (18) bebuya emcimbini endaweni ngoJulayi, kulo nyaka.Ngesikhathi sesehlakalo, kwavela ukuthi umsolwa nomufi babebanga ukudayiselana ucansi. Kwathiwa umsolwa wahamba wayoziceba emndenini kamufi ukuthi usembulele. Kwavela ukuthi baya ocansini besesikhotheni okokuqala, kwathi uma umsolwa esethi abaphinde, umufi wamshintshela wathi uzombophisa ngecala lokumdlwengula, "wavele wabona kungcono ambulale". Kwesinye isigameko esenzeka khona eMthwalume, ngoMeyi, kuwo lo nyaka, uNksz Londeka Mbhele (24) owayeneminyaka emibili ephothule izifundo zomthetho eNyuvesi yaKwaZulu-Natal, wagwazwa, wabulawa uyise wengane yakhe esabhiyozela ukunqoba kweKaizer Chiefs nomndeni wakhe. Esigamekweni, kuthiwa umsolwa owayeshayela amatekisi KwaSanti, ePinetown, wadweba ngalo itekisi, wayobulala umufi. Kwavela ukuthi wamfonela wambizela ngaphandle kwesango lakubo, wabe esemgwaza. Kuthiwa umufi wabuyela endlini egijima, esopha, esho ukuthi uyise wengane yakhe usemgwazile. Waphuthunyiswa esikhungweni sezempilo esiseduzane, ngeshwa washonela khona. Umsolwa waboshwa emva kokufunwa amaphoyisa esebaleke wabuyela KwaSanti. Umfowabo kaNksz Mbhele, uMnuz Sanele Mbhele, uthe udinga usizo lokwelulekwa ngokomqondo njengoba udadewabo agwazwa kukhona yena ekhaya."Sasibhiyoza naye, sijabulela ukuwina kweChiefs. Emva kokuphuma isikhashana eya ngaphandle, wabuya esopha. Weza kimina, ecela ukuthi ngimphuthumise ngemoto emtholampilo,” kukhumbula uMbhele.Uthe uyawukhumbula umzuzu udadewabo engena emotweni opha, maqede wamphuthumisa emtholampilo, nokho wafike waphelela ezandleni zabahlengikazi.Uveze ukuthi indodakazi (3) kamufi nomsolwa ihlale ibuza ukuthi ukephi unina. "Siye siqambe amanga sithi waya eGoli. Samyisa elibeni lakhe, samtshela ukuthi unina uselele la, wathi ngeke ukuba umama ulana,” kusho uMbhele.Uthe bayakuthola ukwesekwa eMnyangweni wokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi, ikakhulukazi uma beya enkantolo, wathi bayafika bazobeseka."Kusenzima kimina, sisahlala sihlale sibuye lesiya sithombe sokwenzeka ngosuku lwesigameko ngoba yimi engangikhona,” usho kanje.Leli cala belihleli eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseScottburgh, ngoLwesine. Kwesinye, naso esenzeke ngoMeyi, nonyaka, uNksz Nontando Shozi (21) waseCabhane, khona eMthwalume, kuthiwa wabulawa yisoka lakhe ngesando.Kuthiwa wayelivakashele, kusolwa ukuthi baxabana, lakhetha ukumbulala. Unina kaNksz Shozi, uNksz Bongekile Shozi, uthe ugcine esephila ngamaphilisi okulala njengoba evele aqwashe bese kubuya yonke imicabango ngesehlakalo."Ngaba wumuntu wokuqala owafonelwa esebulewe. Ngamfica esesimweni esithusayo. Ebusuku buvele buphele ubuthongo, sibuye sonke isithombe salokhu engakufica ngesikhathi ngifika lapho enzakaliswa khona,” kusho uNksz Shozi.Nakuba egculisekile ngenqubekela phambili yecala enkantolo kodwa uthe usaludinga usizo lokwelulekwa ngokomqondo. Leli cala libuyela eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseScottburgh, kusasa.Isishoshovu samalungelo abesifazane enhlanganweni, iWomen of uMthwalume, uNksz Nombuso Sibisi, sithe sebefisa nokuthi kubuyiswe isigwebo sentambo ngenxa yokwanda kwezigameko zokubulawa kwabesifazane ngesihluku kule ndawo."Kukhona okufanele uhulumeni akwenze kangcono ngenkinga yalesi sihlava. Okungenani akabuyise isigwebo sentambo,” kusho uNksz Sibisi.Uqhube wathi okunye okungenziwa wuhulumeni ukuthi limdilikele ngempela ijele lowo osuke elahlwe yicala lokubulala noma elokudlwengula. "Ikakhulukazi labo ababulala abantu abasuke bethandana nabo kanjalo nalabo abasuke bedlwengule izingane ezineminyaka engaphansi kwengu-18,” usho kanje. Nokho uzwakalise ukuthi bagculisekile ngendlela izinkantolo kanjalo namaphoyisa asewasebenza kahle ngayo amacala alolu hlobo.Uthe ayanakwa kakhulu manje la macala futhi babambisene kahle kakhulu nabaseshi abasuke bewaphenya. Uveze ukuthi baphezu kwezinhlelo zokwenza ingqophamlando yohlelo abazolubiza ngeHealing of Memories oluzosiza imindeni yalabo abathikanyezwa yizigameko ezinesihluku. Uthe kulolu hlelo, bazobambisana nenye inhlangano engenzi nzuzo, iGloves Up kanjalo noMnyango wezeMidlalo, ezobuCiko namaSiko. Uthe abalelwa ku-200 amalungu emindeni akhahlanyezwa yizigameko zokubulawa kwabesifazane ngesihluku. Uphethe ngokuthi esinye sezigameko ezabathinta kakhulu, ngesowesilisa owabulala ingane eneminyaka emibili, yatholwa imbozwe ngendishi, edinwa wukuthi unina umalile.
SIQALE phansi sabhibha isilonda emndenini wentombazanyana yaseNkwali, eLlovu, uthola izindaba zokuthi akusensuku zatshwala ivulwe inkulisa okwafa kuyo le ngane. U-Owethu Mbambo (3) kuthiwa wabulawa ukuklinywa ijakhethi ayeyigqokile ngesikhathi edlala umshushuluzo nezinye izingane ngoSepthemba 3, nonyaka, eNomafu Early Child Development (ECD) Centre.Ngokusho komphathi wenkulisa - okuthiwa wayengekho ngesikhathi kwenzeka isigameko - umufi wabanjwa yintambo yejakhethi emqaleni, yamklinya washona. Kuthiwa wathi isigameko senzeke ngesikhathi sekhefu lokudla kule nkulisa okuthiwa inothisha abayisihlanu, ababheka izingane ezingu-31.Ngokusho kukanina kamufu, uNksz Lindiwe Mbambo, emva kwesigameko yavalwa inkulisa, kwathiwa izovulwa uma sekwenziwe uphenyo."Kubuhlungu ukuzwa ukuthi iyavulwa inkulisa kodwa ayikho inqubekela phambili esiyitshelwayo mayelana nokufa kwengane yami,” kusho uNksz Mbambo. Uqhube wathi zikhona ezinye izinkulumo ezivelayo ngabazali bezinye izingane zale nkulisa."Zithi zazidlala zodwa othisha behleli ngaphakathi, kumakhaza. Zithi ikhona eyodwa eyahamba yayobabikela ukuthi u-Owethu uyalimala emnyango kodwa bayixosha,” usho kanje.Uthe kwamlimaza ukuthi bangagonyuluki, bavume uma baba budedengu. Uthe njengoba isizovulwa, impilo iqhubeke njengenjwayelo, kuyamthunuka yena osalinde ukuthi kwenzeke ubulungiswa ngengane yakhe efe ngendlela engaqondakali. Uveze ukuthi bekungekhona okokuqala ingane yakhe ilimala kule nkulisa. "Ngonyaka odlule, yabuya ilimele phakathi kwekhala namehlo. Yayinesibazi futhi ivuvukele. Akekho owasichazela ukuthi ilinyazwe yini. Ngakhetha ukuyikhipha. Ngize ngayibuyisela ekuqaleni kwalo nyaka kanti isizovele ife,” kusho uNksz Mbambo othe ngosuku lwesigameko waze wamtshela emehlweni umphathi wenkulisa ukuthi ngabe kungcono ukuba akayibuyisanga ingane yakhe la ngoba ngabe isaphila. "Ngifuna ubulungiswa, bathathelwe izinyathelo okutholakala ukuthi baba budedengu,” usho kanje. Uninakhulu kamufi, uNksz Zibuyile Mbambo, elandisa ngokwenzeka ngosuku lwesehlakalo uthe, akekho owababikela ukuthi sekwenzeke umonakalo."Sasukuma emva kokuthi kufike omunye wendawo, ethi abakasithinti yini enkulisa ngoba sekuquleke ingane yakwaMbambo (esho lapha ekhaya). Sanikela khona. Sisendleleni, uLindiwe wafonela umphathi wenkulisa embuza ukuthi kwenzekani ngengane yakhe, wangafuna ukuphumela obala, wathi uzobuyela kuye,” kusho uninakhulu.Uthe baze bafika enkulisa, bahlaliswa ehhovisi likamphathi wayo, wababizela umhlengikazi wasemtholampilo wendawo, owafike wabatshela ukuthi othisha balethe ingane emtholampilo, kodwa ngeshwa ibisivele ishonile. Umnikazi wenkulisa, uNksz Za Hlongwa, uthe ohlangothini lwamaphoyisa ubengakatholi lutho ngenqubekela phambili yophenyo, wathi ngesikhathi egcina ukukhuluma nawo amtshela ukuthi: "Idokodo elivuliwe elokufa komuntu kodwa akulona elokubulawa kwakhe.”"Ababange besachaza ukuthi baqonde ukuthini ngalokho,” kusho uNksz Hlongwa othe wayewugqugquzele umndeni ukuthi ukukhuthalele ukuya esiteshini samaphoyisa ukuyofuna kabanzi ngenqubekela phambili yophenyo. Uvumile ukuthi wayewuthembisile umndeni ukuthi uzowuzamela abeluleki bezengqondo kulandela isigameko kodwa babhekana nenkinga yokungabatholi abakwaLifeline.Uthe bekulokhu kukhona ukuxhumana phakathi kwakhe nomndeni kamufi, wathi emyalezweni wokugcina awuthumela owawuthi bahlale bazi ukuthi unabo ngemicabango.Uphinde wavuma ukuthi babakhona ubudedengu kothisha benkulisa ngesigameko, waveza ukuthi wabamisa ngokushesha. "Njengoba sihlela ukuvula, ngizoqale ngizwe emhlanganweni wabaphathi bezinkulisa ozoba ngoLwesibili (kusasa), ngizwe ukuthi bathi yisiphi isinqumo okufanele sisithathe ngothisha,” kusho uNksz Hlongwa othe ngokwezinhlelo inkulisa iyavulwa ngoMsombuluko ozayo.Uthe inkulisa izovulwa emva komhlangano obekhona wabazali, njengoba wayeshilo ngesikhathi ivalwa emva kwesigameko ukuthi kuyoqale kube nomhlangano wabazali ngaphambi kokuba ivulwe.Amaphoyisa agcine engaphefumulanga ngalolu daba, kanti noMnyango wezeMfundo wawugcine ukhiphe isitatimende uzwelana nomndeni wengane eshonile.
I-ANC isiphumele obala yathi umphakathi wawuzovukela uMbuso ukube uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa akajubanga ikhomishini ephenya izinsolo ezenziwa nguKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLt-Gen Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi.UNobhala Jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, uthe uRamaphosa wayengenayo enye indlela ngaphandle kokujuba uphenyo ngezinsolo zokuthi abanye osopolitiki basebenzisana nezigebengu kanti abanye baphazamisa ukusebenza kwengalo yomthetho."Wayengenayo enye indlela ayengayenza uMatamela. Kwadingeka ajube iKhomishini kaMadlanga, ezibuyela eBrazil. Iyani niyofakaza kuleya khomishini. Makanganisabisi amakhomishini ngoba abalulekile. UMkhwanazi uyiphoyisa elithenjiwe, wavuka wakhuluma nesizwe ngokuthi osopolitiki baphazamisa ukusebenza komthetho. Ukuba akakwenzanga lokhu, abantu babeyovukela uhulumeni bekhala ngokuthi kufuywe izigebengu," kusho uMbalula.Uthe kumele bathathelwe izinyathelo okuzothinteka amagama abo kule khomishini. Ukusho lokhu izolo ekhuluma emhlanganweni wePopcru, inyunyana yamaphoyisa, oqhubeka eBirchwood Hotel, eGoli.UMbalula uthe amalungu ePopcru anomsebenzi omkhulu wokuqapha ukuthi abantu baphephile.Uthe ubabonile otsotsi ngesikhathi esaphethe uMnyango wamaPhoyisa."Ngibabonile abantu engangibathembile ukuthi bayizigebengu emaphoyiseni. Uma singaba yizwe eliphethwe yizigebengu, abantu bazozenzela umathanda." Uphawule nangendaba yabafuna ukuthi amaKhomanisi (SACP) ayozimela okhethweni."Asikwazi ukujabulela ukuthi amaKhomanisi ayozimela. Kukhona abajabulayo, abathi abahambe. Sizoyixoxa namaKhomanisi eyokubuyekeza amadlelandawonye okuyinto ekhalisa i-SACP. Asifuni ukuthi iphume i-SACP, iyozimela," kusho uMbalula. Uphawule nangogqingetshe owabakhona kumele kuphasiswe isabelomali sezwe kulo nyaka."Ngangicabanga ukuthi kuzobalula ukuphasisa isabelomali. Kwaba nzima, kwama nse yonke into. Eqinisweni, kwathina sasingayixoxanga eyokunyuswa kwentela efakwa uma kuthengwa impahla, iVAT. Yama nse ibhajethi, kwaba nzima. Abathi kulula, baqamba amanga kunzima emnyango," kusho uMbalula.Usho lokhu nje, amaqembu ayingxenye kahulumeni wokubambisana, aya nasenkantolo echitha ukunyuswa kweVAT. Uhulumeni wagcina egobe uphondo, wehlela ngezansi wayichitha eyokunyusa iVAT emva kwezikhalo zomphakathi. Uveze nokuthi kunzima kuhulumeni wokubambisana kwamaqembu njengoba kudingeka baxoxe ngisho noma befuna ukushintsha izinto ePhalamende."Kudingeka sixoxe sivumelane ngayo yonke into kwiGNU. Kudingeka sibhekane noHellen Zille we-DA," kusho uMbalula.

KWENZIWE izinhlelo eziqinile zokunqanda ukuphazamiseka kokubhalwa kwezivivinyo zika-matric KwaZulu-Natal, eziqala emasontweni ambalwa ezayo.Lezi zinhlelo zenziwe nguMnyango wezeMfundo esifundazweni, ubambisene nezinhlaka ezehlukene okubalwa omasipala, imiphakathi, abezinhlekelele kanjalo nohulumeni wesifundazwe.UMphathiswa wezeMfundo, uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka, uthe kuyasiza ukubambisana kwamathimba ehlukene kuhulumeni ukuze kube lula uma sekubhalwa. Uthe kula mathimba kubalwa omasipala, uMnyango wokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu kanjalo nezinhlaka zokuphepha."Sifuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi akubi nokuphazamiseka uma sekubhalwa izivivinyo. Asifuni ukuthi uma imiphakathi inezikhalo, bese zikapakela ezikoleni kuphazamiseke izivivinyo," kusho uHlomuka izolo emva kokuhambela isikhungo okugaywa kusona amaphepha ka-matric eThekwini.Uthe abezomthetho bazobe beqaphe ngelokhozi uma sekubhalwa."Zizobe ziqinile ezokuphepha njengoba sisebenza namaphoyisa kanjalo nezinye izinhlaka zokuphepha. Ezinye izinhlelo ezithinta ukuphepha ngeke ngizidalule esidlangalaleni." Uthe nophiko lwezinhlekelele lumi ngomumo uma kwenzeka kuba nezinkinga ezingaphazamisa ukubhala.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi ngalesi sikhathi sonyaka kuke kube nemvula ehambisana nomoya kuphephuke izikole okugcina sekuthatha isikhathi ukuthi zilungiswe ngenxa yokushoda kwemali."Sinazo ezinye izinhlelo esizozenza uma kwenzeka kugadla izinhlekelele ezikoleni. Kunamagumbi angomahamba nendlwana okuyiwona azosiza uma kwenzeka kuba nalesi simo," kusho uHlomuka. Okunye okugqamile ngukuthi isifundazwe sifuna ukugcina umlando omuhle, wokungaputshuki kwamaphepha ka-matric.Sekuphenduke insakavukela ukuthi kwezinye izifundazwe kuba nemibiko yokuputshuka kwamaphepha ka-matric. Esifundazweni akukaze kubikwe ngezehlakalo zokuputshuka kwamaphepha."Kubalulekile ukugcina isithunzi sezivivinyo ukuze kungabi nongabazane ngemiphumela. Sifuna ngaso sonke isikhathi ukuvikela isithunzi sesifundazwe." UNdunankulu wase-KZN, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, unxuse abazali ukuthi baseke bonke abafundi abazobhala izivivinyo.Uthe akungagcini nje ngokuthi kwesekwe abakwa-matric, kodwa nabakwamanye amabanga."Siye kobheka lapho kugaywa khona amaphepha ngoba besifuna ukuzenelisa ngokuthi yonke into imi ngomumo. Sinxusa abafundi ukuthi bazibambe ziqine ngalesi sikhathi sezivivinyo eziqala ezinsukwini ezingengaki." UNtuli uthe abafundi abagxile ezincwadini zabo bazilungiselele ngendlela.Izivivinyo ziqala ngo-Okthoba 21 nge-Computer Applications Tech P1, zizophothulwa ngoNovemba 26, nge-Agricultural Management Practices neMarine Sciences P2.
UKHOMISHANA wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, u Lieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, umatanise uNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa omisiwe, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, nezinsolo zokuphazamisa uphenyo lokufa komuntu.UMkhwanazi usole uMchunu ngokuba yingxenye yokuphazanyiswa kophenyo lophiko oluqapha ukusebenza kwamaphoyisa, i-Ipid, eyayiphenya ngokubulawa komuntu okwakusolwa ukuthi ubulewe abaqaphi bakhe ngesikhathi esangundunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal.UMkhwanazi wenze lezi zinsolo ngesikhathi ethula ubufakazi phambi kwekomiti lasePhalamende elikhethekile, izolo. UMkhwanazi uthe lolu phenyo lwaphela ngendlela engaqondakali emva komhlangano owabanjelwa emzini kaMchunu oseMpangeni.Ngokusho kukaMkhwanazi, kulo mhlangano kwakukhona owayephethe i-Ipid ngaleso sikhathi, uMnuz Robert McBride, kanye nosanda kususwa esikhundleni sokuba yichief of staff ehhovisi likaMchunu, uMnuz Cedric Nkabinde.Ngaleso sikhathi uNkabinde wayengumphenyi kwi-Ipid. UMkhwanazi uthe ngesikhathi kunomhlangano uMchunu wayengakabi wuNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa."UNkabinde wangitshela ukuthi bagibela ibhanoyi, baya emzini kaMchunu. Wangitshela ukuthi babephenya icala lokubulawa komuntu lapho uMchunu wayesolwa ngokuphazamisa uphenyo."UMkhwanazi uthe usaluphenya lolu daba. "Lokhu enginitshela khona yinto engayixoxelwa nguNkabinde. Emva kwalokho kukhona nelinye iphoyisa elangixoxela into efanayo. Yilapho engabona khona ukuthi iyiqiniso le ndaba. Angikaluqedi uphenyo lwami."UMkhwanazi uthe emva kokuba uMchunu eqokwe ukuba abe nguNgqongoshe wamaPhoyisa uNkabinde waqokwa ukuba abe yichief of staff. UMkhwanazi uthe uNkabinde wake wamhlanganisa noMchunu."Ngaleso sikhathi uMchunu wayenguNgqongqoshe wezaManzi. Ayikho into etheni esayixoxa. UMchunu wathi nje ubefuna ukuzethula kumina." Kuqale ngobuhixihixi ukulalelwa kobufakazi. Kusuke umsindo, kwabambezeleka ukulalelwa kobufakazi ngesikhathi kubangwa isitatimende esilethwe nguMkhwanazi. Umholi we-EFF, uMnuz Julius Malema, ukhale ngokuthi uMkhwanazi akazange alethe isitatimende esiqondiswe ekomitini. UMalema uthe isitatimende abasitholile yileso uMkhwanazi asethula phambi kweKhomishini eholwa yiJaji Mbuyiseli Madlanga, nayo ephenya izinsolo ezifanayo. "Lapha kubhaliwe ukuthi isitatimende esithayiselwe. Lokhu kusho ukuthi thina sikhosele ngaphansi kwekhomishini. Sekukaningi ngikusho ukuthi thina siyikomiti elizimele, asikho ngaphansi kwekhomishini. Ikhomishini yaqokwa nguMengameli kanti ikomiti laqokwa yiPhalamende. UMkhwanazi kufanele enze isitatimende esiqondiswe ekomitini."Ohola ofakazi ekomitini, u-Advocate Norman Arendse, uthe ikhomishini iyona eyakwazi ukukhuluma noMkhwanazi kuqala. U-Arendse uthe kwaba nesivumelwano sokuthi amanye amadokodo bazowathatha kwikhomishini.Nokho amalungu ekomiti awafunanga nokuyizwa incazelo ka-Arendse, kwaze kwaba khona nabaphakamisa ukuthi u-Arendse asuswe esikhundleni.Amalungu ekomiti avalelane isikhathi esingaphezu kwamahora amathathu, ebanga lolu daba. Abahola ofakazi bagcine beyalelwa ukuba baqale phansi bathathe isitatimende sikaMkhwanazi.UMkhwanazi uzoqhubeka nokwethula ubufakazi namhlanje.
ULAHLWA nawunina owesifazane osolwa ngecala lokweba ingane yomqashi wakhe ngasekupheleni kwenyanga eyedlule.Umsolwa uNksz Lungile Mbonambi (35) ongowokudabuka eMandeni, ubevele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini, izolo, ukuzofaka isicelo sebheyili.Usolwa ngokweba ingane yomqashi wakhe eflethini elisenkabeni yeTheku, ngoSepthemba 27, 2025. Lokhu kwenzeka ngesikhathi unina wengane esemsebenzini. Lona wesifazane watshelwa indodana (14) yakhe ukuthi umsolwa uhambe ekuseni nengane, wathi uma efonelwa wayengasatholakali ocingweni, kwaze kwafakwa isaziso ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ngengane entshontshwe wumzanyana maqede kwaqhamuka abakubo kwesoka, bethi ingane kayebiwe, ize kubo.Imantshi uNkk B Vahed imnqabele ibheyili umsolwa ithi uma ededelwa ngebheyili maningi amathuba okuthi abalekele icala. Unina kamsolwa, uNksz Thembisile Khanyezi exoxa ngaphandle kwenkantolo, uthe ayikho into afuna ukulokhu eyikhuluma "ngesigebengu”.Uthe akazi ukuthi umsolwa ubesengaphansi kwayiphi ingcindezi aze akhethe ukweba ingane yomuntu."Kwamina izingane ezintathu enginazo, okubalwa kuzo naye, ngazithola sengimdala. Sengithukwa nangabantu ngalokho, ngazithola izingane. Naye bengiye ngimtshele ukuthi uzoyithola ingane ngesikhathi esifanele ngoba ingane iyisibusiso esivela kuNkulunkulu,” kusho uNksz Khanyezi. Uthe umsolwa ungumuntu obuye akhulume amanga futhi oziphatha ngendlela engaqondakali.Ugcizelele ukuthi ngeke baqinisekise ukuthi uke wakhulelwa noma cha njengoba ebengeyena umuntu okhonze ukubuya ekhaya. "Simgcine ngoJulayi nonyaka, kungcwatshwa umama. Nakhona wasijoyina esontweni ngosuku lomngcwabo. Mina nje engangiphithene ekhanda angimbonanga,” usho kanje. Unina wengane wangempela, uNksz Zandile Mhlongo, ukhombise ukumzwela umsolwa ngokungadedelwa ngebheyili.Nokho ukhale ngokuthi usamethusa namanje umcabango wokuthi ubehleli endlini nomuntu obephezu komqondo wokweba ingane yakhe."Indlela ebengimthemba ngayo, bengikhululeka ngaphakathi ngisho ngisemsebenzini, ngize ngingabafoneli nokubafonela ukubabheka ukuthi bakahle yini ngoba bengazi ukuthi ingane yami isezandleni eziphephile ngendlela ebengimbona eyithanda ngayo,” kusho uNksz Mhlongo. Uthe bese zintathu izinyanga umsolwa ebasebenzela, waveza ukuthi ingane yakhe ibingasalali ngisho nasembedeni wayo, ilala kokamsolwa egumbini lakhe."Uthando abenalo kumntanami belwenza ukuthi ngisho sesimholela, simnike imali engaphezu kwale esasivumelane ngayo ngesikhathi efika ezosebenza. Sonke emndenini besingamphathisi okwesisebenzi, ubefana nodadewethu. Ngimkhululekele kakhulu. Ngisho ngiye ezitolo bengibuya nokudla okuvuthiwe,” usho kanje.UMnuz Simphiwe Qwane - obezitshela ukuthi ingane ngeyakhe - uthe akukho okumthintayo ngokuthi umsolwa unqatshelwe ibheyili. Udadewabo abehamba naye uveze ukuthi naye wake walethelwa ingane eSouth Beach, wathi ubexoxa kwiWhatsApp. Uthe ngelinye ilanga wamfonela nge-video call phakathi kwamabili, wathi: "Buka ukuthi ingane yakini ingishuka kanjani, ngihleli ebusuku angilele.”Uthe bebebuye bashaye amakhala ngayo emndenini, abanye bethi ikhanya kakhulu ngebala, ngesikhathi abanye beba nemibuzo ngezimpahla zamagama ebihlale izigqokile kanjalo nekhaya lapho behlala khona."Besiye sisho ukuthi le ngane inobaba oyinakekelayo ngoba besazi ukuthi umfowethu akanawo amandla angaka okuthi ihlale igqoke izimpahla zikanokusho futhi ihlala endaweni okubonakalayo ukuthi iphezulu,” kusho lona wesifazane. Ngaphakathi enkantolo ummeli wakhe, uNksz S Maharaj ngesikhathi efunda incwadi kamsolwa efungelwe, kuvele ukuthi wakhulelwa ngoJanuwari 2024, isisu sachitheka ngoMashi 2024. Uzikhalele ngokuthi yena wayezivakashelele isoka lakhe, wayengayintshontshanga ingane."Futhi ngesikhathi sengifonelwa, angizange ngifihle ukuthi ngikuphi, angizange ngibaleke,” kusho incwadi efungelwe. Uqhube wathi nengane wayibuyisa ingalimele ndawo. Umshushisi woMbuso, uMnuz Menzi Sikhakhane efunda incwadi efungelwe yomphenyi wecala, uthe umsolwa angalibalekela icala njengoba wakwazi ukusuka nengane eThekwini adwebe abheke eMpangeni. Esebeka amaphuzu akhe, uNksz Maharaj, uthe umuntu usuke emsulwa kuze kuba utholwa necala, wathi akekho onobufakazi bokuthi uzobalekela icala. USikhakhane yena uthe akulona iqiniso ukuthi wabambisana namaphoyisa nomndeni wengane ngesikhathi befuna ukwazi ukuthi ukephi neMpangeni."Kwaze kwasiza isihlobo sakubo kwesoka, okuyiso esayalela amaphoyisa ukuthi kukephi nendawo lapho ayekhona,” kusho uSikhakhane.Icala lihlehliselwe uNovemba 6, 2025.
KUYENYUKELA kwabaphikisa ukuqokwa kweSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini njengoba behlangabezane nenye imbibizane izolo. INkantolo yaMacala aDlulisiwe ichithe isinqumo seNkantolo eNkulu ePitoli, esivuna abaphikisa ukuqokwa kweSilo. INkantolo yaMacala aDlulisiwe ivune uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, obephonsela inselelo isinqumo esichitha isinqumo sakhe sokuvuma ukuqokwa kweSilo. Isinqumo seNkantolo yaMacala aDlulisiwe siphume izolo.URamaphosa wanikela eNkantolo yaMacala aDlulisiwe emva kokuba iJaji Norman Davies, lichithe isinqumo sakhe sokuvuma ukuqokwa kweSilo. Izicelo eziphikisa ukuqokwa kweSilo zazimbili, zagcina zihlanganiswa.Esokuqala sasifakwe abaseka uMntwana uSimakade kaZwelithini, esesibili sasifakwe abeseka uMntwana uBuzabazi Mbuzeli kaZwelithini. URamaphosa wavuma ukuqokwa kweSilo ngo-2022 kodwa isinqumo sakhe sachithwa yinkantolo ngo-2024.Izolo, iJaji Dumisani Zondi linqume ukuthi uRamaphosa walandela yonke imigomo ngesikhathi evuma ukuqokwa kweSilo. UZondi uyalele abaphikisa ukuqokwa kweSilo ukuba bakhokhe izindleko zenkantolo, waphinde wachitha nesicelo sokuba kuqalwe phansi uhlelo lokubheka ozongena esihalweni sobukhosi bukaZulu.Abaphikisa ukuqokwa kweSilo bebekhala ngokuthi akuzange kulandelwe imigomo ngesikhathi kuqokwa iMbube ngo-2021.Okhulumela iSilo, uMntwana uThulani Zulu, uthe isinqumo senkantolo sishayela isipikili sokugcina."Isinqumo siqinisekisa ukuthi wawusemthethweni umhlangano weNdlunkulu kaZulu wango-2021, okwaqokwa kuwo iSilo, siphinde siqinisekise isinqumo sikaRamaphosa sokuvuma ukuqokwa kweSilo. Isinqumo sizobuyisa isithunzi kanye nozinzo."UMntwana uThulani uthe iSilo sinxuse ukuba kube nokubuyisana eNdlunkulu."Lesi akusona isikhathi sokuba siqhoshelane. Lesi isikhathi sokuba sibuyisane, sibambane, bese sisebenzela isizwe."Okhulumela abeseka uMntwana uSimakade, uMntwana uThokozani Zulu, uthe basazohlanganisa amakhanda."Sisibonile isinqumo senkantolo. Into elandelayo ukuthi sizohlanganisa amakhanda, bese sicela isiluleko kubameli bethu ukuze sizonquma indlela eya phambili."Ibhodi lesikhwama esigade umhlaba kaZulu, iNgonyama Trust, isishayele ihlombe isinqumo senkantolo.IPhini likaSihlalo webhodi, u-Advocate Linda Zama, lithe isinqumo senkantolo sizodala uzinzo ebukhosini bukaZulu nasesizweni."Umbango omude wasezinkantolo awukaze waba mnandi. Sihalalisela usihlalo webhodi, iSilo Samabandla. Isinqumo sinkantolo siqeda ukudideka futhi sizodala ubumbano esizweni."Umbango weSihlalo sobuKhosi bukaZulu waqubuka emva kokukhothama kweSilo uGoodwill Zwelithini kaBhekuzulu, ngo-2021.
I-ANC isidwebe ulayini wokuthi akukho meya ezosuswa esikhundleni ngaphandle kwemvume yobuholi bukazwelonke.Le nhlangano ithe bonke abaholi bezifundazwe kuKhongolose, buyazi ukuthi kumele buze ekomkhulu lale nhlangano, buzochaza ukuthi kungani bufuna kususwe leyo meya, kufakwe enye?UNobhala Jikelele wale nhlangano, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, uthe bakhathele ukuthi kususwe abantu abasebenzayo kungekho sizathu esiphathekayo. Uthe kumele beze kuyena bazomnika izizathu ezizwakalayo ngaphambi kokuba kususwe imeya."Imibango yangaphakathi kwi-ANC iphazamisa ukuhanjiswa kwezidingo emphakathini. Uma sekuqokwe usihlalo wesifunda ongenasikhundla, ngenxa yamandla asenawo ube esenxenxa abanye ukuthi bamvotele kwesobumeya. Kube sekukhethwa yena kususwe umuntu osebenzayo ngaphandle kwesizathu esiphathekayo," usho kanje.Uthe kube sekuphazamiseka ukuhanjiswa kwezidingo emphakathini."Izifundazwe ziyazi ukuthi kumele zizosichazela njengabaholi abaphezulu be-ANC ukuthi kungani zifuna ukususa imeya ethile. Siyobe sesiyixoxa leyo ndaba, uma sivumelana nabo imeya leyo isingasuswa. Kodwa akekho ozomane asuswe ngaphandle kwesizathu esiphathekayo," kusho uMbalula ekhuluma nabezindaba ngempelasonto, njengoba kunomhlangano oyisipesheli wesigungu esiphezulu sale nhlangano, eBirchwood Hotel eBoksburg, Ekurhuleni. UMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa uvala lo mhlangano namhlanje kanti uzokhipha umkhombandlela ngezinto ezizokwenzeka njengoba kubhekwe okhethweni lohulumeni basekhaya.UMbalula uthe bazojuba abantu abanamava ekubeni amakhansela kanjalo nasezikhundleni zobumeya."Sizojuba abantu abazi into abayenzayo, hhayi nje noma ngubani. Sifuna abantu abazokwazi ukumela inhlangano okhethweni," usho kanje. Uthe abavoti babeke ithemba kwi-ANC ukuthi ilungise izinkinga ababhekene nazo ezweni."Asizohlanganisa nje kuphela uhlu lwabantu ukuze bavotelwe ngabantu kodwa sifuna abantu abakwazi ukuhola umphakathi. Abazokhethwa kumele bavele emphakathini. Sizobacubungula kahle, singalandeli indaba yokuthi uhamba naluphi uhlangothi," usho kanje.Uthe sebeyabazi abantu abacuthele ukuhlubukela kwamanye amaqembu."Siyabazi abalalisile kwi-ANC ngenhloso yokuthi bavumbuke kwamanye amaqembu. Sizobaxosha kungakafiki ngisho nokhetho. Abanye basebuholini bezifunda, abanye ebuholini bezifundazwe yingakho sizobaxosha, bahambe baye emaqenjini abacuthele ukuya kuwona," kusho uMbalula. Ukhale ngabantu abakhohlakele abagcwele kwi-ANC."La bantu balokhu bekubiza ngomholi, nawe ujabule kanti bafuna ukwenza inkohlakalo kwi-ANC. Abanye bafuna ukushutha nathi, kanti bafuna ukusebenzisa lezo zithombe ngelinye ilanga bethi bazana nawe," kusho uMbalula.Uthe abanye abaholi basebenzisana notsotsi kwi-ANC.
UPHIKE eyokuthi zibalelwa ku-900 izidumbu ezisemakhazeni kahulumeni ezingaziwa ukuthi ngezobani uMphathiswa wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal.UNksz Nomagugu Simelane, uthe zibalelwa ku-700 izidumbu ezisemakhazeni kahulumeni ezingaziwa, ngokombiko wakamuva.Uthe isibalo sezidumbu eminyakeni emibili edlule besibalelwa ku-3 000. Nyakenye besibalelwa ku-1 700. "Siyehla isibalo sezidumbu ezisemakhazeni kahulumeni, emva kokuba inhloko yoMnyango wezeMpilo yaxhumana namaphoyisa iwazisa ngokuthi kunezidumbu ezingaka ngakho sasifuna usizo. Asikwazi thina njengomnyango ukuthi singadedela izidumbu ngaphandle kwemvume yamaphoyisa," kusho uNksz Simelane. Usho lokhu ekhuluma ohlelweni lwamasonto onke lomnyango kwiFacebook. Uphawule kanje emva kokuba ikomiti lezeMpilo esiShayamthetho sesifundazwe ngeledlule, likhiphe isimemezelo linxusa imindeni edukelwe yizihlobo ukuthi izicinge nasemakhazeni kahulumeni ngenxa yokuthi ziningi izidumbu ezingaziwa eziduve kulawa makhaza.Ikomiti eliholwa, uDkt Imran Keeka we-DA, lithe abadukelwe yizihlobo ababike ngokushesha emaphoyiseni ngoba lithole ukuthi zibalelwa ku-900 izidumbu ezisemakhazeni kahulumeni ezingaziwa. UKeeka uveze ukuthi ezinye zazo kuthiwa selokhu zahlala ngo-2017, wathi: "Umgomo uthi isidumbu sigcinwa izinsuku ezingu-21, ngaphambi kokuba singcwatshwe uma kungukuthi indawo ikhona kanjalo nemali. Yingakho sinxusa umphakathi ukuthi uye kocinga izihlobo emakhazeni uma kukhona odukile ukuze kwehliswe isibalo sezidumbu eziduve emakhazeni." UNksz Simelane uthe zintathu izinhlaka ezithintekayo ekungcwatshweni kwezidumbu ezingenabani.7"Izinhlaka ezithintekayo amaphoyisa, uMnyango wezeMpilo kanjalo nomasipala. Umsebenzi wamaphoyisa ukuphenya uma kushone umuntu nokuthi ushone kanjani. Umsebenzi womnyango ukugcina isidumbu, sisigade size sisidedele uma sekumele siyongcwatshwa sekusho amaphoyisa. Umsebenzi wokungcwaba wenziwa omasipala ngoba yibona abanezindawo zokwenza lokhu."Uthe abakwazi ukumane badedele isidumbu bengazi bazosiyisa kuphi ngoba akubona abanikwe umsebenzi wokungcwaba."Ukube umthetho uyasivumela ngabe sisheshe sisingcwabe isidumbu kungaze kuhambe isikhathi kodwa asikwazi ngoba awusivumeli umthetho. Wuhlelo esilusukumelayo ngokushesha lolu," kusho uNksz Simelane. Uchithe nokuthi basuke begweve nalezi zidumbu bengafuni ukusheshe bazidedele ukuze zingcwatshwe."Asizenzi lutho izidumbu ngoba kudingeka kuze kuphothulwe yonke into ngaphambi kokuba ziyongcwatshwa. Yonke into isuke ilele emaphoyiseni ukuthi asho ukuthi sekuphothuliwe ngaleso sidumbu, sesingangwatshwa." UNgqongqoshe walo mnyango kuzwelonke, uDkt Aaron Motsoaledi, waveza ukuthi phakathi kuka-Ephreli 2024 kuya ku-Ephreli kulo nyaka, bangcwabe izidumbu ezingenabani ezingu-3 819.Waveza ukuthi enye inkinga eyenza kube nezidumbu ezingaziwa wukuthi abantu bakwamanye amazwe, basho amagama okungewona uma besezikhungweni zezempilo okwenza kube nzima ukuthola imindeni yabo uma sebeshonile.
BAKHALA ngokudunguza ebumnyameni abasizi bothisha ezikoleni zakuleli, abaqashwe ngaphansi kohlelo lukaMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, lokusiza intsha engatohozi ngesipiliyoni.Laba basizi bakhala ngokuthi njengoba bengaholile, abazi ukuthi bazoya ngani ezikoleni uma sekubuywa emaholidini njengoba bengatshelwa lutho nguMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal.Omunye wothisha okhulume neSolezwe ocele ukungavezwa, ukhale ngokuthi baningi abangaholanga ekupheleni kukaSepthemba. Uthe sebeyahluleka ukukhokhela izindleko zokuya ezikoleni ngenxa yokuthi abaholile. Okunye abakhala ngakho ngukuthi abakwazi nokusiza emindenini nakuba betohoza. "Okusikhathaza kakhulu ukungabi khona kolwazi olucacile oluvela eMnyangweni wezeMfundo kanjalo nasemahhovisi ezifunda mayelana nokuthi sizohola nini. Sisazimisele ukwenza umsebenzi wethu kodwa lokhu kungaholi kusithena amandla," kusho lo msizi.Omunye wabasizi, uthe abazi nokuthi bazogcina beyithole nini imali yabo njengoba kwaziwa ukuthi umnyango unenkinga yemali."Sididekile manje ukuthi ngabe sesiyanikela ngokuvuka nsuku zonke ekubeni singaholi. Sifuna okungenani incazelo ukuze sazi ukuthi kwenzakalani," kusho lo msizi. UNgqongqoshe wezeMfundo eyisiSekelo, uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, uvumile ukuthi kunenkinga yokubambezeleka ekukhokhweni kwemali yalaba basizi.Uthe abasizi ababe nenkinga ilabo abaqashwe ezikoleni, abangakhokhelwa kuzona nguMgcinimafa."Ukubambezeleka kudalwe ngukuthi bekusaqoqwa futhi kusaqinisekiswa ukuthi lolu lwazi luyilo yini. Kulabo abasebenza ezikoleni ezikhokhelwa ngqo nguMgcinimafa, imali yabo ayibambezelekanga, bayitholile," usho kanje. Uthembise ukuthi nalabo abangakakhokhelwa, bazoyithola imali yabo maduzane."Asikwazi ukukhokha kukhona ulwazi olungaqinisekisiwe. Yingakho senze izinhlelo zokuthi sisheshise lolu hlelo ukuze bakhokhelwe. Abafuna olunye ulwazi abaye emahhovisi omnyango ukuze basizakale." UMphathiswa wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka, uthe bayazi ngokungaholi kwelinye iqoqo labasizi bothisha.Uthe kukhona iqoqo elikhokhelwa ngumnyango athe bakhokhelwe, wathi abangakhokhelwe abambalwa abakhokhelwa ngenye inkampani ezimele eyaqokwa kuzwelonke."Iyasetshenzwa le nkinga ukuze bakhokhelwe laba basizi abambalwa," kusho uHlomuka. Babalelwa ku-200 000 abasizi bothisha abaqashwe ukusiza ezikoleni zakuleli. Baqale umsebenzi ngoJuni, nonyaka, kanti bazogcina ngoNovemba ukwenza lo msebenzi.Lolu hlelo lwethulwa ngo-2020, kanti inhloso ukwehlisa isibalo sentsha engasebenzi ngokuyinika isipiliyoni.Selusize intsha engaphezu kuka-700 000 ngesipiliyoni. Le ntsha yenza imisebenzi ehlukene ezikoleni.
UMENGAMELI we-ANC nezwe, uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa, usetuse umsebenzi wophiko oluphenya amacala athinta inkohlakalo nokukhwabanisa kuleli, i-Special Investigating Unit (SIU), ukuthi luveza umsebenzi omkhulu owenziwayo ukukhuculula inkohlakalo.Uthe inkohlakalo yenza kungabi khona ukuncintisana okuhle ezweni okuyinto ebukela phansi intando yabantu nokulingana."Sizimisele ukukhuculula inkohlakalo njengoba nemibiko evela kwi-SIU ikuveza lokhu. Sitshengisa nokuthi siyayisukumela into ethinta inkohlakalo kuleli ngoba ibukela phansi ukuncintisana okuhle," kusho uRamaphosa izolo, evala umhlangano oyisipesheli wesigungu esiphezulu se-ANC, eGoli. Wethule namasu avele kulo mhlangano, okufukula umnotho wezwe ukuze kwakheke amathuba emisebenzi.Ukhale kakhulu ngokuthi akumele ngabe abantu bakuleli basabhuqwabhuqwa yindlala nsuku zonke."Akwamukelekile ukuthi intsha eningi ayisebenzi. Abantu babhuqwa yindlala okuyizinto okumele sizilungise ngokushesha," kusho uRamaphosa. Uzibophezele ekutheni kuzona zonke izifundazwe kuzofuqwa umkhankaso wokwakha imisebenzi kufukulwe nomnotho."Kumele silwe nenkinga yezinga eliphezulu lokubiza kwezinto. Ngezinye zezinto ezingamasu esizozenza ukuze kubuye nethemba kubantu." Okunye athe bazokwenza wukuvuselela umkhakha wokuthutha impahla, kubalwa ukubuyisa ukusebenza ngendlela kweTransnet."Sizovuselela amachweba kanjalo nezithinta ujantshi. Sizovuselela nomkhakha we-manganese siphinde siqashe abantu abanamava. Siphelile isikhathi sokuthi kufakwe abantu abangazi lutho." Umemezele nokuthi bazotshala imali kwingqalasizinda ikakhulu emakhaya nasemalokishini, ukuze kuzuze abantu."Sizokwandisa imikhakha efana ne-artisan neminye ezonika intsha imifundaze nemisebenzi ezinkampanini. Sizokweseka nosomabhizinisi abancane ngemali ukuze bathuthuke, bakwazi ukuvula amathuba emisebenzi," kusho uRamaphosa.Uthe bazoqinisa nemikhakha efana nokuthunga ukuze abantu bahlomule ezweni."Sizoqinisa nezohwebo ezwenikazi i-Afrika, sinxenxe namanye amazwe ukuthi abe yingxenye yalolu hwebo. Sizosebenzisa ubudlelwano esinabo namazwe akwi-BRICS kwezohwebo." Ubalule nendaba yokuthi kuzohlelwa kahle isabelomali ngokubambisana namaqembu akuhulumeni wokubambisana kuzwelonke, nasezifundazweni.Uveze nokuthi bayakweseka ukuthi kuqashwe abantu abanamakhono kuhulumeni kungaqashwa ngobuqembu."Kudingeka ubuchule ukuze sikwazi ukwenza izinto ezithile. Ngakho akumele kuqashwe abantu ngobuqembu noma ngokuthi bahamba naluphi uhlangothi. Uqalile ukubonakala umehluko kwezinye izinkampani ezingaphansi kukahulumeni ngenxa yokuthi kufakwe abantu abanamava nolwazi ngokumele kwenziwe," kusho uRamaphosa.
UNGQONGQOSHE wamaPhoyisa kuzwelonke osamisiwe, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, useveze ukuthi naye usekulungele ukuveza olwakhe uhlangothi kwiKhomishini kaMadlanga eqale ngenyanga edlule.Lokhu kulandela ukuvela kwezindaba zokuthi wagxambukela emsebenzini wamaphoyisa, nokwavezwa uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi.UMchunu ukusho lokhu esifundweni akade sibanjwe KwaSokhulu, eMpangeni, la bekuhlonishwa kuphinde kukhunjulwa khona amalungu e-ANC abulawa ngesikhathi sobandlululo, oMnuz Samuel Msweli noMike Mthethwa.Ekhuluma nabezindaba, uveze ukuthi akaze ajabule ngale ndlela ajabule ngayo manje ukuthi akusekude lufike usuku lokuthi aziphendulele."Ngoba ungibona nje anginankinga, sengilinde bangithinte basho ukuthi ngize nini kwikhomishini ngoba angikazi nami ukuthi ngizobizwa nini. Engikufunayo ukuthi ngigeze igama lami ngakho konke osekukhulunyiwe ngakho ngivivile, ngikulungele ukuthi ngivele,” kusho uMchunu.Uthe akafuni ukuphawula kakhulu ngakho konke osekuvelile, naye uyoveza konke akwaziyo phambi kwekhomishini."Ithuba elikhulu nakimi leli eliyovela uma isikhathi sesifikile ngakho asilinde leso sikhathi,” kusho yena.Kulesi sifundo ubonge uMsweli noMthethwa ngokulwa nobandlululo ngesikhathi kusungulwa i-ANC.Uthe kwakungelula ngesikhathi sobandlululo ezindaweni ezifana neMpangeni njengoba kwakungadingeki ngisho umuntu okhuluma ngeqembu labo."Kodwa uMsweli noMthethwa bafa bedutshulwa amaphoyisa ngemuva kokudubula ibhanoyi lawo, bebulawa ngenxa yokuthi abakufihlanga ukuthi bayiliphi iqembu lezepolitiki. Kwakuliwa kakhulu ne-ANC ngaleso sikhathi njengoba abe-IFP babevela kodwa kungabi inkinga kodwa i-ANC iyona okwakuliwa nayo kakhulu,” kusho yena.Uthe njengoba kubhekwe okhethweni lomasipala ngonyaka ozayo, akufunayo njengomholi wokuqala owaba usihlalo eMusa Dladla, uzimisele ukuthi babuyise omasipala abathathwa kubo.Yomibili imindeni yalezi zishoshovu ibonge ukuthi kukhunjulwe izihlobo zayo, yathi nayo iyofela khona kwi-ANC, njengoba bekhuliswe ngayo ipolitiki.Igama likaMchunu seliphathwe yibo bonke ofakazi asebethule ubufakazi kwikhomishini. UMchunu uyamaniswa nosomabhizinisi osolwa ngenkohlakalo uMnuz Vusimuzi "Cat" Matlala nozakwabo uMnuz Brown Mogotsi. Kuthiwa kunezinkulumo eziqoshiwe ezidweba isithombe sokugxambukela kosopolitiki nezikhulu zamaphoyisa asezikhundleni eziphezulu.Ngokobufakazi bukaMkhwanazi, uMogotsi wathumelela uMatlala i-screenshot sengxoxo eseceleni eyayiphakathi kwakhe noMchunu.Umyalezo bewuchaza kabanzi izinhlelo zikaMogotsi zokuhlangana nePhini likaKhomishana kuZwelonke, uLieutenant General Shadrack Sibiya, ukuphothula udaba olumayelana noGeneral Dumisani Khumalo noMkhwanazi.UMkhwanazi uveze ukuthi okwamthinta kakhulu wumyalezo kaMogotsi awuthumelela uMatlala ngosuku uMchunu ahlakaza ngalo ithimba elaliphenya ngokubulawa kosopolitiki.Nakuba ingakapheqululwa ifoni kaMogotsi futhi kungenacala abekwe lona kodwa imiyalezo etholwe efonini kaMatlala ishayisa amakhala. Negama lobengungoqngqoshe wamaPhoyisa, uMnuz Bheki Cele, alisalanga ngaphandle ebufakazini bukaMkhwanazi.
