KUQUBUKE ingwijikhwebu ecaleni lokubulawa kowayengunobhala jikelele we-ANC Youth League, uMnuz Sindiso Magaqa, ngesikhathi umbuso uveza ukuthi ufuna kushenxe uqweqwe lommeli olumele abasolwa ababili kuleli cala. Umbuso ufuna kushenxe u-Advocate Shane Matthews, omele uMnuz Mbulelo Mpofana noMnuz Sibonelo Myeza.Umbuso ufuna ukuthi uMatthews ashenxe ngenxa yokuthi uke wamela inkabi esiphenduke ufakazi, uMnuz Sibusiso Ncengwa, kulo icala elifanayo.Lokhu kuhlaluke ngesikhathi kulalelwe icala eNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu, izolo. UMatthews wayemele uNcengwa ngesikhathi icala liqala.Ngesikhathi esamelwe uMatthews, uNcengwa wayeliphika icala.Kwathi maphakathi nokuqulwa kwecala uNcengwa walaxaza uMatthews, wabe esevuma icala emva kwalokho. Umshushisi omkhulu, u-Advocate Lawrence Gcaba, uthe akusafanele aqhubeke nokumela abasolwa njengoba eke wamela uNcengwa osephenduke ufakazi wombuso. "Kuzokuba khona ukushayisana uma eqhubeka nokumela abasolwa ekubeni eke wamela uNcengwa. Ngokwazi kwami umthetho awuvumi ukuthi aqhubeke nokuba ingxenye yecala."UMatthews uthe akukho ukuphambene nomthetho uma eqhubeka nokumela uMpofana noMyeza.UMatthews uphonsele umbuso inselelo yokuba ufake ngokusemthethweni isicelo sokuba ashenxe. "Lezi zinsolo zibucayi, uGcaba akakwazi nje ukuzisho ngomlomo kuphela. Kufanele alethe isicelo esibhalwe phansi. Kufanele alethe incwadi kaNcengwa efungelwe lapho ezokusho khona ukuthi iziphi izinto esazixoxa naye ngesikhathi ngimmele."IJaji uMluleki Chithi likuhlehlisele uNovemba 6, ukulalelwa kwecala lapho umbuso uzofaka isicelo sokuba kushenxe uMatthews. UNcengwa wagwetshwa iminyaka engu-85 ngecala lokubulala uMagaqa.Ekuvumeni kwakhe icala, uNcengwa waninda uMpofana noMyeza naloyo owayeyimenenja yoMasipala waseMzimkhulu, uMnuz Zweliphansi Sikhosana.USikhosana, osolwa ngokuba ungqondongqondo ecaleni lokubulawa kukaMagaqa, waboshwa kamumva emva kokuba enindwe uNcengwa. USikhosana, osanda kunqatshelwa ibheyili iNkantolo yeMantshi eMzimkhulu, uvele noMpofana noMyeza, eMgungundlovu izolo.Bekungokokuqala ukuba laba basolwa bavele kanye kanye enkantolo kusukela kwaboshwa uSikhosana.Ummeli kaSikhosana, u-Advocate Christo Van Schalkwyk, utshele inkantolo ukuthi akakulungele ukuqulwa kwecala njengoba esadinga isikhathi ukuze afunde imiqulu yecala.Umndeni nabangani bakaMagaqa bathe bajabule ngenqubekela phambili abayibonayo ecaleni kepha bathi basafuna kuboshwe abanye abasolwa abathintekayo.Kubasolwa abathe bafuna ukuthi baboshwe bathe kubo kukhona namaphoyisa angaphansi kophiko lwezinhloli okuthiwa aba nesandla ekubulaweni kukaMagaqa.
KULINDELEKE ukuthi aphinde adedele amabhomu uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, uma esethula ubufakazi phambi kwekomiti lasePhalamende elikhethekile.UMkhwanazi uzokwethula ubufakazi phambi kwekomiti lasePhalamende elizoqala ukulalela ofakazi, ngoLwesibili.Ikomiti lasePhalamende liphenya izinsolo ezenziwa uMkhwanazi zokusebenzisana kosopolitiki nezigebengu eziphazamisa ukusebenza kwamaphoyisa.Kuke kwabambezeleka ukulalelwa kobufakazi phambi kwekomiti kungatholakali uMkhwanazi ngenxa yokuthi waqala ngokwethula ubufakazi phambi kweKhomishini eholwa yiJaji uMbuyiseli Madlanga, nayo ephenya izinsolo ezifanayo.Ohola ubufakazi ekomitini lasePhalamende, u-Advocate Norman Arendse, uthe bazoqala ukulalela ofakazi kusasa.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi kunomhlangano wekomiti wokucaba indlela obungoLwesihlanu.U-Arendse uthe isitatimende sikaMkhwanazi azosethula phambi kwekomiti sesilungile."UMkhwanazi uyena ozokuba ufakazi wokuqala. Uzokwethula ubufakazi izinsuku ezimbili. Ngosuku lokuqala uMkhwanazi uzokuba echaza ngezinsolo azenzayo, uzokube ebuzwa abahola ubufakazi. Ngosuku lwesibili amalungu ekomitini azothola ithuba lokuba apheke uMkhwanazi ngemibuzo. Kungenzeka emva kwalokho abahola ubufakazi baphinde futhi bahlome uMkhwanazi ngemibuzo, lokho kuzoncika ekutheni kukhona yini okuzodinga ukuthi uMkhwanazi akucacise ezintweni azokuba ezishilo ngesikhathi ephendula imibuzo yamalungu ekomitini."Emva kukaMkhwanazi kuzolandela uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa kuzwelonke, uLieutenant General Fannie Masemola, ozokwethula ubufakazi ngoLwesine nangoLwesihlanu.NgeSonto elizayo kuyokube sekulandela iPhini likaKhomishana wamaPhoyisa kuzwelonke, uLieutenant General Shadrack Sibiya.Abanye abazovela phambi kwekomiti kubalwa uNgqongqoshe wezamaPhoyisa omisiwe, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, uNgqongqoshe wezamaPhoyisa obambile, uSolwazi Firoz Cachalia nowayengungqongqoshe womnyango, uMnuz Bheki Cele.U-Arendse uthe abanye ofakazi bazocaca emva kokuvela kukaMkhwanazi."Amalungu ekomitini anquma ukuthi abanye ofakazi abazobizwa bazoqinisekiswa emva kokulalela ubufakazi bukaMkhwanazi. Njengamanje silinde ubufakazi bukaMkhwanazi."Ngesikhathi evele phambi kweKhomishini kaMadlanga, uMkhwanazi wasola uMchunu ngokusondelana nezigebengu eziphazamisa ukusebenza kwamaphoyisa.Wayamanisa uMchunu nosomabhizinisi obhekene noxhaxha lwamacala, uMnuz Vusumuzi 'Cat' Matlala.UMkhwanazi noMasemola baphinde bagxeka isinqumo sikaMchunu sokukhipha umyalelo wokuba kuhlakazwe ithimba lamaphoyisa eliphenya amacala okubulawa kosopolitiki KwaZulu-Natal.UMkhwanazi noMasemola bathi uMchunu akanalo igunya lokuhlakaza ithimba lamaphoyisa.UMchunu akakalitholi ithuba lokuziphendulela phambi kweKhomishini kaMadlanga.IKhomishini kaMadlanga isaguqile, izoqhubeka ngesonto elizayo.
UKUKETULWA kwe-ANC kuMasipala wesiFunda uMkhanyakude kubhebhezele ukungezwani emaqenjini abusa ngokubambisana isifundazwe iKwaZulu-Natal, iGPU. I-ANC isikaza ngisho ukuphuma kuhulumeni wokubambisana ngenxa yokunengwa yisenzo seqembu ebambisene nalo, i-IFP. I-IFP ikhiphe abaholi be-ANC abebephethe uMasipala uMkhanyakude ngevoti lokungabethembi ubuholi babo. Obeyimeya, uMnuz Siphile Mdaka nobengusomlomo, uMnuz Solomon Mkhombo, bakhishwe ezikhundleni emhlanganweni womkhandlu obungoLwesihlanu. Kube sekuqokwa amakhansela e-IFP ezikhundleni zabo.Amaketango obuMeya agaxwe loyo obeyimeya kaMasipala waseBig 5 Hlabisa, uMnuz Comfort Khumalo, kwathi kwesikaSomlomo kwaqokwa uMnuz Pat Madlopha.IPhini leMeya eliyikhansela leNFP, uMnuz Thembinkosi Sibiya, libuyiseliwe esikhundleni.Okhulumela i-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Fanle Sibisi, uthe basazoyifakela izibuko eyokuba ingxenye kahulumeni wokubambisana ophethe KwaZulu-Natal.USibisi uthe ukujikelwa i-IFP eMkhanyakude kubashiye nemibuzo eminingi. "Siyazibuza ukuthi ngabe i-IFP isazimisele yini ukuhlala kuhulumeni wokubambisana noma mhlawumbe kukhona okunye abakuhlelayo emakhosombeni? Sizohlala phansi nobuholi be-ANC esifundeni iNokuhamba Nyawo nobuholi bukazwelonke lapho khona sizocaba indlela eya phambili ngodaba lokubusa ngokubambisana KwaZulu-Natal."Ngeke sivume ukudlala abaholi be-IFP. Uma bekhuluma emphakathini bahambe betshela abantu ukuthi kunobumbano kuhulumeni wokubambisana kodwa emakhoneni benza okuhlukile. Abaholi be-IFP kufanele basho uma sebefuna ukuphuma kuhulumeni wokubambisana, bengalokhu becasha ngesithupha."Ubuholi be-ANC Youth League (ANCYL) KwaZulu-Natal bunxuse ubuholi be-ANC ukuba buphume kuhulumeni wokubambisana ophethe esifundazweni.UNobhala we-ANCYL KwaZulu-Natal, uNksz Lulama Mabude, uthe akuyisizi ngalutho i-ANC ukuhlala kuhulumeni wokubambisana, wathi kunalokho iyalahlekelwa.UNksz Mabude uthe i-ANC ibambisane nezitha zayo ezifuna ukuqeda ngayo."Sekuyasicacela manje ukuthi amaqembu esibambisene nawo aseqhubeka nombhidlangano wokuqumba phansi i-ANC. La maqembu ayenesivumelwano asisayina ngaphambi kokhetho sokuketula i-ANC. Kusobala ukuthi basaqhubeka lapho."Sekukaningi sibona kuphunywa iqhubu nomasipala neminyango ephethwe i-ANC. Inhloso ukuthi kubukeke sengathi abaholi be-ANC bayahluleka ukuphatha omasipala neminyango."UNksz Mabude uthe ayikho into ebambekayo eyenziwe uhulumeni wokubambisana ngaphandle kwezimpi ezibhekiswe komasipala naseminyangweni ephethwe i-ANC."Azikho izindlela ezibambekayo zokuthuthukisa intsha. Umnotho ukhula kancane, awekho amathuba atheni. Sinxusa i-ANC ukuba isabele ikhwelo lokuba iphume kulo hulumeni."

YAYINENHLESE yokukhombisa ukuthi akesabi lutho owayeyisishoshovu se-FeesMustFall, uMnuz Bonginkosi Khanyile imiyalezo ayeyinameka ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ngesikhathi kuboshwa owayengumengameli wezwe, uMnuz Jacob Zuma.Lokhu kuvele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini ngesikhathi kufakaza obhekele ezobuchwepheshe ezinkundleni zokuxhumamna, ophikweni loKlebe, uBrigadier Janine Steynberg.UKhanyile ongaphandle ngebheyili ka-R5 000 usolwa wuMbuso ngokuphehla udlame emphakathini ngesikhathi sezibhelu zangoJulayi 2021.UBrigadier Steynberg uqale ngokutshela inkantolo ukuthi wanikezwa umsebenzi wokubheka konke okwenziwa wuKhanyile ezinkundleni zokuxhumana okungaba ama-video awaphanyekayo kumbe ke imiyalezo ayifakayo.Phakathi kweminye yemiyalezo ayifundile kukhona nowawufundeka kanjena: ''Angisabi muntu mina. Ningabiza amaphoyisa uma nithanda. Niqhubeke nize nibize namasosha.''Kuvelile lapha ukuthi uKhanyile wayephendula othile owayefake umbhalo othi: "Asimenze adume asimkhulekele ufuna ukuya ejele. Kuyophela ngawe wena mfana mhla kwafa uZuma."Okucacile ngemiyalezo ebfundwa nguBrigadier Steyberg yindlela abantu ababephendula ngayo bekhombisa ukunengeka yizinkulumo zikaKhanyile."Asibadingi abantu abafana naye emphakathini kumele basuswe," kusho omunye umbhalo ocashuniwe.UBrigadier Steynberg utshele inkantolo ukuthi uKhanyile wabuye wayisusa imiyalezo ayeyiphanyekile ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, wathi kodwa ngokwenza njalo kwakufana nokuthi uthela amanzi emhlane wedada."Yize imibhalo isisusiwe kodwa sasikwazi ukubona ukuthi kunemiyalezo ayeyibhalile kuvela nokuthi yayibhalwe nini, ngasiphi isikhathi futhi ngamuphi unyaka," kuchaza yena.Ngaphambi kokuba kufundwe imiyalezo eyayibhalwa wuKhanyile inkantolo iqale yadlala ama-video amabili aveza uKhanyile ekhuluma ngokuboshwa kukaZuma."Abashisa imigwaqo mabaqhubeke nokukwenza lokho, ababhikishayo nabo mabaqhubeke benze kanjalo. Siyacela bakithi nisilekelele kuphume uJacob Zuma ejele," uzwakala esho kanjena bese kunanela ihlombe elikhulu labantu ayekhuluma emi phambi kwabo.Ekhuluma nabalandeli bakhe uKhanyile izolo ukhale kakhulu ngokuthi ubukeka unteketeke kakhulu uMethethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika.Uthe kuyihlaya nje ukuthi kungathiwa uyena owaba yimbangela yokuthi kugcine kuphume inqwaba yezidumbu ngesikhathi somtapo. Uthe luyaziwa uhlanga olwaluqotha imbokodo nesisekelo ngesikhathi sezibhelu, wathi kodwa ukona kwalo kuyashalazelwa.''Bakuthatha konke bakuletha kithina ngoba nakhu singabantu abamnyama, kudlalwa ngathi uma kunjena,'' usho kanjena.Uthe bazolwa, ngeke bathule nje bebona kudlalwa ngabo bebhekile."Bacabanga ukuthi thina kasiwazi umthetho banamanga, siwazi kahle yingakho-ke singeke sibavumele ukuthi badlale ngathi bese kphela kanjalo nje," kuchaza yena.Kube nokuphikisana ngesikhathi umshushisi, u-Advocate Yuri Gangai, evezela inkantolo ukuthi kunezitatimende angafuni okwamanje ukuba zidluliselwe emantshini ekhala ngokuthi akagculisekile ngazo.Ukuphikisile lokho u-Advocate Sizwe Cele omele uKhanyile wathi ngeke kuze kwenzeke ngaphandle kokuba kuqale kukhulunywe naye.Imantshi nayo imchithile umshushisi yathi akuhambi kanjalo, yinkantolo kuphela ethatha izinqumo ngodaba lwezitatimende. Phambilini umshushisi wadalula ukuthi bangu-62 sebebonke ofakazi abazobizwa kuleli cala.
SELIDLULISELWA eNkantolo eNkulu icala lokubulawa kukamelaphi wendabuko, uMnuz Qedukwazi Theodare Mzimela (35) owayephinde abe yikhansela le-ABC.Umufi, ongowaseMzinto ngokudabuka owayedume kakhulu ngelikaBeefy, isidumbu sakhe namathwasa akhe zatholwa ngaphansi kwebhuloho eliseMngeni. Izidumbu zabo zaziboshwe izandla nezinyawo zinamanxeba. Amathwasa ayehamba nawo kwakunguMnuz Senzo Ngema (34) noMnuz Phumlani Mbuli (28).UMzimela kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi isithombe sakhe sasatshalaliswa ezinkundleni zokuxhumana kuthiwa unyamalele. Abasolwa kuleli cala ngoMnuz Mthokozisi Goodnam Mqadi, Bheki Sibiya, Ayabongwa Tshibane, Mduduzi Mthethwa kanye noPhilane Sanele Hlongwane. Kwabuya incwadi ivela kulesi sibhedlela iqinisekisa ukuthi ngempela uMqadi akaphilile futhi akekho esimeni esikahle sokuthi angamelana naleli cala. Elandisa inkantolo ngomnyombo wetulo lokusocongwa kukaMzimela namathwasa akhe uMdeni wathi : " Umufi wayekade enqaba ukubuyisela uMqadi imali yakhe ayekade emkhokhele yona ngesikhathi emthwasisa. Eqhuba wathi uMqadi wabe esecela yena ukuba ayenge uMzimela aqambe amanga ngokuthi ugulelwa yimfuyo yakhe makaphuthume azoyelapha. Wathi kwahlanganiswa leli tulo ngoba uMzimela bekwaziwa ukuthi unekhono lokwelapha imfuyo egulayo. Wathi nebala kwenzeka lokho wafika uMzimela namathwasa akhe eSpringfield babathatha baya nabo endlini eseKenville.Ngemuva kwalokho wathi basuka kule ndlu kwayiwa nabo ebhulohweni lapho babulawelwa khona.
Amaphoyisa aseBronkhorstspruit, eGauteng, aphenya isehlo sokudutshulwa kwabantu esenzeka endaweni yokucima ukoma eZithobeni, ngokusa kwangeSonto ngabo-01:30, lapho kufe khona abantu abahlanu kwalimala abayisithupha. Imibiko yokuqala iveza ukuthi amadoda amabili, aziwayo emphakathini, atheleke endaweni yokucima ukoma afuna ukuba omunye wabathengi akhiphe isibhamu sakhe esinelayisensi. Kuqale lapho ukuhilizisana kwazwakala sekuqhuma isibhamu abantu bagcwala indawo bezama ukubalakela, abasolwa badubula benganakile. Uthi lokhu akuqali ukwenzeka ngoba ngesonto eledlule kwahlaselwa omunye umlisa ongunogada okwaziwayo ukuthi unezibhamu ezisemthethweni aziphathayo.Udutshulwe walimala umgilwa ongunogada waphucwa isibhamu sakhe. Abalimele baphuthunyiswe ezikhungweni zokwelapha eziseduze ukuze bathole ukwelashwa. (Munye kuphela umufi ohlonziwe). Umgilwa oyedwa olimele ubekwe icala lokusebenzisa isibhamu budedengu, isibhamu sakhe sigcinwe ngamaphoyisa.Uphiko lweProvincial Murder and Robbery Unit lubhalise amacala amahlanu okubulala nayisithupha okuzama ukubulala. Ithimba leProvincial Serious and Violent Crimes Tracking Team lithungatha abasolwa.

Nokho ngithi angikucacise futhi kusemanje ukuthi okwamanje ngokwemibiko nezethulo osekwenziwe ngokuphenya kwethu akukho okukhombisa ukuthi kunogcobho noma okuthile okungafanele okwenziwe wuMphathiswa wezeMpilo nowezeMfundo,” usho kanje. Eqhuba, uthe futhi uyazi ngodaba lokuthi umama kaMphathswa wezeMfundo wayekhona, kepha futhi wagcina ehoxa kule thenda yezokudla, okungasho lutho olubi ngoMphathiswa uqobo. Uthe futhi wakhuluma noMphathiswa wezeMpilo ngezinsolo zokuthi kunenkampani yakubo eyavela ohlwini lwezinkampani ezahlomula kule thenda, kodwa futhi bathola ukuthi yena uqobo akahlomulanga futhi akahlangene nalutho olungambeka ugcobho othile."Ngakho-ke azikho izinqumo ezizothathwa ngokuxhamazela nangokulandela nje umoya ovunguzayo ngaleso sikhathi, kepha kukho konke okuzokwenzeka manje sizoqinisekisa ukuthi siqoqa ubufakazi obanele nobunesisindo, bese kuthi uma kukhona okudingeka ukuthi bashushiswe noma bathathelwe izinyathelo ezithile, kuzoba njalo nje,” kusho uNdunankulu. UNtuli uveze nokuthi kumanje uhlela ukuthi amise emsebenzini inhloko yoMnyango wezokuThutha esifundazweni uMnuz Siboniso Mbhele, osolwa ngokuthi waba nesandla ekungaphatheni kahle imali yalo mnyango. Uthe lokho kuzokwenzeka uma esebuye ekhefini lokugula akulona manje, bese eqhubeka nokuphenya ngalezo zinsolo.Udalule nokuthi njalo ngesonto kuze kuphele le nyanga uzohlale ekhipha umbiko webanga eselihanjiwe ukuphenya ngakho konke okungahambi kahle eminyangweni ehlukene esifundazweni, ngenhloso yokuveza obala ukuthi bewuhulumeni wesifundazwe abayifuni kangakanani inkohlakalo nakho konke okunye okuthiya ukunikezelwa kwezidingo zomphakathi nokuhambisa izinto ngendlela efanele esifundazweni.Lesi sithangami besihanjelwe nawuMphathiswa woMnyango wezemiDlalo, ubuCiko namaSiko uMnuz Mntomuhle Khawula, uMphathiswa woMnyango wezeMpilo uNksz Nomagugu Simelane nebamba likamqondisi jikelele wehhovisi likaNdunankulu, uDkt Nkosenye Zulu.
KUNCONYWE ukuzinikela kothisha abasebenza ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima ezikoleni zaseNingizimu Afrika izolo, kugujwa usuku lothisha emhlabeni jikelele.Izinhlangano ezehlukene kubalwa nezinyunyana zothisha, zikhulume ngazwi linye ukuthi othisha benza umsebenzi obalulekile nonzima kakhulu. Phakathi kwezimo ezinzima abasebenza ngaphansi kwazo, kubalwa ukufundisa amakilasi agcwele, kwezinye izikole kuba nezehlakalo zodlame kanti kwezinye izindawo babanjwa inkunzi baphucwe izinto zabo.UNgqongqoshe wezeMfundo eyisiSekelo kuleli, uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, uthe njengoba bekugujwa usuku lothisha izolo, emhlabeni jikelele, kumele bachonywe uphaphe lwegwalagwala ngomsebenzi abawenzayo. Uthe bacija imiphakathi babumbe izingane ezincane zizelwe zize zibe wutho emhlabeni."Siyabonga ngomsebenzi omuhle eniwenzela isizwe. Anijwayele ukunconywa ngalo msebenzi wenu ofana nobizo. Umsebenzi odinga uthando, ukubekezela kanjalo nokusebenza ngokungenamkhawulo," kusho uNksz Gwarube.Uthe abanye basebenza kushoda izinsiza kufundisa kwezinye izikole."Abanye basebenza ezindaweni okunzima ukufinyelela kuzona kodwa nsuku zonke othisha bayaya ezikoleni. Yingakho siwubonga umsebenzi wabo abawenzayo." UNksz Ella Mokgalane, isikhulu esiphezulu somkhandlu olawula othisha, iSouth African Council for Educators (SACE), ubonge othisha ngomsebenzi omuhle abawenzayo.Uthe basebenza ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima, uthwalo womsebenzi osemahlombe abo besebenza ngaphandle kokukhalaza."Nisebenza kunzima kodwa niqhubeke niyibambe ishisa. Siyabonga ngenikwenzayo ngoba kunzima ukwenza lo msebenzi wokuvuka nsuku zonke uyofundisa abafundi abevile ku-70 ekilasini elilodwa," usho kanje. Uthe noma kungabakhona ubuchwepheshe obusezingeni kodwa akekho ongavala isikhala sikathisha ezikoleni.Inyunyana yothisha, iSadtu, ithe lolu suku laqala ukugujwa ngo-1994, emva kokuba i-UNESCO ithe kumele kubungazwe umsebenzi omuhle owenziwa othisha.Ithe lolu suku lugujwa nje ucwaningo lwenyuvesi iStellenbosch, lusanda kuveza ukuthi abanye othisha bacabanga ukulaxaza umsebenzi ngenxa yezimo ezinzima abasebenza ngaphansi kwazo."Mningi umsebenzi ababhekana nawo nsuku zonke, amakilasi agcwele, abasekwa ngendlela, kunodlame kwezinye zezikole kanti kuphinde kukhule nenkinga yabafundi abangahloniphi. Noma kunjalo kodwa siyawubonga umsebenzi wothisha wokuyibamba ishisa," kusho iSadtu. Inxuse umphakathi ukuthi weseke othisha, uhulumeni andise isibalo sothisha aphinde alungise ingqalasizinda."Kumele basekwe ngabaluleki bezengqondo othisha. Abafundi kumele bahloniphe benze kube lula kothisha ukuthi basebenze," kuqhuba iSadtu.Inxuse othisha ukuthi bahloniphe umsebenzi wabo baphinde bayeke nomkhuba wokulala nabafundi.INaptosa ithe othisha yibona mgogodla wesizwe ngoba yibona abakha amaphoyisa, abahlengikazi, odokotela, onjiniyela neminye imikhakha.Ithe kumele balulekwe ngokwezengqondo ngenxa yezinselelo abasebenza ngaphansi kwazo nsuku zonke.

Inkampani entsha yacela ukuba kwengezwe enye imali phezu kwale diphozithi yemali aqashwa ngayo yize kwase kukhokhelwe iThikho Events."UKetwa uthe uSelaelo usehluleke wancama ukubuyisa le mali kwabathintekayo njengoba uRingo agcina engafikanga emcimbini. LIBASHONELE abesifazane ababili baseThekwini okuthiwa batholana ekhasini likaFacebook iLadies House badayiselana usana olwatholwa lushonile KwaMashu kwa-D ngo-Agasti kulo nyaka. Ngokuthola kweSolezwe, owesifazane okusolwa ukuthi ungunina wosana wangempela, ongowaseMlaza kwa-N, uboshwe ngoMsombuluko. Kuthi lona okuvela ukuthi udayiselwe, waboshwa ngoLwesihlanu KwaMashu. Ngokusho komthombo olwazi ukusuka nokuhlala udaba, ocele ukungadalulwa, insumansumane iqale ngo-Agasti 18, owesifazane waKwaMashu eshayela umngani wakhe ucingo, emtshela ukuthi usevele watetela ekhaya. "Ube esemazisa ukuthi kodwa ingane ivele yakhala kanye, yathula. Umngani wambuza ukuthi umtshelile yini umyeni wakhe ngosekumehlele, waveza ukuthi akakamtsheli,” kusho umthombo.Uqhube wathi umngani uvele wamfonela yena umyeni, oshaye imoto wamlanda, banikela endaweni yesigameko."Bamfice elugeza usana, kubonakala ukuthi lushonile,” kusho umthombo. Uthe babe sebemncenga ukuthi kuyiwe esibhedlela, nokuyinto abengayifuni, eshaya phansi ngonyawo ethi akayiswe kubo eNkandla ukuze luyongcwatshwa masishane ngoba usebatshelile nokuthi ababe bemba igodi.Uthe umyeni uvele wavele washaya imoto wayikhomba emsebenzini kanina enkabeni yeTheku, okwathi uma etshelwa ngodaba, wakhipha umyalelo wokuthi akuyiwe esibhedlela."Emgwaqweni lona wesifazane kuthiwa wayengakhululekile, efuna nokuphuma imoto ihamba, engayizwa eyokuthi uyiswa esibhedlela,” kusho umthombo, othe sekufikiwe esibhedlela iKing Dinuzulu, kuphele amahora amathathu kuliwa nokuthi angene ngaphakathi kodokotela. Udalule ukuthi esengenile ngaphakathi, esehlolwa wodokotela kwavela ukuthi akakaze akhulelwe."Ubengophi, amabele engenabisi kanti nokuhlolwa kwegazi emzimbeni wakhe kwaveza imiphumela ethi akakaze akhulelwe. Udokotela uvele wanquma ukuthi kubizwe amaphoyisa,” kusho umthombo.Uqhube wathi isidumbu sosana, esasinezibazi ezingxenyeni ezehlukene zomzimba, sagcina sihanjiswa emakhazeni kahulumeni ukuze kuyohlolwa imbangela yokuphuma komphefumulo. Imiphumela yakhona ibuye ngoLwesine olwedlule ibaphika bobabili ukuthi bahlobene nosana, yilapho eboshwe khona ngakusasa owesifazane,” kusho umthombo. Udalule ukuthi uphenyo lwamaphoyisa lubuye lwawaholela eMlaza ngoMsombuluko, ayobopha owesifazane okusolwa ukuthi ungunina wosana wangempela.Uthe kuvele ukuthi unina ongungqo wabhala ekhasini likaFacebook iLadies House, efuna usizo ngokukhipha isisu. "Kuthiwa bagcina bexoxa eceleni, lona waKwaMashu, ethi akamdayisele yona ingane uma isizelwe. Amaphoyisa awakatholi-ke ukuthi izalelwephi kahle hle, yasuka kanjani kunina wangempela, yeza kulo etholwe kuye isiyisidumbu. Nokuthi ibulawe yini akukaveli,” usho kanje. Isolezwe lithole ukuthi lona waKwaMashu uvele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseNtuzuma ngoMsombuluko, kwathi owaseMlaza wavela enkantolo efanayo izolo. Amacala abo ahlehliselwe uLwesibili oluzayo ukuze bafake isicelo sebheyili.
UVEZE ukuthi sibulimaze sabuqeda ubudlelwano phakathi kwakhe noyise isigameko sokudlwengulwa kwendodakazi, owesifazane waseGengele, eMtubatuba.Ukusho lokhu ngoLwesithathu ngesikhathi iNkantolo yesiFunda eMtubatuba imgixabeza udilikajele uyise (56) ngecala lokudlwengula umgilwa owayeneminyaka eyisihlanu ngesikhathi kwenzeka isigameko ngoDisemba 2023.Unina kamgilwa ebhala isitatimende esilandisa ngokuthi isehlakalo sibakhahlameze kangakanani uthe: "Ngiphoxekile ngezenzo zikababa, bengimethemba kakhulu. Isigameko sibudungile ubudlelwano bethu.” Ngosuku lwesigameko kuthiwa umgilwa wasuka ngezikhathi zantambama evakashela uyisemkhulu kwenye indlu ekhona egcekeni. Kuthiwa wabuya emuva kwesikhathi wabikela unina ukuthi unegazi esikhindini sangaphansi. Kuvela ukuthi unina wambuza ukuthi udliwe yini, umgilwa waphumela obala ngomkhuba awugilwe uyisemkhulu. Ngesikhathi kuqulwa icala, uMshushisi woMbuso, uSphelele Precious Mdluli, ubize ofakazi phakathi kwabo okukhona unina kamgilwa osho ubufakazi obuhambisana nobendodakazi yakhe. Kwaphinde kwabizwa nodokotela owahlola umgilwa, naye owaveza ukuthi umonakalo awubona ngesikhathi emhlola, wawuhambisana nezinsolo zokuthi udlwenguliwe. Ngale kwesigwebo sikadilikajele, inkantolo iphinde yanquma ukuthi lona wesilisa akafanelwe wukuba nemvume yokuphatha isibhamu. Yaphinde yakhipha umyalelo wokuthi igama lakhe lifakwe ohlwini lwabanukubeza ngokocansi.Okhulumela i-National Prosecuting Authority (NPA) KwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Natasha Ramkisson-Kara, uthe bayasamukela isigwebo esikhishwe yinkantolo. "Ummangalelwa wayengumuntu othenjiwe kodwa wakusebenzisa kabi lokho. Sinethemba lokuthi isigwebo sizoxwayisa nabanye,” usho kanje. Khonamanjalo, iNkantolo yesiFunda eNkandla imgwebe udilikajele owesilisa (41) olahlwe yicala lokudlwengula intombazane eyayineminyaka engu-17 ngesikhathi kwenzeka isigameko ngoNovemba 2022. Ngesikhathi kuqhubeka icala enkantolo kwavela ukuthi umgilwa wayeyisiqashi kubo kalona wesilisa ngesikhathi ehlelwa wumshophi. Kuthiwa ngosuku lwesigameko, owesilisa wanikela endlini kamgilwa ngezithuba zasekuseni, wangqongqoza. Kuvele ukuthi kwathi uma umgilwa evula, wangena wamdlwengula. Kuthiwa umgilwa owaqhubeka nokuya esikoleni, wafike walubika udaba.Akagcinanga lapho njengoba kuthiwa waphinde wabikela unina kanjalo nonina wowesilisa ngokwenzekile. Kuvela ukuthi udaba lwabikwa ngokushesha emaphoyiseni, waphuthunyiswa esibhedlela nokwaholela ekutheni owesilisa azinikele emaphoyiseni ngakusasa.Kuleli cala uMshushisi uPhilile Shilenge ubize ofakazi okungunina kamgilwa nodokotela, kwase kwethulwa nobufakazi bolibofuzo obuninde owesilisa. Ebhala isitatimende esilandisa ngokuthi isehlakalo simkhahlameze kangakanani umgilwa uthe isigameko simphazamise kakhulu emqondweni. "Esikoleni sengidonsa kanzima ezifundweni zami. Isithombe sesigameko silokhu sibuya emqondweni futhi ngizizwa ngiyisiboshwa emzimbeni wami,” kusho umgilwa esitatimendeni. Ngaphezu kwesigwebo, inkantolo inqume nokuthi owesilisa akumfanele ukuba nemvume yokuphatha isibhamu futhi igama lakhe lizofakwa ohlwini lwabanukubeza ngokocansi.I-NPA iphinde yakwamukela ukuphothulwa kwecala, yathi izimisele ukulwela abagilwa ukuze bathole ubulungiswa.
NgoLwesihlanu, isilomo somculi we-hip-hop besihleli sibheke phansi ngesikhathi ijaji limgweba iminyaka emine ejele nezinyanga ezimbili. NgoJulayi, uCombs, 55, atholwa emsulwa emacaleni okushushumbisa ucansi kanye nokukhwabanisa - ayengase agwetshwe udilikajele - kodwa watholwa enecala lokuhamba eyodayisa ngomzimba ehilela izintombi ayethandana nazo, uCassandra Ventura kanye no "Jane". NgoLwesihlanu, iJaji u-Arun Subramanian litshele uCombs ukuthi ngamacala akhe kanye nokuhlukunyezwa kwezintombi zakhe zakudala limgweba izinyanga ezingu-50 ejele kanye nenhlawulo engu-$500,000. Ngesikhathi likhipha isigwebo ijaji lichaze indlela u-Combs asebenzisa ngayo udumo namandla akhe ukuze "athobe" izisulu zakhe.Ngemuva kokwehliswa kwesigwebo uP Diddy uphenduke wabheka isixuku samalungu omndeni nabangane abebegcwele enkantolo ngemuva kwakhe. Wabonakala ekhuluma nomyalezo kubo: "Ngiyanithanda, ngiyaxolisa."Kuthiwa kuqhume isililo ezinganeni zakhe zikhala ngokuthi azisenaye ubaba.
Kubikwa ukuthi bagejile oshayasibhamu abahamba imoto yemali beyimisa ngebhomu kuMain Reef Road, eRobertsville, namuhla ekuseni.Imibiko yabazibonele ngawabo kanye nemibiko yokuqala ikhomba ukuthi abasolwa basebenzisa izimoto eziningi, okuhlanganisa i-Audi A4 esiliva, i-BMW emhlophe, iMahindra SUV neVW Amarok.Kuthiwa basebenzise iMahindra ukushayisa imoto yemali ukuze ime ngaphambi kokuyiqhumisa, nayo iMahindra ishe yangqongqa.Uphenyo oluqhubekayo luveze ukuthi iveni yemali ibingenayo imali ngesikhathi sesigameko. Abezimo eziphuthumayo nabezicishamlilo bafike ngokushesha endaweni yesigameko, lapho bethole khona imoto yemali ivutha amalangabi. Basebenze ngokushesha ukubhula ilangabi.

Indlela esiphethwe ngayo lapha ungathi kuphethwe izinto nje ezingathi shu," kusho yena.Okhulumela uMnyango wokuHlaliswa KwaBantu KwaZulu Natal, uMnuz uNdabezinhle Sibiya, uthe ngebhadi abanawo amandla okuguqula imithetho yebhilidi.Uthe nangesikhathi bexoshwa eBayside kwaba nesikhalo sokuthi baphuza utshwala futhi baphula izinto."Ngesikhathi befakwa kuleli bhilidi kwakhulunywa kahle ngendaba yemithetho yakhona, kwavunyelwana. Ayikho nenye indawo esasingayithola ngaphandle kwaleli bhilidi abanye babenqaba ngoba bazi ukuthi laba bantu bayahlupha," usho kanjena.
IGCINE ixazululekile inkinga ebifufusa yokungathengwa kwezincwadi zokufunda ezikoleni zaKwaZulu-Natal ngonyaka ozayo njengoba uMnyango wezeMfundo usuthole imali negunya lokuthenga lezi zinsiza.Lo mnyango unikwe imvume wuMnyango kaMgcinimafa ukuthi uqhubeke nokuthenga izincwadi kanjalo ne-stationery emva kokuba sekunemali engu-R1.2 billion, yokwenza lo msebenzi.Lokhu kuvezwe wuMphathiswa woMnyango kaMgcinimafa uMnuz Francois Rodgers, emuva komhlangano nozakwabo wezeMfundo uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka, esithangamini nabezindaba eMgungundlovu izolo."Umnyango wezeMfundo usuzoqhubeka nokuthenga izincwadi ne-stationery sangonyaka ozayo ezikoleni. Kuno-R1.2 billion wokwenza lo msebenzi . Asifuni kube nokuphazamiseka kwezemfundo esifundazweni," kusho uRodgers. UHlomuka uthe njengoba bephethe umnyango bebenohlelo abebelwenzile ukubhekana nale nkinga."Siyaqhubeka nezinhlelo zethu zokuthi sithenge lezi zinsiza zangonyaka ozayo ukuze zihanjiswe. Sifuna ukuthi kuthi kuqala unyaka ozayo, zibe sezikhona zonke izincwadi ne-stationery ezikoleni zethu," kusho uHlomuka.URodgers uthe sekulele eMnyangweni wezeMfundo ukuthi udedele imali yezincwadi ngoba isikhona. UHlomuka uthe bebelinde uMgcinimafa ukuthi agunyaze bese beqala uku-oda izincwadi."Sinezinhlelo zokuthi lezi zinsiza zizohanjiswa kanjani ezikoleni ngoba asifuni kube nento ezophazamisa. Esingakuqinisekisa wukuthi zonke izikole zizothola lezi zinsiza. Nalezo zikole ezizithengela izincwadi zizothola," kusho uHlomuka.URodgers uchithe nokuthi wumnyango wakhe obugoloza ukukhipha le mali yezincwadi."Kumele singenelele lapho kudingeka khona singumnyango kaMgcinimafa. Umnyango wezemfundo ungaphansi kwesigaba u-18, sokusetshenziswa kwemali okuyinto eyagunyazwa nayiKhabhinethi. Anginawo amandla okufaka umnyango ngaphansi kweso lomlawuli, kodwa wuNgqongqoshe wezeziMali kuzwelonke onalawo mandla," kusho uRodgers. Laba baPhathiswa basho kanje nje bekunemvunge yokuthi zihgase zingafiki ngesikhathi izincwadi ngenxa yokuthi kuze kube yimanje azikathengwa. Bekusolwa uMgcinimafa ngokuthi ugoloze nemali njengoba uMnyango wezeMfundo ungakwazi ukuthenga noma yini ngaphandle kokugunyazwa nguMgcinimafa.Bekunokwesabela nokuthi kungase kuphazamiseke nezivivinyo ngenxa yokuthi ezinye zezinsiza ezihanjiswa nezincwadi, zisiza uma sekubhalwa izivivinyo eziqala uma sekubuywa emaholidini.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi nyakenye iSadtu yaphazamisa ukubhalwa kwezinye zezivivinyo ikhala ngokuthi ayifakiwe imali yezikole eyaziwa ngama-norms and standards. UHlomuka uthe yonke into isimi ngomumo mayelana nokubhalisa izivivinyo."Sikulungele ukubhalisa izivivinyo hhayi ezika-matric kuphela kodwa nezakwamanye amabanga. Sisalelwe yizinsuku ezingaphansi kuka-20, ngaphambi kokuba kuqale izivivinyo zika-matric. Nakwamanye amabanga sesimi ngomumo ngezivivinyo," kusho uHlomuka.Uthe abafuni ukuthi kube nokuputshuka kwamaphepha ka-matric, okuyinto engakenzeki kulesi sifundazwe, kodwa edlanga kwezinye izifundazwe minyaka yonke."Ezokuphepha ekubhalweni kuka-matric ziqiniswe kakhulu. Ngizoke ngithathe uzakwethu (Rodgers), ngimyise lapho kugaywa khona amaphepha ka-matric. Izinga lokuphepha liphezulu, akungeni ngisho umakhalekhukhwini, kwaphepha elizobhalwa awuliboni ngenxa yendlela ezokuphepha eziqiniswe ngayo," kuqhuba uHlomuka.

IYAMQWASHISA uNobhala Jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, eyokumataniswa kwe-ANC noMnuz Brown Mogotsi, okuvela ukuthi ubecela imali ephindelela kusomabhizinisi obhekene noxhaxha lwamacala, uMnuz Vusumuzi "Cat" Matlala. UMbalula uthe i-ANC ayisoze yazihlanganisa nabantu abafana noMogotsi.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba, izolo.Igama likaMogotsi lisematheni kulezi nsuku njengoba lindiza phezulu kwikhomishini ephenya izinsolo ezenziwa uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi. IKhomishini eholwa yiJaji Mbuyiseli Madlanga izwe ukuthi uMogotsi ubecela imali kuMatlala. Le mali uMogotsi ubesuke eyifunela ukuyisebenzisela izinto ze-ANC.UNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa omisiwe, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, wachaza uMogotsi njengeqabane lakhe.UMbalula uthe kuyayilulaza i-ANC ukuyamaniswa nabantu abafana noMogotsi."Uma kuwukuthi uMogotsi uyilona ngempela ilungu le-ANC, akasona isibonelo esihle selungu le-ANC. Lo muntu uthinteka ezinsolweni zokuhamba ecela imali egameni le-ANC. Izenzo zakhe zingcolisa igama le-ANC. Kuzofanele achaze ngalezi nsolo abekwa zona. Siyazi ukuthi lapha ezweni abantu banelungelo lokuziphendulela uma bebhekene nezinsolo kodwa inhlangano enkulu njenge-ANC ayikwazi ukuyamaniswa nabantu abafana noMogotsi."UMbalula uthe bazoqala uphenyo lokuthola ukuthi ngabe uMogotsi uyilo ngempela yini ilungu le-ANC."Uma eyilona ngempela ilungu le-ANC uzothathelwa izinyathelo ezifanele. I-ANC ayisoze yazimatanisa nabantu abafana noMogotsi. Laba abantu abenza izinto ezingalungile bebe besebenzisa ukuthi bangamalungu e-ANC. Baze bazishaye isifuba ukuthi bangamalungu e-ANC ekubeni benza izinto ezidicilela phansi isithunzi se-ANC. I-ANC angeke ikuvume lokhu."UMbalula uthe abahambisani nenkohlakalo, wathi basuke bengathunyiwe yi-ANC bonke labo abenza inkohlakalo."Akekho umuntu osolwa enkohlakalweni esizomvikela. Asihambisani nenkohlakalo ngoba yenza ukuthi abantu bengazitholi izidingo."UMbalula uthe onke amalungu e-ANC okuvele amagama awo kwiKhomishini kaMadlanga kuzofanele aye koziphendulela phambi kwayo.Amagama abaholi be-ANC asavelile okwamanje kwikhomishini kubalwa elikaMchunu, elaloyo owayengungqongqoshe wezamaPhoyisa, uMnuz Bheki Cele, nelobeyinxusa lakuleli eFrance osanda kutholakala eshonile, uMnuz Nathi Mthethwa."Siyaweseka umsebenzi owenziwa iKhomishini kaMadlanga. Bonke abathintekayo kufanele bayoziphendulela."UMbalula uveze ukuthi uMchunu uzovela phambi kwekomiti lezobuqotho kwi-ANC.UMchunu ubhekene nezinsolo zokusondelana nezigebengu eziphazamisa ukusebenza kwamaphoyisa.Ngokwezinsolo, uMchunu usondelene noMogotsi.Kunezinsolo zokuthi kukhona imali etholwa uMchunu kuMatlala.UMchunu uphinde asolwe ngokwephula umthetho ngesikhathi ekhipha umyalelo wokuba kuhlakazwe ithimba lamaphoyisa eliphenya amacala okubulawa kosopolitiki KwaZulu-Natal.
INGASE ilahlekelwe uMasipala waseMkhanyakude i-ANC njengoba kuzolalelwa isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bomkhandlu.Kungase kushone elakusasa umkhandlu usunobuholi obusha njengoba kubizwe umhlangano ozolalela isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bomkhandlu.Amakhansela anganelisekile afuna kuxoshwe iMeya uMnuz Siphile Mdaka, uSomlomo uMnuz Solomon Mkhombo, nePhini leMeya uMnuz Thembinkosi Sibiya.UMdaka noMkhombo bangamakhansela e-ANC, uSibiya uyikhansela le-NFPIsiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bomkhandlu sesekwa amakhansela e-IFP namanye amaqembu amancane.Amakhansela anganelisekile asola uMdaka ngokwahluleka ukuhola umkhandlu njengoba ekhala ngokuthi umasipala uyahluleka ukuhlinzeka abantu ngamanzi, uthola imibiko emibi kuMcwaningi Mabhuku Jikelele, nokuthi uyehluleka ukusebenzisa imali osuke uyabelwe.Esiphakamiswe sawo, amakhansela asola uMkhombo ngokuchema, akhala nangokuthi amakomiti omkhandlu awasebenzi kahle.Amakhansela anganelisekile abhalele uMphathiswa wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, emcela ukuba ahlalise umhlangano okuzobhungwa kuwo isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi.UButhelezi ujube iphini lomqondisi jikelele elibhekelele ezokubusa ngokubambisana, uMnuz Madoda Khathide, ukuba liyohlalisa umhlangano uzokuba semahhovisi oMasipala waseBig 5 Hlabisa, kusasa.Amakhansela abhalela uButhelezi emva kokuba uMkhombo echithe isicelo sawo sokuba abize umhlangano. UMkhombo uvumile ukuthi la makhansela ambhalela ecela kube nomhlangano ozobhunga iziphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bomkhandlu.UMkhombo uthe isicelo wasichitha ngenxa yokuthi sasingahambisani nemigomo ebekelwe ukuphathwa kwemikhandlu."Ngathola isicelo sabo ngoSeptemba 22, becela ukuthi kube nomhlangano ngoSeptemba 25. Umthetho uthi kufanele balethe isicelo sabo kusasele izinsuku ezintathu kushaye lolo suku abafuna ukuthi kuhlale ngalo umhlangano. Okunye engakuqaphelayo ukuthi indlela abanye babo abasayina ngayo akusiyona indlela abajwayele ukusayina ngayo."UMkhombo uthe kummangazile ukuthi la makhansela avele anquma ukubhalela uButhelezi esikhundleni sokulungisa amaphutha enze ukuba kuchithwe isicelo sawo.UMkhombo uthe basazonquma ukuthi bazothatha siphi isinyathelo.Sekunesikhathi eside kunombango ngokuphathwa komkhandlu.I-IFP inenkolelo yokuthi kufanele engabe iyona ephethe umkhandlu njengoba iphethe yonke imikhandlu engaphansi koMkhanyakude.I-IFP ikholelwa ukuthi into eyenza ukuba ingawuphathi umkhandlu ukuthi akuzange kubalwe kahle ngesikhathi kwabiwa izihlalo emva kokhetho lohulumeni basekhaya lwango-2021.
ISIZULU sithi "Ziyof' izinsizwa kusale izibongo." Lesi saga sizofezeka kwi-2025 Siyabakhumbula Awards eGold Rush Dome (FNB Stadium) eSoweto njengoba kuzohlonishwa uWelcome "Bhodloza" Nzimande. Umsunguli nomgqugquzeli wale ndumezulu yomcimbi, uMzwakhe "The People's Poet" Mbuli, uthe okwenze bakhumbula uBhodloza amagalelo akhe ekusakazeni nasemculweni kamaskandi. Uthe uBhodloza waba wumsakazi wokuqala ukudlala izingoma zakhe oKhozini emuva kokuba umculo wakhe sewuvaliwe. Uthe ubudlelwano babo babubuhle kakhulu kangangoba uBhodloza wayembiza ngeVoice of Reason."Sagcina ukubonana naye ngesikhathi mina, uRay Phiri noCaiphus Semenya sihlonishwa ngabamaSatma Awards emcimbini owawuseMpumalanga. Ngangingazi ukuthi ngase ngimgcina ngalolo suku."UMbuli uthe nangesikhathi uBhodloza evaleliswa oKhozini, wamumema futhi wamqashela indiza nendawo yokuhlala ukuze azogubha naye kulowo mcimbi.UBhodloza wadlula emhlabeni eseneminyaka engu-73 ngoJanuwari 15, 2021 emuva kokuhaqwa yiCovid-19. Waqala ukuzakhela ugazi emkhakheni wezokusakaza ngo-1978 kusewuRadio Zulu. Wavelela kakhulu kulo msakazo ngohlelo olwaluthi Sigiya Ngengoma, Ziqubuk' Olwandle, Dela Makhasane nolwaluthi Ezidl'Ubhedu. Amagalelo akhe ayaziwa ekuvumbululeni nasekuthuthukiseni umculo woHhashi Elimhlophe, Phuzekhemisi, Umfazomnyama, Izingane Zoma, Imithente nabanye. NakwiSoul Brothers, Abangani, Abakhwenyana, Ladysmith Black Mambazo, Mpangeni Home Tigers, Easy Walkers nabanye, waba nesandla kwinqubekela phambili yabo.Ngokubambisana noSolwazi Joseph "Mshengu" Shabalala weLadysmith Black Mambazo, uBhodloza wasungula inhlangano okwakuhloswe ngayo ukuthuthukisa umculo wesintu iSouth African Traditional Music Association (Satma). Nakwithelevishini wavelela ngohlelo lomculo wesintu ayelwethula noThuso Motaung olwaluthi Ezodumo.Emuva kweminyaka engu-19 esakaza, uBhodloza wabe esephatha lo msakazo iminyaka engu-13 kusukela ngo-1997. Nalapho wafike wayibeka induku ebandla njengoba abamba iqhaza ekusungulweni kwamaSouth African Traditional Music Achievement (Satma) Awards ngokubambisana noDumisani Goba noMshengu ngo-2005.Esengumphathi woKhozi wakwazi ukuvumbulula nokupheka abasakazi abanjengoTshatha Ngobe noNgizwe Mchunu.Esethathe umhlalaphansi waqhubeka nokuvukuza ikhono nge-Umculo Wethu Talent Search. UMbuli uthe uBhodloza uzokhunjulwa noClive Barker, Vuyo Mokoena, Thandie Klassen,John Moshoeu, Gloria Bosman, Dorothy Masuka, Baby Jake Matlala noJambo. Abazohlonishwa besaphila nguPatson Banda noBruce Fordyce.
Sekuvelile imininingwane emisha mayelana nokushona kabuhlungu kweNxusa laseNingizimu Afrika eFrance, uNkosinathi Emmanuel Mthethwa, oshonele ehhotela laseParis kuleli sonto. UMthethwa wake waba ngungqongqoshe weKhabhinethi isikhathi eside, ubebhukhe ikamelo ehhotela i-Hyatt Regency cishe emasonto amabili ngaphambi kokunyamalala kwakhe, ngokwesitatimende samaphoyisa aseFrance nomndeni. Leli nxusa elineminyaka engu-58 ubudala belibhukhe leli gumbi ngomhla ziyi-15 kuSepthemba lapho lizohlala khona kusukela ngoMgqibelo, Septhemba 27, kuze kube yiSonto, Septhemba 28, 2025. Akafikanga ngezinsuku zokuqala kodwa wenza amalungiselelo okuhlehlisa ukuhlala ehhotela ngoMsombuluko. Ininingwane yokungena kwakhe ehhotela namahora okugcina amaphoyisa aseFrance akudlulisele kwabamele umndeni wenxusa, okumanje useFrance, okuhlanganisa nomfelokazi wakhe, uPhilisiwe Buthelezi. Okhulumela umndeni, uSifiso Buthelezi ongumfowabo kaPhilisiwe futhi wake waba yiphini likangqongqoshe wezeziMali eNingizimu Afrika, utshele abeNewzroom Afrika ukuthi amaphoyisa akuqinisekisile ukubhukha. "Ugcine ehlehlisele umhla zingama-29 (ngoMsombuluko) nokuyilona suku anyamalala ngalo, mhla zingama-29 nangempela wafika, yingakho bebheka amakhamera yilo ulwazi abasinika lona,” kusho uSifiso Buthelezi. Unkosikazi wakhe wambona okokugcina ngoMsombuluko ntambama ngesikhathi ehlela ukuhambela umcimbi we-cocktail. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi wathola umlayezo odidayo ovela kuyena.Umshushisi uLaure Beccuau uqinisekise lo myalezo esitatimendeni: "lapho exolise khona waveza nenhloso yakhe yokuqeda ngempilo yakhe."
IKOMITI elibhekelele ukusebenza kwemali yomphakathi esiShayamthetho, iStanding Committee on Public Accounts (Scopa), lizwakalise ukukhathazeka ngokwehla kwesibalo seminyango ethole imibiko enganagcobho.Umbiko woMcwaningi-mabhuku ukhombisa ukuthi iyisithupha kuphela iminyango kahulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal ethole imibiko engenagcobho kunyakamali owedlule. Iyisishagalolunye iminyango eyayithole imibiko enganagcobho ngaloya nyakamali. Lokhu kuvele ngesikhathi ihhovisi loMcwaningi-mabhuku lithulela iScopa umbiko.Usihlalo weScopa, uMnuz Tim Brauteseth, uthe bakhathazekile ngokuncipha kweminyango ethole imibiko enganagcobho.UBrauteseth uthe umbiko wakamuva uveze obala ukungalandelwa kwemigomo ebekelwe ukusetshenziswa kwemali kanye nokwahluleka kweminyango ukuhambisa izidingo kubantu.UBrauteseth uthe uMnyango wezeMpilo esifundazweni usebenzise imali engu-R2.3 billion ngaphandle kokulandela imigomo, uMnyango wezeMfundo usebenzise u-R521 million ngaphandle kokulandela imigomo, kwathi uMnyango wezokuHlaliswa kwaBantu wasebenzisa u-R492 million ngaphandle kokulandela imigomo."Iyaqhubeka nokuba yinkinga indaba yokukhishwa kwamathenda. Umbiko uthole ukuthi kube nogcobho endleleni u-75% weminyango kahulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal ekhipha ngayo amathenda. Amathenda anikezwa izinkampani zemindeni kanye nezabantu abasondelene nabantu abasebenzela iminyango. Le nkinga inkulu kakhulu eMnyangweni wezeMpilo, owezeMfundo, nowezokuThutha. Kuyaqapheleka nokuthi uMnyango wezeMfundo uhlulekile ukuxazulula udaba lwethenda ka-R1.2 billion yokuphakela izikole." Iminyango ebalulwe lapha iphethwe abaphathiswa be-ANC kuhulumeni wenhlanganisela yamaqembu.UBrauteseth uthe iminyango iyaqhubeka nokwahluleka ukuqeda ngesikhathi izinhlelo zentuthuko.UBrauteseth uthe ukubambezeleka kwezinhlelo zentuthuko kwenze ukuthi iminyango igcine isikhokha imali eyeqile engu-R827 million."Izibonelo zezinhlelo ezibambezelekile wukwakhiwa kwesikole iDingukwazi, oPhongolo. Ukwakhiwa kwesikole kubambezeleke ngezinyanga ezingu-46, futhi nomsebenzi owenziwe awukho ezingeni eligculisayo. EWembezi kunebhuloho ukwakhiwa kwalo osekubambezeleke iminyaka emine. Ukubambezeleka kokwakhiwa kwebhuloho kuphoqa abantu ukuthi basebenzise izindlela ezingaphephile ukuze bawele."UBrauteseth uthe babize iminyango eyisishiyagalombili ukuba izochaza phambi kwekomiti ngokwahluleka kwayo ukuphatha ngendlela imali. "Ikomiti ngeke likuvume ukungalandelwa kwemigomo ebekelwe ukusetshenziswa kwemali. Izikhulu zeminyango kufanele zichaze ngale simo, sifuna ukubona bethathelwa izinyathelo okutholakala ukuthi bayaqhubeka nokwenza izinto eziphambene nemigomo."

UBEYINKUNZI emidwayidwa eziyinethile kwezepolitiki obeyinxusa laseFrance, uMnuz Nkosinathi (Nathi) Emmanuel Mthethwa (58), okusanendida ngokufa kwakhe njengoba kuthiwa uziphonse ehhotela eliseParis.Uphenyo ngokufa kukaMthethwa lusaqhubeka kanti kuthiwa izinhlelo zokubuyisa isidumbu sakhe kuleli, zizoqala ukwenziwa uma sekuphothulwe lolu phenyo olwenziwa yizinhlaka zokuphepha eFrance.Ngakolunye uhlangothi ilokhu ingena ilakanyana imiyalezo yokuzwelana ne-ANC, umndeni, abangani kanjalo nezihlobo ngokufa kukaMthethwa. Umlando kaMthethwa uveza ukuthi waqala ukulwela inkululeko esemncane eKlaarwater, eMariannhill, lapho kuthiwa wakhulela khona kanjalo nesaKwaMthethwa, lapho akhe khona.Njengoba nesaga sisho ukuthi "akukho soka lingenasici", ziningi izigigaba abebalwa kuzona kwezepolitiki selokhu aba yilungu lePhalamende. Nangesikhathi engungqongqoshe eminyangweni ehlukene kahulumeni, nakhona washiya kunezinkulumo ngezinqumo ayezithatha ezashayisa abanye amakhala. EPhalamende ngo-2004, ube ngusihlalo wekomiti lezokuMbiwa nezaMandla, waba nangusotswebhu we-ANC ePhalamende.Ngesikhathi engungqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa kusuka ngo-2008 kuya ku-2014, kwaba nesibhicongo saseMarikana, lapho amaphoyisa adubula kwafa abavukuzi ababetelekile abangu-34. Igama lakhe lalivela, kuthiwa ngaphambi kwalesi sibhicongo, wayexhumana nabanikazi bemayini iLonmin. Ngesikhathi kunekhomishini ngokufa kwabavukuzi, wavuma ukuthi njengomuntu owayephethe amaphoyisa, wayehambisana nayekwenza. Kwaphinde kwaba nemvunge ngomuzi kalowo owayengumengameli wezwe, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, oseNkandla. Wakhomba umuzi kaZuma njengendawo engaphansi kombuso wezwe. Kwaqiniswa ezokuphepha kulo muzi kaZuma, ezinye zazo okwadingeka ukuthi azikhokhele yena mathupha uZuma. UMthethwa wagxekwa ngowayenguMvikeli woMphakathi, u-Advocate Thuli Madonsela ngokuthi lo muzi ufakwe ngaphansi kwezindawo ezenganyelwe ngumbuso ekubeni kuwumuzi uZuma ayehlala kuwona kungewona okahulumeni.Waba sezindabeni nangesikhathi kunekhomishini yejaji uZondo, eyayiphenya ngokulawulwa kombuso yidlanzana, lapho kwavela khona ukuthi kwathathwa imali esetshenziswa amaphoyisa ukulwa nobugebengu, ebalelwa ku-R196 000, okwakhiwa ngayo udonga emzini wakhe kwesaKwaMthethwa, eMpangeni.Kuthiwa waphinde wagixabezwa ngesipho semoto lonyanyavu iMercedes Benz, eyayibiza u-R400 000, kusetshenziswa le mali. Le moto kuthiwa wagcina ethi ayibuyiselwe emuva ngoba izintatheli zazimlandela. Ngesikhathi eqokelwe ukuba ungqongqoshe wezeMidlalo, ubuCiko namaSiko kwaze kwaba ngamahlandla amabili, wagxekwa amaciko ayekhala ngokuthi akawanakile. Kwasuka omkhulu umsindo ngefulegi lika-R22 million, ayefuna lenziwe kuleli. Kwaze kwangenelela uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, owathi akahoxise indaba yokwenza leli fulegi elasusa imvunge. Wagcina emxoshile kwiKhabhinethi yakhe ngemuva kwalokho.Igama lakhe lisanda kuvela kwikhomishini eqhubekayo kaMadlanga, ephenya izinsolo zokungenelela kosopolitiki ezinhlakeni zokulwa nobugebengu kuleli.Igama lakhe livele emva kokuba uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, esola uMthethwa ngokugxambukela ophenyweni lamaphoyisa.Umfowabo kaMthethwa, uMnuz Khulekani Mthethwa ekhuluma neSABC izolo, ukhale ngabantu abangasihloniphi isifo, ikakhulu ezinkundleni zokuxhumana.Uthe abantu bazibhalela izinto abazithandayo, ezinye zazo ezingelona iqiniso. Uveze ukuthi ne-ANC ayikabazisi ngendlela afe ngayo.
Owayengumongameli waseDR Congo ugwetshwe intambo ngamacala empi, nokuvukela umbuso.UJoseph Kabila owabuyela ezweni lakubo e-DR Congo ngoMeyi ngemuva kwesikhathi eside esekudingisweni, nokho akwaziwa ukuthi ukuphi njengoba egwetshwe engekho enkantolo. Amacala akhe athinta izinsolo zokuthi ubeseka i-M23, iqembu lamavukelambuso eselenze umonakalo esifundeni esisempumalanga yezwe. UKabila ulahlwe yinkantolo yamasosha ngoLwesihlanu ngamacala okuvukela umbuso, ubugebengu obubhekiswe abantwini, namacala empi, ahlanganisa ukubulala, ukuhlukumeza ngokocansi kanye nokuvukela umbuso. Uwaphikile amacala, kodwa akazange avele enkantolo ukuze aziphendulele.Wenqaba ukuba yingxenye yokuqulwa kwecala wathi "alinangqondo” futhi wathi izinkantolo zazisetshenziswa "njengethuluzi lengcindezelo”. Inkantolo iphinde yamyalela ukuthi akhokheaaa inhlawulo ka-$33bn (£25bn). ISINGENWE nguNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, eyokubambezeleka kokuthengwa kwezinsiza kufundisa okuyizincwadi ne-stationery kwangonyaka ozayo, ezinye zazo ezisetshenziswa uma kubhalwa izivivinyo zokuphela konyaka.Ihlale isusa umsindo indaba yokungafakwa ngesikhathi kwemali yezikole eyaziwa ngama-norms and standards, njengoba izikole ezizithengela izincwadi zisebenzisa le mali ukuthenga izincwadi. Kanjalo nakulezo eziphathelwa ngumnyango, kusetshenziswa le mali ukuthenga izincwadi ne-stationery.Ekhuluma emhlanganweni obungoMsombuluko ntambama abe nawo nabaPhathiswa owezeMfundo nowezeziMali esifundazweni, uNtuli uthe lolu daba selufikile kuyena. Kulo mhlangano wokuzama ukuthola izixazululo ezinkingeni zemali eMnyangweni wezeMfundo, bekukhona noNgqongqoshe weMfundo eyisiSekelo, uNksz Siviwe Gwarube."Sengazisiwe ngendaba yokuthi azikathengwa izincwadi ne-stationery zangonyaka ozayo. UMphathiswa wezeziMali ungazise ngale nselelo ngeledlule kodwa ngathi asilinde kuze kubuye uzakwabo kwezeMfundo, obengekho ephesheya. Ukuze kulungiswe ezinye zezinkinga kowezemfundo sidinga uR3.4 billion," kusho uNtuli. Uthe ukunqanyulwa kwesabelomali sowezemfundo kanjalo neminye iminyango, yikhona okube nomthelela wale nkinga."Ayikho imali ethe xaxa efakwe eMnyangweni wezeMfundo. Sengikhulumile noMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ngezinselelo ezibhekene noMnyango wezeMfundo." UNksz Gwarube uthe lo mhlangano uthele izithelo wathi kuvunyelwene ngezinye zezinto okumele zenzeke ngokushesha. Enye yazo ngukuthi kwenziwe ucwaningo ngesibalo sabasebenzi kanjalo nabafundi."Sethemba ukuthi uhlelo lokubheka othisha nabafundi abayizipoki, luzosiza enkingeni yemali ebhekene nomnyango. Sike salwenza uhlelo olufuze lolu phambilini, kodwa kukhona abakwazi ukuputshuka kulona yingakho sifuna luphinde lwenziwe ukuze kongeke imali," kusho uNksz Gwarube.Uveze nokuthi abazi ukuthi imali engu-R3.4 billion, izoqhamukaphi ukuze ixazulule izinkinga emnyangweni."Sikubeke eqhulwini ukuhanjiswa kwezincwadi ezikoleni. Asifuni kube nokuphazamiseka ekubhalweni kwezivivinyo yingakho sisukumile. Sifuna nokuthi abafundi bathole zonke izimfanelo zabo ezikoleni," kusho uNksz Gwarube. Ubalule nokuthi kubalulekile ukukhokhelwa komasipala abakweletwa yizikole imali kagesi namanzi."Abasebenzi abaphatha budedengu imali kumele bathathelwe izinyathelo. Asifuni imali ebekelwe izinhlelo ezithile kuphela igcine isisetshenziselwa ukukhokhela amaholo abasebenzi. Osonkontileka abakhokhelwe ngesikhathi ikakhulu abahlinzeka ngokudla ezikoleni." Izinyunyana zothisha zisabise ngokuphaka impi uma kungukuthi kuyabambezeleka ukufakwa kwemali yezikole.Nyakenye iSadtu yaphazamisa ukubhalwa kwezivivinyo ngenxa yale nkinga. Othishanhloko bagcina sebekhala ngokuthi sebelala obenyoni ngenxa yomashonisa ababamise kabi, befuna imali yabo.

KUQHUME isililo eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini ngesikhathi kudlala i-video ebiveza owesilisa egwaza ebulala ngesihluku ingoduso yakhe. Kule video ehlasimulisa umzimba, kubonakala ummangalelwa, uMnuz Mhleli Ndaba (31) ebulala ingoduso yakhe uNksz Dima Phohlo (31) esigemekweni esenzeka ngo-Okthoba 20, 2023. Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi lesi sigameko saba sematheni kukhulunywa kakhulu ngaso. Ummangalelwa wakhalelwa ngamasongo kaSigonyela. Kusukela lapho ugqigqa inkantolo ngaleli cala. Umphakathi namalungu omndeni bezwakalisa ukungenami ngesikhathi ummangalelwa ededelwa ngebheyili ngonyaka owedlule. Kule video kuqale kubonakale isango elimnyama lomuzi livaliwe.Ngemuva kwesikhashana, kubonakala ummangalelwa ephuma ehubha umufi. Ummangalelwa uma esemficile umufi ngaphandle kwesango, umshaya ephindelela. Umufi ofake ingubo uyazama ukulwa amphushe ummangalelwa kodwa imizamo yakhe iyaphunza ngoba umane avuke indlobane kakhulu ummangalelwa. Konke lokhu kwenzeka phambi kwezingane zabo ezincane, eyomfana neyentombazane.Ngesikhathi bedane bexabana behilizisana, izingane zidane zingena phakathi kwabo ziphinde futhi zibazungeze. Iyaqhubeka ingxabano yabo. Ummangalelwa ubonakala edane ecifiza ifoni, ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ucingo lwakhe ulubeka endlebeni bese kuphele isikhathi esingangamaminithi amabili ekhuluma nocingo. Ngemuva kwalokho, ummangalelwa ungena ngaphakathi endlini, bese nomufi eyangena.Ngemuva kwesikhashana, kuphinde kubonakale umufi esephuma ngejubane ngaphandle kwesango. Ummangalelwa uyamfica umufi, bese eqala emgwaza ephindelala emqaleni nasemahlombe. Uyaqhubeka nokumgwaza noma ngabe eselele phansi. Umufi ubonakala epaquza eze amdonse ngothayi ummangalelwa. Kodwa usuke esedinwe kakhulu aqhubeke nokumgwaza. Lokhu ukwenza kubuka izingane. Kuthi uma eseqedile ukumgwaza, abuyele ngaphakathi endlini. Uyasala umufi, avuke kancane, kube khona akushoyo ezinganeni zakhe, bese edindiliza unomphelo.Uma esebuya endlini ummangalelwa ufica sekukhona owesilisa ohamba ngesithuthuthu obezama ukulekelela umufi. Ummangalelwa ubonakala evuka indlobane ehubha umshayeli wesithuthu. Kuthi kusenjalo ebese kuqhamuka owesilisa oshayela imoto eBlue iRanger. Lo wesilisa uvele aqonde nje ngqo kumangalelwa efuna ukumcindezela ngemoto kodwa usinda ngokulambisa. Ucasuka kakhulu ummangalelwa, amane aye ewindini lalo wesilisa kodwa naye lo wesilisa ugcina esephelela amehlelweni.Ngesikhathi lo wesilisa oshayela iRanger ehilizisana nommangalelwa, kubonakala umshayeli wesithuthuthu ecathama eshaya ngetshe elikhulu ummngalelwa emhlane. Kusona leso siphiphithiphi, kufika inkampani yonogada ingene ngaphakathi endlini, bese ibuya seyimbophile ummangalelwa.Okuxakayo ukuthi uma esefakwe ozankosi ummangalelwa, ubonakala ekhihla isililo aze anikine ikhanda azishikishe phansi phambi kwesidumbu sikamufi. Ngaleso sikhathi, isidumbu sikamufi sisuke sesimbozwe ngendwangu emhlophe. Okuqaphelekayo ukuthi amaphoyisa aze afika ngemuva kwemizuzu emihlanu kubumbane ihora leshumi ntambama.Enkantolo kumane kwaqhuma isililo ngesikhathi kudlala le video, kukhala abomndeni bakubo kukamufi.Ebebephelezele ummangalelwa bona bebebuka i-video bejulile. Ngesikhathi iqhubeka i-video idlala ummangalelwa ubegqolozele udonga. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, imantshi ibibuka i-video, bese ibuka ummangalelwa, bese ibhala phansi. Ummangalelwa ufike enkantolo eswenke econsa efake isudi elinombala onsundu.Icala lihlehliselwe inyanga ezayo. Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi ummangalelwa watshela inkantolo ukuthi akasakhumbuli ukuthi kwenzekani ngosuku lwesigameko.
ABHOKA ayakhahlela amalungu ebandla lamaRoma Akhatholika athi lingawa licoshwe yizinkukhu - ngeke asivumele isinqumo sokumiswa kokuhlatshelwa kwamadlozi kuleli bandla. Amalungu aleli bandla athelwe ngezibonkolo asephumele obala achaza lesi sinqumo njengesiwubudedengu futhi esithathwe kuxhanyazelwa.Afanisa isinqumo esithathwe wubuholi bebandla njengebhomu elingaqhuma noma nini maqede liphenduke umlando ibandla lamaRoma Akhatholika.UMnuz Vusi Mvelase ongomunye wamalungu aqavile eleli bandla uthe udumele kabi ngalesi sinqumo.Uthe sibehle ngaphezulu futhi namanje akuvumi ukuba bakholwe wukuthi ibandla lifinyelele kulesi sinqumo.Ufunge wagomela wathi lutho eluthela - ngeke bamane bathule nje bagoqe izandla ekubeni bephucwa into abayifundiswa ngabazali babo futhi abazi ukuthi iyigugu kubona."Uma ngishisa impepho kwami angisavumelekile ukuba ngikwenze lokho. Angisavumelekile manje mina ukuba ngikhumbule abangasekho. Ngabe kuyadlalwa ngeke siyivume leyo nto," usho kanjena.Uqhube wathi bashaya amakhala ngokuthi lesi yisinqumo esithathwe ekomkhulu lebandla lamaRoma."Uma kudingeka ukuba lolu daba luze lufinyelele kuPhapha, uLeo XIV, kungamane kube njalo ngeke phela sithule ekubeni sibona kahle ukuthi kudlalwa ngathi lapha," kuchaza yena.Uthe bona bakhuliswe kuleli bandla bazi ukuthi liyawagcina amasiko futhi angumgogodla wokuphila."Thina uma sinemicimbi yokumbulwa kwamatshe simema bona abefundisi bethu bafike bezowabusisa, kodwa manje ngeke besafika! Awungitshele yinto enjani leyo?"Uthe okunye okumane kwamnenga kakhulu ngencwadi evela ebuholini bebandla, kubhalwe nokuthi kulicala ngisho ukusina. Uthe ukholwa wukuthi abathathe isinqumo abacabanganga kahle okanye bebelwa nesintu sabo."Sibaningi kabi esicasukile, asifuni nokuyizwa le nto,'' esho kuzwakala ukuthi uthukuthele.Esephetha ubuze ukuthi bazothini ebantwaneni babo njengoba babafundisa ngamasiko, kodwa manje gwiqiqi sekumele kuhlatshelelwe elinye iculo.UMnuz Bhekithemba Maphumulo, naye oyilungu eliqavile lebandla, uthe akakwazi nokuyibala iminyaka eseyikhonze ebandleni lamaRoma, wathi osekwenzeka manje uyakweshwama."Mina ngikholelwa kabi ezintweni zesintu. Namanje kuduma ikhanda lapha kimina ngale nto engiyizwile. Iqiniso ukuthi lesi sinqumo kuhloswe ngaso ukuba sisetshenziselwe ukucindezela abazalwane," usho kanjena.Ulimise ngesihloko elokuthi le nto iyamcika kakhulu futhi ufuna ukubhodla ngayo kungaze kuhambe isikhathi."Kungaba ngcono kabi uma sinikezwa ithuba lokuphefumula ngalokhu kungakonakali kakhulu,'' usho kanjena.Uthe uma kuya ngokuthi lesi sinqumo asiguqulwa ngokushesha kuyobe kusho khona ukushabalala kwaleli bandla."Ibuhlungu le nto ezokwenzeka kuleli bandla. Phela ngeke siqhubeke sikhonze ebandleni lapho esazi khona ukuthi abanandaba namasiko ethu," kuchaza yena.Uthe okumxakayo wukuthi lesi sinqumo kudalwe yini ukuba sithathwe isigubhukane nje. Ubuze ukuthi bekujahweni le engaka ebiphuthunywa.''Kuyaxaka ukuthi isinqumo esikhulu kangaka kungamane nje kulalwe kuvukwe bese kuthiwa sesithathiwe. Kuyacaca ukuthi leli yibandla labathile thina asinazwi kulona,'' usho kanjena.Isolezwe lithole ngomthombo walo ukuthi lesi sinqumo asifikanga nje nhlobo kahle kwabanye oFata bebandla."Phela kuleli bandla kukhona oFata abayizangoma futhi abaziwayo. Uma ke wena uzokhuluma into enje kufana nokuthi uphehla udlame ebandleni inkosi impela,'' kusho umthombo.Encwadini ebhalwe ngoSepthemba 16, kuvela ukuthi eye into evaliwe wukuthi abazalwane bahambe izangoma, ukuhlaba izinkukhu, ukusetshenziswa kweziwasho, amakhandlela ayimibala, ukubusiswa kwamafutha. UMHOLI we-EFF, uMnuz Julius Malema, ulahlwe icala lokuqhumisa isibhamu. INkantolo yeMantshi e-East London ithole uMalema enecala lokwephula imigomo elawula ukuphathwa kwesibhamu.UMalema ubebekwe amacala amahlanu okungelokuphatha isibhamu ngaphandle kwemvume, elokuphatha izinhlamvu ngaphandle kwemvume, elokuqhumisa isibhamu esidlangalaleni, elokubeka impilo yabantu engcupheni kanye nelokuhluleka ukugwema ukucekela phansi impahla. IMantshi Twanet Oliver imlahle ngawo wonke lamacala.Inkantolo izobuye isikhiphe esigwebo.Icala lisukela esigamekweni esenzeka eMdatsane, ngo-2018, ngesikhathi kunomgubho wokubungaza iminyaka emihlanu kwasungulwa i-EFF.Emva komgubho kwasabalala ivideo ekhombisa uMalema ephethe okubukeka njengesibhamu esikhulu, ekuqhumisa.UMalema ubemangalelwe nomqaphi wakhe, uMnuz Adriaan Snyman.Inkantolo imthole engenacala uSnyman.
ISIPHENDUKE ukuphuma kwentombi emgoqweni eyokukhishwa kwesigwebo ecaleni lokuqhumisa isibhamu elibhekene nomholi we-EFF, uMnuz Julius Malema.Inkantolo iphinde yakuhlehlisa futhi ukwethulwa kwesigwebo ecaleni elibhekene noMalema nomqaphi wakhe, uMnuz Adriaan Snyman.Inkantolo izoqhubeka namhlanje nokwethula isinqumo njengoba imantshi ingazange iqede ukwethula isigwebo nayizolo.Ukwethulwa kwesigwebo kuqale ngoMsombuluko, kwabe sekuhlehliselwa izolo, ngenxa yobude besinqumo semantshi.Imantshi Twanet Olivier iqhubekile nokwethula isigwebo izolo, yabe isilihlehlisela inamhlanje icala.UMalema noSnyman bebevele eNkantolo yeMantshi e-East London, e-Eastern Cape, lapho khona bebhekene necala lokwephula imigomo elawula ukuphathwa kwezibhamu.Icala lisukela esigamekweni esenzeka eMdantsane, ngo-2018, ngesikhathi kunomgubho wokugubha iminyaka emihlanu kwasungulwa i-EFF. Emva komgubho, kwasabalala ivideo ekhombisa uMalema ephethe okubukeka njengesibhamu esikhulu, ekuqhumisa.UMalema uyaphika ukuthi isibhamu sangempela lesi abonakala esiphethe.Amalungu e-EFF abebhikisha ngaphandle kwenkantolo.UNobhala Jikelele we-EFF, uMnuz Marshall Dlamini, uthe angeke bavume ukuthi kuboshwe uMalema."Siyabuya nakusasa (namhlanje) sizokweseka umholi wethu. Angeke bamenze lutho umholi wethu. Angazi ukuthi basabani njengoba bengafuni nje ukukhipha isinqumo."UMalema uthembise ukuthi uzokhuluma namhlanje uma sekuphume isigwebo."Okwanamhlanje ngiyanibingelela nje kuphela. Ngizokhuluma kahle kusasa (namhlanje) ngoba bathe isigwebo sizophuma namhlanje. Noma ngabe icala liyangilahla, noma kuthiwani, ngizokhuluma."
IPHENYWA uhulumeni waseFrance, eyokufa kwenxusa lakuleli elizinze kuleliya lizwe, uMnuz Nathi Mthethwa (58).Ngokwemibiko yephephandaba laseFrance i-Le Parisien, uMthethwa ugcinwe ukubonwa ephila ngoMsombuluko. Kukholakala ukuthi uziphonse esitezi sesi-22 ehhotela i-Hyatt eliseParis, kanti isidumbu sakhe sitholakale izolo.Kuthiwa unkosikazi wakhe uthole umyalezo obungamniki ukuthula obuvela kuMthethwa ngoMsombuluko ebusuku, ngokombiko wephephandaba lase-UK, i-The Mirror.Okhulumela uMnyango wezobuDlelwano namaZwe oMhlaba, uMnuz Crispin Phiri, uthe uhulumeni wakuleli udlulisa amazwi endunduzo ngokufa kukaMthethwa."UMthethwa ulisebenzele izwe njengoba abamba izikhundla ezehlukene okubalwa esikaNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa, owezemiDlalo, ubuCiko namaSiko. Ube yilungu lebhodi elalihlela iNdebe yoMhlaba yebhola ngo-2010. Uyisebenzele ne-ANC." UNgqongqoshe wezobuDlelwano namaZwe oMhlaba, uMnuz Ronald Lamola, uthe akangabazi ukuthi akulahlekelwanga kuphela isizwe kodwa nomhlaba jikelele ngokufa kukaMthethwa."Indlela afe ngayo iphenywa yizikhulu zaseFrance. Sidlulisa amazwi endunduzo emndenini kaMthethwa, abangani, izihlobo kanjalo nozakwabo. Ushiye emhlabeni unkosikazi nezingane," kusho uLamola.Kwenzeka lokhu nje, igama likaMthethwa lisanda kuvela ksiKhomishini kaMadlanga. UKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLt-General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, wathi uMthethwa waphoqa owayekwezobunhloli, u-Inspector General uFaith Radebe, ukuthi ahoxise amacala ayebekwe owayeyinhloko yezobunhloli uRichard Mdluli. IKhomishini kaMadlanga iphenya izinsolo zokuthi osopolitiki babegxambukela emsebenzini wamaphoyisa kuleli futhi besebenzisana nezigebengu. Okhulumela i-ANC, uNksz Mahlengi Bhengu, uthe bashaqekile ngokuzwa izindaba zokufa kukaMthethwa.Uncome iqhaza likaMthethwa, wathi ubezinikele enhlanganweni nasekusizeni abantu."Usebenze ngokuzikhandla eminyangweni ehlukene kahulumeni. Ulethe izinguquko nobumbano ngesikhathi eyilungu lesigungu esiphezulu se-ANC, kanjalo nasekomitini elibhekele ukusebenza kwansuku zonke le-ANC." Uthe bazomkhumbula kakhulu ngeqhaza nangomlando wakhe ezintweni ezithinta imigomo yenhlangano kanjalo nakwezinye izinhlaka abesenza ngokuzikhandla kuzona. Uveze ukuthi bazoweseka umndeni wakhe ngalesi sikhathi sobunzima.UMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, uphatheke kabi ngokufa kukaMthethwa.Uthe uMthethwa ube yingxenye yeKhabhinethi iminyaka engu-15, ebambe iminyango ehlukene."Sidlulisa amazwi endunduzo emndenini kaMthethwa, okubalwa nonkosikazi wakhe uNksz Philisiwe Buthelezi. Ulisebenzele izwe kanti bebubuhle ubudlelwano neFrance. Sizoqhubeka nokweseka umndeni wakhe ngalesi sikhathi esinzima," kusho uRamaphosa.
AKASAFUNE lutho oluzomhlanganisa nomsolwa owesilisa waseMatshana, eMpangeni, "obesembathiswe ibhanntshi" ngengane angayazi.UMnuz Simphiwe Qwabe (36) usho kanje ngaphandle kweNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini lapho obekuvela khona obeyisinqandamathe sakhe, uNksz Lungile Mbonambi (35) ngecala lokweba ingane enezinyanga eziyisishiyagalombili.Umgilwa, inkantolo enqume ukuthi lingabhalwa igama lakhe emaphephandabeni, utholwe amaphoyisa eMatshana ngeSonto emva kokuba ngoMgqibelo uNksz Mbonambi "emebe" eflethini labazali bakhe enkabeni yeTheku, lapho abengumzanyana khona. Ngokuthola kweSolezwe, umsolwa uhambe nomgilwa ngezikhathi zasekuseni, unina esemsebenzini. Kuvele ukuthi unina uze wathola ukuthi indodana yakhe intshontshiwe ngezikhathi zantambama, esefonelwa yindodana yakhe (16) ebikhona nayo eflethini, imbuza ukuthi kanti uyephi umzanyana nengane yakwabo.UQwabe uthe: "Buphelile ubudlelwane phakathi kwami naye. Ayikho into esengaqhubeka phakathi kwethu emva kwalesi sigameko.” Uthe kumjabulisile ukuthi babonane ubuso nobuso noyise wengane wangempela ukuze abone ukuthi yena akasilona isela. "Nami ngangazi ukuthi ngihamba nengane yami njengoba ayengitshelile,” kusho uQwabe, oveze ukuthi indaba yokuthi uNksz Mbonambi ubewumzanyana kuleli flethi yinto abeyeshwama ngoMgqibelo sekuvela ukuthi webe ingane."Mina wayengitshele ukuthi ikwamalumekazi wakhe lapho ehlala khona, hhayi emsebenzini,” kusho uQwabe.Uveze ukuthi kwenzeka lokhu nje bekuvele kukuningi okushayisa amakhala, kangangoba izolo bebehlele ukuthi baye esibhedlela esizimele oThongathi, iVictoria, beyokwenza ulibofuzo. "Ngo-3 ntambama besine-appointment yokuyokwenza ulibofuzo, njengoba lowo-3 usungishayela la enkantolo, eseboshiwe. Bekukuningi khona obekungaqondakali kahle nokwenze saze safika esinqumeni sokuthi kufanele senze ulibofuzo,” usho kanje. Phakathi kokunye uthe bekuyindlela abevele agxume ngayo uhhafu uma kukhulunywa eyokuthi kufanele ingane iyiswe emndenini wakhe (uQwabe)."Nokungayilethi kimina ngendlela egculisayo, elokhu ebeka izaba engingaziqondi ezifana nokuthi umndeni wakhe awuvumi ayilethe ngoba angikayihlawuli. Nami bengimile kwelokuthi ngeke ngihlawule ingane engaziwa ekhaya,” kusho uQwabe. Uthe njengoba ibiye kubo ngempelasonto bekungokwesibili eyibona, waveza ukuthi ubevele adinwe uma ephatha eyokuthi ufuna kwenziwe ulibofuzo.Uthe ngesikhathi embona enkantolo ufikelwe wumuzwa wokuthi usesendaweni efanele ngoba amasela afanelwe yijele.Uyise wengane wangempela, uMnuz Bongani Thabede uthe kumphathe kabi ukumbona esebhokisini labasolwa njengoba ebengumuntu ebebemethemba kakhulu. "Ubeyithanda ingane, eyiphatha kahle. Ayikho into ebesiyisola nokuthi angenza into enje. Ngimbone ebukeka ezisola ngakwenzile. Ngiyamzwela bandla kodwa akukho engingakwenza ngoba umthetho kufanele usebenze,” kusho uThabede.Uthe ubona nokuthi udinga usizo lokwelulekwa ngokwengqondo ngoba isenzo sakhe asibukeki singenziwa wumuntu osesimeni esikahle.Inkantolo icala ilihlehlisele u-Okthoba 6 ukuze afake isicelo sebheyili.
UKHALELA ubulungiswa uyise wengane esencane yaseZwelibomvu, ngaKwaNdengezi, okuthiwa idlwengulwe enye, yavuma isenzo sayo phambi kwamaphoyisa.Ngokusho kukayise kamgilwa, isigameko senzeke ngoSepthemba 4, nonyaka, indodakazi (3) yakhe yadlwengulwa umsolwa oneminyaka engu-12 ongumakhelwane.Elandisa ngesigameko uyise engeke sadalula igama lakhe ukuvikela umgilwa, uthe umndeni wathola ngaso ngosuku esenzeka ngalo ngezikhathi umgilwa egezwa. "Wayegezwa ingane yasemndenini, wakhombisa ukuthi amanzi ayamthunuka ngesikhathi egezwa isitho sangasese. Yathi uma imbuza ingane eyayimgeza, washo konke okwenzekile, ethi ingane yakwamakhelwane ayigagula ngegama, ifake isitho sayo sangasese kwesakhe,” kusho uyise kamgilwa.Uthe balusukumele phezulu udaba, baya kubo kamsolwa beyobuza, wafike wavuma phambi kwabo nomndeni wakhe."Waze wavuma ngisho naphambi kwamaphoyisa aKwaNdengezi ngesikhathi sekuyiwe kuwo,” usho kanje. Uqhube wathi yize azivumela ngowakhe umsolwa, waze waxolisa, bathi uma sebefuna ukuvula icala, amaphoyisa athi ngeke alivule ngoba libandakanya izingane ezincane.Uveze ukuthi abayalela ukuthi okungenani abahambe bayolivula esiteshini samaphoyisa saseChatsworth, esikwazi ukusingatha amacala abucayi abandakanya izingane.Uthe lokhu kwenzeke yize bese bebuya khona kudokotela omhlolile umgilwa, washo ukuthi ngempela udlwenguliwe, wathi amagama awathole elumela ngakhishwe amanye amaphoyisa akulezi ziteshi athi: "Vele icala lizophelela emoyeni ngoba lifaka phakathi izingane ezincane.” Udalule ukuthi icala, angakawuboni umnyakazo walo, lagcina livulwa ngoSepthemba 18, ngoba nakhona esevuka indlobane. "Le nkulumo ayehlanga kahle kimina ngoba ngizibuze ukuthi uma umsolwa eyingane, kusho ukuthi kufanele avele axolelwe kalula kanjalo? Kuthiwani-ke ngalo oneminyaka emithathu okufanele athole ubulungiswa ngokuthi udlwenguliwe?” kubuza uyise kamgilwa. Uthe lokhu ukuhlaziye njengokuthi kusho ukuthi ngisho ingane ingabulala umuntu ngeke yenziwe lutho ngoba kuhanjiswa phambili ukuthi incane."Kanti amajele ezingane ngawani? Kungani umsolwa angaboshwa, ayiswe kulelo jele?” usho kanje.Uthe akulwela ukukubona kwenzeka ubulungiswa ngokudlwengulwa kwengane yakhe, umsolwa abhekane nemiphumela. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe abaphenyi basesiteshini saseChatsworth ngaphansi kophiko lweFamily Violence Child Protection and Sexual Offences Unit (FCS) baphenya icala lokudlwengula kulandela isigameko sokudlwengulwa kukamgilwa (3) ngoSepthemba 4, 2025, eZwelibomvu. Isazi sezomthetho, uMnuz Melusi Xulu, sithe ingane uma yenze icala ngokoMthethosisekelo ayibizwa ngomsolwa kodwa ibizwa "ngengane eyenze okuphambene nomthetho”. Uthe zonke izingane ezenze okuphambene nomthetho ziboshwa ngaphansi kweso labazali bese ziza enkantolo zikhashwa yibo. "Ayihlaliswa esitokisini ngaphandle uma ingenalo ikheli eliqondile (engahlala kulo), uma ibihlala lapho isuswe khona (kosingabazali), uma kusolakala ukuthi izoqhubeka yenze okungafanele, ibe yingozi noma ibaleke, yilapho-ke eyiswa khona ejele lezingane,” kusho uXulu.Uthe kunohlelo lwezobulungiswa olwenziwayo ezinganeni ezisolwa ngamacala lapho izinhlaka zomthetho zisuke zicubungula khona ukuthi (ingane) iyakuqonda yini ukuthi into eyenzile iphambene nomthetho."Lapho kusuke kuzobhekwa ukuthi icala lizoqulwa njengomuntu okuqondayo yini ukuthi wenze icala, ikakhulukazi uma ingane ineminyaka engaphansi kweminyaka engu-14,” usho kanje. Uqhube wathi kulesi sigameko bekungafanele amaphoyisa athi "icala lizophelela emoyeni". "Bekufanele athathe umgilwa ayomenzisa ulibofuzo nobekuzokwenza ubufakazi bokuqala obuqinile. Bese kukhishwa incwadi egunyaza ukuthi ingane iboshwe, bese ifike nomzali enkantolo,” kusho uXulu.Uthe amacala afuze lawa aqulwa enkantolo yesifunda, kukhishwe wonke umuntu, lithethwe ungekho umphakathi ukuze kuvikeleke izingane. "Ngisho ingaba neminyaka engaphansi kwengu-12, ubulungiswa buyafuneka nakuyona uma yenze okuphambene nomthetho, akuvele kuyekwe, kufakwa nosonhlakahle babheke ukuthi iyaqonda yini ukuthi yenze icala,” usho kanje.
USAKHALELA ubulungiswa owesifazane wasePhoenix, eThekwini, kulandela isigameko sokugwazwa kubulawe isoka lakhe, wumlisa ababemgibeze emotweni bebuya ebumnandini.Kulesi sigameko kwafa ngesihluku uMnuz Sfundo Shabalala (29) owayehlala kule ndawo kodwa engowokudabuka eHarding. Silandisa ngesigameko esenzeka ngo-Agasti 24, nonyaka, isinqandamathe sakhe esicele ukungadalulwa, esasikhona ngesikhathi kwenzeka isigameko, umsolwa bahlangana naye endaweni yobumnandi iJoe Cools, eNorth Beach, eThekwini. "Sasizijabulele, uSfundo emagange elinde ukugubha usuku lwakhe lokuzalwa olwaluzoba ngo-Agasti 25. Sahamba sayobuka ibhola khona eNorth Beach, kudlala i-Asernal, ayeyithanda. Kwathi uma kuphela umdlalo, wathi asiye eJoe Cools ngoba yena usafuna ukuzijabulisa,” kusho lona wesifazane.Uthe bafika ngezithuba zawo-9 ebusuku, bahlala kule ndawo kwaze kwashaya u-11 wasebusuku, waveza ukuthi ngesikhathi befika khona, umufi wafike watholana nomsolwa, bajwayelana, bexoxa ngezinto ezehlukene sabantu abakade bazana. "Emva kuka-11 ebusuku, sabe sesisukuma, sithi siyothi ukuzihambela kancane ngasolwandle ukuze angazeli uma sengishayela imoto sesigoduka. Ngathi ngiyambona usexoxa nomsolwa, ngihambe ngibalandela ngemuva, maqede wathi asingaqale sihambe, asiye eKoko, okungenye indawo yokucima ukoma eseduze,” kusho lona wesifazane. Uthe nakuba ayenganeme ngalokhu, esejahe ukuhamba, umufi wamncenga ethi akasale esenzela yena, angamphoxi sekusondele usuku lwakhe lokuzalwa.Wathembisa ukuthi bazothi qu, bathenge ugwayi, bese beyahamba. Uthe bathi uma sebephuma umsolwa wacela ukugitshezwa, ashiywe emakethe, lapho ayezothatha khona amatekisi aya kwa-V eMlaza."Safika kungekho matekisi. Ngathi akehle, ngizombizela imoto ekhokhelwa ngebanga elihambile, nokho uSfundo wabona kuwumbono omubi ukushiya umsolwa endaweni lapho ayengagcwelezwa khona yizigebengu,” usho kanje.Uthe umsolwa wabe eseyijika esecela ukushiywa eSbu’s Lounge eNanda, lona wesifazane washaya phansi ngonyawo ethi indlela yabo ayiyi ngalapho. Uveze ukuthi umsolwa wagcina eveza ukuthi ucela ukuya nabo ngakhona ePhoenix ngoba unomfowabo ohlala khona, amgagula ngegama."Sathi sesibude buduze nalapho ayethe uzosala ngakhona, wavele wacela ukusala nganeno. Ngamisa imoto ukuze ehle. Ngesikhathi uSfundo owayehleli nami ngaphambili elula isandla ukuze baxhawulane, umsolwa wavele wakhipha ummese kuplastiki ayelokhu ewuphethe kusuka simbona eJoe Cools, wamgwaza ephindelela,” kusho lona wesifazane. Uthe waphuma eyinhlamvu emotweni ebaleka, eshiya umufi nomsolwa ngemuva. Uthe kukhona umqondo owathi akabuyele emumva, wathi uma ekwenza lokho, wabona ukuthi umsolwa usamgwaza umufi, wakhumbula ukuthi umufi wayemyalele ukuthi noma yinini uma ehlaselwa, akobaleka, asindise eyakhe impilo ngoba uwumuntu wesifazane. Uthe wabaleka waze wanqwamana namaphoyisa kaMasipala weTheku, okwathi uma ephindela nawo emumva, bafica umsolwa engasekho.Ukhale ngokungabutholi ubulungiswa ecaleni njengoba eveze ukuthi lukhona ulwazi alunikeza amaphoyisa olwalungalekelela ekutheni kubanjwe umbulali. "Inombolo ayeyinike uSfundo ngathola ukuthi ekamfowabo, ohlala khona ePhoenix ngalapho esasithi simehlisa ngakhona. Ngaphinde ngathola nokuthi yena lo mfowabo usebenza khona eJoe Cools. Ngokwami lolu lwazi lwalungalekelela ekuthe abanjwe umsolwa,” usho kanje.Uthe nakuba amaphoyisa axhumana nalona wesilisa, ambuza ukuthi uyamazi yini umsolwa, waphika walala ngomhlane, wathi akamazi, wathi nobufakazi bokwaqoshwa amakhamera kulezi zindawo zokucima ukoma uyakholelwa ekutheni kwakungalekelela ekutheni abanjwe. "Kukhona ngisho ne-video lapho elokhu etoboza uplastiki wakhe samuntu olokhu ebheka ukuthi akufake phakathi kusekhona yini,” kusho lona wesifazane, othe lo plastiki owagcina uficwa endaweni yesigameko wayewusonge ngesikibha nebhulukwe."Amaphoyisa ayengathatha ngisho nezinsalela zeminwe kuwona ukuze abanjwe. Ngiyabufuna ubulungiswa ngoSfundo ngendlela ambulala ngesihluku ngayo engamenzanga lutho olubi,” kusho lona wesifazane. Ulinikile Isolezwe inombolo yomndeni kamufi, ethe uma ishayelwa, yakhala, yaze yathula, ingabanjwa. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant Colonel Paul Magwaza, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi amaphoyisa asePhoenix avula icala lokubulawa komuntu emva kwesigameko sokuthi umufi egwazwe umuntu ongaziwa okuthiwa wayemgibeze emotweni.
OBEYINXUSA laseFrance, uMnuz Nkosinathi Emmanuel Mthethwa (58), uzalelwe elokishini iClermont, wakhulela eKlaarwater, eMariannhill, nakwesaKwaMthethwa, eMpangeni. Waphothula iziqu ze-Community Development eNyuvesi yaseNatal. Waphinde wathola ezinye zeMining Engineering eNyuvesi yaseGoli. Wenza nezokuXhumana eRhodes University.Wangena kwezombusazwe esemncane njengoba ayeyingxenye yenhlangano iKlaarwater Youth Organisation ngo-1982, lapho aba ngusihlalo wayo kusuka ngo-1987 kuya ku-1989. Wamela abasebenzi ngaphansi kwenyunyana iFood and Allied Workers Union (Fawu). Waba yilungu le-ANC. Ngo-1989, waboshwa ngesikhathi kunezibhelu ezweni ngenxa yobandlululo, waqokwa waba ngusihlalo egatsheni iSouthern Natal, yeSouth African Youth Congress. Waqokwa njengosihlalo weSouthern Natal Unemployed Workers' Union, ngalowo nyaka.Ngemuva kokuvulwa umlomo kwe-ANC ngo-1990, uMthethwa waba ngunobhala wale nhlangano eKlaarwater. Waba nangunobhala weSouthern Natal ye-ANC Youth League kusuka ngo-1990 kuya ku-1992. Ngo-1994, waqokelwa ekubeni yilungu lesigungu esiphezulu se-ANC Youth League, kwaze kwaba ngu-2001. Kusuka ngo-2001 kuya ku-2002, wasebenzela ithimba le-ANC eyingxenye yababejutshwe ekomkhulu lale nhlangano eLuthuli House. Waba yilungu lePhalamende kusuka ngo-2002, waqokelwa ekubeni yilungu lesigungu esiphezulu se-ANC kanjalo nelungu lekomiti elibhekele ukusebenza kwansuku zonke lale nhlangano kusuka ngo-2007, kwaze kwaba u-2022.Ngo-2008, ube ngusotswebhu we-ANC ePhalamende. Waba ngungqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa kusuka ngo-2008 kuya ku-2014. Ngesikhathi ephethe lo mnyango, kwaba nesibhicongo saseMarikana, lapho amaphoyisa adubula kwafa abavukuzi ababetelekile abangu-34. Kwaphinde kwaba nemvunge ngomuzi kalowo owayengumengameli wezwe, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, oseNkandla.Ngo-2014, uqokelwe ekubeni ungqongqoshe wezeMidlalo, ubuCiko namaSiko kwaze kwaba ngu-ngu-2019 nguZuma. UMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa wambuyisela kulesi sikhundla ethatha izintambo ngo-2019, ngemuva kokhetho. Ngo-2022, wamyalela ukuthi ahoxise indaba yokwenza ifulegi lakuleli ngemali eyevile ku-R22 million, emuva kwezikhalazo ezazivela ezinhlakeni ezehlukene.Wamxosha kwiKhabhinethi ngo-2023, kwathi ngemuva kwesonto emxoshile, wasula ekubeni yilungu lePhalamende. Ngesikhathi ephethe lo mnyango, amaciko ayekhala ngokuthi awanakiwe, aze aba nomkhankaso wokuthi akhonjwe indlela.NgoFebhuwari 2024, uRamaphosa wamjuba eParis, eFrance, njengoba eze waficwa ukufa. UMthethwa ushadelwe nguNksz Philisiwe Buthelezi, ongusomabhizinisi ophinde abe yisikhulu esiphezulu seNational Empowerment Fund. Kuthiwa laba bahlangana engqungqutheleni ye-ANC ngo-2009, kanti bashada ngo-2013.
BAPHUME bedangele kuhlehliswa ukukhishwa kwesicelo sebheyili yeNkosi Simphiwe Erick Zuma, eboshelwe ukubulala ikhansela le-DA, uMnuz Nhlalayenza Ndlovu. Umndeni kaZuma nobuholi be-DA bazwakalise ukudangala inkantolo inquma ukuhlehlisa ukukhipha isinqumo ebesibhekwe ngabomvu. UZuma usehlale izinyanga ezimbili ejele, ukulalelwa kwesicelo sakhe sebheyili kwabambezeleka izikhawu ngenxa yokushenxa kwemantshi.Bekuhlelwe ukuthi iNkantolo yeMantshi eHowick ikhiphe isinqumo izolo.IMantshi uSandy Sindane iveze ukuthi ikuhlehlisela uLwesihlanu ukukhishwa kwesinqumo, yaxolisa ngokubambezeleka kokukhishwa kwaso."Abameli bakho ngibachazelile kabanzi ngezizathu ezenze ukuba kubambezeleke ukukhishwa kwesinqumo esicelweni sakho sebheyili. Kuningi okufanele ngikubheke ngaphambi kokuthi ngikhiphe isinqumo."Undunankulu wesizwe sakwaNxamalala, uMnuz Elliot Zuma, uthe sekuyazwela esizweni njengoba inkosi ingekho."Kuseyiyo leyo nzukazikeyi njengoba kuthiwa asibuye ngoLwesihlanu. Sikhathazeke kakhulu isizwe ngendlela nje okwenzeka ngayo ngoba konke kumile njengoba inkosi ingekho, akwenzeki lutho. Kodwa ngeke sisole bani ngalokho, siyeke wona umthetho ukuba usebenze. Khona akukuhle impela, kukhulu ukukhathazeka."UZuma uphinde abhekane namanye amacala amabili okubulala.Ungaphandle ngebheyili ka-R25 000 ecaleni lokubulala owayengundunankulu wesizwe, uMnuz Qalokunye Zuma.Uphinde abhekane necala lokubulala owayelwa nokudayiswa komhlaba kamasipala, uMnuz Xolani Ndlovu/Ntombela.Akakasifaki isicelo sebheyili kuleli cala njengoba esalinde ukuzwa ukuthi uyayithola yini ibheyili ecaleni lokubulala uNdlovu.Womabili amacala abe esehlehliselwa uLwesihlanu.U-Elliot uthe abazi lutho ngawo wonke amacala abekwe inkosi."Okusihluphayo wukungazi lutho ngalolu daba. Asazi luthonathi sizifanela nani nje. Angifuni ukunikhohlisa, akukho nokukodwa esikwaziyo. Yinkosi kuphela eyaziyo. Iyona eyokhuluma, isho ukuthi nakhu ekwaziyo, nakhu engakwazi."Umholi we-DA KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Francois Rodgers, uthe ukungakhishwa kwesinqumo sebheyili kuzobambezela ukuqulwa kwecala."Thina sijahe ukuba kuqale ukuqulwa kwecala khona umndeni kaNdlovu uzothola ubulungiswa. Sekukaningi libambezeleka icala."URodgers uthe abavumelani nokuthi icala lokubulawa kukaNdlovu lihlanganiswe namanye amacala abhekene noZuma, wathi lokhu kuzobambezela.Khonamanjalo, uMbuso uveze ukuthi usufake isicelo sokuba kuhoxiswe ibheyili eyanikezwa uZuma ecaleni lokubulala uQalokunye.UMbuso usola ukuthi uZuma wagwazela imantshi ngo-R200 000 ukuze anikezwe ibheyili, uphinde usole ukuthi waqamba amanga ngesikhathi efaka isicelo sebheyili.Isicelo esifakwe wuMbuso bekufanele silalelwe ngeledlule kodwa icala lahlehla ngenxa yokushenxa kwemantshi.Isicelo soMbuso sizolalelwa ngoLwesihlanu.
KUVELA ukuthi wathukuthela wasongela uNgqongqoshe wezamaPhoyisa omisiwe, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, usomabhizinisi obhekene noxhaxha lwamacala, uMnuz Vusumuzi "Cat" Matlala, ngesikhathi kuhoxiswa ithenda lezigidi zamarandi ayelithole emaphoyiseni.IKhomishini eholwa yiJaji uMbuyiseli Madlanga, izwe ukuthi uMatlala wasabisa ngokuthi uMchunu uzowukhomba umuzi onotshwala emva kokuba kuhoxiswe ithenda lika-R360 million.Lokhu kuvele ngesikhathi ikhomishini inekelwa ingxoxo yamaselula okuthiwa yayiphakathi kukaMatlala nowachazwa uMchunu njengeqabane lakhe, uMnuz Brown Mogotsi.Ingxoxo inekelwe ikhomishini ngesikhathi kuqhubeka ubufakazi besikhulu sezinhloli esihola ithimba eliphenya ukubulawa kosopolitiki KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Dumisani Khumalo.Ithenda kaMatlala yahoxiswa emva kwezinsolo zenkohlakalo.Ingxoxo iveze ukuthi uMatlala waze wasabisa ngokufaka udaba lokuhoxiswa kwethenda enkantolo.Okwakucasula kakhulu uMatlala ukuthi umyalelo wokuba kuhoxiswe ithenda waqhamuka kuMchunu.UMatlala ngokwemiyalezo kaWhatsApp, ukhala ngokuhluleka kukaMogotsi ukuvimba ukuhoxiswa kwethenda."Sekukaningi wenza izethembiso ungazifezi. Okubi kakhulu ukuthi manje awusayiphenduli nemiyalezo engikuthumela yona. Okuhle ukuthi ngizigcinile izingxoxo zethu. Ngizozisebenzisa lezi zingxoxo uma sengifaka udaba enkantolo."
