Ingxoxo iveze ukuthi uMogotsi ubezixebulela umkhoma lapha kuMatlala njengoba ebehlezi emcela imali.Iningi lemali ebicelwa uMogotsi ubesuke eyifunela izinto ezimayelana nemicimbi ye-ANC.Ngesikhathi kunomcimbi wokugubha usuku okwasungulwa ngayo i-ANC ngoJanuwari 8, uMogotsi wacela uMatlala ukuba amlekelele akhokhele amathikithi ebhanoyi nendawo yokulala eCape Town, lapho kwakuzobanjelwa khona umcimbi.Uma ziqhubeka izingxoxo, kuvela lapho khona uMatlala ekhombisa ukuthi akasayijabuleli eyokuhlezi ecelwa imali.Kwenye ingxoxo, uMatlala ukhala ngokuthi uMogotsi ugcina ngokucela imali kodwa akazifezi izethembiso zakhe."Akufanele kube uwena kuphela ohlomulayo kulobu budlelwano bethu. Ziningi izinto engihlezi ngikucela zona ungazifezi. Lezi zinto ebengizicela kuwena aziphathelene nemali. Kuningi nje engikucele khona wangangisiza ngalutho."Ingxoxo iveze ukuthi uMogotsi ubeputshuzela uMatlala izinto ezenzeka emaphoyiseni, waba owokuqala ukwazisa uMatlala ukuthi selihlakaziwe ithimba eliphenya ukubulawa kosopolitiki KwaZulu-Natal.Ingxoxo iveza ukuthi uMogotsi ubexhumana noMchunu.UKhumalo uzoqhubeka nokwethula ubufakazi namhlanje, obunye ubufakazi uzobethula esithe.
INkantolo eNkulu yaseMpumalanga ikhiphe umyalelo wesikhashana ovimbela i-Alexander Forbes Financial Services ukuba ikhiphe isikhwama sokutshalwa kwezimali sika-R44 million salowo owayeyiPhini likaMongameli ongasekho, uDavid Mabuza.Inkokhelo, okubikwa ukuthi ibiqokelwe uNksz Nonhlahla Mnisi, obethi ungunkosikazi wakhe, isimisiwe njengoba kusalindwe umphumela wokugcina wokuphonselwa inselelo kwezomthetho. Isicelo esiphuthumayo sokumisa ukukhokha safakwa yindodakazi kaMnu Mabuza, uTamara Silinda. Lo mholi owake waba yiPhini likaMengameli kusukela ngo-2018 kuya ku-2023, udlule emhlabeni mhla zi-3 kuJulayi 2025.Imibhalo yasenkantolo ikhombisa ukuthi ikhophi yesitifiketi sokushona kwakhe ikhomba ukuthi akakaze ashade ngokusemthethweni, okwenza kube nokungabaza ukuthi inyunyana yakhe noMnisi isemthethweni.
UMZWILILI emculweni we-jazz uJudith Sephuma uzoshiyelana inkundla neqembu lomculo wezimfijoli iKZN Philharmonic Orchestra (KZNPO) kwiSymphony By The Waters eMidmar Dam, eHowick, ngoMgqibelo kusukela ngo-5 ntambama. La maciko azobe esina ededelana neMalini, The Zulu Kingdom Choir, Afritude, Black Lapels neThe Vukile Band. Ngaphandle kwalokho, abafundi basezikoleni ezisezindaweni ezazincishwe amathuba phambilini, iLuthando High neKwaPata High, bazothola ingqayizivele yethuba lokuncela kogwansile ezingwazini zamaciko ukuze nabo bagcine sebenamava emkhakheni wezobuciko. Umgqugquzeli wale ndumezulu yomcimbi, uNjabulo Shangase, uthe abantu bazobe bengazitiki ngomculo kuphela kodwa kuningi okuzohlonyulwa ngakho. UNjabulo, ongumqondisi weSymphony By The Waters, uthe bahlose ukwakha indathane yamathuba emisebenzi nokusebenzisa izinto zamasiko ukwelapha nokuguqula impilo yabantu."Ngokuhlanganisa imiphakathi ehlukahlukene, amaciko, izikole nosomabhizinisi, sikhombisa ukuthi ezobuciko zingaklama indima engakanani ekulweni nesihlava esikhungethe izwe lethu."UNjabulo uthe ngalo mcimbi baqonde ukuveza ukuthi kungakanani okungafezeka uma imiphakathi ihlangana isebenzisane."Ngokutshala kwezobuciko, amasiko nakwezokuvakasha, sisuke sitshala ekufukuleni umnotho nasekusimamiseni umphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika."Uqhube ngokuthi lo mcimbi uzobhulelwa amazolo ngochungechunge lwemibukiso kusukela ngo-10 ekuseni, okubalwa umbukiso wamabhizinisi asungulwe yintsha nabantu besifazane ngenhloso yokubanikeza inkundla yokukhangisa ngemikhiqizo yabo. Uthe nezingane zizobe zinendawo yazo lapho zizobe zidlala khona imidlalo enhlobonhlobo. Eqhuba uthe kuzobuye kube nezingxoxo nezinkundla zokucobelelana ngolwazi."Okumqoka kakhulu wukuthi lo mcimbi uzodala amathuba amatoho ebantwini abangaphezu kuka-300, okungabesifazane nentsha ngenhloso yokuthuthukisa umnotho," kuphetha uNjabulo.Amathikithi omcimbi aseyatholakala eWebtickets kanti amakhasimende anamakhadi okuthenga ePick n' Pay azothola isaphulelo sika-10%, uma ethenga amathikithi. Umcimbi uxhaswe wuMnyango wabesiFazane, iNtsha nabaBantu abanokuKhubazeka eHhovisi likaMengameli, uMnyango wezokuVakasha nowezobuCiko namaSiko KwaZulu-Natal kanye nosomabhizinisi.
ALISEKHO emhlabeni inxusa laseNingizimu Afrika eFrance, uMnuz Nathi Mthethwa, okuthiwa uwe esitezi ehhotela eParis, ngokwemibiko yakuleliya zwe.UMthethwa (58), oqokwe njengenxusa ngonyaka odlule, kuthiwa uduke ngoMsombuluko watholakala eseshonile ngoLwesibili.Ngokombiko weziko lezindaba iLe Parisien, isidumbu sakhe sitholakale ehhotela iHyatt futhi kusolakala ukuthi uwe esuka esitezi sika-22. Kuthiwa kubike umkakhe uPhilisiwe Buthelezi ukuthi unyamalele futhi umthumelele umyalezo okhathazayo.Ucingo lwakhe beluvuliwe ngabo-3 ntambama ngoMsombuluko ngaseBois de Boulogne, eParis. Amaphoyisa abe esemthungatha esaba ukuthi uzibulele.Ngaphambi kokuba yinxusa, uMthethwa uke waba wuNgqongqoshe wamaPhosisa nowezeMidlalo, ubuCiko namaSiko kuzwelonke.UMnyango wezobuDlelwano naMazwe aNgaphandle uthe uzokhipha isitatimende.
KUNGASE kuphazamiseke izivivinyo zasekupheleni konyaka KwaZulu-Natal, njengoba izinyunyana zothisha zisabisa ngokuphaka impi yokufuna ngodli izidingo ezifana nemali yokubhekela izidingo zezikole eyaziwa ngama-norms and standards, izincwadi kanjalo ne-stationery.Lokhu kulandela ukungafakwa kwama-oda okuthenga izincwadi ne-stationery sangonyaka ozayo, esisuke sihambisana nephepha lokugaya izikole ezilisebenzisa uma sekubhalwa izivivinyo.Izolo uNgqongqoshe weMfundo eyisiSekelo uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, uhlangane nezikhulu zoMnyango wezeMfundo kanjalo noMgcinimafa esifundazweni, ukuzama ukulungisa izinkinga zemali ezibhekene nalo mnyango. Kulo mhlangano obuseThekwini bekukhona noNdunankulu wesifundazwe uMnuz Thami Ntuli kanti kuvunyelwane ngokuthi kubunjwe ithimba elizoqhamuka nezisombululo enkingeni yemali ebhekene nomnyango. UNobhala weSadtu eKZN, uNksz Nomarashiya Caluza, uthe akucaci ukuthi kuzokwenzekani uma kuvulwa izikole ngonyaka ozayo njengoba bezwile ukuthi izincwadi azika-odwa.Uthe izinkinga zomnyango azipheli ngoba uMgcinimafa kumele aqonde ukuthi kunemigudu elandelwayo kwezemfundo uma kwenziwa izinto."Kuyacaca ukuthi kumele siye empini futhi ukuze kulunge izinto. Lokhu kusho ukuthi akukho okuzolunga ngaphandle kokuba silwe," usho kanje. Uthe nangonyaka odlule izivivinyo zaphazamiseka ngenxa yokuthi abafundi babengeke bakwazi ukubhala izinsiza zingafikile.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi njengoba uMnyango wezeMfundo unezinkinga zemali, sekudingeka ushaye indesheni emnyangweni kaMgcinimafa ngaphambi kokuba uthenge noma yini noma ukhiphe ithenda.UNksz Thirona Moodley, isikhulu esiphezulu seNaptosa esifundazweni, uthe othisha kulindeleke ukuthi benze imilingo ekubeni benqindwa amandla wukungabikhona kwezinsiza kusebenza.Uthe izikhala azivaliwe kanti nothisha baphelelwa wumdlandla. "Isimo sibi kakhulu manje. Kumele kuthathwe izinyathelo ezinqala ngokushesha."Uncome ukuhambela kukaNksz Gwarube ukuzama ukulungisa isimo somnyango.Ubalule nokuthi kumele bathathelwe izinyathelo ezinqala labo abavume ukuthi isimo sibe sibi emnyangweni. INatu esitatimendeni esikhiphe ngemuva kokuhlangana noNksz Gwarube, ithe ikhalile ngokuhamba kancane kokukhishwa kwemali yezikole.Ithe ayifuni le mali ifakwe kancane kancane ngoba kwenza lungabikhona uzinzo lwemali ezikoleni."Sifuna zilungiswe ngokushesha izikhalo zethu. Uma kungenjalo sizimisele ukuqinisa umkhankaso wethu." Ekhuluma emsakazweni uKhozi FM ekuseni izolo, uNksz Gwarube, uthe bafuna ukulungisa isimo ngokushesha kungaze kubaphinde okwenzeka nyakenye kubhikisha iSadtu kubhalwa izivivinyo ngenxa yokuthi imali yayingafakiwe.
UZOKWAZI namhlanje umholi we-EFF, uMnuz Julius Malema, ukuthi lizomgweba yini icala lokuqhumisa isibhamu abhekene nalo.INkantolo yeMantshi e-East London, e-Eastern Cape, izokhipha isinqumo ecaleni elibhekene noMelama nomqaphi wakhe, uMnuz Adriaan Snyman.UMalema noSnyman babhekene necala lokuphula imigomo elawula ukuphathwa kwezibhamu.Icala lisukela esigamekweni esenzeka eMdantsane, ngo-2018, ngesikhathi kunomgubho weminyaka emihlanu kwasungulwa i-EFF. Emva komgubho, kwasabalala i-video ekhombisa uMalema ephethe okubukeka njengesibhamu esikhulu, ekuqhumisa.UMalema uyaphika ukuthi isibhamu sangempela lesi abonakala esiphethe.Imantshi uTwanet Olivier iqalile ukwethula isigwebo sayo izolo, izophothula namhlanje ukwahlulela. Amalungu e-EFF abebhikisha ngaphandle kwenkantolo ngesikhathi kuqhubeka ukwethulwa kwesigwebo.UNobhala Jikelele we-EFF, uMnuz Marshall Dlamini, uthe ngeke bavume ukuthi uMalema aboshwe."Akekho umuntu ozobopha umengameli wethu. Umengameli wethu usazoqhubeka nokusihola. Alikho icala elizophazamisa umengameli wethu. Ayikho enye indawo aya kuyona umengameli wethu emva kwecala ngaphandle kwaseWinnie Madikizela-Mandela House (emahhovisi e-EFF)."UDlamini usole i-AfriForum nohulumeni oholwa yi-ANC ngokuzigaxa ezindabeni ze-EFF."Abelungu nalaba be-ANC bayazifaka nje ezindabeni zethu. Lapha sasigubha usuku lokusungulwa kwe-EFF. Sasizihlalele sodwa. Angazi ukuthi bona bangenaphi lapho."UDlamini uthe uMalema uboshelwa amanqina enyathi."Sekuphele iminyaka eyisikhombisa silindile. Nanamhlanje besizitshela ukuthi kuzophuma isinqumo. Lo mama (imantshi) uzikhulumela izinto esingahlangene nazo. Ingoba vele abazi ukuthi bambopheleni umholi wethu. Abayeke ukuba amagwala, basitshele ukuthi isinqumo sithini."UMalema usanda kulahlwa yicala lokuphimisa amagama agqugquzela inzondo.Ngenyanga eyedlule, iNkantolo yezokuLingana yathola uMalema enecala lokugqugquzela inzondo emva kokuba enxenxe amalungu e-EFF ukuba abhekane nomlungu owabonakala eshaya ilungu le-EFF.Ekhuluma emcimbini we-EFF owawungo-2022, eWestern Cape, uMalema wagxeka amalungu eqembu ngokungaphindiseleli ilungu leqembu elabonakala lishaywa umlungu ngesikhathi kunombhikisho.UMalema wanxusa amalungu eqembu ukuba amfune aze amthole loyo mlungu, bese enza okufanele.
IZINHLANGANO zezitshudeni zikhala ngokubanjiswa udonga kozakwabo abasalinde ukukhokhelwa yisikhwama esixhasa ngemali yokufunda ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme, iNational Students' Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS).Lezi zinhlangano okuyiSouth African Union of Students (SAUS), neyophiko lwentsha lwe-DA, i-DASO, zikhala ngokuthi izitshudeni zibhuqwa yindlala kanti zisengcupheni yokuthi zixoshwe omastende abangakhokhelwe.Okhulumela iSAUS, uMnuz Thato Masekoa, uthe isekhula ekhishwe yiNSFAS, iveza ukuthi lesi sikhwama sizokhokhela izitshudeni imali yangenyanga ezayo kanjalo noNovemba. Uthe isekhula idalule ukuthi izitshudeni zikhokhelwa izinyanga ezingu-10 onyakeni, ekubeni zifake izicelo zokukhokhelwa imali yonyaka ogcwele, oyizinyanga ezingu-12."Lesi sinyathelo sisho ukuthi izitshudeni zizobulawa yindlala ziphinde zingene ezikweletini ekubeni zixhaswe ngokugcwele unyaka wonke. Lokhu kuzokwenziwa ngukuthi kunezinyanga ezingeke zikhokhelwe ngazo. Zizokhishwa nalapho zihlala khona omastende ngenxa yalesi sinyathelo."Uthe imali yale nyanga izitshudeni obekumele ziyithole namanje zisayilindile."Sifuna uMnyango weMfundo ePhakeme ungenelele kule nkinga. Abathole uxhaso kumele bahlinzekwe ngemihlomulo yabo unyaka wonke, imali ingakhishwa izikhawu," usho kanje.Ukhale ngokuthi lokhu kubeka engcupheni ikusasa lezitshudeni. USihlalo weDASO uNksz Andrea Martinez, ugxeke iNSFAS ngokuhluleka ukufeza izethembiso kwizitshudeni ezixhasiwe.Uthe lesi sikhwama siyaqhubeka nokuhluphekisa izitshudeni ezizophenduka ondingasithebeni uma sezixoshwa omastende."Izitshudeni zithwaliswa kanzima omastende abafuna imali yabo. Abakhokhelwa ngesikhathi okwenza ukuthi bafune ukuxosha izitshudeni, phezu kokuba zisuke zixhaswe ngokugcwele." Uthe kwezinye izikhungo izitshudeni zisebenzisa imali yokudla ukukhokhela izindawo zokuhlala."Sibonga omastende abanomusa, abaqhubeka bagcine izitshudeni ekubeni zingakhokhelwe Kwabona sebephelelwa yisineke manje njengoba izethembiso zokukhokhelwa zingafezwa," usho kanje.Uthe bafuna uNgqongqoshe weMfundo ePhakeme, uMnuz Buti Manamela, ayisukumele ngokushesha eyokubambezeleka kokukhishwa kwemali yiNSFAS."UMnyango kumele ubhekele ukusebenza kweNSFAS. Sinxusa nezikhungo ukuthi zixhumane nezinhlaka ezimele izitshudeni ngezinselelo ezithinta lesi sikhwama. Izikhungo eziningi ziyathula zingaziveza izinselelo bese kusuka izibhelu." Uveze ukuthi izitshudeni azidli izethembiso ezenziwa ezithangamini nabezindaba ezibizwa ngumnyango neNSFAS.Esithangamini nabezindaba ngasekuqaleni kwale nyanga esasibizwe nguManamela neNSFAS, kwathenjiswa ukuthi kuzophela le nyanga sezilungisiwe izinkinga ezithinta ukungakhokhelwa kwezitshudeni imihlomulo yazo.I-NSFAS yathembisa nokuthi izokhokhela omastende esabakweleta. Okunye okwavela ngukuthi lesi sikhwama sidinga imali ethe xaxa ukuze sihlangabezane nezidingo zezitshudeni.
LIHLABE ikhwelo ikomiti lezeMpilo esiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal, emindenini edukelwe yizihlobo ukuthi izicinge nasemakhazeni kahulumeni ngenxa yokuthi ziningi izidumbu ezingaziwa eziduve kulawa makhaza.Ikhwelo lihlatshwe ngusihlalo wekomiti, uDkt Imran Keeka, othe abadukelwe yizihlobo ababike ngokushesha emaphoyiseni.Uthe abangawashalazeli amakhaza kahulumeni ngoba ziningi izidumbu ezingaziwa."Sithole ukuthi zibalelwa ku-900 izidumbu ezisemakhazeni kahulumeni ezingaziwa ukuthi ngezobani. Ezinye zazo selokhu zahlala kusuka ngo-2017," usho kanje emva kokuhambela izikhungo ezigcina izidumbu muva nje. Uthe kubalulekile ukuthi amaphoyisa asebenzisane namakhaza kahulumeni ukuze kutholakale izihlobo nemindeni yabagcinwe kulawa makhaza."Umgomo uthi isidumbu sigcinwa izinsuku ezingu-21, ngaphambi kokuba singcwatshwe uma kungukuthi indawo ikhona kanjalo nemali. Yingakho sinxusa umphakathi ukuthi uye kocinga izihlobo emakhazeni uma kukhona odukile ukuze kwehliswe isibalo sezidumbu eziduve emakhazeni." Uveze ukuthi bakhathazekile ngokuncipha kwendawo okubekwa kuyona izidumbu ezingenabani. Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi ngisho noMnyango wezeMpilo kuzwelonke, uhlale ukuveza ukuthi eKZN yisona sifundazwe esinesibalo esiphezulu sezidumbu ezingaziwa.Lo mnyango waveza ukuthi kudingeke ezinye zazo zigcine sezingcwatshwa wuhulumeni.UNgqongqoshe walo mnyango kuzwelonke, uDkt Aaron Motsoaledi, waveza ukuthi phakathi kuka-Ephreli 2024 kuya ku-Ephreli kulo nyaka, bangcwabe izidumbu ezingenabani ezingu-3 819.Waveza ukuthi enye inkinga eyenza kube nezidumbu ezingawiza ngukuthi abantu bakwamanye amazwe, basho amagama okungewona uma besezikhungweni zezempilo okwenza kube nzima ukuthola imindeni yabo uma sebeshonile.Kwayalelwa izifundazwe ukuthi zisebenzisane namaphoyisa kanjalo nomasipala ukuze kube nezinhlelo ezisheshayo zokungcwaba labo abasuke bengaziwa.
UMHOLI wethimba eliphenya ukubulawa kosopolitiki KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Dumisani Khumalo, ukhombe ngenjumbane amaqembu emigulukudu athe yiwona ayehamba phambili emkhankasweni wokuba kuvalwe ithimba.UKhumalo uthe amaqembu emigulukudu aphuma umkhankaso wokuba kuhlakazwe ithimba emva kokuba amalungu ethimba enyakazise isidleke sezidakamizwa eGauteng. Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ethula ubufakazi phambi kwekhomishini eholwa yiJaji Mbuyiseli Madlanga. UKhumalo uthe amaqembu emigulukudu aba nesandla esinqumeni sikaNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa omisiwe, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, sokuyalela ukuba kuhlakazwe ithimba. "Amaqembu emigulukudu ayezitshela ukuthi ithimba liphenya wona, nokwenza ukuthi aqale umbhidlango wokuba kuhlakazwe ithimba."UKhumalo ukhombe ngenjumbane iqembu lemigulukudu elakhiwe abantu abahlanu elibizwa ngeBig 5.Kuleli qembu kukhona abantu ababili abayamaniswa noMchunu, uMnuz Vusimuzi "Cat" Matlala noMnuz Katiso "KT" Molefe.Abanye abayingxenye yeqembu abazange badalulwe ngenxa yokuthi kunophenyo olusaqhubeka.UKhumalo uthe leli qembu lishushumbisa izidakamizwa, liduna izimoto eziweliswa imingcele, libambe izimoto zemali, libulala abantu liphinde libe ingxenye yenkohlakalo ethinta amathenda.UKhumalo uthe leli qembu lisondelene kakhulu nosopolitiki kanye nabaholi bamaphoyisa.Uthe uMatlala uxhasa imikhankaso kaMchunu yokuhola i-ANC.UKhumalo uhambe emazwini abantu asebeke bethula ubufakazi phambilini okuthi uMchunu akanalo igunya lokuhlakaza ithimba. UKhumalo uthe umthetho uvumela kuphela uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa kuzwelonke, u Lieutenant General Fannie Masemola, ukuba ahlakaze ithimba. UKhumalo uthe ithimba lenza umsebenzi oncomekayo njengoba bebaningi abantu elibabophile, wathi abanye sebegwetshiwe.UKhumalo uthe zazidla lubi izigameko zokubulawa kosopolitiki KwaZulu-Natal ngaphambi kokuthi kusungulwe ithimba. Uthe osopolitiki babehlezi lubhojozi, wathi abanye babeze beqambe amanga bethi bayasongelwa ngoba befuna ukuhlinzekwa ngabaqaphi.Wenze isibonelo ngekhansela leDA kuMasipala wasoKhahlamba, uMnuz Michael Buthelezi, elangqongqisa indlu yalo.Kulo mlilo kwangqongqa wonke umndeni kaButhelezi. "Ngebhadi uyena kuphela okwakwazi ukuphuma ngoba wayazi ukuthi kuzoshiswa indlu. Ziningi izinto ezenziwa amakhansela ngoba efuna ukunikwa abaqaphi."UButhelezi wagwetshwa odilikajele abathathu kanye neminyaka engu-15.UKhumalo uthe baqaphela ukuthi izibalo zokubulawa kwamakhansela zanyuka kakhulu emva kokhetho lohulumeni basekhaya lwango-2021. UKhumalo uthe lokhu kwadalwa wukuthi kwakunomasipala abaningi lapho kungekho iqembu elanqoba ngamalengiso. "Lokhu kwenza manje ukuthi kungabe kusabulawa kakhulu abantu ababanga isikhundla sobukhansela. Emva kokhetho kwase kubulawa amakhansela ngenxa yombango wokuphatha omasipala. Amakhansela ayethenjiswa imali ukuze avote namaqembu athize. Uma ikhansela linqaba ukuvota neqembu elithize lalibulawa."
I-DA ifuna uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, abophe ababhikishi abacekela phansi impahla kaMasipala wasebaQulusini ngesikhathi izakhamuzi zaseMondlo zibhikishela ukucishwa kukagesi. I-DA ibhalele uMkhwanazi imcela ukuba athathele izinyathelo zomthetho abantu abangqongqisa impahla yomkhandlu embhikishweni owawungasekuqaleni kwenyanga.Ababhikishi ababevutha bengabaselwa, bavuka umbhejazane emva kokuba umkhandlu uqale uhlelo lokucisha ugesi ngamahora ayisishiyagalombili ngosuku ngoba nakhu ukhala ngokuthi ugesi uyasindelwa ngenxa yokuthi abantu abaningi abawukhokheli.Ababhikishi bashisa amahhovisi omkhandlu nempahla okubalwa kuyo nogandaganda.USotswebhu we-DA emkhandlwini, uMnuz Swelakhe Shelembe, uthe ababhikishi badala umonakalo wezigidi zamarandi. Ukusho lokhu encwadini ayibhekise kuMkhwanazi. UShelembe uthe kuyicala elibomvu ukucekela phansi impahla. "Sikhathazeke ngodlame esalubona ngesikhathi kunombhikisho. Siyazi ukuthi abantu banelungelo lokubhikisha. Kodwa ke leli lungelo lihambisana nemigomo okufanele ihlonishwe. Kuyicala ukucekela phansi impahla yomphakathi futhi kuphambene nomthetho, iCriminal Matters Amendment Act (Act 18 of 2015). Umthetho ukubeka kucace ukuthi labo abalahlwa amacala okucekela phansi impahla yomphakathi kufanele banikezwe isigwebo esiqinile." UShelembe uthe bafuna ukuthi uMkhwanazi uqale uphenyo lokuba kungani amaphoyisa aseVryheid, engasukumelanga phenzulu ngesikhathi ebikelwa ngombhikisho."Amaphoyisa abikelwa ababhikishi besaqoqana kodwa wona awazange asukumele phezulu. Ukuhudula kwamaphoyisa izinyawo kwaholela ekucekelekeni phansi kwempahla. Ukuba amaphoyisa asheshe asukuma ayezokwazi ukusheshe awunqande umbhikisho. Kuyasikhathaza ukuhudula izinyawo kwamaphoyisa. Le nto yenza ukuthi abantu bangawethembi amaphoyisa futhi le nto yenza ukuthi abantu baqhubeke nokucekela impahla ngoba bayazi ukuthi angeke bathathelwe izinyathelo. Ingakho sifuna kube nophenyo oluzokwenzeka esifundazweni."UShelembe uthe bafuna ukuthi kube nethimba elizosungulwa elizobhekana nemibhikisho yalolu hlobo."Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi amaphoyisa akwazi ukusukumela phezulu uma kunemibhikisho yololu hlobo. Kuzokwenza ukuthi bathathelwe izinyathelo abantu abacekela phansi impahla."
KUBUKEKA sengathi kuyambhedela naseqenjini aqhamuka kulo, i-IFP, uMphathiswa wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi. Kunamahlebezi okuthi ubuholi be-IFP ebaQulusini, bufuna ukuthi uButhelezi akhishwe esikhundleni. Nakuba ubuholi be-IFP ebaQulusini buyichitha eyokuthi bulolela uButhelezi izembe, umthombo uveze ukuthi ubuholi beqembu khona, busanda kuvumelana ngokuthi kumele ibhantshi ligcwale umoya kuButhelezi. Sekukaningi i-ANC KwaZulu-Natal ikhala ngoButhelezi kusukela kwathatha uhulumeni wokubambisana ophethe kulesi sifundazwe. I-ANC ibiyaye ikhale ngokuthi uButhelezi usebenzisa isikhundla sakhe budedengu, ikhale ngokuthi uqinisa isandla komasipala abaphethwe yiyo KwaZulu-Natal. Nokho, kungokokuqala ukuba kuvele ukungenami ngoButhelezi ngaphakathi kwi-IFP.Ngokusho komthombo, into edalele uButhelezi amazinyo abushelelezi indlela asingathe ngayo udaba lwemibhikisho yezakhamizi zaseMondlo, ebezikhala ngesinqumo sikaMasipala wasebaQulusini, sokucisha ugesi amahora ayisishiyagalombili.UMasipala wasebaQulusini uphethwe yi-IFP.Emva kwemibhikisho enodlame, uButhelezi wabiza umhlangano womphakathi. Kulo mhlangano uButhelezi wayalela umkhandlu ukuba uhoxise uhlelo lokucisha ugesi.Umthombo uthe lesi sinqumo sabacasula abaholi be-IFP ebaQulusini."Babona sengathi uButhelezi uvuna ababhikishi abacekela phansi impahla yomkhandlu. Babona sengathi uButhelezi udayise ngobuholi bomkhandlu. Akukwazi ukuthi ngathi ubuholi bomkhandlu bugqugquzela abantu ukuba bakhokhele ugesi, bese yena ekhombisa ukuhambisana nabantu abangafuni ukukhokhela ugesi."Ngokusho komthombo, umhlangano okwathathwa kuwo isinqumo sokuba kuxoshwe uButhelezi wawuhanjelwe nayizimeya ezimbili zakwabanye bomasipala abasesifundeni iZululand.Usihlalo we-IFP ebaQulusini, uMnuz Henry Sikhakhane, uthe kungamampunge ukuthi bafuna kuxoshwe uButhelezi.USikhakhane uthe amahlebezi akhandwe ngabantu abafuna ukuqhatha i-IFP."Ngikuqala ngawe lokhu, ngiyakweshwama impela. Lena yindlela abafuna ukudunga ngayo i-IFP. Kunezinhlaka kwi-IFP, asikwazi ukugagamela. Akukho lapho khona abaholi asebeke basibiza khona ukuba sikhulume ngalolu daba. Asikwazi-ke ukuqhamuka sesithi akukhishwe esikhundleni umphathiswa ekubeni singazange silubike udaba ezinhlakeni ezifanele."USikhakhane uthe imihlangano abebeyibamba bekungeyokuzama ukulungisa isimo saseMondlo."Uma kuwukuthi ubonile, size saba nomhlangano wawo wonke amaziko lapho sizwakalise khona ukuthi siyayiseka iMeya (yasebaQulusini, uMnuz Sifiso Khehla Mkhwanazi)."UButhelezi unqabile ukuphawula ngalolu daba.
UMBUSO Khoza yindoda ekhuluma amazwi anesigqi somlando esinomongo nenjula yamasiko. Usezakhele udumo ngomculo omtoti, nangokuxoxa ngomlando, uyahlonishwa ngolwazi lwamasiko olumenze umuntu anguye namhlanje. Njengoba elungiselela ikhonsathi yakhe Amahubo Symphony ezobe iseConstitution Hill eGoli mhla ka-28 Septhemba, uKhoza uxoxa ngohambo lwakhe, izingqinamba adlule kuzona, umithelela womsebenzi wakhe nombono okuyiwona oqhubeka nokuba ngumhlanhlandlela endleleni yakhe. Ukuqala kwakhe ukuzibandakanya nomculo kwaqala emicimbini yoiphakathi nasemndenini wakhe. "Ukuqala kwami ukugqugquzeleka ngomculo ngiyakhumbula ukuthi kwaqala ngesikhathi ngibona amabutho ehaya ingoma emicimbini nalapho amantombazane asemancane ayehuba uma kunemicimbi yomemulo. Abesifazane abadala babeculela izingane imilolozelo. Ngagqugquzeleka kanjalo ke.”Esakhula emndenini okhonza eSalvation Army naseNazareth Baptist Church, uKhoza wayefunda izihlabelelo ezifana noHow Great Thou Art nosikompilo olwahlukile lwendumiso yakwaShembe. Ekuhambeni kwesikhathi wabe eselalela umculo kaVuyo Mokoena, lokho kaba yisiqinisekiso kuKhoza sokuthi umculo ungaphezulu kothando lwawo .” Ukhoza uthe umculo wakhe ngeke uwuhlukanise nosiko lakwaZulu, olungumgogodla wawo. "Umthelela wamasiko akwaZulu emculweni wami uhambisana nokukhuthazwa kolimi . Ngikhule ngesikhathi lapho abantu bebezigqaja ngokusebenzisa ukujula kolimi nezingathekiso. Ngesikhathi ngiba wumbhali womculo, ngathatha umlando njengengqophamlando yezehlakalo kanye namasiko, okuyiwona olawula indlela engibhala ngayo, indlela engizwakala ngayo nendlela engicula ngayo.”Umculo kaKhoza usujiyise emidlalweni yethelevishini eminingi yaseNingizimu Afrika okubalwa kuyona Umkhokha: The curse” neShaka ILembe okudingeke ukuthi ngayo akwazi ukuhlanganisa amasiko nobuciko. "Ngesikhathi uDuma Ndlovu engithinta mayelana noMkhokha, wathi ngingumuntu ofanelekile ukuba kuwona ngoba nginomlando wakwaShembe futhi nginolwazi ngolimi. Kwakumele ngihloniphe isonto ngoba ngokuthatha umculo wakhona, ngase ngiqopha umculo owawuzwakala ufana futhi ovusa umuzwa ofanayo kubalandeli. Ngenza ucwaningo olubanzi ukuze ngiqinisekise ukuthi isigqi kanye nohlobo lomculo kuyefana.”Ukuzibandakanya kwakhe neShaka iLembe kwakuqondene naye ngqo. Ukhoza uthi abaphansi bakubo babesebenzisana neNkosi uShaka, ngakho-ke omunye umlando wayewazi."Ngesikhathi abadidiyeli bomdlalo beza endaweni yokuqopha, babesazisa ngezigcawu zomdlalo. Ukwakha umculo ohambisana nendikimba kwakuletha impikiswano enkulu, kepha sasiwukhipha umculo ogcwele ithemba, isiphetho kanye nohambo lukaShaka.”uKhoza uthi usebenzisa indlela yakudala ukukhiqiza umnkenenezo omnandi. Lokho kumenza azizwe eyicilongo lomhlaba. Uqhube wathi umculo kanye nokuxoxa izindaba ngeke ukuhlukanise. Elinganisa ngosiko lwakudala lapho ogogo babexoxa izinganekwane, uthi ngesikhathi belandisa babephinde bacule ngesikhathi esisodwa. Ukuqala kukaKhoza ukuqopha izingoma enzela imidlalo kwakungesikhathi eculela umdlalo kaLeon Schuster, iMama Jack. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi wasesebenzela phesheya kwezilwandle lapho aba ngumqophi ngokugcwele. "Kwakungasho ukuthi kumayelana nokuhlakanipha, kwakungokuqhubeka nalokho okwakwenziwa ngabaphansi. Nasenkundleni yaseshashalazini, kusuka eGreece kuya eRome, amasiko ayemayelana nezingoma nezindaba. Imilolozelo yethu yayimayelana nezepolitiki kepha yenziwa sengathi yizingoma ezenzelwe izingane.”Ukhoza uthi imilolozelo, Amahubo nezingoma zasekhaya, kubalulekile ukuthi kugcinwe kahle. Uma konke lokho kungagcinwa ngokuthi kubhalwe phansi, abantu bayoqhubeka nokucabanga ukuthi umculo wesintu unamadimoni futhi awufanelekile ukulalelwa. Ukulingisa kuyibumbe kakhulu inkambo kaKhoza."Ukulingisa kwenza abantu baxhumanise izwi lami nobuso bami. Kunikeza ukujula bobumina njengeciko. Ngikhuthaze abanye ozakwethu kwezomculo ukuba bazame ukulingisa namanye amakhono ukuze bangasali ngesikhathi amanye amaciko asemancane ethuthuka.”Emcimbini lona kuzobe kukhona nokudla kwesintu ukukhuthaza impilo emphakathini nokuxoxa ngomlando wasekhaya, amadlozi nomvelingqangi. "uzobe ungumcimbi ongafani neminye eyake yabakhona yalolu hlobo” kuchaza uKhoza. "Sifuna ukuvuselela imvelaphi siphinde sithuthukise ukuphila komqondo.”Mhla ka-28 Septhemba, uKhoza uzosingatha Amahubo Symphony. Kule khonsathi kuzogqama izingoma zasekhaya zesintu, imilolozelo, imithandazo, namahubo ahlelwe okokuqala nguSiyanda Zulu. UKhoza ukhuthazwa wukukhula komculo waseNingizimuj Afrika, kepha uqwashisa ngokulahlekelwa wukujula komculo. "Kusuka kumbhaqanga, kuMahotella Queens, kuya emculweni wekwaito kuze kufike kulona wemanje ama-piano, uhambo luyathembisa, kepha sidinga kwengezwe izikole zezinkondlo. Izinkondlo ziyindlela ekuvumela ukuthi ukwazi ukusho lokho okungashiwo. Ngaphandle kwezinkondlo, izingoma zisenkingeni yokuzithola ziphindaphinda into eyodwa isikhathi esingangemizuzu emihlanu. Kumele sihlole ukuthi yini lena esiyizibayo ngoba inkungu iyosiholela ekusaseni esingalazi.”UKhoza uke wabhekana nezinkinga zezikweletu, ngenxa yokungabi nomholo oqondile. Lokho kwaholela ekutheni abe nokhwantala, kepha wanqoba. Ukunqoba kumenza akwazi ukukhuluma ngakho ngokukhululeka ukuze aqwashise nabanye. UKhoza ukhumbula impilo yakhe esaneminyaka engu-47 lapho ayezizwa emusha kakhulu kunakuqala. "Anginawo umdlandla wezinto esezedlula. Ikusasa alikho lana. Sinalomzuzu nje kuphela wokuphila. Umculo wami umayelana nokuphila kulo mzuzu ngokugcwele.”Uma eseqedile ngaMahubo Symphony, uKhoza uzoqala umklamo Umsuthu Mental Space uokuyiindawo lapho abantu bezokhuluma khona ngokhwantalala nokukhathazeka ngokweqile. UKhoza uhlela nokuvula isikhungo sezobuciko eGoli esizoqeqesha abantu abasha sibahlomise ngolwazi oluqondene nendabuko, ulimi lwesiZulu, ukulingisa, nokufundiswa ngomculo. Abazothweswa iziqu bayothola izitifiketi ezisemthethweni. "Ngifuna abazongixhasa. Lesi sikhungo yiwona msebenzi engigxile kuwona." Uthe ifa lakhe kumele libe ngeqiniso, ubumnene nokwamukelisa."Ngifisa ukushiya umphakathi obunjwe ngeqiniso nangobumnene. Ingane eqeqeshwe yimi kumele ikwazi lokho.”Izingoma ezikhethwe nguLutho Pasiya ezingomeni zikaMbuso Khoza ongazithokozela:Njomane: Igqugquzelwe yimpilo yeNdlovukazi uNandi, unina kaShaka. Yingoma ekhuluma ngomoya wakhe wokunakekela, ukulwa namandla akhe njengomgogodla wekusasa lendodana yakhe. Mehlo Abonayo: Ikhumbuza abantu ukuthi mabavule amehlo babone ngale kwenyama babone iqiniso ngamehlo engqondo.Kuyabanda Ngaphandle: YIsingathekiso somzwangedwa, ubunzima kanye nokuhlukana nomqondo, inxusa abantu ukuthi bafune imfudumalo ngokuxhumana emphakathini. Isivikelo (noKelly Khumalo): Ikhuluma ngokubizwa kongabonwayo ukuze asivikele ezikhathini ezinzima. Lena ihlanganisa izwi likaKhoza elijulile nephimbo likaMaKhumalo elinomhawu.
ZIYAQONGA izinkinga ezibhekene noMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, njengoba zingase zingafiki ngesikhathi izincwadi zokufunda kanjalo ne-stationery ezikoleni ngenxa yezinkinga zemali.Lokhu kungaqubula iziteleka zezinyunyana zothisha njengoba ezinye zezinsiza okubalwa amaphepha okugaya ahanjiswa ungakapheli unyaka, esetshenziswa izikole uma zibhalisa izivivinyo, engase angafiki ngesikhathi ezikoleni ngenxa yokuthi namanje uMnyango kaMgcinimafa wesifundazwe, engakagunyazi ukuthi zithengwe izincwadi.Inkinga yemali yenze ukuthi kwehle uNgqongqoshe weMfundo eyisiSekelo, uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, azoba nomhlangano nezikhulu zoMnyango wezeMfundo noMgcinimafa okubalwa noNdunankulu wesifundazwe, uMnuz Thami Ntuli. Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi uMnyango wezeMfundo kudingeka ushaye indesheni eMnyangweni kaMgcinimafa ukuze ukwazi ukuthenga izinsiza ngenxa yokuthi owezemfundo awukwazi ukusebenzisa imali ungayitholanga imvume kuMgcinimafa.Umphathi wezezimali eMnyangweni wezeMfundo, uNksz Yali Joyi, ulibeke ngembaba elokuthi njengoba ingakakhishwa imvume yokuthi bafake i-order lezincwadi, kunengcuphe yokuthi zingase zifike ngemuva kwesikhathi."Bekumele kuphele uNovemba sezisezikoleni izincwadi ne-stationery sangonyaka ozayo. Uma siphuza ukufaka ama-oda, zingaze zifike ngisho nangoMashi noma ngo-Ephreli, ngonyaka ozayo. Lide ibanga elihanjwayo ngaphambi kokuba izincwadi zifike ezikoleni, njengoba kudingeka ukuthi zi-odwe, ziyiswe endaweni ezigcinwa kuyona, zihlukaniswe bese ziyiswa ezikoleni," usho kanje. Usho lokhu ekhuluma namalungu ekomiti lezemfundo esiShayamthetho sesifundazwe, lapho ebechaza khona ngezingqinamba zomnyango.Uveze nokuthi badinga u-R1.2 billion, ukuze bakwazi ukuthenga lezi zincwadi ne-stationery, wathi enye imali izoya ezikoleni ezizithengela izincwadi."Imali yokuthenga izincwadi kulezo ezizithengelayo, ifakwa kuma-norms and standards. Kwaleyo mali ngeke ifike ngesikhathi kulezi zikole ngenxa yokuthi sisalinde uMgcinimafa. Silokhu safaka isicelo ekuqaleni kwale nyanga kodwa lutho impendulo." Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi ukungafakwa kwemali yama-norms and standards, kwasusa umsindo njengoba kwaze kwaphazamiseka nokubhalwa kwezivivinyo zakwamanye amabanga nyakenye.Izinyunyana zothisha zazishaya phansi ngonyawo, zifuna umnyango ufake imali yezikole ukuze zikwazi ukusebenza.ISadtu yaze yavalela izikhulu zomnyango ifuna umnyango ukhokhele izikole. Kwaze kwehla nomqondisi jikelele emnyangweni kazwelonke, uMnuz Mathanzima Mweli, ezobhula umlilo emva kokuba le nyunyana ibhikishe nasembizweni eyayihanjelwe nguMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, imazisa ngezinselelo eMnyangweni wezeMfundo. UNksz Joyi ukhale ngokuthi basadinga enye imali ukuze bakwazi ukwenza zonke izinhlelo zabo.Udalule nokuthi ngendlela isimo esinzima ngayo, abakwazi ukuvala izikhala ngenxa yokunqanyulwa kwesabelomali.UDkt Imran Keeka we-DA, ubuze ukuthi ngeke yini lezi zinkinga ziphazamise ukubhalwa kwezivivinyo ngenxa yokungafiki ngesikhathi kwemali yama-norms and standards ezikoleni?Ukhale nangokuthi azivalwa izikhala ekubeni othisha beshoda futhi kwanda nesibalo sabafundi minyaka yonke.
BEKUFINYWA ngendololwane emgcagcweni weNkosi yesizwe sakwaMpungose, uZakhe Mpungose eNkandla, ngempelasonto. Inkosi beyishadelwa yintokazi yaseMangidini, eNkandla, uThabsile wakwaGoqo. Le ndumezulu yomshado iqale ezinkundleni zemidlalo zaseNkandla, ngoLwesihlanu, yaze yaphothulwa ekomkhulu lwenkosi esigodini saKwaZikhali, ngoMgqibelo. Umshado omhlophe bewuhanjelwe nguNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, iNkosi yaKwaPhindangene uMntwana uZuzifa Buthelezi, uSotswebhu we-IFP kwisiShayamthetho sakulesi sifundazwe, uMnuz Blessed Gwala, usonkondlo uKwazi Nsele, umsunguli weMpucuzeko Maskandi Festival, uXolani Mcineka, umculi kamaskandi uKhuzani Mpungose, umculi wokholo uJumbo, amakhosi aseNdlunkulu kaZulu, izimeya, izinduna namakhansela.Ngalolu suku, iNkosi uMpungose imangazwe yisizwe sayo ngesipho sonyanyavu lweveni eyi-double cab. Ngakusasa ngoMgqibelo, kutheleke uNtuli, uMphathiswa wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zaboMdabu eKZN, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, uKhuzani namakhosi nezinduna zezizwe ezihlukene.Izithameli bezivunule ziconsa. Amabutho abetheleka ethelekile ngamabhasi. Emuva komabo, kube sekunandisa uSamkelo Shezi wodumo kwiTikTok, Q Twins, Falabo Khuzwayo, Mabhilidi noNjoko. Izithameli nezitatanyiswa bezifinya ngendololwane ngenxa yezinkomo ezingaphezu kuka-10 ebezigingqiwe futhi neziphuzo zingangamanzi okuphala izikhumba.INkosi uMpungose ithe iyaqala ngqa ukusiniselwa kodwa ayinaso isiqiniseko sokuthi igcinile. Ithe kuzoya ngokuthi iyawathola yini amandla okuthatha omunye undlunkulu.Inkosi noMaGoqo babusiswe ngamasu amathathu, okungamantombazane amabili aphilayo neyodwa eyadlula emhlabeni.
ZIFISA nokuhamba emhlabeni izingane ezithi zihujiswe utalagu zibizelwa umsebenzi wokuba amasosha maqede zase zilaxazwa okwenyongo yenyathi.Laba bathi okubaphethe kabuhlungu kakhulu ukuthi bashiye phansi imisebenzi ebebekade beyenza abanye bayeka nasemanyuvesi bethemba ukuthi sekufikile ukukhanya kanti kakunjalo, kuza ubumnyama obukhulu. Bathe bachithwe ekugcineni kwathiwa sebeyizitufuza kakhulu abanye kwathi bondile. Manje basola inkohlakalo.Bathi bafe olwembiza kunjalo nje badukuza ebumnyameni ngokuthi ngampela kwenzekeni. Balandise Isolezwe ngakho konke okwenzekile kusukela befake izicelo zokuba yingxenye yamasosha ombutho waseNingizimu Afrika.Omunye wabo waseMlaza ocele ukungadalulwa, uthe njengoba babekade befake izicelo bathole izingcingo ebezibazisa ukuthi kuyiwa enkambini eseKimberley. Uthe batshelwe ukuthi kuhlanganelwa enkanjini yamasosha eseThekwini, ebizwa ngokuthi yiKing Shaka.Uthe bayile nebala ukuyohlangana lapha ngo-Agasti 16. Uthe nakhona lapha bahlangabezane nezimbila zithutha njengoba amabhasi engazange afike ngosuku obekumele bahambe ngalo kwaze kwadingeka ukuba balale khona."Salala amabhasi aze afika ngakusasa. Nakhona uma esefika ngakusasa amabhasi abayicabangi nje indaba yokuthi kumele sigeze. Basinikeza ukudla kuphela base bethi asihambe sinjalo singagezile sesibheke eKimberley,'' usho kanje.Utshele Isolezwe ukuthi le nto imbulele ephila njengoba eyeke isigubhukane emsebenzi abewenza enkampanini esemkhakheni wezezimoto ngoba ethi ufuna ukuba yisosha.''Angisazi ukuthi ngithini manje ngoba ngiyekile emsebenzini ngizitshela ukuthi sengiyoba yisosha kanti ngimane ngiyazikhohlisa nje,'' echaza.Sebefikile eKimberley, uthe baqeqeshiwe base behlolwa izifo kanjalo nezisindo zemizimba yabo.''Mina ngesikhathi bengihlola isisindo somzimba bathola ukuthi sithe xaxa kancane kunangesikhathi ngithathwa eThekwini. Kodwa nalapho futhi basitshela ukuthi asikhululeke kayikho inkinga ngalokho,'' usho kanje.Uthe ukudla kushintshile epuletini bajikelwa esiswini njengotshwala sekufika udokotela ngoMsombuluko, esephinda ebahlola izisindo wase ebatshela ukuthi bonakele, mabaphindele emakhaya.''Ngithe ngisadidwe yilokho, ngathathwa ngayiswa kumuntu okuthiwa ungumeluleki wezengqondo naye ofike waqinisekisa ukuthi ngiphinda emuva ekhaya," kusho yena.Okumphatha kabi kakhulu wukuthi usayiniswe ngendluzula amaphepha okuthi useyahoxa ebusosheni.Omunye wesilisa waseMandeni, uthe kuphelile ngempilo yakhe ngemuva kwalesi sehlo. Uthe naye uthole ucingo wase esukumela phezuliu engazi ukuthi kanti ngokuvuma ukuhamba kuyefana nokuthi uzigxoba umphambili.Utshele Isolezwe ukuthi sebefikile eKimberley, basayiniswe izinkontileka okuyinto okuthi uma eyicabanga avele ezwe inhliziyo yakhe icwila emafutheni.''Mina nje bengisayiniswe inkontileka ebithi ngizohola imali engu-R11 000 nemfalakahlana nyanga zonke. Angikaze ngijabule kanjena ngoba bengicabanga ukuthi ekhaya kuzophela ukuhlupheka,'' echaza.Uthe ngale mali ubebona kahle nje ukuthi ikhaya lakhe lizoba ngcono uzokwazi ukuxosha ikati eziko."Okunye okuvele kungiphathe kabuhlungu kakhulu ukuthi sinikezwe nemifaniswano saze sayigqoka kanti kudlalwa ngemizwa yethu."Uqhube wathi naye kube yinto ngefanayo, wachithwa kukhalwa ngesisindo sakhe."Umama ongizalayo uhola impesheni ubejabule kabi ngoba ubaba akasekho ethi kuzoke kukhanye lapha ekhaya kanti kakunjalo,'' echaza.Uthe naye ubhekene nengwadla njengoba exhaswe yisikhwama sabafundi iNSFAS kodwa yena umane wayeka ukuyobhala izivivinyo zakhe esikhungweni semfundo ephakeme ngoba eseya emasosheni. Uthe ubefunda eTshwane University of Technology."Angiboni ukuthi basazongivumela ukuthi ngibuyele ngiyobhala futhi ekubeni ngingabikanga lutho ngokungabhali nesisodwa isivivinyo,'' echaza.Enye intokazi (20) yaKwaMashu, ithe igqemeke engeqiwa ntwala ngoba leli bekuyithuba eliyingqayizivele empilweni yayo."Cabanga ngoba ngize ngasula ngayeka izifundo zami zePublic Relations ebengikade ngizenza e-Unisa. Okubuhlungu ukuthi bengenza unyaka wesibili futhi ngixhaswe yisikhwama iNSFAS," kuchaza le ntokazi.Ithe inhliziyo yayo iyabhibha ngoba uma isibuyela esikoleni kuzomele izikhokhele yonke imali."Ekhaya ngihlala nogogo, akekho umuntu osebenzayo,'' isho kanjena.Iqhube ngokuthi kuyabhimba ngoba noyise udlule emhlabeni kuwona lo nyaka. Ithe nayo ibisinikeziwe umfaniswano."Angazi ukuthi kwenzeke kanjani ukuthi sinikezwe umfaniswano ebese siyachithwa futhi,'' echaza.Okhulumela iSouth African National Defence Force (SANDF), uRear Admiral Prince Tshabala, uthe kuningi okuye kudale ukuthi umuntu angaphumeleli kwisigaba sokugcina. Uthe akekho umuntu ojikiswa ngaphandle kwesizathu. Uthe odokotela babo baseqophelweni eliphezulu, bakheka yonke into ngenxa yokuthi umsebenzi wamasosha ubucayi.''Kwesinye isikhathi bayajikiswa ngenxa yemizimba yabo. Abanye uma kutholakale ukuthi banesifo senhliziyo. Abanye siye sithole ukuthi sebekhulelwe. Kodwa enye inkinga enkulu kuye kube ukuthi umuntu usefake i-tattoo okuyinto engavumelekile nje nhlobo embuthweni wamasosha,''usho kanjena.Ugcizelele ukuthi abantu kumele bazi ukuthi uma bebiziwe kwiSANDF kusuke kusazoba khona ezinye izigaba abaqale badlule kuzona ngaphambi kokuba kuqinisikiswe ukuqashwa kwabo ngokugcwele. Uthe ilahleka lapho-ke ngoba abaningi uma sebebiziwe bamane bacabange ukuthi sekuqondile kanti kunemigudu abazofike badlule kuyona ankambini.
UTHISHANHLOKO waseSkomplazi, eHlobane, uMnuz Zakhele Selby Xulu, uthi wukusebenza kanzima okumenze wadla umhlanganiso engqungqutheleni yothishomkhulu ebiseBoardwalk Convention Centre, eGqeberha, e-Eastern Cape. UXulu (38), onguthishanhloko waseNkwambazi, ukhale wemuka nomklomelo iBest Leadership Award kwi-2025 South African Principals Association (SAPA). Le ngqungquthela ebiyizinsuku ezintathu ibingempelasonnto eyedlule. Ngosuku lokugcina kube ne-Gala Dinner ehlangene nokuklonyeliswa kothishomkhulu abenza okudlulele ezikoleni zabo, lapho bekumele othishanhloko bafake isicelo sokuphakanyiswa noma sokuziphakamisa bese eletha bonke ubufakazi obuqinisekisa ukuthi nguyena lona owenza lo msebenzi. Yilapho uXulu ebaqwaqwade khona bonke othishanhloko abedlana nabo imilala. Ekhuluma neSolezwe, uXulu uthe amagalelo akhe enze wadla umhlanganiso."Ngibuyise amanzi esikoleni emuva kweminyaka eyisithupha nezinyanga eziyisishigalolunye, ngokunxenxa abaxhasi okuyiFortress, isebenzisana neFood and Trees for Africa. Ukubuya kwamanzi kube wusizo olukhulu olubala ukusetshenziswa kwamathoyilethi ahlanzekile, ukuphuza amanzi ahlanzekile, ukunisela ingadi nokupheka ukudla kwabafundi."Uthe ubuye watholela isikole izincwadi ezingu-500 kwa-Avbob ebambisene ne-Oxford University, ukulekelela abantwana ukuba bafunde ngokuqondisisa. Ngokubambisana nothisha, uXulu wenze ingadi yesikole wayetha ngeNkwambazi Garden Club lapho betshala khona nabantwana, okuthe sekuvunwa konke ukudla kwanikwa abantwana kanye nemindeni yabo."Ubuye wenza nokuthi abantwana noma besendaweni yasemakhaya kodwa bakwazi ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe bamanje, okubalwa ukusebenzisa iQR code, VR, online informal test nokunye okuhlukahlukene."UXulu, obefundisa esikoleni iKwaNotshelwa High, uthe ubuye wasebenzisana nophiko lwakwaSASSA ukulekelela abafundi ngemifaniswano, okubenza bekuthande ukuza esikoleni."Ukugubha usuku lwabesifazane, okuhlanganisa abazali babafundi nothisha ngo-Agasti 9 kulo nyaka, eNkwambazi kwakuqala ngqa. Kulowo mcimbi kwakuxhase iSunbake. Kwafika ne-Old Mutual izofundisa ngemali, yaze yaqasha owesifazane wasendaweni uNksz Busiphi Mhlongo."Kule ngqungquthela ebihanjelwe ngothishomkhulu abangaphezu kuka-800, uXulu ubuye waba yisikhulumi esiqavile. Inkulumo kaXulu ithinte othishomkhulu abaningi ngenxa yokuthi uvelele yize esebenza esikoleni esiphansi kakhulu (Quintile 1) futhi esaziwa nge-multi-grade.UXulu ufunde eHlobane Primary, wadlulela KwaNotshelwa High lapho aphothula khona uGrade 12 ngaphambi kofufundela ubuthishela eTshwane University of Technology nase-University of Zululand (Ongoye) lapho enza khona iBachelor of Education (Honours) manje uphezu kwezeMaster's.
INGWAZI yemidlalo yeshashalazi, uDkt Mbongeni Ngema, seyizophumula ngokuthula lapho ilele khona emuva kokufezeka kwephupho layo leminyaka. Ngaphambi kokudlula emhlabeni ngoDisemba 27,2023, uNgema wayematasatasa namalungiselelo okusungula isikhungo iMbongeni Ngema Academy.Sekungumlando ukuthi uNgema, wodumo lweSarafina, washonela esibhedlela i-Adelaide and OR Tambo Memorial eMbizana, e-Eastern Cape emuva kokubandakanyeka engozini yemoto eyamehlela ephuma emngcwabeni kazakwabo eLusikisiki.UNgema usungula lesi sikhungo nje, wayesekhiqize inqwaba yosaziwayo abahlonishwayo kuleli okubalwa kubo oSomizi Mhlongo, Sindi Dlathu, Leleti Khumalo,Wendy Mseleku, Mfana Jones Hlophe, Thulani Didi, Zimdollar Biyela, Bingelela Mpanza nabanye abaningi. Indodana kaNgema, u-Africa, ithe iMbongeni Ngema Academy izoqala ukuqeqesha amaciko aphokophele ukuzifukula ngolwazi amasonto ayisishiyagalombili, eBat Centre eThekwini kusukela ngo-Okthoba 6 kuya kuNovemba 8 kulo nyaka.U-Africa ubambisene kulesi sikhungo nonina uNompumelelo Ngema, uNtombi Ngema oyi-Chief Operations Officer yalesi sikhungo noSihle Bam oyi-Chief Executive Officer."Leli bekuyiphupho likababa. Wayefuna ukunikeza abaculi abasha indawo yokufunda, yokukhula, nokuqhakambisa amasiko ethu. Sajabula kuphakanyiswa iPlayhouse njengendawo engaguqulwa ibizwe ngeqhawe uDkt Mbongeni Ngema. Sasithi kuzovuleka naso isikhala sokulolonga abathanda umkhakha weshashalazi kepha kwaphelela emoyeni. Ubaba nokho usifundisile ukuphikelela, nokuqhubeka nemibono esinayo noma kunzima kangakanani. Sibonga iBat Centre ngokuvula ithuba lokubambisana.”U-Africa uthe okuzokwenza isikhungo sikayise sihluke kwezinye wukuthi kusona umuntu uzothi efunda athole amava emkhakheni wokulingisa."Maningi amathuba okuthi uma kuphela ukulolongwa kungeneke emsebenzini. Lokhu kunikeza abafundi ithuba eliyingqayizivele lokufunda nokudlala emidlalweni yangempela. Izifundo sizohlanganisa ukuqeqeshwa okujulile kokudansa, ukulingisa nokucula. Konke kwesekwe emisebenzini nasezinkolelweni zobuciko zikaDkt Ngema.Sinikeza abaculi abasha ithuba lokungena emibonweni yakhe yokucija. Ukubhalisa kuvuliwe, okunikeza abaculi abasha ithuba eliyingqayizivele lokufunda kochwepheshe abaphethe umoya nezimfundiso zenkakha kubalingisi, uDkt Mbongeni Ngema."USihle uthe ujabule ngokuthi ligcine lifezekile iphupho likaNgema."Sibongela abafundi abazoqeqeshwa eMbongeni Ngema Academy ngoba bazothola ulwazi oluphezulu kakhulu nokulolongwa ngongoti kulo mkhakha." UNtombi uthe bayakuthakasela ukwethulwa kwalesi sikhungo ngoba yiso kuphela isikhungo sezemfundo kwezobuciko esinezinhlelo ezisezingeni lomhlaba futhi ezihlala zifuneka."Umbono wethu wukuhlonza ikhono,siqeqeshe, futhi sakhe amathuba okuqashwa aqhubekayo emacikweni aseNingizimu Afrika nakwamanye amazwe,” kusho uNtombi.
AMACIKO akuleli ahlonishwa emhlabeni jikelele, uSolwazi Zakes Mda noDkt John Kani, azocobelela ngolwazi ozakwabo abasafufusa eCentre for Creative Arts, e-University of KwaZulu-Natal eThekwini ngoMsombuluko kuya ngoLwesithathu.UKani uzobe ekhipha amangwevu ngobuchule emkhakhenji wokulingisa bese uMda egxila ebungcwetini bokulotshwa kwezincwadi ngaphansi kwesikhungo esisanda kusungulwa iJohn Kani Perfoming Arts Academy (JKA).Lezi zingwevu zizobe zihambisana nomdidiyeli wemidlalo yaseshashalazini, uSteven Stead, yena onguqolothakamango emnxeni wokuqondiswa kwemidlalo. Ngokusho kwesitatimende esithunyelelwe imithombo yezindaba ngabe Centre for Creative Arts, lama-masterclass azobe evuleleke kubantu abayingcosana ukuqinisekisa ukuthi baphekwa baze bavuthwe tobo kule mikhakha.Amaciko azobuye avulwe amehlo ngolwazi lokuthi bengawuvikela kanjani umsebenzi wabo ngaphansi kwe-Intellectual Property & Copyrights, okuwuhlelo oluzobe lwethulwa ngabeCIPC.UKani uthe kuyisibusiso kuye ukwethula uJohn Kani Perfoming Academy KwaZulu-Natal ngoba kuzomnikeza ingqayizivele yethuba lokuxhumana nozakwabo ayibambe nabo insimbi ishisa mkhakheni wezobuciko."Izinhloso zeJKA ukuthuthukisa ulwazi nokufukula amaciko aseza ngemuva. Ngiyalubonga uxhaso lwemali ekhishwe wuMnyango wezeMidlalo, ezobuCiko namaSiko ukuze iJKA ikwazi ukuletha lezi zifundo eKZN."Uthe ngalezi zifundo uqonde ukuba amaciko asemnkantshobomvu abelane ngolwazi nasafufusa. UMqondisi weCentre for Creative Arts futhi oyilungu lebhodi yeJohn Kani Perfoming Arts Academy, u-Ismail Mahomed, uthe bakuthakasele kakhulu ukusingatha uchungechunge lokuqala lwezifundo zalesi sikhungo. Amagalelo kaKani ayaziwa kakhulu kuleli nasemazweni aphesheya kwezilwandle kangangoba yena nozakwabo ongasekho uBarney Simon basungula iMarket Theatre Laboratory eminyakeni engu-30 eyedlule.Ngokusungula iJohn Kani Perfoming Arts Academy uthe uqonde ukufukula ulwazi lwamaciko asacathula naseqalile ukuveza amakhono awo endimeni yezokulingisa.Lama-JKA Masterclasses eThekwini azobe elawulwa yithimba elingaphansi kwe-Emerging Arts Management eCentre for Creative Arts, okungoThalente Ndlovu owenza izifundo zeMasters ezifundweni ze-literature and theatre, uKholeka Khumbuza ongumdidiyeli wamafilimu osathwasa kodwa osenenqwaba yemiklomelo noMvunga osesingathe izinhlelo eziningi kulesi sikhungo. Ngeminingwane egcwele kungenwa ku:https://cca.ukzn.ac.za.
KULOKOZA inhlansi yethemba enkingeni yokwenyuka kwezinga lobugebengu ezindaweni zamakhosi ahlukene kuMasipala waseMfolozi ngemuva kokuba kwethulwe isiteshi samaphoyisa esingumahambanendlwana. Lesi siteshi esiKwaMbonambi singesinye kwezine ezethulwa nguNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli ngenyanga eyedlule.IMeya kaMasipala waseMfolozi, uMnuz uXolani Bhengu namakhosi abehambele lo mcimbi wokwethulwa kwalesi siteshi okubalwa kubo iNkosi uMthiyane yaKwaSokhulu, iNkosi uMthiyane yaseMaMbuka, iNkosi uMthethwa KwesaKwaMthethwa neNkosi uMbuyazi, amaphoyisa, izinduna, nenhloko yoMnyango wezokuPhepha nokuXhumanisa uMphakathi, uMnuz Vuyani Mbesa. Babonge undunankulu emva ngokuzwa isikhalo somphakathi waseMfolozi njengoba iMeya uBhengu ibilokhu ilubike njalo udaba ubugebengu obudlangayo ngaphansi kwalo masipala.Kwethulwa lesi siteshi nje, kuzokhumbuleka phela ukuthi seziyinsakavukela izigameko zobugebengu ezithusayo ezibikwayo ngaphansi kukalo masipala.Kuvelile ukuthi lesi siteshi siphelele njengoba kukhona indawo yokugcina oboshiwe, eyokuhlala abasuke bezofuna usizo nokunye kanti kuzoba nohlelo lokuthi sihambele imiphakathi eyehlukene. Wonke amakhosi asho ngazwilinye kwelokuthi ukhona umehluko ozoke ubonakale ngemuva kokuthulwa kwaleso. INkosi yesizwe sakwaMthethwa, uMduduzeni Mthethwa, ithe bahlabeke umxhwele ngokuthulwa ngokusemthethweni kwalesi siteshi. UMthethwa uthe ubugebengu budlangile kule ndawo.Uthe okumqoka ukuthi kube khona ukusebenzisana okuba khona phakathi komphakathi namaphoyisa ngenhloso yokunqoba ubugebengu."Sijabule kakhulu ngalesi siteshi esesizoba khona manje kodwa sinxusa ukuthi kube khona ukubambisana kithina sonke ukuze kunqotshwe ubugebengu. Ngingenile ngaphakathi kule sisiteshi, ngigculisekile kakhulu ngaso. Ngikholwa ukuthi nakanjani sizowenza umehluko emphakathini wakithi,'' kusho inkosi.UNdunankulu uNtuli ethula omahamba nendlwana beziteshi, wakuchaza njengento emqoka kakhulu ukubaluleka kokuba kube khona okwenziwayo ngenhloso yokulwa nobugebengu kuzona zonke izingxenye ezahlukene zesifundazwe iKwaZulu-Natal. Wagcizelela nokubaluleka kokubambisana phakathi kwezinhlakaza ezhlukene ezimele umphakathi namaphoyisa.
UKUPHUZA ukwethulwa kwesabelomali sezwe kulo nyaka kwenze ukuthi isabelomali samaphakathi nonyaka sethulwe ngoNovemba.Isabelomali sikazwelonke okujwayeleke ukuthi sethulwe njalo ngoFebhuwari, saphuza ukwethulwa ngenxa yokungavumelani kwamaqembu akuhulumeni wokubambisana kuleli, iGNU.Isabelomali esibuyekeziwe saze sethulwa ngoMeyi ngenxa yakho ukubambezeleka ngenxa yokuthi kwakusaqhubeka izingxoxo. UMgcinimafa kazwelonke umemezele ukuthi isabelomali esibuyekeziwe sizothulwa ngoNovemba 21, 2025.Okhulumela iPhalamende, uMnuz Moloto Mothapo, uthe iPhalamende lidedele uhlu lwezinhlelo zalo zekota yesine lapho kukhishwe nosuku lokwethulwa kwalesi sabelomali.Uthe izikhulu zomnyango kaMgcinimafa zimatasa nezinhlelo ezithinta isabelomali esibuyekeziwe."Isabelomali esibuyekeziwe sizokwethulwa nguNgqongqoshe uMnuz Enoch Godongwana, kulandelwa nemigomo ethinta uMthethosisekelo olawula lesi sabelomali. IPhalamende lizogunyaza lesi sabelomali ngonyaka ozayo. Usuku lokusigunyaza olusekhalendeni lePhalamende nguJanuwari 13, 2026,," kusho uMothapo. Uthe lokhu kwenziwe ngumbono owabakhona emaqenjini ahlukene ayechitha ukuphasiswa kwaso."Asethembe ukuthi ngeke kube nokuphazamiseka ezinhlelweni ezithinta isabelomali." Isabelomali esibuyekeziwe sijwayele ukwethulwa ngo-Okthoba minyaka yonke.Umbango esabelweni sokuqala wasuswa wukuthi i-ANC yayifune ukunyusa intela afakwa uma kuthengwa impahla, iVAT. Lokhu kwenza amaqembu ahlukene kwi-GNU ashaya amakhala esichitha ethi lingawa licoshwe yizinkukhu uma engavumela ukuthi kunyuswe iVAT ngoba lokho kuzoshaya abantu abahlwempu. UMgcinimafa wakhala ngokuthi ukunganyuswa kwesabelomali kuzovula umgodi kaR75 billion, emnothweni.Ukuklwebhana kwamaqembu i-DA ne-ANC kwi-GNU kwaqubula nezinkulumo zokuthi i-DA ingase ihoxe kulo hulumeni. Kodwa leli qembu lashaya phansi ngonyawo lathi aliyi ndawo ngoba alifuni ukuthi i-EFF ibe yingxenye kahulumeni.I-EFF ihlale ilibeka ngembaba elokuthi izimisele ukuba yingxenye kahulumeni kodwa ayifuni ukusebenza ne-DA.
KUQOPEHEKE umlando kwavuleka isahluko esisha esizweni sakwaMuthwa njengoba bekuhalaliselwa uFata wokuqala ngqa wakulesi sizwe ebandleni lamaRoma Akhatholika.Loyo nguFata Nkanyiso Osman Muthwa ongumelusi wePherishi yaseMhlabashana eXobho.Ubenzelwe indumezulu yemisa lokubongwa yiPherishi azalelwa kuyona yaKwaMakhutha iLady of Surrows. Kuleli misa uchazwe njengomunye wabaholi abayidlanzana abalisebenzela ngeqiniso kanjalo nangokuzikhandla ibandla likaNkulunkulu. Wethulelwe isigqoko ngendlela abonakale esebenza ngayo ngesikhathi enza izifundo zakhe zobuPhristi.UMnuz Nje Muthwa uthe bajabule kakhulu ngokuqopheka komlando esizweni sakaMuthwa. Obekwenzeka kuleli misa ukufanise nokuqala kwesahluko esisha ebandleni lamaRoma kanjalo nakusona isizwe uqobo.Uthe kulesi sizwe bahlabeke umxhwele ngokuthi omunye wabo uqale izifundo zobuPhristi waze waziphothula. ''Siyaziqhenya kakhulu ngalokhu okwenzekile. Siyabonga ukuthi namhlanje sizozibonela ngalawa awethu amehlo kubhaleka umlando omusha ngesizwe sethu kanjalo nangebandla lamaRoma Akhatholika,'' usho kanjena.Usomabhizinisi odumile oyilungu lomndeni kaFata Muthwa, uMnuz Graham Sabela onguSihlalo wenkampani iG Force Employement Solutions umethulele isigqoko uFata Muthwa. Wamfisela nohambo oluhle noluphephile.''Sijabale kakhulu sesifisa ukuthi konke okwenzayo kubonakale kuhamba kahle ngaso sonke isikhathi,'' usho kanjena.UFata Muthwa uthe lolu bekuwuhambo obelunezinselelo kodwa ngenxa yokuphokophelela ukuphothula ukwazile ukudlula kuzona. Uthe inkinga ebinkulu wukuthi ubenza lezi zifundo emazweni angaphandle.Uthe inkinga bekufike kube wulimi kodwa ngenxa yokuzinikela nokuzitshela ukuthi leyo nto uzimisele ngokuyenza bekumane kube lula nje izinto zenzeke. ''Ngiyabonga kakhulu kubona bonke abakwazile ukuthi bangeseke selokhu ngiluqalile lolu hambo lwami. Ngabe ngiqamba amanga aluhlaza uma ngingathi konke bekulula ngoba bekungenjalo. Ukuphikelela yikhona kanye okumane kwenza izinto zenzeka,'' usho kanjena.Uthe uzimisele ngokuqhubeka asebenzele ibandla ngobuqotho, ngokuzikhandla ngaso sonke isikhathi.Esigabeni sesibile senkonzo uFata Muthwa ugixatshezwe ngendathane yezipho kanye nemali obekuvela emalungwini ebandla.Uthole nesheke likaR50 000, igilosa nomnikelo onikelwe ngesikhathi senkonzo ongahlangene nesheke. Ngesikhathi elokhu ethola izipho ubebonakala emehlweni ukuthi umangele ukuthi kwenzekani.UFata Muthwa ugocotshelwe kwesobuPhristi ngoJulayi 12 kuwona lo nyaka egcotshwa nguMbhishobhi oyiNhloko yebandla lamaRoma Akhatholika kwisiFundabhishobhi saseMarriannhill, uMbhishobhi Neil Augustine Frank, kwindumezulu yenkonzo eyayiseKevelaer Mission.
ULAHLWE elakubo uMnuz Nkululeko Phillip Maphumulo (28) njengoba etholwe yiNkantolo yesiFunda yaseVerulam enecala lokubulala loyo owayekade eyimeya kuMasipala waseNdwedwe, uMnuz Maxwell Hadebe.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi uMaphumulo ongowaKwaMaphumulo ngokudabuka, ubekade egqigqa le nkantolo ngecala alibekwe uMbuso lokufa kukaHadebe.Akusilona kuphela icala abebekwe lona uMbuso njengoba ebekade ebekwe nelinye lokusocongwa kukaMnuz Mbongeni Ndlovu. Bobabili kuvela ukuthi babulawa ngokudutshulwa ezigamekweni ezenzeka izinsuku zilandelana ezindaweni ezahlukene.Loyo owayekade eyimeya yaseNdwedwe yena kuthiwa wahlaselwa uMaphumulo eCornubia, wazama ukumphanga imoto efuna ngodli izikhiye zemoto. Kuthiwa uHadebe wadutshulwa wafa kusona lesi sigameko esenzeka ngoJuni 19, 2019, eCornubia. Ngakusasa, kwatholakala isidumbu sikaNdlovu, eMsunduzi. Inkantolo isebenzise kakhulu ubufakazi obethulwa ngowesifazane, uNksz Busisiwe Zulu.Lo fakazi watshela inkantolo ukuthi wakubona konke okwenzeka ngesikhathi sesigameko. Kuthiwa ufakazi watshela inkantolo ukuthi wabubona ubuso bukammangali ebulala uHadebe.''Ufakazi waze waqinisekisa, wathi akasoze aphinde abukhohlwa lobo buso abubona ngalelo langa,'' kuchaza imantshi uBetty Rawheath.Lo fakazi kuthiwa wathi kwaba lula ukuba abone konke ngenxa yokuthi kwabe kukhona amalambu asemgwaqweni kukhanya namalambu emoto kamufi. Imantshi ithe iyabemukela ubufakazi obethulwa nguNksz Zulu ngoba akukho lapho obuphikisana khona."Sasingekho isidingo sokuba lo fakazi angaqamba amanga afakaze into engekho ngomuntu angamazi. Inkantolo yathola ukuthi ummangalelwa nofakazi kabazani ukuthi nje kwenzeka ukuthi ngosuku lwesigameko banqwamene endaweni eyodwa,'' kuchaza imatshi.Lo fakazi kuthiwa wakuqinisekisa ukuthi wambona ummangalelwa eqala ehilizisana nomufi ngoba efuna aphume emotweni. Ngokusho kukafakazi, kuthiwa uMaphumulo wamthembisa ukumbulala umufi uma eqhubeka egweva nemoto yohlobo lweToyota Run X.Ufakazi wathi uMaphumulo wamphuca neselula yakhe umufi esedindilizile wamphuca nezikhiye zemoto. Iqhuba imantshi, ithe ubufakazi bukaNksz Zulu buyahambiselana nobephoyisa uConstable Ndimande owafika endaweni yesigameko.''Leli phoyisa nalo lathi lathola amagobolondo ezinhlamvu ngenxa yokuthi amalambu emoto nawasemgwaqwni ayekade ekhanya kahle nje bha,'' echaza.Ngenxa yabo bonke lobu bufakazi, iNkantolo yesiFunda yaseVerulam ithe uMaphumulo imthola enecala lokubulala uHadebe.Kanjalo nasecaleni lokuqala lokuduma imoto, inkantolo imthole enecala uMaphumulo. Ecaleni lesibili lokubulawa kukaNdlovu, inkantolo ithe imkhipha phambili uMaphumulo. Ithe lokhu ikwenza nakuba efana amagobolondo atholakala endaweni yokubulawa kukaNdlovu noHadebe.''Inkinga ekhona esigamekweni sesibili ukuthi akekho ufakazi ofikile ankantolo wazoyichazela ukuthi ngampela wabona uMaphumulo lokhu ekwenza. Kuyiqiniso wabulawa impela uNdlovu namagobolondo ayefana kodwa akekho ongama ngonyawo olulodwa athi wambona uMaphumulo ebulala uNdlovu ngelanga lesi sigameko,'' kusho imantshi.Inkantolo ithe okushayisa amakhala ukuthi wangena ezintangeni uMaphumulo ngesikhathi ebuzwa ukuthi wayekephi ngosuku lwangoJuni 19."Angeke inkantolo ibamukele ubufakazi bukaMaphumulo ngenxa yokuthi naye ufakazi akakhulumanga into ecacile ebuzwa ngalolu suku,'' echaza.UMaphumulo akazange athuke ngesikhathi inkantolo imemezela ukulahlwa kwakhe yicala lokusocongwa kukaHadebe. Ubebonakala ewumuntu okhululekile nje, kwaba sengethi akezwanga lutho.Ubekade efake isikibha esimhlophe ebesinombhalo omkhulu obhalwe ngamagama abomvu othi: GALXBOY. Limshonele kanjalo ilanga uMaphumulo, aphuma ejabhile enkantolo amalungu omndeni wakhe.UMaphumulo ubekade ephethe amanzi ngesandla, kuthe esephuma enkantolo waxhawula omunye womndeni wamcifela iso.
IMEYA yeTheku, uMNuz Cyril Xaba isiphumele obala yezwakalisa ukuthi kukhona okumele kwenziwe ngenhloso yokubhekana ngqo nesihlava esigubuzele leli dolobha sokwebiwa kwezimoto zomkhandlu.UXaba uthi seyithanda ukuba yinsakavukela inkinga yokwebiwa kwezimoto zomkhandlu. EMIPHAKATHINI esiphila kuyona ziningi izinhlangano okuhlanganela kuzo abantu ngezinhloso ezahlukene.Singabala lapho amadoda ehlangana edodisana futhi enikana izeluleko zempilo, izitokofela, ukwelulekana ngokwengqondo, ukududuzana nokunye okuningi. Kepha kukhona inhlangano abaningi abangayinakile eyingxenye yezinhlaka emabandleni ezenkolo, uDodana. Amabandla adume ngokuthi awomthetho anayo le nhlangano esingabala iPrayer Men's League (PML) eLuthela, uJosefa kumaKhatholika, amadodana eWeseli nezinye. Ngenxa yokuthi ababaningi abesilisa emabandleni, uDodana luthatheka njengenhlangano encane futhi engenaso isisindo kanti akunjalo. Kuyigugu elikhulu ukuba yilungu loDodana. Kule nhlangano kuyakhuliswana ngokukaMoya, ngokwempilo nangakho konke okudingwa wumuntu. Lapha umuntu wesilisa uyakhuliswa, uyaduduzwa uma edinga, kuyalekelelwana nasezinhluphekweni. Abesilisa, njengezinhloko zamakhaya, inhlangano yoDodana iyinkundla efanele lapho bengathola khona ukwakheka nangezindlela zokuphathwa kwemindeni namakhaya. Abanye namuhla bayasebenza ngokusizwa amalungu abasenhlanganweni nawo. Phela oDodaneni kuhlangene izinhlobo zabantu ezihlukene ngokwemikhakha yempilo. Kukhona abaholi, izincithabuchopho, abanamakhono neziphiwo okwahlukahlukene. Akugcini ngezikaMoya kuphela, kuba nezikhathi lapho udodana luzikhipha luyoshaywa wumoya okungaba ngezimpelasonto kugqokwe izingubo zokuphola, kube nezoso, kwezinye izikhathi kuyiwe ezinkundleni zemidlalo kuyobukwa ibhola ndawonye noma kudlalwe igalofu. Lokhu bakwenzela ukuba bazane kangcono impilo abayiphilayo uma bengekho enkonzweni. Ngenxa yemfudumalo etholakala oDodaneni, muva nje kule nhlangano sesandile isibalo sentsha engamalungu ayo. Umbuzo ongavela owokuthi yini eheha intsha? Ngingasho ngingananazi ukuthi ayikho ingcindezi oDodaneni, wonke umuntu oyilungu uzizwa esekhaya futhi unabafowabo abahlezi behamba naye kukuhle noma kukubi. Ngisho unezinkinga ekhaya uyazi ukuthi bakhona abafowenu bakaMoya abazokusiza futhi abangeke bagiye ngezinkinga zakho. Akugcinwa ngokuthi izinkinga zikhulunywe kepha ziyabikwa ngomkhuleko kophezu konke kwazise uDodana luyinhlangano ephila ngomkhuleko. Nasebelahlekelwe yithemba, uma besoDodaneni liyabuya impilo iqhubeke.Ebandleni likhulu iqhaza loDodana, yilo olunakekela izakhiwo zebandla luqinisekise ukuthi okudinga ukulungiswa kuyalungiswa. Ngamafuphi, amadodana ayiso nabavikeli bebandla. Zonke izinhlangano zebandla zithembele kumadodana njengoba amanye enamakhosikazi nezingane emabandleni akuwo. Amanye iminikelo yamalungu emindeni yawo iphuma kuwo okuwukuqinisekisa ukuthi angabavikeli nezinhloko zamakhaya okungafanele kuphelele ekhaya kepha bakwenze nasenkonzweni. Ngingabagqugquzela abesilisa ukuba balujoyine uDodana ngoba ikhona impilo kulo. Intsha ezimisele ngokuphumelela empilweni ingasika iphethini kumaDodana aseWeseli aseyibambe iminyaka engu-40 eqhulula umculo wokholo. Abambelela emculweni owenze aqhelelana nezinto ezingenza agcine esephelela ezinsisheni noma eseyodonsa iminyaka ejele.Obhalile nguSabelo Mbatha webandla lamaLuthela eseketheni yaseThekwini.
UNGOTI wezomthetho uthi uNgqongqoshe wezamaPhoyisa omisiwe, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, akanawo amandla okuhlakaza ithimba lamaphoyisa eliphenya amacala okubulawa kosopolitiki KwaZulu-Natal. Inhloko yezomthetho emaphoyiseni, uMajor General Petronella Margaretha Van Rooyen, ithe umyalelo kaMchunu wokuba kuhlakazwe ithimba uphambene nomthetho olawula ukusebenza kwamaphoyisa.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ethula ubufakazi phambi kweKhomishini eholwa iJaji uMbuyiseli Madlanga.UMajor General Van Rooyen uthe nguKhomishana wamaPhoyisa, uLieutenant General Fannie Masemola, kuphela onamandla okuhlakaza ithimba."Asikho isigaba somthetho esivumela ungqongqoshe ukuba ahlakaze ithimba. Udaba lwethimba luthinta ukusebenza kwamaphoyisa, nokuyindawo ungqongqoshe angangeni kuyona." UMasemola waveza ukuthi uMchunu wamtshela ukuthi uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, wavuma ukuba kuhlakazwe ithimba.UMajor General Van Rooyen uthe noma ngabe uRamaphosa wavumelana nokuhlakazwa kwethimba akukushintshi ukuthi isinqumo sikaMchunu sasingekho emthethweni."Yonke into abayenzayo kufanele ilandele umthetho. Ukuvumelana kwabo akusho ukuthi kwakusemthethweni ukuhlakazwa kwethimba."UMajor General Van Rooyen uthe noma ngabe uMchunu wayenawo amandla okuhlakaza ithimba, indlela enza ngayo ayilungile."Umyalelo wadala ukudideka okukhulu. Awukwazi ukuqhamuka usuthi ithimba alihlakazwe khona manje. Lokho kusho ukuthini ngamacala asezinkantolo? Usho ukuthi amaphoyisa awangabe esaya ezinkantolo ayophikisa izicelo zabheyili zabantu ababoshelwe amacala okubulawa kosopolitiki?"UMajor General Van Rooyen uthe kuphambene nomthetho okwenziwa ipPhini likaKhomishana wamaPhoyisa, uLiuetenant General Shadrack Sibiya, sokukhipha umyalelo wokuba onke amadokodo amacala okubulawa kosopolitiki KwaZulu-Natal alethwe ehhovisi lakhe."USibiya kwakungafanele aqhubeke nomyalelo ongekho emthethweni. Umthetho olawula ukusebenza kwamaphoyisa ukubeka kucace ukuthi amaphoyisa awavumelekile ukulandela imiyalelo engekho emthethweni. Umyalelo kaMchunu wawungekho emthethweni. Into uSibiya ayengayenza yena kwakungaba ukubikela uMasemola. Kwakufanele atshele uMasemola ukuthi nangu uMchunu enginikeza umyalelo ongekho emthethweni, bese kuba uMasemola onqumayo ukuthi akwenziweni."UMajor General Van Rooyen ugxeke ikomiti lasePhalamende elibhekelele ukusebenza koMnyango wamaPhoyisa ngokungasukumeli phezulu ngesikhathi uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, eqala ukwenza izinsolo zokugxambukela kosopolitiki ekusebenzeni kwamaphoyisa ngesikhathi ikomiti linomhlangano ngoMashi."UMkhwanazi wakhuluma ngalezi zinsolo emhlanganweni wekomiti lasePhalamende elibhekelele ukusebenza kwamaPhoyisa owawungoMashi. Akukho okwenziwa ikomiti kwaze kwaba uMkhwanazi ubiza isithangami nabezindaba ngoJulayi, lapho enza khona izinsolo ezifanayo. Kufanele ngabe kukhona uphenyo olwaqalwa ikomiti emva kwezinsolo ezenziwa uMkhwanazi. Uphenyo kwakufanele lwenziwe noma sekudlule kwamasonto amabili. Ikomiti lehluleka ukwenza umsebenzi walo."
ITHUKUTHELE iyaqhuma iNdlunkulu kaZulu ecishe yawuzwa ngendaba uMkhosi weLembe ngenxa yokucikizela kwezimoto ebizihlelelwe wuhulumeni. OwaseNdlunkulu ukhwele wadilika ezikhulwini zikahulumeni, waveza ukuthi abanye abaNtwana kuphoqeleke ukuthi benze ezinye izinhlelo zokuya koweLembe ngenxa yobuhixihixi ekuhlelweni kwezimoto ebezizobalanda.Omele iSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini endlini yobuholi bomdabu, uMntwana uNathi kaPhumanyova Zulu, uthe kuze kwashaya usuku lomkhosi, uLwesithathu, kungacaci ukuthi kwenzekani ngezimoto ebezihlelelwe abaNtwana baseNdlunkulu.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma eMkhosini weLembe, obuKwaDukuza ngoLwesithathu. UMntwana uNathi, obebhodla umlilo, uthe baze balala ngoLwesibili kungaqinisekisiwe ukuthi zizosuka nini izimoto ebezihlelelwe abaNtwana baseNdlunkulu. "Buningi ubunzima esibhekene nabo ekuhleleni izimoto ezizothwala abaNtwana beNkosi. Akukwazi ukuthi kwaziwa ukuthi kuzoba nomcimbi omkhulu kangaka kodwa izinhlelo zezimoto ezizothutha iNdlunkulu ngize ngitshelwe ngazo ngo-5.45 ekuseni. "Ngitshelwe ngo-5.45 ukuthi angikhulule izimoto zithathe abaNtwana, kwathiwa sesingaphuma. Izimoto zizosuka KwaNongoma ngo-5.45 ziza lapha. INgonyama izoqala umcimbi ngo-9 noma ngo-10. Zizofika nini lezo zimoto okuthiwa azisuke KwaNongoma ngo-5.45? Ngeke kuthi ngo-11 ebusuku (ngoLwesibili) ngitshelwe ukuthi angime, ngingazidedeli izimoto. Ngilale ngo-12, ngavuka ngo-4. Kuze kwashaya u-5.45 kwayima kuthiwa angizikhulule izimoto."UMntwana uNathi uthe bese behambile abaNtwana ngesikhathi kuphuma umyalelo wokuthi sezingaphuma izimoto ezizobathatha."Zizogitshelwa wubani lezi zimoto ngoba abaNtwana beNkosi bese behambile lapho abebezilinde khona. Kwenziwe ngamabomu ukuthi izimoto zingafiki ngesikhathi khona iNdlunkulu ingezukuwubona lo mcimbi. Mina ngokwazi kwami lo msebenzi owayo iNdlunkulu. INdlunkulu kufanele ifike izobona, innkanke iSilo ukuze umsebenzi ube yimpumelelo." UMntwana uNathi uthe wakhala ngalesi simo ngesikhathi kunomhlangano wokulungiselela umkhosi kodwa kubukeka sengathi izikhalo zakhe zashaywa indiva."Ngifikile nakulo mhlangano obuseStanger ngabatshela ukuthi musani ukubulala umsebenzi weNgonyama. Lo msebenzi waqalwa ngelinye izinga, manje seniwenza ube kwelinye izinga. Ngiyabona ukuthi bazitshele ukuthi ngiyadlala ngesikhathi ngibakhuza. Thina KwaMandlakazi sazi ukuthi kuningi umuntu okufanele enziwe khona uma engafuni ukulalela. Namanje ngiyacela ningikhuzele lo muntu okuthi kwaziwa ukuthi kunomsebenzi weNgonyama, yena angakugunyazi ukukhishwa kwezimoto ezizolanda abaNtwana baseNdlunkulu."Ubehleli isonto lonke engakugunyazi ukukhishwa kwezimoto, waze wakugunyaza ekuseni ngoba nakhu sekuthanda yena. Ukuthi nje yingoba nakhu ngingamazi. Kodwa ngiyacabanga ukuthi njengoba ngishaya inja uzovela umnikazi wayo. Uma ungamboni umnikazi wenja kufanele ushaye yona ukuze avele umnikazi wenja. Namanje angimazi lo muntu."Isililo soMntwana uNathi sinanelwe nangusihlalo wendlu yobuholi bomdabu KwaZulu-Natal, Inkosi Sifiso Shinga, naye okhale ngokuthi amakhosi abengahlelelwe izinto zokuthutha.Okhulumela uMnyango wobuCiko namaSiko KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thabo Mofokeng, ucele ukuba athunyelelwe imibuzo, nokho kuze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela engakayiphenduli.
SEBELALA obenyoni abesilisa abadayisa inhloko ezindaweni ezahlukene ezakhele iTheku, bekhala ngokuhlaliswa lubhojozi ngabathile abafuna inkokhelo ebizwa ngemali yokuvikelwa (protection fee).Laba bakhulume neSolezwe base becela ukuba agodlwe amagama abo bethi besabela ukuphepha kwabo.Owokuqala odayisa inhloko endaweni esingeke siyigagule, ulimise ngesihloko elokuthi kubi futhi izinto zibonakala ziphuma kakhulu esandleni kunakuqala.Uthe uhlalele ovalweni njengoba esethuka izanya. Utshele Isolezwe ukuthi ngasekupheleni konyaka owedlule, kwafika abesilisa abathathu abehla emotweni iVW Polo empunga, bamtshela eziqwini zamehlo ukuthi njalo uma kuphela inyanga bayacela ukuba abahlanganisele u-R... (esho imali engaphezulu kuka-R300, esingeke sayisho njengoba injalo ukumvikela)."Ngangizitshela ukuthi laba besilisa bayadlala. Kwathi uma ngibona ukuthi kabadlali ngase ngibabuza ukuthi ngeyani le mali futhi bangazelaphi? Bangiphendula ngokuthi ayazani kodwa kusuka manje isiyazana," usho kanjena.Uthe nebala, laba besilisa bafika ekupheleni kwenyanga bathi bacela okukaKhesari kuze kuKhesari."Oyedwa wabo ngalelo langa wayephethe isibhamu. Ngabanikeza leyo mali. Bavalelisa base bethi izophinde ibonane ekupheleni kwenyanga futhi," echaza.Uthe kusukela lapho uphila ngokukhokha le mali angazi ukuthi ngeyani. Uthe uke wacabanga ukuyeka ukuyikhokha kepha kwakhona omdonsa ngendlebe ukuba angakwenzi lokho."Othile wangitshela ukuthi ngingamane ngiyeke ukudayisa inhloko ngoba uma ngizoqhubeka nokudayisa inhloko ebese nginqwaha nale mali, kuyobe kuyefana nokuthi ngizimbela ithuna ngiphila," echaza.Uqhube ngokuthi okubuhlungu ukuthi endaweni kukhona ababili ababedayisa inhloko abadutshulwa ngendlela engaqondakali eminyakeni eyedlule.Uthe uzamile ukuyovula icala kodwa amaphoyisa amchitha.Omunye odayisa inhloko ngaphathi edolobheni eThekwini, utshele Isolezwe ukuthi usekhokhe le mali iminyaka emibili."Le mali bayilanda emini nje kwabha kubuka wonke umuntu. Mina njalo bafika bazenze abazothenga inhloko, bese ngibanikeza leyo mali," echaza.Uthe bala baphetha uma ecela ukuba le mali ifakwe ebhange. "Basho ukungiqeda bathi ngicabanga ukuthi bona kabasile emakhanda njengoba beyilanda esandleni yini?" echaza.Ulimise ngesihloko elokuthi usekhathele manje ukukhokha isikweletu esingapheli."Ibuhlungu kabi le nto eyenziwa yilaba bantu kithina. Ngifisa sengathi ngingathola usizo," echaza.Uthe ngelinye ilanga, wake watshela iphoyisa alijwayele ukuba libe khona ngosuku abazofika ngalo bezokoleka imali."Leli phoyisa lalingekho emsebenzini ngalelo langa kodwa lethuka uma libabona, lathi bayaziwa futhi bayesatshwa akukho elingakwenza," echaza.Omunye odayisa elokishini eliseningizimu neTheku, uthe lesi sihlava sesinezinyanga ezintathu siqalile elokishini."Namanje ngisamangele ukuthi kwenzekani. Sengidayise inhloko iminyaka eminingi kakhulu kodwa ngiyakweshwama lokhu osekwenzeka manje," esho.Bonke abakhulume neSolezwe bathe osekudala ukuthi bakhulume ukuthi batshelwe ukuthi isizokhuphuka manje le mali ibe u-R... beyigagula."Ubani ozokhipha imali engaka? Angeke phela," kubalisa omunye owenza lo msebenzi bude buduze nedolobha," esho.Amaphoyisa awatholakalanga ukuba aphawule ngalolu daba, kepha aseke asho phamabilini ukuthi abanenkinga yokudiziswa abaxhumane nawo ukuze basizakale.
LIHLABE ikhwelo ibamba likaMengameli wezwe uMnuz Paul Mashatile, ezikhungweni ezigcina amagugu ukuthi zifake isandla empini yokulwa nezinto ezifana nobugebengu nezidakamizwa ezidlange entsheni kanjalo nezinga eliphezulu lokungasebenzi.UMashatile ukhale ngokuthi lezi zinto zidinga ukusukunyelwa ngokushesha ngoba zifana nedimoni."Kumele izikhungo zamagugu ezweni zisize uhulumeni empini yokulwa nenkinga yokungasebenzi kwentsha. Iyasikhathaza indaba yezidakamizwa ezidlange entsheni, ubugebengu nenkohlakalo," kusho uMashatile ethula inkulumo kugujwa uSuku lwamaGugu e-Oudtshoorn, eWestern Cape izolo. Uthe ukungenelela kwalezi zikhungo kungathela izithelo ezinhle."Nemiphakathi ineqhaza elibalulekile empini yokulwa nezinto ezingalungile ezikhinyabeza intsha. Asifuni izingane zethu zigcine sezibizwa ngamaPhara, ngenxa yokuba yimilutha yezidakamizwa," kusho uMashatile.Ukhale nangedimoni eliwutshwala athe ligubuzele isizwe."Akuliwe nenkinga yabantu abankunka utshwala baze baphenduke izidakwa. Kumele sibambisane ukulwa nale nkinga yokuxhashazwa kophuzo oludakayo." Ubalule nabaholi bendabuko wathi baneqhaza elibalulekile ekugcinweni kwamagugu."Abaholi bomdabu kumele bavikele amagugu kanjalo nezinto ezithinta umhlaba. Iqhaza labo lisenza sikwazi ukubumba isizwe esihlanganisa uwonkewonke."Uveze nokuthi izwe libamba imihlangano ehlukene yabaholi bamazwe abakwi-G20."Selokhu kuqale unyaka sisemkhankasweni wokubamba imihlangano ehlukene nabaholi be-G20. Silungiselela nengqungquthela ye-G20 ezoba ngoNovemba kuleli." Uthe abantu bakuleli kumele batshengise amanye amazwe amagugu izwe elizigqaja ngawo."Amagugu ethu enza sibumbane. Ngalokhu singakwazi ukuvula amathuba emkhakheni wezokuvakasha kanjalo nowezobuciko," kusho uMashatile.Ugxeke nohulumeni wobandlululo ngokuzama ukugqiba umlando namagugu abantu abamnyama."Izinhlelo ezifana nohlelo lwezemfundo olwalucwasa abamnyama, yizona zinto ezabukela phansi amagugu ezwe. Yingakho uhulumeni esemkhankasweni wokuthi akhe imigomo ethinta ukungcwatshwa kabusha kwamathambo abaholi bamaKhoisan, kanjalo nokuhlonza izindawo ezigcine la mathambo."
KULOKOZA inhlansi yethemba ebantwini abangu-8.5 million, ababhekene nengwadla yokucishelwa ugesi njalo, ngenxa yokuthi kusuke kwehliswa ukusindelwa kwawo ikakhulu ngesikhathi lapho abantu bewusebenzisa kakhulu. Le nkinga eyaziwa nge-load reduction, yenzeka ezindaweni ezehlukene kuleli. KwaZulu-Natal idlange eMsinga naKwaMbonambi.Lokhu kuvezwe nguNgqongqoshe kaGesi nezaMandla, uDkt Kgosientsho Ramokgopa, izolo ekhuluma esithangamini nabezindaba ngezinhlelo zokuqeda ngale nkinga ebhekene kakhulu nabantu abahlala ezindaweni lapho ugesi ungakhokhelwa khona."Sihlele ukuthi le nkinga yokunqanyulwa kukagesi ngenxa yokuthi ama-transformer asuke esindelwa kakhulu, iphele esikhathini esingangonyaka. Kwezinye izindawo siyazi ukuthi sizohlangabezana nezingqinamba zalabo abazobe begoloza ukuthi silungise le nkinga, lapho sinezinhlelo zokuthi silule izinyanga zokwenza lokhu," usho kanje. Uthe abanye bayamkhalela bathi bacishelwa ugesi ekubeni bewukhokhela."Yingakho sizofaka ama-smart meters ukuze abantu bawukhokhele ugesi. Sizokwazi ukubona labo abangawukhokheli ugesi uma sesifake ama-smart meters. Bangu-2.1 million abantu okumele ngabe bahlomula ngogesi wamahhala kodwa babalelwa ku-400 000 abahlomulayo ngokwe-Eskom," usho kanje. Uthe zine izifundazwe ezinenkinga enkulu ye-load reduction, okuyiGauteng edlange emijondolo ekulesi sifundazwe."Kulandela iLimpopo, lapho kunale nkinga yokucishwa kukagesi ngenxa yokuthi usuke usindelwa bese kuba yiMpumalanga neKZN. E-KZN inkinga inkulu eMsinga kanjalo naKwaMbonambi. KuMasipala waKwaNongoma ku-ward 7 no-8, kunamakhasimende angu-1 293 asebenzisa ugesi wekhadi kodwa abhekene nenkinga yokunqanyulelwa ugesi. Sihlele ukuthi siyilungise le nkinga kule ndawo maduzane."Uveze ukuthi balindele ukuthi emadolobheni bazogoloza abazobe bengalufuni lolu hlelo ngoba bayahlomula kulabo abangawukhokheli ugesi. Uthe imali ekweletwa i-Eskom ngomasipala namakhasimende kuleli ikhula zinyanga zonke njengoba isibalelwa ku-R100 billion."Ngenyanga lesi sikweletu sikhula ngo-R2 billion. Yingakho sifuna ukusehlisa ngokushesha."
