ISILO uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini asifuni nokuyizwa eyokuthi amadoda athathe izibongo zamakhosikazi. IMbube iyalele amadoda akwaZulu ukuba angavumi ukuthatha izibongo zamakhosikazi. Ikusho lokhu ngesikhathi ikhuluma eMkhosini weLembe, obuKwaDukuza, izolo. IMbube ithe ayihambisani nesinqumo seNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo esivumela amadoda ukuba athathe izibongo zamakhosikazi. "Ningayivumi le nto, wukonakala lokhu."Iphini likandunankulu kaZulu, iNkosi Phathisizwe Chiliza, nalo liwugxekile lo mthetho. Umkhosi wakulo nyaka ubuhanjelwe nangumholi wamaNazaretha ohlangothini lwaseBuhleni, iNkosi uMduduzi 'Nyazilwezulu' Shembe. IMbube noNyazi baphonsele uZulu inselelo yokuba uvuse isigodlo seLembe KwaDukuza. IMbube noNyazi bathe kuyoqaqeka amafindo amaningi abophe uZulu uma kungase kuvuswe isigodlo seLembe. ISilo sithe kuyihlazo ukuthi ayikho indawo okungashiselwa kuyo impepho uma kubikwa uMkhosi weLembe. "Kubalulekile ukuba sivuke isigodlo saKwaDukuza. Ngiyanitshela Zulu omnyama. Niyobona ukuthi kuyokwenzekani uma sivusa isigodlo seLembe. Niyobona izibusiso eziyosehlela uma sivusa isigodlo."UNyazi luthe kuyaphoqa ukuthi kuvuswe isigodlo seLembe. "Njengoba ngilapha ngizonitshela ukuthi musani ukuba yizahluleki. Siphi isigodlo lapha. UKwaDukuza wahamba ngesikhathi kuhamba ILembe. Uyovuka nini lo muzi? Sithule sithini thina? Mhla ehamba uShaka wasishiya nentambo emqaleni. Mhlawumbe leyo ntambo iyokhululeka mhla thina savusa lo KwaDukuza. Niyabona ukuthi sixakekile, siyahlupheka? Wayeshilo mhla ehamba ukuthi sizosasala sihlupheka, angifuni ukuphinda amazwi akhe. Asingavumeli ukuhlulwa ezinye izizwe. Idlinza leNkosi limpintshekile lapha."UNyazi luthe kuyihlazo ukungavuswa kwesigodlo seLembe ekubeni kuyilo elabumba isizwe."Kuyihlazo ukuthi kuphele iminyaka eminingi kangaka lo muzi ungavukile. Umbumbi wesizwe sakwaZulu, owasibumba, wasakha, sahlangana, wasifundisa inhlonipho. Sithuleleni lo muzi ungavukile." UNyazi luphakamise ukuba uZulu uhlanganisele ipulazi okuzovuswa kulo isigodlo seLembe. "Nonke madoda ngiyanithuma ukuba nibuyele emakhosini aniphethe, niwatshele ukuthi uNyazi luniyalele ukuba nivuse isigodlo seLembe. Akekho umuntu ozosivusela lo muzi, yithina esizozivusela wona. Kufanele siqale ngokuthenga elinye lamapulazi lapha. Ziningi izimoba lapha."Beliyidliva ngesikhathi kunomkhosi. Imvula ayizange iwadikibalise amabutho nezintombi ebezibhikla ingoma. IMbube ithe imvula ikhombisa ukuthi umkhosi ubusisiwe.
UZOHLANGANA nezinhlaka ezehlukene okubalwa amabhizinisi, uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, othe cababa eMelika izolo.URamaphosa uzoqale ngokuthula inkulumo namhlanje ngeqhaza elibanjwe ngelakuleli njengoSihlalo weG20, emhlanganweni we-United Nations oseNew York.Uzobe edlulisa umyalezo othinta ukuthula kanjalo nokuvikelwa kwamalungelo abantu.Lokhu kuvezwe yisitatimende esithunyelwe yihhovisi lakhe njengoba ehambele umhlangano, i-80th Session of the United Nations General Assembly (UNGA). Lo mhlangano uqondene nomgubho weminyaka engu-80, we-UN Charter kanti kugujwa ngaphansi kwesiqubulo soxolo, intuthuko kanjalo namalungelo abantu.URamaphosa uphelezelwa ongqongqoshe abehlukene okubalwa owezobuDlelwano namaZwe oMhlaba, uMnuz Ronald Lamola, owezoHwebo, iziMboni nokuNcintisana, uMnuz Parks Tau, owezabesiFazane nabantu abaphila nokukhubazeka, uNkk Sindisiwe Chikunga, owezamaHlathi nezeMvelo uDkt Dion George, owezeMpilo uDkt Aaron Motsoaledi kanjalo nePhini likaNgqongqoshe wezokuXhumana, uMnuz Mondli Gungubele."NgoLwesithathu umengameli uzoba yingxenye yengqungquthela ethinta umnotho ehlelwe nguNobhala Jikelele we-UN, uMnuz Antonio Guterres. Kule ngqungquthela abaholi bamazwe bazobe bebhunga ngezindlela zokuthola uxhaso ukuze kuthuthuke amazwe abo," kusho isitatimende.Sithe elakuleli lizoyiveza eyezinselelo ezibhekene namazwe asathuthuka kwezomnotho nokuthi amazwe acebile angangenelela kanjani ukusiza."Okunye okuzobhungwa yindaba yezimpi emazweni ahlukene okubalwa iSudan naseDemocratic Republic of Congo. Ngeke lusale udaba lwempi yase-Ukraine kanjalo nezinye izimpi ezithinta amanye amazwe. Elakuleli lizoqhubeka nokuba umxazululi ezinkingeni ezibhekene nezimpi kwamanye amazwe." Isitatimende siveze ukuthi ngeke isale eyezithinta abesifazane kanjalo nezingane, ikakhulu izingane ezisanda kuzalwa."Eyokuguquguquka kwesimo sezulu nayo ngeke isale kulolu hambo lukamengameli. Lo mhlangano uzobe wenganyelwe nguGuterres noMengameli waseBrazil, uMnuz Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva."Mayelana nezohwebo, uRamaphosa uzoba nengxoxo ehlelwe ngokuhlanganyela nosomabhizinisi baseMelika, ngaphansi kwe-US Chamber of Commerce ngokuhlanganyela nomnyango wezohwebo wakuleli."Uzophinde ahlangane nezinkampani ezehlukene zaseMelika azinxenxe ukuthi zizotshala imali kuleli. Elakuleli linobudlelwano obude neMelika uma kuziwa kwezohwebo."
I-ANC isiphefumule ngabantu bokufika abakuleli abangenawo amaphepha afanele.UNobhala jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, ufuna bagodukiswe abantu bokufika abangenawo amaphepha afanele okuba kuleli.UMbalula ukhale ngokuthi abanye babo benza ubugebengu, bantshontshe izinto zabantu bese beyocasha emabhilidini asemadolobheni amakhulu."Laba bantu kumele sibagodukise baye emazweni abo. Benza ubugebengu bese beyocasha. Emadolobheni afana neGoli yilapho la bantu bedlange khona. Abanawo amaphepha afanele ngakho kumele bagodukiswe," kusho uMbalula. Ukhulume kanje ekhuluma emhlanganweni wamakhansela e-ANC eGoli ngeSonto.Ngesikhathi esho lokhu amalungu ale nhlangano ashaye ihlombe ethi mabahambe.Kushaywe amakhwela bethi impela mabahambe, ngoba benza ubugebengu. UMbalula uncome nomsebenzi omuhle owenziwa yiBorder Management Authority, uphiko olubhekele ukuqinisa umthetho emingceleni yakuleli."Sibonga owayenguNgqongqoshe wezaseKhaya uDkt Aaron Motsoaledi, ngokuqinisa ukusebenza kwalolu phiko. I-DA ihamba izishaya isifuba ithi iyona eyenza lolu phiko lusebenze ngale ndlela. Lolu phiko luyiqinisile imithetho yokungena kwabantu emigceleni yakuleli," kusho uMbalula.Uthe uma kugodukiswa abantu bokufika kumele kwenziwe kulandelwe umthetho. Unxuse amakhansela e-ANC ukuthi ayisukumele eyabantu bokufika abangenawo amaphepha afanele okuba kuleli."Kumele nihlonze izinto ezimbalwa enizozilungisa lapho nihlala khona. Lokhu sikwenzela ukuthi abantu baphinde basithembe. Yingakho emadolobheni amakhulu kumele isukunyelwe eyabantu bokufika abangenawo amaphepha afanele," kuqhuba uMbalula.UMbalula usho kanje nje amanye amaqembu ezepolitiki ahlale ehlaba ikhwelo lokuthi mabaphindiselwe emazweni abo abantu bokufika abangenawo amaphepha okuba kuleli. Izinhlangano ezifana ne-Operation Dudula ezinze eGoli neMarch and March ezinze KwaZulu-Natal, zihlale zisemkhankasweni wokuxosha abokufika abangenawo amaphepha afanele.Lezi zinhlangano zivala emasangweni ezibhedlela zifuna ukuthi abokufika abangenawo amaphepha afanele bangalutholi usizo lwezempilo.Kunengebhe yokuthi ngonyaka ozayo lezi zinhlangano zizogasela ezikoleni zivimbe abafundi abangenawo amaphepha okuba kuleli. Umthetho wezikole iBELA uyakuvuma ukuthi abafundi abangenawo amaphepha afanele bafunde ezikoleni zakuleli. Kodwa ube usuyalela othishanhloko ukuthi babasize laba bafundi ngokuthi bathole izimvume zokuba kuleli.Okukhalisa abantu bakuleli wukuthi izinsiza zezwe ziyashoda kanti zigcina sezisetshenziswa abantu bokufikai, abantu bakuleli bagcine sebengalutholi usizo.
KUZOBUNJWA ithimba eMnyangweni weMfundo ePhakeme elizokwengamela umsebenzi wokuqinisekisa ukuthi aluphazamiseki uhlelo lokufaka izifundo ezintsha emakolishi amakhono amaTVET, kuqedwe ngalezo okuhlale kukhalwa ngokungaphumi kwemiphumela yezitshudeni ngesikhathi.Umnyango uhlela ukuqeda ngezifundo ezaziwa ngeNATED (National Accredited Technical Education Diploma), uqale ezinye i-Occupational Qualifications. Izifundo zeNATED zifaka i-Financial Management, Human Resource Management, Business Management, Legal Secretary, Management Assistant, Marketing Management nezinye. I-Occupational yona ifaka izifundo ezithinta izinto ezehlukene okubalwa ukucwala izinwele, ezithinta ulwandle, ezithinta amabhanoyi, ukupheka, ukulungiswa kwezikebhe nokuzakha nezinye.Lokhu kuvezwe nguNgqongqoshe walo mnyango, uMnuz Buti Manamela muva nje, ekhuluma nabezindaba ngezinhlelo zalo mnyango zokwenza lawa makolishi ahehe intsha njengoba kunenkinga yokushoda kwezikhala emanyuvesi namakhono adingwa ngumnotho wezwe. UManamela uthe okubalulekile ngukuthi intsha kumele ifunde izinto ezintsha ezizokwenza ukuthi ikwazi ukuqala amabhizinisi."Sihlela ukujuba ithimba ukuze liqinisekise ukuthi akubi nokuphazamiseka uma sekuqalwa izifundo ezidingeka kakhulu wumnotho. Leli thimba lizosebenza nezinhlaka ezehlukene okubalwa abezimboni, amakolishi nosomabhizinisi okuyibona abazosho izinto ezidingeka kakhulu ezweni," kusho uManamela.Kuhlale kukhalwa ngokuthi akukwazi ukuthi izitshudeni emakolishi zingenza imikhakha efana naleyo eyenziwa emanyuvesi ekubeni ngabe zenza imikhakha edingwa umnotho. UManamela unxuse izitshudeni ukuthi zibe yingxenye yokubeka umbono ngezikufuna kufundwe kulawa makolishi."Asifuni uma sekuba nalezi zinguquko bese kuphazamiseka ukufunda. Ithimba elizojutshwa lizobheka nokuthi ikhona ingqalasizinda efanele yokufundela nokuthi malini ezodingeka." Uthe uyazazi ezinye zezinselelo ezibhekene namakolishi kuleli."Kunenkinga yezinga eliphezulu labalaxaza izifundo benza unyaka wokuqala. Lezi zitshudeni zigcina ngokungaziphothuli izifundo zazo, ikakhulu zeNATED." Uthe amaSETA azoba yingxenye yalo lonke uhlelo ukuze kube nokusebenzisana namakolishi. "Sifuna intsha ize emakolishi kunokuthi ijahe ukuya emanyuvesi. Uma kunazo zonke izinsiza intsha izoheheka. Asifuni icabange ukuthi amakolishi indawo yokulahla labo abasuke bechithwe amanyuvesi," kusho uManamela.Uveze nokuthi zibalelwa ngaphezu kuka-527 000 izikhala zokufunda ezikhona emanyuvesi angu-50, zangonyaka ozayo.Emanyuvesi zibalelwa ku-200 000 kanti izitshudeni zinxuswe ukuthi zifake nezicelo emaTVET, zingawashalazeli.
UGIXATSHEZWE ngezigwebo ezinzima owesilisa waKwaNyuswa, owalahlwa yicala lokusoconga isikhulu esiphezulu sikaMasipala waseRichmond. UMnuz Sabelo Phewa (34), ngoJulayi, ulahlwe yicala lokubulala uMnuz Sibusiso Sithole. Kuvela ukuthi uPhewa wadubula umufi ngoMashi 6, 2017, esigamekweni okuthiwa senzeka endaweni umufi ayekade esebenzela kuyona eRichmond, embulalela emotweni yakhe. Waphinde walahlwa yicala lokubulala uMnuz Amos Ngcobo nelokuzama ukubulala uConstable Lucky Bongani Ngema wophiko lweSAPS olubizwa ngokuthi yiTactical Response Team (TRT).Walahlwa nayicala lokutholakala nesibhamu esingekho emthethweni nezinhlamvu. NgoLwesibili, iNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini, igixabeze uPhewa ngezigwebo ezinzima kakhulu. Ecaleni lokuqala lokusoconga isikhulu sikaMasipala waseRichmond, ugixatshezwe udilikajele.Kwelesibili lokusoconga uNgcobo, nakhona inkantolo imnikeze isigwebo sikadilikajele. Kwelesithathu lokuzama ukubulala uConstable Ngema, wagixatshezwa iminyaka eyisihlanu.Kwelokutholakala nesibhamu esingekho emthethweni wanikezwa engu-15, kwathi kwelokutholakala nezinhlamvu wanikezwa eyisihlanu. Ngesikhathi iJaji uRuthy Singh likhipha isigwebo, likhale kakhulu ngokungabi nazwelo kukaPhewa. Lithe uqhubekile waphika icala noma ngabe inkantolo seyimthole enalo."Awunawo nhlobo unembeza, uqhubekile waliphika icala noma ngabe sewazi ukuthi likulahlile. Ungumuntu ononya olukhulu,'' lisho kanjena likhuluma libhekise nje ngqo kuyena.Liqhuba, lisebenzise ubufakazi obethulwa udokotela lapho ayeveza khona ukuthi isidumbu sikaSithole sasinamxeba amaningi futhi ajulile."Wena ubuwenza konke ngenxa nje yokuthi ufuna ukuthola imali. Indlela owambulala ngayo uSithole ikuveza ngokusobala ukuthi wawuhlose ukuthi uqinisekise ukuthi ngampela uyadlula emhlabeni,'' kubeka ijaji.Liqhubekile ijaji lasebenzisa ubufakazi obuvele enkantolo bokuthi uPhewa wakhokhelwa u-R5 000 umkaNgcobo njengenkokhelo yokumbonga ngokuphothula umsebenzi."Ungumuntu ongenandaba, ungenza noma yini. Kuyamangaza ukuthi wakhipha isidumbu ngenxa yenkokhelo yemali ewu-R5 000 nje kuphela," lisho kanjena.UNkk Slindile Sithole ongumkaSithole, utshele Isolezwe ukuthi ibambe ngakho ngezigwebo ezinikwe uPhewa. Nakuba kunjalo, uthe njengomndeni bakhathazekile ukuthi uze wagwetshwa uPhewa, lutho ukugonyulula ngokuthi obani ababemthumile."Iqiniso ukuthi bakhona ababemthumile kodwa namanje asazi ukuthi bangobani labo bantu,'' usho kanjena.Uthe sebethemba uNkulunkulu ukuthi bazovela nalabo ababethume uPhewa.Utshele Isolezwe ukuthi abambulala babengenalo ulwazi lokuthi vele useyashiya kuMasipala waseRchmond umufi."Ukube sasazi sasizobatshela ukuthi mabangambulali, vele useyahamba," usho kanje.Uthe umufi wayesethole amadlelo aluhlaza kwenye indawo ngaphandle kweKwaZulu-Natal.UPhewa ugwetshwa nje, ubekade esole inkantolo ngokunhlanhlatha elimisa ngesihloko elokuthi inkantolo nomshunshisi, u-Advocate Nhlanhla Shange, bayehluleka ukwenza umsebenzi."Anishongo nina ukuthi laba bantu engibabizayo lapha bazongishwelezela ukuze ngithole isigwebo esincane. Angifuni nokuyizwa leyo nto mina. Umuntu oshwelezwelayo ngosuke elenzile icala. Mina lingilahlile impela kodwa namanje ngisamile ekutheni angilenzanga," usho kanje ekhuluma ngosuku obelwandulela ukugwetshwa kwakhe.Ngesikhathi kuwa izigwebo, uPhewa ubonakale engathukile. Wehle ebhokisini egijima engafuni ukuba izintatheli zimthwebule izithombe. Kuphele kanjalo ngoPhewa ephuma egijima eyoqala impilo entsha ezikhindini yize ebephikelela ethi "uyasukelwa''.
NKOSIKHONA CELEUVUKE umbhejazane wabhoka wakhahlela owesilisa osanda kulahlwa yicala lokusocongwa kwesikhulu esiphezulu sikaMasipala waseRichmond, esola iNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini, ngokunhlanhlatha nangokuhlulwa umsebenzi wayo.UMnuz Sabelo Phewa (34) ongowaKwaNyuswa, ngoJulayi, ulahlwe yicala lokubulala uMnuz Sibusiso Sithole.Kuvela ukuthi uPhewa wadubula umufi ngoMashi 6, ngo-2017, esigamekweni okuthiwa senzeka endaweni umufi ayekade esebenzela kuyona eRichmond, embulalela emotweni yakhe. Waphinde walahlwa yicala lokubulala uMnuz Amos Ngcobo nelokuzama ukubulala uConstable Lucky Bongani Ngema wophiko lweSAPS olubizwa ngokuthi yiTactical Response Team (TRT).Walahlwa nayicala lokutholakala nesibhamu esingekho emthethweni nezinhlamvu. Izolo, iNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini, inikeze uPhewa ithuba lokuba abize asondelene nabo ukuba bezomnxusela isigwebo esincane enkantolo.Inkinga iqale ngesikhathi iJaji uRuthy Singh selibiza umalume kaPhewa, uMnuz Sifiso Phewa ukuba angene azothula ubufakazi ngokuthi uPhewa ungumuntu onjani nokuthi amnxusele isigwebo esincane.UPhewa ubhoke ngolaka watshela ijaji ukuthi lenza okuphambene nobekuvunyelwane ngakho."Anishongo nina ukuthi laba bantu engibabizayo lapha bazongishwelezela ukuze ngithole isigwebo esincane. Angifuni nokuyizwa leyo nto mina. Umuntu oshwelezwelayo ngosuke elenzile icala. Mina lingilahlile impela kodwa namanje ngisamile ekutheni angilenzanga," usho kanje ekhuluma samuntu othethayo.Ijaji lizamile ukumkhalima lithi makehlise umoya, wavele wabhoka kakhulu wathi: "Sekungamane kuyekwe uma kuya ngokuthi laba bantu nifuna bazongishwelezela. Leyo nto angeke ngize ngiyivume, angidlali futhi ngalokho. Kungamane kuyekwe khona manje," usho kanjena.Ijaji limazisile uPhewa ukuthi inhloso yosuku bekuyikhona lokho ukuthi abamaziyo bakhulume ngaye ukuthi ukhule engumuntu onjani ekhaya nasemphakathini nanokuthi bangafisa yini ukuba ashaywe ngoswazi oluncane lwesigwebo."Kuyacaca asizwani, nenza into engingayazi mina. Okokuqala nje, nina ningilahle ngecala ekubeni singakaze sivezwe leso sibhamu okuthiwa ngasisebenzisa,'' usho kanjena.Uqhubekile wakhomba ngenjumbane umshushisi, u-Advocate Nhlanhla Shange, emsola ngokuphonsa imibuzo engathi shu futhi athe akakholelewa kuyona.Nokho ugcine ehlele ngezansi, waqala wafakaza umalume. Ekhuluma umalume, uchaze uPhewa njengemvu yenkosi futhi ethanda abantu."Siyakweshwama lokhu kokuthi ubandakanyeka emacaleni abucayi kangaka. Siyazibuza siyaziphendula ukuthi lokho kwenzeka kanjani?" usho kanjena.Eqhubeka umalume, uthe ngoba sekuvele kunjena uyacela ukuba ashaywe ngoswazi oluncane umshana wakhe. Waphinde waphakama uPhewa wathi: "Ngizoze ngishaywe ngoswazi oluncane nje ngenzeni? Musani ukudlala ngami madoda!" usho kanjena ijaji lamhlalisa phansi.Uphinde waphakama wathi: "Phela ngizimele anginaye ummeli ngakho-ke kumele ngizikhulumele uma ngibona ukuthi lapha kudlalwa ngami."Ukhuluma ngodaba lokuzimela nje, uPhewa kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi waqala wamelwa ngabameli bamahhala okwathi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, watshela inkantolo ukuthi uyabachitha ngoba behlulwa umsebenzi.Ngemuva kwalokho, wabe eseqasha ummeli wakhe naye kwaphinda kwahlukana inhloko nesixhanti. Wase etshela inkantolo ukuthi ubona kungcono nje kabi ukuthi amane azimele nje, ethi akakaze ahlulwe ukuzikhulumela entweni amayelana naye.Umshushisi ufundele inkantolo incwadi efungelwe ebhalwe ngudadewabo kamufi, uNksz Sibongile Sithole, oveze ukuthi ukubulawa kwakhe kwabashiya nezibazi zaphakade. Uveze ukuthi unina kamufi kunesikhathi lapho abephila khona ngokudane eyobona odokotela. Uthe lokhu kungenxa yokuthi ugcine esehlaselwa yisifo sohlangothi ngenxa yaleli cala athe limhlukumeze kakhulu.Kusasa kulindeleke ukuthi inkantolo igwebe uPhewa.
BAVUTHA bengabaselwe abazali bezingane zakwesinye sezikole ezizimele nezibhekele abantwana iningi labo abangakwazi ukukhuluma nabaphila nokukhubazeka ngezindlela ezahlukene, njengoba kwanda izinsolo zezigameko zokunukubezwa ngokocansi bengaphakathi kulesi sikole esinamagumbi okuhlala abafundi bamabanga aphansi kuya kwaphezulu.Lokhu kuza emva kokuthi omunye wabazali babantwana abafunda kulesi sikole, iSt Martin’s Special, esiseMargate, ePort Shepstone, ogwini oluseningizimu yeKwaZulu-Natal, ebikele Isolezwe ngesigameko sangoLwesihlanu olwedlule sokunukubezwa ngokocansi komntwana wakhe oneminyaka ewu-12, okhubazeke ngokungakwazi ukukhuluma.Lo mzali, uthe okumphatha kabi kakhulu wukuthi unqume ukufaka umntwana wakhe womfana kulesi sikole nonyaka ngoba azi amagalelo aso okuphatha kahle nokunakekela ngendlela efanele abantwana abadinga ukunakekelwa ngokuthe xaxa nangokucophelela njengowakhe.Elandisa ngokwehlele umntwana wakhe, uthe uthole umyalezo komunye wabahlengikazi abagada nabanakekela abafundi kulesi sikole, emcela ukuthi akuhlanganwe esibhedlela esisePort Shepstone ngenxa yokuthi kunesimo esithile esenzeke enganeni yakhe."Kuthe uma ngifika esibhedlela, ngaziswa ukuthi kusolwa ukuthi umntwana wami unukubeziwe ngokocansi, kodwa kwangacaca ukuthi kwenziwe wubani, futhi ngasiphi isikhathi. Kuphela nje umhlengikazi omgadayo ungitshele ukuthi uze umphuthumisa esibhedlela nje, yingoba bese eqaphela izimpawu ezithile zokushintsha kwendlela enza ngayo izinto, njengokuthi uma ezomfunza ukudla noma uma kukhona amnika khona, ubengafuni ukusondela eduze kuyena. Nangempela esibhedlela baqinisekisile ukuthi unukubeziwe, kepha inkinga kwaba wukuthi asisakwazi ukuthatha amasampuli egazi ngoba leso sigameko sesedlule, kungeke kusaba lula ukuthola ukuthi senziwe wubani futhi ngasiphi isikhathi," kulanda umzali.Eqhuba, uthe okuthela upelepele esilondeni ngalokhu wukuthi uma ezama ukulandelela ebuholini besikole ukuthi bakuphi nokuphenya ngalolu daba, akucaci ukuthi yini abayenzayo ukuze athole ubulungiswa, futhi balokhu bethi akalinde uma ecela i-case number yesigameko ukuze akwazi ukuziphenyela yena ngokwakhe."Ngize ngathatha umfana wami ngamgcina ekhaya, okungcono ahlale nami futhi ngikwazi ukumnakekela ngoba angazi ukuthi uphephe kangakanani uma ngimphindisela kulesi sikole, okucacayo ukuthi azisukunyelwa nhlobo izimo ezikhathaza abazali, njengoba kungekhona okokuqala ngiba nenkinga enjena. Kungekudala nje kwathi ngizomvakashela esikoleni, ngafika eqhephuke izinyo, futhi enemihuzuko emzimbeni. Nalapho kwathi uma ngizama ukuthi ngilandelele ngalolo daba, kwagcina kuphelele emoyeni kanjalo," usho kanje.Uthe egcina ukukhuluma nobuholi besikole utshelwe ukuthi uzobizwa uma sekumele kuzobhungwa mayelana nalesi sigameko nezabanye abazali okuvela ukuthi nabo banesimo esifanayo sokuhlukumezeka kwezingane zabo ezifunda kulesi sikole.Kuthintwa omunye wabazali osesigungwini esilawula ukusebenza kwesikole, naye ongathandanga ukuthi kudalulwe igama lakhe, uthe kuyamkhathaza ukubona kwanda izigameko ezinjena ezenzeka ngaphakathi emagcekeni esikole, futhi okubonakala kukuncane kakhulu okwenziwayo ukuzama ukuthi zilungiswe."Sekukaningi kwenzeka izigameko ezinjena ngaphakathi esikoleni ikakhulu ngonyaka odlule, kepha kugcine kungabanga ndaba zalutho. Okwenza siphatheke kabi kakhulu ngalokho wukuthi sekukaningi sizama ukuhlala phansi nobuholi besikole, senzela ukuthola isixazululo, kepha namanje lutho ukulunga - okwenza size sikholwe wukuthi lokho kwenziwa ngamabomu ngoba nakhu kuhlukumezeka izingane zebala elinsuku njengoba isikole siphethwe wubuholi bebala elimhlophe," kubhodla umzali. Kuthintwa uthishanhloko wakulesi sikole, uMnuz Deon Davey, uthe akanalwazi ngalezi zinsolo, engeza ngokuthi umuntu okumele abe nemininingwane ephelele yilowo opotshozele intatheli ngazo."Kanti futhi uMnyango wezeMfundo unaye umkhumeli wawo. Uma kusuke kunezigameko ezinjalo, ziyaye zibikwe ezikhungweni zeThuthuzela ukulandela umthetho wezindaba zezingane okumele zigcinwe ziyimfihlo kuze kube wukuthi abathintekayo sebeziqinisekisile futhi kwabhekwana nazo ngendlela efanele," kusho uDavey.

KUSOLWA ukuthi kade awuqala umkhuba wokulutha abesifazane abathembise umsebenzi, bese eyababulala ehlathini laseMayville, eThekwini, owesilisa oboshwe ngoMgqibelo ntambama, ngemuva kokuthi evume ukuthi nguye obulale owesifazane obesenamasonto amabili edukile kule ndawo.UNksz Nondumiso Dlamini (23), wahamba kubo eyoqala umsebenzi ngemuva kokuthi umsolwa emthembise itoho emizini eseduzane nala behlala khona.Uma elandisa udaba lwakhe uyise kaNksz Dlamini, uMnuz Sbusiso Khanyile, uthe uyoyixoxela amagwababa echobana into ayibone isiyindodakazi yakhe eyahamba ibuya kodwa kwase kuba ukuyigcina kwabo."UNondumiso ubengasebenzi ngakho ubengumuntu owufunayo umsebenzi ngenxa yesimo sasekhaya. Ngakho-ke kuthe ngoLwesihlanu oludlule (Septhemba 12), wahamba ethi kukhona umuntu omtholele umsebenzi, uyobona lana ezosebenza khona. Asinakanga engabuyi ngosuku lokuqala njengoba besazi ukuthi ungumuntu onesoka kodwa sakhathazeka ngoMgqibelo uma lize lishona ilanga singezwa lutho. Kuthe uma kuqala isonto, sase sihamba sibuza ebantwini emphakathini kodwa bemlandula bethi akaze bambone," kusho uKhanyile. Uthe ngoLwesine, kukhona abantu ababatshela ukuthi bagcina ukumbona ehamba nomsolwa nokwabaphoqa ukuthi baye kuye."Waqala indaba ende ethi akamazi kodwa sigcine sibize amaphoyisa ukuthi azomthatha ukuze amphenye kahle. Sigcine sesibizwa kuthiwa usevumile ukuthi uyamazi uNondumiso ukuthi ukuphi, nokula siye ehlathini elingekho kude nathi, wamkhomba. Ingane yami ibisiqala ukonakala, okungiphatha kabi ukuthi uyicwiyile njengoma iminwe inqunyiwe nesingazi noma udayisa izicubu zemizimba yini. Uyidlwengulile wayigwaza kaningi," kusho yena.Uthe okunye okuvelile ukuthi lona wesilisa kungenzeka ukuthi wumkhuba wakhe omdala lona njengoba kukhona owesifazane ophumele obala wathi wasinda kukubi kumsolwa ezama ukumenzakalisa kulona leli hlathi."Ubazi ukuthi amantombazane amaningi awasebezi endaweni, kungakho ebenza lo mkhuba. Lona wesifazane uthi naye wayemthembise umsebenzi kodwa wamjikela endleleni, wathi abahambe ngenye indlela, nokula azama khona ukumlimaza. Lona wesifazane uveze ukuthi weza kuye esezomncenga ukuthi angatsheli muntu ngakade ezama ukukwenza. Okunye okusikhathazayo ukuthi kudala kuduka abantu besifazane endaweni nesisola ukuthi uyena lona obebabulala ngakho njalo ukubathembisa umsebenzi," kuchaza uKhanyile.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, akayiphendulanga imibuzo ayithunyelelwe ngodaba.

UKHOMISHANA wamaPhoyisa, uLieutenant General Fannie Masemola, uthi uNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa omisiwe, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, wagxambukela emsebenzini wakhe ngokukhipha umyalelo wokuba kuhlakazwe ithimba lamaphoyisa eliphenya amacala okubulawa kosopolitiki KwaZulu-Natal.UMasemola uthe uMchunu akanawo amandla okukhipha imiyalelo yokuthi amaphoyisa kufanele asebenze kanjani.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ethula ubufakazi kwikhomishini eholwa yiJaji Mbuyiseli Madlanga.UMasemola uthe isigaba somthetho u-205:3 sinikeza yena amandla okunquma ukuthi amaphoyisa azosebenza kanjani.UMasemola uthe lo mthetho uthi uMchunu kufanele aqhamuke nemigomo."Uma ngingenza isibonelo nje uma kuthiwa sibhekene nenkinga yezidakamizwa ezingena kuleli ziqhamuka emazweni angaphandle, ungqongqoshe angakwazi ukusho ukuthi amaphoyisa kufanele agxile ekuphenyeni la macala. Kodwa ke akakwazi ukusitshela ukuthi kufanele silwe kanjani nalobo bugebengu. Kuwumsebenzi wamaphoyisa ukuqhamuka namaqhinga okulwa nabo."UMasemola uthe uMchunu kufanele adlalele kude nodaba lokusebenza kwethimba eliphenya amacala okubulawa kosopolitiki KwaZulu-Natal ngoba luthinta ukusebenza kwamaphoyisa."Mhlawumbe into ayengayenza yena wukwenza isiphakamiso sokuthi lihlakazwe ithimba uma kuwukuthi ubona sengathi alisebenzi. Mhlawumbe ke sasingaluxoxa lolu daba. Akakwazi ukuqhamuka esesitshela ukuthi asihlakaze ithimba. Okunzima kakhulu wukuthi uqhamuka esethi ithimba alihlakazwe khona manje."UMasemola uthe okwamkhathaza kakhulu wukuthi uMchunu wazithathela eyedwa isinqumo sokuhlakaza ithimba."Ngesikhathi kusungulwa ithimba kwaphuma umyalelo kumengameli, kwahlanganiswa ikomiti leminyango eyehlukene okukhona owamaPhoyisa, oweziNhloli nowezoBulungiswa. Akukwazi ke ukuthi isinqumo sokuhlakaza ikomiti bese siqhamuka kungqongqoshe womnyango owodwa."UMasemola uthe okwenza ukuthi angahambisani nesinqumo sokuhlakazwa kwethimba wukuthi lalenza kahle.UMasemola uthe umsebenzi wethimba wanconywa kakhulu owayenguNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa, uMnuz Bheki Cele, ngesikhathi ekhuluma ngo-2023."Angazi ukuthi ungqongqoshe wayekuthathaphi ukuthi ithimba liyahluleka wukwenza umsebenzi walo. Wonke umuntu uyazibonela ukuthi ithimba lenza umsebenzi oncomekayo. Baningi abantu ababoshwayo nabagwetshwayo. Kazi ubani owamtshela ukuthi ithimba liyahluleka ukwenza umsebenzi. Uma ayefuna ukwazi ngomsebenzi kwakufanele abuze kimi, ngangizomchazela."UMasemola uthe wabikela uMengameli Ramaphosa, ngalolu daba."Nngamchazela uRamaphosa ukuthi angihambisani nokuhlakazwa kwethimba. Ngathi okungenani uma kuwukuthi ithimba liyahlakazwa, akungaxhanyazelwa. Angazi ukuthi kwase kujahwephi kangaka. URamaphosa wathi uzokhuluma noMchunu. Wabuye wangitshela ukuthi ukhulumile noMchunu kodwa angazanga ukuthi bavumelana ngokuthini."UMasemola uthe umyalelo wokuthi kuhlakazwe ithimba wakhishwa ngesikhathi esathathe ikhefu.Uthe usola sengathi kwenziwa ngamabomu ukuba kukhishwe lo myalelo ekubeni esathathe ikhefu.UMasemola uphinde waveza ukungenami ngokuziphatha kwePhini likaKhomishana wamaPhoyisa, uLieutenant General Shadrack Sibiya.UMasemola uthe uSibiya washaya indiva imiyalelo yakhe, wabhala incwadi eyalela ukuba kuhlakazwe ithimba."Wafika nezincwadi ezimbili kimina nganqaba ukuzisayina. Waqhubeka wakhipha incwadi eyalela ukuba kuhlakazwe ithimba."UMasemola uthe bamxwayisa uMchunu ngoSibiya."Ngamtshela ukuthi kunezinsolo zokuthi uSibiya usondelene nezigebengu."UMasemola uthwale kanzima ukuchaza ukuthi kungani agcina ekhombisa ukugoba uphondo odabeni lokuhlakazwa kwethimba.UMadlanga ubuze uMasemola ukuthi yini eyenza ukuthi agcine ekhipha umyalelo wokuthi ithimba lingabe lisanikezwa amacala amasha uma kuwukuthi wayephikisana nomyalelo wokuthi livalwe.UMasemola uzoqhubeka nokwethula ubufakazi namhlanje.

KUME ukufunda amalungu omphakathi ne-EFF bevuka umbhejazane befuna kuxoshwe uthisha waseMziwamandla High School, kwaM eMlaza, osolwa ngokuthumelela umfundi wentombazane isithombe somphambili wakhe. I-EFF ingene ngaphakathi isho ukumudla luhlaza lo thisha Isolezwe elinalo igama lakhe nesibongo.Kuvele kwabonakala ukuthi kuyonakala kwase kuba khona ababiza amaphoyisa njengoba bese kukhona ebebesho ukuzifikela mathupha kuthisha. Ngesikhathi kwenzeka konke lokhu uthisha ubemi nabanye othisha ebheke phansi njengomuntu ohanjelwe wumqondo. Ubebuye abonakale ecofa umakhalekhukhwini wakhe ewugqolozele.Kukhona lapho uthisha ebonakale ebiza abanye abafundi abane ekhuluma nabo. Ubuye wabonakala ebambambatha emhlane. Ubekhuluma nabafundi besilisa. Kube nomsindo omkhulu ngaleso sikhathi abantu bemumemeza bemtshela ukuthi akahlukane nezingane abamethembi futhi abasamdingi emagcekeni esikole.Uthishanhloko wesikole ubize umhlangano odonse isikhathi eside obuhlanganisa abazali bomfundi, abe-EFF kanjalo nabengamele ukusebenza kwesikole. Isolezwe lize lahamba umhlangano ungakapheli.Ngaphakathi emhlanganweni nothisha ugcine ebizwa kwathiwa makangene awujoyine. Umthombo osondelene nalolu daba udalule ukuthi sekuphele inyanga umfundi engasalubhadi esikoleni.''Lo mfundi akadlali uthi ngeke abuyele yena esikoleni uma kusekhona lo thisha. Asazi ukuthi le nto izophelelaphi ngoba nangu phela uthisha uyaqhubeka nokufundisa. Okubuhlungu wukuthi le nto ilimaza yena umfundi ngoba kuyafundwa phela esikoleni,'' kusho umthombo.Ngaphambi kokuba uthisha athumelele umfundi umphambili kuthiwa bese kuphele isikhathi eside emeshela efuna ukuthandana naye. Umthombo uthe uthisha ubephikelela eshela umfundi yize umfundi wayesekhombisa izumpawu zokunengeka. Ngesikhathi Isolezwe lingena emagcekeni kube khona othile okhulume amazwi athi :" Nasiza nafika nizoke nitshele umhlaba ukuthi kwenzekani kulesi sikole. Bhalani impela kubi konakele lapha.''USihlalo wesigungu esilawula isikole, uMnuz Bongani Mthethwa, uthe lolu daba lungaphezulu kwabo. Uthe bayazi ukuthi umfundi sekuphele inyanga eduve ekhaya okuyinto athe ayiyinhle.Uthe bazamile ukungenelela kodwa imizamo yabo iyabhuntsha. Uthe kwenzeka le nkinga nje basembhidlangweni wokubuyisa uzinzo nokuthula kulesi sikole ngoba vele sidume ngezinto ezingezinhle. Ezokuphepha zigcine ziqine kakhulu njengoba bese kuphithizela amaphoyisa abephethe izibhamu ezinkulu. Ngaleso sikhathi bekumile ukufunda nokufundisa othisha bemi izixongololo ngaphandle kwamagceke esikole.Bekubonakala ukuthi babhunga ngalolu daba obelusematheni. ''Asihambe isikhohlakali asizile ukuzodlala la ngeke phela sikumele ukuthi izingane zethu zingahlala nothisha ofuna ukulala nazo ekubeni zincane kangaka,'' kusho uNksz Pinky Zungu we-EFF.Eqhuba uthe kuyabakhathaza ukuthi kungaphela isikhathi eside kangaka kukhulunywa ngento eyodwa. Uveze ukuthi bake balukhuluma lolu daba phambilini kodwa kuyabethusa ukuthi namanje uthisha usekhona futhi uyafundisa.Omunye umthombo upotshozele Isolezwe ukuthi zivele zimapeketwane izinto kulesi sikole ngoba kuningi okungahambi kahle. Umthombo ukhale kakhulu ngokuthi abafundi bakulesi sikole badla izidakamizwa njengokudla. ''Abafundi lapha esikoleni baphila ngezidakamizwa bazidla njengokudla inkosi impela,'' kusho umthombo.Uthe akaboni ukuthi ikhona into enhle okumele abazali bayilindele ngemiphumela ka-matric kubafundi bakulesi sikole. Ulimise ngesihloko elokuthi kulesi sikole kudlalwa ucabhayiyane umdlalo wezingane."Ayikho indaba yalapha kuyabheda akusona isikole lesi wumdlalo,'' usho kanjena.Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uMuzi Mahlambi, uthe lolu wudaba olubucayi abazolufakela izibuko. Uthe uma kutholakala iqiniso ngalo kukhona igxathu abazolithatha njengoMnyango wezeMfundo.

Uthe lesi sinqumo basithatha ngesikhathi beshada ngoMeyi 17, 2008 ukuthi yibo abangosaziwayo hhayi izingane zabo."Yingxenye yempilo esazikhethela yona. Kodwa uma sekuza ezinganeni zethu, ngolunye udaba. Ngeke sazifaka ngekhanda entweni esazikhethela yona, ikakhulukazi ewumthwalo osindayo (esho ukuba wusaziwayo)."Uthe kwakuyinhloso yabo besaqala umndeni ukuthi bazohlale bebavikela abantwana babo."Lokhu akusho ukuthi ezinye izinto ziyimfihlo kodwa zingezangasese. Akusiyo imfihlo kodwa wubungcwele. Yindlela esiphatha ngayo abantwana bethu."Uthe indlela azihlonipha ngayo izingane zakhe uze angathathi izithombe nabalandeli bakhe uma engcebeleka nazo."Uma nginezingane zami, angishuthi nabantu ngoba kusuke kuyisikhathi sazo. Njengoba manje sebebadala, ngihamba nabo noma yikuphi lapho ngiya khona, kungabe ngiyosebenza noma ngiya esontweni, ngiyazama ukuchazela abantu ukuthi kungani nginqaba ukushutha nabo."Uthe akanankinga ngokushutha nabalandeli uma eyosebenza kodwa uma ezikhiphe nabantwana bakhe, kufanele bakhohlwe njengesidomu esikoleni."Ngibacela kahle ukuthi singashuthi, ngingabanga, sibingelelane ngoba kusuke kuyisikhathi sezingane zami. Ngisuke ngenzela ukuthi zazi ukuthi ngigxila kuzo uma kuyisikhathi sazo. Yingoba angifuni zinyanye engibizelwe khona empilweni. Ngifuna zikwamukele kahle."Uthe akafuni ukuthi zikhule zizonda ubizo lwakhe ngoba lwenza umehluko empilweni yabantu."Angifuni izingane zami zikhule zizwa sengathi zazingenaye umama ngenxa yobizo lwami. Ngakho kukimi ukubeka umgoqo nemithetho ezoqinisekisa abantwana bami ukuthi bahlale bazi ukuthi, noma ngiluthanda ugcobo lwami kodwa yibo abangungqaphambili. Ngakho uma ngihlele isikhathi sokuba nabo, kuba ngesikhethekile."Uthe abantwana bakhe bangamantombazane angananazi uma kukhona afuna ukukusho. Uthe uyakuthakasela ukuba nabo, ikakhulukazi ukubafundisa futhi nabo bayabutusa ubuthishela bukanina, ikakhulukazi uma ebafundisa izibalo.
'ZIYIKHA ngamafosholo imali izikhulu namalungu amabhodi kahulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal'. Impendulo ebhaliwe kaMphathiswa woMnyango wezokuThuthukiswa koMnotho, uMfu Musa Zondi, ikhombisa ukuthi izikhulu zamabhizinisi kahulumeni wesifundazwe zihola izigidi zamarandi ngonyaka.Isikhulu esihola kakhulu sihola imali engaphezu kuka-R4 million ngonyaka.Osihlalo bamabhodi namalungu amabhodi nabo athola imihlumulo ebhekile.Umbuzo ububuzwe ilungu le-DA esiShayamthetho, uNksz Hanna Lidgett. Impendulo kaZondi iveza ukuthi isikhulu esihola kakhulu eseThala Development Finance Cooperation, uNksz Pearl Bhengu. Ngokwempendulo, uNksz Bhengu uhola u-R4.4 million ngonyaka. Uphinde athole eminye imihlumulo efana nemoto yohlobo lukaNokusho kanye nemali yobumnandi ewu-R25 000. Amalungu ebhodi leThala Development Finance Cooperation nawo ayayibulala imali. Usihlalo webhodi, uMnuz Sihle Mkhize, uthole u-R1.1 million kunyakamali owedlule. Amanye amalungu ebhodi athole imali esukela ku-R800 000 kuya phansi ngonyaka. Isikhulu esiphezulu kwiRichard's Bay Industrial Development Zone, uMnuz Thabane Zulu, uthole u-R3.9 million uma sekubalwa yonke imihlomula ayithole ngonyakamali owedlule.Isikhulu seKZN Trade Investment, uMnuz Sihle Ngcamu,sithole u-R3.3 million, kwathi isikhulu esiphezulu kwiKZN Economic Regulatory Authority, uNksz Portia Baloyi, sona sahola u-R3.1 million.Isikhulu esiphezulu kweZemvelo KZN Wildlife, uMnuz Sihle Mkhize, sigixabezwe ngo-R2.4 million, kwathi isikhulu esiphezulu kwi-KZN Sharks Board, uMnuz Harry Mbambo, sahola u-R2.1 million.UNksz Lidgett uthe kumshaqisile akubona empendulweni kaZondi."Ngonyakamali owedlule kusetshenziswe u-R30 million ukuholela izikhulu eziphezulu emabhizinisini kahulumeni. Uma uyicaza le mali ikutshela ukuthi isikhulu sisinye sihola u-R2.5 million ngonyaka. Imali engu-R6.6 million ikhokhele osihlalo bamabhodi, kwathi u-R4.4 million wona wakhokhela amaphini osihlalo bamabhodi. Impendulo kaZondi ikhombisa ukuthi lapha ayibaliwe imali ekhokhelwa osihlalo bamabhodi, amaphhini amabhodi namalungu amabhodi uma ehambela imihlangano."UNksz Lidgett uthe okubakhathazayo ukuthi ayikho imithetho ecacile ebekiwe eshoyo ukuthi kufanele izikhulu namalungu amabhodi amabhizinisi kahulumeni akhokhelwe kanjani. Uthe sebebhalele uZondi bebuza ukuthi inqunywa kanjani imihlomulo yezikhulu namalungu amabhodi."Asazi ukuthi inqunywa kanjani imali abakhokhelwa yona."Siyavuma ukuthi benza umsebenzi obalulekile kodwa ukungabi khona kwemigomo kushiya imibuzo eminingi. Sikholwa ukuthi abantu abathola imihlomulo emingaka kufanele kube nencazelo yokuthi kungani beyithola, ikakhulukazi njengoba sikhula isibalo sabantu abangasebenzi KwaZulu-Natal. Izibalo zakamumva zeStatSA zikhombisa ukuthi isibalo sabangasebenzi KwaZulu-Natal sesingu-44.7%."
UMFELANDAWONYE wezinyunyana zabasebenzi iCosatu, uveze ukuthi bevile ku-3.5 million abasebenzi asebenyule imali yabo esikhwameni sezimpesheni.Lo mfelandawonye uthe le mali isize kakhulu lezi zisebenzi zakwazi ukwehlisa izikweletu ezihleli entanyeni.Isitatimende seCosatu siveze ukuthi lolu hlelo olwaziwa ngeTwo-Pot Pension, lusize inqwaba yabasebenzi yakwazi ukuphefumula."Kusuka kwavulwa ithuba lokuthi abasebenzi bakwazi ukunyula ingxenye yemali yempesheni, imali eyevile ku-R60 billion ifinyelele kubasebenzi abevile ku-3.5 million. Siyawuncoma lo mnyakazo owaqala ngoSepthemba 2024, wokuthi abasebenzi bakwazi ukunyula imali yabo ukuze bakwazi ukwehlisa izikweletu," kusho isitatimende seCosatu ngemuva komhlangano obungeledlule eGoli. Okhulumela iCosatu uNksz Zanele Sabela, uthe basezingxoxweni nohulumeni ukuthi ehlise umthwalo wentela obhekene nabasebenzi.Uthe ufuna labo basebenzi abalahlekelwa ngumsebenzi bakwazi ukuthola imali yabo njengoba injalo."Sifuna kwehliswe umthwalo obhekana nabasebenzi abasuke bediliziwe. Lokhu kuzosiza ekutheni bakwazi ukwenza izinto zabo bengenayo ingcindezi yentela." Odabeni oluthinta amadlelandawonye, uthe umhlangano unqume ukuthi kubuyekezwe ubudlelwano bamadlelandawonye okuyi-ANC, SACP, Sanco neCosatu. "Sizosheshisa umhlangano wamadlelandawonye ukuze sihlahle indlela ecacile ebheke okhethweni lwangonyaka ozayo lohulumeni basekhaya. Sizozwa kumalungu ethu ukuthi ikuphi okumele sikwenze mayelana nesizomvotela okhethweni oluzayo lohulumeni basekhaya. Umkhombandlela uzophuma engqungqutheleni yokukhetha ubuholi yeCosatu ezoba ngoSepthemba 2026."I-Cosatu isho lokhu nje, i-SACP ayijiki ekungeneleni ukhetho ngokuzimela. UNobhala Jikelele weSACP, uMnuz Solly Mapaila, umile ekutheni akukho okungabaguqula umqondo ngodaba lokuzimela okhethweni.UMapaila uhlale ekuveza lapho ekhuluma khona ukuthi bakhathele ukuncetheza kwi-ANC, bayilandele ekubeni ingazimisele ukulungisa indaba yamadlelandawonye.I-ANC isamile ekutheni lesi sinqumo se-SACP, sizoyishaya kakhulu okhethweni njengoba ibhekene nokwehlelwa ukwesekwa. I-Cosatu ithe izosebenzisana nohulumeni ukuwusiza emacaleni athinta ukuyiswa enkantolo kweyokuchitha eyomshwalense wezempilo iNHI, kanjalo nomthetho wokubuyiswa komhlaba."Sizowuvikela umthetho othinta ukuthathwa komhlaba ngaphandle kwesinxephezelo eNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo. Sifuna umhlaba ubuyiselwe kubantu ukuze bakwazi ukwakha izindlu baphinde balime."Lo mfelandawonye uveze nokuthi uzoqhubeka nokuhlaba ikhwelo lokuthi kuliwe nesihlava sokuhlukunyezwa kwezingane nabesifazane kuleli.I-Cosatu izogubha iminyaka engu-40 yasungulwa ngoDisemba 6, kulo nyaka, enkundleni yezemidlalo iDobsonville.
ABAHOLI be-ANC bathi akusizi ukuthi kunconywe ubuhle bamabhuku ezimali komasipala kodwa izidingo zibe zingafinyeleli kubantu.Lokhu kushiwo uSihlalo we-ANC kuzwelonke. uMnuz Gwede Mantashe noNobhala Jikelele uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, bekhuluma emihlanganweni ehlukene yokukhuluma namakhansela ale nhlangano izolo.UMantashe okhulume eKhayelitsha eKapa, uthe kumele abantu bathole izinsiza, hhayi ukuthi kube mahle amabhuku okusebenza kwezimali kuphela kodwa dololo izinsiza."Abantu abadli amabhuku ezimali kodwa badinga izinsiza. Uma amanzi bengenawo, izindlu nezinye izinto, awasho lutho lawo mabhuku amahle okusebenza kwezimali. Yilapho ke amakhansela e-ANC okumele aqinise khona ekuhambiseni izidingo," usho kanje. Usho kanje emva kokuba uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, encome omasipala abaphethwe yi-DA, athe banemibiko emihle yezimali evela kuMcwaningi Mabhuku Jikelele.Le nkulumo ayisho ngesikhathi kunokhukhulelangoqo womhlangano wamakhansela eGoli, ngeledlule, yagxekwa abanye ngaphakathi kule nhlangano bethi wenzele phansi i-ANC njengoba kubhekwe okhethweni lohulumeni basekhaya ngonyaka ozayo.UMbalula obekhuluma eGoli, uthe uRamaphosa ubengancomi i-DA kodwa ubekhuluma ngento eyashiwo nguMcwaningi Mabhuku jikelele. Uthe amakhansela e-ANC ayakwazi lokhu okwashiwo nguRamaphosa owakhala ngokuthi njalo uma sekufika umbiko kaMcwaningi Mabhuku Jikelele, omasipala be-DA ibona abahlale behamba phambili uma kuqhathaniswa nabe-ANC."URamaphosa wathi akusikwe iphethini komasipala be-DA. Kodwa lokho akusho ukuthi ngoba imibiko yezimali yalabo masipala be-DA mihle, ukuthi abantu bayazithola izidingo," kusho uMbalula.Ukhale ngokuthi uma abantu bengenawo amanzi bamane bathi sebekhathele i-ANC."Yingakho kumele sisukume ngoba yonke into abakhala ngayo bayibhekisa kwi-ANC. Abaholi be-ANC okuyizimeya, amakhansela kumele baye kubantu bayobachazela ngezinselelo ezenza ukuthi bangakwazi ukuthola amanzi." UMantashe uthe usamile enkulumeni yakhe ayenza emhlanganweni waseGoli, lapho athi amakhansela e-ANC azi ukucula kuphela kodwa ahluleka ukuhambisa izidingo kubantu."Ngimile kwengakusho noma amakhansela amaningi adinwa. Uma ungayibizi imihlangano nyanga zonke emphakathini, uyikhansela elingawazi umsebenzi walo. Kumele uma uyikhansela uye emhlanganweni womkhandlu uye emphakathini uyowubikela okushiwo," usho kanje.Utshele amakhansela ukuthi akekho umholi kazwelonke wale nhlangano ozowinela amakhansela ukhetho."Abantu bahlala emawadini, emagatsheni, ezifundeni ze-ANC, abahlali ekomkhulu lale nhlangano eLuthuli House. Yingakho kumele kusetshenzwe emagatsheni lapho kukhona khona abantu ukuze siwine ukhetho," kusho uMantashe.
UNGQONGQOSHE weMfundo ePhakeme uMnuz Buti Manamela, usevikele isinqumo sokujutshwa kwamalungu e-ANC kumabhodi ama-Sector Education and Training Authority (SETA), phezu kokuba kunezikhalazo.UManamela uthe ukuba yilungu le-ANC, akukuvimbi ukuthi ujutshelwe ekubeni usihlalo we-SETA."Akukho okuvimba umuntu onamava ukuthi ajutshelwe kwi-SETA, noma kungathiwa uyilungu le-ANC. Ukuba yilungu leqembu lezepolitiki akukwenzi ukuthi ungakwazi ukujutshelwa kulezi zinhlaka," usho kanje. Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi evele ngaphambi kwekomiti lomnyango ePhalamende. Ubechaza ngokufaka ngaphansi kwabalawuli kwamaSETA amathathu, okuyiServices SETA, Construction SETA neLocal Government SETA (LGSETA).Indaba yokuqokwa kwamalungu e-ANC kumabhodi ama-SETA, yasusa umsindo njengoba kwakhalwa ngokuthi kufakwa abantu bale nhlangano, abasondelene nabaholi benhlangano okubalwa nezingane zabo. Lo msindo awuqali ukuqubuka njengoba nangesikhathi sikangqongqoshe walo mnyango owaxoshwa nguMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, uDkt Nobuhle Nkabane, kwasuka umsindo ngokuqokwa kwabaholi be-ANC okubalwa noDkt Nomusa Dube-Ncube oseyiPhini likaNgqongqoshe kulo mnyango.UManamela uthe abaqokiwe uma bengenawo umlando wokulahlwa amacala akukho okubavimba ukuthi bajutshwe."Sisuke sifuna umuntu ozobuyisa uzinzo kuleyo-SETA. Ngikholwa ukuthi abantu abajutshwayo bazokwazi ukwenza okulindeleke kubona," kusho uManamela. Uveze ukuthi ufake la maSETA ngaphansi kwabalawuli ngo-Agasti, emva kokuxhumana neNational Skills Authority.Udalule ukuthi wathola ukuthi izinto bezibheda kakhulu kula maSETA."Besingeke sishiye izinto zilenga ekubeni amabhodi abesehluleka ukwenza umsebenzi wawo. Imibiko ethinta uphenyo ngemali ibizitshwa. Abantu okumele ama-SETA ababhekele, izitshudeni, abaqashi kanjalo nabasebenzi abese beshiywe kanjalo, sebezibonela." Uthe ujube oMnuz Lehlogonolo Masoga kwi-Services SETA, Oupa Nkoane kwi-Construction SETA noZukile Mvalo kwi-Local Government SETA."Isimo sisuke sesisibi kakhulu uma sekufakwa inkampani engaphansi kukahulumeni ngaphansi komlawuli. Ibingekho enye indlela ebesingayenza kulokhu ngaphandle kokuthi sizifake ngaphansi komlawuli." Uthe iConstruction SETA, ike yaba ngaphansi komlawuli phakathi kuka-2020 no-2022. "Ngo-2024, kwasatshiswa owahlaba umkhosi wabika ngezinto ezazenzeka. Ibhodi belingahlangani noMcwaningi Mabhuku Jikelele ngezinselelo ezikhona minyaka yonke," kusho uManamela othe bekunombango wamathenda.KwiLocal Government SETA, ukhale ngokuqokwa kwesikhulu esiphezulu nokuhlakazwa kwekomiti elicubungula amabhuku."Kwama imisebenzi ethile, izitshudemi zasala dengwane zingakhokhelwa imihlomulo yazo."
NGESIKHATHI iNingizimu Afrika ithola inkululeko nentando yabantu ngo-1994 kwaba sengathi ukubhuqabhuqana kwabantu ngenxa yombangazwe kuzoshabalala okwamazolo ebona ilanga ngoba babezobe sebeyitholile into ababeyilwela. Umuntu wayengabuzanga elangeni ngoba kwaqala phansi ukufa, kwadla silaza kwadla fumuka, ikakhulukazi KwaZulu-Natal. Kulokhu bekungasalwelwa inkululeko kodwa amadlelandawonye abesebulalana wodwa. Ubufakazi balokho wukuthinteka kwabaholi be-ANC ekubulaweni kowayengunobhala we-ANCYL kuzwelonke, uSindiso Magaqa ngoJulayi 2017. UMagaqa, owayeseyikhansela elimele i-ANC kuMasipala waseMzimkhulu,wabulawelwa ukufuna ukudalula inkohlakalo ngehholo elakhiwe kuleli dolobha. Inkabi esanda kugwetshelwa leli cala uSbusiso Ncengwa, yazivumela yona maqede yaveza ukuthi yayithunywe ngowayeyiMeya uMnuz Mluleki Ndobe nowayeyiMenenja kaMasipala uMnuz Zwelaphansi Sikhosana, osagqigqa enkantolo yakule ndawo. NgoDisemba 2023 kwabulawa obenguSotswebhu oMkhulu we-DA kuMasipala waseMngeni, uNhlalayenza Ndlovu eMpophomeni eHowick. Kulesi sigameko kusolwa iNkosi eyisihlobo sikaNdlovu, uMnuz Siphiwe Zuma (55), uMnu Thabani Masobho Hlongwa (31), Mnuz Khayelihle Shabalala (31) noMnuz Thabo Mathonsi (26). Isolezwe Ngempelasonto lithole ukuthi ngo-2013 bangu-450 osopolitiki abaqothwe kulesi sifundazwe emuva kokuphela kobandlululo. Ngo-2016 kwabikwa ukuthi kwabulawa abantu abangu-20 ngesikhathi kubhekwe okhethweni loHulumeni baseKhaya olwalungomhla ka-3 Agasti ngalowo nyaka, iningi kwakungosopolitiki baseKZN. Ukubulalana ngenxa yepolitiki akubanga phakathi kwe-ANC neNkatha Freedom Party (IFP) kodwa kukapakele nakwezinye izinhlangano. Leli phephandaba lithole ukuthi kwabulawa amalungu eNFP kaNkk Zanele Magwaza awu-21 selokhu le nhlangano yasungulwa ngo-2011 kanti neNkatha yaveza ukuthi angu-10 amalungu ayo ayeyimele okhethweni asathelwa othulini. Ngo-2013 Abahlali Basemjondolo baveza ukuthi ukubulawa komholi wabo uNkululeko Gwala kwakuhlobene nepolitiki. NgoMeyi 2016 kwagwetshwa amakhansela e-ANC amabili ngokusoconga owayengumholi waBahlali Basemjondolo uThuli Ndlovu. Naba abanye asebendela koyisemkhulu ngenxa yepolitiki. Owayeyisishoshovu seNkatha eLindelani futhi eyilungu lePhalamende ngo-2005. UShabalala wabulawa ngaphandle kwesango lomuzi wakhe oseLindelani, eThekwini, kubuka izingane zakhe ngoJanuwari 20, 2005. Owayeyishoshovu seSACP kodwa esabe sesisekela ikhansela elizimele uSinethemba Myeni wabulawa ngo-Ephreli 12,2006. UMazwi 'Komi' Zulu,naye owayeyishoshovu seSACP kodwa eseseka ongenele ubukhansela ngokuzimela, wabulawa eMlaza ngoMeyi 3, 2006. Owayengumholi weSanco, uJimmy Mtolo, wabulawa ngo-2009 ngumuntu owayezenza umuntu owayefuna indlu yomxhaso njengoba uMtolo wayejutshelwe lowo msebenzi eNew Germany. Owayengumholi we-ANC Youth League, uSthembiso Cele (27),wabulawa ekhaya lakhe eliseMgababa phambi kwendodana yakhe eyayineminyaka emithathu ngoJanuwari 2009. Inkosi Mbongeleni Zondi owayeyilungu lokuqina le-ANC wabulawa emzini wakhe oseMlaza ngoJanuwari 2009. Owayengumholi we-ANC kwaNongoma uBongani Ngcobo wabulawa ngo-2009 futhi kwaboshwa owayeyikhansela leNkatha. Omunye umholi we-ANC kwaNongoma uJabulani Khumalo wabulawa ngo-2009, kwaboshwa ikhansela leNkatha. Owayengunobhala we-ANC eThekwini uSbu Sibiya wadutshulwa wabulawa ekwi-drive way yakwakhe eNanda ngoJulayi 2011. Kulesi sigameko kwaboshwa uXolani Sibiya kwathi uzakwabo uZamani Sikhakhane wadutshulwa ngamaphoyisa washona. Owayeyikhansela le-ANC eThekwini uWiseman Zithulele Mshibe wadutshulwa wabulawa esegcekeni lomuzi wakhe oseYellowood Park ngoMashi 2011. Kulesi sehlakalo kwagwetshwa udilikajele uNkosiyabo Ngubane. OwayenguSotswebhu omkhulu we-ANC eMkhandlwini wasoGwini futhi engumlandeli omkhulu kaMnuz Jacob Zuma, uWandile Mkhize (34) wabulawa ngokudutshulwa efika kwakhe eManaba eMargate ngoJulayi 2012 emuva kokusongelwa. UMkhize wabulawa nomngani wakhe uNhlakanipho Shabane owayeyilungu lokuqina le-ANC. Kulesi sigameko kwaboshwa uKwanele Hlongwane noDumisani Sikhakhane. Owayeqokelwe ukuba yikhansela le-ANC uDumisani Malunga wadutshulwa wabulawa esendleleni ebheke ekhaya ngoSepthemba 9, 2012. Owayengusihlalo wegatsha le-ANC oShabeni, uGabriel Bheki Chiliza, washonela endaweni yesigameko emuva kokuqhululwa ngentululwane yezinhlamvu. Owayeyikhansela le-ANC eThekwini uMthembeni Shezi (owayebuye aziwe ngelikaMsizeni Ximba) washonela esibhedlela iRK Khan emuva kokudutshulwa esemhlanganweni eMbaliyethu High eWelbedacht, ngaseChatsworth ngoSepthemba 2012. Owayeyikhansela kuMasipala waseMtshezi uJimmy Lembede wabulawa phambi kwendodana yakhe eyayino-11 ngo-Agasti 2012. Owayeyikhansela le-IFP ehostela laKwaMashu, uThemba Xulu wathunjwa maqede wabulawa ngo-Okthoba 2012. Isidumbu sakhe satholwa sidindilizile eNanda. Owayengusihlalo we-ANC eWembezi e-Estcourt, uSbu Majola wadutshulwa wabulawa ngoMashi 2013. Owayeyikhansela eliqavile le-ANC kwaNongoma uMakhosonke Msibi wadutshulwa wabulawa kubo oLundi ngo-Agasti 11, 2013. Kulesi sigameko kwaboshwa indoda eyayihlala ehostela laKwaMashu. Owayengumholi weNFP oLundi, uSiphumelelo Buthelezi, walalelwa unyendle wabulawa ngoNovemba 3, 2013.USthembiso Biyela noBuyisile Malusi,okwabikwa ukuthi babeshiye iNkatha bajoyina i-ANC, babulawa eThekwini ngo-2014. Ababengabaholi benyunyana iNumsa kwaSithebe, uNjabulo Ndebele, Sibonelo "John-John” Ntuli noNtobeko Maphumulo badutshulwa babulawa eMandeni ngo-Agasti 2014. Owayengunobhala weSACP eNchanga, uNontsikelelo Blose, wabulawa ngokudutshulwa ngo-Agasti 2016 kwathi owayeyisishoshovu se-ANC uXolani Zungu wabulawa ngokudutshulwa aze agxotshwe ngamatshe esigamekweni okusolwa kuso ukuphindiselela ukufa kukaNksz Blose.Owayeyikhansela le-ANC ku-ward 88 kuMasipala weTheku, uSibusiso Maphumulo wabulawa ngokudutshulwa esemotweni yakhe ngo-Okthoba 18, 2018. Ngaphambi kokhetho lohulumeni basekhaya ngoNovemba 2021 kwalalelwa unyendle owayeyikhansela le-ANC ku-Ward 101 eCato Crest, uSiyabonga Mkhize owabulawa ngokudutshulwa nomqaphi wakhe uMzukisi Nyanga. OwayeyiPR Councillor futhi emele iNkatha kuMasipala iLembe, uSbani Robert Mdletshe, wabulawa ngokudutshulwa eyongena eSpar Supermarket eMandeni ngoMeyi 2021.Ngo-Okthoba 2021 owayemele iNFP okhethweni loHulumeni waseKhaya ku-ward 17 kuMasipala wakwaNongoma uDumisani Qwabe wadutshulwa maqede washiswa nemoto emgwaqweni uR66 phakathi kwasoPhongolo nakwaNongoma.Ngomhla ka-15 Septhemba 2022 kwadutshulwa kwabulawa ikhansela elikuMasipala Ilembe,uZakhele Khuzwayo (44) KwaMaphumulo. UDINGISIWE emijondolo yaKwaMasxha, eCato Manor, owesifazane otholakale etetela endlini encane engumahamba nendlwana ngoLwesibili ekuseni.Lona wesifazane (25) kuthiwa ubevakashele isoka elisha analo kule ndawo njengoba yena eveze ukuthi uhlala eGoli.Ilungu lomphakathi elikhulume neSolezwe liveze ukuthi bekuyizithuba zehora lesihlanu ekuseni ngesikhathi bezwa lezi zindaba."Lona wesifazane uthi ubengazi ukuthi ukhulelwe njengoba ingane kungeyomunye, hhayi lona akade emvakashele. Usitshela ukuthi uzwe ngento iluxuka ngesikhathi esendlini encane wase ebanga umsindo, kwaba khona abamuzwayo bangena kuye. Bathuke boma uma bezwa ingane ikhala kwase kubizwa amaphoyisa, waphuthunyiswa esibhedlela. "Singamalungu omphakathi, lesi sigameko sisicasule kakhulu ngenxa yokuthi izinhloso zakhe asazi ukuthi beziyini,” kusho ilungu lomphakathi eliveze ukuthi abafuni ukuphinde bambone lona wesifazane endaweni.Lithe okumenza bamdingise ukuthi uzokwenza into ezoletha isithombe esibi ezinganeni, ezisakhula emphakathini."Kwandoda lena abeyivakashele nayo ithuke yoma yathi ibingazi ngokukhulelwa kwakhe, uthi ubeya ezinsukwini lona wesifazane futhi isisu besingakhukhumele. Kukhona abangani bakhe khona endaweni abaveze ukuthi ubeke abatshele ocingweni ukuthi uyasola ukuthi ukhulelwe futhi ingane eyowesilisa ahlukana naye ngoJanuwari, okucacisayo ukuthi isisu sase sihleli behlukana,” kuchaza yena.Uthe okubi ukuthi lona wesilisa abemvakashele umlaxaze esibhedlela waphela emehlweni akangaziwa ukuthi ushone kuphi.Amaphoyisa uthe aveze ukuthi alikho icala elizovulwa okwamanje kodwa azonika konke kubaphenyi abazophenya uma kukhona okusolisayo bavule icala."Sifuna abhekane nengalo yomthetho ngoba ngokwethu ubezama ukuganga, angeke umuntu onezingane athi ubengaziboni ukuthi ukhulelwe, kanjani? Siyabuyela emaphoyiseni sifuna izigangi ezifana naye zingacabangi ukwenza lokhu lapha emphakathini wethu,” kubhoka elinye lungu lomphakathi. Bathe osonhlalakahle ibona ababashiye bekhuluma nalona wesifazane ngokuzokwenza kuye nengane.Ongoti kwezempilo bathi kuyenzeka umuntu wesifazane azithwale kepha zingabonakali izimpawu ezijwayelekile.
BAYALELWE ukuthi bazibambe ziqine abafundi baka-matric abafuna ukuya emanyuvesi ngonyaka ozayo njengoba ukuphasa nge-Bachelor kuphela, kungasho ukuthi bazongena begijima ezikhungweni.Laba bafundi bayalelwe ukuba babheke imikhakha abafuna ukuyenza ukuthi idinga amaphuzu amangaki ngaphezu nje kokuthi baphase nge-Bachelor.UNgqongqoshe weMfundo ePhakeme, uMnuz Buti Manamela, uthe kubalulekile ukuthi abafundi baka-matric abafuna ukuya emanyuvesi, bazi okumele bakulindele ngonyaka ozayo."Akumele bashaywe yibhomu uma sebethi ngqu emanyuvesi, bachithwe ngoba kuthiwa amaphuzu awenele. Ukuphasa nge-Bachelor kodwa, akusho ukuthi nakanjani uzongena ugijima kulowo mkhakha ofuna ukuwenza," usho kanje. Uthe lolu daba lwe-Bachelor, uzoluxoxa nozakwabo weMfundo eyisiSekelo, uNksz Siviwe Gwarube."Abafundi kumele bazi ukuthi kwamukelwa kuqala labo abanamaphuzu amaningi emanyuvesi. Uma unamancane ungagcina ususala ngaphandle, bese ukhalaza uthi uphase u-matric kodwa wangakwazi ukungena emanyuvesi."Okunye athe kumele kwaziwe ngukuthi kunesibalo esamukelwa amanyuvesi njalo ngonyaka."Uma sekugcwele kulowo mkhakha abakwazi ukwandisa isibalo. Uma ngingenza isibonelo' ngonyaka mhlawumbe sithi sizothatha abangu-10 000 abazokwenza unyaka wokuqala emkhakheni othile kuwona wonke amanyuvesi, uma sesifinyelele kulesi sibalo asibe sisakwazi ukwamukela abanye," kusho uManamela. Uthe abafundi kumele babheke nasemakolishi amakhono ama-TVET, bangagxili kumanyuvesi kuphela.Uqhube wathi ngonyaka ozayo bandisa imikhakha emaTVET ukuze inqwaba yabafundi iye kuwona."Awangashalazelwa amaTVET ngoba afundisa izinto ezidingwa ngumnotho. Yingakho sinxusa ukuthi abafuna ukufunda baye kuwona." Ubalule nokuthi babalelwa ku-815 000 abenza u-matric kodwa ngeke bakwazi ukubamukela bonke ngonyaka ozayo."Iqiniso ngukuthi njengoba izikhala zingenele ezikhungweni zemfundo, cishe sizokwazi ukuthatha uhhafu kwababhala u-matric. Lokhu kusho ukuthi sizothatha ababalelwa ku-400 000 kuphela ngonyaka ozayo." Khonamanjalo: IKhabhinethi ebihleli kuleli sonto inxuse abafundi abafuna uxhaso kwiNSFAS ukuthi basheshe bafake izicelo njengoba kuvalwa ngoNovemba 15. Inxuse othisha nomphakathi ukuthi usize abafaka izicelo.
IKHABHINETHI isinxuse abanolwazi abangafuna ukulwethula kwikhomishini ephenya izinsolo ezenziwa uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, ukuthi baxhumane nale khomishini.Le khomishini eyaziwa ngekaMadlanga, iphenya izinsolo zokugxambukela kosopolitiki, inkohlakalo nobugebengu obenzeka emkhakheni wokulwa nobugebengu kuleli.UNgqongqoshe eHhovisi likaMengameli, uNksz Khumbudzo Ntshavheni, uthe iKhabhinethi ikwamukele ukuqala kokulalelwa kobufakazi kule khomishini. UMkhwanazi uyena oqale ukuthula ubufakazi kwikhomishini kusuka ngoLwesithathu nayizolo."IKhabhinethi inxusa noma ngubani ofuna ukuthula ulwazi ukuthi axhumane nekhomishini ngokushesha. Angakwenza lokhu ngokuyibhalela ku:[email protected] noma ashayele ku: 0800 111 369."UMkhwanazi waveza izinsolo zokuthi kunezigebengu ezisondelene nosopolitiki eziphazamisa ukusebenza kwamaphoyisa kuleli. UNksz Ntshavheni ubuye waveza ukuthi iKhabhinethi yamukele ukukhula komnotho ngo-0.8% ekoteni yesibili ka-2025.Uveze nokuthi uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa uzohola ithimba elibheke eNew York, elizothamela umhlangano ka-80, we-United Nations."Lo mhlangano uqala ngoSepthemba 23 kuya kuSepthemba 29. Kuyobhungwa ngezinto ezithinta ukuthula nezithinta amalungelo. Kunongqongqoshe abavele sebeseMelika, abayoqhubeka nezingxoxo ngezithinta ukuqinisa amaxhama okuhwebelana," usho kanje. Uthe uMnyango wezeMidlalo usebenzisana nababeyiziboshwa ejele iRobben Island, bazoba nomcimbi wokuhlanganisa iziboshwa ezibalelwa ku-1 700 ezaziboshwe kuleli jele. "Umcimbi ungoSepthemba 27. Kuzobe kuhlangana abalwa belwela ukuthi izwe likhululeke. Kuzobe kukhona nabavela kwamanye amazwe okubalwa iNamibia, Lesotho neBotswana."
KUBHEKWE uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa kuzwelonke, uLieutenant General Fannie Masemola, ukuba ahlukanise inhloko nesixhanti ngodaba lomyalelo wokuba kuhlakazwe ithimba eliphenya amacala ezepolitiki KwaZulu-Natal, uma esethula ubufakazi kwikhomishini ephenya izinsolo ezenziwa uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi.UMasemola uzoqala ukwethula ubufakazi phambi kwekhomishini eholwa yiJaji uMbuyiseli Madlanga namhlanje.Lesi simemezelo senziwe okhulumela ikhomishini, uMnuz Jeremy Michaels, izolo.UMasemola ungufakazi wesibili kwikhomishini. LUBHEKE eNkantolo eNkulu yasePitoli udaba lombango wesikweletu semali yama-e-toll avalwa ngonyaka odlule emuva kokuba yiva kubashayeli abaningi baseGauteng.Ama-e-toll aqala ukusebenza ngoDisemba 2013 kulandela ukulungiswa kwemigwaqo emikhulu kulesiya sifundazwe.Akhiwa njengendlela yokubuyisa izindleko zokulungiswa kwemigwaqo. Emuva kweminyaka abashayeli bekhala abanye bengawakhokheli, agcine evaliwe ngo-Ephreli nyakenye kodwa amakhamera awo asele njengemizamo yezokuphepha ngokusho kukahulumeni ngaleso sikhathi.Uhulumeni ngokwamazinga ahlukene wathembisa ukukhokhela izindleko.Inhlangano i-Organisation Undoing Tax Abuse (OUTA), ithe ifake amaphepha enkantolo lapho ifuna kukhishwe isinqumo sokuthi iSanral ingabe isaziqoqa izikweletu ezasala kubashayeli. Emaphepheni ifuna kuphendule iSouth African National Roads Agency (Sanral), uNgqongqoshe wezokuThutha, owezeziMali nowamaHlathi, ukuDoba neMvelo noMqondisi Jikelele wakhona kanjalo nokhomishana wesikhwama esiqoqa intela iSars.I-Outa ithe ngaphandle kwayo abanye abafake amaphepha ngabangu-2 028 abangafuni ukukhokha. Ngokwayo, iSanral iveze ukuthi izimisele ngokusiphikisa isicelo."Amaphepha asenkantolo afuna ukuthi inkantolo enkulu ikhiphe isinqumo esishoyo ukuthi iSanral isikuyekile ukufuna isikweletu kubantu abangu-2 028 abaphikisana naso nokuzobe kukhipha udaba lwayo enkantolo. Uma i-Outa iwina, imizamo yeSanral yokufuna imali kwabangu-2 028 izobe isiphela. I-Outa ifuna nokuthi inkantolo ikhiphe umyalelo ophoqa iSanral ukuthi ikhokhele izindleko ze-Outa zecala," kusho i-Outa. Ithe iSanral yaqala uhlelo lokumangalela abangu-2 028 namabhizinisi angazikhokhelile izikweletu zama-e-toll yase icela usizo kwi-Outa yona yavele yavikela abasolwayo.I-Outa ikholwa wukuthi iSanral yawalaxaza amacala ngesikhathi ibhodi linquma ngoMashi 2019 ukuma ukuqoqa izikweletu zama-e-toll."Kule minyaka eyisithupha kusuka lapho, iSanral ayikaze ithathe zinyathelo kulama cala manje i-Outa isifuna kuphume isinqumo esizoqeda konke." Ngo-2015 i-Outa yasungula i E-Toll Defence Umbrella yokuvikela bonke abathola amasamanisi kwiSanral ngokungazikhokheli izikweletu zama-e-toll. Ngesikhathi ekhishwa isikweletu sasingu-R265 million.
ABANTU abaningi emhlabeni wonke jikelele bahlalele ovalweni kulandela ukusabalala kwezinkulumo ezibalula ukuthi umhlaba uyagoqwa kusukela ngoSepthemba 23 kuya kumhla ka-24. Lesi siphrofetho siqale sashiwo omunye wabefundisi abadume ezinkundleni zokuxhumana uBrother Enigma. Lo mntwana kaNkulunkulu usezakhele ugazi nesigcwagcwa ngokudalula izingxoxo athi uba nazo neNkosi uJesu Khrestu "UJesu wathi...". Abanye sebeze bamfaka enkantolo ngoba besola ukuthi uBrother Enigma usuke efuna ukubukwa ngamagama abo. UBrother Enigma, kwiYouTube Channel iChris Network, uthe kuzobamnyama ngoba uNkulunkulu ucasuke kakhulu. Uthe ugesi ngeke usebenze izinsuku ezine, ngakho kuzodingeka amakhandlela nelambu elisebenzisa upharafini. Eqhubeka uthe abantu kufanele bazi ukuthi ngeke ugesi, amafoni namalambu ezimoto kusebenze. Kuqale kwathiwa uBrother Enigma usevukwe yilokhu kuhhema kwakhe.Lithe lingakagwinywa elikaBrother Enigma, kwaqhamuka omunye umfundisi wakuleli, uPastor Joshua Mhlakela kwiCettwinz TV wathi naye uboniswe ngokubuya kukaJesu ezolanda ibandla lakhe emhlabeni. UMhlakela uthe uyibonile impela iNdodana yoMuntu esibonakalisweni imtshela ngosuku ezobuya ngalo. Uthe okuzokwenzeka kubizwa nge-rapture, okuwumzuzu ngokwenkolo yobuKhrestu lapho amakholwa ehlwithwa emhlabeni, eyiswa eZulwini bese kuthi abahedeni basale bodwa emhlabeni. "Ngimbonile uJesu ehlezi esihlalweni sakhe. Bengimuzwa kahle futhi ngokucacile ethi 'Ngiyabuya maduze.'"Omunye wabethuli kwiCenttwinz TV, uMillicent Mashile, uthe uyavumelana nokubuya kukaJesu futhi ukulangazelele kabi ukuya eZulwini kodwa akanasiqiniseko ngosuku azobuya ngalo."Enginesiqiniseko sakho wukuthi uJesu uzobuya ezolanda umlobokazi wakhe, okuyibandla," kusho uMillicent ongumethuli wezinhlelo zethelevishini nomlingisi wemidlalo yeTV kwiThe Voice with Palesa Podcast.Newele likaMillicent, u-Innocent Sadiki onguSthoko kwiSkeem Saam lithe abantu kufanele bahlale belindele ukubuya kukaJesu njengomfundi osuke ezobhala izivivinyo zakhe zokuphela konyaka.Umlingisi wemidlalo yethelevishini nongumethuli wezinhlelo kuKhozi TV, uMuzi Mthabela, uthe akukhona okokuqala kuthiwa uJesu uyabuya. Uthe kwaqala kwathiwa uzobuya ngo-2000 kodwa kwangenzeka. Uthe nakuba kunjalo kodwa zikhona ezinye izimpawu ezikhombisa ukuthi kukhona okuzokwenzeka. Uthe bakhona abaphrofethi beqiniso ngalokhu kodwa futhi bakhona abasenga ezimithiyo. Eqhuba uMuzi uthe ibhayibheli lithi uJesu uyofika njengesela esezohlwitha ibandla lakhe, ngakho akekho oyokwazi usuku nomzuzu. Unxuse abantu ukuba bakhonze uMdali ngeqiniso ngoba isikhathi sokudlala siphelile futhi abayeke ukufuna ukuzwa ngabantu.UMphrofethi uShepherd Bushiri waseMalawi uthe kwabikezelwa kudala ngalolu suku futhi kubhaliwe naseBhayibhelini, ikakhulukazi ku-Hosea 6:2 naku-2 Peter 3:8. NoMphostoli Given Gobhozi kwiThabani ST Media naye uthe ubonisiwe ngokuphela komhlaba ngoSepthemba 23. Isolezwe Ngempelasonto lithole ukuthi lolu suku luqondene noMkhosi wamaJuda obizwa ngeJewish Feast of Trumpets, lapho amaKhrestu amaningi ehlanganisa lomkhosi nokugcwaliseka kombhalo oseBhayibhelini. Omunye waleyo mibhalo ngosencwadini etholakala KwabaseThesalonika 4:16-17, efundeka kanje "Khona thina, esisekhona sisasele siyakuhlwithwa kanye nabo emafwini, sihlangabeze iNkosi emoyeni, kanjalo-ke siyakuba nayo iNkosi njalo..." Nakuba kunjalo kodwa umbhalo osencwadini NgokukaMatewu 24:29-30 kuthiwa "Ilanga liyakufiphazwa, inyanga ayiyukukhanya, izinkamyezi ziyakuwa emkhathini, namandla eZulu ayakuzanyazanyiswa. Zonke ziyakuyibona iNdodana yomuntu iza emafini eZulu, inamamdla nenkazimulo enkulu...".Iqhubeka le ncwadi kuvesi 36 ithi "Kepha lolo suku nalelo hora akekho owazi lutho ngalo nezingelosi zaseZulwini naNdodana, nguBaba kuphela."Inkulumo kaBrother Enigma noMhlakela isiqibule enkulu inkulumompukiswano kubazalwame bamahlelo ahlukahlukene. Inkantolo yeSifunda eDundee igwebe uSiphamandla Ndlovu (38), uNkosingiphile Kunene (39) noNosipho Francisca Kunene (23) izigwebo ezehlukene ngecala lokubulala uMhlonipheni Elphas Buthelezi (50) eKunene Farm eDundee ngo-2023. Omunye owayekhona uBongiwe Mthombeni (36) ulahlwe ngecala lokushaya.Ngo-16 Disemba 2023 umufi wayesekhaya lakhe ngesikhathi ehlaselwa wuNdlovu, wuNkosingiphile noNosipho ababehlome ngemishiza, induku yegalofu nommese. UMthombeni wafika emuva kwesikhathi. Bamshaya umufi bemsola ngokunyamalala kwengane eyeyidukile. Umufi walimala kabi ngenxa yokushaywa.Ingane yatholakala kwenye indawo. Ngesikhathi umufi ephuthunyiswa esibhedlela kwase kuboshwe ummangalewa oyedwa. Umufi wagcina eshonile esibhedlela.UMshushisi uMphakamiseni Mdlalose ubize ofakazi abazibonela abathathu, wabiza amaphoyisa afika endaweni yesigameko. Kwethulwe nombiko wokuhlolwa kwesidumbu. UMdlalose wethule nesitatimende sikankosikazi kamufi asibhale eluswe wuVictoria Griffiths oyi-Court Prepapration Officer. Unkosikazi kamufi uthe ukushona komyeni wakhe kumgqeme engeqiwa ntwala ngoba ubethemebele kuye.UNdlovu ugwetshwe udilikajele ngecala lokubulala, uNkosingiphile wagwetshwa iminyaka ewu-15 nokubulala, uNosipho wagwetshwa iminyaka ewu-10 ngokubulala. UMthombeni yena ugwetshwe iminyaka emithathu ngecala lokushaya. Inkantolo ibagweba ibheke ukuthi umuntu nomuntu waba naliphi iqhaza ekwenzeni icala.

Ngizobuye ngenze nomucu wami omusha othi Re Lekompo okokuqala ngqa ngenhloso kwiLive My Life Legacy ngenxa yokuthi wayehlale ethi lolu hlobo lomculo (Lekompo) luyadlisa," kuphetha uCandy Tsa Mandebele. UWinnie (51), owayengumculi futhi engumlingisi wemidlalo yeTV namafilimu, wadlula emhlabeni ephuthunyiswa esibhedlela ngoJanuwari 7, kulo nyaka. Lo mculi waqala ukwaziwa eseneminyaka ewu-15 ngenoni elalithi Hey Laatie. Wanyamalala wabuya esesebenza neBrothers of Peace, Brenda Fassie, DJ Cleo noChicco Twala. Akugcinanga lapho kodwa ubuye walingisa emdlalweni wethelevishini iMuvhango neMponeng. Ngo-2008, uWinnie wakhipha ungqambothi lwengoma engasoze yabuna ethi Live My Life, okuyiyo okuqanjwe ngayo umcimbi. Ngo-2010, uWinnie utholakale enesifo sama-ulcer. Ngo-2013, wahlala unyaka esibhedlela ngenxa yama-ulcer okwenza umsebenzi wokucula ume. Nakuba kunjalo, waqhubeka nokucula kwaze kwathi ngo-2014 washiya kwiKalawa Records ngoba wayesesungule eyakhe iWinnKay Music Records. Ungunina kaThando Thobela amthola kumshayisibhakela ongasekho uDingaan "The Rose of Soweto" Thobela noRethabile, osengomunye wabaculi abahlonishwayo.
KUSOLWA impi yomzila wokudayisa izidakamizwa okuvela ukuthi idla lubi eCato Manor, eThekwini, njengoba ngoLwesithathu kudutshulwe kwafa abantu abane ezigamekweni ezehlukene.Esigamekweni sokuqala kuthiwa kuhlasele amadoda angaziwa afike avulela ngenhlamvu kubantu akade behlezi endlini.Kulesi sigameko kushone uMnuz Thokozani Ngubane (40), intombi yakhe uNksz Abongile (isibongo Isolezwe eligcine lingasitholanga) nomngani wabo uMasokisi.Ngezansi kwakhona kube sekudutshulwa intombazane uLinamandla Magudu (15), naye okuthiwa ubesondelene noNgubane.Umthombo weSolezwe ocele ukungavezwa njengoba usabela impilo yawo nobungozi balesi sigameko uveze ukuthi akuqali ukuthi kube nemizamo yokudubula uNgubane njengoba ake apulukutshela kufike abantu bezomfuna."Kubangwa izidakamizwa nje akukho okunye. Iqiniso lendaba yilelo, asifuni lokhu sishona lena nalena, kukhona umuntu lapha endaweni akade bengazwani naye uNgubane okunguye okusolwa ukuthi uthenge izinkabi eziqede ngempilo yalaba, njengoba abababonile bathe abafana baseNanda ababulele laba," kusho umthombo."Bekungathi kuqhuma uthayela, kodwa abasaziyo isibhamu basho ukuthi yisona. Kube sekusuka imoto iVW Polo yabaleka lamadoda okuthe uma ebona le ntombazane imile emgwaqweni njengoba nabo ngokuzwa kwethu kuthiwa bebebheke ngala kuqhuma khona isibhamu bayimisa imoto bayidubula nayo," kuchaza umthombo.Uthe uLinamandla naye ubedla izidakamizwa futhi eseze wayeka isikole ngenxa yokuzinikela kulo mkhuba."Laba bantu bebezoqeda ngalaba njengoba bonke bedutshulwe ngoyaba lwezinhlamvu, kubuhlungu kakhulu okwenzeke kule ngane ngoba ukube yaqhubeka nesikole ngabe iyaphila. Okubuhlungu ukuthi lo mfana uMasokisi akuyena ngisho owalana endaweni ubefika nje ngoba edayisa kodwa wahlangana nebhadi, lona omunye usesimweni esibucayi esibhedlela," kuchaza yena.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uziqinisekisile lezi zigameko zombili wathi asikaziwa isizathu esiholele ekutheni kudutshulwe laba, kodwa baphenya amacala amane okubulala.
ZITHUKUTHELE zibhodla umlilo izimbongi ezayibamba ishisa insimbi ngesikhathi somzabalazo wenkululeko yakuleli, uMzwakhe "The People's Poet" Mbuli noZolani Mkiva ngenxa yomthetho ogunyaza ukuba abesilisa bathathe izibongo zamakhosikazi abo. Ngesonto eledlule iNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo ithe sebevumelekile nabesilisa ukuba basebenzise izibongo zabesifazane asebebophe ifindo likasofasilahlane nabo. Ithe lomthetho ungaphansi kwesigaba 26 (1) (a) to c, okuchaza ukuthi uMthetho wokuBhaliswa komuntu uma ezalwa noma ehamba emhlabeni sewuchithiwe. UMbuli uthe lomthetho usangene, ngakho kufanele uchithwe ngoba kuyacaca ukuthi uqhamuke nejaji elizisanganele futhi elingawahloniphi amasiko abantu abamnyama. Uthe lomthetho uzodukisa futhi uphendule izizukulwane ondingasithebeni ngoba uphambene ngisho naneBhayibheli."UNkulunkulu wenza indoda inhloko yomndeni, okubandakanya nokusetshenziswa kwesibongo sayo. Le nkinga yaqala ngesikhathi amazwe ase-Afrika ebuswa ngemithetho yasentshonalanga neyenza imithetho yase-Afrika yagcina seyibukeleka phansi. Abantu base-Afrika uma bezethula baqale bazigqaje ngobubona, okuyizibongo zabo kanye nangezithakazelo zabo. Ngakho lomthetho uzokwenza isizukulwane sinhlanhlathe."Unxuse abanolwazi ngamasiko ase-Afrika ukuba basukume babhukule balwe nalo mthetho ngoba uzofaka ubuhlongandlebe.NoMkiva, osenguNobhala-Jikelele weContralesa, uthe kuyahlekisa ukuthi inkantolo yase-Afrika ingaqhamuka nomthetho ofuze lona. Uthe umthetho ozokwakha ubutho phakathi kwamadoda nabantu besifazane ngoba akukaze kwanomuntu wesifazane olahlekelwa yimvelaphi yakhe ngenxa yokugcagcela endodeni."Abesifazane bayaqhubeka nokusebenzisa izibongo zabo ngisho sebeshadile. UMaXulu uyqhubeka nokubizwa ngoMaXulu ngisho eseshadile." Uthe lomthetho bazowuphonsela inselelo ngokomthetho nangokwepolitiki imbala. Umlingisi weShaka Ilembe futhi ongumdidiyeli wamabutho aKwaMandlakazi, kwaNongoma, uNkosikhona "Phakelumthakathi" Ndabandaba, ukhwele wadilika kuhulumeni ngokwamukela lo mthetho athe uphambene nesiko.UPhakelumthakathi uthe inkukhu iyawusola kuye umgqakazo ngokushaywa kwalomthetho ngoba abantu bakuleli sebephume umkhankaso wokuxosha abantu abakuleli ngokungemvumo.Uthe okwenza uhulumeni amukele lomthetho yingoba uyazi ukuthi abantu besifazane bantekenteke. "Uhulumeni ushaya lomthetho uzama ukujabulisa nina bantu besifazane ngoba uyazi ukuthi nizolanda amadoda ngezibu eNigeria, niwalethe lapha eNingizimu Afrika....Musani ukuvumela uhulumeni asebenzise nina ukudayisa izwe."
SEKUSUKE esikhulu isidumo ngamazwi kaMengameli Ramaphosa etshela amakhansela e-ANC ukuthi omasipala ababuswa kahle ngabaphethwe yiDA hhayi i-ANC.Kwavuka umbhedukazwe ngaphakathi nangaphandle kweqembu. Sebekhale ubumayemaye ababona ukuthi uMengameli uphakamisa amandla eDA sekusele izinyangana nje siye okhethweni lohulumeni basekhaya. Bakhala ngokuthi lokhu kuphawula kuqhakambisa ukuphatha kweDA, kufadabalisa ukuphatha kwe-ANC.Ngisho nabe-EFF bathi lokhu kusiqhatha nabelungu ngokuncoma bonaekubeni behlupheka abantu ezindaweni abahlala kuzo eKapa lapho sekubuse khona iDA isikhathi eside. Bathi alibusi kahle leli qembu ezindaweni zabadla imbuya ngothi njengakoCape Flats lapho kugcwele khona amakhaladi nakoNyanga naseGugulethu kwezabansundu izindawo. Baze basho nokuthi iGoli neTshwane layihlula iDA yaze yakhishwa emandleni. USihlalo we-EFFuthi inkulumo enje yakha isithombe eseseka umbono wokuthi kwakungcono kusaphethe umbuso wobandlululo nokuthi abelungu baphatha kangcono kunabansundu. Omele leli qembu ePhalamende, uSinawo Thambo, naye uvele ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ethi uKhongolose uma esho kanje ukhomba ukuthi ufuna ukubuyisela izintambo zombuso emabhunwini.Baningi abaphawule ngokuthi le nkulumo ifadabalisa amathemba kubavoti, emalungwini, nakozibonda abavela kwi-ANC. Kunokubakhuthaza ukuthi benze kangcono njengoba bekuhleliwe lokhu kungabaqeda amandla nogqozi.Le nkulumo yenziwe emhlanganweni obuhlanganise ozibonda bakaKhongolose ezweni lonke enkundleni yezemidlalo eGoli ukuzobacija ngomsebenzi kaKhongolose komasipala. Njengenjwayelo, yiqembu leli livamisile ukuvuma izono zalo, likhulume ngesibindi ngobuthakathaka balo. Izingqungquthela zalo zihlala zinakho lokhu kokuvuma amacala. Kuyancomeka lokhu ngoKhongolose ukuthi uyazivumela ukuthi sewagubuzelwa yifu lokukhwabanisa. Usuhamba phambili kulokhu njengoba kwasho yena uMengameli wayo phambi kwekhomishini eyayiphenya ngokukhwabanisa phansi kweso likaMahluleli uRaymond Zondo. Laphinde lazichaza ngokwehluleka kwalo ukufukula umnontho, ukunqoba inhlupheko, ukufeza izinhlelo zezwe unyaka nonyaka.Lokhu akuvezi nje ukukhula nokuqina kweqembu kodwa kubonisa nobuhlakani. Uma abaholi beveza ukuthi bayabona la bengahambisi kahle khona kukhona kweizakhamuzi abazobaxolela babanike ithuba elinye. Kodwa kuwukuziphakamisa ukwenza sengathi awonanga ube uhlulekile wukuphucula impilo yabantu, ukuletha izinsiza, nokufula umnotho. Abantu bayabona, bayazi ukuthi konakelephi. Kodwa lokhu akulisizi leli qembu uma livuma izono zalo bese lingaguquli ukwenza kwalo. Ngalokho ligcina liphindaphinda ukuvuma izono nokona futhi. Lokhu kwenza okunesibindi kugcina kuwubuwula emehlweni ezingqapheli. Ukuxolisa akuzi ngokukhuluma kuphela kodwa nangokuguqula izenzo. UKhongolose usuthembise kaningi ukuzikhipha amakhizane wahluleka yonke le minyaka. Kuyobanzima ukuthi abantu ababone lokhu bathembe uma usuthembisa okufanayo. Izingqungquthela zeqembu kuya emuva ko-1997 zithembisa kakhulu ukuthuthukisa ukwenza namakhono eqembu kodwa kwangenzeka. Akusazolisebenzela ukuthembisa futhi namanje ngoba kuzoba sengathi likhankasela ivoti lalo eselifekela kule minyaka. Kodwa abakhale kakhulu ngokuphawula kukaMengameli abeqembu lakhe abathi unika amandla i-DA esizozincoma ngamazwi akhe manje emikhankasweni yayo yokhetho. Bathi lokhu kukhuluma kwehlisa ithemba kubavoti beqembu nomfutho kwizibonda zeqembu kube sengathi imizamo ekhona yokulungisa iphelela obala. Bakhathazeka nangokuthi kuzoba sengathi ubuholi obuphethe manje sebaphosa ithawula. Labo eqembini ababesola ukuthi uRamaphosa uthengwe abelungu ukuzobulala uKhongolose sebethatha le nkulumo njengobufakazi. Le nkulumo isiphithanisa izinto eqenjini eselilungiselela ukhetho. Sekumele ligijime liphethe itshe ngothi. Emhlanganweni iqembu liphume nesinqumo sokusheshisa izinto komaspala libhekane nezinto eziyisithupha ukwenza lokhu. Okokuqala wukuletha izidingo ngokushesha ikakhulu amanzi, ukuthuthwa kwendle, ukuthuthwa kwezibi, ugesi nezindlu. Okwesibili wukuletha ingqalasizinda eqinile ikakhulukazi eyamanzi nemigwaqo. Okwesithathu wukuxhumana kakhulu nezakhamuzi kuxoxiswane nazo kuxazululwe izinkinga abantu bengakabhikishi. Okwesine wukuqinisa izinhlaka zokubusa ikakhulu ekuphatheni kahle imali, ekweluseni ukuthi imithetho kamasipala iyalandelwa, nokuqashwa kwabantu abafanele. Okwesihlanu wukwenza izinhlelo eziqavile zokukhulisa umnotho nentuthuko emazingeni kamasipala, kwesekwe amabhizinisi nezimboni kulamazinga, kwandiswe namathuba emisebenzi. Okwesithupha wukucacisa kahle njalo emphakathini ukuthi yini eyenziwe, yini esezinhlelweni, nokuthi yiziphi izingqinamba. Konke lokhu kuphusile kodwa akukusha. Kuvele kuwumsebenzi kamaspala ngokomthetho olawula omasipala. Akukho okusha. Mhlawumbe obekufanele kube kusha wukuthi uKhongolose uzokwenzani ngozibonda nomeya bomasipala ababuswa nguye abangenzi okufanele. Akukho okuzokwenza amavila ashintshe. Akukho kulokhu okubaliwe okuzokwenza abangenzi umsebenzi bashintshe ukwenza. Okusho ukuthi uKhongolose uthembele ethembeni ke manje. Uthembe ukuthi bazwile, bazozishaya bona ngaphakathi bashintshe. Uthembe ukuthi unamakhansela aqotho, akhulile kwipolitiki anesibindi sokushintsha ukwenza kwawo. Ithemba alibulali, kodwa alisilo isu uma abantu sebekhathele wukulinda, uma imali ichithwa bebona, uma kubekwa abaholi abangenamava ezihlalweni zento ebucayi njengomasipala. Siyoyicela ivuthiwe le. Sizobona emasontweni ambalwa ukuthi ithemba leli belifanele noma kuwukuthela amanzi emhlane wedada nje.

Inkantolo eNkulu ebihleli eMthunzini igwebe uMduduzi Msezane oneminyaka ewu-41 odilikajele ababili ngokudlwengula nokubulala umzala wayo ngo-2021 eZimpakaneni, KwaNongoma.Ummangalelwa nomgilwa uNomvula Mbatha owayeneminyaka ewu-24, bebehlala kule ndawo futhi isimo sasimuncu phakathi kwabo.
