INKANTOLO ivimbe ukuqokwa kwemenenja entsha kaMasipala waseNdumeni esolwa ngokuqamba amanga esicelweni sayo somsebenzi. INkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu ikhiphe isivimbelo esinqanda ukuqokwa kukaMnuz Nhlakanipho Mvelase, njengemenenja entsha yomkhandlu.UMvelase waphuma phambili ngesikhathi kunohlelo lokuthungatha imenenja entsha yomkhandlu kepha amaqembu aphikisayo, i-ABC ne-ANC akhala ngokuthi uMvelase waqamba amanga esicelweni sakhe somsebenzi.La maqembu abefake isicelo esiphuthumayo esilalelwe eNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu.Inkantolo inqume ukuthi kumiswe ukuqokwa kukaMvelase kuze kuphenywe izinsolo zokungalandelwa kwemigomo ngesikhathi eqokwa.Ikhansela le-ABC, uMnuz Mbulelo Phakathi, lithe uMvelase waqamba amanga ngesipiliyoni anaso ngesikhathi efaka isicelo. Encwadini yasenkantolo efungelwe, uPhakathi uthe uMvelase akanaso isipiliyoni seminyaka emihlanu ephethe isikhundla esiphezulu emkhandlwini.Lona omunye wemibandela owawubekelwe ozongena kulesi sikhundla.UPhakathi uthe uMvelase waqamba amanga esicelweni sakhe somsebenzi wathi waqokelwa esikhundleni sokuba yiChief Financial Officer kuMasipala waseMsinga, ngoJuni ngo-2021."Ulwazi esinalo lukhombisa ukuthi waqokelwa kulesi sikhundla ngo-Okthoba 2022."UPhakathi uthe uMvelase wasebenzisa ifomu okungeyona ngesikhathi efaka isicelo somsebenzi. "Kunefomu okufanele iigcwaliswe abantu abasuke befaka izicelo zomsebenzi wezikhundla eziphezulu emkhandlwini. Esicelweni somsebenzi kuyavela ukuthi uMvelase wasebenzisa ifomu okungeyona. Kwakufanele sichithwe lapho isicelo sakhe."Ikhansela le-ANC, uMnuz Sphamandla Kheswa, lithe kubajabulisile ukuthi inkantolo imise ukuqokwa kukaMvelase."Ngiswele wona amaphiko, ngabe ngiyandiza. Kufanele lesi kube yisifundo emaqenjini aphethe omasipala. Ukuthi ninezihlalo eziningi emkhandlwini akusho ukuthi sekufanele nenze noma yini eniyithandayo."Usihlalo wekhokhasi ye-IFP emkhandlwini, uMnuz Xolani Msezane, uthe nakuba besihlonipha isinqumo senkantolo kodwa basamile ekutheni kwalandelwa yonke imigomo ngesikhathi kuqokwa uMvelase."Asimqashanga ehlathini. Kwavulwa uhlelo lokufakwa kwezicelo, kwahlungwa abazobizelwa kwinhlolokhono, kwase kuba nenhlolokhono. UMvelase uyena owathola amaphuzu amaningi."UMsezane usole amakhansela e-ANC ne-ABC ngokudlala ipolitiki."Amakhansela e-ANC nawe-ABC ayekhona emhlanganweni okwathathwa kuwo isinqumo sokuqoka uMvelase njengemenenja yomkhandlu. Kuyaxaka ukuthi sekuyibona futhi abafaka umkhandlu enkantolo. Bafuna ukubukwa nje."Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kweMeya, uMnuz Mcebo Mkhize, ayizange iphumelele njengoba ucingo lwayo belukhala lungabanjwa.
UKHOMISHANA wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, uveze ukuthi kukhona imali ebitholwa uNgqongqoshe wezamaPhoyisa omisiwe, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, kusomabhizinisi obhekene noxhaxha lwamacala, uMnuz Vusumuzi "Cat" Matlala.UMkhwanazi uthe imali esuka kuMatlala iye kuMchunu ibihanjiswa usomabhizinisi waseNorth West, uMnuz Suleman Karim.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi eqhubeka nokwethula ubufakazi phambi kwekhomishini eholwa yiJaji uMbuyiseli Madlanga, izolo.UMatlala wathola ithenda ka-R360 million emaphoyiseni, le thenda yabuye yahoxiswa. Njengamanje uMatlala ubhekene noxhaxha lwamacala okubalwa kuwo nelokuzama ukubulala isancinza sakhe.UMkhwanazi uthe banobufakazi obukhombisa ukuthi kukhona imali ebitholwa uMchunu kuMatlala."Kunophenyo esiluqhubayo ngalolu daba, yingakho ngingeke ngenabe kakhulu."UMkhwanazi utshele ikhomishini ukuthi uMatlala wazama ukunxenxa uMchunu ukuba avimbe ukuhoxiswa kwethenda yakhe emaphoyiseni."UMatlala wakhuluma noKarim ukuba ayomncengela kungqongqoshe ukuba ingahoxiswa ithenda. Wathuma uKarim ngoba azi ukuthi uyaxhumana nongqongqoshe. UKarim wavuma ukuthi uzokhuluma nongqongqoshe ngalolu daba."UMkhwanazi uthe uMatlala ungene wathi shi ezindabeni zamaphoyisa, wathi wayazi cishe yonke into eyenzeka emaphoyiseni.UMkhwanazi uthe uMatlala washo iPhini likaKhomishana wamaPhoyisa, uLieutenant General Shadrack Sibiya, lingakaqokelwa esikhundleni ukuthi kuzoqashwa lona."URafadi wathumelela uMatlala isikhangiso somsebenzi. UMatlala waphendula ngokuthi isikhundla sizotholwa uSibiya. Wakhuluma kanje kusakhishwe isikhangiso kuphela. Kuyakhathaza ukuthi umuntu osolwa emacaleni abe nolwazi olunje."UMkhwanazi uthe uMatlala wayazi ukusuka nokuhlala kwemizamo yokubopha uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa, uLieutenant General Fannie Masemola."Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi kwakukhona ukugxambukela kosomabhizinisi ekusebenzeni kwamaphoyisa njengoba abantu abangaphandle babenolwazi ngophenyo lwethimba Idac (Investigating Directorate Against Corruption)."UMkhwanazi uthe uMatlala wayekhombisa ukuyijabulela imibiko eyayithi uMasemola uzoboshwa maduze.UMkhwanazi uthe uMatlala waphendula ngokuthi isikhundla sikakhomishana wamaphoyisa sesizothathwa umuntu wakhe ngesikhathi ethunyelelwa umbiko owawuthi uMasemola uzoboshwa.UMkhwanazi uthe uMatlala ubephila kamnandi.Uthe isikhulu soMasipala waseKurhuleni, uBrigadier Julius Mkhwanazi, sabhalisa izimoto zikaMatlala ngaphansi komkhandlu, sazifaka ama-blue lights."Izimoto zamaphoyisa nezamaphoyisa emikhandlu ezivumeleke ukuba zifakwe ama-blue lights, kepha ezikaMatlala zazinawo. Nasejele lo muntu watholakala neselula."Ebufakazini bukaMkhwanazi, kuvele amagama amalungu ePhalamende amabili awasole ngokusebenzisa budedengu ulwazi lwezinhloli. UMkhwanazi usole ilungu le-DA, uNkk Dianne Kohler-Barnard, nelungu leNCC, uMnuz Fadiel Adams, ngokukhipha ulwazi lwezinhloli olubucayi.UMkhwanazi uthe lolu lwazi lwaluputshuzwe ngabantu ababefuna kuhlakazwe ithimba eliphenya ukubulawa kosopolitiki KwaZulu-Natal.UMkhwanazi uzoqhubeka nokwethula ubufakazi namhlanje.
ATHUKUTHELE ayaqhuma amatshitshi ayizifundiswa asola uMphathiswa wezobuCiko namaSiko KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Mntomuhle Khawula, ngokuvimba uhlelo lawo lokugqugquzela imfundo eMkhosini woMhlanga. Izintombi ezifunde zagogoda zithi ziyomkhohlwa zifile uKhawula ezithi waziphoxa kabuhlungu ngesikhathi ezivimba ukuba ziyokuma phambili, zigqugquzele imfundo kwezinye izintombi ngesikhathi kuqhubeka umkhosi esigodlweni eMashobeni.Izintombi ezinamajazi kwakuhlelwe ukuba zibe nohlelo lokugqugquzela imfundo ngeSonto ekuseni. Okhulumela iSilo, uMntwana uThulani Zulu, wayelumemezele lolu hlelo ukuthi luzokuba khona ngesikhathi ekhuluma kuwo uMkhosi woMhlanga, ngoMgqibelo. Izintombi ezikhulume neSolezwe, zithe zaphoxeka zaswela indawo yokucasha ngesikhathi uKhawula esezixosha namajazi azo phambi kwabantu. Induna yezintombi, uNksz Mningi Andile Zuma, ithe uKhawula wabaxosha kabuhlungu. "Wasitshela ukuthi umhlanga awuwona umkhosi wezifundiswa, wathi umkhosi wezintombi. Wakusho lokhu ekhuluma ngombhobho, kuzwa wonke umuntu."UNksz Zuma uthe babenikeziwe imvume yokwenza uhlelo, wathi zingaphezu kuka-30 izintombi ezajika namajazi."Okubuhlungu ukuthi la majazi sasiwatshelekile. Indlela esaphoxeka ngayo mina nje ngakhala usuku lonke. Angikwazanga ukuba ingxenye yomkhosi, ngahlala emotweni usuku lonke."Umdidiyeli wamatshitshi eMajuba Tvet College, uNksz Thandayiphi Mehlokayise Khulu, usole uKhawula ngokuthatha ngesinxele."Ngibona sengathi yonke le nto yathatheka ngesinxele. Kukhona ababuka sengathi kuzochonyelwa labo abangenazo iziqu. Iqiniso ukuthi kwakuzogqugquzelwa amatshitshi ukuba afunde. Sinenkolelo yokuthi ukuphumelela koyedwa kusho ukuphumelela kwethu sonke. Mina nje angikaqedi ukufunda kodwa ngangibize izintombi ezinhlanu esezifunde zagogoda ukuba zizokhuthaza abanye."UNksz Zinhle Kubheka uthe wavele wawushiya phansi umkhosi ngenxa yokuphoxekaUNksz Kubheka uthe kwakuzokuba ngcono ukuba uKhawula wababizela eceleni, ukunokuthi abaphoxe phambi kwabantu."Sazizwa sidelekile kakhulu, saphatheka kabuhlungu. Kube buhlungu ukuhlela into bese idicilelwa phansi. Okwasiphatha kabi ukuthi balubhidliza phambi kwabantu uhlelo lwethu. Ukube basibizela eceleni besitshele ukuze singaphoxeki."UNksz Thato Zondi uthe ukuhoxiswa kohlelo kwenza kubukeke sengathi eMkhosini woMhlanga kusuke kuyokhulunywa indaba yomendo kuphela."NgeSonto, kwagcina nje sekugqama indaba yezintombi ezazivalelisa, eseziyogana. Into enhle leyo uma sibona ezinye izintombi eseziyogana. Kodwa iqiniso ukuthi akusithina sonke esizokuba nenhlanhla yomendo. Ingakho sifuna kube nezinye izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izintombi. INdlunkulu inobuhlobo nabantu basemazweni aphesheya."Singasebenzisa lobo buhlobo ukuthuthukisa izintombi. Mhlawumbe kungagcina kunezintombi eziya kofunda noma ziyosebenza phesheya. EMkhosini woMhlanga singaqhamuka nohlelo lokwelekelela izintombi ukuba zifake izicelo zokufunda. Akufanele emhlangeni kugcine kukhulunywa ngokugana kuphela."UNksz Zondi uthe wayesuke nejazi lakhe eGoli, wafike waphoxeka uma sekubhuntsha uhlelo."Ngagibela ibhanoyi, ngashayela ibanga elide nejazi lami. Akukhona ukuthi ngangifuna ukuyobukwa kodwa inhloso ukugqugquzela abanye. Njengoba nje babemiswe phambili laba ababevalelisa, ngagqugquzeleka. Nathi ukuma kwethu phambili namajazi kwakuzogqugquzela abanye."Okhulumela uKhawula, uMnuz Ntando Mnyandu, ucele ukuba yonke imibuzo ibhekiswe kuMntwana uThulani.UMntwana uThulani uvumile impela ukuthi wamemezela ukuthi kuzokuba nalolu hlelo kepha wagcizelela ukuthi naye wayedlulisa umyalezo ayewunikiwe.UMntwana uThulani uthe uhlelo lokugqugquzela imfundo lwaqhamuka ngemizuzu yokugcina."UMkhosi woMhlanga uhlelelwa kusenesikhathi. Baphuza ukuyisho into yabo. Baqhamuka sebeyifaka ngewindi. Lona akulona uhlelo olubi, ukuthi nje baphazama ngokungalwethuli kusenesikhathi."
KUBHEKWE ukuthi aphendule ngakwenzile selokhu angena esikhundleni ngo-2021, amakhansela e-ANC azonikwa nomkhombandlela azowulandela njengoba kulungiselelwa ukhetho lohulumeni basekhaya, ngonyaka ozayo.Lo mkhombandlela uzokhishwa nguMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa namhlanje eGauteng njengoba ezobe ekhuluma namakhansela ale nhlangano.Imigomo azosebenza ngaphansi kwayo, uRamaphosa uyethule emhlanganweni oyisipesheli wezinsuku ezimbili wesigungu esiphezulu sale nhlangano, osongwe izolo. UNobhala Jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, uthe uhlelo abazoluthula namhlanje luzogxila ekufukuleni omasipala.Uthe le nhlangano inamakhansela angu-4 853 kuleli, wathi wonke azobe esemhlanganweni eGauteng, namhlanje."Siyinhlangano enkulu ezweni emelelekile kuzona zonke izindawo. URamaphosa uzokhipha umkhombandlela ngohlelo oluzolandelwa kanti amakhansela azobika ezinyangeni ezintathu," kusho uMbalula. Uthe bafuna uma kunezinselelo zivezwe ukuze intuthuko ifinyelele kubantu."Sibheka nendaba yenkinga yamanzi ebhekene nezwe. Siyibeke eqhulwini indaba yamanzi kuleli njengoba phambilini sasibeke ekagesi, egcine ilungisiwe." UMbalula uthe abanye babethi sisheshise indaba yokuqeda ukungacishwa kukagesi kuleli ngenxa yokuthi kwakuzoba nokhetho. Uveze ukuthi kodwa lokhu akulona iqiniso ngoba namanje le nkinga ibonakala ixazululeka.Evula lo mhlangano, uRamaphosa uxwayise ngokuthi amakhansela angasebenzi kumele asuswe ezikhundleni.Uthe bafuna ukugxila ezinkingeni ezibhekene nomasipala ukuze bazilungise."Amakhansela amaningi ayahluleka ukuxhumana ngendlela nomphakathi. Lokhu kwenza kube nemibhikisho, abantu bagxeke i-ANC." Uthe abantu basuke bebhikisha ngoba basuke bengenalo ulwazi olwenele ngezinselelo ezibhekene nomasipala."Kumele singahlonizi ukususa abantu esibajubile abenza izinto ezingafanele, nabazibandakanya enkohlakalweni. Asikwazi ukugcina abantu abantshontshela umphakathi. Abajutshiwe kumele baphendule uma bengawenzi umsebenzi wabo," kusho uRamaphosa.UMbalula uthe indaba yobugebengu nenkohlakalo iyabakhathaza bewubuholi obuphezulu benhlangano. Uthe sekuwumlando manje ukuthi kuzokwesekwa abantu be-ANC ababhekene nenkohlakalo."Uma kukhona abasaqhubeka nokweseka abantu ababekwe amacala enkohlalalo abahamba izinkantolo bedlubhe izinto zombutho, kumele sibhekane nabo. Sekuwumlando manje ukuthi sizokweseka abantu abakhohlakele kwi-ANC," kusho uMbalula.UMbalula uthe labo ababika inkohlakalo kuhulumeni kanjalo nakomasipala kumele bavikelwe ukuze bangabulawa."Inkohlakalo ayibikwe, bese labo abayibikayo bavikelwe yizinhlaka zomthetho. Lokho kuzokwenza ukuthi baqhubeke nokuyibika ngaphandle kokwesaba," kusho uMbalula.
KUGXEKWE izikhungo zemfundo ephakeme, ezisagoloza neziqu zezitshudeni ngenxa yokuthi zikweleta lezi zikhungo.Ezinye zalezi zikhungo kuthiwa azifuni ngisho ukukhipha izitatimende eziveza ukuthi leso sitshudeni siziphothulile iziqu ukuze sikwazi ukuyofuna umsebenzi.Lesi sikhalo sivezwe yilungu le-EFF ePhalamende uMnuz Sihle Lonzi, ngesikhathi kunomhlangano wekomiti lemfundo ephakeme izolo. Uthe kuyaxaka ukuthi namanje kusanezikhungo ezisaqhubeka nalo mkhuba ekubeni ngabe kunikwa izitshudeni izimfanelo zazo."Sikhathazekile ngokuthi lezi zikhungo zivimba izitshudeni ukuthi zithole umsebenzi. Kumele kube nomthetho wokuthi ziphoqwe ukuthi zikhiphe izimfanelo uma izitshudeni seziphothule iziqu, ukuze zithole umsebenzi," usho kanje.Usihlalo wekomiti, uMnuz Tebogo Letsie, uvumelene noLonzi, wathi kumele kube nemigomo ebekelwa izikhungo ukuze zidedele iziqu zabaphothule ukufunda. UDkt Nomusa Dube-Ncube, iPhini likaNgqongqoshe kulo mnyango, uvumelene noLonzi, wathi akumele abakweletayo babanjelwe imali.Uthe sebeke baba nezingxoxo nezikhungo zemfundo mayelana nokuthi kudedelwe izimfanelo zezitshudeni noma kuthiwa ziyakweleta."Sizazisile izikhungo ukuthi lo mkhuba wokubanjwa kweziqu uyaqhubeka, ekubeni zona ziveza ukuthi zikhipha izitatimende zemiphumela. Akumele izitshudeni zibanjelwe imiphumela ngisho noma kuthiwa ziyakweleta." Uthe kumele zinikwe ukuze zikwazi ukuthola umsebenzi."Kudingeka kushintshwe umthetho ngoba ezinye zezikhungo ziyisa umnyango enkantolo ngoba zikhala ngokuthi singena i kwezinye zezinto okungamele singene kuzona."ULetsie uthe lezi zikhungo zixhaswa ngemali enkulu ngumnyango kodwa ziyagoloza ukwenza ezinye zezinto. Okunye okukhalwe ngakho kulo mhlangano yindaba yokunyuswa kwemali yokufunda minyaka yonke ezikhungweni.UMqondisi jikelele womnyango, uDkt Nkosinathi Sishi, uthe minyaka yonke bahlale bekhipha umyalelo kulezi zikhungo ukuthi zicabange uma sezinyusa imali."Into esiyenzayo ngukuthi njalo ngoNovemba sikhipha umyalelo wokuthi okungenani imali inyuswe nge-CPI. Into lezi zikhungo eziyenzayo sezimane zisondeze usuku lokunquma ngokuthi imali inyuswa kangakanani singakawukhiphi umyalelo ukuze sithi uma sesiwukhipha kube sekudlule yonke into. Kudingeka kushintshwe umthetho ukuze uNgqongqoshe womnyango, abe nezwi lokugcina ngokunyuswa kwemali," kusho uSishi. Okuphinde kwakhalwa ngakho kulo mhlangano yindaba yokungabikwa ngendlela kwamacala athinta ukuhlukunyezwa kwezitshudeni ezikhungweni.ULetsie ukhale ngokuthi ezikhungweni eziningi siphezulu isibalo sezitshudeni ezihlukunyezwayo kodwa kungenzeki lutho."Siyadinga ukwazi ukuthi kwenzekani ngalawa macala ngoba abazali bathumela izingane zabo ezikhungweni zemfundo ukuthi ziphephe, hhayi ukuthi zidlwengulwe abanye babasebenzi. Sihlale sithola imibiko ngezitshudeni ezidlwengulwa abasebenzi ezikhungweni," kusho uLetsie.
UMNYANGO weMisebenzi yoMphakathi neNgqalasizinda KwaZulu-Natal usuqedile ukukhokha isikweletu sosonkontileka esilinganiselwa ku-R1 billion.Lokhu kuvele esitatimendeni abasithumelele abezindaba lapho umnyango oholwa nguMartin Meyer uqinisekisa ukuthi le mali isikhokhwe yaphela.Kwenzeka lokhu nje, kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi ike yaba yindaba egudwini eyokungakhokhelwa kosonkontileka. Ukuphothulwa kwalesi sikweletu kuye ngokwamagama enkehli njengoba uMeyer wakuveza phambilini ukuthi bazobhukula benze isiqiniseko sokuthi bayasikhokha basiqede.Ngokusho kwalesi sitatimende ukuphothulwa kokukhokwa kwale mali kuyinto efana ncamishi nokuqopheka komlando."Lokhu kuyaqala ngqa ukuthi kwenzeke kulo mnyango. Bekungakaze kwenzeke nhlobo kule minyaka eyedlule. Akekho noyedwa usonkontileka ongakhokhelwe imali yakhe njengamanje,'' kusho isitatimende.Siqhuba sithi imali ebikweletwa ibiyisithiyo esikhulu ikhinyabeza ukusebenza komnyango. "Lokhu bekungesiwona nje umthwalo emnyangweni kuphela kodwa nakubona osonkontileka ebese behluleka wukugcina izethembiso zabo ngenxa yokungakhokheleki,'' sisho kanjena.Siveza ukuthi inkokhelo yokugcina eyenziwe wumnyango ebiya kosonkontileka ilinganiselwa ku-R200 million."Lokhu kusho ukuthi osonkontileka sebezokwazi ukuqhubeka nomsebenzi wabo wokukhokhela abasebenzi baphinde bakhokhele namathuluzi,'' sisho kanjena.Ukuphothulwa kokukhokhwa kwale mali kwenzeke ngesikhathi esingangonyaka izintambo zokuhola umnyango zithathwe nguMeyer."Ngesikhathi engena kuleli hhovisi uMeyer enye yezinto ezaziseqhulwini kakhulu kwakungukuthi kube khona okwenziwayo ngenhloso yokuqeda izikweletu,'' kusho isitatimende.Umnyango utuse indlela enhle yokusebenzisana othi ibe khona phakathi kwawo nosonkontileka ebebekweletwa. Lesi sitatimende sithi uMeyer ubethulele isigqoko abanye babaholi bomnyango abasebenze ngokuzikhandla okukhulu ukuqinisekisa ukuthi lo msebenzi uyaphothulwa.Uncome indima eklanywe yisikhulu salo mnyango esisabambile, uDkt Vish Gover wancoma kakhulu ubuhlakani bakhe nokuthanda kwakhe umsebenzi.Umnyango uthi kube lula ukuthi kube khona ukuxoxisana phakathi kwawo nosonkontileka ngenxa yobudlelwane obuhle obukhona phakathi kwalezi zinhlaka. Kusuka manje kuya phambili lo mnyango uthi uzoqinisekisa ukuthi kusetshenziswana kahle futhi iyagwemeka inkinga yokungakhokhelwa ngesikhathi kosonkontileka.
SEKUQUBUKE omkhulu umsindo ngenxa yezinsolo ezenziwe yingxenye yezintombi nto ebezihambele uMkhosi woMhlanga wanonyaka, obusesigodleni eMashobeni, oPhongolo, lapho obekubuthene khona izinkulungwane zamatshitshi.Umsindo usuke ngoLuthando Dlamini, Precious Meyiwa, Bongiwe Ngubane noZiyanda Dlamini - amatshitshi abekade eseMkhosini woMhlanga, abemenywe ohlelweni loKhozi FM ntambama ngoMsombuluko, iWoza Nabangani bakho olwethulwa wuKhathide "Tshatha" Ngobe.Lezi zintokazi bezimenyelwe ukuzochaza ukuthi kuhambe kanjani kulo mcimbi ongeminye yethandwa kakhulu nesho lukhulu ebantwini bezinhlanga ezahlukene, ikakhulu amaZulu, njengoba ungenye yezindlela ezisetshenziswa ukugcina isiko lokuziphatha kahle ezintombini. La matshitshi akhale ngokuthi okuwaphathe kabi kulo mkhosi wukuthi bekunezintombi, ezingaziwa ukuthi zihlolwa kuphi futhi angakaze azibona ndawo uma kusuke kuhlangenwe lapho okuhlolwa izintombi khona - ezifike kulo mcimbi zihamba ngonyanyavu lwezimoto zamasoka azo okubalwa kuzona ama-V Class, okuthiwa bekubukwa zona zehla zenyuka ngazo esigodlweni.Zikhale ngokuthi izenzo salezo zintokazi ziwaphathe kabi kakhulu ngenxa yokuthi sicekela phansi isithunzi salo mkhosi, nanokuthi ukuzenza kwaso amatshitshi ekubeni kube kwaziwa kahle ukuthi aziseziwona kuphazamise izintombi nto ebezize kulo mcimbi ngenhloso enhle, nezingabange zisawuthola umhlanga ngoba usuhlwithwe kuqala yilabo abangasewona amatshitshi.Inkulumo yalezi zintombi isuse omkhulu umsindo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, kwaze kwavela igama lentokazi edume ezinkundleni zokuxhumana uSnow Zulu, owaziwa ngokuthanda imicimbi yezesintu novame ukufaka izithombe zakhe evunile njengetshitshi.Kuthiwa le ntokazi engomunye walawo mantombazane okusolwa ukuthi avumbuka eMhlangeni kuphela, okuvela ukuthi ifike emcimbini ihamba ngonyanyavu lwemoto yesoka layo. Kanti futhi kweminye yemibhalo esabalale ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, kuvele ukuthi le ntokazi iziphendulele kulezi zinsolo yathi: "Umona yifa lezinja. Ukube impumelelo siyicela komama benu ngabe kade safa ngoba phela omama benu bazi imithi.”
IBHUNTSHILE imizamo kaSiya Mhlongo (42) yokuba iNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini, ingabemukeli ubufakazi bommangali ngoba "buntekenteke futhi bungesebenziseke enkantolo".Le mizamo kaMhlongo kumane kwafana nokuthi ubemane ethela amanzi emhlane wedada njengoba inkantolo isiphikisile isicelo abesifakile.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi ngeledlule, abameli bakaMhlongo bafaka isicelo kule nkantolo sokuba kubuyekezwe ubufakazi obethulwa ummangali njengoba bakhala ngokuthi buntekenteke futhi buyaphambana.Lo msakazi ongaphandle ngesexwayiso ubhekene necala lokushaya alimaze kabi uMnuz Njabulo Duma (29) okuthiwa wayeyisinqandamathe sakhe. Lesi sigameko kuthiwa senzeka eThekwini ebusuku bango -Agasti 31, 2024.Abameli bakaMhlongo okunguMnuz Sikhumbuzo Mathabela obuye abe ngumfundisi odumile eThekwini no-Advocate Simphiwe Mlotshwa benza izethulo behlaba behlikiza ubufakazi bukammangali. Baveza ukuthi kunamaphuzu ebufakazini bommangali ababona kehle nje ukuthi awanasisekelo.Bakhala ngokuthi kukhona lapho ummangali owathi khona akazange ambone uSiya emjikijela ngebhodlela ngoba wayesabheke phansi wezwa ngalo selimshaya. Bathi kuyona le nkantolo waphinde wathi wambona uSiya emjikijela ngebhodlela. Okunye abakhala ngakho abameli bakaSiya ukuthi kungani inkantolo ithembe ubufakazi obethulwa umuntu okwenzeka isigameko ecwile kwizinkamba zikaFaro.Bakhala ngokuthi lobu ubufakazi okungelula ukuthi kungamiwa ngonyawo olulodwa kuthiwe ngempela buyiqiniso. Bakhale nangokuthi ummangali wathi waklinywa ekubeni udokotela owamhlola, wafika enkantolo wathi zazingekho izimpawu zokuthi ngampela waklinywa.Izolo, imantshi uMnuz Mhlonipheni Sibiya ikhiphe isinqumo esimchithile uSiya nabameli bakhe. Imantshi ithe ubufakazi obuphambi kwayo abukho ntekenteke ngale ndlela abachaza ngayo. Ithe ubufakazi enabo bungasetshenziswa yile nkantolo.Uveze ukuthi inkantolo yemantshi ingahoxisa kuphela ubufakazi bommangali uma kubonakala ngampela ukuthi kwabenele futhi kabuwenzi umqondo. ''Kodwa kulokhu akunjalo, sikhuluma ngento ehlukile elapha phambi kwami nani futhi ephambi kwethu,'' kusho imantshi.Ngemuva kwalesi sinqumo, imantshi inikeze uMhlongo nabameli bakhe ithuba lokuba baphumele phandle bacabange ngesinyathelo abazosithatha ngemuva kwalesi sinqumo.Nebala uMhlongo nabameli bakhe baphumele emnyango. Babuye ngemuva kwesikhathi esingangemizuzu eyishumi. Ibibonakala ebusweni indumalo kuMhlongo ngemuva kwesinqumo senkantolo. Kwenzeka konke elokhu nje, kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi omele uMbuso, uMnuz Ntshalintshali, wayesiphikisile lesi sicelo.Wathi akumele inkantolo ilalele udaba lokuthi ummangali kwakungelula ukuba akhumbule konke ngoba wayekade ephuzile ngesikhathi sesigameko.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi uMhlongo uyena owazicelela ukuba Ukhozi FM lummise kancane nokwagcina sekuholela ekutheni angabe esabuyiswa uma sekwenziwa izinguquko zango-Ephreli. Icala liyaqhubeka.
UTHI uyaliphika icala lokushaya ngenhloso yokulimaza abekwe lona uMbuso owayengumsakazi woKhozi FM, uSiya Mhlongo. Ubenikezwe yiNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini, kuleli sonto, ithuba okokuqala ngqa ukuba ethule obakhe ubufakazi ngesigameko.UMhlongo ubhekene necala lokushaya ngenhloso yokulimaza owesilisa ayethandana naye, uMnuz Njabulo Duma ngo-Agasti 31, 2024, eThekwini. Ugibele ebhokisini lofakazi weluswa ngemibuzo ngummeli wakhe, u-Advocate Simphiwe Mlotshwa."Ngiyawaphika amacala Nkosi yeNkantolo,'' kusho uMhlongo ekhuluma ngokukhulu ukuzethemba.Uvumile ukuthi ubemazi kakhulu ummangali, wamchaza kanje: "Sahlangana ngoJanuwari 27, 2020, saba nobuhlobo bokuthandana ngemuva kwezinyanga ezimbili. Saphinde sahlukana ngoFebhuwari 2021.'' Ecelwa ukuba achaze ngobudlelwano bakhe nalo wesilisa ngesikhathi sesigameko uthe: "Ngesikhathi kwenzeka isigameko sasingabantu abathandanayo kodwa sisavumelene ngokuthi ubudlelwano singabugxilisi."Uthe ngosuku lwesigameko bahlangana ngaphandle kwasemsakazweni Ukhozi FM emgwaqweni u-KE Masinga ngabo-1 emini.''Saqala saya eMngeni esitolo esidayisa iziphuzo zokucima ukoma. Sadlulela eLa Lucia Mall, sase siya eGlen Ashley, lapho sasimenywe khona," usho kanjena.Eqhuba uthe: "Safika ntambama sekuyoshaya ihora lesine lapho sasimenywe khona. Sahlala amahora angu-7 kuya kwangu-8. Sahlala naye saphinde sahamba naye sisuka eMhlanga saya eZai, kuFlorida."Uthe ngaphambi kwalokho, babeqale baphuza utshwala iwayini elibovu. Kwathi nommangali waphuza iwayini elobomvu ne-Savanna. Uthe ummangali uyena owayeshayela imoto ababetetemuka ngayo ngalelo langa.Uthe bafika eZai ngezithuba zawo-12 ebusuku. Uthe bahlala khona amahora amabili nje kuphela. Basuka eZai lisanda kugamanxa ihora lesibili ezintatha. Uthe sebesuka eZa, nguyena owabe eseshayela."EZai ngaphuza isiphuzo esisodwa izingilazi ezimbili zikagologo ijudwe nokuthule. Ayengasekho amatafula okuhlala ngesikhathi sifika eZai, sathatha isinqumo sokuthi sothenga ibhodlela likagologo 'njengomngenandlini' ukuze bezosamukela labo esizobajoyina etafuleni,'' echaza.Uthe ummangali waphuza ugologo, wadlulela etafuleni labantu besifazane waphuza iwayini."Emva kwalokho, wase engihlebela ukuthi usezobiza amaSavanna lawa awaqale ukuwaphuza emcimbini,'' echaza.Eqhuba uMhlongo uthe: "Wayehlezi nami ummangali ngesikhathi kusuka imoto sisuka eZai. Wayehlezi phambili eduze kwami. Wafika esihlalweni wasihlehlisa wahlala sakulala. Yayisivele isiqalile impikiswano ngesikathi sisuka eZai.''Ephawula ngomnyombo wengxabano, uthe kwakumaqondana nokuteketisana phakathi kwakhe nomunye wesilisa owabajoyina etafuleni sebezohamba."Sixabana emotweni, kwaba nesiphakamiso sokuthi siyimise imoto khona sizokhuluma siyiqede inkulumo. Ngaqale ngamphikisa ngagcina sengivuma. Inkinga kwakusendaweni emnyama. Amalambu akuloya mgwaqo ayecimile ngaze ngamtshela ukuthi lana afune sime khona kuyindawo ebonakala ingaba nobungozi obukhulu kithina,'' echaza.Uthe wagcina esevuma ngoba ummangali wayengamnike thuba."Akubanga yisikhathi esingakanani ngabona amalambu emoto eyayisondela izoma ngemuva kwethu. Ngambuza ummangali ukuthi ufuna sime lana ngoba efuna abantu bezongiphuca imoto na? Ngaso leso sikhathi kwaqhamuka amadoda amabili avula izicabha,'' esho.Uthe kwaqale kwavuleka esakhe isicabha."Ngithe ngisazama ukuvimba esami kanti sesiyavuleka nalesi sikammangali. Kuthe kusenjalo, ngabona ukuthi okumqoka ukuba ngivikele ummangali. Umcabango wokuqala ngathatha ibhodlela elalihlezi lapho okubekwa khona isiphuzo sakhe. Ngalijikijikela ngenhloso yokunemba lo engangicabanga ukuthi uyisigelekeqe,'' usho kanjena.Uthe waqaphela ukuthi lo obevula isicabha ngakummangali ugijime wazolekelela lo obevula isicabha ngakuyena base bayamdonsa waphumela ngaphandle. Bengishaya ngezibhakela nangezinyawo bengikhahlela. Imoto bagcina beyithatha. Yagcina itholakala esigangeni eMlaza - amaphoyisa ayithatha ayiyisa esiteshini iBhekithemba,'' echaza.Uthe wabe esevula icala lokudunwa imoto. Icala walivula ngoSepthemba 1, 2024, kuyiSonto, wathi bathatha i-laptop, izibuko zelanga, ijakhethi enkulu yamakhaza, isikhwama sami somsebenzi engisebenza ngaso uma ngiya emsakazweni, iwashi lami nokunye okuningi.Ebuzwa ukuthi wamgcina nini ummangali, uthe ngosuku lwesigameko wabe esezama ukumshayela ucingo lwaqale lwangena kodwa lwagcina lungasangeni.''Ngabe sengicela umama ongizalayo ukuba azame ukungibhekela yena,'' echaza.Uthe wagcina ukumbona endaweni yesigameko ehamba kahle engagijimi. Ngagcina ngibona izithunzi angibange ngisambona ukuthi yena uphelelephi ngoba wayesehamba ngezinyawo.Uthe kungamampunge ukuthi wamshaya ummangali waphinde wamklinya. Uthe akakaze akhulume nomphenyi mayelana necala lokudunwa kwemoto ngoba imoto ahamba ngayo ayikho egameli lakhe, isegameni lomhlobo wakhe. Icala lihlehliselwe u-Okthoba 6 no-7.
LUTHE luvulwa izolo uhlelo lokufakwa kwezicelo zoxhaso esikhwameni iNational Students' Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS), kwafakwa izicelo ezibalelwa ku-17 000 zangonyaka ozayo. Kulezi zicelo ezibalelwa ku-15 000, zivela kulabo abathola izibonelelo zakwaSassa.Abesilisa bangu-5 000 abafake izicelo, abesifazane babalelwa ku-12 000.Lezi zibalo zivezwe yibamba lesikhulu esiphezulu seNSFAS, uMnuz Waseem Carrim, njengoba bekuthulwa lolu hlelo lokufaka izicelo zangonyaka ozayo ePitoli."Ezicelweni esizitholile sizobhekisisa olunye ulwazi noMnyango wezaseKhaya. Labo abahola isibonelelo bona nakanjani bazoluthola uxhaso ngoba bavela emindenini ehlwempu," usho kanje. Unxuse abafuna uxhaso ukuthi basheshe bafake izicelo zoxhaso ukuze basheshe bathole izimpendulo.UDkt Nomusa Dube-Ncube oyiPhini likaNgqongqoshe eMnyangweni weMfundo ePhakeme - othule lolu hlelo - uthe kugcinwa ngoNovemba 15, 2025, ukwamukelwa kwezicelo.Uthe bafuna ukuthi lezi zicelo zisheshe zifakwe ukuze kutholakale izimpendulo ngokushesha."Asifuni ukuthi abafuna uxhaso bayeke kuze kube umzuzu wokugcina. Yingakho sisheshe saluvula uhlelo ukuze basheshe bafake izicelo," usho kanje. Uthe njengoba lolu hlelo beluthulwa, bazibonele izinselelo ezibhekana nabafaka izicelo njengoba kusetshenziswa ubuchwepheshe."Sifuna ukubona lapho kunezinselelo khona ukuze sikwazi ukusheshe sizilungise. Izicelo zifakwa ku-myNSFAS portal kusetshenziswa i-internet. Abafake izicelo bazokwazi ukuthola ulwazi lwezinto ezidingekayo uma sebefake izicelo."Okunye ngukuthi bazokwazi ukubona ukuthi isicelo sabo sesikusiphi isigaba. Abafaka izicelo kulesi sikhwama bahlale bekhala ngokuthi abazazi izicelo zabo ukuthi zibhajwaphi njengoba abanye kuze kuphele nekota yokuqala beqalile ukufunda bengazi noma bayaluthola uxhaso noma abalutholi.I-NSFAS iveze ukuthi isebenzisana nezinye izinhlaka okubalwa neminyango kahulumeni okubalwa nomqoqi wentela, ukubheka labo abakokotela ulwazi uma befaka izicelo.Okunye okuvelile ngukuthi abakude namadolobha noma abangenayo i-internet bangaya emahhovisi eNYDA ukuze basizakale ngokufaka izicelo."Sinxusa omasipala, umphakathi, imitapo yolwazi nabama-internet cafe ukuthi basize abafaka izicelo zoxhaso. Ngaleyo ndlela kuzobalula ukuthi izicelo zabo zisheshe zifike," kusho uCarrim. UNgqongqoshe weMfundo ePhakeme, uMnuz Buti Manamela, ekhuluma ngamalungiselelo angonyaka ozayo ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme, uthe ngeke silulwe isikhathi sokufaka izicelo ngoba bafuna ukusheshe bakhiphe izimpendulo.
KUNENHLANSI yethemba ngezitshudeni ezevile ku-40 000 ebezingalutholanga uxhaso esikhwameni iNational Student Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS), njengoba sezizoxhaswa.Lokhu kulandela ukuthi lesi sikhwama kanjalo noMnyango weMfundo ePhakeme, bethathe imali kwezinye izinhlelo ukuze kuxhaswe lezi zitshudeni.Lesi sikhwama sibe nenkinga yokushodelwa yimali ngenxa yokwanda kwabafuna ukuxhaswa. Isitatimende esikhishwe yilesi sikhwama izolo, siveze ukuthi kuno-R13.3 billion, otholakele ukuze kwesekwe izitshudeni ezingu-49 000."Kule mali kuzoxhaswa izitshudeni ezingu-34 000, ebezingakwazi ukubhalisa kanjalo nezinye ezingu-15 000, ebezibhalisele ikota yesibili yonyaka. Ukwanda kwabafuna uxhaso kwenze sangakwazi ukuxhasa zonke izitshudeni," kusho iNSFAS.Ithe ukwehla kwemali ehlinzekwa nguhulumeni ngenye yezingqinamba ezenze ukuthi bangakwazi ukuxhasa abebedinga uxhaso. "Izitshudeni ezisenkingeni ezasemanyuvesi, ezafaka izicelo ngesikhathi kubhalisa abasemakolishi amakhono ama-TVET. Ezinye ezabhalisa ngemuva kokuvalwa kwesikhathi sokufaka izicelo. Elinye iqoqo yizitshudeni ezazifake izikhalo zokuthi kubuyekezwe isinqumo sokungaxhaswa, okwathi uma sekubhekwa kwatholakala ukuthi bekumele zixhaswe." I-NSFAS ithe bazokhokhelwa nomastende abebengakhokhelwe ngenxa yokuthi izitshudeni bezingakalutholi uxhaso."Sifuna kube nozinzo emkhakheni wemfundo ephakeme kulo nyaka. Kusadingeka ukuthi kube noxhaso oluthe xaxa ukuze sixhase abadinga usizo." I-NSFAS ibonge izinhlaka ezehlukene ezikwazi ukubekezela njengoba kunenselelo emalini.UNgqongqoshe weMfundo ePhakeme, uMnuz Buti Manamela, uke wayiveza eyokuthi siyanda isibalo sabadinga ukuxhaswa ngemali yokufunda.Ubalule izinselelo ezibhekene nesabelomali kanjalo nokwenyuka kwezinga lempilo njengezinye izingqinamba ezenza ukuthi bangakwazi ukuxhasa bonke abadinga usizo.Yingakho kunxuswe abafuna ukuxhaswa ngonyaka ozayo ikakhulu abaku-matric ukuthi basheshe bafake izicelo zoxhaso kwiNSFAS njengoba ngoNovemba kuvalwa lolu hlelo.
KUPHENYWA abahola izibonelelo zakwaSassa abangaphezu kuka-220 000 KwaZulu-Natal, ukuthi abaphinde bathole imali engxenye njengoba behola lezi zibonelelo.Lolu phenyo lwenziwa yiSassa ebabheka ngisho kwa-credit bureau, ukuthi isimo sabo asishintshile selokhu baqala ukuhola izibonelelo.Lokhu kudalulwe yisikhulu esibhekele izibonelelo kwaSassa ,uMnuz Brenton van Vrede, ngesikhathi ethula umbiko ekomitini lasePhalamende."Ngokwezibalo kuzwelonke, bangu-396 424 abaphenywayo abahola izibonelelo kanti laba sibabheka ngisho kwa-credit bureau. I-KZN yisona sifundazwe esinesibalo esikhulu kwesibaphenyayo ngabangu-226 937. Siphenya ngoba uthola ukuthi umuntu ufike asho okunye kwaSassa, bese umbona esene-akhawunti yasesitolo noma sekuvela ukuthi unezikweletu ekubeni ethola isibonelelo," usho kanje. Uthe kwa-credit bureau banalo lonke ulwazi abaludingayo ngomuntu kanjalo nezikweletu anazo."Uma sithola ukuthi wakokotela ulwazi ngesikhathi efaka isicelo kwaSassa, sibe sesisihoxisa isibonelelo. Abantu abalethe ulwazi oluyiyo uma befaka izicelo kwaSassa." Uveze ukuthi abagcini ngokubheka ulwazi kwa-credit bureau kodwa nakwezinye izinhlaka okubalwa uphiko oluqoqa intela kuleli iSARS, isikhwama esixhasa ngemali yokufunda ezikhungweni zemfundo iNSFAS, isikhwama sezimpesheni sabasebenzi bahulumeni, kanjalo nezinye izindawo."Lokhu sikwenza ngoba sifuna ukuthola ukuthi abahola izibonelelo abaphindi yini uthole ukuthi bayasebenza. Asifuni kube nabaqola imali kahulumeni." Kulo mhlangano kuvele nokuthi isibonelelo sabangatohozi sabelwe u-R34.9 billion kulo nyaka mali u-2025/2026. Le mali ihlinzekwe kuze kube uMashi 2026.UMnuz Themba Matlou oyisikhulu esiphezulu seSassa, uthe bathola izicelo ezibalelwa ku-18 million, zabafuna ukuhola lesi sibonelo sabangatohozi."Sigcine sigunyaze abangu-7.2 million kuleli. Isibalo esiphezulu sabahola lesi sibonelelo yiseKZN ngabangu-1.7 million. Kulandela iGauteng ngabangu-1.2 million, endaweni yesithathu yisifundazwe i-Eastern Cape ngabangu-970 547," usho kanje. Amalungu ekomiti akhale nangemali eyachithwa yizikhulu zomnyango ezazithamele umhlangano we-United Nations eMelika. Kulo mhlangano okwakuhambe izikhulu eziyisikhombisa, kwasetshenziswa u-R3 million.Usihlalo wekomiti i-Appropriations, uDkt Mmusi Maimane, ukhale ngokuthi inkulu kakhulu le mali eyasebenza.Ubuze ukuthi sasikuphi isidingo sokuthi kuhambe abantu abayisikhombisa ngoba sasingehliswa isibalo?"Uma ubala imali eyasebenza, ibalelwa ku-R400 000 umuntu ngamunye. Le mali yayingasetshenziswa ukukhokha izibonelelo."Umqondisi jikelele eMnyangweni wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi, uMnuz Peter Netshipale, uthe kwakunesidingo sokuthi lezi zikhulu zithamele lo mhlangano ngoba wawukhuluma ngeqhaza labesifazane kanjalo namantombazane.
I-FNB kanye ne-Visa sebeqedile ukukhipha ubuchwepheshe bokukhokha ngohlelo lwesimanje lwe-tap-and-go kuama-toll gate athile ngaphambi kwamaholide kaDisemba.Abashayeli bezimoto ema-toll plaza aku-N3, TRAC N4 kanye nemigwaqo ekhokhelwayo e-Chapman’s Peak (eKapa) sebeyakwazi ukusebenzisa izindlela zokukhokha ezihlukene ngaphandle kokukhipha imali.Imizila engaphezu kwama-88 ku-N3 phakathi kweGauteng neKwaZulu-Natal, e-De Hoek, eWilge, eTugela naseMooi River plaza, kanye nezindlela ezehlukene ezixhuma kulo thela-wayeka.Kweminye imizila engu-73 asefakiwe amatheminali okukhokha ngohlelo lwesimanje emzileni okhokhelwayo kuN4 phakathi kwePitoli neMozambique, eDiamond Hill, Middelburg, Machado kanye neNkomazi plaza, kanye nasemajikeni angena naphuma kulo thela-wayeka.Lolu hlelo luzosiza abashayeli bezimoto abasebenzisa ama-toll plaza ukuba basebenzise izindlela ezahlukene zokukhokha ngama-debit nama-credit card (i-Europay, Mastercard, Visa); izinhlelo zokukhokha ezifana ne-Apple Pay, i-Samsung Pay ne-Google Pay; kanye nabasebenzisa amawashi eGarmin, Fitbit, Samsung, Apple nabanye; kanye nezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza ezivunyelwe ukuthepha ezivumela ukusetshenziswa kwamakhadi asebhange akhishwe eNingizimu Afrika.Amakhadi akwamanye amazwe nawo asezokwamukelwa kuma-toll plaza aseNingizimu Afrika.Amakhadi e-Magstripe, adinga ukuthi ikhadi lokukhokha liswayitshwe ngokoqobo futhi akhishwa, ngeke esamukelwa ezindaweni ezingama-tap and go kusukela ngomhlaka-1 Disemba. I-South African National Roads Agency kanye nezinye izinhlaka ezibhekelele ukusebenza kwemigwaqo emikhulu bazoqhubeka nokwamukela izinkokhelo ze-magstripe kuze kube nguMeyi 31, ngonyaka ozayo, kweminye imizila.Amakhadi e-Fleet negaraji magstripe asengasetshenziswa kuze kube umhla zingama-30 kuJuni 2026.Ngokusho kwe-Organisation Undoing Tax Abuse (OUTA), ukuqalwa kohlelo lwe-tap-to-pay isinyathelo esihle esizokwenza ukukhokhelwa kwe-toll kusheshe, kuphephe, futhi kube lula kubashayeli."Lo msebenzi ngokusobala uzosatshalaliswa ku-Q4 kuma-toll booths asetshenziswa yi-Bakwena (N1,N4). Sikholwa ukuthi ubalulele kakhulu njengoba uthuthukisa indlela yokusebenza," kusho uStefanie Fick, uMqondisi Omkhulu we-Accountability Division."Nakanjani lokhu kulungele abashayeli njengoba kuveza izindlela eziningi ezahlukene zokukhokha ngamakhadi namadivayisi esimanje, kanye nezinkokhelo ezidijithali ezifana ne-Apple, i-Google, i-Samsung ne-Garmin. Kwenza kusheshe futhi kuqinisekisa ukuphepha kubashayeli."

WONKE amehlo athe njo kumculi waseMzumbe, uMalibongwe "Mjolisi" Gwala njengoba kunguye ohlonishwe ngehora elikhethekile kwi-5th Ugu Maskandi Festival, e-Ugu Sport and Leisure, eGamalakhe, ngoSepthemba 27 kusukela ngo-1 emini. UKHOMISHANA wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, uhlabe wahlikiza isinqumo sikaNgqongqoshe wezamaPhoyisa omisiwe, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, sokukhipha umyalelo wokuba kuhlakazwe ithimba eliphenya amacala okubulawa kosopolitiki eKZN.UMkhwanazi uthe uMchunu akanawo amandla okuhlakaza ithimba. Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ethula ubufakazi phambi kwekhomishini eholwa yiJaji uMbuyiseli Madlanga.UMkhwanazi uthe umuntu onamandla okuhlakaza ithimba uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa kuzwelonke, uLieutenant General Fannie Masemola."Ungqongqoshe akanawo amandla okuhlakaza ithimba lamaphoyisa. Ungqongqoshe akangeni ezintweni ezithinta ukusebenza kwamaphoyisa. Yena okwakhe ukubhekana nezinto ezithinta imigomo. UMasemola uyena owasayina ukuba kuqale ukusebenza kwethimba. Ungqongqoshe akakwazi ukuthatha isinqumo eyedwa ukuba kuhlakazwe ithimba. Ngesikhathi ithimba lisungulwa, kwakuhlangene ongqongqoshe beminyango ehlukene. Kwakufanele kuhlangane ongqongqoshe abathintekayo bese besitshela ukuthi akuhlakazwe ithimba." UMkhwanazi uthe kwammangaza ukubona incwadi kaMchunu eyalela ukuthi kuhlakazwe ithimba ngenxa yokuthi ithimba lalenza umsebenzi oncomekayo."Kwakude kwabiwe imali yokuthi ithimba lisebenze kuze kube ukuphela konyakamali. Kuyamangaza ke ukuthi umyalelo wokuba ithimba lihlakazwe waqhamuka ngoJanuwari, maphakathi nonyakamali. Okumangazayo ukuthi ithimba lenza umsebenzi oncomekayo. Ikomiti lase licelwa nokuthi liyokwelekelela kwezinye izifundazwe ezinjengo-Eastern Cape ngenxa yomsebenzi omuhle elaliwenza."UMkhwanazi uthe kwamphula umoya ukubona umyalelo othi akuhlazwe ithimba. Uthe wazama ukuxoxa noMchunu ngalolu daba kodwa wangaphumelela."Ngamthumela umyalezo ngoWhatsApp, wathi uzongitshela ukuthi sizobonana nini. Kuze kube namhlanje ngisalindile."UMkhwanazi uthe waze wacela uMasemola ukuba ahlele umhlangano noMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, lapho okwakuzokhulunywa khona ngomyalelo wokuhlakazwa kwethimba."URamaphosa uyena owakhipha umyalelo wokuba kusungulwe ithimba. Ngangifuna ukuba sizwe umbono wakhe ngalolu daba."UMkhwanazi uthe usamile ekutheni uMchunu wakhipha umyalelo wokuba ithimba lihlakazwe ngenxa yokuthi lafike labopha izigebengu ezisondelene naye ngesikhathi licelwe ukuba liyolekelela eGauteng. Emva kwalokho, kwashushumbiswa amadokodo angu-121, ayiswa ekomkhulu lamaphoyisa ePitoli.UMkhwanazi uthe banabo ubufakazi bokuthi uMchunu usondelene nezigebengu."Obunye balobu fakazi angeke ngikwazi ukubuveza lapha ngoba kunophenyo oluqhubekayo. Mhlawumbe lobo bufakazi singabuveza esithe."UMkhwanazi uthe ukujutshwa kwamalungu ethimba eGauteng kwafike kwaholela ekuhlakazekeni kwesidleke sezigebengu.UMkhwanazi uthe amalungu ethimba aholela ekuboshweni kukaMnuz Vusumuzi "Cat" Matlala, noMnuz Katiso "KT" Molefe, athe bathinteka emacaleni abucayi."Ngiyaziqhenya ngokuthi ngathumela amalungu ethimba ukuba ayolekelela eGauteng. Ukuthumela amalungu ethimba kwaholela ekuboshweni kukaMolefe noMatlala. Njengamanje uMolefe noMatlala babhadle ejele futhi bazothola izigwebo eziqinile uma begcina belahlwa amacala ababhekene nawo."UMkhwanazi uthe kuzokuba kwampunz'edla emini kuleli lizwe uma zingasukunyelwa izinsolo azenzile."Sekunesikhathi eside kunemizamo yokuphazamisa ukusebenza kwezinhlaka zokuphepha nezobulungiswa. Uma kuqhubeka kanje zizogcina zingasasebenzi ezokuphepha nezobulungiswa. Izigebengu zizochanasa."UMkhwanazi uzoqhubeka nokwethula ubufakazi namhlanje.
BENGAZITHOLA bebhadla ejele abazozama ukuphazamisa ikhomishini ephenya izinsolo ezenziwa uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi.Ohola ubufakazi kule khomishini, u-Advocate Terry Motau, uthe abazozama ukuphazamisa ikhomishini bengazithola beboshwa noma behlawuliswa kanzima. Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi kuqala ukulalelwa kobufakazi izolo. UMotau uthe isigwebo sokuphazamisa ukusebenza kwekhomishini izinyanga eziyisithupha ubhadla ejele noma kube inhlawulo."Isigaba sesihlanu semithetho elawula amakhomishini sikubeka kucace ukuthi kuyicala elibomvu ukuphazamisa ukusebenza kwekhomishini. Umthetho ukubeka kucace ukuthi noma ubani ophazamisa ukusebenza kwekhomishini wenza icala. Ngithi angiligcizelele leli phuzu ngoba kubalulekile ukuba kungabi khona abantu abaphazamisa ukusebenza kwekhomishini. Uphenyo lwekhomishini kufanele luqhubeke ngaphandle kokuphazanyiswa."Ngaphandle kwalapho kuqhubeka khona ikhomishini, amalungu eMK abebhikisha. Amalungu eMK ayaphikisana nekhomishini eholwa yiJaji uMbuyiseli Madlanga.Namhlanje kuzolalelwa isicelo seMK eNkantolo eNkulu ePitoli, lapho ifuna ukuthi kuchithwe ikhomishini. Okhulumela iMK eGauteng, uMnuz Abel Tau, uthe bekungafanele ikhomishini iqale ukulalela ofakazi ekubeni singakaphumi isinqumo esicelweni sabo esiphonsela inselelo ukusungulwa kwekhomishini. "UMadlanga nabo bonke abayingxenye yekhomishini bebazi ukuthi kunecala esilifakile elizolalelwa kusasa (namhlanje). Bakhethe ukuqhubeka nekhomishini yize bazi ukuthi asihambisani nayo. Kusobala ukuthi badlala ipolitiki."Ikhomishini iqale ukulalela ofakazi izolo.UMkhwanazi uyena oqale ukwethula ubufakazi lapho echaze kabanzi ngezinsolo zakhe zokuthi kunezigebengu ezisondelene nosopolitiki eziphazamisa ukusebenza kwamaphoyisa.UMkhwanazi uzoqhubeka nokwethula ubufakazi namhlanje.
SIYAQHUBEKA nokushuba isimo phakathi kwe-ANC neSACP njengoba amaKhomanisi ethi ngeke ancetheze kuKhongolose njengoba ebizwa ngawo wonke amagama kumadlelandawonye.Lokhu kushiwo uNobhala jikelele weSACP, uMnuz Solly Mapaila, othe bahlale begxekwa selokhu bamemezela ukuthi bazongenela ukhetho ngokuzimela."Siyalingana singamadlelandawonye. Ngeke sincetheze kuKhongolose ngoba sekuphele iminyaka siwa sivuka nawo. Sekuphele iminyaka engu-70 seseka i-ANC, sifuna ukulingana," kusho uMapaila ethula inkulumo emhlanganweni weCosatu eGoli. Uthe abashintshi ekutheni bangenela ukhetho ngokuzimela ngoba ziningi izinto i-ANC ezishaya indiva, engazilungisi.Uveze ukuthi abazi nokuthi i-ANC iwuthathaphi umkhombandlela wokusebenza ne-DA ngoba sekuphele iminyaka bengahlangani nale nhlangano."Sihlale sikhala ngokuthi asihlangani singamadlelandawonye. Sekuphele cishe iminyaka engu-10 singahlangani ukuze kulungiswe indaba yokubuyekezwa kwamadlelandawonye." UMapaila uthe i-ANC iyaqhubeka nokungabahloniphi njengoba ingazange ibabize emhlanganweni wokunika umkhombandlela wokusebenza kwamakhansela obuseGoli."I-ANC iyaqhubeka nokungawahlonipha amadlelandawonye. Asimenywanga emhlanganweni wamakhansela e-ANC, ngicabanga ukuthi neCosatu ayizange imenywe," kusho uMapaila.Uthe akumele iCosatu ihlukane phakathi ngokuthi izokweseka bani okhethweni."Asikhathazekile ngokuthi iCosatu izokweseka bani okhethweni oluzayo. Asiphoqi ukuthi iCosatu iseseke kodwa uma yeseka ongxiwa, ayiphumele obala ikwenze lokho ngokukhululeka futhi ningasifaki thina. Kulele kwiCosatu ukuthi inqume ukuthi yeseka bani okhethweni," kusho uMapaila. Uthe beyiSACP babizwa ngawo wonke amagama afaka nokuthi baxova amadlelandawonye.Uveze ukuthi u-99% wamalungu abo ungamalungu e-ANC."I-ANC izobe izidubula yona onyaweni uma ikhethisa amalungu eSACP ukuthi ubani okumele amvotele. Amalungu ethu amaningi aphinde abe nobulungu be-ANC." Umengameli we-ANC nezwe uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa, uthe kumele iphele eyokuqashwa kwezinkampani ezizimele ukuzokwenza umsebenzi komasipala.Uthe uma kuzoqashwa komasipala lokho kuzokwehlisa izinga lokungasebenzi kwabantu bakuleli."Siyabuhlonipha ubudlelwano esinabo neCosatu siwuhulumeni. Lo mfelandawonye uneqhaza elibalulekile njengoba ubuwa uvuka ne-ANC nangaphambi kwenkululeko," usho kanje. Uthe kumele kuliwe nesihlava senkohlakalo nokungaphathwa kahle kwemali kuhulumeni nakomasipalaUveze nokuthi kumele amadlelandawonye abumbane ngoba ayadingana."Sisuka kude kakhulu ukuthi ekugcineni singamane sihlukane kanjalo singamadlelandawonye. Uma sihlukana sizontenga. Siyayihlonipha iSACP ngokungenela ukhetho noma singahambisani nesinqumo sayo. Lesi sinqumo sizoba nomthelela ongemuhle kithina sonke, ngoba kubalulekile ukuthi sibumbane," kusho uRamaphosa.

NKOSIKHONA CELE NONOKUBONGWA PHENYANEAMAPHOYISA KwaZulu-Natal anxusa abantu besifazane ukuba bahlukane nomkhuba wokuqamba amanga mayelana nokuthi bakhulelwe. Amaphoyisa akhiphe lesi sexwayiso ngemuva kokuba owesifazane oneminyaka engu-26 waKwaMagwaza, eMelmoth, eqambe amanga emaphoyiseni ngokuthunjwa kosana lwakhe ekubeni engakaze akhulelwe.Kuvela ukuthi owesifazane uqambe amanga emaphoyiseni wathi usana lwakhe luthunjiwe ngemuva kokuba eluphucwe ngamadoda amathathu.Ngemuva kokuba amaphoyisa ethole lo myalezo, enza uphenyo olunzulu ecinga nosana kodwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi athola ukuthi owesifazane ubeqamba amanga - akekho umntwana wakhe othunjiwe futhi akakaze akhulelwe.Amaphoyisa athole ukuthi owesifazane ubeqambe amanga kowesilisa athandana naye nasemndenini wakhe ebatshela ukuthi ukhulelwe. Kuvela ukuthi yena futhi ugcine eseqamba amanga amndenini wakhe ewutshela ukuthi siphuphumile isisu.Kuvela ukuthi ugcine esekhalelwa ngamasongo kaSigonyela wabekwa amacala okuqamba amanga. Kulindeleke kuthi avele eNkantolo yeMantshi yakhona eMelmoth namhlanje. Ngokwesitatimende samaphoyisa lona bekungowesifazane wesibili kule nyanga nje iyodwa obekwe icala elifanayo. Kunomunye wesifazane oneminyaka engu-21 okuvela ukuthi waqamba amanga wathi udlwengulwe uninalume.Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi kuthiwa kwavela ukuthi wayeqamba amanga. Lokhu kwenzeke ekubeni esevele eseboshiwe umalume ngecala lokudlwengula umshana wakhe. Isitatimende siqhuba sithi kuwubugebengu obukhulu ukuvulwa kwamacala angekho. Sthe lokhu kuhambisana nokumosheka kwezinsiza zamaphoyisa.Isitatimende sithi lokhu kuyinkinga ngoba amaphoyisa agcina esemosha isikhathi ephenya amacala angekho ekubeni ekhona amacala angempela enzekile. Amaphoyisa akhipha lesi sitatimende nje, Isolezwe like labika kabanzi ngodaba lowesilisa waseMacambini, eMandeni, okwasala kancane ukuthi angcwabe unodoli.Owesilisa wakhohliswa ngowesifazane eyethandana naye emtshela ukuthi ukhulelwe. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi owesifazane wamtshela ukuthi selushonile usana lwakhe.Ngemuva kwalokho kwabe sekuqalwa amalungiselelo omngcwabo kwambiwa nomgodi kubo kowesilisa."Isidumbu sosana" safika ngosuku lomngcwabo. Kuvela ukuthi umfowabo wowesilisa kwasiza ukubhoka kwakhe efuna ukuba kuvulwe ibhokisi ngaphambi kokuba lifakwe emgodini. Owesifazane kuthiwa wayebhoka ekhahlela engafuni ukuthi lokho kwenzeke. Selivulwa ibhokisi "uyise wengane" wakhangwa wunodoli ogqokiswe izingubo.Owesifazane kuthiwa wacela empunzini. Owesilisa watshela Isolezwe ukuthi lesi sigameko simenze waba nyamanambama emphakathini waseMandeni. Wakhala nangokuthi kuze kwadingeka ukuba ayoshweleza enkosini ngoba wayesembe umgodi, ewumbela into engekho wakhipha nemali eningi enakekela owesifazane ngenkathi ethi uzithwele.Kuthiwa sekuyinto ejwayelekile ezindaweni eziningi ukuthi abesifazane baqambe amanga ngokuthi bakhulelwe ngoba befuna ukutotoswa amadoda.
BASALE bebuzana imibuzo abantu abaningi ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ngemuva kwe-video kaFata Thapelo Masemola abonakala kuyona ekhulekela utshwala.Kule video, uMasemola ubonakala ezidlubhe zaphelela izevatho zebandla laseSheshi, phambi kwakhe kunezinhlobo ezahlukene zikabhiya. Abanye bebebuza ukuthi baphi abazalwane njengoba bekubonakala yena yedwa. Kepha ngasekugcineni kuzwakala kukhona abesifazane abenanele ngomkikizo ngemuva kokubusiswa kwezidlo ebeziphambi kwale nceku.Emkhulekweni awenzile uFata Masemola uzwakala ewethula ethi: "Inkosi inani! Sihlangene ngamancoko amahle nangesipho sasemandulo sabantu, ubhiya."Ngasekuqhubekeni komkhuleko, awuchaze ngokuthi owomgubho wosuku lukabhiya, ugcizelela ukuthi (ubhiya) uyondla, uvuselele abakhathele futhi uma uphuzwa ungeqisi, ukhuthaza ubudlelwano nenjabulo." Ezinkundleni abanye bebethi bangakujabulela-ke bona ukukhonza kuleli bandla.ULover uthe: ''Baphi kanti abazalwane?UCharlotte uzwakale ecasuka njengoba ebhale ukuthi: "Le nto ayihlekisi nje ubuKristu abusiyo into yokudlala.''U@emmy uthe: '' Siyakudinga ukuhambela izinkonzo zalolu hlobo.''UThatelo ubhale ukuthi: "Ameni mfundisi wami!''UHle uthe : ''Akusiyena umfundisi wethu lona.''UMelz07 uthe : ''Ikhona le nto encwadini yomkhuleko mfundisi? UNqubeko uthe: ''Hawu Mfundisi,'' wase efaka uphawu lwabantu abakhalayo.UBonokoane uthe: "UFata bekumele avele athi asiphuzeni.''UNgangelizwe, ebabaza, uthe: "AmaSheshi notshwala.'' Kuthintwa inhloko yebandla lamaSheshi kwiDayosisi yaseNatal, uMbhishobhi Nkosinathi Ndwandwe, uthe akayibonanga i-video okukhulunywa ngayo. Uthe kodwa ibandla lamaSheshi libunjwe ngabantu abehlukene abenza izinto ngezindlela ezingefani.Uqhube ngokuthi akukho eBhayibhelini lapho khona okuthiwa abantu mabangabuphuzi utshwala. Uthe inkinga enkulu ukuthi abantu bona babuphuza beqise bese lokho kugcine sekuholela ekutheni benze izinto ezingafanelekile."Awukho umbhalo othi abantu mabangabulokothi utshwala,'' usho kanjena.Uthe nakubazalwane bebandla nakoFata, uye abatshele ukuthi uma kwenzeka bebusebenzisa abokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi babusebenzisa ngabodwana."Inkinga iqala uma usuphuza ungasazihloniphi, usudlebeleka. Okunye futhi ngeke sivumele umuntu ukuba aqale ngokuphuza utshwala ngaphambi kokuba afike enkonzweni," usho kanjena.Uthe kodwa uma esekhuluma njengomuntu nje ozimele ayikho inkinga ngotshwala kodwa inkinga ngabantu abahlulekayo ukubusebenzisa."Mina ngiye ngihlale nabantu abamhlophe, abayenzi le nto eyenziwa yithina. Abekho abantu abeqisayo otshwaleni njengathi,'' echaza.Uthe yena ngokwakhe ukhuthaza ukuthi umuntu aphuzele ekhaya, lokho uthe kuyalekelela ekutheni azigcine ephephile. Akathandanga kakhulu ukuveza ukuthi ithini inqubomgomo yebandla laseSheshi mayelana nodaba lokuphuzwa kotshwala.

Sizogqamisa ukuthi yiziphi izimo abantu besilisa ababhekana nazo buthule, ukuthi zibaphazamisa kanjani empilweni yabo, eyabasondele nabo nokuthi bangasizakala kanjani," kulanda uNksz Ngobese. Uthe benze ngamabomu ukuthi lo mcimbu ube manje ngoba bakholwa wukuthi izinkinga ezinjena zenzeka nsuku zonke ngakho babone kungeke kubasize ngalutho ukulinda esinye isikhathi njengenyanga yabesilisa uJulayi, andukuba benze into azosiza emphakathini. Kuvungame izinkundla zokuxhumana abantu bebabaza ukuphambana kodwaba lukaPearl Thusi ngobudlelwane bakhe noThabo Bester. Lokhu kulandela isiqephu sokuqala seqophamlando i--Beauty And The Bester eqondiswa yinkampani kaMandla N ekhuluma udaba lukaThabo Bester noNandipha Magudumana. Kuleli qophamlando, kuvezwa izingxoxo zabantu abahlukene okubalwa kubo osaziwayo abasondelene nalezi zithandani ezabanjwa ezweni laseTanzania ngemuva kokuvela kwemibiko yokweqa kukaBester ejele laseMangaung.Uciphize izinyembezi ekhumbula isikhathi ebhekene nombulali futhi ongumdlwenguli owamsabisa ngommese, umethuli wezinhlelo uPearl Thusi nokade ekhuluma ngakho ohlelweni iBeauty and the Bester, ekhonjiswa kwiNetflix kusuka ngoLwesihlanu.UPearl uthe uBester wamazi eqala ukumbona enkundleni yokuxhumana iFacebook nala amcela ukuthi basebenzisane njengoba befuna umethuli wohlelo abazolwenza nala azohola khona imali ewu-R70 000."Inkundla iFacebook ngaleso sikhathi yayisahamba phambili lezi ezinye zingakabi bikho. Saqala ukuxhumana naye ngoJuni, wango-2011, wangitshela ngethuba lomsebenzi analo, sase sihlela ukuthi sohlangana kanjani, nangempela sakwenza lokho. Ngafika kuye wagibela emotweni sahamba imizuzu engu-25, wabe esengitshela ukuthi angijikele komunye umgwaqo, ngathi ngisahamba ngawo waphela, uma ngimbuka kula ngabona khona ukuthi usephethe ummese uwubhekise kimi. Ngathuka kakhulu ngazibona ngiyisilima, ngambuza ukuthi kungani enza lokhu? Wangitshela ngobunzima bempilo yakhe nezinto asedlule kuzo," kusho uPearl.Kube nezinkulumo eziningi ngale ndaba selokhu yethulwe, kanti abanye abafana nonontandakubukwa we-YouTube uSlik Talk bathi mhlawumbe uPearl ulele noThabo Bester ngoba usebenzise amazwi afana nokuthi "ngiphuthuma, ngisencane, ngingenalwazi,” kanti abanye bathi lokhu kungaba amanga ngoba uma wake wakhuluma ngale ndaba eminyakeni eyedlule wayexoxa indaba ehlukile. Ukuphawula kwabantu ezinkundleni zokuxhumana:UNota ongu-phrojusa odumile endimeni yomculo, uphawule kabanzi ngoPearl ngobudlelwane bakhe noThabo Bester@lavidaNOTA UPearl Thusi akayena nje umqambimanga omubi kodwa ungumdidiyeli ecaleni lokubulala onecala... Bekufanele aboshwe noThabo Bester esikhundleni sokwenza sengathi ufuna ubulungiswa ngoReeva ngoba wayezizwa enecala ngokusiza owesilisa ukuba abaleke ekubulaleni abesifazane! Njengoba ngike ngasho ukuthi ngangikhona ngesikhathi kufika amaphoyisa afuna uThabo Bester ezobopha uPearl Thusi. Wayengu-MC emcimbini engangiwulungiselela.Ngicabanga ukuthi wabonisa amaphoyisa isikhali esasetshenziswa ukubulala!Prosper 𝕏@qhamadlula_·Sep 13 UPearl Thusi ubengavele asitshele ukuthi ujole naye (inzwabethi). Yebo, besizomahlulela kodwa besizoqhubeka nempilo ekugcineni, ngibona sengathi kukhona angasitsheli kona ngoba indaba yakhe ayinaso isiqiniseko. #BeautyAndTheBesterOnTheGround@GroundMatters·22h UPearl Thusi abonakale emdlalweni iBeauty and the Bester edida ngendlela eyisimanga. Udaba lwakhe ngokuhlangana okubuhlungu noThabo Bester, lapho okwaqala ngobumnandi begigi kwaphenduka isimo esibi emotweni ehlaselwa ngommese, kodwa futhi kwashintsha ngosizo lokuhlengwa umfundisi wakhe. Akasho lutho ngamaphoyisa, ushiya ababukeli bezibuza ukuthi ngabe kukhona yini umkhondo wangempela owalandelwa amaphoyisa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uPearl uyavuma ukuthi wathandazela uBester, nokuyinto edida okokugcina ukuba nozwelo ngombulali. Abanye abantu bavundulule inkulumo abanayo nephephandaba iSowetan ekhuluma ngalololu daba eminyakeni embalwa eyedlule, njengobufakazi bokuthi useyishintshile inkulumo yakhe.

Indodakazi kaDavid Mabuza inikele enkantolo ngemizamo yokunqanda inkampani yemishwalensi i-Alexandra Forbes ukuba ikhokhele unkosikazi kayise uNonhlanhla Mnisi izigidi zemali yakhe yempesheni.Kuthiwa lapha kukhulunywa ngemali elinganiselwa ku-R44.7-million okumele ukhishwe kulandela ukudlula emhlabeni kukaMabuza kungazelelwe ngoJulayi 3, 2025. Izindaba zokudlula kukaMabuza zakhishwa unobhala jikelele we-ANC uFikile Mbalula ngombhalo awunameka ezinkundleni zokuxhumana.Indodakazi kaMabuza, uTamara Silinda, isifake isicelo esiphuthumayo enkantolo enkulu, izama ukuvimba i-Alexander Forbes ukuthi ingakhokhi yonke le mali engu-R44 million kunkosikazi wakhe, uNonhlanhla Patience Mnisi. UTamara emaphepheni akhe asenkantolo, uthi uMabuza wayeshade nonina, u-Emunah Silinda, ngokomthetho wesintu, futhi udinga imali yesikole, indawo yokuhlala kanye nesibonelelo sanyanga zonke, njengoba wayeyithola kuyise esaphila. IZOQALA namhlanje ikhomishini ephenya izinsolo ezenziwa uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, yize iMK ifake icala lokuba kuvinjwe le khomishini eholwa yiJaji uMbuyiseli Madlanga.Kuhlelwe ukuthi uMkhwanazi kube uyena ozokwethula ubufakazi namhlanje uma sekuqala ikhomishini.Kusasa kuzolalelwa isicelo seMK eNkantolo eNkulu, ePitoli, lapho iphonsela khona inselelo ukuqokwa kwekhomishini.Esitatimendeni, iMK ibicele ukuba ikhomishini ingaqali kuze kube inkantolo ikhipha isinqumo esicelweni sayo. Kepha ikhomishini iqhubekile namalungiselelo ayo izolo.Kubonakale amaphoyisa eqaphe isimo lapho kuzokube kuhlezi khona ikhomishini, eBridgette Mabandla Justice College, ePitoli.Okhulumela ikhomishini, uMnuz Jeremy Michaels, uthe akusekho ukujikela emva kwendlu.Esitatimendeni, uMichaels uthe bakulungele ukulalela ubufakazi bukaMkhwanazi.Ikhomishini yasungulwa uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, emva kokuba uMkhwanazi enze izinsolo zokuthi kunezigebengu ezisondelene nosopolitiki eziphazamisa ukusebenza kwengalo yomthetho.Imibono yehlukene ebantwini bakuleli ngokusungulwa kwekhomishini njengoba kukhona abakhala ngokuthi amakhomishini amosha imali ngenxa yokuthi abekho abantu abathathelwa izinyathelo.UMichaels uthe ungabazane olukhona ngamakhomishini angeke lubaqede amandla."Siyazi ukuthi yini eyenza ukuthi kube khona ungabazane. Imibiko esizoyithumela umengameli izokube inezincomo. Sifuna ukuthi abantu bazethembe izinhlaka zezokuphepha."Okhulumela iMK, uMnuz Nhlamulo Ndhlela, uthe abasiboni isidingo seKhomishini kaMadlanga."Iqiniso ukuthi asikabazi bonke abantu ababandakanyeka ezinsolweni zikaMkhwanazi. UMkhwanazi wenza izinsolo zokuthi namajaji ayabandakanyeka nawo ekuphazanyisweni kokusebenza kwengalo yomthetho. Mhlawumbe laba bantu abahola ikhomishini ibona kanye abathinteka ezinsolweni zikaMkhwanazi."UNdhlela uthe ikhomishini bekufanele imiswe kuze kube kulalelwa icala labo kusasa."Into nje eyenza ukuthi baphikelele nekhomishini ukuthi badelela izinqumo ezithathwe iMK. Abafuni ukuhlonipha izinqumo zomthetho ezithathwe iMK."Nokho iRise Mzansi yona ithe akufanele iphazamiseke iKhomishini kaMadlanga.Ilungu leRise Mzansi, uMnuz Makashule Gana, lithe labo abafuna ukuvimba ukuqala kwekhomishini basho ukuthi bafuna ziqhubeke izinkinga ezibikwa ezinhlakeni zezokuphepha."Sekunesikhathi eside kushiwo ukuthi kunezinkinga ezinhlakeni zezokuphepha. Manje sekuyisikhathi sokuba kuphenywe, kuphinde kulungiswe izinkinga. Akufanele siqhubeke nokuchitha isikhathi."Esicelweni sayo iMK iphinde iphonsele inselelo nokuqokwa kukaNgqongqoshe wezamaPhoyisa obambile, uSolwazi Firoz Cachalia.I-MK yakhala ngaphansi esicelweni esifanayo eyayisifake eNkantolo yezoMthethosisekelo.
UMBUSO ugabe ngobufakazi obuqoshiwe othi kubo kuzwakala iNkosi uSimphiwe Erick Zuma yethulela isigqoko inkabi eyahlela isejele itulo lokubulala ikhansela.UMbuso uthe uma sekuqulwa icala lokubulawa kowayeyikhansela le-DA kuMasipala waseMngeni, uMnuz Nhlalayenza Ndlovu, uzodlala le nkulumo eqoshiwe okuthiwa yayiphakathi kukaZuma nenduna esiphenduke ufakazi wenkantolo, uMnuz Zwelithini Buthelezi. Kule nkulumo kuthiwa uZuma noButhelezi babencoma oboshelwe icala lokubulawa kukaNdlovu, uMnuz Thabo Chonco, ngokuba inkabi eseqophelweni eliphezulu. Umshushisi omkhulu ecaleni, u-Advocate Lawrence Gcaba, uthe uButhelezi uzokuqinisekisa ukuthi nguyena noZuma abakhuluma kule ngxoxo eqoshiwe. Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi kwenziwa izethulo zokugcina esicelweni sikaZuma sokudedelwa ngebheyili. Isicelo besilalelwe eNkantolo yeMantshi eHowick, izolo. UZuma uyakuphika ukuthi nguyena okhuluma kule ngxoxo uMbuso ogabe ngayo.Kodwa uGcaba uthe banelisekile ukuthi nguZuma nezinqotho okhulumayo."Inkulumo izodlalelwa inkantolo uma sekuqulwa icala. UButhelezi uzozisholo yena ukuthi nguyena okhulumayo nokuthi wayekhuluma nobani."UGcaba uthe kuyamtatazelisa uZuma ukuthi uButhelezi usephenduke ufakazi woMbuso, wathi bathole umyalezo lapho khona uZuma eshwabulela uButhelezi eze ambize ngenja."Lo mqhafazo uZuma ubiza uButhelezi ngenja, athi usetshele amaphoyisa yonke into."Ummeli kaZuma, u-Advocate Sthembiso "Sticks" Mdladla, uthe uMbuso awunabo ubufakazi obanele obuyamanisa uZuma necala."UMbuso uthembele ebufakazini bomuntu oyedwa osephenduke ufakazi wenkantolo. Kufanele singakukhohlwa ukuthi lo muntu uMbuso othembele kuyena waqale wenza isitatimende lapho khona ayevuma icala. Inkantolo kufanele ibufakele izibuko ubufakazi balo muntu. Lo fakazi angasho noma yini ukuze yena engagwetshwa."UMdladla uthe asikho isizathu esasingenza uZuma ukuba afune ukubulala uNdlovu. UMdladla uthe uZuma wayengahlangene nombango womhlaba owawuthinta uMasipala waseMngeni.UMasipala waseMngeni wawufake icala lapho wawufuna isivimbelo esasizonqanda ukudayiswa komhlaba owawubangwa."Umuntu okunguye owayehamba phambili kule nto uyena uButhelezi. Imali yokubekwa kwabantu yayingafakwa kwi-akhawunti kaZuma."UMdladla uthe uZuma ngeke alibalekele icala uma ededelwa ngebheyili, wathi uZuma ngeke ashiye imizi yakhe emine yentengo ka-R6 million uma ihlanganisiwe, izimoto zentengo ka-R2 million, umhlambi wezinkomo nesikhundla sobukhosi.Kepha uGcaba uthe maningi amathuba okuthi uZuma uzolibalekela icala njengoba ebhekene namacala amathathu okubulala. Uma engamlahla la macala engathola odilikajele abathathu."UGcaba uthe umthetho uyabavumela ukuba basebenzise ubufakazi bomuntu ongufakazi wenkantolo. Isinqumo esicelweni sikaZuma sizophuma ngoSeptemba 30.Abanye abasolwa kuleli cala uMnuz Thobani Hlongwa noKhayelihle Shabalala, abanqatshelwa ibheyili. UChonco yena akazange asifake isicelo sebheyili njengoba evele ehamba elinye icala lokusoconga umndeni waseBulwer, eliqulwa eNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu.
UKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, usevulele umphenyi ozimele, uPaul O’Sullivan, icala lokwehliswa kwesithunzi, futhi ufuna amademeshe ka-R5 million.Amasamanisi, afakwe eNkantolo eNkulu yaseGoli ngeledlule, achaza amacala amathathu lapho u-O’Sullivan esolwa ngokuhlambalaza uMkhwanazi esidlangalaleni. Ephendula, u-O’Sullivan ukhiphe isitatimende ethi ngeke aphumele obala aphendule imibuzo ngalolu daba, njengoba kuwukuzithoba. Emasamanisini akhe asenkantolo enkulu, uMkhwanazi ubala amacala amathathu lapho u-O’Sullivan, ekhuluma kwabezindaba, ebeka izinsolo ezimbi ngaye kulo nyaka. Izinsolo zika-O’Sullivan ziveza ukuthi uMkhwanazi wasebenzisa budedengu izimali zamaphoyisa ngesikhathi esabambe njengokhomishana wamaphoyisa, nokuthi wamukela izipho zikanokusho ezivela kwabahlinzeka ngemisebenzi nokuthi uyisigebengu esixhumene nobugebengu obuhleliwe.Izitatimende zika-O’Sullivan zazikhomba ngenjumbane neNhloko yeCrime Intelligence, uDumisani Khumalo, kanye noKhomishana wamaPhoyisa kuzwelonke uFannie Masemola. UMkhwanazi umangalele u-O’Sullivan ngo-R5 million ngokudicilela phansi isithunzi sakhe, ethi ucele u-O’Sullivan ukuthi ahoxise izinsolo zakhe esidlangalaleni futhi axolise nokuyinto ahlulekile ukuyenza. Empendulweni ekhishwe ngoLwesibili, u-O’Sullivan uthi unobufakazi obuqinisekisa izinsolo zakhe, wengeza ngokuthi uhlose ukwabelana ngazo neKhomishini kaMadlanga yophenyo.
KUHLUKANE imibono ngenkulumo esuse imvunge kaMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa yokuncoma omasipala abaphethwe yi-DA.URamaphosa uthe labo masipala baphethwe kahle wanxusa amakhansela e-ANC ukuthi asike iphethini, ahambe ayothekela ulwazi kubona.Emuva kwale nkulumo, kukhona abathi udayise nge-ANC ekubeni kubhekwe okhethweni. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, i-DA izishaya isifuba ngokunconywa nguRamaphosa. Le nkulumo uyenze ngoMsombuluko, ngesikhathi ekhipha umkhombandlela ngokumele amakhansela e-ANC akwenze ukuze abuyise ukwethenjwa kwabantu ngenxa yokuthi le nhlangano yehlelwa ukwesekwa.Ezinkundleni zokuxhumana kuFacebook weSolezwe, kuhlukane imibono abanye bethi kakade uqinisile ngoba vele labo masipala be-ANC bayabhacaza. Nakhu okunye ukuphawula kwabantu:UPhilan MuchMoney uthe: "URamaphosa ukhankasela i-DA ngeziphansi, wenzela ukuthi abantu bavotele yona kunokuvotela iMK noma EFF. Umdayisi womzabalazo lo baba. Ayikho nje into esile eyenziwa i-DA."Sizwe Ndlovu Kwasjula-Sekosala uthe: "Uwuqedile umlando ngenhlangano i-ANC. Usewufezile umsebenzi wakhe wokuzoqeda ngoKhongolose, akakaze vele waba yi-ANC uRamaphosa uyi-Capitalist ye-DA.Mthembiseni Khanyile-Iqiniso esingeliphike nje leli ngabelungu ngoba ngisho kwizinkampani sifuna ukusebenzela kweyomlungu kuneyomuntu omnyama ngoba akanaqiniso kwezezimali umuntu omnyama.Zwelihle Zimu-Ubeqinisile, nowethu uMsunduzi sifuna uphathwe yiyo sizokwenza konke okusemandleni.Ernest Mchunu-Iqiniso elimsulwa lelo abantu abamnyama into abayaziyo ukuntshontsha izinto engabe zizosiza abantu baphinde badlale nangezingane ngokuthi bazikhwele ngoba nakhu zincenge amatoho kahulumeni, kube sengathi owakhe lowo msebenzi.Mkhulu Ndebeleh-Ngiyaqala ukuzwa u-president wethu ekhuluma iqiniso kanje futhi ngiyaqala ukuvumelana naye.Mlungic Sibiya-Kuthiwa nicula kamnandi impela kodwa dololo ukusebenza.Mchazeleni Mbhele-Ubekhuluma iqiniso, yalithola embikweni kaMcwaningi Mabhuku.Veli Veli Nkosi-Linishonele masela ndini.Blessing Masinga-Uqinisile umengameli, balibala ukucula badanse njalo uma sibabona, eqinisweni ubahlulile umsebenzi bangamsoli umengameli wethu naye uyazibonela.
UKWEHLUKANA phakathi kwe-ANC neSACP akumele kudale uqhekeko kubasebenzi abakumfelandawonye wezinyunyana zabasebenzi iCosatu.Lokhu kushiwo nguMengameli weCosatu, uNksz Zingiswa Losi, izolo evula umhlangano wezinsuku ezine weCosatu eGoli.Uthe iCosatu ibhekele ilungelo labasebenzi."Ukuhlukana kwe-ANC neSACP akumele kuhlukanise phakathi abasebenzi. Thina simele abasebenzi," usho kanje. Usho lokhu nje kunoqhekeko phakathi kwalawa madlelandawonye njengoba iSACP izongenela ukhetho ngokuzimela.I-ANC ayeneme ngalesi sinyathelo njengoba le nhlangano ivele isenkingeni yokwehlelwa wukwesekwa okhethweni.I-SACP ingenela ukhetho ngoba ingeneme ngezinto ezithile, okubalwa nendaba yokuthi ayikabhungwa eyokubuyekezwa kweyamadlelandawonye, okuyinto amaKhomanisi ayefuna ixoxwe. Njengoba i-ANC yesekwa yiCosatu, kunemibuzo yokuthi ngabe lo mfelandawonye uzokweseka bani uma sekuyiwa okhethweni lohulumeni basekhaya ngonyaka ozayo.Unxuse ukuthi amadlelandawonye abumbane ngalesi sikhathi esinzima.UNksz Losi ubuye wakhuluma ngokudilizwa kwabasebenzi athe kuphuca abantu isinkwa."Uma kudilizwa umuntu, izingane ziyalamba ekhaya. Kuphela nethemba ngekusasa lezingane kwezithinta imfundo." Ukhale ngezinga eliphezulu lokungasebenzi kwabantu kuleli ikakhulu intsha."Liyakhula izinga lokungalingani kuleli, ubugebengu budla lubi kanjalo nenkohlakalo. Omasipala bahluleka ukuhambisa izidingo emphakathini."Ukhale nangokugcwala kwezikole zakuleli nezikweletu ezibhekene nezitshudeni ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme.Uhlabe ikhwelo kubasebenzi ukuthi babhukule bangahlali nje izinto zibe zonakala."Ubumbano yilona olwenza ukuthi sikwazi ukunqoba impi. Uma sibambene singakwazi ukulwa nokuxhashazwa nokudilizwa kwabasebenzi." Lo mhlangano uzobhunga ngezinto ezehlukene okubalwa nengqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi obusha ezoba ngoSepthemba ngonyaka ozayo.Abaholi abahlukene okubalwa uNobhala jikelele weSACP uMnuz Solly Mapaila bazokwethula inkulumo kulo mhlangano ohlanganisa abaholi ababalelwa ku-400, abavela ezinyunyaneni ezingaphansi kwalo mfelandawonye.
APHELILE amahlathi okucasha kwabakhwabanisela isikhwama esixhasa ngemali yokufunda ezikhungweni zemfundo iNational Students' Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS), besebenzisa imininingwane engamanga ngabazali babo njengoba bebabamba oqotsheni.Lesi sexwayiso sikhishwe nguNgqongqoshe weMfundo ePhakeme, uMnuz Buti Manamela, oxwayise abenza lokhu ngokuthi mabagawule babheke ngoba basezithendeni zabo.UManamela uthe ayaphela amahlathi okucasha kwabakokotela imininingwane behubhuza amanga bethi bashonelwa abazali."Bafaka isicelo bathi bashonelwa abazali kodwa uma sebethwala iziqu thushukiyane abazali. Abanye baqamba amanga bathi abazali abasebenzi, abanye bathi bahola imali engaphansi kwesikalo esibekiwe sokuxhaswa. Uma siphenya sithole okunye," usho kanje izolo ekhuluma esithangamini nabezindaba eGoli ngamalungiselelo angonyaka ozayo. Uthe basebenzisana neminyango ehlukene ukubamba abasenga ezimithiyo."Sisebenza noMnyango wezaseKhaya okuyiwo osivezela ukuthi lowo mzali uyaphila. Sisebenza nophiko oluqoqa intela kuleli, okuyilo oluveza ukuthi umzali noma abazali balowo osuke efake isicelo bahola ngaphezu kwesikalo semali esibekiwe."Uthe ukuze uxhaswe yiNSFAS, kumele abazali bahole u-R350 000 ngonyaka kuya phansi. Labo abahola ngaphezu kwale mali kuze kufinyelele ku-R600 000, bona bafaka isicelo sokubolekwa imali yiNSFAS, ngaphansi kweqoqo elaziwa nge-missing middle.Mayelana neziteleka eziphenduka insakavukela njalo uma kuqala unyaka ezikhungweni, uthe baphezu kwezinhlelo zokuqeda ngale nkinga."Iziteleka kumele kungaqali zona uma kukhona ukungaboni ngaso linye noma kunezinkinga. Kumele kube yinto yokugcina ngoba izitshudeni zinalo ilungelo lokuteleka kodwa lokho kumele zikwenze zilandele umthetho," usho kanje. Uthe babumbe inkundla ezohlanganisa izinhlaka ezehlukene yokuzama ukuxazulula izinkinga ezibakhona."Le nkundla izobandakanya zonke izinhlaka, kusuka kwizitshudeni, izikhungo nabo bonke abathintekayo. Ngaleyo ndlela izinkinga zizoxazululwa zisuka amadaka. Le nkundla izokwenganyelwa yihhovisi lami ngokuhlanganyela nelikamqondisi jikelele. Asifuni kube nalezi zinkinga ezibakhona kutelekwe kuze kucekelwe phansi nempahla yesikhungo," kusho uManamela. Uthe uyazi ukuthi abanye abaphathi bamanyuvesi basezinhlelweni zokubeka amacala abaholi bama-SRC. Usho kanje nje njalo uma kuneziteleka abaphathi bamanyuvesi bathola izincwadi zenkantolo zokuvimba ukuthi izitshudeni ziteleke, zicekele phansi nempahla yesikhungo.UManamela umemezele ukuthi luvulwa namhlanje uhlelo lokufaka izicelo zangonyaka ozayo kwiNSFAS.Lolu hlelo luzokwenganyelwa yiPhini likaNgqongqoshe uDkt Nomusa Dube-Ncube.

Bathole i-ATM lapho bezitomulela khona imali," kusho uNdhlela.Ne-DA yazwakalisa isikhalazo ngokuthi osihlalo bamabhodi bazixebulela umkhoma. U-Archie Mdaka (34) onguMphathi Wesifunda seManufacturing, Engineering and Related Services Sector Education and Training Authority (i-MERSETA), uvele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseNkomazi, eMalelane, ngamacala enkohlakalo abekwe wona. UMdaka ubhekelela ukuxhasa ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono nokuqeqeshwa ezingxenyeni ezithile zemboni. Isikhungo asihlinzeki ngokuqeqesha kodwa siqhuba izinhlelo ngokuthi sinikezele ngoxhaso, sibhalise abahlinzeki, siphinde siqinisekise izinga lokuqeqeshwa ukuze kulungiswe izidingo zemboni.Lo mphathi wesifunda wasebenzisa isikhundla sakhe ukufuna inzuzo kubahlinzeki bezinsiza. Wabanjwa nesizumbulu sikaR40 000 semali eyayikhokwe ngomunye wabahlinzeki bezinsiza eMalelane. Ngokolwazi olutholakele, umsolwa ubethatha phakathi kuka-20 no-30% enzuzweni eyenziwa ngabahlinzeki bezinsiza aphinde abasabise ngokubambezela ngenhloso izinkokhelo, okuzokwenza kubenzima ukusebenza kwesikhungo sokuqeqesha uma nje benqaba ukukhokha lelo phesenti alifunayo. Udaba lwabikwa kwabeHawks based Serious Corruption Investigation ukuze benze uphenyo olubanzi. NgoMgqibelo, ithimba elibhekelele ukuphenya ngenkohlakalo enzima (Serious Corruption Investigation) kanye nesikhungo esigcina amarekhondi obugebengu (Local Criminal Record Center) lisebenzise ulwazi olutholakele, umsolwa wavinjwa ngemuva kokuthi athole inkokhelo kaR40 000 kumhlinzeki wezinsiza.Ngesikhathi evele enkantolok, unikezwe ibheyili kaR5.000. Wayalelwa ukuba anikeze umphenyi iphasiphothi yakhe, bese evela esiteshini samaphoyisa saseMiddelburg, kanye ngesonto phakathi kuka 06:00 no-18:00. Waphinde waxwayiswa ngokuthi angamphazamisi ufakazi.Usuku lwakhe lokuvela enkantolo luhlehliselwe umhlaka 03 Novemba 2025.

Uthe amakhansela kudingeka ahlale esemphakathini ukuze abantu bawathembe."Hlalani emphakathini lapho niphethe khona, ningathuthi niyohlala kwezinye izindawo. Uma ufika kubantu ukhulume nabo kahle. Akumele uye kubantu ngoba sekuzoba nokhetho. Khohlwani wukhetho, lusekude kabi. Iyani kubantu ukuze nizazi izinkinga zabo." Uncome omasipala abaphethwe amanye amaqembu wathi benza kahle."Kumele ngikusho la ukuthi kuyadumaza uma uMcwaningi Mabhuku Jikelele esekhipha umbiko ngomasipala eseveza ukuthi abaphethwe amanye amaqembu benza kahle. Iyani ukuyothekela ulwazi komasipala abaphethwe yi-DA, njengaseKapa, ukuthola ukuthi benza ngani ukuthi bahlale bethola imibiko emihle yokusebenza kwemali."Ukhale nangokuthi kuyadumaza ukuthi umbiko wemali uyaphekwa komasipala nokuthi kusetshenziswa izinkampani ezizimele ukwenza le mibiko. "Akuphele ukuphekwa kwemibiko yemali komasipala. Le mibiko ayenziwe abantu abaqashiwe."Ubuye waveza nokuthi ngisho nangezinto ezincane komasipala kukhishwa amathenda."Akuyona yonke into okumele iyiswe kumathenda komasipala. Ezinye izinto omasipala bangakwazi ukuzenza."Uthe la makhansela azobika njalo ezinyangeni ezintathu, kweziyisithupha kanjalo nangemuva konyaka ngomsebenzi awenzile."Uma ningidinga ukuthi ngize emiphakathini yenu ngizonimisa idolo, ngibizeni. IMbube ize yaphonsela uXulu inselelo yokuba asho uma efuna bahlangane emgangeleni.UXulu uthe azisemthusi izinsongo njengoba zingezintsha kuyena.UXulu uveze ukuthi njengamanje unyamanambana emabuthweni kangangoba akasayihambi imikhosi yaseNdlunkulu, wathi waqala ukuthola izinsongo emabuthweni emva kokuhlaziya umsindo owasuswa umbango wombhobho owawuphakathi kowayengundunankulu kaZulu ngaleso sikhathi, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, nowayengusihlalo we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal ngaleso sikhathi, uMnuz Siboniso Duma.Uthe ukuhlaziya kwakhe lesi sigameko esenzeka phambi kweSilo noMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, ngesikhathi kukhunjulwa iSilo uDinuzulu kaCetshwayo, kwamqhatha namabutho.Ngokuqonda kweSolezwe, okucasule iMbube inkulumo eyenziwa uXulu kwiSABC lapho khona agxeka isinqumo sokususwa koMkhosi woMhlanga esigodlweni eNyokeni.Ekhuluma neSABC, uXulu uthe iMbube iphazamile ngokususa umkhosi eNyokeni ikakhulu njengoba uhulumeni ubusanda kuphothula isakhiwo sika-R154 million, wathi iMbube bekufanele ilinde kuze kuphothulwe icala elithinta umbango wesihlalo sobukhosi bukaZulu ngaphambi kokuthi ithuthe uMkhosi woMhlanga.Ekhuluma neSolezwe, uXulu uthe kumshaqisile ukuzwa iSilo sikhwela sidilika kuyena."Kube yishwa ngempela. Ngicabanga ukuthi ubengathatha ucingo angibuze uma kukhona into engiyikhulumile engamuphathanga kahle. Le nto eyenzekile ngiyibona iyisimo sokuhlaseleka. Kodwa ke mina anginanxa naye."UXulu uthe usazoqhubeka nokuhlaziya izindaba ezithinta ubukhosi."Into okufanele ayiqonde ukuthi mina ngingumhlaziyi, angiyena umkhulumeli wakhe. Ngakwezemfundo ngifundile. Ngineziqu zeDoctoral ezintathu engazithola emanyuvesi ahlonishwayo. Ezimbili ezamasiko, ezinye ezenkolo. Njengamanje ngifundela ezinye iziqu ngezobukhosi."

UHLEHLISELWE kuze kube inyanga ezayo umphakathi ukuthi uphawule ngemigomo ethinta umthetho wezikole okunomsindo ngawo iBasic Education Laws Amendment Act (BELA).Le migomo ithinta ukwamukelwa kwabafundi kanjalo nethinta ukugcwala kwesikole.Ukuphawula komphakathi bekumele kuvalwe kule nyanga kodwa uNgqongqoshe weMfundo eyisiSekelo, uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, wabona kunesidingo sokuthi ayihlehliwe. Esimemezelweni asenzile uthe ulula isikhathi sokuthi umphakathi uphawule ngale migomo."Isikhathi sokuphawula sizovalwa ngo-Okthoba 5, 2025. Nginxusa abantu ukuthi baqhubeke baphawule ngale migomo," usho kanje.Phambilini, izinhlaka ezehlukene okubalwa nezinyunyana zothisha zakhala ngokukhishwa izikhawu kwale migomo ekubeni bekumele ikhishwe yonke kanye kanye. Okukhalisa lezi zinhlaka ngukuthi miningi eminye imigomo okusamele ikhishwe, umphakathi uphawule ngayo ngaphambi kokuqala ukusebenza.Okukhalisa kakhulu izinhlaka ngukuthi njengoba ilokhu ikhishwa kancane kancane, kusho ukuthi kusekude ukuqala ukusebenza kwalo mthetho ngoba kusamele kukhishwe yonke imigomo, umphakathi uphawule ngayo ngaphambi kokuba iqale isebenze.UNksz Gwarube wakugcizelela ukuthi akafuni ukuxhamazela ngokuthi adedele yonke into ngesikhathi esisodwa ngoba kuningi ukukhala okukhona ngalo mthetho. Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi ngesikhathi uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, esayina lo mthetho ngokusemthethweni, uNksz Gwarube wayengekho kulo mcimbi kanti wagxekwa kakhulu ngokungawuthameli.Waduba lo mcimbi ngoba iqembu lakhe i-DA lalishaya amakhala ngezinto eziningi elingahambisani nazo okubalwa amandla anikwe izinhloko zoMnyango wezeMfundo ezifundazweni, okuyizona ezinamandla okunquma uma isikole sesigcwele kanjalo nolimi oluzosebenza kuleso sikole.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi ngaphambi kokusayinwa kwalo mthetho, kwase kuthathe iminyaka ecela kwengu-10, kudingidwa indaba yawo.
LUKHULUNYELWA emakhoneni emphakathini waKwaNgcolosi udaba lukagogo oshise umkhulu ongumyeni wakhe nendlu ngoba kuthiwa bese ekhathele wukuhlukunyezwa nguyena.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi umufi, uMnuz Mgcabeni Ndlovu ushiswe wugogo, uMaNgubane Ndlovu, waphelela khona ngaphakthi endlini. Umthombo olwazi ukusuka nokuhlala udaba uthe bebumuncu ubudlelwano phakathi kukagogo nomkhulu - behlala beklwebhana.Uthe bebeyinkukhu nempaka yize bebehlala ndawonye. Uthe yinto endala kabi ukubhimba kwezinto kubona, kodwa bebeqhubeka behlala ndawonye. Kuthiwa nemindeni beyazi ngenkinga yabo.UNksz Slindile Ndlovu ohlobene nabo ukhulume neSolezwe wakhala ngalo mshophi ogubuzele umndeni. Uthe badangele ngokubehlele. Udalule ukuthi yinto endala le yokuhlukunyezwa kukagogo.''Khona yinto ebesiyazi ukuthi ugogo uyahlukumezeka. Akuyona into yamanje kusukela kudala nje impela yinto ebiyenzeka,'' usho kanjena.Ebuzwa ukuthi angabuchaza njengobunjani ubudlelwano bukagogo nomkhulu uthe ngabe uqamba amanga uma engathi bekuwubudlelwano obebuhamba kahle.Echaza ngokwenzeke ngosuku lwesigameko uthe bathole ukuthi umnyombo usukela ekuhizisaneni phakathi kukagogo nomkhulu."Thina besingekho kodwa sizwile ukuthi kube nengxabano phakathi kwabo kwagcina sekonakala njengoba kugcine kwenzekile nje,'' usho kanjena.Ubalise ngobuhlungu athe njengomndeni njengamanje bayabuzwa."Khona kubuhlungu futhi kakhulu nje angazi nokuthi lobu buhlungu buzophela kanjani futhi nini. Le nto besingayilindele nhlobo ukuthi ingagcina yenzekile,'' usho kanjena.Udalule ukuthi ugogo nomkhulu sebesele namadodana amabili asadla anhlamvana wathi abanye abane sebalala kobandayo.Kuthiwa isigameko senzeke ngeSonto. Kuthiwa uMaNgubane wavele wabasa isitofu wasifaka ngaphansi kombhede kaNdlovu obelele, wase ephuma evala umnyango. Kuvele ukuthi sekunesikhathi uNdlovu ewumuntu olala ngisho emini ngenxa yokuthi washaywa yisifo sohlangothi eminyakeni edlule. Amaphoyisa awayiphendulanga imibuzo ayithunyelelwe ngalolu daba, kepha abomndeni bathe uMaNgubane akaboshwanga. Kuhlelwe ukuthi uNdlovu afihlwe kusasa.

BABHOKA bayakhahlela abesilisa bathi lutho eluthela inkomo ingazala umuntu abasoze basebenzisa izibongo zabesifazane abathandana nabo. Lokhu bathi kuyefana nje ncamashi nokuthi bayobe benyundela okhokho futhi bathi bakholwa wukuthi bangathola noswazi olunzima oluvela kwabaphansi uma bengawela kulolu gibe.
