UMnuz Eric Dlamini ozinze eThekwini kodwa ongowaseFree State ngokudabuka uthe bazophendukelwa ngabaphansi ngaleli phutha elikhulu kangaka.''Kuyacaca abaphansi bazosijezisa uma siqhubeka kanjena. Ngeke ngimangale uma kungathiwa lowo muntu wesilisa owenze lo msangano usethole uswazi olunzima oluvela kwabaphansi,'' kuchaza yena.Eqhuba uthe kusho ukuthi ngeke sisaba khona isidingo sokuthi abantu besilisa bayolobola. Uthe akuyenzi ingqondo ukuthi umuntu wesilisa angafike alobole bese futhi esebenzisa isibongo somuntu wesifazane."Impela le nto isiqhatha nokhokho bethu phela manje sesiqhamuka nento abangayazi nje nhlobo. Konakele uma singanakile kuningi okusazokonakala,'' kusho yena.UMnuz Thabani Gwala ongowaseMzinto ngokudabuka uthe namanje akakakholwa ukuthi into enjengalena isivunyelwe. Ukhale kakhulu ngokuthi lokhu kuyashayisana namasiko abantu. ''Yiliphi leli siko elizovumela umuntu wesilisa ukuba enze into enjengelena. Lena izodala umonakalo omkhulu emindenini yethu,'' kuchaza yena.UMnuz Zwelakhe Thabethe waseMlaza uthe umuntu wesilisa uyena oyinhloko yekhaya. Wathi lokho uNkulunkulu wakwenza ngenhloso wathi kusho ukuphambana kwezinkomishi ke uma umuntu wesilisa sekukhulunywa eyokuthi uyena osesebenzisa isibongo somuntu wesifazane. Eqhuba ubuze ukuthi izingane ezizotholwa kulobo budlelwano ziyobiza siphi isibongo.Ubuze ukuthi lokhu ngabe akusho yini ukushabalala kwezibongo zamadoda azakha kanzima kangaka?.''Ngamanye amagama kuthiwa makwandiswe izibongo zabesifazane bese ezemindeni yethu kuphela kanjalo ngazo. Ayi impela lafa elihle kakhulu asikaze sicabange ukuthi ngelinye ilanga kungenzeka into enjengalena,'' usho kanjena.UMnuz Zakhele Makhathini ozinze eThekwini kodwa odabuka KwaMaphumulo uthe lubi ulaka oluzogubuzela amadoda oluzovela emedlozini ngalesi sinqumo.USolwazi VVO Mkhize uthe kuyabonakala ukuthi laba abakhiphe lesi sinqumo esiphikisanayo nomthethosisekelo wezwe laseNingizimu Afrika kabaqondi kahle ngamasiko abantu abaMnyama base-Afrika.Uthe umuntu wesifazane usuke esebenzisa isibongo somuntu wesilisa ngoba usuke efike kulelo khaya waba yizinto ezinhlanu okuyisibiliso, yimpande, yiziko, yikhaya aphinde ebe ukhamba.''Indoda ikuphi lapho ezobe igane khona uma yona seyithatha isibongo somuntu wesifazane,'' ,'' kubuza uSolwazi VVO uMkhize
YIZE kusasele izinyanga ezine kuhlukaniswe unyaka kodwa iningi labaculi bakamaskandi seliphumele obala lathi lihamba nengoma yomculi waseMnambithi, uLethukuthula "uMafikizolo" Mhlongo, esihloko sithi Uyoncengwa Unyoko.Le ngoma seyiphenduke ihubo lesizwe eNingizimu Afrika kangangoba idlalwe okokuqala emsakazweni uKhozi FM kanye nakwiTop 40 yeMetro FM maqede yagidelwa ngisho nangabasakazi balezi ziteshi, okungoSomizi Mhlongo, Dineo Ranaka, Vusizwe Langa noBingelela Mpanza. NakuMhlobo Wenene beyigidelwa wumsakazi wakhona ongumlingisi weSmoke and Mirrors, uLusanda Mbane.Kubaculi bakamaskandi abahambisana nokuthi le ngoma isale seyisiwelisela ku-2026 kukhona Khuzani Mpungose, Mthandeni Manqele, Ntencane, Limit Nala, Menzi Mabizela, Ithwasa Lekhansela nabanye.Ephawula uMafikizolo (25) waseBusi, eWasbank, uthe ukujabulele kakhulu ukuzwa ozakwabo asebemnkantshubomvu kule ndima bekhuluma kanje."Lokhu kukhombise ukuthi sekunobumbano emculweni kamaskandi. Akusafani nakuqala lapho umculi kwakufanele aze athuke omunye ukuze umculo wakhe unakwe."Uthe ngesikhathi enza le ngoma wayekulindele ukuthi ithakaselwe kakhulu ukwedlula ezinye. Uthe okwenza lokho wukuthi uwumuntu ohlale efuna ukuqhamuka nento ehlukile kweyabanye futhi ugxile emculweni wothando.Le ngoma isanda kuqopha umlando ngokwephula irekhodi lengoma kaCiza ethi Isaka (6am) ngokuba nama-streams amaningi masontonke. Njengamanje inama-streams angaphezu kuka-1 367 million, idlula ekaCiza eno-1 289 million. Kuma-iTunes iqengqeleza phambili, idonsa izingoma zoKabza De Small ngomchilo kanti kwiYouTube seyidlalwe amahlandla angaphezu kuka-7.5 million ngenyamga eyodwa. Ilele isithathu ohlwini lwezingoma ezikwi-Local Top 10 ne-International Top 20 kuma- Official SA Charts ngenxa yokudlalwa kwayo kwiSpotify, Apple Music, Deezer nakwiYouTube Music. Ngaphandle kwalokho idanselwa ngapha nangapha kuleli, ngisho nasezinkundleni zemidlalo. Nasezikoleni abafundi babonakala beshaya umdanso futhi becula leli culo likaMafikizolo. Uze wathinteka ezinsukwini waze wayonikelela abafundi ababili basesikoleni saseVryheid, iSingama Primary, wathembisa ukubaxhasa ngomfaniswano wesikole.Nakuba konke kumhambela kahle emculweni uMafikizolo uveze ukuthi akasenabo abazali futhi uyise akamazi kanti nonina washona eseneminyaka emihlanu kuphela.Uthe esikoleni wagcina ephasele uGrade 11 eBusi Combined ngenxa yesimo esenzeka ekhaya nesagcina simphoqe ukuba ashiye ikhaya. Uthe awukho umsebenzi ayehlele ukuthi uzophila ngawo esafunda.Emculweni ungene ngo-2018 emuva kokuba wumlandeli womculo kaMjik'jelwa Ngubane ongasekho. Unezingane angasidalulanga isibalo sazo kodwa akakaganwa.
USIHLALO wenhlangano yababhali, i-Academic and Non-Fiction Authors Association of South Africa (ANFASA), uSolwazi Sihawukele Ngubane, ukhale ngabantu bomdabu abaxhumana ngolimi lwesiNgisi ekubeni zikhona abazincela ebeleni.Uthe lesi senzo sabo yiso esizoshabalalisa izilimi zendabuko kuleli. UNgubane ubeyisikhulumi esiqavile embuthanweni wababhali bamazwe ngamazwe, Iziko Art International Book Fair Festival eDurban Centrum Park, eThekwini. Uthe ababhali abangatatazeliswa ukuqhamuka ubuchwepheshe be-Artificial Intelligence (AI) ngoba luzofukula bona."Kukhona abaze bakhale ngokuthi luzobathathela imisebenzi."Uthe ababhali ababusebenzise ubuchwepheshe bamanje ukuze imisebenzi yabo ilondolozeke ingunaphakade, ize ificwe yisizukulwane esizayo. Eqhuba, uthe izilimi zabomdabu zikhathula enkulu indima ekufukuleni umnotho wakuleli, yingakho kusemqoka ukuqhakanjiswa kwemibhalo elotshwe ngolimi lwebele ezivakashini zakwamanye amazwe. Lo mcimbi uqale ngengxoxo ebinezikhulumi ezintathu okubalwa kuzo, uSiyabonga Ndlozi ongumshicileli obemele Umlazi International Film Festival, Nkk Hlengiwe Ngcongo obemele uMnyango wezeMidlalo, ezobuCiko namaSiko KwaZulu-Natal, nombhali ovela enhlanganweni yabalobi Usiba Writer's Guild, uNkk Busisiwe Maphumulo.Le nkulumo beyigxile kakhulu ekufundiseni ababhali ukuthi bangayithuthukisa kanjani imibhalo yabo ngokwesimo sezobuchwepheshe besimanje, amasu okuziphilisa ngemisebenzi yabo kanjalo nokushicilelwa kwemisebenzi yabo. Ezinye izikhulimi nezihambeli ebezizimazise kuMasipala weTheku, kuMasipala waseMsunduzi nowase-Ingquza Hill, e-Eastern Cape. Nalezi zikhulumi ziwuncome kakhulu lo mcimbi futhi zafisa ukuba usabalalale nakwezinye izifundazwe nezifunda. Umphathi wohlelo bekuwumsakazi woKhozi FM, uZandile "Zeal" Dladla. Umsunguli wale ngqungquthela, uMuntomuhle Mcambi, ubonge kakhulu bonke abaphumelelile, wanxusa neminyango kahulumeni ukuthi ifake isandla ngoxhaso ukuze kusizakale intsha edingayo.Omunye wabathule inkulumo ekhethekile kule ngqungquthela eqale ngoLwesihlanu olwedlule, wuSolwazi Langalibalele Mathenjwa oyisazi samasiko, usomlando nombhali osemkantshabomvu. Imbenge yalo mbuthano isongwa namhlanje lapho kuzobonakala ababhali bamazwe ngamazwe becikoza bededelana phambi kwezithameli, okubalwa kuzo abafundi bezikole ezihlukahlukene.
SEKUQUBUKE omunye umsindo phakathi kwabaculi bakamaskandi abayinkukhu nempaka, uXolisani Mbeje noMzomuhle "Swidi Gcabashe" Mnyandu. Kulokhu lezi zinsizwa ziqhathwe yingoma. USwidi ukhiphe kuqala i-albhamu esihloko sithi Hamba Nqola Yami, enengoma esihloko sithi Ngelus' Amabhubesi, ngo-Agasti 29 kulo nyaka. Kuthe ngoLwesihlanu olwedlule waqhamuka uMbeje nomucu osihloko sithi Lathi Ichunu Asohlupha.Lezi zingoma zifana ngesigqi nangezinye izinhlamvu kodwa esidlalwe kakhulu kwiYouTube ngekaSwidi njengoba seyinama-views angaphezu kuka-350 000 emuva kwamasonto amabili ekubeni ekaMbeje isenawu-165 000 kwiYouTube emuva kwezinsuku eziwu-9. Uma usayikhumbula ingoma kaSwidi ethi Emahostela, ihamba ngaleso sigqi. Bekhuluma kwiBhanyazile TV, uSwidi uthe siyamcika ngempela isenzo sikaMbeje futhi uyacela abasondelene naye bamkhuze ngoba umculo uwumsebenzi, akusiniswa amahleza. Eziphendulela uMbeje uthe kungamampunge ukuthi uyena owebe ingoma kaSwidi. Uthe uyena owenza le ngoma kuqala e-studio kwase kuqhamuka umfowabo kaSwidi wayeba wayinikeza uSwidi njengoba sekuthiwa ngeyakhe. Akukhona okokuqala uMbeje ethatha ngehheshe ingoma kaSwidi. Ngomunye unyaka wayicula emcimbini yona le ethi Emahostela.Omunye umculi osishayile isigqi sengoma ebangwayo nguGqibu, ogadle kubo bobabili uSwidi noMbeje ngengoma ethi Umdolofiya. Yona inama-views angaphezu kuka-6 000 emuva kwezinsuku eziyisithupha iphumile. UMbeje uthe uyizwile ingoma kaGqibu kodwa ayifiki kweyakhe futhi iyahlulwa ngekaSwidi.
AWASIZWA kahle isinqumo sokubuyiselwa esihlalweni kwenkosi eyixhegu elineminyaka engaphezu kuka-100 amanye amalungu obukhosi baKwaMashabane, KwaMhlabuyalingana.Amanye amalungu omndeni athi siwadidile isinqumo sikahulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal sokubuyisela esikhundleni Inkosi Sizabantu Gumede, eneminyaka engu-105.UGumede wehla esihlalweni ngo-2015, kuthiwa wazicelela yena ukwehla ekhala ngokuthi usemdala.Kwabe sekuqokwa indodana yakhe, Inkosi uSipho Sunnboy Gumede, ukuba ithathe isihlalo. Ekuqaleni kwalo nyaka uhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal wathatha isinqumo sokubiyisela uGumede esikhundleni. Okhulumela ubukhosi baKwaMashabane, uMnuz Phila Gumede, uthe ngesikhathi uGumede ecela ukwehla esikhundleni kwabizwa zonke izindlu zobukhosi besizwe.Uthe zonke izindlu, uMbango, Izicethe, Izisongo noMgobeni, zavumelana nesicelo sikaGumede sokwehla esikhundleni.Uqhube ngokuthi kubamangazile ukuzwa sekuthiwa sekubuyiselwa uGumede esihlalweni."Kwafika aboMnyango (wokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu) bezosazisa ukuthi kubuyiselwa inkosi endala esikhundleni. Bathi bathole incwadi eqhamuka emndenini. Okusididayo ke ukuthi yimuphi lowo mndeni ngoba abaveli abantu okuthiwa babhala incwadi. Uhulumeni awuzange uxhumane nathi, wafika nje ususitshela ukuthi usubuyisela inkosi endala esihlalweni. Ngesikhathi ungena lo hulumeni ophethe KwaZulu-Natal, awuzange uphenye ngalolu daba. Wavele nje wamukela incwadi."Umkhulumeli uthe uGumede akakulungele ukuhlala esihlalweni ngenxa yokuba mdala."Inkosi yayivele ikhalile kwasekuqaleni ukuthi ayisakwazi ukwenza imisebenzi yesizwe ngenxa yokuba buthaka. Manje sekwedlulele. Nasemqondweni inkosi isiyingane."Umkhulumeli usole izinduna athe zazihlomula ngesikhathi kusaphethe uGumede ukuthi yizona ezibe nesandla ekutheni abuyiselwe esihlalweni. "Iningi labantu abasemkhandlwini yibona ababehlomula kakhulu ngesikhathi kusaphethe inkosi endala. Inkosi yayingasakwazi ukuya emihlanganweni, kwakuhamba bona. Bake baya ngisho phesheya."Kuyimanje banqabela amalungu omndeni ukuba aye lapho kukhona inkosi. Baxosha izinduna zomndeni. Ziyisithupha izinduna ababhale izincwadi zokuba zixoshwe."Okhulumela uhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Bongani Gina, uthe nguGumede owacela ukuba kwehliswe indodana yakhe esikhundleni. "Inkosi ithe yona yayingaqondile ukuqoka indodana yayo ukuba ibe yinkosi, kodwa yayiqoka ukuba ibe yiso layo. Wayengaqondile ukubeka enye inkosi ekubeni esaphila."UGina uthe lolu daba kwakhulunywa ngalo emhlanganweni weKhabhinethi yesifundazwe ngoJanuwari, kwabe sekuthathwa isinqumo sokuba kubuyiselwe inkosi endala."Lolu wudaba olubucayi kakhulu. Kodwa iKhabhinethi yanquma ukubuyisela inkosi endala esihlalweni."
APHELILE amahlathi okucasha kothishanhloko abangababiki othisha abadlwengula abafundi ezikoleni njengoba kwabona bethathwa njengabanecala emehlweni oMnyango weMfundo eyisiSekelo, nasemkhandlwini olawula othisha kuleli iSouth African Council for Educators (SACE).Lokhu kuvezwe nguMqondisi Jikelele eMnyangweni, uMnuz Mathanzima Mweli, nesikhulu esiphezulu seSACE, uNksz Ella Mokgalane.UMweli obekhuluma emhlanganweni wekomiti lasePhalamende muva nje, uthe othishanhloko bayayazi imigomo okumele bayilandele uma kunomfundi odlwenguliwe noma okhuleliswe nguthisha."Kunemigomo yothishanhloko abayaziyo kanti uma sithola ulwazi ngabahlukumeza abafundi sithatha izinyathelo ngokushesha. Sivula amacala, othishanhloko bayazi ukuthi uma bengabiki, bathathwa njengabantu abanecala. Asidlali uma kuza kothisha abadlwengula abafundi," usho kanje. UNksz Mokgalane, uthe kunemigomo eyaziwayo ezikoleni okumele ilandelwe uma kunothisha ohlukumeze umfundi.Uthe abanye othishanhloko bayawafihla la macala ngoba basuke bevikela igama lesikole."Abanye bafihla ngoba kukhona abasuke bezokuthola okuyintshontsho kulowo thisha osuke egile umkhuba. Nguthishanhloko okumele abike uma kukhona okwenzekile esikoleni ngoba nguyena ophethe isikole. Umthetho ucacile ukuthi kumele babike kanti uma sithola ukuthi bahluleke wukubika, sibabeka icala ngoba bafana nabantu abanecala," usho kanje.Uthe nomthetho wezingane ukubeka kucace ukuthi kumele kubikelwe amaphoyisa uma kudlwengulwe umfundi. Ubalule ukuthi othisha abalahlwa amacala afuze lawa bathathelwa izinyathelo ezehlukene okubalwa ukusulwa unomphela ohlwini lwabantu abangafundisa kuleli."Izigwebo ziyahluka, uma mhlawumbe ugcine ngokweshela ingane wangaqhubekela phambili, ubanjelwa umholo noma umiswe isikhashana esithile. Uma wenze elinzima kakhulu njengokudlwengula, uyasulwa ohlwini lokufundisa bese ufakwa nasohlwini lwabantu okungamele basebenze nezingane kuleli," usho kanje.Uthe njengoba kuyiSACE ebhalisa othisha, uma ususuliwe ohlwini awube usakwazi ukusebenza kuleli.
BATHI liphume nobomvu ngokuhoxiswa kwezichibiyelo emthethweni iNational Credit Act, obezizokwenza ukuthi abakweleta izikhungo zemfundo bafakwe kwa-credit bureau ngoba behluleka ukukhokha.Lokhu kuvezwe yizinhlangano ezehlukene zezitshudeni, kubalwa ne-ANC, ebezikhala ngokuthi lesi sinyathelo sizozicwilisa shi obishini abakweletayo ukuthi bangakwazi ukuphunyuka ebubheni.UNgqongqoshe wezoHwebo, iziMboni nezokuNcintisana, uMnuz Parks Tau, uhoxise lezi zichibiyelo kulo mthetho emva kokuthola izikhalazo. Uthe babalelwa ku-20 000 abalethe izethulo ngaphambi kokuba kuvalwe ukuphawula komphakathi obekungoLwesihlanu."Iningi lezethulo belichitha lezi zichibiyelo kulo mthetho, yingakho kudingeke sizihoxise. Lolu hlelo luveze ukuvuthwa kwentando yeningi ngoba umphakathi uphawulile, uzwakalisa imibono ehlukene. Sizobuyela siyoyibheka kabanzi eyokuthi izitshudeni zingavikeleka kanjani."Uthe bazoxhumana nazo zonke izinhlaka ngomuso ngaphambi kokuba bashicilele imigomo."Sizobe sehlisa nemimoya siphinde sichazele umphakathi ukuthi uhlelo luzohamba kanjani," kusho uTau. UNksz Nonceba Mhlauli oyiPhini likaNgqongqoshe eHhovisi likaMengameli, wakuveza ukuthi uhulumeni uzimisele ukwehlisa umthwalo obhekene nentsha nezikweletu kwezemfundo.Izinhlangano iSasco, ANC Youth League, EFF, eyemikhandlu yamaSRC ezikhungweni zemfundo iSouth African Union of Students, ibiyichitha eyokufakwa kwezitshudeni kwa-credit bureau.ISasco ithe yeneme ngalesi sinyathelo yathi kodwa kumele kube nengxoxo yokuthi zisulwa kanjani izikweletu zentsha kwezemfundo. Ithe kumele kufakwe ingcindezi ezikhungweni zemfundo ukuthi zesule lezi zikweletu."Izikhungo kumele zisebenzise imali egcinwe ezinqolobaneni ukuze zikhokhele izikweletu zezitshudeni. Imfundo yilungelo ngakho kumele ibe mahhala ukuze uwonke wonke ezohlomula," kusho iSasco.I-SAUS ithe lo mnyakazo ubuzovimba izitshudeni eziphothule iziqu ukuthi zithole umsebenzi. Ithe izitshudeni azikwazi ukuthola izitifiketi zazo ukuze zikwazi ukuyofuna umsebenzi ngenxa yezikweletu."Simile ekutheni kumele kusulwe zonke izikweletu zezitshudeni ukuze zikwazi ukuthola umsebenzi. Ukucwila kwazo ezikweletini kwenza zingakwazi ukuqhubekela phambili." UMnuz Sihle Lonzi we-EFF obelwa nalesi siphakamiso, uthe bayakwamukela ukuhoxiswa kwaso ngoba besizokwenza abakweletayo bangakwazi ukuqhubekela phambili. Uthe bazofaka isiphakamiso kulo mthetho ukuthi izikhungo zemfundo zingafakwa ohlwini lokuthi abazikweletayo bafakwe kwa-credit bureau."Akekho okumele avinjwe ukuthi athole imfundo. Impi ayiphelile, isaqhubeka," usho kanje.UNobhala Jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, ukwamukele ukuhoxiswa kwalezi zichibiyelo, wathi kasihambisani nemigomo kaKhongolose."Akumele kuvinjwe intsha efuna imfundo yingakho sikwamukelwa ukuhoxiswa kwalezi zichibiyelo. Sinxusa nomkhakha ozimele ukuthi uqhubeke nokuqasha intsha ukuze ithole amathuba," kusho uMbalula.
NgoMgqibelo ebusuku, ku-N2 phakathi kwe-Shaka's Rock neMandeni, i-IPSS Medical Rescue iphendule izingozi ezine ezahlukene, ezishiye abantu abayisikhombisa beshonile.Izingozi ezintathu zibandakanya abantu abathathu abebehamba ngezinyawo, abashayiswe yemoto bafa.Engozini yesisathathu umshayeli wemoto uhlulekile ukuyilawula ngemuva kokushayisa umuntu obehamba ngezinyawo ngase-Shakas Rock, imoto yakhe yagqamuka amalangabi, okudabukisayo umshayeli ushe washona.Eduze kwaseMandeni, isigameko sesine sishiye abantu abathathu baphangalele.,Abe-IPSS Medical Rescue Advanced Life Support Paramedics bafike kule ndawo bathola ababili abalimele noyedwa eyesithathu ngaphambi kokuphuthunyiswa esibhedlela. AMAKHOSI ezindlu ezehlukene zakwaMchunu, KwaZulu-Natal, asephumele obala athi azomxhasa noma kwenzenjani uNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa osamisiwe, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu.Akusho lokhu emhlanganweni akade ewubambele eWestville, eThekwini, nala ebebize khona uMchunu efuna awachazele ukuthi umsindo uthinta igama lakhe olokhu ukhona ngowani.Embuthanweni bekukhona amakhosi aqhamuka ezindlini ezahlukene okukhona kuzo uMsinga, Dundee, Mzimkhulu nakwezinye izindawo.UMnuz Bhekimpi Mchunu obehola umhlangano, uthe bebesahleli ebumnyameni ngokuqhubekayo kungakho bekhethe usuku lwanamhlanje ukuthi bahlangane bewuzalo bezwe ukuthi yini eholele kulesi simo esikhona manje."Kukhona konke okuzokwenzeka siyameseka owakwethu kodwa okusenze sasukuma ukuthi sifuna ukwazi ukuthi owani umsindi okhona othinta yena, bese sithule isikhathi eside silana sifuna ukuzofuna incazelo,” kusho yena.INkosi uSiyabonga Mchunu ithe ngeke babukele owozalo lwabo enikizwa emphakathini bengazi ukuthi umsuka wakho konke lokhu ukuphi."Okwamanje nathi sifuna ukuzwa ngaye ukuthi kwenzakalani ngempela, wanikizwa nje emphakathini yini edale konke lokhu? Sihlanganile naye emhlanganweni wasichazela konke ngakho akukho esingakusho kwabezindaba ngalokhu asitshele khona. Uveze ukuthi akulindwe ikhomishini ngoba iyona eyodalula konke kodwa njengowozalo wethu simi naye kulokhu asesibikele khona. Siyameseka kuyoze kube sekugcineni,” kuchaza yena.Ungqongqoshe akaphawulanga lutho kwabezindaba njengoba kuvele ukuthi konke useyokuveza kwiKhomishini kaMadlanga okulindeleke ukuthi iqale ngeSonto elizayo, eGauteng.Kodwa ekupheleni komhlangano ubonge amakhosi ngokumeseka nokuhlangana naye ukuze azowavezela okwenzekayo.Uveze kancane ukuthi usekulungele ukuya kukhomishana ukuze ayophendula ngezinsolo ezibhekiswe kuye.Kuyona kuvela ukuthi kuyoqala kufakaze uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uMkhwanazi okunguye owaveza izinto eziningi ezingahambi kahle embuthweni wamaphoyisa.
UNDUNANKULU waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, ugonyuluke okokuqala ngombango wobukhosi oshisaphansi eMdletsheni kwaHlabisa.Ukuqonga kwalo mbango kuze kwenza inkantolo yesizwe yangqongqiswa emuva kwembibizane etholwe yinkosi yaseMdletsheni, uZolani Siphesihle Mdletshe, esale kanjalo emva kokuba uhulumeni uvume ukuqokwa kukaMakabongwe Simangaliso Mdletshe, njengenkosi ekubeni uZolani ehlezi esihlalweni.Eziphendulela engxoxweni ekhethekile nethimba labahleli, izintatheli nezikhulu zase-Independent Media,eThekwini, uNtuli uthe lesi kube yisinqumo esithathwe ngamaqembu asesiShayamthetho sakulesi sifundazwe emuva kokuba uMakabongwe evunwe yinkantolo. UNtuli uphendule kanje emuva kokuba amalungu omphakathi angenelisekile ekhombe ngenjumbane uhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal ngokuphehla udweshu ngenxa yokuthi uvume ukuqokwa kukaMakabongwe ukuba athathe isihlalo obese kuhlale kuso uZolani kusukela ngo-2021.UMakabongwe uzalwa owayeyibambabukhosi, uBonga Mdletshe, uZolani ungumzukulu wenkosi ewumfowabo kaBonga, uSipho Mdletshe.UBonga, owabamba ubukhosi kusukela ngo-1982, wayeyilungu le-IFP esiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal, kanti kuthiwa wayebambele indodana kaSipho eyayisencane ngokweminyaka ngesikhathi kukhothama uyise, uDlozilabadletshe.UDlozilabadletshe ozala uZolani, akazange abuthathe ubukhosi ngenxa yokuthi wake waboshwa.Ngo-2021, owayenguMphathiswa wokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu ngaleso sikhathi, uMnuz Sihle Zikalala, wabhala incwadi echitha uBonga njengebambabukhosi, wabe esevuma ukuqokwa kukaZolani njengenkosi.UZolani ubelokhu ehlezi esihlalweni eyithola nemihlomulo yakhe kuhulumeni njengoba egcine ukuhola ngenyanga eyedlule.Kuleli sonto kushintshile ukudla epuletini ngesikhathi uMnyango wokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu, wazisa umndeni nomkhandlu wenkosi ngokuqokwa kwenkosi entsha emhlanganweni obusenkantolo yenkosi.UNdunankulu wesizwe, uMnuz Wiber Mdletshe, usole uMnyango wokuBusa ngokuBambisana kanye neziNdaba zoMdabu ngokuba budedengu.UWiber uthe uMnyango awuzange ulusingathe ngobunono lolu daba futhi uqhatha izingane zenkosi, "kufana nokuthi babeka enye inkosi phezu kwenye inkosi. Bona aboMnyango bekufanele babhalele uZolani, bamazise ukuthi uyakhishwa esihlalweni. Bebezothini ukube bekusuka udlame emhlanganweni? Bebezothini ukuba bekushayana abantu khona emhlanganweni? Ngizitshelile izikhulu zomnyango ukuthi kuyodingeka kusolwe zona uma kuke kwachitheka igazi lapha eMdletsheni. Siphoxwa wuhulumeni siwethemba."UWiber uthe isimo simazonzo njengoba sekushiswe inkantolo yenkosi."Inkulu imvunge, abantu kabajabule impela. Emuva komhlangano kwashiswa inkantolo yenkosi."Nakuba engazange anabe uWiber kodwa usole inhlese yezepolitiki ngokukhishwa kukaZolani esikhundleni."Uhulumeni bawuphethe ngokobuqembu. Ayilungile le nto abayenzayo. Uhulumeni akufanele usebenze ngokobuqembu."Emuva kokuphawula ngalolu daba, uNtuli ubuye waveza ukuthi uhulumeni wokubambisana eKZN unqanyulelwe isamba sikaR70 billion kodwa sewuyenzile imisebenzi eminingi emihle. Ubuye waveza ukuthi baphezu kokulwa nobugebengu eNanda njengoba benzile eNewcastle.Eqhuba uthe umnotho wesifundazwe ukhule ngo-0.8 percent. Ebuzwa ngezisulu zezikhukhula, uthe bahlele ukuhambisa imindeni ewu-130 emizini emisha eyakhiwa eCornubia ngoDisemba kulo nyaka neminye ngonyaka ozayo. Ubuye wathembisa ukuqinisa ezokuphepha ezikoleni.

KUSOLAKALA ukuthi bebehlela ukuthwala ngomndeni wabo wonke abazukulu abakhonjwa ngokubulala uninakhulu esigamekweni esenzeke, eMlaba Village, eHammarsdale, eThekwini, ngeledlule. Lokhu kuvezwe yindodana kamufi, uMnuz Bheki Nyoka, othe bayasola ukuthi laba bebedlala inyanga ethize ebibathembisa ingcebo noma bebejoyine izinhlangano ezihambisana nemisebenzi kaSathane njengoba kukhona izincwadi abangaziqondi abazithole endlini abakade belala kuyo.Isidumbu sikaNkk Sarah Grace Mnguni (78) sitholwe sidindilizile egumbini lakhe lokulala ngoLwesibili, lwesonto eledlule. Kulesi sigameko kusolwa umzukulu (16) wakhe ofunda uGrade 12 ePhezulu High nomzukulwana (12) ofunda uGrade 7 eSinenzuzo Primary. Kusolwa ukuthi bambulala ngokumcindezela ubuso ngendwangu ematiswe ngotinasi ebusuku ngoMsombuluko. "Ebusuku ngoLwesibili, sithole izincwadi ebezinanyekwe esicabheni. Uma sizivula kubhalwe amagama esingawaqondi nje kodwa kukhona asho ukubulala kuwo. Siyathuthumela ukuthi ngempela lezi zingane bezihloseni kodwa esikusolayo ukuthi kukhona ezisebenza nabo ukuthi zijuqe amalungu emindeni, ubuSathane bonke lobu. Okunye esikubonayo ukuthi lezi zingane bezihlele ukuthwala ngenxa yokuthi bezinesibalo sabantu ezifuna ukubabulala abangamalungu omndeni wazo,” kusho uNyoka.Uthe abakufunayo manje ukuthi kubuye imiphumela yokuhlolwa kwesidumbu bese kuboshwa abasolwa yize kuthiwa basebancane."Njengomndeni sibafuna ejele laba. Omunye umakhelwane usitshela ukuthi lezi zingane bezingalali ebusuku zenza izinto ezingaqondakali lapha egcekeni. Okunye, ubaba wazo washona ngokudutshulwa, bayasho omakhelwane ukuthi lona omdala ubehlala eya la kwashonela khona uyise afike ame isikhathi eside, bengazi ukuthi wenzani nesisola ukuthi kungenzeka wayeseqale le mikhuba, nokungenzeka baba nesandla ekudluleni kwakhe ngale ndlela,” kuchaza yena.Uveze ukuthi konke lokhu abakutholile bazokugcina kodwa bayabheka ukuthi wobani akade besebenzisana nabenzi bokubi.Bathe abazifuni lezi zingane ukuba zibuye ekhaya ezigile lo mkhuba.UNyoka uke wadalula ukuthi lo omdala ufike uLwesihlanu, emva kokudedelwa amaphoyisa watshela ebebekhona egcekeni ukuthi "sekufike amabhoza". "Kuthiwa uqathazwe yiBMW, wathi akekho ozohlala kulo muzi, uzowubhomba (ngebhomu),” kusho uNyoka.Ugcizelele ukuthi bakhathazekile ngokuthi kukhona abasebenzisana naye, kubona uthe bezwa ngandlebenye ukuthi kukhona uthisha wesikole omfake ekhwapheni kodwa ebe eyazi imikhuba yakhe.Waveza ukuthi kuphutshuke iphepha elinohlu lwabantu ebebethi bazobabulala. Kulona bekuhamba phambili igama likamufi, kuze elikaNyoka, kube elikamakhelwane, namanye.Akukaziwa ukuthi uzongcwatshwa nini umufi njengoba kusalindwe imiphumela yokuhlolwa kwesidumbu. Uthe nedokodo elisavuliwe emaphoyiseni elokufa komuntu, athe bathemba ukuthi lizoshintsha libe elokubulala uma sekubuya imiphumela.
AKUFANELE engabe ubegibela imoto ashonele kuyo omunye wabafundi abahlanu ababhubhe engozini yemoto eyenzeke Unit 18, eMbali, izolo. UMthobisi Khambule ubegibela kwenye imoto kodwa yena washintsha wagibela lena ashonele kuyona ngoba nakhu elandela abangani. Lokhu kuvezwe umkhulu wakhe, uMnuz Xolani Zakwe, ngesikhathi ekhuluma neSolezwe. UMthobisi, obefunda eFundokuhle Secondary, ushone kanye nabanye abafundi abane ngesikhathi imoto abeyigibele iphaphalaza iyoshayisa inkulisa.Umshayeli kuthiwa wehlulekile ukulawula imoto, yaya kokhalakatheka enkulisa iSenzokuhle.UZakwe uthe wamangala ngesikhathi ebona umzukulu egibele kule moto ashonele kuyo."Imoto lena engangimfake kuyo iyashesha ukuhamba. Ngabona ngelinye ilanga ephuza ukuhamba, ngase ngibuza ukuthi kungani ephuza ukuhamba ngoba imoto ayigibelayo iyashesha ukuhamba? Wangitshela ukuthi usegibela kule moto ngoba abangani bakhe bagibela kuyona."UZakwe uthe kumshaqisile ukushona kukaMthobisi athe ubesabheke lukhulu kuyena."Kubuhlungu ukushona komuntu lapho ubusuboba khona ukuthi ubhekephi njengoba ebesezosiqeda isikole."Imoto ibilayishe abafundi iningi labo abasuka e-Azalea, abafunda ezikoleni eziseMbali. Abafundi abebekuleli tekisi bafunda eSukuma Comprehensive, Zibekezulu Secondary, Fundokuhle Secondary naseHenryville Primary.Abafundi abane bashonele khona endaweni yesigameko, owesihlanu ushone ngesikhathi ephuthunyiswa esibhedlela. Abafundi abahlanu abalimele baphuthunyiswe ezibhedlela.Bekuwumunyu wodwa ngesikhathi abazali beqinisekisa izingane zabo ezishone kule ngozi.Ngokusho kwabazibonele, umshayeli uphume imoto ihamba ngesikhathi ebona ukuthi ayisalawuleki.Umshayeli kuthiwa ukhale ngokuthi imoto iphelelwe amabhuleki endaweni eyehlelayo.Imoto ifike yashayisa izinsimbi eziseceleni komgwaqo endaweni eyijika elibi.Imoto ibe isidlula nazo izinsimbi, yashayisa isihlahla ngaphambi kokuthi ibhodloze inkulisa.
INDLUNKULU kaZulu ithi ikulindele ukuthi kungezeka kube nobuhixihixi eMkhosini woMhlanga sesigodlweni eMashobeni, oPhongolo, kusasa.Okhulumela iSilo, uMntwana uThulani Zulu, uthe kungenzeka kube khona izingqinamba njengoba kuzokuba kuqala ukuthi uMkhosi woMhlanga ubanjelwe esigodlweni eMashobeni. Eminyakeni ewu-40 eyedlule, uMkhosi woMhlanga ububanjelwa esigodlweni eNyokeni. "Ziningi izinkulumo ezibe khona ngokususwa komhlanga eNyonkeni. Indlela abantu abakhuluma ngayo ungathi eMashobeni, akukhona esigodlweni. Abantu kufanele bazi ukuthi zonke izigodlo ezeSilo. Kungenzeka kube nezinselelo ngenxa yokuthi kuzokube kuqala ukuba uMkhosi woMhlanga ube seMashobeni. Sizohlala phansi emva komkhosi, sibuke ukuthi ikuphi okungahambanga kahle, bese sibona ukuthi singakulungisa kanjani. Indawo esiqalayo ukuya kuyo, sonke sisayijwayela. Sinethemba lokuthi yonke into ilungisiwe."Ekhuluma ngamalungiselelo, uMntwana uThulani uthe konke sekumi ngomumo."Sijabule kakhulu. Izintombi kuzo zonke izingxenye zeKwaZulu-Natal nasezweni jikelele ziyaviva. Izintombi zivivela uMkhosi woMhlanga. Sikulungele ukwamukela Izintombi. ISilo sizokube sikhona, sizokhuluma nezintombi. ISilo sizoyala Izintombi, sigqugquzele ukuziphatha kahle ezintombini. Imbiza izobe iziwa ngothi, bayaye bathi ke abanye intaka ibekelwe amazolo."UMntwana unxuse ukubekezelela kubashayeli abazokube belibhekise eMashobeni. UMntwana uThulani uthe kunamabhuloho amabili aseduze nesigodlo okuwela imoto eyodwa ngesikhathi. "Uma siyalapha engathi ukuhamba kwethu kungaba nokubekezelelana. Uma uqhamuka ngasoPhongolo kunebhuloho eliwumncingo, okulindwanayo kulo. Sifisa ukuthi kube nokubekezelelana kubashayeli. Noma uqhamuka ngaKwaKhangela nakhona kunebhuloho eliwumcingo okufuneka ukuthi kube nokubekezelelana. Ngiyathemba ukuthi sizobambisana namaphoyisa omgwaqo. Uma kuthiwa mana, kuyobe kusalindwe omunye ukuthi awele. Nawe ungabe usuwenza ngendlela yakho ezokwenza ukuthi kube nenkinga."
UMENGAMELI Cyril Ramaphosa ufuna isithangami ngesimo sezwe sihambe size sifinyelele nasezikoleni zaseNingizimu Afrika.Ufuna abafundi ukuthi bahlale phansi baxoxe ngesimo sezwe, izinto abafuna zenzeke ezweni kanjalo nemfundo abayifunayo"Ngizophakamisa ethimbeni elihlela ingxoxo ngesimo sezwe ukuthi ezikoleni, kube nesikhathi nje esizobekwa eceleni, abafundi baxoxe ngezinto ezibathintayo ezweni. Ngifuna baxoxe ngesimo sezemfundo nezinto abafuna ukuzibona zenzeka ezweni," usho kanje.Ephendula imibuzo ePhalamende izolo, uthe washaya amakhala ngesikhathi ebona imali eyayizosebenza kule ngxoxo."Ngathi akukwazi ukuthi kungasebenza imali ebalelwa ku-R700 million engxoxweni ngezwe. Abantu babekhala ngokuthi imali izokhwabaniswa, yehliswe ngomlenze kule ngxoxo, sabaqinisekisa ukuthi sizoyiqapha ngelokhozi ukuthi isebenza ngendlela," usho kanje. Uthe ngeke baphoqe muntu ukuthi abe yingxenye yengxoxo ngesimo sezwe ngoba ngisho ihhashi noma ungaliyisa emfuleni, ngeke uliphoqe ukuthi liphuze amanzi.,Odabeni oluthinta ukwehliswa kwesibalo songqongqoshe kwiKhabhinethi, uthe amaqembu abambisene kuhulumeni avumelana ukuthi ibambe ngakho ngesibalo sabo njengoba wonke amaqembu amelelekile.Kunesikhalo ngokuthi igcwele iyachichima iKhabhinethi njengoba emaningi amaphini ongqongqoshe ekubeni ngabe sehliswa isibalo sawo."Muhle umsebenzi owenziwa amaphini ongqongqoshe, ababambisene nongqongqoshe. Nami ngikhathazekile ngesibalo sabakwiKhabhinethi kodwa inkinga ukuthi wonke amaqembu kumele amemeleke. Ngokwami bengifisa ukuthi sehle isibalo kodwa akhona amaphini enza umsebenzi oncomekayo kuhulumeni," usho kanje. Uveze nokuthi bayaxoxa nezwe laseMelika, odabeni oluthinta ukuhwebelana kwalawa mazwe."Siyaqhubeka nezingxoxo ngezohwebo neMelika ngoba yizwe esibambisene nalo kakhulu. Maduzane sizomemezela inxusa elizobe lizinze eMelika njengoba ngithola iziphakamiso eziningi ngabantu okumele ngibajubele kulesi sikhundla."Uzwakalise ukudumala ngokuhamba kancane kokubunjwa komkhandlu ozobhekela udlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane nezingane."Iyangikhathaza ukuthi namanje lo mkhandlu awukabunjwa ukulwa nalesi sihlava esihlasele izwe. Indaba yodlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane yinto okumele siyinqobe."
IPHINI likaMengameli, uMnuz Paul Mashatile, liphumele obala lathi kwakungamele elakuleli lithembele kuhulumeni waseMelika ngoxhaso lokulwa nokubhebhetheka kwe-HVI/AIDS.UMashatile uthe sesifikile isikhathi sokuthi izwe lidlinze ngomcabango ukuze liphume nomkhombandlela wokuthi kusadingeka yini ukuthembela kwamanye amazwe ukuze axhase elakuleli."Kwakungamele sithembele eMelika isikhathi eside kanje ukuthi isize ezinhlelweni zokulwa ne-HIV/AIDS kuleli. Lokhu kusifake enkingeni njengezwe elizimele njengoba sesishayeka. Ayiningi nokho imali esixhaswa ngayo yiMelika njengoba cishe bekungu-R8 billion kuphela," usho kanje. Uthe akumele izwe libuyele emuva ezintweni ezithinta ingculazi kodwa kumele liqhubeke nokuhlinzeka ngemishanguzo noma lungasekho uxhaso lwaseMelika.Ukusho lokhu izolo ephendula imibuzo eNdlini yoMkhandlu weziFundazwe ePhalamende.Ukhulume kanje kulandela ukuhoxiswa koxhaso lweMelika, obelusiza kakhulu empini yokulwa ne-HIV nengculazi kuleli. Lo mgomo akuwona onomthelela ekutheni kwande isibalo sabantu abangasebenzi kuleli. Ziningi izinto ezidala ukuthi kwande abantu abangasebenzi kuleli. Ngeke ngivume ukuthi kubuye imithetho yobandlululo."Ubuye wakhala ngesikweletu somasipala ezinhlanganweni ezibahlinzeka ngamanzi kuleli. Uveze ukuthi le nkinga iyabakhathaza ngoba abanye omasipala bayayiqoqa imali."Isikweletu sakamuva siveza ukuthi omasipala bakweleta u-R25.6 billion, izinhlangano ezihlinzeka ngamanzi kuleli. Lokhu kwenza ukuthi lezi zinhlangano ziguqe ngamadolo," usho kanje.Uthe amanzi amaningi aphelela emhlabathini, awafinyeleli komasipala."Kunenkinga enkulu kuleli yokuthi amanzi amaningi ayavuza, aphelela emhlabathini okwenza ukuthi angafinyeleli kubantu. Le nkinga idinga ukusukunyelwa ngokushesha."
UMENGAMELI woPhiko lwentsha lwe-ANC, uMnuz Collen Malatji, uthe uma amalungu ale nhlangano eqhubeka nokuhuqa ubuthongo, kuzoba ngumlando ukuthi kwake kwabakhona le nhlangano eyakhulula abantu kuleli.UMalatji uthe amaqembu i-ANC ebambisene nawo kuhulumeni, afuna ukuqeda ngayo."Utshani obulele buvuswa ngomlilo, uma siqhubeka nokulala siyophaphama sekuwumlando ukuthi kwake kwaba nenhlangano eyaziwa nge-ANC kuleli, eyakhulula abantu. Awukwazi ukuthi ungakhuluma ngemfundo kahulumeni ekubeni izingane zakho ozithanda kakhulu uziyisa ezikoleni ezizimele" Uthe bafuna kusulwe zonke izikweletu zezitshudeni ezigcina sezenza ukuthi zingakwazi ukuthola umsebenzi."Sifuna izitshudeni ezikweletayo zingafakwa kwi-credit bureau. AMAKHANSELA akuMasipala waseThekwini afuna umkhandlu usukumele izinkinga ezibhekana namatshitshi akulo mkhandludolobha eMkhosini woMhlanga.Amakhansela athe awafuni ukuzwa kuthiwa nakulo nyaka kukhona izimbali zesizwe ezijikile eziswele amabhasi noma ezizofike ziswele ukudla nendawo yokulala eMkhosini woMhlanga ozokuba esigodlweni eMashobeni, oPhongolo, ngesonto elizayo.Akusho lokhu emva kokuba umkhandlu uveze ukuthi ubeke eceleni u-R1.4 million wokuxhasa izintombi zomhlanga.Imali izosetshenziselwa ukuqasha amabhasi kanye nendawo yokulala izintombi kulo mkhosi wezinsuku ezimbili.Ngokombiko owethulwe emhlanganweni womkhandlu obungoLwesithathu, zingu- 1 780 izintombi eziqhamuka eThekwini ezizoxhaswa.Izintombi zizophelezelwa yizikhulu zomkhandlu eziyisishiyagalombili ezizoqinisekisa ukuthi konke kuhamba kahle.Amakhansela athe kufanele umasipala wenze isiqiniseko sokuthi uqasha amabhasi anele kanye nezindawo zokulala ezanele.Ikhansela le-DA, uNksz Bawinile Nxumalo, lithe zaba ziningi izikhalo ngonyaka odlule."Sinesicelo sokuthi kuhlelwe amabhasi anele ukuze kungenzeki okwenzeka ngonyaka odlule lapho kwasala khona inqwaba yezintombi ezitobhini. Sicela ukuba kuqashwe amatende anele. Sifisa kube nokudla okwanele mhlawumbe bafakelwe kuma-take-away ukuze bezokwazi ukuhlafuna. Sicela nokuthi kulethwe abashayeli bamabhasi abasesimeni esikahle ukuze izintombi zibuye ziphephile."Ikhansela le-IFP, uNksz Bathobekile Shange, lithe asanele isabelomali esinikezwa izintombi.UNksz Shange uthe ukuba ncane kwesabelomali kwenza ukuthi umasipala uhluleke wukuhlinzeka izintombi ngokudla kanye nendawo eyanele yokulala."Lokhu ngikusho ngenxa yezinto esifike sizibone eMhlangeni. Ngonyaka odlule izingane zazilele emnyango, emvuleni."Ikhansela le-ActionSA, uNksz Saneli Zuma, lithe ngonyaka odlule izintombi zahanjiswa ngamabhasi angekho esimeni."Lokhu kwabeka impilo yezintombi engcupheni. Kufanele sifunde emaphutheni esawenza ngonyaka odlule bese senza kangcono kulo nyaka."Usihlalo wekomiti elibhekele imisebenzi yomphakathi, uNkk Zama Sokhabase, uvumile ukuthi ayanele imali eyabelwe ukuxhasa izintombi zoMhlanga."Eqinisweni imali ebesiyinikiwe bekungu-R915 000, kodwa yabuye yangezwa njengoba isiwu-R1.4 million. Ngoba ke iyona mali esiyinikeziwe, sizosebenzisa yona."UNkk Sokhabase uthe bayafisa ukuthi izintombi bazenzele okungaphezu kwalokho abazenzela khona njengamanje."Siyafisa ukuthi kube khona izinto ezenzelwa izintombi. Siyafisa kungagcini ngokuthi izintombi ziyahlolwa kuphela. Sifisa ukuthi zihlonyiswe ngamakhono."Khonamanjalo, kusasa kuzoba noMkhosi woMhlanga esigodlweni eMachobeni, eNgwavuma.Lo mkhosi wandulela owangesonto elizayo.
UHLELO lukaMphathiswa wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, luhlukanise phakathi amakhosi esifundazweni.Amakhosi asesifundazweni ahlukene phakathi ngohlelo lwawo lokuhlomula olwathulwa uButhelezi ngoJuni.Ubuholi bendlu yobuholi bomdabu KwaZulu-Natal bujikijelane ngamazwi nobuholi benhlangano yabaholi bomdabu, iContralesa, kubangwa lolu hlelo lwabaholi bomdabu olufaka phakathi isikhwama sempesheni, medical aid nesikhwama sokonga imali.Umsindo uqale emva kokuba ubuholi beContralesa KwaZulu-Natal bukhale ngokuthi abaholi bomdabu bafakwa ngenkani kulolu hlelo, nokuthi bayaphoqwa ukuba babe ngamakhasimende ebhange elithile ukuze babe ingxenye yohlelo.Njengamanje izikhulu zoMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu zihambela izifunda, lapho zichazela khona abaholi bomdabu ngohlelo olusha.USihlalo weContralesa KwaZulu-Natal, iNkosi Thulasizwe Ngcobo, uthe umnyango awuzange uxoxe nabo ngaphambi kokuthi wethule lolu hlelo."Kuyasishaqisa ukwedelelwa kwabaholi bomdabu esikubonayo. Ukwethulwa kohlelo ngaphandle kokuthi kuxoxwe nabaholi bomdabu kukhombisa indelelo. Inhloso yabo yokuhambela izifunda ukuphoqa amakhosi, izinduna nomabhalane basezinkantolo zamakhosi ukuba bajoyine lolu hlelo olusha. Asihambisani nala maqhinga okuphoqa amakhosi, izinduna nomabhalane basezinkantolo zamakhosi ukuba bajoyine lolu hlelo. Ngeke sisonge izandla kudlalwa ngamalungu enhlangano."UNgcobo uzwakalise ukungenami ngendlela uButhelezi nohulumeni ophethe isifundazwe abaqhuba ngayo.USihlalo wendlu yobuholi bomdabu KwaZulu-Natal, iNkosi Sifiso Shinga, uchithe okushiwo ubuholi beContralesa."Sithanda ukuziqhelelanisa nalokhu abakushoyo. Nakuba bethi bakhulumela abaholi bomdabu, kepha sithanda ukukucacisa ukuthi asihambisani nemibono yabo futhi amakhosi nezinduna eziningi azihambisani nemibono yabo."UShinga uthe akekho umuntu ophoqiwe ukuba ajoyine uhlelo olusha."Izikhulu zomnyango zikugcizelele ukuthi akuyona impoqo ukujoyina uhlelo ngesikhathi ziyochaza ngohlelo ezifundeni iKinga Cetshwayo, oGwini, eThekwini, Amajuba, oThukela naseMzinyathi. Amakhosi nezinduna bayagqugquzelwa ukuthi babheke ubuhle bohlelo."UShinga uthe abaholi bomdabu abaningi bakhombisa ukuluthakasela uhlelo olusha."Lolu hlelo luphendula imithandazo yabaholi bomdabu yokuba nohlelo lwempesheni ne-medical aid. Lolu hlelo lubuyisa isithunzi sabaholi bomdabu."UShinga uthe bajabule ngobuholi bukaButhelezi athe ufike nezinhlelo eziningi zokweseka abaholi bomdabu.
AMANYE amalungu ekomiti elikhethekile lasePhalamende elisungulelwe ukuphenya izinsolo ezenziwa uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, abona ikomiti seliphenduke inja engenamazinyo kulandela ukubambezeleka kokuqala komsebenzi walo ngenxa yokuthi uMkhwanazi kufanele aqale athule ubufakazi kwikhomishini ephenya izinsolo ezifanayo.Amanye amalungu ekomiti athe abona ikomiti seliphenduke umasigcozi njengoba kufanele lilinde iKhomishini eholwa iJaji uMbuyiseli Madlanga ukuba ize iqede ukukhuluma noMkhwanazi.Lokhu kuhlaluke ngesikhathi kunomhlangano wekomiti izolo.Amalungu ekomiti avumelana ngokuthi afuna ukuthi kube uMkhwanazi owethula ubufakazi kuqala.Ikomiti belifuna ukuthi uMkhwanazi avele phambi kwalo ngomhlaka-16 kodwa latshelwa ukuthi uMkhwanazi angaze akwazi ukuvela phambi kwalo emva komhlaka-22 uma eseqede kwikhomishini.Umholi we-EFF, uMnuz Julius Malema nelungu le-ActionSA, uNksz Dereleen James, bebewotha ubomvu, befuna ukuthi uMkhwanazi aphoqwe ukuba avele phambi kwekomiti ngomhlaka-16.UMalema uthe indlela okwenzeka ngayo kubukeka sengathi ikhomishini iyona ebalulekile."Sibukelwa phansi thina, into ebalulekile nje ikhomishini. Angazi noma sisekhona yini isidingo sokuthi siqhubeke naleli komiti uma kunje. Sinamandla okumthumela amasamanisi azomphoqa ukuba avele phambi kwekomiti ngosuku osulufunyo. Mina ngithi asimthumele amasamanisi amphoqa ukuba avele phambi kwekomiti ngomhlaka-16."UNksz James uthe ikomiti alikwazi ukulinda lolu suku uMkhwanazi athe angakwazi ukufika ngalo."Sesiphenduke inja engenamazinyo. Ngabe senikhohliwe yini ukuthi sinamandla okuthumelela abantu amasamanisi abaphoqa ukuthi bavele phambi kwekomiti? Kubukeka sengathi simosha isikhathi."Iningi lamalungu ekomiti asichithile isiphakamiso sokuthi uMkhwanazi athunyelelwe amasamanisi.USotswebhu oMkhulu ePhalamende oyilungu le-ANC, uMnuz Mdumiseni Ntuli, uthe asikho isidingo sokuthi uMkhwanazi athunyelwe amasamanisi ngoba akanqabile ukuvela phambi kwekomiti."Ikhomishini iyona ekhulume kuqala noMkhwanazi. Akulona iphutha likaMkhwanazi ukuthi ikhomishini iyona ekhulume naye kuqala. Thina sisindwe yizinyawo ngenxa yokuthi kukhona izinto obekufanele sizilungise. Akukhona ukuthi uMkhwanazi usibukela phansi. Asikho isidingo sokuthi athunyelelwe amasamanisi."Ilungu le-MK, uMnuz Sibonelo Nomvalo, lithe ikomiti ilona elizifake kule nkinga elibhekene nayo ngokungasheshi ukukhuluma noMkhwanazi."Sizenze thina la. UMkhwanazi akanqabile ukuhlangana nathi. Inkinga nje ukuthi kufanele avele phambi kwekhomishini. Umuntu esingamthumelela amasamanisi umuntu onqabayo ukuvela phambi kwekomiti."UMkhwanazi uzoqala ukwethula ubufakazi kwikhomishini ngoSepthemba 17.Ikomiti litshelwe ukuthi lingaze likwazi ukuqala ukubiza ofakazi ekuqaleni kuka-Okthoba, njengoba livumelene ngokuthi lizolinda uMkhwanazi aze aqede ukwethula ubufakazi kwikhomishini.Ikomiti lanikezwa umnqamulajuqu wokuphela kuka-Okthoba ukuba liphothule umbiko walo.
KUPHENYWA izinsolo zokuthi umshayeli wetekisi okubhubhe kuyo abafundi abahlanu - wehle istafu - washiya abafundi bekhala ubumayemaye ngesikhathi itekisi iyokhalakathela nabo eweni ngaphambi kokuthi ibhodloze inkulisa.UMnyango wezokuThutha KwaZulu-Natal uthe ufuna kuphenywe ukuthi kungani umshayeli wetekisi edale ingozi, e-Unit 18, eMbali, ehle imoto ihamba washiya abafundi bevaleleke ngaphakathi?Ingozi yenzeke izolo ekuseni. Abazibonele bathe umshayeli uphume ngaphambi kokuthi imoto ikhalakathele enkulisa.Umshayeli wemoto ugadwe amaphoyisa esibhedlela. Okhulumela uMnyango wezokuThutha KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Ndabezinhle Sibiya, uthe umnyango usuyalele uphiko iRoad Traffic Inspectorate ngokubambisana namaphoyisa ukuba baphenye izinsolo zokuthi umshayeli ugxume imoto ihamba."Uphenyo luzobheka ukuthi kuyiqiniso ngempela yini ukuthi umshayeli wehle imoto ihamba njengoba kusho omakhelwane abavuswe yizingane ebezikhala. Uma kuyiqiniso sifuna ukwazi ukuthi kungani ehle washiya izingane zivalelekile emotweni? Sifuna ukwazi ukuthi imoto ibikulungele yini ukuba semgwaqweni nanokuthi ngabe ibibhaliswe ngokusemthethweni ngaphansi kwenhlangano ethutha abafundi?"USibiya uthe bahlela ukuthi abafundi abashonile babe nenkonzo enkulu yokubaphelezela."Siyakhuluma nemindeni."Imoto ibilayishe abafundi iningi labo abasuka e-Azalea, abafunda ezikoleni eziseMbali.Abafundi abebesetekisi bafunda eSukuma Comprehensive School, Zibekezulu Secondary, Fundokuhle Secondary, naseHenryville Primary.Abafundi abane bashonele khona endaweni yesigameko, owesihlanu ushone ngesikhathi ephuthunyiswa esibhedlela. Abafundi abahlanu abalimele baphuthunyiswe ezibhedlela.Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Muzi Mahlambi, uthe izothola ukwalulekwa ngokwenqondo imindeni eshonelwe."Umnyango udlulisa amazwi enduduzo kubo bonke abathintekile. Segqemeke engeqiwa ntwala njengoba silahlekelwe abantu abasebancane ebesisabheke lukhulu kubona. Okusizwisa ubuhlungu kakhulu ukuthi lena ingozi yesibili kuleli sonto okushona kuyo abafundi."Umshayeli kuthiwa wehlulekile ukulawula itekisi ebigcwele abafundi endaweni eyehlelayo, kuthiwa ukhale ngokuthi iphelelwe amabhuleki.Itekisi ifike yashayisa izinsimbi eziseceleni komgwaqo endaweni eyijika, yadlulela esihlahleni ngaphambi kokuthi ikhalakathele enkulisa iSenzokuhle Pre-School.Kube ubumayemaye ngesikhathi itekisi ishayisa ibhodloza udonga lwasenkulisa enabafundi abangu-49.Ngesikhathi kwenzeka ingozi kuthiwa bekusafike abafundi basenkulisa abahlanu. Ngenhlanhla kuthiwa abazange balimale ojahidada ngesikhathi kubhodloka udonga okuthiwa baphume bengqasha, bebonakala ukuthi bathukile.Ofundisa enkulisa, uNksz Luthando Msomi, uthe odade bebethuke ngale ndlela yokuthi bebengakwazi nokukhuluma."Izingane beziqhaqhazela, ubona ukuthi zithukile ngempela."
I-Gauteng Highway Patrol isebenzisana nezikhulu zezokuphepha ezizimele bebelandela imininingwane yophiko lweCrime Intelligence mayelana nabasolwa ngokugqekeza nokugebenga emizini eseTshwane South naseJohannesburg North. Ngesikhathi kuqhubeka umsebenzi wokuthungatha umkhondo wabo, ngezithuba zabo-15:00, amalungu abone imoto efana nencazelo yemoto yabasolwa emgwaqeni u-R55 eCenturion base bezama ukuyimisa. Abasolwa basuke ngesivinini. I-Gauteng Traffic Air Wing ibizelwe kule ndawo ukuze isize ithimba ngokugada emoyeni. Abasolwa bagibele u-N14 obheke ePitoli nokuthe uma amaphoyisa evala, abasolwa baqala ukudubula bebhekise emaphoyiseni, abe eseziphindiselela, adubula abulala bonke abagibeli abane. Ngesikhathi amaphoyisa esesha imoto athole izibhamu ezintathu nezinhlamvu kanye nezinto zokugqekeza. Uphenyo lokuqala luphinde lwaveza ukuthi imoto, iHyundai sedan emhlophe ibifakwe amapuleti nama-disc okungesiwona awayo. Laba basolwa sebevele bayamataniswa nezigameko ezingu-18 zokugetshengwa kwezindlu. Abe-SAPS Forensic Crime Scene Management basendaweni yesigameko kanye nophiko oluzimele lophenyo lwamaphoyisa.
I-ANC ithi liyibhoklolo elaziwayo ikhansela le-IFP kuMasipala wesiFunda iLembe, uMnuz Siphiwe Cele, eliboshelwe icala lokuzama ukubulala. Umgqugquzeli we-ANC esifundeni iGeneral Gizenga Mpanza, uMnuz Nkosenhle Mngadi, uthe akubathusanga ukuboshwa kukaCele ngoba bayamazi ukuthi unodlame.UCele, ophinde abe unobhala we-IFP esiFundeni iLembe, udedelwe ngebheyili ka-R1 000 eNkantolo yeMantshi KwaDukuza emva kokuchitha impelasonto esezikhindini.UCele waboshwa ngeledlule, eboshelwa izinsolo zokuzama ukubulala emva kokuzama ukudubula uMnuz Vukani Mthembu, emva kwengxabano.UCele usolwa nangokudubula izicabha zeminye emizi eLindelani, KwaDukuza.UMngadi uthe bekungekhona okokuqala uCele eziphatha budlabha emphakathini.UMngadi uthe uCele wayesho ukubaqeda ngesikhathi kunokhetho lokuchibiyela kuMasipala waseMandeni, ngo-Ephreli."Unomlando nje wokuhlukumeza abantu kanye nezimbangi zakhe kwipolitiki. Ngesikhathi kunokhetho lokuchibiyela wangena ngendlovu iyangena esikhungweni sokuvota, ephethe isibhamu, wafike wasabisa izimbangi zakhe. Le nto ayenzayo iphambene nemigomo yezokhetho."UMngadi unxuse amaphoyisa ukuba aqinisekise ukuthi uCele ubhekana nengalo yomthetho."Siyawancoma amaphoyisa ngokusukumela phezulu, avikela abantu abangenacala. Sinxusa amaphoyisa ukuba aphenyisise lolu daba ukuze ezothola ubufakazi obuzokwenza ukuthi kugwetshwe lesi sigebengu. Sinxusa namalungu omphakathi ukuba anikeze amaphoyisa ulwazi olungalekelela ophenyweni."Sinxusa amaphoyisa ukuthi enze isiqiniseko sokuthi avikela ofakazi ukuze kungeke kuphazamiseke icala. Sinxusa nazo zonke izinhlaka zezobulungiswa ukuba zisebenzise leli cala ukuthumela umyalezo oqinile ezigebengwini ezihlalise lubhojozi abantu."Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kokhulumela i-IFP, uMnuz Mkhuleko Hlengwa, ayizange iphumelele njengoba ucingo lwakhe belukhala lungabanjwa futhi engazange awuphendule nomyalezo awuthunyelwe.
UKHALA ngokuhlaliswa lubhojozi yizigebengu ezibamba inkunzi zihlomile umphakathi waseLower Molweni, eHillcrest, eThekwini. Lokhu kuqinisekiswe yikhansela lendawo, uMnuz Siyabonga Nala, ngesikhathi lithintwa yiSolezwe izolo.Lithe sekungamasonto ambalwa umphakathi uhlaliswe ngesinqe esisolwa yilezi zigilamkhuba. "Zigasela emizini yabantu zihlome ngezibhamu, zibakhombe, zithathe konke ezikufunayo, bese zishaya zichithe,” kusho uNala.Uthe phakathi kempahla ethathwa ngabasolwa kuye kube amaselula, amathelevishini nenye impahla kagesi eziyibone zayithanda. UNala uthe okubi ukuthi kokunye zibuye zisebenzise indlakadla njengoba kukhona izigameko lapho ezidubula khona ngempela kugcine kufa abantu. Uthe esigamekweni esenzeke ngoLwesine, izigilamkhuba zingene emizini emithathu ngobusuku obubodwa. "Kowokuqala zibakhombe, zabaphuca imoto yakhona, zalayisha kuyo yonke impahla ebeziyidinga. Ziqhubeke zasebenzisa yona ukulayisha nangesikhathi sezingena nakule eminye imizi emibili,” usho kanje.Uthe namanje leyo moto ayikaze itholakale. Uthe emva kwaleso sigameko, ubize umhlangano ophuthumayo emphakathini, nokuyilapho okuvele khona ukuthi abasolwa bayaziwa."Yakhonjwa imizi lapho bezalwa khona, nabazali babo bekhona. Baze baphakama, bazihlangula bathi basuke bengabathumanga. Baphinde bacela ukuthi uma kwenzeka kuba khona umphakathi ohlela ukukwenza kubasolwa, uqinisekise ukuthi ubamba abantu okuyibona bona,” usho kanje.Uthe sikhona isigameko esenzeke emasontweni amathathu edlule, lapho umphakathi ushaye khona wabulala umsolwa oyedwa osafunda isikole.Uthe kuyabakhathaza kakhulu ukuthi lobu bugebengu benziwa yintsha eneminyaka ebalelwa ku-20. "Wambamba eMgababa (khona eLower Molweni). Wathi esathi uyokhomba ozakwabo, umphakathi wenganywa ukudinwa, wamshaya, wambulala,” usho kanje. Uthe ukhona omunye umhlangano ozobizwa ngoSepthemba 15, lapho umphakathi uzodingida ngokuthi yini engenziwa ukulwa nobugebengu.Kwenzeka lokhu nje, isimo sisadambile eNanda, lapho bekuhlupha khona imigulukudu esemincane edume ngeleWest. ENanda kuke kwashuba, umphakathi ubhikisha emva kokuboshwa kwabebenukwa ngokubulala ababesolwa ngobugebengu abatholwa beshonile enkundleni yezemidlalo endaweni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kunenqwaba yabantu ababulelwe okubalwa namaphoyisa okusolwa kukho injejane yeWest. NaseMolweni kuthiwa injejane yakhona ehlalise lubhojozi izishaya saWest futhi sekunesikhathi ihlupha.
Namuhla umphathiswa wezokuThutha nokuHlaliswa kwaBantu uMnuz Siboniso Duma ulibangise emndenini kaHlengiwe Mavimbela ukuyobhonga emswanini"Njengamanje sisendleleni ebheke eNseleni ukuyohlanganisa amehlo nomndeni wakwaMavimbela kulandela ukuhamba kabuhlungu kwamalungu omndeni amathathu engozini enyantisayo eyenzeke ku-N2 obheke kwaMbonambi ngempelasonto."Kubikwa ukuthi mathathu amalungu omndeni kaMavimbela ashone engozini enyantisayo ku-N2, obheke kwaMbonambi, ngeSonto ntambama.UDuma uthe izimoto ezimbili zishayisane mahlanze. Abanye abagibeli abane nabo balimale kanzima baphuthunyiswa ezikhungweni zokwelapha zendawo. "Uthi wabikelwa uSomlomo wesiShayamthetho saseKZN, uNontembeko Boyce, ukuthi abashonile bangumndeni welungu lePhalamende, uHlengiwe Mavimbela.
Imibiko yakamuva iveza ukuthi zinhlanu izingane ezishone engozini yetekisi elithutha izingane zesikole.Le ngozi yenzeke ekuseni ngoLwesine, kusolwa ukuthi itekisi ezisuka e-Azalea umshayeli uhlulekile ukuyilawula yaphaphalaza yashayisa enkulisa, eMbali 18, eMgungundlovu. Ngenhlanhla libhodloze udonga lwegumbi ebelingenamuntu, kodwa ngeshwa zinhlanu izingane zesikole ezishone. Bayisiwhiyagalomboli abalimele okubalwa kubo nomshayeli wetekisi. Umphathiswa wezokuThutha nokuHlaliswa kwaBantu uMnuz Siboniso Duma ukhiphe isitatimende ekuseni namuhla."Ngisanda kubikelwa inxusa lomgwaqo u-Ayanda Msweli ngengozi enyantisayo eyenzeke elokishini laseMbali, eMgungundlovu. Kusolakala ukuthi umshayeli obethwele izingane uhlulekile ukulawula itekisi yakhe yaphoseka enkulisa elokishini laseMbali. Okwamanje, asinayo imininingwane mayelana nesimo kanye nenani lezingane ezithintekile. Ngijube ithimba elisehhovisi lami kanye noMnyango ukuthi linikele endaweni yengozi futhi lixhumane nemindeni yezingane ezithintekile. Sizohlinzeka ngolwazi olwengeziwe ngemva kokubonisana nemindeni kanye nabasebenzi bezempilo abafanelekile."
Oklebe abasebenza ngaphansi kophiko lwePort Shepstone Serious Organised Crime Investigation besebenzisana neCrime Intelligence, Sydenham Trio Crime kanye namaphoyisa kaMasipala waseThekwini abophe uSiseko Ludongeni ngokutholakala nesibhamu esingekho emthethweni kanye nezimoto ezebiwe ngoLwesithathu. ULudongeni uqashwe njengothisha eDulati Combined School endaweni yaseMagqagqeni.Amaphoyisa athole umbiko wokuthi ubeshayela imoto eyebiwe. Baqhubeke baze bayofika eduze kwesikole baqapha isimo. Amaphoyisa athe ebona leyo moto ayivimba. Kube sekuseshwa amaphoyisa athola isibhamu sohlobo lwe-9mm esinezinhlamvu. Kusatshalaliswe imininingwane yemoto kwaqinisekiswa ukuthi yebiwa eMgungundlovu ngoNovemba nyakenye.Uboshiwe wayiswa emzini wakhe lapho kutholwe khona izingcezu zemoto yohlobo lwe-VW Polo egaraji. ULudongeni ubekwe icala lokutholakala nesibhamu esingekho emthethweni nelokutholakala nezimoto ezebiwe. Isibhamu esibanjiwe sizoyiswa kohlolwa ukuze kutholakale ukuthi asikaze yini sisetshenziswe ekwenzeni ubugebengu ezweni.Uvele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMzimkhulu, icala lahlehliselwa uSepthemba 22, 2025.
It has come to that time of the year when the last cold front is showing up for the last time until South Africans start to emerge from their hibernation trend. Usually South Africans travel less during winter months and the trend changes when the Spring season starts. This is the reason South African Tourism reaches out to all people of Mzansi with our annual Sho’t Left Travel Week Campaign happening from 08 until 14 September 2025. This time around, please allow us to entice you to the camping and caravanning experience and its ability to connect people and their loves ones. Most people are not aware that you can enjoy camping without having to do the heavy lifting in terms of setting up and breakdown. A lot of camping sites would have services of people who would assist with the setting up of the tent. Let’s explore some of the available sites within an hour to two from Johannesburg and Pretoria.Camping with you own equipment may start with an investment of a tent and other equipment at a budget below R3000 and get to use it as many times as it is convenient for you. You can start your search by visiting TentCo one of the top suppliers for all your camping needs Camping sites with all you need does not necessarily have to be expensive. It is exactly what you need if you have never done camping before. The establishment will provide a tent for you and your besties and all you have to do is bring your favourite food or eat out at the nearest restaurant if your camping site does not have one on site. At Ramoswe lodge within Forever Resort Bela Bela you can spend the night with 9 friends at R600 per person per night and enjoy a campsite with a pool and lapa. One can explore a motorhome and Maui Motorhome Rentals offers a mobile room for four from as little as R2000 per day and all you need is a code 8 drivers license. As a first time camper I would really not miss an opportunity to travel with family or friends especially when you get all the essential facilities like kitchen and bathroom included in the rental sleeper. I can just imagine travelling in what will be our accommodation, having snacks and relaxing at the back with music in a lounge set up. I would also try camping if its that easy. If you are looking for a tent experience on the luxury side, glamping as it is commonly known, one can try Little Mongena Tented Camp. This is a luxury tented camp overlooking a dam within Dinokeng Game Reserve. Each of the ten tents on offer features a tea and coffee-making facility, air conditioning, and en-suite bathroom with a shower.Visit shotleft.co.za to take advantage of Shot Left Travel Week, which runs from 8th to 14th September 2025, for discounted deals of up to 50% off. Explore your own beautiful country and create unforgettable memories. After all, It’s Your country. Enjoy It. Cause nothing is more fun than a Sho’t Left.

Linezikhala phansi lapho okunyathelwa khona, liphinde lingabi nayo nhlobo indawo yokubambelela emaceleni. Kubuhlungu ukuthi umfowethu ushone kabuhlungu kanje,” kusho uNksz Mchunu.Naye uthe bafisa lilungiswe ngoba ayikho enye indlela abangayisebenzisa esikhundleni salo. I-NPA ngoLwesihlanu, izobhalisela ukuvulwa kabusha kophenyo lokushona kwesishoshovu esasilwa nobandlululo kanye nomsunguli nomholi weBlack Consciousness Movement (BCM), uStephen Bantu Biko, owashona eminyakeni engu-48 kanye kusukela ngalolo sukeyedlule. Ukuvulwa kabusha kophenyo kulandela ukuthi uNgqongqoshe Wezobulungiswa Nokuthuthukiswa Komthethosisekelo agunyaze isicelo soMqondisi Kazwelonke Wezokushushiswa Komphakathi, esisekelwe ngabammeli bomndeni wakwaBiko.U-Biko waboshwa nozakwabo, u-Peter Jones, kwisivimbamgwaqo ngase-Grahamstown (eMakhanda) mhla ka18 Agasti 1977. Eboshelwa ukuphula umyalelo owawumnqanda ukuba aye eKing Williamstown (Qonce). Waphuthunyiswa esiteshini samaphoyisa eWalmer, ePort Elizabeth (Gqeberha), okusolwa ukuthi wahlukunyezwa eboshwe ngamaketango emilenzeni wagcinwa enqunu esitokisini. Kuze kwaba ngemva kwezinsuku ezingu-24 esitokisini lapho afunelwa khona usizo lwezempilo ngemuva kokuthi kubonakale "igwebu” emlonyeni wakhe. Mhla zingu-11 kuSepthemba 1977, walayishwa equlekile, enqunu futhi eboshwe ngamaketango ngemuva kweLand Rover yamaphoyisa, wabe eseyiswa esibhedlela sasejele ePitoli, esiqhele ngamakhilomitha angu-1,200. Washonela ngaphandle kwesibhedlela sasePitoli ngomhlaka-12 Septhemba 1977 eneminyaka engu-30 ubudala.Imbangela yokushona kukaBiko yaqoshwa njengokulimala kobuchopho okubangelwa ukuma kwegazi lingahambi ngendlela ne-intravascular blood coagulation, ukwehluleka kwezinso kanye ne-uremia. Uphenyo olusemthethweni lwenziwa ngoNovemba 1977. Umbiko wamaphoyisa ophiko lweSpecial Branch (SB) lwaveza ukuthi walimala ngesikhathi eshaya ngekhanda odongeni. IMantshi Enkulu ngaleso sikhathi uMJ Prins, wamukele lowo mbiko wamalungu e-SB futhi wathola ukuthi u-Biko uthole ukulimala ngesikhathi exabana namalungu eSB. Imantshi yaphinde yakhulula odokotela ababelapha uBiko esejele. Ngomhla zi-2 Febhruwari 1978, owayenguMmeli Jikelele wase-Eastern Cape ngaleso sikhathi wenqaba ukushushisa noma ngubani ngokufa kukaBiko.Inhloso enkulu yokuvula kabusha uphenyo wukubeka phambi kwenkantolo ubufakazi obuzokwenza ukuthi inkantolo ikwazi ukuthola isinqumo ngokwesigaba 16(2) (d) soMthetho wama-Inquests Act 58 ka-1959, mayelana nokuthi ngabe ukufa kwalethwa isenzo esithile, okugodlwa noma ukweqiwa kolwazi okungenziwa yinoma yimuphi umuntu. I-NPA kanye nabalingani bayo bazoqhubeka nemizamo yabo yokubhekana nonya lwesikhathi esidlule futhi basize umndeni wakwaBiko nomphakathi wonkana ukwazi ukubala leli khasi.
Minyaka yonke mhla ziyi-18 kuNtulikazi, abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bahlonipha usuku luka Mandela ngokwenza imisebenzi yokusiza kwaSappi Southern Africa (SA), usuku lukaMandela akulona nje usuku olujwayelekile, kepha ithuba lokuthi kusetshenziswane nemiphakathi yendawo.Kulo nyaka, KwaZulu-Natal amaqembu akwaSappi abebambisene nabaholi bomphakathi ukusiza ezinkulisa, ezikoleni kanye nasemiphakathini.Lena enye yezindlela uSappi asebenza ngayo ukuthuthukisa imiphakathi akhelene nayo. KwaDukuza iqembu laseStanger Mill lanikela ngezingubo zokumbatha nephepha leTypek ekhaya labadala ellibizwa ngokuthi iStanger & District Association for the Aged (SADAFTA). EMandeni, abasebenzi baseTugela Mill besebenzisana nekomiti iTugela Mill Integrated Community Forum (ICF) CSI subcommittee, eholwa nguSbongiseni Thwala, balungise inkulisa iSinethemba Day Care Centre. Phakathi kokunye, obekulungiswa kube ukupenda izindawo zokudlala zabantwana (ama-jungle gym), bavuselela ingadi, banikela nangezinsiza zokufunda, baphinde banikela ngokudla ukulekelela izingane ezingu-71 zalenkulisa. Ngasenyakatho nesifundazwe, abasebenzi bakwaSappi Forests bakhe ama-jungle gyms ezinkulisa ezimbili; iPhumelela Crèche eKwaMthethwa naseNqolobane Crèche eMtubatuba. Baphinde baphathela abantwana amathoyizi okudlala.KwaMbonambi Secondary, kwethulwa uhlelo lwengadi yesikole ngokubambisana nenhlangano Ithuba Agribusiness, olukhuthaza ukuphepha kokudla nokuqwashisa ngemvelo.Maphakathi nesifundazwe, ithimba lakwaSappi Research and Nurseries eTweedie labambisana neRise Against Hunger ukupakisha amaphasela okudla. ENhlazuka, iSappi yasebenzisana noMasipala waseRichmond, uMnyango Wezempilo, kanye nomphakathi wendawo ukulungisa izindlu ezazinikelwe eGabangolwazi Primary School ukuze zisetshenziswe njengenkulisa kanye nesikhungo sezempilo ukulekelela kwezemfundo nezempilo. Eningizimu yeKwaZulu-Natal, iSaiccor Mill yagxila ePrince Inganekwane Crèche eDududu, lapho abasebenzi abangama-40 bavolontiya ukupenda amagumbi okufunda kanye nekhishi, bavuselela ingadi, benza ama-jungle gym, baphinde banikela ngokudla, imibhede, izingubo zokulala, namathoyizi okufunda abantwana abangama-140 kulesi sikhungo. Lolu hlelo beluholwa yiSaiccor Integrated Local Community Forum (ILCF) CSI Subcommittee, eholwa nguCllr. Ayanda Ndlovu, njengengxenye yezinhlelo zonyaka zalelikomidi.Ngokusho kukaTebele Makhetha, oyiHead of Corporate Affairs, eSappi SA, "Ukuxhumana kwethu nemiphakathi akusona nje isibopho sebhizinisi kuphela kepha isibophezelo sendlela yokuziphatha kwethu.” UJames Manana, oyiVice President yakwaHuman Resources, eSappi SA uthe, "sakha ikusasa elingcono - lesi akusona isiqubulo nje kwa Sappi kepha yindlela yethu yokuphila nomphakathi wendawo.” Usuku lukaMandela akulona usuku olwejwayelike, kepha luyingxenye yohambo olukhulu. Amakomiti afana neILCF, kwaSappi ahlale esebenza minyaka yonke ukweseka imisebenzi, ukuthuthukisa amabhizinisi, ukuqeqesha kwamakhono, kanye nokunikeza namathuba kubantu abasha.👉🏾 Bhalisela iphephandaba lethu lomphakathi, Umphakathi, ukuze ulandele lezi zindaba futhi uhlale uxhumene nemikhankaso yakwaSappi KwaZulu-Natal. UMHOLI we-IFP, uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa, uthukuthele uyaveva ngokusabalala ezinkundleni zokuxhumana kwezinhlangothi ezimbili okuthiwa zizobanga izikhundla engqungqutheleni yokukhetha ubuholi beqembu.UHlabisa uthe akukho mbango wezikhundla ngaphakathi eqenjini, wathi umbhalo osabalele ezinkundleni wenziwe amadungamuzi azama ukuxova i-IFP.Ubekhuluma namalungu e-IFP oLundi, lapho enikele khona ngendlu kuMnuz Siyabonga Zulu.Kusanda kusabalala imibhalo enezithombe zabaholi be-IFP okuthiwa bazobanga izikhundla engqungqutheleni yokukhetha ubuholi beqembu.Kukhona uhlangothi oluveza yena uHlabisa njengomengameli, kuvele igama likaMnuz Albert Mncwango kwesephini likamengameli, bese kuthi kwesikasihlalo kuvele igama likaMnuz Bonginkosi Dlamini, ongusihlalo weqembu esifundazweni iGauteng. Abanye abaholi abavela kulolu hlangothi nguMnuz Mkhuleko Hlengwa, okuthiwa uqaqele isikhundla sephini likasihlalo, kube yigama likasostwebhu weqembu ePhalamende, uMnuz Nhlanhla Hadebe, okuthiwa ugaqele isikhundla sikanobhala jikelele, kanye nelikaNksz Zandile Majozi, okuthiwa ulobizela isikhundla sephini likanobhala jikelele.Ohlangothini lwesibili kuvela igama leNkosi Mzamo Buthelezi embangweni wokuhola iqembu, elikaNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, livela embangweni wephini likamengameli, kuthi elikaMnuz Blessed Gwala livele embangweni wesikhundla sikasihlalo.Igama likaMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi livela embangweni wesikhundla sikanobhala jikelele, elikaNkk Thembeni Madlopha-Mthethwa livele embangweni wesikhundla sephini likanobhala jikelele.Igama likaMnuz Narend Singh, livela kuzona zombili izinhlangothi esikhundleni sikamgcinimafa.UHlabisa uthe kungamampunge konke okuqukethwe yilo mbhalo.UHlabisa uthe balandela umuntu osabalalise lo mbhalo, wathi bafuna ukumthathela izinyathelo."Le nto esezinkundleni zokuxhumana, ayikho. Angithi niyezwa. Lo muntu futhi oyenzayo, sisezithendeni zakhe ngoba uphethe idungamuzi. Futhi akasiyona Inkatha. Kodwa sisezithendeni zakhe ngoba uzodala ukuduka."Kwi-IFP kuke kwaba nezinhlangothi ebezibanga izikhundla iKKK nama-AU.Lezi zinhlangothi zazibhilitile ngesikhathi iqembu libheke engqungqutheleni yokukhetha ubuholi yango-2019.UHlabisa uthe sezaphela lezi zinhlangothi ezazibanga ukuhola iqembu."Iqembu Inkatha yeNkululeko lipholile, asinakuxokozela. Ake aba khona amaqembu qembu, sesidlulile lapho."Ingqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi be-IFP yayikhonjwe ekupheleni konyaka kodwa kwabuye kwashintsha.UHlabisa uthe bayaqhubeka nokwakha izinhlaka zeqembu kodwa wathi abakubheke kakhulu wukuvivela ukhetho lohulumeni basekhaya oluzoba ngonyaka ozayo."Njengamanje sesilungiselela ukuthi sivuselele amaziko. Sizolandela ngokucubungula amaziko. Okwesithathu sizokhetha izinhlaka zeqembu. Kodwa umgqigqo omkhulu sibheke okhethweni lohulumeni basekhaya lwangonyaka ozayo."
INkantolo yoMthethosisekelo kulindeleke ukuthi ikhiphe isinqumo ngoLwesine mayelana nokuthi iSigaba 26(1)(a) kuya ku-(c) soMthetho Wokubhaliswa Kokuzalwa noKufa kwabantu siyaphambana nomthethosisekelo njengoba sicwasa ngokobulili, ngokwehluleka ukunikeza amadoda ilungelo lokuthatha isibongo sabesifazane ngemva komshado.Lokhu kungemuva kokuthi abafake izicelo, uJana Jordaan noHenry Van Der Merwe, kanye noJess Donnelly-Bornman no-Andreas Nicolas Bornman bephendukele enkantolo enkulu ngoMashi nonyaka ukuze bathole isiqiniseko sokuthi lesi sigaba asisebenzi.UVan Der Merwe wenqatshelwa ukuthatha isibongo sikankosikazi wakhe uJordaan kwathi uBornman wanqatshelwa ukubiza isibongo sakhe ukuze afake nesibongo somkakhe, uDonnelly.Abafakizicelo baphonsele inselelo ngempumelelo isigaba esishiwo oPhikweni lwaseFree State lweNkantolo eNkulu.Kodwa-ke, kusadingeka ukuthi uMthethosisekelo uqinisekiswe yinkantolo enkulu ukuze uqale ukusebenza.

Kudutshulwe kwabulawa osolwa ngokubulala iphoyisa ngesikhathi evinjwa uphiko loKlebe iKZN Tracking Team KwaNgcolosi namuhla.Lo mlisa usolwa ngokubulala uConstable Mnqobi Shange ngo-2023 esigamekweni esathusa abantu abaningi KwaNgcolosi. UKHALA ngobulungiswa eMnyangweni wezeMpilo umndeni womhlengikazi osephila nokukhubazeka kulandela isigameko sokushaywa yisiguli ngo-2018.UNkk Thengaliphi Nxumalo (65) waseSihlangwini, eNgwavuma, kuthiwa washaywa yisiguli ngoNovemba 23, 2018, esemsebenzini.Indodakazi yakhe, uNkk Nokwazi Modise, ithe emva kwaleso sehlakalo unina wathikamezeka kakhulu emqondweni, uma ekhuluma uphambanisa izinto. "Akakwazi ukuhamba. Uyazingcolisa njengoba kwathikamezeka imithambo yokuzizwa uma sekufanele aye endlini encane,” kusho uNkk Modise.Elandisa ngesehlakalo, uthe senzeka unina esanda kungena emsebenzini njengoba ayengumhlengikazi esibhedlela.Uthe isiguli esamshaya kwakuwumuntu owayengeniswe esibhedlela eshaywe kanzima wumphakathi. "Asazi ukuthi wamshaya ngani ngoba kuze kube inamuhla isibhedlela asikaze sisinike izimpendulo zokuthi sikhali sini umama alinyazwa ngaso,” usho kanje.Uthe mva kokwenzeka kwesigameko, isibhedlela safonela osondelene nomndeni, samtshela ukuthi unina ungeniswe egumbuni labagula kakhulu esibhedlela kulandela ukuhlaselwa yisiguli."Sathola ukuthi wamshaya ngemuva esiphundu, elibele ukubhala okuthile. Kuthiwa waquleka khona lapho,” kuchaza uNkk Modise. Uthe ngakusasa, isibhedlela sabona ukuthi isimo sibi, sabiza ibhanoyi, waphuthunyiswa esibhedlela saseNgwelezane. "Kusona wahlala izinsuku ezimbala, waphinde wathathwa yibhanoyi, waphuthunyiswa esibhedlela Inkosi Albert Luthuli, lapho ahlala khona izinyanga ezimbili egunjini labagula kakhulu,” kulandisa uNkk Modise. Uthe esegundiwe unina esibhedlela, baqaphela ukuthi wayenenkebenkebe yenxeba elivulekile ekhanda. Uthe emhlanganweni ababa nawo nesibhedlela, sathembisa ukuthi uzonxeshezelwa ngesigameko ukuze kunakekeleke zonke izidingo zakhe ezidalwa ukuguquka kwempilo."Siwagcwalisile amaphepha, saletha nemibiko yasezibhedlela kaningi, bathembise ukuthi udaba lwesinxephezelo luyasetshenzwa kodwa kuphinde kuthule,” isho kanje indodakazi.Uthe bebona kuhamba iminyaka kungekho mnyakazo, bede behamba bayobuza esibhedlela naseMnyangweni wezabaSebenzi, babuye bedangele. "Kokunye besitshelwa ukuthi kubambe umbiko othile wesinye sezibhedlela ebezimelapha, basiyalele ukuthi siwulande. Sithi uma sesiwulandile, kuphinde kuthuleke,” kusho uNkk Modise. Uthe noma ngabe bekunezihibe kodwa mide kakhulu iminyaka eyisikhombisa belindile, wathi kunzima ukubhekana nesimo emndenini njengoba unina esephila nokukhubazeka."Udinga umnakekeli, ozomgada ubusuku nemini. Udinga ukuthengelwa amanabukeni nokunye okubalwa ukuyiswa esibhedlela noma emtholampilo uma kukhona isidingo. Siyesinda lesi simo kithina sonke emndenini,” usho kanje. Uthe ngisho noyise obazalayo useze waphenduka isiguli sodokotela abeluleka ngokomqondo ngenxa yokugula komkakhe."Akakwazi nokubhalisa impesheni ngoba umama uvela njengomuntu osasebenza,” kuqhuba uNkk Modise.Uthe bafuna ubulungiswa, anxeshezelwe unina ngemali emfanele ukuze bakwazi ukubhekelela zonke izidingo zokukhubazeka kwakhe.
