KUQHUME esikhulu isililo, abanye bademelayisa, ngesikhathi abanye beqanganisa, iNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini imdedela ngebheyili uthishanhloko osolwa ngokubulala ngesihluku umkakhe izolo. UMnuz Khayelihle Dhlomo (53) onguthishanhloko esikoleni iSithembile Primary, eLindelani, eThekwini, udedelwe ngebheyili ka-R5 000 enemibandela edle ngokuqina.Usolwa ngecala lokugwaza abulale umkakhe, uNkk Khanyisile Dhlomo, emzini wabo oseMalvern, eThekwini, ngoSepthemba 2022. Emva kwesigameko, umsolwa watshela umndeni, izihlobo namaphoyisa ukuthi umufi uzibulale yena ngenxa yokuhlushwa ukhwantalala. Ngaleso sizathu akazange aboshwe, nokho ezinye izihlobo, ezashaya amakhala ngokufa kukaNkk Dhlomo, zazilokhu zilulandelela udaba emaphoyiseni, zidweba isithombe sokuthi akukwazi ukuthi wazibulala.Lokhu kuholele ekutheni idokodo ligcine lithathwa abaphenyi bophiko lweThekwini District Task Team ngoMashi, nonyaka, maqede zamkhalela uDhlomo ngoJulayi nonyaka. Ngesikhathi imantshi uMnuz Scelo Zuma iqeda kusho ukuthi inkantolo imdedela ngebheyili umsolwa, umfowabo kamufi, uMnuz Mduduzi Malinga, akabange esalinda nokuzwa ukuthi ithini imibandela, usukume waphuma ngomnyango.Lokhu kube sekulandelwa yisililo kwabanye ebebehleli emabhentshini, nabo besukuma behamba. "Ayi uMthetho shame!” kusho omunye wesifazane, ngesikhathi abanye bedemelayisa. Kuphoqe ukuthi amaphoyisa ake athi ukumbuyisela emgodini umsolwa, ezama ukulawula isimo. Ngaphandle kwenkantolo, kuqhubekile ukukhala ezihlotsheni, kukhona nezisonga ngokuthi: "Kodwa ukhona uNkulunkulu.”UMalinga (umfowabo kamufi) ekhuluma nabezindaba ngaphandle kwenkantolo, uthe okwenzekile kukhomba ukuthi ukuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane kusaqhubeka."Sekwenziwa ngisho yizimantshi imbala. Umdedela kanjani umuntu obulele umuntu? Noma sekushiwo ukuthi ofakazi izingane zakhe ahlala nazo endlini, futhi ziyamsaba?” kubuza uMalinga. Usole imantshi ngokungahambisi kahle izinto nokushaya indiva amanye amaqiniso avele enkantolo."Izingane zakhe zingofakazi ecaleni. Umndeni awuphephile. Izingane zizoba sengozini, ecisha ubufakazi,” kukhala uMalinga.Uhumushe okuhlaluke enkantolo ngokuthi ibeke phambili amaphuzu abekwe ummeli kamsolwa ukuthi kume nse ukusebenza kwesikole kusukela aboshwa ngoJulayi 13, 2025. "Izinhliziyo zethu zibuhlungu kakhulu ukubona ukuthi amalungelo abantu besifazane acindezeleka kangakanani eNingizimu Afrika,” kusho uMalinga, othe inkantolo njengoba idedele umsolwa, isho ukuthi akeze kubona.Uthe akukho abazokwenza ngoba eNingizimu Afrika umthetho weseka abenzi bobubi bese wenzela phansi abagilwa. Ngaphakathi enkantolo ngesikhathi uZuma emnika ibheyili, umsolwa uthe phakathi kokunye, kuzofanele ayohlala ekhelini lesibili, angaxhumani nofakazi.Icala lihlehlele u-Okthoba 15, nonyaka.
KUSE ngokunye ngesikhathi inkosi ebhekene namacala okubulala yethweswa elinye icala lokubulala. Usizi belubhalwe emehlweni eNkosini uSimphiwe Erick Zuma, ngesikhathi yethweswa icala lesithathu lokubulala.UZuma obhekene necala lokubulala owayeyikhansela le-DA kuMasipala waseMngeni, uMnuz Nhlalayenza Ndlovu, nelokubulala owayengundunankulu wesizwe sakwaNxamalala, uMnuz Qalokunye Zuma, wethweswe icala lokusoconga okuthiwa wayephikisana nokudayiswa komhlaba kamasipala, uMnuz Xolani Ntombela-Ndlovu. UNtombela-Ndlovu wabulawa ngo-2022 eMasosheni, eMpophomeni.UZuma wethweswe icala lokubulala uNtombela-Ndlovu eNkantolo yeMantshi eHowick, izolo. Uboshwe noMnuz Thembelani Mbatha. UMbuso uhlela ukubopha omunye umsolwa wesithathu. Umsolwa wesithathu uboshwe kanye noZuma kwelinye lalamacala awahambayo. UMshushisi omkhulu ecaleni, u-Advocate Lawrence Gcaba, uthe umsolwa wesithathu uzoboshwa maduze."Uphenyo lwethu luku-95% manje. Sihlele ukuthi umsolwa wesithathu avele enkantolo ngoLwesihlanu."Icala libe selihlehliselwa uMsombuluko lapho kuzohlelwa izinsuku zokulalelwa kwesicelo sebheyili. UZuma ube eseqhubeka nokufaka isicelo sebheyili ecaleni lokubulala uNdlovu.Kuleli cala uZuma uboshwe noMnuz Thobani Hlongwa, Khayelihle Shabalala noThabo Chonco. UMnuz Zwelithini Buthelezi yena usephenduke ufakazi woMbuso. Ummeli kaZuma, u-Advocate Sthembiso "Sticks" Mdladla, uchithe izinsolo zokuthi uZuma wakha itulo lokusoconga uNdlovu. "Asikho isizathu esasingangenza ukuba ngakhe itulo lokusoconga isihlobo sami."UMdladla uthe uZuma akabazi abasolwa aboshwe nabo, wathi wazi uButhelezi kuphela oyinduna esizweni sakhe."Into nje esasiyikhuluma noButhelezi yizindaba ezithinta umkhandlu wesizwe. Wayephinde aqaphe ukusebenza kwamatekisi ami amathathu." Encwadini efungelwe, uZuma usole uButhelezi ngokungcolisa igama lakhe, wathi ufuna babhekane enkantolo khona ezomembula izinqe."Usho noma yini ngami ngoba nakhu efuna ukuba angaboshwa. Uvele usezuzile njengoba esehoxisiwe amacala abethweswe wona. Anginandaba nazo zonke lezi zinto azishoyo. Ngifuna ukuthi sihlangane lapha enkantolo khona ezophinda la manga akhe. Kuzovela obala ukuthi uqamba amanga. Kuyishwa ukuthi uMbuso uthembele ebufakazini bukaButhelezi, ongumuntu ongathembekile."UZuma uchithe izinsolo zokuthi wagwazela imantshi ngo-R200 000 ukuze imdedele ngebheyili ecaleni lokubulala uQalokunye. UMbuso wenza izinsolo zokuthi imali yokugwazela imantshi yakhokhwa yilungu le-MK esiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natali, uMnuz Thobani Zuma."Inhloso nje yale nto wukungcolisa igama lelungu lesiShayamthetho."Ukuphikile nokuthi wazama ukuthuma uButhelezi ukuba adlise ufakazi ecaleni elibhekene nomuntu osondelene naye noMnuz Khulubuse Zuma."Ngangixoxaphi noKhulubuse? Ngazi ukuthi uKhulubuse useDubai. Okunye engikwaziyo wukuthi alikho icala elibhekene noKhulubuse." UZuma uthe uhlela ukuvula icala lokwehliswa isithunzi. Ukhale nangokufinyiswa igazi ngamakhala wumphenyi wecala ngesikhathi kupeqululwa ejele.UZuma uthe umphenyi wecala wamshaya waphuma igazi emakhaleni ngesikhathi kupeqululwa ejele.Ngaleli langa uZuma watholakala neselula.Icala lizobuyela enkantolo ngoMsombuluko lapho abameli noMbuso bezokwenza izethulo zokugcina.
UKHATHAZEKILE uNgqongqoshe weMfundo eyisiSekelo, uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, ngokuthi abafundi abaningi abaneminyaka emine, kusuke kusahlwile njengoba bengeke bakwazi ukumelana nabazokufunda.Lokhu kuvele embikweni wocwaningo olwethulwe izolo olwaziwa nge-Thrive by 5, olwenziwe nyakenye kubafundi ababalelwa ku-5 000, abaneminyaka emine.Umbiko uveze ukuthi u-42% kuphela wabafundi okuvele ukuthi bakulungele ukuqala ukufunda. Abanye kuthiwa abakwazi nokulandela imiyalelo abasuke benikwe yona. "Sikhathazekile ngoba lokhu kusho ukuthi kumele siqinise kakhulu emazingeni aphansi ngoba bambalwa abafundi abasuke bezokwazi ukumelana nabazokufunda. Lezi zibalo zikhomba ukuthi kumele siqinise kakhulu kuGrade R uma sebeneminyaka emihlanu ngoba kuyacaca ukuthi uma singaqinisi kuwona kuzoba yinkinga kakhulu uma sebeya kuGrade 1," usho kanje ekhuluma ngemuva kokwethulwa kombiko eSandton. Uthe imali etshalwe kuGrade R, ebalelwa ku-R10 billion, ngeke isize ngalutho uma bengalungisi isisekelo semfundo."Yingakho sinxusa abazali ukuthi bazifundele incwadi izingane zabo. Ingane ayibe nencwadi ukuze kube lula, abazali babambe iqhaza emfundweni yezingane zabo."Uthe abanye bahlale bembelesela ngokuthi kumele kuqiniswe ku-matric, wathi lokhu akusizi uma kungukuthi isisekelo asiqinile."Uma isisekelo sintenga, kuyacaca ukuthi kwamanye amabanga uma sebeqhubeka nemfundo kuzoba nzima kakhulu. Kubalulekile ukuthi baphuthunywe besakhula, ukuze kuthi uma sebefika emazingeni aphezulu bafike sebelungile." Uthe imiphumela ka-matric akuyona okumele kugxilwe kuyona njengoba kuyiyona izwe elisuke liyibheke ngabomvu."Siyazi ukuthi kugadwa kuphela imiphumela ka-matric ekubeni ngabe siqinisa phansi. Akumele sizikhathaze kakhulu ngokuthi umfundi wenza i-Maths noma akayenzi ekubeni kubheda izinto phansi."Umbiko uveze nokuthi izingane zabafana yizona ezisilele emuva kakhulu ezidinga ukwesekwa."Iyangikhathaza neyokuthi izingane zabafana zidonsa kanzima zidinga usizo oluphuthumayo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi akumele sibashiye ngaphandle abafana kuzona zonke izinhlelo esizenzayo," kugcizelela uNksz Gwarube. Uthe kudingeka kube nokubambisana nezinhlaka ezehlukene ngoba ngeke bakwazi ukukwenza bebodwa lokhu.Okunye okuvelile ngukuthi kwezinye izifundazwe abafundisa amazinga aphansi ikakhulu uGrade R abakhokhelwa ngendlela efanele.KwaZulu-Natal izinyunyana zothisha zihlale zikhala ngokuthi abafundisa uGrade R, abaholelwa ngendlela futhi uMnyango wezeMfundo ubuye ungabanyuseli ngesikhathi umholo.
IZOQEDA ukuba yikwampunzi edla emini imigomo emisha ezolawula izimoto ezikhokhelwa ngebanga ezilihambayo kuleli (e-hailing), njengoba abazophambana nayo bezohlawuliswa u-R100 000 noma bavalelwe ejele iminyaka emibili.Ngale migomo banethemba lokuthi izophela impi ephakathi kwabamatekisi nabo. Lokhu kuvezwe ngusihlalo wekomiti lezokuThutha ePhalamende, uMnuz Donald Selamolela ekhuluma nabezindaba ngale migomo. Uthe banethemba lokuthi imigomo izoqeda nokuklwebhana okukhona phakathi kwabamatekisi nabahamba ngalezi zimoto okuwu-Bolt no-Uber."Sifuna baziwe bonke abayingxenye ye-e-hailing njengoba sebezothola nezimvume zokusebenza. Izimoto zabo zizoba nemibhalo ezosho ukuthi zisebenza i-e-hailing. Amalayisense okusebenza azobe esho indawo abagunyazwe ukuthi basebenzele kuyona," usho kanje.Uthe kuzodingeka ukuthi babe nezinto zokuphepha ezimotweni zabo okubandakanya nendaba yokuthi babe nama-panic button. "Abashayeli bazo bazobhekwa ukuthi abanawo amacala, kuzodingeka ukuthi babe nama-professional driving permit (PDP). Kuzodingeka ukuthi babe nesithombe somshayeli esicacile. Abashayeli abazohluleka wukulandela le migomo bazohlawuliswa u-R100 000, noma babhadle ejele iminyaka emibili," usho kanje.Uthe abemigomo banawo amandla okuhoxisa amalayisense okusebenza uma bephula umthetho i-National Land Transport Amendment (NLTA) Act."Lo mthetho wasayinwa nguMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, imigomo izogazethwa ngenyanga ezayo ukuze iqale ukusebenza. Okwamanje usahumushelwa kolunye ulimi ukuze uqale ukusebenza njengoba uNgqongqoshe wezokuThutha, awugunyaza ukuthi usebenze. Sethemba ukuthi izophela le mpi ekhona phakathi kwamatekisi," usho kanje. Uthe phambilini, kwakunempi enkulu phakathi kwabamabhasi nabamatekisi."Kodwa emuva kokukhishwa kwemigomo yokusebenza, wonke umuntu ubazi ukuthi uhamba agcinephi. Kwachitheka igazi njengoba kwenzekile muva nje, esehlakalweni esibuhlungu esenzeka eMaponya Mall, eGoli, kushiswa umshayeli wemoto ye-e-hailing."Umufi uMnuz Siyanda Mvelase ungcwatshwe ngempelasonto, oLundi.USelamolela uthe iyabakhathaza eyalolu dlame phakathi kwabalezi zimoto nabamatekisi oselukapakele naKwaZulu-Natal. Abebehambele isithangami sasePhalamende, babuze ukuthi zingaki izimoto ze-e-hailing ezikhona emigwaqweni yakuleli.USelamolela uthe bazokwazi isibalo sazo uma sekunemigomo ngoba zizobhaliswa.Uthe akuwakhi umqondo ukuthi ziningi kakhulu lezi zimoto emgwaqweni owodwa ngoba lokho kwenza ukuthi abanye behlise imali ukuze bakwazi ukuthola amakhasimende."Sethemba ukuthi le migomo izoqeda ukuthi kube ikwampunzi edla emini, noma ubani amane avuke ayosebenza ngemoto kwa-e-hailing. Izwe liphethwe ngomthetho, asikwazi ukuthi kungaba nabantu abazomane benze izivimbamigwaqo, belwa nabanye abasebenza kwezokuthutha."
UMREPHA uJabulani "Sjava" Hadebe, wenze obekungalindelekile ehlonipha ngengoma ingwazi yomculo kamaskandi ebisilibalekile uSipho "Mahawukela" Mseleku. USjava uqambe ingoma esihloko sithi Gusheshe, esecwecweni lakhe elisha elisihloko sithi Inkanyezi 2.0. Kule ngoma apike kuyo uMandla "Shwi" Xaba, uSjava uhlanganise amanoni amane kaMahawukela okubalwa kuwo elithi Ngesab' Igazi Lomuntu, Ikhathosenta nelithi Ibanga Elincane.UMahawukela owayedabuka eGubazi, eNquthu, wabulawa elokishini iTembisa, eGoli, ngoMeyi 19, 2000. Uyena owavumbulula ikhono likaShwi, Nikwani Ngobese wodumo kwiZingane Zoma, Mgqumeni Khumalo, Muhle Khuzwayo nabanye abaningi futhi ubenamaqembu anjengoBuhle Begubazi, Amatshitshi Amhlophe neZinsizwa ZakwaMseleku.Ngaphandle kwalokho, ungumaskanda wokuqala owayengazidlaleli isigingci futhi wayeqhakambisa kakhulu le nto yobugcokama njengoba ayezibizwa ngeGcokama lakwaMseleku. Ekhuluma emcimbini wokwethulwa kwaleli cwecwe eHue Cafe, eThekwini, ngeSonto, uSjava uthe okwamgqugquzela ukuba enze le ngoma kwaba yiBMW (igusheshe) ebubende kazakwabo futhi ongumkhaya wakhe, uSiyabonga "Big Zulu" Nene. Uthe yayifana ncamashi nekaMahawukela ngisho nangombala."Ngabe sengithi angithole uShwi ngoba uyena owasebenza kakhulu noMahawukela ukuba azongidlalela isigingci."Uthe uthathe isinqumo sokuhlonipha uMahawukela ngenxa yokuthi ungumculi akhula emthanda. USjava ukhiphe leli cwecwe ngoLwesihlanu emuva kwempumelelo ye-EP esihloko sithi Inkanyezi, ebihambisana ne-DVD. "Isinyathelo sokukhipha i-EP asiwona nje umkhuba, kodwa wukuletha inkumbulo yangezikhathi ezedlule, ngesikhathi ukuqopha bukhoma kwakuyingxenye enkulu yomculo. Kuyinto ebengiyifisa kakhulu. Ukucula bukhoma akunamkhawulo futhi i-EP inikeza lowo muzwa weqiniso nowokuphila, into engasatholakali kalula kulezi zinsuku,” kusho uSjava.Inkanyezi 2.0 Live EP yaqoshwa bukhoma eJoburg Theatre ngo-Agasti 15 no-16. Ihlanganisa izingoma ezinhlanu ezintsha ezihambisana nomoya wothando, okubalwa kuzo ethi Mdumise, Moya Wami nethi Sanibonani.Khonamanjalo, uSjava, Big Zulu noLwah Ndlunkulu bazoshiyelana inkundla kwi-Old Mutual at the Lake Series eBotanic Gardens, eThekwini, ngoSepthemba 24 kusukela ngo-1 emini. Amathikithi aseyatholakala ngentengo ehlukahlukene eWebtickets.

KUTHIWA bathe bebefuna inkululeko abazukulu ababili abasafunda isikole, okuthiwa babulale ngesihluku uninakhulu eMlaba Village, eHammarsdale, eThekwini, ngeledlule. Isidumbu sikaNkk Sarah Grace Mnguni (78) sitholwe sidindilizile egumbini lakhe lokulala ngoLwesibili. Kusolwa umzukulu (16) wakhe ofunda uGrade 12 ePhezulu High nomzukulwana (12) ofunda uGrade 7 eSinenzuzo Primary. Kusolwa ukuthi bambulala ngokumcindezela ubuso ngendwangu ematiswe ngotinasi ebusuku ngoMsombuluko. Indodana kamufi, uMnuz Bheki Nyoka ilandisa ngesigameko, ithe yathola ngoLwesibili ntambama, ibizelwa endaweni yesigameko ngomakhelwane. "Ngamthola esethule umama. Kukhombisa ukuthi sekunesikhathi eshonile,” kusho uNyoka.Uthe kukhona okwake kwakhomba ukuthi kukhona okushaya amanzi ezintatha zangoLwesibili."Ngafonelwa iselula kamama cishe izikhawu ezinhlanu ezintatha kodwa ngithi uma ngiyibamba, kungakhulumi muntu, bese iyavalwa. Kwala noma sengifona kaningi, ongale wayelubamba, angakhulumi, bese eyalucisha,” kusho uNyoka.Uthe waze wakhetha ukuvuka, ageze anikele khona, ezitshela ukuthi mhlawumbe unina ufuna amhambise ngemoto ukuyohola impesheni. "Ngaxakeka kodwa uma sengifika ekhaya ngabo-8 ekuseni, ngathola kulenga ingidi esangweni. Ngabuyela emumva kwami, ngizitshela ukuthi ngisindwe yizinyawo, useze wazihambela,” kusho uNyoka.Nokho uthe wabindwa amathe ngesikhathi esefika kugcwele umphakathi egcekeni ntambama, omakhelwane sebembizele isigameko.Uthe nakhona lapho amazwi awakhipha ewabhekise kubasolwa athi "Senize nambulala umama?”. "Ngangikhuluma eyokuthi sebembulele ngokhwantalala ngoba bebebuye bamhluphe. Ngingazi ukuthi zimbulele ngezazo izandla izingane umama,” usho kanje. Uthe baqale basola ukuthi kukhona okushaya amanzi ngalo usuku lokutholwa kwesidumbu, ungasabonakali umazisi kamufi."Isikoqokoqo abewubeka kuso namakhadi akhe ahlala imali kwatholakala emjondolo obuye usetshenziswe yizo lezi zingane,” kusho uNyoka, othe zithe uma zibuzwa zathi azazi ukuthi kwenzekeni, uninakhulu, ushone elele.Uveze ukuthi ithumbu libhoboke ngoLwesine, kutheleka amalungu enkundla elwa nobugebengu endaweni, ithi ayike inikwe ithuba ikhulume nabo abasolwa. "Yilapho abagonyuluke khona ngokuthi bambulale kanjani. Baze baveza ukuthi ngezikhathi zasekuseni ngoMsombuluko, babeqale bamfakela i-retax ephalishini kodwa wangaqhubeka nokulidla ezwa linambitheka kabi. Bathi baphinde bafaka namaphili amaningi okulala etiyeni, nalo wangaqhubeka nokuliphuza ekhala ngokuthi limbi. Eyokumcindezela ngendwangu enotinasi nesicamelo, kwase kuyisu lesithathu,” kusho uNyoka.Uqhube wathi zaze zaveza nokuthi ngesikhathi zimbulala zamfica elele ubuthongo, enye yamcindezela ngendwangu nomcanelo, yahlala ebusweni ngezinqe ngesikhathi enye imbambe izandla nezinyawo ngesikhathi eqhwisha."Zaze zaveza nokuthi wayezikhalela, exolisa ethi azingambulali kodwa le endala yathi akusekho ukujikela emuva. Zithe bezifuna inkululeko,” kulandisa uNyoka. Uthe kukhona imali ezayithatha zayidla ngokuthenga i-play station nogwayi nokunye okungaziwa."Kuleyo mali kwakukhona u-R1 500 weziqashi ezintathu ezase zikhokhile, u-R1 800 owawukhokhwe umakhelwane ngama-blocks ayewathengile, bese kuba u-R500 wesitokofela,” kusho uNyoka. Uthe bezikhona iziwombe ezibikwayo zobugebengu kubasolwa kodwa ubebuye angabi nalo ulwazi olugcwele ngazo ngoba umufi ubebathanda kakhulu, abuye angabiki uma benza izinto eziphambene. Uveze ukuthi abasolwa baqale ukuhlala nomufi bebancane, umndeni ubathatha kubo konina, ubona ukungakhuliseki kwabo ngendlela. Udalule ukuthi ngasohlangothini lwabo, oyise sebashona, yikho bebeyizingane zikamufi. Uveze ukuthi amaphoyisa abathathile abasolwa ngoLwesine, emva kokuvela kwezinsolo zokuthi umufi ufe ngokubulawa, nokho abuye abadedela ngoLwesihlanu.Uthe kufone iphoyisa lesifazane aligagule ngegama, labuza ukuthi bangalethwa yini ekhaya lapho okwenzeke khona isigameko? "Ngibuze ukuthi liyicabangile yini kahle le nto eliyishoyo. Bengingaqondi ukuthi uma lithi lifuna ukubaletha ekhaya, lisho bona yini abenze icala lokubulala?” kusho uNyoka. Uthe bagcine beyiswa kubo konina. Udalule ukuthi lo omdala ube esefika ngalo uLwesihlanu, watshela ebebekhona egcekeni ukuthi "sekufike amabhoza". "Kuthiwa uqathazwe yiBMW, wathi akekho ozohlala kulo muzi, uzowubhomba (ngebhomu),” kusho uNyoka. Uthe bakhathazekile ngokuthi kukhona abasebenzisana naye, kubona uthe bezwa ngandlebenye ukuthi kukhona uthisha wesikole omfake ekhwapheni kodwa ebe eyazi imikhuba yakhe.Uveze ukuthi kuphutshuke iphepha elinohlu lwabantu ebebethi bazobabulala. Kulona bekuhamba phambili igama likamufi, kuze elikaNyoka, kube elikamakhelwane, namanye.Uthe umufi akukaziwa ukuthi uzongcwatshwa nini njengoba kusalindwe imiphumela yokuhlolwa kwesidumbu. Uthe nedokodo elisavuliwe emaphoyiseni elokufa komuntu, athe lizoshintsha libe elokubulala uma sekubuya imiphumela. Unxuse amaphoyisa esifundazwe ukuthi enze ubulungiswa, angabheki ukuthi le nto yenziwe yizingane."Likhona ijele lezingane, abazithathe baziyise khona,” kusho uNyoka, osole amaphoyisa aseHammarsdale ngokungafuni ukwenza i-paperwork ukuze abasolwa bangadedelwa esandleni sabazali kodwa bayiswe ejele. Owenkundla elwa nobugebengu endaweni, uMnuz Sibongiseni "Captain" Mkhize, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi abasolwa banabo ubugebengu, wathi kukhona isigameko lapho oyedwa eke wantshontsha khona amaselula ayisihlanu kwamakhelwane.
ISILO uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini sithi sesisishiywe yisikhathi sokuba sisangakhetha itshitshi eMkhosini woMhlanga.INdlulamithi yamakhosi ithe izinkulungwane zezintombi ezihambela uMkhosi woMhlanga sezifana nezingane zayo. Ikusho lokhu ngesikhathi ikhuluma eMkhosini woMhlanga obusesigodlweni eMachobeni, eNgwavuma, ngoMgqibelo."Kambe ngisangayikhetha yini intombi? Angeke ngisakwazi. Ningabantabami nina. Omama benu balingana nami."Nakuba kunjalo, iMbube ikhombise ukuba nesikhwele ngezimbali zesizwe njengoba ithe angeke ivume ukuba zidlale abafana."Niyizintombi zami nonke njengoba nilapha. Abafana anobatshela ukuthi niyizintombi zami. Uma ethi ufuna inombolo, ufuna ukukhuluma into ebheke eceleni, anobatshela ukuthi hamba uyokhuluma neNgonyama kuqala. Ngeke nami ngivume ukuphucwa intombi."Umkhosi obungempelasonto wandulela uMkhosi woMhlanga omkhulu ozokuba sesigodlweni esisha, eMashobeni, oPhongolo, ngoMgqibelo.ISilo sinxuse izintombi ukuba ziphume ngobuningi ngoMgqibelo. IMbube ithe amagama ezintombi ezizokuba ingxenye yomkhosi wakulo nyaka ayobhalwa emlandweni njengoba kuzokube kuqala ukuba ubanjelwe esigodlweni esisha.Kule minyaka engu-40 eyedlule umkhosi ububanjelwa esigodlweni eNyokeni. "Siyokwenza okukhulu kakhulu la esizojabula khona. Lapha khona nina zintombi nizokuba ngabokuqala ukuhambisa umhlanga esigodlweni esisha. Niyothi uma senixoxa ngelinye ilanga nisho ukuthi kwaba yini izintombi zokuqala ezahambisa umhlanga eMashobeni."IMbube ithe kuzokuba kugcina emkhosini wakulo nyaka ukuba kube nezinkulumo ezinde ezethulwa osopolitiki.Sekunesikhathi eside iMbube ikhala ngezinkulumo ezinde eMkhosini woMhlanga ithi zenza ukuthi izimbali zesizwe zingalitholi ithuba elanele lokuba zicule amahubo."Usuku lwanamhlanje olokuthi isizwe sibuke izimbali zisina, zikhangisa ubuhle bethu njengesizwe. Ilokho okwenziwa emhlangeni nokwayisifiso sikaMdlokomba (iSilo uGoodwill Zwelithini kaBhekuzulu) neNdlovukazi (Shiyiwe Mantfombi Dlamini Zulu) engizalayo."Isikhathi sezinkulumo sikhona. Livulwa yimi futhi iPhalamende. Ngifike ngisho ukuthi sesiyalivula iPhalamende, sesingakhuluma ke manje. Bona bafuna ukuzokhuluma nalapha eMhlangeni. Ngonyaka ozayo nje akukhulunywa. Sifuna ukuthi izingane zifike lapha zisine. Sifuna ukuthi nithi niyolala nibe nikhathele. Ngoba uma nishaya phansi unyawo nisuke nivusa nalaba abalele ngoba nisuke nenza usiko."IMbube iveze ukuthi ihlela umcimbi omkhulu noMnyango wezamaSiko nobuCiko ozohlanganisa onke amakhosi ase-Afrika."Lapho bazokube bezosikhombisa ukuthi amasiko abo bawenza kanjani nokuthi bekhangise usiko mpilo lwabo sibuka. UNgqongqoshe kazwelonke ucele ukuthi isihlalo sikaZulu kube yiso esihlela lo mcimbi. Kuzokube kubizwe onke amakhosi ase-Afrika."
USEPHINDE wakhuza ibuya kuMasipala uMkhanyakude uMnuz Bamba Ndwandwe, ongafunwa wubuholi bomkhandlu kanye nabasebenzi.UNdwandwe ujutshwe wuMphathiswa wokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, ukuba ayolekelela umkhandlu.UNdwandwe usanda kuhoxiswa njengomlawuli kulo masipala.Ukuqokwa kwakhe njengomlawuli womkhandlu kwasusa umsindo owaholela ekuvalweni kwamahhovisi omkhandlu izinyanga ezimbili.Abasebenzi bomkhandlu balibeka ngembaba elokuthi abamfuni uNdwandwe bekhala ngokuthi uphatha ngesandla sensimbi.Nobuholi bomkhandlu baze baya enkantolo buphikisana nokuqokwa kwakhe.Uhulumeni wagcina uhoxisa isinqumo sokufaka umasipala ngaphansi kweso lomlawuli, nokwasho ukuthi uNdwandwe akaseyena umlawuli.Ukukhishwa komkhandlu ngaphansi komlawuli kwalandelwa wukuvulwa kwamahhovisi omkhandlu.UButhelezi usenqume ukuthi uNdwandwe aphindele emkhandlwini.Encwadini ebhalelwe uSomlomo womkhandlu, uMnuz Solomon Mkhombo, uButhelezi uqale achaze ngokuhoxiswa kwesinqumo seKhabhinethi yaKwaZulu-Natal sokufaka umkhandlu ngaphansi kweso lomlawuli.Eqhuba kule ncwandi ebonwe yiSolezwe, uButhelezi ube esebika ukuthi iKhabhinethi inqume ukwelekelela umkhandlu ngaphansi kwesigaba 154 somthetho.Ube usememezela ukuqokwa kukaNdwandwe njengongoti ozolekelela umkhandlu."Nginxusa ukuba wethule le ncwadi emhlanganweni womkhandlu olandelayo."Okhulumela uMnyango wokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Senzelwe Mzila, ukuqinisekisile ukujutshwa kukaNdwandwe.Akucaci ukuthi abaholi bomkhandlu nabasebenzi bazomamukela yini uNdwandwe.Ngesikhathi ejutshwe njengomlawuli ubuholi bomkhandlu abuzange bumhlinzeke ngisho nangehhovisi azosebenzela kulona.Unobhala wenyunyana yabasebenzi bomkhandlu iSamwu, eMkhanyakude, uNksz Zandile Gumede, uthe bazoba nomhlangano namhlanje lapho bezobhunga khona ngokubuyiswa kukaNdwandwe."Sizwe ngalolu daba ngoLwesihlanu. Sizoba nomhlangano nobuholi benyunyana esifundeni kusasa (namhlanje). Ngingakwazi ukuphawula kahle ngalolu daba emva komhlangano."Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kukaMkhombo, kanye nemeya yomkhandlu, uMnuz Siphile Mdaka, ayizange iphumelele njengoba izingcingo zabo bezingangeni.UNdwandwe akamusha kuMasipala uMkhanyakude njengoba eke waba wumlawuli izikhawu ezahlukene.
WEHLISE amaphaphu uNgqongqoshe woMnyango wezoHwebo, iziMboni nokuNcintisana, uMnuz Parks Tau, mayelana nesiphakamiso sokuthi kuchitshiyelwe umthetho i-National Credit Act (NCA), ukuze izikweletu zezitshudeni zifakwe kuma-credit bureau.Lesi siphakamiso siqubule imvunge ezinhlanganweni zezitshudeni, ezithi lo mnyakazo uzokwenza izitshudeni zakuleli zicwile ezikweletini. Lezi zinhlangano zifuna kuchithwe lesi siphakamiso.UTau uthe inhloso akuyona ukucwilisa izitshudeni ezikweletini, ikakhulu lezo ezikweleta izikhungo zemfundo ephakeme. "Inhloso akuyona ukucindezela labo abakweleta izikhungo ngoba siyazi ukuthi yintsha ekweleta lezi zikhungo. Ngezichibiyelo kuhloswe ukuvikela ulwazi lwabantu olukuma-credit bureau. Enye into ngukuthi amabhizinisi amancane akwazi ukuthola usizo lokubolekwa imali," usho kanje.Uthe uzizwile izikhalo zezinhlaka ezehlukene mayelana nesiphakamiso esithinta izikhungo zemfundo."Zonke iziphakamiso ezizokwenziwa zizocutshungulwa ngaphambi kokuba zifakwe emigomeni. Uma kunesidingo kungalulwa nesikhathi sokuthi umphakathi uphawule," kusho uTau. Izinhlangano okubalwa eyentsha ye-EFF, ekaKhongolose, eyezitshudeni i-Sasco, eyemikhandlu emele izitshudeni emanyuvesi i-South African Union of Students' (SAUS), ziyayichitha eyalesi siphakamiso.UMnuz Sihle Lonzi, ilungu lePhalamende le-EFF, ukhale ngokuthi isiphakamiso sizokwenza intsha ingakwazi ukuphuma ogibeni lwezikweletu.Uthe kumele zisuswe izikhungo zemfundo ohlwini lezikhungo okumele kutholakale ulwazi lwabakweletayo."Kuzoba nzima uma abantu abasha sekumele baqale amabhizinisi, sekutholakala ukuthi bakweleta izikhungo zemfundo. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi baqhubeke bacwile endlaleni." I-Sasco ithe uhulumeni kumele akhumbule ukuthi into eyenza izitshudeni zingene shi ezikweletwini, yingoba uyahluleka ukuzixhasa ngendlela efanele."Siyayichitha le ngoba kuyaziwa ukuthi yizitshudeni ezimnyama ezibhekene nale nkinga. Sifuna ukuthi zisulwe izikweletu zezitshudeni," kusho iSasco esitatimendeni.I-SAUS igxeke umnyango kaTau, yathi kumele ngabe usebenzisana nezinye izinhlaka ukuze kusulwe izikweletu zezitshudeni."Uma kufakwa izitshudeni ngaphansi kwamabhuku ezikweletu lokho kusho ukuthi ngeke zikwazi ukuboleka imali uma kumele zivule amabhizinisi. Kwezinye izindawo ngeke ziwuthole kwalowo msebenzi ngoba zizobe zikweleta. Asihambisani nalesi siphakamiso," kusho iSAUS esitatimendeni. UNobhala Jikelele we-ANC Youth League, uMnuz Mntuwoxolo Ngudle, uthe: "Lesi sinyathelo sizokwenza ukuthi izitshudeni zingakwazi ukuthola amathuba uma sezifakwe ngaphansi kwalawa mabhuku ezikweletu. Kumele ngabe uhulumeni uqhamuka nemigomo ethinta ukucishwa kwezikweletu zezitshudeni."Umphakathi unikwe kuze kube uLwesihlanu, ukuthi uphawule ngesiphakamiso.

UMBIKO othulwe ePhalamende uveze ukuthi abafundi bakwa-Grade 6, bashaya udaka kwi-Maths njengoba bengaphezu kuka-30% abafeyilile ekoteni yokuqala yonyaka.Umbiko othulwe nguMnuz Philip Dikgomo, oseMnyangweni weMfundo eyisiSekelo, uveze ukuthi babalelwa ku-70% abaphase lesi sifundo ngo-50%, ekoteni yokuqala yalo nyaka."Badonsa kanzima abafundi kuleli banga okuveza ukuthi ngeke sifinyelele kulokhu esizibekele khona singumnyango. Besifisa ukuthi okungenani babe sebephasa ngo-90%, ngo-2030, ngokomqulu wokuthuthukisa izwe," usho kanje. Uthe emazingeni aphansi baqale benze kahle baphase ngo-80%, kodwa uma sebefika kwa-Grade 6 bese itshe ligaya ngomunye umhlathi."Zikhona izinhlelo esizenzayo zokuzama ukucija othisha kulesi sifundo. Izifundazwe zinazo nezinhlelo zokuphucula ukufundiswa kwalesi sifundo kanjalo neSayensi," usho kanje.UMqondisi jikelele, uMnuz Mathanzima Mweli, udalule ukuthi kuba wumqansa kubafundi uma sebeya kuGrade 8. Uthe yinto abayibheke kakhulu ngoba emazingeni aphansi benza kahle kodwa uma sebenyukela bathwale kanzima."Yinto esiyixoxayo ngisho emhlanganweni wezinhloko zeminyango kwezemfundo. Amamaki abafundi ashona phansi uma sebeya ku-Grade 8 no-9," kusho uMweli.Uveze nokuthi kumele kuqiniswe emazingeni aphansi uma kufundiswa ukuze kube lula kubafundi uma sebedlulela kwamanye amabanga. Amalungu ePhalamende abuze ukuthi ngeke yini kusize ukufundisa abafundi ngezilimi zesintu ikakhulu lezi zifundo ezinzima.UDikgomo uthe zikhona izinhlelo ezifuze lezi njengoba kwamanye amabanga befundisa ngezilimi ezimbili, olwesintu kanjalo nesiNgisi."Nocwaningo luyakuveza ukuthi uma kufundiswa ngolimi lwesintu, umfundi wenza kahle ezifundweni zakhe. Yinto esiyenzayo ikakhulu njengoba sisebenzisana nenhlangano ebhekele izilimi i-Pan South African Language Board."Sekuke kwakhalwa ngokuthi izifundazwe eziningi zilaxaza iMaths zenzise abafundi i-Maths Literacy ikakhulu kusuka ku-Grade 10 kuze kuye ku-matric ukuze baphase.IMaths Literacy kukhalwa ngokuthi ayibasizi ngalutho uma sekumele bangene emanyuvesi.
UZWAKALISE ukungagculiseki unina womfundi (16) wasesikoleni, uMtapo High, eLindelani, eThekwini, umseshi enza kuba lula ukudedelwa ngebheyili kukathisha wakulesi sikole osolwa ngokumdlwengula, aze akhulelwe.Unina kamgilwa, ongeke adalulwe ukuvikela umgilwa uthe kummangazile okuningi okushiwo umseshi, uSergeant Kwenzokuhle Dube ngesikhathi umsolwa (34) efaka isicelo sebheyili."Usho wonke amaphuzu akhombisa ukuthi weseka ukuthi umsolwa adedelwe ngebheyili. Wangasho lutho kwengimtshele khona ngesikhathi sikhuluma ngokuthi angifuni adedelwe,” kusho unina kamgilwa. Phakathi kwamaphuzu athi umtshele wona elokuthi umgilwa usatshiswa umfundi okusolwa ukuthi uthandana nomsolwa esikoleni."Ngimtshelile ukuthi lo mfundi ukhiphe ingane yami ekilasini kufundwa, wayibuza ukuthi ilibophiseleni isoka lakhe,” kusho unina kamgilwa.Uthe ngokusho kukamgilwa, lokhu kwenzeke emva kokuthi lo mfundi efonele umsolwa njengoba eseboshiwe, embuza ukuthi uboshelweni, waphendula ngokuthi akahambe ayofuna impendulo kumgilwa. "Ngaleso sizathu ingane yam isiyaphelezelwa uma iya noma ibuya esikoleni,” kusho unina kamgilwa."Ngithukile ukuthi sikhulumile naye kodwa wangabe esakusho nhlobo engimtshele kona. Ubelokhu ethi kufanele ngibe nobufakazi obuphathekayo,” usho kanje.Uthe uze wabeka nanokuthi umsolwa ungumuntu wendawo nokwenza babe novalo ngokudedelwa kwakhe. Uthe bekungelona iqiniso lokuthi ubehamba yedwa enkantolo, sikhona isihlobo sakhe abehamba naso futhi ikhona inqwaba ebizimisele ngokuza kodwa yathikanyezwa isiteleka samatekisi."Lokhu kokuthi kukhona abathi ingane ibithuleleni, ngiyafisa ukwazi ukuthi obani labo asebenolwazi lokuthi babuza lokho,” kusho unina kamgilwa. Usole umseshi ngokuthi usho wonke amaphuzu akhombisa ukweseka umsolwa, wangasho nelilodwa elikhombisa ukweseka umgilwa. "Angigculisekile ngendlela enze ngayo. Umshushisi uze wangibuza ukuthi kungani ngivuma ibheyili, ngamtshela ukuthi angikaze ngiyivume,” usho kanje.Uthe akasenaso isiqiniseko sokuthi umgilwa uzobuthola yini ubulungiswa uma ithi isuka nje kube kwenzeka kanje.
UCHAZWEngumndeni wakhe njengeqhawe umshayeli wezimoto ezikhokhelwa ngebanga ezilihambile, uSiyanda Mthokozisi Mvelase, odutshulwe washiswa eSoweto, enxanxatheleni yezitolo iMaponya Mall, emasontweni amabili edlule.UMvelase ufihlwe kubo eNhlungwane, oLundi, ngoMgqibelo enkonzweni ebinosizi nebihanjelwe yizikhulu ezihlukene zikahulumeni nosomabhizinisi.Ukushona kukaMvelase kwathinta abaningi njengoba kusolwa ingxabano eyayphakathi kwabamatekisi nabashayeli bezimoto ezikhokhelwa ngebanga ezilihambile. Enkonzweni yomngcwabo odadewabo bamchaze njengomuntu obenokuthula engawufuni umsindo.Bathe okubaphethe kabi wukuthi umfowabo ubeseyithemba lokuthi uzovusa umuzi wakubo kodwa wabulawa enezinsuku ezimbili kuphela eqalile emsebenzini.Okhulumela omalume bakhe, uMnuz Mlamuli Khuzwayo, uveze ukuthi okubuhlungu nokubakhathazayo wukuthi namanje uphenyo lwamaphoyisa aluyi ndawo."Sicela kusheshe uphenyo ngalesi sigameko. Lapho kwashona khona umshana kukhona amakhamera angalusheshisa uphenyo kuboshwe abenzi bobubi. Sicela kubhekwe amakhamera asenxanxatheleni yezitolo ukuze sithole ukuthula emoyeni,” kusho yena.Omemezela isiminyaminya sezimoto emgwaqweni emsakazweni uKhozi FM, u-Ayanda Msweli, ubonge ukubambisana kwezinhlaka ezihlukene ukuze kugcine kufihleke uMvelase ngesizotha.Uthe lolu daba lwathinta abaningi luqala ukuvela kwaze kwaba sekugcineni njengoba efihlwa.I-Santaco KwaZulu-Natal ithe ikhalisana nomndeni futhi nayo ibambisene namaphoyisa ekutheni kutholakale abenzi bobubi.Ithe yize ingazikhiphi ekutheni abanye babashayeli bayo abenza lokhu kodwa kuyabadida ukuthi uMvelase adutshulwe aze ashiswe nokuyinto abangafuni ukuphinde bayibone yenzeka uma kunezinxushunxushu.
BATHI abasamfuni esikoleni uthishanhloko, abazali bezingane ezifunda eNembe Primary, KwaDendethu, eMandeni.Lesi sikhalo sabazali siqubuke ngenuva kokuvela kwezinsolo zokuthi uthishomkhulu ebambisene nosihlalo wesigungu esilawula ukuphathwa kwesikole, i-School Governing Body (SGB), benukwa ngokuthi bafuna ngodli imali engu-R1 500 kwabathathu abaqashwe njengabasizi bothisha ababizwa ngama-Education Assistants (EA).Kuthiwa ama-EA okufunwa kuwo le mali ngaqashwe ngesikhathi kuqala isigaba sesithathu sonyaka ngoJulayi, kulo nyaka. Ngokusho komunye okulesi sigungu, uMnuz Sipho Makhoba, bathole ngezinsolo ngasekupheleni kukaJulayi. "Kuthiwa bathi bayifeyila inhlolokhono, bona base bebenzela ufefe ngokubaqasha ngakho-ke kuzofanele bakhokhe u-R1 500 umuntu ngamunye emiholweni yabo njalo ngenyanga. Babe sebeza kimina ukuzobika lokhu ngoba nami ngikhona kwi-SGB,” kusho uMakhoba.Uthe badonswa ngendlebe ukuthi bangayifaki ebhange kodwa bayilethe ngemvilophu kuthishanhloko ozobe eseyedlulisela kusihlalo, yena ayidlulisele endaweni efanele. "Kuthiwa uthishanhloko wathi izosiza ukuholela umabhalane wesikole, uthisha ofundisa uGrade RR nowesifazane ohlanza amathoyilethi. Ngokusho kwakhe kuma-EA, bonke laba bantu abaholi yikho yena nosihlalo befinyelele kulesi sinqumo,” kusho uMakhoba. Uthe bathe uma sebezenzela olwabo uphenyo bathola ukuthi laba obekuthiwa bakolekelwa le mali, abakaze batshelwe lutho ngayo. Uthe abazali abasamdingi esikoleni uthishanhloko. "Uxhaphaza izingane zendawo ezizama amatoho kulolu hlelo lwama-EA. Naye usihlalo akasafuneki ngoba usebenzisana nothishanhloko ukwenza izinto ezingafanele, ecindezela intsha eqashwe ngalolu hlelo. Akakhombisi ukuba yizwi labazali,” kusho uMakhoba.Uqhube wathi wonke umphakathi uyiqaphe ngeso lokhozi eyokuphepha kwala ma-EA aveze ngalo mkhuba, wathi emva kwemashi ababe nayo ngoLwesine, bebekubeke kwacaca ukuthi uthishanhloko bafuna amiswe ngokushesha njengoba kuqhubeka uphenyo ngezinsolo. Wengeze ngokuthi banovalo lokuthi ukuba khona kwakhe esikoleni kuzophazamisa upheyo.Uthe ohlwini lwabo lwezikhalazo bebethe bafuna kushaye uSepthemba 5, kulo nyaka, sebephenduliwe.Ucingo lukathishanhloko aluzange lungene ngesikhathi eshayelwa. Usihlalo weSGB, uMnuz Khanyisani Jiyane, uvumile ukuthi zikhona izinsolo ezifuze lezi, eziphenywa wuMnyango wezeMfundo ezingeni lesekethe nesifunda."Nakuba ngingasavumelekile ukuthi ngande kabanzi ngalolu daba ngoba seluvele luyaphenywa, ngifuna ukukubeka kucace ukuthi ayikho into yokuthi kugwaziswa intsha,” kusho uJiyane.La ma-EA kulindeleke ukuthi asebenze kuze kube sekupheleni kukaNovemba, kulo nyaka, njengoba inkontileka yawo ingeyezinyanga eziyisithupha. Abasuke beqashwa kulolu hlelo bahola u-R4 500 umuntu ngamunye.Isolezwe liyithumele imibuzo ukuze kutholakele ukuphawula koMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, kwaze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela ungaphawulanga ngokuthi uphenyo ngothishanhloko waseNembe lukusiphi isigaba.
BATHI bafe olwembiza abadayisi basemarenki ngokuma kwamatekisi njengoba bethi lokhu kuyabakhinyabeza kakhulu futhi kudala ukuthi bangakwazi nokucosha inkece yokuphila.UNksz Lungile Zungu waseSolezwe, ngakwa-C, KwaMashu, osedayise iminyaka erenki yakule ndawo, uthe bagqemeke engeqiwa ntwala njengoba kuqale isiteleka samatekisi izolo.Uthe uziphilisa ngokudayisa - umndeni wakhe uwondla ngayo le mali. Ugcizelele kakhulu ukuthi kubalimazile ukuba khona kwesiteleka samatekisi. "'Akekho umuntu esimthembile sibheke yona le nto yokudayisa lapha emgwaqweni. Ngiwumama oziphantelayo njengoba namhlanje kungasetshenzwa ngiyalimala kakhulu. Ekhaya kubhekwe mina,'' usho kanjena.Uthe njengoba kuphele inyanga nje baye babe nethemba lokuthi kukhona okungcono abazokuthola, wathi kodwa lesi simo sesidale ukuthi kumane kube nzima kakhulu.Uthe ubhekene nesimo esinzima njengoba bekufanele aye eBhamshela emngcwabeni wesihlobo ngempelasonto obekuzokuba lula ukube ubesebenzile kwabakhona imali engenayo. Uthe ngenxa yokubhimba kwezinto akaboni ukuthi bonke emndenini bazokwazi ukuya emngcwabeni. "Ngeke sisaya sonke ngoba akuzange kudayiseke kahle,'' usho kanjena.Ukhale nangokuthi uhambe ngezinyawo eya erenki, wabalisa nangokubola kwezinto abazidayisayo ezifana nobhanana."Uma kunjena izinto zethu ziyabola. Besilapha nje sinethemba lokuthi kukhona okuncane esizokuthola,'' kuchaza yena.Unxuse ukuthi uma kunenzingqinamba ezikhona embonini yamatekisi, kube khona ukuxoxisana okuphuthumayo phakathi kwayo nazo zonke izinhlangothi ezithintekayo. UNkk Nomusa Mhlongo odayisa erenki yaseYMCA naye ukhale esifanayo etshela Isolezwe ukuthi isiteleka sibalimaza kangakanani njengabadayisi."Kubuhlungu kakhulu lokhu esikubona kwenzeka ngoba kuyafana nje nokuthi kusiphuca iqatha emlonyeni. Thina siziphilisa ngokudayisa emarenki. Uma sekuma amatekisi sizodayisela bani ngoba abantu abeza eThekwini balethwa yiwona kanye amatekisi,'' usho kanjena.Khonamanjalo ngenhloso yokubhekela izidingo zomphakathi, iMeya yeTheku, ikhansela uCyril Xaba noMphathiswa wezokuThutha KwaZulu Natal, uMnuz Siboniso Duma, sebenxuse abaholi bemboni yamatekisi ukuba baqede isiteleka."Sizimisele ngokweseka imboni yamatekisi futhi sifisa ukubona kunezixazululo. Sizophinde sixoxisane noNgqongqoshe wezokuThutha uNkk Barbara Creecy,'' kusho uXaba. Uveze ukuthi isigungu esihlanganisa abamele imboni yamatekisi, uMasipala weTheku noMnyango wezokuThutha bazoqhubeka babhunge ngezixazululo ezinkingeni ezibonakala zikhungethe imboni. Kunomhlangano obuhlanganisa abeMetro Taxi Council eholwa nguMnuz Mathula Mkhize, imenenja yeTheku uMnuz Musa Mbhele kanye nezikhulu ebezimele iClermont neKwaDabeka.Lo mhlangano ubuyingxenye yemizamo kahulumeni yokungenelela ezinkingeni zemboni yematekisi ikakhulukazi KwaDabeka naseClermont. Kulo mhlangano kubhungwe kabanzi nangenkinga yezimvume kanye nokudedelwa kwezimoto eziye zithathwe.Okhulumela iSantaco, uMnuz Sifiso Shangase, uthe zikhona izingxoxo eziqhubekayo futhi kulokoza inhlansi yethemba ngokuthi kuzophuma isixazululo. "Okuningi sesivumelene ngakho emhlanganweni ophele entathakusa namuhla (esho izolo). Sinethemba lokuthi kozoba namuhla ntambama (esho izolo) kuzophuma isinqumo sokuthi ziyabuya izimoto kusasa (esho namuhla)," kusho uShangase.Uthe okuningi izinhlaka ebezisemhlanganweni zivumelene ngakho, phakathi kwakho ubale ukudedelwa kwamatekisi aKwaDabeka angu-25, ayeshaqwe amaphoyisa ngoLwesihlanu olwedlule kuthiwa awanazo izimvume zokuba semgwaqweni.
KWENZEKE okungajwayelekile eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseNtuzuma, uthisha osolwa kwelokudlwengula umfundi (16) waze wakhulelwa, ededelwa kalula ngebheyili ka-R2 000.Umsolwa (34) okuthiwa ufundisa iMathematics neScience esikoleni uMtapo High, eLindelani, uboshwe ngoLwesibili olwedlule.Kuthiwa wadlwengula ephindelela umgilwa ofunda uGrade 10 kulesi sikole. Kubikwa ukuthi isigameko sakamumva senzeke ngeSonto eledlule, umgilwa eya esontweni. Kuvela ukuthi umsolwa wamphoqa ukuthi agibele emotweni, wayishaya yazula yaya emqashweni wakhe, wafike wamdlwengulela khona.Esandulela leso, kuthiwa senzeka emasontweni ambalwa edlule, lapho umgilwa adlwengulelwa kwelinye lamagumbi okufunda esikoleni. Ngesikhathi evela izolo ezofaka isicelo sebheyili, kwenzeke okungajwayelekile, umshushisi woMbuso, uNkk Govendor esho okunye nomseshi esho okunye. UNkk Govendor ubesendlalele ngezethulo ezikhombisa ukuthi uMbuso uyaphikisana nokuthi umsolwa adedelwe ngebheyili, kodwa umphenyi, uSergeant Kwenzokuhle Dube, wathi yena akakuphikisi ukuthi umsolwa adedelwe ngebheyili."Abukho ubudlelwane obuphakathi kukamsolwa nomgilwa. Umgilwa uyingane, kubukeka kunesenzo sokusizakala ngalokho ohlangothini lukamsolwa, nokuyicala elibomvu,” kusho uNkk Govendor.Wengeze ngokuthi emacaleni amane okukhona kuwo awokudlwengula nawokuthumba, kukhona nenzeka umgilwa eseneminyaka engaphansi kuka-16. Ube esekubeka kwacaca ukuthi uMbuso uyaphikisana nokuthi umsolwa adedelwe ngebheyili ngoba leli yicala elibucayi.Nokho kuthe umphenyi, uDube osebenza ophikweni lwamaphoyisa olubhekelela amacala odlame lwasemndenini, ukuhlukunyezwa kwezingane, namacala aphathelene nocansi eNanda, esengena ebhokisini lofakazi, wathi akaphikisani nokuthi umsolwa adedelwe ngebheyili.Uthe ngesikhathi enza uphenyo lwakhe uthole ukuthi umsolwa akakaze abe nacala phambilini futhi alikho elinye alihambayo njengamanje. "Usebenzela uMnyango wezeMfundo, ngeke alibalekele icala. Ngiliqinisekisile nekheli laseMlaza, lalapho angaphuma ayohlala khona uma ededelwa ngebheyili. Ngeke axhumane nomgilwa ohlala eNtuzuma, uma kwenzeka ededelwa ngebheyili,” kusho uDube. Uthe akukho zinsongo zokusabisa ezitholwa wumgilwa nomndeni wakhe kumsolwa kanjalo nasemndenini wakhe. Uveze nokuthi uke waya esikoleni lapho kufundisa khona umsolwa, wafike wathola ukuthi umnyango usezinhlelweni zokumumisa emsebenzini ngenxa yezinsolo zokudlwengula. Uqhube wathi ngesikhathi ekhuluma nonina kamgilwa umtshele ukuthi akafuni umsolwa adedelwe ngebheyili. Nokho uthe azibanga bikho izizathu eziphathekayo azibekile ukwesekela lokho ngaphandle kokuthi leli yicala elibucayi."Nomphakathi uhlukene phakathi. Ngikhuluma nje njengamanje lapha enkantolo kugcwele abazokweseka umsolwa, abekho abazokweseka unina kamgilwa. Emphakathini nasesikoleni, kukhona ababuza ukuthi wayethuleleni sonke lesi sikhathi, abanye bathi yingoba useyingane,” kusho uDube. Encwadini efungelwe kamsolwa, efundwe wummeli wakhe uMnuz Mafika Dlamini, uveze ukuthi uhlela ukuwaphika wonke amacala abekwe wona. "Angikaze ngimdlwengule umgilwa futhi angikaze ngimthumbe. Ngosuku lwesigameko ngamgibeza emotweni yebo, egqoke izingubo zesonto kodwa angizange ngimenze lutho,” kufundeka incwadi.Uqhube wathi unikela nangokuthi kuthathwe uketshezi lwakhe, luyohlolwa e-laboratory."Ngisola ukuthi unovalo lokukhuluma iqiniso kubazali bakhe wase ebona ukuthi kungcono asulele ngami,” kuqhubeka incwadi efungelwe. IMantshi uMnuz S Cadir ngaphambi kokuba imdedele ngebheyili ithe iyaqala ukubona kuba khona ukushayisana phakathi koMbuso nomseshi uma kwenziwa isicelo sebheyili."Umshushisi uyasiphikisa isicelo sebheyili, umseshi uthi akasiphikisi. Yinto engajwayelekile le,” kusho uCadir.Uqhube wathi inkantolo iyakucabangela nokuthi umsolwa unguthisha wezifundo ezinothisha abangandile . "Kuvela nokuthi usemisiwe emsebenzini noma kunezinhlelo zokuthi amiswe. Lokho kukodwa sekuyisijeziso ngaphandle kokuthi kuze kuzwakale ubufakazi obugcwele ngecala,” kusho uCadir.Emdedela ngebheyili, phakathi kweminye imibandela, uthe akufanele axhumane nomgilwa noma nofakazi, kufanele athuthele ekhelini laseMlaza ngokushesha angabe esabonakala eNtuzuma, KwaMashu naseNanda ngaphandle uma eze ecaleni. Icala lihlehlele u-Okthoba 29, 2025 ukuze kuqhutshekwe nophenyo.

UZuma unemizi ebiza ngaphezu kwesigidi samarandi, izimoto nemfuyo ebulala inyoka, kanti izingane zakhe zifunda ezikoleni zomtakabani.Le mininingwane ivele ngesikhathi uZuma efaka isicelo sebheyili eNkantolo yeMantshi eHowick. Umuzi ka-R1.4 million useMpendle, endaweni yakhe uZuma. UZuma unomuzi ka-R1.5 million oseSweetwater, eMgungundlovu. Nawo lo muzi usendaweni engaphansi kwakhe uZuma. UZuma unomuzi ka-R1.5 million endaweni yabadla izambane likapondo, eHowick West. Utshele inkantolo ukuthi lo muzi usawukhokhela. UZuma uphinde abe nomuzi ka-R1.7 million eClaridge, ngaseHilton. Umuzi oseMpendle uhlala undlunkulu wakhe onguthisha, bese kuthi lena eminye ihlala izingane zakhe nezingoduso.Uveze ukuthi unezinkomo ezingu-400, izimbuzi ezingu-42, nezimvu ezingu-120. Uthe uziphilisa ngokudayisa imfuyo kanye nezitshalo. "Ngonyaka ngiyawuthola u-R500 000 ngokudayisa imfuyo. Ngiyawuthola u-R300 000 ngonyaka ngokudayisa izivumo."Utshele inkantolo ukuthi unezimoto ezintathu ezimbili ezingama-SUV, neveni elinezicabha ezine, bese kuba ogandaganda ababili.Uphinde abe namatekisi amathathu athe abeka u-R50 000 njalo ngenyanga, itekisi lilinye. Izingane zakhe ezimbili ezifunda enkulisa, enye ikhokha u-R40 000 ngonyaka, enye ikhokha u-R30 000 ngonyaka. Ezifunda isikole enye ikhokha u-R50 000 ngonyaka, enye ikhokha u-R40 000 ngonyaka. UZuma unezingane ezimbili nondlunkulu, bese eba nezinye eziyisishiyagalombili azithola ngaphandle komshado.Ngesikhathi evele enkantolo ngoMsombuluko, uZuma ubeswenke econsa.UZuma usolwa ngokuhlela itulo lokusoconga uNdlovu. UMbuso uthe wakhokha u-R70 000 ukuze kubulawe uNdlovu. UNdlovu kuthiwa wabulawelwa ukungahambisani nokuxhunywa kukagesi ngendlela engekho emthethweni, eMpophomeni. UZuma uyawaphika amacala abekwa wona.Uboshwe noMnuz Thobani Hlongwa, Khayelihle Shabalala noThabo Chonco. Umsolwa oyinduna, uMnuz Zwelithini Buthelezi, yena usephenduke ufakazi wenkantolo. Icala lokubulawa kukaNdlovu lizobuyela enkantolo ngoMsombuluko.UZuma uphinde abhekane necala lokubulala owayengundunankulu wesizwe, uMnuz Qalokunye Zuma.Wadedelwa ngebheyili ka-R25 000 kuleli cala. UMbuso usola ukuthi wagwazela imantshi ngo-R200 000 ukuze adedelwe ngebheyili.Imali yokugwazela imantshi kuthiwa yakhokhwa ilungu le-MK esiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thobani Zuma.Lezi zinsolo zenziwa ngesikhathi uZuma evele enkantolo, ngoMsombuluko.UMbuso waphinde wenza izinsolo zokuthi uZuma wazama ukwakha itulo lokuba kudliswe ufakazi ecaleni elibhekene nomuntu osondelene nosomabhizinisi, uMnuz Khulubuse Zuma.
ATHUKA izanya amalungu omphakathi asoDidini, ku-ward 105, eMbumbulu, njengoba sekuphele inyanga ugesi ungekho ekubeni kudlange kakhulu izigameko zokubulawa kwabantu osekuphenduke insakavukela kule ndawo.Amalungu omphakathi akule ndawo akhulume neSolezwe athe alala obenyoni njengoba ugesi ungekho kule ndawo."Asazi ukuthi kwenzekani ngempela endaweni njengoba ugesi ungekho isikhathi eside kangaka. Phela le nto iyasihlukumeza futhi kakhulu kabi nje,'' kusho ilungu lomphakathi elicele ukuba ligodlwe igama lalo.Liqhuba lithe okudala ukuthi abantu bangenwe ngamanzi emadolweni ngokungabuyi kukagesi wukuthi babona bengaphephile.''Sebephelile abantu lapha eMbumbulu babulawa njengezimpukane. Okubuhlungu wukuthi kubukeka sengathi akekho umuntu onendaba nale nto eqhubeka endaweni,'' lisho kanjena.Elinye ilungu lomphakathi nalo elicele ukuba kugodlwe igama lalo likhala ngokungaphephi lithe ukungabi bikho kukagesi bakholwa wukuthi kuzokwenza ukuthi kube lula ukubulawa kwabantu kule ndawo."Uma kuqhubeka nokuthi kube mnyama kanjena lapha endaweni kuzoba lula kabi ukuthi abantu bangenelwe ezindlini babulawe. Yini ezovimba ababulali ukuthi bawenze kalula umsebenzi wabo ekubeni bekwazi ngisho ukuwenza ukhona ugesi," lisho kanjena lizwakala likhathazekile ilungu lomphakathi.Liqhuba lithe sebeqala ukubona sengathi le ndawo akekho umuntu onendaba nayo."Kule ndawo kufa abantu mihla namalanga kodwa akukho okwenzekayo. Noma kuhamba ugesi nakhona alukho usizo oluqhamukayo," lisho kanjena.Esikhathini esingangonyaka Isolezwe selibike ngabantu ababulawe ngokudutshulwa kule ndawo abangaphezulu kuka-25. Bonke akuqondakali ukuthi usuke uyini umnyombo wokubulawa kwabo.Bonke basuke bebulawe ngokudutshulwa behlaselwa ezindlini okanye bacathanyelwe uma besendleleni.Phambilini uNdunankulu, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, ebuzwa yiSolezwe ngalokhu wathi bazolusukumela udaba lwaseMbumbulu.Ikhansela lakule ndawo, uMnuz Ayanda Ndlovu, lithe bayazi ngenkinga kagesi, lathi lizoba nomhlangano ngesonto elizayo nabase-Eskom ngenhloso yokubhunga kabanzi ngale nkinga.Mayelana nezidumbu eziphumayo kule ndawo uthe uyazi nangalokho wathi lolu wudaba olubucayi abalushiyela ingalo yomthetho.''Yinto ebucayi kabi udaba lokuphuma komphefumlo womuntu. Kuye kube ngcono ukuthi lumane lusetshenzwe ngabomthetho,'' usho kanjena.Kodwa uthe bakhathazekile ngokungabi bikho kozinzo kule ndawo. Baningi abantu asebebulewe esikhathini esifishane esedlule. Muva nje kudutshulwe kwabulawa uMnuz Msawenkosi Chonco (59) emi esitobhini sangakubo. Kuthiwa kwaqhamuka abathile bangabuza lutho bamane bavulela ngenhlamvu bebhekise ngqo kuyena. Ngenyanga edlule kudutshulwe kwafa uMnuz Skhumbuzo Ndlovu.UNdlovu wadutshulwa kungakapholi maseko kubulawe uMnuz Mduduzi Ngcongo wakuyona le ndawo. UNgcongo wadutshulwa eseFolweni ehamba ngemoto yakhe. Kuwona lo nyaka kudutshulwe kwabulawa uMnuz Siphelele Khathi noMnuz Sihle Sibisi. Kwabulawa nenduna uMnuz Sphiwe Msweli kwase kulandeliswa ngendodana yakhe uMnuz Mhlengi Msweli. Bobabili badutshulwa bephuma esitolo sabo.Ngesikhathi kubulawa induna kukhona ababekholwa wukuthi kuyamelana nokudembesela kwayo uma kukhulunywa ngokwebiwa kwemfuyo. Kodwa kuthe sekuqhubeka kubulawa abanye, abantu baqala bacula elinye iculo sebethi kabasazi ukuthi kubulawa abantu abanjani futhi babulawelani.Kwabulawa noMnuz Mzwandile Nxumalo owahlaselwa esemzini wakhe ngabantu abangaziwa abamdubula ngoyaba lwezinhlamvu waphelela khona lapho, kwabulawa nabesilisa abahlanu esigamekweni esashiya umphakathi uthuthumela uzibuza uziphendula ukuthi kwenzekani kule ndawo.Kwabuye kwadutshulwa noMnuz Zakhele Ximba okuthiwa wayengusomatekisi. Bonke ababulawayo akuveli ukuthi kungani bebulawa.Isolezwe lathola ngomthombo walo ukuthi bonke ababulawayo bafa bazi njegoba baye baqale bathunyelelwe umqhafazo obazisayo ukuthi seliyashona ilanga. Kubona lobo bumnyama kukhalwa ngemoto encane okuthiwa uma kuke kwabonakala yona izulazula nakanjani ukhona umphefumulo osuke uzophuma.

KUME nse ukufunda esikoleni samabanga aphansi esiseMpendle, eHoloma Primary, othisha beduba umsebenzi ngoba bekhala ngothishanhloko abathi ufuna bacele kuye noma beya endlini encane.Sekuphele amasonto amabili kungafundwa kulesi sikole esiseNzinga, njengoba othisha bekhala ngokuphathwa ngesandla sensimbi uthishanhloko.Uthisha ocele ukuba igama lakhe lingadalulwa ukhale ngokuthi uthishanhloko uyabathuka."Usibiza ngezidomu, asitshele ukuthi asifundile. Kufanele uqale ucele kuyena uma ufuna ukukhuluma neselula. Uma ufuna ukuya ethoyilethi kufanele ucele kuyena. Noma ufuna ukudla ngesikhathi sokudla, kufanele ubike kuyena."Uthisha uthe uthishomkhulu ufike washintsha nesikhathi sokuphuma kwesikole."Zonke izikole zalapha eMpendle ziphuma ngo-2.30. Yena ufike wengeze u-30 minutes. Indlela engijabule ngayo namhlanje ngizoke ngilale ubuthongo. Ubuthongo bebungasafiki sidalo. Bengikhathazeke kakhulu njengoba izingane zethu bezingafundi nje."UNksz Khumalo uthe othisha abazange babatshele ukuthi yini ebenze baduba ukufundisa.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi isivumelwano sokuba othisha babuyele emsebenzini esesikhashana njengoba kunomhlangano ozokuba ngoMsombuluko, lapho kuzokhulunywa ngodaba olufanayo.Isakhamuzi, uMnuz Njabulo Cele, sithe kuyinto eyaziwayo ukuthi uthishanhloko akezwani nothisha."Akafuni ukuxhumana kahle nothisha. Uyabakalela ukuthi bazokuya nini ethoyilethe. Uyabakalela ukuthi bawachofa nini amafoni abo. Wake wahleba ngabanye bothisha, wathi abakwazi ukufundisa."UCele uthe bafuna kuhlakazwe isigungu sabazali bese kuphinde kuxoshwa nothishomkhulu."Asazi ukuthi sakhethwa kanjani isigungu sabazali esikhona. Sicela nokuthi uthishanhloko asuke esikoleni. Ufike ngonyaka owedlule kodwa usefike wadala izinkinga ezenza ukuthi kungasebenzeki kahle. Ayikaze yenzeke le nto ko-principal ababili abadlule."IKhansela, uMnuz Sadewu Ngubane, lithe izinkinga ezikhona esikoleni zijule kakhulu."Nabahloli bashilo ukuthi izinkinga zinkulu kakhulu, bangasichazela zonke. Emhlanganweni wanamhlanje (esho izolo) uthishomkhulu ubengekho. Lokhu kukutshela ukuthi azikapheli izinkinga."UNgubane ukhale ngokungabambisana phakathi kukathishomkhulu, othisha nesigungu sabazali."Ngiyazi ukuthi uthishomkhulu uyafika. Uma kukhona izinto afuna ukuzishintsha kufanele aqaphele ukuthi akunyatheleki amalungelo abanye. Thina into esiyifunayo ukuthi izingane zibe sesikoleni. Kufanele izinkinga zilungiseke zisencane ngoba uma sezinkulu azibe zisalungiseka kalula. Kugcina sekuphazamiseka nezingane."Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Muzi Mahlambi, akazange awuphendule umbuzo awuthunyelwe.

I-ANC ixoshe ikhansela lakuMasipala waseMandeni elisolwa ekufeni komuntu owatholwa eshonile emva kokuba elivulele icala lokushaya nelokuzama ukubulala. UKhongolose umise ubulungu bekhansela lawo elinukeka ekufeni kukaMnuz Siyabonga Makhoba, owashona evulele ikhansela icala emva kokuba limhudule ngemoto limsola ngokweba uthayela. UMakhoba watholakala eshonile ngo-2023.Isidumbu sikaMakhoba satholwa sesonakele silaxazwe emafusini agudle ujantshi phakathi kwamafemu KwaSithebe, eMandeni.Ngesikhathi uMakhoba enyamalala ikhansela - igama lalo elingeke lidalulwe - laligqigqa enkantolo ngecala lokushaya nelokuzama ukubulala. Ikhansela lalimaza kabi uMakhoba ngesikhathi limhudula ngemoto, limsola ngokweba uthayela. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kwabuye kwavela ukuthi uthayela wawungantshontshwa uMakhoba. Emva kwalokho, kwabe sekuba nezingxoxo phakathi kukaMakhoba nekhansela kodwa bagcina bengavumelana ngemali okwakufanele ikhokhwe yikhansela ukuze kusulwe icala.Emva kwalokho, uMakhoba wabe esenyamalala, isidumbu sakhe saze satholakala emva kwezinyanga ezintathu.Okhulumela i-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Fanle Sibisi, uthe banqume ukumisa ubulungu bekhansela kwi-ANC."Ukumiswa kobulungu bakhe kusho ukuthi akakwazi ukuqhubeka abe yikhansela. I-ANC ayihambisani nodlame nabantu abasebenzisa amandla abo budedengu. Asihambisani nezenzo ezibeka engcupheni ukuphepha komphakathi nezehlisa isithunzi sabanye abantu. Siyaphinda futhi siyazibophezela ekusebenzeni ngokwethembeka nasekuhlonipheni amalungelo abantu."USibisi uthe i-ANC izoqhubeka nokuvikela amalungelo abantu."Isinqumo sokuxosha ikhansela sikhombisa ngokusobala ukuthi sizimisele ukuvikela abantu. Sinxusa abantu ukuba basebenzisane namaphoyisa."UMakhoba ungcwatshwe isibili ngenyanga eyedlule.Umndeni wangcwaba amathambo emva kokuphuma kwemiphumela yolibofuzo.Okokuqala wayekade engcwatshwe uhulumeni ngesikhathi kusalindwe imiphumela yolibofuzo.Ngenyanga eyedlule, umndeni kaMakhoba wabhalela ubuholi be-ANC esifundeni iGeneral Gizenga Mpanza, ucela ukuba kumiswe ikhansela. Umfowabo kaMakhoba, uMnuz Mthoko Makhoba, usishayele ihlombe isinqumo sobuholi be-ANC sokuxosha ikhansela."Siyasijabulela kakhulu isinqumo se-ANC siwumndeni wakwaMkhoba, sizokuya ukuyoyikhankasela uma sekunokhetho lokuchibiyela ngoba ikhombise ukuzwelana kakhulu nabantu."UMakhoba akazange afune ukwanda kakhulu, wathi umphenyi wecala ubaluleke ukuba bengakhulumi ngalolu daba kwabezindaba.Ngesikhathi umufi esadukile, umndeni watshelwa ukuthi lihoxisiwe icala lokushaya nelokuzama ukubulala elalibhekene nekhansela ngenxa yokushoda kobufakazi.
KUVELE ukuthi ubehlale emjaha ngezikhali ezehlukene umkakhe, uthishanhloko wasesikoleni iSithembile Primary, eLindelani, eThekwini, osolwa ngokugcina embulele. Ethula ubufakazi obuphikisa isicelo sebheyili umphenyi, uSergeant Sanele Mdima, uthe ofakazi abehlukene baveze ukuthi emlandweni wodlame kulaba abaganene, umsolwa ubebuye amjahe ngommese umufi, kokunye kube wucelemba. "Indodana yabo yaveza esitatimendeni ukuthi ezinsukwini ezimbili ngaphambi kwesigameko sokubulala, umsolwa wayemgijimisa endlini ngommese,” kusho uMdima. Kwesinye isehlakalo, ufakazi ongumakhelwane, naye uveze ukuthi kukhona lapho ayemjaha khona ngocelemba, kwaze kwakhuza yena. UMdima utshele inkantolo ukuthi umsolwa wamtshela ukuthi ummese wokugcina amasiko umufi "azibulala" ngawo. Kusolakala ukuthi yisinqindi agcagca ngaso uNkk Dhlomo okanye wummese wokuhlaba. "Wathi lo mmese babewubeka ngaphansi kukamatrasi, embhedeni ababelala kuwo,” kusho uMdima. Embuza umshushisi woMbuso, uMnuz Calvin Govender ukuthi yiwo yini lo mmese okuthiwa watholwa uphethwe, umufi ngesandla, uMdima uthe kunjalo.Ubufakazi bukaMdima bubuye babeka obala izinsolo zokuthi umsolwa waphula umthetho, wasusa isidumbu endaweni yesigameko, wayosibeka kwenye indawo lapho esagcina sificwa khona amaphoyisa. Lokhu kuvele esitatimendeni sendodana yabo nesikanina kamsolwa. Kwesendodana kuvela ukuthi yezwa uyise (umsolwa) esho ngengila emnyango ngesikhathi yona ihleli ngaphakathi egunjini lokuphumula. "Ithi yaqale yalunguza ngewindi, yabona uyise emi eduze kwesidumbu sikanina. Ithi yagijima yaya kuye, ukuyozwa ukuthi kwenzekeni, wayitshela ukuthi unina usezibulele,” kusho uMdima. Uthe wabe eseyiyalela ukuthi ibuyele endlini ngoba incane ngeminyaka ukubona into efana nale. "Esitatimendeni sayo indodana, ibuye iveze ukuthi yabuye yabuyela lapho okwakulele khona isidumbu sikanina sekufike amaphoyisa. Yaqaphela ukuthi unina usebambe ummese ngesandla, ekubeni ayekade engawuphethe ngesikhathi imbona okokuqala ekuqaleni,” kuqhuba uMdima. Ngakolunye, uhlangothi uMdima uveze ukuthi isitatimende esenziwa unina kamsolwa, okuthiwa wayekhona ekhaya ngosuku lwesigameko, siveza ukuthi umsolwa wangqongqoza ekamelweni lakhe, wamfica edla iphalishi, elungisela ukuya esontweni. "Uthe wamtshela ukuthi kukhona into eseyenzekile, uKhanyi usezibulele. Uthe wambuza unina ukuthi kanjani, wamphendula ngokuthi uzinqume uqhoqhoqho,” kusho uMdima. Uthe balandelana, umsolwa ehola unina phambili, baze bayofika emnyango wekamelo labo (abashadile). "Umnyango wawuvaliwe, umsolwa watshela unina ukuthi angangeni ngoba azokubona kuzomenza angalali ebusuku,” kusho uMdima. Lokhu kudwebe isithombe sokuthi ngokukamsolwa zimbili izindawo okwenzeka kuzo isigameko esisodwa. Indawo yokuqala isekamelweni labo, okuvela ebufakazini bukanina. Eyesibili ingaphandle egcekeni, lapho abizela khona indodana, eyikhombisa ukuthi unina usezibulele. Uphinde waveza nokuthi umakhelwane, naye oweza endaweni yesigameko, waveza ukuthi umufi ubeseqale uhlelo lokufaka isehlukaniso nomsolwa, wathi naye waze wameseka kusona njengoba ayenolwazi oluphelele ngokuthi ubudlelwane babo bunomlando wodlame. "Lo fakazi uthe waze wamtshela ukuthi uyameseka kuleso sinqumo ngoba uma engasifaki isehlukaniso uzogcina embulele, nokuyinto eyagcina yenzeke ngempela,” kubeka uMdima.Kuvele ukuthi umsolwa ngaphambi ngokuba aboshwe, wathumela indodana yakhe umyalezo ethi uyifisela inhlanhla. Lokhu yakuhlaziya njengokuyisabisa ngoba yase ithole ukuthi useyazi ukuthi kade bebhalisa izitatimende. Inkantolo ibigcwele, ivale ngomuntu emnyango. Kwabebezothamela, bekukhona umndeni wakwaNduli lapho okuzalwa khona umufi, owakwaDhlomo lapho aganele khona, bese kuba amalungu e-ANC. KwabakwaDhlomo ubekhona noMnuz Sibongiseni Dhlomo, obonakale ephuma masinyane elandela amanye amalungu omndeni wakwaNduli, aphume echiphiza izinyembezi ngesikhathi uMdima ethula ubufakazi obushaqisayo. Kusolakala ukuthi uDhlomo ubeyowathulisa lawa malunga, njengoba bebuye babuya ngaphakathi enkantolo belandelana emva kwemizuzu embalwa. Imantshi uMnuz Scelo Zuma ilihlehlisele inamuhla icala, ukuze kuqhubeke ukuhlonywa ngemibuzo kukaMdima.
ISHAQISE abaningi eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini, izolo, eyokuvela kwezinsolo zokuthi uthishanhloko osolwa ngokubulala umkakhe, waficwa abanye ofakazi edlonya utshwala namaphoyisa ayejutshwe ukuba ayoqoqa obunye ubufakazi endaweni yesigameko. Lokhu kuvele ngesikhathi kuqhubeka ukuhlonywa ngemibuzo komphenyi wecala, uSergeant Sanele Mdima, ngummeli kamsolwa, ngu-Advocate Scelo Zungu. Umsolwa, uMnuz khayelihle Dhlomo (53) onguthishanhloko wasesikoleni iSithembile Primariy, eLindelani, eThekwini, uqhubeka ngokufaka isicelo sokuthi adedelwe ngebheyili. Lona wesilisa futhi oyindodana yomfowabo kasihlalo wekomiti lezeMpilo ePhalamende, uDkt Sibongiseni Dhlomo, kuthiwa wagwaza umkakhe, uNkk Khanyisile Dhlomo, wambulala emzini wabo oseMalvern, ngoSepthemba 4, 2022. Kuthiwa ngaleso sikhathi watshela umndeni, abasondelene naye kanjalo namaphoyisa ukuthi umufi uzigwaze yena, wazibulala. UMdima uveze ukuthi kwakunguSepthemba 11, 2022, ngesikhathi ithimba lamaphoyisa lihambela emzini kamsolwa. Uthe inhloso kwakuwukuyophenya ukuthi abukho yini ubufakazi uphiko lochwepheshe elalizobuthola endlini obabuzoveza ukuthi kukhona igazi elalichaphazeleke phansi, kodwa lasulwa."Lokhu kwenziwa ngokuthi ithimba lifike esigamekweni namakhemikhali afuthwayo, bese eyaveza uma libe khona igazi elichaphazelekile kuleyo ndawo. Lolu hlobo lophenyo lwenziwa ebusuku kuphela. Kulesi sigameko kuthiwa lwenziwa ngaphakathi endlini,” kusho uMdima. Udalule ukuthi ngeshwa lolu phenyo lwabuyisa imiphumela eyayithi alikho igazi elaconsela ngaphakathi endlini nokuyinto eyashiya ezinye izihlobo ezazishaya amakhala - ngokufa kukaNkk Dhlomo - zikhathazekile. "Zaze zayokhalaza ngalokhu kumphathi siteshi (waseMalvern),” kuqhuba uMdima. Uthe yilapho okwaze kwavela khona ukuthi ngesikhathi lifika leli thimba lamaphoyisa emzini wakwaDhlomo, umsolwa wayalela izingane ukuba ziyohlala kwamakhelwane ngesikhathi kuqhubeka uphenyo. "Esitatimendeni sendodana yakhe, kuvela ukuthi zathi uma zibuya kwamakhelwane zafica umsolwa namaphoyisa behleli egaraji, beziphuzela utshwala, kumnandi,” kusho uMdima. Nokho uZungu uthe ikhasimende lakhe liyakuphikisa lokhu, wathi liveze ukuthi izingane zabuya amaphoyisa esehambile, umuntu owayephuza utshwala umngani wakhe uMnuz Twist Ndlovu.UZungu uphinde waveza ukuthi ikhasimende lakhe lithi akukho elikwaziyo ngokuthi umkalo wayesesezinhlelweni zokufaka isehlukaniso, uMdima uphendule ngokuthi igama lommeli okuthiwa wayeseqalile ukusebenza lolo daba liyaziwa, angabizwa azochaza ukuthi lwase lukusiphi isigaba.Ubuye waveza nokuthi kukhona izikhawu ezimbili lapho umufi athe wake wazama khona ukuzibulala, wathi yingaleso sizathu waze watshela izihlobo ukuthi uzibulele yize ayengambonanga ekwenza lokhu. Nakuba evumile uMdima ukuthi ngesikhathi enza uphenyo lwakhe utholile ngalokhu, waveza ukuthi wathola ukuthi umufi wazama ukuzibulala kuzo zombili lezo zigameko."Indaba yokuzama ukuzibulala, uyayiveza nasencwadini yesivimbelo ayenzela umsolwa ngo-2014, kodwa futhi kuyona ukubeka kucace ukuthi ukuzama ukuthatha impilo yakhe yinto angeke aphinde ayenze,” kuphendula uMdima. Ubuye wathi kuningi okudweba isithombe sokuthi umsolwa wayekuhlelile ukubulala umufi, phakathi kwakho, ubalule ukutshela wonke umuntu ukuthi umufi uzibulele ekubeni engazange ambone ekwenza lokhu. "Uveza ukuthi umufi wazibulala ngommese ohlala ngaphansi kombhede wabo, ohlangothini olulala yena umsolwa kodwa akukho lapho aveza khona ukuthi wamuzwa ephakamisa umbhede, ewuthatha lo mmese,” kusho uMdima.Uqhube wathi, umsolwa wehluleka wancama ukuchaza ngamachaphazelo egazi ayeholela lapho okwagcina kuficwa khona isidumbu. "Ubuye akhulume ngokuthi waphuma wahamba wayombheka njengoba wayengumuntu ovuka ayogijima. Athi nokho wathi esebuya, wabona amateki akhe okugijima egaraji. Uphenyo luveza ukuthi akazange awabone lawa mateki ngesikhathi esaphuma eyombheka,” kusho uMdima. Uqhube wathi okunye okumangazayo ukuthi emlandweni wokugijima kukamsolwa, akukho lapho ayeke ahambe ayombheka khona."Umbuzo uthi kungani ngalelo langa lodwa waba nomuzwa wokuthi kufanele ayombheka? Obunye ubufakazi obuphambanayo, obokuthi umufi wayeseyekile ukugijima ngenxa yokuphathwa i-asthma,” usho kanje.Wenezele ngokuthi okushiya imibuzo kakhulu ukuthi ngisho ngesikhathi esagijima umufi wayengeze engakwenza ngezikhathi zasekuseni, wayegijima ngezikhathi zantambama. Imantshi uMnuz Scelo Zuma ilihlehlisele uMsombuluko, icala ukuze ummeli enze izethulo zakhe.

UFUNA zibuyele emasisweni kukhunjuzwe abantu abaMnyama ngokubaluleka kwamakhambi esintu umelaphi wendabuko waseXobho, uMnuz Siyanda Miya odume kakhulu ngelikaBrazo.UMiya ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ethula ngokusemthethweni umkhankaso wakhe wokuzungeza izingxenye ezahlukene KwaZulu Natal ngenhloso yokukhuthaza ukusetshenziswa kwalawa makhambi.Uveze ukuthi le mizungezo uyethe ngokuthi "Mazibuyele emasisweni." ITHATHA elinye igxathu eyenzinsolo zokucwasa ngokobuhlanga ezibhekiswe kuNgqongqoshe wezeMidlalo, ubuCiko namaSiko, uMnuz Gayton McKenzie, njengoba iSouth African Human Rights Commission SAHRC, isimemezele ukuthi izomusa eNkantolo yezokuLingana.Okuqhathe uMcKenzie nekhomishini yizikhalo eyazothola ebantwini abamsola ngokucwasa ngokobuhlanga.Lokhu kulandela ukupeqululwa kwezinkulumo zakhe zakudala azifaka kwi-X, lapho kwezinye kwasebenza khona igama elicwasa abamnyama eliqala ko-K. Kuvundululwa izinkulumo nje, abantu babemsola ngobuxoki kulandela ukugxeka abohlelo lweYouTube i-Open Chats Podcast ayebasola ngokucwasa amakhaladi.I-SAHRC ithe emuva kokuthola izikhalo, yazicubungula yase ibona ukuthi kukhona okuphathekayo ngokuthi wenze icala."Emuva kwalokho, ikhomishini ibe isithumela incwadi yezinsolo kuNgqongqoshe uMcKenzie. Ikhomishini ayikaze iyithole impendulo kungqongqoshe," kusho iSAHRC.Ithe isithathe isinqumo sokulifaka ngokushesha eNkantolo yezokuLingana lolu daba. IKHATHAZEKILE iKhomishini yezokuLingana ngokoBulili ngezikole eziphoqa abazali babafundi abakhulelwe ukuthi baphelezelwe nsuku zonke uma beya ezikoleni ukuze bazobagada baze babelethe.Ikhomishini ithe izikole zenza lokhu ekubeni ikhona imigomo ecacile ebekiwe yokubhekana nabafundi abakhulelwe.UDkt Denis Matotoba oyisikhulu esiphezulu sekhomishini, uthe lo mkhuba uyabakhathaza ngoba izikole ziwenza ngamabomu. "Sesize sabhalela uMnyango weMfundo eyisiSekelo ngokukhathazeka kwethu ngale nkinga. Abafundi abakhulelwe bagcina sebelaxaza isikole ekubeni kungafanele ngoba baba ngaphansi kwengcindezi yokuthi kumele abazali babo bazobagada," usho kanje.Lokhu kuvele ngesikhathi le khomishini ivele ngaphambi kwekomiti leMfundo eyiSekelo ePhalamende. Kulo mhlangano, amalungu ePhalamende aphinde akhala ngothisha nothishanhloko abadlwengula baphinde bakhulelise abafundi. Amalungu athe othisha yibona okumele ngabe bagada abafundi njengabazali. Aveze ukuthi kwezinye izikole akuphephile ngenxa yokuthi kudliwa izidakamizwa kuphinde kubhenywe nogwayi emathoyilethi.Aveze ukubaluleka konogada nokuthi amaphoyisa asondele eduzane afake isandla ukusiza kwehle udlame oluhlasele kwezinye izikole.UMnuz Mandla Shikwambana, ilungu le-EFF, ufune ukwazi ukuthi bangaki abafundi abakhuleliswa ngothisha ezikoleni. Ugxeke othisha nothishanhloko abenza lo mkhuba wathi kwezinye izikole ikwampunzi edla emini. "Iyakhathaza eyokuthi sithumele izingane zethu ezikoleni kodwa zikhuleliswe othisha. Othisha yibona abafana nabazali okumele ngabe bavikela izingane zethu kodwa bona bayazihlukumeza." Usihlalo wekomiti, uNksz Joy Maimela, uthe umthetho wezikole iBela, ukubeka kucace ukuthi akumele bakhishwe inyumbazane abafundi abakhulelwe.Uthe izikole kumele ziwulandele lo mthetho okubeka kucace ukuthi abafundi abakhulelwe kumele basekwe kuze kube bayabeletha baphinde babuyele nasezikoleni. UMatotoba ukhale ngodlame oludla lubi kwezinye izikole, olusuke luphakathi kwabafundi nolunye olusuke lubhekiswe kothisha.Uveze ukunengwa eyokuphathwa kwezikhali, ukudliwa kwezidakamizwa, kube ukungalandelwa kwemigomo ebekwe ngumnyango."Kubalulekile ukuthi kuphephe ezikoleni ngoba abanye abafundi baze bashiye phansi ukufunda ngoba kungaphephile. Abanye bashiya phansi ngoba behlala kude nesikole, kudingeke balubhade phansi ngezinyawo," usho kanje.
LIGCINE lizibulele okwangempela ibhungu laseMalangeni, eNdwedwe, uMnuz Simphiwe "Minza" Goqo, emuva kokuzama kabili. Nebala abe esesifonela ethi asiphuthume esiteshini sakhona. Kuthe uma sifika asibuza ukuthi uSimphiwe wayehambe egqokeni, sathi uma siwatshela, athi uyena lo muntu amtholile. Silahlekelwe yileli qhawe ebelingumlandeli omkhulu waMaBullet, uSimphiwe "Minza” Goqo wangakithi eNdwedwe. Ubengesiye umlandeli nje kodwa bekungumfowethu. Waze wasishiya kabuhlungu Ndaba mfowethu. Kusenzima nokuyikholwa le ndaba. Ulale kahle qhawe lakithi. Umoya wakho uphumule ngokuthula. Umndeni, izihlobo, abangani kanye namaBullet wonkana sengathi ningaduduzeka," kusho isitatimende saMaBullet.
LUYAVEVA uphiko lwentsha lwe-ANC, lufuna kuhoxiswe isiphakamiso sokuthi kuchitshiyelwe umthetho i-National Credit Act, ukuze izikweletu zezitshudeni zifakwe ngaphansi kwamabhuku amnyama ezikweletu, kwa-credit bureau.UNobhala Jikelele we-ANC Youth League, uMnuz Mntuwoxolo Ngudle, uthe bakhathazekile ngesiphakamiso soMnyango wezoHwebo, iziMboni nokuNcintisana, sokuthi kuchitshiyelwe lo mthetho ukuze izitshudeni ezikweletayo zifakwe ngaphansi kwalawa mabhuku.Uthe bayasichitha isiphakamiso, bafuna sihoxiswe ngoba sizovalela amathuba izitshudeni. "Lesi sinyathelo sizokwenza ukuthi izitshudeni zingakwazi ukuthola amathuba uma sezifakwe ngaphansi kwalawa mabhuku ezikweletu. Kumele ngabe uhulumeni uqhamuka nemigomo ethinta ukucishwa kwezikweletu zezitshudeni," usho kanje.Uhlabe ikhwelo kulo mnyango ukuthi usihoxise lesi siphakamiso ngokushesha."Abantu abasha akumele bafakwe emabhukwini amnyama ngoba kungukuthi bafuna ukuzithuthukisa ngakwezemfundo. Imfundo yilungelo elikuMthethosisekelo wezwe ngakho akumele ivinjwe ukuthi iyithole. Sifuna uma kuzoba nezinguquko izinhlangano zentsha yaziswe," kusho uNgudle. Uthe ngeke bavume ukuthi kubekhona okuzovimba intsha ekutheni ithole imfundo. Lo mnyango ukhiphele umphakathi ukuthi uphawule ngezichibiyelo emthethweni iNational Credit Act, ngo-Agasti 13, 2025. Umphakathi unikwe kuze kube uSepthemba 12, 2025 ukuthi uphawule ngalezi zichibiyelo ezifaka yona indaba yokuthi izikweletu zezitshudeni zifakwe ngaphansi kwa-credit bureau.Uma ufakwa ngaphansi kwa-credit bureau, kuba nzima ukuvula ama-akhawunti ezindaweni ezehlukene ngoba usuke unegama elibi lokuthi uyahluleka ukukhokha. Kuba nzima nokuthi amabhange akuboleke imali yokuthi uthenge umuzi noma imoto ngenxa yalokhu.Ihlale iyindaba egudwini eyezikweletu zezitshudeni minyaka yonke kumbe ezikweleta izikhungo zemfundo ephakeme nezikweleta isikhwama esixhasa ngemali yokufunda ezikhungweni zemfundo iNational Students' Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS). Muva nje, iNSFAS iveze ukuthi ikweletwa u-R45 billion yizitshudeni ezathola uxhaso ngaphambi kuka-2018.Lesi sikhwama sifuna lezi zitshudeni zihlanze imali ezaxhaswa ngayo njengoba zibalelwa ngaphezu kuka-800 000 kuleli.I-NSFAS iveze ukuthi isiyenze yonke imizamo yokuthi ithole imali ekweletwa yona kodwa ezinye izitshudeni esezisebenza ziyagoloza ukukhokha.Abalesi sikhwama baveze ukuthi sebenze eminye imizamo njengokuthi sebesebenzisana nezinkampani zabammeli ukuqoqa lezi zikweletu.

Izolo uMphathiswa wezeziMali, uMnuz Francois Rodgers, nezikhulu zomnyango babambe umhlangano omude nobuholi bomkhandlu.Kulo mhlangano kuvunyelwane ngokuthi babuye ongoti abahoxiswa. IMeya kaMasipala wesiFunda uMkhanyakude, uMnuz Siphile Mdaka, ithe ongoti bazokwelekelela ophikweni lomkhandlu olukhipha amathenda nakwezezimali.UMdaka uthe kwehle umthwalo emahlombe kuyena njengoba kubuya ongoti."Bahoxiswa ngesikhathi lapho khona wase uqala ukubonakala umsebenzi abawenzayo. Wawusubonakala umehluko ngisho nasendleleni izinhlaka zomkhandlu ezisebenza ngayo. Ngakho ke ngiyajabula kakhulu njengoba sebebuyile. Ngiyethemba ukuthi kukhulu esizokuzuza ngokubuya kwabo. Ukubuya kwabo kuzoqinisa indlela yokusebenza kwethu njengomkhandlu. Sibheke izinkinga ezikhona ngokusebenza kwemali emkhandlwini, savumelana ngokuthi sizosebenza ngokubambisana."UMdaka uthe bakujabulele nokukhishwa komkhandlu ngaphansi kweso lomlawuli, wathi sebesitholile isiqiniseko sokuthi umkhandlu usukhishiwe ngaphansi kweso lomlawuli."Ukunqakisana kwezinhlaka zikahulumeni ezisesigabeni ngezinto ezithinta ukuthuthuka kwabantu asikujabuleli. Kunezinhlaka ezikhona zokuxazulula izinhlaka zikahulumeni uma kukhona ukuphambana kwemibono njengoba sikhona lapha."Amahhovisi omkhandlu abesehlale izinyanga ezimbili evaliwe ngenxa yomdonsiswano.UMdaka uthe bazohlala phezu komsebenzi njengoba sewuphelile umdonsiswano."Ayikho manje into ezosivimba. Sizoqhubeka nomsebenzi wethu. Sizosebenza ngokuthembeka nangokuzimisela. Besiqhubeka nokuyenza eminye imisebenzi yethu efana nokuhambisa amanzi nenhlanzeko ngesikhathi kuvaliwe emahhovisi omkhandlu."
