WENZA okungajwayelekile umndeni womfundi owabulawa njengoba uthi ngeke usingcwabe isidumbu ulinde isinqumo senkantolo lapho kuqulwa khona icala.Umufi, uMmeli Ngcobo (16) owayefunda uGrade 12 eHillgroove Secondary, eNewlands East, kuvela ukuthi ngoFebhuwari 2021 kwafika imoto iMercedes Benz yamthatha yamthumba ngenxa yokuthi wayesolwa ekulahlekeni kweselula yomunye wabafundi.Lelo kwaba yilanga agcinwa ngalo ukubonakala edla anhlamvana umufi. Ngemuva kwezinsuku ezimbalwa kwatholakala isidumbu sakhe KwaMkhizwane, ngaseCato Ridge, sishisiwe.Ngemuva kwalokho bakhakhalelwa ngamasongo kaSigonyela oMnuz Asanda Nyawuza (23), Andile Myeni (19), Thuthukazi Nyawuza (37) noButte Nyamakazi (47). UMyeni, Nyawuza noNyamakazi bathweswe wuMbuso amacala okusabisa, ukushaya ngenhloso yokulimaza, ukuthumba nokubulala, bese kuthi u-Asanda abhekane nelokushaya kuphela.Izolo unina kamufi, uNkk Hlengiwe Ngcobo, utshele Isolezwe ukuthi sekuhlangana iminyaka emihlanu manje kwenzeka isigameko kodwa isidumbu sisaduve amakhazeni kahulumeni asePinetown.Uthe lokhu bavumelana nomndeni ukuthi mabakwenze.''Sathatha isinqumo sokuthi siyomfihla uma sekuphothulwe icala sekuphume nesinqumo esizwakalayo kuleli cala. Nakanjani uma seliphothuliwe siyobe sesiqala ke senza amalungiselelo okumfihla,'' usho kanjena.Izolo eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini bekufakaza uSlindokuhle Ngcobo okuvele ukuthi ungomunye wabafundi ababekhona ngesikhathi kugasela imoto ithatha umufi ihamba naye. USlindokuhle utshele inkantolo ukuthi uyakukhumbula okwenzeka ngaleli langa.Uthe yena waphuma wasilela ngemuva kwabanye abafundi. Kwathi esephuma wakhangwa yimoto iMercedes empunga eyayihamba izulazula ifuna iselula kaXolani.Uthe le moto kwathi uma ihlangana nabanye babafundi ababekade behamba noMmeli yamane yama. Ngokusho kwakhe, kwathi seyimile kuyona kwehla amadoda amabili kwathi amanye amabili asala ngaphakathi emotweni.Uthe okwadala ukuthi akwazi nokubona ukuthi ngaphakathi kukhona amanye amadoda asele yingoba amawindi emoto ayekhanya kubonakala kalula ukuthi kukhona abanye ngaphakathi."Sebehlile ababili bathatha umufi bahamba naye ngenkani bamfaka ezihlalweni ezingemuva, Ngemuva kwalokho imoto yahamba yathatha umgwaqo obheke ngasemgwaqweni uDumisani Makhaye,'' echazela inkantolo.Eqhuba uthe kwathi besamangazwe yilokho bavumelana ngokuthi mabangathuli kodwa mababikele abakaMmeli ngosekwenzekile."Nebala sahamba saya kubo kaMmeli okuyilapho esafica khona ugogo wakhe samlandisa ukusuka nokuhlala,''usho kanjena.Uthe ngemuva kwalokho bavumelana ngokuthi mabanikele esiteshini samaphoyisa eNewlands East ukuyovula icala. Utshele inkantolo ukuthi iselula okwakukhulunywa ngayo yayiduke ngoLwesihlanu, imoto yafika ngoMsombuluko.Udalule ukuthi ngalo uLwesihlanu wakhuluma noMmeli emtshela ukuthi makabuyise iselula uma ithathwe nguye.''Wangiphendula ngokuthi ngeke yena aze antshontshe iselula ngoba abazali bakhe bamphethe kahle banezitolo futhi ngosuku abanqeni ukumupha u-R300,'' kuchaza yena.Ngokwamaphepha asenkantolo umufi wayesolwa ngokweba iselula kaXolani Nyawuza, oyindodana kaNyamakazi. Icala liyaqhubeka.
INGWAZI yomculo we-jazz, uBhekumuzi Hyacinth "Bheki" Mseleku, izothulelwa isigqoko ingasekho edolobheni eyazalelwa kulo. UMseleku uzokhunjulwa edilini lomculo elibizwa ngeBetween Two Worlds: Bheki Mseleku And The Cosmic South, eThe Chairman namhlanje ngoLwesine ngo-12.30 emini. Kulo mcimbi kuzobe kunandisa uSpha Mdlalose, Linda Sikhakhane noNduduzo Makhathini, okungabaculi be-jazz abakhula bebukela kuMseleku. Ukuhlonishwa kukaBheki kuyingxenye yochungechunge lwamakhonsathi abizwa ngeStandard Bank Joy of Jazz: Follow The Blue Note abanjelwe eGoli, eCape Town naseThekwini. UMseleku ngomunye wamaciko ayiminsinsi yokuzimilela eLamontville. Waqala ukuzihlanganisa nomculo we-jazz ngokudlala upiyano lukayise. Kwathi ngeminyaka yo-1970 uMseleku walifulathela iTheku walibhekisa eGoli lapho afike wadlalela khona amaqembu amaningi e-jazz anjengeMalombo, Spirits Rejoice neThe Drive. Ngo-1980 uMseleku wabuye wayifulathela iNingizimu Afrika walibhekisa eSweden ngaphambi kokuyozinza eLondon. Wakhipha i-albhamu yakhe yokuqala esihloko sithi Celebration ngo-1992. Ezihlabanini ezidume umhlaba wonke asebenza nazo kubalwa u-Abbey Lincoln, Joe Handerson, Pharoah Sanders no-Elvin Jones. Ngaphandle kwalokho uMseleku wabuye wafundisa ngomculo eTechnikon Natal, osekuyiDurban University of Technology. Yilapho ahlangana khona nozakwabo uFeya Faku, Lex Futshane noLulu Gontsana agcina eqophe nabo i-albhamu eyayithi Home At Last. Oyisikhulu sakwaStandard Bank, uBonga Sebesho, uthe kube yingqayizivele kubo ukukhumbula uBheki edolobheni adabuka kulo.UMseleku unguyise womlingisi we-Outlaws, uNirvana Nokwe-Mseleku futhi unguyise omncane wemizwilili engasekho uWendy Mseleku no-Andile Mseleku. Wadlula emhlabeni esezinze e-United Kingdom eseneminyaka ewu-53 ngoSepthemba 9 ngo-2008.
ZIKHALELWE amasongo kaSigonyela izithandani ezisolwa ngokubulala ngesihluku owesilisa okhulisa ingane ngayedwana eShakaskraal, KwaDukuza, ngoMgqibelo.Abasolwa babanjwe izolo, wonogada benkampani iReaction Unit South Africa (Rusa) bebhace eShaka’s Head, KwaDukuza. Ngokusho kokhulumela iRusa, uMnuz Prem Balram, abasolwa babulale uMnuz Doctor William Mputhi (34) besebenzisa isikela. "Umufi ubulawe ngesikela, phambi kwendodakazi (6) yakhe ngezithuba zango-6:30 ntambama ngoMgqibelo. Bathe uma beqeda ukwenza isigameko, abasolwa ebebehamba neyabo indodakazi (3), babaleka nalo isikela ebelihambe liconsa igazi,” kusho uBalram.Uthe umufi uqinisekiswe njengoseshonile ngesikhathi efika emtholampilo wasoThongathim wathi bona bathintwe umkhwekazi kamufi izolo ekuseni, ebabikela ngesigameko, esho nokuthi unovalo lokuthi abasolwa bangahle babaleke unomphela, bangaphinde batholakale. "Onogada bethu babe sebesabalalisa ulwazi ngabasolwa abafunwa uthuli ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, maqede kwalandela inqwaba yemikhondo,” usho kanje.Uthe bagcine belandela umkhondo obubakhomba endlini enamagumbi ayisihlanu okulala eseShaka’s Head."Bebebhace khona ngesikhathi besazama ukuthola imali yokubaleka kule ndawo edume ngokuba yisidleke sobugebengu,” kusho uBalram. Uthe onogada babo baqale bavala zonke izintuba zokungena nokuphuma kule ndawo. Uthe babe sebebukisisa umnyakazo wabantu abangu-10 abahlala kulo muzi, ebebeziphethe ngendlela esolisayo. "Emva kokubukisisa isikhashana, kube sekubonakala umsolwa wesifazane egone indodakazi (3) yakhe. Onogada babe sebegasela kulo muzi, bambopha. Emva kwemizuzwana, kube sekutholwa umyeni wakhe ezimboze ngenqwaba yezingubo phansi ekameleni. Uqale wagoloza ukuboshwa kodwa kwangamsiza,” kusho uBalram. Uthe babe sebebiza amaphoyisa aseMhlali, ababopha ngokusemthethweni.Imizamo yokuthola umndeni kamufi ayiphumelelanga.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLt Col Paul Magwaza, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi likhona icala lokubulala elivulwe esiteshini samaphoyisa saseMhlali.
YAZIKHALELA yathi: "Malumekazi uyangilimaza” ingane yomfana yakwa-Q, eMlaza, ngesikhathi owesifazane ongumakhelwane eyisonta intamo, eyibulala ngoMgqibelo odlule.Lokhu kuvezwe uNksz Noncedo Ngwadla ongudadewabo kamsolwa ngaphandle kweNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMlaza, izolo, ngesikhathi evela okokuqala.UNksz Sibongile Ngwadla (39), usolwa ngecala lokuthumba nokubulala uNtobeko Xaba (5). Umsolwa wayemthumbe ngo-Agasti 22, umufi, wambulala ngakusasa. Isidumbu sakhe size satholwa ngoLwesine olwedlule, emhosheni ongaphansi kwebhuloho eliphakathi kwaka-Q nakwa-U, sikhonjwa wuye umsolwa. Emva kokuvela kwakhe enkantolo ebigcwele phama umphakathi, udadewabo, uNksz Ngwadla uthe wuye umsolwa omxoxele ukuthi umufi wazikhalela wathini ngesikhathi embulala."Ukhombise unya, eklinya ingane encane kangaka, maqede wayisonga ngengutshana (throw), wayiphonsa ngaphansi kwebhuloho,” kusho uNksz Ngwadla. Umsole ngokungawucabangeli umndeni kamufi, ewuphuca othandiweyo wawo ngendlela enesihluku. "Akwenzile kukhombisa ukuzicabangela yedwa. Akawucabangelanga umndeni wengane, yimbi into ayenzile,” usho kanje. Umchaze njengowesifazane obenakho ukukhohlakala kodwa wathi bebengakaze bazitshele ukuthi usengaze abulale umuntu."Asikaze sizitshele ukuthi ngelinye ilanga angabulala umuntu, angiphathi ke ingane encane,” kubeka uNksz Ngwadla. Uthe ngesikhathi efika ekhaya ngoMgqibelo, wafika esezihambela yedwa, wabatshela ukuthi kuthiwa untshontshe ingane kwa-Q. Nokho uthe wabuye wayembathisa kahle inkulumo yakhe ethi usexhumene nonina kamufi, wathi akangabe esakhathazeka ngoba ingane isitholakele. "Ecashe ngaphansi kombhede, wathi ukhetha kona kuze kuba ukuthi iyatholakala ingane bese beyabona ukuthi yena abengahlangene nokunyamalala kwayo,” usho kanje.Udalule ukuthi ubulala umufi nje, yena uzele eziyisithupha izingane. Unina wengane, uNksz Ntombifikile Xaba, uthe kumthusile ukuzwa ngaphakathi enkantolo ukuthi umsolwa uhlongoza ukufaka isicelo sebheyili. "Emva kwento engaka ayenzile, angazi ukuthi isibindi sokufuna ukufaka isicelo sebheyili usithathaphi?” kusho uNksz Xaba. Uthe ngesikhathi embona emile ebhokisini labasolwa, kuke kwathi akajombe ayombamba ngezandla ngenxa yobuhlungu amzwise bona, embulalela ingane, engakaze amone ngalutho. Ngaphakathi enkantolo umshushisi woMbuso, uMnuz Lungelo Mkhithi, uthe bazosiphikisa isicelo sebheyili uma umsolwa esesifaka. Waveza ukuthi kusekhona ulwazi olusashoda olufaka phakathi ukuthola kabanzi ngaye (profiling), uqinisekiswa kwekheli angaphuma ayohlala kulo uma kwenzeka ededelwa ngebheyili.Umsolwa ucele ukumelwa ummeli kahulumeni. Imantshi uMnuz Kheswa ibe isilihlehlisela uSepthemba 8, icala ukuze umsolwa afake isicelo sebheyili. Umufi wanyamalala ngo-Agasti 22, eyodlala nezinye izingane. Ezintatha zangakusasa unina wabe esethola umyalezo uvela enombolweni angayazi, umyalela ukuthi akafake u-R60 000 ngo-cash send ungakashayi u-1 wasemini, uma efuna ingane yakhe ibuye iphila. Omunye umyalezo wathi sesifikile isikhathi sokuthi akhokhe ngalokhu amenza kona ngo-2020. Emva kokuhlatshwa komkhosi ngokunyamalala kwengane ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, owesifazane wasemijondolo yaKwaJeena, eMlaza, waveza umkhondo wokuthi umsolwa ufikile kuye ehamba nengane efanayo. Waphinde wabonakala eyibelethe ngasezihlotsheni zakhe ezihlala eMalukazi, ngaphambi kokuba abalekele eMzimkhulu, lapho agcine ebanjwa khona ngoLwesithathu.
IPHENDULWE ihlaya i-ANC esiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal, amalungu eqembu uMkhonto weSizwe (MK), ehlekisa ngayo eyitshela kwezikabhoqo ukuthi ayiwuphethe uhulumeni wesifundazwe kodwa uphethwe nguNtuli.Amalungu eMK agcine esethi akhuleka kuNtuli (Mnuz Thami Ntuli) we-IFP ngoba nguyena ophethe, hhayi i-ANC.Lokhu kwenzeke, ngesikhathi kunempikiswano ngesiphakamiso seMK, ngesihlava sezidakamizwa esidlange entsheni yesifundazwe. Ilungu le-ANC ebelikhuluma belilokhu lithi uhulumeni we-ANC, wenze lokhu nalokhu ukulwa nenkinga yezidakamizwa.Kumane kwasukuma ilungu leMK, lathi kumele amalungu e-ANC azi ukuthi akukho hulumeni eKZN ophethwe yi-ANC."Akukho hulumeni oka-ANC la, kuphethe uNtuli. Sikhuleka kuMphemba ngoba nguyena ophethe, hhayi i-ANC," kusho amalungu eMK kwaqhuma uhleko. Ngisho nePhini likaSomlomo, uNksz Mmabatho Tembe, oyilungu le-DA, ligcine selihleka. Amalungu esiShayamthetho asho ngazwi linye ukuthi kumele kuliwe nalesi sihlava sezidakamizwa.Kusolwe nabokufika kuleli ukuthi bangabanye babantu abadayisa izidakamizwa. Amalungu aveze ukuthi izidakamizwa zigqilaza intsha yesifundazwe ephenduka imilutha yazo.UMnuz Simanga Mabaso weMK - ophakamise ukuthi kubhungwe ngale nkinga - uthe kudingeka uhulumeni okhona uyisukumele le nkinga uyeke ukuklwebhana. "Lo hulumeni wezintethe ezibelethene, ngabe ulungisa le nkinga kodwa ulibele ukuklwebhana. Izibalo ziveza ukuthi u-60% wentsha ugxile ezidakamizweni. Uhulumeni uyahluleka." UMnuz Mncendisi Maphisa we-IFP, uthe bayaweseka umsebenzi owenziwa nguNtuli noKhomishana wamaPhoyisa esifundazweni, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi."Siyaweseka umsebenzi owenziwayo ukulwa nale nkinga esifundazweni," usho kanje.UMphathiswa wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi, uNksz Cynthia Shinga weNFP, ukhale ngomonakalo owenziwe yizidakamizwa esifundazweni."Akube nemali ezohlinzekwa izinhlaka ezehlukene okumanje zenza umsebenzi wokulwa nalesi sihlava. Inkinga okumele kuliwe nayo le ngoba ibulala isizwe," usho kanje.Khonamanjalo: Amalungu esiShayamthetho saseSwatini avakashele esiShayamthetho sesifundazwe kusuka izolo nanamhlanje ukuzothekela ulwazi.
Uphiko oluphenya amacala ayisipesheli (iSIU) luthi ubufakazi obusha obuvelayo mayelana nenkohlakalo yeDigital Vibes buthinta amalungu omndeni walowo owayengungqongqoshe wezempilo udokotela uZweli Mkhize.Abaphenyi bathi banikezwe imvume yiSpecial Tribunal yokudlulisela ulwazi abalutholile enkantolo.Uphenyo lwango-2021 lwathola ukuthi ithenda yezokuxhumana ye-COVID ka-R150 million nesikhungo sezokukhangisa esizinze eKZN yayingekho emthethweni.I-SIU isola ukuthi unkosikazi kaMkhize, indodana, kanye nozakwabo kwezamabhizinisi bahlomula emalini eyenzelwe izinkontileka zokuxhumana nge-COVID kanye neNational Health Insurance. Okhulumela i-SIU uKaizer Kganyago uthe ubufakazi bubalulekile ukuze kudalulwe indlela ezadliwa ngayo izimali ngamabhizinisi mbumbulu."Sibone kubalulekile ukuthi sengeze lolu lwazi olubalulekile njengengxenye yalolu daba esigungwini. Abamangalelwa nabo bebefake isicelo esigungwini sokuthi lumiswe lolu daba. Isizathu sabo kube wukuthi kunodaba oluseNkantolo eNkulu olufakwe nguDkt Mkhize, lapho ezama ukuchitha umbiko wethu kumengameli. Ngakho-ke bathi ngenxa yalokho, asingaqhubeki nalolu."Yize ezinye izinkampani ezithintekayo zizibuyisele ngokuzithandela ingxenye yezimali, iSpecial Tribunal igcizelele ukuthi ukukhokha akukhululi isikweletu ngaphansi koMthetho Wokuvimbela Ubugebengu Obuhleliwe (i-POCA).Yize ibuyile ingxenye yemali kodwa lokho akusho ukuthi sekuphelile ngecala, lisangaqhubeka ngokushushiswa ngaphansi kwemithetho elwa nenkohlakalo.Inkantolo ayikasikhiphi isinqumo mayelana nokwamukelwa ngokusemthethweni kwe-afidavithi entsha, kodwa kulindeleke ukuthi kukhishwe isinqumo ngokushesha.Icala elikhulu liyaqhubeka nokuvela phambi kwe-Special Tribunal.
I-Orlando Pirates Football Club iqinisekise ukuthi umqeqeshi u-Abdeslam Ouaddou kanye nabasebenzi abahlanu beqembu babe sengozini ngeSonto ebusuku.Lokhu kwenzeke emgwaqeni onguthelawayeka u-R21 ngesikhathi iqembu libuya eGqeberha, kulandela ukunqoba kwalo iChippa United ngo 3-0. Kushayisane izimoto ezimbili, umqeqeshi u-Ouaddou kanye nozakwabo behla ebhasini leqembu ukuze bayosiza. Ngesikhathi beya endaweni yengozi, kuqhamuke imoto yohlobo lweNissan NP200 yashayisa lezi zimoto ebezimile, kwalimala nabantu abebemile.Umqeqeshi u-Ouaddou, kanye nabasebenzi abahlanu abathintekile, baphuthunyiswe esibhedlela, lapho belashwa khona. Iqembu liyaxhumana nodokotela futhi lizokhipha imininingwane ngokuhamba kwesikhathi.Isiyazisiwe imindeni yabathintekile futhi ikuthola konke ukwesekwa okudingekayo ngalesi sikhathi esinzima.

UHLONISHWE yiNyuvesi yaseZululand, oNgoye ngokuqanjwa kwelinye lamabhilidi ngaye uNgqongqoshe wezeSayensi uDkt Blade Nzimande.UNzimande uhlonishwe yinyuvesi emcimbini wakamuva ngokuqamba ngaye ibhilidi lezobuNjiniyela kule nyuvesi ukumhlonipha ngeqhaza lakhe kwezemfundo.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi uNzimande uke waba nguNgqongqoshe weMfundo ePhakeme isikhathi eside. "Angikaze ngisho ngiphupha njengomfana waKwaDambuza ukuthi kungaba nebhilidi elingaqanjwa ngami enyuvesi. Ngithobekile ngokwenziwe yinyuvesi ukungihlonipha," kusho uNzimande.Kuphinde kwavulwa namanye amabhilidi amabili aqanjwe ngowayengumengameli wokuqala wentando yabantu, uMnuz Nelson Mandela. Elinye liqanjwe ngowayenguSihlalo wesigungu esilawula inyuvesi uMnuz Vuyani Gamede. Emabhilidini avuliwe kukhona nendawo yokuhlala izitshudeni.UNzimande uthe ingqalasizinda evuliwe kumele igqugquzele izitshudeni ukuthi zizimisele. "Ngesikhathi sobandlululo, abamnyama babengavunyelwe ukuthi benze umkhakha wezobunjiniyela. Kumele siyitshele intsha ngalo mlando ukuze yazi ukuthi eminye imikhakha esikwazi ukuyenza ngokukhululeka, kwakunzima kanjani ukuyenza phambilini."Uthe kubalulekile ukuthi kube nomkhakha wezobunjiniyela kulesi sikhungo ngoba siseduzane kweRichards Bay, enezinto eziningi eziyiswa kwamanye amazwe.Unxuse izitshudeni ukuthi ziyinakekele ingqalasizinda eziyakhelwe. "Siyanxusa ukuthi ningayicekeli phansi ingqalasizinda ngoba izosiza izizukulwane ezizayo. Kumele niqinisekise ukuthi iyanakelelwa. Abafundi basemazingeni aphansi naphezulu sebezokwazi ukuthola ulwazi kule ngqalasizinda ekule nyuvesi," kusho uNzimande.Uhulumeni uhlale uhlaba ikhwelo ezitshudenini wathi akungathi uma zinezikhalo zifuna izinto ezithile, bese zicekela phansi ingqalasizinda okungaba yizindawo zokuhlala, ama-lab kanjalo nezinye ngoba ngomuso zizozidinga.
BAKHATHAZEKILE abazali bezingane ezifunda esikoleni iMpunga High, eMzinto, isikole sinquma ukuthi kumiswe ukufunda ngenxa yempi yezigodi engapheli.Encwadini ebhalelwe abazali ngoLwesine ebonwe yiSolezwe, abazali bayalelwe ukuthi bangazidedeli izingane zabo ukuba ziye esikoleni kusuka ngoLwesihlanu kuze kube uLwesithathu okuzobanjwa ngalo umhlangano wabazali.Kule ncwadi kuvela ukuthi abafundi abafunda uGrade 8 kuya kuGrade 11, abahlale emakhaya kusuka ngoLwesihlanu. Kuthiwa lokhu kungenxa yokuphazamiseka kokufunda ngenxa yezimpi zezigodi, izidakamizwa nokungaphephi kwabafundi nothisha. Iqhubeka iveza ukuthi kuzoba khona umhlangano wabazali ehholo lomphakathi eJolivet ngoLwesithathu. Iveza nokuthi ukufunda kuzoma kuze kube wukuthi kuba nomhlangano. Leli phephandaba likhulume nomzali onengane efunda kulesi sikole, ongeke avezwe, odalule ukuthi izingane ezilwayo ezabafana."Zibanga izintombi,” kusho umzali.Uthe izigodi ezithintekayo yiGoqo, yi-14 neNkawini. "Balwa ngaphakathi esikoleni, bashayana ngezandla. Impi yabo isinesikhashana iqalile belwa izinsuku ezintathu, kubuye kuthule, iphinde iqhubeke ezinye izinsuku ezintathu,” kusho umzali. Uthe kuyabakhathaza okwenzekayo bengabazali, wathi okubi kakhulu wukuthi lesi yisona sikole esiseduze kuwona wonke umuntu. "Siyafisa ukuthi kube khona isixazululo. Okungenani akuthathelwe izinyathelo abafundi abazibandakanya nempi ngoba yize kungesibo bonke abalwayo, kodwa uma sekuvalwa isikole kugcina sekuchaphazeleka nabafundi abangahlangene,” kusho umzali. Uthishanhloko wesikole uthintiwe ekuseni izolo, wathi usabambeke emhlanganweni, wacela ukuthintwa ntambama ukuze anikezele ngenombolo yomzali osesigungwini sesikole iSchool Governing Body (SGB). Kuthe sekubuyelwa kuye ngaleso sikhathi ubengasalubambi ucingo.Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Muzi Mahlambi, uluvalile ucingo ngesikhathi intatheli imfonela nomyalezo awuthunyelelwe ngoWhatsApp akazange awuphendule.
IPHINI likaNgqongqoshe wezeMfundo ePhakeme nezokuQeqesha eNingizimu Afrika, uNkk Nomusa Dube-Ncube, usephonsele abesifazane abasembonini yamatekisi inselelo yokuba babhukule baqinisekise ukuthi yibona abadala ukuthula nozinzo kule mboni. UNkk Dube-Ncube uphonse le nselelo ngesikhathi eyisikhulumi sosuku emcimbini omkhulu wokubungazwa kwabesifazane abasembonini yabamatekisi obukade uhlelwe yinhlangano i-Iron Sharpens Iron kaMfu Thomas Radebe.Umcimbi ubuqhubeka eBotanic Gardens, eThekwini, ngeSonto ntambama.Ekhuluma lapha, uNkk Dube-Ncube uqale ngokuncoma isibindi sabesifazane asebekwazile ukuthi bazibambe ziqine kule mboni.Uthe iqiniso ukuthi sebekhona manje abesifazane ababonakala bebekezela beqhubeka nomsebenzi omuhle kule mboni.''Badinga ukushayelwa ihlombe elikhulu bonke ebesifazane abasembonini yamatekisi ngendlela ababonakala benza kahle ngakhona. Lokhu kuveza ngokusobala ukuthi abesifazane sebeyakwazi manje ukumelana nemisebenzi phambilini okwabe kwaziwa ukuthi ngeyabantu besilisa kuphela,'' usho kanjena.Ube esebaphosela inselelo yokuba babhukule kube yibona abaqinisekisayo ukuthi baletha uzinzo nokuthula kule mboni.''Lapho okukhona khona umuntu wesifazane kuyabonakala. Nalapha embonini njengoba sekukhona nina manje kumele kucace. Kumele kube yinina eniba phambili niqinisekise ukuthi kule mboni kuba nokuthula,'' usho kanjena.Uthe ukholwa ukuthi inkulu indima angaklanywa ngabantu besifazane ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kuyaphela nje nya ukugobhoza kwegazi kule mboni."Mkhulu umehluko eningawenza kule mboni uma nje ningazitshela ukuthi lokho nifuna ukukwenza,'' echaza.URadebe uthe kumqoka kakhulu ukuba babungazwe besadla anhlamvana abesifazane abayingxenye yale mboni.Uthe kuyajabulisa kakhulu ukubona isibalo sabesifazane abasembonini yamatekisi sikhula minyaka yonke. Kulo mcimbi bekukhona nabesifazane ebebevela kwezinye izifundazwe.
KULANDWE owake waba yiMeya yesiFunda, iLembe, uMnuz Siduduzo Gumede ukuba azohola uMasipala waKwaDukuza obese kuphele isikhashana ungenayo imeya.Ukuqokwa kukaGumede kwenzeke emhlanganweni wamakhansela obukade uKwaDukuza Town Hall, izolo.UGumede ungena ngemuva kokushenxiswa kukaloyo obekade eyimeya kulo masipala, uMnuz Ali Ngidi owahoxiswa naloyo owabe eyiphini lakhe, uMnuz Njabulo Cele.UNgidi okungaphelanga ngisho unyaka ehola lo masipala wayekade engene esikhundleni sikaNksz Lindiwe Nhaca.Izicathulo zagcwala udaka kulaba ababili ngasekuqaleni kukaJulayi ngemuva kokuba kwasabalala izinsolo zokuthi bafake inhlangano yabo i-African National Congress (ANC) ehlazweni.Basolwa ngokusebenzisa budedengu izimali zikamasipala nokuqashwa kwezimoto zikanokusho nokusebenzisa imali kubaqashi abazimele.UGumede akathuki isisinga ekuholeni umasipala kwazise ngo-2016 waqokelwa kwesokuhola isiFunda iLembe waze waphuma ngo-2021.Ekhuluma lapha uGumede uthe uzizwa ethobekile kakhulu ngokuthola ingqayizivele yethuba lokuthi ahole uMasipala waKwaDukuza.Uthembise ukuthi bazoqhubeka nokusebenzisana nomphakathi ngenhloso yokuqinisekisa ukuthi konke kuhamba kahle.''Okubalulekile ukuthi sisebenzele ukuthi umphakathi uthola izinsiza zawo. Asikholelwa ekutheni izinkinga zingaphezulu kukamasipala,'' usho kanjena.Uthe bazimisele ngokuthi balungise amaphutha abonakale eba khona. Uthe luzoba seqhulwini udaba lokulungiswa kwenkinga kagesi.''Sizokwenza konke okusemandleni ngenhloso yokulungisa inkinga kagesi ekhona kule ndawo,'' usho kanjena.Ukhulume nangokubaluleka kokuba bakhelwe izindlu abantu baKwaDukuza namaphethelo. Uthe bakholelwa kakhulu ekutheni kumqoka ukuba abantu bathole izindlu ezisemgangathweni.''Sizosebenza ngokuzikhandla ukuze abantu bazithole izidingo zabo. Siyazi ukuthi abantu bazidinga kangakanani izindlu. Yingakho ke udaba lwezindlu sizokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi siyalisebenza,'' usho kanjena.Ugcizelele kakhulu ukubaluleka kokuba zisatshalaliswe ezingxenyeni ezahlukene izinsiza ngoba abantu bayazidinga. "Akumele kube nezaba uma kukhulunywa ngodaba lokuhanjiswa kwezidingo kubantu kodwa kumele bazithole,'' usho kanjena.Ugcizelele ukuthi ukubambisana yikhona okungadala ukuthi izinto kube lula ukuzenza kulo masipala.
UMHOLI weMK, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, ubhoboke ngokuphoxwa yisenzo sowayengunobhala jikelele weqembu, uMnuz Floyd Shivambu, sokuphuma ibhodwe lakhe.UZuma uthe wayemethemba kakhulu uShivambu angazange ambize ngegama, wathi waphoxeka kakhulu ngesikhathi enquma ukuvula iMayibuye.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma namalungu eqembu, eFree State. Njengamanje uShivambu useqale elisha, iMayibuye.UZuma uthe amaqembu amaningi iwona enza ukuthi abantu abamnyama bangalibusi izwe. "La bantu bakithi abafundile bayinkinga ngoba bazitshela ukuthi bangcono ngoba nakhu bekwazi ukukhuluma isilungu. Uma ngenza isibonelo nje ngathatha umfana omncane ngoba nakhu sakha leli qembu. Ngathi akakhe iqembu, yena wenzani? Waphuma wakha elakhe ekubeni ngangithe abantu abamnyama kufanele bahlangane. Waphuma nabantu engangibethemba impela. Naye ngangimthemba impela."Uthe: "Khuzani abantu abamnyama, singalwi sodwa siqhathwa. Sifuna ukubakhipha abantu abamhlophe emandleni, asifuni ukubambisana nabo. Into esiyishoyo ukuthi hlangana ndlemnyama, sikhululwe izwe lethu. Asikho isidingo sokuthi uma kunokhetho sihlukane phakathi. Kufanele sihlangane, sithathe izwe lethu. Kufanele wonke umcebo wezwe lethu ubuye uze kuthina. Iqembu eliphethe njengamanje lihlulekile ukuthuthukisa abantu abamnyama."UZuma uthe ufuna kudliwe ngoludala, kuphathe amakhosi. "Kufanele thina sikhumbuzane ukuthi ngesikhathi kusaphethe amakhosi babengekho abantu ababulala abanye. Namhlanje izwe liphethwe abelungu, abantu bayafa noma kungandiswa amaphoyisa. Lokhu kwenziwa ukuthi izwe alisaphethwe abanikazi balo."I-MK yemukele inqwaba yamalungu amasha eFree State.UZuma ubonge amalungu amasha ngokujoyina iMK, wathi ngeke azisole."Nithathe isinqumo esifanele. I-MK iyona kuphela iqembu elijoyinwa inqwaba engaka yamalungu. Amanye ayehluleka ukwenza lokhu esikwenze namhlanje."
ABAHOLI abaphezulu be-ANC bavuma eyokuthi le nhlangano isesimeni esibucayi ngendlela eyisimanga.Abaholi abehlukene okukhona kubo uSihlalo we-ANC, uMnuz Gwede Mantashe, nelungu lesigungu esiphezulu, uDkt Zweli Mkhize, bafuna ukuthi le nhlangano ivuke izithathe.Bakusho lokhu ngesikhathi bekhuluma emihlanganweni yokulungiselela iNational General Council (NGC), ezoba ngoDisemba. Kule mpelasonto i-ANC ibinemihlangano ezifundeni ezahlukene lapho kwethulwe khona ngokusemthethweni imiqulu okuzokuba kuxoxwa ngayo kwi-NGC.Emhlanganweni weNGC kubhekwa kabanzi imigomo yenhlangano kanye nobuholi bayo.UMantashe, obekhuluma e-Eastern Cape, uthe i-ANC idinga imithandazo. "Mfundisi, ngiyabonga ukuba usithandazele. Singayithatha kancane nje le nto kodwa siyayidinga imithandazo kulesi simo esibhekene naso."UMantashe ukhuze ukuklwebhana kwamalungu e-ANC njengoba kuzokuba nezingqungquthela zokukhetha ubuholi ezifundazweni okubalwa kuzo neKwaZulu-Natal."Angifuni nokuyizwa indaba yezingqungquthela. Abantu abajahe izingqungquthela bayizilima. Bajahe nje ukulwa." UMkhize uthe akazi ukuthi yini enye ezolekelela i-ANC uma ihluleke wukuphuma namaqhinga okulungisa isimo sayo kwiNGC.UMkhize naye ukhuze ukuklwebhana kwamalungu e-ANC."Into okufanele siyazi wukuthi njengoba silapha sithunywe amagatsha ethu ukuba sizowamela. Asithunywanga ukuba sizolwa izimpi zethu." KwaZulu-Natal kube nesiphakamiso sokuba zihlehliswe izingqungquthela zokukhetha ubuholi besifundazwe nobezifunda okuhlelwe ukuthi zibe ngoNovemba.Ilungu le-ANC esifundeni iNokuhamba Nyawo, uMnuz Rich Zwane, lithe izingqungquthela zizophazamisa umkhankaso wokhetho lohulumeni basekhaya oluzoba ngonyaka ozayo.UZwane uthe izinhlangothi ezibanga izikhundla uma kuzoba nezingqungquthela zokukhetha ubuholi be-ANC ziyaye zibekane amabala. "Uma kuzoba nezingqungquthela siyaye singcolisane. Indlela esingcolisana ngayo kuba nzima ukusebenza ndawonye emva kwengqungquthela."UZwane uphakamise ukuthi kuqhubeke ubuholi besikhashana obukhona kuze kudlule ukhetho.Uthe uma izingqungquthela ziqhubeka i-ANC izolahlekelwa omasipala. "Ngabe siyicabangisisile le nto yokuba nezingqungquthela? Akufanele siyithathe kalula le nto. Into ezokwenzeka kuzogcina kuzuza abantu abambalwa abasebuholini uma sekuxoxwa eyokubambisana komasipala namanye amaqembu."Ilungu lesigungu esiphezulu kwi-ANC, uMnuz Phumulo Masualle, lithe zizoqhubeka kumnyama kubomvu izingqungquthela.UMasualle uthe abafuni ukuthi kuyiwe okhethweni i-ANC iholwa amathimba esikhashana. I-ANC KwaZulu-Natal naseGauteng iholwa amathimba esikhashana kulandela ukuhlakazwa kobuholi bezifundazwe ngenxa yokungenzi kahle okhethweni lukazwelonke lwangonyaka odlule."Sathatha isinqumo sokuthi kufanele kube nezingqungquthela zokukhetha ubuholi kuzona zombili lezi zifundazwe. Kufanele uthi uphela lo nyaka zibe sezihlalile izingqungquthela zokukhetha ubuholi bakulezi zifundazwe. Ngonyaka ozayo sifuna ukugxila emkhankasweni wokhetho. Yngakho sifuna ukuthi izingqungquthela zibe kulo nyaka."
KUTHI hu kubashayeli baseNingizimu Afrika ngesimemezelo sokuthi amanani kaphethiloli nodizili azokwehla ngoLwesithathu.UMnyango Wezezimbiwa Namandla (i-DMRE) ukhiphe isitatimende esithi uphethiloli we-93 kanye ne-95-octane uzokwehla ngo-4 cents ilitha.Intengo kadizili izokwehla ngo-0.05%.Udizili (0.05% sulphur) wehla ngamasenti angamashumi amahlanu nesithupha ilitha (56.00 c/l), bese uDizili (0.005% sulphur) wehla ngamasenti angamashumi amahlanu nesikhombisa ilitha (57.00 c/l).UPharafini (othengiswa kwezitolo ezinkulu) uzokwehla ngamasenti angamashumi amathathu nesikhombisa ilitha (37.00 c/l).Intengo ye-LP gas yehla ngo-R1.32 ikhilogremu ngayinye ezweni lonke, ngaphandle kwaseWestern Cape, lapho izokwehla ngo-R1.51 ikhilogremu ngayinye.
UVUKE wawudiliza izolo umphakathi wakwa-Q, eMlaza, umjondolo okuthiwa ubuhlala owesifazane osolwa ngokubulala ngesihluku ingane yomfana esencane, kulandela ukungawutholi uR60 000 abewufuna ngodli kunina wale ngane.Isidumbu sikaNtobeko Xaba (5) sitholwe ngoLwesine, kulandela ukukhonjwa kwaso wumsolwa obanjwe esebhace eMzimkhulu. Ngokusho kukaninakhulu kamufi, uNkk Thandekile Xaba, umsolwa utshele amaphoyisa ukuthi umufi wambulala ngoMgqibelo ngesikhathi ebona kushaya isikhathi ayesinqumele unina ungangeni umyalezo wemali. "Utshele amaphoyisa ukuthi wayibulala ngokuyisonta intamo ingane,” kusho uNkk Xaba. Uthe lapho kutholakale khona isidumbu, yisemhosheni ongaphansi kwebhuloho eliphakathi kwesigceme sakwa-Q nesakwa-U. "Itholwe isithanda ukonakala ingane, kuphele izinsuku ihleli exhaphozini lamanzi,” kusho uNkk Xaba. Uveze ukuthi kukhona lapho unina wengane ake wangaboni ngaso linye nomsolwa, bebanga ibhakede elishisisa amanzi (urn).Nokho uthe ubengakaze azitshele ukuthi usengabulawelwa ingane ngalokho ikakhulukazi njengoba avele waliduba ibhakede lakhe, umsolwa egweva nalo."Kuthiwa ngesikhathi amaphoyisa empheka ngemibuzo umsolwa uthe ngesikhathi ecabanga ukuthi iyiphi ingane azokwenza ngayo ubugebengu, emqondweni kuvele wafika le agcine eyibulele," usho kanje. Uthe umphakathi udilize umjondolo wakhe wathi awumdingi endaweni."Bathe abakwazi ukuhlala nesigebengu. Kungakuhle ahlale ejele angayifuni ibheyili ngoba umphakathi udiniwe,” kusho uNkk Xaba. Umsolwa uboshwa nje, kuthiwa kukhona isihlobo sakhe esathinta izihlobo eMzimkhulu, sathi uma efika, abosihlebela ukuze sibikele amaphoyisa ngoba uhambe ethumbe ingane eThekwini. "Sizwa kuthiwa ubumfihla ke kodwa umndeni wakhe waseMzimkhulu ngoba ngesikhathi kufika amaphoyisa ezomfuna, bathe abamazi. Kusize ukuthi elilodwa livele libuze enganeni, evele yamkhomba ezimboze ngenqwaba yezingubo embhedeni,” usho kanje.Ubonge owesifazane wasemijondolo yakwaJeena, owahlaba umkhosi ngesonto eledlule, ngokuthi ubone umsolwa efika kule ndawo nengane yomfana ekubeni bemazi eneyentombazane.Uthe emva kokuvela kwezindaba zokuthunjwa kwengane, baningi ebese bevela obala besho ukuthi umsolwa uwumuntu oyisigebengu. "Thina besimbona ewumuntu okahle, ongakhombisi ukuthi uyisigebengu. Abanye bayambabaza ngobugebengu bokuqhwaga abantu imali, nokho bathi bebengakaze bazitshele ukuthi usengabulala umuntu,” kusho uNkk Xaba.Umufi wathunjwa wumsolwa ngoLwesihlanu olwedlule. Wabe esethumela umyalezo kunina ethi sesifikile isikhathi sokukhokha ngobuhlungu amzwisa bona ngo-2020. Kuthiwa wamnqumela ugwayi katiki ethi akungashayi u-1 ngakusasa imali engayithumelile.Umsolwa kulindeleke ukuthi avele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMlaza namuhla.
ZIGIXABEZWE udilikajele umuntu ngamunye neminyaka engu-80 isihlanganisiwe, izinkabi ezimbili ezilahlwe icala lokubulala nelokubamba inkunzi ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima.UMuzi Sibiya (42) noNduduzo Shezi (36), bagwetshwe ngesikhathi bevele eNkantolo yesiFunda saseMgungundlovu ngoLwesihlanu. Uthe kwathi uma sekucutshungulisiswa kahle ulwazi ngaye kwavela ukuthi wayengumshayeli futhi esolwa ngobunkabi endaweni yaseMsinga. Abangezukukwazi ukungenela izinketho zokuchibiyela kuzofanele basichazele ukuthi kungani bengakulungele ukungenela izinketho. Kulezi zinketho sizokube singancintisani ne-ANC. Siyiqembu elizimele, elinemigomo yalo." UMapaila uthe sekulele kwi-ANC ukuthi iyabaxosha yini abaholi be-SACP kwiKhabhinethi."Uma i-ANC inquma ukuxosha amalungu ethu, asinendaba. Wayivalela isikhathi isingakanani ngaphambi kokuyidlwengula? Wayidlwengula izikhawu ezingakhi? Wayibulala ngemuva kwesikhathi esingakanani eseyidlwengulile? Inkantolo ithi yonke le mibuzo ayiphenduleki ngale kokuthi ingane yatholakala emjondolo wakhe ngemuva kwezinsuku ezimbili ebalekile futhi akukho lapho okuvela kona ukuthi ngesikhathi eseboshwa, wabonisa ukuzisola nokuthi uyazi uboshwelani, kunalokho kuvela ukuthi esanda kuboshwa wabonisa ukuthi uzowaphika wonke amacala azobekwa wona.Ube esegwetshwa kanje, ngecala lokuthumba ugwetshwe iminyaka emibili, ngecala lokubulala uthole udilikajele, ngecala lokudlwengula uthole udilikajele, kanti ngecala lokuba kuleli ngokungemthetho ugwetshwe iminyaka emibili. Izigwebo zakhe uzozidonsa kanye kanye okusho ukuthi uzodonsa udilikajele owodwa.

INGASE iphele eyokuphasa ezinye izifundo ngo-30% ka-matric njengoba uMnyango weMfundo eyisiSekelo uqoke umkhandlu ozobheka izikhalazo ngalokhu.Lokhu kulandela ukumenyezelwa komkhandlu iNational Education and Training Council (NETC), nguNgqongqoshe walo mnyango, uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, kuleli sonto.Inhloso wukubuyekeza imigomo ekhona kwezemfundo bese imluleka ngezinyathelo okumele azithathe. "Lo mkhandlu uzophenya eminye yemigomo ekhona kwezemfundo ukuthi ayikaphelelwa yisikhathi, bese ungiluleka ngokumele ngikwenze. Ngiyobe sengiwubuka umbiko bese nginquma ngezinyathelo engizozithatha," kusho uNksz Gwarube.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi minyaka yonke ihlale iyindaba egudwini kumaqembu ahlukene ezepolitiki kanjalo nasezinhlakeni ezehlukene eyokuphaswa kwezinye izifundo ngo-30%.Lezi zinhlaka zihlale zikhala ngokuthi liphansi kakhulu leli zinga ngakho kudingeke linyuswe. Umnyango uhlale uzivikela uthi akekho umuntu ongaphasa u-matric uma ephase zonke izifundo zakhe ngo-30%.Akuyona kuphela indaba ka-30% okuhlale kukhalwa ngayo kwezemfundo kodwa nendaba yokukleliswa kwezikole kusetshenziswa uhlelo lwama-Quintile, luhlale lukhonondisa othisha nezinyunyana.Ngaphansi kwalolu hlelo, izikole okungakhokhwa kuzona imali yokufunda okudliwa nokudla zikleliswa kusuka ku-Quintile 1 kuya ku-3, bese kuthi lezo okukhokhwa kuzona iningi lazo ezisuke zisemadolobheni ziba nguQuintile 4 kuya ku-5. Nemali etholwa yilezi zikole ayifani njengoba kulezo okungakhokhwa kuzona zithola imali ethe xaxa emnyangeni uma uqhathanisa nalezo okukhokhwa kuzona.UNksz Gwarube uthe ngesikhathi engena emnyangweni wakuveza ukuthi uhlela ukuqoka leli thimba ukuze limcebise."Sifuna uma leli thimba lithi akushintshwe lonke uhlelo lokufunda nokufundisa, lisinike into ebambekayo ukuthi kungani kumele senze lokhu. Akulona elizothatha izinqumo ezingujuqu kodwa nje umsebenzi walo ukungeluleka," usho kanje. Ezinye zezinto okuke kwakhalwa ngazo ngukuthi abafundi bakuleli kwaGrade 4, abakuqondi abakufundayo. "Kunezinselelo eziningi kwezemfundo okubalwa nabafundi abalaxaza isikole bengaqedile, ukubhacaza kwabafundi ezifundweni i-maths nesayensi, ukushoda kothisha, ingqalasinda engekho ezingeni, ukushoda kwezinsiza nezinye," usho kanje.Uthe kuleli thimba kunongoti bezemfundo, wathi unethemba ukuthi lizokwenza umsebenzi oncomekayo ukuze kufukulwe imfundo.

ISITSHUDENI esibuye sibe wumsebenzi waseDurban University of Technology (DUT) owenza izifundo zobudokotela emkhakheni we-Chemical Engineering kule nyuvesi uNkk Nomthandazo Sibiya-Dlomo, sibeke lesi sikhungo esicongweni siqokwa nabayisishiyagalombili abanqobe umklomelo we-Doctoral Fellows Awards kuma-South African Women in Science Awards (SAWISA).Lokho kwenzeke emcimbini wokuklomelisa abadle umhlanganiso kuma-SAWISA obungesonto elidlule eBloemfontein, eFree State, lapho bekuklonyeliswa khona abantu besifazane abenza imisebenzi emihle ehlukene yokucwaninga ngezeSayensi.Nonyaka indikimba yomcimbi ibithi Unpacking STEM Careers: Her Voice in Science, lapho bekubekwa eqhulwini ubumqoka bokuqhakambisa imikhakha yezeSayensi, ubuChwepheshe besimanje, ezobunjiniyela nezibalo okugxile abantu besifazane kuzona.Nyakenye uNkk Sibiya-Dlomo waqokwa ukuba yi-lecturer yezifundo ze-Chemical Engineering eDUT, kanti kumanje uvele umatasa nonyaka wesithathu wezifundo zakhe zobudokotela iDoctoral of Engineering in Chemical Engineering, lapho elulekwa futhi ecijwa khona wuSolwazi Sudesh Rathill noDkt Thembisile Mahlangu."Lokhu engikuzuze manje kufakazela khona ukuthi noma ngabe usuka kuyiphi indawo ezweni, akukho okukuvimba ukufeza izinto ezinhle ozifisela zona empilweni yakho, engikhuthaza ngakho nabanye abantu abasha abeza emva kwami ukuqhubeka benze okuhle njengoba nami ngenzile ngalo mncintiswano engihlabane kuwona,” kusho uNkk Sibiya-Dlomo.UNkk Sibiya-Dlomo uhlabane ngenxa yocwaningo lwakhe obelubheka ukuthi umkhiqizo womoba, ubhanana namawolintshi okukhiqizwa ngendlela efanele necolekile kusiza kanjani ukugwema ukufaka ingcindezi emvelweni."Lokhu kusho lukhulu kimina ikakhulu njengoba ngikhuliswe wugogo nomkhulu, ngakho into emqoka kimina nengihlale ngishisekela ukuyenza wukuguqula isimo sasekhaya, njengoba namanje ngisayibambe lapho njengoba ngisho ezifundweni zami ngihlale nginabaxhasi abathwala zonke izindleko kusukela ngiqala ukufunda kuze kuzoba yimanje, ngakho ngikhuthaza nentsha ikakhulu amantombazane ukuziphatha kahle ukuze afike ezingeni esengikulona manje nangaphezu kwalo,” kukhuthaza uNkk Sibiya-Dlomo.Lesi sifundiswa asiqali ukuhlabana ngama-SAWISA njengoba ngo-2023 sahlabana ngendondo ye-NRF Research Excellence kuma-Next Generation Researchers ne-2024 Research Debut-Young Talents kuma-Eni Awards.
Liphothulwe ngoLwesihlanu ngaphandle kwenkantolo icala likaMduduzi Myeza oyiMeya yase-Estcourt, obethweswe icala lokushaya.Ubesolwa ngokushaya umgilwa kubangwa udaba oluphathelene nomsebenzi. Udaba lulungiswe ngokuxoxisana (Alternative Dispute Resolution Method-ADRM)Isigcawu sokuxoxisana sivulwa uma ummangalelwa nomgilwa benquma ukulungisa udaba ngaphandle kwenkantolo. Lokhu kuyingxenye yohlelo olubizwa nge-Restorative Justice Process lapho abathintekayo bexoxisana bodwa eceleni. Kulolu daba umgilwa nommangalewa baxoxisene. Lokhu bakwenze bona ngokufisa kwabo kodwa UMshushisi oMkhulu woMbuso ozinze eNkantolo yeMantshi e-Estcourt neBamba loMphathi wabaShushisi bebelwelusile udaba.Ummangalelwa uxolisile kumgilwa futhi naye walwemukela uxolo, udaba lwaphothulwa.
Ikhishwe emoyeni umethuli wezindaba obonakale exakazisana noDokotela Mamphela Ramphela ngodaba lwaseGaza.Lokhu kusuke engxoxweni phakathi kwentatheli yakwa-SABC nomdidiyeli wezindaba uJuliet Newell nesishoshovu esasilwa nobandlululo uRamphele. Ngesikhathi bexoxa, uNewell ubuze uDkt Ramphele ngokufanisa izehlakalo zokubulawa kwabantu basePalestine nokuqothulwa kwesizwe, ebuza: "Anikuboni njengokuvusa inkanuko?" "Ukuqothulwa kwesizwe kwenzeka, futhi kusazoqhubeka kwenzeke ngezindlela ezehlukene...Ngabe kufanele silinde ukufa kwezigidi ukuze sikubize lokhu okuyikho? Uma silinda ukufa kwezigidi eziyisithupha, isintu asinalo ilungelo lokuzibiza ngomuntu. Ukuba ngumuntu kuwukuzwa ubuhlungu bawo wonke umuntu njengokungathi uzizwa wena," kuphendula uRamphele.Le ngxoxo use omkhulu umsindo wabomkhankaso wePalestine Solidarity kanye nezishoshovu zabezindaba, ezisole le ntatheli ngokunanela amaphuzu okukhuluma akwa-Israel kanye nokubukela phansi unya lwaseGaza. Inhlangano yezokusakaza yaseNingizimu Afrika (i-SABC) ikhiphe isitatimende iveza ukuthi lo methuli usemisiwe."ISABC iyalwazi udaba oluthinta ukuziphatha komunye wabethuli bayo bezindaba, engxoxweni noDkt Mamphela Ramphele. Ngaleyo ndlela, abaphathi bezindaba ze-SABC bathathe isinyathelo ngokushesha ngokuhambisana nenqubo yangaphakathi ye-SABC, kanti umethuli okukhulunywa ngaye okwamanje akahlelelwe ukusebenze. I-SABC igqugquzelwe wuhlaka lomthetho olwahlukene oluphoqelela ukuthotshelwa koMthetho Wezokusakaza 4 ka-1999 kanye nenqubomgomo yayo yokuhlela eqinisekisa ukunikezwa kwemibono eminingi kanye nezinhlobonhlobo zezindaba nolwazi.
"KUSEMAHLOMBE ethu ukusebenzisa ulwazi nethalente lobuciko bethu ukuziphendlela indlela eya phambili neyokuchuma ngakho ngoba iqiniso wukuthi yonke into esiyenzayo manje ngobuciko bethu izocaba indlela yokuzokwenzeka nesizokufeza ngekusasa lethu.”Usho kanjalo uNtsika Tyatya wophiko lwezokuxhumana lwesikhondlakhondla senkampani yezemfashini iMaXhosa Africa, ngenkathi ethula inkulumo yosuku kwesinye sezigcawu zokucobelana ngolwazi emcimbini i-The Music Imbizo, osongwe ePlayhouse, eThekwini lapho obekucotshelelwana ngamasu nezindlela zokusebenzisa ubuciko ukuzichumisa nokwakha amabhizinisi eyamene nawo.UNtsika ubecikwe ubethula inkulumo yesihloko esithi Cultural Innovation: The Future of African Creativity, lapho abegxile khona ekunikezeleni ngamasu ezinto okumele zenziwe ukusebenzia ubuciko ngendlela efanele ukusiza ukuthi kube nekusasa eliqhakazile. "Sihlalelwe wumsebenzi wokuqinisekisa ukuthi ubuciko bethu buhambisana nesikhathi ngokuthi sisebenze ngendlela ehambisana nesikhathi esikusona manje kodwa nalapho futhi siqikelele ukuthi asilahlekelwa wubunjalo yobuciko, amasiko nobuthina uqobo,” usho kanje.Eqhuba, ucebise izethameli ukuthi zingazisindeli ukusebenzisa ubuciko bazo ngendlela efanele emhlabeni jikelele ukugwema ukuthi kungaze kuqhamuke abanye abantu bakwamanye amazwe basebenzise ubuhle bomlando nakho konke okunye okwenza ukuthi sihluke kwezinye izizwe ukuzicebisa bona, bese izakhamuzi zisala zincela izithupha."Kucacela noma wubani ukuthi thina ma-Afrika sihlobe ngobuciko namasiko okwenza sibe yinyama kwabanye abantu bakwamanye amazwe ngakho uma singakusebenzisi lokho ngendlela efanele sizohlale sikhala ngokuthi ubuciko bethu abusisebenzeli ekubeni kube kuyithina esingenzi okwanele nokufanele ukuzibeka ebalazweni,” kuxwayisa uNtsika.Lo mcimbi, owaqalwa wuSphe Mbhele ngo-2009, indikimba yawo yanonyaka ibithi At The Root of Innovation Is Culture, Creativity and The Power of IP - okusho ukuthi izingxoxo ezahlukene ezenziwe bezigxile ekutheni yiziphi izindlela namasu okungasetshenziswa ukusebenzisa ubuciko, amasiko nobuchwepheshe besimanje ukufukula ezobuciko namabhizinisi ehlukene eyamene nabo.
BAKHISHELWE ngaphandle abangabona abomndeni emngcwabeni wesihlabani somculo wombhaqanga nowe-reggae, uSolwazi Richard "Richie S" Siluma ozoba seNewcastle, ngeSonto. Okhulumela umndeni kamufi, uNtokozo Siluma, ugcizelele ukuba kufike amalungu omndeni kuphela, hhayi abanye abantu. "Siyakuqonda ukuthi baningi ebebethanda ukubakhona nokuzobhonga emswanini. Siyaxolisa kakhulu kwabazophoxeka. Sihlonipha izifiso zikamufi." UNtokozo uthe abantu bathole ithuba lokuvalelisa kuSiluma enkonzweni yesikhumbuzo ebiseBassline eNewtown, eGoli, izolo. USiluma (72), obesaziwa ngelikaSaggy Saggila emculweni we-reggae, ushonele esibhedlela saseGoli, iMilpark Netcare, ngoMsombuluko ezintatha. UNtokozo uthe umufi wayengeniswe esibhedlela emuva kokuhlaselwa yisifo sohlangothi emasontweni amabili adlule. "Isifo sohlangothi sasidalwe yisifo se-high blood pressure. Wayengumqemane. Wavuka ekuseni wayobuza okuthize emahhovisi akwaSamro (okuyinhlangano eqoqa imali etholakala ngokudlalwa komculo emisakazweni naseziteshini zethelevishini), lapho afike wawa khona phansi. Wabe esephuthunyiswa esibhedlela, lapho edlulele khona emhlabeni," kusho uNtokozo. USiluma waqala ukwaziwa kakhulu emculweni ngenoni elalithi (Umbhaqanga Jive Our African Dance ngo-1985, okuyingoma eyabuye yenziwa kabusha umculi kamaskandi ongasekho uMtshengiseni Gcwensa ngaphansi kwaMageza Amahle kodwa seyibizwa ngeTaxi Taxi ngo-2007. Empeleni uSiluma waqala ukubamba iqhaza emculweni ngo-1976, edayisa umculo owawukhiqizwa yi-Warner Brothers Communications, ngaphambi kokucula eqenjini i-The Love Brothers ngo-1979. Ngo-1982, uSiluma wabe esekhushulelwa esikhundleni sokuba wuphrojusa.Njengomunye wophrojusa bokuqala abamnyama, uSiluma waqala ukuphrojusa umculo weStimela ngaphansi kwe-Teal Records. Emuva kwalokho, wabe esenxenxa umzala wakhe, uLucky Dube, ukuba ashiye emculweni wombhaqanga angene emculweni we-reggae. Sekungumlando ukuthi uLucky wafike wakhonya kulo mculo kangangoba ushone esebizwa ngenkosi ye-reggae e-Afrika namaphethelo.USiluma waqhubeka waphrojusela Izingane Zoma, Sinakho Dance Band, Thulani Manana, Pongola Home Train nabanye. Ngo-1999, uSiluma ugcine esehola iqembu iReggae Gospel Soldiers futhi bakhipha i-albhamu ye-gospel reggae esihloko sithi Zonke Izono. Ngo-2010, uzibize ngoSaggy Saggila wakhipha i-albhamu ye-reggae esehamba yedwa esihloko sithi Game 2010. Ngo-2012, wabuye wakhipha icwecwe elithi I Wanna Be With You, walandelisa ngelithi Endless Love Racing ngo-2014 nelithi Truth Needs To Be Told ngo-2017. Emiklomelweni aseke wahlabana ngayo kubalwa oweProducer of the Year ngo-1988 kwaGallo Music, Superior Achiever Award kwaGallo Limited ngo-1989 nango-1990, Best Producer kuma-OKTV Music Awards ngo-1990, Contribution To The Arts Award kwiDrakensberg Promotions nakuMnyango wezobuCiko namaSiko ngo-2012, 50 Double Platinum & Gold Disc nge-albhamu kaLucky Dube ethi Slave. Uma ezihasha ubethi ungu "Saggy Saggila Somthakathi ongazingeli nabafokazana. Umashaya ndawonye njengendlala bazomzondel' okuhle ngokushintsh' izimpilo zomuzi nemizanyana".
IKHALELA ukutholakala kwesixazululo intsha eyishumi yaKwaNxamalala eNkandla, amanye amalungu omphakathi evuka umbhejazana, emisa ukusebenza kwensimu eyiqale ngenhloso yokugwema ukuzibandakanya ebugebengwini. Ngokusho kukaMnuz Sabelo Magwaza (28), okule ntsha, bahlangane ngoMeyi kulo nyaka basungula iZincinze Cooperative egxile kwezolimo. "Ngesikhathi siqhamuka nalo mbono sasibona ukuthi abanye bethu bazithola sebebizelwa phansi kwesihlahla somganu, beyoshaywa wumphakathi ngenxa yokuzibandakanya nobugebengu. Sahlala phansi sazibuza ukuthi yini enhle, esingachitha ngayo isikhathi. Kwase kuzaleka umbono wokulima,” kusho uMagwaza. Uthe sebevumelene, bakhetha ukuthi badayise izimbongolo ezingenamnikazi kubeSuthu ukuze bazenzele imadlana yokuqala ukusebenza. Uveze ukuthi kwathi sebeyihlanganisile imali eyanele, baya kowesifazane wasendaweni onomhlaba omkhulu angawenzi lutho, bacela ukuwusebenzisa. "Wasivumela kalula, wathi uyaweseka umbono wethu, muhle. Saqala salima sisebenzisa zona izimbongolo eziwuvanzi. Sathenga amapayipi amanzi, sayowadonsa epayipini lamanzi elikhulu elikude nathi,” usho kanje. Uthe kukhona owesilisa wendawo owabathembisa ukuthi uzobachushisa ngezindawo zokudayisa uma amaklabishi, abaqale ngawo, eselungele ukuvunwa. Udalule ukuthi izinkinga ziqale emasontweni ambalwa edlule, amanye amalungu omphakathi evukwa wumona, maqede akhala ngokuthi insimu yabo ibaqedela amanzi. "Siqale sazibuza ukuthi maphi amanzi ngoba thina esichelela ngawo siwadonsa kude, asiwadonsi epayipini eliphakela umphakathi,” usho kanje. Uthe nakuba bezamile ukukuchaza lokhu kodwa kube nhlanga zimuka nomoya njengoba begcine bebizelwa emhlanganweni obekukhona kuwo ibamba lenduna, maqede batshelwa ukuthi abame ukuchelela ensimini kusafunwa isixazululo. "Seliphelile isonto silindile, singazicheleli izitshalo zethu. Asazi ukuthi inqubekela phambili ithini ngoba uma sibuza kulokhu kuthiwa asilinde,” usho kanje. Uthe okubakhalisayo wukuthi izithukuthuku zabo, betshala izithombo zamaklabishi awu-4000, zizoba yize leze. Uveze ukuthi okunye okubaphatha kabi wukuthi abangahambisani nensimu, sebelwisa ngisho nowesifazane owabanika indawo yokutshala. "Asazi ukuthi yini kanti okufanele siyenze ngoba sasizitshela ukuthi yindlela ekahle lena yokugwema ukuzibandakanya nezinto ezingalungile emphakathini. Manje uma sesilwiswa kanje, asazi noma bafuna abanye bethu babuyele ebugebengwini yini,” kubuza uMagwaza. Uthe lokhu bakubona njengempi ebhekiswe kubo beyintsha ezizamela into enhle. Uqhube wathi babona sengathi sekuvuka umona kulabo asebezama ukulwa ngamanzi, bebona ukuthi into yabo yokutshala iyaphumelela. "Siphatheke kabi ngempatho esiyithola kwabazama ukusinqinda emphakathini. Sifisa ubuholi bendawo busilekelele ixazululeke le ndaba ngoba siyawuthanda umsebenzi wethu wokutshala,” usho kanje.Uthe abakufisayo wukuthi batholelwe imvume esemthethweni yokuthi bazidonsele awabo amanzi epayipini elikhulu ukuze kungabi bikho muntu ozobalwisa uma sebephethe imvume ngesandla. Uthe i-co-op yabo inamalungu aneminyaka ephakathi kuka-14 no-28. Kuwona uthe kunabayisishiyagalombili abasafunda bese kuthi ababili okukhona kubo naye, sebasiqeda isikole. Uveze ukuthi abafundayo bavuka bayochelela ekuseni ngaphambi kokuya esikoleni, uma bebuya, baphinde bashone khona okwenza sibe sincane isikhathi sokubandakanyeka ezintweni ezimbi. Ikhansela lendawo, uMnuz Philani Nkwanyana likuqinisekisile ukuthi kukhona uthuthuva emphakathini ngenxa yensimu. "Kuyiqiniso ukuthi ayikho into ezilwiselwa yona lezi zingane,” kusho uNkwanyana. Uthe umphakathi uhlukene phakathi ngoba bakhona abayesekayo intsha ngalokhu ekuqalile, ngakolunye uhlangothi kube khona abangayifuni. "La manzi abathi ziyawathatha, bayazisukela ngoba ipayipi alihlangene nhlobo nelamanzi omphakathi. Kuvele kwasuka umona nje,” kusho uNkwanyana.
UKUBE kuya ngesifiso somndeni wesaguga saseMthebeni, eNdwedwe, esabulawa ngesihluku umzukulu, ubezofela ejele aphume ngebhokisi.Lokhu kushiwo umndeni ngaphandle kweNkantolo yesiFunda saseVerulam, izolo, emva kokugwetshwa kwakhe udilikajele.U-Andile Vilakazi (29), ugixabezwe ngezigwebo ezinzima emacaleni amane alahlwe ngawo yinkantolo. Kuwona kukhona elokubulala, amabili okuzama ukubulala kanjalo nelokushaya ngenhloso yokulimaza.Kwelokubulala ugixabezwe ngodilikajele, kwamabili okuzama ukubulala wanikwa iminyaka engu-15 icala ngalinye, kwase kuthi kwelokushaya ngenhloso yokulimaza, wanikwa iminyaka eyishumi.Izigwebo zakhe uzozidonsa kanyekanye. Inkantolo iphinde yanquma ukuthi akumfanele ukuba nesibhamu, yayalela nokuthi igama lakhe lifakwe ohlwini lwabantu okungafanele basebenze endaweni enezaguga. Iphinde yanquma nokuthi mhla sekumlungele ukudedelwa ngoshwele, kuyofanele aboMnyango wezokuHlunyeleliswa kweziMilo baqalae babuze umndeni ukuthi uyafuna yini ukuthi adedelwe. Ngosuku lwesigameko, uSepthemba 7, 2024, u-Andile washaya uninakhulu uNkk Sibongile Vilakazi (70), ngesitini nangesando waze wafa. Kuleso sigameko, washaya ngenhloso yokulimaza umalumekazi wakhe, uNksz Zimbili Vilakazi.Waphinda washaya ngesitini nangesando uyisemkhulu wakhe kanjalo noyise uMnuz Bongani Vilakazi. Omunye umalumekazi wakhe uNksz Thokozani Vilakazi, uthe bayasamukela isigwebo ngoba singesokugcina kwezikhishwa yizinkantolo emacaleni okubulala. "Ngoba iwona (udilikajele) onikezwa a benze amacala anje, akukho esingakwenza ukudlula lapho. Ukube kuya ngathi ngabe ufela khona, aphume ngebhokisi, eseyongcwatshwa,” kusho uNksz Vilakazi.Ugcizelele eyokuthi bayayisaba eyokuphuma kwakhe ngaphandle mhla esevumelekile ukuthi adedelwe ngoshwele."Njengoba wayesho ukuqeda ngomndeni ngosuku lwesigameko, cabanga ke ukuthi angaphuma enzeni uma esededelwe,” kusho uNksz Vilakazi. Uveze ukuthi inkosi yesizwe yayithe ayisamdingi endaweni ngemuva kwesigameko.Uthe lokhu kusho ukuthi ukuthi ngisho esededelwa ngoshwele, akanayo indawo yokuhlala endaweni njengoba adingiswa. Uqhube wathi kwaba yisilonda kubona ukuthi u-Andile abulale uninakhulu, owayefana nonina kuye. "Ukhuliswe wuye, efika ekhaya enezinyanga ezimbalwa. Umama ambelethe aye naye emajalidini. Uthe eqambe evula amehlo, uwavulele kumama, emupha lonke uthando kodwa ekugcineni wambulala ngesihluku,” kusho uNksz Vilakazi.Uveze ukuthi u-Andile unomlando wodlame njengoba eseke washaya uyisemkhulu wakhe ngetshe, waze wayotishwa esibhedlela. Ngesikhathi imgweba imantshi uNksz B Mpungose, ithe akakaze akhombise ukuzisola ngesenzo sakhe. "Wenza isihluku esikhulu. Asikho isaguga okufanele sibulawe, angiphathi ke ngesihluku esinje, sibulawa umzukulu waso,” kusho uNksz Mpungose. UNksz Mpungose uthe abantu abasebenzisa izikhali eziyingozi nabangakwazi ukulawula ulaka lwabo, kufanele babhekane nengalo yomthetho. Uthe lesi sigwebo asinike u-Andile uyazi ukuthi ngeke sisambuyisa umufi, wathi namanxeba avuleka emva kwesigameko ngeke avaleke kodwa kubalulekile ukuthi kwenzeke ubulungiswa obuthumela umyalezo oqinile nakulabo abasacabanga ukwenza ubugebengu obufanayo.
KUXABENE ubendle kumalungu e-ANC ngodaba lokuqokwa kwemeya entsha kuMasipala waseMpendle. Amalungu e-ANC awavumelani ngokufanele angene kulesi sikhundla esesihlale izinyanga ezimbili singenamuntu kulandela ukukhishwa kowayeyimeya, uMnuz Buyisani Mlaba, owakhishwa ngevoti sokungabethembi ubuholi bakhe. Kukhona amalungu e-ANC afuna ukuba kungene loyo owalahlwa yicala lokubulala, uRussel Ngubo, kanti amanye afuna kungene loyo owayeyimeya yomkhandlu, uNkk Sizakele Makhaye. UNgubo noNkk Makhaye abawona amakhansela emkhandlwini, okusho ukuthi kukhona ikhansela okufanele lehle esikhundleni ukuze kungene oyedwa walaba abaphakanyiselwa esikhundleni. Ubuholi be-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, buvele sebuqinisekisile ukuthi bafuna ukunikeza isikhundla sobumeya umuntu ongelona ikhansela. Indaba yokuthi kukhona ikhansela okufanele lidliwe yizembe ukuze kuzovuleka isikhala sozoba imeya, isidale imvunge. Amalungu e-ANC anganelisekile abambe umhlangano ngoLwesithathu ntambama, kuleli sonto, lapho ezwakalise khona ukuphikisana nokuthi kube khona ikhansela elikhishwayo. La malungu aqhubekile abamba umhlangano yize umgqugquzeli we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Mike Mabuyakhulu, ebewayalele ukuba angaqhubeki nomhlangano wawo.UMabuyakhulu ubesabise ngokuthi bazothathelwa izinyathelo bonke abazohambela umhlangano. Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba, ngoLwesithathu emini."Lowa mhlangano awugunyaziwe. Abazowuhambela bazozibeka engcupheni yokuthi kumiswe ubulungu babo enhlanganweni."UMabuyakhulu uthe abakaluphothuli uhlelo lokuqokwa kwemeya entsha. "Siyazi ukuthi ukungabikhona kwemeya kudale ukuthi lungabi khona uzinzo. Sizolanda umuntu ongesilona ikhansela ukuba abe imeya khona kuzokuba nozinzo."UMabuyakhulu umemezele ukuthi bazothathela izinyathelo amakhansela abo akulo mkhandlu angazange amvikele uMlaba ngesikhathi ekhishwa esikhundleni.I-ANC inamakhansela amaningi emkhandlwini. Yonke into esasiyenza yayigunyazwa iMisa. UNdwandwe uyena owayegunyaza ukuba kukhokhwe. Imali eningi yakhokhwa ngo-2021 nango-2022, ngesikhathi uNdwandwe ewumlawuli. KUNAMAHLEBEZI okuthi lugcine lugobile uphondo kuhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal, ngodaba lokufakwa kukaMasipala waseMkhanyakude ngaphansi kweso lomlawuli. Umthombo ongeke uvezwe uthe iKhabhinethi yaKwaZulu-Natal, inqume ukuhoxisa isinqumo sokufaka umasipala ngaphansi kweso lomlawuli, emva kokuba ubuholi bomkhandlu buphonsele inselelo isinqumo sokufakwa ngaphansi kweso lomlawuli. Sekunezinyanga ezimbili kuvaliwe emahhovisi omkhandlu njengoba kukhona abangafuni ukwamukela ukujutshwa kukaMnuz Bamba Ndwandwe, njengomlawuli. Kunecala elifakwe wubuholi bomkhandlu eNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu, lapho buphonsela khona inselelo isinqumo sokufakwa ngaphansi komlawuli. Umthombo utshele Isolezwe ukuthi maduze uhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal, uzomemezela ukuthi umkhandlu awusekho ngaphansi komlawuli. Umthombo uthe inkinga enkulu wukuthi uNgqongqoshe wokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu, uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa, akazange asivume isinqumo sokufakwa komkhandlu ngaphansi komlawuli. "Kwakufanele engabe uHlabisa wavuma ukufakwa komkhandlu ngaphansi komlawuli ungakadluli uJulayi 26. Njengamanje sisekupheleni kuka-Agasti. Nabo bagcine sebebona ukuthi ayikho le nto yabo. Bebengeke bayinqobe le mpi."Amahlebezi okuthi uhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal sewehlele ngezansi kulolu daba, abuye aqiniswa yinkulumo kaMnuz Mike Mabuyakhulu, ongumgqugquzeli we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal.UMabuyakhulu uthe sekuseduze sitholakale isisombululo odabeni lwaseMkhanyakude. Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba, ngoLwesithathu.UMabuyakhulu uthe uNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, ubamukele kahle ngesikhathi bezokhala ngokufakwa komkhandlu ngaphansi komlawuli.UMabuyakhulu uthe ubuholi bomkhandlu buyafuna ukuthi uhulumeni wesifundazwe ulekelele, kodwa wathi buyaphikisana nokufakwa ngaphansi komlawuli. "Sinxusa uNtuli neKhabhinethi yakhe ukuba bamukele isiphakamiso somkhandlu sokuba uthunyelelwe abantu abazowulekelela khona kuzohamba uNdwandwe. Lokhu kuzobuyusa uzinzo."UMabuyakhulu uthe ukufakwa komkhandlu ngaphansi komlawuli akukho emthethweni ngoba uHlabisa akazange avumelane nalesi sinqumo.IMeya kaMasipala, uMnuz Siphile Mdaka, engafunanga ukusho ukuthi sebazisiwe yini ngokuhoxiswa kwesinqumo sokufakwa komkhandlu ngaphansi kweso lomlawuli, uthe ukuvalwa kwamahhovisi omkhandlu akuzange kubaphazamise. "Siyaqhubeka nokusebenza. Sibonga abantu baseMkhanyakude ukuthi basihloniphile kulesi sikhathi esinzima kangaka. Kube nombhikisho owodwa nje kuphela."Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kokhulumela uhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Bongani Gina, ayizange iphumelele njengoba ucingo lwakhe belukhala lungabanjwa futhi engazange awuphendule umbuzo awuthunyelwe yize kukhombisa ukuthi uwufundile.Nokhulumela uHlabisa, uNkk Pearl Maseko-Binqose, akazange awuphendule umbuzo awuthunyelelwe.
IHLELI mazonzwane i-ANC kuhulumeni wokubambisana ophethe iKwaZulu-Natal njengoba ikhala ngokudliwa izithende amaqembu ebambisene nawo.I-ANC ibize isithangami nabezindaba izolo lapho ikhale khona ngokuhlokolozwa abaphathiswa be-DA ne-IFP.Umgqugquzeli we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Mike Mabuyakhulu, uthe sebekhathele ukufakwa umunwe esweni abaphathiswa bamaqembu ababambisene nawo. Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba izolo, eThekwini.UMabuyakhulu ubalule uMphathiswa wezeziMali oyilungu le-DA, uMnuz Francois Rodgers, noMphathiswa wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu oyilungu le-IFP, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, wathi kufanele bafakwe emgqeni.Phambilini, ukungahoshelani kuhulumeni wokubambisana bekuphakathi kwe-ANC ne-IFP kanti manje sekuphakathi kwe-DA ne-ANC, emva kokuba uRodgers esabise ngokufaka ngaphansi kweso lomlawuli uMnyango wezokuThutha esifundazweni. UMnyango wezokuThutha uphethwe uMphathiswa oqhamuka kwi-ANC, uMnuz Siboniso Duma.URodgers usonge ngokuthi uzowufaka ngaphansi komlawuli lo mnyango ngenxa yezinsolo zenkohlakalo.Usanda kuwuyalela ukuba uqale phansi uhlelo lokuqoka abazohlomula kwithenda engaphezu kuka-R300 million, yokuthutha abafundi ezikoleni olusiza abafundi abangaphezu kuka-157 000. Usephinde wafaka uMnyango wezeMfundo ophethwe yilungu le-ANC, uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka, ngaphansi kweso lomlawuli.UMabuyakhulu uphinde wakhalaza ngokuthi uButhelezi ufaka omasipala abaphethwe i-ANC ngaphansi kweso lomlawuli.Uthe kufanele bahloniphane abaholi bamaqembu abusa ngokubambisana ngoba bahlezi endlini eyodwa. "Siyakuqonda ukuthi lapha siphethe nabantu esibanga nabo amavoti. Sangena ngenxa yokuthi sicabangela abantu, sifuna kube nozinzo. Onke amaqembu amane kufanele alwele uzinzo. Lokho akusho ukuthi kufanele sivumele amanye amaqembu agibele phezu kwethu. Siyawahlonipha amanye amaqembu. Nathi silindele ukuthi amanye amaqembu asihloniphe."Uthe: "Asilindele ukuthi kube khona amaqembu azosebenzisa izikhundla kuhulumeni wokubambisana ukulwa izimpi zepolitiki. Akekho umphathiswa okufanele azenzele umathanda. Lapha siphethe ngokubambisana. Abantu abathola u-11% abakwazi ukwenza sengathi bathola u-51%."Izinsongo zikaRodgers zimdalele amazinyo abushelelezi ophikweni lwentsha kwi-ANC, i-ANCYL KwaZulu-Natal, oluthe i-DA kufanele iphume kuhulumeni wokubambisana uma isikhathele. I-DA KwaZulu-Natal imvikelile uRodgers. IPhini lomholi we-DA KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Sithembiso Ngema, lithe bazoqhubeka nokulwa nokungalandelwa kwemigomo ebekelwe ukusetshenziswa kwemali."I-ANCYL kufanele ingakhohlwa ukuthi i-ANC yathola u-17% okhethweni olwedlule besuka ekutholeni u-54% okhethweni lwango-2019. Kufanele engabe sikhona isifundo abasitholile kulokhu. Sinxusa onke amaqembu aphethe KwaZulu-Natal ukuba abambisane embhidlangweni wokwakha kabusha umnotho wesifundazwe khona abantu bezothola amathuba angcono."UMnyango wezokuThutha ukhiphe isitatimende lapho ugxeke khona isenzo somnyango kaRodgers sokukhipha isitatimende esiqinisekisa ukuthi zoqalwa phansi ithenda yokuthutha abafundi ezikoleni.UMnyango kaDuma usole umnyango kaRodgers ngokudukisa nokuputshuzela abezindaba ulwazi oluyimfihlo.
SITHOLWE, sintanta emfuleni isidumbu sengane yomfana yakwa-Q, eMlaza, ebithunjiwe.Ngokusho kwamaphoyisa aKwaZulu-Natal, isidumbu sikaNtobeko Xaba (5), sitholwe sisongwe ngejakhethi ngaphansi kwebhuloho kule ndawo.Okhulumela amaphoyisa, uLieutenant Colonel Paul Magwaza, uthe umsolwa - naye oseboshiwe - uyiphonse ebhulohweni ingane. "Umsolwa uboshwe amaphoyisa ebhace eMzimkhulu, ngoLwesithathu ebusuku," kusho uMagwaza.Kulesi sigameko, umufi wanyamalala ngoLwesihlanu, eyodlala nezingane ezingangaye endaweni.Emva kokunyamalala kwakhe, kungene umyalezo oshaqisayo kunina, obuthi sekuyisikhathi sokuthi akhokhe ngobuhlungu abuzwisa umsolwa ngo-2020, waze walahlekelwa yingane. Umsolwa ube esefuna imali engu-R60 000 uma umndeni ufuna ukuthi ingane ibuye iphila.Umkhondo ugcine ukhomba owesifazane wakwamakhelwane, okuvele ukuthi emva kokuthumba ingane, waya nayo emijondolo engakwaJeena, khona eMlaza, wadlulela kubo eMalukazi, lapho abonakala eya nayo ngasemfuleni.Liqale isonto engasabonwa nangalukhalo, kwavela ukuthi ubalekele eNanda, nokho ugcine ebanjwa eMzimkhulu.Umsolwa uzobekwa icala lokubulala nelokufuna imali njengoba ayefuna u-R60 000.Isolezwe libike kabanzi ngalolu daba kanti imizamo yokuthola umndeni ayiphumelelanga izolo ntambama.
Umbuzo MAGUMEDE ngifihle elawini lakho. Nginenkinga nomuntu wami ave engakuthandi ukuba ngaphezulu uma sisenkonzweni yasekameleni. Uma kwenzekile ufika kahle kuvuthondaba kodwa uyavilapha angazi ngingamnqoba kanjani mina ngiyayithanda le ndlela yokwenza.Impendulo KUMELE ukuqonde ukuthi akusibo bonke abantu besifazane abathanda futhi abanomfutho wokuba ngaphezulu uma kwenziwa inkonzo yasekamelweni. Abanye bayahluleka futhi bayashesha ukukhathala. Kungakuhle ulekelelane nophathina wakho uma kwenzekile waba ngaphezulu ukuze engazoshesha ukukhathala. Mkhuthaze ukuthi anyakaze embhedeni ukuze ajwayele.
BAZALELWE yinja endlini abakweleta isikhwama esixhasa ngemali yokufunda ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme iNational Students' Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS), njengoba bezodluliselwa kwabaqoqa izikweletu ukuze babuyise le mali.Lokhu kuvezwe yisikhulu esiphezulu salesi sikhwama uMnuz Waseem Carrim odalule ukuthi lesi sikhwama sikweletwa uR45 billion, okuyimali eyasiza abaxhaswa ngaphambi kuka-2018."Abanye bakweleta lesi sikhwama sisabizwa ngeTertiary Education Fund of South Africa (TEFSA) phambilini. Yize kunzima kwiNSFAS ukuqoqa izikweletu kodwa ngeke sihlale singayiqoqi imali esikweletwa yona," usho kanje. Uthe uyazi ukuthi inqwaba yabakweletayo isiyatohoza kodwa ayifuni ukukhokha."Umuntu owaxhaswa, wathola iziqu osesebenza manje kumele ayibuyise imali axhaswa ngayo. Le mali izosiza ukuxhasa abanye abadinga usizo. Esifuna bakhokhe asebehola uR30 000 kuya phezulu. Imali abazoyibuyisa izoya ngokuthi bahola malini."Usihlalo weNSFAS uDkt Karen Stander, uthe baqoke izinkampani ezizoqoqa izikweletu. Lezi zinkampani yiKhumalo Masondo Attorneys Incorporated, New Integrated Credit Solutions (Pty) Ltd (NICS), Ncube Incorporated Attorneys, Morkalio Revenue Solutions (Pty) Ltd neQLink Holdings (Pty) Ltd.'Sifuna abaqashi bazi ukuthi lezi zinkampani yizona ezisemkhankasweni wokuqoqa izikweletu. Imali kumele ifakwe kwi-akhawunti yeNSFAS kuphela, hhayi kwenye. Sikhulu isidingo sokuxhaswa kwezitshudeni zakuleli."Ukhale ngokunyuka kwesibalo sabadinga ukuxhaswa, ukubiza kwezinto kanjalo nokwehla koxhaso oluvela kuhulumeni okwenza babe nengcindezi ngasemalini kwiNSFAS. "Ezinye izitshudeni azikwazanga ukubhalisa ngenxa yalezi zinselelo. Sishoda ngoR10.6 billion esabelweni sokuxhasa izitshudeni kanti sixoxa noMnyango weMfundo ePhakeme mayelana nokuthi sithole uchatha ukuze sixhase ezinye izitshudeni."Uveze ukuthi baxhase izitshudeni ezingu-783 000 kulo nyaka, ezingu-576 000 zisemanyuvesi kuthi ezingu-206 000 zisemakolishi amaTVET. Esithangamini nabezindaba kuleli sonto abalesi sikhwama baveze ukuthi bathole izikhalo zabachithwe wuxhaso ezingu-87 121 zabenza unyaka wokuqala, kwachithwa ezingu-14 700. Zingu-5 915 ezisabuyekezwa, ezingu-38 243 zigunyaziwe, kanti kwezinye kusalindwe eminye imininingwane.

KUPHELILE ngombuso wenkosi ebiyiphini likasihlalo wendlu yobuholi bomdabu KwaZulu-Natal, uNgqayizivele Sithole, waseMhlumayo, eMnambithi.USithole ukhishwe kwesokuba inkosi maqede kwaqokwa iNkosi entsha, uSabelwesihle Simphiwe Sithole.Imininingwane yokuqokwa kwenkosi entsha iqukethwe encwadini ebhalwe nguNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli. Ukukhishwa kukaSithole ekubeni inkosi kusho ukuthi sizomphunyuka nesikhundla sokuba iphini likasihlalo wendlu yobuholi bomdabu KwaZulu-Natal njengoba engeselona ilungu lendlu.USithole waqokelwa kwesephini likasihlalo wendlu yobuholi bomdabu KwaZulu-Natal, okhethweni olwalungo-2023.Incwadi ebonwe yiSolezwe iveza ukuthi uSithole ubekade eyibamba bukhosi sonke lesi sikhathi. Incwadi yazisa uSithole ngokuphela kwesikhathi sakhe njengebamba bukhosi."Le ncwadi ikwazisa ngesinqumo esithathwe undunankulu ehlangene nesigungu sakhe esiphezulu, sokwamukela uSabelwesihle Simphiwe Sithole njengeNkosi yesizwe sakwaSithole kusukela ngoJuni 11, ngokwesigaba 8 (3) somthetho wobuholi nokubusa kwendabuko namaKhoisan, ofundwa nesigaba 19(2) somthetho waKwaZulu-Natal, 2005."UNtuli wazise uSithole ukuthi akaselona ilungu lendlu yobuholi bomdabu esifundeni uThukela njengoba engeselona ibamba bukhosi. "Kulesi sigaba uhulumeni uthanda ukudlulisa amazwi okubonga ngeqhaza olibambile ekuthuthukiseni isizwe sakwaSithole ngesikhathi usaphethe. Uhulumeni uphinde ukufisele impilo ende."Okhulumela uhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Bongani Gina, uyiqinisekisile incwadi ebhalelwe uSithole.Okhulumela uMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu, uMnuz Senzelwe Mzila, uyalele ukuba yonke imibuzo ibhekiswe ebuholini bendlu yomdabu KwaZulu-Natal. Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kukaSithole noSihlalo wendlu yobuholi bomdabu KwaZulu-Natal, iNkosi Sifiso Shinga, kayizange iphumelele njengoba izingcingo zabo bezikhala zingabanjwa.USithole wangena esikhundleni ngo-2010.Inkosi entsha, eneminyaka engu-34, kuthiwa yaqala ukuzama ukungena esikhundleni ngo-2015, kanti izalwa uLwazi Sithole, owakhothama ngo-2010.
ABEMBONI yamatekisi KwaZulu-Natal sebeqinisekise ukuthi kabajiki ngesinqumo sabo sokwenyusa imali yokugibela amatekisi kulandela ukuvungama kwabantu emva kokusabalala kwemibiko yokuthi imali yokugibela izonyuka kusukela ngoMsombuluko, ezindaweni ezahlukene ezakhele isifundazwe.Lokhu kudalulwe okhulumela inhlangano yabamatekisi iSantaco esifundazweni, uMnuz Sfiso Shangase, othe kuwumgomo wabo waminyaka yonke wokuhambisana nezindleko ezihlale zikhuphuka."Imali yokugibela ihlale inyuka njalo ngoJulayi kepha kulokhu asikwenzanga lokho ezindaweni ezithile esifundazweni ngoba sithi sizama ukuzwelana nabagibeli ngoba bangamakhasimende ethu njengoba size sinquma ukuzoyinyusa manje. Akusikho ukuthi yingoba singazwelani nabo kodwa yingoba nathi sinezindleko okudingeka ukuthi sibhekane nazo njengoba lena kuyindlela esiziphilisa ngayo ezweni,” kusho uShangase. Uthe ngaphambi kokuba bafinyelele kulesi sinqumo baqale babonisane nezinhlaka ezithile zobuholi bomphakathi kubalwa amakhansela nezinduna kwezinye izindawo ukwenzela ukuthi uma sekufikwa esinqumeni esinjena, kungabi yinto entsha kuwo wonke umuntu."Kanti futhi uma uqhathanisa ukwenyuka kwezindleko zansuku zonke emhlabeni uzobona ukuthi indlela esinyusa ngayo intengo yokugibela ayiyimbi ngale ndlela abanye abantu abangabuka ngayo. Kunalokho sisaqhubeka nokushayeka ezintweni eziningi ngoba kuningi esibhekene nakho njengoba kudingeka ukuthi sikhokhele abasebenzi bethu, sikhokhele zona izithuthi futhi sikwazi ukuphilisa imindeni yethu kule mali engekho,” usho kanje.Ezinkundleni zokuxhumana abantu bakhalile ngokuthi le mali iyanyuka ekubeni isimo somnotho singesihle.
Amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal abophe abantu abayishumi nanhlanu (15) ngemibuzo mayelana nokuhilizisana phakathi kwabashayeli be-e-hailing nabanikazi bamatekisi nabashayeli bamatekisi okuholele ekuzameni ukubulala umshayeli oyedwa we-e-hailing kanye nokushaywa komunye KwaDabeka ngoLwesithathu ekuseni, zingama-27 kuNcwaba wezi-2025.Lokhu kulandela imibiko yokuqhunyiswa kwesibhamu okuthe uma efika emgwaqeni uZaza kwabe sekutholakala ukuthi iqulu labanikazi bamatekisi nabashayeli bamatekisi kuthiwa liqhamuke kubashayeli bezimoto ezikhokhelwa ngebanga abebepake izimoto zabo eceleni komgwaqo lathi mabasuse izimoto zabo. Kuphinde kwabikwa ukuthi ngesikhathi kuqhubeka ingxabano kuphume isibhamu kwaphuma inhlamvu yangena esicabheni somgibeli kwenye yezimoto ezithutha, umshayeli engaphakathi emotweni. Kubikwa ukuthi omunye umshayeli uphinde washaywa ngesikhathi kuqhubeka umsindo. Amaphoyisa alandele imininingwane kusukela ngoLwesithathu ebusuku kwaze kwaba uLwesine ekuseni, kanti kulowo mkhankaso, abantu abangu-15, abangabashayeli bamatekisi nabanikazi bamatekisi okusolakala ukuthi babeyingxenye yeqembu okubikwa ukuthi lihlasele abashayeli bezimoto baphonswa imibuzo.Kuthathwe izibhamu eziyisishiyagalombili ezinelayisensi emzini womnikazi wetekisi oyedwa kanti uzothweswa icala lokwehluleka ukuvikela izibhamu ngokuhambisana neFirearms Control Act. Kuphinde kwakhishwa izibhamu ezine kubanikazi bazo kanti zonke izibhamu ezingu-12 zizothathwa ukuze ziyohlolwa. Omunye umnikazi wetekisi, okusolakala ukuthi ushaye umshayeli wemoto encane, uthinte umphenyi wamaphoyisa wazethula emaphoyiseni ehamba nabammeli bakhe ngoLwesine ekuseni.
Umbuzo:MAGUMEDE, ngingowesilisa onenkinga yokuhalela abafazi babantu ngendlela exakile. Nginaye umuntu engithandana naye okungowami kodwa akufiki ukuthi ngimlobole, kunalokho ngizishelela abafazi babantu bangiqome ngizilalele nabo.Ngikhuluma nje, nginababili engijola nabo, amadoda abo akhona kodwa bathi beneliswa yimina kakhulu. Okungikhathazayo ukuthi silala ngaphandle kwejazi lomkhwenyana, sengike ngazama ukuphuma kule nkinga kodwa akuphumeki MaGumede. Kunalokho, uma ngike ngabona owesifazane efake indandatho livele linyakaze kancane lize lime, ngigcine sengizijubile ngashela. Abangani bami bathi nginomuthi ngendlela abafazi babantu abangithanda ngayo. Ngisize MaGumede, sengifuna ukuphuma kule nto ngingaze ngibanjwe ngibe senkingeni.Impendulo:BHUTI othanda abafazi babantu, ukube angiqashelwanga ukusiza abantu ngabe ngithi wena ufuna induku nje kwaphela ngoba uyaganga kodwa-ke ngoba umsebenzi wami akukhona ukujaja abantu, ngizokusiza.Le nto isemqondweni kuwe njengoba wayiqala wena uyoyiyeka wena futhi, angiqondi ukuthi ukuphi umehluko kowesifazane ofake indandatho nongayifakile ngoba inkomo iyafana? Kungani ufuna ukudla izithukuthuku zamanye amadoda? Ngicela uyiyeke leyo nto ngoba uma ungabanjwa wena ungofileyo, bhuti wami. Landa umuntu wakho uzohlala naye eduzane yikhona uzoyeka ukuhashukela abantu babantu. Zama nokuchitha isikhathi esithe xaxa naye noma uhamba uhambe naye ebese naye umfaka iringi ngoba kuyacaca ukuthi indaba ineringi.Ungenzi into ongeke uthande yenziwe kuwe ngoba nawe ngeke uthande bakuphingele umfazi, yekela ukuganga!

UHULUMENI waKwaZulu-Natal ufuna ukuthi idlinza lowayengundunankulu kaZulu, iNkosi Mangosuthu Buthelezi, ligcine liyindawo yokugcina amagugu yomhlaba ukuze umhlaba wonke uzofunda ngomlando kaButhelezi.Lokhu kuvezwe uNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, izolo, ngesikhathi ekhuluma emcimbini wokwethulwa kwezinhlelo zokwenza idlinza likaButhelezi indawo yamagugu yesifundazwe, KwaPhindangene, eMahlabathini.UNtuli uthe ukuthathwa kwedlinza likaButhelezi njengendawo yokugcina amagugu yesifundazwe bekuseyisiqalo nje. Uthe bafuna ukuthi kulandele ngokuba idlinza likaButhelezi libe indawo yokugcina amagugu kazwelonke."Sinethemba lokuthi uhulumeni kazwelonke uzoweseka umbhidlango wethu wokuba idlinza likaButhelezi libe indawo yokugcina amagugu esigabeni sikazwelonke. Ekugcineni sifuna ukuthi idlinza likaButhelezi libe indawo yokugcina amagugu yomhlaba."Uthe: "Lokho kuzokwenza ukuba kufike izivakashi lapha zizofunda ngomlando kaButhelezi. Ukufika kwezivakashi kuzofukula umnotho walapha. Eqinisweni nje namhlanje bekuseyisiqalo nje. Uhlelo lwethu luzokuba izigaba ezintathu." UNtuli uthe kumfanele uButhelezi ukuhlonishwa esigabeni somhlaba ngenxa yamagalelo abe nawo.Uchithe labo abathi uButhelezi uhlonishwa ngalolu hlobo ngenxa yokuthi wasungula i-IFP okuyiyona ehola uhulumeni wokubambisana ophethe KwaZulu-Natal."UShenge wahlonishwa ngisho nangamanyuvesi aphesheya. Labo abaphikisa ukuhlonishwa kwakhe kusho ukuthi baphikisa nokuhlonishwa kwakhe ngamanyuvesi aphesheya. Imisebenzi yakhe izikhulumela yona ngoba isiqu sakhe asilingani nepolitiki. Ube undunankulu kaZulu ngaphansi kwamakhosi amathathu. Walwela amakhosi. Uwumdondoshiya ohambe uhambo angaluqalanga esekwi-IFP, okuyiqembu alisungula. Waqala uhambo lwakhe esekwi-ANC. Manje umlando wakhe uyaphoqa ukuthi ugcinwe ukuze sikwazi ukufunda." Uthe: "Awu ngiyaphinda ngithi ntaba zaMahlabathi nilondoloze okukhuku, inqabakuthola kaZulu. Ifagugu lethu KwaZulu, eNingizimu Afrika nase-Afrika. Yikho njengohulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal sithi uShenge aphile ungunaphakade, empilweni yethu, kuzenzo zethu nalapho siqhuba inkonzo yesizwe. Namuhla siqopha ukuthi nembala ulifagugu lethu sonke. Ngakho ngoba ubeyisimanga sezimanga ngesethu isikhathi."UNtuli uthe baningi abantu abazozuza ngohlelo lokuhlonishwa kukaButhelezi."Uma kwenziwa indawo yamagugu kusuke kungachithwa imali, kusuke kwenzelwa abantu. Imali esetshenziswe lapho ngeke iqhathaniswe nokuzozuzwa abantu."Umcimbi wokuhlonipha uButhelezi ubuhanjelwe abantu abaqhamuka emikhakheni eyehlukene okukhona kubo abantwana baseNdlunkulu, amakhosi nabaholi be-IFP.
UKHATHAZEKILE umndeni wakwa-Q, eMlaza, kuphela izinsuku ingatholakali ingane (5) enyamalale ngendlela engaqondakali, maqede kwangena umyalezo othi kufuneka u-R60 000 ukuze ingabulawa. UNtobeko Xaba, oyingane yomfana, kuthiwa uduke ngoLwesihlanu olwedlule ngesikhathi eyodlala nontanga yakhe. Ngokusho kukagogo wakhe ohlangothini lwakubo kayise, uNkk Thandekile Xaba, uthe kuze kwabonakala sekuhwalele ukuthi udukile. "Kufunwe yonke indawo, wangatholakala. Entathakusa ngoMgqibelo, unina uthole umyalezo kuWhatsApp uthi 'sesifikile isikhathi sokuthi ukhokhe njengoba wangihlukumeza ngo-2020, ngaze ngalahlekelwa yingane, ngifuna u-R50 000 uma ufuna ingane yakho ibuye iphila’. Komunye umyalezo lo muntu uqhubeke wamyalela ukuthi angabenzi 'ubulima’ ayifake ebhange imali, akayithumele nge-eWallet yaseFNB noma enze uCash Send,” kusho uNkk Xaba.Uthe baphuthume emaphoyiseni beyobika kwathi uma elandelela inombolo, kwavela ukuthi idonsa emijondolo engakwa-Jeena. Kuvela ukuthi unina wengane uveze ukuthi umuntu amaziyo ohlala kule mijondolo wumalumekazi wayo Kuvela ukuthi amaphoyisa abesaqhubeka nokuphenya lolu daba ngesikhathi uNkk Xaba ethola umyalezo ekhanseleni lendawo ngeSonto, limthumelela i-voicenote yowesifazane ohlala emijondolo efanayo, ethi ake kuphenyisiswe ngoba kufike owesifazane ehamba nengane yomfana eneminyaka efanayo, ekubeni yena aziwa ngokuthi uneyentombazane."Sithe abasithumelele isithombe sayo, okuthe uma sifika sabona ukuthi uyena uNtobeko. Siphuthume khona, kodwa safika esehambile owesifazane. Sithe uma silandelela kwavela ukuthi unekubo eliseMalukazi, okuyilapho esithole khona ukuthi empeleni wumuntu esimaziyo, ongumakhelwane wethu kwa-Q ngoba unomjondolo ahlala kuwo eduze kwalapho okuhlala khona ingane nabazali bayo,” kusho uNkk Xaba.Uthe sebenikele eMalukazi bafike bathola ulwazi olushaqisayo lokuthi kukhona isihlobo esimbone ebelethe ingane emhlane, eya ngasemfuleni osendaweni, kodwa wabuya esehamba yedwa. "Ngeshwa thina sifike khona engasekho, odadewabo uma bemfonela esebatshela ukuthi useNanda,” kusho uNkk Xaba. Uthe bakhathazekile njengoba ingane namanje ingakatholakali. Uqhube wathi okubakhathaza kakhulu yilolu lwazi lokuthi kungenzeka ukuthi ingane umsolwa uyiphonse emfuleni. "Kusukela izolo (uMsombuluko), sivuka nomndeni nomphakathi siyokanisa eduze komfula, ngethemba lokuthi sizoyithola ingane,” usho kanje.Uthe namaphoyisa abethembise ukuthi azoletha izinja ezifuna umkhondo ngephunga emfuleni ngoMsombuluko, kodwa bekungakaze kwenzeke."Sesikhathazwa nawukuthi sibonile amaphoyisa eshesha elandela umkhondo wenombolo umsolwa athumela ngayo umyalezo ngoMgqibelo kodwa asikawaboni elandelela eNanda lapho efonele odadewabo phambi kwethu, esho ukuthi usebalekele khona ngoba uzwa kuthiwa abantu bathi untshontshe ingane,” kusho uNkk Xaba. Uveze ukuthi unina wengane wayengazani nomsolwa ngo-2020 abewubalula emyalezweni weWhatsApp. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant Colonel Paul Magwaza, usiqinisekisile isigameko, wathi amaphoyisa aseMlazi ophiko lwe-Family Violence, Child Protection and Sexual Offences (FCS), aphenya icala lokuthumba nelokuphanga."Udaba lwabikwa emaphoyiseni ngoMgqibelo, seluyicala lokuthumba ngoba bese kukhona imiyalezo efuna imali enguR60 000 ngodli. Amaphoyisa ophiko lwe-FCS asaphenya,” kusho uMagwaza.
UNENGEKILE ngokubambezeleka kwecala umndeni wowesilisa okuthiwa wabulawa yizihlobo ngesihluku nyakenye eMolokohlo, eNdwedwe, kuphinde kuhlehla icala eNkantolo yesiFunda saseVerulam.Kulesi sigameko okukholakala ukuthi senzeka ngoJulayi nyakenye, kwabulawa uMnuz Nkosikhona Vilakazi (25), maqede kwaboshwa uMnuz Enock Cele nendodana yakhe uMnuz Sabelo Cele. UVilakazi kuthiwa wayegcine ukubonwa ephila ngoJulayi 21, 2024, eyothenga okuthile esitolo sendawo. Isidumbu sakhe sagcina sivundululwa ethoyilethi lomgodi emzini wabamangalelwa ngo-Agasti 21, 2024, emva kokuthi bekhombe lapho babesiphonse khona, maqede badiliza izindonga zalo, bezama ukugqiba ubufakazi. Emva kokukhomba indawo yesigameko, zabe sezibakhalela. Izolo umndeni othi usugqigqe ezinkantolo isikhathi eside, ubulindele ukuthi kube khona inqubekela phambili kuleli cala.Ngokusho kukamalume kamufi, uMnuz Mboniseni Ngiba, bebenethemba lokuthi kuzomenyezelwa ukuthi lizoqala nini ukuqulwa icala. Nokho akubanga njalo njengoba uMshushisi woMbuso uMnuz Ntuthuko Mngadi, ephakamise ukuthi lihlehliswe icala njengoba kusekhona izitatimende okusafanele azidlulisele kummeli wabamangalelwa. Ummeli wabo, uMnuz Denvar Reddy, uthe lokhu kuzomnika nethuba lokuthi athi ukuxoxa nabamangalelwa, ukubalungiselela ukuqala kokuqulwa kwecala. IMantshi uNksz B Mpungose, ibe isilihlehlisela u-Okthoba 2, 2025 icala, ukuze kukhishwe izinsuku elizoqulwa ngazo. UNgidi uthe kuyabamangaza ukuthi kungani kulokhu kuba khona ukubambezeleka ecaleni ngoba abamangalelwa bazikhombela bona lapho babegqibe khona isidumbu sikamufi. "Kwambiwa, kwaphuma isidumbu salo muntu esasimfuna. Manje asigculisekile ngokushaya kwecala ngonyawo lonwabu ngoba asazi ukuthi inkinga ikuphi,” kusho uNgidi.Uthe ngokwabo kufanele ngabe abamangalelwa sebeze bagwetshwa nokugwetshwa. "Sekuphele unyaka ngoba isigameko esangoJulayi kuya ku-Agasti nyakenye,” usho kanje.Isidumbu sikamufi satholwa emva kwenyanga, sikhonjwa abamangalelwa emva kokuthi umphakathi uvuke umbhejazana uqeda kuthola umkhondo ngesigameko. Khonamanjalo, inkantolo efanayo, ilihlehlisele inamuhla icala lokubulala isaguga elibhekene noMnuz Andile Vilakazi waseMthebeni, eNdwedwe.Esigamekweni, kwafa uNkk Sibongile Elizabeth Vilakazi (70), (uninakhulu kamsolwa) ummangalelwa emgximfa ngesikhali esingajicile. Kuthiwa wahlaselwa ngokushaywa kuphindelelwa ngento engacijile okusolwa ukuthi kwakuyisitini noma isando.Izolo bekufanele inkantolo yethule ukwahlulela kwayo kuleli cala. IMantshi uNksz Mpungose, ithe icala lihlehliswa ngenxa yobuningi bamacala abezolalelwa yinkantolo izolo, wathi wusuku lwanamuhla oluzoba kahle ukuthi inkantolo yethule ukwahlulela kwayo.Ngosuku lwesigameko, umsuka kuthiwa kwaba wukuthi isihlobo sikammangalelwa, senza esasingajwayele ukukwenza, sifudumezela umsolwa ukudla efika ebusuku ebuya 'ezindaweni zakhe’.Kuthiwa umsolwa wasibuza isihlobo ukuthi kungani senza into esingayenzi, wasishaya. Kwavela ukuthi umufi nomyeni wakhe (umkhulu) baphuma egumbini labo lokulala bethi bayolamula kanti ummangalelwa uzobahlasela nabo. Kuthiwa umufi waphangalalela kuveranda wendlu. Kwavela nokuthi ngesikhathi sekubizwa uyise kamsolwa okuthiwa isigameko senzeka elele endlini yakhe, naye wahlaselwa ngummangalelwa, walimala.
