Sike saxhumana nobuholi bomkhandlu we-e-Hailing waKwaZulu-Natal. Kumanje basesiteshini samaphoyisa KwaDabeka nezisulu. Ubuholi buthembise ukusebenzisana nami kanye nabanye ababambiqhaza ababalulekile ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi asiboni ukuchitheka kwegazi okungaphezulu kanye nokubhebhetheka kodweshu," kusho uDuma.

UHLOSE ukulekelela abafelokazi nabadlule ezigabeni zezahlukaniso ukuba baphole amanxeba owesifazane waseMgungundlovu, ozoba nomcimbi wembokodo ngo-Agasti 30, esontweni iCFCI elikuVictoria Street, eMgungundlovu.UNkk Nonhlanhla Thabethe wase-Azaliya, eMgungundlovu, ophinde abe ngusomabhizinisi, uzokuba nomcimbi owethiwe elokuthi yi-Healing Journey, eMgungundlovu, athe baningi abesifazane abazithola bebhekana nezimo ezinzima ebese kuba lukhuni satshe ukuba badlule kuzona. Inhlosongqangi yalolu hlobo lomcimbi uthe akusikho ukubhibhisa izilonda kodwa ukubanikeza ithuba eliyingqayizivele lokuba bagonyuluke ngakho konke okusezinhliziyweni zabo mayena nezimo asebeke badlula kuzona empilweni.''Ayikho into emqoka ngaphezulu kokuba umuntu wesifazane akhulume ngezinto asuke edlule kuzona. Lokhu kuyamlekelela kakhulu ekutheni ugcine wehlile umthwalo abhekana nawo emoyeni.''Uthe lolu hlobo lomcimbi luzosetshenziselwa ukuthi abafelokazi - abadlule ezigabeni zezahlukaniso - babhodle ngokuthi bekwenzekani ngesikhathi beficwa yilezi zimo ezinzima. ''Kuzobalekelela nabanye besifazane ukuzwa enye imbokodo ikhuluma kalula ngezimo edlule kuzona. Iqiniso ukuthi kuyalekela kakhulu ukukhuluma futhi kuyelapha,'' usho kanje.Uthe kuzoba khona nabesifazane abangosomabhizinisi abazokhuluma ngezingqinamba kanjalo nangezinselelo abake babhekana nazo kwezamabhizisinisi.Uveze ukuthi olunye uhlangothi abangeke balushalazele olwabesifazane ababhekene nengwadla yokungabatholi abantwana emshadweni. "Abesifazane abaningi baye bathwale kanzima, bahluleke nokubhekana nesimo sokungabatholi abantwana uma beshadile. Kodwa lolu udaba kumele kukhulunywe ngalo ukuze bangeke bazizwe bebodwa kuleso simo."

SIZOQHUBEKA ngenyanga ezayo isicelo sebheyili sowayeyimenenja kaMasipala waseMzimkhulu, uMnuz Zweliphansi Sikhosana, oboshelwe icala lokubulawa kowayengunobhala jikelele we-ANC Youth League, uMnuz Sindiso Magaqa.USikhosana ubevele eNkantolo yeMantshi, eMzimkhulu, izolo, lapho bekuqhubeka khona isicelo sakhe sebheyili.Ngesikhathi kuqhubeka isicelo izolo, uMbuso yiwo ubuwenza izethulo emva kwezethulo ezenziwa ngabameli bakaSikhosana ngesikhathi kuqala ukulalelwa kwesicelo sebheyili emasontweni amabili edlule.Icala libe selihlehliselwa uSepthemba 2, lapho khona abameli bakaSikhosana bezophinde benze izethulo ngaphambi kokuthi kuphume isinqumo.UMbuso uthe ugabe ngofakazi olazi ukusuka nokuhlala itulo lokusocongwa kukaMagaqa, wathi unesitatimende sikafakazi esiveza ukuthi uSikhosana uyena impela owayengungqondongqondo ekuhlelweni kwetulo lokubulawa kukaMagaqa.USkhosana yena uthe uzowaphika onke amacala abekwa wona.UMagaqa owayeyikhansela kuMasipala waseMzimkhulu, wabulawa ngo-2017, kanti uSikhosana wanindwa yinkabi eyavuma icala, uSibusiso Ncengwa.UNcengwa wathi uSikhosana nowaweyimeya yoMasipala wesiFunda iHarry Gwala, uMnuz Mluleki Ndobe, yibona ababengongqondongqondo betulo lokubulawa kukaMagaqa.USikhosana noNdobe bake baboshelwa leli cala ngo-2018 kodwa abuye ahoxiswa amacala kubona ngenxa yokushoda kobufakazi.USikhosana uthe akamazi uNcengwa, watshela inkantolo ukuthi waqala ukumbona ngesikhathi beboshwe ngo-2018."Izinsolo azenzayo ngami zingcolisa igama lami."UMagaqa kuthiwa wabulawelwa ukulwa nenkohlakalo. UNcengwa wagwetshelwa iminyaka ewu-25 ebhadla ejele emva kokuba evume icala.Abanye abasolwa ababili, uMnuz Sibonelo Myeza noMbulelo Mpofana, bayaqhubeka nokuliphika icala, kanti uMyeza noMpofana bazovela eNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu, ngo-Okthoba, lapho kuzoqulwa khona icala labo.Omunye umsolwa, uMnuz Mlungisi Ncalane, kwatholakala ukuthi akakulungele ukubhekana necala emva kokuhlolwa ingqondo.
UMBIKO uphakamisa ukuthi bavulelwe amacala emaphoyiseni abaholi be-ANC abasolwa ngokuthola amantshontsho ezigidigidi zamarandi enkampanini eyashiya ingaqedile ukufakela abantu amanzi eMkhanyakude. Umbiko obhalwe ngumlawuli kaMasipala wesifunda, uMnuz Bamba Ndwandwe, uphakamisa ukuthi mabavulelwe amacala abaholi ababili abanezikhundla eziphezulu kwi-ANC esifundeni iNokuhamba Nyawo, okuyisifunda sikaKhongolose eMkhanyakude.Laba baholi, amagama abo agodliwe ngenxa yokuthi abazange batholakale ukuba baziphendulele, kuthiwa bathola intshontsho lika-R10 million enkampanini eyahlomula ngethenda yokufakela abantu baseJozini amanzi ngaphansi kohlelo iNondabuya Water Scheme Project.Kulolu hlelo olwaqala ngo-2019, kwakufanele kuhlomule imizi engu-2 400.Inkampani eyanikwa umsebenzi, iMinathi Consulting Engineering, yashiya ingawuqedile umsebenzi emva kokukhokhelwa u-R150 million.Umnikazi wenkampani, uMnuz Minathi Mthimkhulu, kuvela ukuthi wabhala incwadi efungelwe lapho echaza khona kabanzi ngokufumbathisa abaholi be-ANC.UNdwandwe waqokwa ukuba abe ngumlawuli kuMasipala weSifunda uMkhanyakude ngenyanga eyedlule nokwalandelwa umsindo, iziphathimandla kulo masipala zingafuni ukulandela umyalelo wesifundazwe.UNdwandwe usebhalele uMphathiswa wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, emyalela ukuba athathele izinyathelo abaholi abasolwa ngokwamukela amantshontsho.Umbiko, obonwe yiSolezwe, uveza ukuthi iMinathi yayidizela abaholi be-ANC abathintekayo ngo-10% (wemali yethenda). Umbiko kaNdwandwe uveza ukuthi laba baholi babethola intshontsho njalo uma kukhona imali ekhokhelwe iMinathi."IMinathi yabakhokhela izikhawu eziwu-14 imali ephakathi kuka-R500 000 no-R1.7 million ngo-2022. Umbiko uveza ukuthi le mali yayifakwa kuma-akhawunti asebhange ahlukene. La ma-akhawunti asebhange kwakungawezinkampani zomuntu oyedwa. Umnikazi weMinathi wayeyilanda imali kumnikazi walezi zinkampani bese eyinika u...(egagula umholi we-ANC)."Umbiko uqhube ngokuthi umasipala wagcina usunqaba ukukhokhela iMinathi ngenxa yokuthi yase ikhokhelwe imali eningi kakhulu ekubeni umsebenzi wokufakela abantu wawuhamba kancane."IMinathi yagcina iletha incwadi lapho yayisho khona ukuthi inqamula inkontileka yayo nomkhandlu. Lwama kanjalo-ke uhlelo lokufakela abantu amanzi."Okhulumela uButhelezi, uMnuz Senzelwe Mzila, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi bawutholile umbiko. UMzila uthe uButhelezi uzothatha izinyathelo ezifanele.Ngakolunye uhlangothi, uSomlomo womkhandlu, uMnuz Solomon Mkhombo, uthe bafuna ukuthi iMinathi ihlanze imali eyayikhokhelwa. UMkhombo uthe iMinathi yathola ngokweqile imali ewu-R24 million."Saqala uphenyo olwathola ukuthi le nkampani yakhokhelwa ngokweqile. Sisenkantolo naye, siyambopha. NoMcwaningi Mabhuku naye wathola ukuthi samkhokhela ngokweqile ngo-R25 million. Siyalufuna uphenyo oluzoveza ukuthi yashonaphi le mali."UMkhombo ubuye wakhala ngokuthi uButhelezi usebenzisa inkohlakalo eyenzeka kulolu hlelo ukulwa izimpi zepolitiki."Umphathiswa wenza izinkulumo lapho athi thina sigangile. Lokhu kwenza manje ukuthi singabe sisaluthemba uphenyo alwenzayo."
BAWOTHA ubomvu ngokubambezeleka kokuqala kwekhomishini ezophenya izinsolo ezenziwa uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi.UNgqongqoshe wezoBulungiswa, uNksz Mmamoloko Kubayi namaqembu ezepolitiki, bagxeke ukubambezeleka kokuqala kwekhomishini eholwa iJaji uMbuyiseli Madlanga, obekufanele iqale umsebenzi wayo ngoMsombuluko.Izolo, uMadlanga umemezele ukuthi ngeke ikhomishini isaqala ukulalela ofakazi ngoMsombuluko, ngenxa yokwehluleka koMnyango wezoBulungiswa ukuhlinzeka ikhomishini ngengqalasizinda edingakalayo. Esitatimendeni ithe: "Senza isimemezelo sokuthi sizoqala ukulalela ofakazi ngoSepthemba 1, ngoba sasazi ukuthi sizokube sesiyithole yonke ingqalasizinda esiyidingayo. Ngeshwa ke siyaphoqeleka ukuba sihlehlise."UNksz Kubayi uthe zizothathelwa izinyathelo izikhulu ezihlulekile ukutholela ikhomishini ingqalasizinda edingekayo.Umemezele ukuthi uzothathela izinyathelo umqondisi jikelele womnyango, u-Advocate Doc Mashabane nokumiswa kwephini lo mqondisi jikelele, elibhekelele ezobuchwepheshe, uMnuz Jabu Hlatshwayo."Uzomiswa emsebenzi kuze kuphothulwe uphenyo." Uthe inkinga enkulu edale ukubambezeleka kokuqala kwekhomishini ukungabi khona kwengqalasizinda yezobuchwepheshe."Okunye nje kube ukwedembesela kwabantu abathile. Ngesikhathi ngaziswa ngale nkinga ngoLwesihlanu isikhathi sase sihambile kakhulu, kwaba nzima ukuba ngingenelele. Ngidumele kakhulu futhi sengixolisile nakumengameli."Okhulumela i-EFF, uMnuz Sinawo Thambo, uthe ukubambezeleka kokuqala kwekhomishini kuyimizamo nje yokuvikela abantu abathinteka ezinsolweni zikaMkhwanazi."Ingakho sinxenxa uMadlanga ukuba ashiye kule khomishini ngoba izongcolisa igama lakhe." Okhulumela iMK, uMnuz Nhlamulo Ndhlela, uthe basamile ekutheni asikho isidingo sokuba kusungulwe le khomishini.Khonamanjalo: Ahlehlile amacala abantu ababili ababalwa uMkhwanazi ezinsolweni zokuthi bayingxenye yabantu abaphazamisa ukusebenza kwengalo yomthetho.Icala elifakwe iPhini likaKhomishana wamaPhoyisa, uLieutenant General Shadrack Sibiya, likhishiwe ohlwini lwamacala aphuthumayo.USibiya uphonsela inselelo ukumiswa kwakhe, ufake icala eNkantolo eNkulu ePitoli. Icala likasomabhizinisi, uMnuz Vusimuzi "Cat" Matlala, lona lihlehliselwe isonto elizayo.UMatlala ubhekene namacala ehlukene okubalwa kuwo nelokuzama ukubulala.Onke amacala abhekene noMatlala azohlanganiswa, bese equlwa eNkantolo eNkulu eGoli.
SELUBEKIWE usuku lokulalelwa kwesicelo sebheyili senkosi eboshelwe icala lokubulala ikhansela elingumshana wayo.Inkosi Simphiwe Erick Zuma izofaka isicelo sebheyili ecaleni lokubulala owayeyikhansela le-DA kuMasipala waseMngeni, uMnuz Nhlalayenza Ndlovu, ngesonto elizayo.UZuma uzothola ithuba lokufaka isicelo sebheyili eNkantolo yeMantshi, eHowick, ngoMsombuluko. Ukulalelwa kwesicelo sebheyili kaZuma bese kuhlehliswe kwaze kwaba kabili.Okokuqala kwahlehliswa ngenxa yokuthi uMbuso kukhona owawusafuna ukukuqedela, okwesibili kwahlehliswa ukugula kwemantshi.NgoLwesihlanu uZuma uvele kafushane enkantolo, icala lakhe labe selihlehliselwa uMsombuluko wangesonto elizayo. Isinqumo esicelweni sebheyili kaZuma kulindeleke ukuthi sikhishwe ngoSepthemba 11.Isonto lesine leli uZuma egqunywe ejele iWestville, eThekwini.UZuma waboshwa ngasekuqaleni kwale nyanga yithimba lamaphoyisa eliphenya amacala okubulawa kosopolitiki. Waboshwa kanye noMnuz Thabo Chonco, okuthiwa wahlela itulo lokusoconga uNdlovu engaphakathi ejele.UChonco yena akezukusifaka isicelo sebheyili njengoba evele eboshelwe elinye icala.Abanye abasolwa kuleli cala oMnuz Thobane Masobho Hlongwa noKhayelihle Shabalala. Induna uMnuz Zwelithini Buthelezi, yona isiphenduke ufakazi woMbuso.Ngesikhathi evele enkantolo ngoLwesihlanu, uZuma wenze izinsolo zokuthi washaywa amaphoyisa aphenya icala, inkantolo yamluleka ukuba awavulele icala.UZuma ubhekene necala lokusoconga owayengundunankulu wesizwe, uMnuz Qalokunye Zuma. UZuma wadedelwa ngebheyili kaR25 000 kuleli cala. Icala lokubulawa kukaQalokunye ebelilalelwa eNkantolo yeMantshi eMpendle, selizolalelwa eHowick. Nalo leli cala lizolalelwa ngawo uMsombuluko.
Amaphoyisa aseMpumalanga akugxeke kakhulu ukubulawa ngesihluku nokushiswa kwabantu ababili ezehlakalweni ezimbili ezenzeke eBarberton ngoMsombuluko.Ngokwemibiko yokuqala, amaphoyisa athole ulwazi ngezikhathi zasemini mayelana nomphakathi ozithathele umthetho ngezandla eBarberton Extension.Ngesikhathi amaphoyisa efika athole isidumbu somuntu okusolakala ukuthi ushaywe wagqokiswa ithayi ngaphambi kokushiswa."Ngemuva kwalokho, amaphoyisa alunywe indlebe ngesigameko sesibili esifuze lesi esenzeke enkundleni yezemidlalo (eBarberton) Extension 13, lapho kutholakale khona esinye isisulu sishisiwe," kusho okhulumela amaphoyisa esifundazweni eMpumalanga, uLieutenant Colonel Jabu Ndubane.Kuthiwa bobabili abashonile bebesolwa ngamanye amalungu omphakathi ngokubandakanyeka ekugqekezeni imizi kule ndawo."Kuze kube manje akekho osaboshiwe mayelana nalezi zigameko, uphenyo lwamaphoyisa lusaqhubeka, amaphoyisa acela umphakathi ukuthi uphumele obala ngolwazi olungasiza ophenyweni, okuholela ekutheni kubanjwe abathintekayo,” kusho uNdubane.
UMASIPALA weTheku usuzishayele ihlombe ngokuqoqa imali ewuR1 billion ngohlelo lawo lokuqoqa izikweletu kwizakhamuzi zakuleli dolobha, futhi onhloso yalo wukuzisiza ukuthi zehlise umthamo wazo wezikweletu ukuze zikwazi ukuphila ngokukhululeka.Lokho kushiwo yiMeya yeTheku uMnuz Cyril Xaba, lapho edalule khona nokuthi phakathi kwaMeyi noJuni baqoqe cishe u-50% wezikweletu, okufakazela ukuzibophezela kwabo ukwehlisa umthwalo wezikweletu kwizakhamuzi."Umbiko wethu walolu hlelo ophume kuleli sonto usivezele ukuthi umasipala uqoqe uR1 billion wezikweletu, kanti futhi okunye okusemqoka wukuthi ngenxa yalokho kusizakale izakhamuzi ezingaphezu kwa-18 000 ezithwele kanzima ngenxa yezikweletu, okusize ukuthi kwehle umthwalo nokukhombisa ukuthi siwuhulumeni oshisekela ukusiza amakhasimende ethu ukuthi aphile impilo engenazo izikweletu ezandisa izindleko,” kusho iMeya.Eqhuba, uthe bazibophezele ukuqhubeka basize amakhasimende abo ukuphila ekhululekile ngokuthi akhokhele izindleko zezinto azisebenzisayo."Lolu hlelo luhlose ukusiza ukuthi amakhasimende ethu abexinwe kakhulu yizikweletu ngenkathi kuqala lo nyaka, okuthi uma ikhasimende selikhokhe uhhafu wesikweletu saso, bese umkhandlu uyayesula le ngxenye esele. Ukwengeza kulokho, ikhasimende libe sekumele ukuthi likhokhe sonke isikweletu esiphakathi kwaFebruary kuya kuJuni. Amakhasimende asuke engakwazanga ukuqedela isikweletu sawo emva kwaJanuwari 31, avunyelwe ukuthi angene ohlelweni lokusiqedela zingakapheli izinyanga eziyisithupha futhi bangenzi lutho olunye oluyisikweletu ngaleso sikhathi,” kusho uXaba.
USUQALE uhlelo lokufundisa abafana abancane ngokubaluleka kokuziphatha uMasipala waseMthonjaneni ngenhloso yokunciphisa izigameko zokuhlukunyezwa nokubulawa kwabesifazane. Lokhu kudalulwe yiMeya yakule ndawo, uMnuz Mbangiseni Biyela, ngesikhathi kunemidlalo eyahlukeke ebihlelwe yiwona umasipala ebiseMthonjaneni Sports Door Centre.Ekhuluma kulo mcimbi uBiyela uthe bafuna ukwenza konke okusemandleni abo ngenhloso yokuqinisekisa ukuthi abafana bakhuliswa ngendlela efanele.''Sifuna ukwakha amadoda azokhula azi kahle ukuthi akalokothwa umuntu wesifazane. Yingakho sesiqale nezinhlelo zokubadodisa ngoba sihlose ukuthi zinciphe izigameko zokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane ezingxenyeni ezahlukene zale ndawo,'' usho kanje. Uveze ukuthi igxathu lokuqala lokwenza lokhu kwaba wukuthi kusungulwe imbizo yamadoda ebakhona kule ndawo njalo ngoJulayi. Uthe inkulu indima eklanywa yilolu hlobo lwembizo kule ndawo.''Le mbizo sisazoqhubeka nokuba nayo ngoba ngikholwa wukuthi yenza umehluko omkhulu. Umuntu wesilisa kumele uqale ukumakha esakhula.'' Uthe abantu besilisa kabalutho ngaphandle kwabesifazane kusuka emandulo. "Asibahloniphe abantu besifazane njengoba sasenza kudala. Kwakuthi uma kuliwa kuthi uma kuqhamuka umuntu wesifazane kume konke namanje kumele kube njalo.'' Mayelana nemidlalo uthe nayo ingenye yezindlela abahlose ngazo ukuthi bagcine abafana abancane kukhona abamatasa ngakho. Le midlalo ibihlanganise ama-ward ehlukene akule ndawo. Abadle umhlanganiso kube u-ward 4 okhale wemuka nesheke likaR15 000 ngemuva kokwehlula u-ward 6 kowamanqamu. Nemidlalo yamantombazane ibikhona.UBiyela ugcizelele kakhulu ukuthi ezemidlalo zingasetshenziswa njengethuluzi lokulekelela umphakathi ekutheni kube nozinzo nokuthula.''Sifuna ukukhuthaza abafana abasakhula ukuthi mabazibandakanye nezemidlalo. Okuhle ngezemidlalo wukuthi uma unekhono ungagcina sewuba nekusasa eliqhakazile ukwazi ukuziphilisa ngekhono lakho,'' usho kanje.
IZIHLOBO ezisele ngemuva kokudlula emhlabeni komzali obengumnikazi womuzi womxhaso, obebhalwe etayiteleni, kubalulekile ukuthi zisukume ziyilungise ngokushesha eyokuthi ubani osezothatha izintambo ngokusemthethweni. Lesi yiseluleko sommeli onolwazi olunzulu ngokudayiswa kwemizi, uMnuz Ayanda Mkhwanazi, wabameli iMK Attorneys eThekwini.UMkhwanazi ukhiphe alolu lwazi, kulandela izigameko ezimbalwa lapho Isolezwe libike ngokudayiswa kwemizi yomxhaso, izihlobo ezihleli ngaphakathi zingazi lutho ngalokho. Phakathi kwalezi zigameko, kukhona esenzeke kwa-F KwaMashu ngasekupheni kukaJulayi 2025, lapho umndeni wakwaMchunu waphunyuka ngembobo yenaliti, indlu yomxhaso eyasala kushona abazali, ishiswa abathile.Kusolwa ukuthi yashiswa wumnikazi omusha, okuthiwa wayithenga kwesinye isihlobo, okuthiwa yiso esabe sesibhalwe etayiteleni. Abagilwa batshela leli phephandaba ukuthi kwenzeka lesi sehlo nje babesanda kukhonjwa ngezibhamu abantu abangabazi, abagasela kulo muzi babatshela ukuthi bazobabulala uma begoloza ukuphuma endlini esikhokhelwe futhi esinomnikazi omusha. Kwesinye isigameko, esenzeke khona kwa-F KwaMashu, ngawo uJulayi, emndenini wakwaMlambo kwafika ummeli eyoxoxisana nezihlobo ebezihleli endlini esineminyaka yadayiswa, ukuthi uma ziqhubeka nokunqaba ukuphuma, udaba seluzongenelelwa yisikhonzi senkantolo. Ngokuthola kwaleli phephandaba, lo muzi wadayiswa yisihlobo esasicelwe ukuthi asigade izingane ezazisencane, kulandela ukushona komzali, owayengumnikazi womuzi. Kuvela ukuthi lesi sihlobo sakhwabanisa ubunikazi bawo, sabufaka egameni laso, kwahamba iminyaka, sawudayisa umuzi ngo-2012. Kuphinde kwavela ukuthi umnikazi wawo omusha ubelokhu ezama ukukhipha abahlala kuwo kusukela ngawo u-2012 kodwa bengavumi, bethi ngeke baphume endlini yomndeni.UMkhwanazi uthe ukugwema izinkinga ezifuze lezi, abazali abaqinisekise ukuthi babhala incwadi yokwabiwa kwefa, ukuze uma beshona kungabi khona ukudideka."Incwadi yamafa ilungisa izinto eziningi, iqede ukuqagela ngoba isuke ibeka zonke izinto ngononina,” kusho uMkhwanazi. Uthe uma kwenzekile abazali bashiya bengambekanga umuntu ozothatha umuzi uma bona bedlula emhlabeni, izingane zabo kufanele zibe nomhlangano masinyane uma umninimuzi eshona, noma ngemuva komngcwabo."Izihlobo azihlale phansi, zibonisane ukuthi ubani okufanele athathe izintambo. Kube yisinqumo esithathwa kuvunyelwene,” kusho uMkhwanazi.Uthe lokhu kungalekelela ekutheni kugwemeke ukuthi kube khona ingane eyodwa ezohlakaniphela ezinye, iyozibhalisa yona ukuthi umuzi sekungowayo ngoba abazali abasekho. Uqhube wathi kuyalekelela nokuthi uma abazali besaphila, bahambe bayoqinisekisa eMnyangweni wezaseKhaya ukuthi zonke izingane zabo ziyavela yini ngaphansi kwabo kwenzelwe ukuthi uma beshona, i-Master of the High Court, isheshe ibone ukuthi umufi kahle hle unezingane ezingaphezu kweyodwa. "Kwezinye izikhathi uthola ukuthi ingane ivele iwudayise umuzi, ithi izelwe yodwa kanti eqinisweni zikhona ezinye zakwabo,” kusho uMkhwanazi. Uthe zikhona izindlela zokuzama ukulungisa lo monakalo yize ezinye zazo zingelula. Uthe indlela yokulungisa umonakalo wukuya enkantolo, okushaya abaningi ngoba kudla ephaketheni. "Isinyathelo sokuqala wukufaka isikhalazo kwa-Master of the High Court, usho ukuthi uyiphonsela inselelo indlela okwaphuma ngayo incwadi yegunya (letter of authority) kulowo osuke esethi umuzi usungowakhe yedwa."Uthe:"Uma kuze kwashintshwa itayitela, kufanele baye eNkantolo eNkulu bayochaza ukuthi kwenzeka ubukhoshosho. Uma indlu ingaphezu kukaR400 000, uya eNkantolo eNkulu, uma ingaphansi uya eNkantolo yesiFunda ngoba ihhovisi lamatayitela aliyishintshi itayitela ngaphandle kokuyalelwa yinkantolo.” Uveze ukuthi uma itayitela lishintshwe ngenxa yokuthi umuzi usudayiselwe umnikazi omusha, leli hhovisi alikwazi ukusheshe libone ukuthi kukhona okushaya amanzi ngamaphepha elisuke liwanikwe wummeli.Uthe liye lithembele ekutheni ummeli usuke enze umsebenzi wakhe ngokwethembeka, njengoba esuke esebenza ngamaphepha afungelwe."Uma inkantolo ivumelana nalo osuke efake icala, usuke esengasivulela isihlobo sakhe icala lokukhwabanisa, aphinde avulele ummeli icala, kwi-Law Society of South Africa, (inhlangano ebheka ukuziphatha kwabameli) ukuthi ube budedengu ngokungaqinisekisi ukuthi ikhasimende lakhe lenze ubugebengu,” usho kanje. Uphinde waveza nokuthi enye into edala ukuthi kwande izinkinga ezifuze lezi ikakhulukazi ngezindlu zemixhaso ezakhiwa ngeminyaka kahulumeni wobandlululo, yindlela umasipala owasingatha ngayo uhlelo lokubhaliswa kwazo kabusha."Umasipala wawuvele uthumele izisebenzi zawo ukuthi ziye emakhaya lapho kwakhiwe khona lezi zindlu ziyobhalisa kabusha ubunikazi. Uthole ukuthi uma zifika, zifica isihlobo esisodwa, ezinye zisemsebenzini, kuvele kubhaliswe sona,” usho kanje.Uthe kokunye, lowo owayeficwa ngaleso sikhathi kwakutholakala ukuthi uxabene nezinye izihlobo, avele azibhalise yedwa, elaya abakwabo. "Uma efa lowo muntu, ingane yakhe ithi umuzi womzali wami lo, bese ixosha wonke umndeni,” kusho uMkhwanazi.Uthe lolu hlelo kwakufanele lwenziwe ngokuthi kuphinde kubuyelwe emabhukwini, kuyobhekwa ukuthi abazali babebhalise ukuthi banezingane ezingaki."Kuthi uma lezi zisebenzi zikamasipala seziya kulama khaya, zifike zibhekisise ukuthi kwenzekani ngazo zonke izingane ezibhalwe phansi,” usho kanje. Kulabo abazithola bethenga imizi 'enokukhuluma’, ubayalele ukuthi kufuneka baqale bazenzele olwabo uphenyo ngaphambi kokuba baze bathenge lowo muzi abasuke bedayiselwa wona.Uthe olunye lwalolu phenyo bangalwenza eMnyangweni wezaseKhaya, ngokubheka ukuthi umuntu owudayisayo akazalwa namuntu yini."Bangabuye babheke nakwi-website yoMnyango woBulungiswa ukuthi buthini ubunikazi bomuzi abadayiselwa wona, babheke nakuMaster of the High Court ukuthi awunawo yini umbango,” usho kanje.Udalule ukuthi abehlulekayo wukuzenzela ngokwabo lokhu, bangacela usizo lwabameli bakahulumeni,abasebenza ngaphambi kwenkokhelo noma bavakashele amanyuvesi anezifundo zomthetho, athe avame ukuba nawo amahhovisi asiza umphakathi mahhala ngalezi zinto.
USELE nemibuzo engenazimpendulo umndeni wowesilisa waKwaSithebe, eMandeni, owanyamalala ngoDisemba 2023, ongcwatshwe esengamathambo ngempelasonto.Amathambo kaMnuz Siya Makhoba, owayeneminyaka engu-39 ngesikhathi ehlelwa umshophi, agcine engcwatshwa wumndeni ngoMgqibelo, kulandela ukubuya kwemiphumela yolibofuzo eqinisekisa ukuthi uye ngempela.Umfowabo kamufi, uMnuz Khobs Makhoba elandisa ngesigameko, uthe kwakunguNovemba 2023, ngesikhathi omunye wabaholi bomphakathi emhudula ngemoto, emsola ngokuthi webe uthayela wakhe. Uthe emva kwesigameko, lo mholi wabuye wathola ulwazi lokuthi uthayela awuthathwanga umufi, wazivumela phambi komndeni, waxolisa wase ethembisa ukuthi uzomnxephezela ngemali umufi ngokumlimazela into angayazi."Akuhambanga kahle ngesivumelwano sabo njengoba bagcina sebephikisana ngesamba semali eyisinxephezelo. Omunye nomunye wagcina edonsa ebheka le, umfowethu ethi usezoqhubeka necala lokuhudulwa kwakhe enkantolo, nalo mholi wathi kulungile akenze njalo,” kusho uMakhoba. Uthe umndeni wawusalinde ukuthi kuqhubeke icala enkantolo ngesikhathi umufi evele enyamalala ngoDisemba wonyaka ofanayo. Udalule ukuthi lo mholi wayegqigqa icala lokushaya ngenhloso yokulimaza nelokuzama ukubulala enkantolo. Uveze nokuthi umfowabo wayengayi enkantolo eyothamela icala banganaka ukuthi yingoba edukile."Saqala sanganaka sizitshela ukuthi uzihambele izindlela zakhe njengoba engumuntu wesilisa. Kuthe uma kuba uFebhuwari ka-2024, kwacaca ukuthi kukhona okushaya amanzi ngokuduka kwakhe, umndeni wabikela amaphoyisa,” kusho uMakhoba.Uthe kwakungu-Ephreli 2024, ngesikhathi kutholwa amathambo okwakusolwa ukuthi akamfowabo, idokodo lokuduka komuntu laphendulwa elokufa komuntu. "Amathambo ayekhombisa ukuthi ushisiwe, ekhanda enezindawo enezibazi ezivulekile, kwaphinde kwaba nembobo ekhombisa ukuthi udutshuliwe,” usho kanje.Uthe bebelokhu belinde imiphumela eze yabuya kuyo le nyanga maqede kwenzeka isixakaxaka, uhulumeni ewangcwaba amathambo akhe, ewaphambanisa nawomunye umuntu ongaziwa, ayelokhu ehleli ngo-2020."Simngcwabe ngoMgqibelo, emva kokuba amathambo akhe angcwatshwa nguhulumeni ewaphambanisa namanye, ambiwe ngoLwesine lapho abesengcwatshwe khona (uhulumeni),” kusho uMakhoba. Uthe basabufuna ubulungiswa ngokufa kwakhe kodwa abazi bafuna izimpendulo abangazi bazozithathaphi."Kukhona abomphakathi abathi asingabuki kude kodwa sibuke kulabo abebenenkinga nomufi. "Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kwamaphoyisa ayiphumelelanga njengoba engazange ayiphendule imibuzo athunyelwe yona.
BAZOTHATHELWA izinyathelo ezinqala omasipala baKwaZulu-Natal abangayilandeli imigomo yokuphathwa kwemali njengoba kuzomiswa imali abayithola kuhulumeni kazwelonke nowesifundazwe.UMphathiswa wezeziMali, uMnuz Francois Rodgers, uthe uzobhalela uNgqongqohse wezeziMali kuzwelonke, uMnuz Enoch Godongwana, ecela ukuba kumiswe izabelo ezitholwa omasipala abangayilandeli imigomo yokusetshenziswa kwemali.Ukusho lokhu emva kokwethula umbiko wokusetshenziswa kwemali esiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal. Isigaba u-216 (20) somthetho sivumela uGodongwana ukuba amise isabelo somasipala abangayilandeli imithetho yokusetshenziswa kwemali.URodgers uthe uGodongwana umcelile ukuba alethe amagama omasipala abangayilandeli imigomo."Ngiyalelwe ukuba ngilethe amagama omasipala abangayilandeli imigomo ungakashayi uSepthemba 15. Ngizokwenza njengoba ngiyaleliwe. Kuningi engizokubheka uma sengihlanganisa umbiko engizowunika uGodongwana. Ngizobheka ukuthi zikhona yini izinyathelo ezithathwa omasipala ababhekene nenkinga yokungasetshenziswa ngendlela kwemali. Sizobheka ukuthi ngabe iyehla noma iyakhula yini imali esetshenziswa ngaphandle kokulandela imigomo komasipala abathintekayo." URodgers uthe kunomasipala abayishumi baKwaZulu-Natal abagadwe yizikhulu zoMnyango wezeziMali kuzwelonke ngenxa yokuthi bayaziwa ukuthi abayilandeli imigomo yokusetshenziswa kwemali.Uthe umbiko ukhombisa ukuthi omasipala abayisithupha kulaba abayishumi abagadiwe, basebenzise ngaphandle kokulandela imigomo imali ewu-R73 million phakathi kukaJanuwari noMashi."Omasipala abahlanu kulaba abayishumi abagadiwe basebenzise ngaphandle kokulandela imigomo imali ewu-R59 million phakathi kuka-Okthoba noDisemba wangonyaka owedlule. Lo mbiko ukhombisa ukuthi azikho izinyathelo ezithathwa omasipala ukuvimba ukusetshenziswa kwemali ngaphandle kokulandelwa kwemigomo. Imithetho ebekelwe ukusetshenziswa kwemali iyalela izikhulu zomasipala ukuba ziqinisekise ukuthi iyalandelwa imigomo yokusetshenziswa kwemali. Sizoqhamuka nezinhlelo zokweseka omasipala ababhene nale nkinga." URodgers uthe omasipala baKwaZulu-Natal abangu-20 batholwe ukuthi babhekene nenkinga yemali."Labo masipala abanayo imali eyanele yokukhokhela izidingo, bacwile ezikweletini, bayahluleka ukuqoqa izikweletu futhi bathola imibiko emibi kumcwaningi mabhuku. Abanye balabo masipala bangaphansi kweso lomlawuli. Ngokubambisana noMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu, sesiqhamuke nohlelo lokujuba ongoti abazokwelekelela le mikhandlu. Ongoti bazolekelela imikhandlu ukuba ikwazi ukusebenzisa kahle imali, ikwazi nokuqoqa izikweletu."
UNDLUNKULU weSilo esabuza uGoodwill Zwelithini kaBhekuzulu, uThandekile Jane Ndlovu Zulu, usexwayise onomehlo abanenkinga yophuzo oludakayo ukuthi bangayicabangi nokuyicabanga eyokuza eMkhosini woMhlanga wakulo nyaka.Uthe onomehlo abaphuzayo bazowukhomba umuzi onotshwala uma beke babanjwa kulo mkhosi ohanjelwa yizinkulungwane zezintombi, bebukhile.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi kunomcimbi wokweluleka izintombi nonomehlo obusenkundleni yezemidlalo iPrincess Magogo, KwaMashu. Uthe nakuba onomehlo benza umsebenzi omuhle wokugada izimbali zesizwe, kodwa kukhona abenza okungalungile. "Isekhona leyo mithonseyana yonomehlo abagcina benza okungalungile, sebephethe izintwana zabo ezimnandi o(egagula igama lotshwala) nobani bani. Ngishilo bakithi ngikhuluma nonomehlo, siyacela ukuthi abantu abangahambi beyophoxeka phambili lapho sebephethe khona izinto ezimnanjana kubona, bese beba yisibonelo esibi."Uthe onomehlo abahlulwa wukuzithiba baze basize bangalubhadi eMkhosini woMhlanga. "Noma ngabe umuntu uyaphuza akazame ukuzithiba, angaphuzi. Bonomehlo ngike ngasho ukuthi siyacela konomehlo abaphuzayo ukuthi bangezi emhlangeni. Ngicela basale la. Iphoyisa liye lisho uma uphuza ushayela, ukuthi phuzela ekhaya. Kanjalo nonomehlo abaphuzayo abadakelwe emakhaya. Abangayi kosihlaza lapha phambili."Uthe kuzoba nohlelo lokubheka ukuthi ngabe bonke onomehlo bafanelwe yini wumsebenzi."Kuzoba nohlelo lokuqeqesha onomehlo. Sizobheka ukuthi ngabe bonke onomehlo basenza khona yini okulungile. Sifuna ukubona ukuthi onomehlo bayisibonelo esihle yini ezintombini. Sicela ukuthi nani nikhuzane. Umakhelwane wakho uyamkhuza angaze ayohlazeka phambili." Uphinde wenza isiphakamiso sokuthi zonke izintombi zihlolwe ukuthi azizithwele yini ngaphambi kokuba zigibele amabhasi aya emhlangeni.Uthe kunabantu asebeke babeletha emva nje kwenyanga bekade beseMkhosini woMhlanga."Ngenxa yokuthi akekho umuntu ohlolwayo emhlangeni, izintombi zihlolwa ezifundeni eziqhamuka kuzo, kuyenzeka ukuthi kube khona izintombi eziya emhlangeni zikhulelwe. Zithi zibuya nje emhlangeni zibe ziyishaya phansi ingane. Sigcina singazi ukuthi uphunyuke kanjani kunomehlo?" Uthe:"Lokhu kuthunaza isithunzi salo msebenzi. Kungagcina mhlawumbe nohulumeni esethi kanti akusebenzi lutho uma umuntu ekwazi ukuya emhlangeni, athi ebuya nje ngenyanga elandelayo sekubhedile. Kunobufakazi bokuthi kuyaye kwenzeke into enje. Sisahleba okwamanje."Uthe bazohlawuliswa labo okuzothalakala ukuthi bahambe umkhosi bekhulelwe."Uma nje sike sathola ukuthi uye lapha komkhulu wayongcolisa, kufanele ugeze isigodlo uphinde ugeze zonke izintombi." UMkhosi woMhlanga uzokuba sesigodlweni eMashobeni ngoSepthemba 13-14.Kuzoba kungokokuqala ukuba umkhosi ubanjelwe eMashobeni njengoba kule minyaka engu-40 eyedlule, ububanjelwa esigodlweni eNyokeni.Isinqumo seSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini sokususa umkhosi eNyokeni sesiqubule imibuzo yokuthi ngabe isigodlo esisha sikulungele yini ukusingatha lo mkhosi ohanjelwa yizinkulungwane zabantu. UMphathiswa wezobuCiko namaSiko KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Mntomuhle Khawula, uthe konke sekumi ngomumo."Elami linye nje Ndlunkulu yakithi, iSilo iNdlulamithi yamakhosi sithe siya eMashobeni. Owami umsebenzi wukuba ngisho izwi elilodwa lokuthi uMnyango wezobuCiko namaSiko KwaZulu-Natal umi ngomumo. Sikulungele ukuya eMashobeni."
UMNDENI wabayisihlanu baseNkalankulu, eNdwedwe, ababhubhe engozini enyantisa igazi emgwaqweni onguthelawayeka uN2, phakathi kweMatigulu neDokodweni ngoMgqibelo odlule, ufuna kuphenywe ngezingozi ezenzeka kulo mgwaqo ezidlula nenqwaba yabantu.Bayisithupha ngomshayeli weloli kashukela abantu abashone kule ngozi. Kwababhubhile abayisihlanu abayizihlobo, kukhona uNksz Lowren Mthiya (41), Mnuz Sithabiso Mthiya (35), Mnuz Ephraim Ntuli (44), Mnuz Phakamani Mthiya (44) noNksz Khululiwe Maphumulo (35). Abafi bashone ngesihluku ngesikhathi imoto ababehamba ngayo beya emcimbini wesihlobo, ishayiswa yiloli, layidudulela eceleni komgwaqo. Kuvela ukuthi libe seligingqika iloli, liyiphitshiza, bafa bobahlanu ebebekuyo.Umngcwabo wabo ubuhanjelwe wuMphathiswa woMnyango wokuThutha, uMnuz Siboniso Duma izolo.Umndeni uzwakalise ukukhathazeka ngokuthi ingozi edlule nabathandiweyo bawo yenzeke emgwaqweni okujwayele ukuthi kubikwe izingozi ezinyantisa igazi kuwo. UMnuz Muziwenhlanhla Ntuli ekhuluma neNewzroom Afrika, uthe baphatheke kabi ngokwenzeke ezihlotsheni zabo.Uthe bafuna kuphenywe nangalo mgwaqo ababhubhe kuwona nesimo sawo. Ekhuluma nabezindaba uDuma, uthe bakhathazekile ngalezi zingozi ezehla emigwaqweni emikhulu yesifundazwe."Kube khona ubudedengu ngoba imoto ibibonakala ngokwanele emzileni wezimoto eziphuthumayo. Sihlale sikugcizelela ukuthi uma ushayela, awuqaphi nje kuphela imoto yakho kodwa ubheka engakwesokudla, engakwesobunxele kanjalo nephambi kwakho,” kusho uDuma.Uthe isimo salo mgwaqo sihle, ubonakala kahle wakhala ngobudedengu babashayeli. Ubuye wathi kujutshwe amaphoyisa kule migwaqo emikhulu kulesi sifundazwe ngenxa yalezi zingozi, wanxusa abantu ukuthi bahloniphe imithetho yomgwaqo ngoba uma sekunenhlekelele efuze le, kusala umonakalo ongalungiseki empilweni yalabo ebebesondelene nababhubhile. Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi kwenzeka le ngozi nje, ngoMeyi kulo nyaka, kwafa amalungu esonto laseZayoni eMtubatuba ayisishiyagalolunye emgwaqweni ofanayo.Babehamba ngemoto eyiveni, behlelwa yingozi bebuya esiguqweni. Imoto yabo yashayiswa yiloli elaliyilandela ngemuva, kwalimala inqwaba.NgoMashi kuwo lo nyaka, kwafa amanye amakholwa ebandla i-12th Apostolic Church ayisishiyagalolunye. Ngokwemibiko leyo ngozi yenzeka emva kokuthi ibhasi ababehamba ngalo laqhunyelwa yithayi, lagingqika. Khonamanjalo: UDuma udlulise amazwi enduduzo emindenini yabane abashone engozini eyenzeke kuN3, phakathi kweloli netekisi ngoMgqibelo ekuseni.Okhulumela uDuma, uMnuz Ndabezinhle Sibiya, uthe lo mndeni ungowase-Eastern Cape, ubuya eGauteng kanti umshayeli weloli kuthiwa usagcwele amathafa.Kujutshwe nonjiniyela emigwaqweni okwenzeka kuyo izingozi ezinyantisa igazi.
IPHINI likaNgqongqoshe wemiSebenzi uMnuz Jomo Sibiya, likhale ngokwanda kwesibalo sezingane zamantombazane ezikhindayo, lathi lokhu kuphazamisa uhlelo lokufunda nokufundisa ezikoleni.USibiya, obeyisikhulumi esiqavile, ukhulume kanje emcimbini wokunikelwa kwama-laptop awu-250 entsheni efundela ukuthuthukisa amakhono nama-tablet awu-269 kubafundi basezikoleni KwaZulu-Natal. Lo mcimbi bewubanjelwe eNkungumathe Youth Centre, esigodini saseMshisandlu, eNkandla ngoLwesihlanu. "Kunabazali abathengela ingane isiketi sifike ngezansi kwamadolo, sivuleke kahle. Ihambe iye esikoleni, iyabuya ngakusasa isiketi sesisifushane futhi sesisincane, angasho lutho umzali. Ingane uma ihlala edeskini, isiketi sinyuke kuvele iphenti bese abafana begxila kuleli phenti, awusho lutho, uthuli ungumzali." USibiya uthe abazali kufanele bayikhuthalele imfundo yabantwana babo futhi baqikelele ukuthi izingane zabo ziziphatha ngendlela ezikoleni. "Kumele baqikelele ukuthi izingane ziyaya esikoleni, ziyafunda, zibuya ngesikhathi, ziyafunda emakhaya futhi zilala ngesikhathi."Uthe abazali abangayekeleli izingane ziphuze ukulala ngoba azibe zisakwazi ukuvuka ekuseni ngesikhathi esifanele. Eqhuba uthe kunabazali abathengela abantwana babo ama-smartphone ukuze baphase izifundo zika-matric kodwa bona bahlale kuWhatsApp kuze kube yisentathakusa. Ubuze ukuthi ingane isuke isaxoxa nobani entathakusa. "Ingane izogcina seyishelwa ngamadoda amadala angangathi ngoba wena awuyinaki ingane yakho. Isikole akusiwo umgqomo wokulahla noma yini." USibiya uthe abazali abangagxeki uhulumeni ngamalungelo anikezwa izingane kodwa ababambisane nohulumeni ekufukuleni izinga lemfundo yezingane zabo. Ubuye wancoma kakhulu uthishanhloko wasePhalane High, futhi ongumsunguli wenhlangano engenzinzuzo, iNkungumathe NPO, uMnuz Mthokozi Mchunu, ngenxa yeqhaza alibambile kule ndawo ekufukuleni imfundo nasekudaleni amathuba emisebenzi entsheni esiqedile ezikoleni. Uthe ukube kuya ngaye uMchunu ubezohlonishwa nguhulumeni ngendondo. Ube esekhuthaza umphakathi ukuba umqoke emqhudelwaneni wezindondo kahulumeni futhi umvikele uMchunu ngoba ubalulekile. "Kuvamisile ukuthi abantu abafana nobaba uMchunu kube nabantu abangabathandisisi kahle ngenxa yomona." UMchunu uthe baqala ngokusiza intsha isafunda ezikoleni, baqhubeke noma seyisezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme futhi basize nentsha engakawatholi amathuba emisebenzi. Uthe izikole abasebenzisana nazo zibalelwa ku-24 ezivela ezifundeni eziningi zaKwaZulu-Natal. Uqhube wathi lolu hlelo balwenza ngokubambisana nama-Seta ahlukahlukene kahulumeni njengeServices Sector Education and Training Authority (SSETA) enikele ngoR2 661 000 ne-Finance and Accounting Services Sector Education and Training Authority (FASSET) ekhiphe uR26 787 500. Abanye ebebehambele lo mcimbi kubalwa amakhosi aseNdlunkulu, ilungu lePhalamende uNkk Thembeka Mchunu, iPhini leMeya yaseNkandla uNksz Nokuthula Magubane, othishanhloko, amakhansela, abahloli nabanye.
KUZOBIZWA nowayengungqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa, uMnuz Bheki Cele, ukuba azophendula imibuzo ekomitini lasePhalamende eliphenya izinsolo ezenziwa nguKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi.Amalungu ekomiti avumelane ngokuthi uCele abizwe ukuba azochaza ukuthi wazini ngezinsolo ezenziwa uMkhwanazi zokuthi amaphoyisa asebenzisana nezigebengu.Lesi sivumelwano senziwe emhlanganweni wekomiti obungoLwesihlanu, lapho bekudwetshwa khona umhlahlandlela ozolandelwa yikomiti ophenyweni lwalo. Isiphakamiso sokuba kubizwe noCele senziwe ilungu leMK, uMnuz David Skosana.UCele waba ungqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa kusukela ngo-2018, waze waphuma kulesi sikhundla emva kokhetho lwangonyaka owedlule.Emva kwakhe, kube sekuthatha uNgqongqoshe osamisiwe, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu. Ikomiti lizoxhumana noMkhwanazi, sizwe ukuthi angakwazi ukuza nini ukuzokwethula ubufakazi. Emva kwalokho siyobe sesixhumana nabanye ofakazi. Sifisa ukuthi konke lokhu kwenzeke ngokushesha."Ikomiti kufanele liphothule umbiko walo ozokwethulwa ePhalamende ungakadluli u-Okthoba 31.ULekganyane uthe bahlalelwe umsebenzi omkhulu wokuqinisekisa ukuthi baphothula umsebenzi wabo ngaphambi komnqamulajuqu abawubekelwe yiPhalamende.

Okhulumela inkampani yonogada iReaction Unit South Africa, uMnuz Prem Balram, uthe baye kulesi sikole bafica umfundi elele phansi, ummese umtafula ubhajwe ngemuva entanyeni. Kwabalimele kukhona oneminyaka engu-15 nona-17."Balashelwe endaweni yesehlakalo base beyiswa esibhedlela. Kubikwa ukuthi ubanjiwe umphehli wodweshu wayiswa emaphoyiseni. Sikhathazekile ngalezi zehlakalo futhi siyazigxeka kakhulu ezikoleni zethu. Sibafisela ukululama okusheshayo abalimele," kusho uHlomuka.
IDLINZA likandunankulu kaZulu ongasekho, Inkosi Mangosuthu Buthelezi, lizokwenziwa indawo yokugcina amagugu ezingeni lesifundazwe.Uhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal uzokwethula ngokusemthethweni izinhlelo zokwenza idlinza likaButhelezi indawo yokugcina amagugu, ngoLwesithathu.Idlinza likaButhelezi ongumsunguli we-IFP, lisemzini wakhe kwaPhindangene, eMahlabathini. Ngokwesitatimende esikhishwe wuhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal, uhlelo lokuphendula idlinza likaButhelezi ukuba libe yindawo yokugcinwa kwamagugu luzothatha iminyaka emithathu.Okhulumela uhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Bongani Gina, uthe izinhlelo zokwenza idlinza likaButhelezi indawo yokugcina amagugu zizokwethulwa wundunankulu wesifundazwe, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, kanye nomndeni wakwaButhelezi.UGina uchaze izinhlelo zokwenza idlinza indawo yamagugu njengengqophamlando. "Ukwethulwa kwalezi zinhlelo kuzokwenza ukuthi isizukulwane esizayo singagcini nje ngokwazi uButhelezi njengomholi, kodwa sizomazi njengendoda eyazinikela ngokweqile ekuthuthukiseni abantu kanye nezwe layo. Emcimbini wokwethulwa kwezinhlelo kuzokhuluma abaholi abaqhamuka kuhulumeni, abaholi bomdabu, abakwaButhelezi kanye nezicukuthwane ezimenyiwe."UGina uthe phakathi kwezinto uButhelezi azokhunjulwa ngazo yiqhaza alibamba ekusungulweni kweMangosuthu University of Technology, Ithala Bank nendawo yezimboni eseMandeni, iSithebe Business Development Zone.UButhelezi waba wundunankulu kaZulu ngaphansi kwamakhosi amathathu akwaZulu kusukela ngo-1954 kwaze kwaba uyakhothama ngo-2023. Waqala ukuba wundunankulu kaZulu ngesikhathi kubusa iSilo uCyprian Bhekuzulu kaSolomon, waqhubeka kubusa iSilo uGoodwill Zwelithini kaBhekuzulu, waphinde waqhubeka nesikhundla ngesikhathi kungena iSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini.UButhelezi waba wumengameli we-IFP kusukela ngo-1975 kwaze kwaba wu-2019.Wayehola uhulumeni wakwaZulu phakathi kuka-1977 no-1994.Phakathi kuka-1994 no-2004 wayengungqongqoshe wezasekhaya, futhi wayeke abambe isikhundla sikamengameli wezwe uma ababengomengameli ngaleso sikhathi bephumile bekwamanye amazwe.
Umbutho wamaPhoyisa aseNingizimu Afrika eFree State uthole inqubekela phambili mayelana namacala okubulala ezenzeka eHeidedal, eBloemfontein, ekuqaleni kwalo nyaka. NgoLwesine amaphoyisa ophiko lwezobunhlolo alandele umkhondo wabasolwa ngezintatha phakathi kuka-02:00 no-08:00, okuholele ekuboshweni komsolwa okukholakala ukuthi uhlobene nezigameko ezimbili ezihlukene zokubulala. Isehlo sokuqala senzeka ngoJuni 2025, ngesikhathi abahlaseli abangaziwa behlasela umuzi owaziwayo odayisa izidakamizwa eHeidedal. Izisulu ezazikhona wahlaselwa zingalindele, kwadutshulwa kwabulawa abantu abathathu. Isehlo sesibili senzeka ngoJulayi 2025, lapho umnikazi wendawo edayisa izidakamizwa wadutshulwa wabulawa owesilisa ongaziwa wase eyabaleka ngemva kokuhlasela. Emuva kokuboshwa komsolwa kwenziwe inqubo yokuba izisulu zikhombe umsolwa, nebala kwwqinisekiswa ukuthi nguyena obefunwa.Lo msolwa oneminyaka engu-35 ubudala kuthiwa nguyena onecala lokubulala ngoJulayi. Ithimba likazwelonke kophiko elizingela impahla eyebiwe elisebenza ngaphansi yohlelo i-operation Buyisa liphume umkhankaso wokuqoqa izibhamu ezingekho emthethweni ezinkampanini zonogada.Lishaqe izibhamu ezingu-226 ezinkampanini zonogada ezizimele ngokwephulwa koMthetho Wokulawulwa Kwezibhamu, ka-2000 (uMthetho 60 ka-2000). Umthetho ubeka izibopho eziqinile kubanikazi bamalayisensi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zigcinwa ngendlela efanele, ziphathwa ogunyaziwa futhi abaziphathayo bayazibophezela ekulandeleni umthetho. NgokweSigaba 120(1), kuyicala ukwenza lokhu: – Ukuphulwa noma ukuhluleka ukuhambisana nanoma yimiphi imigomo yooMthetho; – Ukwephulwa kwemibandela yelayisensi, imvume yokusebenza isibhamu - Ukunganaki noma yisiphi isaziso esisemthethweni noma imfuneko ekhishwe ngaphansi koMthetho. Ithimba lishaqe izibhamu ezilandelayo ezibhaliswe egameni lenkampani yonogada kulandela uphenyo oluqhutshwa uphiko lwezobunhloli: Krugersdorp, GP – kushaqwe izibhamu ezingu-204 zenkampani yonogada, kukhona nezimbili ezingekho emthethweni, kuboshwe umuntu oyedwa. Lephalale, LIM – Kutholakale inhlokohlela eyodwa iphethwe umuntu ongagunyaziwe. Booysens, GP – Kutholakale izibhamu ezintathu ezisenkampanini yonogada ngokungafanele. Makhado, MP – Izibhamu ezingu-11 zigcinwe ngokungafanele, esinye salezizibhamu sinezinhlamvu kanti amagobolondo aso atholakale ehlathini. Dirkiesdorp, MP – kushaqwe izibhamu ezinhlanu konogada abebeziphethe budedengu futhi beziqhumisa emphakathini. Randburg, GP – Kutholakale isibhamu esisodwa eziyamaniswa necala lokuzama ukubulala amaphoyisa elenzeka ngo-2016.Seziphelele zingu-226 izibhamu ezishaqiwe, kanti nezingu-377 ezibhaliswe yinkampani yonogada kodwa azingaziwa ukuthi ziphi. Kukhishwe isaziso ngokweSigaba 106 esiphoqa le nkampani ukuthi yethule lezi zibhamu ezingakatholakali. Kuvele ukuthi Isebenza ngaphansi kwamagama amaningi okuhweba, ikheli lokugcina impahla elibhalisiwe lenkampani nalo liyinto engekho.

KULOKOZA inhlansi yethemba ngokuxazululeka kwenkinga yamanzi kuMasipala wesiFunda uThukela, ngemuva kokuba usayine isivumelwano sokusebenzisana noMnyango wezaManzi nokuHanjiswa kweNdle noMgeni Waterboard.IMeya yesiFunda uThukela, iNkosi Ntandoyenkosi Shabalala, ithe ibuyelwe yithemba elikhulu njengoba lesi sivumelwano sifaka phakathi ukuvuselela ingqalasizinda nokusatshalaliswa kwamanzi.Lesi sivumelwano sifaka phakathi nokuthi kube khona ingqalasizinda entsha eyakhiwayo. UShabalala uthe le ngeminye yemizamo yabo yokuqinisekiusa ukuthi abantu basoThukela bayawathola amanzi.''Baningi kakhulu abaholi abake bafika lapha ngaphambilini ngisho noMengameli wezwe, uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa, kodwa akukho okushintshile enkingeni yamanzi,'' usho kanje.Uchaze ukusayinwa kwalesi sivumelwano njengengqophamlando kubantu basoThukela. ''Sijabule nokuzwa ngemali okuthiwa isikhona esizoqala isilekelele kakhulu ngokuthi kulungiswe ingqalasizinda,'' echaza.UMnyango wezaManzi nokuHanjiswa kweNdle uzokhipha imali engu-R300 million eminyakeni emithathu ezayo, ebese kuthi uMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana uzoqala ngokukhipha imali engango-R74 million.Ngaphambi kokuba kusayinwe lesi sivumelwano, uMphathiswa wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, uqale waveza izingqinamba eziningi uMasipala wesiFunda uThukela obhekene nazo okufaka phakathi ukonakala kakhulu kwengqalasizinda."Yingakho nje kubalulekile ukuthi kube nesivumeleano esinjengalesi lapho zonke izinhlaka ezizibophezele kulesi sivumelwano kuzomele zibambe iqhaza kulo monakalo."
INHLANGANO eyengamele ukhetho, i-Independent Electoral Commission (IEC), ikhathazekile ngokugcweleza kwamalungu amaqembu ezepolitiki ezikhungweni zokuvota uma kunokhetho KwaZulu-Natal.UKhomishana we-IEC, uMnuz Glen Mashinini, uthe kumele isukunyelwe eyokuchukuluzana kwamalungu ezinhlangano zepolitiki uma KwaZulu-Natal.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma esiShayamthetho sesifundazwe lapho khona i-IEC ibichaza ngamalungiselelo okhetho lohulumeni basekhaya oluzayo. UMashinini uthe ukuchukuluzana kwamalungu amaqembu ezepolitiki kwenzeka kakhulu ngaphandle kwezikhungo lapho khona amaqembu ezepolitiki esuke ebeke khona amatafula namatende amancane."Ngifuna ukusho ukuthi sikhathazekile ngokuziphatha kwamalungu amaqembu. Kade ngingakithi oSizweni, ngithi angikusho ukuthi engikubone khona kungishaqisile. Amatafula asinikeza inkinga."UMashinini uthe abaholi kufanele bayisukumele eyokuchukuluzana kwamalungu amaqembu. "Kufanele sizame ukusigwema lesi simo. Asingalindi kuze konakale kuze kube ima sisukuma."Isikhulu esiphezulu kwi-IEC, uMnuz Sy Mamabolo, sithe bayaqhubeka namalungiselelo okhetho oluzayo.UMamabolo uveze ukuthi ngeke kuvotwe kusetshenziswa ezobuchwepheshe okhethweni oluzayo. I-IEC ibikade inezithangami lapho ibilalele imibono yabantu ngodaba lokuvota kusetshenziswa ezobuchwepheshe.UMamabolo uthe bazoqhubeka nalezi zithangami."Okwamanje sisacubungula umthetho, kungenzeka okhethweni oluzolandela ukuba kuvotwe ngezobuchwepheshe." Amalungu esiShayamthetho akhombise ukungalwethembi uhlelo lokuvota kusetshenziswa ubuchwepheshe, athi uma kuvotwa kusetshenziswa lobu buchwepheshe kunganzima ukuba kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kuvote abantu abafanele.UMamabolo uthe ukhetho lukazwelonke lwangonyaka owedlule, lubafundise izinto eziningi. "Umbango ubumkhulu kakhulu okhethweni olwedlule. Asikaze siyibone into enje uma kunokhetho. Kube namacala ezinkantolo abalelwa ku-80 athinta ukhetho olwedlule. Nakuba umbango ubumkhulu kodwa ukhetho lwaba nokuthula. Maningi amampunge asabalaliswa ngaphambi kokhetho. Lena inselelo okufanele sibhekane nayo."Uthe: "Kufanele sizibuze ukuthi sizokulwa kanjani nokusabalaliswa kwamampunge uma kunokhetho? Ukusabalaliswa kwamampunge kulimaza isithunzi senhlangano eyengamele ukhetho. Kwaba nezinselelo okhethweni okubalwa kuzo nokucisha kwemishini ngesikhathi kubalwa. Kodwa ekugcineni singasho ukuthi ukhetho lwaba olukhululekile."UMamabolo uthe sebeqoke inkampani ezimele ukuba ihlole umshini wokuvota ukugwema ubuhixihixi obenzeka okhethweni olwedlule."Nathi asijabule ngobuhixihixi obaba khona. Ukungasebenzi kahle komshini wokuvota kwadala ukuba kube nemigqa emide ezikhungweni zokuvota."

ISIFUNDA uMzinyathi KwaZulu-Natal, yize singanakekile kodwa siyisizinda sezinkabi esifundazweni nasezweni lonkana.Lokhu kuvezwe wuKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant-General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, ngoLwesibili ebusuku ngesikhathi kuqhubeka umhlangano wezinhlaka ezehlukene zokulwa nobugebengu esifundazweni.Umhlangano ububizwe wuNdunankulu wesifundazwe uMnuz Thami Ntuli ehhotela, eLangeni, eThekwini. Ngaphansi kwesifunda uMzinyathi kukhona izindawo ezifana noMsinga neGreytown, okuhlale kuvela ukuthi izinkabi eziningi zivela khona. Ethula inkulumo yakhe kulesi sithangami uMkhwanazi uthe imvamisa yonke inkabi ebanjwayo kuye kuvele ukuthi ivela kulesi sifunda.Ube esebalula ukuthi akufanele kugcinwe ngokuthi kuliwe nobugebengu kuphela kodwa akuliwe nomsuka wembangela yokuthi kube nobugebengu Uthe kuningi okufanele kwenziwe ukuze kukhucululwe le nsila. "Intsha yabafana evela ezindaweni ezakhele lesi sifunda, uye uthole ukuthi ikhulele emakhaya anesithembu. Umuntu akutshele ukuthi uyise ubuye abe nomunye unkosikazi anezingane naye. Athi wahamba wabashiya kanjalo, wayosebenza ezimayini, wangaphinde wabuya,” kusho uMkhwanazi.Uthe lolu hlobo lwezingane lubuye lwehlelwe wumshophi wokuthi kushone oyise bese onina bengenwa abafowabo boyise. "Babazalisa ezabo izingane, bese bekhohlwa yibo. Lolu hlobo lwezingane lukhula lungazi ukuthi kufanele lwenze njani, bese luvuma kalula uma luyengelwa ekubeni yizinkabi, bese lungena ebugebengwini,” kusho uMkhwanazi.Uthe yilokho abakutholayo uma behlaziya ubugebengu. "Silwa nobugengu, asilwi nomnyombo wabo,” usho kanje. Ephawula ngobugebengu obuthinta ukuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane, uthe kufanele kushintshwe ukwenza, kuyekwe ukudluliswa kwemiyalezo kumathelevishini. "Iningi labantu abenza lokhu abawabuki kwakuwabuka lawo mathelevishini, bazihlalela ezindaweni zokucima ukoma,” kusho uMkhwanazi.Uthe okufanele kwenziwe wukuthi kungenwe umnyango nomnyango kukhulunywe nabo. "Akungenwe ezindaweni zokucima ukoma lapho abasuke behleli khona bephuza bebuka ibhola, kucishwe leyo thelevishini, kufakwe i-video yomgilwa, kuthi ukuma kancane lelo bhola, badlalelwe izigameko ezenzeka nsuku zonke,” kusho uMkhwanazi. Uthe ukholwa wukuthi uma kungenziwa lokhu, umehluko ungaqala ubonakale ngoba abenzi balobu bubi abazibuki izindaba, bahamba bayoziphuzela ematshwaleni, babuke ibhola bese beyagoduka bayoshaya amakhosikazi.Kulo mhlangano uNtuli unxenxe osomabhizinisi ukuthi basebenzisane nezinhlaka ezilwa nobugebengu ukuze kuliwe nobugebengu kusetshenziswa ubuxhakaxhaka besimanje obufana nama-drone namakhamera. Uthe ukusetshenziswa kwalezi zinto kungahamba elide ibanga ekukhinyabezeni izinswelaboya ebugebengwini bazo. Kwabebeyingxenye yomhlangano kubalwa abaphathi bamabhizinisi, izifundiswa, izinhlaka ezilwa nobugebengu emazingeni ahlukene, abezenkolo, izinhlangano zokuphepha ezizimele nabanye.
KUNZIMA kuMasipala wesiFunda uMkhanyakude njengoba i-ANC ne-IFP beqhubeka nokuphikisana ngodaba lokufakwa kwalo mkhandlu ngaphansi kweso lomlawuli.La maqembu abambene ngezihluthu njengoba lingekho elifuna ukugoba uphondo embangweni osuswe yisinqumo seKhabhinethi yaKwaZulu-Natal, sokufaka umasipala ngaphansi kweso lomlawuli.I-ANC ne-IFP bayingxenye yohulumeni wokubambisana ophethe iKwaZulu-Natal. Ukungavumelani kwala maqembu ngodaba lokufakwa komkhandlu ngaphansi kweso lomlawuli, sekuholele ekuvalweni kwamahhovisi omkhandlu.Amahhovisi omkhandlu aqale ukulenga ukhiye ngasekuqaleni kwenyanga eyedlule ngesikhathi kwethulwa umlawuli, uMnuz Bamba Ndwandwe.NgoLwesithathu, kusuke uthuthuva ngesikhathi amalungu e-IFP ebhikisha, efuna kuvulwe amahhovisi. Amalungu e-IFP afike athibelana namalungu enyunyana yabasebenzi edlelana ne-ANC, iSamwu. Amalungu eSamwu ayaphikisana nokujutshwa kukaNdwandwe.Osebuholini be-IFP esifundeni uMkhanyakude, uMnuz Makhosonke Sithole, uthe inkohlakalo inuka phu kuMasipala wesiFunda uMkhanyakude.USithole uthe labo abaphikisana nokufakwa komasipala ngaphansi komlawuli bavikela abantu abathinteka enkohlakalweni. "Lapha eMkhanyakude sizokhalaza ngokubhubhudlwa kwemali yomkhandlu. Ayilandelwa imithetho lapha eMkhanyakude. La bantu abavimbile lapha bavimbe ngoba phela bangamalungu e-ANC, bahlulwa ukhetho bekade bemele i-ANC. I-ANC yabe isibaqasha ukuba babe abasebenzi bomkhandlu. Baqashwa ngaphandle kokulandelwa kwemithetho."USithole uthe ukuvalwa kwamahhovisi kuphazamisa ukuhanjiswa kwezidingo."Sifuna ukuthi kuvulwe amahhovisi khona umasipala uzokwazi ukuqhubeka nokusebenza. Siyaphikisana nale nto eyenziwa ubuholi be-ANC yokuvimba umlawuli. Umlawuli kufanele avunyelwe ukuba enze umsebenzi wakhe. Umlawuli ulethwe lapha ngenxa yokuthi kunezinkinga ezikhungethe umkhandlu. Angeke zilungiseke lezi zinkinga uma umlawuli engavunyelwa ukuba enze umsebenzi wakhe." Kunecala elifakwe umasipala eNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu, lapho uphikisana nokufakwa ngaphansi kweso lomlawuli. Inkantolo ayikasikhiphi isinqumo kulolu daba.IMeya yomkhandlu, uMnuz Siphile Mdaka, ithe akekho umlawuli abazomvumela ukuba angene emkhandlwini."Ngeke sivume ukubanjwa ngobhongwane ngento ephambene nomthetho." UMdaka uthe bazoqhubeka nokulwa nokufakwa komkhandlu ngaphansi kweso lomlawuli."Ngeke siyiyeke le mpi. Uma i-IFP ifuna ukuthi siyikhombise ukuthi singayehlula, sizoyikhombisa lapha eMkhanyakude."
KUXWAYISWE izinhlangano ezilwa nabokufika ezikhungweni zezempilo kuleli ukuthi zingadlaleli ezikoleni ziphazamise ukufunda ngonyaka ozayo, ngenhloso yokuxosha abafundi abangenazo izimfanelo zokuba kuleli.Isexwayiso sikhishwe osihlalo bamakomiti asePhalamende, abebekhuluma nabezindaba izolo, eKapa.Labo sihlalo okungowekomiti elibhekele iMfundo eNdlini yoMkhandlu weziFundazwe ePhalamende, uMnuz Makhi Feni kanjalo nelezeMpilo uDkt Sibongeni Dhlomo, bathe akumele kudlalelwe ezikoleni. UFeni uthe abafuni kusuke udweshu ngonyaka ozayo uma sekuvulwa izikole, kuphazamiseke ukufunda.Uthe akumele kuphazanyiswe izikole kuphinde kuhlukunyezwe izingane ezincane ngoba nomthetho wezikole uyavuma ukuthi zifunde izingane ezingenazo izimfanelo zokuba kuleli."Akuziwe etafuleni kuxoxwe uma lezi zinhlangano zikhathazekile. Kodwa nomthetho wezikole iBela, uyavuma ukuthi izingane ezingenazo izimfanelo zokuba kuleli, azifunde. Abanezikhalo abaphawule kwabo ohlelweni oluvuliwe ngaphansi kwalo mthetho ukuthi baphawule ngokwamukelwa kwabafundi ezikoleni." Usho lokhu nje, kunemvunge ezinkundleni zokuxhumana njengoba kunenkulumo ethi uma kuvulwa izikole, izinhlangano ezichitha abokufika ezikhungweni zezempilo kuleli okubalwa i-Operation Dudula nezinye zizogasela ezikoleni ziyokhipha abafundi abazali babo abakuleli ngokungemthetho, ukuze izinsiza ezihlinzekwe abafundi bakuleli ziphelele kubona.Isibe yinkinga enkulu kwezemfundo indaba yabafundi ababizwa ngokuthi ba-undocumented (abanye babo abangenazo izitifiketi zokuzalwa), okwenza kube nzima ukuthi bahlinzekwe ngezidingo.UMnyango wezeMfundo uma uhlinzeka ngothisha ezikoleni, usebenzisa isibalo sabafundi abasuke bekuleso sikole. Kanjalo noma kuhlinzekwa ngezincwadi zokufunda, uhlelo lokudla kanjalo nemali enikwa izikole eyaziwa ngama-norms and standards, kusetshenziswa isibalo sabafundi abasuke bekhona abanezitifiketi zokuzalwa. Othishanhloko bebebekwa amacala uma abahloli befika bethi ngqu ezikoleni befica isibalo sabafundi sisincane kunaleso esibhalwe phansi ngenxa yokuthi kusuke sekufakwe nalabo abangenazo izitifiketi, bese ebekwa icala lokukhwabanisa ngumnyango. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, umnyango ububatshela ukuthi kumele bamukelwe labo abangenazo izitifiketi zokuzalwa.Ngokwe-Bela, othishanhloko kumele babamukele labo abangenazo izitifiketi bese bebasiza bazithole.UDhlomo uthe izikhalazo zalezi zinhlangano ngeke zizitshwe kanjalo wathi sebake bahlangana nazo. Ukhale ngokuthi akukwazi ukuthi abantu bangafunwa omazisi ezikhungweni zezempilo ngoba abanye bakuleli bangagcina kwabona bengasakwazi ukuya kuzona."Uma kwenzeka nje kwehla umshophi kusha imijondolo abantu bashelwe omazisi nezinto zabo, bazongena kanjani ezikhungweni zezempilo beyofuna usizo? Noma kuthiwa abakuleli kusho ukuthi bayogcina bengasalutholi usizo ngoba bengenabo omazisi, beshe emlilweni?" usho kanje.
UKHOMISHANA wamaPhoyisa, uGeneral Fannie Masemola, uthe bazohlangana enkantolo nePhini likaKhomishana, uLieutenant General Shadrack Sibiya, amhlabisa ikhefu. USibiya uyalele uMasemola ukuba ambuyisele esikhundleni, ngale kwalokho bazohlangana enkantolo.Lokhu kuvele encwadini ebhalwe ngabameli bakaSibiya, i-iRan Levit Attorney. Laba bameli bakhale ngokuthi kunemithetho eyinqubomgomo engazange ilandelwe ngaphambi kokuba amiswe uSibiya.Le ncwadi ebhekiswe ngqo kuMasemola ibhalwe ngoLwesithathu. Abameli bakhala ngokuphoqwa kukaSibiya ukuthi ahambise iziphakamiso mayelana nokumiswa sekuvele kwenzekile. "Ikhasimende lethu lisinikeze umqingo obubhalwe ukuthi kunezinhlelo zokuthi limiswe eliveze ukuthi liwuthole ebusuku ligamenxe ihora lesishiyagalombili ngoLwesithathu,” bechaza.Abameli bakaSibiya bathe lawa maphepha kuhloswe ngawo ukuthi kubizwe ikhasimbende labo, eselivele limisiwe emsebenzini ukuthi libhale phansi, lichaze ukuthi kungani kufanele lingamiswa? Abameli basola uMasemola ngokwenza okungekho emthethweni, eqhubeka nohlelo olusha lokummisa emsebenzini. "Iyo kanye le nto yokuhlukumeza esiyiveza esicelweni sethu sokumisa lolu hlelo.” UMasemola okhulume nabezindaba izolo, ngesikhathi kucekelwa phansi izidakamizwa, uthe akathandi ukwanda kakhulu kulolu daba.Uthe bazohlangana enkantolo lapho kuzovela khona konke.USibiya wamiswa emva kokuba uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, amsola ngenkohlakalo nokuvikela izigebengu.
KUGQAME ukushayisana kobufakazi eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini, ngesikhathi kuqhubeka ukuqulwa kwecala lokushaya elibhekene nowayengumsakazi woKhozi FM, uSiyabonga "Siya" Mhlongo. USiya (42) usolwa ngokushaya ngenhloso yokulimaza owayeyisinqandamathe sakhe, uMnuz Njabulo Duma (30) esigamekweni okuthiwa senzeka eThekwini ebusuku, bango-Agasti 31, 2024. Obethula ubufakazi phambi kwenkantolo uDkt Talent Ngcobo wasesibhedlela e-Addington, eThekwini, okuthiwa uyena owahlola uDuma emva kwesigameko.UDkt Ngcobo ngesikhathi ethula ubufakazi bakhe eholwa uMbuso, uveze ukuthi ummangali walinyazwa ngebhodlela. "Wayenezibazi zokulinyazwa esiphongweni, ngezansi kweso elilodwa kanjalo nangezansi kwekhala,” kusho uDkt Ngcobo.Uveze ukuthi kwi-fomu i-J88, egcwaliswa udokotela uma ehlola isiguli esilimele, wagxila ebusweni kuphela ngoba ibona obabulimele."Angigxilanga kwezinye izingxenye zomzimba ngoba zazingalimele,” usho kanje. Ngesikhathi ummeli kaSiya, u-Advocate Simphiwe Mlotshwa, esemphosa ngemibuzo, umbuze ukuthi isiguli samtshela yini ukuthi sishaywe ngempama nangenqindi esifubeni saphinde saklinywa?UDkt Ngcobo uphendule ngokuthi lokho akukaze kwenzeke. "Ngisho ngoba ebufakazini bakhe ummangali ngoJulayi 11, kulo nyaka, waveza ukuthi washo ukuthi ushayiwe esifubeni kodwa wena awuzange umhlole isifuba kodwa wavele wathi uzomnika amaphilisi ezinhlungu,” kusho u-Adv Mlotshwa. UDkt Ngcobo ugcizelele ngokuthi yena akakwazi lokho. Kuphinde kwavela ukuphambana kwesikhathi ummangali ahlolwa ngaso njengoba uDkt Ngcobo ehlawumbisele ku-11 wasebusuku ngosuku lwesigameko, kwathi u-Adv Mlotshwa waveza eyokuthi ngaleso sikhathi ummangali wayengakalinyazwa. UDkt Ngcobo ubuye wakhombisa ukunengwa yimibuzo ka-Adv Mlotshwa, kwaze kwaba nesikhathi lapho abevele azithulele khona, angaphenduli. IJaji uMnuz Mhlonipheni Sibiya, likhumbuze uDkt Ngcobo ukuthi uma ofakazi bethula ubufakazi phambi kwenkantolo, basuke belekelela ekutheni inkantolo ithole ulwazi olufanele ukuze yahlulele ekugcineni.UDkt Ngcobo ubuye waveza nokuthi ngesikhathi ehlola ummangali, yize engabhalanga lutho phansi kodwa wambona ukuthi wayedle amanzi amponjwana.Icala lisongwe u-Adv Mlotshwa eveza ukuthi kunesicelo abafuna ukusifaka, uMbuso waveza ukuthi ngokuxoxisana, bavumelana ngokuthi basifake uma seliphinde lihlala icala enkantolo. USibiya ube eselihlehlisela uSepthemba 9, 2025, icala. USiya uvele enkantolo ezicuphe ngesudi empunga, ihembe elimhlophe, elihambisana nothayi obomvu. Ubehamba nabanye abesifazane ababili, okukholakala ukuthi amalungu omndeni wakhe. USiya owazicelela ukuthi Ukhozi luthi ukummisa kancane emva kokusabalala kwezindaba zesigameko nyakenye, akabange esabuyiselwa emsakazweni ngesikhathi sekwethulwa abasakazi bakulo nyaka, ngo-Ephreli.
USHAYA phansi ngonyawo oyalelwe ukuba axolise kunobhala jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula.UNksz Anele Mda, oyalelwe yinkantolo ukuba axolise ngokusola uMbalula ngokubandakanyeka ecaleni lokubulala, uthe ngeke axolise.UNksz Mda, owayengenele ukhetho lukazwelonke olwedlule ngokuzimela, uyalelwe yiNkantolo eNkulu eGoli ukuba axolise kuMbalula ngokumsola ngokuthinteka ekufeni kukasomabhizinisi, uMnuz Wandile Bozwana. UBozwana, owayengumngani omkhulu kaMbalula, wabulawa ngo-2015."Wena igama lakho liyathinteka ekufeni kukaWandile Bozwana. Awufuni ukuchaza ukuthi kwenzekani ngempela. Wena ufanelwe yijele."Inkantolo ithole ukuthi okubhalwe wuNksz Mda akusilona iqiniso nokuthi kungcolisa igama likaMbalula. UNksz Mda ube eseyalelwa ukuba asuse umbhalo awufaka ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, aphinde axolise engakapheli amahora angu-24.Uthe uzosidlulisela phambili isinqumo senkantolo.Ukusho lokhu esitatimendeni asikhiphe emva kwesinqumo senkantolo. Kwaqala ukubikwa ngale nto eminyakeni eyishumi eyedlule. Kuyakhathazake ukuthi ngoba nakhu mina ngiwumuntu owaziwayo, unquma ukungimangalela enkantolo." Uthe:"Ngikhulumile nabameli bami. Sizosiphonsela inselelo isinqumo senkantolo. Angikungabazi ukuthi enye inkantolo izofike isichithe lesi sinqumo. Kuningi okuzokonakala uma ngingasiphonseli inselelo isinqumo. Kusho ukuthi thina baholi bezepolitiki sizogcina singasakwazi ukukhuluma ngokukhululeka uma ngiyeka ukuphonsela inselelo isinqumo."Lize lashona elayizolo uNksz Mda esamile kwelokuthi ngeke axolise.Ufake umbhalo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ethi ngeke avume ukudlala abanye abantu.
KUWISWE izinkomo ezintathu ngesikhathi iSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini sithelelana amanzi nodadewabo esamhlambalaza uMntwana uNomkhosi kaZwelithini. INdlunkulu kaZulu ibe nenhlambuluko esigodlweni KwaKhangelamankengane, izolo.Umhlangano ubuhanjelwe amakhanda ezindlu zasendlunkulu. Inhlambuluko yenziwe emva kokusabalala kwenkulumo yeSilo lapho khona sasichapha uMntwana uNomkhosi ngenhlamba.Ngasekuqaleni konyaka, kwasabalala inkulumo eqoshiwe, lapho kuzwakala khona iSilo sichapha ngenhlamba uMntwana uNomkhosi.IMbube noMtwana uNomkhosi abasesigodlweni KwaKhangelamankengane, baphuma esibelethweni seNdlovukazi eyayibambe ubukhosi bukaZulu, uShiyiwe Mantfombi Dlamini Zulu. Okhulumela iSilo, UMntwana uThulani Zulu, uthe inkomo yokuqala eyokuxolelana kweSilo noMntwana uNomkhosi."Enye eyokugeza isigodlo kanti enye eyokugeza iNdlovukazi."UMntwana uThulani uthe inhlambuluko ibalulekile ikakhulukazi njengoba isigameko sokuhilizisana kweSilo noMntwana uNomkhosi senzeka ngaphakathi esigodlweni KwaKhangelamankengane. "Thina njengoZulu siyasihlonipha kakhulu isigodlo ngoba siyakholelwa ukuthi umoya weSilo uZwelithini ukhona lapha. Siyakholelwa ukuthi umoya weNdlovukazi ukhona lapha. ISilo siqhamuka kuso lesi sigodlo. Kubalulekile ukuba isigodlo okuqhamuka kuso iSilo sihlanzeke ukuze iSilo sizobusa kahle izwe laso."UMntwana uThulani uthe iSilo sikhombise ukuba yisibonelo esihle ngokuvuma ukuba kube nenhlambuluko."Ngaphambi kokuthi iSilo singene esihlalweni besiwuMntwana nje waseNdlunkulu. Naso besenza izinto njengebanye abantu. Manje sesingaphezu kwayo yonke into. Sesiyaqala ukukhombisa ukuthi sesihlezi esihlalweni esikhulu." IMbube ithe indlunkulu kufanele ibe isibonelo esihle ezweni."Siyikhanda lesizwe sonke. Isizwe sonke ithemba lisibeke kuthina. Abantu bayayibuka yonke into esiyenzayo. Asikwazi ukwenza sengathi asiboni ukuthi abantu bayasibona ngoba lokho kolimaza thina. Yonke into yasendlunkulu kufanele ibe sobala futhi ibe yinhle. Ngiyabonga kakhulu kwabasukumile, bebona ukuthi kufanele kwenziwe ubulungiswa."IMbube ithe inethemba lokuthi uMdlokombane neNdlovukazi esiyizayalo bayijabulele inhlambuluko."Ngiyethemba ukuthi amathambo abo ayanyakaza njengoba sihlangene ngale ndlela lapha. Sihlanganele ubulungiswa, ukuya phambili nokwakha lo muzi."
SEHLISE amaphaphu iSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini, ngesakhiwo sezintombi sezigidi zamarandi esakhiwe esigodlweni eNyokeni, esithe ngeke sisale singasetshenziswa njengoba uMkhosi woMhlanga usuthuthele esigodlweni esisha eMashobeni.IMbube ithe lesi sakhiwo sika-R154 million esisanda kuphothulwa eNyokeni, sizosetshenziselwa ukwenza eminye imicimbi.Sikusho lokhu ngesikhathi sikhuluma nabaNtwana basendlunkulu esigodlweni, KwaKhangelamankengane, izolo. Inhloso yesakhiwo esisha ukonga imali esetshenziswa ukuqashela izintombi amatende uma kunoMkhosi woMhlanga. Isakhiwo sinendawo ekwazi ukuhlala abantu abangu-2 000, izindawo zokushintsha, amahhovisi nendawo yokupaka izimoto.Isinqumo seSilo sokuthutha uMkhosi woMhlanga sishiye abaningi benemibuzo ngekusasa lalesi sakhiwo.ISilo sithe isakhiwo esisha sizoqhubeka sisebenze uma kuneminye imicimbi yasendlunkulu. Baningi abantu abasazofika befisa ukukhangisa amabhizinisi abo. Singakwazi ukwenza imibukiso kulesi sakhiwo."Uthe: "Kuzokuba nemali engeke ize kuMisuzulu kodwa ezongena esikhwameni sendlunkulu. Ngoba lokho kumele sikuhlukanise nina beNdlovu. Angithandi ukufaka isandla sami ezintweni zendlunkulu. Kufana nalezi zinto zamafa kaMdlokombane. Kangingeni ngoba akusikhona okwami, okukaMdlokombane nomndeni wakhe ngokwesihlalo. Lesi sakhiwo esendlunkulu, singesenu boNdaba. Okufanele sikubonge ukuthi lesi sakhiwo sisihlanganisa sonke."IMbube ithe labo abakhalazayo baqhamuka kobunye ubukhosi obumonazela ubukhosi bukaZulu ngokuthi bakhelwe isakhiwo esingaka uhulumeni. Iminwe ayilingani boNdaba, uNkulunkulu wakwenza ngamasibomu lokho. Baningi ke abathi uNkulunkulu wenza into engalungile, kwakufanele yonke iminwe ilingane."Khonamanjalo: Okhulumela iSilo, uMntwana uThulani Zulu, ubuye wachitha imibiko yokuthi iSilo sifuna abantu basinikelele ngo-R10. UTHUMELE umyalezo oshubile uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa, uGeneral Fannie Masemola, ukuthi bazoqhubeka nokulwa nezidakamizwa ezibulala isizwe.UMasemola ukusho lokhu izolo, kucekelwa phansi izidakamizwa ezibalelwa ku-R420 million izolo, eGoli.Uthe lezi zidakamizwa zashaqwa ezindaweni ezehlukene okubalwa nesikhumulo sezindiza i-OR Tambo eGauteng, kanjalo naKwaZulu-Natal. "Eminyakeni emithathu edlule sesicekele phansi izidakamizwa ezibalelwa ku-R5.3 billion. Siyalwa nezidakamizwa ezicekela phansi isizwe," usho kanje.Uthumele umyalezo oshubile wokuthi bazolwa nezindawo eziyisizinda sezidakamizwa.Ubale isifundazwe iGauteng ukuthi siyisizinda sezidakamizwa. Uveze ukuthi nakwezinye izifundazwe okubalwa iKZN ne-Western Cape, izidakamizwa ziyangena echwebeni.Phakathi kwezidakamizwa ezicekelwe phansi kubalwa i-cocaine, mandrax, heroin, neminye imithi engabhalisiwe.I-mandrax ecekelwe phansi ibiza u-R285 million, eyashaqwa eMandeni ngo-2022. I-cocaine ecekelwe phansi ingabiza u-R6 million kanti yashaqwa e-OR Tambo phakathi kuka-2016 no-2022.Kucekelwe phansi nezinto zokwenza i-mandrax ezingabiza u-R50 million, ezabanjwa elolini elaliza eGoli.

ZIPHUMELE obala ezinye zezinyunyana zabasebenzi zagxeka inkulumo kaKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, lapho abezisola khona ngokuba yimbangela yokuncishiswa kwesibalo sabasebenzi bahulumeni. UMkhwanazi ukhulume la mazwi emhlanganweni wokulwa nobugebengu esifundazweni obubandakanya izinhlaka ezehlukene eLangeni Hotel, kuleli sonto.Usole abezinyunyana ngokuthi ukufuna ngodli amaholo amakhulu, wabuza ukuthi yini engcono phakathi kokuthi umuntu angasebenzi nhlobo kunokuthi asebenze bese ehola umholo oyisilinganiso sokuphila? ICongress of South African Trade Unions (Cosatu) ekhasini layo lika-X ithe: "Sikhathazeke kakhulu futhi siphoxekile ngenkulumo kaMkhwanazi asanda kuyenza kulo mhlangano, lapho esola khona izinyunyana ngokuncishiswa kwesibalo sokuqashwa kwezisebenzi zikahulumeni.”UNobhala Jikelele weSouth African Federation of Trade Unions (Saftu) uMnuz Zwelinzima Vavi, uthe bayaphikisa nokushiwo uMkhwanazi ukuthi ukufuna imiholo ephezulu kwezinyunyana kunqanda imizamo yokuthi kugcwaliswe izikhala ezisemaphoyiseni. "Le nkulumo ihlanekezela ulwazi lokuqondisisa ukuthi inkinga inkulu kakhulu imayelana nokuncishiswa kwesabelomali (seminyango ehlukene kahulumeni), okudale umonakalo emaphoyiseni, kubeka engcupheni ezokuphepha zakuleli,” kusho uVavi. Uthe into eyinkinga ukuncishiswa kwesabelomali, hhayi isiphakamiso sokunyuswa kwemiholo. Uze wenza isibonelo sokuthi isabelomali seminyango kahulumeni sango-2024 sasingu-R125 billion kodwa esakulo nyaka sehliswe ngo-9%, saba u-R113,6 billion.Uthe inkinga yangempela eNingizimu Afrika ukuthi ngokwemibiko yango-2023, iphoyisa elilodwa libheka abantu abangu-423, wathi eminye imibiko eyenziwe onyakeni wezimali u-2024/25, kuvela ukuthi iphoyisa ngalinye libhekana nabantu abangu-427. "Ngokwemigomo ye-United Nations (UN), iphoyisa elilodwa kufanele libhekane nabantu abangu 220 kuphela. Izwe lethu alikwazi ukuhlala linesibalo esicishe sibe u-50% waleso esidingekayo ngokwemigomo yamazwe, siphinde singabi nezinsizakusebenza,” kusho uVavi. Uthe beyiSaftu bamile ekutheni awaxhaswe amaphoyisa ngakho konke akudingayo kodwa futhi nabo ngeke bayeke ukulwela ukuthi izisebenzi zithole imiholo efanele.IFederation of Unions of South Africa (Fedusa) esitatimendeni esithumelele abezindaba, ithe uphambuke kakhulu uMkhwanazi ngenkulumo yakhe."Inhlekelele yesibalo esiphezulu sabangasebenzi, ayibangwa yizisebenzi ezilwela amaholo angcono."
UZWAKALISE ukungayizwa kahle eyesigwebo seminyaka ewu-15, esingahle sinikwe ummangalelwa uma elahlwa yicala, umndeni wowesifazane owabulawa yisoka ngesihluku.Lokhu kuza emva kokuvela kukammangalelwa, uMnuz Mduduzi Masuku (32) eNkantolo yesiFunda saseMbumbulu, ngaleli cala.UMasuku ubekwe icala lokubulala kulandela isigameko sokugenca ngesihluku uNksz Bongekile "Mabongi" Mkhize (32), emzini wakhe oseMangamazini Reserve, eFolweni, ngoJanuwari 5, kulo nyaka. Evela okokuqala izolo kule nkantolo, icala eselidluliselwe kuyo, imantshi uNkk Maboe imtshele ukuthi ubhekene necala lokubulala, yase imchazela amalungelo akhe.Emva kwalokho, ube esemchazela ukuthi mingaki iminyaka angayibhadla ejele uma kwenzeka limlahla icala."Uma likulahla, kuvela ukuthi uyaqala ukwenza icala, ngalokho ungagwetshwa iminyaka ewu-15. Uma kuvela ukuthi akhona amanye amacala oke waba nawo phambilini, ungagwentshwa kusuka eminyakeni ewu-20 kuya kwewu-25,” kusho uNkk Maboe. Yile nkulumo engehlanga kahle kwabomndeni kamufi. Unina, uNkk Thembisile Mkhize, ehlengezela izinyembezi ngaphandle kwenkantolo, uthe akayizwa eyeminyaka ewu-15 uma ecabanga isihluku ummangalelwa asisebenzisa ngesikhathi ebulala indodakazi yakhe."Ngathi ayibulala kabuhlungu kangaka ingane yami, iminyaka ewu-15 mincane kakhulu,” kusho uNkk Mkhize. Esinye isihlobo size sananela ngokuthi uma engagcina ethola iminyaka ewu-15 ngempela, lokho ngabe kuchaza ukuthi uzohlala iminyaka engaphezudlwana kweyisikhombisa kuphela ejele okuyinto abayibona njengokushaywa ngoswazi oluncane.Ngaphakathi enkantolo, uMasuku obezicuphe ngesikibha esimnyama nebhulukwe elisamfaniswano wamasosha kodwa elimnyama, ucele ummeli kahulumeni, oveze ukuthi angahle afune ukufaka isicelo sebheyili. Umshushisi woMbuso, uMnuz Govender, ube esecela ukuthi icala lihlehliselwe uSepthemba 3, kulo nyaka, ukuze uMbuso unikezele ngezitatimende kummeli kaMasuku omusha. "Icala lihlehliselwa uSepthemba 3, ukuze ummeli wakho anikezwe izitatimende,” kubeka uNkk Maboe.Umndeni kamufi ubuye wanengwa nawukuthi ummangalelwa ubeshaye ne-cut ekhanda, bebuzana ukuthi ubani omgunda kahle kanje ngaphakathi ejele?Ngosuku lwesigameko umufi wahlaselwa ummangalelwa, owayemcuthele egcekeni ebuya ukuyozijabulisa nabangani endaweni yobumnandi eseMlaza. Ngokusho komndeni kamufi, ummangalelwa wayeqale ngezikhathi zasemini ukuthumela umufi imiyalezo emsongelayo. Umndeni waveza ukuthi wamhlasela emva kokuthi ehle emotweni yakhe (umufi) ayehamba ngayo nabangani. Wamgenca ngobhushu ephindelela, ngisho eselele phansi.Kuthiwa ngaphakathi endlini kwakukhona izingane zikamufi nowesifazane osizayo, abezwa wonke umsindo, umufi ezikhalela, ummangalelwa emhlasela. Nokho, ngokomthombo ongaphakathi esiteshini samaphoyisa, ummangalelwa, owavele wayozinikela emaphoyiseni emva kokwenza isigameko, wawatshela ukuthi wamhlasela ehamba nesoka elisha. Kuthiwa waphinde waveza ukuthi wayedinwa ukuthi like lamshayela, limthuka ngokuthi unesoseji elincane, okuyinto eyamdina njengoba kuthiwa ngesikhathi emgenca ngobhushu wayembuza ukuthi lisazelaphi isitho sakhe sangasese. Umndeni kamufi wazichitha zonke lezi zinsolo, wathi zingamapunge. Evela okokuqala eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMbumbulu, ummangalelwa wake wezwakalisa eyokuthi yena akamdingi ummeli ngoba vele uzolivuma icala. Yize ayesho kanje, imantshi yambonisa ngokuthi amthole ummeli kahulumeni ngoba kukhona amanye amatemu asenkantolo okuzoba nzima ukuthi awaqonde.
