Isitatimende esikhishwe yisikhungo sithe umufi uzibulele ngenxa yezizathu ezingahlangene nezinkinga ezibhekene nezinye izitshudeni zokuphucwa uxhaso yisikhwama esixhasa ngemali yokufunda iNSFAS.Siveze ukuthi uMadela obenza unyaka wesithathu kwiBHSc Diagnostic Radiography, ubezimisele futhi ewenza kahle nomsebenzini wakhe wesikole. Siqhube sathi ubexhaswe yiNSFAS engekho ohlwini lwabaphucwe uxhaso. "Sidlulisa ukudabuka ngokudlula emhlabeni kukaMadela. Kumiswe ukufunda ukuze kuhlonishwe ukushona kwakhe."Sithe ukufunda kuzoqhubeka namhlanje njengokujwayelekile. "Inkonzo yesikhumbuzo izobanjwa ngokubonisana nomndeni wakhe, esikhathini esifanele. Sizobazisa bonke abasenyuvesi ngalokhu."I-NSFAS ikhiphe isitatimende izwakalisa ukudabuka ngokushona kukaMadela.Ithe uMadela ubexhaswe ngokugcwele yilesi sikhwama."Siyazi isikhathi esinzima kuwonke wonke okubalwa umndeni wakhe, abangani nezihlobo. Sizimisele ukweseka umndeni nenyuvesi ngalesi sikhathi esinzima."
KUNGQONGQISWE inkantolo yenkosi emva kwembibizane etholwe yinkosi yaseMdletsheni, uZolani Siphesihle Mdletshe, esale kanjalo emva kokuba uhulumeni uvume ukuqokwa kukaMakabongwe Simangaliso Mdletshe, njengenkosi ekubeni ihlezi esihlalweni.Abanganelisekile basola uhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal ngokuphehla udweshu, emva kokuba uvume ukuqokwa kukaMakabongwe ukuba athathe isihlalo obese kuhlale kuso uZolani kusukela ngo-2021.UMakabongwe uzalwa owayeyibambabukhosi, uBonga Mdletshe, uZolani yena ungumzukulu wenkosi ewumfowabo kaBonga, uSipho Mdletshe. UBonga, owabamba ubukhosi kusukela ngo-1982, wayeyilungu le-IFP esiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal, kanti kuthiwa wayebambele indodana kaSipho eyayisencane ngokweminyaka ngesikhathi kukhothama uyise, uDlozilabadletshe.UDlozilabadletshe ozala uZolani, akazange abuthathe ubukhosi ngenxa yokuthi wake waboshwa. Ngo-2021, owayenguMphathiswa wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu ngaleso sikhathi, uMnuz Sihle Zikalala, wabhala incwadi echitha uBonga njengebambabukhosi, wabe esevuma ukuqokwa kukaZolani njengenkosi.UZolani ubelokhu ehlezi esihlalweni eyithola yonke nemihlomulo yakhe kuhulumeni njengoba egcine ukuhola ngenyanga eyedlule.Kuleli sonto kushintshile ukudla epuletini ngesikhathi uMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu, wazisa umndeni nomkhandlu wenkosi ngokuqokwa kwenkosi entsha emhlanganweni obusenkantolo yenkosi. UNdunankulu wesizwe, uMnuz Wiber Mdletshe, usole uMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana kanye neziNdaba zoMdabu ngokuba budedengu.UWiber uthe uMnyango awuzange ulusingathe ngobunono lolu daba."Angifuni ukungena ekutheni ubani ofanelwe isihlalo kodwa engakhala ngakho yindlela abenze ngayo. Le nto abayenzayo iqhatha izingane zenkosi, ifana nokuthi babeka enye inkosi phezu kwenye inkosi. Bona aboMnyango bekufanele babhalele uZolani, bamazise ukuthi uyakhishwa esihlalweni." Uthe: "Bebezothini ukube bekusuka udlame emhlanganweni? Bebezothini ukuba bekushayana abantu khona emhlanganweni? Ngizitshelile izikhulu zomnyango ukuthi kofanele kusolwe zona uma kuke kwachitheka igazi lapha eMdletsheni. Siphoxwa uhulumeni siwethemba."UWiber uthe isimo simazonzo njengoba sekushiswe inkantolo yenkosi."Inkulu imvunge, abantu kabajabule impela. Emva komhlangano kwashiswa inkantolo yenkosi." Nakuba engazange anabe, uWiber usole inhlese yezepolitiki ngokukhishwa kukaZolani esikhundleni."Uhulumeni bawuphethe ngokobuqembu. Ayilungile le nto abayenzayo. Uhulumeni akufanele usebenze ngokobuqembu."Okhulumela uhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Bongani Gina, uthe uhulumeni wesifundazwe uvume ukuqokwa kukaMakabongwe, emva kokuba igama lakhe liphakanyiswe ngumndeni ukuba angene esihlalweni. "Ngokwazi kwethu, umndeni waba nomhlangano ngoSepthemba 8, wangonyaka owedlule, lapho waphakamisa ukuba uMakabongwe angene esihlalweni. Umndeni wanquma ukuthi uMakabongwe aqale enze umsebenzi wakhe. IKhabhinethi yaKwaZulu-Natal yabe seyivuma ukuqokwa kukaMakabongwe emhlanganweni owawungo-Agasti 6."Okhulumela uMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana kanye neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Senzelwe Mzila, akazange ayiphendule imibuzo abuzwe yona.
Inkampani ekhiqiza ukudla iTiger Brands inxusa amakhasimende kuthi abuyisele ezitolo umkhiqizo wabo wokunonga ukudla i-Benny Beef Flavored Stock Cubes kanye ne-Benny Chicken Flavored Stock Cubes, ekhiqizwe i-Culinary Division, ngenxa yokulebula okungalungile kokudla okunempilo ephaketheni.Le nkampani ibalula izinga likasawoti eleqile kweminye yemikhiqizo kanti ithatha lesi sinyathelo kulandela ukuxhumana kayo nekhomishini kazwelonke yabathengi. Nakuba ingakazitholi izikhalo zabathengi mayelana nemikhiqizo ethintekile. Lesi sinqumo sihambisana nokuzibophezela kwaso emazingeni aphezulu kakhulu futhi esizuzisa abathengi baso. I-Tiger Brands isebenza namakhasimende ayo ezitolo nezitolo ezinkulu ukuze isuse yonke imikhiqizo ethintekile ye-Benny Flavored Stock Cube emashalofini esitolo. Lokhu akufaki eminye imikhiqizo emakethe adayiswa ngaphansi kohlobo lwe-Benny.Imikhiqizo eyingxenye yalokhu ihlanganisa osayizi bephakethe le-cube engu-12, 24 kanye no-48 be-Benny Flavored Stock Cubes ku-Beef kanye ne-Chicken flavour anezinsuku zokuphelelwa yisikhathi ezibhalwe umhla ka-31 kuJulayi 2027 nanoma yiluphi usuku lwangaphambilini.
ISILO uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini sizokhumelana umlotha nodadewabo esambiza ngaphansi kweziketi, uMntwana uNomkhosi kaZwelithini. INdlunkulu kaZulu ibize umhlangano lapho iMbube izothelelana amanzi noMntwana uNomkhosi. Umhlangano ozokuba namhlanje umenyezelwe okhulumela iSilo, uMntwana uThulani Zulu. Kwashaqeka abaningi ngasekuqaleni kwalo nyaka ngesikhathi kusabalala inkulumo eqoshiwe, lapho kuzwakala khona iSilo sichapha uMntwana uNomkhosi. IMbube noMntwana uNomkhosi abasesigodlweni kwaKhangelamankengane, baphuma esibelethweni seNdlovukazi eyayibambe ubukhosi bukaZulu, uShiyiwe Mantfombi Dlamini Zulu. Enkulumeni eyasabalala ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, kwakuzwakala uMntwana uNomkhosi elokhu ebabaze njalo ukuthi iMbube imthuka ngeNdlovukazi ebazalayo.Kule nkulumo kwaphinde kwangena negama likasomabhizinisi oganwe eNdlunkulu, uMnuz Moses Tembe. UTembe uganwe wuMntwana uNtandoyesizwe kaZwelithini, naye ozalwa yiNdlovukazi uShiyiwe. Nakuba kungacaci ukuthi igama likaTembe langena kanjani engxabanweni, kodwa kwakulokhu kuzwakala iMbube ithi 'umtshele uTembe ukuthi ngizomthola'.UMntwana uThulani uthe sabashaqisa kakhulu lesi sigameko. "Ezinyangeni ezimbalwa ezedlule kube nesimo esingesihle ngaphakathi esigodlweni kwaKhangelamankengane. Umphumela walesi simo kwaba wukuphendulana ngamazwi angemahle ikakhulukazi ezinkundleni zokuxhumana kwaze kwachaphazeleka nomkhwenyana waseNdlunkulu."Emva kokusabalala kwenkulumo kwabizwa umhlangano waseNdlunkulu lapho kwabhungwa khona ngalolu daba.Namazinyane akwaKhangelamankengane akhipha isitatimende agxeka ukusebenzisa kweSilo ulimi oluqosheme. UMntwana uThulani uthe iNdlunkulu ibilokhu imatasa izama ukulungisa lolu daba, wathi sebefisa ukuba kube nemhlambuluko ukuze lufinyelele emaphethelweni.."Emuva kokuhlala kweNdlunkulu ilungisa lolu daba izigaba ngezigaba, isifinyelele ekutheni ngoLwesine (namhlanje) kudlulwe esigabeni senhlambuluko ukuze kuvalwe leli khasi elingabanga lihle eNdlunkulu nasesizweni. Amakhanda ezindlu, abaNtwana baseNdlunkulu neNdlunkulu bayamenywa ukuba babe yingxenye yalo mhlangano."
ngoLwesithathu iNkantolo yesiFunda yaseThekwini igwebe uNdabezinhle Mvune (29), Simiso Mthimkhulu (47) noThamsanqa Msabala (29) iminyaka engu-10 bebhadla ejele ngecala lokuzama ukubulala iphoyisa lingekho emsebenzini. Ngomhla ka-29 ku-Agasti 2021, uCaptain Gysbert Johannes Grotius wayehamba emgwaqeni u-Cato Crest, eManzimtoti ngesikhathi ebona itekisi eyayisolisa inabantu abathathu. Wasondela etekisini ngenhloso yokubuza ukuthi kukhona yini abakudingayo. Ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabo kube nengxabano kwathi omunye umsolwa washaya uKaputeni Grotius ngekani likabhiya. Wayicosha uKaputeni wayijikijela etekisini.Abasolwa abathathu behla bamshaya kanzima. Omunye wabasolwa usebenzise insimbi ukushaya uKaputeni ngesihluku. Ngenxa yalokhu ukulimala okubi okuhlanganisa ukuphuka ugebhezi, ukopha ebuchosheni, iminwe ephukile kanye nezibazi eziningi ebusweni nasemzimbeni. Umkakhe wayekhona kwenzeka lokhu, wamphuthumisa esibhedlela sendawo ukuze athole usizo lwezempilo. UKaputeni Grotius wadluliselwa kwesinye isibhedlela ukuze ayohlinzwa ubuchopho. Ngenxa yobunzima bokulimala kwakhe uKaputeni Grotius okodokotela banquma ukuthi athathe umhlalaphansi wokugula njengoba esebenza ophikweni lwe-Air Wing. Ngo-Ephreli 2022, uMvune, Mthimkhulu noMsabala baboshwa ngamalungu oKlebe ophiko lwe-Durban Serious Organised Crime Investigation. Babekwe amacala bevela eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini izikhathi eziningi laze labagojela ngomhla ka-29 Meyi 2025. Laba bobathathu kuthiwa abakulungele ukuba nezibhamu.
Kwande imibuzo ngokuhleleka kwemboni yezimoto ezisebenza ngokukhokhelwa ngebanga inkampani iphika owabulawa ngeledlule.Umndeni kaMnuz Siyanda Mthokozisi Mvelase (27) obengumshayeli wemoto ekhokhelwa ngebanga owadutshulwa washiswa eMaponya Mall ngeledlule, uthi usashaqekile ngemuva kokuthi inkampani i-Uber ithe ayinalo irekhodi lokuthi ubesebenza njengomshayeli wayo.Esitatimendeni, i-Uber ithe ibuhlungu kakhulu ngalesi sigameko kodwa iyaqinisekisa ukuthi abashayeli abathintekayo bebengabhalisiwe ezinkundleni zabo zokusebenza."Siphatheke kabi kakhulu ngokwenzekile - lesi sigameko sinzima kakhulu, futhi imicabango yethu ikubo bonke abathintekile ngalesi sikhathi esinzima ngendlela emangalisayo," kusho u-Uber."Nakuba abashayeli abathintekile sekuqinisekisiwe ukuthi ababhalisiwe epulatifomu ye-Uber, ukuphepha kwawo wonke umshayeli nomgibeli osebenzisa noma iyiphi isevisi kufanele kube yinto ehamba phambili, futhi kuyinto esiyibheka njengento ebalulekile kwa-Uber.” Le nkampani ithe, ngosuku lwesigameko, bathumela ithimba labo Lezokuxhumana Nokuphepha Komphakathi - elakhiwe ngochwepheshe abanolwazi lokugcinwa komthetho- ukuthi lisebenze neziphathimandla futhi linikeze ukwesekwa kophenyo. Le nkampani ithe iphinde yafinyelela kwabomthetho ukuze banikeze usizo lwayo olugcwele."Simise okwesikhashana isevisi endaweni ethintekile kwaze kwaba yilapho sesiqiniseka ukuthi abashayeli nabagibeli epulatifomu ye-Uber bangahamba ngokuphepha." "Sizibophezele ekusebenzisaneni eduze nababambe iqhaza embonini, iziphathimandla, kanye nomphakathi obanzi ukusiza ukwenza imboni iphephe kubo bonke abashayeli nabagibeli," kwengeza.

Saqhubeka saya naseGrace, nakhona sangamthola,'' usho kanje.Uthe bathathe isinqumo sokuthi bambheke nasemakhazeni.''Sigcine sesimthola amakhazeni kahulumeni akhona eMgungundlovu, ngoLwesihlanu odlule.'' Kusixakile kakhulu lokho ngoba sasikade siqale khona kulesi sibhedlela kodwa sangamthola,'' usho kanje. Uqhube wathi banemibuzo eminingi ngokufa kukamfowabo, waveza ukuthi umzimba wonke kuyabonakala ukuthi waqala washaywa ngaphambi kokuba abulawe.''Siyazibuza siyaziphendula nje ukuthi ubani ongenza into enesihluku esinjena kumfowethu. Lona ngumuntu obenokuthula engazwani nokukhuluma futhi ebathanda abantu, yingakho sididekile ngokuthi ubani lona owenze into enjengalena kuyena.''Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal,uLieutenant Colonel Paul Magwaza, ukuqinisekisile ukubulawa kukamufi.Uthe amaphoyisa asePrestbury, eMgungundlovu, aphenya icala ngokubulawa kowesilisa. "Kusolakala ukuthi lo wesilisa wahlaselwa ngabathile bamlimaza, wagcina ngokushona."
BESEZIHLALISE lubhojozi ngisho unina nodadewabo izelamani zasesigodini sakwaGubhuza, eMzumbe, ezisolwa ngokubulala ugogo wazo uNkk Rose Mncibi nomalume wazo uMnuz Sbonelo Mncibi, abatholwe begqitshiwe beboshwe nezandla ngoLwesihlanu owedlule.Unina wezelamani ongeke avezwe, ubhoboke wathi bese ethuthile washiya umuzi wakhe ngoba ezisabisa okwenyoka lezi zelamani ngenxa yokuthi bezihlala zimsabisa ngokumbulala.Owesifazane ubekhuluma no-Ayanda Msweli oye lapho ebhace khona ngemuva kokuboshwa kwamadodana akhe. Uthi lesi sigameko simqhathe nomndeni wakhe ngendlela angakwazi ukuyichaza ngoba akazi ukuthi uzobabhekelwa wubani."Yizingane zami lezi, lona omdala uneminyaka engu-24, omncane angazi noma ingu-20. Izingane lezi zibulale izihlobo zazo njengoba mina ngiyindodakazi yakwaMncibi. Nami bese ngishiyile emzini wami nezinye izingane zakwabo ngoba sibona singaphephile. Angazi ukuthi konakalephi ngenxa yokuthi ekuqaleni besihleli kahle. Bebeze bangiphekele bekhuthele nasekhaya. Kwathi sebeqala ukushintsha udadewabo wangitshela ukuthi yena uyahamba ekhaya ngoba ebona ukuthi bayingozi,” kusho owesifazane.Uthe lona omdala ubehlala emtshela ukuthi uzombulala. "Ubengenawo umazisi, besengizame kaningi ukumshayela kodwa kube nezinkinga. Beqala lo mkhuba wokuhlasela abantu bashaya omunye umfana khona endaweni wabavulela icala, bebehlala befunwa amaphoyisa kodwa engabafici. Kukhona la engake ngathi asiye edolobheni ngiyomenzela umazisi, wathi ngifuna ukumnikela emaphoyiseni, wangitshela kwezikabhoqo ukuthi uzongibulala. Yila engathatha khona isinqumo sokuhamba,” kusho yena.Uthe ngisho abazukulu bakhe bebengasalubhadi esikoleni ngenxa yokubona bengaphephile kulaba bafana."Izingane sathi aziyeke isikole ngoba sisaba ukuthi uma behlangana nazo bazoziqhuba bazilethe lapho esesihlala khona. Ngisho ukuya edolobheni kunzima ngoba sisaba ukuthi bazosibona, sihlala ngokukhiya umuzi siphume ngoba siya ethoyilethi kuphela. Kumanje ngizwa kuthiwa kukhona umgodi omkhulu ombiwe ekhaya lapho besihlala khona, esingawazi ukuthi ngowani. Kungenzeka ukuthi bekuzogqitshwa mina nezingane zami uma kwenzeka sibuya. Ngeke ngazi ukuthi yini ebenze bathatha isinqumo sokwenza abakwenzile,” kuchaza yena. Uthe akufisayo manje wukuthi akhelwe umuzi omusha ngoba ngeke esakwazi ukubuyela emzini wakhe omdala ngenxa yokwesaba.Uveze ukuthi lapho ehlala khona manje yindlu yomxhaso, angayithandisisi kahle ngoba bese ejwayele ukuhlala emzini omkhulu.Iphoyisa elingagunyaziwe ukukhuluma nabezindaba, liveze ukuthi umsolwa owaboshwa kuqala ngeSonto, uMnuz Sphamandla Mncibi (21), uvelile enkantolo yaseHighflats ngecala lokubulala nokutshontsha impahla, icala lakhe lahlehla.Umsolwa wesibili kulindeleke ukuthi avele namhlanje enkantolo yaKwaPhungashe, eSt Faiths ngamacala afanayo.Umngcwabo kulindeleke ukuthi ube ngempelasonto.
UMHLAZIYI wezepolitiki useveze ukuthi ukugxeka kwe-ANC esidlangalaleni amalungu ayo esigungu esiphezulu, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, noDkt Malusi Gigaba, kuyamene nombango wezikhundla wokuhola le nhlangano oqhubeka umshosha phansi.Umhlaziyi waseNyuvesi yaKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Zakhele Ndlovu, uthe isitatimende esigxeka uMchunu noGigaba, esikhishwe yiHhovisi likaNobhala Jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, sikhombisa ngokusobala ukuthi usuqalile umbango wezikhundla.I-ANC izokuba nengqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi obusha ngo-2027. UMbalula, Mchunu noGigaba kulindeleke ukuthi bangenele umbango wezikhundla kule ngqungquthela.UMchunu noGigaba basanda kuziqhatha nolaka lweHhovisi likaMbalula, emva kokuba benze izinkulumo ezigxeka inhlangano.UMchunu uzithintele iziqandu ngokuthi i-ANC isengozini yokulahlekelwa amandla okhethweni lomasipala, wayifanisa nomuntu ohamba onqenqemeni lwewa. UGigaba yena uzibangele amazinyo abushelelezi ngokuthi agxeke ukufakwa kwe-DA kuhulumeni wokubambisana nangokuphakamisa ukuba kumiswe ingxoxo kazwelonke.I-ANC ikhiphe isitatimende lapho isole khona uMchunu noGigaba ngokwakha isithombe sokuthi kunoqhekeko enhlanganweni nokuthi inhlangano iyashabalala. "I-ANC izothatha izinyathelo ezifanele ukulungisa lokhu kuziphatha ngoba alikho ilungu lenhlangano okumele ligudluke emigomweni yokuziphatha," kusho isitatimende esikhishwe i-ANC ngoMsombuluko ebusuku. UNdlovu uthe uMbalula uzama ngayo yonke indlela ukuphebeza labo abangase baphazamise umkhankaso wokuqokelwa esikhundleni esiphezulu."Ngiyazi ukuthi uma ubabuza manje abaholi be-ANC, bazokutshela ukuthi awukaqali umkhankaso wezikhundla. Siyazi ukuthi umbango wezikhundla uqala kusasele iminyaka emibili kufike ingqungquthela."UNdlovu uthe uMbalula angaziqhatha namalungu e-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, ngokugxeka abaholi abaqhamuka kulesi sifundazwe. "Izomlimaza le nto ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ikakhulukazi uma sekubhekwe engqungqutheleni. Ingaba khona imibuzo yokuthi kungani egxeka bona kuphela? Kubukeka sengathi ugxeka bona ngoba nakhu kwehlela kubona. Kungaba khona ababuzayo ukuthi kungani engabagxeki abanye abaholi be-ANC abahlezi besematheni ngezindaba ezingezinhle?"UNdlovu uthe ubheke ukuthi ushise kakhulu umbango wokuhola i-ANC engqungqutheleni elandelayo ngenxa yokuthi baningi abazofuna ukuthola ithuba lokuhola le nhlangano ngaphambi kokuthi iphume ngokugcwele emandleni."Njengamanje akusafani nakuqala lapho wawazi khona ukuthi umengameli we-ANC uyena ozokuba umengameli wezwe. Empeleni babanga ithambo elingenanyama."
IDurban University of Technology (DUT) ikhiphe imininingwane yesitshudeni esiziphuce impilo ngoLwesibili emini kuvela amahlebezi wokuthi sizibulele ngenxe yezinkinga zoxhaso lwezemmfundo.Lesi sitshudeni kuthiwa nguSphiwokuhle Madela ongasekho, ubenza unyaka wesithathu ohlelweni lwe-BHSc Diagnostic Radiography ngaphakathi kweFaculty of Health Sciences.I-DUT iveze ukuthi iphoxekile ngemibiko engamampunge yokuthi lesi sitshudeni siphucwe uxhaso lweNSFAS."UMadela ubexhaswe yiNSFAS ngokuphelele lokhu kuqinisekiswe efayeleni lokugcina lokukhokha langomhla zi-4 kuNcwaba 2025, lapho abhalwa khona njengomfundi obuyayo kukho kokubili ukufundiswa nokuhlala ngo-2025. Okubalulekile, uMadela ebengeyona ingxenye yefayela le-NSFAS elihlukile (elivame ukubizwa ngokuthi 'ngabafundi abangasaxhasiwe’)."
UMHOLI weRise Mzansi uMnuz Songezo Zibi useveze ukuthi akakholwa wukuthi ukwandisa amaqembu ezepolitiki kuhulumeni wokubambisana kuleli kuzoxazulula izinkinga zokungaboni ngaso linye kula maqembu.UZibi obekhuluma esithangamini nabezindaba izolo eGoli, uthe kudingeka kuqale kuqiniswe imigomo yokusebenzisana kwamaqembu."Hhayi ngoba ngiyichitha eyokuthi kube namanye amaqembu azoba yingxenye kahulumeni wokubambisana kodwa kudingeka kulungiswe imigomo yokusebenzisana. Ukwandisa isibalo samaqembu angikholwa wukuthi kungaxazulula izinselelo zokungaboni ngaso linye kwi-GNU." Usho lokhu nje i-ANC, okuyiyo eyanxenxa amaqembu ahlukene ukuthi abe yingxenye kahulumeni wokubambisana, ithe izimisele ukwandisa isibalo samaqembu azoba yingxenye yalo hulumeni.Angu-10 amaqembu akuhulumeni wokubambisana kanti i-DA eyingxenye yalo hulumeni ayihambisani nokuthi kwengezwe isibalo samaqembu.Amaqembu angeyona ingxenye kahulumeni okubalwa i-EFF, afuna ukungena kuhulumeni kodwa uma kungukuthi i-DA iyaphuma.Uhulumeni wokubambisana usubhekane nezinselelo eziningi okubalwa nokungaboni ngaso linye ngesabelomali sezwe. UZIbi uthe kudingeka kushintshwe isivumelwano esikhona kube khona into okuzovunyelwana ngayo ukuthi ingenziwa.Ukhale ngokuklwebhana phakathi kwe-ANC ne-DA kuhulumeni. "Sizobhalela i-ANC ngodaba lokuthi kudingeka yande imihlangano yabaholi abakwi-GNU ukuze kuxazululwe izinkinga. Le nkundla izosiza ukuthi kulungiswe izinselelo ezikhona." Ubalule nokuthi nakuba beyiqembu elincane ePhalamende kodwa bakwazile ukwenza ukuthi ongqongqoshe bazophendula ngabakwenzayo ngasohlangothini lokusebenza kwemali yomphakathi."Sinemizuzu embalwa yokuthi sikhulume ePhalamende kodwa siyakwazi ukukhuluma ngezinto ezithinta ngqo abantu. Siza neziphakamiso zokusiza ezinkingeni ezibhekene nezwe."Uveze ukuthi bazongenela ukhetho lokuchibiyela oluzoba seThekwini ku-ward 64. Ubalule nokuthi babheka amanye amaqembu abazobambisana nawo njengoba kuyiwa okhethweni lohulumeni basekhaya ngonyaka ozayo.
KUHLEHLE izivivinyo ebhilidini obekuzobhalela kulona izitshudeni izolo eNyuvesi iDurban University of Technology (DUT), eThekwini, esinye sezitshudeni sizithanqaza sisuka esitezi esiphezulu. Isitshudeni okusabalele i-video yaso siziphonsa akucaci ukuthi sizibulalelani.Silobe igama laso lingakadalulwa ngoba bekusaziswa umndeni nezihlobo ngesehlakalo.Kwi-video siziphonsa eqoshwe ezinye izitshudeni, kuzwakala abebememeza bezama ukusikhuza. Isolezwe lihambele kulesi sikhungo lafica kugcwele izitshudeni zithukile, kusathathwa isidumbu sesitshudeni. Ezinye izitshudeni bezikhala, ezinye zidangele ngenxa yento eziyibonile. Omunye wabasondelene nesitshudeni, ongeke avezwe, uthe utshelwe wumufi ukuthi kukhona okungahambi kahle phakathi kwakhe nomunye wesifazane."Noma engachazanga ukuthi kwenzekani, kodwa ungitshelile ukuthi kukhona izinkinga,” kuchaza ozibize ngomngani. Uthe uyathuthumela ngokwenziwe wumngani wakhe, athe ubengakulindele futhi akaze asho ukuthi ngendlela aphatheke kabi ngayo angaze akhethe ukuzibulala.Esinye isitshudeni esithumelele leli phephandaba umyalezo, sithe yimbi into abayibonile abakufunayo wukuthi kuhlehliswe izivivinyo futhi bathole ukwelulekwa ngokomqondo ngenxa yalesi sehlakalo."Sifuna iNyuvesi ihlehlise izivivinyo ezizoqala maduzane, ayilula into esiyibonile ibuhlungu, kakhulu,” kuchaza isitshudeni. Ezinye izitshudeni bezikhiphela ngaphandle ozakwabo kulesi sikhungo zithi abaye lapho behlala khona kungabe kusaqhutshekwa nokufunda nokubhala.UMnuz Alan Khan wakulesi sikhungo, esitatimendeni abasikhiphele abezindaba, uthe njengesikhungo basathukile ngokudlula emhlabeni kwesitshudeni ngokuzuma."Sidlulisa amazwi enduduzo emndenini wakhe, abangani kanye nezitshudeni abefunda nazo. Amaphoyisa ayaphenya ngokuholele kulesi sigameko, igama lakhe lizodalulwa uma sekubikelwe umndeni wakhe. Izitshudeni nabasebenzi bazokwelulekwa ngokomqondo. Sengathi umphefumulo wakhe ungalala ngoxolo,” kusho uKhan.
KULANDWE uqweqwe olunesipiliyoni kwezokuphathwa komasipala, uDkt Michael Sutcliffe, ukuba luzotakula uMasipala waseMsunduzi.UMphathiswa wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, uqoke uSutcliffe ukuba ayolekelela kulo mkhandlu okhungethwe yizinkinga.USutcliffe owayeyimenenja kuMasipala waseThekwini, wethulwe ngokusemthethweni, izolo. UMasipala waseMsunduzi ukhungethwe yizinkinga okubalwa kuzo ukungcola kwedolobha, inkinga yamanzi nogesi. Ukungcola kwedolobha kwenze ukuthi izitolo ezinkulu zithuthe enkabeni yedolobha eMgungundlovu. UButhelezi uthe uqoke uSutcliffe ngokulandela isigaba u-154 somthetho, esimgunyaza ukuba aqoke umeluleki uma ebona izimpawu zokuthi umasipala awusebenzi ngendlela. Uthe uqoke uSutcliffe emva kwesikhathi eside kunezikhalazo ngokufadabala kwengqalasizinda yomkhandlu nokubaleka kwamabhizinisi enkabeni yedolobha."Umsebenzi wakhe wokuqala ukuba aqhamuke neqhinga lokushintsha isimo somkhandlu. Ngifuna agxile kakhulu ekuhanjisweni kwezidingo, ukuphathwa kahle kwemali nokubuyisa ithemba kosomabhizinisi. Ukujutshwa kukaSutcliffe kuzokwelekelela bonke abantu baseMsunduzi. Nginxusa amakhansela omkhandlu ukuba abambisane naye."UButhelezi uthe uyamethemba uSutcliffe. USutcliffe ubekade ejutshwe ukuba alekelele kuMasipala waseThekwini kulezi zinyanga ezingu-12 ezedlule."Uyancomeka umsebenzi awenzile ngesikhathi ejutshwe eThekwini. Uke waba imenenja kuMasipala waseThekwini isikhathi esingaphezu kweminyaka eyisishagalolunye futhi uke wajutshwa ukuba ayolekelela komasipala abahlukene."IMeya kaMasipala waseMsunduzi, uMnuz Mzimkhulu Thebolla, ithe bayakwamukela ukujutshwa kukaSutcliffe. "Siwumkhandlu ozimisele nohlezi uzibophezela ukuhambisa izinsiza kubantu. Sihlezi sizimisele ukusebenza ngendlela egculisayo. Sihlezi siba nezinselelo njengayo yonke imikhandlu yalapha eNingizimu Afrika. Sikujabulela kakhulu ukwesekwa ezinye izinhlaka zikahulumeni."UThebolla uthe abakungabazi ukuthi uSutcliffe uzobalekelela kakhulu ekulungiseni izinkinga ezikhungethe umkhandlu."Okusijabulisa kakhulu umuntu ojutshiwe umphathiswa, uSutcliffe. Sonke siyamazi ukuthi uyingqalabutho kwezokuphathwa komasipala. Kuningi esikufunda kuyena. Siyazi ukuthi ulwazi analo luzokwenza umehluko. Siyazi ukuthi ukulethwa kwakhe into yesikhashana kodwa sikujabulele kakhulu ukuba khona kwakhe. Sinethemba lokuthi sizohlomula kakhulu. Siyazi ukuthi uzolekelela lapha ukuba siqinisekise ukulandelwa kwemigomo. Siyamamukela futhi sizobambisana naye."
LALISOBISHINI lwezikweletu futhi seliphenduke umlutha wezidakamizwa iphoyisa elingummangalelwa wokuqala ecaleni lokusocongwa kwekhansela le-ANC nabanye abathathu.Abamangalelwa kuleli cala ngoConstable Mayendriam Collin Chetty noConstable Thanduxolo Vincent Phelago. Laba bobabili babekade besebenza bengamaphoyisa esiteshini saseMkhomazi.Bakhalelwa ngamasongo kaSigonyela ngoNovemba 8, besemsebenzini ngemuva kokuba kuphothulwe uphenyo ngokubulawa kwekhansela le-ANC laku-Wadi 99, ePort Shepstone, uMnuz Mnqobi Victor Molefe, esigamekweni okuthiwa senzeka ngoSeptemba 11, 2022, eMvutshini, eMargate. Abanye okusolwa ukuthi babulawa yilawa maphoyisa, nguMnuz Zitha Mqapheli Cele owabulawa ngo-Agasti 22, 2022, esigamekweni okuthiwa senzeka ngaphandle kwasesikoleni Ohlangeni Primary, eGamalakhe.Umufi kubikwa ukuthi wathulela kuyona indawo yesigameko. Omunye okusolwa ukuthi wabulawa nguMnuz Nhlonipho Nzimande esigamekweni okuthiwa senzeka ngo-Agasti 23, eMahlongwa, eMkhomazi.Ngaphambilini, umfowabo kaNzimande watshela inkantolo ukuthi uNzimande nalawa maphoyisa babekade bebanga izidakamizwa. Wakuveza ukuthi uNzimande wayeziphilisa ngokudayisa izidakamizwa. Waphinde waveza nokuthi abamangalelwa bobabili babefika njalo bezothatha izidakamizwa esitolo sikamufi. Ngosuku olufanyo okwabulawa ngalo uNzimande, kusolwa ukuthi badubula babulala uMnuz Pilayelo Sydney Buthelezi eMagabheni. Izolo, iNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini ilalele ubufakazi bukaQiniselani Mabhida, owayekade enguStation Commander waseMkhomazi ngesikhathi kusebenza abasolwa kuso.UMabhida utshele inkantolo ukuthi waba nenkulumo ejulile noChetty okuyilapho agonyuluka khona kuyena ngengwadla yokucwila ezikweletini kanjalo nokuphenduka umlutha wezidakamizwa.''Saba nengxoxo naye wangitshela ukuthi unenkinga yezezimali, wangitshela nokuthi unenkinga yezidakamizwa,'' echazela inkantolo. Eqhuba uMabhida, uthe ngenxa yalokho waphakamisa ukuba uChetty ayiswe esikhungweni samaphoyisa sangaphakathi esibizwa ngokuthi yi-EHW, esinikeza ngosizo emaphoyiseni abhekene nezinkinga ezahlukene.Uveze ukuthi umnyombo wengxoxo yabo isukela ekutheni uChetty wayekade elahle isibhamu sasemsebenzini nezinhlamvu eziwu-25, okwathi uma embuza ngakho wathi akasakhumbuli kahle ukuthi ukubeke kuphi nendawo ekhaya. Kodwa wabuye washaya ungqimphothwe, wathi usinikeze uKuben Chetty."Kwathi uma ngimbuza uKuben Chetty, walandula. Yilapho-ke engaqala khona ukuqaphela ukuthi ikhona inkinga anayo,'' echaza.Njengenjwayelo, bekuthi uma kuqhubeka icala, abamangalelwa bobabili belokhu beqhwebana bahlebelana okuthile. Kulokhu bebengawaphethe amaphepha namapeni. Icala liyaqhubeka.
Amaphoyisa aseWestern Cape aveze ukuthi umsolwa wesibili useboshiwe ngecala lokuhlasela kumalungu ephalamende okwenzweke ePhilippi. Lapha kwahlaselwa amalungu amathathu eDemocratic Alliance (DA) ePhalamende abhekele ukusebenza kwamaphoyisa esigamekweni esinodlame sokuhlasela ePhilippi ngoLwesibili ntambama. USihlalo weKomidi lamaPhoyisa u-Ian Cameron, ekanye nozakwabo uLisa Schickerling no-Nicholas Gotsell, bebehamba eduze kwezimpambano zomgwaqo u-New Eisleben noGovan Mbeki Road ngesikhathi abasolwa abangaziwa bephula amafasitela emoto yabo baqala ukubajikijela ngezitini. UCameron uchaze ukuhlaselwa kwabo "njengokuhlasimulisa umzimba”. "Bajikijela imoto ngezitini, ngakwazi ukushaya oyedwa wabo kodwa wabuya, ngazama ukulwa, ngathi uma ngibheka uNicholas ubegebise ikhanda, ngakhipha isibhamu sami ngadubula, angazi noma ngishaye umuntu na." Abaseshi bobugebengu obunodlame balandele umkhondo ophenyweni lokuhlaselwa kwamalungu amathathu ePhalamende ePhilippi ngoLwesibili ntambama basebenze ubusuku bonke kwathi ezintatha zangoLwesithathu babopha umsolwa wesibili. Umsolwa oneminyaka engu-16 ubudala waboshwa eBrowns Farm usebekwe icala. Umsolwa wokuqala, owesilisa oneminyaka engu-18 ubudala, uboshwe ngoLwesibili ebusuku ngesikhathi efuna usizo lwezempilo esikhungweni esiseLentegeur. Kukholakala ukuthi udutshulwe ngesikhathi behlasela izisulu ezintathu ezingamalungu eDA ePhalamende. Njengamanje ugadwe amaphoyisa esibhedlela. Imibiko yokuqala sobugebengu iveza ukuthi lesi senzo sokuhlasela senziwe abasolwa abathathu besilisa. Uphenyo lusaqhubeka njengoba kulindeleke ukuthi kuboshwe omunye ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Abasolwa babhekene namacala okuzama ukubulala nelokuzama ukuduna imoto.
UMENGAMELI we-IFP osanda kusolwa ngokuxegelwa wuziphu nokuphenya iziketi zabanye besifazane abaseqenjini, uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa, uthe uyazi ukuthi kunomkhankaso wokungcolisa igama lakhe.UHlabisa uthe uzophelela emoyeni njengentuthu umkhankaso wokumthela ngodaka athe uqhutshwa abaphikisana nemizamo yakhe yokulwela abantu besifazane.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma emcimbini wokugubha inyanga yembokodo obuhlelwe wuphiko lwabantu besifazane kwi-IFP, i-IFP Women's Brigade, ngeSonto ntambama eThekwini. UHlabisa uthe uzoqhubeka nokulwela abesifazane, athe abanye babo bahlukunyezwa abaholi beqembu abanezikhundla komasipala.Uthe abesifazane abasebasha abasebenza komasipala bathwele kanzima ngenxa yokuhlukunyezwa abaholi abaphethe izikhundla.Uphawula kanjena nje kusanda kusabalala umbhalo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana omsola ngokujola namalungu eqembu. Lo mbhalo ubuhambisana nezithombe ezimbili zabesifazane abagagulwe ngamagama, kwathiwa banobudlelwano noHlabisa."Ngizoqhubeka nalo mbhidlango wokulwela abesifazane nakuba kukhona umkhankaso wokudicilela phansi igama lami oqhubekayo. Ngiyazi ukuthi kunomkhankaso wokungcolisa igama lami. Noma bangathini ngami, ngeke baphumelele. Noma yiliphi itulo abalakhayo ngeke liphumelele. Engingakusho nje wukuthi ngizoqhubeka nokulwela abesifazane abahlukunyezwa abaholi bethu."UHlabisa uthe uzoqhubeka nokuhamba ezinyathelweni zomsunguli we-IFP, Inkosi Mangosuthu Buthelezi, owabayalela ukuba bavikele abantu besifazane. "Ngesikhathi ekhuluma engqungqutheleni yokugcina ye-IFP eyayisoLundi, ngo-2019, uMntwana wakwaPhindangene wasiyalela ukuba sivikele abantu besifazane. Ngizoqhubeka lapho okwagcina khona uMntwana wakwaPhindangene."UHlabisa uphonsele inselelo abaholi beqembu abaphethe imikhandlu ukuba bavikele abesifazane abasebasha abasebenza emahhovisi. Uthe abanye abaholi bemikhandlu bayabukela kuhlukunyezwa abesifazane, wathi abanye abaholi yibona imbala abahlukumeza abesifazane."Ngifuna ukuhlaba leli khwelo kubaholi bethu besilisa abayizimeya, amaphini ezimeya kanye noSomlomo. Abantu besifazane abasha abasebenza komasipala bayahlukumezeka nikhona. Ngifuna ukukusho nje ukuthi sizolwa nalo mkhuba wokuhlukunyezwa kwabantu besifazane. Lo mkhuba wenziwa abaholi abanezikhundla." Uthe uzolwela ukuba abesifazane baqokelwe ezikhundleni ezibalulekile eqenjini kanye nakomasipala abaphethwe yi-IFP."Ngizolwela ukuthi abantu besifazane bajutshwe ezikhundleni ezahlukene ezinhlakeni zikahulumeni. Ngizoqhubeka ngilwele ukuthi abantu besifazane bangahlukunyezwa eqenjini kanye nasemiphakathini. Sizoqhamuka nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa abesifazane."UHlabisa uthe kuyamjabulisa ukuthi banoMphathiswa ongowesifazane KwaZulu-Natal, baphinde babe nezimeya, amaphini ezimeya kanye nosomlomo besifazane komasipala abahlukene. "Abesifazane bawumgogodla weqembu. Ngithanda ukubonga ukuzinikela kwamalungu ophiko lwabesifazane kwi-IFP. Njengoba ngikhuluma nani nje, yinina vele enibaningi okusho ukuthi ngikhuluma nabantu abeseka iqembu."Indaba yabaholi abaphezulu abaphenya abesifazane iziketi kuleli qembu yinto eyaziwayo kodwa ebikhulunyelwa phansi. Kweminye imikhandlu kuthiwa abaqashwayo baqale benyuse imiqhewu ngaphambi kokuba bathole umsebenzi.
Owesifazane owathola izingane ezimbili ngaphandle komshado ulahlekelwe ingxenye yakhe ku-Government Employees Pension Fund (GEPF) yowayengumyeni wakhe ngesikhathi kuxazululwa isehlukaniso.Lona wesifazane, ogamalakhe ligodliwe ukuvikela izingane unikele enkantolo eNkulu eLimpopo ukuze ichithe isinqumo sokudliwa kwempahla esathathwa yinkantolo yeMantshi ngesikhathi behlukana nomyeni wakhe.Laba bashada umshado ohlanganisa amafa ngoNovemba 2015. Ngesikhathi beshada, lona wesifazane wayeneminyaka engu-30 ubudala, futhi umyeni wakhe cishe wayeneminyaka engu-60 ubudala. Babanengane eyodwa ngo-2016.Ushiye ikhaya labo lomshado ngoSepthemba 2019 wabuya ngo-2020 kodwa wathola amasamanisi esehlukaniso ngoJuni 2021.Ugcine ehambile futhi ngo-Okthoba 2021 ngemuva kokuthi owayengumyeni wakhe esabise ngokumdubula. Wazakhela indlu enamakamelo amathathu, wagcwalisa nempahla yasendlini ngemali ayithola kumyeni.Ngokwamaphepha asenkantolo, ngaphambi kokuba ahambe okokugcina endlini, wayeneshende ngaphandle futhi walizalela izingane ezimbili. Ingane yokuqala yazalwa ngoFebhruwari 2019, kanti eyesibili yazalwa ngoJuni 2022. Lokhu kukhomba ukuthi ukujola kwakhe ngaphandle komshado kwaqala ngo-2018.Wafuna isondlo kowayengumyeni wakhe salezi zingane ezimbili, egcizelela ukuthi ngezakhe. Kube ngemuva kokuthi umsolwa ephikelele ekutheni kwenziwe ulibofuzo okwaqinisekisa ukuthi lezi zingane ezimbili akuzona ezakhe.Esicelweni sakhe, uthe iMantshi yenza iphutha ngokunquma ukuthi ukungathembeki kuyisizathu sokudliwa kwengxenye yakhe yefa. Izibonelo eziningi zomthetho wamacala ziveza ukuthi umlingani ofuna umyalelo wokudliwa kwempahla kumele afakazele ukungaziphathi kahle kwezezimali kowonile ukuze aqinisekise lowo myalelo.Uqhube wathi inkantolo akufanele ivume ukuthi yenze iphutha ngoba abukho ubufakazi bobudedengu ngokwezimali. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uthe abukho ubufakazi bokuthi wake wamosha impahla ehlangene nesoka lakhe, njengokwesinqumo esakhishwa yiMantshi ngesimangalo sowayengumyeni wakhe.Yize ayengasebenzi ngesikhathi eshadile, uthe ubenegalelo elikhulu ekwakheni ingcebo yakhe nomyeni wakhe. Uveze ukuthi inkantolo bekumele ikubeke eqhulwini ukuhlukunyezwa kwakhe ngumyeni wakhe ngesikhathi beshadile futhi ishaye indiva ububi bakhe bokuba nezingane ezimbili ngaphandle komshado, ngoba ukuhlukunyezwa yikona okubaluleke kakhulu.Ugcizelele ukuthi ukuphinga akusona isizathu sokuphucwa imali; ngokufundisa, ukuba nezingane ngaphandle komshado kuwumphumela wokuphinga, futhi ukuphinga angeke kube isizathu sokulahlekelwa yingxenye yefa.Kodwa-ke, iJaji uMariska Naude-Odendaal lithole ukuthi lona wesifazane akabekanga izizathu ezintsha ezingasiza ukuguqula isinqumo seMantshi.Uqhube wathi lo wesifazane waze waqamba amanga ethi izingane zakhe ezimbili azalwe ngaphandle komshado ngezomyeni wakhe ngesikhathi efaka isicelo sesondlo.Ijaji lisichithile isicelo sakhe, lasho ukungaziphathi kahle okukhulu. Lokhu kwakuhlanganisa nomkhuba wakhe wokuthatha ikhadi lasebhange lomyeni wakhe esebenzisa imali namanye amadoda, nokuqamba amanga ngokuthi izingane ezizalwa ngaphandle komshado ngezakhe kuze kube yilapho ukuhlolwa kwe-DNA kubonisa ukuthi akunjalo.
KUSHUNQE uthuli emhlanganweni wekomiti lasePhalamende eliphenya izinsolo ezenziwa wuKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, kubangwa indlela ikomiti okufanele lisebenze ngayo.Kube ncane indawo ngesikhathi amalungu ekomiti ebanga imigudu okufanele ilandelwe yikomiti uma sekuqalwa uphenyo.Amalungu aphikisane ngokuthi yibaphi abantu okufanele babizwe ukuba bazokwethula ofakazi nokuthi yimiphi imiqulu ezokwenziwa ibe yimfihlo. Ikomiti belinomhlangano wokuhlahla indlela, izolo.IMK ne-EFF bathe akufanele kube khona imibiko ezokwenziwa ibe yimfihlo.Ilungu leMK, uMnuz David Skosana, lithe ikomiti kufanele linikezwe ilungelo lokuba libhunge ngayo yonke imibiko noma ngabe kuthiwa iyimfihlo. "Asifuni kube nemiqulu okuthiwa izoba yimfihlo. Uma kuke kwaqala kwaba khona imiqulu eyimfihlo kuningi esizoxhoshwa kukhona. Inhloso yokufihla imiqulu kusuke kuwukuvikela abathinteka enkohlakalweni. Akufanele sivume ukuthi kube nemibiko eyimfihlo. Kanti sizokwenzani la uma kukhona izinto okuzothiwa asingakhulumi ngazo? Okungcono asivele siyeke."Ilungu le-EFF, uNksz Leigh-Ann Mathys, lithe ukungabhungwa kwemibiko eyimfihlo kuzokwenza ukuthi abantu bangaluthembi uphenyo lwekomiti."Izinsolo esiziphenyayo zibucayi kabi. Abantu vele banezinsolo zokuthi uphenyo luzovikela abathintekayo. Yonke into kufanele ibekwe obala. Uma singabhekile izwe lizosha." Ilungu le-ANC elinguSotswebhu omkhulu ePhalamende, uMnuz Mdumiseni Ntuli, lithe kufanele kuhlonishwe imithetho eyengamele ukusingathwa kwemibiko eyimfihlo."Kunemithetho eyengamele imibiko eyimfihlo. Imibiko noma imiqulu eyimfihlo kufanele kubhungwe ngayo ezinhlakeni ezifanele. Akufanele umsebenzi wethu ugxambukele emsebenzini wamanye amakomiti."Amalungu ekomiti avumelene ngokuthi wuMkhwanazi ozokwethula ubufakazi kuqala. UMkhwanazi wenza izinsolo zokuthi uNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, usondelene nezigebengu eziphazamisa ukusebenza kwengalo yomthetho.Wenza izinsolo zokuthi kunezigebengu eziphazamisa ukusebenza kwamaphoyisa, izinhloli nezobulungiswa.Amalungu ekomiti azichithile iziphakamiso ezenziwe yi-DA zokuthi ikomiti libhunge ngezinguquko okufanele zenziwe kwezobunhloli, ezobulungiswa kanye nasekusebenzeni kwamaphoyisa. I-DA beyenze isiphakamiso sokuba kwenziwe izinguquko kulezi zinhlaka ukuze kuvinjwe ukugxambukela kosopolitiki.Amalungu ekomiti asole i-DA ngokugagamela, athi kufanele kuphenywe izinsolo zikaMkhwanazi ngaphambi kokuba kubhungwe ukuthi yiziphi izinguquko ezingenziwa kulezi zinhlaka.
KWENZEKE obekungalindelekile ngoMsombuluko, iPhoyisa likaMasipala weTheku elibhekene necala lokubulala umkalo, lihoxisa isicelo sebheyili eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini.USenior Constable Qiniso Sishi (41), uthweswe uMbuso icala lokubulala umkakhe obengummeli, u-Advocate Thandokuhle Mkhize (48).Kusolwa ukuthi leli phoyisa labulala umufi ngokumgwaza emzini wabo eMontclair, eThekwini. Umufi kuthiwa washonela endaweni yesigameko, kwathi uSishi waphuthunyiswa esibhedlela ngemuva kokuba ezame ukuzibulala ngokuzisika imithambo yegazi ezihlakahleni. Bekulindeleke ukuthi kuqalwe kwenziwe isicelo sebheyili. Kodwa ummeli kaSishi utshele inkantolo ukuthi akayidingi okwamanje ibheyili ngenxa yezizathu ezahlukene.Ngaleso sikhathi, uSishi ubebonakala ebheke phansi samuntu odidekile nocabanga emajukujukwini. Ngaphambilini, udadewabo kamufi, uDkt Thobeka Ntshevu, waveza ukuthi ezikhathini eziningi umufi nomsolwa babebukeka njengabantu abajabulile kakhulu othandweni lwabo, kungekho okusolisayo."Kodwa ke ngeke uze wazi izinto ezenzekayo uma abantu sebebodwa,'' washo kanje. Omunye udadawebo kamufi, uNksz Khumbuzile Mkhize, phambilini watshela Isolezwe ukuthi umsolwa wahlasela umufi eselele emva kokuba bobabili sebebuye ezindaweni zobumnandi ngokwahlukana. Wathi umufi wayekade ezikhiphe nabanye abangani beye endaweni yokudlela enkabeni yeTheku eMtateni, umsolwa yena eye eMlaza nabangani bakhe.Kuthiwa umsolwa owafika ekhaya kamuva, waqala ingxabano, umufi wezwakala esememeza ecela usizo okusolakala ukuthi kwakungaleso sikhathi ayesemgwaza ngaso.Emva kwalokhu, kuthiwa umsolwa wayegxamalazele isidumbu, ala ukhasha kwababezama ukusondela, ebasabisa ngokuthi uzobabulala. Imantshi, uMnuz Scelo Zuma, ilihlehlisele uSepthemba 29, icala.
INXENXA abatshalizimali ukuba bangabe besacabanga kaningi kodwa basondele eduze kuthuthukiswe indawo yasoPhongolo iMeya yakule ndawo uMnuz Bheki Thwala, njengoba ithi ukholwa wukuthi ukuza koMkhosi woMhlanga kuzoyithuthukisa le ndawo.UThwala ukhulume kanje ngesikhathi kunemidlalo eyahlukene ebikade ihlelwe yiwona lo masipala. Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi iSilo uMisuzulu kaZwelithini simemezele ukuthi uzothuthelwa esigodlweni esiseMashobeni uMkhosi woMhlanga ususwa esigodlweni eNyokeni.UThwala uthe bayabonga eSilweni ngokuthatha isinqumo sokuba uMkhosi uze kule ndawo. Uthe akangabazi nakancane nje ukuthi le ndawo izobonakala ithuthuka kakhulu kunakuqala. ''Le ndawo izobonakala ikhula kakhulu ngenxa yokuza koMkhosi woMhlanga kuyona. Esikucelayo nje wukuthi mabasondele phela abatshalizimali kukhulunywe ukuthi singayithuthukisa kanjani indawo yasoPhongolo,'' usho kanje.Uthe kuyimanje izindawo eziningi zokulala sezigcwele abantu abafuna ukuzoba yingxenye yalo mkhosi.''Lokhu nje kukodwa kukutshela kahle ukuthi uMkhosi woMhlanga uzoletha umehluko ongakanani kubantu bakule ndawo namaphethelo,'' kuchaza yena. Uthe kulokoza inhlansi yethemba mayelana nokudlondlobala kwale ndawo kusuka manje kuya phambili. Uveze ukuthi enye yezinto abatshalizimali okumele bangenelele kuyona wukwakhiwa kwamahhotela kule ndawo.''Kule ndawo kugcwele kakhulu ama-lodge kodwa manje sekumele kushintshe lokhu ngoba baningi kakhulu abantu asebezoza njalo uma kuza lo mkhosi,'' kuchaza uThwala.Mayelana nemidlalo ebebeyihlelile, uthe inhlosongqangi yayo wukukhuthaza abantu abasha ukuba bagxile kwezemidlalo bakhohlwe wuphuzo oludakayo kanye nezidakamizwa. "Sifuna ukubona abantu abasha bethu begxila kakhulu kwezemidlalo kunokuthi benze ubugebengu noma bacwile ophuzweni oludakayo." Uhalalisele uMelokuhle Nxumalo noNomvelo Makhubo, amantombazane adlala ikarate ngokuthola ingqayizivele yethuba lokuyomela iNingizimu Afrika eJapan ngonyaka ozayo. Njengoba kuyinyanga yabesifazane ube nomyalezo wokuthi kumele abesifazane banakekelwe futhi bathandwe. Ugcizelela kakhulu ukuthi ikhaya elinozinzo yilapho owesifazane ephatha kahle umyeni, nendoda inakekela umkayo.
ENINGIZIMU Afrika, amabhizinisi aphethwe ngabesifazane ayakhula, yize esabhekene nezinselelo ezihlukile. Nakuba iphesenti lamabhizinisi angabanikazi besifazane lingaphansi kancane kwesilinganiso somhlaba, kunezibonelo eziningi eziyimpumelelo emikhakheni eyahlukene. Lawa mabhizinisi aneqhaza elikhulu emnothweni futhi adlala indima ebalulekile ekudaleni amathuba emisebenzi nasekufukuleni abantu amandla.Yize kunjalo kusekhona ukukhathazeka ngokunywabuluka kohlelo lokuxhaswa kwamabhizinisi aphethwe ngabantu besifazane. Kusenezikhala ezikhinyabeza ukukhula kwamabhizinisi amancane, aphakathi namancane (SMME) aholwa ngabesifazane eNingizimu Afrika, kanti nezinhlelo ezibekiwe zokweseka amabhizinisi, zibukeka zizinhle ngesikhathi zisamenyezelwa kodwa kazinalusizo uma sebesondela abadinga uxhaso ngenxa yemigomo nemibandela eqinile.UMatsie Mpshe, umsunguli we-SMME Empowerment Summit, okuyinkundla yoguquko egxile ekuthuthukisweni nasekuphumeleleni kwamabhizinisi amancane eNingizimu Afrika, uthe izikhungo eziningi ezixhasa ngezimali zisadinga isibambiso, futhi osomabhizinisi besifazane abaningi badonsa kanzima ukuze bathole uxhaso ngenxa yokushoda kwempahla abangabambisa ngayo."Lokhu kuyinselelo ikakhulukazi emalokishini nasezindaweni zasemakhaya lapho ubunikazi bezakhiwo kuyinselele khona. Ukuchema okusekelwe ebulilini ezinqumweni zokuxhaswa kwezimali kungaholela ekutheni uxhaso oluncane lutholakale kubantu besifazane uma kuthathwa izinqumo zokubolekwa kwezimali kanye nokutshalwa kwezimali. Izibonelelo eziphuma kanye ngaphandle kokwesekwa okulandelwayo ngendlela yokwelulekwa nokuqeqesha zivame ukuhluleka ukudala ukukhula okusimeme kwesikhathi eside," kusho uMpshe.Wengeze ngokuthi umbono oyiphutha omkhulu ngama-SMME aholwa ngabesifazane wukuthi awadingi ukwesekwa ngokobulili. Izinhlelo eziningi kakhulu zisaphatha bonke osomabhizinisi ngokufanayo ngaphandle kokubhekana nezithiyo eziqondene nabesifazane.UMpshe uphawule ukuthi kugcizelelwa kakhulu indaba yokuqalwa kwamabhizinisi esikhundleni sokuqapha laba asebeqalile ukuthi ngabe bathola usizo ngendlela okuyiyona yina."Ziningi kakhulu izinhlelo ezigxile ekugqugquzeleni abantu besifazane ukuthi baqale amabhizinisi kunokubasiza ukuthi bakhule besuka ekubeni osomabhizinisi abancane baye emabhizinisini amakhulu. Kumele kube nokwesekwa okuthe xaxa okufana nokuxhaswa ngezimali okuthuthukile, ukwenza amabhizinisi aholwa ngabesifazane ukuthi alungele ukuthekelisa, ukukhula ekusebenziseni izinsiza zedijithali nokunye,” usho kanje.Lokhu kufakazelwa uGugu Mjadu, oyi-Executive General Manager: Marketing kwaBusiness Partners Limited, okholelwa ukuthi ukwesekwa kwamabhizinisi aholwa ngabesifazane kubalulekile ukuze kuvalwe igebe lezwe kwezezimali ngobulili."Maningi kakhulu amabhizinisi aholwa ngabantu besifazane axhaswa ngemali encane nokwesekwa kwayo akukho ezingeni. Lokhu esikhathini esiningi kwenziwa wukuthi ngokujwayelekile, abaxhasi kabayishintshile indlela abasebenza ngayo ukuze ihlangabezane namaqiniso ezimo ezikhethekile abesifazane osomabhizinisi ababhekana nawo,” usho kanje.Uthi lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuthi abesifazane abaningi baqala amabhizinisi abo njengendlela yokuqeda isizungu, badembesele ukufaka izicelo zezimali ngesikhathi esifanele. Abanye bazuza ifa lamabhizinisi aqala ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima kakhulu zezenhlalo nezomnotho kanti abanye bangena ezimbonini ezigcwele abantu besilisa lapho okuyfanele basebenzi ngokwedlulele ukuzibonakalisa ukuthi nabo bafanelwe wukusebenza."Ngezisombululo zoxhaso lwezimali kanye nokwesekwa okungezona ngokwezimali okuhambisana namabhizinisi aphethwe abesifazane, sizibophezele ekuvuleni amathuba osomabhizinisi abangakasetshenziswa,” kusho uMjadu, ophawula ukuthi kuvame ukuba nomphumela onamandla uma kukhulunywa ngokutshala imali emabhizinisini aholwa abesifazane."Sizibonele mathupha umthelela woguquko ukuthi ukufinyelela kwezezimali kanye nokwesekwa okuhlelekile kokuthuthukiswa kwebhizinisi okungaba nawo kosomabhizinisi besifazane. Lezi zinsiza zenza abesifazane bakwazi ukukhuthaza ulwazi lwezezimali, bakhulise amabhizinisi abo akhiqiza amathuba omsebenzi, athuthukise amakhaya, futhi afake isandla emiphakathini eqinile nebandakanya wonke umuntu. Lena imiphumela ezuzisa umnotho waseNingizimu Afrika ngokubanzi," echaza.
MHLELI: Langa limbe ngiye enkantolo yaseNquthu ngiyofuna usizo thizeni, nebengingaqali ukuyolufuna, ngabuya senginesiqiniseko sokuthi abantu abaziwa nokuthi bayini laphaya.Okokuqala ngiya, ngakuqaphela engangikhuluma naye uyisichwensi esixakile ngendlela ayekhuluma ngayo. Kamuva ngiphinde ngaya. Lapha ngikhuluma ngosizo olutholakala egumbini okuthiwa kusenombolo 07. Uma ufika laphaya uhlala ngaphandle ebhentshini ulinde ngoba awazi ngaphakathi banomuntu noma akunamuntu.Silinde kwayisikhathi esingangehora lapha khona kuqhamuke owesilisa wavula umnyango watshela abangaphakathi ukuthi abantu baningi emnyango, nokuyilapho kuphume intokazi thizeni yathi asingene.Sesiphakathi senqakwe ngombuzo othi yini singangenanga, nawo lo mbuzo owuzwayo nje unengcwenso phakathi ngoba umnyango uvaliwe. Futhi uzothi uyangena kuthiwe ungene nje ubizwe ubani ngoba ulinda kuphume ophumayo bese kuba yima ungena.Kubalulekile-ke ukungaphikisani nesichwensi, uvele wehlise umoya. Kwenziwe okwenziwayo, kwafuneka ngiyofuna okunye kwenye indawo ngokugunyazwa yibo njengenkantolo. Ekubuyeni kwami ngehora leshumi nambili, ngibuye kwathiwa ubuxhakaxhaka bemishini noma ama-computer awasasebenzi nokuyinkinga engadibana nayo nakuqala ngonyaka odlule, futhi okwashiwo ngesikhathi esifanayo.Omunye wabo wayelele. Kanti sisangena okokuqala, babezicofela izingcingo zabo bezifudumeze nange-aircon. Thina siqhuqhwa amakhaza phandle. Asazi-ke thina, yibo abaziyo. Kodwa ngiyazibuza ukuthi iziphathimandla le nkinga aziyilungisi ngani ngoba isinesikhathi.Ebengifisa ukukwedlulisa nje ukuthi uma size enkantolo, asizile ukuzogcwanekelwa zisebenzi zakhona. Okumangazayo lezi zichwensi ezesifazane, bona laba okuthiwa abanikwe amathuba. Akobe niyezwa lapho e-number 07. Yekani ukwedelela. Kungenjalo sukani kungene abantu abaziyo ukuthi baqashelwe ukuthi basize umphakathi futhi bayakuholela lokho nyanga zonke.Sibusiso Madoda HadebeENQUTHU
KUZONCISHISWA amanzi komasipala abathathu KwaZulu-Natal, kusuka ngenyanga ezayo yisikhungo esiphakela amanzi izimboni nakomasipala, uMngeni-uThukela Water.Lesi sikhungo sikhiphe isaziso sokuthi kusuka ngenyanga ezayo, kuzoncishiswa amanzi awumthamo ahlinzekwa kuMasipala weTheku, uMsunduzi kanye noMasipala wesifunda uMgungundlovu.Isitatimende esikhishwe yilesi sikhungo, sithe lolu hlelo luhambisana nemibandela yemvume yokudonsa amanzi ekhishwe nguMnyango wezaManzi.. "Ngokwale mibandela, uMngeni-uThukela Water akumele udlule esikalweni esibekiwe sokudonsa amanzi emadamini. Lokhu kwenzelwa ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amanzi ayatholakala uma kwenzeka kuba nesomiso. UMnyango wezaManzi wethula uhlelo lokuncishiswa kwamanzi adonswa emadamini nyakenye kepha wabuye walumisa ngenxa yemvula enkulu yasehlobo eyaholela ekutheni amadamu agcwale achichime." Sithe kuze kube manje, uMngeni-uThukela Water ubulokhu uhlinzeka ngamanzi adlula inani okuvunyelwene ngalo kulabo masipala abathathu abathintekayo."Nakuba izinga lamanzi emadamini lisatshengisa uzinzo, kubalulekile ukuthi kuthathwe izinyathelo zokonga amanzi ukuze anele uma kwenzeka izulu lomisa esikhathini esizayo. UMngeni-uThukela Water uzibophezele ekusebenzisaneni nomnyango, omasipala kanye nomphakathi ukuze kongiwe amanzi."Kuke kwaba nezikhalo ezivela emnyangweni mayelana namanzi aphelela emhlabathini ngenxa yokuvuza angafinyeleli kubantu.
UKHALA ngonya nobuhlungu okubulawe ngawo amalungu omndeni wawo umndeni wakwaMncibi, endaweni yaKwaGubhuza, eMzumbe.Kulesi sigameko okusolakala ukuthi senzeke ekuqaleni kwesonto eledlule, kubulawe unina nendodana yakhe abatholwe ngoLwesihlanu ethuneni elingashoni, ehlathini eliseduzane nomuzi wabo.UNkk Rose Mncibi (82) nendodana yakhe uMnuz Sbonelo Mncibi (50), batholakale beboshwe izandla, uSbonelo enengozi ekhanda kanti ugogo yena akucaci ukuthi ubulawe kanjani. Ikhuluma no-Ayanda Msweli indodakazi yakulo muzi endala, uNkk Nokuthula Hadebe, ithe yagcina ukubona abomndeni wakhe ngeSonto, ephuma esontweni kungekho lutho olubi."NgoLwesine, ngathumela indodana yami kumalume wayo ngoba kukhona udaba okwakumele siluxoxe, yangitshela ukuthi akafici muntu kodwa kwangixaka ukuthi bayephi ngoba njalo uma bezohamba bebesho. Yangitshela ukuthi okuyixakayo ukuthi imoto ayikho egcekeni, isemgwaqweni. Ngaphinde ngathi ake ahambe ayobheka futhi, wathi akabafici futhi akukhanyisiwe. Ngakhetha ukuthi ngize mina khona ebusuku, ngacela enye ingane yakamakhelwane ukuthi ingiphelezele. Sathi uma sesisondela sezwa kukhala izicabha emotweni, ekhaya kungakhanyi. Saya kocela umakhelwane owubaba ukuthi asiphelezele ngoba sisaba,” kuchaza yona.UNkk Hadebe uthe ngesikhathi sebefika ekhaya bathola ukuthi ugesi unqanyuliwe kwezinye izindlu futhi kuthathwe izimpahla, ama-ID namakhadi asebhange. "Ugogo kuyabonakala ukuthi wayeselele ngoba umbhede wawungandluliwe. Sathatha isinqumo sokubiza umndeni sacinga, sabiza namaphoyisa abhala isitatimende. Sathatha isinqumo sokuthi sime ukubheka ngoba isebusuku, sawatshela amaphoyisa ukuthi sovuka ekuseni siqhubeke sibheke ngoba sihlala endaweni enamahlathi, sawacela ukuthi afike nezinja ukuze zinuke umkhondo,” kuchaza yena.Uthe izidumbu zalaba bazithole ngemuva kokulandela la kwakuhamba khona imoto abanye omakhelwane abathi bayibona imi khona kodwa bangazi ukuthi ifunani."Amasondo emoto asifikisa ekupheleni komgwaqo, sathi uma siqhubeka sabona indawo okubonakala ukuthi ibimbiwa, ilungisiwe kodwa ayiqumbile njengethuna. Safonela amaphoyisa afike aqala kwagujwa, kwatholakala umzimba kamama nokamfowethu. Kubuhlungu esikubonile, asazi lesi simo siyophola kanjani, izigebengu ziphumile, izidakamizwa ziyinkinga,” kuchaza yena.Kuvele ukuthi ethuneni abafihlwe kulona bekukhona nezingubo zikaSbonelo, umuthi wokuxubha, upholishi nazo zonke ezinye izinto okubalwa nezicathulo zakhe. Kuthiwa bebeboshwe ngayo yonke into ebusweni yokubavala umoya, okuyi-tape enkulu, izintambo zikagesi kanjalo nangezinye izinto beboshwe nezandla.Izolo Isolezwe lithole ukuthi umfana oyedwa wendawo ubanjwe ngabafana akade belusile, abamthole ehlathini nezimpahla zikamufi neselula yakhe. Kuthiwa uthathwe amaphoyisa kanti omunye akade enaye ubalekile.Lo mfana othathwe amaphoyisa kuvela ukuthi akafunanga ukukhuluma ukuthi izimpahla uzithathephi, ubezenza sengathi uyaphambana ekhanda.Sishicilele okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, engakaphawuli ngesehlakalo.
I-ANC ikhiphe isitatimende izwakalisa ukuphoxeka ngezinkulumo ezenziwe ngamalungu esigungu esiphezulu saleli qembu esidlangalaleni nokuyinto eyithathe njengokwakha isithombe soqhekeko eqenjini.UDokotela Malusi Gigaba unxuse ukuthi kuhlehliswe iNational Dialogue ukuze ilungiselelwe kangcono, waxwayisa ngokuthi ingase ibe yindawo yezingxoxo nje ngaphandle kwemibono edidiyelwe yabathintekayo.Ngaphezu kwalokho, uGigaba ugxeke isinyathelo sokufaka iDA kuhulumeni wobumbano."Ngangihlezi nginombono wokuthi akufanele kufakwe iDA kuGNU futhi ngisamile kulokho angisiboni isizathu sokuthi sisebenze neDA singasebenza kangcono namanye amaqembu afana ne-EFF," kusho uGigaba engxoxweni yakhe nomhleli wepolitiki kuSunday Times.UMalusi Gigaba uyilungu lesibili eliphezulu ngemuva kuka-Andile Lungisa ophakamise ukuthi kuhlakazwe isigungu esiphezulu se-ANC. UMnuz Senzo Mchunu yena uthe i-ANC "ilokhu ishona phansi,” njengokuthi "umuntu ohamba onqenqemeni lwewa” abe "nekhanda elikhulu,” futhi usengozini yokulahlekelwa amandla uma ehluleka okhethweni lomasipala lwangonyaka ozayo.Unobhala Jikelele we-ANC ukhiphe isitatimende esikubeka kucace ukuthi le nhlangano ayihambisani nezinkulumo zalaba bobabili.Kulesi sitatimende, laba bobabili basolwa ngokwakha isithombe sokuthi leli qembu alibambisene lihlukene phakathi, futhi liyawa. "I-ANC izithatha izinyathelo ezifanele ukulungisa lokhu kuziphatha ngoba alikho ilungu lenhlangano ekumele ligudluke ezinhlosweni zeqembu zokuziphatha kahle ngenhloso yokwakha ubumbano."

UNDLUNKULU waKwaLinduzulu, uThandekile Jane Ndlovu Zulu, ukhuza abazali nonomehlo abadedela izingane ezingaphansi kweminyaka engu-16 ukuba ziye eMkhosini woMhlanga.UNdlunkulu uthe ukudedelwa kwezingane ezingaphansi kweminyaka engu-16 ukuba ziye kulo mkhosi ohanjelwa yizinkulungwane zabantu, kwephula amalungelo ezingane angaphansi komthetho iChildrens Act.Uthe ukuvunyelwa kwabangaphansi kweminyaka eMkhosini woMhlanga kungabophisa abazali, onomehlo nabahlela umkhosi. Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma esithangamini sokuqeqesha omama abahlola izintombi esifundeni iTheku. Lesi sithangami siyingxenye yamalungiselelo oMkhosi woMhlanga wakulo nyaka ozokuba sesigodlweni eMashobeni, ngoSeptemba 12.UNdlunkulu uthe iChildrens Act, ayivumi ukuba izingane ezingaphansi kuka-16 zibe ingxenye yoMkhosi woMhlanga.Unxuse onomehlo ukuba bangazivumeli izingane ezingaphansi kweminyaka ukuba zize emkhosini wakulo nyaka. "Ngiyacela bantakwethu. Angazi ukuthi ngizothini bakithi. Izingane ezineminyaka engaphansi kuka-16 azingezi. Ngiyacela, azingezi. Izintombi zomhlanga lezi. Sikhuluma ngezintombi zomhlanga. Ingakho sibeka iminyaka ukuthi siqala kuphi kuya phezulu."Uthe akuphephile ukuba izingane ezingaphansi kweminyaka zihambele uMkhosi woMhlanga."Nokuthi lezi zingane ezincane ubani ozobheka zona? Kubuye kugijinywe laphayana, kugxotshwane. Niyaye nibone nasezinkundleni zemidlalo kunyathelwana. Kungani niletha izingane ezincane lapho?" Undlunkulu uthe baningi abangaboshwa uma kungenzeka kube khona ingane engaphansi kweminyaka evelelwa inkinga."Niyazi yini ukuthi zonke lezi zikhulu ziyoboshwa nokuboshwa uma sekutholakala ingane engaphansi kuka-16 isishonile? Niyazi yini ukuthi sonke siyoya ejele uma kungatholakala ingane engaphansi kuka-16 isigxobeke yashona? Kuyoqala koyifake ebhasini, siboshwe sonke. Ngakho ke ngiyacela bakwethu ukuba ningazilethi izingane ezingaphansi kuka-16 ngoba nizosidalela inkinga. Onomehlo abangazi ukuthi bazozishiyaphi izingane abasale nazo."Uthe iziqiniswa kakhulu imigomo emkhosini wakulo nyaka. "Sizokubopha usathi uza nayo ingane engaphansi kuka-16. UMkhwanazi (uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal) uphumile. Ufuna abanjengani abazoletha izingane ezingaphansi kweminyaka engu-16 ngoba umthetho usubekiwe."Undlunkulu uphinde wakhala ngokuthi imithetho yakuleli yenza kube nzima kubazali ukuba bakhulise ngendlela izingane zabo."Uhulumeni kufanele ubuye ubheke ukuthi le mithetho ayishayayo ayisixovi yini. Sekuthiwa singazithethisi nokuzithethisa. Nithi singathethi kakhulu kanti kwesinye isikhathi uma uqinisa izwi enganeni iba nokwethuka, isabe. Angisho ukuthi asizishaye kodwa ukuthetha nje kancane kuyasiza. Izingane azisesabi lutho."

KUVAMILE ukuthi abesifazane njengabanakekeli bekhaya nemindeni, bagxile kakhulu ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi wonke umuntu ekhaya uphilile futhi uzizwa enakekelekile bashaye indiva izidingo zabo zezempilo.Ziningi izinto ezixina abantu besifazane okubalwa kuzo izinhlelo ezimatasa, izinkathazo zezimali, noma ukubukela phansi ubungozi obubanyonyobelayo, bagcine bengakwazi ukuhlolela izifo ezihlasela bona ngqo. Ukuhlolwa kwezempilo kubalulekile ukuze abesifazane balondoloze impilo enhle, bathole izinkinga zempilo ezingaba khona kusenesikhathi, futhi bakwazi ukuzixazulula zingakabhebhetheki kakhulu emzimbeni.UMurray Hewlett, oyiCEO ye-Affinity Health uthi; "kule nyanga yabesifazane, sifuna ukukhumbuza wonke umuntu wesifazane ukuthi impilo yakhe ibalulekile. Ukuhlolwa okuvamile akuyona into oyenza-nje kodwa kuyisidingo esibalulekile."Ukuhlolela iPap Smear neHPV Umdlavuza womlomo wesibeletho ungomunye wemidlavuza evikekekayo, nokho usalokhu uyimbangela ehamba phambili yokushona kwabantu besifazane baseNingizimu Afrika okuhlobene nomdlavuza. Ukuhlola ngokujwayelekile kusiza ukuthi umuntu akwazi ukusheshe athole uma kukhona inkinga futhi asheshe athole ukwelashwa. Ngokweziqondiso ezibuyekeziwe zamazwe ngamazwe, abesifazane abaneminyaka engu-25 kuya ku-65 kufanele bahlolelwe i-HPV njalo eminyakeni emihlanu. Uma zingekho izinsiza zokuhlolela i-HPV, kungasiza ukwenza i-Pap smear njalo ngemuva kweminyaka emithathu. Lokhu kuhlola kungasiza ukuthola izinguquko ezingavamile zamaseli kanye nokuba khona kwezinhlobo ze-HPV eziyingozi kakhulu ngaphambi kokuba umdlavuza uvele.Ukuhlolela umdlavuza webeleUmdlavuza webele awulindi ukuthi uhlanganise iminyaka engu-50. Ukuzihlola wena ngokujwayelekile kuwumkhuba omuhle, kodwa akwanele. Ukuhlolwa kwebele emtholampilo kanye ne-mammogram kungasiza kakhulu ukuthola izigaxa noma izinto ezingalungile ngaphambi kokuba zibe yingozi. Uma uneminyaka engaphezu kuka-40 noma kukhona umlando womdlavuza webele emndenini, ungalindi, khuluma nodokotela wakho mayelana nokuqala i-mammogram.Ukuhlolwa komfutho wegazi, i-Cholesterol, neGlucoseIsifo senhliziyo sivame ukubhekwa "njengenkinga yamadoda”, kodwa siwusongo olukhulu nakwabesifazane. Isifo senhliziyo siyimbangela ehamba phambili yokufa kwabesifazane emhlabeni jikelele. Umfutho wegazi ophakeme, i-cholesterol ephezulu, kanye noshukela ophezulu wegazi kuvame ukukhula ngaphandle kwezimpawu kuze kube yilapho kwenzeka okuthile njengokuhlaselwa yinhliziyo noma uhlangothi. Yingakho ukuhlolwa okuvamile kubaluleke kakhulu kwabesifazane abangaphezu kweminyaka engama-35, noma labo abanomlando womndeni wesifo sikashukela noma isifo senhliziyo.Izinkinga zesinye nenzaloIzinkinga ezifana nezinhlungu uma usesikhathini, ukushintshashintsha kwemizwa, ukukhuluphala ngokweqile kungalindelekile, noma ukungazali kungase kubonise ukungalingani kwama-hormone noma izimo ezifana ne-PCOS noma i-endometriosis. Ukuhlolwa okujwayelekile ngodokotela kungasiza ekuboneni lapho kudingeka olunye uphenyo. Ukuqikelela ukuthi uyazinakekela ikakhulukazi ezintweni ezithinta inzalo kungenye yezindlela ezisiza ukulawula isikhathi sokunqamuka kokuya esikhathini kanye nezimpawu zokunqamuka kokuya esikhathini (menopause).Ukuhlola impilo yengqondoAbesifazane basethubeni eliphindwe kabili kunabesilisa lokuba nengcindezi, ukudangala nokukhathazeka, nokho ukucwaswa kanye nengcindezi yomphakathi kusenza kube nzima ukuthola usizo. Kule nyanga yabesifazane, yenza impilo yengqondo ibe yingxenye yendlela yakho yokuphila. Uma uzizwa ucindezelekile, udangele ngendlela exakile, ucasukile, noma ukhathele kakhulu umzimba ungavumi lutho, ungalenzi iphutha lokuziziba lezi zimpawu, zama ukuthola umuntu ongakwazi ukukhuluma naye.
UKHONGOLOSE udingida ukubeka owalahlwa yicala lokubulala, uRussel Ngubo, kwesobumeya kuMasipala waseMpendle.UNgubo walahlwa icala lokubulala ilungu le-IFP, uMnuz Ernest Nzimande, ngo-1998, ngesikhathi kubhoke udlame lwezepolitiki KwaZulu-Natal.UNgubo wagwetshwa iminyaka engu-25 ebhedla ejele, wakhishwa ngoshwele ngo-2017. Igama likaNgubo kuthiwa lisohlwini lwamagama okuzokhethwa kuwo ozokuba imeya.La magama kuthiwa kudingidwe ngawo emhlanganweni wobuholi be-ANC esifundeni iMoses Mabhida, nobuholi benhlangano esifundazweni.Umthombo ongaphakathi kwi-ANC, uthe onke amagatsha e-ANC eMpendle asho ngazwi linye ukuthi afuna ukuba uNgubo abe yimeya. "Akekho omunye esimbonayo ofanelwe isikhundla. Asiboni okungamvimba ukuba abe yimeya ngoba usasiqeda isigwebo sakhe."UNgubo uthe akazi ukuthi igama lakhe liphakathi kwalawo okuzokhethwa kuwo ozokuba imeya kodwa wathi ngeke anqabe uma eqokwa.UNgubo uthe kuyaziwa ukuthi uyena nomngani wakhe owagwetshelwa icala lokubulala, uThami Memela, babancenga abantu baseMpendle ukuba bashiye i-IFP. Njengamanje uNgubo uwusihlalo wegatsha le-ANC kuWard 1.I-ANC ithe ibingakaluphothuli uhlelo lokuqoka imeya entsha.UMasipala waseMpendle nowaKwaDukuza sebehlale isikhathi eside bengenazo izimeya. Okhulumela i-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Fanle Sibisi, uthe sebesemaphethelweni okuqoka abazongena ezikhundleni."Izinhlelo zangaphakathi kwi-ANC zokuqoka abazongena ezikhundleni ziyaqhubeka. Ezinsukwini ezilandelayo sizokwenza isimemezelo ngalezi zinhlelo."USibisi uthe kubalulekile ukuba kuqokwe abazongena ezikhundleni ukuze kungeke kuphazamiseke ukuhanjiswa kwezidingo. "Sifuna ukubona le mikhandlu isebenza ngendlela khona izokwazi ukuhambisa izidingo kubantu. Ingakho sikubeke eqhulwini ukuqokwa kwabazongena ezikhundleni."UMasipala waKwaDukuza wasala ungenayo imeya kanye nephini lemeya emva kokusula kukaMnuz Ali Ngidi noMnuz Njabulo Cele, ngasekuphelni kwenyanga edlule.Umhlangano owawubizelwe ukuqokwa imeya nephini lemeya elisha, wahlehliswa ngemizuzu yokugcina. Kunamahlebezi okuthi i-ANC ifuna ukuqoka owayeyimeya yoMasipala wesiFunda iLembe, uMnuz Siduduzo Gumede, ukuba abe imeya.Kuthiwa i-ANC ifuna ukuba owayeyimeya yomkhandlu, uNksz Lindile Nhaca, abe yiphini lemeya.UMasipala waseMpendle wasala ungenayo imeya emva kokukhishwa kukaMnuz Buyisani Mlaba, ngasekuqaleni kwenyanga eyedlule.UMlaba wakhishwa ngevoti lokungabethembi ubuholi bakhe.Isiphakamiso safakwa amaqembu aphikisayo, amakhansela e-ANC awazange avote.
IKHATHAZEKILE inhlangano ekhokha izibonelelo zikahulumeni iSouth African Social Security Agency (SASSA), ngokwanda kwezehlakalo zokubanjwa kwemali yabahola lezi zibonelelo ekubeni bona bethi abazi ngale mali.Le nhlangano ithe ithola izikhalo ezivela kwabahola izibonelelo, bekhala ngokuthi izinkampani zemishwalense nomasingcwabisane zibamba imali yabo ekubeni bengazange bayithathe le mishwalense.UMnuz Themba Matlou, isikhulu esiphezulu seSASSA, uthe abahola izibonelelo bacabanga ukuthi lezi zinkampani zisebenzisana nabo. Uthe beyiSASSA abanalo ilungelo lokubamba imali yabahola izibonelelo."ISASSA ayinalo ilungelo lokubamba imali. Imali eyenu asinalo ilungelo lokuthi sinqume ukuthi niyisebenzise kanjani. Ngeke sisebenzisane nezinkampani zomasingcwabisane noma imishwalense ukuthi sibambe imali," usho kanje.Uthe ababanjelwa imali bengazi abaye emahhovisi abo bayobika. "Sizophenya uma sekukhona ababikile. Abachitha ukuthi bayazi ngemali ebanjwayo bangathumela i-sms ku-34548, bafake inombolo yabo kamazisi negama laleyo nkampani ebamba imali." Uthe abaye nasemahhovisi alabo ababamba imali bayobika.Udalule nokuthi akuvumelekile ukuthi kubanjwe imali yomshwalense kwabahola isibonelelo sezingane esaziwa ngemali yeqolo kanjalo nabahola i-Care Dependency Grant, noma i-Foster Child Grant. Ubalule nokuthi nalabo abahola isibonelelo i-Temporary Disability Grant, akuvumelekile ukuthi babanjelwe imali yimishwalense.

INHLANGANO yamalungelo abantu, iSA Human Rights Commission (SAHRC), ishubisela uNgqongqoshe wezeMidlalo, ezobuCiko namaSiko osolwa ngokucwasa abantu abamnyama, uGayton McKenzie.I-SAHRC isibhalele uMcKenzie imyalela ukuba achaze kabanzi ngezinkulumo azibhala ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ezicwasa abantu abamnyama.Inikeze uMcKenzie umnqamulajuqu wangoLwesithathu ukuba achaze, yaveza ukuthi izinkulumo zakhe zingenza ukuba avulelwe icala eNkantolo yezokuLingana. UMcKenzie ungene obishini emva kokuba abantu bevundulule izinkulumo zakhe zakudala azifaka ezikundleni zokuxhumana lapho khona kwezinye ayebiza abantu abamnyama ngegama eliqala ngo-K.Lezi zinkulumo zavundululwa emva kokuba uMcKenzie egxeke abanikazi be-Openchats Podcast, abasola ngokucwasa amakhaladi.I-SAHRC ithe isiqale uphenyo ngodaba lukaMcKenzie emva kokuthola izikhalazo eziqhamuka emaqenjini ezepolitiki kanye nakubantu abehlukene. "Siphinde saqaphela ukuthi baningi abantu abakhonondayo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana."Isikhulu seSAHRC, uSolwazi Tshepo Madlingozi, sithe akekho umuntu ovumeleke ukusebenzisa igama eliqala ngo-K."Noma ngabe kuthiwa uyadlala, umthetho awukuvumeli ukuba usebenzise leli gama. Ngenxa yesikhundla asiphethe uMcKenzie, kulindeleke ukuthi indlela aziphatha ngayo ihambisane nemithetho ebekelwe ongqongqoshe namalungu ePhalamende. Bukhona ubufakazi bokuthi uMcKenzie wephule umthetho wezokulingana, ingakho simbhalele incwadi okufanele ayiphendule lingakashoni ilanga langoLwesithathu." UMadlingozi uthe kungenzeka bafake icala eNkantolo yezokuLingana.Amaqembu ezepolitiki okubalwa kuwo i-ActionSA ne-EFF afuna ukuba uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa axoshe uMcKenzie.Lawa maqembu athe uMcKenzie akafanelwe ukuqhoqhobala isikhundla njengoba esolwa ngokucwasa. Ilungu le-ActionSA ePhalamende, uMnuz Alan Beesley, lithe basamile ekutheni uMcKenzie kufanele ashiye esikhundleni."Sikushayela ihlombe ukuba iSAHRC iqale uphenyo. Siyaphinda siyasho namanje ukuthi asikwazi ukuba nongqongqoshe ocwasa ngokobuhlanga. Asinendaba ukuthi le nto wayisho kudala noma uyisho manje. Kufanele athathelwe izinyathelo lo ngqongqoshe. Sifisa ukuthi iSAHRC isazise ngokuqhubeka ophenyweni lwayo. Ngeke sikubekezelele ukucwaswa kwabantu, ikakhulukazi njengoba sonke sazi ukuthi sisukaphi njengezwe."UMcKenzie waxolisa ngokufaka lezi zinkulumo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana kodwa wathi ngeke ehle esikhundleni, wathi akumele ajeziselwe izinkulumo azifaka eminyakeni engaphezu kweyishumi eyedlule.

ABOKUFIKA abakuleli ngokungemthetho abahambe babuyele emazweni abo.Lawa ngamazwi akhishwe nguNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, ngesikhathi ehambele eCornubia, eThekwini, eyohlola umsebenzi wokwakhiwa kwezindlu zalabo abakhahlanyezwa yizikhukhula.Ubephawula kwabezindaba njengoba kuqhubeka imikhankaso yezinhlangano ezehlukene ezilwisana nabokufika abakuleli ngaphandle kwamaphepha. Izinhlangano ezifana neMarch and March ne-Operation Dudula, zinkanisa ezikhungweni zikahulumeni zezempilo ukuvimba abokufika abangenamaphepha ukuba bangene bathole usizo lwezempilo.Zizwakalisa ukukhathazeka ngokuthi lezi zikhungo zikahulumeni ziyasindwa ngenxa yomthamo omkhulu wabokufika abangenamaphepha abafika kuzo bezofuna usizo lwezempilo. Zibuye ziveze nokuthi uhulumeni akanayo imali eyanele yokubhekela izidingo zezempilo zabantu abakuleli ngokungemthetho.UNtuli ezwakalisa uvo lwakhe ngalolu daba uthe: "Abahambe babuyele emazweni abo.” Uthe: "Imali esinayo KwaZulu-Natal, ilingene abantu bala nabaseNingizimu Afrika bodwa.”Uqhube wathi abantu bokufika abafuna ukuba kulesi sifundazwe, akube abantu abalana ngokusemthethweni."Uma kukhona umuntu ofohlayo angene eNingizimu Afrika, uqala ubugebengu ngokwenza njalo. Uma sebenza ubugebengu nangaphakathi ngeke ubaphikele ngoba kwakungena kwabo, kwaba wubugebengu,” kusho uNtuli. Uthe sesiphelile isikhathi sokuthi (abokufika) bacabange ukuthi kuleli, yikwamachanca."Akukhona kwampunzi edla emini lapho ungena khona, uphume, ugange, wenze yonke into, uthumbe, ufake izidakamizwa. Abahambe bayofuna izimvume uma befuna ukuba lana ngoba umthetho awubanqabeli ukuthi beze lana kodwa uthi abangene ngemvume okuyiyona yona," usho kanje.Uphinde wanxusa nezisebenzi zoMnyango wezaseKhaya nezeminye iminyango ukuthi lolu daba ziluphathe ngobuqotho. "Akungabi bikho izinsolo zokuthi abanye babuye babenzele izindlela zokuthi bakwazi ukungena, noma bangene ngomgunyathi. Kukhona abanye abake baboshwa eThekwini, ehhovisi loMnyango wezaseKhaya mbumbulu,” kusho uNtuli.Uthe izisebenzi azazi ukuthi ngeke bakuvumele ukuthi KwaZulu-Natal kube yindawo yokuhlala wonke umuntu nongenayo imvume.Uphinde wabalula ukuthi lesi simo sishaya kuzwele ngisho nasodabeni lokushoda kwamathuba omsebenzi. "Sinesiqiniseko sokuthi baningi abangasebenza uma kungathiwa kuhleli abantu bakulesi sifundazwe nabaseNingizimu Afrika bodwa lana. Maningi amafemu enginolwazi lokuthi aqashe abantu bokufika, lokhu sikuthola ngemibhidlango yamaphoyisa eqhubeka zonke izinsuku,” kusho uNtuli. Wexwayise ngokuthi wonke umuntu wokufika okuleli ngaphandle kwamaphepha, kufanele azi ukuthi zizomkhalela.UNtuli ukhuluma kanjena nje, izinhlangano ezilwa nabokufika abakuleli ngokungemthetho zigxekwa ezinye izinhlaka zomphakathi.Kuzona kukhona abathi kuyicala ukunqabela umuntu usizo lwezempilo esefikile ezolufuna esikhungweni.
