"Leli bhikawozi lizosiza kakhulu ekongeni imali abayisebenzisayo ngoba sebezozenzela izinkwa. Imali ezokongiwa ngonyaka ilinganiselwa ku-R3 million."Uveze ukuthi ilinganiselwa ku-R7 million imali abayisebenzisile, wathi nokho lokho bakuthatha njengokutshala imali."Lokhu kuzophenduka inzuzo esikhathini esingaphezu kweminyaka emibili," usho kanje. Uthe isinkwa ngaphakathi ejele siyinto ebaluleke kakhulu njengoba iziboshwa zisidla nsuku zonke.Ube eseveza ukuthi lena yibhikawozi ka-13 ukwakhiwa wumnyango, wathi banethemba lokuthi u- 2028 uzoshaya sesifinyelele ku-20 isibalo samabhikawozi abazobe sebewakhile. Udalule ukuthi njengamanje imali eyongekayo ngokusebenza kwalawa angu-13, ingu-R7 million. Uthe uhlelo lokukhethwa kwabazosebenza ebhikawozi luzobandakanya ukuthi kubhekwe amarekhodi eziboshwa kanjalo namafayela azo achaza kabanzi ukuthi zikusiphi isigaba bese bebheka nokuthi zake zenzani okungaba amakhono."Sizobe sesikhetha abakulungele, emva kwalokho luqale uhlelo lokulungiselela ukusebenza kwebhikawozi. Bangaphezulu kuka-50 abazoqala ukusebenza. Kufanele bakujabulele kakhulu laba abayingxenye yebhikawozi ngoba siqeqesha osomabhizinisi okuzothi uma bephuma ezandleni zethu baziqalele amabhizinisi athi bona, besebenzisa amakhono esibanike wona.” Lo mnyango unezinye izinhlelo okubalwa ezolimo, ukukhiqiza indwangu nokunye. Uthe bazimisele ngokuqhubeka bathuthukise amakhono eziboshwa ukuze zilungele impilo uma seziphumela ngaphandle, wathi lolu hlelo luzokhipha izitifiketi eziqinisekisa ukuthi leli khono balifundele ngaphakathi.
KUZOTHATHA izinyanga ezine ukuphothulwa kokwakhiwa kwezindlu ezingu-113, okuzohlomula kuzo ingxenye yalabo abakhahlanyezwa yizikhukhula zika-2022 nezika-2025. Lokhu kuvezwe uNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli izolo, ngesikhathi ehambele eCornubia, eMount Edgeombe, eThekwini, ukuyohlola umsebenzi wokwakha lezi zindlu. UNtuli ubehamba noMphathiswa wezokuHlaliswa kwaBantu esifundazweni, uMnuz Siboniso Duma.UNtuli uthe lokhu kuyisiqalo emizamweni wesifundazwe ukuthi siphuthumise usizo kulabo abakhahlanyezwa yizikhukhula. "Ngalokhu sihlose ukuthi kuthi kushaya u-2027, wonke umuntu owakhahlanyezwa yizikhukhula kulesi sifundazwe abe eselutholile usizo lwendlu enazo zonke izidingo, azohlala kuyo unomphelo,” kusho uNtuli.Uthe lezi zindlu ezakhiwa njengamanje, zakhiwa ngendlela yokuthi zizokwazi ukumelana nezinhlekelele zemvelo, ukubhekelela izimo zabakhubazekile kanjalo nokunye.Uqhube wathi ukwakhiwa kwalezi zindlu kukhombisa ukuzibophezela kukahulumeni ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi abakhahlanyezwa yizikhukhula babuyelwa yisithunzi. "Lokhu esikwenza namuhla akukho mayelana nokubheka nje kuphela ukuqhubeka komsebenzi kodwa kumayelana nokuguqulwa kwempilo,” kusho uNtuli. Uthe ukwakhiwa kwazo esikhathini esingangezinyanga ezine kuyisethembiso esesiqalile ukufezeka."Phakathi kukaJulayi noDisemba kulo nyaka, izindlu ezingu-113 zizobe seziphothuliwe. Lokhu kuzolandelwa ukukhishwa kwemali engu-R149 million, ukuze kulungiswe indaba yeziza ezingu-692 ukuze kuphinde kuqhubeke omunye umsebenzi wokwakha,” kusho uNtuli. Uphinde waveza nokuthi imali engango-R261 million, izobekwa eceleni uMnyango wezokuHlaliswa kwaBantu kwisabelomali sango-2026/27, ukuze kwakhiwe ezinye izindlu ezingamaflethi.Ngesikhathi imali engu-R25 million yona ezothathwa kwiCapital Balances, izosetsheniswa ukuthi kuqedelwe ukwakhiwa kwezindlu ezingu-108 ekupheleni kuka-Okthoba 2025. "Lezi ezingu-692 izindlu kulindeleke ukuthi ziqedwe ukwakhiwa ngoDisemba 2026, bese kuthi abazohlomula ngazo bangene ngawo uDisemba kuya kuJanuwari 2026,” kusho uNtuli. Ngezikhukhula zika-Ephreli 2022, isifundazwe sabhekana nesimo esithathwa njengezinkulu emlandweni weNingizimu Afrika. Bangaphezu kuka-400 abantu abalahlekelwa yimpilo yabo, kwathi izinkulungwane zasala zingenayo indawo yokufihla ikhanda.Izikhukhula zika-2025, nazo ziphinde zanezezela omkhulu umonakalo, owaholela ekutheni inqwaba isale dengwane. Iningi lisahleli emahholo omphakathi, kanjalo nasezindaweni zesikhashana.
PHEZU kokuba imali yezikole eyaziwa ngama-norms and standards KwaZulu-Natal eyasusa umsindo phakathi kwezinyunyana zothisha nomnyango wezeMfundo esifundazweni isikhokhiwe, kodwa uMphathiswa woMnyango uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka, uthe basadinga enye imali.Ukungakhokhwa ngesikhathi kwale mali kwasusa umsindo omkhulu okwenza izinyunyana zahudula izinyawo zifuna ikhokhwe. Zaze zaduba nokubhalisa izivivinyo zikhala ngokuthi izikole azinayo imali yokuzibhalisa ngenxa yokushoda kwezinsiza.Zazikhala ngokuthi kuphela isikhathi eside le mali ingakhokhwa. Lokhu kwakwenza ukuthi izikole zingakwazi ukuthenga ezinye izinsiza kulezo eziziphathela imali. Izinsiza kubalwa ukungakhokhelwa kukagesi namanzi, ukuthengwa kwezincwadi okubandakanya ne-stationery noshoki, kanjalo nezinye izinsiza ezibandakanya nemali yokulungisa uma kukhona izinto ezonakele ezikoleni. UHlomuka uthe bazikhokhele izikole imali abebeyikweleta."Siwukhokhile uR900 million, ebesiwukweleta izikole ngosizo lukandunankulu nehhovisi likaMgcinimafa. Noma sesiyikhokhile le mali kodwa sisadinga enye," kusho uHlomuka.Uveze lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma emhlanganweni wekomiti lezemfundo esiShayamthetho kuleli sonto. Inkinga yokungakhokhelwa kwezikole nosonkontileka abenza imisebenzi nomnyango yinkinga ebhekene nalo mnyango esifundazweni.Osonkontileka okubalwa abaphakela izikole, abasabalalisa izincwadi, abagaya amaphepha ka-matric nabanye bahlale bekhala ngokungakhokhelwa ngesikhathi.Izinyunyana zothisha zaze zahlaba ikhwelo lokuthi lo mnyango ufakwe ngaphansi kokulawulwa wuMnyango kazwelonke ngenxa yezinselelo obhekene nazo. Izikhulu zomnyango zihlale zikhala ngokuthi ukunqanyulelwa isabelomali kunomthelela wokuthi ungakwazi ukumelana nezinye izikweletu.Kanjalo nendaba yokunyuswa kwamaholo abasebenzi ngaphandle kokuthi umnyango kazwelonke ufake lowo chatha wokunyusa amaholo, kwenza umnyango kudingeke uhlwaye imali yokukhokhela abasebenzi kwezinye izinhlelo ukuze lingenzeki iphutha lokuthi bangaholi.Amalungu esiShayamthetho azwakalise ukukhathazeka ngokuhluleka komnyango wukukhokha ngesikhathi.Kulo mhlangano kuvele ukuthi umnyango ugcina usukhokha nenzalo ngenxa yokuthi awukwazi ukubakhokhela ngesikhathi osonkontileka.
LIZOQALA ukuqulwa ngasekupheleni konyaka icala likaNkk Duduzile Zuma-Sambudla obekwe wuMbuso icala lokuphehla udweshu ngesikhathi sezibhelu zango-2021. Izindaba zokuthi leli cala selizoqala ukuqulwa zivele izolo ngesikhathi uNkk Zuma-Sambudla evele enkantolo eNkulu.UMbuso nenkantolo bavumelene ngokuthi kusetshenziswe usuku lwangoNovemba 10 kuya ku Novemba 21 kuwona lo nyaka. UNkk Zuma-Sambudla usolwa wuMbuso ngokuthi wayegqugquzela eyezibhelu zango-2021, ezashiya umonakalo omkhulu KwaZulu Natal naseGauteng.Izibhelu zaqubuka emva kokuthi uZuma ezinikele ejele eliseMtshezi, okwaholela ekucekelweni phansi kwempahla kanye nokuzitapela kwabantu ezitolo ezehlukene. Lezi zibhelu zadala umonakalo ka-R50 billion emnothweni, inqwaba yalahlekelwa yimisebenzi. Kwashona abantu abangu-345. Ngesikhathi kuqhubeka izibhelu uNkk Zuma-Sambudla wayelokhu efaka ekhasini lakhe kwi-X, izigameko ezazenzeka zihambisana nombhalo owawuthi : ''Siyanibona'' bese eyigagula ngegama indawo okwenzeka kuyona isigameko. Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi ngaphambilini uMnuz Jean Le Roux, wenhlangano iForensic Research Lab, wathi imibhalo kaNkk Zuma-Sambudla yayikhombisa ukuthi ukushayela ihlombe okwabe kwenzeka ngesikhathi sezibhelu.Omele uNkk Sambudla-Zuma, u-Advocate Dali Mpofu, wenze izethulo evezela inkantolo ukuthi umsolwa uyakuvuma ukuthi kukhona izinto ayezibhala ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ikakhulukazi ekhasini lakhe i-X, kodwa ngalokho wayengakaze athume muntu ukuthi kube khona akwenzayo.Esekhuluma nabezindaba uNkk Zuma-Sambudla, uthe ujabule kakhulu ngokuthi kuvunyelwane ngezinsuku zokuqala ukuqulwa kwecala. Uthe lokhu kubuyise ithemba kuyena njengoba ethe ukholwa wukuthi okuningi sekuyovela khona. Nakulokhu ngaphandle kwenkantolo abanye babaholi boMkhonto weSizwe baqhubekile nokusola inhlese yezepolitiki bethi iyona edale ukuthi aze ahambe icala uNkk Zuma-Sambudla.UNobhala weqembu, uDkt Bongani Mncwango, uthe bakhathazekile kakhulu ngecala elibekwe uNkk Zuma-Sambudla.Uthe ayikho into ephathekayo uMbuso onayo mayelana naleli cala. Usole inhlese yepolitiki njengoba uNkk Zuma-Sambudla ejezela ukuthi uyindodakazi kaMsholozi.''Lo mntwana ujezela ukuthi uyindodakazi kaZuma, akukho futhi okunye okudlula lokho. Kodwa kuzogcina kuvela ukuthi ayikho into ayenza kodwa ufela icala angalazi. UMkhonto uzoqhubeka nokuma naye kuze kube sekugcineni,'' usho kanje.
KUYAQHUBEKA ukubulawa kwabantu oDidini, eMbumbulu, njengoba sekuphenduke insakavukela ukugobhoza kwegazi. Ngeledlule kudutshulwe kwabulawa uMnuz Musawenkosi Chonco (59), emi esitobhini sangakubo.Kuvela ukuthi kuqhamuke abathile abavulele ngenhlamvu bebhekise kuyena. Kakuqondakali ukuthi ukubulawa kwakhe bekumayelana nani nanokuthi kungani ebulewe.Udadewabo kamufi, uNksz Nozipho Chonco, ukuqinisekisile ukubulawa kwakhe. Uthe njengomndeni badunguza ebumnyameni ngokuthi kungani ebulewe. Kubulawa uChonco nje, umphakathi wakule ndawo uvele uthuka izanya njengoba kungami ukugobhoza kwegazi kule ndawo, abantu bebulawa ngokudutshulwa. Muva nje, kubulawe uMnuz Skhumbuzo Ndlovu, odutshuliwe ngenyanga eyedlule. Naye kakuqondakali ukuthi yini le abulawelwa yona.UNdlovu wabulawa kungakapholi maseko kade kudutshulwe kwabulawa uMnuz Mduduzi Ngcongo wakuyona le ndawo.UNgcongo yena wadutshulwa eseFolweni, ehamba ngemoto yakhe. Kuwona lo nyaka kudutshulwe kwabulawa uMnuz Siphelele Khathi benoMnuz Sihle Sibisi. Kubulawe nenduna, uMnuz Sphiwe Msweli. Kwangaphela sikhathi esingakanani, kwabulawa nendodana yenduna uMnuz Mhlengi Msweli. Induna yadutshulwa yabulawa iyovala isitolo sayo kanjalo nendodana nayo yabulawa iphuma esitolo isigoduka. Kubulawe noMnuz Mzwandile Nxumalo owahlaselwa esemzini wakhe ngabantu abangaziwa abamdubula ngoyaba lwezinhlavu waphelela khona lapho.Kwabulawa nabesilisa abahlanu esigamekweni esashiya amalungu omphakathi wakule ndawo ethuka izanya. Amalungu omphakathi asaqhubeka ngokukhala ngemoto yohlobo lwe-Etios ezulazula kule ndawo okuthiwa ibahlalise lubhojozi abantu.''Abantu abaningi badutshulwa ngabantu abasuke behle kule moto, asisazi ngampela ukuthi siyithini indaba yale moto,'' kubalisa ilungu lomphakathi elingeke livezwe ngoba lisaba. Okunenga kakhulu umphakathi ukuthi kuzona zonke lezi zigameko akekho oboshwayo.''Bonke laba bantu asazi ngempela ukuthi kungani bebulawa futhi basuke benzeni?'' kubalisa elinye ilungu lo mphakathi elicele ukuba ligodlwe igama lalo.Isolezwe lithole ngomthombo walo ukuthi bonke ababulawayo basuke sebazi ngoba baqale bathole imiyalezo ebaxwayisayo ngaphambi kokuba basocongwe.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu Natal, uLieutenant Colonel Paul Magwaza, ukuqinisekisile ukubulawa kukaChonco. Uthe ukhona oseboshiwe mayelana nalesi sigameko.
UMNDENI wephoyisa elabulawa ngesihluku ngaphandle kwesitolo sangakubo eNewtown C, eNanda, ngo-Ephreli kulo nyaka, uthe namanje usabubhekile ubulungiswa ngokubulawa kwalo.Ukusho lokhu kulandela isimemezelo samaphoyisa aKwaZulu-Natal sokuthi ngoLwesibili ebusuku athele othulini abasolwa ababili, abathinteka kulesi sigameko.Esigamekweni sango-Ephreli 8, 2025, kwadutshulwa, kwashona uSergeant Sanele Dlamini (36), owayesebenza ophikweni lokuqashwa kukamengameli (uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa) uma eze esifundazweni. Ngaleso sikhathi kwavela ukuthi wahlaselwa amalungu eqembu lemigulukudu iWest, aphinde abe ngomakhelwane bakhe. Ngosuku lwesigameko kuthiwa abasolwa abahlanu, bamfica esathenga i-airtime esitolo bamdubula. Kwavela ukuthi wakwazi ukudubula, alimaze umsolwa oyedwa, ngaphambi kokuba aphangalale. Lowo msolwa, okuthiwa usahamba icala namanje, waboshwa amaphoyisa ngesikhathi eyofuna usizo lwezempilo emtholampilo wendawo emva kwesigameko. Ngokusho kokhulumela amaphoyisa esifundazweni, uColonel Robert Netshiunda izolo, abasolwa ababili ebebefunelwa amacala ehlukene, okukhona kuwo elokubulala iphoyisa, elokuzama ukubulala noxhaxha lwamacala okubamba inkunzi kuhlonyiwe badutshulwe bafa ngesikhathi besusa impi yesibhamu namaphoyisa. Echaza kabanzi ngalokhu uNetshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa abelandela umkhondo wokuthi abasolwa abebafuna babhacephi. "Umkhondo wamaphoyisa uwaholele komunye umuzi oseMaplazini, eNanda. Kuthe uma efika amaphoyisa, ezethula, eyalela abasolwa ukuthi bavule umnyango, bona bavele baphendula ngenhlamvu,” kusho uNetshiunda. Uthe akukho okunye amaphoyisa abengakwenza ngaphandle kokuthi nawo abuyisele ngayo inhlamvu ukuze azivikele. "Ngesikhathi kudutshulwana, kusale enkundleni abasolwa ababili abaneminyaka engu-20 nengu-21. Kutholwe nesibhamu ebesinenombolo exikiziwe kubona abasolwa,” kusho uNetshiunda, oveze ukuthi kulesi siwombe, akubanga khona phoyisa elilimalayo. Umfowabo kaDlamini, uMnuz Siya Dlamini uthe basabufuna ubulungiswa ngokubulawa kukamufi, wathi amaphoyisa abengakabazisi ngokusemthethweni ukuthi sekukhona asebabulele."Thina besisalokhu silandela lo oyedwa owaboshwa emva kokubanjwa emtholampilo. Ubelokhu evela eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseNtuzuma, icala lihlehla,” kusho uDlamini.Uveze ukuthi bagcine bekuduba ukuhamba icala ngenxa yokuhlehla kwalo njalo. "Umphenyi waze wasithembisa ukuthi uzositshela uma seliqala ukuqulwa,” usho kanje. Uthe bekungakabibikho umphenyi abesakushilo kubona ngalaba abanye abasolwa abane ngaphandle kwalo oboshiwe."Ubulungiswa sisabufuna siwumndeni,” kusho uDlamini, othe emva kokubulawa kukamfowabo, abanye babasolwa bebebuye babonakale endaweni njengoba bengomakhelwane.

OWESIFAZANE waseZimbokodweni KwaMakhutha eNingizimu yeTheku, uthe uyokuxoxela amagwababa echobana okumehlele ngesikhathi obeyisoka lakhe, eshisa indlu futhi eshaya phansi ngonyawo ethi akaliwa yena ngakho kungamane kuphume isidumbu.UNksz Celiwe Myeni (38), uthe namanje usazibuza uyaziphendula ukuthi kungani obeyisoka lakhe ekhethe ukwenza into enjengalena. Uthe uhlala emqashweni eZimbokodweni kanti bese kuphele isikhathi eside ejola nowesilisa amgagule ngegama.Ngenxa yokuhlukumezeka uthe ugcine esemala. "Angikaze ngithole ukuhlukumezeka okunjeya empilweni yami. Lo muntu ubengishaya nsuku zonke. Angagcini lapho aphinde ashaye nomntwana wami engamthola komunye engangithandana naye ngaphambi kokuba ngihlangane naye. Le nto ibingihlukumeza kakhulu,'' usho kanje. Uthe ngenxa yaleso sizathu ugcine ebona kukuhle ukuthi akamane amale ukuze engagcini esephuma ngebhokisi kulobu budlelweno.''Ngikhethe ukumane ngimshiye ngoba bese ngibona kahle ukuthi uma ngiqhubeka ngihlala, ngizofa. Ngamtshela naye ngesikhathi ngimala ukuthi sengikhathele wukuhlukumezeka nesibhaxu sakhe sesingakhathazile,'' echaza.Uthe owesilisa wamane wamtshela emakhaleni ukuthi akaliwa yena ngoba akasiyona into yokudlala. ''Wangitshela ukuthi njengoba ngashelwa nguyena kusho ukuthi uyena futhi oyosho uma esefuna ukuthi kuhlukwane.'' Uthe owesilisa ubenawo umkhuba wokuza emqashweni wakhe okwaMakhutha ezomncenga ethi ufuna babuyelane. Uqhube wathi ngoLwesihlanu ufikile njengenjwayelo kwathi uma ephinde emchitha wamtshela ukuthi usekhathele wukumncenga kumele azi ukuthi indlu yakhe yomqasho uzoyishisa ntambama."Angizange ngizitshele ukuthi uqinisile ngale nto abeyisho kanti umuntu akadlali uzobuya ngempela ngalolu suku,'' usho kanje.Uthe ngenhlanhla ngesikhathi ebuya ezoshisa indlu yena ubengekho esaphumile. ''Ngiyazibuza nje ukuthi yini ebizokwenzeka ukuba bengikhona endlini.'' Ubalise ngokuthi ufe olwembiza njengoba kungqongqe yonke into yakhe ebikade ikhona ngaphakathi endlini. "Kuyimanje ngisele ngiyimina anginazingubo, anginayo indawo yokuhlala. Yaze yabuhlungu into eyenziwe ngumuntu ngoba nakhu enqaba ukwaliwa nje."Umnikazi wendlu yomqasho uNksz Nomvula Dlamini, uthe sibashiye bebambe ongezansi isenzo sowesilisa. Uthe naye wamuzwa owesilisa esonga esho ukuthi uzolishisa igumbi okuhlala kulona owesifazane uma kuya ngokuthi uyaqhubeka nokudaza inkani engafuni babuyelane. Ethintwa umsolwa ebuzwa ngalolu daba uvele waluvala ucingo. Eseshayelwa okwesibili bese lungasangeni.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, usiqinisekisile isigameko. Uthe kusolakala ukuthi owesilisa owaziwayo endaweni ungqongqise indlu yomqasho yomuntu wesifazane amaziyo eZimbokodweni. Uthe amaphoyisa aphenya leli cala kodwa imbangela ibingakaziwa.
BAPHITHENE amakhanda abaholi bakahulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal ngesakhiwo sezintombi sika-R154 million esisanda kuphothulwa esigodlweni eNyokeni okungacaci ukuthi kuzokwenzekani ngaso njengoba uMkhosi woMhlanga usuzobanjelwa esigodlweni eisha seSilo eMashobeni.UMnyango weMisebenzi yoMphakathi KwaZulu-Natal kanye neDA bathe banethemba lokuthi isakhiwo ngeke sigcine sisele kanjalo, singasetshenziswa muntu.UMphathiswa woMnyango weMisebenzi yoMphakathi, uMnuz Martin Meyer, uthe isakhiwo bese siphothuliwe. Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nesiteshi sethelevishini esikhokhelwayo.Le sakhiwo sezintombi saqalwa ngo-2014 ukwakhiwa ngesikhathi kusaphethe iSilo uGoodwill Zwelithini kaBhekuzulu.Ukwakhiwa kwaso bekushaya ngolonwabu. Inhloso yaso kwakuwukonga imali esetshenziselwa ukuqashela izintombi amatende uma kunoMkhosi woMhlanga.Isakhiwo sinendawo ekwazi ukumumatha abantu abangu-2 000, izindawo zokushintsha, amahhovisi nendawo yokupaka izimoto.Isakhiwo simbozwe ngothayela. ISilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini, simemezele ukuthi umkhosi wakulo nyaka uzokuba sesigodlweni eMashobeni, oPhongolo. UMeyer uthe isakhiwo esisha bekufanele sisebenze okokuqala eMkhosini woMhlanga wakulo nyaka ozokuba ngoSepthemba 12."Kade nje bengithumelela izithombe zesakhiwo esisha. Engingakusho wukuthi sihle kakhulu le sakhiwo futhi bese silangazelele ukubona isakhiwo siqala ukusebenza."UMeyer uthe iSilo sinelungelo lokunquma ukuthi imikhosi izobanjelwa kuziphi izigodlo. Uthe bathandazela ukuthi isakhiwo singasali kanjalo."Lesi sakhiwo sizolekelela abantu bakwaNongoma. Ngiyathemba ukuthi ikhona enye indlela esizosetshenziswa ngayo."UMeyer uthe uhulumeni wesifundazwe uzokuba nezingxoxo neSilo ngalolu daba. "Undunankulu (uMnuz Thami Ntuli) usazisile ngesinqumo seSilo, wasitshela ukuthi usazokuba nezingxoxo neMbube ngalolu daba."Okhulumela i-DA kwezeMisebenzi yoMphakathi, uNksz Tammy Colley, uthe sebebhalele uNtuli, becela ukuthi isakhiwo esisha singasali kanjalo."Siyakuvuma ukuthi iSilo sinegunya lokunquma ukuthi imikhosi kufanele ibanjelwe kuphi nendawo. Kodwa ke into esingeke siyibalekele wukuthi lapha kusebenze imali yomphakathi kwakhiwa eNyokeni. Manje isakhiwo sesiphothuliwe. Sinokwesaba ukuthi le sakhiwo sizogcina singasebenzanga futhi sizogcina singasanakekelwa."Uthe:"Kufanele sichazelwe ukuthi kuzokwenzekani ngale sakhiwo njengoba uMkhosi woMhlanga usuzobanjelwa esigodlweni esisha. Yingakho sifuna incazelo kundunankulu, uMnyango weMisebenzi yoMphakathi obuwakha isakhiwo esisha, kanye noMnyango wezobuCiko namaSiko okuyiwo okhokhele isakhiwo esisha."
SEKUQUBUKE indida ngokungqongqa kwendlu esigodlweni seSilo esisha okuthuthelwe kuso uMkhosi woMhlanga.Ukusha kwendlu eseduze nelawu leSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini esigodlweni eMashobeni, kubashiye nemibuzo engaphenduleki abaseNdlunkulu.Ngokuthola kweSolezwe le ndlu ehlala amaphoyisa, ishe yangqongqa ngoMsombuluko ebusuku. Umthombo uthe amaphoyisa agada iMbube acishe asha aphela kulo mlilo okungacaci kahle ukuthi udalwe yini.Umthombo osondelene nodaba uthe kusize ukuthi amaphoyisa adubule umnyango ukuze athole intuba yokuphuma."Aphume kanzima amaphoyisa ngoba umlilo uvele washa ubuhanguhangu." Omunye umthombo waseNdlunkulu uthe kuyakhathaza ukusha kwendlu ikakhulukazi njengoba indlu eshile iseduze nelawu leSilo."Cishe sezwa okunye laphaya. Kulula ukuthi umlilo ubungokheleka kwezinye izindlu njengoba zisondelene futhi zifulelwe ngotshani. Okukhathaza kakhulu wukuthi le nto yomlilo isithanda ukuxaka eNdlunkulu. Uma uzokhumbula nakwaFihlinqindi (emzini wengwevu yaseNdlunkulu, uMntwana uPhilemon kaTshelendoda kaDinuzulu), sekuze kwasha kabili. Kufanele ibhekisiswe le nto. Kukhona okungalungile."Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kokhulumela iSilo, uMntwana uThulani Zulu, ayizange iphumelele.Akucaci ukuthi ngesikhathi kusha iMbube ibikuphi. Ngesikhathi efonelwa, uMntwana uThulani ukhale ngokuthi uphuthuma emhlanganweni.Uthembise ukufonela intatheli emva kwemizuzu eyishumi, akabange esalubamba ucingo esephinde efonelwa.Kusha indlu nje ngempelasonto bekukade kunoMkhosi weSivivane kuso lesi sigodlo. Kulo mkhosi iMbube imemezele ukuthi yonke imikhosi yaseNdlunkulu emikhulu isizobanjelwa esigodlweni esisha.Phakathi kwemikhosi emikhulu ezobanjelwa khona kubalwa noMkhosi woMhlanga, ozokuba ngoSeptemba 12.UMkhosi woMhlanga ububanjelwa esigodlweni eNyokeni kule minyaka engu-40 eyedlule. Ukususwa komkhosi eNyokeni sekudale itwetwe lokuthi isakhiwo sezintombi sezigidi zamaRandi esisanda kuphothulwa kulesi sigodlo ngeke sisasetshenziswa.Isakhiwo sika-R154 million esinendawo ekwazi ukumumatha abantu abangu-2 000, izindawo zokushintsha, amahhovisi nendawo yokupaka izimoto, sisanda kuphothulwa.Le sakhiwo sezintombi saqalwa ngo-2014 ngesikhathi kuphethe iSilo uGoodwill Zwelithini kaBhekuzulu. Ukwakha bekushaya ngolonwabu.Bekubhekwe ukuthi isakhiwo sisebenze okokuqala uma sekunomkhosi wakulo nyaka.Khonamanjalo ikomiti lasesiShayamthetho KwaZulu-Natal elibhekele ukusebenza koMnyango weMisebenzi yoMphakathi, liye kohlola isakhiwo esisha.USihlalo wekomiti, uMnuz Nhlanhla Msimango, uncome umsebenzi owenziwe yizinkampani ebezakha isakhiwo esisha.UMsimango uthe lezi zinkampani zenze umsebenzi oseqophelweni eliphezulu.
INkantolo yeSifunda eMadadeni igwebe indoda eneminyaka ewu-41 ubudala ngecala lokubulala ingoduso yayo ngoJulayi 2024 eJakkalspan, eNewcastle.Ummangalelwa nomufi oneminyaka ewu-29 bebehlala ndawonye njengoba wayelobolile ummangalelwa ekhweni lakhe.Bebenezingane eziwu-4 abazithola ndawonye. Ngo-11 Julayi 2024 kwaqubuka ingxabano phakathi kwabo bebodwa ekhaya. Ummangalewa wayesola umufi ngokumolela. Ingxabano yabo yashuba, ummangalelwa waklinya umufi wambulala. Waya emzini womfowabo eyombikela ukuthi useklinye umkakhe wambulala. Watshela umfowabo ukuthi uzozonikela emaphoyiseni. Wafika emaphoyiseni wabika udaba wathathwa amaphoyisa ayobona isidumbu wase eyaboshwa wathweswa icala lokubulala.UMshushisi uZama Zikalala ubize umfowabo kammangalelwa wafakaza, yiphoyisa elabikelwa nalo lafakaza, kwethulwa nombiko wokuhlolwa kwesidumbu.UZikalala ekhonga isigwebo esiqinile uthe ummangalelwa wake walahlwa yicala lokushaya umufi. Ngaphezu kwesigwebo, inkantolo ithe ummangalelwa akafanelwe wukuba nemvume yokuphatha isibhamu.
UPHOQELEKE ukuthi ungcwabe umlenze wodwa umndeni womfundi waseNtshawini, KwaDukuza, ngeSonto, kuhamba isikhathi zingatholakali ezinye izingxenye zezitho zakhe, kulandela ukuminza ngesikhathi ebhukuda olwandle nabangani.UMnqobi Mngadi (15) obefunda uGrade 8 eTshelenkosi High, eShakaville, kuthiwa waminza ngoJulayi 1, kulo nyaka, ehambe nabangani abane olwandle "KwaMjekisi", okungavumelekile ukubhukuda kulo olungaseMvoti Mouth. Unina, uNksz Zinhle Mngadi, utshele Isolezwe ukuthi bagcine benquma ukulungcwaba lodwa unyawo lwendodana yakhe njengoba bebebona kuhamba isikhathi zingatholakali ezinye izitho. Elandisa ngesigameko, uthe indodana yakhe yaminza ngesikhathi yona nabangani ababili sebebhukuda isibili, abanye ababili sebephumele ngaphandle kolwandle, bekhala ngokuthi abasazizwa kahle."Kuthiwa baqale baya phambili bonke, okubalwa naye uMnqobi. Laba abanye ababili, babonakala bebuya, yena washona phambidlana, okuyilapho azwakala esememeza khona umngani wakhe omkhulu (owayekulaba ababehleli ngaphandle kolwandle), ethi akayomcelela usizo ngoba akusabhukudeki, kukhona into embambe unyawo,” kusho uNksz Mngadi.Uthe bazama abangani ukubiza abahlengi (lifeguards), abafika ntambama, bekhala ngokuthi balitshaziswe ukuthi baqale baya kolunye ulwandle "laKwaMjekisi" olukwenye indawo, beluphambanisa nalolu okwakwenzeke khona isigameko. "Bambheka kodwa bangathola lutho, bakhala nangokuthi lapho okuthiwa uminze khona kugcwele amatshe kangangoba kukhona ngisho nawudonga,” kusho kanje unina. Uthe ukucingwa kukaMnqobi kwagcina sekudluliselwa kubatshuzi (divers), ababelokhu bemcinga kodwa ngendlela engawugculisi kahle umndeni."Babengangeni ngaphansi bayobheka kodwa babelokhu betshuza ngaphezulu. Bathi ingane yami ayisekho la eyayiminze khona, bathi isidumbu sayo sesingaphuma kolunye ulwandle KwaDukuza, Richards Bay kanjalo nasePort Shepstone,” usho kanje. Uthe kukhona abenkampani ezimele ababatshela ukuthi babukile ngezipopolo, babona kukhona into esasidumbu egaxele ematsheni kodwa kuthi uma lolo lwazi selwedluliselwa kubatshuzi bamaphoyisa, bavele baluchithe, bathi inhlabathi leyo ebonwe abezipopolo.Udalule ukuthi omunye owayesuka kubatshuzi baseThekwini amgagule ngegama, walimisa ngesihloko elokuthi ngeke yena abeke engcupheni impilo yabatshuzi bakhe ngoba ulwandle luphenduka ngamandla kule ndawo okuthiwa kubonwe kuyo into esamuntu ngezipopolo, wathi bekuwuJulayi 7, emva kwezinsuku ezimbili kade eyonikela eBuhleni, ngesikhathi ethola umbiko wokuthi kutholakale umlenze olwandle lwaseZinkwazi. "Ngiyile ukuyolubheka, ngilahlela, ngafika ngabona ukuthi akulona olwendodana yami. Nakuba kunjalo, amaphoyisa angiyalela ukuthi ngenze ulibofuzo,” kusho uNksz Mngadi. Uthe uthole ucingo emaphoyiseni ngo-Agasti 1, 2025, amaphoyisa ethi isibuyile imiphumela yolibofuzo, wathi athe abeze bezoyibheka ngo-Agasti 4, 2025."Sithe uma sifika, sathola ukuthi ithi owayo indodana yami umlenze,” usho kanje. Uthe babe sebeluthatha beluyisa emakhazeni azimele, okuyilapho aphinde wayolubukisisa kahle esephethe nesithombe. "Ngigcine ngibona ukuthi olwayo ngempela indodana yami, sengibukisisa ngisho nezinzwane.” Uthe okwenze balubambela inkonzo yomngcwabo kwangathi kungcwatshwa umuntu ophelele, ukuthi abantu abazi isizulu bathe kuyenziwa lokhu ezimweni ezifuze lezi. "Ngithe angivele ngingcwabe lokhu okukhona ngoba anginaso isiqiniseko sokuthi zikhona yini ezinye izitho engiyobuye ngizithole,” kusho uNksz Mngadi.Uthe ubone kungeke kumsize ukulokhu ehlalise umlenze undendende emakhazeni, waqhuba wathi kukhona amasiko enziwe okubalwa nelokugeza amanxeba njengoba kucaca ukuthi indodana yakhe ayishonanga ngokugula. Uveze ukuthi baphinde benza elinye isiko lokuhlanganisa isidumbu sakhe ngokomoya. "Uma kukhona ezinye izingxenye zesidumbu sakhe ezitholwayo emva kwalokhu, nazo ngiyozingcwaba ngokuthi ngigubhe lapho esingcwabe khona umlenze, ngizifake,” usho kanje. Nokho uthe namanje usezwa ubuhlungu ngokumehlele, wathi usele nemibuzo yokuthi zishonephi ezinye izitho zendodana yakhe.Sishicilelele amaphoyisa engakaphenduli ngalesi sehlakalo.
KULINDEKELE ukuthi ihluke indlela obekuphekelwa ngayo abafundi ezikoleni ezahlukene kuleli njengoba abakwaKnorrox nenkampani yakwa-Unilever, beqale umkhankaso wokuqeqesha abesifazane abaphekela abafundi ezikoleni ezahlukene kuleli.Kulo mkhankaso oqale esifundeni iKing Cetshwayo, esikoleni iShowe High, abesifazane abaphekela abafundi baqeqeshwe ngezinto ezithinta ukuhlanzeka nokwenzela abafundi ukudla okumnandi nokunomsonco.UNksz Naledi Mhlane wakwa-Unilever uveze ukuthi uhlelo lolu akade baluqala lokungenelela ezintweni ezithinta izindawo okuphekelwa kuzo ezikoleni. "Kulo nyaka sibone ukuthi ake senze ukudla okudliwa izingane kube okunambithekayo njengoba sikhiqiza ukudla okugcwele umsoco ohlukene. Ngakho sibone kubalulekile ukuthi sihlangane noMnyango wezeMfundo ukuze kukhuphuke izinga ngoba kukhona izingane ezithembele kukhona lokhu kudla futhi sifuna izingane zikujabulele ukudla ezikutholayo,” kusho uNaledi.Uthe bangaphezu kuka-5 000 abesifazane abaphekela izingane kanti bazothatha ababili ezikoleni ezehlukene ezifundazweni."Uma sisuka lana siya eGauteng, sizolokhu sihambela izifunda ezehlukene ngakho sijabule ukuthi kukhona ulwazi abazohamba nalo balusebenzise,” kuchaza yena. UNkk Sibahle Simelane obemele uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uthe bayabonga kakhulu kulezi zinkampani ezimbili ezikhethe ukusukumela into ebaluleke kangaka ethinta impilo yabafundi."Njengomnyango thina asinayo imali esingenza ngayo izimfundiso zalolu hlobo. Kodwa siyabonga kwabakaKnorrox no-Unilever ngokuthi basukume baqale bahambise ukuqeqeshwa komama. Siyazi ukuthi luzohamba ibanga elide, ngeke nje baluthathe manje bese beyaluyeka,” kuchaza yena.Uthe bona bebenohlelo lokuthi ukudla kwezingane kumele bakuphathe kanjani futhi kuhlale ezindaweni ezinjani ukuze kuhlale kuvikelekile. UNksz Zaphezulu Dludla ongumpheki eLittle Flower Primary, uthe bayabonga ngokuzothola ukuqeqeshwa njengoba kwezinye izikole bezithola izinongo ezenza ukudla kube mnandi ezinye bengakutholi."Singakujabulela ukuthi izinongo zibe khona ekudleni kwezingane ngenxa yokuthi kuyasiza kukwenze kunambitheke. Ngijabule ukuthola ukuqeqeshwa ngisho kubapheki abaphezulu abasikhombise ukuthi sisebenzise izipuni ezinjani, amapulangwe esiqobela phezu kwawo nokunye,” kuchaza yena.
U-AGASTI awupheleli emigubheni nasezinhlelweni ezahlukene zokukhumbula iqhaza elibanjwa ngabantu besifazane emphakathini nasezweni lonke phecelezi i-Women's Month, kepha futhi waziwa nangokuthi yi-Hair Loss Awareness Month, lapho okusuke kwenziwa khona izinhlelo nemikhankaso eyahlukene yokuqwashisa abantu ngokuqothuka kwezinwele.Udokotela wesikhumba ozimele ozinze eThekwini uDkt Cebi Sibisi uthe lesi yisikhathi esihle kakhulu sokukhuluma ngokukhululeka ngezinguquko abantu besifazane abaningi ababhekana nazo ikakhulu uma sebesesigabeni se-menopause, lapho abasuke bengasangeni ezinsukwini zabo nyangazonke futhi bengeke besakwazi ukukhulelwa, bazale izingane."I-menopause yisigaba esenzeka empilweni yawo wonke umuntu wesifazane uma esekhulile, esiza nezinguquko eziningi emzimbeni kubandakanya ukuba namabala namaqhuqhuva ebusweni, ukuqothuka kwezinwele, ukushintsha kombala wesikhumba nokuthi some nkwe, kanti zonke lezo zinguquko kungaba nzima ukuzamukela uma ungazi ngazo," kucebisa uDkt Sibisi. Uthe konke lokhu kudalwa wukuthi isikhumba nezinwele kuyakhombisa uma kuwukuthi sekunezinguquko ezenzeka emzimbeni wakho ikakhulu kwabesifazane, okudinga ukuthi abantu bakuqonde lokhu kusenesikhathi ukuze kungabagqilazi emqondweni uma sekwenzeka.Kungani isikhumba nezinwele kushintsha uma usungene kwi-menopause?Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi i-hormone ebizwa nge-oestrogen, esiza ukugcina izinwele nesikhumba kunempilo, iya ngokuya incipha emzimbeni uma owesifazane esekwi-menopause, okuzoqapheleka ngalezi zimpawu ezilandelayo: - Ukuphela kwe-collagen ne-elasticity emzimbeni, okwenza ukuthi isikhumba sigoqane, kube nemigqa ehlukanisa izinwele, kube nezikhala phakathi kwazo.- Ukoma kwesikhumba ngokweqile kunokwejwayelekile.- Ukuba namabala namaqhuqhuva ikakhulukazi ebusweni nasezandleni.- Ukuncipha kwezinwele ezinhlangothini zekhanda nasokhakhayini.- Ukumila koboya obumhloshana ebusweni.UDkt Sibisi unamathiphu angasiza ukubhekana nezinguquko ze-menopause:- Ukuphuza amanzi amaningi ngosuku, uwathake ngezithako zezithelo ezinempilo ukusiza ukubuyisa amandla esikhumbeni.- Ukusebenzisa imikhiqizo ye-sunscreen usakhula nje ukuze ukhule isikhumba sakho siyijwayele.- Sebenzisa imikhiqizo egunyazwe ngabezempilo yokususa amabala namaqhuqhuva ebusweni nasemzimbeni.- Qaphela indlela oyisebenzisa ukunakekela isikhumba sakho njengoba sizwela kalula kunoma yini oyisebenzisa kusona.- Lala ngokwanele futhi ugweme izinto eziphazamisa umqondo wakho ngoba ukugqilazeka emqondweni kudala ingcindezi esikhumbeni sakho. - Gwema ukudla okusheshayo nokunamafutha amaningi, bese ugxila kokunempilo okungaba yizithelo, imifino nokunama-protein.- Gwema ukugeza ngamanzi ashisa kakhulu ngoba aba nomthelela omubi esikhumbeni sakho. "Wonke umuntu wesifazane ubhekana nezinguquko ze-menopause ngendlela ehlukile nehambisana nendlela adalwe ngayo, ngakho akumele ukuthi ubhekane nalezi zinguquko wedwa ngoba zikhona izindlela zezempilo zokuzixazulula," kucebisa uDkt Sibisi.
UMBUSO ufuna bavikelwe ofakazi abengeziwe ecaleni lokubulawa kukamrepha uKiernan ''AKA'' Forbes.Lokhu kuhlaluke izolo eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini, ngesikhathi kuqhubeka icala. Lo mrepha wadutshulwa wabulawa ekanye nomngani wakhe uTebello ''Tibz'' Motsoane bengaphandle kwendawo yobumnandi iWish ekuFlorida esigamekweni esenzeka ngoFebhuwari 2023.Ngemuva kwalokho bakhalelwa ngamasongo kaSigonyela oMnuz Lindokuhle Mkhwanazi, Lindani Ndimande, Siyanda Myeza, Mziwethemba Gwabeni noLindokuhle Ndimande. Babekwe amacala okubulala nawokuzama ukubulala. Umshushisi u-Advocate Lawrence Gcaba, utshele inkantolo ukuthi ngeke bawadlulisele kwabamele abasolwa amagama abanye bofakazi kuleli cala. Uthe nezitatimende zabo ngeke bazidlulisele kubona. Lokhu uthe bakwenza ngaphansi kwesigaba u-144 obavumelayo ukuthi lokhu banegunya eligcwele lokuthi bangakwazi ukukwenza.Kuvelile ukuthi ofakazi uMbuso ongafuni ukubadalula yilabo abazokwengezwa uma sekuqaliwe ukuqulwa kwecala.Omunye wabameli babasolwa u-Advocate Jimmy Howase SC, ukuvezile enkantolo ukuthi udaba lwalabo fakazi kanye nezitatimende zabo uke walubhunga noMbuso. IJaji uJacqueline Henriques walile ukuthi kube nempikiswano phakathi koMbuso nabameli babasolwa mayelana nalolu daba ekhala ngokuthi kukhona abezindaba. Kuvunyelwane ngokuthi icala liguqe lize libuye ngoJuni 19 ngonyaka ozayo, lapho kuzobe sekunesixazululo salokhu.Kuvunyelwane nangokuthi izitatimende zalabo fakazi ziyodluliselwa kwabamele abasolwa sekusele amasonto ayisithupha ngaphambi kokuba kuqale ukuqulwa kwecala. Phambilini kuyona le nkantolo kwavela ukuthi bangu-45 ofakazi osekuqinisekisiwe ukuthi bazofakaza uma icala seliqulwa.
ISEYINDABA egudwini namanje eNsalabantu, KwaMaphumulo, eyomakhelwane okuthiwa bahlanganyele umakhelwane wabo, bambulala ngesando nange-screwdriver ngoLwesithathu olwedlule.Kuthiwa isidumbu sikaMnuz Sibongakonke Sakhile Ngobese (25) wakule ndawo, sitholwe ngoLwesine emhosheni osezimobeni eKearsney, edume ngeleKheyizeni, ngaKwaDukuza.Kuvela ukuthi ubephelile yisando ekhanda, kuthi entanyeni nasesifubeni embobombobo yi-screwdriver. Isolezwe lithole ukuthi kubasolwa abathathu ababoshiwe, kukhona ababili abasafunda isikole. Lithole nokuthi kusekhona owesine osagcwele amathafa. Uyise kamufi, uMnuz Mshu Ngobese, elandisa ngesigameko uthe umufi obezisebenza ngokuthi athuthe izingane zesikole kanjalo nezasenkulisa, bamgcina ekhaya ngoLwesithathu ntambama."Kuthe ngezikhathi zantambama unina owayekhona ekhaya, wabona imoto yakhe idlula ishushuluza ngaphandle komuzi yayojoyina umgwaqo obheke KwaDukuza, uR74,” kusho uNgobese. Uthe unina waqala lapho ukumfonela umufi kodwa kwanhlanga zimuka nomoya ngoba ucingo kwakhe lwalukhala lungabanjwa.Uveze ukuthi bebona kuhamba isikhathi, esinye isihlobo sathi akufakwe ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ukuthi kuduke umufi nemoto yakhe."Akuphelanga nemizuzu engu-20, kwase kukhona abaphawulile ukuthi imoto isitholakele eThembeni, eGroutville, KwaDukuza. Kwaphoqa ukuthi uhlelo lwethu lokuyobika umuntu odukile emaphoyiseni aKwaMaphumulo lushintshe, sivele sinikele KwaDukuza, siyobheka umkhondo owase utholakele,” usho kanje. Uthe nebala bathola ukuthi yiyo imoto yendodana yakhe eyase ibanjwa abezinhlaka eziqapha ubugebengu eThembeni, abasolwa bekhuluma into engahlangani.Udalule ukuthi njengoba abezinhlaka bathi ukubathintathinta, balihlanza lonke iqiniso lokuthi umufi bambulala, base beyomlahla esimobeni."Baveza ukuthi babanjwa nje babesendleleni belibangise eThekwini lapho babeyodayisa khona imoto. Bagonyuluka nangokuthi indodana yami bayibulalela khona KwaMaphumulo, bathi ngesikhathi unina eyibona imoto idlula ngehubo ngaphandle komuzi, base bevele bembulele,” kulandisa uNgobese. Uthe baveze ukuthi bambulele ngoba bebezama ukugqiba ubufakazi ngoba umufi bebemazi kakhulu.Uqinisekise eyokuthi bebazana ngempela umufi nabasolwa."Yizingane lezi ezingomakhelwane futhi bebejwayelene kakhulu, nathi sesazi ukuthi zingabangani bakhe. Ngisho eba nendlela, ubeye acele eyodwa yazo ukuthi ayithathe imoto yakhe, imthathele izingane abezihambisa esikoleni nasenkulisa,” kusho uNgobese. Uthe abasolwa bayizingane kunomufi, wathi omunye wabo uneminyaka engu-17 kanti usafunda isikole."Simuncu isimo, siphatheke kabi ngokubulawa kwengane yethu ebibazisa kakhulu abantu, ihlonipha, inomusa, ihlale izihlekela nje. Ngisho nasemphakathini, wonke umuntu umangele ukuthi igcine ibulawa ngesihluku esingaka,” kusho uNgobese. Uveze ukuthi ngisho nomunye wemindeni yabasolwa uze waphimisa amagama okuthi ngendlela esibi ngayo isigameko, bafisa sengathi bekungathi uma sekumi itende lomngcwabo kamufi, lime nasekhaya labo, kungcwatshwe omunye wabasolwa ngoba ingane yabo ikhathazile ngobugebengu. Uthe umufi ubengesiyo ingane ehluphayo, kodwa ubethanda ukuzizamela, wathi ubeye amlekelele ngisho nangomsebenzi wokwakha njengoba yena (uyise) engumakhi. Uveze ukuthi le moto ayibulawelwe, kwakungeyendodakazi yakhe eyashona engozini yomgwaqo ngo-2023, kwathi uma kusala imoto yayo, umufi wakhetha ukuqala umsebenzi wokuzisebenza ngayo, ehambisa izingane esikoleni nasenkulisa.Uthe umphakathi ubathembise ukuthi uzoyomasha enkantolo uma abasolwa sebevela, uphikisane nokuthi badedelwe ngebheyili. Siye koshicilela amaphoyisa engaphendulanga ngalesi sehlakalo.
KUZOQOPHEKA umlando ngenyanga ezayo, uma uDkt Nomcebo Mthembu, owaziwa ngokuba wungoti kwezocansi, aphinde abe wumsunguli weNdoni SA, eseba owokuqala wesifazane webala elinsundu ukuvula isibhedlela sokwelashwa ngokomqondo esithi yena. Lesi sibhedlela, iMedilution Wellness Retreat esiKwaGengeshe eRichmond kulindeleke ukuthi sivulwe maphakathi noSepthemba.Elandisa Isolezwe ngaso uthe, sizosiza ngosizo lokwelashwa kulabo abaphethwe yizifo ezehlukene ezithinta umqondo, phakathi kwazo kukhona ukhwantalala, ingcindezi nezinye. Uthe isibhedlela sizokwamukela iziguli eziyizingane ezinezinkinga zomqondo ezidalwe wukuhlukumezeka emakhaya, esikoleni nokunye."Sizophinde samukele neziguli ezingabantu abadala ezibhekene nezinkinga ezehlukene emakhaya, emsebenzini, othandweni, ababhekene nesahlukaniso emshadweni nokunye,” kusho uDkt Mthembu.Uqhube wathi ukusebenza kwalesi sibhedlela kuzothi ukwehluka kunokwezinye izibhedlela ezijwayelekile njengoba kuzoxuba izindlela zokwelapha ngokwasentshonalanga kanjalo neokwesintu. Ubuye waveza nokuthi kuzoba khona imisebenzi (activities) ezokwenza ukuthi abantu bakhumbule ukuthi bangobani."Okokuqala nje, indawo okwakhiwe kuyo isibhedlela iyodwa, iyawelapha umqondo ngoba inezintaba namagquma okuhle okukuthatha kukubeke. Kukhona nomfula oseduze, uMkhomazi, nawo odlala eyawo indima ukukubuyisela emvelweni,” kusho uDkt Mthembu.Uthe nezakhiwo zesibhedlela bazenze ngendlela yokuthi isiguli esingena phakhathi, siphume selaphekile emphefumulweni. "Kukhona amagumbi afulelwe ngotshani, kube khona asindwa ngobulongwe phansi nokuyinto okuthi uma eyibona umuntu, azikhumbule ukuthi ungubani uphumaphi. Lokhu kuphinde kudlale nendima enkulu kwezempilo njengoba ubulongwe bubodwa, bunamakhemikhali awusizo emzimbeni womuntu,” usho kanje.Echaza ngezinye zezinto ezizokwenziwa yiziguli kulesi sibhedlela uthe, kuzoke kube khona isikhathi lapho umuntu ephuma khona nodokotela wakhe wengqondo bayosusa ukhula engadini bebe bexoxa."Uma beqeda lowo msebenzi udokotela uzobe esehlala phansi nesiguli, esibuza imibuzo efana nokuthi kusho ukuthini ukususa ukhula, uma sesikuthatha sikubuyisela kweyaso impilo lokhu abazobe bekade bekwenza engadini,” kusho uDkt mthembu. "Ngizinikele emsebenzini wokwelapha imiqondo, ukubuyisa isithunzi kulabo abalwa nezinkinga zomqondo,” usho kanje. Esikhathini esiningi abantu bahlukumezeka buthule, besaba ukwahlulelwa. Bengifuna ukuthi ngiqhamuke nento ehlukile lapho ukwelashwa kungekho ngomtholampilo kuphela kodwa kufake isiko kuphinde kuthi thasi nemvelo,” usho kanje.Uthe njengomuntu wesifazane webala elinsundu, kuphoqe ukuthi alwe ngokuphindaphindiwe ukuveza izindlela ezintsha zokwelulekwa ngokomqondo, nabebala elimnyama abasele ngaphandle kuzo. Angu-57 amathuba omsebenzi azodaleka ngokuvulwa kwesibhedlela, kuwona kukhona odokotela bazozonke izifo, abeluleka ngokomqondo, abahlengikazi, abahlanzi, nabanye kanti sizokwazi ukwamukela abantu abangu-100 ngesikhathi, abangu-60 abadala, bese kuba yizingane esezithe ukukhula (teenagers) angu-40. Udalule ukuthi enye injongo yakhe ngesibhedlela wukuthi athathe enye yemali esizoyenza, ayiphonse esikhwameni seNdoni SA, ukuze kuqhubeke umsebenzi wokukhulisa intsha yaseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi iqhubeke iziphathe kahle."Ngalesi sibhedlela, ngifuna ukuthi kube khona umnikelo ophumayo uye kwiNdoni ukuze umsebenzi wayo, obandakanya ukuholelwa kwabasebenzi abenza umsebenzi wayo uqhubeke,” usho kanje.UDkt Nomcebo akamusha kwezokwelapha njengoba eseneminyaka engaphezu kuka-20 eyibambile emkhakheni wezokwelapha. Usebenze iminyaka ezibhedlela zikahulumeni kanjalo nakwezizimele ngaphambi kokuba azivulele eyakhe indawo yokusebenza iMedilution ngo-2017 enamagatsha amabili eHillcrest naseRichards Bay, lapho elapha khona iziguli ngamakhambi asentshonalanga kanjalo nezindlela zesintu. Wazakhela udumo iminyaka eyisishiyagalombili emsakazweni iGagasi FM ohlelweni no-Alex Mthiyane lapho ayebeka khona izinto ngembaba uma ekhuluma ngezithinta ikamelo. Sekuphele iminyaka emithathu adlulela kuKhozi FM, lapho esaqhubeka khona nezinkulumo ezifanayo.
USUKHETHE ukuthi uvele uziphelezele uma ziya esikoleni izingane zawo umphakathi wasekuPheleni, kwesaKwaMthethwa eMfolozi, kulandela ukutholwa kwesidumbu somfundi obelahlekile sidindilizile, sinezibazi.Isidumbu sikaKhethokuhle Ncube (16) obefunda uGrade 9 esikoleni iGome High, sitholwe ehlathini elibude buduze nakubo ngoLwesine olwedlule.Umufi kuthiwa waduka ngoJulayi 31, ephume ekhaya eya esitolo sendawo, maqede wangabe esabuya. Ngokusho kukamamkhulu wakhe, uNksz Smangele Mthiyane, umufi waphuma ekhaya ntambama eyothenga ama-data esitolo sendawo.Uthe umndeni waqala ukuthuka ubona kushaya u-6 kuya ku-7 ebusuku engabuyi. Uthe baqala lapho ukuthinta abantu abehlukene ngezingcingo, waqala ukubhekwa yonke indawo. Uqhube wathi ngakusasa bavuka bayobika emaphoyiseni, ngesikhathi amanye amalungu omndeni ebambisene nomphakathi bebheka yonke indawo. "Sacinga yonke indawo eseduze nasekhaya, sabheka ezikhotheni nasemahlathini, lutho ukumthola,” kusho uNksz Mthiyane.Uthe baqhubeka bemcinga nsuku zonke kwaze kwaba uLwesithathu.Uveze ukuthi ngoLwesine okutholwe ngalo umufi, bakhetha ukungayi ukuyomcinga, ngoba sebedidekile ukuthi sebezophuma babheke kuziphi izinkalo. Uthe ugcine etholwa yizingane zesikole, ebezibuya esikoleni."Ziqale zathola iselula yakhe, itshingiwe eduze nendlela lapho okulula ukuthi ibonakale khona,” kusho uNksz Mthiyane.Uqhube wathi emva kokubona iselula, kwathi uma ziqalaza futhi endaweni, zabona uphaqa wakhe umufi. "Zibe sezithi ake ziqhubeke nokubukisisa kahle kuleli hlathi, zazithela phezu kwesidumbu sikamufi, maqede zavele zayobiza abantu abadala,” usho kanje.Uthe ngesikhathi umndeni ufika endaweni yesigameko, waqaphela ukuthi umufi unezibazi emzimbeni, ezihlakaleni kunokusikeka okukhombisa ukuthi ubeboshiwe. "Okusididayo wukuthi kuleli hlathi atholwe kulo, sibheke siphindelela, engekho. Siyakholelwa ekutheni isidumbu sakhe sibekwe emva kwezinsuku enyamalele,” kusho uNksz Mthiyane. Uthe lesi sehlo sitshale ukwesaba emindenini njengoba abazali sebekhetha ukuthi baziphelezele izingane zabo uma ziya esikoleni."Wonke umphakathi uthukile, abantu abazi ukuthi kwenzekani. Manje sebeyaziphelezela izingane zabo uma ziya esikoleni, bazihlangabeze uma sezibuya,” usho kanje.Uthe ngesikhathi besafuna ukwazi ngokunyamalala kukamufi, bathole ukuthi wafika esitolo, wawathenga ama-data. "Kuthiwa ngesikhathi esebuya eza ekhaya, waze wahambisana nenye ingane yasendaweni, sekuhwalala. Yasitshela ukuthi babuyisana, yona yase ihluka ingena endleleni ebheke kubo, naye waqhubeka neyakhe indlela,” kusho uNksz Mthiyane.Uthe le ngane yabatshela ukuthi wayicela ukuthi imphelezele njengoba wayesezizwa esesaba, kodwa yala, yathi nayo iyasaba.Uthe bayabufuna ubulungiswa ngesigameko, wathi basalinde kuhlolwe isidumbu ukuze kuvele ukuthi umufi ubulawe kanjani. Uveze ukuthi iselula yakhe ibilokhu idonsa ezindaweni ezikude ezehlukene ezinsukwini ezimbalwa emva kokunyamalala kwakhe. Udalule nokuthi ivele yangabe isadonsa nhlobo.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa aKwaMbonambi aphenya icala lokubulala kulandela ukutholakala kwesidumbu sowesifazane osemncane esikhotheni ngoLwesine."Ngesikhathi amaphoyisa efika endaweni yesigameko, athole isidumbu sinamachaphazelo egazi, sinezibazi emathangeni. Isidumbu sihlonzwe njengesentombazane uKhethokuhle Ncube, okwakubikwe ukuthi udukile,” kusho uNetshiunda.Uthe imbangela yobulawa kwakhe kanjalo nabantu abangaba abasolwa akukaziwa okwamanje.

UKHOMISHANA wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, unxuse ukuthi umnikelo 'wezinkomo ezimbili’ awunikelelwe abantu abasebenzisa inkundla yokuxhumana i-X, uyiswe esikhwameni semali efundisa izingane zamaphoyisa afela emsebenzini.UMkhwanazi usho kanje emva kokuvela kokuthi imali eqoqwe ngohlelo lweBack A Buddy Campaign, igcine ihlangana uR44 000.Yaba wumbono kaChris Excel, ongomunye wabasebenzisa inkundla yokuxhumana i-X, emva kokuthi uMkhwanazi ededele amabhomu esithangamini nabezindaba ekuqaleni kwenyanga edlule. UMkhwanazi uthe uthanda ukubonga kuChris Excel ngokuza nombono wokweseka ukusebenza kwamaphoyisa. "Nakuba umbono kwakuwukuthi ngithengelwe izinkomo futhi ngikuthakasela lokho, kodwa ngiyisisebenzi somphakathi. Umphakathi uvele uyangibonga ngokwanele ngomholo engiwuhola nyanga zonke. Ukhokhwa yimali yentela esiholelwa ngayo njengezisebenzi zomphakathi, nami ke ngingomunye wedlanzana elakhethwa ukuthi ngiwusebenzele umphakathi,” kusho uMkhwanazi.Uthe ngaleso sizathu, ufisa ukucela uChris Excel ukuba umnikelo awufake esikhwameni iSouth African Police Educational Trust (SAPET), ekhokhela izindleko zesikole zezingane zamaphoyisa abulawa esemsebenzini. "Unyaka nonyaka sihlanganyela eziNdlini zoMbuso ePitoli siyokhumbula amaphoyisa abulawa esemsebenzini. Amaningi awo, afa emancane, engakabi nemali etheni azoyishiyela izingane zawo,” kusho uMkhwanazi.Uthe lesi sikhwama silekelela kakhulu enfundweni yezingane ezisuke zisele dengwane.Khonamanjalo, ubuholi bamaphoyisa buzokwamukela amaphoyisa angu-1 918 embuthweni wamaphoyisa ezifundazweni ezehlukene namhlanje ekuseni. Lokhu kulandela ukuphothula kwawo ukuqeqeshelwa lo msebenzi emakolishi ehlukene. UNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa osabambile uSolwazi Firoz Cachalia noKhomishana wawo kuzwelonke uGeneral Fannie Masemola, bazoba yingxenye yokwamukelwa kwesibalo esikhulu sawo esingu-849, eSAPS Academy Bhisho e-Eastern Cape.Izifundazwe ezifana neWestern Cape (Bishop Lavis), Eastern Cape (SAPS Academy Mthatha), North West (SAPS Academy Mankwe), KwaZulu-Natal (SAPS Academy Ulundi) naseGauteng (SAPS Academy Moloto), zizothola ingxenye yamaphoyisa. Wonke lawa maphoyisa aqeda kuqeqeshwa kwi-Introductory Police Development Learning Programme (IPDLP). Kuthiwa wonke aneziqu zeCriminology, Policing, Law, Forensic investigation nezinye. Kuvela ukuthi azotshalwa eziteshini zamaphoyisa ezingu-30 ezihamba phambili ngezibalo zobugebengu obuyingozi eNingizimu Afrika yonke.
Abasolwa ababili abebefunelwa icala lokubulala iphoyisa, ukuzama ukubulala noxhaxha lwamacala okugebenga emzini yabantu behlomile badutshulwe babulawa ngesikhathi bedubulana namaphoyisa endaweni yaseMaplazini, rNanda ngoLwesibili ebusuku. Amaphoyisa asebenzise ezobunhloli ukulandela umkhondo wabasolwa abebefunwa, kanti imininingwane iholele amaphoyisa emzini oseMaplazini eNanda. Ngesikhathi amaphoyisa efika kulo muzi aziveza ukuthi angamaphoyisa ayalela abasolwa ukuthi bavule umnyango. Abasolwa baphendule ngezibhamu bebhekise emaphoyiseni bengaphakathi endlini kanti amaphoyisa asale engenakwenza lutho ngaphandle kokuthi adubule ukuze azivikele. Ngesikhathi sokudubulana, abasolwa ababili abaneminyaka engu-20 no-21 ubudala, badutshulwe baphelela khona lapho. Kutholwe kubasolwa isibhamu esicishiwe iserial number. Alikho iphoyisa elilimale ngesikhathi sokudubulana.
INENGEKILE indodakazi yommeli osanda kubulawa ngesihluku ngesikhathi umsolwa oyiphoyisa likaMasipala weTheku, ehleka kuvela elomhlathi ngesikhathi evela eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini izolo.USenior Constable Qiniso Sishi (40), ubevele enkantolo ngecala lokugwaza, abulale unkosikazi wakhe, uNkk Thandokuhle Sishi (48) ngoJulayi 27, 2025, emzini kamufi oseMontclair. Ngesikhathi uSishi evela enkantolo izolo bekulindeleke ukuthi afake isicelo sebheyili. Nokho ngesikhathi uMbuso, ngomlomo kaNksz Beauty Cele, uveza ukuthi usukulungele ukuthi kulalelwe isicelo sebheyili, ummeli wakhe uMnuz Musawenkosi Mkhize, uveze ukuthi akakulungele ukwenza lokhu.Udalule ukuthi ngoLwesihlanu wayehlele ukuthi babe nengxoxo nomsolwa okwagcina kungenzekanga njengoba bagcina bengabonananga. "Ngafika ejele laseWestville ngahlala isikhathi esingaphezu kwamahora amabili ngimlindile. Ngathola ukuthi usematasa nabezempilo njengoba egcinwe endaweni yabangaphilile ejele,” kusho uMkhize. Uthe wenze imizamo yokuthi atholelwe umsolwa ukuze baxoxe, nokho kwavela ukuthi akekho obenolwazi lokuthi ukuphi kahle hle. "Ngigcine ngingakwazanga ukuthatha imiyalelo kuye, ngakho angikwazi ukuqhubeka nokufaka isicelo sebheyili. Ngizobe angibenzi ubulungiswa,” kusho uMkhize. IMantshi, uMnuz Ashwin Singh, ilihlehlisele uMsombuluko ozayo icala ukuze umsolwa afake isicelo sebheyili. Umsolwa, obesasibhandishile isandla sangakwesobunxele, uqale wamoyizela ngesikhathi ethatha ikhona, ehla ngezitebhisi ezibheke esitokisini.Ithe indodakazi kamufi, u-Aphiwe Mkhize (18) engazalwa wuSishi, uma ikhipha amazwi athi "sengathi ungabolela ejele”, umsolwa wavele wahleka kwavela elomhlathi.Ngaphandle kwenkantolo u-Aphiwe uthe kumdinile, kwamphatha kabi futhi kwamthusa ukubona umsolwa ehleka. "Ngibone ezihlekela nje, sengathi ukubulala kwakhe umzali wami kuyinto engelutho. Ngizwa ubuhlungu ngokuthi yena ukwazi nokumoyizela, ahleke ekubeni owami umama eshonile,” kusho u-Aphiwe.Uthe usenze ngisho ne-petition ukuthi abantu bayisayine, ukuze bamlekelele ekutheni aphikisane nokuthi adedelwe ngebheyili.Uveze ukuthi akamfiseli ukuthi afe kodwa ufisa abolele ejele, naye ezwe ubuhlungu abuzwayo njengamanje ngokumphuca umuntu obeyikho konke kuye. "Umama wami ubeyikho konke kimi, ubewumzali, abe wumngani. Manje ngisele dengwane, impilo ayilula nhlobo ngaphandle kwakhe,” kusho u-Aphiwe.Uqhube wathi unina ubemthanda kakhulu umsolwa, emhlonipha kodwa yena wakhetha ukumbulalisa okwesilwane.Kulokhu u-Aphiwe ubephethe uqwembe olunomyalezo othi: "Ngiyathemba ukuthi ezobulungiswa ngeke zimenzele phansi umama wami ngokuthi zidedele umsolwa ngebheyili. Ngifisa angafi kodwa abolele ejele. Ngifuna ubulungiswa ngoThando Mkhize (Sishi).” Ngaphakathi enkantolo bekugcwele ngendlela yokuthi kuze kwaba khona abazama ukuhlala phansi. Inkantolo ishaye phansi ngonyawo yathi abangayitholanga indawo yokuhlala emabhentshini, abaphume bayolinda ngaphandle.Ngaphandle enkantolo bekukhona inqwaba ebibhikisha igqoke izimpahla zeMKP iphethe nezingqwembe ezibhalwe imiyalezo eyahlukene.
BAFUNA kuqiniswe ezokuphepha abazali babafundi abafunda esikoleni iJG Zuma High, kwa-L KwaMashu kulandela ukuphazamiseka kokufunda ngoLwesihlanu, kusatshwa ukusuka kothuthuva kungcwatshwa obeyilungu leqembu lemigulukudu, iWest ngempelasonto.Ngokuthola kweSolezwe, isikole sivalwa nje, bekusanda kufa ilungu leWest ngeledlule ngesikhathi kukhona ukudubulana phakathi kwayo (iWest) nelinye iqembu lemigulukudu endaweni.Umufi ungcwatshwe ngoMgqibelo. Kuvela ukuthi obekwenza amaphaphu abe phezulu wukuthi kubo kamufi kwakhelene nesikole. Ngokusho kukaSihlalo wesigungu esilawula isikole, uNkk Khanyi Mngomezulu, bewubuholi besikole bathathe isinqumo esisheshayo emva kokuthola umbiko ngoLwesine wokuthi kungase kusuke uthuthuva.Uthe kujwayelekile ukuthi kusuke uthuthuva uma kudlule oweWest. "Obeshonile sizwe kuthiwa ungcwatshwa ngoMgqibelo. Sibone kuwumqondo omuhle ukuthi kungabi khona ukufunda okwengeziwe (extra classes) njengoba bekuzobe kunenkonzo yomngcwabo,” kusho uNkk Mngomezulu. "Esikwenzile, besibhekelela isimo ukuvikela abafundi nothisha bethu ukuthi kungathi uma sekuqala uthuthuva, bese bethelwa amachaphazelo noma bavimbeke ngoba umgwaqo munye.”Uthe: "Siye sibone kuba nemibikisho, izixakaxaka nokuqhunyiswa kwezibhamu uma kufe amalungu ala maqembu. Ngokucabangela ukuphepha kwabafundi bethu ababalelwa ku-1 700, sibe sesinquma ngokuhlanganyela ukuthi akungafundwa ngoLwesihlanu.”Isolezwe lithole ukuthi amalungu aleli qembu ngeledlule abefuna umnikelo ngamabhakede ngaphandle kwesango lesikole ewufuna ngodli. Liphinde lathola ukuthi uhambo lwesikole obelungoMgqibelo, obekufanele lusukele esikoleni, lugcine lusukela enxanxartheleni yezitolo iBridge City, KwaMashu. UNkk Mngomezulu ukuqinisekisile ukuthi isimo sesibuyele kwesijwayelekile izolo, wathi balindele nokuthi ukufunda okwengeziwe okuba ngezimpelasonto kuqhubeke kahle ngempelasonto ezayo.Ekhuluma nabezindaba zeSABC, okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Muzi Mahlambi, uthe bazwile ngesimo ngoLwesihlanu ezikoleni ezakhele le ndawo. "Othishanhloko bezinye izikole ezakhele iNanda neKwaMashu basazisile ukuthi bazobhekelela ukuphepha ngokuthi bangavumi ukuthi othisha nabafundi beze esikoleni,” kusho uMahlambi.Okhulumela amaphoyisa, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, ekhuluma nesiteshi esifanayo sezindaba, uthe abazali kufanele basebenzisane namaphoyisa ukuthi kuqoqwe izibhamu ezigcwele ezinganeni. "Uma uwumzali ubona ingane yakho inesibhamu kufanele ukhathazeke. Kufanele wazi ukuthi leso sibhamu akusona esokuhlobisa, esokubulala,” kusho uNetshiunda. Uqhube wathi kufanele bazi abazali ukuthi ngelinye ilanga lezo zibhamu ziyobulala bona. Uthe okukhathazayo wukuthi wonke amalungu eWest yizingane ezingaphansi kweminyaka engu-20.Kuhlatshwe nekhwelo lokuthi kukanise amaphoyisa eduzane nesikole ukuze abafundi baphephe.Lesi sikole sidume ngemiphumela emihle kwa-matric siphinde sidume nangomculo. Saqanjwa ngowayengumengameli we-ANC nezwe okumanje uhola iqembu iMK uJacob Zuma.

Kodwa uthi intombi kamufi ithe umuntu owadubula wabulala umufi, waqhamuka ngasohlangothini lwakhe umshayeli. ''Asazi ukuthi lokhu kwenzeka kanjani. Thina sibona inxeba lokudutshulwa ngemuva ekhanda kanjalo nangaphambili. Khona lapho futhi sididwa nawukuthi emotweni belilincane kakhulu igazi,'' usho kanje.Uthe bayazibuza bayaziphendula ukuthi kwenzeka kanjani ukuthi igazi libe amaconsi amancane kanjeya kumuntu odutshulelwe emotweni. Ukhale ngokuthi bafuna izimpendulo ngalo mshophi ngoba okwamanje badukuza ebumnyameni.Uveze ukuthi intombi ibatshele ukuthi ngaphambi kokuba umufi adutshulwe ngabantu abangaziwa ubekade enze iphutha wangena emzileni obekungafanele angene kuwona wase ejikiswa yimoto ebihamba onogada angabazi. "Siyazibuza siyaziphendula ke ukuthi bese beshonephi labo nogada abaphindisele umfowethu emuva uma sekuqhamuka abantu bemdubula kungakapheli namzuzu nje ejikisiwe?'' Eqhuba uthe intombi ibatshele ukuthi umufi ufike kuyona ekhala izinyembezi ebiza igama lomunye umngani wakhe kodwa wangachaza ukuthi ukhaliswa yini. Uveze ukuthi kukhona abathile umufi ake wahilizisana nabo emasontweni ambalwa edlule kodwa uthi bebezitshela ukuthi yinto edlulayo nje.Leli phephandaba lizibonile izithombe zemoto kamufi inezimbobo zokudutshulwa ngaphambili. Kuze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela amaphoyisa engaphendulanga.

Uthe uboshwa nje, ubeyovela ngecala lokugqekeza nelokuzama ukubulala okuthiwa wawenza ngoNovemba 2024, ngesikhathi edubula umnikazi womuzi eHibberdene, maqede wamphuca imoto. Kuwona kuthiwa kukhona amathathu okubulala nelilodwa lokuzama ukubulala okuthiwa wawenza ngesikhathi edubula, ebulala abantu abathathu ababesolwa ngecala lokubulala okuthiwa balenza eMsinsini ngo-2021. Kuthiwa laba abathathu badutshulwa babulawa bengaphakathi emotweni ababehamba ngayo eHibberdene, beqeda kuvela enkantolo ngoJuni 27, 2024, ngecala abalenza ngo-2021. UNetshiunda udalule nokuthi amaphoyisa asaqhubeka nokubheka abanye abasolwa ababili okuthiwa babeyingxenye yokubulawa kukaKhoaele.
BABHIKISHE ngaphandle kwesibhedllela esizimele, iLife Westville bevutha bengabaselwe, bekhala ngokumiswa isigubhukane kukadokotela wenhliziyo osezakhele igama emphakathini.Kuvela ukuthi ezinye iziguli zakulesi sibhedlela zisale dengwane njengoba kumiswe uDkt Ntando Duze, okuthiwa usenokhakhayi oluqinile ekusebenzeni njengengodokotela wenhliziyo. Izolo kube nombhikisho befuna izimpendulo kulesi sibhedlela ngokumiswa kukaDuze. Ababhikishi bebephethe izingqwembe ebezinemibhalo ehlukene. Eminye yayo ibifundeka kanje: Hlukanani noDuze akanacala! Isono sikaDuze ukuba nsundu! Okwani ukucindezelwa kodokotela abansundu eWestville?Omunye wabahleli bale mashi, uMnuz Sandile Madlala, uthe baphume ngobuningi ukuzovikela igama likadokotela abakholwa ukuthi umiswe kungafanele esibhedlela.''Kukhona abathile abafuna uDuze ahambe ngaphakathi kulesi sibhedlela, ngeke sikuvume lokho ekubeni esiza abantu abaningi kangaka abanesifo senhliziyo,'' usho kanje. Umthombo ongaphakathi esibhedlela, uveze ukuthi zidinwe kakhulu iziguli ngokumiswa isigubukane kukaDkt Duze."Zicasukile kakhulu iziguli zifuna izimpendulo ngokumiswa kukaDuze. Zikholwa ukuthi kukhona abathile abamdinga ehambile ngoba enomthamo omkhulu weziguli futhi iziguli eziningi zithembele kuyena,'' usho kanje.Omunye umthombo ongaphakathi uthe ukumiswa kukaDuze kumayelana nabanye abangaphakathi abafuna izinyawo zakhe zigcwale udaka.''Konakele, bamfuna ehambile uDuze, banomona ngendlela asebenza ngayo,'' kusho umthombo. Omunye umthombo osondelene nalolu daba, uveze ukuthi kuneziguli ezithengiwe ukuze kungcoliswe igama likaDuze, okuholele ekutheni agcine esemisiwe zikhala ngokusebenza kwakhe.Kuvela ukuthi kunomunye wodokotela ohamba phambili ekukhandweni kwetulo lokumiswa kukaDuze.Ukumiswa kukaDuze kuvela ukuthi sekuze kwafinyelela nakumkhandlu iHealth Professions Council of Southern Africa ngamafuphi iHPCSA. Kuvela nokuthi kunamacala uDuze asewavulele abangaphakathi ebasola ngokudicilela phansi igama lakhe. Isolezwe linencwadi efungelwe yesinye seziguli siqinisekisa ukuthi besikade sisetshenziswa ngomunye wodokotela abangaphakathi ukuthi kudicilelwe phansi igama likaDuze.Ethintwa Duze, uvumile ukuthi umisiwe kodwa wathi akathandi ukuphawula ngalolu daba ukuze kungaphazamiseki uphenyo oluqhubekayo ngaye. Kodwa ukuqinisekisile uthe ufuna kuvele iqiniso ngabamkhandela uzungu.Umxhumanisi walesi sibhedlela nomphakathi, uMnuz Mark Raptie, uthe lolu udaba olubucayi abangekho esimweni sokuthi bangakwazi ukuphawula ngalo okwamanje.
UFONGQE isigqoko uhulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika ezingxoxweni zawo nohulumeni waseMelika ngodaba lwentela entsha eyengezwa emikhiqizweni yakuleli ethunyelwa eMelika.Uhulumeni wakuleli uzothumela isiphakamiso esisha kowaseMelika njengoba iqhubeka imizamo yokuba kuhoxiswe intela ka-30%, ekhokhwa yizinkampani zakuleli ezithumela imikhiqizo eMelika.Lezi zindaba zivezwe nguNgqongqoshe, wezeziMboni, ukuHwebelana nokuNcintisana, uMnuz Parks Tau, ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba. UTau uthe isiphakamiso esisha esizothunyelwa eMelika siphasiswe emhlanganweni weKhabhinethi obungesonto eledlule, wathi kulesi siphakamiso balungise zonke izinto iMelika ebikhala ngazo ngesikhathi kunezingxoxo."Isiphakamiso esisha sizothunyelwa ehhovisi lezohwebo eMelika. Sinethemba lokuthi isiphakamiso esisha sizodala ukuba sifinyelele esivumelwaneni. Le siphakamiso silandela esasithumela ngoMeyi. Esiphakamisweni esisha silungise kakhulu izinto iMelika ebikhala ngazo." Phakathi kwezinto iMelika ibikhala ngazo kubalwa imibandela eqinile ebekelwe izinkampani ezifuna ukuthumela inyama yenkukhu neyengulube kuleli."IHhovisi likaMengameli waseMelika lezohwebo lapha e-Afrika, lingazise ukuthi lizothumela ngomkhumbi inyama yenkukhu neyengulube emasontweni amabili ezayo. Lokhu kukhombisa ngokusobala ukuthi sezilungisiwe izinkinga ebezikhona."UNgqongqoshe wezoLimo, uMnuz John Steenhuisen, uthe sekucacile ukuthi kulezi zingxoxo akubangwa nje kuphela izindaba zokuhwebelana kodwa wathi kukhona okunye okubangwayo. "Le nto yenza kube nzima ukuthola isisombululo ngokushesha njengoba umbango ungasuswa indaba yokuhwebelana kanye nentela. Ingakho sizithola sikule simo esikuso njengamanje."USteenhuisen uthe maningi amazwe acuthele ukuthumela imikhiqizo eMelika."Uma usiqhathanisa namanye amazwe mincane imikhiqizo esiyithumela eMelika. Maningi amanye amazwe acuthele amakhasimende abetholwa izinkampani zakuleli. Lokhu kwenza ukuthi izingxoxo zibe nzima. Okunye kwenza ukuba izinto zibe nzima imithetho yakuleli." USteenhuisen uthe bazama ukuthola ezinye izindawo okuzothunyelwa kuzo imikhiqizo yakuleli."Akulula ukuvela sikhohlwe iMelika kodwa iqiniso ukuthi kufanele sibe siqala sibheka ezinye izindawo esingathumela kuyo imikhiqizo ukuze kungeke kukhahlamezeke izinkampani zakuleli ezithumela imikhiqizo eMelika."Uhulumeni wakuleli ufuna ukuthi izinkampani ebezithembele ekuthumeleni imikhiqizo eMelika, ziqale ukuthumela imikhiqizo yazo e-Asia, Europe nase-Afrika.
ABAHOLA izingxoxo ngesimo sezwe bathi ngeke baphazanyiswe wukuhoxa kwezinhlangano zamaqhawe omzabalazo.Abahola lezi zingxoxo bathe bayaqhubeka namalungiselelo omhlangano owandulela izingxoxo ozokuba ngoLwesihlanu. Bakusho lokhu ngesikhathi bekhuluma nabezindaba, izolo. Izinhlangano zamaqhawe omzabalazo ebezisekhaleni lamalungiselelo ezingxoxo, iThabo Mbeki Foundation, Steve Biko Foundation, Chief Albert Luthuli Foundation, Desmond and Leah Tutu Foundation kanye neFW de Klerk Foundation, zihoxile emalungiselelweni ezingxoxo.Lezi zinhlangano zikhale ngokungabi khona kwesikhathi esanele sokuhlelela izingxoxo, kanye nokungacaci kokuthi imali ezosetshenziswa ezingxoxweni izoba yimalini.USihlalo wekomiti elilungiselela izingxoxo, uMnuz Boichoko Ditlhake, uthe umhlangano wangoLwesihlanu uzoqhubeka yize sekuhoxe lezi zinhlangano. "Akusekho ukujikela emva kwendlu. Izingxoxo zizoqhubeka. Ngeke sivume ukulawulwa yizinhlaka ezithile. Abekho abantu okufanele babe ongqoshishilizi ezingxoxweni. Izingxoxo ezesizwe. Selokhu ziqalile izinhlelo sithole ukwesekwa abantu abaningi. Ukuhoxa kwabo ngeke kusiphazamise nakancane. Kulezi zinsuku ezine ezedlule kuningi kakhulu esikwenzile uma sizoqhathanisa nesikwenzile ngaphambi kokuthi kuhoxe lezi zinhlangano. Ngamafuphi nje ngingasho ukuthi ukuhoxa kwezinhlangano akusiphazamisanga, futhi ngeke kusiphazamise."UDitlhake uthe kumenywe abantu abangu-775 emhlanganweni wangoLwesihlanu ozoba senyuvesi yakuleli i-Unisa ePitoli. "Abantu abamenyiwe baqhamuka emikhakheni engu-30, bamele izinhlangano ezingaphezu kuka-300." UDitlhake uthe bazokonga imali ngokuthi abantu abasuka ezifundazweni eziseduze naseGauteng bangagibeli amabhanoyi. Okhulumela ikomiti elilungiselela izingxoxo, uMfu Zwoitwaho Nevhutalu, uthe enye imali ezosetshenziswa ezingxoxweni ayizukuqhamuka kuhulumeni njengoba kukhona izinhlangano ezizonikela."Ngokwezinhlelo u-60% wemali ezosetshenziswa uzoqhamuka kuhulumeni, lena enye izonikelwa yizinhlangano ezahlukene." UNevhutalu uthe kuyabamangaza ukuthi kukhona izinhlangano ezikhala ngokuthi asikho isikhathi esanele sokulungiselela izingxoxo. "UMengameli wafike wamemezela ukuthi kuzokuba nengxoxo ngesimo sezwe, akalukhiphanga usuku. Kwaba yibona abantu abamphoqa ukuba akhiphe usuku. Manje ke uselukhiphile usuku. Siqhamukaphi le sikhalazo sokuthi asikho isikhathi esanele ekubeni kuyithina ebesimjaha sithi akakhiphe usuku?"UNevhutalu uthe izingxoxo zizokuba khona kuzo zonke izingxenye zezwe."Kuzokuba nezingxoxo kuwo wonke ama-ward angaphezu kuka-4 000 akhona lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Sihlela ukuthi ewadini ngayinye kube nezingxoxo ezindaweni ezintathu ezahlukene. Kusho ukuthi ekugcineni sizokuba nezingxoxo ezindaweni ezingaphezu kuka-13 000 ezahlukene."
IKOMITI leMfundo eyisiSekelo ePhalamende likhale ngesenzo soMnyango weMfundo eyisiSekelo sokudedela kancane kancane imigomo emthethweni wezikole iBela Act.Leli komiti lithi le migomo bekumele idedelwe kanye kanye ukuze kungabikhona ukudideka emphakathini, futhi usheshe uqale ukusebenza umthetho.USihlalo wekomiti uNksz Joy Maimela, uthe babehlabe ikhwelo lokuthi imigomo idedelwe kanye kanye hhayi izikhawu.
