I-DA ifuna kuqedwe imithetho okuthiwa kuhloswe ngayo ukuthuthukisa abantu abamnyama kwezamabhizinisi nakumathuba emisebenzi.Ithe ifuna kuqedwe umthetho ophoqa ukuba kubhekelelwe izinkampani eziphethwe ngabantu abamnyama, iBroad-Based Black Economic Empowerment (BBBEE), kanye nophoqa ukuthi kubhekelelwe abantu abamnyama uma kuqashwa abazophatha izikhundla, i-Employment Equity Act.Umholi weDA, uMnuz John Steenhuisen, uthe bafuna nokuthi kuchithwe umthetho wokuthathwa komhlaba. Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba izolo. USteenhuisen uthe le mithetho emithathu abafuna ukuthi ichithiwe ixosha abatshalimali."Akusikhona ukuthi siphikisana nokuthi kube nezinguquko kodwa iqiniso ukuthi le mithetho yenza ukuthi umnotho ungakhuli ngenxa yokuthi abatshalibemali bayesaba. Le mithetho ayibasizi ngalutho abantu bakuleli abafuna imisebenzi. Ingakho sifuna ukuthi iphele. Into ezothuthukisa abantu ukuba kuqedwe imithetho evimba ukukhula komnotho. Izigidi zabantu bakuleli zifuna imisebenzi. Indlela yokuthuthukisa abantu ukuba ubanikeze amathuba emisebenzi." USteenhuisen uthe iBBBEE ihlomulisa idlanzana elithile losomabhizinisi. "Osomabhizinisi abancane bayacindezeleka ngenxa yokuthi kuhlomula idlanzana elithile elisondelene nabantu abakhipha amathenda. Maningi amabhizinisi asafufusa agcina ewe bhu phansi ngenxa yokuthi uxhaso lutholwa ilabo abazana nabathile kuphela."USteenhuisen uthe umnotho wakuleli awukhuli ngenxa yale mithetho emithathu. "Uma uzobheka kule minyaka ewu-15 eyedlule, izinga labantu abangasebenzi likhulile lisuka ku-22%, njengoba selisondele ku-33% manje. Uma uzobala nalaba asebaphonsa ithawula ekufuneni umsebenzi, kusho ukuthi empeleni bangu-43% abantu bakuleli abangasebenzi."USteenhuisen uthe bazophakamisa ukuba kube nezinguquko emithethweni yakuleli ukuze kuzovuleleka zonke izinkampani ezifuna ukutshala imali, kukhule umnotho, kuphinde kudaleke amathuba emisebenzi. USteenhuisen uthe bafuna ukuthi uhulumeni uyeke ukutakula izinkampani zawo ezicwile ezikweletini, kuliwe nenkohlakalo, kuphinde kulungiswe izinkinga ezibhekene nomasipala. "Angixoxi inganekwane lapha kodwa ngikhuluma ngento thina esiyenzayo esifundazweni esisiphethe, iWestern Cape, kanye nakomasipala esibaphethe. Umnotho ukhula kangcono kulezi zindawo eziphethwe yi-DA."Uthe: "Ngizokwethula iziphakamiso zethu emhlanganweni weKhabhinethi. Ngifisa ukuthi uMengameli (Cyril Ramaphosa) aseke iziphakamiso zethu zokukhulisa umnotho. Ngizophinde futhi ngenze izethulo ePhalamende. Phela ePhalamende kusemphelandaba, lapho kuxoxwa khona zonke izindaba."
IZOBHEKANA nomqansa i-ANC emizamweni yayo yokwandisa isibalo samaqembu ayingxenye ohulumeni wokubambisana njengoba iqembu lesibili ngobukhulu kulohulumeni ophethe, iDA, lithi angeke livume ukuba kwandiswe amaqembu.Umholi weDA, uMnuz John Steenhuisen, uthe abahambisani nokuba kwandiswe amaqembu kulohulumeni ophethwe owakhiwe amaqembu ayishumi.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba, izolo.I-DA iyiqembu lesibili kuhulumeni wokubambisana ukuba liphikisane nesiphakamiso sokuba kwandiswe amaqembu njengoba neFF Plus nayo isanda kuveza ukuthi ayihambisani nalesiphakamiso. Umhlangano wesigungu esiphezulu kwi-ANC wathatha isinqumo sokuba kwandiswe amaqembu ayingxenye yohulumeni wokubambisana.Lesinqumo sathathwa emva koqhekeko olwabonakala emaqenjini abusa ngokubambisana ngesikhathi kufanele kuvotelwe isabelomali.I-DA neFF Plus baphuma eceleni bangasivotela isabelomali esasinesiphakamiso sokuba kunyuswe intela ngo-0.5%. I-ANC yagcina yesekwa amaqembu amancane angeyona ingxenye yohulumeni wokubambisana, i-ActionSA, neBosa, ngesikhathi kuvotelwa isabelomali.Ekugcineni sahoxiswa isiphakamiso sokunyusa intela ngenxa yokuthi iDA neFF Plus babeqhubeka nokusiphikisa.USteenhuisen uthe i-ANC ayikwazi ukuvele inqume ukwandisa isibalo samaqembu ayingxenye yohulumeni wokubambisana. "I-ANC kufanele ikhumbule ukuthi kunesivumelwano eyasisayina ngesikhathi kwakhiwa uhulumeni wokubambisana. Nesivumelwano sinemibandela okufanele ilandelwe yiwo wonke amaqembu ayingxenye yohulumeni wokubambisana. Imibandela ikubeka kucace ukuthi yini okufanele yenziwe uma kufanele kujoyine iqembu elisha. Kofanele kube nesibalo esanele samaqembu ayingxenye yohulumeni wokubambisana azokweseka ukuba kujoyine amaqembu amasha."USteenhuisen uthe bona abasiboni isidingo sokuba kwandiswe amaqembu okwamanje.
Kusolwa ababhikishayo edolobheni laseKurhuleni ngokusha kwamahhovisi omnyango wezaseKhaya.Yize ingacacile okwamanje inqikithi yombhikisho kodwa imigwaqo ephazamisekile uPresident street, Queen street kanye noJack street. Ngokwesitatimende samaphoyisa kamasipala waseKurhuleni, kukholakala ukuthi ibhilidi loMnyango wezaseKhaya lishiswe ababhikishi. Umxhumanisi wedolobha laseKurhuleni nabezindaba uWilliam Ntladi uthe imigwaqo eminingi ithintekile. UNtladi uthe bathole ucingo ngabo-8 ekuseni kubonakala ilangabi kuleli bholidi. "Ibhilidi loMnyango wezaseKhaya liyangqongqa. Lesi yisakhiwo esinezitezi ezimbili njengamanje ingxenye ephezulu yilena evutha kakhulu, engezansi, sisalwela ukugqekeza siyobheka ukuthi kwenzakalani," kuqinisekisa uNtladi.Uqhubeke wathi njengoba sebewunqobile umlilo, kuzophenywa ngembangela yawo.Uthi ngeke aqinisekise ukuthi quale kanjani kodwa abakuzwile ngomanalapho wukuthi ababhikishi baphonse ibhomu likaphethiloli phezulu kuleli bholidi.Njengamanje imigwaqo esondelene nale ndawo kanjalo namabhilidi aseduze kusavaliwe ukuqinisekisa ukuphepha kwabantu.
UNOBHALA jikelele omusha weMK, uDkt Bongani Mncwango, uthi akasiyena umafikizolo kwezepolitiki. UMncwango uthe into eyenza ukuthi abantu abaningi bangamazi, wukuthi akasiyena unontandakubukwa.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba emva kokwethulwa kwakhe. UMncwango wethulwe ngokusemthethweni esithangamini nabezindaba, ebesingoLwesihlanu eGoli. UMncwango ungena esikhundleni esivuleke emva kokuxoshwa kukaMnuz Floyd Shivambu. Ungumuntu wesishiyagalombili ukubamba isikhundla sikanobhala jikelele kwiMK. Usihlalo weMK, uMnuz Nkosinathi Nhleko, uthe uMncwango unesipiliyoni sokuphatha seminyaka engu-35.UNhleko uthe uMncwango uke waba yisikhulu esiphezulu ezinhlanganweni iSanlam HealthCare neNetcare 911.Nokho abantu abaphawulile bathe abamazeli lutho uMncwango kwezepolitiki. Eziphendulela, uMncwango uthe uyisishoshovu esaziwayo kwezepolitiki."Ngike ngaba yisishoshovu ezinyunyaneni zabasebenzi. Ngike ngaba usomaqhinga ezinhlanganweni eziningi. Nayo iMK ngike ngayilekelela ukuqhamuka namaqhinga. wukuthi angisiyena umuntu othanda ukuzigqamisa yingakho kukhona abantu abathi abangazi. Ukuthi kukhona abantu abathi abangazi akusho ukuthi ngiwumafikizolo."UMncwango uthembise ukubuyisa uzinzo kwiMK. "Okwami wukuqinisekisa ukuthi inqola ayiphumi endleleni. Into ebalulekile wukubona iqembu likhula."IMK iphinde yamemezela ukuxoshwa kukaShivambu.UShivambu usezinhlelweni zokusungula iqembu elisha.UNhleko uthe bambhalele uShivambu incwadi emazisa ngokuxoshwa kwakhe eqenjini. "Sibonile ukuthi uhambe ekhuluma kabi ngeqembu. Ngeke sisamphendula ngenxa yokuthi sekuphelile obekusihlanganisile."UShivambu uthe uyakwamukela ukuxoshwa kwakhe kwiMK, wathi ngeke asiphonsele inselelo isinqumo esithathwe wubuholi beqembu.Uphinde wamemezela ukujoyinwa obeyiphini likanobhala jikelele weMK, uNksz Nombuso Mkhize. UNksz Mkhize wethulwe ngokusemthethweni ngoLwesihlanu, akucaci ukuthi ushiye nini kwiMK. IMK ayipholisanga maseko, yaqoka uNksz Nomsa Dlamini, njengephini likanobhala jikelele elisha.IMK iphinde yamemezela ukuqokwa kobhekelele ukuhlela ukusebenza kweqembu, uMnuz Aleck Nkuna.IMK ithe lezi zinguquko ezintsha zizolekelela emkhankasweni wayo wokhetho lohulumeni basekhaya oluzayo.
UKUTHUTHELWA koMkhosi woMhlanga esigodlweni seSilo esisha, eMashobeni, sekususe imibuzo yokuthi kuzokwenzekani ngesakhiwo sezintombi esisha esidle izigidi zamaRandi esakhiwa eNyokeni.ISilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini, simemezele ukuthi yonke imikhosi emikhulu yesizwe isizokwenzela eMashobeni, eMpakama, oPhongolo.Kule mikhosi kukhona nowoMhlanga obuhlezi ubanjelwa esigodlweni eNyokeni kule minyaka engu-40 eyedlule. Uhulumeni wakha isakhiwo sezintombi sikaR154 million esigodlweni eNyokeni.Inhloso yesakhiwo bekuwukunciphisa izindleko uma kunomkhosi njengoba besingeke sibe khona isidingo sokuqasha amatende uma sesiphothuliwe.Bese kusele kancane ukuba siphothulwe isakhiwo njengoba izikhulu zikahulumeni zike zaya kosibhekana ezinyangeni ezimbili ezedlule. Kubukeka izintombi zingeke zisasisebenzisa isakhiwo kulandela isimemezelo esenziwe yiMbube, eMkhosini weSivivane.Okhulumela iSilo, uMntwana uThulani Zulu, nokhulumela uMnyango wezobuCiko namaSiko KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Ntando Mnyandu, banqabile ukuphawula ngesikhathi bebuzwa ukuthi kuzokwenzekani ngale sakhiwo njengoba kuthuthwa uMkhosi woMhlanga.UMntwana uThulani uthe uzokhipha isitatimende emva kokukhuluma neSilo. UMnyandu yena uthe umnyango awukezukuphawula ngalolu daba.IMbube ibeke uNdlunkulu omusha, uSihle Mdhluli, esigodlweni eMashobeni.Kulesi sigodlo sekuke kwaba noMkhosi wokweShwama. Akucaci ukuthi lisigodlo esisha sinazo yini izinsiza ezifanele umkhosi omkhulu njengowomhlanga.Kube okokuqala ngqa emlandweni, uMkhosi weSivivane ubanjelwa eMashobeni.IMbube ithe uZulu kufanele amukele ukuthi yonke imikhosi isizokwenziwa eMashobeni. "Ngiyazi ukuthi sonke besesijwayele ukuthi yonke imicimbi ibanjelwa esigodlweni eNyokeni, kodwa-ke sesiyokhalela ngaphakathi ngoba isiko yilona elisikhombayo ukuthi yini okufanele yenzeke."UMkhosi wokweShwama ubanjelwe khona lapha. Lowo ngumkhosi owandulela yonke imikhosi yasendlunkulu. Njengoba owanamuhla ulapha nawo. UMkhosi woMhlanga owandulelwa ngowasesigodlweni eMachobeni, eNgwavuma, nawo uzobanjelwa khona lapha eMashobeni. Lesi yisigodlo sikandlunkulu wami uMaMdhluli."Ungoti wezamasiko uthe kuthusile ukuthuthwa komsamo kaZulu ngenxa yokuthi bese kujwayeleke ukuthi umsamo useNyokeni. USolwazi Sihawu Ngubane, waseNyuvesi yaKwaZulu-Natal, uthe iSilo uGoodwill Zwelithini kaBhekuzulu, asizange siwususe umsamo eNyokeni ngesikhathi sibusa."Saqhubeka nokuya eNyonkeni yize sabe sinesigodlo saso KwaKhangelamankengane, sesiphumile kwaKhethomthandayo. Siyathuka sonke ngoba bese sijwayele eNyokeni."UNgubane uthe akukho okuphambene nesiko uma iSilo sinquma ukuthutha umsamo."Ukususwa komsamo kuyabikwa. Kufana nokulanda umuntu oshonile. Uyabika. Nawo amakhosi amadala ayimimoya, ayalandwa. Namakhosi amadala akhothamela ezintabeni, njengoCetshwayo, alandwa."
IZOTHELEKA KwaZulu-Natal inhlangano iMayibuye Consultation Process, ukuzovukuza abantu bakulesi sifundazwe ukuthi bayeseke njengoba izongenela ukhetho elilandelayo.Le nhlangano iholwa ngobengunobhala jikelele oxoshwe eqenjini uMkhonto weSizwe, uMnuz Floyd Shivambu.UShivambu ukuqinisekisile ukuthi bazongenela ukhetho lohulumeni basekhaya ngonyaka ozayo nokhetho lukazwelonke. Wasungula le nhlangano emva kokususwa kulesi sikhundla yiMK, wathi ufuna ukuzwa amanzi ngobhoko ngokuthi ahambele imiphakathi ehlukene efuna ukuzwa imibono yayo mayelana nokuthi kusungulwe iqembu lezepolitiki elizongenela ukhetho. Uthe abantu abaningi bavume ngo-elethu ukuthi balisungule iqembu, libhalisele ukungenela ukhetho."Sisemkhankasweni wokubhalisa iqembu ukuze lingenele ukhetho lwangonyaka ozayo nokheho lukazwelonke. Sifuna ukudla umhlanganiso eGauteng nakwezinye izifundazwe kuleli," usho kanje. Ukusho lokhu ekhuluma emhlanganewni obuseGoli izolo, wathi bazoba nezinhlaka ezehlukene okubalwa izinyunyana zabasebenzi, uphiko lwezitshudeni nezinye izinhlaka eqenjni."Sihambele izifundazwe ezehlukene ukukhuluma nabantu ukuthola lwabo mayelana nokuthi ikuphi okumele sikwenze. Izinhlaka ezehlukene esikhulume nazo okubalwa abefundisi, abaholi omdabu, umphakathi jikelele, bathe bafuna iqembu elizobayisa phambili hhayi nje kuphela elizongenela ukhetho," usho kanje. Uthe abantu bathe kumele kuliwe nendlala, kufukulwe abantu enkingeni yokungasebenzi kuphinde kulungiswe izinkinga ezibhekene nezwe."Kunethimba lodokotela, elisiza mahhala ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza zezempilo, bhusende. Lokhu likwenza ngokunikelela umphakathi. Sisemkhankasweni wokuthi sifake amanzi ezindaweni ezinenkinga yamanzi," kusho uShivambu.Uthe ngeke bagcine ngokwenza izethembiso ezingekho kodwa abantu bazozibonela bona umsebenzi abazobe bewenza. "Sifuna ukuthi maphakathi nenyanga ezayo, sikwazi ukuyethula ngokusemthethweni le nhlangano njengeqembu lezepolitiki. Yingakho siqhubeka nokulalela abantu njengoba siseGauteng namhlanje," usho kanje.Uthe yingakho bezoba KwaZulu-Natal kusuka ngoLwesithathu kuze kube uMsombuluko ozayo, lapho bezobe behlangene nezinhlaka ezehlukene."Sifuna ukuthola umbono wezitshudeni, abefundisi, abaholi bomdabu nezinye izinhlaka zomphakathi. Abantu baseKZN kade belokhu besinxenxa ukuthi size kubona ukuze bazobeka umbono wabo nge-Africa Mayibuye," kusho uShivambu. Uthe abantu baphenduka izigqila emaqenjini abo abathembisa izinto ezingekho.I-MK ithe imxoshe uShivambu ngoba ubelokhu ekhuluma kabi ngeqembu.UShivambu uthe uyakwamukela ukuxoshwa kwakhe kwiMK, wathi ngeke asiphonsele inselelo isinqumo esithathwe ubuholi beqembu.
IHHOVISI likaMemgameli seliveze ukuthi lilandela yonke imigudu ebekiwe ukwehlisa izindleko njengoba kuzoba nengxoxo ngesimo sezwe kuleli sonto.Okhulumela uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, uMnuz Vincent Magwenya, uthe kulandelwa yonke imigomo ebekiwe yokusebenzisa imali kule ngxoxo ezoba senyuvesi i-Unisa, ePitoli, kusuka ngoLwesihlanu nangoMgqibelo.Uthe ikomiti eliholwa nguMnuz Paul Mashatile, iPhini likaMengameli wezwe, nezinye izinhlaka lisebenze ngokuzikhandla ukuzama ukuqoqa imali yokubamba isithangami sikazwelonke. "I-Unisa izobamba le ngxoxo mahhala, ngeke kukhokhwe lutho. Kunezinye izindawo ezitholakele okuzobe kubhungelwa kuzona, ezinye okuzosetshenzelwa kuzona. Imali ezosebenza kule ngxoxo yokuqala iqhamuka kwiNedlac," usho kanje. Uthe bathole neminikelo yezinto ezehlukene ezizobe zisetshenziswa kuyona."Sikwenze lokhu ngoba sifuna ukwehlisa umthwalo obhekene nohulumeni. Sizoqhubeka nokuhlwaya imali ezinhlakeni ezehlukene." Uveze nokuthi le ngxoxo iyaqhubeka nakuba kube nokungaboni ngaso linye kwezinye izinhlangano ezigcine zihoxa. Imibiko iveze ukuthi ezinye zezinhlangano bezifuna ukuthi ihlehliselwe olunye usuku.UMagwenya uthe uRamaphosa uthe ayiqhubeke ingxoxo ngoba abantu bayilinde ngabomvu. "Izinhlangano zithe zizohoxa ekubeni yingxenye yabahleli kodwa zizoqhubeka nokuba yingxenye yayo. Sinxusa abezinhlaka ezehlukene ukuthi baqhubeke babambe iqhaza kulesi sithangami ngesimo sezwe," usho kanje.Kulo mbuthano kulindeleke izinhlangano ezibalelwa ku-200, eziqhamuka emikhakheni engu-33 ehlukene.Phambilini kwakunemibiko ethi le ngxoxo izodla u-R700 million, okuyinto eyachithwa nguRamaphosa.
LIYAQHUBEKA nokulenga ukhiye ihhovisi lemeya kuMasipala waseMpendle njengoba kusathombe ukhiye ezingxoxweni zokuqoka imeya entsha, ezovala isikhala esavuleka ngenyanga eyedlule.Abe-ANC kuthiwa kabavumelani ngokufanele angene esikhundleni esavuleka emva kokuketulwa kukaMnuz Buyisani Mlaba, owakhishwa ngesiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bakhe.I-ANC inezihlalo eziyisithupha kweziyishumi kuMasipala waseMpendle. Isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaMlaba saphumelela ngenxa yokuthi amakhansela e-ANC awazange avote, okwenza ukuthi amakhansela amane amaqembu aphikisayo akwazi ukuqumba phansi uMlaba.Umthombo weSolezwe uthe abaholi be-ANC kabavumelani ngokuthi ubani okufanele athathe isikhundla.Amaqembu aphikisayo athe ukungaqokwa kwemeya entsha kuphazamisa ukuhanjiswa kwezidingo. Ikhansela le-IFP, uMnuz Sadewu Ngubane, lithe ukungabi khona kwemeya kumise izinto eziningi ikakhulukazi njengoba lingekho iphini lemeya."I-ANC ayibakhathalele abantu. Ihhovisi lemeya likhulu kakhulu. Akufanele lihlale livaliwe. Umphakathi waseMpendle awuzitholi izidingo. Sekungaze kuphele izinyanga ezimbili ihhovisi lemeya livaliwe? Kuvalwe thaqa ehhovisi lemeya, abasebenzi bakhona balele."UNgubane uthe njengoba ingekho imeya, imihlangano yamakomiti awumgogodla wokuphathwa komkhandlu, isigungu esiphezulu nelezezimali, ayihlali. "Lokhu kwenza ukuthi nemihlangano yomkhandlu ingahlali ngoba kusuke kufanele ukuthi ibhunge imibiko eqhamuka kula makomiti."UNgubane unxuse uMnyango wezekuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal, ukuba ungenelele."Umthetho uthi imeya kufanele iqokwe emva kwezinsuku ezingu-14." IKhansela le-EFF, uMnuz Sifiso Zuma, likhale ngombango wangaphakathi kwi-ANC elithe ubambezela izinhlelo zokuqokwa kwemeya entsha."Thina asinawo amandla, i-ANC inamakhansela amaningi. Asikwazi ukuhlangana ngaphandle kwamakhansela e-ANC. Njengamanje abavumi ukuba kubizwe umhlangano womkhandlu. Kubhajwe kubona, umdonsiswano ukwi-ANC. Bayabanga ukuthi ubani okufanele akhethwe abe imeya. Iphutha le-ANC."Imenenja yomkhandlu, uMnuz Zakhele Tshabalala, ithe bona balinde i-ANC ukuba iqede izinhlelo zayo zokuqoka imeya entsha. "Umkhandlu awungeni kakhulu lapha kodwa kusele ngaseqenjini lezepolitiki elithintekayo ukuba liphothule izinhlelo zalo."UTshabalala uthe umkhandlu uyaqhubeka nokusebenza ngokwejwayelekile yize ingekho imeya.Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kukaSotswebhu we-ANC, uMnuz Thabani Makhaye, kayizange iphumelele.Ngesikhathi eshayelwa ucingo ngoLwesihlanu, wacela ukuthi athintwe izolo. Akazange alubambe ucingo ngesikhathi eseshayelwa.
