Stellenbosch FC (0) 0Kaizer Chiefs (1) 2IKAIZER Chiefs igcine isithembiso ngokwehlula iStellenbosch emdlalweni wokuqala wesizini ka-2025/2026 yeBetway Premiership e-Athlone Stadium, eKapa.Amagoli aqinisekise ukuthi Chiefs ibuya namaphuzu amathathu avalelwe phakathi nguNkosingiphile Ngcobo kuyi-free kick esiwombeni sokuqala, kusaphele imizuzu engu-15 kuphela umdlalo uqalile, noGlody Lilepo obekuyiphenathi ngesikhathi esengezwe ngunompempe. IStellenbosch izithole isishoda kusaphele imizuzu engu-13 kuqale umdlalo kulandela ukukhishwa ngekhadi elibomvu kukaSiviwe Nkwali emuva kokudlalisa kabi uWandile Duba ngaphandle kwebhokisi eseyobhekana nonozinti. Okuqaphelekile esikimini seChiefs esiqale umdlalo wukuboshelwa komgadli osemncane uNaledi Hlongwane okhushulelwe esikimi esikhulu ekupheleni kwesizini edlule, esuka kweseDStv Diski Challenge, nobekungumdlalo wakhe wokuqala esigabeni sePremiership. Kanti ebhentshini leChiefs bekuhleli uKhalil Ben Youssef ongelinye lamaphini omqeqeshi uNasreddine Nabi ophuthume isigubhukane ekhaya, eTunisia, ngemuva kokulimala komkakhe ngoLwesihlanu. Ngokunqoba izolo, iChiefs isishaye iStellies emidlalweni eyisihlanu ilandelana kwazise ngesizini edlule iyixebule kane emiqhudelwaneni eyahlukene. Ukucosha kwayo amaphuzu akubuzwa ukuthi kubajabulisile abalandeli ababheke lukhulu kule sizini kwazise iqembu lisayinis inqwaba yabadlali abasha. Ngaphandle kwalokho, uNabi ubathembisile ngesonto eledlule ukuthi Amakhosi azoba yiqembu elihlukile kule sizini kwazise selivuthiwe ibhodwe abelipheka ngedlule lapho beqede khona isomiso ngokuwina indebe yeNedbank Cup.Emuva komdlalo neStellies izolo, uYoussef uthe bathembisile ukuthi bazowina kwiStellies ngenxa yesimo abhekene naso uNabi."Kufanele ngisho ukuthi sithembise umndeni waMakhosi ukuthi sizowuwela umqeqeshi lo mdlalo senzele umkakhe ukuze abe ngcono, alulame. Siyaziqhenga ngabadlali, badlale kahle kakhulu. Sibe nenkinga kancane esiwombeni sokuqala emuva kokuba izimbangi zithole ikhadi elibomvu, sicabange ukuthi umdlalo usuphelile. Sibe nenhlanhla ukuthi asingenelwanga yigoli. Esiwombeni sesibili sishintshe izinto eziningi. Siyabajabulela abalandeli, yonke indawo kuhlala kusekhaya. Nabo bajabule manje ngoba sesiwuqedile lo mdlalo, sesizoqala ukucabanga ngomdlalo olandelayo esizowudlala nePolokwane. Sinezinsuku ezimbili zokuphumula, sekufanele sicabange ngomdlalo olandelayo,"kusho uYoussef kuSupersport.Akubuzwa ukuthi abalandeli baMakhosi balindele ukuthi aqhubeke nomgqigqo omuhle uma esebhekene nePolokwane City eFNB Stadium, eNasrec, ngoLwesithathu ngo-7.30 ebusuku. Mancane amathuba okuthi uzobe esebuyile uNabi, okusho ukuthi uYoussef uzoqhubeka nokuyibamba benoCedric Kaze ongelinge lamaphini alo mqeqeshi waseTunisia. Ngaphandle kokuwina kweChiefs, abalandeli bathakasele ukubona enkundleni umgadli osemncane, uNaledi Hlongwane, obedlala okokuqala esikimini esikhulu kulandela ukuzakhela igama eshaya amagoli kwiDStv Diski Challenge ngesizini edlule. Abanye abebedlubhe imibala yaMakhosi okokuqala nguThabiso Monyane noSiphesihle Ndlovu ongene ngesiwombe sesibili endaweni kaThabo Cele. UMonyane noNdlovu bebedlalela i-Orlando Pirates neSupersport United ngokwehlukana.Ngasohlangothini lweStellies, uMuzomuhle Khanyi ohambe phambili ngokushaya amagoli kwiMotsepe Foundation Championship ngesizini edlule, udlale okokuqala egqoke ijezi kwiPremiership. Leli qembu limthole kwiHungry Lions. Enkundleni, nakuba iChiefs iqale ingaphezulu ngomdlalo kwiStellenbosch kodwa kwesesibili iqembu lasekhaya libuye selingcono futhi kuyilona elakhamathuba amaningi okukhahlelela ipali. Kubadlali abahlulwe ngamathuba kubalwa uLilepo noGaston Sirino ongene esiwombeni sesibili. Nokho kuphele konke ukungabaza ngesikhathi u-Omega Mdaka ewisa ebhokisini u-Ashley Du Preez ngesikhathi esengeziwe, unompempe u-Eugene Mdluli, wayikhomba emlotheni.
I-African Transformation Movement (ATM) ifake ngokusemthethweni isimangalo ngoNgqongqoshe wezeMidlalo, ezobuCiko namaSiko, uGayton McKenzie, ikhala ngezinkulumo ezicwasa ngokwebala ezibhekiswe kubantu abamnyama baseNingizimu Afrika nokuthi kumele kwenziwe uphenyo oluphuthumayo bese esuswa esikhundleni. Isikhalo, esithunyelwe eHhovisi likaMongameli, ePhalamende, kanye naseKomidini Elihlanganyelwe LePhalamende Lezimiso Zokuziphatha Nezintshisekelo Zamalungu, sigxile kuma-Twitter i-ATM ethe siqukethe "izinhlamba zobandlululo” ezibhekiswe emphakathini omnyama. UMcKenzie uhileleke engxabanweni mayelana nokuthunyelwe kwakudala kwenkundla yezokuxhumana kusukela ngo-2011, okwabiwe ku-X (owayekade engu-Twitter) ngesikhathi engusomabhizinisi. Okuthunyelwe kuveze ukusetshenziswa kwenhlamba yobuhlanga ecasulayo kubantu abamnyama. Kweminye yemibhalo yakhe ugxeke igama elithi 'Black Diamond’ ngesikhathi esebenzisa igama elicwasa ngokwebala abaningi eNingizimu Afrika abalithatha njengeliyihlazo.
IHLOSE ukuhlala phansi nabafelokazi ukuze kubhungwe ngobunzima bokusala bodwa emakhaya sebeshonelwe abayeni iMeya kaMasipala waseNkandla, njengoba isanda kuhlanganisa izinsuku ezingu-100 yangena ehhovisi.UNkk Nonhlahla Nzuza uthe izinhlelo ezithinta abesifazane, abesilisa, nentsha yizona azozibheka kakhulu.Ekhuluma neSolezwe uveze ukuthi kusukela kusasa kuze kube wuJanuwari ngonyaka ozayo banezinhlelo ezihlukene ezithinta umphakathi nokumele bazisukumele bona njengabaholi."Njengomkhandlu wasemakhaya kuningi okumele sikubheke emphakathini okuphilisa abantu kabi. Kusasa (namhlanje) kunembizo yamadoda la kuzoxoxwa khona ngezinto ezihlukene amadoda okumele azenze ekukhuliseni izingane nabo nje uqobo ukuthi kumele babe obaba nabayeni abanjani emakhaya abo. Isimo esike sasivelela endaweni yaseNhlotshane, esikoleni iBizimali sisivule amehlo ngakho kungakho sikhethe ukuba nohlelo olufana nalolu, ukuze singaphinde sibe nezigameko lapho izingane ziyozizwa zingaphephile,” kusho uNkk Nzuza.Uthe ngenyanga ezayo bahlele ukuhlangana nabesifazane abashonelwa abayeni nondlunkulu bamakhosi ukukhuluma nabo ngezinto ezihlukene nabo abazidingayo kubo."Uyazi ukushiywa wumyeni wakho adlule emhlabeni kube ngenye yento engiyibone kimi inzima, ngoba sijwayele ukubambisana kodwa uma usuwedwa konke kusala nawe. Ngakho njengoMasipala ngibone kungcono ukuthi sibe nohlelo lokuhlangana nalaba besifazane sixoxe siphinde sizwe ukuthi badingani. Sihlela ukuthi kube khona izikhulumi ezizobakhuthaza babone ukuthi ababodwa. Nondlunkulu kanjalo sifuna babe yisibonelo emphakathini nabo sizobheka izinhlelo esingazenza nabo ukusiza ezindaweni zamakhosi abahlala kuzo,” kuchaza yena.Uveze ukuthi asekubheke kakhulu wukuthi kuqale ukwakhiwa kwenxanxathela yezitolo nezindawo zokulala njengoba uNgqongqoshe uMnuz Dean Macpherson efikile ezobanika indawo lapho okumele kuqale khona ukwakhiwa kwezitolo.Uthe kubo kuwumlando lokhu njengoba kuzovula amathuba omsebenzi futhi kuthuthukise idolobha labo kungene nomnotho.Ezintweni ezifana namanzi, imigwaqo nogesi uthe sebekhulumile nozakwabo ababhekele le minyango esifundazweni ukuze lezi zingqalasizinda zilungiswe njengoba imigwaqo imibi kwezinye izindawo kungahambeki, amanzi engekho futhi kusekhona izindawo ezingenawo ugesi eNkandla.Bona uthe isabelomali abanaso salo nyaka omusha wezimalii singu-R293 million nabahlele ukuthi balungise ngaso imigwaqo emincane yasedolobheni nengenela emakhaya, amahholo omphakathi nezinkulisa.
Umphathiswa wezokuThutha nokuHlaliswa kwaBantu uMnuz Siboniso Duma uqinisekise ukuthungathwa kwemoto ebishayelwa owesifazane okubikwa ukuthi iphonseke eweni ngoMgqibelo.Ngokusho kwakhe, uthole umbiko namuhla ekuseni ovela kumsakazi wezomgwaqo oKhozini u-Ayanda Msweli emazisa ngengozi enyantisayo eyenzeke KwaSwayimane izolo."Singakuqinisekisa ukuthi imoto ebishayelwa umshayeli wesifazane iphahlazeke eweni KwaSwayimane. Siye sazisiwe ukuthi amalungu ethimba lokuhlenga indiza enophephela emhlane bebezama ukuthola isidumbu. Okwamanje, asinayo imininingwane egcwele mayelana nenani labantu abebesemotweni nesimo sabo," kusho yena ngesitatimende.Kujutshwe ithimba lezimo eziphuthumayo ebihamba ngendiza enophephela emhlani ukuthungatha le moto nabebengaphakathi ehlathini.
UNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa obambile, uSolwazi Cachalia usefikile esiteshini samaphoyisa eRoodepoort lapho ezovakashela khona imindeni yamaphoyisa amabili adutshulwa abulawa esemsebenzini eRoodepoort. Ujoyinwe nguKhomishana weDivisional for Policing and Operations, uLieutenant General Mamotheti, uKhomishana wesiFundazwe saseGauteng, uLieutenant General Tommy Mthombeni, uKhomishana wesiFunda saseGoli, uMajor General Nonhlanhla Kubheka, nezinye izikhulu eziphezulu zoMnyango kanye nesiFunda saseGoli. Umkhuzi wamaphoyisa kazwelonke uLt-Gen Fannie Masemula unxusa amaphoyisa ukuba angafi ephethe amathuluzi okuzivikela. Usho lokhu ngesikhathi ehlanganyele nemindeni yalawa maphoyisa."Ngisanda kuhlangana nomndeni ka-Warrant Officer Vuyisile Sintwa oneminyaka engu-51 ubudala, ongumseshi osebenzela ithimba le-Johannesburg Trio Task Team. IJohannesburg Trio Task Team wuphiko olubhekele ukuphenya ukugetshengwa kwezindlu namabhizinisi kanye nokudunwa kwezimoto. U-warrant officer wayeneminyaka engu-23 eSebenza esiphoyiseni ujoyine inhlangano ngo-2002. Sizobhekisa amabombo emndenini kaSergeant Simon Masenye (45) owabulawa kanye noWarrant Officer Sintwa. Usayitsheni Masenye ubeneminyaka engu-17 esebenza kanti naye ubeyingxenye yale Trio Task Team."Uthe lusaqhubeka uphenyo lokuthi laba baseshi badutshulwa babulawa kanjani nguJabulani Moyo."Lolu phenyo luholwa ophiko loKlebe futhi sithembele kofakazi abazibonele ngawabo kwenzeka lesi sigameko kusuka eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseRoodepoort nalapho kwenzeka khona ukudubula. .I-SAPS izokhipha umklomelo wemali kunoma ngubani ongaba nolwazi ngoJabulani Thabang Moyo ofunwayo mayelana nokubulawa kwamaphoyisa amabili eRoodepoort ngoLwesihlanu, 08 August 2025. Sibeka ukheshi ka-R150 000 kunoma ngubani ongasiholela lapho ekhona," kusho amaphoyisa ngesitatimende. Amaphoyisa athi lesi sigebengu siyingozi kakhulu abantu bangasondeli kuso, asinandaba nempilo. Abangaba nolwazi ngaleli cala okuhlanganisa nokuthi uMoyo ukuphi bayakhuthazwa ukuthi bashayele uWarrant Officer Rabosiwana wophiko loKlebe ku-0728444442.
IVEZELWE umphakathi ukuthi uphawule ngemigomo emibili esemthethweni wezikole iBela Act. Le migomo ithinta ukwamukelwa kwabafundi ezikoleni zakuleli kanjalo nokuthi ikilasi kumele libe nabafundi abangaki.Le migomo ikhishwe nguNgqongqoshe weMfundo eyisiSekelo, uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, kanti umphakathi unikwe izinsuku ezingu-30, ukuthi ubhalele umnyango uphawule ngayo.Okhulumela umnyango, uMnuz Elijah Mhlanga, uthe umphakathi awuphawule ngale migomo ethinta ukusebenza kwalo mthetho, osayinwe nyakenye. Yasusa umsindo indaba yalo mthetho njengoba amanye amaqembu engahambisani nawo.UNksz Gwarube uthe ngale migomo bahlose ukuqinisekisa ukuthi akubi nokukhala uma kwamukelwa abafundi ezikoleni.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi ihlale isusa umsindo eyokwamukelwa kwabafundi ezikoleni, ikakhulu ezazingama-Model C. Abazali bahlale bekhala ngokuthi lezi zikole azifuni ukwamukela izingane zabo - ezikhathini eziningi - uma bengahlali eduzane nezikole. Okuqukethwe yile migomo mayelana nokwamukelwa kwabafundi kufaka nokuthi akumele abafundi bangamukelwa ngenxa yebala, ubuzwe, ubulili, ukukhubazeka, inkolo noma ngoba bengeke bakwazi ukukhokha imali yesikole."Izikole kumele zibamukele abafundi abangenawo amaphepha okuba kuleli, kulabo abavela kwamanye amazwe. Kumele zisize abazali ukuthi bathole amaphepha afanele abafundi," kusho le migomo.Eminye ibeka isibalo sabafundi okumele sibe semakilasini njengokuthi angagcwali kakhulu. "KwaGrade R, kumele ikilasi libe nabafundi abangu-33, kwaGrade 1 kuya kwaGrade 12, kumele abafundi bangadluli ku-44, ekilasini ngalinye. Uthisha oyedwa kumele afundise abafundi abangu-30 kwaGrade R, kwaGrade 1 kuya kwaGrade 12, kumele afundise abafundi abangevile ku-40," kusho imigomo.Le migomo kubukeka izosusa ukukhuluma njengoba ezikoleni ezisemalokishini nasemakhaya, abafundi bacela ngaphezulu kuka-50 kuya phezulu ekilasini ngalinye. Kuhlale kukhalwa ngokuthi lezi zikole zigcwele kakhulu, okwenza othisha bangakwazi ukuba nesikhathi kahle nomfundi ngayedwa. Umphakathi unikwe kuze kube uSepthemba 5, ukuthi uphawule ngale migomo, kanti kusazokhishwa neminye imigomo ekuhambeni kwesikhathi ukuze umphakathi ubeke uvo lwawo ngayo.Abafuna ukubona le migomo bangaya ku: www.education.gov.za bese bephawula.
KUBE yinjabulo yodwa ngesikhathi amalungu ebandla i-St John’s Apostolic Faith Mission eClermont, amukela itayitela kwiMeya yeTheku uCyril Xaba.Miningi kakhulu iminyaka leli sonto lisebenza ngamalungelo e-Permission to Occupy (PTO), nokuyinto engavikelekile, enganqanyulwa noma yinini nokujyinto edala ukungazinzi ngokuphelele kwebandla. Uhlelo lokubuyisela umhlaba emasontweni luthathe elinye igxathu njengoba iMeya ueTheku, uCyril Xaba, inikezele ngetayitela ebandleni iSt John's Apostolic Faith Mission elaziwa ngokuthi yiseChibini. Ikhuluma namalungu ebandla, imeya ithe ukunikezelwa kwetayitela kukhombisa ukuthi umasipala uzibophezele ekulungiseni amaphutha akudala futhi ugxile ekuhlinzekeni ubunikazi obugcwele bomhlaba ezikhungweni zezenkolo nakubantu abajwayelekile abebencishwe amathuba phambilini. "Lokhu kungaphezu kokuthengiselana ngomhlaba, kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile ekulungiseni umaphutha akudala angenabo ubulungiswa. Kufeza isigaba 25(6) soMthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika, esithi: Umuntu noma umphakathi osebenzisa umhlaba wawo ngokungavikeleki ngokomthetho ngenxa yemithetho noma imikhuba yaphambilini yokucwasa ngokwebala, unegunya, ngokwezinga elihlinzekwe nguMthetho wePhalamende, lokuhlala endaweni evikelekile ngokomthetho noma ukunxeshezelwa ngendlela efanayo."Uqhubeke wathi leli tayitela lizocaba nendlela yokuthi isonto lifake isicelo emkhandlwini sokuthi lingawakhokhi ama-rates njengoba kwenzeka kuwona wonke amasonto nasezinhlanganweni ezingenzi nzuzo. IMeya iphinde yanikezela ngomshini wokuphrinta ukuze ibandla likwazi ukwenza imisebenzi yasehhovisi. Uthe lolu hlelo lokunikezela amasonto ngamatayitela luzoqhubeka ukuze wonke amasonto afaka izicelo ahlomule.
AMACIKO nabanamabhizinisi ehlukene ezobuciko bazothola ithuba lokufunda futhi bacebe ngolwazi lokuthi bangakusebenzisa kanjani ubuciko babo namasiko ehlukene akuleli zwe ukuthi bachume kwezobuciko nokuthi basimamise amabhizinisi abo ezobuciko.Lokho kuzokwenzeka emcimbini walo nyaka waminyaka yonke wezingxoxo zezamabhizinisi omculo nobuciko i-The Music Imbizo, ezoba se-Inkosi Albert Luthuli International Convention Centre (ICC), eThekwini ngo-Agasti 26 kuya ku-30.Nonyaka, lo mcimbi owasungulwa wuSphe Mbhele ngo-2009, ingqikithi yawo ithi At The Root of Innovation Is Culture, Creativity And The Power of IP, okusho ukuthi kuzobhekwa kabanzi kuthi amasiko nobuciko kungasebenzisana kanjani ukuthuthukisa ezobuciko. Isitatimende esithunyelwe ngabahleli balo mcimbi siqinisekise ukuthi nonyaka lo mbuthwano uzovulwa ngokusemthethweni yiSekela likaNgqongqoshe wezemiDlalo, ubuCiko namaSiko, uNkk Bertha Peace Mabe, ozokwethula inkulumo ezohluba udlubu ekhasini ngokuthi yimaphi amasu angasetshenziswa ngamasiko nezobuciko ukufukula umnotho wezwe.Kuzothi ngosuku lwesibili lwalo mcimbi okuwuLwesithathu, kube khona umakadebobona wumculo we-jazz uNomfundo Xaluva-Dyantyis, ozobe exoxa noVuyisile Mshudulu obhekele ezobuciko eGoli, bona abazobhunga ngokuthi amasiko engasetshenziswa kanjani ukufukula ubuciko namabhizinisi ezobuciko nomculo. NgoLwesihlanu, kuzobe kukhona uNtsika Tyatya wesikhondlakhondla senkampani yezimpahla zokugqoka ezigqize ngesintu iMaXhosa Africa, ozokhuluma ngokuthi kungasetshenziswa kanjani ezemfashini nomculo ukuqhakambisa ubuhle bamagugu e-Afrika.Ngale kwalokho, kulezi zinsuku ezinhlanu kuzobe kunezigcawu ezahlukene zokucobelana ngolwazi okuzohlangana kuzona izikhulumi ezingaphezu kwa-60, amaciko awu-25 nosomabhizinisi abawu-60 abazokhangisa ngamabhizinisi nemikhiqizo kwabo okwehlukene.Kulokhu lo mcimbi uzokhonjiswa bukhoma kwiSABC 1, kanti ugabe ngamaxhasi abehlukene okukhona kubona i-Independent Media, Durban Tourism, CAPASSO, Brand South Africa, SAMRO, TikTok, Bathu ne-NoOx Worldwide yase-Italy.
INDLALA, ukungalingani, izinguquko kwezomnotho nokwakhiwa kwamathuba emisebenzi, ukungalingani ngakwezobulili kanjalo nodlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane ngezinye zezihloko okuzobhungwa ngazo emhlanganweni wokuqala wethimba elajutshwa nguMengameli wezwe ozondlalela ingxoxo ngesimo sezwe.Lo mhlangano ohlanganisa abevile ku-1 000, abavela emkhakheni engu-30 yakuleli, bazohlangana ngesonto elizayo enyuvesi i-Unisa, lapho bezobe bebhunga ngalezi zihloko nezinye izinto.Ekakhukhulelangoqo ngesimo sezwe yamenyezelwa nguMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ngesikhathi ethula inkulumo ebhekiswe esizweni. Esitatimendeni esikhishwe nguhulumeni, siveze ukuthi lo mhlangano uzoba se-Unisa ePitoli kusuka ngo-Agasti 15 kuya ku-Agasti 17.Sithe ezinye zezihloko okuzoxoxwa ngazo kubalwa izinguquko kwezomhlaba, ezokuphepha, ukuphathwa kukahulumeni nokugxilisa intando yeningi."Indlala, ukungalingani nezinguquko kwezomnotho ngezinye zezihloko eziseqhulwini emhlanganweni. Lezi zingxoxo zizoba yizigaba ezehlukene okubalwa nokuhlangana kwemikhakha ehlukene kuze kufinyelelwe ekutheni kuhanjelwe imiphakathi ezindaweni ezehlukene kuhlanganiswe izikhalazo zawo," kusho isitatimende. Evala umhlangano wezinsuku ezine wesigungu esiphezulu se-ANC, uRamaphosa ubalule ukubaluleka kwale ngxoxo ngesimo sezwe wathi izinkinga ezibhekene nezwe zidinga izixazuluko ezingunomphela.URamaphosa uthe uwonke wonke kumele abe yingxenye yalezi zingxoxo ukuze kutholakale izixazululo ezizoyisa izwe phambili."Le ngxoxo ifaka wonke umuntu kusuka kosopolitiki, abezenkolo, abaholi bomdabu, intsha, abamabhizinisi, izifundiswa, uhulumeni, osaziwayo nabanye ukuze kuvezwe isithombe esiyiso ngezwe lethu. Sifuna abantu kube yibona abazoba sekhaleni lwale ngxoxo ngezwe," kusho uRamaphosa. Unxuse abantu ukuthi babe yingxenye yale ngxoxo ngoba umbono wabo uyadingeka.Uthe isigungu esiphezulu se-ANC sigcizelele ukubaluleka kwale ngxoxo ngezwe ukuze sifinyelele ezweni esilifisayo."Ezinyangeni ezingu-8 kuya kwezingu-10, kuzobe kuhanjelwa izifundazwe ezehlukene ezweni ukuyothola umbono wabantu. Ukubambisana yikhona okuzoyisa izwe phambili yingakho umbono wabantu ubaluleke kakhulu."Usho lokhu nje akukacaci ukuthi le ngxoxo izodla malini njengoba kwaba nezikhalazo ngokuthi mkhulu kakhulu u-R700 million, okuthiwa uhlelelwe le ngxoxo. Nehhovisi likaRamaphosa lakuchitha ukuthi kuzosebenza imali engaka.
USELE nemibuzo engaphenduleki umfelokazi wowayenguMqondisi omkhulu ophikweni i-Technical and Infrastructure, kuMasipala i-Alfred Duma eMnambithi, uMnuz Oscar Hlatshwayo, owadutshulwa washona ngentululwane yezinhlamvu ngoFebhuwari 2019. Umfelokazi kaHlatshwayo, uNkk Zinhle Hlatshwayo, uthe namanje akasazi isizathu sokusocongwa komyeni wakhe, owayeya emsebenzini.Kube yinjabulo nosizi kuNkk Hlatshwayo ngoLwesithathu ngesikhathi inkantolo yesifunda eMadadeni, igixabeza ngodilikajele ababulali ngecala lokubulala uHlatshwayo. Omunye uzakwabo kamufi ayesebenza naye emphethe kamasipala, akhula waphinde wafunda naye esikoleni emazingeni aphezulu waphinda wayokwenza naye iziqu ezifanayo enyuvesi, uNomaswazi Angel Shabalala (owesifazane), nguyena ungqondongqondo othole isigwebo sikadilikajele kanti kuthiwa nguyena owakha itulo lokuthi kubulawe uHlatshwayo. Abanye abathole odilikajele ngoMondli Mabaso, Mduduzi Njuza noNqobile Brown Ngcobo.Okhulumela amaphoyisa uBrigadier Athlenda Mathe, uthe uShabalala wayeyi-Senior Engineer kulo masipala, uMabaso usomabhizinisi owayethola amathenda kulo mkhandlu, uNjuza wathola izibhamu ezasebenza kubulawa umufi, kanti uNgcobo inkabi eyadubula uHlatshwayo. Kuthiwa ababulali bamlalela unyendle emgwaqweni ohlale unenqwaba yezimoto, okwakuphoqa ukuthi ehlise isivinini, abahlaseli bathola ithuba lokumdubula bephindelela ekhanda nasesifubeni, washonela endaweni yesigameko."UShabalala ukhethe ukuthi aze ayongena ekhulukuthu engakaze asibeke isizathu sokuthi kungani abulala umyeni wami. Endaweni yesigameko wayekhona emva kokwenzeka kwaso, wafika ngisho nasekhaya ezosiduduza, nasenkonzweni yesikhumbuzo waze wama phambili embhobheni, waqhubeka wasiduduza ebe azi kahle ukuthi wuye ungqondongqondo wokubulawa komyeni wami," kusho uNkk Hlatshwayo.Ubalise ngokuthi emva kokubulawa kukamufi, impilo ayibange isafana njengoba aqala lapho ukugqigqa kodokotela abaluleka abantu ngokomqondo, ehambisa izingane zakhe, okumanje azikakwamukeli ukubulawa kukayise. Uthe ngesikhathi isidedela isigwebo inkantolo ufikelwe wumuzwa wokujabula nowosizi ecabanga ukuthi ngesikhathi umyeni wakhe ebulawa babesanda kuthola izingane ezingamawele, ezazinezinyanga ezintathu zizelwe."Isehlakalo senzeka ngisesekhefini lokuteta. Ingane yethu endala yayineminyaka eyisishiyagalolunye, eyesibili ineminyaka emihlanu,” kukhumbula uNkk Hlatshwayo.Uthe ngesikhathi kugwetshwa abasolwa uvele wacabanga wona amawele, wezwa umuzwa wosizi uqala phansi. Uthe ayikho into emkhame njengokwehla enyuka enkantolo iminyaka eyisithupha, efuna ubulungiswa ngokubulalwa komyeni wakhe ngesihluku.Uveze ukuthi kuvuse izilonda ukubona umsolwa ohamba phambili kuleli cala, uShabalala, engakhombisi nokuncane ukuzisola ngesikhathi egwetshwa. "Uyena owakha itulo, enxenxa abanye ukuthi bamlekelele abulale umyeni wami. Okungiphatha kabi kakhulu wukuthi wumuntu esimaziyo, esikhule naye endaweni, waze wafunda naye umyeni wami,” kusho uNkk Hlatshwayo. Uthe usizi lokukhulela komyeni wakhe ekhaya elihlwempu kodwa abhukule aze abe ngowokuqala ukugqoka ijazi lasenyuvesi bese ephucula umuzi wakubo, yinto umufi ayenza phambi kwakhe uShabalala."Wambulala yize azi kahle ukuthi uwukuphila kwekhaya lakubo nomndeni wethu,” kubalisa uNkk Hlatshwayo.Ubabaze isibindi sikaShabalala sokubulala umyeni wakhe ekubeni babesebenza ophikweni olulodwa, kumasipala owodwa. "Enkantolo kuvele ukuthi ezakhe izingane seziyaziphothula izifundo zazo zobudokotela emanyuvesi, ezami zidonsa kanzima, zehla zenyuka kodokotela abeluleka ngokwengqondo,” kusho uNkk Hlatshwayo, othe uShabalala umsaba ngisho esegwetshiwe.Uveze ukuthi kubo kaShabalala kwakunesitolo kanti wakhula kahle ekubeni kwaHlatshwayo babedonsa kanzima.Ubonge ithimba labaphenyi, ebeliholwa wumphenyi omkhulu, uMnuz Mzwamandla Kubheka, athe belilokhu libabambe ngesandla kusukela kuqala icala kwaze kwaba yisekugcineni. Ngesikhathi kuqulwa icala, uMshushisi woMbuso, u-Advocate Cyril Selepe, wabiza ofakazi ababili ababengaphansi kuka-Section 204, ubufakazi be-video, ubufakazi bamaselula nombiko wezibhamu.Ngaphezu kwesigwebo sabo, inkantolo iphinde yanquma ukuthi abanayo imvume yokuphatha izibhamu. Okhulumela i-National Prosecuting Authority (NPA) KwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Natasha Ramkisson-Kara, uthe bayasemukela isigwebo, wathi bakushayela ihlombe ukubambisana kwabashushisi namaphoyisa, wathi banethemba lokuthi isigwebo sizoxwayisa nabanye.
SEKUQUBULE ukwesaba kwezinye izisebenzi zaseMangosuthu University of Technology (MUT), eMlaza, ukubulawa ngesihluku kozakwabo abasebenza ophikweni lwezokuthutha. Sezimbili izigameko zokuhlaselwa, kudutshulwe, kubulawe abashayeli abasebenza ngaphansi kwalolu phiko esikhathini esingaphansi kwezinyanga ezimbili.Esigamekweni sakamumva esenzeke ngoLwesihlanu olwedlule, kudutshulwe, kwabulawa uMnuz Innocent Zenzele Mqadi (50). Ngokusho kwabale nyuvesi ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, umufi okuvele ukuthi ungumfowabo kaMax Mqadi wodumo lweMax’s Lifestyle, eMlaza, udutshulwe, wabulawa esemotweni yakhe.Omunye umthombo utshele Isolezwe ukuthi abahlaseli bamfice enengane yakhe esencane phakathi emotweni uMqadi. Kuthiwa kuthe noma esethi uyazama ukubaleka ngemoto, abahlaseli baqhubeka nokumlandela, kwaze kwaba bayamfica, bamnqoba nesibhamu.I-MUT ithe uMqadi ubewuhlobo lomuntu ozihloniphayo, ezimisela, ewuthanda umsebenzi futhi eyisibonelo esihle emsebenzini. NgoJuni kuwo lo nyaka, inyuvesi yamemezela ngokubulawa kukaMnuz Lucky Xolani Dlamini (53) owayedume ngelikaLondi. UDlamini kuthiwa wadutshulwa ngoJuni 24, 2025 abantu abangaziwa esendleleni elibangise emsebenzini. Inyuvesi yaveza ukuthi uDlamini ubulawa nje ubesesebenze kuyona iminyaka njengoba ayijoyina ngeminyaka yo-1990. Isisebenzi esicele ukungadalulwa sithe zethukile izisebenzi eziningi njengoba zingaqondisisi ukuthi kwenzekani."Kubukeka sengathi kukhona impi ebhekiswe kithina kodwa okudidayo wukuthi asazi ukuthi iqhamukaphi,” kusho isisebenzi. Siqhube sathi wonke umuntu usovalweni, uzibuza ukuthi ingabe ubani ozolandela. UNobhala wesifunda iTheku (Durban Region) kwiNehawu, uMnuz Prince Mthalane uthe abazokwenza maduzane wukuthi baye kulesi sikhungo bayoxoxisana namalungu abo."Sizobe siyozwa nje ukuthi bathini, sizwe ukuthi zikhona yini izikhalo abazoziphakamisa,” kusho uMthalane othe kuseva ukuthi kungaba khona ukuphawula okutheni asebengakwenza.Uthe lokhu ukusho ngoba awekho amalungu abo aseze kubo azobabikela ngokukhathazeka kwawo kulandela izigameko. Uphinde wathi okunye okwenza bangabi nawo umcabango wokuthi ukuhlasela kweyamene nomsebenzi wukuthi abafi bahlaselwa ngaphandle kwenyuvesi bengekho emsebenzini.UMqadi kuthiwa ushiye izingane ezintathu kanti uLondi yena washiya unkosikazi nezingane ezine.
UTHI ubesesabela impilo yakhe obenguSihlalo we-IFP egatsheni iPhambili eNewcastle, uMnuz Bonginkosi Ngwenya (38) odume kakhulu ngelikaManganesi.UNgwenya bese kuphele iminyaka emithathu egcwele enguSihlalo we-IFP kuleli gatsha.Uthi ushiye isigubhukane kulona ngoJulayi 27 maqede wathatha isinqumo sokujoyina uMkhotho Wesizwe.Enkulumeni ekhethekile be nayo neSolezwe Ngempelasonto udalule ukuthi bese simuncu kakhulu isimo phakathi kwakhe nomunye abenguzakwabo ngoba ubemhlalise lubhojozi efuna ukugwamanda amandla.Ngenxa yalesi simo uthi ubonile ukuthi kungcono amane eshenxe ngoba ubesebona kahle ukuthi impilo yakhe isisengcupheni.Uthe ipolitiki inesihluku yingakho kumqoka kakhulu ukucabanga ngobuhlakani nangokushesha ukuze ukwazi ukugwema amathonsi abanzi.''Ngimane ngathatha isinqumo sokuba ngijoyine uMkhonto Wesizwe. Ziningi izizathu ezidale ukuthi ngimane ngincamele ukujoyina lo mbutho. Esinye salezo zizathu ukuthi uMkhonto ngibone kuyiwona owenza izimfuno zabantu baseNewcastle uma ngiqhathanisa ne-IFP le engiyishiyile,'' usho kanjena.Udalule ukuthi ezinsukwini eziyishumi elaxaze i-IFP wase ejoyina uMkhonto ukwazile ukunxenxa abangu-150 ukuba bajoyine uMkhonto Wesizwe. Uthe kulaba kukhona abaphume kwi-IFP abanye abaphume emaqenjini ehlukene akhona KwaZulu Natal.ISolezwe Ngempelasonto lisibonile isikhangiso somcimbi omkhulu wokwamukelwa kukaNgwenya nabangu-150 ozokuba ngeSonto ngehora leshumi nanye ePhambili Primary School khona eNewcatsle.UNgwenya uthi ukholwa ukuthi kuningi kakhulu azokwazi ukukuzuza ngokusebenzisana neqembu lakhe elisha uMkhonto Wesizwe.Uveze ukuthi kuningi abefisa ukukulungisa eNewcatsle okumayelana nokufinyelela kwentuthuko kubantu kodwa kumane kufane nje nokuthi umane uthela amanzi emhlane wedada.Uveze ukuthi kunemizi engu-123 engenawo ugesi kule ward abekuyona kodwa uthi bekuthi uma efuna kulungiswe leyo nkinga bamane bamhlabe inhlali kwale noma eseludlulisela kwabakhulu abaholi iqembu.Ilungu leSiyingi oSizweni uMnuz Jobe Sithole we-IFP uthe uyamazi uNgwenya basebenzisane kakhulu naye. Wathi bekungelula ukuba angaphendulwa isichuse ekubeni enguSihlalo. Wathi uma kwenzeke kanjalo uyena uNgwenya obekuvumela lokho. Mayelana nodaba lokuthi ubesabela impilo yakhe uthe kanjani ngoba nangu namanje uswadla anhlamvana.
AbeZemvelo KZN Wildlife babungaze abaqaphi beziqiwi abangaphezu kuka-150 abazinikele, behlonipha isibindi sabo esikhulu nokuzinikela kwabo ekuvikeleni izindawo zasendle zaseNingizimu Afrika.Ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi "Abaqaphi Banika Amandla Ezokongiwa Kwemvelo,” lo mcimbi ukhanyise indima ebalulekile ekhathulwe yilaba baqaphi ekubhekaneni nezidingo ezikhulayo zokongiwa kwemvelo. Umgubho uzwakale kakhulu kulo lonke usuku kukhulunywa ngokuningi. Lokhu bekuhlanganisa izingxoxo ezehlukene ezenzelwe ukukhuthaza ubudlelwano kubasebenzi.UMusa Mntambo okhulumela lesi siqiwi, uphawule ukuthi lo mbungazo ubuhambisana ngqo nezinhlelo zosuku."Lokhu bekuhlanganisa izingxoxo ezehlukene ezenzelwe ukukhuthaza ubudlelwano phakathi kwabasebenzi bezokuvikela, kwaphinde kwagcizelelwa nokuqina ngokomzimba nangokwengqondo okudingekayo emsebenzini wabo onzima nokwesekwa okudingekayo kwabaqaphi bethu bamagugu emvelo," kusho uMntambo.Amazwi akhe enanelwe nayinqwaba yabantu abebehambele lo mcimbi, okuhlanganisa nabamele umbutho wamaphoyisa aseNingizimu Afrika (SAPS) noMbutho wezokuVikela waseNingizimu Afrika (i-SANDF), ababambe iqhaza bakhombisa ukuziphatha kwabo namakhono abo ahlukahlukene.Lo mgubho ulandela owangenyanga kaJuni, lapho bekuqhakanjiwa khona abaqaphi besifazane baseziqiwini. Ihhotela laseBergville eligudla isiqiwi iSpioenkop, iThree Tree Hills, lagqamisa abaqaphi ababili balesi siqiwi abayimbokodo ekhethekile nesebenza ngokuzikhandla.UTebogo Mtshali uyiSection Ranger noNtombi Zulu uSenior Field Ranger. Ngemuva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe eMangosuthu Unversity of Technology, uTebogo waqashwa ukuthi enze izifundo ze-Ezemvelo. Ngaphambi kokuthi aqedele ngisho ukufundela umsebenzi, wahlwitha isikhundla sokuba yi-Field Ranger eHluhluwe-iMfolozi Wilderness Area, lapho asebenze khona iminyaka engu-13 ngaphambi kokuthi anyuselwe esikhundleni sakhe njengoSection Ranger eSpioenkop. Uhlale ezizwa esekelwa amaqembu akhe nabaphathi bakhe, okumenze wakwazi ukugqama emsebenzini wakhe.UNtombi waqala umsebenzi wakhe esiqiwini esincane, oNgoye Forest, ihlathi elinomlando ojulile eduze kwaseMthunzini, wabe esechitha iminyaka engu-10 eqapha indawo yaseSiMangaliso Wetland Park ngaphambi kokuba adluliselwe eSpioenkop njengoMqaphi Omkhulu. Uthole inselelo ngenxa yemikhuba eyenziwa ngabanye beesilisa esifundeni sakithi kodwa uthi ukuqeqeshwa kwe-Ezemvelo kumnike amathuluzi okubhekana nalezi zinselelo. "Sibungaza abaqaphi ababili abasebenza ngokuzikhandla. Abesifazane badlala indima ebalulekile ekuvikeleni izilwane ezisengozini yokushabalala, ekulweni nokuzingela ngokungemthetho nasekukhuthazeni ukusimama kwemvelo. Siyakuhlonipha ukuzibophezela kwabo njengoba kungeyona indima elula. Kuyimboni egcwele abesilisa, enezinselelo ezinzima. Sinenhlanhla yokuba nababili balaba besifazane abanamandla abahola amathimba ezokulondolozwa kwemvelo endaweni eyisiqiwu esingumakhelwane, i-Spioenkop," kubhala abeThree Tree Hill.
UKUKHUTHAZA abantu besifazane ukuzimela nokushisekela ukukwazi ukumelana nobunzima ababhekana nakho empilweni yizona zinto ezizogqama emdlalweni weshashalazi i-The Cry of Winnie Mandela, okhonjiswa ePlayhouse, eThekwini namhlanje ngo-2 ntambama. Lokho kushiwo wumlingisi uThembisa Nxumalo, olingisa indawo kaWinnie Madikizela-Mandela ongasekho, owayeyisishoshovu sezepolitiki esilwela amalungelo abantu besifazane, futhi owayewunkosikazi wowayengumengali wokuqala wohulumeni wentando yabantu uDkt Nelson Rolihlahla Mandela, naye ongasekho emhlabeni.Lo mdlalo, oqale ukukhonjiswa izolo ususelwa encwadini kaNjabulo S. Ndebele ethi The Cry of Winnie Mandela, wase uguqulwa wu-Alex Burger, kanti lona weshashalazi uqondiswe wuMoMo Matsunyane. Amathikithi okuwubuka abiza uR150 eWebtickets. UThembisa uthe kuhlale kuyinselelo enkulu ukulingisa emidllaweni efuze lona ngoba kusuke kudingeka ukuthi wenze ubulungiswa ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umlando wendaba exoxwayo awudukiseki endleleni, okudinga ucophelele futhi ucwaninge ngokwanele usazilungiselela."Kusemqoka kakhulu ukuqhubeka sixoxe izindaba ezifuze lena ikakhulu njengoba zivame ukunganakeki emphakathini esiphila kuwona okwenza ukuthi kube lula ukuthi kuqhamuke noma wubani aphambanise umlando wethu, futhi ukungazixoxi ngokwanele kuzokwenza ukuthi singazazi ukuthi sisuka kuphi nokuthi siya kuphi nezwe nomlando wethu siyizwe."Ngalo mdlalo sibhekise kakhulu ebantwini besifazane njengoba sizoneka obala ubunjalo bezimo ababhekana nazo emizini abaganene kuyona, ikakhulu uma besele bodwa ngoba abayeni babo bengekho eduze kwabo ngenxa yezizathu ezahlukene. Kanti futhi kuzogqama nobumqoka bokuzimela nokufunda ukuvuka emaqandeni uma kunezimo ezinjalo obhekene nazo empilweni ukuze ukwazi ukuthuthuka uye phambili,” kusho uThembisa.Abanye abalingisi balo mdlalo woWarona Seane owuMannete, uSiyasanga Sibuyi owuMarara, uPulane Pampoana owuMamello, Lesley Made owuSolwazi Ndebele noMoMo Matsunyane olingisa uDelisiwe.
INTOKAZI yaseThekwini uNonkululeko "Lefty” Mlaba, odlalela iqembu lesizwe amaProteas neHollywoodbest Dolphins kwabesifazane, ugile izimanga ngenkathi iCricket South Africa iklomelisa abadlali abenze kahle emdlalweni wekhilikith, emcimbini obuse-Emperors Palace, eGoli Gauteng, ngoLwesine olwedlule. Kulo mcimbi uNonkululeko ukhale wemuka nemiklomelo emine ebibhekwe ngabomvu okungowe-SA Women’s T20 International Player of The Year, Women’s Player’s Player of The Year, Women’s Best Delivery nowe-Women’s Player of The Year. Ezintweni ezenze leli nxele lahlabana, ngama-wikhethi angu-12 eliwathathe emqhudelwaneni i-2024 T20 World Cup okulenze laqeda endaweni yesibili kwabathathe amaningi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uMlaba uqophe umlando wokuba ngowesifazane wokuqala othathe amawikhethi angu-10 emdlalweni we-test ngesikhathi bebhekene ne-England ngoDisemba. Ukuhlabana kukaMlaba ngemiklomelo kumenza abe ngomunye wabadlali abazobe bebhekiwe emqhudelwaneni i-ODI Cricket World Cup ezoba se-India ngenyanga ezayo.
AMADODA anxuswe ukuba akhulise ngendlela abafana ukuze bakwazi ukunakekela abantu besifazane. Leli khwela lishaywe yiMeya yaseMshwathi, uMnuz Mandla Zondi embuthanweni wokucija amadoda obubanjelwe ehholo lomphakathi waseCool Air, eMgungundlovu ngoLwesine.UZondi uthe abafana kufanele bakhuliswe ngendlela ukuze bayeke ukucekela phansi ikusasa lamantombazane nokubhabhabala nawo maqede bawalaxaze nezingane. Uthe ukholelwa ukuthi umfana khuliswe ngendlela akasoze amhlukumeza noma amcekela phansi umuntu wesifazane kodwa kunalokho uyamnakekela.Abesilisa ebebehambele le mbizo babuyele emakhaya sebengamadoda aqotho ngenxa yeziyalo abazithole kwizingcithabuchopho ezihlukahlukene ebezimele izinhlaka eziningi zikaHulumeni ezisebenzisana nomphakathi, okubalwa kuzo umbutho wamaphoyisa, abakwaSassa, uMnyango weziNdaba zaseKhaya, uMnyango wezeMpilo, uMnyango wamaJele, Uphiko olenza ucwaningo, uMnyango wezeMfundo, uMnyango wokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi namakhansela angaphansi kukaMasipala waseMshwathi. Namakhosi akhele izindawo zaseMshwathi kanye nomphakathi obuqhamuka kuwona wonke amawadi aseMshwathi, bebekhona ukuzoba iqhaza ekufukulweni ngolwazi kwamadoda.Iminyango yonke beyidingida namadoda ngezinselelo ezibhekana nawo. Akugcinanga lapho kodwa kubuye kwaqhamuka nezisombululo zokuxazulula izinkinga ezibhekene namadoda. Esephetha uZondi unxuse amadoda ukuba aqinise kakhulu ekuvikeleni abantu besifazane nezingane futhi agxile nasezinhlelweni zokwakha isizwe.
ABAFUNDI bakwesinye sezikole zamabanga aphezulu zaseGqumeni, eBulwer, maphakathi neKwaZulu-Natal eMahlahla Secondary, bathole ingqayizivele yethuba lokuhlomela ikusasa, becetshiswa ngomkhakha wezokuthwebula izithombe nokunye okweyamene nakho.Lokho kwenzeke ohlelweni olubizwa ngokuthi Impilo Yasemakhaya Exhibition, obelwenziwe ihlandla lesine ngoLwesithathu, khona eBulwer, nolwaqalwa wumthwebuli wezithombe uMnuz Khulasande Tshayile weTshayile Media. Kulolu hlelo kusizakale abanfundi abawu-121 bakwaGrade 9, 11 nabo-matric wakulesi sikole abacetshiswe ngamasu okuchuma kwezokutwebula izithombe, futhi bahlonyiswa ngolwazi lweminye imikhakha eyahlukene yemfundo, ukubasiza uma sebephothule izifundo zabo. Ngaphambi kokuhambela eBulwer, uTshayile wenze lolu hlelo amahlandla amathathu eNtabankulu e-Eastern Cape, iseMlaza eningizimu yeTheku naseDurban Art Gallery, eThekwini.Ngale kokuhlomisa abafundi ngolwazi lwemikhakha eyahlukene, uTshayile uthe okwenze wazolwenza eBulwer wukuthi ubefuna ukwenza ukuthi abantu bakule ndawo baqonde ukuthi nakwezinye izindawo njengakoNtabankulu bakhona abantu abaphila ngendlela efanayo nabaphila ngayo endaweni yabo. Lolu hlelo luxhaswe wuMnyango wezemiDlalo, ezobuCiko namaSiko nophiko loMnyango wezokuVakasha iCulture Mzansi Golden Economy, kanti kulokhu abafundi baseBulwer bahlonyiswe ngolwazi wuMnyango wezobuciko waseDUT nenhlangano engenzinzuo yakhona eBulwer Iphupho Connect. Kwabacobele abafundi ngolwazi bekukhona usomabhizinisi uNkosinathi "Malume” Zungu, kwanandisa uLindo Mbambo odlala izinsimbi zomdab nembongi uXolile Zion Vilakazi obephethe uhlelo. UTshayile uneziqu ze-National Diploma in Photography, iBTech in Photography nesanda kuziphothula ze-Honours Degree in Business Administration, kanti futhi imisebenzi yakhe iyaziwa njengoba sekuyisikhathi eside enza umsebenzi wokuthwebula nokuqopha ama-video.
IZINGOZI zomgwaqo ezilokhu zenzeka ngaphansi koMasipala waseBaqulusini naseZululand, ziphoqe ukuthi kubanjwe umkhuleko ozovala lesi sihlava esesishiye imindeni eminingi inezintandane nabafelokazi.NgoLwesihlanu, le mikhandlu yomibili yenze umkhuleko eCecil Emmet, eVryheid, ngenjongo yokuphebeza lo mshophi.Lo mkhuleko wenzelwe eVryheid ngoba zombili izingozi zakamuva zenzeke ngaphansi kwalo masipala. Muva nje, izingozi ezithinta ukushona kwamalungu ahlukene amaqembu epolitiki athinte abaningi.Ukushona kwamalungu e-IFP ngonyaka odlule nawe-EFF bonke besuka eThekwini - emibuthanweni yamaqembu - yikhona okwenze ukuthi kusukunyelwe lezi zingozi.Abafelokazi abakhulume neSolezwe baveze ukuthi selokhu bashonelwa abayeni babo impilo ayiphindanga yafana nasekuqaleni.UNkk Magret Nkosi uveze ukuthi impilo inzima njengoba kungajwayeleki ukuthi ashiywe umyeni owamshiya nezingane ezincane. "Umyeni wami udlule engozini yomgwaqo eyenzeka ngo-2022, nokuyinto eyaba nzima kimi nomndeni wami ngoba singayilindele. Kodwa ukubona kwenziwa imikhuleko yalolu hlobo kuyasiduduza ezinhliziyweni ngoba akulula ukudlulelwa umuntu engozini engagulanga ndawo. Siyacela ukuthi kulungiswe imigwaqo futhi kuphindwe kuhlonishwe imiyalelo yemigwaqo ukugwema izingozi zalolu hlobo,” kuchaza uNkk Nkosi.UNkk Ncamisile Buthelezi uthe wayesemncane eshonelwa ngumyeni wakhe engozini yemoto futhi akwangaba lula ukubhekana naleso simo."Ngaphenduka ngaba ubaba nomama ezinganeni zami, kwaba isimo esingekho lula kodwa ukukhuthazwa abantu abahlukahlukene kwangenza ngazifanisa nabanye impilo yaqhubeka yaya phambili. Siyabonga kuzona zombili izimeya ngokwenza umkhuleko walolu hlobo ufike wathinta izinto eziningi ezinhliziyweni,” kusho uNkk Buthelezi. UMfundisi Canon Mbatha uveze ukuthi imigwaqo yakuleli isifana nomfula ongashi wegazi nokudingeka ukuthi abawusebenzisayo bawusebenzise ngokucophelela.Uthe akuthandile ukuthi kuqoqwe abafelokazi abavelelwa umshophi, nabathemba ukuthi ngokuhlangana kwabo basizakele.IMeya yaseBaqulusini, uMnuz Sifiso Mkhwanazi, ithe bese sifikile isikhathi sokuthi kusukunyelwe izingozi ezenzeka kule ndawo nesezibashayisa ngovalo muva nje."Inkinga lena esibhekene nayo yokuthi kube khona izingozi zalolu hlobo ezisondelene nathi kangaka. Emkhulekweni wanamhlanje sithe ake sibize omama abashiywa ngabayeni babo sizobakhulekela sibacelele ukuthula enhliziyweni kulesi simo ababhekana naso. Sizobalekelela ngezinto ezihlukene ezithinta izikweletu abasala nazo kanjalo nendlela yokuthi bathole imali yesinxephezelo ngokwenzeka emindenini yabo,” kusho uMkhwanazi.UMnuz Micheal Khumlo oyiMeya yaseZululand, uthe sesifikile isikhathi sokuthi bahlangane beyizinhlangano ezihlukene bakhulekele lezi zingozi.Uthe sebeyesaba ngisho ukuqasha amabhasi namatekisi ukusa abantu emicimbini ehlukene ngoba abazi kuzokwenzakalani.
ATITINYWE wumphakathi amadoda abemba imigodi emisha phezu kwamathuna asavalwa aseMishini yebandla i-UCC SA, aphakathi kwaseGolokodo naseFolweni, eThekwini.Umkhuba wokumbiwa kwamathuna okuthiwa abethengiswa ngokungemthetho kuthiwa kade waqala futhi kunokudideka ukuthi wenziwa ngobani.Ilungu lomphakathi elikhulume neSolezwe, uMnuz Yeke Khwela, liveze ukuthi bekubathusa obekwenzeka njengoba la mathuna ebengasasebenzi, kodwa ekugcineni balithola iqiniso ngokungcwaba kwabantu bephindelela kuwo."Ngesikhathi iqala le nto thina sasicabanga ukuthi kungenzeka kube yimindeni yabantu ababefihle kula mathuna kudala, manje bayaqhubeka nokuzofihla kuwo - njengoba kuvumelekile ukungcwatshwa komuntu phezu komunye uma sekuphele iminyaka engu-10. Kuthe uma sesiphenya kahle sathola ukuthi laba abantu abayizigebengu basebenzisana nomunye umuntu ongumngcwabi onamakhaza futhi badayisa imigodi ngokungemthetho," kusho uKhwela owusibonda esizweni sakwaMakhanya.Uthe kudala kule ndawo imigodi yayibiza u-R30 ukuze kuholelwe labo abawagadayo amathuna baphinde bawahlanze kodwa laba bakamuva bebewubiza u-R-2 500 umgodi."Siqonde kubo ngoLwesihlanu sababuza ukuthi benzani ngoba bebemba. Bashone ezintangeni. Imigodi esiyificile kube emithathu yabantu abadala nemihlanu yezingane, okusho ukuthi bebezofihlwa ngempelasonto. Esilwa nakho wukuthi asisafuni kungcwatshwe abantu kule ndawo ngoba yavalwa kudala, ngisho ibandla alisangcwabi kuyona," kusho yena. Uthe amadoda abawaficile ematasa emba imigodi abengaphelele kodwa laba abebekhona babatitinye ngenduku njengoba ngisho imali abebeyikhokhelwe ngokuthi bambe imigodi bebeyiphethe.Uthe bathole ukuthi kunabantu abathathu abangobhongoza kulo mkhuba okuyibo abaqasha abantu abamba imigodi. Uthe ababili besilisa noyedwa wesifazane. Uveze ukuthi emasontweni amathathu adlule bathole ukuthi bese bedayisa nomhlaba osegcekeni lesonto ngqo, okuthe uma abesonto bebuza ngakho bahlaselwa amadoda abehlome ngezibhamu.Uveze ukuthi bawabizile amaphoyisa kodwa bona bengumphakathi abalivulanga icala ngakho abazi ukuthi abasolwa bazothweswa yini amacala ngokusemthethweni.Uthe bashiyele emaphoyiseni ukuthi abone ukuthi enzani ngabo kwazise bona njengabaholi banqande umphakathi usufuna bashiswe ngamathayi."Njengobuholi bendawo besingeke sivume ukuthi kwenzeke into enjalo yokuthi kushiswe abantu. Yingakho sikhethe ukuthi sibanikele ezandleni zamaphoyisa yize bucika ubugebengu abebebenza ngoba bebemba amathuna abantu bethi akungcwatshwe phezu kwawo. Asazi ukuthi bebenzenjani uma behlangana nebhokisi okanye amathambo omunye umuntu owafihlwa kule ndawo." Ugcizelele ukuthi bakhona nabanye abasazobabamba abebengekho.Uthe bafuna ukuthi bavele nabantu abangcwabe izihlobo zabo kula mathuna bedayiselwa imigodi yizigilamkhuba.NgoMgqibelo ekuseni bekuvele ezinkundleni zokuxhumana abantu bethi sekubanjwe abantu abambe izidumbu zabantu kula mathuna nokho okubuye kwavela ukuthi akulona iqiniso. Kwenzeka lokhu nje, kuyaziwa ukuthi kunenkinga yokuntuleka kwezindawo zokungcwaba eThekwini namaphethelo okukholakala ukuthi sekuvule intuba yokuzinothisa ebantwini abangamathamelangozi.Iphoyisa elingagunyaziwe ukukhuluma nabezindaba lisiqinisekisile isigameko sokubanjwa kwabebemba amathuna, lathi umphakathi ubagqibisile imigodi abese beyimbile.
INTOKAZI yaKwaMnqobokazi, eHluhluwe, uNksz Thandoh BS Gumede, izokwethula irobhothi elakhele ukufukula intsha yasezindweni ebezincishwe amathuba ngaphambili. UNksz Gumede (31) uthe leli robhothi elibizwa ngo-Iris lizokwethulwa eDurban Golf Club (DGC) ngo-Agasti 19 ngo-6 ebusuku."Lo mcimbi kulindeleke ukuba ube yingqophamlando ngenxa yokuthi uzobe uhanjelwe ngabantu abamqoka okubalwa kubo iPhini likaNgqongqoshe uNomalungelo Gina, uMphathiswa wezeMfundo nowezokuThuthukiswa koMnotho KwaZulu-Natal, nabazobe bemele uhulumeni waseBotswana."Uthe u-Iris yirobhothi elithuthukiswe yinkampani iBSG Technologies kaNksz Gumede ngenhloso yokufukula imfundo yabantwana abasukela kuGrade R kuya ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme. "Leli robhothi lisebenzisa izilimi eziyishumi nanye ezisemthethweni kuleli. Lakhiwe ngenhloso yokucija abafundi ukuze behlale besemgangathweni futhi bakwazi ukuba sezingeni elilinganayo nozakwabo bakwamanye amazwe."Uthe uyakholelwa ukuthi yonke ingane iyakudinga ukunikezwa imfundo eseqophelweni eliphezulu nezoyenza iqasheke."Ngakho u-Iris uzofeza lelo phupho." Yize esemncane ngeminyaka kodwa uNksz Gumede usungule isikole samabanga aphansi esifundisa izingane zasemakhaya ngeSayensi, ezobuchwepheshe, ezobunjiniyela, coding and robotics. Isikole sokuqala esizimele esisendaweni yasemakhaya esigxile kulo mkhakha. Uthe inhlosongqangi ngeBSG and Technologies Combined Primary ukuhlinzeka abafundi nge-4th Industrial Revolution ngenhloso yokuthi bengaphuthelwa ngamathuba emisebenzi. Nakuba okwamanje lesi sikole sisaqala kwaGrade RR sigcine kuGrade 9 kodwa uphokophele ukuba sigcine kuGrade 12 ngo-2026 futhi sibe yi-boarding school. UNksz Gumede yintokazi esebenza ngokukhulu ukuzikhandla njengoba ike yaqwaqwada zonke izintokazi zase-Afrika emqhudelwaneni iMiss Dot Afrika, kudliwana imilala ngezobuchwepheshe. Waba kwi-Top 50 kwiLadies of Liberty Programme eyamenza ayocobelele ulwazi eDubai. Njengamanje unguMiss Tech Universe ka-2024/25, okuyisicoco asinqoba eThailand nyakenye. UNksz Gumede wafunda amabanga aphansi KwaMnqobokazi Primary, wadlulela KwaGiba High, okuyizikole ezisendaweni. Abazali bakhe bebengasebenzi okwenza kwabanzima kakhulu, lokho kukodwa kwamenza wanesifiso sokukhula elekelele kulesi simo sakubo. "Ngenza izifundo zeSayensi esikoleni samabanga aphezulu, ngaqhubekela e-University of Zululand lapho ngenza khona izifundo zeBSc Microbiology neHydrology. Ukwenza lezi zifundo kwenza ngathola ukuthi likhulu igebe ezindaweni zasemakhaya, ikakhulukazi uma sekumele lapho sekumele senze ama-experiments khona. E-labolatory kwakumele ngiqale kabusha ukwazi izinsiza kusebenza njengoba ezikoleni zethu sasinganawo ama-laboratory." kusho uNksz Gumede oyingane yesine kaMnuz Bongani Gumede noNkk Nomthandazo Gumede. Izikole ezidinga ukummema nerobhothi lakhe zingamthinta ku-/[email protected].
UMZWILILI we-jazz odabuka ePitoli kodwa osuzinze eBelgium, uTutu Puoane, unochungechunge lwamakhonsathi azobe ekhangisa kuwo nge-double album yakhe esihloko sithi Wrapped In Rhythm emadolobheni akuleli kule nyaacvnga.UTutu uthe wafakelwa ugqozi incwadi yezinkondlo yembongi uLebo Mashile esihloko sithi In A Ribbon of Rhythm, ayehlale eyifake ekhwapheni cishe iminyaka elishumi yonke.Uthe okwakumchaza ngezinkondlo zikaLebo zazidingida kabanzi ngamaqiniso emhlabeni athinta owesifazane omnyama waseNingizimu Afrika emuva kokuphela kobandlululo. Lezi zinkondlo zamthinta kangangoba wayethi uma ezifunda, ezwe umculo. "Ngiyakhumbula ukuthi lalingithinta kanjani emphefumulweni iqoqo lezinkondlo elaliqukethwe yi-In Ribbon of Rhythm. Ngangihlale ngithola izinto ngezwe lami okwakunzima ukuzichaza. Kwakuyinto engajwayelekile ukuthi emuva kweminyaka ngahamba ekhaya kodwa kunento esangixhumanisa nezwe nabantu. Izinkondlo zikaLebo zangisiza ukuba ngikwazi ukusho izinto engangingeke ngizisho mina."UTutu uthe wahlangana noLebo eGoli, ngo-2014. "Ngamtshela ukuthi umsebenzi wakhe ungihlabe kanjani umxhwele. Wabe esengipha ikhophi yencwadi yakhe futhi wangibusisa ngokungivumela ukuba ngiqhubeke nokucula amazwi akhe. Waba nomusa, uthando nemfudumulo futhi washesha wabona kuwumqondo omuhle. Wayithanda inkondlo yakhe yokuqala engayiqopha kwenye yama-albhamu, ngakho wawumukela umbono wokuba ngenze wonke umsebenzi womculo ngezinkondlo zakhe."UTutu wabe esebhala iqoqo lezingoma azisusele ezinkondlweni azithanda zikaLebo, okwenza kwaphuma unqambothi lwe-double album esihloko sithi Wrapped In Rhythm, ingxenye yokuqala ephume ngoMashi 2024, asebenze kuyo nengwazi yomculi enguphrojusa waseMelika, uLarry Klein. Ngo-Agasti 2024, leli cwecwe lihlabane ngemklomelo emithathu kumaSouth African Jazz Awards, emunxeni weBest Female Artist, Best International Jazz Album noweBest Contemporary Jazz Album. Ekhuluma ngalolu chungechunge lwamakhonsathi, uTutu unxuse abantu bakuleli ukuba bafike ngobuningi babo ngoba bazobhema bakholwe. "Ngingathanda abantu abazofika bahlale phansi, bacishe amafoni bese bephuza kula mazwi (kaLebo) nasemculweni. Ngizozidlala nezinye izingoma ezindala kodwa yithuba lokuba abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bazwe umlingo womsebenzi kaLebo Mashile othi In A Ribbon Of Rhythm." UTutu uqale ukunandisa eMarket Theatre eGoli, ngoLwesihlanu, wase edlulela eState Theatre ePitoli, namhlanje, e-UKZN Jazz Centre, eThekwini ngoLwesithathu, adlulele eYoungblood Gallery eCape Town ngoLwesihlanu, eGuga S'thebe eCape Town, ngeSonto elizayo, bese imbenge eyisonga eThe One Room eGqeberha, ngo-Agasti 15.Kula makhonsathi uzobe ephelezelwa ngu-Ewout Pierreux.
UMCULI wesifazane onezingoma ezishisa izikhotha kulezi zinsuku kwiYouTube nakuSpotify, uThandeka Hadebe, ukhuze ibuya ngesivuthevuthe se-albhamu esihloko sithi Indawo Yenyembezi. Kule-albhamu ephume ngoLwesihlanu, uThandeka (32)) waseHlokozi eHighflats, usebenze neNkosi Yamagcokama engomeni ethi Bavele Bangithatha noLindani Gumede engomeni ethi Impilo Iyazenzela."Uma bekuphathe kabi, ikhona eyakho ingoma ewu-nombolo 2 . Uma uzazi ukuthi uyingqongqo, ukulindile unombolo 3. Uma usothandweni eyokugcina eyakho. Ukhetha oyithandayo. EzikaBhombela yizo engivule ngazo." Kwenzeka lokhu nje i-albhamu kaThandeka yangonyaka ofile esihloko sithi Wang'shela Wazi igila izimanga kwiYouTube nakwiSpotify. KwiYouTube le ngoma eyisihloko saleli cwecwe seyidlalwe amahlandla angaphezu kuka-2.1 million, ethi Musa Uku-confessor seyino-1 million, iWozani seyino-4 million kanti ethi Kuyangihlula Ukugana seyino-1.2 million. KwiSpotify iWozani ino-3.1 million streams, iWang'shela Wazi seyino-1.3 million bese iMusa Uku-confessor seyiku-1.3 million. UThandeka uthe ubonga kakhulu abantu bakuleli ngokumqophisa umlando wokuba ngumculi wokuqala wesifazane ukufinyelela kuleli zinga njengoba ama-million asewenzile engaphezu kuka-14. "Zingane zakwethu ngiswele wona amazwi okubonga angalingana nendlela enginibonga ngayo. Eningenzele khona kukhulu kakhulu, iqiniso enilenze kimi njengomuntu wesifazane endimeni, angazi ngingabonga ngithini. Umlando niwuqophe ngami bafowethu, bukani eningenzele khona lapha babhemu. U-14 million umlando lo eniwenze kule-albhamu." UThandeka ngomunye wabaculi abaqale benandisa emigwaqweni yaseThekwini futhi umculo wabo ungadlalwa emisakazweni njengoba esedlisela ozakwabo besifazane nabesilisa ngokudayisa. Nakuba kunjalo akalilahlanga ithemba njengoba agcina eseqokwa eminxeni emibili kuma-Independent National Gospel Music Awards (Ingoma) ngo-2021.Wayeqokwe emunxeni weBest Gospel Maskandi nakoweBest Promotion nge-albhamu yakhe eyayithi Anginavalo (Inkom' Ingazal'Umuntu). Wayeqala ngqa ukuqokwa emqhudelwaneni wezindondo selokhu afika emculweni ngo-2009."Kade ngangizama kodwa kungalungi. Ngiqale emculweni ngiphelezela abanye abaculi ngephimbo. Ngo2015 ngabe sengenza eyami i-albhamu ethi Bayeke Bahleke. Ngo-2019 ngibe sengilandelisa ngethi Anginavalo." Ubuye wakhipha i-albhamu ethi Tshelan' Abantu.UThandeka uyingane yesibili ebantwaneni abane bakaNkk Bonangani uMaXulu noMnuz Thulebona Hadebe. Uphothule u-matric eMkhumbi High ngo-2012 ngaphambi kokufundela ubuntatheli eDurban University of Technology (DUT).
UMENGAMELI woMkhonto Wesizwe Party (MKP), uMnuz Jacob Zuma uthi ngabe usexoshe inqwaba yabantu kuleli qembu kodwa kusiza khona ukuthi abanye babaholi baleli qembu babuye bamkhuze.Ubekade ekhuluma njengoba leli qembu kade linesithangami nabezindaba eGoli. Uthe uye abezwe nje bethi uxosha njalo kanti kazisoli ngalokho ngoba kuleli qembu kakudlalwa kodwa kumele kusetshenzwe.Leli qembu libe seliphumela obala ngongazisoli ngokweseka imizamo yeMorocco yokubusa iWestern Sahara. USihlalo waleli qembu uMnuz Nkosinathi Nhleko ukugcizelelile ukuthi bamile kulokhu abakholelwa kukhona njengeqembu. Mayelana nokuthi uMengameli waleli qembu uMnuz Jacob Zuma wethula inkulumo yokweseka iMorocco emi eduze kwefulegi laseNingizimu Afrika uthe ifulegi akuselona elezwe kodwa nabo elabo.Loyo oyiNhloko ehhovisini likaMengameli waleli qembu uMagasela Mzobe uthe okwamanje kusanomsindo ngalokhu abakholelwa kukhona kokweseka iMorocco.Uthe kodwa kungekudala kuzohlala obala ukuthi iMK yiyona ethathe isinqumo esikahle futhi okumele izwe lonke liseseke.Ukuphikile ukuthi kukhona uxhaso lwemali olutholwa yileli qembu oluvela eMorocco.''Akukho lutho okuvela eMorocco okutholwa yileli qembu. Akukho futhi asake sakuthola akukho nesikubhekile kodwa senza lokhu esikholwa ukuthi kumele sikwenze,'' usho kanjena.
IMEYA kaMasipala waseNewcastle, uMnuz Xolani Dube, isivikele isinqumo somkhandlu sokusiza izakhamuzi ebezingenawo ugesi ngoba zanqanyulelwa i-Eskom.Lezi zakhamuzi bese kuphele iminyaka zihleli ebumnyameni. Izikhulu zomkhandlu zingaphansi kwengcindezi evela ezinhlakeni, okubalwa kuzo i-AfriForum, ezibasola ngokudlala ipolitiki nokukhankasa njengoba kuyiwa okhethweni lohulumeni basekhaya ngonyaka ozayo.Esithangamini sabezindaba eNewcastle, izolo, uDube uthe abakwazi ukuhlala basonge izandla abantu besenkingeni. "Kubuhlungu ukuthi kube khona abagxekayo uma sizama ukulekelela abantu bakithi, akusilo iqiniso ukuthi siyakhankasa ngokusiza kodwa senza umsebenzi wethu okuMthethosisekelo," usho kanje.Uthe bazosivikela isinqumo sabo, wengeza ngokuthi bangaya ngisho enkantolo uma kufanele."Lolu daba siluxoxe ezinhlakeni eziningi sawufaka nomphakathi ngaphambi kokuthi sithathe isinqumo," usho kanje. Uthe bathathe isinqumo sokuthi bathenge iziphehli zikagesi ezingu-47 ngo-R2. 4 million. UDube uthe lolu hlelo luzohlomulisa umphakathi wasoSizweni naseMadedeni."Baningi abantu abazohlomula kulolu hlelo, yimindeni leyo edla imbuya ngothi." Imenenja yoMkhandlu, uMnuz Zamani Mcineka, ithe baqale bathola izeluleko zomthetho ngaphambi kokuthi bathathe lesi sinqumo.Ithe ummeli abaxoxe naye uthe isinqumo sabo siyahambisana nomsebenzi wabo oseMthethwenisisekelo.UMcineka uthe imali abayisebenzisile ileyo ebekelwe zona izinhlelo zokulekelela imiphakathi.Uthe bazoqhubeka nokufuqa intuthuko emphakathini noma kukhona abazama ukubaphazamisa.
BAZOHLEKA bodwa abantu abakhonze ukudla kwasemanzini nokuthakwe ngezinhlanzi nezinye izilwane ezihlala emanzini njengoba abebhizinisi lendawo yokudlela elaziwa umhlaba wonke i-Ocean Basket, sebevule enye indawo yokudlela eseLa Lucia, eMhlanga Ridge, enyakatho yeTheku.Le ndawo yokudlela, esendaweni yabadla izambane likapondo, iqale ukusebenza namhlanje (ngoLwesihlanu), kanti futhi isingeyesine kule ndawo njengoba yelama ezintathu zokuqala zokudlela zale nkampani eseDurban North, eGateway neseMhlanga Rocks.Esinye sezikhulu ze-Ocean Basket uMnuz John Camacho uthe isunqumo sokuqala le ndawo siqhamuke ngoba bebona kufanele ukuthi bangeze eyesine ngenxa yokuthandwa kwalezi ezintathu ebezivele zikhona, okwenze babona ukuthi nalena izothandwa kakhulu. "Kulena entsha siqashe abasebenzi abawu-30 ngokugcwele, kanti yona yenza ukuthi isibalo sezindawo zethu zokudlela zibe wu-129 emhlabeni kuleli zwe, kube ngeziwu-48 ezisemazweni ehlukene omhlaba koDubai, eSaudi Arabia, e-United Kingdom nakwamanye amazwe ehlukene ase-Afrika,” usho kanje."Kanti asicginile lana, njengoba sesivele siyaqhubeka nezinhlelo zokuthi sivule ezinye izitolo emhlabeni wonke jikelele, kubalwa ezimbili futhi esizozivula andukuba kuphele lo nyaka khona lana eThekwini eRiverside naseSpringfield Park,” kusho uCamacho.UNksz Khari Mulungwa wophiko lwezokumaketha e-Ocean Basket yena uthe njengoba sebevule le ndawo eMhlanga Ridge, babheke ukuthi baqhubeke ne nto abaziwa ngayo yokudidiyela ukudla nempatho kwezinga eliphezulu emakhasimendeni akho, okubasiza ukuthi baqhubeke babe yinkampani ethenjwayo yezokudla kwasemanzini kuphela.I-Ocean Basket isineminyaka ewu-30 ikhona njengoba isitolo sayo sokuqala saqala ukusebenza ePitoli ngo-1995.
Abadayisa Ngomzimba Bathatha Isithuthuthu Ngokungakhokhelwa: E-Verulam CBD - KZNAbadayisa ngomzimba ababili (2) bebetholakala nesithuthuthu sikagesi i-Dimentro abasiphuca ngenxa yokungakhokhelwa kwabo.Ozibonele ngawakhe ubikele onogada beRUSA ukuthi besifazane bebephusha isithuthuthu ku-Todd Street enkabeni yedolobha laseVerulam.Onogada bathunyelwe kule ndawo ukuphenya ngalolu daba bathola bobabili abesifazane nesithuthuthu eduze kwaseVerulam Train Station. Ngesikhathi bephekwa ngemibuzo, laba besifazane babikele izikhulu ukuthi basebenza ngokudayisa ucansi.Baphinde bathi owesilisa ufike kubo ntambama izolo. Wacela usizo lwabo wabe esebathengela utshwala ngaphambi kokuba abhukhe igumbi. Iklayenti lasebenzisa izinsiza zabo bobathathu (3) abesifazane ubusuku bonke, kodwa lino-R100 kuphela wokukhokha owesifazane oyedwa (1).Abesifazane ababili (2) abangakhokhelwa bagodle okhiye besithuthuthu sakhe njengesibambiso ngesikhathi enza izinhlelo zokuthola u-R300 osele ukuze akhokhele imisebenzi abayenzayo. Abesifazane balinda amahora ambalwa, kodwa ikhasimende alizange libuye nemali.Banqume ukuliphusha sisuka ku-Wick Street kuya e-Verulam Train Station ngenhloso yokuthola umuntu ongasiza ekugibeleni isithuthuthu nokuthungatha ikhasimende. I-Reaction Officers ilandele imininingwane yelayisensi ukuthi kutholakale umnikazi wesithuthuthu obhalisiwe bathola ukuthi ngesebhizinisi. Ufikile omele ibhizinisi wathatha okungokwakhe.
KUHLULE ngisho uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa esezikhalela kuMengameli waseMelika uDonald Trump, ukuba kumiswe ukusebenza kwentela ka-30% eyengezwa emikhiqizweni yakuleli ethunyelwa eMelika. Intela entsha okuthiwa izoshaya kuzwele ezinkampanini zakuleli ezihwebelana neMelika, iqale ukusebenza namhlanje. URamaphosa ushayele uTrump ucingo ngaphambi kokuqala kokusebenza kwentela ngenxa yokungabi khona kwenqubekela phambili ezingxoxweni zala mazwe ngalolu daba.UNgqongqoshe eHhovisi likaMengameli, uNksz Khumbudzo Ntshavheni, uthe asikho isivumelwano okufinyelelwe kuso kulo mhlangano.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba lapho ebethula izinqumo ezithathwe emhlanganweni weKhabhinethi. "Inhloso enkulu kaRamaphosa yokufonela uTrump bekuyikho nje ukwelekelela ithimba lakuleli eliqhuba izingxoxo nelaseMelika. URamaphosa uzoqhubeka nokwelekelela ithimba elihola izingxoxo. Asikho ke isivumelwano abebengasenza ocingweni, ithimba kufanele liqhubeke nezingxoxo."UNksz Ntshavheni uthe abakalilahli ithemba lokuba la mazwe azogcina efinyelelile esivumelwaneni."IKhabhinethi inxuse uhulumeni ukuba aqhubeke nokuzama ukuthola isisombululo. Kufanele ziqhubeke izingxoxo zamazwe omabili." UNksz Ntshavheni uthe intela entsha izokhahlameza kakhulu ezolimo nezinkampani ezikhiqiza impahla yezimoto.Uthe baqhamuka namaqhinga okuthumela impahla yakuleli kwamanye amazwe ukuze izinkampani zingeke zithembele kwiMelika."Kufanele sizame ukusabalalisa imikhiqizo yethu kwamanye amazwe. Kufanele sithumele imikhiqizo e-Asia, Europe, naseMiddle East. Sizokwelekelela izinkampani ukuba zikwazi ukuthumela imikhiqizo yazo kwamanye amazwe." UNksz Ntshavheni uthe bazokuba nezinhlelo zokweseka izinkampani ezizothikanyezwa intela entsha. Ukusebenza kwentela entsha kubeka engcupheni imisebenzi engu-30 000.UNksz Ntshavheni uthe bazoqhamuka nezinhlelo zokuvikela imisebenzi ingalahleki. "Sizokugwema ukulahleka kwemisebenzi. Siyazi ukuthi isimo somnotho asisihle, baningi abantu abangasebenzi. Ingakho sizolwela ukuthi kungabi khona abantu abazolahlekelwa imisebenzi ngenxa yalentela."Akuyona iNingizimu Afrika kuphela ebhekene nolaka lweMelika njengoba nezinkampani zakwamanye amazwe, zizokhokha intela uma zithumela imikhiqizo eMelika.Omakhelwane beNingizimu Afrika bakwazile ukuzikhalela kwiMelika, behliselwa intela. ISwatini, esanda kwamukela izigebengu eziyingozi ezisuka emajele aseMelika, yehliselwe intela ngo-10%.Izinkampani zaseLesotho zona sezizokhokha intela ka-10% esikhundleni sika-50% owawumenyezelwe uTrump ekuqaleni.
KUSHUBILE esizweni sakwaNxamalala, eMpendle, kulandela ukuboshelwa icala lokubulala kwenkosi yesizwe obekungakapheli sikhathi esingakanani ikhishwe ngebheyili kwelinye icala lokubulala.Selokhu kuphinde kwaboshwa Inkosi uSimphiwe Eric Zuma, ayicaci kahle indlela eya phambili njengoba kubhuntshe nomhlangano obubizelwe ukuzobhunga ngalolu daba.Umzamo wokubiza umhlangano wokubhunga ngalolu daba wachithwa emva kokuba kube khona abavukele undunankulu wesizwe, uMnuz Tallman Zuma, befuna ukuthi axoshelwe ukubiza umhlangano uZuma engekho.UZuma (Inkosi) uboshelwe icala lokubulala ikhansela eliwumshana wakhe, uMnuz Nhlalayenza Ndlovu.Abaholi bomphakathi bathe bakhathazekile ngokuboshwa kukaZuma abathe kudala ukudideka emphakathini.UZuma uzovela eNkantolo yeMantshi eHowick ngoLwesihlanu, lapho ezofaka khona isicelo sebheyili.UZuma uboshwa nje ubengaphandle ngebheyili ka-R25 000 ecaleni lokubulala undunankulu wesizwe, uMnuz Qalokunye Zuma.UZuma uyena nkosi enomhlaba omkhulu eMpendle njengoba indawo yakhe ize iphele eMpophomeni, eHowick.Undunankulu wesizwe, uMnuz Tallman Zuma, uthe kukhulu ukukhathazeka esizweni njengoba inkosi iboshiwe."Ukhungathekile umkhandlu kodwa ke silindile njengoba icala lisazoqulwa enkantolo. Nakuba singakaluhlaleli phansi udaba kodwa ke uma uhamba ukhuluma nabantu esizweni, uyezwa ukuthi kukhulu ukukhathazeka." UTallman uthe nakuba uZuma engekho umkhandlu uyaqhubeka nokusebenza."Imikhandlu iyakwazi ukuqhubeka isebenze noma inkosi ingekho. Vele amakhosi awakwazi ukuhambela yonke imihlangano yemikhandlu ngenxa yokuba matasa."UTallman uthe wazama ukubiza umhlangano wokubhunga ngalolu daba ngesikhathi uZuma eboshelwe icala lokuqala.Eqhuba uthe umhlangano wagcina ubhuntsha ngenxa yokuthi kwaba khona abakhalayo, bethi akakwazi ukubiza umhlangano inkosi ingekho.Uthe inhloso yomhlangano kwabe kuwukuzogqugquzela ukuthula esizweni."Uma uzokhumbula undunankulu (owabulawa) owakwaZuma, nenkosi eyakwaZuma. Kwakubalulekile ukuthi kungasuki impi kube khona abaxhasa inkosi, nabaxhasa umndeni kandunankulu. Ngangivimba lokho. Ngangizama ukuvimba impi. Ngenhlanhla bangizwa abashonelwe."Ikhansela lasendaweni, uMnuz Sadewu Ngubane, lithe sikhulu isizungu emphakathini."Njengekhansela lendawo ngiyabona ukuthi kukhona okukhungethe isizwe samaNxamalala ngokuboshwa kwenkosi. Sinxusa umphakathi ukuthi ubeke amaphaphu phansi, uvumele amaphoyisa ukuba enze umsebenzi wawo. Ngiyazi ukuthi kuba kuningi ukudideka uma inkosi ingekho. Abantu bakhuluma izinto ezahlukene. Nginxusa abantu ukuthi bangadideki. Abalinde inkantolo. Iqiniso wukuthi inkosi iwumsolwa, asikho isinqumo esesithathwe yinkantolo."
IHLANGABEZANE nembibizane iMK emalungiselelweni ayo okhetho lohulumeni basekhaya, njengoba ilaxazwe amakhosi akhala ngendelelo kuleli qembu eliholwa owayengumengameli wezwe, uJacob Zuma. Amakhosi aqhamuka ezifundazweni ezine anqume ukulaxaza iMK ngesikhathi lapho amaqembu ezepolitiki eseqalile ukulungiselela ukhetho lohulumeni basekhaya. La makhosi angaphansi kwenhlangano iTransvaal Kingdom of Monarchs, athe abona engaphenduka izicashalala uma iMK inganqoba ukhetho ezindaweni ezingaphansi kwawo. La makhosi aqhamuka ezifundazweni iGauteng, Mpumalanga, Limpopo neNorth West, athe asekhathele wukwenziwa opopayi wuZuma nabaholi beMK. Esitatimendeni, amakhosi athe sekukaningi ebukelwa phansi abaholi beMK. Amakhosi anqume ukuziqhelelanisa neMK yiNgwenyama Ndzundza wesibili wobukhosi bakwaNdzundza kaMusi, yiSilo uLekhuleni wobukhosi bakwaMohwaduba, yiNnkosi Ntsele, yiNdlovukazi Sheba, yiNkosi Manana, nobukhosi bamaNguni. Okhulumela la makhosi, induna Tsebela Pallo, uthe kuzokuba nesithangami nabezindaba ngoSepthemba 1, lapho amakhosi ezogeqa khona amagula ngokuhlukumezeka kwawo kwiMK.Amakhosi athe ukubukelwa kwawo phansi kwagqama kakhulu ngesikhathi kwethulwa umkhankaso weMK wokhetho eGoli, lapho aphenduka khona ondingasithebeni njengoba kwaba nobuhixihixi sekufanele ayohlaliswa lapho kwakuhlezi khona izicukuthwane.Athe aphinde aphenduka inhlekisa nangesikhathi kunomcimbi wokugubha unyaka kwasungulwa iMK, owawuseMoses Mabhida, lapho makhosi avinjwa ukuba aye endaweni eyayihlezi izicukuthwane. "Le nto yokudelelwa kwamakhosi yenzeka kuzo zonke izifundazwe. Wumkhuba nje wakhona kwiMK ukwedelelwa kwamakhosi."Amakhosi athe okuwacasule kakhulu wukungafiki kukaZuma emhlanganweni wabo obekufanele ube ngeSonto.Amakhosi aqhamuka ezifundazweni ezahlukene athe ayela ubala emzini kaZuma oseNkandla njengoba engazange amfice. "Kwaqala nje kwaba nesidididi ngaphambi komhlangano. Kwaba khona isimemezelo esithi umhlangano usuhlehlisiwe. Sabuya sathola umyalezo oqinisekisa ukuthi umhlangano uzoqhubeka. Ngesikhathi amakhosi efika emzini kaZuma atshelwa amaphoyisa ukuthi uZuma akekho, ngeke ahlangane nawo."IMK ifuna ukucoboshisa kwasani okhethweni oluzayo futhi ithembele kakhulu kubantu abahlala ezindaweni eziphethwe amakhosi. IMK ayikufihli ukuthi ifuna izwe liphathwe amakhosi. Nakuba iMK ihlezi ithi iyawahlonipha amakhosi, kepha amakhosi alaxaze leli qembu ayaphikisana nalokhu. Amakhosi athe kusobala ukuthi azophucwa amandla awo uma kungase kuphathe iMK."Le nto eyenzekile isivule amehlo ikakhulukazi njengoba kuza ukhetho lohulumeni basekhaya. Indelelo yabo isikhombise ngokusobala ukuthi sizobukelwa phansi uma bengase banqobe ukhetho ezindaweni zamakhosi." Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kokhulumela iMK, uMnuz Nhlamulo Ndhlela, ayizange iphumelele njengoba ucingo lwakhe belukhala lungabanjwa futhi engazange awuphendule umbuzo awuthunyelwe.
UKHUTHAZA amadoda ukuthi angafeli ngaphakathi kodwa abhoboke ngezinkinga eziwahlalisa lubhojozi emindenini nasemisebenzini owesifazane ongumsunguli wenhlangano Amaqhawekazi Anamandla Movement, uNkk Gugu Mtshali.UNkk Mtshali ongowaseNagina ngokuzalwa uthi amadoda amaningi afela ngaphakathi noma sekunzima kangakanani ngoba nakhu ebambe elokuthi indoda kayikhali. Udalule ukuthi le nhlangnao isungulwe ngo-2019 futhi ngaleso sikhathi umbono ngokusungulwa kwayo kwabe kungukulekelela ekwelashweni kwabesifazane abanezilonda azibhibhayo ezidalwa yizinkinga ezahlukene.''Kuthe ngokuhamba kwesikhathi kwangena nabantu besilisa, okuvelile wukuthi nabo abakhulumi ngoba bebambe elokuthi indoda kayikhulumi ekubeni benezinkinga ezahlukene abazivalele ngaphakathi kubona,'' usho kanjena.Phakathi kwezinkinga ezijulile athe amadoda azivalele ngaphakathi kubalwa eyezingane okwathiwa ngezawo kwagcina kuvela ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ukuthi kakunjalo. Lena uthe yinkinga esiyinsakavukela kodwa ewabulala ephila amadoda kodwa akhethe ukuthalalisa kube sengathi akwenzekanga lutho kube konakele.''Lena ngenye yezinkinga amadoda amaningi azithola ebhekene nayo kodwa kuba lukhuni satshe kuwona ukuba aphumele obala ngalokhu. Kule nhlangano ke siyawalalela amadoda kakhulu futhi siyawakhuthaza ukuthi akhulume kunokuthi afele ngaphakathi,'' usho kanjena.Uthe nabo njengabantu besifazane bayakuvuma ukuthi akhona amadoda ahlukunyezwayo ngakho ke lokhu uthi akumele kushalazelwe.''Kuyinyanga yamadoda iqiniso okumele silikhulme njengabantu besifazane wukuthi akekho phakathi kwethu ofisa ukubona indodana yakhe ihlukumezeka kumbeke abone umyeni wakhe ehlukumezeka,'' usho kanje.Uthe udaba lweGBV kakumele lubukwe ohlangothini olulodwa kodwa kumele lubukwe ngeso elijulile futhi lubukwe kuzona zombili izinhlangothi kwabesifazane kanjalo nakwabesilisa.''Uma kukhulunywa ngeGBV akumele kuwakheke isithombe sowesilisa ehlukumeza owesifazane, kodwa kumele kubuye kucatshangwe indoda ihlukunyezwa nayo,'' echaza.Ukhale kakhulu ngokuthi maningi amadoda ahlukumezekayo egameni lothando.''Uma siyimbokodo singasukuma silwe ngomkhuleko singavumi ukubona amadodana athu ehlukumezeka ngenxa yothando ngabe senze umsebenzi omuhle kakhulu,'' usho kanjena.Uthe kugcina sekuphuma nezidumbu ngenxa nje yokuthi amadoda ayehluleka wukukhuluma futhi akekho ozimisele ngokuwalalela.Uthe le nhlangano ivulelekile ekulalelweni kwezikhalazo zamadoda nokuwacebisa kanjalo futhi yinto efanayo nakubantu besifazane.
NKOSIKHONA CELEUMENGAMELI wokuqala wesifazane wenhlangano yabangcwabi, iSouth African Funeral Practitioners Association (SAFPA), uNkk Nomfundo Mcoyi-Zondo ufuna kube khona okwenziwayo ukwandisa isibalo sabesifazane kanye nabantu abasha abangena kulo mkhakha. Lokhu ngezinye zezinto athe ziseqhulwini ezinhlelweni zakhe njengoba esanda kuqokelwa kulesi sikhundla.Selokhu yasungulwa eminyakeni engu-26 eyedlule iSAFPA kungokokuqala ukuba iholwe ngumuntu wesifazane.UNkk Mcoyi-Zondo ubekhuluma kwindumezulu yomcimbi wokwamukelwa kwakhe kanye nokwethulwa ngokusemthethweni obuse-ICC, eThekwini, ngempelasonto. Uthe njengomuntu wesifazane uzimisele kakhulu ngokuthi abacathulise abesifazane abanentshisekelo yokungena kwezokungcwaba kodwa abaye bazizwe bengenwa ngamanzi emadolweni."Sizoba nazo izinhlelo zokubalekelela bonke abesifazane abanentshisekelo yokungena kule mboni. Akumele kuqhubeke kanjena kube sengathi yimboni yabantu besilisa kuphela,'' usho kanjena.Uthe bafuna nokuqinisekisa ukuthi siyanda nesibalo sabantu abasha abangena kulo mkhakha. Okwamanje uthe abantu abasha abakhona kule mboni yilabo abangena ngesikhathi beshiyelwa abazali babo ibhizinisi.''Sikholwa wukuthi kungaba yinto enhle kakhulu ukubona abantu abasha bengena begxila ebhizinisini lokungcwaba. Sizimisele ngokuthi sibalekelele ngayo yonke indlela labo abafisayo ukungena." Uveze nokuthi kuzokuba nezigcawu zokucobelela ngolwazi abangcwabi abasafufusa babanike amasu angabalekelela ukuze kuthuthuke amabhizinisi abo. Mayelana nezinselelo ezikhona kule mboni uthe eqhulwini bazobheka ngeso elibanzi eyengwadla yokushoda kwezindawo zokungcwaba.Lo mcimbi ubuzinyaziswe yizicukuthwane nezikhulu ezahlukene.Bekukhona neMeya yeTheku uMnuz Cyril Xaba omhalalisele kakhulu uNkk Mcoyi-Zondo ngokugixabezwa ngesikhundla esiphezulu. NoMbhishobhi Vusi Dube weThekwini Community Church uthe kuyinto enhle kakhulu ukubona abesifazane benikezwa ithuba lokuhola.UNgqongqoshe wokuBusa nokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, uyincomile iSAFPA ngokungabheki ubulili kodwa inikeze isikhundla loyo muntu obonakala kumfanele ukuhola. Umyeni kaDkt Mcoyi-Zondo, uDkt Bahle Zondo, umncome kakhulu ngokusebenza ngokuzikhandla ukwenza igama lakhe livelele.
OMUNYE wofakazi ecaleni lezibhelu ezenzeka eVerulam, ngo-2021, lapho okwagcina kubulawa khona ngesihluku uMnuz Njabulo Allen Dlamini kwalinyazwa kabi nabanye, ukhombe abasolwa abathathu wathi ubakhumbula kahle ukuthi yibona ababephambili ngesikhathi kusuka uthuthuva.Kuleli cala abamangalelwa ngoMnuz Ravive Naidoo (67) ongummangalelwa wokuqala, uTrevor Gopal (52) ongummangalelwa wesibili, Tyreece Govender (21) ongummangalelwa wesithathu noTimothy Govender (46) ongummangalelwa wesine.Basolwa ngokuthi yibona ababephambili bebhebhezela udlame lokushaywa kwabantu ngesikhathi sezibhelu ngoJulyi 12, 2021, kule ndawo. Babekwe amacala okubulala uDlamini kanye nawokuzama ukubulala oMnuz Sandile Collin Sambo noMthobisi Ntuli. Umufi kuvela ukuthi washaywa kabi ekhanda ngenduku yegalofu waphuthunyiswa esibhedlela eMahatma Gandhi, okuyilapho okwafike kwamenela khona.Ufakazi, uMnuz Nkosikhona Madlala, izolo eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini ubekade ethula ubufakazi ngakho konke okwenzeka ngalolu suku.Utshele inkantolo ukuthi babesemotweni eyayingena eVerulam, ngesikhathi kuthushuka imoto eyamane yama phambi kwabo. Uthe kuyona kwehla abathile besilisa ababekade behambisana nenqwaba yabantu bona ababekade behamba ngezinyawo. Uveze ukuthi leli qulu labantu lalikade lihlome ngezikhali ezahlukene okufaka phakathi izinduku zegalofu, izando, izinduku, ocelemba nezimbazo.Uveze ukuthi yena nomunye bazama ukucela empunzini kodwa behluleka ngenxa yokuthi babebaningi kakhulu abantu ababezobahlasela. Udalule ukuthi wabona sekungqongqa itekisi ababekade behamba ngayo."Basiphoqa ukuba singene kuyona ivutha itekisi kodwa sanqaba. Kunalokho, mina ngaze ngalala phansi eceleni kwayo itekisi,'' usho kanje. Uveze ukuthi washaywa kwaze kwaphela ihora walimala kabi. Ukhombe ummangalelwa wokuqala wathi wambona efake ijakhethi futhi ehlomile. "Ngambona, wayekade efake i-tracksuit. Kodwa kwathi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi eqhubeka engishaya wagcina eseyikhumula ijakhethi esala ngesikibha esiluhlaza,'' usho kanje.Uqhubekile wakhomba ummangalelwa wesithathu, wathi wambona ngoba wayemshaya ngenduku yegalofu umzimba wonke. Uthe futhi wayekade efake amateku nekepisi elimnyama."Yena wayekade engishaya umzimba wonke, aphinde angishaye nasekhanda,'' usho kanje. Ukhombe nommangalelwa wesine, wathi wayengomunye owabaphoqa ukuba baphume emotweni ababehamba ngayo. Uthe wayephethe isando esinombala o-silver futhi sinerabha emnyama nenduku ende e-brown ngombala.Uthe wayefake isifonyo esimnyama ebusweni, esifana nesasisetshenziswa ngesikhathi kudlange uKhuvethe nesikhindi se-jean esi-navy, ikepisi elinombala oluhlaza, nesikibha esiluhlaza.Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi uthe wasisusa isifonyo nekepisi.Uthe yilapho aqaphela khona ukuthi ugundile ekhanda. Uveze ukuthi nakuba wasinda naye akazi ukuthi wasinda kanjani. Icala liyaqhubeka.
KUPHELE amahlathi okucasha abesifazane abane baseNtshanga, eCamperdown bebanjwa nenqwaba yezitifiketi zokufa, ezokuzalwa, ezomshado, ezika-matric, izincwadi zodokotela, izigxivizo zasesibhedlela, omazisi nenqwaba yamakhadi asemabhange ahlukene.Laba basolwa ngenkohlakalo ethinta imali yezibonelelo zakwaSassa nokunye.Ngokuthola kweSolezwe ngomthombo, abasolwa baboshwe wuphiko lwamaphoyisa oluphenya amacala ahleliwe, i-Crime Intelligence isebenzisana nolwe-Organised Crime ngoLwesibili.Ngokusho komthombo bonke abasolwa abaneminyaka ephakathi kuka-36 no-44, baboshwe emizini yabo kanokusho eseNtshanga emva kokuseshwa kwayo maqede kwatholakala izinto ezisolisayo. Umthombo uthe emzini womsolwa (36) wokuqala nowesibili (30), kutholwe izitifiketi zabashonile ezingu-31, isitifiketi soMnyango wezaseKhaya ebesingabhalwe lutho esisodwa, izitifiketi zokuzalwa ezingu-14."Kuphinde kwatholwa nomazisi abangu-34, izithombe zomazisi ezinhlanu, izincwadi zokukhoseliswa kwabokufika (asylum) ezingu-17, amakhadi okuhola izibonelelo angu-14 nezitifiketi zomshado ezintathu,” kusho umthombo othe kubuye kwatholwa namanye amaphepha ehlukahlukene akwaSassa, awoMnyango wezaseKhaya kanjalo nowezeMpilo.Umsolwa wesithathu (44) kuthiwa utholwe namaselula ayisikhombisa, isitembu esisodwa soMnyango wezeMpilo, omazisi abane, amaphepha akwaSassa amahlanu, izitifiketi zika-matric ezinhlanu namakhadi aluhlaza oMnyango wezeMpilo. "Umsolwa wesine (43) utholwe nama-sim card ayishumi, amakhadi asebhange ayisikhombisa, ama-smart shopper cards ayishumi, izitifiketi zokuzalwa ezimbili kanjalo neziliphu zokufaka imali ezintathu,” kusho umthombo. Uveze ukuthi umsolwa oneminyaka engu-36 usanda kuthenga ngokheshi umuzi obiza uR1,1 million eBisley eMgungundlovu, nemoto iToyota Corolla Cross ngoR400 000.Uthe basola ukuthi ubugebengu obenziwa abasolwa bubandakanya ukuhola izibonelelo zikahulumeni zabakhubazekile nezokuguga. "Kutholakale nomazisi babantu asebebadala kanjalo namaphepha odokotela aqinisekisa ukukhubazeka ngokwehlukana,” kusho umthombo.Uveze ukuthi basola nokuthi abasolwa balekelela nabokufika abakuleli ngokungemthetho ukuthi bathole amaphepha athile njengoba kutholwe izincwadi zokubakhoselisa kanjalo namaphepha anezithupha."Sisola nokuthi kukhona nemihlomulo abayithola ngokufa kwabantu njengoba kutholwe nezitifiketi zokushona kwabantu,” usho kanje. Kwenzeka lokhu nje, amaphoyisa ophiko olufanayo ngoJuni kuwo lo nyaka, abopha owesifazane waseMid Illovo ngezinsolo ezifanayo.Umsolwa watholwa nenqwaba yamakhadi asebhange okwavela ukuthi ubelokhu ehola ngawo izibonelelo zakwaSassa kusuka ngo-2013.Lo wesifazane kwavela ukuthi unemizi emithathu yemali eshisiwe okuthiwa ikhokhelwe yaqedwa. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa aseNtshanga abophe abasolwa abane ngamacala okukhwabanisa emva kokuba betholwe namakhadi akwaSassa, awasebhange, izitifiketi zokuzalwa nomazisi."Abasolwa baboshwe ngoLwesibili eNtshanga," kusho uNetshiunda.Uthe bekulindeleke ukuthi abasolwa bavele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseCamperdown izolo.
KUQHUME umkikizo emphakathini waseMondlo, eVryheid, amaphoyisa ophiko lweNational Intervention Unit (NIU), edubula elahla phansi abantu abane kule ndawo ngoLwesibili.Ngokusho komthombo, kubafi bekukhona owesilisa (48) okuthiwa ubesekhathazile ngobugebengu endaweni. Kuvela ukuthi lesi sigameko senzeke emgwaqweni uGobinsimbi, eduze kwamahhovisi oMnyango wezaseKhaya. "Kuthiwa amaphoyisa abelandela umkhondo ngesibhamu esingekho emthethweni. Athe uma ezama ukumisa imoto eyiToyota Tazz esebenzisa amalambu aluhlaza, ebebekuyo bavele bakhetha ukuvulela ngenhlamvu bebhekise emaphoyiseni, nawo avele abuyisela ngayo inhlamvu, kwafa bonke ebebephakathi,” kusho umthombo. Umthombo uqhube wathi endaweni yesigameko, amaphoyisa agcine ethola isibhamu sohlobo lwe-9mm, ebesinenombolo exikiziwe. Uthe amaphoyisa aphinde athola izinhlamvu eziyisikhombisa nemagazini eyodwa. Sizophumula,” kusho umthombo.Uthe abasolwa bebezibandakanya ebugebengwini bezidakamizwa, obokubulala nobokweba izinkomo.
