Kuthiwa isigameko sibikiwe ophikweni oluphenya amacala enziwe amaphoyisa i-Independent Police Investigative Directorate (Ipid).Siye koshicilela amaphoyisa engakaphawula ngalesi sehlakalo.
ABAFUNDI basezikoleni ezimbili zaseNtambanana, eMpangeni, enyakatho yaKwaZulu-Natal, bathole ingqayizivele yethuba becetshiswa ngezindlela zokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, begxile ekubalulekeni kwemfundo nasekugwemeni izinselelo ezingabavimbela empumelelweni.Lokho kwenzeke ngoLwesine, emcimbini obusenkundleni yezemidlalo yakule ndawo, obuhlelwe wuphiko olubheke ukuthuthukiswa komnotho nokuheha abatshali zimali kule ndawo iRichards Bay Industrial Development Zone (RBIDZ) ngokubambisana nophiko loMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu olubhekele ukuthuthukisa ingqalasizinda kaMasipala,iMunicipal Infrastructure Support Agent (MISA).Kulo mbuthwano bekuhlangene abafundi ababalelwa ngaphezu kuka-600 bezikole ezimbili zakule ndawo bakwaGrade 12 okuyiMningi High neMgezeni Secondary, lapho becotshelelwe khona ngolwazi lwemikhakha eyahlukene okumele beyilandele nengabasiza ukuchuma emfundweni. Ethula inkulumo yosuku kulo mbuthwano, uNgqongqoshe woMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu, uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa, ukhuthaze abafundi ukuthi banganqotshwa izimo abakhulele kuzo kepha, basebenzise lezo zimo njengogqozi lokuphokophela empumelelweni, bagxile ekunakeni imfundo yabo."Sebenzisani isimo eniphila kusona njengensika yokunikhuthaza ukuba niphokophele ngemfundo yenu futhi nikhuthalele ukusebenzisa yona ukuphumelela. Lokho ngikwazi ngami ukuthi angikhulanga ngiyisigwili esicaphuna kusale; nami ngingomunye wabantu abakuqonda kahle ukuthi kunjani ukukhulela emndenini oswele. Kepha futhi ngiwufakazi wokuthi ukuzibophezelela emfundweni kuyasiza ukushintsha isimo sakini,” usho kanje."Lokhu enikufundiswa nenizocotshelelwa ngakho namhlanje kumele nikusebenzisele ukuthi nivule iminyango evaliwe. Kumele nikubeke emahlombe enu ukusebenzisa imfundo ukushintsha nokuphucula izimo enikhulela kuzona. Ukuzibophezela kwenu nokuqinisekisa ukubamba ngezandla zombili wonke amathuba okufunda nawezemfundo eninikezelwa ngakho kusukela namhlanje kuzokhuthaza nathi siwuhulumeni ukuthi sinilekelele nganoma yini eniyidingela ukugxila ekufundeni nasekuzithwasiseni ngolwazi,” kusho uHlabisa. Ungqongqoshe wexwayise abafundi ukuthi badlalele kude nezidakamizwa, wuphuzo oludakayo kanjalo nokunaka izinto ezingenasidingo njengokuqomana besebancane, athi kuphazamisa kakhulu impilo yomfundi futhi kungesinye sezizathu ezenza bengachumi."Ngikholwa wukuthi nani nike nibone abangaphambi kwenu abavumela ukubuswa yilezo zinto ukuthi impilo yabo iphazamiseke kangakanani, nokuthi ukungahloniphi, nokungalaleli imiyalelo yabazali neyothisha kuyisana emuva futhi kumisane ndawonye kangakanani. Ngakho nani ngininxusa ukuthi nigweme izinto ezinjalo ukuze ningakhaleli ubisi oluyobe seluchithekile sekungaselula ukulicosha,” kusho yena.Uthe kumjabulise kakhulu ukuthi lo mbuthwano wenziwe lapho sekusele ngaphansana kwezinyanga ezintathu andukuba kuqale uhlelo lokuhlolwa kokugcina kwabafundi baka-Matric, athi ukholwa wukuthi abakufunde kulo mcimbi kuzobalekelela ukuthatha izinqumo ezifanele malungana nendlela abaqoka ukuyithatha emva kokuphothula ibanga lokugcina."Leli thuba lisebenziseni ukuzikhuthaza ukuthi nenze kahle ezifundweni zenu futhi niqhubeke nigxile ekufundeni ukuzilungiselela ukuhlolwa kokugcina ukuze nizoba yingxenye yabafundi abazophasa kahle nikwazi ukuqhubeka nemfundo ezingeni eliphakeme,” usho kanje.UMnuz Harris Khuzwayo, onguthishanhloko waseMningi High, uthe nabo bajabule kakhulu ngokuthi kube khona ababona kufanele ukuthi benze uhlelo olunjena ukusiza abafundi babo ukuvuleka imiqondo ngemikhakha eyahlukene."Lokhu kwehlisa umthwalo kithina bothisha nakuMnyango weMfundo eyiSisekelo ngoba siyazi ukuthi kubuye kushode kwezinye izinto ezidingekayo ezifuze lezi. Sijabule ukuthi abafundi bethu bahlonyiswe ngolwazi oluzokwenza ukuthi baqonde imikhakha eyahlukene abangayifundela, ukusiza ukuthi bangakhethi noma yini ngokududana ngobungani, okugcina kwenza ukuthi bengayitholi imisebenzi yize sebefunde bagogoda,” kusho uKhuzwayo.Omunye wabafundi bakhona eMningi High, uKwanele Ntetha waseNgwelezane, naye uzwakalise ukujabula nokugculiseka ngakufunde kulolu hlelo, athi lumvule umqondo futhi lwamcebisa ngezinto abengaziqondi ngemikhakha eyahlukene yemfundo ephakeme."Ngifunde nobumqoka bokubheka ukuthi unakhono lini nokuthi ungalisebenzisa kanjani ukuthi likusebenzele ukufeza amaphupho akho uphinde ukwazi ukuzimela, into engicabanga ukuthi bekungathatha isikhathi eside ukuthi ngigcine ngiyazi noma ngiyifunde,” kusho umfundi.Isikhulu esiphezulu (CEO) se-RBIDZ, uMnuz Thabane Zulu, uthe lokho abakwenze ngalo mcimbi kungenye yemikhondo yabo yokubamba iqhaza ukuthuthukisa abantu abasha basezindaweni zasemakhaya ezakhele uMasipala uMhlathuze."Kanti futhi asizukugcina lana njengoba sesivele sinezinhlelo zokuthi siqhubeke sihambele kwezinye izikole ukuqhuba umbono ofanayo. Sibabele nokuthi singagcini ngokuhlangana kanjena sikhulume ngomlomo, kodwa siyafisa ukuthi abafundi bavakashele izakhiwo zethu ukuzobona ukusebenza kwethu ukuze bakhuthazeke ngomsebenzi esiwenzayo wansuku zonke ohlanganisa imikhakha eyahlukahlukene njengoba lokhu kungenye yezinhlelo zethu zokufundisa nokuthuthukisa ulwazi kubafundi nasemiphakathini. Sifuna babe nentshisekelo ukulandela imikhakha eyahlukene ezokwenza bachume empilweni, futhi sizimisele ukubalekelela nangemifundaze ezokwenza ukuthi ukufunda kwabo kungabi wumthwalo kubona nakubazali,” kusho uZulu. Utholakale ezibulele owesilisa obefunelwa icala lokubulala intombi ekhulelwe kanye nonkosikazi wakhe.Owesilisa, 42, osolwa ngokudubula abulale intombi yakhe eneminyaka engu-22 ubudala kanye nonkosikazi oneminyaka engu-49 ubudala eNgobozana, eLusikisiki, e-Eastern Cape, ngezintatha zangoLwesibili ekuseni, utholwe eshonile endaweni yaseGqathula, cishe amakhilomitha ayishumi ngaphandle kwenkaba yeLusikisiki.Imibiko yokuqala iveza ukuthi ushone ngenxa yenxeba lokuzidubula, nakuba amaphoyisa enza uphenyo olunzulu. Kuthiwa umsolwa wabulala laba besifazane wase ebaleka endaweni yesigameko esebenzisa imoto yomndeni, eyatholwa amaphoyisa ilahliwe. Kube nophenyo olunzulu ngokunyamalala kwakhe kwaze kwasiza amalungu omphakathi eGqathula ebiza amaphoyisa ngemuva kokuthola isidumbu sowesilisa endaweni eyihlane nesibhamu sohlobo lwe-9mm eduze. Umufi uhlonzwe kahle njengomsolwa emacaleni okubulala eNgobozana.Amaphoyisa aseLusikisiki avule idokodo lophenyo ukuze kutholwe kahle izimo ngokufa kwakhe.
Minyaka yonke, izimboni zakwaSappi - eSaiccor, eTugela, naseStanger - zenza umsebenzi obalulekile wokulungiswa imishini yenkampani. USappi kanye nama-contractors akhe baphinde badale amathuba omsebenzi wesikhashana womphakathi wendawo kanye namathuba amasha emabhizinisini omphakathi wendawo nge-shut. E-Saiccor Mill, i-shut yakulo nyaka ibe nkulu, idale amathuba omsebenzi abangaphezu kuka-1,000 kumphakathi owakhelene nawo, baqashwe ngendlela yesivumelwano somphakathi - Integrated Local Community Forum (ILCF). E-Tugela nase-Stanger nakhona basebenzisane nama-ILCF kwaqashwa abasebenzi bendawo abangu-370 abanamakhono ahlukene kwaphindwa kwadaleka amathuba kosomabhizisi bendawo UNomvelo Ngidi, umsunguli weBonito Cleaning – ibhizinisi elasungulwa ngowesifazane eMandeni, usedale amathuba omsebenzi angu-44. Ngesikhathi se-shut eTugela Mill, waphinda, waqasha abantu abangu-110, iningi labo kungabesifazane. UMziwakhe Dlamini we-Isizwe Samalanga, inkampani yezobunjiniyela KwaDukuza, waqasha abantu abangu-50 ngesikhathi se-shut eStanger Mill, okuhlanganisa nabesifazane abayishumi. "Lolu lwazi lube wusizo olukhulu, futhi siyabonga kakhulu ngaleli thuba,” kusho uDlamini. Osomabhizinisi bendawo bahlomule kumathuba angaphezu kuka-R5 million eSaiccor, osomabhizinisi bendawo bahlomule kumathuba angu kuka-R4 million eMandeni naKwaDukuza.Iqembu lakwaSappi le-Enterprise and Supplier Development (ESD) lisebenzisana namalunga omphakathi minyaka yonke ukukhulisa osamabhizinisi bendawo. "Inhloso yethu ukukhulisa osomabhizisi bendawo abakhelene noSappi,” kusho uLesiba Lamola, Regional Manager we-ESD Procurement eSappi Southern Africa. I-ILCF no Sappi basayina isivumelwano sokuthuthukisa kwemphakathi eyakhelene noSappi kubandakanye nokudaleka kwamathuba omsebenzi endaweni kanye namathuba kosomabhizinisi bendawo.

SIYINDABA egudwini ebantwini bakwa-Z eMlaza isigameko sokubulawa kowesilisa kubuka wonke umuntu.Kuvela ukuthi umufi uMnuz Phumlani Gwala (34) udutshulwe ngowesilisa ongumakhelwane wakhe wafa ngemuva kwengxabano.Umthombo uthe kusuke uthuthuva besemcimbini wokumbulwa kwetshe obukhona endaweni. Uqhuba uthe umufi ubekade emi nentombi yakhe ngesikhathi umsolwa efika emdonsa efuna ukukhuluma naye ngenkani. "Bagcine bekhulumile, yilapho-ke okubonakale khona bexabana kodwa balanyuliwe. Ngemuva kokuba belanyuliwe umsolwa ugodukile waya kubo," usho kanjena.Uqhuba kuthe esebuya wabuya esephethe isibhamu kodwa esifihlile, ubuyele kumufi babonakala bexoxa kodwa kulokhu bekhulumela phansi."Asazi ukuthi bavumelane ngani ngoba sibabone sebenyuka beya ngasemgwaqweni okuyilapho umsolwa adubule khona umufi," usho kanjena.Kuthiwa umufi udutshulwe yizinhlamvu ezine eyodwa esiphongweni ezinye emzimbeni.Owomndeni kamufi obekhathazekile kakhulu, uMnuz Lungelo Hlubi, uthe bazibonele ebulawa ngesihluku uGwala."Ngimbonile emdubula," usho kanjena sakudangala. Eqhuba ukhale ngonya athe lukhonjiswe wumsolwa.Uthe umsolwa lokhu ubekwenza ngenhloso njengoba engazange abaleke kodwa eye kubo ngemuva kokudubula umufi."Leya nto ubeyenza enenhloso enkulu. Uyena owaziyo ukuthi lokhu bekumayelana nani. Kodwa siyabufuna ubulungiswa ," usho kanjena.Uveze ukuthi bamphuthumise esibhedlela saseSiphingo umufi nokuyilapho okufike kwamenela khona.Umsolwa kuvela ukuthi uziphilisa ngokuba wunogada.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, ukuqinisekisile ukubulawa komuntu eMlaza. Uthe kusolakala ukuthi umufi udutshulwe ngumuntu amaziyo ngemuva kwengxabano ababe nayo. Umsolwa uboshiwe.
UTHI uyoxoxela amagwababa echobana okumehlele owesilisa waseMachibini, eMandeni, ocishe wangcwaba unodoli ezitshela ukuthi yisidumbu sosana lwakhe olusanda kudlula emhlabeni.UMnuz Nkululeko Zulu (44) uthe kuduma ikhanda kuyena ngemuva komgilingwane athe wenziwe ngobethandana naye uNksz Diyana Maluleke (44). Elandisa uZulu uthe owesifazane usenge ezimithiyo emtshela ukuthi ukhulelwe. Uthe ngemuva kwalokho ubelokhu emfakela imali, kwathi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi owesifazane wagcina engasezi kwakhe njengoba ebehlala eThekwini eqhubeka nokumfakela imali.Uthe owesifazane "esanda kuteta" akazange amkhombise isithombe sengane kwathi esazibuza lokho wamane wamehla ngaphezulu emtshela ukuthi sekwehle umshophi kwashona usana.''Ngiphatheke kabi kakhulu ngoba bese ngizitshelile ukuthi sengizoba nosana. Kodwa akukho ebesingakwenza simane saqala senza amalungiselelo omngcwabo sengibabikelile nasekhaya,'' usho kanjena.Uthe owesifazane usuke eThekwini "nesidumbu" wangafika ngosuku lomlindelo kodwa wafika seliyoshona ngosuku lomngcwabo sekumbiwe negodi."Ufike esehla evenini emotweni ebimlethile futhi kunguyena ophethe ibhokisi elibanjiswe ngabantu abehamba nabo. Ngaleso sikhathi ubebonakala edangele njengomuntu ofelwe yingane ngempela,'' usho kanjena.Uthe nakuba egcine ethole iqiniso kungenxa kamfowabo omphoqe ngenkani ukuba makavule ibhokisi avalelise osaneni lwakhe aphinde alusule nobuso."Umfowethu ungitshele ukuthi mangivule ibhokisi ngivalelise enganeni yami. Uvele wabhoka ngolaka owesifazane ethi asikho isidingo salokho,'' kuchaza yena.Uthe kuthe makaquleke uma evula ibhokisi ethola ukuthi kukhona unodoli phakathi osongwe ngezingubo kwenziwa sengathi wusana lwangempela.Uqhube wathi kuthe nxa ethinta wezwa kuqinile yagcwala incwadi yokuthi lona wunodoli."Ngicishe ngamelwa yinhliziyo, ngawujikijela phansi unodoli,'' usho kanjena.Uthe ngemuva kwalokho owesifazane ucele empunzini.Uthe kudingeke ukuba athenge imbuzi ayibulale kugqitshwe yona ngoba umbe umgodi ngento engekho. Ubabaze amandla edlozi lakhe njengoba ethe akuphelanga sikhathi esingakanani eggqibe imbuzi umfowabo wentombi wavelelwa okuthile eThekwini - wathi kuyimanje kwembulwa kwembeswa kuyena.Uveze ukuthi usenkingeni njengoba kumele axolise esizweni nasenkosini yendawo ngokumba umgodi kungafanga muntu.''Kuyimanje ngibizwe konkosi kumele ngishweleze ngento eyenziwe wumuntu engazi nokuthi uyenzelani futhi uzozuzani. Ibuhlungu nansi into kuduma ikhanda kimina,'' usho kanjena.Uthe iningi kakhulu imali emlahlekele enza amalungiselelo omngcwabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho ukhale ngento efanayo futhi njengoba elahlekelwe yimali eningi elokhu efakela umuntu othi ukhulelwe ehhubhuza akabhejane.Uthe wathengiswa inqwaba yezingubo zokugqoka kanti kudlalwa ngaye. Ubalise ngokuthi amalungu omndeni wakhe amthukuthelele akazi nokuthi uzothini kuwona ngehlazo afakwe kulona ngowesifazane abezitshela ukuthi uyamthanda.Uveze ukuthi bese kuphele iminyaka emibili egcwele bethandana."Bonke bangibuza ukuthi ubezotholani ngalesi senzo kodwa nami kangazi. Kodwa inhloso yakhe bekungukuthi alokhu ethola imali kimina,'' usho kanjena.Ugcizelele ukuthi owesifazane unguchwepheshe kwezobugebengu njengoba ebemthumelela i-scan naye aze akholwe wukuthi impela uNkulunkulu umbusise ngomntwana.Uthe ngaphambi komngcwabo owesifazane umshayele ucingo emtshela ukuthi kubo kuthiwa makafake imali yokuthenga imbuzi ukuze kugezwe umuzi. Nokho uthe akakwenzanga lokho ngoba bese ekhathele wukukhipha imali.Usihlalo wezinduna esizweni sakwaMathonsi, uMnuz Bheki Mathonsi, uvumile ukuthi lesi sehlakalo senzekile. Kodwa akazange athande ukunaba ngaso.Belukhala luze lube nesilokozane ucingo lowesifazane lungabanjwa ngesikhathi eshayelwa. Kwale noma esethunyelelwa umyalezo - akaphendulanga.
Ingozi yendiza enophephela emhlane ibulale abantu abayisishiyagalombili okuhlanganisa nongqongqoshe bezokuvikela kanye nemvelo, ngokusho kukahulumeni waseGhana. UNgqongqoshe wezokuVikela u-Edward Omane Boamah kanye noNgqongqoshe wezeMvelo u-Ibrahim Murtala Muhammed baphakathi kwezisulu zengozi eyenzeke eningizimu ye-Ashanti yezwe, kusho uJulius Debrah, isikhulu sabasebenzi kuMengameli uJohn Mahama, ngoLwesithathu. "UMengameli nohulumeni badlulisa amazwi enduduzo kanye nobumbano emindenini yamaqabane ethu namasosha aphumelele ekukhonzeni isizwe,” kusho uDebrah. Phakathi kwezisulu bekukhona u-Alhaji Mohammad Muniru Limuna, isekela lomxhumanisi wezokuphepha kuzwelonke nowayengungqongqoshe wezolimo, kanye noSamuel Sarpong, iphini likasihlalo weqembu likaMahama's National Democratic Congress (NDC). Umbutho Wasemoyeni waseGhana ubike ngaphambilini ngoLwesithathu ukuthi indiza enophephela emhlane yamasosha inyamalale e-radar ngemuva nje kokusuka e-Accra ngezithuba zabo-09:00 (ngesikhathi sendawo nange-GMT), ilibangise e-Obuasi, enyakatho-ntshonalanga yenhloko-dolobha.
Inkantolo yeSifunda eMadadeni igwebe uNomaswazi Angel Shabalala, uMondli Mabaso, uMduduzi James Zakes Njuza noNqobile Brown Ngcobo udilikajele ngecala lokubulala abalenza ngo-2019 eLadysmith. Umufi uSimangaye Oscar Hlatshwayo wayeyi Executive Director: Technical Service kuMasipala i-Alfred Duma. UShabalala ehlangane nabanye bakha uzungu lokusoconga uHlatshwayo.Ngo-7 Febhuwari 2019, uHlatshwayo wasuka ekhaya kwakhe ngemoto eya emsebenzini. Ababulali bakhe bamlalela unyendle emgwaqeni ophithizelayo lapho okwakuphoqa khona ukuthi anciphise isivinini semoto. Abahlaseli badubula ngentululwane yezinhlamvu bebhekise kuHlatshwayo. Bamdubula ekhanda nasesifubeni washonela khona lapho endaweni yesigameko. UMshushisi u-Advocate Cyril Selepe ubize ofakazi ababili abangaphansi kuka-Section 204, ubufakazi be-video,ubufakazi bamaselula nombiko wezibhamu.U-Advocate Selepe ekhonga isigwebo esiqinile, wethule isitatimende somfelokazi kaHlatshwayo asibhale eluswe wuVictoria Griffiths oyi-Court Preparation Officer. Uthe umyeni wakhe ubewumngani wakhe omkhulu futhi wuyena obekwazi ukondla ekhaya.
ZIZOHANJISWA emphakathini waseNanda, KwaMakhutha, Bulwer naKwaMbonambi, izimoto ezine ezinikelwe nguNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, emaphoyiseni asesifundazweni ukuze kuqhubeke umsebenzi wokulwa nobugebengu.Lokhu kuvezwe wuye uNtuli emahhovisi oMnyango wemiSebenzi yoMphakathi eMayville, eThekwini, kuleli sonto lapho enikele ngalezi zimoto ngokusemthethweni ebuholini bamaphoyisa esifundazweni.Lezi zimoto okuthiwa zinobuxhakaxhaka obusezingeni eliphezulu bezokuxhumana, zizosebenza njengeziteshi zamaphoyisa ezingomahamba-nendlwana. Ngesikhathi enikela ngazo, uNtuli uthe ziyiswa emiphakathini ebhekene nenkinga yobugebengu obuphezulu kanjalo naleyo enezinsiza-kusebenza ezincane.Phakathi kwezinhlobo zobugebengu okuthiwa budla lubi kulezi zindawo ezokubulala, ukudlwengula, ukubamba inkunzi kuhlonyiwe kanjalo nokudunwa kwezimoto."Lo omunye wemizamo yokuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza kusebenza ziyiswa emiphakathini lapho zidingeka khona kakhulu,” kusho uNtuli. IPhini likaKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uMajor General Phumelele Makoba, obemele uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, ebonga lolu xhaso, uthe luzohamba ibanga elide ekutheni bafinyelele kuwo wonke amakhona ezindawo abazojuba kuzo lezi zimoto. "Zizoba wusizo olukhulu emphakathini ohamba amabanga amade ukuze ufinyelele eziteshini ozisebenzisayo kodwa eziqhelelene nawo,” kusho uMaj Gen Makoba.Uthe zizoba wusizo olufanayo nasemiphakathini ethathwa njengaleyo ebhekene nenkinga yobugebengu obuphezulu. Uthe ukuhanjiswa kwazo kuzolekelela ekutheni amaphoyisa abonakale emphakathini, ukunciphisa isikhathi esilindwa ngabagilwa uma bebike izigameko zobugebengu, bese zilekelela ekubuyiseni isithunzi samaphoyisa.Ube esekhumbuza imiphakathi ukuthi ukulwa nobugebengu akulona ijoka lamaphoyisa kuphela kepha nezakhamuzi okukhona kuzo abaholi bendabuko, izinhlaka ezilwa nobugebengu, izinhlangano zezenkolo, kulindelekile ukuthi nazo zilekelele.Uveze ukuthi lezi zimoto zidle uMnyango wokuPhepha koMphakathi imali engu-R6,8 million. Uthe izindawo okutholwe ukuthi zihlomule ngalezi zimoto zikhethwe ngokwemininingwane eqoqwe ngezikhalo ezivela emalungwini omphakathi ehlukene, lapho ekhala khona ngobuncane bezinsiza-kusebenza ezindaweni ezinobugebengu obuningi, kuphinde kube yilezo okukhalwa ngamabanga amade ahanjwayo uma kuyiwa eziteshini eziseduzane. Unxuse umphakathi ukuthi ubambisane namaphoyisa ukuzinakelela lezi zimoto, ukuze kungenzeki lutho olubi kuzo njengoba zilethelwe ukuthi zibe wusizo kuwona. "Zilethelwe ukusiza nina ngakho kufanele nizivikele. Uma ubona benza okungafanele, bika. Nathi sizozigada ukuthi ziyawenza yini umsebenzi ezilethelwe wona,” kusho uMaj Gen Makoba.
USIHLALO wekomiti lezeMpilo ePhalamende, uMnuz Sibongiseni Dhlomo, uthe balwamukela ngezandla zombili uphenyo lwamaphoyisa oluholele ekutheni kugcine kuboshwa indodana kamfowabo ngecala lokubulala unkosikazi.Umufi, uNkk Khanyisile Dhlomo, watholwa edindilizile emzini wabo oseMalvern, eThekwini, ngoSepthemba 2022. Ngaleso sikhathi umyeni wakhe okuthiwa wayekhona ekhaya, uMnuz Khayelihle Dhlomo (53), watshela umndeni namaphoyisa ukuthi umufi uzibulele ngoba ubehlushwa yinkinga yokhwantalala. Umsolwa ugcine eboshwa ngeSonto eledlule ngaleli cala, idokodo lokufa komuntu elalivulwe amaphoyisa emva kwesigameko lashintshwa laba yicala lokubulala.Umsolwa ubevele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini izolo, kulindeleke ukuthi afake isicelo sebheyili.Phakathi kwabebezothamela icala bekukhona amalungu omndeni wakwaDhlomo, okubandakanya uDhlomo (Sibongiseni), abomndeni wakwaNduli lapho kuzalwa khona umufi, amalungu ambalwa e-ANC nabanye. Umsolwa ugcine engasifakanga isicelo sebheyili njengoba kuvele ukuthi kukhona imininingwane yebheyili esaqinisekiswa ngaphambi kokuthi avunyelwe ukufaka isicelo sakhe. Inkantolo igcine ilihlehlisela uLwesibili oluzayo icala ukuze afake isicelo sakhe.Ekhuluma ngaphandle kwenkantolo uDhlomo uthe bayabonga ukuthi udaba seluhambe lwaze lwafika enkantolo."KwakunguSepthemba 2022 ngesikhathi kudlula uKhanyi. Kwasithusa futhi kwasidida (ukufa kwakhe). Safisa ukuthi ngelinye ilanga kube khona iqiniso eliyovela. Sengathi kuya ngakhona ke manje ukuthi livele iqiniso,” kusho uDhlomo. Uthe yayilokhu ishiya imibuzo indaba yokuthi umufi wafa ngokuzibulala."Sasilokhu sizibuza ukuthi ungazibulala kodwa ube manxebanxeba? Ibingezwakali indaba yokuthi kungathiwa umuntu uzibulele kodwa bese eba nenqwaba yamanxeba. Bekulokhu kusidida singumndeni ngoba nozidubulile uba nenxeba elilodwa,” kusho uDhlomo.Nokho uDhlomo uthe njengoba amaphoyisa egcine ebopha umshana wakhe, kubanika ukuthi abahlale bazinze, balalele iqiniso ngesigameko. "Bekulokhu kusihlupha ukuthi bese kungaphela nje kanjalo kuthiwa wazibulala. Asikakalizwa ke iqniso njengoba kuseyima kusazoqalwa ngesicelo sebheyili,” usho kanje. Ebuzwa ukuthi ubukhona yini umlando wokuhlukumeza abewazi phakathi kwabebeganene, uDhlomo uthe ubekujana nabo futhi bemhlonipha, ubengenalo ulwazi lomlando wodlame phakathi kwabo."Asilinde ukuzwa ukuthi abekho yini abanye bomndeni abazoqhamuka enkantolo bacacise ukuthi kukhona yini okunjalo abakwaziyo,” kusho uDhlomo.
UTHANDO lomculo kamaskandi kanjalo nokugida ingoma luqale ngesikhathi efunda ukukhuluma nokuhamba ujahidada oshone nabane engozini enyantisa igazi eBergville, KwaZulu-Natal, ngeSonto.Lokhu kuvezwe nguNksz Hloniphile Mbatha, ongunina kamufi, uMnotho Mngomezulu (2) obedume ngelikaNkunzavava ezinkundleni zokuxhumana waseNorkem Park, eGoli.Kule ngozi kubuye kwadlula uyise kaNkunzavava, uMnuz Bongumusa Mngomezulu, umzala wakhe uLungelo Makhungo (15), Mthabiso "Sthalala" Mahlangu bese kuba owesihlanu ongakaziwa, obeshayela iPolo VW eliyimoto yesibili eshayisane mahlanze naNissan Magnite ebinabafi. Elandisa Isolezwe uNksz Mbatha uthe kubo bayikhaya elizifelayo ngomculo kamaskandi, waveza ukuthi amalungu amabili omndeni abengamagidangoma omculi kamaskandi uSibonelo "Khotha” Hlongwane."UMnotho kuthe uma eqala efunda ukukhuluma nokuhamba, wabona umalume wakhe uSiphelele Mbatha (osindile engozini, osesibhedlela) noLungelo (umufi) begida, becula umaskandi. Akazange azithambise, naye ubevele abajoyine,” kusho uNksz Mbatha, obezwakala ukuthi umoya wakhe udangele.Uqhube wathi kuqale ngawo unyaka odlule ukuthi bamthathe bahambe naye uma beyogida emicimbini ehlukene. "Bengikhululeka uma beye kwelana eGoli, ngoba ibiseduze. Kuthe sebeqala ukuhambela nezinye izifundazwe, ngibe sengicela ukuthi bahambe noyise ukuze kube nomuntu ozomnakekela ngendlela,” kusho uNksz Mbatha. Uthe kwenzeka le ngozi, babehambe ekhaya ngoLwesihlanu beya kogida komunye umcimbi KwaZulu-Natal.Uthe bebengabantu obekufanele babuye ngeSonto, wathi njengoba behlelwe yingozi eBergville, bese besendleleni bephindela eGoli. Uthe simuncu isimo emndenini kulandela ingozi ngoba babengakaze bacabange ukuthi bangalahlekelwa yingane ngendlela ebuhlungu ngalolu hlobo.Uthe okunye okuvule umgodi ezinhliziyweni zabo wukulahleka kukaLungelo, athe uyingane kadadewabo ebisafunda kwaphinde kwabhubha noyise kaNkunzavava.Uveze ukuthi likhona elinye ilungu lomndeni elisesimeni esibi esibhedlela.Isolezwe likhuluma noKhotha uthe kuselukhuni satshe ukwamukela ukulahlekelwa ngamalungu eqembu lakhe amane, kwalimala nabanye ababili okubalwa kubona ingane yakhe intombazane, owesifazane ahlekisana naye nelinye ilungu leqembu, okumanje basesibhedlela.Uthe abafi bebengamagindangoma bebehamba ngeNissan Magnite, eshayisane mahlanze nePolo Vivo, iPolo yagqamuka amalangabi.Engxoxweni neSolezwe, uKhotha uveze ukuthi ungowakhona eBergville, wathi kwehle le ngozi kade benandisa emcimbini obungoMgqibelo ebusuku. UKhotha uthe bekumele ngabe bagoduke okungenani ngoMsombuluko noma namhlanje bephindela eGoli lapho bezinze khona ngomsebenzi nangomculo, kepha ngenxa yesimo sokuthi kukhona obekumele baphuthume emsebenzini kwaphoqa ukuthi bahambe ngeSonto, kanti sekuzoba wukulimala kwabo kanjalo endleleni, bengasafikanga lapho bebeya khona."Kubuhlungu kakhulu lokhu okungehlele ikakhulu ngoba ingxenye yalaba bafowethu ikhulele esandleni sami kusuka ngiqala ukugxila emculweni ngo-2019, abanye babo baze bakwazi ukuzimela nokuziphilisa nemindeni yabo. Kubi kakhulu nokukaNkunzavava ngoba ubesemncane kakhulu, futhi ekhombisa ukuvuthwa kulo msebenzi esiwenzayo wobuciko, nabantu bebemthanda kakhulu kusukela aqala ukulandela omalume bakhe esinabo eqenjini, njengoba naye bese sihamba naye emicimbini esinandisa kuyona," kusho uKhotha.Udalule ukuthi kumanje uphithene ikhanda njengoba esesele namalungu amathathu kuphela eqenjini labo, kanti futhi akwaziwa ukuthi kuzohamba kanjani ngalaba abathathu abasesibhedlela, nabo abalimele kabi.
Kuzolalelwa isicelo sebheyili sikasomabhizinisi uKatiso KT Molefe eNkantolo yeMantshi yase-Alexandra. UMolefe usolwa ngokuhlela ukubulawa kuka-Oupa Sefoka, odume ngelika-DJ Sumbody, waboshwa ngenyanga edlule nabanye abasolwa abathathu. Lab baphinde bamataniswa nokufa kukaHector "DJ Vintos” Buthelezi, Don Tindleni nonjiniyela u-Armand Swart. Babhekene namacala okubulala, ukuzama ukubulala nokutholakala nezibhamu ezingekho emthethweni.

INkantolo yeSifunda eMadadeni igwebe owesilisa oneminyaka ewu-38 udilikajele ngokudlwengula indodana yakhe phakathi kuka-2019 no-2021 eMadadeni.Umgilwa wayehlala nabazali bakhe nomfowabo. Ummangalelwa wadlwengula umgilwa izikhawu uma unina engekho. Kuthe emuva kwesikhathi umgilwa, wunina nomfowabo bahamba bayohlala ekhaya konina. Uyise kamgilwa wayevame ukubalanda beyomvakashela. Ngaleso sikhathi bevakashile ummangalelwa waqhubeka wadlwengula umgilwa.Indaba yavela obala emuva kokuthi uthisha eqaphele izinto ezosolisayo kumgilwa wambuza ukuthi kwenzenjani. Umgilwa wabikela uthisha ukuthi uyise ubemdlwengula izikhawu. Uthisha wabikela uthishomkhulu kwabikelwa umndeni kamgilwa. Kwahanjiswa umgilwa emtholampilo kwabikwa udaba emaphoyiseni kwaboshwa ummangalelwa.UMshushisi uCindy Alberts ubize ofakazi okunguthisha owabikelwa kuqala,udokotela owaxilonga umgilwa oqiniseiksie ukuthi kukhona ukulimala akuqaphela kuyena futhi kuzohlala naye isikhathi eside. UMshushisi ekhonga isigwebo esiqinile,ubize ubabekazi kamgilwa ochaze ukuthi selokhu kwenzeka isigameko umgilwa usehlala eyinkomo edla yodwa futhi uyamsaba ummangalelwa.Ngaphezu kwesigwebo, inkantolo inqume ukuthi akafanelwe wukusebenza nezingane futhi igama lakhekufanele lifakwe ohlwini lwabanukubeza ngokocansi. Inkantolo ithe akafanelwe wukuba nemvume yokuphatha isibhamu.
KUBE wumzuzu onzima emndenini wommeli waseMontclair, eThekwini, ngesikhathi kuvela iphoyisa likaMasipala weTheku, elisolwa ngokumbulala eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini, izolo.UNksz Thandokuhle Mkhize (48) kuthiwa wagwazwa wabulawa uSenior Constable Qiniso Sishi (40) ekhaya ngoLwesihlanu olwedlule.Bekungokokuqala uSishi evele enkantolo izolo, njengoba ngoLwesibili olwedlule, lamenyezwa igama lakhe kodwa wangasabela. Ngaleso sikhathi kwavela ukuthi usalalisiwe esibhedlela, ulashelwa ukuthi wazama ukuzibulala naye emva kokubulala umufi.Umunye wodadewabo bakamufi, uDkt Thobeka Ntsevu, uthe kubuhlungu futhi kuwuhlukumezile umndeni ukumbona ngamehlo umsolwa emva kwesigameko."Kusihlukumezile ukubona umuntu obulale udadewethu ngesihluku esinje, ezihambela nje ngokukhululeka enkantolo, ethokozela elakhe ilungelo lokuphila ekubeni ebulale udadewethu ayemthembise ukuthi uzomthanda,” kusho uDkt Ntsevu. Uveze ukuthi ezikhathini eziningi umufi nomsolwa bebebukeka bengabantu abajabulile othandweni, kungekho okusolisayo ukuthi kungagcina kwenzeke isigameko esifuze lesi."Kodwa-ke phela ngeke wazi izinto ezenzeka uma abantu sebebodwa,” kusho uDkt Ntsevu.Uthe kuyabakhathaza ukuthi umsolwa uyiphoyisa lomthetho kodwa uphinde abe nelinye icala lokubulala owesifazane elisaqhubeka enkantolo. Kulelo cala Isolezwe lathola ukuthi limayelana nesigameko okuthiwa senzeka kwenye yezindawo zobumnandi eSouth Beach eminyakeni edlule. Kuleso sigameko kuthiwa umsolwa wadubula, kwafa owesifazane ayekade ehamba naye nabangani ukuyozijabulisa. Ngokusho komthombo, lelo cala labuye laphelela emoyeni, nokho Isolezwe libuye lathola ukuthi icala lisaqhubeka enkantolo.UDkt Ntsevu uthe bewumndeni basanda kuthola ngaleli cala, bebengenalwazi ngalo phambilini.Uthe abafuna kwenzeke ukuthi umsolwa abolele ejele ngakabenze khona. "Ukube kuya ngathi ngabe uvele unikwa isigwebo sentambo ngokubulala ephindelela abantu besifazane abangenamandla okuzophindiselela,” usho kanje.Uthe kubaphathe kabi ukumbona ewumuntu ojwayelekile ngesikhathi evela enkantolo."Ungafunga ukuthi akaze enze lutho olubi,” kusho uDkt Ntsevu. Uthe kusenzima kakhulu emndenini kulandela isigameko, wathi umuntu okubukeka ezwele kakhulu, yindodakazi kamufi, u-Aphiwe Mkhizi (18), eyayikhona ngesikhathi kwenzeka isigameko.U-Aphiwe kuthiwa ufunda u-matric kanti isigameko simthikamezile ezifundweni zakhe zesikole.Ngesikhathi evela umsolwa, kuqaphelekile ukuthi ubebhandishe isandla nengxenye yengalo yangakwesobunxele.Ngaphandle kwenkantolo bekukhona idlanzana ebelizokweseka umndeni, licula izingoma zomzabalazo. Phakathi kwazo bekukhona ethi: "Akulona iphoyisa umbulali, akulona iphoyisa iphara...” Kubona, ibikhona nendodakazi kamufi, u-Aphiwe, ebiphethe uqwembe olubhalwe ukuthi: "Umama ngabe usaphila ukube bekungekho mayelana nendoda ebidinwe yizinkinga zayo. Yekani ukubulala nokuhlukumeza abantu besifazane. Aluphele udlame lobulili.”Umufi ufihlwe ngeSonto, emva kwenkonzo yomngcwabo ebibanjelwe ehholo lomphakathi kwa-Q, eMlaza. Phakathi kwezethameli bekukhona noMphathiswa woMnyango wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi KwaZulu-Natal, uNksz Mbali Shinga.Icala lihlehlele uMsombuluko ozayo, ukuze umsolwa afake isicelo sebheyili.

UHULUMENI waseNingizimu Afrika usemizamweni yokugcina yokuvimba intela ezofakwa empahleni yakuleli ethunyelwa eMelika. Intela ka-30% ezofaka emkhiqizweni yakuleli engena eMelika, izoqala ukusebenza ngoLwesihlanu. Le ntela iyingxenye yesijeso sikaMengameli waseMelika, uMnuz Donald Trump, ongeneme ngezinqumo ezithathwa wuhulumeni wakuleli. UNgqongqoshe wezoBudlelwano naMazwe aNgaphandle, uMnuz Ronald Lamola, uthe bayaqhubeka nezingxoxo zokuzama ukuvimba intela.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba, izolo. ULamola uthe uhulumeni wakuleli angeke uziphindiselele ngokufaka intela empahleni yaseMelika engena kuleli. "Ukungaziphindiseleli kwethu akufanele kubonwe njengobugwala. Uma singase sithi akube iso ngeso, kuningi okungonakala emhlabeni. Impi yezomnotho engaqubuka lapho ingachaphazela abantu abaningi abangenacala. Ingakho sikhethe ukuqhubeka nezingxoxo."ULamola uthe izingxoxo neMelika ziphazanyiswe yizinhlangano zakuleli ezinyudela uhulumeni eMelika. ULamola akazange azigagule ngamagama izinhlangano kodwa kubukeka sengathi ubebhekise kwiDA, AfriForum neSolidarity. Lezi zinhlangano sezike zathumela amathimba azo eMelika, lapho zafike zakhala ngeminye yemithetho eshaywa kuleli. "Selokhu ungenile uhulumeni okhona, miningi imizamo esiyenzile yokubuyisana neMelika. Inkinga ekhona ukuthi kukhona izinhlangano zakuleli ezisikhuluma kabi kuhulumeni waseMelika. Lokhu kwenza ukuthi nabo abaphethe uhulumeni waseMelika begcine bengasazi ukuthi kufanele bakholwe bani. "Okubi ukuthi enye inhlangano ekhuluma kabi uhulumeni wakuleli iyingxenye yohulumeni wokubambisana. Singajabula uma bonke abantu bakuleli bengakhuluma kahle ngezwe labo ikakhulukazi uma bekhuluma nabantu bangaphandle."UNgqongqoshe wezoHwebo, iziMboni nokuNcintisana, uMnuz Parks Tau, uthe izisebenzi ezingephezu kuka-30 000 zisengcupheni yokulahlekelwa imisebenzi ngenxa yentela entsha.Izimboni ezizoshayeka kakhulu ezolimo, ezezimoto kanye nemikhiqizo yendwangu.UTau uthe banezinhlelo zokweseka izinkampani zakuleli ezizochaphazelwa intela entsha, wathi bafuna ukuthi intela yaseMelika ingakhinyabezi umnotho wakuleli.Ebhala encwadini yakhe yamasonto onke, uRamaphosa uthe osomabhizinisi bakuleli kufanele bangenise kwamanye amazwe."Kulezi zinyanga ezizayo sizoqala umbhidlangano wokuhwebelana namanye amazwe ukuze izinkampani zakuleli zingeke zishode ngezindawo lapho zizothumela khona imikhiqizo."URamaphosa uthe elakuleli lizoqhubeka nokuxoxa nelaseMelika njengoba ethe ubudlelwano buhlomulisa womabili amazwe.

Ngaphambi kokuqokelwa esikhundleni esisha ubejutshwe wuMnyango wokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal ukuba ayoqapha isimo.UMndebele uthe kunezinto afike wazibona ngesikhathi ejutshwe kulo mkhandlu afuna ukuzilungisa.UMndebele ukhale ngokuthi lo mkhandlu uyahluleka wukusebenzisa imali yezibonelelo oyithola kuhulumeni kazwelonke, nokwenza ukuthi imali igcine iphindela emumva."Inhloso yami wukuthi siyisebenzise imali esisuke siyabelwe ngoba isuke ihambisana nemibandela. Njengamanje sesibhale izicelo lapho sicela khona ukuba singaphucwa imali esihlulekile wukuyisebenzisa."UMndebele uthe uzoqinisekisa ukuphathwa kahle kwemali yomkhandlu."Kunemithetho ebekelwe ukusetshenziswa kwemali yomkhandlu. Le mithetho ibeka imigudu okufanele ilandelwe uma kusetshenziswa imali noma kukhishwa amathenda. Sizoyilandela yonke imithetho ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi iphathwa ngendlela imali yomkhandlu."UMndebele uthe uzobeka eqhulwini ukuhanjiswa kwezidingo, wathi abantu baseMsunduzi bazokwaziswa uma kuphazamiseka ukuhanjiswa kwezidingo ezifana namanzi nogesi.IMeya kaMasipala waseMsunduzi, uMnuz Mzimkhulu Thebolla, ithe ukuqashwa kukaMndebele kuyigxathu elibalulekile."Okuhle wukuthi uMndebele akamusha lapha eMsunduzi njengoba ekade ejutshwe wuMnyango wokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu. Izinto azibonile ngesikhathi ejutshiwe zizomlekelela kakhulu kule sikhundla esisha aqokelwe kuso. UMndebele unesipiliyoni ekuphathweni komasipala. Isipiliyoni sakhe sizolekelela kakhulu embhidlangweni wethu wokuqinisekisa ukuphathwa kahle kwemali yomkhandlu, ukuhanjiswa kwezidingo kanye nokubuyisa ukwethenjwa ngabantu."UMndebele uke waba yimenenja kaMasipala iGovan Mbeki, esifundazweni i-Eastern Cape.
UZOBATHATHELA izinyathelo zomthetho uMnyango wezokuHlaliswa kwaBantu KwaZulu-Natal, bonke abadayisela abokufika abakuleli ngokungemthetho izindlu zomxhaso.Lokhu kushiwo uMphathiswa wezokuHlaliswa kwaBantu, uMnuz Siboniso Duma, ngoLwesihlanu, kulandela ukulunywa indlebe ngamalungu omphakathi ngalo mkhuba okuthiwa udla lubi ezingxenyeni ezehlukene zesifundazwe.Ngokusho kukaDuma, kusuka emasontweni ambalwa edlule, bathole inqwaba yezikhalo emalungwini omphakathi, ekhala ngabathile abadayisa ngokungafanele izindlu zomxhaso ezakhiwe wumnyango. Uthe lolu hlobo lwezikhalo lunyuka ngesivinini kanti luvela ezingxenyeni ezehlukene zeKwaZulu-Natal."Siphinde sathola nencwadi ivela kwabamele inhlangano iMarch and March eNquthu, ingicela ukuba ngingenelele. Ngiyazinikela ukuthi ngizongenelela futhi ngithathe izinqumo nganoma yiluphi uhlobo lobugebengu ukuze ngivikele labo abamsulwa,” kusho uDuma.Uthe uma umnyango wakha izindlu zemixhaso, usuke uzakhela abakuleli abadinga uxhaso lwendawo yokufihla ikhanda, hhayi ukuthi ngelinye ilanga abathile, abanomhobholo baziphendule zibe yinto abenza ngayo inzuzo. "Sifuna ukukubeka kucace ukuthi siwumnyango ngeke sizishalazele izikhalazo zalabo abakhathazwa ukusetshenziswa kwezindlu zemixhaso ukwenza izinto ezingalungile njengokudayiswa kwezidakamizwa kanjalo nokusetshenziswa njengezindawo zokucasha izinkabi kanjalo nezinye izinhlobo zezigebengu,” kusho uDuma.Unxuse izakhamuzi zesifundazwe ukuba zibambisane nomnyango ukubeka obenza lo mkhuba. Uthe bazosebenzisana nezinhlaka zomthetho ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izigilamkhuba ziyaphuma ziyaphela ezindlini zomxhaso zikahulumeni. Uthe bafuna ukuthumela umyalezo oqinile emphakathini wokuthi kuyicala ukudayisa indlu yomxhaso eminyakeni yokuqala eyisishiyagalombili uyinikiwe, wathi inqubomgomo efanele yokudayisa indlu yomxhaso ukuthi ubandakanye umnyango."Abenza okuphambene nalokhu bazophucwa izindlu zabo zomxhaso,” usho kanje. Uthe ngokoMthetho wezeZindlu (Housing Amendment Act), nanoma yimuphi umuntu onikwe umxhaso osefuna ukuwudayisa ingakapheli iminyaka eyisishiyagalombili noma isiphelile, kufanele axhumane nomnyango. "Umnyango ozoyithatha indlu usebenzisane nomasipala ukuze yedluliselwe kwelinye ilungu lomphakathi elisohlwini lwabayidingayo,” kusho uDuma.Uthe bahlela ukuthi basebenzisane nabenhlangano yamalungelo abantu iSouth African Human Rights Commission (SAHRC), uMvikeli woMphakathi, uMcwaningi Mabhuku waseNingizimu Afrika (Auditor General of South Africa) ngalolu daba. Uthe nanoma ngubani onolwazi ngokudayiswa komxhaso okungekho emthethweni, angasebenzisa izinombolo ezilandelayo ukubika lo mkhuba, ekaWhatsApp ithi 060 105 5505, efonelwayo emahhala ithi 080 005 5505.

Lokhu kugqame kakhulu ngesikhathi kunomsindo mayelana nesiphakamiso sokwenyuswa kwentela eyengezwa empahleni ethengwayo.I-DA yamangalela uNgqongqohse wezeziMali, uMnuz Enoch Godongwana, futhi ayizange iseseke isabelomali esasinesiphakamiso sokuba kunyuswe intela.Ngakolunye uhlangothi, iSACP yona ithathe isinqumo sokungenela ukhetho lohulumeni basekhaya lwangonyaka ozayo.I-SACP ibiyaye ikhankasele i-ANC okhethweni olwedlule kepha kulokhu izokube incintisana nayo i-ANC.

Amathimba ezinhlekelele asekulungele ukusukumela phezulu uma kukhona okubikwayo ngoba kubalulekile ukuphepha kwabantu bakithi," kusho uMfu. Buthelezi. UMSINDO oqhubekayo ngokuvinjwa kwabantu bangaphandle abangenamvumo ukuba bathole ukwelashwa ezikhungweni zezempilo eNingizimu Afrika usaqhubeka njengoba umlisa waseCongo ehlangabezane nezimbila zithutha ziholwa emhlophe phambili esibhedlela saseThekwini, kuleli sonto.UMnuz Christian Tchizungu Kwigoma uthe ubeyofuna ukwelashwa esibhedlela i-Addington wavinjwa ukuba angene kulesi sibhedlela. UKwigoma akanqandwanga ngonogada basesibhedlela kodwa uvinjwe ngamalungu aziqokile enhlangano iMarch on March Movement, aphume umkhankaso wokuxosha bonke abantu bakwamanye amazwe abangenamaphepha okuba kuleli. Leli qeqebana likubeke emahlombe alo ukuthi liqapha ukungena kweziguli esibhedlela ngokuthi lifune ukubona ukuthi lowo muntu unemvumo yini yokuba kuleli, uma engenayo, bamkhomba indlela ebheke lapho eqhamuka khona. Umyalezo waleli qeqebana ucace bha: "Izikhungo zezempilo zomphakathi ngezabantu bakuleli abazoveza amapasi kuphela. UKwigomba uthe uyoyizekela amagwababa echobana ahlangabezane nakho ."Ngihlukumezeke ngendlela engingayifiseli omunye umuntu. Ngisho nabesifazane abakhulelwe bayajikiswa. Kuphakathi kokufa nokuphila." Uthe impilo yakhe ibekwe engcupheni njengoba isifo sakhe sikashukela sidinga imishanguzo. "Sengilindele ukufa."UTeresa Nortie ongusihlalo weMarch on March Movement, usivikele isenzo sozakwabo ngokuthi athi sekunenqwaba yabantu bangaphandle abafuhleleka kuleli benganazimvumo zokuba lapha. "Izibhedlela zakuleli ngezabantu bakuleli abakhokha intela."Ube esecaphuna uMthethosisekelo wakuleli kodwa omphikisayo kusigaba 27 njengoba uqinisekisa ukuthi izikhungo zezempilo zifanele ukusiza wonke umuntu okuleli lizwe, ngisho nabangaphandle imbala. Ngesonto eledlule, kubonakale kuma-video, leli qeqebana likhipha ngoshova isishoshovu esineminyaka engu-77, uCrispin Hemson ngoba sinqabe ukuveza umazisi waso. UMphathiswa wezeMpilo kulesi sifundazwe, uNomagugu Simelane-Mngadi, usigxeke kakhulu isenzo saleli qeqebana, wathi abakwenzile akukho emthethweni futhi akekho umuntu onelungelo lokuvimba abantu abazofuna usizo lwempilo.Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMpilo, uFoster Mohale, unxuse ukuba konke okwenziwayo kuhambisane nomthetho. Ugcizelele ukuthi ukubeka engcupheni impilo yabantu ngokwephula uMthethosisekelo akwamukelekile. Sekujutshwe amaphoyisa nabasemnyangweni wezempilo ukuba bayonkanisa ezikhungweni zezempilo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umthetho uyagcinwa uma kunemibhikisho.Okhulumela uhulumeni osabambile, uNomonde Mnukwa, uthe akwamukelekile ukuthatha umthetho esandleni futhi kubukela phansi amalungelo entandoyeningi.

UZWAKALISE ukukhathazeka ngokwanda kwezigameko zokubulawa kwabesifazane ngesihluku uMphathiswa woMnyango wokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi, uNksz Mbali Shinga.UNksz Shinga ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ehambele inkonzo yomngcwabo kaNksz Thandokuhle Mkhize (48) ehholo lomphakathi kwa-Q, eMlaza. UNksz Mkhize ushone ngoLwesihlanu olwedlule kulandela ukugwazwa ephindelela wumyeni wakhe, uSenior Constable Qiniso Sishi (40) oyiphoyisa kuMasipala weTheku.Lesi sigameko kuthiwa senzeka ebusuku emzini kamufi oseMontclair, eThekwini.UNksz Shinga uthe lesi sigameko asigcinanga nje ngokuthusa izakhamuzi zaseThekwini kodwa zathusa isifundazwe sonke.Uthe kuyakhathaza ukuthi uNksz Mkhize ushone singakafiki isikhathi sakhe, eba wumgilwa wodlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane futhi enzakaliswa wumyeni wakhe.Uthe bewumnyango zikhona izinhlelo abanazo ukuzama ukulwisana nalesi sihlava."Nokho kuwumsebenzi ongeke wenziwe ube yimpumelelo wuhulumeni kuphela. Udinga ukuthi sonke kubandakanya nomphakathi, sibambisane. Zonke izinhlaka zomphakathi kufanele zihlangane zibambisane ukulwa nalesi sihlava esibhekiswe kwabesifazane nezingane," kusho uNksz Shinga.Ebalula okumbalwa ezinhlelweni zikahulumeni zokulwa nesihlava, uthe banezinhlelo zokunikeza umhlahlandlela entsheni yesifazane neyesilisa esencane ukuthi iyiphi indlela efanele yokuziphatha. "Sisanda kuba neSilwanetshe Camp yezingane zabafana eyesekwa ngisho nayiNdlunkulu kaZulu. Kuyona izingane zisuke zicijwa ngobulili, isiko nenhloniphi," kusho uNksz Shinga.Uthe lokhu kulandela ukuthi beke bagxekwa phambilini ngokugxila kakhulu ezinkingeni ezithinta izingane zamantombazane nabesifazane kuphela, nokudwebe isithombe sokuthi bayazishalazela ezabesilisa kanjalo nezingane zabafana."Yingakho ke sesinezinhlelo ezakhelwe ukubhekana ngqo nezingane zabafana nabesilisa ukuze bafundiswe ukuthi baba kanjani abavikeli babesifazane kunokuthi kube yibo abayimbangela yesihlava sokuhlukunyezwa nokubulawa kwabo," usho kanje.Uthe bayakholelwa ekutheni kuzohamba ibanga elide njengoba bekholelwa ekutheni kuzoletha ushintsho nasezinganeni zabafana ezizobe sezikhulile sezingamadoda eminyakeni eminingi ezayo. Ngosuku lwesigameko kuthiwa umufi nomsolwa babekade behambe ngokwehlukana beya ezindaweni zobumnandi.Kuthiwa umufi wabuya kuqala walala, umsolwa wabuya kamumva, nokwaba khona ingxabano ngesikhathi efika.Kuvela ukuthi kwezwakala ngomufi esekhala ememeza indodakazi yakhe (18) ecela usizo.Kuthiwa indodakazi kanjano nesinye isihlobo esasisegcekeni bazama ukuvula umnyango wekamelo lalezi zithandani, kwatholakala ukuthi umsolwa uwuvale ngaphakathi.Kuvela ukuthi ngesikhathi sekufike omakhelwane nezihlobo bewubhodloza umnyango bezama ukungena endaweni yesigameko, umsolwa wayala ukhasha, efuna ukugwaza kwasani esondelayo.Kuthiwa ngaleso sikhathi wayesigxamalazele isidumbu, esandleni ephethe ummese owawusavuza igazi.Kuvela ukuthi wagcina enqotshwe amaphoyisa ambopha.Umsolwa kulindeleke ukuthi avele okokuqala eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini namuhla kulandela ukuhluleka kwakhe wukuvela ngeledlule.NgoMsombuluko odlule ngesikhathi libizwa igama lakhe kule nkantolo, akazange asabele.Kwabe sekuvela umbiko wokuthi akakwazanga ukuza enkantolo ngoba usalaliswe esibhedlela lapho alashwa khona njengoba naye azama ukuzibulala ngosuku lwesigameko, ezisika imithambo ezihlakaleni.
USEJUBE ithimba elizophenya kabanzi ngenhlekelele yengozi eyenzeke izolo ekuseni eBergville, kwabhubha abayisihlanu, kwalimala abanye.Kwabalahlekelwe imiphefumulo kuthiwa kukhona nengane eneminyaka emihlanu.Ngokuthola kweSolezwe, ingozi yenzeke emgwaqweni uRookdale ngesikhathi izimoto ezimbili okuyiVW Polo neNissan Magnite zishayisana mahlanze. Kubikwa ukuthi emva kokushayisana kwazo, iVW Polo ibe isigqamuka umlilo, kwasha umshayeli obephakathi ngesikhathi laba abanye abane beshonele kule enye imoto ebibandakanyeke engozini. Kuvela ukuthi nakuba abezimo eziphuthumayo, benikele endaweni yesigameko masinyane kodwa ababange besakwazi ukuhlenga impilo kwabayisihlanu njengoba bese bevele bethule. UMphathiswa woMnyango wezokuThutha, uMnuz Siboniso Duma, edlulisa amazwi enduduzo emindenini yababhubhile uthe ulinde umbiko kwabeRoad Traffic Inspectorate (RTI) ozodweba isithombe esigcwele ngokwenzeka kwengozi. Okhulumela uDuma, uMnuz Ndabezinhle Sibiya, uthe: "Lokhu kuzolekelela ekutheni aqonde kabanzi ngokuthi kwenzekeni nokuthi yini eholele ekutheni kugcine kwenzeka inhlekelele efana nale.”Ugcizelele eyokuthi umnyango usondele emndenini yabashonile, wathembisa ukuthi umnyango ngokubambisana nomndeni, uzolekelela ngezinhlelo zomngcwabo. "Usejube ithimba elisuka emnyangweni wakhe ukube liyobambisana nemindeni,” usho kanje. Ube esefisela ukululama okuphuthumayo kulabo abalimele kule ngozi. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa esiteshi saseBergville asevule icala lokufa kwabantu ukuze liphenywe kulandela isigameko sokushayisana kwezimoto ezimbili maqede kwashona abayisihlanu izolo ekuseni."Imibiko ithi iVW Polo eluhlaza neNissan Magnite ebomvu bezihamba emgwaqweni uRookdale ngesikhathi zishayisana mahlanze. IPolo kuthiwa livele lagqamuka umlilo emva kokushayisana," kusho uNetshiunda. Uthe umshayeli walo utholwe eseshonile endaweni yesigameko, kwathi izingane ezimbili kanjalo nabantu abadala ababili abebekule enye imoto nabo bashona."Abanye abantu ababili abadala nengane eyodwa abebesemotweni iNissan, baphuthunyiswe esibhedlela ukuze bayothola usizo," kusho uNetshiunda.Uthe okwamanje imbangela yengozi isaphenywa.
Umculi kamaskandi uKhotha ugqemeke udume lwengozi kudlula emhlabeni amagidangoma akhe amane, okunguNkunzavava, Sthalala, Mcondo noMgqomezulu engozini enyantisayo eyenzeke eBergville.UNkunzavava ubesephenduke isilomo ngenxa yezimanga abezigila esteji yize esewujahidada. Kule ngozi kushone abantu abahlanu. Ngokwemibiko, kushayisane izimoto enye yezimoto igqamuka amalangabi, omunye wabashonile kubikwa ukuthi ushe kulo mlilo.Umphathiswa wezokuThutha nokuHlaliswa koMphakathi KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Siboniso Duma, udlulise amazwi enduduzo waphinde wathembisa nokweseka imindeni elahlekelwe."Sidlulisa amazwi enduduzo emindenini yabashonelwe,” kusho uDuma. "Ngithumele ithimba elivela ehhovisi lami kanye ukuthi liqinisekise ukuthi liyayithola imindeni yabashone kule ngozi enyantisayo.”Wengeze ngokuthi uMnyango uzosebenzisana kakhulu nemindeni ethintekile ezinsukwini ezizayo.
USAZOGQUNYWA esitokisini owayeyimenenja kaMasipala waseMzimkhulu, uMnuz Zweliphansi Skhosana, oboshelwe icala lokusoconga owayengunobhala jikelele we-ANC Youth League (ANCYL), uMnuz Sindiso Magaqa.USkhosana uvele kafishane eNkantolo yeMantshi eMzimkhulu, izolo. Icala lakhe libe selihlehliselwa uLwesihlanu lapho ezofaka khona isicelo sebheyili.USkhosana uboshwe eThekwini ngoMsombuluko. Okhulumela iNational Prosecuting Authority KwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Natasha Ramkisson-Kara, uthe uSikhosana uthweswe amacala ayisithupha."Uthwese amacala okuhlela ukubulala, ukubulala, ukuphatha isibhamu esingavumelekile, ukuphatha isibhamu ngokungemthetho, ukuphatha izinhlamvu ngokungemthetho nokuphazamisa ukusebenza komthetho."I-ANCYL ithe ifuna ukuthi uSkhosana angayitholi ibheyili. UNobhala jikelele we-ANCYL, uMnuz Mntuwoxolo Ngudle, uthe uSkhosana uzolibalekela icala uma engase anikezwe ibheyili."Ubeseshintshe indawo yokuhlala ngenxa yokuthi ubefuna ukubalekela ukuboshwa. Siphinde sathola ukuthi lo muntu unelinye icala (amataniswa nalo), nokwenza ukuthi sibe novalo lokuthi uzozama ukubaleka."UNgudle uthe bafuna ukuthi kuboshwe abanye ababeyingxenye yetulo lokusoconga uMagaqa."Esikwaziyo wukuthi isibhamu esadubula uMagaqa sathengwa ngemali eyayisuka esikhwameni samaphoyisa. Sifuna ukuthi baboshwe bonke abathintekayo okubalwa kubona namaphoyisa alekelela abasolwa. Ngeke siphumule baze baboshwe bonke abathintekayo."Akukhona okokuqala leli cala lilalisa uSkhosana ezikhindini.Ngo-2018 uSkhosana waboshwa kanye nowayeyimeya yaseHarry Gwala, uMnuz Mluleki Ndobe.USkhosana noNdobe babuye badedelwa ngenxa yokushoda kobufakazi obubayamanisa naleli cala.Inkabi eyavuma icala lokusoconga uMagaqa, uSibusiso Ncengwa, yachaza uSkhosana kanye noNdobe, ongasekho, njengobhongoza betulo lokusoconga uMagaqa.UNdobe watholakala eshonile ngo-2020, kukholakala ukuthi wazidubula.UNcengwa, owagwetshwa iminyaka engu-25 ebhadla ejele ngaleli cala, wathi bahlukaniselana u-R120 000 emva kokusoconga uMagaqa.Usanda kuveza nokuthi wabuye wathola kamumva ukuthi empeleni babekhokhelwe u-R600 000.UMagaqa, owayeyikhansela kuMasipala waseMzimkhulu, wabulawa ngo-2017.Kuthiwa wabulawelwa ukukhononda ngenkohlakalo eyayenzeka emkhandlwini.Abanye abasolwa ababili, uMnuz Sibonelo Myeza noMbulelo Mpofana, bayaqhubeka nokuliphika icala.UMyeza noMpofana bazovela eNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu ngo-Okthoba, lapho kuzoqulwa khona icala labo.Omunye umsolwa, uMnuz Mlungisi Ncalane, kwatholakala ukuthi akakulungele ukubhekana necala emva kokuhlolwa ingqondo.
UMNDENI yowayengunoobhala-jikelele we-ANC Youth League, uMnuz Sindiso Magaqa, ubuyele emakhaya ujabule kangangoba uphume wayokosa inyama ugubha ukugqunywa esitokisini kosolwa ngokuba wungqondongqondo ekubulaweni kukaMagaqa, uMnuz Zweliphansi Stanley Sikhosana.Umsolwa (55) ubevele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMzimkhulu, ngoLwesihlanu. Ngokusho kwelungu lomndeni elingathandanga negama lalo, okwenze umndeni kaMagaqa washisa inyama ukujabulela ukuthi seliyaqhumbuka ithumbu ebeliwuqaqamba iminyaka eyisishiyagalombili kusukela ngo-2018."Bekubuhlungu yonke le minyaka engu-8 singazi ukuthi wabulawa ngobani. Ngoba manje sesiyazi sikhululekile emoyeni. Sesifuna umsolwa abhoboke, achaze ukuthi umfowethu wabulawelani?" kusho omunye womdeni oveze nokuthi bayosa ngenxa yokuthi sekuyantwela ukuthi umthetho uzothatha indawo.Enkantolo bekugcwele amalungu e-ANC, ikakhulukazi awophiko lwentsha, ezokweseka umndeni kamufi. Umsolwa ubebonakala enomunyu futhi elokhu echiphiza izinyembezi engaqedi.Okhulumela uPhiko lwezokuShushisa KwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Natasha Ramkisson-Kara, uthe icala lihlehlele u-Agasti 14, ukuze ummangalelwa azofaka isicelo sebheyili."Umsolwa ubevele okwesibili eNkantolo yeMantshi eMzimkhulu malungana necala lokubulala. Uthweswe amacala okuhlela itulo lokubulala, ukubulala, ukuphatha isibhamu esingavumelekile, ukuphatha isibhamu ngokungemthetho, ukuphatha izinhlamvu ngokungemthetho nokuphazamisa ukusebenzisa ukusebenza komthetho," kusho uNkk Ramkisson-Kara.USikhosana owayeyimenenja kaMasipala waseMzimkhulu, waboshwa wuphiko lwamaphoyisa oluphenya ngamacala okubulala malungana nesigameko sokubulawa kukaMagaqa.UMagaqa wayengunobhala jikelele we-ANC Youth League futhi eyikhansela kulo masipala ngenkathi edutshulwa esemotweni yakhe ngo-2017. USikhosana wake waboshwa ngo-2018, nabanye abasolwa abane okubalwa kubona nowayeyimeya kaMasipala waseHarry Gwala, uMnuz Mluleki Ndobe, ongasekho emhlabeni.Amacala ababebekwe wona ahoxiswa okwesikhashana ngoMashi, wango-2019. USikhosana uboshwe okwesibili esemzini wakhe oseMalvern, eThekwini, ngesonto elidlule. Abanye abasolwa ababili kuleli cala kuyaqhubeka ukushushiswa kwabo kuleli cala, eseliqalile ukuqulwa, kuthi lona wesithathu yena wagwetshwa ekuqaleni kwaJulayi, emva kokuvuma icala lokubulala uMagaqa.
Kubikwa ingozi enyantisa igazi kuN2 ngaseGingindlovu. I-IPSS Medical Rescue kanye nabanye ababambiqhaza basendaweni yesigameko njengamanje kulandela ukushayisana kwezimoto kulo thela-wayeka. Okungenani abantu abane, okuhlanganisa nezingane ezimbili, bathole kulimala okwahlukene kusukela kokubucayi kuya kwimihuzuko emincane ngemuva kokushayisana kwezimoto ezimbili. Enye yezimoto nayo igqabuke ilangabi ngemuva nje kwengozi abantu abebephakathi bangakwazi ukuphuma. Isibalo sabashonile asikaziwa okwamanje njengoba imoto isasha. Umgwaqo wonke uphazamisekile, kunxuswa ukubekezela kubashayeli. Enye ingozi eyenzeke namuhla ekuseni idlule nemiphefumulo yabantu abahlanu, okuhlanganisa nengane eneminyaka emihlanu ubudala, abashone kabuhlungu engozini yomgwaqo enyantisayo emgwaqeni uRookdale, eBergville.Ngokwemibiko, kushayisane izimoto enye yezimoto igqamuka amalangabi, omunye wabashinile kubikwa ukuthi ushe kulo mlilo.Abezimo eziphuthumayo kanye nezicishamlilo, bathunyelwe endaweni yesigameko bakhipha umbiko wesibalo wabashinile baveza ukuthi bekungakaqinisekiswa ukuthi ngobani abashonile, kanti imbangela yengozi isaphenywa. KUGUJWE ukuphela kweminyaka ewu-105 kwazalwa owayeyisishoshovu somzabalazo kuleli ngesikhathi sikahulumeni wobandlululo, uMnuz Harry Thembeyakhe Gwala. Umcimbi wokukhunjulwa kwaleli qhawe bewusemzini walo osesigodini saseTsheni, kwaSwayimani, eMgungundlovu ngoLwesithathu.Lo mgubho bewuhanjelwe wuNdunankulu waseGauteng, uMnuz Panyaza Lesufi, owayenguNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Zwelini Mkhize, owayenguMengameli woPhiko lwabesifazane kwi-ANC, uNksz Bathabile Dlamini, iMeya yaseMshwathi uMnuz Mandla Zondi namanye amalungu aqavile ale nhlangano.Laba baholi bakhumbule uGwala ngokubeka izimbali ethuneni lakhe elisemzini wakhe ngaphambi kokuyozitika ngenguzanguza yekhekhe ebelikwakhe.ULesufi ubonge kakhulu umndeni wakwaGwala ngokuqhubeka nokwenza umlando waleli qhawe ungashabalali. UGwala, owayaziwa ngelikaMunt'omdala noma ngeBhubesi laseMidlands, wazalelwa kwaSwayimani ngoJulayi 30, 1920, wadlula emhlabeni ngoJuni 20, 1995.Amagalelo akhe emzabalazweni enza wahlonishwa ngokuthi kuqanjwe izinto eziningi ngaye njengenkundla yebhola edumile eMgungundlovu, uMkhandlu oseXobho, isibhedlela saseMgungundlovu nokunye okuningi. Emuva kokuphothula iziqu zobuthishela e-Adams College, eManzimtoti, uGwala wafundisa eSlangspruit, eMgungundlovu. Yikulesi sikhungo lapho ahlangana khona nabafundi ayedingida nabo izindaba zepolitiki. Esefundisa wabutha abafundi abaningi okubalwa kubo uMoses "Mncane" Mabhida no-Agrippa Ngcobo. I-SACP yamyalela ukuba ashiye phansi ukufundisa kodwa ayoqhuba umzabalazo wabasebenzi. Wabuye waqashwa ukuba abe yi-typist esibhedlela esesiqanjwe ngaye, i-Edendale Hospiital kodwa waxoshwa esasebenze iminyaka emine ngenxa yokuthi wayesefake abasebenzi enyunyaneni.Seyivalwe umlomo i-ANC ngo-1960, uGwala wangena ephuma eRobben Island kangangoba akavunyelwanga ukuba ayongcwaba umkakhe ngo-1984. Esesejele wahlaselwa yisifo esamshiya ekhubazeke izingalo nokwaphoqa ukuba adedelwe ejele ngo-1988.Yize ayesekhubazekile waqhubeka nokuba yisishoshovu kwaze kwaba i-ANC ivulwa umlomo. Yingakho i-ANC yagcina imhloniphe ngomklomelo weSithwalandwe-Seaparankoe ngo-1992.Ngo-1994 waqokelwa ekubeni yilungu lesigungu esiphezulu seSACP kodwa wabuye wahoxiswa kwaze kwashaya isikhathi sokushona wakhe ngonyaka olandelayo.
USEZINHLELWENI zokuthola usizo lokwelulekwa ngokomqondo uyise wezingane ezimbili okuthiwa zabulawa wunina eNgonyameni, eMlaza, ngenyanga edlule.Lokhu kuvezwe uninakhulu wabafi, uNkk Nelisiwe Mkhize, izolo eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMlaza, emva kokuvela kukamsolwa, uNkk Neliswa Nompilo Thusini (28).UNksz Thusini usolwa ngokuklinya indodana yakhe eyayizohlanganisa izinyanga ezimbili izelwe uNqobizitha Thusini nendodakazi yakhe eyayineminyaka emibili, uNozibusiso Thusini. Izidumbu zabafi zatholwa abantu ababedlula ngendlela ngoJulayi 13. Zazisongwe ngengubo yokulala yezingane, phakathi kushuthekwe ipheshana elibhalwe inombolo yeselula kagogo nekayise wazo.Izolo ugogo wazo, uNkk Mkhize, uveze ukuthi indodana yakhe, uMnuz Njabulo Khuzwayo, enguyise wabafi, isibhalisele ukuthola usizo lokwelulekwa ngokomqondo."Besizitshela ukuthi unawo amandla okumelana nalesi simo. Kodwa kuthe emva kokuba umsolwa elokhu emfonela njengoba esejele, wakhombisa izimpawu zokungabi esimeni esikahle,” kusho uNkk Mkhize. Udalule ukuthi umsolwa njengoba ebelokhu efonela uyise wezingane zakhe ubefuna ukuthi amlethele izingubo zakhe ejele."Sisola ukuthi lokhu kumvusele amanxeba. Usebhalisile ukuthi athole usizo lokwelulekwa ngokomqondo,” kusho uNkk Mkhize. Ngaphakathi enkantolo ummeli kahulumeni obemele umsolwa, uNkk Shamika Sahdeo utshele inkantolo ukuthi emva kokuxoxisana nomsolwa isikhathi eside, belekelelwa nangutolika, umchazele ngezizathu zokuthi kungani uMbuso uthi uzosiphikisa icelo sebheyili. "Ugcine ethatha isinqumo sokuthi asilaxaze isicelo sakhe sebheyili,” kusho uNkk Sahdeo.UMshushisi woMbuso, uMnuz Khulekani Mzotho, ephakamisa ukuthi lihlehliswe icala uthe kusekhona uphenyo olushodayo."Phakathi kwalo wukuthi umsolwa abhukhelwe esibhedlela sabathikamezeke ngokwengqondo, iFort Napier ukuze ayohlolwa,” kusho uMzotho. Uphinde waveza nokuthi nombiko wokuhlolwa kwezidumbu ozocacisa ngembangela yokufa kwezingane, nawo usashoda.IMantshi, uMnuz Gqada, igama layo elingatholakalanga, ilihlehlisele uSepthemba 4 icala ukuze kuqhutshekwe nophenyo.Ephawula ngokulaxaza ibheyili kukamsolwa, uNkk Mkhize uthe kubajabulisile. "Kusikhululile ukuthi naye abone ukuthi akufanele aphume. Besizophatheka kabi ukuba ubeyithola ngoba besizibona singaphephile. Siyamesaba,” kusho uNkk Mkhize othe njengoba eyinqabile bazoke bathole ubuthongo.Ngaphakathi enkantolo, umsolwa uke waqale wazithulela nje ngesikhathi ebizwa ukuba aphakame lapho abehleli khona ukuze ame ebhokisini. Uze wasukuma igama lakhe selibizwa okwesibili, nemantshi isivule amehlo imangazwa wukuthi uhlaleleni phansi ebizwa.Ezithamelini bekukhona umndeni kayise wezingane, abebezoweseka kanjalo nezishoshovu ze-ANC zendawo.
INKAKHA yomculo wekwaito, uSbusiso "Sbu Malawyer" Ntshangase, izogubha ukuqeda iminyaka ewu-25 isicula ngokuzimela e-Eyethu Lifestyle Centre eSoweto namuhla. USbu Malawyer (53) uzoshiyelana inkundla nezingwazi zakuleli okubalwa kuzo uJoe Nina, Thebe, Spikiri, Jakarumba, Mgarimbe, Gwyza, DJ Sbu, DJ Cleo, Alaska, Pitch Black Afro, Rethabile, Nokwazi, DJ Ganyani, Ma E, Duncan, Maggz, Ba2cada, DJ Fisha Fasha, Beast RSA, DJ Finzo, La Sauce no-Uncle Charlie. Uthe lo mcimbi uwenze ngenxa yokufakwa ugqozi yi-albhamu ayikhiphe ngo-2023, ebophele amaciko asemnkantshubomvu nasafufusa."Okungenza ngenze lo mcimbi yingoba, ngisho i-albhamu seyize yaqokwa kumaSama Awards ngo-2024, ngiyabona ukuthi kukhona okusafanele kwenziwe ngayo." Lo mculi waqala ukuzibandakanya nezokungcebeleka ngesikhathi elingisa emdlalweni kaGibson Kente osihloko sithi What A Shame. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi uSbu Malawyer wabe esethulwa kuChicco Twala wuLindelani Mkhize weJoyous Celebration.Ngo-1994 nango-1995 wabe esesebenza noMdu Masilela engomeni ethi Tsikitsiki nakwethi Y U 4 Me ngaphambi kokusungula iqembu iMashamplan ngokubambisana nomufi uTokollo Tshabalala.Ngo-1997 uSbu Malawyer wabe esekhipha eyakhe yokuqala esehamba yedwa esihloko sithi Amalawyer. Wabuya ngonyaka olandelayo esehambisana neTKZee nelinye icwecwe elashisa izikhotha elisihloko sithi Mzala.Le-albhamu yenza kahle kakhulu njengoba yadayisa amakhophi awu-45 000. Ngo-1999 uSbu wahlanganyela noTokollo, Zwai Bala, Kabelo Mabalane, Loyiso Bala, Gwyza noDr Mageu basungula iTKZee Family.Ngo-2000 uSbu Malawyer wakhuza ibuya ne-albhamu yesithathu eyayisihloko sithi Inja Yangasese, esepike umculi we-jazz ongasekho uGloria Bosman. Yize uSbu Malawyer azalelwa eSoweto kodwa u-matric wawuphothula esikoleni saseThekwini ngaphambi kokuyokwenza izifundo ze-Electronic Engineering eJohannesburg Technical College. Amathikithi okuthamela lo mcimbi asatholakala kumaComputicket, Shoprite naseCheckers.
IZOCULA induna eboshwe kanye nenkosi ecaleni lokubulawa kwekhansela njengoba isiphenduke ufakazi woMbuso. UMnuz Zwelithini Buthelezi, oboshwe neNkosi uSimphiwe Eric Zuma, usephenduke ufakazi wenkantolo. Lokhu kuhlaluke ngesikhathi uZuma evele kanye nabanye abasolwa abathathu, oMnuz Thobane Masobho Hlongwa, Khayelihle Shabalala noMnuz Thabo Chonco, eNkantolo yeMantshi eHowick, izolo. UButhelezi nasolwa nabo baboshelwe icala lokusoconga owayeyikhansela leDA kuMasipala waseMngeni, uMnuz Nhlalayenza Ndlovu. Obemele uButhelezi, u-Advocate Mlilo (onqabile negama lakhe), ufake isicelo sokuhoxa kuleli cala. UMlilo uthe utshelwe ukuthi uButhelezi usenabameli abasha nokuthi usezoba wufakazi woMbuso. "Ngitshelwe ukuthi amacala abebhekene nawo ahoxisiwe nokuthi usezoba wufakazi woMbuso. Ngitshelwe ukuthi ubevele enkantolo ngoLwesibili. Angizange ngaziswe ukuthi uzovela enkantolo yngakho namhlanje ngifaka isicelo sokuhoxa kuleli cala."UButhelezi uyinduna eMpophomeni, nokuyindawo engaphansi kukaMasipala waseMngeni. UButhelezi usolwa ngokuba ngomunye wongqondongqondo ekuhlelweni kwetulo lokusoconga uNdlovu.UButhelezi uke wambisa amaphoyisa iqanda lenjelwane ngaphambi kokuthi aboshwe.Amaphoyisa aphenya amacala okubulawa kosopolitiki aze asabalalisa isithombe sakhe, ecela abantu ukuba bawabikele uma kwenzeka bembona.UNdlovu wabulawa phambi komndeni wakhe ngo-2023.Kuthiwa uNdlovu wabulawelwa ukulwa nokuntshontshwa kwempahla yomkhandlu kagesi okubalwa kuyo nama-transformer ayegcina edayiselwa abantu abanenkinga kagesi.IMeya kaMasipala waseMngeni, uMnuz Chris Pappas, ithe kuyakhathaza ukuzwa ukuthi obengummeli kaButhelezi akazange atshelwe mhla evuma ukuba wufakazi woMbuso. "Abameli bomunye wabantu ababoshiwe uveze ukuthi ubengazi ukuthi icala belihleli ngoLwesibili. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi kuningi okwenziwa amaphoyisa noMbuso ngale. Siyathemba ukuthi lena akusiyona imizamo yokuchitha icala."Icala lizobuyela enkantolo ngo-Agasti 8, lapho uZuma ezofaka isicelo sebheyili.UZuma ubesanda kudedelwa ngebheyili ka-R25 000 kwelinye icala lokubulala lapho esolwa khona ngokusoconga undunankulu wesizwe sakhe, uMnuz Qalokunye Zuma.Umsolwa oboshwe noZuma ngoLwesithathu, uChonco, utshele inkantolo ukuthi ngeke asifake isicelo sebheyili.UChonco uvele udonsa esinye isigwebo ejele, kuthiwa wahlela itulo lokusoconga uNdlovu ejele.
ICHIPHIZE izinyembezi inkosi eboshelwe icala lokusoconga ikhansela eliwumshana wayo. Inkosi Simphiwe Eric Zuma yakwaNxamalala, eMpendle, icwebise amehlo ngesikhathi ivela enkantolo lapho ebibhekene khona necala lokubulala owayeyikhansela le-DA kuMasipala waseMngeni, uMnuz Nhlalayenza Ndlovu. UZuma uvele kafushane eNkantolo yeMantshi eHowick, izolo. Icala lakhe lihlehliselwe u-Agasti 8, lapho ezofaka khona isicelo sebheyili. Ngesikhathi evele enkantolo, uZuma uvele wagubuzela, izinyembezi bezigcwele amehlo.UZuma uboshwe noMnuz Thabo Chonco, okuthiwa wahlela itulo lokubulala uNdlovu esejele. UNdlovu wabulawa phambi komndeni wakhe ngo-2023.Kuthiwa uNdlovu wabulawelwa ukulwa nokuntshontshwa kwempahla yomkhandlu kagesi okubalwa kuyo nama-transformer ayegcina edayiselwa abantu abanenkinga kagesi.Abanye abasolwa ababhekene necala ngoMnuz Thobane Masobho Hlongwa noKhayelihle Shabalala. UMnuz Simo Ndlovu, ozalwa umfowabo kaNdlovu, uthe kumshaqisile ukuzwa ukuthi ubaba omncane wakhe wasocongwa umuntu oyisihlobo sakhe esikhulu.USimo uthe uNdlovu uzalwa udadewabo kaZuma, wathi bayaya kwaZuma uma kunemicimbi."Bebebizana ngomzala kodwa empeleni uNdlovu uwumshana wenkosi. Ingakho ngithi kungishaqisile ukubona ukuthi isihlobo sethu naso siyathinteka kuleli cala."USimo uthe uZuma ubenakho ukubabuza ukuthi baqhuba kanjani njengoba engasekho uNdlovu.USimo uthe ukuchiphiza kukaZuma izinyembezi akuzukwenza ukuthi amzwele."Angikunakanga kakhulu lokhu ngoba kusangenzeka ukuthi ubezenzisa. Engikufunayo ukuba kuvele iqiniso."UZuma uboshwa nje, ubesanda kudedelwa ngebheyili ka-R25 000 kwelinye icala lokubulala.UZuma ubhekene necala lokubulala undunankulu wesizwe asiphethe, uMnuz Qalokunye Zuma, naye owumndeni wakhe.IMeya kaMasipala waseMngeni, uMnuz Chris Pappas, ithe igama likaZuma liyathinteka kwezinye izinsolo zobugebengu emphakathini."Uyaziwa nje lapha emphakathini ngokwephula umthetho. Igama lakhe liyathinteka ekuntshontshweni kwama-transformer. Ngiyazibuza nje ukuthi kungani engathweswa necala lobugebengu obuhleliwe?"Ummeli kaZuma, u-Advocate Mduduzi Nkomo, uzame ukumcelela ukuba ayoboshelwa ejele eliseMgungundlovu.UNkomo uthe uZuma akaphilile kahle, kungagcono uma engasuswa ejele eliseThekwini, khona ezokuba seduze nenkantolo okuthethelwa kuyo icala lakhe.Kepha umshushisi, u-Advocate Elvis Gcweka, usichithile lesi sicelo.UGcweka uthe basabela ukuthi uma uZuma engagqunywa ejele eliseMgungundlovu uzofike ahlangane noChonco, bese beqhubeka nobugebengu babo.IMantshi uNtini, isichithile isicelo sikaZuma.UNtini usichithile nesicelo sokuba abasolwa bathwetshulwe izithombe ngabezindaba.AbakwaZuma, okubalwa kubo nelungu leMK esiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thobani Zuma, bebekhona enkantolo bezokweseka uZuma.UZuma uhlobene nomholi weMK, uMnuz Jacob Zuma.
BAFUNA bubuyiselwe emumva emndenini ubunikazi betayitela bese kuboshwa nabathile, abaphunyuke ngembobo yenaliti, kungqongqiswa indlu yomxhaso enombango kwaF, KwaMashu, ngoMsombuluko.Kulesi sigameko kusinde ilungu lomndeni elidala nezingane zalo ezimbili, enye yazo eshe isandla.UNksz Thabisile Mchunu ongomunye wabagilwa, elandisa ngesigameko, uthe sehle sebelele. "Siphaphanyiswe umsindo wokusha komlilo kanti nomakhelwane sebebonile ukuthi kuyasha. Abaningi bese begcwele egcekeni, besimemeza ukuba siphumele ngaphandle,” kusho uNksz Mchunu.Uthe nakuba umlilo ubusuvimbanise cishe zonke izingxenye zendlu kodwa bakwazile ukuphuma, wathi abakufuniseli ukuthi umuzi ushiswe yibhomu likaphethroli ngabasolwa ababaziyo. Udalule ukuthi ezinyangeni ezimbili ezedlule, bake bahlaselwa amadoda angaziwa, afike abakhomba ngezibhamu."Asitshele emehlweni ukuthi asiphume ngoba sizolimala ngoba lo muzi usuthengiwe,” kubeka uNksz Mchunu.Uthe bathola ukuthi umuzi udayiswe yisihlobo, esesineminyaka sahamba ekhaya. Elandisa ngalokhu, uthe bathole ukuthi isihlobo esike safika ekhaya esikhathini esingaphezu kweminyaka emibili edlule sazosayinisa umamncane wakhe owayegula kakhulu amaphepha athile."Sithole emva kwendaba ukuthi njengoba ayemkhohlisa ngendaba yokulungisa imali yempesheni, wayesayinisa ukuthi umuzi ususwe kumamncane ube ngaphansi kwakhe,” kusho uNksz Mchunu.Uthe yingalesi sizathu isihlobo sikwaze ukuwudayisa umuzi womndeni bona behleli phakathi. Uthe umuzi kwakuwumxhaso kagogo nomkhulu wabo, kwathi uma beshona wawela ezinganeni zabo, kuzona kukhona nale egcine ishona ngo-2023, esikhathini esifishane isayiniswe amaphepha okushintsha kwetayitela."Ngesikhathi sihlaselwa sivele sabona ukuthi lokhu kumayelana nalo mbango ngoba thina siyala ukuthi kudayaswe ikhaya eliwumsamo wethu sonke,” kukhala uNksz Mchunu.Uthe abafuna ukukubona kwenzeka ukuboshwa kwesihlobo, abashise umuzi nalabo ababezobakhomba ngezibhamu. Udalule ukuthi kumthusile ukuthi emva kokuvulwa kwecala ngoMsombuluko kulandela isigameko, bathole izolo ukuthi idokodo selivaliwe, kuthiwa ubufakazi abukho."Lokhu ngikuthole ngesikhathi ngizwa kuthiwa isihlobo esiboshwe amaphoyisa ngoLwesibili, sesibuye sadedelwa. Ngithe uma ngiya khona, ngathola ukuthi idokodo selivaliwe ngoba akunabufakazi,” usho kanje.Usole amaphoyisa ngokuthengwa abantu abanemali ukuze anyathele amacala. "Nelokukhonjwa kwethu ngezibhamu nalo laphelela emoyeni,” kusho uNksz Mchunu.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa aKwaMashu avule icala lokulinyazwa kwendlu emva kokuthi indlu ilayithwe ngomlilo abantu abangaziwa ngoMsombuluko."Amalungu omndeni akwazile ukuphuma engenamyocu, imbangela yesigameko ayikaziwa,” kusho uNetshiunda.
ISIZWE sakwaMuthwa sesikuchaze njengokuqala kwesibani esiletha ukukhanya ukuhoxiswa kwesiqalekiso phezu kwalesi sizwe esabe sibekwe yibandla lamaRoma aKhatholika.Lokhu sikusho ngemuva kokuba kade kunendumezulu yemisa ebihlanganisa ibandla lamaRoma Akahatholika nabakwaMuthwa ebikade iqhubeka eSt Joseph, eMarriannhill. Kuvela ukuthi ukhokho wesizwe sakwaMuthwa osalala kobandayo uMabhabha Muthwa kukhona iphutha elikhulu alenza nelaholela ekutheni ibandla lamaRoma lehlise isiqalekiso kuyena kanjalo nakusona sonke isizwe sakhe. Namhlanje ke leli misa liyingqophamlando ngoba lisho ukususwa ngokugcwele kwalesi siqalekiso futhi kusho ukukhululwa kwesizwe sonke,'' usho kanjena.Ingwevu endala yesizwe sakwaMuthwa uMnuz Sibongisipho Muthwa uthe besibakhathaza kakhulu lesi siqalekiso esabekwa yibandla lamaRoma esizweni.Uthe njengamanje kulokoza inhlansi yethemba ngokuthi kuningi okuzokhanya njengoba lesi siqalekiso sesisusiwe nje manje.''Leli misa lizoletha ukukhanya kanjalo nokukhululwa esizweni sonke sakwaMuthwa. Kuyasijabulisa nje kakhulu lokhu esikubona kwenzeka namhlanje. Sengathi kungaba kuningi okuhle okuvelayo nokwenzekayo ngemuva kokususwa kwalesi siqalekiso,'' usho kanjena.Ngemuva kwaleli misa kube nendumezulu yomcimbi lapho obekusindwe khona ngobethole kuhlatshwe izinkomo kukhonjwa ngophakathi.
