Imali ezobe itholwa iwadi ngayinye ilinganiselwa ku-R800 000. Le mali izosiza ekuthengweni kwamathangi amanzi kanjalo nasekutheni kuvuselelwe izikimu ezindala ezingasasebenzi,'' usho kanjena.Kuvelile lapha ukuthi amanzi abevulwa azolakelela abantu abalinganiselwa ku-250. Phakathi kwezindawo ezizohlomula kubalwa uNhlopheni, KwaBombo, Zwelisha, eMooiplass kanye naseGundintaba.Kuhlalukile ukuthi umsebenzi owenziwa lapha ufaka phakathi ukuxhunywa kompompi abangu-68 abazoba semphakathini kanye nokuvuselelwa kweziteshi ezintathu zokuphampa amanzi kumaboreholes.IMeya idalule ukuthi wonke lo msebenzi udle imali elinganiselwa ku-R18,5 million. IMeya ibe seyiphosela inselelo umphakathi wakule ndawo ukuba ubhukule ulwe namasela aphazamisa ingqalasizinda yamanzi.''Kasifisi ukuzwa ukuthi sekwebiwe icable, umpompi noma yini nje enye ephathelene namanzi. Akufanele imali eyabelwa amawadi igcine seyenza into eyodwa yokuphesha izinto ezebiwe,'' exwayisa.Eqhubeka uphosele inselelo abaesifazane bakule ndawo babone ukuthi yimaphi amathuba abangawasebenzisa ukuziphilisa. Ukulekelelwa kwabantu besifazane uthe kungaphansi kohlelo uMzinyathi Development Agency."Baningi kakhulu abesifazane esisibaxhasile ngaphansi kwalolu hlelo. Yingakho sinxusa nabanye ukuba basondele eduze,'' ephetha.
ISEYINDABA egudwini e-Unit 13, eMbali, eMgungundlovu, eyowesilisa obenezinsuku ezimbili ededelwe ngebheyili ejele okuthiwa ubulale umuntu ngesihluku kule ndawo ngenxa yentombi.Kulesi sigameko okusolakala ukuthi senzeke ebusuku ngeSonto kodwa isidumbu saze satholwa ngoMsombuluko ekuseni, kushone uMnuz Lifa "Fah" Muloyi (34).Ngokusho kwesihlobo esicele ukungadalulwa, umndeni uvuswe ngumuntu wendawo obedlula ngendlela elibangise emsebenzini entathakusa, ezithela phezu kukamufi edindilizile ngaphandle kwesango lakubo. Silandisa ngesigameko isihlobo sithe umufi ubelimele kakhulu ebusweni, kukhombisa ukuthi ubengqimuzwa ngobuso etiyeleni kuphindelelwa. Isihlobo sithe umsolwa, uMnuz Andile Ngubane, ngumuntu owaziwayo, ohlala e-Unit 15, khona eMbali, okuyibanga elilingana nekhilomitha elilodwa uma usuka endaweni yesigameko, uya kubo (kamsolwa).Silandisa ngesehlo isihlobo sithe umsolwa ubevele emsongela ngokumbulala umufi engaphakathi ejele. "Esikutholile wukuthi umsolwa uboshwe emasontweni ambalwa edlule, eboshelwa ukuhlukumeza owesifazane abethandana naye. Lona wesifazane kuthiwa wambophisa, wabe eseqhubeka nempilo, ethandana nomufi,” kusho isihlobo.Siqhube sathi, lokhu kwafika ezindlebeni zikamsolwa engaphakathi ejele maqede waphathisa umyalezo ngabantu bendawo wathi "uzombamba".Siveze ukuthi ngesonto ebusuku umufi ubemi ngaphandle kwesango nentombi ethintekayo ngesikhathi kuthushuka umsolwa ehamba nomngani wakhe. "Kuthiwa wababuza ukuthi basaqhubeka kanti nale nto yabo, wabe egadla kumufi. Kuthiwa umngani ayehamba naye wazama ukulamula kodwa umsolwa wamshaya, waze wabaleka. Kuthiwa waphendukela entombini, nayo wayithela induku, yabaleka nayo, wase ebuyela kumufi,” kusho isihlobo.Siveze ukuthi bayabona ukuthi umsolwa wamhlula umufi ngamandla njengoba ambulala ngokumsakaza etiyeleni ephindelela waze washona.Uthe sibethusile isigameko futhi bayafuna ukubona ubulungiswa. Ubonge onogada benkampani iNjoms Security, okuthiwa basukumele phezulu emva kokubikelwa ngesigameko maqede wabanjwa umsolwa, waboshwa.UMnuz Bruce Mhlongo wale nkampani yonogada uthe kusebenzile ukuthi balusukumele phezulu udaba maqede bazenzela olwabo uphenyo olusheshayo, umsolwa zamkhalela."Emva kokufika endaweni yesigameko sithole umkhondo othi umufi ubulawe wumsolwa othile oqeda kuphuma ejele. Siye kwelinye ikhaya lakubo eliKwaDambuza sayomfuna, sangamthola,” kusho uMhlongo. Uthe umndeni ubatshele ukuthi umsolwa abamfunayo uboshiwe.Uveze ukuthi ngisho namaphoyisa asho okufanayo, angafuna nokuyiphenya eyezinsolo zokuthi umsolwa ungaphandle."Sidlulele ekhaya lakhe elise-Unit 15, nabo baphika balala ngomhlane ukuthi ungaphandle,” kusho uMhlongo, othe bavele bacindezela eyokuthi kuseshwe zonke izindlu, okubandakanya nalezo ezingaphandle. "Simbhadame ecashe kwenye yazo, engekho obembonile, nobazi ukuthi ukhona. Ubeseze wazishutheka ngaphansi kukamatrasi, samvundulula khona,” kusho uMhlongo.Uthe bathole ukuthi ubehlele ukuthi kuhlwe bese eshaya utshani njengoba bese epakishe ngisho nesikhwama ebesigcwele izingubo zakhe zokugqoka. Udalule ukuthi umsolwa ngumuntu owaziwa ngamacala abucayi okukhona kuwo awokubamba inkunzi kuhlonyiwe nokubulala. Ukhale ngamaphoyisa ahudula izinyawo uma kufanele enze umsebenzi, wathi ngisho nomphakathi usunengekile ngalokhu.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa esiteshi sasePlessislaer avule icala lokubulala kulandela isigameko sokutholwa kowesilisa ebulewe ngaphandle kwesango lakubo ngoMsombuluko elokishini iMbali. "Ubenenqwaba yezingozi. Imbangela yokubulala ayikaziwa,” kusho uNetshiunda.
BATHWELE kanzima abathanda inyama njengoba izibalo zangoJulayi zikhombisa ukunyuka kwentengo yezinhlobo ezahlukene zenyama.Izibalo ezikhishwe yinhlangano engenzi nzuzo, iPietermaritzburg Economic Justice and Dignity (PMBEJD), zikhombisa ukuthi intengo yezinhlobo zenyama okubalwa kuzo usu namanqondo inyukile kule nyanga.AbePMBEJD bathe ukunyuka kwezinhlobo ezahlukene zenyama kwenza ukuthi ukudla kubize.Bathe ngenxa yokunyuka kwamanani okudla abantu abaningi abasebenzayo abanayo imali eyanele yokuthenga ukudla okuzobaqhuba kuze kuphele inyanga.Izibalo zakamumva zikhombisa ukuthi inyama ebomvu nosu kukhuphuke ngo-5% ngoJulayi. Amanqondo, izingingila, isibindi, iwors, inhlanzi, no-polony kunyuke ngo-4% kule nyanga.Okunye ukudla okunyukile ngoJulayi yiklabishi, yisinkwa esi-brown nobisi. Ukudla kunyuke ngo-R159 kule nyanga uma kuqhathaniswa noJulayi wangonyaka owedlule. "NgoJulayi wangonyaka odlule ukudla okudingwa wumndeni kwakubiza u-R5 252, kuJulayi wakulo nyaka ukudla okudingwa wumndeni kubiza u-R5 442."Amanani ezinye izinhlobo zokudla okukhona kuzo impuphu, amafutha, ubhontshisi, ushukela, amazambane namaqanda ehlile kancane kule nyanga.Ngokwamadolobha amanani okudla anyuke ngo-R45 eThekwini, anyuka ngo-R60 eMtubatuba, abe esehla ngo-R56 eMgungundlovu kule nyanga. Umqondisi kwiPMBJED, uMnuz Mervyn Abrahams, uthe izibalo zikhombisa ukuthi abasebenzi abanayo imali eyanele yokuthenga ukudla okuzobaqhuba kuze kuphele inyanga. U-Abrahams uthe umsebenzi ohola kancane kufanele ukuthi uhole u-R5 297 kuJulayi njengoba bekunezinsuku ezingu-23 zokusebenza kule nyanga. Uthe umndeni ojwayelekile wabantu abane udinga u-R3 755 ukuze ukwazi ukuthenga ukudla okwanele inyanga.U-Abrahams uthe ucwaningo abalwenzile eMgungundlovu luveze ukuthi abantu abahola kancane basala no-R2 275 wokuthenga ukudla emva kokukhokhela izindleko zabo zenyanga."Lokhu kusho ukuthi abanayo imali eyanele yokuthenga ukudla. Abantu baqala ngokukhokhela izindleko ezifana nezokuthutha kanye nogesi, bagcina ngakho ukudla." U-Abrahams uthe nomama bezingane bathwele kanzima.U-Abrahams uthe ucwaningo lwabo lukhombisa ukuthi ukudla kwengane kwenyanga kubiza u-R957."Isibonelelo sezingane singu-R560. Singaphansi kwemali edingekayo."
UKUSHAYWA kaningi ngento engacijile ngokwakhipha umphefumulo wesaguga saseMthebeni, eNdwedwe, esashona emva kokulinyazwa ngoSepthemba, ngonyaka odlule, okuthiwa sahlaselwa umzukulu waso.Lokhu kuvele izolo, eNkantolo yesiFunda YaseVerulam, ngesikhathi udokotela wasemakhazeni kahulumeni ePhoenix, ethula ubufakazi ngakuthola ngesikhathi ehlola isidumbu. Kulesi sigameko kwashona uNkk Sibongile Elizabeth Vilakazi (70) okuthiwa wahlaselwa umzukulu, uMnuz Andile Vilakazi (30). Umufi kuthiwa wahlaselwa ngokushaywa ephindelela ngento engacijile okusolwa ukuthi kwakuyisitini noma isando. Esigamekweni, kwaphinde kwahlaselwa nezinye izihlobo okukhona kuzo umalumekazi kamsolwa uNksz Zimbili Vilakazi, uyise kamsolwa uMnuz Bongani Vilakazi nomkhulu kamsolwa uMnuz Bhekokwakhe Vilakazi.Umsusa wokuhlaselwa kuthiwa kwaba ukuthi uZimbili afudumezele umsolwa ukudla ngesikhathi efika ekhaya ebusuku.Kuthiwa umsolwa wabuza umgilwa ukuthi kungani enza okuhlukile, emfudumezela ukudla, wase emshaya. Kuvela ukuthi umufi nomyeni wakhe baphuma egunjini labo lokulala bethi bayakhuza nabo behlaselwa umsolwa.Kuthiwa umufi waphangalalela everanda. Kuvela nokuthi ngesikhathi sekubizwa uyise kamsolwa okuthiwa isigameko senzeka eselele endlini yakhe engaphandle, naye wafika wahlaselwa umsolwa. Embikweni kadokotela wezidumbu, kuvele ukuthi izingozi ezazisekhanda ohlangothini lwesokunxele kanjalo naphezulu okhakhayini zazingaphezu kwezinhlanu. Udokotela uthe nakuba lolu hlobo lokulimala umuntu engaluthola uma ewe maqede washayeka endawe eqinile kodwa yena wafinyelela esiphethweni sokuthi izingozi zikamufi ezokushaywa ngento engacijile, hhayi ukuwela endaweni eqinile. Ugcizelele eyokuthi ngokolwazi lwakhe, umuntu ongawa esuka endaweni ephezulu kakhulu ongaba nezingozi ezifuze lezi azibona kumufi, hhayi owe ngokuphushwa umuntu kade ezimele noma ehamba. Uphinde wathi lokhu ukusho ngoba umuntu olimale ngokuwa angaba nengozi eyodwa, hhayi eziningi.Lokhu kugcizelela kukadokotela kwenzeke emva kokuthi ummeli kahulumeni kammangalelwa, uMnuz Denvar Reddy, ebuze ukuthi kungenzeke yini ukuthi umufi walimala ngale ndlela emva kokuphushwa?UDenvar lokhu ubekususela ekutheni ummangalelwa kuthiwa uthi yena akamhlaselanga umufi ephindelela ngento engacijile kodwa wamphusha kwaba ukuthi uwela endaweni eqinile. Udokotela uveze ukuthi ngokwesipiliyoni sakhe, waqala ukuba wudokotela ngo-1972, kwathi umsebenzi wokuhlola izidumbu wona wawuqala ngo-1982. Emva kokusonga kukadotokela ubufakazi, uMshushisi woMbuso, uMnuz Ntuthuko Mngadi, uveze ukuthi phakathi kwamanye amazibithi awaletha phambi kwenkantolo kukhona imibiko emibili yodokotela eqondene necala lokuhlaselwa kukayise kammangalelwa kanjalo nelokuhlaselwa komyeni kamufi ongumkhulu womsolwa.Uthe maqondana nokushaywa kukayise, udokotela wathola ukuthi unamanxeba ayisihlanu ayevulekile ekhanda kanjalo nakamkhulu. Icala lisongwe ngokuthi uMbuso umbize lo dokotela ukuba azofakaza ngalo mbiko phambi kwenkantolo njengoba kwenzeke okufanayo ngodokotela owahlola isidumbu.Lesi siphakamiso senziwe uDenvar, ngelithi akahambisani nokuthi inkantolo yamukele lo mbiko njengezibithi njengoba udokotela engezanga ukuzofakaza ngawo phambi kwenkantolo.Yize uMbuso ubusuzitshela ukuthi usufike esiphethweni sofakazi bawo kodwa ugcine uthi uzobizwa lo dokotela kanjalo nowathwebula izithombe endaweni yesigameko ukuthi bazoba ofakazi bokugcina. IMantshi, uNksz B Mpungose, ilihlehlisele uLwesithathu oluzayo, icala ukuze kuze laba ofakazi.Khonamanjalo: Inkantolo efanayo ilihlehlisele u-Agasti 26, kulo nyaka, icala lokubulawa kukaMnuz Nkosinathi Vilakazi waseMolokohlo, eNdwedwe, elibhekene noMnuz Enock Cele nendodana, uMnuz Sabelo Cele.Abamangalelwa kuthiwa babulala umufi bamphonsa emgodini wethoyilethi, maqede balidiliza, bezama ukugqiba ubufakazi ngoJulayi, ngonyaka odlule. Isidumbu sikamufi satholwa emva kwenyanga, sikhonjwa yibo abasolwa, umphakathi uvuka umbhejazana emva kokuthola umkhindo.Ngesikhathi kuhlehla icala, kuvele ukuthi kukhona izitatimende okufanele zilethwe ummeli wabamangalelwa.
AMAPHOYISA abophe abasolwa abangu-14 273 ngamacala ahlukene, okubalwa kuwo awokubulala nokudlwengula ngesonto eledlule, eqhuba umkhankaso obizwa ngeshanela.Abasolwa baboshwe phakathi kukaMsombuluko neSonto ngoJulayi 27.Owakhulumelayo, uLieutenant Colonel Vincent Mukhathi, esitatimendeni uthe abasolwa abangu-2 081 baboshelwe amacala okubamba inkunzi amabhizinisi nasemizini, ukuduna izimoto, ukubulala, ukuzama ukubulala nokudlwengula. "Abangu-172 baboshelwe ukubulala futhi abaningi abangu-46 baboshelwe eGauteng, kwalandela i-Eastern Cape ngo-37. Abangu-138 baboshelwe ukuzama ukubulala. Abangu-170 baboshelwe ukudlwengula futhi iGauteng ihamba phambili ngo-26," kusho uMukhathi.Uqhube wathi abangu-1 598 baboshelwe ukushaya ngenhloso yokulimaza, abangu-324 babanjelwe ukushushumbisa izidakamizwa, kwathi abangu-1 376 baboshelwe ukutholakala nezidakamizwa iningi labo eliseWestern Cape.IKwaZulu-Natal ihamba phambili ngababoshelwe amacala athinta ukutholakala nezibhamu ezingekho ezimthethweni njengoba abangu-45 kwabangu-119 ababoshwe ezweni bebanjwe kulesi sifundazwe. Ihamba phaili nangababoshelwe ukushayela bephuzile noma bedle izidakamizwa. Kuboshwe abangu-157, kwalandela iGauteng ngo-156 kwabangu-672 ababoshiwe.UMukhathi uthe baphinde bathola izibhamu ezingu-140, izinhlamvu ezingu-1 720 kanjalo nezimoto ebezebiwe okanye eziduniwe ezingu-81.
UMNDENI wobengumlingisi wemidlalo yomoya neyethelevishini futhi eyiphimbo loKhozi FM, uMartin Edward Ziqubu, uthi nawo ushaqekile ngokudlula emhlabeni kwalesi silomo. Ngokusho kukankosikazi kaZiqubu, uNkk Nhlanhla Ziqubu, umufi ubeziphilela engumqemane ngoLwesine emini futhi kungebuhlungu ndawo. "Ubeye emhlanganweni eThekwini ngabo-1 futhi kwahamba kahle konke. Uthe esebuya wezwa enqanyulekelwa wumoya. Ube esedlula kudokotela osesigcemeni sakwaM, KwaMashu lapho okufike kwamenela khona." UNkk Ziqubu uthe umyeni wakhe sike samhlasela isifo sofuba ngoJulayi 2, waze wanikezwa isifutho kodwa kulokhu akasindanga. Osabambile ophikweni lwezinhlelo emsakazweni uKhozi FM, uMandla "Mr Gold" Mdletshe uthe balimele kakhulu ngokudlula emhlabeni kwaleli qhawe ngenxa yokuthi bese besebenze nalo iminyaka engu-26. "Safikela kubo, i-drama isenziwa uDT Ngwenya, Bheki Msane noMuvo Maphalala (nabo abangasekho emhlabeni). Yibona abasemukela obaba uZiqubu kwa-drama, kodwa yena walethwa wumama uVicky Masuku owayekade efundisa naye. Ubaba u-Eric Ngcobo wayefuna umuntu onezwi elikhulu, uVicky Masuku wahamba wayomcela ukuthi akazodlala imidlalo yomoya. Wafike wagila izimanga ngo-1991. (Kusukela lapho) akazange aphinde abheke emuva, kwagcina sekungena nakwi-tv. Ugcine sekunguye i-voice yomsakazo" UZiqubu (68), obedabuka eNtuzuma, eThekwini, ungene ekulingise ephuma ebuthisheni lapho asebenze khona iminyaka ewu-40. Ekulingiseni, abantu abaningi bazomkhumbula nasemdlalweni owawuthi Buchitheka Bugayiwe nakowuchungechunge owawuthi Kusa Kusa, lapho azakhela khona udumo ngokudlala indawo kaNgqongqo. Ushone edlala indawo kaGombela emdlalweni othi Indandatho Yesethembiso. Ngo-2018 ube esengena kwithelevishini emuva kweminyaka esaba ukulingisa khona. Emidlalweni yethelevishini aseke walingisa kuyo kubalwa i-eHostela, Isibaya, Durban Gen, Uzalo, Imbewu, Umjolo:Gone Wrong noNomthawelanga. Ngo-2022 uZiqubu wahlonishwa ngendondo yekhethelo kuma-Excellence Teachers’ Awards ayeseLuthuli Museum, KwaDukuza. Ushiye emhlabeni umkakhe, indodana enguzinyobulala, uLindisipho nabazukulu ababili, uLindelwa noKhulani. Esephetha uNkk Ziqubu uthe okwamanje abengakaphothulwa amalungiselelo omngcwabo kamufi.
UMHOLI webandla lakwaShembe, ohlangothini lwaseBuhleni, Inkosi uMduduzi Unyazilwezulu Shembe, ugadle isinyenyela eNkosini yaseThembezinhle engasekho, uVela Imisebeyelanga Shembe nakoFakazi bakaJehova ngesikhathi evala umhlangano kaJulayi ngempelasonto. Unyazi luthe ngabe kwaphela ngenkonzo yobuNazaretha ukube amaQadi ayengekho, ikakhulukazi Inkosi uMzonjani neNkosi uMqoqi Ngcobo. Belucacisa ngokunikeza Inkosi yamaQadi inkonzo yasekuseni. Luthe lokhu kwaqalwa yinkosi esiyakhothama nengumkhulu walo, u-Amos Kula Inyangayezulu Shembe eminyakeni eyedlule. "Umkhulu Inyangayezulu kwakuthi uma kuyiSabatha lokuvalwa komhlangamo kaJulayi, inkonzo yasekuseni inikezwe iNkosi yamaQadi bese eyasemini iphathwa wuyena umkhulu." UNyazi luthe luzama ukubuyisela le nkonzo yokuvala umhlangano kaJulayi kokwakwenziwa yiNyangayezulu. "Ukube ayengekho amaQadi la, ngabe ubuNazaretha baphela. Ngesikhathi inkosi ezala le ekhona yamaQadi (uMzonjani), ithatha isifungo sobuNazaretha ngesikhathi sikamkhulu, Ilanga (Inkosi Johannes Galile Shembe), kwathi uma umkhulu eseyibhabhadisa wathi namhlanje ngiyitholile inkosana yobuNazaretha." UNyazi luncome kakhulu amagalelo eNkosi uMqoqi ekusimamiseni leli bandla laseBuhleni. "Nanamhlanje leli Qadi elikhona libumele lobu buNazaretha, sihamba nalo izinkantolo, limile lithi 'uNyazi iNkosi, angiyazi enye inkosi. Nangesikhathi besifakele amaphepha ngaphansi, sebezenze zonke izinto, sebethe bazomemezela leliya gama ababethi likhona (Imisebeyelanga). Angazi iQadi layibamba kanjani le nto ukuthi nakhu konakala. Labe selimemeza elami igama kuqala. Nalo elesibili lamenyezelwa, kodwa-ke ukumenyezelwa kwalo akuthathanga sikhathi ngoba elami lisekhona namanje. Into enobuNkulunkulu ayifi kodwa-ke manje uma inobuNkulunkulu obushodayo iyafa, iphele."UNyazi lukhuluma kanje kuyaziwa ukuthi ngenkonzo yokutshalwa kukayise, Inkosi uVimbeni Uthingolwenkosazane Shembe ngoMashi 2011, Inkosi uMqoqi yamemzela kuqala uNyazi kwathi ummeli woThingo uMnuz Zwelabantu Buthelezi wamemezela umfowabo woThingo, Imisebeyelanga. Kwathi uma isixazululo singaphumi ngaphakathi ebandleni, kwabe sekuyiswana eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini lapho Imisebeyelanga yaphumelela khona ngo-Okthoba 2016.Abameli boNyazi babe udaba sebeludlulisela eNkantolo eNkulu yaseMgungundlovu, ngo-Okthoba 23, 2017 kodwa kwaphinda kwanqoba Imisebeyelanga. NgoNovemba 24, 2017, Imisebeyelanga yakhothama emuva kokudunguzela isikhashana, kwabe sekuqokwa Inkosi uPhinda "Ukukhanyakwelanga" Shembe ukuba ihole uhlangothi lwaseThembezinhle ngoDisemba 23, 2017.AboNyazi baphinde badlulela eNkantolo ePhakeme yokuDlulisa amaCala nakhona bafike bachithwa ngoDisemba 2, 2019. Babe sebedlulela eNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo nakhona bakhala ngaphansi okwentshebe yaKwaMashu. Kwathi ngoDisemba 4, kwayalelwa uNyazi ukuba luphume luphele eBuhleni kodwa lwanqaba, kunalokho isikhonzi senkantolo saphuma sesihlehla nyova kusha isimbambamba.Sekungumlando ukuthi ngo-Okthoba nyakenye kugcine kunqobe uNyazi njengoba abaseThembezinhle bachithwa yinkantolo esicelweni sabo sokuba luyekiswe ukukhonzisa amaNazaretha, ukuzibiza ngomholi wakwaShembe, luphume luphele eBuhleni futhi lungathathi ngisho noma yini ethathekayo eBuhleni uma seluhamba nabalandeli balo. Inkantolo yavele yathi inkomo ingazala umuntu ngoba umuzi waseBuhleni uyikhaya loNyazi.Kule nkonzo okubonakale kudansa ngisho ilanga futhi lishintsha imibala, uNyazi luthe amaNazaretha akahlukane nokuthenga amabhukwana awanikezwa ngoFakazi BakaJehova. "Ningavumi wemaNazaretha ukuhamba nivinjwa yilaba bantu abama ezimpambanweni zemigwaqo belokhu benidayisela lokhu okuthiwa woPhaphama. Angiyena uPhaphama mina, nginguShembe. Le nto yifa lenu lokuphila, eningalibangi namuntu. Manje ngoba niyabazi lobu buNazaretha, nizohluthuka uma umuntu eniphikisa, musani ukuhlanganyela nabo. Mina ngiwu-2, ngikhona angikho. UShembe uyinto esuke ikhona ibe ingekho. Uma uyimemeza iyasabela," kuphetha uNyazi.

UMathaba uthe intsha kufanele idlalele kude notshwala athe bubulala izwe.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma emcimbini waminyaka yonke wokudodisa amabhungu asakhulu. Lo mcimbi obuhlelwe inhlangano Ubuhle beZolo Lethu Youth Development. Ngicela uma nisikhulisela izintombi sikhuliseleni izintombi eziphilayo. Sifuna izintombi owaziyo ukuthi uma uganwa yizo, kuyobe uthole umfazi oqotho. Kodwa-ke angeke kusize ukuthi nisakhele izintombi eziqotho, ezingaphuzi, kufike lezi zinsizwa zidakiwe, zingaboni nanokuthi nansi intombi. AHLUKENE phakathi amaqembu asesiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal ngodaba lokuvinjwa kwabokufika abakuleli ngokungemthetho ekutheni bathole usizo ezikhungweni zezempilo zikahulumeni. UKeeka uthe naye unqatsheliwe ukungena esibhedlela ngenxa yokuthi wenqabe ukuveza umazisi wakhe kulabo abavimbe esangweni esibhedlela i-Addington. Into engiyibuzile ukuthi kuzokwenzakalani ngalaba abanye abavinjwayo? Mphathiswa kufanele silusukumele lolu daba."UMphathiswa woMnyango wezeMpilo, uNksz Nomagugu Simelane, uthe kuphambene nomthetho ukuvinjwa kwabokufika, wathi akusikhona ukuthi bavikela abantu abakuleli ngokungemthetho kodwa wathi balandela umthetho.

Amaqembu aphethe kufanele aphendule. Emhlanganweni sivumelene ukuthi ukwanda kwezinsolo ezibhekiswe eminyangweni kahulumeni sezande ngale ndlela yokuthi sesingazifanisa nobhubhane. Ingakho sifuna ukuba kube nomhlangano wamadlelandawonye lapho sizofuna khona izimpendulo ngezinsolo."
LIHLEHLISELWE uMsombuluko ozayo, icala lokuzama ukubulala usomatekisi waseMadundube, eMbumbulu, elibhekene nenkabi yaseFolweni.UMnuz Fanele Mthembu ubevele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini, izolo, ngecala lokuzama ukubulala uMnuz Siyanda Ndlela esigamekweni esenzeka ngePhasika lakulo nyaka eSouth Beach, eThekwini.Kulesi sigameko okusolwa ukuthi siyamene nombango womzila wamatekisi, kwashona inkabi eyodwa, okuthiwa yadutshulwa yafa nguNdlela ezama ukuzivikela. Inkantolo ilihlehlisele ukuthi umsolwa afake isicelo sebheyili. Umgilwa, uNdlela uthe ufuna ukubona kwenzeka ubulungiswa ngaleli cala njengoba bese kungokwesithathu ehlaselwa ngezibhamu.Ebala ezigameko, uthe kwesakamuva esenzeke ngo-Ephreli 18 kulo nyaka, wahlaselwa ehleli emotweni nomunye usomatekisi egaraji likaphethroli eSouth Beach. "Esingaphambi kwaleso senzeka ngoFebhuwari, 2022, ePinetown. Kulesi sigameko kwasala iselula yenkabi eyodwa, ekhombisa ubuso bayo,” kusho uNdlela.Uthe uyakholelwa ukuthi umsuka wokuthi yena nabanye abahlaselwa phambilini, okukhona kubo abanye abaze bafa, ngesikhathi abanye bephuma nemihuzuko, wawumayelana nomsebenzi osemzileni waseHarding."Baningi abadutshulwa ngo-2021, kukhona isigameko saseMarburg, lapho okwadutshulwa khona abathathu, kwafa ababili,” kusho uNdlela, othe ingemumva kwaleso sigameko lapho athola khona ukuthi bahlaselwa osomatekisi ababaziyo. Uthe kwakungemumva kwalapho lapho okwavela khona ukuthi nelakhe ikhanda liyafuneka, zase ziyenzeka ke izigameko lapho edutshulwa khona.Uthe isimo saba sibi ngendlela yokuthi kwase kudutshulwa ngisho nabantu ababengahlangene nodungunyane."Kwase kudutshulwa nanoma ngubani, uma ebonakele ukuthi uzwana nathi,” usho kanje. Enza isibonelo, uthe bathola ngamakhamera ukuthi ngesikhathi eqeda kudutshulwa eSouth beach, abasolwa ababaleka, babelindwe enye imoto bude buduze, okuthe uma ibhekwa, kwavela ukuthi abanikazi abakulolu hlangothi olubahlaselayo."Engifuna ukukubona kwenzeka ngaleli cala ubulungiswa ngoba kade ngiqalile ngidutshulwa ngenhlanhla abaphumeleli ukungibulala. Ngifuna leli cala liqulwe lize liyofika ekugcineni, ngithole ubulungiswa,” usho kanje.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uqinisekise izigameko ezimbili kulezi ezintathu ezibalwe umgilwa. Ummangalewa wayecela ukuthi uninakhulu kamgilwa ameboleke yena ayomsiza ngemisebenzi yasendlini nokulapho amdlwengula khona. Uninakhulu kamgilwa wayemvumela ukuthi ayolekelela ehambe nezinye izingane ezimbili ezingomzala bakhe umgilwa.Ummangalelwa wayethuma izingane ezimbili phandle noma athi aziyokha izithelo bese esala nomgilwa emdlwengula. UMENGAMELI Cyril Ramaphosa noNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa omisiwe, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, bathi igagamelile iMK ngokufaka icala lapho ifuna ukuthi kuxoshwe uMchunu, iphinde iphonsele inselelo ukumenyezelwa kozobamba kwesikaMchunu, uSolwazi Firoz Cachalia.URamaphosa noMchunu bathe iMK kufanele ilinde kuze kuphothulwe umsebenzi wekhomishini ezophenya izinsolo ezibhekene noMchunu ngaphambi kokuthi yenze ikhwelo lokuthi akaxoshwe.Bakusho lokhu ngesikhathi kuqulwa icala elifakwe yiMK eNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo.Ummeli womholi weMK, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, u-Advocate Dali Mpofu, uthe uRamaphosa kanawo amandla okumisa ungqongqoshe esikhundleni.UMpofu uthe umthetho uvumela uRamaphosa ukuba aqoke noma axoshe ungqongqoshe, wathi akukho emthethweni ukunikwa kukaMchunu ikhefu elikhethekile."Into obekufanele uRamaphosa ayenze wukuxosha uMchunu."UMpofu uthe umthetho awumvumeli uRamaphosa ukuba aqoke umuntu ongesilona ilungu lePhalamende ukuba abambe isikhundla sikangqongqoshe.UCachalia akasilona ilungu lePhalamende.Ummeli kaRamaphosa, u-Advocate Ngwako Maenetje, uthe uRamaphosa akakwazi ukuvele axoshe uMchunu zingakaphenywa izinsolo ezenziwa wuKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi."Njengoba sibona lapha emaphepheni asenkantolo ukuthi ungqongqoshe uyaziphika izinsolo abhekene nazo, umengameli akakwazi-ke ukumxosha kuze kuba kuphenywa ngezinsolo. Yingakho umengameli enqume ukunikeza ungqongqoshe ikhefu elikhethekile kuze kuphothulwe uphenyo."UMaenetje uthe besingekho isidingo sokuba iMK izame ukuzovimba ukuqokwa kukaCachalia ngoba vele akakaqokwa.UMaenetje uthe uRamaphosa wagcina ngokwenza isimemezelo sokuthi uzoqoka uCachalia, wathi uzoqale aqokwe ukuba abe wungqongqoshe ngaphambi kokuthi aqokelwe ukuba abambe isikhundla sikangqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa. Omunye ummeli kaRamaphosa, u-Advocate Kate Hofmeyr, uthe iMK ithathe ngamawala ngokufaka icala eNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo.U-Advocate Hofmeyr uthe iMK bekufanele ifake icala eNkantolo eNkulu.Ummeli kaMchunu, u-Advocate Griffiths Madonsela, uthe uRamaphosa ngabe uqala umkhuba omubi uma engavele axoshe ungqongqoshe ngaphandle kokumnikeza ithuba lokuziphendulela."Emva kwezinsolo zikaMkhwanazi iMK yavele yalola imikhonto. Yayimemeza ithi akabethelwe uMchunu. Ayifunanga ngisho nokumnika ithuba lokuziphendulela. Ayifunanga ngisho nokulinda umengameli ukuba aphendule."UMadonsela uthe isigaba 98 somthetho sinikeza uRamaphosa igunya lokuba aqoke ungqongqoshe ozobamba uma kuwukuthi kukhona ungqongqoshe othathe ikhefu.Inkantolo isigodlile isinqumo.
Omunye wabasolwa abebefunelwa icala lokuzama ukubulala udutshulwe wafa kwathi ababili balimala ngesikhathi bedubulana namaphoyisa KwaDabeka ngoLwesithathu ntambama. NgoLwesibili, ngomhla ka-29 kuJulayi 2025, amaphoyisa amabili ayesemsebenzini eshayela emgwaqeni u-Danisa endaweni yakwa-Bester ngesikhathi edutshulwa abasolwa abayishumi. Ngesikhathi kwenzeka lesi sigameko amaphoyisa akwazile ukubuyisela inhlamvu abasolwa babaleka. Womabili amaphoyisa athole imihuzukwana aphuthunyiswa esibhedlela ukuze athole ukwelashwa. Ukuthungathwa kwabasolwa kuqale ngokushesha kwathi ngoLwesithathu amaphoyisa aqoqa ulwazi mayelana nokuthi bakuphi abasolwa. Uphenyo luholele amaphoyisa ehostela laKwaDabeka eKK lapho bekucashe khona abasolwa abane. Ngesikhathi amaphoyisa esondela egunjini abebecashe kulo abasolwa, abasolwa baqale badubula bebhekise emaphoyiseni kwase kuba nokudubulana. Umsolwa oyedwa udutshulwe wafa ngesikhathi sokudubulana. Abasolwa abathathu baphume ngamawindi, ababili babo batholwe ngaphandle benamanxeba okudutshulwa, baphuthunyiswa esibhedlela begadwe ngamaphoyisa. Alikho iphoyisa elilimale ngesikhathi sokudubulana. Abasolwa abaphinde bayamataniswa nesinye isigameko sokubulala eNanda, batholwe nesibhamu nezinhlamvu ezingu-93. Olunye uphenyo lwamaphoyisa luholele ekutheni kutholwe ezinye izibhamu ezintathu. Abasolwa ababoshiwe bazovela enkantolo uma sebeluleme. Kusaqhubeka ukuthungathwa kwabasolwa abengeziwe.
UZWAKALISE enkulu injabulo umndeni kathisha owabulawa ngesihluku ngo-2022 eMalvern, eThekwini, kuboshwa umyeni wakhe ngaleli cala. Umsolwa onguthishanhloko, uMnuz Khayelihle Dhlomo (53), ubevele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini izolo, kulandela ukuboshwa kwakhe ngaleli cala eLindelani, ngaKwaMashu, ngeSonto. Ngosuku lwesigameko okuthiwa senzeka ngoSepthemba 2022, umufi, uNkk Khanyisile Dhlomo (48) watholwa enamanxeba okugwazwa egcekeni lomuzi wakhe. Kuthiwa wonke amanxeba ayekwesingenhla. Kuthiwa ngaleso sikhathi umsolwa watshela amaphoyisa ukuthi umufi uzibulele ngoba ubewumuntu obenokhwantalala. Isihlobo sikamufi esicele ukungadalulwa sithe simfuna evalelwe ngaphakathi umsolwa, angadedelwa. "Akavalelwe angaphinde aphume," kusho isihlobo. Sithe kubaphathe kabi ukuthi kuthathe isikhathi eside ukuthi umsolwa akhalelwe amasongo kaSigonyela. "Sesijabule manje njengoba umthetho ususebenza," kusho isihlobo. Siqhube sathi babenazo izinsolo zokuthi kukhona okushaya amanzi ngokufa kukaNkk Dhlomo. "Akugqekezwanga phela emzini wakhe kodwa yena sambona esedindilizile ngaphandle kwendlu," kusho isihlobo.Ngaphakathi enkantolo bekukhona idlanzana lezihlobo elivela ohlangothini lwalapho kuzalwa khona uNkk Dhlomo, kwaNduli, bese kuba khona nebebezokweseka umsolwa. Ebebezokweseka umsolwa okuthe uma izintatheli zicela ukuphawula kwabo, bala baphetha, bathi bangabangani, abawona umndeni.Kulaba ebebeze ngomufi, bekukhona abambalwa ebebephethe amapheshana amancane amhlophe abebhalwe ukuthi akangadedelwa ngebheyili.Kubona kukhona abavele banxapha ngesikhathi uMshushisi woMbuso, uMnuz Calvin Govender efunda umbhalo wokuthi uDhlomo usolwa ngecala lokubulala mufi ngokumgwaza.UGovender ube eseveza ukuthi bazosiphikisa isicelo sebheyili, waphakamisa nokuthi icala lihlehliselwe uLwesibili oluzayo ukuze kuqhutshekwe nolunye uphenyo.Phakathi kwalo, kukhona nemininingwane yezingane zikamufi, okukhona kuzo eneminyaka engu-16 neneminyaka engu-19.Ummeli kamsolwa, uMnuz Nkululeko Zungu uphakamise ukuthi icala lihlehliselwe uLwesihlanu lwalo leli sonto.Uzwakalise ukuthi ikhasimende lakhe selinesikhathi litokile, lingaveli enkantolo njengoba laboshwa entathakusa ngeSonto.UGovender ube eseveza ukuthi uma kwenzeka lokho kuzoba seduze kakhulu ukuthi umphenyi angabe eseqedile ngophenyo lwakhe.IMantshi, uMnuz Scelo Zuma, ilihlehlisele uLwesibili icala ukuze umsolwa afake isicelo sebheyili nokuthi kuqhutshekwe nophenyo.Umsolwa kuthiwe uzogcinwa esitokisini sesiteshi samaphoyisa eDurban North. Icala liqale laba nobuhixihixi, kuphele inqwaba yamahora kungaqondakali ukuthi lizongena nini njengoba bekulokhu kuvela ukuthi idokodo nomsolwa akukafiki enkantolo.Inkantolo ize yawaqeda wonke amanye amacala ebihlele ukuthi ahlale. Ligcine lingena emizuzwini engu-15 ebisisele ukuthi kuvalwe inkantolo ngo-4 ntambama.
USEQASHE inkampani ezimele ezovikela isithunzi sakhe uMphathiswa wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal osolwa enkohlakalweni, uNksz Nomagugu Simelane. UNksz Simelane uqashe inkampani iPR Worx ukuba ilungise isithunzi sakhe.AbePR Worx bakhiphe isitatimende sabezindaba lapho bechitha khona izinsolo ezibhekene noNksz Simelane. Kulesi sitatimende uNksz Simelane uphinde wagxeka ukuvinjwa kwabantu bokufika abakuleli ngokungemthetho ezikhungweni zezempilo. UNksz Simelane usematheni kulezi zinsuku ngezinsolo zenkohlakalo. Kunezikhalazo mayelana noxhaso olwathola inkampani yomndeni wakhe eMnyangweni wezoLimo kanye nangemali eyabolekwa yile nkampani ebhange Ithala.Kuphinde kube nezikhalazo ngokugixabezwa ngezikhundla eziphezulu kwamalungu omndeni kaNksz Simelane eminyangweni kahulumeni. UNksz Simelane uphinde asolwe ngokuba nesandla ekuxoshweni komsakazi weVuma FM, uJacinta Ngobese-Zuma.Zonke lezi zinsolo uziphikile uNksz Simelane.
KUBOSHWE nenkosi ecaleni lokubulawa kowayeyikhansela le-DA kuMasipala waseMngeni, uMnuz Nhlalayenza Ndlovu. Le nkosi eneminyaka engu-56, iboshwe yithimba eliphenya amacala okubulawa kosopolitiki KwaZulu-Natal, izolo. Le nkosi, igama layo elingeke lidalulwe kuze kuba ivela enkantolo, iboshwe kanye nomunye umsolwa oneminyaka engu-26.UNdlovu, owayenguSotswebhu omkhulu emkhandlwini, wadutshulwa wafa phambi komndeni wakhe ngo-2023.Okhulumela amaphoyisa kuzwelonke, uBrigadier Athlenda Mathe, uthe laba basolwa ababili baba ingxenye yokuhlelwa kwetulo lokusoconga uNdlovu."Laba basolwa bazovela eNkantolo yeMantshi eHowick, ngoLwesine (namhlanje). Bazobhekana namacala okuhlela ukubulala, elokubulala nelokutholaka nesibhamu nezinhlamvu ezingekho emthethweni."UBrigadier Mathe uthe umsolwa oboshwe nenkosi walihlela esejele itulo lokusoconga uNdlovu. UNdlovu kukholakala ukuthi wabulawelwa ukulwa nokuntshwa kwempahla kagesi yomkhandlu waseMngeni.Le mpahla kagesi okukhona kuyo nama-transformer okuthiwa yayintshontshwa kwamasipala bese iyodayiselwa amalungu omphakathi anenkinga kagesi.Ukuboshwa kwabasolwa ababili kusho ukuthi sebebane abasolwa ababhekene necala lokubulala uNdlovu.Abasolwa abasezikhindini ngaleli cala yiNduna yakwaNxamalala, uZwelithini Buthelezi noMnuz Thobane Masobho Hlongwa, owaboshwa kuqala.UBrigadier Mathe uthe inkosi nomsolwa eboshwe naye bazojoyina laba abanye abasolwa ababoshwa kuqala.Umholi we-DA KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Francios Rodgers, ukushayele ihlombe ukuboshwa kwabasolwa.URodgers uthe bazokube bephume ngobuningi babo enkantolo ukuyokweseka umndeni kaNdlovu."Sinxusa amaphoyisa kanye nenhlangano yezokushushisa (iNational Prosecuting Authority) ukuba baqinisekise ukuthi leli cala liqulwa ngokushesha. Sifuna ukuthi abantu abathinteka kuleli cala bathole isigwebo esibafanele."Amalungu e-DA avamise ukubhikisha ngaphandle kwenkantolo uma kuvele abasolwa kuleli cala.
ABAFUNDI bakwesinye sezikole zamabanga aphezulu esiseNanda, enyakatho yeTheku - Ohlange High, bakhuthazwe ukuthi banamathele emfundweni ukuze bacabe indlela yekusasa eliqhakazile okuzosiza ukwenza umehluko emphakathini owakhele ilokishi.Lokho kwenzeke emcimbini obukulesi sikole ngoLwesibili ngenkathi iHollywood Foundation ivula kabusha amagumbi, okuthathe cishe iminyaka emibili ukuwalungisa kabusha, kubalwa ukushintsha ifenisha, wukulungisa ingaphandle nengaphakathi lawo, kwalungiswa nohlelo lokuphakela ngamanzi - okuzokwenza ukuthi aphume nsuku zonke noma ngabe anenkinga endaweni, konke okudle imali ebalelwa ku-R2.2 million.Omunye wabaholi beHollywood Foundation, uMnuz Mpho Dintwa, uthe enye yezinto ezenze babona kumqoka ukuthi baxhase lesi sikole, enqwabeni yezikole ezibathintayo zicela ukusizwa ngezizathu ezahlukene, wukuthi singesinye sezikole ezindala zaselokishini futhi esinothe ngomlando omqoka kakhulu odweba isithombe salapho izwe livela khona. "Inhloso yethu ngalo msebenzi wukuqinisekisa ukuthi umlando walesi sikole awushabalali, nokuthi siqinisekise ukuthi abafundi abafunda kusona abakhali ngabakudingayo uma befunda esikholwa wukuthi kuzobakhuthaza ukuqinisa emfundweni yabo, bakwazi ukuphumelela bese beqhubeka beba wusizo emphakathini abawakhele. Nabo siyabanxusa ukuthi lo msebenzi esiwenzele bona bangawucekeli phansi, kepha baqikelele ukuthi konke kuhlale kusesimeni esihle ukuze kusize nabafundi besizukulwane esizayo,” usho kanje. Uthishanhloko wakulesi sikole, esinothisa abawu-49 nabafundi abawu-1 442 - okuhlanganisa abawu-200 abahlala ngaphakathi esikoleni, uMnuz Siyanda Nxumalo, uthe kubajabulise kakhulu ukuthi kube nomsebenzi omuhle kangaka owenziwa kulesi sikole esesineminyaka ewu-127 okwenza babe nethemba lokuthi umlando waso omkhulu awusoze washabalala njengoba sakhiwa ngumsunguli weqembu lezepolitiliki i-African National Congress, uDkt John Langalibalele Dube, ongasekho emhlabeni. "Kuyasikhuthaza ukubona izinhlaka ezizimele zibamba iqhaza ukuphucula izikole zethu ikakhulu ngoba siyazi ukuthi uMnyango wezeMfundo ubuye ungabi nawo amandla okuthi kwenzeke ezinye izinto esizifisayo ukuthuthukisa izinga lokufunda ezikoleni,” kusho uNxumalo. Omunye wesizukulwane sikaDkt Dube, uMnuz Zweli Dube weJohn L. Dube Foundation, naye uzibongele kakhulu ngomsebenzi osuwenziwe, wathi ubona uzoba wusizo kakhulu lokuthi igama likakhokho wakhe nayekushisekela ngemfundo kume njalo, kungashabalali.
LIHLEHLISELWE uMsombuluko ozayo icala lephoyisa likaMasipala weTheku, elisolwa ngokugwaza libulale umkalo obengummeli ngoLwesihlanu, kuvela ukuthi liselashwa esibhedlela.Lokhu kuvele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini izolo. Umsolwa uSenior Constable Qiniso Thulasizwe Sishi (41) usolwa ngecala lokugwaza abulale u-Advocate Thandokuhle Mkhize (48) emzini wabo oseMontclair, eThekwini. Umufi kuthiwa washonela endaweni yesigameko, kwathi uSishi waphuthunyiswa esibhedlela emva kokuzama ukuzibulala ngokuzisika imithambo yegazi ezihlakaleni.Ngesikhathi lihlala leli cala enkantolo izolo, umenyeziwe uSishi kodwa lutho ukusabela. UMshushisi woMbuso, uMnuz Calvin Govender, ube eseveza ukuthi isizathu sokuthi angezi enkantolo wukuthi usalaliswe esibhedlela. "Sithole umbiko wokuthi usalaliswe esibhedlela lapho alashwa khona,” kusho uGovender. Imantshi, uMnuz Scelo Zuma, ibe isinquma ukuthi icala lihlehliselwe uMsombuluko ukuze umsolwa avele siqu sakhe enkantolo. UGovender uveze ukuthi umsolwa likhona elinye icala lokubulala owesifazane alihambayo, kodwa wangenaba ngalo. Akekho ofikile ezokwethamela icala ezihlotsheni zikamufi kanjalo nakwezikamsolwa. Engxoxweni yeSolezwe nodadewabo kamufi, uNksz Khumbuzile Mkhize ngeSonto, uveze ukuthi umsolwa wahlasela umufi eselele, emva kokuba bobabili sebebuye ezindaweni zobumnandi.Uthe umufi wayekade ezikhiphe naye nabanye abangani beye ezindaweni zokudlela ezisenkabeni yeTheku eMtateni, ngesikhathi umsolwa eye kweyaseMlaza nabakhe abangani.Kuthiwa umufi, owayekade ehanjiswe uye umsolwa eMtateni ngezikhathi zasemini, walandwa esinye isihlobo, samgodukisa. Kuvela ukuthi umsolwa owafika ekhaya kamumva, waqala ingxabano engatheni nomufi, wezwakala esememeza ecela usizo, nokuthiwa yingaleso sikhathi ayesemgwaza ngaso.Izihlobo okuthiwa zazisegcekeni zazama ukuvula umnyango wekamelo labo kodwa zathola uvaliwe, kwaze kwabizwa ezinye izihlobo nabangani, abafika bawubhodloza umnyango.Kuthiwa umsolwa owayegxamalazele isidumbu, wayala ukhasha kwabebezama ukusondela, ebasabisa ngokuthi nabo uzobagwaza. Kuvela ukuthi wagcina ezisika ezihlakaleni, ezama ukuzibulala kodwa amaphoyisa ayesebiziwe amnqoba esezikhiyele egumbini lokugeza, ethi uzicwilisa kubhavu wokugeza.Umsolwa kuthiwa usesebenze iminyaka engaphezu kuka-20 emaphoyiseni kaMasipala weTheku, kuthi umufi abe wummeli ozimele weminyaka.Kuthiwa bashade ngo-2022.
USHAYE iMK ngezinduku zayo uMphathiswa wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal, uNksz Nomagugu Simelane, wasola amalungu aleli qembu ngokuzitamuzela kumathenda kahulumeni.UNksz Simelane unxuse ukuba kuphenywe amalungu eMK athe ahlomula kumathenda kahulumeni okubalwa kuwo neyokuphakela izikole.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi echitha izinsolo zeMK zokuthi umndeni nezihlobo zakhe bathola amathenda ezigidi zamarandi. I-MK yenqabile ukweseka isabelomali somnyango kaNksz Simelane sika-R56 billion, yathi umnyango uphethwe wumuntu onesandla esingesihle ngasekuphatheni imali yomphakathi.Ilungu leMK, uNksz Ntombikayise Gasa, lithe kunezinsolo zokuthi umndeni nezihlobo zikaNksz Simelane bathola amathenda eminyangweni kahulumeni."Nithi asimthembe kanjani ukuthi uzoyiphatha ngendlela imali enikezwe umnyango? Kusobala ukuthi lo mphathiswa umatasa nezinye izinto eziseceleni. Umnyango kufanele uholwe wumuntu okhathalela abantu. Sifuna kuphenywe onke amathenda akhishwe wumnyango."UNksz Simelane uthe akanankinga nokuba kuphenywe amathenda akhishwe wumnyango."Nginxusa undunankulu, uMnyango wezeziMali noMcwaningi Mabhuku ukuba baphenye wonke amathenda akhishwe wumnyango. Nginxusa labo abenza lezi zinsolo ukuba babhalele undunankulu kanye nezinye izinhlaka ukuze kuphenywe. Lokhu ngikusho ngokukhululeka ngoba ngiyazi ukuthi akukho engikufihlayo."UNksz Simelane uthe naye ufuna ukuba kuphenywe amalungu eMK athola amathenda eminyangweni kahulumeni.UNksz Simelane uthe kunenqwaba yezinkampani zamalungu eMK ezithola amathenda ezigidi zamarandi eminyangweni kahulumeni."Ngazi ngisho amagama alezi zinkampani. Njengoba sikhuluma nje manje lezi zinkampani zinamathenda eminyangweni kahulumeni. Ezinye zihlomule ngisho ohlelweni lokuphakelwa kwezikole. Konke lokhu kufanele kuphenywe."UNksz Simelane uthe ufuna nokuthi kuphenywe amanye amalungu eMK athola izikhundla eminyangweni kahulumeni ekubeni engenazo iziqu ezifanele."Laba bantu kufanele baphenywe, bese bebuyisa imali abayihola ngoba kusobala ukuthi kwakungafanele bayithole ngoba kabanazo iziqu zemisebenzi ababeyiqashelwe."Ilungu le-ANC, uNksz Hlengiwe Mavimbela, limvikele uNksz Simelane, wathi izinsolo zeMK ezibhekise kuNksz Simelane azinabufakazi."Ngeke sivume ukuba kungcoliswe igama likamphathiswa. Ngeke sihambe silalela yonke inhlebo ekhulunywa emakhoneni. Yebo, asihambisani nenkohlakalo kepha kufanele kuthathwe izinyathelo uma kukhona lapho okungalandelwanga khona umthetho. Kodwa esikunqabayo wukuthi kungcoliswe amagama abantu."
AMAQEMBU aphikisayo esiShayamthetho KwaZulu-Natal atinyele uMphathiswa wezeMfundo, uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka, emsola enkohlakalweni yokuqokwa kwezinkampani ezizohlomula ethendeni lokuphakelwa kwezikole.I-MK ne-EFF basola uHlomuka ngokuba wumagaya azidlele njengoba kunezinsolo zokuthi kuhlomule ngisho inkampani eyasungulwa nguye kulolu hlelo lwezigidi zamarandi.Bakusho lokhu ngesikhathi bekhuluma esiShayamthetho, kulandela ukwethulwa kwesabelomali somnyango esingu-R66 billion.Ilungu leMK, uMnuz Lucky Hadebe, lithe izinsolo zokuthi kuhlomule nenkampani eyasungulwa wuHlomuka zikhombisa ukuthi uHlomuka ungugombela kwesakhe."Niyazenzela ngamathenda, nidla nize nidle neyokudla kwezingane? Kwenzekani ngempela? Kunezinsolo zokuthi nawe Mphathiswa uhlomulile. UHlomuka uzingela ephethe itswayi. UHlomuka udla lapho eboshelwe khona. Mphathiswa uhola emali engaphezu kuka-R2 million ngonyaka. Ngenyanga uhola u-R 148 000. Ngiyazibuza ukuthi le mali ayikwenelisi?"UHadebe uthe uHlomuka kufanele ashenxe esikhundleni."Kanti usebenza kanjani lo mthetho we-ANC othi abaholi abasolwa enkohlakalweni kufanele bashenxe ezikhundleni?"Ilungu le-EFF, uNksz Thobisile Nkosi, lithe uNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, kufanele alusukumele ngokushesha lolu daba."Sithi asidlulise ilaka kundunankulu obonakala ezithela ngabandayo ekuphenyeni uHlomuka osolwa ngenkohlakalo emayelana nethenda yokuphakelwa kwezikole."UNksz Nkosi uthe nabo bafuna ukuthi uHlomuka ashenxe esikhundleni."Siyazi ukuthi icala wumphikwa kodwa bekungakuhle ukuba umphathiswa ashenxe esikhundleni kuze kuphothulwe uphenyo." Amaqembu abusa ngokubambisana athe ayakweseka ukuthi izinsolo ezibhekene noHlomuka ziphenywe.La maqembu axwayise ngokuthi sekukhona amaqembu asesebenzisa le zinsolo ukufeza izinhloso ezithile.Ilungu le-IFP, uMnuz Mncedisi Maphisa, lithe kuyabajabulisa ukuthi uHlomuka avume ukuzochaza ngalezi zinsolo.Ilungu leDA, uMnuz Sakhile Mngadi, lithe bathatha ngamawala labo abathi uHlomuka akehle esikhundleni."Asikafiki lapho. Okwamanje kusafanele kuphenywe. Sinethemba lokuthi uphenyo luzopequlula konke. Kubalulekile ukuthi luphenyisiswe lolu daba njengoba le zinsolo zenza ukuthi abantu bangawuthembi uhulumeni."Yebo siyavuma ukuthi izinsolo kusafanele ziphenywe kodwa asikwazi ukuziziba. Umthetho awuvumi ukuba osopolitiki nezikhulu basebenzise amandla abo ukuzicebisa. Uma kutholakala ukuthi ngempela kukhona lapho okwaphulwa khona imigomo, kufanele kuthathwe izinyathelo ezifanele."UHlomuka uthe umnyango uyaziphenya izinsolo ezenziwe."Sizizwile izikhalo zabantu ngalolu hlelo. Siyazisukumela izikhalo. Inhloko yomnyango iyazibheka le zikhalo. Sithanda ukuqinisekisa abantu ukuthi ngeke luphazamiseke uhlelo lokuphakelwa kwezikole. Izinkampani ebezikade ziphakela izikole zizoqhubeka nokwenza umsebenzi kuze kuba siqeda uhlelo lokuqokwa kwezinkampani ezintsha. Akekho umuntu ozoya kophazamisa uhlelo lokuphakelwa kwezikole. Labo abanezikhalo abaxhumane noMnyango wezeZimali."
Uphenyo olunzulu lwabaseshi bamaphoyisa aKwaDukuza, besebenzisana nonogada abazimele, seluholele ekuboshweni komyeni wowesifazane owatholwa eshonile emotweni KwaDukuza ngomhla zingama-27 Juni 2025. Uphenyo lwamaphoyisa luphinde lwaxhumanisa umsolwa wesibili kuleli cala kanti naye walandelwa wagcina eboshwa. Abasolwa ababili baboshwe ngoLwesithathu, mhla ka-30 kuJulayi 2025. ngosuku lwesehlo, owesifazane oneminyaka engu-31 ubudala watholwa edindilizile emotweni Zinkwazi Link Road KwaDukuza, enamanxeba okudutshulwa ekhanda. Umufi uhlonzwe njengoNokulunga Happiness Mashabane obesebenza kuMasipala waKwaDukuza. Ithimba labaphenyi laKwaDukuza labe seliqhuba uphenyo okugcine ngokuthi kuboshwe abasolwa ababili. Abasolwa ababili, abaneminyaka engu-32 no-26 ubudala ngokwehlukana kwabo, bazovela eNkantolo yeMantshi yaKwaDukuza ngoLwesihlanu, lu-1 Agasti 2025.

USEBENZISE imali engu-R53 million uMasipala waseMzinyathi ngenhloso yokushintsha ipayipi elidala lamanzi eliphakela imizi yaseNquthu elinganiselwa ku-17 500.Lokhu kuqinisekiswe yiMeya yaseMzinyathi, uNkk Thembisile Mchunu. UMENGAMELI, uCyril Ramaphosa, ubona izinhlangano ezalwela inkululeko emazweni ase-Afrika zizoqhubeka nokudonsa ngodizili njengoba kwanda isibalo sentsha evotayo.URamaphosa uthe intsha ayinendaba nomlando weqembu emzabalazweni wenkululeko uma ikhetha umuntu ezomvotela, wathi intsha ivotela iqembu elibona lizothuthukisa impilo yayo.Ukusho lokhu ekhuluma emhlanganweni wezinhlangano ezalwela inkululeko emazweni, iNingizimu Afrika, Zimbabwe, Mozambique neNamibia.Izinhlangano ezalwela inkululeko kula mazwe zehlelwa ukwesekwa okhethweni.Lapha eNingizimu Afrika i-ANC yahluleka ukuthola amavoti anele ukuba ibuse ngokuzimela njengoba isibusa ngokubambisana namaqembu awu-10. URamaphosa othe okwenza ukuthi intsha ihambele kude namaqembu ayelwela inkululeko ukuthi azikafezwa izethembiso ezenziwa ngesikhathi somzabalazo."Intsha ayinandaba nokuthi yini esayenza ngesikhathi silwela inkululeko kodwa ekubhekayo amaphutha esiwenzayo njengamanje. Intsha ibona sengathi izinhlangano ezalwela inkululeko ziqhelile kuyona. Ibona sengathi la maqembu asadlala ngoludala."Lesi yisizukulwane esifuna amathuba emisebenzi, amathuba omnotho, izindlu, imfundo kanye nokuphila impilo engcono. Intsha yanamhlanje ayenelisekile ngekubonayo futhi ifuna amathuba angcono."URamaphosa uthe izinhlangano ezalwela inkululeko ziya ngokuphunyukwa amandla emazweni ahlukene.Ukhale ngezimpi zangaphakathi ezinhlanganweni ezalwela inkululeko nokugxambukela kamazwe aseNtshonalanga ezindabeni zasemazweni ase-Afrika.Uthe amazwe aseNtshonalanga asebenzisa izikhalo zabantu ukuba achithe ohulumeni abaphethwe yizinhlangano ezalwela inkululeko."Yebo zikhona izikhalo zabantu ezizwakalayo kodwa ngeke sikubalekele ukuthi amazwe aseNtshonalanga nawo abuye abhebhezele umlilo. Amazwe aseNtshonalanga ayagxambukela ezindabeni zasemazweni ase-Afrika. Ukungajabuli kwabantu kwenza kube lula ukuba amazwe angaphandle agxambukele ezindabeni zase-Afrika."URamaphosa uthe amazwe aseNtshonalanga alwa kakhulu namazwe ase-Afrika ashaya imithetho ehlose ukuthuthukisa abantu ababencishwe amathuba ngaphambilini.URamaphosa ukhuluma kanjena nje, iMelika iyaqhubeka nokuqinisa isandla kwiNingizimu Afrika emva kokushaywa komthetho wokubuyiswa komhlaba.Uqhube ngokuthi abaholi basemazweni ase-Afrika akufanele bavumele ukushayelwa umthetho ngamazwe aseNtshonalanga."Singamazwe azimele. Akufanele sitshelwe amanye amazwe ukuthi sishaye miphi imithetho."Uphethe ngokunxusa abaholi basemazweni ase-Afrika ukuba balwele ukuthuthukisa amazwe abo."I-Afrika inothile kakhulu. Kuningi okumbiwa phansi okutholakala lapha e-Afrika. Sekufanele siyeke ukuthumela okumbiwayo ukuba kuyokwakha ubucwebe emazweni aphesheya, kufanele sizakhele thina ubucwebe."
LINGASE lithathe osemnyango limbeke emsamo uma sekuqokwa ubuholi obusha bukaMasipala waKwaDukuza njengoba owaxoshwa kwesobumeya kulo mkhandlu, uNksz Lindile Nhaca, esethubeni lokukhuza ibuya. Igama likaNksz Nhaca livela ohlwini lwamagama amathathu i-ANC ezoqoka kuwona ozoba yimeya yomkhandlu. Ubuholi obusha bomkhandlu buzoqokwa emhlanganweni ozoba ngoLwesine.Isikhala sobumeya kuMasipala waKwaDukuza sivuleke emva kokuxoshwa kwemeya, uMnuz Ali Ngidi.UNgidi wangena kulesi sikhundla ngonyaka odlule kulandela ukukhonjwa indlela kukaNksz Nhaca.UNgidi, nephini lemeya, uMnuz Njabulo Cele, bayalelwa ukuba basule ezikhundleni ngasekuqaleni kwale nyanga.UNgidi noCele badilizwa ezikhundleni emva kombiko wokuthi umasipala wasebenzisa imali eshisiwe ubaqashela izimoto ekubeni umhlangano womkhandlu ungakaze ugunyaze ukuthi baqashelwe izimoto.Kwakuphinde kube nombiko oveza ukuthi umasipala ubukhokha u-R170 000 njalo ngenyanga wokuba kugadwe uNgidi nomuzi wakhe.Uhlu lwamagama okuzokhethwa kuwona luqinisekiswe wumgqugquzeli wethimba lesikhashana elihola i-ANC esifundeni iGeneral Gizenga Mpanza, uMnuz Nkosenhle Mngadi.Ekhuluma ne-IOL uMngadi uthe babe nomhlangano wekomiti elibhekelele ukusebenza kwansuku zonke kwi-ANC esifundeni, lapho beqoke khona amagama amathathu okuzokhethwa kuwo."La magama athunyelwe ebuholini be-ANC esifundazweni, okuyibo obuzothatha isinqumo sokugcina."Okhulumela i-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Fanle Sibisi, akazange ayiphendule imibuzo ayithunyelwe.Ubuholi be-ANC esifundeni iGeneral Gizenga Mpanza buphakamise igama likaNksz Nhaca, elikasomlomo, uNkk Dolly Govender, nelalowo owayeyimeya kaMasipala wesifunda Ilembe, uMnuz Siduduzo Gumede, ukuba kukhethwe kuwo ozoba yimeya.Amaqembu aphikisayo athe ukungaqokwa ngokushesha kwemeya kwenza ukuthi izinto zibe mapeketwane emkhandlwini.I-DA ne-ActionSA bakhale ngokuthi ayisahlali imihlangano yekomiti elibhekelele ukusebenza kwemali emkhandlwini.UNgidi uyena obengusihlalo wekomiti ngesikhathi ephethe isikhundla sobumeya.Womabili la maqembu acele uMphathiswa wokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, ukuba angenelele.Ohola iDA emkhandlwini, uNksz Privi Makhan, uthe imihlangano yekomiti neyesigungu esiphezulu ihlezi ihoxiswa ngaphandle kwencazelo."Lokhu kuphazamisa ukusebenza komkhandlu. Sinxusa uButhelezi ukuba angenelele ngokushesha."Ikhansela le-ActionSA, uMnuz Halalisani Ndlovu, lithe umhlangano wokugcina wekomiti wawungasekuqaleni kukaJuni."Umhlangano olandelayo kuhlelwe ukuthi ube ngo-Agasti 20. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kuzophela izinyanga ezine ikomiti lingakaze lihlangane."
UKUVELE ushayeke phansi nje esikhaleni kungonakele lutho akuyona nje into engatheni futhi akumele ukushaye indiva, ikakhulu ebantiwni asebekhulile. Lokho kufakazelwe wucwaningo lwenhlangano yezempilo emhlabeni iWorld Health Organization lokuthi lesi simo sisendaweni yesibili ezimweni zokuzilamaza eziholela ekufeni, ikakhulu ebantwini abaneminyaka ewu-60 kuya phezulu, okuvele ukuthi yibona abasengozini kakhulu.Isikhulu esiphezulu senhlangano yezempilo esizimele i-Affinity Health, uMnuz Murray Hewlett sithe lesi simo singaholela ekutheni lowo esimehlele ahlale esibhedlela isikhathi eside, kwenze ukuthi angakwazi ukuhamba kahle, futhi ungafa nokufa ngenxa yaso."Lesi simo sikwezihamba phambili ezenza ukuthi abantu abadala balimale, futhi singenza nokuthi bangabe besakwazi ukuzimela nokuphila ngendlela abayijwayele. Nokho okuhle wukuthi lezi zigameko ziyagwemeka uma uzinakekela kahle," kusho uHewlett.Kungani abantu abadala besengcupheni enkulu yokuba kulesi simo?- Ukuguga noma ukuhamba kweminyaka kuza nezinguquko emzimbeni ezibandakanya ukuphelelwa ngamandla kwemisipha, ukungakwazi ukuhamba kahle usheshe ngendlela ejwayelekjile, ukungaboni kahle emehlweni nokungezwa kahle ezindlebeni - konke okwandisa amathuba okushayeka phansi noma yinini kungonakele lutho. - Izifo eziyimbelesela njenge-arthritis, isifo sikashukela nesomfutho ophansi wegazi, kanjalo nemishanguzo ethile, nakho kwenza ukuthi kubhebhetheke umonakalo. - Kweminye imizi lokhu kubhebhethekiswa wukuthi phansi akukhonkiwe ngendlela efanele, akukhanyi kahle, wukuba nama-tile ashelelayo nokungabi bikho kwezinto zokubambelela ezindaweni okungaba yingozi ukuhamba kuzona njengasendlini encane noma emastebhisini okunyukela emagunjini aphezulu endlini eyistezi. Ubungozi nomthelela walesi simo emzimbeni womuntu:- Ukulimala emalungeni ahlukene omzimba.- Ukungakwazi ukuma nje ukhululeke isikhathi eside.- Ukulimala okungathikameza umqondo.- Ukulimala okungenza ukuthi ukhubazeke emzimbeni.- Kungenza ukuthi kube lula ukungenwa yizifo ezinjenge-pneumonia noma i-blood clot, okungenzeka kalula uma ungasakwazi ukuhamba kahle.- Abantu abaningi abalinyazwa yilesi simo kuyenzeka ukuthi bangaphinde bakwazi ukuzimela, okungathikameza futhi kuhlukumeze abathandiweyo babo. Izindlela zokusiza ukugwema lesi simo ebantwini asebekhulile:- Qinisekisa ukuthi ekhaya kuphephile ngokususa phansi izinto ezingenza ukuthi kube lula ukuthi umuntu akhubeke, awe phansi, wenze kukhanye kakhulu nangokuphelele endlini.- Bakhuthaze ukuhlale behlolwa amehlo ukusiza ukugwema ukungaboni kahle emehlweni.- Qaphela imishanguzo abayisebenzisayo ngoba eminye ingenza kube lula ukuphathwa yisiyezi. - Bakhuthaze ukuthi bahambe nje, belula izinyawo ukuze bahlale beqaqekile emzimbeni ikakhulu kwesingezansi.- Bakhuthaze ukuphuza amanzi ngendlela efanele neyanele ukuzigcina benamandla nomdlandla.- Gwema ukuthi bahlale bebodwa ukuze bakwazi ukuthola usizo ngokushesha uma kwenzeka behlelwa yisimo esinjena.Nazi izimpawu ezikhomba ukuthi kudingeka usizo lwezempilo:- Uma umuntu ewe phansi washayeka kabi ekhanda.- Uma umuntu ewe wahuzuka, wavuvukala noma wopha.- Uma ekhononda ngobuhlungu emathangeni, emhlane nasekhanda.- Uma bengasakwazi ukuma kahle, ukuzihambela nokunyakaza emva kokuwa phansi.- Uma ubona sengathi badidekile, abaqondi kahle ukuthi kwenzekani nokuthi bakuphi nendawo emva kokuwa.- Ngisho noma ngabe umuntu ubonakala sengathi akanankinga, kodwa kuyasiza ukubonana nabezempilo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi awukho umonakalo nokumcathamelayo.
KUBUYE inhlansi yethemba kumalungu omphakathi waseMhlwaneni kuward 19 eMnambithi ngesikhathi iMeya yakule ndawo uMnuz Zama sibisi ethula ngokusemthethweni usonkontilekla ozolungisa umgwaqo wakule ndawo uMhlawaneni Road.IMeya uSibisi uthe kuyinto eseqhulwini kubona ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imigwaqo yakule ndawo ibonakala isemgangathweni.Uthe yingakho bethathe isinqumo sokuba ilungiswe kabusha imigwaqo emibili uMalva Road noMhlwaneni.Ekhuluma ehlangene nomphakathi eDriefontein Community Hall uSibisi uthe umasipala awuhoyo usembhidlangweni wokuqinisekisa ukuthi iyalungiswa imigwaqo yakule ndawo.Ugcizelele kakhulu ukubaluleka kokulungiswa kwengqalasizinda ekuyamanisa nokwenziwa ngcono kwezimpilo zabantu baseMnambithi.''Siyakholelwa kakhulu ekutheni kumele yenziwe ibe ngcono ingqalasizinda yethu. Lokhu kulekelela kakhulu ngezindlela ezahlukene. Sifuna ukuthi indawo yethu igcine ibalwa nezinye ezinengqalasizinda esemgangathweni,'' usho kanjena. Uthe lo msebenzi wokulungiswa kwemigwaqo usazobonakala usabalala ezingxenyeni ezahlekene zaseMnambithi. ''Sihlose ukuthi sisabalele kuzona zonke izindawo ukuze indawo yaseMnambithi izobonakala isesimweni esifanelekile,'' usho kanjena.Amalungu omphakathi abekede aeyingxenye yokwethulwa kukasonkontileka abonge anconcoza kumasipala ngokusabela kwikhwelo labo.Usonkontileka iSihlahlasiyahluma Construction ugixatshezwe ngomsebenzi wokulungisa uMalva Road kuward 20.Lona kuhlalukile ukuthi kuzoba umsebenzi ka-R6 million kudaleke namathuba omsebenzi angu-14.Usonkontileka uMuntuza Engineering ugixatshezwe ngomsebenzi wokulungiswa uMhlwaneni Road nakhona umsebenzi okuvele ukuthi uzokuba ngowenani lika-R6 million ebese kudaleka amathuba omsebenzi angu-15.UNkk Zandile Vilakazi uthe kubuye ithemba kubina uma kuqinisekiwa eyokulungiswa kwale migwaqo yomibili.
UZweliphansi Stanley Skhosana (55) uvele eNkantolo yeMantshi eMzimkhulu namuhla, ngecala lokubulala kowayenguNobhala-Jikelele we-ANC Youth League uSindiso Jethro Magaqa ngoJulayi 2017 eMzimkhulu.USikhosana uthwese amacala okuhlela ukubulala, ukubulala, ukuphatha isibhamu esingavumelekile, ukuphatha isibhamu ngokungemthetho, ukuphatha izinhhlamvu ngokungemthetho nokuphazamisa ukusebenza komthetho.Icala lihlehlele u-01 Agasti 2025 ukuze kuqokwe ummeli ozokwengamela isicelo sebheyili.
BELIHLALE liyiphindaphinda eyokuthi ngelinye ilanga liyovele limbulale umkalo iphoyisa likaMasipala weTheku okuthiwa ligcine limgwaza ngempela waze washona emzini kamufi oseMontclair, eThekwini, ngoLwesihlanu.Kulesi sigameko kuphangalale uNkk Thando Mkhize-Sishi (48) obewuqweqwe lommeli. Ngokusho kukadadewabo, uNksz Khumbuzile Mkhize, isigameko senzeke ngabo-11:30 ebusuku emva kwengxabano encane esuke ngesikhathi umsolwa efika ebuya ebumnandini. UNksz Mkhize uthe kwenzeka lokhu nje, yena nodadewabo babekade bezikhiphile nabangani, baya endaweni yobumnandi eMtateni, eThekwini."Sihambe ngezikhathi zasemini, sihanjiswa uye umsolwa. Bafika kwami bezongilanda behamba bobabili nengane yami ehlala nabo. Umsolwa wafika wasishiya eMtateni kodwa wakhombisa ukungabi mnandi kahle,” kusho uNksz Mkhize.Uthe umsolwa waze wabuza umufi ukuthi baphi pho abanye abangani bakhe ngoba ubona ababili kuphela, ekubeni ebemtshele ukuthi baningi abangani okuyohlanganwa nabo. "Akazange ayithathele phezulu udadewethu leyo nto. Omunye wabangani bakhe wakuqaphela ukuthi umsolwa akeneme, waze wabuza ukuthi unani namhlanje, wahlina nje,” kulandisa uNksz Mkhize.Uthe bazihlalela kwaze kwaba bafonela indodana yakhe (ebihlala nomufi) ukuthi ayize izobalanda. Uthe cishe bekungo-10 ebusuku befika emizini yabo ngokwehlukana. Udalule ukuthi akutholayo wukuthi udadewabo ngesikhathi efika kwakhe uqaphele ukuthi umsolwa uhambe ngemoto yakhe anezinyanga ezimbili eyithengile. Uthe umfonelile emtshela ukuthi akayibuyise imoto entsha ahambe nganoma iyiphi enye endala, esaba ukuthi uzoyishayisa le entsha. "Kuthiwa ufike emva kuka-11 ebusuku, wafica udadewethu eselele. Asazi ukuthi babangeni ngoba indodakazi (18) kadadewethu efunda u-matric izwe kukhona ukuqophisana ngamazwi okungatheni isegunjini layo lokulala, unina wabe eseyimemeza ekhala,” kusho uNksz Mkhize.Uthe ngesikhathi izama ukuzobheka ukuthi unina ukhalelani, yazithela phezu komnyango wekamelo labo uvaliwe ngaphakathi.Uveze ukuthi yagijima yayovusa umzala wayo endlini engaphandle, babiza nomakhelwane, ngesikhathi kufonelwa nomndeni okukhona kuwo naye uNksz Mkhize. "Sifike khona esavalile ekamelweni labo, kwathi uma kubhodlozwa umnyango, wala ukhasha engafuni muntu ozosondela, esabisa ngokuthi ozoke asondele naye uzomgwaza, esho ewuphethe ummese owawuconsa igazi. Esedindilizile udadewethu,” usho kanje.UNksz Mkhize uthe kukhona lapho umsolwa wake wama phezu kwaso isidumbu ehleka, kwathi esuka wathi naye kungcono azibulale kanye nomkakhe, washo wabe ezisika izihlakala.Uthe amaphoyisa amnqobe esegijime wayozivalela egunjini lokugeza, ezama ukugeza igazi ezahlakaleni. Uthe bekuyinto yemihla ngemihla ukusabisa ngokuthi uzombulala."Ubethi uma esesho njalo, athi kwanathi nomama wethu oshone ezinyangeni ezimbili ezedlule, uyosibulala sonke. Umama wake wamtshela udadewethu ukuthi 'wena lo muntu wakho uyokubulala ngempela ngelinye ilanga',” kukhumbula uNksz Mkhize. Udalule nokuthi sikhona isikhathi lapho umsolwa ake wamkhomba khona ngesibhamu udadewabo kodwa yabuye yadlula leyo. Nokho uveze ukuthi kwenzeka lesi sigameko nje, isibhamu ubese esiphuciwe njengoba kuthiwa uke "wabulala ngaso omunye wesifazane owayehleli nabo nabangani ebumnandini eSouth Beach ngo-2023".Kuthiwa leli cala laphelela emoyeni, umsolwa wake wamiselwa lona emsebenzini, wabuye wabuyiselwa. UNksz Mkhize uthe bafuna ubulungiswa ngodadewabo obulawe njengesilwane. Uthe umsolwa wumuntu oyingozi emphakathini ngakho abafuni adedelwe ngebheyili, ikakhulukazi njengoba eke wasabisa ngokuthi nabo uzobabulala. Umchaze njengomuntu obeshintshashintsha ngoba phambi kwabantu ubekhombisa olukhulu uthando kudadewabo kodwa uma sebebodwa enze okuhlukile. Uveze nokuthi ubebuye akhombise ukungamenameli umufi uma kukhona okuhle azenzela kona. Enkundleni yokuxhumana iFacebook umufi uze wazibiza ngokuthi unguMrs Sishi, kanti ezithombeni zakhe kukhona nalapho afake khona nezomyeni wakhe, bathi uma bephawula abantu bethi "uSibari wethu", aphendule ngokujabula athi: "impela kunjalo".Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant Colonel Paul Magwaza, uthe amaphoyisa abophe owesilisa oneminyaka engu-41 ngecala lokubulala. "Amaphoyisa aphuthume endaweni yesigameko emva kokubikelwa ngesigameko esithinta udlame lwasemndenini eYellowood Park. Ngesikhathi efika, enze uphenyo lwawo, athola owesifazane kwelinye igumbi, enamanxeba okugwazwa,” kusho uMagwaza. Uthe kube sekuboshwa owesilisa ngecala lokubulala.
LIGAYA ngomunye umhlathi kwelokubulawa kowayengunobhala jikelele we-ANC Youth League, uMnuz Sindiso Magaqa, njengoba seziqalile ukubakhalela abasolwa abanindwa inkabi eyavuma icala.Ithimba lamaphoyisa eliphenya amacala okubulawa kosopolitiki libophe owayeyisikhulu kuMasipala waseMzimkhulu.Lesi sikhulu, igama laso elingeke lidalulwe kuze kuba sivela enkantolo, siboshwe izolo, kanti kulindeleke ukuthi sivele eNkantolo yeMantshi, eMzimkhulu, namhlanje.Inkabi eyavuma icala lokubulala uMagaqa, uSibusiso Ncengwa, yachaza isikhulu esiboshiwe njengomunye wobhongoza ecaleni lokubulawa kukaMagaqa.UNcengwa wathi lesi sikhulu kanye nowayeyimeya kaMasipala wesifunda iHarry Gwala, uMnuz Mluleki Ndobe, yibona abakhipha umyalelo wokuba kusocongwe uMagaqa.Akukhona okuqala lesi sikhulu siboshelwa leli cala njengoba sake saboshwa ngo-2018 kanye noNdobe.Icala elibhekene nalo kanye noNdobe labuye lahoxiswa okwesikhashana ngenxa yokushoda kobufakazi.UNdobe watholakala eshonile ngo-2020, kusolakala ukuthi wazidubula.Ngaleso sikhathi uNdobe wayeyiphini likasomlomo wesiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal.Okhulumela amaphoyisa, uBrigadier Athlenda Mathe, uthe umsolwa uboshelwe eThekwini, wabe esedluliselwa eMzimkhulu."Lo msolwa oneminyaka engu-55, wake waboshelwa leli cala ngo-2018. Waboshwa kanye nowayeyimeya, usomabhizinisi, ababili ababengamaphoyisa kanye nenkabi. Umsolwa kulindeleke ukuthi avele eNkantolo yeMantshi eMzimkhulu, ngoLwesibili (namhlanje)."UMagaqa owayeyikhanslela kuMasipala waseMzimkhulu, wabulawa ngo-2017.Kuthiwa wabulawelwa ukukhononda ngenkohlakalo eyayenzeka emkhandlwini.Ngesikhathi evuma icala, uNcengwa wathi isikhulu esiboshiwe noNdobe ibona abakhipha izindodla zemali yokuba kubulawe uMagaqa, wathi bahlukaniselana u-R120 000 emva kokusoconga uMagaqa.Wathi wabuye wathola ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ukuthi empeleni bakhokhelwa u-R600 000, yena waxhoshwa abanye ababeyingxenye yetulo lokusoconga uMagaqa.UNcengwa wagwetshwa iminyaka engu-25 ebhadla ejele iNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu.Ngesikhathi ezithethelela enkantolo, uNcengwa wathi uzimisele ukwelekelela uMbuso ukuba kuboshwe nabanye abasolwa abathinteka kuleli cala.Abanye abasolwa ababili, uMnuz Sibonelo Myeza noMbulelo Mpofana, bayaqhubeka nokuphika icala.UMyeza noMpofana bazovela eNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu ngo-Okthoba, lapho kuzoqulwa khona icala labo.Omunye umsolwa, uMnuz Mlungisi Ncalane, kwatholakala ukuthi akakulungele ukubhekana necala emva kokuhlolwa ingqondo. Umfowabo kaMagaqa, uMnuz Lwazi Magaqa, uthe uzokwazi ukuphawula kahle namhlanje uma isikhulu esiboshiwe sesivelile enkantolo.
ISABAMBA iyeka ikhomishini ezophenya izinsolo ezishaqisayo ezenziwa wuKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, njengoba ingakayitholi indawo ezosebenzela kuyo, kungakaziwa ukuthi izosebenzisa imali engakanani, nokuthi ubani ozobizwa kuqala ukuba azokwethula ubufakazi.Ohola ikhomishini, iJaji Mbuyiseli Madlanga, uthe basazama ukuthola indawo okuzobanjelwa kuyo ikhomishini.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba izolo.UMengameli uCyril Ramaphosa, wayalela ikhomishini ukuba yenze umsebenzi wayo ngokushesha ngenxa yobucayi bezinsolo ezenziwa wuMkhwanazi.UMkhwanazi wasola uNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa omisiwe, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, ngokuphazamisa ukusebenza kwengalo yomthetho nangokusondelana nezigebengu.UMkhwanazi waphinde wasola amanye amaphoyisa nabezinhlaka zobulungiswa ngokusebenzisana nezigebengu.UMadlanga uthe banethemba lokuthi bazoyithola maduze indawo okuzobanjelwa kuyo ikhomishini."Okwamanje esingakuqinisekisa wukuthi ikhomishini izohlala esifundazweni iGauteng. Njengamanje simatasa sizama ukuthola indawo. Abantu bazokwaziswa ukuthi ikhomishini izokuba kuphi nendawo."URamaphosa wayalela ikhomishini ukuba imnikeze umbiko wokuqala emva kwezinyanga ezintathu, iphinde imnikeze omunye umbiko emva kwezinyanga eziyisithupha.UMadlanga uthe bafuna ukuhlangabezana neminqamulajuqu abayibekelwe wuRamaphosa."Sifuna ukuthi kuthi kuphela izinyanga ezintathu kube wukuthi siyobe sesiwuqedile umbiko wokuqala. Uma kuwukuthi lowo mbiko uyobe uqukethe ubufakazi obanele ukuba siphakamise ukuba kube khona abavulelwa amacala."UMadlanga uthe abakazi ukuthi ikhomishini izosebenzisa malini."Imali izobe yenganyelwe wuMnyango wezoBulungiswa. Okwamanje asikazi ukuthi kuzodingeka malini."UMadlanga uthe abakazi ukuthi ubani ozoba wufakazi wokuqala nokuthi bangaki ofakazi abazobizwa.Ubuye wathi kuzocaca kahle uma sebeqale ukukhuluma nabantu abathintekayo ukuthi yibaphi ofakazi okufanele bazokwethula ubufakazi.Uthe sebeqalile ukuhlela ukubonana nabathinteka kulezi zinsolo.Uthe umuntu wokuqala abazobonana naye wuMkhwanazi.Uthe uma kukhona abantu abafuna ukwethula ubufakazi esithe, kufanele benze izicelo."Akuyona into engizoyivuma kalula lena. Ngizozibhekisisa izicelo zabantu abafuna ukwethula ubufakazi esithe. Kufanele kube nezizathu ezizwakalayo."
ISISHOSHOVU se-ANC esidumile esifundeni iMzala Nxumalo sigxeke uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, samsola ngokuthatha ngamawala.Umgcinimafa we-ANC egatsheni laseHlobane, eVryheid, uMnuz Lindokuhle Xulu, usebe owokuqala ukuphumela obala KwaZulu-Natal wagxeka uMkhwanazi, wathi waxhamazeka ngokunekela izwe izinsolo azibhekise kuNgqongqoshe wezamaPhoyisa osamisiwe, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu.UXulu uthe uMkhwanazi kwakufanele asebenzise izinhlaka ezifanele ukubika izinsolo ezishaqisayo azenza ekuqaleni kwenyanga.UMkhwanazi washaqisa abantu abaningi ngesikhathi esola uMchunu ngokusondelana nezigebengu nangokuphazamisa ukusebenza kwengalo yomthetho.Izinsolo zikaMkhwanazi zenza ukuba uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, aqoke ikhomishini ezoholwa iJaji Mbuyiseli Madlanga.UXulu uncome isenzo sikaMchunu sokuzicelela ikhefu elikhethekile, wathi bazomeseka uma eseyovela kwikhomishini."Isenzo sikaMkhwanazi esokuxhamazela. Lokhu akwenza akakucabanganga kodwa-ke siyameseka uMacingwane kukhona konke okwenzekile. Silinde ukuthi sihambe naye kulona lonke uhambo lwekhomishini ezophenya ngezinsongo ezibhekiswe kuye, kuze kube kuphuma isinqumo."UXulu uthe ukwamukela kukaMchunu ikhomishini kukhombisa ngokusobala ukuthi ufuna ukugeza igama lakhe.UXulu uthe okubakhathazayo ukuthi kunabaholi balapha KwaZulu-Natal abafuna ukuphazamisa ikhomishini ngenxa yokuthi basaba ukuthi izoveza amahlazo abo."Okunye yikho ukuthi bafuna uMacingwane angabi bikho ohlwini lwesigugu esiphezulu esizokhethwa ngo-2027, lokho nakho siyakugxeka, abaholi ake babambane, kuvuswe umbutho."Kunamahlebezi okuthi uMchunu uzongenela umbango wesikhundla esiphezulu engqungqutheleni yokukhetha ubuholi be-ANC engqungqutheleni ezokuba ngoku-2027.Kuzokuba kungekhona okokuqala uMchunu engenela umbango wesikhundla esiphezulu kwi-ANC.Ngo-2017, uMchunu wayesembangweni wokuba unobhala jikelele we-ANC kodwa wahlulwa ngamavoti angu-24.Engqungqutheleni yango-2022, igama likaMchunu lake lamataniswa nombango wesikhundla sephini likamengameli kodwa wabuye wahoxa emjahweni walesi sikhundla.
KUSEMNYAMA kuMasipala waseMkhanyakude njengoba abasebenzi bengaholile futhi kungase kuphazamiseke ukuhanjiswa kwezidingo ezifana namanzi.Imali yomkhandlu ibhajwe ebhange ngenxa yomdonsiswano wokufakwa komkhandlu ngaphansi kweso lomlawuli.Abasebenzi bomkhandlu obekufanele bahole ngoLwesihlanu akucaci ukuthi bazohola nini njengoba engekho ofuna ukwehlela ngezansi phakathi kobuholi bomkhandlu kanye noMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana kanye neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal ababanga udaba lokuqokwa komlawuli, uMnuz Bamba Ndwandwe.UNdwandwe waqokwa ngasekuqaleni kwenyanga, kuze kube manje ubuholi baseMkhanyakude abavumelani nokufakwa komkhandlu ngaphansi kweso lomlawuli.Umasipala awukwazi ukuholela abasebenzi kanye nokukhokhela ezinye izidingo ngenxa yokuthi imali ephumayo kufanele isayinelwe nguNdwandwe.USomlomo waseMkhanyakude, uMnuz Solomon Mkhombo, uthe ukubhajwa kwemali yomkhandlu kubabeka esimweni esinzima."Kwenza ukuthi singakwazi ukuholela abasebenzi. Kuzophazamiseka ukuhanjiswa kwezidingo ezifana namanzi nokuqoqwa kukadoti. Sisengcupheni yokuthi kube khona abantu abasithathela izinyathelo zomthetho futhi lesi simo sizokwenza ukuthi abantu bangabe besawuthemba umkhandlu."UMkhombo uthe abahambisani nesinqumo sokuthi kube uNdwandwe osayinela imali yomkhandlu."Ngokomthetho olawula ukuphathwa komasipala imenenja kamasipala iyona okufanele isayinele imali. Imenenja iyakwazi ukuthi inikeze isikhulu sezimali igunya lokuba sisayinele imali yomkhandlu. Umlawuli ofakwa ngenkani emkhandlwini uvele wathatha isinqumo sokumisa ukusebenza kwemali yomkhandlu."UMkhombo uthe bayaqhubeka nokuphikisana nokufakwa komkhandlu ngaphansi kweso lomlawuli, wanxusa uMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu kuzwelonke kanye noMkhandlu weziFundazwe ukuba bangenelele kulolu daba.UMphathiswa wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, uyalele ubuholi baseMkhanyakude ukuba busebenzisane noNdwandwe.UButhelezi uthe uNdwandwe uyena okufanele asayinele imali yomkhandlu."Ukungafuni kobuholi bomkhandlu ukubambisana noNdwandwe kubeka engcupheni isinkwa sabasebenzi. Ayamukelekile indlela abaholi bomkhandlu abaziphethe ngayo. Bakhombisa ukungawuhloniphi umthetho. Kufanele bamukele ukuthi umkhandlu ufakwe ngaphansi kweso lomlawuli, nokuyisinqumo esathathwa iKhabhinethi laKwaZulu-Natal."UButhelezi uthe umasipala awuyilandeli imigomo yokuphathwa kwemali.UButhelezi uthe usanda kuthola incwadi evela kuMcwaningi Mabhuku omkhulu, uNksz Tsakani Maluleke, emcela ukuba angenelele odabeni lokungalandelwa kwemigomo yokuphathwa kwezimali zomkhandlu.UMnyango wezeziMali KwaZulu-Natal usanda kuhoxisa ithimba obulijube ukuba liyokwelekelela umkhandlu.Umnyango uthe ubuholi bomkhandlu bebungafuni ukusebenzisana nethimba lawo.Unobhala wenyunyana yabasebenzi, iSamwu esifundeni iShonamalanga, uNksz Zandile Gumede, uthe kunezinyathelo zomthetho abazithathayo njengoba kungacaci ukuthi bazohola nini."Engingakutshela khona ukuthi siphatheke kabi kodwa okuningi ngizokukhuluma uma sesiqedile nabameli."I-EFF KwaZulu-Natal ithe umbango wokuqokwa komlawuli akufanele uchaphazele abasebenzi.Okhulumela i-EFF KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Chris Msibi, unxuse ukuba kungenelele uMnyango wezeziMali kulolu daba.
UKUBA sendaweni efanele ngesikhathi esifanele nokungalindi amathuba ezinto ezinkulu ukuza kuyena ngamasu nobuchule obusebenzela uMnuz Mnqobi Mthethwa, umnikazi weMagaga Media and Communications, inkampani yezokuxhumana, ezokumaketha negxile kakhulu ukusiza izinkampani nezinhlaka ezahlukene ukuhlela imicimbi emikhulu ehlukene.UMthethwa, ongowokuzalwa eThembeni, KwaDukuza, kodwa wakhulela eHambanathi, oThongathi, enyakatho yeTheku, uze wenza ezibukwayo kule nkampani nje wayekhule ezitshela ukuthi mhlawumbe uyokhula agxile emikhakheni yezesayensi, nakhu vele wayenza lowo mkhakha esefunda amabanga aphezulu eBurnwood Secondary, eSydneham."Nokho kuthe sengiphothule u-matric wami ngo-2012 ngangathathwa enyuvesi komunye umkhakha wezesayensi engangithemba ukuthi ngizofundela wona. KULINDELEKE ukuthi bavele namuhla eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseVryheid abesilisa abathathu abakhalelwe amasongo kaSigonyela emva kokutholakala nophondo lukabhejane nezibhamu ezimbili ePaulpietersburg, ngoMgqobelo.Ngokusho kokhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant Colonel Paul Magwaza, abasolwa abaneminyaka ephakathi kuka-34 no-50 babhadanywe amaphoyisa ngosizo lomphakathi nenkampani yonogada sebecashe esikhotheni. UMagwaza uthe ngale kophondo lukabhejane abasolwa abatholwe nalo, babuye batholwa nezibhamu ezingekho emthethweni ezimbili zohlobo lwe-303 ne-R5. Uthe babe sebeqhubeka nohambo lwabo lokuyodubula ubhejane, bawunquma uphondo. "Bathe besamatasa nalobu bugebengu, baphazanyiswa umsindo we-alamu ebelicushiwe. Babaleka endaweni yesigameko, bakhohlwa isibhamu esincane eduze kukabhejane obusufile,” kusho uMagwaza. Uthe kubikelwe amaphoyisa ngokuphazima kweso ngesigameko, aphendula masinyane. Uqhube wathi nakuba efice bengasabonwa nangokhalo esiqiwini amaphoyisa, onogada benkampani ezimele benze konke okusemandleni ukubathola. "Ngosizo lomphakathi abasolwa bagcine beboshwa emva kokubanjwa becashe esikhotheni. Baficwe nesibhamu iR5, i-303 nophondo lukabhejane,” usho kanje.Udalule ukuthi imoto ebebehamba ngayo ithathwe amaphoyisa.Uthe abasolwa babekwe icala lokubamba inkunzi behlomile, elokuzingela ubhejane ngokungemthetho nelokutholakala nezibhamu ezingekho emthethweni nezinhlamvu. ENingizumu Afrika isalokhu iyinkinga indaba yokubulawa kobhejane eziqiwini ezehlukene, nokho uhlelo lokususwa kwezimpondo zabo lubukeka luwenza umehluko.Ngokombiko wabezeMvelo KZN Wildlife, uhlelo lokususwa kwezimpondo zobhejane oluqalwe ngo-Ephreli, ngonyaka odlule, lwenze omkhulu umehluko. Ngokocwaningo, ezinyangeni ezine zokuqala zika-2024, bangu-124 obhejane ababulawa kodwa emva kokuqalwa kwalolu hlelo, kubonakale kubakhona umehluko ongu-67%.

Unina wezingane zami akazami lutho kodwa uhlalele ukukhiqiza izingane kuphela nokwenza isimo sibe nzima manje kimi.Ngizizwa sengiphelelwa uthando lwakhe ngoba ngathi akazimisele ngempilo. Ngingamtshela kanjani ukuthi angisamdingi empilweni yami?ImpenduloNGOKUBONA kwami, omunye umunwe ukhombe wena lapha. Uma uthi umama wezingane zakho ulibele wukuzala, ngabe uzaliswa ubani okanye uyazizalisa? Lokhu nje okushoyo kukhombisa ukuthi uyinhloboni wena kapende. Lalela-ke bhuti, kuzomele uhlale phansi nomama wezingane nibonisane ngokuthi kumele nihlele umndeni ukuze ningabi nezindleko eziningi kwazise nguwena kuphela osebenzayo. Futhi ekugcineni kufanele uyovela ngokusemthethweni kubo kasisi. Kumele nibonisane nangokuthi yikuphi okungenziwa usisi ukuze naye athole amasentshana nikwazi ukubambisana endlini.
UMBUZOSISI MaGumede, ngicela ukubuza ukuthi yikuphi okungcono, ukukhiya umyeni nokumfaka ubheka mina ngedwa? Kona angifisi ukumdlisa kodwa ngike ngizwe kuthiwa nokumkhiya futhi kuyinkinga ngoba kuba nesilwane esimgadayo sigcine sesilala naye, manje angisazi ukuthi ngenzenjani. Inkinga yami uyafeba kakhulu, uhambe elala kokunye angabuyi ngisho ekhaya izinsuku ezintathu zilandelana. Ngiyamthanda, angikwazi ukumyekelela nje kanjalo ngoba ekugcineni uzongibuyela nezifo. Siza sisi MaGumede.IMPENDULOSISI wami, ngiyayiqonda inkinga yakho kodwa manje ngifisa ukukuxwayisa ngalento ocabanga ukuyenza. Omunye umuntu uyamdlisa livele limgulise idliso ashone bese uphenduka umfelokazi kade uthi uyazisiza.Nokumkhiya futhi akulungile ngoba ekugcineni uma kwenzeka wena udlula emhlabeni yena usala abe nenkinga. Lalela sthandwa sami, uma indoda isifeba uboqale uzinuke amakhwapha mhlawumbe kukhona lapho ishoda khona.Umuthi wokudlisa indoda yinhlonipho, isimilo nokuthobeka ungaqophisani nayo futhi ungayiqulisi amacala. Hlala phansi nayo nikhulume, nizame ukulungisa okonakele. Uma ubona ukuthi akulungi, uthintane nabeluleki bemishado ngiyazi nizosizakala.

UVEZE ukuthi uthikamezekile ekhanda owesifazane osolwa ngokubulala izingane zakhe eNgonyameni, eMlaza, umbiko kadokotela omhlole ingqondo izolo.UNksz Nelisiwe Nompilo Thusini (28) uhanjiswe kudokotela wesifunda ohlola ingqondo khona, kulandela umyalelo weNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMlaza ngeledlule.UNksz Thusini usolwa ngecala lokuklinya, abulale indodana yakhe uNqobizitha Thusini ebizohlanganisa izinyanga ezimbili izelwe nendodakazi yakhe uNozibusiso Thusini (2) ngoMsombuluko odlule. Emva kokufundwa kombiko kadokotela, inkantolo ibe isinquma ukuthi aphinde ayohlolisiswa esibhedlela sabathikamezekile emqondweni iFort Napier, eMgungundlovu.Ummeli kaNksz Thusini uqale wezwakalisa ukuthi ikhasimende lakhe ngeke lisifake isicelo sebheyili.Nokho uthe eqeda ukusho lokho phambi kwenkantolo, uNksz Thusini wabe ephakamisa esandla, ekhombisa ukuthi ufuna ukuveza okuthize. Yilapho eveze khona ukuthi yena kahle hle uyafuna ukufaka isicelo sebheyili, wathi ukhona umalumekazi wakhe angayohlala naye uma kwenzeka ededelwa ngebheyili.Icala ligcine lihlehliselwa uLwesine oluzayo ukuze uNksz Thusini akwazi ukufaka isicelo sakhe sebheyili.Uyise wezingane, uMnuz Njabulo Khuzwayo, obezifikele mathupha enkantolo uthe namanje usalimele ngokubulawelwa izingane. "Ngifisa sengathi bengisheshe ngabona, mhlawumbe kukhona ebengingakwenza. Ngisalimele ngokulahlekelwa abantwana ababili,” kusho uKhuzwayo.Uthe ulinde ukuthi umthetho usebenze, ungamniki ibheyili umsolwa."Siyamesaba. Sizothini uma ededelwa bese ezoqhubeka lapho egcine khona ngoba namanje asazi ukuthi lokhu akwenzile ukwenziswe yini ngoba besingakaze sixabane,” kusho uKhuzwayo. Ube esekhuza abantu ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, ethi abayeke ukusheshe baphawule ngento abangayazi.Uninakhulu wezingane, uNkk Nelisiwe Mkhize, uthe bungehla ubuhlungu abuzwayo uma umsolwa echithwa esicelweni sebheyili."Ubuhlungu enginabo mhlawumbe bungehla uma ejeziswa ngesenzo sakhe. Uma ededelwa ngebheyili, kuzobe kusho ukuthi akajeziswa ngesenzo sakhe ngoba uzobe esekhululeka engaphandle,” kusho uNkk Mkhize. Uchithe izinsolo ezenziwa abanye abantu ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, abathi kungenzeka ukuthi ubehlukunyezwa."Labo abasola ukuthi ubehlukunyezwa, akunjalo. Ubengakaze ahlukunyezwe, ubethandwa kakhulu kabi enzelwa yonke into. Lokhu akwenzile asazi ukwenzeleni,” usho kanje.Ngesikhathi zitholwa eceleni kwendlela izingane ngeledlule, zazinemihuzuko yokuklinywa, encane iphuma igazi ngamakhala. Zazisongwe ngoblankethi owodwa zombili, kwase kushuthekwa isiqeshana sephepha elibhalwe izinombolo ekagogo nekayise wazo.Umsolwa owayekade evakashele kubo kayise wazo, esuka eZwelisha, eNanda, wavele wahamba nazo engavalelisile ngosuku olwandulela okwatholwa ngalo izidumbu.Umndeni wawusenza imizamo yokuthola ukuthi uhambe wayaphi ngesikhathi kungena ucingo luthi sekutholwe izingane zibulewe.
Uphiko lwezobunhloli eNingizimu Afrika seluqinise uphenyo ngezinsolo zokuthi izinkambu okuqeqesha amasosha axhumene neLesotho lapha eNingizimu Afrika.UGeneral Fannie Masemola uhlangane nabo bonke okhomishana bezifundazwe abayisishiyagalolunye esifundazweni ngasinye ngesikhathi somhlangano ohleliwe weBhodi Lokhomishana (BOC) wokudingida imizamo yokulwa nobugebengu ezweni. I-BOC iyinhlangano ephakeme kunazo zonke ethatha izinqumo ye-SAPS ehlanganisa bonke oKhomishana Bezifundazwe, okhomishana bezinhlaka ezahlukene kanye nenhloko kazwelonke esabambile yophiko lokuphenya ngobugebengu obuseqhulwini (DPCI). Emhlanganweni, uJenene uFannie Masemola uveze ukwaneliseka kwakhe ngokuthi izinhlangano zobugebengu obuhleliwe ezweni ziyahlakazwa, ziyaxoshwa, ziyaxoshwa futhi ziyaboshwa. Ukuphawula okushiwo yiNhloko yamaPhoyisa eLesotho, u-Advocate Borotho Matsoso bekuseqhulwini ezinhlelweni. U-Advocate Matsoso, uthe kunentsha yabeSuthu ebuthelwa ukuqeqeshelwa impi eNingizimu Afrika. Uchaze lokhu ngokuba yisenzo siyingozi enkulu embusweni waseLesotho. Ekhuluma esithangamini nabezindaba ukhombe iqembu elizibiza ngeMalata Naha athi lisebenzela eNingizimu Afrika. UMasemula uphiko lwezobunhloli luqinise umsebenzi ukuze kuphenywe izinsolo ezenziwe futhi lapho kunesidingo, zilandelele futhi zehlise le misebenzi engekho emthethweni. I-DPCI ebuye yaziwe ngele-HAWKS Crimes Against the State (CATS) nayo ibiziwe ukuze iphenye. I-CATS isatshalaliswe ngezindlela ezahlukene emapulazini ahlukene ahlonziwe futhi abukho ubufakazi bezinkambu obutholakele kuze kube manje.
