LIPHINDE labambezeleka futhi icala lokubulawa kwalowo owayengumrepha, uKiernan "AKA” Forbes nomngani wakhe owayengumpheki odumile, uTebello "Tibz” Motsoane eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini izolo.Lokhu kuze emva kokuvela kokuthi kusekhona izitatimende ezisashoda, uMbuso okusafanele uzilungise kahle.Phakathi kwazo kukhona imiphumela yokuhlolwa kwesibhamu, ubufakazi obaqoshwa amakhamera, izitatimende zasemabhange zabo bonke abamangalelwa kanjalo nezincwadi ezifungelwe zofakazi abangu-45 abazobizwa ukuthi bazofakaza kuleli cala. U-AKA noTibz badutshulwa, bafa ngaphandle kwendawo yokudlela iWish eyayisemgwaqweni odumile eThekwini, uFlorida ngoFebhuwari 2023. Le ndawo umnikazi wabuye wayivala, ekhala ngokuthi ayisenzi kahle kulandela isigameko.NgoFebhuwari wonyaka odlule amaphoyisa abopha oMnuz Lindokuhle Mkhwanazi, Lindani Ndimande, Siyanda Myeza, Mziwethemba Gwabeni noLindokuhle Ndimande.Babekwe amacala okwakha itulo lokubulala, elokubulala nelokuzama ukubulala. Ngaphezu kwalaba abahlanu, kukhona izelamani ezimbili, oMnuz Siyabonga Gezani Ndimande noMalusi Dave Ndimande, nazo ezisolwa ngaleli cala kodwa ezisaseSwatini. UMbuso usalwa indaba yokuthi zibuyiselwe kuleli, ukuze zizojoyina ozakwabo ecaleni. INkantolo yeMantshi KwaManzini, eSwatini, yanquma ukuthi laba ababili babuyiselwe kuleli, kodwa bona bafaka isicelo sokuthi lesi sinqumo sibuyekezwe. UMbuso, ngomlomo ka-Advocate Elvis Gcweka uveze ukuthi kusekhona izitatimende ezisadinga ukulungiswa kancane.UMbuso uphinde waveza ukuthi ngaphezu kofakazi abangu-45 okuqinisekiswe ukuthi bazobizwa, kukhona abanye abazonezelwa. Abameli babamangalelwa babe sebenza isiphakamiso sokuthi uMbuso ubahlinzeke ngamagama kanjalo nemininingwane yalabo othi uzobengeza.Ijaji, uNkk Jacqueline Henriques, lithe lokhu kukhomba ukuthi icala alikakulungeli ukuthi liyiswe esigabeni sokuba kumenyezelwe izinsuku elizoqulwa ngazo.Icala lihlehliselwe u-Agasti 13 kulo nyaka ukuze inkantolo imemezele ukuthi lizoqala nini ukuqulwa.Nakuba kulindeleke ukuthi uNkk Henriques azimemezele kahle ngo-Agasti izinsuku zokuqulwa kwecala kodwa kuvele ukuthi kuzobe kuwunyaka ozayo.
USIZWE wumphakathi, ovele washaya phansi ngonyawo, wathi awuyi ndawo umndeni wakwa-F, KwaMashu, eThekwini, okuthiwa ubusuthunyelwe ngommeli ukuthi uzokhishwa ngodli endlini.Ngokusho komnikazi womuzi osemthethweni, uNksz Ntokozo Mlambo (60), bavuswe ngummeli obathelekele nezigora, ezizame ukukhipha impahla yabo ngodli, "enye yaze yonakala".Elandisa ngodaba, uthe luwumbango owaqala ngo-2012, abesezitshela ukuthi sewadlula kuwo. Echaza, uthe kwakungu-2011 ngesikhathi yena nendodana yakhe bethola ukuthi indlu eyikhaya labo, isihlobo sesiyidayisele omunye umuntu.Uthe lolo daba lwaze lwangena enkantolo ngo-2012, lwadonsa, waze waluwina ngo-2020."Emva kwalokho, ngibuye ngaphumula ngokuthula ngizitshela ukuthi sekudlulile njengoba sengizohlaselwa manje,” kusho uNksz Mlambo. Usole isihlobo sakhe asidalule ngegama, ethi yiso esakhwabanisa imininingwane, sadayisa umuzi wakubo, yena engazi.Edweba isithombe ngalona wesifazane (76), uthe waqokwa wumndeni ukuthi azomgada emva kokushona kukayise ngo-1981."Ngesikhathi kushona ubaba ngangimncane, ngifunda nesikole. Kwavunyelwana ngokuthi kuhle ngitholelwe isihlobo esizohlala nami, singigade njengoba ngangingeke ngikwazi ukuhlala ngedwa,” kuchaza uNksz Mlambo. Uveze ukuthi lokhu kwenzeka ngoba unina wavele waduka ngenxa yokuthikamezeka emqondweni, kanti izingane zakwabo zasezivele zishonile."Lona okwathiwa akazohlala nami wumzala wami. Angazi wayiphambanisa kanjani imininingwane yetayitela, washutheka igama lakhe kulo, wase edayisa umuzi ngaphandle kokubazisa,” usho kanje.Uthe ngokwetayitela elidala, amagama ayevela kulo kwakungelikayise nelikanina, bese kuvela elakhe, elomfowabo nodadewabo asebashona. "Njengoba wonke umuntu engasekho, kwasala mina, umuzi kwase kuba owami ngokomthetho,” kusho uNksz Mlambo.Uthe nakuba engasakhumbuli kahle kodwa leso sihlobo, sahamba kubo phakathi kuka-2002 no-2004.Uthe wezwa kuthiwa sesihlala KwaDukuza, kanti umuzi saze sawudayisa ngo-R35 000 ngo-2011. Uthe ebebemkhipha endlini, kusewumndeni ofanayo, owathenga indlu ngaleso sikhathi."Sengixakwa wukuthi yini abazongikhiphela yona endlini ngoba icala ngaliwina enkantolo ngo-2020?” kusho uNksz Mlambo.Uthe akwehlanga kahle kuye ukuthi kugasele ummeli nezigora, ezozama ukubakhipha endlini. "Ngibonga umphakathi ovele wagcwala egcekeni, wathi angiyi ndawo futhi akekho umuntu ozokhipha izimpahla zami ngaphandle komuzi,” kusho yena.Uthe kuze kwafakaza ngisho izakhamuzi ezazi kangcono ngomthetho, ezithe isikhonzi senkantolo kuphela esinelungelo lokukhipha umuntu endlini. Ummeli, uMnuz Ayanda Mkhwanazi, ucacise ukuthi ubengayile ukuyokhipha umndeni ngenkani, wathi izigora okuthiwa ubehamba nazo, ngabaqaphi bakhe. "Bengiyoxoxa nabo ngokuthi isinyathelo esesizolandela emva kwencwadi engibabhalele yona ezinsukwini eziyisikhombisa ezedlule, wukuya enkantolo ukuze kuzongenelela isikhonzi senkantolo,” kusho uMkhwanazi.Uthe yena uqale ukusebenza udaba ngenyanga edlule, ikhasimende lakhe licela usizo ngodaba, wathi lamendlalela konke ngokuthi umuzi lawuthenga esihlotsheni ngo-2012, kodwa kuze kube yimanje lisalwa indaba yokungena emzini walo. "Lingikhombise nesinqumo esenziwa yinkantolo ngo-2014, ukuthi akawukhiphe umndeni. Ngikuqinisekise nenkantolo lokhu, ngathola ukuthi isinqumo sisamile, ngabe sengiyaqala ukusebenza ngayo,” kusho uMkhwanazi.Udalule ukuthi ngokwamaphepha, ikhasimende lakhe lawuthenga ngendlela eqondile umuzi futhi linalo ilungelo lokukhipha umndeni wakwaMlambo, wathi okwawo wukuthi uye enkantolo uyocela kwenziwe isibuyekezo esizovundulula ukuthi kwenzeka kanjani ukuthi isihlobo sibe namandla okudayisa umuzi wabo.

yaphinde yathola uxhaso luka-R1.3 million eMnyangweni wezoLimo KwaZulu-Natal.UNksz Simelane uthe le nkampani yasungulwa abazali bakhe ngo-1996, wathi washiya kuyona ngo-2004.Uthe akazange abe nesandla ekutheni iKwazi-Gugu Enterprise ithole uxhaso lukahulumeni.Uthe uzobhala umbiko azowuthumelela uNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, nobuholi be-ANC, mayelana nalolu daba."Ngisacabanga nokuthatha izinyathelo zomthetho njengoba kube khona nokuhuduleka phansi kwegama lami."Liyakhula ikhwelo lokuba uHlomuka noNksz Simelane behle ezikhundleni.UNksz Simelane uphinde asolwe nangokuba KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Mike Mabuyakhulu, uthe udaba lokuqokwa kwezinkampani ezizophakela izikole alukaphothulwa.UMabuyakhulu uthe njengamanje kuvulwe ithuba lalabo abanezikhalo ukuba beze Inkantolo yeSifunda eNquthu igwebe indoda eneminyaka ewu-59 odilikajele abawu-10 ngokudlwengula izingane eziwu-12 eNdindindi nakwaLuvisi eNquthu.Lo mlisa ulahlwe nangamacala awu-7 okunukubeza ngokocansi namanye awu-7 okubukisa izingane imikhuba wase egwetshwa iminyaka ewu-70.Izigameko zenzeka phakathi kuka-2020 no-Agasti 2022 kanti abagilwa kwakungabafana namantombazane abaphakathi kweminyaka ewu-6 kuya ku-14.Ummangalelwa wayengumfundisi webandla endaweni ebuye enze umsebenzi wokukhanda izinto zikagesi. Wayethenjiwe emphakathini futhi abagilwa nabazali babo babengamalungu ebandla.Ummangalelwa wayevame ukucela abagilwa ukuthi bamsize ukukhanda izinto zikagesi bese ebakhokhela. Abazali ngokwethemba ummangalewa babevumela izingane ziyolala kuyena. Uma belele khona wayebabukisa imikhuba yocansi, abadlwengule bebuka abanye abasabise ngokubabulala uma bebika udaba.Indaba yaze yavela emuva kokuthi omunye ogada izingane ezilamanayo ezingabagilwa wezwa zikhuluma ngalokhu ezikubone ngesikhathi ummangalelwa ezibukisa ifilimu yocansi. Waziphenya kabanzi izingane zaphumela obala zathi baningi nabanye abagilwa. Kwabikelwa amaphoyisa kwaqoqwa nabanye abagilwa kwase kuboshwa ummangalewa.UMshushisi uMphakamiseni Mdlalose ubize ofakazi abawu-22, okungabagilwa,odokotela ababahlola,abazali nababheki bezingane ezingabagilwa. UMdlalose wethule nezitatimende zabagilwa nabazali babo abazibhale beluswe wuVictoria Griffiths, oyi-Court Preparation Officer. Omunye wabagilwa uthe ukwesaba ukubulawa kwadala ukuthi athwale kanzima kakhulu emoyeni wakhe ngoba wayefela ngaphakathi. Umgilwa uthe uthemba ukuthi inkantolo izomgweba isikhathi eside ummangalelwa. Omunye umgilwa uthe wadlwengulwa phambi kwabangani bakhe washaqeka uma ebabona beshaya sengathi ababoni nokwamenza wabona ukuthi nabo bake babhekana nesimo esifanayo.Abazali ababhale izitatimende bebesho ngazwi linye ukuthi bazizwa sengathi ubagilile ummangalelwa. Bathe njengoba kade ewumfundisi nje bekufanele abe nomthelela omuhle ezinganeni zabo kodwa yena waqeda ngempilo yazo.Bathe lo mlisa ubeyimpisi embethe isikhumba semvu. Abazali bathe okubuhlungu kakhulu wukuthi izingane zabo bezisaba ukubhoboka zibabikele ngemkhuba kammangalelwa.Ummangalelwa ulahlwe ngamacala okudlwengula awu-10 wagwetshwa udilikajele ngecala ngalinye.
ABAKWA-SASKO bakhethe ukuwethula KwaZulu-Natal umkhankaso wabo obhekelele ukujabulisa omuntuza.Ingqikithi yalo mkhankaso ithi Siyasizana, kanti ngokususho koyiMarketing Manager kwaPepsico, lokhu kuyiqiniso elingenakuphikiswa ngoba konke okwenziwayo ukuphilisa izifiso zomuntuza kwenzeka ngokubambisana kwabo, izikole moMnyango wezeMfundo.Kwenziwani-na? ININGI labantu okufanele babuyiselwe imali yabo yisikhwama esigade umhlaba kaZulu, iNgonyama Trust, abakatholakali.INgonyama Trust ithe isathole abantu abangaphezudlwana kuka-200 kulabo abangaphezu kuka-1 600 okufanele babuyiselwe imali eyaqoqwa yilesikhwama ngokungekho emthethweni.Isiyonke imali okufanele ikhokhelwe abantu ingaphezu kuka-R4 million.Isikhulu esiphezulu esibambile kwiNgonyama Trust, uMnuz Siyamdumisa Vilakazi, sithe bayaqhubeka nokuthungatha abantu okufanele babuyiselwe imali yabo."Kunzima ukubathola bonke ngenxa yokuthi abanye sebashona kanti abanye azidonsi izingcingo lapho behlala khona njengoba behlala ezindaweni zasemakhaya. Abantu okufanele bakhokhelwe imali yabo bangu-1 620. Okwamanje sisakwaze ukuthola abangu-208."UVilakazi uthe kusangenzeka kube khona abanye abavelayo abathi nabo babekhokhiswa."Kodwa okwamanje abantu abavelayo emabhukwini ukuthi babekhokhiswa bangu-1 620."UVilakazi uthe abantu okufanele bakhokhelwe yilabo abasayiniswa isivumelwano sokwakha esaziwa nge-residential lease."Le mali ayifaki eyokukhonza, eyokukhonza yona igcinwa wuMnyango wokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu."UVilakazi uthe abantu baqala ukukhokhiswa le mali kusukela ngo-2007 kwaze kwaba u-2021."Abantu bebekhokhiswa imali ehlukene. Kwezinye izindawo abantu bebekhokhiswa u-R1 200 njalo ngonyaka."UVilakazi uthe bafisa ukuthi bebe sebebakhokhelile bonke abantu okufanele bakhokhelwe ezinyangeni ezingu-18. Ngo-2021 iNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu yanquma ukuthi kwakungekho emthethweni ukukhokhishwa kwabantu abakhe emhlabeni ongaphansi kweNgonyama Trust emva kwecala elalifakwe yizinhlangano ezilwela amalungelo abantu, iCouncil for the Advancement of the South African Constitution (Casac) neRural Women's Movement.IJaji Mjabuliseni Isaac Madondo lanquma ukuthi iNgonyama Trust ibuyisele abantu imali yabo.Ibhodi eledlule leNgonyama Trust lazama ukuphonsela le sinqumo inselelo, kodwa imizamo yalo yahluleka.Iphini likasihlalo webhodi leNgonyama Trust, u-Advocate Linda Zama, lithe banqume ukulandela umyalelo wenkantolo.Uthe akazi ukuthi yisiphi isizathu esaholela ekutheni ibhodi eledlule lithathe isinqumo sokukhokhisa abantu.U-Advocate Zama uthe bayazi ukuthi kukhona abangahambisani nesinqumo sabo sokukhokha le mali.
IBHODI leNgonyama Trust lisola owayengusihlalo walo, iJaji Jerome Ngwenya, ngokunqwaha no-R41 million walesi sikhwama.Amalungu ebhodi athi asehluleke ancama ukuthola le zigidi zamarandi ezabolekwa wuhlaka olungaphansi kweNgonyama Trust, iNgonyama Holdings, ngesikhathi uNgwenya esengusihlalo webhodi.UNgwenya ungomunye wabaqondisi beNgonyama Holdings, ibhodi lithe selizame kaningi ukususa uNgwenya ohlwini lwabaqondisi beNgonyama Holdings.Isikhulu esiphezulu esibambile kwiNgonyama Trust, uMnuz Siyamdumisa Vilakazi, sithe sebethathele uNgwenya izinyathelo zomthetho.UVilakazi uthe iNgonyama Holdings yabhaliswa ngokusemthethweni ngo-2019.Uthe uNgwenya, nomunye owayeyisikhulu esiphezulu kwiNgonyama Trust ngaleso sikhathi, baba abaqondisi beNgonyama Trust.UVilakazi uthe ngo-2021 iNgonyama Holdings yaboleka izigidi zamarandi kwiNgonyama Trust.Ngalesi sikhathi uNgwenya wayengusihlalo webhodi leNgonyama Trust aphinde abe wumqondisi kwiNgonyama Holdings.UVilakazi uthe uNgwenya uyanqaba ukuchaza ukuthi yashonaphi le mali."Le mali yakhokhwa izigaba ezintathu. Kwaqalwa ngo-R10 million ngoMashi (2021), kwalandela omunye u-R10 million ngoJulayi, kwase kuba u-R21 million ngoNovemba. Kusukela lapho iNgonyama Holdings ayikaze ilethe umbiko wokusebenza kwemali. UMcwaningi-mabhuku omkhulu uhlezi ebuza ukuthi le mali ibuya nini uma ecwaninga amabhuku eNgonyama Trust."UVilakazi uthe sebefake izicelo ezimbili enhlanganweni ebhalisa amabhizinisi iCIPC, bezama ukususa uNgwenya njengomqondisi weNgonyama Holdings.UVilakazi uthe lezi zicelo azizange ziphumelele emva kokuba abameli bakaNgwenya beziphikisile."Namhlanje sithi siyaziqhelelanisa neNgonyama Holdings. Sifisa abantu bazi ukuthi iNgonyama Trust isiqhwagwe abantu abathile. Yingakho sesinqume ukuthatha izinyathelo zomthetho."UVilakazi uthe bathatha izinyathelo zomthetho ezehlukene."Angikwazi ukuphawula kakhulu ngalezi zindaba njengoba kusaqhubeka uphenyo. Kukhona izinsolo zokukhwabanisa eziphenywa woKlebe."Kuthintwa uNgwenya, uvele wabhoka ngolaka.UNgwenya ubuze ukuthi kungani ibhodi lihluleka wukumphuca iNgonyama Holdings uma kuwukuthi ngempela le nkampani ingaphansi kweNgonyama Trust.UNgwenya uphonsele inselelo intatheli ukuba ilethe imininingwane yokubhaliswa kweNgonyama Holdings, eyemizamo yokumkhipha njengomqondisi weNgonyama Holdings, kanye neyezinyathelo zomthetho athathelwe zona ngaphambi kokuthi aphendule ngalolu daba.Iphini likasihlalo webhodi leNgonyama Trust, u-Advocate Linda Zama, lithe kwaba yiphutha kwasekuqaleni ukuthi uNgwenya abe wusihlalo webhodi aphinde abe wumqondisi weNgonyama Holdings ngesikhathi esisodwa.U-Advocate Zama, owayeyilungu lebhodi ngesikhathi iNgonyama Holdings itshelekwa u-R21 million, uthe waphikisana nalesi sinqumo."Nokho langidla ivoti, ngabe senginquma ukusula ngoba ngangingahambisani nalesinqumo."
I-MK ichitha uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, ngesixoliso sokwehluleka ukuhlangabezana nomnqamulajuqu wokuba afake amaphepha asenkantolo.Umkhonto weSizwe Party uthe awusamukeli isicelo sikaRamaphosa sokuba avunyelwe ukuba afake amaphepha asenkantolo sekudlule isikhathi.URamaphosa uhlulekile ukuhlangabezana nomnqamulajuqu wokuba afake amaphepha aphikisa isicelo seMK ephonselela inselelo ukuqokwa kwekhomishini ezophenya izinsolo ezibhekene noNgqongqoshe wezamaPhoyisa omisiwe, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu.Inhloko yamaJaji, uMandisa Maya, wayekade enikeze uRamaphosa umnqamulajuqu wangoLwesibili, ukuba afake amaphepha aphikisa isicelo seMK efuna nokuthi kuchithwe ukuqokwa kukaNgqongqoshe wezamaPhoyisa ozobamba, uSolwazi Firoz Cachalia.Abameli bakaRamaphosa babhalele izinhlaka ezithintekayo ecaleni, bexolisa.I-MK iphendule ngokuthi ayilwamukeli uxolo. NgoJulayi 17 wabe usuphendula, usho ukuthi angeke usihoxise isinqumo sakho."Ngesikhathi sifaka icala senza isiphakamiso sokuthi unikezwe umnqamulajuqu wangoLwesibili. Ngempela inhloko yamajaji yavumelana nathi. Ngenxa yokuthi lolu udaba olubhekiwe kakhulu ezweni, asifuni ukuba kube nokubambezeleka."Abameli beMK bathe bazosiphikisa isicelo sikaRamaphosa sokuba athethelelwe.Okhulumela iMK, uMnuz Nhlamulo Ndhlela, uthe ukwehluleka kukaRamaphosa ukuhlangabezana nomqamulajuqu kukhombisa ngokusobala ukuthi akawuhloniphi umthetho."Le nto izokwenza ukuthi abantu bengabe besazithemba izinkantolo uma uRamaphosa ezohluleka ukulandela imiyalelo yezinkantolo. Ingakho nje sifake isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bakhe ngoba kusobala ukuthi akafanelwe ukuba sesikhundleni."Imizamo yokuthola okhulumela iHhovisi likaMengameli, uMnuz Vincent Magwenya, ayiphumelelanga.I-MK yafaka icala eNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo, ngeledlule, ifuna kuchithwe ikhomishini ezoholwa yiPhini leNhloko yamaJaji, uMbuyiseli Madlanga. I-MK ithe le khomishini izomosha imali.I-MK iphinde ikhale ngokuthi umthetho awumvumeli uRamaphosa ukuba aqoke uCachalia ukuba azobamba isikhundla sikangqongqoshe ngenxa yokuthi akasilona ilungu lePhalamende.
ENINGIZIMU Afrika isalokhu iqhubeke njalo inkinga yezemfundo okubukeka igqama kakhulu emagunjini okufundelwa kuwona izibalo okubukeka kuseyinselelo enkulu ukuthi abafunde bazifunde futhi baziphase ngamalengiso kanjalo neziyamene nobuchwepheshe nesayensi.Lokho kwafakazelwa wucwaningo lwe-Trends in International Mathematics Science (TIMSS), olwadalula ukuthi izingane ezifunda uGrade 5 ezweni zazikeliswe emsileni emazweni awu-59 enza kahle ezibalweni nasezifundweni zesayens, lokho okuvela ukuthi kuba yinkinga kuze kuyofika esigabeni samabanga aphezulu emfundo.Kanjalo futhi noMnyango wezeMfundo eyiSisekelo ngo-2024 udalule ukuthi sehle sisuka ku-49% saya ku-39% isibalo sabafundi ba-matric abakhetha i-maths ngqo kusuka ku-2010. Nanokuthi kulabo ababhale ukuhlolwa kwango-2024, wu-17.4% kuphela owathola ngaphezu kwa-60% ezibalweni, okwenza ukuthi zikwazi ukungena ohlelweni lokukwazi ukwenza izifundo ze-Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics (STEM) ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme. Nokho inselelo enkulu kuseyikhona ukuthi ezingaweni zasemakhaya izingane ziqala isikole sezivele sezisele kakhulu ngeminyaka, ekubeni uhlelo lokufunda olusebenza manje alunazo izinhlelo eziqondene nabo ngqo ukubasiza ukuthi bakwazi ukuthola ulwazi lwabasele kukho.Yingalezo zizathu abenhlangano yezemfundo ezinze eGoli ecija abafundi ngezibalo nezobuchwepheshe nesayensi i-OLICO sebephose inselelo yokuthi abafundi bakhuthalele ukuthi kuthi noma sebeqedile ukufunda kwasesikoleni, babe khona futhi kwezinye izinhlelo zokufunda zantambama nangezimpelasonto ukusiza ukuthi bacijeke kokubahlulayo.UMnuz Andrew Barrett we-OLICO uthe inselelo enkulu ngohlelo lokufunda olusetshenziswa ezikoleni zaseNingizimu Afrika manje wukuthi alubasizi abafundi abasuke besalele emuva ngalezi zifundo ezithathwa ngokuthi "zinzima’’. "Kunalokho lwenza ukuthi bame ndawonye futhi bangacijeki ngolwazi ngendlela okumele ngabe bacijeka ngayo, okwenza ukuthi kuthi sebefika emabangeni aphezulu, kube wukuthi basalele emuva ngokwezinga ongalifanisa neminyaka emithathu kuya kwemine yokufunda abangayifundanga ekubeni beyifundile, bese belahlekelwa wukuzethemba nogqozi lokufunda okuholela ekutheni bangenzi kahle ezifundweni zabo,” kusho uBarrett."Yingakho sikhuthaza abafundi ukuzibandakanya nokuqinisa ezinhlelweni ezinjengalolu nathi esilwenzayo ngoba yilapho abakwazi ukukhululeka khona, bavuleleke nokubuza imibuzo okungenzeka bangakhululeki ukuyibuza uma kufundwa ezikoleni abafunda kuzona, bese beyawazi ukubuyelwa wukuzethemba nokuthanda ukufunda,” usho kanje.Uthe sekucacile ukuthi lolu hlelo lungezinye zezinhlelo ezimbalwa, uma kungesilo lodwa olukhona, kwezingasiza ukuphucula ukufunda kwabaafundi okuzokwenz ukuthi bakwazi ukwenza kahle kulezi zifundo, bese besizakala ngokuthi bekwazi ukuqhubeka nezifundo ezeyamene ne-STEM uma sebeqhubekela ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme."Lokhu kumele kusetshenziswe ukuthi kube yicebo lokutshala ekusaseni lomnotho wezwe lethu ngoba uma kufuleka ezemfundo, kuzofukuleka nezomnotho ngakho sikhuthaza nabaholi bezamabhizinisi, abatshalimali nezinhlaka ezahlukene ezizimele nezohulumeni ukweseka izinhlelo ezinjengalolu ukuze zisebenze kahle,” kucebisa uBarrett.
ITHATHE igxathu elibalulekile imizamo yeMelika yokuhlawulisa abaholi be-ANC.Ikomiti lezobudlelwano namazwe angaphandle eMelika livume umthethosivivinywa ophakamisa ukuthi iMelika ibuyekeze ubudlelwano bayo neNingizimu Afrika, nokuthi kuhlawuliswe abaholi be-ANC.Iningi lamalungu ekomiti likwesekile ukuphasa kwalo mthetho ophakamisa ukuthi kuhlonzwe abaholi be-ANC okufanele bahlawuliswe.Lo mthetho obizwa nge-US-South Africa Bilateral Relations Review Act of 2025, waphakanyiswa yilungu lamaRepublicans, uMnuz Ronny Jackson.Ubudlelwano beNingizimu Afrika neMelika abubuhle kusukela kwangena uDonald Trump kwesikamengameli waseMelika.Okuqhatha iNingizimu Afrika yicala eyalifaka eNkantolo yaMacala oMhlaba, lapho yamangalela khona izwe elidlelana neMelika, i-Israel. Okunye wukudlelana kweNingizimu Afrika namazwe ayizimbangi zeMelika okubalwa kuwo iChina.UJackson uthe njengoba ikomiti selivume umthethosivivinywa sekucabeke indlela yokuthi isiphakamiso sakhe sibe wumthetho waseMelika.UJackson uthe baningi abazothathelwa izinyathelo uma usushayiwe umthetho."Umthetho uzonikeza uTrump amandla okuba abhekane namadlelandawonye ethu azenzela umathanda. Alikho izwe esidlelana nalo elizokwenza umathanda uma sekushaywe lo mthetho."UJackson uthe maningi amacala enziwe abaholi baseNingizimu Afrika."INingizimu Afrika izisondeza namazwe abuswa ondlovukayiphikiswa. Kule minyaka sibone iNingizimu Afrika ilokhu iqhela kwiMelika."Inhlangano i-AfriForum, ikushayele ihlombe ukuvunywa komthethosivivinywa.I-AfriForum ibilokhu ikhala ngohulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika, iwusola ngokuphuca abamhlophe umhlaba wabo.Abaholi bale nhlangano baze baya eMelika, beyoceba uhulumeni wakuleli emva kokuphasiswa komthetho wokuthathwa komhlaba.Okhulumela i-AfriForum, uMnuz Ernst van Zyl, uthe isikhuni sesibuya ngomkhwezeli kubaholi be-ANC."Kunini sibakhuza? Sekunesikhathi eside uhulumeni oholwa yi-ANC uthatha izinqumo, usho nezinto ezicasula amazwe esidlelana nawo afana nayo iMelika. Sesifikile isikhathi sokuthi bathathelwe izinyathelo abathintekayo."I-ANC nohulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika bebengakaphawuli ngalolu daba.
USADIDEKILE umndeni wesikhulu ebesisebenza kuMasipala waseMsinga, kulandela ukudutshulwa kwaso, sibulawe ngesihluku eFabeni, eMsinga, ngoMsombuluko. UMnuz Khalesakhe James Mchunu (46), obebuye adume ngelikaSagila, udutshulwe ngoyaba lwezinhlamvu zesibhamu esikhulu nesincane ntambama ebuya emsebenzini.Ngokuthola kweSolezwe, umufi okuthiwa ubesesebenze iminyaka engaphezu kuka-15 ophikweni lwezicishamlilo kulo masipala, udutshulwe esezofika ekhaya. Kuthiwa umufi ushone esengumphathi kulolu phiko. Ngokusho kwekhansela lendawo, uMnuz Msawenkosi Ndebele, abasolwa bamhlasele ngakwisinciphisajubane esingekude nasekhaya. Isihlobo sikamufi, uMnuz Njabulo Mchunu, sithe isigameko sibashiye bedidekile bewumndeni."Sididekile siwumndeni ngoba umufi ubengumuntu wabantu, engenazo izitha esizaziyo futhi akakaze asibikele lutho, ngisho nanokuthi kukhona nje akusolayo okungase kumehlele,” kusho uMchunu. Uthe umufi uhlaselwa nje, ubezibuyela emsebenzini, ewumuntu obehambe ekhaya ekuseni njengenjwayelo.Uthe abanaso isiqiniseko sokuthi abasolwa bebehamba ngezinyawo noma ngemoto, wathi abakwaziyo wukuthi umufi uhlaselwe ngesikhathi ehamba ngemoto yakhe emgwaqweni."Imoto yakhe siyifice ivundlile emgwaqweni. Yena eseshonele ngaphakathi, okusho ukuthi akakwazanga ngisho nokuphuma abaleke,” kusho uMchunu. Uthe bayafuna ukuthi iphenduleke imibuzo abanayo ngokubulawa kwakhe okuyindida.Uveze ukuthi ushiye unkosikazi nezingane, kuzona kukhona nezisafunda. UNdebele uthe isigameko siwushaqisile nomphakathi njengoba kungavamile ukuhlaselwa kwezakhamuzi ngale ndlela. "Umphakathi ubulokhu ubuthene njalo endaweni yesigameko, bahlale kusukeka ngabo-6 izolo (esho ngoMsombuluko) kwaze kwaba sentathakusa namuhla (esho izolo),” kusho uNdebele.Ekhasini leFacebook likaMasipala waseMsinga, iMeya uMnuz Felinkosi Sikhakhane idlulisa amazwi enduduzo ithe ukushona kukaMchunu kubashiye nobukhulu ubuhlungu ezinhliziyweni."Umndeni ulahlekelwe yindodana, umphakathi ulahlekelwe yisisebenzi esithembekile, umasipala ulahlekelwe yisikhulu esizinikele emsebenzini nesizwe sonke silahlekelwe yiqhawe,” kusho uSikhakhane. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant Colonel Paul Magwaza, uthe amaphoyisa aseMsinga aphenya icala lokubulala, kulandela isigameko sokubulawa kowesilisa oneminyaka engu-46 esemotweni yakhe eFabeni ngoMsombuluko."Imibiko ithi umufi ubesendleleni eya ekhaya ngesikhathi ehlaselwa abantu abangaziwa bamdubula,” kusho uMagwaza, othe imbangela yokuhlasela ayikaziwa.
KUKHONA nowayengungqongqoshe ohlwini lwabantu okuthiwa amacala abo ahoxiswa ngendlela engaqondakali wuMqondisi wezokuShushisa esifundeni iGauteng South, u-Advocate Andrew Chauke, omiswe wuMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa.Kuvela igama lowayengungqongqoshe wezeMidlalo, uMnuz Zizi Kodwa, ohlwini lwamacala ahoxiswa uChauke ngendlela engaqondakali.UChauke umiswe ngoMsombuluko, kuzoqala uphenyo lokuthi ukulungele yini ukuba sesikhundleni.Okhulumela iHhovisi likaMengameli, uMnuz Vincent Magwenya, uthe uRamaphosa ubone kungcono ukuba amise uChauke ngenxa yobucayi bezinsolo abhekene nazo."URamaphosa uqale wanikeza uChauke ithuba lokuthi achaze ukuthi kungani kungafanele amiswe emsebenzini. Ekugcineni uRamaphosa unqume ukuba amise uChauke njengoba kuzoqala uphenyo."Kuvela ukuthi sekunesikhathi eside kunezikhalo ngoChauke.Umqondisi wezokuShushiswa koMphakathi kuzwelonke, u-Advocate Shamila Batohi, wabhalela uRamaphosa eminyakeni emibili eyedlule, emcela ukuba amise uChauke.Kunezinsolo zokuthi kunokuhudula izinyawo ekushushiseni amacala kwikhomishini eyayiphenya izinsolo zokuLawulwa koMbuso yiDlanzana afakwe ezinkantolo ezingaphansi kwesifunda asiphethe.Ngonyaka odlule uChauke wathatha isinqumo sokuhoxisa icala lenkohlakalo kanye nokukhwabanisa elalibhekene noKodwa kanye nabanye asolwa nabo. Icala lahoxiswa emva kwezethulo zabameli bakaKodwa.U-Advocate Batohi waphumela obala, wathi bazosibuyekeza isinqumo sokuhoxiswa kwala macala.Ngo-2014 uChauke wanquma ukuhoxisa icala lokubulala, nelokuthumba elalibhekene nowayengumphathi wezinhloli, uMnuz Richard Mdluli.Isinqumo sikaChauke sachithwa yiNkantolo yamaCala aDlulisiwe, uMdluli wagcina egwetshwa iminyaka emihlanu.Amaqembu ezepolitiki akwamukelile ukumiswa kukaChauke. Umholi we-ActionSA ePhalamende, uMnuz Athol Trollip, uthe kade babesho ukuthi uChauke akamiswe esikhundleni."Asazi ukuthi yini lena eyenze ukuthi uRamaphosa athathe isikhathi eside kangaka ukumisa uChauke. Nakuba sikujabulela ukuthi useze wamiswa ekugcineni, kodwa siyafuna ukwazi ukuthi bekubambephi. Njengoba esemisiwe nje sifuna kuqalwe uphenyo ngokushesha. Sifuna zonke izinsolo abhekene nazo ziphenywe."Okhulumela iDA kwezobulungiswa, u-Advocate Glynnis Breytenbach, uthe baningi abantu abakhohlakele abavikelwe wuChauke."Maningi amacala ahudule izinyawo kuwona. UChauke akafanelwe wukuhlala kulesi sikhundla. Abantu abasazithembi ezobulungiswa ngenxa nje yabantu abambalwa abakhohlakele abasezinhlakeni zobulungiswa. Manje sekuyikhathi sokuthi senze izinto ezizobuyisa isithunzi sezobulungiswa."
USULUQALILE uhlelo lokuqoqwa kwemininingwane yemindeni ehlala emijondolo eyakhiwe phezu kwamathuna eCoedmore, eSeaview, eThekwini, uMnyango wezokuHlaliswa kwaBantu KwaZulu-Natal.Lokhu kuvezwe uMphathiswa woMnyango, uMnuz Siboniso Duma, ngeSonto.UDuma uthe: "Sengikhulume neNhloko yoMnyango, uMnuz Max Mbili, osebenzisana noMasipala weTheku ukuthi basheshise lolu hlelo lokuqoqwa kwemininingwane yabahlali.” Ingaphezu kuka-400 imindeni ehlale emijondolo exhunyekwe phezu kwamathuna kule ndawo.Ngokusho kwabo abahlala kule mijondolo, baqala ukungenisa kuyona ngaphambi kuka-1994.Bathi sekuyiminyaka ngeminyaka behlala kuyo kanti iningi lize laba nabantwana, nabo asebenezabo izingane. Ngesikhathi Isolezwe lihambele le ndawo, bakhala ngokubanjiswa udonga yizikhulu zikahulumeni, zibathembisa ukuthi bazosuswa bayofakwa ezindlini zomxhaso ezikwezinye izindawo.Baveza ukuthi izikhulu zifika zizobatshela lezi zethembiso ekugcineni zingazifezekisi.Nokho uDuma uthe emva kokungena kukahulumeni wenkululeko, abantu ababehlala kule ndawo bakhelwa izindlu ngokushesha. "Kwabekwa eqhulwini imindeni eyayilokhu ihleli kule ndawo kusukela ngo-1981. Ngasekuqaleni konyaka ka-2000, ababeyizikhulu zomnyango ngaleso sikhathi baqinisekisa ukuthi imindeni yababehlala kule ndawo iyathuthwa, iyiswa ezindlini eziseWelbedacht, eChatsworth,” kuchaza uDuma. Uthe kuyishwa ukuthi yize noma yathuthwa le mindeni, eminye yayo yabuyela kule ndawo futhi yakha imijondolo emisha.Unxuse abantu ethi nakuba umnyango ukuqonda ukuthi abaningi basuke besuka ezindaweni zasemakhaya ukuzozama impilo eThekwini nokuthi izindawo zokufihla ikhanda ziyashoda kodwa abahlonishwe abalele. "Amathuna ayindawo engcwele lapho asebeshonile kufanele bayekwe baphumule ngokuthula,” usho kanje. Uqhube wathi basazoqhubeka nokukhuluma nabenhlangano iRatepayers Associations, emele izakhamuzi ezinemizi eduze komhlaba kahulumeni lapho umnyango othi uzama khona ukwakha imixhaso ukuze kuhlaliswe abahlwempu, kodwa uvinjwe yilezi zakhamuzi. Udalule nokuthi umnyango uphezu kocwaningo ngodaba lokuhlaliswa kwabantu. Lolu cwaningo kuzokwenziwa ngokubambisana neMoses Kotane Research Institute, National Home Builders Registration Council, Stats SA, Council of Scientific Industrial Research kanjalo noMnyango wekuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu. Phakathi kwezinto ezizocwaningwa yizidingo zalabo abahlala ezindaweni zabanye, ababhekene nokuxoshwa, abahlala ezindaweni zasemakhaya, emijondolo kanjalo nasezindaweni ezikhahlanyezwa kalula yizinhlekelele zesimo sezulu, abahlala emathuneni njengalaba abaseCoedmore, bese kuba abahlala emapulazini.
UMNDENI wowesifazane waKwaMkhizwana, eCato Ridge, owabulawa ngesihluku ekhulelwe eDassenhoek, eThekwini, ngo-2019, ukhale ngobuncane besigwebo inkantolo esinikeze owayeyisoka emva kokuvuma icala.UNksz Ziningi Mkhize (35), kuthiwa wafa emva kokuthi uJabulani Mdlalose (50), embophe izandla nezinyawo, maqede wamfaka uplastiki ekhanda ngo-Ephreli 4, 2019.Kuthiwa lokhu kwenzeka emva kokuba uMdlalose ebambe umufi nesoka endlini ngesikhathi ebuya emngcwabeni wesihlobo salapho edabuka khona, eNgwavuma. Ibamba lejaji, uNkk Nomfundo Sipunzi, limgwebe iminyaka engu-16 ebhadla ejele uMdlalose, laphinde lanquma nokuthi akumfanele ukuba nesibhamu. Udadewabo kamufi, uNksz Hlengiwe Mkhize, uthe abeneme ngesigwebo njengoba bebona ukuthi sincane kumuntu abakholwa wukuthi wakhipha imiphefumulo yabantu ababili."Umufi wayekhulelwe, izinyanga sezibalelwa kweziyisikhombisa noma eziyisishiyagalombili. Yayisingumuntu ophelele ingane, yangcwatshwa eceleni kukanina. Sincane kakhulu lesi sigwebo. Bekufanele bamnike noma udilikajele,” kusho uNksz Mkhize. Uqhube wathi namanje kusenzima ukwamukela ukufa kukadadewabo, wathi ngisho nendodana kamufi ayithola kuMdlalose ayivumi ukuxola.Kuthiwa ngesikhathi ebulawa unina, indodana yayineminyaka eyisishiyagalombili, manje isineminyaka engu-15."Ulimise ngesihloko elokuthi ngeke amxolele uyise. Wathi uma efuna amxolele, kungadingeka aqale avuse unina,” usho kanje. UMdlalose yize enza isiga ngo-2019 kodwa waze waboshwa ngo-Agasti ngonyaka odlule, ebanjwa emngceleni weNingizimu Afrika neMozambique, njengoba wayebhace kuleliya zwe emva kokubulala.Encwadini efungelwe avume kuyo icala, uMdlalose uthe ngosuku lwesigameko, watheleka endlini kamufi, wezwa amazwi abantu abakhulumayo ngaphakathi.Uthe kwathi uma engqongqoza, umufi wangawuvula umnyango, kwaze kwaba uthatha amagxathu ebuyela emotweni. Uqhube wathi kwaba yingaleso sikhathi lapho aqaphela khona ukuvuleka komnyango wendlu kamufi maqede kwaphuma owesilisa angamazi, wabaleka washona ngemuva kwendlu."Umufi wangitshela ukuthi angihlukane naye phansi uma ngimbuza ngalo muntu, lokho kwaholela ekutheni sibe nenkulu ingxabano njengoba kwakungekona okokuqala ngimbamba ephutheni elifanayo,” kusho uMdlalose encwadini efungelwe.Udalule ukuthi ngaphambi kwesigameko, wayesembambe kabili umufi emjolela, wamxolela ngoba emthanda. Uveza ukuthi waqale wamshaya ngempama, nokwaholela ekutheni balwe, wase emcaphuna umufi, wamshaya odongeni ngekhanda."Wawa phansi, wavuka esenolaka kakhulu kunakuqala, ngamhlula ngamandla, ngambopha ngendwangu izandla ngemumva kanjalo nezinyawo. Ngabe sengimfaka uplastiki ekhanda maqede ngawubopha thaqa,” usho kanje.Uthe ngaleso sikhathi wayazi ukuthi wayengafa nokufa umufi ngoba wayewubophisisile uplastiki. "Yize kunjalo, ngaqhubeka ngaphuma endlini, ngaya emotweni, ngiyocabanga ukuthi yini okufanele ngiyenze futhi ngikwehlise nokucasuka,” kusho uMdlalose.Uthe emva kwesikhashana wabuyela endlini, kwathi uma emthinta umufi, waqaphela ukuthi usefile.Uthe yilapho atatazela khona, wambhoza ngengubo yokulala wabe esebaleka.Evuma icala uthe nakuba wayengakuhlelanga ukubulala umufi kodwa uyavuma ukuthi wafa ngenxa yesenzo sakhe.

UNtuli uthi uziqaphele izinsolo ezibucayi ezibhekiswe kumphathiswa wezeMfundo, uMnuz S. Hlomuka, nomphathiswa wezeMpilo, uNkk N. Simelane-Mngadi. Nakuba lezi kuyizinsolo futhi kungekho sinqumo esenziwe, uNdunankulu uthi ukholelwa ukuthi ubuholi obunomthwalo wemfanelo budinga impendulo esheshayo nelinganiselwe. "Yize lezi kuyizinsolo ezingenabufakazi okwamanje, nginesiqiniseko sokuthi amalungu athintekayo kanye nomphakathi wonkana bazobuqonda ubunzima obungase bube yingozi yokwehla kwesithunzi eminyangweni yabo, uhulumeni wesifundazwe, nakubantu abathintekayo. Ngakho, ngibhalele laba baphathiswa ngokusemthethweni ukuthi balethe imibiko ephelele ehhovisi lami, echaza wonke amaqiniso abalulekile, ingqikithi, nanoma yiziphi izenzakalo zakamuva eziphathelene nalezi zinsolo." Uthi lolu lwazi luzoqondisa inkambo efanelekile nenesibopho sokuthatha isinyathelo sikahulumeni wesifundazwe, esizokwaziswa esidlangalaleni kuleli sonto elizayo.

KUVELE kwavuka imibuzo engenazo izimpendulo emndenini wezingane ezimbili okuthiwa zabulawa wunina ngeledlule eNgonyameni, eMlaza, kuvela ukuthi endala eziyelamayo, yashona ngendlela engaqondakali eminyakeni edlule.Isidumbu sengane yomfana, uNqobizitha Thusini, obezohlanganisa izinyanga ezimbili ezelwe phakathi noJulayi, nesikadadewabo, uNozibusiso Thusini, obeneminyaka emibili, zitholwe zisongwe ngoblankethi wezingane ngoMsombuluko odlule. Kwabikwa ukuthi babulawa ngokuklinywa, kwasolwa unina, uNksz Nelisiwe Nompilo Thusini (28) ngalesi sigameko, owagcina ekhalelwa amasongo kaSigonyela ngoLwesibili olwedlule, esebalekele kubo eMsinga. Kuthiwa abafi bangcwatshwe ohlangothini lwakubo kayise, uMnuz Njabulo Khuzwayo, ngoMgqibelo kulandela isicelo somndeni kamsolwa, okuthiwa uthe ucela bazingcwabe bona izingane kulandela 'ihlazo’ abathele ngalo. Exoxa neSolezwe ugogo wabafi, uNkk Nelisiwe Mkhize uthe emva kwesigameko, kukhona isihlobo sikaNksz Thusini, esibatshele ukuthi bashaya amakhala ngengane kamsolwa endala, nayo eyashona ineminyaka emibili."Uthe ngaleso sikhathi umsolwa wabatshela ukuthi ivele yakhwingcwa yiphalishi yashona,” kusho uNkk Mkhize. Uthe lesi sihlobo sithe bazibuze imibuzo eminingi ngesikhathi sekuvela ukuthi "ubulale" izingane ezimbili.Uthe isigameko salena yokuqala, isihlobo siveze ukuthi senzeka esahlala eGoli kanti leyo ngane owayeyithole ebudlelwaneni bakhe baphambilini.Uveze ukuthi uyise wabafi ubazi ukuthi umsolwa unengane eyashona, amtshela ngayo. "Ayengakuchazanga wukuthi yashona kanjani, nendodana yami ayizange inake ukubuzisisa ukuthi le ngane umsolwa ayemtshela ukuthi yashona yabulawa yini,” usho kanje.Uthe ukuvela kwalezi zindaba akuzange kuhlale kahle kubona, kunalokho zibashiye nemibuzo."Uma lokhu esikutshelwe wumndeni wakhe kuyiqiniso ngabe kukhona okushaya amanzi okufanele kuphenywe ngoba ngabe kuchaza ukuthi ungowesifazane ovele azibulale izingane zakhe zizincane,” kusho uNkk Mkhize. Uthe bazimisele ngokuya eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMlaza ngoLwesine, bayozibonela uma umsolwa esefaka isicelo sebheyili."Sifisa angayitholi nhlobo ngoba sinovalo lokuthi angenza into engalungile uma ephumela ngaphandle. Kwanathi asazi ukuthi ngeke yini asenzakalise uma ededelwa njengoba enza sengathi uthikamezekile ekhanda,” usho kanje.Umsolwa kuthiwa wenza isigameko nje, wayekade efike eNgonyameni ngoJulayi 10, bembizile ukuthi azohlala nabo isikhashana. Kuthiwa ngeJulayi 13 kwathi bayombheka endlini kayise wezingane (oseGoli ngomsebenzi), bafika ekhale amaphepha nazo zombili izingane.Kuvela ukuthi izingane zatholwa wumuntu owayedlula ngendlela zishonile, kublankethi kwashuthekwa iphepha elibhalwe inombolo kagogo noyise wazo.Kusolwa ukuthi waziklinya ngoba zazinemihuzuko entanyeni nasekhanda, encane, iphuma igazi ngamakhala.

SEKUVELE izinsolo zokuthi umsebenzi wokuphakela izikole KwaZulu-Natal uzonikezwa izinkampani zabantu abeseka umkhankaso kaMphathiswa wezeMfundo, uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka, wokuhola i-ANC esifundazweni.Uhlelo lokuqokwa kwezinkampani ezizohlomula kwithenda ka-R2.1 billion yokuphakela izikole ezingaphezu kuka-5 000 seluya ngasemaphethelweni.Abafake izicelo sebeqalile ukushaya amakhala njengoba bekhala ngokungalandelwa kwemigomo kanye nokugxambukela kosopolitiki ohlelweni lokuqokwa kwezinkampani ezizonikezwa umsebenzi. Umnyango usanda kukhipha uhlu lwezinkampani ezisethubeni lokuhlomula.Abanganelisekile bakhala ngokuthi uhlu lugcwele izinkampani zosopolitiki, obhululu kanye nemindeni yabo.Inhlangano yabaphakela izikole, iNational School Nutrition Program Service Providers Association, iphakamise ukuba uhlelo lumiswe, kuphinde kuphenywe izinsolo zokungalandelwa kwemigomo.Okhulumela le nhlangano, uMnuz Thabang Mncwabe, uthe baphethe ubufakazi bokuthi kunokwenzelela ohlelweni lokuqokwa kwezinkampani ukuze kuhlomule abeseka uHlomuka. Kunamahlebezi okuthi uHlomuka uzongenela umbango wokuhola i-ANC KwaZulu-Natal engqungqutheleni ezayo. UMncwabe uthe emasontweni adlule baputshuzelwa uhlu lwezinkampani ezizonikezwa umsebenzi wokuphakela izikole."Uhlu lukhombisa ngokusobala ukuthi kuzohlomula abeseka umkhankaso kaHlomuka. Lana abagcinanga nje ngokwephula imigomo yokuphathwa kwemali yomphakathi, kodwa babuye banyathela amalungelo abafundi abahlwempu abahlomula ohlelweni lokuphakelwa kwezikole. Basebenzisa uhlelo olubaluleke kangaka ukulwa izimpi zepolitiki."UMncwabe uthe kunezinsolo zokuthi umnyango waphulukundlela waqasha isikhulu esilandelwa yifu elimnyama esikhundleni somphathi wenkence emnyangweni ngoba nakhu ufuna ukuphuthumisa le nkohlakalo.UMncwabe uthe bafuna ukuthi izinsolo zenkohlakalo ziphenywe wuphiko oluphenya amacala enkohlakalo, iSpecial Investigating Unit (SIU)."Sifuna uphenyo lubheke ukuthi ngobani abasondelene noHlomuka abahlomulile. Sifuna ukwazi izinkampani zabo, ezabafazi babo, ezezingane zabo kanye nabangani babo. Sinxusa bonke abantu abaphakela izikole ukuba bafake izikhalazo ngale thenda eMnyangweni wezeZimali." Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Muzi Mahlambi, uthe bazibonile izinsolo ezenziwe abaphakela izikole, wathi izinhlaka ezifanele zizosukumela lezi zinsolo.UMahlambi uthe abanganelisekile banelungelo lokufaka izikhalo."Azikaqokwa izinkampani ezizohlomula. Uhlu esilukhiphile olwezinkampani esifuna ukuziqoka. Inhloso yokukhipha lolu hlu yikhona ukunikeza abanganelisekile ithuba lokuba bafake izikhalo."Omunye wosopolitiki okusabalale ukuthi umndeni wakhe usethubeni lokuhlomula, wuMnuz Thanduxoolo Sabelo, oyikhansela kuMasipala waseThekwini.USabelo kuvela ukuthi izinkampani eziphethwe amakhosikazi akhe zisethubeni lokuhlomula.Eziphendulela embhalweni awufake ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, uSabelo uthe akusilona iqiniso ukuthi amakhosikazi akhe ayazitamuzela kulo msebenzi wokuphakela izikole.Uthe bake bathola kanye umuntu eyedwa, wathi futhi lo msebenzi baqala ukuwenza engakabi nesikhundla kwipolitiki, ngo-2014.Akusikhona okokuqala uhlelo lokuphakelwa kwezikole lubhekana nezinsolo zenkohlakalo.Ngo-2023 kwaba nomsindo emva kokuba ithenda inikezwe inkampani iPacina Food.Yagcina ihoxisiwe ithenda emva kwezikhalo zokuthi ukudla kwakungafiki kwezinye izikole.
UZOSEBENZISANA nabalimi abakhiqiza ubisi uMnyango wezoLimo nokuThuthukiswa kweziNdawo zasemaKhaya KwaZulu-Natal ukuzama ukunqanda ukubhebhetheka kwamatele.Lokhu kushiwo wuMphathiswa walo mnyango, uNkk Thembeni Madlopha-Mthethwa ngeSonto, kulandela umhlangano abenawo nabalimi abakhiqiza ubisi e-Orange Grove Dairy, eDundee.UNkk Madlopha-Mthethwa uveze ukuthi isiphakamiso sokuthi kube khona ukusebenzisana size emva kokubheduka kwamatele oThukela naseMzinyathi. Uveze ukuthi umnyango uphezu kophenyo kulandela ukutholwa kwalesi sifo emapulazini amathathu akulezi zifunda ezimbili. "Njengoba lesi sifo sesivele sibeke engcupheni impilo yabalimi bezinkomo, abakhiqiza ubisi bakhathazeke ngokufanayo njengoba umnyango uqhubeka nokwenza uphenyo ngezigameko zokubheduka kwalesi sifo emapulazini akhiqiza imikhiqizo yobisi eMzinyathi nasoThukela,” kusho uNkk Madlopha-Mthethwa. Uthe kwenzeka lokhu nje, abamapulazi emikhiqizo yenyama yenkomo abebelokhu bengaphansi kwengcindezi, bekhahlamezekile, kusukela kubheduke amatele ngo-2021, njengoba kamumva nje lesi sifo sesibikwe nasemapulazini emikhiqizo yobisi. "Amathimba omnyango aphansi phezulu, asebenzisana nezinhlaka ezehlukene kulo mkhakha, ukulawula isifo,” usho kanje. Uthe njengohulumeni, bagqugquzela ukuthi kube khona ukubambisana nazo zonke izinhlaka ezithintekayo ukuthi kunqandwe isifo.Uthe esebekwenzile bewumnyango wukuzama ukulawula isimo ukushaya umthetho wokuthi imfuyo inyakaze ngemvume ebhalwe phansi, wathi bayajabula ukuthi abalimi bayawuhlonipha lo myalelo. Wethembise ukuthi wonke amaphuzu abekwe abalimi emhlanganweni, bazowahambisa embizweni ezoba sePitoli kuleli sonto, lapho kuzobe kudingidwa kabanzi ngalesi sifo. Isikhulu esiphezulu e-Orange Grove Dairy, uMnuz Dave Durham, sithe inhloso yomhlangano nomnyango bekungukuthi kusungulwe ubudlelwano bokusebenza ngokubambisana bese kuqhanyukwa nezisombululo ukuze kunqandwe ukubhebhetheka kwesifo. "Kufanele kwenziwe konke okusemandleni ukuqiniseka ukuthi lesi sifo asifiki emzileni womgwaqo owuthelawayeka uN3. Lo mgwaqo uyinhliziyo yomnotho wezwe, uxhumanisa ichweba laseThekwini nesizinda somnotho iGoli,” kusho uDurham. Isifundazwe iKwaZulu-Natal siyikhaya lezimboni ezingu-16 ezikhiqiza imikhiqizo yobisi. Kuzona kukhona nenkulukazi eNingizimu Afrika iClover Industries Limited. Lokhu kwenza ukuthi isifundazwe sibalwe nezinye ezihamba phambili ngokukhiqiza imikhiqizo yobisi ngo-30% ezweni lonkana. Selokhu abheduka amatele ngo-2021, kwaqalwa imigomo yemfuyo ngo-2022, zingaphezu kuka-700 000 izinkomo esezigonyiwe esifundazweni, ezingu-24 000 zazo, zigonywe esifundeni uMzinyathi.
BESE lihlukene nonina wengane, laze lamenzela ngisho nencwadi yesivimbelo ukuthi angafiki kubo iphoyisa okuthiwa ulidubule nentombi entsha eMbayimbayi Location, eMurchison, ePort Shepstone, ngoLwesihlanu.Lokhu kuvezwe ngumfowabo kamufi, uMnuz Ayanda Hlophe.Esigamekweni okukholakala ukuthi besiwumbango wezothando, kubulawe ngesihluku uConstable Mxolisi Lucas Hlophe (34) noConstable ST Groom, igama lakhe elingatholakalanga. Bobabili abashonile kuthiwa bebesebenzela esiteshini samaphoyisa iGamalakhe, kuthi umsolwa uConstable Ntombethemba Mgidi, asebenze kwesasePort Shepstone. Wamlimaza ngenkomishi efayo. Kwakungemumva kwaleso sigameko lapho umfowethu amala khona, wase emtholela le ncwadi yesivimbelo,” kusho uHlophe. Uthe zikhona nezinye iziwombe zodlame ezikhonjiswe umsolwa ngaphambi kwalokho, ezaholela ekutheni umndeni ungamnambithisisi kahle."Ubevele afike alwe naye phakathi egcekeni ekhaya, angabi nandaba ngisho nokuthi nathi sikhona,” usho kanje.Uvumile ukuthi umfowabo nentombi yakhe entsha umsolwa ubadubule phambi kwakhe. "Bathe befika, umfowethu wabona ukuthi nangu unina wengane yakhe esangweni. Uye kuyena eyomtshela ukuthi akahambe, akadingeki, nokuyilapho amdubule khona, amahlandla amaningi,” usho kanje.Uqhube wathi umsolwa uthe eseqedile ukudubula umfowabo, wanikela kuConst Groom, wamdubula naye. Kuthiwa uConst Groom uphume wabaleka, kwasala uConst Hlophe, ophuthunyiswe esibhedlela kuqala. Kuvela ukuthi ufike washonela khona eqeda kufika.Kungene ucingo lwabebesesibhedlela lubazisa ukuthi uConst Groom olimele kanzima utholwe esikhotheni ngasendaweni yesehlo.Kuthe uma ephuthunyiswa esibhedlela naye, wafike washonela khona. UHlophe uveze ukuthi ingane kamfowabo nomsolwa ineminyaka emibili, wathi bahlangana ekolishi lamaphoyisa eminyakeni emihlanu edlule.Uthe umsolwa ongowokudabuka e-Eastern Cape, ubeqashe ngakubo kayise wengane, esondezela umsebenzi. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, phambilini ubekuqinisekisile ukuthi amaphoyisa asePort Shepstone, abophe iphoyisa elingu-constable ngecala lokubulala iphoyisa okukholakala ukuthi linguyise wengane yalo nelinye okusolakala ukuthi yintombi yakhe eMbayimbayi Location, eMurchison. "Kuthiwa umsolwa uye ekhaya elithile lapho athole khona uyise wengane yakhe nomunye wesifazane, wavulela ngenhlamvu kubona bobabili ngaphambi kokuthi ahambe endaweni yesigameko,” kusho uNetshiunda.Uthe abafi bobabili baqinisekiswe njengasebeshonile ngesikhathi befika esibhedlela. Umsolwa kuthiwa uvelile enkantolo.

I-ANC inengwa wukusetshenziswa kwefulegi leNingizimu Afrika emcimbini lapho umholi weMK, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, ezwakalise ukweseka iMorocco esemzamweni wokudla indawo iWestern Sahara.I-ANC nohulumeni wakuleli abahambisani nemizamo yeMorocco njengoba beseka umbono wokuba iWestern Sahara izimele.UZuma uhambele eMorocco ngeledlule, lapho ebonakale khona noNgqongqoshe woBudlelwano naMazwe aNgaphandle eMorocco, uMnuz Nasser Bourita.UZuma uzwakalise ukuthi bayayeseka imizamo yeMorocco yokubusa iWestern Sahara.Ukusho lokhu ekhuluma eseduze kwefulegi lakuleli.I-ANC ithe ukusetshenziswa kwefulegi kulo mcimbi kudicilela phansi isithunzi sezwe.Okhulumela i-ANC, uNkk Mahlengi Bhengu-Motsiri, uthe bekungafanele kusetshenziswe ifulegi lakuleli ngoba uZuma akasiyona ingxenye kahulumeni ophethe. "Ubudedengu lobu, futhi nje le nto ihlokoloza uhulumeni wakuleli okhethwe ngokwentando yabantu. Lesi senzo asamukelekile futhi siphambene nemigomo yokudlelana namanye amazwe. Empeleni lena yimizamo eyingozi yokubukela phansi imithetho kanye nohulumeni okhethwe ngokwentando yabantu. Kuyishwa ukuba kusetshenziswe ifulegi lezwe entweni yeqembu lezepolitiki. Lesi senzo sinenhlese yokugxambukela kwezwe langaphandle ezindabeni zepolitiki yakuleli."UNkk Bhengu-Motsiri unxuse uMnyango woBudlelwano naMazwe aNgaphandle ukuba ufake isikhalazo esisemthethweni kuhulumeni waseMorocco."Sifuna ukuba uhulumeni waseMorocco uchaze ngalesi senzo, uphinde futhi uxolise ngokukhulu ukushesha. Sinxusa abantu baseNingizimu Afrika, noma ngabe bangamalungu amaqembu epolitiki ahlukene, ukuba balwe nale mizamo yokubukela phansi ukuzimela kwezwe lethu."UNkk Bhengu-Motsiri uthe isenzo sikaZuma siphambene nalokhu abekushumayela ngesikhathi esahola i-ANC. Obengunobhala jikelele weMK, uMnuz Floyd Shivambu, naye ukhwele wadilika kwiMK.UShivambu uthe umbono weMK wokweseka iMorocco uphambene nombono wawo wonke amaqembu alwela inkululeko ezwenikazi i-Afrika.UShivambu uthe umbono wokuba iWestern Sahara izimele wesekwa yiNingizimu Afrika, Algeria, Angola, Botswana, Cuba, Ethiopia, Iran, Mexico, Mozambique, Namibia, Nigeria, North Korea, Tanzania, Uganda, Uruguay, Venezuela, Vietnam neZimbabwe."Thina asisoze sadayisa ngabantu baseWestern Sahara."Ngesikhathi ekhuluma ngokuxoshwa kwakhe kwesikanobhala jikelele weMK, uShivambu wenza izinsolo zokuthi kunamalungu eMK afumbathiswa imali ukuze iqembu leseke iMorocco.

Kulesi sigameko okusolwa ukuthi esombango wezothando, kushone uConstable Mxolisi Lucas Hlophe (34) noConstable ST Groom, igama lakhe elingatholakalanga. Uveze ukuthi umfowabo ubehamba nentombi yakhe, nayo edutshulwe wumsolwa, kodwa yakwazi ukubaleka."UHlophe, okuthiwa ubedutshulwe amahlandla amaningi, uphuthunyiswe esibhedlela iMurchison, nokuyilapho efike washonela khona,” kusho umthombo.Uqhube wathi ngesikhathi amaphoyisa esasesibhedlela obese kushonele kuso uHlophe, kungene ucingo luvela kumakhelwane wasesigamekweni, ethi intombi isitholwe esikhotheni, inenxeba lokudutshulwa. "Ibe isiphuthunyiswa esibhedlela esifanayo nayo, nokuyilapho efike yashonela khona,” kusho umthombo. Uthe umsolwa ube esecingwa, watholwa nesibhamu sakhe somsebenzi.Okhulumela amaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa asePort Shepstone abophe iphoyisa elingu-Constable ngecala lokubulala iphoyisa okukholakala ukuthi linguyise wengane yakhe nelinye okusolakala ukuthi beliyintombi yakhe eMbayimbayi Location, eMurchison. "Kuthiwa umsolwa uye ekhaya elithile lapho athole khona uyise wengane yakhe nomunye wesifazane, wavulela ngenhlamvu kubona bobabili ngaphambi kokuthi ahambe endaweni yesigameko,” kusho uNetshiunda.Uthe abafi bobabili baqinisekiswe njengasebeshonile ngesikhathi befika esibhedlela. BUCHITHEKE bugayiwe inkantolo ivimba ingqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi beqembu elingababeki benkosi kuMasipala waseNewcastle, iTeam Sugar SA.INkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu ikhiphe isivimbelo esinqande ukuhlala kwengqungquthela ebizokuba seNewcastle, ngempelasonto.Kule ngqungquthela bekumenywe ngisho nomholi we-ActionSA, uMnuz Herman Mashaba, obezokwethula inkulumo.ITeam Sugar yamangaza abaningi okhethweni lohulumeni basekhaya lwango-2021 njengoba yathola izihlalo ezayenza ukuba ibe ababeki benkosi kuMasipala waseNewcastle kanye nakuMasipala wesifunda Amajuba. Kepha yabuye yagubuzelwa yizinkinga zangaphakathi eziqale ukugqama kakhulu ngonyaka odlule.Amalungu eqembu ahlukene phakathi njegoba kukhona abeseka umholi weqembu, uMnuz Musa 'Shukela' Thwala, bese kuba khona abeseka iphini likamengameli weqembu, uMnuz Andile Nkosi.UThwala wabakhipha bonke ezikhundleni abangahambisani naye, waqoka amalungu esigungu esiphezulu esisha.Abangahambisani naye nabo babe sebemgudluza esikhundleni, nokuyisinqumo asiphonsela inselelo enkantolo.Abeseka uThwala bebebize ingqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi.Amalungu amabili eqembu anganelisekile, uMnuz Mncedisi Cele, noMnuz Bongani Mthethwa, babe sebenikela enkantolo beyokhala ngokungalandelwa kwemigomo ngesikhathi kulungiselelwa ingqungquthela.IJaji Muzi Ncube linqume ukuba imiswe ingqungquthela."Kufanele kulandelwe yonke imigomo yeqembu uma kuhlelelwa ingqungquthela okubalwa kuyo nokunikeza wonke amagatsha eqembu ithuba lokuba akhethe izithunywa ezizowamela engqungqutheleni." UNcube uphinde wanquma ukuthi akukho ukuqokwa kwesigungu esiphezulu seqembu esaqokwa uThwala ngo-2024.UNcube uphinde wayalela uThwala ukuba ame ukuzibiza ngomholi weqembu kuze kuphume isinqumo ecaleni lapho ephonsela khona inselelo ukuxoshwa kwakhe.ITeam Sugar SA imandla kakhulu esifundeni Amajuba njengoba ike yaphatha izikhundla ezibalulekile komasipala abangaphansi kwalesifunda. Emva kokhetho lwango-2021 uThwala waqokelwa kwesephini lemeya kuMasipala waseNewcastle.Wabuye wakhishwa kulesikhundla ngonyaka odlule emva kokuxabana nobuholi beqembu ababambisene nalo emkhandlwini, i-IFP.UNkosi yena waqokelwa kwesikaSotswebhu omkhulu kuMasipala wesifunda Amajuba. ITeam Sugar SA yahluleka ukungenela ukhetho lwangonyaka odlule.
UKHATHAZEKILE ngokuphepha kwawo umphakathi wasoLundi, kwanda imijondolo edolobheni lakule ndawo. Ngokuthola kweSolezwe, le mijondolo okuthiwa iphakathi enkabeni yedolobha, isiphenduke umhhume wezinswelaboya eziphilisa lubhojozi umphakathi. Kuthiwa yevile ku-30 imijondolo egxunyekwe phakathi edolobheni kanti kunovalo lokuthi izokwanda kakhulu njengoba zonke izinsuku kuvukwa sekukhona emisha. Ngokusho kwesakhamuzi esicishe saphenduka umgilwa, uMnuz Sphesihle Zulu waseNkonjeni, uthe okubi ukuthi selokhu iqalile ukuba khona le mijondolo, ubugebengu bunyuka ngesivinini.Uthe naye ucishe waphenduka umgilwa ngeledlule ngesikhathi ehlwelwa, efika edolobheni ebusuku, evela eThekwini. "Ngangiphuthuma e-renki yamatekisi, ngiyobheka ukuthi ngisazowathola yini amatekisi aya ekhaya. Ngazithola sengilandelwa abantu engingabazi, abasolisayo, bevela kuyo le mijondolo,” kusho uZulu, othe abasolwa behluleka ukumbamba inkunzi ngoba wavele wamemeza kakhulu efuna usizo, bavele bajika. Esinye isakhamuzi, uMnuz Ntobeko Mbatha waseMkhazane, sikhale nangokungcola kwedolobha ngenxa yayo le mijondolo. "Uma bedayisa noma bepheka abanikazi bayo ngezikhathi zasemini, balahla udoti noma kuphi, bechithe amanzi angcolile ebaleni, kuvimbanise iphunga elibi,” kusho uMbatha. Ubuye wathi bona laba bantu babuye balahle esithubeni amakhanda nezikhumba zezinhloko, wathi banxusa iziphathimandla zingenelele. IMeya kaMasipala wasoLundi, uMnuz Wilson Ntshangase, uthe nabo abahambisani nesenzo sabantu abagxumeka izakhiwo eziyimijondolo phakathi edolobheni. Wathi kunemigudu elandelwayo uma umuntu ufuna ukwenza imizamo yokwenza amabhizinisi okuziphilisa edolobheni. "Umasipala unazo izinhlelo zokunciphisa lezi zakhiwo, uphinde ube nemali yokuthenga kabusha izindlu ezisesimweni ezifanele ukuthi abahwebi badayisele kuzo,” kusho uNtshangase.

Abanye abagibeli abangu-7 bathole ukulimala, izingane ezine, zonke ezineminyaka engaphansi kwengu-14 zilimale kanzima. Abalimele kanzima bazinziswe endaweni yesigameko ngabe-IPSS Medical Rescue Advanced Life Support Paramedics, ngaphambi kokuba bathuthelwe ezikhungweni eziseduze ukuze bathole ukunakekelwa okwengeziwe.

Lokhu kuhlale obala okwezinqe zesele emuva kokuzwakala kwezindaba zokudlula kwakhe emhlabeni. Kwabanye babaholi abaziwayo kwipolitiki abalile esikaNandi isililo, kubalwa uMbuyiseni Ndlozi. UGumbi (75) uzofihlwa ngomngcwabo osezingeni likahulumeni, emuva kwenkonzo ezokuba seStanderton Showgrounds, eMpumalanga, ngoLwesibili kusukela ngo-9 ekuseni. IKHALA ngokushaywa yinduku eyodwa kuphindelela inhlangano yaBahlali baseMjondolo, kushona ababili ngenkathi kusha eminye imijondolo ngasemgwaqweni uKennedy, eThekwini ngoMgqibelo.Kulesi sehlakalo, kushe kwangqongqa ingane enezinyanga ezingu-19 uBandile Zulu nowesifazane, uNksz Nonhle Mbango (25), kubona kukhona owaseMzimkhulu, KwaZulu-Natal nowaseMount Frere, e-Eastern Cape. Abafi kuthiwa abahlobene, kanti bashe emijondolo ehlukene esigamekweni okushe kuso imijondolo engu-122, emlilweni okusolwa ukuthi udalwe yikhandlela. Umengameli wenhlangano, uMnuz Sbu Zikode edlulisa amazwi enduduzo emindenini yababhubhe emlilweni, uthe sekungokwesine kusha kule mijondolo kusukela kuqale ubusika bakulo nyaka. Uthe kuyabakhathaza ukuthi sekuyiminyaka ngeminyaka beshaywa yinduku eyodwa emijondolo esemgwaqweni uKennedy. "Siyaluhambisa uhlu lwezinto esikholelwa ekutheni zingaba yisisombululo kuhulumeni kodwa balushaye indiva. Bese sizithola sibhekana nezinhlekelele ezifuze lezi,” kusho uZikode. Uthe nangoMgqibelo ngesikhathi beyohlola umonakalo endaweni yesigameko, behamba nabehhovisi lePhini leMeya eThekwini, uNksz Zandile Myeni, bamtshelile ukuthi akukwazi ukuthi ngaso sonke isikhathi kugidwa ndawonye ngenxa yokungalalelwa kweziphakamiso zabo. Phakathi kwezingqinamba athe ziholela emonakalweni ofuze lona wukungahlinzekwa ngezidingo ezifana nogesi emijondolo. Uphinde wabalula nokuthi ukhona umhlaba osubonakele ezindaweni ezehlukene eThekwini, okufanele ngabe usetshenziselwa ukwakha kuwo. "Uma abantu bengasikelwa kulowo mhlaba, bakhe imijondolo yabo engaminyene, umuntu nomuntu angakwazi ukubhekelela eyokuphepha kwakhe nomndeni wakhe,” kusho uZikode.Nokho uthe bayavuma ukuthi buba khona ubudedengu nangasohlangothini lwabo bengabahlali. Enza isibonelo uthe, zibe khona izikhathi lapho uhulumeni abefika khona azothatha isibalo sabathile kule mijondolo, ayobafaka ezindlini zomxhaso. "Okubi wukuthi uhulumeni ubefika athathe abangu-10 ayobafaka ezindlini, kusale kungena abangu-15 kuleyo mijondolo,” kusho uZikode.Uthe kule nkinga kufanele engabe kuba khona ukubambisana phakathi kwabo nohulumeni, okubandakanya ukusetshenziswa kwengalo yomthetho, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imijondolo osekukhishwe kuyo abantu, iyadilizwa futhi kungaphinde kube khona umuntu owakha eminye.Ube esexwayisa abahlali ngokuthi baqikelele uma bebase izitofu zikapharafini, amakhandlela nokunye. "Lezi zinto kufanele ziqashwe ngelokhozi uma zibasiwe, zingashiywa zodwa. Nalabo abadla amanzi amponjwana siyabanxusa ukuthi abangalayithi lutho uma bekhothile,” kusho uZikode. Esitatimendeni esikhishwe wuMasipala weTheku, uNksz Myeni uhambise usizo obekukhona kulo amaphasela okudla, izingubo zokulala neziponji kulabo abakhahlamezekile.Sithe bonke abakhahlamezekile bazogcinwa ehholo lomphakathi isikhashana. Esitatimendeni esithunyelwe wuMnyango wokuHlaliswa kwaBantu KwaZulu-Natal, uMphathiswa uMnuz Siboniso Duma uveze ukuthi amathimba omnyango asuka kuzwelonke, esifundazweni nakuMasipala weTheku asephezu kohlelo lokuthi abagilwa bahlinzekwe ngempahla yokwakha. "Nokho sikhathazekile ngeqiniso lokuthi abahlali abahlala kule ndawo kuqala, basuswa bayofakwa emixhasweni eWaterloo nakwamanye amaflethi aseduze kwakhona kuKennedy babuye benze okuphambene. Engxoxweni yethu noNgqongqoshe (Nksz Thembi Simelane) neMeya yeTheku uMnuz Cyril Xaba, sivumelene ngokuthi akuqiniswe umthetho. Lokhu kuzolekelela ekutheni kugwenywe abantu abaphinde bahlale noma baqashise ngemijondolo okusuke sekukhishwe kuyo abanye,” kusho uDuma.Imizamo yokuthola imindeni yabashonile ayiphumelelanga.

UNGQONGQOSHE wamaPhoyisa kuleli osanikwe ikhefu elikhethekile, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, uphawule okokuqala ngezinsolo ezenziwa ngaye nguKhomishani wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uGeneral Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi. Lezi zinsolo zithukuthelise abantu abaningi kangangoba iMK Party ize yahlela inhlabaluhide yamamashi kuleli sonto kwathi iDemocratic Alliance yavulela uMchunu icala.Ekhuluma nabezindaba zakwaSABC ngoLwesihlanu, uMchunu uveze ukuthi umagange futhi usekujahe kabi ukuziphendulela kwikhomishini esanda kumenyezelwa wuMengameli wezwe, uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa. Ukhale kakhulu ngabezindaba abasole ngokuthi sebemhlulele engakaziphenduleli. Eqhuba, uthe udaba selikubameli bakhe okuyibo asebelusingathile. UMchunu uthe yena umsulwa futhi uyaziphika izinsolo. Uthe sezenziwe izinsolo, sekuyisikhathi sokuthi kunikezwe ithuba abasolwayo ukuba bazikhulumele."Ngikulungele ukuziphendulela kwengisolwa ngakho." UMchunu ubekhuluma ngesikhathi kubungazwa usuku okwazalwa ngalo uMengameli wokuqala kuhulumeni oxube izinhlanga, iNelson Mandela International Day, kwenye inkulisa eseMpangeni lapho amalungu e-ANC esifundeni saseMusa Dladla, abegubha khona lolu usuku ngokupenda inkulisa. NgeSonto eledlule, uRamaphosa umemezele ikhomishini ezobe iholwa yiPhini leNhloko yamaJaji ebambile uMbuyiseli Madlanga, kwathi uSolwazi Firoz Cachalia, waqokwa ukuba abambe esikhundleni sikaMchunu njengoba kusaqhubeka uphenyo ngaye. Izolo, iMK imashele e-Union Buildings eTshwane, ifuna uRamaphosa asule esikhundleni sobumengameli futhi ifuna kuboshwe wonke umuntu othinteka ezinsolweni ezashiwo nguMkhwanazi.Okhulumela iMK Party, uMnuz Nhlamulo Ndhlela, usabise ngokuthi uma luphela usuku lwayizolo uRamaphosa engasulile esikhundleni, bazokuya eNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo. Le mashi iqale eChurch Square yadlulela ePaul Kruger, Frances Baard nasePark Streets. NgoLwesithathu leli qembu belimasha eThekwini lifuna kuhlukanwe phansi noMkhwanazi.Kwenye imashi inhlangano iDefend South Africa nayo imashele ukuba uRamaphosa ashiye phansi. Ababhikishi bahlangane edepho yamabhasi akwaPutco endala eMarabastad, yanqamula emigwaqweni iStruben, Sophy de Bruyn noMadiba ngaphambi kokufinyelela e-Union Buildings.
UMSUNGULI welinye lamaqembu ebhola ahlonishwayo nathandwa kakhulu ezweni, iKaizer Chiefs, uDkt Kaizer Motaung, uphonsele inselelo izitshudeni wathi azisebenzise imfundo yazo ukuza nokwenza umehluko obonakalayo nozoba wusizo emiphakathini eziyakhele.UMotaung usho kanjalo ngesikhathi ethula inkulumo emcimbini obuseWits Great Hall, eGoli, ngoLwesibili, lapho ehlonishwe khona yisikhungo semfundo ephakeme, iWits University, ngeziqu zobudokotela iHonourary Doctrate in Commerce, ukumhloniphela umsebenzi omuhle asewenzile ezweni."Yibani yizibani zemikhakha ehlukene ngendlela yenu, nilwele ukuthi ninqobe zonke izinselelo enibhekana nazo empilweni yenu, bese nisebenzisa amakhono enu ukwenza umehluko emphakathini wezindawo eniphuma kuzona. UDkt Nelson Mandela wasifundisa ukuthi imfundo yisikhali esinamandla esingasisebenzisa ukushintsha umhlaba, ngakho nani nginicebisa ukuthi nenze kanjalo ukuqhakambisa nokuthuthukisa ezemidlalo, ezemfundo nezomnotho bese nisebenzisa ulwazi eniluthola lana ukuthuthukisa abanye abeza emva kwenu,” kusho uMotaung. Ushansela waseWits University, uDkt Judy Dlamini, uncome amagalelo kaMotaung ekusebenziseni ezemidlalo ukuguqula umhlaba nokwenza umehluko emphakathini, ezweni nasemhlabeni jikelele okwenza iqembu lakhe, eliteketiswa ngokuthi Amakhosi For Life noma ngokuthi yiGlamour Boys, libe semaqenjini ahlonishwayo emhlabeni jikelle, athi kwenze babona kukuhle ukuthi kube khona abakwenzayo ukumhloniphela amagalelo akhe. Uhambo lukaMotaung ebholeni lezinyawo lwaqala eneminyaka ewu-16 esadlalela izimbangi ezinkulu zeqembu lakhe manje i-Orlando Pirates. Ngo-1968 wathola ithuba lokuhlolwa ikhono kwinhlolokhono eyayiseZambia, okwalandelwa wukuthi ayodlalela iqembu laseMelika i-Atlanta Chiefs - okwathi esesungula iqembu lakhe ngo-1970, wasusela kulona igama lalo.Kuningi nokunye akwenzele ibhola lakuleli zwe kubalwa nokuba yingxenye yethimba elalikhankasela ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika isingathe umqhudelwano weNdebe yoMhlaba eyayikuleli zwe ngo-2010, okwakungokokuqala ukuthi isingathwe ezweni lase-Afrika.
Kubikwa ukuthi qmaphoyisa amabili asogwini oluseningizimu ye-KZN abulawe - okusolwa elinye ilungu le-SAPS, embangweni wezothando. Umlisa oneminyaka engu-34 ubudala kanye nentombi yakhe, bobabili abangamaphoyisa, bashonele esibhedlela eMurchison ngemuva kwesigameko esenzeka ngoLwesihlanu ebusuku. Ngokwemibiko, owesilisa ubesanda kufika ekhaya ehamba nozakwabo oyintombi, ngesikhathi unina wengane yakhe ebavimbezela. Indoda idutshulwe amahlandla ambalwa. Intombi ikwazile ukubaleka kodwa yatholwa umakhelwane inenxeba lokudutshulwa yabe esephuthunyiswa esibhedlelalapho eshonele khona. Amaphoyisa akwazile ukulandelela umkhondo kamsolwa wabe eseboshwa, waphucwa isibhamu somsebenzi okukholakala ukuthi yisona asisebenzisile ehlasela.Okhulumela amaphoyisa aKwaZulu-Natal uColonel Robert Netshiunda usiqinisekisile isehlo."Amaphoyisa asePort Shepstone abophe iphoyisa ngecala lokubulala elinye iphoyisa okukholakala ukuthi nguyise wengane yalo kanye nelinye iphoyisa, okusolwa ukuthi yintombi," kusho yena.
KUWUTHOBA amanxeba umphakathi waKwaDukuza kanye nomndeni wesishoshovu se-ANC, iNkosi Albert Luthuli ukuqalwa phansi kophenyo mayelana nokukhothama kwale ngqalabutho.Lokhu kushiwo yiMeya yaKwaDukuza uMnuz Ali Ngidi obekhuluma ngesikhathi kunomjaho oba khona minyaka yonke iLuthuli Walk okusuke kuhloswe ngayo ukukhumbula lesi sishoshovu. ''Manje ke yisona sikhathi ke lesi esesifikile sokuthi kuphume iqiniso ngokuthi kwenzekani kuLuthuli. Iqiniso ukuthi yinto engekho nje nhlobo le yokuthi washayiswa yisitimela kwakumane kukhohliswa thina nje sitshelwa lokho,'' usho kanjena.Uthe njengamanje umndeni ujabule ukholwa ukuthi kukhona okuzovela okusha mayelana nokubulawa kukaLuthuli.Ubuze ukuthi uma ashayiswa yisitimela uLuthuli pho inxeba ayekade enalo ngemuva esiphundu kwakungelani ?Wabuza nokuthi uma umuntu efe ngokushayiswa yisitimela kungenzeka kanjani ukuthi afihlwe umzimba wakhe ungalimele kakhulu?''Ukube kuyiqiniso ukuthi wabulawa ukushayiswa yisitimela ngabe kwakhulunywa ukuthi umzimba wakhe uLuthuli walimala waphela. Kodwa kakungenjalo ngoba vele kukhona lokhu esifihlelwa khona ngokufa kwakhe,'' usho kanjena.Bonke abasubathi ebebeyingxenye yalo mjaho uNkk Luthuli ubabongile kakhulu ngokuthi kube khona abakwenzayo ngenhloso yokukhumbula lesi sishoshovu.''Ngithanda ukubabonga bonke abasubathi njalo abaphumayo bezoba yingxenye yalo mjaho ngoba bayakuqonda ukuthi bakhumbula bani ngawo,'' usho kanjena.Abasubathi abenze kahle banikezwe izindondo. Lo mjaho ubuhlelwe ngokubambisana umasipala waKwaDukuza, iLuthuli Museuem, yiLembe Enterprise nabanye abaningi.

Mdluli iphume maqede kwanesithangami sabezindaba ebesibizwe wuKhomishana waPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uGeneral Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi. Uyiqale ngesingeniso esisuselwe engomeni yomculi wokholo waseZimbabwe uBryan K. Yilapho eveza khona ukuthi kungcole kwasani kuleli. Nasengomeni ethi Cross Night usaqhubeka nokudingida ngokwenzeka edolobheni londingasithebeni ababizwa ngamaphara. Engomeni esihloko sithi Ma11, uK.O. ucaphune ingxoxo yango-2008 yeLaw and Disorder in Johannesburg lapho uLouis Theroux ayekhuluma khona noMosimanegape "Maleven" Moleta owayegixabezwe ngesigwebo sentambo ngecala lokubulala ngo-2021.Usakhumbula ukuthi kwenzekani ngesikhathi uK.O. enze ingoma ethi SETE ngo-2022? Eculweni alenze nozakwabo uCassper Nyovest, uK.O. elithi Supernova, ufudumeze inoni lomculi ongasekho uLebo Mathosa elithi I Love Music. Yize le-albhamu imnandi yonke kodwa lengoma iyintandokazi yami.Okwenza lokho ukuthi ngangisithanda isigqi sengoma kaLebo. Singichazile isigqi sengoma ayenze neBlaq Diamond esihloko sithi Phara Love. Ezinye izingoma ezizokugeza ubebebe ngezithi Summer To Remember, No Chorus, Joina, GBS, Push It, California nethi Hush Money.Ngiyithandile ikhava ngoba isidweba siphelele isithombe sokuthi uK.O. uxoxa ngani ezingomeni eziqukethwe yile-albhamu. UMNDENI womlingisi wodumo lukaMadluphuthu, uVuyo Oscar Mgudlwa, ugonyuluke ngembangela yokushona kwalesi silomo. Izindaba zokudlula kwaleli ciko, elibuye lazakhela udumo engomeni kaSpikiri esihloko sithi Ngeke Balunge, zidalulwe yindodana yalo, u-Asanda Mgudlwa. "Uphumule ngokuthula baba. Ngiyakuthanda futhi ngiyohlale ngikuthanda, Madiba Dlomo," kubhala u-Asanda kwiFacebook.Umfowabo kamufi, uSipho Mgudlwa, ucashunwe emithonjeni yezindaba ethi uMadluphuthu ushonele esibhedlela iRosettenville, eGoli, ngoLwesithathu ekuseni, emuva kokugula isikhashana. USipho uthe uMadluphuthu ungeniswe esibhedlela emuva kokukhala ngenkinga yokuphefumula ngeSonto.Phakathi kwamaciko athumele umyalezo wenduduzo ngokudlula emhlabeni kukaMadluphuthu kubalwa uZola Hashatsi kaMotsiri othe ugqemeke udume lwengozi ngozakwabo ngoba ubewumngani futhi engumfowabo. UZola ubonge uMadluphuthu ngendima ayiklame emkhakheni wezokungcebeleka. "Ulale ngokuthula mfowethu, sibe nesikhathi esimnandi. Sengathi umndeni wakho, abangani nemboni kungaphola," kuphetha uZola.Umlingisi futhi ongumdidiyeli wamafilimu, uMandla N Ngcongwane, uthe ulahlekelwe umkhakha wezokulungisa ngoMadluphuthu ngoba ubengeyena kuphela usaziwayo kodwa ubengumthokozisi wabantu kunoma yikuphi lapho abehamba khona."Ubenekhono elingandile lokuthokozisa abantu ngisho nangesikhathi ezinzima kanjani," kusho uMandla N osebenze noMadluphuthu emidlalweni yakhe yethelevishini ekhonjiswa kwi-e.tv, Isitha neBlackdoor. UMandla N uthe ulahlekelwe wumuntu obengaphezu komngani."Ngilahlekelwe nguzakwethu wangempela kwezobuciko. Ubewumuntu ebengithembela kuye uma kuziwa ekubhaleni, ukubonisana ngamaqhinga. Besiphezu kokuqala omunye umsebenzi omkhulu. Ushiye umgodi ongeke wagqitshwa ngumuntu," kuphetha uMandla N.Umculi wekwaito kodwa oseyilungu lePhalamende, u-Eugene Mthethwa, uthe usebenze kakhulu noMadluphuthu emafilimini kaChicco Twala. Uthe uMadluphuthu ubenekhono lokukwazi ukwenza indawo ayilingisayo kube sengathi yimpilo ayiphilayo. Umchaze njengomuntu obezithobile yize abesedumile."Phezu kokuduma kwakhe kodwa ubengakaze wakhukhunyezwa wudumo. Ubehlonipha, ehlale ehleka nanoma wubani," kuphetha u-Eugene.UMadluphuthu wadunyiswa kakhulu yile ndawo kangangoba waze wadla izidlo nomengameli bezwe futhi nabesifazane bechazeka uma bembona. Uzalelwe eDaveyton, e-East Rand eminyakeni ewu-50 eyedlule. Uyise wamshiya eseneminyaka ewu-13 okwenza wagcina esekhuliswa wunina naye ongasekho. Kumthathe iminyaka ewu-15 ezama ukungena endimeni yezokungcebeleka. Ngo-1998, wake wenza i-albhamu neMina Nawe esihloko sithi Man Child.Abathandi bomculo wekwaito bazomkhumbula engomeni kaMapaputsi eyayithi Izinja Zakhona ngo-2001. Wazama ukukhipha ama-albhamu amabili kodwa abhacaza, okwamphoqa ukuba ayobamba itoho ePick n Pay. Kwaze kwaba ikhono lakhe libonwa nguChicco maqede uMadluphuthu wagqama esenguMadluphuthu efilimini eyayithi My Sht Father and My Lotto Ticket, elingisa nowayeyisiqongqwane se-Orlando Pirates, uSteven Mnguni, umculi uWinnie Khumalo, uNokwazi Dlamini noLucky Boy Mtshali owayedume ngelikaSdididi ngeminyaka yo-1980.Kusukela lapho akabange esabheka emuva. Uqophe amafilimu amaningi njengoba aze adlala nekwethi Ukufa KukaMadluphuthu. Emculweni ugcine esepikwa wuSpikiri engomeni ethi Ngeke Balunge, ehambisana noBrickz, Skhokho, Brown Dash, Skhokho, Ntukza nomfowabo uMa-E bodumo kwiTeargas.USipho uthe umufi ushiye emhlabeni abantwana abane, odadewabo abathathu nomfowabo. Kuze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela kungakaziwa ngezinhlelo zomngcwabo kamufi.
USUKHALELA ukuthola noma yithambo lothandiweyo wawo, osekuyophela iminyaka emibili "athunjwa ngabantu bendawo abaziwayo", umndeni waseKhombe, eMazizini, eBergville. UKhayelihle Hlatshwayo kuthiwa wathunjwa abantu bendawo abaziwayo efunda uGrade 10 esikoleni iTholithemba High ngoSepthemba 1, 2023. Ngokusho kukayise, uMnuz Mqiniseni Hlatshwayo, abasolwa balapho owayevame ukubamba khona itoho lokwakha izitini uma kuyimpelasonto, bafika bamcaphuna ngaphandle kwesikole ayefunda kuso bamfaka emotweni ababehamba ngayo. Uthe kuthiwa baya naye ekhaya labo lapho abafike bamshaya khona ngaphambi kokuba baye naye ehlathini lendawo, eselimele."Kuthiwa babemsola ngokweba isibhamu sakhona, okuthiwa salahleka egcekeni,” kusho uHlatshwayo.Uthe likhona ilungu lomphakathi elabatshela ukuthi abasolwa ababexhakathise indodana yakhe bazithela phezu kwalo ehlathini liyolanda izimbuzi zalo. "Wasitshela ukuthi umfana wami uphunyukile, wazomtshela ukuthi uthunjiwe. Washo ukuthi abathumbi bamfuna isibhamu abathi usebe ngesikhathi ezosebenza egcekeni labo,” kusho uHlatshwayo.Uveze ukuthi lona wesilisa wabatshela ukuthi uKhayelihle, owabuye wabanjwa abasolwa, wayelimele.Udalula ukuthi lolu lwazi baludlulisela emaphoyiseni, aqinisekisa ukuthi ngesikhathi eyophenya ekhaya labathintekayo kanjalo nasemotweni okuthiwa kwathunjwa ngayo umufi kwaficwa igazi. Uthe baboshwa abasolwa kodwa iNkantolo yeMantshi yaseBergville yabadedela, ithi abukho ubufakazi obenele ukuthi kungashushiswa."Phakathi kwezizathu eyazibeka, esokuthi njengoba isidumbu sikaKhayelihle singakaze sitholwe, akekho onesiqiniseko sokuthi wabulawa,” kubeka uyise kaKhayelihle.Uthe lokhu kwabalimaza njengomndeni ngoba bonke ubufakazi babukhomba ukuthi abasolwa babazi ukuthi uKhayelihle uphi. Uthe lokhu ukusho ngoba ngesikhathi beya emzini othintekayo, beyobuza ukuthi uKhayelihle uphi, umnikazi womuzi wabatshela ukuthi abakhululeke "ingane izobuya".Uthe unomuzwa wokuthi ezobulungiswa zibenzele phansi ngokudedela abasolwa ekubeni indodana yakhe ababeyithumbile ingakaze ibuye."Ngoba bonke ubufakazi bebukhona. Akukho esingakuhambisanga emaphoyiseni. Sajabha uma inkantolo ibadedela egameni lokuthi ubufakazi abeneke ukubashushisa,” usho kanje. Uthe asebekukhalela ukuthola ithambo lendodana yakhe ukuze bayifihle ngesizotha."Ngiyazi ukuthi amathuba okuthi iyaphila awekho. Engikucelayo ukuthi okungenani basho ukuthi bayigqibaphi,” kusho uHlatshwayo.Kuze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela amaphoyisa engakaphenduli.
AMAPHOYISA abophe abasolwa abangu-388 ezifundazweni ezahlukene selokhu kuqale inyanga ngamacala athinta ubugebengu bokuvukuza ngokungemthetho.Abasolwa baboshwe ngaphansi komkhankaso osabalele izwe iVala Umgodi.Baboshelwe amacala okuvukuza ngokungemthetho namanye athinta ukuphatha iziqhumane ngokungemthetho, ukutholakala nezibhamu ezingekho emthethweni, impahla okusolakala ukuthi yebiwe nokuphatha ngokungemthetho okuthwala igolide. Zine izibhamu ezingekho emthethweni ezishaqiwe, izinhlamvu ezingu-36, izimoto eziyisikhombisa, amaloli angu-13 nogadaganda ababili, ama-pendukas angu-166 nama-generator angu-43.Okhulumela amaphoyisa uLieutenant General Vincent Mukhathi uthe umkhankaso ngowaphakathi kukaJulayi 1 noJulayi 13.Uthe ngoJulayi 7 kuboshwe abasolwa abayisithupha abaneminyaka engu-18 no-27 eBoksburg ngokutholakala nezinto ezisetshenziswa emayini. EFree State kuboshwe abangu-87 abakuleli ngokungemthetho abatholakale nezibhamu ezingekho emthethweni nemishini yasemayini. Kuboshwe nabanye abahlanu abaneminyaka ephakathi kuka-27 no-29 ngokutholakala nezibhamu ezingekho emthethweni.ENorthern Cape kuboshwe abangu-15 ngamacala okuvukuza ngokungemthetho nomunye oneminyaka engu-23 oboshwe eSamaria ngecala elifanayo.Amaphoyisa aphinde abopha abanye abathathu eSabie, eMpumalanga.Abanye baboshwe eNorth West naseLimpopo.
UZOHANJISWA kudokotela ohlola ingqondo owesifazane waseMsinga, oboshelwe icala lokuklinya, abulale izingane zakhe eSankontshe, eNgonyameni, eMlaza, ngoMsombuluko.Umsolwa, uNksz Nelisiwe Nompilo Thusini (28), ubevele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMlaza izolo, kulandela ukuboshwa kwakhe ngoLwesibili.Kuthiwa waklinya wabulala indodana yakhe ebizohlanganisa izinyanga ezimbili izelwe, uNqobizitha Thusini nendodakazi yakhe ebineminyaka emibili, uNozibusiso Thusini. Izidumbu zabafi zatholwa abantu ababedlula ngendlela, zisongwe ngoblankethi owodwa, zashuthekwa inombolo yocingo kagogo wabo kanjalo nekayise. Evela enkantolo izolo ubezifihle ubuso ngesigqoko, amehlo ebonakala kancane.Isandla sobunxele besingasuki ebusweni uma ehleli phansi kanjalo nangesikhathi esemi phambi kwemantshi. Ubegqoke izingubo nezicathulo okumthuqasi, ungafunga ukuthi uvuka esikhotheni. Emva kokuveza ukuthi uzodinga ummeli kahulumeni, ummeli uNkk Shamika Sahdeo usukume waya kuye eyothola imininingwane yakhe.Isolezwe lizwe eqinisekisa ukuthi uneminyaka engu-28 futhi akasebenzi. Kuthe uNkk Sahdeo esembuza ukuthi unezingane ezingaki waphendula ngelithi: "angazi”.UMbuso ngomlomo kaMnuz Khulekani Mzotho uthe ucela lihlehliswe icala ngezizathu ezimbili azibekile."Phakathi kwazo wukuthi sifuna athunyelwe kudokotela wesifunda ohlola ingqondo,” kusho uMzotho, esinye esokuthi afake isicelo sebheyili. Uzwakalise ukuthi uma uNksz Thusini esefaka isicelo sebheyili, uMbuso uzosiphikisa ngoba ukholwa wukuthi angalibalekela icala. Kuthe utolika esemtolikela ukuthi uMzotho ubethini, uNksz Thusini oke wathula isikhashana, waphendula ngokubuza ukuthi kukhona yini utolika ambuza khona, utolika wamtshela ukuthi akukho, ubemhumushela obekushiwo. Imantshi, uMnuz Gqada ithe icala ilihlehlisela uJulayi 24 ukuze uNksz Thusini ayohlolwa ingqondo nokuthi azofaka isicelo sakhe sebheyili. Enkantolo yomibili imindeni, owakubo kwabafi (ohlangothini lakubo kayise wabafi) nowakubo kamsolwa, ibingabonwa. Bekukhona amalungu omphakathi ambalwa, athe afuna ukuzozibonela ngamehlo owesifazane athe ukhombise isihluku, ebulala izingane zakhe. Seliguqisiwe icala, iphoyisa selimthatha limbuyisela esitokisini, uvele wazimboza thaqa ubuso ngesigqoko abesigqokile. Wenze lokhu waze wacishe wayozishayisa odongeni, ezama ukugwema abezindaba ukuthi bangaqhubeki nokumthwebula izithombe kanjalo nama-video. Ngaphambi kokuba enze isigameko, kuthiwa wayefike eNgonyameni ngoLwesine, umamezala wakhe embize ukuthi azothi ukuhlala nabo kancane, esola ukuthi usentekenteke, kulandela ukubeletha umagcino wakhe ngoMeyi nonyaka.Kuthiwa uhlale izinsuku ezimbalwa ngaphambi kokuthi kuvukwe ngeSonto engasabonwa nazo zombili izingane endlini kayise wazo engaphandle. Kuthiwa ubhekwe yonke indawo engatholakali futhi engabambi ngisho ucingo.Kuvela ukuthi bekunguMsombuluko ekuseni ngesikhathi umndeni kayise wabafi uthola ucingo kumuntu ozithele phezu kwezidumbu zisongwe ngoblankethi, eceleni kwendlela.Lesi sakhamuzi kuthiwa sifonele umndeni ezinombolweni ebezishuthekwe kublankethi obekusongwe ngawo abafi.Umsolwa ugcine eboshwa amaphoyisa kubo eMsinga, lapho okuvela ukuthi bese ebalekele khona.
UKhomishana wesiFundazwe saKwaZulu-Natal uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi uhlanganyele noMqondisi-Jikelele woMnyango Wezemisebenzi Yomphakathi Nengqalasizinda (DPWI), uMnuz Sifiso Mdakane ekugubheni usuku lukaNelson Mandela esikhungweni e-SAPS Vehicle Pound eSiphingo, eningizimu yeTheku. Usuku lwaqala lapho u-DG Mdakane ehlinzeka ngenqubekelaphambili ekuvuselelweni okuqhubekayo kwephawundi eyalimala kakhulu ngesikhathi sezikhukhula zango-2022. UMqondisi-Jikelele uMdakane, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, kanye nethimba lonke le-noDPWI ne-SAPS KZN bahambe bezungeza iphawundi ngaphambi kokwenza imisebenzi yosuku lukaMandela ehlanganisa ukupenda izindonga nokuhlanza igceke. UMqondisi-Jikelele uMdakane uthembise ukuthi iSiphingo Vehicle Pound, engathwala izinkulungwane ezimbalwa zezimoto, izobuyela ekusebenzeni kwayo okuphelele futhi ethuthukisiwe ekupheleni kukaDisemba 2025, kanti ezinye izinsiza kusebenza ezibalulekile kulindeleke ukuthi ibuyiselwe ekupheleni kuka-Okthoba 2025.
KUPHAZAMISE ukulalelwa kwesicelo sebheyili ukushintshwa kwabameli ecaleni lowesilisa osolwa ngokwakha itulo lokubulala isihlobo sakhe esasiyibambabukhosi, futhi esake saphatha isikhundla sokuba yiphini likasihlalo we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal.Umsolwa, uMnuz Mzamo Mlaba, bekulindeleke ukuthi afake isicelo sakhe sebheyili eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMlaza izolo. Umufi, uMnuz Zibuse Mlaba, owayeyibambabukhosi lesizwe sakwaMlaba, KwaXimba, eCato Ridge, wadutshulwa wabulawa ngoyaba lwezinhlamvu yizinkabi okuthiwa zazithunywe wuMzamo eHillcrest ngo-Okthoba 2021. Umshushisi woMbuso u-Advocate Sanele Ntombela utshele inkantolo ukuthi abameli bakaMzamo sebemazise ngezinguquko ecaleni. Kube sekusukuma ummeli u-Advocate Van Schalkwyk SC eqinisekisa ukuthi kube khona izingxoxo ezijulile phakathi kwabo, ikhasimende labo nabanye abasondele. "Siyakuqinisekisa ukuthi siyahoxa kuleli cala,” kusho uVan Schalkwyk SC. Ummeli omusha uMnuz Sipho Mkhize ukuqinisekisile ukuthi nguye osezothatha izintambo ekumeleni uMzamo. "Sengixoxile nozakwethu ohlangothini loMbuso, ngihlongoza ukuthi icala lihlehliselwe uJulayi 23 kulo nyaka ukuze sifake isicelo sebheyili,” kusho uMkhize. Uthe ngalolu suku yena noMzamo bazobe sebeyibhalile incwadi efungelwe, bayinika uMbuso. UNtombela uthe unxuse ukuthi incwadi efungelwe uMkhize ayithumele ngesikhathi ukuze ezokwazi ukuyifunda.Uthe uma izobe inolwazi olusha kunalolo obelukulena ebilethwe abameli baphambilini, uzodinga isikhathi sokuthi acubungule. UMkhize uthembise ukuthi izobe isikuye ngoJulayi 21, 2025, wathi uzoyithumela nge-email. Imantshi, uMnuz Gqada, ithe ilihlehlisela uJulayi 23 icala ukuze uMzamo akwazi ukufaka isicelo sebheyili. Kuleli cala uMzamo afuna ukufaka isicelo sebheyili kulo, usolwa ngokudubula abulale inkabi, uMncedisi Gwala, okuthiwa wuye owadubula, wabulala uZibuse. Lokhu kuvela encwadini efungelwe kaFortune Dlamini, ongomunye wezinkabi "ezazithunywe" wuMzamo ukuthi ziyombulalela uZibuse, wazikhokhela u-R130 000. Kulesi sicelo udalula ukuthi kwathi sebembulele uZibuse uMzamo wabe esemyalela ukuba ahlele ukubulala uGwala. Siphinde siveze ukuthi emva kokubulawa kukaZibuse, uGwala waboshelwa ukubanjwa nesibhamu esingekho emthethweni nokuyilapho uMzamo okuthiwa wakhipha umyalelo wokuthi kubulawe uGwala. Ecaleni lokubulala uZibuse, uMzamo uboshwe noMthobisi Dubazana kanye noNhlanhla Hlongwa, okungezinye zezinkabi okuthiwa wazithumela.
