BAGUBUZELWE yifu lenhlupheko abangazi ukuthi liyogudluka nini, abagxumeke imijondolo yabo emathuneni aseCoedmore, eSeaview, eThekwini, abakhala ngokuthi bakhunjulwa kuphela ngabezepolitiki ababavakashela emathuneni uma kufanele babavotele. Kule mijondolo, okuthiwa yaqala ukwakhiwa kule ndawo ngo-1990, kuhlala imindeni engaphezu kuka-400, okukhona kuyo nezingane ezincane.Uma ungena kule ndawo okuthiwa kwakungcwatshwa kuyo abomdabu baseNdiya eminyakeni eminingi edlule, ukhangwa amatshe amathuna, okwakhiwe phezu kwawo imijondolo. Kokunye itshe lethuna ulifica likugqolozele emnyango womjondolo, ngesikhathi kokunye ulifica liphakathi emjondolo, kuhanjwa okanye kulalwa phezu kwalo. Akekho osazihlupha ngokucabanga ukuthi lena yindawo yabalele. Ngisho nezingane ezisencane, uzifica zidlala, zigijimisana phakathi naphezu kwawo, zingazi nanyaka. Ngakwesinye isakhiwo, kunethuna okubekwe ikhabethe phezu kwalo, kuqotshelwa phezu kwalo ukudla. Kukhona ngisho itshe lethuna elibhalwe ukuthi "Isikhumbuzo sikaS.C Chetty owashona ngoFebhuwari 9, 1941.Omunye wabahlali, uMnuz Mzosindiso Mtheli, ongowokuzalwa eMthatha, e-Eastern Cape, uthe yena akasakhumbuli nokuthi wafika ngamuphi unyaka ngendlela asehlale isikhathi eside ngayo emathuneni.Uthe zonke izingane ezikhona kule ndawo zazalelwa khona, wathi ezinye sezize zaqede ngisho isikole, ngesikhathi ezinye sezize zazala abazo abantwana. "Kade safika lana. Izikhulu zikahulumeni ziyafika nazo zisithembise izulu nomhlaba bese kuphelela emoyeni,” kusho uMtheli.Uthe kade befika, bababhalise, babathembise ukuthi bazokwakhelwa izindlu ndawana thize, basuswe emathuneni."Kunzima ukuhlala lana ngoba nemimoya yasemathuneni ayimihle. Siyahlala ngenxa yobunzima esibhekene nabo,” kusho yena. Uthe okwabasusa emakhaya ukuzozama amatoho njengoba engabonwa amafemu ngasemakubo."Uma ulana akufani ngoba uyalithola lelo toho lezinsuku noma izinyanga ezimbalwa,” usho kanje.Uthe abakufisayo ukuthi kufezekiswe izethembiso ezihlale zenziwa kubona njengoba nabo bengabavoti abavotayo uma kuwukhetho. Uthe nabamaqembu ehlukene epolitiki bahlale befika ukuzobanxenxa ukuthi basukume bayovota njalo uma kuzoba wukhetho, wathi njengoba nabo bengabantu ababazisayo abantu abashonile, akumnandi ukuhlala emathuneni."Siyafisa ukusuka kule ndawo, siyohlaliswa kwengcono,” usho kanje. Omunye umhlali, uNksz Buyelwa Ncedo wakuTsolo, e-Eastern Cape, othe yena wafika endaweni ngo-1995, uthe izihlobo zabangcwatshwa emathuneni abakhe phezu kwawo, zeza zakhathala zifika sekwakhiwe. Uthe azisezi nhlobo."Zakhathala ngoba zazibona ukuthi ayikho indlela yokuthi zibone amathuna ezihlobo,” kusho uNksz Ncedo.Uthe babengakaze babalwise noma babathathele izinyathelo ngoba babebona ukuthi le ndawo isiphenduke amakhaya abo. Okhulumela uMphathiswa woMnyango wezokuHlaliswa kwaBantu KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Siboniso Duma, uMnuz Ndabezinhle Sibiya, uthe usaxoxa no-Ayanda Msweli. "Bazohamba naye kanjalo nenhloko yomnyango bayobona khona. Okunye kuyomenyezelwa ngokubambisana neTheku,” kusho uSibiya.
Kubulawe indoda esigamekweni sokudubula eMontclair ngoLwesine ntambama. Umufi, ungiwesilisa oneminyaka ebalelwa ko-40 utholakale edindilizile emotweni kuMontclair Road, ngaphambi kwehora lesithathu ntambama ngoLwesine. Abezimo eziphuthumayo bakwa-ALS baphendule izingcingo eziningi zesigameko sokudubula endaweni edumile yokudla okusheshayo futhi bafike bathola imoto inenqwaba yezimbobo zenhlamvu endaweni yokupaka. Abezimo eziphuthumayo bahlole owesilisa obenamanxeba amaningi okudutshulwa emzimbeni wakhe. Lo mlisa ubenemihuzuko ebulalayo kanti akukho abezimo eziphuthumayo abebengamenzela khona kwabe sekumenyezelwa ukuthi ushonele endaweni yesigameko. Indawo yesigameko ivalwe ekhoneni ngabakwa-SAPS. Okwamanje izehlakalo ezandulela lesi sigameko azikaziwa nokho abeSAPS bakhona basazophenya kabanzi.
UNDUNANKULU waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, wethweswe ijoka lokuba avikele uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, ukuba angahlukunyezwa ngosopolitiki. Abeseka uMkhwanazi banxuse uNtuli ukuba angayivumeli imizamo yokulwiswa kukaMkhwanazi osanda kudedela amabhomu. Bakusho lokhu ngesikhathi benombhikisho eHhovisi likaNdunankulu, eMgungundlovu, izolo. Umbhikisho ubuhlelwe yinhlangano yamalungelo abantu edlelana neMK, iSA Coalition of Civil Society Organizations (Sacocso).Ababhikishi bathe banomuzwa wokuthi uMkhwanazi uzohlukunyezwa ngosopolitiki. UMkhwanazi wamangaza abaningi ngesikhathi ebiza isithangami nabezindaba, lapho asola khona uNgqongqoshe wezamaPhoyisa omisiwe, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, ngokuphazamisa ukusebenza kwengalo yomthetho nangokusondelana nezigebengu. Ozobamba esikhundleni sikaNgqongqoshe wezamaPhoyisa, uSolwazi Firoz Cachalia, uvele usekhonondile ngokuthi uMkhwanazi akazange elandele imigudu. UCachalia uthe uzofuna impendulo egcwele kuMkhwanazi uma eseqala emsebenzini ngenyanga ezayo.Ababhikishi bathe abafuni lutho oluzothinta uMkhwanazi."Sifuna ukuthi uNtuli avikele uMkhwanazi angahlukunyezwa ngosopolitiki noNgqongqoshe wezamaPhoyisa. Asifuni kube khona okumphazamisayo uMkhwanazi," kusho uhlu lwababhikishi.Ababhikishi bathe bazomvikela bona uMkhwanazi uma uNtuli ehluleka.Obambe kwesikamqondisi jikelele eHhovisi likaNdunankulu, uDkt Nkosenye Zulu, uqinise ababhikishi idolo.UZulu uthe uNtuli uyakholelwa kakhulu emagalelweni kaMkhwanazi."UNtuli uphumele obala, washo ukuthi usebenzisana kahle noMkhwanazi. UNtuli ushilo ukuthi uyafisa ukuthi uMkhwanazi aqhubeke nomsebenzi awenzayo."Ababhikishi bayalele uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, ukuba axoshe uMchunu.Umholi weSacocso, uMnuz Sizwe Ngubane, uthe akazi ukuthi kungani kuthiwa izinsolo ezenziwe uMkhwanazi zizophenywa ikhomishini ezoholwa yiphini lenhloko yamaJaji uMbuyiseli Madlanga."Yini lena ezophenywa? UMkhwanazi unabo bonke ubufakazi. Yini pho lena ezophenywa?"UMnuz Mlungisi Zondi weMK Labour Desk, uthe ukungaxoshwa kukaMchunu kuzomosha imali.UZondi uthe le mali emoshwayo kufanele engabe isetshenziselwa ukunyusa imiholo yamaphoyisa."Amaphoyisa ahola imali encane, ngapha kuzohohelwa ongqongqoshe abaningi. Kukhona omisiwe, obambile namaphini ongqongqoshe amabili. Bonke laba bantu bayahola. Uma ufika eziteshini zamaphoyisa kuthiwa izimoto ziyashoda, ezinye zifile. Ayikho imali yokuthenga noma yokulungisa izimoto kodwa kukhona imali emoshwayo."Ababhikishi banikeze uNtuli izinsuku ezimbili ukuba aphendule, basabisa ngemibhikisho uma bengayitholi impendulo.
IZINKINGA zemali kungenzeka ziphazamise ukulalelwa kwesicelo sebheyili kaMnuz Mzamo Mlaba, osolwa ngecala lokwakha itulo lokubulala owayeyiphini likasihlalo we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Zibuse Mlaba namuhla.UMzamo, oyisihlobo sikaZibuse, owayephinde abe yibamba bukhosi lesizwe sakwaMlaba, KwaXimba, ngaseCamperdown, kuthiwa waqasha izinkabi ukuthi zidubule zibulale umufi.Kuthiwa yena uMzamo wabe esebekwa icala lokudubula abulale eyodwa yalezo zinkabi, uMnuz Mncedisi Gwala. Ngokwesicelo sikaFortune Dlamini, ongomunye wezinkabi ezazithunywe wuMzamo ukuthi ziyombulalela umfowabo uZibuse, wakhokha uR130 000. Kulesi sicelo uDlamini udalule ukuthi emva kokuba bembulele uZibuse ngo-Okthoba 21, 2021, uMzamo wabe esemyalela ukuba yena (uDlamini) ahlele ukubulala uGwala. Siqhuba sithi kukhona isikhathi lapho emva kokubulawa kukaZibuse, uGwala waboshwa, eboshelwa ukubanjwa nesibhamu esingekho emthethweni. Sibuye siveze ukuthi babuye bathola nokuthi amaphoyisa aqoqa nobufakazi bolibofuzo endaweni yesigameko (okwabulawa kuyo uZibuse) nokuyilapho ke uMzamo ayalela ukuthi uGwala kufanele abulawe.UMzamo ufaka isicelo sebheyili ngecala lokubulala uGwala eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMlaza. Ecaleni lokubulala uZibuse, uMzamo uboshwe noMthobisi Dubazana noNhlanhla Hlongwa, izinkabi okuthiwa wazithumela. Kuleli cala elalihleli eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseCamperdown, wavele wasilaxaza isicelo sebheyili, icala lakhe ladluliselwa eNkantolo yesiFunda saseCamperdown. Izolo ekuseni, isicelo sebheyili sikaMzamo asibange sisaqhubeka njengoba bekulindelwe. Umshushisi woMbuso u-Advocate Sanele Ntombela utshele inkantolo ukuthi bayitholile incwadi efungelwe kaMzamo, kubameli bakhe ngoMsombuluko, beyithumela nge-email. Kuvele ukuthi nakuba kunjalo, abakwazanga ukuyivula kwaze kwashaya uLwesibili."Umphenyi wecala uchithe isikhathi efunda incwadi efungelwe, wathi udinga ukuqinisekisa izinto ezimbalwa eminyangweni,” usho kanje.UNtombela uphinde wathi kudingeka ukuthi uMbuso uphendule encwadini efungelwe, kufanele lokhu kwenzeke ngoLwesithathu noma ngoLwesine ekuseni ungakashayi u-7 ekuseni. Ummeli kaMzamo, u-Advocate Van Schalkwyk SC, utshele inkantolo ukuthi bathe ukukubambezela ukubiza icala enkantolo ngoba incwadi efungelwe bekufanele ayisayine uMzamo, futhi bebesaxoxisana naye."Kube khona ushintsho encwadini efungelwe, ngimazisile uzakwethu ngalokhu," etshela inkantolo.UVan Schalkwyk uthe bayathemba ukuthi konke okubalulekile kuzophothulwa namuhla futhi bazonikezela ngokusemthethweni izincwadi ezifungelwe ezingamaphepha ngesandla enkantolo. Zombili izinhlangothi, oloMbuso nolwabameli zenze isicelo sokuthi icala lihlehliselwe usuku lwanamuhla kuze kuqale ukulalelwa kwesicelo sebheyili.Kuthe inkantolo isathi ufuna ukuphendula, uMzamo wabonakala ephakamisa isandla, wathi ufuna ukusho okuthile. UVan Schalkwyk usukume masinyane waya kuye, ehambisana nommeli asebenzisana naye u-Arvina Harrichran.Emva kwalokho, uVan Schalkwyk ekhuluma nenkantolo uthe: "Ukuma kwethu kungenzeka kuphazamiseke ngenxa yemali kodwa sizoqhubeka kusasa (esho namuhla) udaba.” Ngesikhathi inkantolo iliguqisa icala, uMzamo ubengasakwazi nokulinda ukuthi ahambe. Uze wabuza ephoyiseni ukuthi usengahamba yini.
USASHAQEKILE namanje umndeni wowesilisa waseNgonyameni, eMlaza, kulandela isigameko sowesifazane (28) waseMsinga, okuthiwa ubulale izingane zakhe azizala khona ngoMsombuluko.Kulesi sigameko kuthiwa kubulawe ngokuklinywa ingane yomfana, uNqobizitha Thusini obezohlanganisa izinyanga ezimbili ezelwe izolo neyentombazane, uNozibusiso Thusini oneminyaka emibili.Izidumbu zabo zitholwe ngabantu ebebedlula ngendlela eSinkotshe, eNgonyameni, ngoMsombuluko. Ngokusho kukagogo wazo (ozala uyise), uNkk Nelisiwe Mkhize, zitholwe zisongwe ndawonye ngoblankethi owodwa esikhotheni esiseceleni komgwaqo. Phakathi kublankethi kuthiwa bekushuthekwe iphepha elibhalwe inombolo yeselula yakhe uNkk Mkhize kanjalo nekayise wazo, okuthiwa ngokomsebenzi uhlala eGoli. Elandisa ngesehlakalo, uNkk Mkhize uthe umsolwa ongunina wezingane, ufike nabo eNgonyameni, ngoLwesine, esuka endlini kayise wezingane eseZwelisha, eNanda. "Ubehlala nazo eZwelisha endlini yendodana yami. Ngathi uma ngikhuluma naye ocingweni, ngathola ukuthi usentekenteke njengoba ubesanda kuteta. Ngibe sengimyalela ukuthi akake eze ngapha isikhashana, khona sizoba sonke,” kusho uNkk Mkhize. Uqhube wathi ubede evuka njalo ekuseni ayombheka endlini yendodana yakhe engaphandle ukuthi balale kanjani nezingane."NgeSonto, ngivuke ngenza okufanayo kodwa ngamangazwa ukuthi yena nezingane ababonwa,” usho kanje. Uthe uqaphele ukuthi izimpahla zabo bobathathu zikhona, wathi uzamile ukumthola ocingweni kodwa belukhala engalubambi, wathi uthe uma efonela omakhelwane baseZwelisha, ebuza ukuthi ukhona yini, nabo balandula."Ntambama (ngeSonto) wafonela indodana yami, wathi ucela ukuvalelisa, uyazibulala ngoba ayifunanga ukudayisa umuzi waseZwelisha ukuze bezoyokwakha kwenye indawo,” usho kanjena. Uthe udaba lokudayiswa kwendlu yinto aqale ukuyikhuluma ngonyaka odlule, kodwa uyise wezingane wangayinaka ngoba engaboni kuwumqondo ophusile.Eqhubeka nokulandisa, uthe babizelwe endaweni yesigameko ngamalungu omphakakthi, afonele izinombolo zabo zamaselula umsolwa abezishutheke kublankethi abegoqe ngawo abafi. "Eyodwa ingane ibiphuma igazi ngamakhala, zinemihuzuko yokuklinywa emqaleni futhi zivuvukele,” kusho uNkk Mkhize. Udalule nokuthi ngesikhathi besashaqeke kanjalo endaweni yesigameko, kufike izingane zendawo, ezithe zithunywe unina wezingane ukuthi zizobheka ukuthi sebezitholile yini izingane."Uphinde wafonela noyise wazo khona lapho, ebuza ukuthi siyazithola yini, sithe siyabheka, nanguya ebhulohweni. Amaphoyisa athe ayamlandelela, angamthola,” kusho uNkk Mkhize. Udalule ukuthi unina wezingane ubenakho ukukhuluma izinto ezethusayo uma evukwe yiconsi. "Ubethi uma esukwe yizinto zakhe, athi ufuna ukuzibulala yena konke nezingane,” kusho yena.Uthe bashaqekile ngakwenzile, ebulala izingane ezincane kangaka ngesihluku. "Indodana yami ayikwazi ngisho ukukhuluma kulandela isigameko. Sishaqekile futhi siphatheke kabi,” usho kanje. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa aseBhekithemba aphenya amacala amabili okubulala kulandela ukutholwa kwengane enezinyanga ezimbili neneminyaka emibili zifile esikhotheni eSinkontshe, eNgonyameni, ngoMsombuluko."Amaphoyisa abizelwe esigamekweni lapho kutholwe khona izidumbu ezimbili zezingane ebezinezibazi zokulimala emakhanda,” kusho uNetshiunda.Uthe imbangela yokubulala ayikaziwa okwamanje. Nakuba uNetshiunda engayiqinisekisanga eyokuboshwa kukanina wabafi kodwa umthombo weSolezwe uthe useboshiwe.Uthe ukusebenza kophiko lweCrime Intelligence ngokubambisana nolwe-Organized Crime kwiSAPS, kuholele ekutheni umsolwa alandwe kubo eMsinga emva kokuthola umkhondo wokuthi usebalekele khona.
UZOQHUBEKA nomsebenzi wakhe wasePhalamende nakwi-ANC uNgqongqoshe wezamaPhoyisa onikwe ikhefu elikhethekile, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu.UNobhala jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, uthe uMchunu uzokuma kuphela esikhundleni sokuba wungqongqoshe.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba emva komhlangano wekomiti elibhekelele ukusebenza kwansuku zonke kwi-ANC. UMchunu unikezwe ikhefu lesikhashana emva kwezinsolo ezishaqisayo ezenziwe nguKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, osole uMchunu ngokusondelana nezigebengu eziphazamisa ukusebenza kwamaphoyisa.Ngaphandle kokuba ungqongqoshe, uMchunu uyilungu lePhalamende aphinde abe yilungu lekomiti elibhekelele ukusebenza kwansuku zonke kwi-ANC.UMbalula uthe uMchunu uzoqhubeka kulezi zikhundla ezimbili. Ubuye wathi ubelindele ukuthi uMchunu ahambele umhlangano wekomiti elibhekelele ukusebenza kwansuku zonke kwi-ANC obungoMsombuluko. "Ulethe isixoliso. Ngimtshelile ukuthi ikhefu elikhethekile aliwuthinti umsebenzi wakhe wakwi-ANC. Kufanele aqhubeke nomsebenzi wakhe wakwi-ANC. Silindele ukuthi azosichazela ngezinsolo ezibhekiswe kuyena."UMbalula uthe uMchunu usazoqhubeka nokubonakala ePhalamende."Ongqongqoshe bangamalungu ePhalamende. UMchunu akamisiwe. Uzoqhubeka nokuhambela imihlangano yasePhalamende nokwenza yonke imisebenzi yakhona." UMbalula uthe bebengakahlangani noMchunu ukuba abachazele ngalezi zinsolo abhekene nazo."Sizohlangana naye maduze. Kade simatasa njengoba besiseMpumalanga. Okufanele sikusho-ke kodwa ukuthi angeke senze okuphambene nomthetho."UMchunu uchithe amahlebezi okuthi ikomiti lezobuqotho kwi-ANC linqume ukuthi ashenxe esikhundleni.UMbalula uncome indlela uMengameli wezwe asingathe ngayo udaba lukaMchunu njengoba eqoke ikhomishini ezophenya izinsolo."URamaphosa akenzi izinto ngoba nakhu efuna ukubukwa, ulandela umthetho. Siyishayela ihlombe imizamo yakhe yokubuyisa isithunzi sezwe. Siyazi ukuthi abantu bafuna ukuthi kuthathwe izinyathelo ngokushesha. Sonke sifuna ukubona kuthathwa izinyathelo ngokushesha kodwa-ke akufanele kunyathelwe amalungelo abantu."UMbalula uphinde wamemezela ukuhlehliswa komhlangano wesigungu esiphezulu obuzokuba kule mpelasonto.Umhlangano uhlehliswe ngenxa yokuthi abaholi be-ANC bafuna ukuzinikeza isikhathi sokulungisa ubudlelwano babo namadlelandawonye kanye namaqembu abambisene nawo kuhulumeni.Idlelandawonye le-ANC, iSACP, lifuna ukungenela ukhetho lohulumeni basekhaya ngokuzimela.Nakuhulumeni wokubambisana akukuhle njengoba i-ANC ijwayele kakhulu ukuphikisana neDA."Sinqume ukuthi sizinikeze isikhathi sokuthi sibhekane nalezi zinkinga."
ZITHUSE abaningi izindaba zokudlula emhlabeni komlingisi wamafilimu amahlaya u-Oscar Mgudlwa, wodumo lukaMadluphuthu efilimini eyayithi My Sht Father and My Lotto Ticket.Izindaba zokushona kukaMadluphuthu ziqale ukusabalala namhlanje ntambama. Kule filimu wayelingisa nowayeyisiqongqwane se-Orlando Pirates uSteven Mnguni owayelingisa indawo kayise nomculi uWinnie Khumalo noNolwazi Dlamini, owayedlala indawo kanina. UMadluphuthu wabuye wabamba iqhaza nasemculweni, abaningi bazomkhumbula engomeni kaSpikiri ethi Ngeke Balunge, lapho ayehambisana khona noBrown Dash nabanye. Kuze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela kungakatholakali isitatimende sabomndeni ngaphandle kwe-poster eyenziwe yinkampani yabangcwabi.
APHENDUKE ihlaya amalungu eMK esiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal ephikisana wodwa phambi kwezimbangi zawo ezinkulu. Uqhekeko kwabeMK luhlale obala ngesikhathi behluleka ukuzibamba, baphikisana phambi kwamaqembu aphethe ngokubambisana KwaZulu-Natal.Amalungu eMK avote ngokwehlukana ngesikhathi kuvotelwa uhlaka lwesabelomali esiShayamthetho, izolo.Ukuvota ngokwehlukana kwamalungu eMK kuwaphendule inhlekisa emaqenjini abusa ngokubambisana KwaZulu-Natal, i-IFP, ANC, DA neNFP.I-MK iyizimbangi ezinkulu zala maqembu njengoba ihlezi ikusho ukuthi ifuna uhlakazeke uhulumeni ophethwe yila maqembu ehlukene.Kumangale abaningi ngesikhathi amalungu amahlanu eMK eqoka ukuphikisana nomyalelo kaSotswebhu weqembu osanda kuqokwa, uMnuz Bonginkosi Mngadi, ngesikhathi kuvota.Amalungu esiShayamthetho abezonikeza umyalelo amalungu oMkhandlu weziFundazwe aKwaZulu-Natal ukuthi kufanele avote kanjani uma sekuphasiswa isabelomali ePhalamende.UMngadi umemezele ukuthi beyiMK bafuna ukuthi amalungu aqhamuka KwaZulu-Natal afike avumelane nokuphasiswa kwesabelomali.Amalungu amaqembu abusa ngokubambisana nawo avote ngendlela efanayo nalena okuvote ngayo uMngadi.Amalungu amahlanu abe wona esephakamisa izandla, aphikisana nokushiwo uMngadi.Amalungu eMK aphikisene nokushiwo uMngadi iloyo obenguSotswebhu omkhulu weqembu ngoMnuz Mervyn Dirks, Nksz Patience Gamede, Mnuz Simphiwe Mbatha, Mnuz Bonginkosi Mkhize, noMnuz Sithembiso Magubane.I-MK inamalungu angu-38 esiShayamthetho, onke amanye amalungu avumelane nomyalelo kaMngadi.Bagcine bedliwa yivoti laba abaphikisane noMngadi njengoba iningi lamalungu esiShayamthetho livumelane ngokuthi amalungu oMkhandlu weziFundazwe avotele ukuphasiswa kwesabelomali.Okuqaphelekayo ngabaphikisane noMngadi ukuthi bonke basanda kudilizwa ezikhundleni. UDirks usanda kudilizwa kwesikasotswebhu omkhulu, kwaqokwa uMngadi.UMbatha, Mkhize noMagubane bake baba osostwebhu ngaphambilini.Izimpi zidla lubi kwiMK njengoba sekuyinsakavukela ukudilizwa kwabaholi ezikhundleni.UMngadi wenqabile ukuphawula ngalolu daba."Ngeke ngiphawule kakhulu ngezinto ezithinta iqembu. Indlela esivote ngayo ayikashintshi. Sivote ngale ndlela esivote ngayo. Sineqembu okuyilona elisiphethe. Ngenxa yokuvikela isithunzi seqembu, ngizocela ukuma lapho."Ebuzwa ukuthi bebevumelane ngokuthi bazovota kanjani ngaphambi kokuqala komhlangano, uMngadi ukhale ngokuba matasa, wacela ukuba abuye afonelwe.Emva kokuvota, amalungu amaqembu aphikisayo ahlekise ngoqhekeko oludla lubi kwiMK.Okhulumela i-DA kwezezimali, uMnuz Tim Brauteseth, uthe ukuvota ngokwehlukana kwamalungu eMK kukhombisa ngokusobala ukuthi izinto zimayakayaka kuleli qembu okuyilo eliphikisayo."Le nto isikhombisa ngokusobala ukuthi kunohlangothi oluzenzela umathanda kwiMK. Lokhu kusho ukuthi leli qembu alikwazi ukwenza kahle umsebenzi walo njengeqembu eliphikisa ngokusemthethweni."
UBESANDA kukhuzwa ngomkhuba wokubhala izincwadi, eshela umzukulwana (12) wesaguga (70) okuthiwa usibulale ngesihluku eMphazima, eMondlo, owesilisa obezenza umfundisi. Umufi kuthiwa utholwe esethule ngeSonto, ngasethoyilethi lomgodi ekhaya lakhe enamanxeba okuklinywa nokudutshulwa. Umsolwa naye kuthiwa ubanjwe ngosuku olufanayo eMgabadeli, eJozini, lapho ebesebalekele khona ehamba nabazukulwana bakamufi ababili. Kubona kukhona lona okuthiwa ubede embhalela izincwadi emshela, okuvela ukuthi umdlwengulile, kanjalo nomunye oneminyaka emine. Isihlobo esisondelene kakhulu nabathintekayo siveze ukuthi bese kunesikhathi umsolwa ebhala izincwadi, abuye azishutheke o-chocolate eshela umgilwa (12)."Ngacela umufi ukuthi akayikhuze le nto. Kodwa ngibuye ngathola ukuthi iyaqhubeka njengoba umgilwa engifonele ngoLwesihlanu ekhala, ethi usecela ukuyohlala kubo kayise ngoba 'umfundisi' usaqhubeka nokumbhalela izincwadi,” kudalula isihlobo. Sithe sithathe ucingo sashayela umufi, simtshela ukuthi akaphinde akhuze umsolwa. Kasigcinanga lapho, sibuye samshayela ngokwaso, simtshela ukuthi akahlukane phansi nengane."Akazange aphike,” kusho isihlobo.Sithe bekunguMgqibelo ngesikhathi sithola ukuthi umufi nabazukulwana banyamalele. "Ngibafonele kodwa lutho ukubathola ezingcingweni. Ngize ngathuma isihlobo ukuthi siyongibhekela, sabuyisa nomyalezo othi abekho futhi kukhiyiwe ekhaya,” kubeka isihlobo.Sithe sigcine sinikela ekhaya ngeSonto, nokuyilapho esizithele khona bezu kwamaphoyisa ehlola indawo yesigameko, lapho okutholwe khona umufi esebanda.Siveza ukuthi besisakhungathwe yilokho ngesikhathi kungena ucingo luvela eJozini, kuthiwa izingane zikhona futhi nomsolwa usebanjwe ngamalungu eCommunity Policing Forum (CPF). "Kuthiwa ufike nezingane ngoMgqibelo, wathi ngezakhe. Kuthiwa umgilwa (12) ubenele ambone esithela atshele izihlobo zikamsolwa ukuthi ucela zimfonise, ufuna ukukhuluma nonina,” kusho isihlobo.Sithe umndeni kamsolwa uqale wangamnaka umgilwa, kwaze kwaba uyayibhadlaza indaba yokuthi ubathumbile."Kuthiwa yilapho umndeni uvele wabiza khona iCPF, laphuma kanjalo iqiniso ngaye,” kuchaza isihlobo. Sithe umgilwa (12) ubatshele ukuthi waqale wamklinyela endlini phambi kwabo umufi, kwathi esebona ukuthi usefile, wase emhudulela ngasethoyilethi, nokuyilapho afike wamdubulela khona, wase ebashaqa, wakhiya, zaya.Udalule ukuthi umphakathi ubumkhululekele njengoba ubengakhombisi ukuthi uyisigebengu."Esikwaziyo ukuthi ubezipha isikhundla sokuba ufundisi kuleli sonto abesonta kulo. Kodwa yena ubejwayelene nawo wonke umuntu njengoba nomufi ubemthatha njengomngani wasendaweni,” usho kanje.Uthe abagilwa bebevele besonta kuleli sonto ngaphambi kokuba afike umsolwa azosonta kulo naye.
ZISABISE ngokhukhulelangoqo wesiteleka sikazwelonke izinhlangano ezehlukene ezigcwale izitaladi zeTheku izolo, zimashela ukuthi kuhlukanwe phansi noKhomishana wamaPhoyisa kwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi. Nihlale niziphethe kahle kanje. Ayikho into elungiswa ngokulwa,” kusho uMasemola.Wethembise ukuthi uhlu lwezikhalazo zabo uzoluhambisa ehhovisi elifanele, wathi amaphoyisa ayaqhubeka nokwenza umsebenzi wawo, wanxusa umphakathi ukuthi uqhubeke nokuweseka.

NgoMgqibelo kuzophinde kube nenkonzo yesikhumbuzo emzini kaGumbi oseStanderton ngo-3 ntambama bese ngeSonto ebandleni likaMbhishophi Mkhwane iChurch Combined Spiritual Feast & U-"Amen Usekhona" kube nenkonzo yesikhumbuzo ngo-3 ntambama. NgoMsombuluko kuzophinde kube nomthandazo ohambisana nomlindelo phakathi kuka-6 no-8 ebusuku. UGumbi (66), owazakhela udumo ohlelweni loKhozi FM UNkulunkulu Nomuntu Omusha futhi edume ngombuzo othi "Usekhona u-Amen?", udlule emhlabeni ngoMsombuluko, ngezithuba zabo-8.30 ebusuku. Izindaba zokushona kwaleli qhawe kwezenkolo zimenyezelwe ngozibize ngendodana kaGumbi, uMfu Nhlapho. Uthe ukufa kumenele uGumbi emuva kokugula isikhathi eside. SABELO MBATHAKUTHIWA uhlanze lonke iqiniso umsebenzi wophiko lwezamanzi kuMasipala weTheku oboshwe ngoLwesihlanu, ngezinsolo zokweba udizili okuthiwa ubewukhipha elolini lamanzi abelishayela.Umsolwa osevelile enkantolo, uboshwe amaphoyisa esemzini wakhe eHammarsdale, nezigubhu ezingamalitha awu-25 eziwu-21 ebezigcwele udizili. Kuthiwa uzivumele yena ukuthi sekunezinyanga ezintathu enza lo mkhuba osudle umasipala imali elinganiselwa ku-R 900 000.Umqondisi weCity Integrity and Investigations Directorate, uMnuz Jimmy Ngcobo, ukuqinisekisile ukuboshwa kwalo msolwa nokuthi uzivumele ukugila lo mkhuba."Lesi isenzo esicacile sokuphikisana nemizamo yethu yokulwa nomkhonyovu nenkohlakalo. Umsolwa uvumile ukuthi uyazi ngabanye abashayeli bamaloli amanzi ababanjwe bentshontsha udizili emalolini amanzi kamasipala," kusho uNgcobo.Ekuqaleni kwale nyanga, kuboshwe abasebenzi bakamasipala ababili eMbumbulu ngamacala afanayo. NgoJuni nonyaka, kubanjwe oqotsheni owesilisa obezenza umsebenzi kamasipala efaka udizili egaraji okwetha kulo izimoto zomkhandlu.Esinye isigameko esenzeke ngoMeyi, kubanjwe abasebenzi ababili bakamasipala emzini othile bethulula udizili kanti omunye uboshwe ngoFebhuwari, emva kokuba ilungu lomphakathi lihlabe umkhosi.Ezinyangeni ezidlule, abasebenzi abaningi bakamasipala babanjwe bentshontsha udizili ezimotweni zomkhandlu bezowudayisa. Ngenyanga edlule, kwabikwa ukuthi izisebenzi zikamasipala ezimbili zaboshwa emva kokubanjwa zintshontsha udizili okwakufanele usetshenziswe wumkhandlu. Umasipala wakuqinisekisa ukuthi baboshwa eKukhanyeni, ngaseVerulam, emva kokuba abaphenyi belandele imibiko ngokusolisayo okuthinta amaloli athwala amanzi kamasipala. Elinye iloli lamanzi likamasipala labanjwa lithulula udizili emzini othile ngesikhathi elinye limi ngasesangweni lawo lo muzi. Kuthiwa lawa maloli ayethwele amanzi okwakufanele ayiswe emiphakathini.Ezinyangeni ezinhlanu ezidlule, kwabikwa ukuthi ukuthuthwa kwamanzi kwamiswa ngenxa yokushoda kukadizili edepho yase-Ottawa. Ababili ababanjwe kuleli sonto baboshwe eMbumbulu.UNgcobo uthe abanye abasebenzi basembhidlangweni wokuqumba phansi umasipala ngakwezezimali, wagcizelela ukuthi uphiko lwakhe luphenya amacala ahlukene okweba okuhlanganisa udizili, ukhonkolo, amabhethri ezimoto, usimende, amaphepha, umkhonyovu wokuthengwa kwempahla nokunye.Ubonge umphakathi ngokuhlale uqaphile nokubika izigameko zomkhonyovu wengeza ngokuthi umasipala usuthathe isinqumo sokungawubekezeleli umkhonyovu nenkohlakalo. ABE-SOUTH African Social Security Agency (Sassa) banxuse abahola izibonelelo zikahulumeni ukuba babambisane nabo njengoba kuqhubeka uhlelo lokubuyekezwa kwalabo abahlomulayo.Lokhu kushiwo yisikhulu esiphezulu seSassa, uMnuz Themba Matlou, ngesikhathi kuqhubeka isithangami nabezinda eHatfield, ePitoli, izolo.UMatlou uthe bafuna ukuqondisa ukudideka okukhona, wathi njengamanje abangu-210 000 abahlomula esibonelelweni sabangasebenzi abababuyekezayo, esibalweni sabangu-19 million abathola izinhlobo ezahlukene zezibonelelo. "Ababuyekezwayo yilesi sibalo esincane kulandela ukuvela kolwazi lokuthi akufanele bahlomule ngoba kukhona enye imali engenayo eceleni,” kusho uMatlou, othe kwabanye leyo mali ingena ngoba bayasebenza ezindaweni ezithize. Uthe bezingakabi bikho izikhawu lapho kuba khona abangakhokhelwa izibonelelo, nokho wathi uma bethola ukuthi umuntu akasafanele ukuhola isibonelelo, nakanjani bazosinqamula."Ubengakabi bikho osenqanyulelwe isibonelelo okwamanje,” kusho uMatlou. Uthe okwamanje bebesathumele imiyalezo esibalweni sabathize, ababathatha njengesigaba sokuqala ngoJuni. Wathi yilabo asebethunyelelwe le miyalezo okufanele beze amahhovisi abo ukwenza uhlelo lokubuyekeza. "Sibanqumele isikhathi. Uma sidlula leso sikhathi, bengezi, izibonelelo zabo zizonqanyulwa ke. Zizobe zinganqanyulwa ngoba bengafanele wukuhlomula, kodwa zizobe zinqanyulwa ngoba bengazibandakanyanga nohlelo lokubuyekeza,” usho kanje. Uthe njengoba besaqhubeka nohlelo lokubuyekeza, bazowazisa umphakathini ukuthi sebebuyekeze abantu abangaki, imiphumela yakhona ithini kanjalo nesibalo sabantu abazoqhubeka bathole isibonelelo nalabo esizonqanyulwa esabo. "Lolu lwazi sizolukhipha ekupheleni kukaJulayi,” kusho uMatlou. Uthe abahlomula ngezibonelelo baphoqwa wumthetho ukuthi badalule uma sekukhona imali abayitholayo noma uma kuba khona ushintsho emalini."Lokhu kwenzelwa ukuthi usizo lukahulumeni luye ebantwini abafanele futhi abaludinga ngempela,” usho kanje.
ONGOTI bezomthetho bathi uxamu ugeje umgodi kuMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, oqoke umuntu ongesilona ilungu lePhalamende ukuba abambe isikhundla sikaNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa.Ongoti, uMnuz Melusi Xulu weDonda Attorneys noMnuz Mpumelelo Zikalala weZikalala Attorneys, bathe ukuqokwa kukaSolwazi Firoz Cachalia, ukuba abambe isikhundla sikaNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa kuphambene nomthetho.UXulu uthe isigaba 91(3) (c) somthetho sivumela uRamaphosa ukuba aqoke umuntu ongesilona ilungu lePhalamende ukuba aphathe isikhundla sikangqongqoshe ngokugcwele, hhayi umuntu ozobamba."Akukho okukhuluma ngebamba likangqongqoshe kulesi sigaba somthetho esivumela umengameli ukuba aqoke ungqongqoshe ongelona ilungu lePhalamende. Uma abameli bethu sebesilulekile sifuna ukulufaka ezithebeni zeNknatolo yoMthethosisekelo lolu daba. Okumele ngikusho wukuthi lolu daba sizolulwa ezinkantolo, ePhalamende, siphinde sibe nemibhikisho."UNdhlela uthe bafuna nokuthi uRamaphosa ahoxise isinqumo sakhe sokuthi uzoqoka ikhomishini ezophenya izinsolo.UNdhlela uthe amakhomishini amosha imali."Kugcina kungaboshwa muntu emva kwamakhomishini. Le khomishini izophazamisa ukusebenza kwamaphoyisa."UNdhlela uthe bafuna ukuthi baboshwe ngokushesha bonke abathinteka ezinsolweni ezenziwe wuMkhwanazi.Amalungu eMK aqhubekile nemibhikisho yokuzwelana noMkhwanazi.Izolo bekunemibhikisho eThekwini naseGoli, lapho amalungu eMK ezwakalise ukweseka uMkhwanazi.Okhulumela i-EFF, uMnuz Sinawo Thambo, uthe ukuqokwa kukangqongqoshe obambile kuzoholela ekumoshweni kwemali njengoba uMchunu ezoqhubeka nokuthola imihlomulo yakhe."UMchunu uzoqhubeka ahole, ngapha sizoba nongqongqoshe obambile oqokwe ngendlela engekho emthethweni. Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bazoholela umuntu osolwa ngobugebengu. Lo muntu uphila impilo ewubukhazikhazi. Ukuqhubeka kwakhe nokuhola kuzomnika namandla okuthi akwazi ukuphazamisa uphenyo."UThambo uthe bafuna ukuthi uMchunu axoshwe."UMchunu ubhekene nezinsolo ezibucayi. Usolwa ngokuhlakaza ithimba eliphenya ngokubulawa kosopolitiki KwaZulu-Natal. Uphinde asolwe ngokuba mdibi munye nesigebengu esithola amathenda emaphoyiseni, uMnuz Vusumuzi 'Cat' Matlala. UMchunu wumuntu wokuthi aboshwe nje."
UMENGAMELI, uCyril Ramaphosa, uqoke uNgqongqoshe wezokuMbiwa Phansi, uMnuz Gwede Mantashe, ukuba abambe isikhundla sikangqongqoshe wezamaPhoyisa. UMantashe uzobamba lesikhundla kuze kuphele inyanga. UMNYANGO wokuHlaliswa kwaBantu KwaZulu-Natal, usuthenge iMontclair Lodge okwakungeyakwaTransnet, eThekwini ukuze kuhlaliswe kuyo abakhahlanyezwa yizikhukhula.Lokhu kumenyezelwe wuMphathiswa walo mnyango, uMnuz Siboniso Duma esithangamini nabezindaba izolo.Lesi sithangami silandela ukukhishwa kwabakhahlanyezwa yizikhukhula zangoFebhuwari kulo nyaka, ehhotela iBayside enkabeni yeTheku ngeledlule. Abehhotela kuthiwa babaphonsa emnyango abagilwa ngoba uhulumeni engayikhokhile imali yerenti.Abagilwa kwaphoqeleka ukuthi balale onqenqemeni lomgwaqo njengoba babengenayo enye indawo ababezokhosela kuyo.UDuma uveze ukuthi bonke abagilwa sebegcinwe endaweni efudumele eMbilo. Elandisa ngodaba lweMontclair Lodge, uDuma uthe bayithenge kwabakwaTransnet."Sesiwukhokhile uR33 million ukuze kuhlaliswe abagilwa bezikhukhula. Ngamanye amazwi ngeke sisazisebenzisa izindawo eziqashwayo ukugcina abagilwa okwesikhashana,” kusho uDuma. Uthe iMontclair lodge inamagumbi angu-268 nemibhede engu-600. Uqhube wathi bazoqoka unjiniyela ngaphambi kokuphela kukaJulayi ukuze ayihlole le ndawo kubhekwe ukuthi ungakanani umsebenzi wokuthi ilungiswe. Uveze ukuthi emva kwalokho bazobe sebeqoka usonkontileka ozoyilungisa. Ubalule ukuthi bazobeka eceleni imali enguR35 million, ukuze indawo ilungiswe kuthi uR4.2 million ubekelwe ukuthi kwenziwe umsebenzi wokuyihlola. UDuma uthe bayakholwa wukuthi ngoDisemba kulo nyaka noma uJanuwari wangonyaka ozayo, bazobe sebekhona abagilwa abangeniswa kule ndawo. Uthe lokhu kungenye yemizamo yabo yokuthi baqinisekise ukuthi bayilungele imvula enkulu eza nehlobo. "Lena yingqophamlando yokuthi uhulumeni abe nezakhe izindawo zokuhlalisa abasuke bekhahlanyezwe yizikhukhula. Izonciphisa izindleko ze-renti ekhokhwa wuhulumeni kulabo okusuke kuhlaliswe abagilwa ezindaweni zabo,” kusho uDuma. Udalule ukuthi kwenzeka lokhu nje bamatasa bakha izindawo zesikhashana ezizogcina abagilwa bezikhukhula ezindaweni ezihlonzelwe lokhu, okukhona kuzo nezindawo zamakhosi.Uthe nezindlu bayazakha kodwa wakuveza ukuthi nakuba benza le mizamo, basabhekene nenkinga yemiphakathi enqaba ukuthi kuzokwakhiwa eduze nayo. Uthe kukhona olunye uhlelo abaphezu kwalo, lokwakha izindlu zesikhashana kanjalo nalezo ezizohlala abantu ingunaphakade ezindaweni zamakhosi. UDuma uthe emhlanganweni ababa nawo namakhosi eThekwini, avuma ukudedela umhlaba ukuze kwakhelwe abakhahlanyezwa yizikhukhula. Uthe phakathi kwezindawo osekuqaliwe ukwakhiwa kuzo kubalwa naseMnini eningizimu yeTheku. Uthe zikhona ezinye izindlu ezingu-19 ezakhiwa e-llovu ezakhelwa eminye imindeni eyagilwa yizikhukhula, nezinye izindlu ezakhiwa eNanda ngaphansi kwenkosi uMqoqi Ngcobo. Udalule ukuthi ngesikhathi bebuyekeza uhlu lwabakhahlamezeka bathole ukuthi kukhona abangeke bahlomule ohlelweni lokwakhelwa ngezizathu ezehlukene. "Abanye kuvele ukuthi banazo izindlu zomxhaso asebevele bezakhelwe emagameni abo. Uhulumeni akakwazi ukwakhela umuntu indlu yomxhaso kabili,” kusho uDuma.Uthe kuvele ukuthi abanye bahola imali engaphezu kwaleyo ebekiwe ukuze umuntu akwazi ukuhlomula ngendlu yomxhaso.Uthe abanye bebengenabo omazisi, kuthi uma sebenzelwe uhlelo lokuthi bashayelwe eMnyangweni wezaseKhaya, bavele banyamalale. "Abanye sithole ukuthi ngabokufika,” usho kanje.

KUHLATSHWE ikhwelo kubafundi abazobhala u-matric KwaZulu-Natal ukuthi basebenzise incwadi enamathiphu azobacija njengoba kusele izinyanga ezimbalwa baqale ukubhala izivivinyo.La bafundi bayalwe ngokuthi abasebenzise isikhathi esisele ukuthi bagxile ezincwadini zabo, bafunde. Ikhwelo lihlatshwe nguMphathiswa wezeMfundo uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka, njengoba abafundi bezoqala ukubhala ngo-Okthoba. Bangu-173 584 abafundi abazobhala u-matric esifundazweni nonyaka. UHlomuka uthe zingaphansi kuka-100 izinsuku ezisele ngaphambi kokuba ziqale izivivinyo."Lide ibanga leminyaka engu-12, elihanjwe abafundi abazobhala u-matric kulo nyaka. Izivivinyo zalo nyaka ziqala ngo-Okthoba 21, kanti ziqala nge-Eastern Languages, kanjalo ne-Computer Applications Technology," usho kanje.Uthe ziphothulwa ngoNovemba 26, 2025. "Abafundi mabazilungiselele ngendlela nakuba kusasele izinyanga ezimbala ngaphambi kokuba babhale. Mabasebenzise i-Study Tips Booklet ezobasiza ngamathiphu ngaphambi kokubhala. Abazakhele ne-timetable yabo abazofunda ngayo, baphinde babheke ukuthi babhalani ngaliphi ilanga." Ubaxwayise ngokuthi bangazibandakanyi nezinto ezingafanele uma sebebhala ezingabenza bagcine sebejeziswa kanzima."Sibaxwayisa ngokuthi bangazihlanganisi nezinto ezithinta ukukopela ngoba zinomthelela ongemuhle ngomuso. Ayikho indlela enqamulelayo ezivivinyweni ngaphandle kokuthi ufunde, uphinde uzinikele ukuze uphase." Ngaphambi kokuba abafundi baka-matric babhale, basayina isibophezelo sokuthi ngeke bazihlanganise nezinto ezingalungile njengoba bebanjelwa imiphumela yabo uma kutholakala ukuthi bakopelile.Le micimbi iba kuzona zonke izifundazwe kanti kusuke kuxwayiswa ngayo ukuthi abafundi babe nonembeza bangakopeli.Abanye abasuke bekopelile uma kutholakala ubufakazi babanjelwa imiphumela yabo, kwabanye ithathwa njengento engekho, baqaliswe phansi babhale.Baphinde bajeziswe ngokuthi babekelwe iminyaka ethile bengazibhali izivivinyo njengoba besuke bedonsa isigwebo sabo ngokukopela.

UShivambu uxoshwe kwesikanobhala jikele weMK ngoJuni. Ngesikhathi exoshwa, iMK yathi uShivambu uxoshelwe ukuhambela esontweni lomfundisi waseMalawi ofunelwa amacala, uShepherd Bushiri.Kwabuye kwavela ukuthi uShivambu waxoshelwa ukuthi wayefuna ukuketula uZuma kwesokuhola iMK.UZuma uveze ukuthi uShivambu wabanjwa enza ubugebengu wathi futhi bese ehambe etshela abantu ukuthi uzophatha maduze.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma esidlweni sasebusuku ebesihlelwe wuphiko lwentsha kwiMK. Kade sikhuluma naye sibuzana ukuthi singawanciphisa kanjani amaqembu ezepolitiki. Ubekhuluma ashaye isiNgisi esiphezulu. Ubungaze uthembe uma umuzwa ekhuluma. Ube eseganga ke. Thina asidlali ke uma sikubamba uganga. Noma ngabe besikuthanda kanjani, uma ubheda sikubeka endaweni yakho. Uma sesithi akabuyele eceleni, wahlanya umuntu. Usethi uzokhuluma namakhosi, abuze ukuthi sikhona yini isidingo sokuthi kuqalwe enye inhlangano. Ubehambe eganga, ekhohlisa abantu, ethi uzophatha maduze." Iqembu liphethwe sengathi yisitokfela sikaZuma. Ngababuza ngale zinto. Akukhona ukuthi ngiyabahleba."UShivambu uthe bazobhalisa iqembu elisha lezepolitiki, iMayibuye Africa Organisation, athe izomela bonke abantu bakuleli.

UKHATHAZEKILE umndeni wensizwa endala yaseMadibhini, oPhongolo, okuthiwa sekuphele amasonto amabili idukile.UMnuz Mzwakhe Phakathi (76), kuthiwa wagcinwa ukubonwa ethamele ilanga ngaphandle kwendlu yakwakhe ngoJuni 29, kulo nyaka.Ngokusho kwendodakazi yakhe, uNksz Ayanda Phakathi, ithe uyise ohlala nomkakhe, wavuka waphumela phandle ngosuku anyamalala ngalo. "Umamncane wamgcina ethamele ilanga, wathi uyabona akasekho,” kusho uNksz Phakathi.Uthe uyise akasiye umuntu onabangani endaweni noma ovame ukuvakashela omakhelwane."Yayingekho nendlela owayebike ukuthi uzoyithatha,” kusho uNksz Phakathi. Uthe udaba lokulahleka kwakhe, basheshe balubikela umphakathi, owahlangana masinyane, waqala wacingwa uyise, wathi ngakusasa banikela emaphoyiseni asoPhongolo, ukuyobika ngokunyamalala kwakhe, amaphoyisa abajoyini ukuzobacingisa."Zonke lezi zinsuku siyavuka siyocinga yonke indawo, ngisho nasemahlathini asendaweni,” usho kanje. Uthe basadidekile ukuthi kwenzekani kuyise. "Indawo yethu ayinabo ubugebengu bokuthunjwa kwabantu. Yisigameko sokuqala lesi endaweni ukuthi kulahleke umuntu,” kusho yena.Uqhube wathi bakhathazekile ngokubehlele. "Isimo asisihle kithi sonke ekhaya ngoba asazi ukuthi ukuphi nokuthi uphephile yini,” kusho uNksz Phakathi othe sebekhulekela ukumthola noma ngabe ekusiphi isimo.Uthe nasezibhedlela eziseduze, nasemakhazeni endawo, sebebuya khona ukuyolahlela ukuthi akatholakali yini.Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kwamaphoyisa ayiphumelelanga saze sayoshicilela.
UBONGE ukusebenza ngokuzikhandla kwamaphoyisa kanjalo noMbuso uyise womfundi waseDurban Girls Secondary, owabulawa ngesihluku nyakenye, iNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini, idedela isigwebo esinzima kwabesilisa ababili abalahlwe yicala.UWandile Ngcobo (17) wagwazwa wabulawa ekhaya kubo kwa-U eMlaza, ngoMeyi, ngonyaka odlule. Ngaleli cala, kwaboshwa umakhelwane wakhe, uSfundo Bhengu (40) nomngani wakhe uBongani Jali (28). IJaji uGarth Harrison libagwebe udilikajele ngecala lokubulala abanecala. Kwelokubamba inkunzi kusetshenziswa indlakadla, uBhengu ugixabezwe iminyaka ewu-20, uJali wanikwa ewu-15. Izigwebo zabo bazozidonsa kanye kanye. Uyise kamufi, uMnuz Mondli Ngcobo, uthe yize indodakazi yakhe ingeke isavuka kodwa ugculisekile ngesigwebo esinikwe laba ababili. UNgcobo uthe umshushisi woMbuso, u-Advocate Krishen Shah nomphenyi wecala, uSergeant Mndeni Mzila, baqinisekisile ukuthi ubulungiswa buyenzeka."UMzila usebenze ngokuzinikela kuleli cala, besifuna ukuthobeka amanxeba, lokho kwenzekile,” kusho uNgcobo. Nokho uthe uphoxekile ngelokuthi abalahlwe yicala bagcina bephunyukile kwelokudlwengula indodakazi yakhe ngaphambi kokuyibulala. Kuthiwa ngesikhathi uMzila eqala ephenya icala, kwase kwedlule isikhathi, umufi wayesengcwatshiwe. Uveze ukuthi isidumbu sikamufi sonakala ngesikhathi sihleli emakhazeni kahulumeni ngakho odokotela ababange besakwazi ukuhlola ukuthi wayedlwenguliwe. Emva kokudedelwa kwesigwebo, ummeli kaJali, uMnuz Phumelele Daniso, utshele inkantolo ukuthi uJali umyalele ukuthi ukuthi afake isicelo sokudlulisa isigwebo, wathi udilikajele uwuswazi olukhulu kuyena.Uthe nakuba uJali wayekhona ngesikhathi kuhlelwa icala lokweba, elagcine lenzeka ngempumelelo njengoba izimpahla zagcina zidayiswa kodwa akazange amgwaze umufi. "Lapho inkantolo ilahleke khona isekutheni, bekufanele ibhekisise ukuthi umuntu ngamunye wenzani kahle hle esigamekweni,” kusho uDaniso. Uthe inkantolo ibagwebe ngelithi benza icala ngenhloso eyodwa, wathi enye inkantolo ibingamgweba ngendlela ehlukile uJali. UHarrison uthe ukuze inkantolo igudluke esinqumweni sayo, kufanele kube nezimo ezibalulekile nezicindezelayo.Ubuze uDaniso ukuthi lokhu akushoyo ukusho ngoba uJali engazange wamgwaza umufi, waphendula ngethi impela. UHarrison uthe lokhu okuphakanyiswa uDaniso ukubhekile ngesikhathi ekhipha isigwebo. "Ngikubhekile konke lokhu ngaleso sikhathi futhi ngakuchitha. Imvume yokudlulisa isicelo sokudlulisa eyesigwebo iyachithwa,” kusho uHarrison.Ngosuku lwesigameko, laba ababili kuthiwa bangena kwaNgcobo ngenhloso yokokweba ithelevishini ukuze bayidayise bese bethenga izidakamizwa, bazibheme. Kuthiwa bahamba bayongena endaweni yesigameko, beba ithelevishini, iselula kamufi, ubhakha kamufi wePuma ne-decoder ye-DSTV. Isidumbu sikamufi satholwa siboshwe nge-pantyhose emlonyeni, ezinyaweni nasezandleni.Kuqhume umkikizo ngesikhathi laba begwetshwa njengoba le nkantolo ibihlale igcwele uma kuqulwa leli cala.Bekubakhona ngisho nabamaqembu ahlukene ezepolitiki njalo uma liqhubeka.
ISILO uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini siphonsele inselelo abaholi ukuba balwe nendlala ngesikhathi sihlonishwa ePhalamende lase-United Kingdom.IMbube ithe ifisa ukuchonywa kwayo uphaphe lwegwalagwala ePhalamende lamaNgisi, kube yisibani esizokhanyisela abantu ababhuqwabhuqwa yindlala.Ikusho lokhu emva kokuhlonishwa kwayo, ngoLwesihlanu. IMbube ihlonishelwe iqhaza layo ekugcinweni kwamasiko nokugqugquzela ububambano ngesikhathi kunomcimbi wokuklomelisa abaholi base-Afrika abanohlonze, i-Africa Achievers Awards.ISilo siphonsele inselelo amakhosi, abaholi ezinhlakeni ezahlukene kanye nabo bonke abantu ukuba babe yingxenye yombhidlango wokuthuthukisa i-Afrika kanye nomhlaba jikelele."Asingabi yisizukulwane esihudula amadolo. Asingabi yisizukulwane esivumela ukubhuqwabhuqwa yindlala. Akufanele sivumele inkohlakalo noqhekeko. Amakhosi awangagcini nje ngokuba amakhosi ngegama. Amakhosi kufanele abambe iqhaza ekuthuthukisweni komnotho, ekugcinweni kokuthula kanye nokugcinwa kwamasiko." Sithe:"Lena akungagcini nje ngokuba yindondo, kodwa makube yisibani. Sifisa abangasekho ukuba basikhanyisele kulolu hambo esiluhambayo. Sifisa ukuba i-Afrika ithuthuke. Asiqaleni sicathule, siye phambili. Amakhosi ase-Afrka, awase-Europe, izinhlangano zamalungelo abantu kanye nabo bonke abantu abakhona emhlabeni kufanele babambisane ukwakha ikusasa elingcono."IMbube ithe ukuvunywa kwayo kufanele kuthuthukise abantu abahlwempu."Le ndondo akusiyona eyami ngedwa kodwa eyawo wonke umuntu wesifazane othwala amanzi ekhanda. Le ndondo eyawo wonke umfundi ofunda ngekhandlela. Le ndondo eyawo wonke amakhosi alwela umhlaba." IMbube ithe kuyijabulisile ukunyathela lapho kwanyathela khona okhokho bayo."Umlando wethu namaNgisi mude kakhulu. Sahlangana okokuqala ngempi yaseSandlwana ngesikhathi kuphethe iSilo uCetshwayo. Emva kwempi iSilo saboshwa, salethwa lapha. Namhlanje nami ngilapha. Okuhlukile wukuthi mina angiboshiwe, ngize ngesihle."IMbube ibihamba noNdlunkulu uSihle Mdluli, iphini likandunankulu kaZulu, Inkosi Phathisizwe Chiliza, usihlalo womkhandlu weSilo, Inkosi Zuzifa kaMangosuthu Buthelezi, okhulumela iSilo uMntwana uThulani kaGqikazi Zulu, nabanye.
Iqembu le-DA eliyingxenye yeGNU likhiphe isitatimende Lizwakalisa ukwamukela inkulumo kamengameli Cyril Ramaphosa kodwa futhi likhala ngezinkundla ezisungulelwa ukuphenya inkohlakalo kugcine kungashushuswa muntu.Ngesitatimende esithunyelwe abezindaba umholi weDA uJohn Steenhuisen uthi, iDA uyasamukela isimemezelo sikamengameli Ramaphosa sekhomishana yamajaji ezophenya ngezinsolo ezenziwe nguKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uGeneral Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi. Lezi zinsolo zigadla enkabeni yohlelo lwezobulungiswa bobugebengu eNingizimu Afrika, zibandakanya abomthetho, abashushisi, ezobunhloli, kanye nezikhulu eziphezulu ebugebengwini obuhleliwe kanye nenkohlakalo ehleliwe."Yize sisemukela isimemezelo sekhefu likaNgqongqoshe wezamaphoyisa njengesinyathelo esidingekayo, siza ngemuva kwengcindezi engapheli ye-DA kanye nokukhala kwezwe lonke."Uqhubeke wathi lezi zinsolo zinikeze umengameli ithuba lokukhombisa ubuholi obunesibindi nobuqinile. Esikhundleni salokho, usephinde wanikeza ikhomishana umthwalo, futhi abantu baseNingizimu Afrika sebethanda ukungabaza ngalezi nkundla zezingxoxo, amathimba aqokiwe kanye namakhomishana abawabona njengokuthenga isikhathi nokugwema ukuziphendulela. I-DA ithi ngeke iyamukele inqubo yeminyaka eqoqa ubufakazi obushaqisayo kodwa bungasetshenzwa ngendlela ukushushisa abatholwa benindeke ebubini. "Izwe alikwazi ukukhokhela enye inqubo yokuqoqa amafayela azoqoqa uthuli ngenkathi abaxhumene nosopolitiki bebalekela ubulungiswa. I-DA izobheka umengameli ukuthi aziphendulele ngakho konke okutholwe yile khomishini kanye nezincomo zayo, futhi sizolwa kwikhabhinethi nasephalamende ukuze kuthathwe izinyathelo ezisheshayo nezibonakalayo." IPhalamende akumele libekwe eceleni futhi umsebenzi wephalamende wokuba isigungu esiphezulu esithatha izinqumo kufanele liqhubeke ngaphandle kokuvinjwa.
I-IFP ithi iyaseseka isimemezelo sikaMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa sokuqoka iKhomishana ezimele ezophenya ngezinsolo ezibucayi ezenziwa nguKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant-General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, ezibhekise kuNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu. I-IFP incoma umengameli ngokusisukumela isiphakamiso abathi senziwa yibona ngomhla ka-6 kwephezulu - sokuba kube neKhomishana Yophenyo eholwa ngamajaji kanye nokuba uNgqongqoshe uMchunu afakwe ilivu eyisipesheli ngesikhathi kusaphenywa. Kuyasikhuthaza ukuthi umengameli uthathe lesi sinyathelo esiwujuqu ukuze kuzuze izwe. Lolu wudaba oluhlaba ngqo ekujuleni kokuthenjwa wumphakathi kwezikhungo zentando yeningi, uhlelo lwezobulungiswa bobugebengu, kanye nokuphepha kwezwe. Izinsolo zobugebengu, inkohlakalo, ukusebenzisana kanye nokugxambukela phakathi koMbutho wamaphoyisa aseNingizimu Afrika (i-SAPS) ziyethusa kakhulu futhi zidinga impendulo yobuqotho obuphezulu.
UNGQONGQOSHE wamaPhoyisa, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, uzohlaba ikhefu emsebenzini kulandela izinsolo ezibucayi abekwe zona nguKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi.Lesi sinqumo siza ngemuva kwesimemezelo esenziwe ngumengameli uCyril Ramaphosa, sokuthi kuzosungulwa ikhomishana Yezobulungiswa, ezoholwa yiPhini lejaji eliyinhloko elibambile, uJaji Mbuyiseli Madlanga. UNgqongqoshe uMchunu usengiphe isitatimende esichaza ukuthi usamukele lesi sinqumo futhi uzwakalise ukweseka ngokugcwele lolu hlelo. "Ngiyasamukela futhi ngiyasihlonipha isinqumo sikamengameli futhi ngiyazibophezela kulolu hlelo. Ukuhlonipha nobuqotho yizimfanelo ezinhle engizivumelayo futhi sonke esidinga ukwenza imizamo yokuzigcina. Ngimi ngomumo ukuphendula amacala engibekwe wona futhi ngiphendule izakhamuzi baseNingizimu Afrika, ngokugcwele nangobuqotho."
WONKE amehlo azobe ethe njo kuMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, ozokwenza isimemezelo ngodaba lwezinsolo ezishaqisayo ezibhekene noNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu.URamaphosa uzokwethula inkulumo ayibhekise ezweni ngeSonto, ngo-7 ebusuku.Kule nkulumo kubhekwe ukuthi amemezele izinyathelo azozithatha kulandela izinsolo ezishaqisayo ezenziwe uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, zokuthi uMchunu usondelene nezigebengu eziphazamisa ukusebenza komthetho. Okhulumela uRamaphosa, uMnuz Vincent Magwenya, uthe umengameli usekulungele ukwenza isimemezelo kulandela izingxoxo abe nazo nabantu abahlukene.Kwenzeka lokhu nje, ziyaqhubeka nokumnetha uMchunu njengoba evulelwe amacala okudukisa iPhalamende waphinde wabikwa nasekomitini lezobuqotho.Omathathu amaqembu alandela i-ANC ngobukhulu ePhalamende, i-DA, MK ne-EFF, athathele uMchunu izinyathelo. I-DA neMK bavulele uMchunu icala emaphoyiseni, kwathi i-EFF yona yaceba uMchunu ekomitini lezobuqotho ePhalamende.La maqembu afuna ukuthi uMchunu ajeziselwe ukuthi waqamba amanga ePhalamende njengoba eseshaye ungqimphothwe, wavuma ukuthi uyamazi uMnuz Brown Mogotsi. UMchunu wathi akamazi uMogotsi ngesikhathi ebuzwa ngaye ePhalamende ngoMashi. NgoLwesithathu, uMchunu ubuye wakhipha isitatimende, wavuma ukuthi uyamazi uMogotsi kodwa wathi akasondelene naye. IPhini likaSotswebhu we-DA ePhalamende, uMnuz Baxolile Nodada, lithe bafuna ukuthi uMchunu ajezele ukuqamba amanga lathi uzifake ogibeni olukhulu."Ngesikhathi esePhalamende ngoMashi, wathi akamazi uMogotsi. UMogotsi lona usondelene nezigebengu. Manje yena uMchunu useyajika, uthi uyamazi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi waqamba amanga ePhalamende."UNodada uthe bazophinde babike uMchunu ekomitini lezobuqotho ePhalamende. Okhulumela iMK, uMnuz Nhlamulo Ndhlela, uthe phezu kwecala lokudukisa, baphinde bavulela uMchunu icala lokuphazamisa ukusebenza kwengalo yomthetho.Uthe baphinde bavulela icala nePhini likaKhomishana wamaPhoyisa, uLieutenant General Shadrack Sibiya. UMkhwanazi wenza izinsolo zokuthi uSibiya uhlezi phezu kwamadokodo anemiyalelo yokuba kuboshwe abantu ababandakanyeka emacaleni okubulawa kosopolitiki esifundazweni. USotswebhu we-EFF ePhalamende, uNksz Nontando Nolutshungu, uthe kusobala ukuthi uMchunu uqambe amanga ngakho ke kufanele kube nophenyo olunzulu.UMchunu akasiyena umholi wokuqala ukubhekana necala lokudukisa.OwayenguNgqongqoshe wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi, uNksz Bathabile Dlamini, walahlwa icala lokuqamba amanga efungile ngesikhathi ethula ubufakazi kwikhomishini eyayiphenya ngesiphithiphithi esacishe saholela ekutheni umnyango uhluleke ukuholela izibonelelo. Wagetshwa iminyaka emine ebhadla ejele kodwa wagcina ekhokha inhlawulo ka-R200 000.Owayengungqongqoshe weziMali, uMnuz Nhlanhla Nene, wasula esikhundleni emva kokuba kuvele ukuthi waqamba amanga, wathi akabazi abomndeni wakwaGupta.Owayengusotswebhu we-ANC ePhalamende, uMnuz Tony Yengeni, wagwetshwa iminyaka emine ejele ngecala lokudukisa kanye nenkohlakalo. Wadedelwa ngoshwele emva kokudonsa izinyanga ezine.
AKUSENSUKU zatshwala luqale uhlelo lokuholelwa konomehlo ngomsebenzi wabo omuhle abawenzela isizwe samaZulu.Lokhu kudalulwe nguMphathiswa wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal, uMfuThulasizwe Buthelezi.UButhelezi ubekade ekhuluma emcimbini omkhulu wokubungazwa kwezintombi nezinsizwa zesizwe saKwaMachi. Umcimbi ubukade usezinkundleni zemidlalo zaKwaMachi, eHarding, ngempelasonto.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi akusikhona okokuqala luvela udaba lokuholelwa konomehlo baKwaZulu-Natal.UButhelezi uthe konke sekumi ngomumo manje. Uchaze onomehlo njengabantu abadlala indima enkulu ekuqinisekiseni ikusasa elihle nelingcono lesizwe samaZulu."Iqiniso ukuthi mkhulu umsebenzi obonakala wenziwa ngonomehlo ezingxenyeni ezahlukene zeKwaZulu-Natal. Kodwa akekho umuntu okuqaphelayo ukusebenza ngokuzikhandla kwabo. Yingakho sikholwa ukuthi sekumele bahlomule manje ngomsebenzi omuhle ababonakala bewenzela isizwe," kusho uButhelezi.Ukhulume nangokubaluleka kokuthi kube khona okwenziwayo ngenhloso yokuqinisekisa ukuthi nezinsizwa nazo zikhuliswa kahle. INkosi yesizwe saKwaMachi, uMthetho Machi, ithe beyisizwe bakubeka eqhulwini ukubaluleka kokubona izintombi nezinsizwa ziqhubeka nokuziphatha kahle.Ithe ngaphambilini, lo mcimbi wawukade ugxile kakhulu ekutheni kukhuthazwe ukuziphatha okuhle emantombazaneni amancane kuphela.Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi isizwe sigcine siqaphela ukuthi akukuhle ukuba kugxilwe nxanye ebese kuzitshwa abafana. "Sigcine sesivumelana ngokuthi alube khona phela nohlelo lokufundisa izinsizwa ngokubaluleka kokuziphatha kahle," kusho uMachi.NoNdlunkulu walesi sizwe, uNkk Lulama kaFaku Machi, uthe isizwe sibophezele ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi izinsizwa nezintombi zikhuliswa ngendlela efanele.Uthe ngaphambilini, bebekade benza ubudedengu bokugxila ekucijeni kokuziphatha kwamantombazane ebese beziba izinsizwa okuyinto athe babonile ukuthi akumele yenziwe."Uma ufundisa izintombi ngokuziphatha akumele ubashiye ngaphandle nabafana. Phela amantombazane azogana abafana. Uma ke bengafundiswa abafana, sikuphi isidingo sokufundisa amantombazane?"
KUKHALWA ngezakhamuzi ezingaphansi kukaMasipala waseBig Five Hlabisa, okuthiwa zigoloza ukukhokhela izidingo.Kuthiwa sezihlule ngisho sezincengwa nangokuthi ziphulelwe isikweletu kodwa kuthiwa aziyingeni eyokukhokha.Lokhu kuvezwe yiMeya waseBig Five Hlabisa uMnuz Comfort Khumalo, esithangamini nabezindaba ebesibizwe yilo masipala muva nje. UKhumalo uthe kumanje baphulele izakhamuzi izikweletu ngamaphesenti angu-40 ukuze zikwazi ukukhokhela umasipala okuzokwenza nabo bakwazi ukwenza kahle emalini emisa umkhandlu. "Sesithathe isinqumo sokuthi sibe nendlela yokuqoqa izikweletu kulezo zakhamuzi ezifuna ukusikhokhela. Sizoqoqa izikweletu ngohlelo oluzophoqa ukuba izakhamuzi zisikhokhele kodwa lezo ezizimisele ngokuxoxisana nathi sivule izandla, ngoba yikhona okuzokwenza ukuthi sihlale sihambisa izidingo emphakathini, kulungiswe imigwaqo kanjalo nezinye izidingo ezidingekayo kuleli dolobha lethu elincane kodwa elingekho esimeni esigculisayo, nesidinga ukulithuthukisa ukuze kuze abatshalimali " kusho uKhumalo.UKhumalo ubuye wethula isabelomali sonyaka esiqale ekuqaleni kwale nyanga esikuyo.Uthe lesi sabelomali singu-R240 million. Kulesi sithangami kubuye kwaba nokukhathazeka ngezinye izinhlelo zentuthuko.Ezinye izinhlelo zentuthuko zibanjezelwe wukushona kukasonkontileka okuphoqe ukuba ithenda iqalwe kabusha ikhangiswe ukuze kutholakale omunye usonkontileka.Ngaphandle kwalokho ushayelwe ihlombe umasipala ngokuthi kulesi sabelo mali esidlule, uthole umbiko oncomekayo kuMcwaningi Mabhuku Jikelele.
UMNYANGO wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal usunxuse izinhlaka zomthetho ukuthi zibathele izinyathelo abakanisa emasangweni ezikhungo zezempilo esifundazweni, bevimba abokufika abangenamaphepha ukuba bangene ngaphakathi ngenhloso yokuthola usizo lwezempilo. Lokhu kushiwo uMphathiswa womnyango, uNkk Nomagugu Simelane-Mngadi, izolo. "Sinxusa izinhlaka zomthetho ukuthi zibathathele izinyathelo ezinqala abavimba abantu ukuba bangene ezikhungweni zethu,” kusho uNkk Simelane-Mngadi. Uthe bayabagxeka labo abakhetha ukuzithathela umthetho ngezandla, bekhetha izikhungo ezithile, bavimbe abafuna usizo. Uthe iNingizimu Afrika yizwe elilawulwa uMthethosisekelo, wathi nanoma yiziphi izikhalo, kufanele zibikwe ngokusebenzisa imigudu efanele. Uthe nakuba bekugxeka lokhu kodwa bayakugxeka futhi ukweqa umngcele kwabokufika abangenamaphepha ngenhloso yokuzothola usizo lwezempilo ezikhungweni zezempilo zakuleli. "Isibalo esiphezulu sabokufika abeza ezikhungweni zethu silokhu siqhubekile nokudala ingcindezi kwezempilo zakuleli ezivele zinenkinga yokuhlinzekwa ngemali engenele,” kusho uNkk Simelane-Mngadi.Uthe nakuba uzwela umkhizo ejazini emnyangweni ngabokufika abangenamaphepha, bayasichitha isenzo salabo abavimba abagulayo ukuthi bathole usizo. "Alikho ilungu lomphakathi elinelungelo noma eligunyazwe ukuthi livimbe abantu ukuba bangene ezikhungweni zezempilo,” usho kanje. Uthe akugcini nje kuphela ngokuthi lesi senzo singabi semthethweni kodwa sibeka engcupheni ezempilo zomphakathi. "Umnyango umatasa nokulawula ukubheduka okusha kwezifo ezifana ne-measles, i-influenza nokubuya kweCovid-19 entsha. Ukuvimba abantu ukuthi bathole usizo lwezempilo kuzoba nomthelela omubi, emizamweni yokuzama ukulawula lezi zifo ezingagcina zibhebhetheka ngokushesha emphakathini,” usho kanje.Ubalule imithetho eyehlukene, okukhona kuyo uMthethosisekelo, umthetho wezempilo, owababaleki, kanjalo nowabokufika (immigrants), athe yonke iyaphikisana nokwenziwa ilaba abavimba ezikhungweni. UNkk Simelane-Mngadi usho kanje, kusuka ngesonto eledlule, amalungu enhlangano i-March and March, akanisa ezibhedlela ezifana ne-Addington, eThekwini, avimbe abokufika abangenamaphepha okuba kuleli ukuba bangene ngaphakathi.Lokhu kwenzeka nasesifundazweni iGauteng.Umsunguli wale nhlangano, uNkk Jacinta Ngobese-Zuma, wayisungula ekuqaleni kwalo nyaka ngenhloso yokulwa nodaba lwabokufika abathutheleka kuleli bengenamaphepha.Waveza ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika ibhekene nenkinga yabokufika, abakuleli ngokungemthetho, abancintela abakuleli izidingo ezivele zinganele, waphinde wakhala nangokuthi abanye beza nobugebengu obufana nokuhweba ngezidakamizwa.
UNGOTI wezepolitiki uxwayisa i-ANC ngokuthi izobhekana nolaka lwabavoti okhethweni lohulumeni basekhaya lwangonyaka ozayo, uma ingasusi ngokushesha esikhundleni uNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa okhungethwe yizinkinga, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu.Umhlaziyi wezepolitiki waseNyuvesi yaKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Zakhele Ndlovu, uthe abantu angeke bayivotele i-ANC okhethweni lwangonyaka ozayo uma ingase ingalusukumeli ngokushesha udaba lukaMchunu.UMchunu ulandelwa yifa elimnyama kulandela izinsolo zokuthi usondelene nabantu abasebenzisana nezigebengu. Lezi zinsolo zenziwe uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi.UNdlovu uthe izinsolo ezibhekene noMchunu zibucayi kakhulu."Abantu bacasukile. Uma i-ANC ingase ingamsusi uMchunu esikhundleni, abantu bazoveza ulaka lwabo okhethweni oluzayo. I-ANC izolahlekelwa yibo bonke omasipala." UNdlovu uthe uMchunu akafanelwe ukuphatha umnyango kahulumeni."I-ANC kufanele imshushumbise, iyomenza inxusa ezweni elingaphandle. Kufanele ahlale lapho kuze kuba kuphola lolu daba."UNdlovu ukhale ngokuhudula izinyawo kukaMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa. Izinsolo ezibhekene noMkhwanazi zenziwe uRamaphosa engekho kuleli, eseBrazil.UNdlovu uthe uRamaphosa kwakufanele ashiye yonke into ayeyenza eBrazil, abuye azobhekana nalolu daba."Lolu udaba oluthinta ezokuphepha ezweni. URamaphosa kwakufanele aphuthume azolulungisa. Bekufanele athumele umyalezo wokuthi i-ANC ayihambisani nenkohlakalo." UMchunu kubhekwe ukuthi angenele umbango wezikhundla engqungqutheleni yokukhetha ubuholi be-ANC elandelayo.UNdlovu uthe lezi zinsolo zizowuphazamisa umkhankaso kaMchunu."Kahle kahle nje kuphelile ngaye kwi-ANC. Akasophinde aphathe isikhundla esiphezulu kuhulumeni." UNobhala Jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, uthe bayalusukumela udaba lukaMchunu.UMbalula uthe balindele ukuthi uMchunu abanikeze umbiko maduze."Udaba lwenzeke uRamaphosa engekho, asikahlangani singabaholi be-ANC kodwa nginesiqiniseko sokuthi uMchunu uzoletha umbiko maduze. Ngalena kwalokho, kukhona izinhlaka zangaphakathi kwi-ANC ezibhekana nabantu abasolwa enkohlakalweni. Kufanele kulandelwe zonke lezi zinhlelo."
ABAZALI sebephonselwe inselelo yokuthi balungise inkinga okubukeka yanda ezweni yezingane ezincane ezisebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumana ngokweqile, okuvela ukuthi lokho kuba nomthelela omubi nobungozi empilweni yazo, nasekusebenzeni komqondo wazo ngenxa yobungozi balezi zinkundla.Lokhu kuza emva kokuvela kwezethulo zocwaningo lwenkampani yezobuchwepheshe i-Hello Yes Markerting, edalule ukuthi silokhu siqhubeke njalo nokwenyuka isibalo sezingane ezincane ezisebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumana ezweni.I-Hello Yes Marketing idalule ukuthi ebantwini abawu-26.7 million bakuleli zwe abasebenzisa i-internet, kukhona u-95% wezingane ezifunda uGrade 4 kuya kuGrade 11 ezineminyaka ewu-10 kuya ku-17, kube wu-62% onama-smart phone ube uneminyaka ewu-10 nje kuphela, bese kuthi u-83% usebenzise okungenani uhlelo olulodwa lwezinkundla zokuxhumana ube uneminyaka ewu-12. Lezi zibalo ziphuma nje, ziqondane nokuthi uJulayi waziwa nangokuthi yi-Mental Health Awareness Month, lapho okusuke kwenziwa khona imikhankaso kuhlatshwa nekhwelo lokufundisa nokuqwashisa abantu ngezimo nangezinto abazenzayo ezibahlukumezayo emqondweni.UMphathiswa wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal uNksz Nomagugu Simelane uxwayise abazali ukuthi bangayishayi indiva le nto yokunikeza izingane ezincane omakhalekhukhwini ngoba ingenye yezinto eziholela ekutheni kube nezinkinga ezithikameza impilo yabantwana babo. "Kuningi okubi abantwana abakubona nabakuthola kulezi zinkundla zokuxhumana okunye kwakho okwenza bahlukumezeke, kubalwa nengcindezi yokwenza izinto ezithile ezingalungile abayithola kontanga yabo, futhi kukhona nabahlukunyezwa ngamabhoklolo akhona kulezi zinkundla, ngakho kumqoka ukuqaphela ukuthi yini izingane zethu eziyibonayo neziyenza kulezi zinkundla ukuze singenelele uma kunesidingo," kusho uNksz Simelane.I-Teenage Coach ezimele uNksz Nomveliso Mbanga yona ithe inkinga enkulu ayikho ekuthengeleni izingane amafoni zisencane kuphela ngoba seziyakwazi ukungena kwi-internet komakhalekhukhwini babangani bazo, futhi ziyasebenzisa nokwabazali bazo kulelo thuba elincane ezilitholayo."Inkinga enkulu wukuthi abazali ababafundisi abantwana babo ukuthi zisetshenziswa kanjani izinkundla zokuxhumana futhi ababaqwashisi ngokumele bakuqaphele kuzona ngoba ngeke sikubalekele ukuthi sebevele bayazisebenzisa futhi aziyi ndawo, zizohlale zikhona. Kunjalo nje, sifika kulesi sigaba esikusona manje nje, izingane zibonele kithina indlela esithanda ngayo lezi zinkundla zokuxhumana, bese nazo zifuna ukubona okwenzekayo kuzona, ngakho yijoka lethu futhi ukuthi sizikhalime bese siyaziqwashisa ngobungozi bazo," kusho uNksz Mbanga.Ucebise abazali ngokuthi abaqale ukufundisa izingane zabo ngokusebenza kwezinkundla zokuxhumana okungenani uma sezineminyaka ewu-12 ngoba yilapho ezisuke seziqala khona ukuzibandakanya ezintweni eziningi. "Okumqoka nokho wukuthi abantwana bafundiswe ngalezi zinto, hhayi ukubafihlela ngoba lokho kungenza kuthi bazifunele ngokwabo bese bethiyeka kwezinye izinto. Okunye okungasiza wukuthi uma umntwana usumthengele umakhalekhukhwini ngenxa yezizathu ezahlukene, uqaphele ukunaka nokubheka ukuthi uwusebenzisa kanjani nokuthi uxhumana nobani kuwona ukuze kube lula ukusheshe ungenelele uma kukhona okonakalayo," kucebisa uNksz Mbanga.

BAZISHAYA isifuba abenkampani yabangcwabi iCebolethu ngokuba yinkampani ezokuba nohlelo oludlala kumabonakude oluveza konke okwenzekayo uma bengcwaba.Le nkampani iveze lezi zindaba ngoLwesihlanu, eThe Bond Shed ePoint eThekwini, ngesikhathi yethula ngokusemthethweni lolu hlelo, Icebo Labantu eqale ukudlala izolo, kwiSABC 1, ligamenxe ihora lesihlanu ntambama. ''Kuyajabulisa kakhulu ukuthi namhlanje sihlangene lapha sizokhuluma ngokuthi sekufeziwe lokhu ebesikade sikusebenza sonke lesi sikhathi. Ayikho into ejabulisa njengokubona into ebenikhuluma ngayo seyenzeka ngempela,'' usho kanje.Udalule ukuthi inhloso yalolu hlelo ukuvezela abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi kwenzekani ngaphambi kwemingcwabo. Uthe lizophinde liveze nezinselelo le nkampani eye izithole isibhekene nazo ngesikhathi ilungiselela ukufihla.UMnuz Legend Manqele oyisikhulu esiphezulu senkampani ekhiqiza imidlalo iBarLeader, uthe leli yithuba lokuthi abantu babone ukuthi le nkampani iye ibhekane nani ngaphambi kokuba ingcwabe. Uthe imidlalo yalolu hlobo kuyajabulisa kakhulu ukuyibona iba khona ngoba izodala ukuthi abantu bafunde okuningi futhi okuhlukile mayelana nokungcwaba.Umsakazi woKhozi FM obephethe uhlelo, uThembeka Zondo Cele, uthe ubezibuza ekuqaleni ukuthi Icebo Labantu limayelana nani. Uthe kuyajabulisa ukuthi le nkampnai ifike nombono ongajwayelekile.UMfu Thomas Radebe uyihalaliselile kakhulu le nkampani ngokucabanga ijule ize ifinyelele kuleli gxathu, wathi sebekhulekela ukuthi uNkulunkulu aqhubeke abe nabo kunanoma yini abazobe beyihlela ngalolu hlelo.
KUSEQHULWINI kumhleli womcimbi iDundee July ukubona lo mcimbi udala amathuba omsebenzi uphinde uphephezelisele phezulu ifulegi lezindawo zasemakhaya.Lokhu uMnuz Vezokuhle Nala weMathole Funerals, ukusho ngesikhathi kunesithangami nabezindaba ebesiseBattleField, eDundee eveza izinhlelo zokulungela ukusingatha lo mcimbi waminyaka yonke.Uveze ukuthi owamahhashi uzoqala ngoJulayi 19. Uthe kodwa udinga umuntu okwaziyo ukuhlela imicimbi angaqali into bese eyahluleka wukuyiqhuba ngokuhamba kwesikhathi.

UKHUNGATHEKILE umndeni webhungu elingakwazi ukukhuluma eliduke maqede latholakala selibulewe. Umndeni kaMnuz Tsio Duma (16) waseBrighton, eMpendle, usashaqekile emva kokumthola esebulewe ngesihluku. UDuma utholakale eshayiwe kanzima, waphinde washiswa.Kunemidlinzo yokuthi uDuma ucwiyiwe.Utholakale endaweni okusanda kutholakala kuyo owesifazane owayeshayiwe, wacwiywa.Unina kaDuma, uNksz Thobisile Duma, uthe indodana yakhe yaphuma njengomuntu oya endlini encane ngoMgqibelo ebusuku."Sathi uma sibona kuqhubeka isikhathi eside engabuyi, sabe sesiphuma siyombheka. Sambheka kuyo yonke indawo esasiyicabanga ukuthi kungenzeka ukuba udukele kuyo, sangamthola. Kwaze kwashaya u-2 ekuseni, sifuna."UNksz Thobisile uthe uDuma watholakala ngeSonto ekuseni, endaweni engaba ikhilomitha ukusuka ekhaya."Wayeshayiwe futhi eshisiwe. Kunembobo nje eyayisesiswini, angazi ukuthi babemgwaza ngani. Umzimba wawuluhlaza, kunemivimbo. Kwakukhombisa ukuthi wayebhaxabulwa. Bazama nokumshisa."UNksz Thobisile uthe kungenzeka ukuthi indodana yakhe yacwiywa, wathi indlela eyayilimele ngayo, abakwazanga ukubona ukuthi zisaphelele yini izitho zomzimba.UNksz Thobisile uthe ufuna ukwazi ukuthi ibulaweleni indodana yakhe."Okubuhlungu ukuthi akakwazi ukukhuluma. Ukuba ubekwazi ukukhuluma bengizothi mhlawumb e ubathukile. Ubengasukeli muntu. Okubuhlungu asazi ukuthi ubulewe ubani. Uma okungenani kungavela ukuthi ubulewe ubani, khona bezongichazela ukuthi ubenzeni."UNksz Thobisile uthe uDuma ubenakho ukuphuma anyamalale. "Besiyaye simbheke, simthole. Kwesinye isikhathi besimthola esengene emzini yabantu. Abantu bebemazi."Ikhansela lakuMasipala waseMpendle, uMnuz Sadewu Ngubane, lithe bakhathazekile ngokwanda kwezigameko zabantu abatholakala bebulewe kulendawo."Mumva nje kusanda kutholakala umuntu wesifazane owayeshayiwe naye. Wayesikwe ulimu, lwafakwa esiswini. Kuthona izitho zomzimba ezazingabonakali." UNgubane uthe kukhona owesilisa owaduka endaweni efanayo athe sebemfune baze bancama."Wagcina ukubonakala esendaweni yobumnandi. Isikhindi sakhe sangaphansi satholakala sinegazi. Okukhathazayo ukuthi abekho abantu ababoshaywa. Siyafisa ukuthi kube khona abantu ababoshaywo. Sinxusa ukuthi umphakathi ubambisane namaphoyisa."UNgubane uthe umndeni wakwaDuma uthwele kanzima njengoba ulungiselela umngcwabo. "Isimo sinzoma ngoba bebethembele kakhulu esibonelelweni sakhe umfana. Bacelile nje ukuthi uma kukhona abangasiza, ikakhulu ngokudla."Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uConstable Thenjiswa Ngcobo, uthe amaphoyisa aphenya icala lokubulala."Imbangela yokubulala ayikaziwa. Wabulawa abantu abangaziwa. Watholakala eshile emzimbeni, washonela khona endaweni atholakala kuyo."
INkantolo yeMantshi yase-Alexandra ilihlehlisele umhlaka-26 Agasti 2025 icala elibhekene nosomabhizinisi uVusimuzi Matlala. UMatlala uvele nomkakhe uTsakani Matlala, kanye noMusa Kekana noTiego Floyd Mabusela. UMbuso ucele ukuhlehliswa ukuze kuvunyelwe ukufakwa phakathi kwamadokodo amabili atholwe ePitoli, lapho abasolwa bayathinteka khona futhi kuvunyelwe ukuba icala lidluliselwe eNkantolo eNkulu yaseNingizimu Afrika eGoli. Abasolwa babhekene namacala okuzama ukubulala, itulo lokubulala, ukukhwabanisa kanye nelokuzama ukufihla ubugebengu. La macala asukela ezigamekweni okusolwa ukuthi zenzeke eGoli phakathi kuka-12 no-17 Okthoba 2023, lapho kusolwa ukuthi abammangalelwa bakha itulo lokubulala uTebogo Thobejane. Kuthiwa bavulela ngenhlamvu kuThobejane nabanye ababili ayehamba nano emotweni. Kusolwa nokuthi ummangalelwa wakhokha imali engu-R120 000 ehlobene netulo lokubulala wase ehambisa ne-invoice yomgunyathi ezama ukufihla umsuka wale mali nokudukisa inkantolo. Abameli babammangalelwa bafake isicelo sokuthi umbuso udalule izingxenye ezithile zedokodo; nokho-ke iMantshi yasichitha isicelo. Usomabhizinisi nabasolwa ababili basagcinwe esitokisini, kanti uTsakani Matlala yena udedelwe ngebheyili.
UKHUZA ibuya ihlandla lesibili nonyaka umcimnbi onhloso yawo wukuqhakambisa nokunika osomabhizinisi abasafufusa abadayisa ukudla okusheshayo ithuba lokusabalalisa futhi bathengise ukudla kwakho ngokukhululeka okubasiza basimamise amabhizinisi abo.Lo mcimbi obizwa ngeThekwini Kota Festival, uzoba seKings Park Stadium, eThekwini ngoMgqibelo ngo-Agasti 2, ngo-10 ekuseni kuya ku-8 ebusuku, lapho okuzobe kuhlangene khona osomabhizinisi bedayisa, kube kuqhubeka idili lomculo.Omunye wabasunguli balo mcimbi uMnuz Luvo Dimba waseGoli, uthe impumelelo yomcimbi wanyakenye, ibakhuthaze ukuthi bakhuthalele ukuwubuyisa futhi nonyaka ukuqhuba umbono wabo wokufukula labo somabhizinisi, kube kuqhakanjiswa nezinhlobo zokudla okusheshayo nokuwundabamlonyeni ebantwini. "Inhloso yethu wukuthi lezi zinhlobo zokudla zihlale ziqhakanjiswa zona nosomabhizinisi abazidayisayo ikakhulu ngoba yinto yethu esikhule ngayo neyenza ukuthi sihluke kwabanye abantu bezinye izinhlanga. Yingakho siqhubeka nokuveza ithuba elinjena elizosiza ngokuthi osomabhizinisi bakhuthazeke kwabakwenzayo ngokubasondezela abantu abazothenga imikhiqizo yabo, bayishebe nomculo omnandi," usho kanje. Uthe emcimbini kuzobe kunedili lomculo, lapho okuzobe kunandisa khona amaciko ehlukene adumile, nokho abangezukuwadalula ngoba umcimbi awukho ngabo, kodwa uqondene nosomabhizinisi abazobe bedayisa u kudla kusukela umcimbi uqala uze uphele. "Bangaphezu kuka-20 osomabhizinisi abazobe benkanise inkundla yonke bedayisa ukudla kwabo okwehlukene, kanti sibheke ukuthi umcimbi wethu usize ukwakha amathuba omsebenzi angaphezu kuka-300 ngalolu suku okuzosiza abantu baseKZN kuphela," kusho uDimba.Amathikithi omcimbi ayatholakala eComputicket naseShoprite ngo-R200 i-general no-R400 i-VIP kubantu abadala, kube wuR150 i-general noR400 i-VIP yezitshudeni zesikhungo zemfundo ephakeme noR110 noR250 izingane ezincane.

KUHLWE emini kubamangalelwa ababili ebebesolwa ngecala lokubulala ngesihluku umfundi waseDurban Girls Secondary, ijaji libalahla ngecala lokubulala eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini, izolo. USfundo Bhengu (39), ongummangalelwa wokuqala futhi ongumakhelwane kamufi noBongani Jali (28), ongummangalelwa wesibili, balahlwe yicala lokugwaza babulale uWandile Ngcobo (17) owayefunda uGrade 11. Isigameko senzeka ngesikhathi esele yedwa kubo kwa-U eMlaza, ngoMeyi, ngonyaka odlule. Ijaji uGarth Harrison, libasukumisa oBhengu noJali lithe: "Ecaleni lokuqala lokugqekeza, nginikhipha phambili nobabili. Kwelesibili lokuphanga ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima, nginithola ninecala nobabili bese kuthi kwelesithathu, elokubulala, nginilahla ngecala nobabili.” Ngaphambi kwalokho, uHarrison ucacise eyokuchitha ubufakazi babo bobabili abalahlwe yicala, wagxila kakhulu kummangalelwa wesibili. "Inkantolo ayikukholwa uma uthi awuzange uzibandakanye ebugebengwini. Ubufakazi bakho buyashintshashintsha,” kusho uHarrison. Enza isibonelo, uthe kukhona lapho uJali aveza khona ukuthi yena wasala kubo kammangalelwa wokuqala, wangaya endaweni yesigameko. Uthe kuphinde kube khona lapho aveza khona ukuthi yena wayemi ngaphandle kwendawo yesigameko, eqaphile, waze wabona ithelevishini (eyayingaphakathi endlini) ikhanya umbala oluhlaza. "Inkantolo ikubona njengofakazi ozama ngawo wonke amandla ukuziqhelelanisa necala ekubeni abanye ofakazi bekubeka esigamekweni,” kusho uHarrison. Ubalule nokuthi kuvela amanga ebufakazini bakhe lapho eveza khona ukuthi yena wangena ngaphakathi egcekeni eseyothatha ithelevishini kuphela."Waqonda ngqo lapho eyayibekwe khona egcekeni ngoba wawazi ukuthi ikuphi ngoba naniyibeke nobabili,” usho kanje.Ubuye wabalula nokuthi ukuboshwa kukamufi izandla, izinyawo nomlomo ukuze angamemezi, yinto abayenza ngokubambisana. UHarrison ucaphune ubufakazi bofakazi abehlukene, esho abamukelayo nalobo angabamukeli. Obabo bobabili abamangalelwa uthe akabamukeli, wathi abunaqiniso futhi buqukethe amanga. Ubuye wacaphuna ubufakazi bukayise kamufi, uMnuz Mondli Ngcobo, wathi inkantolo iyabamukela njengobuyiqiniso. "Ubengubaba osezinhlungwini, elinde olwakhe usuku enkantolo ukuthi akhiphe konke okusesifubeni ngokubulawa kwendodakazi yakhe,” kusho uHarrison. Uqhube wathi bekungekho abefuna ukukufihla, waze waveza nokuthi indodakazi yakhe yayineselula nobhaka wePuma. Uphinde wamukela ubufakazi bukamasitende kaBhengu, uMnuz Mxolisi Ngcobo, oveze ukuthi ummangalelwa waqala ukuhlala emqashweni ekuqaleni kukaMeyi, ngonyaka odlule, ngaphandle kokukhokha irenti.Uthe waze waveza ukuthi baxabana naye, bebanga lokho, waze wabamba ubhaka wakhe wePuma awubona emqashweni. "Yilowo bhaka athi wathola ucingo lukaGugu (intombi kaBhengu), ewufuna, ethi unezimpahla zomsebenzi zikammangalelwa,” kusho uHarrison. Uveze ukuthi wathi uma ewubheka ubhaka waqaphela ukuthi owePuma, phakathi une-decoder yeDStv ne-remote yethelevishini. "Lezi zimpahla zambeka esigamekweni ummangalelwa wokuqala,” usho kanje. Obunye ubufakazi athe uyabamukela obukaMnuz Malungisa Dlamini, ophenduke ufakazi woMbuso, emva kokugeqa amagula ngokuthenga iselula kamufi komunye wabamangalelwa. Icala liyaqhubeka namuhla, ukuze abameli benze izethulo zokuthi abalahlwe amacala banikwe isigwebo esincane.
INkantolo yeMantshi yaseRandburg inike amasosha angu-12 eSouth African Defence Force (SANDF) ibheyili ka-R10 000 ngamunye, asolwa ngokubandakanyeka emacaleni okubulala uLieutenant Colonel Mathipa nabanye abantu ababili okusolakala ukuthi babathumba eMall of Africa ngomhla ka-29 Disemba 2022. Abammangalelwa babhekene namacala abucayi, okuhlanganisa namacala amathathu okubulala, ukuthumba, ukukhwabanisa, ukuphazamisa ukusebenza kwengalo yomthetho, ukuqamba amanga ngesifungo kanye nokweba imoto. La macala asukela ekuthunjweni kuka-Abdella Hussain Abadiga noKadir Jemal Abotese, abathunjwa base beyiswa e-Zwartkop Military Base, kanti namanje akwaziwa ukuthi bakuphi. Abammangalelwa baphinde babhekane namacala ahlobene nelokubulala uLieutenant Colonel Frans Mathipa, iphoyisa elisebenza ngaphansi kophiko loKlebe elaliphenya icala lokuthunjwa kuka-Abadiga no-Abatise. UMathipa wabulawa mhla zi-6 ku-Agasti 2023, eshayela ku-N1 Highway abagibeli besebenzisa imoto ye-SANDF. Umshushisi wethule incwadi efungelwe evela kumphenyi wecala, esho ukuthi bayingozi emphakathini njengoba beqeqeshelwe ukusebenzisa izibhamu ezisezingeni eliphezulu ukuze kuqedwe noma yikuphi usongo. Incwadi efungelwe iphinde yachaza kabanzi ngokuthi umsolwa ngamunye uhlobene kanjani nalezi zinsolo nokuthi umsolwa kuthiwa wazama kanjani ukukhipha imoto emgwaqweni kubulawa kukaCol. Mathipa. Abameli babamangalelwa bethule izincwadi ezifungelwe zabamangalelwa, bethi bebengekho ezundaweni zezigameko futhi abazi lutho ngamacala okubulala. UKHALE ngo-R500 000 wakhe osebhange, athe ngeke akwazi ukufinyelela kuwo ukuze aqhubeke nokondla izingane zakhe uSfundo Bhengu (40), ezicelela ejajini laseNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini, izolo, ukuthi limshaye ngoswazi oluncane.UBhengu noBongani Jali (28), abanikwe ithuba lokuthi bazikhalele ukuze bathole izigwebo ezincane, balahlwe yicala lokugwaza babulale umfundi waseDurban Girls Secondary ngoMeyi, ngonyaka odlule.UWandile Ngcobo (17), owayefunda uGrade 11 ngesikhathi ebulalwa, wahlaselwa yilaba ababili esele yedwa kubo. Kuthiwa bangena kubo bantshontsha impahla okwakukhona kuyo ithelevishini, iselula, i-decoder ye-DStv base begwaza bebulala umufi, abambopha nge-pantyhose izandla, izinyawo nomlomo. Mathathu amacala abebhekene nawo, kuwona kukhona elokubulala, elokugqekeza nelokubamba inkunzi ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima. UBhengu okuthiwa wayengumakhelwane kamufi, uveze ukuthi unezingane ezinhlanu ezisencane, ezingasakutholi ukunakekelwa kahle kulandela ukuboshwa kwakhe. "Uma ngigwetshwa udilikajele, konke lokhu ebese ngizame ukukwakha ngesikhathi ngisengaphandle kuzoshabalala. Ngicabanga nangezingane zami, bengizondla ngemali ye-renti kodwa ngizwa kuthiwa umphakatthi wazixosha iziqashi, lokhu kusho ukuthi ayisekho imali yokondla izingane zami,” kusho uBhengu. Nginayo imali esebhange engu-R500 000 kodwa angikwazi ukuyikhipha njengoba ngiboshiwe,” kusho uBhengu.Kuvele ukuthi le mali okuthiwa iyisamba asinikwa yiRoad Accident Fund, kulandela ukulimala engozini ngo-2019, ingene ebhange esevele eboshiwe.Kuthiwa ingeyesibili njengoba kukhona esinye isamba esike sangena phambilini, okuthiwa wasibhubhudla nabangani ngezidakamizwa. Kuvele nokuthi izihlobo zakhe, okukhona kuzo abazali nezingane zakwabo bashona ngesikhathi elokhu engena ephuma ejele ngamacala ehlukene obugebengu. UJali yena ubelokhu ekhale njalo ngokuthi akazange abulale.Ube esecela ukuthi bahlukaniswe noBhengu ngoba ukuthola kunzima ukuthi alokhu ehleka ubala nomuntu okuze kwafikwa ekugcineni engafuni ukuveza iqiniso lokuthi yena akazange ambulale umfundi. Umshushisi woMbuso, u-Advocate Krishen Shah, uthe kuyamangaza ukuthi ngaso sonke isikhathi uma abalahlwe ngamacala sebezicelela isigwebo esincane, bavele bagijimise phambili indaba yezingane zabo.Ebuza ijali, ogcine ebaleke njalo nempendulo yombuzo ukuthi, "Emalini enahlukaniselana yona, ikhona owayihlephula wayiyisa enganeni?”Uphinde wathi kuyamangaza ukuthi izigebengu uma zithola imali yobugebengu ziyibhubhudla ezintweni eziqondene nazo njengezidakamizwa, zingacabangi ngezingane ezibe seziveza ukuthi zinazo uma sezilengelwa yizembe lesigwebo. Ngasekupheleni kokuzinxusela kwabo, iJaji uGarth Harrison, lithe kuyamangaza ukuthi kuze kwafika ekugcineni engekho kubo ophumela obala, asho ukuthi wuye owamgwaza wambulala umufi."Lokhu kudweba isithombe sokuthi anizisoli nhlobo ngecala enilenzile,” kusho uHarrison.Laba bagwetshwa namuhla.
