BAKHALA ngohulumeni abathi udlala ngabo abayizisulu zezikhukhula, abaphenduke ondingasithebeni bekhishelwa emnyango ehhotela ebebegobe kulo amadlangala iBayside eThekwini ngoLwesithathu ekuseni, balala endle.Lezi zisulu ziququdwe amakhaza, zashiswa nayilanga ngoba zingenayo enye indawo ebezizoya kuyona ngenxa yokuthi bezisalinde ukuthi uhulumeni aphinde azibhekele enye indawo ebezizogoba kuyo amadlangala.Ibalelwa ngaphezu kuka-70, imindeni ebihleli kuleli hhotela, isuka ezindlini ezingamathini eLamontville ngoFebhuwari kulo nyaka, kulandela ukukhahlanyezwa yizikhukhula. Libakhiphela ngaphandle ihhotela, likhale ngokungakhokhelwa wuhulumeni imali yerenti. Ngesikhathi lifika Isolezwe kule ndawo izolo, izimpahla zabo bezikleliswe onqenqemeni lomgwaqo ngaphandle kwehhotela. Kuzona bekukhona izimpahla zokugqoka nezokulala. Kubona bekukhona abesifazane, abesilisa, izaguga nezingane ezincane.Okhulumela uMnyango wokuHlaliswa kwaBantu KwaZulu-Natal uMnuz Ndabezinhle Sibiya, udalule ukuthi ibalelwa kuR185 million imali esikhokhwe wuhulumeni emahhotela nasemafulethini okuhlaliswe kuwo abakhahlanyezwa yizikhukhula.Uthe ingu-R128 million imali edingwa wuhulumeni ukuze uqhubeke ukhokhele abangu-1 200 abasala dengwane ngenxa yezikhukhula. Kubagilwa bezikhukhula abahlaliswe ezindaweni ezehlukene okukhona kuzo amahhotela namafulethi, kukhona nabakhahlanyezwa yizikhukhula zango-Ephreli 2022.Uma uhulumeni ewuthola lo-R128 million othi uyadingeka ukuze uqhubeke ukhokhele abagilwa kulezi zindawo zesikhashana abagcinwe kuzo, kusho ukuthi izoba wuR313 million isiyonke imali ezosebenza kulolu hlelo.Omunye wabagilwa, uMnuz Siyabonga Mthethwa ulibeke ngesihloko elokuthi iyabadina eyokuthi kudlalwe ngabo. "Ngesikhathi sisuswa eLamont, izikhulu zikahulumeni zazithe sesizokwakhelwa izindlu uma siphuma la sizoya ezindlini zethu esizokwakhelwa zona," kusho uMthethwa.Phakathi kwababalile ukuthi benza lezi zethembiso wuMengameli wezwe uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa, uNdunankulu wesifundazwe nobuholi bukamasipala, athe bonke bafika qathatha eBayside, bezokwenza lezi zethembiso.Uthe basola ukuthi idliwe imali yokuthi bakhelwe ngoba babethenjiswe ukuthi umnyakazo uzoqala ukubonakala ezinyangeni ezinhlanu kuya kweziyisithupha. "Kodwa manje akukaqali lutho. Sizithola silele emnyango," usho kanje.Uthe ukukhishwa kwabo phandle kushaye kwazwela ngoba kubona kukhona izingane ezincane, ezinye zazo ezisanda kuzalwa, ezilale emoyeni."Kukhona nogogo, nabantu abadala, esilele nabo la. Izikhulu zikahulumeni zona zilele kamnandi emizini yazo zifudumele," kusho uMthethwa. Uthe kwasekuqaleni babeshilo ukuthi bafuna izindlu hhayi amahhotela abizayo."Imali sebeyiqedile ke manje, yikho sesikhishelwa phandle," usho kanje.Uthe abafuni ukuya ehholo laseChesterville, uMnyango wokuHlaliswa kwaBantu esifundazweni, osuhlele ukuthi bayocupha kulo isikhashana. "Imiphakathi ihlale isixosha. Njengoba sila, sisuka kwelaseChatsworth, la basixosha khona," kusho uMthethwa, othe ngisho nakwelaseLamontville baxoshwa.Ukhale nangokuthi ukuyohlala eChesterville kuzobashaya ephaketheni ngoba bazokhokha imali ephindiwe yokugibela beya emsebenzini baphinde bagibeze izingane ezifundayo.USibiya uthe: "Kubi ukuthi abanikazi behhotela bavele baxosha abantu ngale kokuxoxisana nohulumeni. Sithole izolo (esho ngoLwesithathu) ukuthi sebexoshiwe."Uveze nokuthi sebelwenzile uhlelo lokuthi abagilwa bayohlaliswa ehholo lomphakathi eChesterville. Uthe bazitholile izikhalo zokuthi kukhona idlanzana elisabisa abafuna ukuya eChesterville okwesikhashana ngesikhathi uMphathiswa uMnuz Siboniso Duma noNgqongqoshe kazwelonke walo mnyango uNksz Thembi Simelane, besaqhamuka nesixazululo."UDuma unxusa abafuna ukuya eChesterville ukuthi bahambe ngaphandle kokusatshiswa," usho kanje. Ubalule nezingqinamba umnyango obhekene nazo ngolwabezikhukhula, ethi abakhi ebebeyoqala umsebenzi wokwakha izindlu zezisulu eShallcross, baxoshwa ngezibhamu."Nathi sasatshiswa, kwaqhunyiswa ngisho izibhamu. Le nto isibuyisela emuva. Asifuni ukubona imiphakathi ivimba uhlelo lokuhlaliswa kwabakhahlanyezwa yizikhukhula," kusho uSibiya.

IMbube izohlonishwa ngeqhaza layo ekugcinweni kwamasiko kaZulu nangokulwela ubumbano ezwenikazi i-Afrika.Okhulumela iSilo, uMntwana uThulani kaGqikazi Zulu, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi amabombo abheke e-United Kingdom.UMntwana uThulani, okhulume neSolezwe ngesikhathi elungiselela ukuya emcimbini, uchaze ukuhlonishwa kweSilo kulo mcimbi njengengqophamlando. "Okuningi sizokukhuluma kahle uma umcimbi sewenzekile."Abe-African Achievers Awards, bathe iNdlulamithi yamakhosi ibambe iqhaza elikhulu ekugcinweni kwamasiko.IMbube ihola imikhosi kaZulu ebalulekile okubalwa kuyo, owoMhlanga, owokweShwama kanye noweLembe. "Kuyintokozo kithina ukuthi emcimbini wakulo nyaka sizohlonipha iSilo samaZulu. IMbube isezingeni layo yodwa njengomholi uma sikhuluma ngokuqhakanjiswa kwamasiko. ISilo sizinikele ekuthuthukiseni i-Afrika."Abahleli bomcimbi bathe iMbube kufanele ishayelwe ihlombe ngokuzama ukuhlanganisa isizwe sayo."ISilo siyalilandela ngempela igama laso njengoba silwela ubumbano esizweni saso. Namanje iSilo siyaqhubeka nokuqhakambisa amasiko, ulimi kanye nabantu baso. Lona kuzoba wumcimbi omkhulu ngempela." Abahleli bomcimbi baphinde bancoma imizamo yeSilo yokubumba izizwe zase-Afrika.IMbube isike yothiwa amakhosi aqhamuka ezingxenyeni ezahlukene zezwekazi i-Afrika.EMkhosini weLembe wangonyaka odlule, iSilo sakhuza ukuhlukunyezwa kwabokufika, sanxusa ukuba kube nobumbano kubantu basezwenikazi i-Afrika. Muva nje sisanda kusayina isivumelwano sokusebenzisana neNkosi yaseNigeria, u-Ogiame Atuwatse III.Abahleli bomcimbi bathe kubalulekile ukuthi amakhosi agqugquzele ubumbano ezwenikazi."Izwekazi i-Afrika linothile. Uma abantu bakhona bengase babumbane, kuningi abangakwenza. Yingakho sigqugquzela abaholi ukuthi balwele ubumbano."Umcimbi wakulo nyaka uzohanjelwa abaholi bezepolitiki, osomabhizinisi kanye nabaholi bezinhlangano zamalungelo abantu.
BASHAYA amakhala abaholi be-ANC ngohlu lwabantu abazovota okhethweni lokuchibiyela oluzokuba kuMasipala wasebaQulusini.Abe-ANC bathi kunezinkulungwane zabantu ezibhalisele ukuvota kulolu khetho, okusolwa ukuthi abahlali endaweni okuzokube kunokhetho kuyo.Ukhetho lokuchibiyela luzokuba kuWard 23, ngoLwesithathu ozayo. I-ANC yabhalela inhlangano eyengamele ukhetho, i-Independent Electoral Commission (IEC), ikhalaza ngohlu lwabantu ababhalisele ukuvota.Esikhalazweni sayo i-ANC yenza izinsolo zokuthi kukhona abantu abangahlali kuWard 23, ababhalisele ukuvota.Okhulumela i-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Fanle Sibisi, uthe impendulo abayithole kwi-IEC emva kwesikhalazo sabo ikhombisa ngokusobala ukuthi kukhona okushaya amanzi. USibisi uthe ucwaningo olwenziwe i-IEC emva kwesikhalazo sabo luveza ukuthi kunabantu abangaphezu kuka-2 000 abangatholakalanga ukuze kuqinisekiswe ngempela ukuthi bahlala endaweni.Bebonke abantu ababhalisele ukuvota okhethweni bangu-5 741."Abakwa-IEC bahambele cishe yonke imizi ekhona endaweni, kwasala nje imizi eyisishiyagalombili, lapho babeqinisekisa khona ukuthi abantu bahlala khona yini kule mizi ababhalise ukuthi bahlala kuyo. Bangu 3 293 abantu okwaqinisekiswa ukuthi bahlala khona ngempela endaweni. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kunabantu abangu-2 448 okungazange kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bahlala khona ngempela yini endaweni." USibisi uthe abantu abangu-680 kulabo abangazange batholakale ohlwini lwabazovota."Nakuba sikwamukela lokho kodwa iqiniso ukuthi kunabantu abangu-1 768 abasohlwini lokuvota abangatholakalanga ukuba baqinisekise ukuthi bahlala khona ngempela endaweni. Ukungakhishwa ohlwini lwabavoti kwala bantu abangu-1 768 abangazange batholakale, kubeka engcupheni ubuqotho bokhetho."Uthe: "Bonke laba bantu abazange batholakale ngesikhathi kunohlelo lokuhambela yonke imizi. Lolu hlelo lokuhambela imizi lwaluqhutshwa i-IEC futhi kwakukhona abamele onke amaqembu angenele ukhetho. Sinxusa i-IEC ukuba ichaze kabanzi ukuthi kungani laba bantu bengakhishwanga ohlwini lwabavoti." Okhulumela i-IEC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thabani Ngwira, akazange ayiphendule imibuzo ayithunyelelwe.Umbango wokuhola iwadi ishisa phansi njengoba amaqembu angenele ukhetho eqhubeka nemikhankaso yawo.Iwadi ibikade iphethwe i-IFP, isikhala savuleka emva kokushona kwekhansela.
LUGOBILE uphondo esikhwameni esigade umhlaba kaZulu, iNgonyama Trust, njengoba sigcine sivumile ukukhokha izigidi zamaRandi, ezaqoqwa kubantu ababekhokhiswa imali yokukhonza ezindaweni zamakhosi.INgonyama Trust imemezele ukuthi isiluqalile uhlelo lokukhokhela abebekhokhishwa imali yokukhonza.INgonyama Trust izoqala uhlelo lokukhokha le mali emuva kombango wasenkantolo owaqala eminyakeni emihlanu eyedlule. "Bonke abantu ababenezivumelwano zokukhokha bayanxuswa ukuba basithinte ukuze sibheke imininingwane yabo, bese beyakhokhelwa uma kuwukuthi ngempela kufanele bakhokhelwe."Imali eyaqoqwa yiNgonyama Trust ayikaze igagulwe kodwa kuthiwa iyizigidi zamaRandi.Kwezinye izindawo kuthiwa abantu babekhokhiswa imali engu-R7 000 ngonyaka. UMxakaza uthe iminyakeni edlule iNgonyama Trust, yaphuma umkhankaso wokusayinisa abantu abakhe ezindaweni zamakhosi izivumelwano zokwakha ezibizwa ngama-residential leases.Uthe baningi kakhulu abantu abasayiniswa lezi zivumelwano, wathi bakulo lonke elikaMthaniya."Lezi zivumelwano zazenza ukuthi kube lula ukuba abantu bakwazi ukusebenzisa imizi yabo njengezibambiso uma beyoboleka imali emabhange." Uthe inkinga ababhekene nayo njengamanje ukuthi abanye abantu ababekhokhiswa abasatholakali."Kukhona abanye abantu asebashintsha izinombolo zocingo. Sinxusa abantu ukuthi bathintane namahhovisi ethu."Ngesikhathi kwenzeka lokhu kwakukhona Isilo esabuza uGoodwill Zwelithini. Khonamanjalo, iNgonyama Trust isanda kuqoka isikhulu esiphezulu esisha esibambile, uMnuz Siyamdumisa Vilakazi.UVilakazi uyisikhulu sezimali kwiNgonyama Trust, uzoncelisa amawele. ANGASE abhekane necala lokudukisa iPhalamende uNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa okhungethwe yizinkinga, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, emva kokuba evume ukwazana nomuntu athi akamazi ngesikhathi ebuzwa ngaye ePhalamende.Usihlalo wekomiti lezamaphoyisa ePhalamende, uMnuz Ian Cameron, uthe bazohlala phansi bacubungule ukuthi bazomthathela ziphi izinyathelo uMchunu ovume ukwazana noMnuz Brown Mogotsi.Esitatimendeni asikhiphe izolo, uMchunu uvumile ukuthi uyamazi uMogotsi kodwa wathi akasondelene naye. Phezu kokuvula icala kungaphinde kube khona nesidingo sokuthi simcebe ekomitini lasePhalamende lezobuqotho," kusho uCameron.I-DA ihlela ukuvulela uMchunu icala, namhlanje. Izinsolo zokuthi uMchunu usondelene noMogotsi zenziwa uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi.UMkhwanazi wathi uMogotsi wazana nosomabhizinisi oboshelwe icala lokuzama ukubulala, uMnuz Vusumuzi "Cat" Matlala, osolwa ngokusebenzisana nezigebengu.UMatlala usanda kubanjwa nomakhalekhukhwini ejele. Esitatimendeni asikhiphe izolo, uMchunu uthe akamazi uMatlala, wathi futhi akakaze acele lutho kuyena.USomlomo wePhalamende, uNkk Thoko Didiza, uyalele amakomiti asePhalamende, elezamaphoyisa, elezobulungiswa nelezinhloli, ukuba abhekisise kahle izinsolo zikaMkhwanazi bese emnikeza umbiko.UNkk Didiza usichithile isicelo sokuba kube nenkulumo mpikiswano ePhalamende ngalolu daba. Uthe izinsolo ezenziwe uMkhwanazi azinabo ubufakazi, zisadinga ukuba ziphenywe.UKhomishana wamaPhoyisa, uGeneral Fanie Masemola, uveze ukuthi sekuqiniswe ezokuphepha zikaMkhwanazi ngenxa yezinsongo."Ngiyakuqinisekisa ukuthi sekuqiniswe ezokuphepha ngenxa yokuthi uMkhwanazi uthola izinsongo esifundazweni." UMasemola uthe angeke uMkhwanazi ajeziselwe ukubiza isithangami sabezindaba ngeSonto.UMasemola uthe uMkhwanazi unelungelo lokubiza isithangami sabezindaba akhulume ngezindaba ezithinta ubugebengu."Wangazisa ukuthi uzobiza isithangami nabezindaba. Wangitshela ukuthi uzokhuluma ngamacala athinta ukubulawa kosopolitiki. Sekunesikhathi eside kwagcina ukuba kube nesithangami esikhuluma ngala macala. Njengoba ewukhomishana wamaphoyisa unalo ilungelo lokubiza isithangami nabezindaba. Ingakho singeke silokhu simhluphela ukuthi ubize isithangami nabezindaba." UMasemola uthe akazange awukhiphe umyalelo wokuba kuhlakazwe ithimba eliphenya amacala okubulawa kosopolitiki KwaZulu-Natal.Lokhu kuyashayisana nokushiwo iPhini likaKhomishana wamaPhoyisa, uLieutenant General Shadrack Sibiya, othe ithimba lahlakazwa emva komyalelo kaMasemola, naye owayethathe umyalelo kuMchunu."Uke wayibona incwadi esayinwe yimi ethi akuhlakazwe ithimba?" kubuza uMasemola. UMasemola unxuse amaphoyisa ukuba aqhubeke nokwenza umsebenzi wawo."Lesi isikhathi esinzima. Siyakujabulela ukuthi uMengameli (Cyril Ramaphosa), uthe uyalusukumela lolu daba. Sikulungele ukuba siyohlangana nomengameli, siyomnikeza umbiko."
INkantolo eNkulu eThekwini ikugwebe uPhilani Siyabonga Ndwandwe udilikajele, emuva kokuthi umbuso wedlulise isinqumo ngesigwebo ayesithole ngo-2023.Phakathi kukaJulayi 2018 no-Ephreli 2020, uNdwandwe waxoxa nabagilwa kwi-Facebook ebathembisa umsebenzi. Wayevame ukuhlangana nabagilwa eMaoti naseCongo bese ehamba nabo.Kuyothi endleleni bese ebajikela abasabise ngommese abashove ehlathini abadlwengule. Inkantolo ayichazanga isizathu sokuchezuka kulesi sigwebo esibekiwe kodwa yagweba uNdwandwe iminyaka ewu-15 nakulawo macala anesigwebo sikadilikajele. I-Road Traffic Management Corporation (RTMC) iyakwemukela ukugwetshwa komhloli waKwaZulu-Natal wamalayisensi okushayela kanye nothisha wesikole sokushayela ecaleni elichazwa njengokwephulwa kobuqotho emkhakheni wokukhishwa kwamalayisensi okushayela. Ngomhla ka-8 Julayi 2025, iNkantolo yoBugebengu eThekwini ithole uMnuz Sandile Ndlovu, umhloli waseMooi River, enecala lokukhwabanisa nelokwakha itulo lenkohlakalo ngemuva kokuba kutholakale ukuthi wayekhiphe ilayisensi yomfundi ngomgunyathi kumuntu owayengalubhalanga uvivinyo oludingekayo. UNdlovu waboshwa ngo-2016 kulandela izikhalo ezatholwa yiNational Traffic Anti-Corruption Unit (NTACU), ophikweni lweRTMC. Lolu phiko lusebenzisana nophiko lwezobunhloli KwaZulu-Natal KwaZulu-Natal kanye nophiko olulwa nenkohlakalo iDirectorate for Priority Crime Investigation (Hawks) ukuze kuphenywe ngalezi zikhalo. Kutholakale ukuthi uNdlovu wakha itulo noNksz Zandile Dlamini, ofundisa ukushayela, ukuze akhiphe ilayisensi yokufundela ukushayela kwakhokhwa imali engu-R3000. UNksz Dlamini naye ulahlwe yicala ngeqhaza lakhe lokugqugquzela ukungaziphathi kahle ngokwamukela umhlomulo ongekho emthethweni ngaleli cala.Icala lihlehliselwe ka29 Agasti 2025 ukuze kwenziwe izendlalelo zesigwebo. Ngaleso sikhathi, uMbuso kulindeleke ukuthi ubize ofakazi abengeziwe ukuze bagqamise umthelela walezi zinyathelo ekuphepheni emgwaqeni nasezinsizeni zomphakathi ezibanzi.
EBHAYIBHELINI encwadini yeZaga zeNkosi uSolomoni zesi-22 evesini lesithupha, kufundeka kanjena: "Khulisa umntwana ngendlela eyakuba ngeyakhe; kuyakuthi lapho esekhulule, angasuki kuyo.”’Wukubuswa yilawo mazwi okwenze uNksz Nomthandazo Mnguni wakhuthazeka ukuqopha ama-video endodana yakhe yenza imigilingwane yomgwabo waseZayoni, bese ewafaka ekhasini lakhe lakwi-TikTok, elilokhu likhule njalo ngenxa yenqwaba yabantu abalilandelayo.Leli khasi elithi @nomteebabe selinabalandeli abangaphezu kwa-13 000, kanti futhi selibukwe izikhawu ezingaphezu kwa-178 000 ngenxa yama-video kaNkosingiphile (4), okuvame ukuvela egwaba noma egekla (okuyindlela yokudansa yaseZayoni). Engxoxweni neSolezwe Ngempelasonto, uNksz Mnguni wakwaThema, e-East Rand, eGauteng, uthe uthando lwesonto luqale ukumvela kumntwana wakhe wesithathu nongowokugcina esaneminyaka emibili, okuthi njalo uma kudlala ingoma yaseZayoni bezihlalele ekhaya, avele atshakadule kuhle kwethole libona onina. "Kuthe ngelinye ilanga ngivakashelwe ngabazalwane ekhaya, bambona enza le mgilingwane yakhe, base bengicebisa ukuthi ngimshuthe ama-video bese ngiwafaka ekhasini lami likaTikTok. Nakuba ngaqala ngaba manqika ngoba ngingafuni ukuthi umntwana wami azeke kunoma wubani, ikakhulu ngoba usasemncane, kepha kwagcina kube kanjalo nangempela kwaba wukuduma kwakhe kanjalo, njengoba ngathi ngiqeda ukufaka i-video yakhe yokuqala esayenza ngo-2023, akuphelanga sikhathi esingakanani yabe isibukwe ngabantu abangaphezu kwa-2 000,” usho kanje. Eqhuba, uthe lokho kumkhuthaze ukuthi aqhubeke amqophe ama-video njalo ikakhulu ngoba vela naye ukhombisa intshisekelo yakho konke lokhu njengoba isikhathi esiningi kuvame ukuba wuyena omcelayo ukuthi amdlalele ingoma ethile yaseZayoni, bese enza adume ngakho."Ngicebisa nabanye abazali ukuthi baqaphele izimpawu zezinto ezinhle abazibona zenziwa ngabantwana babo bese bebeseka kuzona, ikakhulu ezenkolo nesonto ngoba ziyamkhulisa kakhulu umntwana futhi zenza ukuthi aqoqeke ezintweni eziningi,” kusho uNksz Mnguni okhonza ebandleni lamaZayoni i-Grace of Christ Umusa, elizinze khona eGauteng.

Kusolwa ukuthi iloli ebelihamba libheke ngaseThekwini umshayeli wahluleka ukulilawula laphaphalaza lawela phakathi nendawo lashayisa ibhasi. Kusetshenziswe ama-ambulensi amaningi ukuhlenga abalimele endaweni yesigameko ngaphambi kokuba bahanjiswe ezibhedlela ezahlukene zaseThekwini. Ngebhadi umshayeli weloli owesilisa okukholakala ukuthi uneminyaka engamashumi amahlanu ubudala utholwe evaleleke kule ngozi elimele kakhulu, akukho abezimo eziphuthumayo abebengamsiza ngakho kwabe sekumenyezelwa ukuthi ushonele endaweni yesigameko. NJENGOBA izwe limagange ukuzwa izinyathelo ezizothathwa uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, ngodaba lwezinsolo ezibhekiswe kuNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, abantu bayaqhubeka nokuzwakalisa ukweseka kwabo uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi.Izinsolo ezishaqisayo ezenziwe uMkhwanazi sezidale inkulumo mpikiswano ezweni.Nakuba kukhona abasola uMkhwanazi ngokungalandeli imigomo, babukeka banda abazwakalisa ukweseka uMkhwanazi. Kukhona abahlela imibhikisho yokweseka uMkhwanazi.Eyokwesekwa kukaMkhwanazi isize yangenwa nangabantu bangakubo, eMakhuzeni, eMpendle.UMkhwanazi uyisakhamuzi saseMakhuzeni esizakhele ugazi ngokuhlela idili le midlalo.Kubikwa nokuthi sekuqiniswe ezokuphepha emzini kaMkhwanazi kulandela isithangami sangeSonto. Ikusasa likaMkhwanazi alicaci emaphoyiseni njengoba nenkontileka yakhe iphela kuwo lo nyaka.Ikhansela lalapho kuqhamuka khona uMkhwanazi, uMnuz Sadewu Ngubane, lithe bangakujabulela ukuthi uMkhwanazi aqhubeke kulesi sikhundla.UNgubane uthe mkhulu umehluko owenziwe uMkhwanazi kusukela angena. "SiyiMpendle siyaziqhenya ngomsebenzi awenzile njengoba eqhubeka nokulwa nezaphula mthetho. Siwabonile amaphoyisa awaholaya lapha KwaZulu-Natal ebhekana nezigilamkhuba. Izigebengu seziyazi ukuthi iKwaZulu-Natal akuyona indawo yokudlalela. Ngakho ke siyameseka kakhulu ukuthi aqhubeke nomsebenzi wakhe."UNgubane uthe uMkhwanazi ungumfana wendawo njengoba ethe akapheli ekhaya."Lisekhona ikhaya lakubo futhi naye ujwayele ukufika. Ekukhuleni angimazi kahle ngoba yena ungaphambili kwethu kodwa into engingakutshela yona ukuthi akukho okubi esengike ngakuzwa ngaye." Muva nje uMkhwanazi usanda kwenza idili lezemidlalo eMpendle, lapho egqugquzele khona intsha ukuba iziphathe kahle. UNgubane uthe le midlalo bayijabulela kakhulu."Yinto enhle lena ayenzayo njengoba kubalulekile ukuthi intsha uyibambe isemaphuphu. Kufanele isheshe itshalwe ezinqondweni zayo le nto yokuthi kufanele badlalele kude nobugebengu. Le midlalo yasivula amehlo njengoba yasigqugquzela ukuba kube khona nokusebenzisana namaphoyisa empini yokulwa nobugebengu." I-ActionSA izokuba nombhikisho emahhovisi amaphoyisa eThekwini, kusasa.Lo mbhikisho uzoholwa ilungu lePhalamende, uNksz Dereleen James, nosihlalo we-ActionSA KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Zwakele Mncwango.UMncwango uthe bazomeseka kuze kube sekugcineni uMkhwanazi. UMncwango uvikele uMkhwanazi kulabo abamsola ngokungayilandeli imigomo ngesikhathi ededela amabhomu.Uthe isizathu esenze ukuthi uMkhwanazi angayilandeli imigomo yingoba akazithembi izinhlaka okufanele ziphenye.Kuhlelwe omunye umbhikisho ozokuba seThekwini, ngelizayo. Umlando omfishane kaMkhwanaziUMkhwanazi uqokelwe kwesikakhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal ngo-2019. Wake wabamba kwesokuba ukhomishana wamaPhoyisa kuzwelonke ngo-2011.Uke waba ukhomishana wamaPhoyisa esifundazweni iWestern Cape, futhi uke waphatha ezinye izikhundla ezibalulekile emaphoyiseni.Ngokwemfundo uMkhwanazi uneziqu i-B-Tech degree kwiPolicing kanye neNational Diploma kwiPolice Administration.Ngokuqeqeshwa uMkhwanazi uyilungu lophiko olukhethekile iSpecial Task Force.
I-ANC ihlele uxhaxha lwemicimbi yokukhumbula owayeyiphini likamengameli wezwe, uMnuz David Mabuza, ozongcwatshwa ngoMgqibelo.I-ANC izokuba nezinkonzo ezintathu zokukhumbula uMabuza ezizokuba ngoLwesihlanu.Kulezi zinkonzo kuzokhuluma abaholi abaphezulu kwi-ANC okubalwa kubo iphini likamengameli we-ANC nezwe, uMnuz Paul Mashatile, nephini likanobhala jikelele, uNkk Nomvula Mokonyane. Unobhala jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, uthe izinkonzo zokukhumbula uMabuza zizokuba sezindaweni ezintathu ezahlukene esifundazweni iMpumalanga.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi eyohlanganisa amehlo nomndeni kaMabuza.UMbalula uthe bakhethe ukuhlela izinkonzo zokukhumbula uMabuza ukuze nabangeke baye emngcwabeni bezothola ithuba lokumvalelisa. UMbalula uthe balindele ukuthi amalungu e-ANC aphume ngobuningi kulezi zinkonzo njengoba ethe uMabuza ubethandwa kakhulu enhlanganweni."UMabuza akakaze ayilahle i-ANC. UMabuza uzinikele kwi-ANC ngezikhathi ezinzima. Ngesikhathi sibheke okhethweni akazange aze alinde ukuthi aze acelwe ukuba akhankasele i-ANC. Ubehlezi elwela iqiniso. Ubekwazi ukusibuyisa uma ebona sengathi siyaphuma endleleni. Silahlekelwe kakhulu."UMbalula uthe uMabuza ubengathandi ukubukwa, wathi yingakho engakaze azwakale esekhuluma kabi nge-ANC. "Ubazi ukuthi uma kukhona okungamphethe kahle kufanele lokho akubike ngaphakathi, angahambi ekhuluma esidlangalaleni. Uma uzobheka nje emva kokubunjwa kukahulumeni wokubambisana, abantu abaningi bazwakalisa imibono yabo. Abanye babesho ukuthi abawufuni uhulumeni wokubambisana, abanye bethi bayaweseka."UMabuza akakaze aye kokhuluma ngalolu daba esidlangalaleni ngoba ubazi ukuthi uma uwumholi kufanele zonke izinto uzikhulume ezinhlakeni ezifanele. Konke ayefuna ukukusho wayekukhuluma ezinhlakeni ezifanele. Okubuhlungu nje wukuthi abanye ababekhuluma esidlangalaleni abazange bayikhankasele i-ANC ngesikhathi kubhekwe okhethweni. UMabuza wakhankasa."UMabuza uhlonishwe ngomngcwabo kahulumeni osesigabeni sesibili.Kuzokuba nezinhlelo zokumhlonipha ezizoqhutshwa amalungu ombutho wezokuvikela. UMabuza ushone ngeledlule kulandela ukugula.Ushonele esibhedlela esiseGoli, kuthiwa wayenenkinga yokuphefumula.Phambilini kwake kwaba nezinsolo zokuthi uMabuza udlisiwe, waze waya ukuyokwelashwa eRussia.Ngesikhathi eyiphini likamengameli ubevame ukuyoxilongwa kuleliya zwe.
U-Aaron Matete, 23, ongowokudabuka eLesotho, ulahlwe yicala lokubulala intombi yakhe eneminyaka engu-29, uMpho Gift Mphatsoe, kanye nokwephula iSigaba 49(1)(a) somthetho we-Immigration Act ka-2002. Inkantolo yeSifunda eStilfontein iphinde yaveza ukuthi akakulungele ukuba nesibhamu. Lesi sigameko senzeka ngomhlaka-12 Okthoba 2024, kulandela ingxabano phakathi kukaMatete noMphatsoe emjondolo wabo oseKhuma Location, eNorth West. Ubufakazi obethulwe enkantolo buveze ukuthi uMatete washaya umufi ngebhodlela likabhiya, wamshaya ebusweni. Ngokushuba kwengxabano yabo, wamgwaza ngommese ekhanda nasentanyeni ephindelela, wagcina ngokushona. Ngemuva kokuhlasela ngesihluku intombi, uMatete washiya isidumbu sikamufi endlini ebusuku wabe esebikela umama kaMphatsoe Waze wabona indodakazi yakhe ngakusasa ekuseni isithule. Amaphoyisa abizelwe endaweni yesigameko, athola isidumbu sinamanxeba amaningi okugwazwa lwaqala lapho uphenyo nomkhankaso wokuthungatha umsolwa. UMatete waboshwa ngemuva kwezinsuku ezimbalwa wagqunywa esitokisini ngesikhathi kuqhubeka icala. Yize aliphika icala kodwa lagcina limgojela ngenxa yobufakazi obuqand’ ikhanda obuholwa ngabashushisi. Ekwengezeni kwesigwebo, uMshushisi woMbuso uChris Kok unxuse inkantolo ukuthi ingagudluki kwinqubo yesigwebo esinqunyiwe, esho nokukhula okushaqisayo kwamacala okubulala. Ubalule nokuthi imijondolo yaseKhuma ibalwa nemiphakathi ebhekene nezinga eliphezulu lodlame olubhekiswe kubulili, kanti abanye abenzi bobubi bekungabakwamanye amazwe okuhlanganisa nabasuka eLesotho.
BANOMLANDO okushiya ubambe ongezansi abanye okuvela amagama abo ezinsolweni ezishaqisayo ezenziwe wuKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi.Abanye ababalwe wuMkhwanazi, sebeke babhekana nezinsolo ezishaqisayo phambilini, abanye babo sebeke baboshwa. Sibheka kabanzi umlando wabo bonke abantu uMkhwanazi athinte amagama abo.Owokuqala owabalwa wuMkhwanazi, nguNgqongqoshe wezamaPhoyisa, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, amsole ngokusondelana nabantu abaphazamisa ukusebenza komthetho.UMchunu, umfokaNyawo zekewu, uzalwa eNhlwathi, kwaHlabisa.Uke wabhekana nezivunguvungu ngesikhathi kubhekwe engqungqutheleni yokukhetha ubuholi be-ANC KwaZulu-Natal eyayingo-2015. Ngesikhathi kubhekwe kule ngqungquthela kwashona owayengusihlalo we-ANC esifundeni iMusa Dladla, uMnuz Thulani Mashaba, owashona engozini yemoto.Kwaba khona abanuka uMchunu ngale ngozi, nokuyizinsolo aziphika.UMchunu wafike wahlulwa kule ngqungquthela, lapho khona ayefuna ukukhuza ibuya njengosihlalo we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal.Ukuhlulwa kwaholelwa ekutheni ehliswe esikhundleni sokuba undunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal. Wake waphatha noMnyango wezeMfundo esifundazweni. Uxoshwa nje i-ANC yayibheke engqungqutheleni yokukhetha ubuholi ngo-2017 lapho khona kwakubanga khona uMengameli, uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa noDkt Nkosazana Dlamini Zuma.UMchunu wayesohlangothini lwababeseka uRamaphosa, futhi wayengenele umbango wokuba unobhala jikelele.Wahlulwa ngamavoti angu-24 embangweni walesikhundla.Nokho waphuma phambili kuqokwa amalungu esigungu esiphezulu, okwenza ukuthi abuyelwe amandla kwezepolitiki. Emva kwale ngqungquthela waqokelwa esikhundleni sikaNgqongqoshe weziSebenzi zikaHulumeni nokuPhatha, wabuye waqokelwa kwesikaNgqongqoshe wezaManzi.Emva kokhetho lwangonyaka owedlule uMchunu waqokelwa kwesikangqongqoshe wezamaPhoyisa.UMchunu uneziqu zobuthishela. Igama lesibili elivelayo elephini likakhomishana wamaPhoyisa, uLieutenant Shadrack Sibiya.UMkhwanazi wasola uSibiya ngokuphazamisa ukusebenza kwethimba eliphenya ukubulawa kosopolitiki KwaZulu-Natal.USibiya sezike zamnetha phambilini. Igama lakhe livela ecaleni lokubulawa kowayengunozinti we-Orlando Pirates, uSenzo Meyiwa.USibiya, kusolwa ukuthi wenza uphenyo olumayelana naleli cala ngesikhathi esamisiwe esikhundleni sokuba inhloko yoKlebe eGauteng. Ngo-2015 uSibiya waxoshwa kwesokuba inhloko yoKlebe eGauteng emva kwekhomishini eyayiphenya izinsolo zokubuyiselwa ngodli abantu baseZimbabwe ababekuleli ngokungemthetho.Ngo-2022 iNkantolo yezabaSebenzi yathola ukuthi kwakungekho emthethweni ukuxoshwa kukaSibiya. Igama lesithathu elivelayo elikasomabhizinisi, uMnuz Vusumuzi Cat Matlala.UMatlala ungusomathenda okuthiwa usebenzisana nezigebengu.Phakathi kwamathenda asematheni atholwa yinkampani yakhe kubalwa eyasesibhedlela iTembisa, kaR50 million. Kule thenda kwaba nenkohlakalo futhi kwasocongwa owayekhononda ngale nkohlakalo, uNkk Babita Deokaran, owayesebenzela umnyango wezeMpilo.Muva nje inkampani yakhe ithole ithenda kaR48 million emaphoyiseni. Le thenda yabuye yahoxiswa.Njengamanje uMatlala ugqunywe esitokisini ngecala lokuzama ukubulala umakhwapheni wakhe ongumlingisi uTebogo Thobejane. Igama lesine elivelayo elikaMnuz Brown Mogotsi.Akukuningi okuvelayo ngoMogotsi.UMkhwanazi wathi uMogotsi unolwazi oluyimfihlo lwamaphoyisa. Kuthiwa uzwana noMchunu kanti kuthiwa ungowaseNorth West. Elinye igama elivelayo elenhloko yezinhloli, uLieutenant General Dumisani Khumalo, oboshelwe amacala enkohlakalo nokukhwabanisa.UMkhwanazi wathi uKhumalo uboshelwe ukulwa nobugebengu obenziwa abantu abavikelwa osopolitiki.

IZIGULI eziya okokuqala ngqa emitholampilo yaseThekwini sezigqugquzelwe ukuthi ziqinisekise ukuthi ziyabaphatha omazisi bazo uma zivakashela lezi zikhungo ngenhloso yokuthola usizo lwezempilo.Lokhu kucaciswe wuphiko lwezokuxhumana kuMasipala weTheku, izolo kulandela ukuzungeza kwesithombe esishiya imibuzo ngalokhu ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ngempelasonto.Kulesi sithombe esibonakalisa ukuthi siyisaziso esifakwe ezikhungweni zomkhandlu, kubhalwe ukuthi: "Phatha umazisi wakho uma uza emtholampilo.” Ukuvela kwalesi sithombe ezinkundleni zokuxhumana kushiye abaningi bezibuza ukuthi ngabe imitholampilo yaseThekwini isiyalela iziguli ukuthi ziphathe omazisi bazo uma ziza ezikhungweni ngenxa yemikhankaso yenhlangano iMarch and March, echitha abokufika abakuleli ngokungemthetho ukuthi bahambele izikhungo zezempilo.Isitatimende esikhishwe ngumasipala sithe, abantu bayakuhlanekezela okuqondwe ngalesi saziso."Abantu sebecabanga ukuthi abantu abeza ezikhungweni bengabaphethe omazisi bayanqatshelwa ukuthi bangene okuyinto engesilo iqiniso,” kusho isitatimende. Sithe lokhu kungenye yenqubomgomo ukuthi iziguli ezivakashela noma yimuphi umtholampilo kamasipala okokuqala, ziyalelwe ukuba ziphathe omazisi bazo."Lokhu kusuke kushiwo ngenhloso yokuthi zivulelwe amafayela. Uma isiguli sesivulelwe ifayela, asibe sisaba khona isidingo sokuthi siphathe umazisi waso uma siphinda sivakashela isikhungo,” sisho kanje. Kuqubuka lokhu kukhuluma nje, inhlangano iMarch and March iqale imikhankaso yayo ngeledlule, lapho ihambela khona izikhungo zezempilo zikahulumeni. Amalungu ale nhlangano akanisa amasangweni ezikhungo, amise abokufika kuleli, abayalele ukuba baveze amaphepha abagunyaza ukuba kuleli ngaphambi kokuba bangene ezikhungweni.Lokhu kususe umsindo, abanye bekweseka okwenziwa amalungu ale nhlangano, ngesikhathi ezinye izinhlaka ziveza ukuthi ekwenzayo, akukho emthethweni.Inhlangano yamalungelo abantu iSouth African Human Rights Commission (SAHRC) iphumele obala yathi uMthethosisekelo uthi wonke umuntu ongaphakathi emgceleni wakuleli, unelungelo lokunikwa usizo lwezempilo ezikhungweni zikahulumeni. Ithe lokhu kubandakanya nabokufika abakuleli ngokungemthetho.NoMnyango wezeMpilo usho okufanayo, wathi nakuba ungahambisani nendaba yabokufika abakuleli ngokungemthetho, kodwa lokho akusho ukuthi lolu hlobo lobugebengu, lokuthi babe kuleli ngaphandle kwemvume luchaza ukuthi akuliwe nalo ngobunye ubugebengu bokuthi bavinjwe.IMarch and March iveze ukuthi izomashela emahhovisi eSAHRC ngoJulayi 17, iyozwakalisa ilaka layo ngokuhlanekezelwa koMthethosisekelo yile nhlangano yamalungelo abantu. Iphinde yathi nakuba igxekwa yizinhlaka ezithile futhi amalungu ayo esongelwa ngokubulawa, ngeke iyeke ukukanisa ezikhungweni zezempilo, iqhubeke nemikhankaso yayo.
LIGCINE linengekile ijaji enkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini izolo lathi ngeke liyibekezelele indaba kammangalelwa obelokhu ephakamisa isandla, ezama ukuphazamisa ngesikhathi kuqhubeka icala lokubulawa kowayengumfundi waseDurban Girls Secondary.UWandile Ngcobo (17) owayefunda uGrade 11, wagwazwa, wabulawa kubo kwa-U eMlaza ngoMeyi nyakenye.Kwaboshwa ummangalelwa wokuqala uSfundo Bhengu (39) noBongani Jali (24).UJali wayengumakhelwane, umuzi wakubo, ungaphesheya komuzi wakubo kamufi. Ngosuku lwesigameko, kuthiwa umufi wahlaselwa esele yedwa ekhaya, engayile esikoleni.Kuthiwa uyise nodadewabo kamufi babehambe ngokuhlukana ekuseni beya emsebenzini nasesikoleni.g Izolo ijaji uGarth Harrison, bese lilungiselela ukwendlalela ukwahlulela kwalo ngesikhathi uJali ephakamisa isandla maqede ummeli wakhe, u-Advocate Phumelele Daniso waya kuye."Engimumele uthi unephepha aliphethe afuna ukulifundela inkantolo," kusho uDaniso, othe akazi ukuthi kubhalweni ephepheni ngakho ucela ukuthi kuthathwe ikhefu kancane ukuze ayifunde le ncwadi, axoxe kafushane naye ngayo, bese etshela inkantolo.UHarrison ubuze ukuthi ngabe uJali ufuna ukuthi kubuyelwe emuva yini ecaleni kwazise inkantolo isisesigabeni sokwethula ukwahlulela? UDaniso ubuye wabuyela kuJali, obesephakamise isandla okwesibili, wamtshela ukuthi impela kukhona ofakazi ababili afuna ukubabiza."Ufuna ukubiza ofakazi ababili. Kubona kukhona nonina. Ngiyaqonda ukuthi asikho isidingo salokhu ngoba lo fakazi akabalulekile. Ngizamile ukubonisana nekhasimende lami ngalokhu kodwa lezwakalisa ukuthi yilokho elikudingayo," kusho uDaniso.UJali, emva kokuphakamisa isandla okwesithathu uveze ukuthi kahle hle ofakazi afuna ukuthi baqale phansi bazokwethula ubufakazi enkantolo, abazali bakhe bobabili. UHarrison ebuza uMbuso, ngomlomo ka-Adv Krishen Shah ukuthi kuthini ukuphawula kwawo, uthe ummangalelwa unalo ilungelo lokuphakamisa ukuthi kubuyelwe emuva kodwa uma kukhona ofakazi abangaletha ubufakazi obubalulekile, obuzomlekelela ecaleni."Uma ummangalelwa esefuna kubizwe abazali bakhe manje, yini abazoyisho manje ezokwenza umehluko ecaleni? Babekhona yini ngesikhathi enza icala? Mina ngiphakamisa ukuthi icala kufanele lifinyelele esiphethweni," kusho uShah.UHarrison unqume ukuthi kungabuyelwa emuva, ethi akaboni ukuthi ofakazi abasha bazoletha buphi ubufakazi obuzomsiza manje ummangalelwa ecaleni. UJali uphinde waphakamisa isandla futhi, okuthe uma uDaniso eyozwa ukuthi ufuna ukuthini, wathola ukuthi ufuna ukuveza ukuthi owesithathu ufakazi afuna abizwe, wumphenyi wecala.Lokhu kuvele kwamangaza wonke umuntu, uHarrison wagcina ethi: "Uma sengiqala ukwethula ukwahlulela kwami, ngeke ngilokhu ngiyingena eyokuphazanyiswa."Eseqala ukwethula ukwahlulela kwakhe, uHarrison ucaphune ngamafuphi konke okwahlaluka kofakazi abehlukene abethula ubufakazi phambi kwenkantolo.Phakathi kwabo kukhona uyise kamufi uMnuz Mondli Ngcobo, umakhelwane uMnuz Sizwe Mthembu owababona abasolwa emva kokwenza icala, umasitende kammangalelwa wokuqala uMnuz Mxolisi Ngcobo owathola ezinye zezimpahla ezazebiwe emqashweni.Ukwahluleka kukaHarrison kuyaqhubeka namhlanje.

Kuyihaba elingenasidingo."UMchunu ukhulume kanje ngesikhathi ephendula kwinkulumo mpikiswano ngombutho iSAPS, Independent Police Investigative Directorate neCivilian Secretariat for Police Service, emuva kokwethula isabelomali somnyango wakhe. Uthe bayayincoma imali kodwa abazi ngomsebenzi obahlalele. "Umsebenzi odinga ukwenziwa ungaphezu kwezinsizakusebenza." Uthe ubugebengu sebubhebhetheke kakhulu futhi buxhaswe ngenkulu imali ngakho nabo kufanele babuhlelele. Zingu-225 iziteshi zamaphoyisa ezihlonzwe njengesezidlekeni zobugebengu, okudingeka ukungenelela okuqonde nobugebengu ngqo."U-R85 million owokweseka iziteshi ezilwa nobugenengu obukhulu. UMENGAMELI Cyril Ramaphosa uthembise ukusukumela izinsolo ezishaqisayo ezenziwe uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi.URamaphosa uthe izinsolo zikaMkhwanazi zokuthi uNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, usondelene nezigebengu, zidinga ukusukunyelwa ngokushesha.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba ohambeni lwakhe lwaseBrazil izolo. URamaphosa uthe izinsolo ezenziwe uMkhwanazi zibucayi. "Awukwazi ukuziba lezi zinsolo ngoba zithinta ezokuphepha kwezwe. Into ethinta ezokuphepha ibucayi njengoba ithinta impilo yabantu."URamaphosa uthe uzoziphenya kahle lezi zinsolo uma efika kuleli. "Ngizokuba nemihlangano nabantu abathintekayo bese nginquma ukuthi isiphi isinyathelo engizosithatha."UNobhala Jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, uthe ngeke bathathe uhlangothi lukaMchunu.UMbalula uthe bafuna kwenziwe noma yiluphi uphenyo oluzoholela ekutheni kutholakale iqiniso. Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba, izolo. "Uma iPhalamende libona ukuthi kufanele kube nophenyo, kufanele luqalwe ngokushesha uphenyo. Akufanele balindele ukuthi bazokuzwa ngathi."UMbalula uthe uRamaphosa uzofika kuleli namhlanje njengoba eseBrazil. Uthe ulindele ukuthi uMchunu achazele uRamaphosa ngalezi zinsolo."Nathi njengobuholi be-ANC uzosichazela kodwa umuntu okubaluleke kakhulu ukuthi amchazele uRamaphosa ngoba uyena owamqokela esikhundleni."UMbalula uthe bafuna uRamaphosa azisukumele ngokushesha izinsolo ezibekwe uMchunu. "Lezi zinsolo zibucayi, zenza ukuthi sibukeke njengezwe elingenamthetho."Ngaphambi kwalokho, inyunyana yamaphoyisa, iSouth African Policing Union (Sapu) ibithe awayimangazi amabhomu adedelwe uMkhwanazi.Okhulumela iSapu, uMnuz Lesiba Thobakgale, ekhuluma nabesiteshi sezindaba sethelevishini uthe banxusa uRamaphosa ukuba angenelele kulolu daba. "Ngokujwayelekile, izinkinga zalolu hlobo azivamile ukuvela kwabezindaba ngoba zithinta ezokuphepha kwezwe kodwa njengoba sizwile izinsolo ezibhekiswe ezikhulwini eziphezulu, ezifana nePhini likaKhomishana wamaPhoyisa, ezobulungiswa, lezi yizinsolo ezibucayi ngakho kufanele zibhekisiswe,” kusho uThobakgale.Uthe uRamaphosa kufanele angenelele ngaphambi kokuba isimo siphume esandleni. Udalule ukuthi nabo bake bambhalela umengameli, bephakamisa ukuthi ake abukisise ezinye izingqinamba ezithinta ezobunhloli kodwa bangathola mpendulo. Uthe banethemba lokuthi njengoba sekuvele lezi zinsolo, umengameli uzozisukumela phezulu. Khonamanjalo: USihlalo wekomiti lamaPhoyisa ePhalamende, uMnuz Ian Cameron, uthe kufanele icatshangwe nendaba yokummisa isikhashana uMchunu ngezinsolo ezenziwe uMkhwanazi.UCameron uthe ukumiswa komuntu kuyinto ejwayele ukwenziwa uma kunezinsolo ezifuze lezi. "Kusuke kwenzelwa ukuthi kuvikelwe isikhungo kanjalo nophenyo olusuke luzokwenziwa ngalowo muntu,” kusho uCameron.Uthe izinsolo ezenziwe uMkhwanazi zidwebe isithombe esicacile sokuthi ezobulungiswa kazinabo ubuqotho."Yikho kubonakala kunzima kangaka ukuthi ubugebengu bucindezelwe,” usho kanje.

YIZE enonyaka esemculweni kodwa uNtethelelo "Gandaganda" Sikhakhane useqophe umlando ngokuba wumculi wokuqala wesifazane onengoma esilalelwe amahlandla angaphezu kuka-9.2 million kuYouTube esihloko sithi Halala.UGandaganda (24) wasesigodini saseThelezini, eNquthu, ungene emculweni nyakenye, kodwa uyena mculi wokuqala wesifazane obe nengoma eno-1 million views kuYouTube njengoba manje seyibheke ku-10 million views. Uthe ikhono lakhe emculweni latholwa ngumculi uNdoni Ndunakazi weNdoni Music."UNdoni wangipha ithuba lokuthi ngingene emculweni, engibona kuyo imibukiso esezinkundleni zokuxhumana, sase sikhipha ingoma ethi Halala esidume umhlaba wonke neyenza kahle kakhulu ezitolo za-online."UGandaganda akagcinanga ngoHalala kodwa ubuye wenza enye noNdoni esihloko sithi Lilizela, nayo esino-650 000 views kuYouTube. Yize uGandaganda esedume kangaka kodwa usaqhubeka nokuhamba uMkhosi woMhlanga, okuyinto ayiqale eseneminyaka eyishumi. "Yilapho leli gama elithi Gandaganda lavela khona endleleni yokuzigcina ngoba konke engangikwenza - esibala kukho ukusina ngokuzimisela - kwakuveza ngokweqile amandla kaGandaganda. Sengingabala nakho ukuphakama-ke kwethambo, kuningi nje. Lase livela kanjalo-ke leli gama," kusho uGandaganda onguthunjana ezingane ezimbili zikaNksz Hlengiwe Sikhakhane noMnuz Sboniso Buthelezi.Nasemfundweni uGandaganda akazibekile phansi njengoba eneziqu zeFinancial Management aziphothula eMajuba TVET College emuva kokufunda amabanga aphansi eThelezini Primary naphezulu eMuziwephahla Secondary, lapho aphothula khona u-matric. UGandaganda uthe ubonga kakhulu abalandeli bomculo nenkampani angaphansi kwayo, Indoni Music Production and Events. "Engingakusho ngomlando osuqophekile endimeni kamaskandi ukuthi engathi ungahlala ubengumlando omuhle esiyokwazi ukuziqhenya ngawo kwabaseza ngamuva. Bethi uma babewubuka, bagqugquzeleke, baqhubeke bazabalaze kuze kufike la befisa kufike khona." Uthe ukhule ebukela kubantu abaningi okukhona kubo uMama Mkhonza (uMaMdletshe) eThelezini, obengumphathi wezintombi zaseBaqulusini "ngakho konke okuhle abekwenza esaphila. Yikhona okwangakha ngayile ntombi engiyiyo namhlanje. Ngiyohlezi ngimbonga njalo."UNdoni uthe yingakho bethathe isinqumo sokubungaza uGandaganda ngomcimbi, iHalala Song Celebration, eMakhoba VA Hall, eNquthu ngo-Agasti 9, kulo nyaka. Kule ndumezulu yomcimbi kuzobe kushiyelana inkundla oJaiva Zimnike, Imfezemnyama, Ngiga, Saliwa, Indoni, Gqizile, Bonakele, Luve, Thandeka Hadebe, ManV, Fihlisikhwele, Amasinamuva Amasha, Ibhova Elincane, TV Biyela, KissBefore, Mashudula, Indodana KaNuba noKabaja. Esephetha unxuse abafuna ukuphonsa itshe esivivaneni bamthinte ngoba akakalutholi uxhaso eminyangweni kahulumeni, komasipala nakosomabhzinisini.

Luthela izithelo uphenyo lwamaphoyisa ngokubulawa kwabantu abayisithupha esigcemeni sakwa-V/6 eMlazi ngomhlaka-17 Agasti 2024.Lokhu kulandela ukuboshwa kowesilisa ongowokufika oneminyaka engu-28 ubudala. Ngalobo busuku besehlo, amadoda ayisithupha ayephuza utshwala nabesifazane abathathu ngesikhathi kufika amadoda amabili angaziwa athi afuna ukuthenga ugwayi, kwathiwa abahambe ngoba akekho odayisayo. Laba balisa ababili bahamba, babuya ngemuva kwesikhashana base beyalela abesifazane abathathu ukuthi balale phansi njengoba bedubula izisulu zesilisa. Amadoda ayisithupha adutshulwa ashonele endaweni yesehlo. Uphenyo luveze ukuthi ukubulawa kwalaba bekuyisizathu sokuziphindiselela. Kubikwa ukuthi abashonile, abebekhuluma isiXhosa bobabili, kuthiwa balwe namaSwati ahlala kuyo le ndawo. UMelusi Dlamini, 28, ongowokudabuka eSwatini, waboshwa eKrugersdorp esifundazweni saseGauteng ngoLwesihlanu, 4 July 2025, ubhekene namacala ayisithupha okubulala, ukutholakala nesibhamu nezinhlamvu okungekho emthethweni. Uvele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMlazi ngoMsombuluko, 7 July 2025 futhi akasifakanga isicelo sebheyili icala lakhe lihlehliselwe umhlaka-14 Agasti 2025.
BAHLINZEKWE ngoR1.2 billion omasipala bakuleli ukuze babhekane nezinhlekelele ezisanda kuhlasela ezingxenyeni ezehlukene zezwe, ezidale umonakalo kwingqalasizinda kwaphinde kwashona nabantu.Lokhu kuvezwe nguNgqongqoshe wokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu kuzwelonke, uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa esithangamini nabezindaba.UHlabisa uthe izifundazwe ezikhahlanyezwe yimvula ngasekuqaleni konyaka yizona ezizohlomula kakhulu. Lezi zifundazwe yiKwaZulu-Natal, Free State ne-Eastern Cape eshayeke kakhulu muva nje. "I-EC yisona sifundazwe esithole ingxenye enkulu yemali. Izoqale ithole uR50 million, bese ithola uR504 million ngo-Agasti."UHlabisa unxuse ukuthi imali ekhishiwe isetshenziswe ngendlela efanele.Udalule nokuthi izogodlwa imali komasipala abahluleka wukuyisebenzisa ngendlela efanele. Le mali izolungisa ingqalasizinda eyakhahlamezeka ngenxa yenhlekelele. "Ngaphambi kokuba sifake enye ingxenye yemali, sizofuna umbiko ogcwele ngokuthi imali isebenze kanjani. Sifuna imali yenze umsebenzi ofanele." Uthe bazoqala ngokukhipha uR151 million kule nyanga bese bededela enye engu-R708 million ngenyanga ezayo, baphinde bafake nenye. UMnyango wokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal, esitatimendeni uthe uyawamukela uR139 million wemali yenhlekelele enikwe omasipala.Lo mnyango uthe le mali izolungisa umonakalo odalwe yizinhlekelele wathi uzoyiqapha ngelokhozi ukuthi omasipala bayisebenzisela izinhlelo ezifanele.Umasipala waseZululand ubonge uR13 million, owuthole kuHlabisa.Lo mkhandlu uthe le mali izosiza ekulungiseni ingqalasizinda yamanzi eyacekeleka phansi ngenxa yemvula enamandla.
SEBEYASATSHISWA abenhlangano elwa nabokufika abakuleli ngokungemthetho, iMarch and March, abanye babo asebevule icala emaphoyiseni.Le nhlangano izomashela emahhovisi eSouth African Human Rights Commission (SAHRC) naweHelen Suzman Foundation ngoJulayi 17.Izokwenza lokhu kulandela ukuphawula kwalezi zinhlangano zomphakathi, ikhala ngokuxoshwa kwabokufika kwezinye zezikhungo zezempilo zikahulumeni KwaZulu-Natal naseGoli.Kusuka ngesonto eledlule, amalungu eMarch and March abekanise ezibhedlela zikahulumeni ezifana ne-Addington eThekwini, ephoqa abokufika ukuthi baveze amaphepha abagunyaza ukuba babe kuleli ngaphambi kokuba bangene esibhedlela. Ekhuluma neSolezwe, umsunguli weMarch and March, uNkk Jacinta Ngobese-Zuma, uthe okuzoyobamashisa emahhovisi alezi zinhlangano ukuthi ziyawuhlanekezela uMthethosisekelo."Sifuna ukuthumela umyalezo wokuthi abayeke ukusebenzisa uMthethosisekelo ukuphikisana nezidingo zabantu baseNingizimu Afrika,” kusho uNkk Ngobese-Zuma.Uthe lezi zinhlangano azikwazi ukusebenzisa uMthethosisekelo ukubeka phambili abantu bokufika abakuleli ngokungemthetho. Uqinisekise nezinsolo zokuthi bathola izinsongo kubantu bokufika, bebasabisa ngokubabulala."Mina bangithumelela imiyalezo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, abanye bethu (okufaka phakathi nosihlalo weMarch and March) babasabisa ubuso nobuso,” usho kanje.Uthe likhona icala lokusabisa elivulwe usihlalo, kulandela izinsongo azithole ngeledlule. Udalule nokuthi abanezinombolo zabo, bayabafonela babasongele ezingcingweni. Udalule ukuthi ziyethusa izinto abazitholayo njengoba kuqhubeka le mikhankaso"Ngale kokuthi abanye abanamaphepha, abanye basikhombisa amaphepha omgunyathi, abanye basikhombise omazisi abayinhlobo endala (green book) kodwa abakhombisa ukuthi bashaye emasontweni edlule,” kusho uNkk Ngobese-Zuma.Uthe uMnyango wezaseKhaya osekunesikhathi bezama ukuthi usondele ukuze basebenzisane, awuyingeni."Mhlawumbe banovalo lokuthi kukhona abangakwenzi kahle, asazi. Amaphoyisa ayazama ukungenelela kodwa kufanele imizamo yawo ihlangatshezwe yizinhlaka ezifana nawo uMnyango wezaseKhaya,” usho kanje. Unxuse zonke izakhamizi zaseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi zisukume zilwe nendaba yabokufika abakuleli ngokungemthetho ngoba mkhulu umonakalo abawudalayo."Banesibindi sokuza ezweni lethu bazokwenza izinto ezehlukene, bangagcini lapho, babe nesibindi sokusisabisa. Sibi isimo. Izingane zethu ngeke zibe nakusasa uma kungaliwa nale nto,” usho kanje.Inhlangano yamalungelo abantu, iSouth African Human Rights (SAHRC), ikhumbuze izakhamuzi nezinhlaka ezithintekayo ukuthi ilungelo lokuya ezikhungweni zezempilo elawo wonke umuntu okuleli. "UMthethosisekelo uthi wonke umuntu oseNingizimu Afrika - kungakhathalekile ukuthi buthini ubuzwe bakhe, ulana ngokusemthethweni noma ngokungemthetho, ibala, ubulili, iminyaka yokuzalwa - uvumelekile ukuthi athole usizo lwezempilo."Ithe: "Kufanele sikucacise ukuthi abekho abantu abanelungelo lokuvimba abanye ukuba bangene ezikhungweni zezempilo ukuzama ukuphoqelela imithetho yokungena kuleli. Amandla okuhlola, ukubopha nokugcina abokufika abakuleli ngokungemthetho, anikwe uMnyango wezaseKhaya, bese belekelelwa ngamaphoyisa uma kunesidingo."Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMpilo kuzwelonke, uMnuz Foster Mohale ekhuluma nabesiteshi sezindaba sikamabonakude, uthe akungatshazwa ukuthi indaba yabakuleli ngokungemthetho inomthelela omubi kuleli.Uthe nakuba kunjalo, kodwa ngeke kushintshe imithetho yezwe ukuze ihambisane nalabo abangayizwa eyabokufika abakuleli ngokungemthetho. Uqhube wathi bayakuqonda ukukhathazeka kwezinhlaka ezilwa nalabo abakuleli ngokungemthetho kodwa wathi akufanele zilungise ubugebengu ngobugebengu."Uma kukhona umuntu omaziyo ukuthi ukuleli ngokungemthetho, mbike ezinhlakeni ezifanele ezifana noMnyango wezaseKhaya, kwabaqaphe emingceleni noma emaphoyiseni ukuze babuyiselwe emazweni abo,” usho kanje. Ibamba lokhulumela uhulumeni, uNksz Nomonde Mnukwa, lithe bakhathazekile ngokuvinjwa kwabokufika ezikhugweni zomphakathi ngoba akwamukelekile ukuzithathela umthetho.Lithe abezomthetho bayabhekana nabokufika abakuleli ngokungemthetho futhi kuqiniswa nemingcele."Amaphoyisa noMnyango wezeMpilo azojuba uphiko oluqapha izibhelu ezikhungweni zezempilo ukuze kube nokuthula. Bazothathelwa izinyathelo abazozithathela umthetho, baphazamise iziguli kanti bazoboshwa nalabo abaphula umthetho wokuba kuleli."
IBEHLE ngaphezulu abaholi be-ANC KwaZulu eyokukhishwa kwemeya kaMasipala waseMpendle, uMnuz Buyisani Mlaba, elahlwe ngisho amakhansela eqembu ngesikhathi kuvotelwa isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bayo.UMlaba ukhishwe ngesiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bakhe.Isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaMlaba siphase ngenxa yokuthi amakhansela e-ANC akhethe ukungavoti. Okhulumela i-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Fanle Sibisi, uthe basazohlangana namakhansela e-ANC ukuze bathole umbiko ogcwele.Isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaMlaba besifakwe amakhansela e-IFP ne-EFF.I-ANC iwuphethe ngokunethezeka lo mkhandlu njengoba inezihlalo eziyisithupha kweziyishumi. I-IFP ne-EFF bona banezihlalo ezimbili iqembu ngalinye.Ngesikhathi kunesiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaMlaba, kube uyena yedwa ovotela ukusiphikisa, kwathi amanye amakhansela amahlanu e-ANC akhetha ukungavoti.USibisi uthe basalinde ukuthola umbiko ogcwele ngalolu daba. "Iqiniso wukuthi besingakahlangani nobuholi be-ANC esifundeni (iMoses Mabhida) kanye namakhansela eqembu kuMasipala waseMpendle ukuze sizwe ukuthi ngempela kwenzekeni. Njengamanje asikwazi ukuphawula kahle ngalolu daba ngoba asikawutholi umbiko ophelele."Uthe:"Sizoba nomhlangano nabo zingakapheli izinsuku ezimbili. Emva komhlangano sizokhipha isitatimende esigcwele."Umthombo weSolezwe uthe sekunesikhathi eside amakhansela e-ANC ekhala ngoMlaba. "Kukaningi bekhala ngaye ebuholini be-ANC. Ziningi izincwadi abazibhalile becela ukuba kuthathelwe uMlaba izinyathelo. Yingakho bevele bakhetha ukungavoti ngesikhathi kunesiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bakhe. Asazi ukuthi ubuholi be-ANC buzoyithini le ndaba ngoba kusobala ukuthi abasamfuni ngempela uMlaba."UMasipala waseMpendle ubhekene nenkinga yemali njengoba wehluleka wukuholela abasebenzi ngoMeyi.Amakhansela e-IFP nawe-EFF asola uMlaba ngokwehluleka wukuhola umkhandlu nangokuqamba amanga ngesimo somkhandlu. "UMlaba akazange akhulume iqiniso ngesimo semali kumasipala ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba kulandela ukwehluleka komkhandlu ukuholela abasebenzi ezinyangeni ezimbili ezedlule. Futhi uMlaba wehluleka wukuchazela ubuholi ngesikhathi kunenkinga yokungaholelwa kwabasebenzi njengoba engazange afike ukuzoxazulula inkinga."Amakhansela e-IFP ne-EFF athe uMlaba uyalova emihlanganweni yomkhandlu."UMlaba akayibizi imihlangano yekomiti angusihlalo walo."Akhale nangokuthi imoto ehamba uMlaba isike yaba sezingozini kodwa wangawuletha umbiko wengozi emkhandlwini.
SEKUPHETHE I-IFP kuMasipala wakwaNongoma kulandela ukukhishwa kobuholi beNFP ne-ANC obebuphethe umkhandlu. IMeya eqhamuka kwiNFP, uMnuz Mshangane Ndabandaba, nosomlomo uNkk Babongile Sithole, oyikhansela le-ANC, bakhishwe ngevoti lokungabethembi ubuholi babo. Izikhundla abebeziphethe zithathwe amakhansela e-IFP aqokwe emhlanganweni womkhandlu obunamhlanje.UMnuz Mbekezeli Zondo uqokelwe kesobumeya, kwathi uMnuz Sinethemba Mbongwa, yena waqokelwa kwesikasomlomo.Ikhansela le-EFF, uMnuz Mthobisi Luvuno, uqokelwe kwesephini lemeya.
UKHALA ngokungazisoli kwamaphoyisa, umndeni womgibeli okugcine kumenela esibhedlela, kulandela ukudutshulwa kwetekisi amaphoyisa ayeyifanisa neyayiduniwe.Lesi sigameko esashiya abagibeli ababili belimele kanzima, senzeka ngoJuni 25 kulo nyaka, emgwaqweni uSalt Rock Link eMhlali.Kulabo bagibeli, kwakukhona noMnuz Zithulele Doyisa (46) waseMthwalume. Ngokusho kwesihlobo, uMnuz Andile Luthango, uDoyisa, obengcwatshwa izolo, washona emva kwezinsuku ezintathu kwenzeke isigameko. Uthe kubahlukumezile emoyeni okwenziwe amaphoyisa."Aba budedengu kakhulu ngesikhathi enza umsebenzi wawo. Okusiphatha kabi kakhulu wukungakhombisi nhlobo ukuzisola ngakwenzile,” kusho uLuthango. Uthe lokhu bakubone ngesikhathi beya kuwona beyobika ukuthi uDoyisa sekumenele esibhedlela, bacela ukulekelelwa ngezindleko zomngcwabo."Asitshela ukuthi akukho azosisiza ngako, athi uma sinezikhalo ngesigameko, esingakwenza wukuthi siwafake icala,” kusho uLuthango, othe njengoba besemanzini nje, bayizwe inenhlabathi - inkulumo yamaphoyisa.Uchaze ngobunzima besimo emndenini, athe bekunzima nokuhlanganisa izindleko zomngcwabo. Isolezwe lithole ukuthi kuze kwahlangana ngesikhathi sekungenelela abafake isandla. "Sishayekile ngalesi simo sonke emndenini, okubi wukuthi umufi ubenengane esencane, yiyo esibona ukuthi kusazoba nzima kakhulu kuyo njengoba eseshonile,” usho kanje.Uveze ukuthi umufi ubesebenza eMargate isikhathi eside, kwathi ezinyangeni ezimbili ezedlule wafudukela eTete elandela inkampani yakhe, ethuthele ngaseBallito. Ngosuku lwesigameko kuthiwa amaphoyisa ayelandela umkhondo wetekisi eyebiwe. Kuthiwa afanisa eyayigitshelwe wumufi nabanye abagibeli, abe eseyidubula. Kuvela ukuthi kwatholakala ukuthi adubule itekisi engafanele sekwenzeke umonakalo sekubonakala ukuthi itekisi edutshuliwe ibizigcwalele abagibeli.Kwavela ukuthi labo bagibeli babesuka eBallito beya eTete.
INGCABHA ikuMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, ukuba asukumele izinsolo ezishaqisayo ezenziwe uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLt General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, ngoNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu.Amaqembu ezepolitiki aphonsele uRamaphosa inselelo yokuba asukumele izinsolo zokuthi uMchunu usondelene nezigebengu eziphazamisa ukusebenza kwengalo yomthetho.Amanye amaqembu amemelele ukuba uMchunu ehle esikhundleni, amanye athi afuna kube nekhomishini ezophenya izinsolo. UMchunu uthe usazohlala phansi abheke zonke izinsolo ezenziwe nguMkhwanazi.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba emuva kokuhambela umkhankaso we-ANC, wokhetho lokuchibiyela oluzokuba seVryheid.UMchunu uthe ubengakasiboni isitatimende sikaMkhwanazi, wathi konke akuzwayo kuseyinzwabethi. "Ngizosazohlala phansi ngibheke konke okukhulunyiwe. Ngisazwile nje ukuthi uMkhwanazi khona akushilo, bese konke sikufakela izibuko."Okhulumela uMchunu, uNksz Kamogelo Mogotsi, uzichithile izinsolo ezenziwe uMkhwanazi.Uthe uMchunu usabheka ukuthi iziphi izinyathelo azozithatha."UMchunu ngeke avume ukuba igama lakhe noma elamaphoyisa licekelwe phansi ngabantu abenza izinsolo ezingenabufakazi. UMkhwanazi umangaze abaningi ngesikhathi edalula izinsolo ezishaqisayo ngoMchunu kanye nePhini likaKhomishana wamaPhoyisa, uLieutenant General Shadrack Sibiya.Le zinsolo uzenze ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba, izolo, eThekwini.UMkhwanazi ubedlubhe umfaniswano wophiko lwamaphoyisa olukhethekile, iSpecial Task Force.Ubekakwe amanye amaphoyisa nawo abedluphe umfaniswano walolu phiko, kuphinde kube khona nabaphathi bamaphoyisa esifundazweni. UMkhwanazi ubengagayelwe mphako njengoba eze waphimisa namagama okuthi ukulungele ukufela ensimini.Izinsolo zikaMkhwanazi zishiye abaningi bebambe ongezansi njengoba egeqe amagula ngakubize ngokungcola okufaka phakathi osopolitiki, amaphoyisa nabashushisi.UMkhwanazi wenze izinsolo zokuthi uMchunu wanquma ukuhlakaza ithimba eliphenya ukusocongwa kwesopolitiki lapha KwaZulu-Natal, ngenxa yokuthi lathikameza isidleke sezidakamizwa esilawulwa abantu abaseGauteng.UMkhwanazi uthe amaphoyisa aseGoli acela ukuba ithimba eliphenya ukubulawa kosopolitiki lapha KwaZulu-Natal lizokwelekelela ekuphenyeni isidleke sezidakamizwa okuthiwa sisabalele kulo lonke elakuleli. Uthe kwase kusele kancane ukuba ithimba lisombulule amacala abucayi enzeka eGauteng, okubalwa kuwo nawokubulawa kwabaculi abadumile. Uthe emva kwalokho, kwabe sekuphuma umyalelo wokuba kuhlakazwe ithimba eliphenya ngokubulala kosopolitiki."Ngithi angibatshele abantu baKwaZulu-Natal ukuthi ithimba lahlakazelwa ukuphenya la macala enzeka eGauteng."UMkhwanazi uthe uSibiya wathatha onke amadokodo ayephenywa ithimba."Kula madokodo kwakukhona namahlanu okwakunomyalelo wokuba kuboshwe abantu. Kuze kube manje la madokodo ahlezi ehhovisi likaSibiya, akuboshwe muntu."USibiya naye uzichithile izinsolo ezenziwe uMkhwanazi, wathi uzothatha izinyathelo zomthetho. Okunye okuvezwe nguMkhwanazi ngukuthi uMchunu waphika ukuthi uyamazi omunye wamaqabane akhe uMnuz Brown Mogotsi waseNorth West, ekhuluma phambi kwekomiti lasePhalamende. Kodwa wabuye wavuma ukuthi uyamazi. Uphinde waveza ukuthi kwaba nokuxhumana phakathi kukasomabhizinisi oboshelwe amacala athinta nokuzama ukubulala, uMnuz Vusumuzi Matlala, abathole kwimiyalezo yeselula yakhe ukuthi uMchunu wayexhumana noMogotsi.Udalule ukuthi uMatlala uxhasa uMchunu ngemali njengoba kunombiko oveza lapho akhokhela khona uhambo lwababeye esidlweni sasebusuku se-ANC ngesikhathi yenze umgubho iJanuwari 8, eKapa. Lo mbiko oveza imali eyakhokhwa wathunyelwa uMatlala kuMogotsi. Kuphinde kuvele nokuthi uMatlala wathola umbiko owawuvela kuMogotsi, mayelana nokuhlakazwa kwethimba elaliphenya ukubulawa kosopolitiki. Uphinde waveza ukuthi yanqanyulwa inkontileka uMatlala ayenayo namaphoyisa.I-DA isibhalele uSomlomo wePhalamende, uNkk Thoko Didiza, icela ukuba kube nenkulumo mpikiswano ngalolu daba. Okhulumela i-DA kwezithinta amaphoyisa, uMnuz Ian Cameron, uthe ziyakhathaza izinsolo ezenziwe uMkhwanazi."IPhalamende neHhovisi likaMengameli kufanele baphenye lezi zinsolo ukuze kuzotholakala iqiniso."Okhulumela i-EFF, uMnuz Sinawo Thambo, uthe bafuna ukuthi uMchunu amiswe esikhundleni, wathi bayameseka uMkhwanazi. USotswebhu we-UDM ePhalamende, uMnuz Nqabayomzi Kwankwa, uthe uMchunu akufanele aze alinde ukuthi atshelwe ukuthi akagudluke esikhundleni."Uma kuwukuthi uyazi ukuthi akanacala kufanele agudluke esikhundleni khona kungeke kuphazamisele uphenyo."Umholi weBosa, uMnuz Mmusi Maimane, uthe bafuna izinsolo zikaMkhwanazi ziphenywe nawuphiko oluphenya amacala enkohlakalo, iSpecial Investigating Unit (SIU).
ITHOLE isigwebo esiqinile inkabi elahlwe yicala lokusoconga owayengunobhala jikelele we-ANC Youth League, uMnuz Sindiso Magaqa. INkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu igwebe uSibusiso Ncengwa iminyaka engu-25 ebhadla ejele ngecala lokwakha itulo lokusoconga uMagaqa.IJaji Nontuthuzelo Mlaba ligwebe uNcengwa iminyaka engu-25 ngecala lokusoconga uMagaqa. Uphinde wagwetshelwa amacala okuzama ukubulala, ukulimaza impahla kanye nawokutholakala nesibhamu nezinhlamvu ezingekho emthethweni. Zonke lezigwebo uzozidonsa kanye kanye. UNcengwa wazivumela yena icala lokusoconga uMagaqa. Evuma icala, uNcengwa waphinde wakhipha abanye athi babaeyingxenye yokwakhiwa kwetulo lokusoconga uMagaqa. UMagaqa wasocongwa ngo-2017 ebuya emhlanganweni wamakhansela kuMasipala waseMzimkhulu. Kuthiwa wabulawelwa ukukhononda ngenkohlakalo eyayenzeka kulomkhandlu.Icala likaMpofana noMyeza lizobuyela enkantolo ngo-6 Okthoba 2025 lapho lizoqulwa khona. UNcalane owahlonzwa njengongakulungele ukuqula icala, ugcinwe esikhungweni sabagula ngengqondo.Namhlanje le nkantolo igwebe uNcengwa odililajele ababili ngokubika icala.

KUHLATSHWE ikhwelo kumaxhwele ukuthi ayeke ukubhema ugwayi njengoba ngonyaka kushona evile ku-7 million emhlabeni jikelele. Lokhu kuvele embikweni wakamuva i-World Health Organization Report on the Global Tobacco Epidemic.Lo mbiko uveza ukuthi akubona kuphela ababhema ugwayi ngqo abafayo, kodwa nalabo abangabhemi kodwa abahogela intuthu kulabo abasuke bebhema nabo bayashona.Kulaba kuvele ukuthi u-1.6 million wabangabhemi ugwayi ngqo kodwa abahogela umoya wentuthu kulabo abasuke bebhema uyashona. Umbiko uphakamisa ukuthi kumele kwenziwe okuthile ukunqanda le nkinga."Ugwayi ubulala uhhafu wabantu ababhemayo kodwa abangafuni ukuyeka. U-80% wabantu ababalelwa ku-1.3 billion ababhemayo emhlabeni jikelele, uhlala emazweni angathuthukile ngokomnotho kuya kulabo abanomnotho omaphakathi," kusho umbiko.Umbiko udalule ukuthi ugwayi yiwona obhenywa kakhulu uma kuza ezintweni ezine-tobacco. Kwezinye kubalwe isigazu, isibhawubhawu nokunye. Kuvele ukuthi ugwayi awuyekeki kulula. "Ababhemayo kudingeka bayeke. Abazi ubungozi bukagwayi bayafuna ukuwuyeka. Ukwelulekwa nokuhlinzekwa ngemishanguzo kuyasiza kulabo abafuna ukuyeka ukubhema," kusho umbiko. Ukufaka intela kugwayi ngezinye zezindlela zokuzama ukwehliswa ukubhenywa kwawo."Ukufaka intela engu-10% kugwayi kwehlisa ukubhenywa kwawo ngo-4%."Umbiko uveze ukuthi ugwayi ongagunyaziwe ukuthi udayiswe udala enkulu ingozi.Kuthiwa ugwayi owodwa kwengu-10, awugunyaziwe ukuthi udayiswe emhlabeni jikelele kanti lo gwayi kumele uvalwe.
PHEZU kokuba inyuka minyaka yonke imali yokuxhasa izitshudeni esikhwameni iNational Students' Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS), kodwa ayenele ukubhekana nomthamo okhula njalo wezitshudeni.Lokhu kuvezwe nguNgqongqoshe weMfundo ePhakeme uDkt Nobuhle Nkabane izolo, ethula isabelomali sikaR142.4 billion, ePhalamende eKapa.Lesi sabelomali kulindeleke ukuthi sikhule siye kuR150 billion, onyakeni ozayo wezimali. INSFAS yabelwe uR48.7 billion kulo nyaka wezimali kanti ngonyaka ozayo izonyuka iye kuR50 billion.UDkt Nkabane uthe noma sinyuka isabelomali kodwa asenele ukubhekana nezidingo ezikhulayo."Noma inyuka minyaka yonke imali eyabelwe umnyango kodwa ayenele ukubhekana nezidingo. Ziningi nezinye izinsiza ezidingekayo," usho kanje.INSFAS ixhase izitshudeni ezingu-811 011, abangu-580 000 kulaba abasemanyuvesi kuthi abangu-231 000 abasemakolishi amakhono amaTVET.Uveze ukuthi amakolishi ama-TVET, abelwe uR14 billion kulo nyaka esuka kuR13.1 billion. UDkt Nkabane uthe bayaqhubeka nokufuqa umkhankaso wokuthi la makolishi abe yizikhungo ezizofika kuqala emiqondweni yezitshudeni uma ziqeda u-matric."Asifuni kube yizikhungo lapho bezoya khona ngoba sebelahlela. Ukuba yi-artisan yiwona mgogodla wezwe elinomnotho okhulayo." Uveze nokuthi nemali eyabelwe ukuphucula amakhono namaSETA izoba nguR26 billion, ngonyaka ozayo izokhula iye kuR27.8 billlion.Ubalule nokuthi isabelo samanyuvesi sizoba nguR96 billion, sisuka kuR91.7 billion."Le mali kulindeleke ukuthi iye kuR100 billion ngo-2026. Ishoda cishe ngo-R1.4 billion imali ehlinzekwa amanyuvesi."Amanye amaqembu okuyi-DA ne-EFF asichithile isabelomali ekhala ngezinto eziningi okubalwa nokuthi asibhekeli izitshudeni.La maqembu aphakamise ukuthi kubuyekezwe iNSFAS ngoba ayizisizi izitshudeni zakuleli.
UBUFAKAZI kubaSibusiso Ncengwa (37) buvula umnyango wokuthi abasunguli betulo, abaxhumanisi nezinkabi abathinteka ecaleni lokubulawa ngesihluku kukaSindiso Magaqa, owayengusekela-nobhala jikelele wephiko lentsha likaKhongolose, i-ANC Youth League, ngoSepthemba, 2017, babhekane nengalo yomthetho.UNcengwa ongomunye wabasolwa abane kuleli cala eselidonse iminyaka eyisishiyagalombili, ugeqe amagula ngemuva kwesinqumo sakhe sokulivuma ngenhloso yokuthola ushwele. Ukuvuma kwakhe kuhlakaze amagama ezikhulu zikahulumeni ebezihlonishwa emphakathini, okuveza izinsolo zokuhleleka kobugebengu ngaphakathi kwezinhlelo zombuso.Enkulumweni yakhe eyashicilelwa njengesitatimende sokuvuma icala ngokweSigaba 220, uNcengwa wembula iqiniso elibuhlungu lokuthi uMagaqa wabulawa ngenxa yokuzinikela kwakhe ekulweni nobugebengu obuhlobene nenkohlakalo ngaphakathi koMkhandlu waseMzimkhulu, ongaphansi kwesifunda saseHarry Gwala. Ucwaningo lwakhe nentshisekelo ayenayo yokulwa nenkohlakalo kwambeka engcupheni ngemuva kokulandela imikhondo ebonisa izinhlelo zokufunjathiswa ezazigqilaza uhlelo lokunikezwa kosokontileka amathuba emisebenzi kanye nokudliwa kwezimali okubikwa ukuthi zazibekelwe ukuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza zomphakathi.Ngokombiko kaNcengwa, uzungu lokubulawa kukaSindiso Magaqa lwaqhamuka kuMluleki Ndobe owayengusodolobha eHarry Gwala, owazidubula emzini wakhe ngoNovemba ka-2020, kanye noZweliphansi Sikhosana, owayengumphathi woMkhandlu waseMzimkhulu. Lezi zikhulu, ngokusho kukaNcengwa, zazilekelelwa nguMdu Ncalane, isikhulu sezokuxhumana eMkhandlwini waseThekwini nowaziwa nangokubamba iqhaza ebuholini be-ANC esifundazweni saKwaZulu-Natal.UNcengwa waphinde waveza ukuthi uMdu Ncalane wadlala indima yokuxhumanisa uNdobe noSikhosana kanye nezinkabi, okufaka phakathi yena uNcengwa, uMbulelo Mpofana, uSibonelo Myeza, noMlungisi Ncalane. UNcengwa wabika ukuthi uMdu Ncalane wayengamele ukuhanjiswa kwenkokhelo yokuqala, elinganiselwa ku-R120 000, abayihlukaniselana ngaphakathi. Lezi zinsolo zigqamisa ukusebenza kwengalo yomthetho ekuqinisekiseni ukwenziwa kobulungiswa emacaleni wobugebengu obuhleliwe, ikakhulukazi lawo abandakanya ushayasibhamu, umsunguli wetulo, kanye nomxhumanisi. Lokhu kusekelwe yizinhlinzeko zoMthetho i-Criminal Law Amendment Act 105 ka-1997, odla fumuka nasilaza kuhle kwentukuthelo yoThukela uma lungenisa ekujeziseni abanesandla kubudlova obuhleliwe. Ngaphandle kwezinhlinzeko zoMthetho iCriminal Law Amendment Act, izinkantolo zaseNingizimu Afrika zibophezelwe ukuhlonipha umgomo wendlela yesinqumo esijwayelekile, lapho izinqumo zenkantolo enkulu ziba yisibonelo esibophezelayo emacaleni afanayo. Izinqumo ezifana noMbuso ubhekene noMgedezi nabanye (1989), uMbuso ubhekene noPule (1995), uMbuso ubhekene noMasilela (2001), kanye noMbuso ubhekene noThebus nabanye (2003), zigcizelela ukuthi ukukhokha, ukuhlela noma ukutholwa kwezikhali kukhombisa inhloso efanayo nokubulala uqobo.Ngaphansi komgomo wezomthetho, izinqumo ezinjengezoMbuso ubhekene noPule, uMbuso ubhekene noMasilela, kanye noMbuso ubhekene noThebus, zenza kube sobala ukuthi umuntu ongazange adubule mathupha kodwa owahlela, waxhasa noma waba yingxenye yokuhlela ukubulawa, angabekwa icala lokubulala njengomuntu owenze isenzo uqobo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma ubufakazi obufanele bubakhona, uMdu Ncalane noZweliphansi Sikhosana, njengabantu abaphilayo ababalulwe nguNcengwa njengabaxhumanisi nabahleli, bangabhekana nezinsolo ezifanayo zokubulala okuhleliwe ngokwesigaba sokuqala sokubandakanyeka (principal in the first degree). Lokhu kuhlonipha umgomo wokuthi ubulungiswa abukhethi ukuthi ubani odubulile, bukhetha ukuthi ubani owahlela ukuthi kudutshulwe.Umphakathi kumele ukubheke ngamehlo abomvu ukugwetshwa kukaNcengwa okulindeleke ngoMsombuluko womhlaka-7, ngoba kulandela ukuvuma kwakhe icala lokubulala okuhleliwe, nokusho ukuthi ubufakazi obumelene naye sebuhlolwe yinkantolo enegunya elifanele, enekhono lokusungula isibonelo esibophezelayo (legal precedent). Lokhu kubeka isisekelo esiqinile sokuthi ubufakazi obathathwa njengobuqinile ngokwanele ukuze kube nesigwebo, abunakwenqatshwa noma buthatheke kancane uma busekelwa yisikhungo sabashushisi (NPA) njengobufakazi obuholayo emacaleni abasolwa abasele, okufaka phakathi uMdu Ncalane kanye noSikhosana.Ngokomthetho, inkantolo kayikwazi ukuziphikisa noma ingayinaki imininingwane eyayiyigunyazile njengobufakazi obuqinile ngesikhathi ithatha isinqumo sokugweba. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma i-NPA ithatha isinqumo sokusebenzisa ubufakazi bukaNcengwa njengesisekelo sokulandela abanye abasolwa, inkantolo kufanele ibhekane nabo ngendlela efanayo, ngaphandle kokubandlulula noma ukwehlisa isisindo salobu bufakazi.Ngale ndlela, isigwebo sikaNcengwa akumele sibonwe njengokuqedwa nje kwesahluko saleli cala, kepha singase sibe yisiqalo sokuphonsela inselelo izinhlaka zikahulumeni ukuba zilandele izinkomba ngobuqotho, ukuze ubulungiswa buqhubeke, bungabi yinto edonswa phambili yizizathu zezombusazwe noma ubuholi obunezinhloso zobulwane.

Ngingakusho nje ukuthi azikho izinxushunxushu, yebo ke kukhona labo abenza okuphambene."UHlophe uthe ngeke ananaze ukwenza izinguquko uma kunesidingo wathi izinqumo uzozithatha ngaphandle kokulinda ukuthi abonisane noZuma."Yimina umholi weMK ePhalamende, ngiphinde ngibe yiphini lomholi weqembu. Lapha ePhalamende kukhala isicathulo sami. UZuma washo ukuthi ngingalokhu ngiza kuyena ngizotefa." UHlophe ukuphikile ukuthi kukhona abafuna kususwe esikhundleni usotswebhu omkhulu weMK ePhalamende, uNksz Colleen Makhubele.Kunemibiko yokuthi kunamalungu eMK abhalele uZuma acela ukuba kususwe uNksz Makhubele. UHlophe uthe akayazi yena leyo ncwadi. "Uma kunesikhalo kufanele size kimina bese kuba yimina engisidlulisela kuZuma. Ngijabule kakhulu ngomsebenzi awenzayo."Uthe ngeke abanake abakhonkotha iMK ngoba inja ayiyikhonkothi imoto emile, kodwa ikhonkotha ehambayo.

KwiPEP kungenwa ngokufaka isicelo uma kunezikhala ezikhangisiwe.
