KUPHINDE kwaphazamiseka ukugwetshwa kowayeyiphoyisa elalinesikhundla esiphezulu, uKhephu Ndlovu nabanye abane eNkantolo yesiFunda yasePinetown izolo, omunye wabameli enza isiphakamiso sokuthi imantshi eyengamele icala mayihoxe kuleli cala.UKhephu, ongummangalelwa wesibili kuleli cala, uzakwabo emaphoyiseni uBonginkosi Dlamini ongummangalelwa wokuqala, uFelokwakhe Ndlovu, Sibongile Ndlovu noLindokuhle Ndlovu balahlwa yicala lokuphazamisa ukusebenza kwengalo yomthetho kanjalo nelenkohlakalo. Kuthiwa uKhephu noDlamini bamukela imali engu-R120 000, ukuze bashabalalise ubufakazi becala lokubulawa kowayeyilungu eliqavile le-ANC, KwaNdengezi. Kwavela ukuthi laba ababili bamukela le mali kuSibongile Ndlovu, (ongummangalelwa wesine ecaleni) endaweni epaka izimoto phakathi esiteshini samaphoyisa iDurban Central. Kuthiwa ngale mali uSibongile wayehlose ukuthi umyeni wakhe uFelokwakhe (ongummangalelwa wesithathu ecaleni) aphunyuke ecaleni lokubulala umzala wakhe uMnuz Thulani Nxumalo owayephinde abe wumholi wegatsha le-ANC KwaNdengezi.UNxumalo wabulawa wuNkosinathi Mbambo ngo-2018, emva kokukhokhelwa uR2 000 wuFelokwakhe. UFelokwakhe waboshwa wuDlamini. Wagcina egwetshwa udilikajele yiNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini ngo-Ephreli 2023, emva kokumlahla ngecala lokubulala uNxumalo.Efaka isicelo sokuthi imantshi ihoxe kuleli cala u-Advocate John Broster, ongummeli kaDlamini, uthe ukwenza lokhu emva kokuba imantshi uMnuz Muntukayise Khumalo, ikhiphe isinqumo esiwujuqu sokuthi ngeke luyiswe kwenye inkantolo ukuze lubuyekezwe olwesinqumo eyasenza phambilini, sokunqaba ukuthi kubuyiswe omunye ufakazi owayesefakazile kuleli cala. Lowo fakazi kuthiwa wayesefakaze waqeda ngesikhathi uDlamini esemelwe omunye ummeli. Kuvela ukuthi ngesikhathi sekufika u-Adv Broster owangena endaweni yalowo mmeli, wenza isiphakamiso sokuthi lo fakazi abizwe okwesibili azompheka ngemibuzo, okwaba yinto uKhumalo ayinqabayo, ngelithi ubufakazi balo fakazi vele abunamthelela ongakanani ecaleni.UBroster ubephakamise ukuthi kuhlehliselwe uDisemba 2025, ukugwetshwa kwabamangalelwa, ethi lesi sikhathi sizokwanela ukuthi kubuyekezwe isinqumo sikaKhumalo. Uveze ukuthi ukuba wanikwa ithuba lokuhloma ngemibuzo lo fakazi, mhlawumbe ngabe inkantolo ayifikanga ekutheni imlahle ngecala uDlamini nozakwabo. UBroster akafunanga nakuyizwa eyomshushisi woMbuso u-Adv Lawrence Gcaba, ngesikhathi ephakamisa ukuthi akayeke inkantolo iqhubeke nokuwisa isigwebo iqede bese enza isicelo sokubuyekeza emva kwalokho. "Nakuba kufanele kubhekelelwe amalungelo abamangalelwa, kodwa kufanele inkantolo ibacabangele nalabo abafuna ukubona kwenzeka ubulungiswa ngecala okukhona kubo abagilwa kanjalo nomphakathi olilandelayo,” kusho uGcaba. Yize inkantolo ihambe emazwini kaGcaba ngesikhathi isiveza ukuthi ngeke ivume isinqumo sayo siyobuyekezwa kwenye inkantolo, noBroster ukhombise ukungayizwa leyo, okuyilapho ephakamise khona ukuthi ngokomyalelo wekhasimende lakhe, uzofaka isicelo sokuthi imantshi ihoxe ukwengamela icala. UKhumalo ufike kulesi sinqumo emva kokufunda inqwaba yezibonelo zokwahlulela okufanayo, okwenziwa amajaji ehlukene kwamanye amacala acishe afane. Kuzona bekuvela ukuthi ijaji noma imantshi inalo ilungelo lokunquma ukuthi angabizwa okwesibili ufakazi osefakaze waqeda. UKhumalo ugcine enquma ukuthi uBroster nabanye abameli abangafisa ukumjoyina esicelweni sakhe kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi bafaka amaphepha okwenza njalo ungakashayi uJulayi 18 kulo nyaka. Ube eseyalela uMbuso ukuthi wona kufanele uphendule abameli esicelweni sabo ungakashayi u-Agasti 1 kulo nyaka. Ube esethi abameli nabo kufanele baphendule okuzoshiwo wuMbuso ungakashayi u-Agasti 15, kulo nyaka. Konke lokhu bayalelwe ukuthi bakwenze ngama-email, bese kuze kuziwe enkantolo ngo-Agasti 22. Enkantolo bekugcwele, kwaze kwaphela indawo yokuhlala, kwabakhona okuphoqeleka ukuthi bame. USibongile obebukeka engakhathazekile kangako, futhi eswenke econsa, waze wapenda nomlomo, ucele umndeni wakhe ukuba umlethele izinto ezifudumalayo. "Ngicela ningilethele izinto ezifudumalayo, o-poloneck namasokisi anovolo phakathi, kuyabanda ejele,” kusho uSibongile.UKhephu naye obebukeka ezikhululekele, ubelokhu ebingelela abathandiweyo bakhe, abanye baze bamthakazele ngokuthi 'Gatsheni'. Ngaphambi kokuqala kwecala, kubonakale isihlobo singena nebhantshi elihle, sehla nalo sayongena emgodini, kuthe sebenyuka abamangalelwa sekuqala icala, leli bhantshi bese ligqokwe wuKhephu. Bonke abamangalelwa bagcinwe ejele laseWestville.
ISIHEHA nezivakashi zakwamanye amazwe indawo yokulala esetshenziselwa amaholidi, iFJ Places B and B eseGlenwood eThekwini, ephethwe ngowesifazane owayishiyelwa ngunina ongasekho emhlabeni. UNksz Akhona Dlamini (23), uthe ukufika kwezivakashi zangaphandle kule ndawo kwenza kufezeke iphupho likanina lokubona le ndawo idlondlobala kunokuba ifadabale. Uveze ukuthi unina wavula le ndawo ngo-2017. UNksz Dlamini uthe unina, uNkk Zoleka Dlamini (uMaDuma),wadlula emhlabeni ngo-2021.Ubalule ukuthi ezivakashini esezike zavakashela le ndawo ngesikhathi samaholidi, kubalwa ezivela ezwenikazi i-Afrika okuyiseGhana, Malawi naseNigeria. Uthe muva nje sekuke kwaba nezivakashi ezivela eFrance, India, England nase-UK. Lokhu uthe kumthoba amanxeba ngoba kwakuyinto unina ayefisa ukuyibona yenzeka ngesikhathi eyisungula eminyakeni eyedlule.''Kuyangijabulisa kakhulu ukubona le ndawo isihanjelwa yizivakashi zakwamanye amazwe. Lokhu kuveza ngokusobala ukuthi lokhu umama ayekufisa sekuyenzeka manje,'' usho kanje. Eqhuba uthe wayengakaze azicabange kunguyena ophethe indawo yalolu hlobo. Uthe kodwa ukudlula emhlabeni kukanina yikhona okwadala ukuthi abe nentshisekelo enkulu yokuqinisekisa ukuthi le ndawo iyadlondlobala.''Umama wayesebenza ubusuku nemini efuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi le ndawo iba sezingeni. Wayenza konke okusemandleni akhe ngoba efuna ukubona le ndawo iba ngcono,'' usho kanje.Uthe kuyisibophezelo asenzile enhliziyweni yakhe ukuthi angamphoxi unina. ''Ngifuna ukuthi nalapho ekhona umama abone ukuthi into ayishiya ayifadabali kodwa kunalokho iyakhula ezandleni zami,'' kuchaza uNksz Dlamini.Uveze ukuthi uneziqu zeBachelor in Arts, azizuza esikhungweni semfundo ephakeme esiseThekwini i-Afda.
KUVUNGAME namaqembu ezepolitiki KwaZulu-Natal ngokuqashwa kwesikhulu esizophatha ezezimali eMnyangweni wezeMfundo esifundazweni, esisule eMnyangweni wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu, silandelwa yifu lenkohlakalo.Amaqembu okuyi-DA ne-EFF, kanjalo nezinyunyana zothisha iSadtu, Natu neNaptosa, bayaveva ngesinqumo salo mnyango sokuqasha uNksz Yali Joyi. Bafuna uMphathiswa wezeMfundo, uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka, abuyekeze ukuqokwa kukaNksz Joyi,UNobhala weSadtu, uNksz Nomarashiya Caluza, uthe badumele ngokuqashwa kukaNksz Joyi ngoba kuyaziwa ukuthi wasula eMnyangweni wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana, ngaphansi kwefu lezinsolo zenkohlakalo. Uthe uMnyango wezeMfundo unezinkinga zemali ngakho akudingeki kube nobudedengu okuzocwilisa lo mnyango, wathi uyazi ukuthi umuntu umsulwa aze alahlwe yicala kodwa bazwile ukuthi wasula ngaphambi kokuqondiswa ubugwegwe. "Sifuna ukubona umbiko wophenyo omveza ukuthi akathinteki enkohlakalweni. Sifuna ukuhlangana nomphathiswa kanjalo nenhloko yomnyango ukuze sithole umbono wabo. Sizoya nakwiPublic Service Commission noMvikeli woMphakathi, sifuna baphenye lolu daba. Siyakuchitha ukuqokwa kwakhe size sithole ukuthi akathinteki ezinsolweni zenkohlakalo," usho kanje. Isitatimende seNatu sithe ishaqekile le nyunyana ngokuqokwa kukaNksz Joyi ngoba wasula engazange aligeze igama lakhe emnyangweni asuka kuwona ezinsolweni zenkohlakalo.Ithe umnyango ubhekene nezinkinga zezezimali ngakho awufuni kube nomuntu onefu lenkohlakalo ekhanda lawo."Ukuqokwa kwakhe nguHlomuka kukhomba ukuthi ukungaziphathi ngendlela komuntu akujeziswa kodwa kuyaklonyeliswa. Sinxusa umnyango asuka kuwona ukuthi udedele umbiko wawo ngaye uNksz Joyi," sisho kanje.INaptosa ithe umnyango kumele uchaze ngokuqokwa kukaNksz Joyi. "Umnyango omkhulu onesabelomali esikhulu ngakho awukwazi ukuthi isikhundla sezezimali singanikwa umuntu okunemibuzo ngaye. Washiya lapho evela khona engazange aphendule ngezinsolo ayebekwe zona." Okhulumela i-DA kwezemfundo esifundazweni, uMnuz Sakhile Mngadi, uthe bafuna kubuyekezwe ukuqashwa kwakhe, noma bamnqumela okatiki uHlomuka ukuthi abhekane nomthetho."Uma engayibuyekezi eyokumqasha, sizodlulisela udaba kuNdunankulu, kwiPublic Service Commission, kuMvikeli woMphakathi nakuNgqongqoshe weMfundo kuzwelonke. Sesimbhalele uHlomuka mayelana nalolu daba," usho kanje. Ukhale ngokuthi wamiswa nyakenye uNksz Joyi ngezinsolo zenkohlakalo, wase ejaha ukusula kulo nyaka."Ukuqokwa kwakhe kuveza isithombe sokuthi umuntu osuke enze okuphambene nomthetho, uyahlonyuliswa. Asikwazi ukuthi kungalethwa umuntu ofuze lo emnyangweni."I-EFF ithe iyakuchitha ukuqokwa kwakhe kwezemfundo, yathi akakulungele ukuzokwengamela imali zomnyango wezemfundo. Ithe lo mnyango ubhekene nengwadla yemali ngakho kuwukuhluleka kukahulumeni wokubambisana kwamaqembu ukujezisa abasuke bebhekene namacala enkohlakalo."Sifuna kuchithwe ukuqashwa kwakhe emnyangweni, kukhishwe nombiko ogcwele ngokumiswa kwakhe eMnyangweni wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana. Ngeke sithule sibona kwenzeka inkohlakalo." Umnyango kaHlomuka umemezele ukuqokwa kwakhe kuleli sonto.
AMAQEMBU ezepolitiki athi liphume nobovu kuxoshwa iMeya kaMasipala waKwaDukuza, uMnuz Ali Ngidi, nephini lemeya, uMnuz Njabulo Cele, abaphinde bahlanziswa ingxenye yemali esetshenziswe wumkhandlu ubaqashela izimoto nabaqaphi.I-DA, ActionSA neMK bathe kufanele engabe kade bakhonjwa indlela uNgidi noCele. UNgidi noCele basule ezikhundleni ngoLwesithathu emva komyalelo wobuholi be-ANC KwaZulu-Natal. Ubuholi be-ANC KwaZulu-Natal buthathe isinqumo sokuyalela la baholi ukuba basule emva kophenyo. Uphenyo lwaqala emva kwezinsolo zokuthi umkhandlu usebenzisa imali eshisiwe uqasha izimoto ezazisetshenziswa yilaba baholi. La baholi bebengakaqedi ngisho unyaka bengenile ezikhundleni. Ngesikhathi bengena ezikhundleni abazange bazisebenzise izimoto zomkhandlu ezazisetshenziswa ababephethe izikhundla ngaphambi kwabo.Umgqugquzeli we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Mike Mabuyakhulu, uthe uNgidi noCele bayalelwe ukuba bakhokhe ingxenye yemali esetshenziswe wumkhandlu ubaqashela izimoto emva kokufungiswa kwabo. "Imali abazoyikhokha yilena esetshenziswe wumkhandlu ngaphambi kokuthi kube nesinqumo somkhandlu esithi abaqashelwe izimoto. Imali abangeke bayikhokhe yilena esetshenziswe emva kokuba umkhandlu usuthathe isinqumo sokubaqashela izimoto."Kunezinsolo zokuthi enye yalezi zimoto okwakufanele engabe bayazisebenzisa yayibonakala ihambisa izingane zikaNgidi esikoleni. UMabuyakhulu uthe uNgidi uyalelwe ukuba kube khona imali ayikhokhayo ngokusebenzisa le moto. Bekuphinde kube nesikhalo sokuthi inkulu kakhulu imali ekhokhelwa abaqaphi abagada uNgidi nasemzini wakhe njengoba umasipala ubukhokha u-R170 000 njalo ngenyanga.Nayo le mali uzoyikhokha uNgidi.UMabuyakhulu uthe ukuxoshwa kwalaba baholi kukhombisa ukuzinikela kwabo ukwakha kabusha i-ANC. Akazange asho ukuthi obani abazongena ezikhundleni.Okhulumela i-DA kuMasipala waKwaDukuza, uNksz Privi Makhan, uthe abamfisi uNgidi."Kule zinyanga eziyisishiyagalombili ephethe uhluleke wancama ukuhola umkhandlu. Ziningi izinqumo azithathile ezifake umasipala ehlazweni. Ubezithwele futhi engafuni ukuboniseka. "Ngesikhathi kuphethe yena sibone umasipala uhluleka wukuhambisa izidingo kubantu. UNgidi ubengabonakali nhlobo emiphakathini. Into abeyazi nje wukuhamba imicimbi yomntakabani."Ikhansela le-ActionSA, uMnuz Nel Sewraj, lithe ukuxoshwa kukaNgidi noCele kuzobuyisa isithunzi somkhandlu.Umdidiyeli weMK esifundeni Ilembe, uMnuz Basil Ntuli, uthe banethemba lokuthi kuzoqokwa abaholi abaqotho ukuba bangene ezikhundleni ezivulekile.
INGENA ingenile imiyalezo yenduduzo emndenini wowayeyiPhini likamengameli wezwe uMnuz David Dabede Mabuza.Amaqembu ahlukene abhonge emswanini edlulisa amazwi enduduzo nakwi-ANC, ngokushona kwalo mholi obebuye abe neziqubu zokugula nangesikhathi eseyiphini likamengameli.UMabuza (64) waseMpumalanga kuthiwa ushonele esibhedlela eSandton, eGoli izolo kanti amaqembu afana ne-ACDP, BOSA, ActionSA, ATM namanye, adlulise amazwi enduduzo. Unobhala jikelele we-ANC uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, uthe bashaqekile ngokudlula emhlabeni kukaMabuza.Uthe wayezinikele futhi engumuntu ohlale efuna kube nobumbano kwi-ANC nasezweni."Sidlulisa amazwi enduduzo emndenini wakhe, kubangani, izihlobo nakubantu bakuleli. Silahlekelwe ngumuntu obethanda izwe lakhe, owayezinikele ekulweleni inkululeko."UMabuza owasiza umengameli Cyril Ramaphosa wathatha izintambo engqungqutheleni ye-ANC eNasrec ngo-2017 eGoli, embangweni owawushisa phansi phakathi kukaCR noDkt Nkosazana Dlamini Zuma, wanconywa kakhulu njengomholi owayefuna ubumbano kwi-ANC. Ababeseka uDkt Dlamini Zuma bambiza ngomdayisi njengoba wayezishaya samuntu owayemeseka ukuze angene emandleni kodwa washintsha ngomzuzu wokugcina waseka uRamaphosa. Uphinde anconywe ngokusheshe adede inkundla njengoba aphatha ihlandla elilodwa kwesePhini likamengameli. Wadedela iphini elikhona likamengameli nakwesephini likamengameli we-ANC uMnuz Paul Mashatile.UMabuza wazalelwa ePhola Trust, eMpumalanga, kanti uneziqu zeBachelor of Arts kwiPsychology, zasenyuvesi yakuleli. Wathola isitifiketi sokufundisa eMgwenya College of Education ngo-1985. Waba nguMphathiswa wezeMfundo eMpumalanga kusuka ngo-1994 kuya ku-1998 futhi engusihlalo we-ANC.Ngo-2017 wakhethelwa kwesokuba yiphini likamengameli eNasrec ngo-2017 kuya ku-2022. Waba ngundunankulu waseMpumalanga kusuka ngo-2009 kuya ku-2018 kanti wasula njengelungu lePhalamende ngo-2023.Wayeteketiswa ngoKati ngoba wayebizwa ngomuntu onempilo eningi njengoba ayehlale eya eRussia eyokwelashwa.
ZIYAGIBELANA izinkinga eqenjini lebhola lempunyela yaseThekwini, iRoyal AM, njengoba isiphucwe uxhaso lwezigidi zamaRandi wuMasipala waseMsunduzi.Lo masipala uthathe isinqumo sokuhoxisa uxhaso luka-R27 million, obelutholwa ileli qembu likasomabhizinisi waseThekwini, uNksz Shauwn Mkhize.Isinqumo sokuhoxisa uxhaso sithathwe emhlanganweni womkhandlu obungoLwesithathu. Umasipala wangena esivumelwananeni seminyaka emithathu sokusebenzisana neRoyal AM ekuqaleni kwesizini yebhola eyedlule.Ngokwesivumelwano, iRoyal AM kwakufanele idlalele imidlalo yayo yasekhaya enkundleni yezemidlalo eseMgungundlovu, iHarry Gwala.Maphakathi nesizini kwaba nezinkinga njengoba iRoyal AM yehluleka ukudlala imidlalo yayo.IRoyal AM yagcina ixoshwa kwiPSL. Umasipala uhoxisa uxhaso nje, kunecala elifakwe i-DA eNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu, lapho ifuna khona ukuba inkantolo ichithe isivumelwano sokuxhasa.I-DA ithe nakuba ikushayela ihlombe ukuhoxiswa koxhaso, ifuna kubuye yonke imali ebisinikezwe iRoyal AM.Okhulumela i-DA eMgungundlovu, uNksz Tammy Colley, uthe bazolwela ukuthi bathathelwe izinyathelo bonke ababa ingxenye yokuba umasipala ungene esivumelwaneni sokusebenzisa neRoyal AM."Okufanele singakukhohlwa ukuthi iMeya yomkhandlu (Mnuz Mzimkhulu Thebolla) yayihamba phambili ekuphoqeni ukuthi umasipala ungene kulesi sivumelwano. I-ANC yayesekwa amakhansela e-IFP, EFF nePA. Kufanele ibuye yonke imali yomkhandlu bese isetshenziselwa ukuhambisa izidingo kubantu."UNksz Colley uthe ukuhoxiswa koxhaso akusho ukuthi sebezoliyeka icala abalifake enkantolo.Inkantolo yasigodla isinqumo sayo emva kokulalela izethulo zazo zonke izinhlangothi ezithintekayo. USotswebhu omkhulu emkhandlwini, uMnuz Sandile Dlamini, uvumile ukuthi sihoxisiwe isivumelwano kodwa wabe esekhala ngokuxhomondela kweDA.UDlamini uthe lolu daba ludingidwe esithe, wathi bekungafanele i-DA igijime iyolukhuluma nabezindaba."Uma udaba ludingidwe esithe kuyaye kufanele umphakathi waziswe ngendlela eqondile, udaba lungaqhamuki ngabantu abadlala ipolitiki."UDlamini uthe banqume ukuhoxisa uxhaso ngenxa yokuthi iRoyal AM isixoshiwe kwiPSL."Isivumelwano sasinombandela wokuthi iqembu kufanele lidlale esigabeni esikhulu. Njengoba lingasekho nje esigabeni esikhulu asisekho isidingo sokuthi siqhubeke nokulixhasa. Ukube lisekhona esigabeni esikhulu besizoqhubeka nokulixhasa."
SITHOLWE ekotishini obekuhlala kulo uzakwabo wasemsebenzini eMashona, oLundi, isidumbu sowesilisa waseVryheid, obekubikwe ukuthi uduke ngendlela engaqondakali.Ongasekho, uMnuz Linamandla Mngomezulu (24), wayebikwe ukuthi udukile ngeSonto.Ngokusho kwesihlobo sakhe, uNksz Nokubekezela Mngomezulu, umufi wagcina ukubonwa ephila, eya endlini okuhlala kuyona uzakwabo abesebenza naye kwinkontileka yokwakha umgwaqo oLundi. "Uzakwabo lo oseboshiwe, sithole ukuthi ubengumuntu obemisiwe emsebenzini, kulandela iziwombe zokungaziphathi kahle. Kuthiwa ubizele uLi emqashweni wakhe esingazi ukuthi ubefuna baxoxe ngani,” kusho uNksz Mngomezulu.Uveze ukuthi umufi ubeyimenenja yesayithi lapho umsolwa ebesebenza khona ngaphansi kwakhe, wathi emva kokungatholakali kwakhe kanjalo nemoto yomsebenzi abehamba ngayo, kuhlatshwe umkhosi wokuthi unyamalele. "Kubhekwe iselula yakhe, wavela ukuthi igcine ukubonakala eMandeni, okuyilapho esibike khona umuntu odukile emaphoyiseni,” kubeka uNksz Mngomezulu.Uveze ukuthi emva kokubheka yonke indawo, kugcine kuyiwa ekotishini likamsolwa, okulapho bezithele khona phezu kwesidumbu sakhe ngoLwesibili ekuseni."Ubeshawe ngensimbi, eficwe endaweni yesigameko igcwele igazi. Isidumbu sakhe besiboshwe izandla nezinyawo,” usho kanje. Uqhube wathi imoto ebihamba umufi yona igcine itholwa eNanda, lapho okuthiwa umsolwa ubezama khona ukuyidayisa ngo-R10 000."Kuthiwa ubethi inkampani imkweleta le mali, yikho edayisa imoto yayo ngawo,” kulandisa uNksz Mngombezulu.Uthe bathole ukuthi umsolwa ungowokudabuka eMzimkhulu. Uthe basadidekile namanje ukuthi yini edale ukuthi umsolwa abulale umufi ngoba nakuba ebebheke umsebenzi esayithini kodwa akuyena othatha izinqumo enkampanini."Akuyena owammisa emsebenzini. Namanje sisadidekile ukuthi kungani embulele,” usho kanjena. Uveze ukuthi babambisane kahle nomnikazi wenkampani kusuka ngesikhathi kuvela izindaba zokunyamalala kukamufi kwaze kwaba uyatholwa. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uConstable Thenjiswa Ngcobo, uthe amaphoyisa aseMahlabathini, aphenya icala lokubulala kulandela ukutholwa kowesilisa oneminyaka engu-24 efile ngoLwesibili, eMashona-White City. "Kuthiwa umufi ubebikwe njengomuntu olahlekile esiteshini samaphoyisa saseMandeni, ngeSonto,” kusho uConstable Ngcobo.

UMnuz Vukani Victor Shangase (28), obedume ngelika-Man, kuthiwa waduka ngo-Ephreli 15 kanti kuvela ukuthi kwayehamba nabo, kukhona abagcina bemhlanganyela, bamshaya kanzima.Unina ka-Man, uNksz Khumbuzile Zondi elandisa ngesehlo, uthe walandwa wumngani wakhe, ethi kuqashwe itekisi ukuze kuyiwe edolobheni, bayozijabulisa. Uthe zilokhu zishintshashintsha izinto ezishiwoyo njengoba nalo mshayeli, engasafuni ukuyiphatha le afika wayisho kubona kusanda kuvela eyokuthi uMan, akabuyanga ohambeni lwasedolobheni.Udalule ukuthi okunye okudidayo wukuthi kukhona igazi elalichaphazeleke ophahleni lwetekisi, elinye lisesihlalweni naphansi.Uveze nokuthi ijakhethi yendodana yakhe yatholwa ekhaya loyedwa emva kwamasonto amathathu idukile. Amphoyisa ahudula izinyawo ngalolu daba. Zonke izimpendulo zikhomba laba ayehamba nabo, kodwa akukho mnyakazo esibona amaphoyisa ewenza,” kusho uNksz Zondi. Uthe asakubonile amaphoyisa ekwenza wukuthatha abathintekayo 'ayohlala nabo ematafuleni’ ebapheka ngemibuzo, maqede abadedele.Uqhube wathi ngisho ukucingiswa indodana yakhe awakwenzi, njengoba eba madolo nzima ngisho ukubatholela izinja ehogela umkhondo ngephunga."Linye iphoyisa elalisuka kude, elafika nenja, lenza umsebenzi ngokuzinikela. USOLA ukwenzelela ngephoyisa okuthiwa lashayisa abafundi abathathu, oyedwa wagcina eshonela esibhedlela, umndeni kamufi waseGezubuso, eMgungundlovu.Ngokusho kwesihlobo esicele ukungadalulwa, uKwanele Dlamini (15), ugcine eshonela esibhedlela ngoJuni 21, emva kokushintshashintsha izibhedlela kusukela ngosuku lwesigameko, uJuni 9, 2025. Silandisa ngesigameko isihlobo, sithe umufi nengane yakubo, nenye engesona isihlobo, babesendleleni beya ezikoleni zabo ngesikhathi behlelwa wumshophi. "Kuthiwa babehamba ohlangothini olufanele bobathathu, nemoto ngesikhathi iza, yayihamba ohlangothini kwayo olufanele. Akwaziwa ukuthi kwenzekani, njengoba yagcina iza ohlangothini olwaluhambababafundi, yabashayisa,” kusho isihlobo.Sithe zontathu izingane zangeniswa ezibhedlela ezehlukene, uKwanele, kuwuye osesimeni esibucayi."Wayiswa esibhedlela iGreys, yamdlulisela eNkosi Albert Luthuli, yona egcine imbuyisela eHarry Gwala (Edendale), esekhombisa izimpawu zokuba ngcono. Yilapho avele washonela khona,” kulandisa isihlobo. Siveze ukuthi odokotela batshela umndeni ukuthi kukhona igazi elichitheke ekhanda, futhi cishe lachithekela ebuchosheni.Sithi kuphele eside isikhathi engakhulumi engenzi lutho, uqale ukuvula amehlo nokukhuluma kancane esebuye e-Albert. Sithe bakhathazwa wukuthi bathole emva kwendaba ukuthi umuntu owashayisa abafundi uyiphoyisa futhi usebenza esiteshini samaphoyisa abavule kuso icala. "Amaphoyisa awakaze asithinte. Sagcina ukuxhumana ngesikhathi sisendaweni yesigameko, emva kwalokho awakaze asithinte, asazise ukuthi kuqhubekani ngecala,” kusho isihlobo.Sidalule ukuthi akukaze kube khona ukubambisana okuhle phakathi komndeni kamufi, umsolwa nomndeni wakhe."Ngosuku lwesigameko akakhulumanga kahle nathi, wasitshela ukuthi yena wayengeke asuke kwakhe, asukele ukuyoshayisa izingane emgwaqweni,” sisho kanje. Sibuye saveza nokuthi ngesikhathi bephakamisa ukuthi balekelelwe ngezindleko zokugqigqa e-Albert, iphoyisa lakhipha uR300, lathi yiwo elinawo."Kwathi uma sikhala ngokuthi sizofikaphi ngoR300, umndeni walo wathi kuphakathi kokuthi siyayithatha noma siyayiyeka imali,” usho kanje.Sithe eseshonile umufi, babazisa, bacela ukuhlangatshezwa ngezindleko zomngcwabo, umndeni wephoyisa wathi uzolekelela ngezinkwa. Siveze ukuthi bayichitha eyezinkwa, bathi badinga ukuhlangatshezwa ngo-R20 000 wezindleko zomngcwabo, wala waphetha umndeni wephoyisa, wagcina ukhipha u-R10 000. "Sifuna ubulungiswa, aboshwe uma kufanele, ajeze ngakwenzile. Sikhathazwa yindlela amaphoyisa asethule ngayo, ekubeni sesizwile ukuthi usebenza esiteshini samaphoyisa esivule kuso icala,” kusho isihlobo.Lithintwa iphoyisa elisolwa ngokushayisa abafundi, lithe ukube intatheli ifone ngesikhathi esikahle, belizokhuluma. Likhale ngokubanjwa yisiminyaminya emgwaqweni, lacela ukuthi lifonelwe kahle namuhla ukuze libeke kahle uhlangothi lwalo.Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kwamaphoyisa ayiphumelelanga.
BASALE bebambe ongezansi eCornubia, eThekwini, owesifazane okuthiwa ubepopolwa yizingane ezishaye ngesigubhu samanzi kwashona eyodwa. Lesi sehlakalo kuthiwa senzeke ngoMsombuluko kanti kusona kushone uVuyo Notana (16) obefunda uGrade 10 eForest Avenue Secondary, eVerulam.Ngokusho kokhulumela inkampani yonogada iReaction Unit South Africa (Rusa), uMnuz Prem Balram, umufi nomngani wakhe bebelokhu bepopola lona wesifazane besebenzisa umnyango wasekhishini. Uthe ngenxa yokudinwa yilo mkhuba ebebejwayele ukuwenza kulo wesifazane, ube esethatha isigubhu esingu-5 litre, ebesigcwele amanzi, washaya ngaso umufi."Isigubhu simshaye ekhanda wavele wawa. Lona wesifazane usolile ukuthi umfundi ushonile kodwa engenaso isiqiniseko,” kusho uBalram.Uthe yilapho ebizele khona abeRusa endaweni yesigameko, bafika bathola umfundi edindilizile. Uyise kamufi, uMnuz Ntuthuzelo Genu, uthe bayamsola lona wesifazane ngesenzo sakhe."Ingane uma yenza okuphambene, uyayibika kubazali bayo ukuze babe nolwazi lokuthi iyakuhlupha,” kusho uGenu.Uthe bekungafanele ukuthi athathe isinqumo sokuthi aziqondisele yena ubugwegwe enganeni yabo. "Buka ke manje uyibulele. Ukube ubeke wasibikela ukuthi iyamhlupha, mhlawumbe besizoyikhuza, bekungeke kuphethe ngokuthi asibulalele ingane,” kusho uGenu.Uthe ngesikhathi kufika abantu kubona, bebabikela ngomshophi, bethi abaphuthume endaweni yesigameko, baqale bangakholwa."Sikholwe ngoba sesiyibona idindilizile ingane,” usho kanje. Uthe ngokwabo bekufanele umsolwa azithwale zonke izindleko zomngcwabo, bese eqhubeka ke nokubhekana nengalo yomthetho.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uConstable Thenjiswa Ngcobo, uthe amaphoyisa aseVerulam, abophe owesifazane oneminyaka engu-48 ngecala lokubulala."Lokhu kuze emva kwesigameko lapho umfana oneminyaka engu-16, ebulewe eCornubia ngoMsombuluko,” kusho uConstable Ngcobo.Uthe kulindeleke ukuthi umsolwa avele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseVerulam namhlanje.
ZISASHAQEKILE izihlobo zabayisikhombisa okuthiwa babhubhiswe wukuhogela intuthu yembawula endlini ebebelele kuyo KwaMnyandu, eMgungundlovu, ngeSonto.Kuthiwa endaweni yesigameko kushone abayisithupha, kwathi owesikhombisa washonela esibhedlela. Esinye sezihlobo ezishonelwe kulo mshophi, uMnuz Nkosiphile Zungu, uthe bona bahanjelwe wuMnuz Philasande Zungu (23). Uthe kwenzeka isigameko nje, ekhaya bekunomcimbi ngoMgqibelo, kuhlatshiwe. Babe sebebasa imbawula, bayibeka emva kwesicabha sendlu ebebelaliswe kuyo,” kusho uZungu.Uthe basola ukuthi balale ivutha ngenxa yamakhaza futhi bezitshela ukuthi baphephile njengoba ibibekwe endaweni engenabungozi. "Umonakalo ubonwe ubaba wekhaya ekuseni ngeSonto, ebona bengavuki, waze waya kuyo le ndlu, wafike wadudula isicabha,” kubeka uZungu.Uthe ube esezithela phezu kwabayisithupha babo, belele bengasaphefumuli."Owesikhombisa kuthiwa ubesaphefumula kodwa kunzima. Uphuthunyiswe esibhedlela kodwa sizwa kuthiwa ubuye washona naye,” kusho yena. Udalule ukuthi bonke ebebekule ndlu yizihlobo ebezifike kulo muzi ngoba kunomcimbi, waveza nokuthi iningi labafi bahlobene kodwa bebesuka emakhaya ahlukene. Uthe sibashaqisile isigameko sokuhamba kwezihlobo kanye kanye kade kuhlangenwe kubuswa. "Sibuhlungu ngoPhilasande ngoba ubesemncane, sisabheke lukhulu kuye,” kusho uZungu.Nokho uthe abasoli nyawo lwemfene ngesigameko, wathi sibe yibhadi elehlele izihlobo kungazelele. Umnikazi wekhaya okwenzeke kulo isgameko, uMnuz Nkululeko Magwenyane, utshele abezindaba zeSABC ukuthi naye usathukile. "Ngihambe ngaya kule ndlu ekuseni, ngithi ngiyobavusa. Ngiqale ngangqongqoza kodwa kwangasabela muntu. Ngithe ngisuka ngangiwuvula ngenkani umnyango, ngathi uma ngingena ngaphakathi, ngabathola benganyakazi,” usho kanje.Uthe ngesikhathi esamangazwe yilokhu, ube eseqaphela ukuthi bebebase imbawula kule ndlu ebebelele kuyo.UMphathiswa woMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, edlulisa amazwi enduduzo, wexwayise abantu ukuba baqaphele uma bezifudumeza ngezinto ezifana nezimbawula nama-generator. Uthe ukwenzeka kwesigameko saseMgungundlovu kusibeka kwabayisishiyagalolunye isibalo sabashone ezigamekwini eziyamaniswa nezigigaba zobusika njengoba kufe abanye ababili ngoMgqibelo emijondolo yaseCrossmoore, ngaseChatsworth, eThekwini. "Wonke umuntu akaqaphele, aphephe njengoba kuyisebusika. Nginxusa nabazali ukuthi baqaphe nezingane zabo ukuthi abazishiyi zodwa uma zihlezi eduze kwezimpahla zikagesi ezifudumezayo,” kusho uButhelezi. Ujube abamathimba ezinhlekelele emindenini ukuyolekelela ngayo yonke inhlobo yosizo eludingayo. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uBrigadier Jay Naicker, uthe amaphoyisa asePlessislaer aphenya idokodo lokufa kwabantu kulandela ukufa kwamalungu omndeni ayisithupha KwaMnyandu, ngeSonto."Kuthiwa amadoda ayisikhombisa omndeni owodwa abelele endlini enegumbi elilodwa ngoMgqibelo, ebase imbawula ukuze afudumale. Ngakusasa (ngeSonto) elinye ilungu lomndeni (ebelilele kwenye indlu) lifike lavula umnyango, lazithela phezu kwabayisithupha, bengasaphefumuli. Owesikhombisa ubephefumula kanzima,” kusho uNaicker. Uthe kubizwe i-ambulensi, abezimo eziphuthumayo bafike baqinisekisa ukuthi abayisithupha bashonile. "Lona wesikhombisa uphuthunyiswe esibhedlela. Abashonile baneminyaka ephakathi kuka-17 no-50,” kusho uNaicker, othe banxusa abantu ukuthi bayeke ukusebenzisa izimbawula ezindaweni ezivalelekile.Uthe ukuzibasa ezindaweni ezivalelekile, kuholele ekufeni kwabantu ngezikhathi zasebusika."Siyaqhubeka nokubafundisa abantu ngalokhu emihlanganweni yomphakathi njengoba siye siqaphele ukuthi izigameko ezifuze lezi zihlale zanda ebusika,” usho kanje.
KUTHIKAMEZEKE ukusebenza kwe-internet, kungena indathane yezicelo zentsha efuna ukungena esibalweni salabo abazoqeqeshelwa ukuba amaphoyisa eSouth African Police Service (SAPS).Lokhu kuvezwe amaphoyisa ezingeni likazwelonke kuleli sonto.Ngokusho kwawo esitatimendeni asifake ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, zingaphezu kuka-67 000 izicelo ezingenile esikhathini esingangamahora angu-24, kuvulwe uhlelo lokuthi zifakwe kusetshenziswa i-internet. Kungokokuqala amaphoyisa ophiko lweSAPS ekhiphe umyalelo wokuthi kufakwe izicelo kusetshenziswa i-internet.Phambilini, abafuna ukufaka izicelo bebeye bazihambise eziteshini zamaphoyisa eziseduze. Lokhu amaphoyisa athe akwenzela ukugwema amaphepha amaningi, ukunqanda ukuphasiswa kwezicelo ngokobungani, ngokobuhlobo, inkohlakalo nokulahleka kwezicelo. Lolu hlelo lokufakwa kwezicelo luvulwe ngoJuni 30, 2025, kanti luzovalwa ngoJulayi 18, 2025. Bangu-5 500 abazothathwa bese befakwa ngaphansi kohlelo lokuqeqeshwa okuzothatha izinyanga eziyisishiyagalolunye emakolishi amaphoyisa ehlukene ezweni lonke. Abaneminyaka engu-18 kuya kwengu-35 bavunyelwe ukuthi bafake izicelo. Isitatimende sithe abesifazane nabesilisa abanale minyaka, abangakaze balahlwe amacala, bayakhuthazwa ukuba baqhubeke nokufaka izicelo ngokuvakashela i-website ethi erecruitment.saps.gov.za.

Baboshwa kanye nezikhulu zomkhandlu kanjalo nosomabhizinisi osolwa ngokubafumbathisa.Amakhansela afuna ukubakhipha akhala ngokuthi ukuboshwa kwabo kwathunaza isithunzi somkhandlu. Amakhansela aqale abhalela uNkk Sithole emcela ukuba abize umhlangano ozolalela isiphakamiso, abe esedlulela kuMnguni emva kokuba uNkk Sithole enqabile ukubiza umhlangano. UNkk Sithole ubhalele uMnguni incwadi eshubile lapho emyalela khona ukuthi amise umhlangano wakusasa.UNkk Sithole usabise ngokuthatha izinyathelo zomthetho uma ungamiswa umhlangano obhekwe ngabomvu.Kule ncwadi ebonwe yiSolezwe, uNkk Sithole uthe uMnguni akanalo ilungelo lokubiza umhlangano. UNkk Sithole uthe inkontileka kaMnguni yokubamba njengemenenja yomkhandlu yaphela ngoMashi. "Inkontileka yakho ayikaze ivuselelwe. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izinqumo ozithathile emva kokuphela kwenkontileka yakho, esibala kuzo nalesi sokubiza umhlangano wakusasa, azikho emthethweni. "Okunye ke futhi iminyaka yakho ayisakuvumeli ukuba uphathe isikhundla sokuba yimenenja kamasipala ebambile. Usungaphezulu kweminyaka engu-65, umthetho awusakuvumeli ukuthi uphathe le sikhundla." UNkk Sithole ubenikeze uMnguni umnqamulajuqu wayizolo ukuba ahoxise isaziso esibiza umhlangano wakusasa. "Uma ungakwenzi lokhu ngizophoqeleka ukuba nginikele enkantolo."UNkk Sithole ukuchithile ukuthi wanqaba ukubiza umhlangano ozolalela isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bakhe. Uthe wayalela amakhansela ukuba ayolungisa isicelo sawo sokuba kubizwe umhlangano. UMnguni utshele Isolezwe ukuthi uzoqhubeka umhlangano wakusasa. "Mina ngilawulwa wumthetho, hhayi imizwa yabantu nezinhliziyo. Labo abafuna ukumisa umhlangano ngeke bawumise ngezinhliziyo." Uthe ubize umhlangano ngokulandela isigaba 29 somtetho olawula ukuphathwa komasipala kanye nesigaba semithetho elawula ukuphathwa kukaoMasipala waKwaNongoma. UMnguni uthe uyakweshwama ukuthi inkontileka yakhe yaphela ngoMashi yangabe isavuselelwa.Alikho iqembu elinezihlalo ezanele ukuphatha ngokuzimela KwaNongoma. Njengamanje umasipala uphethwe yi-ANC neNFP ngokubambisana.

"Into engiyiqaphelile ukungaphathwa kahle kwamalungu eqembu. Indlela okwenzeka ngayo izinto uyabona nje ukuthi lena into yomndeni kanye nabathile. Into ejwayelekile ukuthukwa kwabantu kwiMK."UDlangamandla uthe usebenze ngokuzikhandla kwiMK."Kwakungelula ngesikhathi kusungulwa iMK. Njengomgqugquzeli weqembu esifundeni, ngenza isiqiniseko sokuthi siba nezinhlaka zobuholi kuwo wonke amawadi angu-80 aseMkhanyakude, kanye nakubo bonke omasipala abane abasesifundeni." UDlangamandla uveze ukuthi uselitholile ikhaya elisha."Ngizokwelekelela ithimba leMayibuye eliqokwe uShivambu ukuba liqhube izingxoxo ngokusungulwa kweqembu elisha."UNtombela naye uthe izinqumo ezibalulekile zithathwa abantu abathize. Muva nje, kuputshuke incwadi lapho khona iPhini lomholi weMK, uDkt John Hlophe, belikhalaza ngoNkk Zuma-Sambudla. Kule ncwadi ebhekiswe kumholi weqembu, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, uHlophe usole uNkk Zuma-Sambudla ngokusebenzisa ulimu oluqosheme kanye nangokuphazamisa umhlangano wamalungu eqembu ePhalamende.Okhulumela iMK, uMnuz Nhlamulo Ndhlela, uthe kungenzeka ukuthi incwadi kaHlophe ikokotelwe."Ngimbuzile uHlophe ngesikhathi ngibona incwadi isisabalele ezinkundleni zokuxhumana. Into ayishilo kumina ukuthi ucabanga ukuthi kukhona umuntu ovele wasebenzisa budedengu indlela yakhe yokusayina esebenzisa ezobuchwepheshe. Ingxoxo yethu iphelele lapho." UNdhlela ukuphikile ukuthi kunoqhekeko kumalungu eMK ePhalamende njengoba kunemibiko ethi kukhona abafuna kuxoshwe uSotswebhu weqembu, uNksz Colleen Makhubele.UNdhlela uthe into eyenza kubukeke sengathi kukhona abaphikisana noNksz Makhubele udaba lwempi yaKwa-Israel, wathi iMK yeseka iPalestine kanti uNksz Makhubele yena weseka elaKwa-Israel.

UMatlamela ucelele uNcengwa ukuba ashaywe ngoswazi oluncane, wathi uNcengwa uvele useyidonsile iminyaka eyisishiyagalombili ejele elinde ukuqula leli cala."Siyazi ukuthi isigwebo esincane esinikwa abantu abalahlwa amacala okubulala kuyaye kube udilikajele. Sithanda ukubonga amaphoyisa asebenze ngokuzikhandla."UNgcobo uthe bafuna ukuthi uPhewa anikezwe isigwebo esiqinile. "Sinethemba lokuthi isigwebo azosithola sizokhombisa ubucayi becala alenzile. Wasiphuca umholi owayethandwa abantu. Salahlekelwa wumholi owayebeke eqhulwini ukuthuthukisa abantu. Isigwebo kufanele sithumele umyalezo oqinile kulabo abasoconga abaholi abasebenza ngobuqotho. UWilson, osakaza uhlelo oluthi Sounds and Stuff Like That ngeSonto phakathi kuka-9 ekuseni no-12 emini, uzohlonishwa ngomklomelo iLifetime Achievement Award emcimbini ozoba seGoli ngo-Okthoba kulo nyaka.Sikhuluma neSolezwe Ngempelasonto, lesi silomo sithe lo mklomelo usho izinto eziningi kuso."Uchaza ukuthi ngikwazile ukusebenza ngezipho engiphiwe zona. Ngiyabonga ngamathuba nezinkundla ebenginikezwa zona ukuze lesi sipho sesibenze. Lo mklomelo usho ukuthi imithandazo yami izwakele futhi yaphendulwa," kushaya ngezinqamulelayo lo msakazi oneminyaka ecela ku-40 eyibambile insimbi ishisa endimeni yezokusakaza njengoba aqala ngo-1986. Ukholelwa ukuthi ukusebenza ngokuzikhandla nokuhlale ebhukula yikho okumenza ehlale isikhathi eside futhi engungqaphambili endimeni yokusakaza. Umengameli walo mqhudelwano wezindondo, uSinemivuyo Mpulu, uthe bakuthakasele kakhulu ukuchoma uphaphe lwegwalagwala ingqalabutho esizakhele ugazi kwizinkumbi zabantu. "Lona wumzuzu wokugubha hhayi imisebenzi yakhe kodwa ukubeka kwakhe induku ebandla okusaqhubeka nokukhuthaza abanye abeza ngemuva. Yingakho sifisa ukuhlanganyela nabantu baseNingizimu Afrika ebusukwini obungeke balibaleka," kuphetha uSinemivuyo. UWilson wazalelwa ePiet Retief, eMpumalanga, kodwa wakhulela eSwatini. Ukuba wumsakazi yiphupho elalivele limbusa. Emuva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe, wathola isimemo enhlanganweni yezokusakaza kuleli ukuba enze inhlolokhono njengoba kwakuzokwethulwa iRadio Metro, esiyiMetro FM.Sekungumlando ukuthi uWilson waqashwa futhi akabange esabheka emuva njengoba esenze inqwaba yezinhlelo kulesi siteshi. Usebuya kolwasekuseni nolwantambama. Nakwithelevishini, useke wethula uhlelo oluthi Sidlalela Intsha - Sidlalela Ulusha, Jam Alley neStudio Mix, ebambela uBob Mabena uma esaxinwe ngeminye imisebenzi.Ngaphandle kokusakaza nokunandisa emicimbini, uWilson ubuye asebenze kwinkampani yakhe iWilson B Nkosi Communications njenge-copywriter, abuye abhale futhi adidiyele izikhangiso zemisakazo nezethelevishini. Useneminyaka ecela kwewu-20 esebenza njenge-copywriter enkampanini iJ Walter Thompson. Ezinye izinkampani aseke wasebenza kuzo kubalwa iRubican and Ogilvy neMather. Uyaqhubeka nokusebenzela ezinye izinkampani njengombhali ne-voice over artist ezimele. Ikhono lakhe ligcine selimenza inxusa yeReliable Music Warehouse kangangoba abantu bagcine sebezitshela ukuthi uyena umnikazi wale nkampani yomculo.
KUHLATSHWE ikhwelo kwabadayisa utshwala lokuthi baqinisekise ukuthi babeka phambili ukuphepha kwabantu, bangadayisi utshwala obungumbombayi. Lokhu kushiwo okhulumela inhlangano iNational Liquor's Traders, uMnuz Lucky Ntimane, kulandela ukushaqwa kotshwala obudume ngokuthi wumzambiya obungumbombayi eKlaarwater, eMariannhill, ngasePinetown, ngoLwesibili. Uthe sikhulu isidingo sokusebenzisana phakathi kwemboni yotshwala, imiphakathi kanjalo nezinhlaka zomthetho.Ngokusho kwamaphoyisa, bungabiza inani lasemgwaqweni elingu-R250 000 lobu tshwala bohlobo lweSmirnoff esiwumzambiya esitholwe ngamaphoyisa kulo muzi.UNtimane uthe lokhu kuveza ngokusobala ukuthi sikhulu isidingo sokuthi izinhlaka zibambisane. "Lokhu kuzoqinisekisa ukuthi ziyancishiswa izephulamthetho. Ukuncishiswa kwazo kuzosiza ekutheni kuphele nya ukudayiswa kwalobu tshwala obungafanele,” kusho uNtimane. Uphosele inselelo abanye abahwebi botshwala abasemthethweni ukuthi yibo okufanele bahambe phambili ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi utshwala obudayiselwa umphakathi ngobufanele. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uBrigadier Jay Naicker, uthe amaphoyisa ashaqe utshwala obuwumbombayi obungabiza u-R250 000 eKlaarwater, eMariannhill ngoLwesibili.Udalule ukuthi amaphoyisa abe esebopha owesilisa oneminyaka engu-31, okuthiwa uvele eNkantolo yeMantshi yasePinetown, ngoLwesithathu. Elandisa ngalokhu, uthe amaphoyisa ophiko lweProvincial Organised Crime Unit (Narcotics) elekelelwa awophiko lweProvincial Drug and Firearm Unit kanjalo naweProvincial Counterfeit Goods Unit, athole umkhondo ngokukhiqizwa nokudayiswa kukatshwala obuwumbombayi. "Bathe uma besesha umuzi ebebenikwe umkhondo ngawo, bafica owesilisa oneminyaka engu-31, abavele bambopha khona lapho ngecala lokuphula umthetho katshwala, nowezimpahla ezingombombayi,” kusho uNaicker.Uqinisekise ukuthi babe sebethola utshwala obuwumbombayi obungabiza u-R250 000 uma budayiswa emgwaqweni. UCaptain Carmen Rhynes osophikweni lwezokuxhumana emaphoyiseni esifundeni seTheku, uthe abakalwazi usuku okuhlehlele kulo icala likamsolwa njengoba idokodo lingakabuyi enkantolo. Ucwaningo lwakamuva lweDrinks Federation of South Africa (DF-SA), luveza ukuthi u-18% wabo bonke utshwala obudayiswa kuleli buwumbombayi.
KUKHALWA ngogesi ohamba njalo eSwapo, eCopesville, eMgungundlovu, owesilisa engqongqa nendlu ngoLwesine olwedlule.Lesi sigameko okuthiwa senzeke osukwini lwesibili kuhambe ugesi kule ndawo, sidlule nomphefumulo kaMnuz Vuyolwethu Mpathane (27), ongowokudabuka eMount Ayliff, e-Eastern Cape. Isihlobo sikamufi uMnuz Aphiwe Khumalo, sithe basola ukuthi umlilo othathe impilo yakhe udalwe yikhandlela. "Esinye sezihlobo ebezilele kwelinye ikamelo endlini yesigameko,sithe sifike ekhaya ebusuku, saqaphela ukuthi ukhanyise ikhandlela njengoba ugesi bese kuphele izinsuku ezimbili uhambile,” kusho uKhumalo.Uthe lesi sihlobo siphaphanyiswe wukuzwa ukushisa okuxakile, kwathi uma sivula amehlo, sakhangwa amalangabi ekamelweni likamufi. Uveze ukuthi bazame ngokubambisana nomakhelwane ukucisha umlilo, kodwa kwanhlanga zimuka nomoya ngoba ubusumkhulu kakhulu. Uthe okwenzekile kubaphathe kabi ngoba kuwumphumela kagesi ohluphayo endaweni.Uqhube wathi isidumbu sesihlobo sakhe, akusona esokuqala ukuphuma ngenxa kagesi.Ukhale nangokuthi abazi ukuthi bazothathani bahlanganise nani njengoba kudlule umufi ngokuzuma, obekuthenjelwe kuye. Uthe phakathi kwezinhlelo abafisa ukusizwa ngazo wukuhanjiswa kwesidumbu e-Eastern Cape, ukuhlangatshezwa ngosizo lwezokuthutha ukusuka eMgungundlovu kuyiwa kulesiya sifundazwe kanjalo nomngcwabo.Uphinde wazwakalisa ukuthi bayaludinga usizo lwendlu njengoba le okwenzeke kuyo isigameko, ingqongqile. Ikhansela lendawo uMnuz Sphamandla Madlala lithintwa, lithe liyazi ngodaba, lathi lithumele amakomiti emva kokubikelwa ngalo. "Besishiye umyalezo wokuthi uma sebehlangene njengomndeni, babona ukuthi badinga luphi usizo, basazise, sizobe sesibona ukuthi singenelela kanjani ngezinhlelo zikamasipala ezisiza abantu abasuke behlelwe yinhlekelele yalolu hlobo,” kusho uMadlala.Mayelana nokunikwa usizo lwendawo yokufihla ikhanda, uthe baye baludlulisele emnyangweni wezinhlekelele kumasipala udaba olufuze lolu, bese wona ubona ukuthi ungasiza kanjani."Mayelana nokuhlushwa wugesi ewadini, isimo asisibi kangako uma sisiqhathanisa nakwezinye izindawo. Thina kusuke kuthintekile nje izintambo zikagesi, bese sibiza abawulungisayo, bazolungisa isimo masinyane,” usho kanje.
KUTHIWA uphethe ngokungqongqiswa kwemoto umbango wesikweletu sika-R200 eWaterloo, eVerulam, eThekwini, ngeSonto.Ngokusho kokhulumela iReaction Unit South Africa (RUSA), uMnuz Prem Balram, umgilwa wesifazane okushiswe imoto yakwakhe, utshele abale nkampani yonogada ukuthi ubezihlalele ekhaya lakhe ngesikhathi kufika umakhelwane wesilisa, efuna ngodli u-R200 athe wawubolekwe umyeni wakhe. "Lona wesilisa ube esekhipha isibhamu, esabisa ngokuthi uzodubula umnyango uma imali yakhe ingakhokhwa futhi engavulelwa. Lona wesifazane ube esefonela umyeni wakhe emazisa ngobekwenzeka,” kusho uBalram. Uthe umyeni kalona wesifazane uvele wamkhokhela lona wesilisa obezobasela isikweletu. Uveze ukuthi ubesezitshela ukuthi konke sekudlulile lona wesifazane ngesikhathi lona wesilisa ephinde ebuya emva kwamahora ambalwa, efuna ukungena ngodli endlini. "Kuthe uma abangaphakathi befonela izinhlaka zomthetho, lona wesilisa uvele waya emotweni iVW Jetta ebipake egcekeni, wabulala iwindi, wayishisa imoto,” kusho uBalram.Uthe emva kwalokho, lona wesilisa uqede lapho wakhala amaphepha, wangaphinde wabuya.
KUNGASE kuphothulwe ezinyangeni ezintathu ezizayo ukwakhiwa kwesikole saseMlaza, iMenzi High, esike saphazanyiswa Amadelangokubona isakhiwa.Lokhu kuvele ngesikhathi uMphathiswa wezeMisebenzi yoMphakathi neNgqalasizinda, uMnuz Martin Meyer nozakwabo woMnyango ofanayo eWestern Cape, uMnuz Tertuis Simmers, behambele kulesi sikole eyobheka inqubekela phambili ngokwakhiwa kwaso.Ekhuluma lapha uMeyer, uthe kumqoka kakhulu ukuba kuphothulwe ukwakhiwa kwalesi sikole ngenxa yendima esiyidlalayo kwezemfundo KwaZulu-Natal. Uthe kubuyisa ithemba ukubona umsebenzi uqhubeka ngaphandle kwezinselelo ezike zaba khona ngaphambilini. "Lesi yisikole esenza kahle kakhulu njalo uma kuphuma imiphumela kamatikuletsheni. Ngakho kumqoka ukuba senze konke okusemandleni ukuthi akubi khona lutho okugcine sekubonakala kusikhinyabeza,'' kuchaza uMeyer.Ngaphambi kokuba baye eMenzi, bobabili abaphathiswa bale minyango baqale ngokusayina isivumelwano sokusebenzisana.Ukudaleka kwamathuba omsebenzi, ukubheka kabanzi izindlela ezingcono zokwakhiwa kwezakhiwo ukuze zingakhahlamezeki kalula, ukulwa nenkohlakalo, ngezinye zezinto okuhlalukile ukuthi le minyango izobhunga kabanzi ngazo ngaphansi kwalesi sivumelwano. UMeyer uthe bazoncela kogwansile ngokusebenzisana nalo Mnyango waseWestern Cape.Uthe lokhu kuzobe kudalwa ukuthi banenhloso eyodwa okungukuqinisekisa ukuthi lo Mnyango ubonakala udlondlobala kunokuba ufadabale. Uthe le minyango ngokuhluka kwezifundazwe ibhekene nenselelo efanayo yokukhahlamezeka kwezakhiwo ngenxa yezikhukhula.''Uma sisebenzisana nakanjani kuzoba lula ukuba sihlale phansi siqhamuke nesisombululo sokuthi yini engenziwa ngenhloso yokubhekana nje ngqo nalesi simo. Sikholwa ukuthi ubudlelwane bungaholela ekutheni kube lula ukuxazulula izinkinga ezikhona kulo Mnyango,'' usho kanje. Mayelana nengwadla yenkohlakalo kulo mnyango uthe bakholwa ukuthi sikhona isixazululo abazophuma naso uma sebehlezi phansi sebekhuluma.''Inkinga yenkohlakalo ngenye yezinselelo esizithola sibhekene nayo. Kodwa iqiniso ukuthi kumele siyinqobe njengoba inomthelela ongemuhle ekulethweni kwezidingo kubantu,'' usho kanje.USimmers naye uthe akangabazi ukuthi lesi sivumelwano sizohlomulisa izinhlangothi zombili. Uthe ukusebenzisana kunomthelela omuhle ngaso sonke isikhathi. Ugcizelele ukuthi bakubone kumqoka ukuba basebenzisane, bangazihluphi ngokuthi baqhelelene kangakanani njengoba kuhluke izifundazwe.''Obekumqoka kakhulu ngelesi sivumelwano ukuthi senza umsebenzi ofanayo."Uthe bafisa ukuthi lesi sivumelwane kungabi nje yinto ezophela manje kodwa kube yinto ezobonakala iqhubeka naseminyakeni ezayo."Kunamandla ukusebenzisana ngoba akwenzeki kungabi khona omunye ofunda okuthile komunye. Yilokhu esinesiqiniseko sokuthi kuzobonakala kwenzeka phakathi kwayo yomibili le minyango,'' usho kanje.Uthe bafuna nokubhunga ngezindlela abangazisebenzisa ukuze le minyango idale amathuba omsebenzi.
INDLOVUKAZI yomculo kamaskandi engasekho, uBusi Mhlongo, ngomunye wezingwazi zakuleli ezihlonishwe kwiMayibuye i-Afrika eJoburg Theatre, eGoli ngeSonto. Bekuphela iminyaka ewu-15 uBusi odabuka eNanda, adlula emhlabeni. Le nkakha, ehlonishwe ngezingoma zayo nguZoe Madiga, ikhunjulwe noHugh Masekela, Sibongile Khumalo, Miriam Makeba, Dorothy Masuka nabanye. UZoe ucashunwe ethi kuyisibusiso kuye ukushiyelana inkundla nezihlabani ezisezingeni lomhlaba."Ngokwemvelo umama u(uBusi) Mhlongo wayecula ngezindaba zethu futhi abuye acule ngoxolo." Abanye abaculi ebebesina bededelana bekhumbuza izithameli ngamaqhawe namaqhawekazi asalala, ngoJudith Sephuma, Maleh noBerita.UMaleh ucule amanoni kaSibongile, uBerita wacula akaMiriam Makeba nakaDorothy kwathi uJudith wahlabelela akaLetta Mbulu osadla anhlamvana. UBusi, owashona eneminyaka ewu-62, ubehlanganisa umculo wombhaqanga, umaskandi, amarabi nesigqi se-Afro jazz. Waqale wazibiza ngoVickie ngeminyaka yo-1960 ngaphambi kokuzibiza ngoBusi Mhlongo.Ngo-1970 wafudukela eLondon, e-UK lapho afike waqopha khona nezinkakha ze-jazz, oJulian Bahula noDudu Pokwana. Ngo-1980 wagcina esezungeza umhlaba nenkakha yaseMali, uSalif Keita. Ekuqaleni kuka-1990, uBusi wakhipha i-albhamu yakhe esehamba yedwa elithi Barbentu kwathi ngo-1998 wakhipha icwecwe lesibili elamenza wavelela umhlaba wonke elithi Urban Zulu.Uyena owavumbulula ikhono leShana, eyayihlanganise uBlack Coffee, Shoba noDemor. Ugqozi emculweni wakhe walufakwa wuMntwana uPrincess Magogo, ongunina woMntwana waKwaPhindangene. Wayeshade nomshayi wama-drums, u-Early Mabuza futhi babusiswa ngendodakazi eyodwa, uNompumelelo Elaine Mabuza-Black.
UKHALA ngokubhecwa ngobende inyama engayidlile uMbhishobhi webandla iLiving Well Ministries, elizinze eZimbokodweni eNingizimu yeTheku, osolwa kwiFacebook ngokushona komkakhe nokuthwala ngamalungu omndeni wakhe.Phakathi kwezinsolo ezibhekiswe kuMbhishobhi Sicelo Miya waseMzinyathi eNanda, kubalwa ukuthi waba nesandla ekushoneni komkakhe uMaMchunu ngo-2022 ngoba efuna ukushada nomngani kamufi agcine emgane ngo-Okthoba ngonyaka odlule.Uphinde asolwe ngokuthwala ngamalungu omndeni wakhe, phakathi kwawo okukhona nomfowabo okuthiwa babesanda kuxabana naye owabulawa ngokudutshulwa. Izinsolo ziqhuba zithi ngisho sekushone unina, wancengwa ukuba aye emngcwabeni kwathi emva kwalokho wosa inyama ejabulela ukushona kwakhe. Uphinde anukwe ngokushona kwezingane zakhe ezintathu ayezithole kuMaMchunu, ukuhlukumeza umufi esaphila ngokumshaya ngeketanga nokuhamba izinyanga. Zonke lezi zinsolo zivela kwiFacebook ngaphansi kwegama likaBongi Madida, nokho osezisusile.UMiya usola uNksz Nosihle Mchunu, ozalwa udadewabo kamufi, ngokubhala lezi zinsolo kwiFacebook esebenzisa igama likaBongi Madida emva kokuxoxa namanye amalungu omndeni wakhe athe kukhona kuwo nomuntu omdala. Eziphendulela uMiya, uthe uyafisa ukwazi ukuthi zisukelaphi izinsolo nokuthi uthwale nini ngoba amanye amalungu omndeni kamufi abehlala kwakhe futhi evakasha ngisho engasekho."UNosihle nje ukhulele phambi kwami kwaze kwaba uyakhulelwa, ngamthatha ngoba uyise edinwe wukukhulelwa kwakhe. Ngiyamangala ukuthi babengakuboni ngani konke lokhu asebekusho manje ukuthi ngingumbulali nosikhotheni." Uthe inkinga iqale emva kokushadelwa wunkosikazi omusha, uMaNtshangase, ababambisene naye emsebenzini wesonto. Uthe uMaNtshangase akaze abe wumngani kamufi, babehlanganiswa wumsebenzi wesonto kwazise bebekhonza ndawonye.Uthe eyokuthandana kwakhe noMaNtshangase yaqala ngo-Agasti nyakenye. Uqhube wathi konke okwenziwa emva kokudlula komuntu emhlabeni wakwenza ngisho nokwembulwa kwetshe lomkakhe lesikhumbuzo sakhe. Mayelana nomfowabo owabulawa, uthe umbulali wakhe waboshwa waze wagwetshwa.Emngcwabeni kanina uthe wayengeke akwazi ukuya ngoba kwakunezinkinga emndenini kwaze kwangenelela uninalume noMaMchunu wagcina eyile kodwa eyokosa inyama akayazi. "Ukubulawa komuntu wesifazane eNingizimu Afrika kuyinto ethathelwa phezulu. Njengoba bethi ngangishaya umkami ngeketanga, kungani ngingaboshwanga ngoba kuyicala elibomvu ukuhlukumeza abesifazane?"UMiya uthe usola ukuthi enye imbangela yalezi zinsolo wukuthi waphuca udadewabo kamufi imoto ayemdayisele yona ngoba engasakhokhi. Uzichithile nezinsolo zokuthi uhamba izinyanga. Uveze ukuthi usevulele uNosihle icala emaphoyiseni."Ngiyafisa ukwazi ukuthi sezivelaphi zonke lezi zinsolo ngoba nomlamu wami wazi konke besinaye kugula udadewabo kwaze kwaba uyashona. Wathini umbiko kadokotela ngembangela yokushona kwakhe?" kubuza yena. Ethintwa uNosihle, uthe kade ayemtshela uMbhishobhi Miya ukuthi akazani nalezi zinsolo nokuthi akusiyena uBongi Madida obhale kwiFacebook."Angazani nalesi zinsolo, umkhulu (uMiya) besimthatha njengobaba. Eyokuthwala ngiyizwe kwiFacebook, ukuba bekunjalo ngabe kade sabona ngoba besihlala naye," kusho uNosihle othe useze wamvala uMbhishobhi Miya ocingweni lwakhe ngoba umthumelela imiyalezo emthuka. Ubuze ukuthi kungani angaphenyi ngalo Bongi Madida, kwazise ubuchwepheshe buyakwazi ukuveza umsuka wezinto ezibhalwa ezinkundleni zokuxhumana."Uma esetholile ukuthi angiyena uBongi Madida uyobuya yini ezoxolisa kimi? Ngibona ukuthi umuntu owenza lezi zinsolo wazi konke ngaye, mhlawumbe usesontweni lakhe noma usondelene naye."Uthe okwenzekayo akumkhathazi ngoba uMbhishobhi Miya wazisholo yena ukuthi akukho osekubahlanganisa.
IHLABE ikhwelo i-EFF KwaZulu-Natal ukuthi ukubulawa ngesihluku kowesifazane obesebenza kuMasipala waKwaDukuza, kungagcini ngokwengeza izinombolo zabalahlekelwa yimpilo yabo ebugebengwini kodwa kwenziwe okuthile ngesigameko.UNksz Nokulunga Mashabane (32) ongowokuzalwa KwaMshibe KwaMaqumbi, KwaMaphumulo, utholwe ebulewe emotweni yakhe, iHyundai Creta SUV, emgwaqweni ongaseZinkwazi, phakathi kweKwaDukuza neMandeni.Kuthiwa ubulawe ngokudutshulwa kanti abafike kuqala endaweni yesigameko kuthiwa bathi uficwe ephangalalele esihlalweni somshayeli, kwangathathwa lutho. Ushona nje, ubeseyimenenja ye-Intergovernmental Relations and Protocol, ehhovisi lemeya yalo masipala, okuthiwa waqala ukusebenza kuwo ngo-2019.USihlalo we-EFF KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Mongezi Twala, uthe isigameko sokubulawa kukaNksz Mashabane ngesihluku, kuyisikhumbuzo sokuthi sibi kangakanani isihlava sokubulawa kwabesifazane ngesihluku. "Sithi akwenziwe uphenyo olunzulu ngokuholele ekutheni umufi abulawe. Ubulungiswa kufanele benzeke masinyane, kuthi labo abathintekayo, babhekane nengalo yomthetho,” kusho uTwala. Esitatimendeni esikhishwe uMasipala waKwaDukuza, iMeya uMnuz Ali Ngidi, uthe izindaba zokufa kukaNksz Mashabane ngesihluku zethuse wonke umuntu.Uthe bebekade begcinane ngayizolo, komunye wemicimbi ebiyenziwe umasipala, wathi bebevumelene ngokuthi bazobonana komunye obuhlelelwe uLwesihlanu."Emva kokuthola umbiko wokushona kwakhe, angibange ngisaba nawo amandla okuya kuwo futhi ngivele ngahlehlisa zonke izinhlelo ebenginazo zosuku,” kusho uNgidi. Umchaze njengomuntu wesifazane obemnene, ehlonipha futhi esebenza ngokuzikhandla. "Ubemnene ngendlela yokuthi ubengeke abulale ngisho impukane yize kunjalo, ubulawe ngesihluku,” usho kanje.Ube esexwayisa labo asebeqalile ukuqagela ngokubulawa kwakhe ukuthi abadedele amaphoyisa enze umsebenzi wawo ngale kokuphazanyiswa. Udlulise amazwi enduduzo emndenini, abangani, izihlobo, kanjalo nozakwabo. Khonamanjalo: Ushonele endaweni yesigameko omunye wesifazane, odutshulwe ngabantu abangaziwa ngoyaba lwezinhlamvu eZindlovini, eNdwedwe, ngoMgqibelo.Ngokuthola kweSolezwe, lona wesifazane kuthiwa ubengusomabhizinisi kanti ubesebudlelwaneni bezothando nowesilisa ongusomatekisi. Ngokusho kokhulumela inkampani yonogada iReaction Unit South Africa (Rusa), uMnuz Prem Balram, umufi uthelekelwe abasolwa ngesikhathi ehamba ngeVW Tiguan yakhe emgwaqweni uP100. "Onogada bethu babizwe endaweni yesigameko umphakathi ngesikhathi imoto kamufi, igingqika, iyolala ngokhakhayi emzini womuntu oseduze nomgwaqo ehlaselelwe kuwo,” kusho uBalram."Oshaye ucingo uqinisekise ukuthi kukhona owesifazane oyedwa ovaleleke ngaphakathi emotweni, wathi abanaso isiqiniseko sokuthi ulimele kangakanani,” kusho uBalram. Uthe ngesikhathi befika endaweni yesigameko, abezimo eziphuthumayo beRusa, bambhekile lona wesifazane, bathola ukuthi usephangalele. "Umzimba wakhe ubumbobombobo yizinhlamvu,” kusho uBalram, othe kutholwe amagobolondo ezinhlamvu ayishumi endaweni yesigameko.Sishicilele amaphoyisa engaphendulanga ngalezi zehlakalo.
KUSHINTSHE izinhlelo zomhlangano kaJulayi zamaNazaretha aseThembezinhle aholwa yiNkosi Phinda "UKukhanyakwelanga" Shembe, njengoba esamisiwe ukusebenzisa indawo abeyithengile ukubambela kuyo uJulayi.Emasontweni adlule Isolezwe libike ukuthi abaseThembezinhle bathenge indawo epulazini eNtanda, eNdwedwe, abebezobambela kuyo umhlangano kaJulayi ongena kusasa. Phambilini le ndawo ibisetshenziswa yizintombi zaseBuhleni uma kuqala umhlangano ukukha izintingo ebezihanjiswa kumholi walolu hlangothi, iNkosi Mduduzi "UNyazilwezulu" Shembe.Ngokuthengwa kwale ndawo okwakuwumuzi weNkosi Johannes Galile "iLanga" Shembe, obizwa ngeBethlehem Judiya, bese kusho ukuthi abaseBuhleni ngeke besakwazi ukuyisebenzisa njengoba kungena uJulayi. Leli phephandaba lithole ukuthi abaseThembezinhle basamisiwe ukusebenzisa le ndawo ngoba kushoda okuthile esivumelwaneni sokuthengiselana. Uthe lokhu akusho ukuthi indawo akuseyona eyabo kodwa bazoma okwamanje ukuyisebenzisa ngesikhathi kusalungiswa eyesitifiketi. USibisi uthe umnikazi wepulazi ubathembisile ukuthi uzozama ukukulungisa ngokushesha lokhu nakuba kuye kuthathe isikhathi eside."Nakuba sekwenzekile lokhu kodwa akusho ukuthi uJulayi awusekho, sizoba nawo ngoba sinezindawo eziningi esingazisebenzisa." Uthe umhlangano kaJulayi bazowubambela eThembezinhle."Konke kumi ngomumo ngomhlangano kaJulayi yikho nje ukuthi ngeke sisawubambela eBethlehem Judiya okuyindawo enomlando kithina. INkosi ithe abantu mabaphume ngobuningi ukuya kuJulayi njengoba bebezobe bephumile eNtanda," kusho uSibisi egcizelela ukuthi ubudlelwano babo no-Armstrong busebuhle akukho okushintshile.Ngakolunye uhlangothi, uMnuz Thokozani Mncwabe okhulumela abaseBuhleni, uthe sebemi ngomumo ukuqala uJulayi nezintombi sezikulungele ukuya eNtanda. "Umkhumbi wezintombi uyanyuka noma yikanjani, simema wonke umuntu njengoba kungena umdedele mhla ka-1 Julayi," kusho uMncwabe.
ATHUSE abaningi amanye amagama abaholi abathenjwayo kwiMK nakwi-EFF avele ethimbeni elizohola izinhlelo zobengunobhala jikelele weMK, uMnuz Floyd Shivambu, zokuqala iqembu elisha.Amalungu eMK ne-EFF athi noma abekulindele ukuthi uShivambu uzotheze emaqenjini awo kodwa abengakulindele ukuthi uzolandelwa nangabaholi abaqavile, abanye babo abebenezikhundla eziphezulu emaqenjini abasuka kuwona.Ithimba lesikhashana elizohola izingxoxo zokuba kufanele yini uShivambu asungule iqembu elisha limenyezelwe ngoLwesihlanu. UGoge naye ukhona ebuholini beMK. Ngiyambona uMkhathini (Khoza) ngoba vele ubesehleli ekhaya. Ipolitiki izokumangaza ngempela. Kusho ukuthi abantu sebebheke izikhundla." Ekhuluma nabezindaba, uShivambu uthe ukujoyina kwabaholi abaningi abasuka kwiMK kukhombisa ukuthi baningi abangajabule ngokwenzekayo kuleli qembu elisanda kumkhipha esikhundleni."Yebo, baningi abantu abasuka kwiMK kuleli thimba lesikhashana esilimemezele namhlanje. Kusho ukuthi abanelisekile ngokwenzeka kuleliya qembu. Abantu babenethemba lokuthi iMK izokuba iqembu elizolwela, livale isikhala se-ANC. Ngisho nabantu abasele kwiMK abaneme."UShivambu wakhishwa kwesikanobhala jikelele weMK ngoba nakhu esolwa ngokuthi ufuna ukuketula umholi weqembu, uMnuz Jacob Zuma. UShivambu uthe sebeqalile ukuzizwa izigi zakhe abeMK.Uthe uZuma uzame kaningi ukuxhumana naye kusukela amemezela izinhlelo zokuqala iqembu elisha. "Ngebhadi ngimatasa kabi kulezi zinsuku, ngizombona uma sengiqede izingxoxo." UShivambu uthe balindele ukujoyinwa abantu abaqhamuka emaqenjini ahlukene ngokuhamba kwesikhathi."Baningi abantu esixoxa nabo njengamanje. Kukhona ngisho abangamakhansela abafuna ukusula ezikhundleni. Abantu bafuna ikhaya elisha. Iqiniso ukuthi abantu abasayethembi i-ANC, MK ne-EFF. Lawo ke amaqembu amakhulu aphethwe abantu abamnyama."Khonamanjalo: UShivambu uphinde waxolisa kokhulumela iMK, uMnuz Nhlamulo Ndhlela, amsola ngokuba umlutha wotshwala nezidakamiza. UShivambu uthe ithimba elihola izingxoxo limluleke ngokuthi axolise aphinde ahoxise izinsolo azenza ngoNdhlela.UNdhlela ofuna ukuba uShivambu amhlawule ngo-R3 million, uthe uzoqhubeka necala, wathi akwanele ukuxolisa kukaShivambu.
UNGOTI ufanise i-DA nenja engenamazinyo njengoba iphinde yakhetha ukuhlala kuhulumeni wokubambisana yize ithi ayijabule kulo mshado.Umhlaziyi wezepolitiki waseNyuvesi yaKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Zakhele Ndlovu, uthe i-DA iyogcina ngokusonga, ngeke iphume kuhulumeni wokubambisana.Umholi weDA, uMnuz John Steenhuisen, umemezele ukuthi bazoqhubeka nokuhlala kuhulumeni wokubambisana yize bebona bedelelekile. I-DA ibinqumele uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ugwayi katiki, yamyalela ukuba axoshe bonke ongqongqoshe abalandelwa yiphunga lenkohlakalo.I-DA ibikhiphe lo myalelo emva kokuba uRamaphosa exoshe ilungu layo, uMnuz Andrew Whitfield, kwesokuba yiphini likangqongqoshe wezoHwebo, iziMboni, nokuNcintisana.UWhitfield uxoshelwe ukuhambela izwe elingaphandle engagunyaziwe wuRamaphosa. UNdlovu uthe:"Bayasaba ukuthi uma bephuma kuhulumeni wokubambisana kuzongena amahlubuka e-ANC. Ukuphuma kwabo kuzovulela umnyango iMK ne-EFF. Bayazi ukuthi uma kungangena labo kuzobhubhudlwa imali. Yingakho nje bezogcina nje ngakho ukusabisa. Kuyoze kufike ukhetho oluzayo belokhu besabisa ngokuphuma kuhulumeni wokubambisana."UNdlovu uthe iDA ngeke isifake isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaRamaphosa."Bancamela yena kubaholi be-ANC, uyena ababona kusebenzeka naye. Uma bemkhipha yena kuzongena bani? UMashatile (iphini likamengameli)? Phela uMashatile uyena oyiphini likaRamaphosa. Le zinto abazishoyo bamane bayazisho nje ngoba bafuna ukuthusa uRamaphosa." Unobhala jikelele we-ANC uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, uthe abazigqizi qakala izinsongo zeDA.UMbalula uthe bazoqhubeka nokuphatha ngisho noma iDA ingenzani.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ethula inkulumo yokuvala ingqungquthela yokukhethwa kobuholi be-ANC esifundeni i-OR Tambo, e-Eastern Cape. UMbalula uthe bayaseseka isinqumo sikaRamaphosa sokuxosha uWhitfield."Umengameli akufanele avumele ukudelelwa wumfana omncane, odelela ngoba nakhu ethembe ukuthi uzokhulunyelwa yiDA. Abahambe uma bethanda, baningi abalinde emnyango abafuna ukungena. Sithe abasheshise balethe igama lomuntu ozovala isikhala soxoshiwe."Ukhale ngokuthi kuzobashaya ukuzimela kweSACP okhethweni oluzayo lohulumeni basekhaya.

"Sinezinhlelo ezehlukene zokulekela abantu abasha. Sibalekelela ngoba siyakuqonda ukuthi izwe lidinga abantu abasha ukuze libe nenqubekela phambili," usho kanje. Sengenze izinto eziningi ukusiza la kudingeka khona njengoba ngisethimbeni elaziwa ngeResearch Associate, eNyuvesi yaseJohannesburg futhi ngaphinde ngafaka isandla emikhankasweni yezinkampani ezifana noMcDonald's ukuze senze ushintsho empilweni yabantu abehlukene. Ngiyakholelwa ekutheni ngingomunye wabantu abakhulise umkhakha wamabhizinisi kuleli ngokwenza izinto ezehlukene ezithinta abantu,” kuchaza yena.Uthe ukuthola iziqu zebhizinisi azenza eWharton Business School, e-University of Pennsylvania kudale ukuthi aphinde azakhele igama emkhakheni wokudayisa, owezimayini, wamafilimu, wokubhala, wokusiza abantu nowokusebenza kwezemfundo. "Iphupho lami ukusiza la kudingeka khona, ikakhulukazi ebantwini abazaziyo ukuthi bafunani. Mina ukuzibona ngila ngikhona yingoba nganginomqondo obheke entweni oyifunayo futhi ngizimisele ukuyenza. Njengomphathi wenkampani eyenza izinto ezehlukene ekudayiseni, udinga ukuhlanganisa lokhu ofuna ukusebenza ngakho, udayise bese uqinisekisa ukuthi uyalifezekisa iphupho lakho lokudayisa ukuze wenze inzuzo."Uthe:"Ibhizinisi kumele uliyise ebantwini owaziyo ukuthi lizohambisana nabo. Inkantolo yeSifunda e-Vryheid igwebe u-Innocent Fanyane Dubazane (51) udilikajele ngecala lokubulala uNonsikelelo Nqobile Xaba (45) ngoFebhuwari 2024 eMondlo. Umufi nommangalelwa babethanda kodwa beyifihlele imindeni yabo.Ngo-8 Febhuwari 2024 kwatholakala isidumbu sikamufi sidindilize emseleni e-C section eMondlo. Isidumbu sasigoqwe ngengubo yokulala nesaka eliwufefe. Isidumbu sasigqokile kodwa singazifakile izicathulo. Kwaqapheleka ukuthi umufi wayeshawe kanzima ngento thizeni. Umufi wayengumuntu owayaziwa endaweni nokwenza kwaba lula ukumhlonza.Uphenyo lwamaphoyisa lwaveza ukuthi wayegcine ukubonakala endlini kaDubazane enaye. UDubazane wathathwa wayophenywa kwakhona izinto azivumayo ezimyamanisa nokubulala. Ngesikhathi kuqhubeka uphenyo kwatholakala izicathulo zikamufi zinegazi zisongiwe endlini yangasese engaphandle. Amaphoyisa aqaphela umzila owawudwebeke phansi emuva kwendlu. Umzila wawubheke ngalapho okwatholwa khona isidumbu. Ingubo yokulala kwakungeyakwaDubazane kanti isafa eliwufefe kwakungelomfowabo ayehlala naye. UMshushisi u-Andre Symington ubize ofakazi abaqinisekisa ukuthi izicathulo ezatholakala kwaDubazana ezikamufi. Ufakazi ongowakubo kaDubazane wafakaza ngengubo yokulala okwakusongwe ngayo umufi. Kwabizwa umphenyi wecala nephoyisa elabopha ummangalelwa nabo bafakaza.Ufakazi wakubo kaDubazane ufakaze ukuthi wabona ummangalelwa nomufi bendawonye ngaphambi kwesigameko. Unkosikazi kafakazi, ongasekho emhlabeni wathi yena wezwa ukuhilizisana wabikela umyeni wakhe. USymington ekhonga isigwebo esiqinile, utshele inkantolo ukuthi amacala afana nalawa adla lubi eNingizimu Africa. Uthe ummangalewa waba nesihluku futhi akakhombisi ukuzisola.Inkantolo ithole ukuthi umufi nommangalelwa babenobudlelwano basekhaya. Inkantolo ithe ayisiboni isizathu sokuchezuka ekukhipheni isigwebo esibekiwe okuwudilikajele.UDubazane ugwetshwe udilikajele futhi inkantolo ithe akafanelwe wukuba nemvume yokuphatha isibhamu.
INDLUNKULU kaZulu igubuzelwe yifu elimnyama njengoba kudlule emhlabeni insika eyeseka iSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini.UNdlunkulu uThoko Ntombela Zulu, udlule emhlabeni ngesonto eledlule.UNdlunkulu wakwaNxangiphilile ungomunye wezingwevu zasendlunkulu ebezilokhu zisemuva kweSilo kusukela sangena esihlalweni. Ubehlezi ebonakala ehamba noNdlunkulu uMavis Zungu Zulu emihlanganweni yasendlunkulu.UNdlunkulu ubegane owayeyibamba bukhosi bukaZulu,uMntwana uMcwayizeni kaSolomon.UMntwana uMcwayizeni waba yibamba bukhosi ngaphambi kokuba kungene esihlalweni iSilo uGoodwill Zwelithini kaBhekuzulu. UMntwana uMcwayizeni wayeyilungu lePhalamende elimele i-ANC.Ubuholi be-ANC KwaZulu-Natal nakuzwelonke budlulise amazwi enduduzo ngokuguqa kukaNdlunkulu.Okhulumela i-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Fanle Sibisi, uthe uNdlunkulu ubambe iqhaza elibalulekile ekukhuthazeni intsha ukuba izigqaje ngobuzwe bayo. "Ubengakuthandi ukukhuluma kodwa ubekwazi ukufundisa ngendlela yakhe ehlukile. Ubehlezi ekhuthaza intsha ukuba ingakhohlwa lapho iphuma khona, ingawalahli amasiko nokuthi iziqhenye ngobuzwe bayo. Besifunda okuningi kuNdlunkulu."USibisi uthe akulahlekelwe indlunkulu kaZulu kuphela kodwa wathi isizwe sonke silahlekelwe."Simethulela isigqoko njengoba ebehlezi egqugquzela ukuthula. Baningi abantu abafunde lukhulu kuye." Okhulumela i-ANC kuzwelonke, uNkk Mahlengi Bhengu-Motsiri, uthe uNdlunkulu wakhombisa ubuholi ngesikhathi ema noMntwana uMcwayizeni ngezikhathi ezinzima."Ngalesi sikhathi uMntwana kwakufanele abhekane nomsebenzi wasendlunkulu aphinde abhekane nempi yokulwela inkululeko."UNkk Bhengu-Motsiri uthe ukuguqa kukaNdlunkulu kuthunuka izilonda ezingakapholi.Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kokhulumela iSilo, uMntwana uThulani Zulu, ayizange iphumelele.
AZOBE ephume ngezinkani amalungu e-ANC Youth League (ANCYL), ecaleni lokubulawa kowayengunobhala jikelele walolu phiko, uMnuz Sindiso Magaqa. Amalungu e-ANCYL eholwa uMengameli wawo, uMnuz Collen Malatji, azozifikela mathupha eNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu, namhlanje. Inkantolo kulindeleke igwebe inkabi evume ukusoconga uMagaqa, uSibusiso Ncengwa. UNobhala Jikelele we-ANCYL, uMnuz Mntuwoxolo Ngudle, uthe bafuna ukuthi uNcengwa athole isigwebo esimfanele."Icala selifike esigabeni esibalulekile. Sekuseduze ukuba sithole ubulungiswa. Iqiniso ukuthi salahlekelwa omunye wethu. Ukuhambela kukaMalatji icala kukhombisa ngokusobala ukuthi sizimisele ngokuthola ubulungiswa."UNgudle unxuse abantu ukuba baphume ngobuningi babo. Ubuholi be-ANCYL esifundeni iMoses Mabhida bumemezele ukuthi buzokuba nombhikisho ngaphandle kwenkantolo.UMagaqa wadutshulwa ngo-2017, ebuya emhlanganweni wamakhansela.Ngesikhathi esocongwa wayeyikhansela kuMasipala waseMzimkhulu. Kuthiwa wabulawelwa ukukhononda ngenkohlakalo eyayenzeka kulo mkhandlu.UNcengwa, ongumsolwa wesine kuleli cala, wagonyuluka ngokuba ingxenye yetulo lokusoconga uMagaqa.Ekuvumeni kwakhe icala, uNcengwa waninda abanye abasolwa kanye nabantu abangaboshiwe kuleli cala. Waveza ukuthi bahlukaniselana u-R120 000 emva kokudubula uMagaqa.UNcengwa wathi wabuye wathola ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ukuthi empeleni imali ababeyikhokhelwe ngokubulala uMagaqa kwakungu-R600 000.UNcengwa wabuye wavuma necala lokuzama ukubulala ababengamakhansela ngaleso sikhathi, uNksz Jabulile Msiya noNksz Nonsikelelo Mafa, ababehamba noMagaqa mhla edutshulwa. UNcengwa waphinde wavuma necala lokuzama ukubulala uMnuz Nceba Mazongolo, owayedlula ngendlela mhla kudutshulwa uMagaqa.Kuleli cala uNcengwa uboshwe kanye noMnuz Sibonelo Myeza, Mbulelo Mpofana, noMlungisi Ncalane.UNcalane kwatholakala ukuthi akakulungele ukubhekana necala ngenxa yokuphazamiseka emqondweni.UMyeza noMpofana bona bayaqhubeka nokuphika icala, kanti icala labo lizoqulwa ngo-Okthoba.
YIZE inkakha yomlingisi, uDelisile Malinga, izakhele ugazi ngokulingisa indawo kaThenjiwe MaMzobe Gumede kuMkhokha:The Curse kodwa sekuphele izinyanga eziyisishiyagalolunye ingalingisi ndawo. Nakuba kunjalo, uDelisile oseneminyaka eminingi eyibambile insimbi ishisa kulo mkhakha, uthe akakhathazekile kangako ngoba usekujwayele lokhu. Ekhuluma kwiYouTube Channel ayiqambe ngegama lakhe ngempelasonto, uDelisile (59) uthe yena ubeqala ngqa ngoMkhokha ukulingisa indawo eqavile, nemdlalisa isikhathi eside kwaze kwaba lo mdlalo ufinyelela emaphethelweni. "Uma ungathi uyabheka ukuthi ngiqale nini ukulingisa, ngineminyaka engaphezu kuka-35 kule ndima. Bengilokhu ngilingisa impilo yami yonke. Bengilokhu ngisebenza izinsuku ezintathu laphaya. Ngithole ezinhlanu laphaya." Uthe umsebenzi ake asebenza izinyanga eziyithupha kwakuyiGenerations, nakhona ewumlingisi owayebizwa uma edingeka i-call actor. "Yini i-call actor, umuntu oholelwa ngalezo zinsuku abizwe ngazo ukuzoshutha. Bengilokhu ngiphila njengomlingisi. Niyabona ukuthi kunzima kanjani? Bengiqala ngoMkhokha ukuthola isivumelwano (sesikhathi eside)."Yize kusemnyama okwamanje kodwa akanalo ukhwantalala ngoba wangena azi kahle ukuthi kulo mkhakha usebenza namhlanje, ungangeni kusasa.Uthe okumenza akhulume kanje yingoba efuna ukuqwashisa ozakwabo abathe beqala babe bethola umsebenzi isikhathi eside. "Ngiyajabula uma ngingasebenzi ngoba angikhathazeki futhi angibi nokhwantalala. Uma ngingasebenzi ngithi 'Akunankinga. Oh sekuyiso leso sikhathi, angisebenzi. Angigxile kwezinye izinto. Umsebenzi uzobuya futhi," kuchaza uDeli.Uke wacela iminikelo ngesikhathi eqokwe kumaLadies In Media Awards eKenya, ngoMashi, wakulo nyaka. Ekhuluma neSolezwe wakubeka kwacaca ukuthi akanamali ngenxa yokuthi wayegcine ukuhola ngo-Okthoba. Sekungumlando ukuthi uDelisile wagcina eyile kulo mqhudelwano wezindondo ngenxa yokuxhaswa futhi wafike wahlabana ngomklomelo we-African Female Actor of the Year, ngendawo kaThenjiwe MaMzobe Gumede kuMkhokha. Selokhu uDelisile aqala ukulingisa ngo-1989, usedlale emidlalweni eminingi okubalwa kuyo iGenerations enguSarah futhi enguNtombizodwa kwiRhythm City.Ngaphandle kwale midlalo, ubuye walingisa kwiNkaba, Isibaya, Greed & Desires, The Queen, Broken Vows, Durban Gen, Gaz'lam, Home Affairs, Imbewu, Jacob's Cross, Jozi Streets, Lingashoni, Mfolozi Street, Redemption, Saints & Sinners, Shaka Ilembe, Skeem Saam nakwi Single Girls.
ASENGAMATHE nolimu amaqembu esicathamiya abeyinkukhu nempaka, iZulu Messengers yaKwaHlabisa neRoyal Messengers yaKwaNongoma. Ukuheleza komoya wokuthula phakathi kwala maqembu kucace bha okwekati elimnyama ohlungwini ngesikhathi kubonakala amalungu eZulu Messengers enandisa ndawonye naweRoyal Messengers emcimbini obusehholo lomphakathi waseMagabheni, eThekwini ngempelasonto.Ebuzwa ngale ngqophamlando, umholi weZulu Messengers, uSkhumbuzo "Mavulakuvaliwe" Mhlongo, uthe wahlala phansi nomholi weRoyal Messengers, uMbhekiseni "MaSuprise" Khumalo ngokuba bangabe besaqhubeka nokungcofana ngezingoma."Ngamtshela ukuthi mina ukungcofana nabo akungisebenzeli, ngathi yena engaqhubeka nakho uma kumsebenzela," kusho uMavulakuvaliwe. Uthe wagcina ukungcofana noMaSuprise ema-albhamini amadala. "Kusukela kwi-albhamu ethi Iyatelebhela Injomane, Umthwalo Uzethule, Indod' Eqotho nethi Unontandakubukwa, bengingasangcofi muntu."Echaza ngokubonakala kwamalungu akhe ecula neRoyal Messengers, uMavulakuvaliwe uthe kuqale nyakenye emcimbini owawuseYMCA."Kwasuka amalungu eRoyal Messengers akhwela esteji, acula nathi." UMaSurpise uthe lolu bumbano nozwano lusho ukukhula emculweni wesicathamiya. "Nami kunginike ukuthi la malungu asefike kuleli qembu lomkhaya ayawuqonda umdlalo wezinsizwa. Kusho ukuthi zehlukile ngokucabanga ngalo mdlalo womculo, azifani njengalezi ebezicula ngaphambili kumkhaya. Lokhu kusho ukuthi basazojabula abalandeli bethu nomkhaya ngoba bahlezi beyifisa le nto abayibone ngempelasonto, eMagabheni lapho ezami zithole khona unombolo 2."Eqhuba uMaSuprise uthe namanje abantu bayafona futhi bayancoma ngesenzo somkhaya kanye nezami ngokudlela ogqokweni linye. Uthe lo moya wokuzwana usazoqhubeka kakhulu ezinsizweni eziphuza iMona neziphuza iMpelwanyane."Kusangenzeka nangale mpelasonto njengoba iRoyal Messengers izobe inandisa eYMCA," kuphetha uMaSuprise othe usemalungiselweni okukhipha unqambothi lwe-albhamu kulo nyaka. Impi yamazwi phakathi kweZulu Messengers neRoyal Messengers beyishube ngale ndlela yokuthi iZulu Messengers yake yasikaza ukushiya emahholo ngoba sekukhona nokunukana phakathi kwabo.
WONKE amehlo asethe njo emlandweni ozoqopheka kwi-Ayanda Ntanzi One Man Show eMoses Mabhida Stadium eThekwini ngoJulayi 12. Amathikithi aseqalile ukuthengwa ubuthaphuthaphu okwamagwinya ashisayo ebhakawozi ezitolo ezidayisa amathikithi. U-Ayanda uthembisa lukhulu kwabazohambela le ngqophamlando. Uthe ufuna ukuqopha umlando ngokuba wumculi wokuqala wokholo ukugcwalisa phama le nkundla. "Lo mlando akusiwo owami kodwa owabaculi bonke abacula owokholo njengoMbuso kaNkulunkulu." Uthe abantu abazitshela ukuthi uzophinda izingoma abezicula nyakenye bashaye phansi ngoba uzobe eqhulula amanoni amasha. Ezingomeni okufanele zilindelwe yizithameli kukhona nethi Wangifela Wangihlenga.Kuzokhunjulwa ukuthi u-Ayanda wagila izimanga e-ICC eThekwini, lapho ama esiteji amahora amane ejabulisa abalandeli bakhe ngezingoma ezehlukene."Ngikubheke ngabomvu ukuthi ngihlangane nabalandeli abaphuma ezindaweni ezehlukene njengoba ngifuna ukuzojabula nabo ngalolu suku. Umcimbi lona engiwenza ngenhloso yokuhlangana nabo, sijabulele izingoma zami ezindala nezintsha futhi ngiyobe ngiqopha i-albhamu yami yesihlanu. Kodwa ngibheke phambili ukuthi babone nezinye izinto, ngiyawuthanda umcimbi oseqophelweni eliphezulu, isiteji sami nje sisodwa siyobe sixoxa indaba,” kuchaza yena. Uthe amathikithi ayatholakala eWebticket kusuka ku-R250, R350 no-R1000.Ukuzibeka ethubeni lokuziwinela amathikithi okuba yingxenye yale ndumezulo yomcimbi. Thumela igama elithi "ISOAYANDA" ku-33258, i-SMS ibiza R1.50. Abawinile bazokwaziswa ngocingo. Umncintiswano uzovalwa ngoMsombuluko, 30 Juni, ngo-8 ekuseni.

SIBHEKWE ngabomvu isigwebo esizogixabezwa inkabi egonyuluke ngokusoconga owayengunobhala jikelele we-ANC Youth League, uMnuz Sindiso Magaqa.Umndeni kaMagaqa uthe ufuna ukuthi athole isigwebo esiqinile umsolwa wesine ecaleni, uSibusiso Ncengwa.UNcengwa uzovela eNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu, ngoMsombuluko, lapho ezogwetshwa khona.UNcengwa waqale waliphika icala lokubulawa kukaMagaqa.Mumva nje uNcengwa ushaye ungqimphothwe, walivuma leli cala elenzeka ngo-2017.Njengamanje icala likaNcengwa selihlukanisiwe nelabanye abasolwa bona abasaqhubekayo nokuliphika.Umfowabo kaMagaqa, uMnuz Lwazi Magaqa, uthe bafisa ukuthi uNcengwa anikezwe isigwebo esimfanele."Uma ngikhuluma ngesigwebo esimfanele siyazi ukuthi lapha eNingizimu Afrika umuntu olahlwa yicala lokubulala ugwetshwa udilikajele. Uzivumele yena icala ngakho ke sifisa ukuthi inkantolo imnikeze isigwebo esifanele."ULwazi uthe noma uNcengwa engathola isigwebo esikhulu kangakanani lokho ngeke kuzipholise izilonda ezisabhibhayo emndenini ngokusocongwa kukaMagaqa. "Bukhulu ubuhlungu esibuzwile siwumndeni. Impilo ngeke iphinde ifane noma inkantolo ingenzani. Noma ngabe yisiphi isigwebo azosithola ngeke simbuyise umfowethu."UNcengwa uvele udonsa isigwebo seminyaka engu-95 ngaphakathi ejele, walahlwa yicala lokubamba inkunzi kuhlonyiwe.UMagaqa wayeyikhansela kuMasipala waseMzimkhulu ngesikhathi esocongwa. Kuthiwa wabulawelwa ukukhononda ngenkohlakalo eyayenzeka kulo mkhandlu.Ekuvumeni kwakhe icala, uNcengwa waninda abanye abasolwa kanye nabantu abangaboshiwe kuleli cala okukhona kubo nabantu ababephethe izikhundla ezibalulekile kuMasipala waseMzimkhulu nowesifunda iHarry Gwala ngesikhathi kusocongwa uMagaqa. Ngesikhathi egonyuluka uNcengwa waveza ukuthi bahlukaniselana u-R120 000 emva kokusoconga uMagaqa.UNcengwa wathi wabuye wathola ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ukuthi washaywa emva kwendlebe ozakwabo njengoba abuye wathola ukuthi empeleni imali ababeyikhokhelwe ngokubulala uMagaqa kwakungu-R600 000.Kuleli cala uNcengwa uboshwe noMnuz Sibonelo Myeza, Mbulelo Mpofana, noMlungisi Ncalane. UNcalane kwatholakala ukuthi akakulungele ukubhekana necala ngenxa yokuphazamiseka emqondweni.UMyeza noMpofana bona bayaqhubeka nokuphika icala kanti icala labo lizoqulwa ngo-Okthoba.

Umsunguli waleli tende u-Andile Chili, uveze ukuthi balisungule ngenhloso yokuthi bahlanganise abantu abaqhamuka ndawozonke bezojabulela ubumnandi obuza nalolu hlobo lomcimbi."Umcimbi ohamba phambili lona obungazwa abamabhizinisi, abemfashini kuxutshwa nobumnandi, okuyilapho kuhlangana khona yonke inhlobo. Etendeni lethu sizobe sikhombisa ubuhle bemfashini, ubumnandi obehlukene obuthinta umculo kanye nokudla okuphambili, konke lokhu okuzobe kuqhakanjiswa abanamakhono ahlukene,” kuchaza yena.
