Uthe izihambeli bazivulele amathuba ahlukene okuthi zizijabulise njengoba benamathikithi abantu abazobe behamba ngabodwana kanye nabahamba ngababili.Amathikithi abo uveze ukuthi aseyadayisa eTicketPro, wathi bakhethe ukuthi bakhiphe angemaningi ukuze abantu bajabule ngendlela efanele. Kulo nyaka ingqikithi yalo mhaho ithi "Marvels of Mzansi”, lapho kulindeleke ukuthi intsha edlisa ngemisiko yesintu kube iyona egqamayo njengoba abahleli beHollywood Bets baba nomcimbi wokubungaza abanye abasiki begqephu abazobe bekhombisa ngemisiko yabo ezohambisana nomcimbi.
SIZODLA uR154 million isikhungo sokulwa neTB esizophuthulwa ngonyaka ozayo esingaphakathi esibhedlela iKing Dinuzulu. Lokhu kuvele izolo ngesikhathi uMphathiswa weMisebenzi yoMphakathi kanye neNgqalasizinda KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Martin Meyer ehambele kulesi sibhedlela. Inhloso bekuwukuyobheka ibanga elihanjwe njengoba sakhiwa.Usonkontileka wokuqala wahluleka wukuqhubeka nomsebenzi kwase kudingeka ukuthi lo msebenzi udluliselwe kwenye inkampani.''Ingu-R154 million isiyonke imali ezostshenziswa uma sekuphothuliwe konke ukwakhiwa kwalesi sakhiwo,'' kusho uMeyer.Uveze ukuthi kulo Mnyango bakubeka eqhulwini ukubaluleka kokuba izibhedlela zaKwaZulu-Natal zibonakale zisezingeni ngaso sonke isikhathi. Uthe indlela iTB esiphenduke yaba yisifo esiyingozi ngayo, bekumqoka kakhulu ukuthi kube nesibhedlela esizoba nalolu hlobo lwesikhungo ngaphakathi kusona. Ugcizelele kakhulu ukuthi kuseqhulwini kubona ukwenza konke okusemandleni ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izibhedlela ziba yindawo ephephile futhi enezakhiwo ezifanele. Isikhulu esibambile kulesi sibhedlela, uDkt Tumelo Mabesa, sithe kulokoza inhlansi yethemba ngokuthi bazokwazi ukulwa neTB. Udalule ukuthi uhlobo lweTB abazobe belubheka kakhulu yilolu olubizwa nge-XDR.Uthe lesi sikhungo sizobhekelela abantu abaqhamuka ezingxenyeni ezahlukene. Umnikazi weMakhathini Projects, uMnuz Mbuso Makhathini uthembise ukuthi lesi sikhungo sizobe sesiphothuliwe maphakathi nonyaka ozayo.''Sifuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi lo msebenzi uzobe sewuphothuliwe maphakathi nonyaka ozayo. Lokhu kuzokwenzeka ngoba abasebenzi basebenza ngokuzikhandla okukhulu,'' usho kanje.
KULOKOZA inhlansi yethemba ngodaba lwamanzi ahlanzekile emphakathini waseMbhongampisi, kuwadi 4 eMfolozi, abeSouth32 Hillside Aluminium ngokubambisana nomasipala wakule ndawo, bephendula isoyi le-projekthi yamanzi.Ngokusho kwesikhulu seSouth32, uMnuz Thembelani Singiswa, sithe ingu-R5 million imali abayitshale onyakenimali ka-2025, ukulekelela ngengqalasizinda yamanzi kule ndawo.Phakathi kwengqalasizinda athe bazotshala imali kuyo, ithangi lamanzi lensimbi elimumatha amanzi angama-litha angu-50 000, isakhiwo sephampu yamanzi ezosebenza nge-generator, ukufakwa kwepitsi elisha. USingiswa uthe bazobuye bafake namapayipi amanzi azohamba ibanga elingama-mitha angu-4,3 ama-standpipes angu-21 bese kuba wucingo lokubiya ukuze yonke le ngqalasizinda ivikeleke. "Le projekthi izohlomulisa imindeni engu-98, okukhona kuyo abantu abangu-784,” kusho uSingiswa. Uthe akungatshazwa ukuthi lokhu kuzoletha uguquko oluhle kwezempilo kubantu bakule ndawo bese kuphinde kwethule umthwalo kwabesifazane, izingane nezaguga abahamba ibanga elide ukuyofuna amanzi. "Kuyaziwa ukuthi phambilini, imiphakathi eyakhele uMasipala uMfolozi ibibhekene nengwadla yamanzi. Izakhamuzi eziningi bezithembela emalolini amanzi abebuye angafiki, ziyokha amanzi angcolile emifuleni, obekubeka impilo yabo engcupheni,” usho kanje.Uthe lokhu kuphendulwa kwesoyi kuzobuyisa isithunzi kubantu, kwenze ngcono ezempilo bese kuvula namathuba. "Kungesinye sezibophezelo zethu siyiSouth32 ukuthi sizohlale sisifaka isandla ezintweni ezithinta ezemfundo, ezempilo, ezomnotho kanjalo nakwezemvelo,” usho kanje. Uthe bayaziqhenya ngalolu hambo nomphakathi waseMbhongampisi nomasipala ababambisene nabo.IMeya kaMasipala wesifunda iKing Cetshwayo, uMnuz Sikhumbuzo Dlamini, ihambe emazwini kaSingiswa, yathi iprojekthi izoletha umehluko omkhulu. "Sijabule kakhulu ukubambisana nabeSouth32 ekuzameni ukuqeda inkinga yokuntula amanzi ahlanzekile,” kusho uDlamini.UDlamini unxuse nezinye izinkampani ezinamabhizinisi eKing Cetshwayo, ukuthi zisondele ukuzokwelula isandla emiphakathi eyakhele lo masipala.ISouth32 ayiqali ukuphonsa itshe esivivaneni kolwamanzi kule ndawo, njengoba ike yakwenza phambilini, ifaka imali engu-R12 million. Kule mali kwakukhona u-R7 million, eyawutshala onyakenimali u-2022.
USUKHONA umhlaba osuhlonzwe eCornubia, eMount Edgecombe, eThekwini, okuzokwakhelwa kuwo abakhahlanyezwa yizikhukhula zika-2022 nezinye zangemuva kwalezo.Lokhu kuvezwe wuNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli eDurban ICC, lapho ebeyokwethula khona ngokusemthethweni isivumelwano sokusebenzisana ngezokuxhumana nabakwaMTN.Ukubambisana kukahulumeni nale nkampani yamaselula kuthiwa kuzokwenza ngcono ezokuxhumana ezindaweni zasemakhaya esifundazweni sonke. Ephawula ngolwabakhahlanyezwa yizikhukhula uNtuli uthe: "Ukhona umhlaba esesiwutholile eCornubia lapho okuqala khona umsebenzi wokwakha. Okwenziwayo njengamanje wukufakwa kwengqalasizinda ezolekelela kulokhu.” Uveze nokuthi eMgungundlovu zikhona izindlu esezisesiphethweni sokuqedwa ukwakhiwa."Lezi zindlu sezifakwa uphahla. Sinethemba lokuthi zizophothulwa ukwakhiwa ngoJulayi,” kusho uNtuli. Uthe isikhathi abazibekele sona ukuphothula wonke umsebenzi wokwakhela izisulu wuDisemba 2026."Ngaleso sikhathi, bonke abagilwa kuyobe sekufanele ukuthi babe sebeyitholile indawo yokufihla ikhanda,” usho kanje.Mayelana nokusebenzisana nabakwaMTN, uNtuli uthe lokhu kusebenzisana kuyingqophamlando esifundazweni. "I-MTN izosilekelela ukusiza izibhedlela, imitholampilo, izikole, imitapo yolwazi nezinkantolo zamakhosi ukuthi zikwazi ukusebenzisa ukuxhumana ngobuxhakaxhaka besimanje, ezingeni elisheshayo lika-4 no-5G,” kusho uNtuli, othe lokhu kuzoba mahhala.Uveze ukuthi zingaphezu kuka-2000 izindawo ezizohlinzekwa ngalolu hlelo lwamahhala. Udalule nokuthi kuzophinde kuqeqeshwe intsha engu-80 ngamakhono ezobuxhakaxhaka ukuze ikwazi ukungena emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe. "Ukulwa nobugebengu yisona sisekelo esisakhayo. Intsha engazibandakanyi nobugebengu idinga ukugqugquzelwa. Izinhlelo ezifana nalolu zingenye yezindlela esizisebenzisayo ukwenza lokhu,” kusho uNtuli.Uthe intsha idinga amathuluzi kanjalo nendawo yokuncintisana ngamathuba omsebenzi."Badinga ukuqeqeshwa ukuze nabo bakwazi ukuncintisana besebenzisa ubuxhakaxhaka besimanje." Uthe lokhu kuzohamba ibanga elide emizameni yokuvala igebe uma kuqhathaniswa ezokuxhumana zasezindaweni ezisemadolobheni nalezo ezisemakhaya.

ZISHAYA amakhala izinyunyana zothisha KwaZulu-Natal, ngesinye sezikhulu esasula sisabhekene nokuqondiswa ubugwegwe eMnyangweni wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu esifundazweni okuthiwa "sizovumbuka" eMnyangweni wezeMfundo khola belu eKZN.Lesi sikhulu esingeke sidalulwe ngoba singatholakalanga ukuze siphawule, kulindeleke ukuthi siqale ukusebenza eMnyangweni wezeMfundo ngenyanga ezayo, kanti kuthiwa sizophatha isikhundla esiphezulu.Umthombo weSolezwe oseminyangweni yomibili, uveze ukuthi lesi sikhulu nabanye abasebenzi basule ngoJanuwari, kulo nyaka, besalinde uhlelo lokuqondiswa ubugwegwe. "Uzokhumbula ukuthi kunezikhulu ezamiswa ngoSepthemba, nyakenye, nguMphathiswa uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, ngenxa yokukhwatshaniswa kwemali kubhekwe okhethweni lwangonyaka odlule. Lesi sikhulu sisule ngoJanuwari, kulo nyaka, sahamba singashushiswanga. Manje kuyasixaka ukuthi 'sizoqashwa' eMnyangweni wezeMfundo obhekene nenkinga yezezimali ekubeni sahamba ngenxa yokukhwabanisa imali," kusho umthombo.UMengameli weNatu, uMnuz Sifiso Malinga, uthe kungaba yishwa uma lesi sikhulu singavumbuka eMnyangweni wezeMfundo. Uthe bekufanele sihlanze igama laso ngaphambi kokuthi siqashwe omunye wumnyango."Uma umuntu ebhekene nezinsolo, kufanele athathelwe izinyathelo. Akufanele umuntu obhekene nezinsolo zenkohlakalo abalekiselwe komunye umnyango. Sizokuba nenkinga enkulu uma kuzothathwa umuntu ngapha, agange, bese eyashushumbiswa ayofihlwa kwenye indawo. Ukungathathelwa izinyathelo kwabasolwa enkohlakalweni ikhona okwenza ukuthi inkohlakalo idle lubi eminyangweni kahulumeni." UMalinga uthe akafunakali umuntu olandelwa yiphunga lenkohlakalo eMnyangweni wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal njengoba lo mnyango ubhekene nenkinga yemali."Sinezinkinga eziningi lapha eMnyangweni wezeMfundo. Uma singanikezwa umuntu onenkinga kusho ukuthi sisazoqhubeka sibe nenkinga." UMalinga uthe bazofuna umnyango uphumele obala ngezinsolo zokuqashwa kwalesi sikhulu, wathi bazolulandela lolu daba.UNobhala weSadtu, uNksz Nomarashiya Caluza, uthe bakhathazekile ngale mibiko yokuthi kuzoqashwa umuntu olandelwa yiphunga komunye umnyango, bese evumbuka eMnyangweni wezeMfundo. Uthe bafuna ukwazi ukuthi ngabe yalandelwa yonke imigomo ngaphambi kokuba aqashwe okubala nokuveza ukuthi lapho esuka khona ukuthi wahamba kanjani."Ngoba umuntu osuka komunye umnyango, bekumele abhekwe ukuthi wahamba kanjani la esuka khona. Asimdingi umuntu olandelwa yiphunga lenkohlakalo kwezeMfundo ngoba sinezinkinga eziningi zemali. Sifuna ukwazi kwalaba abenza uhlelo lokumqasha ukuthi ngabe yonke imigudu bayilandela, bambona ukuthi akanukeki yini kwinkohlakalo? Uma naye engavezanga ukuthi wahamba kanjani la esuka khona, kuyosho ukuthi uqambe amanga ngesikhathi efuna umsebenzi ngakho kumele achithwe," usho kanje. Uthe bazolulandelela lolu daba, ngeke baluyeke kanjalo ngoba luthinta ngqo othisha, abafundi kanjalo nabazali.Kushaye esokushicilela engaphendulanga imibuzo athunyelelwa yona ngoLwesithathu, futhi wangaluphendula nocingo uMnuz Muzi Mahlambi, okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo. Kanjalo nenhloko yalo mnyango, uMnuz Nathi Ngcobo, ayizange iyiphendule imibuzo.Okhulumela uMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana, uMnuz Senzelwe Mzila, naye akazange ayiphendule imibuzo.
BABONA uphenyo lukaNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal lwezinsolo zokungalandelwa kwemigomo ekukhishweni kuka-R100 million wokuxhasa amabhizinisi aphethwe intsha, kuyimizamo yokuvala imilomo labo abakhalayo. Omunye wabafaka isikhalazo ngokukhishwa kwale mali, uluchaze njengenganekwane uphenyo olumenyezelwe uNdunankulu, uMnuz Thami Ntuli.UNtuli umemezele ukuthi useyalele obambe njengomqondisi-jikelele KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Nkosenye Zulu, ukuba aqale uphenyo oluzimele. Lesi simemezelo usenze ngesikhathi ekhuluma ohlelweni lokuqeqeshwa kwentsha ehlomule kulolu hlelo.UNtuli uthe uphenyo luzolandelela ukuthi zaqokwa kanjani izinkampani ezihlomule kusukela kwasungulwa lolu hlelo."Sifuna ukwazi ukuthi obani abahlomulile nokuthi basondelene nobani. Sifuna ukwazi ukuthi ngabe yalandelwa yonke yini imigomo? Okunye okubalulekile okufanele sikwazi ukuthi ngabe laba abahlomula kwakubafanele yini ukuba bahlomule?" UNtuli uthe uma umbiko usuphothuliwe, bazonekelwa izwe bonke abahlomulile.Izinsolo zokungalandelwa kwemigomo ziqale ukuvela emva kokusula isigubhukane kobengumqondisi-jikelele KwaZulu-Natal, uDkt Nonhlanhla Mkhize.UDkt Mkhize kuthiwa wasula emva kokuba enqabe ukusayina uhlu lwamagama ezinkampani ezazizohlomula. Kuthiwa wayekhala ngokungalandelwa kwemigomo nokuthi kwaholela ekutheni egcine esehlukunyezwa ngowayengumqondisi wophiko lwezentsha ehhovisi likaNtuli, uMnuz Melusi Ndima.Omunye wabantu abashaye amakhala ngokuqokwa kwezinkampani, uMnuz Zwakele Mncwango, uthe akanalo ithemba lokuthi uphenyo lukaNtuli, luzophuma nento ephathekayo.UMncwango, ongusihlalo we-ActionSA KwaZulu-Natal, wabhalela uNtuli emnuxa ukuba amise ukuqokwa kwezinkampani kuze kube kuphenywa izinsolo. Phakathi kwezinsolo uMncwango ayefuna ziphenywe, ukuthi uNtuli wagxambukela ohlelweni lokuqokwa kwabazohlomula.UMncwango uthe uNtuli bekufanele aqoke inkampani ezimele ukuba iphenye."Njengoba naye ethinteka bekungafanele ukuba ayalele umuntu amphethe ukuba aphenye. Umuntu ongaphansi kwakhe uzomphenya kanjani?" UMncwango uthe ufuna ukuthi izinsolo ziphenywe yiHhovisi loMvikeli woMphakathi.Uthe okunye okwenza ukuthi uNtuli afune uphenyo ingoba nakhu uzama ukulibazisa, wathi ihhovisi likaNtuli alinayo le mali eliyithembise abahlomulile."Imali kwakufanele isebenze ngonyaka wezimali owedlule, bahluleka. Uma imali ungayisebenzisanga ngesikhathi ibuyela emuva. Uma usufuna ukuyisebenzisa kufanele ubhalele uMnyango kaMgcinimafa, uyicele. UMphathiswa wezeziMali KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Francois Rodgers, ushilo ukuthi abakaze bayicele le mali (Isolezwe liyibonile incwadi kaRodgers lapho ephendula uMncwango)."URodgers uthe le mali angaze akwazi ukubanika ngo-Okthoba, uma esehlela kabusha isabelomali. NJENGOBA kuyinyanga yokuqhakambisa ezempilo kwabesilisa, bayakhuthazwa ngokunakekela impilo yabo kanjalo nokuhlolwa izifo ezicashayo kodwa eziyingozi.UMphathiswa wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal, uNksz Nomagugu Simelane, ubonge owesilisa waseMlaza ngokuba nesibindi sokukhuluma ngohambo lwakhe nomdlavuza wendlala yesinye, okuyisifo esingazibiki kodwa esibulalayo nesihlasela ngendlela exakile abesilisa abamnyama.UMnuz Dumisani Pakkies, okwatholakala ukuthi unomdlavuza wamankwahla osesigabeni sesithathu ngo-2020, engakaze abe nezimpawu zokugula, ubemnywe ohlelweni lwamasonto onke lomnyango iKwaZulu-Natal Health Chat, lapho egeqe khona amagula ngohambo lwakhe ebhekene nalesi sifo.UMphathiswa uchaze uMnuz Pakkies njengeqhawe ngokuba nesibindi sokubhekana nesimo ayekuso nokwabelana ngodaba lwakhe emphakathini."Ngokusinda emdlavuzeni wendlala yesinye nokwabelana ngendaba yakhe, uguqula ubuhlungu bakhe bube yithuba lenguquko enhle. Ukuphumela kwakhe obala ngalokhu kuzonikeza nabanye ithuba elifanayo nokubanika isibindi sokuhlolwa kusenesikhathi nokuyinto engasindisa amanye amadoda," kusho yena. Sikhulu isibalo samadoda ansundu eNingizimu Afrika ahlaselwa yilesi sifo esitholakala sesisezigabeni eziphezulu nesimo saso sesibucayi kakhulu uma kuqhathaniswa nezinye izinhlanga. Lokhu kwehluka kwenziwa yinhlanganisela yezinto okungaba wufuzo, amazinga aphansi okuhlolwa, kanye nezithiyo ezihlobene nesimo senhlalo-mnotho nokufinyelela ekunakekelweni kwezempilo."Amadoda angaphezu kweminyaka engu-50 asengozini, ngakho-ke ayelulekwa ukuthi ahlolwe minyaka yonke. Iminyaka yobudala enconyiwe yokuhlolwa yalabo abanomlando womndeni yiminyaka engu-45. Ngeshwa, amadoda amaningi ayakushalazela ukuhlolwa ngenxa yokwesaba, ukungabi nolwazi oluyiqiniso ngalo mdlavuza, noma izinkolelo ezinjengokuthi umdlavuza "yisifo sabelungu", noma udalwa wubuthakathi.UMnuz Pakkies wayevame ukuhlolelwa umdlavuza wendlala yesinye. Ngemva kokuxilongwa kwakhe, waqala ukwelapha nge-hormonal (i-androgen deprivation therapy) ngoJanuwari 2021. Lokhu kwalandelwa yi-brachytherapy (ukufakwa kwezimila ze-radioactive kwi-prostate) ngo-Febhuwari 2021, kanye nemisebe yangaphandle ye-beam ngoJulayi ngonyaka ofanayo."Ngiyajabula ukusho ukuthi bengixolelwe kusukela ngo-2023. I-PSA yami manje ayibonakali - nje ingu-0.05," esho. "Akunamsebenzi ukugwema udokotela, kuphela wukuthi ugcina usunamanabukeni - ungakwazi ukuhamba noma ukuzondla wena,” kuxwayisa uMnuz Pakkies.Unxuse abesilisa ukuthi bazihlole njalo:"Uma ungeke uzenzele ngokwakho, kwenzele izingane zakho noma obathandayo. Masikhulume ngomdlavuza wendlala yesinye ngendlela esikhuluma ngayo ngonobhutshuzwayo, ipolitiki, noma inkolo. Ngoba ukuthula kuyasibulala."

Kade saphuma kuZuma naye kufanele aqhubeke nempilo."Uthe bazosiphikisa isicelo sikaZuma.IMK ithe iyaseseka isinqumo sikaZuma sokuphonsela inselelo ukuxoshwa kwi-ANC. Yingakho wonke umuntu enelungelo lokuya ezinkantolo. Ukuba elinye izwe lapho kungahlonishwa khona amalungelo abantu ngabe kwenzeka okunye."

UKHATHAZEKILE umndeni wesaguga (96) okuthiwa sidlwengulwe yisihlobo maphakathi nenyanga KwaNgobeni, eMgungundlovu, umsolwa ededelwa emva kokuboshwa kwakhe.Lokhu kuvezwe umzukulu kamgilwa, ngesikhathi elandisa Isolezwe ngalokhu kukhathazeka.Uveze ukuthi umgilwa wehlelwe wumshophi ngoJuni 14, kulo nyaka. "Wasitshela ukuthi wathi elele, wangqongqozelwa umuntu, owathi ucela amphuzise amanzi ngezithuba zango-12 ebusuku. Wathi wavele wamxosha lo muntu, ethi akamyeke phansi, ngeke amvuse ngalesi sikhathi,” kusho umzukulu.Udalule ukuthi umsolwa washaya sengathi uyahamba kodwa wabuye wabuya esebhodloza isicabha, wakhala ngaphakathi.Uthe yilapho ambhozomela khona umgilwa, waqala ngokumfaka umunwe, walandelisa ngokumdlwengula. Uveze ukuthi nakuba ugogo wazama ukuklwebha umsolwa, emluma kodwa wamehlula ngamandla. "Wamdlwengula izikhawu ezintathu waze wozela walala. Kwasekuyizintatha, ngesikhathi ugogo ecela kumsolwa ukuthi amdedele ayochama, lapho wavuka khona wathi gubhubhu, wagqoka, waphuma wabaleka,” kuchaza umzukulu.Uthe yilapho ugogo owathola khona intuba yokuphuma naye, amemeze omakhelwane, ebatshela ukuthi udlwenguliwe. Uqhube wathi babe sebethintwa nabo njengemndeni, base bemyisa esibhedlela ugogo."Odokotela bafika baqinisekisa ukuthi ngempela udlwenguliwe, sase siyovula icala emaphoyiseni,” kulandisa umzukulu. Uthe emva kokusabalala kwezindaba zokudlwengulwa kukamgilwa nokuthi wamklwebha emqaleni, wamluma nasemnweni, umphakathi waletha ulwazi lokuthi ukhona abasolayo "olimele" ezindaweni ezibaluliwe. "Yilapho esathola khona ukuthi umsolwa kanti yisihlobo sethu, uthi mamkhulu kumgilwa,” kubeka umzukulu.Uthe emva kokuboshwa kwakhe umsolwa ngoJuni 18, babelindele ukuthi ayobingelela imantshi ngoJuni 20. "Sezwa sesitshelwa ukuthi akabange esayibingelela imantshi, udedelwe ngoba kusekhona ubufakazi obushodayo,” kusho umzukulu. Uthe lokhu kubathikamezile bewumndeni kanjalo nomgilwa. "Sizibuza ukuthi udedelwe kanjani ekubeni enze icala elibucayi kangaka?” usho kanje.Uthe ngisho nomgilwa, aveze ukuthi ususiwe endaweni yesigameko wayohlaliswa endaweni ephephile, usathikamezekile emqondweni. "Uma sikhuluma naye uthuka izanya. Simuzwe ethi uzobuya umsolwa azomdelela. Abuye athi akasafuni ukuphinde alubhade emzini wakhe ngoba akuphephile,” usho kanje.Udalule ukuthi umgilwa ubezihlalela yedwa endaweni yesigameko njengoba umndeni wake wazama phambilini ukumthatha ayohlala nezinye izihlobo kwezinye izindawo kodwa washaya phansi ngonyawo, ethi ugade amathuna omndeni.Siye koshicilela amaphoyisa engakaphenduli.
IHOLLYWOODBETS Durban July enomlando obambekayo wokuheha izinkumbi zabantu kulindeleke ingenise imali elinganiselwa ku-R690 million, emnothweni wedolobha laseThekwini.Lokhu kuvezwe yiMeya yalo mkhandlu uMnuz Cyril Xaba, esitatimendeni esithunyelwe kwabezindaba njengoba kuzoba nalo mjaho ohanjelwa nangosaziwayo eGreyville Racecourse ngoMgqibelo ozayo. Uthe iDurban July wumcimbi obaluleke kakhulu ekhalendeni lomkhandlu njengoba iletha izinkumbi zabantu eThekwini, bevela ezindaweni ezehlukene zaseNingizimu Afrika. Uqhube wathi iDurban July yenza umehluko omkhulu emnothweni wedolobha oke wakhahlamezeka ngesikhathi kuhlasele iCovid-19, izikhukhula nomtapo owacekela phansi izakhiwo eziningi ezingenisa imali."Idolobha lilindele abantu ababalelwa ku-45 000 abazoba yingxenye yomjaho. Izibalo zikhombisa ukuthi abantu bazochitha imali elinganiselwa kuR278.6 million emjahweni ngqo, bese kuthi ukuba khona kwawo kwenze imali engu-R689.4 million kwiGross Domestic Product (GDP),” kusho uXaba. Udalule nokuthi abalelwa ku-4 403 amathuba omsebenzi azodaleka. Uthe abamabhizinisi ahlukene, okukhona kuwo nafufusayo, ngeke asale ngaphandle, azohlomula."Amanye azohlomula ngomjaho amabhizinisi afana nelengqephu, elezokuthutha, elezindawo zokulala, elezinwele, elokuzicwala nalawo adayisa ukudla okuvuthiwe,” kusho uXaba.Uthe imicimbi efana nalela, yenza omkhulu umehluko ikakhulukazi emikhakheni efana nowezokuvakasha nowokudla. Uqhube wathi iTheku iyona ndawo okufanele abantu beze kuyo bezozithokozisa njengoba kuzobe kuvunguza umoya wenjabulo."Nginxusa wonke umuntu ukuthi abe yingxenye yomjaho, ubumnandi obusezingeni lomhlaba buzobe bubuzwa khona. Abantu abeze ngobuningi bezobuka umjaho, ezemfashini nokunye okuningi,” usho kanje. Uyalele namaphanta nalabo abazifelayo ngamahhashi ukuthi bangalenzi iphutha lokungezi emjahweni. Ebala eminye yemicimbi ezoba khona uthe yiFact Durban Rocks, Anywhere in Your City, Any Given Sunday, Mojo’s July Weekend ne-All White Maxi’s Lifestyle Party.Uthe ngonyaka odlule lo mjaho wahlanganisa isibalo sezibukeli ezingu-50 000. Isigqi salo nyaka sithi "Marvels of Mzansi” kanti siqhakambisa amagugu aseNingizimu Afrika, ukwehlukahlukana kwamasiko, izindawo ezinhle ngendlela eyisimanga bese yethulela isigqoko izwe ngakho konke elikuzuzile. Isikhulu sezokuxhumana enkampanini exhase lo mjaho iHollywoodbets, uNksz Kuhle Mkize, sithe umthelela omuhle walo mjaho ngeke ugcine ngempelasonto ezayo kuphela kodwa kuzokapakela nakwezinye izinsuku."SiyiHollywoodbets siyibheke ngabomvu iDurban July yanonyaka. Ngaphandle komjaho omkhulu nemibhiyozo ezobe yenzeka eGreyville, kuningi okunye okuzobe kwenzeka ezindaweni ezehlukene zeTheku. "Lo mjaho unomthelela omuhle emnothweni ngenxa yezinkumbi zabantu ezizovakashela leli dolobha, abayophinde babuye nangelinye ilanga.Maningi namathuba emisebenzi azodaleka emikhakheni yengqephu kuphinde kuhlomule nosomabhizinisi," kusho uNksz Mkize.

KUBE yizindaba ezimnandi kumaNazaretha aseBuhleni ukuthola ukuthi asenayo indawo angayisebenzisa njengoba kungena umhlangano kaJulayi ngenyanga ezayo. Kuleli sonto kube nemibiko yezinguquko ezingase zibekhona kulo nyaka ezinhlelweni zaminyaka yonke zomhlangano kaJulayi emva kokuba amaNazaretha aseThembezinhle aholwa yiNkosi Phinda "UKukhanyakwelanga" Shembe, ethenge indawo iNtanda, eNdwedwe, ebisetshenziswa abaseBuhleni abaholwa yiNkosi Mduduzi "uNyazilwezulu" Shembe. Obekudala ungabazane ngezinhlelo zabaseBuhleni wukuthi le ndawo ibisetshenziswa yizintombi zalolu hlangothi ukukha izintingo eziyiswa oNyazini uma kuqala umhlangano kaJulayi. Izintombi ziya eNtanda zihamba nabaphathi bazo, zifike zikhe izintingo, zilalele izwi futhi zilale khona. Ngakusasa zivuka ziye eBuhleni zethule izintingo kuNyazi, ziviliyele.Okhulumela abaseBuhleni, uMnuz Thokozani Mncwabe, uthe awehle amaphaphu ngoba sebetholile ukuthi abaseThembezinhle abayithathanga yonke indawo. "Thina sinelethu ipulazi leNyangayezulu, bona bathenge leli elinye. INtanda inkulu kakhulu kukhona nepulazi leNkosi iNyangayezulu (AK Shembe) neleNkosi iLanga (JG Shembe), angiboni kuzoba khona inkinga ngoba kuhlukanisa imigwaqo, kunemingcele. Njengamakholwa sonke thina eBuhleni nabo eThembezinhle, angiboni siba nokushayisana, bathenge ingxenye yepulazi kuphela," kusho uMncwabe.Uthe balinde izwi loNyazilwezulu abazozwa ngalo yonke into. "Munye umshayeli womkhumbi oya ezulwini, uyangena umdedele mhla ka-1, akuphazamiseke lutho phansi amaphaphu," kuphetha uMncwabe.Uthe kulolu daba kumele kugadwe kungaqanjelwana amanga. UMshumayeli uChancey Sibisi waseThembezinhle, uthe kwasekuqaleni kabaze bavimba muntu ukuya eNtanda. UKUBHOKA kwesihlava sokusetshenziswa kwezidakamizwa emphakathini - ikakhulu okwenziwa yintsha nomthelela walokho empilweni yayo - kwenze umbhali futhi oshicilela izincwadi wabhala incwadi ukuzama ukwexwayisa abangakangeni kule nkinga.UMnuz Siyabonga "Siya” Mabaso ubhale wakhipha incwadi esihloko sithi Unbroken Futures: The Journey Away From Drugs, akholwa wukuthi izoba wusizo kakhulu ukuzama ukulwa nenkinga yesihlava sezidakamizwa entsheni, okuze kwenze ukuthi abanye babo bonelwe ikusasa labo, bagcine bengafikanga ndawo empilweni, abanye bafe nokufa imbala.Engxoxweni neSolezwe ngale ncwadi, uMabaso uthe iqale ukutholakala ezinyangeni ezintathu ezedlule, kanti ukuyibhala kwakhe kusukela ezintweni nasezimweni akhule ebuka zenzeka emphakathini, ezinye zazo ezenzeka kwinsizwa akhule nayo, okonakala ikusasa layo laphela nya ngenxa yokuluthwa nokubuswa yizidakamizwa ezahlukene. "Kwangikhathaza kakhulu ukubona umuntu engimaziyo ephelela emoyeni kanjena engasafikanga ndawo nempilo ngenxa yengcindezi yezidakamizwa, angena kuzona ecindezelwa ngabangani abangalungile abamfaka kuzona. Indlela impilo yakhe eyajika ngayo ngomzuzwana nje, waze wafa ebulawa wumphakathi umsolela ukweba, nakho ayekwenzela ukuthola imali yokuthenga izidakamizwa, kwawuphula kakhulu umoya wami, kwenza ngafisa kube khona engikwenzayo ukunqanda ukudloba komonakalo,” usho kanje. Eqhuba, uthe encwadini yakhe udidiyele izeluleko zokuxwayisa kakhulu abantu abasha abangakangeni kulolu gibe, ukuthi bangalinge baqale ngoba umthelela walo ungenza ukuthi impilo yabo iphelele emoyeni, bagcine bengafezanga lutho lwabebezifisela khona empilweni."Lokhu ngibona kuzosiza kakhulu ukunqanda umonakalo futhi kungasiza nokwehlisa umthwalo kothisha nabazali, okuyaye kugxekwe bona uma sekukhona okungahambi kahle empilweni yomntwana osuke esengenwe yizidakamizwa,” kusho uMabaso.Lo mbhali udabuka eMpophomeni, eHowick, kanti manje uzinze eRichards Bay, enyakatho yaKwaZulu-Natal ngomsebenzi. Le ncwadi yakhe ibiza u-R179 no-R49 i-ebook kwi-website ethi: www.manoebooks.com/unbroken, kanti ingeyesibili njengoba eyokuqala esihloko sithi Dream Chasers After High School, ayikhipha ngo-2017.

INkantolo yeSifunda eMadadeni igwebe uMduduzi Jerome Kunene (57) iminyaka ewu-15 ebhadla ejele kulandela ukulahlwa yicala lokushushumbisa izidakamizwa.Iminyaka ewu-5 yesigwebo ilengiswe iminyaka ewu-5 ngombandela wokuthi angatholakali ecaleni elifanayo kule sikhathi.Ngo-11 Okthoba 2023 Ithimba lamaphoyisa elaliholwa wu-Warrant Officer Mfanufikile Nyembe lagasela endlini ese-section 3 eMadadeni lathola ukuthi kubiyiwe ngocingo olusikayo kwafakwa wamabhodlela afile ngaphezulu.Amaphoyisa amemeza efuna ukungena kodwa uKunene walunguza wase eyabaleka wamyamalala. Amaphoyisa asebenzisa amathuluzi okugwabula angena. Amaphoyisa ayehlome ngencwadi ewagunyaza ukusesha. Angena athola uKunene ecashe endlini yenja. Amaphoyisa acela ukusesha indawo wavuma uKunene. UKunene wayeyedwa endlini ngesikhathi kugasela amaphoyisa. Kwavundululwa izidakamizwa endlini yenja nasemapayipini.Amaphoyisa athola i-Mandrax ewu-1851, i-Mandrax ewu-38 ewuhhafu nemali ebalelwa kuR 1300. UKunene waboshwa wathwesa icala lokushushumbisa izidakamizwa.Umshushisi uZama Zikalala ubize ungoti owacubungula izidakamizwa waqinisekisa ukuthi i-Mandrax. Kubizwe nomabhalane obhekene ubufakazi obusuke butholwe kubasolwa kwabizwa nabanye abasebenzela I-SAPS.UKunene ukuphikile ukuthi watholwa nezidakamizwa wathi zafika namaphoyisa. Kwavakashelwa indawo kwaqinisekiswa indlu yenja namapayipi.Umshushisi ekhonga isigwebo esiqinile, uthe izidakamizwa zidala abantu babe yimilutha, ubugebengu nenhlupheko.Uthe izigwebo eziqinile kubashushumbisi kungayinqanda inkinga yokusabalala kwezidakamizwa.UKunene ugwetshiwe ngaphezu kwalokho, inkantolo inqume ukuthi ummangalelwa akafanelwe wukuba nemvume yokuphatha isibhamu.

BASALE ngaphandle abaholi be-ANC ezifundeni ezinkulu zaKwaZulu-Natal, iTheku neMoses Mabhida, ngesikhathi kuqokwa abazohola amathimba esikhashana azophatha i-ANC kulezi zifunda.Obengusihlalo we-ANC eThekwini, uNkk Zandile Gumede, obengunobhala we-ANC kulesi sifunda, uMnuz Musa Nciki, obengusihlalo we-ANC esifundeni iMoses Mabhida, uMnuz Mzimkhulu Thebolla, nobengunobhala we-ANC kulesi sifunda, uMnuz Samora Ndlovu, abekho kubantu abazohola amathimba esikhashana aqokelwe ukuhola i-ANC kulezi zifunda.I-ANC ikhethe ukuqoka izingwevu ukuba kube yizo ezihola amathimba esikhashana. Labo abebekade bephethe izikhundla kulezi zifunda bazokuba amalungu ajwayelekile amathimba esikhashana.UMgqugquzeli we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Mike Mabuyakhulu, uthe baqoke owayeyilungu lePhalamende, uMnuz Don Gumede, ukuba kube wuye ozodidiyela i-ANC esifundeni iTheku.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba eThekwini, izolo. Owayengumphathiswa wezeziMali KwaZulu-Natal waphinde waba iphini lemeya kuMasipala waseThekwini, uNkk Belinda Scott, uqokelwe kwesikaMgcinimafa esifundeni iTheku.Esifundeni iMoses Mabhida kuqokwe umakadebona, uMnuz Nathi Mdladla, ukuba abe ngumdidiyeli.Oke waba yilungu lePhalamende nonobhala weCosatu KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Zet Luzipho, uqokelwe kwesikamgqugquzeli. UMabuyakhulu uthe la baholi banikezwe umsebenzi wokwakha kabusha i-ANC kulezi zindawo."Banikezwe umsebenzi wokuvuselela ubuhlobo be-ANC nemiphakathi. Sifuna ukuthi abantu babuyelwe ukuyethemba i-ANC. Sifuna babuyise umkhuba wokusebenzela umphakathi kumalungu e-ANC, baphinde bagqugquzele ukuziphatha kahle. Sizoqhubeka nokusebenzela abantu baKwaZulu-Natal."UMabuyakhulu uthe bazokuba nemihlangano namalungu e-ANC kuzo zonke izifunda zaKwaZulu-Natal, lapho bezothula khona ngokusemthethweni amathimba esikhasahana. I-ANC izoholwa amathimba esikhashana kuzo zonke izifunda zaKwaZulu-Natal.Isinqumo sokuqoka amathimba esikhashana sathathwa emva kokuba bonke ubuholi be-ANC ezifundeni zaKwaZulu-Natal buhlulekile ukuhlela ngesikhathi izingqungquthela zokukhetha ubuholi obusha.Ubuholi be-ANC izifundeni kufanele bukhethwe kabusha njalo emva kweminyaka emithathu. Khonamanjalo: UMabuyakhulu umemezele ukuthi sesitholakele isixazululo odabeni lwebhange Ithala, wathi ngeke lisavalwa Ithala njengoba ethe izingxoxo noNgqongqoshe wezeziMali, uMnuz Enock Godongwana, zithele izithelo ezinhle."Ngesikhathi kuvela izindaba zokuthi Ithala lizovalwa sanquma ukungenelela, sakhuluma noGodongwana. Engingakusho ukuthi kukhona esivumelane ngakho noGodongwana."
USOLA ubudedengu bamaphoyisa umnikazi wetekisi okuthiwa idutshulwe ngamaphoyisa ngephutha eyifanisa nenye, kwalimala abagibeli eBurnedale Farm, eBallito, ngoMsombuluko ebusuku. Kulesi sigameko okuvela ukuthi amaphoyisa adubule amahlandla abalelwa kwayisishiyagalombili ngemuva, kulimale abagibeli ababili.Kuvele ukuthi laba abalimele, bebehleli ngemuva etekisini, baphuthunyiswe esibhedlela esiseduze ukuze bayonikwa usizo lwezempilo. Ngokusho kukaMnuz Den Ndlovu, itekisi yakhe ebadakanyeke esigamekweni isebenza ngaphansi kukasoseshini iDolphin Coast. Elandisa ngesigameko, uthe umshayeli wetekisi ubesuka eBallito, ethwele abagibeli ebebeya eTete. Uthe ngesikhathi itekisi ihamba emgwaqweni onguthelawayeka uN2, ubelokhu elandelwa yimoto yamaphoyisa, ebizikhanyisele amalambu aluhlaza. Uthe akukho obekukhombisa ukuthi njengoba ilandela itekisi, ililandela ngoba ifuna lime."Kuthe kungakapheli amamitha abalelwa ku-100, ijikile emgwaqweni uN2 ingena kuR102, aqala amaphoyisa adubula, ebhekise etekisini,” kusho uNdlovu.Uthe umshayeli uqale wazitshela ukuthi kuqhuma isondo kodwa kwathi uma kuqhubeka, wabona ukuthi itekisi iyadutshulwa. UNdlovu uthe uyabufuna ubulungiswa ngokulinyazelwa itekisi ngento ebingahlangene nayo."Engikuthole ngesikhathi ngifika endaweni yesigameko, ukuthi itekisi yami idutshulwe ngephutha, ibifaniswa nenye okuthiwa iduniwe. Bathe izinombolo zayo ezicishe zifane nezaleyo eduniwe,” kuchaza uNdlovu.Usole amaphoyisa ngokwenza umsebenzi wawo budedengu, wathi uzohlwaya izeluleko zomthetho. "Bekufanele akhalise umsindo emotweni yawo, ukuze amkhombise ukuthi afuna ame. Ubezoma ngoba ubengahambi nangesivinini esiphezulu,” kusho uNdlovu. Uqhube wathi ngisho ebengamdlula ayomvimba ngaphambili, bekuzolekelela kakhulu lokho."Bekuzothi ngesikhathi imoto yawo isilinganisene netekisi, babone ukuthi izithwalele abagibeli, bese beyabona ukuthi akuyona le abayifunayo,” kubeka uNdlovu. Uthe akaphathekile kahle ngesehlo."Ngizohlwaya izeluleko zezomthetho, ukuze ngikwazi ukuthatha izinyathelo ezifanele, ngithole ubulungiswa,” usho kanje.Uthe uzwe kuthiwa sibi isimo sabagibeli abaphuthunyiswe esibhedlela, wathi nomshayeli wakhe usathikamezekile emqondweni. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uCaptain Ntathu Ndlovu, uthe amaphoyisa aseMhlali aphenya amacala amabili okuzama ukubulala kulandela isigameko esenzeke emgwaqweni uSalt Rock Link ngoMsombuluko. "Amaphoyisa athole umbiko wokuthi imoto eyebiwe ibonakele kuN2, okuholele ekutheni kube khona ukujahana nayo,” kusho uCapt Ndlovu.Uthe emva kokuzama kaningi ukuyimisa kodwa ingami, nokubona ishaya indiva isimo sokuphepha kwezinye izimoto ezisebenzisa umgwaqo, amaphoyisa avulele ngenhlamvu eyimisa. "Kulimale abagibeli ababili, akekho oshonile futhi akekho oboshiwe,” usho kanje.
UMENGAMELI Cyril Ramaphosa uthe bafuna ibe ngaphansi kakhulu kuka-R700 million, imali ezosetshenziselwa ukuhlela nokusingatha ingxoxo ngesimo sezwe.URamaphosa uthe u-R700 million mkhulu kakhulu, wathi bafuna le mali yehliswe.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ephendula imibuzo ePhalamende, izolo. "Kuzokuba kungokokuqala siba nengxoxo ngesimo sezwe kusukela sathola inkululeko. Ziningi izinto okufanele sikhulume ngazo. Kunabantu balapha abasikhuluma kabi emazweni angaphandle. Lezo izinto okufanele sikhulume ngazo."URamaphosa uphekwe ngemibuzo ngohambo lwakhe lwaseMelika lwangoMeyi, lapho khona ahlangana noMengameli wakuleliya zwe, uMnuz Donald Trump.URamaphosa uchithe izinsolo zokuthi emva kwalolu hambo, elakuleli lazama ukuxegisela inkampani kasomabhizinisi owayengamathe nomlimi noTrump ngaleso sikhathi, uMnuz Elon Musk. Uthe abaqondile ukuhlomulisa inkampani kaMusk ngokuxegisa umthetho ophoqa ukuthi zonke izinkampani zangaphandle ezisebenza kuleli, kufanele u-30% wabantu abaziphethe kube abakuleli."Akukho lapho siphule khona umthetho. Konke esikwenzile kuyahambisana nemithetho yakuleli. Futhi le nto esiyenzile asiyenziswanga ukuthi sifuna ukuhlomulisa inkampani eyodwa. Ziningi izinkampani ezizohlomula kulokhu. Ngithi angikusho nje ukuthi asisoze senza okuphambene nemithetho yakuleli."URamaphosa uphinde wabuzwa ngezinkinga ezikhungethe omasipala bakuleli. Uthe ukwehluleka komasipala ukusebenzisa imali abasuke beyabelwe, kuholela emibhikishweni yemiphakathi, wathi kufanele zithathelwe izinyathelo izikhulu zomasipala ezihlulwa wumsebenzi kanye nalezo ezenza inkohlakalo.URamaphosa uveze ukuthi iyaqina eyokuthi kuncishiswe omasipala ukuze bezokwazi ukusebenza kahle."Bakhona labo abathi kufanele sinciphise isibalo somasipala. Uma kuncipha isibalo somasipala kusho ukuthi abanye omasipala bazohlanganiswa nomasipala abakwaziyo ukuqoqa imali. Lokho kuzokwenza ukuthi bonke omasipala bakwazi ukuzimela. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, kukhona abakhathazekile. Bakhala ngokuthi uma sinciphisa omasipala kuzokusho ukuthi abantu abasezukumeleleka kahle. Uma omasipala sebebancane kusho ukuthi bazokuba kude nabantu. Izingxoxo ziyaqhubeka."

Kufanele aze lapha kuthina njengabaholi ezosichazela ukuthi yini lena ayiqalayo."Ngesikhathi uShivambu exoshwa esikhundleni iMK yathi uxoshelwe ukuhambela esontweni lomfundisi waseMalawi, ofunelwa amacala, uShepherd Bushiri. Kepha yena uShivambu wakuphika lokhu wathi uxoshiswe wumbiko wezinhloli ongamampunge othi ufuna ukuketula umholi weqembu, uMnuz Jacob Zuma.UNdhlela uphinde wakugcizelela ukuthi uShivambu waxoshelwa ukuya esontweni likaBushiri."Waphula umthetho weqembu waphinde waqamba amanga wathi wayegunyazwe wuZuma ukuba aye eMalawi. Naye uyazi ukuthi yiqiniso leli engilukhulumayo. Waze waxolisa." Ngesikhathi iMK ikhipha uShivambu esikhundleni yayithembise ukumjuba ePhalamende.Kepha izolo akazange afungiswe uShivambu ngesikhathi kufungiswa amanye amalungu eMK ayisishiyagalolunye.UNdhlela uthe banqume ukungabe besamjuba uShivambu ePhalamende emva kokuthola ukuthi miningi eminye imigomo yeqembu ayiphulile ngesikhathi esaphethe esikanobhala jikelele. UNdhlela ubuye waqinisekisa eyokuthi kunezinsolo zokuthi uShivambu wayeyoziqinisa eMalawi.UNdhlela uthe kunezinsolo zokuthi uShivambu wantshontsha isigqoko sendodakazi yomholi weMK, uNkk Duduzile Zuma-Sambudla."Kunezinsolo zokuthi wayefuna ukuthakatha uNkk Zuma-Sambudla. Lena yinto okukhulunywa ngayo. Kuthiwa wayeyofuna umuthi ozokwenza ukuthi kube uyena ohola iqembu uma engasekho uZuma." UNdhlela ubambene ngezihluthu noShivambu njengoba emthumelele incwadi yabameli.Kule ncwadi uNdhlela uyalela uShivambu ukuba axolise aphinde ahoxise izinsolo zokuthi udla izidakamizwa.UShivambu usanda kwenza izinsolo zokuthi uNdhlela uhlezi edakiwe nokuthi udla izidakamizwa. UNdhlela uphikile ukuthi udla izidakamizwa.Kusasa uShivambu uzomemezela abazohola izingxoxo zokuqalwa kweqembu elisha.
UMPHATHISWA woMnyango weMisebenzi yoMphakathi, uMnuz Martin Meyer, usezwakalise ukukhathazeka ngezigameko zokufa nokulimala kwezisebenzi lapho kwakhiwa khona kulesi sifundazwe. Lokhu kulandela ukushona komuntu oyedwa izolo kwalimala abane abebesebenza kwenye indawo eSpringfield Park eThekwini, emuva kokuwa kwezinsimbi abebegibele kuzo.Ngokusho kokhulumela umnyango esifundazweni uMnuz Steve Bhengu, ngoJanuwari kulo nyaka, kwalimala abasebenzi abangu-7 ngesikhathi kuwa isakhiwo esasakhiwa kuR102 ngaseKing Shaka International Airport.Uthe ngoMeyi nyakenye kwafa abasebenzi abane benkontileka eyakhayo ngesikhathi udonga luwela phezu kwabo eBallito kanti ngoJulayi odlule kwafa omunye umsebenzi emva kokuwa esuka ophahleni lwesakhiwo eMorningside, eThekwini. "Njengomnyango obhekele ezokwakha, uMeyer uzwakalisa ukukhathazeka okukhulu ngezigameko ezinjena ezibikwayo. Ukholwa wukuthi abasebenzi abangabakhi babambe iqhaza elikhulu ezakhiweni abantu abaningi abazibonayo. Izakhiwo zibonakala njengophawu lomnotho nomphakathi okukhulayo, kodwa lezi zigameko ezimbi ziyisikhumbuziso sempilo elahlekayo, " kusho uBhengu.Uthe njengoba kusalindwe imininingwano egcwele ngesigameko sayizolo, uMeyer unxusa bonke abathintekayo ukuba bavumele abomthetho nabafanele ukuba bathole imbangela yengozi."Udaba lokuphepha nendawo elungele ukusebenza, okungaba yimisebenzi emikhulu noma emincane, uMphathiswa ukuthathela phezulu okumanje uyahlangana nabakulo mkhakha nabengalo yomthetho zinyanga zonke ukuthola izisombululo," kusho uBhengu.Uthe lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuqedwa kokukhokhiswa imali kwezinkampani nodlame.Ubonge ukusukumela phezulu kwabezimo eziphuthumayo nabomthetho ngesikhathi kwehla lezi zigameko waphinde wadlulisa amazwi enduduzo emindenini yezisulu.
BAWOTHA ubomvu abaholi be-IFP ngokubuyiswa kwencwadi egxibha umsunguli weqembu, Inkosi Mangosuthu Buthelezi.I-IFP ikufanise nokudlalela ezitsheni ezifayo ukugaywa kabusha kwencwadi egxibha uButhelezi.Le ncwadi eyabhalwa yisishoshovu se-ANC, uMnuz Mzala Nxumalo, iqale ukudayisa kuleli ngoMsombuluko. Incwadi esihloko sithi, Gatsha Buthelezi: Chief with a double agenda, yabhalwa ngo-1988.Ngesikhathi sekufanele ishicilelwe uButhelezi wasabisa ngokuthatha izinyathelo zomthetho.Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni incwadi igcine ingashicilelwanga kuleli, yashicilelwa eNgilandi kuphela. Inkampani eshicilelayo, iJacana Media, imemezele ukuthi incwadi isiyatholakala kuleli, ibiza uR340.Incwadi iqukethe izinsolo eziningi ngoButhelezi okubalwa kuzo ukuthi wayesebenzisana nohulumeni wobandlululo kanye nokuthi uButhelezi wayengafanelwe ukubizwa ngoMntwana.UButhelezi waze wahamba ehlezi ekhala ngale ncwadi. Ezinkulumeni eziningi uButhelezi wayeke athi incwadi kaNxumalo yayiqukethe izinto ezingamampunge.Okhulumela i-IFP uMnuz Mkhuleko Hlengwa, ukugxekile ukubuyiswa kwale ncwadi."Besingakasiboni isimemezelo sabo (abeJacana Media). Le simemezelo sabo siwubudedengu obukhulu futhi siyasigxeka ngayo yonke indlela. AbeJacana Media badlala ngomlilo." UHlengwa uthe basabheka ukuthi yiziphi izinyathelo zomthetho abangazithatha ngalolu daba.Umndeni kaButhelezi uthe ushaqekile ngokubuyiswa kwencwadi.Inkosi Zuzifa kaMangosuthu Buthelezi, ithe ukubuyiswa kwencwadi ngeke kumnikeze uButhelezi ukuphumula. "Okumangazayo wukuthi kwakhulunywa kakhulu ngale ncwadi futhi kwavunyelwana ngokuthi iqukethe izinto ezingelona iqiniso ngoMntwana. Kwavunyelwana ngokuthi incwadi yayihlose ukungcolisa igama likaMntwana. Umuntu owayebhala incwadi wayebhala nje noma yini eyayizongcolisa igama loMntwana. Into eyayibangwa wukuthi uMntwana wayengaboni ngaso linye nabe-ANC, kubangwa indaba yokunswinywa kwezwe."Uthe:"Kuyadabukisa ukuthi noma engasekho akanikezwa ithuba lokuthi alale ngokuthula. Nawe ungufakazi wami ukuthi uMntwana ubehlezi ekhuluma ngale ncwadi. Ibingamphethe kahle le ncwadi. Kukaningi sibona ezama ukuqondisa izinto ezingelona iqiniso ezishiwo ngaye."Inkosi uZuzifa ithe basazohlala bewumndeni babone ukuthi yiziphi izinyathelo abangazithatha. "Besingakasiboni isimemezelo sokuthi incwadi izodayiswa kuleli. Kusafanele sihlale phansi uma sesithole konke sibone ukuthi sizokwenza njani."Sekukaningi incwadi kaNxumalo isusa ukukhuluma. Okubuye kwadunga kakhulu izinto yisinqumo se-ANC sokuqamba isifunda iZululand ngoNxumalo. I-ANC yaze yaba nesiphakamiso sokuthi noMasipala wesifunda iZululand, uqanjwe ngoNxumalo.Ngesikhathi kuqhubeka izingxoxo zokubuyisana phakathi kwe-ANC ne-IFP, ubuholi be-IFP bayalela ubuholi be-ANC ukuba bushintshe isiqumo sokuqanjwa kwesifunda ngoNxumalo.
BAKHALA ngokuphenduka inhlekisa emphakathini odokotela baKwaZulu-Natal, ababhuquza emakhaya neziqu zeminyaka eyisishiyagalolunye. Labo dokotela bathe ukungawutholi kwabo imisebenzi emva kokufunda isikhathi eside kangaka, kuzokwenza ukuthi intsha ingakuboni ukubaluleka kokufunda. Bakusho lokhu ngesikhathi beqhinqe eHhovisi likaNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, eMgungundlovu, izolo. Bafunge ngokuthi bazoqhinqa kuze kube uMnyango wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal, ufeza isethembiso sokukhangisa imisebenzi yodokotela. Ngokwezibalo zabo, bangu-137 odokotela abangaqashiwe KwaZulu-Natal.Abanye baqede ukufunda ngo-2023, abanye baqede ngonyaka odlule.UDkt Nobuhle Makhanya uthe abantu bayazibuza ukuthi kungani ebhuquza neziqu yize kuhlezi kuthiwa bayashoda odokotela? "Abantu abafani, abanye abaqondi ukuthi kungani sihleli emakhaya. Sigcina siphenduka inhlekisa ukuthi asiwutholi umsebenzi emva kokufunda iminyaka engaka. Kwabanye babona sengathi siyavilapha ukufuna imisebenzi njengoba kukhona inkolelo yokuthi thina bantu abasha siyavilapha. Le nto isifakela ingcindezi, abanye bagcina beba nokhwantalala."UDkt Makhanya uthe awukho umnyakazo owenziwa uMnyango wezeMpilo, yize kwezinye izifundazwe sebeqashiwe odokotela abangasebenzi kulandela isimemezelo sikaNgqongqoshe wezeMpilo kuzwelonke, uDkt Aaron Motsoaledi, sokuthi kuzoqashwa odokotela abangu-1 200 kuzwelonke."Side isikhathi sizama ukuxoxa nabaphethe umnyango esifundazweni. Ziningi izethembiso abangazigcinanga. UMphathiswa (uNksz Nomagugu Simelane) akafuni ukuzoxoxa nathi. Sihlezi simbona ehambela izibhedlela nakuma-podacast kodwa akanaso isikhathi sokuhlangana nathi. Ingakho sesifuna ukuba kungenelele uNdunankulu (uMnuz Thami Ntuli)." UDkt Thamsanqa Zakwe uthe impilo imile njengoba bengasebenzi."Abanye banemindeni, banezingane. Abanye bese bethenge imizi. Njengoba bengasasebenzi nje, imizi iyadliwa. Abantu bazokubona kanjani ukubaluleka kwemfundo uma kunabantu abahleli ekhaya namajazi?"UZakwe uthe bayazi ukuthi bayashoda odokotela ezikhungweni zempilo KwaZulu-Natal. "Odokotela basebenza amahora amade ngenxa yokuthi bayashoda. Iziguli azikutholi ukunakekelwa okufanele. Ingakho nje esibhedlela eMshiyeni, udokotela owayesaqeqeshwa aphoqwa ukuthi asebenze noma egula. Iqiniso lithi kwakungafanele udokotela osaqeqeshwa afakelwe ingcindezi yokuba asebenze noma egula. Kufanele engabe umnyango uqasha thina esihleli emakhaya."UZakwe uthe abayicabangi eyokusebenzela izibhedlela ezizimele noma eyokuya emazweni angaphandle."Ngeke sithi sifunde ngemali yabantu abakhokha intela bese siyosebenzela izibhedlela ezizimele. Lokho kusho ukuthi abantu kuzofanele ukuthi bakhokhe ukuze bathole usizo lwethu. Sizolwela ukuthi basiqashe. Siyazi ukuthi sekuze kwamukeleka emphakathini ukuthi kunenqwaba yothisha nonjiniyela abangasebenzi. Asifuni nakuthina ukuba kugcine sekuyinto eyejwayelekile."Ihhovisi likaNtuli noMnyango wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal, abazange bayiphendule imibuzo abayithunyelwe.

INkantolo yeSifunda eShowe igwebe indoda eneminyaka ewu-41 odilikajele abane ngamacala okudlwengula amadodakazi ayo amane eHluhluwe. Izigameko ezenzeke phakathi kuka-2015 no-2019 ngesikhathi izingane zineminyaka ephakathi kwemibili kuya kwengu-8.Ummangalelwa unguyise wezingane wegazi futhi wayehlala nazo nonina. Wayezidlwengula uma unina engekho. Abagilwa bathe uma bedlala phandle uyise wayebabizela endlini abadlwengule. Wayebasabisa ukuze bangalubiki loludaba.Udaba lwaze lwabikwa wunina wezingane emuva kokuqaphela ukulimala ezithweni zangasese. Ummangalelwa waboshwa esekhaya lakhe eHluhluwe.Ummangalelwa wawaphika wonke amacala. Umshushisi, uKacey Pillay ubize abagilwa bafakaza ukuthi badlwengulwa izikhawu eziningi. Nakuba unina wezingane washona lingakaphothulwa icala kodwa umshushisi ufake isicelo sokuthi isitatimende sakhe samukelwe njengobufakazi ngokuka-Section(3)(1)(c) of the Hearsay Evidence Act.Inkantolo yabona kufanele ukwamukela ubufakazi bukanina wezingane. Kwethulwa nobufakazi bombiko kadokotela i-J88.Umbuso ucele isigwebo esiqinile, ngokwethula izitatimende zabagilwa abazibhale beluswe wu-Amanda Pretty Nxumalo oyi-Court Preparation Officer.Omunye wabagilwa uthe yena ubehlala ejabule edlala kodwa manje usehlala edangele. Uthe akasabethembi abantu besilisa. Omunye uthe isigameko simphazamise kakhulu usehlala ecasukile. Omunye uthe uyamzonda ummangalelwa ngalokhu akwenzile.Ummangalelwa ugwetshwe udilikajele ngecala ngalinye lokudlwengula. Ngaphezu kwalokho inkantolo inqume ukuthi igama lakhe lifakwe ohlwini lwabanukubeza ngokocansi. Inkantolo inqume nokuthi akafanelwe wukuba nemvume yokuphatha isibhamu.

OKHULUMELA iMK, uMnuz Nhlamulo Ndhlela, usabisa ngokumthathela izinyathelo obengunobhala jikelele weqembu, uMnuz Floyd Shivambu, emva kokuba emsole ngokusebenzisa izidakamizwa nokucwila ezinkambeni zikaFaro.UShivambu ushaqise abaningi ngesikhathi ethi uNdhlela udla izidakamizwa nokuthi uphuza utshwala ngokweqile.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabesiteshi sethelevishini, i-eNCA. UNdhlela yisithutha esingumholi weMK. Uhlezi edle izidakamizwa, futhi uhlezi edakiwe. Uma esehubhuza amanga uNdhlela usebenzisa ukuthi uwumngani wendodakazi kaZuma, engazi lutho." UShivambu ungene ezintangeni ngesikhathi ebuzwa ukuthi ngabe wayebhekise endodakazini kaZuma, uNkk Duduzile Zuma-Sambudla, ngesikhathi ethi kukhona abantu abamthuka ebusuku bedle izidakamizwa.UShivambu usanda kuthi kukhona abantu abamchapha ngenhlamba ezinkundleni zokuxhumana uma sebedle izidakamizwa.UNkk Zuma-Sambudla wake wachapha uShivambu ngenhlamba enkundleni yezokuxhumana i-X. Akumina engathi akaye eMalawi (ayohlangana nomfundisi ofunelwa amacala kuleli, uShepherd Bushiri). Waqamba amanga wathi wayethunywe wuZuma." Akekho ezingeni lami."UNdhlela uthe amalungu eMK ajabule ngokukhishwa kukaShivambu. "Abantu bajabule kakhulu. Amalungu eMK abesekhathele wukuphathwa wumuntu ozithwele."UNdhlela uphinde wavikela uNkk Zuma-Sambudla."Uma kukhulunywa ngomuntu ongazi lutho yilona othe uNkk Zuma-Sambudla akazi lutho. Uma sikhuluma ngomuntu ongazi lutho, yilona ovele athathe isinqumo sokuyovakashela ezweni elingaphandle engakhulumanga namuntu. Umuntu ongazi lutho yilona ozama ukusungula iqembu elisha."UShivambu uyaqhubeka nezinhlelo zakhe zokusungula iqembu elisha.

Kuhlonzwe izikole ezingu-283, ezisezizindeni zezindawo lapho kudlange khona ubugebengu." Kuvunyelwane ngokuthi kuzohlolwa abasebenzi abasezikoleni ukuthi abakaze balahlwe yini amacala abucayi kuphinde kuseshwe izikhali nezinye izinto eziyingozi ezikoleni."Sifuna ukukucacisa ukuthi asizoba nazwelo kulabo abazophemba udlame ezikoleni zethu. Izikole ezokufunda nokufundisa hhayi udlame. Kuzokwakhiwa amakomiti azobandakanya othishanhloko, izigungu zabazali namaphoyisa. La makomiti azosebenzisana nesiteshi samaphoyisa esiseduzane nesikole," kusho uNksz Gwarube. Labo ngqongqoshe bafuna iphele indaba yamagenge ezikoleni, ukuchukuluzana kwabafundi, ukudayiswa kwezidakamizwa, ukuphathwa kwezikhali nodlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane.Kunxuswe nothisha ukuthi babambe iqhaza ukulwa nazo zonke lezi zinto ngokuthi baqaphe okwenzeka emathoyilethi ezikoleni."Okunye okumele bakwenze wukubheka izindawo ezicashile ngesikhathi samakhefu ukuthi kwenzekani kuzona. Okunye wukubheka nezinkundla zemidlalo lapho kuhlanganyela khona abafundi ukuthi benzani uma bendawonye," kusho uNksz Gwarube
ZIYAMSHUBELA izinto uNgqongqoshe weMfundo ePhakeme, uDkt Nobuhle Nkabane, njengoba iPhalamende selimbekele umnqamulajuqu wokuthi adalule bonke abantu ababeyingxenye yethimba elalimluleka ngokuqokwa kosihlalo bamabhodi ama-Sector Education and Training Authorities (SETAs). Lokhu kulandela izinsolo zokuthi kukhona amagama awashiya noma awakhipha ngesikhathi ehambisa uhlu lwalaba bantu, ekomitini lalo mnyango ePhalamende ngedlule.Izolo, ekhuluma nabezindaba, uSihlalo wekomiti uMnuz Tebogo Letsie, uthe bafuna lonke ulwazi olugcwele mayelana nethimba aliqoka elalimluleka ngabantu okumele abaqoke kuma-SETA. Lokhu kulandela isikhalazo esavela ezinhlakeni ezehlukene kubalwa namanye amaqembu ezepolitiki ePhalamende, ngamagama abantu ababeqokwe nguDkt Nkabane kuma-SETA, okubalwa osopolitiki abaziwayo abayi-ANC.Lezi zikhalazo zaphoqa uDkt Nkabane ukuthi agcine eluqala kabusha lolu hlelo lokuqoka abama-SETA. ULetsie uthe bafuna yonke imininingwane besuka beqokwa labo abasethimbeni likaDkt Nkabane, kuya emihlanganweni ababe nayo, imali ababezoyihola nolunye ulwazi."Sifuna bachaze neqhaza labo kuleli thimba. Sifuna uDkt Nkabane azophendula ePhalamende noma singakalutholi usuku azovela ngalo ngenxa yokuthi iPhalamende limatasa nokuphasisa isabelomali," usho kanje.Uveze ukuthi bafuna ukuthola kabanzi kuDkt Nkabane ngoba omunye wabantu athi babesethimbeni, ukuchithile lokhu. "Lokhu kuqubula imibuzo eminingi yingakho sithi kumele azosichazela. Simnike kuze kube uJuni 25 (kusasa), ukuthi aphendule imibuzo yekomiti ngamanye amagama okubonakala ukuthi acishiwe encwadini enamagama asithumelele yona," usho kanje.Uthe uma kungukuthi uDkt Nkabane ubekwa amacala ngokudukisa iPhalamende, angabhadla ejele izinyanga ezingu-12."Simatasa sixoxa nethimba labameli basePhalamende ngalolu daba olusematheni." NoMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa wafuna umbiko ogcwele kuDkt Nkabane ngalolu daba kanjalo nangesikhalazo esavela ngendlela aziphatha ngayo ngesikhathi evele ngaphambi kwaleli komiti, ebuzwa ngalolu daba.
WEDLULE emhlabeni washiya amawele anenyanga eyodwa ezelwe, owesifazane okuthiwa ubedayisa ngomzimba, okuvela ukuthi ubulawe yikhasimende lakhe eVerulam, eThekwini, ngeSonto.Lokhu kudalulwe abenkampani yonogada eqapha ubugebengu kule ndawo, iReaction Unit South Africa (Rusa). Okhulumela le nkampani, uMnuz Prem Balram, uthe imininingwane yokuthi lona wesifazane ungubani wakwabani, ivezwe yisoka lakhe emva kwesigameko. "Isoka lakhe elifike endaweni yesigameko, yilo eliqinisekise ukuthi ungubani. Liphinde latshela onogada bethu ukuthi umufi ungunina wezingane ezingamawele, ezinenyanga eyodwa zizelwe,” kusho uBalram. Elandisa ngesigameko, uBalram uthe lona wesifazane kuthiwa ubulawe ngowesilisa obeyikhasimende lakhe, enkabeni yedolobha eVerulam."Onogada bethu babizelwe endaweni yesigameko esemgwaqweni u-Ireland, bathola owesifazane obekubikwa ukuthi ugwaziwe,” kusho yena. Uthe onogada bafike endaweni yesigameko ngabo-7.42 ebusuku, bazithela phezu kwesidumbu sikamufi sidindilizile erenki yamatekisi aya eNdwedwe. "Ubenenxeba lokugwazwa ngemuva,” usho kanje.Uthe abazizwele, bathe lona wesifazane kuyaziwa ukuthi udayisa ngomzimba kule ndawo, aphinde adle nezidakamizwa. "Bathe ungene esikhotheni esiphakathi kwerenki yamatekisi aya eNdwedwe nomgwaqo u-R102 nowesilisa obemcele ukuba baye ocansini,” kusho uBalram.Uthe abanye abadla izidakamizwa nalabo abahlala emgwaqweni, bezwe esekhala ecela usizo, ngaphambi kokuba bambone ephuma esikhotheni, maqede wawa, waquleka."Umsolwa ubesaqhubeka nokumjaha kodwa wavele wabaleka esebona ukuthi kukhona abambonayo,” kusho uBalram. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uCaptain Ntathu Ndlovu, uthe amaphoyisa aseVerulam aphenya icala lokubulala kulandela isigameko esenzeke ngeSonto ebusuku, erenki yamatekisi aya eNdwedwe, edolobheni eVerulam."Owesifazane oneminyaka engu-21, kuthiwa ugwazwe wabulawa owesilisa ongaziwa, obonakale ebaleka endaweni yesigameko emva kwesikhashana kuzwakale owesifazane ekhala ecela usizo,” kusho uCapt Ndlovu. Uthe umufi uqinisekiswe njengoseshonile abezimo eziphuthumayo endaweni yesigameko. Uveze ukuthi akukaboshwa muntu ngalesi sehlakalo. Ayiphumelelanga imizamo yeSolezwe yokuthola izihlobo noma isoka likamufi izolo, kwaze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela.
IBONGWE isadla anhlamvana ngendina esiyikhathulile ekufukuleni ezemfundo kwiSekethe yaseMhlathuze Inkosi yesizwe saKwaMadlebe, eMpangeni. Inkosi Zenzo Zungu beyikade yenzelwe indumezuliu yomcimbi ngothishanhloko bezikole zakule ndawo ngenhloso yokuyibonga ngendlela efukula ngayo ezemfundo kule ndawo.Kulo mcimbi obukade usehholo lomphakathi lakuyona le ndawo kuvele izinto eziningi ezenziwa yinkosi ezikoleni ezehlukene endaweni. Phakathi kwazo kubalwa ukuqinisekisa kwayo ukuthi kuba nokuthula ezikoleni iqeda izimpi, ilekelele abafundi abantulayo iphinde yehle yenyuka ifunele imifundaze labo bafundi abasuke bebonakala benze kahle ezifundweni zabo.Ikhuluma neSolezwe inkosi ithe nakuba yenza konke okusemandleni ayo ngenhloso yokuqinisekisa ukuthi konke kuhamba kahle kwezemfundo ezikoleni zendawo kodwa lokho isuke ikwenza ingabheke inzuzo.Idalule ukuthi ezemfundo ziyinto eseqhulwini kuyona ngoba ifuna ukuthi uma kwenzeka ihamba emhlabeni kodwa kukhulunywe indaba yokuthi ishiye isizwe esinabantu abasha abafundile hhayi ababalakele isikole.''Ngifisa ukuthi uma ngihamba emhlabeni ngishiye isizwe esinabantu abasha abafundile futhi abakuqonda kahle kamhlophe ukuthi isho ukuthini imfundo kulesi sikhathi esiphila kusona,'' isho kanjena.UMnuz Mandlakhe Khoza onguthishanhloko wesikole sakule ndawo iSigisi Primary uthe idinga ukushayelwa elikhulu ihlombe inkosi ngomsebenzi ewenzela izikole.Uthe nabo kuyabajabulisa kakhulu ukuba nohlobo lwenkosi ezihlupha ngezemfundo ngoba lokho kudala ukuthi izinto zibe lula ezikoleni ezahlukene.Uthe bekumqoka kakhulu ukuba inkosi ibongwe isadla enhlamvana ngeqhaza layo kwezemfundo.''Kwezinye izikole ezikhona lapha kunamagumbi agcine esakhiwa ngenxa yosizo lwayo inkosi okuyinto esikholwa ukuthi idinga ukushayelwa elikhulu ihlombe. Ngisho izimpi zezigodi ebeziphazamisa izikole azisekho ngenxa yokuthi inkosi ibingenelela ngaso sonke isikhathi. Yingakho sikholwa ukuthi mkhulu umsebenzi inkosi esiwenzele izikole zethu kule ndawo," kusho uKhoza.Ugcizelele kakhulu ukuthi amakhosi afana nalawa yiwona kanye adingekayo kulesi sikhathi samanje.Emcimbinii inkosi igixatshwezwe ngendathane yezipho ebezivela kothishanhloko bezikole zendawo.
KUZOBIZWA ofakazi abangu-22 uma sekuqala ukuqulwa kwecala lokubulawa kukaNksz Ayabongwa Mjilo (23) okwatholakala isidumbu sakhe sigqitshiwe ngemuva kwendlu maqede kwaboshwa uMnuz Mfanafuthi Kunene (37).Eyofakazi abangu-22 ihlaluke eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini, uKunene evele kule nkantolo. Kwavela ukuthi wambulala ngokumklinya ngaphambi kokuba amgqibe esikhotheni esingemuva kwendlu, eMaotana, eNanda. Egcina ukubonakala esadla anhlamvana uNksz Mjilo kuthiwa wayekade ephuma endaweni yokudlela eseMhlanga, ngoDisemba 24. Kwavela ukuthi wagcinwa ehamba noKunene. Kuthiwa umsolwa wabonakala esukuma emlandela umufi kade besendaweni yokudlela. Ngaphambilini kwavela ukuthi ukuze umsolwa akhalelwe ngamasongo kaSigonyela, kwalekelela kakhulu amakhamera aseCappello (indawo yokudlela), okuyiwona anikeza umkhombandlela nomkhondo emaphoyiseni.Omele uMbuso, uMshushisi Calvin Govender, uqale watshela inkantolo ukuthi ohlangothini lwabo sebeluphothulile uphenyo mayelana nakho konke okwenzeka kuleli cala. Kube sekuvunyelwana ngokuthi icala selingadluliselwa eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini ngoJulayi 24, 2025. Ngalolu suku lizobe liqala liqulwa kubizwa nofakazi abehlukene.UGovender uthe uKunene bambeke amacala amathathu - elokuthumba, elokubulala kanye nelokucisha ubufakazi njengoba umsolwa kuthiwa wayezama ukugqiba ubufakazi ngokuthi agqibe isidumbu, aze afake nosimende phezu "kwethuna". Uthe ukholwa ukuthi ofakazi abanabo bazokwazi ukuthi balekelele inkantolo ngakho konke okudingekayo ukuze kugwetshwe umsolwa. Umsolwa ubelokhu efaka izibuko aphinde azikhiphe, abheke phansi. Ubegqoke i-jean emnyama kanye nejakhethi emnyama.Bekukhona nonina uNkk Elizabeth Kunene (uMaZulu), obonakale eciphiza izinyembezi ngesikhathi kumenyezelwa ukudluliselwa kawaleli cala enkantolo enkulu. Esekhuluma neSolezwe uNkk Kunene uthe yonke le nto iyamhlukumeza kakhulu kangangoba usedla namaphilisi. Ugcizelele ukuthi ufisa kube nokukhumelana umlotha phakathi kwemindeni.Uthe kubuhlungu ngoba lo omunye akasekho emhlabeni, ngeke esakwazi ukuthi azikhulumele. Uncome ubuhle bukamufi wathi wayengakujabulela ukuthi agcine eba umalokazane wakwakhe. Uqhube wathi uyabuqonda ubunzima umndeni kamufi obhekene nabo.''Mina ngikhulele enkonzweni ngingumama wenkolo. Yingakho nje ngifisa ukuthi kube khona ukukhuluma okuba khona phakathi kwale mindeni yomibili,'' usho kanje.UKunene wayeyimenenja yase-call centre okwakusebenza kuyo umufi.
IBAGIXABEZE ngenqwaba yodilikajele ngoLwesihlanu, iNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini, abesilisa abathathu abalahlwe amacala okubulala osomatekisi ezindaweni ezehlukene KwaZulu-Natal. Laba besilisa oNkazimulo Ndlovu (28), Mzameleni Tsepo Majola (33) noMondli Fihlela (35), bagixabezwe ngodilikajele abangu-8, neminyaka engu-187 bebhadla ejele.Phakathi kwamacala abalahlile kukhona awokubulala, awokuzama ukubulala, ukuthumba nokubamba inkunzi ngenhloso yokulimaza. Ngokusho kokhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe lawa macala, laba besilisa bawenza eMayville, KwaDukuza, Empangeni naKwaMsane."INkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini ibanike odilikajele abayisishiyagalombili neminyaka engu-187 bebhadla ejele,” kusho uNetshiunda.Ecacisa ngamacala, uNetshiunda uthe edluliselwa yiziteshi zamaphoyisa ezehlukene esifundazweni ophikweni oluphenya amacala ayamaniswa nemboni yamatekisi esifundazweni, iProvincial Taxi Violence Unit. Uveze ukuthi lolu phiko lwabe selubopha abasolwa abathathu ngoFebhuwari 2022, laphinde lakwazi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abaphumi ngaphandle kwaze kwaba bayagwetshwa.Uthe uNdlovu waseMpangeni ugixabezwe ngodilikajele abayisithupha neminyaka engu-92 ngaphezulu. "UFihlela waseNdwedwe unikwe odilikajele ababili ebhadla ejele, waphinde wagixabezwa ngeminyaka engu-50 ngaphezulu,” kusho yena. Uqhube wathi uMajola waseMkhandlwini, eMelmoth, uzobhadla ejele iminyaka engu-45.Uthe bobathathu abalahlwe amacala, inkantolo ibuye yehlulela ukuthi akubafanele ukuba nezibhamu. Khonamanjalo: Uphiko lwamaphoyisa iProvincial Murder and Robbery Unit, Point Tracing Team neMlazi Trio Task Team, lubophe umsolwa oneminyaka engu-28 oyamaniswa necala lokubulawa kwabayisishiyagalombili emijondolo yaseZamani kwa-U eMlaza, ngoMeyi, kulo nyaka. "Amaphoyisa athole umkhondo elungwini lomphakathi, umsolwa wabhadanywa ebhace emijondolo yaseMhlabeni, eMlazi,” kusho uNetshiunda. Uthe umsolwa okuvele ukuthi wakhishelwa incwadi egunyaza ukuboshwa kwakhe ngoNovemba, ngonyaka odlule, ngecala lokukhomba umuntu ngesibhamu, uzovela maduze enkantolo.
IMALI kuthiwa yiyona ebe wumsusa wengxabano kwaze kwagcina sekufa ngesihluku amasosha amabili aKwaZulu-Natal, ophiko lweSouth African National Defense Force (SANDF) enkambini yamasosha, iMacadamia Military, eduze kweKomatipoort, esifundazweni iMpumalanga. Lokhu kuvezwe umthombo weSolezwe, ocele ukungadalulwa.Esigamekweni, kuthiwa kushone isosha elingelokuzalwa eMgungundlovu, okuvela ukuthi ligwazwe uzakwabo ephindelela. Kuvela ukuthi umsolwa uphinde wagwaza walimaza omunye uzakwabo ongowokuzalwa KwaMashu, okuthiwa ubezama ukulamulela umufi obegwazwa. Kuthiwa sibi isimo kumgilwa osinde ngokulambisa. Umsolwa kuthiwa ugcine ngokuyozikhiyela egumbini lakhe, lapho afike wazigwaza khona emqaleni ezinquma, okwenze wagcina ephangalala naye.Umthombo uthe: "Umbulali waziwa njengomashonisa, yize lokhu kungavumelekile emasosheni kodwa ubezizamela eceleni. Uthe uma ebuya emsebenzini, wathola lona elele, wamgwaza waze washonela khona lapho.” "Lo obezama ukulamula, wehlulekile njengoba naye evele wamgwaza, walimala kanzima,” kusho umthombo. Uthe imbangela yesigameko igodliwe."Kufihlwa ihlazo, imbangela imayelana nemali,” usho kanje. Uveze ukuthi simuncu isimo kulandela isigameko njengoba senzeke kungazelele. "Umsolwa ubengumuntu okahle, ongenalo udlame,” kusho umthombo.Kuvela ukuthi bonke abathintekayo esigamekweni bafike eMacademia ngonyaka odlule, besuka enkambini i-5 South African Infantry Battalion, eMnambithi. Kule nkambi okwenzeke kuyo isigameko, kuthiwa kugcinwa amasosha asuke ezoyotshalwa emngceleni wakuleli neMozambique. OweSANDF, othumele isitatimende abezindaba ngeSonto, uRear Admiral Prince Tshabalala, uthe bayasiqinisekisa isigameko esinyantisa igazi esenzeke enkambini iMacadamia Military. "Ilungu leSANDF ebeselinikwe imvume yokuthi seliqedile ukusebenza, lihambe layohlasela uzakwabo endaweni ahlala kuyo,” kusho uTshabalala. Uthe umgilwa kumenele endaweni yesigameko, kwathi umsolwa wafa kamuva njengoba naye ezikhiyele endlini, wazigwaza emqaleni.Uthe beyiSANDF ngokubambisana namaphoyisa baqale uphenyo ngesigameko. "Amagama abafi azogodlwa kuze kuba ukuthi imindeni yabo iyaziswa ngokufanele. Eminye imininingwane, izovezwa njengoba kuqhubeka uphenyo,” kusho uTshabalala, othe badlulisa okukhulu ukudabuka emindenini yabafi.

INkantolo yezeMali eThekwini igwebe uNhlakanipho Wiseman Dlamini (45), iminyaka ewu-10 emuva kokulahlwa ngamacala amabili enkohlakalo.Wenza lobu bugebengu phakathi kuka-Novemba 2019 noJanuwari 2020.UDlamini wayesebenza kuMasipala uMsunduzi eyibamba le-Fleet Control Advisor. Inkampani i-EWCop yayiqashelwe ukuhlinzeka ngobuchwepheshe bokwelusa ukuhamba kwezimoto.Ngo-2018 inkontileka ye-EWCop yaphela, yase ivuselelwa inyanga nenyanga kusalindwe isinqumo ngethenda. UDlamini wakhuluma nabe-EWCop ecela ukuthi bamnike okuthile ukuze kuvuselelwe ithenda yabo. UDlamini wabuye wakhonga uR 100 000 ukuze le nkampani ikhokhelwe imali yanyangazonke. Kwacushwa umgoga ngokuka Section 252 A of the Criminal Procedure Act 51 0f 1997,kwaboshwa uDlamini eqeda ukwemukela imali yomgoga.Ubufakazi ngokuka-Section 252A okuwumgoga obuhambisana nengxoxo eqoshiwe kwethulwa wuMshushisi u-Adv. Reenai Ramouthar.UDlamini ugwetshwe iminyaka ewu-8 ngecala ngalinye lenkohlakalo. Iminyaka ewu-6 ecaleni lesibili uzoyidonsa kanyekanye nesigwebo ecaleni lokuqala nokusho ukuthi uzodonsa iminyaka ewu-10.
USanele Dlamini oneminyaka engu-28 ubudala uvele okokuqala eNkantolo yeMantshi eMlaza nenqwaba yamacala okubulala.UDlamini uthwese amacala ayisishiyagalombili okubulala amadoda ayisithupha nabesifazane ababili, abaneminyaka ephakathi kuka-22 no-40 ubudala, batholakale bedindilize edamini legazi enamanxeba okudutshulwa nelokuzama ukubulala.Amacala asukela esigamekweni sango-16 Meyi 2025 ethaveni emjondolo yaseZama esigcemeni sakwa-U, eMlaza. Kubikwa ukuthi abashonile bebengaphakathi kulo muzi ngesikhathi kungena abasolwa abangaziwa bavulela ngenhlamvu bashonela endaweni yesigameko. Icala lihlehlele u-30 Juni 2025 ukuze kulalelwe isicelo sebheyili.
KUKHULU ukukhathazeka kwabakhele uMasipala Inkosi uMtubatuba kulandela izigameko zokubulawa kwasebekhulile kule ndawo. Kwesakamuva nje, kutholwe isidumbu sikaMnuz Mandlenkosi Nzuza waseDukuduku, KwaNdonyana, iminyaka yakhe elinganiselwa ngaphezu kwengu-60, sinamanxeba okugencwa ehlathini eliseduze kwedamu laseSt Lucia. Kuthiwa isidumbu ebesilimele kakhulu sitholwe abantu abebedlula ngendlela ngoLwesibili ekuseni base behlaba umkhosi. Kanti kusolwa ukuthi ubulawe ngayizolo.Lesi sigameko silandela esinye esenzeke ngoFebhuwari kulo nyaka eMfekayi lapho kwatholwa isidumbu sikaNkk Nelisiwe Madolofiya Bukhosini (94) endlini engahlali muntu futhi engenalo uphahla. Kuthiwa kwabonakala kusha umuzi kamufi owayehlala yedwa nokwaba yindida ukungatholakali kwakhe endlini eyayisha kwazise wayehlala kuyo. Isidumbu sakhe sathola kwenye indlu kanti izihlobo zisola ukuthi wahudulwa wayofakwa kuyo.Okunye okwazimangaza ukutholakala kukamufi elele ebheke phezulu ikhanda libheke ngasemnyango kwase kuvalwa isicabha sendlu. Zithi zisola ukuthi umenzi wobubi washisa indlu ukudidisa umkhondo. Okhulumela lo masipala, uMnuz Khulekani Msweli, uthe sezandile izigameko zokubulawa kwezaguga kule ndawo.Uthe emasontweni amathathu edlule kubulawe ikhehla lakwaSibiya ngokugwazwa ngesikele umzukulu walo. UMsweli uthe umasipala unazo izinhlelo zokufundisa umphakathi ngokuphathwa kwabantu abadala."Angazi noma yishwa yini ngoba ngoLwesibili okutholwe ngalo isidumbu sikaNzuza besinomkhankaso wokuqwashisa ngokuhlukunyezwa kwabantu asebekhulile sihambisana nenhlangano engenzi inzuzo, i-Age in Action, kanti ntambama ngalolo suku sizothola umbiko ngalesi sigameko," kusho uMsweli. Ngesikhathi imeya kalo masipala, uMnuz Mxolisi Mthethwa, ihambele umndeni wakwaNzuza kuleli sonto ikhuze isihlava sokubulawa kwabantu abadala. Inxuse abezomthetho ukuba baqinise uphenyo zitholakale izigilamkhuba ukuze umndeni nomphakathi bakwazi ukuhlala ngokuthula.Inhloso yokuyovela kulo mndeni bekuwukuyowukhalisa, kubukwe isimo nokuzwa ukuthi umasipala ungalekelela kanjani kwazise umufi ushiye indodana eneminyaka engu-30. Kuyaqapheleka ukuthi ukubulawa kwezaguga akwandile kuphela ezindaweni zasemakhaya nasemadolobheni amakhulu ziyabikwa. Emasontweni edlule kugwazwe kwafa isalukazi esilinganiselwa eminyakeni engu-80 kwathi indodakazi (60) yaso yalima ngesikhathi bengenelwa ekhaya labo ePhoenix, eThekwini.
KUNGASE kube nezinguquko ezinhlelweni zomhlangano kaJulayi waminyaka yonke webandla lakwaShembe ohlangothini lwaseBuhleni oluholwa iNkosi uMduduzi "UNyazilwezulu" Shembe. Lokhu kulandela ukuthi uhlangothi lwaseThembezinhle oluholwa yiNkosi Phinda "UKukhanyakwelanga" Shembe, luthenge indawo iNtanda, eNdwedwe, ebisetshenziswa yizintombi zaseBuhleni ukukha izintingo eziyiswa kuNyazi eBuhleni, uma kuqala umhlangano kaJulayi.Izintombi ziya eNtanda zihamba nabaphathi bazo zifike zikhe izintingo, zilalele izwi futhi zigobe amadlangala khona. Ngakusasa, zivuka ziye eBuhleni zithule izintingo kuNyazi, ziviliyele kube kuhle kudele.Ukuthengwa kwale ndawo kusho ukuthi abaseBuhleni ngeke besakwazi ukuyisebenzisa kusukela kulo Julayi, njengoba sekungeyaseThembezinhle. Kuthintwa uMshumayeli Chancey Sibisi, waseThembezinhle, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi le ndawo bayithengile. "Njengoba ngikhuluma nawe nje, ngikhona siyalungisa ngoba le ndawo kufanele siyisebenzise ngoJulayi," kusho uSibisi kuzwakala ukuthi uneme.Uthe le ndawo umuzi omdala wakwaShembe owawubizwa ngeBethlehem Judiya, okwathi uma kuba nezingxabano ebandleni ngo-1976, yagcina ithengwe umndeni wabamhlophe wakwa-Armstrong.Uthe abaseThembezinhle baphinde bayithenga kuwona lo mndeni emva kokuzikhalela kuwo. Ebuzwa ukuthi njengoba abaseBuhleni bebe yisebenzisa le ndawo kuzokwenzekani, uthe: "Sinenkosi yethu, thina bantu ngeke sasho ukuthi benzenjani futhi ngeke sithi siyabamema. Uma besafuna ukuqhubeka nokuyisebenzisa, kuyoya ngokuthi bacela kanjani, esikwaziyo ukuthi sivusa umuzi omdala kaBhombela."Okhulumela abaseBuhleni, uMnuz Thokozani Mncwabe, uthe uShembe akaze aphazamiseke uma enza umsebenzi wasezulwini. "Ngisho uShembe angathi izintombi azilulande eMlaza uthingo noma eNkosini yamaQadi noma kuWest Street, kuyoba njalo. Izinhlelo zasezulwini zihlale zikhona oNyazini," kusho uMncwabe.Uthe lolu daba uqale ukuluzwa ngonyaka odlule.Uqhube wathi, uShembe unemfihlo yakhe yedwa ngakho-ke abantu nezintombi abangakhathazeki. "Silinde izwi loNyazi elizotshelwa khona ngabasezulwini, abantu abeze eBuhleni, uyangena umdedele mhlaka 1 Julayi, zonke izinhlelo zihamba kahle kakhulu, akukho okungeke kwenzeke," kusho Mncwabe.Ephetha, uthe baphuma nasentabeni iNhlangakazi baya "ezweni lesithembiso iKhenana ngoba singafuni kuchitheke igazi".
IZOBA nobuholi obusha i-ANC kuzona zonke izifunda zaKwaZulu-Natal, okubalwa kuzo nezifunda ezinkulu iTheku neMoses Mabhida.I-ANC isizoholwa amathimba esikhashana kuzona zonke izifunda eziyisishiyagalolunye zaKwaZulu-Natal.Lezi zindaba zivezwe okhulumela i-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Fanele Sibisi. Lokhu ukuphelelwa izikhundla kwabaholi abaqavile okubalwa kubo owayeyimeya yaseThekwini, uNkk Zandile Gumede, obengusihlalo esifundeni iTheku neMeya kaMasipala waseMsunduzi, uMnuz Mzimkhulu Thebolla, obengusihlalo we-ANC esifundeni iMoses Mabhida.USibisi uthe sebeluqedile uhlelo lokuqoka amathimba esikhashana azohola i-ANC ezifundeni.Amathimba aqokwe emva kokuba ubuholi be-ANC kuzona zonke izifunda, buphelelwe isikhathi obusibekelwe ukuba bubambe izingqungquthela zokukhetha ubuholi. Ubuholi be-ANC ezifundeni kufanele bukhethwe njalo emuva kweminyaka emithathu.Iningi lobuholi obebuphethe izifunda KwaZulu-Natal, bakhethwa ngasekupheleni kuka-2021, obunye bakhethwa ngasekuqaleni kuka-2022.Ubuholi bokugcina ukuphelelwa isikhathi ubuholi besifunda iHarry Gwala, lapho bekuphethe khona, uMnuz Zamo Nxumalo, ophinde abe yimeya ephethe kulesi sifunda. Isikhathi sobuholi bakulesi sifunda buphele ngenyanga eyedlule.USibisi uthe maduze bazokuba nemihlangano lapho bezokwethula ngokusemthethweni ubuholi bezifunda.USibisi uthe ubuholi obusha bunikezwe umsebenzi wokuba bakhe kabusha izinhlaka zenhlangano. "Ubuholi obusha bunikezwe umsebenzi wokuba bulungise ubudlelwano be-ANC nemiphakathi kanye nezinhlaka ezikhona emiphakathini. Ubuholi obusha buzoqapha ukusebenza kwabaholi abajutshwe komasipala buphinde benze isiqiniseko sokuthi omasipala bayazihambisa izidingo kubantu. Ibona obuzolungiselela ukhetho lohulumeni basekhaya oluzokuba ngo-2026."Khonamanjalo: I-ANC KwaZulu-Natal ibambe umhlangano wokuzinuka amakhwapha obuhanjelwe amadlelandawonye, iSACP, Sanco neCosatu.Kulo mhlangano obuseThekwini kubhungwe ngezinselelo ezikhungethe omasipala. Umdidiyeli we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Jeff Radebe, uthe bathathe izinqumo ezinqala kulo mhlangano.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ethula inkulumo yokuvala lo mhlangano wezinsuku ezimbili."Umyalezo ucacile. Kufanele senze izinto ngendlela eyehlukile. Kufanele silungise isimo komasipala. Lokhu akufanele sigcine ngokukusho ngomlomo kodwa kufanele sikweze. Siphelile isikhathi sokukhuluma kodwa kufanele silungise." URadebe uthe ukungenzi kahle komasipala kwenza ukuthi abantu bangayivoteli i-ANC."Ziningi izikhalazo ezikhona. Abantu bakhala ngokunganakekelwa kwengqalasizinda kanye nokungaphathwa kahle kwemali. Lokhu kwenza ukuthi abantu bengayethembi i-ANC."
Sandile isibalo samasosha avele enkantolo kulandela ukuboshwa kwamasosha amabili ngeSonto ngamacala okubulala iphoyisa elaliphenya ithimba lasemasosheni lemigulukudu ethumba abantu.Amalungu angu-12 ombutho okhethekile we-South African National Defence Force’ (SANDF) okuhlanganisa nenkampani ye-Special Forces eSebenza ngaphansi kwe-SANDF, avele okokuqala eNkantolo yeMantshi yase-Randburg ngezinsolo zokuthumba, ukubulala, ukukhwabanisa, ukuphazamisa ukusebenza kwengalo yomthetho, ukwenza isitatimende esingamanga ngaphansi kwesifungo kanye nokwebiwa kwemoto. Abasolwa ababili baboshwe ngeSonto ngesikhathi kuqhubeka umkhankaso ohlanganyelwe yiDirectorate for Priority Crime Investigation (DPCI), kwathi abasolwa abayishumi bazinikela emaphoyiseni namhlanje ekuseni. Amacala abo asukela ekuthunjweni kuka-Abdella Hussain Abadiga noKadir Jemal Abotese eMall of Africa ngomhlaka-29 Disemba 2022. Laba ababili kusolakala ukuthi baphoqwa ukuba bangene emotweni bayiswa e-Zwartkop Military Base. Akwaziwa ukuthi bakuphi kuze kube yimanje, kanti abasolwa babhekene namacala okubabulala. ULieutenant Colonel Frans Mathipa woKlebe washona ngesikhathi eshayela eHammanskraal ku-N1 Highway ngomhla Karen Agasti 2023, kwavela ukuthi wahlaselwa oshayasibhamu owamnqokloza ekhanda imoto ihamba. Kuthiwa umbulali wayehamba nemoto yombutho we-SANDF eyayimlandela. Ngosuku lokufa kwakhe, uMathipa wayelandela umkhondo wethimba lemigulukudu ethimba abantu liholwa ngamalungu e-SANDF. Icala lihlehliselwe umhlaka-01 Julayi 2025 ukuze afake isicelo sebheyili, kanti abasolwa basagqunywe esitokisini.

UShezi ubehlezi ephambili ekwesekeni uZuma kusukela ngesikhathi esakwi-ANC.UShezi, owayeyingxenye yabantu ababezibiza ngaRadical Economic Transformation Forces kwi-ANC, wayephambili ekuhleleni imicimbi yokweseka uZuma uma evela ezinkantolo ngesikhathi i-ANC ikhiphe umyelelo wokuthi amalungu ayo angayi ukuyokweseka abaholi ababhekene namacala ezinkantolo.UShezi wayengabanye babantu ababephambili ekwesekeni uZuma ngo-2021, ngesikhathi ebhekene nokuboshelwa icala lokwedelela umyalelo weNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo. Ngo-2023, uShezi waba ingxenye yokusungulwa kweqembu elaliholwa omunye owayeseka uZuma, uMnuz Carl Nehuis, i-African Radical Transformation Alliance.UShezi wabuye wajoyina iMK emva kokuvalwa kwe-ARTA eyavalwa emva kokuba uNehuis ejoyine i-EFF.Elinye igama eliqaphelekayo ohlwini lweMK elaloyo obeyilungu le-EFF ePhalamende, uNksz Khanyisile Litchfield. UNksz Litchfield walaxaza i-EFF wajoyina iMK ngesikhathi kushiya inqwaba yabaholi abaqavile kwi-EFF bejoyina iMK.UShivambu akabonwa nangalukhalo kulolu hlu. UShivambu uphezu komkhankaso wokuxoxa nabantu bakuleli, lapho efuna ukuzwa khona ukuthi sikhona yini isidingo sokuthi aqale iqembu elisha.UShivambu uthe ngeke ashiye kwiMK yize esezinhlelweni zokuvula iqembu elisha.I-MK ayikasho lutho ngoShivambu, kwagcina ngokuthi okhulumela iqembu, uMnuz Nhlamulo Ndhlela, akhiphe uShivambu eqoqweni lweMK lakuWhatsApp.Izolo, uShivambu ubeqhubeka nokumemezela izinhlelo zakhe zokuhambela zonke izingxenye zakuleli lapho ezokuba ethatha khona imibono yabantu.Emibhalweni ayifake ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, uShivambu unxuse abantu ukuba babe yingxenye yezingxoxo.
