SEKUQUBUKE izikhalazo ngezindleko eziphezulu zokuhlela nokusingatha inkulumongxoxo kazwelonke ngesimo sezwe.Amaqembu ezepolitiki nezinyunyana zabasebenzi azifuni nokuyizwa eyesiphakamiso sokuthi uhulumeni uzosebenzisa u-R700 million, ukuhlela isithangami ngesimo sezwe.Ikomiti elihlela lesi sithangami lisanda kuveza ukuthi kuzodingeka u-R700 million ukusihlela. Amaqembu ezepolitiki nezinyunyana bathe le mali inkulu kakhulu, bathi ibingasetshenziselwa ukwenza izinto ezibalulekile.Izinhlelo zokusingatha isithangami ngesimo sezwe zamenyezelwa uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, owabe eseqoka ikomiti labantu abangu-32 okuyilo elizohola izingxoxo.Leli komiti lizoba nomhlangano omkhulu ngo-Agasti 15, bese kulandela imihlangano yomphakathi ezokuba sezindaweni ezahlukene. Umholi we-EFF, uMnuz Julius Malema, uthe kuyamangaza ukuthi uhulumeni awunayo imali yokwelekelela abakhahlanyezwe yizikhulu KwaZulu-Natal kodwa unemali yokuhlela isithangami sikazwelonke."Lapha kuyokhulunywa nje kuphela. Bafuna ukusebenzisa u-R700 million ukuvula nje umlomo. Okubi imigwaqo namabhuloho awekho kodwa bona bafuna ukusebenzisa imali engaka. Bafuna ukuntshontsha imali. Asiyifuni inkulumongxoxo. Abathathe le mali bayothuthukisa ezemfundo. Sifuna kufundwe mahhala ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme."ICosatu ithe uhulumeni akufanele uvume ukukhokha u-R700 million. Okhulumela iCosatu ePhalamende, uMnuz Matthew Parks, uthe le mali inkulu kakhulu."Okusijabulisayo ukuthi uhulumeni akakayivumi, kuseyisiphakamiso nje sabantu abathile. Kuyashaqisa ukuthi kukhona abantu abangaba nesibindi sokuphakamisa ukuba kusetshenziswe imali engaka ukuhlela isithangami. Nakuba sihambisana nokuba kusingathwe inkulumongxoxo, asihambisani nokumoshwa kwemali. Sinethemba lokuthi uNgqongqoshe wezeziMali uzoqapha ngeso lokhozi ukusebenza kwemali. Abakhohlwe labo abacabanga ukuthi uhulumeni uzosebenzisa imali engaka ukuhlela inkulumo ngxoxo."Okhulumela umengameli, uMnuz Vincent Magwenya, uthe akukavunyelwana ngemali ezosetshenziswa ukuhlela isithangami sikazwelonke. "Le mali okukhulunywa ngayo kuseyisiphakamiso nje sekomiti elihlela isithangami. Uhulumeni uwona ozonquma ukuthi imalini ezosetshenziswa. Kusazoboniswana bese kuthathwa isinqumo ngesabelomali esizodingeka."UMagwenya uthe uNgqongqoshe wezeziMali, uMnuz Enoch Godongwana, nguyena ozothatha isinqumo sokugcina ngalolu daba. "Asikho isidingo salo msindo okhona njengamanje ngoba uhulumeni awukasithathi isinqumo."
USUTHOLA izinsongo umndeni womfundi ozibulele ngeledlule waseMaphephetheni, eNanda, kulandela ukushaqwa kwababili abasolwa ngokumthumba baphinde bamdlwengule bephindelela ngasekuqaleni kwale nyanga. U-Athabile Khanyi (17) obefunda uGrade 11 esikoleni iMakhapha Combined, ushonele esibhedlela. Lokhu kulandela ukuphuza inqwaba yamaphilisi ngoMsombuluko odlule, emva kokubuyiswa abasolwa ababili, okuthiwa babemthumbe impelasonto yonke, beshintshana ngaye, bemdlwengula. Abasolwa abantu besilisa abaziwayo endaweni, abasebenza ematekisini angaphansi kweMaphephetheni Taxi Association. Olwezinsongo ezibhekiswe emndenini, luvezwe udadewabo kamufi uNksz Ntombifikile Mthembu izolo, ngesikhathi umphakathi nabafundi bezikole zendawo abebevutha bengabaselwe, bebhikishe baya ngqo erenki yamatekisi. UNksz Mthembu uthe emva kokulandwa kwabasolwa amaphoyisa ngoMsombuluko, baqalile ukungenelwa izingcingo ebezithi abagawule babheke. "Abasifonelayo ngezinombolo ezifihliwe bathi akoba kuhle ukuthi sizifihle nathi njengoba kwenzeka kanje," kusho uNksz Mthembu. Uthe bafuna ukukubeka kucace ukuthi ngeke basatshiswe abantu abangabazi, ngesihlobo sabo esihlukunyezwe ngesihluku abasolwa abaziwayo endaweni."Sizolwa kuze kube sekugcineni ngo-Atha," usho kanje. USihlalo weMaphephetheni Taxi Association, uMnuz Nkosinathi Shabalala, uthe abahambisani nesigameko beyimboni. "Ubufakazi bakhona, bufuna ukusithinta njengemboni. Asihambisani nalokhu okwenzekile. Sisazobheka nathi sibone kahle ukuthi obani laba abathintekayo embonini. Okubi ukuthi uye umqashe umuntu, uthi akazokusebenzela, ashayele imoto yakho, bese kwenzeka into ekanje," kusho uShabalala. Uthe namuhla bazoba nomhlangano lapho bezoludingida khona lolu daba. "Ngeke ngisho ukuthi kuzokwenzekani njengoba lo mhlangano ungakahlali, kodwa ngokwami, umuntu okanje akakwazi ukuqhubeka asondele emphakathini," kusho uShabalala, othe umuntu olandelwa iphunga elinje akakwazi ukuqhubeka nokusebenza. Uthe ukube yikudala bebezoziqondisela bona ubugwegwe, wathi kodwa ngoba sekwayekwa umthetho kuthi usebenze, bazoyekela wona ukuthi wenze njalo. Uthembise ukuthi kuzoba khona ukubambisana phakathi kwabo nomndeni kamufi, umphakathi namaphoyisa, ngakho konke abazokudinga. UNksz Nomathemba Sibiya weThekwini Children's Sector, uthe bazoqala phansi bafuqe imikhankaso emphakathini nasezikoleni ukuthi abantwana bangathuli nezinto ezibehlelayo, bangazizwa benomzwangedwa uma behlelwe okuthize."Kudinga bafundiswe ukuthi into noma incane kanjani, iyabikwa ukuze basizakale,” kusho uNksz Sibiya.Unxuse imindeni ukuthi ibalalele abantwana uma bezama ukubika ukuthi behlelwe okuthize. "Ngisho ngabe umntwana uyilolu hlobo okuthiwa luyahlupha, kodwa abalalelwe. Ngisho ngabe uyamazi ukuthi uwumntwana ongahloniphi, obuye ahambe angabuyi ekhaya, kodwa uma eseza kuwe ezosho ukuthi uhlukumezekile, mlalele,” kusho uNksz Sibiya.Uthe abazali abayiphonse imibuzo ebantwaneni babo uma kukhona abangakuboni kahle futhi balivule igumbi lokuvuleleka kwabantwana babo ukuze basheshe bathole uma sebehlelwe yinkinga.Obehamba phambili ekuhlelweni kwemashi, uNkk Nokuthula Cele weThekwini Women's Sector, uthe okubalethe erenki yamatekisi ukuthi bazwile ukuthi umufi ubethunjwe abesilisa abasebenza embonini yezokuthutha. "Abantu bemboni basebenza nathi siwumphakathi. Yithi obasi babo. Sizobabukelwa ubani uma kuzoqhamuka izehlakalo ezikanje?” kubuza uNkk Cele.Uthe bewumphakathi abayifuni imboni ezofuya abantu ababuye bahlukumeze umphakathi.Uthe nakuba umufi ezibulele kodwa ubephushwa okuthile, wathi ukube ubengathunjwanga, wadlwengulwa, ubengeke abe nesizathu sokuzibulala.
LIHLEHLISELWE kusasa ukuze bakwazi ukufaka isicelo sebheyili abayisikhombisa abasolwa ngamacala okudayisa ngama-passport kwabokufika abakuleli ngokungemthetho.Lokhu kuvezwe okhulumela oKlebe KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant Colonel Simphiwe Mhlongo, izolo, kulandela ukuvela kwabo eNkantolo yamaCala athinta iMali eThekwini, ngoLwesibili. Esitatimendini esikhishwe nguColonel Katlego Mogale woKlebe ezingeni likazwelonke, sithe uphiko oluphenya inkohlakalo lubophe abahlanu obelubasola ngalawa macala, lwaphinde lwabopha abanye ababili ngoMgqibelo, kulesi sifundazwe. Uthe babanjwe ezindaweni ezehlukene zeTheku ngamacala enkohlakalo, ukukhwabanisa nokuphula umthetho i-Identification Act and Immigration Act.UMogale uthe ukuboshwa kwabo kulandela isikhalazo ebesivela eMnyangweni wezaseKhaya, sokuthi kukhona abakhipha ama-passport kubantu bokufika abakuleli ngaphandle kwamaphepha agunyaza lokho. Udalule ukuthi lawa macala enziwe phakathi kukaFebhuwari 2020 kuya kuJulayi 2023. "Iqeqebana lezakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika lilekelele abokufika abakuleli ngokungemthetho ukuthi bathole ama-passport emahhovisi ehlukene oMnyango wezaseKhaya,” kusho uMogale.Phakathi kwamahhovisi athe kwenzeka kuwo lo mkhuba, uthe ngelisenkabeni yeTheku emgwaqweni uCommercial, eliseSiphingo kanjalo naseShowe. "Amacala abenziwa ngamahora acezile kulawo okusebenza ajwayelekile, okufaka phakathi izikhathi zasebusuku, izimpelasonto kanjalo nangamaholidi, lapho amahhovisi alo mnyango esuke engagunyaziwe ukuvula,” kusho uMogale. Udalule ukuthi izakhamuzi zakuleli bezibiza imali ephakathi kuka-R300 kuya ku-R1 000 ukuze kuqhubeke umshikashika wokwenzelwa kwabokufika ama-passport kungafanele, wathi kusuka ngoSepthemba 2022, kuze kube yimanje sebengu-38 ababoshelwe lawa macala. Kubona uthe kukhona izisebenzi zalo mnyango eziyisikhombisa, bese kuba abangu-31, abangabantu abajwayelekile. UMogale uphinde waveza nokuthi ngaphezu kwalesi sibalo, kukhona abangu-24 asebelahlwe amacala base begwetshwa izigwebo zeminyaka engu-310 uma isihlanganisiwe, bebhadla ejele. Kubona uthe kukhona abane abayizisebenzi zalo mnyango.Uveze ukuthi njengoba kuboshwe laba basolwa, kusengenzeka ukuthi kube khona abanye ababoshwayo.Kwenzeka lokhu nje, Isolezwe lisanda kubika ngokugqekezwa kwehhovisi lalo mnyango elisemgwaqweni uMngeni, kuphindelela. Umphathi waleli hhovisi waveza ukuthi le nkinga sebeyibikile kuzwelonke, wathi basola ukuthi kukhona izisebenzi zomnyango ezibandakanyeka kulo mkhuba. Nangaleso sikhathi Isolezwe libika ngalolu daba, kwavela ukuthi ingxenye yaleli hhovisi elokhu igqekezwe njalo, ileyo egcina ama-passport.

Ngagcina ngibaleka ngoba ngisabela impilo yami."UDkt Mkhize ukhale ngokungasukunyelwa kwezikhalazo zakhe."Simatasa, siphenya udaba lokuhlukumeza ngokobulili kepha asivimbi muntu ukuba aye kovula icala ezinhlakeni ezifanele njengoba sazi ukuthi udaba lokuhlukumeza ngokobulili lubucayi kakhulu." UDkt Mkhize uveze ukuthi ukuhoxisile ukwesula kwakhe esikhundleni.Uthe wesula ngoba nakhu esathukile wabuye washintsha umqondo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi.Ihhovisi likaNtuli livele selisikhangisile isikhala sikaDkt Mkhize.Kepha uDkt Mkhize uveze ukuthi azikapheli izinsuku ezingu-30 abekelwe zona ukuba ashintshe umqondo ngokwesula kwakhe.Uthe uzothatha izinyathelo zomthetho ukuzama ukubuyela emsebenzini.

SEKUQUBUKE ukukhathazeka emphakathini waku-ward 2 esigodini iMbozamo, eMaphephetheni kulandela isenzo sabasebenzi bomtholampilo wasendaweni iMaphephetheni Clinic, sokunquma ukuwuvala, kungasetshenzwa kuwona - bekhala ngomthamo omkhulu womsebenzi, ekubeni kube kushoda abasebenzi.Ilungu lobuholi bomphakathi wakule ndawo, uNksz Dolly Mngoma, lithe bashaqeke kwaphela nasozwaneni emasontweni amabili edlule, bevukela emtholampilo uvaliwe ngempelasonto, okuthe uma bezama ukulandelela ukuthi kungani kunjalo, batshelwa ukuthi yisenzo samabomu sendlela entsha osekuzosetshenzwa ngayo kulo mtholampilo."Sitshelwe ukuthi umtholampilo awusezukuvulwa ngezimpelasonto nangamaholidi ngenxa yokuthi abasebenzi bakhala ngokuthi bancane kakhulu njengoba kunonesi ababili kuphela, okwenza bangakwazi ukumelana nomthamo omkhulu womsebenzi wansukuzonke. Kuthiwa lokho kudalwe wukuthi kunonesi ababili abathathe umhlalaphansi futhi kunomunye umsebenzi wasemtholampilo ongekho emsebenzini ngenxa yokuxinwa wukugula. Kunjalo nje kukhona nomunye umsebenzi osanda kuthatha umhlalaphansi, okudale ukuthi laba abasele basala nomthamo womsebenzi ongaphezu kwamandla,” kusho uNksz Mngoma. Eqhuba, uthe umphakathi ukhathazekile kakhulu ngalesi simo ngoba lo mtholampilo uwusizo ebantwini abaningi abahlala ezindaweni ezakhele wona koMkhukhwini, Kuphiwa, Ngcukwini, Vutha, Mbozamo, Mqeku, Phaweni nabaKwaNyuswa naKwaNgcolosi - ababuye beze kuwo."Omunye umtholampilo esingaze siye kuwona woseMzinyathi, okubiza uR24 ukugibela ukuya kuwona, esaziyo sonke ukuthi impilo esiphila kuyona manje ayivumeli wonke umuntu ukukwazi ukuya kuwona ngenxa yobunzima. Nanokuthi ukuvala ngezimpelasonto kuzoba yinkinga enkulu ngoba akuwona wonke umuntu oba nesikhathi sokuya kuwona phakathi nezinsuku. Okunye ukuthi kuba nezimo eziphuthumayo ezenzeka ngezimpelasonto ezisuke zidinga ukuthi abantu baphuthunyiswe kuwo lo mtholampilo, okusho ukuthi bazohambela ubala, bangasizakali uma kuzobe kuvaliwe,” kukhononda uNksz Mngoma.Kuthintwa okhulumela uMmyango wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Ntokozo Maphisa, uthe nakuba zikhona izinkinga kulo mtholampilo, kubalwa ukuhamba kwabahlengikazi abathile okushiye isikhala somsebenzi, kepha ngokwakhe umonakalo awumubi njengoba kushiwo."Ngenxa yenkinga yokushoda kwemali eMnyangweni wezeMpilo kusenzinyana ukuthi uma kukhona isikhala somuntu esivulekayo sisivale ngokushesha, kodwa nakuba kunjalo ikhona imizamo esiyenzayo ukulungisa lesi simo ngokushesha kubalwa ukusebenzisana neminye imitholampilo engomakhelwane balo mtholampilo ukuthi kungazweli kakhulu,” usho kanje.Uthe futhi bazibophezele ukuhlale bexhumana nomphakathi ukuwazisa ngakho konke okuqhubekayo malungana nesimo, futhi bayaxoxisana nezinhlaka ezehlukene kuhulumeni ukusiza ukuthi isimo sibuyele kwesejwayelekile ngokushesha.
ISIKHATHI esiphila kuso ungathi sinezinsuku ezifingqiwe. Umzali uvuka ekuseni alungiselele umndeni, abaya ezikoleni nasemsebenzini. Uma kubuywa emsebenzini nanka amabhodwe alindile nomsebenzi wasekhaya ezinganeni zesikole awuzibekile phansi. Impelasonto ayikho ngempela-ke kumuntu othi eqeda izimfanelo zasendlini noMgqibelo usuphelile. Umndeni uphumula nini? Umndeni usithola nini isikhathi sokuhlala kuxoxwe kuhlekwe kube mnandi? Yingakho kubalulekile ukuthi ezokuvakasha zibe yingxenye yezinhlelo zomndeni ukuze uchithe isikhathi ndawonye kungekho muntu onengcindezi yomsebenzi noma isikole. Imindeni iyadinga ukuphuma ivakashe ukuqinisa ubudlelwano nokwakha izikhumbuzo eziyoxoxelwa abazukulu.Angazi noma yimina ngedwa yini kodwa uma ngixoxa nomuntu ngiyakwazi ukuzwa ukuthi lo ophambi kwami uzalelwe la, wakhulela la, wafunda la, wasebenza la, wagana noma waganwa khona la. Uma sengikuzwile lokho ngiye ngicabange izingane ngidabuke ngoba uma zikhuliswa wumzali onjalo ulwazi lwazo ngomhlaba luphelela la okuphelele khona abazali. Sinenhlanhla yokukhulela ezweni elingashodi ngezindawo ezinhle zokuvakasha. Isifundazwe nesifundazwe sidlisa ngokuhlukile. Akekho umuntu ongathi akazi ukuthi uphuma ubheka ngaphi. Ingxenye yempilo yami ngikhulele e-Eastern Cape, namanje uma ngidlula eKokstad umoya uyashintsha kube sengathi ngikwelinye izwe, kanjalo noma nginyuka nesifundazwe ngiya eMkhanyakude. Ukuvakasha kungaphezu kweholide. Kuyimfundo ekhethekile ongeke uyithole ekhaya. Ukubona usikompilo lwabanye abantu kuyakwakha ungumuntu ubone umhlaba ngokwehlukile. Ukuvakasha kufundisa umlando ohlukile, kunike ukuqonda okukhethekile.Lokhu ngikusho ngikubona kwezami izingane engiqala ukuzivakashisa zincane ukuze zikhule nemiqondo evulelekile. Lo omdala noma enamahloni kodwa uyazethemba, uyakwazi ukuzimela nokuthatha izinqumo nokwamukela abantu ngokwehlukana kwabo. Lo omncane (7) akanamahloni, akabesabi abantu futhi uyazikhulumela, akanandaba nokuthi ukuphi kukhona bani. Ngibhala nje sisendleleni siwumndeni, ngangithi kuzoba yisipho esiyimfihlo emndenini kanti angibuzanga elangeni. Lo omncane wabona ukuthi ngiyahlela wafunda wathula. Ngathi ngibeka ucingo phansi wabuza ukuthi iyaphi indlela, ngazama ukumkhohlisa. Impendulo yabuya ithi awukwazi ukufika lapho ngemoto, wabuza ukuthi yena uzohamba kanjani ngoba incwadi yakhe yokuvakasha iphelelwe yisikhathi. Angichithanga sikhathi kwadingeka ukuba ngibize umndeni ngiwazise ngoba kwakuzothi kusa abeselidayisile iphepha.Uma singakhuluma iqiniso bangaki kithina ababazi nokuthi kukhona into okuthiwa yincwadi yokuvakasha? Bangaki kithi abazi beneminyaka eyisikhombisa ukuthi uma uya e-United Arab Emirates uhamba ngani nokuthi kukhona kwayindawo enjalo injani? Yena lo omncane ungiqede amandla esebuza ukuthi sihlezi kuphi ebhanoyini kwi-Economy noma i-Business Class. Ngithe mangithi okwamanje umama usakhona ithikithi le-Economy wathi akusebenze imali yakhe esebhange sinyukele kwi-Business Class. Noma ngiphoxekile kodwa ngijatshuliswe wukuthi emncane engaka uyayazi le mininingwane.Ezokuvakasha ziyawuvula umqondo enganeni, ikhule yazi ukuthi umhlaba mkhulu, udinga umuntu onomqondo osabalele wedlule amagquma nezintaba umuntu akhulela kuzo. Okubalulekile wukuthi ingane ifunda ukuphupha kangcono ibe nezifiso ezingapheleli lapho okuphelela khona amehlo ayo.Ezokuvakasha azikhulisi izingane kuphela kodwa nabantu abadala bayadinga ukuphungula ingcindezi ngokushiya amakhaya bake bayobona umhlaba babeke uhlangothi emashidini amhlophe qwa. Angive ngibusiseka uma ngihambile ngibona abantu abadala bezipholele, ikakhulukazi uma behamba bodwa bengakhalelwa ngane namzukulu. Abantu abasebenzayo bayazikweleta amaholide noma amabili ngonyaka, bajabulise lo mzimba osebenzayo obathwala nsuku zonke.Ukuvakasha akusho ibhanoyi njalo. Umuntu angagibela imoto aye noma yikuphi esifundazweni ahlala kuso noma avakashe kwesinye isifundazwe. Kubalulekile ukuthi ngaphambi kokuthi simeme abantu bangaphandle ukuthi basivakashele sibe nathi sesivakashile. Kuningi engingakusho kodwa awukwazi ukukhulela eThekwini kanti awukaze uye ePort Shepstone noma ePort Edward. Umuntu azishaye isifuba ngokuba owaseThekwini kodwa eMtubatuba wagcina ngokubona kancane behambise umbondo, akazi nokuthi kune-World Heritage Site khona.Ayike ivalelwe isizathu esizwakalayo imizi abantu bephumile nemindeni bevakashile nokungenzeka ukuthi umuntu abuye nomqondo omusha ozokhulisa umndeni.
UMFUNDI kaGrade 12 esikoleni iNorthern Academy, uPearl Mathebula, ugqugquzele intsha ukuba ivuke izithathe uma ingaphumeleli okokuqala emizamweni yayo. UPearl (17) wasendaweni yaseMakotopong, ePolokwane, ukhulume kanje emuva kokuklonyeliswa ngesicoco sika-2025 Miss Teen International eLima, ePeru, ngeSonto. Lesi singqazu siqumbe phansi intokazi yakuleliya lizwe, uLuciana Henriquez no-Ángela García waseVenezuela, ophume isithathu. Likhuluma kwiNewzroom Afrika le ntokazi, ithe bese ihluleke amahlandla amabili kulo mqhudelwano. Ithe ngo-2023, yaphuma endaweni yeshumi."Ngo-2023, kwase kuwumqhudelwano wesibili ngiwungenela. Angiphoxekanga neze ukuphuma endaweni yeshumi. Ngiyaziqhenya kakhulu (ngalokhu kuhlabana) ngoba kusho ukuthi ukusebenza kwami ngokuzikhandla kuthele izithelo ekugcineni kosuku."UPearl uthe uqale ukuzibandakanya nokukhangisa ngengqephu esemncane kakhulu. "Bengihlale ngigqoka amaqhoks kamama. Bengikuthanda ukuswenka nokuziphaqula ubuso. Yilapho ngabona khona ukuthi ngibizelwe ekubeni umkhangisi wengqephu. Umama wayelokhu ethi 'gxila emsebenzini wesikole, uyothi uma sewusesikoleni samabanga aphezulu, bese uqala ugxila ekukhangiseni ngengqephu," kusho uPearl. UPearl ugila lezi zimanga nje kulo mqhudelwano wonobuhle, akakaqedi neminyaka emihlanu ekulo mkhakha njengoba eqale ukungenela ngo-2022. Nyakenye, ukhale wemuka nesicoco sikaMiss Teenager South Africa.IMeya yasePolokwane, uMnuz John Mpe, nezinye izikhulu zalo mkhandlu zihlanganyele nabantu bakulesi sifundazwe ukwamukela uPearl esikhumulweni sezindiza yaseGoli, i-OR Tambo International Airport izolo.
UMSAKAZI wohlelo lwasekuseni kwiGagasi FM, uMinnie Ntuli, ugonyuluka ngembangela yokungahoshelani kwakhe nomculi we-Afro house, uLondie London kwiSeason 5 yeThe Real Housewives of Durban. Kulolu hlelo bekuhlale kongaphansi nongaphezulu phakathi kwalabo saziwayo baseKZN. Ebuzwa ukuthi ingxabano yabo isukaphi, uMinnie uthe akukho okwake kwabaqhatha ngaphambilini kodwa ukungaboni ngasolinye phakathi kwabo bekwenzeka ohlelweni kuphela. "Bekuphakama umoya, kuhluthuka izinhliziyo futhi kuphele nokuxhumana. Ngibuye ngabuyela kulokho ngabe sengixolisa kuye ngasese. Obekubonwa ngababukeli akusona isithombe esiphelele sobekwenzeka." UMinnie (30), osakaza noFelix Hlophe i-The Uprising, uthe bakhona ababambe iqhaza kwiReal Housewives of Durban, abezwana nabo ngenxa yokuzwana kwemimoya. "Yebo, beyikhona imiphefumulo enenhliziyo enhle ebengizwana nayo ohlelweni nangaphandle engingeke ngiyidalule kodwa bakhona abesifazane engibahlonipha ngempela futhi ubudlelwano bami nabo ngobeqiniso." Uthe kumsize kakhulu ukuhlaba ikhefu nokuthandaza kakhulu ukuze abhekane nengcindezi abeyifakelwa ukuba kulolu hlelo. "Futhi ngifunde ukuzikhumbuza ukuthi umbono wabantu awunamthelela kimi. Abantu abazi inhliziyo yami enginendaba nabo. Namanje kunzima. Ezinye izinsuku zinzima kunezinye kodwa ngisafunda ukungafaki izinto enhliziyweni." UMinnie uthe wayengakaze wahlela ukuba kulolu hlelo kodwa kwathuka ucilo ezishaya endukwini. "Lathi uma ithuba livela, ngabona kuyithuba lokuthi ngibambe iqhaza entweni ezongikhipha ekunethezekeni nemayelana neTheku. Ngangifuna ukumela olunye uhlobo lomuntu wesifazane osazithola kodwa ongahloninizi nongazenyezi ngobuyena." Uthe nakuba abangani nezihlobo bashaqeka ngesikhathi bethola ukuthi uzoba yingxenye yalolu hlelo kodwa bamsekile. "Umama wathi 'ungakhohlwa ukuthi ungubani'. Engizwana nabo bajabula kakhulu futhi bangivikela. Bayazi ukuthi ngiwumuntu ozwelayo futhi ohlelweni lwethelevishini olungempilo yangempela, akusiniswa amahleza." Ukuvezile ukuthi wayethukile ngokuthi abantu bazombuka kanjani. "Ngichaza ukuthi abantu bazokwahlulela ngokuphefumula kabi kwikhamera. Kodwa ngangazi ukuthi ngingena nenhliziyo evulelekile nokuthi ngizohlala ngiyimina. Bengingalindele ukuthi kuhambe kahle emoyeni." Uthe umehluko phakathi kokubuka lolu hlelo nokuba kulo mkhulu. "Kumnandi ukulubuka kodwa ukuba kulo kwenzeka nanoma yini, kuhlukumeze umoya. Amakhamera akayeki ukushutha ngisho ukhathele noma uphatheke kabi. Awukwazi ukuhlela kahle izimpendulo zakho, yilapho ukhula khona." Ucacisele abantu ngempilo yakhe. "Abantu bacabanga ukuthi ngiluhlaza futhi ngiyazitshela kanti akunjalo. Ngilungile, ngithembekile futhi nginozwelo. Kuyenzeka ngibe nonya uma ngichukuluzwa. Angizenzi umuntu engingasiye. Ngiyibhasi ebhaliwe."

UKHALA ngokungabi bikho kweqembu lesizwe labaneminyaka engaphansi kuka-23 umqeqeshi weLamontville Golden Arrows, uManqoba ''TV" Mngqithi.Lokhu uMngqithi uthe kuyalikhinyabeza kakhulu ibhola laseNingizimu Afrika ngokwahlukana kwezigaba zalo.Lo mqeqeshi osebebeze iminyaka eminingi kwiMamelodi Sundowns awina nayo indebe yeCaf Champions League ngo-2016, ubekhuluma neSolezwe ngesikhathi ehambele ukwethulwa ngokusemthethweni kwemidlalo yeligi yezinkampani zaseCato Ridge, iCatomlaas Soccer League. Ngokusho kukaMngqithi, amaqembu esizwe akuleli ngokwehlukana kwezigaba zawo abonakala enza kahle kakhulu wathi inkinga nje isekutheni alibonwa iqembu labangaphansi kweminyaka engu-23. ENingizimu Afrika iqembu lika-Under 23 lijwayele ukuhlanganiswa uma sekuhlungelwa imidlalo yama-Olympic."Lokhu ngikholwa ukuthi kumele kulungiswe ebholeni laseNingizimu Afrika. Uma lokho bengakulungisa angingabazi nje nakancane ukuthi akukho okungabonakala kushoda ngebhola lethu," usho kanjena.Uqhube wathi iqembu labangaphansi kweminyaka engu-17 lenza kahle nomqeqeshi walo uyaziwa, wathi yinto efanayo naseqenjini labangaphansi kweminyaka engu-20. Uthe neBafana Bafana ibonakala yenza kahle. Iqembu lesizwe lika-Under 17 eliqeqeshwa nguVela Khumalo, Amajimbos, lisanda kuzibekisela indawo kwiNdebe yoMhlaba ezodlalelwa eQatar ngoNovemba. Elika-Under 20 eliphekwa nguRaymond Mdaka, liwine indebe i-Africa Cup of Nations (Afcon) e-Egypt ngenyanga edlule.''Inkinga iqala uma sekukhulunywa ngeqembu labangaphansi kweminyaka engu-23. Uma ngingase ngibuze wena nje ukuthi ubani umqeqeshi waleli qembu ungangiphendula uthini,'' ebuza samuntu olindele impendulo.Ukhale ngabadlali abaningi ababonakala benekusasa eliqhakazile eqenjini labangaphansi kweminyaka engu-20 ebuza ukuthi bazoya kusiphi isigaba manje.''Le nto izobalimaza laba badlali ngoba manje uma sebeneminyaka engaphezulu kuka-20 alikho iqembu abazolidlalela ngoba sinenkinga. Angikhumbuli nokuthi ligcine nini ukudlala uma kuya ngokuthi like lidlale,''usho kanjena.
EMINYAKENI lapho intsha isasezikoleni ifunda amabanga aphezulu, uMongiwa Hazel Ntuli, uzobe edlubhe ijazi lakhe leziqu njengomunye wabafundi base-University of Pretoria (UP) abasebancane abagogodile. Uthole iziqu ze-Actuarial Science eneminyaka engu-17. Uhambo lwemfundo lukaMongiwa waseRosettenville, eGoli, luyamangaza. Waqala ukufunda enyuvesi emva kokwenza ezibukwayo esikoleni kulandela ukugqama kobuhlakani bakhe kwezemfundo eseyingane."Ngifunda uGrade 3 ngabhala ngephutha iphepha lezibalo lakwaGrade 4 ngathola ngaphezulu ukudlula bonke abafundi baleli banga. Uthisha wami wakubona lokhu wase engivumela ukuba ngibhale amanye amaphepha, wabona ukuthi ngenze kahle kakhulu," kusho yena..Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni eqiswe amakilasi, wazithola esesenyuvesi, esengaphambili ngeminyaka kontanga bakhe. Uthe, impumelelo yakhe yakhelwe ekubongeni nasekukholweni. "Okokuqala kunakho konke, lokhu kungamandla kaNkulunkulu. Ukukhetha i-UP kwaba yisinqumo esilula kuMongiwa."Kwaba yinyuvesi yokuqala ukwamukela isicelo sami sokufunda. Inezinto ezinhle eziningi futhi ngesinye sezikhungo ze-Actuarial Science esisezingeni eliphezulu nesihlonishwa umhlaba wonke.Ukuba "kude naseduze" kwasekhaya kwengeza kwengangikufuna," kusho yena.Ngaphandle kobuhlakani bakhe ezifundweni, ukuba muncane kunabanye abafundi ayenabo kulethe izinselelo. "Abafundi abaningi bebengiphathisa okukasisi omncane abangakaze babe naye. Bekulindeleke okuningi kumina okwenza kwabanzima ukuhlangabezana nalokho okwakulindelwe," kusho yena.Ukufunda ukusebenza nabantu abadala kunaye nokuzwakala kwezwi lakhe endaweni yemfundo angayijwayele kube wumqansa kodwa kube yindlela yokufunda emhlomulisile. Ukuphokophelela kwakhe bekuqhutshwa wumbono ocacile nokwesekwa okuqinile - ababemakha abangani, ababemfundisa futhi ubonga ikakhulukazi umama walapho ayehlala khona efunda, uZamile, owayehlala emgqugquzela."Bengihlala ngizikhumbuza ukuthi kungani ngiqalile futhi ngenza isiqiniseko sokuthi umvuzo wami uqine ngokwanele. Ukuba nemibono eminingi kungenze ngangaphambuka endleleni, kwangisiza nokukhuleka." Umzuzu angeke awukhohlwa wukuthola isiqiniseko sokuthi uzothweswa iziqu. UMongiwa uthe wayecabanga ukuthi ufeyilile futhi kuzodingeka ukuthi aphinde unyaka. "Ngazitshela ukuthi noma ngingashayeka kanjani, uma ngivuka ngizithatha, ngangisenalo ithuba lokulwa..Njengoba sengibheke ukuthola iziqu anginazon izinhlelo zokwehlisa umfutho. Emva kwalokhu ngihlela ukusebenza ngibe ngiqhuba izifundo zami. Bengihlezi ngifuna iziqu zeMBA," kusho yena. Umbono wakhe wesikhathi eside uhlanganisa ukuthola iziqu zalo msebenzi awufundele bese eyasebenza uma isikhathi sesivuma. Njengoba engowokuqala emndenini wakhe ukuthola iziqu zasenyuvesi, uMongiwa ubona lokhu kungeyona impumelelo yakhe yedwa kodwa kuwumlando wesizukulwane. "Abazali bami bazozigqaja kufanele. Kuzonciphisa ingcindezi enkulu nomthwalo umndeni wami obuwuthwele isikhathi eside".Weluleke intsha enephupho lokusheshe ingene enyuvesi ukuba ivume ukufundiseka. "Awazi yonke into. Funda ukwehlulekela phambili. Thatha ukulahlekelwa kwakho ukuhlanganise nokubekezela nokuphokophelela noma kunzima. Yiba njengengane uma ubhekene nenselelo - ulindele ukuthola lonke ulwazi nobuhlakani ongakuthola," kusho yena eluleka abanye.
UDIDEKILE umndeni kasomatekisi wesifazane obulawe namanye amalungu omndeni amabili, behlaselwa abantu abangaziwa emzini wabo e-Auckland, eMariannhill, ngoLwesibili ebusuku. Kulesi sigameko kushone uNksz Tholakele Magutshwa, obengusomatekisi, indodana yakhe uMnuz Mthobisi Magutshwa nomzukulu, uMvelo Magutshwa.UMthobisi noMvelo bashonele endaweni yesigameko ngawo uLwesibili, uNksz Magutshwa washonela esibhedlela ngoLwesithathu. Isihlobo esicele ukungadalulwa, silandisa ngesigameko sithe, kugasele abesilisa ababili ebebengazifihlile kodwa abangaziwa ngabo-7 ebusuku.Sithe lesi yisikhathi lapho okufika ngaso abashayeli belethe amatekisi amane kaNksz Magutshwa njengoba epaka ekhaya. "Oyedwa uye endlini kaMthobisi engaphandle, wafike wamdubula wambulala. Omunye uhambe waya endlini enkulu, naye wafike wavulela ngenhlamvu kwabebekhona,” kusho isihlobo. Kwabasindile, ebebesendlini enkulu, kube enye indodana kaNksz Magutshwa nomshayeli wetekisi, okuthiwa bekunguye kuphela umshayeli obesafikile ukuzoletha itekisi. "Lokhu kwenza sidideke ukuthi babulawelweni ngoba noNksz Magutshwa ubengakaze abike zinkinga embonini yamatekisi asebe yingxenye yayo iminyaka engaphezu kwengu-15 ngaphansi kukasoseshini waKwaNdengezi,” kusho isihlobo. Yize kunjalo, uthe bewumndeni bayabona ukuthi obekuhloswe abasolwa ukuqotha imbokodo nesisekelo kuphela."Badubule wonke umuntu obesendlini, ngokwabo bekumele kufe wonke umuntu. Ebebekufuna ukubulala kuphela ngoba abazange bathathe futhi abashongo lutho,” kusho isihlobo.Sithe bayafuna ukubona abasolwa beboshwa, ukuze bachaze ukuthi bazibulaleleni izihlobo zabo. "Sididekile, sizwa ubuhlungu obungachazeki, siyafuna ukwazi ukuthi babulawelweni,” usho kanje.Ikhansela lendawo, uMnuz Mthokozisi Gasa, lithe umphakathi usathuthumela kulandela isigameko."Isimo simanzonzo. Umphakathi uthukile. Sifisa izinhlaka zezokuphepha zisondele ngoba kukwampunzi idla emini kule ndawo, izigebengu ziyacanasa futhi isimo siphumile esandleni,” kusho uGasa. Uze waveza nokuthi indawo ibinomtholampilo ongumahamba nendlwana ayisekho ngenxa yokuthi abahlengikazi baxoshwa wukubanjwa inkunzi bephucwa izimoto, amaselula nemali.Uveze ukuthi kwenzeka okufanayo nasezisebenzini zikamasipala ezisuke zizolungisa ugesi namanzi endaweni. Yize umndeni uqinisekisa osekuchaziwe odabeni, imininingwane etholakale emaphoyiseni isho okuhlukile. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa aseMariannhill avule icala lokubulala, namane okuzama ukubulala kulandela isigameko sokuhlaselwa komndeni wamalungu ayisihlanu ngoLwesibili. "Kuthiwa kungene abesilisa ababili, bafika bavulela ngenhlamvu, kwafa owesilisa oneminyaka engu-36, kwalimala abane abaphuthunyiswe esibhedlela,” kusho uNetshiunda. Uthe imbangela yokubulala ayikaziwa.

Kubulawe umsolwa oyingozi ovefunelwa inqwaba yamacala ngesikhathi edubulana namaphoyisa aseKZN eMzinto.Umsolwa, 27, ubefunelwa amacala okungenani angu-20 okubulala. Kuthiwa amacala amaningi uwenze eMzinto, amanye abikwe eScottburgh naseMlaza.Amaphoyisa akholwa wukuthi unesandla kuma-CIT nasekushushunjisweni kwezidakamizwa.Ngosizo lophiko lwezobunhloli besifundazwe, amalungu ophiko lwamaphoyisa kaMasipala i-Trio Crimes Unit kanye namaphoyisa e-SAPS Durban North Trio Crimes alandele umkhondo womsolwa bafika emzini osemgwaqweni uMalibu Drive ngenhloso yokukhipha incwadi egunyaza ukuboshwa kwakhe. Bebenethemba lokuthi bazozitholela izibhamu zakhe ukuze bamxhumanise namacala angakaboshwa. Kuthiwa uvulele ngenhlamvu ngesikhathi amaphoyisa efika, wafela khona lapho. Umsolwa ubephethe isibhamu esingekho emthethweni.
Kufe abahlanu abasolwa ngamacala okubulala ngoLwesihlanu ebusuku.Isehlo sokuqala senzeke emgwaqweni lapho amaphoyisa abelandela umkhondo womsolwa oyedwa."Lo msolwa ubefunelwa icala lokubulala, amathathu okuzama ukubulala nelokugebenga ibhizinisi. Uvulele ngenhlamvu emaphoyiseni evinjezelwe emgwaqweni kwaqala lapho ukudutshwana," kusho amaphoyisa ngesitatimende. Esinye isehlo senzeke ngesikhathi amaphoyisa elandela umkhondo wabasolwa ngokubulala, ukuzama ukubulala nokugqekeza imizi. KUTHIWA zibize iloli, zalayisha yonke imithwalo yazo, zaphela emehlweni izihlobo zengane yomfana, osekuphele inyanga ilahlekile eMabedlane, oLundi.U-Andile Sibiya (3) wagcina ukubonwa edlala ngasemzini walezi zihlobo, okuthiwa zithuthile endaweni. Umthombo olwazi ukusuka nokuhlala udaba, uthe kulezi zihlobo ezithuthile kukhona esikhulume kwesinye ukuthi sona sesikhathele ukuthula "nale nto". "Lona wesifazane okuthiwa ukhulume kanje esihlotsheni, ungomunye womakoti kulo muzi. Kuthiwa uze waveza ukuthi umuntu owaziyo ukuthi ingane ikuphi isaguga sasemndenini,” kusho umthombo.Uthe emva kokuthi ezinye izihlobo zikhombise ukuthi zifuna ukuzwa kabanzi ngalokhu, lo makoti nomndeni wakhe bavele bathutha endaweni."Kubonakale ngeloli lithi nse egcekeni, lalayisha yonke imithwalo yabo, bahamba,” kusho umthombo. Uthintwa umndeni wengane ngalokhu, wale waphetha ukukhuluma nentatheli. Obambe ucingo lukanina wayo, uthe akekho esimweni esikahle sokukhuluma.Ucele ukuthi kube wuye ophawulayo, naye wakhala ngesifanayo. Kube sekuzwakala owesifazane obekhuluma eceleni ethi: "abahlukane nathi phansi, ezabo izingane bahleli nazo, azilahlekile”.Isolezwe like labika ngalolu daba ngasekupheleni kukaMeyi, kulo nyaka, ngesikhathi abenhlangano yabefundisi, i-Olundi Zion Pastors Association, ihambisa umkhuleko kubo kwengane. Ngaleso sikhathi unobhala wenhlangano, uMfu Khayelihle Mtshali, wathi okwabasukumisa phansi bengabafundisi ukuthi u-Andile uyingane yesithathu ukulahleka kule ndawo. Wathi ukwenzeka kwento enje endaweni kuyathusa, wathi abakwazi ukuhlala phansi basonge izandla kube kubonakala ukuthi konakele. Phakathi kwezigameko azibalayo kukhona esangoJuni, nyakenye, lapho okwalahleka khona uLisulenkosi Lamula (2). ULisulenkosi wagcina ukubonwa edlala egcekeni emzini wesihlobo. Kuthiwa wathi uyaphuma unina emva kwemizuzu engu-30 embheka, waqaphela ukuthi akasabonwa.Bacinga yonke indawo, ngisho nasethoyilethi lomgodi emzini anyamalala kuwo, bangamthola.Emva kwezinsuku ezimbili, watholakala kulo ithoyilethi elifanayo, enezibazi zokuklinywa emqaleni. Nakuba amaphoyisa avula icala lokufa komuntu, umndeni wakhe walimisa ngesihloko elokuthi ukholelwa ukuthi ubulewe, wase ephonswa ethoyilethi.UMtshali waveza ukuthi sikhona esinye isigameko sokulahleka kwengane (5) kule ndawo, naso esenzeke ngonyaka odlule, wathi nakuba yatholwa iphila emzini wesakhamuzi, kwaba nemibuzo yokuthi kukhona umkhuba wesintu owenziwa emzimbeni wayo. Waveza ukuthi bagcina amaphoyisa elulandela udaba, yize kwagcina kungacacanga ukuthi lwabuye lwaphelelaphi.

Ngaphambilini, kwake kwaqhuma isililo kuleli cala ngesikhathi amalungu omndeni wabafi ekhala ngokuhamba ngonyawo lonwabu kwaleli cala.Bekuthi njalo uma bevele enkantolo kugcwale phama uma bengena enkantolo baphakamise izandla bebingelela abalandeli babo ebebehlezi begcwele enkantolo. Kodwa izolo, kuse ngokunye njengoba enkantolo bebeyidlanzana abebezobaseka. Imindeni yezisulu ibingasalubhadi enkantolo.

Yize kufanele ngabe kade ngayenza le ncazelo kodwa ngithe angiyenze ngenxa yothando lomculo nasekuhlonipheni abalandeli bami nendima yomculo."Uthe nakuba kunjalo kodwa uyohlale eyithulela isigqoko inkampani eyavumbulula ikhono lakhe, iNative Rhythm. "Ngiyayibonga inkampani eyangisiza ngokwethula iphimbo lami emhlabeni. Leso sahluko sangiguqula futhi sanginikeza amathuba engiyohlale ngiwatusa."Uthe njengamanye amaciko naye uhlangabezanile nezingqinamba nezinselelo njengokunqindeka ekukhuleni emculweni, ikakhulukazi njengomuntu wesifazane."Kodwa nanoma iyiphi ingqinamba idlale indima ekungikhuliseni, hhayi njengomculi nombhali wezingoma kodwa njengesishoshovu nomnakeleli." Uthe kuyona yonke le minyaka ubesafake ikhanda phansi obizweni lakhe lokucula ngenhloso yokupholisa ikhanda ngomculo nokuthuthukisa ngokuxoxa indaba. "Ngisaqhubeka nokubhala, ukuqopha nokucula izingoma engizenzile ngesikhathi ngisathungatha engizosebenzisana nabo nesigqi esisha. Namhlanje ngokuziqhenya ngiseGauteng, lapho ngihlale nginandisa bukhoma futhi ngixhumana nabalandeli bami abakhula mihla namalanga." USiphokazi ube esezibongela kakhulu kubantu abawe bevuka naye kule minyaka eyedlule nabebeseka umsebenzi wakhe wokucula. "Ngiyanimema ukuba nihambe nami kulolu hambo olusha sengiwumculi ozimele. Umgwaqo ophambi kwami uyakhanya futhi ngijabule ukwabelana nani ngomculo, umzuzu nangesifundo ngomculo," kuphetha uSiphokazi. Lo mculi owazalelwa eLusikisiki, e-Eastern Cape, uqale ngokuphelezela ngephimbo izingwazi ezinjengoTshepo Tshola, Ringo Madlingozi, Pat Mtshikiza, Simphiwe Dana, Zama Jobe neStimela. Uqale ukuzakhela igama nge-albhamu yakhe yokuqala eyayithi Ubuntu Bam, eyadayisa amakhophi angaphezu kuka-100 000. Ngayo uSiphokazi wahlabana ngendondo yeBest Newcomer neyeBest African Adult Contemporary Album kumaSama ngo-2007.NakumaMetro FM Music Awards, wakhala wemuka neBest Female, Best Newcomer neBest Produced Album. Kwathi ngo-2008, waqokwa kumaKora Awards emunxeni weBest Southern African Artist. Wabe eselandela ngecwecwe elithi Ndinovuyo ngo-2008, nelithi Ethembeni ngo-2010. Unandise emicimbini emikhulu okubalwa kuyo i-2009 Fifa Confederation Cup nakwi-2010 Fifa World Cup kuleli.Ubuye waba yinxusa lomkhankaso we-One Love ngenhloso yokugqugquzela abantu abasha ukuba basebenzise amakhondomu noma bazithibe ocansini. Akagcinanga lapho, wahambela ingqungquthela iWorld Music Conference neSXSW and Midem.
AYAQINA amahlebezi okuthi osanda kudilizwa esikhundleni sokuba unobhala jikelele we-MK, uMnuz Floyd Shivambu, uzoqala iqembu lakhe elisha lezombusazwe. UShivambu uzokuba nesithangami nabezindaba namhlanje, lapho kulindeleke ukuthi amemezele ukwesula kwakhe kwi-MK, kanti uthembise ukukhipha ingonyuluka uma esekhuluma nabezindaba, namhlanje, eGoli. Isimemezelo sikaShivambu sanamhlanje, sibhekwe ngabomvu futhi sesihlukanise phakathi amalungu e-MK. Kunamalungu e-MK afunga ngokuthi alinde ukuthi "athi pe" bese eyamlandela, kanti amanye athi kobe liphume nobomvu uma engashiya.Abeseka uShivambu kanye nabafuna ukuthi ahambe bebebambene ngezihluthu ezinkundleni zokuxhumana. UShivambu udilizwe esikhundleni ekuqaleni kwale nyanga emva kokuhambela isonto loMfundisi waseMalawi ofunelwa amacala kuleli, uShepherd Bushiri. Ngesikhathi uShivambu edilizwa yi-MK, yathi izomjuba ePhalamende kodwa kuze kube yimanje, akakaze afungiswe futhi negama lakhe aliveli ohlwini lwamalungu e-MK azothunyelwa khona. Kusukela uShivambu adilizwa esikhundleni akakaze abonakale emicimbini ye-MK.Kunamalungu e-MK angahambisani nesinqumo sokudilizwa kukaShivambu esikhundleni. Amalungu angeneme azama ukubhikisha ngesikhathi kunomcimbi woSuku lweNtsha okwakhuluma kuwo umholi, we-MK uMnuz Jacob Zuma. UZuma washiya angalazi kulabo ababehlela umbhikisho.Ekhuluma emcimbini owawuseThekwini, ngoMsombuluko, uZuma uthe akekho umuntu ozoncengwa kwi-MK.Uthe abangahambisani nezinqumo zokukhishwa kwabaholi abahambe beyoqala iqembu labo. Uqhube wathi bonke abakhishwa ezikhundleni kusuke kukhona amaphutha abawenzile.UShivambu uthe: "Labo abake basebenza nami bayazi ukuthi ngiyakholelwa ekukhulumeni iqiniso. Ngaso sonke isikhathi ngihlezi ngikhuluma iqiniso. Ngizoveza obala konke okungamanga."Umhlaziyi wezepolitiki, uMnuz Ongama Mtimka, uthe uShivambu kofanele acabangisise kahle ngaphambi kokuthi athathe isinqumo ngekusasa lakhe. "Ngiyazi ukuthi abanye abantu bayathanda ukwenza izinto ngoba nakhu befuna ukuhlabekisa izimbangi. Uma wenza izinto ngoba nakhu udiniwe, ugcina usuwenza nezinto ozozisola ngazo. Kuhle kwesinye isikhathi ukungathathi izinto ngenhliziyo."UShivambu uhlale esikhundleni sikanobhala isikhathi esingaphansi kwezinyanga eziyisikhombisa.Kulesi sikhathi asihlalile ubhekane nezivunguvungu. Indodakazi kaZuma, uNkk Duduzile Zuma-Sambudla, yamchapha ngezinhlamba ezinkundleni zokuxhumana.Kwaphinde kwavela ukuthi kunamalungu esiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal, angafuni ukwemukela ukuqokwa kwakhe.Uma uShivambu egcine eshiya kwi-MK, kuzobe kungekhona okokuqala egejana noZuma. UShivambu wagcina eshiya kwi-ANC emva kokugejana noZuma. Ngaleso sikhathi uZuma wayengumengameli we-ANC, uShivambu yena wayekwi-ANC Youth League.UShivambu ujoyine i-MK esuka kwi-EFF, lapho ebeyiphini lomholi waleli qembu.Kubukeka engenayo indlela ebuyela kwi-EFF njengoba umholi weqembu, uMnuz Julius Malema, esanda kumemezela ukuthi isigungu esiphezulu savumelana ngokuthi ngeke sibamukele labo abasanda kushiya.UMalema wayekade exwayise ngokuthi uShivambu ngeke awuqede unyaka kwi-MK.
BASOLA ozakwabo ebuthisheleni abomndeni kathisha, okuthiwa ushone isigubhukane, kulandela ukungenelwa yizigebengu, ezimfune izindodla zemali yempesheni.UNkk Sizakele Biyela (61) waseNkangala, eNkandla, ushonele esibhedlela sendawo ngoLwesithathu olwedlule, kulandela ukungenelwa yizigebengu ngoLwesibili.Elandisa ngodaba umyeni kamufi, uMnuz Mtobozeni Biyela, uthe abasolwa abane babangenela ngoLwesibili olwedlule, ngezikhathi zasebusuku. Uthe yena wayesecambalele ekameleni labo, umufi kade ehleli nendodana yabo kwelinye ikamelo, eyozela, yalala."Wasukuma waqoqa isitsha eyayikade idla ngaso, wasiyisa ekhishini. Esekhona ekhishini, kwezwakala umsindo omkhulu kanti abasolwa sebebhodloza umnyango, bangena ngaphakathi,” kusho uBiyela. Uthe waphuma ekameleni ezobheka ukuthi kwenzekani, wazithela phezu kwabasolwa abane, beqhuba umkakhe bezomfaka ekameleni labo. Uthe ngaleso sikhathi indodana nayo yaphaphama kodwa yacasha ku-wardrobe, wathi sebebahlalise phansi ekalemeleni, bathi kumkakhe "wena gogo sifuna izikhiye zemoto yakho nama-millions asanda kuphuma empesheni". "Baze bathi obathumile ubatshelile ukuthi isiphumile le mali,” kusho uBiyela, okuqinsekisile lokhu, ethi umkakhe ugcine emsebenzini ngoDisemba 2024. Uthe umkakhe wayelokhu elandule njalo, ethi akanayo yena imali, wathi ngaleso sikhathi babengasamboni umsolwa wesine, sekungabathathu abanabo shaqa, behla benyuka endlini."Babelokhu beqoqa okunye ababekufuna, okukhona kukho amaselula, amakhadi asebhange, kanjalo ne-laptop kamufi,” usho kanje. Uthe ngesikhathi indodana yabo izivalele ku-wardrobe, yafaka iselula ku-silent, yase ithumela umyalezo wokuthi bavinjezelwe yizigebengu ekhaya kwi-WhatsApp yomndeni."Yaphuma ku-wardrobe, yazithela phezu kwabasolwa, abayiqhuba bayiletha kithina. Baqhubeka nokufuna imali kunkosikazi, bagcina sebethi njengoba egoloza nemali, okusho ukuthi akayithandi indodana yakhe,” kusho uBiyela.Uthe lokho umkakhe wakuhlaziya njengokuthi bazoyidubula indodana yabo uma eqhubeka nokugoloza nemali. "Wagcina esethi imali ekhona isekhadini lakwaCapitec,” usho kanje.Uthe leli khadi lalino-R7 000 kuphela abagcina bengakwazanga ukuwuthatha njengoba wawulokhu ufuna imicikilisho yokushuthwa kwesithombe, ukuze bakwazi ukuyikhipha.Uthe bathikanyezwa ukufika kwamaphoyisa, acabanga ukuthi ayesethintwe esinye sezihlobo ezikwi-WhatsApp. Uthe amaphoyisa aphambana nalezi zigebengu esangweni ngemoto."Athi uma efika ngaphakathi endlini, athola ukuthi kungenzeka ukuthi abasolwa yibo laba aphambane nabo ngemoto, aqala phansi abajaha,” usho kanje.Uthe imoto yabasolwa yagcina igingqika kwelinye lamajika endaweni, kwabanjwa umsolwa oyedwa, eseziyise emaphoyiseni, eyothi ubedunwe imoto. "Athi uma embona ukuthi ulimele engalweni futhi nodaba lwakhe aluhlangani, asola ukuthi ungomunye wabasolwa,” kusho yena. Uthe ngobusuku besehlakalo, yena nendodana baya kobhalisa isitatimende emaphoyiseni, beshiya ngemuva umkakhe."Sabuya ekuseni esekhwehlela, ekhala nangokuthi kukhona into emi esifubeni. Sagcina simphuthumisa esibhedlela okuyila agcine eshonela khona,” usho kanje. Uthe basola ukuthi ukhona ushevu owafakwa abasolwa emanzini abamphuzisa wona ngosuku lwesigameko.Uqhube wathi ukufika kwezigebengu kwakhe, zilibeke ngesihloko elokuthi zizofuna ama-millions empesheni, kusho ukuthi zazithunywe ngabantu abanolwazi olugcwele."Asiboni ukuthi kungaba umuntu womndeni. Sisola abesebenza nabo ngoba nabo bangaba nolwazi uma impesheni isiphumile,” kusho uBiyela. Uthe kukhona abeke abacele ukuthi basize ngokumthumelela imali yasenyuvesi yezingane besebenzisa i-app yasebhange lakhe."Mhlawumbe bebebuye bapopole ukuthi njengoba ethi abamthumelele isamba esithile enyuvesi, kukhona malini ebhange lakhe,” usho kanje.Nokho uthe bazolinda uphenyo lwamaphoyisa ngokwenzekile, bese belinda nomphumela wokuhlolwa kwesidumbu, ozocacisa ukuthi yini ethathe impilo yenkosikazi yakhe."Sesiyasaba ukuhlala endaweni ngoba bagcine bengayitholanga imali. Sinovalo ngoba asazi noma bazobuya yini." Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kwamaphoyisa ngalolu daba ayiphumelelanga.
UKUBHOBOKA kwenkabi evume icala lokusoconga owayengunobhala jikelele we-ANC Youth League, uMnuz Sindiso Magaqa, akwanele ukubophisa nabanye abachakidwa ile nkabi ukuba babeyingxenye yetulo lokusocongwa kukaMagaqa.Ungoti wezomthetho wenkampani yabameli iDonda Attorneys, uMnuz Melusi Xulu, uthe ukuze kuboshwe kuphinde kushushiswe ngempumelelo bonke abachakidwe yinkabi, kofanele inkabi iphenduke ibe ufakazi woMbuso.Umsolwa wesine ecaleni, uSibusiso Ncengwa, wavuma icala waphinde washo namagama abantu athi babeyingxenye yetulo lokusoconga uMagaqa. Ebantwini ababala, kukhona kubo avele aboshwe nabo kuleli cala, uMnuz Sibonelo Myeza, Mbulelo Mpofana noMlungisi Ncalane, kanye nabantu abangaboshiwe kuleli cala.UNcengwa uzogwetshwa ngoJuni 30.UXulu uthe ukuze uMbuso ukwazi ukusebenzisa ubufakazi bukaNcengwa kuzofanele ukuthi aphenduke ufakazi wenkantolo. "Okwamanje uNcengwa usavume icala nje kuphela. Ngokwesigaba 219 somthetho wamacala, ubufakazi bomuntu ovuma icala abusetshenziswa ukugweba abanye ngaphandle uma evuma icala ngaphansi kwesigaba u-204. Ngaphansi kwalesi sigaba umuntu osuke eyingxenye yecala ukhomba abanye, aphinde abe ufakazi wenkantolo. Ubufakazi bakhe ke buyasetshenziswa. Into eyaye yenzeke ukuthi ufakazi uyaye avume icala ngaphambi kokuthi agwetshwe, bese kuba nezivumelwano."UMyeza noMpofana bazovela eNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu, kusasa, lapho bezonikezwa kabusha uhlu lwamacala kulandela igonyuluka kaNcengwa."Silindile ukubona laba ababili ukuthi bazothini uma sebevela enkantolo, sibone nobufakazi obukhona ukuthi buthini. Ukuvuma icala kukaNcengwa kukodwa akwanele ngaphandle ke uma engasintsha ngaphambi kokuba agwetshwe, aphenduke ufakazi woMbuso." UXulu uthe uma uNcengwa engaphenduka ufakazi wenkantolo kungaphinde kube lula ukuthi uMbuso ubophe nabanye abakhonjwa uNcengwa."Uma uNcengwa engavuma ukuba ufakazi wenkantolo kungagcina sekusetshenziswa ubufakazi bakhe ukugweba laba abanye."Abanye bala bantu abakhonjwa uNcengwa sebashona, kubo kukhona umuntu owadubula kanye nongqondongqondo ekuhleleni itulo lokusoconga uMagaqa.UMagaqa wasocongwa ngo-2017 ebuya emhlanganweni wamakhansela. UMPHATHISWA wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi KwaZulu-Natal, olengelwa yizembe, uNksz Mbali Shinga, akaziboni eshiya esikhundleni.UNksz Shinga uthe usazimisele ngokuqhubeka nomsebenzi wakhe yize iqembu lakhe, iNFP, selithathe isinqumo sokumkhipha esikhundleni.I-NFP iyalele uNksz Shinga ukuba esule njengelungu lesiShayamthetho, uma egcina esulile uzophunyukwa isikhundla sokuba umphathiswa. I-NFP ithathe isinqumo sokushintsha uhlu lwamalungu ayo esiShayamthetho, yabeka phezulu igama likamengameli wayo, uMnuz Ivan Barnes.Leli qembu linesihlalo esisodwa esiShayamthetho.UNksz Shinga uphinde abe usihlalo weNFP KwaZulu-Natal. Esitatimendini, uNksz Shinga uthe uzinikele emsebenzini aqokelwa kuwona ngonyaka odlule."Ngiyaqhubeka esikhundleni sokuba umphathiswa kanye nesokuba ilungu lesiShayamthetho futhi ngizibophezele ekusebenzeleni abantu baKwaZulu-Natal. Ngizinikele ukwenza umsebenzi engaqokelwa kuwo undunankulu yize noma kukhona izindaba zokuthi iqembu lami lingihoxisile esikhundleni. Ngizoqhubeka nokusebenzela abantu baKwaZulu-Natal ngokuzimisela nokuthembeka."Izindaba zokuhoxiswa kukaNksz Shinga, sezidale ungabazane ngohulumeni wokubambisana ophethe KwaZulu-Natal. Kepha uNksz Shinga uveze ukuthi iNFP isazoqhubeka nokuba ingxenye kahulumeni ophethe isifundazwe lapho ibambisene khona ne-IFP, ANC neDA."Sizimisele ukufeza izethembiso esazenza ebantwini baKwaZulu-Natal. Lokhu sizokwenza ngokubambisana kanye namanye amaqembu ayingxenye kahulumeni wokubambisana."UNksz Shinga uthe kusukela angena kulesi sikhundla ngonyaka owedlule, kuningi akwenzile ukuthuthukisa impilo yabantu baKwaZulu-Natal. "Emsebenzini engiwenzile bengigxile kakhulu ekuthuthukiseni abahlwempu. Njengamanje ngiphezu komkhankaso wokushintsha indlela umnyango owenza ngayo izinto. Ngifuna ukuthi umnyango ugxile kakhulu ekuthuthukiseni abantu abahlwempu ukuze bezokwazi ukuzimela. Akufanele umnyango ugcine ngokubanika usizo lwesikhashana. Njengomnyango sinezinhlelo ezinqala zokuthuthukisa abantu baKwaZulu-Natal."Ihhovisi likaSomlomo wesiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal, likuqinisekisile ukuthi liyitholile incwadi ehoxisa uNksz Shinga, lathi lisayicubungula.Akusiyena uNksz Shinga yedwa olengelwa yizembe kwiNFP njengoba iqembu lifuna ukukhipha ezikhundleni nezimeya zalo ezimbili. I-NFP iyalele iMeya kaMasipala waKwaNongoma, uMnuz Mshangane Ndabandaba, neMeya kaMasipala waseDumbe, uMnuz Sibusiso Mkhabela, ukuba bashiye ezikhundleni.Izimpi zangaphakathi azizintsha kwiNFP njengoba zaqala emva kwengqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi eyayingo-2018.Ubuholi obakhethwa kule ngqungquthela bagcina buchithiwe emva kwesinqumo senkantolo.
UPHIKO lweNtsha ye-ANC ku-ward 1 KwaXimba lukhala "ngamakhehla nogogo" abaqhoqhobele izikhundla kule nhlangano luthi abashenxe manje ungaze ucwile umkhumbi.Lolu phiko lusho lokhu ngesikhathi luhlangene ndawonye ehholo lomphakathi KwaDeda KwaXimba lukhumbula isishoshovu saleli salo mbutho esingasekho uMnuz Dumisani Mkhize, muva nje. UMkhize wadlula emhlabeni ngo-2018 eneminyaka engu-35. Izikhulumi ebezisina zidedelana zigcizelele ukuthi sekudingeka abantu abasha hhayi ogogo nomkhulu.UMnuz Sphamandla Khomo oyiphini likanobhala kule nhlangano, uthe sebekhathele ukuthula benze sengathi ababoni ekubeni izinto ziya ngokuya ziba mapeketwane ngaphansi kwezandla zabantu abadala."Iqiniso ukuthi manje sesidinga abantu abasha kwi-ANC abazoyithatha bayiyise kwelinye izinga. Sikhathele ngabantu abadala," usho kanje. Uthe umzabalazo wokulwa nobandlululo wawungeke uphumelele kalula ukuba nabantu abasha ababhukulanga bavuka umbhejazane ngo-1976.UNksz Nomusa Maduna ongusihlalo kule nhlangano, uthe uyobe ungumdayisi umuntu omusha oweseka umuntu omdala ukuba aqhubebe asebenze ekubeni kusobala ukuthi inhlangano idinga intsha ngoba isengcupheni yokufadabala.UMnuz Charlie Mzimela oyiphini likanobhala eThekwini, uthe sesifikile isikhathi sokuthi abantu abasha babhukule bachithe abantu abadala kungene igazi elisha.Bekuqhuma amakhwelo nemikikizo uma izikhulumi zihlaba zihlikiza eyabantu abadala ebuholini beqembu. Lolu phiko luthe sekulimi ephinjeni ukuba nomengameli oneminyaka engaphezulu kuka-60.Ngokuphumela obala ngokungafuni abantu abadala lolu phiko belunanela ikhwelo likaMengameli we-ANCYL, uMnuz Collen Malajti.Kumbulwe itshe likaMkhize elikhokhelwe yiMzungezwa Foundation, ephethwe yilungu lale nhlangano uMnuz Sizwe Bee Khanyile. UKhanyile uthe bekumqoka ukukhunjulwa kukaMkhize ngenxa yendima ayiklama enhlanganweni.Ukhale kakhulu ngendlala athe ibhuqabhuqa abantu abasha wathi kumele basukume balwe nalesi simo.
BAZOKWENZA olwabo uphenyo lwangaphakathi abeSouth African Social Security Agency (Sassa), ngowesifazane owayeyisisebenzi sabo, obanjwe nenqwaba yamakhadi okuthiwa ubehola ngawo izibonelelo zikahulumeni ngokungemthetho. Lokhu kushiwo okhulumela iSassa KwaZulu-Natal, uNksz Sandy Godlwana izolo.Umsolwa (37) onesithabathaba somuzi eCamperdown, ngaseMgungundlovu, uboshwe ngoLwesine amaphoyisa ophiko lwezobunhloli iCrime Intelligence, ebambisene nalawo aphenya ubugebengu obuhleliwe, i-Organised Crime. UNksz Godlwana uthe kuyiqiniso ukuthi kukhona owesifazane oboshwe amaphoyisa ngecala eliyamane nezibonelelo zakwaSassa. "Umsolwa wayeqashwe iSassa ngaphansi kohlelo i-Expanded Public Works Programme (EPWP), phakathi kuka-Okthoba 2012 kuya kuSepthemba 2013,” kusho uNksz Godlwana. Uthe abakuthole ngamaphoyisa ukuthi ubanjwe namakhadi angu-180, okukhona kuwo awasemabhange ahlukahlukene, kanjalo nawakwaSassa. "Silutholile lonke ulwazi ngalokhu siyiSassa, sizokwenza olwethu uphenyo ngalolu daba,” kusho uNksz Godlwana.Ube esekuqinisekisa nokuthi umsolwa akasayisebenzeli iSassa, waveza ukuthi ngesikhathi eyisebenzela, wayebekwe ehhovisi lawo eliseThekwini.Elandisa ngohlobo lomsebenzi ayewenza ngesikhathi esabasebenzela, uthe wayeqashelwe ukuthi alekelele ngesikhathi kubhaliswa kabusha izibonelelo. "Okwakhe kwakuwukusiza njengomabhalane, esiza ngokugaya nokugcwalisa amaphepha,” kusho uNksz Godlwana. Uthe ufuna ukucacisa ukuthi asikho isisebenzi esisebenza ngaphansi kophiko lwe-EPWP, esike sinikwe ilungelo lokungena kwi-system lapho okuhlelwa khona izicelo zezibonelelo.Ngokuthola kweSolezwe umsolwa ubanjiswe ukuthenga ngokheshi iToyota Fortuner okuthiwa ibiza uR600 000. Emakhadini abanjwe nawo, kukhona ahola ngawo izibonelelo zokuguga, kube ezabakhubazekile, ezezingane ezashonelwa abazali kanjalo neseqolo.Kuthiwa njalo ngenyanga ubehamba ayoyikhipha le mali emabhange ngamakhadi, bese eyifaka ebhange lakhe. Kuvela ukuthi ikhadi ngalinye libhalwe igama nesibongo "somnikazi" kanjalo nenombolo eyimfihlo yokukhipha imali ekulo. Kuthiwa njalo uma eseyofaka le mali ebhange lakhe ebibalelwa kuR80 000, ubeye athi uyazisebenza, unebhizinisi lokupheka kanti aphinde athi usebenza kwaShukela.Okunye okuvelile ukuthi unemizi emithathu yentengo kaR3 million, okuthiwa yonke ayikweleti.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uConstable Thenjiswa Ngcobo, uthe amaphoyisa aseMid Illovo abophe owesifazane obanjwe nempahla okusolwa ukuthi yebiwe. "Phakathi kwayo, kutholwe inqwaba yamakhadi asebhange emzini wakhe ngoJuni 5, 2025. Uvelile eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMgungundlovu ngoJuni 6, 2025,” kusho uConst Ngcobo.
UMSAKAZI weMetro FM, uSomizi "Somgaga" Mhlongo, usekhwele wadilika kubantu abalokhu begxeka izinkolelo zabanye. USomgaga uthe abantu abayeke ukuthi ngoba sebexakwe ubungoma noma ukusindiswa, bese begxeka leyo nkolo asebephumile kuyo. Lo saziwayo ongumdidiyeli wemidanso yamanje ukhulume kanje emuva kokuba kunozakwabo abalokhu begonyuluka ngokubenze balaxaza inkolo yamadlozi. Phakathi kwabo, kubalwa umlingisi wodumo kwiSibaya nakwiGenerations, uSiyabonga Thwala, osanda kuphumela obala ngokushiya inkolo yobuNazaretha. Omunye, uGogo Sikhotheni osanda kusindiswa emuva kokushiya ubungoma. Owake walingisa kwiGenerations futhi ongunina wengane kaSomizi, uPalesa Madisakwane, nozakwabo uThabiso Makhethi, bashiye phansi ubungoma bajoyina inkolo yobuKhrestu. Nomculi uPhelo Bala usanda kuphumela obala ngokushiya phansi ubungoma. USomizi uthe ayikho inkinga ngokuthi umuntu aphenduke, azalwe kabusha akhethe iNkosi. "Ayikho into embi ngalokho. Impilo yakho. Uhambo lwakho. Inkululeko yakho nelungelo lakho elukuMthethosisekelo. Akunankinga. Okungikhuba umphefumulo futhi okungenasidingo, ukugxeka into osuka kuyo. Asikho nje isidingo sokugxeka into obuyiyo. Qhubekela phambili!" Uthe uma ubona ukuthi obukukho akukusebenzelanga, dlulela kokunye ocabanga ukuthi kuzokusebenzela. "Musa ukugxeka ngoba yikho enginenkinga nakho ngoba kuwukwedelela abantu abasagcina leyo nkolelo wena osuka kuyo. Ungakwenzi nje lokho ngoba awutholi lutho ngikugxeka inkolelo yomunye," usho kanje ekhuluma ezinkundleni ezehlukene zokuxhumana. Uthe kunabantu abafike bahlabe izimbuzi ngoba bekholelwa emadlozini. "Gwiqiqi, wena sewuthi inkolelo yamadlozi ingamadimoni futhi ukuhlabela amadlozi imbuzi akunamsebenzi walutho. Omunye ubewumKhrestu obekholelwa eBhayibhelini nakuJesu, jikijiki uJesu yinto engekho." Uthe umuntu akagxile kulokhu akholelwa kukho ngoba wonke umuntu usuke eseyedwa ebhokisini.
KUSOLWA ukuthi ubanjwe isithongwane umshayeli webhasi okushone kuyo amalungu e-EFF angu-10.Abasinde engozini eyenzeke ngoMsombuluko, ngaseVryheid, bathi umshayeli webhasi ubebukeka ebanjwe ubuthongo ngesikhathi ibhasi ebithwele amalungu e-EFF ishayisana neloli Amalungu e-EFF abebuya emcimbini wokugubha uSuku lweNtsha obuseKing Zwelithini, eMlaza, eThekwini.Umholi we-EFF, uMnuz Julius Malema, uyena othule inkulumo yosuku kulo mcimbi wangoMsombuluko.Kule ngozi kulimale inqwaba yabantu, ababili kuthiwa basesimweni esibucayi. Osinde kule ngozi, uMnuz Lindizwe Zungu, uthe ubesathathe isihlwathi ngesikhathi behlelwa yingozi."Abantu basho okuningi, abanye bathi umshayeli webhasi ubezama ukudlula enye imoto kanti abanye bathi ubeseficwe ubuthongo."UZungu uthe yena uphaphame abantu abehamba nabo sebekhala ubumayemaye. "Ngiphaphame sekukhala abantu besimame, abantu bememeza. Abantu bebekhala ngapha nangapha."UZungu, okunguye obehlela uhambo lwabasuka eVryheid, uthe usekude ukukhohlwa isiphihli asibonile."Namanje angazi ukuthi kufanele ngithini. Bengiqala ukubona isiphihli esinje. Ngithe ngiyaqalaza abantu ebengihamba nabo, ngabona ukuthi sebeshonile." UMphathiswa wezokuThutha KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Siboniso Duma, uthe bazophenya ngembangela yengozi, wathi umshayeli webhasi noweloli basesibhedlela."Sesixhumanile namaphoyisa ukuba asondele eduzane. Lokhu senzela ukuthi abe seduzane uma kuba nesidingo sokuthi amaphoyisa ahlole labashayeli ukuthi bebengaphuzile yini ngesikhathi kwenzeka ingozi. Okwamanje kusaphenywa icala lokubulala ngokungenhloso." IMeya kaMasipala wasoLundi, uMnuz Wilson Ntshangase, ikhale kakhulu ngomthelela wamaloli amakhulu ahamba kulo mgwaqo.UNtshangase uthe zonke izingozi ezenzeka kulo mgwaqo zibandakanya amaloli."Sinxusa iziphathimandla ukuba zilusukumele udaba lwamaloli asebenzisa lo mgwaqo. Isikhathi esiningi uma kunengozi ethatha imiphefumulo eminingi kusuke kukhona neloli. Asazi ukuthi ikuphi iziphathimandla zomgwaqo ezingakwenza." Okhulumela i-EFF, uMnuz Sinawo Thambo, ufanise amalungu aphangalele namasosha afele emsebenzini."Silahlekelwe amalungu abezinikele emzabalazweni wokuthuthukisa abantu abamnyama. Bashone bephuma ukuyokweseka umzabalazo wokuthuthukisa abantu abamnyama. Silahlekelwe impela."UThambo uthe bazokweseka imindeni yamalungu ashonile. Amaqembu ezepolitiki okubalwa kuwo i-ANC ne-IFP adlulise amazwi enduduzo emindenini eshonelwe.Ezingozini ezenzeke kule minyaka eyedlule eVryheid kwashona amalungu e-ANC kwenye kwashona nawe-IFP.
IKHULUNYELWA phansi eyokusolakala kowomndeni ngemuva kokusocongwa kukasomabhizinisi waKwaMaphumulo.UMnuz Zwelibanzi Makhathini (57), kuvela ukuthi ubulawe ngokudutshulwa esemzini wakhe eZithabeni, KwaMaphumulo, ngoMgqibelo ebusuku.Kuvela ukuthi kufike amadoda amane angene endlini avulela ngenhlamvu amshiya efile. Kusolwa ukuthi kukhona abanye abomndeni ebebekhona ngaphakathi endlini kodwa bona kabazange bathinteke. Umthombo olaziyo lolu daba ocele ukungavezwa, upotshozele Isolezwe ukuthi abahlaseli bafike behamba ngemoto yohlobo lwePolo empunga, okuthiwa babonakale behla kuyona buqamama, base besondela behamba ngezinyawo.''Ibuhlungu le nto eyenzekile kule ndoda ngoba thina siyazi njengomuntu wabantu futhi ongaluthandi udlame,'' kuchaza umthombo.Uthe umufi ubewusizo emphakathini njengoba ebejwayele ukunikela ngamagilosa okudla emindenini entulayo, ikakhulukazi uma kuyisikhathi sikaKhisimusi. Uthe impela umphakathi wakule ndawo ufe olwenziwa ngalo mshophi obehle ngaphezulu. Indodana kamufi, uMnuz Zakhele Makhathini, ebingathandi ukukhuluma kodwa yagcina yehlisa umoya, igagule igama lowomndeni, yathi bayazi ukuthi nguye ongungqondongqondo wokusocongwa kukayise.Ithe kodwa ngenxa yokuthi kusalele isidumbu bazothula bathalalise kube sengathi ababoni ukuthi kwenzekeni kumufi.''Le nto eyenzekile sazi kahle ukuthi ubani oyenzile, ngabe siqamba amanga aluhlaza nje uma singathi kasazi,'' isho kanje.UMakhathini uthe kodwa akukho zinyane lemvubu ladliwa zingwenya maqede kucwebe iziziba. Ecelwa ukuba acacise ngale nkulumo uthe isho ukuthi ''umdlalo awukapheli'' kodwa yima uqala. ''Lo owenze lokhu mina angifihli nje ukuthi kumele avive kahle futhi ngoba kuzobe kubhekene abomndeni, kuyocaca khona,'' usho kanje, wase ecela ukuvalelisa ekhala ngokuthi umane acasuke kakhulu uma ekhuluma ngalolu daba.Uveze ukuthi uyise udutshulwe bekhona endlini kungekho abangakwenza ngoba amadoda abehlome eyizingovolo futhi emaningi. Uqhube wathi uyise ubenamabhizinisi ehlukene afaka phakathi inqwaba yezindlu zomqasho ezingxenyeni ezahlukene zaseThekwini, ama-tuck shops nendawo yamakhaza.Siye koshicilela amaphoyisa engakaphenduli emibuzweni ethunyelwe ileli phephandaba.
