UFUNA ubulungiswa umndeni waseMaphephetheni, eNanda, umfundi ezibulala emva kokukhala ngokuthunjwa nokudlwengulwa ngabasolwa abaziwayo abasebenza embonini yamatekisi. U-Athabile Khanyi (17) obefunda uGrade 11 esikoleni iMakhapha Combined endaweni, ushonele esibhedlela esiKwaMashu, iDkt Pixley Ka-Isaka Seme Memorial ngoLwesine, kulandela ukuphuza inqwaba yamaphilisi.Elandisa ngesehlo udadewabo kamufi, uNksz Ntombifikile Mthembu, uthe abasolwa ababili, abagagule ngamagama umufi, bamthumba ngetekisi umufi ngoJuni 6, 2025, bemfica ezimele esitobhini. "Baze bambuyisa ngoMsombuluko (Juni 9). Wafika ekhaya watshela umndeni ukuthi ubethunjwe obani futhi bamdlwengula beshintshana ngaye,” kusho uNksz Mthembu.Uthe umndeni awuzange ukuthathele phezulu owawukutshelwa umufi, uzitshela ukuthi uqamba amanga, ubeziyele ezindaweni zakhe."Ebona ukuthi akekho omkholwayo, uvele waya emzini kanina, oseduze nasekhaya. Wafike wabhala incwadi echaza ngakho konke okumehlele, wase ephuza inqwaba yamaphilisi,” kusho yena. Uthe kwase kuyizikhathi zantambama ngesikhathi unina emfica esesimweni esibi kodwa esaphila."Waphinde washo ukuthi kwenzekeni kodwa ebonakala ukuthi uxinekile ngoba ephalaza ngakho wonke umuntu ngaleso sikhathi wayesekhathazeke ngesimo sempilo yakhe,” usho kanje.Uthe unina wathola nencwadi lapho umufi ayechaza ngakho konke okumehlele. Uveze ukuthi bamyisa emtholampilo wendawo, owathi uma umhlola wathola ukuthi usechama igazi, wamdlulisela esibhedlela iMahatma Gandhi Memorial, sona esamdlulisela eDkt Pixley Ka-Isaka Seme Memorial ngoLwesithathu. Umufi ugcine eshonela kulesi sibhedlela ngoLwesine. Kuthiwa abezempilo bathe isibindi sakhe sivele sehluleka, ngenxa yobuningi bamaphilisi awaphuzile. Kuphinde kwavela nokuthi kukhona izidakamizwa abasolwa abamgxisha zona ngesikhathi bemthumbile. "Kuvele nokuthi ubedlwenguliwe ngempela ngabantu abehlukene,” kusho uNksz Mthembu, lokhu kufakazela akushilo encwadini umufi, njengoba ethe babeshintshana ngaye."Sibuhlungu ngokwenzeke ku-Atha. Okusiphatha kabi kakhulu ukuthi abasolwa bayaqhubeka nempilo yabo sengathi abenzanga lutho olubi,” usho kanjena.Uthe omunye umsolwa usebenza erenki yamatekisi eMaphephetheni, kuthi omunye abe wusicabha. "Sibona sengathi amaphoyisa asicekela phansi. Bonke ubufakazi abunikiwe kodwa awababophi abasolwa. Uma siwabuza athi asaphenya noma asizibe. Asazi ukuthi yini ayiphenyayo,” usho kanje.Kuthintwa usihlalo wophiko lwabesifazane iCivil Society esifundeni seTheku, uNksz Nokuthula Cele, uthe badumele futhi bacasukile ngesenzo sabasolwa.Uthe okubakhathazayo ukuthi akuqali ukuthi babikelwe ngesigameko salolu hlobo eMaphephetheni. "Sibuya siphindelela ngezehlakalo zalolu hlobo kule ndawo. Okubi ukuthi asibuboni ubulungiswa. Amacala ayalandelelwa kodwa kungafinyelelwa esiphethweni. Umnyakazo size siwubone uma udaba silusukumela siyizinhlaka ezilwa nokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane,” kusho uNksz Cele. Uthe bengomama sebeyasaba ukuthuma izingane zabo ezitolo."Indawo yaseMaphephetheni isemakhaya kodwa inezigameko ezinyantisa igazi,” usho kanje. Ukhale nangedlanzana eleseka abantu abasuke besolwa ngobugebengu obubucayi endaweni, kubona wabalula imindeni yabasolwa nabelaphi bendabuko. "Izinyanga nabelaphi abayeke ukunika abasolwa ngamacala umuthi wokuthi baphume phambili emacaleni. Ngalokho babulala amandla ethu siyizinhlaka ezilwa nesihlava. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abehlukene nabantu ababulala abagilwa bephila,” kubeka uNksz Cele. Uthe uhulumeni akalungise eyokuphuza ukuphuma kwemiphumela yolibofuzo ngoba nayo iba nomthelela emacaleni afuze lawa. Ukhale nangamadoda angafuni ukuzibandakanya emibhidlangweni yokulwa nesihlava sokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane.Uthe namuhla - umphakathi okuhamba phambili kuwo abafundi - uzoba nokhukhulelangoqo wemashi, waveza ukuthi izosuka enkundleni yezemidlalo endaweni iya erenki yamatekisi, lapho okuthiwa kusebenza khona abasolwa, bese iphetha esiteshini samaphoyisa eNanda, ukuyowanika uhlu lwezikhalazoSishicilele amaphoyisa engakaphenduli imibuzo mayelana nalesi sehlakalo.
KUZOKWEHLISA umthwalo wezindleko ukwakhiwa kwesikhungo esiseNyokeni, KwaNongoma, esizosetshenziselwa izintombi ngesikhathi soMkhosi woMhlanga.Lokhu kushiwo uMphathiswa wezebuCiko namaSiko KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Mntomuhle Khawula, okhulume ngezindleko athe beziba khona futhi zimba eqolo singakakhiwa lesi sikhungo. Ubekade ekhuluma kuleli sonto ngesikhathi ehambele kulesi sikhungo ukuyobheka ukuthi ngabe sesikulungele yini ukubhekana nalo msebenzi woMkhosi woMhlanga.Ubehambisana noMphathiswa wezemiSebenzi yoMphakathi kanye neNgqalasizinda esifundazweni, uMnuz Martin Meyer. UKhawula uthe phambilini ibiba ningi kakhulu imali ebisetshenziswa kuqashwa amatende. Uthe lezo zindleko bekumele zithwalwe uMnyango wezamaSiko namaCiko minyaka yonke.Uveze ukuthi yingakho kwagcina sekuba nombono wokuthi kube nesakhiwo salolu hlobo."Iqiniso ukuthi beyiningi kakhulu imali ebesiyikhipha ngenxa yokuthi besiqasha amatende amaningi uma kuza lo mkhosi. Kulokhu uzoke uthi ukwehla kancane umthwalo ngoba izindleko ngeke zibe nkulu," usho kanje. Uthe kumhlabe umxhwele kakhulu lo msebenzi ufinyelela kulesi sigaba osukusona manje. Uthe lo msebenzi kwaqalwa ukubhungwa ngawo kusekhona iSilo esesabuza, uMdlokombane."Kuyangijabulisa ukuthi namhlanje lokhu okwakhulunywa ngakho noMdlokombane kuyenzeka." Udalule ukuthi bagcine besebenzisa imali enguR154 million ukuphothula lesi sakhiwo kodwa uthe babekade behlele uR140 million. "Uyabonake ukuthi ngeke ufike usebenzise imali eningi kangaka kodwa bese kuba uwena futhi oqhubekayo nokuqasha amatende amaningi.''UMeyer uncome kakhulu ukudaleka kwamathuba omsebenzi ngenxa yalo msebenzi. Ushayele ihlombe abakwa-Enza, okuyibona ababenikwe umsebenzi wokwakha.Uthe bafuna ukuthi iKwaZulu-Natal ibe nezakhiwo zeqophelo eliphezulu.
UKHUTHAZA abesifazane ukuba bangazitheli ngabandayo kodwa babhukule balwele ukuzuza isitifiketi esibagunyaza ukusebenza emabhange oweCebolethu.UNksz Xolile Khakhuse (40), oqeqesha abesifazane ukuze bazuze isitifiketi iRegulatory Examination Five (FEF), uthe sesifikile isikhathi sokuba balwele ukuzithuthukisa ngalolu hlobo lwesitifiketi.Ubaqeqeshela esikhungweni sakhe esiseBridge City, KwaMashu, aphinde kube khona abafundisa online. Lesi sitifiketi uthe sijwayelwe ukudingeka emabhange nakwezinye izikhungo ezisebenza ngemali.UNksz Khakhuse odabuka KwaMachi, eHarding, ukholwa wukuthi abantu abanalolu hlobo lwesitifiketi bayakwazi ukuthi basebenze nasemabhange ahamba phambili kuleli.Yena usebenza egatsheni lenkampani yabangcwabi Icebolethu eliseMpangeni. ''Lolu uhlobo lwesitifiketi engikholwa ukuthi luyakwazi ukwenza umehluko empilweni yomuntu wesifazane. Yingakho nje ngibakhuthaza kakhulu ukuthi bangazitheli ngabandayo kodwa bakukhuthalele ukusenza,'' usho kanjena. Njengoba esebenza eCebolethu uthe kuningi akufundile ngokubaluleka kokuba abesifazane bahlome ngezitifiketi ezahlukene. Uveze ukuthi uneziqu zeNational Diploma in Accounting azithola ngo-2010.Nakuba ekhuthaza kakhulu abantu besifazane ukuba balwele ukuzuza lezi ziqu kodwa akakhethi iphela emasini, nabantu besilisa ukholwa ukuthi ingaguquka impilo yabo uma bengathola lolu hlobo lwesitifiketi.Uthe uma esebaqeqeshile ubadlulisela kwabakwaMoonstone ukuyobhala uma bephasa okuyilapho-ke abathola khona izitifiketi.Uthe okumkhathazayo ukuthi ababaningi abanolwazi mayelana nalolu hlobo lwesitifiketi. ''Ngiyafisa ukuthi bande abesifazane abathola lolu lwazi ngoba lungabalekelela kakhulu,''usho kanjena.''Eqinisweni nje nabo abantu besilisa impilo yabo ingaba ngcono kabi uma bengase bathole lolu hlobo lwesitifiketi,''usho kanjena.
INKABI ebufunwa uthuli ngamacala okubulala embonini yamatekisi igcine ikhalelwa amasongo kaseGonyela ngoLwesibili ekuseni.Le nsizwa okunguVuyolwethu Tshukela odume ngelikaYesu ubhekene nohide lwamacala okubulala nokukhwabanisa iqoqa imali emabhizinisi ngo-dli. Amaphoyisa ayekhiphe umehlo kaboni kaR100,000 kufunwa le nsizwa edabuka eMthatha okukholakala ukuthi igawule kwazwakala embonini yamatekisi ngonyaka odlule ePhilippi East, Nyanga, naseDelft.Le nsizwa ivele enkantolo yeMantshi e-Athlone namhlanje.
ABAMANGALELWA abayisikhombisa bavele eNkantolo yezeMali eThekwini ngezinsolo zomkhonyovu wezincwadi zokuhambela amazwe.Abammangalelwa uMmeli Philani Trevor Zaca (Dlamini), uThandiwe Pretty Khwela, Zime Anita Shange, Fumani Hlayisi, Bongiwe Kubheka, Lindokuhle Bongumusa Mpanza noLungisani Siyanda Mzobe.Babhekene namacala okukhwabanisa, ukuphula umthetho 68 ka-1997 wokuhlinzekwa komazisi, ukuphula umthetho 13ka 2002 (njengokuchibuyelwa) wabokufika, and Corruption othinta ukwemukela ukugwazelwa.UMbuso ukholwa wukuthi kunabasebenzi boMnyango wezaseKhaya abasebenza ngokubambisana nabanye abaqhuba ubugebengu, kwafakwa izicelo zomgunyathi emahhovisi ahlukene KwaZulu-Natal. Izicelo kuthiwa zazenziwa amahhovisi esevalile ebusuku, ngezimpelasonto nangamaholidi.Izicelo zomgunyathi zazikhishelwa abokufika kuleli kungafanele futhi kwakusetshenziswa imininingwane yabantu baseNingizimu Afrika abanomazisi kodwa abangenazi izincwadi zokuhambela amazwe.Icala lihlehlele u-20 Juni 2025 ukuze abamangalelwa bafake izicelo zabameli be-Legal Aid namalungiselelo esicelo sebheyili.Konke lokhu kusukela ophwenyweni loMnyango wezaseKhaya KwaZulu-Natal noKlebe besebenza nabashushisi be-NPA.
IZOQALE yemukelwe ngomthandazo ohlanganisa wonke amabandla inkosi obese kuphele iminyaka emihlanu ingahlezi esihlalweni ngenxa yombango. Lokhu kuzokwenzeka ngoLwesithathu oluzayo, ngemuva kokuthi uMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana noBuholi boMdabu umemezele ukuthi uzodlulisela isitifiketi eNkosini Musawenkosi Ngubane (40), ozalwa eMabomvini, eMsinga.Ukhokho weNkosi uNgubane, uMnuz Leonard Ngubane, uveze ukuthi okwamanje bazoqala ngomthandazo njengoba isimo besingelula, umbango usha phansi. "Sizobonga ukuthi ekugcineni uhulumeni uzonikeza umuntu oyinkosi isikhundla sakhe. Kube iminyaka emihlanu enzima yombango walesi sikhundla owaqala kukhothama uyise weNkosi uPano Ngubane. Ngakho ngoLwesithathu oluzayo, ngeke senze mcimbi wokubungaza ojwayelekile uma inkosi inikwa isitifiketi, sobamba umkhuleko sibonge uMdali ngokusigcina size sibone lolu suku," kusho uMnuz Ngubane.Uthe babize isizwe ngoba sebethole isitifiketi nokuyinto okumele yaziwe esizweni sonke."Sifuna ukukubeka kucace ukuthi asikhethi nkolo, sibiza wonke umuntu. Engingakusho ukuthi umcimbi ojwayelekile angeke ngisho ukuthi uyoba ngemuva kweminyaka emingaki kusuka manje, esisazokwenza ukuhambela izigodi ezihlukene sethula inkosi kubantu bayo, bese iyahola ngendlela enokuthula," kuchaza yena.Uthe ngisho amabutho azobe engekho ngenxa yohlelo abafuna ukulwenza okwamanje. Uveze ukuthi nasenkosini eyakhothama njengoba sekuthatha lena manje, wawukhona umbango kodwa abawubone kumele kuthathe eyamanje, ubumubi kakhulu.Ukugcizelele ukuthi bona njengabantu abadala bazimisele ukuthi bayikhulise iNkosi uMsawenkosi njengoba isencane. Uthe uma inkosi isondela kubona akukho nokuncane ukungabaza lokhu ukuthi ngokwenza kwayo kanjalo iyoncela kogwansile, wathi nabo njengabantu asebehambe ibanga elide nesizwe, bazokwenza konke okusemandleni ngenhloso yokuqinisekisa ukuthi inkosi ibonakala yenza konke ngendlela efanele nevuma isizwe.UNgubane uthe okumele kube seqhulwini kwinkosi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi isizwe sikayise siba nobumbano, ukuthula, uthando kanye nokusebenzisana kunoma yini eyenziwayo.
UNGQONGQOSHE wezamaPhoyisa, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, useveze ukuthi akukho ezandleni zakhe ukuqoka okhomishana bamaphoyisa okuphela izinkontileka zabo ngasekupheleni konyaka.UMchunu ubehambele endaweni yaseWembezi, eMtshezi ngeSonto, lapho bekunomkhankaso we-Asiyekhaya, wokwamukela amalungu ajoyina i-ANC aphuma kwamanye amaqembu.Ekhuluma nabezindaba uveze ukuthi akanalo izwi ekuqokweni kokhomishana bamaphoyisa njengoba beqokwa nguMkhuzi wamaPhoyisa, uGeneral Fannie Masemola. "Udaba olungathinti mina lolo, kodwa luzobhekwa uMasemola njengoba kusehhovisi lakhe ukuthi bakhethe okhomishana abasha,” kusho uMchunu.Uthe yena akubhekile ukuqhubeka nokungenelela ezindaweni ezigcwele ubugebengu ezinye ezikhona KwaZulu-Natal, Gauteng naseWestern Cape."Angifuni kubonakale sengathi sinake iNanda noMlaza ngoba ngoba lezi zindawo zihlale zihamba phambili ngobugebengu uma kuphuma izibalo zobugebengu, kodwa zikhona nezinye izindawo isimo esibi kakhulu khona KwaZulu-Natal, la kubulawa khona abantu usuku nosuku. Uyazi nje ePhoenix kunenkinga kodwa ayigqamile ngakho ngifuna singabuki izindawo ezithize kuphela kodwa sisukumele zonke izindawo ezinezinkinga,” kuchaza uMchunu. Kulo mkhankaso akade ekuwo njengelungu lesigungu esiphezulu kwi-ANC, uveze ukuthi banomlando ngendawo yaseMtshezi njengoba kwachitheka igazi labantu abehlukene ngenxa yezimpi zepolitiki.Uthe akugcini lapho banomengameli owaphatha i-ANC, uMnuz Josiah Gumede ophuma kuyona le ndawo."Ziningi izindawo esisazozihambela ukuze sibuyise abantu abashiye i-ANC, esithi ababuye ekhaya. Siyajabula ukwamukela abantu abangaphezu kuka-100, abasuka emaqenjini ehlukene ababone ukuthi babuye ekhaya kwi-ANC. Amaqembu ezepolitiki akhona manje abantu abasuka kwi-ANC, abanye abaphuma sengathi bayochama bahehwa ngoju bavula amaqembu abo. Uyabona lo muntu waphuma namagugu ethu siyiqembu, wathatha imibala yeqembu nokunye yingakho sisenkantolo manje ngoba sifuna okungokwethu,” kuchaza yena. Ebantwini abamukelwe kubalwa abasuka kwiNFP, IFP, EFF neDA.UMnuz Sizwe Mchunu obeyikhansela leNFP ongomunye wabajoyine i-ANC, uveze ukuthi azolwa nakho kakhulu ukuthi kuphinde kubuye amanzi elokishini iWembezi angaphumi muva nje futhi baphinde bazame ukubuyela kuMasipala ILangalibalele, ukuze intsha iphinde ivulekelwe amathuba omsebenzi ayekhona kuqala.Kulolu hambo uMchunu ubehambisana nobuholi bendawo nephini likaNgqongqoshe wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana nobuHoli boMdabu kuzwelonke uMnuz Dickson Masemola, ophinde abe sethimbeni elijutshwe ukuzolungisa isifundazwe iKwaZulu-Natal ngemuva kokungenzi kahle okhethweni lwangonyaka odlule.
UMHOLI we-MK, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, uthe lisazoqhubeka nokugawula izembe kubaholi beqembu abenza okuphambene nomthetho, wathi abakhathali noma ngabe bathandwa kangakanani.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma emcimbini wokwethula ngokusemthethweni ubuholi bophiko lwentsha kwi-MK obuseClermont. Ziningi izinguquko ezenziwe ebuholini be-MK kusukela yasungulwa eminyakeni engaphansi kwemibili eyedlule.Muva nje, i-MK idilize obengunobhala jikelele wayo, uMnuz Floyd Shivambu, obengakaqedi ngisho unyaka ehlezi kulesi sikhundla.Bayisikhombisa abantu asebephathe isikhundla sikanobhala jikelele kwi-MK kulesi sikhathi esingaphansi kweminyaka emibili yasungulwa. UZuma uthe akekho umholi ozozenzela umathanda kwi-MK."Lena akuyona inhlangano yokuzicebisa, yinhlangano yokukhulula abantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Ingakho uma uzoqhaphela kahle uma kuke kwabakhona omunye wethu owenza into engalungile, siyamsusa esikhundleni. Uma uzoqaphela kahle bayisikhombisa abantu asebephathe isikhundla sikanobhala jikelele ngoba asidlali. Uma sibona ukuthi awenzi kahle siyakwehlisa esikhundleni. Sifuna inkululeko."UZuma uthe ugazi angeke lubavikele abaholi ukuthi bakhishwe ezikhundleni. "Noma ngabe uthandwa kangakanani, noma ngabe ufunde kangakanani, asinendaba. Akekho umuntu ozoncengwa. Noma ngabe uwuGedleyihlekisa, uma usuwenza okuphambene nomthetho kufanele uhambe. Wonke umuntu uyazizela lapha kwi-MK, uma ungasanelisekile phindela emuva kwagogo."UZuma ukhuze abavikela abaholi abakhishwa ezikhundleni."Ngizwile nje kuthiwa lapha bekukhona abebefuna ukubhikisha, befuna ukuzokhalaza ngezinqumo esizithathile. Kusho ukuthi kusekude phambili uma kuwukuthi kusekhona abantu abenza kanje."UZuma ugqugquzele intsha ukuba iqhubeke nokulwela izidingo zayo."Intsha iyona eyikusasa lakuleli zwe. Thina ningasizwa nje sidaza inkani sithi asikagugi kodwa iqiniso ukuthi ikusasa laleli lizwe lisezandleni zenu. Ingakho kungafanele ningathuli uma nibona izinto zibheda."
KUSUKE isidumo kuqhuma isibhamu emhlanganweni wokukhetha ubuholi be-ActionSA kuWard 25 kuMasipala waseThekwini.Umhlangano obuhanjelwe umholi we-ActionSA, uMnuz Herman Mashaba nowaKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Zwakele Mncwango, uchithiwe emva kokuba kugasele umuntu ofike waqhumisa isibhamu waphinde washaya abebehambele umhlangano ngesando.Umhlangano ububanjelwe kuKennedy Road, ngeSonto. Kube ubumayemaye ngesikhathi kugasela umsolwa ofike wasongela abebehambele umhlangano.Umsolwa ube eseqhumisa isibhamu kwaze kwaba kathathu.Emva kokuphucwa isibhamu, umsolwa uvele wadonsa isando waphihliza kwasani obekuphambi kwakhe. Lo msolwa ugcine eboshiwe, kulindeleke ukuthi avele enkantolo namhlanje.UMncwango uthe amalungu e-ActionSA akwazile ukuphuca umsolwa isibhamu."Udubule amahlandla amaningi, ngenhlanhla-leyo amalungu eqembu akwazile ukumbamba, amphuca isibhamu. Sibonga ubuhlakani nesibindi samalungu eqembu. Ukucabanga ngokushesha kwamalungu eqembu kugweme inhlekelele enkulu ebingenzeka ukube akazange aphucwe isibhamu ngokushesha umsolwa." Uthe umsolwa bamdlulisele emaphoyiseni aseSydenham."Amaphoyisa asitshele ukuthi umsolwa uzovela enkantolo ngoLwesibili (namhlanje). Sizokube sikhona enkantolo lapho sinxusa ukuba umsolwa anganikezwa ibheyili."Uthe baphoqelekile ukuba bahoxise umhlangano emva kwesidumo okulimale kuso elinye lamalungu eqembu. "Ngokucabangela isimo sokuphepha samalungu eqembu noMashaba, sithathe isinqumo esinzima sokuba sihoxise umhlangano. Elinye ilungu leqembu lilimale kanzima ngesikhathi kusuka isidumo."UMncwango waziwa ngokugxeka inkohlakalo eminyangweni kahulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal nokomasipala.Uthe kuyakhathaza ukuthi isigameko senzeka lapho kubhekwe khona okhethweni lohulumeni basekhaya nokuyilapho zande kakhulu izigameko zokusocongwa kosopolitiki esifundazweni. "Le nto isikhumbuza umlando omubi wokungabekezelelani kwezepolitiki lapha KwaZulu-Natal. Iphambene noMthethosisekelo wezwe onikeza bonke abantu amalungelo okuba bakhankase ngokukhululeka. Njengoba sekusondele ukhetho lohulumeni basekhaya sinxusa wonke amaqembu ezepolitiki ukuba ashumayele ivangeli lokubekezelelana."UMashaba ubonge amaphoyisa ngokusukumela ngokushesha lolu daba.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uConstable Thenjiswa Ngcobo, akazange ayiphendule imibuzo athunyelelwe yona.
UKHALA ngonya owesilisa okudutshulwe kwabulawa unina omzalayo nonina wengane yakhe ngabathile athi ubesenolwazi lokuthi yibona abeba imoto yakhe ngonyaka owedlule.UMnuz Asanda Cingo ukhala ngokubulawa ngesihluku kukanina uNkk Ntombetsha Mmangaliso (52) benomama wengane yakhe, uNksz Nokuthula Mkhize (39). Laba ababili kuvela ukuthi badutshulwe babulawa esigamekweni esenzeke ngoLwesine kusihlwa, besendlini abahlala kuyona eseKenviille. Kuvela ukuthi umuntu emunye udutshulwe ngenhlamvu eyodwa ekhanda. Isigameko kuvela ukuthi senzeke ngezithuba zabo-6 ntambama. Kusolwa ukuthi kungene abesilisa ababili babuza ukuthi uphi umnikazi wemoto eyebiwa, besho uCingo. Kuthe uma ebebesendlini bephendula ngokuthi kabamazi, bavele bavulela ngenhlamvu babashiya sebethule abafi.UCingo ekhuluma neSolezwe Ngempelasonto ulithathe walibeka ngokuze kwaholela kulo mshophi. Ulimise ngesihloko elokuthi ukubulawa kwalaba kungenxa yomnyombo wempi yemoto yakhe i-Avanza eyebiwa ngoJulayi 24, ngonyaka owedlule. Ngemuva kokuba seyebiwe imoto, uthe wathola ukuthi yibaphi abantu abayithathile imoto yakhe."Ngathola ukuthi imoto yami ithathwe ngabesilisa bakhona lapha endaweni. Okwadala ukuthi ngithole kalula ukuthi bayeba emini kwabha kubuka abanye abantu. Kugcine kufinyelela ke ezindlebeni zabo ukuthi sengiyazi ukuthi yibona abathatha imoto yami,'' echaza.Uthe kusukela lapho, bekuba khona abamtshelayo ukuthi laba besilisa kabaneme ngokuthi useyazi ngabo, bahlela itulo lokumbulala.Udalule ukuthi laba besilisa kuke kwaba nesikhathi lapho abenyamalale khona endaweni kodwa bagcina sebebuya bobathathu.''Kukhona omunye obesanda kusho kwabanye abantu ukuthi uke wazama ukungibulala kodwa wamane wasindelwa, wehluleka,'' kusho yena Uveza ukuthi isigameko sokubulawa kwalaba senzeke kabi engekho ekhaya njengoba kukhona lapho abephuthume khona kukhona izinto abeyozilungisa.''Angazi ukuthi kwenzeke kanjani ukuthi ukufika kwabo bakuqondanise ngesikhathi mina ngingekho. Ngiyazibuza ukuthi mhlawumbe bebazi ukuthi angikho yini,'' usho kanjena.Uchaze lesi simo njengesimhlukumezile kakhulu, wakhala ngalaba besilisa wabachaza nengabantu abanesihluku esingechazwe.''Sebengaze bakhiphe izidumbu ezimbili zonke ngenxa nje yokuthi kubangwa imoto. Ibuhlungu le nto abayenzile kodwa akukho engingakwenza, ngizokwamukela ngigwinye noma kubaba,'' kusho uCingo.Ugcizelele kakhulu ukuthi ufuna umthetho uthathe indima yawo, bakhalelwe ngamasongo kaSigonyela abenzi bobubi bajeze ngesigwebo esibafanele. Okhulumela amaphoyi KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda uthe amaphoyisa aseGreenwood Park avule icala lokubulawa kwababili besifazane. Uthe kuvela ukuthi laba bahlaselwe babulawa besendlini ngoLwesine
ABANTU baseNingizimu Afrika abehlise umoya bangasheshi ukubheka imiphumela ehambisana nabo kuhulumeni wokubusa ngokubambisana kwamaqembu ehlukene.Lokhu kushiwo umhlaziyi wezepolitiki, uMnuz Zakhele Ndlovu, ekhuluma neSolezwe ngeMpelasonto kulandela isigcawu sangoLwesine ebesibanjwe ngobuchwepheshe ukudingida ukuthi ngabe izwe selikuphi selokhu kwangena uhulumeni wobumbano, izinselelo ezikhona ngaphansi kwawo nokuthi kungabhekwana kanjani nazo. Kulesi sigcawu ebesihlelwe iNyuvesi yaKwaZulu-Natal (UKZN) bekushiyelana inkundla abemikhakha ehlukene. UNdlovu uthe kusesekuseni ukuthi abantu bangalindela lukhulu kulo hulumeni ngoba ziningi izinkinga izwe elibhekene nazo."Inkinga enkulu ukuthi abantu abakulo hulumeni abazwani bebodwa okushiya umbuzo wokuthi bazosebenza kanjani," esho. Uthe lokhu kubonakale ngempikiswano ebekhona ngemithetho; owomshwalense wezempilo iNational Health Insurance (NHI), owezemfundo eyisisekelo, iBasic Education Laws Amendment Bill, owokuthathwa komhlaba nesabelomali sanonyaka."Bazosebenzisana kanjani uma kuyilowo nalowo efuna ukujabulisa abamuvotele? Lokhu kufana nomshado wababili okufanele babambisane ukuze izingane zidle kodwa bengasathandani," echaza.Uqhube wathi lokhu akhuluma ngakho kuphinde kwagqama ngesikhathi sempikiswano ngesabelomali nathe kunzima ukusebenzisana phakathi kukaNgqongqoshe wezeziMali nephini lakhe. UNdlovu uthe njengoba izwe libhekene nenkinga yomnotho, ingqalasizinda inganakekelwa namabhizinisi kahulumeni ehluleka ukudala imisebenzi, kuzothatha isikhathi ukuthi uhulumeni wobumbano uqhamuke nesisombululo."Angiboni bezokwenza umehluko omkhulu ngoba ababambisene. Umbuzo okhona owokuthi ngabe iminyaka emine esasele iyophela besasebenzisana yini?"Lo mhlaziyi uthe njengoba kunezinkomba zokuthi kusazobusa amaqembu ngokubambisana ngabe lizoba njani ikusasa lezwe? Uthe ukuhambela kukaMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa eMelika ehambisana nethimba ebelihlanganisa abamhlophe kuyalibuyisa ithemba kubatshalimali nokuthi babekhuluma ngazwilinye.
UMHOLI we-EFF, uMnuz Julius Malema, unxuse abantu baKwaZulu-Natal ukuba bangayivoteli ngobuningi i-MK njengoba benzile okhethweni langonyaka owedlule.UMalema uthe kwaba yiphutha ukuthi abantu baKwaZulu-Natal bavotele ngobuningi leli qembu eliholwa owayengumengameli wezwe ne-ANC, uMnuz Jacob Zuma.Ukusho lokhu ekhuluma emcimbini we-EFF wokugubha uSuku lweNtsha obuseKing Zwelithini, eMlaza, izolo. I-MK iyona eyathola amavoti amaningi KwaZulu-Natal okhethweni lwangonyaka owedlule kodwa yasala ngaphandle ngesikhathi kwakhiwa uhulumeni ophethe isifundazwe.Nakuzwelonke, i-MK yafika kwezwakala njengoba yaba iqembu lesithathu ngobukhulu ePhalamende.UMalema uthe i-MK ayibasizi ngalutho abantu abayivotelayo, wakhala ngokuthi leli qembu lijuba ezikhundleni abantu abangawazi umsebenzi. Wenze isibonelo ngelungu le-MK ePhalamende, uMnuz Eric Kulani Giyani Nkovani, odume ngelikaPapa Penny, othe ukhuluma into engazwakali ePhalamende."Lapha KwaZulu-Natal navotela i-MK, yathola u-45%. Benzani ngaloyo 45%? Abenzi lutho. Bazihlalele nje. NasePhalamende bazihlalele nje, abenzi lutho yize benenqwaba yezihlalo. Banikeza izikhundla abantu abangazi lutho. Umuntu okhuluma aze aqede ungezwanga ukuthi ubethini. Banikeza izikhundla oPapa Penny abantu abakhuluma into engazwakali. Le nto iwukwedelela abantu abavotela i-MK."UMalema usole uZuma ngokudukisa abantu, wathi wenza izethembiso ahluleka ukuzifeza ngesikhathi ewumengameli wezwe iminyaka eyisishiyagalolunye. "Njengamanje uhamba ethembisa abantu ukuthi uzobabuyisela umhlaba. Wahlulwa yini ukubuyisela abantu umhlaba ngesikhathi esengumengameli? Kufanele amukele ukuthi isikhathi sakhe sesidlulile."UMalema ukhuze eyokuvota ngobuhlanga KwaZulu-Natal."Abantu baKwaZulu-Natal bathanda into enenqubekela phambili. Angeke bavume ukubuyiselwa emuva amakhehla afuna ukwenza sengathi iKwaZulu-Natal ngeyawo." UMalema uthe ukuphikwa izinto okhethweni lakamuva kwaZulu-Natal ngeke kubadikibalise.I-EFF ayenzanga kahle KwaZulu-Natal okhethweni likahulumeni kazwelonke olwalungonyaka owedlule, njengoba yasala nezihlalo ezimbili kweziyisishiyagalolunye ebiziphethe esiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal.Nasokhethweni lokuchibiyela lakamuva eselibe khona KwaZulu-Natal, i-EFF isiphenduke ukudla kwenduku. "Sifuna ukwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi i-EFF ithola ukwesekwa kuzo zonke izindawo lapha KwaZulu-Natal. Sifuna ukunqoba omasipala, sizokwethula umkhankaso wethu khona lapha KwaZulu-Natal."
Umbuzo:MAGUMEDE, ngingowesifazane onenkinga yokuthi njalo uma eya ocansini nomyeni wakhe kuba khona ubuhlungu obungachazeki.Le nto isinesikhathi yaqala ukwenzeka kodwa manje selokhu ngiyazenzisa ngizama nokubekezela ukuze umyeni wami angaphoxeki ngoba ngisuke ngimbona ukuthi yena ujabulile ngakho-ke akumele ngimphazamise.Ngisho sesiqedile uma ngithi ngiyochama kuvele kuthi angihayize kakhulu ngale ndlela engachazeki, manje angazi ukuthi ngingamtshela kanjani ukuthi mina angiluthokozeli ucansi nokuthi ngicela uma kukhona into oyaziyo ukuthi ingase ingisize ungiyalele yona sisi wami. Impendulo:SAWUBONA sisi wami, kwesinye isikhathi thina bantu besifazane ziningi izinto ezinzima esibhekana nazo ngesikhathi senkonzo yaseLawini kodwa siqhubeke sithule sibekezele ngenxa yokuthi sizama ukujabulisa amadoda ethu.Ngiyazi futhi akulula ukubuziba ngoba ekugcineni kosuku, uthola ukuthi uziba nje kanti uyalimala ngaphakathi yingakho kubalulekile ukuthola usizo kusenesikhathi. Umyeni wakho angikholwa ukuthi angangakweseka uma uzomtshela ngale nto ekuphethe nakhona ungalindi nize nenze ucansi. Kodwa mtshele nje kukuhle ningenzi lutho, bese uyahamba uyobonana nodokotela wabesifazane yikhona ezokuxilonga akunikeze nosizo. Ukuhlala ubekezele kungadala omkhulu umonakalo.
KUBANJWE umoya ngokusabalala kohlobo olusha lobhubhane iCovid okuthiwa lusabalala ngamandla uma luqhathaniswa nezinye izinhlobo zaleli gciwane.Izikhulu zikahulumeni wakuleli zinxuse abantu ukuba baqhubeke nokuhlonipha imigomo ebekelwe ukulwa nokusabalala kobhubhane i-corona, njengoba kunegciwane elisha elisabalala ngamandla emazweni amaningi.Igciwane elisha elibizwa ngeNimbius lihlasele emazweni angu-22 iningi lawo ase-Asia nase-Europe. Nakuba engekho kuleli okubikwe ukuthi unalolu hlobo olusha lwe-corona kodwa abantu bakuleli banxuswa ukuba baqaphele. Isikhungo esihlolela izifo, iNational Institute for Communicable Diseases (NICD), sithe ucwaningo lukhombisa ukuthi uhlobo olusha lwe-corona lusabalala ngokushesha nokuthi lushaya kakhulu amasosha omzimba uma kuqhathaniswa nezinye izinhlobo zaleli gciwane."Kodwa-ke imininingwane ekhona njengamanje ayikhombisi ukuthi uhlobo olusha lwe-corona olusabalele, lugulisana kakhulu kanti futhi nezinkomba zayo azehlukile."I-NICD ithe asikho isidingo sokuba abantu bakuleli batatazele njengoba uhulumeni eqhubeka nokuqapha ukusabalala kohlobo lwe-corona olusha. "Imigomo izoqhubeka isebenze kanti futhi nokuhlolela i-corona kuyaqhubeka."UNgqongqoshe eHhovisi likaMengameli, uNksz Khumbudzo Ntshavheni, unxuse abantu ukuba bahloniphe imithetho ebekelwe ukulwa nokusabalala kwaleli gciwane.Ubekhuluma emuva komhlangano weKhabhinethi izolo. "Sinxusa abantu ukuba baqinisekise ukuba bazigcina behlanzekile, bageze izandla ngamanzi anensipho, bagweme ukuxhawulana isidingo singekho, baqinisekise ukuthi bafaka izifonyo uma bekhwehlela baphinde benze isiqiniseko sokuthi bahlala emakhaya uma begula."UNgqongqohse wezeMpilo, uDkt Aaron Motsoaledi, uthe bakuqaphile ukubheduka kohlobo olusha lwe-corona."Sinengqalasizinda esezingeni yokuqapha ukusabalala kwezifo. Njengamanje akukho okusabikiwe. Sizoqhubeka nokuqapha isimo." UMotsoaledi uthe uhlobo olusha lwe-corona luhlobene nezinye izinhlobo esezike zaba khona.Uthe lokhu kusho ukuthi imigomo ebivele isetshenziswa izokwazi ukugwema uhlobo olusha.UMotsoaledi uthe abakuqaphelayo okwamanje ukunyuka kwesibalo sabantu abaphethwe umkhuhlane. "Isimo lesi esizokwazi ukubhekana naso."I-World Health Organisation iyalele izikhulu zakuleli ukuba zilindele noma yini ngokusabalala kwaleli gciwane.Isikhulu seWHO kuleli, uDkt Shenaaz El-Halabi, sithe nakuba engekho umuntu osatholakale ukuba unalolu hlobo lwe-corona kuleli, izinto zingaguquka ngokushesha."Njengoba eshilo ungqongqoshe (uMotsoaledi), iNingizimu Afrika inengqalasizinda esezingeni yokuhlolela izifo iphinde iqaphe nokusabalala kwazo. Kungenzeka ukuthi njengamanje akekho osehaqekile kodwa lokho kungashintsha noma inini. Ingakho kubalulekile ukuhlala uzilungiselele."

IThimba elihlanganisa abophiko lwe-Tactical Response ezinze e-OR Tambo kanye naseChris Hani nethimba leReece lilandele umkhondo wetekisi iToyota Quantam eladunwa eQonce ngeSonto, 15 Juni 2025. Ikhumbi ibonwe endaweni yase-Darhabe ngase-Elliotdale. Ngesikhathi amaphoyisa ezama ukuyimisa, umshayeli afake amafuthi wayishaya yazula, kodwa wagcina evinjiwe. "Umshayeli nokunye abahamba naye bazamile ukubaleka bavulela ngenhlamvu bebhekise emaphoyiseni," kusho amaphoyisa ngesitatimende. Bobabili abasolwa badutshulwe bafa. Amaphoyisa athole izibhamu ezimbili zohlobo lwe-9mm ezinezinombolo ezisuliwe, eyodwa kumsolwa ngamunye.
USHAYE ungqimphothwe, walaxaza ukufaka isicelo sebheyili, uMnuz Linda "Mjinja" Hlongwa, ngesikhathi evele eNkantolo yeMantshi yasePinetown.UHlongwa (31) obuye adume ngelikaPutin, okuvela ukuthi usatshiswa okwenyoka eMariannhill, bekulindeleke ukuthi afake isicelo sakhe sebheyili.Ubhekene namacala ayisikhombisa okukhona kuwo amathathu okubulala, amabili okuzama ukubulala, elilodwa lokutholakala nesibhamu esingekho emthethweni nelilodwa lokutholakala nezinhlamvu. Ummeli kaHlongwa, uMnuz Nkosi, usukume watshela inkantolo ukuthi yize phambilini uPutin wayezwakalise ukuthi uzofaka isicelo sebheyili kodwa usebuye wamyalela ukuthi akasenazinhloso zokusifaka.Mathathu amadokodo esewonke amacala okuthiwa abhekene noPutin. Kwelokuqala; usolwa ngokutholwa nesibhamu esingekho emthethweni nelokutholakala nezinhlamvu okuthiwa lenzeka ngo-2020.Kuvela ukuthi yilo leli ayekhishwe kulo ngebheyili, kwathi sekufanele aye enkantolo, wangabe esayingena. Elinye idokodo linamacala amabili okubulala, okuvela ukuthi wawenza ngoMashi 28, 2025. Kuwona kuthiwa wabulala ababili ngokubadubula KwaSanti. Kwidokodo lokugcina; kunecala elilodwa lokubulala namabili okuzama ukubulala okuthiwa wawenza ngo-2023. UMbuso uzwakalise ukuthi wonke la madokodo angahle ahlanganiswe enziwe idokodo elilodwa. Ubuye waveza nokuthi busebuningi ubufakazi obushodayo, phakathi kwabo uthe imibiko yokuhlolwa kwezidumbu, izitatimende zofazi nobunye. Imantshi uNkk Gwendolyn Robinson ithe izowahlehlisela uJulayi 21, wonke amacala akhe. UPutin uke waba sematheni maphakathi no-Ephreli, kuwo lo nyaka, ngesikhathi eboshwa ngamaphoyisa eseMidrand, eGauteng. I-video yakhe yasabalala ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, ikhombisa ezama ukubaleka ngophahla lwebhilidi ayebhace kulo. Ukuboshwa kwakhe kwango-Ephreli, kwalandela ukukhishwa kwencwadi ekugunyazayo ngoSepthemba, ngonyaka odlule.Ngesikhathi kukhishwa leyo ncwadi, inkantolo yaveza ukuthi kusukela ngoJulayi 2020, wayengasayingeni eyokuza enkantolo ngecala ayelihamba lokutholakala nesibhamu esingekho emthethweni nezinhlamvu.Esitatimendini samaphoyisa esathunyelelwa abezindaba ngesikhathi efunwa, amaphoyisa athi usolwa nangokuhlukumeza osomabhizinisi baseMariannhill nezindawo ezingomakhelwane, efuna ngodli imali yokuvikela.
KUKHONA nabangu-232 abasolwa ngamacala okudlwengula, kubasolwa abangu-11 600 ababoshelwe amacala ahlukahlukene KwaZulu-Natal, ngenyanga edlule. Lokhu kuvezwe okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, esitatimendeni asithumelele abezindaba. UNetshiunda uthe kulesi sibalo kukhona nabayishumi ababoshelwe amacala okuzama ukudlwengula. "Simi kwabangu-161 isibalo salabo ababoshelwe amacala okubulala, kuthi abangu-192 baboshelwa amacala okuzama ukubulala,” kusho uNetshiunda. Uthe zingu-287 izibhamu ezingekho emthethweni ezitholwe amaphoyisa, wathi kuzona kukhona ezingu-16 ezinkulu. "Abangu-182 baboshelwe amacala ayamaniswa nokubamba inkunzi kuhlonyiwe kanjalo nokudunwa kwezimoto,” kusho uNetshiunda. Ababoshelwe amacala okushaya, nawokushaya ngenhloso yokulimaza, uthe bangu-2 521. "Bangu-417 ababoshelwe amacala okugqekeza imizi yabantu kanjalo namabhizinisi, awokwebiwa kwemfuyo, nokweba izimoto,” kusho uNetshiunda.Uthe ukubonakala kwamaphoyisa ezivimbamgwaqweni ezindaweni ezehlukene, kuholele ekutheni kuboshwe abashayeli abangu-535, ebebeshayela bedle amanzi amponjwana, abanye besebenzise izidakamizwa. "Ababoshelwe amacala amayelana notshwala, okufaka phakathi ukubuphuza esidlangalaleni, ukuhweba ngabo okungekho emthethweni, ukubusabalalisa, nokubakha ngokungekho emthethweni bangu-1 161,” usho kanje. Uveze ukuthi zingu-709 izikhali eziyingozi ezisuswe emphakathini. Kuzona kukhona imimese engu-637 nobhushu abangu-24. Uthe ingu-131 imfuyo etholiwe, kuyona kukhona izinkomo ezingu-63, izimbuzi ezingu-51 nezinkukhu ezingu-17. Uthe imikhankaso yamaphoyisa yokulwa nobugebengu usazoqhubeka, wathi babonga nemiphakathi ngokuba wusizo olukhulu emaphoyiseni. Uthe olunye ulwazi oludalulwa imiphakathi lulekelela amaphoyisa ukuthi akwazi ukusheshe abambe izigebengu.
UPHUMELE obala wavuma eyoxhaxha lwezikweletu okumele uzikhokhe ngenxa yokwehlulwa ezinkantolo uMasipala weTheku, obhekene ngeziqu zamehlo nezinkampani ezahlukene kubangwa inkokhelo. Izolo, uMasipala weTheku ube nesithangami sabezindaba ngenhloso yokuzocacisa kabanzi ngezingqinamba ozithola ubhekene nazo ngenxa yokwehlulwa ezinkantolo.Loyo obhekelele ezomthetho kulo masipala, uMnuz Melusi Mhlongo, uhlube udlubu ekhasini echaza kabanzi ngesimo sokugqigqa ezinkantolo komkhandlu, uhubhana nezinkampani ezahlukene. Eqhulwini ukhulume ngodaba olusematheni lokuguqa kukalo masipala wehlulwa eNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo yinkampani iDaily Double. Lo masipala uyalelwe yinkantolo ukuba kumele ukhokhele le nkampani imali elinganiselwa ku-R53 million.UMhlongo ukuvezile ukuthi baqala ukusebenzisana nale nkampani ngo-2013, ngesikhathi imenenja kamasipala kusanguMnuz Sipho Nzuza. Uthe kwakunesivumelwano esasikhona phakathi kukamasipala nale nkampani.''Kodwa sigcine sesiphulwa isivumelwano ngenxa yokuthola ukuthi kukhona okuningi abanikazi bale nkampani abangazange bakuhambise kahle,'' usho kanje. Uveze ukuthi phakathi kokunye abanikazi bale nkampani bahhubuza akabhejane ngenani lezimoto abanazo nokunye okuningi. "Abagcinanga lapho, imali ababeyibiza kuthina beyidlulela kule okumele engabe bayayibiza. Bagcina sebesibuyisela enye." Uthe le nkampani yalwa nokunqanyulwa kwenkontileka yayo, isigubhukane udaba yaluyisa enkantolo kanti ngeshwa umkhandlu weTheku uzogoba uphondo.''Le mali sizoyikhokha, siyitholile nencwadi yabameli babo besiyalela ukuthi kumele siyikhokhe zingakapheli izinsuku ezinhlanu." Uveze ukuthi okudale ukuthi bahlulwe enkantolo yingoba kunesikhulu esithile esagxambukela, sagunyaza ukuthi kukhokhelwe le nkampani ekubeni kwakungesiwona umsebenzi waso ukuba senze lokho. ''Angeke ngikwazi ukudalula igama laso okwamanje,'' kusho uMhlongo.Mayelana nodaba lwenkampani iBless Joe Trading, nakhona umkhandlu ukhale ngaphansi enkantolo. Kuvela ukuthi lo mkhandlu waba nesivumelwano sokuthi le nkampani igcine abantu ababengenayo indawo yokuhlala eTehuis eMlaza. Kuvela ukuthi kwakukade kunesivumelwano sokuthi lokhu kwenzeke izinsuku ezingu-14, usuku lulodwa umasipala kwakumele ukhokhe u-R208 000.UMhlongo uthe ngeshwa abantu bagcina sebehlala lapha kwaze kwahlangana unyaka. Le nkampani uthi ibe seyiluyisa enkantolo udaba ifuna ukuba ikhokhelwe u-R73 million, kanti izolunqoba udaba eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini. Uthe kodwa okwamanje zisazohlangana izinhlangothi zombili kuvunyelwane ngokuthi yimalini okungase kuvunyelwane ngayo. Mayelana nodaba lokukweleta inkampani iSolBeth Protection Services imali elinganiselwa ku-R500 million, uMhlongo uthe ekuqaleni umnikazi wenkampani, u-Advocate Siya Xulu, wayebatshele ngo-R40 million, wathi abazi ukuthi igcine seyifinyelela kanjani kule mali eningi kangaka.UXulu exoxa neSolezwe, uveze ukuthi inkampani yakhe yathola umsebenzi kuMasipala weTheku, yokuqinisekisa ezokuphepha ngesivumelwano semali ethile okwathi uma ingakhokhwa yakhula yaze yafinyelela kule mali.Lo msebenzi uthi wawuthola ngemuva kokuba kuvele ukuthi kunezikhulu zangaphakathi ezithola izingcingo zokusatshiswa kubantu abangaziwa. Uveze ukuthi inkampani yakhe yanikezwa lo msebenzi ngo-2017, yawenza kodwa kuze kube yimanje, lutho ukukhokhelwa.Imenenja yomkhandlu, uMnuz Musa Mbhele, ithe ngabe baqamba amanga uma bengathi ukuhlulwa kwabo ezinkantolo akubakhinyabezi. Uthe leyo mali okuzomele ikhokhelwe izinkampani ezithile ibingaphucula abantu bahanjiselwe izidingo.
UMHOLI we-EFF, uMnuz Julius Malema uthe ufuna kube khona ukusebenzisana phakathi kweqembu labo kanjalo nabamabandla. UMalema ukusho lokhu ngeSonto,l ngesikhathi yena nobuholi beqembu ezingeni lesifundazwe kanjalo nakuzwelonke, behambele ibandla laseChibini, iFather Madwe St Johns Apostolic Church, ePlazini, eNdwendwe.UMalema ofike wakhonza kuleli bandla uthe elakuleli liyawudinga umkhuleko wamabandla, kulezi zinkinga elibhekene nazo. "Sinesibalo esiphezulu sabangasebenzi, ububha budla lubi, kanjalo nezidakamizwa entsheni. Isonto liyindawo enika ithemba. Kufanele sisebenzisane, ukulwa nalezi zinkinga,” kusho uMalema.Uqhube wathi abahambisani nezikhangiso zotshwala nogwayi ngoba zidweba isithombe sokuthi buyinto efanele, ekubeni buwumbulalazwe. Uthe baphezu kwemizamo yokuzwakalisa uvo lwabo lokuthi kufanele kuphele nya ngezikhangiso zotshwala kumathelevishini. Ubuye wezwakalisa nokuthi ePhalamende bahlongoza eyokuthi umfaniswano wabafundi abasemazingeni aphansi kanjalo naphezulu, unikezelwe kubafundi mahhala."Uma besibuza ukuthi izovelaphi imali yokuwuthenga, sithi izovela la abathatha khona eyokuthenga owamaphoyisa nowamasosha,” kusho uMalema, othe kuyamangaza ukuthi amaphoyisa namasosha bahlinzekwa mahhala uhulumeni ngomfaniswa, ngesikhathi abahlwempu belindelwe ukuthi bazithengele ngokwabo izingane umfaniswano. UMalema umemezele ukuthi owakhe umnikelo azowunikela kule nkonzo uR50 000, wathembisa nokufaka isandla esakhiweni sebandla esingaqedwaukwakhiwa. Ube esenxusa intsha ukuthi igcwale amabhasi kusasa, iyothamela inkulumo ye-EFF yeholidi lentsha, iJune 16 kusasa enkundleni yezemidlalo, iKing Zwelithini, eMlaza. Umfundisi webandla, uMnuz Mdima uthe beyibandla bayayibona indlela uMalema akhathalela ngayo abantu abahlwempu. "Siye siyibone ingcindezi oyifakayo ePhalamende. Amagalelo akho kubantu abahlwempu siyawabona. Awadliwa amandla omuntu,” kusho uMdima.Ubonge wanconcoza ngomnikelo kaR50000, nesethembiso sokwelekelelwa ngesakhiwo sebandla esakhiwayo, wathi wazomeseka ngomkhuleko ukuthi ngelinye ilanga abe umengameli wezwe.

UKWANDA kwezikhalo ngamadoda akhulelisa abantu besifazane bese engabe esazondla izingane, futhi angabi yingxenye yempilo yengane kukhuthaze amaciko ukuba asebenzise ubuciko bawo ukukhuza lesi sihlava emphakathini.Usukele lapho umcabango wefilimu ethi Playing Dad, edidiyelwe yinhlangano engenzinzuzo iHeartliners, ezoqala ukukhonjiswa kwisizindalwazi sale nhlangano, kwiYouTube, SowetoTV nasezindaweni ezehlukene eziqhakambisa ubuciko emphakathini ukusabalalisa umyalezo.Elandisa ngale filimu, uphrojusa wayo u-Eric Mogale, uthe umcabango wale filimu uze uba kulesi sigaba okusona manje, indaba iqale eminyakeni edlule ngesikhathi yena nethimba asebenza nalo beqala ucwaningo abalubiza nge-Father’s Matter, lapho abebehambela khona ezindaweni ezehlukene emphakathini ukucwaninga ngezizathu ezenza ukuthi kwande izigameko zokugxekwa kobaba namadoda ngenxa yezinto ezingezinhle abazenzayo. "Besicwaninga futhi sibheka ukuthi yini esingayenza ukuqhakambisa nokubuyisa isithunzi samadoda emphakathini, kwaze kwafika lapho esibona kufanele ukuthi umyalezo wethu siwudlulise ngokuthi senze le filimu ezokhuthaza obaba ukunakekelea izingane zabo nokuthi yikuphi okumele bakwenze nokumele bakugweme." "Sihlose nokuthi sidlulise umyalezo ozokwenza ukuthi abafana abasakhula bazi futhi baqonde ukuthi kumele benze kanjani ukukhula bengamadoda aqotho nathembekile, esibona kuzosiza ukuthi kube nenhlakahle nokubambisana ezweni,” kusho uMogale, othe le filimu iphuma kusasa. Eqhuba, udalule ukuthi le filimu bayiqophele elokishini iSoweto e-Orlando West, i-Orlando East naseMzimhlophe - kanti izobe igabe ngabalingisi okukhona kubona uVincent Mahlape, Siyamthanda Nxumalo, Neo Ntlantleng noLuyanda Mzazi.UMogale akamusha ekukhiqizeni amafilimu nemidlalo yethelevishini njengoba esesebenze futhi wabamba iqhaza emidlalweni eminingi esingabala kuyona iYizo Yizo 1, Takalani Sesame, Backstage, Uzalo, Durban Gen, The Wife, Empini neRhythm City.

Ngaphambi kwalokhu usebenze iminyaka eminingi njengoMbhishobhi wamaSheshi eDiocese of Zululand.Le nceku edabuka e-Italy ibinogazi kakhulu emakholweni abeyithandela nokuthi ibikhuluma isiZulu ingasishebi. UKWENZA kahle ehlandleni lesibili engenele umqhudelwano womgijimo waminyaka yonke kwenze isitshudeni saseDurban University of Technology (DUT) sakholwa wukuthi kukhulu esisengakuzuza kule ndima uma siqhubeka sizimisela futhi sigxila kule ndima ngokugcwele.Lowo wuNgceba Kenisa (29), ongomunye wabawu-22 baseDUT abebengenele lo mjaho obusuka eMgungundlovu, uya eThekwini, nonyaka. Bekungokwesibili engenela lo mncintiswano, akuchaze ngokuthi kube yimpumelelo enkulu kuyena eqeda ngesikhathi esiwu-7:55:01, kusuka esikhathini asenze nyakenye esiwu-11:50:00.Lesi sitshudeni saKwaGezubuso, e-Elandskop, ngaseMgungundlovu, senza unyaka wokugcina wezifundo zobuthishela ophikweni lweDUT Indumiso, khona eMphithi. Sithe ukwenza kahle ngale ndlela kusikhuthaze ukuthi siqhubeke nokugxila kwezokugijima ngokugcwele manje, ukwenzela ukuthi sigcine sikwaze ukunqoba lo mqhudelwano. "Ngizibona ngidlondlobala futhi ngithuthuka kakhulu kule ndima kangangokuthi manje amehlo ami asethe njo ekutheni ngiqhubeke nokugijima ngokugcwele futhi sengivele ngixoxile nomqeqeshi wami ukuthi indlela esizivocavoca ngayo ngifuna ukuthi ishintshe kangakanani, ngenzela ukuzicijela ukuthi ngidle umhlanganiso weComrade eminyakeni ezayo,” usho kanje. Eqhuba, uthe okunye okwenza aqine isibindi futhi kunyuke nezinga lokuzethemba kulokhu wukuthi njengoba ehlale ezihlupha ukucwaninga ngabagijimi aseke badla umhlanganiso kulo mqhudelwano wukuthi uqaphele ukuthi iningi labo lisuke lisesigabeni seminyaka akuyona."Lokho kwenza ngibone ukuthi nami uma ngingakhela kulokhu esengikuzuzile kule ndima, kusukela manje ngingakwazi ukufeza okukhulu engizifisela khona ngokugijima, kangangokuthi ngikulungele nokubeka eceleni kancane umkhakha engiwufundele ukuze ngiqhubeke nezemidlalo ngokuphelele nangokugcwele,” kusho uNgceba oyilungu leqembu labagijimi bakulesi sikhungo iDUT Athletics Club.
OYINHLOKO yamaJaji KwaZulu-Natal, iJaji uThoba Poyo-Dlwathi, ukhiphe isexwayiso esiqinile kubameli babamangalelwa kanjalo noMbuso ecaleni kokubulawa kowayengumculi, uKiernan "AKA" Forbes nomngani wakhe uTebello "Tibz" Motsoane.Abamangalelwa abahlanu kuleli cala, ngoMnuz Lindokuhle Mkhwanazi, Mnuz Lindani Ndimande, Mnuz Siyanda Myeza, Mnuz Mziwethemba Gwabeni noMnuz Lindokuhle Lindo Ndimande, bavele eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini.U-AKA noTibz badutshulwa babulawa ngaphandle kwesitolo sokudla iWish, emgwaqweni uFlorida, eThekwini, ngoFebhuwari 2023. Amaphoyisa abuye aveza ukuthi kukhona izelamani ezimbili zakwaNdimande, okungoMnuz Siyabonga Gezane Ndimande noMnuz Malusi Dave Ndimande ezaboshwa eSwatini, okumele zibuye zize kuleli, ukuzojoyina laba abayisihlanu. Phambilini, uMbuso waveza ukuthi nakuba uphezu kwezinhlelo zokuthi kubuyiswe abamangalelwa abaseSwatini, uzobe uqhubeka nokuqulwa kwecala kulaba abayisihlanu abangaphambi kwenkantolo njengamanje. IJaji uPoyo-Dlwathi uthe abameli babamangalelwa abayisihlanu kanjalo noMbuso kufanele bazibophezele ekutheni ngeke babe namathizethize uma sekuqala ukuqulwa kwecala ngo-2026. UNkk Poyo-Dlwathi udalule ukuthi kuzothatha izinyanga ezintathu ezigcwele ukuthi leli cala liqulwe ngonyaka ozayo. "Abanye bozakwethu abafikelwa isikhathi sokuthatha umhlalaphansi, uma kukhona amacala abawenzayo, angaphelile, kuye kuphoqe ukuthi babuye,” usho kanje.Ebuka ozakwabo emehlweni, ubatshele ukuthi uma kwenzeka kuba khona isimo esiholela ekutheni bangabi bikho, kuyofanele baqinisekise ukuthi kuba khona obamelayo. Inkantolo ibuye yezwa ukuthi owayeyibamba lomqondisi wezokuShushisa KwaZulu-Natal, u-Advocate Simphiwe Mlotshwa, ngeke esaqhubeka nokumela bonke abamangalelwa kodwa usezomela ummangalelwa wokuqala uMnuz Lindokuhle Mkhwanazi nowesihlanu, uMnuz Lindokuhle Lindo Ndimande. U-Adv Paul Jorgensen yena uzomela uMnuz Lindani Ndimande noMnuz Mziwethemba Gwabeni, ngesikhathi u-Adv Mkhululi Nkomo emela uMnuz Siyanda Myeza. UMbuso, ngomlomo wephini likamqondisi wezokuShushiswa koMphakathi, u-Adv Lawrence Gcaba, uphakamise ukuthi icala lihlehliselwe uJulayi 24, 2025, ukuze kubekwe izinsuku icala elizoqulwa ngazo. Uqhube wathi bazobe sebekulungele ukuthi kuqhutshekwe ngalolu suku, uJaji Poyo Dlwathi, wabe eselihlehlisela uJulayi 24, 2025. Ngaphandle kwenkantolo, okhulumela uphiko lwezokushushisa, iNational Prosecuting Authority (NPA) KwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Natasha Kara-Ramkisson, uthe izelamani zakwaNdimande, eziboshwe eSwatini, ziyaqhubeka nesicelo sokubuyekezwa kwes inqumo sokuthi zibuyiswe kuleli.
BADINWE ukuhamba kwezinsuku bengafundi futhi bengazibhali izivivinyo abafundi basezikoleni ezimbili zaseMakhonyeni, eJozini, abagcine betholana phezulu namaphoyisa ngoLwesithathu.I-video ekhombisa amaphoyisa amabili ebhonya kanzima umfundi, isabalale ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ngoLwesithathu emini. Ikhombisa abafundi bebaleka begcwala izinkalo, bejahwa iveni yamaphoyisa. Uma iqhubeka, kubonakala iveni ibuyela engxenye ngesivinini, bese kwehla iphoyisa elilodwa liphuma iqhubu nomfundi oyedwa, limbhonya. Ligcina selijoyinwa elinye, nalo elifika, lisine lizibethele kulo mfundi, bese limbamba ngesidlozane, limyisa evenini. Isishoshovu somphakathi esinguNobhala we-ANC ku-ward 7, uMnuz Siyanda Ntshembeni, sithe abakutholile ukuthi abafundi basesikoleni iZibukweni High neSinethezekile High, bakhethe ukuteleka ngoba kwanda izinsuku bengafundi."Kunombhikisho onokuthula olokhu uqhubeka wothisha beSadtu neNatu. Sizwa kuthiwa abafundi bathi badinwa ukuthi kuthikamezeka imfundo yabo,” kusho uNtshembeni. Uthe abakutholayo ukuthi abafundi bathi bakhathele ukuvuka baye ezikoleni bethi bayofunda, kodwa bafike bajikiswe. "Bakhathazwa nawukuthi kwenzeka lokhu nje, yisikhathi sezivivinyo lesi, kufanele engabe bayabhala,” usho kanje.Uveze ukuthi lapho okubonakala khona kwi-video yodlame lwamaphoyisa, ingaphandle kwesikole iGugulesizwe High. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa awabonile ama-video asabalale ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, akhombisa amaphoyisa eshaya umfundi, ngesikhathi eyomfaka evenini."Ukuziphatha okunjalo emaphoyiseni akuvumelekile. Kuzophenyisiswa ubuqiniso be-video, uma amaphoyisa etholwa esephutheni lokusebenzisa indlakadla eyeqile, azothathelwa izinyathelo ezinqala,” kusho uNetshiunda.Ubuye waveza nokuthi amaphoyisa aseJozini abophe abafundi abane, ngokudala udlame emphakathini, ukuhlasela amaphoyisa nokulinyazwa kwempahla. "Imibiko ithi abafundi bezikole ezimbili zamabanga aphezulu bamashele esikoleni sesithathu ebesingatelekile, basusa umbhikisho onodlame esangweni. Ngesikhathi benza lo mbhikisho, balimaze imoto yamaphoyisa ngamatshe, baphinde bahlasela nawo uqobo,” kusho uNetshiunda. Uthe abafundi abane abagcine bekhalelwa amasongo kaSigonyela, baneminyaka ephakathi kuka-18 no-20. "Babuye badedelwa emva kwesikhathi, banikezelwa kubazali babo. Kulindeleke ukuthi bavele eNkantolo yeMantshi yasoBombo namuhla, (esho izolo) bephelezelwa abazali babo,” usho kanje. Wexwayise izitshudeni, abafundi nawo wonke umuntu onesifiso sokumasha noma nesokubhikisha ukuba bakhumbule ukuthi lokho akufanele kuphazamise umthetho ngoba amaphoyisa azovikela abantu nempahla.
KUDLULE emhlabeni obengumhlaziyi wezincwadi zeSolezwe, uNkk Mpume Nzimande, ngemuva kokugula isikhashana. UNkk Nzimande ubesebenzela Isolezwe esethimbeni labahluzi bezindaba kodwa umsebenzi wakhe obuvela emehlweni abafundi bephephandaba bekuba yingosi yangoLwesihlanu ethi Eshalofini noMpume Nzimande.Le ntokazi, ebiyaziwa ngokuthanda ukufunda izincwadi, yaba yingxenye yethimba lokuqala kusungulwa Isolezwe ngo-2002, lapho yakhombisa amagalelo amakhulu ekucabeni indlela leli phephandaba elalihlela ukuzwakala ngayo ekusetshenzisweni kolimi lwesiZulu.UMhleli weSolezwe, uMnuz Thulani Mbatha, uthe: "Silahlekelwe ngoMpume, ubengumuntu oqonde thwi nasekwenzeni kwakhe. Nomsebenzi wakhe ubufana nobuyena, ezihlupha njalo ngokufuna ulwazi ekusetshenzisweni kolimi nasekuhlonishweni kwemigomo yobuntatheli. Indlela abezikhathaza ngayo ngokufuna ulwazi yacaca nalapho eqhuba imfundo yakhe sekukudala aqala ukusebenza. Kuleli thimba esinalo nje, uMpume ungomunye wabantu abancwadile impela, ngaleyo ndlela ubeneso elibukhali ekucubunguleni umsebenzi nezindaba," kusho uMbatha.UNkk Nzimande odabuka KwaMashu, ushiye emhlabeni umyeni wakhe nendodana yabo eyodwa. Inkonzo yakhe yokugcina ihlelelwa ukuba khona KwaMashu, ngeSonto.

LUKHALA ngokukhethwa okwephela emasini, lungahlinzekwa ngamanzi wuMasipala wesiFunda saseZululand, uhlangothi lwaseThembezinhle, ebandleni lakwaShembe njengoba kuqhubeka izinkonzo eziba ngoJuni minyaka yonke KwaNongoma.Lokhu kuvezwe uMshumayeli uMbongeni Manqele, owengamele ithempeli laseMafutheni, eSiginsi, KwaNongoma, izolo.UManqele uthe njalo phakathi kukaJuni 1 kuya ku-15, uhlangothi lwabo luba nezinkonzo kuleli thempeli, ezihlanganisa amagatsha ehlukene ebandla. Uthe kulezi zinkonzo, kusuke kukhona nomholi wohlangothi, uPhinda Shembe."Asihlinzekwa nhlobo ngamanzi yize kusuke kwaziwa ukuthi kunezinkonzo ezinkulu esinazo,” kusho uManqele, othe lezi zinkonzo zihanjelwa amalungu angaphezu kuka-5 000.Uthe isimine iminyaka bebhekene nale nkinga. Uqhube wathi okubaxakayo ukuthi izinkonzo zohlangothi lwaseBuhleni, oluholwa uMduduzi Shembe, uNyazilwezulu eziba soSuthu, khona KwaNongoma, ngesikhathi esifanayo zona ziyahlinzekwa ngamanzi. Uveze ukuthi bayakholelwa ekutheni umasipala ukwenza ngamabomu lokhu njengoba basuke bewacele kusasele inyanga yonke amanzi. "Sisuke singabathathelanga phezulu. "Sixakwa ukuthi amaloli ayafa uma kufanele balethele uhlangothi lwethu amanzi kodwa uma kuhanjiselwa uhlangothi lomholi owaphikwa yizinkantolo, ayibi khona inkinga,” usho kanje. Ithimba lethu lihlala lizimisele ngokuhlinzeka amanzi izinkonzo zebandla," kusho uNksz Mthethwa.
UWADEDELE izolo, uMnyango wezokuThutha KwaZulu-Natal, amagama abantu abasha abashone ngesikhathi kuphahlazeka indiza abebehamba ngayo ngaseGreytown, ngeSonto.Kule ntsha kukhona uNksz Nqobile Biyela (23), Mnuz Lulama "Lwazi" Msane (23) noMnuz Siphesihle Buthelezi (20).UMphathiswa walo mnyango, uMnuz Siboniso Duma, uthe bakushayela ihlombe ukuthi abeSouth Affican Civil Aviation Authority (SACAA), bamemezele ukuthi bazokwenza olwabo uphenyo ngokuphahlazeka kwendiza. "Isimemezelo sokuthi umbiko ngalolu phenyo uzolunga esikhathini eziyizinsuku ezingu-30 ukusuka manje, kuzowathoba amanxeba emindeni,” kusho uDuma. Uthe lolu phiko luzokwenziwa uphiko lwe-Accident and Incident Investigation Division, ngaphansi kwe-SACAA. Uthe beyisifundazwe bazoyibuyekeza eyokubaluleka kokuxhumana ngokomoya, neyokusebenza komkhakha wezamabhanoyi esifundazweni. Uthe umkhakha wezamabhanoyi ongomunye wemikhakha ebamba iqhaza ekuxhumaniseni umnotho wakuleli nalowo wamanye amazwe. Ebalula ezinye zezikhumulo uthe iDube Trade Port, King Shaka International Airport namanye afana ne-Oribi, Richards Bay, Umkhuze, Newcastle, Ulundi, Virginia, Margate naseLadysmith. Uveze ukuthi bewumnyango basalokhu beqhubeke njalo nokuxhumana nemindeni yabashonile. "Kubuhlungu ukuthi ngenyanga yentsha, silahlekelwe imiphefumulo yentsha ebezimisele, ikhaliphile futhi kusalindeleke ukuthi ibe nekusasa eliqhakazile emkhakheni wezamabhanoyi kanjalo nowezempilo,” kusho uDuma.Uthe ubuhlungu obuzwiwa abazali, imindeni, abangani kanjalo nozakwabo esikoleni kungelinganiswe, wathembisa ukuthi abomnyango wakhe bazoqhubeka nokuxhumana nemindeni, njengoba kuqhubeka izinhlelo zemingcwabo. Uthe bayakholelwa nasekutheni ukuhlolwa kwezidumbu ngodokotela abaqeqeshelwe lokho kuzobaluleka ekudwebeni isithombe sokuthi balimale kanjani. Umnyango uveze ukuthi imindeni ibingakathandi ukukhuluma nabezindaba.Abafi bashone ngeSonto, ngesikhathi indiza ebebehamba ngayo iphahlazeka eGreytown. Kuthiwa yayikade isuka esikhumulweni sezindiza iVirginia. Kwavela ukuthi yehluleka ukufika esikhumulweni saseGreyitown, emva kokushintsha kwendlela yokuyofaka uphethroli esikhumuleni saseMnambithi.
ZILINGANISELWA ku-68 izikole ezikhahlanyelwe umoya obuvunguza ngamandla KwaZulu-Natal. Lokhu kuvele izolo, ngesikhathi uMphathiswa woMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, ekhipha umbiko wakamuva ngomonakalo odalwe umoya kanjalo neqhwa esifundazweni. Uthe okwamanje abekho okubikwa ukuthi bashonile. "Imibiko esisayitholile iveza ukuthi ziwu-68 izikole ezikhahlamezekile ezifundeni eziyisishiyagalolunye KwaZulu-Natal. Umonakalo omkhulu ubikwe esifundeni Ugu, lapho okukhahlamezeke khona izikole ezingu-38,” kusho uButhelezi. Uthe nabafundi abane basesikoleni esisesifundeni Ugu, balimale ngesikhathi kuphephuka uphahla lwesikole ngoLwesibili, bayalulama, wathi nakuba umonakalo ubikwe ezindaweni ezehlukene zesifundazwe kodwa isifunda Ugu yisona esikhahlamezeke kakhulu kunezinye. "Ingaphezu kuka-80 imizi ekhahlamezekile ngesikhathi umoya onamandla uphephula izindlu zabantu komasipala abehlukene,” kusho uButhelezi.Uveze nokuthi amathimba abo alibangise KwaMpumuza ngaphansi kukaMasipala uMsunduzi, eMgungundlovu, lapho okukhahlamezeke khona imizi engu-31. Imigwaqo ebivaliwe uN2 noR56, ngaseningizimu yesifundazwe, uthe isivuliwe, imiphakathi isizokwazi ukuthi iyisebenzise. "Lonke iqhwa ebelisemigwaqweni ehlukene, selisuswe lonke,” kusho uButhelezi. Maqondana nogesi, uthe amathimba ezinhlekelele asaqhubeka nokuhlola umonakalo odalwe isimo sezulu esibi ezinsukwini ezimbili ezedlule, ngesikhathi beqhubeka nomsebenzi wokulungisa umonakalo odalekile. Uthe ngokubambisana ne-Eskom, sebewubuyisile ugesi ezindaweni eziningi, wathi amathimba akwa-Eskom asaqhubeka nokuwubuyisa ezindaweni obungakabuyi kuzo. "Nakuba usubuyisiwe ezindaweni ezehlukene kodwa ukuqhubeka kwesimo sezulu esibi kanjalo nobuningi bomonakalo odalekile, okufaka phakathi ukungafinyeleleki kahle ezindaweni ezehlukene, yikho okunqinde ukuthi ugesi ungalungiswa ngokushesha,” kusho uButhelezi.Uthe bayabuqonda ubunzima obubhekene nalabo abakhahlamezekile, wathembisa ukuthi bazosibuyisela kwesejwayelekile isimo ngokushesha. Uthe njengoba engakapheli amakhaza ezindaweni eziningi, banxusa izakhamuzi ukuthi ziphephe uma ziphemba imililo zizama ukuzifudumeza, bese ziqinisekisa ukuthi ziyazilandela izexwayiso zesimo sezulu.
UKUSHUMAYELA ivangeli lokufuna ukwamukelwa, ukuhlonishwa nokungacwasa ngenxa yempilo abayiphilayo, yizona zinto ezizoba seqhulwini emcimbini i-eThekwini Pride ozobe wenziwa okokuqala nonyaka, ngenhloso yokulwa nezinkinga ezibhekena nabantu abathandana nabobulili obufana nobabo, okwenza bazibone bengamukelekile emphakathini.Lo mcimbi ozobe uvuleleke kuwo wonke umuntu futhi okuzobe kungenwa mahhala kuwona, uzoba se-Ushaka Marine Beach, ngoMgqibelo, kusuka ngo-10 ekuseni kuya ku-10 ebusuku, lapho okuzobe kulindelwe ukuthi kubuthane abantu abangaphezu kwa-500.Umhleli walo mcimbi uMantsha Khuzwayo, uthe benze ngamabomu ukuthi ube ngenyanga uJuni ngoba beqonda ukuthi le nyanga akuyona eyokuqhakambisa imisebenzi emihle yabantu abasha kuphela, kepha yaziwa nangokuthi yi-Pride Month.Uthe bahlose nokufundisa abantu ukuhlonipha nokwamukela abantu abathandana nobubuli obufana nobabo. "Sizohlanganyela ukugqugquzela ukuthi kwamukelwe impilo esiyiphilayo nendlela esiyiyona yingakho umcimbi wethu sizowuqala ngokuthi simashele edolobheni, sisuka eShaka Marine size siyofika ngasesiteshini samaphoyisa esiseduze nathi, senzela ukuthi kuzwakale zonke izinkinga zethu nokusikhathazayo ukuze kuphele ukucwaswa emphakathini," usho kanje. Eqhuba, uthe kuzothi kungaqedwa lapho bese kubuyelwa ebhishi lapho bezobe benze umcimbi okuyidili lomculo okuzonandisa kulona uDJ Happygal, DJ Cndo, Mprue nomsakazi woKhozi FM uSelbyonce. "Akuzukuphelela lapho, njengoba kuzothi khona lapho emcimbini sihambise uhla lwezikhalazo zethu ezikhulwini zomkhandlu woMasipala weTheku ngenhloso yokuthi kwazeke ngokusikhathazayo ngenhloso yokuthi kulunge," kusho uMantsha. Uthe kuningi abantu okusamele bafundiseke ngakho ngempilo abayiphilayo, ukusiza ukugwema ukuthi bangabi nenkolelo yezinto ezingelona iqiniso okukhohliswana ngazo.
ISISHOSHOVU esiphambili ekulweni nokutholakala komnyombo wokubulawa kukaMnuz Sindiso Magaqa, uMnuz Thabiso Zulu, ukhale ngamaphoyisa athe angamazambane abolile futhi ayishaya emuva ayishaye phambili okwenza kube lukhuni satshe ukuwathemba. UZulu usho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma neSolezwe ngemuva kwengonyuluka eyenziwe yinkabi ivuma icala, uSibusiso Ncengwa.Egonyuluka ngakho konke okwenziwa uNcengwa, kukhona lapho aveza khona ngokusobala ukuthi babekade belekelelwa ngamaphoyisa. Lokhu uZulu uyakuhlaba ukuthi kungathiwa kwenziwa ngabantu abangamaphoyisa.Ubuze ukuthi nhloboni yamaphoyisa lawa amdibimunye nezinswelaboya? Uthe kuyacaca ukuthi akuselula manje ukuthemba amaphoyisa ngenxa yokwenza kwawo okuletha olukhulu ungabazane. "Indlela amaphoyisa enza ngayo iyethusa kakhulu. Kuyaxaka ukuthi kungavela igama lamaphoyisa kangaka ekubuleweni kukaMagaqa. Lokhu kukutshela ngokusobala ukuthi konakale kangakanani,'' usho kanje.Uthe okudidayo ukuthi lawa akusiwona nje amaphoyisa ajwayelekile kodwa ngamaphoyisa eqophelo eliphezulu. Uqhube wathi kuvele kuthuse kakhulu ukuthi nesibhamu i-AK47, eyasetshenziswa kulokhu kusoconga, yatholakala ngosizo lwamaphoyisa.''Konke lokhu kukushiya udikibele, uzibuza uziphendula ngodaba lwamaphoyisa ethu,'' usho kanje. Uthe sekusobala manje ukuthi kuyithikithi lokuya ezulwini ukulwa nenkohlakalo kuleli zwe.''Uma ufuna ukusheshe ugoduke uye ezulwini, yilwa nenkohlakalo nakanjani uzohamba emhlabeni akugeji. Umbuzo ke uthi ngabe kumele kube njalo yini?''Mayelana namagama abantu avelile ngesikhathi inkabi yenza ingonyuluka, uthe kungaba yinto enhle kakhulu uma kungaqinisekiswa ukuthi bonke bagcina bejezile ngokubandakanyeka ekubulaweni kukaMagaqa. Ugcizelele kakhulu ukuthi lawa magama avelile afakazela ngokusobala ukuthi umkhuba usekhaya, amazambane abolile angaphakathi kwi-ANC. UNcengwa udalule ukuthi bathenjiswa u-R120 000 nethenda ngaphezulu uma umsebenzi bewenze kahle wokusoconga uMagaqa. Uveze ukuthi ngo-2023, waxhumana nomndeni kaMagaqa ecela uxolo kuwona, wawazisa nokuthi uzolivuma icala ebese enikeza inkantolo ubufakazi.UMagaqa owake waba ngumholi wophiko lwabantu abasha be-ANC, wadutshulwa ngo-2017, ephuma emhlanganweni wamakhansela. Washona emuva kwesikhathi esesibhedlela.Ekhuluma neSolezwe unina kaMagaqa, uNkk Khethiwe Magaqa, uthe uNkulunkulu kuphela owaziyo ukuthi kungani kwahlanganiswa uzungu lokubulawa kwakhe. UMengameli wezwe, uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa, naye uphawulile ngalolu daba izolo, waveza ukuthi kumele luqhubeke uphenyo ukuze bajeze abathintekayo kulona.
LIKHALE ngonya nesihluku ijaji libagixabeza ngezigwebo ezinzima, abesilisa ababili ababulala owesilisa waseMlaza owayehamba ngesihlalo esinamasondo, kufihlwa ubufakazi.USiyabonga Ngubane (36) nomngani wakhe uSithembiso Khomo (23), balahlwe yicala lokudubula kushone uMnuz Simanga Khumalo (29), owayedume ngelikaKatsande. Izolo inkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini ibagixabeze ngezigwebo ezinzima njengoba uNgubane imgixabeze ngesigwebo sikadilikajele ngecala lokubulawa kukamufi. Imnikeze iminyaka engu-15 ecaleni lokutholakala nesibhamu esingekho emthethweni, kwengezwa neminye iminyaka emithathu kwelokutholakala nezinhlamvu.IJaji uRadebe lithe uNgubane zonke lezi zigwebo uzozidonsa kanye kanye. ''Inkantolo ibona kufanele ukuba ikunikeze lesi sigwebo ngenxa yesenzo sakho sokudubula ubulale umufi,'' kuchaza ijaji. UKhomo ugixabezwe ngesigwebo seminyaka engu-20 ngecala lokubulala. Ijaji lithe ngeke zifane izigwebo zalaba ngenxa yokuthi uKhomo akazange adubule kodwa wabalekisa uNgubane ngemoto. Liqhuba ijaji likhale kakhulu ngesihluku nesibindi sokubulala umuntu ohamba ngesihlalo esinamasondo.''Nakhombisa unya olubi kabi ngokuthi nibulale umuntu evele esehamba ngesihlalo esinamasondo,' 'kusho ijaji.Likhale ngokuthi laba bahubhuza amanga enkantolo bezama ukuziphungela. Lincome uMbuso lathi ukwazile ukuvezela inkantolo ubuqiniso bokuthi ngempela laba yibona ababulala umufi. Kuvela ukuthi umufi wahlaselwa wadutshulwa engaphandle kwakubo kwa-Q eMlaza, evakashele ugogo wakhe ntambama ngoMashi 28, ngonyaka odlule.Ngesikhathi icala lisenkantolo yeMantshi eMlaza, uNgubane yamchitha inkantolo ecela ibheyili ikhala ngokuthi izizathu zakhe kazizwakali, kwathi uKhomo yena inkantolo yamvumela. Umufi ubesehamba ngesihlalo esinamasondo ngemuva kokudutshulwa okokuqala ngo-2021, ecaleni okwaboshwa kulona umlisa owaziwayo, okwakukholakala ukuthi uyena ogcine ethumela izinkabi esejele ukuba zizoqeda ngomufi ukuze agqibe ubufakazi.Enkantolo phambilini kwahlaluka ukuthi umufi ngaphambi kokuba abulawe, wayelokhu ethola izinsongo ezazivela kumuntu ongaziwa, emxwayisa ngokuthi makesule icala lokudutshulwa kwakhe lango-2021 uma efuna ukuqhubeka nokudla anhlamvana. Wabulawa sekuphele iminyaka emibili ehamba ngesihlalo esinamasondo. Bagwetshwe bengayidalulanga imbangela yokubulala umufi. Umufi kuthiwa wakhubazeka ngesikhathi abathile bembamba inkunzi engena kubo, bamshaya ngenduku yegalofu ngaphambi kokuba bamphuce ifoni yomsebenzi. Kuthiwa umufi wabikela unina wase ehamba naye eyobikela unina kamsolwa ngokwenzekile, kodwa kuthiwa umsolwa kwathi uma ebabona wangabuza lutho, wamane wamdubula kwaba wukugcina kwakhe ukukwazi ukuzihambela ngezinyawo umufi.Ilungu lomndeni kamufi elingeke livezwe, lithe bathobeke amanxeba ngokuthi abanecala lokubulala sebeze bagwetshwa. Lithe kodwa basenovalo ngokucatshangwa yilona osengaphakathi ejele abasola ukuthi nguyena owayethumele asebegwetshiwe ukuba babulale umufi.
SENGATHI lukhulu oluza lunyelela odabeni lokubulawa kwesishoshovu se-ANC, uMnuz Sindiso Magaqa, ngemuva kokuba kusabalele inkulumongxoxo ephakathi kwabathile mayelana nokusocongwa kukamufi. Kule nkulumo kuzwakala iphimbo lomuntu okukholakala ukuthi uyinkabi, esanda kugeqa amagula eNkantolo yaseMgungundlovu, uSibusiso Ncengwa.Kule nkulumo, lo okukholakala ukuthi uyinkabi uqala ngokuzethula azisho ukuthi unguNcengwa bese-ke engena odabeni. Enkulumweni yakhe uzwakala njengomuntu odumele futhi onengekile nokhala kakhulu ngokungagcinwa kwezethembiso ngabathile. Uzwakala ekhala ezimathonsi ngenkokhelo engazange ifinyelele kuyena.Uze abalule abathile ukuthi lokhu kwenzeka ngenxa yabo njengoba esola ukuthi yibona abaholela ekutheni inkokhelo igcine ingabe isafinyelela kuyena. ''Uyabona nje leli cala likhulu kabi, akumele ngabe imindeni yethu iyantula,'' isho kanje. Iqhuba, ize ikhale ngothile ukuthi unomhobholo yingakho le mali igcine ingazange ifinyelele esandleni sayo. Kule nkulumo 'inkabi' ikhuluma nothile okukholakala ukuthi yayimaze ekuhlelweni kwenkokhelo abe ezoyiletha kuyo. Iyachaza nokuthi imthinta yena ngoba ingabatholi laba abaqondene nendaba, yabe isinxusa ukuba ayokhuluma naye ngoba yona ayisamtholi."Le nto izoba buhlungu ngoba ekugcinineni nami liyangigqilaza umqondo. Umuntu onomhobholo kakhulu la yilesi sikhulu esiphezulu. Imindeni yethu iyahlupheka la ngaphandle. Le nto mfethu iyinkinga enkulu kabi,'' kuqhuba uNcengwa.Inkabi iqhubeka ithi yona izowucwilisa umkhumbi futhi baningi abayongena obishini kuphele ngabo uma ingase iqale icule. "Nathi phela bafowethu sinezingane. Bekufanele abantu benze konke ukuhambisa kahle leli cala, bebengadayisa noma yini abanayo ukuze nathi sihlomule,'' isho kanje. Ikhale kakhulu ngokuthi bayahlupheka ejele ekubeni benganikwanga namali. Uma iqhubeka igcizelela kakhulu indlela engeneme ngayo ngokungakhokhelwa kwayo. Ngasemaphethelweni, lo okukhulunywa naye uyathembisa ukuthi kukhona azokwenza mayelana nalolu daba lwemali ukuze luxazululeke. Okhulumela i-ANC esifundazweni, uMnuz Fanele Sibisi, uthe bayakuhlonipha ukubona inqubekela phambili kuleli cala okuyinto athe kumele ishayelwe ihlombe. Mayelana nokuvela kwamagama amalungu ale nhlangano, uthe nasekuqaleni babevele beshilo ukuthi kumele umthetho ukhathule indima yawo.Uthe umthetho kumele ubonakale kubona bonke abantu, kungakhulunywa eyokuthi ukhetha amabala.''Noma ubani okutholakala ukuthi uyabandakanyeka ecaleni kumele ajeze, akumele kube nokukhetha okuthile uma kukhulunywa ngamacala. Yikho lokhu okwavunyelwana ngakho eqenjini i-ANC,'' usho kanje.Umufi wadutshulwa wabulawa ephuma emhlanganweni wamakhansela ngo-2017. Washonela esibhedlela emuva kwesikhathi elashwa.
