ENYE yamanyuvesi asesifundazweni i-University of KwaZulu-Natal isiqophe umlando iba yinyuvesi yokuqala yakuleli zwe ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe besimanje ukwakha nokunikezela ngezibuko zamehlo ukusiza izitshudeni ezinhlanu ezingaboni kahle emehlweni ezibizwa phecelezi ngokuthi ngama-smart AI Glass. Lolu hlelo lwenziwe kule nyuvesi wuhlaka lwakhona i-UKZN Foundation ngokubambisana ne-Sensory Solutions enikele ngalezi zibuko ohlakeni lwale nyuvesi olubhekele izitshudeni ezikhubazekile olubizwa ngokuthi yi-University's Disability Support (DSU), okunikezelwe ngazo ezitshudenini oMnuz Bright Sello, Nksz Thandeka Ngcobo, Nksz Londiwe Ndaba, Mnuz Siboniso Mabuza noNksz Thembisa Xolo.Okuhle kakhulu ngalezi zibuko wukuthi zakhiwe ngobuchwepheshe bezinga eliphezulu okusiza ozigqokayo ongaboni kahle emehlweni ukuthi abone, Zizinye zibiza uR75 000 uma uzithengela zona ngokwakho, okusho ukuthi njengoba zinhlanu lezi ezininikezelwe izitshudeni - zibiza uR375 000 sezizonke. Lezi zibuko zehluke ngokuthi azisizi ukuthi ukwazi ukubona kuphela, kepha zikwazi ukuxhumana ne-camera yazo esiza ukucaphuna umbhalo ophambi kwazo, uzisondeze eduzane ngendlela yokuthi ukwazi ukubona ukuthi kubhalwe ukuthini, futhi zikwazi nokucaphuna amazwi okukhulunywayo enjengoba enjalo, bese zenza ukuthi lowo ozisebenzisayo akwazi ukukusebenzisa sekuyinto ebhalwe phansi ukuze kiube lula ukufunda.Isitshudeni esikwezihlomule ngalezi zibuko uSello, owenza unyaka wesine kwi-Bachelor of Science, uthe ujabule kakhulu ngento enhle kangaka abayenzelwe yi-UKZN, athi kuzobe kungokokuqala ngqa ezizwa futhi ezibona engasaleli emuva ezifundweni zakhe njengoba manje naye esezokwazi ukufunda kahle nangendlela ejwayelekile njengezinye izitshudeni. "Ngiyakhumbula ukuthi ngendlela obekunzima ngayo bekuthi kufundwa egunjini lokufundela ngingakwazi ukulandelela kahle esifundiswa khona ngenxa yokuthi bengingakwazi ukufunda into esuke ibhalwe ebhodini lokufundela, futhi ngingakwazi ukufunda into esuke ikhonjwa wofundisayo. Bekudingeka ukuthi ngincike kwabanye ozakwethu nabasizi babafundisi bethu ukuqonda okufundwayo, obekwenza ngisalele emuva kwabanye. Manje sengizokwazi ukufunda ngendlela ejwayelekile nefana neyezinye izitshudeni," kusho uSello ngenjabulo.Inhloko yophiko olubhekele izitshudeni ezikhubazekile e-UKZN, uMnuz Amith Ramballie, uthe baziqhenya kakhulu ngokuthi babe yisikhungo sokuqala ezweni ukwenza lolu hlelo oluzoba wusizo kangaka ezitshudenini abakwazi ukuzihlomulisa kulona, akholwa wukuthi kuzosiza ukukhuthaza nabezinye izikhungo ukusika iphethini kubona, bahambe ezinyathelweni zabo."Lezi zibuko zikhombisa ukuzibophezela kwethu ukuthi zonke izitshudeni zingathiywa lutho ekufundeni kwazo, nokuthi sibe ngabokuqala ukwenza into enjena kuzosiza ukuqhubeka kukhuphule inyuvesi yethu ize ifinyelele kwelinye izinga eliphezulu," kusho uRamballie.UMnuz Mukthar Khan weSensor Solutions eyenza lezi zibuko, uthe ukuzibophezela kwe-UKZN ukuphucula impilo yezitshudeni ngobuchwepheshe besimanje kwenze bangacabanga kabili sebenquma ukuthi basebenze naye ukufeza umbono walolu hlelo."Manje sekusele ezitshudenini ukusebenzisa amathuba afuze leli ukufeza amaphupho azo ukusiza ukuthi zibe nempumelelo empilweni futhi zithuthukise amakhono aze ehlukene ukusuka manje kubhekwe phambili," ksho uKhan.
IZINHLAKA ezibhekele ezolimo KwaZulu-Natal seziphonsele uhulumeni inselelo yokuthi anqume bese ememezela isifo samatele ukuthi sesiyinhlekelele ezweni ukusiza ukuqala izinhlelo zokunqanda ukubhebhetheka kwaso.Lokhu kuza emva komhlangano obuphakathi kwezinhlaka ezehlukene okubalwa iSouth African Pork Producers Organisation, Milk Producers Organization, KZN Red Meat Producers Organisation, Wildlife Ranching South Africa, National Wool Growers Association neKwanalu, lapho kubhungwe khona ngomthelela omubi odalwa wukudlondlobala kwalesi sifo esishaya sibhuqe imfuyo ezweni ikakhulu esifundazweni.Umhlangano walezi zinhlaka ubanjwa nje inhlangano yezilwane emhlabeni iWorld Organization for Animal Health, isanda kubika ngoMashi nonyaka ukuthi sezingaphezu kuka-167 izigameko zesifo samatele ezisanda kubikwa eKZN.Ithe ukuqhubeka kwande izilwane ezihlaselwe amatele, kuzoshaya kuzwele kubalimi. Isikhulu esiphezulu seKwanalu, uNksz Sandy La Marque, siphonsele inselelo uhulumeni ikakhulu eMnyangweni wezoLimo ukuthi kube khona okwenzayo ngale nkinga ukugwema ukubhebhetheka komonakalo ababona kuzokwenzeka maduze."Uma kuqhubeka kanje lesi simo sizokwenza ukuthi kuphoqeleke ukuvalwa kwamabhizinisi osomabhizinisi abasafufusa abangezukukwazi ukumelana nobukhulu bomonakalo. Lokhu kuzothikameza imboni yethu yezolimo," usho kanje.UNksz La Marque uthe ukumemezela ukuthi lesi sifo siyinhlekelele ezweni kungenza ukuthi kusukunyelwe ukubhebhetheka kwaso, okungasiza ngokuthi kusondele izinhlaka ezahlukene ukufaka imali yokuxhasa ukusiza ukunqanda umonakalo kusenesikhathi. Usihlalo weRed Meat Producers, uMnuz Angus Williamson, uthe nakuba lesi sifo sigxile kakhulu eKZN okwamanje, kodwa akumele kushaywe indiva ukudlondlobala kwaso ngoba umonakalo okuzoza nawo ungagcina usunabela nakwezinye izifundazwe uma unganakiwe."Ngeke sikwazi ukulungisa sonke isimo nakho konke okungahambi kahle ngokwethu, sidinga ukuthi uhulumeni angenelele kulokhu ukusiza ukuhlenga imboni yethu. Ezintweni esibona zingasiza ukwenza umehluko wukuthi kwandiswe izinhlelo zokugoma imfuyo, kulawulwe imfuyo ezinkalweni, kuqikelelwe ukuthi lowo nalowo ofuyile ugcina imfuyo endaweni efanele, bese kwakhiwa ubudlelwano bokusebenzisana," usho kanje.
UKUKHOLELWA ekutheni enye yezinto ezenza ukuthi kwande izigameko zodlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane nezingane ukungabhoboki kwabahlukumezayo, kwenze insizwa emodelayo yahlaba ikhwelo lokuzama ukuthi kuliwe nalesi sihlava.UNtandoyesizwe Mhlongo (22) waseTete, KwaDukuza, KwaZulu-Natal, ungomunye wabangaphezu kwa-40 abangenele umncintiswano ka-Mr South Africa, athi uhlela ukusebenzisa igama lalo mcimbi ukuhambela izindawo ezahlukene futhi enze izigcawu zokuqwashisa abesilisa."Njengoba ngikhulele elokishini ngiqaphelile ukuthi abantu abaningi besilisa emphakathini banezinkinga ezahlukene ezenza ukuthi badinwe wubala ngenxa yezinye izinto ezibaxinile emoyeni nasemphefumulweni. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukubhodlela kwabanye abantu ngodlame, ikakhulu kwabesifazane nezingane ezincane ngoba kuyehlela kubona futhi akulula ukuthi bazivikele ezimweni ezinjalo," kusho uNtandoyesizwe. Leli bhungu, elenza unyaka wesithathu kwi-Bachelor's Degree in Sports Recreation and Exercise Science eNyuvesi yaseWestern Cape, lithe kuyalikhathaza ukuthi namanje kusenzima ukuqeda insila yokuthi indoda kayikhali, okwenza ukuthi kungabi lula kubantu besilisa ukubhoboka ngezinkinga ezahlukene nokunye okubaphethe kabi empilweni. "Yingakho ngifuna ukuthi ngihambele ezindaweni ezahlukene ngixoxe nabo ikakhulu abasebasha njengami, ngenze izigcawu ezivulelekile lapho bezokwazi ukukhuthala khona ukubhodla ngokubahluphayo futhi ngifuna ukwenza ukuthi kube yinto ejwayelekile, engelona ihlazo," lisho kanje. UNtandoyesizwe uqale ukumodela ngo-2020, ngesikhathi ekhala emuka nesicoco sika-Mr Umlazi, kanti nyakenye ubengenele u-Mr KwaDukuza - lapho ahambe waze wafika esigabeni sabahlanu bokugcina emncintiswaneni. Ugxile kakhulu futhi kwezokukhangisa ngengqephu njengoba eseke wasebenzisana nezitolo esingabala kuzona iMarkham, Zara ne-SPCC.
SEKUQUBUKE impikiswano nokubhekana ngeziqu zamehlo kwabezinhlangano eziqhakambisa isintu nezibhekele ukuhlola izintombi nto ezweni, neKhomishini yamaLungelo ezamaSiko, ezeNkolo nezeziLimi, iCultural, Religious and Linguistics Rights Commission (CRL), ngesiphakamiso sayo sokuthi izingane ezineminyaka engaphansi kuka-16 zingabe zisahlolelwa ubuntombi njengoba kwenzeka ezweni lonke ikakhulu KwaZulu-Natal.I-CRL idalule ukuthi lokhu ayikusho ngoba imelene nesiko nendlela yokwenza yesintu kodwa yingoba ifuna ukuthi kuvikeleleke izingane ezincane zamantombazane ukuthi zingathintwa ngendlela eziyibona ingafanele.Ithe abanye bonomehlo abahlola izintombi abakufundele ukwenza lo msebenzi, okungenza ukuthi kube nobungozi thizeni ezinganeni. Idalule nokuthi ihlaba leli khwelo ngoba ilandelela imithetho ebhekele ukuvikela izingane. Iphakamisa ukuthi okungenani uma kwenzeka ukuthi umntwana oneminyaka engaphansi kuka-16 uhlolelwa ubuntombi, kumele umzali wakhe akugunyaze lokho, asayine phansi ukuthi uyavuma ingane yakhe ihlolwe. USolwazi Nomagugu Ngobese wenhlangano engenzi inzuzo, iNomkhubulwane Institute ebhekele ukuhlola izintombi nto, uthe isenzo se-CRL nohulumeni uqobo ubona siyindlela yokuphazamisa ivangeli abalishumayela emphakathini lokuqhakambisa ukuziphatha kahle nokuzigcina kwezintombi nto."Uhulumeni akumele ukuthi ugxambukele esikweni lethu lokuhlola izintombi futhi asizukukuvuma ukwenza izinto ngale ndlela abasho ngayo. Uma befuna ukusithathela izinyathelo zomthetho ngalokho, bangenza kanjalo kodwa asijiki kulokhu esikwenzayo ngoba kuyisiko lethu kusukela kudala. Sikulwele kanzima ukuthi kufike kulesi sigaba esikusona manje ngakho asizuvumela ukuthi loniwe kalula kanjalo," usho kanje.Uthe bayazi ukuthi benza ini uma behlola izintombi ngakho ngeke batshelwe yinoma wubani ukuthi lo msebenzi asebewenze iminyaka, ukuthi bawenze ngayiphi indlela. "Lokhu okwenzeka manje sibona kusayimizamo kahulumeni yokufuna ukulawula yonke into yesiko lethu, ngenhloso yokuqhubeka benze inzuzo ngokungaziphathi kahle kwentsha yethu njengoba sihlale sibona benza imikhankaso yokuthi izingane zethu zifundiswe ngocansi zisencane futhi zingakalungeli ukwenza lokho. Lokhu kufakazelwa nayizinhlelo zikahulumeni zokukhipha amajazi omkhwenyana ezikoleni, esibona kusayindlela yokuqhubeka kuqhakanjiswe ukuziphatha okungekuhle ezinganeni zethu," kusho uSolwazi Ngobese.Uveze ukuthi izingane zikhipha izisu zincane, wathi bona abakwenzayo ukuzigqugquzela ukuthi zizigcine zimsulwa.Okhulumela le khomishini, uMnuz Javu Baloyi, uthe bona babhekele ukulwa nazo zonke izenzo abazibona ziphambene nomthetho, kubalwa nakho lokhu kokuthi kuhlolwe izingane ezincane ezineminyaka engaphansi kuka-16."Kuphambene noMthethosisekelo wezwe ukuthi kuhlolwe izingane ezincane kangaka ngoba lokho okusuke kwenziwa kuzona, kusuke kungeyona intando yazo futhi zisuke zingazivumelanga ngokwazo ukuthi kwenziwe kuzona. Ezweni lethu iminyaka okuvumeleke ukuthi umuntu azithathele izinqumo ngazo ikakhulu ezintweni ezithinta isitho sakhe sangasese iminyaka ewu-17, ngakho lokhu okwenziwa ezinganeni kuphambene nomthetho."Uphonsele inselelo uMnyango wezaseKhaya ukuthi ungenelele kulokhu ukuze kuvikelwe amalungelo ezingane.Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kweNdlunkulu kaZulu, ayiphumelelanga njengoba iSilo esabuza uMdlokombane savuselela uMkhosi woMhlanga oba ngoSepthemba, minyaka yonke, esigodlweni eNyokeni.Inhloso yalo mkhosi wukuhambisa umhlanga kwiMbube yizintombi nto nokugqugquzela ukuhlolwa kwazo.
KUKHALWE ngama-consultant asetshenziswa komasipala ekubeni kusuke kunabasebenzi abaqashelwe ukwenza umsebenzi wokuqinisekisa ukuthi imali isebenza ngendlela.Lesi sikhalo sivezwe ngusihlalo wekomiti lezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu ePhamende, uDkt Zweli Mkhize izolo, ekhuluma nabezindaba ngezaleli komiti. UMkhize uthe lezi zinkampani ezisetshenziswa komasipala ziyahluleka ezinye zazo ukwenza umsebenzi ogculisayo.Uthe kunezinselelo zokuthi kwabanye omasipala akukho ukulandelela. "Kunezinselelo ngasekuphathweni kwemali komasipala. Lokhu kuvele ngisho embikweni woMcwaningi Mabhuku Jikelele. Umbiko olethwe ngeminye imikhandlu uveza izinto eziningi ezingahambi kahle kuyona ekubeni bekusetshenziswa izinkampani ezizimele," usho kanje.Ukhale ngokuthi omasipala basebenzise ngaphezu kuka-R1.4 billion kulezi zinhlangano."Kwenzeka lokhu nje, kulabo masipala kunabasebenzi abaqashwe ngokugcwele okuyibo okumele babhekane nomsebenzi wezezimali kodwa lowo msebenzi wenziwa abanye abantu. Kumele kuphele ukusetshenziswa kwemali budedengu." Khonamanjalo: usihlalo wekomiti leziSebenzi zikaHulumeni nokuPhatha, uMnuz Jan de Villiers, ukhale ngokudla kubi kwezipoki eminyangweni ehlukene kahulumeni.Uthe lezi zipoki zibhubhudla imali kahulumeni wathi inkohlakalo edla lubi yazo eminyangweni okubalwa owezeMfundo nowezeMpilo."Asaziwa isibalo sabasebenzi abayizipoki kuhulumeni kodwa bona bakhona futhi baningi. Sekuqalwe uphenyo oluhlanganisa izinhlaka ezehlukene ezizophenya ngalesi sihlava." Uthe ngisho noNgqongqoshe wezeziMali, uMnuz Enoch Godongwana, wakubalula ethula isabelomali ukuthi kumele kubalwe abasebenzi ukuze kuliwe nalesi sihlava sezipoki kuhulumeni. "Lo mkhonyovu wenziwa ngabantu abayizikhulu eminyangweni. Awenziwa umuntu oyedwa emnyangweni kodwa izikhulu okungenani ezintathu okudinga ukuthi zisayine, bese kuba nesipoki. Lokhu kusho ukuthi inkohlakalo igxile kakhulu kuhulumeni." Ubalule ukuthi uMcwaningi Mabhuku Jikelele waveza embikweni wakhe ukuthi eMnyangweni wezeMfundo eMpumalanga, kwakhokhelwa izipoki imali ebalelwa ku-R4.6 million.
UZWE ubuhlungu obuphindaphindwe kaningi umndeni ohanjelwe yisihlobo engozini yomgwaqo, "uhlukunyezwa" yinduna yesigodi saseWome, eMthandeni, KwaMaphumulo.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi kwale kancane kubhuntshe umngcwabo ngeSonto, induna igasela namaphoyisa ngenhloso yokumisa umngcwabo, sekumbiwe negodi.Umngcwabo bekungokaMnuz Xolani Cele, okuthiwa washona ngesonto eledlule kulandela ukubandakanyeka kweloli yasemsebenzini wakhe engozini yomgwaqo eNkandla. Isihlobo esicele ukungadalulwa sithe indaba iqale ngesikhathi umndeni uyobikela induna njengokwenqubo yasendaweni ukuthi uzoba nomngcwabo njengoba bedlulelwe yisihlobo."Ibatshele ukuthi akufanele umufi angcwatshwe esigodini sayo iWome, kufanele angcwatshwe eThabane, lapho ebese akhe khona,” kusho isihlobo.Sithe umndeni uzamile ukuyichazela induna ukuthi yize kunjalo, ngokwenqubo yomndeni, wonke amalungu omndeni wakwaCele, angcwatshwa emathuneni asekhaya elikhulu eliseWome. "Ayifunanga nokuyizwa leyo, yathi awukho umngcwabo ozokuba sesigodini sayo,” kusho isihlobo.Sithe ngokuhlonipha inqubo yomndeni, baqhubekile nezinhlelo zokuthi umufi afihlwe ekhaya elikhulu."Amadoda athe esamatasa nokumba igodi induna yatheleka namaphoyisa, ukuzozama ukumisa umngcwabo, nokho umndeni wakubeka kwacaca ukuthi umngcwabo uyaqhubeka,” kusho isihlobo. Sithe induna igcine isabisa ngokuthi izobavulela icala konkosi ngokuthi bayishaye indiva ikhuluma.Siqhube sathi abakwenziwe yinduna beshonelwe yisihlobo kabuhlungu kubazwise ubuhlungu obuphindiwe."Umndeni ubusakuthola kunzima ukubhekana nokuthi umufi udlule kabuhlungu kangaka engozini, ngesikhathi induna inezela isawoti esilondeni, iwuhlukumeza ngokuthi ngeke ukwazi ukungcwaba lapho ohlale ungcwaba khona uma kukhona ilungu elidlulile,” kusho isihlobo. Esinye isihlobo siveze ukuthi induna iwujwayele umkhuba wokuxakazisa abantu besigodi sayo uma beshonelwe."Uma kushone umuntu ebikade ingasamboni endaweni, ngisho ngabe ubesekuhambeni ngokomsebenzi, umndeni uthwala kanzima uma sekufanele angcwatshwe, ithi awuhambe uyomngcwaba lapho abesehlala khona,” kusho esinye isihlobo.Siveze nokuthi kunanemali induna eyikhokhisa imindeni esuke inemicimbi esigodini efana nemishado neminye. "Yonke le mali asazi kahle hle ukuthi umphakathi uyikhokhiselwani,” sisho kanje. Imizamo yokuthola induna ayiphumelelanga.
USANEMINJUNJU futhi usathunukala izilonda unina kaMnuz Sindiso Magaqa, uNkk Khethiwe Magaqa, ngendlela okwabulawa ngayo indodana yakhe njengoba ethi uNkulunkulu kuphela owaziyo ukuthi kungani kwahlanganiswa uzungu lokubulawa kwayo.UNkk Magaqa ubekade enenkulumo ekhethekile neSolezwe ngemuva kokuba inkabi uSibusiso Ncengwa engummangalelwa wesine ecaleni lokubulawa kwalo mholi, igeqe amagula ngoLwesihlanu eNkantolo eNkulu yaseMgungundlovu, ibiza ngamagama abantu ethi bayathinteka ekubulaweni kukaMagaqa.Ikusho lokhu esitatimendini sokuvuma icala, njengoba kulindeleke ukuthi igwetshwe ekupheleni kwale nyanga. UMagaqa, owake waba ngumholi wophiko lwentsha lwe-ANC, wasocongwa ngo-2017, ebuya emhlanganweni wamakhansela.''Namanje kusangifikisela ngezinyembezi ukukhuluma ngale nto eyehlela umntanami. Namanje ngithi uma ngicabanga ngayo ngizizwe ngihlengezela izinyembezi,'' usho kanje.Mayelana nokuvela kwamagama abevezwa yinkabi enkantolo, uthe konke ukushiyela kuNkulunkulu ngoba bona akukho abangakwenza. Umfowabo kamufi, uDkt Lwazi Magaqa, uthe ukugonyuluka kwenkabi mayelana nokusocongwa kukamufi, kubuyise ithemba elikhulu kubona njengomndeni.Uthe kulokoza inhlansi yethemba ukuthi bakhona abazogcina bejeza mayelana nokubulawa kukamfowabo. Ukhale ngokuthi selokhu laqala ukuqulwa leli cala belingacaci, wathi kodwa manje yima bebona ukuthi liyaphi njengoba sekunamagama avelile.''Ukubalulwa kwalawa magama kusho ukuthi kukhona ukukhanya okuvelayo mayelana nalo,'' usho kanje.Igonyuluka inkabi, iqale yakuqinisekisa ukuthi yona ingummangalelwa wesine kuleli cala. Iyakuqinisekisa nokuthi ingonyuluka yayo iyenza ingazange iphoqwe. Ithe ngoJulayi 11, 2017, yayiseBerea Centre, eThekwini, ngesikhathi ithola ucingo luvela kuSibonelo Myeza. "Wacela ukuhlangana nami ezansi ezitebhisini lapho engamfica emi noJabulani Mdunge. Bangazisa ukuthi kunomsebenzi okumele siwenze eMzimkhulu. Ngababuza ukuthi msebenzi muni loyo,'' isho kanje.Ithe bamphendula ngokuthi kunothile kuMasipala waseMzimkhulu ofuna ukuveza inkohlakalo eyenziwa ngabanye. ''Abazange balisho igama lomuntu, kunalokho bathi ngaphambi kokuba kwenziwe umsebenzi kunabanye abantu okumele siqale sihlangane nabo.''Ngakusasa ithe baphinda bahlangana futhi eBerea Centre, sekukhona uJabulani Mdunge, Sbonelo Myeza, Lindokuhle Nkosi, Mlungisi Ncalane noMbulelo Mpofana. Ithe kuloyo mhlangano, uMbulelo Mpofana wabachazela ukuthi kunabanye futhi abantu ababili abadinga usizo kubona."Ngamcela ukuba asinikeze amagama alabo bantu. Wasitshela ukuthi uMnuz Skosana (Zweliphansi) owayesisikhulu esiphezulu kuMasipala waseMzimkhulu, noMnuz Mluleki Ndobe (owayeyimeya kuMasipala waseHarry Gwala). Washo ukuthi usizo abaludingayo kithina elokuthi sihambe siyobulala loyo muntu ofuna ukudalula inkohlakalo,'' isho kanje.Ithe babe sebeqala sebebhunga ngenkokhelo okwavunyelwana ngokuthi ibe u-R120 000 kodwa oyotholakala ngemuva kokuphothulwa komsebenzi. ''Sathenjiswa nokuthi ngemuva kwalokhu kuyoba nethenda yesigidi samarandi esiyogixatshezwa ngayo. Ngabatshela ukuthi angazi lutho ngalezo zinto kodwa uMpofana wathi uzongisiza." Ngesikhathi esejele uthe uSkosana, uNdobe, uSbo Myeza, uMlu Ncalane noMbulelo Mpofana nabo bakhalelwa ngamaSongo kaSigonyela.''Yilapho ke engaqala khona ukuhlangana noNdobe noSkosana sisejele iNew Prison, eMgungundlovu. Yilapho ke engathola khona ukuthi uSkosana noNdobe babekade bekhokhe u-R600 000, okuyimali uMpofana noMyeza abangayiphikanga. UNdobe noSkosana basicela ukuba singalwi ngesivumelwano sokuthi uNdobe uzokhokha u-R500 000 ukugwema ukuklwebhana phakathi kwethu. UMdu Ncalane wathunywa ukuba azolanda loyo R500 000, ngemuva kwalokho ngezwa kuthiwa asehoxisiwe amacala ayebekwe uNdobe noSkosana,'' kuchaza uNcengwa. UNdobe wazidubula ngo-2020, emuva kokuvela ukuthi uphethwe wumdlavuza.Uveze ukuthi ngo-2023, waxhumana nomndeni kaMagaqa icela uxolo kuwona, wawazisa nokuthi uzolivuma icala ebese enikezela inkantolo ngobufakazi.Okhulumela uphiko lwezokuShushisa KwaZulu-Natal uNkk Natasha Ramkisson-Kara, uthe uNcengwa uwavumile amacala wathi uMagaqa wadutshulwa ngoJulayi 2017, kodwa waze washona ngemuva kwesikhathi esesibhedlela.Uthe uNcengwa uzogwetshwa ngoJuni 30, enkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu.I-ANC Youth League yenze isitatimende mayelana nokugonyuluka kwenkabi, yathi ifuna ukuthi kugcine kuvele konke ngalolu daba.
KUME nse ukusebenza kwangavulwa ngisho izitolo edolobheni laseNquthu izolo njengoba amalungu omphakathi abeqhamuka ezindaweni ezehlukene ebhikishe ekhala ngokuntula amanzi. Intukuthelo abeyibhekise kuMasipala waseMzinyathi oholwa uNkk Thembisile Mchunu, naseMkhandlwini waseNquthu oholwa uMnuz Lindokuhle Shabalala.Elinye lamalungu omphakathi abehola imashi, uMnuz Lucky Hlatshwayo, lithe kuyihlazo ukuthi kusuka ngo-2016 amanzi awaphumi kompompi okuyinto akade banxusa ukuthi isukunyelwe. "Kusuka kwangena iNkatha kulabo masipala bobabili, asiphindanga sawabona amanzi. Yinto ebuhlungu esiphila ngaphansi kwayo. Sivale idolobha ngoba kade sikhuluma indaba yamanzi kodwa inganakwa. Kuthe uma sebezwa ukuthi sihlela le mashi bawavulela aqala ukuphuma ngoLwesine kwezinye izindawo, asephumaphi ke?” kubuza uHlatshwayo.Uthe okubacasula kakhulu ukuthi labo masipala bobabili balibele ukwenza imicimbi engathi shu edla izigidi zemali, bayeke ukuhambisa izidingo ebantwini."Ngabe basebenzisa le mali abenza ngayo imicimbi yemijaho yamahhashi nezinja, ukulungisa ingqalasizinda edingwa abantu, kodwa benza izinto ezingasizi muntu. Kuke kwalethwa injini okuthiwa idle imali enguR6 million, kwathiwa intsha kodwa ibonakala ukuthi indala, yafakwa kodwa yangasebenza. "Into abayenza bakhipha ithenda yokuhambisa amanzi emphakathini ngamaloli omunye weqembu labo, nawo abuye angawahambisi amanzi emphakathini. Imeya lena esanda kuxoshwa iyona iqembu iyona lento eyayixoshisa kuthiwa idla imali,” kuchaza yena. Uveze ukuthi ngalo mbhikisho bakhala nangemigwaqo eminye okungahambeki kuyo ngenxa yokugugulwa imvula, kanye nokuhanjelwa ugesi."Nemigwaqo njengoba kusemakhaya mibi nayo kade sasinxusa ukuthi ilungiswe. Ugesi awusahambi ngokohlelo lwe-Eskom kodwa lana eNquthu uyahamba, sanxusa umasipala ukuthi usilungisele lolo daba kwathiwa kuzoyiwa eNewcastle, kwa-Eskom kuyoxoxwa nesikhulu sakhona ngalokhu naso esagcina singafiki emphakathini,” kuchaza yena.Uthe balinde ukuthi iMeya yaseMzinyathi kube iyona ebanika isinqumo abazosithatha esizoletha isixazululo ngamanzi. Uveze ukuthi bazobanika izinsuku eziyisikhombisa ukufeza lokho ababatshele khona uma bengazigcini izethembiso zabo bazobuyela edolobheni balivale kuze kube amanzi ayaphuma kuyona yonke imiphakathi engaphansi kweNquthu.Uthe izimeya zombili zithembise umphakathi ukuthi ezinsukwini ezimbili noma ezintathu zizozama ukulungisa udaba lwamanzi.Kushaye esokushicilela abakhulumela omasipala bengaphendulanga.
UQHATHWE yiToyota Fortuner asanda kuyithenga owesifazane waseCamperdown, okuvela ukuthi uqole iSouth African Social Security Agency (Sassa) izigidi.Owesifazane (37) oboshwe amaphoyisa ophiko lweCrime Intelligence, ibambisene neProvincial Organised Crime ngeledlule, kuvela ukuthi wayesebenza kwaSassa kodwa wabuye wesula.Umthombo weSolezwe, olwazi ukusuka nokuhlala udaba ongeke uvezwe, uthe angaphezu kuka-180 amakhadi atholwe amaphoyisa kowesifazane ngesikhathi egasela kwakhe ngoLwesine eyophenya. "Ubehola izibonelelo zikahulumeni ezehlukene ngawo wonke la makhadi. Kukhona ahola ngawo izibonelelo zabantu asebekhulile, kube esabakhubazekile, esezingane ezashonelwa abazali kanjalo neseqolo,” kusho umthombo.ENingizimu Afrika isibonelelo sezaguga singu-R2 1.15 kwabaneninyaka engu-60 kuya kwengu-74, sibe ngu-R2 335 kwabaneminyaka engu-75 kuya phezulu. Esabahola impesheni yokukhubazeka singu-R2 315, kube u-R1 250 kwabahola isibonelelo sabantwana abangenabazali, bese kuthi iqolo libe wu-R560. "Njalo ngenyanga ubehamba ayoyikhipha le mali kuwo wonke la makhadi bese eyifaka ebhange lakhe,” kusho umthombo, oveze ukuthi ibhange lakhe linemali elinganiselwa kuR6 million. Uthe cishe ebhange lakhe ubevamise ukufaka imali elinganiselwa kuR80 000 njalo uma eyofaka imali.Udalule ukuthi ikhadi ngalinye belibhalwe igama 'lomnikazi’ nenombolo yalo eyimfihlo.Kuvela ukuthi imoto ayithenge ezinyangeni ezimbalwa ezedlule ibiza uR600 000 kanti uyithenge ngokheshi. Kuphinde kwavela ukuthi unemizi yenani likaR3 million ezindaweni ezehlukene, ekhokhelwe yaqedwa. Kuyona kukhona lo abanjwe ekuwo oseCamperdown kanjalo nongaseMhlanga. Kuthiwa ebantwini ubehambe ethi usebenza kwashukela futhi unebhizinisi lokupheka, okuthe uma kubukwa impilo ayiphilayo, izibalo zangahlangana. "Abantu bebekhathazwa wuhlobo lwempilo ephezulu ayiphilayo, bexoxa, nokuholele ekutheni izinkulumo zihambe zize ziyofika ezindlebeni zamaphoyisa, abe eseqala uphenyo,” kusho umthombo. Kuvela ukuthi nakuba esayeka ukusebenza kwaSassa kodwa ubesaqhubeka nokuhola imali yezipoki nyangazonke futhi ekwazi ukwenza ubugebengu bakhe bokuvuselela esebenzisa ubuchwepheshe.Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kweSassa namaphoyisa ayiphumelelanga izolo kwaze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela.
ZILULEKWE ngendlela yokuziphatha izintombi ebezihambele uMkhosi kaNomkhubulwane ngempelasonto KwaSokhulu, kweseNkosi u-B Mthiyane njengoba kulungiselelwa noMkhosi woMhlanga ongoSepthemba, esigodlweni saseNyokeni KwaNongoma.Kulo mkhosi osongwe izolo, onomehlo baluleke amatshitshi ngendlela okumele aziphathe ngayo aphinde azigcine emsulwa.Akugcinanga ngokululekwa kwamatshitshi kodwa nabafana abasebancane balulekwe ngendlela okumele baziphathe ngayo. Siwumasipala siyohlale siweseka umcimbi ofuze lo," usho kanje.Kwenzeka lokhu nje kunemvunge ngokuhlolwa kwezintombi nto kuleli njengoba ikhomishini ebhekele ukulingana ngokwezeNkolo, amaSiko neziLimi ichitha eyokuhlolwa kwezintombi nto ezingaphansi kweminyaka engu-16, ngaphandle kwemvume yabazali. Le khomishini ithi ingane engaphansi kwale minyaka ayikwazi ukuzinqumela ngokumele ikwenze uma kuza endabeni yokuhlolwa kobuntombi.
AMI ngomumo amathimba aqaphe izinhlekelele ngenxa yesimo sezulu esingesihle KwaZulu-Natal, njengoba kukhishwe isexwayiso ngalesi simo njengoba kwezinye izindawo liyidliva, kanti kwezinye likhithikile.Isexwayiso sakamuva sabakwa-South African Weather Service siveza ukuthi isimo sezulu esimbi sizoqhubeka sibonakale kusona sonke isifundazwe iKwaZulu-Natal.Lokhu kufaka phakathi isigaba sesibili sokuduma kwezulu okuvela ukuthi kuzobonakala kulezi zifunda ezilandelayo, uThukela, iHarry Gwala, Ugu, iLembe, uMkhanyakude, yiZululand, uMzinyathi naseThekwini. Isigaba sesine semvula enamandla sibhekwe ukuba sifinyelele eKokstad, Ray Nkonyeni, Ubuhlebezwe, Umdoni, Umuziwabantu, Umzimkhulu, naseMzumbe.Kuxwayiswa nokuthi lesi simo sezulu singaholela ekutheni kube khona abalahlekelwa yimpilo yabo.UMphathiswa wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, uthe bami ngomumo ukubhekana nanoma yisiphi isimo sezinhlekelele esingenzeka. Ingane eneminyaka engu-12 ubudala ivele enkantolo yeMantshi eBrakpan phambi kweso lomqaphi wayo, ibhekene necala lokubulala ngokungenhloso kanye nokushayela imoto ngaphandle kwelayisensi.Ngomhlaka-7 Juni 2025 ngabo-13H00, le ngane engummangalelwa yayishayela imoto yabazali bayo yohlobo lweMazda iwelela ekhoneni likaMadeley noNorthdene Street, eBrakpan, ngesikhathi ishayisa umfana, 14, imoto yaphaphalaza yashayisa udonga lomuzi. Umfana, 14, ushonele khona lapho. Ummangalelwa oneminyaka engu-12 ubudala wabe eseyiswa emaphoyiseni aseBrakpan futhi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi wadedelwa ngaphansi kweso labazali bakhe ngomhlaka-8 Juni 2025. Enkantolo, icala lihlehliselwe umhla ka-28 ku-Agasti 2025 ukuze kuhlaziywe ubungako nesisindo secala.
Ingane oneminyaka engu-12 ubudala yebe imoto ekhaya kanti izodala umonakalo emgwaqweni ngoMgqibelo eBrakpan, eKurhuleni.Kubikwa ukuthi le ngane ebishayela imoto yohlobo lweMazda ihlulekile wukuma ezimpambanweni zomgwaqo yashayisa umfana oneminyaka engu-14 ngaphambi kokuthi imoto iphaphalaze ishayise udinga lomuzi. .Abezimo eziphuthumayo babike ukuthi umgilwa ushonele endaweni yesehlo selishonile endaweni yesigameko. Ingane, 12, inikezelwe emaphoyiseni aseBrakpan ihamba nomqaphi wayo. Okhulumela uMkhandlu uZweli Dlamini unxuse abazali ukuthi baqaphele indlela ababeka ngayo okhiye bezimoto. "Ingozi edabukisa kakhulu le, futhi sidlulisa amazwi enduduzo emndenini kamufi. Kusenjalo sidlulisa umlayezo obalulekile emiphakathini yethu: masiqinisekise ukuthi sigcina okhiye bezimoto bephephile, masiqinisekise ukuthi izingane azifinyeleli ezimotweni zethu ikakhulukazi lezi ezingaphansi kweminyaka yobudala yokushayela."

UNDUNANKULU wesifundazwe iKwaZulu-Natal uMnuz Thami Ntuli, uncome isifundazwe ngokubamba ngempumelelo umjaho iComrades Marathon izolo. UNtuli nezinye izikhulu, okukhona kuzo noNgqongqoshe wezeMidlalo kuzwelonke uMnuz Gayton McKenzie kanjalo ngoMphathiswa wezeMdlalo kulesi sifundazwe uMnuz Mntomuhle Khawula, bebenkanise ePeople’s Park, bezokwamukela abanqobile. Umjaho unqotshwe wuTete Morena Dijana waseLimpopo kwabesilisa, kwathi kwabesifazane kwaba nguGerda Steyn waseFree State ozihole phambili. Kulo nyaka, lo mjaho ongamakhilomitha angu-89 ubusuka eMgungundlovu uya eThekwini. "Siyababongela kakhulu oDijana noSteyn, ngokugijima ngokuzikhandla,” kusho uNtuli.Uqhube wathi bayababongela bonke abasubathi ababe yingxenye yomjaho, wathi abagcinanga nje ngokuba abasubathi kodwa babe yizivakashi esifundazweni iKwaZulu-Natal. Uthe isifundazwe siyaziqhenya ngokusingatha umdlalo waleli zinga. Uthe lokhu kuqinisa ubudlelwane bakuleli namazwe ahlukahlukene. "Lona ngumjaho osalokhu uqhubeke njalo nokukhombisa ukuthi siyisifundazwe sinamandla okusingatha umcimbi waleli zinga,” kusho uNtuli.Uncome uMasipala weTheku kanjalo nowaseMgungundlovu ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi konke kuhambe kahle kusuka umjaho uqala waze waphelela eThekwini. Uthe labo masipala babambisane kahle ukuze umjaho ube yimpumelelo. Uqhube wathi akungatshazwa ukuthi ngokuba khona kwalo mjaho esifundazweni, ezokuvakasha zihlomulile. Uphinde wabonga abebeseka abasubathi emgwaqweni ebebegijima kuwo, wabonga abosizo oluphuthumayo, kanjalo namaphoyisa. Uthe ukweseka kwabasubathi kuqinisekise ukuthi lo mcimbi uba yimpumelelo.
Kudingeke ukuba kuvalwe thaqa uPoint Road namhlanje ekuseni kutholakala umsubathi okubikwe ukuthi anyamalale ngemuva kokuqeda icomrades marathon.Kubikwe ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ngeSonto ntambama izihlobo zingasamtholi ocingweni futhi engabonwa ndawo. Abanye abantu baveze ukuthi bamubonile egudla ngasolwandle eqhamuka ngaseSun Coast kodwa abazi uphelelephi ngoba nano babe hamba indlela yabo. Abezimo eziphuthumayo ngaphansi kwenkampani i-ALS Paramedics batshele abezindaba ukuthi lo wesifazane utholwe esesimweni esibucayi kakhulu. Uphuthunyiswe esibhedlela ngendiza enophephela emhlani.Kumanje amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal aphenya amacala ngokuduka komgijimi weComrades Marathon okubikwa ukuthi udukile ngemuva komjaho. Lo wesifazane utholwe ngoMsombuluko ekuseni ngemuva kophenyo olunzulu lwamaphoyisa ophiko lweSearch and Rescue, esebenzisana nabanye abomthetho kanye nezinhlaka ezizimele. Utholwe endaweni yasePhoyinti eThekwini. Kumanje lona wesifazane usesibhedlela kanti nakuba etholakale engenamyocu obonakalayo, amaphoyisa azolinda umbiko kadokotela ozocacisa ngokulandelayo okumele kwenziwe ngamaphoyisa.
Isikhungo sokulawulwa kwezinhlekelele KwaZulu-Natal siqaphe ngeso lokhozi isimo sezulu esingesihle esithinta izingxenye eziningi zesifundazwe. UMfundisi Thulasizwe Buthelezi, ongumphathiswa wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu, unxuse izakhamizi ukuthi ziqaphele njengoba lezi zimo zibeka engcupheni impilo yabantu. I-South African Weather Service isikhiphe isexwayiso sesigaba 4 mayelana nomoya olimazayo namagagasi ayingozi, okulindeleke ukuthi abe phakathi kwamamitha angu-4.5 no-6.0 KwaZulu-Natal. Izindawo ezithintekayo kubalwa iBig Five Hlabisa, eThekwini, KwaDukuza, Mandeni, Mfolozi, Ray Nkonyeni, Umdoni, noMlalazi. Kulindeleke ukuthi kube nomoya olimazayo phakathi kwePort Edward neKosi Bay kusukela ngoLwesibili ekuseni kuze kube uLwesithathu kusihlwa, okungadala ukunqwabelana kwesihlabathi emizileni yasogwini, kuphazamise amachweba namachweba amancane, ukuba sengcupheni kokunqamuka kwezintambo zemikhumbi ezincane nemikhulu. Kubhekwe umonakalo ongaba khona ezintanjeni zikagesi, ukuwa kwezihlahla. Kunxuswa izakhamuzi kanye nabadebenza olwandle ukuthi bagweme imisebenzi yasogwini kanye nokuba sogwini ngalesi sikhathi. Abanezikebhe ezincane kuya kweziphakathi kufanele bafune indawo yokuzikhoselisa.

Kuvela ukuthi le moto igcine seyibandakanyeka engozini njengoba ishayisane netekisi eDurban North.Umshayeli wale moto kuvela ukuthi bekuyiphoyisa lesifazane, kuze kwadingeka ukuba alekelelwe atakulwe ngaphakathi emotweni. Ugcizelele kakhulu ukuthi ubuholi obuphezulu bamaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal ngeke buthule bugoqe izandla bubukele kwenzeka izinto ezidicilela phansi isithunzi salo mbutho. Umphakathi ubalisa ngemoto ewuhlobo lwe-Etios okuthiwa iyona eqeda abantu bakule ndawo.Okudida umphakathi wakule ndawo ukuthi akuqondakali ukuthi bonke laba ababulawayo kungani bebulawa ngalolu hlobo. Kuvela ukuthi ukugobhoza kwegazi akumi, kunalokho kuqhubekela phambili.NgoMgqibelo, kuvela ukuthi kudutshulwe kwabulawa uMnuz Skhumbuzo Ndlovu.''Akuqondakali ukuthi uNdlovu ubuleweleni, ubenzeni, kubani?'' kusho ilungu lomphakathi. Izolo emini kudutshulwe kwabulawa uMnuz Mdu Ngcongo. Umufi kuthiwa udutshulwe ehamba ngemoto yakhe esanda kudlula nje eFolweni. Sisadisekile sonke ukuthi kuqhubekani njengoba sekubulewe uNgcongo nje namhlanje. Ayi konakele kule ndawo bayaphela abantu, asisazi ukuthi senze njani uma kunjena,'' kubalisa ilungu lomphakathi elicele ukungavezwa. Lithe abantu babulawa khona eMbumbulu noma balandelwe bayobulawa kude. "Uyabona nje uNgcongo, kusho ukuthi bakhethe ukuthi bamane bamlandele baze bayombulalela eFolweni.''Kubulawa laba nje umphakathi ubusamangele ngokudutshulwa kubulawe uMnuz Mhlengi Msweli oyindodana yenduna nayo eyadutshulwa yabulawa. Kuwona lo nyaka, kuvela ukuthi kudutshulwe kwabulawa oMnuz Sphelele Khathi noSihle Sibisi."Uma kuqhubeka kanje, impela kuningi okusazokonakala lapha endaweni. Siyacela ukuthi uhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal ungenelele, nakhu abantu bephela,'' kusho elinye ilungu lo mphakathi nalo elingeke livezwe ngoba lisaba. Lithe kulo mphakathi kudlange kakhulu imoto ewuhlobo lwe-Etios. Lithe uma le moto ike yabonakala izulazula emphakathini, nakanjani ngakusasa lisa nezindaba zalo okanye lishone nazo ezokuthi kukhona oseyohlangana noyisemkhulu."Saze sayiphila impilo enzima. Kwaze kwaba lukhuni ukuba umhlali waseMbumbulu uma kunje. Pho siyokhala kubani asizwe?'' lisho kanje leli lungu.Isolezwe lithole ngomthombo walo ukuthi bayaziwa abantu abayizinkabi abaqotha abantu kule ndawo. Kuthiwa futhi bayazicanasela nje, ngoba abakaze bakhalelwe ngamaSongo kaSigonyela ngokwenza kwabo.''U-(emgagula ngegama) nabangani bakhe sebesiqedile lapha emphakathini,'' kusho ilungu lomphakathi. Okunye leli phephandaba elikutholile ukuthi bonke abasocongwayo kule ndawo basuke sebazi ngoba izinkabi ziqale zithumele umyalezo kubona, ngaphambi kokuba zibayise kwagoqa nyawo.''Ibuhlungu kabi le nto eyenzeka lapha eMbumbulu. Bonke laba bantu babulawa sebazi ukuthi bayazobulawa. Awucabange nje isihluku esinje."Elinye ilungu lomphakathi lithi sebehlezi ngesinqe esisodwa kule ndawo. "Uma kuhamba ugesi abanye baze bancamele ukuthi baphume bayolala emahlathini ngenxa yokwesaba ukuthi kukhona okungase kwenzeke uma kumnyama." Phambilini, kuke kwaba nemibiko yokuthi ukubulawa kwabantu kumayelana nokwebiwa kwemfuyo okuthe ngokuhamba kwesikhathi umphakathi wabona ukuthi empeleni kakunjalo, abantu bayaqothwa nje kodwa isizathu kasaziwa.Isolezwe selibike kaningi ngezigameko zokuqothwa kwabantu.Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kwamaphoyisa ayiphumelelanga.
KUSOLWA isoka ngesidumbu sowesifazane esitholakale sigqitshiwe ngemuva kwendlu yesoka abethandana nalo, eThembeni, eMandeni.Kuvela ukuthi isidumbu sikamufi uNksz Snenhlanhla Ngubane (26) sitholakale sigqitshiwe ngemuva kwegceke lesoka lakhe okuvela ukuthi lona bese ligcwele amathafa.Kuvela ukuthi isidumbu sikamufi esitholakale ngoLwesithathu besingenawo amanxeba kodwa besimbozwe ngamahlamvu nangengubo yokulala. Umfowabo kamufi, uMnuz Cebo Ngubane, ukhale ngesihluku sokubulawa kukadadewabo. Uthe kubaphathe kabi kakhulu ukubulawa kukadadewabo ngesihluku esinjena."Namanje akukavumi ukuba sikholwe ukuthi ingane yakwethu ibulawe ngaleya ndlela. Ibuhlungu kakhulu le nto eyenziwe kumuntu wesifazane. Siyazibuza siyaziphendula ukuthi kwenzekeni nokuthi kungani aze abulawe ngaleya ndlela futhi ubekade enzeni kubani,'' kubalisa uNgubane. Ligcine litholakala isoka libhace ehostela KwaMashu.UNgubane veze ukuthi kutholakala isidumbu nje, udadewabo ubekade ehambe ekhaya ngoLwesibili kwathi uma sebezama ukumshayela ucingo, belungasangeni.Uthe bebemshayela ucingo ngoba beqaphela ukuthi seliyoshona ilanga kodwa akabuyi ekhaya. Uthe kukhona abantu abambonile udadewabo ehamba nesoka lakhe njengoba esetholakala eseyisidumbu nje. Uveze ukuthi owesilisa ongumsolwa uyaziwa endaweni.Uthe njengomndeni bafuna ukubona ubulungiswa benzeka ngokubulawa kukadadewabo. Kuvela ukuthi isoka lihambile laqoqa izimpahla zalo. Ikhansela lakule ndawo, uNksz Lungile Mthembu, likhale ngesihluku esikhulu esikhonjiswe yisoka.UNksz Mthembu uthe bakhathazekile kakhulu ngokuthi kunabantu abacabanga ukumane babulale umuntu wesifazane ngoba nakhu sekukhona ukungaboni ngaso linye phakathi kwabo. Uthe endaweni bayakweshwama lokhu okwenzekile, abakaze bakubone.''Le nto isihlukumezile kakhulu yangagcina lapho yasishiya nenqwaba yemibuzo engenazimpendulo,'' usho kanjena.Eqhuba uthe ukholwa ukuthi isoka bakhona abanye ebebelilekelela. "Angeke umuntu oyedwa aze akwazi ukumba umgodi aphinde afake isidumbu kalula. Kumele batholakale nalaba abanye,''usho kanjena. Ikhansela lithe kukhona okumele kwenziwe ngenhloso yokunqanda isihlava sokubulawa kwabesifazane ngabesilisa abathandana nabo.''Kuyacaca ukuthi izingane zethu zamantombazane kumele ziqaphele kakhulu uma zijola nabafana ngoba kuyacaca ukuthi zisuke zingaphephile nje nhlobo,'' usho kanjena.Liphethe ngokuthi izingane zabafana kumele zifundiswe ukwamukela uma zaliwa ngamantombazane."Inkinga iqala uma owesilisa engasafuni ukwaliwa. Kanti kumele bazi ukuthi akukho okungenziwa uma ucu lungasahlangani."

Uthe nakuba izinsolo zenkohlakalo ezibucayi zivele engakangeni kulesi sikhundla kodwa uzimisele ukubhekana nazo futhi izinyathelo zizothathwa ngaphandle kokusaba nokwenzelela.Ugcizelele ukuthi ngeke afakwe ingcindezi ukuba athathe izinqumo ngokuxhamazela ekwenzeni umsebenzi wakhe azibophezela kuwo ngesifungo.
BAKHATHAZEKILE ngokuphinde kuqubuke izigameko zokufa kwabantu eMaoti eNanda, kulandela ukushona kowesilisa ngesikhathi kungenelwa iziqashi, abebezibamba inkunzi kuleli sonto.Kuthiwa abalisa abane bangene kweminye imiqasho kule ndawo, bengene indlu nendlu bephanga impahla nezinye izinto ngoLwesibili ebusuku.Kuvela ukuthi bafike kwenye indlu bafica owesilisa kwaba ongaphansi nongaphezulu kubangwa isibhamu. UMnuz Thabani Mhlongo, osekomitini lewadi, uthe bathole ukuthi abasolwa abagasele kule miqasho, bebehamba bebane bengene indlu nendlu bebamba inkunzi. "Bebehambe bengena umnyango nomnyango, bethatha ngodli amaselula, amathelevishini nokunye,” kusho uMhlongo.Uthe kuthe sebefika ekotishini lesiqashi esigcine sishonela esibhedlela, savele sangavuma ukuthi bathathe izimpahla zaso kalula. "Ngesikhathi isiqashi silwa nomsolwa obephethe isibhamu, siqhume, sadubula omunye umsolwa. Naso isiqashi basidubulile, base bebaleka,” kusho uMhlongo. Uthe baqinisekise ukuthi babaleka naso isibhamu esenze umonakalo.Uqhube wathi umsolwa obedubulekile uzamile ukubaleka kodwa waphelelwa amandla esangweni, ngalo uLwesibili. Umufi uthe ugcine eshonela esibhedlela izolo."Sifisa amaphoyisa athole ukuthi odubuleke washona ungubani wakuphi bese eya emndenini wakhe ayobuza ukuthi obani abangani angahlukani nabo. Babuze nokuthi ngosuku lwesigameko bamgcina enabaphi abangani,” kusho uMhlongo.Uthe ngaleyo ndlela ungavela umkhondo wokuthi ababalekile bangobani. Uthe isiqashi esishonile esasePort Shepstone.Uveze ukuthi umphakathi ubusazitshela ukuthi kusathule ukubulawa kwabantu kulandela ukuboshwa kwalaba abahamba inkantolo njengamanje."Besisathi siphumule kancane ngobugebengu bokubulawa kwabantu. Ebesikuqaphela nje yibo ubugebengu bokubanjwa kwabantu inkunzi,” usho kanje. Ubalule ukuthi into evele ibakhathaze wukuthi nakuba bebulawa amaphoyisa abanye (abasolwa), abanye beboshwa, abasasele emphakathini basuke bematasa bepheka abasha.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi umasitende wemiqasho okwenzeke kuyo isigameko akahlali khona, uhlala komunye umuzi osePhoenix.Kuze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela amaphoyisa engaphenduli imibuzo athunyelelwe yona ngoLwesithathu.Imizamo yokuthola umndeni wesiqashi ayiphumelelanga njengoba inombolo yomndeni ebishayelwa ibikhala ingabanjwa.
KUSEQHULWINI kuMasipala wesiFunda iLembe ukuxazulula ingwadla yenkinga yamanzi esezingxenyeni ezahlukene zalesi sifunda. Lokhu kudalulwe yiMeya yalesi sifunda, uMnuz Thobani Shandu, izolo ngesikhathi echaza kabanzi ngabakubeke eqhulwini kwisabelo mali esizoqala ukusebenza ngoJulayi.Uthe ngabe benza elikhulu iphutha uma beyiziba inkinga yamanzi ekule ndawo. Uthe njengoba isifunda iLembe sibunjwe yindawo yaKwaDukuza, Mandeni, Ndwedwe, naKwaMaphumulo, le nkinga ikhona kuzona zonke lezi zindawo."Imindeni edla imbuya ngothi izohlinzeka ngamanzi amahhala angu-10 000 wamalitha njalo ngenyanga. Abadla izambane likapondo bona bazongena bashone ephaketheni. Imindeni enemizi ebiza ngaphansi kukaR130 000, ngeke iyikhokhe imali yezindleko zokwethuthwa kwendle," kusho UShandu njengoba isabelomali singuR1.9 billion. Uveze ukuthi iningi kakhulu imali abayikhiphayo bezama ukulungisa inkinga yamanzi. Udalule ukuthi babakhokhela izigidi aboMgeni-uThukela, ukuze bathole amanzi.Uthe abakufisayo wukuthi iphele indaba yokuthi abantu bahanjiselwe amanzi ngezimoto ezithwala amanzi. Uqhube wathi bafake iziphehli zamanzi kubona bonke omasipala ababumba iLembe.EMandeni uthe sebefake amapitsi amanzi angu-8, KwaMaphumulo sebefake angu-14, eNdwedwe bafake awu-14. "Inhloso enkulu kodwa wukuthi sibe namaphrojekthi amakhulu amanzi azoqeda nje nya ngenkinga yamanzi kule ndawo''Uthe mukhulu umthamo wamanzi odingekayo ngenxa yabantu abaningi abafudukela kulezi zindawo. Uthe amaphrojekthi amakhulu amanzi abazowenza kulesi sabelo mali esizoqala, abandakanya ukunyuswa komthamo wamanzi atholakala esiphehlini uMvoti Water.Uqhube wathi bazophinde baqedele ingxenye uPhase 5C NO 5d, wesiphehli samanzi saseMandeni, Macambini, KwaDukuza naKwaMaphumulo. Bazophinde babheke ngeso elibanzi inkinga yengqalasizinda.UShandu uthe kuyinto engeke iphikwe ukuthi kubuye kubadalele inkinga enkulu kakhulu ukuba khona kwengqalasizinda esindala ngoba lokho kukhinyabeza namanzi. Ugcizelele ukuthi izindawo ezikulesi sifunda zibonakala zithuthuka wathi lokho kudoba abantu ukuba beze kuzona kanti uma kunjalo kumqoka ukuthi kulungiswe izinto eziningi.

KULINDELEKE ukuthi kungene inzuzo yemali engaphezu kukaR600 million emnothweni wesifundazwe iKwaZulu-Natal ngale mpelasonto ngenxa yomqhudelwano waminyaka yonke iComrades Marathon, ezosuka eMgungundlovu iphothulwe eThekwini, ngeSonto.Lokho kudalulwe wuMnuz Sibusiso Gumbi, isikhulu esiphezulu esibambile ophikweni lwezokuvakasha nezamafilimu, iKwaZulu-Natal Tourism and Film Authority.Uthe isasasa lakulo nyaka, okufakazelwa wukugcwala kwamahhotela aseThekwini nawaseMgungundlovu, kwenza bakholelwe ekutheni nonyaka bazodlula kuR600 millilon wenzuzo abayenze nyakenye, futhi okunye okuhle wukuthi kuzohlomula nenqwaba ngenxa yamathuba emisebenzi awu-18 000 adalekile."Lo mjaho uletha izivakashi eziningi esifundazweni sethu cishe ukwedlula yonke eminye imiqhudelwano yezemidlalo esinayo endaweni yethu. Nathi senze konke okusemandleni ethu ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izivakashi zethu zizojabula futhi zihlabeke umxhwele ngale mpelasonto ngezinto ezehlukene zobumnandi, amabhishi ethu asezingeni elifanele, futhi sihlome ngezindawo ezehlukene zokuzijabulisa,” kusho uGumbi. Imenenja jikelele yeComrades Marathon Association, uMnuz Alain Dalais, ithe balindele ukuthi umqhudelwano wanonyaka ube sezingeni eliphezulu kakhulu kunokujwayekile njengoba kungokokuqala ukuthi uma lo mjaho wehlela eThekwini ungenelwe ngabagijimi abangaphezu kuka-20 000. Nonyaka kungenele abagijimi abangu-22 677. Isibalo esikhulu esike sabakhona uma kwehliwa kwaba wu-19 047 ngo-2018.Nonyaka lo mjaho udonse iso labagijimi abawu-3 063 basemazweni ehlukene."Silindele ukuthi laba bagijimi bakwamanye amazwe beze namalungu emindeni yabo alinganiselwa ku-3 000 ukuzobeseka, bese futhi kuba nabantu abawu-6 000 abazobuka umjaho,” usho kanje.Kuzobe kubekwe iziteshi eziwu-47 zokuthiba iphango endleleni ukusiza abagijimi ukuthi bangabulawa yinkemane nokoma. Okunye okwehlukile nonyaka wukuthi umjaho uzoqala ngezigaba ezimbili; ingxenye yabagijimi bokuqala izoqala ngo-5.45, bese abanye belandela ngo-6 ekuseni ukuqikelela ukuphepha nokugwema ukuminyana nokunyathelana ngoba abagijmi bazobe bebaningi kakhulu, ekubeni endleni kunemigwaqo elungiswayo.Abadle umhlanganiso nyakenye kwabesilisa nabesifane oPiet Wiersma waseNetherlands noGerda Steyn bazobe bekhona nakulokhu, kanti abanye aseke badla umhlanganiso abazobe bencintisana nakulokhu woTete Dijana, Edward Mothibi no-Alexandra Morozova waseRussia.Nosaziwayo bamelelekile njengoba kuzobe kukhona usomahlaya futhi ongumethuli wezinhlelo zethelevishini uSchalk Bezuidenhout ozobe egijima okokuqala kulo mqhudelwano. Umculi wekwaito, uKabelo Mabalane, uzobe egijima ihlandla lika-13 nonyaka.
KUBOSHWE abasolwa ababili mayelana necala lokubulawa komholi we-IFP, uMnuz Khethamabala "KP" Sithole (68), owadutshulwa wabulawa ehostela iBuyafuthi, eKatlehong, eGoli, ngoMgqibelo.Lokhu kuqinisekiswe okhulumela amaphoyisa aseGoli, uLieutenant Colonel Mavela Masondo.Uthe, ngoMsombuluko kuphekwe ngemibuzo abantu abathathu, ababili babo abaneminyaka engu-30 nengu-32 abayamaniswa naleli cala kwathi owesithathu wadedelwa. ULieut Col Masondo uthe laba babekwe icala lokubulala namabili okuzama ukubulala."Kubikwe ukuthi abantu abangaziwa bavulela ngenhlamvu kubantu ababenomhlangano. USithole washonela endaweni yesigameko kanti abanye ababili baphuthunyiswa esibhedlela benamanxeba okudutshulwa," kusho uLieut Col Masondo.Uthe omunye wabalimala welashwa wadedelwa kanti omunye usasesibhedlela. Abasolwa bavele eNkantolo yeMantshi ePalmridge. ULieut Col Masando uthe kulindeleke ukuba kuboshwe abanye abasolwa njengoba uphenyo lwamaphoyisa lusaqhubeka. USithole ubeyilungu lesigungu esiphezulu se-IFP futhi eyiPhini likaSotswebhu weqembu ePhalamende. Uzofihlwa eQhudeni, eNkandla, ngeSonto ngo-9 ekuseni lapho okulindeleke ukuba uMengameli we-IFP, uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa, ethule inkulumo.
KUZOJUTSHWA ithimba labaphenyi bomshoshaphansi abazohlola babheke okwenzeka ezibhedlela zaKwaZulu-Natal, odabeni oluthinta ukushoda kwemithi nezinsizaLokhu kuvezwe nguNdunankulu wesifundazwe uMnuz Thami Ntuli izolo ephendula imibuzo yamalungu esiShayamthetho eMgungundlovu.UNtuli uthe la mathimba asabalele ezibhedlela ezehlukene kanti noMphathiswa wezeMpilo esifundazweni, uNksz Nomagugu Simelane, akawazi. "Ngijube ithimba ukuphenya ngezikhalo zokuthi iyashoda imithi ezibhedlela zesifundazwe. Nami sengike ngagasela kungazelele muntu kwezinye zezikhungo, angitholanga kunenhlekelele yokuthi imithi ayikho," kusho uNtuli.Uthe kukhona ukushoda kwezinye zezinto kodwa akuyona into enkulu noma efinyelele ezingeni lenhlekelele."Ngifuna ukuthola umnyombo wokuthi kungani uma kukhona ukushoda kwemithi. NoNksz Simelane uzivakashele izikhungo wathola umbiko, uzongibikela ngakutholile. Nami ngiyafuna ukwazi lapho kunenkinga khona ukuze ngiziyele mathupha kungazelele muntu, ngiyophenya," kusho uNtuli. UNtuli usho lokhu nje kuke kwaba nokukhala nasezinkundleni zokuxhumana kuthiwa ayikho imithi ezikhungweni zempilo.Abanye abebekhala bebethi kuthi uma befika kuthiwe imithi ethile noma amaphilisi awekho.Ngakwezemfundo uNtuli uvumile ukuthi kunezinselelo ezinkulu ezibhekene nalo mnyango esifundazweni. Uthe ukufunda kuyaqhubeka ezikoleni phezu kokuba kunezinselelo zokushoda kwemali."Uhlelo lokudla ezikoleni aluphazamisekile abafundi bayadla. Siyazilungisa izinselelo ezikhona noMphathiswa walo mnyango, uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka. Sinethemba lokuthi lezi zinkinga zizolunga." Kumanje iSadtu ihudula izinyawo ikhala ngezinto eziningi umnyango ohluleka wukuzenza okubalwa ukungayifaki imali yezikole eyaziwa ngama-norms and standards, esiza ngokuthi kukhokhelwe ugesi namanzi. Le nyunyana isabise ngokuthi uma izinkinga zingalungiswa kusengcupheni ukubhalwa kwezivivinyo ezikoleni.Unxuse amalungu omphakathi nawesiShayamthetho ukuthi afake isandla empini yokulwa nokuhlaselwa kwezikole. "Ngihlela ukuthi ezinye zezinselelo zemali ngizidlulisele ezingeni likazwelonke. Asifuni kube nokuphazamiseka kokufunda nokufundisa ezikoleni zesifundazwe."Odabeni lokugcwala kwezikole uthe kuhanjiswe amakilasi angomahamba nendlwana ukuze kwehliswe umthwalo obhekene nalezi zikole.Uveze ukuthi kunemali engu-R95 million ehlinzekwe uMnyango wezeMfundo ukulungisa izikole ezakhahlanyezwa yizikhukhula.UNtuli ubalule nemali efakiwe ukusiza ezinhlelweni zokutakula abakhahlanyezwa yizikhukhula kulesi sifundazwe.
KUCEKELEKE phansi imijondolo engu-47 kwathi abantu abangu-76, okubalwa nezingane, basala dengwane emva komlilo oshe ubuhanguhangu emijondolo ekuKennedy Road, eThekwini, ngoLwesithathu ebusuku.Ngokusho kukaMasipala weTheku, ingu-49 imindeni ekhahlamezekile okuphoqeleke ukuba itholelwe indawo yokukhosela ehholo lomphakathi eliseduzane.Umkhandlu uthe ngokuhlanganyela neminyango kahulumeni, baphezu kwemizamo yokuthola isisombululo sesikhathi eside. Lishone elayizolo ingekho imibiko yabashonile noma abalimele. Imbangela yomlilo kusolakala ukuthi kube ukuxhunywa kukagesi ngokungemthetho.UMphathiswa woMnyango wokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, ushayele ihlombe abezicishamlilo namaphoyisa ngokusukuma ngokushesha ukulwa nomlilo nokuqinisekisa ukuthi izakhamuzi ziphuma ziphephile.Nokho, umnyango uveze ukuthi bangu-70 abantu abahlengiwe. UButhelezi uthe abakhahlanyezwe umlilo kumele batholelwe usizo lwesikhashana okuhlanganisa ukusekwa ngokushesha nokulekelelwa ukuba bakhe kabusha impilo yabo."Imijondolo yakuKennedy Road ngenye yezindawo eziningi esifundazweni lapho umnyango ufake izinsiza ezixwayisa ngomlilo. Yizona lezi ezibambe iqhaza elikhulu ukuhlenga impilo yabantu ngokusheshe zixwayise izakhamuzi ukuze zikwazi ukuphuma ziphephile," kusho uButhelezi.
KUMSHUBELE uNgqongqoshe weMfundo ePhakeme, uDkt Nobuhle Nkabane, ngendlela aziphathe ngayo ngesikhathi esemhlanganweni wekomiti lalo mnyango ePhalamende, njengoba uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa efuna umbiko ogcwele ngokwenzekile.UDkt Nkabane ugxekwa nxa zonke ngendlela aziphatha ngayo kulo mhlangano obungeledlule, lapho abonakala enxamfuza ushingamu ngesikhathi kuqhubeka umhlangano.Wabonakala ezitika ngokudla ngesikhathi kuqhubeka umhlangano, okwenza amanye amalungu ekomiti amnxusa ukuthi angadli phambi kwesizwe njengoba lo mhlangano wawuvezwa bukhoma ezinhlakeni ezehlukene.La malungu athi kunezitshudeni ezilambile ezingakhokhelwe yisikhwama iNSFAS ezikhungweni ngakho akukuhle ukuthi yena angadla. Okunye agxekwa ngakho yindlela ayephendula ngayo imibuzo ayeyiphonswa ngamalungu ePhalamende mayelana nokuqokwa kosihlalo bama-Seta, agcina ehoxisa ukuqokwa kwabo.Abantu ezinkundleni zokuxhumana babemgxeka ngendlela aziphathe ngayo etshengisa ukungabi nandaba uma ephendula imibuzo.Abanye babethi uma i-ANC iqhubeka ifaka abantu abafana naye ezikhundleni eziphezulu, izoqhubeka ilahlekelwe ukwesekwa ekubeni ivele isenkingeni yokwehlelwa ukwesekwa.Okhulumela uRamaphosa, uMnuz Vincent Magwenya, uthe umengameli ulinde umbiko ogcwele kuDkt Nkabane ngokwenzekile. "Ngeke ngikwazi ukuveza ukuthi umbiko ulindeleke nini kodwa yena kumele awulethe. URamaphosa ulusukumele lolu daba njengoba kube nezikhalazo eziningi ezivela ezinhlakeni ezehlukene ngendlela ababona eziphethe ngayo uDkt Nkabane," kusho uMagwenya.URamaphosa ubuye wadlulisa amazwi endunduzo emndenini kalowo owayengumengameli waseZambia, uMnuz Edgar Lungu, oshone izolo, kuleli, njengoba ebelashelwa esibhedlela esisePitoli.
UKHOMISHANA wamaPhoyisa, uGeneral Fannie Masemola, uwafisele okuhle amaphoyisa azobe eyingxenye yomjaho iComrades Marathon, esuka eMgungundlovu iphelele eThekwini ngeSonto.UMasemola uthe angu-437 amaphoyisa azobe eyingxenye yalo mjaho ka-98."Kulawa maphoyisa angu-66 awesifazane, angu-371 awesilisa. Asuka kuzona zonke izifundazwe kanti azobe eyingxenye yabangu-22 000 abazongenela umjaho." Uthe ukungenela kwamaphoyisa lo mjaho kufakazela into abahlale beyisho yokuwagqugquzela ukuthi ahlale ephilile.'Minyaka yonke siyakhula isibalo samaphoyisa angenela lo mjaho. Nyakenye ayengu-356 ayengenele. Siyawanxusa ukuthi abhebhezelise ifulegi lamaphoyisa." UMasemola uzokhuluma namaphoyisa azoba yingxenye yomjaho kusasa eThekwini.
ABASOLWA bebehamba ngemoto yohlobo lweVW Polo enezinombolo zaseFree State abasolwa abathathu abadutshulwe babulawa amaphoyisa kuN1 phakathi wemigwaqo uRivonia noWinnie Mandela, eGoli.Kuthiwa abasolwa bagqekeze umuzi oseSandton, Okhulumela amapoyisa eGauteng uLt Colonel Mavela Masondo uthi bathole umbiko ngabasolwa abagqekeze umuzi eSandton bathatha impahla kanjalo nemoto yohlobo lweVW Polo ngaphambi kokuthi babaleke ngale moto nenye yohlobo lweToyota okuthiwa bebehamba ngayo."Abasolwa bafe ngesikhathi bedubulana namaphoyisa, ababili bafele emotweni oyedwa wafela emgwaqweni njengoba ubesephumile ezama ukubaleka," kusho yena.Uthi umbiko wokuqala uveza ukuthi imoto ebihamba abasolwa iyathinteka emacaleni amaningi okugqekeza kule ndawo. UMHOLI we-EFF, uMnuz Julius Malema, uthe bazoqhuthana amakhizane noMnuz Floyd Shivambu, uma sebehlangana ePhalamende.UShivambu obengunobhala jikelele weqembu Umkhonto weSizwe, ususwe ngubuholi obuphezulu baleli qembu bamyisa ePhalamende, kulandela ukuphula umthethosisekelo weMK, ngokuhambela eMalawi, evakashele uMfu Shepherd Bushiri, ofunwa ngabomthetho kuleli.UShivambu washiya kwi-EFF eyojoyina iMK emuva kokungabuvuseleli ubulungu bakhe. UMalema uthe akathandi ukukhuluma ngezinto ezithinta uShivambu noma iMK."Angisebenzisani noFloyd, angifuni ukungena ezintweni zakhe. Kodwa wayeyaphi? Akayona inkinga yethu, uma sihlangana ePhalamende sizoqhuthana amakhizane naye," kusho uMalema.Ukusho lokhu ekhuluma nezintatheli emuva kokuyobhonga emswanini emndenini womlingisi oshone ngeledlule, uPresley Chweneyagae ePitoli. UMalema uthe yintsha ephethe ePhalamende manje."Uma uFloyd ecabanga ukuthi uzochitheka asihlakaniphele, simlindile. Ngeke akwazi ukusichithekela ngomqondo ngoba simlindile," usho kanje.Ugxeke nokuthi iMK ihlale ifuna kuhlangane amaqembu abamnyama abe yinto eyodwa. "Kungani ihlale ithi akuhlangane abamnyama kodwa ayiyi kwamanye amaqembu iyoxoxa nawo. I-MK ilokhu ifuna ukuhlangana ne-EFF ngoba bafuna ukusigwinya, okuyinto engeke yenzeke," kusho uMalema.Umholi weMK, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, uhlale eshumayela ivangeli lokuthi amaqembu amnyama abumbane, asebenzisane.
UNdunankulu waseGauteng uPanyaza Lesufi kanye nomphathiswa wezoMgwaqo nezokuThutha uKedibone Diale-Tlabela bathula uhlelo olusha, olusezingeni eliphezulu lwezobuchwepheshe, lokungaphazamiseki nezinombolo zamapuleti esifundazwe.ULesufi uthi izinombolo zomgunyathi nezimoto ezingenazo izincwadi ezifanele yizona zinto ezibhebhethekisa ubugebengu esifundazweni, ikakhulukazi emacaleni okuthumba nokubulala ngoba izigebengu zishintshashintsha amapuleti azo futhi zihamba ngezimoto ezingenawo amaphepha.Uthe lolu hlelo olusha luzosiza iziphathimandla zezomthetho ukulwa nobugebengu obuthinta lolu hlobo lwezimoto.Lesi simemezelo sokwethulwa kulandela ukuhlola kwesifundazwe uhlelo olusha ngezimoto zikahulumeni onyakeni wezimali wezi-2024/25.Uhulumeni wesifundazwe ubengakaze athi vu ngokwethulwa esidlangalaleni kohlelo olusha lwezinombolo zamapuleti kuze kube manje.Lolu hlelo lwesekwa ungqongqoshe wezokuThutha waseNingizimu Afrika u-Barbara Creecy owayalela ukuthi izimoto zikaHulumeni wesiFundazwe saseGauteng zihambisane nemibandela yamanje yezinombolo zamapuleti."Inhloso yohlelo olusha lwezinombolo ze-GP, olunezici zokuphepha ezithuthukisiwe kanye nezinguquko ezihlobene nalo, ukuthuthukisa indlela iziphathi mandla zezomthetho zibona ngazo izimoto nobunikazi bazo ukuze kunciphe ubugebengu," kusho ungqongqoshe.
ONGUMDIDIYELI weHollywood Athletics Club, uLala Cele, ukhuze umkhuba owenziwa ngabanye babaqeqeshi besilisa kwezokugijima nakweminye imidlalo wokubona izintombi ezinganeni zamantombazane abaziqeqeshayo.ULala ongomunye wabagijimi besifazane abagijimela ukuzigcina beyimiqemane (social runners) uzobe ephakathi kwabagijimi abalinganiselwa ku-1 300 abazobe begijimela ukuzigcina beyimiqemane emjahweni waminyaka yonke, iComrades Marathon. IComrades yakulo nyaka yebanga lika-89.98km, izogijinywa kusukwa eMgungundlovu kubhekwe eThekwini, ngeSonto. "Okokuqala nje, bayashoda kakhulu abagijimi besifazane abamnyama kulo mdlalo wethu wezokugijima. Emiphakathini yethu yabamnyama, ikakhulukazi emalokishini nasezindaweni zasemakhaya, sinenselelo yokuthi izingane zamantombazane azinikwa ithuba elanele lokubamba iqhaza kwezemidlalo uma kuqhathaniswa nezinye nezinye izinhlanga."Uthe kunenkolelo yokuthi intombazane uma ibuya esikoleni kufanele ipheke yenze neminye imisebenzi yasendlini, ayicatshangelwa ukuthi kumele ibe nomdlalo ewudlalayo."Kuphinde kube nalabo bazali abanenkolelo yokuthi uma ingane ihamba iyodlala ntambama uma ibuya esikoleni nangezimpelasonto, isuke iye ebafaneni, okuyinto ewadikibalisayo amanye amantombazane,” kusho uLala Cele, osegijime iComrades amahlandla ayisithupha, wayiqeda amahlandla amahlanu. Uthe noma ingane yentombazane isidedeliwe-ke ngabazali ukuthi iyobamba iqhaza emidlalweni, kuphinde kube nenselelo yabaqeqeshi besilisa okuyibona abaqeqesha lezi zingane.Uveze ukuthi bagcina bengaziphathi lezi zingane njengezingane zabo kodwa bagcine bebona izintombi. "Ithi ingane isiqala ukukhombisa ukudlondlobala emdlalweni wayo, uthole ukuthi isikhulelwe, ikhuleliswa nguye lo mqeqeshi. Emva kwalokho, inyamalale ingabe isabuya emdlalweni ebiwenza kahle, bese kuba ukuhamba kwalo njalo ithalente, lona leli eliyindlala elidengekayo labagijimi besifazane neminye imidlalo." Uthe: "Ngakho kungaba kuhle ukuthi nabo abaqeqeshi besilisa kulesi sikhathi samanje, ikakhulukazi kulesi sihlava esidlangile sokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane, ukuthi bakubeke phambili ukuthuthukisa izingane abaziqeqeshayo nokulwela ukubona ukuqhakaza kwekusasa lazo."Uthe akungabi yibona abacekela phansi ikusasa lazo. "Abathathe lezi zingane abaziqeqeshayo njengezingane, imizwa bayibeke eceleni bagxile ekuzilekeleleni zisimame emidlalweni ngoba akuzona zonke izingane ezizophumelela ngemfundo. Ezinye yizona ezizokwenza umehluko emindenini yazo ngokudlala kwazo,” kuqhuba uNksz Cele. ULala Cele usho kanje, zikhona izigameko ezahlukene ezithinta abaqeqeshi besilisa kwezokugijima nakwezikanobhutshuzwayo nakweminye imidlalo, osekuke kwabikwa ngazo kwabezindaba.Muva nje, obengumqeqeshi weMamelodi Sundowns Ladies edlala kwiSafa Hollywoobets Super League, uJerry Tshabalala, umisiwe kuleli qembu ngoDisemba, nyakenye, ngezinsolo zokunukubeza abanye babadlali baleli qembu lebhola labesifazane.
SEKUVELE ukuthi kushaye kwaqeda imali engaphezu kukaR16 million ukulungisa umshini wokugaya izincwadi zokushayela ezweni ohlale ufa njalo. Lokhu kwenza ukuthi kubambezeleke uhlelo lokwenza amakhadi ezincwadi zabashayeli.Lokho kuvele emva kokuthi uMnyango wezokuThutha ezweni umemezle ekuqaleni kwenyanga edlule ukuthi umshini wokugaya amakhadi ezincwadi zokushayela usuyasebenza, kulandela ukuma nse kokusebenza kwawo ngenxa yokufa ngoFebhuwari 5, okwaholela ekutheni kubambezeleke ukugaya amakhadi ezincwadi zokushayela awu-747 748 kuze kuzoba yimanje.Ukuzama ukuphuthumisa ukulungisa umonakalo osudalekile, uhlaka lwezincwadi zokushayela eMnyangweni wezokuThutha lwandise amahora okusebenza ezisebenzini zalo. Lokhu kuvezwe nguNgqongqoshe wezokuThutha uNkk Barbara Creecy, ephendula umbuzo ePhalamende womholi weRise Mzansi, uMnuz Songezo Zibi, obebuze ukuthi kubiza malini ukulungisa lo mshini ofa njalo.UZibi ubuze nokuthi bangaki abasebenzi ababhekele ukwenza umsebenzi wokugaya amakhadi kulo mshini, nokuthi yimalini esikhokhelwe bona ngokusebenza amahora angaphezu kwajwayelekile. Yilapho uNkk Creecy edalule khona ukuthi ngoMeyi 15 abelinganiselwa ku-733 000 amakhadi ezincwadi zokushayela angakagaywa, waphiinde waveza ukuthi kuhambe kanjani futhi kwaba namthelela muni ukuphazamiseka kokusebenza kwalo mshini. Ngonyaka wezimali u-2022/23 ziwu-26 izinsuku ezingasetshenzwanga ngenxa yokufa kwalo mshini, zibe ngu-48 ngo-2023/24, zingu-17 ngo-2024/25 neziwu-38 ngo-2025/26.Kanti imali esetshenziswe ukulungisa lo mshini ngaleyo minyaka kube wuR9,267,862,33 ngo-2022/23, R1,651,772,57 ngoR2023/24, R544,747,64 ngo-2024/25 noR624,988,10 ngo-2025/26.Imali esisetshenziswe ukukhokhela amahora angaphezu kwajwayelekile asetshenzwe ngabasebenzi wuR624,988,10 ngo-2022/23, R1,608,102,52 ngo-2023/24, R1,351,473,78 ngo-2024/25, kanti akukakhokhwa mali kunyakamali ka-2025/26.UNKk Creecy uthe lo mshini usetshenziswa ngabantu abane ngesikhathi esisodwa, nokuthi basohlelweni lokuthi kutholakale umshini omusha wesibili ukusiza ukugwena izimo ezinjena.
SEKUQUBUKE ukukhathazeka kubasebenzi abawu-95 abayitoho lezinyanga eziyisithupha base-University of KwaZulu-Natal, kuphela izinyanga ezinhlanu bengaholile selokhu beqashelwe ukuzofundisa isifundo esisanda kwethulwa kule nyuvesi, iCritical Social Justice ngoJanuwari.Omunye walaba basebenzi ocele ukuthi lingadalulwa igama lakhe exoxa neSolezwe uthe kuze kufika kulesi sigaba abakusona manje, indaba iqale ngoDisemba ngesikhathi inyuvesi ikhipha izikhangiso zomsebenzi wokufundisa lesi sifundo, esiqale ukufundiswa kulesi sikhungo nyakenye, nangempela bafaka izicelo, kwaqala kwasetshenzwa ekuqaleni kwalo nyaka."Siqale ukusebenza ngoMashi, emva kokuqeqeshwa izinyanga ezimbili ukufundisa lesi sifundo, nazo lezo zinyanga ezimbili sasithenjiswe ukuthi sizozikhokhelwa, kodwa kuze kuzoba yimanje lutho ukungena umholo, ngisho owenyanga eyodwa okungenani. "Sasithenjiswe ukuthi sizohola imali ephakathi kuka-R3 500 kuya kuR3 700 njalo ngenyanga ngomsebenzi wokufundisa lesi sifundo kuzona zonhlanu izikhungo zale nyuvesi, kodwa bekuthi uma sekumele sihole, kulokhu kuthiwa asilinde, kwaze kwafika lapho esitshelwa khona ukuthi asisezukuholelwa umholo ophelele wenyanga yonke, kunalokho sebezosiholela ngokwamahora esiwasebenzile, nalapho futhi bakhulumela ukuthi sizoze sihole ekupheleni kwenkontileka ngoJuni," kusho isisebenzi.Siqhuba, sithe bakhathazekile ngokuthi kuze kuphela izinyanga ezinhlanu besebenzela ubala, kuthi nalapho sekukhona ababathembisa khona, kodwa akusekhona okwavunyelwanga ngakho futhi kwasayinwa phansi mhla bezoqala umsebenzi ngoJanuwari."Kuyasidida ukuthi kwenzeka kanjani ukuthi siqashwe, kodwa uma sekumele sikhokhelwe sitshelwe ukuthi imali yokusikhokhela ayikho. Sasiqashwe kanjani uma kuzoba nezinkinga uma sekumele sikhokhelwe? Kwayona le ndlela abasho ngayo yokuthi bazosiholelela amahora esiwasebenzile kuphela, kuzosilimaza kakhulu ngoba kusho ukuthi esikhundleni semali engaphezu kuka-R20 000 okumele siholelwe yona sekuhlangene zonke lezi zinyanga, kuzokwenzeka ukuthi sigcine sithole okungenani o-R7 000 kuphela. Yisenzo esibona singenabo nhlobo ubulungiswa ngoba akuvunyelwananga ngalokho ekuqaleni," sisho kanje. Kuthintwa umqondisi wophiko lwezobudlelwano nokuxhumana e-UKZN, uNksz Normah Zondo, uvumile ukuthi kube nokubambezeleka ngokukhokha umholo wabasebenzi, wathi kudalwe yizingqinamba ezithile - nokho wathembisa ukuthi bazozilungisa ngokushesha."Kumanje silungisa yona le nkinga ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi abathintekayo kule nkinga bakhokhelwa imali yabo ngokushesha, futhi siyathembisa ukuthi bazothola umholo wabo njengoba unjalo. Sizobathinta bonke abathintekayo kulesi simo ukuze kulungiswe izinkinga zabo, futhi siyaxolisa ngakho konke okwenzekile," kusho uNksz Zondo.
SISHAQISE umphakathi isigameko sokubulawa ngesihluku kowesifazane, egwazwa yisoka lakhe eZinketheni, eMgungundlovu, ngeledlule. Kulesi sigameko kushone uNksz Zanele Dumakude (52) kulandela ukugwazwa yisoka lakhe ngento ecijile . Osekomitini lomphakathi, uMnuz Mthandeni Zikhali, ethintwa yiSolezwe uthe bathole ukuthi isigameko senzeke emva kwengxabano ebiphakathi kukamufi nomsolwa. "Esikutholayo wukuthi babezihlalele, beziphuzela njengenjwayelo. Kuthiwa kwasuka ingxabano engatheni, bagcina sebebekana izandla,” kusho uZikhali.Uthe kuvele ukuthi kungemuva kokushayana lapho umsolwa ethole khona isikhali esicijile, wagwaza ngaso umufi entanyeni."Sibona ukuthi umgwaze endaweni embi njengoba umufi wavele washonela endaweni yesigameko,” kusho uZikhali. Uthe akhona amalungu omphakathi agijime eza endaweni yesigameko njengoba kwezwakala ukuthi kunomsindo phakathi kwabo."Ngeshwa afika sekonakele,” usho kanje.Uqhube wathi isoka alizange libaleke emva kwesehlakalo."Kwabizwa amaphoyisa langabaleka, futhi lavuma nokuthi ubulawe yilo,” usho kanje. Uveze ukuthi isoka nomufi bebeyizithandani ezivame ukuziphuzela utshwala ndawonye, futhi baziwa endaweni.Uthe bese benesikhathi eside bethandana, wathi nakuba bekuba khona ukungaboni ngasolinye kwezinye izikhathi, kodwa bekungeze kungafika ekutheni baze babekane izandla. "Asazi ukuthi yini le engaka abayibangile kulokhu kwaze kwaholela ekutheni babekane izandla bese kuphetha ngokuthi owesifazane abulawe ngoba bekungeze kungafika lapho ukuxabana kwabo," kusho uZikhali. Ezinkundleni zokuxhumana kusabalale amahlebezi okuthi umufi uyilungu eliqavile loMkhonto weSizwe nokho ukuchithile uZikhali lokhu."Lawa ngamampunge. Umufi isikibha abonakala esigqokile ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, wayesimukeliswe ngesikhathi kukhankaselwa ukhetho," kusho uZikhali.Imizamo yokuthola indodakazi kamufi, uNksz Lungile Dumakude ayiphumelelanga, ucingo lwayo lukhale, lwangabanjwa. Kanjalo nemizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kwamaphoyisa ayiphumelelanga.
Kubikwa ukuthi kufe kufe umsolwa obehamba abanye begebenga abahlali basemakotishi ngasendlini yamanzi, eMaoti ngoLwesibili ntambama.Kuthiwa amadoda amathathu abehlomile abangena imizi nemizi egebenga abantu impahla yabo, kodwa afike abhajwa emzini wokugcina. Kuthiwa umnikazi ekhaya ulwe nomsolwa oyedwa bebanga izibhamu, ngeshwa badubuleka bobabili.Ngokusho kwabeReaction Unit South Africa (RUSA), umsolwa uzamile ukubaleka kodwa waqulekela esangweni."Siphuthume kule ndawo ngemuva kokuthola umbiko wokuduthsulwa kwabantu. Umgilwa ubelimele kabi, ulashelwe endaweni yesehlo sawe ephuthunyiswa esibhedlela. Umsolwa odubuleke ekhanda wafela khona esangweni," kusho abeRUSA.Kuthiwa ngesikhathi eselele phansi ngasesangweni umuzi, abangani bakhe bathathe isibhamu sakhe, bacela empunzini. [email protected]
BAVUKE umbhejazane abazali baseCelubuhle Primary, eFolweni, kulandela ukuzwa amazwi okuthiwa akhishwe nguthishomkhulu walesi sikole kumzali kamgilwa okuvela ukuthi "udlwengulwe uthisha ngaphakathi ekilasini".Ngokuthola kweSolezwe, isigameko sokudlwengulwa komfundi oneminyaka engu-11, ofunda uGrade 5, kulesi sikole, senzeke ngenyanga edlule.Unina kamgilwa, ongeke adalulwe ukuvikela isithunzi sikamgilwa, uthe yena uthole ngesigameko ngoMeyi 25, 2025, kulandela ukubizwa kwakhe ngohlola izintombi endaweni. "Indodakazi yayikade iyohlolwa ngayizolo. Ugogo obahlolayo wangibizela kwakhe ngakusasa, lapho wangitshela khona ukuthi indodakazi ayisaphelele,” kusho umzali.Uthe umgilwa wehlulekile ukugonyuluka ngesehlakalo kuyena (umzali) nakulabo abahlolayo. "Ubevele akhale uma ebuzwa ukuthi woniwe ngubani. Kuphele eside isikhathi encengwa ukuthi akhulume, waze wagcina egonyuluka kudadewabo ekhaya,” kusho umzali. Uthe utshele udadewabo ukuthi isehlakalo senzeka ngosuku yena nomunye umfundi ababejutshwe ngalo wumsolwa ukuthi abasale bahlanze ikilasi."Kuthiwa wabe eseyalela le enye ingane ukuthi ishanele uphawini wayo kuqala bese iyahamba. Kuthiwa eyami yasala yashanela yodwa, yathi isiqedile, uthisha wangena wavala umnyango,” kusho umzali.Uthe wabe eseyiyalela ukuthi igibele phezu kwetafula, wayikhumula wayidlwengula. Kuvela ukuthi wayidonsa ngendlebe ukuthi uma ike yasho uzoyibulala, ayigqibe. Uveza ukuthi esetholile ukuthi inukubeziwe, waya eshibhedlela, odokotela bakuqinisekisa lokho, wase eyovula icala esiteshini samaphoyisa eFolweni. Uthe bathe uma sebeya esikoleni ngoLwesibili ngalolu daba nomseshi, uthishomkhulu, owayekhombisa ukwethuka, wabakhulumela "insumansumane". "Wasibuza ukuthi ayikho yini enye indlela okungenziwa ngayo, wathi usecabangela ithunzi sakhe nesesikole,” kusho umzali.Uthe wakhala ngokuthi lolu daba sekuzofanele alubike kubaphathi bakhe, nokho umphenyi okuthiwa wayengenasikhathi, wamtshela emakhaleni uthishomkhulu ukuthi uzohamba naye umsolwa ngaso leso sikhathi. "Yile nkulumo, engabona sengathi ivikela uthisha eyenza ngaphuma esikoleni, udaba ngalubeka ezithebeni zomphakathi, wavele wavuka umbhejazana,” kulandisa umzali. Isolezwe lithole ngomunye umthombo walo ukuthi uthisha wamiswa esikoleni emhlanganweni owawuvalelekile, wathi nokho lolu lwazi belungakalethwa ngendlela efanele kubazali njengoba aboMnyango wezeMfundo bengazange balubhade emhlanganweni wabazali obungoLwesithathu. "Abezanga futhi ababekanga sizathu. Kwakhona lokhu kubadinile abazali, babona sengathi umnyango awuluthatheli phezulu lolu daba njengoba wenzile eSibusisiwe (eMbumbulu), isikole sehlelwe okufanayo,” kusho umthombo.Uveze ukuthi sekuqubuke izinsolo zokuthi uthisha ubengaqali ukudlwengula umfundi njengoba sekukhona abafundi asebefunda uGrade 12 kwesinye isikole esiseduze, abathe babonga ukuthi okukamgilwa wamanje kube nenhlanhla yokuvela. "Okusho ukuthi kade aqala edlwengula izingane uma ezinye zazo sezifunda uGrade 12 esikoleni samabanga aphezulu,” kusho umthombo. NgoLwesihlanu, kuthiwa kwakukhona inkeshezana (10%) yezingane esikoleni.Khonamanjalo: Wesulile ekufundiseni uthisha wasesikoleni iSibusisiwe Comprehensive, eMbumbulu, kulandela isigameko sokusolwa ngokudlwengula umfundi (16).Ngokusho komthombo weSolezwe, isigameko senzeka lapho okupaka khona izimoto zothisha. "Kuthe uma sekuvela ngesigameko, isikole sameluleka ngokuthi akavele esule ekufundiseni, nebala wesula ngoLwesine,” kusho umthombo, oveze ukuthi uze waboshwa kwakhe eShowe umsolwa, njengoba ebese ekhale wemuka esikoleni nalapho abeqashe khona. KUWUJABULISILE umndeni okwenzeka ecaleni lowesifazane waKwaMame, oLundi, okusolwa ukuthi wabulawa ngesihluku yisoka emijondolo yasemgwaqweni uCoedmore eSeaview, eThekwini ekuqaleni konyaka odlule.Isidumbu sikaNksz Nonhlanhla Nene (39) sambiwa egodini elingashoni ehhokweni lezinkukhu elikule mijondolo, kulandela ukuthi uMnuz Mandla Zuma, ongowokudabuka eNkandla, eshaywe wumphakathi waze wagonyuluka ukuthi umbulele.Umfowabo kamufi, naye ohlala kuyo le mijondolo, uMnuz Sfiso Nhleko eyilanda emumva uthe, udadewabo babegcine ukumbona ephila ngoDisemba 22, 2023, ehamba nomsolwa. Uthe kwenzeka okungajwayelekile, udadewabo owayekade ehlala naye phambilini, kodwa wathutha wayohlala nomsolwa emva kokuqala komjolo wabo ngo-2023, engaqhamuki ngoKhisimusi (Disemba 25, 2023)."Ngambuza uZuma ukuthi uphi udadewethu, wangitshela izinto ezahlukene. Wafike wathi akamazi ukuthi uphi, wabuye wathi uhambe wayohlala eClairwood nowokufika asethandana naye,” kusho uNhleko.Uthe emva kokuhamba kwamasonto bengezwa lutho kudadewabo, umphakathi waqoqana, wathi ukuxoxaxoxa noZuma, wagcina egonyuluka ngokumbulala nokumgqiba ehhokweni. "Kwalekelela nokuthi indodakazi (12) kadadewethu, angayizali uZuma, ithole isibindi isibona sekungenelele umphakathi. Yasho ukuthi usingababa wayo owabulala unina phambi kwayo maqede wayisabisa ngokuthi uma ike yatshela abantu, uzoyibulala, bese ebulala nathi singomalume bayo,” kusho uNhleko.Uveze ukuthi indodakazi yaze yalanda izikhali ayezisebenzisa, ezatholakala zisenegazi, okwathi uma bembuza ngalo, wathi elofishi, abadobayo.Uthe kwavela ukuthi uZuma wambulala ngokumklinya ngentambo udadewabo waze wafa. Kuthiwa wabe esemgwaza ngezikhali ezehlukene, emkhipha izitho zomzimba zangaphakathi. Uthe kwavela nokuthi indodakazi kadadewabo wayeyidlwengula ephindelela, kusaphila unina."Kuthiwa umbulala nje, babebanga khona lokho, udadewethu embuza ukuthi ubenzelani ubulwane obungaka,” kusho uNhleko.Uthe okuke kwabadida wukuthi icala akukho okutheni obekuqhubeka ngalo.Nokho kuthe ngoMsombuluko odlule, ngesikhathi libuyela enkantolo, laqala ukuqulwa, umshana wakhe wethula ubufakazi. "Ubethule izinsuku ezimbili. Lase lihlehliselwa uJuni 20 kuwo lo nyaka lapho okuzofakaza khona mina, iphoyisa elafika endaweni yesigameko nosonhlalakahle,” kusho uNhleko.Uthe: "Lo mnyakazo uyasithokozisa ngoba bese kuphele isikhathi eside kungenzeki lutho. Bese size sizibuze ukuthi kanti yini eshodayo ngoba uZuma wazivumela yena ukuthi uye obulele udadewethu, kwavela nezikhali ayezisebenzisa ngesikhathi enza lokhu, waze wakhomba ngisho nalapho emgqibe khona. Sasesidideka ukuthi kanti kwenzekani,” kusho uNhleko.Uchaze uZuma njengomuntu owayemhlukumeza udadewabo esikhathini esingaphansi konyaka abasithandana. Uthe waze wamtshela udadewabo ukuthi akamyeke ngoba ukhombisa izimpawu zodlame, kodwa kwaba nhlanga zimuka nomoya ngoba wayemthanda.
ABANGABAZI ukuthi uxhaso lwe-Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics (STEM) lab olunikelwe yiSouth African Muslim Charitable Trust (SAMCT), ngokucelwa yilungu lePhalamende ezingeni likazwelonke, uMnuz Imraan Subratie, esikoleni iClarence Primary eGreyville, eThekwini, luzohamba ibanga elide ekusizeni abafundi ngezithinta ezobuchwepheshe. Lolu xhaso lwegumbi elinama-khompyutha angu-40 nobunye ubuxhakaxhaka be-technology okudle u- R900 000, livulwe ngokusemthethweni izolo kulesi sikole.Uthishanhloko wesikole, uMnuz Bheki Shandu, uthe luzoba wusizo esifundweni iCoding and Robotics, esenziwa ngezindlela ezimbili ezehlukene kusuka kwaGrade R kuya kuGrade 7. Uveze ukuthi iningi lezingane ezifunda kulesi sikole zivela ezindaweni zasemakhaya kanjalo nasemalokishini ngenhloso yokuthola imfundo engcono."Uxhaso olufana nalolu lulekelela ukuthi luvale igebe elikhona phakathi kwabantulayo nabadla izambane likapondo. Igebe likhulu kakhulu njengoba kusuka kudala, izindawo zasemakhaya zingathuthuki, kusho uShandu. Uthe: "Manje uma abazali bethuma izingane zabo ezikoleni ezifana neClarence, abanikela ngoxhaso kufanele bazi ukuthi uxhaso lwabo luhamba ibanga elide ngoba kuhlomula izingane zasemalokishini nasemakhaya,” kusho uShandu. Uthe uxhaso lufike endaweni ekahle kakhulu njengoba bekholelwa ukuthi ubuxhakaxhaka bamakhompuyutha ne-technology, kufanele buqale ukufundwa emazingeni aphansi."Kuzoba lula noma sebeya ezikoleni ezinamabanga athe thuthu kanjalo naphakeme ngoba bazobe sebenalo ulwazi lokuthi busebenza kanjani,” kusho uShandu.Uthe abantwana abafunda ngobuxhakaxhaka babasethubeni lokukhetha noma yiziphi izifundo uma befika emanyuvesi. Uthe uxhaso olufana nalolu luwukuthuthuka komphakathi okuzodala amathuba omsebenzi eminyakeni eminingi ezayo, bese kunciphisa ubugebengu.Oyilungu lebhodi leSAMCT, uMnuz Chohan, uthe uxhaso lwabo lungukutshala kubaphathi bezwe bakusasa. "Ikusasa eliqhakazile ngelalabo abanemiqondo ecijiwe. ICoding and Robotics iyithuluzi lokucabanga, ukucija amakhono kusetshenziswa i-technology okulekelela ekuxazululweni kwezinkinga. Ukuze sikwazi ukubhekana nezinkinga zamanje, sidinga ubuxhakaxhaka be-technology,” kusho uChohan. USubratie uthe akungatshazwa ukuthi uxhaso lweSAMCT luzoletha uguquko oludingekayo kulesi sikhathi samanje esifuna abantu babe nolwazi bezobuchwepheshe. "I-4th IR akuyona into ekude nathi, yinto esifikile. Kufanele siqinisekise ukuthi sibeka isisekelo esiqinile. Ukufundiswa kwabo besebancane isayensi, kuzosiza ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sebekwazi ukuxazulula izinkinga besebenzisa i-technology,” kusho uSubratie. Uthe akulona iqiniso ukuthi i-Artificial intelligence (AI) izoqeda ngemisebenzi, wathi kunalokho, izovula amathuba. "Abasunguli bezinto ezehlukene bakhona la, i-lab yenu iyinkundla yenu yokudlala, qinisekisani ukuthi niyafunda, nifundisise. Nochwepheshe abakhona, nabo baqala bengazi lutho. Fundani, lokho kuyonisiza noma senikhetha imikhakha enifuna ukuyilandela,” kusho uSubratie.Umfundi kaGrade 7, u-Azande Zondo (13), uthe uxhaso lubajabulise kakhulu."Kuyinto enhle kithina. Ngelinye ilanga sobe sesixoxa ukuthi thina sayifunda i-technology esikoleni sethu,” kusho u-Azande.Kwabanye abaveze ukuthi balwamukela ngezandla zombili uxhaso kube wumqondisi wesifunda uMlaza kwezemfundo, uNkk Busi Mahlambi.
IDIDEKILE imindeni yezithandani zaKwaMangethe, eMandeni okuthe ngoMgqibelo zatholakala zidutshuliwe emzini obekuhlala kuwona owesifazane obengunobhala esiteshini samaphoyisa saseMandeni.UMnuz Nkomo (igama elingatholakalanga) kuthiwa kwembulwa kwembeswa kuyena esibhedlela njengoba edubuleke kabi kanti uNksz Cebi (Isolezwe eligcine lingayitholanga imininingwane egcwele ngaye) kuthiwa utholakale eseshonile.Imindeni yabo yomibili kuthiwa isithembe ukuthi asinde uNkomo ukuze kube uyena ozobatshela ukuthi bekwenzenjani. Akucaci ukuthi badutshuliwe yini noma phakathi kwabo kukhona owenze lesi sigameko.Umthombo weSolezwe osondelene nemindeni yomibili uveze ukuthi owesifazane ubehlala yedwa phakathi nesonto njengoba uNkomo ubesebenza ePort Shepstone abuye uma kuyimpelasonto kuphela."Ngesikhathi betholakala isimo sibe sibi kakhulu emindenini yomibili njengoba bebengahlali namuntu bekuyibona bobabili nje. Okubuhlungu wukuthi akwaziwa ukuthi yini eholele kulesi simo ngoba akekho nowazi nangezingxabano ebekungenzeka ukuthi zikhona phakathi kwabo," kusho umthombo.Uveze ukuthi ngisho emphakathini abantu bathukile ngemuva kokuzwakala kwalolu daba. Abezimo eziphuthumayo bakwa-IPSS Medical Rescue okuyibona abafike kuqala endaweni yesigameko bathe babafice belele phansi egunjini lokulala, nokuyilapho bezame khona ukuphephisa owesilisa ogcine ephuthunyiswa esibhedlela ngendiza enophephela emhlane.Bathe ngokolwazi nabo abalutholile akucaci noma oyedwa kubo owenze lesi sigameko noma kukhona ababahlasele.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, usiqinisekisile lesi sigameko wathi amaphoyisa aphenya icala lokubulala."Imbangela yokudutshulwa kwabo ayikaziwa okwamanje kodwa kusolakala ukuthi isondelene nokuhlukumezeka othandweni njengoba eduzane kowesilisa kutholakale isibhamu," kuchaza yena.
UHLOSE ukubuyisa ithemba kubantu abehlukene umsakazi wesiteshi somphakathi ngezinkonzo azenzayo ezihlanganisa abamabandla ehlukene.Loyo uSiphelele Myeni ogumsakazi wesiteshi somphakathi saseNdwedwe iSiyathuthuka FM. Lokhu ukusho ngemuva kokuba kade kunendumezulu yenkonzo yamabandla ehlukene ebikade iqhutshwa oThongathi eHambanathi. Uhlelo lwakhe lungena ngamaSonto kusukela ngehora lesithupha kuze kubumbane ihora leshishiyagolounye. ''Abantu abaningi baphelelwe yithemba lokhu kudalwa yizinto eziningi kakhulu abazithola bebhekana nazo endleleni. Lezi zinkonzo sifuna ukusebenzisa zona kanye ukubakhuthaza nokubuyisa ithemba kubona ukuze bazi ukuthi uNkulunkulu ukhona futhi akasoze abalahla noma ngabe babhekene nasiphi isimo kweyabo impilo,'' usho kanjena.Uthe yingakho besebenzisana nabefundisi bamahlelo ehlukene ngoba bahlose ukuthi kukhulekwe ndawonye kungabhekwa ukuthi omunye ukhonza kwelinye ibandla.
