Le nkonzo beyethiwe elokuthi : UnguJehova Ongajiki Conference. Phakathi kwabebeseke le nkonzo kubalwa aboSizwelwethu Funerals,neHambathi Barriel Services kanye nabeMZ Lodge.
UKUKHATHAZWA wukubona kwanda izigameko zokuhlukumezana kwabantu othandweni nomthelela omubi okuba nakho ebantwini jikelele, kwenze insizwa yakwa-J eMlaza yazihlupha ngokuthi yini engayenza ukukhuza isihlava.Uqale kanjalo umcabango wama-video anoteku kodwa adlulisa umyalezo wokukhuza leso simo kwabathandayo kuMnuz Zaninazo Cele, osedume ngelikaZanny Official ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, osekwenze waba nabalandeli abangaphezu kuka-292 000 kwiTikTok, futhi asebukwe izikhawu ezingaphezu kuka-5.2 million.Engxoxweni neSolezwe, uCele ozinze eGeorge, eWestern Cape ngokomsebenzi, uthe i-video yakhe yokuqala wayenza ngo-2023 okwathi eseyifake ezinkundleni zokuxhumana yabukwa ngabantu abangaphezu kuka-500 000, okwamkhuthaza ukuba aqhubeke enze amanye. "Bekungikhathaza ukubona abantu behlukumezana elokishini egameni lokuthi bayathandana, kungikhathaza nokuthi okunye kwalokho kuhlukumezana kwenzeka phambi kwezingane, zikhule zibona isithombe esibi sento eyenziwa ngabantu abadala. Ngathi uma ngicabanga, ngabona ukuthi mhlawumbe lokhu kungenza umehluko wokuthi kufake umoya wokwenza izinto kangcono kunokwenzeka ngayo manje ngokuthi ngisebenzise ama-video azokudoba ngokuthi anoteku namhlaya lapha nalaphaya, kodwa futhi uma ulalelisisa uzwe ukuthi kunomyalezo omqoka kuwona." kulanda uCele. Leli bhungu, elivame ukusho itemu elithi "Anginamathoyizi angidlali lana" kuma-video alo, lithe liyakuqonda ukuthi akuwona wonke umuntu ozothanda into eliyenzayo, kepha futhi ligculisekile ngokuthi baningi abantu ababonakala bewuthakasela umsebenzi eliwenzayo."Baningi kakhulu abangincomayo usuku nosuku, bengikhuthaza ukuthi ngiqhubeke ngenze lama video engiwenzayo, okwenza ngibe nentshisekelo yokuthi ngiqhubeke ngikhuze izinto ezimbi engizibona zenziwa ngabantu ebantwini abathandana nabo. Into engifuna icace wukuthi udlame aluzilungisi izinto, kepha wukubonisana okusizayo - nokuthi uma sekucaca ukuthi anisavumelani, nihlukane ngokuthula," kusho leli bhungu eliwumculi we-Afro pop.
UTHI usuyekela kuhulumeni ukuba ungcwabe ilungu lawo umndeni wowesilisa waKwaDabeka okusolwa ukuthi wadutshulwa wabulawa ngoba engufakazi woMbuso ecaleni lokubulala.Phezu kwalokhu, umndeni kamufi, uMbuso Mkhize (42), ususekubhaceni ngenxa yokusongelwa ngokubulawa yizinkabi. Lo mndeni usunqume ukuthi ungalifihli ithambo lawo ngakho ukwesaba ukubulawa. Umfowabo kaMbuso omncane, uNhlanhla Mbatha, utshele Isolezwe Ngempelasonto ukuthi batshelwa amaphoyisa ukuthi isidumbu sikamnewabo asithola emathuneni aKwaDabeka mhla ka- 8 Mashi kulo nyaka sinenxeba lokudutshulwa ekhanda. Kuyimanje sisaduve emakhazeni kahulumeni ePinetown. Uthe umfowabo wanyamalala mhla ka-7 Mashi ekwamngani wakhe khona KwaDabeka. Ngokusho kwakhe, umfowabo wabulawelwa ukuthi wayengufakazi ecaleni lokubulawa kukamakhelwane kamsolwa. "Ngesikhathi ubhuti (uMbuso) esejele eboshiwe kwafika umuntu amaziyo naye owayeboshiwe okuthe uma embuza ukuthi ubekwa yini ejele wamtshela ukuthi uboshelwe ukubulala umakhelwane wakhe. Wachaza konke kuyena nokuthi leli cala walenza nobani," kusho uNhlanhla. Uthe esephuma ejele umfowabo waya emaphoyiseni wenza nesitatimendeni nokuthi uzoba ufakazi. UNhlanhla uthe ngoMashi 7 icala lizongena ngakusasa, umfowabo wathunjwa abafana ababili abaqale bafika kubo bemfuna kodwa bangamthola watholakala ngakusasa esebulewe. Uthe ngoMashi 10 babika emaphoyiseni ngokunyamalala kukamfowabo kwathi emva kwezinsuku ezimbili wabona enkundleni yokuxhumana uFacebook kufakwe isithombe sakhe eseshonile kuthiwa omaziyo akaxhumane nephoyisa lasesiteshini KwaDabeka. Uqhube wathi esekubonile lokho wahamba nogogo wakhe oneminyaka engu-65 beyokhomba isidumbu kwathi uma befika emakhazeni bephethe ikhophi kamazisi kamufi batshelwa ukuthi ngeke usetshenziswe kufuneka wona uqobo okuyinto ayengenayo.UNhlanhla uthe amaphoyisa athi azothatha izithupha zikamufi ukumhlonza nakho okwagcina kungaphumelelanga ngoba kwathiwa azisacacile kwazise isidumbu sakhe bese sihlale isikhathi eside emakhazeni. Uqhube wathi ngoLwesithathu, kuleli sonto, kufike ekhaya lakhe iphoyisa liyothatha amathe kagogo wakhe ukuze kwenziwe ulibofuzo. "Akuphelanga isikhathi esingakanani iphoyisa lihambile kwangena kimina ucingo luvela kowesilisa obezwakala ekhulile futhi enesizotha ozibize ngenkabi ethengiwe ukuba isibulale nomndeni wami ngoba sisaqhubeka nendaba yecala umfowethu abengufakazi kulo," kusho uNhlanhla. Uthe obemshayele uzisholo yena ukuthi uyinkabi futhi usekhokhelwe ukuba aqede ngomndeni wakhe. "Uthe ukuze angasibulali asimkhokhele imali angasidalulanga isamba kodwa wathi ilingana nasekhokhelwe yona ukuba asibulale. Okuxakayo wukuthi lo muntu wazi konke ngami nezindawo engike ngaya kuzo okukhomba ukuthi uyangilandela," kusho uNhlanhla. Uthe emva kokuthola lolu cingo banqume ukubaleka baye ekubhaceni. "Ngifuna kwaziwe, kwazi nalabo abafuna ukusibulala ukuthi sesikuyekile nokufuna isidumbu sikamfowethu, sesiyekela kuhulumeni ukuba umngcwabe ukuvikela impilo yethu." Uthe okumkhathaza kakhulu wukuthi abahlangene nezinto ebezenziwa wumfowabo ngisho nokuthi ubesengufakazi ecaleni lokubulala abahlangene nakho futhi abazi nokuthi ubezofakaza athini. "Sinqume ukuthi sivele siyeke ukufuna isidumbu sikamfowethu, useyongcwatshwa wuhulumeni. Sengizovikela umkhulu nogogo ngoba ngeke abantu abadala bafele izinkinga zezingane abangahlangene nazo," kusho uNhlanhla oveze ukuthi uMbuso wumfowabo abesesele naye bakhuliswa wugogo nomkhulu (69) ababathatha njengonina noyise. Uthe njengoba icala umfowabo abengufakazi kulo libuyela enkantolo ngoJulayi, abazi noma bazobe besaphila yini ngoba kuyacaca ukuthi izinkabi zifuna ukuqeda ngofakazi nabantu abasondelene nabo. "Kungcono bazi ukuthi ufakazi kuleli cala akasekho futhi uzongcwatshwa wuhulumeni ukuze nathi sikhululeke nakuba kubuhlungu ukuthi ngeke sikwazi ukungcwaba umfowethu," kubalisa yena. UNhlanhla uthe abawabikelanga amaphoyisa ngokusongelwa ngokubulawa ngoba abasawathembi kwazise njalo uma beke baxhumana nawo balandelwa yizinkabi.
LIGQUGQUZELWE ukudlula emhlabeni kukamshana walo ngo-2023, indela elithathe amehlo abaningi lithweswa iziqu eDurban University of Technology (DUT) ngoLwesithathu. INdela, uLethiwe Mazibuko (55), ebeliphekezelwa amanye asemancane amathathu eliwakhulisayo, lingene emcimbini obubanjelwe e-Olive Convention Centre, eThekwini, lidlubhe izevatho zobusistela, kwachazeka abebewuhambele. ULethiwe waseMnambithi, othe ugqugquzelwe ukudlula emhlabeni kukamshana wakhe ukuba aqhubeke nezifundo zakhe, uthweswe iziqu zeDegree of Master of Management Sciences kanti ugxile kwiPublic Administration. Uphinde abe neDiploma in Office Administration neBachelor of Arts in Psychology. Uqale ukufundela iziqu asanda kuzizuza ngo-2020, wenza ucwaningo ngemfundo yamasiko axubile njengeqhingasu loxolo ezikoleni. Uthe uhambo lwakhe ukuze azuze lezi ziqu belungelula njengoba ebehlanganisa imisebenzi yesonto nezifundo zakhe. Ngokusho kwakhe, lolu hambo lwaphazanyiswa ukubheduka koKhuvethe nokubhekana namalungu omndeni wakhe ayesehaqekile. "Ngangehluleka ukugxila ezifundweni zami, ngangingaphansi kwengcindezi enkulu. Kwangithatha isikhathi ukuba ngivuke ngizithathe," kulandisa uLethiwe. Uthe ngo-2023, wagqugquzeleka ukuba abuyele ezifundweni zakhe emva kokushona ngokuzuma kukamshana wakhe ngoJuni 26, ngo-2023. "Ucwaningo lwami ngalwenzela yena ngoba kwangigqugquzela ukuthi ngibe nempilo ende nethuba lokufunda. Ngakwenzela yena," kusho leli Ndela eliyilungu leDominican Sisters of Montebello liphinde libe yiRegistrar weSt. Joseph Theological Institute. Lithe njengoba umshana walo wayeneziqu zemfundo kodwa engasebenzi kepha ngosuku ashona ngalo, bathola ucingo olwaluvela komunye womasipala umunika umsebenzi. "Kwakuyisikhathi esibuhlungu kumina kodwa sangigqugquzela ukuqhubeka nocwaningo lwami ngoba ngangifuna ukufeza engikuhlosile," esho.Ukholwa ukuthi umuntu ngeke alishumayela izwi likaNkulunkulu engahlonyisiwe ngolwazi futhi engenawo umqondo ovulekile ukusebenza nabantu. Echaza ngempilo yakhe, uthe waqala ukuba yindela esanda kuphothula u-matric, njengoba eseneminyaka engu-35 kulo msebenzi.Uveze ukuthi okwamenza ukuba akhethe indlela yobundela ukugqugquzelwa wuthando lokusiza abantu nokwenza umehluko empilweni yabo. Nokho, uthe abazali bakhe babe ngayizwa eyobundela njengoba babefuna ukuba aye enyuvesi kodwa ekugcineni bamukela futhi bameseka. Uthe: "Ngikhule ngaphansi kwamaRoma aKhatholika. Abazali bami babengafundile kodwa babe nothando lwemfundo. Babe sebenza ngokuzikhandla futhi babefuna ukuba sifunde."Kwabo, uthe bayisikhombisa, yena ungowesithathu.Uthe yena nezingane zakwabo bazama ukufezekisa izifiso zabazali babo njengoba umfowabo omncane engudokotela, udadewabo ungunesi kanti omunye umfowabo enguthisha. ULethiwe uthe kumphathe kabi ukuthi unina oshone ngoDisemba 2024, ubengekho ukuchitha lo mzuzu obalulekile naye. Leli ndela lihlela ukuqhuba izifundo zalo lize libe udokotela wemfundo liqhubeke nothando lokulapha impilo yabantu.Lihalalisela uLethiwe, iNdela u-Assampta Msiya (25), lithe uhlale ebagqugquzela ukuba bafunde. Lithe ukubona uLethiwe ethweswa iziqu kuligqugquzele ukuba liqhubeke lisebenze kanzima ukuze lithole iziqu zalo zeBachelor of Arts in Theology njengoba lenza unyaka wesithathu.

UQWEQWE lommeli u-Advocate Muzi Sikhakhane SC, luthi kuyishwa ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika isemgodini omnyama futhi oshonayo kodwa kayiboni yona iwubiza ngokuthi yinkululeko. USikhakhane ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi enenkulumo neSolezwe, ngencwadi yakhe ayibhalile esihloko sithi:"Odyssey of Liberation.''Ngale ncwadi uSikhakhane uthe uzama ukuba nengxoxo nabantu abamnyama bakuleli abavuse emaqandeni ukuze babone ukuthi lokhu okubizwa ngokuthi yinkululeko, yinto engekho kodwa iningi elicabanga ukuthi yinto ephilayo.Ngokusho kwakhe kungaba wubudedengu obukhulu uma kungase kuvunyelwane ngokuthi iNingizimu Afrika ikhululekile ekubeni kusekhona izinto eziveza ngokusobala ukuthi yiphupho nje ukuthi leli zwe likhululekile. ''Angikwenzele isibonelo nje sithi sikhululekile kodwa sihlulwa yidlanzana labelungu abakhona kuleli zwe. Thina phela sicishe sifinyelele ku-60 million, kodwa sonke sincike ebelungwini abangu-5 million. Yini nje leyo,'' kubuza uSikhakhane.Lokhu uthe kuwuphawu olusobala lokuthi iNingizimu Afrika isemgodini oshonayo omnyama kodwa yona ecabanga ukuthi uyinto enhle. Uyamanise ingwadla ebhekene neNingizimu Afrika nohambo olude lwabantwana bakwa-Israel, abahamba iminyaka engu-40.Uthe bangcono nabo ngoba ekugcineni waqhamuka uJoshua wabatakula sekuvalwe amehlo. ''Inkinga ekhona kule Ningizimu Afrika wukuthi asinaye nje nhlobo uJoshua ongasitakula. Kodwa sinabantu abasondelene nabelungu ngoba kukhona abakuzuzayo ebese becabanga ukuthi kukhona abakuzuzayo kanti bamane banikwa imvuthuluka nje,'' usho kanje.Ukhale ngengqondo yomuntu omnyama wathi akazi ukuthi ingaguqulwa kanjani ayeke ukwesaba umlungu. Uthe kubuhlungu ngoba abantu abamnyama bachitha isikhathi sonke bencenga abelungu futhi bazama ngakho konke okusemandleni ukuchazela abelungu ngezinto abazenzayo.Uyihlabe wayihlikiza indaba yokuthi uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, uhambele eWhite House eMelika, wathi lokhu kuwuphawu olusobala lokuthi abantu abamnyama bazibona bengelutho kangakanani ngaphandle kwabelungu. ''Ibe buhlungu kabi leya nto ukubona umengameli wethu efana nomfana omncane ofunda isikole, echazela umlungu ngezinto zaseNingizimu Afrika ezingamdingi,'' usho kanje.Uthi ngale ncwadi uzama ukuqala ingxoxo eshubile futhi ebalulekile phakathi kwabantu abamnyama mayelana nalokhu abacabanga ukuthi yinkululeko ekubeni kungesiyona.''Usho kanjani ukuthi sikhululekile kusenabantu abangenawo amanzi nogesi ngo-2025. Usho kanjani ukuthi sikhululekile kusanezikole ezingenawo ngisho amathoyilethi, ezinye zinamathoyilethi adilikayo?'' kubuza uSikhakhane. Uthe iqiniso wukuthi le nkululeko abaningi abacabanga ukuthi sebeyithintile ngezandla zabo, basakude kabi nayo kunalokho bamane bahubha utalagu nje, into abangeke baze bayifice ngisho sebethanda.Uqhube wathi ngisho nakwamanye amabandla kuhlonishwa kakhulu abelungu kunabantu abamnyama.''Kubi, konakale abantu bakithi bafundiswe ukuthi okwabo akungcono uma kuqhathaniswa nokwabelungu. Sifundiswe ukuthi kungcono ukuba wuPatrick kunokuba wuThemba,'' usho kanje. Uveze ukuthi incwadi yakhe iqale ingamakhasi angu-800, kodwa wayinciphisa yagcina isiba ngamakhasi angu-498. Uthe kwakhona nje ukuthi le ncwadi uyibhale ngesilungu kuwuphawu lokuthi naye ucabanga ukuthi isilungu singcono kunesiZulu.Ubalule ukuthi yingakho nje ezoqala phansi ayibhale nangesiZulu. Uveze ukuthi usanda kuhlonishwa yinyuvesi yaseZululand, edume ngokuthi isoNgoye ngeziqu zobudokotela. Ngokuzalwa ungowaseBulwer.Esephetha ukhale ngabaholi athe abekho bona eNingizimu Afrika wathi yingakho kulukhuni satshe ukuba izwe liwelele ezweni lesethembiso ngoba akekho ongama athi yena angalithatha aliwelisele khona. Abafisa ukuthola le ncwadi uthe iyatholakala Exclusive Books.
BAGCWALE amahlathi abokufika abasebenza kwenye yamafemu eStanger, kugasela amaphoyisa, uNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal nabaseMnyangweni wezaseKhaya bezofuna amaphepha okuba kuleli. Abevile ku-50 zibakhalele kanti abanye kusacutshungulwa ukuthi ngabe bakuleli ngokusemthethweni.UMkhuzi wamaPhoyisa esifundazweni uLieutenant-General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, uthe kuboshwe laba bokufika abebengenazo izimvume ezisemthethweni zokuba kuleli.Uthe njengoba besebenza noMnyango wezaseKhaya ubazisile ukuthi abevile ku-50 bakuleli ngokomgunyathi. "Kuyakhathaza ukuthi umthetho uphulwa osomabhizinisi abazi umthetho. Sizoqhubeka nokubopha abakuleli ngokungemthetho," usho kanje.Uthe obunye ubugebengu obandile wukweba ezitolo okusho ukuthi abantu abasuke bezama ukuphila.UNdunankulu uMnuz Thami Ntuli, uthe inqwaba kusamele bayicubungule ukuthi ikuleli ngokusemthethweni yini noma ikuleli ngokungemthetho. "Izinkumbi zabantu besifundazwe azisebenzi ekubeni kunenqwaba yabantu bokufika abasebenza ngokungemthetho. Sisazohambela nezinye izindawo, siyeza ukuzobafuna, uma sesifika sibopha osomabhizinisi ngoba kuyicala ukuqasha abantu abakuleli ngokungemthetho," kusho uNtuli.Uthe ngesikhathi befika kule femu, kunabanye abagcwale amahlathi bebalekela ukuboshwa.Uveze ukuthi abakuleli ngokungemthetho bazobuyiselwa emazweni abo."Umnikazi wefemu uthe yena wazi ukuthi bakuleli ngokusemthethweni. Uma kungukuthi ubaqashe azi ukuthi abanamaphepha, uzoba senkingeni," kusho uNtuli.

Amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal aphenya amacala okubulala, ukuzama ukubulala, nokushayela budedengu kulandela isehlo lapho iphoyisa elinguConstable okusolwa ukuthi lidubule labulala uzakwabo kanye nabanye abantu ababili, kwashona oyedwa kwalimala omunye endaweni yaseMachunwini, esiFundeni iHarry Gwala, ezintatha zangoMgqibelo, 31 May 2025. Kubikwa ukuthi amaphoyisa amathathu, oSergeant ababili kanye noConstable, abangamalungu eTactical Response Team yaseFree State Province, bebehamba ngemoto besuka lapho bebejutshwe khona e-Eastern Cape belibangise eFree State ngesikhathi begeja uphawu lokuchezuka emgwaqweni kanti imoto abebehamba ngayo izophaphalaza ishayise izinsimbi. Amalungu omphakathi amabili aphuthume ukusiza futhi asiza ngokuthinta abezimo eziphuthumayo neloli edonsa izimoto ezilimele. Kubikwa ukuthi uConstable wehla emotweni wadubula umshayeli weloli elidonsayo. Ngesikhathi uzakwabo engenelela kuthiwa uConstable wamdubula nelinye ilungu lomphakathi. Kuthiwa uConstable ube esezibhekisa kuye isibhamu wazidubula. UConstable nomshayeli weloli bashonele endaweni yesigameko, kwathi uSergeant nomunye wesilisa baphuthunyiswa esibhedlela. Iphoyisa lesithathu lisindile kulesi sigameko. Isizathu salokhu kudubula siyingxenye yophenyo lwamaphoyisa.

IGCAGCELE esokeni izolo, iNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini ivuna umndeni wakwaSibiya ukuthi kube yiwo ongcwaba ikhansela ebeliyi-PR kuMasipala waKwaDukuza. UNkk Sebenzile 'MaMthembu’ Sibiya washona ngoMeyi 16 kulo nyaka, kulandela ukuqiniswa wukugula. Kuvele ukuthi nakuba ebemningi emzini wakhe nomyeni wakhe ongasekho, oseLindelani, KwaDukuza, kodwa amasiko ubewagcinela emzini wabo oseGingindlovu. Emva kokushona kukaNkk Sibiya, kuphakame umoya emndenini wakwaSibiya, umndeni wakwaMthembu ufuna ngodli ukuthi inkonzo yomngcwabo ibe seLindelani. Umndeni wakwaSibiya wagcina uveza ukuthi umndeni wakwaMthembu kufanele ukucele lokho, ungakuphoqi, kwazise umufi ubengumakoti wabo ngokugcwele. Maphakathi nesonto eledlule, umndeni wakwaSibiya uthe wagcina uvuma ukuthi inkonzo ingaba seLindelani kodwa umufi angcwatshwe eduze komyeni wakhe eGingindlovu. Wathi ngesikhathi usabheke lokho, wahlaselwa amadoda ayehlome ngezibhamu, ethi athunywe abakwaMthembu ukuzosho ukuthi konke kuzokwenzelwa eLindelani.Yilapho benikele khona ebuholini bomdabu baseLindelani, kwathi uma umndeni wakwaMthembu ungasondeli nganeno ukuthi kuzoxoxiswanwa, bavele banikela enkantolo.Inkantolo ikhiphe incwadi yokuvimbela ukuqhubeka kongcwabo, isikhonzi senkantolo sazama ukuyiyisa kwabakwaMthembu, kodwa kuthiwa banqaba ukuyisayina. Ikhophi yayo, ihanjiswe kwabasemakhazeni, beyalelwa ukuthi bangasidedeli isidumbu kuze kube inkantolo ikhipha isinqumo izolo. Likhuluma neSolezwe emva kokuphuma kwesinqumo izolo ilungu lomndeni wakwaSibiya, elicele ukungadalulwa lithe bagculisekile ngesinqumo senkantolo ngoba umufi ungowabo."Zakhokhwa zonke izimfanelo zakwaMthembu. Asibakweleti lutho. Umufi ubechelwe ngenyongo kwaSibiya. Asikufuniseli ukuthi ungowethu ngokusemthethweni,” kusho isihlobo.Sithe ukube ubegcina engcwatshwa abakwaMthembu, bekuzobadalela utalatiya lokho njengoba bengabantu abakholelwayo esintwini nasemasikweni. Uveze ukuthi ubungabonwa nangokhalo enkantolo umndeni wakwaMthembu, wathi abafuni nakwazi ukuthi kungani ukhethe ukungezi."Thina sijatshuliswa wukuthi sesizokwazi ukuqhubeka nezinhlelo zethu zokufihla ngesizotha umakoti wethu kuphela,” usho kanje.Uthe abakholwa ukuthi abakwaMthembu bangeza enkonzweni yomngcwabo kamufi umndeni wakwaSibiya oyihlelele uJuni 7, kwazise bayenzile eyabo ebingenasidumbu ngoMgqibelo odlule. Uthe banakho ukusola ukuthi indlela yokuziphatha komndeni wakwaMthembu imayelana nefa likamufi, ngoba bakhona kubona ababezwe bekhuluma eyendaba yencwadi yefa nokuthi umuzi oseLindelani bekungewona owakwaSibiya kodwa owakwaMthembu."Uma sibabheka, baphambili kakhulu ngokucabanga. Thina besisagxile kweyokungcwaba, bona sebekweyefa,” kusho isihlobo, esithe okuningi sebeyokubona ngomngcwabo. Isolezwe liphinde lazama ukuthola ukuphawula komndeni wakwaMthembu, enombolweni okuthiwa ekamfowabo kamufi, kodwa ibikhala ingabanjwa.

KUKHONJWA ngenjumbane uhulumeni ngesibalo esiphezulu sezingane ezikhuliswa ngomama bebodwa kuleli. Lokhu kuvele embikweni weStats SA kuleli sonto, oveze ukuthi u-45.5% wezingane kuleli ukhuliswa abesifazane bebodwa.Kulezi zibalo kuvela nokuthi iMpumalanga yisona sifundazwe esinesibalo esiphezulu sezingane ezihlala nonina kuphela ngo-53.3%, kulandele iKwaZulu-Natal ngo-51.7%, endaweni yesithathu kune-Northern Cape ngo-49.2%.Ziphinde ziveze nokuthi iKZN iyona enesibalo esiphezulu sezingane ezihlala noyise ngo-5.7%, kulandele iFree State ne-Gauteng ngo-4.6%. Okunye okuvelile ngukuthi iWestern Cape iyona enesibalo esiphezulu sezingane ezihlala nabo bobabili abazali bazo ngo-50.1%, kulandele iGauteng ngo-44.6% neFree State ngo-34.4%.. Lezi zibalo ziphinde ziveze ukuthi e-Eastern Cape u-32.1% wezingane azihlali nabo bobabili abazali, kulandele iKZN ngo-23.7% kuze iLimpopo ngo-21.4%.Isazi samasiko nezesintu, uSolwazi Velaphi Mkhize, sithe kuningi kakhulu okungaba yimbangela yalokhu - kodwa sabhekisa umunwe ezinhlakeni ezahlukene kuhulumeni, sizisola ngokuthi size sifika lapho esikhona manje nje, okuningi kwezinto ezonakele, koniwe yizinqumo nemithetho okushaywa yizona."Uhulumeni wethu awukaze waba nohlelo oluqondile lokuthi kuzophilwa kanjani ngendlela ezokwenza ukuthi kungabi bikho ozibona engcono kunomunye kwabesilisa nabesifazane. Ukulahleka kwemithetho yesintu eyayikwazi ukuqoqa nokukhulisa umuntu ngendlela efanele, ngenye into eyenza ukuthi kube njena, ngoba umuntu nomuntu wenza noma yini okuthi akayenze ngesikhathi afisa ngaso. Sekushintshane omengameli bezwe baze baba bahlanu manje kodwa akekho noyedwa kubona engingamkhomba ngithi kukhona okubonakalayo akwenzile ukuthi izwe libuyele endleleni okwakuphilwa ngayo kudala ukulungisa izinto,” kusho uMkhize. Umholi womphakathi futhi owumfundisi, uMbhishophi Bhekani Mthembu, uthe okunye ngukuthi abantu besilisa abanayo indlela nezinkundla abangakhalela kuzona uma kukhona okubahluphayo, ekubeni abesifazane kusheshe kuzwakale kalula okwabo uma kukhona okubahluphayo."Lokho ngikusho ngoba sekukaningi ngikhuluma futhi ngeluleka amadoda akubeka ngokusobala ukuthi azizwa ecindezelekile futhi abona kungenamuntu onendaba nokuzwa ukuthi yini ewahluphayo. Kudingeka ukuthi uhulumeni angenelele ngoba yiqiniso elingephikwe ukuthi abantu bakholelwa kakhulu entweni abayizwa kuhulumeni."Uthe okunye ngukuthi uma kwenzeka izinto zingahambi kahle ebantwini abathandanayo, umthetho uvame ukuvuna noma ubeke phambili abantu besifazane .UMthembu uthe ngisho ungafunda iBhayibheli noma ulandelele ezenkolo nezesintu uzobona ukuthi kunendlela izinto ezidalwe ukuthi zenziwe ngayo, ngakho ukuguquka kwakho kakhulu manje kungesinye sezizathu ezone izinto."Izinto eziningi ziyoqala ukulunga mhla savuma futhi samukele ukuthi nakuba kumele sibhekele ukulingana kwezinye izinto, kodwa iqiniso wukuthi sidalwe wuNkulunkulu sangalingana," kusho uMthembu
SEKUVELE inqwaba yabesifazane eveze ukuthi iqolwe abesilisa ababili baKwaMashu, abebengaphandle ngebheyili ecaleni lokuthumba nelokubamba inkunzi owesifazane, abasolwa ngokubulala uNksz Olerato Mongale, eGoli ngeSonto.Lokhu kuvezwe okhulumela amaphoyisa kuzwelonke, uBrigadier Athlenda Mathe esithangamini nabezindaba izolo. Laba basolwa abangoMnuz Fezile Ngubane, Bongani Mthimkhulu noPhilangenkosi Makhanya, bafunwa uthuli amaphoyisa ngaleli cala, kanjalo nangamanye amacala. UNksz Mongale (30) kuthiwa walandwa owesilisa owayehamba nge-VW Polo emhlophe ngabo-3 ntambama ngeSonto e-Athol, eGoli, okuyilapho abehlala khona.Isidumbu sakhe satholwa ngabo-5 ntambama ngalo iSonto, eduze kwaseLombardy West, enyakatho yeGoli.UBrig Mathe uthe ngo-Ephreli kulo nyaka amaphoyisa abopha uMthimkhulu noMakhanya ngecala lokuthumba nelokubamba inkunzi eGoli. "Iphoyisa elalimatasa nomsebenzi walo wokuqapha ubugebengu, laqaphela iVW Polo esolisayo, okuyiyo le okukhulunywa ngayo manje, layimisa ngenyanga edlule eGoli. Lathola ukuthi kunowesifazane, owayeqeda ukuphangwa wase ethunjwa zabe sezibakhalela,” kusho uBrig Mathe, othe bavela enkantolo baphuma ngebheyili. Uthe emva kokukhipha kwabo inombolo kaBrigadier Nama, ophenya leli cala, ukuthi noma ubani onolwazi ngabasolwa amthinte, kuqhamuke inqwaba yabesifazane beveza ukuthi nabo babe yizisulu, abasolwa bebayenga ngomshado, bese becindezela indaba yokuthi kuhlanganwe. "Baveza ukuthi bahlangana kanjani noMthimkhulu noMakhanya ngezikhathi ezehlukene. Kuthiwa basebenzisa indlela eyodwa ukubayenga. Bahlangana nabo enxanxatheleni yezitolo, babacele umshado, bacele ukubakhipha kuyodliwa, bese bebabamba inkunzi,” kusho uBrig Mathe.Uthe izifundazwe osekuvele ukuthi benza kuzo lo mkhuba yiNorthern Cape, Free State naseGoli. Uthe bagculisekile ngomsebenzi owenziwe yithimba eliphezulu, elibophele amaphoyisa ezinhlaka ezahlukene eGoli naKwaZulu-Natal kusuka kuvela izindaba zesigameko ngeSonto. "NgoLwesithathu ithimba linikele KwaMashu lapho obesekuvele ukuthi abasolwa badabuka khona, futhi babalekele khona ngeSonto, emva kokubulala u-Olerato,” kusho uBrig Mathe, othe bawutholile umuzi wakubo koyedwa wabasolwa.Uthe badlulele endaweni okukhandwa kuyona izimoto ePhoenix, okuyilapho bethole khona iPolo ebebelibheka. "Ithimba lamaphoyisa lithole ukuthi iPolo linegazi ngaphakathi,” usho kanje.Uthe bathole ukuthi umnikazi wePolo, nguyise woyedwa wabasolwa. "Ugcinwe amaphoyisa, ukhombisa ukusebenzisana namaphoyisa amhloma imibuzo ngemoto engaphansi kwegama lakhe, ebandakanyeka ebugebengwini bokubulawa komuntu,” kusho uBrig Mathe. Uthe kufanele achaze ukuthi uma imoto yakhe ingekho kuye, usuke ethi ikuphi, nokuthi uyazi yini ukuthi ithinteka ezehlakalweni ezehlukene zobugebengu okubalwa nesango-Ephreli sokuthunjwa nokubanjwa inkunzi kowesifazane.UBrig Mathe unxuse umphakathi ukuthi uqhubeke nokuletha lonke ulwazi olungalekelela ekutheni babanjwe.Ucele umphakathi ukuthi ungabafihli njengoba befunwa nje, waxwayisa nangokuthi ungazami ukuzibambela ngokwawo ngoba bayingozi. Uphenyo lwamaphoyisa lwaphambilini luthole ukuthi i-number plate eyayifakwe kwi-Polo eyalanda umufi kwakungeyeToyota Hilux. Luveze nokuthi ezinye zezimpahla zikamufi obefunda enyuvesi iWits, okukhona kuzo iselula nesikhwama zatholwa zitshingwe eKew, kanti izolo bekunenkonzo yesikhumbuzo sakhe, uzofihlwa ngeSonto eBloemfontein.
BASOLA ukuthi umkhuba usendaweni ngekhehla elitholwe lihlahlelwe ngocelemba izolo KwaVimbukhalo, eNdwedwe. UMnuz Fanyana Ndimande (70), kuthiwa utholwe endlini abelala kuyona engu-rondo, esethule enenqwaba yezingozi ezivulekile ekhanda, esiphangeni nasezandleni.Isihlobo, uMnuz Sandiso Ndimande, sithe umufi utholwe owesilisa obeyokha amanzi emigqonyeni yamanzi okukha kuyo umphakathi engenhla komuzi. "Uma esho lona wesilisa uthe ungene ngaphakathi ekhaya, ethi uzoboleka ujeke ukuze akhe amanzi kule migqomo. Uthe ufice umnyango uvulekile, kwathi uma engena ngaphakathi, wazithela phezu kwakhe umkhulu, egenciwe. Ube esehlaba umkhosi,” kusho uNdimande.Uthe umufi ubulawelwe esiponjini sakhe alala kuso."Igazi beligcwele yonke indawo, elinye laze lasaphazekela ngisho nasodongeni,” kusho uNdimande, oqhube wathi amanxeba abawabone kuye ayesabisa. "Umgence ngisho izandla, siyabona ukuthi mhlawumbe ubezama ukuvika ngazo,” usho kanje.Uthe akukho okuthathiwe ngoba iselula yakhe, imali nokunye, bakuthole kukhona."Kusobala ukuthi wumuntu nje obefuna umphefumulo wakhe. Futhi akuyena umuntu wokufika, owendawo,” kusho uNdimande. Uthe lokhu bakusho ngoba zikhona ezinye izindlu ezisegcekeni kodwa umsolwa uvele waqonda ngqo kule ebilala umufi, wagqekeza wase embulala."Umuntu wokufika ubezokwazi kanjani ukuthi avele aqonde ngqo kule ndlu abelala kuyo? Ubezobe azi ngani ukuthi ubani ophakathi?” kubuza uNdimande. Uthe azikho izitha abazaziyo abenazo umufi. Nokho uveze ukuthi lukhona udaba olubucayi obelukhulunywa endaweni, naye obengahlonizi ukuthi akahambisani nalo."Kukhona imizamo yokuketulwa kwezinduna eziyisikhombisa zesizwe sakwaGcwensa okuyinto eqhubekayo njengamanje endaweni. Ubelimisa ngesihloko elokuthi lokhu akufanele kwenzeke noma kuvunyelwe,” kusho uNdimande, obe eseshesha ekugcizelela ukuthi kodwa abasho ukuthi ubulawelwe lokho.Uthe ubekuveza ukuthi akahambisani nakho ngoba lezi zinduna akukho ezikwenzile ukuze zishintshwe. "Ubebuza ukuthi kungani kudingeka ukuthi zishintshwe, zenzeni. Asikho isizathu esiphathekayo ebesenza ukuthi zize zishintshwe. Bese kunesikhathi kuba nemihlangano yokususa lezi zinduna, kodwa umphakathi umane ungafiki ngoba ungahambisani nalesi sinqumo," kusho uNdimande.Uveze ukuthi umufi ungowokuzalwa khona ebukhosini bakwaGcwensa. Uthe into ebidala ukuthi umufi ahlale yedwa wukuthi ezinye izihlobo zakhe zisezindaweni ezehlukene ngokuhanjiswa wumsebenzi.Okhulumela amaphoyisa uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe ubengakalutholi ulwazi ngaleli cala wathi bebesafuna ulwazi.
BANGASE bathathelwe izinyathelo ezinqala abantu abalinganiselwa ku-210 000, abasolwa ngokuhola imali yesibonelelo sikahulumeni sabangasebenzi, ekubeni kukhona enye imali abayithola engxenye. Lokhu kushiwo okhulumela iSouth African Social Security Agency (Sassa), uMnuz Paseka Letsatsi, oveze ukuthi lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi kubambezeleke ukukhokhelwa kwabasolwa ngalokhu ngenyanga ezayo."Laba kulindeleke ukuthi beze emahhovisi akwaSassa aseduze nabo zingakapheli izinsuku ezingu-30 ukusuka manje, ukuze kubuyekezwe imihlomulo yabo,” kusho uLetsatsi. Uthe abazohluleka wukwenza lokhu, bazibeka engcupheni yokuthi sinqanyulwe unomphelo isibonelelo.Uveze ukuthi ngokusebenza kwabo ngokubambisana nezinye izinhlaka ezikwazi ukubona imali engenayo emabhange abantu, bathole ukuthi la bantu, bathola enye imali, kodwa bakugodla lokhu kwaSassa. "Ngokuphoqwa wumthetho, abantu abathola lesi sibonelelo kufanele baveze lonke uhlobo lwemali engenayo emagameni abo ngesikhathi befaka isicelo sayo,” kusho uLetsatsi.Uthe umthetho uphinde ubaphoqe ukuthi uma sebeqalile ukubahola oR370, bakudalule kwaSassa uma sekwenzeka kuba khona ushintsho ngenye imali engena emaceleni. Uqhube wathi umuntu okhetha ukungakwenzi lokho, usuke esenza okuphambene nomthetho futhi kungaholela ekutheni athathelwe izinyathelo.Uveze ukuthi ngale kokuthathela izinyathelo abafihla lolu lwazi, bazophinde bathathele izinyathelo izisebenzi zabo ezilekelela laba bantu ukuthi benze lobu bugebengu."ISassa ayihambisani nenkohlakalo, uma kwenzeka kuvela ukuthi kukhona izisebenzi zethu ezibandakanyeka kulokhu, nazo zizothathelwa izinyathelo ngokucekela phansi inhlangano (Sassa),” kusho uLetsatsi.Ngokwezibalo zangonyaka odlule, balinganiselwa ku-8,5 million abantu abahola isibonelelo sabangatohozi kuleli.
UYAFA yiminjunju umndeni wowesifazane waseBhobhoyi, ePort Shepstone, kuphela izinyanga engabonwa nangokhalo, kulandela ukunyamalala kwakhe evakashele isoka, KwaNqetho, eHillcrest, eThekwini. Umndeni kaNksz Bongiwe Nyawose (38), uthe wagcina ukuzwa izwi lakhe ngabo-9 ebusuku ngoDisemba 31, 2024, ewufisela ukungena kahle ku-2025. Kuthiwa wayebafonela ehleli nesoka lakhe, uMnuz Xolani Mbili, ayehambe ekhaya ngoDisemba 13, 2024, elivakashele, ewumuntu ozohlala izinsukwana. Ngokusho kukanina, uNkk Lindeni Nyawose, uMbili wamfakela imali yokugibela uBongiwe, kwaqondana nokuthi nasefemini yakhe sebemtshela ukuthi akeze azosebenza, kulandela ukuhlala ekhaya inyanga ngoba ungekho umsebenzi."Sazitshela ukuthi uzobuya ngoKhisimusi, kodwa wangabuya. Saba nesiqiniseko sokuthi uzobuya ngoDisemba 27 njengoba kwakunomcimbi kadadewabo, nakhona wangabuya,” kusho uNkk Nyawose.Uthe kwathi ngoDisemba 30, bafona bobabili nesoka bethi bacela ukuzohlukanisa unyaka eBhobhoyi, njengoba uBongiwe agcina engawudlanga nabo uKhisimusi. Uthe babalindela ngakusasa (Disemba 31), kodwa nakhona laze layoshona bengaqhamuki. Uqhube wathi uBongiwe wabashayela ngoDisemba 31 ebusuku, ebafisela ukungena kahle onyakeni. Ngakusasa ngoJanuwari 1, 2025 udadewabo wavuswa wucingo lukaMbili ngabo-4 ekuseni, ethi usemshayile uBongiwe, ngoba umbambe elele nomngani wakhe. "Wathi ngo-12 uhambe waya kukhulu wakhe endlini enkulu, wabuya uBongiwe eselele nendoda, wabashaya bobabili, baphuma babaleka,” kusho uNkk Nyawose. Uthe wabatshela ukuthi emva kwaleso sehlakalo, wavele wayolala endlini enkulu, kwathi uma evuka ekuseni eza endlini yakhe, wafika engakabuyi uBongiwe. "Emva kwezinsuku eziyisikhombisa, ngamtshela ukuthi njengoba engabuyile nalapha ekhaya, akahambe ayobika ukuthi udukile emaphoyiseni. Ngabe sengilandelela ukuthi ukwenzile yini ngempela lokho, wathi ukwenzile,” kulandisa uNkk Nyawose.Uthe ngesikhathi eselusukumela udaba ngoMashi, eya esiteshini samaphoyisa eHillcrest wafike wathola ukuthi uMbili akambikanga uBongiwe njengomuntu olahlekile, amaphoyisa athi uma embuza ngalokho, wathi yena wayezididekele ngesikhathi ethi umbikile. Kuthe eseya kwaMbili, wafike wathola umazisi neselula kaBongiwe kukhona. Uthe bakhathazekile futhi basele nemibuzo."Ngizibuza imibuzo eminingi ngaye, ukuthi wamshonisaphi. Akekho umuntu ongavele aphelele emehlweni nje,” kusho uNkk Nyawose.Uthe udaba luwusinda wonke umndeni njengoba kunzima nasezinganeni zakhe ezintathu ezineminyaka ephakathi kuka-12 no-17. "Le-eno-12, ivele iyohlala egcekeni, maqede ilidlale iphindelela iculo elithi 'Kulungile Baba’. Ngivele ngingene ekamelweni, ngivale, zigobhoze izinyembezi,” usho kanje. Ukhale ngokuthi okungenani, akutholakale ithambo lakhe, ukuze balifihle ngesizotha, bathole ukuphumula emphefumulweni. Uthe njengomama onezinseka, nomuntu osebenza ngamakhambi esizulu, ziyavela izibonakaliso zokuthi indodakazi yakhe, ayisekho emhlabeni futhi yabulawa. Ethintwa uMbili walandisa ngolwakhe uhlangothi wathi yena ngokwazi kwakhe uNksz Nyawose, usaphila yikho nje ukuthi akazi kahle ukuthi ukuphi. "NgoFebhuwari, ngafonelwa wumalume wakhe, ethi uBongiwe uyaphila, uyaxhumana nezingane zakhe. Angikholwa wukuthi wayengavele asuke angiqambele amanga,” kusho uMbili.Uthe yena usola ukuthi uhlala nomngani ambamba naye, njengoba umngani wavele wathutha kubo emva kwesigameko, wayoqasha kwenye indawo."Seziningi izindawo asehlale kuzo kusukela lapho. Ngisola ukuthi bahlala ndawonye, yikho ukuthi ngeke ngikwazi ukuthola ngoba kwayena umngani angisamazi ukuthi usehlalaphi, nenombolo yakhe yocingo ebengiyazi, isihlale ivaliwe uma ngithi ngiyayifonela,” kusho uMbili.Uveze ukuthi uke wathola iFacebook invite, evela kuNksz Nyawose kodwa wangayingena indaba yayo ngoba zibuye zimdide izinkundla zokuxhumana. Nokho uthe naye bukhona ubufakazi abugcine endaweni ephephile, alinde ukubuveza emaphoyiseni, mhla esefika ethi azombopha. Ukhale ngokuthukwa abakubo kaNksz Nyawose, wathi mhla kutholakala ukuthi uyaphila, uyobavulela icala ngokumsola ngento angayazi.Elandisa ngokwenzeka ngoJanuwari 1, 2025, uthe emva kokuhlukana konyaka ngo-12 ebusuku, wathi shelele waya kukhulu wakhe endlini enkulu, eyomfisela izilokotho zonyaka omusha."Ngahlala naye imizuzu engu-20. Kwathi sengibuyela endlini yami, ngafica sekuvaliwe, umsakazo ukhalela phezulu. Ngathi uma ngipopola, ngabona umngani wami ephezu kukaBongiwe, beya ocansini,” kusho uMbili. Uthe wakhahlela isicabha wabangena ngenduku. "Umngani waphuma wabaleka, uBongiwe wasala. Ngabuyela endlini enkulu ngiyobikela ukhulu, ngathi uma ngibuya, ngafica naye engasekho,” kusho uMbili.Echaza ngomngani, uthe kwakuwumngani wakhe omkhulu weminyaka engu-15 futhi eqashe egcekeni kubo.Ebuzwa ngokumbika emaphoyiseni ukuthi udukile, uthe ngesikhathi efika esiteshini samaphoyisa iHillcrest, athi njengoba ethi uphume ebaleka nendoda, asikho isidingo sokumbika njengomuntu odukile. Siye koshicilela amaphoyisa engakaphenduli.

UNGQONGQOSHE wezokuXhumana, uMnuz Solly Malatsi, uzivikele ekugxekweni kulandela umyalelo woMnyango wakhe oshicilelwe okuthiwa uvuna inkampani ye-internet, iStarlink. IStarlink wubuchwepheshe be-internet okuthiwa busebenza ngisho emakhaya lapho oyithengayo ethola okubekwa ngaphandle kubheke emkhathini kudonse i-network ne-router bese ekhokha ngenyanga.Ngeledlule uMalatsi ukhiphe umyalelo obukeka uxegisela inkampani yempunyela uMnuz Elon Musk, iStarlink, ukuthi ingene kuleli. Phambilini obekuvimbile bekuthiwa yimithetho yokuthi izinkampani zaphesheya kumele zibambisane nezosomabhizinisi bakuleli uma zifuna ukuzoqala ukusebenza ngokweBroad-Based Black Economic Empowerment (B-BBEE).Evele phambi wekomiti lezokuxhumana lePhalamende lapho ebebizelwe ukuyochaza ngalo myalelo obukeka ungahambisani ne-Electronics Communications Act, uthe abazami ukwenzelela iStarlink. Ephekwa ngemibuzo amalungu aleli komiti eliholwa uNkk Khusela Diko, uthe lo myalelo yingxenye yomzamo obanzi wokwenza ukuthi umkhakha wezokuxhumana ngobuchwepheshe uhambisane nohlaka lweB-BBEE."Asizami ukwenzelela iStarlink noma enye inkampani okanye umuntu. Sithi imithetho emkhakheni wethu kufanele ihlale ivumela ukuba kube nokuzikhethela okwenzeka kweminye, okungamaphesenti angu-30 abanikazi basekhaya noma kube nokulingana," kuchaza uMalatsi.Uveze ukuthi akukho okwenziwe esithe njengoba ethe umsebenzi wokulungiselela umyalelo waqala ngoSepthemba 2024 ne-Authority of South Africa (ICASA) yaziswa ngokusemthethweni ngo-Okthoba 4, 2024. UMalatsi uthe ukwaziswa komphakathi ngalokhu nomyalelo owawusakhiwa kwenziwa ngaphambi ngokuhambela kukaMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa eMelika ngeledlule.Uzithethelele ngokuthi bebengeke bazi ukuthi uRamaphosa uzoya eMelika, okukhomba ukuthi akukho okunuka santungwana ngalo myalelo.
BALAHLWE yicala abesilisa ababili ababulala owesilisa waseMlaza, owayehamba nge-wheelchair.USiyabonga Ngubane (36) nomngani wakhe uSithembiso Khomo (23), bebebekwe icala lokudubula babulale uMnuz Simanga Khumalo (29) owayedume kakhulu ngelikaKatsande. Kuvela ukuthi umufi wahlaselwa wadutshulwa engaphandle kwakubo kwa-Q, eMlaza, evakashele ugogo wakhe ngezithuba zantambama, ngoMashi 28 ngonyaka odlule.Ngesikhathi icala lisenkantolo yeMantshi eMlaza, uNgubane yamchitha ngesikhathi ecela ibheyili ikhala ngokuthi izizathu zakhe kazizwakali, kwathi uKhomo inkantolo yamvumela. Bebebhekene namacala amahlanu okukhona kuwona elokwakha itulo nokuhlela ukubulala, elokutholakala nesibhamu esingekho emthethweni kanye nelokutholakala nezinhlamvu.Umufi ubesehamba ngesihlalo esinamasondo ngemuva kokuba adutshulwa okokuqala ngo-2021 ecaleni okwaboshwa kulona umlisa owaziwayo, okwakukholakala ukuthi uyena ogcine ethumela izinkabi esejele, ukuba zizoqeda ngomufi ukuze zicishe ubufakazi.Enkantolo ngaphambilini kwahlaluka ukuthi umufi ngaphambi kokuba abulawe wayelokhu ethola izinsongo ezazivela kumuntu ongaziwa, emxwayisa ngokuthi akasule icala lokudutshulwa kwakhe lango-2021, uma efuna ukuqhubeka nokudla anhlamvana. Umufi kuthiwa wakhubazeka ngesikhathi abathile bembamba inkunzi engena kubo, bamshaya ngenduku yegalofu ngaphambi kokuba bamphuce ifoni yomsebenzi. Kuthiwa umufi wabikela unina wase ehamba naye eyobikela unina kamsolwa ngokwenzekile, kodwa kuthiwa umsolwa kwathi uma ebabona wangabuza lutho wamane wamdubula kwaba wukugcina kwakhe ukukwazi ukuzihambela ngezinyawo umufi.Izolo iJaji uRadebe uchaze laba ababili njengabantu abanonya abenza into bazi kahle ukuthi bahloseni ngayo.'Naba nobabili endaweni eyodwa ngesikhathi esifanayo nihlose ukwenza into engeyinhle kumuntu ongenacala.'' URadebe ukhale ngokuthi laba bahubhuze amanga enkantolo bezama ukuzivikela wancoma uMbuso ngokuthi ukwazile ukuvezela inkantolo ubuqiniso bokuthi ngempela laba yibona ababulala umufi.''Nobabili nginithola ninecala lokubulala,'' kusho uRadebe.Ecaleni lokutholakala nesibhamu nelokutholakala nezinhlamvu limkhiphe phambili uKhomo, lathi abukho ubufakazi obuqinile obumyamanisa nalokho. Ummeli kaKhomo umcelele ukuba aphindele kubo izolo njengoba ebengaphandle ngebheyili kodwa uRadebe wakuchitha lokhu wathi ngeke adedele umuntu oselahlwe yicala elibucayi lokubulala. Ilungu lomndeni kamufi lithe bathobeke amanxeba ngokuthi laba ababili balahlwe yicala lokubulala.Lithe kodwa bazizwa bengenwa ngamanzi emadolweni ngoba kabazi ukuthi yini ecatshangwa yilona osevele ungaphakathi, okunguyena owayekade ethumele laba ukuba babulale umufi.

UMMELI kaMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, uvezele inkantolo yokuDluliswa kwamaCala eBloemfontein, ukuthi uRamaphosa akaphuthumanga ukukhipha isitifiketi esigunyaza iSilo uMisuzulu kaZwelithini, ukuhlala esihlalweni. Kwenzeke lokhu njengoba uRamaphosa efake isicelo sokuphikisa isinqumo seJaji Norman Davis weNorth Gauteng, phambilini owathola ukuthi uMengameli akayilandelanga imigudu efanele ngesikhathi ekhipha isitifiketi futhi lokhu kufana nento engekho.UDavis wathi uRamaphosa wahluleka wukulandela imigudu efanele,ngokomthetho iTraditional and Khoi-San Leadership Act 3 of 2019, ephinde yaziwe ngeLeadership Act, ukujuba ikomiti elizophenya ngesikhathi kuqubuka umbango wesihlalo phakathi kukaMisuzulu nomnewabo uSimakade.NgoLwesithathu, ummeli kaRamaphosa, u-Advocate Marumo Moerane, utshele inkantolo ukuthi uMengameli wathatha isinqumo emva kokuthola isiqiniseko samaminithi omhlangano waseNdlunkulu, owabe ungoMashi 14, 2021, lapho kwavunyelwana ngokuthi iSilo uMisuzulu kufanele singene esihlalweni. Lo mhlangano wawubizwe owayenguNdunankulu kaZulu, uMntwana uMangosuthu Buthelezi, ongasekho. "Siyakuveza ukuthi uMengameli akaxhamazelanga ukuthatha isinqumo futhi akasebenzisanga ulwazi olungaphelele," kusho uMoerane etshela iJaji uDumisani Zondi.Uthe incwadi eyathunyelelwa uRamaphosa yihhovisi likaNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, yakuqinisekisa ukuthi yiSilo uMisuzulu esizothatha ubukhosi."Isinqumo sikaMengameli sasihambisana nomthetho, asenziwanga ngokuphuthuma," usho kanje. Omele iSilo uMisuzulu, u-Adv Tembeka Ngcukaitobi, uthe ukuqokwa kweSilo kwenziwa emhlanganweni osemthethweni futhi kwenziwa ngokomthetho wesintu.Uthe lolu daba selwaphothulwa enkantolo. Uhlangothi lukaMntwana uMbonisi noMntwana uSimakade osembangweni wesihlalo, luthe kuyilungelo lalaba ukuba baqoke iSilo.Inkantolo izwe ukuthi laba abanaye umuntu abamqokile kodwa bafuna ilungelo labo lokuqoka ngokomthetho wesintu. Bame kwelokuthi uMengameli wayengenalo ilungelo lokuqoka kungaboniswananga.Ngaphandle nangaphakathi kwenkantolo amabutho atheleke ekuseni, eviliyela ehuba amahubo akwaZulu. Phakathi kwabebethamele icala kubalwa uSihlalo woMkhandlu weSilo, Inkosi uZuzifa Buthelezi, iNkosi uPhathisizwe Chiliza, wuMphathiswa woMnyango wokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu esifundazweni, uMfu UThulasizwe Buthelezi, nabantwana basendlunkulu. Icala liyaqhubeka namhlanje.

SISHAQISE umphakathi waseNgome eGreytown isigameko sokubulawa kowesilisa obebanga insimu nomakhelwane wakhe. Ngokuthola kweSolezwe, umufi uMnuz Fano Patrick Dladla (51), ushaywe waze wafa ngumakhelwane wakhe, okuthiwa akaboshiwe.Kuvela ukuthi umsolwa weza kumufi ezocela ukuba amuphe ingxenye ethile yensimu, ufisa ukulima. Umthombo ongeke adalulwe uthe umufi wavuma wamupha umsolwa leyo ngxenye.Umthombo uthe umnyombo wengxabano phakathi kwabo uqale uma umsolwa engasalimi kule ndawo kodwa njalo amane afake izinkomo zakhe zize zingene egcekeni likamufi. "Kumnengile kakhulu lokhu umufi wase etshela umsolwa ukuthi akayibuyise insimu ngoba uyehluleka wukulima kodwa kunalokho umane afake izinkomo kuyona," usho kanje.Uthe umsolwa kwamcika lokhu wamane waqonda ngqo kuDladla esensimini wamshaya kabi okuyinto eyenzeke ngoMeyi 16, waphuthunyiswa esibhedlela lapho ehlale khona cishe isonto lonke wase eshona. Uqhube wathi akucaci ukuthi umufi ubeshaywa ngani ngoba umsolwa wayebonakala engaphethe lutho esandleni."Esikusolayo wukuthi kukhona okuthile ayekufumbethe esandleni ayemshaya ngakho njengoba ephelile ebusweni. Nodokotela bakhala ngokuthi ulimele kabi ebusweni futhi uze wophela ngaphakathi," usho kanje. Indodana kamufi, uMnuz Sabelo Dladla, ithintwa ngalolu daba iqale yanqaba ukuphawula kodwa yagcina ikhuluma ngakho konke okwenzekile.''Inkinga iqale ngesikhathi umakhelwane ecela insimu kubaba. Ubaba ngenxa yokuthi ungumuntu olungile akazange abe nankinga kodwa kunalokho wamnikeza ngoba wayethi insimu ufuna ukuyisebenzisela ukulima.''Uthe inkinga iqale ngesikhathi umakhelwane engasalimi kodwa njalo esevuka afake izinkomo zakhe ensimini.''Izinkomo zakhe bezigcina zingena ekhaya okuyinto egcine imcika ubaba wase eyambuza ukuthi kanti insimu wayeyicelela ukuthini? Ukushisa kusuke lapho ke umakhelwane wamshaya wamlimaza.''Uqhube wathi bamphuthumisa esibhedlela bezitshela ukuthi sekuyoba ngozi makhaza awuphonse umbalane kanti ababuzanga elangeni uzokwandulela kwelamathongo. Ukhale ngokuthi induna yendawo, uMnuz Msukelwa Jika Zondi, akukho okungako ebasize ngakho ngalolu daba kodwa imane yathalalisa nje. Uthe ngokuvamisile uma kuvela isiga esinjena induna kuye kudingeke ukuthi ibize amaphoyisa kodwa yona yamane yashaya sengathi akwenzekanga lutho yangawabiza amaphoyisa.''Induna yathi umakhelwane uzosinikeza u-R7 500 wamakhandlela, asithule. Yaqhubeka yathi uma sike sakhuluma sizoshiswa ekhaya futhi sidingiswe,'' usho kanje.Uphinde wakhala ngamaphoyisa aseGreytown athe baya kuwona beyovula icala kodwa amane ayihlaba inhlali, athi kumele oshayiwe alindwe alulame kube uyena ozivulela icala.Ithintwa induna uZondi ithe ngamampunge lokhu okushiwo ngayo. Ivumile ukuthi yakhuluma ngemali yamakhandlela, ngoba kuwusikompilo lwakule ndawo ukuthi obulele kumele anxephezele umndeni kamufi ngemali yamakhandlela engu-R7 500.''Inhloso yale mali umoni usuke ethi nxese emndenini kamufi,'' kuchaza uZondi.Mayelana nokuthi bekumele ibize amaphoyisa ithe kungumsangano lokho ngoba yona ayihlangene nabaKwasidlodlo.UDladla uthe akasasiboni isidingo sokuya emaphoyiseni ngoba awazange amsize.
