UQANJWE ngesishoshovu se-ANC esingasekho uMasipala uBuhlebezwe, ngaphansi kowesiFunda iHarry Gwala. Kusukela lo Masipala oseXobho usubizwa ngeJohannes Phumani Phungula Local Municipality, okuyigama lesigayigayi se-ANC esasidume ngelikaPassfour.Umcimbi wokushintshwa kwegama ubuthanyelwe wumdidiyeli wohlaka lwe-ANC olujutshelwe ukusebenza KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Jeff Radebe, izimeya ezingaphansi kweHarry Gwala, eziphuma eminyangweni kahulumeni eyahlukene, amalungu omphakathi nomndeni kaPhungula.Eminye imigwaqo yendawo ibivaliwe kwazise bekunemiviliyelo okuhlanganisa neyamaphoyisa. UPhungula odlule emhlabeni ngo-2009, wajoyina i-ANC ngo-1952 ngesikhathi sombhidlango wokulwa nombuso wobandlululo, waphinde waba yivolontiya esasebenza efemini yetiye, iJoko Tea. Ngo-1959 wajutshwa ngakubo eHlokozi lapho abamba iqhaza elikhulu ukuvuselela umbusazwe emphakathini waphinde wahola imibhikisho eyayilwa nemithetho yamapasi, ikakhulukazi kwabesifazane baseXobho.Ubambe iqhaza elikhulu ophikweni lwezempi lwe-ANC oselwavalwa, Umkhonto weSizwe. Ngo-1976, ngokuyalelwa yi-ANC, waya sekudingisweni kwathi kamuva waqeqeshelwa ezempi eSoviet Union.Ekudingisweni ubuye ngo-1993 kanti ngo-2003 waba yilungu lePhalamende kwaze kwaba sekupheleni kwePhalamende lesithathu.Ekhuluma nabezindaba kulo mcimbi uRadebe uthe bayajabula ukuthi lo masipala uqanjwe ngoPhungula."Siyajabula ukuthi lo masipala uqanjwe ngomunye wethu kwi-ANC futhi owayeyilungu loMkhonto weSizwe eliqavile," usho kanje.
SEKUQUBUKE omkhulu umsindo nokukhombana ngeminwe kwabezinhlangano ezingenzinzuzo ezibhekele ukuzigcina kwezintombi emphakathini iNomkhubulwane kaSolwazi Nomagugu Ngobese nebizwa ngokuthi Ubumbano Lwezintombi lukaNkk Ivy Ntanzi, kubangwa ukwenza umcimbi waminyaka yonke wokuhlola nokuyala izintombi.Engxoxweni neSolezwe Ngempelasonto uSolwazi Ngobese uthe isisusa somsindo sidalwe wukuthi iqeqebana labantu besifazane abebambisene nalo kulo mbono wakhe waminyaka yonke womcimbi wezinsuku ezintathu, bamhlamuka bephuma enhlanganweni yakhe ngaphandle kwesizathu esiqondile, okuthe kusenjalo base beqala umcimbi ofana ncamishi nowakhe.OweNomkhubulwane uzoba seHopewell, eMgungundlovu ngoJuni 27 kuya ku-29, bese kuthi owoMbumbano Lwezintombi nawo uhlelelwe ukuthi ube ngezinsuku ezifanayo elokishini iMbali, khona eMphithi, into uSolwazi Ngobese athi uyibona iwukulwa naye.Uthe yena uneminyaka engaphezu kuka-40 enza lo mcimbi ngalesi sikhathi, ngakho ngokwakhe - akumele kube khona omunye umuntu oqhamuka nombono ofana ncamashi nowakhe, athi ngoba uyakwenza - kusale sekufana konke nezinsuku zomcimbi."Umcimbi wami usukhule kakhulu kule minyaka ngenxa yokuzikhandla kwami kunzima, ngizama ukuthi isiko lethu lokuhlola izintombi nto nokuqinisekisa ukuthi ziziphatha kahle alishabalali, njengoba sesingagicini KwaZulu-Natal kuphela; kepha sesike sihambele nakwezinye izifundazwe koMpumalanga, eGauteng, Free State nase-Eastern Cape; kanti kulona esiwuhlelayo manje kuba khona amatshitshi angaphezu kuka-3 000. Okusiphatha kabi wukuthi isenzo salaba abanye siphazamisa izinhlelo zomcimbi wami engisebenze kanzima ukuthi ube yimpumelelo, njengoba sekuvele kunabantu abangithintayo, bengibuza ukuthi yiwona muphi okufanele ukuthi kuye izingane zabo kuwona,” kusho uSowazi Ngobese.Uthe udaba ulubikile kwabomthetho, bagcina ngokumbhalisa isitatimende nje kuphela, kepha wangasizakala ngalutho olunye - uthe manje ukhathazekile ngokuthi kungenzeka izindimbane zezintombi ezivame ukuthutheleka kuyena zigcine zingafikanga emcimbini.Kuthintwa uNkk Ntanzi woBumbano Lwezintombi ukuzwa ukuphawula kwabo ngalezi zinsolo, uthe kuze kufika kulesi sigaba asebekusona manje - indaba yaqala ngokuthi yena anqume ukuthi khumu ezinhlelweni zikuNomkhubulwane ngenxa yokuthi usemdala kakhulu."Kuthe kusenjalo, kwaba khona abanye omama abane abakhetha ukuhosha imfe ekusebenzeleni uNomkhubulwane, base bezongicela ukuthi kusungulwe enye inhlangano ezoqhubeka yenze iumsebenzi wokuqikelela ukuthi izintombi ziyazigcina futhi ziziphatha kahle, yaqala kanjalo le nhlangano yethu njengoba sekufika kulo msindo okhona manje."Okwezinsuku zomcimbi kuziqondanele nje ngoba nathi sazi ukuthi kulesi sikhathi kusuke sekuvalwe izikole, izingane zizokwazi ukuza lapho esizibizela khona - hhayi ngoba sinenkinga nabanye abenza umcimbi onjena. Ngokwami akumele kube nomsindo ngalolu daba, nokuthi ukuba bekukhona okudida abathile, bekumele beze kithina kuqala - kuboniswane kahle, hhayi ukugijimela kwabezindaba,” kusho uNkk Ntanzi eqinisekisa ukuthi nabo abahlehli, bazoqhubeka nezinhlelo zomcimbi wabo kusuka manje kuqhubekela phambili.
'KUYIPHUTHA elikhulu kabi ukuthi umphakathi ubheke uhulumeni ukwenza yonke into ukuwufukula nokulungisa yonke into eyonakele emphakathini ophila kuwona, kunalokho kudingeka sibambisane futhi sihlangabezane ukuze konke kube kuhle ngoba empeleni akuwona umsebenzi wethu ukukhulisa abantwana emakhaya abaphila kuwona.'Usho njalo uNgqongqoshe woMnyango wokuThuthukisa uMphakathi, uNkk Sisishi Tolashe, ephosela umphakathi inselelo yokuthi ubambisane nezinhlaka zoMnyango awuholayo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kuyancipha futhi kuphele izinselelo ezenza inhlalakahle yomphakathi ingabi yinhle.UNkk Tolashe ubekhuluma eManguzi Multipurpose Centre, eManguzi, enyakatho yeKwaZulu-Natal, lapho abevakashele khona umphakathi wakule ndawo ukuzoxoxa nawo futhi azwe ukuthi yiziphi izinto nezinselelo eziwuhluphayo ukuze zilungiswe, kubalwa inkinga yabangakwazi ukuhola izibonelelo zabo ngokwehlukana kwazo, walalela nezinselelo ezenza inhlalakahle yomphakathi ibe yinkinga. "Okunye engifisa ukuthi sikwenze kube wumthwalo wethu wukuthi sivikele abantu abadala esihlala nabo emakhaya ethu ngoba okuningi okubahluphayo, kubalwa nenkinga yokuthi bangakwazi ukuhola ngesikhathi imali yabo yempesheni. Siyazi ukuthi isikhathi esiningi kudalwa wubugebengu obenziwa ngabantu abahlala nabo bokungabanaki, babayekekele ukuhamba bodwa uma beyohola. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukuthi bagetshengwe kanti futhi ngeke sikubalekele ukuthi kwesinye isikhathi bagetshengwa ngabantu abahlala nabo,” usho kanje.Kuwo futhi lo mcimbi kunikelelwe ngomfaniswano wesikole ezinganeni ezingaphezu kwa-20 eziphila emindenini eswele, kwase kwasizwa namalungu omphakathi ezinselelweni zawo ezahlukene ezenza kube nzima ukuthola izibonelelo zazo zanyangazonke, kwasiza nalabo abebenenkinga yezitifiketi zokuzalwa zezingane zabo, nalabo abanezithiyo zokwenza omazisi.Abaholi bomphakathi nabo bathole ithuba lokwethula izinselelo ababhekene nazo emphakathini, okugqame kakhulu inkinga yendlala edalwa ukwentuleka kwamathuba omsebenzi, wukwanda kwezenzo zobugebengu emphakathini nokuswela ingqalasizinda yomphakathi.Ungqongqoshe wethembise ukuqhubeka avakashele izindawo zasemakhaya aqondayo ukuthi zinezinselelo eziningi ezihlupha umphakathi, wethembisa nokuqhubeka abambisane nobuholi bomphakathi ezindaweni ezahlukene ukusiza ugcina umpahakthi ugculisekile.
EMIZAMENI yokunciphisa umthwalo kwizakhamuzi, uMasipala weTheku usumemezele ukwehliswa kwesikweletu semali ekhokhelwa ukuhlinzekwa ngezidingo ngamaphesenti angu-50.IMeya yalo Masipala, uMnuz Cyril Xaba, ithe lesi saphulelo sizosebenza ezikweletini ezidaleke ngaphambi komhla ka-31 Januwari nonyaka. "Lolu hlelo olukhethekile luzodonsa kuze kube wuJuni 2025. Umbandela wukuthi izakhamuzi kufanele zikhokhe amaphesenti angu-50 esikweletu anaso nemali egcwele. Ngalo kuhloswe abanemizi nabanamabhizinisi ababhekene nezinselelo zomnotho nokusiza amalungu omphakathi ama-akhawunti awo aphazanyiswa wukuvuza kwamapayipi obekungabonwa, " kusho uXaba.Uthe nalabo abathola amanzi angu-6kl kungafanele kumele bakhokhe.Izakhamuzi ezibe nesikweletu phakathi kukaFebhuwari noJuni 2025, kumele zenze izinhlelo zokukhokha isikweletu ngokuphela kukaJuni 2025. "Lolu hlelo lukhombisa ukuthi thina njengomkhandlu onakekelayo nokuthi izikhalo ezavezwa yizakhamuzi ngesikhathi somkhankaso wokuzwa ukuphawula kwawo, zilaleliwe futhi zaphendulwa," kusho uXaba.Imeya inxuse abakhokhela izidingo ukuba balisebenzise leli thuba futhi babhalise ezikhungweni zoSizakala.
ASECELA ukuba kungenelelwe osizini abhekene nalo amalungu omphakathi wasoDidini, eMbumbulu athi ahlezi lubhojozi kubulawa abantu ubusuku nemini kuphinde kuhlinzwe nemfuyo.Isigameko sakamuva okuyisona esithuse umphakathi kakhulu, ngesokubulawa ngesihluku kukaMnuz Mhlengi Msweli (23) oyindodana yenduna.Isolezwe lithole ngomthombo walo ukuthi umufi udutshulwe washona engaphandle kwakubo kade ephuma esitolo. Udadewabo kamufi uNksz Nombuyiselo Msweli, uthe bafe olwembiza ngokubulawa kukamfowabo omncane kungakapheli ngisho isikhathi esingakanani kudutshulwe kwabulawa uyise.Uthe umufi ufike wapaka imoto ngaphandle kwakubo wase evula isango.''Kuthe eselivulile isango sekumele afake imoto ngaphakathi, baqhamuka lapho bamshaya bamlimaza ngesibhamu. Indlela alimale kabi ngayo, kuyabonakala nje ukuthi laba ngabantu ebebemhlosile nje vele,'' usho kanje. Uthe badukuza ebumnyameni ngokuthi ngobani ngempela laba abanabo shaqa.''Asisazi manje ukuthi sithini kubani ngoba kuyacaca ukuthi kukhona laba bantu ababhekene nathi nje lapha ekhaya,''usho kanje.Ukhale kakhulu ngokuthi akukho ukuthula kule ndawo, ubusuku nemini kukhala isibhamu. ''Konakele kule ndawo. Okubuhlungu kakhulu wukuthi sesigadle kwaze kwaba kabili emzini owodwa, egcekeni elilodwa,''usho kanje. Umufi udutshulwa nje akukapheli ngisho unyaka uyise owayekade eyinduna kule ndawo, uMnuz Sphiwe Msweli, ahlaselwa ngamadoda angaziwa ambulala engaphandle kwesitolo sakhe.UNksz Msweli uthe ngesikhathi kubulawa uyise, kwakunamahemuhemu ayethi umphakathi umcasukele ngodaba lokwebiwa kwemfuyo. Kodwa manje uthe bayabona ukuthi akunjalo yinto nje lena eseceleni.Elinye ilingu lomphakathi likhale ezimathonsi ngendlela izinto ezenzeka ngayo kule ndawo. ''Sesiqala ukukhathazeka manje ngalesi simo esibonakala siqhubeka lapha oDidini. Hheyi baze baphela abantu bakule ndawo, lapho ubuholi bendawo buthule ungaze ufunge ukuthi busesontweni,'' kukhala ilungu lomphakathi.Elinye ilungu lomphakathi liveze ukuthi omama bakule ndawo sebekhetha ukumane balale emahlathini ngoba sebelala obenyoni emakhaya.''Omama ikakhulukazi labo okungekho abantu besilisa emakhaya abo, sebencamela ukulala emahlathini. Njalo ekuseni ubabona sebephuma nezingane zabo emahlathini. Angazi ke ukuthi bawabekezelela kanjani amakhaza,'' usho kanje. Elinye ilungu lithe kuyacaca ukuthi kunempi ewumshoshaphansi. Lithe okubuhlungu kule ndawo wukuthi kuhlinzwa abantu kuhlinzwe nezinkomo.''Akugcini nje ngokuthi abantu banqunyiswe okwezilwane. Kukhona abathile abangena emizini yethu, bathathe imfuyo, siyithola seyihlinziwe maqede ishiywe kanjalo.'' Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu Natal, uConstable Thenjiswa Ngcobo, usiqinisekisile isigameko.Uthe amaphoyisa aseMbumbulu aphenya icala lokubulawa kowesilisa oneminyaka engu-23.''Kusolakala ukuthi owesilisa udutshulwe wabulawa ngabantu abangaziwa,'' usho kanje.Kwenzeka lesi sigameko nje ngesonto eledlule kudutshulwe kwabulawa abesilisa abane ebebezosika utshani komunye umuzi wakule ndawo.
USHAQEKILE umndeni wentombazane yaseDokodweni, okutholakale isidumbu sayo silahlwe emobeni. Umufi uNksz Xolile Mpanza (18) akuqondakali ukuthi ngubani ombulele.Uninalume kamufi, uMnuz Jabulani Mpanza, uthe lesi simo sibahlukumezile kakhulu futhi abakakholwa wukuthi yinto eyenzeke ngempela.''Lokhu bengihlezi ngikubona kuthiwa kwenzekile kodwa bengingazitsheli ukuthi kungenzeka lapha eduze kakhulu,''usho kanje. Uthe lesi simo sibahlukumeze ngendlela engachazeki. Uthe: ''Indlela esizizwa ngayo njengomndeni ayichazeki. Ngikutshela ukuthi akucabangeki futhi akulaleki. Siwumndeni sihlukumezekile kakhulu.'' Uthe okudala isilonda esikhulu ukuthi bebesabheke lukhulu kumufi kanti abazi ukuthi uzohamba emhlabeni ngale ndlela enesihluku.Umufi kuvela ukuthi ushiye emhlabeni umntwana oneminyaka emithathu. Kutholakala isidumbu sakhe nje kuvelile ukuthi ubekade enyamalele. UNdunankulu waKwaZulu Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, uhambele umndeni kamufi ukuyobhonga emswaneni. Usigxekile lesi senzo wanxusa ukuthi kube khona ukusebenzisana phakathi kwamalungu omphakathi namaphoyisa ngenhloso yokubhekana ngqo nalesi sihlava sokuhlukunyezwa nokubulawa kwezingane nabantu besifazane.Uthe kumele batholakale abenzi bokubi ukuze bezojeza. ''Kumele itholakale ivalelwe le migulukudu ebulala izingane zethu zamantombazane ebese iyocasha yona iqhubeke iphile. Akumele kube njalo kumele baboshwe ukuze sizonqotshwa lesi sihlava,'' usho kanje.Uthe kuyichilo elibi kabi ukuthi kunamadoda akwazi ukwenza into enjengalena. Ulimise ngesihloko elokuthi lena yimidlwembe ecekela phansi igama lamadoda aqotho. ''Eqinisweni nje sibhekene nempi kodwa esingakwazi ukuthi siyinqobe uma nje singabambisana sonke.''Kuyona le ndawo kuhlalukile ukuthi kukhona nabanye besilisa abadlwengule intombazane bezifihlile ebusweni. Kuvelile ukuthi umgilwa usesibhedlela. Naso lesi sigameko uNtuli usigxeke kakhulu.
UMPHATHISWA emnyangweni wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu, uMfundisi, uThulasizwe Buthelezi, usigxekile isehlo zokuzama ukubulala inkosi uSimphiwe Cele weVukuzithathe Traditional Authority eZinqoleni, engaphansi kukamasipala waseRay Nkonyeni.Lokhu kuhlasela okwenzeke ngoLwesibili ngesikhathi inkosi ihlaselwa ihamba nabantu ababili emotweni. Kuthiwa amadoda angaziwa avulele ngenhlamvu ebhekise kuleyo moto, ngeshwa kwashona oyedwa wabagibeli, inkosi nomunye obehamba naye balimele. UButhelezi usenxuse abomthetho ukuthi basebenzise zonke izinsiza ukuze kuboshwe labo abenze lokhu.Ukholelwa ukuthi lokhu kuhlaselwa kwenkosi uCele nabambisene nabo kuwukubukela phansi ukuthula nozinzo esifundazweni ngenxa yemizamo yokudala ukungazinzi esifundazweni nasesikhungweni sobuholi bomdabu.Udlulise amazwi enduduzo emndenini kamufi waphinde wafisela iNkosi nomunye osindile ukululama okusheshayo nokugcwele.
UMNTWANA uThulani Zulu, okhulumela iNdlunkulu kaZulu useveze ukuthi noma ngabe iNkantolo yokweDluliswa kwamaCala eBloemfontein ikhipha siphi isinqumo, akukho okuyophazamisa ukubekwa esihlalweni kweSilo uMisuzulu kaZwelithini.UMntwana uThulani ukusho lokhu njengoba kusasa nangoLwesine, le nkantolo izolalela izethulo zethimba labameli bakaMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, ophonsela inselelo isinqumo seJaji uNorman Davis waseNorth Gauteng High, ePitoli, elanquma ukuthi uRamaphosa akenzanga kahle futhi kufana nento engekho ukukhipha kwakhe isitifiketi esiqinisekisa ukuthi iSilo uMisuzulu singena esihlalweni kulandela ukukhothama kweSilo uZwelithini kaBhekuzulu ngo-2021.UDavis wathi ukukhipha isitifiketi esigunyaza iSilo kukaRamaphosa, kwakungekho emthethweni futhi kufana nento engekho. Wathola ukuthi uRamaphosa wehluleka ukulandela imigudu efanele ngokweTraditional and Khoi-San Leadership Act 3 of 2019, ephinde yaziwe ngeLeadership Act, ngokwehluleka ukujuba ikomiti elizophenya ngesikhathi kuqubuka umbango wesihlalo phakathi kweSilo nomnewabo uMntwana uSimakade. Nakuba ijaji lamchitha uRamaphosa kodwa lamnika imvume yokusiphikisa lesi sinqumo kodwa lakubeka ukuthi mancane amathuba okuthi angaphumelela."Singakuqinisekisa ukuthi amaphaphu phansi Zulu! Asikho isidingo sokutatazela ngecala eliseBloemfontein, noma ngabe umengameli uthola muphi umphumela ngoba akukhulunywa ngesihlalo, kukhulunywa ngendlela eyalandelwa okwaholela ekukhishweni kwesitifiketi," kusho uMntwana uThulani esitatimendeni izolo.Uthe icala eliseBloemfontein elokucwaninga ukuthi kwahanjiswa ngendlela yini ngaphambi kokukhishwa kwesitifiketi. Uqhube wathi umphumela waleli cala awunamthelela esihlalweni nohlezi kuso ngoba iSilo uMisuzulu sabekwa sapheleliswa ngokwesiko esibayeni, esigodlweni KwaKhangelamankengana ngo-Agasti 20, 2022. UMntwana uThulani uthe isizwe kufanele sikuqonde ukuthi ukwamukeliswa kweSilo isitifiketi, akuhlangene nesiko lokungeniswa kwaso esibayeni okuyindlela isizwe neziNyandezulu abamukela ngayo ongena esihlalweni."Ngokwamukela isitifiketi isizwe nenkosi yaso, babehlonipha isigaba sikahulumeni noMbuso wanamuhla okumele siphile nawo futhi siwuhloniphe njengezakhamuzi zakuleli zwe," usho kanje.Uthe iSilo siyohlala siyiNgonyama yamaZulu sikhona noma singekho isitifiketi."Empeleni iqiniso lithi akekho owaphonsela inselelo iSilo uMisuzulu emuva kokuphumelela kwaso eMgungundlovu, okwaholela ekutheni sinikwe isitifiketi," kuphetha uMntwana uThulani.
UBALWA nalabo abalaliswe esibhedlela ngaphansi kweso lamaphoyisa umshayeli webhasi egingqike oThongathi, yabulala abantu abathathu, kwalimala inqwaba izolo.Lokhu kuvezwe uMphathiswa wezokuThutha KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Siboniso Duma, ngesikhathi ehambele indawo yesigameko. Bangu-15 abantu abalimale kule ngozi, baphuthunyiswa esibhedlela. Ngokusho kwabeRoad Traffic Inspectorate (RTI), isigameko senzeke ngezikhathi zasekuseni, umshayeli webhasi ehluleka ukuyilawula, emva kokuba iphelelwe amabhuleki.Kuthiwa uzame ukugwema ukushayisa ezinye izimoto, wayiphendula, wayiphonsa ebhulohweni elingamamitha angaphezu kuka-50. UDuma uthe bazokwenza uphenyo olugcwele ngesigameko, ukuphelelwa amabhuleki kwebhasi, nokuziphatha komshayeli kule ngozi. "Umshayeli webhasi uyaphila kodwa naye ulimele. Ulaliswe esibhedlela. Ubhekwe amaphoyisa ophiko lweSouth African Police Service (SAPS), okuyinto eyenziwayo uma kube nengozi ekanje,” kusho uDuma.Uthe udaba lokungasebenzi kwamabhuleki, yilona abathe uma befika endaweni yesigameko, batshelwa ngalo kuqala. Uthe bawathathile ama-rim ebhasi endaweni yesigameko ukuze ayohlolwa. Uveze ukuthi nebhasi ngokunjalo, lizothathwa (liyohlolwa). Uqhube wathi ngeke lusale ngaphandle olokubhekwa kokuthi abukho yini ubudedengu ohlangothini lwenkampani yebhasi. "Uma kutholakala ukuthi bukhona enkampanini yebhasi noma kumshayeli, sizophusha ukuthi babekwe icala lokubulala,” usho kanje.Uveze ukuthi uphenyo luzokwenziwa umnyango ngokubambisana namaphoyisa, iRTI neRoad Traffic Management Corporation (RTMC). Udalule ukuthi abafe engozini, abesifazane abathathu baseBurbreez, oThongathi, ku-ward 62. Bebesuka esitobhini sebhasi ngo-6 ekuseni, belibangise emsebenzini.UDuma uthe bafisa ukudlulisa amazwi enduduzo emindenini yabashonile, wabe esefisela labo abaphuthunyiswe esibhedlela ukululama okusheshayo.
KUHLELWE amabhasi angu-10 azothutha uZulu ozothamela icala elingena namuhla eNkantolo yokuDluliswa kwaMacala eBloemfontein. Namuhla nakusasa le nkantolo izolalela izethulo zabameli bakaMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, ofuna kuguqulwe isinqumo seJaji Norman Davis laseNorth Gauteng High, ePitoli, elanquma ukuthi uRamaphosa akenzanga kahle futhi kufana nento engekho ukukhipha kwakhe isitifiketi esiqinisekisa ukuthi iSilo uMisuzulu kaZwelithini sihlala esihlalweni kulandela ukukhothama kweSilo uZwelithini kaBhekuzulu ngo-2021.Leli jaji lachitha uRamaphosa nokho lamnika imvume yokusiphikisa lesi sinqumo kodwa lathi mancane amathuba okuthi angaphumelela."Kuzobe kukhona amabutho eviliyela, abantwana basendlunkulu namakhosi abazobe bembathe iBloemfontein kulezi zinsuku ezimbili," kusho okhulume neSolezwe ozazi zonke ezasendlunkulu. Uthe bazobe beholwa yiNkosi uZuzifa Buthelezi, esanda kuqokwa njengoSihlalo woMkhandlu weSilo. NgoMsombuluko uMntwana uThulani Zulu okhulumela iSilo uMisuzulu ucacisele, uZulu ngokudideka ngaleli cala wathi awehle amaphaphu umphumela walo ngeke uyishintshe eyesihlalo. Uthe noma ngabe inkantolo ikhipha siphi isinqumo akukho okuyophazamisa ukubekwa esihlalweni kweSilo uMisuzulu."Singakuqinisekisa ukuthi amaphaphu phansi Zulu! Asikho isidingo sokutatazela ngecala eliseBloemfontein mhla ka-28 no-29 noma ngabe uMengameli uthola muphi umphumela ngoba akukhulunywa ngesihlalo kukhulunywa ngendlela eyalandelwa okwaholela ekukhishweni kwesitifiketi," kusho uMntwana uThulani.Uthe leli cala elokucwaninga ukuthi kwahanjiswa ngendlela yini ngaphambi kokukhishwa kwesitifiketi. Uqhube wathi umphumela walo awunamthelela esihlalweni nohlezi kuso ngoba iSilo uMisuzulu sabekwa sapheleliswa ngokwesiko esibayeni esigodlweni KwaKhangelamankengane mhla zingu-20 Agasti 2022.
KUHLEHLE isicelo sebheyili kwengezwa amanye amacala amabili okubulala eNkantolo yeMantshi yasePinetown, kowesilisa okuthiwa usatshiswa okwenyoka eMariannhill, ngaphandle kwasePinetown.UMnuz Linda Hlongwa (31) odume ngelikaPutin, kwesinye isikhathi waziwa ngelikaMjinja, ubevele kule nkantolo, ebhekene namacala ahlukene.UMjinja uke waba sematheni maphakathi no-Ephreli kulo nyaka ngesikhathi eboshwa amaphoyisa eMidrand, eGoli. I-video yakhe yasabalala ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, ikhombisa ezama ukubaleka ngophahla lwebhilidi ayebhace kulo. Ukuboshwa kwakhe kwakamuva kulandela ukukhishwa kwencwadi eyayigunyaza ukuthi aboshwe, ngoSepthemba ngonyaka odlule. Amaphoyisa asabalalisa izithombe zakhe eveza ukuthi amfuna uthuli.Ngesikhathi kukhishwa leyo ncwadi, inkantolo yaveza ukuthi kusukela ngoJulayi 2020, wayengasayingeni eyokuza enkantolo ngecala ayelihamba lokutholakala nesibhamu esingekho emthethweni nezinhlamvu. Ngesikhathi evela izolo iMantshi, uNkk Gwendolyn Robinson, itshele uMjinja ukuthi emacaleni amahlanu abewazi, kwengezwa amanye amabili okubulala abesilisa ababili. Ithe womabili wawenza ngoMashi 28 nonyaka, KwaSanti ePinetown."Bobabili wababulala ngokubadubula,” kusho uNkk Robinson. UMjinja uphinde ubhekane namacala amabili okubulala owesifazane owayengunina wengane yakhe nonina, okuthiwa wababulala ngokubadubula ekhaya labo eNazaretha, ePinetown ngoMashi 18 kuwo lo nyaka. Inkantolo iphinde yathi kukhona elinye icala lokuzama ukubulala abhekene nalo. Ukwengezwa kwamacala akwaSanti okubulala, yiwo aholele ekutheni angabe esaqhubeka nokufaka isicelo sebheyini ngalawa amanye abevele aziwa. Ngomlomo wommeli wakhe uMnuz Nkosi, uMjinja ucele ukuthi ahlehliselwe usuku olulodwa wonke amacala akhe, ukuze akwazi ukufaka kahle isicelo sebheyili kuwona wonke. "Sizokwenza nesicelo sokuthi wonke lawa madokodo ahlanganiswe, abe yidokodo elilodwa,” kusho uNkosi. Inkantolo ibe isilihlehlisela uJuni 10 icala ukuze afake isicelo sebheyili. Enkantolo ungene ehlinile, ehlahla amehlo, ebuka wonke umuntu obekhona. Esebuyela emgodini, ubonakale ebingelelana nomunye wesilisa, obehamba nedlanzana ebelizomeseka. Ngokwezitatimende zamaphoyisa abezithumelela abezindaba ngesikhathi esafunwa, uMjinja unoxhaxha lwamacala okukhokhisa imali yokuvikela eMariannhill nakwamanye amalokishi angomakhelwane. Kuthiwa phakathi kwabantu abebakhokhisa 'womalume’ abathutha izingane zesikole, abezipaza nabamatekisi.
USULEKE izinyembezi owesifazane omncane waseVryheid, okuthe ngesonto eledlule wabhala enkundleni yokuxhumana ethi ucela isizo lokuthi aqasheke ukuze ashintshe isimo sakubo.UNksz Xolile Khoza ukhethe ukuyokhala azilahle ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ngoba sisibi isimo sakubo.Lokhu kwenze iMeya yaseBaqulusini, uMnuz Khehla Mkhwanazi nemenenja yalo masipala uNksz Sbonga Dlaminil, basukumela phezulu bahambela umndeni kaNksz Khoza, ukuze bayozibonela isimo. Uthe unina uyagula, uyise kwamphoqa ukuthi ashiye phansi umsebenzi ukuze anakekele inkosikazi yakhe ngoba wayedayisa edolobheni.Echaza ngesimo sakubo uNksz Khoza, uveze ukuthi ubenza iziqu zeComputer Science and Information Technology, azithole esikhungweni semfundo i-UKZN, eMgungundlovu.Ngemuva kwalokho uthe kwaphoqa ukuthi abuyele ekhaya ngoba eseqedile, wafike wabona ukuthi kumele asheshe athole umsebenzi ukuze ekhaya kulale kudliwe. Uthe kube nzima ukuthi athole umsebenzi ngemuva kokubuyela ekhaya okwenze wakhala ezinkundleni zokuxhumana."Ngibonga isibindi sami sokwenza lokhu ngoba ngisizakele kakhulu, kube khona abantu abanginikelele ukuze ekhaya silale sidlile. Ngesikhathi ngisafunda imali yeNSFAS ibike ingisize ngikwazi ukubathumelela yona badle. Ubaba wayedayisa imithombo erenki eVryheid, kodwa kwashintsha konke ngesikhathi kuqala ukugula kumama. Nami bese ngifunda ngifuna ukuqeda ukuze ngithole umsebenzi, ngishintshe isimo sasekhaya,” kuchaza yena.Uveze ukuthi akufisa kakhulu wukuthi athole umsebenzi ashintshe isimo somuzi wakubo ongemuhle. Uthe noma seluqhamukile usizo kodwa usazoqhubeka afake izicelo zomsebenzi kuze kube uyawuthola umsebenzi.UMkhwanazi uveze ukuthi lo mndeni ukwehlonzwe njengezohlumula ngokwakhelwa kabusha ikhaya ohlelweni oluholwa wuMkhandlu waseZululand."Ngiqale ngadideka ukuthi lo mndeni owakuphi ngoba isibongo sikaXolile akusona lesi thina esinaso phansi. Kodwa ngemuva kokuphenya kabanzi kulapho sithole khona ukuthi wumndeni owahlonzwa ngenyanga edlule. Uhlelo lolu olusungulwe wuzakwethu, iMeya yaseZululand, uMnuz Michael Khumalo, lokwakhela imindeni ehlukene imizi,” kuchaza yena. Okwamanje uthe abazokwenza wukuthi umndeni ulale njalo udlile njengoba befike nokudla ngosuku abahambele ngalo umndeni.Uphinde wanxusa abantu abahlukene ukuthi bafake isandla ukusiza umndeni.
KUSUKE isidumo wagcina ubhuntshile umngcwabo wekhansela eliyiPR laseLindelani, KwaDukuza, kulandela umbango wesidumbu emndenini elizalwa kuwo, nalowo eliganele kuwona.UNkk Sebenzile Sibiya, uMaMthembu, washona ngoMeyi 16, kulandela ukuqiniswa wukugula.Kuthiwa nakuba ebemningi emzini wakhe nomyeni wakhe ongasekho, oseLindelani, KwaDukuza, kodwa ubenawo omunye umuzi oseGingindlovu. Kuvela ukuthi umuzi oseGingindlovu yilapho abegcina khona amasiko akwakhe kwaSibiya, okuyilapho okwangcwatshwa khona umyeni wakhe ngo-2021.Ngokusho kwesihlobo esicele ukungadalulwa ngasohlangothini lakwaSibiya, ukudideka abangazange bakunake kuqale ngoMeyi 17, befica umndeni wakwaMthembu ugcwele indlu eLindelani.Sithe baqale banganaka kodwa imimoya yagcina iphakama emindenini yomibili, owakwaMthembu usuveza ukuthi inkonzo yomngcwabo izoba seLindelani, aye eGingindlovu eseyongcwatshwa. "Umfowabo kamyeni kamufi, okuwuye owengamela izinto zakwaSibiya, kwamdina lokho. Wathi umufi wathelwa ngenyongo kwaSibiya, akufanele ukuthi abakwaMthembu kube yibo asebehamba phambili ezinhlelweni zomngcwabo. Wagcina esukuma ehamba, kucaca ukuthi abatholani ngenkulumo nabakwaMthembu,” kusho isihlobo.Siqhube sathi kwaze kwagcina ngokuthi elinye ilungu lomndeni wakwaSibiya,libatshele abakwaMthembu ukuthi bekufanele bacele ukuthi umufi angcwatshwe eLindelani, hhayi ukuthi babatshele. "Bagcina bethi abacelelwe ke kumfowabo kamyeni kamufi ukuthi angcwatshwe eLindelani. Leli lungu labathembisa ukuthi impendulo izobuya uma umndeni wakwaSibiya usube nomhlangano ngesicelo sabo,” kusho isihlobo. Kuthiwa emhlanganweni, kwagcina kuvunywa eyokuthi inkonzo yomngcwabo kube yiyo ezoba seLindelani, kodwa umufi angcwatshwe eduze komyeni wakhe eGingindlovu. "Kuthe sisazitshela ukuthi sivumelene ngalokho, sahlaselwa abantu ababehlome ngezibhamu, bathi bathunywe abakwaMthembu bazositshela ukuthi umufi usezongcwatshwa eLindelani ngoba abanayo imali yokuhambisa isidumbu eGingindlovu,” usho kanje.Uthe umndeni wakwaSibiya wanikela khona, usuyofuna amaphepha ukuze uzenzele wonke amalungiselelo okufihla umakoti wawo. "Banqaba. Saze sagcina siye enduneni yendawo, eyazama ukuxazulula kodwa kwanhlanga zimuka nomoya,” kusho isihlobo.Sithe bagcine ngoLwesine benikela enkantolo beyofuna incwadi yesivimbelo, enikwe abamakhaza ngoLwesihlanu, kwathi sekumele isikhonzi siyinike umndeni wakwaMthembu, sabuya nayo, benqaba ukuyisayina.Siveze ukuthi ngoMgqibelo, umndeni wakwaMthembu uqhubekile nenkonzo yomngcwabo, abakwaSibiya baze balanda amaphoyisa ukuthi ayobabhekela ukuthi abamakhaza bagcine besidedele yini isidumbu, bathola ukuthi inkonzo iyaqhubeka yodwa ngaphandle kwesidumbu. Kuthiwa ngezikhathi zasemini abantu bagcine bezidlela ukudla, bahlakazeka kucaca ukuthi umngcwabo awukho."Sesilinde ukulanyulelwa yinkantolo ngoMeyi 29, isho ukuthi ubani onelungelo lokungcwaba umufi,” kusho isihlobo.Siveze ukuthi bekungekho ukuxakazisana phakathi komndeni wakwaSibiya nomufi, ngaphandle kombango wefa lomyeni wakhe, obusaqhubeka phakathi kukamufi nezingane zomyeni wakhe, zangaphandle komshado wabo. Uthe nokho ngesikhathi kuqhubeka impi yamazwi kule mindeni, abakwaMthembu baveze ukuthi umufi ngokomthetho ungowabo ngoba akazange abathole abantwana kwaSibiya. Induna yendawo (KwaDukuza), uNkk Pinky Ndunakazi ikuqinisekisile ukuthi udaba lulethiwe kuyo wumndeni wakwaSibiya maphakathi nesonto eledlule. "Bangendlalela ukuthi banenkinga nomndeni wakwaMthembu, kubo kamakoti wabo, osubajikele esiswini njengotshwala, wathi ngeke umufi esaya ukuyofihlwa eGingindlovu, usezofihlwa la,” kusho uNkk Ndunakazi. UNkk Ndunakazi uthe wasukumela phezulu, wacela ezinye izinduna zezigodi ezingomakhelwane ukuba zimkhaphe ayozwa uhlangothi lwabakwaMthembu. "Safica kukhona umakoti kamfowabo kamufi, owathi umyeni wakhe okunguye okufanele achaze uhlangothi lwabo, akekho,” kusho uNkk Ndunakazi.Uthe kwathi uma ecela inombolo yakhe, umakoti wala, wathi okungcono uNkk Ndunakazi akashiye eyakhe, uzoyidlulisela kumyeni wakhe uma esebuyile. "Ngayishiya, kodwa akazange angithinte, kwaze kwaba yingakusasa. Umndeni wakwaSibiya ke wagcina usuya enkantolo yomthetho,” usho kanje.Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula komndeni wakwaMthembu ayiphumelelanga, ucingo lukamfowabo kamufi, belukhala lungabanjwa.
ISIKHWAMA esixhasa ngemali yokufunda ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme iNSFAS sesizibophezele ukuthi siyayilungisa inkinga yokungakhokhelwa kwezinkumbi zezitshudeni.Abalesi sikhwama bathe kunezinselelo ekukhokhelweni kwezitshudeni ezikhungweni ezehlukene.Esitatimendeni esikhishwe ngokuhlanganyela yiNSFAS noMnyango weMfundo ePhakeme, kuvele ukuthi kube nokubambezeleka ekukhokhelweni kwezitshudeni. Sithe le nkinga yenze ukuthi izitshudeni zingazi ukuthi kwenzekani. "Ezinye zezitshudeni ezifake izicelo emanyuvesi zibhekene nezinselelo zokungakhokhelwa. Kanjalo nalezo okulethwe imininingwane yazo yokubhalisa sekudlule isikhathi kube nezinselelo zangakhokhelwa." Sithe ezinye izitshudeni ebezisalinde izimpendulo emva kokufaka izimangalo ngokungalutholi uxhaso zibe nezinselelo zangakhokhelwa."Kulezo ebezilinde izimpendulo ngoba zafaka izimangalo kunezinselelo zokuthi kudingeka kutholakale imali ngenxa yokuthi isincane ekhona. Kodwa yinkinga esizama ukuyixazulula ngokushesha," kusho isitatimende. Umnyango unxuse izikhungo ukuthi zisize izitshudeni zixazulule izinkinga ezikhona ngokushesha."Sizimisele ukusiza zonke izitshudeni okumele zithole uxhaso ngokuthi sihlwaye imali ukuze zingaphazamiseki ezifundweni zazo. Sinxusa ukuthi zibekezele ziphinde ziqonde ukuthi sisebenza ngamandla ukuxazulula lezi zinkinga." Isitatimende sithe izitshudeni kumele zibheke imibiko ezovela kwiNSFAS kanjalo nasenyuvesi mayelana nezithinta uxhaso. Lesi sikhwama sihlale sibhekene nezinselelo minyaka yonke ngokuxhaswa kwezitshudeni.Lokhu kwenza ukuthi kuze kube nemibhikisho ezikhungweni ezehlukene ngenxa yokuthi izitshudeni zisuke zifuna ukuxhaswa, ekubeni lesi sikhwama sisuke sisacubungula ezinye zezinto ezibandakanya nokuthi kubhekwe labo abasuke bechithwe ukuthola uxhaso.Akuzona kuphela izitshudeni ezikhala ngokungaxhaswa kodwa nabanye omastende bakhala ngokuphuza ukukhokhelwa yilesi sikhwama. Bakhala ngokuthi baze bagcine sebexosha izitshudeni ngoba zingakhokhelwe.INSFAS ihlale ihlaba ikhwelo lokuthi omastende mabangazixoshi izitshudeni ezisuke zingakhokhelwe ngoba ziphenduka ondingasithebeni.
KUBHUNTSHILE ukugwetshwa kwabamangalelwa ababhekene necala lokubulala abangu-9 ehostela eGlebelands, eMlaza kubangwa imibhede. Inkantolo enkulu yaseThekwini izolo bekulindeleke ukuthi iwise isigwebo kuleli cala kodwa lokho kwangenzeka.Icala lihlehliselwe uJuni 18 njengoba kuvele ukuthi ijaji obekumele liwise isigwebo likwelinye icala elibucayi. Abamangalelwa kuleli cala ngoMnuz Bongile Mabele (34), Siyamthemba Zintenteni Mthwana (32), Nkosayikhethi Njeya (35), Bongani Patrick Mboyiyana (38), noSibusiso Mkhonde ( 41), bonke ababehlala ngaphakathi kuleli hostela.Kuvela ukuthi laba badubula babulala oMnuz Phakamani Lukhozi, Thamsanqa Helman Shongwe, Mpilo Christopher Khumalo, Lungani Sikobi, Yandisa Ennox Msungubali, Nkululeko Freedom Lukhozi, Bongani Petros Mkane, Mxolisi Comfort Mthethwa noMandla Bhodloza Mncaka. Abamangalelwa babekwe amacala ayisishiyagalolunye okubulala kanjalo namane okuzama ukubulala nawokutholakala nezibhamu ezingekho emthethweni.Kuthiwa abafi babulawa behlezi ndawonye ngobusuku bangoJuni 2, 2023 eBlock 57 kulona leli hostela. Ababulawa kuhlaluke ukuthi babedutshulwa ekhanda, entanyeni nasesifubeni.Bonke abagilwa kuvela ukuthi umnyombo wokubulawa kwabo kwakuwumbango wemibhede owawudla lubi eGlebelands bengakaboshwa abamangalelwa. Njengenjwayelo izolo bebephume ngobuningi babo ebebezokweseka abamangalelwa.Phambilini kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi abamangalelwa bake bashaya ungqimphothwe, bethi kabasamdingi ummeli wabo. Kodwa babuye batshela inkantolo ukuthi sebeyambuyisa.Lokhu kwaze kwanenga uMbuso ukhala ngokuthi lawa ngamaqhinga okulibazisa icala ukuze lingabi nayo inqubekela phambili.
OWAYENGUMENGAMELI wezwe uMnuz Jacob Zuma usephonsele enye yezingane zakhe inselelo yokuthi iqhubeke isebenze kanzima nangokuzikhandla, ukuze ibe nekusasa eliqhakazile, okuzokwenza ikwazi ukuzimela futhi inganciki kuyena.UZuma (83) usho kanje ebongela indodakazi yakhe uNksz Bridget Zuma, othweswe iziqu ze-Advanced Diploma in Taxation eDurban University of Technology (DUT), emcimbini obuse-Olive Convention Centre, eThekwini.Bese kungokwesibili uZuma ongumholi weqembu uMkhonto weSizwe, ehambela umcimbi wendodakazi yakhe kule nyuvesi njengoba ayekhona futhi ngesikhathi ithweswa iziqu zeDiploma in Taxation ngoMeyi wango-2023. Kulokhu, njengenjwayelo, kuthe eqhamuka nje - kwezwakala inhlokomo ezihambelini zomcimbi, zimjabulela ehlala eduze kwabanye abazali abebezobungaza izingane zabo. "Ngijabule kakhulu ngesikhathi ngizwa kubizwa igama lakhe esiteji, futhi ngiyaziqhenya ngaye. Kuhlale kuyintokozo kimina ukubona izingane ziphumelela, ngakho ngimfisela okuhle kodwa - futhi ngifuna ukuthi aqhubeke nezifundo zakhe. Naye uyakwazi lokho ngoba ngihlale ngimtshela ukuthi imfundo ayiqedwa, ngakho ngifuna aqhubekele phambili ukuze ezokwazi ukuzimela, abe nempilo engcono," kusho uZuma. Emva kokuthweswa iziqu, uBridget (28) yena, uthe into aseyibheke kakhulu manje wukuthola umsebenzi nokuthi aqhubeke nemfundo yakhe ukusiza ukuzicabela indlela yokuba nekusasa eliqhakazile. "Inhloso yami wukuqhubeka ngiphile kahle ngoba ngikholelwa ekutheni uNkulunkulu wangidalela ukuthi ukube njalo. Okwamanje angisebenzi, ngifuna umsebenzi kanti futhi nginethemba lokuthi ngizowuthola ungakapheli lo nyaka. Angikhethile, ngibheke ukuthatha noma yiluphi uhlobo lomsebenzi engizokwazi ukuwenza okuhambisana nomkhakha engiwufundele futhi angibhekile ukuthola into enkulu okwamanje ngoba ngisafuna ukukhula ngize ngibe namava okwenza nokuzuza okukhulu kakhulu," kusho uBridget.Uncome nesikhungo iDUT ngokuqhuba ivangeli lenhlonipho, athi kungesinye sezimiso akhuliswe ngaso ekhaya futhi esihlale sigcizelelwa nguyise kuyena. Uthe uhlela nokuthi uma esesimeme kahle ezimalini, aqhubeke nemfundo yakhe akwazi ukuzikhokhela izindleko.Ethula umyalezo wokubongela izitshudeni ezithweswe iziqu emcimbini, uSolwazi Oludayo Olugbara, esinye sezikhulu zomkhakha we-Accounting ne-Informatics eDUT, uzincome ngokuzikhandla emsebenzini wazo wesikole, wase enxusa ukuthi zenze umehluko obonakalayo emphakathini ngemfundo yazo.
SIBUYE sinjengoba sinjalo kuNkk Thembisile Hlatshwayo (45), isithombe sendodakazi yakhe engasekho emhlabeni, uNksz Sinenhlanhla Hlatshwayo (25), ngesikhathi eyokwamukela iziqu zayo ze-Diploma in Information and Communications Technology, emcimbini wokuthweswa iziqu weDurban University of Technology (DUT), obuse-Olive Convention Centre, eThekwini ngoMgqibelo.Exoxa neSolezwe ngalo mzuzu, emva kokwamukela iziqu zendodakazi uNkk Hlatshwayo, uthe lubuye lunjengoba lunjalo usizi lokushiywa wumntwana wakhe, amshiya nezingane zakwabo ezine ezimelamayo, ikakhulu njengoba ahamba emhlabeni engagulanga."Namanje asikapholi leso silonda ngenxa yendlela ahamba ngayo emhlabeni, namanje engisadidekile ngayo. Wabuya ekhaya ngoNovemva 2024, emva kokuqeda ukuhlolwa kokuphela konyaka, kwadlula isonto elilodwa, kwasa ethule emva kokuthi sihlukene ngayizolo ebusuku siyolala engenalutho nje. Kusenzima ukwamukela isimo esangehlela, ngoba ngihlale ngizibuza ukuthi senzeka kanjani, namanje angizitholi izimpendulo,” kusho uNkk Hlatshwayo. Uthe wayenethemba lokuthi njengoba ayesefundile, kwakuzothi angaphothula izifundo zakhe, athole iziqu bese efuna ngazo umsebenzi owawuzokwenza isimo sasekhaya sibe ngcono kakhulu kunesiyikhona manje. "Ubewumntwana oziphethe kahle, ekhonze isonto futhi ubengenangane njengoba sibona sekuwumkhuba ovamile kontanga yakhe, abazala ngapha nangapha, bagcine bengaqedanga isikole. Kubuhlungu ukuthi umntwana wakho wokuqala ukuya enyuvesi, esikhathini okumele ngabe sijabulela umvuzo wakhe, usuwamukelwa yimina ngendlela ebuhlungu kangaka manje,” kusho yena.Yize kubuhlungu kanjalo, uNkk Hlatshwayo waseMachibini, eMtubatuba, enyakatho yaKwaZulu-Natal, uthe ubone kubalulekile ukuthi afike ukuzokwamukela iziqu zomntwana wakhe ngoba ubebona ukuthi ubezikhandla kangakanani ngezifundo zakhe. Uthe wethemba ukuthi lokhu kuzokhuthaza izingane zakhe ezisele ukuqhubeka nemfundo zihambe ezinyathelweni zikadadewabo ongasekho emhlabeni.

KUHLUKENE imibono ngokuxhaswa komcimbi wezindondo, amaMetro FM Music Awards, wuMasipala weTheku. Lo masipala umemezele ukuthi ungene esivumelwaneni nabahleli bamaMetro Awards, seminyaka emithathu esizowudla u-R25 million."UMasipala usuzibophezele esivumelwaneni sokusingatha umcimbi odumile amaMetro FM Music Awards ozofaka kuwo imali engu-R25 million eminyakeni yemali emithathu ezayo," kusho umasipala esitatimendini oveze ukuthi lesi siphakamiso senziwe emhlanganweni oyisipesheli wesigungu obungoLwesihlanu.Sithe kulo mhlangano kuthathwe izinqumo ezizosiza ukuphuthumisa ukuhlinzekwa kwezidingo emphakathini. Siqhube sathi izinqumo ezithathiwe, zisazodluliselwa esigungwini sawo wonke amakhansela. Umkhandlu uthe lesi sivumelwano sizosiza ukubeka iTheku ebalazweni nokuheha abavakashi Kuvezwe nokuthi kuzodaleka amathuba omsebenzi kuphinde kwenze iTheku laziwe nasemazweni angaphandle.UMnuz Zwakele Mncwango ohola i-Action SA ethintwa, uthe kuyamethusa ukukhishwa kwalesi simemezelo ekubeni umkhandlu ophelele weTheku ungakaziswa."Ubani osayine lesi sivumelwano isigungu esiphelele singakabikelwa, izothathwa kusiphi isabelomali le mali okuzoxhaswa ngayo lo mcimbi?" kubuza uMncwango. Uthe lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi umkhandlu ophelele ubukelwa phansi uma kuzothathwa izinqumo ngaphandle kwawo. Uqhube wathi iTheku linenkinga yengqalasizinda exosha izivakashi nendle egelezela olwandle."Uma ungakulungisile konke lokhu ulindele ukuthi ubani ozovakashela eThekwini? Siyayidinga imicimbi ezofukula umnotho wedolobha kodwa kuya ngokuthi kusetshenziswa imali engakanani," kusho uMncwango.Uthe le mali ngabe itshalwa ezintweni ezizosiza izakhamuzi njengohlelo lwamabhasi iGo Durban obeluzohlanganisa izindawo ezingaphansi kweTheku. Okhulumela i-DA kwezokuThuthukiswa koMnotho eThekwini, uNksz Welekazi Sibiya, uthe bayakwamukela ukubuya kwamaMetro FM Awards eThekwini. Kodwa, uthe bazovula amehlo ngoba imicimbi efana nalena ayiphathwanga ngendlela phambilini."I-DA izobamba iqhaza elikhulu ukulandelela ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izakhamuzi ziyahlomula njengoba kuthembisa abahleli bomcimbi," kusho uNksz Sibiya.I-EFF eThekwini ngomlomo kaMnuz Themba Mvubu, ithe uma lesi sivumelwano sizozuzisa izakhamuzi bazoseseka.Umbuzo okhona owokuthi yini ezozuzwa abantu esibamele kulokhu, uma impendulo ithi kukhona asinaso isizathu sokuphikisa, " kusho uMvubu. Uthe banomthwalo wokuvusa iTheku ngakho imicimbi ezokwenza lokhu ngeke bayiphikisa. "Kufanele siwuqede umqondo wokuthi izindawo eziphethwe abantu abamnyama aziphumeleli yingakho singeke sakuphikisa okuzoyisa iTheku phambili, inqobo uma kuzozuza umphakathi," kusho uMvubu.Umasipala uphinde waveza ukuthi uzothengela uphiko lwawo lwamanzi nokuthuthwa kwendle izimoto, ogandaganda namaloli athwala amanzi ngo-R784. 8 million."Lokhu kuzobhekana nenkinga yengqalasizinda esigugile, isidingo samanzi esiphezulu nokuphazanyiswa kokuhlinzekwa kwezidingo, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezakhahlanyezwa yizikhukhula neziyimijondolo," kusho iTheku. Umasipala uthe ukunciphisa ukuthembela emalolini amanzi aqashiwe kuzokwehlisa izindleko. Uveze ukuthi unamaloli amanzi angu-299, okubalwa asanda kuthengwa asebenza ezindaweni eziseThekwini."Kodwa, lezi zimoto azanele ukuhlangabezana nokwanda kwabantu nemijondolo engenayo ingqalasizinda yamanzi."

UNGQONGQOSHE wezokuXhumana uMnuz Solly Malatsi uqinisekise ukuthi uzosihlonipha isimemo sekomiti lezokuxhumana ePhalamende, elifuna azochaza ngomyalelo oshicilelwe okuthiwa uvuna inkampani ye-internet, iStarlink.NgoLwesihlanu uMalatsi ukhiphe umyalelo obukeka uxegisela inkampani yempunyela uMnuz Elon Musk iStarlink, ukuthi ingene kuleli. Phambilini obekuvimbile bekuthiwa yimithetho yokuthi izinkampani zaphesheya kumele zibambisane nezosomabhizinisi bakuleli uma zifuna ukuzoqala ukusebenza ngokweBroad-Based Black Economic Empowerment (B-BBEE).USihlalo wekomiti lezokuxhumana ePhalamende, uNkk Khusela Diko esitatimendeni ngempelasonto, uthe bameme uMalatsi ukuthi azochaza ngesenzo sakhe athe sibukeka singahambisani ne-Electronics Communications Act. "USection 9 (2) (b) we-Electronics Communications Act (ECA) 36 ka-2005 ubeka imigomo ngesicelo nemvume yelayisensi emkhakheni wezokuxhumana futhi uyalela i-Icasa (Independent Communication Authority of South Africa), ukuthi ibhekele ukuthi ababencishwe amathuba phambilini bathola ingxenye engekho ngaphansi kuka-30%,” kusho uNkk Diko.Uthe umhlangano uzoba sePhalamende ngoLwesibili ngo-9 ekuseni.UMalatsi ubhale ku-X ukuthi uzosihlonipha isimemo. IStarlink wubuchwepheshe be-internet okuthiwa busebenza ngisho emakhaya lapho oyithengayo ethola okubekwa ngaphandle kubheke emkhathini kudonse i-network ne-router bese ekhokha ngenyanga ukuthola i-internet.

UMalema ubuye wasola uRamaphosa ngokudayisa ngezwe ethi kugcwele ubugebengu."Njengoba ekhale ngokuthi bayabulawa abantu kuleli, ubulele ezokuvakasha ngoba ngeke beseza kuleli abantu baseMelika bezovakasha. Bekungamele yena akhulume kabi kangaka ngezwe lakhe," kusho uMalema.Uthe uhluleke nawukuvikela uMthethosisekelo wezwe ngokuthi angakuvezi ukuthi ingoma i-Dubul' ibhunu' yagunyazwa yinkantolo yoMthethosisekelo. "Le ngoma akuyona eyami, ayisungulwanga yimi. Yingoma eyaculwa abalwela umzabalazo. Kwakumele uma uTrump ebuza ukuthi kungani ngingaboshwa, akuveze ukuthi le ngoma yavunywa yinkantolo."Uthe kucacile ukuthi i-EFF ayifile njengoba kukhona abebesho lokhu ngenxa yokuthi eMelika kukhulunywa ngaleli qembu.Uveze ukuthi akamesabi uTrump futhi ngeke agwajiswe nguyena. "Angimesabi (Trump), kwakumele bangibize emhlanganweni wabo ukuze ngimtshele amaqiniso ngaphandle kokwesaba uTrump. Angimesabi futhi abasoze bangisabisa neMelika yakhe," kusho uMalema.Ugxeke impunyela yakuleli uMnuz John Rupert owagxeka umholi we-DA eMelika, uMnuz John Steenhuisen, phambi kukaTrump ukuze abukeke kahle."Asinandaba ne-DA noSteenhuisen, kodwa uma singaphandle kwakuleli kumele sivikelane. URupert wazibeka kahle egxeka uSteenhuisen ngobugebengu obenzeka eWestern Cape, ephethwe yi-DA," usho kanje.Uthe akakwesabi ukufa ngoba uyazi ukuthi njengoba uTrump abuza ukuthi kungani engaboshiwe ngokucula ingoma egqugquzela ukubulawa kwamabhunu, kusho ukuthi kumele abulawe. Ubuye waveza nokuthi ngeke babuyisane neqembu eliholwa ngowayengumengameli wezwe ne-ANC uMnuz Jacob Zuma, Umkhonto weSizwe."Ngeke sibuyisane neMK noZuma.Uma babefuna sihlangane singamaqembu amnyama, kwakumele bajoyine i-EFF bangavuli amaqembu amasha. Uma bevula amaqembu kusho ukuthi bahlukanisa phakathi abantu abamnyama," kusho uMalema.Uvale ngokucula iDubul' ibhunu.

ABEZINHLAKA ezilwa nobugebengu eNanda eThekwini, bazifaka zonke ezimbanjeni kuhulumeni, ngezibalo zobugebengu ezingakhombisi ukuba ngcono, ngasebugebengwini bokubulawa kwabantu nobokudlwengula.Lokhu kuvele ngesikhathi Isolezwe linenkulumo ekhethekile noMnuz Andile Jali weThekwini Neighbourwood Watch.Ingxoxo kaJali ilandela ukudedelwa kwezibalo zobugebengu zekota yokugcina yonyaka u-2024/2025, ezikhishwe nguNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, ngoLwesihlanu. Kulezi zibalo kuvele ukuthi isiteshi saseNanda, siqengqeleza phambili ngesibalo samacala okubulala abikwe kuso eNingizimu Afrika yonke.Silele isibili ngesibalo samacala okudlwengula abikwe kuso. Siphinde silale isibili ngawokuzama ukubulala.Akuyona into entsha ukuthi lesi siteshi sibe sohlwini lweziteshi ezinhlanu ezizihola phambili ngesibalo esikhulu samacala abucayi eMzansi. UJali uthe abantu okufanele bazinuke amakhwapha ngalezi zibalo ezihlasimulisa umzimba, wuhulumeni wesifundazwe kanjalo noMasipala weTheku. "Thina sisemphakathini, sazi ukusuka nokuhlala ngobugebengu. Siphumele obala, sathi sizimisele ngokulekelela ekulweni nobugebengu, saze sakha ngisho nezinhlaka ezilwa nabo,” kusho uJali. Uthe bona futhi benze yonke imizamo ukuhambisa ezinhlakeni zikahulumeni uhla lwabo ebebebona ukuthi lungalekelela ekutheni kuncishiswe ubugebengu. "Sihlale nabo emihlanganweni eminingi ema-boardroom, sabatshela esibona ukuthi kuzosebenza. Abakwenze ngenkulu impumelelo wukuthi basilalele, maqede basithembisa ukuthi bazozibuyekeza iziphakamiso zethu, kwabe siyagcina ke ukuzwa kubo,” kusho uJali. Ebuholini bukahulumeni abugagule ngamagama uthe uNdunankulu wesifundazwe uMnuz Thami Ntuli, yiMeya yeTheku uMnuz Cyril Xaba, noNksz Zandile Myeni oyiPhini lemeya kulo masipala, aphinde abe ngusihlalo wezokuphepha komphakathi kumasipala.Ebalula iziphakamiso ezimbalwa kwathi bazenza kuhulumeni, uthe babecele ukuthi lubuyekezwe olwesibalo sezimoto abazozisebenzisa beqapha ubugebengu, ababezithenjiswe wuNdunankulu waphambilini, uNkk Nomusa Dube-Ncube. Uthe babuye bacela ukuthi uMasipala weTheku ukopele uhlelo lwabaqaphi bobugebengu lwaseGoli olwaziwa ngelama-waderns.Wengeza ngokuthi baphinde baphakamisa ukuthi uma uhulumeni ehlela ukuthenga izimpahla zokuqapha ubugebengu zezinhlangano ezifuze eyabo emiphakathini, kumele baqale baxoxisane nazo, ukuze bathenge lokho ezithi ziyakudinga. "Akusilekeleli ukuthi bathenge bengaxhumanile nathi ngoba thina siyazi ukuthi sidingani. Uzothola bethenga okuthile kanti thina sidinga amabhuzu, amajakhethi afudumalayo, nalawo avimba imvula. Kuhle babuze thina,” usho kanje. Uthe bayakuqonda ukuthi uhulumeni ngeke akwazi ukuvele abe nesamba sokubaholela ngokuqapha ubugebengu emphakathini, kodwa banxusa ukuthi akulalele abasuke bekuphakamisa. INanda yindawo ehlushwa kakhulu yiqembu lemigulukudu elibizwa ngeWest.Ngokusho kwezakhamizi, ezikhala mihla namalanga ngobugebengu bokubulawa kwabantu, leli qembu linamalungu evile ku-200 ayintsha esencane, okwenza kube nzima ukuthi liphele. Ziningi izehlakalo lapho amalungu alo ebulawa khona amaphoyisa, itholene phezulu ngezibhamu. Muva nje kukhona nababalelwa kwabayisishiyagalombili ababoshiwe emasontweni ambalwa edlule, kwabonakala umphakathi ubhikisha ngaphandle kweNkantolo yeMantshi yaseNtuzuma, uthi abangadedelwa ngebheyili. Yize kunjalo kodwa ubugebengu bokubulawa kwabantu eNanda, bubikwa nsuku zonke.UNtuli uhlale ekuveza ukuthi bayalwa nobugebengu obudlangile esifundazweni.
UNDUNANKULU waKwaZulu-Natal uMnuz Thami Ntuli, uthe uma bethi bafuna abantu bakwamanye amazwe babe kuleli ngokusemthethweni, akungoba bengabafuni kulesi sifundazwe kodwa kumele kulandelwe umthetho.UNtuli obekhuluma izolo kugujwa i-Africa Day ezwenikazi i-Afrika, oLundi, uthe bafuna abantu bakwamanye amazwe babe nezimvume."Sifuna abantu bakwamanye amazwe babe nezimvume zokuba kuleli. Sifuna bangene ngesango, hhayi ukufohla. Lokho siyaphikisana nakho ngoba abenza lokho bayizigilamkhuba," kusho uNtuli. Uthe abayihloniphi imithetho yokubuswa kwezwe abangena ngokungemthetho."Njengezwe nesifundazwe kumele siwuvikele umnotho wakuleli. Kwamanye amazwe kukhona lapho umuntu ongeyena owakulelo lizwe, engeke avule ibhizinisi lokucwala izinwele, elingadingi ikhono." Uthe kumele kunxenxwe amazwe namazwe ukuthi avakashele oNdini ngoba kunomlando obalulekile othinta namaliba amanye amakhosi aKwaZulu. Usuku i-Africa Day lugujwa njalo ngoMeyi 25. Ngalolu suku kwabunjwa inhlangano i-Organisation of African Unity, eyagcina isiyaziwa nge-African Union.Kuzwelonke umgubho walolu suku ubuseFreedom Park Heritage Site eGoli.UNgqongqoshe ehhovisi likamengameli uNksz Maropene Ramokgopa, uthe kubalulekile ukuthi i-Africa ibumbane. Ekhuluma eThekwini izolo, uthe bahlale belukhumbula lolu suku ngoba ngalo kwabunjwa inhlangano ebaluleke kakhulu e-Africa.Uthe kumele ngalolu suku kubunjwane kuthuthukiswe nezwekazi i-Afrika."Kumele ngaso sonke isikhathi sigqugquzele ubumbano e-Afrika. Uncome nowayengumholi we-ANC Inkosi Albert Luthuli, ngeqhaza lakhe ekubumbeni abantu base-Afrika."
ISILO uMisuzulu kaZwelithini seluleke amakhosi ukuba ayeke ukuphila impilo ewubukhazikhazi kodwa anake imiphakathi ayiphethe. ISilo besikhuluma emkhosini wokuthela amanzi obusesigodlweni eMashobeni, oPhongolo, ngoLwesihlanu.Inhloso yalo mcimbi wukubusisa amakhosi asenikwe izihlalo. NgoLwesihlanu, kubusiswe amakhosi amahlanu okuyiNkosi uMM Dube yesizwe sakwaDube eKing Cetshwayo, iNkosi uPMT yakwaMathaba eMacambini, iNkosi SB Lushaba yakwaLushaba, iNkosi NI Zikhali yakwaMbila eMkhanyakude neNkosi BM Mkhize yaseSimahla eThekwini."Zibambeni ziqine ngoba kasilula isihlalo ngoba kuthatha isikhathi eside kungavunyelwana ngosifanele. Ngiyanibongela ngokuqokwa kwenu ngakho-ke ngiyaniyala ukuba ningaphili impilo yobukhazikhazi kodwa ninake umphakathi," kuyala iSilo. UMphathiswa wokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, naye obehambele lo mcimbi echaza ngawo uthe uyingxenye yohlelo lokubekwa kwamakhosi kanti ugunyazwe wumthetho iKwaZulu-Natal Traditional Leadership and Governance Act. Uthe wenziwa yiSilo ngaphambi kokubekwa kwenkosi esihlalweni. "Silapha simele uhulumeni wesifundazwe ukuzokweseka iSilo kulo msebenzi. Uqinisekisa ukuthi amakhosi ethulwa ngokusemthethweni eNdlunkulu futhi ayikho inkosi engabekwa lungenziwanga lolu siko," kusho uButhelezi.Uthe asengu-17 amakhosi asenzelwe lo mcimbi okuyigxathu elibalulekile ekuqiniseni isikhungo sobukhosi. Uqhube wathi, njengoMnyango bayohlale beyeseka imicimbi efana nalona. Njengendlela yokubonga, kulo mcimbi obuthanyelwe amakhosi, amabutho nezintombi, amakhosi aphe iSilo izipho okubalwa kuzo inkomo nezimbuzi. Akhombise ukujabula kwawo eSilweni njengoba abemukela ngokusemthethweni umsebenzi asenikwe wona wokuhola imiphakathi yawo. Inkosi Mathaba yaseMacambini ebijabule, ithe kungokokuqala lolu siko lwenziwa ozalweni lwayo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, inkosi Lushaba ithe lolu siko luzoqinisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwesizwe sakwaLushaba neNdlunkulu.
EMHLANGANWENI obuphakathi kukaMengameli uCyril Ramaphosa noMengameli uDonald Trump kuzwakele ukuthi imibuzo ebibuzwa nguTrump ibinenhlese yezimvo kanye nezimfuno zeqeqebana eleseka amaJuda. Kucace bha ukuthi imibuzo ibihlose ukujivaza iNingizimu Afrika ngesenzo sayo sokumangalela elaKwa-Israel eNkantolo yezoBulungiswa yaMazwe Omhlaba. Kuqaphelekile ukuthi okaTrump ubegxile kakhulu ekusebenziseni igama lokubhuqwabhuqwa kwabantu ngesikhathi egxeka iNingizimu Afrika ngokuhlukunyezwa nokubulawa kwabalimi abamhlophe.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi nayo iNingizimu Afrika yamangalela elaKwa-Israel ngaso belu isigameko sokubulawa kwabantu abaningi abayizakhamuzi zaseGaza, ePalestine, Maphakathi neMpumalanga. Njengalokhu ngingusomlando, ngiyafisa ukuveza isithombe sokuthi akufihliwe ukuthi elaKwa-Israel aliyifuni nalapho ihambe khona iNingizimu Afrika. Ukusetshenziswa kwegama lokubhuqwabhuqwa kwabantu kwalilimaza kakhulu elaKwa-Israel ngokomqondo, lokhu ngikusho ngoba isibhicongo sokubulawa kwamaJuda ebulawa ngamasosha amaJalimane ayeholwa nguu-Adolf Hitler ngesikhathi sempi yesibili, akugcinanga nje ngokuwahlukumeza amaJuda kepha mkhulu umonakalo owenzeka ezingqondweni zawo. Yingakho-ke isenzo seNingizimu Afrika sokumangelela amaJuda ngokubulawa kwabantu eGaza sidale enkulu intukuthelo nenzondo.Enkulumweni kaMengameli Trump bekuzwakala ukuthi uyafisa kubukeke sengathi kubulewe izigidigidi zabalimi kodwa iqiniso lithi kazikho lezo zigidigidi zabalimi ababulewe. Asikuvume ukuthi bakhona abalimi ababulewe kodwa asikwazi ukwamukela ihaba likaMengameli Trump, ehubhuza aluhlaza, ebiza ukubulawa kwalelo dlanzana labalimi ngesibhicongo sokubulawa kwabalimi.Uma singasebenzisa ulimi lwesimanje, inkulumo kaTrump kade iwukuziphindiselela kwezwe laKwa-Israel kwelaseNingizimu Afrika lisebenzisa uMengameli Donald Trump ongunontandakubukwa.Izingxoxo zakamuva maqondana nobudlelwano bezwe laseMelika (US) kanye nelaKwa-Israel, ingxabano ekhona phakathi kwabaKwa-Israel kanye namaPalestina, ipolitiki yamazwe aMaphakathi neMpumalanga okungavamile ukuthi uma kukhulunywa ngayo, ingaphathwa indaba yeqeqebana lamaMelikana eseka ama-Israeli. Labo abayiqeqebana eleseka u-Israel bajwayele ukugxekwa ngokweseka nokugqugquzela udlame olubhekiswe kumaPalestine nabaseLebanoni, ngokungafuni kweMelika ukucindezela kumbe ukugxeka elaKwa-Israel kanye nangokungenisa kwe-Iraq ngokunjalo nokwesatshiswa kwakamuva kwezwe lase-Iran. Sekukhona neqoqo lezimboni zezokuxhumana ezivundulula zibike ngezenzo zenkohlakalo ezenziwa yiqeqebana eleseka elaKwa-Israel.Okuphawulekile ngesithangami somhlangano wezindaba phakathi kukaMengameli Trump kanye noMengameli Ramaphosa udaba obelicathama ngemuva kwezingxoxo luxoxwa kodwa lungaphathwa ngegama. Lapha ngikhuluma ngodaba olumayelana nezwe lamaJuda, iIsrael. Sekungumlando ukuthi kuwowonke amazwe omhlaba, yizwe laseNingizimu Afrika kuphela elingagcinanga kuphela ngokuphumela obala ukugxeka isibhicongo sokubulawa kwamaPalestinians eGaza, ebulawa izwe yi-Israel, elakuleli laphinde lathatha igxathu lokumangalela izwe laKwa Israel ngokubulala ngesibhicongo abantu baseGaza. Iqiniso lithi ukulimala kobudlelwano phakathi kweNingizimu Afrika kanye neMelika, ukuqedwa koxhaso iMelika ebelinikeza iNingizimu Afrika, konke lokho umsusa wakho ukuphumela obala kwezwe lase-Afrika ekugxekeni izwe laKwa-Israel, iphinde futhi ilibophise kwinkantolo yomhlaba yobulingiswa. Uma ikhona into eyenza i-Israel iyizonde iNingizimu Afrika kakhulu, yisenzo selakuleli sokusebenzisa igama ukubhuqwabhuqwa kwabantu (genocide) maqondana nokubulawa ngesihluku esingachazeki kwabantu baseGaza, bebulawa ngamasosha aKwa-Israel. Igama elithi ukubhuqwabhuqwa kwabantu (genocide) livusa uhlevana kumaJuda wonke ngoba amaJuda ayizisulu zokubhuqwabhuqwa kwawo u-Adolf Hitler owayengumholi waseJalimane ngesikhathi yempi yesibili. Alinganiselwa ezigidini eziyisithupha amaJuda abulawa yiqembu lamaNazi elaliholwa uHitler. Nanamhlanje isosha lamaNazi elitholakayo noma ngabe lineminyaka eyikhulu, liyaboshwa lijeziswe. Okudidayo ukuthi i-Israel kufanele kube ngabe yiyo egqugquzela ukuthula ngoba ikuqonda kangcono ubuhlungu bokubulawa ngohlelo lokubhuqwabhuqwa kwabantu.Iqiniso lithi kuwukucasha ngomunwe okwenziwa iMelika ukuthi ithi iNingizimu Afrika nayo ibhuqabhuqa abalimi bamaBhunu. Empeleni uma umuntu ecabanga ngokujula, izwe i-Israel elisho njalo, likusho ngaleqeqebana elibizwa ngesiNgisi ukuthi i-pro-Israel lobby noma i-pro-Jewish lobby.Iqiniso lithi ukulimala kobudlelwano phakathi kweNingizimu Afrika kanye neMelika, ukuqeda uxhaso kanye nokunye, konke lokho kuqonde ukujezisa iNingizimu Afrika ngokumangalela i-Israel ngokubulala amaPalestine. Ake senze izibalo. Kusukela ngo-Okthoba, ngonyaka odlule, kuze kube manje, i-Israel isibulale abantu baseGaza abangaphezu kwezinkulungwane ezingamashumi ayisithupha. Abalimi bamaBhunu ababulawe kusukela ngo-Okthoba, kuze kube manje inombolo yabo ayidluli ngisho ku-500. Angifisi ukuzwakala kabi. Angisho ukuthi kuyancomeka ukuthi zincane izibalo zokufa kwamaBhunu. Cha. Ngihlose ukuveza isithombe sokuthi le genocide yokubulawa kwamaBhunu into engekho. Ngamafuphi, nina beSilo, empeleni thina sishaywa yi-Israel. Iyaziphindisela kithi.Ngiyafisa ukuphetha ngokuthi ngiphawule ngokubonakala kwethimba ebelihamba noMengameli Ramaphosa liphephula ngaphambi kukaTrump. Ukube uTrump abengumuntu omnyama, ubungafunga ukuthi uwudle umuthi wawuqeda elungiselela umhlangano wakhe noMengameli waseNingizimu Afrika.Kusize khona ukuthi ngokwendalo uMengameli Ramaphosa insizwa enomoya ophansi. Nayo zibe khona izikhathi lapho ububona khona ukuthi kungathi iyamesaba uTrump. Angazi bese kwenzenjani uRamaphosa ekhumbula ukuthi kufanele abonge uTrump ngama- respirator uTrump awahlinzekela iNingizimu Afrika ngesikhathi segciwane iCovid-19. Ukuthi mhlawumbe uvalo olukhumbuze uRamaphosa ukuthi abonge uTrump noma isithunzi sikaTrump, ngeke sazi, hleze ibibagcabele, yagquma, yaphinde yaphalaza ekaTrump. Angikaze mina ngibone amanye amadoda, omengameli uqobo betatazela kangaka uma behlangene noTrump. Le nto engiyichazayo ingazwakala iyihlaya kodwa iqiniso lithi amadoda akwaZulu awayihambeli imicimbi noma imihlangano ebucayi efana nalona obuphakathi kukaRamaphosa noTrump elula, ephephuka, engagqumile, engagcobisanga ngovaselini kaShembe. SISAKHATHAZA isibalo esiphezulu samacala okubulala KwaZulu-Natal, eGauteng, e-Eastern Cape naseWestern Cape. Lokhu kudalulwe nguNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, ngesikhathi yena noKhomishana wamaPhoyisa kuzwelonke, uFannie Masemola, bethula izibalo zobugebengu ePitoli, zangoJanuwari 1 kuya kuMashi 1, nonyaka.IKwaZulu-Natal iphinde yavelela ngamacala athinta ucansi okuhlanganisa ukudlwengula njengoba ebe ngamaphesenti angu-19.9, ilandelwa iGauteng ngawu-19.1. "Izibhamu zisetshenziswa kakhulu ukubulala kulandele imibese. Enye yezinto eziseqhulwini kuthina ukunciphisa izibhamu ezingekho emthethweni nokuqiniswa kokulawulwa kwezibhamu ezisemthethweni," kusho uNgqongqoshe uMchunu.Uthe eziteshi zamaphoyisa eziwu-30 ezinezibalo eziphezulu zamacala okubulala, eziwu-13 zibe nesibalo esincane kanti akubanga bikho ushintsho kwezimbili. Udalule ukuthi njengoMnyango sebethole izinto eziseqhulwini okubalwa ukwehlisa izinga lokubulawa kwabantu, ukunciphisa izibhamu ezingekho emthethweni nokuqinisa ukulawulwa kwezibhamu ezisemthethweni, ukulwa nodlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane nokubulawa kwabo, ukulwa nobugebengu obuhleliwe okuhlanganisa amaqembu ashushumbisa izidakamizwa, ukubanjwa kwezimoto ezithwala imali, ukukhokhisa osomabhizinisi, ukuthunjwa kwabantu, ukulwa nodlame lwamaqembu emigulukudu nenkohlakalo emaphoyiseni nasezweni lonke.UMchunu udalule ukuthi izibalo zobugebengu zonyaka wonke zizokhishelwa umphakathi ngoSepthemba, kulo nyaka. Khona izolo, uKhomishana uMasemola ukhiphe umbiko wezibalo zobugebengu ngalesi sikhathi. Njengoba isematheni eyezinsolo zokubulawa kwabamhlophe, ikakhulukazi abalimi kuleli, uMchunu uthe ikhona inqubekela phambili kumacala enzeka emapulazini futhi baningi abasolwa asebe boshiwe. "Sifuna ukuqinisekisa izakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi amaphoyisa asukumela lonke uhlobo lwamacala futhi ayaphenyisisa ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ekugcineni buyenziwa ubulungiswa," kusho uMchunu.Uthe abahlukanisi abantu ngobuhlanga kodwa njengoba kukhulunywa ngokubulawa kwenqwaba yabamhlophe kuyaphoqa ukuthi leli phuzu balichaze ngale ndlela. Uveze ukuthi abalimi ababulawe ngekwata lesine lonyaka bekungabamnyama, hhayi abamhlophe. "Ngaphezulu kwalokho, abasebenzi basepulazini ababili nemenenja yalo bebe mnyama, uyedwa omhlophe obehlala epulazini.Ekhuluma ngezinsolo zokubulawa kwenqwaba yabamhlophe kuleli osekungenelele kuzo iMelika, uzichithile lezi izinsolo, wathi uMnyango wakhe uyayihlonipha iMelika, izakhamuzi zakhona noMengameli Donald Trump kodwa lezi zinsolo kazilona iqiniso futhi kazinabufakazi. "Asikuphiki ukuthi amazinga obugebengu ezweni aphezulu futhi sikhathazekile. Ubugebengu buthinta wonke umuntu. Kumanje siqinisa impi ebhekiswe ebugebengwini nasezigebengwini," esho. Uqhube wathi, eNingizimu Afrika kunezinhlangano ezingenzi inzuzo namaziko abezindaba abebe ngeke bathule uma lokhu kwenzeka. UMchunu ukhuluma kanjena nje, ziningi izigameko ezahlukene muva nje okubikwe ngazo ezimayelana nokubulawa kwabantu.Phakathi kwazo, kubalwa esokubulawa kwabayisishiyagalombili Kwa-U, eMlaza, esokusocongwa kwabesilisa abane eMbumbulu, esokubulawa komshayeli wetekisi esigamekweni esenzeka eHowick. Kuyimanje luyindaba egudwini udaba lowesilisa oboshelwe amacala okudlwengula abafundi baseBizimali, eNkandla.

Nayo iSafa EThekwini iyohlomula ngoba labo nompempe ngezimpelasonto bazodlalisa kososesheni. Yini ke engabalekisa leli bhange emidlalweni yebhola. Kuyokhumbuleka ukuthi leli bhange belixhase le midlalo yabebala njenge-cricket. Lokhu kuzolakhela ugazi ukuthi alifikile ebholeni kodwa ligalelekile.Uma ubhekisisa kahle lokhu kungaphezulu komdlalo kanobhutshuzwayo.Asingayintshontshi imali yezinkampani,asibuyisele okuthile, izikole mazingabi okhamisangithele.Okumnandi wukuthi iminyango, owezeMfundo noweZemidlalo lapha kwelikaMthaniya ziyaweseka lo mqhudelwano. Izingane ikakhulukazi ezimnyama azinawo ama akhawunti asemabhange, kodwa ngosizo lwalo mqhudelwano webhola,kuzobanjalo.Lokhu kuyisifundo sokuthi uma kukhona abanye abaxhasi noma ngabe bancane kanjani,uma ubaphathe kahle, abanye bayozizela,bebona uzinzo. Ngicabanga ukuthi akekho ongazi ukuthi iSafa eThekwini inabaxhasi abaningana,futhi siyabakhangisa. Iyiphi ke inkampani engeke ithande ukukhangiswa ngaphandle kokukhokha izigidi.Kumqoka ke ukuthi izikole ziziphathe kahle ungabibikho lo mkhuba wokupheka iminyaka ngoba lokho kuyodicilela pjansi igama lebhange. Asikho ke isakhiwo esithanda ukuzihlanganisa nenkohlakalo. Kuyoba kubi sesibona umuntu odlala ku-over 35 ngoba nakhu ezacile futhi engutondo. Kufanele uMnyango wezeMfundo uqinisekise ukuthi izimiso nezimvume zokuyodlala zigunyazwe wumnyango. Asikho isikole esiyodlala singalandelile imithetho yomnyango. OkweSafa kulula ngoba ihambisana noMasipala weTheku ekuletheni onompempe nezinkundla nokunye oku- technical ngolimi lwasebholeni. Uma izikole zaseThekwini ziziphathe kahle nezinye izifunda ziyoba sethubeni lokuthi le midlalo inabele kuzona.Asingayintshontshi le mali yabaxhasi ngokwenza okuphambene nomthetho. Lo mqondo wokufuna ukuwina kumnyama kubomvu,yiwona lona oholela enkohlakalweni.Othisha kumele bakwazi ukuhlukanisa phakathi kokuthuthukisa (development) nokuncintisana (competition).Uyobezwa sebesho bethi noma singadlala kabi kanjani uma siwinile nje kuyobe kuphelile,yibo kanye labo abankonkothela iminyaka ngoba kufanele bawine noma kanjani.Yibo ke laba abantshontsha imali yabaxhasi. Bese kuba yilezi ezikhulisa abadlali zilinisele ithalente, bafaka abadlali beminyaka efanele, bakhuthaza abadlali ukuthi mabadlale ngenkululeko, ababashintshi indlela ebavumelayo. Okumqoka ukujabulela abakwenzayo bese imiphumela iziqhamukela yona. Ibhola liyadlalwa alihujwa, alidlalwa emoyeni ngoba abukho utshani phezulu.Asingalokhu sibalisa ngokuthi ibhola alixhasiwe njenge-cricket ne-rugby. Kuyothi mhla ziyodlala igalofu lezikhulu bese zixoxa ngebhola, nalabo abangalinakile bayoba nomdlandla bese besondela, ibhola lingabukwa njengento yabantu abamnyama engahlelekile emazingeni aphansi. Hhiya,sesiyokwakha umkhanya.

KUKHISHWE izibalo ezishaqisayo zokukhulelwa kwabafundi ezikoleni zaseThekwini, kanjalo nabafundi abakhipha izisu zinyanga zonke.Ezibalweni eziphume ngesikhathi kunengqungquthela yokubhunga ngesihlava sokukhulelwa kwabafundi besebancane ebiseNkosi Albert Luthuli Convention Centre eThekwini muva nje, kuvele ukuthi esikhathini esiphakathi kuka-Ephreli 2024 no-Ephreli 2025, zingu-7 627 izingane zamantombazane ezikhuleliwe, ezineminyaka ephakathi kuka-10 no-19.Kulesi sibalo kunezingu-154 eziphakathi kuka-10 no-14 ezikhulelwe. Ulwazi oluvelile luveza nokuthi zibalelwa ku-582 zinyanga zonke izingane ezincane ezivakashela izikhungo zezempilo zomkhandlu ziyokhipha izisu. UNkk Zandile Myeni, iPhini leMeya kulo masipala, uthe kunesidingo sokuthi kuhlangane izinhlaka ezehlukene ukulwa nalesi sihlava.Uthe kudingeka kwehliswe izinga lokukhulelwa kwezingane ezisencane."Iyasikhathaza eyesihlava sokukhulelwa kwezingane zisencane njengoba kwandisa nesandulela ngculazi iHIV. Lokhu kwengeza nasezibalweni zabalaxaza isikole kwandise nendlala," usho kanje. Uthe ukukhulelwa kwengane esencane akunamthelela kuphela kumama osemncane kodwa kunomthelela nasenganeni ezozalwa."Ziyasikhathaza futhi nezibalo zezingane ezikhipha izisu nyanga zonke ezihambela izikhungo zezempilo zomkhandlu. Ngenyanga zingu-582 ezihambela lezi zikhungo kanti kulezi zibalo azikho ezalezo zingane ezihushula izisu ezindaweni ezingagunyaziwe, ezikwenza esithe," usho kanje. Uveze nokuthi kunezikole ezingu-10 ezinesibalo esiphezulu sabafundi abakhulelwe. "Izindawo ezinesibalo esiphezulu sezikole okukhulelwe kuzona abafundi kusuka ngoJanuwari kulo nyaka kuya kuMashi nonyaka, yiseNanda, KwaMashu, Hammarsdale, KwaDabeka, KwaNyuswa, Tshelimnyama, uMlaza naseChatsworth.Kule ngqungquthela bekukhona abaphuma emikhakheni ehlukene okubalwa noNdlunkulu kaMdlokombane uMaNdlovu.UNkk Myeni ubalule uhlelo lokungenelela, iZero Percent Learner Pregnancy Programme, olungaphansi kweDistrict Aids Council olwethulwa eminyakeni emibili edlule. Lolu hlelo uthe luhlomisa abafundi bamantombazane ukuba bangasiyeki isikole luphinde lugqugquzele ukuziphatha kahle kwezocansi. Ngaphansi komthetho wezikole woMnyango wezeMfundo, iBela Act, umfundi okhulelwe akumele akhonjwe indlela esikoleni.Okunye wukuthi kumele kubikwe abafundi abasebancane abakhulelwe.

ICHAZWE njengoyisebenzele ngobuqotho i-ANC ingqalabutho yale nhlangano, uNkk Getrude Shope, edlule emhlabeni ngoLwesine, ineminyaka engu-99.UNkk Shope obedume ngelikaMaShope, waba ngumengameli wokuqala we-ANCWL emva kokwakhiwa kwayo kabusha. Ushonele ekhaya lakhe eGoli. Ushona nje, i-ANCWL isazikhotha amanxeba kulandela ukudlula emhlabeni kukaNkk Lungi Mnganga-Gcabashe obeyisekela likasihlalo walolu phiko. Phakathi kwabababaze amagalelo kaNkk Shope, kubalwa uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, othe izwe lilahlekelwe iqhawekazi nomama wesizwe okuthe ngesikhathi sakhe wenza umnikelo omkhulu emzabalazweni weNingizimu Afrika ekhululekile nehlanganisa wonke umuntu. "Ugqugquzele abesifazane emiphakathini ezweni lethu nezinhlangano zomhlaba ukulwa nobandlululo nokuqeda inhlupheko yababecindezelwe ngesikhathi umzabalazo uqhubeka," kusho uMengameli Ramaphosa. Uqhube wathi: "Nembala ubeyimbokodo ubandlululo olwehluleka ukuyihlakaza futhi wangena ePhalamende lokuqala lentando yeningi ngo-1994, enomfutho nombono okwamenza waba isizukulwane sokuqala samalungu ePhalamende ayisibonelo." Uthe uyohlala ekhunjulwa uMaShope futhi umsebenzi wakhe uyabonakala oguqukweni oluzuziwe futhi uzoqhubeka ube negalelo emphakathini. Eneminyaka engu-29, uMaShope walaxaza umsebenzi wobuthishela wajoyina i-ANC ngoba ekhala ngohlelo lwemfundo, iBantu Education. Ibhonga emswaneni, i-ANC ithe: "Impilo yakhe ibigqanyiswe ukusebenza ngokuzinikela, ukuziphatha kahle, intobeko nokuzinikela okungenamkhawulo emzabalazweni wenkululeko, wokulingana nobulungiswa. Kusukela kumagumbi okufundela eSoweto, kuya ekudingisweni e-Afrika, nangaphandle efeza injongo ye-ANC, uMaShope unikele impilo yakhe kwizinjongo zobulungiswa, ukulingana ngokobulili nenkululeko yabantu bakhe."Ngaphansi kweFederation of South African Women (FEDSAW), wayephambili ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ezithinta inkululeko yabesifazane ziyanakwa. Ngo-1966, waphoqeleka ukuba aye ekudingisweni eCzechoslovakia lapho aficana nomyeni wakhe owayeyisishoshovu sezinyunyana, uMark Shope. Bahambe amazwe okubalwa iTanzania, Zambia, Nigeria neBotswana, lapho uMaShope ayeqhuba umsebenzi we-ANC. Ungene emlandweni ngokuba ngomunye wabesifazane bokuqala ukumela i-ANC emazweni angaphandle njengoba yena ayeyimele eLusaka. "Ngo-1985, uMaShope waqokelwa kusigungu esiphezulu se-ANC lapho abamba iqhaza elikhulu ukufundisa ngepolitiki nokulingana ngokobulili," kusho i-ANC. Ithe ubuholi bakhe busize kakhulu ukuguqula iqhaza labesifazane kwi-ANC. Ngokuzinikela kwakhe, i-ANC yamhlonipha nge-Order of Isithwalande/Seaparankwe okuyindlela yokuhlonipha labo abanikele ngempilo yabo emzabalazweni wenkululeko. IPhalamende lakuleli, lithe uMaShope owaba ngomunye wabokuqala ukuba yilungu lalo kungenwa kwintandoyeningi ngo-1994, ubambe iqhaza elikhulu ukuguqula iPhalamende ekubeni uphawu lwengcindezelo laba yisikhungo sabantu esisebenza ngendlela engenamfihlo, ehlanganisa wonke umuntu neqhuba ngemigomo yoMthethosisekelo."Ube ngomunye wabesifazane bokuqala abalwa nohulumeni wobandlululo, ephambili kwimibhikisho egqugquzela imiphakathi ukuba ilwe nobubi obabenziwa wuhulumeni wedlanzana," kusho iPhalamende esitatimendeni. UMengameli Ramaphosa kulindeleke ukuba athule inkulumo yosuku enkonzweni kaNkk Mnganga-Gcaba namuhla e-ICC, eThekwini.

Amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal athungatha abasolwa ababili ngamacala okubulala abantu abane endaweni yaseMzomusha, eDundee ngoLwesihlanu ntambama.Kubikwa ukuthi izisulu ezimbili zabesilisa, ezineminyaka engu-31 no-35 ubudala, bezingaphandle kwendlu ngesikhathi kufika abasolwa ababili bavulela ngenhlamvu bebhekise kubo, bashonela khona lapho. Abasolwa babe sebeqhubeka ngaphakathi endlini lapho bekukhona abantu abathathu. Kubikwa ukuthi abasolwa bafuna imali nezidakamizwa kowesifazane oneminyaka engu-29. Kubikwa ukuthi kube nokuhilizisana phakathi komsolwa oyedwa nalo wesifazane ohlonziwe nokuphethe ngokuthi adutshulwe amahlandla amaningi. Abasolwa kuthiwa bamseshile bathatha isamba semali esingadalulwanga. Intombazane eneminyaka engu-14 ubudala nayo idutshulwe amahlandla amaningi yashonela endaweni yesigameko. Kuthiwa bekukhona nowesilisa okubikwa ukuthi ukwazile ukuphuma endlini ngemuva kokuzwa umsindo wesibhamu sokuqala, wasinda kanjali. "Imbangela yalokhu kubulala kusolakala ukuthi ngukugebenga, nokho-ke, umbango ohlobene nezidakamizwa ngeke ukhishwe," kusho amaphoyisa.Amaphoyisa acela noma ngabe ngubani ongaba nolwazi ngesigameko nokuthi abasolwa bakuphi ukuthi athinte isiteshi samaphoyisa esiseduze.
UKHOLELWA ngukuthi kungenziwa okuthile ngesikweletu sikahulumeni asikhokha nsuku zonke esingu-R1.2 billion ngosuku uSihlalo wekomiti lezeziMali ePhalamende uDkt Joe Maswanganyi. UMaswanganyi ukholelwa ngukuthi uhulumeni kumele afake isicelo sokuthi kuxoxwe ukuze sibuyekezwe lesi sikweletu nalabo abakweletayo ngoba inkulu le mali ekhokhwa nsuku zonke ngenxa yesikweletu."Ukunganyuswa kweVAT okwachithwa ngamaqembu amaningi ePhalamende ezabelwenimali ezedlule, kwandise umthwalo obhekene nohulumeni. Lokhu kusho ukuthi ziyanyuka izindleko zikahulumeni," usho kanje.Ukusho lokhu izolo ekhuluma esithangamini nabezindaba eKapa emuva kokwethulwa kwesabelomali sezwe nguMnuz Enoch Godongwana, uNgqongqoshe wezeziMali. UGodongwana waphoqeleka ukuthi ahoxise izabelomali ezimbili ezedlule emuva kokuchithwa kokunyuswa kweVAT. Kwakukhalwa ngokuthi umphakathi uzodonsa kanzima uma kunyuswa iVAT.UGodongwana ube esememezela ukuthi kuzonyuswa intela efakwa kuphethroli, nakho okukhalisa abantu ngokuthi kuzonyusa izinto zokuthutha umphakathi kanjalo nokudla.UMaswanganyi uthe isabelomali sakamuva sibhekelela abamhlwempu. "Sinethemba lokuthi isabelomali esethuliwe sizophasiswa ngamaqembu ahlukene. Iyasikhathaza eyesikweletu sikahulumeni siyikomiti yingakho sifuna ukuthi sehliswe ngokuthi uhulumeni ayoxoxa nabakweletwayo," usho kanje. Usihlalo wekomiti elibhekele ukusebenza kwemali yoMphakathi iStanding Committee on Public Accounts (SCOPA), uMnuz Songezo Zibi, uthe isabelomali esedlule sibe nombango omkhulu ngendaba yeVAT okwenza i-DA ne-EFF baya enkantolo.Uthe unethemba lokuthi sizophasa lesi sabelomali."Angiboni sibuyela esimeni esedlule lapho kwakunombango ngesabelomali. Ngethemba ukuthi sizophasiswa." Nomholi weBuild One South Africa (BOSA) uMnuz Mmusi Maimane, uthe unethemba lokuthi sizophasiswa isabelomali samanje."Kunethemba lokuthi sizophasa ngoba kunokubona ngaso linye, akufani nesikhathi esedlule. Angiboni kukhona iqembu elifuna ukuthi kube nomsindo kuyiswane nasezinkantolo ngenxa yokuthi eyeVAT ayikho kulokhu."
SAMUKELWE ngesasa isinqumo sikaNgqongqoshe wemMfundo Ephakeme, uDkt Nobuhle Nkabane, sokuvula kabusha ithuba kokuqokwa kozihlalo bamabhodi eSector Education and Training Authorities (SEFA). Lokhu kulandela umsindo oqubuke emva lokumenyezelwa kwamagama ozihlalo bala mabhodi phakathi kwawo obekukhona elendodana kaNgqongqoshe weziMbiwa obuye abe nguSihlalo kazwelonke we-ANC, uGwede Mantashe, uBuyambo, nowayenguNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal uNomusa Dube-Ncube. IDA ayipholisanga maseko yabhalela uSihlalo weKomiti lePhalamende elibhekele iMfundo ePhakeme, uTebogo Letsie, ifuna ukuba kubizwe uNgqongqoshe Nkabane ukuze achaze ngalokhu. IDA ibisola ukuthi kufakwe amalungu e-ANC kulezi zikhundla ukuze kufezwe izinhloso zayo. Kuleli sonto kusuke umsindo ngesikhathi kuleli leli ikomiti okuholele ekutheni ilungu lePhalamende le-EFF, uSihle Lonzi, likhishwe ngesidlozana kulokhu kuhlala emva kokuba libuze ngokuqokwa kwendodana kaMantashe. Lugcine lugobile uphondo kuNgqongqoshe njengoba ememezele ukuthi uhlelo lokuqokwa kozihlalo luzoqalwa phansi.I-ANC ithe iyasiseka futhi iyasamukela lesi sinqumo. "Lokhu kugcizelela ukuzibophezela kwe-ANC ekuphatheni ngobuqotho nokwethembeka kuntando yeningi," kusho i-ANC esitatimendeni.Ithe uNgqongqoshe Nkabane oyilungu layo uyiqinisekisile ukuthi uhlelo lokuqokwa luzohamba ngendlela efanele futhi engafihliwe nehambisanayo nomthetho iSkills Development Act "Sinelisekile ukuthi konke okufanele kuzolandelwa uma sekuqokwa. Nokuthi bonke abazoqokwa bazothathwa ngoba befanele," kusho i-ANC.Khonamanjalo, uKarabo Khakhau weDA oyilungu ekomiti lasePhalamende kwezeMfundo Ephakeme, uthe bayasamukela lesi sinqumo. Uthe amaSETA abambe iqhaza elibalulekile ekuthuthikisweni kwamakhono futhi alawula ukuthuthukiswa komnotho eNingizimu Afrika."Lezi zikhungo zakhelwe ukusiza zonke izakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi intsha elangazelele ukuthola amathuba namakhono ukuze bakwazi ukuthola imisebenzi, akuzona ezokubonga osopolitiki ngokuthembeka kwabo," kusho uKhakhau.Ugcizelele ikhwelo leDA lokuthi ingafakwa ipolitiki kuzikhungo zikahulumeni. "Sinxusa UNgqongqoshe ukuba aqinisekise ukuthi abazoqokwa banesipiliyoni futhi bakufanele. Iphutha elenzekile lingabe lisaphindeka," kuphetha uKhakhau.
ULINDELE ukwazi ukuthi kwenzekeni kwindodana yakhe unina kaDkt Alulutho Mazwi, oshone kade esemsebenzini esibhedlela iPrince Mshiyeni eMlaza. Unina kamufi, uNkk Thabisa Maqoqa, ubekhuluma ngesikhathi ubuholi obuphezulu baKwaZulu-Natal noboMnyango wezeMpilo bufikile buzobhonga emswaneni kulo mndeni.UMazwi kuthiwa ushone emuva kokubika ukugula komunye wabaphathi bakhe, okuthiwa umphoqile ukuthi eze emsebenzini nakuba engaphilile. ''Ngifuna ukwazi ukuthi ingampela kwenzekeni kumtanani?" kusho uNkk Maqoqa."Okokuqala nje, ubenganazo izimpawu zokugula. Ngizikhulisele yena. Ngiyabonga ngokufika kwenu lapha,'' usho kanjena .UMazwi ubekade esebenza njengodokotela oqeqeshwayo ePrince Mshiyeni Memorial Hospital eMlaza, kusukela ngoJulayi, wangonyaka owedlule. Lobu buholi bebukade buhambele kubo kaMazwi eMnquma, ngaseGcuwa eButterworth, e-Eastern Cape.Ekhuluma emndenini, loyo oyisikhulu esisabambile eMnyangweni wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Penny Msimango, wenze isibophezelo sokuthi bazoqhubeka nokweseka umndeni kamufi.''Silapha namhlanje, hhayi nje ukuzokhala kuphela kodwa ukuzokhombisa ukuthi siyaneseka kakhulu kulesi simo enizithola nibhekene naso njengomndeni. Njengesifundazwe iKwaZulu-Natal kanye noMnyango wezeMpilo siyaqinisekisa ukuthi sizoba nani sineseke kulesi simo,'' usho kanjena. Eqhuba, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi seluqalile uphenyo olunzulu ngokufa kukaMazwi. ''Sizophinde senze isiqiniseko esikhulu sokuthi siyanazisa ngokuzobe kuvele kuloyo mbiko,'' kusho yena.Ubonge kakhulu uMasipala waseMnquma ngalo lonke usizo olukhombisile emndenini kamufi. Loyo oyiPhini likaMqondisi eHhovisini likaNdunankulu, uDkt Fikile Ndlovu, udlulise amazwi enduduzo emndenini kamufi.Uthembise ukuthi lolu daba lizobhekwa ngokukhulu ukuphuthuma nangokweqiniso. Bekukhona nesikhulu esiphezulu saseMshiyeni, uMnuz Bigboy Khawula.UMnyango wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal uthe uzimisele ngokuqinisekisa ukuphepha nanokuqinisekisa ukuthi odokotela basebenza endaweni evikelekile nenenhlalonhle. Naloyo onguNgqongqoshe wezeMpilo kuzwelonke, uDkt Aaron Motsoaledi, uthe ufuna kwenziwe uphenyo olunzulu ngokufa kukaDkt Mazwi. Umufi uzofihlwa khona eGcuwa, ngoLwesine oluzayo.
INGENE emgwaqweni yamasha inhlangano emele abazali bezingane eziphila nokukhubazeka KwaZulu-Natal, iSouth African National for Special Education (Sanase), ikhala ngokuba mapeketwane kwezinto ezikoleni zabaphila nokukhubazeka.Abazali abangaphansi kwale nhlangano bamashe besuka eMarket Square baze bayofika emaHhovisini kaNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal eMgungundlovu, okuyilapho abafike bashiya khona uhlu lwezikhalazo obeluqukethe izinto abakhala ngazo.Ilungu eliqavile lale nhlangano futhi ebelihlele imashi, uMnuz Bonginhlanhla Mjwaha, lilimise ngesihloko elokuthi zimapeketwane izinto ezikoleni zabaphila nokukhubazeka ezitholakala ezingxenyeni ezahlukene zeKwaZulu-Natal. Phakathi kwezinto athe ziseqhulwini ohlwini lwezinto abakhononda ngazo ukushoda kothisha, ukushoda konogada nabashayeli bamabhasi. Uthe ukuze ezikoleni zabaphila nokukhubazeka kuhambe kahle ukufunda kudingeka kungashodi lutho.Uqhube wathi sekukaningi bezwakalisa ukunganeliseki kwabo ezinhlakeni ezahlukene kodwa kumane kufane nje nokuthi bathela amanzi emhlane wedada.''Sinethemba elikhulu lokuthi izikhalazo zethu bazozizwa futhi bayazisukumela. Sesikhathele ukukhuluma into eyodwa. Iqiniso limile nje, konakele kakhulu ezikoleni zabaphila nokukhubazeka. Izinto ziya ngokubheda kakhulu kunokuba zibe ngcono,'' usho kanje. Uveze ukuthi ngonyaka owedlule, bake bafakana imilomo noMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, owabathembisa ukuthi zizosukunyelwa ngokushesha izikhalazo zabo.''Kodwa akukho esikubona kuhamba kahle kuze kube yimanje. Sicabanga ukuthi imashi iyona ezokwazi ukubenza balalele labo esikholwa ukuthi nakanjani yibona okumele basukume bangenelele kule nkinga engaka esizithola sibhekene nayo ezikoleni,'' usho kanje.Abazali ebebeyingxenye yale mashi bathe bakholwa ukuthi abantwana babo bayayidinga imfundo engcono yize bephila nokukhubazeka. Bathe bazimisele ngokuthi balwe kuze kube yisekugcineni ngoba bakholwa ukuthi abantwana babo nabo kumele nakanjani bayithole imfundo ebafanele. OseHhovisi likaNdunankulu, uNkk Hlongwane (igama lakhe elingatholakalanga), okunguyena owemukele uhlu lwezikhalazo, uthe bazozibhekisisa izikhalazo zabo bese bebuya nezimpendulo.Phakathi kwezingqembe abebeziphethe bezithi, ''Sicela okungcono ezikoleni zabaphila nokukhubazeka."Ezinye bezithi, ''Sicela nilalele ukukhala kwethu kube nesithunzi ezikoleni zabaphila nokukhubazeka.''

SEKUQUBULE uvalo ukwanda kwezigameko zokuduka kwezingane ezisencane eMabedlane, oLundi. Lokhu kuza emva kwesigameko sakamuva, lapho okuthiwa kuduke khona ingane yomfana eneminyaka emithathu, u-Ayanda Sibiya. U-Ayanda kuthiwa uduke ngoMeyi 15, edlala egcekeni lakubo. Emva kokwenzeka kwalesi sigameko, inhlangano yabefundisi, i-Olundi Zion Pastors Association, ihlele umkhuleko kusasa.Unobhala wale nhlangano, uMfu Khayelihle Mtshali, uthe kubasukumise phansi bengabafundisi ukulahleka kuka-Ayanda njengoba eyingane yesithathu ukulahleka kule ndawo."Ukwenzeka kwento enje endaweni kuyathusa. Asikwazi ukuhlala phansi sisonge izandla sibe sibona ukuthi konakele,” kusho uMtshali. Uthe ukunyamalala kuka-Ayanda kushiye umphakathi uthukile ngoba isigameko esinje kusithinta sonke.
