Ingane ayikwazi ukuvele ilahleke nje esithubeni,” usho kanje.Uthe abantu basovalweni lokuthi njengoba nabo bezele, isehlakalo esifuze lesi singabehlela. NgoJuni, nyakenye, endaweni efanayo, kwalahleka uLisulenkosi Lamula (2). ULisulenkosi naye kuthiwa wagcina ukubonakala edlala egcekeni emzini wesihlobo.Kuthiwa wathi uyaphuma unina emva kwemizuzu engu-30, embheka, waqaphela ukuthi akasabonwa. Kuvele ukuthi bambheka yonke indawo, ngisho nasethoyilethi lomgodi emzini anyamalala kuwo, bangamthola.Emva kwezinsuku ezimbili, watholakala kulo ithoyilethi elifanayo, enezibazi emqaleni. Nakuba amaphoyisa avula icala lokufa komuntu, umndeni wakhe walimisa ngesihloko elokuthi ukholelwa ukuthi ubulewe, wase ephonswa ethoyilethi. UMtshali utshele Isolezwe ukuthi sikhona esinye isigameko sokulahleka kwengane (5) kule ndawo, naso esenzeke ngonyaka odlule.Uthe nakuba yatholwa iphila emzini wesakhamuzi, kwaba nemibuzo yokuthi kukhona umkhuba wesintu owenziwa emzimbeni wayo. Uqhube wathi bagcina amaphoyisa elulandela lolu daba, yize engazi lwaphelelaphi. USotswebhu weNFP eZululand, uMnuz Siphamandla Ntombela ezwelana nomndeni, uthe into ebakhathazayo ukwanda kwesihlava sokwebiwa kwezingane, nokushushumbiswa kwazo, ezinye zibulawe bese ziyacwiywa. "Okwesithathu sigida kule ndawo ngesihlava esisodwa. EyakwaLamula ingane yaze yatholwa ethoyilethi. Sinxusa abantu ukuthi babuyelwe unembeza, bayeke ukweba nokubulala izingane ezincane,” kusho uNtombela. Ukhale ngabantu abasebenzisa izicubu zemizimba yabantu ukuze bathwale. Unxuse abazali abasebenzayo ukuthi uma bengenabo ababheki bezingane, baziyise ezinkulisa izingane, lapho zizoba ngaphansi kweso lomuntu ozobe eqinisekisa ukuphepha kwazo njalo ngemuva kwemizuzu emihlanu. Umndeni ka-Ayanda awuthandanga ukukhuluma nabezindaba.Kushaye esokushicilela amaphoyisa ungakaphenduli.

SEKUZOPHELA ukuthelwa yizintuli nodaka emphakathini waku-ward 3 kuMasipala waseMshwathi kulandela ukwethulwa kukasonkontileka ozofaka itiyela emgwaqweni uP278.Kube yintokozo emphakathni wakulo mkhandlu ngesikhathi uMphathiswa woMnyango wezokuThutha nokuHlaliswa kwaBantu KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Siboniso Duma, ezokwethula lolu hlelo ezinkundleni zemidlalo zaseMakeni, eMount Elias ngoLwesibili.UDuma uthe ngale ngqalasizinda kubekwe eceleni isamba sikaR353 million. Uthe izinkampani ezizinze kuMasipala waseMshwathi nowaseMvoti zizokwabelana ngesamba sikaR79.3 million. "Izinkampani eziphethwe ngabesifazane zizothola uR23.8 million, eziphethwe yintsha zizokwabelana ngoR27.7 million, eziphethwe ngabantu abanokukhubazeka zizohlukaniselana uR3.9 million, eziphethwe ngabantu ababengamasosha alwela umzabalazo zizohlukaniselana ngoR7.9 million bese ezinye zabelana ngoR15.8 million."UDuma uthe lo mgwaqo, oyibanga elingu-22.5 wamakhilomitha, uzokwenziwa izikhawu ezimbili. Ephetha uthe angu-72 amalungu omphakathi azohlomula ngokwakhiwa kabusha kwalo mgwaqo.IMeya yaseMshwathi, uMnuz Mandla Zondi iveze ukuthi sekunesikhathi eside umphakathi owakhele le ndawo yaku-ward 3 ukhala ngokulungiselwa umgwaqo.UZondi ubonge kakhulu uhulumeni ngokuthi ulalele bese uphendula izicelo zomphakathi.Khonamanjalo amakhosi akhele le ndawo, iNkosi uNgubane kanye neNkosi uNdlovu, anxuse uDuma ukuthi alekelele nakwezinye izidingo zomphakathi ngisho ezingekho eMnyangweni wakhe.UDuma ube esethula usonkontileka ozokwakha lo mgwaqo okuyinkampani yakwaBejives ebihamba nonjiniya, Umzansi Engineers.
LIHLEHLELE umhla ka28 Meyi icala lowesilisa oneminyaka engu-28 oweqe esitokisini eMariannhill ngoMsombuluko.Lo mlisa uvele phambi kweMantshi yasePinetown ngoLwesine kulandela ukuboshwa kwakhe esenyangeni ehostela eDalton, eThekwini. Uzogqunywa esitokisini saseDurban North kuze kube ubuyela enkantolo yasePinetown ngoLwesithathu oluzayo ngecala lokweqa esitokisini.Kuthiwa uzobuye ahanjiswe eKhombe, eNkandla, njengoba kulindeleke ukuthi avele enkantolo yakhona ngamacala okudlwengula.Umkhuzi wamaphoyisa esifundazweni uLieutenant-General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi ehambisana nondunankulu uMnuz Thami Ntuli bazohambele esiteshini saseMariannhill ukuze bathole umbiko ogcwele ngokuthi lo mlise weqe kanjani esitokisini.Kuvela nemibiko yokuthi kuboshwe umfowabo kamsolwa ngamacala okusabisa ofakazi eNkandla njengoba umfowabo usolwa ngokudlwengula abafundi besikole samabanga aphakeme abahlala emakotishi.
IPHENDUKE usizi injabulo yokunganyuswa kwentela efakwa uma kuthengwa impahla kuleli iVAT njengoba uNgqongqoshe wezeziMali uMnuz Enoch Godongwana, ememezele ukunyusa intela efakwa kuphethroli kusuka ngenyanga ezayo.Lokhu kufana nokuthi abantu bakuleli bebebalekela ukushaywa yinyoka kodwa bangena emlonyeni wengwenya njengoba ukunyuswa kwale ntela eyaziwa nge-fuel levy, okuqala ngoJuni 4 kuzoshaya abahluphekayo.Ukunyuswa kwale ntela kuzoba nomthelela ekunyukeni kokudla kuleli nezinto zokuthutha. UGodongwana uthe ukuze uhulumeni akwazi ukukhulisa isikhwama sakhe kuphoqe ukuba kuthathwe izinqumo ezinzima phakathi kwazo okubalwa ukunyuswa kwale ntela.Ethula isabelomali eKapa, uGodongwana umemezele ukuthi eminyakeni emithathu ubekumisile ukunyusa le ntela kaphethroli.Uthe kusukela ngoJuni 4 kulo nyaka, intela kaphethroli izonyuka ngo-16c ilitha kuthi ekadizili ibe ngu-15c. "Ngeshwa lokhu kukodwa ngeke kukwazi ukuvala umgodi esikhwameni sethu kulesi sikhathi. Ngakho-ke isabelomali sika-2026 kufanele siphakamise ezinye izindlela zokunyusa intela ukuze siqoqe imali engu-R20 billlion,” kusho uGodongwana.Uveze ukuthi bangeze u-R7.5 billion ukulekelela iSouth African Revenue Service ukuze ikwazi ukuqoqa intela."Ingxenye yalesi sabelo izosetshenziselwa ukwandisa imali esiyikweletwayo. ISARS isiveze ukuthi singaqoqa imali ephakathi kuka-R20 billion kuya ku-R50 billion emalini eyengeziwe ngonyaka.” UGodongwana uphinde wakuqinisekisa ukuthiiVAT ngeke inyuswe.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi isabelomali ebesithulwa izolo bese kungesesithathu kulo nyaka, okudalwe wukuthi amaqembu epolitiki achitha ebeziphakamisa ukunyuswa kweVAT."Inkulumompikiswano ebalulekile kodwa edale ukunganeliseki. Sekucacile manje.ukuthi iVAT ngeke inyuke izohlala emaphesentini angu-15,” kuqinisekisa uGodongwana, othe lesi sinqumo sikhombisa ukuzibophezela kukahulumeni ekulaleleni izakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika nawo wonke amaqembu amelwe ePhalamende. Kodwa, uthe iqiniso elingenakuphikwa elokuthi ukungayinyusi iVAT ibe ingekho enye indlela yokwenza imali, kuzonqinda uhulumeni amandla okuxhasa ngemali ezinye izinhlelo."Noma kunjalo, lesi sabelomali silekelela ekutheni kube nesimo esihle semali, ukuhlinzekwa kwezibonelelo nokutshala ekukhuleni komnotho."Ekhuluma ngalesi sabelomali, uthe ingqalasizinda yabelwe u-R1 trillion ngenhloso yokufukula umnotho nokwenza ngcono ukuhlinzekwa kwezidingo.Ubalule isimo somnotho emhlabeni athe sesishintshile esikhathini esiyizinyanga ezimbili kanti okukhathaza kakhulu wukuthi sesibe nomthelela emnothweni waseNingizimu Afrika.
UQEDE ukuqagela ngesibonelelo sabangatohozi sika-R370 uNgqongqoshe wezeziMali, uMnuz Enoch Godongwana, ngesikhathi ememezela ukuthi sizoqhubeka kuze kube unyaka ozayo.Ukuveze lokhu ethula isabelomali sika-2025 ePhalamende izolo, lapho edalule ukuthi lesi sibonelelo esibizwa ngeSocial Relief of Distress (SRD), sizoqhubeka kuze kube sekupheleni kukaMashi 2026.Bekunovalo lokuthi singase simiswe lesi sibonelelo esaqala ngesikhathi seCovid-19 njengoba isimo somnotho singesihle. "Uhulumeni usafuna izindlela zokuhlanganisa lesi sibonelelo namathuba omsebenzi. Lokhu kubandakanya ukucabangisisa ngokubanika isibonelelo abasafuna umsebenzi nezinye izindlela." Uthe inhloso kahulumeni akusikho ukuhlinzeka ngosizo lwesikhashana kodwa wukwakha izindlela zokuqasheka, ukusimamisa izakhamuzi ukuze zikwazi ukwakhela zona nemindeni yazo ikusasa elihle.Kusona lesi sabelomali, kuhlomule izinkulisa ezengezelwe u-R10 billion njengoba kwakumenyezelwe kwisabelomali sika-12 Mashi esachithwa kanti lokhu kwenzelwa ukuthi izingane zikwazi ukuthola imfundo yasezinkulisa. "Lokhu kuzonyusa uxhaso lwezinkulisa lusuka ku-R17 ingane ngosuku luye ku-R24. Olunye uxhasomali luzosiza ezinye izingane ezingu-700 000 kuze kufinyelele kwezineminyaka engu-5,” kusho uGodongwana.Uphinde waveza ukuthi ezempilo ezifundazweni zabelwe u-R845 billion.Uthe ngalokhu kuzoqashwa odokotela abazosebenza emiphakathini abangu-800 kutholakale nempahla ebalulekile kuncishiswe nezikweletu. Omasipala, kulesi sabelomali, bathole uR552.7 billion, uGodongwana uthe le mali izosiza ukubhekana nezindleko zamanzi nogesi wamahhala onikwa imindeni entulayo.IMinyango yezeMfundo ezifundazweni ithole u-R1.04 trillion kanti u-R9.5 billion uzophinde wengezwe ukugcina othisha emagumbini okufundela nokuqasha abasebenzi abaningi.Uthe u-R1.4 billion wabelwe ukwelekelela emalungiselelweni okhetho lohulumeni basekhaya oluzayo, u-R885 million uya kwi-Independent Electoral Commission (IEC), u-R550 million wabelwe amaphoyisa ukuze aqaphe isimo ngalesi sikhathi.
UKHALE ngemali engu-R1.2 billion, ekhokhwa nsuku zonke esikweletini sezwe uNgqongqoshe wezeziMali, uMnuz Enoch Godongwana.UGodongwana uthe siphezulu isikweletu sezwe njengoba siya ku-R1.3 trillion, eminyakeni emithathu ezayo.Ethula isabelomali eKapa, uveze ukuthi kudingeka kwehliswe ukubolekwa kwemali. "Sikhokha u-R1.2 billion ngosuku esikweletini sezwe. Le mali inkulu kakhulu kunemali esiyichitha kwezemfundo, ezempilo kanjalo nasemaphoyiseni. Kumele sisiqede lesi sihlava okungenani sikhulise umnotho."Phezu kokuba izwe likhokha imali engaka esikweletini kodwa uthe izophinde inyuke imali yempesheni yabadala.Ngo-Ephreli, lesi sibonelelo sinyuswe ngo-R120 siya ku-R2 310 kanti ngo-Okthoba, sizonyuswa ngo-R10 siye ku-R2 320. Ubalule izinto ezingadinga imali ekuhambeni konyaka athe zihlanganisa ukuhoxiswa koxhasomali iPresident's Emergency Plan for AIDS Relief (PEPFAR) obelukhishwa iMelika ukusiza izinhlelo zokulwa nengculaza nesandulela sayo, amaprojekthi engqalasizinda nezitimela, ukwanda kwesibalo sabantu, ukuqinisa iHhovisi likaMengameli wamaJaji neleStatistics South Africa.Ezinye izinhlelo ezizodinga imali ubalule eyoxhaso lwamaqembu ezepolitiki, ukuphucula ingqalasizinda yezigodlo zasendlunkulu nezinye izinhlelo.
AMAPHOYISA KwaZulu-Natal athungatha owesilisa osolwa ngecala lokuzama ukubulala usomatekisi ongusihlalo kasoseshini eMsinga.Amaphoyisa anxusa umphakathi ukuba ulekelele kutholakale uRichard Zwakushiwo Dlamini, odume ngelikaMasiliva. BAZOTHWALA kanzima abantu abahlwempu kuleli ngokunyuswa kwentela efakwa kuphethroli njengoba lokhu kuzonyusa ukudla kanjalo nezinto zokuthutha.Lokhu kushiwo amaqembu aphikisayo, ePhalamende, emuva kwesimemezelo esenziwe nguNgqongqoshe wezeziMali, uMnuz Enoch Godongwana, sokuyusa intela eyaziwa nge-fuel levy ngo-16c kusuka ngenyanga ezayo.Umholi we-EFF, uMnuz Julius Malema, ukhale ngokuthi isabelomali abaseseki ngenxa yokuthi sizothwalisa kanzima abahlwempu. Uthe abantu basazoqhubeka badonse kanzima ngemuva kokunyuswa kwale ntela."Abantu bazokhokha imali ethe xaxa ngokudla ngoba kuzonyuka. Siyasichitha isabelomali ngoba asibabhekeli abamhlwempu," usho kanje.UMnuz Vuyo Zungula we-ATM ukhale ngokuthi akuzange kwandiswe ukudla okungenayo i-VAT okwenza isabelomali singabazweli abahlwempu. Ukhale ngokunyuswa kwentela kaphethroli, wathi abantu bazoshayeka ngoba kuzonyuka amatekisi."Abantu abasebenzisa izinto zokuthutha bazoshayeka kakhulu. Lesi sabelomali asizwelani nabantu abahlwempu." Okhulumela iqembu Umkhonto weSizwe, uMnuz Nhlamulo Ndhlela, ugxeke isabelomali wathi sifana nento engekho. Usifanise noMengameli wezwe, uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa, obengekho eseMelika njengoba ehlangane noMengameli wakuleliya lizwe, uMnuz Donald Trump."Asiseseki lesi sabelomali ngoba sizohluphekisa abantu. Akusona isabelomali esikhipha abantu osizini lobubha ngenxa yokuthi kuzonyuka izinto eziningi." UMnuz Nqabayomzi Kwankwa we-UDM, ukhale ngokuthi isabelomali kasivezi ukuthi izoqhamukaphi imali yokuvala isikweletu sezwe. Ukhale ngokuthi inkulu kakhulu imali ekhokhwa nsuku zonke ngenxa yesikweletu sezwe."Asicacisanga ukuthi izoqhamukaphi imali yokuvala igebe elikhona lokunganyuswa kweVAT." UMnuz Steve Swart we-ACDP, ukhale ngokunyuswa kwentela kaphethroli, wathi izoshaya abahlwempu.I-DA ne-IFP basesekile isabelomali bathi sizophucula imikhakha efana nezemfundo nezempilo. Umholi we-IFP, uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa, ukhale ngokuthi akwandiswanga ukudla okungenantela, wathi kodwa isabelomali sizophucula ingqalasizinda.UDkt Alex Mashilo we-SACP, ukuchithile ukunyuswa kwentela kaphethroli wathi abantu yibona abazothwala kanzima."Siphunyuke kwiVAT saya ekunyusweni kukaphethroli. Nakanjani lokhu kuzobashaya abantu abahlwempu."

UMENGAMELI waseMelika, uMnuz Donald Trump, ufune incazelo egcwele ngokwenzeka kuleli, njengoba ethi abalimi abamhlophe bayabulawa, bathathelwe nomhlaba.UTrump uthe yimbi into eyenzeka eMzansi ngoba abalimi baze bafudukele eMelika ngoba behlukunyezwa.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ehlangene noMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa izolo ebusuku, ngokwesikhathi sakuleli, eWhite House, eMelika. "Sizoxoxa ngezinto ezenzeka eNingizimu Afrika. Sifuna ukwazi ukuthi kwenzekalani, kubulawa abalimi abamhlophe. Nginabangani abaningi eNingizimu Afrika. Ngithobekile ngokuthi uze kuleli, angazi inombolo yami yocingo uyithathephi," kusho uTrump kuRamaphosa, kwaqhuma uhleko.Uthe bathole izikhalazo eziningi ngokwenzeka kubalimi abamhlophe kuleli."Sithole izikhalazo ngeNingizimu Afrika. Sinabantu abangu-21 million abangena emingceleni yaseMelika, abanye basuke bebaleke emazweni abo, abanye basuke beyizigebengu, besuka emajele abanye. Abantu bakhathazekile ngokwenzeka eNingizimu Afrika. Sethemba ukuthi nizosichazela ukuthi kwenzakalani," kusho uTrump. URamaphosa uthe abangani bakaTrump, abanye babo abasuka eMzansi, bazophefumula ngokwenzeka kubalimi abamhlophe."Sifuna uTrump alalele okuzoshiwo nanguNgqongqoshe wezoLimo, uMnuz John Steenhuisen, ngokwenzeka eNingizimu Afrika," kubeka uRamaphosa.UTrump ube esecela ukuthi adlalelwe okwenzeka kuleli, kwadlalwa i-video lapho umholi we-EFF, uMnuz Julius Malema, ecula amaculo okubalwa nelithi akubulawe abalimi. Uvezwe uMalema ecula nelithi "shoot to kill".Kudlalwe ne-video yomholi weqembu uMkhonto weSizwe, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, ecula elithi "sizobadubula ngombayimbayi".Ephendula, uRamaphosa uthe ezinye zezinto ziphambene nomgomo kahulumeni noma kuthiwa zishiwo ePhalamende. Ubalule ukuthi intando yeningi iyavuma ukuthi amaqembu amancane abekhona ePhalamende.UTrump uthe uRamaphosa uvumela ukuthi kuthathwe umhlaba, uRamaphosa wakuchitha lokhu, wathi abantu bayabulawa kubalwa nabamnyama."Safundiswa uMengameli Nelson Mandela ukuthi uma kukhona ukungaboni ngaso linye, sihlale phansi sixoxe ngezinkinga. Sinobudlelwano bokusebenzisana phakathi kwamazwe womabili," kusho uRamaphosa. UTrump uthe ziningi izinto ezenzeka kwamanye amazwe kodwa zimbi kakhulu ezenzeka eNingizimu Afrika."Nishaye umthetho wokuthi kuthathwe umhlaba ngaphandle kwesinxephezelo. Nithatha umhlaba wabantu bese nibabulala, yinto embi le eniyenzayo," kusho uTrump.URamaphosa uthe awukho umhlaba odliwa ngejozi kuleli njengoba kunoMthethosisekelo olandelwayo. URamaphosa uthe kunenkampani ezingu-22 zaseNingizimu Afrika eziseMelika, ezinye ezingu-600 zaseMelika ziseNingizimu Afrika."Siyazi sinezimbiwa enizidinga kakhulu, nathi sinezinto esizidinga eMelika. Ngakhuluma nawe ngesikhathi seCovid-19, wasihlinzeka ngezinto zokuphefumula, wasisiza kakhulu ekulweni neCovid-19."USteenhuisen uthe abalimi abaningi bafuna ukuzinza eMzansi, abafuni ukuhamba baye kwamanye amazwe ngenxa yokuhlaselwa. "Abaholi ababonakala kwi-video becula, uZuma noMalema bangabantu abasemaqenjini aphikisayo. Siyasebenzisana singamaqembu ahlukene kuhulumeni wokubambisana," kusho uSteenhuisen.UTrump ubuze ukuthi kungani engaboshwanga uMalema othi akubulawe abalimi abamhlophe?Umpetha wegalofu wakuleli u-Ernie Els, ongumngani kaTrump, uthe bafuna elakuleli lithuthuke.
UGCWELE amathafa owesilisa osolwa ngokudlwengula abafundi basesikoleni iBizimali High, eNkandla, kulandela ukweqa kwakhe esitokisini ngoMsombuluko ebusuku.Lokhu kuqinisekiswe okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, izolo."Amaphoyisa aphansi phezulu athungatha umsolwa oneminyaka engu-28, okuthiwa weqe esitokisini ebusuku ngoMsombuluko,” kusho uNetshiunda.Uthe umsolwa ubeboshwe ngamaphoyisa asesiteshini iMariannhill, ePinetown, ngamacala okudlwengula awenze eNkandla. "Bekusalindeleke ukuthi ahanjiswe ejele ngesikhathi ekhala ngokuhlaselwa yisifo sofuba, waquleka. Amaphoyisa athe esematasa emsiza, wavele waphunyuka, wabaleka, waphelela emehlweni ngenxa yobumnyama,” kusho uNetshiunda.Uthe sekubunjwe ithimba leqophelo eliphezulu ukuthi limcinge, limthole.Khonamanjalo: UMphathiswa wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka, uzohambela lesi sikole kusasa kulandela izehlakalo zokudlwengulwa kwabafundi. UHlomuka uthe izigameko zokudlwengulwa kwabafundi azinandawo emphakathini. "Sikhathazekile ngokuphepha kwabafundi bethu, izehlakalo zokudlwengulwa kwabafundi zisishiye sithuthumela,” kusho uHlomuka.Uthe sebebumbe ithimba losonhlalakahle abaluleka ngokomqondo ukuba bayonikezela ngalolu sizo kubafundi nemindeni yabo. Uqhube wathi ohambweni lwakhe kulesi sikole, uzobe eyohlanganyela nemindeni yabagilwa kanjalo nomphakathi."Okwethu ukukhombisa ukweseka abagilwa kulesi sikhathi esinzima, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi basesimweni esikahle,” usho kanje.Uthe bengumnyango bazimisele ukusebenza eduze namaphoyisa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abagilwa bayabuthola ubulungiswa. Isolezwe libike ngezimbalwa zalezi zehlakalo.Kuzona kukhona esomfundi okuthiwa udlwengulwe ngumsolwa ngeledlule ephume ekotishini lakhe waya ethoyilethi elingaphandle, ekhishwa yisisu. Kuthiwa uthe ephuma ethoyilethi, umsolwa ubesemlindile, wamdlwengula. Kwesinye isigameko, okuthiwa senzeke ngasekuqaleni kukaMeyi, umsolwa kuthiwa wangenela abafundi ababili ekotishini, wabakhipha ngendluzula, ebayisa ehlathini. Kuvela ukuthi wagcina ephumelela ukudlwengula oyedwa, njengoba omunye wakwazi ukuphunyula, abaleke. Izolo, kuthiwa kunabanye abafundi abese beqalile ukuhamba bekhala ngezokuphepha njengoba nabazali bakhala ngezokuphepha.
BEKUKHONA nomfowabo kaMnqobi "Number 10" Nzimande weWest, kwababili, okuthiwa badutshulwe, babulawa eminye imigulukudu, eziMangweni, eNanda, ngempelasonto. Isolezwe lipotshozelwe wumthombo walo ongeke uvezwe ukuthi umufi yilo owayedansa nehlahla lomlahlankosi emngcwabeni kaMnqobi ngoFebhuwari kulo nyaka, maqede kwababaza wonke umuntu ezinkundleni zokuxhumana.Ngokusho komthombo, umufi nedlanzana leminye imigulukudu, bebezihlalele ngaphandle kwesitolo kule ndawo ngesikhathi kungena inkulumo yokuthi kukhona "abakweleta uMnqobi uphawini wakhe”, okuyimali. "Kuthiwa iqale lapho ingxabano, bebanga ukuthi njengoba kwabulawa uMnqobi, wafa kade besebenze imali ethize, okwathi uma esebulawa amaphoyisa, bangabe besawuletha uphawini wakhe,” kusho umthombo. Uthe umufi ubedinwa wukuthi ngisho nangemuva komngcwabo kaMnqobi, abazange bayilethe le mali emndenini. Umthombo uthe umufi uyindodana yesithathu esiswini sikanina ukubulawa ngesibhamu. Lokhu Isolezwe lakuthola enkulumeni ekhethekile elaba nayo nomndeni emva komngcwabo kaMnqobi ngoFebhuwari, lapho udadewabo, uNksz Nompumelelo Mngoma, aveza ukuthi ngo-2024, bashonelwa omunye umfowabo, uMmeli Nzimande, owafa ngokudutshulwa.Ngokusho kwakhe, uMmeli wazithola esendaweni engafanele, ngesikhathi esingafanele, wase edutshulwa. Waveza ukuthi kwakubanjwa inkunzi endaweni yesigameko, uMmeli azithola ekuyo, wase edubuleka. Yize kunjalo amalungu omphakathi ayichitha le nkulumo, athi isosha lafela emsebenzini walo. UMnqobi ubeyindodana yesibili kunina ukubulawa ngesibhamu. Wadutshulwa amaphoyisa ekupheleni kukaJanuwari kulo nyaka, betholene phezulu ngezulu lezandla eVerulam.Ngaleso sikhathi amaphoyisa aveza ukuthi ubefunelwa amacala angaphezu kuka-20 okubulala. Ethintwa uNksz Mngoma kulandela isehlakalo sangoMgqibelo, uthe akukho afuna ukukuphawula ngaphandle kokuthi athi: "Lokhu enizwe kuthiwa kwenzekile, okubhalwe ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, kuyikho. Sisemanzini, siphatheke kabi asifuni ukulokhu siphawula.” Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uConstable Thenjiswa Ngcobo, uthe amaphoyisa aseNanda aphenya amacala okubulala amabili emva kokudutshulwa kwabesilisa ababili eziMangweni eNanda. "Kuthiwa abafi badutshulwe kuphindelelwa ngabasolwa abangaziwa,” kusho uConstable Ngcobo.
ZITHI ncinci kamjoli iningi lezakhamuzi zaseXobho, ngokubulawa kowesilisa okuthiwa ubeyiphela endlebeni, ehlalise lubhojozi umphakathi wakule ndawo.Umthombo weSolezwe uthole ukuthi umufi, uMnuz Sandile Magubane (37), ubewuhlalise lubhojozi umphakathi wakule ndawo.Kuvela ukuthi udutshulwe ngabantu abangaziwa ekubo, abamhlasele ngezithuba zantambama ngoLwesihlanu olwedlule. Umthombo uthe umphakathi wakule ndawo bese kukaningi ulimisa ngesihloko elokuthi usukhathele wona yilo wesilisa.Kuvela ukuthi ubeneqembu lakhe lemigulukudu aliholayo ahlasela nalo ezindlini zabantu.''Lo mfana neqembu lakhe bebengenalo nje nhlobo uzwelo, uma befikile kwakho bebethatha yonke impahla. Uma kukhona okhulumayo bebemane bamdubule,'' kuchaza umthombo. Uthe okubuhlungu ukuthi umufi indlela abesatshwa ngayo, bekuthi noma esefika ezogila imikhuba yakhe amane angazifihli ebusweni.''Mina befikile ekhaya ngoNovemba, ngambona ngoba wayengazifihlile ebusweni. Bangena bathatha yonke into eyayikhona endlini base bayahamba. Ubhuti wami wathi uzama ukukhulumisana nabo bamdubula engalweni,'' usho kanje.Omunye umthombo uveze ukuthi kwake kwabizwa umhlangano womphakathi kodwa kwafika ingcosana yabantu ngoba nakhu babethi bayesaba ukuya kuwona ngoba umufi wayebatshele ukuthi bazowukhomba onotshwala abazoba yingxenye yomhlangano. Elinye ilungu lomphakathi lithe likholwa ukuthi sekuzoke behle ubuthongo njengoba sekubulewe ubhongoza.Ilungu lomndeni kamufi, uNksz Sithenjiwe Magubane, livumile ukuthi umfowabo udutshulwe wabulawa ngabantu abangaziwa.''Bekuyizikhathi zantambama naye esanda kubuya lapha ekhaya, kwamane kwapaka imoto iPolo eli-grey. Kuphume amadoda amane, aqonde endlini yakhe. Kuthe uma evula amane angabuza lutho, amdubula washonela khona lapho,'' usho kanje. Uthe kubaphathe kabi ukubulawa kwelungu labo. Uvumile ukuthi bebeke bezwe kuthiwa umufi uhlalise lubhojozi umphakathi.''Kodwa okusixakayo ukuthi nalapha ekhaya sekuze kwaba amahlandla amabili kuhlasela abantu bethatha impahla, belimaza nabantu balapha ekhaya. Pho ngabe basihlasela kanjani uma kungukuthi umuntu ogila umkhuba ngowalapha ekhaya?'' Ugcizelele ukuthi ithemba labo selilele ophenyweni lwamaphoyisa ukuze kutholakale abenzi bokubi.''Asazi ngampela ukuthi kungani ebulewe, sesethemba ukuthi amaphoyisa kukhona azokuthola ngokubulawa kwakhe.''Amaphoyisa aKwaZulu-Natal, athe alikho icala elisavuliwe mayelana nalolu daba.
UBANJWE ehostela iDalton eyofuna usizo enyangeni uMnuz Khumbulani Ngubane (28), osolwa ngokudlwengula abafundi baseBizimali High, eNhloshane eNkandla.UNgubane uvele kafushane izolo enkantolo yasePinetown ngecala lokweqa esitokisini samaphoyisa eMariannhill ngoMsombuluko. Okwamanje kuthiwa uzogcinwa esitokisini esiteshini samaphoyisa eDurban North kanti wenqatshelwe ibheyili. Uzobuyela enkantolo yasePinetown ngoMeyi 28.Ngezinsolo zamacala okudlwengula eBizimali kuthiwa uzovela ngawo eNkandla. UNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal uMnuz Thami Ntuli, uncome umsebenzi wamaphoyisa ngokuboshwa kukaNgubane.Uthe uNgubane kuthiwa uye enyangeni eyofuna usizo ngamacala akhe, inyanga yawusola umgqakazo yahlaba umkhosi emaphoyiseni.UNtuli uveze nokuthi akasayi namhlanje esiteshini samaphoyisa eMariannhill ukuyovula icala umfowabo kaNgubane, okusolwa ukuthi usesabisa ofakazi. Ihhovisi likaNtuli izolo beliveze ukuthi yena noKhomishana wamaPhoyisa esifundazweni, uLieutenant-General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi bazoya esiteshini samaphoyisa iMariannhill namuhla.Kuthiwa bayofuna izimpendulo zokuthi weqe kanjani uNgubane owaqala wabanjwa ebhace eTshelimnyanga, eMariannhill, ebalekela amacala 'okudlwengula' eBizimali. Usolwa ngamacala ayisithupha okudlwengula izingane zalesi sikole ezihlala emakotishi, emizini eseduzane. Kuthiwa weqa emuva kokuziqulekisa, ethi uhlaselwa yisifo sofuba, kwathi uma amaphoyisa ezama ukumsiza kulokho, waphunyuka, wabaleka. UNtuli uthe noma yiluphi uhlobo lokusatshiswa kofakazi luyicala elibucayi futhi ngeke lubekezelelwe. "Sifuna ukukubeka kucace ukuthi ukusatshiswa kofakazi kuwukuma endleleni yobulungiswa, kanti ngeke sinanaze ukuvikela abazophumela obala ngalokhu,” kusho uNtuli.Mayelana nokuhambela kwakhe esiteshini samaphoyisa iMariannhill, uNtuli uthe bahlose ukuthi bacaciseleke ngokweqa kukamsolwa, baphinde baqinisekise ukuthi lowo okufanele aphendule ngalokhu, wenza njalo. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi amaphoyisa aseMariannhill asephinde ambopha umsolwa oneminyaka engu-28, oweqe esitokisini ngoMsombuluko, kulandela ukuboshwa kwakhe ngezikhathi zasekuseni ngalolu suku.Uthe amaphoyisa abemthungatha ubusuku nemini, ambhadame ebhace ehostela eliseMbilo (iDalton) izolo.
UMNYANGO wezobuDlelwano namaMazwe omhlaba unethemba elikhulu lokuthi umhlangano obhekwe ngabomvu phakathi kukaMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, noMengameli waseMelika, uDonald Trump, uzoqinisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwala mazwe.URamaphosa noTrump kulindeleke ukuba babe nomhlangano eziNdlini zoMbuso eMelika, iWhite House namhlanje.Ekhuluma neziko labezindaba likahulumeni, iSAnews, ngaphambi kokutheleka kukaRamaphosa eMelika, uMnuz Clayson Monyela, walo Mnyango, uthe ukuhambela kukaRamaphosa kuleliya zwe kuyisinyathelo esibaluleke kakhulu neqhinga elizoqinisa ubudlelwano bala mazwe. Muva nje, ubudlelwano beNingizimu Afrika neMelika bubonakale budungeka kusukela ngoFebhuwari nonyaka, ngesikhathi uTrump enqamula uxhasomali lweNingizimu Afrika lokusiza izinhlelo zokulwa nengculaza nesandulela sayo.Akugcinanga lapho, uTrump uphinde wakhomba indlela obeyinxusa lakuleli eMelika, uMnuz Ebrahim Rasool, emva kokwenza inkulumo engehlanga kahle kwabaseMelika. Ngeledlule, iqeqebana labamhlophe libophe imithwalo, lalibangisa eMelika njengababaleki likhala ngokungaphathwa kahle eNingizimu Afrika.URamaphosa ukuchithile ukuthi laba ababaleki. UMonyela uthe bayathemba ukuthi umhlangano walaba baholi uzonika ithuba lokudingida nokucacisa izinkulumo ezikhona ngokwenzenjalo kuqine ubudlelwano bala mazwe. "Sifuna ukubonga ukuthi kunethuba lokuba laba baholi baxoxisane. Ukuthi uMengameli Ramaphosa ulapha eWashington, ehambisana nongqongqoshe abane ukuzohlangana noMengameli Trump nethimba lakhe, kuyigxathu elihle nobudlelwano phakathi kwala mazwe obubalulekile," kusho uMonyela.Uchaze iMelika njengezwe lesibili ngobukhulu elihwebelana neNingizimu Afrika, ukugcizelele ukuthi la mazwe asesebenzisane iminyaka eminingi."IMelika izwe lesibili ngobukhulu esihwebelana nalo. Sinomnotho ohlukile, onamandla, ohamba phambili ezwenikazi i-Afrika, kumanje singabasingathi beG20, ngakho-ke lo mhlangano ubalulekile ukuba la mazwe omabili ahlangane axoxe ngezinto ezizoqinisa ubudlelwano obuvele bukhona phakathi kwala mazwe okuzohlomulisa abantu bawo, " kusho Monyela. Ukuvumile ukuthi kukhona okusadinga ukuchazwa futhi kucaciswe ekugcineni kodwa banethemba lokuthi lezi zingxoxo zizosiza ukuba kusondelwane kuqhutshekelwe phambili futhi kuqiniswe ubudlelwano obuzozuzisa la mazwe omabili.Uthe iNingizimu Afrika ayinabo ubudlelwano eMelika kuphela kodwa itshale imali emnothweni wakuleliya zwe.Ephetha uthe: "Sitshale imali emnothweni waseMelika. Izinkampani zaseNingizimu Afrika ezifana neNando's iyasebenza lapha. Uma uya eLouisiana, uzothola izikhamuzi eziningi zaseMelika ziqashwe izinkampani zaseNingizimu Afrika."Uthe abaya kulo mhlangano njengezwe elingaphethe lutho okungakho kubalulekile ukuthi buqiniswe ubudlelwano bala mazwe.

Nokuthi uma sikwenze kahle lokhu kokufaka ezobuchwepheshe besimanje ezinganeni zethu, kungasiza ukuqeda lo mkhuba esihlale sikhala ngawo wokuthi kudingeke abantu bakwamanye amazwe bazokwenza izinto esihlulwa wukuzenza ezweni lethu,” kuqhuba yena Obemele iMeya yoMkhandlu weTheku uMnuz Ntando Khuzwayo, uthe banethemba lokuthi lo mcimbi uzoqhubeka uthele izithelo ezibonakalayo, ezizophumelelisa umbono wabo wokuthi ngo-2030, ingxenye eningi yentsha yaseThekwini namaphetehlo ibe isikwazi ukungena igxile emikhakheni ezoletha ushintsho futhi ithuthukise nomphakathi.Omunye wabafundi baka-matric abebekhona kulo mbuthano, uNtokozo Cele (19) waseKloof, ofunda e-The Kenmont School, eBluff, uthe bajabule kakhulu bengabafundi ngaleli thuba abalitholile.Uthe ukholwa wukuthi limsize kakhulu yena nozakwabo ukuqonda kabanzi ngemikhakha abebengayinakile abasengakwazi ukuyilandela uma beqeda ukufunda.
KWEMBULWA kwembeswa kowesifazane okuthiwa ubhokodwe ngommese esiswini, amathumbu aphumela ngaphandle enkabeni yedolobha oThongathi ngoMgqibelo.Owesifazane kuthiwa ugwazwe owesilisa, odinwe wukuthi unqabe ukuthi baye ocansini.Ngokusho kwabenkampani yonogada eqapha ubugebengu, iReaction Unit South Africa (Rusa), umsolwa ungaphandle ngoshwele.Okhulumela iRusa, uMnuz Prem Balram, uthe umsolwa wayeboshelwe icala lokubulala. Elandisa ngesigameko, uPrem uthe umsolwa ufice umgilwa emi yedwa, elinde isoka lakhe ebelisangene kwesinye isitolo."Kuthiwa ufike wacela ukuthi baye ocansini nomgilwa, kuthe uma enqaba, wavele wakhipha ummese, wamgwaza esiswini, wasishiya sivulekile,” kusho uBalram.Uqhube wathi isoka likamgilwa elimfice eselimele, livele lamqhuba nge-trolley, limphuthumisa emtholampilo oseduzane. Udalule ukuthi unogada wakwaRusa, obehamba ngesithuthuthu, ezulazula emgwaqweni uGopalall Hurbans, eqapha ubugebengu umiswe yisoka likamgilwa, limtshela ukuthi usegwazwe wumuntu ongaziwa. "Ngesikhathi besendleleni beya endaweni yesigameko, isoka likamgilwa libe selimbona umsolwa, lamkhombisa unogada, ongapholisanga maseko, wamjaha,” kusho uBalram. Uqhube wathi umsolwa uvele wakhipha ummese, efuna ukugwaza unogada."Unogada ukwazile ukunqoba umsolwa obekhombisa udlame, wambopha, wase emnikela emaphoyiseni,” kusho uBalram.

UNGQONGQOSHE wezeMpilo, uDkt Aaron Motsoaledi uyazichitha izinkulumo zokuthi luyafadabala uhlelo lwakuleli lokulwa nengculaza nesandulela sayo kulandela isimemezelo sikaMengameli waseMelika, Donald Trump, sokunqamula koxhasomali lwePresident’s Emergency Plan for AIDS Relief (PEPFAR).NgoFebhuwari nonyaka, uTrump wasayinda umyalelo wokunqamula lolu xhasomali lweNingizimu Afrika olusiza ezinhlelweni zokulwa nengculaza nesandulela sayo. Uhlelo iPEPFAR, lwasungulwa owayengumengameli waseMelika, uGeorge W Bush, ngo-2003 kanti luqhubekile ngaphansi komengameli abalandela emva kwakhe. Kuleli sonto, inhlangano yabezindaba iReuters bike ukuthi ukuhlolwa nokulandelelwa kwabana lesi sifo eNingizimu Afrika, kuphazamisekile kulandela ukunqanyulwa kwalolu uxhasomali iMelika obeluxhasa abasebenzi bezempilo nemitholampilo okushaye kakhulu abesifazane abakhulelwe, izingane ezisanda kuzalwa nentsha.Ukunqanyulwa kwalo kufake itwetwe kubasebenzi bezinhlangano ezingenzinzuzo ngekusasa lazo kanye nezinhlelo zokulwa nengculaza nesandulela sayo. Ekhuluma nabezindaba ngoLwesine uNgqongqoshe Motsoaledi, uthe uhulumeni unazo izinhlelo ezinqala zokuqhuba uhlelo lokwelapha ingculaza nezokuyinqanda.Ubalule ukulahlekelwa imali engu-R7. 9 billion ebiphuma kuPEPFAR kwengu-R 46.8 billion ebisetshenziswa ezinhlelweni zokulwa nalolu bhubhane ngonyaka.Lokhu kwenzeka nje kunabantu abangu-5.9 million abadla imishanguzo yengculaza. Uqhube wathi akuwenzi nakancane umqondo ukuthi emalini engu-R46. 8 billion esetshenziswa uhulumeni kuzinhlelo zokulwa nengculaza nesandulela sayo, ukunqanyulwa koxhaso lukaR7. 9 billion iMelika sekungaholela ekutheni luphazamiseke lonke uhlelo. "Kusukela kunqanyulwe uxhaso lwePEPFAR, uhulumeni uqale iqhingasu elinqala ukuvala igebe loxhasomali nokuthi kuqhutshekwe nokuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo zezempilo," kusho uNgqongqoshe. Phakathi kwamaqhingasu akhuluma ngawo kubalwa imihlangano ehlanganisa izifundazwe eba masontonke ukubheka no kulandela inqubekela phambili ezinhlelweni zokwelapha lesi sifo. "Sesikwazile ukufinyelela kubantu abayingxenye yesigidi sisebenzisa izinhlelo zethu ezididiyelwe nezinhlangano zomphakathi futhi saluthola uxhasomali okuhlanganisa nokwesekwa ngo-R 1 billion iGlobal Fund," kusho uNgqongqoshe Motsoaledi. Uveze ukuthi njengengxenye yokuqinisekisa ukuthi akukho ukuphazamiseka kwezinhlelo, babe nemikhankaso ezifundazweni lapho bebe hlangana nezisebenzi zezempilo, imikhandlu ebhekele izinhlelo zengculaza nabaphuma emphakathini. "Kuyiphutha ukuthi umkhankaso wezinhlelo zengculaza nesandulela sayo ziyafa ngoba akunjalo. Khona ukuthi siqhamuke naleli qhinga kukhombisa ukuba siyazi ukuthi izinto zingonakala," esho. Maqondana nokuvalwa kwemitholampilo eqondene nalesi sifo engu-12 ebixhaswe iPEPFAR, uthe amafayela eziguli ezingu-63 000 adluliselwe ezikhungweni zezempilo zikahulumeni. Udalule ukuthi uhulumeni usuqeqeshe abasebenza emitholampilo abangu-1000 nabasebenzela ngaphandle kwayo abangu-2300 ezifundazweni ezingu-7.UNgqongqoshe Motsoaledi uthe uhulumeni usakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemishanguzo amaphesenti angu-90 ayo ethengwe uhulumeni kanti angama-10 kwaba uxhaso.UNgqongqoshe Motsoaledi uthe uhulumeni usaqhubeka nokufuna uxhaso emazweni osebenzisana nawo okubalwa imihlangano nezinhlangano ezifana neBill and Melinda Gates Foundation neFrench Development Agency. "Lesi isikhathi sokuba kuhlanganwe, kubumbanwe kuliwe nalesi simo siyimbumba," kusho uNgqongqoshe Motsoaledi.
KUME nse ukufunda esikoleni esidume ngemiphumela emihle ka-matric eNkandla, iBizimali High, abafundi bebhikishela ukuphepha emakotishi abaqashe kuwo, bekhala ngokudlwengulwa kozakwabo.Ngokuthola kweSolezwe, zibalelwa kwezinhlanu izigameko zokudlwengulwa kwabafundi balesi sikole ezenzeke ukusuka emasontweni ambalwa edlule. Uveze ukuthi kuba nesiteleka sabafundi nje, bebenomhlangano wabazali ngeSonto. Kuwona uthe bekukhona abazali, ubuholi besikole, umphakathi, omastende, iforamu eqapha ubugebengu endaweni kanjalo namaphoyisa. "Umhlangano singasho ukuthi ube yimpumelelo ngoba amaphoyisa ashilo ukuthi nakuba engeke ande kakhulu ngamazwi ngoba lokho kuzophazamisa uphenyo, kodwa ukhona umkhondo awulandelayo,” kusho uNgubane.Uveze ukuthi kwezinye izinhlaka ebezikhona, kushiyane imibono, njengoba abanye bezwakalise ukugculiseka ngesikhathi abanye bezwakalise ukungagculiseki, kwathi abanye bakhombisa ukukhathazeka. "Abanye abazali banelisekile ngokushiwo amaphoyisa kodwa ebebengagculisekile, bacele izincwadi zokukhipha izingane zabo kulesi sikole, baphindela nazo emuva,” kusho uNgubane. Uthe abazali abenze lokho abanezingane ezivela ezindaweni ezikude, abathe ngeke bakwazi ukunikela ngezingane zabo 'kumdlwenguli’ wendawo.Kuthiwa laba bazali bebenza nezinsolo zokuthi umdlwenguli uhlasela izingane zabo ngoba kungezona ezendawo.Kuvela ukuthi bebesola ngisho nomastende ukuthi abakwenzi okwanele ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izingane zabo ziphephile emakotishi abo."Omastende bakhombise ukuthi luyabahlupha lolu daba ngoba konke lokhu kwenzeka endaweni yabo. Uma unamakotishi ayishumi, abazali abayisithupha bekhipha izingane zabo esikoleni, okusho ukuthi ususele nezingane ezine. Bakhathazeke kakhulu,” kusho uNgubane. Isolezwe emasontweni ambalwa edlule, liqala ukuzwa ngalolu daba, lathola ukuthi umsolwa ubethula izimpahla zabafundi zangaphansi kolayini.Kuthiwa lokhu kwatshala uvalo lokuthi le ndawo inomalugaju, kwavela nokuthi abafundi sebenovalo lokuya emakilasini asebusuku, beyofunda. Nokho uNgubane uthe lolu lwazi aluvelanga emhlanganweni obukhona. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uqinisekise isigameko esisodwa sokudlwengula. Uthe abaphenyi baseMariannhill beholwa wumphathi siteshi, uColonel Muzi Twala, babophe umsolwa (28) ngamacala okudlwengula, ukuthumba nokubamba inkunzi izolo. Kuthiwa umsolwa ubanjwe eTshelimnyama, lapho ebesebhace khona."Lokhu kulandela isigameko sokuthunjwa kuphinde kudlwengulwe intombazane (17) ngoMeyi 4, 2025. Umgilwa wahlaselwa wumsolwa elele, wamqhuba baya ehlathini, emsabisa ngommese, umsolwa wabe esedlwengula umgilwa, wamphuca imali yakhe neselula,” kusho uNetshiunda.UNtuli uthe izehlakalo ezifuze lezi azinandawo emphakathini wethu.

BAKHALE mi izinyembezi abazalwane bebandla likaMfu Tim Omotoso, iJesus Dominion International (JDI), eBallito, ngesikhathi eqinisekisa izindaba zokuthi amabombo usewabhekise kwelakubo eNigeria. Lokhu kwenzeke izolo ngesikhathi kunenkonzo kuleli gatsha lesonto, okuyilo lodwa esifundazweni iKwaZulu-Natal.U-Omotoso, oteketiswa abazalwane bakhe ngelika”Daddy”, uqinisekise lezi zindaba ngesikhathi ekhuluma kumakhalekhukhwini nonkosikazi wakhe osazinze kuleli. Ubelokhu ephuma engena esontweni ngesikhathi kunenkonzo, okuthe esebuya okokugcina, wabuya ekhuluma nocingo, wayalela abadlala izinsimbi ukuthi uzolufaka esipikheni ucingo luka-Omotoso, maqede izwi lakhe lazwiwa yibo bonke abazalwane.Ushaye ngamafuphi wathi: "Abangifuni kuleli zwe, akukho engizokwenza kufanele ngihambe.” Isolezwe ebelithamele inkonzo, lithole ukuthi u-Omotoso ube yingxenye yenkonzo yasebusuku izinsuku ezintathu ezedlule okokuqala ngqa emva kokudedelwa kwakhe ephuma phambili emacaleni abesolwa ngawo.Bese kuphele iminyaka eyisishiyagalombili bagcina ukumbona. Enkonzweni yayizolo bekuze namalungu ebandla akade agcina ukuza, ngethemba lokuthi azombona njengoba kuthiwa ubethembise ukuthi uzoba khona enkonzweni yayizolo. Okuqaphelekile ngaleli bandla wukuthi liwubukhazikhazi.Uma uza khona, ukhangwa olude uthango, olwelekwe ngocingo lukagesi, olwenza ungakwazi ukubona kahle ngaphakathi. Uma usungene ngaphakathi, ukhangwa ama-khamera afakwe yonke indawo, kukhonkwe igceke lonke ngokusezingeni eliphezulu, kunezakhiwo ezinhle ezehlukene, Isolezwe elithole ukuthi kukhonzelwa kuzo, ngokwahlukana. Kutshalwe ezinhle izimbali, izihlahla, notshani obonayo ukuthi bunakekelwa zonke izinsuku. Kuphinde kube khona nendawo yokudlala izingane, ongafunga ukuthi yisenkulisa. Ngaphakathi endlini yesonto kufakwe amakhamera, nakhona ukhangwa obakhona ubukhazikhazi, kusuka ezitulweni, airconditioner, kuya kuma-instruments okucula. Ubuholi bebandla obubandakanya nonkosikazi wakhe, abahola ngokuhlabelela nomkhuleko, bonke ngabokufika.Abazalwane, uyabona ukuthi iningi lingomacaphuna kusale, bese kuba yidlanzana lalabo abaphakathi nendawo. Bonke baswenka baconse, futhi iningi lihamba ngezimoto zalo, ezinye zisuka ezindaweni ezehlukene esifundazweni.Uma bekhuleka bayaguqa, babodwa abaze banqekuzise amakhanda, abanye bafikelwe yizinyembezi, kukhombisa ukuthi bayizwa ngaphakathi into abayenzayo. Uma kuculwa amakhorasi, kuculwa eside isikhathi, ngesiNgisi nangolimi lwabokufika. Ubufakazi kanjalo namaculo abeculwa bekuzwelana naye u-Omotoso "nokuhlaselwa” kwakhe abezomthetho bakuleli. Phakathi kwamaculo aculiwe kukhona nelithi "He lifted me up from the deep muddy clay”, umkakhe athe bebelokhu belishaya ngaphandle kwenkantolo, kube kuncane indawo.Okunye okutholwe yiSolezwe kumalungu ebandla ambalwa, lizixoxela nawo, wukuthi banolunye uhlobo lokukholwa kumfundisi wabo."Akekho osezingeni lakhe kule lizwe, ezwenikazi nasemhlabeni jikelele. Akekho ofinyelela kuye,” kusho leli lungu, elithe lona laqala ukusonta ngo-2013. Liqhube lathi u-Omotoso unamandla angaphezu kwawemvelo, kuningi okungakholakali abakubone ngamehlo, ngokholo lwakhe."Izinto ezingabonwa ngamehlo enyama, yizinto ezibonwa ngeso lakwamoya kuphela,” usho kanje.Liqhuba leli lungu lithe, okwenze bangayeka ukusonta kuleli bandla yize u-daddy ebevalelwe iminyaka eyisishiyagalombili, wukuthi njalo uma ekhuluma ubethi abalandele kakhulu izimfundiso zakhe. "Ezimfundisweni zakhe usifundisile ukuthi sazi ukuthi njengoba engesiye nje umuntu ojwayelekile, uzobhekana nezilingo,” kusho ilungu, elithe ukuboshwa kwakhe ezinye zazo lezo zilingo.Ligcizelele eyokuthi akekho omunye umfundisi eliyobuye limuzwe ukudlula u-Omotoso.Elinye ilungu, nalo ebelizikhininda, lithe lona laqala ukusonta kuleli bandla ngo-2007, lineminyaka elinganiselwa ku-20. Lithe lisalokhu liyibambile ngoba zonke iziphrofetho azisho kulo, zenzeka njengoba ayeziphrofethile."Wabona ukuthi ngizoba nezingane ezintathu, umyeni, nomuzi. Konke kwenzeka njengoba ayekubonile. Uma esephrofetha, ubevele akubize ngegama lakho nesibongo, bese eyakutshela lokhu akuboniswayo. Ngimthanda ukufa. Angiziboni ngikholwa kwelinye ibandla,” kusho leli lungu. Liphawula ngamacala okudlwengula akhishwe kuwo phambili, lithe: "Yeyi ngoba usathane uyabasebenzisa abantu. Lezo zingane zazihlala la eduze kwethu, kanti ngelinye ilanga zizomphendukela kanje u-daddy.”U-Omotoso unawo amanye amagatsha kwezinye izifundazwe, okukhona kuzo, iGauteng, Mpumalanga ne-Eastern Cape.UMnyango wezaseKhaya uveze ukuthi u-Omotoso akavumelekile ukuza kuleli kuze kuphele iminyaka emihlanu. Ubuholi baleli bandla bulixoshile Isolezwe ngesikhathi intatheli isiveza ukuthi iphuma kwabezindaba. Buthe ngeke buphawule kwabezindaba. Buthumele abazalwane abatshele intatheli ukuthi ayifuneki, bayikhapha baze bayoyikhiphela ngaphandle kwesango, base belivala.Izolo kuvele ukuthi ibhanoyi abeligibele belisuka eThekwini, kanti uyalelwe ukuthi angabuyi kuze kuphele iminyaka emihlanu.
UBUHOLI besikole iBizimali High, eNkandla, buthembise ukuthi buzokwenza konke okusemandleni ukuthi isihlava sokudlwengulwa kwabafundi balesi sikole, singabi nomthelela omubi emiphumeleni ka-matric walo nyaka.Lokhu kushiwo wuthishanhloko Mnuz Thamsanqa Dumakude izolo, emhlanganweni wabazali nomphakathi, obuhanjelwe wuMphathiswa wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka.UHlomuka uvakashele kulesi sikole kulandela umbhikisho wabafundi ngoMsombuluko, bekhala ngokwanda kwezigameko zokudlwengulwa kwabafundi abahlala emakotishi asemizini eyakhele isikole. Ziyisithupha izigameko zokudlwengulwa kwabafundi eziqinisekiswe okhulumela amaphoyisa esifundazweni, uColonel Robert Netshiunda. Kuzo zonke, kusolwa uMnuz Khumbulani "Vovo” Ngubane (28), ofunwe, watholwa eTshelimnyama, eMariannhill, osomatekisi baseNkandla. UDumakude uthe lezi zigameko zenzeke ngesikhathi esibi, besanda kushiywa wuthishanhloko waphambilini, onomlando wokukhiqiza imiphumela emihle ka-matric. "Lesi simo sisehle ngaphezulu, sisabhekene nenselelo yokubamba umgqigqo kathishanhloko waphambilini. Nokho siyathembisa ukuthi kuzobonakala uma kuphela unyaka ukuthi senze kanjani,” kusho uDumakude. Uthe bazoqhubeka nokusebenza ngokuzikhandla, ukuze okwenzekile kungabi nomthelela omubi emiphumeleni yesikole.Uveze ukuthi ukudlwengulwa kwabafundi kuphidelelwa bese kuholele ekutheni ama-class asebusuku akhishwe ngaphambi kwesikhathi esejwayelekile. "Ama-class ethu asebusuku abengena ngo-6 aphume ngo-10. Sigcine siwashintsha, angena ngawo u-6 kodwa aphuma ngo-8,” kusho uDumakude, othe ikhona i-forum yomphakathi ezinikela ngokukhapha abafundi uma sebegoduka ebusuku. Uveze ukuthi isigameko sokuqala senzeke ngoMeyi 4, ezinye zase zilandela emva kwalokho. Uthe abagilwa bebehlala emakotishi asemzini owodwa, okuze kwaholela ekutheni kuthathwe isinqumo sokuthi abafundi ebebengakehlelwa yisiga, basuswe bonke, bafunelwa ezinye izindawo zokuhlala. UHlomuka uthe okubasukumisile wukuthi iBizimali esinye sezikole ezibambe iqhaza ekutheni isifundazwe silale isibili ngemiphumela emihle ka-matric kuzwelonke."Ngeke ke sivume ukuthi umsebenzi omuhle kangaka woniwe wuVovo,” kusho uHlomuka. Uthe uzokhuluma noKhomishana wamaPhoyisa esifundazweni, uLieutenant-General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi ukuthi akalandwe umfowabo kamsolwa.Uthe kufanele azochaza ukuthi lezi zinsongo azisho kwi-voice note, ezungeza ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, zichaza ukuthini. Ugcizelele ukuthi umsolwa abamdingi ngaphandle, ngoba lokhu akwenzile kuyethusa, wathi njengoba edlwengule abafundi, kusasa uzodlwengula othisha. Uveze ukuthi bajube ithimba lodokotela abeluleka ngokomqondo nosonhlalakahle ukuthi bazonikezela ngalolu sizo kubo bonke abafundi nothisha.Uthe ukhulumile noMkhwanazi (uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal), emtshela ukuthi kuzoba nzima ukuthi amaphoyisa achaze ukuthi weqe kanjani umsolwa esitokisini, esebanjiwe osomatekisi, bamnikela emaphoyiseni. "Siyawufuna umbiko wokuthi yimaphi lawo maphoyisa adedele umsolwa esebanjelwe yena,” kusho uHlomuka. Ubabongile osomatekisi ngokumfuna baze bamthole umsolwa, wathi ukuba abalusukumelanga udaba, ngabe namanje umsolwa usagcwele amathafa.
LIKHATHAZEKILE ikomiti leMfundo eyisiSekelo ePhalamende ngokuthi zingaphezu kuka-400 izikole zamabanga aphezulu kuleli ezingayifundisi nhlobo i-maths.Lezi zikole zifundisa i-maths literacy kuphela njengoba kusuka kwaGrade 10 kuya kwaGrade 12, abafundi kumele benze i-maths noma i-maths literacy.Lokhu kwenzeka phezu kokuba kuhlale kuhlatshwa ikhwelo lokuthi abafundi benze i-maths ukuze bakwazi ukungena emikhakheni ehlukene. Kwabona abafundi ikakhulu abenza u-matric, bahlale bekhala ngokuthi abakwazi ukungena kweminye imikhakha ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme ngenxa yokuthi basuke benze i-maths literacy.Usihlalo wekomiti, uNksz Joy Maimela, ukhale ngokuthi zingu-462 izikole zamabanga aphezulu ezingayifundisi i-maths.Uthe lokhu kuveza ukuthi kunabafundi abashiywe ngaphandle abangakwazi ukwenza i-maths ezindaweni zasemakhaya. "Akumele ngabe uma umfundi efuna ukwenza i-maths angakwazi ngenxa yokuthi kayifundwa esikoleni sakhe. Umfundi kumele akwazi ukusenza lesi sifundo, angancishwa ithuba." Ngokwezibalo zomnyango, kulezi zikole ayikho i-maths kanjalo ne-technical maths, kufundiswa kuphela i-maths literacy.Ziveze nokuthi izifundazwe ezinezikole eziningi ezingayenzisi i-maths kubalwa neKwaZulu-Natal. "I-KZN inezikole ezingu-136 ezingayenzisi nhlobo i-maths, kulandele i-Eastern Cape ngezingu-97, endaweni yesithathu kuneLimpopo ngezingu-78. EWestern Cape zingu-61."Umqondisi jikelele emnyangweni, uMnuz Mathanzima Mweli, uthe iningi lalezi zikole zinesibalo esincane sabafundi.Uthe lokhu kudalwa ngukuthi abafundi bafudukela kwezinye izindawo ngenxa yokuthi abazali babo basuke sebeyosebenza kwezinye izindawo. "Lokhu kwenza ukuthi singakwazi ukuhlinzeka othisha abenele kulezi zikole. Sisebenzisana neminyango yezifundazwe ukuze ihlinzeke ngezinto zokuthutha, abafundi bayiswe kwezinye izikole," kusho uMweli.UNgqongqoshe walo mnyango, uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, uthe ukhathazekile ngalesi simo sezikole ezingayifundisi imaths.Uthe banezinhlelo zokuhlanganisa izikole ezehlelwa yisibalo sabafundi nalezo ezinyukelwa, isibalo sabafundi. "Sigxile emfundweni yasemazingeni aphansi ukuze abafundi basenze lesi sifundo. Siyakhala ngabanye abafundi, abagqugquzelwa ukuthi bangasenzi lesi sifundo ngoba kuthiwa sinzima, okwenziwa othisha babo. Yinto okumele iphele le," usho kanje.UMweli noNksz Gwarube bathe abafundi kumele bazikhethele izifundo abafuna ukuzenza okubalwa nayo imaths.
UVUKWE wumunyu uMphathiswa wezokuThutha KwaZulu Natal, uMnuz Siboniso Duma egonyuluka ngokuthi naye wake wabhekana nosizi lokudlulelwa ngamalungu omndeni wakhe engozini yomgwaqo. ''Kwadlula umama wami, ubhutiabashana bami ababili kanye nomzala. Bonke ngosuku olulodwa engozini yemoto. Ngangizibuza nje ukuthi lokhu kwenzeke kanjani. Ngizibuza ukuthi lokhu kudalwe yini ukuthi kwenzeke kimina ekubeni uNkulunkulu ngimthanda kangaka,'' usho kanje.Uthe nabafana abancane bamaHebheru kwakuthiwa mabakhonze izithixo kodwa bashaya phansi ngonyawo ngoba babethi bazi uNkulunkulu wangempela.Uqhube wathi nabezihlobo ezishonile kumele baqhubeke bakhonze uNkulunkulu noma ngabe kunzima kangakanani. ''Ngangizibuza ukuthi kungani lokhu okunje kwenzeke kimina. Ngangizitshela ukuthi ngelinye ilanga uNkulunkulu uyongiphendula angitshele ukuthi kungani kwenzeka kimina,'' usho kanje.Uthe ngaleso sikhathi uMphathiswa wezokuThutha kwakunguMnuz uBheki Cele.''UKhongolose wangilekelela kakhulu ukuze umngcwabo wasekhaya uhambe kahle kakhulu. Yingakho nathi le mindeni sithathe isinqumo sokuthi siyithumelele abantu abazoyibheka ngezindlela ezahlukene,'' usho kanje. Ubaqinise idolo abale mindeni wathi uNkulunkulu unabo noma kunje.''UNkulunkulu unecebo lakhe."Uthe le mindeni kumele inqobe usathane ngokuthi iqhubeke imkhonze uNkulunkulu noma isimo ebhekene naso sinzima. IMeya yaseMkhanyakude uMnuz Siphile Mdaba, ithe kumele kulungiswe izinto kuphenywe ukuthi kungani le moto yayilayishe inqwaba yabantu.IPhini likangqongqoshe wezokuThutha, uMnuz Mkhuleko Hlengwa, lithe wayekhathele umshayeli owayeshayela imoto ethwala ezinye uma zingahambi, okuyiyo eyashayisa eyayihamba amakholwa.UHlengwa uthe yingakho kubalulekile ukuphumula emgwaqweni.Uhlelo beluphethwe ngobunyoninco nguMbhishobhi Vusi Dube webandla i-EThekwini Community Church (ECC). Bekukhona nongqongqoshe beminyango ehlukene.
OSETHIMBENI eliqokelwe ukwakha kabusha i-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Mike Mabuyakhulu, uthi ukumema amaqembu ezepolitiki ukuthi ahlangane ukuze kwakhiwe uhulumeni wobumbano kulesi sifundazwe akusho ukuthi uKhongolose usushintshile.Lokhu ukusho ekhuluma emcimbini wesikhumbuzo sikaNksz Balungile Shembe, owayeyilungu laleli qembu owashona ngo-1990 eZulwini, oBuka, eMpangeni. UBalungile wayezalwa yinkosi uJohannes Galile (J.G) Shembe, iLanga, yaseKuphakameni kwaShembe.Uthe: "Kungenxa yokuthi sinesibophezelo sokuqinisekisa ukuthi kukhona uzinzo ezweni lakithi, kanti futhi nomsebenzi wokwenza impilo yabantu bakithi ibe ngcono uyaqhubeka. Kulesi sikhathi esikuso okuyiyona ndlela ekhona ukuba siqhubeke nalo msebenzi, kube ngukuthi sisebenzisane namanye amaqembu." Uthe abase bebhekile ngeminyaka ka-1994, bazokhumbula ukuthi bake baba khona ohulumeni bokubambisana ngo-1994 kanye nango-1999 KwaZulu-Natal, futhi kuningi okwazuzwa ngaleso sikhathi, okwakungeke kuzuzwe ukuba i-ANC yayingekho emandleni.Uqhube wathi i-ANC ibuyisela umbutho wabantu kubantu futhi basebenzela abantu ngokweqiniso."Iqiniso elingephikwe ukuthi ayikho inhlangano yezepolitiki kuleli zwe lakithi eqonda kahle ukuthi kufanele lakhiwe kanjani izwe ngaphandle kukaKhongolose. Abaningi abazicabanga ukuthi bayizimbangi zikaKhongolose abakaze bahole ngisho amabrantshi abo. Abanye njalo, sebeke bahola kepha bahluleka bancama. NguKhongolose kuphela onombono ojulile wokuthi leli lizwe lakithi kumele silakhe kanjani. NguKhongolose kuphela onolwazi olunzulu, namagalelo abonakalayo okuhola isizwe nokuguqula impilo yabantu bakithi." Ekhuluma ngoNksz Shembe uthe: "Abantu balapha Obuka namaphethelo bayaqonda ukuthi lingakanani iqhaza alibamba kanye nomndeni wakwaShembe ukuze sikwazi ukuthola inkululeko. Ngiyafisa ukucacisa ukuthi lo mndeni usuka kude nombutho wesizwe uKhongolose. Umlando uyasikhumbuza ukuthi ngisho uMqali wendlela, uMphrofethi Isaiah Mdliwamafa Shembe, wayenobuhlobo obukhulu noMengameli wokuqala kaKhongolose ubaba uJohn Langalibalele Dube."
UNGQONGQOSHE wamaPhoyisa kuzwelonke, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, usigxekile isehlakalo sokubulawa kwabayisishiyagalombili eMlaza, ngoLwesihlanu ebusuku.Kulesi sigameko esenzeke emijondolo yakwa-U kuleli lokishi, kubulawe abesilisa abayisithupha nabesifazane ababili. Kuthiwa abafi bahlaselwe ngabantu abangaziwa, abagasele emjondolo obekuhleli kuwo abafi, maqede bavulela ngenhlamvu. Munye umuntu osinde kulesi sehlakalo, okuvela ukuthi ubaleke wacasha ngosofa ngesikhathi ezwa kuqhuma inhlamvu."Ukuhlasela okudlule nemiphefumulo yabantu abangenacala ngesihluku esinje, kuhlasimulisa umzimba. Siyasigxeka kakhulu lesi sehlo,” kusho uMchunu. Uthe lokhu kubulala obenziwe ngobunyoninco nangesihluku esingaka buyayihlukanisa imiphakathi.Uthe sekukhethwe ithimba labaphenyi abazolandela yonke imikhondo yabasolwa."Bazoqoqa bonke ubufakazi obubalulekile ukuze babanjwe abenzi bobubi,” kusho uMchunu othe ngeke baphumule kuze kuba abasolwa bayazijezela izenzo zabo. Unxuse amalungu omphakathi ukuthi asebenzisane namaphoyisa, uma kukhona ulwazi analo angalenzi iphutha, alwedlulisele emaphoyiseni. "Uma kukhona ulwazi onalo, noma ngabe luncane kangakanani, uma nje luzosiza ekutheni abasolwa baziwe ukuthi bangobani nokuthi baphi, lulethe emaphoyiseni,” kusho uMchunu.Uthe bangaluhambisa ngokuthi bathinte amaphoyisa aseduze noma bashayele inombolo yamaphoyisa ethi 08600 10111, wathi bangacela ukungadalulwa uma befuna ukungaziwa.Izigameko zalolu hlobo zejwayelekile emijondolo yaseMlaza, njengoba ngo-Agasti nyakenye, kwadutshulwa abayisithupha kwa-V6 ngemuva kwehostela iTehuis. Kuleso sigameko kuthiwa amadoda amathathu ayezihlalele ngaphandle kwemiqasho yawo eyimijondolo, eziphuzela utshwala ngesikhathi kutheleka abasolwa, bavulela ngenhlamvu.Adlulela endlini kamastende amdubula nomunye wesilisa, athi sebebaleka ahlangana nomunye wesilisa, naye amdubula wafa. Bonke abafi babeneminyaka eqala ku-20 kuya kwengu-40.

UKUSEBENZA isikhathi eside embonini yezomthetho enza imisebenzi eyahlukene kubalwa ukuba wumshushisi akwenze eminyakeni edlule noukuba yimantshi akwenzayo manje eNkantolo yeMantshi eseXopo, ogwini oluseningizimu Afrika, lwenze wabona ukuthi kusekuningi kangakanani okusadinga ukwenziwa ukulwa nesihlava zokuhlukunyezwa kwabantu besifazane nezingane emphakathini nasezweni lonke jikelele.Lowo wuNksz Ntompela Bhengu, othweswe iziqu ze-Master of Laws in Advanced Criminal Justice e-University of KwaZulu-Natal (UKZN) kuleli sonto, lapho abenza khona ucwaningo oluthi The Role of Izinduna and Amakhosi in Eradicating Domestic and Gender-Based Violence, lapho abecwaninga khona ngeqhaza okumele libanjwe ngamakhosi nezinduna ukulwa nokunqoba inkinga yokuhlukunyezwa kwabantu besifazane nezingane ezweni."Ngenkathi ngiqala ukusebenza emacaleni ezinkinga ezahlukene zemindeni, bengivame ukuzwa ukuthi imibono ephusile yabaholi bomphakathi ukuthi basebenzisa ziphi izindlela ukuzama ukuxazulula izinkinga ezibhekene nabantu ababaholayo emphakathi abayiphethe. Bebevame ukukhuluma izinto, othi uma ulalele - uzwe ukuthi zinobuhlakani obunzulu, kodwa kuthi uma sekungamacala eyamene nodlame lwezobulili, kube yibona abasho kuqala ukuthi izinkinga ezinjalo kumele zixazululwe ngokulandela umthetho," kusho uNksz Bhengu. Ocwaningweni lwakhe ubebheka iqhaza elingabanjwa ngabaholi bomphakathi ukulwa nalesi sihlava ezindaweni zasemakhaya, ecwaninga elandela isigatshana somthetho i-Domestic Viollence Act 16 yango-1998, esabuyekezwa ngo-Ephreli wango-2023."Bengigxile kakhulu kwiqhaza abangalibamba uma benganikwa imvume yokungenela ukuxazulula amacala anjena ezinkantolo zabo ezincane emakhaya. Lokho kungenxa yokuthi ngiyaqonda ukuthi udlame lobululi alunamncele, lwenzeka ezindaweni zomtakabani nasezindaweni zasemakhaya ngokufanayo," kusho uNksz Bhengu ohlala eMgungundlovu.Uveze ukuthi ocwaningweni lwakhe uthole ukuthi abantu besifazane basezindaweni zasemakhaya balengela engozini enkulu yokuhlukunyezwa ngokobulili, okuthi uma sebehlukumezekile futhi kuba nezimo ezenza ukuthi kube lula ukuthi bengakutholi ubulungiswa ezigamekweni zokubi okusuke kubehlele.Uthe yingakho ebheka ngeso elibanzi ukuthi abaholi bomphakathi lapho laba bantu besifazane behleli khona yikuphi abangakwenza uma benikwa ithuba lokungenelela, kulandelwa isigatshana somthetho u-Section 5(2) we-Deomestic Violence Act. Ubonge owakwakhe nezingane zabo eziyisithupha ngokumeseka njalo ohambweni lwakhe lwalolu cwaningo obelungelula neze.
ITSHE limi ngothi ngomsebenzi wesikhulu esiphezuliu eMnyangweni wezeMisebenzi yoMphakathi neNgqalasizinda KwaZulu-Natal, esimiswe isigubhukane emsebenzini sisolwa ngoxhaxha lwamacala.Umthombo weSolezwe ongaphakathi emahhovisi alo mnyango, uzikhininde zonke uveza nencwadi ebhalelwe uMnuz Sikhumbuzo Shabangu onguMqondisi ehhovisi leNhloko yoMnyango.Umthombo uveza ukuthi uShabangu phakathi kokunye asolwa ngakho, wukuqasha abasebenzi abangakulungele ukusebenza, wukweba ulwazi lwangasese loMnyango alusebenzisela ukuzizuzisa yena, ukupotshozela osonkontileka abasuke begaqele imisebenzi ngokusuke kudingeka nokungabahloniphi abasebenzi. ''Konakele, le ndoda imisiwe emsebenzini, yona angifuni ukuqamba amanga iyaganga kakhulu. Yenza noma yini ngendlela ethandwa yiyona,'' kulandisa umthombo wangaphakathi.Isolezwe litholile ukuthi abasebenzi bakulo Mnyango bakikiza buthule ngokumiswa kukaShabangu, futhi abafisi ukuthi abuye. Ngokwencwadi abhalelwe yona Isolezwe elinayo, kuvela ukuthi ukubuyela kwakhe emsebenzini kuyoncika kokuzotholakala ophenyweni mayelana nokuziphatha kwakhe.Le ncwadi eveza usuku lukaMeyi 13, isayinwe yisikhulu esiphezulu esisabambile uVish Govender. Abasebenzi bakulo Mnyango abakhulume neSolezwe bacela kugodlwe amagama abo, bathe liphume nobovu ngokumiswa kukaShabangu.''Impela mkhulu uNkulunkulu, kuzoke kushaye umoya njengoba emisiwe nje. Angimboni futhi ebuya,ngoba ubhekene namacala abucayi kakhulu,'' usho kanje.Omunye umsebenzi naye obejabulile uthe ncinci kamjoli ngokunyakaziswa kwesigodlo ''sesikhondlakhondla''. Uthe umbiza kanje ngoba ubenza umathanda maqede kungenzeki lutho kuyena.''Ngiyamangala ukuthi ekugcineni useze wamiswa,'' usho kanje.Kuvela ukuthi uShabangu kunezinye izikhulu zangaphambilini ibhantshi eligcine seligcwala umoya kuzona ngenxa yetulo abelikhanda ngazo. ''Bahambile abantu emsebenzini ngenxa yale ndoda,'' kusho omunye umsebenzi.Umthombo ugcizelele ukuthi uShabangu akasiyena umholi okungathenjelwa kuyena ngenxa yokuthi uyahluleka wukuphatha abasebenzi ngendlela efanele. Kuvela ukuthi uShabangu waxoshelwa into ecishe ifane naxoshelwe yona komunye uMnyango abekuwona phambilini.Ekhuluma neSolezwe uShabangu, uthe yipolitiki nje yangaphakathi eholele kukhona konke lokhu.Kumiswa uShabangu nje zikhona ezinye izikhulu esezike zamiswa phambilini kulo Mnyango selokhu kungene uMphathiswa uMnuz Martin Meyer.UMeyer phambilini wagcizelela ukuthi kulo mnyango abanayo indawo yamazambane abolile.

IZIKHULU zebhange Ithala zithi kuzothatha isikhathi eside ukuba lisebenze ngokujwayelekile kulandela isinqumo senkantolo esilivumela ukuba liqhubeke nokusebenza.Isikhulu esiphezulu eThala, uDkt Thulani Vikalazi, sithe kuningi okudinga ukuthi kulungiswe ngaphambi kokuba ibhange liqale ukusebenza ngokujwayelekile.Ukusho lokhu esithangamini nabezindaba, eThekwini. Ngeledlule iNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu yakhipha isinqumo sokuthi Ithala liqhubeke nokusebenza ngokujwayelekile.Ukusebenza ngokujwayelekile eThala kwama ngoJanuwari 16, kulandela isicelo sohlaka olungaphansi kwebhange loMbuso, iPrudential Authority, sokuba kuvalwe Ithala.UVikalazi uthe ngenxa yokuthi ukusebenza kwebhange kume isikhathi eside kuningi okudinga ukulungiswa ngaphambi kokuba ibhange lisebenze ngokujwayelekile. "Le nto ifana nokuvalwa kwemboni. Uma sekufika isikhathi sokuthi imboni ivulwe kuningi okudinga ukulungiswa ngaphambi kokuthi iqale ukusebenza ngokujwayelekile. Kufanele uqale uhlole ukuthi ngabe yonke imishini isasebenza kahle yini. Kuzokwenzeka ukuthi kukhona abasebenzi asebeshiyile. Yizo zonke izinto okufanele ubhekane nazo."UVikalazi uthe abantu abaningi babelindele ukuthi bazokwazi ukuthola yonke inhlobo yosizo ngoMsombuluko ngesikhathi ibhange liqala ukusebenza.Uthe okwamanje basacathula. "Uhlelo esilwenzile olokuthi labo abakhokhela imishwalense kube nendlela okuzokwenzeka ngayo ukuthi baqhubeke nokukhokhela imishwalense. Okunye esikwenzile wukuthi senze uhlelo lokuthi abafuna ukukhokhela izikweletu zabo bakwazi ukukhokha. Senze uhlelo nelinye ibhange."Nakuba Ithala livunyelwe ukuba liqhubeke nokusebenza, alivumelekile ukwamukela imali yamakhasimende ngenxa yokuthi kusazolalelwa isicelo sokuba livalwe.Undunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, unxuse abantu ukuthi bangalilaxazi Ithala. UNtuli uthe imali yamakhasimende aseThala ngeke icwile, wathi bazolivikela ngayo yonke indlela Ithala ukuba lingavalwa."Imali yabo iphephile, ngeke ibalahlekele. Okubalulekile njengamanje ukuba silwele ukuthi Ithala liqhubeke nokusebenza. Ithala libalulekile ikakhulukazi ekuthuthukiseni umnotho waKwaZulu-Natal. Sizoqhubeka nokulwela ukuthi liqhubeke nokusebenza. Ukukhombisa ukuthi sizimisele kanjani ukulwela Ithala, le ndaba ngayikhuluma noMengameli (uCyril Ramaphosa) noNgqongqoshe wezeziMali (uMnuz Enoch Godongwana). Yingakho ngithi abekho engcupheni abasebenzisa iThala. Singaya ngisho eNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo siyolwela Ithala."UNtuli unxuse iminyango kahulumeni, omasipala namaqembu ezepolitiki ukuba babhange neThala uma selinelayisensi yokuba yibhange.
UMPHATHISWA woMnyango wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi KwaZulu-Natal, uNksz Mbali Shinga, uthi sebedidekile ukuthi hloboluni lomyalezo okufanele bawedlulisele emphakathini ukukhuza isihlava sokubulawa kwabesifazane ngesihluku.UNksz Shinga usho lokhu izolo ngaphandle kweNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMzumbe, lapho obekuvela khona uMnuz Seluleko Zakwe, osolwa ngokugwaza abulale unina wengane yabo eneminyaka emithathu, eMthwalume ngoMgqibelo.Kulesi sigameko, kubulawe ngesihluku uNksz Nozipho Mbhele (24), okuvela ukuthi umsolwa umbizele esangweni ngokumshayela ucingo, wase emgwaza emva kwengxabano. Umufi ubesabhiyozela ukuwina kweKaizer Chiefs indebe yeNedbank Cup.Umufi, okuvela ukuthi ugwazwe emqaleni, ubalekele egcekeni kubo, wanxusa umfowabo ukuthi amphuthumise esibhedlela, okuyilapho afike washonela khona, abahlengikazi besathi bazama ukumsiza. UNksz Shinga uthe: "Sizama ukucabanga ukuthi yimuphi ngempela umyalezo odingwa abantu bakithi.”Ukhale ngokuthi umufi ubengowesifazane obesemncane, obezoba nekusasa eliqhakazile. Uthe kwayena umsolwa usemncane, bekukhona okungcono abengakwenza ngekusasa lakhe. "Ingane yabo isencane kakhulu. Njengamanje isele dengwane, unina ubulewe, uyise uzobolela ejele,” kusho uNksz Shinga, othe bewumnyango ziyabakhathaza izigameko zalolu hlobo. Uncome umphakathi nabezinhlangano ezingenzi nzuzo ngokuphuma ngobuningi, bezobhikisha ngaphandle kwenkantolo, bephikisana nokuthi umsolwa adedelwe ngebheyili.Icala lihlehlele uMeyi 21 ukuze umsolwa, ocele ukumelwa ummeli kahulumeni, akwazi ukufaka isicelo sebheyili. Phambilini, umfowabo kamufi, uMnuz Sanele Mbhele utshele Isolezwe ukuthi isigameko esenzeke bezihlalele ekhaya njengezelamani, bejabulela ukuwina kweChiefs.Uthe umufi ungenelwe wucingo lomuntu ombuze ukuthi ukuphi, wamphendula ngokuthi usekhaya nomndeni wakhe. Uqhube wathi babone esenyamalele, kwathi emva kwesikhashana, bambona engena egijima ebaleni, ebambe emqaleni, ethi: "Nangu uZakwe engigwaza.”UMbhele uthe ngesikhathi embheka udadewabo ofike wazoma eduze kwakhe ebambe ngesandla emqaleni, ubone ukuthi uyopha. Uthe umphuthumise esibhedlela, okuyilapho afike washonela khona. Uveze ukuthi isigameko senzeka nje, udadewabo ubebatshele ngesonto eledlule ukuthi usehlukene noyise wengane. Emva kwesigameko umsolwa okuthiwa ubefike ngetekisi ayishayelayo endaweni, ubaleke ngayo, esephindela eLuganda, ngasePinetown, lapho ehlala khona nonina.
I-SOUTH African Social Security Agency (Sassa), izwakalise ukukhathazeka ngemibiko engamapunge esatshalaliswa nsuku zonke ngale nhlangano, ikhala ngokuthi abenza lokhu bazama ukudukisa umphakathi ngolwazi olungelona iqiniso.Esitatimendini ithe akulona iqiniso ukuthi abantu bazokhokhelwa kabili ngenyanga ezayo. "Akukho simemezelo esenziwe sokuthi ngenyanga ezayo uJuni, abantu bazozithola ziphindwe kabili izibonelelo zabo. Lawa ngamanga futhi akumele abantu bawakholwe," kusho okhulumela iSassa, uMnuz Paseka Letsatsi.Uthe kwamenyezelwa ukuthi izibonelelo zizonyuka ngesikhathi kwethulwa isabelomali salo nyaka, okuyinto eyenzekile ngenyanga edlule."Izibonelelo zizophinde zinyuswe ngo-Okthoba, kulo nyaka. Akukho okunye ukunyuswa okuzoba khona." Uthe akukho migomo emisha ebekiwe kwabahola izibonelelo."Akukho zinguquko ezikhona mayelana nokuholwa kwezibonelelo. Sike saba nohlelo lokubheka abanye abaholayo, ebesidinga ukuthi beze nomazisi babo emahhovisi ethu. Lolu hlelo lwenzeke kulabo abambalwa abahole kule nyanga."Unxuse umphakathi ukuthi uthembele olwazini olukhishwa yiSassa kuphela, hhayi kwezinye izindawo."Sinxusa ukuthi abantu baqale bayibhekisise into abayizwa ishiwo, bangamane bakholwe yonke into ikakhulu ezinkundleni zokuxhumana. Ukushicilela ulwazi olungelona kwenza abantu babe netwetwe."
UKUKHOLELWA ekutheni impilo ephilwa esikhathini samanje idinga ukuzimela nokunganciki kwabanye abantu ukuthola okufunayo, ngeminye yemikhondo aphila ngayo uNksz Slindile "Thingolwenkosazane" Ximba, esinye sezitshudeni ezithweswe iziqu yiDurban University of Technology (DUT), emcimbini obusophiweni Indumiso, eMgungundlovu kuleli sonto.UNksz Ximba (22), futhi osesigungwini esiphethe izitshudeni iStudent Representative Council eDUT, uthweswe iziqu zokuqala ze-Diploma in Business and Information, into athi isho lukhulu kakhulu kuyena ngoba yenzeke esahleli ngentombi, okuyivangeli alishumayela nakwabanye ozakwabo eqenjini abakulona lamatshitshi afunda kule nyuvesi abalibiza ngokuthi Izimbali Ze-DUT Virgins Club Society."Siyafunda, siyaphasa Siyafonda, sihlolelwe ubuntombi bethu. Ukuthweswa iziqu manje kukhombisa ukuthi leli vangeli esilishumayela nsuku zonke eqenjini lethu, asigcini ngokulikhuluma nje kuphela, kepha siyalenza futhi njengoba nami sengilana engikhona," kusho le ntokazi eyamukele iziqu zayo ihlombe ngemvunulo, ukuzigqaja ngobuyona. Eqhuba, uNksz Ximba uthe akamile nemfundo yakhe njengoba kumanje esevele uyaqhubeka wenza i-Advanced Diploma in Business and Information Manangement, athi kuyamjabulisa ngoba kwenza abe yisibonelo kwabanye ikakhulu ozakwabo abeza emva kwakhe. "Njengoba ngikhona nasesigungweni esihola izitshudeni, futhi ngibhekele izinselelo zabo zansuku zonke enyuvesi, kuwumsebenzi wami futhi ukuba yisibonelo ngokwenza kahle ezifundweni ukukhombisa ukuba wumholi oqotho nozaziyo ukuthi ufuna ini empilweni. Konke engikwenzayo ngenzela ukufeza umbono nomkhondo wami wokuthi ukubambisana kwesikwenzayo kungasiyisa phambili, nokuthi ukuphumelela emfundweni akumele kube yinto yabantu abathile, kepha akube yilungelelo lawo wonke umuntu ofuna kube njalo," usho kanje.Uthe uhlela ukuthi uma esephothule izifundu zakhe, aqhubeke afundele eminye imikhakha eyamene nazo, ezokwenza athole ulwazi lwezobuchwepheshe besimanje noma olokuba wumholi, okuzokwenza akwazi ukusebenzisa khona ukuba wumholi oqotho noza noshintsho esebenzisa ubuchwepheshe besimanje.
IYANDA iminyango kahulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal ebhekene nolaka losomabhizinisi abangakhokhelwe.Izolo osomabhizinisi abangakhokhelwe bagasele emahhovisi oMnyango wezokuThutha beyobasela imali yabo.Lo mnyango uthe ukweleta izinkampani ezingaphezu kuka-2 000 imali engaphezu kuka-R1.5 billion. Osomabhizinisi abebethukuthele beganwe unwabu bakhale ngokulindiswa imali yabo isikhathi eside.UMphathiswa woMnyango, uMnuz Siboniso Duma, ukhale ngobuhixihixi obudalwe wukushintshwa kohlelo lokukhokha olwenganyelwe wuMnyango wezeziMali kuzwelonke.UDuma uthe basebenzisana nalo mnyango ukuzama ukuxazulula le nkinga. "Sibikile ngesonto eledlule ukuthi uMnyango wezeziMali wethule uhlelo olusha lokukhokha, usuka ohlelweni oludala olwaqala ukusebenza ngo-2017. Kusobala ukuthi ukushintshwa kohlelo akugcini nje ngokuphazamisa abanikazi bezinkampani kodwa kuphazamisa nezinhlelo zethu zokwakha imigwaqo. Kuzophazamiseka izinhlelo zethu zokuhambisa intuthuko. Okubi futhi wukuthi le simo siphazamisa izinhlelo zethu zokuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke osomabhizinisi bakhokhelwa zingakapheli izinsuku ezingu-30."UDuma uthe ukhathazekile ngokubambezeleka kokukhokhelwa kosonkontileka."Ngixolisile kakhulu kosomabhizinisi abangakhokhelwe. Kusiphatha kabi ukungakhokhelwa kosomabhizinisi abenza umsebenzi obalulekile lapha esifundazweni. Abantu esibakweletayo bakha imigwaqo namabhuloho, abanye basihlinzeka ngezokuthutha nangokunye." UDuma uthe osomabhizinisi bazoqala maduze ukuthola imali yabo."Kunemali engu-R600 million esizoyikhokha kuleli sonto. Enye imali engu-R700 million sizoyikhokha emasontweni amabili azayo."Lo wumnyango wesithathu KwaZulu-Natal ukubhekana nolaka losomabhizinisi abangakhokhelwe. Osomabhizinisi abangakhokhelwe basanda kubasela izikweletu zabo eMnyangweni wezeMfundo nakowezeMpilo.Osomabhizinisi abasohlelweni lokuphakelwa kwezikole basanda kuqhinqa emahhovisi oMnyango wezeMfundo, bekhala ngokungakhokhelwa.UMnyango wezeMpilo wona unesikweletu sikaR1.7 billion. Osomabhizinisi abangakhokhelwe basanda kuvala amahhovisi alo mnyango befuna imali abayikweletwayo.Nayo le minyango yakhala ngobuhixihixi obudalwe wukushintshwa kohlelo lokukhokha.
I-ANC Youth League (ANCYL) isabisa ngokunyomfa umcimbi wokwethulwa kwesabelomali sikaMasipala waseThekwini, njengoba ikhala ngokungabi bikho kwezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa intsha ezicacile kwisabelomali somkhandlu esihlongozwayo.I-ANCYL esifundeni iTheku, isabise ngokuthi izogovuza intsha ukuba iphazamise umcimbi wokwethulwa kwesabelomali uma singashintshwa isabelomali esihlongozwayo.Lolu phiko olungaphansi kwe-ANC lufuna ukuthi lo mkhandlu oholwa i-ANC, ubeke eceleni u-R100 million ozosetshenziselwa izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa intsha. UMasipala waseThekwini unesabelomali esingu-R71.3 billion.I-ANCYL ithe intsha ayizange ibhekelelwe kulesi sabelomali.Lokhu ikusho esitatimendeni esikhiphe emva komhlangano okhethekile wesigungu esiphezulu kwi-ANCYL. UNobhala we-ANCYL esifundeni iTheku, uNksz Nokulunga Khuzwayo, uthe kuyabacasula ukushaywa indiva kwentsha ezinhlelweni zoMasipala waseThekwini."Kulesi sabelomali esihlongozwayo esethulwe wumasipala azikho izinhlelo ezicacile zokuthuthukisa intsha. Lesi sabelomali sabo siyinhlamba kubantu abangu-60% abahlala eThekwini, okuyintsha engasebenzi futhi evaleleke ngaphandle ezintweni eziningi."UNksz Khuzwayo uthe imenenja yomkhandlu, uMnuz Musa Mbhele nesikhulu esiphethe ezezimali emkhandlwini, uDkt Sandile Mnguni, yibona abame endleleni yentsha. "Yibona abayizitha zethu ngoba baphikisa yonke into ezothuthukisa intsha. Sinxusa amakhansela e-ANC nawamanye amaqembu ukuba athathele laba bantu izinyathelo ngokushesha."UNksz Khuzwayo uthe bafuna ukuthi umkhandlu ubeke eceleni u-R100 million ozosetshenziselwa izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa intsha."Asihlehli kule mali esiyifunayo ukuba yabelwe izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa intsha." UNksz Khuzwayo uthe bazomisa ukusebenza komkhandlu uma izikhalazo zabo zishaywa indiva."Akukho mhlangano womkhandlu ozohlala. Sizogovuza abantu abasha ukuba baphume ngobuningi babo. Sizogcwala imigwaqo, endaweni yomhlangano nakuzo zonke izikhungo eziqhubekayo nokucindezela abantu abasha. Angeke sivume ukuthathwa kancane ekubeni kuyithina esibaningi eThekwini."Sinxusa onke amakhansela aseThekwini ukuba aphikisane nalesi sabelomali. Ikhansela elizokweseka lesi sabelomali kuzobe kusho khona ukuthi liyahambisana nokucindezelwa kwabantu abasha." Okhulumela uMasipala waseThekwini, uNkk Gugu Sisilana, uyalele ukuba yonke imibuzo ibhekiswe kokhulumela imeya yomkhandlu, uMnuz Mluleki Mntungwa. Kuze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela uMntungwa engakayiphenduli imibuzo ayithunyelwe.Njengamanje umasipala umatasa nohlelo lokulalela imibono yomphakathi ngesabelomali, kanti lolu phiko luthi luyayiveza imibono yalo kulezi zigcawu. Enye yezinto ekhalisa kakhulu abantu baseThekwini ngalesi sabelomali isiphakamiso sokunyuswa kukagesi namanzi.Umasipala uphakamisa ukuthi ugesi unyuswe ngo-12.72%, bese kuthi amanzi wona anyuswe ngo-15%.Isabelomali somkhandlu sizokwethulwa ngasekuqaleni konyaka wezimali womasipala oqala ngoJulayi.
AKALINDELE ukuthi uzodelelwa noma aphoxwe ngumengameli waseMelika, uMnuz Donald Trump, uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa uma esehlangene nalo mholi eMelika ngesonto elizayo.Lokhu kushiwo nguNgqongqoshe eHhovisi likaMengameli, uNksz Khumbudzo Ntshavheni, ekhuluma esithangamini nabezindaba ePitoli, ngokuphume emhlanganweni wakamuva weKhabhinethi.Uthe njengoba uRamaphosa ezohlangana noTrump ngoLwesithathu oluzayo uMeyi 21, bamenywe yiMelika."Simenywe nguTrump eMelika ukuthi siyohlangana naye, asizibambeli nje, Asilindele ukuthi ungafike umeme umuntu bese umphatha kabi. Ngakho silindele ukuthi lo mhlangano ube nokuhloniphana nokubekezelelana," usho kanje. Uthe uRamaphosa uzokhetha ithimba azohamba nalo wathi ziningi izinto ezizobhungwa kulo mhlangano.Usho lokhu emuva kokuba iqembu lamabhunu elinabangu-49, lifune ukuyobhaca eMelika likhala ngokuthi abalimi bayabulawa kuleli futhi bahleli lubhojozi ngenxa yokuthi elakuleli linomthetho wokudla umhlaba.UNksz Ntshavheni uthe uma kubhekwa inqwaba yabahambile, akubona abalimi. "Laba abayocela ukubhaca eMelika abangeni ngaphansi kwabantu abangababaleki kuleli. Abantu abazihambele ngokuthanda kwabo." Ukuchithile ukuthi kukhona ukuhlukunyezwa okubhekiswe kubalimi abamhlophe kuleli."Akukho kubulawa kwabalimi abamhlophe okwenzekayo kuleli. Lokhu kukhomba ngokusobala ukuthi bugxilile ubudlelwano bezomnotho phakathi kwala mazwe," kusho ihhovisi likaRamaphosa. URamaphosa wajuba owayeyiphini likaNgqongqoshe wezeziMali, uMnuz Mcebisi Jonas, ethimbeni eliphemba ubudlelwano neMelika. Lokhu kulandela ukukhonjwa indlela kobeyinxusa eMelika uMnuz Ebrahim Rasool ngoba akhuluma izinto ezingehlanga kahle ngoTrump, nohulumeni waseMelika. Izinto zishubile phakathi kwelakuleli neMelika njengoba uTrump aveza ukuthi bangase bangezi kuleli ukuzokwamukela isikhundla sokwengamela umhlangano we-G20, ngenxa yezinto ezenziwa nguhulumeni wakuleli kubalimi abamhlophe.IMelika iyona okumele ithathe izintambo zokuhola i-G20, ekupheleni konyaka, kanti umhlangano wokwenza lokhu kumele ube kuleli.

BEKUKHONA nomholi weqembu lemigulukudu, kwabathathu abathelwe othulini amaphoyisa, ngesikhathi bedubulana eZimbabwe, eMaoti, eNanda izolo.Lokhu kuvezwe okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba endaweni yesigameko.Elandisa uNetshiunda, uthe lo bhongoza, wasinda ngokulambisa ngesikhathi amaphoyisa ebopha abangani bakhe abane eCato Manor, ngenyanga edlule. Udalule ukuthi basola ukuthi uthinteka emacaleni okubulala angaphezu kuka-20 enzeke khona eNanda. "Ezigamekweni zokubulala ezingaphezu kuka-20 ezibikiwe eNanda, amaphoyisa abethola amagobolondo ohlobo oluthile lwesibhamu esingaqondakali. Okumangazayo ukuthi kulesi sigameko sanamuhla (esho izolo), amaphoyisa athole amagobolondo afanayo nalawa abelokhu etholakala ezigamekweni ezedlule (angaqondakali),” kusho uNetshiunda. Uqhube wathi lesi sibhamu bese kuphele eside isikhathi besicinga. Uveze ukuthi abasolwa bafa nje, bavele badubula kuqala bebhekise emaphoyiseni ngesikhathi bebona ukuthi asegalelekile.Uthe ngesikhathi sebeseshwa batholwe nezibhamu ezintathu, okusho ukuthi umsolwa ngamunye ubephethe isibhamu sakhe. "Sizozithumela ukuthi ziyohlolwa, ukuze sikwazi ukuthola ukuthi zinamaphi amacala abikwe phambilini,” kusho uNetshiunda. Uthe abafi bebeyingxenye yelinye iqembu lemigulukudu, ebelizenza iWest kodwa lingeyona.Khonamanjalo, kwenzeka lesi sigameko nje, amaphoyisa alalise uyaca kubasolwa abahlanu eMophela, eHammarsdale ngeSonto ebusuku. UNetshiunda uthe bebefunelwa amacala okubulala owesilisa nomkakhe, ezigamekweni ezehlukene, ezenzeke kuwo lo nyaka. Ubuye waveza nokuthi bebefunelwa namacala amabili okubulala amaphoyisa amabili. "Esigamekweni sokubulawa kowesilisa (66), wadutshulwa, wabulawa emzini wakhe eKwandeni ngoMgqibelo odlule. Umufi ubeke wasinda bezama ukumdubula ngoJanuwari,” kusho uNetshiunda. Uthe inkosikazi kalona wesilisa, yona idutshulwe yabulawa emzini wayo ngoFebhuwari kuwo lo nyaka. Ngesikhathi kwenzeka isiwombe sokudubulana namaphoyisa, kuthiwa abasolwa babhadanywe amaphoyisa behamba ngemoto yabo emgwaqweni uMophela. Kuvela ukuthi azamile ukubamisa kodwa bawashaya indiva, base bedubula bebhekise kuwo. "Nawo abuyisele ngenhlamvu, bafa bobahlanu. Batholwe nezibhamu ezintathu,” kusho uNetshiunda. Uthe kusazokwenziwa uphenyo kubhekwe ukuthi awekho yini amanye amacala abayamaniswa nawo.Uthe bebengahlangene nalaba ababulawe eNanda, wathi bona bebezihluphela ngendlela yabo eHammarsdale.

Yilokhu ke esikwenzayo. UKUNGENELELA kwabazali ukusiza ngakho okudingekayo emdlalweni owaziwa ngokuthi owabantu abacabanga bajule ngengqondo i-chess. Iyona nto okubukeka ithela izithelo ezibonakalayo kuHlelolwenkosi Ntshakala, ogila izimanga kulo mdlalo esifundazweni.Uyise walo mfana (8) ofunda uGrade 3 eGlenmore Primary, eThekwini, uMnuz Sipho Ntshakala, uthe izimpawu zothando lwalo mdlalo ziqale ukuvela ngonyaka odlule endodaneni yakhe, emva kokusizwa ngomunye wothisha bayo owayifaka kulo mdlalo."Kuqale kanjalo, kwakhula kangangokuthi bekuthi noma sizihlalele nje ekhaya kungonakele lutho, alokhu esibelesela ngalo mdlalo, esitshela ukuthi uwuthanda kangakanani nokuthi ufisa ukuhamba ibanga elide kangakanani ngawo, okwenze mina nomama wakhe sakhuthala ukuthi simlekelele kukho konke akudingayo ukuze achume ngawo," kusho uNtshakala. Eqhuba, uNtshakala waseHillcrest, entshonalanga yeTheku, uthe ukuzikhandla komfana wakhe kulo mdlalo, kuthela izithelo ezibonakalayo njengoba eseqalile ukuwola izicoco ezahlukene kuwona, kanti futhi wenza kahle nasesikoleni - okwenza bakholwe wukuthi lo mdlalo usiza kakhulu ukuvula umqondo nokuwukhaliphisa. Esikhathini esiwunyaka uHlelolwenkosi aqala ukudlala i-chess, useke wamela isifundazwe, futhi wenza kahle emincintiswaneni okukhona kuwona iMoja Chess Extravangaza eGoli, iMzansi Inter-Provincial Youth Chess Championship eLimpopo neKZN Open Chess Championship ebiseThekwini emasontweni ambalwa edlule."Sesize samtholela umqeqeshi waseZambia, omsizayo ukumfundisa okunye okuningi ngalo mdlalo, axhumana naye ngezinhlelo zokuchwepheshe besimanje ukumcija futhi amchushise kukho konke angangakwazi kahle nge-chess ngoba sifisa ukuthi leli khono aye kude ngalo empilweni ngoba kuyabonakala ukuthi yinto esemzweni yakhe. "Sikhuthaza nabanye abazali ukuthi bangabayekeleleli abantwana babo abanamakhono ehlukene, kepha bafaka isandla lapho okudingeka khona ukuze bakhuthale ukuqhubeka nawo," kusho uNtshakala.
UKHONGOLOSE ushove iMK kwamhlaba, unqoba ukhetho lokuchibiyela - obelubhekwe ngabomvu - ngamalengiso obelukuwadi 4 kuMasipala waseMpofana, ngoLwesithathu. NgoMashi, iMK yathatha uWadi 2 kuMasipala waseRichmond, ngo-Ephreli yanqoba uWadi 28 kuMasipala waKwaDukuza, kwathi kule nyanga yanqoba uWadi 18 kuMasipala waseMandeni. I-ANC inqobe ngamavoti angu-1 436, i-IFP yalala isibili ngamavoti angu-712, kwathi iMK yona yathola angu-635.Okhulumela i-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Fanele Sibisi, uthe ukunqoba kwabo ukhetho kukhombisa ukuthi izinhlelo zokwakha kabusha inhlangano, seziqalile ukuthela izithelo ezinhle."Kusobala ukuthi abantu baseMpofana bayaqhubeka nokuthemba i-ANC. Bayazi ukuthi i-ANC ibeka phambili izidingo zabo. Sibonga bonke abantu abasivotele nalabo abebekhankasela i-ANC. Imizamo yabo iyona eyenze ukuthi umyalezo we-ANC ufinyelele kubantu." Umbango wokuhola le wadi ubushisa phansi. Ngesikhathi kuqhubeka umkhankaso wokhetho, amaqembu akhankasayo abethelana ngodaka. Siyazi ukuthi abantu banelungelo lokukhetha iqembu abafuna ukulivotela."UNobhala Jikelele weMK, uMnuz Floyd Shivambu, uthe bebebhekene nobunzima kulolu khetho, wathi i-ANC ibisebenzisa izinsiza zikahulumeni ukukhankasela ukhetho.
