Kuthiwa ushone emuva kokubika ukugula komunye wabaphathi bakhe, okuthiwa umphoqile ukuthi eze emsebenzini nakuba engaphilile.Lo mphathi kuthiwa umiswe isigubhukane emuva kwalesi sehlakalo esenzeke ngoMsombuluko.UMnuz Mlungisi Ndlovu wePSA, ukhale ngokuthi baphethwe kabi odokotela abasafunda njengoba abanye baze bagule bephethwe wukhwantalala. Uthe bathole ukuthi wonke umuntu ngumazimele kulesi sibhedlela ikakhulu abasaqeqeshwa."Lesi sibhedlela sinabahlengikazi abangu-28 abasemalivini okugula ngenxa yokhwantalala. Sithole ukuthi uMazwi uqale emsebenzini ngoJanuwari nonyaka, uneminyaka engu-24, kanti uma sikhuluma nonina uveze ukuthi nguyena muntu abebethembele kuyena ekhaya," kusho uNdlovu ekhuluma nesiteshi sethelevishini iNewzroom Afrika izolo.Uthe odokotela abasaqeqeshwa bathe bayayekelelwa ukuthi bazisebenzele bodwa, okuyinto engavumelekile ngokomthetho. "Ngikhuluma nonina ubengaphathekile neze kahle ngalesi sehlakalo. Lesi sibhedlela siyaziwa ngokuthi baphathwa kabi abasaqeqeshwa, ungabuza ngisho abadlule kusona. Sifuna umengameli wezwe angenelele ezintweni ezenzeka kulesi sibhedlela," kusho uNdlovu, othe umphathi kaMazwi umisiwe.Uthe kade beyikhuluma indaba yalesi sibhedlela kodwa benganakwa beyiPSA, wathi kulesi sibhedlela abafuni abasaqeqeshwa bakhulume ngokuhlukumezeka kwabo ngisho enyunyaneni.USihlalo weSAMA KwaZulu-Natal, uDkt Zanele Bikitsha, uthe umisiwe lo dokotela emva komhlangano ababe nawo nobuholi besibhedlela izolo. "Senze isicelo esiphuthumayo sokuthi asuswe lo dokotela ethimbeni lodokotela abanesipiliyoni, ababheka ukusebenza kwalabo abasafunda. Lo dokotela uqhubekile nokuxhaphaza umufi yize ebebona ukuthi uyagula. Ubemsabisa ngokuthi ngeke awasayine amaphepha aqinisekisa ukuthi ulwenzile uqeqesho esibhedlela,” kusho uDkt Bikitsha. Uthe bayasigxeka kakhulu isenzo salo dokotela, wathi umuntu uma ethi uyagula kufanele kuthathelwe phezulu lokho.Uqhube wathi bayasigxeka nesenzo sokuthi udokotela asebenzise amandla akhe, ukusabisa osafunda ngokuthi uzomkhipha ekuqeqeshweni ngenxa yokuthi uveza ukuthi akaphilile. Uthe emhlanganweni baphinde baveza ukuthi bazolandelela ukuthi odokotela abasafunda, baphathwa kanjani kulesi sibhedlela."Engikuqaphelile wukuthi odokotela abasafunda bamanqikanqika ukuphumela obala, bakhulume ngeziwombe zokuhlukunyezwa, basaba ukuthi bazoba abagilwa abalandelayo," usho kanje.Ubalule ukuthi isenkulu inkinga yokushoda kwabasebenzi ezibhedlela njengoba bethole ukuthi eMshiyeni, uma umuntu enenkinga, engeke akwazi ukuza emsebenzini, kufanele athole umuntu ozombambela. Ukhale ngokuthi lokhu okwenzekile kuveza isithombe sento abahlale beyikhalela yokushoda kwabasebenzi ezibhedlela zakuleli. Kuthintwa unina kamufi, kuzwakale ngesikhathi ekhuluma ukuthi uyakhala, wacela ukubuye ashayelwe, ethi ukwadokotela. Kuthe eseshayelwa, ucingo bese lunqamuka, wathi usemgwaqweni. Emva kwalokho ugcine engasalubambi.UDkt Bikitsha uveze ukuthi unina kamufi akekho esimeni esikahle ngoba ubuholi besibhedlela bumphindisele emuva kabili, buthi kukhona amaphepha ashodayo ukuze kulungiswe izinto eziphathelene nokushona kukamufi. Uthe lokhu kuyamhlukumeza emoyeni njengoba besuka esifundazweni i-Eastern Cape. IDemocratic Alliance KwaZulu-Natal, ithe ifuna kuphenywe kabanzi ngezinsolo ezivele emva kokufa kukaDkt Mazwi. UDkt Imran Keeka weDA uthe: "Uma kuvela ukuthi lezi zinsolo ezishiwoyo ngokufa kukaDkt Mazwi ziyiqiniso, kufanele athathelwe izinyathelo lo dokotela.”Uthe phakathi kwezinyathelo angathathelwa zona wukuvulelwa icala lobugebengu emaphoyiseni, aphinde abikwe ngendlela yakhe yokuziphatha kwiHealth Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) noma axoshwe unomphelo ekusebenzeleni izikhungo zikahulumeni. UMnyango wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal uvele wayishaya indiva eyezinsolo eziyamene nokufa kukaMazwi.Ukhiphe isitatimende esizwakalisa ukudabuka ngokufa kwezisebenzi ezine ezikhungweni ezehlukene esifundazweni, kubalwa nesokufa kwakhe uMazwi.Isitatimende somnyango sithe, bathole izindaba zokushona kukaDkt Siyabonga Zulu obesebenza esibhedlela iNgwelezane ngeSonto. "NgoMsombuluko, umnyango uphinde walahlekelwa wuDkt Alulutho Mazwi, obesebenza esibhedlela iPrince Mshiyeni Memorial (eMlaza). Izindaba ezimbi ziqhubekile nangoLwesibili, ngokudlula emhlabeni kukaMnuz Mvelo Cele obesebenza esibhedlela ePort Shepstone,” kusho umnyango. Uthe isehlakalo sesine kube esokushona kuka Dkt Tumelo Kgaladi, obesebenza esibhedlela i-Addington, oshonele ekhaya, eClare Estate, eSydenham.
ZIYAZIQHENYA izinsizwa zaKwaZulu-Natal, ezithe zingena emkhakheni wokulingisa zahlonishwa ngezindawo eziphezulu emkhakheni wokulingisa. UWiseman Mncube noThembinkosi Mthembu bathi ukunikwa izindawo zamaKhosi aKwaZulu, kwiShaka Ilembe, yikhona okubenza bathobeke.UWiseman ulingisa indawo kaZwide, uThembinkosi alingise indawo kaDingiswayo. UThembinkosi uthe ngeke indawo yakhe ishintshe kakhulu uma kuziwa kwebonakale kwisizini yokuqala. "Siyabonga ngokuthola uxhaso olungaka ekhaya. Singabafana abaneminyaka endimeni yokulingisa kodwa sesenze umlando. UDingiswayo uzoqhubeka ebonakala efuna ukubuyisa ubukhosi aphucwa bona. Futhi kuzobonakala engena kwezothando nabanye besifazane. Kuzoba isizini egcwele igazi nezimpi ngakho ngithi kuzoba nzima kakhulu kodwa abantu bazoyithakasela le sizini inkulu kunalena edlule," kusho uThembinkosi.UWiseman uthe uZwide uzobonakala ekhulile kunangesizini edlule, njengoba esezele nezingane."Ubudlelwano bukamama kaZwide uNtombaze (Khabonina Qubeka) buzokhula kakhulu ngakho nami ngizohamba emazwini kaThembinkosi ukuthi ibe nkulu kakhulu le sizini ezoqala, abantu bazobona umlando ongeke ucishe kalula emiqondweni yabo," kuchaza uWiseman. UFanele Zulu noLungani Mabaso abangabanye abazogqama kule sizini baveze ukuthi bona okubadonse amehlo ukulingisa nabantu abaningi, okuyinto engakaze yenzeke kubo.Abezindaba bakhonjiswe amanye amazwibela alo mdlalo okucace bha ukuthi uzoqhubeka udonse izinhlanga zabantu abahlukene kuleli.Le sizini yesibili izolandelwa eyesithathu lapho abakwaMultichoice bathe iyobe isigqamisa ukuthi bafika kanjani abelungu kuleli. Abanye abalingisi abasha abazobonakala uMelusi Mbhele no-Andile Xhakaza.Okunye okuvelile kulesi sikhangiso ukuthi kuzogqama izizwe zamaXhosa namaSwati.
INkantolo yeSifunda e-Estcourt igwebe uThokozane Vodacom Nqubuka (35) udilikajele neminyaka ewu-55 ngoxhaxha lwamacala awenza phakathi kuka-15 kuya ku-16 Julayi 2022,e-Estcourt.Ngo-15 Julayi 2022 ntambama,lo mlisa wagasela umuzi womuntu e-Estcourt ephethe isibhamu wabamba inkunzi owesifazane wamphuca iselula. Akagcinanga lapho kodwa wamdlwengula ephindelela ebusuku. Lo mlisa wasuka lapho wabaleka ezintatha wahlangana nabanye abagilwa ababili okwakungowesilisa nowesifazane bebuya emsebenzini.Wababamba inkunzi wabephuca amaselula ebakhombe ngesibhamu. Wayalela lo wesilisa ukuthi alale phansi, wase eqala enukubeza owesifazane ngokocansi. Umgilwa wesifazane walwa noNqubuka wakwazi ukumphuca isibhamu. Umgilwa wesifazane washaya ummangalelwa ngesibhamu kwase kulekelela nalo wesilisa owayelaliswe phansi. Ngesikhathi kuliwa kwaphuma isimfonyo ayezifihle ngaso ummangalewa bambona.Kuthe kusaliwa kanjalo kwama imoto,umshayeli wayo wamemeza uNqubuka ngegama embuza ukuthi kwezenjani. UNqubuka waphoseka emotweni nomshayeli bashaya bachitha.Abagilwa bakwazi ukuthatha izinombolo zemoto nokwenza kwaba lula ukuthi isheshe itholakale nomshayeli wayo. Umshayeli watshela amaphoyisa ngakwaziyo ngoNqubuka nokuthi wamtshela ukuthi abagilwa babemshaya,yingakho bashaye bachitha ngemoto. UNqubuka waboshwa. UMshushisi uZamaswazi Portia Mawethusonke Ndlovu ubize ofakazi okungabagilwa namaphoyisa afika endaweni yesigameko. Umshayeli wemoto eyagibeza uNqubuka naye ubiziwe wazofakazela umbuso. Kwethulwe nobufakazi bolibofuzo obukhomba uNqubuka ecaleni lokudlwengula umgilwa wokuqala. Umshushisi ekhonga isigwebo esiqinile, ubize abagilwa bachaza ukuthi isigameko sibathinte kanjani.Umgilwa wokuqala uthe bekuzoba ngcono ukuba uNqubuka wavele wambulala ngoba vele impilo yakhe yonakele kakhulu. Uthe ubenesifiso sokufunda athuthukise impilo yakhe kodwa emuva kwesigameko uphelelwe wukuzethemba akasafuni nokuhlangana nabantu. Umgilwa wesibili uthe walwa nommangalelwa bebanga isibhamu ngoba esaba ukuthi uzomdlwengula. Abagilwa bathe bazama ukumncenga uNqubuka ukuthi athathe akufunayo angabathinti bona kodwa wangabalalela. UNqubuka ugwetshwe udilikajele ngecala lokudlwengula, iminyaka ewu-15 ngecala ngalinye kwamathathu okubamba inkunzi ngesihluku, iminyaka ewu-5 ngokunukubeza ngokocansi neminyaka ewu-5 ngokukhomba ngesibhamu. Inkantolo ithe ummangalelwa uzodonsa udilikajele futhi akafanelwe wukuba nemvume yokuphatha isibhamu.I-National Prosecuting Authority (NPA) ikwemukele ukulahlwa ngecala nokugwetshwa kwesigebengu esiyingozi esinikwe udilikajele neminyaka engu-55 ngokudlwengula nokuphanga. "Lesi sigwebo siwubufakazi bokuthi ngeke bubekezelelwe ubugebengu obunodlame obujivaza isithunzi nokuphepha kwabantu"
iLIKHIHLE isililo isosha elibhekene necala lokudubula libulale owesifazane ngesikhathi linqatshelwa ibheyili yinkantolo yeMantshi yaseMlaza izolo emini.UMboniseni Zilozi (49) usolwa ngokudubula abulale uNksz Zandile Mnomiya (44), esigamekweni esenzeka ngoMashi 15 kwa-Z , eMlaza.Laba ababili kuvela ukuthi bahilizisana ngemuva kokuba kushayisane izimoto zabo. Kuvela ukuthi isosha lalishayela iMercedez, umufi eshayela iRenault.Esitatimendeni esisenkantolo kuvela ukuthi isosha lathukuthela kakhulu laphusha umufi kabuhlungu. Kwathi uma umufi esevuka phansi esefuna ukumphusha naye, uZilozi wavele wakhipha isibhamu wamdubula washonela khona lapho, maqede washaya wachitha wamshiya kanjalo endaweni yesigameko.Waze wakhalelwa ngamasongo kaSigonyela ngemuva kwesikhathi esingangenyanga kwenzeka isigameko.Kuvela ukuthi amaphoyisa ambopha kalula ngoba ayesebenzisa i-number plate yakhe emthungatha. Lifika izolo isosha belifaswe izinyawo zombili ngamaketanga, lifake into yokuzifihla ebusweni. Beliqashwe ngelokhozi ngamaphoyisa. Lize laphela icala libheke phansi.Imantshi, uFit Gerald, isebenzise kakhulu ubufakazi obethulwa wumphenyi wecala, uNonkululeko Mthembu, owageqa amagula ngakho konke akuthola mayelana naleli cala. Kuvelile ukuthi uMthembu wakuveza ukuthi umelene nokudedelwa ngebheyili kwesosha ngoba lakhombisa ukuba nonya ngokudubula umuntu maqede limshiye edindilize phansi kanjalo langaba nanembeza.Imantshi igcizelele nokuthi uMthembu wathi kungagovuzeka umphakathi kusuke nodungunyane olungeke lulawuleke, uma kungenzeka agcine ededelwa ngebheyili umsolwa. Imantshi ithe uMthembu watshela inkantolo ukuthi umsolwa imoto yakhe yayihuzukile ohlangothini lwangakwesokudla, isalele nopende omhlophe wemoto kamufi.''UMphenyi wecala waphinde watshela inkantolo ukuthi umsolwa waqamba amanga wathi uyile eBhekithemba eyovula icala ngoba kukhona abesilisa ahlangana nabo endleleni bamlimaza kwaze kwalimala nemoto yakhe. Umphenyi waveza ukuthi umsolwa wathi eBhekithemba waxhumana nephoyisa uMhlongo. Ngeshwa ngemuva kophenyo kwavela ukuthi alikho iphoyisa lakwaMhlongo eBhekithemba,'' kuchaza imantshi.Ikhulume nangophaqa owasala endaweni yesigameko ofana ncamashi nowatholakala ngalapho kuhlala khona umsolwa. Imncomile kakhulu uMthembu ngokuthi wangena wazikhulumela yena wangenza incwadi efungelwe njengomsolwa.Ngakolunye uhlangothi umsolwa encwadini efungelwe wathi uMbuso unecala elintekenteke. ''Umsolwa ngabe kungcono ukuba wazikhulumela futhi waveza nokuthi kungani ekholwa wukuthi icala loMbuso ulibona lintekenteke,'' kusho imantshi.Ithe kuningi okubhekwayo okumqoka kakhulu njalo uma inkantolo kumele ikhiphe isinqumo ecaleni elifuze leli. Phakathi kwezinto athe inkantolo kumele izibheke kubalwa ukuthi ukudedelwa komsolwa ngeke yini kuze kuwugovuze umphakathi, ngeke yini kugcine sekudala ungabazane ngokusebenza kwezinkantolo zaseNingizimu Afrika futhi ngeke yini ingalo yomthetho yakuleli igcine seyibukeleka phansi, kuthiwe ihlulwa wumsebenzi.Ngemuva kwale ncazelo icele umsolwa ukuba asukume. ''Ngenxa yazo zonke lezi zizathu ngeshwa elikhulu isicelo sakho sebheyili asizange siphumelele,'' isho kanje ibhekise kumsolwa.Ngemuva kwalawa magama emantshi umsolwa uvele wakhihla isililo waphelelwa ngamandla, wamane wahlala phansi samuntu ophelelwe yithemba. Kuqhume isililo enkantolo amalungu omndeni akubo kwesosha engakukholwa akuzwayo, ukuthi ilungu lawo lizoqhubeka nokugqunywa esitokisini ngemuva kokubhuntsha kwemizayo yokulikhulula.Kuhlukwane kanjalo enkantolo ngesivumelwano sokuthi izophinde ibonane ngoJuni 6. Amalungu omndeni kamufi azwakalise ukujabula okukhulu athi kubuye ithemba kuwona ngokusebenza kwezinkantolo zaseNingizimu Afrika. Abhoke ngolaka amalungu omndeni kamsolwa ngesikhathi Isolezwe lizama ukukhuluma nawo.''Asifuni ukukhuluma nawe, hamba la. Hheyi wedadewethu ungavumi ukuphendula imibuzo yalo, '' kusho isihlobo sakubo kamsolwa sitshela omunye wabo obeseza ngemuva.
UMASIPALA waseNdumeni usolwa ngokushalazela umbiko ophakamisa ukuthi kuthathelwe izinyathelo zokuqondisa ubugwegwe izikhulu zomkhandlu ezithinteka enkohlakalweni.USomlomo womkhandlu, uMnuz Andile Nsibande, usolwa ngokuhudula izinyawo ekubizeni umhlangano womkhandlu ozobhunga ngalo mbiko.Lo mbiko owenziwa uMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal, uphakamisa ukuthi kuthathelwe izinyathelo izikhulu zomkhandlu ezimbili ezithinteka enkohlalweni yezigidi zamaRandi. Lo mbiko obonwe yiSolezwe, wathola ukuthi lezikhulu ezimbili zikhokhela izigidi zamaRandi inkampani yonogada eyayingenaso isivumelwano sokusebenzisa nomasipala ngaleso sikhathi.Uphinde uphakamise ukuthi kuphenywe ubudlelwano bezikhulu ezithintekayo kanye nabanikazi benkampani yonogada.Esinye isikhulu esithintekayo kule nkohlakalo sesathola isikhundla esiphezulu kulo mkhandlu. Lo mbiko wethulelwa umhlangano womkhandlu owawungasekuqaleni kuka-Ephreli.Umasipala wanikezwa izinsuku ezingu-21 ukuba uhlalise umhlangano owawuzothatha isinqumo ngalolu daba.Kuze kube manje umhlangano awukaze ubizwe. Ukungabizwa komhlangano sekususe imvunge njengoba kukhona amalungu omphakathi ahlela ukuba nombhikisho ngalolu daba kanye nezinye izikhalazo ezithinta ukuphathwa komkhandlu.Usotswebhu we-ANC kulo mkhandlu, uMnuz Siphamandla Kheswa, uthe abakaze batshelwe ukuthi kungani ungakaze ubizwe umhlangano ozoxoxa ngalo mbiko.Uthe sebebhalele uMphathiswa wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, uNgqongqoshe woMnyango kuzwelonke, uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa kanye nehhovisi likaMengameli bekhalaza ngalolu daba. "UButhelezi wagcina ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi uyitholile incwadi yethu kodwa akazange asiphendule. UHlabisa naye akakaze asiphendule. Sesizame ngazo zonke izindlela ukuthola izimpendulo kodwa lutho."UKheswa uthe bayaweseka umbhikisho ohlelwa umphakathi."Ngoba thina njengamakhansela bayasibalekela, mhlawumbe kungcono khona ukuthi babhekane nolaka lomphakathi. Abantu banelungelo lokubhikisha. Abaphethe umkhandlu kuzofanele bezochazela abantu ukuthi kungani umbiko ufihliwe. Ngingasho nje ukuthi sizobe sikhona nathi kulowo mbhikisho womphakathi ngoba iyasithinta le ndaba." Okhulumela uMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu, uMnuz Senzelwe Mzila, uthe uNsibande wacelwa ukwelulelwa isikhathi."Nempela umnyango wabe usumlulela isikhathi sokuba abize umhlangano womkhandlu."UKheswa ubuze ukuthi uNsibande wayethunywe ubani ukuba ayocela ukululelwa isikhathi. "Leso kwakungafanele kube isinqumo sakhe yedwa, kwakufanele abize umhlangano, bese amakhansela evumelana ngokuthi acele ukululelwa isikhathi."Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kukaNsibande ayizange iphumelele njengoba ucingo lwakhe belungangeni, futhi akazange awuphendule umbuzo awuthunyelwe.
KUVELE izinsolo zokuhlukunyezwa kodokotela abangamathwasa esibhedlela saseMlaza, iPrince Mshiyeni Memorial, kushona oyedwa esemsebenzini ngoMsombuluko.Kuthiwa udokotela osemncane, igama lakhe eligodliwe, okuvela ukuthi ungowokudabuka e-Eastern Cape, ushayeke phansi washona ngesikhathi esebenza ezihudula nge-shift yakhe. Ngokwesitatimende esizungeza ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, kuvela ukuthi umufi ubekubikile ukungaphili, kodwa umphathi wakhe wamphoqa ukuthi eze emsebenzini.Lesi sitatimende siphelezelwa nayi-screenshot senkulumo okuthiwa ibiphakathi kukadokotela, lapho ebebika khona ukuthi uzizwa engaphilile. "Ngiyabingelela Dkt, Angizizwa kahle namuhla. Ngiyaxolisa ukuba yimbangela yokuthikamezeka kwethimba,” kusho umufi.UDkt obebikelwa uphendule wathi: "Ngiyabingelela. Ngicela ubheke umyalezo e-groupini. Ngilindele ukuthi uze emsebenzini.”Ngokwalesi sitatimende, odokotela abafundayo nonina kamufi banethemba lokuthi uzothathelwa izinyathelo ezinqala umphathi wakhe ngesehlakalo. Siveza ukuthi umufi ubegula, futhi kucacela nanoma ngubani ukuthi akaphilile, kodwa waphoqwa wumphathi wakhe ukuthi eze emsebenzini. "Umufi ubesanda kuthola ukuthi unesifo sikashukela. Esikhathini esingangeviki esedlule ubebonakala ukuthi ugula impela. Uke wawa kabili esemsebenzini, waze wathatha ikhefu lokugula, ngethemba lokuthi uzolulama,” kusho isitatimende.Siveza ukuthi ngesikhathi esekhefini lokugula, abuzange bubekhona ubungcono."Kuthiwa usatshiswe wumphathi wakhe othe akabuye eze emsebenzini yize ebecela ukwelulelwa isikhathi esekhaya ngoba ubebona ukuthi isimo sempilo yakhe besiya ngokuya siba sibi,” kusho isitatimende. Siveza ukuthi ngosuku ashone ngalo bekucacela noma ubani ukuthi akakwazi ukumelana nomsebenzi, esimweni abeyiso, waphetha ngokuwa, ashone. "Odokotela abasafunda nezinye izisebenzi zezempilo zithwele kanzima kulesi sibhedlela ngenxa yokuhlukunyezwa abaphathi nsuku zonke,” kusho isitatimende. Kuvele ukuthi umufi bekufanele angeniswe esibhedlela (ayolaliswa) ngosuku aphoqwe ukuthi aye ngalo emsebenzini, kanti uzoshona. Ngaphezu kwalezi zinsolo, kuqubuke nezinye zokucwasa ngokwebala, okuthiwa abaphathi abathathu bacwasa abasebenzi bebala elimnyana. Kuthiwa abasebenzi banqatshelwa ngisho ukuthatha ikhefu uma beshonelwe abathandiweyo babo. Okhulumela iPublic Servants Association (PSA) KwaZulu-Natal uMnuz Mlungisi Ndlovu, uthe sibaphathe kabi le sehlakalo. "Ukwenzeka kwesehlakalo kuwubufakazi balokhu ebesihlale sikusho ukuthi abasebenzi basebenza ngaphansi kwezimo ezibucayi eMshiyeni. Kade sasikubika emnyangweni ukuthi kunokuxhashazwa kwamandla kulabo abasezikhundleni kulesi sibhedlela,” kusho uNdlovu.Uthe beyiPSA bake babhikisha, bahambisa uhla lwezikhalo ngokuhlukunyezwa kwabasebenzi kulesi sibhedlela kodwa alukho uphenyo noma izinyathelo umnyango oke wazithatha ngalolu daba.Ulimise ngesihloko elokuthi sekunesikhathi umnyango uvikela omunye wabaphathi okwaziwayo ukuthi uyahlukumeza. "Sasixwayisile ngokuthi kungenzeka kuphume isidumbu ngenxa yalokhu, nebala sekugcine kwenzekile,” kusho uNdlovu.Siye koshicilela uMnyango wezeMpilo ungakaphawuli ngalesi sehlakalo.

UHULUMENI waKwaZulu-Natal namaqembu ezepolitiki ashayele ihlombe isinqumo senkantolo esivumela ibhange Ithala ukuba liqhubeke nokusebenza.Iminyango kahulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal eyehlukene namaqembu ezepolitiki athe ukuvunyelwa kweThala ukuba liqhubeke nokusebenza kuzokhulula emaketangeni izinkulungwane zabantu obekubhajwe imali yazo kuleli bhange.NgoLwesihlanu, iNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu ivumele Ithala ukuba liqhubeke nokusebenza. Ukusebenza kweThala ilokhu kwama nse ngoFebhuwari, emva kokuba uhlaka olungaphansi kwebhange loMbuso, iPrudential Authority (PA), lufake isicelo sokuba kuvalwe leli bhange.Njengoba bekumile ukusebenza kwebhange, amakhasimende aseThala angaphezu kuka-250 000 abengakwazi ukukhipha imali yawo, nabasebenzi basebhange bebengaholi.IJaji uThomas Ncube linqume ukuthi loyo owaqokwa yi-PA ukuba aqaphe ukusebenza kweThala, uMnuz Johannes Kruger, akanawo amandla okumisa ukusebenza kwebhange. UNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, uthe bazothola ukuphefumula abantu okubhajwe imali yabo eThala."Lesi sinqumo sizosinikeza ithuba lokuba sililungise kahle udaba lweThala njengoba sifuna ukuthi ibhange liqhubeke nokusebenza. Ithala libalulekile kakhulu emnothweni waKwaZulu-Natal."UMphathiswa wezeziMali KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Francios Rogders, uthe kade babexwayisa ngokuthi uKruger uyagagamela. URodgers uthe mkhulu umonakalo osudalwe yizenzo zikaKruger."Kubuhlungu kakhulu lokhu ngoba sonke siyazi ukuthi Ithala lisiza kakhulu abantu okungelula ukuthi bathole usizo kwamanye amabhange. Uhulumeni wokubambisana ophethe KwaZulu-Natal, uzoqhubeka nokulwa nemizamo yokuphazamisa ukusebenza kweThala."UMphathiswa wezokuThuthukiswa koMnotho KwaZulu-Natal, uMfu Musa Zondi, uthe isinqumo senkantolo sizoqinisekisa ukuthi Ithala liyaqhubeka nokusebenza. Okhulumela i-IFP, uMnuz Mkhuleko Hlengwa, uthe kwakungafanele kwasekuqaleni ukuba kumiswe ukusebenza kweThala."Lesi sinqumo siphazamise impilo yezinkulungwane zabantu saphinde sabeka engcupheni inqwaba yamabhizinisi."UHlengwa uthe bazoba yingxenye yezinhlaka ezilwela ukuba Ithala liqhubeke nokusebenza. Usihlalo we-EFF KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Mongezi Twala, uthe isinqumo senkantolo sizothumela umyalezo oqinile kuzo zonke izinhlaka ezilwisa izinhlangano ezisiza abantu abamnyama.UTwala uthe basamile ekutheni Ithala lijeziselwa ukuthi lisiza abantu abamnyama.Ithala aliphumile ngokuphelele obishini njengoba kusazolalelwa isicelo sokuba livalwe.Nakuba leli bhange livunyelwe ukuqhubeka lisebenze kodwa alivumelekile ukuba liqhubeke nokwamukela imali yamakhasimende afuna ukulondoloza imali yawo kuleli bhange.
AMAPHOYISA aKwaZulu-Natal asenxuse ukuthi kube khona ukubekezelelana phakathi kwabantu nokuthi bathole ezinye izindlela ezingenalo udlame ukuxazulula ukungaboni ngaso linye.Lokhu kulandela ukuthi ecubungule izibalo zakamuva zobugebengu obenzeka esifundazweni.Okhulumela amaphoyisa esifundazweni, uCol Robert Netshiunda, uthe baqaphele ukwenyuka kwezibalo emacaleni abucayi, abandakanya awokushaya nawokushaya ngenhloso yokulimaza kanzima "Emva kokucubungula izibalo zobugebengu, sitholile ukuthi amacala amaningi okuhlasela adaleka emva kokuthi umuntu ehlulwe wukubekezelela omunye, agcine eseshaya,” kusho uNetshiunda. "Amaphoyisa athola ukuthi abavulelana amacala kusuke kungomakhelwane nezihlobo ezihlulwa wukuxazulula iziwombe zokungaboni ngasolinye ngokuthula, bagcine sebehlaselana,” kusho uNetshiunda. Uthe babuye baqaphela nokuthi ziningi izincwadi zesivimbelo okwenziwe izicelo zazo, wathi nakhona zisuke zenziwa womakhelwane, izihlobo noma abantu abazanayo emva kwezigameko zokuhlaselana. Ubuye wadalula ukuthi enye into eyandisa izibalo zamacala okushaya ngenhloso yokulimaza, abashayeli abashayelisana kabi emgwaqweni, behlulwa wukubekezelelana. "Kuke kwaba khona isigameko ngaphansi kwesifunda sasoThukela, abashayeli bephikisana ngokuthi ekabani imoto enamandla kunenye. Leyo mpikiswano yagcina iba nodlame, bobabili abashayeli bavulelana amacala okushayana,” kusho uNetshiunda.Uthe bengamaphoyisa bayawukhuza lo mkhuba. Ube esegcizelela ukuthi amaphoyisa asazoqhubeka nokuvula amacala asuke ebikwa abagilwa, awaphenye njengokuyalelwa wuMthethosisekelo. "Kodwa izinsizakusebenza ezisetshenziswa uma kuphenywa lolu hlobo lwamacala, ngabe zisetshenziswa kangcono ukulwa nobunye ubugebengu obunzima obugubuzele isifundazwe,” usho kanje. Uthe banxusa nobuholi bendabuko namakhansela ukuthi babambe iqhaza ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi abantu baphilisana ngokuthula emphakathini, kusungulwe nemidlalo ezolekelela ukwakha ubumbano.

UNGQONGQOSHE wezikaGesi, uDkt Kgosientsho Ramokgopa, uthi ukwehluleka kwe-Eskom ukunakekela ingqalasizinda yikho okwenze ukuthi kubuye uhlelo lokucishwa kukagesi.URamokgopa uthe i-Eskom ihlulekile ukuqeda ngesikhathi izinhlelo zokunakekela ingqalasizinda, wathi lokhu kuphoqe ukuthi kubuye uhlelo lokucishwa kukagesi.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba, izolo. Uhlelo lokucishwa kukagesi ngenhloso yokuwonga luqale ngoLwesibili ntambama.Ugesi ucishwa ngokwesigaba sesibili ngezikhathi zantamba lapho khona abantu besebenzisa khona kakhulu ugesi.URamokgopa uthe kunezizathu eziningi ezahlukene ezenze ukuthi i-Eskom ingakwazi ukuqeda ngesikhathi zonke izinhlelo zayo zokunakekela ingqalasizinda. "Kwezinye izindawo inkinga isezinkampanini ezinikezwe umsebenzi, kwezinye impahla edingakalayo ukulungisa ingqalasizinda ayitholakali ngesikhathi. Kodwa-ke lokho into okufanele thina sibhekane nayo. Engingakusho okwamanje ukuthi konke lokhu kukhombisa ukwehluleka ngasohlangothini lwethu ukuqinisekisa ukuthi siqeda ngesikhathi izinhlelo zokunakekela ingqalasizinda."URamokgopa uthe ukunganakekelwa kwengqalasizinda kwenze ukuthi izwe lishode ngogesi ongu-3 000 megawatts.URamokgopa uxolisile ebantwini bakuleli ngokubuya kohlelo lokucishwa kukagesi. "Siyazi ukuthi uhlelo lokucishwa kukagesi luphazamisa impilo yabantu, luphinde luphazamise ukusebenza kwamabhizinisi."Uhlelo lokucishwa kukagesi lubuya nje, uRamokgopa nezikhulu ze-Eskom basanda kufunga ngokuthi ugesi ngeke ucishwe ebusika.URamokgopa uphinde wakuqinisekisa ukuthi ugesi ngeke ucishwe kulobu busika. "Lokhu okwenzeka njengamanje inkinga nje yesikhashana. Izikhulu ze-Eskom zisebenza kanzima ukuqinisekisa ukuthi sinogesi owanele. Kukhona iziphehli zikagesi ezizoqala ukusebenza maduze. Ukusebenza kwalezi ziphehli kuzokwenza ukuthi sibe nogesi ongu-2 000 megawatts. Ngingasho ukuthi isimo esikuso kulo nyaka singcono kakhulu kunaleso esasikuso ngesikhathi kuqala ubusika ngonyaka owedlule."Isikhulu esiphezulu e-Eskom, uMnuz Dan Marokane, sithe babevele beshilo ukuthi uma kwenzeka kuba nesidingo sokuthi kucishwe ugesi ebusika, kuzokuba ngokwesigaba sesibili.UMarokane uthe uhlelo lokucishwa kukagesi luzoqhubeka kuze kube namhlanje, wathi bazothatha isinqumo khona namhlanje ukuthi luzoqhubeka yini.
UYAVEVA yintukuthelo umndeni wesaguga okuthiwa sihlaselwe yisiguli esinokuthikamezeka emqondweni esibhedlela oSindisweni, eNdwedwe, ngoLwesihlanu.Kule sigameko, kulimale kanzima uNkk Busisiwe Ntuli (80) wasoGunjini, eNdwedwe, nesinye isaguga okuthiwa sineminyaka ewu-75.Ngokusho kukamzukulu kamgilwa, uNksz Zama Ntuli, uthe ugogo wakhe wangeniswa kulesi sibhedlela ngasekupheleni kuka-Ephreli, exinwe wukugula. Asazi bawasuseleni ngoba sonke lesi sikhathi abekhona kodwa emva kwesigameko, sebevele bawasusa,” kusho uNksz Ntuli. Uthe bubacasulile ubudedengu besibhedlela futhi bazimisele ngokusivulela icala."Kubuhlungu ukuthi ungaletha othandiweyo wakho esibhedlela ephethwe wokunye, aphinde azokwehlelwa inkinga yokuhlaselwa, alinyazwe esesibhedlela,” usho kanje. I-ANC ichitha eyokuthi ishela iMK ukuba ijoyine uhulumeni wokubambisana bese kukhishwa i-DA.I-ANC ithe kungamampunge ukuthi ihlela ukukhipha i-DA kuhulumeni wokubambisana. Ikusho lokhu emva kokuputshuka kwenkulumo eqoshiwe yomholi weMK, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, lapho eveza ukuthi abe-ANC bafuna ukuthi iMK ibe ingxenye yohulumeni wokubambisana ophethe kuzwelonke naKwaZulu-Natal. Kule nkulumo eqoshiwe, uZuma uzwakala ethi ulindele ukufika kwabaholi be-ANC abazomnxenxa ukuba avume ukuba yingxenye yohulumeni wokubambisana. Le nkulumo kukholakala ukuthi uZuma uyenze ngesikhathi ekhuluma emhlanganweni wesigungu esiphezulu seMK. UZuma uzwakala ethi abe-ANC bafuna ukuthi izwe liphathwe amaqembu amathathu. Uqhubeka athi ngeke avume ukuba yingxenye yohulumeni wokubambisana. "Ababoni ukuthi leli iqhinga lezitha lokuqedela i-ANC. Abantu bayakhohlwa ukuthi mhla sivula iqembu elisha sathi silivuliswe ukuthi i-ANC isishintshile. Manje ke abantu kufanele basibuke kanjani thina uma sesiphinda futhi sesixoxa ne-ANC?"Okhulumela i-ANC, uNkk Mahlengi Bhengu-Motsiri, uthe abakaze bakhulume neMK ngodaba lokuthi ijoyine uhulumeni wokubambisana. "Besingakayiqinisekise le nkulumo eqoshiwe ukuthi ngabe ngempela uye yini uZuma lo okhuluma lapha. Uma kuwuye ngempela okhuluma lapha, sithanda ukuchitha lokhu akushoyo njengoba kungamanga futhi kudukisa abantu."Asikaze nangelilodwa ilanga sikhulume nabantu beMK ngodaba lokuthi bajoyine uhulumeni wokubambisana. Uma sinezingxoxo ngodaba lukahulumeni wokubambisana siyaye sibabikele abantu."Kuke kwakhona amalungu e-ANC ahlaba ikhwelo lokuba i-DA ikhishwe kuhulumeni wokubambisana emva kokuba ingazange ikuvotele ukuphasiswa kwesabelomali ePhalamende.Kepha uNkk Bhengu-Motsiri uthe kalikho iqembu abahlela ukulikhipha kuhulumeni wokubambisana. "Amampunge nje lawa adala ukudideka okungenasidingo. Kubi ukuthi la mahlebezi abhebhethekiswa umuntu owake waphatha isikhundla esikhulu kangaka ezweni. Angeke sizikhathaze kakhulu ngokuqophisana nabantu abazicabangela bona bodwa. Sizimisele ukudala amathuba emisebenzi, silwe nobubha siphinde senze ukuthi bonke abantu bahlomule emnothweni wakuleli."I-MK, eyiqembu lesithathu ngobukhulu kuzwelonke, yasala ngaphandle ngesikhathi kwakhiwa uhulumeni wokubambisana. Yaphinde yasala ngaphandle nangesikhathi kwakhiwa uhulumeni wokubambisana esifundazweni eyathola amavoti amaningi kuso, iKwaZulu-Natal.Leli qembu linezihlalo ezingu-37 kwezingu-80 esiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal.

UFAKAZI woMbuso uveze ukuthi owayengumengameli we-ANC, Inkosi Albert Luthuli, washaywa ngaphambi kokuthi akhothame.Umphenyi uWarrant Officer Sanet Nel, uthe ubufakazi abuphethe bukhombisa ukuthi uLuthuli washaywa.Lokhu ukusho ngesikhathi ethula ubufakazi esigcawini esiphenya ngokukhothama kukaLuthuli esiseNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu. Okushiwo uWarrant Officer Nel kuphambene nokwatholwa yisigcawu sokuqala esasiphenya ngoLuthuli.Isigcawu sokuqala sathola ukuthi uLuthuli wakhothama emva kokushayiswa yiguzu elithwala impahla.UWarrant Officer Nel utshele inkantolo ukuthi wenze uphenyo olunzulu ngalolu daba. "Ngibe nemihlangano eminingi nabantu abahlukene okubalwa kubo abashushisi nabaphenyi. Ngaxoxa nalabo ababeshushisa amacala asukela kwikhomishini yamaQiniso nokuBuyisana, iTruth and Reconcilliation Commission. Emva kokuqoqa bonke ubufakazi bami ngibe sengifinyelela esinqumeni sokuthi uLuthuli washaywa."UWarrant Officer Nel uthe uzonaba kahle ngalokhu uma eseqhubeka nokwethula ubufakazi, namhlanje.Ngaphambi kwakhe ungoti wezitimela, uMnuz Andries van Tonder, uthe wenza amaphutha amaningi umshayeli weguzu okuthiwa lashayisa uLuthuli. UVan Tonder uthe umshayeli wesitimela, uStephanus Lategan, kwakungafanele agudluze isidumbu sikaLuthuli emva kwengozi."Kwakufanele alinde kuze kufike amaphoyisa kanye nabosizo lokuqala okuyibona ababezobheka isidumbu."UVan Tonder uthe uLategan kwakungafanele ahambe endaweni yengozi engakawachazeli amaphoyisa ngokwenzekile. "Kwakufanele ahambe endaweni yesigameko esewanikezile amaphoyisa isitatimende."UVan Tonder uphinde wathi uLategan waphinde waphula umthetho ngokungababikeli abaphathi bakhe ngengozi."Umthetho uthi kufanele ubikele abaphathi uma wehlelwa yingozi." UVan Tonder uthe ubufakazi obukhona bukhomba ukuthi uLategan wayengayigwema ingozi."Iguzu liyakwazi ukuma ngokushesha. Uma lihamba ngo-60km/p lingakwazi ukugwema into ekude ngebanga elingu-1 500 metres."Abaholi be-ANC bebephume ngobuningi beze esigcawini. Phakathi kwabaholi abebeze esigcawini bekukhona iphini likamengameli, uMnuz Paul Mashatile kanye nelungu lesigungu esiphezulu, uDkt Zweli Mkhize.Abaholi be-ANC basamile kwelokuthi uLuthuli wasocongwa wuhulumeni wobandlululo.ULuthuli wakhothama ngo-1967.Kwabe sekuba nophenyo ngawo u-1967, olwathola ukuthi uLuthuli washayiswa yiguzu.

''Ukuhlala kwabafundi bengafundi ngenxa yenkinga yezindlu zangasese kuyabalimaza kakhulu abafundi ngoba kulahleka isikhathi behlezi emakhaya,'' kusho uMnuz Zwakele Mncwango, umholi we-Action SA KwaZulu Natal, encwadini ayibhalele uHlomuka.Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu Natal, uMnuz Muzi Mahlambi uthe bayalwazi udaba lwaseMatimane lwenkinga yezindlu zangasese, athe iyalungiswa.Mayelana nenkinga yaseMbindleni lapho okufundelwa khona emagumbini engekho esimeni esikahle, uthe akukho abakwaziyo ngalokho. UPHETHE ngemvula yezinyembezi umbhiyozo wokunqoba kweKaizer Chiefs isicoco seNedbank Cup emndenini wakwaMbhele eMthwalume, kubulawa owomndeni ngesihluku.UNksz Londeka Mbhele (24) ushonele emtholampilo wendawo, kulandele ukuphuthunyiswa khona, emva kokugwazwa uyise wengane obeshayela amatekisi aKwaSanti, ePinetown. Ngokusho kukamfowabo kamufi, uMnuz Sanele Mbhele, okhulume neSolezwe izolo, isigameko senzeke ngabo-7 ebusuku, kungakapheli nasikhathi esingakanani leli qembu liqukule indebe. "Besikade sisemnyango sizibhiyoza, siqhumisa iziqhumane, sishaya ne-hoot yemoto ngesikhathi kungena ucingo kwiselula kaLondeka. Simuzwe ephendula ethi usekhaya nomndeni wakhe. Emva kwalapho simbone esenyamalele,” kusho uMbhele. Uthe kuphele imizuzu embalwa, babona ngaye engena ngesango egijima, ethi umsolwa (amgagule ngegama) uyamgwaza,” kubeka uMbhele, othe uqaphele ukuthi ngesikhathi efika ema eduze kwakhe, ubopha entanyeni ecindezele inxeba ngesandla.Uqhube wathi uzingenele emotweni, bamphuthumisa emtholampilo, nakhona wafike wazikhulumela nabahlengikazi, ethi: "ngicela ningisize ngokushesha, ngiyafa”. Uveze ukuthi abahlengikazi bamthathe masinyane ukuyomxilonga, ngesikhathi yena esematasa nokumvulela ifayela. "Ngibizwe udokotela ngisekhona lapho emafayeleni, waqinisekisa ukuthi ngihlobene naye, maqede wangitshela ukuthi usevele washona,” kusho uMbhele.Uthe isigameko siyiguqule ngemizuzwana injabulo yabo."Indlela ebesizijabulele ngayo. Ibhola besilibuka ndawonye siyizelamani, sizidlela ama-snacks no-drink ngoba sonke kasibuphuzi utshwala. Besilokhu sixhumana ngisho nanomfowethu obesemsebenzini, sipiklelana ngokuthi ubani ozowina. Bekuthi uma kungena igoli, sifonelane, kube yilowo nalowo athi yiqembu lakhe elizowina ekugcineni,” kusho uMbhele. Udalule ukuthi umufi ubatshele ngesonto eledlule ukuthi usehlukene nomsolwa, wathi babanga ukuthi akasazenzi izimfanelo zendodakazi yabo eneminyaka emithathu."Uze waveza nokuthi usemyalele ukuthi ambuyisele ne-sim card yakhe kodwa yena wavele wamthumelela isikibha sakhe (umsolwa), waqamba amanga wathi uyisonge ngaso,” kulandisa uMbhele.Uthe yiso lesi sikibha abasithole endaweni yesigameko sebebuya esibhedlela. "Sisola ukuthi ngesikhathi eya kuye emva kokumfonela, uphume naso isikibha, ngenhloso yokumbuyisela sona,” usho kanje. Uthe okunye abaphinde bakuqaphela sebebuya esibhedlela, ucezu lommese ophukile, odwebe isithombe sokuthi umgwaze waze waphuka. Uveze ukuthi emva kwesigameko, umsolwa ongowokuzalwa endaweni kodwa osehlala nonina eLuganda, ubefike endaweni ngetekisi ayishayelayo, waphinde wabaleka ngayo. Kuvela ukuthi ugcine ezinikela emaphoyiseni aseMariannhill ngoMsombuluko. UMbhele uthe bakhumbula isigameko esisodwa sodlame esenzeka ebudlelwaneni bukamsolwa nomufi, esafunda eNyuvesi yaKwaZulu-Natal (UKZN)."Wavakashela udadewethu endaweni ehlala izitshudeni, baxabana, wambulalela i-laptop neselula. Ngaleso sikhathi umfowethu omdala wamyalela ukuthi ahlukane phansi noLondeka, kwangathi bayahlukana kodwa babuye babuyelana,” kusho yena. Uveze ukuthi bebeyizithandani ezaqala umjolo wazo zisafunda emazingeni aphezulu, njengoba babefunda ekilasini elilodwa.Ubalule ukuthi umsolwa wasishiya phansi isikole kwa-matric, umufi waqhubeka waze wagogoda ezifundweni zoMthetho e-UKZN, ngo-2023, wathi ubengakawutholi umsebenzi awufundele, ebamba amatoho uma ethuke eqhamuka ezitolo. Uveze ukuthi bayabufuna ubulungiswa ngodadewabo ukuze baphole. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uLieutenant Colonel Paul Magwaza, uthe amaphoyisa aseHibberdene abophe owesilisa ngecala lokubulala owesifazane (24). "Kulindeleke ukuthi avele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseTutor namuhla," kusho uMagwaza.Uthe imibiko ithe umsolwa ugwaze umgilwa emva kwengxabano, waphuthunyiswa esibhedlela, lapho afike washonela khona.
BANGAWA bhu phansi noma yinini omasipala baKwaZulu-Natal abahlanu ababhekene nenkinga yemali.Umbiko woMcwaningi-maBhuku omkhulu uveze ukuthi ngabe kade bavalwa labo masipala ukuba bayizinkampani ezizimele. Umbiko owethulwe esiShayamthetho KwaZulu-Natal, uveze ukuthi kungaba mnyama kulabo masipala uma bengase bangazitholi izabelo eziqhamuka kuhulumeni kazwelonke nowesifundazwe. Umbiko wethulwe emhlanganweni obuhanjelwe amalungu amakomiti ahlukene, elibhekele ukusebenza kwemali yomphakathi nelibhekele ukusebenza koMnyango wokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu.Omasipala okuthiwa basengcupheni yokuwa womasipala bezifunda, Ugu, uThukela, uMzinyathi, Ndumeni nowaseMpofana.Osehhovisi loMcwaningi-maBhuku KwaZulu-Natal, uNksz Nomalungelo Mkhize, uthe izinto ezifake labo masipala enkingeni, wukungaphathwa kahle kwemali, ukwehluleka ukuqoqa izikweletu, kanye nokuhluleka ukusukumela eyamanzi aphelela emhlabathini nekagesi ontshontshwayo. "Lesi simo senza ukuthi omasipala abaningi bagcine sebebika ukuthi basengcupheni yokuwa. Ukuba labo masipala bayizinkampani ezizimele ngabe kade bavalwa. Bathembele emalini abayithola kuhulumeni wesifundazwe nokazwelonke. Kuyimanje labo masipala abanayo imali eyanele yokuqedela ezinye izinhlelo zentuthuko."Abanye omasipala abane nabo kusele kancane ukuthi bafike kule simo.UMasipala waseNewcastle, uMngeni, eMadlangeni nowaseMpendle nabo basenkingeni yemali. UNksz Mkhize uthe omasipala abaningi basebenzisa baze badlule emalini abasuke beyabelwe.Uthe lokhu kwenza ukuthi omasipala bagcine sebesebenzisa imali yangonyaka wemali olandelayo ukukhokhela izikweletu zangonyaka wemali owedlule."U-26% womasipala baKwaZulu-Natal usebenzise ngokweqile izabelo zawo zonyaka wemali. Lokhu kusho ukuthi isabelo sakulo nyaka wemali sizokhokhela izikweletu zangonyaka owedlule. Unyaka wemali uphele omasipala abaningi sebengenele ezabelweni zonyaka olandelayo." UNksz Mkhize uthe nakuba omasipala besebenzisa ngokweqile imali abasuke beyabelwe kodwa bayahluleka ukwenza izinto abasuke bezibekele zona ngasekuqaleni konyaka wemali.Omasipala abahluleka kakhulu wukwenza izinto abasuke bezibeke zona omasipala bezifunda.UMasipala wesifunda uMzinyathi usebenzise u-113% wesabelomali kodwa wenza u-20% kuphela wezinto ozibekele zona. UMasipala wesifunda Ugu wenze u-41%, uMkhanyakude wenze u-46%, Amajuba wenze 54%, owaseHarry Gwala wenze u-52% owasoThukela wenza u-56%."Munye umasipala okwenze konke obuzibekele khona, okuwuMasipala wesifunda iZululand. Le nkinga yokungenziwa kwezinto omasipala abasuke bezibekele zona, yenza ukuthi abantu bagcine bengazitholanga izidingo ezifana namanzi. Ekugcineni abantu banquma ukubhikisha."
IPHINI likaNgqongqoshe eMnyangweni wezaManzi, uMnuz David Mahlobo, selikhale ngabashayeli bamaloli ahambisa amanzi, abafuna ukugwazelwa abesifazane ngocansi ukuze babahambisele amanzi. Ukusho lokhu ehambele eMachibi, eJozini neMeya yaseMkhanyakude uMnuz Siphile Mdaka, ukuzodingida udaba lwamanzi.Uthe laba bashayeli abagcini ngalokho kodwa baqonywa khona emphakathini baphinde bakhokhise umphakathi ukuze bawunike amanzi noma amaloli ahlale kweminye imindeni amanzi atholwe yiyo kuphela. "Kula maloli kugcwele izigebengu okumele silwe nenkohlakalo eziyenzayo. La eMkhanyakude ngiyabonga ukuthi amakhosi asheshe ayivimba eyabantu abakhokhisa osonkontileka uma benza umsebenzi. Ngiyanxusa meya ukuthi ibhekwe indaba yamaloli futhi silwe nenkohlakalo egcwele khona,” kusho uMahlobo.UMahlobo uthe okwenzeke eMkhanyakude kokubambisana kwamaqembu ezepolitiki yikhona okwenze ukuthi umsebenzi uqhubeke uye phambili."Kuke kwaba kubi eMkhanyakude kodwa eminyakeni emibili emithathu edlule kulo masipala kube nozinzo njengoba amaqembu ezepolitiki ebambene abheka inkinga yamanzi emphakathini. Bekunzima ukusebenza kulo masipala kodwa manje siya phambili ngoba ezamaqembu enu niyozibona ngokhetho. Amanzi aphuma nje yingoba amaqembu abambisene kulo mkhandlu," kusho uMahlobo. Ubize idamu laseJozini njengesiqalekiso eveza ukuthi ngesikhathi lakhiwa kwafa abantu, kwasuswa abanye kule ndawo."Lalisungulelwa ondlebe zikhanyilanga ikakhulu abesilisa. Kodwa ngohulumeni kaMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa kwaba khona izingxoxo nezixazululo njengoba manje seliphakela wonke umphakathi. Imeya ifikile ePitoli izositshela ngezinkinga zamanzi, saqala uhlelo olwaluthinta amakhosi nemeya," kuchaza yena.UMahlobo ubonge ukuthi kukhona lapho amanzi asephuma khona, wathi kodwa bazofaka izindondla zemali ezingeke zidliwe wotsotsi.Uthe bazosebenzisana nenkampani ehlinzeka ngamanzi ukulungisa indaba yamanzi. UMdaka uveze ukuthi uzimisele ukuqeda inkinga yamanzi abalokhu beyilungisa ezigodini ezehlukene."Isifiso sethu wukuthi abantu bayeke ukusebenzisa amanzi abawasebenzisa nezilwane. La eMachibini besikhona sizokwethula isabelo esididiyelwe nalapho kwaba khona izikhalo ezehlukene. Lana emphakathini baveza ukuthi intsha ayisebenzi, bakhala ngenkinga yamanzi, nemigwaqo bathi bafuna nohlelo lwezolimo," kuchaza uMdaka.Uthe ipayipi, okwaba nokukhuluma okukhulu ngalo lithengiwe langasebenza iminyaka, yilona leli abaqale ukulifaka eminyakeni emibili edlule."Seliqalile ukuthi likhiphele umphakathi waseMachibini amanzi."Uthe nakwamanye amawadi uyaqhubeka umsebenzi njengoba bekhona osonkomtileka futhi bazoqhubeka nokuthi bawakhiphe ekujuleni amanzi abangakwazi ukuwathola edamini laseJozini.
BAYINEPHUZE bayiqeda abantu baseMsunduzi imeya yalo mkhandlu ebonakale ibuka umdlalo wezinkunzi zaseSoweto enkundleni iMoses Mabhida, ihlezi endaweni yomntakabani, emva kokuba umasipala ewuphethe uhoxise ngemizuzu yokugcina uhlelo lokubuka lo mdlalo obuluhlelele abantu abangakwazanga ukuthola amathikithi okuyowubuka.Abantu baseMsunduzi bathe iMeya yomkhandlu, uMnuz Mzimkhulu Thebolla, ikhombise ukungazwelani nosizi lwabo ngokuqhubeka iyobuka ibhola enkundleni ekubeni umasipala ugile abantu abebezimisele ngokuzobuka umdlalo ndawonye.UMasipala waseMsunduzi wamemezela ukuthi uzoba nohlelo lokubuka ibhola eCarbineers Garden, eseceleni kwehholo ledolobha. NgoMgqibelo, umasipala uvele wabagila igoda abathandi bebhola njengoba umemezele ukuhoxiswa kohlelo lokubukwa kwebhola.Lesi simemezelo senziwe kusele isikhathi esingaphansi kwamahora amabili kuqale umdlalo.Abanye abantu bajike khona endaweni obekuzobukwa kuyo ibhola njengoba bebengazi ukuthi sekuhoxisiwe ukubukwa kwalo. Okucasule kakhulu abantu baseMsunduzi wukubonakala kwezithombe zikaThebolla, ebuka ibhola enkundleni.Kulezi zithombe uThebolla ubonakala ehlezi nokhulumela uhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Bongani Gina nomsakazi weGagasi, u-Alex Mthiyane.Abantu bekuthi abamudle bamfele ezinkundleni zokuxhumana. Abanye bebebuza ukuthi kungani yena engenzanga njengeMeya yaseThekwini, uMnuz Cyril Xaba, ebonakale ibuka ibhola nabantu endaweni yokubuka ibhola ebihlelwe wumkhandlu?Ikhansela le-IFP, uMnuz Thinasonke Ntombela, lithe kube kubi ukuthi umasipala uhoxise uhlelo sekusele isikhathi esincane ukuba kuqale umdlalo."Awukwazi ukuhoxisa ngomzuzu wokugcina ngoba phela uMsunduzi mkhulu kakhulu, kukhona abantu abasuka kude. Abantu abasuka koVulindlela nakoNcwadi bese bevele sebesendleleni ngesikhathi kumenyezelwa ukuthi sekuhoxisiwe. Yimbi le nto ngoba phela sonke siyazi ukuthi abantu abaningi abazange bawathole amathikithi. Yingakho nje omasipala abaningi benqume ukuhlelela abantu." UNtombela uthe bafuna kuphenywe ngalolu daba."Kungenzeka ukuthi kunemali ebisikhishiwe njengoba abantu begcine bengalibukanga ibhola."Ikhansela le-DA, uMnuz Reggie Khanyile, lithe uThebolla ukhombise ukungabi nazwelo. "Abantu basuke ezindaweni ezikude, le koVulindlela, bangabafica obhazabhaza bamathelevishini. Yena uyaqhubeka nokuyoqhiphotheka eMabhida."UThebolla uxolisile kubo bonke abantu abagibelele ubala.UThebolla uthe bathole ukuthi umuntu abebemqashile ukuba abahlinzeke ngobhazabhaza wethelevishini ubeqashwe ezindaweni ezimbili. "Ngesikhathi abasebenzi bomkhandlu sebethi bazama ukumfonela, bathole ukuthi uye komunye umasipala. Lapho bese kusele isikhathi esincane ukuthi kuqale umdlalo, okuphoqe ukuthi sivele sinqume ukuhoxisa. Asazi ukuthi kungani evumile ukusihlinzeka ngobhazabhaza wethelevishini ekubeni azi kahle ukuthi uqashwe ezindaweni ezimbili."UThebolla uthe bazophenya ngalolu daba.Uthe akazi ukuthi kungani abantu begxeka ukuya kwakhe eMoses Mabhida. Uthe njengomuntu othanda ibhola uhlezi eya ukuyolibuka."Ngiyaya ngisho lidlala eGoli. Bengingenalo uhlelo oluthi ngizoya kobukela ibhola endaweni ebihlelwe wumasipala."
I-DA ithi ukungaqokwa kukaMqodisi Jikelele woMnyango wezokuVikela nomakadebona bezempi sekudale ukungabikho kozinzo nokubambezeleka kwemihlomulo yomakadebona.IPhini lomkhulumeli weqembu kwezokuphepha uMnuz uMnuz Maliyakhe Shelembe, esitatimendeni lithe isikhala sikaMqondisi Jikelele sakhangiswa ngonyaka odlule kwathi ukufakwa kwezicelo zomsebenzi kwavalwa ngoNovemba kuwo lowo nyaka.Lokhu kulandela ukusula kukaNksz Irene Mpolweni emva kokumiswa ngoMashi 2024. Kumanje kubambe uNksz Nontobeko Mafu. Leli qembu lithe uNgqongqoshe wezokuVikela uNkk Angie Motshekga, kufanele aqoke ozongena kulesi sikhundla ngokugcwele ngokushesha."Ukungavalwa kwalesi sikhala sekudale ukuthi lungabikho uzinzo nokubambezeleka kokuba omakadebona bathole imihlomulo yabo. Ukwehluleka kukaNgqongqoshe ukuqoka ngokugcwele uMqondisi Jikelele, kulimaza uhlelo lokukhishwa kwemihlomulo yomakadebona bezempi abafanelwe nemindeni yabo abalokhu balinda kusukela ngo-2011," kusho uShelembe.Uthe lokhu kuvelile ngesikhathi izinyunyana nabasebenzi boMnyango befuna ukukhuluma ngodli nekomiti lePhalamende elibhekele ezokuphepha. Uqhube wathi i-DA ikubona kungamukelekile ukubambezeleka kokuqokwa kukaMqondisi Jikelele kwazise uneqhaza elibalulekile alibambile ekukhishweni kwemihlomulo yomakadebona bezempi."Kuphula inhliziyo ukuthi zonke izinsuku sithola izikhalazo komakadebona bezempi okuhlanganisa ukuthi abangasebenzi namanje, abakakwazi ukuya ezibhedlela ngoba uMnyango awubaniki uxhaso lwemali."UShelembe uthe lokhu kunyathela ilungelo lomakadebona elikuMthethosisekelo wezwe.Uthe sebembhalele uNkk Motshekga ukuba asheshise ukuqokwa kukaMqondisi Jikelele ukuze kuzobuya uzinzo kulo Mnyango nokuqinisekisa ukuhlinzekwa kwezidingo komakadebona.
BALALE bebaliwe abasebenzi bakuMasipala waseThekwini ababanjwe oqotsheni bentshontsha udizili emalolini amanzi.Kuphele amahlathi okucasha kulaba basolwa ngesikhathi bebhadanywa bemoma udizili emalolini, bewufaka ezigujini. Abasolwa baficwe begila lo mkhuba emzini oseKukhanyeni, eduze naseVerulam.Ngesikhathi abaphenyi bomkhandlu befika kulo muzi bafice abasolwa bemoma udizili elolini, iloli lesibili lona belimi esangweni lilinde ukuzothulula. Omabili la maloli abethwele amanzi obekufanele awahambise ezindaweni ezingenawo amanzi.Abasolwa bebevele becushelwe unoxhaka njengoba bese kunesikhathi eside belandelwa, ngemuva kwemibiko yokuthi amaloli amanzi omkhandlu ayabonakala ethulula udizili kulo muzi.Abasolwa bavulelwe icala esiteshini samaphoyisa eNanda. Inhloko yophiko oluphenyayo kuMasipala waseThekwini, iCity Intergrity and Investigations, uMnuz Jimmy Ngcobo, income ukuzinikela nobuhlakani babaphenyi abebelandela lolu daba."Sizoqhubeka nokuphenya ngokuntshontshwa kukadizili kule ndawo njengoba kuthiwa udla lubi lo mkhuba. Angeke sivume ukuthi abantu bantshontshe impahla yomkhandlu. Sinxusa abantu ukuba basibikele uma bebona lo mkhuba nezinye izenzo zenkohlakalo khona sizophenya."UNgcobo uthe abasolwa babanjwe nezigubhu ezingo-25 litres ezingu-12, athe kusho ukuthi bantshontshe u-300 litres kadizili. UNgcobo uthe udizili ontshontshwa emalolini omkhandlu udayiselwa abantu basendaweni.UNgcobo uthe bayaqhubeka nokulwa nenkohlakalo emkhandlwini.Izibalo zikhombisa ukuthi kunabasebenzi bomkhandlu abangu-25 abavulelwe amacala kulo nyaka wezimali.Uphiko luphenya amacala okuntshontshwa kwempahla yomkhandlu angu-126, kanye nangu-181 enkohlakalo nokukhwabanisa onke enzeke kulo nyaka wezimali.

LIKHUPHUKILE izinga lokungasebenzi kuleli lisuka ku-31.9% laya ku-32.9% ekoteni yokugcina yonyaka odlule.Lokhu kuvezwe yiStats SA General, uMnuz Risenga Maluleke, embikweni ewukhiphe izolo.UMaluleke uthe abantu abangu-291 000 abangenawo umsebenzi ekoteni yokuqala yonyaka. "Intsha engasebenzi yiyona nkinga enkulu esabhekene nezwe. Yinto ekudingeka isukunyelwe ngokushesha."Umbiko kaMalulele uveze ukuthi ikota nekota liyehla izinga labasebenzayo njengoba bengu-16.8 million, besuka ku-17.1 million ekoteni yokugcina ngo-2024.Uveze ukuthi izinga lemisebenzi linyuke emkhakheni okubalwa ezokuthutha, ezomnotho neminye. "Linyukile nezinga labantu asebelahle ithemba lokuthi bayoke bawuthole umsebenzi ngo-7 000. Abantu abangenzi lutho bona linyukile izinga labo laya kwabangu-177 000."Imikhakha okwehle kuyo abaqashiwe kubalwa owezohwebo, owezokwakha nowezimayini.Izibalo zikhomba ukuthi linyukile izinga labasebenzayo eWestern cape ngabangu-49 000, Gauteng (9 000) naseFree State (4 000).Izinga lehle KwaZulu-Natal ngabantu-104 000, Eastern Cape (83 000), North West (57 000), Limpopo (55 000), Mpumalanga (43 000) naseNorthern Cape (12 000). Izinga lentsha engasebenzi lifinyelele ku-4.8 million. Kuhlale kukhalwa ngenkinga yokungasebenzi kuleli.Uhulumeni uhlale enxuswa ukuthi akhe amathuba emisebenzi, ikakhulu entsheni njengoba kuyiyo engatohozi.Uhulumeni uzithethelela ngokuthi kudingeka ukhulise umnotho ukuze ukwazi ukuqasha abantu abangatohozi.

UMnyango unxuse abalimi ukuba banake isikhathi esiyizinsuku ezingu-14 lapho izimpawu zalesi sefiso zisuke zingakabonali."UMnyango unxusa bonke abalimi bemfuyo ezweni lonke ukuba bazame ngayo yonke indlela ukunciphisa ukuhanjiswa kwemfuyo. Sicela abadayisa esidlangalaleni nabanikazi bemfuyo ukuba baqaphele uma bethenga izilwane ezifundazweni lapho kunalesi sifo." Uthe umthetho uyabaphoqa abanikazi bemfuyo ukuba baqinisekise ukuthi imfuyo yabo isesimeni esihle sempilo.UMnyango ululeke ngokuthi izimpawu zalesi sifo ezibonakalayo kufanele zibikwe ngokushesha kodokotela bezilwane bakahulumeni."Isigaba 11 se-Animal Diseases Act siphoqa bonke abanikazi bezilwane nezimenenja ukuthi kube umsebenzi wabo ukugwema ukuthelekeka kwezilwane zabo, ukunqanda ukusabalala kwezifo ezilwaneni nasezakhiweni," kusho uMnyango.

BEBAZI ukuthi bazozethweswa kanyekanye iziqu zabo zeBachelor of Social Sciences Honours abangamawele akwa-B, eMlaza.U-Amanda no-Ayanda Ndawonde (23) bathweswe iziqu zabo ngoLwesibili e-University of KwaZulu-Natal (UKZN). Ekhuluma neSolezwe izolo u-Ayanda, uthe okwenza babe nesiqiniseko sokuthi bazogqoka kanyekanye wukuthi bebefunda ndawonye, futhi befunda into eyodwa. "Bekuthi uma sitadisha, sikwenze ndawonye, ngokubambisana, ngakho into ebifundwa yiwele lami, bekuba yinto engiyifundayo nami,” kusho u-Ayanda. Uthe lokhu bekuvela ngisho nasemamakini ebebewathola ngoba abengashiyani kakhulu."Bekuthi uma omunye ethole u-70%, omunye athole u-75%,” kusho u-Ayanda. Uthe lezi yiziqu zabo zesibili njengoba ngo-2023, bathweswa ezokuqala zeBachelor of Social Sciences. Uthe isifiso sabo ukuthi babhukulele ukwethweswa iMasters ezifundweni ezifanayo khona bezoba nezindawo zabo ezizimele zokunikeza abantu usizo lokwelulekwa ngokomqondo. Singabangani sobabili,” kusho u-Ayanda, othe abeve bejabule ngokwethweswa kwabo iziqu, wathi kujabule ngisho nomndeni. E-UKZN kuqhubeka imicimbi yokwethweswa kweziqu okuba minyaka yonke.Le micimbi, okubokala kuyo izitshudeni zihlobe ngezindlela ezehlukene, iqale ngoLwesibili kanti kulindelele ukuthi iqhubeke kuze kube uMeyi 16. INKAMPANI yokudla iTiger Brands ngoMsombuluko iveze ukuthi izonxephezela izisulu ze-listeriosis.Lokhu kuthathwe njengesinqumo esikhulu esithathiwe kusukela kwabheduka lesi sifo ngo-2017 esadlula nemiphefumulo yabangu-200 kwagula abangaphezu kuka-1,000.Lesi siphakamiso senziwe abameli abamele inkampani yomshwalense ehola iTiger Brands, i-QBE Insurance Group Limited, ngo-Ephreli 25, eyakhipha isiphakamiso sokunxeshezelwa kwabafake izicelo ezithile abaphethwe yi-listeriosis, kusho inkampani esitatimendeni. Isiphakamiso samanje sigunyaza isinxephezelo esigcwele kwabafake izicelo zawo wonke amademeshe aqinisekisiwe, kuncike endleleni yokukhokha okusadingeka ukuba iphothulwe - okuhlanganisa nokuthi amademeshe azohlolwa kanjani.Ukuze kuvikelwe isithunzi sabantu abathintekayo okuyibona abafake izicelo zokukhokhelwa, ayikho imininingwane yomnikelo kanye/noma inkokhelo ezokhishwa esidlangalaleni, kusho inkampani. "Isimemezelo sanamuhla simele igxathu elibalulekile futhi silandela maduze ezinyathelweni esezivele zathathwa ngoFebhuwari 2025 zokuhlinzeka usizo lwesikhashana ngendlela yokukhokha kulabo abahlonziwe abanezidingo eziphuthumayo zokwelashwa," kusho uTjaart Kruger, isikhulu esiphezulu kwaTiger Brands, esitatimendeni.NgoJanuwari 2017 kwaqubuka isifo i-listeriosis, isifo esitholakala ngokudla, okuyinto eyenzeka eNingizimu Afrika okwathi uma kulandelwa umsuka waso wakhomba ngqo efemini eyayiphethwe yinkampani engaphansi kwe-Tiger Brands ngaleso sikhathi, i-Enterprise Foods, eyenza amasoseji agayiwe, ubhekeni kanye nenyama.

Uthe umshayeli wabo akukho okungafanele akwenzile, wathi kwenzeke konke lokhu yena ehleli ngaphambili eduze komshayeli.Isolezwe libuye lakhuluma noMfu Vusumuzi Myeni webandla iNew Jerusalem, nalo elingelamaZayoni , obelethelwe isiguqo. Uthe izinkonzo zalolu hlobo bavamisile ukuba nazo njengoba baye bacele ukuzokhulekiswa uma kukhona okuthile okungahambi kahle kumzalwane othile. "Ubebona sekubikwe ngayo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana. Ngivele nganikela khona uma ngifika ngathola ukuthi yibo ngempela. Ubuhlungu engibuzwayo, abuchazeki, ngiyaqala ukubona into enje eminyakeni engu-67 esengiyiphile emhlabeni,” kubalisa uMyeni. Ngesikhathi Isolezwe likhuluma naye uthe usesibhedlela iNgwelezane uyobheka abasindile."Sibi isimo. Balimele kanzima abantu bakaJehova,” usho kanje.Imizamo yokuthola umfundisi webandla abafi ebebekhonza kulo, uNksz Nyawo, ayiphumelelanga, ucingo belukhala lungabanjwa. UMlungwana uveze ukuthi baphansi phezulu bacinga imindeni yabashonile, ukuze bayiphelezele iyohlonza izidumbu eMpangeni. Isolezwe lithole ukuthi kukhona isidididi esikhona njengoba kukhona abayocinga esibhedlela abathandiweyo babo, bangabafici, okukhomba ukuthi bakulaba abashonile. Kuthiwa abanye baya lapho kugcinwe khona izidumbu, bafike bathole ukuthi abathandiweyo babo basesibhedlela. I-DA ifuna iphenywe yizinhlaka zokuphepha okukhona kuzo izinhloli kanye noKlebe, eyabantu abavala amanzi ngamabomu eThekwini ngoba nakhu befuna ukunikezwa umsebenzi wokuhlinzeka abantu ngamanzi.Leli qembu selibhalele imenenja yomkhandlu, uMnuz Musa Mbhele, licela ukuba kube nophenyo olunzulu ngalo mkhuba obukeka wanda kuleli dolobha wokuvalela abantu amanzi ngamabomu.Sekuyinsakavukela ukuhamba kwamanzi ezindaweni ezahlukene ezingaphansi kukaMasipala waseThekwini. Kwezinye izindawo abantu abasawazi amanzi ompompi, sebephila ngokuwathola ezimotweni.Ohola i-DA kuMasipala waseThekwini, uMnuz Thabani Mthethwa, uthe sekucacile ukuthi kunesandla semfene kulokhu kuhamba kwamanzi ezindaweni eziningi."Ubufakazi kanye nemibiko esiyitholayo wukuthi lena yokuhlupha kwamanzi eThekwini, ayidalwa nje yinkinga yokunganakekelwa kwengqalasizinda kanye nokuqhuma kwamapayipi. Inkinga enkulu esibhekene nayo lana eyabantu abahamba beyovala amanzi ngamabomu. La bantu banamaloli amanzi, bayahlomula uma amanzi engekho." Uthe:"Lezi zigebengu zifike zona zicekele phansi ingqalasizinda yamanzi, zenze kubukeke sengathi kunenkinga yamanzi. Umasipala ugcina uphoqeleka ukuthi uqashe amaloli azohambisela abantu amanzi. Amaloli aqashwayo awabo kanye la bantu abavala amanzi."UMthethwa uthe bafuna ukuba kube nophenyo olunzulu ngalolu daba."Lo mkhuba uphazamisa umnotho waseThekwini. Sifuna uphenyo oluzohlanganisa amaphoyisa, izinhloli, oKlebe, iSpecial Investigating Unit kanye nezinye izinhlaka ezithintekayo. Abantu baseThekwini bafuna izimpendulo. Ngaphezu kwezimpendulo abantu baseThekwini bafuna ukuthola amanzi ahlanzekile. Ngeke siphumule kuze kube sibaphenya izinqa laba abenza lo mkhuba omubi kangaka." Ngeledlule kwavinjwa abasebenzi bakaMasipala waseThekwini ababeyovula amanzi esiphehlini esiseChatsworth.Le simo sashiya abantu basezindaweni eziphakelwa yile siphehli bengenawo amanzi njengoba abasebenzi bomkhandlu baze babuya ngakusasa.Ngokusho komkhandlu abasebenzi bavinjwa amalungu omphakathi ayengajabule ngohlelo lokuncishiswa kwamanzi kodwa kunezinsolo zokuthi abasebenzi bavinjwa yibo kanye la bantu abavalela abantu amanzi.

Uthe ukubambezeleka kudalwe ukwehluleka ukuvuselela izinkontileka zothisha bakaGrade R ngaphambi kokuphela konyaka wezimali. "Maqondana nothisha bakaGrade R, kube nenselelo ngoba asizivuselelanga izinkontileka zabo ngaphambi kokuphela konyaka wezimali, lokhu, ngeshwa, okuphazamise ukukhokhwa kwemiholo ngoba bezingekho izinkontileka," kusho uHlomuka. Kodwa lokho sesikuxazululile manje, futhi bonke bakhokhelwe namuhla (ngoLwesithathu)," esho. Kodwa, abanye othisha bakaGrade R bakuphikisile okushiwo ungqongqoshe. UNksz Nonhlanhla Zuma, osefundise uGrade R iminyaka engu-10, uthe :"Kushiwo ungqongqoshe kuqhelelene neqiniso. Kungamanga uqobo. Siyalamba futhi sithwele kanzima ngoba asikaholelwa. Kungani umnyango usiphatha ngale ndlela? "Uveze ukukhathazeka, wathi akasakwazi ukukhokhela imali yemoto yesikole yendodakazi yakhe okanye yesikole ngenxa yokungaholelwa. Phezu kokuba nesipiliyoni seminyaka engu-10, uNksz Zuma, njengabanye, usasebenza ngenkontileka evuselelwayo ehlala ibambezeleka ngenxa yezinkinga zasehhovisi. Omunye uthisha onesipiliyoni sokufundisa seminyaka engu-14, uveze ukukhathazeka kwakhe encwadini ayithumele iDaily News esesitebeleni esisodwa naleli phephandaba. Echaza, :"Imina obeka isinkwa etafuleni emndenini wami. Ngaphandle komholo, akukho ukudla noma into yokuhamba kwezingane zami. Kuphula inhliziyo. Umnyango awusikhathalele. Futhi singabesifazane kulo mkhakha, sibhekene nezinselelo ezinkulu." Uqhube wathi, emva kweminyaka engaphezulu kwengu-10 ekulo mnyango, usalokhu eyitoho, engabanjelwa imali yempesheni, okuvusa ukukhathazeka ngekusasa lomndeni wakhe uma eshona. Uthisha wesithathu ofundisa uGrade R waseThekwini, uveze ukunganeliseki wathi, "Ungqongqoshe uqambe amanga. Iningi lethu, okuhlanganisa nami, asikatholi ngisho isenti. Lokhu kuwukuphathwa kabi okukhulu.
