UKUDLULA emhlabeni kwabaculi bakamaskandi namagidangoma abo maqede kungaziwa ukuthi kufanele kuthathweni, kuhlanganiswe nani ukuze bafihlwe, kusukumise isihlabani salo mculo, uBuselaphi Buthelezi-Gxowa. "Sinohlelo esiluqalayo lokungcwaba amaciko ngoba siba nenkinga uma kushona umculi namagidangoma akhe, kungabibikho ongenelelayo." Lo mculi, owaqala ukuzakhela udumo kwiMithente, uthe uphatheka kabi uma sekufanele kwehliwe kwenyukwa kuqongelelwa iminikelo ukuze kungcwatshwe iciko elibambe iqhaza kumaskandi. Uthe kulo mbhidlango usebenzisana nenkampani yabangcwabi esemthethweni, esifihle amaciko amaningi kuleli, okubalwa kuwo noWinnie Khumalo, i-21 Century Funeral Services. "Sizoba nenkundla esizoqobela kuyo phansi wonke amaciko akuzozonke izifundazwe ukuze uma kufika izikhathi ezinzima singabi nenkinga yokuthi sithathani sihlanganisa nani ukuze sifihle umufi." Uthe lo masingcwabisane uwuqhuba ngaphansi kwenhlangano yakhe engenzi nzuzo iDr Buselaphi Foundation. "Into esizoyenza wukuthi kumele iciko libe nabantu abayisikhombisa kuphela. Wumphathi bese kuba amagidangoma akhe ayisithupha, ukuze kuhlangane abantu abayisikhombisa. Sizocela umuntu ngamunye anikele ngoR100 kanye ngenyanga, zinyangazonke ukuze silekelelane." Uthe njengamanje uxoxisana neminyango kahulumeni nosomabhizinisi abazimele ngenhloso yokuba nabo baphonse itshe esivivaneni. "Silungiselela nokuba nehhovisi esizosebenzela kulo. Sizodinga amagama omuntu aphelele ne-ID yakhe ukuze angene kwi-database yethu ezoba sehhovisi nakwi-21 Century ukuze uma sivelelwa yinkinga kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ungowethu ngempela, kungaqhamuki umuntu esingamazi athi uyigidangoma likaBuselaphi kanti akalona." Esephetha uBuselaphi uthe isiqubulo sabo sithi "Asizisize Thina Ngaphambi Kokuba Sisizwe Ngabanye."
UMPHATHISWA wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal, uNksz Nomagugu Simelane, uvumile ukuthi bayazazi izinkinga zengqalasizinda ezikhungethe izikhungo zempilo zakulesi sifundazwe kodwa wathi ukungabi nayo imali eyanele kwenza kube nzima ukuthi balungise zonke lezinkinga njengokufisa kwabo. UNksz Simelane uthe banalo uhlelo lokulungisa zonke izinkinga ezisezikhungweni zezempilo, futhi bayazi ukuthi iziphi izinto ezidinga ukulungiswa.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma emva komhlangano wekhabhinethi laKwaZulu-Natal. Kuhlezi kunezikhalazo ngokunganakekelwa kwengqalasizinda kwezinye izikhungo zezempilo zaKwaZulu-Natal.Umbiko owethulwa umnyango esiShayamthetho nyakenye waveza ukuthi ziningi izinto okufanele engabe sezilungisiwe ezikhungweni zempilo ezingalungisiwe ngenxa yenkinga yemali.Umnyango wathi udinga imali ephakathi kukaR14 billion noR21 billion ukuze ulungise zonke izinkinga okufanele engabe kade zalungiswa, wathi kudingeka uR2.8 billion minyaka yonke ukulungisa ingqalasizinda yasezikhungweni zempilo. UNksz Simelane uthe kuyaqhubeka ukulungiswa kwengqalasizinda kwezinye izikhungo zezempilo."Sinalo uhlelo lokulungisa ingqalasizinda kuzo zonke izikhungo zezempilo. Siyazi ukuthi iziphi izinkinga ezikhona kuzo zonke izikhungo zezempilo. Siyazi ukuthi yini okufanele ilungiswe kuzo zonke izibhedlela. Kuyenzeka ke kwesinye isikhathi kungenzeki ngale ndlela esisuke sifisa ngayo ngenxa yokuthi asinayo imali eyanele. Kodwa lokho akusho ukuthi asinalo uhlelo lokulungisa izibhedlela."UNksz Simelane uthe njengengxenye yalolu hlelo lokulungisa izikhungo zezempilo basanda kuqala umsebenzi wokulungisa isibhedlela iNorthdale, esiseMgungundlovu. Lesi sibhedlela sinenkinga yokuvuza kophahla.UNksz Simelane uthe kufanele engabe kade lwaphothulwa uhlelo lokulungisa iNorthdale."Kwaba nenkinga yokuthi inkampani eyayinikezwe umsebenzi wokulungisa isibhedlela yashiya phakathi, yathi ayikwazi ukuqhubeka nomsebenzi. Lokhu kwasiphoqa ukuba siqale phansi uhlelo lokuthungatha inkampani ezoqhubeka nomsebenzi. Kuqalelile emasontweni amabili edlule ukulungiswa kwesibhedlela." INorthdale isanda kuba semehlweni abantu emva kokusabalala kwezithombe zezisebenzi zakulesi sibhedlela zipheka ukudla kweziguli emlilweni.Lokhu kwenzeka emva kokuhamba kukagesi kanye nokuhluleka kwama-generator ukusebenza ngesikhathi kuhambe ugesi.Emva kwalesigameko uNksz Simelane wathi bazothathelwa izinyathelo labo abathatha isinqumo sokuthi ukudla kweziguli kuphekwe emlilweni, wathi umgomo womnyango uthi ukudla kufanele kulandwe esibhedlela esiseduze uma kuhambe ugesi. "Amagenerator asezikhungweni zezempilo ayahlolwa njalo ukuthi asasebenza yini. Kusho ukuthi kukhona umuntu ongazange awenze umsebenzi wakhe wokuhlola ukuthi wonke ama-generator asasebenza yini. Sifuna nokwazi ukuthi kungani abaphathi besibhedlela bengazange balusukume udaba lokungasebenzi kwe-generator, kwaze kwasukuma izikhulu zomnyango ukuze kube iyalungiswa i-generator."
BANGAPHEZULU kuka-600 ababoshelwe amacala abucayi eNingizimu Afrika phakathi kukaJanuwari noMashi kulo nyaka.Lokhu kuvezwe oyiNhloko yophiko loKlebe, uLieutenant General Godfrey Lebeya, esithangamini sabezindaba izolo ePitoli.ULebeya uthe lesi sibalo esingu-656 esababoshelwe amacala afana nawenkohlakalo, ukukhwabanisa, ukushintshisana ngemali, ubugebengu obenziwa online (cybercrime) nokubamba inkunzi kuhlonyiwe.Uthe amanye amacala ebebewabheka kakhulu awokubulawa kwamaphoyisa, ukubanjwa kwezimoto zemali inkunzi, ukuthumba nokushushumbiswa kwezidakamizwa. Uveze ukuthi iGauteng izihola phambili ngesibalo esiphezulu sababoshelwe lama cala njengoba imi ku-139, ilandelwe iNorth West ngo-99, kuze iKwaZulu-Natal ngo-88 bese kuba yi-Eastern Cape neFree State ebanesibalo esilinganayo esingu-73 isifundazwe ngasinye.ULebeya uthe kulesi sibalo sababoshiwe, amaningi amacala asesezinkantolo ngakho ngeke kube lula ukudalula ukuthi mangaki asefinyelele esiphethweni. Ngokusho kwakhe, angu-22 amaphoyisa abulewe kulesi sikhathi, wathi angu-16 kulesi sibalo, abulawa engekho emsebenzini, kuthi ayisithupha abulawa esemsebenzini."Esikhathini esifanayo, kuboshwe abangu-38 ngamacala okubulala amaphoyisa. Abangu-14, balahlwe yila macala, banikwa odilikajele abayishumi nanye neminyaka engu-487 ngaphezulu," usho kanje. Uthe uphiko lwakhe luphenya amacala angu-50 okubanjwa inkunzi izimoto zemali, wathi kuboshwe abasolwa abangu-64 ngala macala namanye. Udalule ukuthi abangu-13 babasolwa, abalahlile lama cala.Uveze ukuthi angu-33 amaphoyisa aboshelwa ukuzibandakanya ebugebengwini.Kuwona uthe kukhona angu-19 omgwaqo, bese kuba angu-14 ophiko lweSouth African Police Service (SAPS). Uthe lesi sibalo sisezifundazweni iGauteng, Mpumalanga neFree State."Baboshelwe amacala afana nokukhwabanisa, inkohlakalo, ukubulala, ukubamba inkunzi nokuthikameza ukusebenza kwengalo yomthetho," kusho uLebeya.Wengeze ngokuthi ayisithupha agwetshiwe, kulandela ukulahlwa kwawo amacala okukhona kuwo ukuphazamisa ukusebenza kwengalo yomthetho, ukuhlanganisa itulo lokubamba inkunzi, ukukhwabanisa nenkohlakalo. "Siphinde sakhipha imiyalelo engu-102 yokushaqwa kwempahla yenani likaR418 million. Kuphinde kwafakwa imali enguR19 million kwiCriminal Assets Recovery Account (CARA),” usho kanje. Ubuye wadalula nokuthi zingu-395 izibhamu ezingekho emthethweni abazitholile kanye nezinhlamvu ezingu-1 746. Uthe babuye bavukuza nezidleke okwenziwa kuzo izidakamizwa, bashaqa izidakamizwa zenani likaR23 million.
KUZOHLALUKA ngoJuni 12 kulo nyaka, ukuthi liyaya yini ukuyoqulelwa eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini, icala lokubulawa kwephoyisa likaMasipala weTheku kanye nabangani balo ababili. Lukhu kuvele izolo eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini ngesikhathi kuvela abasolwa abathathu ngaleli cala. Isigameko, senzeka eshisanyama yaseLamontville ngoMashi 3 ngonyaka odlule.Abasolwa badubula babulala uSiyathokoza Mthethwa (40) owayesebenza ophikweni lweVIP Protection kulo masipala, abangani bakhe ababili, oMnuz Merik Thringe (40) noMnuz Nkanyiso Makhanya (34). Kwaboshwa ngokwahlukahlukana abasolwa abathathu ngoSepthemba ngonyaka odlule.Umsolwa wokuqala kwakuwuMnuz Thandolwenkosi Nzimande (21) owaboshwa ngoSepthemba 4. Owesibili, uMnuz Nandos Ngcobo (23), owaboshwa ngoSepthemba 8. Owesithathu uMnuz Samkelo Mkhize (23) yena waboshwa ngoSepthemba 19. Ngosuku lwesigameko kuthiwa abasolwa batheleka eshisanyama, bayokhuluma nabafi. Kuthiwa kwabe sekusuka ingxabano, abasolwa badubula abafi bephindelela maqede bashaya bachitha, beshiya abafi sebethule endaweni yesigameko. Owayeyingoduso kamufi uMakhanya, uNksz Lihle Dumakude utshele Isolezwe izolo ukuthi wakhetha ukuyeka ukulandela icala njengoba wayenomuzwa wokuthi liyamhlukumeza emoyeni."Angisayi enkantolo uma liqulwa, angisalilandeli ngoba belingihlukumeza kakhulu,” kusho uNksz Dumakude.Uqhube wathi kwabuye kwamphula umoya ukuxolisa komunye wabasolwa, owavele waphenduka wabheka ngakubona emabhentshini, wathi uyaxolisa ngokubulala. "Leso senzo sangiphatha kabi. Angazi ukuxolisa kwakhe kwakusazosiza ngani emonakalweni ayesewenzile. Uma wayazi ukuthi akwenza kwakungalungile, okusho ukuthi kwakungamele akwenze kwasekuqaleni,” kusho uNksz Dumakude.Uthe usesizwa wukuxoxelwa yizihlobo zabafi ezisalihambela icala ngokwenzekayo enkantolo uma kuvele abasolwa.
USHUMAYELE ivangeli lokuthi babuyele ezikhungweni zempilo bayolanda imishanguzo yokuthithibalisa i-HIV abadikile ama-ARV ngoba azobasiza. Leli khwelo lenziwe yiPhini likamengameli lezwe uMnuz Paul Mashatile, ephendula imibuzo izolo ePhalamende.UMashatile uthe basemkhankasweni wokuthola abantu abangu-1.1 million, abahaqwe yi-HIV kodwa abangayidli imishanguzo. Uveze ukuthi iningi lalaba abesilisa."Sifuna ikakhulu labo abadikile imishanguzo ukuze babuyele bayidle. Sihlela ukuthi sibathole laba abangu-1.1 million, abangayidli." Usho lokhu nje KwaZulu-Natal bangaphezu kuka-100 000 abacingwa ngumnyango wezeMpilo, abadikile ama-ARV. Umnyango wezeMpilo kuzwelonke unomkhankaso wokuhambela izindawo ezehlukene, ezigcwala abesilisa ababafunayo abalaxaze ama-ARV.UMashatile uthe banohlelo lokuthi abadla imishanguzo bayilande ezinyangeni eziyisithupha ukuze bangayi njalo emitholampilo."Siyazi ikakhulu ezindaweni ezisemakhaya, kuhanjwa amabanga amade uma umuntu eya emtholampilo. Yingakho sifuna ukubasondezela ngokuthi okungenani bangayi njalo, ukuyolanda imishanguzo yabo." UMashatile ubuye wakhuluma nangohlelo lwezempilo, obeluxhaswe yizwe laseMelika lokulwa negciwane iHIV.Uthe phezu kokuhoxiswa kwalolu xhaso kodwa bayaqhuba ngokuthi abantu basayithola imishanguzo yabo.Uveze ukuthi lolu hlelo beluxhase u-17% kuphela hhayi ukuthi izwe belithembele kulona. "Lolu hlelo belufaka cishe uR8 billion. Sikhuluma nomnyango kaMgcinimafa mayelana nokuthi afake isandla emuva kokuhoxa kweMelika ekuxhaseni uhlelo olwaziwa nge-Pepfar." Uthe noma engakatholakali ozofaka isandla ekuxhaseni ingxenye ebifakwa wuhulumeni waseMelika, kodwa sebeye iSouth African National AIDS Council, iye kwiNational Lotteries Commission, iyofuna ifake isandla. Uveze ukuthi unethemba ukuthi lezi zinhlelo zizothela izithelo. "NoNgqongqoshe wezeSayensi usesungule ithimba elizomluleka ngezinto ezithinta ucwaning nezinye. Asihleli nje emuva kokuhoxiswa koxhaso kodwa kuningi esikwenzayo."Uveze nokuthi mhlawumbe ukuhoxa kweMelika kuzovula amehlo elakuleli ukuthi lizimele lingathembeli kwamanye amazwe ngezinto ezithinta uxhaso nemali.Uphinde waveza ukuthi uhulumeni ukhathazekile ngesihlava sokuhlukunyezwa kwezingane nabesifazane. Uthe uyahambisana nokuthi kuhlolwe kabanzi abantu abasebenza nezingane ukuthi abakaze balahlwe amacala okuzihlukumeza."Ngiyahambisana nokuthi kubhekwe ohlwini lwabantu asebeke balahlwa amacala emabhukwini agcinwa ngumnyango wezobuLungiswa. Lokho kuzokwenza ukuthi kungaqashwa abantu asebeke bahlukumeza izingane," usho kanje.
UKHOMISHANA wamaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLiet General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi usetuse izincomo abazithola emalungwini omphakathi wasezifundazweni zomsebenzi abawenzayo wokulwa nobugebengu. Uthi kungenye yezinto ezikhuthaza yena nethimba aliholayo lengalo yomthetho ukuqhubeka aqinise isandla kosikhwili phambana nobhoko, abephula umthetho.UMkhwanazi usho njalo ekhuluma esithangamini sabezindaba abesenze kuleli sonto ukuzobhunga ngesimo sezamaphoyisa nezomthetho esifundazweni, lapho afike wadalula khona ukuthi ukunconywa wumphakathi ngomsebenzi abawenzayo kuyabakhuthaza.Uthe bayazibona izincomo zomphakathi ngemibhalo enamekwa nefakwa njalo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ukuncoma umsebenzi owenziwa ngamaphoyisa uma kubikwa ngezigameko ezithile zobugebengu ezisuke zingenelele kuyona ukusiza umphakathi. "Sekukaningi sithola izincwadi esithunyelelwa zona nezingcindo sithintwa, sibongwa ngomsebenzi omuhle esiwenzayo wokuvikela umphakathi esiwuholayo, okwenza sigqugquzeleke ikakhulu ngoba sijwayele ukugxekwa njalo ngamabatha enzeka emsebenzini wethu. Konke lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi ukuzibophezela kwethu ukuqeda nya ngobugebengu kuthela izithelo njengoba sibona kwenzeka nje,” kusho uMkhwanazi.Eqhuba, uthe ukuzikhandla kwabo ngomsebenzi nsuku zonke kufakazelwe wukuncipha kwezikhalo zokungenzi umsebenzi ngendlela efanele ngo-697 kusuka ku-3 754 kuya ku-3 057, wathi bazibophezele ukuqhubeka nokwenza kube ngcono kakhulu kunalokho."Onyakeni wezimali u-2024/25, ibalelwa kuR3.3 billion ekhokhelelwe izikhalo ezisuke zifakelwe ukungenzi kahle kwamaphoyisa, okuthe uma ithimba lethu lezomthetho selicubungula, sagcina sikhokhe uR154 million kuphela. Nalokho kuyimali enkulu kabi, okudingeka siqhubeke sisebenze kanzima ukuyehlisa kakhulu,” usho kanje.UKhomishana udalule nokuthi banezinhlelo abazenzayo zokuhlangana nomphakathi, ukuqhubeka kubhungwe ukuthi kungasetshenziswana kanjani ukulwa nokuthi kuqotshwe ubugebengu. Ukhuthaze amalungu omphakathi esifundazweni ukukhuthala ukuyihambela ukuze abe yingxenye yezinqumo ezithathwayo nezinhlelo zokuvunyelwana ukwenziwa.
OWAYEYIBAMBA lo mqondisi wophiko lwezokushushisa KwaZulu-Natal u-Adv Simphiwe Mlotshwa, usezomela bonke abalisa abahlanu abasolwa ecaleni lokubulawa kowayeyintandokazi yomrepha wakuleli zwe uKiernan Forbes, owayaziwa ngelika-AKA, nomngani wakhe owayewumpheki nosomabhizinisi odumile uTebello 'Tibz' Motsoane.Lokho kudalulwe yisekela lo mqondisi wophiko lwezokushushisa u-Adv Lawrence Gcaba, ngenkathi kubuye leli cala eNkantolo ePhakeme yaseThekwini, kulandela ukuthi mhla ligcina ukuhlala ngoFebhuwari, kwakumenyezelwe ukuthi liyasuka eNkantolo yeMantshi.UMlotshwa uzomela laba basolwa okungoMnuz Lindokuhle Thabani Mkhwanazi, Lindani Zenzele Ndimane, Siyanda Eddie Myeza, Mziwethemba Harvey Gwabeni noLindokuhle Lindo Ndimane, abavele kafushane enkantolo. Icala lihlehliselwe uJuni 12, ukuzoqhuba amalungiselelo okuqulwa kwalo.Ngaphambi kwalokhu, uMlotshwa ubemele uMkhwanazi noNdimande (Lindokuhle) kuphela, kuthi uMyeza yena wayemelwe uNkk Yolanda Gielink, bese kuthi uGwabeni noNdimande (Lindani) bona bebemelwe wuMnuz Joe Wolmarans.Laba balisa basolwa isigameko sokudutshulwa, kwafa u-AKA noTibs bengaphandle kwendawo yokudlela iWish, esemgwaqweni uFlorida, eThekwini ngoFebhuwari 10, 2023. Babekwe amacala amabili okubulala, elokuhlela itulo lokubulala, amahlanu okuzama ukubulala, amabili okutholakala nezibhamu nezinhlamvu okungekho emthethweni. UGcaba utshele inkantolo ukuthi ummeli uMnuz Sibusiso Dlamini, wuyena ozomela abasolwa, bese kuthi u-Adv Mlotshwa athathe imiyalelo kuyena. Uveze nokuthi bavumelene ngokuthi leli cala lihlehliswa ngenxa yokuthi uMlotshwa kudingeke ukuthi aye eSwatini, lapho okuqhubeka khona ukulalelwa kwesicelo sokuthi kubuyiswe kuleli zwe abanye abasolwa ababili abasolwa kuleli cala oMnuz Siyabonga Gezani Ndimande noMalusi Dave Ndimande, abavalelwe kuleliya lizwe.Umbuso waveza ukuthi uGwabeni walandela u-AKA nethimba ayehamba nalo besuka esikhumulweni sezindiza iKing Shaka, kwaze kwaba bafika ehhotela ababezolala kulona eMhlanga, eThekwini. Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi ngenkathi uGwabeni ezama ukufaka isicelo sebheyili kabusha, u-Adv Gcaba wamphikisa ngalokho, emnqoba ngokuthi banabo ubufakazi obuveza okwenzeka esikhumulweni sezindiza, nokuthi umbuso waveza izinsolo zokuthi uNdimande (Lindokuhle) wayekhona eWish ngesikhathi u-AKA esahleli ngaphakathi, wakhetha ukuhlala ngalapho ayezokwazi ukubona khona yonke iminyakazo ka-AKA nethimba ayehamba nalo. Umbuso wathi uNdimande wayelokhu ematasa ocingweni ebe edla, amehlo akhe engasuki nhlobo ku-AKA, okwathi ngenkathi sekudutshulwana ngaphandle, yena wasala ngaphakathi endaweni yokudlela, futhi wayengathukile nhlobo njengabanye.
USUKU lwango-10 Meyi 1994 luyohlala lusemlandweni weNingizimu Afrika njengoba kwabekwa esihlalweni umengameli wokuqala omnyama emva kweminyaka leli zwe laliqhoqhobelwe abamhlophe. Namuhla kuhlangana iminyaka engu-31 kwabekwa umengameli wokuqala wentando yeningi kuleli, uMnuz Nelson Mandela. Inhloso enkulu kaMandela ngaleli zwe kwakuwukubuyisana kwezinhlanga, ukwakha kabusha izwe nobumbano.Umbuzo omile owokuthi ngabe kukhona yini osekwenziwe ukufeza lezi zinhloso?Umhlaziyi wepolitiki uMnuz Thabani Khumalo, uthe elakuleli libukeka libuyela emuva kunokuba liye phambili.Uthe ngesikhathi sikaMandela kwagcina kusemiqondweni wazo zonke izakhamuzi zakuleli ukuthi kuhloswe ukuba kubuyiswane, kwakhiwe kabusha izwe futhi kube nobunye."Namuhla sibona liphezulu izinga lokucwasana ngokobuhlanga njengoba sibona nezinhlangano ezifana ne-Afriforum neSolidarity ziya emazweni angaphandle ziyothi abamhlophe abaphethwe kahle eNingizimu Afrika. Ubunye nokubuyisana sekwaphela, " kusho uKhumalo. Uthe ukwakhiwa kabusha kwezwe kufana nento engekho njengoba komasipala izinto zonakele. "Emigwaqeni uthi uzihambela uhlangane nendle, amanzi asiwatholi, ugesi besingenawo nezigebengu ziyazicanasela."Uthe laba khona ithemba kungena esihlalweni uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa njengoba kwakuthenjwa ukuthi uzoqeda inkohlakalo kodwa labuye lashabalala. Uqhube wathi inkohlakalo isekhona ngoba asiqinile isandla nomgomo owawubekwe i-ANC wokuthi obhekene namacala enkohlakalo kufanele ashenxe esikhundleni awusebenzi kunalokho wawubekelwe ukukhahlelana. "Sizithola sesibuyela kuGNU engafani neyakuqala eyayakhelwe lezi zinhloso ezithathu. Eyamanje yakhelwe izinhloso eziningi okungaba ukujezisa iqembu ebelibusa noma ukukhombisa ukungabethembi osopolitiki," esho. UKhumalo uthe inkinga leli zwe elibhekene nayo osopolitiki abafuna ukuzinothisa bona bakhohlwe izakhamuzi ingakho abantu sekufanele basukume baziphathele izwe. Uthe lokhu kungenzeka ngokuthi izinhlangano zomphakathi zibandakanywe ekuphathweni kwezwe. Umhlaziyi uqhube wathi amalungu omphakathi kufanele azidalele wona amathuba omsebenzi akhohlwe ukuthembela kosopolitiki. Uthe sekuyisikhathi sokubizwa kwesithangami sikazwelonke uMengameli Ramaphosa ayekhulume ngaso lapho kuzohlangana abamabhizinisi, izinhlangano zomphakathi nezinye izinhlaka ukubonisana ukuthi kungayiwa kanjani phambili kulungiswe izwe. "Iseluleko sami ukuthi osopolitiki abaphucwe amandla kunikwe izinhlangano zomphakathi abantu baziphathele izwe.Ngendlela abantu abavote ngayo okhethweni ngonyaka odlule kukhombisile ukuthi sebelilahlile ithemba kosopolitiki," kusho uKhumalo. Emva kukaMandela kwangena esihlalweni uMengameli Thabo Mbeki ngo-1999 kuya ku-2008 owakhishwa engakaliqedi ihlandla lesibili kwangena uMengameli Kgalema Motlanthe ngo-2008 kuya ku-2009, walandela uMengameli Jacob Zuma ngo-2009 kuya ku-2018 naye ongaliqedanga ihlandla lakhe lesibili. Ngo-2018 izintambo zathathwa uMengameli Ramaphosa osasesihlalweni namanje.
IZOFAKELWA izibuko eyezinyanga KwaZulu-Natal, eziqinisa izigebengu eziyingxenye yobelelesi obudla lubi esifundazweni. Kuzokuba nomhlangano wabelaphi bendabuko KwaZulu-Natal lapho izobhekisiswa ngeso elibanzi indaba yabelaphi abasiza izinswelaboya. Lokhu kuvezwe undunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba. UNtuli usanda kuba nomhlangano wokubhunga ngobugebengu lapho abelaphi bendabuko bezivumele khona ukuthi nabo banesandla ekubhebhethekeni kobugebengu esifundazweni."Abelaphi bendabuko bazivumele bona ukuthi banesandla ekubhebhethekeni kodlame. Bashilo ukuthi ezinye izigebengu ziyafika kubona, bazigcabe."UNtuli uthe lezi zilelesi eziqiniswa yizinyanga, zigcina sezisebenzisa indluzula, kwesinye isikhathi zigcine zidubulana namaphoyisa ngoba nakhu zinenkolelo yokuthi ngeke zidubuleke. "Abanye baba nenkolelo yokuthi uma begcabile ngeke baze badubuleke. Lena yinkolelo nje. Izinyanga zinikeza abantu amandla abangenawo."UNtuli uthe umhlangano wabelaphi bendabuko wokubhunga ngalolu daba uzokuba khona maduze."Abelaphi bendabuko bazicelele bona ukuba nomhlangano walolu hlobo, lapho bezokhuluma kabanzi ngalolu daba. Sizowuhlela lo mhlangano ngoba siyakholelwa ukuthi uzolekelela kakhulu emkhankasweni wokulwa nobugebengu esifundazweni." Umelaphi wendabuko oke waphatha inhlangano yabelaphi, uMnuz Sazi Mhlongo, uthe inkinga enkulu idalwa wukuthi ayikho imithetho elawula ukusebenza kwabelaphi bendabuko."Silinyazwa kakhulu wuMnyango wezeMpilo. Umnyango kufanele ugcobe umkhandlu wabelaphi bendabuko ozokwazi ukuvakashela izigodlo. Le mpi sesiyilwe iminyaka engu-15. Abelaphi bendabuko nabo kufanele babe nemigomo abayibekelwe. Othisha namanesi banemigomo abayibekelwe njengoba besebenza. Yingakho ngithi sifuna ukuthi kube nomkhandlu ozoqapha ukusebenza kwezinyanga ukuze sazi ukuthi la bantu bangabelaphi ngempela noma bangabathakathi."UMhlongo uthe baningi abelaphi abangayilandeli imigomo. "Kukhona abelaphi mbumbulu njengoba kukhona nabefundisi mbumbulu. Abelaphi mbumbulu yibona abasifaka kule nkinga yokusiza izigebengu. Abanye babo bayizigebengu njengoba kukhona namaphoyisa ayizigebengu."UMhlongo uphinde wakhala nangoqhibukhowe bezinhlangano zabelaphi bendabuko."Kufanele kube nenhlangano eyodwa yabelaphi bendabuko. Lapha eNingizimu Afrika kunenqwaba yezinhlangano zabelaphi bendabuko. Ezinye zalezi zinhlangano ziphethwe emazweni angaphandle. Umuntu umuzwa ethi eyami inhlangano iphethwe eMalawi. "
BAHLEKA bodwa abanikazi bezindawo zokungcebeleka eThekwini njengoba kulindeleke ukuthi abalandeli bebhola abazobuka umdlalo wamanqamu ophakathi kwezinkunzi zaseSoweto, iKaizer Chiefs ne-Orlando Pirates, basebenzise izigidi zamaRandi kuleli dolobha.UMphathiswa wezokuThuthukiswa koMnotho KwaZulu-Natal, uMfu Musa Zondi, uthe umdlalo wamanqamu eNedbank Cup ufake u-R24 million emnothweni waseThekwini.Amakhosi nezikaMagebhula bazotholana enkundleni iMoses Mabhida, kusasa. UZondi uthe kuzokube kuphithizela eThekwini ngenxa yalo mdlalo weNedbank Cup."Abanye abantu bangathatha nje sengathi wumdlalo webhola nje kuphela. Iqiniso ukuthi lo mdlalo uzolekelela ukufukula ezokuvasha kanye nomnotho. Uma ubala imali ezongena emnothweni waseThekwini kule mpelasonto, iningi kakhulu uma uyiqhathanisa nemali engenayo uma kuyizimpelasonto nje."UZondi uthe kuzohlomula kakhulu abaqashisa ngezindawo zokulala kanye nabanezindawo zobumnandi. "Laba abasihlanganisela izibalo bathi abantu abazohambela eThekwini kule mpelasonto ngeke basebenzise imali engaphansi kuka-R24 million. Lapha kubalwa abantu abazokuba sezindaweni zokudla, ezobumnandi kanye nasenkundleni."UZondi uthe izindawo zokulala eziningi eziseThekwini sezigcwele."Uma uthi ufuna indawo yokulala bakutshela ukuthi khohlwa. Indawo usungaze uyithole le kude. Isasasa likhulu kakhulu njengoba abantu beqhubeka nokubekisa izindawo zokulala." UZondi ugqugquzele ukuziphatha kahle kulabo abazobe behambele umdlalo, wanxusa nokubambisana nezinhlaka zokuphepha.UZondi uthe kulihambela kahle iTheku kwezokuvakasha kulezi zinsuku njengoba eveze ukuthi kunemihlangano emibili ekuleli dolobha, ezohanjelwa abantu abaqhamuka emazweni angaphandle.Uthe kunomhlangano wongqongqoshe bamazwe angaphansi kweG20 okule mpelasonto. "Lo mhlangano omkhulu uzodonsa izinsuku ezine. Uzohanjelwa ongqongqoshe abaqhamuka emazweni angu-20. Ongqongqoshe abahambi bodwa kodwa bahamba nabeluleki babo."UZondi the ngesonto elizayo kuzoba ne-Africa Travel Indaba."Lokhu kusho ukuthi kuzokuthi kuphuma labo abebeze emhlanganweni weG20 kanye nalabo bebhola, bese kungena abaze kwi-Tourism Indaba. Ngingasho nje ukuthi kulihambela kahle iTheku kwezokuvakasha njengoba isibalo sezivakashi sinyuke ngo-100 000 ngamaholidi ePhasika uma siqhathanisa nangonyaka owedlule. Nangamaholidi kaDisemba nakhona senyukile isibalo sabantu abavakashele eThekwini. Kubalulekile ukuthi umnotho weTheku siwufukule ngoba uma kungawa iTheku sonke isifundazwe singaguqa."
USALE ushaqekile umphakathi waseMachobeni eNanda kulandela ukuthelwa ngoyaba lwezinhlamvu kukathisha, uNkk Slindile Lushaba uMaButhelezi, nomyeni wakhe, uMfu Lushaba (elingatholakalanga igama lakhe). Isolezwe lithole ukuthi uNkk Lushaba (38), obefundisa uGrade 4 eMatikwe Primary, uqhululwe ngentululwane yezinhlamvu ezingu-24 kwathi uLushaba (38) yena wathelwa othulini ngezintathu. Lesi sigameko senzeke phambi kwezingane zabo ngoMsombuluko.Okhulumela amaphoyisa aKwaZulu-Natal, uCaptain Ntathu Ndlovu, usiqinisekisile lesi sigameko. UCaptain Ndlovu, uthe amaphoyisa aseNanda aphenya icala lokubulawa kwabantu ababili nelokubanjwa kwenkunzi emzini oseMachobeni "lapho izidumbu ezimbili okungesendoda nesowesifazane, okukholakala ukuthi baneminyaka ewu-38, zitholwe zidindilizile ngaphakathi endlini.Uthe kusolwa ukuthi amadoda amabili angaziwa angene endlini maqede aqhulula ngenhlamvu ebhekise kubagilwa futhi antshontsha ezinye izimpahla ngaphambi kokukhala amaphepha endaweni yesigameko. UMASIPALA weTheku usuqhamuke nesu eliwumthobanhliziyo kubahlali baseThekwini, namaphethelo abangakwazanga ukuthola amathikithi okubuka umdlalo obhekwe ngamehlo abomvu wamanqamu eNedbank Cup.Kulo mdlalo kuzotholana phezulu izinkunzi zaseSoweto, iKaizer Chiefs ne-Orlando Pirates, eMoses Mabhida Stadium, eThekwini ngo-3:30 ntambama kusasa.Abantu abaningi basale bencela izithupha futhi bedinwe beveva ezweni lonke ikakhulu abasesifundazweni KwaZulu-Natal, kulandela ukuhambela ubala ezitolo ezidayisa amathikithi ngoMsombuluko ekuseni, abanye baphantsha kwaze kwajama omakhalekhukhwini, bethi bazama ukuthenga amathikithi alo mdlalo - okugcine kuvele kuthi amathikithi abekanyelwe wona angaphezu kwa-40 000 adayise aphela ngehora nohhafu. Ukuzama ukududuza abantu abangawatholanga amathikithi alo mdlalo, uMasipala weTheku umemezele ukuthi uzobeka ama-fan park okubuka umdlalo mahhala kobhazabhaza bamathelevishini enkabeni yedolobha ukwenza kube mnandi kubalandeli bebhola lezinyawo.La ma-fan park amabili aklanywe wuMasipala azoba sepaki i-Albert, naseDurban Beachfront, ebhishi khona eThekwini okulindeleke ukuthi avulwe ngo-12 emini ukuqala amukele abantu abazofuna ukubuka ibhola ukusiza ukuthi kushaye isikhathi sokuqala komdlalo sekuhlelekile.UDkt Vusi Mazibuko wakumasipala weTheku, uqinisekise ukuthi ezokuphepha zizobe zibekwe eqhulwini kule mibuthwano ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abantu abazobe bezobuka umdlalo kuyona, bayaphepha kuze kuphele umdlalo. Uthe banethemba lokuthi lolu hlelo luzojabulisa abalandeli bebhola lezinyawo, wanxusa ukuthi bafike ngobuningi babo nemindeni yabo ukuzojabulela lomdlalo omkhulu nokubhekwe ukuthi kusiphuke izididndi kuwona sekubangwa umklomelo kaR7 million.
UBONA eyisikhali sesizwe esingasetshenziswa ukuzithuthukisa nokuyisa impilo yezakhamuzi phambili. Lowo nguDkt Ngogi Emmanuel Mahaye onguMqondisi eHhovisi loMphathiswa wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal ngoLwesithathu ophinde wafaka emgodleni wakhe wemfundo iziqu zePHD in Education Management.UMahaye ube ngomunye wabathweswe iziqu yiNyuvesi yasoNgoye. Amagalelo akhe kwezemfundo asuka kude njengoba azibonakalisa enguthishomkhulu waseVelangaye High, eNkandla, ngo-2003 eyagcina ibizwa ngeVelanganye Comprehensive Technical School sekufundiswa izifundo zobuChwepheshe, ubuNjiniyela, iSayensi yezoLimo nokunye okuningi okuwumlando emfundweni yakuleli ikakhulukazi ezikoleni zasemakhaya.Kulesi sikole kwakunabafundi abangu-278 nothisha abangu-7 futhi zingekho izinsiza ezanele. Lesi sikole sagcina sesinolimi isiFrench njengesinye sezifundo. Siyaziwa kakhulu ngokukhiqiza imiphumela ka-matric emihle kanye nezifundiswa esezifunde zagogoda. UMahaye akagcini kulesi sikole, uyaziwa ngamagalelo akhe kwiSayensi esaseBizimali High khona eNkandla, nayo ekhiqiza imiphumela ka-matric emihle. Ngenxa yamava akhe ubonwe wuMnyango wezeMfundo lapho esesebenze khona nabaPhathiswa abahlanu kusukela ngo-2014.Ekhuluma ngeziqu azizuzile, uthe lokhu kusho lukhulu kuyena, emphakathini, esizweni sakwaMahaye nesakwaMpungose, eNkandla, lapho adabuka khona.Uthe lezi ziqu ziwumnikelo esizweni. "Mina ngiwutho nesikhali isizwe esingakusebenzisa. Ekufundeni kwami nganginombono wesizwe futhi engikwenzile kungaphezulu kweziqu engizitholile kodwa kuwukugqugquzela abantu ukuba bazithuthukise ngolwazi ngoba isikhathi sanamhlanje sinezinselelo eziningi ezidinga ukuthi umuntu abe nolwazi, " kusho uMahaye osebhale izincwadi nemibhalo eminingi esezingeni lomhlaba.Phakathi kweziqu zemfundo asezizuzile kubalwa iDiploma in Education, Diploma in School Management, Certificate in School Management,, BTECH, ACE, BED Hon, MED-EM, PhD-EM nePhD ELMP asayenza.Ngaphandle kokubamba iqhaza kwezemfundo, uMahaye uhlala emabhodini ahlukene okubalwa ele-Anton Lembede Maths and Science Academy, uyisikhulu esiphezulu seDr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Foundation, unguSihlalo we-Isiqabetho Senhlalamafini Critical Thinkers ngaphansi kweNazareth Baptist Church eBuhleni, lapho ekhonza khona. Lolu hlaka luhlanganise izincithabuchopho zebandla ukuthuthukisa ulwazi. NaseNkandla ubambe iqhaza kwezentuthuko. Le ncithabuchopho ikusho kugcwale umlomo ukuthi iyakuzonda ukuthi abantu abamnyama ikakhulukazi basemakhaya babukelwe phansi."Inkinga enkulu wukuthi yithina uqobo esizibukela phansi futhi yilowo mqondo kufanele silwe nawo. Kufanele sinike isizwe ithemba," kusho yena.Ephawula ngezinga lemfundo namhlanje, uthe likhulu ithemba lokuthi isemgudwini okahle kodwa ngeke kwaphikwa ukuthi zikhona izinselelo ezinye zazo ezidalwa yizimo zamazwe omhlaba. Nakuba ephumelele kodwa uthi ziningi izinselelo adlule kuzona okubalwa ukusebenza ezikoleni ezingenazo izinsiza, ukufunda ebe esebenza, ukungalali efunda noma ecwaninga, ukungakutholi ukwesekwa okwanele ngokwemali uma ehambela amazwe eyokwenza ucwaningo nokuthi ashebe isikhathi somndeni wakhe nemfundo.UMahaye uganwe wuMaNxumalo wasebukhosini bakwaDlomo, babusiswa ngabantwana abane. Ephetha, uthe: "Ngibonga ukwesekwa abezindaba abayikhulisile impilo yami konke abebekusho kimi bengikuthatha kunjalo ngibheke indlela engingakusebenzisa ngayo ukuya phambili."Ubonge nabafundi bezikole adlule kuzona athe nabo babambe iqhaza elikhulu empumelelweni yakhe.
IYINDABA egudwini emalungwini omphakathi waseXobho eyabangani okuthiwa babe nengxabano ebishubile kubangwa intombi kwaze kwagcina sekuphuma isidumbu.Umsolwa (44), ogama lakhe ligodliwe ngoba engakaboshwa, kuvela ukuthi ugwaze wabulala umngani wakhe omkhulu uMnuz Zwelibanzi Makhathini (36). Lesi sehlakalo esishaqise umndeni kamufi senzeke ngoMsombuluko.Umthombo olwazi ukusuka nokuhlala lolu daba, ocele ukungavezwa uthe umnyombo wengxabano uqale ngemuva kokuba umsolwa ethole ukuthi uMakhathini umudla izithende ujola nowesifazane amlobole ngoDisemba nyakenye. Umthombo uthe akucaci ukuthi umsolwa lolu daba uluthole kanjani kodwa ufike esitolo engasadle nkobe zamuntu, wafica kunabesilisa ebebedlala i-snooker wase ebizela uMakhathini eceleni.''Umbuzile ukuthi kungani emenza isiphukhuphu nokuthi kungani avuma ukuba yingxenye yabakhongi ngonyaka odlule ekubeni azi kahle ukuthi lo muntu okuyiwa kuyena ubabhangqile?" Uqhuba umthombo uthe ube esemqala ngempama wamlandelisa ngesibhakela. ''Kulapho ke ezwakale esexolisa khona ethi yiphutha naye angazi ukuthi lenzeka kanjani,'' kusho umthombo.Ngemuva kokugonyululuka kwakhe kanjalo umthombo uthe umsolwa ukhiphe ummese wamgwaza entanyeni uMakhathini wase ebaleka.''Uphelele endleleni sithi sizama ukumphuthumisa emtholampilo. Inkinga wukuthi ubopha kakhulu njengoba emgwaze entanyeni inxeba elivulekile,'' usho kanje.Uqhuba umthombo uthe lesi sigameko siwushiye ubambe ongezansi umphakathi ngoba bangabangani abadala. Omunye womndeni kamsolwa ocele ukuba kugodlwe igama lakhe, uthe laba baqala ukuzwana bengamabhobhodleyana befunda ndawonye.''Indlela ebebezwana ngayo asikaze sicabange ukuthi le nto yabo ingagcina iphela kabuhlungu kanje. Namanje asiyikholwa into esiyibone yenzeka,'' usho kanje.Isihlobo sikamufi, uMnuz Zakhele Makhathini, sithe bathole umbiko wokuthi mabaphuthume esitolo ngoba umfowabo usegwaziwe. UMakhathini uthe nabo kubethusile ukuzwa sebefikile ukuthi ugwazwe wumuntu abezwana naye."Besazi ukuthi sonke lesi sikhathi ungumngani wakhe wokuqina. Ngikutshela ukuthi namanje akukavumi ukuba ngikholwe ukuthi ngempela umfowethu impilo yakhe ithathwe ngumuntu abemkhonze kangaka ehlale ekhuluma ngaye lapha ekhaya,'' usho kanje.Uthe kodwa uma kuyiqiniso ukuthi umfowabo ubejola ngempela nentombi kamsolwa, ngokwenza kanjalo wonile ngokuphindiwe. ''Ngeke size sikufihle ukuthi wonile ngoba nakhu eseshonile,'' usho kanje.Siye koshicilela amaphoyisa engakaphenduli, kanti umsolwa kuthiwa usagcwele amathafa.

NGIYAZI ukuthi kunemindeni eminingi kodwa othola ukuthi ngenxa yesimo somnotho esintengayo bazithola sebehlala endlini encane noma enganele ukuthi izingane zingaba negumbi lazo lokulala, abanye uthola ukuthi bahlala emkhukhwini ngenxa yaso njalo isimo.Akunankinga lokho ngiyaqonda ukuthi akuvelwa kanye kanye kungemadlebe embongolo, kodwa namhlanje ngifisa kubhekwe kabanzi le nto yokuya ocansini endlini eyodwa enilala kuyo nezingane. Ngifisa abazali bazijwayeze ukwenza ngenye indlela ukuze izingane zingagcini sezizwa umcimbi loyo osuke wenziwa, angisho ukuthi ningazijabulisi ngoba phela ayikho into enisuke ningayenza.Kodwa ngifisa nizame ukuthi uma nizijabulisa ngocansi izingane zingayizwa leyo nto enisuke niyenza ngoba izingane zanamhlanje ave zihlakaniphile into ziyibamba njengoba injalo.Sikhule emakhaya lapho khona ingane ibithi ingakhula ihambe iyolala nogogo okanye iyolala nezinye kwenye indlu ngoba bekwenzelwa ukuthi ingayizwa le nto esuke yenziwa abantu abadala.Ngifisa abazali benze imizamo yokuthi okungenani uma behlala endlini eyodwa nezingane bazilinde okungcono ziqale zizumeke futhi nakhona niqinisekise ukuthi zizumeke ngempela ngoba lezi zingane zanamhlanje ungazitshela ukuthi zilele kanti zibheke ngawo womabili.Ngifisa kube segazini kubazali ukuthi uma bezijabulisa esimeni esikanjalo abawubangi umsindo ozokwenza ukuthi kugcine sekuvuka izingane. Ngiyakuqonda ukuthi ukuya ocansini ucansi kuwumcimbi omnandi abanye okubahlulayo ukungawubangi umsindo,kodwa ngifisa konke ukuzijabulisa esikwenzayo singabazali siqinisekise ukuthi izingane azivuki okanye aziphazamiseki. Abanye uthola ukuthi ingane balala nayo embhedeni, kungakuhle uma nizijabulisa ingane niyindlalele phansi ukuze ingaphazamiseki. Okubi ngalokhu ukuthi izingane zanamhlanje ziyaxoxa kakhulu, yingakho uthola ukuthi izingane zizithola sezixoxa nezinye zixoxa ngezinto ezenziwa abantu abadala okufanele engabe ziyimfihlo.Ngifisa uma ikhona indlela izingane esezibona emehlweni zingayizwa imikhuba yethu esiyenzayo uma sizijabulisa.Kuhle ukuthi izingane sizihloniphe yikhona nazo zizosihlonipha, akuzwakali kahle uma ingane isihamba ixoxa ukuthi abazali bayo benzani ebusuku, ezinye izingane azigcini ngokuxoxa kuphela uma sezihleli nabangani bazo.Kodwa ziphinde zilingise lento ezisuke zibona abazali beyenza, leyo nto iyihlazo elikhulu kuthina bantu abamnyama futhi yenza nokuthi abazali baleyo ngane sibabuke ngenye indlela.Abanye baze bancamele nokuzivakashisa izingane ukuze bazijabulise kahle uma bebona ukuthi bampintshekile, nalokho kungcono kakhulu ukunokuthi izingane zibone indlela abazali abazijabulisa ngayo.Uma beya ocansinii.kuhle ukuthi izingane zihlale ziyizingane, kuthi noma seziqala ukuganga kodwa nathi bazali singabi nomthelela kulokho. Izingane azilale nogogo bakwethu. Ngelinye ilanga ngadumala kabi ngizwa inkulumo eqoshiwe lapho ingane yayixoxa khona ukusuka nokuhlala ngendlela abazali bayo abazijabulisa ngayo,isho nokuthi izigcina ilele phakathi nendawo kodwa uma isiphaphama iphaphama isilele eceleni. Uyabona ukuthi lowo muntu usehlakaniphe ngokwanele ngoba usekwazi nokuxoxa izindaba ezinkulu. Ebese kubakhona labosisi abangashadile othola ukuthi bazithandanela nobhuti nje futhi umuntu uzihlalela emqashweni nengane yakhe.Esimeni esikanjalo kungakuhle sisi wami kube uwena ogaxa isikhwama uyovakashela isoka lakho ukuze izingane zingazi ukuthi kwenzekani.Asizifundise ukuhlonipha abantwana bethu, singayi ocansini kuze kuphaphame izingane.Abanye abahlala emqashweni bancamela ukuzijabulisa emini izingane zingekho zisesikoleni.nalokho futhi kungcono kakhulu, kanti abanye bayazigxosha bathi aziyodlala yikhona bezokwazi ukwenza izinto zabo kahle.Yiba umzali oqotho enganeni yakho,kumele sazi ukuthi kunezinto ekungamele zibonwe yizingane isikhathi singakafiki.angikholwa ukuthi ukhona umzali ofisa ukuthi ingane yakhe ihambe ixoxa ngaye ngekuzwile okanye ekubonile. Asizihlonipheni thina siphinde sihloniphe nabantwana bethu,singavumeli izinkanuko zethu zenze sikhohlwe ukuthi ingane iyohlezi iyingane.
INkantolo yesiFunda yaseQumrha igwebe lowo owayeyiphoyisa usayitsheni, uThembalethu Gqeku (50) iminyaka engu-20 ebhadla ejele ngecala lokudlwengula owesifazane oneminyaka engu-17 engaphakathi ehhovisi labaseshi esiteshini samaphoyisa eKei Mouth ngo-Agasti 8 2022. Ngosuku lwesigameko, uGqeku owayesemsebenzini eshayela imoto yombuso walanda isisulu esitolo esiseduze kulelo dolobha. Wasithatha wenza sengathi uzothatha isitatimende kuso ngecala lodlame lwasekhaya elalivulelwe owayeyisoka laso. "Esengaphakathi ehhovisi, uGqeku wavala umnyango wakudlwengula le ntokazi encane ngomzimba phezu kwetafula. Le ntokazi yakwazi ukuzilwela, yamlimaza ekhanda isebenzisa ibhodlela elingenalutho, yagijima yaya e-charge office ihayiza." Wamkhomba umsolwa kodwa, ngokudabukisayo, ozakwabo ababesemsebenzini okuhlanganisa nowayeyibamba lomphathi siteshi ngaleso sikhathi bahluleka ukubopha. Kubikwa ukuthi elinye iphoyisa lagcona isisulu, labuza ukuthi sesiphinde sadla izidakamizwa yini. Waze waboshwa ngemuva kwezinsuku eziyishumi ngabe-Independent Police Investigative Directorate (IPID).Ngesikhathi kuqhubeka icala, uGqeku waliphika icala ethi uyena owaba yisisulu sokushaywa yisisulu esasidle kakhulu izidakamizwa. Nokho, uMshushisi omkhulu wombuso, uThango Pangalela ubehola ubufakazi bommangali, iphoyisa elilodwa ebelisemsebenzini kanye nongoti wezempilo iCecilia Makhiwane, iThuthuzela Care Centre (TCC). Ngokuphenya ngemibuzo ngobuchule, umbuso ukwazile ukuphikisa okuashiwo ummangalelwa. Umbiko wezempilo othunyelelwe wumbuso nawo Uveze ukuthi azikho izimpawu zokusetshenziswa kwezidakamizwa ngummangali.
KUBATSHAZWA unya nesihluku kowesilisa waseNkemba, eNdwedwe, osolwa ngokushaya owesifazane (36) anengane naye, ekubeni asahlakuna naye ongowaseNdlwedwe, eZibomvini, maqede wamdlwengula ezesekela ngokuthi njengoba enengane naye, unelungelo laphakade lokwenza noma yini afuna ukuyenza kuyena njengoba bezoze bahlukaniswe wukufa.Lokho kuvezwe ngomunye womndeni walona wesifazane, esiligodlile igama lakhe ukuze bavikeleke, elilandisa Isolezwe ngalesi sigameko okuthiwa senzeke ngoLwesine olwedlule ntambama, ngesikhathi behlangene edolobheni oThongathi, enyakatho yeTheku, ukuyohola isibonelelo sikahulumeni, bese kuhlanganiselwa ukuthenga izicathulo zesikole zengane yabo yentombazane (10).Kuthiwa nakuba sekuyisikhathi eside bahlukana kodwa bayaxhumana ngoba bahlanganiswe yingane, kanti ngaphezu kwalokho, umsolwa ubeke afike ekhaya lalona wesifazane ukuzobona ingane, kokunye angene ngoshova - ethi ngeke bamenze lutho, angenza noma yini ayithandayo kwabomndeni wonina wengane yakhe ongasenabazali. "Mina ngifonelwe wudadewethu omdala ngoLwesine ebusuku, engitshela ukuthi uSisi ulokhu ehambe eya ezitolo ekuseni, akakabuyi - ucingo lwakhe lukhala umlibe lungabanjwa. Kuze kwasa engabuyanga, saba nokuthi mhlawumbe kukhona lapho ebambeke khona, uzobuya ngakusasa, singazi ukuthi usesenkingeni enjena emvelele."Uma esesilandisa, uthi kwathi sebeqede konke ababeyokuthenga edolobheni, umsolwa esikhundleni sokuthi ashiye udadewethu esangweni lasekhaya njengenjwayelo uma bekade behlangene, wadlula naye ngemoto, eyishaya izule wazo wayofika naye kubo ngenkani, engafuni ukumdedela ehle endleleni," kulandisa owomndeni.Eqhuba, uthe kuthe sebefike kubo kwamsolwa - ohlala yedwa isikhathi esiningi - kwaqhubeka ingxabano yabo, umsolwa washaya lona wesifazane ngezibhakela, waze waba mabokoboko, wavaleka amehlo womabili, maqede wamdlwengula ubusuku bonke. "Ekuseni wazama ukuzenza umuntu omzwelayo, exolisa ngento ayenzile, waze wamthengela namaphilisi ezinhlungu endleleni esemphindisela ekhaya, ezitshela ukuthi ngeke amvulele icala ngalokho. Konke lokhu sibona kusayindlela yakhe yokusihlukumeza ngoba azi ukuthi ekhaya akunamuntu omdala ongasimela nongasilwela njengoba singamantombazane wodwa, abazali bengasekho. Sikhathazekile nangokuthi sekuze kuyophela isonto lonke engaboshiwe, osekwenza sikholwe wukuthi kusho ukuthi wayeqinisile ngenkathi ethi wazi abantu, ngeke aboshwe wumuntu ngisho kungenzakalani," usho kanje.Kuvele nokuthi ngempelasonto, kufike umfowabo kamsolwa kubo kwalona wesifazane, eyozama ukumcelela uxolo, ethi le ndaba ayidlule, kungavunyelwa ukuthi ingenwe ngabomthetho. Kuthiwa kwale ngisho esethi bazogeza umuzi ngenkomo, ukuzama ukushweleza nokwedlulisa umonakalo owenzekile kepha bamchitha.Kuthintwa okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uCaptain Ntathu Ndlovu, uqinisekise ukuthi amaphoyisa asesiteshini esisoThongathi, aphenya icala lokudlwengula mayelana nalesi sigameko."Kusolwa ukuthi umsolwa wagibelisa umgilwa emotweni yakhe kodwa wamenqabela ukwehla lapho ayefuna ukwehla khona, wamphoqa ukuya egunjini lakhe lokulala, wase emdlwengula khona," kusho uCapt Ndlovu.
ABAHOLI be-ANC esifundeni iNokuhamba Nyawo, babhekene ngeziqu zamehlo kubangwa eyezinkinga ezikhungethe uMasipala uMkhanyakude.Abaholi be-ANC Youth League (ANCYL) esifundeni iNokuhamba Nyawo, bathibelene nobuholi be-ANC obuphethe umasipala wesifunda.Abaholi be-ANCYL bafuna izimpendulo ngenkinga yamanzi ekhungethe izindawo ezingaphansi kwalo mkhandlu, baphinde benze izinsolo zokungaphathwa ngendlela kwemali yomkhandlu. Muva nje abaholi be-ANCYL basabise ngisho nangokuthi bazowuvala lo mkhandlu uma bengazitholi izimpendulo ezigculisayo kwabakhala ngakho.UNobhala we-ANCYL eNokuhamba Nyawo, uMnuz Makhosonke Maphanga, uthe umasipala uyehluleka ukuhambisela abantu amanzi."Abantu abawatholi amanzi. Kunezinhlelo eziningi zokuhanjiswa kwamanzi ogcina uzwa kukhulunywa ngazo uma zisethulwa, kodwa sigcine zingaqedwanga. Ezindaweni eziningi amapayipi agcina esala kanjalo eduze nomgwaqo, amanzi egcine engafakwanga." UMaphanga uthe okubakhathaza kakhulu ukuthi nakuba umkhandlu uhluleka ukuhambisa izidingo ebantwini kodwa uyaqhubeka nokusebenzisa ngokweqile isabelomali sawo.Isolezwe libone incwadi ebhalwe imenenja kamasipala, uMnuz Musawukhethi Nxumalo, ememezela uhlelo lokubopha izifociya kulo mkhandlu.Kule ncwadi ebhekiswe kubasebenzi uNxumalo uthi bakhethe ukuqala uhlelo lokubopha izifociya ngenxa yokushoda kwemali. UMaphanga uthe bafuna ukwazi ukuthi umasipala uyishonisephi imali oyabelwe njengoba usukhala ngokushodelwa imali ekubeni ungakapheli unyakamali."Kungani lo mkhandlu uqeda imali yonke imali ekubeni engakashayi uJulayi (wokungena kwesabelomali esisha)?"UMaphanga uthe usebabhalele abaholi bomkhandlu lapho khona efuna ukuthi baphendule ngalezi zinto, wathi bazowuvala umkhandlu uma bengatholi izimpendulo ezigculisayo. "Lo mkhandlu ungaphansi kweso lomlawuli. Sifuna nokwazi ukuthi yini lena eyenza ukuthi umasipala uhlale ngaphansi kweso lomlawuli. Yini lena eyenza ukuthi bangazilungisi izinkinga ezenze ukuthi umasipala ufakwe ngaphansi kweso lomlawuli?"UMaphanga uthe akaxabene nabaholi be-ANC abaphethe umkhandlu, wathi yena akufunayo izimpendulo nje kuphela.IMeya yomasipala, uMnuz Siphile Mdaka, ithe ayizazi zonke lezi zinto uMaphanga akhala ngazo, yathi ubengakaze ababikele. LINGENE shi esithandweni somlilo ibhodi lesikhwama esixhasa ngemali yokufunda ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme iNational Student Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS), ngezinkinga elizama ukuzixazulula ezizothatha isikhathi.Lokhu kuvezwe yibamba likaMqondisi jikelele emnyangweni weMfundo ePhakeme uDkt Marcia Socikwa, ekhuluma emhlanganweni wekomiti lasePhalamende izolo.Uthe ibhodi eliqale ukusebenza ngoFebhuwari nonyaka, linqwamane nezinkinga. Ibhodi lingene esithandweni somlilo ngenxa yezinkinga eziningi ezithinta izindawo zokuhlala izitshudeni, ukungakhokhwa kwemihlomulo yezitshudeni nokunye," usho kanje.Uthe lizama ngakho konke okusemandleni leli bhodi ukulungisa isimo nezinselelo ezikhona.USihlalo webhodi uDkt Karen Stander, uthe selokhu bengenile lunzima uhambo ababhekene nalo Uthe ezinsukwini ezingu-65 bengenile, kunzima basemlilweni, bayasha."Impela singabantu abasesithandweni somlilo. Kulo mhlangano kuvele ukuthi isikhwama siqoqe imali ebalelwa kuR850 million, eyakhokhwa emanyuvesi nasemakolishi amakhono amaTVET kungafanele.Uthe le mali ibuye ngenxa yokusebenzisana neSpecial Investigating Unit (SIU)."Imali ebuyile iyingxenye yemali enguR2 billion, eyahlonzwa yiSIU ukuthi kumele ibuye ezikhungweni ezehlukene. Amanyuvesi ahlukene abuyise enye yale mali akhokhelwa yona kungafanele." Kwamanye awo ubale eyaseFort Hare, eyasePretoria, iWitwatersrand neFree State."Le mali ibandakanya ukukhokhelwa imali ethe xaxa kungafanele, noma ukukhokha kabili. Senza konke okusemandleni ukubuyisa imali eyakhokhwa ngendlela engafanele," kusho uDkt Stander.Lesi sikhwama sisanda kunxusa omastende ukuthi bangabaxoshi abangakakhokhelwa. Indaba yokukhokhelwa komastende ihlale iyindaba egudwini minyaka yonke.Abanye omastende bagcine sebezikhomba indlela izitshudeni bekhala ngokuthi abakhokhelwe.Lesi sikhwama ekuqaleni konyaka sijube abasebenzi baso ezikhungweni ezehlukene ukuze balungise izinkinga nezikhalo zezitshudeni.
KUVELA ukuthi ubesongelwa usomabhizinisi waKwaMxhosa, KwaMaphumulo okuthiwa udutshulwe wabulawa ehamba nentombi yakhe.Umufi uMnuz Siphamandla Ngcobo (44), kuvela ukuthi udutshulwe ngabesilisa abangaziwa ngesikhathi ephuma esitolo sakhe, ehamba nentombi ngoLwesihlanu.Kuthiwa kwehle emotweni abesilisa abane behamba ngePolo, bambuza ukuthi abashongo yini ukuthi bazomthola kwathi uma ephendula umufi base beyaqala bamdubula waphelela khona lapho. Udadewabo kamufi uNksz Slindile Ngcobo, utshele Isolezwe ukuthi umufi ubulawa nje ubesongelwa abantu angabazi.Uveze ukuthi umufi ubenezitolo namakhaza kanti bese kuvamile ukuthi athole imiyalezo emsongelayo. Uthe kodwa bekungacaci ukuthi abamsongelayo ubangani nabo. "NgoLwesine olwedlule kade nginaye, kufone owesilisa wamtshela ukuthi uma engenzi okufanele lizoduma limthathe. Ngimbuzile ukuthi owesilisa ukhuluma ngani wathi naye akazi, udidekile ufana nami," echaza.Eqhuba uthe umufi uyibuzile indoda ebisocingweni ukuthi yini le okumele ayenze, yamphendula ngokuthi uyazi yena umufi. "Ubehlezi engitshela mina ukuthi usethola izingcingo ezimsabisayo kodwa ngingamnaki. Lezi zingcingo uma ngingaphosisi ziqale ukumhlupha ngonyaka odlule," kuchaza yena.Uthe ucingo lokuqala waluthola ngoKhisimusi, kufona owesilisa owathi uma engenzi okufanele uma kuqala unyaka, kuyacaca ukuthi lona wuKhisimusi wokugcina awudlayo.Uqhube wathi ngenxa yokwethuka, umufi akazange aphendule kodwa kunalokho wamane waluvala ucingo, wangenwa ngamanzi emadolweni. Ngesikhathi intatheli ibuza kuNksz Ngcobo ukuthi ngempela abazi yini ukuthi yini le nto obekuthiwa akayenze umufi, uthe naye udunguza ebumnyameni.Uthe umufi akanazo izitha wathi bafuna ligcine livelile iqiniso ukuthi ngubani obengenza into embi kanje kumfowabo.Kushaye esokushicilela amaphoyisa engayiphendulanga imibuzo athunyelelwe yona.
KULINDELEKE asifake ngoLwesibili oluzayo isicelo sebheyili, owesifazane osolwa ngokuthumba usana olunamasonto amabili luzelwe, ngenhloso 'yokuyobamba' ngalo isoka ebelingasamfuni. UNksz Nontando Bhodoza (21) uvele okokuqala eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini, kulandela ukuboshwa kwakhe ekubo kwesoka, e-Ext 3 khona eChesterville.Usana, u-Owami Sindane, umsolwa ubemebe ngeSonto, emjondolo kanina, uNksz Bongiwe Sindane (21) eNsimbini eCato Manor. UMshushisi woMbuso, uMnuz Ntshayintshayi (igama elingatholakalanga) ukubeke kwacaca ukuthi bazosiphikisa isicelo sebheyili uma umsolwa esesifaka ngesonto elizayo."Phakathi kwezinye izizathu esizosiphikisa ngazo wukuthi umsolwa angalibalekela icala uma ededelwa ngebheyi. Okwesibili, umphakathi ukhathazekile kulandela isigameko,” kusho uNtshayintshayi.IMantshi uNkk Vahed (igama elingatholakalanga) ube eselihlehlisela uLwesibili icala ukuze umsolwa afake isicelo sebheyili, nokuthi kuqhutshekwe nophenyo. Isolezwe lithole ukuthi umsolwa nonina wosana bahlangana okokuqala emtholampilo waseCato Manor ngo-Ephreli 24. Kuthiwa unina wosana wayelulethele umgomo wezinsuku eziyisithupha luzelwe, umsolwa akucaci ukuthi wayeyokwenzani.Kwavela ukuthi bagcina behambisana sekugodukwa, kanti umsolwa usezolokhu emvakashela nsuku zonke unina wosana emjondolo wakhe. Kuthiwa wafika ngoMgqibelo, njengenjwayelo, kodwa wagcina ecela ukulaliswa, ethi useyasaba ukugoduka njengoba kwase kunombikisho womphakathi uvale omunye wemigwaqo.Kwavela ukuthi ngeSonto, bavuka bazihlalela njengoba base bejwayelene, baze baphelezelana beyokhipha imali egaraji lendawo. Kuthiwa emva kwesikhashana bebuyile egaraji, unina wosana waphuma wayoneka izingubo kulayini wokuneka kwamakhelwane, wabuya umsolwa nosana bengasabonwa.Kwacingwa yonke indawo, lutho ukutholakala, kwaze kwabikwa emaphoyiseni, kwafakwa nasezinkundleni zokuxhumana ukuthi kukhona owesifazane owebe usana.Ngesikhathi esebanjwa ngoMsombuluko, kwavela ukuthi uthathe usana waya nalo ngqo kubo kwesoka (20), wafike wabatshela ukuthi usebelethile. Kuthiwa unina wesoka waxoxela umakhelwane wakhe ukuthi indodana yakhe isinengane, intombi ibelethile. Zamshiya nemibuzo lezi zindaba umakhelwane njengoba athi babebona ukuthi umsolwa akakhulelwe yize ayelokhu aqala ngonyaka odlule ukubelesela ngokuthi ukhulelwe.NgoMsombuluko ekuseni umakhelwane wazithela phezu kwesaziso ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, kufunwa usana olwebiwe eNsimbini. Wabe esenza indlela yokuthi unina wesoka alulethe kuye, wathwebula isithombe masinyane wasithumela kwabenkampani yonogada iReaction Unit South Africa (RUSA), eyayifake isaziso.Zamkhalela kanjalo isithombe sesithunyelwa kunina wosana, waqinisekisa ukuthi yingane yakhe.

Angikwazi ukukhuluma nani ngalolu daba."Okhulumela i-EFF kuzwelonke, uMnuz Sinawo Thambo, akazange awuphendule umyalezo awuthunyelwe.Ubuholi be-EFF KwaZulu-Natal bebuvele buhleli ngesinqa esisodwa kulandela ukungenzi kahle kwaleli qembu esifundazweni ngesikhathi kunokhetho lukazwelonke ngonyaka owedlule.
