KUVELA ukuthi unesikweletu sikaR1.7 billion uMnyango wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal, osanda kubhikishelwa osomabhizinisi abebebasela izikweletu zabo.Lokhu kuhlaluke empendulweni yoMphathiswa woMnyango, uNksz Nomagugu Simelane, lapho ebephendula khona umbuzo welungu le-DA esiShayamthetho s, uMnuz Tim Brauteseth.Kule mpendulo, uNksz Simelane uthe le sikweletu esangonyaka wezimali owedlule, wathi bazosikhokha uma sekungene isabelomali somnyango salo nyaka wezimali. NgoMsombuluko osomabhizinisi abangakhokhelwe bavale amahhovisi omnyango aseMgungundlovu, bafuna ngoshova imali abayikweletwa wumnyango.Impendulo kaNksz Simelane iveze ukuthi kule sikweletu kunemali esihlale isikhathi eside ingakhokhwa.Isikweletu umnyango osuhlale naso izinsuku ezingaphezulu kuka-90 singuR71 million, ukweleta izinkampani ezingu-1 519. Isikweletu umnyango osuhlale naso izinsuku eziphakathi kuka-60 kuya ku-90 singuR1.3 billion, ukweleta izinkampani ezingu-562.Isikweletu umnyango osuhlale naso izinsuku eziphakathi kwezingu-30 nezingu-60 singuR66 million.Ngokomthetho kahulumeni zonke izikweletu kufanele zikhokhwe zingakapheli izinsuku ezingu-30. UNksz Simelane uthe bayaye bezame ukukhokha zonke izikweletu zingakapheli izinsuku ezingu-30."Inkinga yemali esibhekene nayo yenze sangakwazi ukukhokha ngesikhathi. Zonke izikweletu zizokhokhwa kuwo lo nyaka wezimali."Okhulumela i-DA kwezeMpilo ophinde abe usihlalo wekomiti lezeMpilo esiShayamthetho, uDkt Imran Keeka, uthe izinkampani ezisafufusa yizona ezishayeke kakhulu ngale simo esiqhubeka emnyangweni. "Okuqaphelekayo wukuthi umnyango uyaye uthathe imali okufanele engabe ikhokhela abanye abantu, ukhokhele ngayo ezinye izikweletu. Lokhu kwenze ukuthi izinkampani eziningi zingakhokheleki ngesikhathi. Ngeshwa sibonile ngoMsombuluko abanikazi bezinkampani ezikweletwa wumnyango behlangene emahhovisi omnyango."UKeeka uthe ukuqalwa phansi kwesabelomali kuzokwenza ukuthi kubambezeleke ukukhokhelwa kosomabhizinisi.UNgqongqoshe wezeziMali uMnuz Enoch Godongwana, uzophinde ethule isabelomali ngoMeyi 21, bese kulandela izifundazwe. "Kuyoze kucace kahle uma sekwethulwe isabelomali sesifundazwe."UKeeka uthe bazoqhubeka nokuqapha ukusebenza kwemali yomnyango."Sizofuna ukuthi umnyango ulokhu usinikeza imibiko yokusebenza kwemali njalo emva kwezinyanga ezine. Sizophinde sifune nemibiko yokusebenza kwemali yasekupheleni konyaka. Okwamanje kunzima ukuthola le mibiko kodwa ngeke siphele amandla." Obehola umbhikisho wosomabhizinisi abangakhokhelwe, uMnuz Zethembe Ngcongo, uthe umnyango ubatshelile ngalesi sikweletu.UNgcongo uthe umnyango ubatshele ukuthi awunayo imali yokubakhokhela bonke."Isikhulu sezimali emnyangweni (uMnuz Khothamani Vilakazi) sisitshele ukuthi imali ekhona yokukhokhwa kwezikweletu ngu-R1.2 billion. Asazi ukuthi bazokhokhela abanjani, bayeke abanjani."
KUNENQWABA yabantu bokufika abasebenzisa izinsiza zeminyango kahulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal exakwe izikweletu yize besuke bengabaliwe ngesikhathi le minyango yabelwa imali.Iminyango wezeMfundo nowezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal, ithe kunenqwaba yabantu basemazweni angomakhelwane abasebenzisa izinsiza zayo.Abantu abaningi baqhamuka eSwatini naseLesotho bafunda ezikoleni baphinde basebenzise imitholampilo yakuleli esondelene nemingcele. Lokhu kushiwo abaphahiswa bale minyango ngesikhathi bekhuluma emva komhlangano weKhabhinethi yaKwaZulu-Natal izolo.UMphathiswa wezeMfundo, uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka, uveze ukuthi kunabafundi abangu-149 000 ezikoleni zesifundazwe abangenazo izitifiketi. UHlomuka uthe abanye babafundi abangenazo izitifiketi abasemazweni angaphandle. Uqhube wathi abanye balaba bafundi abanazo izitifiketi, bangabokuzalwa kuleli kodwa abanazo ngenxa yokuthi abazali bahlala emadolobheni akude.Uthe bonke abangenazo izitifiketi basuke bengabalwa ngesikhathi kwabiwa imali, wathi kodwa bayahlomula ezinsizeni zomnyango. UMphathiswa wezeMpilo, uNksz Nomagugu Simelane, naye uthe baningi abantu bangaphandle abasebenzisa izinsiza zomnyango. "Uma ubheka nje oPhongolo baseduze naseSwatini. Bahlukaniswe ucingo nje, ibanga elincane abalihambayo ukuze bafike kuleli. NabaseLesotho bavele baye eBergville."Yomibili le minyango ibhekene nenkinga yemali.UMnyango wezeMpilo ubhekene nesikweletu sika-R1.7 billion. UMnyango wezeMfundo wona ubhekene nenqinamba yokukhokhela ngesikhathi abaphakela izikole kanye nokufaka imali yezidingo zezikole. Othisha bakaGrade R nabo abazange bakhokhelwe ngesikhathi. Yomibili le minyango ibhekane nolaka losomabhizinisi abangakhokhelwe ngoMsombuluko. Osonkontileka abangakhokhelwe bavale amahhovisi oMnyango wezeMpilo, kwathi abanikazi bezinkampani eziphakela izikole bona baqhinqa emahhovisi oMnyango wezeMfundo. Abaphathiswa bale minyango bakhale ngokuphundlwa kwesabelomali bathi ikhona okubafake kule nkinga.UNksz Simelane uthe kule minyaka emine isabelomali somnyango siphundlwe ngo-R9 billion. Uthe isikweletu sabo siqale ukukhula kakhulu ngoNovemba."Yilapho siqale khona ukubhekana nenkinga okwenza ukuthi singakwazi ukukhokha zonke izikweletu zethu."UNksz Simelane uthe sebeqalile ukukhokhela izinkampani abazikweletayo. "Besifisa ukukhokha zonke izikweletu ekuqaleni kuka-Ephreli, kodwa kwaba nobuhixihixi ngesikhathi uMnyango wezeziMali kuzwelonke ushintsha uhlelo olusetshenziswa iminyango kahulumeni."UNksz Simelane uthe bazomisa ezinye izinhlelo zomnyango ukuze bezophuma kule nkinga yemali ababhekene nayo.UHlomuka naye uthe umnyango wakhe awuzange usinde ngesikhathi kuphundlwa isabelomali kule minyaka emine eyedlule. Uthe inkinga yemali iyona eyenza ukuthi kwesinye isikhathi umnyango wehluleke ukufaka imali yezikole.Uqhube wathi bayayilungisa inkinga yokungakhokhelwa kwabanye babantu abaphakela izikole.Uveze ukuthi abanye balaba bantu abaphakela izikole baletha imininingwane engaphelele. "Abanye baletha izinto ezingasayiniwe othishanhloko."UHlomuka uphinde wakhala ngokuthi sekukhona abantu abasebenzisa lolu daba ukulwa izimpi zezepolitiki.
Golden Arrows (0) 1Orlando Pirates (0) 2KUBONAKALE ngesikimu se-Orlando Pirates esiqale umdlalo wayizolo weBetway Premiership neLamontville Golden Arrows ukuthi umqondo womqeqeshi wayo, uJose Riveiro, usukowamanqamu weNedbank Cup abazowudlala neKaizer Chiefs ngoMgqibelo ngo-3.30 ntambama, eMoses Mabhida Stadium, eThekwini.I-Pirates efike emdlalweni we-Arrows ishayela phezulu kwazise inqobe ngo 2-1 kwiChiefs koweligi ngempelasonto edlule e-FNB Stadium, iwine ngamagoli kaPatrick "Tito” Maswanganyi noTshegofatso Mabasa.Ele-Arrows lokubika lishaywe uSiyanda Mthanti esiwombeni sesibili.Njengoba bekulindelekile, kunabadlali abaningi abamqoka uRiveiro abebaphumuzile kodwa ogqame kunabo bonke nguRelebohile Mofokeng osefomini kulezi zinsuku kodwa ubengekho ngisho ebhentshini. Omunye obengekho ngunozinti uSipho Chaine indawo yakhe ethathwe nguMelusi Buthelezi olizwa ngendaba ijezi kweZimnyama. UMofokeng ubengomunye wabekubhekiwe ukuthi lo mqeqeshi waseSpain uzobasebenzisa yini ngoba besengcupheni yokweqiwa owamanqamu weNedbank kwazise banamakhadi amathathu aphuzi.Bawuqalile umdlalo uThapelo Xoki noMaswanganyi abebesengcupheni efana nekaMofokeng kodwa kugqamile nokuphunyuzwa kukaDeon Hotto, Evidence Makgopa, Mabasa noMohau Nkota bonke abasefomini encomekayo kulezi zinsuku.Njengoba uThalente Mbatha noNkosinathi Sibisi bebengekho ngenxa yamakhadi kowe-Arrows, ukushintsha kwesikimu sePirates kuvulele abadlali abafana noBoitumelo Radiopane, Karim Kimvuidi, Yanga Madiba noButhelezi, ithuba lokuziveza kuRiveiro uma kungenzeka abadinge kowamanqamu ngoMgqibelo.Bekufanele ziye ekhefini i-Arrows isihamba phambili okungenani ngamagoli amathathu kodwa yadlala ngamathuba alula kulandelana. Lokhu bekufakazela okushiwo umqeqeshi we-Arrows, uManqoba Mngqithi, ngaphambi komdlalo."Amathuba siyawakha kodwa esikwenza uma sesibhekene nonozinti kuyesabeka futhi kuyaphoxa uma ngizokhuluma ngingahlonizi,” kusho uMngqithi kwiSuperSport.Akabuyanga esiwombeni sesibili uMakhehleni Makhaula obese enekhadi, indawo yakhe yathathwa uSimphiwe Selepe ongene nenhlanhla yegoli likaMaswanganyi.Ngaphambi komzuzu ka-60, uMthanti ulinganisele ngonyazi lwegoli alakhelwe uVelemseni Ndwandwe. Uyibuyisele ebuhleni iBucs uMabasa ngelakhe alishaye esanda kungena.Lo mphumela ugawulele iPirates isikweletu samaphuzu esele ngawo kwiMamelodi Sundowns embangweni wesicoco aba yisishiyagalombili yize la maqembu engalingani engemidlalo yeligi ewasalele.
IZINGQINAMBA ezibhekene noMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, ziholele ekutheni amalungu esiShayamthetho sesifundazwe afune umhlangano ophuthumayo lapho khona ehlela ukuwupheka ngebhodwe elincane.Sekubhalelwe obambe njengosihlalo wekomiti loMnyango wezeMfundo esiShayamthetho, uNksz Hlengiwe Mavimbela, bamcela ukuba abize umhlangano wekomiti ophuthumayo lapho khona umnyango uzophendula ngezinselelo eziholele ekutheni wehluleke ukukhokhela ngesikhathi izinkampani eziphakela izikole, othisha bakaGrade R, nokufaka ngesikhathi imali yezikole.Umnyango uzivika ngapha nangapha izinkinga. Kuleli sonto ubhekane nolaka lwabanikazi bezinkampani eziphakela izikole abakhala ngokungakhokhelwa.Abanikazi bezinkampani abebeqhinqe emahhovisi omnyango asezifundeni zaKwaZulu-Natal, bathe sebehlale isikhathi eside bengakhokhelwa. Kwenzeka lokhu nje kusenesililo sothisha bakaGrade R abangazange bakhokhelwe.Sekwaba insakavukela ukuthi uma kuvulwa izikole lo mnyango ungayifaki ngesikhathi imali yezikole, okugcina kuphoqa othishomkhulu ukuba basebenzise imali yabo ukuthenga izinto ezidingekayo ezikoleni. Muva nje kusanda kuvela ukuthi umnyango ukweleta uMasipala waseThekwini u-R200 million.Lesi sikweletu ngesamanzi nogesi. Umbiko ngalokhu ushicilelwe iphephandaba elinguzakwabo weSolezwe, iThe Mercury. Umnyango uhlezi ukhala ngokuthi awunaso isabelo esanele ukubhekana nezidingo zawo.Uma uvele esiShayamthetho umnyango uyaye ukhale ngokuthi ukwehliswa kwesabelomali sawo kwenza kube nzima ukuba ukhokhele zonke izidingo.Izikhulu zomnyango zake zakuveza esiShayamthetho ukuthi ngabe kade wawa ukube uyinkampani ezimele. Amanye amalungu axwayisa ngokuthi kuyokwenzeka ngelinye ilanga umnyango uhluleke ukukhokhela othisha kodwa umnyango wakuchitha lokhu. Okhulumela i-DA kwezeMfundo esiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Sakhile Mngadi, uthe izingqinamba ezibhekene nomnyango zingase zidale ukuthi kulambe abafundi abangaphezu kuka-2.4 million, abahlomula ohlelweni lokuphakelwa ezikoleni."Okubuhlungu ukuthi ezinye izingane zithembele kukho lokudla ezikuthola esikoleni, emakhaya azikutholi ukudla okwanele."UMngadi uthe bafuna umhlangano wekomiti lapho khona umnyango uzoveza ukuthi ingakanani imali oyikweletayo. USihlalo we-EFF KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Mongezi Twala, uthe ezinye izikole azikaze ziyithole namanje imali yazo."Othisha basebenzisa imali ukuze benze isiqiniseko sokuthi izikole aziphazamiseki ekusebenzeni kwazo. Lezi zinkinga ezibhekene nomnyango ziphazamisa ukufunda nokufundisa. Okubi ukuthi izikole ezizophazamiseka kakhulu yilezo ezisemalokishini nezisezindaweni zasemakhaya."Okhulumela i-MK, uMnuz Nhlamulo Ndhlela, uthe bafuna ukuthi umnyango uqinisekise ukuthi imali yokukhokhela abaphakela izikole ayizange isetshenziselwe ukukhokhela ezinye izidingo. "Sifuna ukuthi bakhokhelwe ngokushesha bonke abakweletwa umnyango bese futhi umnyango uqhamuka nolunye uhlelo lokukhokha ukuze kungeke kuphinde kube nenkinga efanayo."Nezinyunyana zothisha zihlale ziyilwa mihla eyokungafakwa kwemali yezikole.Izikhulu zomnyango zihlale zithi kudingeka kwandiswe imali yesabelo ukuze zikwazi ukukhokhela ngesikhathi izidingo.
UGANE unwabu umholi we-EFF uMnuz Julius Malema osola iziphathimandla zaseBrithani ngokumnqabela iVisa njengoba bekulindeleke ukuthi abhekise amabombo eLondon namhlanje."Iziphathimandla zaseBrithani zinginqabele i-visa yokuya eLondon eNgqungqutheleni yaseCambridge kule mpelasonto, zinganikezi isizathu esizwakalayo. Kuyangicacela ukuthi lokhu kungumzamo wokuvala umlomo umbono wezepolitiki ongahambisani nawo." UMalema uthi yena nethimba lakhe basesikhumulweni sezindiza i-OR, njengoba bathenjiswa ukuthi konke kuzolungiswa ngo-15:30. "Kunalokho, sithola incwadi yesixoliso njengoba kusele amahora amane ukuthi sihambe. Lokhu akwamukelekile futhi akunangqondo."
NGOLWESITHATHU mhla ka-7Meyi 2025, oKhadinali abakhethiwe abayi-133 bazongena eSistine Chapel bezokhetha uPhapha omusha waseRoma, ozongena esikhundleni sikaPhapah uFrancis, owakubalekela ukunikeza izigqoko ezibomvu ezifundabhishobhi ezinkulu kodwa wakhetha ukunikeza udumo ezindaweni ezikude, eziningi zazo ezazingakaze zibe nokhadinali ngaphambili.Kokhadinali abangu-133 abanelungelo lokuvota kule ngqungquthela, abangu-108 bagcotshwa nguPhapha uFrancis ngakho-ke bazobe bebambe iqhaza okokuqala ngqa okhethweni lukaPhapha.Uma kuqhathaniswa nengqungquthela yango-2013 eyakhetha uPapa uFrancis, akekho noyedwa kwabaphambili abavame ukuholwa ukhadinali ozomelwa kulokhu, okuhlanganisa obhishobhi baseSydney, Vienna, Genoa, Paris, Milan, Palermo, Armagh, naseKrakow.
UKHALE ngokuxinwa wukugula ummangalelwa wokuqala ecaleni lokubulawa komfundi waseDurban Girls, obekumele athulele inkantolo ubufakazi bakhe izolo eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini.USifundo Bhengu (39) bekulindeleke ukuthi ethule ubufakazi kuleli cala. Yena nomngani wakhe ongummangalelwa wesibili uBongani Jali (24), babekwe wuMbuso icala lokubulala umfundi waseDurban Girls, uWandile Ngcobo (17).Basolwa ngokuthi yibona abagasela kubo kamufi kwa-D, eMlaza, bafike bamdlwengula ngaphambi kokumbulala. Kuthiwa abagcinanga lapho njengoba besolwa nangokweba izimpahla ezahlukene ezazikhona endlini okubandakanya umakhalekhukhwini kamufi, ithelevishini nokunye okuningi. Isigameko senzeka ngoMeyi ngonyaka odlule. Isidumbu sikamufi kuthiwa satholakala siboshwe izandla nge-pentihose, elinye i-pentihose lishuthekwe emlonyeni, sinamanxeba okugwazwa amahlanu.Izolo uBhengu akabange esabethula ubufakazi njengoba engene enkantolo enyathela kancane, kubonakala ukuthi kukhona okumxinile.Ummeli kaBhengu unxuse inkantolo ukuba lingaqhubeki icala ngoba akazizwa kahle uBhengu, uxinwe wukugula. Uthe uzizwa ephelelwa ngamandla kanti futhi uhlushwa nayisisu.Kube sekuvunyelwana ngokuthi makaphuthunyiswe kudokotela osesibhedlela esisejele eWestville, ngaphambi kokuba kuphume isinqumo sokuba lihlehle icala. Nebala liguqile isikhashana icala ngesivumelwano sokuthi uBhengu aqale ahlolwe udokotela ukuthi ngabe akaphilanga ngempela yini, noma usenga ezimithiyo.Ngaleso sikhathi uBhengu ubehluleka nawukuma, eqhaqhazela ebambelele nasedolweni futhi ehlahle namehlo samuntu othukile. UMbuso ufunde incwadi kadokotela obexilonga uBhengu, okuqinisekisile ukuthi ngempela uyagula futhi ngeke aze abe sesimeni esikahle sokuthi angakwazi ukuqhubeka necala.IJaji lithe liyawamukela umbiko kadokotela lase lithi liyahlehla icala lizoze libuye namhlanje enkantolo efanayo.Kwenzeka konke lokhu nje kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi ummangalelwa wesibili uJali, usanda kuchakida uBhengu, egeqa amagula ngokwenzeka ekhomba ngenjumbane uBhengu ethi uyena owabulala umufi.Ngaphakathi enkantolo njengokwenjwayelo, bekukhona amalungu omphakathi aseMlaza, amalungu ebandla okwakukhonza kulona umufi, i-United Congregational Church of Southern Africa (UCCSA), kanye malungu e--ANC, nawe-EFF.
UKUKHOLELWA ekutheni ubengeke afike esigabeni sempilo akusona manje nokuthi konke adlule kukho empilweni kungamandla kaNkulunkulu, yizona zinto ezigqugquzele uNkk Thembsie Mchunu ukubhala, ashicilele incwadi yakhe eqhakambisa amandla obuKristu.UNkk Mchunu (70) waseMaqeleni, Eshowe, enyakatho yeKwaZulu-Natal, usanda kukhipha incwadi esihloko sithi Receiving The Call: Trusting God's Lead, ayibhale ngokubambisana nangosizo lwendodana akhe encane uMnuz Zabalaza Mchunu (37), omchushise kokuningi.Engxonxweni neSolezwe Ngempelasonto, uNkk Mchunu uthe uqale ukubhala le ncwadi kusukela ngo-2020, engajahile kangako ukuyishicilela, ekade ezenzela nje, futhi engazitsheli ukuthi kungagcina kuyincwadi, njengoba ize yaqala ukudayisa ngo-Ephreli 27. "Ngenkathi ngiqala ukubhala le ncwadi, bengingazi ukuthi kungagcina kuba yincwadi ephelele njengoba sekwenzeka manje, ngangizenzela nje ngizibhalela ngohambo lwempilo yami ukuthi ngikhule kanjani, ngiveza futhi ngibabaza amandla kaNkulunkulu engimkhonzayo ukuthi ungisize kanjani ukungibeka esigabeni engikusona manje empilweni."Izinto ziqale ukushintsha ngenkathi eminye yemibhalo engangiyigcine kwi-laptop yami ibonwa wumfana wami - owagculiseka kakhulu ngawo, wase ecela ukungisiza ukuqhubeka kuwona - wangicebisa ukuthi sisale sesenza kube yincwadi ephelele," kusho uNkk Mchunu.Eqhuba, uthe kule ncwadi ugqamisa amandla kaNkulunkulu ukuthi amsize kanjani futhi kangakanani ukumelana nezimo zempilo yakhe kusukela ebuncaneni bakhe njengoba kwathi esemncane waphoqeka ukunakekela umfowabo nonina, emva kokushona kukayise."Ngihluba udlubu ekhasini nangokuthi impilo yami ishintshe kangakanani ngenkathi ngigana umfundisi ngineminyaka ewu-20, bese ngiveza futhi ngiqhakambise ukuthi lokho kube lula kangakanani ngenxa yokukholelwa emandleni eNkosi uJesu - nokunye okuningi nje engibe nakho empilweni kuze kuzofika kule minyaka engikuyona manje, engibona nengikholwa wukuthi bekungeke kwenzeke ngaphandle kokusizwa wuNkulunkulu," usho kanje.Uthe incwadi yakhe ibiza uR250 kwabayidingayo kuyena, kanti iyatholakala futhi ku-Amazon.
IYAQENGQELEZA iKwaZulu Natal ngamacala okudlwengula.Lokhu kuvele esitatimendini esikhishwe amaphoyisa ngezibalo zababoshiwe, beboshelwa amacala okudlwengula.Amaphoyisa aveze ukuthi abophe abangu-200 ngamacala okudlwengula muva nje. Kulesi sibalo kuboshwe abangu-79 bakulesi sifundazwe. Kulesi sitatimende kuvele ukuthi kuboshwe abangu-14 255 kusuka ngo-Ephreli 28 kuya kuMeyi 4, ngaphansij komkhankaso obuvutha uphondo kuzwelonke."Sizimisele futhi sizibophezele ekutheni senze konke okusemandleni ukunqanda isihlava sokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane ezweni lonke. Lokhu sikwenza ngokuthi senze uphenyo olunzulu ngezigameko ezehlukene siphinde silandelele." Amaphoyisa athe afisa ukubona bonke ababoshelwe amacala abucayi alolu hlobo begcina bethola izigwebo ezinzima.Kuvele nokuthi kunowesilisa, uBethuel Morake, otholwe yinkantolo yesiFunda yaseModimolle enecala lokudlwengula wabe esegwetshwa iminyaka engu-15. Wadlwengula owesifazane oneminyaka engu-21 owabe eyintombi yakhe.Inkantolo yeMantshi yasePhuthaditjhaba igwebe udilakajele owesilisa (39) olahlwe yicala lokudlwengula indodakazi yakhe eneminyaka engu-15. Kuvela ukuthi ngo-Ephreli 30 inkantolo yeMantshi yaseBethlehem igwebe owesilisa oneminyaka engu-33 uBennett Mokoena, udilikajele ngokubulala unkosikazi wakhe. Lo wesifazane kuvela ukuthi washaywa kabuhlungu umyeni wakhe esebenzisa into ecijile nepayipi esigamekweni esenzeka ngonyaka odlule.Kwamanye amacala kuboshwe abangu-160 ngamacala okubulala, iningi lalaba kuvela ukuthi ngabaseWestern Cape ngabangu-38, kulandele iKwaZulu Natal ngabangu-34.Abangu-91 baboshelwe amacala okuzama ukubulala. Abangu-1 178 baboshelwa amacala okushaya ngenhloso yokulimaza. Kwaboshwa nabahwebi bezidakamizwa abangu-192. Kukhona nabanye futhi abangu-2 464 ababoshwe betholakala nezidakamizwa iningi labo okuvela ukuthi ngabaseWestern Cape. Abangu-85 baboshelwe ukutholakala nezibhamu ezingekho emthethweni, iningi ngabantu abavela KwaZulu Natal nase-Eastern Cape.Abangu-7 baboshelwe amacala okushushumbiswa kwabantu. Kube nabashayeli abangu-1 220 ababoshelwe ukushayela bedle amponjwana.
IYAQONGA ingcindezi ebhekene noMnyango weMfundo eyisiSekelo kuleli yokuthi uqinisekise ukuthi othisha abasebenza nezingane abaveli ohlwini lwalabo asebeke balahlwa amacala okuhlukumeza izingane.Ngokwezibalo ezikhishwe nguNgqongqoshe walo mnyango, uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, sisephansi isibalo sothisha abasabhekwe ukuthi abekho kulolu luhlu.Ephendula umbuzo we-IFP ePhalamende uNksz Gwarube uveze ukuthi u-19%, wothisha abasabhekiwe ukuthi abekho ohlwini. Uveze ukuthi kothisha abangu-405 738 kuleli, bangu-78 509 kuphela abasabhekiwe ukuthi abaveli ohlwini okusho ukuthi abangu-327 229 akwaziwa bona ukuthi sebeke balahlwa amacala afuze lawa noma abakaze.KwaZulu-Natal okuyiyona enothisha abaningi ezweni ngabangu-91 508 abaqashiwe, abangu-6 661 kuphela abasabhekiwe ukuthi abekho ohlwini, okusho ukuthi abangu-84 847 akwaziwa ukuthi sebeke balahlwa yini amacala."Esikwenzayo manje singumnyango ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umuntu omusha oqashwayo uyabhekwa ohlwini lwabantu asebeke balahlwa amacala, okungamele basebenze nezingane. Simbheka ohlwini olugcinwa nguMnyango wezobuLungiswa kanjalo nalolo olugcinwa nguMnyango wezeNhlalakahle," kusho uNksz Gwarube. Uthe basebenzisana namaphoyisa ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kuyaphepha ezikoleni."Asifuni ukuthi izingane zethu zifundiswe abantu okungamele bazifundise yingakho kubunjwe nethimba eliyisipesheli elihlanganisa amaphoyisa nomnyango, yokusheshisa lapho kunezinkinga ekufakweni kwezicelo zokuthi sibheke amagama othisha ukuthi abekho ohlwini. Sifuna nokuthi zonke izikole zibe nokusebenzisana namaphoyisa."Uthe ngisho ezikoleni ezizimele kumele babhekwe othisha ukuthi abekho ohlwini. Ukhale ngokuthi kunokubambezeleka ekubhekweni kwamagama ohlwini lomnyango wezobuLungiswa."Ohlwini lwaseMnyangweni wezeNhlalakahle azikho izinkinga ngoba luvele uhlu lwakhona luyatholakala kalula, uma uqhathanisa nohlu lwasemnyangweni wezobuLungiswa ngoba kudingeka kufakwe isicelo, bese kuphuza ukubuya kwezimpendulo. Kodwa ke yonke iminyango yezifundazwe iyalelwe ukuthi isheshise ukubheka bonke othisha okusasilele emuva ukuthi babhekwe ukuthi ngabe abaveli yini ohlwini," kuqhuba uNksz Gwarube.UNksz Gwarube empendulweni uveze nokuthi isifundazwe iLimpopo esinothisha abangu-51 446, akukho noyedwa osabhekiwe ohlwini.
KUSOLWA ukuthi ubezama ukubamba indoda ngosana alwebe kunina emijondolo yaseNsimbini, eCato Manor, ngeSonto, owesifazane ogcine ekhalelwa ngamasongo kaSigonyela izolo.Umsolwa (21) kuvela ukuthi wahlangana okokuqala nonina wosana olunamasonto amabili luzelwe, ngo-Ephreli 24 kulo nyaka, emtholampilo waseCato Manor.Kuthiwa wazenza umngani wakhe, bagcina sebehambisana sekugodukwa. Kuvela ukuthi unina wosana wachezuka kuqala wangena emjondolo wakhe, umsolwa waqhubeka nendlela.Kuvela ukuthi ubesehlale emvakashela nsuku zonke kusukela ngalelo langa. Umthombo ongeke uvezwe osondelene nonina wosana obelwebiwe, uthe kwenzeka lesi sigameko nje, umsolwa ubekade efike ngoMgqibelo, ewumuntu ovakashile njengenjwayelo kodwa wagcina esecela ukulaliswa ethola ukuthi sekunombhikisho womphakathi, owawuvale ngasemgwaqweni uN2 ngaseChesterville. Uthe ngeSonto bavukile kwakuhle, baze baphelezelana beyokhipha imali egaraji lakwaSasol. "Babuya lapho bahlala kancane, unina wosana wase ephuma eyoneka izingubo kulayini wakwamakhelwane eshiya umsolwa nosana, wabuya bengasabonwa."Umthombo wase-Extension 2, eChesterville, ongumakhelwane wakubo kowesilisa (20) obezombathiswa ibhantshi, uthe kufike unina wowesilisa ngeSonto ntambama ezomtshela ukuthi intombi yendodana yakhe isitetile. Uqhuba umthombo uthe, nakuba inkukhu ibiwusola umgqakazo kubona njengoba bebelokhu besho ukuthi nakuba lona wesifazane ebehlala ethi ukhulelwe kodwa isisu bebebona ukuthi asikhuli."Namuhla ekuseni (esho izolo) ngikhangwe yisaziso ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, abenkampani yonogada, iReaction Unit South Africa (Rusa) besho ukuthi kukhona usana olwebiwe eNsimbini. Kuvele kwaba khona into engitshela kuthi lolu sana okuthiwa lwebiwe yilo lolu olufike nalona wesifazane,” usho kanje.Uthe ube esebiza unina wowesilisa emkhombisa isazisoi, wase emyalela ukuthi akabuye nalo njengomuntu ozokhombisa (umthombo), okuyilapho ethole khona ithuba lokuthwebula isithombe, wasithumela kwabakwaRusa.Kuvela ukuthi abakwaRusa bathathe leso sithombe basithumelela umakhelwane kanina wosana, bembuza ukuthi akulona yini usana lwakhe lolu, nebala waqinisekisa ukuthi yilona. Udalule ukuthi owesilisa obezombathiswa ijazi bese enenye intombi abesha amashushu ngayo, esemchizela umsolwa."Sisola ukuthi yikho lo wesifazane enze imizamo yokuthi anakwe yisoka,” kuchaza umthombo.Imizamo yokuthola unina wosana ibhuntshile njengoba Isolezwe lifike esiteshini samaphoyisa eCato Manor esehanjiswe nalo esibhedlela ukuze luyohlolwa. Kuvele ukuthi angahle alaliswe. Inombolo yeselula kadadewabo, okuthiwa ubehamba naye ibingangeni. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uCaptain Ntathu Ndlovu, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi amaphoyisa aseCato Manor abophe owesifazane (21), ngecala lokuthumba nelokweba kulandela isehlakalo esenzeke ngeSonto. "Kulesi sigameko kuthunjwe usana olunamasonto amabili luzelwe. Kuthiwa unina wosana uvakashelwe wumsolwa abahlangana naye emtholampilo. Kuthiwa kuthe esaphumile eyoneka izingubo kulayini, wabuya umsolwa nosana bengasekho. Iselula yakhe nemali nakho bekwebiwe,” kusho uCapt Ndlovu.Uthe emva kokutholakala kosana, luhanjiswe esibhedlela, lapho lusaxilongwa khona ukuze kubonakale ukuthi lusesimeni esikahle yini.Umsolwa kulindeleke ukuthi avele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini kusasa.
ISENKINGENI iminyango kahulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal ekhungethwe yinkinga yemali njengoba osomabhizinisi abangakhokhelwe befuna ngoshova imali yabo.Izolo iMinyango, owezeMpilo nowezeMfundo, ibhekane nolaka losomabhizinisi abangakhokhelwe abanqumele le minyango ugwayi katiki. Yomibili ibhekene nenkinga yemali.Abaphakela izikole baqhinqe emahhovisi oMnyango wezeMfundo bekhala ngokungakhokhelwa, abanye osomabhizinisi bavale amahhovisi oMnyango wezeMpilo. Izinkampani eziphakela izikole zithi seziphelelwe amaqhinga okuthi zizoyithathaphi imali yokuqhubeka ziphakele izikole ngalesi sikhathi zisalinde ukukhokhelwa wumnyangoAbanikazi bezinkampani bathe sekunesikhathi eside umnyango ubabambisa udonga.Bathe abanye babo basalinde ukukhokhelwa imali yokudla abakuhambise ngonyaka odlule. Kulolu hlelo lokuphakelwa kwezikole kuhlomula abafundi abangaphezu kuka-2 million abaqhamuka ezikoleni ezingu-5 400.Okhulumela inhlangano yabaphakela izikole KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thabang Mncwabe, uthe abanikazi bezinkampani bathwele kanzima."Kunabanikazi bezinkampani abangakaze bayithole imali yabo okwakufanele bayithole ngonyaka odlule. Abanye bakhokhelwa imali engaphelele. Awazi ukuthi inconzulwa wubani, ayishonisephi lena enye ngoba uMnyango wezeMfundo kuzwelonke uyikhipha iphelele imali." "Besikade sithembele kwiThala, njengoba selivaliwe sesidlala omashonisa. Nabo omashonisa sebekhathele yithina ngoba siyahluleka wukukhokha. Iningi lethu lihlafuna lijeqeza ngenxa yokukweleta omashonisa."UMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal uthembise ukuthi abanikazi bezinkampani bazoyithola imali yabo ngoLwesine wathi uqale kwakhona izolo ukuyifaka.Esitatimendeni umnyango uthe u-78% wezinkampani wakhokhelwa ngo-Ephreli, wathi ukukhokhelwa kwezinye izinkampani kwabanjezelwa wubuhixihixi obadalwa wukushintshwa kohlelo olusetshenziswayo. Inhloko yomnyango, uMnuz Nkosinathi Ngcobo, ishwelezile kubanikazi bezinkampani abangakhokhelwe."Umnyango uzama ngakho konke okusemandleni ukulungisa lobu buhixihixi. Ukubambezeleka akuhlangene nenkinga yemali ebhekene nomnyango njengamanje. Imali yokuphakelwa kwabafundi iqhamuka emnyangweni kazwelonke."UMncwabe uphakamise ukuthi kushintshwe uhlelo olusetshenziswayo ukukhokhela izinkampani."Akukaze kwenzeke ukuthi abantu bengazitholi izibonelelo zikahulumeni. Uma kunezinkinga kuyaye kwenziwe izinhlelo zokuthi abantu bathole izibonelelo kwezinye izindawo, okungaba yisezitolo. Nakuthina kufanele kwenziwe uhlelo olukanjalo uma kunobuhixihixi." Osomabhizinisi abangaphansi kwenhlangano, iKZN Black Small Business Association, bavale amahhovisi oMnyango wezeMpilo aseMgungundlovu.UMnuz Zethembe Ngcongo, wale nhlangano enamalungu angu-245, uthe nabo sekunesikhathi eside umnyango ungabakhokheli.Ukhale ngokuthi umnyango ujaha ukukhokhela izinkampani ezinkulu bese ukhohlwa wukukhokhela izinkampani ezisafufusa. "Ekugcineni sigcina sisebenzela omashonisa ngoba uma ngithola umsebenzi emnyangweni, kuyaye kungiphoqe ukuba ngiboleke imali komashonisa. Imali kamashonisa izala u-40%. Uma umnyango uphuza ukukhokha imali inzalo igcina isikhula isidlula ngisho imali engizoyithola emnyangweni. Mina ngigcina ngisala nesikweletu."Wonke amasango angenela emahhovisi omnyango asesakhiweni iNatalia, abekhiywe ngamaketanga nezingidi ezinkulu.Abasebenzi bomnyango bafike bama izixongololo ngaphandle kwesakhiwo. Bebelokhu beqhwebana, bebabaza. Nabadlula ngendlela bebebabaza bengaqedi.Amasango aze avulwa ngesikade emva kokuthi osomabhizinisi abakhalayo sebekhulume nesikhulu esiphethe imali emnyangweni, uMnuz Khothamani Vilakazi.UMnyango wezeMpilo awuzange uyiphendule imibuzo ethunyelwe.
IBHIMBILE imizamo yokugebenga imoto ethutha imali emgwaqweni uKhumalo Street eduze noMorubisi Street, eThokoza. Kubikwa ukuthi izigebengu ezibalelwa kwezishumi zivimbe imoto yemali behlome ngezikhali ezahlukene behamba ngezimoto ezahlakukene zikanokusho. Abahlaseli baqhumise iziqhumane bezama ukuvula le moto yemali nokuyinto ethuse izakhamuzi. Ngeshwa umsolwa oyedwa ushaywe yilelibhomu lezanda kwakhumuka umlenze. Ayikho imali eyebiwe kodwa kutshontshwe izibhamu zonogada. Amaphoyisa asendaweni yesehlo.
ZIYANDA izikhalo ngesibhedlela esisanda kuba sematheni ngokuphekela iziguli emlilweni obaswe ngamaphepha namapulangwe anopende, iNorthdale. Lokhu kulandela ukuqubuka kwezikhalo ngesikhungo esisetshenziswa iNorthdale ukwelapha iziguli ezingenabani esiseHowick, eMgungundlovu. Kukhalwa ngokuthi lesi sakhiwo asinakiwe ngalendlela yokuthi umuntu odlula ngendlela angazitshela ukuthi yisakhiwo esingasasebenzi. Iziguli ezithunyelwa kulesi sikhungo ilezo ezingakwazi ukuyoqhubeka nokusebenzisa imithi namaphilisi emakhaya.Iningi leziguli ezikulesi sikhungo ziphila nokukhubazeka.Kuthiwa lesi sikhungo esaziwa ngeStepdown, asinabo abasebenzi, nesakhiwo kuthiwa asikho esimeni. Isolezwe lithole ukuthi kulesi sikhungo kunamawindi afile kanye nezicabha ezingavaleki. Lesi sikhungo kwakukade kuyinkambi yamasosha ngaphambi kokuthi sithathwe uMnyango wezeMpilo.Umthombo osebenza kulesi sikhungo, ongeke uvezwe uthe isakhiwo asinakiwe ngale ndlela yokuthi umuntu odlulayo angazitshela ukuthi asisasebenzi. "Uma ungasibona angeke uzitshele ukuthi kukhona iziguli ezilashelwa lapha. Ungakhohlwa ukuthi lapha sikhuluma ngeziguli ezidinga ukunakekelwa ngempela ngoba ezinye zikhubazekile. Umuntu angazitshela ukuthi le yindawo nje ezihlalela amaphara."Lo msebenzi uthe basabela ukuphepha kwabo kanye nokweziguli."Kuneminyango engasavaleki lapha kuphinde kube namawindi afile. Ebusuku siyesaba. Nakhona sincane kakhulu isibalo sabasebenzi lapha uma uzoqhathanisa nomsebenzi osihlalele." UNobhala weNehawu eMgungundlovu, uMnuz Mazwi Ngubane, uthe bafuna ukuthi uMnyango wezeMpilo ulungise ngokushesha lesi sikhungo."Siyafisa ukuthi umnyango usheshise uhlelo lokushintsha lesi sikhungo, sibukeke njengesikhungo sikahulumeni. Akwamukelekile ukuthi iziguli zilaliswe endaweni enjena, ikakhulukazi ngoba lapha sikhuluma ngeziguli ezidinga ukunakekelwa ngempela."UMnyango wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal awuzange uyiphendule imibuzo ethunyelwe ngoLwesihlanu. Umnyango wawuthe uzokhipha isitatimende esiphendula udaba lwezikhalo ngalesi sikhungo kodwa kuze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela ungakasithumeli isitatimende.Kwenzeka lokhu nje okunye okuvelayo ukuthi onogada eNorthdale bebehudula izinyawo ngeledlule ngenxa yokuthi sekuphele isikhathi eside bengaholile.Kuthiwa sekuphele izinyanga ezintathu onogada bengaholile, inkampani ebaqashile ikhala ngokuthi nayo ayikhokhelwe umnyango. INorthdale, engaphandle kancane kwedolobha uMgungundlovu, ibe sematheni muva nje ngesikhathi kusabalala izithombe zabasebenzi bakulesi sibhedlela bepheka ukudla kweziguli emlilweni.Lokhu kwenzeka ngesikhathi kuhambe ugesi, ama-generator amathathu akulesi sibhedlela awazange asebenze ngesikhathi kuhambe ugesi.Kwasala kumnyama bhuqe kulesi sibhedlela esikwazi ukulalisa abantu abangu-420, kwacisha nasemakhazeni akusona isibhedlela.
KWENZEKE okungajwayelekile eMatshotshombeni KwaMakhutha, eningizimu yeTheku kuhlehla umngcwabo usuphakathi ngoMgqibelo, umndeni uthola ukuthi awunawo umgodi wokungcwaba umufi.Lokhu kulandela ukuba abamakhaza, benqatshelwe abaqapha amathuna ase-Adams ukuthi bangene ukuzokwenza amalungiselelo okungcwaba, bafake amadlelo netende ebelizohlala umndeni.Kuthiwa umngcwabo ubungokaMnuz John Bruce Sithole (58), obeyinhloko yekhaya, okuvela ukuthi ushone ngokugula ngoLwesibili olwedlule. Ngokusho kwesihlobo uNksz Khuthala Magugu, umsusi waso sonke lesi sidididi esenzekile, owesilisa ohamba ezibiza ngekhansela lase-Adams, uMnuz Mazi Manqele."Ukhokhelwe uR2 500 womgodi ngoLwesine, wasinika isiliphu, esiwubufakazi bokuthi umgodi siwukhokhele,” kusho uNksz Magugu.Uthe baqhubeke namalungiselelo bekhululekile, bazi ukuthi konke kuhamba kahle. "Isidumbu sisilande emakhazeni ngoLwesihlanu, kwenziwa inkonzo yomlindelo. Kuthe ngoMgqibelo ekuseni, kwangena inkonzo yokumphelezela. Ibisaqhubeka ngesikhathi sifonelwa abasemakhazeni abese beye emathuneni beyolungiselela ukuthi sithi sifika nesidumbu konke kube sekumi ngomumo,” kulandisa uNksz Magugu.Uthe abamakhaza babatshele ukuthi onogada bayabanqabela ukuthi bangene ngaphakathi emathuneni, bathi kugcwele, akusangcwatshwa. "Sinikele khona, safike satshelwa okufanayo nathi ukuthi amathuna kudala kwamiwa ukungcwaba kuwona ngoba agcwele,” usho kanje.Uthe kuthe uma bemfonela abamkhokhele imali yomgodi, bembuza ngalokhu, bemyalela nokuthi akabuyise imali, wababuza ukuthi bathi akayithathephi.Utshele Isolezwe ukuthi imali ugcine eyibuyisa izolo. Uthe okudale ukuthi kuhlehle umngcwabo wukuthi ubungasatholakali omunye umgodi kwamanye amathuna masinyane."Kuthe uma sibuza kwawaseFolweni, satshelwa ukuthi umgodi ubiza uR4 500, ebesingenawo masinyane njengoba konke besikwenza ngokupatanisa, engekho osebenzayo ekhaya,” usho kanje.Uthe igcine ihlangana ebusuku imali, njengoba begcine beqhubeka izolo nomngcwabo. Udalule ukuthi lokhu kubamoshile, kwaphinde kwabafaka kwezinye izindleko ebebengazihlelele, njengoba begcine sebekhokha uR2 000 ngaphezulu kwabamakhaza ukuze babuyisele isidumbu emuva, baphinde babuye izolo ukuzolekelela ngamalungiselelo nokunye."Nokudla ebesikupheke ngoMgqibelo, kugcine kudliwa emva kwenkonzo yomngcwabo ephethe ngokuphelela emoyeni. Njengoba singcwaba okwangempela namuhla (esho izolo), akukho okunye ukudla esizobuye sikupheke,” kusho uNksz Magugu. Uthe baphatheke kabi ngokwenziwe owesilisa njengoba bengabantu abantulayo. Uphinde wazwakalisa ukuhlukumezeka umndeni obhekane nakho, nokungahlonishwa kwesidumbu sehla senyuka, kuhlehla umngcwabo. Isolezwe lizamile ukuthinta umsolwa enombolweni eliyinikwe yisihlobo, kodwa kwatholakala ukuthi ucingo luvaliwe.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi kule ndawo likhona ikhansela elinesibongo esifanayo nesikamsolwa futhi bahlobene. Umthombo oyisihlobo sekhansela uthe: "Kuhlale kuba nezikhalo, lisolwa ngokuthi liqole abantu imali yemigodi. Kokunye lize lifonelwe ngisho nangamaphoyisa, libuzwa ngalokhu. Empeleni umuntu owenza lo mkhuba umalume wekhansela, osebenzisa igama lobukhansela uma eqola abantu ekubeni engakaze abe yilo.” Uqhube wathi indaba yakhe igcine isingenelelwa nayizinduna zendawo, isonto elakhelene namathuna kanjalo nobukhosi bakwaMakhanya, wakhuzwa.Ikhansela lakwenye ingxenye ye-Adams, uMnuz Siphephelo Mnyandu lithe nalo sekukaningi lithola imibiko ngezakhamuzi ziwela kulo mgoga kamsolwa."Asimazi ukuthi ukwenzelani ngempela lokhu,” kusho uMnyandu.
I-MK isiphinde yenza ezinye izinguquko ebuholini bayo baKwaZulu-Natal.Leli qembu eliholwa owayengumengameli we-ANC nezwe uMnuz Jacob Zuma, lenze izinguquko ezikhundleni ezimbili ezimqoka.Isolezwe libone incwadi ebhalwe uNobhala Jikelele we-MK, uMnuz Floyd Shivambu, ememezela izinguquko. Kule ncwadi ebhekiswe kumdidiyeli we-MK KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Willies Mchunu, kanye nobuholi be-MK esifundazweni kanye nasezifundeni, uShivambu umemezele ukuqokwa komgqugquzeli omusha we-MK KwaZulu-Natal.UShivambu uthe lesi sikhundla sizothathwa uMnuz Simphiwe Mpungose, obekade ebhekelele ukuhlela ukusebenza kweqembu esifundazweni.UMpungose akamusha kulesi sikhundla, uke wasibamba ngaphambi kokhetho lwangonyaka owedlule. Wakhishwa kulesi sikhundla ngoJuni wangonyaka owedlule, i-MK ayizange izidalule izizathu zokumehlisa esikhundleni.Isikhundla somgqugquzeli we-MK KwaZulu-Natal bese siphethwe uMnuz Sibusiso Xulu, owaqokelwa kulesi sikhundla ngasekupheleni konyaka owedlule.Encwadini, uShivambu uveze ukuthi uXulu uqokelwe kwesokudidiyela amalungu esigungu esiphezulu kwi-MK ajutshwe esifundazweni iNorthern Cape. UShivambu uphinde wamemezela ukuqokwa kozobhekelela ukuhlela ukusebenza kweqembu KwaZulu-Natal, okunguMnuz Reggie Ngcobo.UNgcobo ubekade eyephini lobhekelele ukuhlela ukusebenza kwe-MK esifundazweni.Ngaphambi kwalokho uNgcobo ubekade ewumgqugquzeli we-MK esifundeni iMoses Mabhida. UShivambu uthe lezi zinguquko ziyingxenye yamalungiselelo okhetho lohulumeni basekhaya oluzokuba ngonyaka ozayo.I-MK ihlose ukuhlwitha inqwaba yomasipala baKwaZulu-Natal okhethweni oluzayo njengoba liqhubeka nokwenza kahle ezinkethweni zokuchibiyela eziba esifundazweni.I-MK isanda kuwina izinketho zokuchibiyela ezintathu zilandelana KwaZulu-Natal, lapho ithathe khona izindawo ebeziphethwe i-ANC neDA koMasipala, owaseThekwini, owaKwaDukuza nowaseMandeni. UShivambu uthe banethemba lokuthi izinguquko zizokwenza ukuthi i-MK idle amagalane KwaZulu-Natal, okuyisifundazwe i-MK eyathola amavoti amaningi kuso okhethweni lwangonyaka owedlule."Lezi zinguquko zenziwe emva kwezingxoxo ezijulile. Umholi weqembu uyavumelana nalezi zinguquko. Inhloso yalezi zinguquko ukuqinisa ubuholi beqembu esifundazweni, siqinisekise ukuthi iqembu liyaqhubeka nokukhula, kanye nokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi i-MK yenza kahle KwaZulu-Natal okhethweni lwangonyaka ozayo. IKwaZulu-Natal iyona esibukela kuyona."UShivambu unxuse amalungu e-MK ukuba amukele izinguquko ezenziwe. "Sinxusa ukuba neseke abaholi abaqokelwe ezikhundleni ezintsha. Asiqhubekeni nokuba imbumba, silwele into eyodwa."Imizamo yokuthola okhulumela i-MK, uMnuz Nhlamulo Ndhlela, ukuba aqinisekise lezi zinguquko ayizange iphumelele.

UNOBHALA Jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, usabise ngokuqondisa ubugwegwe abaqhuba umkhankaso wephini likamengameli we-ANC, uMnuz Paul Mashatile, wokuhola le nhlangano. UMbalula usole abeseka uMashatile kwesikamengameli ngokuhambela i-ANC phambili njengoba ekhala ngokuthi asikafiki isikhathi sokuba kukhulunywe eyomjaho wezikhundla. Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma emcimbini wokungcwatshwa kabusha kwamathambo ezishoshovu ze-ANC ezabulawa uhulumeni wobandlululo. Amathambo angcwatshwe kabusha ngakaMnuz Benjamini Moloise noMnuz Abraham Mngomezulu.Zombili lezi zishoshovu zalengiswa, imindeni yazo ibingazi ukuthi amathambo abo alele kuphi.Amathambo abo adluliselwe ngokusemthethweni emindenini emcimbini obuseSoweto ngempelasonto. I-ANC izokuba nengqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi ngo-2027.UMashatile ungomunye wabantu okulindeleke ukuba angenele umbango wokuhola i-ANC.UMbalula uthe kukhona abantu asebeqalile ukukhankasela uMashatile, waxwayisa ngokuthi lokhu abakwenzayo kuphambene nemigudu ye-ANC. "Nihamba nibiza imihlangano, nifaka izikibha ezinombhalo othi uMashatile yithemba lenu lokugcina. Nizwe ngobani ukuthi sesivuliwe isikhathi sokuba sikhulume ngombango wezikhundla?Uma isikhathi sesivuma, i-ANC izovula ithuba lokuba amalungu enhlangano aphakamise amagama abantu afuna bangenele umbango wezikhundla."Uma kuwukuthi abantu bayamthanda uMashatile, bazomkhetha. Okwamanje sinaye umengameli, futhi usiphethe kahle. Sonke kufanele sigxile ekulungiseni izinto ezingalungile. I-ANC ayenzanga kahle okhethweni olwedlule, kufanele sizikhathaze ngalokho."UMbalula uwugxekile umbhalo osezikibheni eziqokwa abaseka uMashatile, wathi lo mbhalo wenza kubukeke sengathi uMashatile ubaluleke ukwedlula i-ANC. "Simatasa lapha sishumayeza abantu ukuthi abathembe i-ANC ukwedlula abantu, nina ngapha nifaka izikibha ezibhalwe ukuthi uMashatile ithemba lenu lokugcina. Kusho ukuthi uMashatile nimthemba ukwedlula i-ANC?"Le nto sihlezi siyikhuza, sithi yekani ukulandela abantu ngoba kusasa kuzokusa sebeshintshile. Nizosala ningazi ukuthi kufanele nenzenjani. Abantu bayashintsha kodwa i-ANC iyohlezi ikhona."UMbalula uthe uzobathathela izinyathelo zokuqondiswa abalandeli bakaMashatile uma beqhubeka nomkhankaso. "Lokhu enikwenzayo kuphambene nemigomo ye-ANC. Kusho bani ukuthi uMashatile akathandwa."UMbalula ukhuluma kanjena nje ezinkundleni zokuxhumana kusanda kusabalala izikibha ezinobuso bakhe.Lezi zikibha zihambisana nombhalo othi uyena ofanelwe isikhundla sokuhola i-ANC. UMbalula washeshe wayihlaba wayihlikiza eyokusabalala kwalezi zikibha, wathi akahlangene nazo.Umbango wokuhola i-ANC kulindeleke ukuthi ushise phansi.
INGENE ophahleni lwendlu imoto ebipakile ngesikhathi ishayiswa enye eWaterloo.Lesi sehlakalo senzeke ngoLwesihlanu ebusuku emgwaqweni uSithebe.Abakwa-Reaction Unit South Africa (RUSA), bashayelwe ucingo baziswa ngalesi sehlakalo.Umbiko abawutholile ngukuthi imoto iHonda Accord, ebipakile, ishayiswe ngemuva yiVW Polo.Lo mbiko uveze ukuthi lesi sehlakalo senzeke ungakashayi u-7 ebusuku."IHonda ibe isingena ophahleni lwendlu njengoba umuzi ungezansi komgwaqo. BAPHINDE babanjiswa udonga nguMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, othisha abafundisa uGrade R abangaholanga ngoLwesihlanu.Labo thisha bathenjiswa yinhloko yalo mnyango uMnuz Nathi Ngcobo ukuthi bazohola ngoLwesihlanu emuva kokuba bengaholanga ekupheleni kwenyanga edlule.NgoLwesihlanu bathe bethi ngqu beyobheka imali bafica itshe lome inhlama. UNobhala weSadtu KwaZulu-Natal, uNksz Nomarashiya Caluza, uthe labo thisha abaholanga nangosuku abathenjiswa lona ngumnyango.Uthe sekuyinsakavukela eyenzeka minyaka yonke ukuthi bangaholelwa ngesikhathi."Minyaka yonke bafana nabantu abaqala kabusha baqashwe ngamahhovisi ezifunda omnyango, angavuseleli ngesikhathi izinkontileka zabo. Sihlale siyikhuluma le nto nomnyango kodwa iwela ezindlebeni ezingezwa." Uthe bahlale behlaba ikhwelo lokuthi njalo uma kuqala unyaka, kufakwe ulwazi lwalabo thisha ukuze kuthi uma kufika u-Ephreli, kube sekuphothulwe yonke into."Okubuhlungu kakhulu manje ngukuthi umnyango awusavunyelwe ukuthi ukhokhe noma yinini kwi-Persal, okungenza ukuthi bangakhokhelwa. Sawunxusa umnyango ukuthi ukhulume nehhovisi likaNdunankulu wesifundazwe, mayelana nendaba yokuthi kubekhona okuzokwenzeka ku-Persal ukuze bakwazi ukukhokhelwa," usho kanje.Uthe bahlele umhlangano namhlanje lapho umqashi ezochaza kabanzi ngezinhlelo zokulungisa le nkinga ebhekene nalabo thisha. Le nyunyana ihlale ikhala ngezinselelo ezibhekana nalabo thisha minyaka yonke, esikhathini lapho kuphasiswe khona umthetho wezikole iBela, ofaka ukuthi uGrade R ube yimpoqo ezikoleni zakuleli.Labo thisha bahlale bekhala ngokuthi azinakiwe ngumnyango izimo zokusebenza kwabo okuyinto abahlale bekhala ngayo minyaka yonke.Okhulumela umnyango, uMnuz Muzi Mahlambi, uthembise ukubuyela entathelini nezimpendulo. Omunye wothisha ofundisa leli banga, ocele ukungavezwa, uthe ubaphindile umnyango ngokuthi ungabaholeli, okuyinto esijwayelekile uma kuqala unyaka omusha wezimali.Uthe njalo ngonyaka kudingeka bavuselele izinkontileka zabo uma kuqala u-Ephreli kuze kube uMashi wonyaka olandelayo."Njalo uma kuphela u-Ephreli umnyango awusikhokheli. Umnyango awenzi lutho ukulungisa le nkinga minyaka yonke," kusho umthombo. Uthe kwezinye izifunda kubanjezelwa wukuthi ziyaphuza ukukhipha amafomu okuvuselela izinkontileka.Ukhale ngokuthi umnyango awubacabangeli abasebenzi.Uthe abasazi ukuthi kumele benzenjani ngoba le nkinga ihlale yenzeka emnyangweni kanti akekho onendaba nabo.
BAKHALA ngosizi lokungabibikho kwamanzi kanye nesimo semigwaqo ezindaweni eziningi kuMasipala waseBaqulusini, eVryheid, abathi nakanjani kumele kulungiswe kulo nyaka omusha wezimali.Lokhu kushiwo yizakhamuzi ebezithamele isabelo sentuthuko edidiyelwe, ebesibanjelwe ehholo lomphakathi eMondlo Kwa-A.Umkhandlu uqale ukuhambela imiphakathi ehlukene kusuka ngoLwesihlanu njengoba uye emphakathini waKwaKhambi naseShoba. Kuyona yomibili le mihlangano kukhalwe kakhulu ngesimo semigwaqo. UNkk Senzeni Mjiyakho waseMondlo, uthe imigwaqo abebenayo eMondlo ibisesimeni esikahle kodwa yakhahlanyezwa yimvula."Imigodi egcwele lana elokishini ishayisa ngamahloni. Osekukuningi yimigodi kunomgwaqo, abayisukumele le nto njengoba kuyiyona emibi nesimo samanzi sona esisikhahlameza usuku nosuku. Uzwa kuthiwa kulungisiwe, aphume kodwa aphinde ahambe futhi ngenxa yengqalasizinda esindala okumele ilungiswe," kuchaza uNkk Mjiyakho.UMnuz Sizwe Khanyile, uveze ukuthi nabo abakwazi ukuphuma ngezimoto ezincane uma linile futhi nendaba yokungabi nawo amanzi iyabahlukumenza. "Sicela amanzi emphakathini, angisayiphathi eyemigwaqo iyasihlukumeza kakhulu, siyabona nathi izulu lina njalo lana. Alipheli isonto izulu linganile, okwenza izimoto zikhahlamezeke. Umasipala uma ungasukumela lezi zinto zombili isimo singaba ngcono.IMeya yaseBaqulusini uMnuz Khehla Mkhwanazi, ivumile ukuthi eVryheid nasezindaweni ezakhele yona, banenkinga yemigodi emgwaqweni okwenza isimo sayo sibe sibi.UMkhwanazi uthe bazimisele ukuthi kuleli sonto baqashe abantu abazoqala balungise imigwaqo yize imali bengenayo manje bayoze baqale babakhokhele ngoJulayi. Ugcizelele ukuthi okunye abazimisele ngakho wukuthi kusukunyelwe udaba lokwandisa izindawo ezibheka izinhlekelele, okuyinto ebaphoqayo ukuthi bayenze."Akumele njengabaholi siqhamuke sesithukile ngoba sekwenzeke umonakalo. Lana eMondlo isimo sezulu sibe sibi ngendlela eyisimanga, namanje abantu abadala bangafakaza ukuthi izulu alikaze line ngale ndlela elenza ngayo manje."Uthe:"Ngokwami ngibona kumele kuqashwe abantu ezindaweni abazoqeqeshwa ukuthi uma kuba nezimo eziphuthumayo kusha imizi noma kuhlasela imvula, bafike ngokushesha kungalindwa abantu abasuka edolobheni eVryheid abafica indlu isishe yaphela. Uhlelo lwe-EPWP bengingafisa ukuthi luphinde lwenziwe lubhekane nezinhlekelele." Uthe okunye abafuna ukukwenza kuleli lokishi ngenxa yobukhulu balo, wukuthi bakhe ihholo elisezingeni eliphezulu,Ukhwele wadilika kubasebenzi bomkhandlu athe abanye abafuni ukusebenza, okuyinto okumele bayisukumele.Uthe abasebenzi bakamasipala kushaya u-12 emini sebehamba nezintombi zabo edolobheni izidingo zomsebenzi zingenziwe. "Namhlanje ngininika igunya lokuthi uma nibona umsebenzi kaMasipala edakiwe ngesikhathi somsebenzi, ningifonele. Abasebenzi abafiki ngesikhathi emsebenzini, bayajola ngesikhathi somsebenzi, malungu omphakathi ngiyaninxusa ukuthi nisibikele ngabo," kuchaza yena.Uthe endaweni yaseShoba kuningi okusamele kulungiswe njengoba abantu bakhona bakha endaweni egcwele amanzi, okunzima ukuthi bayisebenze njengomasipala njengoba kusekhona izinkinga ngokwanda kwemizi kuleya ndawo.
ISIKHULU sophiko lwezokuvikela kuleli uLt-Gen Rudzani Maphwanya, sithe ukuhoxiswa kwamasosha akuleli eDRC, akusho ukuthi elakuleli lingenwa ngamanzi emadolweni noma ubugwala kodwa ahoxiswa ngoba kukhona umehluko osukhona kuleliya lizwe.UMaphwanya obekhuluma esithangamini nabezindaba izolo ePitoli, uthe kunezingxoxo zokwakha uxolo yingakho kuthathwe lesi sinyathelo.Kulesi sithangami obekukhona kuso noNgqongqoshe wezokuVikela uNkk Angie Motshekga, uthe banika isikhathi izingxoxo ukuze ziqhubeke kuleliya lizwe. "Isinqumo esisithathile asisithathanga ngoba singenwa ngamanzi emadolweni, kodwa esokuthi kuqhubeke izingxoxo ezikhona kuleliya lizwe. Lokhu kuyizinkomba zokuthi kuba nozinzo nemizamo yokuthi kube noxolo eDRC," usho kanje.Amasosha angu-14 akuleli asala enkundleni eGoma ngoJanuwari ngesikhathi ibambene namavukela mbuso iM23.Uthe kunenhlansi yethemba ngoxolo eDRC njengoba ethe baxoxile neM23 ngenyanga edlule mayelana nokuhoxiswa kwamasosha. "Likhona iqoqo lokuqala elihlanganisa amaloli angu-13, namasosha angu-57 eselifikile esizindeni okuzohlanganyelwa kusona eTanzania. Leli qoqo likwazile ukudlula eRwanda," kusho uMaphwanya.Uthe uhambo lwaleli qoqo luqale ngo-Ephreli 29, wathi izolo iqoqo lesibili liqale olwalo uhambo."Kulindeleke ukuthi lolu hlelo luphothulwe ekupheleni kwenyanga. Amasosha azotheleka kuleli ngendiza, kuthi impahla ifike ngomkhumbi." Ubalule nokuthi akakwazi ukusho ukuthi amasosha azotheleka nini kuleli ngenxa yokuthi kuba nokubambezeleka endleleni.UNkk Motshekga uthe amasosha ahoxiswe emuva kwezingxoxo ezithinta uxolo esifundeni.Uthe baxhumane nezinhlaka ezehlukene ezingxoxweni wathi likhona ithemba ngezithinta uxolo. Ubonge amasosha abeyibambe kuleliya lizwe ngokuzinikela, emele izwe."Elakuleli lizoqhubeka nokweseka imizamo yokuphemba uxolo eDRC, ngokuhambisana nemigomo ye-African Union 2063. Lokhu kufana nesiqalo esisha emizameni yokwakha uxolo," kusho uNkk Motshekga.
UKUTHANDA umsebenzi wakhe wobuciko nokuzibophezela kuyo yonke indawo athole ithuba lokuyilingisa, yizona zinto ezigqamile nokuvele ukuth kuzokhunjulwa ngazo umlingisi wemidlalo yeshashalazi yeyakwithelevishini, uNkosikhona Dube (32) ongasekho emhlabeni, oshone ngokukhula ukuzuma, edlula emhlabeni ngokudutshulwa ngesonto elidlule.Lokho kushiwo wozakwabo abafunde, futhi basebenza naye endimeni yezokulingisa enkonzweni yakhe yesikhumbuzo ebiyenzelwe lapho acijelwa khona ezokulingisa eCouryard Theatre, eDurban University of Technology (DUT), eThekwini ngoLwesihlanu emini. "Ngikhumbula ngenkathi ngimfundisa ngisafika kule nyuvesi enza unyaka wakhe wesibili, kanti ebengikuthanda kakhulu kuyena wumfutho wakhe nokushisekela ukwenza kahle umsebenzi wakhe wokulingisa. Ngimbonile ekhula futhi edlondlobala phambi kwami, futhi ngicabanga ukuthi ushiye emhlabeni into engeke ithathwe wumuntu," kusho uNkk Craigheid. Omunye wabasebenze naye kule ndima uMusa Khumalo naye ukhale ngesihluku okuhambe ngaso uzakwabo endimeni, akuchazse ngokuthi kubuhlungu ukubona ozakwabo abadlule ezandleni ze-DUT bedlula emhlabeni kusabhekwe lukhulu kubona, njengoba besazikhotha amanxeba ngomunye wozakwabo oshone eminyakeni edlule uSenzo Mabanga."Ngeke ngikwazi ukuklala ubungaka begalelo lakhe (uNkosikhona) ngoba mkhulu kakhulu umsebenzi awenzile endimeni. Ngizohlale ngimkhumbulela ukuzibophezela kwakhe kuwo wonke umsebebenzi abenikwe wona. Konke lokhu ngifisa kusiphosele inselelo yokuthi sibambisane ukuqhuba umsebenzi wethu wobuciko ikakhulu ngoba siphila esikhathini lapho indima yethu yezokulingiswa ingahlonishwa futhi inganakiwe njengeminye," kusho uMusa. Kuwo futhi lo mcimbi bekukhona amaciko ehlukene kubalwa nabafunde naye uNkosikhona enyuvesi. Bekukhona nomakadebona wophiko lwezokulingisa lweDUT uSolwazi Debbie Lugte, umlingisi nomqondisi wemidlalo yeshashalazi uSam Hlophe nomlingisi wodumo lakwiSibongile and The Dlaminis uVuyo Biyela, naye osebenze kakhulu noNkosikhona.Lo mlingisi, ushiye emhlabeni izingane zakhe ezimbili, odadewabo nabafowabo. Ulingise emidlalweni okukhona kuyona iGenerations: The Legacy, iWoza Albert ne-Horns of Sorrow. Uzofihlwa ngeSonto lapho edabuka khona Empangeni, enyakatho yaKwaZulu-Natal.

IZINGA eliphezulu lokungasebenzi kwabantu ikakhulukazi intsha sekuphoqe umphakathi waseKlaarwater, eMariannhill, ukuba uqhamuke nohlelo lokulwa nalesi simo.Ngokusho kwephini likasihlalo wekomiti lomphakathi, uMnuz Sifiso Majola, izinga lokungasebenzi kwabantu kule ndawo liphezulu kakhulu kangangokuthi kunemindeni okungasebenzi muntu kuyona."Ngenxa yalesi simo sibone ukuthi ayikho enye indlela esingalungisa ngayo le nkinga ngaphandle kokuthi siwumphakathi sisukume kubekhona esikwenzayo," kusho uMajola. Echaza ngalolu hlelo, uthe kuzosetshenziswa abantu bendawo abanamakhono emikhakheni ehlukene yemisebenzi yezandla."Okuhle ngalokhu wukuthi ngisho nezingane ezifundayo zizophuma ezikoleni ziye kofundela imisebenzi yezandla okuzozisiza ukuthi zikwazi ukuziphilisa uma ziqeda isikole," kuchaza uMajola.UMajola uthe lolu hlelo luzophinde lulekelele ukulwa ngobugebengu nenkinga yezidakamizwa endaweni. Lo mphakathi awuqali ukusungula izinhlelo zokuzithuthukisa njengoba unolwezingadi lapho kutshalwa izinto ezinjengesipinashi, iklabishi, amazambane nokunye okuningi. "Sesiyakwazi ukutshala sidayise siphinde sidle emakhaya. Kulolu hlelo silekelelwa wuMnyango wezoLimo osixhase ngamathuluzi okusebenza nembewu," kusho uMajola.Uthe kukhona amalungu omphakathi asethole ukuqeqeshwa kwezolimoUveze ukuthi sebesungule umfelandawonye nososeshini wabalimi bendawo kanti bamatasa balungisa indawo enkudlwana kulona leli lokishi okuzotshalwa kuyo. Ekutshaleni uthe basebenzisa ulwazi lwabo kanye nabaluthola ezincwadini abazinikwa wumnyango."Iphupho lethu wukuthi iKlaarwater ifakele abezimakethe izitshalo, abezitolo impahla yokugqoka nezikole imifaniswano. Sifuna kwaziwe ukuthi uma ufuna into noma ngabe umakhenikha wemoto uzomthola eKlaarwater."UMajola uthe uhlelo lwamakhono luzophumelela noma kanjani inqobo nje uma umphakathi ubambisene. Uthe sebekwazile ukusungula uhlelo lokuqapha ubugebengu endaweni oselube yimpumelelo lapho abesilisa beqapha indawo ubusuku nemini.Uqhube wathi abesifazane bendawo sebenohlelo lokusiza abashonelwe ngokubahambisela igilosa uma kunesifo."Siyakugqugquzela ukuthi abesilisa bendawo kube yibo abaqapha ubugebengu. Umphakathi usukwazile ukuzihlanganisela imali yokuthenga amakhamera uphinde uzifakele wona." Ngaphezu kwalezi zinhlelo, uthe banolunye abazohlangana kulo neSeta lokuvuselela imizi nezakhiwo kuleli lokishi athe luzobe lweziwa amalungu omphakathi kanye nabazoqeqeshwa ohlelweni lwamakhono.UMajola ugqugquzele ukuba amalungu omphakathi eseke amabhizinisi endawo ukuze kufukulwane. Ekomitini labo kunomnyango obhekele ezamabhizinisi."Sinxusa umphakathi ukuba usukume uzibandakanye ezinhlelweni zentuthuko futhi ubambisane kukho konke okwenziwayo. Sifuna ukuthi indawo yethu ibe yisibonelo esihle nakwezinye. Ubugebengu nezidakamizwa sizokuqeda futhi sifuna ukubuyisa ithemba kubantu ngoba bakhona asebelilahlile ngenxa yezimo zempilo abaphila kuzona."
IMEYA yaseMlalazi ithi nakanjani kumele bazisukumele izigameko zokudlwengulwa kwabesilisa nabesifazane ezilokhu zanda emiphakathini engaphansi komkhandlu.UNkk Queen Xulu ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ethula isabelo sentuthuko esididiyelwe sika-2024/2025, eDlangubo, eShowe.Kulo mhlangano obemele amaphoyisa, uSergeant Dumisani Ntuli, unxuse umphakathi ukuthi ake uzisukumele izigameko ezithe chithi saka zokudlwengulwa kwabesifazane nabesilisa. Uthe eMlalazi la macala athe chithi saka njengoba bewathola ngaso sonke isikhathi."Njengamaphoyisa iyasikhathaza lena yokwanda kwamacala angaka abantu abadlwengulwayo. Ngithanda ukukhuthaza amadoda ukuthi angesabi ukuzobika amacala njengoba nawo emaningi. Okunye esithanda ukuqwashisa emphakathini ngakho ukuthi akuyekwe ukufunwa kwemali kosomabhizinisi abasuke belethe intuthuko. La macala nawo ayanda futhi aphoqa ukuthi izinto zime emphakathini, zingaqhubeki,” kuchaza yena.UNkk Xulu uveze ukuthi kuyabakhathaza okuvezwe amaphoyisa futhi bazonxusa ukuthi umphakathi uzibike izigameko. "Ngigxeka kakhulu uphuzo oludakayo ukuthi lunesandla ekwandeni kwalezi zigameko. Abantu besifazane nabesilisa okumele bakwenze ukuthi bayeke ukuhlala emajoyintini kuze kuse ekuseni ngoba ila ngikholelwa khona ukuthi izigamejko zenzeka khona, kanjalo nezokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane kudalwa uphuzo oludakayo," kuchaza yena Uthe okunye okubakhathazayo yizigameko zomlilo ezakhipha izidumbu kanjalo nemvula eshiywe kukhalwa ngonyaka odlule nakulo nyaka. "Uyabona ngoba sekuqala ubusika, abantu sebezoqala imililo ngonyaka odlule eyasishiya sibhekene nenhlekelele. Engikwaziyo ukuthi le mililo esaba nayo yaqalwa umuntu okuyinto okumele siyibheke kulo nyaka. Angifisi ukuthi kube khona isimo esabhekana naso ngoba saba esibi futhi esibuhlungu. Angeke ngigcine lapho, ngizophinde ngikhulume ngezinhlekelele zemvula ezingajwayelekile, ezikhona kule minyaka. Kusebusika manje kodwa imvula ina ngendlela engajwayelekile. Izigameko zokumuka kwabantu nazo zisihlasele kakhulu ngoba emasontweni adlule, kumuke ingane lapha emfuleni Imfolozi, okuthe kusabhekwa yona kwatholakala izidumbu ezine ezingaziwa ukuthi ngezakuphi,” kuchaza yena.Ukugcizelele ukuthi amabhuloho bona njengomasipala kabawakhi kodwa umsebenzi woMnyango wezokuThutha esifundazweni.Uveze ukuthi isabelomali akade benaso ngonyaka odlule, bayaziqhenya ukuthi basisebenzise kahle ngoba kukhona imigwaqo abayilungisile, amahholo omphakathi kwaphinde kwakhiwa nezindlu zomxhaso emawadini ahlukene. Kulo mcimbi imeya ibe isinikela ngezingubo zokulala kwizaguga ezingu-50, yaphinde yanikela ngezinsiza ezinkulisa zendawo. IKOMITI lokuthuthukiswa komnotho kuMasipala weTheku, seliphasise ukusungulwa kohlaka oluzobhekela ukuguquguquka kwesimo sezulu.Lokhu kwenzeka nje, iTheku lingenye yezindawo ekhahlamezeka kakhulu uma kunemvula enamandla kucekeleke phansi ingqalasizinda kuphinde kuphume imiphefumulo.Isitatimende somkhandlu sithe lolu hlaka luzobamba iqhaza elikhulu ekuhlanganiseni izinhlelo zedolobha zokubhekana nobungozi obungadalwa ukuguquguquka kwesimo sezulu nokwenza ukuthi amaqhinga alo ahambisane nomthetho kazwelonke. "Lolu hlaka luzoqinisekisa ukuthi umasipala uyawulandela umthetho i-International Governance Relations Framework Act, Number 13 ka-2025. Luzosebenza njengesigcawu lapho kuzodingidwa imigomo ethinta ukuguquguquka kwesimo sezulu, kwabelwane ngolwazi kuphinde kuxhunywane nezinye izinhlaka ezithintekayo. "Isitatimende sithe lolu hlaka luzohlanganisa eminye iminyango kahulumeni, izimboni, izifundiswa nomphakathi.Khonamanjalo: Emhlanganweni waleli sonto, kamasipala, kwethulwe neminye imibiko yentuthuko ethinta nokweseka kwesivumelwano sokusebenzisana seminyaka emithathu esiphakathi kweDurban Tourism neGold Circle ukuba basingathe ngokuhlanganyela umcimbi wamahhashi iDurban July kusukela ngo-2025/26 kuya ku-2027/28.Sekulindwe ukuba le mibiko iphasiswe umkhandlu nesigungu.

KUPHOQELEKE ukuba lihanjiswe esibhedlela sikahulumeni iphoyisa elisebenza ngaphansi kukaMasipala waseGoli lijikiswa eNetcare Milpark Hospital.Ngokubika kweSowetan Live, iMilpark ijikise leli phoyisa ebelisesimweni esibucayi kakhulu ngenxa yesikweletu sikamasipala esinguR35 million. Nakuba u-Sarah Wissler ongusihlalo wekomidi elibhekelele ukuphepha komphakathi kulo masipala esekuqinisekisile ukuthi iphoyisa elilimele lisesimweni esibucayi njengamanje e-ICU yase-Charlotte Maxeke Johannesburg Academic Hospital, ufunge wagomela ukuthi uzofuna ukuthi kuphenywe ngazo zonke izikweletu ezingakhokhiwe ezingase zithinte abezimo eziphuthumayo. Umasipala waseGoli ukhiphe isitatimende ezwakalisa ukushaqeka ngalokhu okwenzekile.Ngokusho kwakhe, asikho isikweletu sikaR35 million kodwa singu-3.9 million futhi kunohlelo olusetshenziswayo lokusikhokha njalo ngesonto. Lo masipala uthi uphoxekile ngokwenziwe yileli sibhedlela sijikisa iphoyisa eliphuthunyiswe ngendiza enophephela emhlani lisesimweni esibucayi kakhulu.Umasipala uthi uhlela ukufaka izikhalazo nabeHPCSA ngesenzo salesi sibhedlela. AbeNetcare bayayiphika imibiko yokujikisa iphoyisa. INetcare iqinisekise ukuzibophezela kwayo ekuhlinzekeni ukunakekelwa kubo bonke abantu, kuhlanganise namalungu e-JMPD, futhi iyazichitha izinsolo zokuthi iphoyisa linqatshelwe usizo oluphuthumayo. Bathi ngobusuku bango-Ephreli 30, iphoyisa le-JMPD lathola ukwelashwa okusindisa impilo e-Netcare Milpark Hospital. "Ukulandela ukunikezwa usizo yokuqala olukhethekile lweziguli ezilimele kakhulu futhi ezisengcupheni yokuphangalala, lithe sekunonakala ukuthi isimo salo sizinzile, labe selidluliselwa kwesinye isikhungo esifanele ngaphansi kokuqondisa kukadokotela ohlinzayo," kusho uDkt Erich Bock, umqondisi ophethe we-Netcare's Hospital Division.
UFUNA achaze kabanzi amaphara abephila naye, umndeni wowesifazane wakwesaKwaBiyela, eBhukhanana, kulandela ukutholwa kwesidumbu sakhe sicwiyiwe ngoLwesibili.UNksz Dumisile Xulu (29) kuthiwa utholwa ebulewe nje, bese kuphele cishe amasonto amabili, izihlobo zakhe zagcina ukumbona ephila. Isihlobo, uMnuz Sifiso Biyela, silandisa ngesehlakalo, sithe esinye isihlobo sithole ucingo kumuntu ongaziwa, ethi akuphuthunywe emaphoyiseni aseMpangeni, kumayelana noDumisile."Ngempela kusukunyelwe phezulu, kwanikelwa khona. Amaphoyisa afike asitshela ukuthi utholwe edindilizile ngakujantshi wesiteshi sesitimela eMpangeni," kusho uBiyela. Uthe kule ndawo okutholwe kuyo isidumbu sikamufi ayivamisile ukuhamba muntu, njengoba kwasona isiteshi sesitimela singasasebenzi."Indawo nje enamahlathi. Abantu esiye sibabone benokudlula ngakhona onogada abaqaphe indawo," kusho uBiyela.Uthe abakuqaphele ukuthi isidumbu sakhe bese sithanda ukonakala kodwa kukhombisa ukuthi ulinyaziwe emqaleni. "Akubukeki sengathi ubebulawe ngalo uLwesibili. Cishe bese kunezinsukwana ebulewe kodwa esikuqaphelile ukuthi ubenenxeba elivulekile emqaleni, elikhombisa ukuthi unqunyiwe," kusho uBiyela.Uthe nakuba kukhona izinsolo zokuthi ucwiywe ulimi nesitho sangasese kodwa basalinde umbiko kadokotela wokuhlolwa kwesidumbu ukuze ukuqinisekise lokhu, wathi okubadidile ngesikhathi sebeya kule ndawo okuthiwa kutholwe kuyo isidumbu, yisenzo samaphara avele abanika isikhwama sikamufi. "Sithe uma siwabuza ukuthi umnikazi wesikhwama uphi, athi ubulewe. Sithe uma sesiwabuzisisa ukuthi ubulawe ubani, avele asincisha amehlo," kuchaza uBiyela.Uthe lokhu kubashiye nemibuzo eminingi njengokuthi, sifike kanjani isikhwama sikamufi kuwona njengoba isidumbu sakhe sitholwe endaweni ethe ukuqhela nala avamise ukuhlala khona? "Njengoba isikhwama sakhe sikubona, sifike kanjani? Bamgcine nini ephila? Kungani besincisha amehlo uma sibabuza ngokubulawa kwakhe," kubuza uBiyela.Uthe lolu lwazi balwedlulisele emaphoyiseni ngenhloso yokuthi azokwenza okuthile ngalo. "Kukhona akwaziyo, kukhona akufihlayo," kugcizelela uBiyela othe mhlawumbe kwasuka ingxabano phakathi kwabo, base eyambulala.Echaza umufi, uthe ubengumuntu obuye abuye eze ekhaya, kokunye azihlalele khona lapho ngasesiteshini sesitimela.Uthe nakuba bengeke bazi ukuthi ubezisebenzisa yini izidakamizwa kodwa abanesiqiniseko sakho ukuthi ubezishayela izinkamba zikaFaro. Uveze ukuthi ubenezingane ezintathu, ezineminyaka ephakathi konyaka owodwa neminyaka engu-13.Ikhansela lendawo, uMnuz Silili Msimango, lithe sibashaqisile lesi sigameko.Kuze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela amaphoyisa engaphendulanga.

KUQUBUKE ingebhe yokuthi kungase kubheduke izifo ejele iWestville, eThekwini, kulandela ukuphela kwamanzi.Sibi isimo kuleli jele njengoba sekuphele isonto amanzi engabonwa. Ngokusho kwemithombo emibili engaphakathi eWestville, sekuyoqala isonto lesibili, amanzi engaphumi kompompi baleli jele.Umthombo wokuqala uthe banesikhalo ngalesi simo esibeka impilo yojele neyeziboshwa engcupheni. "Sikhathazekile ngalesi simo, isihlobo sami sivalelwe kuleli jele, silinde ukuqulwa kwecala laso. Leli jele livele linenkinga yokugcwala ngokweqile kweziboshwa, ezimpintshana esitokisini esisodwa. Njengoba sekuphele isonto lonke amanzi engabonwa, lokho kuyakhathaza kakhulu," kusho umthombo.Uthe okubamangazayo ukuthi indawo yomntakabani, iWestville, leli jele elakhiwe eduze kwayo, ayize ingaba nenkinga yamanzi isikhathi eside kanje."Sikhuluma nje bona banawo amanzi. Kuyaxaka ukuthi ijele lona lodwa kule ndawo okuthiwa alinamanzi," kusho umthombo. Umthombo wesibili ongujele, uthe ngesikhathi bebuza ukuthi konakelephi, batshelwe ukuthi kukhona i-pump engasebenzi."Ukulungiswa kwayo kubanjezelwa nawukuthi sekwashintsha indlela yokusebenza uma kunezinkinga ezifuze lezi emajele. Sekulindeleke ukuthi kuqalwe kutholwe imvume kungqongqoshe womnyango ezingeni likazwelonke, ngaphambi kokuthi nkinga iqale ilungiswe," kusho umthombo.Uqhube wathi yinhlekelele yodwa le eyenzeka kuleli jele njengoba ibeka engcupheni impilo yenqwaba yeziboshwa nojele. "Siyafisa ukusizakala masinyane, kungenjalo, kuzogula inqwaba yabantu," kusho umthombo. Isolezwe lithole ukuthi akhona amaloli amanzi awalethayo nsukuzonke, yize engeneli kwazise leli jele likhulu.Kubukeka inkinga yokufa kwama-pump maqede aphuze ukulungiswa, isithanda ukwejwayeleka emajele akulesi sifundazwe.NgoFebhuwari, kulo nyaka, kwenzeke isimo esifanayo ejele laseNcome njengoba kuze kwaphela inyanga ijele lingenamanzi. Nakhona kwabikwa ukuthi kwakulimele yona i-pump. Ngaleso sikhathi Isolezwe lathola umbiko othi iziboshwa seziphila ngokuthi zeqise izinsuku zokugeza ngenxa kokwentuleka kwamanzi.Kwavela nokuthi ezinye zazo sezinokugula okubalwa kukho i-cholera kanjalo notwayi.Kuze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela ungakaphenduli uMnyango wezokuHlunyeleliswa kweziMilo.
UKUQAPHELA izimo ezahlukene zempilo, ezinye zazo ezenza ukuthi abantu badikibale futhi baphelelwe yithemba kwabasuke bezama ukukwenza, ngenye yezinto ezikhuthaze iciko laseNqundu, eNkandla, enyakatho yaKwaZulu-Natal, ukushicilela incwadi egxile kulokho.Lowo wuMnuz Ndumiso Khathi, obhale futhi wakhipha incwadi yeqoqo lezindaba ezimfishane eziwu-20 esihloko sithi Imivimbo Yezihlambi, athi iyindlela asebenzisa ubuciko bakhe ngayo ukubuyisa ithemba lempilo engcono nokulunga kwezinto kubantu okubabhedelayo.UKhathi, okhule evele ekhonze ukufunda izincwadi, ukhiphe le ncwadi eshicilelwe Inhlamva Press kaMnuz Thokozani Gumede, ekuqaleni kwenyanga edlule, kanti isiqalile iyatholakala kuyena ngoR170 kubantu abayidingayo, nabakhonze ukufunda imibhalo eyahlukene yesiZulu. "Kusukela esihlokweni sencwadi, nje ngiveza umcabango ebenginawo ngenkathi ngiyibhala wokuthi ngifisa ukuthi kunoma wubani ozoyifunda, ifane nemvula eza ngamandla, ezodala ukuthi aphaphame futhi abuyelwe ngamandla okuqhubeka nanoma yini ebimehlula."YIncwadi edidiyele izindaba ezinemiyalezo eyahlukene yempilo, okukhona kuyona egxile kakhulu ekuqwashiseni abantu ngezinto nezimo ezahlukene zempilo, bese futhi kuba khona nezinye ezikhuthaza abantu ukungaphosi ithawula kokuhle abakwenzayo," kusho uKhathi. Leli ciko, elizinze eMgungundlovu manje ngokusebenza, lithe kulithathe izinyanga ezimbili ukubhala le ncwadi liyiqede, laveza nokuthi kuyona libheke kakhulu izindaba ezithi Umunwe Wengcebo, Amabheka nethi Umuthi Wamanxiwa.Ngaphandle kwemiVimbo yeziHlambi, uKhathi useke wavela kwezokushicilela izincwadi phambili njengoba eminye yemisebezi yakhe yobuciko itholakala eqoqweni lezindaba ezimfishane elihlelwe wuDKt Nakanjani Sibiya noNksz Nelly Shozana elisihloko sithi Ezosiba nelithi Umjikelo likaMnuz Muntomuhle Mcambi noMnuz Siyabonga Nxumalo.
UMKHONTO weSizwe (MK) uyaqhubeka nokuzidlela amahlanga okhethweni lokuchibiyela komasipala baKwaZulu-Natal.I-MK icoboshise iwadi ebeliphethwe yi-ANC kuMasipala waseMandeni, okhethweni lokuchibiyela obelungoLwesithathu, phezu kwezinxushunxushu ezibekhona.Lolu ukhetho lwesithathu laKwaZulu-Natal olunqotshwa yiMK ngokulandelana njengoba isanda kunqoba obelukuMasipala waseThekwini nobelukuMasipala waKwaDukuza. I-MK inqobe ukhetho obelukuwadi 18 kuMasipala waseMandeni, ngamavoti angu-813, kwathi i-ANC yona yathola amavoti angu-533.Isikhala sekhansela kule wadi savuleka emva kokubulawa kukaMnuz Phendukani Mabhida, owayedume ngokulwa nenkohlakalo.Ngenyanga eyedlule, iMK yahlwitha iwadi ebeliphethwe i-DA kuMasipala waseThekwini uwadi 110, yaphinde yahlwitha newadi ebiphethwe yi-ANC kuMasipala waKwaDukuza, uwadi 28. Ukunqoba ukhetho lwangoLwesithathu kusho ukuthi iMK isinamakhansela amahlanu KwaZulu-Natal njengoba inamakhansela koMasipala waseRichmond, Ray Nkonyeni nowaseMzumbe.Iningi lamawadi asephethwe yiMK KwaZulu-Natal ebekade ephethwe yi-ANC.I-ANC ikhombise ukufadabala okhethweni lwangoLwesithathu njengoba ilale isithathu kule wadi, yadlulwa nayi i-IFP elale isibili. Kube nezinxushunxushu ngesikhathi kuqhubeka ukhetho lwangoLwesithathu. Kwesinye isikhungo kuke kwama kancane ukuvota emva kokunyamalala komshini wokuvota.Kuvele ukuthi esinye isikhulu ebesivotisa sithathe umshini saya kowu-charger emzini oseduze nalesi sikhungo sokuvota esiyitende.Amalungu amaqembu ezepolitiki avuke umbhejazane ngesikhathi ethola ukuthi umshini wokuvota kawusekho esikhungweni sokuvota. Kuma-video asabalale ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, kubonakala isikhulu sixhakathiswe ngamalungu eMK, ebuya naso emzini ongumakhelwane. Lesi sikhulu sibonakala siwuphethe umshini wokuvota, sihamba sixolisa.Amalungu eMK anuke i-ANC ngalesi senzo, athi isikhulu sizwelana ne-ANC kepha i-ANC isiphikile lesikhulu.Unobhala we-ANC esifundeni iGeneral Gizenga, uMnuz Siphesihle Zulu, uthe isikhulu esibanjwe nomshini wokuvota besikhuluma kabi i-ANC ngaphambi kokhetho. "Lesi sikhulu sibanjwe sizama ukunxenxa abantu ukuba bangayivoteli i-ANC. Besihambe sitshela abantu ukuthi uMasipala waseMandeni ophethwe yi-ANC uyahluleka ukulungisa imigwaqo."UZulu uthe ibona ababike ngokunyamalala komshini wokuvota."Sibonga ukuthi inhlangano yokhetho ilusukumele ngokushesha lolu daba." Inhlangano eyengamele ukhetho KwaZulu-Natal, i-Independent Electoral Commission (IEC), ithe simisiwe isikhulu esithintekayo.Isikhulu se-IEC KwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Ntombifuthi Masinga, sithe baqhuba uphenyo ngalolu daba."Esikutholile ukuthi umshini ufike uvele ungenalo i-battery elanele. Sizoluphenya lolu daba ukuze siqinisekise ubuqotho bunqubo yokhetho. Sizibophezele ekuqhubeni ukhetho ngokwethembeka nangaphandle kokwenzelela."UNkk Masinga uthe bazokwenza isimemezelo uma seluphothuliwe ukhetho.

UMKHUZI wamaphoyisa, uGeneral Fannie Masemola, useqinisekisile ukuthi izohlolisiswa imoto iVW Polo ebihamba amaphoyisa aduke ngeledlule kwaze kwatholakala izidumbu zawo emfuleni iHennops, eCenturion, ePitoli, ngoLwesibili.Amaphoyisa, okungoConstable Boipelo Senoge (20), Cebekhulu Linda (24) noKeamogetswe Buys (30), anyamalale esuka eBloemfontein ngoLwesithathu olwedlule elibangise eLimpopo lapho abejutshwe khona.NgoLwesithathu kutholakale ubhampa wePolo kwathi izolo abatshuzi bayikhipha ngokuphelele imoto. UMasemola uthe yize engeyena ungoti kodwa ngokubuka kwakhe imoto sengathi igingqikile yaphonseka emfuleni. Nokho uthe bazoyekela uphenyo kube yilo olushoyo.Ugcizelele ukuthi akulindwe uphenyo ngesikhathi ebuzwa ngabakholwa wukuthi kungenzeka ukuthi amaphoyisa alinyazwe kwenye indawo izidumbu zase zilahlwa emfuleni ngenxa yamacala obekungenzeka ukuthi ayawasebenza."Asinike uphenyo indawo singaphrofethi. Asivumele uphenyo luqhubeke. Abaphenyi balethwe endaweni yesigameko ngenxa yobuchwepheshe okusho ukuthi imoto ike yafika la. Ngenhla komgwaqo kunekhamera esikhombise imoto yehla. Ngeke siphike lutho kodwa futhi asikwazi ukusho ngqo ukuthi nakhu okwenzekie. Asiyekele uphenyo,” kusho uMasemola. Uphinde wacacisa ngezinye izidumbu ezimbili ezitholakale kuwo lo mfula wathi azitholakalanga endaweni efanayo. Ezitholakele ngesolungisa ingadi esiteshini iLyttleton nomabhalane wakhona.Uthe amaphoyisa ngesikhathi ebheka emfuleni ngakuN14 Ben Schoeman Highway athole imoto yakwaRenault ngoMsombuluko obekungeyolungisa ingadi hhayi lapho kutholakale khona izidumbu zamaphoyisa.Uthe umufi ubehlala budebuduze nendawo yesigameko. Esinye isidumbu sitholakale kolunye uhlangothi. UMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa udlulise amazwi enduduzo emindenini yabashonelwe.
UDIDEKILE futhi ushaqekile umndeni wowesifazane waseNgwavuma, okuthiwa uzikhungile ngemuva kokuba abakhongi bengazange balubhade kubo njengokwesethembiso sesoka.Kuvela ukuthi umufi, uNksz Sinethemba Jiyane (38), utholakale esezilengisile egumbini lakhe lokulala. Udadewabo kamufi, uNksz Xoliswa Jiyane, uthe bebekade belindele ukufika kwabakhongi, abebezothunywa "umkhwenyana", uMnuz Zolani Chonco waKwaMaphumulo, ngempelasonto.Uthe kodwa lokhu akubange kusenzeka ngemuva kokuba umkhwenyana ethole ngomzuzu wokugcina ukuthi umufi uyajola emsebenzini nomunye uzakwabo esikoleni afundisa kusona. Eqhuba, uthe njengomndeni bathole esezihilele umufi ukuthi uthole lezi zindaba isoka, langabe lisabathumela abakhongi.''Sibalinde kwaze kwaphela usuku, abakhongi lutho ukufika ngoMgqibelo. Udadewethu selokhu ngazalwa angikaze ngimbone enjeya. Ubekhala engathuli. Ebusuku ngihlale naye elokhu ebalisa ngokuthi isoka lidlale ngaye,'' usho kanje.Uthe ngakusasa ngeSonto ekuseni, isoka lishayele ucingo umufi lamtshela ukuthi makacele uthisha lo ajola naye esikoleni ukuthi akaye komlobola. ''Udadewethu ube esegonyuluka kimina wavuma nokuthi uyathandana nalo thisha. Uthe kodwa akazi ukuthi le ndaba ifinyelele kanjani 'kumkhenyana' obezofika ezolobola,'' usho kanje.NgoMsombuluko ekuseni, uthe uqaphelile uma kushaya u-10 ekuseni engavukile umufi ukuthi kukhona okungahambi kahle ngoba nguyena muntu osheshe avuke kwabo. ''Ngibe sengiya egumbini lakhe ngamfica eselenga,'' usho kanje ekhala. Uthe ngemuva kwalokho, ubatshelile abazali bakhe ukuthi kwenzekeni nokuthi kungani abakhongi begcine bengafikanga.Wenqabile ukudalula igama lesikole umufi abekade efundisa kusona, wathi akaboni ukuthi lokho kubaluleke ngani.Uveze ukuthi isimo sibi kunina kamufi ngoba akasadli futhi uyehluleka ukwamukela isimo esehlile emndenini sokushona kwendodakazi yakhe. Isolezwe limthintile uChonco wavuma ukuthi ukuhoxisile ukuthumela abakhongi.Uthe ubengeke athumele abakhongi kubo kamuntu ongaziphethe kahle.''Wena ke mfowethu ubungaqhubeka yini uyolobola emva kokuba sewuthole le nto mina engiyitholile? Phendula ndoda ngiyabuza?'' kusho uChonco entathelini kuzwakala ukuthi uphoxekile futhi udidekile. Uzwakale ethuka uma intatheli imbuza ukuthi usezwile yini ukuthi lokhu kumphathe kabi lo wesifazane wase ezihilela."Hayibo ndoda! Unamanga, ungayisho leyo nto. Angayenza yini leyo nto? Kade phela abantu bakubo bengishayela ucingo nabo ngibaziba,'' usho kanje evala ucingo engasavalelisanga.Kuze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela amaphoyisa aKwaZulu-Natal, engaphendulanga emibuzweni athunyelelwe yona.
LUYA enkantolo olokubola kwesidumbu somfundi waseDurban Girls Secondary uWandile Ngcobo, okusolakala ukuthi wadlwengulwa wabulawa ekubo ngonyaka odlule.Umufi owayefunda uGrade 11, kuvela ukuthi wahlaselwa ngabesilisa abangaziwa esele yedwa kubo kwa-D eMlaza eningizimu yeTheku bamenzakalisa.Kunezimpawu zokuthi waqale wadlwengulwa ngaphambi kokuba abulawe. Ngemuva kwezinyanga ezimbalwa abasolwa ababili okunguMnuz Sifundo Bhengu (39) ongummangalelwa wokuqala noMnuz Bongani Jili (25) ongummangalelwa wesibili bakhalelwa ngamasongo kaSigonyela. Laba ababili muva nje basanda kuchakidana bodwa umsolwa wesibili ekhomba owokuqala ngenjumbane ethi uyena owabulala umufi.Ngemuva kokubulawa kukamufi uyise, uMnuz Mondli Ngcobo, wahambisa isidumbu emakhazeni kahulumeni asePark Rynie.Uthe wethuka koma nasozwaneni efica isidumbu somntwana sesonakele. "Sesiyotholana enkantolo noMnyango wezeMpilo waKwaZulu Natal. Kwangisiza kakhulu ukuthi ngithi asivulwe isidumbu ngesikhathi ngiyosilanda ukuze ngibone ukuthi sesonakele. Ukube angikwenzanga lokho njengoba abamakhaza kahulumeni babenqaba ukusivula, ngabe angazanga,'' usho kanje.Isolezwe liwabonile amaphepha aveza ukuthi uMnyango wezeMpilo esifundazweni sewufakwe enkantolo.UNgcobo namanje uyakhala ngoMnyango wezeMpilo athi ukholwa wukuthi wamhlizela ezibini. Uthi ukholwa wukuthi uzobuthola ubulungiswa njengoba leli cala seliya enkantolo nje.AboMnyango wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal bathe ngeke baphawule ngoba udaba lusezithebenij zenkantolo. .

Yinto okumele silwe nayo ukuze nabo bazizwe bephephile." "Asisangeni kakhulu ekutheni ubani okumele axoshwe nokungamele. Ekugcineni uMengameli nguyena okumele anqume ngekusasa likaGodongwana." Usho lokhu nje amaqembu afana ne-EFF afuna uGodongwana akhonjwe indlela.UNksz Losi uthe abeneme ngendlela uMnyango kaMgcinimafa asebenza ngayo."Aseneme ngendlela izinto ezenzeka ngayo eMnyangweni kaMgcinimafa, kusuka kudala. Kumele kwenziwe okuthile ngalo mnyango."Umgubho kazwelonke wosuku lwabasebenzi uzoba senkundleni iKees Taljaard eMiddleburg, eMpumalanga. Kulindeleke ukuthi kukhulume uRamaphosa neSACP.
UZOQALA ngeSonto elizayo umhlangano wokuqoka umholi omusha webandla lamaRoma aKhatholika.Umhlangano wokuqoka umholi omusha uzoqala ngoMsombuluko, akwaziwa ukuthi uzodonsa kuze kube nini.Lokhu kumenyezelwe yikomkhulu lebandla, iVatican. Okhulumela iVatican, Matteo Bruni, uthe abefundisi bazoqala ngomthandazo ozokuba seSt Peter's Basilica, e-Italy.Uthe emva kwalokho kuzokube sekungena umhlangano wokuqoka umholi webandla ozokuba se-Sistine Chapel.Umhlangano wokuqoka umholi webandla uzohanjelwa abefundisi ababalelwa ku-135. Munye umfundisi oqhamuka eNingizimu Afrika ozokuba yingxenye yomhlangano, okunguCardinal Stephen Brislin, waseGoli.Uhlelo lokuqoka umholi omusha kulindeleke ukuthi luthathe izinsuku njengoba bebaningi abefundisi abazovota.Ozoqokwa kufanele athole isibalo samavoti angaphezu kuka-66%. Uma engathola isibalo esanele samavoti kuzophinde kuqalwe phansi.Bangu-15 abefundisi okuzoqokwa kubona.Kuvele sekuqalile ukuqagela ngegama lozongena esikhundleni. Kukhona abaphusha umkhankaso wokuthi isikhundla sinikezwe umuntu omnyama, okungaba yingqophamalndo njengoba leli bandla lingakaze liphathwe wumuntu omnyama.Abefundisi abamnyama abasethubeni lokukhethwa, nguCardinal Peter Turkson (76), waseGhana, noCardinal Robert Sarah (79), waseGuinea.Abanye baphakamisa igama likaCardinal Luis Antonio Tagle, oqhamuka ezwenikazi i-Asia. Nakho ukuqokwa kukaTagle kungaba yingqophamlando njengoba engakaze abe khona umholi webandla oqhamuka e-Asia.Izinkumbi zabantu zizobe zilinde ngaphandle komhlangano ukuzwa ukuthi useqokiwe yini umholi omusha. Isikhundla somholi webandla sivuleke emva kokushona kukaPope Francis, owashona emasontweni amabili edlule.UFrancis washona emva kokuxinwa wukugula, ungcwatshwe ngoMgqibelo.Umngcwabo wakhe wawuhanjelwe yizinkumbi zabantu eziqhamuka emhlabeni wonke, bekunezinkonzo zokumkhumbula nakwezinye izindawo.
SEKUVELE ukuthi bese kungokwesihlanu kugingqika izimoto endaweni okuphaphalaze kuyo iloli lamanzi, eShayamoya, e-Edendale, eMgungundlovu ngeSonto ebusuku.Kulesi sehlakalo kudlule amalungu amabili omndeni wakwaDlamini, okubandakanya nengane eneminyaka eyisithupha.Ilungu lomphakathi laku-ward 11, elisondelene kakhulu nalo muzi okushone abantu ababili kuwona, uMnuz Phakamani Kheswa, lidalule ukuthi bewumphakathi kuyabakhathaza kakhulu ukwanda kwezigameko ezinjena, ikakhulu njengoba kulokhu kuze kwaholela ekufeni kwabantu ababili bomndeni owodwa.Kulimale nabanye ababili okubalwa kubona nomshayeli weloli, olimale kabi.Exoxa neSolezwe uKheswa, uthe bewumphakathi basavevezela namanje uma becabanga indlela okwenzeke ngayo lesi sehlo.Uthe bakhathazekile ngokuthi sekuze kufika lapho kuphuma imiphefumulo yabantu khona. "Sekungokwesihlanu kwenzeka isimo esinjena kuyo le ndawo esiyakhele njengoba kuke kwenzeka esikhathini esedlule kugingqika izimoto amahlandla amane, ngokwehlukana kwezinsuku. Okubi kakhulu wukuthi kuthe kwenzeka manje, kwadlula nemiphefumulo yabantu abangenacala, futhi abebengeke bakwazi ukwenza lutho ukuzivikela,” usho kanje.Eqhuba uthe inkinga enkulu nedala ukuthi kube lula ukwenzeka kwezigameko ezinjena wukuthi indawo okwakhiwe kuyona iyiwa, okwenza ukuthi uma imoto iqhamuka yehla igijima, kube lula ukuthi umshayeli imphunyuke, bese ingena emizini yabantu."Asazi ngempela ukuthi singenza kanjani ukulungisa lesi simo ngoba phela ngeke abantu basuke lapho bakhe khona njengoba imizi eminingi iseduze nomgwaqo. Eminye yawo ayibiyiwe, okwenza kube lula ukufohla kwezimoto zngene kuyona,” kusho uKheswa. Kuthintwa ikhansela, uMnuz Sanele Zuma, lithe bewubuholi bomphakathi baphatheke kabi ngenxa yalesi simo.Uthe inkinga enkulu yiyo leyo yokuthi abantu bakhile kule ndawo, kanti iyiwa futhi akulula nokushayela kahle kuyona ngoba yehlela mawala.Uveze ukuthi kunejika eliyingozi, okungelula ukulawula imoto kulona ikakhulu uma ugijima noma imoto isesimeni esingesihle."Nokho sesivele sesiluqalile uhlelo lokuthi kube nokokunciphisa ijubane kubashayeli abahamba kule ndawo. Lokhu asikwazi ukukuphuthumisa ngokushesha ngenxa yokungeneli kwemali eklanyelwe lo msebenzi. Nokho nje siyacela kubashayeli ukuthi bacophelele kakhulu uma behamba kule ndawo ukuze kugwemeke izingozi ezinjena ngokuzayo.”

UmbuzoSAWUBONA ntombi yakwaQwabe, ngicela ungisize ungilekelele ngane yakwethu nakhu ngisobishini la. Ngiyinsizwa esencane, nginomawengane engingasathandani naye ngenxa yokuthi ugxajelwa yikhanda.Uyinkinga nangumuntu wesifazane, MaGumede. Sengike ngazama ukumqonda ngimbuze kodwa aphike, avele athi mina ngizomhlukumeza uzongibophisa. Angisazi ukuthi ngiyenzenjani lento ngoba lo sisi uyangikhathaza.
