KUQHUME isibhakela esiqhwiza umentshisi kumuhluzana amalungu e-ANC Youth League (ANCYL) abehambele ingqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi beqembu esifundeni iMzala Nxumalo.Ingqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi obekuhlelwe ukuthi ibe ngempelasonto oPhongolo, igcine ibhuntsha emva kokuba kutholane phezulu izinhlangothi ezimbili ebezibanga izikhundla.Ubuholi be-ANCYL KwaZulu-Natal buziqhelisile nale ngqungquthela, bathi akuzange kulandelwe imigomo ngesikhathi ihlelwa. Ngokuthola kweSolezwe ubuholi be-ANCYL KwaZulu-Natal, bebuvele bungahambisani nokuthi ingqungquthela ibe kule mpelasonto.Isolezwe libone incwadi ebhalwe wubuholi be-ANCYL esifundazweni, ebhekiswe kunobhala jikelele we-ANCYL, uMnuz Mntuwoxolo Ngudle, lapho ubuholi besifundazwe bebukhala ngokungalandelwa kwemigomo ngesikhathi kuhlelwa ingqungquthela.Kule ncwadi ubuholi besifundazwe bukhale ngokuba nhlakanhlaka kwethimba lesikhashana elihola i-ANCYL esifundeni iMzala Nxumalo. "Njengamanje kunohlangothi oluhamba nomdidiyeli wethimba, kube nohlangothi oluhamba nomgqugquzeli wethimba. Zombili lezi zinhlangothi zihlela ukuba nezingqungquthela zokukhetha ubuholi. Asazi ukuthi iyona yiphi ingqungquthela okuzothiwa isemthethweni."Kuma video asabalale ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, kubonakala amalungu efinyisana igazi, aze agxobane nangezinyawo.Kwenye ivideo kubonakala abesilisa beshova iqupha, badudulana beze beyowisana phansi. Kwamanye ama video kubonakala ezinye izithunywa zivinjwa esangweni, zizama ukungena.Unobhala we-ANCYL KwaZulu-Natal, uNksz Lulama Mabude, uthe ibingekho emthethweni le ngqungquthela.Uthe ubuholi be-ANCYL eMzala Nxumalo, bahlakazwa ngenxa yakho ukungaboni ngaso linye. Ngokwakhe umuntu obehlela ingqungquthela akanalo ilungelo njengoba ethe iminyaka ayisamvumeli ukuthi abe yilungu le-ANCYL."Kuyishwa ukuthi umuntu ongaselona ilungu le-ANCYL ukhethe ukuhlela ingqungquthela mbumbulu ye-ANCYL. Lesi sinqumo esiwubudedengu asigcinanga nje ngokudelela ubuholi be-ANCYL, kodwa siphinde sabeka engozini abantu abasha. Iqiniso wukuthi ihhovisi likanobhala yilona kuphela elinelungelo lokumemezela ukuhlala kwezingqungquthela zokukhetha ubuholi."UNksz Mabude uthe bazothathelwa izinyathelo zokuqondiswa ubugwegwe labo okuzothalakala ukuthi baphula imigomo yenhlangano. "Ngeke sibabekezelele abantu abasebenzisa igama le-ANCYL ukuze kuzuze bona kuphela. I-ANCYL yinhlangano ehloniphekile."Kube nezinxushunxushu nakwezinye izingqungquthela zokukhetha ubuholi be-ANCYL ebeziKwaZulu-Natal ngempelasonto. Kube nokuhilizisana ezingqungqutheleni zokukhetha ubuholi be-ANCYL ezifundeni iHarry Gwala neNkosi Bhambatha, kubangwa ukungalandelwa kwemigomo.Zombili lezi zingqungquthela zigcine ziqhubekile, kwakhethwa ubuholi obusha.
UMSOLWA oneminyaka engu-29 ubudala kulindeleke ukuthi avele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMasoyi ngemuva kokuboshwa ngesikhathi amaphoyisa emthola ilele embhedeni eduze kwamathambo okukholakala ukuthi abekhishwe emathuneni.Umsolwa uboshwe ngoMsombuluko ngemuva kokuthi amaphoyisa alandele umbiko awutholile mayelana nokumbiwa kwamathuna aseSwalala, eMasoyi, ngaseWhite River.Ngokusho kwamaphoyisa, ngezithuba zabo-13:30 ngoMsombuluko owesifazane ungene esiteshini samaphoyisa eMasoyi ezobika ukuthi kunowesilisa ombe amathuna amabili.Okhulumela amaphoyisa aseMpumalanga uBrig Donald Mdhluli uthe amathuna ahlonzwa ngelikayise kanye nomkhulu kamsolwa, abangcwatshwa ngo-2010."Amaphoyisa aseMasoyi asamukele isikhalo aqala uphenyo, ngesikhathi efika emathuneni aqinisekisile ukuthi amathuna aphazamisekile. Amaphoyisa anikele kumsolwa lapho ahlala khona eSwalala, amthola elele embhedeni wakhe namathambo okukholakala ukuthi yilawa awambe emathuneni eseduze kwakhe,” kusho uMdhluli.Umsolwa ubhekene necala lokuphazamisa amathuna.
KWENZEKE okungavamile eMancence, eNtambanana, owesilisa okuvele ukuthi ubesevulelwe icala lokudlwengula umshana, ezilengisa ngesikhathi kufika amaphoyisa ethi azombopha. Umufi (28), igama lakhe elingeke lidalulwe ukuze kuvikelwe umgilwa (12), yena osadla anhlamvana, kuthiwa uzihilele ngoLwesine.Ngokusho kukayise kamufi, bebezihlalele nje ekhaya ngoLwesine bexoxa nomufi ngokuthile. Uthe umufi ubekhuluma naye emi emnyango wenye yezindlu, wambona ehwaqabala ebusweni, emva kokubona imoto yamaphoyisa emgwaqweni ongenela ekhaya."Uthe esuka wabe engena ngaphakathi kule ndlu abemi emnyango wayo. Ngisukile lapho ebengikhona ngeza ngakuyo le ndlu, ngifuna ukubona ukuthi yini le eyenza ashintshe ebusweni. Ngibe sengibona kungena imoto yamaphoyisa,” kusho uyise kamufi, owumkhulu kumgilwa.Uthe amaphoyisa afike amtshela ukuthi ahamba nomgilwa nonina, abebeyovulela umsolwa icala, owumalume kamgilwa. "Ngishaqeke kwaphela nasozwaneni, ngizibuza ukuthi mihlola mini le engehlelayo emzini kababa. Nokho emva kokuxoxa namaphoyisa imizuzu embalwa, ngibe sengithuma yena umgilwa, ukuthi akahambe ayombiza umalume wakhe kule ndlu engimbone engena kuyo. Sizwe ngaye esekhihla isililo, ethi umalume usezibulele,” kusho uyise kamufi.Uthe bahambe bayobheka insumansumane ebebeyitshelwa umgilwa, bamfica elenga umufi."Angikaze ngiyibone into enje. Ngehlelwe yimishophi emibili ngesikhathi esisodwa. Bengisathuswe yikho lokhu kokuthi uvulelwe icala lokudlwengula, ngathi ngisamangazwe yilokho, nangu naye esevele ezibulala,” kusho uyise kamufi, othe uyabona ukuthi uzibulale ngesikhathi ebona amaphoyisa esondela nganeno. Uqhube wathi zimshaqisile izinsolo zokudlwengula ngoba umufi ubebukeka eyindodana ehloniphayo, engazibandakanyi nobugebengu, engaphuzi futhi engabhemi.Uthe ngesikhathi esenaba ngesenzo sokudlwengula, amaphoyisa athe umgilwa uveze ukuthi senzeka ngoFebhuwari kuwo lo nyaka. "Kuvela ukuthi ubhale incwadi eshoyo ukuthi umalume uyamnukubeza, wayiphonsa esikhwameni sikanina obeyoqala umsebenzi omusha ngoLwesibili,” kusho uyise kamufi, othe unina kamgilwa incwadi uze wayibona ngoLwesithathu ekuseni, ngesikhathi esethulula isikhwama, wabe esenikela emaphoyiseni. Uyise kamufi uthe ufe olwebiza njengoba ngokwakhe bekungamele azibulale umsolwa."Ngizithole sengikhuluma nesidumbu silenga, ngimbuza ukuthi kodwa ubusungaze uzibulale pho, kunokuthi uyeke umthetho usebenze, liqulwe icala, unikwe leso sijeziso ozosinikwa, uma sesiphelile isigwebo, ubuye uze ekhaya? Pho ke, bese ngikhuluma nomuntu ongeke esangiphendula. Ngilimele,” usho kanje. Uthe ukwenzeka kwesigameko kumkhumbuze inkulumo eyavuka bezixoxela ngawo uFebhuwari, bebona udaba lokudlwengulwa kwengane kwithelevishini."Ngaxoxa nje, ngibuza ukuthi kodwa umuntu owenza into enje usuke esengenwe yini? Waphendula ngelithi kanti baba iyabavelela le nto abantu (abasolwa), bengathandi. Wanezela ngokuthi yena uma kungamfica, angavele azilengise, amaphoyisa ayomfica esebanda,” kusho uyise kamufi. Uqhube wathi umufi wanezela ngokuthi uyobe ezilengisela ukuthi uhlulwe umthetho wasekhaya ngoba bakhuliswe kahle ngakho kuyobe kungasamfanele ukuphila, esephoxe uyise. "Ngayivala leyo ngxoxo ngokuthi ngithi kufanele bajeze abenzi balolu hlobo lobugebengu. Uma sengibuka lokhu akwenzile, kusobala ukuthi ngalesiya sikhathi siba nale ngxoxo, wayevele eseyinukubezile ingane,” kusho uyise kamufi, obelokhu ekuphindaphinde njalo ukuthi ulimele. Ucele usizo lokwelulekwa ngokomqondo, kulandela isigameko, wathi umgilwa ozithele phezu kwakhe elenga, uyaludinga usizo lokwelulekwa ngokomqondo.Uveze ukuthi nabo bewumndeni bayaludinga usizo olufanayo ngoba umshophi obavelele uyabasinda.Siye koshicilela amaphoyisa engakaphawuli.
UMNDENI wowesilisa waseNtuzuma, oboshelwe icala lokudlwengula intombazane, uphika ulala ngomhlane ukuthi lo wesilisa uyilungu leqembu lemigulukudu esatshwayo, elidume ngokuqotha ngenhlamvu eNanda namaphethelo, iWest.Umsolwa oneminyaka engu-24 ubhekene necala lokudlwengula intombazane eneminyaka engu-14, esigamekweni okuthiwa senzeka emijondolo yaseNtuzuma.Umndeni womsolwa uzifikele qathatha emahhovisi eSolezwe, uzokhipha ingonyuluka ngakho konke okwenzeka kuleli cala. Eqhulwini uveze ukuthi kungamampunge ukuthi umsolwa uyilungu leWest.Leli cala lisenkantolo yeMantshi yaseNtuzuma."Ngiyakweshwama mina ukuthi umntanami uyilungu leWest. Angiyazi ukuthi isukaphi ngempela le nto yokuthi mina ngizala izingane eziyiWest,'' usho kanje, ebusweni kubonakala ukuthi iyamnenga le nto unina womsolwa.Eqhuba uthe uthathe isinqumo sokuzifikela mathupha emahhovisi aleli phephandaba ngoba ubefuna ukugeza igama lomsolwa nelamadodana akhe. Uthe akangabazi nje nakancane ukuthi lizovela iqiniso enkantolo mayelana nalolu daba ngokuhamba kwesikhathi.Usole unina wengane okuthiwa ingumgilwa ngokuphehla udweshu.''Uyabona nje okokuqala umsolwa akazange alandwe ngamaphoyisa ngosuku aboshwa ngalo. Kunalokho walandwa yiqulu lamadoda, athatha umsolwa amyisa esiteshini samaphoyisa saseNtuzuma,'' usho kanje. Uveze ukuthi yena uyisangoma, akazwani nokukhuluma nesixakaxaka esingenasidingo."Yingakho ngifuna ukuthi lolu daba olusenkantolo luphathiswe okwezikhali zamaNtungwa ukuze ekugcineni kungachitheki igazi." Elinye ilungu lalo mndeni lithe umsolwa ungowesilisa oqotho futhi othembekile.Liveze ukuthi yingakho bedidekile uma eboshelwa icala lalolu hlobo futhi bakhathazekile njengoba sebethuka izanya. "Kunemoto esiilandelayo noma yikuphi lapho sihamba khona. Asazi ukuthi kungani lo muntu enza le nto ayenzayo,'' usho kanje. Liveze ukuthi kuke kwabakhona isikhathi lapho badutshulwa khona kodwa basinda. Enkantolo lithi baphathiswa okwezingcanga uma beze khona ngenxa yokuthi kusuke kunabalandeli abaningi be-EFF."Sishaywa nangezimpama uma size enkantolo yaseNtuzuma. Uyabona nje ukuthi bahlose ukusihlukumeza ngamabomu,'' lisho kanje. Nalo leli lungu liphike lalala ngomhlane ukuthi umsolwa uyilungu leqembu lemigulukudu elisatshwayo iWest."Angazi ngempela ukuthi isukaphi le nto yokuthi umsolwa uyiWest, ayikho nje leyo nto,'' lisho kanje.Ilungu lesithathu lomndeni womsolwa lithe sebethola ngisho imiyalezo ebasabisayo, yokuthi mabahambe endaweni.Nalo lichaze umsolwa njengemvu yeNkosi, engabhemi engaphuzi futhi engenalo nodlame. Ligcizelele ukuthi umsolwa ubhecwa ngobende nje inyama engazange ayithi mbibi. ''Asazi sonke ukuthi kungani bemsukela ngalokhu okuthiwa ukwenzile."Uthe abayithandi le nto yokuthi kube khona abantu ababazingelayo.Phambilini kuhlaluke ukuthi umgilwa ubeyintshitshi ngaphambi kokuba adlwengulwe. Ngesikhathi icala ligcina ukuba senkantolo, ngaphandle kwayo kwakunamalungu e-EFF ayebhikisha.Icala libuyela enkantolo ngoJuni 3.Muva nje amaphoyisa asanda kujuqa abesilisa abane okwabikwa ukuthi bangamalungu eWest emgwaqweni uM4 Highway eMlaza.
IZINTOMBI ZaKwaXimba eNumber 9 zigubhe uSuku lweNkululeko ngokumashela ukuhlukunyezwa kwabantu besifazane nezingane emigwaqweni yakule ndawo. Ngaphambi kokugcwala imigwaqo izintombi ziqale zakhempa ubusuku bonke ehholo lomphakathi lapho bezikhuthazwa futhi ziqwashiswa ngezihlava ezihlukahlukene ngongoti bemikhakha ehlukene. Omunye unomehlo waKwaXimba, uNkk Sthembile MaNgubane Ndlovu, uthe bahlanganise izintombi nto ngenhloso yokuba zihlonyiswe ngolwazi futhi zixwayiswe ngezinto eziyingozi ezihlukumeza abantu besifazane kulezi zinsuku. Uthe bebedonsa izintombi ngendlebe bethi azifunde ukwamukela isimo sasemakubo ngoba abanye abantu besifazane bazithola sebehlukumezeka othandwenii ngenxa yokuthi basuke belandela ibhodwe eliconsayo. Uqhube wathi babuye bagqugquzela izintombi ukuba zigxile emfundweni ukuze zithole imisebenzi engcono engenza zikwazi ukuguqula impilo yasemakubo. UNkk Ndlovu uthe babuye baxwayisa izintombi ngeziqumama eziziheha ngezinto ezinhle kanti ziqonde ukucekela phansi ikusasa lazo."Kufanele ziyeke ukuhalela impilo ezingakafiki kuyo nezinto eziwubukhazikhazi ekubeni zingazithenganga ngemali yazo. Kunomuntu intombi ezozwana naye, ayenzele konke okuhle, intombi ize izitshele ukuthi uyayithanda, akabheke lutho kuyo, kanti uzoyiphendukela esiswini njengotshwala, ayidlwengule, esefuna ikhokhele zonke izinto abeyinika zona," kusho uNkk Ndlovu obebambisene noNkk Nomthandazo Khanyile, Nkk Zethu Mkhize, uNkk Dumazile Maphanga noNksz Zandile Hlongwane. Ubuye wadonsa izintombi ngendlebe wathi azibaxwaye o-lift ezibanikezwa ngabantu besilisa ngoba abanye bakhohlakele. "Nasekhaya intombi mayingathembi muntu ngoba kukhona ongayigila ngoba efuna ukuyala umzali wayo. Intombi uma kukhona ekusolayo okwenziwa wuyise noma wumfana wakubo, njengokuthi ayipopole igeza noma asho okuthize ngomzimba wayo, ayisibikele ukuze lusheshe lusukunyelwe lolo daba. Intombi mayingathuli ize ificwe wukudlwengulwa noma wukufa." UNkk Ndlovu uthe izintombi zibuye zathola amazwi anobuhlakani kosonhlakalahle, abahlengikazi nasemaphoyiseni. Izikhulumi bekungumhlengikazi waseMsunduzi, uSister Nonhlanhla Gonya, umsebenzi wakwaMasipala uMnuz Zwe Mlungisi nokhulumele abazali uNkk Lungelo Ngubane kanye Mnuz Ngidi (elingatholakalanga igama lakhe) okhulumele amaphoyisa aseMsunduze Kwenzeka lokhu nje kuhlale kukhalwa ngezibalo eziphezulu zokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane kuleli.
UPHITHENE amakhanda umndeni wesaguga saseMthombisi oThongathi, osekuyophela inyanga singaziwa emva kokuphuma ekhaya siyokha imfino.UNkk Cwelani Jayiya (87), kuthiwa wanyamalala ngoMashi 27 kulo nyaka.Umzukulu, uNkk Nonkululeko Ntshangase, uthe uNkk Jayiya ubehlala nesihlobo esasheshe sabona ukuthi kukhona okushaya amanzi ngesikhathi engabuyi ekhaya. Uthe isihlobo savuka ngakusasa sahlaba umkhosi, sitshela ezinye izihlobo, omakhelwane, namalungu omphakathi."Kwaqala kwacingwa yonke indawo, lutho ukutholakala, kwaze kwayobikwa nasemaphoyiseni,” kuchaza uNkk Ntshangase.Uthe kwakhuluma nabo uNkk Jayiya, wathi usaya emapulazini, uyokha imfino, bese eyoyidayisa. "Ujwayele vele ukuyikha cishe nsuku zonke, bese eyahamba ayoyidayisa, azitholele amasenti,” kusho uNkk Ntshangase.Uthe uNkk Jayiya yize esegugile kodwa usenawo amandla okuzenzela izinto ezehlukene."Ukuyokha kwakhe imfino yinto abeyenza ngaphandle kokukhathala. Ungumuntu osakwazi ngisho nokutheza izinkuni. Okuningi usazenzela, futhi nomqondo wakhe usebenza kahle,” kuchaza uNkk Ntshangase. Uthe ngesikhathi becinga kukhona ababekuzwa, okunye kwakubethusa.Phakathi kwako wukuthi bakhona abathi bambona esendleleni eya khona emapulazini okwakha isithombe sokuthi waya ngempela ukuyokha imfino. Uthe okubathusile yizinsolo zokuthi sekunesikhathi abanikazi bamapulazi bengahambisani nendaba yabantu abangena emapulazini abo, bezozenzela izinto ezithandwa yibo njengakho ukukha imfino. Uthe abanikazi bamapulazi basola abantu ngokweba izitshalo."Kuthiwa uma kwenzekile wabanjwa, bayakuthatha bayokuphonsa eweni elibudebuduze namapulazi,” kusho uNkk Ntshangase.Uqhube wathi ukhona nonogada wasepulazini, oke waveza ukuthi uNkk Jayiya wambelwa omkhulu umgodi, wafakwa khona,” kusho uNkk Ntshangase, othe lonke lokhu, kubashiya bethuthumela.Uveze ukuthi konke lokhu bakubikele amaphoyisa ngethemba lokuthi azokwenza okuthile. Uthe zonke lezi zinsolo ziyabathusa ngoba zakha isithombe sokuthi mhlawumbe uNkk Jayiya wabulawa. "Sesikhalela ithambo lakhe,” usho kanje.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal Colonel Robert Netshiunda, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi idokodo lokuduka komuntu lavulwa esiteshini samaphoyisa eMhlali. "Lona odukile usafunwa,” kusho uNetshiunda
UNGQONGQOSHE wezeZimali, uMnuz Enoch Godongwana, umemezele usuku azokwethula ngalo isabelomali esisha.UGodongwana uveze ukuthi isabelomali esisha uzosethula ngoMeyi 21, ePhalamende.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba. Ukwethulwa kwesabelomali esisha kulandela ukuchithwa kwesiphakamiso sikaGodongwana sokunyusa intela eyengezwa ezintweni ezithengwayo.Isiphakamiso sokunyusa intela ngo-0.5% sachithwe iNkantolo eNkulu eWestern Cape.UGodongwana uthe unethemba lokuthi iPhalamende lizophasisa isabelomali esisha ungakashayi umnqamulajuqu wangoJulayi.
BANETHEMBA lokuthi kuzobehlisa ubugebengu ukufakwa kwama-boom gate ezindaweni ezimbili eNtuzuma.Lokhu kushiwo umsunguli weThekwini Neighbourwood Watch, uMnuz Andile Jali, emva kwesiqalo salolu hlobo lokuqapha ubugebengu.Ekhuluma neSolezwe uthe, okwamanje basawafake ezindaweni ezimbili."Siwafake ngakwaNozaza, nokuyindawo esekungeneni uma uya ezikhungweni ezifana neSizakala Centre, umtholampilo nokunye. Enye siyifake emgwaqweni oseduze nemizi esanda kuhlushwa yizigebengu, zigqekeza, zithatha impahla, zaze zadlwengula nabantu,” kusho uJali. "Ukufakwa kwawo kusiza ekutheni izigebengu zicabanga kabili ngaphambi kokungena ngawo ngoba ziba novalo lokuthi zizobonakala, bese zibizelwa amaphoyisa ziboshwe. Ziphinde zicabange ukuthi uma kwenzekile zakwazi ukungena, kungenzeka zivaleleke ngaphakathi, bese zingena enkingeni,” kuchaza uJali.Uthe basanxusa kosomabhizinisi ukuthi babaxhase ngemali yokuthi bawasabalalise ezindaweni eziningi, bakhe nezindlu ezincane ezizohlala abaqaphi, bengeze nangamakhamera. INtuzuma ingelinye lamalokishi axakwe wubugebengu bezigelekeqe zeWest. Kuke kwabulawa nabasezinhlakeni eziqapha ubugebengu emphakathini.
IYINDABA egudwini emalungwini omphakathi waseNdwedwe, ekamashonisa okuthiwa udilize indlu yowesilisa wakule ndawo ngoba esehluleka wukumkhokhela isikweletu.Isolezwe lithole ngomthombo walo osondelene nalolu daba ukuthi uMnuz Xolani Bhengu ongumashonisa owaziwayo kule ndawo, udilize indlu kaMnuz Bhubhu Nxumalo.Akucacai kahle ukuthi yimalini uNxumalo abeyikweleta umashonisa. Okuvelayo wukuthi bese iyiningi nje impela. Kuvela ukuthi indlu ediliziwe inamagumbi amathathu.Umthombo osondelene noNxumalo, ongeke uvezwe, uthe bese kuphele isikhathi eside ekweleta.Okuyikhona obese kuyinkinga kakhulu umthombo uthe wukuthi ikhadi lasebhange likaNxumalo bese lihlala kumashonisa. Kuthiwa ngumashonisa owaqhamuka nombono wokuthi ukuze kusheshe kuphele isikweletu, kungcono ikhadi lasebhange lihlale kuyena kuze kube uyasiqeda.UNxumalo kuthiwa wayengahambisani nalesi sinqumo, kodwa kungekho angakusho njengoba umashonisa echazwa njengondlovukayiphikiswa. Kuvela nokuthi ushonisela abantu baseNdwedwe kuphela hhayi abangaphandle kwayo.Okunye okuvelayo wukuthi unesikhathi eside enza lo msebenzi. ''Bekuthi njalo uma kuphela inyanga umashonisa ahambe ayozikhiphela yena imali ekhadini likaNxumalo. Lokhu bese kuphele isikhathi eside kwenzeka. Kodwa uNxumalo ubehlezi ebalisa ngale nto, ekhala ngokuthi akasayiboni into ayisebenzelayo,'' usho kanje.Uthe okuwumnyombo wokudilizwa kwendlu wukuthi uNxumalo ulishintshile ikhadi wenza elisha.''Kuthe uma kuphela inyanga engafici lutho ebhange, umashonisa wadinwa waveva waqonda ngqo emzini kaNxumalo wafike wawudiliza,'' usho kanje. Uthe lesi senzo sibe nonya ngoba ubezibambela imali kanti umshiye engazi ukuthi uzothathani ahlanganise nani.Ethintwa uBhengu uvumile ukuthi babe nokungaboni ngaso linye noNxumalo.Uthe uNxumalo wayiboleka kuyena imali yokuthenga indawo ngesikhathi ezoqala ukwakha eNdwedwe. Uveze ukuthi akagcinanga lapho waphinde watsheleka nenye imali.Ukuchithe njengamampunge ukuthi udilize indlu wathi yena ukhiphe uthayela."Kwathayela lowo wawuthengwe ngemali ayitsheleka kimina," kusho uBhengu. Ngemuva kwesikhashana ube esebhoka ngolaka wathi intatheli mayiphume ezindabeni engaxhumene nazo futhi lolu daba ngeke alukhulume nayo.Ube esevala ucingo engasavalelisanga.Amaphoyisa aKwaZulu Natal kuze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela engaphendulanga njengoba kuthiwa kunecala elivuliwe.Naye uNxumalo ubeshayelwa ucingo kodwa lungabanjwa.
UTHEMBISE ukuthi zizokhokhelwa kusasa izitshudeni zasemakolishi amaTVET ezingakhokhelwanga ngenxa yobuhixihixi.Lesi sithembiso senziwe nguNgqongqoshe weMfundo ePhakeme, uDkt Nobuhle Nkabane, oxolisile ngokuthi ezinye izitshudeni azikutholanga okuzifanele.Uthe bekumele zikhokhelwe ngo-Ephreli 25, kodwa kwaba nobuhixihixi imali zaze zayithola ngo-Ephreli 27. "INSFAS isebenzisana nezikhungo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi le nkinga ayiphindi yenzeke. Kunezitshudeni ezingazitholanga izimfanelo zazo, ngenxa yezinselelo kanti le nkinga iyalungiswa ukuze zithole imali yazo ngo-Ephreli 30," usho kanje.Uthe uyazi ukuthi izitshudeni zithembele kule mali wathi bayazwelana nazo.Ubuye waveza nokuthi iNSFAS izibophezele ekukhokheleni ngesikhathi izitshudeni nomastende abahlinzeka ngezindawo zokuhlala. "INSFAS imatasa yakha uhlelo lapho izomemezela ukuthi kuzokwenzekani ngemali okumele ikhokhwe. Sizimisele ngokukhokhela omastende ngesikhathi esifanele."Mayelana nezitshudeni ezifake izimangalo ngoba zikhale ngaphansi zangaluthola uxhaso, uthe ikomiti leNSFAS elicubungula lezi zimangalo limatasa nomsebenzi walo."Sinxusa izitshudeni ukuthi zilokhu zibheka ukuthi akufuneki yini eminye imininingwane kulabo abafake izimangalo. Kulandelwa yonke imigomo ebekiwe ngaphansi kwalolu hlelo lokucubungula izimangalo," usho kanje. Ubuye wakhala ngokuthi iNSFAS ibe nezinkinga zama-code ewasebenzisayo uma ithumela imali kulabo abenza eminye imikhakha emakolishi ukuze bakwazi ukukhokhelwa jmali bathole imiphumela yabo."Le nkinga yama-code ithinte izitshudeni ezenza iNational Certificate (Vocational) [NC (V). Ngifisa ukukuveza ukuthi u-80% wemiphumela usukhishiwe wayiswa ezikhungweni obekubhalelwa kuzona.Siqoqe neminye imininingwanei esizoyiyisa emkhandlwini Umalusi ukuze ugunyaze ukukhishwa kwale miphumela kwabenza iNCV, uLevel 2 kuya ku-4. Sihlela ukudedela imiphumela ngoMeyi 9 kuya kuMeyi 12, kuye ngokuthi Umalusi ugunyaza nini ukukhishwa kwayo." Ubonge ukubekezela kwezitshudeni ezithintekile wathi bazimisele ngokuthi imiphumela ziyithole ngesikhathi.
IZOHLABANA nge-quantum induna ezophuma phambili emcimbini wokuklomelisa izinduna ezenza kahle, ohlelwa wuMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana kanye neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal.Umcimbi wokuklomelisa izinduna uzokuba kuwo lo nyaka, usuku alukabekwa.Lokhu kumenyezelwe wuMphathiswa woMnyango, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, obekhuluma nabezindaba emva kokwethula isabelomali somnyango esiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal. Kuzobe kungokokuqala kwenziwa umcimbi walolu hlobo.UButhelezi uthe bahlose ukuqhakambisa umsebenzi omuhle owenziwa yizinduna."Izinduna ziwuhlaka olubalulekile emiphakathini yakithi. Kunezinduna eziningi ezenza umsebenzi oncomekayo. Ngakho-ke kulo nyaka sizokwenza umcimbi wokuthi induna evelele, ebashaya bonke emakhanda iwine i-quantum. Lena yikhumbi esizoyinika induna, siyincome, siyiklomelise." UButhelezi uthe kubalulekile ukuthi zinconywe izinduna ezenza kahle."Izinduna zenza umsebenzi obalulekile ukuqoqa imiphakathi ehlwempu. UButhelezi uthe kusukela angena esikhundleni kunezinduna ezingu-120 eseziqokiwe."Maduze lezi zinduna zizonikezwa izitifiketi. Udaba lokuqokwa kwezinduna lubalulekile futhi ludinga ukuphathwa ngokucophelela. Njengoba ngishilo izinduna zibambe iqhaza elibalulekile esizweni ziphinde zeseke amakhosi."Sisonke isabelomali somnyango siwu-R1.9 billion. UButhelezi uthe isabelomali somnyango sizosebenza kakhulu ekuqinisekiseni ukuhanjiswa kwentuthuko komasipala nasezindaweni zamakhosi.Uthe babeke eceleni u-R397.5 million ozolekelela omasipala ukuba bafakele abantu amanzi nogesi.Kule mali kuzohlomula zonke izifunda zaKwaZulu-Natal ezingu-11. Komasipala abazohlomula kulo nyaka wezimali kubalwa noMasipala wasoLundi onikezwe u-R56 million.Le mali izosetshenziselwa ukulungisa iziteshi zikagesi ezimbili kuphinde kufakwe ugesi eBabanango, lapho kuzohlomula imizi engu-105."U-R15 million uya kuMasipala waseNkandla, uyofaka ugesi ku-ward 4, 6, no-10. Lapho kuzohlomula imizi engu-100 ezofakelwa ugesi. U-R42 million uya kuMasipala waseBaqulusini. Le mali iyofaka ugesi. U-R26 million uzosetshenziselwa ukufaka ugesi ohlelweni olubizwa ngokuthi yiMabhula, kuzohlomula imizi engu-260. U-R16 million uyofaka ugesi eMadanyini ku-ward 2, kuzohlomula imizi engu-150.""U-R3.7 million uya kuMasipala waseNdumeni, uyofaka ama-high master lights amabili asebenza nge-solar, kuzophinde kufakwe nepitsi eWasbank ukuze kusizakale umphakathi."UButhelezi uthe basazomemezela ukuthi yibaphi abanye omasipala abazohlomula kulolu hlelo.

NJENGOBA ngeSonto iNingizimu Afrika ibigubha uSuku lweNkululeko, amaqembu epolitiki akholwa wukuthi kusekuningi okufanele kwenziwe ukuze izakhamuzi zakuleli zikhululeke ngokuphelele. Imigubho ibihlelwe ezindaweni ezahlukene ezweni.Kulo nyaka kuhlangana iminyaka engu-31 izwe lakhululeka. Likhuluma ngenkululeko eyazuzwa ngo-1994, Iqembu uMkhonto weSizwe Party (MK) esitatimendeni ligcizelele ukuthi ukubaluleka kwalolu suku wukukhumbuza abantu ngomzabalazo wenkululeko yabamnyama ephelele nabacwaswayo osaqhubeka abasagqilazwe wububha, wukungasebenzi nakuba sekudlule iminyaka engu-31 izwe lakhululeka. "Ngeshwa, emva kweminyaka engu-31 umnotho waseNingizimu Afrika usasezandleni zedlanzana elahlomula kuhulumeni wobandlululo," kusho iMK.Iqhube yathi, emva kweminyaka engu-31 izakhamuzi zakuleli zaphuma emaketangeni obandlululo okwaletha ithemba ezigidini zabantu ababencishwe amathuba kodwa yibo laba bantu abasathwele ubunzima benselelo yezomnotho nenhlalo uhulumeni ohlulekayo wukukuqeda. IDemocratic Party (DA) ekuhulumeni wokubambisana ne-African National Congress (DA), ithe inkululeko eyazuzwa ilethe inqubekelaphambili yangempela njengoba izigidi zabantu bakuleli manje sezikwazi ukuthola amanzi ahlanzekile, ugesi, ezempilo nemfundo."Ukungena kwethu siphuma obandlululweni kusanconywa emhlabeni wonke. Ngalokhu, kuningi okufanele sizigqaje ngakho," kusho uDkt Ivan Meyer ongusihlalo wesigungu esiphezulu seDA.Nokho uthe, iqiniso wukuthi akuzona zonke izakhamuzi zakuleli ezithola amathuba enkululeko afanayo. Uthe leli zwe lisabalwa emazweni anemiphakathi engalingani emhlabeni wonke lapho abantu abaningi, ikakhulukazi, intsha ibhekene nokwenyuka kwezinga lokungasebenzi, ubugebengu, ukusetshenziswa kwezidakamizwa nokuhlala emigwaqweni.Ekhuluma emgubhweni obuhlelwe yi-Economic Freedom Fighters (EFF), eBrandfort, eFree State, umengameli wayo uMnuz Julius Malema ugxeke isimo saleli zwe samanje athe sigubuzelwe yinkohlakalo, wukungalingani, wukunganeliseki nesimo lapho izidingo zingafinyeleli kubona bonke abantu."Sithi sikhululekile ekubeni abantu bethu behlala endleni, lapho izingane zingasebenzi nabazali sebeziduduza ngezidakamizwa,” kusho uMalema. UNgqongqoshe wokuMbiwayo, uMnuz Gwede Mantashe, obesemcimbini obuse-Ermelo emele uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, uthe ububha, ukungasebenzi kwabantu nokungalingani ngamanxeba ajulile avimbela izwe ukuba lifinyelele endaweni efanele."Singelinye lamazwe emhlabeni angenakho ukulingana. Kubuhlungu ukuthi amaphesenti angu-10 abantu abanothile ngabanikazi bezinto ezingenisa imali eNingizimu Afrika. Izigidi zabantu zisahola imali ezingeke zikwazi ukuziphilisa ngayo nemindeni yazo," kusho Mantashe.Naye ukhale ngobugebengu, inkohlakalo, nokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane okudlangile.Uthe kule minyaka engu-31 edlule kuningi osekwenziwe okuhlanganisa imfundo, ukuhlaliswa kwabantu, ezempilo nokuhlinzekwa kwezidingo kodwa iqiniso wukuthi akwanele.

Baphinde bakuphinde futhi uphinde uthule futhi. Bakuphinde futhi uphinde uthule?" kubuza imantshi. Ithe kukhona okushaya amanzi kulolu daba. ''Njengoba nanihlala emagumbini ahlukene, wena wathula engqongqoza okokuqala efika elala nawe. Wabuya futhi ngakusasa wangqongqoza nakhona futhi wawuvula umnyango. ''Ngiyakunikeza ibheyili ngaphansi kwemibandela ehlukene okumele uyigcine. Omunye wawo wukuthi njalo ngoLwesihlanu kumele uyosayina esiteshini sangakini,'' kuqhuba imantshi.Kuvelile ukuthi owesifazane uthe wayethule edlwengulwa kuphindelelwa ngoba wayengafuni ukuphenduka umantuntanendishi aswele indawo yokuhlala.Baphume bedangele abantu abaningi ebebezokweseka isisulu. Naso isisulu ngesikhathi kukhuluma imantshi bese sibonakala sibheke phansi kubonakala ukuthi asikukholwa esikuzwayo .

KUBOSHWE abantu abangu-6 253 abebezama ukungena nokuphuma kuleli ngokungemthetho ngesikhathi samaholidi ePhasika kulo nyaka.Lokhu kudalulwe wuKhomishana weBorder Management Authority (BMA), uDkt Michael Masiapato, ngesikhathi ethula umbiko ngokwenziwe yilesi sikhungo esikhathini esiyizinsuku ezingu-10 zePhasika.UMasiapato uthe nakulo nyaka abantu baseZimbabwe, Lesotho naseMozambique basaqhubeka nokungayihloniphi imithetho yakuleli yokungena nokuphuma kwabantu ezweni. Bangu-2019 abaseZimbabwe ababanjiwe, abangu-1921 abaseLesotho nabangu-1143 baseMozambique. Abangu-1170 abasemazweni ahlukene. UMasiapato uthe laba babuyiselwe emazweni abo. Uveze ukuthi isibalo sababoshiwe sinyuke ngamaphesenti angu-61 uma kuqhathaniswa nonyaka odlule owawunabangu-3841."Nakulo nyaka abantu basemazweni amathathu ahamba phambili ngokungayihloniphi imithetho yokungena nokuphuma kwabantu kuleli baqhubekile nokwenza lokho," kusho uMasiapato. Uthe kwababoshiwe, abangu-4795 bebengenawo amaphepha, abangu-1059 bengavumelekile ukungena kuleli nabangu-493 abebenama-visa omgunyathi okanye bahluleka wukuveza izitifiketi ezinemininingwane ngesimo sabo sempilo. Uphinde waveza ukuthi kunabanye ababanjelwe amacala ahlukene badluliselwa emaphoyiseni. "Lokhu kwenyuka kwesibalo sababanjiwe ngamaphesenti angu-61, kudalwe wuhlelo lwethu lokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe bamakhamera andiza phezulu nafakwa emzimbeni okwenza kube lula ukuba sisheshe sikwazi ukuhlonza ubugebengu bungakenzeki," usho kanje. Uphinde wadalula ukuthi kuboshwe izisebenzi zabo ezimbili emngceleni iBeitbridge, ezisolwa ngokusebenzisana nabadlulisa abantu emingceleni ngokungemthetho. UMasiapato uthe sebeqale umkhankaso wokuqinisekisa ukuthi izisebenzi zabo ziyabuqonda ubungozi bokuzibandakanya nenkohlakalo ikakhulukazi ukusiza abantu ukuba bangene kuleli ngokungemthetho. Mayelana nemikhankaso yokulwa nobugebengu obuhlanganisa ukushushumbiswa kwempahla, uthe kube nengu-83 ezweni lonke lapho bebesebenzisana namaphoyisa, baba nezivimbamgwaqo ezingu-59, izimoto ezihlolayo ezingaphezulu kuka-1141 nabahamba ngezinyawo abangu-1183. Uthe kubanjwe izimoto ezine nesithuthuthu obekuzanywa ukukushushumbisa, insangu yenani lika-R129 550, kwabanjwa izincwadi zokuhambela kwamanye amazwe ezingu-8 ezinezigxivizo zomgunyathi, utshwala, izingubo zokugqoka, izicathulo nogwayi womgunyathi.Uthe kusukela ngo-Ephreli 15, sekubanjwe ugwayi womgunyathi wenani elingaphezulu kwesigidi samarandi. Nakulo nyaka isikhumulo sezindiza i-OR Tambo sibe nesibalo esiphezulu sabantu abebengena bephuma kuleli ngesikhathi sePhasika.

BUZULELWA ngamanqe ubuholi be-EFF esifundazweni iKwaZulu-Natal.Umholi weqembu, uMnuz Julius Malema, ukhwele wadilika ebuholini benhlangano kulesi sifundazwe.UMalema uthe ubuholi be-EFF KwaZulu-Natal abukhombisi nakancane ukulwela ukuthi leli qembu lingaphinde liphenduke ihlazo okhethweni lohulumeni basekhaya oluzokuba ngonyaka ozayo. Lokhu kuqukethwe enkulumeni kaMalema ayethule emhlanganweni wesigungu esiphezulu se-EFF, eLimpopo.Le nkulumo kaMalema inamekwe kuzo zonke izinkundla zokuxhumana ze-EFF.I-EFF ayenzanga kahle esifundazweni iKwaZulu-Natal okhethweni lukazwelonke olwalungonyaka owedlule. Njengamanje i-EFF isele namalungu amabili vo esiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal, ngaphambi kokhetho yayinamalungu ayisishagalombili.Yize uMalema ebuncomile ubuholi be-EFF ezifundazweni eziningi, ukhalile kakhulu ngobasesifundazweni iKwaZulu-Natal."Ngithi angiphinde futhi ngizwakalise ukungenami kwami ngobuholi baKwaZulu-Natal. Ngokubuka kwami, indlela abasebenza ngayo ayikhombisi ukuthi banokuzisola. Ngathi abanendaba neyokuthi asenzanga kahle okhethweni lwangonyaka owedlule. Ayikho nje into abayenzayo esiyibonayo." UMalema uthe ubuholi be-EFF KwaZulu-Natal buyahluleka ukusukumela izinto ezithinta abantu bakulesi sifundazwe."Abasho lutho ngezinto okukhulunywa ngazo kakhulu. Bazithulele nje abasho lutho ngodaba lokuvalwa kwebhange Ithala. Ithala lisetshenziswa inqwaba yabantu KwaZulu-Natal ikakhulukazi ezindaweni zasemakhaya."UMalema uthe imiphumela yezinketho zokuchibiyela esibe khona esifundazweni iKwaZulu-Natal kusukela kwadlula ukhetho lwangonyaka owedlule, ikhombisa ukuthi iqembu alikhuli. I-EFF ijwayele ukuba ukudla kwenduku ezinkethweni zokuchibiyela njengoba ijwayele ukuthola amavoti amancane.Ezinkundleni zokuxhumana kuyaye kuhlekiswe ngayo i-EFF njengoba kwezinye izikhungo iyaye ithole amavoti angaphansi kweshumi."Kuyasikhathaza ukuthi iqembu liyaqhubeka nokuthola amavoti amancane. Kuyasikhathaza ukuthi ayikho into ebambekayo eyenziwayo ukuzama ukukhulisa iqembu." UMalema uthe ufuna incazelo egcwele ukuthi yini eyenziwa ubuholi beqembu KwaZulu-Natal, waxwayisa ngokuthi iqembu lizophenduka isilo sengubo okhethweni lwangonyaka ozayo uma udaba laKwaZulu-Natal lungasukunyelwa ngokushesha."Kufanele sichazelwe ukuthi yini eyenziwayo ukukhulisa iqembu KwaZulu-Natal. Zonke izinkomba zikhombisa ukuthi sizokwehlelwa isimo esifanayo okhethweni lwangonyaka ozayo uma singasukumi ngokushesha."Ubuholi be-EFF KwaZulu-Natal baqokwa ngasekupheleni kuka-2022. Usihlalo we-EFF KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Mongezi Thwala kuthi unobhala kube uMnuz Nkululeko Ngubane.Emva kokhetho lwangonyaka owedlule kwake kwaba khona ikhwelo lokuba buhlakazwe lobu buholi kodwa kwaba uyena oMalema othi asikho isidingo sokuthi buhlakazwe.
UMSAKAZI woKhozi FM, uBingelela Mpanza, usephumele obala ngokuthandana nenkosi kamaskandi, uMongezi "Mayoghurt" Jama. UBingelela (34), osakaza uSigiya Ngengoma ngokubambisana noVusizwe Langa, uthe ugcine ehlulekile ukuzibamba ngenxa yothando abeseluzwa luvutha amalangabi ngoMayoghurt. "UJama uyangichaza. Unenhlonipho kakhulu, unothando kimina. Kuyamangaza ukuthandwa umuntu ofana naye. Ungowekhethelo impela." Uthe ukuthandana noMayoghurt kufane nokufezeka kwephupho lakhe ayenalo esakhula. "Vele ngisemncane ngangifisa ukuthandana nomuntu ongithanda njengo-Bliss." Yize uBingelela ezifela ngalo mculi obuye avele kuMzansi Magic ohlelweni lwabantu abakhubazeke ngokungakhuli, iShort and Sweet kodwa kunabantu abashaya amakhala ngalobu budlelwano ngenxa yokuthi uBingelela ushiya uMayoghurt (23) ngeminyaka elishumi nanye futhi uMayoghurt akakabi namntwana ekubeni uBingelela esenabo.Nakuba kunjalo kodwa uBingelela uthe izimfamona zizokhala zize zome izinyembezi ngoba lolu thando oselumvale izindlebe. "Ngiyabezwa nje abantu abaningi abayiboni kahle le nto yethu kodwa nje bazojwayela. Khona uthando vele aluvamile ukwemukeleka. NaKwaNongoma bamjabulele kakhulu (uMayoghurt) sifika naye eyobingelela emzini," kusho uBingelela. Uthe uMayoghurt usemthulile nasemndenini wakhe. "NgoMgqibelo esiya kuwona, uyobe egqoke into efana neyami ngenxa yokuthi uma siya phakathi kwabantu kumele sibukeke kahle," kuphetha uBingelela. NoMayoghurt waseMzimkhulu, uthe okwamenza wazibika kuBingelela ukuthi wahlabeka umxhwele yinhlonipho nokuba nomoya omuhle.Lo mculi ungomunye wabaqashwa kakhulu kulezi zinsuku ngenxa yengoma yakhe ethi Bhinca Lami. NgoMgqibelo, uzobe eshiyelana inkundla kwiNongoma Big Night Music Festival ezinkundleni zemidlalo zaKwaLindizwe, KwaNongoma, nezihlabani ezinjengoBabes Wodumo, Thokozani Langa, AmaSiblings, Menzi, Imfezemnyama, Buselaphi, Mdumazi, Mjolisi, Mafikizolo, Ithwasa Lekhansela, Njabulo Langa, Stability, Dumakahle, Inkosi Yamagcokama, NND International nabanye. Uhlelo lwalo mcimbi luzobe luphethwe nguTshatha, Zimdollar, Selbeyonce, Mroza Buthelezi, Londa Mbatha, Mdonso Ngcobo, Kiss Before, Londi Gazu, Welcome Ntombela, Nqubeko Ndlela, Gwajo, Mfanuphetheni, MC Wesizwe nabanye. Amathikithi atholakala eComputicket, Shoprite, TicketPro nasezitolo zaseSpar ngo-R100 nango-R500.
SEHLILE isibalo sezingozi nokufa kwabantu emgwaqweni ngempelasonto yePhasika, ngokukaNgqongqoshe wezokuThutha kuzwelonke, uNkk Barbara Creecy.UNkk Creecy ekhuluma nabezindaba izolo, eKranskop Toll Plaza eLimpopo, uthe izibalo zehle kuzo zonke izifundazwe ngaphandle kwaseMpumalanga, lapho kube nengozi enkulu ngoLwesine ebusuku."E-Eastern Cape naseWestern Cape izibalo azikhombisi ukunyuka kodwa zilapho ezazikhona ngonyaka odlule. Kuzo zonke ezinye izifundazwe, sehlile isibalo sabafayo nezingozi,” kusho uNkk Creecy. Uthe ngeke azikhiphe ngoba yinto abazoyenza uma sebeqede umkhankaso.Uthe kulezi zinsuku ezimbalwa ezedlule amaphoyisa, amise izimoto ezingu-70 000, akhipha amathikithi angu-21 000 kwaboshwa abangu-512 ngamacala ahlukene ahlanganisa ukushayela bephuzile, ukushayela ngesivinini esiphezulu nokungabi nezimvume."Kuboshwe abahamba ngezinyawo abayisithupha ngokuhamba emgwaqweni ngokungemthetho futhi babeka engcupheni impilo yabanye abasebenzisa umgwaqo. Isibalo esiphezulu esabashayela bephuzile." Uqhube wathi umkhakhaso wabo uqale ngoMashi 20 futhi kusukela lapho sebemise izimoto ezingu-782 000 bakhipha amathikithi angu-116 000.Uthe kuboshwe abashayeli abangu-3 500 ngamacala ahlukene."Kuboshwe abahamba ngezinyawo abangu-89 ngokuhamba kuthelawayeka. Ngeke sikuvumele ukuthi abantu bahambe kuthelawayeka."Uthe izimoto ezingu-2 200 ezingekho esimeni sokuba semgwaqweni ziboshiwe. Ezinye ezingu-2 500 zishaqiwe ngokungahloniphi izimvume. Izibalo ezikhishwe ngumnyango wezokuThutha KwaZulu-Natal izolo ekuseni, ziveza ukuthi bayisithupha abashone ezingozini, okuyisibalo esehle kakhulu kunesanyakenye ngalesi sikhathi njengoba babengu-21.Kuboshwe abangu-13 abebeshayela bebukhile, kuboshwe nabanye abangu-24 abebevele benezincwadi ezigunyaza ukuthi zibakhalele."Kushaqwe izimoto ezingu-77, kwamiswa ezingu-15 657, kanti kubanjwe abangu-108 abebeshayela ngaphandle kwezincwadi. Kubhalwe amathikithi angu-258 okuhamba ngesivivini," kusho umnyango.
INKAMPANI yabangcwabi iCebolethu igoqe impelasonto yePhasika ngendlela ehlukile ikhipha iminikelo ebheke emabandleni angu-50 ezifundazweni iKwaZulu-Natal, Eastern Cape, eMpumalanga naseGauteng. Lo mkhankaso osiqubulo sithi Indodana iVukile, ubuholwa yisikhulu esiphezulu uNomfundo Mcoyi, enikelela amabandla ahlukene ngezipho ezihlanganisa igilosa, inyama, izihlalo, amatende, izinto zokuhlobisa, izinkomo nezinye izinto ezibalulekile. Ngokusho kwale nkampani ngesitatimende; "Lolu hlelo lukhombisa ukuzibophezela kwabo okuqhubekayo kwezenkolo, umphakathi, kanye nokuqhakambisa ubuntu."
IHLATSHWE yahlikizwa indaba yosonkontileka abanikwa imisebenzi bese beyahluleka ukuphothula umsebenzi ngesikhathi esifanele.Lokhu kushiwo yiMeya yaseMfolozi, uMnuz Xolani Bhengu, egxeke kakhulu indaba yosonkontileka abehlulekayo ukuqeda umsebenzi ngesikhathi okusuke kuvunyelwane ngaso.UBhengu ukusho lokhu ekhuluma ngesikhathi ethula uhlelo lwentuthuko edidiyelwe enkundleni yezemidlalo yakwaSokhulu. Uthe zizogcwala udaka izinyawo kosonkontileka abayimbangela yokuthi intuthuko igcine seyibonakala ihamba ngonyawo lonwabu.Wenze isibonelo ngomunye usonkontileka athe ubekade esingethe umsebenzi othile kwase kuvunyelwana ngokuthi makawuphothule ngezinyanga ezine kodwa lokho kwangenzeka.''Sesimxoshile ke ngoba kuyacaca ukuthi umsebenzi umehlule. Sesizothola omunye ozokwazi ukuqhubeka nalo msebenzi,'' usho kanje. Ubethulele isigqoko osonkontileka abebenikezwe umsebenzi wokuba kuvulwe umgwaqo oyinkwali waseNsikeni, athe bawenze kahle umsebenzi waba seqophelweni eliphezulu.Uthe bakwazile nokuthi bawuphothule ngesikhathi okwakuvunyelwane ngaso.Ube eseveza izinhlelo abanazo athe zizoqala ukwenzeka ngoJulayi. Phakathi kwazo ubalule ukulungiswa kwemigwaqo eyahlukene yakule ndawo athe kuzodla imali eshisiwe.Phakathi kwemigwaqo ezolungiswa ubalule iMashobeni Access Road, okuzosetshenziswa u-R3 589 234 nomgwaqo uKhumalo ukulungiswa kwawo athe kuzodla u-R4 629 927.Uveze nokuthi bazolungisa inkulisa i-Othini ngesamba esingu-R898 9772. Okunye athe kuzoba seqhulwini wukulungiswa kwezinkundla zemidlalo nokulungiswa kwezikhungo eziphakela ngamanzi.Udalule nokuthi benza konke okusemandleni ukweseka osomabhizinisi bendawo.Kube khona nezinhlangano ezahlukene zakule ndawo ezihlomule ngezinsiza kusebenza. "Sizimisele ngokuthi senze konke okusemandleni ukulekelela osomabhzinisi abancane,'' úsho kanje.Amalungu omphakathi aphakamise ukuthi kube khona okwenziwayo ngodaba lwamanzi kuphinde kuqhutshekwe nangokwakhiwa kwemigwaqo esezingeni.
SIKHUSHULIWE isabelomali sesikhwama esibhekele izidingo zeSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini neNdlunkulu kaZulu, njengoba iZulu Royal Household Trust (ZRHT) yabelwe u-R86.1 million kulo nyaka wezimali.Lokhu kumenyezelwe nguNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, ngesikhathi ethula isabelomali sehhovisi lakhe, izolo. Ngonyaka odlule, iZRHT yabelwa u-R77.5 million. Kunyuswa le mali nje, iZRHT isanda kuveza ukuthi senyukile isabalo sabantu abafakwe ohlwini lwabahlomula kulesi sikhwama. IMbube isanda kwakha isigodlo esisha, eMashobeni, futhi kusanda kufakwa oNdlunkulu beNdlulamithi yamakhosi ohlwini lwabantu abahlomula esikhwameni. UNtuli uthe inhloso yokunyuswa kwesabelomali ukuba benze isiqiniseko sokuthi baseseka ngokwanele iSilo neNdlunkulu. UNtuli uthe iZRHT izoqhubeka nokuzama ukuthola izindlela zokwenza imali, ingagcini ngokuthembela emalini eyithola kuhulumeni. "IZRHT izobheka amathuba kwezolimo iphinde ibambisane nezinkampani zikahulumeni ezisemkhakheni wezolimo."UNtuli uthe maduze bazoqoka Ibhodi elisha leZRHT elizoqhuba izinhlelo zokwenza imali. "Kasijabule ngesivinini oluhamba ngayo uhlelo lokuqhamuka nezinhlelo zokwenza imali. Sinethemba lokuthi ibhodi elisha lizofike lenze umehluko."UNtuli uthe iZRHT ihlela umcimbi wokukhumbula umlando kaZulu."Umcimbi kuhlelwa ukuthi ube kuwona lo nyaka wezimali. Inhloso wukuqoqa imali." Amalungu esiShayamthetho akwamukele ukunyuswa kwesabelomali seZRHT kodwa akhala ngokuthi lesi sikhwama siyahluleka namanje wukuqhamuka nezindlela zokuzenzela imali.Ilungu le-IFP, uMnuz Blessed Gwala, lithe ukunyuswa kwesabelomali seZRHT kukhombisa ngokusobala ukuthi uhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal uyabuhlonipha ubuholi bomdabu.Ilungu le-ANC, uMnuz Mthandeni Dlungwane, lithe iZRHT kufanele ishintshe ukwenza."Sikhathazekile ngokushaya ngonyawo lonwabu kwezinhlelo zeZRHT zokwenza imali."Ilungu leNFP, UNksz Mbali Shinga, lithe iZRHT iyahluleka ukwenza umsebenzi eyawusungulelwa. "Inhloso yokusungulwa kweZRHT kwakungukuthi yenze imali ezoqhuba izidingo zeNdlunkulu. Kuze kube manje konke lokhu akwenzeki."Ilungu le-DA, uMnuz Tim Brauteseth, lithe isiphenduke iculo eyokuthi iZRHT kufanele iqale ukwenza imali."Lesi yisabelo esanele njengoba sizovumela iZRHT ukuba iqhube umsebenzi wayo okubalwa ukulungisa izigodlo. Kodwa ke sikhathazekile ngeZRHT. Sekuphele isikhathi eside kuculwa iculo lokuthi iZRHT kufanele iqale ukwenza imali. Kwaze kwakhishwa imali ewu-R3 million yokuba kuqalwe izinhlelo zokwenza imali kodwa kuze kube namhlanje kasiboni lutho. IZRHT isihlale isikhathi eside ingenalo ibhodi. Isebenza kanjani ingenalo ibhodi?" Isabelomali seHhovisi likaNdunankulu (Ntuli) singu-R817.8 million.UNtuli uthe bazogxila kakhulu ekuqinisekiseni ukuhanjiswa kwezidingo, ukulwa nodlame lwezobulili nenkohlakalo."IHhovisi likaNdunankulu linikezwe umsebenzi wokubheka ukusebenza kweminyango kahulumeni wesifundazwe. Sifisa ukuthi isabelomali silethe uzinzo kuhulumeni, sikwazi ukusheshe siphendule, ikakhulukazi njengoba sibuye sihlaselwe yizikhukhula kulesi sifundazwe."
NAMHLANJE kunomhlangano omkhulu eNyuvesi yaKwaZulu-Natal, eMgungundlovu, ngaphansi kwesikole sezeNkolo, iNjulalwazi nezaseMandulo lapho abelaphi bendabuko bezobe behlanganise amakhanda. Lo mhlangano ungowokuqala ngqa ukuthi kubhekwe indlela abelaphi bendabuko abasebenza ngayo emifuleni, ezimpophomeni nasolwandle.Umhlangano uxhaswe uMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu ngesivumelwane esiphakathi kwawo nenhlangano yezamasiko nesintu, Umsamo Institute. Kulo mhlangamo ozobe ungaphansi kophiko lweChart-Umsamo kuzobe kukhona abelaphi abavela kuyona yonke indawo abangaphansi kwenhlangano entsha, nayo ezokwethulwa ngokusemthethweni kulo mhlangano, eyaziwa ngaBelaphi Bendabuko base-Afrika (ABBA). Le nhlangano isinamalungu angaphezulu kwekhulu kanti isizakhele umthethosisekelo yabhalisa ngokugcwele ngaphansi komthetho wezinkampani kuleli. Ibhalisa nje ngoba ingafuni ukuthathwa njengeqembu elifana nalawa ahlale egijima ezinkundleni zokuxhumana.Umhlangano umayelana nezigameko ezenzeka emifuleni nasolwandle lapho kumuka khona abantu ngoba kuthiwa bayohlanjululwa, abanye bebhabhadiswa ngabefundisi. UMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu usukhuze kaningi ukuthi abantu abaqikelele kungayiwa noma yikanjani emifuleni nasezimpophomeni. Kungekhona nje ukuthi izigameko ezenzeka emifuleni zodwa, kodwa nokungabi khona kwenhlanzeko lapho kusuke kuthiwa kugezwa khona abantu - kuzobhekwa.Umsebenzi wokwelapha kwendabuko usubukeleka phansi ngendlela ebuhlungu ngoba ufica izinkukhu zilahlwe noma kanjani, izimbuzi ezibulawa zishiywe kanjalo namakhandlela ashiswa kushiywe khona lapho. Iningi lale mifula okwenzeka kuyona konke lokhu kunabantu abaphuza nabaphila ngalawo manzi kodwa izangoma azikugqizi qakala lokho.Sekuke kwakhalwa kakhulu ngemifula esondelene namalokishi lapho abantu bengenamanzi, bethi bayokhalela emifuleni bafike kunuka iphunga lezilwane ezibulawe zalahlwa lapho. Lokhu kuhamba kuze kuyongcolisa ezindaweni ezifana namamabhishi namapaki. Izimpophoma eziningi zisezindaweni ezingamapaki lapho kuhambela khona izivakashi ezisuke zifuna ukuyophumula. Kokunye bageze ezimpophomeni lapho kodwa bayofica kubhuza izimpukane.Abelaphi bendabuko sebethathwa njangamanuku adidayo ngalesi senzo sabo. Ngakho uMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu uthathe isinyathelo sokuba kuke kubhalwe ibhukwana okuyilona elizobophezela abelaphi ukuthi migomo mini okufanele bayilandele uma kuthiwa uyogeza umuntu noma uyombhabhadisa empophomeni noma emfuleni okanye olwandle.Le ncwajana yemigomo iyona lena ezobunjwa namhlanje bese ishicilelwa. Le migomo izokuba yimpoqo ngoba emva kwayo kuzohanjelwa zonke izinduna namakhosi ukuthi umelaphi oyoke atholakale enza okuphambene nalokhu uyohlawuliswa.Kune-video esisatshalalisiwe ngalokhu kugeza abantu emifuleni eyenziwe nguMsamo Institute uhlangane nabe-Disaster Management Centre engaphansi kwawo uMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu. Le video iyatholakala kanti iyabukiswa ezindaweni ngezindawo okuyikhona kufanele kulandelwe. Incwadi lena isizokuza njengesingezelelo kosekwenziwe.Ngokungabi khona okwamanje komkhandlu wabelaphi bendabuko esifundazweni, abelaphi banqume ukuhlangana ngaphansi kwale nhlangano nayo abazoyethula khona namhlanje - eyabelaphi bendabuko abakulona lonke izwe. Le nhlangano isizakhele umthethosisekelo, kanjalo wonke umuntu obhalisa kuyo ungena ngokuthi agcwalise amafomu okufanele kuqondakale uluhlobo luni lomelaphi, wathwasaphi futhi nini.Lokhu kungumgomo ngoba kuzanywa ukunqanda abelaphi-mbumbulu abavele kuthi kusa sebenamathwasa sebelapha abantu. Yizona zonke izinto lezi eseziwuthunaze kakhulu lo msebenzi, ubona uhulumeni kuyaye kube sengathithi abelaphi bendabuko akabagqize qakala.Ngesonto eledlule uNgqongqoshe wezeMpilo uDkt Aaron Motsoaledi umemezele ithimba eliphezulu elizokwengamela umkhandlu kazwelonke wabelaphi bendabuko. Lokhu kuthande ukunikeza ithemba ukuthi cishe kukhona lapho kuyiwa khona. Kodwa inkinga enkulu isele ezifundazweni lapho umsindo uthe bhe kubangwa izikhundla zokuba ngosihlalo namaphini osihlalo. Njalo uma kuthiwa kubanjwa umhlangano ozozama ukuvela necebo lokuya phambili, kukhona labo abasuke sebetshaliwe ukuthi abawuhliphize umhlangano ngomsindo.Sekuhluleke imihlangano emibili ibizelwe eTown Hill, eMgungundlovu, ibizwa nguMqondisi eMnyangweni wezeMpilo uMnuz Khoza okunguyena obekelwe ukusebenzisana nabelaphi, ukuzama ukuthi phela kuyiwe phambili. Yomibili le mihlangano kuphunywa kunhlanga zimuka nomoya. Cishe yisona-ke lesi sinyathelo esesenze ukuba kusukume abantu abafana noMakhosi Dumisani Mkhwanazi ukuthi kuhlanganwe kubunjwe leli qembu, ngesikhashana esincane nje eselenze omkhulu umsebenzi ngaphandle komsindo nokudonsisana.Kulo mhlangano wanamhlanje abelaphi bonke bazophuma bebhalisile, kungabanga khona msindo kodwa kungukubuka ukuthi lo msebenzi wenziwa kanjani ukuthi nawo uhlonipheke njengeminye imisebenzi ekhona ekwelapheni abantu ezweni. Asithathe leli thuba siwufisele inhlanhla lo mhlangano ukuya phambili kubonakale.Solwazi Bhedlindaba "VVO” Ka Lu Phuzi Mkhize (PhD)Isigodlo saseMlambomunye: School of Ancestral Studies: www, umsamo.org.za
LITHELEKE eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseNtuzuma liziphihle ngayo "ijakhethi yokwebiwa" elinye ilungu leqembu "lemigulukudu" iWest, njengoba belivela nozakwabo abathathu ngoxhaxha lwamacala abucayi okuthiwa bebewenza eNanda. Kubona, bekukhona uMnuz Sfiso Zukulu, Mnuz Sanele Ngwane, Mnuz Sanele Shwabede noMnuz Khayelihle Cele.Bakhalelwe amasongo kaSigonyela ngoMgqibelo, eCato Manor, eMayville, ngoMgqibelo.Phakathi kwamacala abasolwa ngawo awokubulala, ukuzama ukubulala, ukubamba inkunzi kuhlonyiwe nokuthumba okuthiwa bawenze kusuka ngoJuni ngonyaka odlule kuze kuba bayaboshwa. Bebesina bededelana ebhokisini labamangalelwa, ngokwehlukahlukana kwamacala abo. Kwelokuqala elibhekene noZukulu noShwabede, babekwe amacala amathathu.Kuwona kukhona elokubulawa kukaMnuz Cebolenkosi Ndlovu (41) ngokudutshulwa, amabili okuzama ukubulala uMnuz Msawenkosi Jaba noMnuz Mongezi, isibongo sakhe esingadalulwanga, nawo okuthiwa babadubula. Kuvele ukuthi bawenze eMaoti, ngoJanuwari kuwo lo nyaka. Kwelesithathu elibhekene noShwabede noNgwane, bathweswe amacala amabili. Kuwona, kukhona elokubulala uMnuz Andile Hadebe (41) ngoFebhuwari, kulo nyaka, eMaoti, nelokubamba inkunzi kuhlonyiwe lapho abathatha khona ithelevishini.Kwelesine, elibhekene noZukulu noNgwane, basolwa ngamacala amathathu. Kuthiwa babulala uMnuz Simbongile Mgqibandaba ngoJanuwari, kulo nyaka, elokubulala uZolile Mchokoviyana nelokubamba inkunzi behlomile, bathatha ithelevishini nemali engu-R2 000.Elokugcina, kuthinteka uNgwane, Zukulu, Shwabede noCele.Basolwa ngokubulala uJabulani Maphumulo ngoFebhuwari, kulo nyaka, elokuzama ukubulala uMnuz Masheshe, elokuthumba owomndeni wakwaNgcobo, nelokweba izimpahla ezehlukene zenani lika-R40 850. Kulezi zimpahla yilapho okubalwe khona ijakhethi ebigqokwe ummangalelwa. Laba kuthiwa baphinde babaphoqa ukuba babathumele (transfer) imali ewu-R25 000. Kuvele ukuthi kukhona amanye amacala ababewaboshelwe wona, abawahambayo eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini. Kuwona kukhona elokutholakala nesibhamu esingekho emthethweni, izinhlamvu nempahla eyebiwe.Bonke bathe bayasilaxaza isicelo sebheyili, imantshi yawahlehlesela uMeyi 27, wonke amacala abo, ithi uMbuso usalinde kuqoqwe obunye ubufakazi obusele. Kubona kukhona imibiko yokuhlolwa kwezidumbu, izitatimende zofakazi nokunye. Ngesikhathi besaqala ukungena enkantolo, ababili abangene ngasekuqaleni, bebebukeka behlinile, bedla imihlathi. Kuthe imantshi isiveza ukuthi izobavumela abezindaba ukuba baqophe konke okwenzeka ngaphakathi enkantolo, bavele bahloma amakhanda phansi unomphelo. Baze bakhuphula ngisho namajakhethi, bawabeka ngenhla kwamakhala, bezama ukuzifihla ubuso. Nokho imantshi ifune incazelo yokuthi kungani bezifihla, baphoqeleka ukuthi bawehlise amajakhethi, maqede baqhubeka nokuwahloma phansi amakhanda.Ngaphakathi enkantolo, umphakathi ungene ulakanyana, waze wanqanyulwa yiphoyisa, lisho ukuthi akungabe kusangena muntu ngoba sekugcwele.Bekukhona namaphoyisa abengeziwe, nawo abenkanise ngaphakathi enkantolo, ukuzoqapha isimo.Esicabheni esingenela egumbini lenkantolo bekukhona enye inqwaba yomphakathi, ebilokhu imile.

KUSALINDWE ummeli ukuba aqale axoxisane nowesifazane osolwa ngokusoconga indodakazi yakhe ngoba eyidlalele umshwalense.UNksz Ncamisile Evarista Hlophe ubekwe uMbuso icala lokubulala ngenhloso indodakazi yakhe eneminyaka engu-14, uLuvuyo Tafadzwe.Lo wesifazane ubekade evelile kafushane enkantolo yeMantshi yaseNtuzuma. Isigameko kusolakala ukuthi senzeka emzini wakhe uNksz Hlophe oKwaMashu ngoJuly 22, 2024.Kuvela ukuthi ummangalelwa wabiza amaphoyisa wawazisa ukuthi indodakazi yakhe uyifice seyishonile endlini kade engekho.Wazisa amaphoyisa ukuthi umufi ubekade esanda kuphuza amaphilisi ekhanda wacambalala akabange esavuka emva kwalokho.Kuthiwa okwaxaka ngukuthi isidumbu sikamufi satholakala sinenxeba elibi kakhulu ngemuva kwekhanda, futhi eshonele khona lapho. Ngemuva kwalokho unina wabe esekhalelwa ngamasongo kasigonyela ngo-August ngemuva nje kwenyanga kushone umufi.Enkantolo ngaphambilini kwahlaluka ukuthi umphenyi wecala kanye namaphoyisa bathola ukuthi umufi wabulawa hhayi ukuthi washona kade ephuze amaphilisi.Kwavela ngaphambilini futhi ukuthi omakhwelwane bawuzwa umsindo kamufi ngezithuba zasekuseni ehayiza, kodwa bangaqonda ukuthi kwenzakalani. Kuthiwa inkukhu yawusola umgqakazo uma sebethola izindaba zokuthi indodakazi ibulewe.Ngesikhathi ligcina ukuhlala enkantolo leli cala, lahlehliswa uMbuso waveza ukuthi idokodo alifinyelelanga enkantolo.Kwahlaluka nokuthi leli cala selisezandleni zeProvincial Task Team. SESISEZANDLENI zeMangosuthu University of Technology (MUT), isakhiwo sabaphila nokukhubazeka saseMlaza, esaziwa ngeNduduzweni ngemuva kokuba sidayiswe wuMnyango wezeMisebenzi yoMphakathi neNgqalasizinda KwaZulu-Natal.Lokhu kuvezwe uMphathiswa walo mnyango, uMnuz Martin Meyer, ngesikhathi ehambele kulesi sikhungo.UMeyer uqale ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi lesi sakhiwo bekungesabo. Uthe ukudayiswa kwaso kumayelana nohlelo oluhlabahlosile umnyango wakhe oluqhubayo lokunciphisa izindleko.''Sihlale phansi savumelana, sabona kumqoka kakhulu ukuthi lesi sakhiwo simane sisisuse ezandleni zethu. Lokhu sikholwa ukuthi bekuyinto obekumele nakanjani siyenze,'' usho kanje.Uthe bakholwa ukuthi sesifikile manje isikhathi sokuba bazidedele zonke izakhiwo abakholwa ukuthi lo mnyango awusazidingi. Ephendula mayelana nabantu abahlala ngaphakathi kusona, uthe ngeke balenze iphutha lokuthi bamane babashiye nje kanjalo, baphenduke ondingasithebeni kodwa banohlelo lokuthi babatholele enye indawo engcono abangahlala kuyona.Kuvelile lapha ukuthi isikhungo iMangosuthu University of Technology (MUT), safaka isicelo sokuthenga le ndawo ngokusemthethweni ngo-2019. Kuke kwaba khona isikhathi lapho futhi okwakukhalwa ngokuthi awasekho amanzi nogesi kulesi sakhiwo.Lesi sakhiwo sidayiswa nje, bese kuphele isikhathi eside kakhulu sisetshenziswa ngabantu abaphila nokukhubazeka. Kuhlalukile lapha ukuthi bangu-21 abaphila nokukhubazeka abasaqhubeka nokuhlala kulesi sakhiwo.Ngaphambilini sake saba ngaphansi koMnyango wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi KwaZulu-Natal.Abanye abaphila nokhubazeka bebebuye benze nezinto abaziphilisa ngazo okufaka phakathi ukwenza imisebenzi yezandla eyehlukene nokunye okuningi. Umphathi weMUT, uSolwazi Nokuthula Sibiya, uthembise ukuthi nakanjani bazotholelwa enye indawo abebesaqhubeka nokuthi basebenzise lesi sakhiwo.IMangosuthu ithe ifuna ukusebenzisa lesi sakhiwo ukuze kube yindawo yezitshudeni nokuthi kuphinde kufundelwe kuyona.Lesi sakhiwo sidayiswa nje, ngaphambilini kwake kwaba nesikhalazo esikhulu sokuthi asisekho esimweni esikahle futhi asisaphephile kubantu abahlala kusona.Bekukhona naloyo oyisikhulu esiphezulu eMnyangweni wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Dumisani Xaba.
UKUNGANAKI nokungasukumeli phezulu ubumqoka bokuba nomuntu oqeqeshelwe ukweluleka ngemali, ngesinye sezizathu ezinqala ezidala ukuthi kwande isibalo sabantu bakuleli zwe, ikakhulu abamnyama abangene shi enkingeni yezikweletu.Lokho kushiwo wumqondisi wophiko lwezokucwaninga eBureau of Market Research, uSolwazi Carel van Aardt, ngesikhathi ekhuluma esigcawini sokucobelana ngolwazi lokuphatha nokonga imali ebesihlelwe yiMomentum Group, ebesiseFour Seasons Hotel, eGoli, ngoLwesihlanu.USolwazi Van Aardt ubesethimbeni ebelibambisene neMomentum ukucwaninga ngezizathu ezenza ukuthi abantu bakuleli zwe babe manqika ukuthola abantu noma izinkampani eziqeqeshelwe ukwelulekana ngokuphatha, ukonga nokubeka imali. Uthe kulolu cwaningo abalwenze nyakenye, balwenze kubantu bakuleli zwe abawu-1 600 abaphila impilo nje ejwayelekile nabawu-200 abaphila impilo ethathwa ngokuthi ngeyabadla izambane likapondo, okuyilapho bethole khona ububanzi benkinga yezezimali ebaxakile."Ocwaningweni lwethu sithole ukuthi abantu abaningi ababethembi abeluleki bezimali ngemali yabo, okunye kwalokho okudalwa wukwanda kwezigebengu eziqola abantu imali yabo. Okubi nokho wukuthi ngenxa yakho konke lokhu, u-77% wabantu bakuleli zwe bazama ngokwabo ukuhlela nokunquma ukuthi imali yabo bayisebenzisa kanjani, bese kuthi u-12% uthembela kubangani, emindenini yabo nakubantu osebenza nabo ukuthi ubasize kulokho. Bawu-9% kuphela abantu abazihluphayo ngolwazi lwalokho, okusekubi kakhulu ngoba yonke le nqwaba yabantu engazihluphi, ingena shi ezikweletini," usho kanje. Isikhulu esiphezulu seConsult by Momentum, uMnuz Hannes van den Berg, sona sithe into edala ukuthi kube kubi kanjena wukuthi namanje ayikasukunyelwa indaba yokuthi izingane zifundiswe kusukela emazingeni aphansi ngobumqoka bokuphatha imali ngendlela efanele."Nanokuthi thina esiqeqeshelwe nesigunyazelwe ukwenza lo msebenzi sisanenselelo yokwenza ukuthi abantu bakithi bazi kabanzi ngomsebenzi esiwenzayo. Yingakho sandisa izigcawu ezinjena ngoba sifuna ukuqhubeka nevangeli lokuthi abantu bazi ukuthi ukuba nomeluleki wezezimali yinto engenambandela namigomo etheni. Kepha idinga ukuthi uyenze ngokushesha kusukela uqala ukusebenza noma uma nje usunendlela ongenisa imali ngayo ukuze wejwayele ukuhlela nokuphatha imali yakho ngendlela efanele," kusho yena. USolwazi van Aardt uthe nakuba kusenzima kanje futhi usemkhulu umsebenzi okusadingeka ukuthi bawenze ukulungisa lesi simo kodwa kuyabejabulisa ukuthi bakhona abantu abaphumela obala, becelwa ukuchushiswa ngamasu okuphatha nokonga imali. Uthe lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi isimo sibe ngcono njengoba nabo bezimisele ukuqhubeka bafake lo moya ebantwini.Isikhulu esiphezulu sophiko lwezokumaketha eMomentum Group, uNksz Nontokozo Madonsela, sithe banethemba lokuthi ukwandisa kwabo izigcawu ezinjena kuzosiza ukwesusa ulwembu olusathe mbo ebantwini. Uthe okumanje abantu kabangaqondi ubumqoka bokuba nomeluleki wezezimali, okuzosiza ukunqoba inkinga yabantu ababhajwe ezikweletini.Ezinye izikhulumi ebezikhona kulo mbuthwano, wumholi weWealth Managament yaseMomentum, uNkk Therese Grobler, uNksz Mamelo Masote wophiko lwezokuxhumana eMomentum nomakadebona wezokuthula izinhlelo, obephethe uhlelo, uDan Moyane.
UBUNONO, ubuqhathanzipho nokubambisana yizona zinto ezigqame kubazalwane bebandla leZayoni Isiqalo Sokuthula Kwama KreStu Church of God in Zion, enkonzweni yoMkhosi wePhasika ebeliyenze eSikhonyane Primary School, eNdulinde, eMandeni ngempelasonto edlule yokugubha lo mkhosi wamaKrestu waminyaka yonke. KUSALINDWE ummeli ukuba aqale axoxe nowesifazane osolwa ngokubulala indodakazi yakhe ngoba eyifake kumshwalense.UNksz Ncamisile Evarista Hlophe ubekwe wuMbuso icala lokubulala ngenhloso indodakazi yakhe eneminyaka engu-14, uLuvuyo Tafadzwe. Ummangalelwa ubevele kafushane eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseNtuzuma. Isigameko kusolakala ukuthi senzeka emzini wakhe, uNksz Hlophe, oKwaMashu, ngoJuly 22, 2024.Lo wesifazane kuthiwa wazisa amaphoyisa ukuthi umufi ubekade esanda kuphuza amaphilisi akhe ekhanda, wacambalala, akabange esavuka emva kwalokho kodwa okwaxaka ngukuthi isidumbu sikamufi satholakala sinenxeba elibi kakhulu ngemuva kwekhanda futhi eshonele khona lapho. Inxeba kuthiwa lalimbi kakhulu kubonakala sengathi ugwazwe ngento ecijile. Ngemuva kwalokho, unina wabe esekhalelwa ngamasongo kaSigonyela ngo-Agasti, emuva nje kwenyanga, kushone umufi.Enkantolo ngaphambilini, kwahlaluka ukuthi umphenyi wecala namaphoyisa bathola ukuthi umufi wabulawa, hhayi ukuthi washona kade ephuze amaphilisi. Kwavela ngaphambilini futhi ukuthi omakhwelwane bawuzwa umsindo kamufi ngezithuba zasekuseni ehayiza kodwa bangaqonda ukuthi kwenzakalani.Kuthiwa yaqala inkukhu yawusola umgqakazo uma sebethola izindaba zokuthi indodakazi ibulewe.Ngesikhathi ligcina ukuhlala enkantolo leli cala, lahlehliswa ngoba uMbuso waveza ukuthi idokodo kalifinyelelanga enkantolo. Kwahlaluka nokuthi leli cala selisezandleni zeProvincial Task Team.Izolo, umsolwa ungene enkantolo ebonakala njengomuntu odidekile.Ummeli kamsolwa, uMnuz Siya Mncube, utshele inkantolo ukuthi usadinga isikhathi sokuqale axhumane kahle nomsolwa ngaphambi kokuba leli cala liqale ukuqulwa. Imantshi ivumile yathi lokho kumqoka kakhulu ukuba makwenzeke, yabe seyithatha isinqumo sokuba leli cala ilihlehlisele uMeyi 19.Ngaphakathi enkantolo bekukhona amalungu omphakathi.
UKhomishana wamaphoyisa kuzwelonke, uGeneral Fannie Masemola ucela usizo kumalungu omphakathi ukuze athole oConstable abathathu abalahlekile. Laba abathathu, abesifazane ababili nowesilisa, uConstable Cebekhulu Linda, 24, uConstable Keamogetswe Buys (30) noConstable Boipelo Senoge (20) bebehamba ngemoto yohlobo lwe-VW emhlophe besuka eBloemfontein beya endaweni abebesebenzela kuyona eLimpopo. Indawo yabo yokugcina eyaziwayo bekusegaraji lakwa-Engen eduze kwase-Grasmere toll plaza ku-N1 ngoLwesithathu, zingama-23 ku-Ephreli 2025. Imishini yokuthungatha izimoto kanye namaselula beyivaliwe kusukela ngelanga abaduka ngalo. Inombolo yabo yokubhaliswa kwemoto ithi JCL 401 FS. Amalungu abengekho emsebenzini ngaleso sikhathi futhi awazange afike lapho abejutshelwe khona. Kunxuswa noma ngubani ongaba nolwazi ngokuthi ashayele umphenyi wecala uCaptain Chaacha Manga ku-082 527 6099. I-SAPS iphenya icala lokuduna imoto kanye nokuthumba.

Ngiqale emculweni ngiphelezela abanye abaculi ngephimbo. Ngo-2015, ngabe sengenza eyami i-albhamu ethi Bayeke Bahleke. Ngo-2019, ngibe sengilandelisa ngethi Anginavalo."UThandeka uyingane yesibili ebantwaneni abane bakaBonangani uMaXulu noThulebona Radebe. UMNYANGO wezokuVakasha kuleli uthi konke kumi ngomumo ngombukiso omkhulukazi wamabhizinisi ezokuvaka ezwenikazi lase-Afrika, i-Africa Travel ndaba (ATI) ngenyanga ezayo.Lo mbukiso othatha izinsuku ezintathu kusukela ngomhlaMeyi 13 kuya ku-15, 2025, uqala ngohlelo olwaziwe nge-Business Opportunity Networking Day (BONDay) ngoMeyi 12, lapho osomabhizinisi abahlukene behlangana ndawonye ukwazana kangcono ngaphambi kokuthi kuqale imibukiso e-ICC, eThekwini.NgoLwesithathu, kuhlangane ndawonye ababamba iqhaza embonini yezokuvakasha, osomabhizinisi abancane nabakhulu, abezindaba nezinhlaka ezahlukene zikahulumeni ezibambe iqhaza kule mboni, enkundleni iMoses Mabhida, lapho uNgqongqoshe wezokuVakasha, uNksz uPatricia de Lille, eqhakambise iqhaza elikhulayo lalo mcimbi ekuthuthukiseni umnotho okubandakanya wonke umuntu, ukusungula izinto ezintsha nokusebenzisana kwezifunda. Indikimba yalo nyaka, ethi, "I-Afrika Engenamkhawulo,” ibeka izwekazi njengendawo yokufinyelela nezifiso ezingenamkhawulo.Umcimbi uzophinde unikeze abathengi ithuba elilodwa lokuzitholela imikhiqizo ehlukahlukene yezokuvakasha nolwazi oluvela ezwenikazi lonke. Njengoba kunabakhangisi abangaphezu kwa-1,200 abavela emazweni awu-26 ase-Afrika nabathengi bamazwe ngamazwe abangu-908 abahloliwe abamele izimakethe zomhlaba wonke ezingu-55. Iningi labo selihlele imihlangano engaphezu kuka-7,430 eqinisekisiwe yokuxhumana kosomabhizinisi abahlukene.Enkulumweni yakhe yosuku, u-De Lille uchaze i-ATI ngokuthi: "Akuwona nje umbukiso wezohwebo - iyinkundla yokubumba kabusha izindaba ezixoxwayo, ukwakha ukuxhumana okunamandla nokuvula ukubaluleka kokwaba amagugu alo lonke izwekazi lethu." Ungqongqoshe uveze ukuthi nakulo nyaka kukhona osomabhizinisi abangu-120 abasafufusa abathole ithuba eliyingqayizivele lokukhangisa imisebenzi yabo kulo mbukiso."Leli thuba lizosiza kakhulu osomabhizinisi ukuthi bakwazi ukuxhumana nabathengi bakwamanye amazwe, bakhe ubudlelwano obusha futhi bahehe izivakashi ngemikhiqizo yabo ekhethekile." UDe Lille ubuye wazwakalisa injabulo yakhe ngokuthi lo mcimbi wandulela ukwethulwa komkhankaso omkhulu wezokuvakasha osatshalaliswe umhlaba wonke othi, "INingizimu Afrika Ilindile - Woza Uthole Injabulo Yakho! Umgubho oqhakambisa ubuhle bezwe, ukuqhakaza kwamasiko namagugu.""Umgomo wethu ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izivakashi ziyeza ukuze zithole injabulo yazo kulo lonke elaseNingizimu Afrika futhi zivumbulule zonke izinhlobonhlobo zezinhlelo kwezokuvakasha esinazo namagugu ethu afihlwe kuwo wonke amadolobha amancane nasemalokishini."
USEQALE izingxoxo nabaholi abehlukene bamaqembu ezepolitiki kanjalo ne-Judicial Service Commission, uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, mayelana nozojutshelwa kwesephini likamengameli wamajaji kuleli.Lesi sikhundla savuleka emva kokuba owayesiphethe, uJaji Mandisa Maya ajutshelwa kwesikauengameli wamaJaji. Washiya lesi sikhundla ngoSepthemba 1, 2024.Okhulumela uRamaphosa uMnuz Vincent Magwenya, uthe umengameli uqoka iphini likamengameli wamajaji, emuva kokuxoxa ne-JSC kanjalo nabaholi bamaqembu ahlukene. Uthe uRamaphosa ubhalele uJaji Maya, ongusihlalo weJSC, efuna umbono wakhe."Bane abaphakanyiselwe kulesi sikhundla, umengameli afuna umbono ngabo ukuze kuqokwe oyedwa ozongena kulesi sikhundla. Lokhu ukwenza ngokuhlanganyela nezinhlaka ezehlukene," usho kanje.Abakaphanyisiwe oJaji Dunstan Mlambo, Mahube Molemela, Cagney John Musi, noLazarus Pule Tlaletsi. UMagwenya uthe libaluleke kakhulu iqhaza elidlalwa yiphini likamengameli wamajaji kwezobulungiswa kuleli."Nguyena muntu oqinisekisa ukuthi ezobulungiswa ziyahlonishwa, umthetho uyalandelwa kanjalo nokuthi ikhona inkululeko kuMthethosisekelo."Uthe abaholi bamaqembu uRamaphosa axoxa nabo amelwe ePhalamende lakuleli. Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi kwaqopheka umlando ngesikhathi uJaji Maya ephakanyiselwa esikhundleni sokuba ngumengameli wamajaji, njengoba wayengakaze abekhona owesifazane.Lesi sinyathelo sanconywa kakhulu emkhankasweni wezwe wokufukula abesifazane emkhakheni ehlukene yakuleli.Abesifazane bamelwe ngo-48% kwezobulungiswa kuleli okusho ukuthi ezimantshini nasemajajini angu-252 akhona kuleli, angu-121 abesifazane. Zingu-15 izinkantolo eziphethwe abesifazane kuleli. Ngaphambi kuka-1994, akekho owesifazane omnyama owayeyijaji kuleli kanti emajajini angu-150 ngalesi sikhathi amabili awo kwakungabesifazane.

UBUBHODLA umlilo umphakathi waseMaoti, eNanda, uhlome ngayo yonke inhlobo yesikhali izolo, ngesikhathi ubhikisha ngaphandle kweNkantolo yeMantshi yaseNtuzuma, lapho obekuvela khona abane abasolwa ngokuba ngamalungu eWest, okuyiqembu lemigulukudu elesatshwayo. Laba abane okungoMnuz Sanele Ngwane, Sfiso Ngema, Sanele Shwabede noKhayelihle Cele, bebevele ngoxhaxha lwamacala abucayi, okukhona phakathi awokubulala, ukuzama ukubulala, ukubamba inkunzi kuhlonyiwe nokuthumba okuthiwa bawenze kusuka ngoJuni ngonyaka odlule kuze kuba bayaboshwa. Bakhalelwe amasongo kaSigonyela ngoMgqibelo, eCato Manor, eMayville. Umphakathi obubhikisha ngaphandle kwenkantolo nobugcwele intukuthelo, ukubeke lwacaca ukuthi awudingi badedelwe ngebheyili abasolwa. Uze wasonga ngokuthi uma kungenzeka badedelwe ngebheyili, bazobanquma.Phakathi kwezikhali ebebeziphethe imikhonto, ebebeze bayilole etiyeleni, ocelemba ababukhali, izimvubu, izinduku kanjalo nezagila. Osohlakeni olulwa nobugebengu kule ndawo, uMnuz Mbongeni Phewa, uthe into ekhiphe umphakathi ezindlini, ukuba manzonzo kwesimo eMaoti namaphethelo ngenxa yaleli qembu lemigulukudu. Uthe okubajabhisa kakhulu ukuthi bancane abasolwa ngeminyaka kodwa benza ubugebengu obunyantisa igazi. "Kukhona abesifazane asebephenduke abafelokazi, izingane eziphenduke izintandane ngenxa yalezi zingane. Silana ukuzozwakalisa ilaka lethu ukuthi lezi ngane zingalinge zidedelwe ngebheyili," kusho uPhewa, othe bayazisaba ngoba azinanembeza.Uthe bayakubonga ukusebenza ngokuzikhandla kwamaphoyisa. Uthe lokhu kuqale emva kwembizo ebibanjwe eMaoti, eyayihanjelwe uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLt Gen Mkhwanaza."Basithembisa ukuthi amaphoyisa azohambahamba endaweni. Lezi zingane zilahlekelwe onembeza. Izingane ezino -14 sezinezidumbu ezingaphezu kuka-20," kusho uPhewa. Uthe umphakathi uzwakalise ukuthi uzosebenzisana namaphoyisa, kakhulu kunakuqala.
USASEZINHLUNGWINI namanje unina wowesifazane okwembulwa kwembeswa kuyena esibhedlela, kulandela isigameko okuthiwa uxhonxwe kuso amehlo ngobeyisoka lakhe esebenzisa i-screwdriver. Lowo mngani ukhishiwe ungaphandle, siyesaba, sizizwa singaphephile,” kuchaza uNksz Nxele. SEKUQALA ukuzwela emqondweni nasemzimbeni kowesifazane onebhizinisi lezindawo zokuhlala eziqashisayo, osola uMnyango wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal ngokugweva nemali ewuR15 million, athi sekuphele iminyaka emibili elinde ukukhokhelwa yona.Elandisa Isolezwe ngosizi lwakhe, uNksz Yandisa Mbulawa, ohlala eThekwini, uthe uqale ukusebenzisana noMnyango wezeMpilo ngo-2021 benza isivumelwano sokusebenzisana ngokuthi usebenzise izindawo zakhe zokuhlala, uziqashele odokotela bomnyango.Uthe unezindawo zokuhlala eziyisithupha okungezimbili eMgungundlovu, eyodwa eKokstad, eXobho, eGreytown naKwaMaphumulo lapho bekuqashe khona abasebenzi bomnyango okungodokotela abawu-79 uma sebehlangene bonke kuzona zoyisithupha ngokwehlukana."Besisebenzisana kahle kusukela ngaleso sikhathi futhi bekhokha kahle imali yenyanga yonke eba kuR5 000 kuya phezulu indlu ngayinye, kuthe kusuka ngabo-2023 baqala umkhuba wokungakhokhi ngesikhathi, kuthi uma kwenzekile bakhokha kodwa kube wukuthi imali abangikhokhela yona kayipheleli, belokhu bethembisa into engekho. Isikweletu besilokhu sikhula kanjalo njengoba manje sesize safika kuR15 million,” usho kanje.Uthe ubelokhu ebekezela, ezitshela ukuthi bazomkhokhela imali yakhe, ebilokhu inyuka kancane, kancane njalo ekupheleni kwenyanga, okugcine kumfaka ezikweletini sekudla kuyena ephaketheni, kwaze kwaba wukuthi udaba ulwedlulisa kubameli bakhe."Nalapho futhi sengizame ngaze ngaphelelwa yikho konke ebengikubekile ngoba konke okwenziwayo kudinga ukuthi ngikhiphe imali ekubeni kungalungi ngokushesha, ngaze ngabisha ezikweletini kangangokuthi kumanje ngicindezelekile emqondweni, ngiphelelwa amandla ngoba le nto iyangihlukumeza nsuku zonke,” kusho uNksz Mbulawa.Leli phephanda libubonile ubufakazi bokuxhumana kwaboMnyango wezeMpilo noNksz Mbulawa, labona futhi okukhombisa imali esuka kwabomnyango iya kuyena - kanjalo nesikhathi nezinsuku okwenzeka ngaso lokho phakathi kwezinhlangothi zombili.UNksz Mbulawa udalule nokuthi ngendlela izinto ezinzima ngayo ngenxa yalesi simo kuze kwafika lapho esegula khona, wakhushukelwa wushukela waze walala esibhedlela, okwenza abone sengathi kuzoqhubeka kube nzima ngoba usuku nosuku le nto iyamudla."Okunye okungihlukumeze kakhulu wukuthi abomnyango bathe besuka bathatha abasebenzi bayobaqashela kwezinye izindawo, okungididile wukuthi bakwenza kanjani lokho ngoba phela kimina bahlale bekhala ngokuthi abanayo imali, engingazi-ke ukuthi bazokhokha ngani lapho sebebaqashele khona manje,” kukhononda uNksz Mbulawa.Uthe indlela lesi simo esimhlukumeza ngayo sesiqala nokumthikameza nasemqondweni njengoba esanda kuzama ukuvala ngebhasi esinye sezibhedlela zakhona eMgungundlovu, ezitshela ukuthi kuzoba ngcono, kodwa kwangasiza ngalutho - ngoba esikhundleni sokuthi kulalelwe izikhalo zakhe, kuvele kwabizwa amaphoyisa amchayisa.Kuthintwa okhulumela uMnyango weMpilo eKZN uMnuz Nathi Olifant uthe uzobuyela entathelini uma sekukhona angakusho ngalolu daba.
ISABISE ngombhikisho uma uMnyango weMfundo eyisiSekelo uziba izikhalazo zayo inyunyana yothisha iSadtu.Le nyunyana igcwale imigwaqo yasePitoli, izolo, yalibhekisa emahhovisi oMnyango wezeMfundo, nakuMgcinimafa ukuyozwakalisa izikhalazo ngokuncishiswa kwesabelomali sezeMfundo.OwezeMfundo unikwe izinsuku ezingu-21 ukuthi uphendule uhlu lwezikhalazo zeSadtu ngendlela egculisayo, uma kungenjalo kuyoqhuma nhlamvana. Izikhalazo zeSadtu zifaka ukungakhokhelwa ngesikhathi imali ephucula amaholo othisha minyaka yonke, ukungalungiswa kwezikole, ukugqoza kwengqalasizinda ezikoleni, ubugebengu ezikoleni okufaka ukungaphephi kothisha nezinye.UNobhala Jikelele weSadtu, uDkt Mugwena Maluleke, uthe ukuncishiswa kwesabelomali, kulimaza ezemfundo kuleli.Uthe lokhu kwenza inqwaba yothisha isule ezikhundleni, kusale ingcosana. "Othisha babhekene nomthwalo omkhulu, wokufundisa amakilasi agcwele. Ukushoda kothisha kwenza ukuthi abanye bathwale ijoka lokufundisa inqwaba yabafundi, bese bengabaniki isikhathi esenele abafundi."Uthe ingqalasizinda ezikoleni ayigculisi kuleli."Abafundi nothisha bahlala ezikoleni ezingekho esimweni. Abafundi abamnyama bayaqhubeka nokuntula, kuthi abadla izambane likapondo, izikole zabo zinazo zonke izinsiza, okubalwa nama-swimming pool," kusho uMaluleke. UMaluleke uveze ukuthi izwe alikwazi ukulahlekelwa othisha abanamava."Asikwazi ukudedela othisha abanamava ngenxa yokuthi kudingeka kufakwe abancane. Abagcinwe othisha baze bathathe umhlalaphansi." Ihlale iyinkinga eyokungaqashwa kothisha ezikoleni kanjalo nokugcwala kakhulu kwamakilasi.KwaZulu-Natal, le nyunyana ihlale ilwa nomnyango ngenxa yokungafakwa ngesikhathi kwemali yezikole, eyaziwa ngama-norms and standards ngenxa yokungeneli kwemali.Lokhu kwenza othishanhloko bagcine sebekweleta osonkontileka ngenxa yokuthi umnyango usuke ungakhokhile.Kwawona umnyango uyahluleka ukukhokhela ngesikhathi osonkontileka ngenxa yokuthi imali isuke ingekho.Umnyango wesifundazwe usuze wayalelwa ukuthi ungazenzi izinhlelo ezintsha ngenxa yemali.Uhlu lwezikhalazo emashini yeSadtu lwamukelwe nguDkt Granville Whittle, othembise ukuphendula zingakapheli izinsuku eziwu-21.Ngesikhathi uMaluleke etshela abebesemashini ukuthi uNgqongqoshe walo mnyango, uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, akekho, kube nenhlokomo kumalungu eSadtu.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi abubuhle ubudlelwano phakathi kukaNksz Gwabure neSadtu.Okunye uMaluleke athe abajiki kukhona, ngukuthi bafuna uqale usebenze ngokushesha umthetho wezikole iBela, owasusa umsindo emaqenjini ahlukene okubalwa ne-DA.
NJENGOBA ibandla lamaRoma aKhatholika lisemanzini kulandela ukudlula emhlabeni komholi walo, uPope Francis (88), ngakolunye uhlangothi lesi sehlo sivuselele ubudlelwano phakathi kwaleli bandla nelamaLuthela.UFrancis udlule emhlabeni ngoMsombuluko kulandela ukuxinwa ukugula isikhathi eside. Ngonyaka ka-1517, uMartin Luther ongumsunguli webandla lamaLuthela waphumela obala ephikisana nezinye zezimfundiso zamaRoma aKhatholika okwaholela ekutheni agcine ephumile kuwo, wazaleka ibandla lamaLuthela. Emva kokuzwakala kwezindaba zokudlula emhlabeni kukaFrancis, uMbhishobhi oMkhulu wamaLuthela eNingizimu Afrika, uNkosinathi Myaka, uthe uFrancis ukulwele ukuxhumana kwabezinkolo ezahlukene, wanxusa amaKhatholika namaLuthela ukuba ahlanganyele abe yizikhonzi zethemba."Ngo-Okthoba 31, 2016, uFrancis ugubhe nabaholi beLWF (Lutheran World Foundation)... emadolobheni aseSweden, emicimbini yokugubha iminyaka engu-500 yokuqembuka kwebandla lamaLuthela ngo-1517," kubeka uMbhishobhi Myaka.Uthe kule micimbi eyayigqugquzelwa ukuzibophezela kwango-1999, uFrancis nabaholi bamaLuthela banxusa amaKhatholika namaLuthela ukuba akhohlwe okudala okwakugujuzelwe yizingxabano nokwehlukana kodwa bahambe ngokuhlanganyela. Uphethe ngokuthi sengathi ifagugu likaFrancis lingahlala ligqugquzela ukubekezelelana, ukuhlangana kwabezinkolo nentuthuko.UFrancis kulindeleke ukuba angcwatshwe ngoMgqibelo, eSt Peter's Square.Izolo, isidumbu sakhe besiseSt. Peter’s Basilica, lapho bekunenkonzo khona futhi sizohlala kule ndawo izinsukwana ukuze abantu bafike bezombona, ngaphambi kokuba angcwatshwe.Nakuleli kube nenkonzo yesikhumbuzo kaPope ebiseCathedral of Christ eGoli, ebihanjelwe abaholi abehlukene bamaqembu ezepolitiki okubalwa nabe-ANC.

KUZOBEKWA eqhulwini ukulungiswa kwenkinga ebhekene nezindawo ezakhele uMasipala weTheku, esabelwenimali esizothulwa ngumkhandlu.Lokhu kuvele njengoba lo masipala uqale uchungechunge lwemikhankaso yokulalelwa kwemibono yezakhamuzi ngesabelomali sika-2025/26.NgoLwesibili umasipala uhlangane nezinhlangano ezimele abakhokhela ukuhlinzekwa ngezidingo lapho kuvezwe imibono ngezithinta amanzi, ugesi nokunyuswa kwemali yezidingo.Izolo kulalelwe imibono yomphakathi waseHammarsdale. ITheku lithi okuphawulekayo ngalesi sabelomali sika-R71.3 billion, wukuthi sibeka eqhulwini ukuhlinzekwa kwezidingo ezibalulekile njengoba u-R1.15 billion, uzofakwa ohlelweni lokunqanda ukumosheka kwamanzi nokufakwa kwamapayipi amanzi amasha.U-R859 million uzoya ezinhlelweni zikagesi.IMeya yeTheku, uMnuz Cyril Xaba, ithe: "Lesi sabelomali sizogxila ekuhlinzekweni kwezidingongqangi. Kuzothuthukiswa ingqalasizinda yedolobha. Zikhona izinhlelo zokulungisa, ukwenziwa ngcono nokufakwa kwengqalasizinda esikhathini esifishane, esiphakathi neside." Umasipala uveze ukuthi kuphakanyiswe ukuthi imali yokukhokhela ukuhlinzekwa ngezidingo eqondene nogesi inyuke ngamaphesenti angu-12.72, amanzi ngo-15% ezindaweni ezihlala abantu no-16% kwezamabhizinisi.Eyokuthuthwa kwendle ezindaweni zabantu kuphakanyiswe ukuba inyuke ngamaphesenti angu-13, kwezamabhizinisi angu-14, ukuthuthwa kukadoti ezindaweni ezihlala abantu ngo-9.9 kanye no-9 kwezamabhizinisi.Eyezakhiwo izokhuphuka ngo-6.5%. UXaba uphethe ngokuthi izigcawu zokulalelwa kwemibono yomphakathi zizosongwa ngoMeyi 14."Zibalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izakhamuzi ziba ngumnikazi kamasipala. Isabelomali sizophasiswa ngoMeyi 22, uma sekulalelwe imibono yomphakathi."
INKAKHA emculweni ongasoze wabuna, uBongani Nkwanyana, ithembisa lukhulu ekhonsathini yayo kwiSunday Jazz Sundowners eBat Centre, eThekwini, ngo-Ephreli 27 kusukela ngo-3 ntambama. UNkwanyana uthe uzoqhulula wonke amanoni akhe aziwa ngawo bese ebuya ebhansela izithameli ngazowacaphuna emisebenzini kaSipho Gumede, kwazise phela ukuthi waphekwa wuGumede waze wavuthwa eminyakeni eyedlule. Yingakho uNkwanyana aze wenza ingoma eyayisihloko sithi Moments To Remember, ayethulela ngayo uGumede isigqoko. UNkwanyana noGumede bazalelwa eMkhumbane, okuyindawo esiyaziwa ngeCator Manor ngesikhathi kusabhoke ubandlululo kuleli.Njengeminye imindeni, nokaNkwanyana waphoqeleka ukuyohlala elokishini KwaMashu ngo-1965, yena eseneminyaka emithathu. Ukungena emculweni wakuqala ngo-1974 ngesikhathi uyise ethenga izinsimbi zomculo maqede wasungula iqembu. Emuva kwalokho uNkwanyana wajoyina ibhendi eyayizinze KwaMashu, iStax. Kulelo qembu elaliholwa nguQunta Mbhele, uNkwanyana wazithola esesebenza nomufi uMandla Masuku owayefutha i-saxophone noWake Mahlobo owayeshaya ama-drums. NgoSepthemba 1984, iStax sadla umhlanganiso emqhudelwaneni iLion Lager Talent Search Show. Yacabeka lapho indlela ebheke empumelelweni kuNkwanyana. Ngo-1986 uNkwanyana wathatha imithwalo yakhe wabhekisa amabombo eGoli lapho afike wajoyina khona iqembu iCasino. YikwiCasino lapho uNkwanyana afike wathola ithuba lokufunda izigqi eziningi zomculo futhi wagcina esesebenza nezingwazi ezinjengoGTX Xaba, Busi Mhlongo, Wendy Mseleku, Tu Nokwe, Mercy Phakela, Ali Katt noMbongeni Ngema. Wazithola esenandisa emicimbini enezihlabani zamazwe ngamazwe koGermany, Swatini, Botswana, Senegal, Namibia nakwamanye amazwe amaningi. UNkwanyana wabe esehlangana noGumede owachazeka yikhono lalo mdlali wesigingci sebhesi. UGumede akacucuzanga kodwa wavele waqasha uNkwanyana ukuba adlale kwibhendi yakhe. Udlale ebhendini kaGumede kwaze kwaba uyadlula emhlabeni ngo-2004. Waqopha ama-albhamu amaningi noGumede, okubalwa kuwo ethi Ubuntu, 20 Years of Life nethi African Sunshine. Uma ulalela umculo kaNkwanyana uyezwa ukuthi uphuma ebhodweni elabaselwa futhi labondwa wuGumede kangangoba izigqi zabo zifana ncamashi. Esehambile emhlabeni uGumede, uNkwanyana wabe esezimela futhi wakhipha i-albhamu yakhe yokuqala eyayithi Ithemba Lami. Amangwevu kuNkwanyana azwakala ezingomeni ezithi Zikode, Talking Fingers neMoments To Remember. Ngo-2022 uNkwanyana wahlabana ngendondo yeBest Jazz Bassist kumaMzansi Musical Instrumentalist Awards.
