KUNGAPHEZU kwethu ukuphawula ngezinqumo ezisuke zikhishwe yinkantolo ngemuva kokuthethwa kwamacala, ikakhulu ngoba ubulungiswa abusebenzi ngemizwa nezinseka futhi abunahlangothi olubukhali nolubuthuntu ukwedlula olunye. Kodwa kunzima ukungabhekisisi okushiwo yiJaji ecaleni likaMfundisi uTimothy Omotoso obebekwe amacala abucayi okunukubeza ngocansi. Lapha kuvele ukuthi abezokushushisa badembeselile ngokungasingathi ngendlela icala okuholele ekutheni adedelwe njengomsulwa ummangalelwa.Yishwa elesabekayo leli ngoba okushiwo yijaji kunenhlese yokuthi ubufakazi obethuliwe yilabo abathinteka kula macala okudlwengula, isihluku socansi nokucumbaza, bekungatholakala isinqumo esehlukile kulesi esikhishiwe ukuba abashushisi babephapheme.Ngale kokusola kakhulu abezokushushisa, singeke sakubalekela ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika ibhekene nenkanankana ngendaba yokudlwengulwa kwabantu besifazane nezingane. Okwenza le nkinga iqonge mawala yikuthi iningi lale mikhuba lenzeka esimeni lapho abesifazane noma izingane becabanga ukuthi baphephile khona.Akuyona imfihlo ukwanda kweziga lapho abadlwenguli nabanukubezi kuba ngabantu abasondele noma abathenjiwe yizisulu. Singakusho ngaphandle kokushwathiza ukuthi abefundisi, obaba, obhuti, omkhulu, omalume, abangani, abalingani emsebenzini nezinye izihlobo kanye nomaqondaba uqobo abasuke beseduze nezisulu yibona bantu abavame ukugila le mikhuba bese bekwazi ukugcina bengajezanga ngezenzo zabo.Iningi lalezi zimo zenzeka zinyathelwa ngaphakathi emindenini, kokunye abagilwa besabe ukubhoboka ngezizathu ezehlukene, bafele phakathi nesilonda esingaseyikuphola. Kuyacaca-ke ukuthi ubunuku obuningi bufihlwa khona emiphakathini, emisebenzini nasemindenini bungafiki nasezandleni zomthetho ubufakazi. Kushiya iphunga elibi ezandleni zabashushisi ubudedengu bokusingatha icala lale nceku edabuka eNigeria eyabanjwa isizama ukushaya ichithe belu.
MHLELI: Abantu bakhombisile ukuthi kumele beluswe njengezinkomo ngokuqina komthetho. Lokhu kufakazelwe wukuncipha kwezingozi emigwaqweni ezivame ukudlula nemiphefumulo yabantu obesekufana nensakavukela ezweni. Uchithisaka wezivimbamigwaqo kuzona zonke izifundazwe kusilethele izithelo ezinhle kwancipha nezingozi ebezivamise yonke iminyaka zedlule nemiphefumulo. Okwenzeke kula maholidi kuvule ikhasi elisha kwababhekele ukuhlonishwa kwemithetho emigwaqweni, ikakhulukazi kwabaphuza amambawu maqede beshayele izimoto sebedakiwe.Siyafisa ukuba abezokuphepha bahambe ngaleli giya nangamaholidi kaKhisimuzi. Sikhathele abantu abaphuza sengathi baloywa umthakathi maqede wafa nezikhwama zakhe. Umthetho sengathi ungaqina kuzona zonke izigameko zokuphulwa kwemithetho, ikakhulukazi emacaleni okubulawa kwabantu osekufana nomdlalo ezweni lethu.Sengathi nezinkantolo zingake zilungise indaba yokuba lula ukutholakala kwebheyili. Sikhathele ukubona abagilwa bodlame bebhikisha ezinkantolo, bechitha izicelo zamabheyili. Sengathi nalo mthetho owafika neNingizimu Afrika emva kokhetho lwango-1994 wokuthi umuntu uthathwa ngokuthi akanacala kuze kube uyagwetshwa bawuthatha ngesinxele .Sipho Robert MpungoseESHOWE
BABANDELWA zinyawo abagilwa yiqembu lemigulukudu yeWest eMaoti eNanda, ukuyokhomba abasolwa ababoshwe amaphoyisa ngamacala ahlukene okubalwa awokubulala.Kuhlokome iNanda amaphoyisa ebopha abasolwa abane abayamaniswa naleli qembu lemigulukudu eselikhathazile. Ngokusho kwamaphoyisa, abasolwa abaneminyaka ephakathi kuka-21 no-33, bavalelwe ngamaphoyisa ekhoneni ngoMgqibelo, eCato Manor, lapho ebebebhace khona. Ngokusho kwesitatimende samaphoyisa, bebefunelwa amacala angaphezu kuka-20 okubulala kanjalo nayinqwaba okuzama ukubulala, okuthiwa bawenze kusuka kuJuni ngonyaka odlule kuze kube yimanje. Ngokusho kwelungu lomphakathi elisezinhlakeni ezilwa nobugebengu eNanda, elingeke livezwe, lithe kujabule wonke umuntu kuzwakala izindaba zokuboshwa kwabasolwa. "Abantu banethemba lokuthi buzoke buthi ukuxega kancane ubugebengu obunyantisa igazi eMaoti njengoba beboshiwe,” kusho leli lungu.Lithe kukhona ukukhathazeka abanakho ngabasolwa njengoba amaphoyisa eseqalile efonela abagilwa nofakazi ukuthi beze ukuzoqinisekisa ukuthi yibo abasolwa, babakhombe kwi-nkombamuntu (i-parade). "Ngokwazi ukuthi lezi zingane ziyingozi kanjani, iningi lalabo asebefonelwe, liyasaba ukuya. Linovalo lokuthi, lizoba yizisulu zokubulawa, emva kokubakhomba ngoba wonke umuntu uyazi ukuthi ziyingozi kangakanani, zinamehlo azo ngaphandle, yize ziboshiwe,” kusho ilungu lomphakathi. Nokho lithe beyizinhlaka ezilwa nobugebengu endaweni, bazama ngakho konke okusemandleni ukubatshela abagilwa nofakazi ukuthi ukutholakala kobulungiswa, kuncike ekutheni basebenzisane namaphoyisa."Siyabagqugquzela impela ukuthi baye ukuyobakhomba ukuze buqine ngokwanele ubufakazi amacala uma esequlwa enkantolo. Siyabatshela ukuthi uma bengayi, lokho kungaholela nasekutheni badedelwe, luqale phansi usizi lokuphila lubhojozi endaweni,” lisho kanje. Enza izibonelo ngamanye amacala abasolwa ngawo, uthe kukhona elokudutshulwa kubulawe usomatekisi, okuthiwa wadutshulwa ehleli nabangani ngaphandle kwesitolo sendawo, iSunrise ngasekupheleni kukaFebhuwari kulo nyaka."Bathushuka (umufi nabangani) bezihlalele, beziphuzela. Kwaba wuye kuphela abamqhulula ngenhlamvu, maqede bamkhuthuza, bathatha isibhamu sakhe, bazihambela,” kukhumbula ilungu lezokuphepha. Kwesinye isigameko, lithe badubula babulala uMnuz David Bheja owayenesitolo, abahlangana naye ehamba ngezinyawo, naye abathatha isibhamu sakhe. Ilungu lithe umphakathi uhlela ukuyomasha ngaphandle kwenkantolo kusasa uma sebevela, ukuzwakalisa ilaka lawo nokuthi awufuni badedelwe ngebheyili. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe abasolwa batholwe nezibhamu ezimbili, izinhlamvu nezimpahla okusolwa ukuthi zebiwe, okukhona kuzo ama-laptop namaselula.Uthe uphenyo lwamaphoyisa lusaqhubeka kanti kusathungathwa nabanye abasolwa. UKhomishana wamaPhoyisa esifundazweni, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, ukushayele ihlombe ukusebenza ngokuzikhandla kwamaphoyisa okufaka phakathi iCrime Intelligence, Cato Manor Crime Prevention, Inanda Detectives neDurban Metro Police.
LUYINDABA egudwini kumalungu omphakathi waseKhombe, eNkandla, udaba lwesehlakalo sangeSonto, lapho kuthiwa khona indodana yenduna idubule yabulala umuntu kade idlala ngesibhamu, maqede yadla phansi.Umthombo weSolezwe ongeke udalulwe, uveze ukuthi indodana yenduna yaseThuma, igcwele amathafa ngemuva kokuba isolwe ngokudubula kwafa uMnuz Thamsanqa Mkhize.Kuthiwa le ndodana kayihlukani nesibhamu futhi iyazazi ukuthi ngeke ithintwe ngoba ''kwesatshwa'' uyise, uMnuz Muntuwo Dladla. Umthombo uthe indodana ibikade iphethe isibhamu, ihamba nabangani bayo yase ibona iqulu labafana bephuma emcimbini othile, yabatshela ukuthi yize yona ikude kodwa ''ingamkora'' umufi.Kuthiwa ibizincoma ithi izobe ingaqali ukuthi idubule ibulale umuntu ikude ngoba yona nesibhamu bajwayelene, nenhlamvu iya lapho esuke ithunywe khona, kayigeji.''Bamphikisile abangani bakhe, nebala yase isikhipha isibhamu yadubula, inhlamvu yamshaya esiphongweni uThamsanqa,'' kuchaza umthombo onxuse ukuthi lingalinge lidalulwe igama lawo ngoba umndeni kaDladla, uyasatshwa njengoba aphinde abe usomatekisi. Kuthiwa indodana yenduna ibona ukuthi ulimale kabi uMkhize, ibe seyimthwala imphuthumisa emtholampilo okuyilapho ukufa okufike kwamenela khona. Nemoto eyisebenzisile ukuphuthumisa umufi esibhedlela, umthombo uthe iyebile kanti ngeshwa maphakathi nendlela - sekubuywa esibhedlela - izophelelwa uphethroli yase iyishiya kanjalo.''Imletha emtholampilo, iqambe amanga yathi ilethe umuntu engamazi, ehlangane naye endleleni enenxeba esiphongweni, yase ibona kumqoka kakhulu ukuba imsize angaze ashone,'' kulandisa umthombo. Ngemuva kwesigameko, kuthiwa indodana yenduna igcwale amathafa, akwaziwa ukuthi ilibangise kuphi nendawo.Kwenzeka lesi sigameko nje, leli phephandaba lithole ngomunye umthombo ukuthi amadodana enduna abhubhisile kule ndawo, ebulala abantu bese uyise egijima eyoshweleza ngesilwane okuba yimbuzi okanye inkomo nesamba esithile semali.Kuvela ukuthi kunesinye isigameko lapho khona enye indodana yenduna esanda kudubula khona ibulale. Ngemuva kwalokho, kuthiwa induna igijime yaya kubo kamufi, yashweleza ngezimbuzi nangesamba esithile semali.Ithintwa induna, uDladla, ivumile ukuthi indodana yayo igcwele amathafa ngoba isolwa ngokuthi ibulale umuntu kade idlala ngesibhamu esigamekweni esenzeke ngeSonto.''Ngiyavuma impela kuyiqiniso ukuthi indodana yami ibulale umuntu kade idlala ngesibhamu ngeSonto. Kuyimanje angiyazi nokuthi ibaleke yashona kephi nendawo. Kodwa ngizwile ngandlebenye ukuthi ibhace eThekwini. Ngabe ngenza iphutha uma ngingavikela umuntu obulele,'' isho kanje. Ithe ike yazama ukuyishayela ucingo (indodana) kodwa yaluchizela, kwathi uma selushaywa ngunina yamphendula yase igonyuluka ngakho konke okwenzekile.Ivumile nokuthi ikhona enye indodana yayo eyayihlawulela ngokunikela ngezimbuzi ezimbili nesamba semali esiwu-R7 000.Ikuchithile ukuthi ngalezi zilwane isuke icele intethelelo, ishweleza emndenini kamufi kodwa kunalokho, ithe kusuke kungumphakathi oyinikeza ingcindezi yokuba iyoshiya okuthile lapho okusuke kone indodana yayo. Owomndeni osekuke kwabulawa umuntu emndenini wakhe ngenye yamadodana enduna, uthe wesabela impilo yalo ngokugonyuluka ngale ndaba.Ukhihle isililo wathi kwaba buhlungu ukubulawa kwelungu labo maqede kwacweba iziziba.Uvale ucingo engasathandi ukuqhubeka nokukhuluma kabanzi ngalolu daba. Iphunzile imizamo yokuxhumana nomndeni kamufi obulawe ngeSonto. Kunenombolo enikezwe intatheli kodwa ibikhala ingaphendulwa.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, ukuqinisekisile ukubulawa kowesilisa athe kwenzeke ngeSonto.Uthe amaphoyisa aseKhombe, amatasa nophenyo olunzulu mayelana nesigameko sokubulawa kowesilisa oneminyaka engu-30 ubudala."Amaphoyisa aphenya icala elithinta ukutholakala kwesidumbu sowesilisa sinamaxeba amabi emzimbeni esigamekweni esenzeke endaweni yaseThuma, eKhombe, eNkandla. Ubekade elimele kabi ekhanda,'' usho kanje.
UGCINE ehlela ngezansi uNgqongqoshe wezeZimali, uMnuz Enoch Godongwana, obephakamisa ukuba kunyuswe intela ngo-0.5%. Ihhovisi likaGodongwana liveze ukuthi ngeke isanyuka intela ngoMeyi 1.UGodongwana uzokwenza isiphakamiso sokuba intela iqhubeka nokuhlala ku-15%.Amaqembu ezepolitiki amakhulu okubalwa kuwo iDA, MK ne-EFF abengafuni nokuyizwa eyokunyuswa kwentela.Ngesikhathi kuvotelwa isigaba sokuqala sokuphasiswa kwesabelomali angu-194 amalungu ePhalamende avotela ukuba siphasiswe, kwathi angu-182 avotela ukuba sichithwe.
KUBOSHWE abasolwa abangu-17 605 ngesonto edlule, okuyisibalo esiphezulu ngesonto elilodwa kuleli, ngamacala ahlukune ngaphansi komkhankaso i #OperationShanela.Okhulumela amaphoyisa kuzwelonke, uBrigadier Athlenda Mathe, uthe amaphoyisa abophe abasolwa abangu-3 662 ngamacala okudlwengula, ukubulala nokuzama ukubulala.Abangu-215 baboshelwe ukudlwengula, kuthi u-67 wabo uboshwe KwaZulu-Natal. "Amaphoyisa avale amathaveni angekho semthethweni angu-541 ngempelasonto yePhasika. Eziwu-270 zalezi zindawo zokuphuza ezingeko emthethweni zivalwe KwaZulu-Natal," kusho uBrigadier uMathe.Uthe kuboshwe abasolwa abangu-757 ngokudayisa utshwala ngokungekho emthethweni futhi abangu-270 bashaqwe KwaZulu-Natal.Abangu-144 baboshwe eMpumalanga no-142 obanjwe eGauteng.UBrigadier Mathe uthe amaphoyisa abophe abashayeli abangu-1 166 ngokushayela bephuzile noma bedle izidakamizwa.Abangu-265 baboshwe eMpumalanga. Abasolwa abangu-393 kwabangu-1 209 abatholakale nezidakamizwa, baboshwe KwaZulu-Natal.Abangu-249 baboshelwe ukushushumbisa izidakamizwa.UBrigadier Mathe uqhube wathi amaphoyisa abophe abangu-145 ngamacala okubulala futhi abangu-30 bavalelwe eGauteng.Abangu-129 baboshelwe ukuzama ukubululala, kwathi abangu-1 574 baboshelwe ukushaya ngenhloso yokulimaza."Abasolwa abangu-110 baboshelwe ukutholakala nezibhamu ezingekho semthethweni futhi iningi lalaba basolwa liboshwe KwaZulu-Natal (35)," kusho uBrigadier Mathe.Uthe kushaqwe izibhamu ezingu-128, izinhlamvu ezingu-4 220, kwatholakala nezimoto eziduniwe nezebiwe ezingu-87.
I-EFF isola uNgqongqoshe wezeziMali, uMnuz Enoch Godongwana, ngokudukisa umphakathi ngodaba lokunyuswa kwentela.I-EFF ithe uGodongwana uyishaya phambili abuye ayishaye emuva ngesiphakamiso sokunyuswa kwentela iVAT ngo-0.5%.Ikusho lokhu ngesikhathi kulalelwe icala lapho i-EFF ne-DA befuna ukuthi kumiswe ukunyuswa kwe-VAT okufanele kuqale ngoMeyi 1. Icala belilalelwe eNkantolo eNkulu yaseWestern Cape.Ummeli we-EFF, u-Advocate Tembeka Ngcukaitobi, uthe uGodongwana usho izinto ezahlukene ngokunyuswa kwentela.UNgcukaitobi uthe kwesinye isikhathi uGodongwana ukhuluma sengathi kungenzeka kubuye kuhoxiswe ukunyuswa kwentela, abuye futhi aziphikise athi ngeke sihoxe isiphakamiso. UNgcukaitobi uthe ngenxa yokudukisa kukaGodongwana iqembu elingahambisani nokunyuswa kwentela, i-ActionSA, ligcine livotela ukuphasiswa kohlaka lwesabelomali oluphakamisa ukunyuswa kwentela.Uthe lokhu i-ActionSA ikwenze ngoba nakhu inethemba lokuthi sizoshintshwa isiphakamiso sokunyuswa kwentela."Indlela enze ngayo uGodongwana ukhombise ukudukisa. Wazi kahle ukuthi angeke sisashintshwa isinqumo sokunyuswa kwentela kodwa uhamba enikeza abantu ithemba elingekho lokuthi kusangenzeka sishintshwe isinqumo sokunyuswa kwentela." UNgcukaitobi uthe okukhathaza kakhulu ukuthi ikhona enye indlela okungatholakala ngayo imali eshodayo, wathi uKhomishana weSA Revenue Services, uMnuz Edward Kieswetterjm, washo ukuthi kunemali ephakathi kukaR700 billion no-R800 billion engatholakala uma kungaqiniswa imithetho."ISars yathola ukuthi kunezinkampani eziningi ezibalekela ukukhokhela intela nokuthi kunezimpahla ezingena ngokungemthetho kuleli ezingayikhokhi intela. Lokhu kwenzeka ngenxa yokungabi khona kwezinsiza ezanele zokulandela laba ababalekela intela. ISars ikubeke kwacaca ukuthi izoqhamuka nezinhlelo zokuqinisa uhlelo lokuqoqwa kwentela. Lokhu kusho ukuthi ikhona indlela okungaqoqwa ngayo le mali eshodayo." Ummeli we-DA, u-Advocate Michael Bishop, uthe akuzange kulandelwe imigomo ngesikhathi kuthathwa isinqumo sokunyusa intela."UGodongwana akanawo amandla okunyusa intela. IPhalamende kuphela elinamandla okunyusa intela. Akukwazi ukuthi intela inganyuswa ekubeni iPhalamende lingakaqedi ukuvotela isabelomali." Ummeli kaGodongwana, u-Advocate Mahlaphe Sello, ukuchithile ukuthi uGodongwana wadukisa abantu ngokunyuswa kwentela. U-Advocate Sello uthe i-EFF iphambanisa okwashiwo uGodongwana nalokho okwashiwo ngumholi we-ActionSA ePhalamende, uMnuz Athol Trollip, owathi baseseke isiphakamiso ngoba nakhu bethenjiswe ukuthi kuzohoxiswa ukunyuswa kwentela.Uthe kwalandelwa yonke imigomo ngesikhathi kwethulwa isabelomali.Inkantolo isigodlile isinqumo.
KUNGASE kuqopheke umlando isikhundla somholi webandla lamaRoma aKhatholika, sithathwe ngumuntu omnyama wase-Afrika.Njengoba isigungu sabaholi bebandla sizokhetha umholi omusha ezinsukwini ezingaphansi kweziwu-20 ezizayo, sekuvele igama lomfundisi owazalelwa e-Ghana kulabo abasethubeni lokuthatha isikhundla.UCardinal Peter Turkson (76), ungomunye wabagcotshwa abasethubeni lokuthatha isikhundla esivuleke emva kokushona kukaPope Francis, oshone ngoMsombuluko. UTurkson wake wamataniswa nalesi sikhundla ngo-2013, ngaphambi kokuthi kuqokwe uFrancis. Ukuqokwa kwakhe kungasho ukuthi ungumholi wokuqala omnyama webandla.UFrancis naye waba ngomholi wokuqala webandla oqhamuka eLatin America. Abantu basho amashushu ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ngokuqokwa komholi wokuqala webandla omnyama.Omunye umfundisi wase-Afrika okuvela igama lakhe uCardinal Robert Sarah (79), waseGuinea. USarah uyingxenye yabefundisi okuzokhethwa kubona kodwa amathuba okukhethwa mancane njengoba iminyaka isihambile kuye. Kuphinde kuvele negama lomfundisi wasezwenikazi i-Asia, uCardinal Luis Antonio Tagle. Angaba owokuqala wase-Asia ukuphatha lesi sikhundla uma kungagcina kuqokwe yena.Bebonke bangu-15 abantu okuzokhethwa kubona.Umfundisi waseNingizimu Afrika ozokuba yingxenye yabazokhetha umholi omusha nguCardinal Stephen Brislin. UBrisil bekufanele afulathele elakuleli izolo, ukuze ezokuba yingxenye yemihlangano yokulungiselela umngcwabo kaFrancis, neyokuqoka umholi omusha. Ekhuluma nabeNewzroom Afrika, uBrislin uthe kuyamjabulisa ukuba ingxenye yabefundisi abazoqoka umholi webandla omusha."Kuyithuba eliyingqayizivele ukuba yingxenye yabantu abazokhetha umholi webandla omusha. Ngikhulekela ukuba iNkosi isiphe ubuhlakani ngalesi sikhathi."Khonamanjalo: Ikomkhulu lebandla seliveze ukuthi umngcwabo kaFrancis uzoba ngoMgqibelo, eSt. Peter’s Square, e-Italy. Lokhu kuhambiselana nezifiso zakhe uFrancis.Umzimba wakhe uzohlala izinsuku ezintathu eSt. Peter’s Basilica, lapho abantu bezonikezwa ithuba lokuthi bawubone ngaphambi komngcwabo.Ibandla lizozila izinsuku eziyisishiyagalolunye.
KULINDELEKE ukuba ashaye ungqimphothwe, avume icala omunye wabalisa ababoshelwe icala lokusoconga owayengunobhala jikelele we-ANC Youth League, uMnuz Sindiso Magaqa.Umsolwa wesine, uMnuz Sibusiso Ncengwa, ufuna ukuvuma icala lokusoconga uMagaqa, njengoba kanye nabanye abasolwa babekade beliphikile icala ngesikhathi liqala ukuqulwa eNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu.Kepha manje uNcengwa usefuna ukulivula icala futhi ufuna ukuthi elakhe icala lithethwe lodwa.UNcengwa kanye nabanye abasolwa ababili, uMnuz Sibonelo Myeza noMbulelo Mpofana, bavele kafushane enkantolo, ngoLwesine.Icala labo lihlehliselwe uMeyi 22. Ummeli kaNcengwa, u-Advocate Andrew Matlamela, utshele inkantolo ukuthi ngalolu suku bazofaka isicelo sokuthi icala likaNcengwa lithethwe eceleni.Umbuso uyasiphikisa isicelo sokuhlukaniswa kwecala.IJaji elibambile kuleli cala, uNkosinathi Chili, linqume ukuba icala lihlehlele uMeyi 22."Abasolwa bayaxwayiswa ukuba bafike enkantolo ngalolu suku lapho kuzolalelwa khona isicelo sikaNcengwa."UNcengwa uvele udonsa isigwebo seminyaka engu-95 ejele, njengoba walahlwa yicala lokubamba inkunzi.UNcengwa usanda kulaxaza uqweqwe lommeli, u-Advocate Shane Matthews.UMagaqa wasocongwa ngo-2017, wadutshulwa ebuya emhlanganweni wamakhansela kuMasipala waseMzimkhulu. UMagaqa kukholakala ukuthi wabulawelwa ukulwa nenkohlakalo. Ukuqulwa kwecala sekubambezeleke izikhawu eziningi.Omunye ummangalelwa kuleli cala, uMnuz Mlungisi Ncalane, kwatholakala ukuthi akakulungele ukubhekana necala emva kokuhlolwa ingqondo.
UPHITHENE amakhanda umndeni waKwaDenge, KwaNongoma, kutholwa isidumbu selungu lawo lizolo ekuseni, sinqunywe nentamo, silaxazwe ngakubo. Kuthiwa isidumbu sikaMnuz Lulama Ntshangase (27), obenza iziqu zePostgraduate Certificate in Education (PGCE) e-Unisa, sitholwe abebezidlulela.Ngokusho kukadadewabo, uNkk Nontobeko Khumalo, umufi utholwe ngabantu bendawo, isidumbu siphoswe emseleni osendleleni eya kubo. "La etholwe khona kuseduze kakhulu nasekhaya,” kusho uNkk Khumalo.Uthe basola ukuthi ubulawe ngabantu abamaziyo njengoba ijakhethi namabhuzu abewagqokile, abephoswe ngaphakathi kubo. Uthe ngokusho kukanina, obehlala nomufi, umgcine ngabo-7 ebusuku ngeSonto, waveza ukuthi umufi ubenendlu yakhe engaphandle."Uma sibuka, uphume engumuntu obuyayo ngoba i-laptop yakhe itholwe ivuliwe, kade idlala umculo. Amaselula akhe wonke abekhona endlini yakhe,” kuchaza uNkk Khumalo. Uthe isigameko sibehle ngaphezulu njengoba umufi bengamazeli zitha endaweni. "Kukhona amachaphazelo egazi abechaphake kusuka endaweni ethile, amaphoyisa asaphenya ke ngalokhu. Sisalinde asitshele ukuthi atholani,” kulandisa uNkk Khumalo.Uthe sibashaqile isigameko, sabashiya nemibuzo eminingi. Ikhansela le ndawo, uMnuz Phiwa Mpanza, lithe umphakathi uveze ukuthi umufi ubekade ehleli nabangani namantombazane kujatshulwa komunye umuzi oseduzane."Akucaci ke ukuthi usuke nini kuwona njengoba esetholwa ebulewe nje,” kusho uMpanza.UMpanza uthe ngesikhathi Isolezwe limthinta, umphakathi ububuthene kuwo lo muzi, ulinde ukuzwa ukuthi amaphoyisa aphuma naluphi ulwazi.Uthe umphakathi usuqala ukungahlaliseki kahle futhi usuyahluthuka ngezigameko zokubulawa kwabantu ngesihluku esicishe sifane."Cishe yisigameko sesine lesi kubulawa abantu ngesihluku esinyantisa igazi. Kuke kwabulawa imantshi nje, ngoDisemba kubulawe owesifazane oqalwe ngokudlwengulwa,” kusho uMpanza.Uthe ngaphambi kwalokho, kukhona nowesilisa owayehlala yedwa, owahlaselwa kwakhe, wabulawa ngokunqunywa."Okubi ukuthi zilokhu zenzeka lezi zigameko kodwa abasolwa abatholwa,” usho kanje. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa aKwaNongoma aphenya icala lokubulala kulandela isigameko sokubulawa kowesilisa, KwaDenge, KwaNongoma, izolo. "Umufi utholwe elele exhaphozini le gazi, enqunywe intamo. Utholwe njengoseshonile endaweni yesigameko,” kusho uNetshiunda. Uthe umufi ubegcine ukubonwa ephila ngeSonto, wathi imbangela yokubulawa ayikaziwa, abasolwa basafunwa.
ABESEKA uMntwana uSimakade Jackson kaZwelithini embangweni wesihlalo sobukhosi bukaZulu, bavuma ubunzima bezindleko zecala.Bathe ubunzima bezindleko zecala yibona obenze ukuthi bacele abantu ukuba babasize.Icala elithinta umbango wesihlalo sobukhosi bukaZulu lizongena eNkantolo okuDluliswa kuyo amaCala aDlulisiwe, ngasekupheleni kwenyanga ezayo.Leli cala laqala ukuqulwa eNkantolo eNkulu ePitoli, lapho inkantolo yachitha isinqumo sikaMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, sokuvuma ukuqokwa kweSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini.Ngempelasonto abeseka uMntwana uSimakade bakhiphe imininingwane yasebhange lapho benxusa abantu ukuthi babaxhase ngezindleko zecala.Okhulumela abeseka uMntwana uSimakade, uMntwana uNdabenhle Zulu, uthe ukulwela isihlalo sobukhosi bukaZulu ezinkantolo, kudinga izigidi zamaRandi.Uthe okwenza ukuthi kuzwele kakhulu kubona wukuthi uhulumeni uxhasa uhlangothi olulodwa."Kunzima kakhulu. Sisesimeni lapho kubanga abantu ababili baseNdlunkulu, kodwa uhulumeni uqoke ukuxhasa uhlangothi olulodwa. UMnuz Francois Rodgers, (uMphathiswa wezeziMali KwaZulu-Natal), ngesikhathi ekhuluma waveza ukuthi bazokhipha u-R10 million wokuxhasa (iSilo) ngezindleko zecala. Thina asizange sinikwe lutho."Uthe zikhula nsuku zonke izindleko zecala."Yilesi sizathu esenze ukuthi siphumele ngaphandle, sicele abantu ukuthi baphonse. Thina lapha enkantolo sinabameli ababili, u-Senior Advocate ne-Junior Advocate, Engingakusho wukuthi le mali ifika ezigidini zamaRandi. Lapha emhlabeni kunzima ukunqoba icala uma ungenayo imali. Icala lingakudla impela ngenxa yokuthi awunayo imali."Uthe abantu sebeqalile ukulalela ikhwelo lokuba baxhase."Nakuba isimemezelo siphume ngempelasonto ematasa, abantu bakwazile ukuxhasa . Bakhona abangithumelele ubufakazi bokuthi sebephonsile. Njengoba amaholidi asedlulile, nginethemba lokuthi sizonyuka isibalo sabantu abaphonsayo."Uthe imali ifakwa ngqo kubameli boMntwana uSimakade, abakwaHammann Moosa Incoporated."Kubalulekile ukuthi wonke umuntu afake isandla ngoba lolu wudaba olubalulekile oluthinta isihlalo. Isihlalo sobukhosi esikaZulu, iNdlunkulu ingababheki besihlalo."

Lokhu kwenzeka emva kokushona kukammeli kaSibiya, u-Adv Thulani Mngomezulu ngoDisemba nyakenye, emva kokuhlaselwa wukugula isikhashana. UMnisi wabe esecela ukuthi anikwe isikhathi sokuthi abuyekeze lonke irekhodi, ukuze ezokulungela ngokugcwele ukuhloma imibuzo umphenyi, uBrigadier Bongani Gininda, maqondana noSibiya.Kwakumele liqhubeke ngesonto eledlule, kodwa u-Adv Mnisi wacela ukwelulelwa isikhathi njengoba efike wathi namanje akakaqedi ukufunda irekhodi."Bekufanele ngiqhubeke nokuphosa ngemibuzo ufakazi, njengokuvumelana kwethu ngoFebhuwari. Ngenze konke okusemandleni, nakuba kunjalo, angiqedanga ukufunda wonke amakhasi erekhodi,” kusho uMnisi.Uthe okumenze wangakwazi ukuqeda, wukuthi ubethi esafunda ahlangabezane nenqwaba yobufakazi obebudinga ame, abuyele kobunye, bese eyacubungula, aphinde aqhathanise.
NGEKE kuvotwe ngezobuchwepheshe okhethweni lohulumeni basekhaya oluzoba ngonyaka ozayo.Inhlangano eyengamele ukhetho, i-Independent Electoral Commission (IEC), ithe kuzothatha isikhathi ukuba kushintshwe indlela yokuvota bese kuvotwa ngezobuchwepheshe.Lokhu ikusho ngesikhathi inesithangami nabezindaba, izolo, lapho ibichaza khona ngamalungiselelo okhetho oluzayo. I-IEC isanda kuba nengqungquthela lapho bekuxoxwa khona ngokuqhamuka nendlela yokuvota ngezobuchwepheshe.Nakuba isikhulu esiphezulu kwi-IEC, uMnuz Sy Mamabolo, sithe ingqunguthela yaba yimpumelelo, sithe ayikezukushintshwa manje indlela yokuvota."Kubalulekile ukuba ngikuveze ukuthi asikasithathi isinqumo ngodaba lokuvota ngezobuchwepheshe futhi asiyicabangi kwakuyicabanga eyokuthi kungase kuvotwe ngezobuchwepheshe okhethweni oluzayo." I-IEC izovula ithuba lezinyanga eziyisithupha ukuba abantu bakuleli babeke imibono yabo ngodaba lokuvota ngezobuchwepheshe."Uhlelo lokuthatha ukuphawula komphakathi luzovalwa ngoSepthemba. Emva kwalokho kuyokube sekubhekwa iziphakamiso, kulungiswe umqulu ozovotelwa ePhalamende."UMamabolo uthe balinde uNgqongqoshe wokuBusa ngokuBambisana kanye neziNdaba zoMdabu, uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa, ukuba aqoke usuku lokhetho lohulumeni basekhaya. Ukhetho oluzayo kubhekwe ukuthi lube ngasekupheleni kuka-2026 noma ekuqaleni kuka-2027.UMamabolo uthe namanje isabakhathaza eyesibalo esincane sabantu abasha ababhalisela ukuvota.UMamabolo uthe nakuba sikhula njalo isibalo sentsha eNingizimu Afrika incane kakhulu ebhalisela ukuvota. UMamabolo uveze ukuthi kunamaqembu epolitiki angu-609 kuleli, wathi amaqembu angu-53 azokhishwa ohlwini."NgoFebhuwari kulo nyaka sazisa amaqembu angu-192 ukuthi sihlela ukuwakhipha ohlwini lwamaqembu abhaliswe ngokusemthethweni. Amaqembu angu-136 enza izethulo zokuthi kungani kufanele angakhishwa ohlwini lwamaqembu abhalisiwe, kwathi amathathu azicelela wona ukukhishwa."UMamabolo uthe iSACP iyingxenye yamaqembu enze izethulo zokuthi kungani kufanele ingakhishwa ohlwini lwamaqembu abhalisiwe. UMamabolo uveze ukuthi amaqembu angu-20 ameleleke ePhalamende azohlukaniselana u-R335 million kulo nyaka."Le mali izocazwa ngokobukhulu bamaqembu ezepolitiki. Le mali izolokhu ikhishwa ngezigaba ezahlukene."UMamabolo uveze ukuthi sehlile isibalo samaqembu adalula abantu abawaxhasayo uma kuqhathaniswa nangesikhathi kubhekwe okhethweni lukazwelonke obelungonyaka odlule. UMamabolo uthe sehlile kakhulu isibalo samaqembu adalula abantu abanikela kuwo ngemali engaphezu kuka-R100 000 njengoba kusho umthetho.

KULINDELEKE ukuba kube nenqwaba yezinkonzo zokukhumbula umholi webandla lamaRoma aKhatholika, uPope Francis (88), eNingizimu Afrika njengoba ukushona kwakhe kunyakazise abaningi kule lizwe.Izolo abaholi bebandla eNingizimu Afrika, bathe basematasa nokuhlela izinkonzo zokukhumbula uFrancis abathe zizoba khona izwe lonke.Ibandla lamaRoma aKhatholika kubhekwe ukuthi lizilele uFrancis izinsuku eziyisishiyagalolunye, kanti umngcwabo kufanele ukuba ube sesikhathini esiphakathi kwezinsuku ezine neziyisithupha. Umngcwabo wakhe kulindeleke ukuthi wehluke kunojwayelekile wabaholi bebandla njengoba uFrancis ubenza izinto ngendlela ehlukile kulabo ababengaphambi kwakhe.UFrancis udlule emhlabeni izolo ekuseni kulandela ukuxinwa wukugula isikhathi eside.Ngokusho kwekomkhulu lamaRoma aKhatholika, iVatican, uFrancis ushonele lapho abehlala khona, eCasa Santa Marta, e-Italy. Ushona nje ngeSonto, ubonakale eSaint Peter's Basilica, lapho efisele khona izinkulungwane zamakholwa okuhle kodwa njengoba bekuwusuku lokuvuka kukaJesu.Ubesanda kukhishwa esibhedlela lapho ebese ehlale khona isikhathi eside ngenxa yenkinga yokuphefumula.Abagcotshwa baseNingizimu Afrika bathe uFrancis bese eyibona indlela yakhe. UNobhala Jikelele wabaBhishobhi bamaRoma aKhatholika e-Afrika eseNingizimu, uFather Hugh O'Connor, uthe ngesikhathi uFrancis ephuma esibhedlela ukhombisile ukuthi useyahamba."Uyisibonelo esihle. Uyibonile indlela yakhe ukuthi isiphelile, wabe eseqala ezilungiselela. Uphume esibhedlela waya kokwenza lokho obekumsalele emhlabeni."Ozongena esikhundleni kubhekwe ukuthi aqokwe esikhathini esiphakathi kwezinsuku ezingu-15 no-20. Abagcotshwa yibona abazovotela ozongena esikhundleni, kanti iNingizimu Afrika izomelwa umholi webandla eGoli, uCardinal Stephen Brislin.Namaqembu ezepolitiki adlulise amazwi enduduzo ebandleni lamaRoma aKhatholika.UMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, uthe uFrancis ubelwela abahlwempu. "Njengomholi webandla ohlonishwa umhlaba wonke, uFrancis ubelwela ukuba kube nokulingana emhlabeni nokunakekelwa kwabantu abebencishwe amathuba phambilini." Okhulumela i-ANC, uNkk Mahlengi Bhengu, uthe uFrancis ubengahambisani nezimpi, ububha nokungalingani.Umholi we-DA, uMnuz John Steenhuisen, uthe uFrancis uyohlezi ekhunjulwa ngokunakekela abahlwempu nangokuba umholi webandla ohambisana nezikhathi esiphila ngaphansi kwazo. Okhulumela iMK, uMnuz Nhlamulo Ndhlela, uthe uFrancis ubehlezi eshumayela izwi lokuthula nokubuyisana, wathi ubengasabi ukukhuluma iqiniso.Okhulumela i-EFF, uMnuz Sinawo Tambo, uthe ngeke bawakhohlwe amagalelo kaFrancis ezwenikazi i-Afrika njengoba ahambela izingxenye zezwekazi ezikhungethwe yizimpi nobubha.
'ISIKHATHI esiphila kusona sidinga ukuthi abantu bakhuthalele ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe besimanje ngendlela efanele ukusiza ukuhambisana nesikhathi, nokungasaleli ngaphandle emathubeni amahle obuchwepheshe nezesayensi.'Usho kanje umshayeli wamabhanoyi osemncane uMnuz Siboniso Sibisi, ecebisa ontanga yakhe ukuthi bangalubukeli kude ulwazi olwehlukene olutholakala kwi-internet, athi nayo lungenye yezinto ezimsize ukumbeka ezingeni akulona manje.USiboniso (25) ubexoxa neSolezwe ngohambo lwakhe kulo msebenzi, adalule ukuthi uze ungena kulona nje wayengaqondile, njengoba ayephothule u-matric engazi lutho ngomsebenzi wamabhanoyi.Uthe wenza i-Bachelor of Sciences in Life and Earth Sciences, eNyuvesi yaKwaZulu-Natal (UKZN), ophikweni lwaseMgungundlovu ngo-2018. "Kuthe sengizophetha izifundo zami ngo-2020, ngaphoqeleka ukuma kancane kuzona ngenxa yokubhoka kwegciwane iCovid-19, okwenza sangakwazi ukuqhubeka nokufunda ngaleso sikhathi. Yilapho okwathi ngizihlalele ekhaya ngathola ngamathuba okushayela amabhanoyi, engakuthola ngenxa yokuthi njengoba ngangisekhaya ngingenzi lutho olutheni, ngangenwa wumkhuba wokuhlale ngibheka izinto ezehlukene kwi-internet,” usho kanje.Uthe lokho kwamsiza ngolwazi lohlelo lomfundaze wokwenza izifundo zamabhanoyi mahhala olwenziwa wuhlaka loMnyango wezokuThutha, iTransport Education Training Authority, olwamukela isicelo sakhe.Waqeqeshelwa lo msebenzi iminyaka emibili, eFuze Aviation Academy khona eMgungundlovu.Uthe: "Ngiyakhumbula nokuthi ngenxa yokubona amathuba ebengizowathola uma sengingene ngagamanxa kulo mkhakha, ngabonisana nabazali bami ukuthi ngishiye phansi izifundo engangizenza e-UKZN." Uthe wayenzela ukugxila kulo mkhakha ngokugcwele."Manje sengisesigabeni engizothi uma sengidlule kusona kulo nyaka, bese ngivumeleka ukushayela amabhanoyi aphumela nakwamanye amazwe imbala, njengoba ngisagxile ekuhambeleni izikhumulo zezindiza ezahlukene ukusiza ukuthola amava omsebenzi.” Ucebise abantu abasha ikakhulu abasezindaweni zasemakhaya ukuthi bangawabukeli kude amathuba emikhakha efuze lo, ngoba ingeminye yemikhakha enemali namathuba okuphila."Lo wumkhakha okusashoda kakhulu abantu abazosebenza kuwona, odinga ukuthi umuntu ofuna ukungena kuwona agxile ezifundweni zomkhakha wesayensi emabangeni aphezulu, bese futhi ekhuthalela ukuzihlupha ngolwazi lwawo ngoba lugabe nangamathuba emifundaze esiza ukucijelwa kuwona bhusende njengoba kwenzeka nakimi,” kusho uSiboniso.
UKUBA nezikole eziningi okungakhokhwa nhlobo kuzona imali yokufunda KwaZulu-Natal, kwenza uMnyango wezeMfundo esifundazweni ungakwazi ukunyusa imali oxhasa ngayo abafundi abafunda kulezi zikole.Kulesi sifundazwe abafunda ezikoleni okungakhokhwa kuzona bakhokhelwa imali encane kakhulu kunemali ekhokhelwa abanye abafundi kwezinye izifundazwe.Abafundi abafunda ezikoleni okungakhokhwa kuzona esifundazweni baxhaswa ngemali engaphansi kukaR1 000 nguhulumeni ekubeni abakwezinye izifundazwe baxhaswa ngemali ebalelwa ku-R1 700.UMnuz Nathi Ngcobo, inhloko yomnyango, uthe ezinye izifundazwe zinezikole ezibalelwa ku-65%, okungakhokhwa kuzona."EKZN izikole okungakhokhwa kuzona zibalelwa ku-85%, okwenza zibe ningi kakhulu. Yingakho uthola ukuthi sekuphele iminyaka ebalelwa ku-15, singakwazi ukunyusa imali okuxhaswa ngayo laba bafundi, uma uqhathanisa nezinye izifundazwe. Sikhokha imali engaphansi kakhulu ngenxa yokuthi ziningi kakhulu izikole ezingoQuintile 1 kuya ku-3 esifundazweni-okufundwa mahhala kuzona," kusho uNgcobo.Ukusho lokhu izolo ngesikhathi uMnyango wezeMfundo uvele ngaphambi kwekomiti lezimali esiShayamthetho eMgungundlovu.Le mali okuxhaswa ngayo abafundi kumele inikwe izikole ngaphansi kohlelo lwama-norms and standards.Bayakhala othishanhloko bezikole ezehlukene abagcina ukuthola le mali yama-norms nyakenye, okuyimanje akucaci ukuthi iyongena nini kuma-akhawunti ezikole.Othishanhloko balezi zikole bakhala ngokuthi sebejahwa ngisho osonkontileka ngenxa yokuthi umnyango awuyifakile imali, okwenza bangakhokhelwa.UNgcobo uthe bakhokhelwe abasebenzi izolo, imali yabo isinochatha ka-5% kodwa uhulumeni kazwelonke awuyifakanga imali yokunyusa amaholo."Izinkinga esihlale sikhala ngazo mihla namalanga nanyakenye sakhala ngazo. Akekho umuntu esizombeka icala ngokuthi usebenzise imali engekho." Uthe le nkinga yokungaxhaswa iyohlale inomthelela ongemuhle esabelweni sezimali somnyango.Lo mnyango ubhekene nezinkinga ezithinta ukungakwazi ukukhokhela ngesikhathi osonkontileka.

Kuthiwa umnikazi wethaveni udutshulwe wafa emi emnyango ngabo-12.15 ebusuku ngoMgqibelo.Udutshulwe waphuthunyiswa esibhedlela lapho okufike kwaqinisekiswa khona uuthi akasekho. Abanye abane abadubulekile baphuthunyiswe esibhedlela.Imbangela yalokhu kuthiwa ayikaziwa.
ISEMBHIDLANGWENI wokuhambela izikole ezahlukene ngenhloso yokulekelela abafundi abavela emindenini entulayo ngezicathulo nangemifaniswano yesikole, inhlangano yabangcwabi i-South African Funeral Practitioners Association (SAFPA).Lokhu kuqinisekiswe yiloyo ongusihlalo wale nhlangano, uMnuz Sihle Magudulela, ngesikhathi behambise izicathulo nemifaniswano yesikole kubantwana abangu-70 esikoleni samabanga aphansi iNtuzuma Primary. Uthe lokhu bakwenza ngoba bayinhlangano yabangcwabi eyihloniphayo imfundo futhi eyaziyo ukuthi kusho ukuthini ukubekwa eqhulwini kwemfundo.UMagudulela uthe ngemuva kokuba beqaphelile ukuthi uma bengcwaba baye bahlangabezane nemindeni okubonakalayo ukuthi iyantula, babe sebevumelana ngokuthi kubunjwe inhlangano eyethiwe elokuthi yiKZN Foundation, ezokuba wuphiko lenhlangano yabangcwabi kodwa ezobhekelela imindeni entulayo.Uthe okuseqhulwini kubona ukubona abafundi - ikakhulukazi abangojahidada - befunda kahle ngaphandle kokweswela umfaniswano nezicathulo."Sifuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi senza konke okusemandleni ngenhloso yokuqinisekisa ukuthi kukhona esikwenzayo mayelana nokulekelelwa kwabantwana abavela emindenini entulayo,'' usho kanje.' Ongumxhumanisi wale nhlangano nomphakathi, uMfu Philani Gama, uthe okwaholela ekutheni baqale lolu hlelo, ukuqaphela uma bezofihla ukuthi ikhona imindeni edinga ukusizakala.''Sabe sesivumelana ngokuthi senze inhlangano okuyiyona ezosetshenziselwa ukunakekela abantulayo,'' usho kanje.Uveze ukuthi abagcini nje ngokuthi banikele ngezicathulo kuphela kodwa bananohlelo olubizwa ngeRhoda lapho abakhipha khona nemifundaze kubafundi abanentshisekelo yokuqhuba izifundo zabo emanyuvesi.Uthishanhloko waseNtuzuma Primary, uNkk Lindiwe Ntuli, uthe kuyabajabulisa kakhulu ukubona kuba nezinhlangano eziphonsa itshe esivivaneni uma kukhulunywa ngokulekelwa kwabafundi abavela emindenini entulayo.Uthe lesi sikole sifundisa abafundi iningi labo elivela emindenini entulayo."Ngenxa yaleso sizathu kumqoka kakhulu ukuba sibalekelele abafundi ngezinto okubonakalayo ukuthi abakwazi ukuzithola emindenini abavela kuyona,'' usho kanje.
ZILENGELWA yizembe izimeya ezimbili zemikhandlu yaKwaZulu-Natal, ezisolwa ngokwahluleka ukwenza umsebenzi.Izimeya, ekaMasipala wasoKhahlamba, uMnuz Vikizitha Mlotshwa, nekaMasipala waseJozini, uMnuz Mfananaye Mathe, zibhekene neziphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bazo.Iziphakamiso zokungabethembi ubuholi balezi zimeya zithunyelwe emahhovisi osomlomo bale mikhandlu. Isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaMlotshwa sifakwe amakhansela e-IFP.Amakhansela asola uMlotshwa ngokwehluleka ukuhola lo mkhandlu njengoba ekhala ngokuthi umasipala ubhekene nenkinga yezimali.Inkinga yemali kulo mkhandlu ize yaphoqa ukuthi umasipala umise ezinye izinhlelo zawo. Incwadi yesiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaMlotshwa ifakwe uMnuz Bonginkosi Mchunu, wesekwa uMnuz Philani Zwane.Esiphakamisweni esibonwe yiSolezwe, uMchunu uthe bafuna ukuthi uMlotshwa aphume aphele esikhundleni."Ngokubuka indlela isimo esiyiso lapha emkhandlwini, asisabethembi ubuholi bakhe. Siphakamisa ukuthi akhishwe esikhundleni." UMasipala wasoKhahlamba uphethwe ngokubambisana yi-Apemo, ANC namanye amaqembu amancane.UMlotshwa uthe badlala ngesikhathi labo abafake isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bakhe, wathi kuzobe kungekhona okokuqala ukuba abhekane nesiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bakhe."Uma ungenamsebenzi ugcina ulibala yizinto ezingeke zikuphumelelise. Kungokwesihlanu manje befaka isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bami. Lapha emkhandlwini sinamakhansela angu-29, i-IFP inamakhansela ayisishiyagalolunye. Ukuze isiphakamiso sakho siphase udinga amakhansela angu-15. Angazi ke bona ukuthi bazowathathaphi lawa amanye amakhansela." UMlotshwa uthe isiphakamiso samakhansela e-IFP asimthusi nakancane."Umasigcozi, into nje engingayinakile. Iyiphupho nje le nto yokuthi bacabange ukuthi bazophatha umasipala ngaphambi kokhetho lohulumeni basekhaya oluzokuba ngo-2026. Bafana nabantu abaphupha emini."Isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaMathe sona sifakwe yi-ANC.I-ANC ikhale ngenkohlakalo kulo mkhandlu, ngeledlule ibinombhikisho. Kulo mbhikisho i-ANC inxuse ukuba kuphenywe ngokukhishwa kwamathenda athile emkhandlwini okukhona kuwo nawokulungiswa komgwaqo.I-IFP iwuphethe ngokuzimela uMasipala waseJozini, inethezekile njengoba inezihlalo ezingu-24 kwezingu-45 kulo mkhandlu.UMathe ukhombise ukungabagqiziqalaka abamgxekayo ngesikhathi enengxoxo ebibukhoma ekhasini lakhe elisenkundleni yezokuxhumana, iFacebook. UMathe uthe kulindelekile ukuthi kube khona abantu abangamthandi ngoba akusibona bonke abantu abavotela i-IFP ngesikhathi kunokhetho lohulumeni basekhaya.UMathe ugqugquzele labo abenza izinsolo zenkohlakalo emkhandlwini ukuba bayovula amacala emaphoyiseni.Uthe konke kuhamba kahle emkhandlwini, wathi abasebenzi bayahola njengokwejwayelekile."Ngeke sikufihle ukuthi nathi singaphansi kohlelo lokunciphisa imali esiyisebenzisayo. Le nto yenzeka kuyo yonke iminyango kahulumeni, akuyona inkinga yethu kuphela."
SIPHILA esikhathini lapho abantu bevumeleke ukwenza noma yini abafisa ukuyenza, futhi ezikhawini eziningi akubi bikho muntu obabuzayo nobabeka icala ngezinqumo ezahlukene zabasuke benquma ukukwenza noma ukukuyeka ngaleso sikhathi.Lokho kwenzeka eminxeni eyahlukene yempilo nakubantu abehlukene kubalwa nosaziwayo imbala. Okunye kokufakazela lokhu yisimemezelo esenzeke emasontweni ambalwa edlule sikasaziwayo wodumo lobungoma uTumi Motsoeneng, obaziwa ngelikaGogo Skhotheni.Le ntokazi yathusa abaningi ngenkathi imemezela ukuthi ayisesona isangoma futhi ayisophinde yenze lutho oluyihlanganisa nezinto, imikhuba nendlela yokwenza yesintu kusukela manje kuqhubekela phambili. Yathi lokho akupheleli lapho njengoba futhi isinqume ukungena igamanxe enkolweni yobuKristu, ikhonze iNkosi uJesu - isinqumo esathakaselwa futhi sanconywa ngabantu abaningi ikakhulu amakholwa enkolo yobuKristu, okwaziwayo ukuthi abaningi babo bavame ukubeka amabala ezintweni zesintu nendlela yokwenza eqhakambisa amasiko.UGogo Skhotheni akayena usaziwayo wokuqala ukunquma kanjena njengoba emva kwakhe kulandele umrepha uGenesis Gabriella Tina Manney, owaziwa ngelikaGigi Lamayne - naye osanda kubhala emakhasini akhe ezinkundla zokuxhumana ukuthi useqoke iNkosi uJesu ukuthi ibe yiNkosi noMsindisi wakhe, ngakho akasezukwenza lutho oluhlangana nesintu. UGigi Lamayne noGogo Skhotheni balandela ezinyathelweni zabanye osaziwayo nabo abake benza okufanayo okukhona kubona umlingisi wodumo lwakwiGenerations futhi ongumethuli wezinhlelo uThabiso Mokhethi nomlingisi uPalesa Madisakwane. Kuthintwa isishabasheki sezobuciko namasiko uMbuso Khoza, owaziwa ngokukhathalela izinto nezimisio zendlela yokwenza yesintu, uthe izinqumo zalabo saziwayo zikhombisa ukuthi babevele bengazi ukuthi benzani kusukela ekuqaleni ngenkathi bethabatha uhambo lobungoma. "Yingakho manje sebeshintsha. Le nto abayishoyo nabayenzayo iwukuhhema nje kimina, ngizibonela abantu abadukile, abangazazi ukuthi bami kuphi nokuthi bangobani,” kusho uMbuso.Lesi sishoshovu esinamava nasezomculweni wamahubo ne-jazz, siqhube sathi enye into edala ukuthi kube njena ezweni wukuthi abantu sebelawulwa wudumo nokufuna ukuhlale besematheni, okwenza ukuthi bagcine benza noma yini ezokwenza kukhulunywe ngabo. "Nokuthi bayazi vele ukuthi inkolo yobuKristu ikwezilandelwa kakhulu emhlabeni njengoba inabalandeli abangaphezu kuka-1 billion, ngakho bayazi ukuthi uma besho noma benza into ehambisana nayo vele bazothandwa futhi bavunwe ngalokho. Izinto ezinjena zidinga ukuhlalelwa phansi, kubhungwe ngazo ukuze singadukisani,” usho kanje.
MHLELI: Njengoba siqala impelasonto yePhasika namuhla, nokwenyuka kwesibalo sezimoto emigwaqweni sekuyabonakala. Abe-Road Traffic Management Corporation (RTMC) neziphathimandla zezithuthi zomphakathi bakhumbuza abashayeli ukuthi baqikelele ukuthi izimoto zabo nabashayeli basesimweni esifanele ukuba semgwaqweni futhi bahlonipha yonke imigomo. Abashayeli nabasebenzisa izithuthi zomphakathi bayaxwayiswa ukuthi babe nezimvume ezifanele zokuthwala abagibeli emizileni ehlukile. Bayakhuthazwa futhi ukuba basebenzise izinqola zemithwalo, bagweme ukuxuba kuze kweqe abagibeli nemithwalo. Abathwala abagibeli ngokungekho emthethweni nabo bayaxwayiswa ukuba bangasebenzisi ukwanda kwesibalo sabantu abafuna ukuhanjiswa bese belayisha abantu ngokungekho emthethweni. Abomthetho bazobe bephume ngobuningi beqaphe ukwephulwa komthetho nokuqinisekisa ukuthi imigomo yomgwaqo iyalandelwa. Iziphathimandla ngeke zithandabuze ukukubopha, imoto ziyiphonse ephawundini uma uyisebenzisa ngokuphambene nomthetho i-National Transport Act.Kusukela ngomhla ka-20 Mashi 2025 esaqala ngawo umkhankaso wezokuphepha wePhasika sesifake emaphawundini izimoto ezingu-1 155. Abanikazi balezi zimoto sebeyaphoqeleka ukuba bakhokhe imali eshisiwe ukuze zikhishwe emaphawundini, futhi nabagibeli kumosheka isikhathi sabo ngalokhu.Isibalo esikhulu sezimoto ezaboshwa saba sesifundazweni iMpumalanga lapho kwakhishwa ezingu-792 emgwaqweni. ILimpopo ilandela ngezingu-88, kwathi iWestern Cape yeza ngo-87. EGauteng singu-78 eseziboshiwe, kwaba yiNorth West ngo-39 elandelwa yiKwaZulu-Natal ngo-37 kwathi eFree State kwaboshwa ezingu 31. E-Eastern Cape kwaba ezintathu kuphela, kwangaboshwa moto eNorthern Cape.Namuhla ntambama izimoto eziningi zizobe zisemigwaqweni ezweni lonke, nasekuseni kusasa silindele isibalo sibe phezulu njengoba abantu bazobe beya ezindaweni ezahlukene ngamaholidi. NgoMsombuluko silindele isimo esifanayo abantu sebebuyela emakhaya nasemsebenzini.Ngalesi sizathu abantu bayanxuswa ukuba bahlele uhambo lwabo bahambe ngokungajahi ikakhulu emizileni efana no-N1 phakathi kweGauteng neLimpopo, u-N1 osuka eGauteng uya eFree State, u-N2 KwaZulu-Natal obheke e-Eastern Cape, kube u-N3 phakathi kweGauteng neKwaZulu-Natal. Kulindeleke isimo sokuminyana naku-N4 phakathi kweGauteng neMpumalanga, u-N4 kusuka eGauteng kubhekwe eNorth West, no-R61 eWestern Cape obheke e-Eastern Cape no-N2 phakathi kweWestern Cape ne-Eastern Cape.Izitobhu zokuphumula ziningi lapho abashayeli bengakwazi ukwelula imilenze ukuze behlise ukukhathala komzimba. Nokubheka isimo sezulu njalo kuyingxenye yokuhlela indlela yakho, ukuze ugweme ukuzithela phezu kwesimo sezulu esingalungele ukuba semgwaqweni njengemvula enkulu nokuduma okwenza kungabonakali kahle endleleni.Ukusebenza kwama-wiper kuyisibopho somthetho wezokuphepha, ungathathi indlela ende ungawahlolile. Amabhuleki kufanele abe sezingeni elihle, kanjalo namathayi namalambu. Siyanxusa ukuba abahamba ngezinyawo babambe iqhaza ekwehliseni izingozi ngokugwema ukuwela imigwaqo ephithizelayo, kodwa bavame ukuwela ezindaweni ezibekelwe ukwenza lokhu, hhayi noma kanjani.Simon ZwaneUMKHULUMELI WE-RTMC
AMAHOLIDI ayisipesheli aqhakambisa ukholo, indumiso nobunye kulindeleke ukuthi anikeze imboni yezokuvakasha KwaZulu-Natal umfutho owengeziwe ngezivakashi eziwu-400 000 phakathi kuka-Ephreli noMeyi. LUSUKUMISE inhlangano iWear Your Brand ucwaningo olushaqisayo lwesikhungo iMoses Kotane Institute oluveza ukuthi badukuza ebumnyameni kangakanani osomabhizinisi abancane mayelana namathuba abangahlomula ngawo athinta umphakathi nohulumeni.Lesi sikhungo senze ucwaningo olunzulu mayelana nokuthi kwenzeka kanjani ukuthi osomabhizinisi abancane babonakale besalela ngaphandle emisebenzini yomphakathi nohulumeni phecelezi iPrivate Public Patnerships (PPP). UDkt Simphiwe Buthelezi walesi sikhungo nobeyingxenye yalolu cwaningo uthe bathole ukuthi osomabhizinisi abaningi baKwaZulu-Natal badukuza ebumnyameni ngamathuba abangahlomula ngawo kuhulumeni nasemphakathini.Uthe lolu cwaningo belubheka ukuthi uma kunobudlelwano phakathi kukahulumeni nomphakathi kukhona yini osomabhizinisi abancane abahlomula ngakho, nokubheka ukuthi kungani besala ngaphandle?Uthe bathole ukuthi u-84% wosomabhizinisi abancane baKwaZulu Natal udukuza ebumnyameni uma kukhulunywa nge-PPP."Lesi ke yisibalo esiphezulu kakhulu futhi lokhu kuyakhathaza ngoba kuchaza ukuthi akulula ukuba osomabhizinisi abancane bahlomule entweni abangayazi ,''usho kanjena.Uthe lolu cwaningo luqinisekisile ukuthi bantula ulwazi kangakanani lokuhlomula ngemisebenzi osomabhizinisi abancane.Uthe enye ingcosana yosomabhizinisi abancane bathole ukuthi ulwazi lukhonyana kodwa alwenele ukuthi lungabasiza bahlomule ngokufanele futhi kabazi ukuthi kumele balandele miphi imigudu ukuzibeka endaweni angcono.Usihlalo wenhlangano iWear Your Brand uMnuz Selby Gumede uthe yibona abacele lesi sikhungo ukuba senze ucwaningo ngokusala ngaphandle kosomabhizinisi abancane emisebenzini yomphakathi nohulumeni.Uthe lokhu bakwenze ngemuva kokuqaphela ukuthi kukhona okungahambi kahle mayelana nendlela okwenzeka ngayo izinto.Uthe ngemuva kwalolu cwaningo bafinyelele esinqumweni sokuthi babe nesigcawu sokubhunga kabanzi ngalokhu. UMNDENI wowesilisa wasoLundi, owadutshulwa wabulawa inkosi yesizwe sakwaMlaba, uthi isigwebo enikwe sona bebengasilindele. Inkosi uBongani Mlaba ugwetshwe iminyaka engu-12 ebhadla ejele ngecala lokudubula abulale uMnuz Phakamani Dubazane ngo-2023. Isihlobo esicele ukuthi igama laso lingadalulwa sithe: "Njengomndeni siyakuqonda ukuthi umthetho usebenza ngendlela yawo, yebo sona akusiso isigwebo ebesisilindele, besilindile esikhulu kunalesi.” Uthe nakuba benganelisekile kodwa bayabonga ukuthi ekugcineni, benzekile ubulungiswa, yagwetshwa inkosi. "Siyathemba kuzothumela umyalezo oqinile kuwo wonke umphakathi ukuthi akekho ongaphezu komthetho, noma ngaba uyinkosi kodwa nawe uphethwe ngokomthetho wezwe,” kusho usihlobo. Ngosuku lwesigameko kwakunomsebenzi kwaMlaba, kubikwa ukuthi umufi nezihlobo zakhe babesalinde ukuvulelwa esangweni ngesikhathi inkosi iphuma endlini, yavulela ngenhlamvu ibhekise ngakubo. Kuleso sigameko kuthiwa kwadubuleka umufi ezindaweni ezibucayi, waphuthunyiswa esibhedlela, kodwa kwamenela.

Umufi wahlaselwa wadlwengulwa ekubo eMlaza, esigamekweni esenzeka ngoMeyi 28, ngonyaka odlule.Isidumbu sikamufi satholakala sinamanxeba futhi sinezimpawu zokuthi siqale ngokudlwengulwa. Kwavela ukuthi ngesikhathi ehlaselwa umufi wayekade eyedwa ekhaya, engekho uyise uMnuz Patrick Ngcobo.Emuva kwezinyanga ezimbalwa laba ababili bakhalelwa ngamaSongo kaSigonyela. Endlini kwebiwa umakhalekhukhwini kamufi nethelevishini nokunye okuningi.Izolo, zithe zusuka nje uMbuso wafundela laba ababili amacala ababekwe wona. Babekwe icala lokugqekeza, elokubamba inkunzi nelokubulala ngenhloso.Babuziwe bobabili ukuthi ngabe bayawaqonda yini ukuthi abucayi kangakanani lawa macala ababekwe wona uMbuso, bavuma.Inkantolo iqale yabuza uBhengu ukuthi uyawavuma noma uyawaphika yini amacala abekwe wona, wathi uyawaphika. Kube yinto efanayo nakuJali, wawaphika.Ingwiji iqale ngesikhathi abameli babamangalelwa sebefunda izitatimende ezifungelwe lapho bekumele bachaze khona ukuthi kungani bethi bayawaphika amacala.Ummangalelwa wokuqala akathandanga ukusebenzisa lelo thuba. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ummangalelwa wesibili ugeqe amagula echakida umngani wakhe.Utshele inkantolo ukuthi ummangalelwa wokuqala nguyena owabulala umufi, wathi ngosuku lwesigameko wahamba waya ngasePhilani, eMlaza, kwenye indawo edayisa izidakamizwa, ehamba nomunye ambize ngoBrian.Uveze ukuthi bahlangana nommangalelwa wesibili owamcela ukuthi makahambe naye kuyiwe kubo ngoba unezinye izidakamizwa abangaqhubeka bazisebenzise. Eqhuba uthe wathatheka, wavumela phezulu nebala bahamba.Sebefikile kubo kammngalelwa wokuqala, uthe kwadingeka ukuthi bathole ezinye izidakamizwa. Ubalule ukuthi ummangalelwa wokuqala wambuza ukuthi uyazidinga yini ezinye izidakamizwa, wavuma.Uthe wathi makahlale amlinde usaya komunye umuzi oseduzane.Ngokusho kwakhe, uthe wazumeka ngenxa yokuthi wayesedle kakhulu izidakamizwa, watshela inkantolo ukuthi umngani wakhe wabuya elambatha, engaziphethe izidakamizwa kunalokho wamtshela ukuthi lapho abeya khona ufike wabulala intombazane encane.Eqhubeka echaza uthe ummangalelwa wokuqala wamdonsa ngendlebe ukuthi uma eke wayithi vu indaba yokuthi kukhona umuntu ofile, naye uyofa."Ngawatshela amaphoyisa ukuthi angazi lutho, ngawachazela ukuthi ummangalelwa wokuqala uyena obulele umuntu," usho kanje.Emuva kokugonyuluka kwakhe, iguqile inkantolo isikhashana. Kuthe sebehla beya emgodini, ummangalelwa wesibili wabonakala ehla egijima samuntu obalekela ummangalelwa wokuqala.Sekubuywa, ijaji liphakamise ukuthi abamangalelwa bangabe besaba ndawonye futhi bangagcinwa esitokisini esisodwa futhi noma beza enkantolo bahlukaniswe."Emuva kwalokhu osekuvelile lapha enkantolo, ngiphakamisa ukuthi laba bangabe besafakwa ndawonye noma yikuphi," lisho kanje.Ngesikhathi ummangalelwa wesibili kufundwa isitatimende sakhe, ummangalelwa wokuqala ubelokhu emjeqeza kancane, kubonakala ukuthi akakholwa ukuthi umngani wakhe usemjikele esiswini njengotshwala.Ngaphakathi enkantolo bekukhona amalungu omphakathi abephume ngobuningi. Abephakamisa izingqwembe ezinobuso bukamufi, ebezibhalwe ukuthi "Sifuna ubulungiswa ngendodakazi yethu".Abaningi bebedlubhe izembatho zebandla i-United Congregational Church (UCCSA), okuyilapho umufi nomndeni wakhe abakhonza khona.Noyise kamufi ubedlubhe ezakhe izembatho ngesikhathi eqala ethula ubufakazi bakhe khona izolo.Uveze ukuthi endlini wayekade ehlala nomkakhe ongasekho emhlabeni, wagcina esehlala namadodakazi akhe amabili amancane. Icala liyaqhubeka.
UKHOMISHANA wamaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, uncome abaseshi abenze uphenyo oluholele ekugixabezweni kukaLindani Gcumisa waseMbali, eMgungundlovu, ngodilikajele abane.UGcumisa ulahlwe ngamacala okudlwengula izingane zabafana ezineminyaka engu-10, 12, 13 neno-9, emzini wakhe.UMkhwanazi ubuye wabonga iNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMgungundlovu ngokugcina ithole uLindani enala macala. "Ukudlwengula kuseyisihlava esiphathisa amaphoyisa ngekhanda KwaZulu-Natal, ngakho izigwebo ezifuze lezi zigqugquzela amaphoyisa ukuba asebenze ngokuzikhandla ukuxazulula amacala okudlwengula. Abagilwa bayakhuthazwa ukuba baphumele obala futhi bavule amacala fbazi ukuthi ubulungiswa buzokwenzeka." Ngokwesitatimende samaphoyisa uLindani ubenukubeza laba bafana emzini wakhe oselokishini laseMbali Unit 18, phakathi kukaFebhuwari noMashi nyakenye.Isigwebo sikhishwe ngo-Ephreli 11. "Ebusuku ngoFebhuwari 23, 2024, umfana oneminyaka ewu-12 wathunywa esitolo nabangani bakhe ababili. Ngesikhathi esesitolo, uGcumisa, obaziwa ngelika-Uncle Lee, wabiza umfana oneminyaka ewu-12 maqede wamyisa endlini yakhe lapho afike wamdlwengula khona. UGcumisa wabe esemupha uR5 maqede,wamyalela ukuba angalinge atshele abanye. Kwathi umgilwa esebuya, omunye wabangani wamyalela ukuba akhumule ibhulukwe ukuze amhlole izinqa. Emuva kokuqaphela ukuthi kunoketshezi, abangani bayalela umgilwa ukuba abikele unina." Siqhuba isitatimende sithe kwabe sekuvulwa icala lokudlwengula maqede uGcumisa wakhalelwa ngamasongo kaSigonyela. "Kwenziwa uphenyo olunzulu elwaveza ukuthi kwakungekhona okokuqala u-Uncle Lee edlwengula umgilwa. Abaseshi boPhiko olubhekene noDlame, ukuVikelwa kweziNgane nokuNukubeza ngokoCansi, bathole ukuthi nabangani bomgilwa, oneminyaka eyishumi nono-13 kanye nomfowabo womunye wabagilwa oneminyaka eyisishiyagalolunye, nabo badlwengulwa ngu-Uncle Lee, kwabe sekwengezwa amanye amacala," kuphetha isitatimende.
INHLANGANO ekhokha izibonelelo kuleli iSouth African Social Security Agency (SASSA), isiqinisekise ukuthi akekho umuntu ongeke asithole isibonelelo sakhe noma kuthiwa akakashintsheli ekhadini elisha lasePostbank.Le nhlangano ithe abangakawashintshi amakhadi, bangaya kunoma yiliphi ibhange bavule i-akhawunti ukuze bakwazi ukuhola.Okhulumela iSassa, uMnuz Paseka Letsatsi, uthe kunalabo abebesabalalisa imiyalezo engelona iqiniso bethi zizohoxiswa ezinye izibonelelo ngoba kudingeka imininingwane ethile."Lo myalezo awulona iqiniso, ungamanga. Phansi amaphaphu akekho ozovalekelwa yisibonelelo sakhe. Imininingwane ethinta izibonelelo ikhishwa yiSassa ezinkundleni zale nhlangano," usho kanje.Ikomiti lezeNhlalakahle ePhalamende, lithe abangakawashintshi amakhadi abo ayigolide akwaSassa, bazoqhubeka bathole izibonelelo zabo.Usihlalo wekomiti uNksz Bridget Masango, uthe ibhange loMbuso iSouth African Reserve Bank, iyalele iSassa ukuthi iqinisekise ukuthi abasenamakhadi amadala bayaqhubeke basithole isibonelelo sabo.Uthe leli bhange likubeke kwacaca ukuthi alifuni kube nokuphazamiseka ekukhokhweni kwezibonelelo."Ibhange loMbuso lithe wonke umuntu kumele asithole ngendlela isibonelelo, onekhadi elisha kanjalo nonekhadi elidala. Alifuni kube nabangeke bahole, okuwumyalelo ocace bha ovela kuleli bhange." Kuke kwaba nengebhe yokuthi abangawashintshile amakhadi bangase bangazitholi izibonelelo zabo.Lokhu kulandela ukuhamba kancane kohlelo lokushintsha amakhadi phambilini obekwenziwa ngukuthi baningi abantu abathutheleka ezitolo obekushintshwa kuzona amakhadi, bafike kugcwele.Abashintsha amakhadi bebekhala ngokuthi uhlelo lwasePostbank, belusiza abantu abambalwa ngosuku, abanye bebeze bagoduke bengasizwanga ekubeni bebesuke befike ngovivi.Ikomiti lasePhalamende lithe lizoqhubeka liqaphe ngelokhozi ukuthi akekho ongasitholi isibonelelo njengoba kunomyalelo ofuze lo ovela eBhange loMbuso.ISassa ithe abantu ababheke izinkundla zokuxhumana zale nhlangano ngemininingwane ethinta izibonelelo.Lezi zinkundla zithi:Facebook (SASSA News),X (@OfficialSASSA),TikTok (@officialsassanews)WhatsApp (SASSA_Official)YouTube (South African Social Security Agency)Instagram (sassa10_za)
BAKHIPHE isexwayiso ngemvula enamandla namuhla ezindaweni ezehlukene zesifundazwe iKwaZulu-Natal abeSouth African Weather Service (SAWS). Ngokusho kwesaziso abasifake emakhasini abo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, izoba sesigabeni sesine imvula enamandla ezindaweni ezifana noThukela, Amajuba, Harry Gwala, uMzinyathi, iLembe, King Cetshwayo kanjalo noMgungundlovu. Bathe kwezinye izingxenye zesifundazwe, kuzoba namafu, bese lithi ukufudumala, bese liba nomkhemezelo ohambisana nokuduma okungatheni. Okhulumela uMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu esifundazweni, uMnuz Senzelwe Mzila, uthe amathimba abo ezinhlekelele azoqhubeka nokunkanisa ezindaweni ezehlukene zesifundazwe. Ukhumbuze izakhamuzi ukuthi imvula enamandla ibeka engcupheni abasebenzisa imigwaqo namabhuloho angahle agcwale amanzi. Uthe nokudilika kwamakhaya nakho kugcina kuholela ekutheni abantu baphenduke ondingasithebeni. "Izakhamuzi ziyanxuswa ukuthi ziqaphele, bese ziqinisekisa ukuthi ziyazilalela izexwayiso ezinikwa zona,” kusho uMzila. Phakathi kwezexwayiso uthe, abantu abahlale emakhaya, bagweme ukuthatha izindlela ezingenasidingo. Ubuye wathi kufanele bagweme nokuwela imifula, amaxhaphozi, ikakhulukazi lapho amanzi edlula khona ngenhla kwamaqakala. "Uma imoto yakho ivimbeka emanzini, ishiye kanjalo ngokushesha, uzame ukuya endaweni ethe ukuphakama,” kusho uMzila.Isifundazwe iKwaZulu-Natal silokhu sikhahlanyezwa yizikhukhula ezigadla ziphindelela. Ngenyanga edlule, babalelwa kwabayisikhombisa abamuka namanzi ngesikhathi kugasele izikhukhula eLamontville, ngaseMlaza.Ngaphambi kwalokho, kwashona abahlanu KwaMakhutha naseMbumbulu, kugasele zona izikhukhula.

KUVELE isizathu okuyisona okusolwa ukuthi saba yimbangela yokubulawa kwephoyisa loMkhandlu weTheku, uConstable Zwelakhe Thomas Ntombela.Umufi wadutshulwa washona ngabantu abangaziwa esigamekweni esenzeka esemzini wakhe okwa-S, eMlaza, eningizimu yeTheku, ngo-2023. Waphuthunyiswa esibhedlela, iSiphingo Medical Towers, okuyilapho okwafike kwamenela khona.Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kwaboshwa inkabi uMzo Ntombela eyageqa amagula itshela inkantolo ukuthi yayithunywe ngumkamufi, owayesebenza eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMlaza, uFaith Nongcebo Ntombela. Emuva kokuba seyigwetshiwe inkabi, wabe esekhalelwa ngamasongo kaSigonyela uFaith kanye nothishanhloko wasesikoleni saKwaMaphumulo, iMpumulwane Primary, uMnuz Sithembiso Khumalo. Kwavela negama lenkabi eyesatshwayo engeyaKwaMaphumulo, uKhulani Cele, ovele usejele ukuthi naye wabamba iqhaza elikhulu ekubulaweni kukamufi.UFaith ugqigqe eNkantolo yaseMlaza neyaseThekwini kwaze kwafika isigaba lapho agonyuluka khona, evuma icala lokubandakanyeka ekubulaweni komyeni. Evuma icala enkantolo yaseScottburgh, akazange agxile kakhulu emnyombweni wokubulawa komyeni, kunalokho wathi ubehlukumezeka emshadweni.Waveza nokuthi walingwa yinkabi uCele ukuze kuhlanganiswe itulo lokubulawa kukamufi. Wagonyuluka ngokuthi lwase luvutha amalangabi uthando phakathi kwakhe nenkabi. Nokho muva nje, umthombo weSolezwe uveza ukuthi empeleni ukubulawa kukaNtombela kuyamene nomshwalense waseMetropolitan, owawusuvuthiwe owawuthathwe uFaith ngo-Okthoba 1, 2009.Isolezwe linayo ikhophi yomshwalense, lapho kuvela khona ukuthi uFaith nyanga zonke ubekhokha u-R1 300.Isihlobo esisondelene noFaith, esingeke sidalulwe yisona okuthiwa sasizohlomula kulo mshwalense. Kuvela nokuthi sasizohlomula u-100% okusho ukuthi uma kwenzeka edlula emhlabeni umufi, lesi sihlobo sasizothola yonke imali.Umthombo uveza ukuthi isihlobo sathatha umshwalense senzela ukuthi uma kubonakala sesiphila impilo entofontofo, kucatshangwe ukuthi yimali yempesheni kanti yimali yokubulawa kukaNtombela.Leli phephandaba lihabule ngomthombo walo ukuthi isihlobo kukhona okusina kusijeqeza njengoba igama laso lilokhu livela kaningi kuleli cala. Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi isihlobo besivamise ukuza eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMlaza sizokweseka uFaith, kodwa sagcina singasezi.Kwenzeka lokhu nje, eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini kuqulwa icala likathishanhloko uKhumalo, njengoba yena ala waphetha ukugonyuluka ngokubandakanyeka kuleli cala.UKhumalo ungaphandle ngebheyili.UFaith iNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini yamgixabeza ngesigwebo sikadilikajele, yamgixabeza ngeminyaka emihlanu ngecala lokuhlela ukubulala, eminye emihlanu ngecala lokweba isibhamu somyeni wakhe nonyaka owodwa ngecala lokunikezela ngolwazi olungamanga emaphoyiseni.Wakhala encenga inkantolo ethi akathandi ukugwetshwa phambi kwabantwana bakhe.Umfowabo kamufi, uMnuz Nkosinathi Ntombela, uthe sebeyazi manje ukuthi kungani kwabulawa umufi, wathi bayajabha kodwa ukuthi kwakungaze kuphume umphefumulo ngenxa yemali.

IKAPAKELE eMnyangweni weMfundo ePhakeme eyokuhoxiswa koxhaso lukahulumeni waseMelika, obelusiza kuleli. Lolu xhaso olufaka izinsiza zezempilo zokulwa neHIV, lwahoxiswa nguMengameli wakuleliya lizwe, uMnuz Donald Trump.Lokhu kwenze uNgqongqoshe eHhovisi likaMengameli, uNksz Khumbudzo Ntshavheni, nozakwabo kwezemfundo ephakeme uDkt Nobuhle Nkabane, bahlangana nabaphathi bamanyuvesi ngaphansi kwenhlangano yabo i-Universities South Africa (USAF).Isitatimende esikhishwe ngemuva kwalo mhlangano, siveze ukuthi indaba yokuhoxiswa kwalolu xhaso inomthelela nakwezemfundo. Sithe amanyuvesi athinteka ngasohlangothini oluthinta ucwaningo. Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi amanyuvesi aba matasa nocwaningo okuze kushintshane nabanye osolwazi abasuka kwamanye amanyuvesi, bezothekela ulwazi kwamanye."Indaba yentela efakwa wuhulumeni waseMelika uma kuhanjiswa izimpahla kuleliya lizwe, nayo inomthelela. Kubhungwe nangendaba yesabelomali nemali ezotholwa yilo mkhakha kulo nyaka wezimali."Sithe indaba yesabelomali ichazwe yiPhini likaNgqongqoshe wezeziMali, uDkt David Masondo.Kuphinde kwabhungwa ngokuthi abamanyuvesi kumele bakhe ubudlelwano nozakwabo bakwamanye amazwe.Abamanyuvesi bahlale bekhala ngezinkinga ezibhekene nesikhwama esixhasa ngemali yokufunda, iNational Students' Financial Aid Scheme.Indaba yalesi sikhwama ihlale idala imibhikisho ehambisana nokushiswa kwempahla kwezinye izikhungo.UDkt Nkabane uhambele eWalter Sisulu University, eMthatha, lapho kushone khona isitshudeni ngesikhathi kunombhikisho.Izitshudeni bezikhala ngesimo esingesihle sezindawo zokuhlala.Ngendlela isimo esibi ngayo kushiswe izimoto, kanti umsolwa kuthiwa ngesinye sezisebenzi zakule nyuvesi ezihlaselwe yizitshudeni ngesikhathi sombhikisho. Kuthiwa uhoshe isibhamu wadubula ebhekise kwizitshudeni ebezibhikisha ngoLwesibili.UDkt Nkabane uthe uzozizwela izinkinga kule nyuvesi, wadlulisa namazwi enduduzo emndenini wesitshudeni esishonile.Kuke kwaba nokudideka ukuthi oshonile uyisitshudeni noma akasona isitshudeni. Kodwa uDkt Nkabane ukuqinisekisile ukuthi uyisitshudeni.
UFELE emanyaleni u-Emmanuel Mahamba waseMvuma, eZimbabwe, osebenza njenge-Personal Trainer ebanjwa nonkosikazi womuntu eRivonia, eSandton, ngoMgqibelo.Ngokusho kwabazi izinhlangothi ezithintekayo, uMahamba naye oshadelwe futhi unengane encane ubejola nonkosikazi kamsolwa wase-Uganda uNtombizodwa ongumkhaya wakhe. Kuthiwa intombi le yazama ukuhlukana noMahamba ngemuva kokuthi umyeni wayo esezwile ngomjolo wabo.Kuqubuke ingxabano umyeni ebhadama uMahamba nonkosikazi wakhe ekhoneni lika-12th Avenue, eholele ekutheni umsolwa obehamba ngeveni iFord Ranger ensundu agandaye ishende lenkosikazi ephindelela walishiya lithule.Okhulumela amaphoyisa uColonel Dimakatso Nevhuhulwi uthe izolo kuvulwe icala lokubulala ukuze kuqhutshekwe nophenyo."Akekho oseboshiwe kanti yonke imigudu yokuthungatha umsolwa iyalandelwa," kusho uNevhuhulwi.
KUNXUSWE abasebenzisa umgwaqo ukuba bahloniphane ngesikhathi iMeya yaseMfolozi, uMnuz Xolani Bhengu, ubuholi bukamasipala, amaphoyisa omgwaqo, abophiko lwezicishamlilo nabeKZN Ezemvelo Wildlife benesivimbamgwaqo kuN2. Kulesi sivimbamgwaqo bekubhekwa ukuthi izomoto zisesimeni sokuba semgwaqweni, abashayeli banazo izincwadi zokushayela nokuthi izimoto zithelile. Bekubhekwa nokuthi akukho yini okungekho emthethweni obekuphakathi ezimotweni. Kulesi sivimbamgwaqo kukhishwe amathikithi abatholwe beshayela izimoto ezinama-disc aphelelwe yisikhathi, kwatholwa nomshayeli obelayishe inqwaba yezinhlanzi ngaphandle kwemvume. UBhengu uthe njengoba kunalesi sivimbamgwaqo, banxusa abashayeli ukuba bahloniphe imithetho yomgwaqo futhi bangaphuzi amanzi amponjwana bese beyashayela ukuze bagweme izingozi ezigcina zibizwa ngokuthi ezePhasika. "Sifisela bonke abazoya ezinkonzweni ukuthi bahambe kahle, baphephe, bakhonze kahle, babuyele emindenini yabo bephephile," kusho uBhengu. Uthe njengoba imvula ina umlibe, banxusa abashayeli ukuba bacophelele nemiphakathi ukuthi ihlale iqaphile ikakhulukazi abawela imifula nabakhe ezindaweni eziseduze nemifula. Uthe njengoba imvula ina, iphazamisa nezinye izinhlelo zentuthuko abazenzayo emphakathini kodwa bacela ukuba izakhamuzi zomkhandlu zibekezele. Uveze ukuthi ezinye izinhlelo uzozimemezela ngoLwesibili uma esethula isabelomali nezinhlelo zentuthuko edidiyelwe enkundleni yezemidlalo KwaSokhulu.
UMAKADEBOBONA emidlalweni yethelevishini, u-Eric Don Mlangeni Nawa, siqale ukwazi ngaye enguLaqhasha emdlalweni wamahlaya kwithelevishini iS'gudi S'naysi, ehlale eyofuna izikweletu kuSdumo, okuyindawo eyayilingiswa wuJoe Mafela. Wabuya esenguZakhe Mhlongo kuHlala Kwabafileyo. Nakhona wafike wayibeka induku ebandla. Ngeminyaka yo-2000 ukhuze ibuya esenguZebedee Matabane kwiSidingo, lapho elingise khona iminyaka ewu-16. Nakule ndawo ufike wakhipha amangwevu ngoba uqale eyisishoshovu samalungelo abasebenzi ngaphambi kokuba wubasi.UDon wazalelwa eBoksburg ngoJuni 7, 1959 kodwa wakhulela eVosloorus emuva kokukhishwa nguhulumeni wamaBhunu ngoshova.Ukhuliswe ngudadewabo kanina futhi owayeyiwele nonina.,Wayezalwa umhlengikazi, uLisbert Mlangeni owayesebenza eFree State.Unguzinyobulala kunina noyise owayenguthisha, kodwa abazali bakhe benezinye izingane. Waveza ukuthi uyise wakhulelisa unina maqede wakha phansi ngenxa yokuthi wayezalwa wumfundisi, ngakho wayengafuni kwaziwe ukuthi unomntwana amthole ngaphandle komshado. Waze wazi esemdala ukuthi wayezalwa ngubani ngenxa yokuthi umyeni kanina, uMhlongo walibeka ngembaba elokuthi akayifuni ingane angayizali.Noyise, uTimothy Nawa, waze wahlangana naye eseneminyaka eko-35. Wathi abazali bakhe badlula emhlabeni esekhumelane nabo umlotha ngoba wayefuna isizukulwane sakhe sazi ngemvelaphi yakhe. Ubekhala uma ecabanga ngokukhula ngaphandle kwabazali ngenxa yobunzima ahlangabezane nabo esakhula. Esikoleni wagcina kuForm 3 (Grade 10). UDon esakhula ubewumdlali obebizwa ngoSugar ngenxa yokuthi wayedlalisa okukaCedric "Sugar Ray" Xulu. Ube esengena ekulingiseni ngo-1976 emuva kokuhlonzwa kwekhono lakhe nguGibson Kente. Wagcina esesheba ukudlala ibhola nokulingisa. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi washiya ebholeni wangena ekulingiseni ngokugcwele ngo-1979.Ngo-1980 wajoyina inkampani kaGibson Kente, kusenoBrenda Fassie. Wake wacula ngokuhlanganyela noBrenda emdlalweni owawuthi Hungry Spoon.UDon wake wasebenza njengomabhalane efemini. KwiTV uqale kuDeliwe ngo-1983. KwiSidingo waxoshwa ngoba wenqaba ukwenza isikhangiso selinye ibhange kulo mdlalo.Yize ebenekhono lokulingisa nelokucula, kodwa ubelinyazwa ukungakwazi ukudansa.UDon ubuye wadlala indawo kaDavid kuBambo Lwami, wadlulela kwiStokvel, Rockville, Uzalo, The River, Abomama, The Throne, The Republic, Losing Lerato, Legacy, The Estate, Good Men, Makoti, uMbali, Shaka Ilembe neSoon Comes Night.Phezu kweminyaka ewu-45 eyibambile insimbi ishisa emkhakheni wokulingisa, kodwa uDon Mlangeni Nawa uze wahamba emhlabeni engakaze wawina indondo emqhudelwaneni omkhulukazi kuleli, iSouth African Film and Television Awards (Saftas). AmaSaftas asezingeni lamaSouth African Music Awards (Sama).Ekhuluma noDavid Mashabela, uDon wathi yize enazo ezinye izindondo zeminye imiqhudelwano kodwa kumaSaftas akatholanga neyodwa, okwamenza waba nesilonda esingapholi. "Bekuba wukuqokwa nje kuphela, cishe amahlandla awu-12 kodwa angikaze ngathola ngisho eyodwa indondo. Imiklomelo enginayo ngeyama-SABC Artes Awards, Star Tonight Awards, Simon Mabhunu Sabela Awards namaRoyal Soapie Awards. Okokugcina nje ngangiqokwe eminxeni emibili. Ngokudlala kwiLegacy ngaqokwa kwiBest Actor kwathi ngokulingisa kwi-The Estate ngaqokwa kwiBest Supporting Actor kodwa ngangathola lutho." Uthe ngokuhlonishwa, wathola iLifetime Achievement Award kumaRoyal Soapie Awards nakuma Simon Mabhunu Sabela Awards kuphela. Ubeshadelwe futhi enezingane ezimbili, umfana nentombazane, u-Lwande noLubanzi.
UNGQONGQOSHE wezeziMali, uMnuz Enoch Godongwana, uthe kusangenzeka sigcine sihoxisiwe isiphakamiso sokunyuswa kwentela.UGodongwana uthe ukuhoxiswa kwesiphakamiso sokunyuswa kwentela ngo-0.5%, kuzoncika ekutheni bayayithola yini enye indlela okungatholakala ngayo imali eshodayo esabelwenimali.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba, izolo e-Eastern Cape. IPhalamende lanikeza umnyango kaGodongwana kuze kube sekupheleni kwenyanga ukuba uthole enye indlela okungagwenywa ngayo ukunyuswa kwentela.Amaqembu ezepolitiki ayaqhubeka nokudonsisana ngodaba lokunyuswa kwentela.UGodongwana uthe abafuni kubukeke sengathi badaza inkani ngokunyusa intela. "Asifuni kubukeke sengathi asifuni nokuyizwa eyokuhoxiswa kwesiphakamiso sokunyuswa kwentela ngo-0.5%. Uma ubuka kahle lapha sethule isabelomali esingu-R2.3 trillion. Udaba lokunyuswa kwentela ngo-0.5% sikhuluma ngemali elana koR13 billion walo R2.3 trillion. Iqiniso ukuthi akufanele sibange indaba yemali engaka. Kufanele sibeke phambili izidingo zezwe. Akufanele udaba lokunyuswa kwentela bese luma endleleni yokuphasiswa kwesabelomali sikaR2.3 trillion."UGodongwana uthe bayaqhubeka nokucubungula iziphakamiso zokuba inganyuswa intela."IPhalamende lacela ukuba amaqembu ezepolitiki anikezwe izinsuku ezingu-30 ukuba aqhamuke neziphakamiso zokuthi yiziphi ezinye izindlela okungatholakala ngazo imali eshodayo. Njengamanje silinde iPhalamende ukuba lisitshele ukuthi kufanele siziphendule ndlelani lezi ziphakamiso." UGodongwana uthe nakuba kukhona iziphakamiso ezinhle abazitholile, kodwa lezi ziphakamiso aziyelaphi inkinga ababhekene nayo manje."Zinhle kakhulu ezinye iziphakamiso esizitholile kodwa inkinga wukuthi izinto abaziphakamisayo akuzona izinto ezingenzeka manje ngokushesha, kuzothatha isikhathi ukuthi zenzeke.Ihlandla lesibili lokuvotelwa kwesabelomali lingoMeyi 6, lapho kuzobe kuvotelwa ukuthi iminyango kazwelonke, eyezifundazwe kanye nomasipala bazocazelwa malini. Ihlandla lokugcina lokuvotelwa kwesabelomali lingoJuni.Ngesikhathi kunehlandla lokuqala lokuvotelwa kwesabelomali aba ngu-194 amalungu ePhalamende avotela ukuba siphasiswe, kwathi angu-182 avotela ukuba sichithwe.Kula maqembu avotela ukuba kuphasiswe isabelomali, kukhona namalungu e-ActionSA ayisithupha, leli qembu labeka umbandela wokuthi kuhoxiswe isiphakamiso sokunyuswa kwentela ngesikhathi livuma ukuvotela ukuphasiswa kwesabelomali. UGodongwana uthe akanalo itwetwe lokuthi isabelomali sizogcina singaphasanga."Ngidedele igazi. Uhlelo lokuphasiswa kwesabelomali lwenzeka ngendlela. Akukho okufihliwe, yonke into isobala."
IZINHLANGANO zomphakathi zinxuse ubuholi be-ANC ukuba busukumele inkinga yamanzi ekhungethe izingxenye eziningi zeTheku.Izinhlangano zomphakathi zithe inkinga yamanzi eThekwini isiphenduke isinengiso, zathi idinga ukuxazululwa ngokushesha. Lokhu zikusho ngesikhathi zinesidlo sasekuseni nobuholi be-ANC. Abamele izinhlangano zomphakathi bathe iya ngokukhula kunokuba ilunge inkinga yokuhlupha kwamanzi ezingxenyeni eziningi zeTheku.Bathe okukhathaza kakhulu ukuthi bathi bengenawo amanzi kodwa bebe bewabona egxaza kwezinye izindawo emapayipini avuzayo ahlala isikhathi eside engalungiswa.Abebehambele isidlo sasekuseni baxwayise ubuholi be-ANC ngokuthi le nhlangano izohlangana nezimbila zithutha okhethweni lwangonyaka ozayo, uma ingaxazululwa ngokushesha inkinga yamanzi. UNksz Thabisile Nzimande, oqhamuka kwiSanco, uthe inkinga yamanzi ibaphilisa kabuhlungu ezindaweni ezingaphansi kwe-INK (Inanda, Ntuzuma, KwaMashu)."Amanzi ayahlupha kakhulu kulezi zindawo."UNksz Nzimande ukhale ngamakhansela angabasizi ngalutho abantu ababhekene nenkinga yamanzi, wasola la makhansela ngokuhuqa ubuthongo."Kufanele sibe nendlela yokugada ukusebenza kwamakhansela. Asikwazi ukuba namakhansela ahuqa ubuthongo. Uma mina ngilokhu ngilandela ngemuva ikhansela, kuba sengathi ngiyalibangisa. Nina njengabaholi kufanele nithole indlela yokuqinisekisa ukuthi amakhansela ayawenza umsebenzi." UNksz Nzimande uthe abaholi be-ANC kufanele bayisukumele ngokushesha inkinga yamanzi uma bengafuni ukubhekana nolaka lwabantu okhethweni lwangonyaka ozayo."Uma nifuna ukunqoba lapha eThekwini, kufanele nifake abantu abazokwenza umsebenzi ngoba sonke siyabona ukuthi akuzi kahle."UMnuz Jacques Poupard wenhlangano yabaHlali baseMhlanga, uthe sebecupha isikhathi sokugeza ngoba bayazi ukuthi amanzi ayahamba njalo ngehora lesishiyagalolunye. "Sonke siyabona ukuthi izinto azihambi kahle lapha eThekwini. Inkinga enkulu ukuthi abekho abantu abathathelwa izinyathelo. Mina ngiwusomabhizinisi. Uma kukhona umsebenzi ongawenzanga umsebenzi wakhe, ngiyaye ngimthathele izinyathelo. Kungani bengathathelwa izinyathelo abantu abangawenzi umsebenzi kwamasipala?"UPoupard uphinde wakhala nangesiphakamiso sokunyuswa kwamanzi nogesi eThekwini."Uma uqhathanisa iTheku nabanye omasipala njengamanje, amanzi nogesi kumba eqolo lapha eThekwini. Siyaphikisana nokuthi kuphinde kunyuswe amanzi, ugesi, nezinye izidingo." Umgqugquzeli we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Mike Mabuyakhulu, uthe bayazi ngenkinga yamanzi eThekwini, wathi bayangenelela.UMabuyakhulu uthe ngisho uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, uyangenelela kule nkinga."Akusiyona inkinga ongayixazulula ngokushesha. Inkinga ekhona ukuthi kunciphiswe amanzi eThekwini ngenxa yokuthi abantu bakhona bawasebenzisa kakhulu. Okuzosikhipha kule nkinga ukuthi kuqedwe ukwakhiwa kwedamu eliseMkhomazi."Odabeni lwesiphakamiso sokunyuswa kukagesi namanzi, uMabuyakhulu uthe basazoqhathanisa ukuthi lezi zidingo zibiza kangakanani kwabanye omasipala.
