UKUNIKELELWA ngendathane yemiklomelo yokuhlonipha umsebenzi omuhle wokukhangisa ngamabhizinisi abo embukisweni iDurban Business Fair (DBS), kubafakele ugqozi lokuthuthuka. Osomabhizinisi abathathu abahlabane ngemiklomelo bathole intshisekelo yokuqhubekela phambili bayibambe noma ishisa emabhizinisini.Lokho kwenzeke ngenkathi kusongwa umbukiso wosomabhizinisi obusenxanxatheleni yezitolo iBridge City, KwaMashu. Bekuhlangene osomabhizinisi abangephezu kwa-150 bekhangisa ngamabhizinisi abo futhi becotshelelwa nangamasu okuchuma. Ukubakhuthaza ukuthi bangakhathali emsebenzini wabo, uMasipala weTheku ukhiphe imiklomelo yeBest Stand - enikezelwe osomabhizinisi abathathu abakhangise amabhizinisi abo ngendlela ehehayo futhi ekhombisa ukuwakhathalela ukuthi athuthuke. Lo mklomelo ubuhambisana nemiklomelo yezipho ezixhaswe yibhange iFNB, yinkampani yeziphuzo zokucima ukoma iCoca Cola nezenkampani yezokuxhumana i-iKhokha.Odle umhlanganiso kulokhu uNksz Nonhlanhla Xulu weVukari Art yaseNanda, enyakatho yeTheku, uthe kube yinto enkulu kubona ikakhulu ngoba kuzobasiza ngamathuba azochumisa amabhizinisi kusukela manje kuya phambili. "Ngijabule kakhulu kabi ngomsebenzi esiwenzelwe wuMasipala weTheku ikakhulu ngoba bekungokokuqala ngikhangisa ngebhizinisi lami kulo mbukiso wosomabhizinisi. Bengingalindele lutho olutheni - into ebibalulekile kimina wukukhangisa ngemikhiqizo engiyenzayo, bese ngihlangana nabantu abaningi nje kuphela,” kusho uNksz Xulu. Endaweni yesibili kube nguMnuz Simo Mkhathini weTofo Tissue yasePheonix, eThekwini eyenza imikhiqizo yamaphepha asendlini encane, kwase kwathi endaweni yesithathu kwaba wuNksz Olwethu Siwendu weRoyalty Holistic Healing yaseNewland West, eThekwini eyenza imikhiqizo ehlukene yokunakekela isikhumba nokunye okunjalo.
KUVUKE upelepele ogqokweni kuvuka amanye amacala okuthiwa bawenza abafowabo ababili bomsakazi woKhozi FM,Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi izelamani zakubo kalo msakazi, uMnuz Vika Biyela (okuthiwa usatshiswa okwenyoka embonini yamatekisi) nomfowabo omncane, uMnuz Bo Biyela, bakhalelwa ngamasongo kaSigonyela emasontweni edlule.Kuvuke amanye amacala ngesikhathi befaka isicelo sebheyili eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMpangeni ngoMsombuluko. Phakathi kwala macala kubalwa awezinsolo zokubulala. Icala labo libe selihlehliselwa uMeyi 5 kuyona inkantolo efanayo.Umthombo waveza ukuthi laba baboshwa besembuthanweni okuthiwa kwakungowokujabulela ukufa komunye usomatekisi waseMpangeni. Lo somatekisi kwahlaluka ukuthi wasocongelwa ukuthi lwase luseMome ukhetho lukasihlalo wamatekisi eMpangeni njengoba abaningi babefisa ukuthi kungene yena.Kwavela ukuthi oBiyela baboshelwe icala lokubulawa kukasomatekisi, uMnuz Gagasi Sipho Mashiyane (49), isidumbu sakhe okuthiwa satholakala silahlwe ehlathini lasoBuka, iLuwamba, esehlakalweni okuthiwa senzeka ngo-2022.Kusolwa ukuthi abambulala bamkhipha emotweni yakhe eyitekisi ayesanda kuyithenga. Kwavela ukuthi imoto yatholakala seyikhishwe injini eduze kwakubo kwabasolwa.Owomndeni kamufi owakhuluma neSolezwe, wacela ukuba kugodlwe igama lakhe, wathi kade azi vele ukuthi ngobani ababulala umfowabo."Ngazenzela olwami uphenyo ngathola ukuthi laba yibona ababulale umfowethu kodwa ngakhetha ukuzithulela njengoba labaya bantu bayingozi kabi,'' washo kanje. Wathi okumqeda amandla ukuthi uye azibuze aziphendule ukuthi yini le engaka eyadala ukuthi abasolwa basoconge umfowabo owayenamatekisi amabili nje kuphela ekubeni bona benenqwaba.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa aseNtambanana avula icala lokubulala kulandela isigameko sokutholwa kwesidumbu sowesilisa owadutshulwa ngoJulayi 27, 2022, kule ndawo.Phambilini Isolezwe labika kabanzi ngokokhelwa kwamatekisi kaVika. Mayelana naleso sigameko, uVika wasola abathile wathi bamdlela umona.
BAGIXABEZWE ngezigidi zamarandi zokulungisa ingqalasizinda yamanzi omasipala baKwaZulu-Natal abasebenzisa kahle imali yezinhlelo zamanzi.UMnyango wezaManzi nezeNhlanzeko wabele omasipala baKwaZulu-Natal uchatha ka-R317 million, wezibonelelo eziqondene nokulungiswa kwengqalasizinda yamanzi, iRegional Bulk Infrastructure Grant (RBIG) neWater Services Infrastructure Grant (WSIG).Omasipala abahlomulile ngochatha ngaphansi kwesibonelelo se-WSIG, uMasipala Ugu, Amajuba nowaseNewcastle, bonke abanikezwe u-R15 million. UMasipala iZululand iwona ohlomule kakhulu njengoba uthole u-R217 million ngaphansi kohlelo lwe-RBIG, waphinde wathola u-R55 million ngaphansi kohlelo lwe-WSIG.UMphathiswa wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, ukushayele ihlombe ukunikezwa kwemikhandlu uchatha.UButhelezi uthe le mikhandlu inikezwe uchatha ngenxa yokuthi iyisebenzisa kahle imali yezinhlelo zamanzi esuke iyinikeziwe.UButhelezi uthe ukunikwa kwemikhandlu uchatha kuzokwenza umehluko omkhulu."Le mali ikhombisa ngokusobala ukuthi uhulumeni uzimisele ukuhlinzeka bonke abantu ngamanzi. Lo chatha uzokwelekelela kakhulu emkhankasweni wokufakela abantu amanzi ikakhulukazi labo basezindaweni zasemakhaya." Labo masipala banikezwa le mali nje, akukapheli sikhathi esingakanani kunikezwe abanye omasipala baKwaZulu-Natal uchatha.Omasipala baKwaZulu-Natal abayisikhombisa basanda kunikezwa u-R30 million ngaphansi kwesibonelelo sengqalasizinda yomasipala, iMunicipal Infrastructure Grant.Bona banikezwa uchatha ngenxa yokuthi bayisebenzisa kahle imali yalolu hlelo ababeyinikwe ngonyaka owedlule.Omasipala abahlomula uMasipala uMgungundlovu owathola u-R10 million, iZululand owahlomula u-R6 million, owaseGreater Kokstad owathola u-R7 million, owasoLundi wona owathola u-R3 million. Omasipala abathathu, owaseMzumbe, owasoKhohlamba nowaseBuhlebezwe bathola u-R1.5 million ngamunye."Bonke omasipala kufanele babukele kule mikhandlu. Kubalulekile ukuthi bonke omasipala babeke phambili ukwakhiwa kwengqalasizinda ukuze kuzothuthuka imiphakathi."UButhelezi uthe bazoqhubeka nokuqapha ukusebenza kwemali komasipala.
UMLINGISI onguGoloza kaZwide kaLanga kuShaka Ilembe, uCalvin Ratladi, ngomunye wamaciko ahlabane kumaStandard Bank Young Artists Awards ngoLwesine. Ngokuphumelela emunxeni wemidlalo yeshashalazi, uCalvin (34), uzosebenza ngokubambisana neStandard Bank neNational Arts Festival unyaka wonke.Leli ciko elidabuka eMalahleni, eMpumalanga, lineziqu zokulingisa nezokuqondisa imidlalo elazithola eTshwane University of Technology futhi liphezu kwezeMaster's elizenza eNyuvesi yasePitoli.Lo saziwayo udle umhlanganiso namanye amaciko, okungoNyakallo Maleke (visual arts), Modise Sekgothe (poetry), Muneyi (music), Siyasanga "Siya" Charles (jazz) no-Asanda Ruda (dance). Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kukaCalvin ayiphumelelanga kwaze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela.UModise waseSoweto ucashunwe ethi kuye kuwukufezeka kwephupho leminyaka ukuhlabana ngomklomelo, wathi okunye okumjabulisayo ukuthi sekungokwesibili kuphumelela usonkondlo.UNyakallo waseMohlakeng, eNorth West, uthe ubengakulindele neze ukudla ubhedu emunxeni okuke kwakhonya khona izingwazi ezinjengoMbongeni Ngema noSibongile Khumalo.Oyisikhulu seNational Arts Festival, uMonica Newton, uthe bayabahalalisela abanqobe kulo nyaka, wathi lo mqhudelwano wezindondo usaqhubeka nokuvukuza ikhono emkhakheni sezobuciko nokubungaza amaciko ngenhloso yokufaka abaseza ngemuva ugqozi nofuqufuqu.Lo mkhosi wezobuciko uzobanjelwa eMakhanda, e-Eastern Cape, kusukela ngoJuni 26 kuya kuJulayi 6.
KUSALOKHU kuqhubeke njalo ukukhathazeka nokungahlaliseki konogada abasebenza emahhovisi oMnyango wokuThuthukisa uMphakathi, ophikweni olusedolobheni KwaDukuza, KwaZulu-Natal. Isizathu wukuthi sekuphele izinyanga ezintathu bengaholile, bathi lokhu sekuqala ukuzwela empilweni.Omunye wonogada abayisishiyagalolunye abangaholile, odonse Isolezwe Ngempelasonto ngendlebe ukuthi lingamdaluli igama lakhe, uthe sekuphele iminyaka emibili besebenza kule ndawo. Wathi inkinga yabo yokungaholi iqale ngoJanuwari ngenkathi besaholwa yiQwabe Security, okuyiyona abebenesivumelwano sokusebenzisana nokuholelana nayo."Akuholwanga ngoJanuwari nangoFebhuwari, kwangaba nancazelo ecacile - yaze yashaya yachitha leyo nkampani, ihamba ingasiholelile izinyanga ezimbili. Sifone saze sakhathala, sithi sizama ukulandelela umkhondo wokuthi kungani singaholelwanga, izingcingo zabo azisangeni selokhu bashiya emsebenzini abebewenza wokuba yi-agent,” usho kanje.Eqhuba, uthe ngenyanga edlule kungene enye inkampani iThembalamashenge Security, nayo wayisola ngokubagila ngesifanayo ngenyanga edlule, bangaholelwa, ekubeni bebelindele ukuhola ekupheleni kwenyanaga njengenjwayelo.Uthe kuthe uma bebuza ukuthi kungani bengaholanga ekupheleni kukaMashi, batshelwa ukuthi umholo wabo ovame ukuba wuR6 000 noma ngaphansana kwalokho umuntu emunye, bazowuthola ngomhla ka-15 kule nyanga."Kuyasikhathaza lokho ngoba kumanje asirentile ezindaweni abanye bethu abaqashe kuzona, kanti ngendlela okunzima ngayo sekuvele kuyezwela kwabanye bethu okumele bahlale bebeka izaba uma sekumele bakhokhe irenti njengoba sekuyinyanga yesithathu manje sigileka ngale ndlela. Asisathembi nokuthi sizohola ngawo umhla ka-15 lowo, kanti nesimo sempilo siyasinda njengoba singenamali nje,” kubalisa lo nogada okhathazekile.Kuthintwa omunye wabaholi beThembalamashenge Security, uMnuz Themba Khumalo uthe kuyamxaka ukuthi le ndaba ifike kanjani kwabezindaba ekubeni bona bengabaphathi kungakaze kufike msebenzi namunye ukuzokhononda ngokuthile kubona."Nokuthi kuyaxaka ukuthi yini ebakhulumisayo ngoba esivumelwaneni esisenze nabo, sasivele sishilo ukuthi kuzoholwa mhla ka-15, futhi sakubeka obala ukuthi njengoba kuqalwe ukusebenza ngoMashi, kuzoze kuqalwe ukuhola kule nyanga, hhayi ngenyanga edlule. Lokho okunye kwezinye izinkampani abasebenze nazo ngeke ngiphawule kukho ngoba angikwazi futhi ngangingekho kwenzeka. Kodwa nje ohlangothini lwethu asinabala thina, futhi konke sizokwenza ngendlela esasivele sivumelane ngayo ekuqaleni,” kusho uKhumalo.AbeQwabe Security abatholakalanga njengoba izingcingo esinikezwe zona bezingangeni.
UBANJWE eMidrand, eGoli, umsolwa waseMariannhill obefunelwa amacala abucayi, uMnuz Linda Hlongwa obaziwa ngelikaPutin noma uMjinja.UHlongwa ubanjwe emuva kokusebenzisana kwamaphoyisa aKwaZulu-Natal nawaseGauteng.Okhulumela amaphoyisa esifundazweni, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe umsolwa bebemfuna phansi phezulu kanti uboshwe ntambama eMidrand.Uthe ubefunelwa amacala ahlukene okubalwa kuwo nawokubulala."Ubelokhu ebalekela ingalo yomthetho kusuka ngoJulayi 2020 emuva kokuhluleka ukuvela enkantolo ngamacala athinta ukutholakala nezibhamu kanye nezinhlamvu okungekho emthethweni. Ubefunelwa namacala amabili, elokubulala intombi yakhe kanjalo nonina wentombi, isehlakalo esenzeka ngoMashi 2025."Uthe kuthiwa uMjinja ubebuye afune ngodli imali kulabo abathutha izingane zesikole kanjalo nakubanikazi beziphaza eMariannhill."Sibonga umphakathi okuyiwo osincinze indlebe eyenze ukuthi aboshwe. Sinxusa bonke abagebengwa nguMjinja ukuthi baye esiteshini samaphoyisa bayovula amacala ukuze kwenziwe ubulungiswa," usho kanje.
I-South African Weather Service isaqhubeka nokukhipha izexwayiso zesimo sezulu esingesihle semvula enamandla engadala umonakalo ezingxenyeni ezithile zeKwaZulu-Natal. Isexwayiso sesimo sezulu sesigaba 5 sikhonjwa kulezi zifunda ezilandelayo: iTheku, iLembe, uMgungundlovu, Ugu, neHarry Gwala. Isexwayiso sesimo sezulu sesigaba 4 sikhonjwa ezingxenyeni zezifunda zasoThukela, Amajuba, Harry Gwala, uMzinyathi, iLembe, King Cetshwayo, kanye noMgungundlovu. Umphathiswa wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu, uMfundisi Thulasizwe Buthelezi useqinisekise izakhamizi ukuthi amathimba abhekelele izinhlekelele azoqhubeka nokuqapha isimo sezulu. Imvula iyaqhubeka nokudala umonakalo okubalwa kuwo: Ukugcwala kwamanzi emgwaqweni nasezindaweni zokuhlala. Ukwanda kwengozi yokulimala kwamabhuloho. Ukugcwala kwamanzi emizini yabantu okuzophoqa ukuthi basuswe emakhaya. Ingozi yezimoto nokumuka kwabantu ngenxa yamanzi agelezayo. Ukuphazamiseka okuqhubekayo kwezinsiza ezibalulekile, okuhlanganisa amanzi nogesi. Izakhamizi ezisezindaweni ezithintekile zelulekwa kakhulu ukuthi zihlale ziqaphile futhi ziqhubeke nokulandela lezi zinyathelo zokuphepha ezilandelayo: Hlala endlini futhi ugweme uhambo olungenasidingo. Gwema ukuwela imifula nemifudlana egcwele. Uma imoto yakho ivaleleka emanzini ezikhukhula, yiyeke ngokushesha futhi ufune indawo ephakeme. Qinisekisa ukuthi izinto ezibalulekile ezingaphakathi kwezakhiwo ziyiswa endaweni ephephile. Ezindaweni zasemakhaya, qhubeka nokuvikela noma ukuhambisa imfuyo endaweni ephakeme. Qaphela kakhulu lapho usohambweni, futhi ugweme ukuhamba uma kungenzeka, njengoba imigwaqo ingase igcwale futhi imigodi ivalwe amanzi. Umphakathi uyanxuswa ukuthi uhlale ulalele njalo izimemezelo zesimo sezulu futhi ulandele imiyalelo ekhishwa iziphathimandla zendawo kanye nabezimo eziphuthumayo.
UYATHUTHUMELA futhi uhlalele ovalweni umndeni wakwaHlabisa, eMacambini eMandeni, ngemuva kokuzithela phezu kwebhokisi lomngcwabo ngoMsombuluko ekuseni.Owomndeni, uNksz Nokukhanya Hlabisa, utshele Isolezwe ukuthi sebethuka izanya ngoba abazi ukuthi lokhu kumayelana nani.Uthe bakholwa ukuthi lo muntu oshiye ibhokisi kukhona umyalezo oshubile abehlose ukuthi awudlulise emndenini wabo."Sikhungathekile, asazi ngempela ukuthi kwenzekani uma kunjena. Siyazibuza siyaziphendula ukuthi lokhu kusho ukuthinini ngempela? Le nto isithuse kakhulu," usho kanje.Uthe okubakhathazayo kakhulu ukuthi akekho umuntu abaxabene naye. "Uma ngingathi bakhona abantu esike saba nokuhilizisana nabo ngabe ngiqamba amanga aluhlaza. Yingakho nje sididekile ukuthi kwenzekani,'' echaza.Osekuletha kakhulu itwetwe kulo mndeni ukuthi ebhokisini bathe bafice izithombe zabantu abangu-6 ezibaziwe, ekubeni nabo bengu-6 emndenini.Uthe kubazwe abesilisa abane ekubeni bebane abantu besilisa emndenini. Uveze ukuthi kubazwe abesifazane ababili baze babashuqulisa emakhanda ekubeni bebabili futhi abantu besifazane abakhona kuleli khaya.Ubalule ukuthi abangabazi ukuthi lona umyalezo oshubile odluliswa kubona ngumuntu othile. Phakathi ebhokisini, uNksz Hlabisa uthe bekukhona negazi athe yikhona impela okubenza bangenwe ngamanzi emadolweni."Sihamba sijeqeza emuva kwalesi senzo. Sivule necala emaphoyiseni ngenxa yokusaba," usho kanje. Induna yendawo, uMnuz Bongani Msweli, ithe kuyakhathaza ukuthi kutholakale ibhokisi emagcekeni alo mndeni. Ubekhuluma neSolezwe ekhona kule ndawo.Nayo induna ikhale ngomyalezo ethe kungenzeka ukuthi udluliswa ngabathile. Igcizelele ukuthi lesi simo kasisihle futhi sishiya imibuzo eminingi engenazo izimpendulo."Asazi lokhu singumphakathi ukuthi kuphathelene nani. Siphuthumile singumphakathi ukuzobheka lo mhlola esiwuzwe ngomndeni," kusho induna.Siye koshicilela amaphoyisa aKwaZulu-Natal, engakaphenduli mayelana necala elivuliwe.
KUNUKEKA umndeni ngokusocongwa ngesihluku kwenduna yaseMbozamo, eMaphephetheni, eNanda, ngeSonto ebusuku, izibukela ibhola phakathi kweKaizer Chiefs neSundowns. Umufi, uMnuz Aaron Gwala, obeyinduna yalesi sigodi ngaphansi kobukhosi bakwaGwala, udutshulwe umuntu ongaziwa ngesikhathi enethezeke egumbini lokuphumula ebuka umdlalo. Kuvela ukuthi umkakhe obekwelinye igumbi, uzwe kuvuleka umnyango wazitshela ukuthi sekubuya izingane zabo, kanti sekungena inkabi. Kuthiwa kube sekuqhuma isibhamu kathathu, inkosikazi kamufi yathi uma iphuma izobheka, yabona umuntu ethi pheshe, yathi uma ithi nhla ibheka umyeni, yambona opha engasanyakazi.INkosi yesizwe, uMnuz Thandizwe Gwala, ithe basola ukuthi umhlola usekhaya. "Ngesikhathi ngimbeka nyakenye, baningi abasemndenini abangakuthandanga lokho. Kwasho ukuthi akukho ebabengakwenza ngoba ngase ngilikhombile igama lakhe,” kusho uGwala othe wamkhetha ngoba ewazi amagalelo akhe esizweni kusuka ngo-1990, kukhotheme inkosi ezala yena (uGwala obusa njengamanje). UGwala uthe nakuba ubazi ukuthi isimo kasimnandi ngokuqoka kwakhe umufi kodwa ubenganakile ukuthi sekungaze kufe umuntu."Ubulawelwe isihlalo sobunduna ebebengathandi ahlale kuso,” kusho uGwala othe ushayeke kakhulu ngokubulawa kukamufi, wathi okufanele kwaziwe ukuthi ngisho sebembulele, ngeke abeke umuntu othandwa yibo, uyokhetha othandwa wuye. Ubuye waveza nokuthi ukhona umsindo oke waba khona ngokufakwa kwenkwali emgwaqweni wendawo, okuvele ukuthi kukhona abathile abangahambisani ngendlela okuqhubeka ngayo."Ngeke sazi noma nakho kuyathinteka yini ngoba khona kuyinto yamanje nje,” usho kanje. Enaba, uthe bakhona abake bezwakalisa ukungayizwa kahle eyokulandwa kwenkwali esizweni sakwaKhumalo."Owanikwa ithenda lokufaka inkwali wakuveza ukuthi akanankinga nokuthi inhlabathi abeseyilethile, kukhona abashaya phansi ngonyawo bethi ayingafakwa, abayifuni. Wahamba wayolanda leyo abathi ilungile. Kufakwa yona ngikhuluma nje,” kubeka uGwala.Uthe abanye babedinwa ukuthi imishini yokusebenza ihlaliswe emzini kamufi, becabanga ukuthi kukhona imali ayihlomulayo ngalokho, ekubeni kungenjalo. "Nakuba singeke sazi kodwa angikholwa ukuthi lokhu kuhlangene nokusocongwa kwakhe,” usho kanjena.Ngakolunye uhlangothi, isihlobo esicele ukungadalulwa, siveze ukuthi bona bewumndeni bakholwa ukuthi ubulawelwe yona indaba yokufakwa kwenkwali emgwaqweni wendawo."Sisola lokhu ngoba emini ubeye komunye wemizi yalabo abakhombise ukuba nenkinga naye ngenkwali, kunomcimbi, wafike wazibonela naye ukuthi akamukelekile ngakho washeshe wabuya,” kusho isihlobo.Sithe abantu abaphumela obala ngalokhu, baze beza ekhaya lakhe umufi ngenyanga edlule, bezozwakalisa ukungenami kwabo ngendlela umufi nenkosi abenza ngayo ngethenda yomgwaqo. "Uye khona ezitshela ukuthi ukukhuluma sekwedlule kodwa uthe uma efika wabona ukuthi akukedluli, ngendlela abangamgqizanga qakala ngakhona. Akafunanga ukukhombisa ukuthi uyabona ukuthi akamukelekile, yikho evele wakhetha ukugoduka,” kusho isihlobo.Ngokwezibalo eziqoqwe wuMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu, zingaphezu kuka-50 izinduna namakhosi asebebulewe kulesi sifundazwe kusuka ngo-2019. Amaphoyisa sishicilele engakaphenduli ngokubulawa kwenduna.
SIQUBULE imibuzo isinqumo soMnyango wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi KwaZulu-Natal, sokunciphisa imali ebekelwe izinhlelo zokulwa nokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezidakamizwa.Ikomiti leziMali esiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal, lifuna ukwazi ukuthi akukho yini lapho umnyango obungaphundla khona kunokuba unciphise imali yalezi zinhlelo.Umnyango uzonciphisa ngezigidi zamaRandi imali yalezi zinhlelo kule minyaka emithathu ezayo.Lokhu kuvele ngesikhathi umnyango uvele phambi kwekomiti, ngoLwesihlanu.Kulo nyaka wezimali isabelo salezinhlelo sizonciphiswa ngo-R19 million, bese sinciphiswa ngemali engaphezu kukaR20 million kule minyaka yezimali emibili elandelayo e.Umnyango uthe le mali incishiswe ukuze kuholelwe abasebenzi, kuphinde kuqashwe abanye abasebenzi.Umnyango uthe ukunyuswa kwamaholo abasebenzi bakahulumeni ikhona okwenze ukuthi ungabi nayo imali eyanele.Umnyango ukhale ngokuthi awunayo imali eyanele yokuholela abasebenzi ngenxa yokunyuswa kwamaholo abasebenzi bakahulumeni.Ilungu lekomiti, uMnuz Lourens de Klerk, lithe likhathazekile ngokuncishiswa kwesabelo salezi zinhlelo."Ngikhathazekile ngokuthi uhlelo olubaluleke kangaka luyaphazamiseka ngenxa yokuthi umnyango awunayo imali yokunyusa imiholo yabasebenzi. Ayikho enye indlela obekungenziwa ngayo?"UDe Klerk uthe akuqali manje ukuncishiswa kwale mali."Ngeke kube lula. Inkinga selokhu yaqala ngo-2021 ngesikhathi uhulumeni kazwelonke unciphisa isabelomali esitholwa iKwaZulu-Natal."UDe Klerk uthe uhulumeni kazwelonke kufanele wandise isabelomali seminyango yezifundazwe uma kunyuselwa abasebenzi bakahulumeni imiholo."Manje umnyango ukulesi simo esibi ngenxa yesinqumo esathathwa uhulumeni kazwelonke. Le simo sizophazamisa ukuhanjiswa kwezidingo."Inhloko yomnyango, uNkk Nelisiwe Vilakazi, ithe akuzange kube lula ukuthi banciphise imali yalezi zinhlelo."Sibukile ukuthi ikuphi lapho singanciphisa khona, besibhekene nesimo esinzima. Uqinisile ukuthi lolu hlelo esinciphise kulo lubalulekile kakhulu. Lana sikhuluma ngezinhlelo zokunciphisa kanye nokubhekana nokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane."UNkk Vilakazi uthe ukunciphiswa kwale mali akusho ukuthi umnyango awuzoqhubeka nezinhlelo zokulwa nokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane."Siyakholelwa ukuthi sizogcina sikwazile ukusinqoba lesi sihlava. Indlela esifuna ukuyilwa ngayo lena ukuthi siqhamuke nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa abesifazane ukuze singeke sibe nesimo lapho siphezulu isibalo sokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane."UMphathiswa womnyango, uNksz Mbali Shinga, uthe akusilona lodwa lolu hlelo olushayekile ngenxa yokunciphiswa kwemali."Ngesikhathi sivele kwelinye ikomiti lalapha esiShayamthetho, ngiyakhumbula ukuthi kwaba khona isikhalazo ngokunciphiswa kwemali yolunye uhlelo olubalulekile."
KUBHUNTSHE ukuqala kokuqulwa kwecala lokusocongwa kwephoyisa loMkhandlu weTheku, uConstable Zwelakhe Thomas Ntombela, ngenxa yokuthi indodana yommeli wenkabi, uKhulani Cele ovele ungaphakathi ibandakanyeke engozini yemoto.Lokhu kuvele izolo enkantolo enkulu eThekwini.Umufi wadutshulwa wabulawa ngabantu abangaziwa, esigamekweni esenzeka esemzini wakhe okwa-S, eMlaza eningizimu yeTheku.Waphuthunyiswa esibhedlela eSiphingo Medical Towers okuyilapho okwafike kwamenela khona. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi kwaboshwa inkabi uMzo Ntombela, eyageqa amagula itshela inkantolo ukuthi yayithunywe ngumkamufi, owayesebenza enkantolo yeMantshi yaseMlaza, uFaith Nongcebo Ntombela. Ngemuva kokuba seyigwetshiwe inkabi yabe isikhalelwa ngamasongo kaSigonyela kwaboshwa noFaith kanye nothishanhloko wasesikoleni saKwaMaphumulo, iMpumulwane Primary, uMnuz Sithembiso Khumalo.Kwavela negama lenkabi eyesatshwayo engeyaKwaMaphumulo,uKhulani Cele, ovele usejele, ukuthi naye wabamba iqhaza elikhulu ekubulaweni kukamufi, ummeli wakhe yilo indodana yakhe okuthiwa ibandakanyeke engozini yemoto.Izolo bekulindeleke ukuthi kuqale ukuqulwa kwecala njengoba sekusele uthishanhloko uKhumalo nenkabi uCele. Enkantolo kuvele ukuthi kusazobuye kuvele ukuthi leli cala liqhubeka nini kodwa kuncike ekutheni ummeli wenkabi angakwazi nini ukuza enkantolo. Kubhuntsha nje ukuqala kokuqulwa kwalo bekugcwele enkantolo njengenjwayelo.Phambilini uFaith wagqigqa enkantolo yaseMlaza neyaseThekwini kwaze kwafika isigaba lapho agonyuluka khona evuma icala lokubandakanyeka ekubulaweni kukaNtombela.Waveza ukuthi walingwa yinkabi uCele lwagcina luvutha amalangabi uthando phakathi kwabo bobabili. Ngaleso sikhathi uthi wayezitshela ukuthi uthandana nomunye wabaholi be-ANC kanti akunjalo.Wathi batholana nenkabi ezinkundleni zokuxhumana.UFaith inkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini yamgixabeza ngesigwebo sikadilikajele,yamgixabeza ngeminyaka emihlanu ngecala lokuhlela ukubulala, neminye emihlanu ngecala lokweba isibhamu somyeni wakhe nonyaka owodwa ngecala lokunikezela ngolwazi olungamanga emaphoyiseni.Umfowabo kamufi, uMnuz Nkosinathi Ntombela uthe sebejahile ukuthi liqale ukuqulwa icala ukuze noKhumalo athole isigwebo esimfanele.
KWEMBULWA kwembeswa kumlingisi wakuleli ongumakadebona emidlalweni yethelevishini nasemafilimini, uNandi Nyembe. Lokhu kuvele ngesikhathi evakashelwe yiqembu lepolitiki, Umkhonto Wesizwe Paty. Izithombe zakhe ezisabalele ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ziveze ukuthi lo mlingisi usesesimweni esibucayi kangangoba usehlale elele embhedeni. Nayo iMK Party imfice kwakhe elele egumbini lakhe lokulala. Ifike yamembesa enye yezingubo ebimphathele zona njengesipho. Usizi lwalo mlingisi, osebuya kwiYizo Yizo nakwiSithembiso, luqale ukusabalala ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ngesikhathi ekhuluma kwenye iPodcast.UNandi uphumele obala ngokudla imbuya ngothi, waveza nokuthi imali abesanda kuyihola ewuR88 000 welaphe ngayo indodana yakhe obese kubonwa ngokusa kuyo.Selokhu kuvele lezi zindaba osaziwayo nezikhulu zikahulumeni bangena bephuma emzini kaNyembe, okubalwa umlingisi abelingisa naye kwiCala, uSanna Mchunu noNgqongqoshe wezeMidlalo,ubuCiko namaSiko, uMnuz Gayton McKenzie. Nakuba kunjalo, kunokuba isimo sibe ngcono silokhu sibhebhethekile. Ngaphandle kokuthi usehamba nge-wheelchair, uNandi wadalula ukuthi kunesifo esesimhlasele emgogodleni. Abanye ababone izithombe zakhe ezinkundleni zokuxhumana basihlabe kakhulu isenzo seMK sokumshutha ekulesi simo kwathi abanye banxusa ukuba athandazelwe ukuze alulame ngokugcwele.
SEKUQUBUKE ingebhe ngokugqekezwa kaningi kwehhovisi loMnyango wezaseKhaya emgwaqweni uMngeni, eThekwini. Akucaci kahle ukuthi isehlakalo sakamuva senzeke nini phakathi kukaLwesihlanu neSonto, kodwa sibonakale ngoMsombuluko ekuseni sekungena abasebenzi.Onikele emahhovisi eSolezwe, ezobika udaba, uMnuz Jabu Madlala waseLamontville, uthe bakhathazekile emva kokutshelwa ukuthi ingxenye yehhovisi egcina omazisi nama-passport igqekeziwe kwantshontshwa. "Ilokho sime ezintatha ngethemba lokuthi sizothola omazisi bethu. Emva kwamahora amade silindile, izisebenzi zifike ngo-8 zasitshela ukuthi ngeke sikwazi ukungena ngoba kugqekeziwe, kusalindwe amaphoyisa,” kusho uMadlala. Uveze ukuthi yena ubezolanda umazisi wakhe, athola i-email emtshela ukuthi usukulungele ukuthi awulande. Uthe lokhu abakutsheliwe kuyabakhathaza njengoba sekwanda ubugebengu ezweni."Uthola kuvulwa izikweletu ezitolo nasemabhange ngomazisi babantu. Uthi uyezwa wena mnikazi wawo wangempela, kuthiwa unesikhulu isikweletu lesi ongasazi, kanti kwathathwa umazisi wakho kwayogangwa ngawo,” kusho uMadlala.Uthe nawo ama-passport, ayinyama kuleli njengoba kwaziwa ukuthi kunenkinga yabantu bakwamanye amazwe abangena kuleli ngokungemthetho. "Akube khona okwenziwayo ngalo mhlola ngoba sitshelwe ukuthi njengoba wenzeke kulokhu, awuqali,” kusho uMadlala othe kulayini wokuyolanda omazisi bekukhona nezaguga, okubonakalayo ukuthi zinengekile ngokuvukela ubala.Uthe umbuzo abazibuza wona owokuthi ziqine ngakanani ezokuphepha uma izigilamkhuba zizozichachazela emahhovisi omnyango ophethe amaphepha abucayi kangaka."Sinenkinga enkulu yabokufika abasezweni ngokungemthetho. Kuzothathwa omazisi bethu badayiswe kwabokufika, sizozithola sesishadiswe nabakwamanye amazwe, kuningi nje abangakwenza ngomazisi bethu,” usho kanje. Isolezwe lizamile ukuthola okhulumela uMnyango wezaseKhaya KwaZulu-Natal uMnuz Cyril Mncwabe, kodwa iselula yakhe ibingangeni, ucingo lwasehhovisi lakhe belukhala lungabanjwa.Lithinte imenenja yehhovisi elithintekayo, uMnuz Mbongeni Magagula ovele waziqinisekisa lezi zindaba.Udalule ukuthi isimo ababhekene naso siyabakhathaza kakhulu njengoba ukugqekezwa kwaleli hhovisi ngeSonto ebusuku bese kuyisigameko sesithupha."Esingaphambi kwaleso senzeke emasontweni amabili edlule. Selanywa ezinye ezenzeke ngaphambi kwalokho. Lulodwa uhlangothi lwehhovisi lethu abalokhu belugqekeza, yilolu olugcina ama-passport aselungele ukulandwa,” kusho uMagagula. Uveze ukuthi athathwa kakhulu yilawo abesilisa bomdabu waseNdiya. "Asingabazi ukuthi kunethimba elenza lo mkhuba, futhi asikungabazi ukuthi basebenza baningi. Kubona sisola nokuthi kukhona nabethu, abakhona la ngaphakathi,” kusho uMagagula.Uthe bazamile ukwenyusa izinga lezokuphepha emva kokuqaphela ukuthi lezi zigameko sezithanda ukwanda kodwa bayabona ukuthi lokhu akwenzi mehluko."Sishintshe indawo lapho ebekwakhona ama-passport, sawafaka emakhabetheni aqine ngokwanele kodwa buyaqhubeka lobu bugebengu,” kusho uMagagula. Unxuse zonke izinhlaka zomphakathi ukuthi zibasize ngalo lonke uhlobo lolwazi olungaba wusizo njengoba ethi kuyacaca ukuthi kukhishwe imali eshisiwe ukuze kuqhubeke iphrojekthi yokwebiwa kwama-passport. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa aseDurban Central avule icala lokweba kulandela ukuthi ukugqekezwa kwehhovisi lo mnyango kahulumeni ngempelasonto. "Kubikwa ukuthi kukhona okwebiwe kuleli hhovisi,” kuqinisekisa uNetshiunda.
KUYALELWE izitshudeni zasemakolishi amakhono amaTVET ezifakelwe ngephutha imali obekumele iye komastende, ukuthi ziyidlulisele kubona ngokushesha ngoba uma zehluleka ukwenza lokhu, zizokhishwa la zihlala khona.Lo myalelo ukhishwe yisikhwama esixhasa ngemali yokufunda ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme iNational Students' Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS), emva kokuba ezinye izitshudeni zingenelwe yimali ethe xaxa kuma-akhawunti azo obekuhloswe ukuthi kukhokhelwe ngayo omastende.Umyalezo othunyelwele izitshudeni yiNSFAS, uveze ukuthi lezi zitshudeni zikhokhelwe u-R13 800, ngo-Ephreli 4, u-R10 800 wale mali owezindawo zokuhlala. Umyalezo uthe uhlu lwezitshudeni ezikhokhelwe le mali kungafanele seludluliselwe ezikhungweni zabo kanti azikhokhe ngokushesha le mali, zihambise nobufakazi bokuthi zikhokhile ehhovisi lezezimali ezikhungweni.Lesi sikhwama sithe uma kungukuthi ziyahluleka ukukhokha zingazibona sezilala endle noma zibanjelwe le mali emalini okumele ingene ngokuzayo.Ebuzwa ngaleli phutha izolo, ohlelweni iWeek Ahead kwiSABC, okhulumela iNSFAS uMnuz Ishmael Mnisi, uthe le mali bekumele iye komastende kodwa yagcina ingene kuma-akhawunti ezitshudeni. Uthe emaTVET izitshudeni zikhokhelwe kuma-akhawunti azo, kodwa omastende bakhokhelwa yiNSFAS ngqo."Okwenzekile ngukuthi ulwazi lokubhalisa luphuzile ukufika kwiNSFAS, safaka imali kuma-akhawunti ezitshudeni. Yingakho siziyalele ukuthi zikhokhele omastende le mali ukuze zingakhishwa la zihlala khona ngoba le enye ingxenye yemali bekumele ikhokhele izindawo zokuhlala," usho kanje.Ezinye izitshudeni ekhasini likaFacebook leNSFAS, zikhala ngokuthi azisakwazi ukubuyisela emuva imali ngoba ziyisebenzisile. Zithe akulona iphutha lazo ukuthi kuthiwe zizokhishwa la zihlala khona ngenxa yokuthi kufakwe imali kodwa iphutha eleNSFAS. Khonamanjalo: UNgqongqoshe weMfundo ePhakeme, uDkt Nobuhle Nkabane, unxuse izitshudeni ukuthi zikhethe imikhakha eshodayo kuleli.Ekhuluma emcimbini obuhlelwe ngokubambisana noMnyango wezokuVikela obucebisa abafundi ngemikhakha abangayenza, eFree State, ngoLwesihlanu, ubagqugquzele ukuthi benze kahle, baphase ama-Bachelor."Ibalelwa ku-3 million intsha engafundi nengasebenzi kuleli. Yingakho kubalulekile ukuthi ningabalwa kulesi sibalo ngomuso, kodwa nifunde niphinde nikhethe imikhakha ehlukile," usho kanje.
SITHEMBISE ukuthi sizokwenza konke okusemandleni ukuphemba ubudlelwano nezwe iMelika, isithunywa esiyisipesheli sikaMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, kuleliya lizwe uMnuz Mcebisi Jonas.URamaphosa ujube uJonas ukuthi ayommela aphinde aphembe ubudlelwano neMelika.Izolo uJonas emuva kokuqokwa, uthe: "Ngibonga uMengameli ngokungethemba ukuthi ngilungise ubudlelwano neMelika. Ngizokwenza konke okusemandleni ukulungisa lobu budlelwano." Uthe uyazi kuzoba nobunzima kulo msebenzi emuva kwezinto ezenzekile.Unxuse abantu bakuleli ukuthi babekezele bamnike isikhathi sokuthi enze umsebenzi wakhe.UJonas owayeyiphini likangqongqoshe eMnyangweni wezeziMali, uzobika ngqo kuRamaphosa. Uzosebenzisana noNgqongqoshe wezoBudlelwano namazwe oMhlaba, uMnuz Ronald Lamola kanjalo nabanye, emuva kokuxoshwa kowayeyinxusa laseMelika, uMnuz Ebrahim Rasool.Okhulumela uMengameli, uMnuz Vincent Magwenya, uthe uJonas akalona inxusa laseMelika ngakho akavali isikhala sikaRasool. Uveze ukuthi uzomela uMengameli ezintweni ezithinta iMelika. Uthe uzobhekana nezinto ezithile ezithinta uhwebo, ahole nezingxoxo nohulumeni waseMelika."Uzogqugquzela ukuthi kube nokubuyisana neMelika, ahole izingxoxo ezithinta uhwebo nezinye. Uzobeka izinto ezithinta elakuleli phambili eMelika," usho kanje.Uthe banethemba lokuthi kuzoba nokubuyisana phakathi kwelakuleli nelaseMelika."Ujutshelwa kulo msebenzi nje, isimo sishubile phakathi kweNingizimu Afrika nelaseMelika. URamaphosa ukhathazekile ngezinselelo ezikhona ezithinta ubudlelwano neMelika, yingakho kunethemba ngokujutshwa kukaJonas." UMengameli waseMelika, uMnuz Donald Trump, uhlale egxeka elakuleli ngomthetho ethinta ukubuyiswa komhlaba ngaphandle kwesinxephezelo, ethi uhlose ukudla umhlaba wabamhlophe ngaphandle kokubakhokhela.Lokhu kwenze wahoxisa uxhaso oluthinta ezempilo kuleli.UJonas wayejutshelwe ukuba ngabanye abahlwaya uxhaso kuleli ngo-2018. UMagwenya uthe uJonas unamava kwezomnotho njengoba ayeyiphini likangqongqoshe wezeziMali, kanti uyingxenye yeMTN Group.Ezinkundleni zokuxhumana bayakuncoma ukuqokwa kukaJonas ezintweni ezithinta iMelika.UJonas wabamba isikhundla sokuba yiphini likangqongqoshe emnyangweni wezeziMali kusuka ngo-2014 kuya ku-2016.Wazalelwa e-Eastern Cape, waqala ukugqama esasesiShayamthetho sakulesi sifundazwe, wajoyina iPhalamende ngo-2014. Waxoshwa ngowayengumengameli wezwe, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, ngo-2017, wase engena emabhizinisini.
UHLANGANISE abantu abahlukene umcimbi wokubungaza usuku lokuzalwa lomholi weMK, uJacob Zuma.Umcimbi wokubungaza iminyaka engu-83 kwazalwa uZuma, ubuhanjelwe abantu abahlukene okubalwa kubo abaNtwana baseNdlunkulu namakhosi.Okuqaphelekile kakhulu kulo mcimbi obungoMgqibelo, ukubonakala kwenkosikazi kaZuma yesibili, uNkk Nompumelelo MaNtuli Zuma. Bese kunesikhathi eside uMaNtuli agcina ukubonakala kusukela kwavela izinsolo zokuthi wazama ukudlisa uZuma.UMaNtuli wahlatshwa ngemibuzo ngo-2015, abaphenyi boKlebe njengoba ayesolwa ngokubopha itulo lokubulala uZuma, wayalelwa ukuba aphume aphele emzini kaZuma. Icala labuye lahoxiswa ngenxa yokushoda kobufakazi.Namanye amakhosikazi kaZuma, uNkk Sizakele MaKhumalo Zuma noNkk Bongekile MaNgema Zuma, nawo abekhona. Kubonakale noNksz Nonkanyiso Chonco, onengane noZuma.Ekhuluma kulo mcimbi, uZuma uchaze okwamenza wanquma ukulwa nohulumeni wobandlululo. Kulapho ngathatha khona isinqumo sokuthi nami ngiye kolwa nohulumeni wobandlululo. Ngazitshela ukuthi ngoba bafa ababengaphambi kwethu nami ngiyokufa uma kufanele ngife. Namanje ngisamile kulokho."UZuma uthe wayenesifiso sokubona abantu abamnyama bethuthuka emva kokuphela kohulumeni wobandlululo, wathi emva kokubona ukuthi uhulumeni we-ANC usukhohliwe abantu abamnyama, wanquma ukuqala enye inhlangano, iMK.UZuma uthe inhloso yaleli qembu ukuthuthukisa abantu abamnyama.Ibithe chithi saka imicimbi yokubungaza usuku lukaZuma ebihlelwe yiMK.Le micimbi ebingoMgqibelo yenzelwe ezindaweni ezahlukene okubalwa kuzo esifundazweni iKwaZulu-Natal, Gauteng, Mpumalanga, nezinye. UZuma akazange abonakale kule micimbi.

I-SACP ifuna kutholakale abanye ababandakanyeka ekusocongweni kowayengunobhala wale nhlangano, uMnuz Chris Hani, owasocongwa ngaphambi kokhetho lwango-1994.AmaKhomanisi athe ayengasebenzi wodwa amadoda amabili alahlwa yicala lokusoconga uHani.Lokhu akusho esitatimendeni sokukhumbula usuku okwasocongwa ngalo uHani.Izolo, bekuphela iminyaka ewu-32 kwasocongwa uHani.Amadoda amabili, Janusz Waluś noClive Derby-Lewis, alahlwa icala lokusoconga uHani. UDerby-Lewis washona ngo-2016, uWaluś yena wadedelwa ngoshwele ngonyaka odlule.Okhulumela iSACP, uDkt Alex Mashilo, uthe basamile ekutheni kukhona abanye ababesebenzisana nala madoda ekuthungeni itulo lokusoconga uHani."Zikhona izinkomba zokuthi baningi ababandakanyeka ekuhlelweni kwetulo lokubulawa kukaHani. Sifuna ukuthi bonke labo ababandakanyekayo batholakale. Sifuna ongqondongqondo abahlela itulo, ilabo abalekelela kanye nalabo ababenolwazi lwetulo."UMashilo uthe aluzange lwenziwe kahle uphenyo ngokubulawa kukaHani."Kuningi okungenziwanga kahle ngamaphoyisa ayephenya icala ngesikhathi sobandlululo. Ashaya indiva ubufakazi obuningi obubalulekile."UMashilo uthe lokhu kubenza ukuthi baphinde bahlabe ikhwelo lokuba kuqalwe phansi uphenyo ngokubulawa kukaHani.."Sekukaningi sihlaba ikhwelo lokuba kuqalwe phansi uphenyo, uhulumeni awukaze uthathe izinyathelo ezinqala. Sinxusa yonke iminyango kahulumeni ethintekayo ukuba ilusukumele lolu daba. Uphenyo olunzulu lungasinikeza izimpendulo ezigcwele. Uphenyo lungaqinisekisa ukuthi bavela obala baphinde bathathelwe izinyathelo bonke ababa nesandla ekusocongweni kukaHani."Okhulumela umndeni, uMnuz Mphatheli Hani, ugxeke uhulumeni ngokungasheshisi uphenyo.UMphatheli uthe kwabaphatha kabi ukuzwa uWaluś ekhombisa ukungazisoli ngesenzo sakhe ngesikhathi enenkulumo nesiteshi sethelevishini, ayenza emva kokudedelwa ngoshwele."Wathi angaphinda futhi amdudule uHani uma enganikwa elinye ithuba lokwenza lokho."UNgqonggoshe wezeMidlalo, uMnuz Gayton McKenzie, uthe luzokuba khona uphenyo ngokubulawa kukaHani.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma emcimbini kahulumeni wokukhumbula uHani."UWaluś angacabangi ukuthi sekuphelile. Kuzokuba nophenyo ngokufa kukaHani. Kufanele abuye azophendula. Angeke kumphathe kabi lokhu uma kuwukuthi akanacala. Thina into esiyifunayo nje iqiniso. Sifuna ukwazi ukuthi kwenzakalani. Miningi imibuzo engaphendulekile. Siyokhululeka ngaphakathi mhla sathola iqiniso."UMcKenzie ukhale ngokungahlonishwa ngokwanele kwamaqhawe alwela inkululeko."Amaqhawe afana noHani awakutholi ukuhlonishwa okufanele. Lokhu kwenziwa ukuthi abaholi abakhona bangamagwala. Ongqongqoshe nezimeya bayasaba ukuthi bazobuzwa ukuthi basebenzise malini ngesikhathi benza izinhlelo zokuhlonipha amaqhawe. Mina angisabi. Imali ngeke uyiqhathanise negazi lamaqhawe elachitheka."UMcKenzie uthe yena uzoqhubeka nokuhlonipha amaqhawe angasekho."Sizokwakha imifuziselo yamaqhawe. Sizoyakha eRobben Island. Kufanele kube yithina esiqhakambisa amaqhawe akithi. Akekho ozoqhakambisa igalelo lamaqhawe akithi uma thina sisaba."

Bayisihlanu sebebonke abasolwa abathweswe uMbuso icala lokucosocongwa kukalo nozinti owayengaconsi phansi kubalandeli bebhola likanobhutshuzwayo laseNingizimu Afrfika.UMeyiwa wadutshulwa wabulawa ngo-Okthoba 26, 2014, ekubo kwentombi yakhe uKelly Khumalo eVosloorus, eGauteng.Bonke abamangalelwa bayawaphika amacala abawabekwe uMbuso. Icala lisesigabeni sokuqulwa lapho uMbuso uqhubeka khona nokubiza ofakazi bawo okholwa wukuthi bazosiza ukugojela abamangalelwa.
UMPHATHISWA wezokuThutha nokuHlaliswa kwaBantu KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Siboniso Duma, ufuna amaphoyisa angathetheleli kubashayeli abazothokakala bephuzile njengoba kuyiwa kwiPhasika ngempelasonto.UDuma uzibophezele ekusebenzisaneni nophiko lwezokuShushiswa koMphakathi ukuze abatholakala beshayela bephuzile bagwetshwe iminyaka eyisithupha bebhadla ejele.Lokhu kuvezwe wumkhulumeli wakhe, uMnuz Ndabezinhle Sibiya, ngesikhathi ekhuluma kwiSA FM. "Uthe asikwazi ukubonisana nezidakwa. Akafuni iKwaZulu-Natal ibe nesandla ezibalweni zikazwelonke zabafela emgwaqweni,” kusho uSibiya.Uthe ngale kophiko lwezokushushisa abasebenza nalo, kukhona abazimele nobuchwepheshe obukwazi ukubona imoto engekho sesimweni sokuba semgwaqweni nokuthi umshayeli akaphuzile yini. Uqhube wathi ngempelasonto, balindele ukuthi kudlule izimoto ezilinganiselwa ku-1 500 ngehora kuma-tollgate esifundazwe. Ngenxa yokwanda komthamo kuzokwandiswa namaphoyisa azotshalwa emgwaqweni. Uveze ukuthi angu-837 akwaRoad Traffic Inspectorate azonkanisa ezindaweni ezahlukene ehlola izimoto zabavakashi namakholwa ukuthi zisesimweni yini. IPhini likaNgqongqoshe wezokuThutha, uMnuz Mkhuleko Hlengwa likhuluma ne-SABC izolo, kwethulwa umkhankaso wezokuphepha e-Eastern Cape, lithe abashayeli abangaphuzi bese bengena ezimotweni."Abashayeli abaphumule, bangahambi amabanga amade. Akungasetshenziswa amaselula uma kushayelwa. Amaphoyisa azobe enkanise emigwaqweni yakuleli njengoba sijube namaphoyisa kazwelonke ukuqapha isimo."
SIZOQALA ngoMsombuluko isigcawu esiphenya ngokushona kwezishoshovu ze-ANC, Inkosi Albert Luthuli, noMnuz Mlungisi Griffiths Mxenge.Isigcawu esiphenya ngokushona kwalaba baholi sizokuba seNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu.ULuthuli, owaba umengameli wokuqala we-ANC, wakhothama ngo-1976.Imibiko ithi washayiswa yiguzu. Isigcawu esasiphenya ngokukhothama kukaLuthuli, saveza ukuthi abukho ubufakazi obukhomba ugcobho kubasebenzi be-South African Railway noma omunye umuntu.UMxenge, owayengummeli aphinde abe yisishoshovu se-ANC, wabulawa ngo-1982.Wasocongwa eMlazi, eThekwini. Wagwazwa amanxeba awu-45,wanqunywa uqhoqhoqho.Imizamo yokuhlonza ababulali bakhe yabhuntsha nakuba kwaba nesigcawu sophenyo ngo-1982.Ababulali bakaMxenge bavela emuva kweminyaka ewu-9 eshonile ngesikhathi kugonyuluka uButana Almond Nofemela.Ngo-1997 uNofemela, uDavid Tshikalange noDirk Cotzee balahlwa yicala lokubulala uMxenge.Bobathathu banikezwa ushwele ngesikhathi kuneKhomishini yamaQiniso nokuBuyisana, i-Truth and Reconciliation Commission (TRC), besalinde ukuthi bagwetshwe yiNkantolo eNkulu eThekwini.Inhlangano yezokushushisa, iNational Prosecuting Authority (NPA), ifuna ukuthi izinqumo zasekuqaleni zichithwe.Okhulumela iNPA KwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Natasha Ramkisson-Kara, uthe inhloso yezigcawu zophenyo wukuveza ukuthi abafi bahamba kanjani emhlabeni, nokubheka ukuthi bakhona yini okufanele bashushiswe."I-NPA KwaZulu-Natal ibilokhu ixhumana nemindeni owakwaLuthuli nowakwaMxenge ukuyazisa ngokuqhubeka kwezinhlelo okuyinto eyenziwa kuwowonke amacala e-TRC. I-NPA nezinhlaka esebenza nazo, izimisele ukulungisa indaba yesihluku esenzeka kudala ukuze imindeni yabagilwa ithobeke amanxeba."Abashushisi be-TRC ophikweni lwaKwaZulu-Natal bazokwethula ubufakazi uma sekuqhubeka isigcawu sophenyo.Okhulumela i-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Fanle Sibisi, uthe ukuqala kwesigcawu kuzokwelapha imindeni."Sinethemba lokuthi iqiniso lizogcina livelile, imindeni yazi ukuthi kwenzekani ngempela. Okusijabulisayo ukuthi isigcawu sizophenya ngokushona ngendlela engaqondakali kwabaholi, kubhekwe ukuthi bakhona yini abantu okufanele bajeze."USibisi uthe bafisa ukuthi kuphinde kuphenywe nangokufa ngendlela engaqondakali kwenqwaba yezishoshovu ze-ANC, ezashona ngesikhathi sobandlululo."Baningi abaholi abashona ngendlela engaqondakali. Njenge-ANC siyafisa ukuthi yonke imindeni ithole isiphetho. I-ANC yinhlangano ekholelwayo ekusebenzeni kwezinhlaka zobulungiswa."
I-ANC KwaZulu-Natal ikuchaze njengenganekwane ukuthi owayengumengameli wayo, Inkosi Albert Luthuli, washayiswa yiguzu.I-ANC ithe isola isandla semfene ekukhothameni kukaLuthuli, owayesephenduke iqaqa kuhulumeni wobandlululo.Izolo umdidiyeli we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Jeff Radebe, wethule ubufakazi esigcawini esiphenya ngokukhothama kukaLuthuli. URadebe utshele isigcawu esihlezi eNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu ukuthi bayaphikisana nokwatholwa yisigcawu sokuqala esasiphenya ngokukhothama kukaLuthuli.Le sigcawu sango-1967 sathola ukuthi uLuthuli wakhothama emva kokushayiswa yiguzu.ULuthuli uthe isigcawu sango-1967 sasiyimizamo kahulumeni wobandlululo yokufihla imbangela yokukhothama kukaLuthuli. "Lesiya sigcawu sasingazimele. Ngenhlanhla ngawufundela umthetho. Ngenza izifundo zami oNgoye. Laphaya safundiswa ngokwahlukana kwamandla anikezwa izinhlaka zokuphatha. Satshelwa ukuthi kukhona izinhlaka zomthetho, kube khona iPhalamende kanye nohulumeni. Zonke lezi zinhlaka zinikezwe amandla ahlukene, zizimele."Uthe:"Kulesi sigcawu sibona incwadi ebhalwe yimantshi eyayilalele isigcawu, ebhekiswe esikhulwini sikahulumeni lapho bekhuluma khona ngecala. Lapha kusho ukuthi bawuphula umgomo othi lezi zinhlaka zinikezwe amandla ahlukene. Kuyona le ncwadi siphinde sibone futhi yona imantshi lena ibeka umbono wayo ngesigcawu, ngaphambi kokuthi izwe ubufakazi. Konke lokhu kusitshela ukuthi inhloso yesigcawu kwakuyikho ukufihla iqiniso."URadebe uthe uLuthuli wayenyamanambana kuhulumeni wobandlululo ngenxa yokulwa kwakhe nokucindezelwa kwabantu abamnyama.URadebe uthe uhulumeni wobandlululo wazama kaningi ukuvala uLuthuli umlomo. "Amaphoyisa kahulumeni wobandlululo ayembona njengomuntu oyingozi uLuthuli. Zikhona izincwadi eziveza lokho. Okwakubakhathaza kakhulu wukuthi yayehluleka yonke imizamo yabo yokumvala omlomo. Wayekwazi ukubahlakaniphela, aqhubeke nokubamba imihlangano. Nangesikhathi izinhlangano eziningi zezepolitiki sezivalwe imilomo, wayekwazi ukuqhubeka nokubamba imihlangano eyimfihlo."URadebe uthe uLuthuli wabamba iqhaza elikhulu ngesikhathi kuliwa nohulumeni wobandlululo, ebambisene nabaholi abafana nowayengumengameli, uMnuz Nelson Mandela, kanye naloyo owaba umengameli we-ANC isikhathi eside, uMnuz Oliver Tambo.URadebe uthe ngaphansi kobuholi bukaLuthuli i-ANC yaqinisa umkhankaso wokulwa nohulumeni wobandlululo, waze waqala umbutho wezempi, uMkhonto weSizwe. URadebe uthe ukulwa kwe-ANC nohulumeni wobandlululo ngaphansi kobuholi bukaLuthuli kwakufakela uhulumeni wobandlululo amehlo omhlaba."Lokhu kwafaka uhulumeni wobandlululo ngaphansi kwengcindezi. Kwakuthi uma uhulumeni wobandlululo uzama ukuqinisa isandla, abantu bavele bavuthe kakhulu."Isigcawu siyaqhubeka.
ZIKHATHAZEKILE izikhulu zoMnyango wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal, ngezinsolo zokuxhimfwa kowesifazane emtholampilo waseNtuzuma eThekwini.Kulesi sigameko okuthiwa senzeke ngoMgqibelo, kushaywe ngesihluku uNksz Nomfundo Muthwa, waze wahlephuka izinyo, kwaxega amanye. Umsolwa kusona ungunogada wesilisa kulo mtholampilo. Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMpilo kulesi sifundazwe uMnuz Ntokozo Maphisa uthe: "Ziyasikhathaza lezi zinsolo, futhi asizithathi neze kancane. Siyaxolisa ngokungaphatheki kahle kukadadewethu emtholampilo othintekayo.”Uthe ngokomthetho umtholampilo yindawo lapho umphakathi okumele uthole khona usizo lwezempilo uma uzizwa ubuthaka emzimbeni, hhayi ukuthi uhlukunyezwe."Singakuqinisekisa ukuthi abaphathi besifunda saseThekwini babe nomhlangano nomgilwa othintekayo ngoLwesibili. Baqale ngokumnika usizo lwezempilo njengoba ebelimele,” kusho uMaphisa.Uthe emhlanganweni bekukhona nomnikazi wenkampani yonogada ezimele, okuyiyo eqashe onogada abathinteka kulolu daba."Siyafisa nokukuveza ukuthi ngokwemibiko, akulona iqiniso ukuthi lesi sigameko senzeke emva kokukhononda kweziguli - futhi uma lokhu kwenzeka siyaye sigqugquzele iziguli ukuba zixhumane nabaphathi bezikhungo zezempilo. Kuthiwa uthuthuva ludalwe wukufika kwabantu abebedle amanzi amponjwana emtholampilo, okuyibo abahilizisane nonogada,” kusho uMaphisa.Uthe nakuba bengeke bagxile kakhulu kulolu daba njengoba lusezithebeni zabomthetho, kodwa bangakuqinisekisa ukuthi onogada abane bamisiwe emsebenzini njengoba kusaqhubeka uphenyo.Ngokusho kukamgilwa umsindo wasuka ngesikhath abesifazane ababili ababezofuna usizo lwezempilo besukuma beyobuza abahlengikazi ukuthi kungani bengabasizi njengoba kwase kuphele isikhathi eside benganakiwe.Uthe onogada bangenelela ingaleso sikhathi bagxavuna abesifazane babakhiphela ngaphandle komtholampilo.Uveze ukuthi yena okwamdonsela amanzi ngomsele ukuthwebula okwakwenzeka, onogada bambhozomela, bezama ukumphuca iselula.Udadule ukuthi yilapho agcina eseshaywa khona elinyazwa. Udaba luphenywa amaphoyisa esiteshi samaphoyisa eNtuzuma njengoba agcina evula icala ngokushaywa kwakhe.
UMREPHA ongumculi we-Afro soul, uJabulani "Sjava" Hadebe, uzokhumbuza abalandeli bakhe ngezingoma zamzukwane ePlayhouse Opera Theatre, eThekwini, ngale mpelasonto. USjava odabuka eBergville, unochungechunge lwamakhonsathi oluqala namhlanje ngo-7 ebusuku, luze luphothulwe ngeSonto ngo-3 ntambama. KwiSjava 2018 Tour lo mculi usuke eqhulula amanoni awacaphune kuma-albhamu akhe awakhipha ngalo nyaka, esihloko sithi Umqhele nethi Umphako (EP). Yilo nyaka lapho uSjava akhala wemuka khona nendondo phesheya kwezilwandle kumaBET Awards futhi wapikwa kwi-albhamu kaKendrik Lamar ethi Black Panther. Kumanoni angeke aphume engawaculanga bukhoma esiteji kubalwa elithi Ikhandlela, Linda, Izitha nelithi Abangani. USjava uthembise ukukhipha amangwevu ukuze ashiye izithameli zisahalela impinda. Uthe akuthanda kakhulu ngokucula bukhoma emicimbini ukuthi uthola ithuba lokuxhumana nabalandeli bakhe."Indlela engikwazi ukuxhumana ngayo nabalandeli bami nezihlwele ngesikhathi nginandisa bukhoma iyamangalisa futhi iyona ewumgogodla emsebenzini wami wokucula."Uthe ngisho nangezikhathi ezinzima empilweni yakhe, uma esesteji, konke okusuke kwenzeka kumnikeza umdlandla."Yikho okungigugquzelayo. Yilokhu engiphila ngakho." Lolu chungechunge olukazwelonke njengoba uSjava ehamba enandisa koGreen Point, eCape Town, eState Theatre ePitoli, eSand Du Plessis eBloemfontein, eJoburg Theatre eGoli, nasePlaytsongo Dome eMalahleni, eMpumalanga. Ikhonsathi yanamhlanje nakusasa aqala ngo-7 ebusuku, bese eyangeSonto iqale ngo-3 ntambama.
KUNTWELA ezansi ngoxhaso lwezinhlelo zezempilo kuleli ikakhulu zokulwa nokusabalala kweHIV, iTB nezinye izifo njengoba sekunoxhaso oluzodla uR1 billion, lokuthenga imishanguzo yokuthithibalisa iHIV.Lolu xhaso luvela kwiGlobal Fund, kanti kusewuxhaso lokuqala lokusiza ezinhlelweni zokulwa naleli gciwane, emva kokuba iMelika yahoxisa uxhaso lwayo lwezempilo.Lokhu kuvezwe nguNgqongqoshe wezeMpilo, uDkt Aaron Motsoaledi ekhuluma nabezindaba eGoli ngezinhlelo zezempilo.Uthe selokhu iMelika yanqamula uhlelo lwayo lokuxhasa elakuleli ngaphansi kwePepfar ne-USAid, bebelokhu bethembisa abazosiza kodwa kungekho okubambekayo."Manje sithole imvume kwiGlobal Fund, ukuthi sithenge ama-ARV abiza uR1 billion. Lolu uxhaso lokuqala oluphathekayo esilutholayo kwezempilo selokhu uMengameli waseMelika, uMnuz Donald Trump, amisa uxhaso kuleli," usho kanje. Uthe noma lolu xhaso lungasekho, kodwa abadla le mishanguzo bazoqhubeka bayithole emitholampilo noma ezibhedlela."Senze izinhlelo nozakwethu ezifundazweni zokuthi kungenzeki kube khona abangayitholi imishanguzo ngenxa yokuthi zivaliwe izindawo lapho bebeyithola khona. Sifuna nokuthi abathatha le mishanguzo bathole eyezinyanga eziyisithupha, ukuze bangezi njalo emitholampilo beyoyifuna," usho kanje. Ukusho lokhu njengoba ehlangene nozakwabo ezifundazweni ukubhunga ngezempilo.Ubalule nokuthi kuzokwakheka imisebenzi engu-1 650, njengoba kuzoqashwa odokotela abangu-1 200."Sizoqasha abahlengikazi abangu-200, nabanye abasebenzi bezempilo abangu-250. Sifuna ukwehlisa izinga lodokotela abangasebenzi njengoba kuke kwaba nezikhalo."Usho kanjena nje sebemashe izikhawu eziningi odokotela abangasebenzi kuleli, bekhala ngokungaqashwa.Lezi zikhala zizodla uR1.78 billion, kanti zizokhangiswa maduzane.Ubalule nokuthi uhlela ukuthengela izibhedlela ezehlukene izinsiza ezizodla uR1.4 million."Ezinye zalezi zinsiza zibandakanya imibhede, omatrasi, amashidi, izinto zokulala nokunye. Asifuni kuphinde kube nesimo lapho izingane zilala emabhokisini."Ukhale nangezokuphepha ezikhungweni zezempilo, wathi lolu daba bazoluxoxa kabanzi."Sikhathazekile ngezehlakalo zokugetshengwa kwabasebenzi bezempilo neziguli ezikhungweni zethu. Mhlawumbe kumele zibhekisiswe kahle izinkampani ezigada ezikhungweni ukuthi ziyahambisana yini nayo yonke imigomo ebekiwe," usho kanje.
KUZOQALWA uphenyo oluzohlanganisa izinhlangano ezehlukene ngokukhishwa phambili ecaleni lokudlwengula kukaMfundisi Timothy Omotoso.IKhomishini egqugquzela ukuvikelwa kwamalungelo, amasiko, ezenkolo, ikhomishini yezokulingana ngokobulili, kanjalo neSouth African Human Rights Commission, bazoqala lolu phenyo maduzane, ngemuva kokudedelwa kwalo mfundisi obesetoke isikhathi eside kuqulwa leli cala.Lezi zinhlangano zikhala ngendlela okusingathwa ngayo amacala athinta ukuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane kuleli."Yingakho sizoqala uphenyo, lapho sizobizela esigcawini izinhlaka ezehlukene zizophendula ngokwenzekile. Sifuna kuphenywe lonke uhlelo olulandeliwe, bese sikhipha iziphakamiso," kusho usihlalo wekhomishini yokuvikelwa kwamalungelo, uNkk Thoko Mkhwanazi-Xaluva, efunda isitatimende esihlanganyelwe salezi zinhlangano.Uthe bakhathazekile ngokwanda kwamacala okuhlunyezwa kwabesifazane kuleli.Ukhale nangendlela okwabulawa ngayo omunye wofakazi ecaleni lika-Omotoso."Sikhathazekile nangobungozi obubhekene nofakazi woMbuso uNksz Cheryl Zondi. Leli cala liphinde lamfaka ingcindezi njengoba engabutholanga ubulungiswa."Uthe indlela iNPA esingathe ngayo icala, izodikibalisa izisulu ezidlwenguliwe ngomuso."Leli cala liveze igebe elikhona kwezomthetho. Uma lingavalwa lizokwenza kube nzima ukubhekana namacala afuze lawa."ISAHRC ithe kumele kusheshiswe kulungiswe indaba yezikhungo zokuhlola ulibofuzo kuleli.
KUVELA ukuthi lisocongwe ngomakhelwane balo abangamalungu eqembu lemigulukudu iWest, iphoyisa laseNewtown C, eNanda.Umufi uSergeant Sanele Dlamini (37), ohlaselwe esesitolo sendawo ethenga okuthile ngoLwesibili, kuvela ukuthi nabasolwa bebethenga kusona lesi sitolo.Kuthiwa ubhozonyelwe ngabasolwa ababili walwa nabo wabadubula. Oyedwa walaba ulimale kabi waze waphuthunyiswa esibhedlela engasakwazi ukusuka endaweni yesigameko. Kuthiwa kuthe umufi esabhekene nalaba ababili, kanti ngemuva kukhona abanye besilisa abathathu okuyibona abamnqobile ngenhlamvu.Kuvela ukuthi bamdubule amahlandla ambalwa.Owomndeni ongudadewabo kamufi, uNkk Ntombenhle Mhlongo, uveze ukuthi bekukhona nabesilisa abangomakhelwane babo ngesikhathi kubulawa uDlamini, wathi omunye wabahlaseli wayekade efunda naye umufi esikoleni ngaphambilini.''USanele ubekade ephuma emsebenzini, wadlula egaraji wathela uphethroli. Kuthe eseqedile, kwase kuqhamuka abafana ababili bambhudubeza. Wazama, wamdubula oyedwa lo omunye wabaleka. Akabonanga ngemuva ukuthi kukhona abanye abathathu okuyibona abakwazile ukumnqoba,'' kuchaza uNkk Mhlongo.Uveze ukuthi kunemoto yohlobo lwe-VW Polo, ebikade imlandela ngesikhathi esegaraji base bayaphuma ngesikhathi esephuma esoyothenga esitolo."Bathe bebengazi ukuthi babulala umuntu abamaziyo, bona bebecabanga ukuthi umuntu nje abangamazi ongunogada,'' usho kanje.Uthe kulokoza inhlansi yethemba ngokuboshwa kwabenzi bokubi njengoba lo odubulekile osesibhedlela, esecula, waveza ukuthi u-wallet kamufi abazange bawuthathe kodwa bathathe isibhamu.Owomndeni uthe bagqemeke udume lwengozi ngokwenzekile.Umufi kuthiwa ubeqapha umengemeli uma eKwaZulu-Natal, kodwa ubesebenzela esiteshini samaphoyisa eMalvern.Ushiye emhlabeni amadodakazi akhe amabili; eneminyaka emithathu neneminyaka emibili.Umfowabo kamufi, uMnuz Phumlani Dlamini, uthe uyena owabizwa ngosuku lwesigameko, wathi wamfica uSanele elele ebheke phansi ngobuso egcwele igazi emhlane."Ngamfica esaphila ngabe sengimqukula ngamyisa esibhedlela. Bamzama esibhedlala base besitshela ukuthi usethule. Udokotela wasikhombisa amanxeba amabili emhlane, kukhona eliphezu kwendlebe nelinye ngaphansi kwekhwapha,'' echaza.Uthe into engabagculisa ukubona kuma itende nakubo komakhelwane ababulele uSanele."Ubulungiswa kimina ukubona kuma itende nakulabo ababulale umfowethu. Okubuhlungu ukuthi abantu abenze le nto abalapha eduze kwethu,'' usho kanje, wathi yena ukholelwa ekutheni iso ngeso."Akukho okunye mina engizokusho ngaphandle kokuthi iso ngeso. Nabo abafe ngoba babulele. Laba bantu babulele umuntu obelungile, obeya enkonzweni engabhemi futhi engaphuzi,'' usho kanje.Uveze ukuthi abasolwa ngosuku lwesigameko babedane bedansa, beqhumisa nesibhamu.Uthe kwenzeka lokhu nje, amalungu eWest ayekade esongile ngokuthi azoziphindiselela emaphoyiseni ngemuva kokuba amaphoyisa esoconge umholi wabo, uMnqobi Nzimande.Ngesikhathi Isolezwe lifika kubo, bese kukhona amalungu ebandla e-United Congregational Church of Southern Africa (UCCSA), abezobhonga emswaneni.Imoto emhlophe okuthiwa bekungeyakhe, ibipakiwe eceleni kwendlu. Baveze ukuthi umufi uzofihlwa ngoLwesithathu, lapho azalelwa khona eHighflats.

Engomeni ethi Ndiyabulela, uyezwa ukuthi uRiky Rick uyisusele kweyeFreshlyground ethi Nomvula.Ethi Higher Power iyadabukisa ngoba uRiky Rick uveza ubuhlungu bokukhulela emzini okuhlale kunengxabano phakathi kukababa nomama. Uveza nokuthi kuyenzeka umuntu aphumelele ngenxa yamandla athize awatholayo.Eziningi ziyakuveza ukuthi wayesebonisiwe ngokuhamba kwakhe emhlabeni. Okunye engikuphawulile ukuthi ubenekhono lokucula, hhayi ukusebenzisa i-autotune.Ezinye izingoma ezizokuchaza ngezithi Raindrops, Cishe Ngaposta, Eish, Usangikhumbula, Calling Me Back, The Chant, Owami nethi Never Let Me Down.Engingakusho nje ukuthi lo mrepha wasishiya emhlabeni eyibekile induku ebandla ngale albhamu ewunqambothi.

LIHLEHLISELWE kuMeyi 12, kulo nyaka icala lokudlwengula elibhekene nesishoshovu seMK saKwaMakhutha. Owesilisa osolwa ngokudlwengula, akhulelise indodakazi (19), uvele izolo eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMbumbulu. Imantshi ngesikhathi ihlehlisa icala ithe kusaqhutshekwa nophenyo.Umsolwa ophinde abe yilungu leCommunity Policing Forum (CPF), ungaphandle ngebheyili kaR1000, kulandela ukudedelwa kwakhe ngoFebhuwari kulo nyaka. Umsolwa uboshwe ngasekuqaleni kwalo nyaka, emva kokuthi umgilwa egonyuluke ngesigameko emndenini wakhe ngasekupheleni kukaDisemba. Kuthiwa umgilwa wagonyuluka emva kokuthi unina ebambe imiyalezo eshaqisayo phakathi kukamgilwa noyise, lapho ayeveze khona ukuthi akumphathi kahle ukuthi uyise uvele afune ukulala naye.Ngesikhathi kuqhubeka ukuvela kukamsolwa enkantolo, kuvele ukuthi umsolwa wambizela kubo umgilwa, emkhohlisa ngokuthi kukhona izihlobo ezikhona, okufanele azozibona.Kwavela ukuthi wathi uma efika, wathola ukuthi uyise ubesenga ezimithiyo ngokuba khona kwezihlobo ngoba wamthola eyedwa, wase embhozomela.Kwavela ukuthi wamsabisa ngokumbulala, okuyisona sizathu esenza ukuthi athule angatsheli muntu ngesigameko.Okunye okwabuye kwahlaluka enkantolo ukuthi umgilwa wacela ukusihushula isisu, wasabisa ngokuthi uma ephoqwa ukuthi ayigcine ingane, uzovele azibulale.
UKHALA ngonya olukhonjiswe ngunogada wenkosi yesinye isizwe eMacekane, eMpangeni, nesihluku asenza ebulala indodana yakhe endaweni yokujuxuxa 'embangweni wesigqoko'. Kulesi sehlakalo esenzeka ngoMashi 29 nonyaka, kwadutshulwa kwashona uMnuz Njabulo Dladla (27) ngaphandle kwale ndawo esedolobheni eMpangeni. Elandisa ngokwenzeka unina kamufi, uNksz Sphiwe Mthethwa, uthe uthuthuva kuthiwa lwaqala ngaphakathi kule ndawo ngesikhathi inkosi (28) ifika izobingelela umufi nabangani bakhe etafuleni ababehleli kulo. "Unogada wayo wafike wahlwitha isigqoko esasifakwe yindodana yami, wathi isiyosilanda ngekesi nebhodlela emzini wenkosi,” kusho uNksz Mthethwa. Uthe inkosi yamlandela unogada, yasithatha isigqoko, yasibuyisela kumufi.Uveze ukuthi kwathi umufi esephuma kule ndawo yokucima ukoma entathakusa, unogada, wamlandela wafika ngasemotweni ababezogoduka ngayo, wamxakazisa.Uthe umufi wezwakala ethi: "Kanti mfethu ulokhu ungilandela ngenzeni kuwena?”Kuthiwa wamphendula unogada wathi: "Ngizokudubula”, maqede kwezwakala sekuqhuma isibhamu. "Omunye wabangani bakhe ababemlandela, wathi waphuthuma waya eduze kwemoto, wafike wabamba unogada ngemuva, isibhamu saqhashela kude, wabe ewa kanye naye,” kusho uNksz Mthethwa.Uthe yilapho okwaqhamuka khona inkosi, yafike yamdonsa ngomlenze, imsusa phezu kukanogada, wakwazi ukukhululeka."Esekhululekile, kuthiwa wasukuma wacosha isibhamu sakhe, maqede babaleka nenkosi ngemoto, kukhona nonogada wesibili, bashaya bachitha,” kusho uNksz Mthethwa. Uthe umufi, owaphuthunyiswa esibhedlela, wagcina eshona ngalo usuku lwesigigaba.Uveze ukuthi okubaphathe kabi ukungaveli kwenkosi emndenini emva kwesehlakalo."Ngize ngathumela kabili kuyona ngithi ngicela ifike ekhaya, kuzodingidwa lolu daba kodwa lutho,” kusho uNksz Mthethwa, othe, kubantu bokuqala abathumela inkosi yathi "phindelani emuva niyobuza lowo mama ukuthi ngihlanganaphi nokufa kwengane yakhe?” Uthe abathume okwesibili, ebaphathise incwadi, yathi abayivule, bayifunde bona."Sinemibuzo eminingi ngesigameko ngoba umufi ubengesiye umuntu othanda udweshu, ubevame ukuzithulela, engatholwa ezimpini. Asazi namanje ukuthi yini eyayingadala unogada ambulale,” usho kanje.Uqhube wathi nakuba bezindla ngokuthi yisigqoko esaba wumsusa wodweshu, kodwa babuye bazibuze ukuthi kanjani ngoba ukubuyiswa kwaso yinkosi, ngokwabo, kwakukhombisa ukuthi alikho elibi."Sifuna ubulungiswa, baboshwe bobabili ngoba nakuba ingamdubulanga inkosi umufi kodwa yambalekisa umsolwa endaweni yesigameko. Ngokwenza njalo, siyibona inecala nayo,” kusho uNksz Mthethwa. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa aseMpangeni abophe owesilisa (45) mayelana necala nokubulawa komunye wesilisa (27) ngoMashi 29. "Umgilwa watholwa enenxeba lokudutshulwa, waphuthunyiswa esibhedlela, lapho agcina eshonela khona,” kusho uNetshiunda.Imizamo yokuthola inkosi ayiphumelelanga izolo.

I-NFP eZululand, isiphakamise ukuthi kuphenywe kabanzi ngesibhamu okuthiwa kasikho emthethweni, esitholwe kuSomlomo kaMasipala wasoPhongolo ngeSonto.USomlomo oyilungu le-IFP, uMnuz Kwenzakakufani Nxumalo, ukhalelwe amasongo kaSigonyela emva kokutholakala nezulu lezandla. Kumele izinto ezifuze lezi sizivike zingakenzeki. Sisebenzisana namaphoyisa kulolu daba," kusho uNksz Gwarube.

UMENGAMELI Cyril Ramaphosa ubona ukwandiswa kwamajaji esifazane kungasiza ukwelekelela ekulweni nesihlava sokuhlukunyezwa kwesibhuda nezingane ezinkantolo.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma emhlanganweni wamajaji esifazane obuseKapa.URamaphosa uthe nakuba amajaji esilisa nawo ekwazi ukulalela amacala okuhlukumeza ngokobulili, kodwa ukuba khona kwamajaji esifazane amaningi kungenza ukuthi anakwe ngokuthe xaxa la macala."Uma kuza ekulandelweni komthetho emacaleni okuhlukumeza ngokobulili, ubulili bamajaji nabo buba nomthelela. Njengamajaji abantu besifazane likhulu iqhaza lenu futhi kuningi eningakwenza ezinkantolo ukulwa nalesi hlava esixakile."URamaphosa uthe isihlava sokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane siyaqhubeka nokudla lubi kuleli.URamaphosa uthe ukungaqiniswa kwemithetho kwababoshelwa la macala nakho kube nomthelela kule simo."Esakuthola ukuthi abantu ababoshelwa amacala okuhlukumeza abantu besifazane babenikezwa ibheyili, bese bengezi ezinkantolo. Abanye babephinde benze amanye amacala khona bengaphandle ngebheyili. Okwavela ukuthi izinkantolo zazingabanikezi izigwebo ezibekiwe abalahlwa amacala okuhlukumeza abesifazane nezingane. Abantu abahlukumezekile babephinde bahlukunyezwe amaphoyisa kanye nasezinkantolo."URamaphosa uthe le simo senza ukuba kuqiniswe imithetho evikela abantu besifazane nezingane.URamaphosa uthe ngo-2022 kwenziwa izinguquko emithethweni emithathu, iCriminal Law (Sexual Offences and Related Matters) Amendment Act, i-Criminal and Related Matters Amendment Act ne-Domestic Violence Act."Lezi zinguquko zizokwenza ukuthi kulandelwe imithetho. Izinguquko ngeke zigcine ngokuqinisekisa ukuvikelwa kwamalungelo abasolwa, kodwa ziqinisekisa nokuthi baphathwa kahle ezinkantolo abavula amacala.URamaphosa uthe mkhulu umehluko osuwenziwe eNingizimu Afrika emizamweni yokwandisa isibalo samajaji esifazane."Njengezwe sisuka kude kakhulu. Siqhamuka esikhathini lapho sike saba namajaji nje amathathu kuphela amnyama. Nawo lawo majaji kwakungabantu besilisa, kungekho ngisho oyedwa umuntu wesifazane. Namhlanje cishe u-48% wamajaji asezinkantolo ezinkulu abantu besifazane. Izinkantolo ezinkulu eziyisithupha kwezingu-15 ziphethwe abantu besifazane. Kulezi zinkantolo eziphethwe abantu besifazane kubalwa eyoMthethosisekelo neyaMacala aDlulisiwe. Uma kuza ezinkantolo zezimantshi, uhhafu wezimantshi ngabantu besifazane."

SEKUQUBUKE ukukhathazeka emndenini waku-ward 74 eTamboville, eLamontville, eThekwini, ngenxa yenkiyankiya obhekene nayo yokungatholi imali yesibonelelo yomzukulu ongasenabo abazali, ebhajwe kwababhekele izibonelelo iSouth African Social Security Agency (SASSA).Owomndeni osekhulile, ocele ukuthi kugodlwe igama lakhe ukuze kuvikelwe umndeni wakhe, uthe inkinga ebhekene nomzukulu iqale ngo-2023 ngenkathi kuma ukukhishwa kwesibonelo sakhe sokuthi akasenabazali.Lithe nakuba lokho kungabethusanga kangako ngaleso sikhathi ngenxa yokuthi kuyenzeka vele kumuntu oseneneminyaka ewu-18, okudingeka ukuthi afake isicelo kabusha uma kuwukuthi usuke engakawuphothuli u-matric, kepha kubaphatha kabi ukuthi ngisho sebebhalise kabusha - sekuze kuba yiminyaka emibili kunemali abangakayitholi."Sekuphele iminyaka emibili yonke sigqigqa emahhovisi abezenhlalakahle ukubheka ukuthi yini eyinkinga, kepha kunhlanga zimuka nomoya. Esikhundleni sokuthi basikhokhele imali yesibonelelo seminyaka emibili, nyakenye bavele basifakela eyonyaka owodwa kuphela, okuthe uma silandelela ukuthi kungani ingekho eyomunye unyaka - balokhu bethi asilinde kodwa kuze kuzoba yimanje akukho okuphathekayo olwenzekayo," kusho owomndeni.Eqhuba, uthe kubaphatha kabi ukuthi ulokhu ehliswa enyuswa njalo ekubeni esekhulile ngeminyaka, kodwa kungekho okulungayo ngemali esele yomzukulu womfana (20), okumanje ufunda u-matric kwesinye sezikole zamabanga aphezulu eLamontville."Kuhlale kuthiwa angihambe, ngibuye nemininingwane ethile - ngenze njengoba kushiwo, kodwa lutho ukulunga kwezinto. Kwesinye isikhathi kuthi sengifikile, bangitshele ukuthi angilande imininingwane ethile ekhombisa ukuthi umzukulu wami usafunda, nalokho sengikwenzile kodwa ayikangeni le mali esikweletwa yona yonyaka wonke, okumele ibe ngaphezudlwana kuka-R12 000 esawuthola wonyaka wokuqala, ngoba phela manje le mali yesibonelelo isanda kunyuswa, isingaphezudlwana kuka-R1 000 ngenyanga," usho kanjena.Ugogo , ohlala nabazukulu abane - kubalwa nalona onale nkinga, uthe sonke lesi sidididi senza asole ukuthi kunogcobho endleleni okusingethwe ngayo inkinga yakhe, athe akuqali ukuthi kube nento enjena emhluphayo njengoba kwake kwenzeka isimo esifana nalesi futhi eminyakeni eyisishiyagalolunye edlule."Kwake kwanzeka ukuthi imali yesibonelo sami sempesheni ingangeni cishe unyaka wonke, okwaze kwangenelela owayewuNgqongqoshe wokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi ngaleso sikhathi uNkk Bathabile Dlamini, kwayikhathii kulungiseka inkinga yami. Yingakho namanje ngisola ukuthi kukhona okungale kwengitshelwa khona ngalesi simo," kusho umntomdala.Kuthintwa okhulumela iSASSA uNksz Sandy Godlwana uthe akazi lutho ngalolu daba, wacela ukuthi bathunyelelwe imininingwane ephelele yabathinteka kule nkinga ukuze kubhekwe ukuthi yikuphi okungenziwa ukubasiza enkingeni ababhekene nayo.
UKUBAMBISANA kwabasebenzi nokubeka umsebenzi phambili - ngisho nasezimweni zomkhakha wobuntatheli zingelula - yizona zinto ezibe wukhiye wempumelelo wentandokazi yephephandaba Isolezwe, ebeligubha umlando wokuba nabalandeli abangu-1.5 million kwiFacebook.Leli phephandaba ligubhe neminyaka ewu-23 lasungulwa. Lokho kushiwo ngumhleli waleli phephanda lesiZulu elihamba phambili eNingizimu Afrika, uMnuz Thulani Mbatha, ngesikhathi ethula inkulumo yokubonga nokujabulela umlando oqophekile, emahhovisi okusebenza aleli phephandaba aseGreyville, eThekwini, izolo. UMbatha uthe lesi sigaba okufikwe kusona siyinkomba yokuthi ukusebenza kanzima kuzala impumelelo, ikakhulu kulesi sikhathi lapho ziningi izinselelo ezibhekene nemboni yobuntatheli okuhlupha kakhulu emkhakheni wamaphephandaba. "Ngiyobe angenzi ubulungiswa uma ngingancomi abasebenzi baleli phephandaba, abahlale bezikhandla njalo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi iphephandaba lethu liya phambili, nakuba kubuye kube nezinselelo nezimo zokusebenza ezenza ukusebenza kwethu kungahlale kumnandi, kepha lokhu okwenzeka lana manje kukhomba ukuthi kukude lapho esizoqhubeka siye khona uma siqhubeka nokuzimisela emsebenzini esiwenzayo,” kusho uMbatha. Omunye wababeyingxenye yethimba elalikhona kusungulwa Isolezwe ngo-Ephreli 8 wango-2002, uMnuz Mazwi Xaba, naye uhambe emazwini kaMbatha kwelokuthi lesi sigaba leli phephandaba eselifike kusona manje akubanga wuhambo olulula nobelunoshukela njengalobhazabhaza wekhekhe onikezelwe yiReddy’s Bakery, ukufakazela umsebenzi omuhle ofeziwe ukufika lapho okukhona manje, njengoba ziningi izinselelo eziphazamisayo. "Sifisa ukuthi lo msebenzi uqhubeke uye phambili njalo futhi ube yisiqalo sezinye izinto eziningi ezinhle ezizokwenzeka futhi zifezwe yileli phephanda kubhekwe phambili. Yisigaba okumele sizijabulele kakhulu lesi futhi siziqhenye ngokuthi sesifike kusona,” kusho uXaba.Ngaphandle kwa-Facebook; Isolezwe likhona nakwezinye izinkundla zokuxhumana, kanti litholakala ezitolo ezahlukene nsukuzonke ngeSolezwe laphakathi nezinsuku eliphuma ngoMsombuluko kuya kuLwesihlanu.KunengeMpelasonto elidayisa ngoMgqibelo nangeSonto. Izindaba zephephandaba ziyatholakala futhi ku-www.isolezwe.co.za
MHLELI: Angithi qaphuqaphu, ngidedele abanye ngemvume yakho. UZimdollar (Zimiphi Biyela) nguyena umhleli womcimbi iMother of all Maskandi obekubangwa khona imoto iQuantum. Okungiphatha kabi yinkulumo kaZimiphi engumhleli lapho ezwakale khona ethi: "ULimit akawiniswanga nje yivoti, imisebenzi yakhe embeke lapha ekhona nanabantu-ke abamvotele". Okungididayo kule nkulumo kaZimiphi ukuthi uma ethi akusilo ivoti kuphela eliwinise uLimit, kanti yini enye ebhekwayo ebesingayazi kulo mqhudelwano? Ngabe uZimiphi kukhona akwaziyo?Ungumhleli womcimbi, ukhuluma kanjani inkulumo enjena ekubeni vele kunezinsolo zomkhonyovu obuwenziwa? Ngabe okwenzeka ebumnyameni sekuyavela vele?
