UMUNWE ukhonjwa ekuntengantengeni kwezobunhloli emaphoyiseni akuleli, ngokudlanga kwezigameko zokubanjwa inkunzi kwezimoto ezithwala imali.Muva nje, kubonakala ziqala phansi izigameko zokugetshengwa kwalezi zimoto, lapho izinswelaboya ziqhumisa izimoto zikhale zemuke nezishaqane zemali.Cishe alipheli isonto ingabanjwanga imoto ethwala imali. Isehlakalo sakamuva senzeke ngoLwesibili, lapho kubanjwe enye imoto yemali eNhlungwane eDumbe.Esinye isigameko esibe undabuzekwayo, esenzeke ngo-Ephreli 1, lapho imoto yemali ibanjwe emgwaqweni uM25 (KwaMashu Highway), phakathi kweDuffs Road neKwaMashu Cross Roads. Abasolwa abalinganiselwa ku-12, ababehamba ngezimoto ezimbili, behlome bephelele badumisa izulu lezandla, bephoqa imoto yemali ukuthi ime.Behlisa onogada ngenhlamvu emotweni babaphuca izibhamu, kubona kwalimala abathathu. Baqhumisa ngeziqhumane lapho okuvalelwe khona imali bayisavuna, ngamakesi ebekwa ngawo, beyithuthela ezimotweni ababehamba ngazo, maqede baqhelisa abashayeli ababemi endleleni yabo yokubaleka.Isigameko esandulela leso senzeke KwaCaluza eMgungundlovu ngoMashi 28, lapho abasolwa babhomba imoto yemali emgwaqweni u-Edendale, ngasegaraji iBP, ngabo-6 ntambama. Kulesi sigameko balimaza unogada oyedwa, babaleka nesamba semali.Ngokwama-rekhodi amaphoyisa akamuva, iKwaZulu-Natal izihola phambili ezinye izifundazwe ngezigigaba zokubanjwa inkunzi kwezimoto zemali. Ilandelwa iGauteng. Umthombo weSolezwe osebenza ophikweni lwezobunhloli emaphoyiseni, ongeke uvezwe, uthe lezi zigameko zandiswa ukuthi iziphathimandla zamaphoyisa zivele zanqamula imali 'okubongwa’ ngayo abaziphilisa ngokupotshozela amaphoyisa ulwazi ngezinhlelo zezigilamkhuba ezibamba lezi zimoto inkunzi."Lolu, wuhlobo lwabantu abasuke bephuma khona ebugebengwini bokubanjwa kwalezi zimoto inkunzi. Basuke bengasafuni ukuzibandakanya nalolu hlobo lobugebengu, bese benika amaphoyisa ulwazi olungawasiza ukuze abambe abasaqhubeka nalo mkhuba,” kusho umthombo.Uthe ngesikhathi kusathule ngokubanjwa kwalezi zimoto, bebekhokhelwa abaputshuzi, kodwa kwathi kungazelelwe, iziphathimandla emaphoyiseni, zayinqamula imali abebebongwa ngayo."Iphakathi kukaR80 000 noR100 000 imali ebinikwa laba bantu ngamunye. Futhi ibibagculisa ngoba bekuyimali ebebeyithola ngendlela eyiyo, bayidle bekhululekile, ingafani nale yokubamba inkunzi abayidla bejeqeza. Manje uma bengasayitholi, bayayeka phela ukuletha ulwazi ngoba akekho umuntu ofuna ukubeka impilo yakhe engcupheni, engeke athole ngisho isenti,” kusho umthombo.Uthe iziqhumane ezisetshenziswayo, imvamisa zisuke zithathwe emazweni angaphandle afana noDRC, lapho okusuke kuqhubeka khona izimpi.Ezichaza lezi ziqhumane, uthe zenza umsebenzi omkhulu ngomzuzwana nje njengoba zikwazi ukuqhumisa indawo egcina imali, okwaziwayo ukuthi yakhiwe ngezinto okungelula ukuziqhumisa. "Imali ihlala obala ngomzuzwana, bayithathe yonke, babaleke nayo,” kusho umthombo.Uthe abakutholayo ukuthi ubugebengu bokubanjwa kwalezi zimoto, buhlelwa, buhlanganiswe abantu abalinganiselwa ku-20. Umuntu ngamunye uyasho ukuthi yena uzobamba liphi iqhaza."Omunye uvolontiyela ukuhlinzeka ngezimoto okuzosetshenzwa ngazo, omunye athi uzoza nezibhamu, omunye eze neziqhumane, njalo njalo,” kusho umthombo.Udalule nokuthi kulesi sibalo kuvame ukuthi kube khona amaphoyisa (azibandakanya nobugebengu), amasosha (aqeqeshelwa ukusebenzisa iziqhumane) nonogada (bangaphakathi ezinkampanini zezimoto zemali).Ukuqinisekisile ukuthi impela izinswelaboya zinayo indlela yokuyigeza imali esuke ithelwe u-ink, wathi ziyigeza ngekhemikhali ethize, nayo abayithola kwabayikhiqizayo kuleli kanjalo nasemazweni angaphandle.Uveze ukuthi abasolwa abenza lolu hlobo lobugebengu, baphambili kakhulu ngolwazi njengoba besuke benazo zonke izinsiza ezenza ukuthi babenze ngempumelelo ubugebengu."O-ova abaxhunywe kwi-system yamaphoyisa nabo banabo. Uma sebubikiwe ubugebengu bokubanjwa kwemoto, bawuzwa wonke umnyakazo wamaphoyisa, asuke esegijima eya endaweni yesehlakalo. Lokhu kubasiza ukuthi bazi ukuthi njengoba bebaleka, yimiphi imigwaqo okufanele bayigweme ukuze bangazitheli phezu kwamaphoyisa,” kusho umthombo.Umthombo uqhuba uthe babanemishini ejamisa i-network ingasebenzi kuwo wonke amaselula asuke ekuleyo ndawo."Lokhu kulekelela ekutheni, kube nzima ukuthi asebebone isigameko basibike ngaleso sikhathi sisenzeka."Udalule nokuthi kuyiwa ezinyangeni ngaphambi kokuthi kubanjwe inkunzi lezi zimoto, kuyohlalwa noma yisonto lonke, kudliwa umuthi, izibhamu ezisuke zizosebenza nazo zichelwa ngemithi, izinhlamvu zicwiliswe emithini."Ngisho nezimoto okusuke kuzohanjwa ngazo uma sekuyobanjwa inkunzi ziyachelwa ngamakhathakhatha,” kugobhoza umthombo.Uthe okunye okwenzekayo ukuthi akuvele nje kuvukwe kuthiwe kuyobanjwa imoto yemali inkunzi, siyaphela isikhathi esingangamasonto amabili kuya enyangeni, ibukwa nje."Basuke befunda wonke umnyakazo wayo njengokuthi ihambela ziphi izitolo, iqoqa imali kwezingaki, ihamba kumiphi imigwaqo, njalo njalo. Abamane bayibhozomele nje. Lokhu bakwenzela ukuthi bangaqhumisi imoto engenamali,” usho kanje.Ongumcwaningi wezobugebengu, uNkk Mary de Haas, uthe kuyiqiniso ukuthi abaputshuzi abasakhokhelwa, wathi yena lolu lwazi uluthole ngesikhulu samaphoyisa ezingeni likazwelonke."Bakhipha ulwazi oluyiqiniso, oluwusizo kodwa abakhokhelwa ngalokho. Akekho-ke umuntu ofuna ukubeka impilo yakhe engcupheni mahhala,” kusho uNkk De Haas.Uthe ingcabha isala nezobunhloli emaphoyiseni ngokwanda kwalezi zigameko njengoba kufanele kubuzwe umbuzo wokuthi kwenzeka kanjani ukuthi izigebengu zikuhlele zize zikuqede ukubamba inkunzi izimoto zemali, kungekho muntu emaphoyiseni otholayo ngalokho."Ezobunhloli azisebenzi nhlobo. Isiteshi nesiteshi samaphoyisa kufanele sibe nawo amaphoyisa ambalwa alolu phiko. Bese wona eba nabaputshuzi bawo, abavikelwayo, abakhokhelwayo ngolwazi abalulethayo,” usho kanje.Uthe inkinga yesibili edala zingapheli lezi zigameko ukuthi onogada abaqashwa ilezi zinkampani ababhekisiswa ngesikhathi beqashwa."Kusuke kufanele bahlolisiswe ukuthi njengoba bejoyina izinkampani, beze ngani ngoba abanye babo, bangena njengabantu abafuna umsebenzi ekubeni besuke beyizigebengu ezifuna ukwazi kabanzi ngokuthuthwa kwemali ukuze zenze umshikashika wazo ngempumelelo,” kusho uNkk De Haas, othe lokhu ukusho ngoba kuye kwenzeke kwezinye izigameko, kuvele ukuthi bayandakanyeka nabo. Uthe ukubanjwa kwalezi zimoto zinemali ngaphakathi, kusobala ukuthi izigebengu zisuke zinolwazi olugcwele ngazo, wathi kusala umbuzo othi, ziluthathaphi lolu lwazi olushaya emhloleni?Wenze isiphakamiso sokuthi kungasiza ukujutshwa kophiko lwamaphoyisa iNational Intervention Unit (NIU) ukuba lukhaphe lezi zimoto uma zihambisa imali. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe izinsolo zokuthi kukhona abaputshuzela amaphoyisa ngezinhlelo zokubanjwa kwenkunzi lezi zimoto abangasakhokhelwa, kuyizinsolo amaphoyisa angenalwazi ngazo."Ukube laba baputshuzi abasekho, amaphoyisa ngabe awakwazi ukuthola umkhondo oyiwo ngabasolwa,” kusho uNetshiunda.Uthe abasolwa ebebeyamaniswa nezigameko zakamumva zokubanjwa kwezimoto ezithwala imali esifundazweni, badutshulwe babulawa eRidgeview ngeledlule."Oyedwa wabo ubengungqondongqondo ngokubanjwa inkunzi kwezimoto zemali ezigamekweni ezenzeka eNingizimu Afrika yonke. Eziningi izigameko zokubanjwa kwalezi zimoto inkunzi bezivinjwa amaphoyisa zingakenzeki ngolwazi alunikwa abaputshuzi,” kusho uNetshiunda.Ugcizelele ukuthi izinsolo ezishiwo umthombo nomcwaningi wezobugebengu azilona iqiniso, azinasisindo futhi zicdicilela phansi isithunzi samaphoyisa.Khona manjalo, kuvele izindaba zokuthi inkampani iG4S ilidayisele i-Izi Africa ibhizinisi layo lokuthutha imali.Abantu abaningi ezinkundleni zokuxhumana bakuhlaziye lokhu njengesinyathelo esiphusile sokuchitha ibhizinisi elihaqwe yizinkinga njengoba kwanda izigameko zokubanjwa kwalezi zimoto inkunzi.UMark Frinke uthe leli bhizinisi lisengcupheni eNingizimu Afrika, izimoto zemali zibanjwa inkunzi nsuku zonke.
SIWUJABULISILE umndeni kamgilwa isinqumo sikamsolwa sokulaxaza isicelo sebheyili ecaleni lokudlwengula eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseNtuzuma, izolo.Umsolwa (24), okuthiwa uyilungu leqembu lemigulukudu, iWest, uvela enkantolo nje, waboshwa ngamaphoyisa ngoMsombuluko wangesonto eledlule, kulandela isigameko sokudlwengulwa kukamgilwa (14). Sikhuluma neSolezwe ngaphandle kwenkantolo isihlobo sikamgilwa, siveze ukuthi sizwa ukukhululeka emoyeni ngesenzo sikamsolwa."Besingakutholi ukuphumula ebusuku. Lolu daba luyawuhlukumeza umoya. Sinethemba lokuthi uyophuma esesesimweni esikahle ngoba sigcina ukumbona wayekhombisa ukuzisola, ekhala kodwa manje useguqukile. Ubuso bakhe abusakhombisi nhlobo ukuzisola uma esibona,” kusho isihlobo.Sithe banethemba lokuthi nangawo uJuni, icala elihlehliselwe wona, ngeke asifake isicelo."Simdinga ehleli ngaphakathi ukuze abangani bakhe nonina bafunde isifundo sokuthi umuntu uma enze into engafanele uyajeza,” usho kanje.Isihlobo siveze ukuthi unina kamsolwa usalokhu eqhubeke njalo nokubajikijela ngamagama ayiziswana."Bathi sikhokhele ngisho nomseshi ngoba sinemali,” kusho isihlobo esithe uke wamhlasela futhi unina wengane ngezikhathi zasekuseni enkantolo ngesikhathi esibona sisodwa, engakafiki amalungu e-EFF avele agcwala inkantolo ukuzomeseka.IPhini likaNobhala we-EFF KwaZulu-Natal, elibuye libe yinhloko ye-desk yophiko olulwa nesihlava sokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane, uNkk Khethiwe Buthelezi, lifanise indawo yaseNtuzuma nesizinda esihlala abadlwenguli.Ugqugquzele ebebezokweseka umndeni ukuthi kunokuthi baphele amandla, abanxenxe abanye beze ngobuningi uma kuhleli icala enkantolo."Asifune bheyili kubadlwenguli. Umuntu akaqale ukuzwa umuzwa wokuhlala ejele engakagwetshwa ngoba uma bekhishwa, baphuma basabise ofakazi ngaphandle,” kusho uNkk Buthelezi.Uqhube wathi kuyathusa ukuthi umsolwa - amchaze ngengomuntu omusha - afune ukukhula ngokudlwengula."Kuyamangaza ukuthi ungathi uno-24, wena usuqala ukudlwengula,” kusho uNkk Buthelezi othe kodwa indlela azikhukhumeze ngayo ngaphathi enkantolo umsolwa, yenza bazibuze ukuthi ngabe ubeqala yini ukudlwengula? "Akazisoli nhlobo, uyambona yikho-ke silana, sizothi akabhadle (ejele),” kusho uNkk Buthelezi othe basazoqhubeka nokuletha amanye amacala afanayo enkantolo ngoba bayezwa ukuthi maningi kule ndawo.Umdidiyeli we-EFF kwiNorth Central Subregion, uMnuz Mandla Ngubane, unxuse amalungu eqembu ukuthi angaziphenduli iziwombe zokuchukuluzwa kwawo kanjalo nomndeni kamgilwa ngaphakathi enkantolo."Balindeni beze ngaphandle, bese uyangenelela-ke. Sizobabekezelela ngaphakathi kodwa uma sifika ngaphandle, umlilo sizowulwa ngomlilo,” kusho uNgubane. Ngaphakathi enkantolo umsolwa utshele ummeli wakhe ukuthi ngeke esasifaka isicelo sebheyili.UMbuso uveze ukuthi usadinga isikhathi sokuthi uqhubeke nolunye uphenyo, olufaka phakathi ukuthathwa kwezinye izitatimende ezibalulekile kuleli cala kanjalo nemiphumela yolibofuzo.Imantshi ibe isilihlehlisela uJuni 3 ucala, ukuze kuqhutshekwe nophenyo.Amalungu e-EFF avele ayigcwalisa phamba inkantolo, abelokhu eziphakamise njalo izingqwebe ebezidlulisa umyalezo wokuthi umsolwa akadingeki emphakathini.Unina kamsolwa nabafowabo nabo bebekhona enkantolo. Kuthiwa uzame ukuchukuluza elinye ilungu le-EFF ngesikhathi sekuphunywa, emva kokuhlala kwecala.
AMAZINYANE aKwaKhangelamankengane aseyale iSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini ukuba siqoqe ulimi lwaso uma sikhuluma nabantu besifazane. Afunge ngokuthi azovikela udadewabo owathukwa yiSilo enkulumweni eqoshiwe. Lokhu akusho enkulumweni ebhalwe phansi ayithumele kwabezindaba. Le nkulumo ayithumele emva kokusabalala kwenkulumo eqoshiwe, lapho kuzwakala khona iMbube ishiya engalazi kudadewabo, uMntwana uNomkhosi kaZwelithini. Kule nkulumo eyasabalala ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, iMbube izwakala ikhipha uMntwana uNomkhosi ngaphansi kwezidwaba zeNdlovukazi ebazalayo, uShiyiwe Mantfombi Dlamini Zulu, ongasekho. AbaNtwana baKwaKhangela bathe lena akusiyo indlela abakhuliswa ngayo. "Abazali bethu bakhombisa ubumqoka benhlonipho nobunye emndenini. Indlela esikhuluma ngayo, umoya kanye nolimi esilusebenzisayo kumele kube yisibonelo esizweni. ISilo uMisuzulu kaZwelithini, Mntwana uNtandoyesizwe, Mntwana uNomkhosi, Mntwana uBukhosibemvelo, Mntwana uBambindlovu, Mntwana uLungelo, Mntwana uMandlesizwe kanye noMntwana uSimengaye, sonke savundla esibelethweni sinye sendlovukazi ehloniphekile, okumele sivikele ifagugu layo futhi singaliphathi ngeze igama layo."Abantwana bathe bazomvikela udadewabo noma ngabe uhlaselwa ngubani ikakhulukazi njengoba sidla lubi isihlava sokuhlaselwa kwabesifazane kuleli zwe."Njengalokho silwela ukuvikela igama leNdlovukazi noMdlokombane, siqhakambise amagugu kanye nobuntu, sifisa ukukuveza ukuthi ngeke sangabaza ukuvikela udadewethu nanoma yimuphi umuntu wesifazane ekuhlukunyezweni yinoma imuphi umuntu wesilisa, kungakhathalekile ukuthi unasikhundla sini emphakathini. Silapha ngenhloso yokuzoqinisa, sikhuthaze abesifazane ukuba baqhubeke nokubambana ngezandla balwe nalolu bhubhane lodlame lwangokobulili."Abantwana bathe uma iMbube ihluleka ukuziqoqa kuningi okuzokonakala eNdlunkulu kaZulu, baxwayisa nangokuthi iyongena emlandweni omubi."Ukuqubuka kokwehlukana endlunkulu kusuke kungaqondene nje nalabo abathintekayo kodwa kusuke kuphazamisa nesisekelo sobukhosi. ISilo uShaka kaSenzangakhona asizange sisebenzise impi yobugovu nokwenza izinto budlabha ukwakha lesi sizwe esinamandla kangaka."Uma kungagcinwangwa ukuthula, kuba nemiphumela engemihle, kungesikhona emndenini kuphela kepha nasesizweni sonkana. Umbuso kumele ube insika yamandla, ungabi yinkundla yokuveza ukuzigqaja kwabathile. Abazokhohlwa yileli qiniso ngeke bakhunjulwa ngokuthi babe ngabaholi, kepha bayokhunjulwa ngokuthi yibona abaqumbe phasi umbuso."
BAHLELI lubhojozi othishanhloko bezikole eziziphathela imali KwaZulu-Natal, asebehlaselwa ezindlini osonkontileka abangakhokhelwe nguMnyango wezeMfundo esifundazweni ngenxa yokungafakwa kwemali yama-norms and standards.Le mali yokukhokhela ugesi, amanzi, ukuthenga izincwadi no-inki ephinde yenze nezinye izinto, yagcina ukufakwa kwezinye izikole ngoJuni nyakenye.Njengoba kuvulwa izikole emuva kwamaholidi ekota yokuqala yonyaka, luyaqhubeka usizi kulezi zikole njengoba othishanhloko beqhubeka nokusebenzisa imali yabo.Omunye wothishanhloko wesikole esiseMpangeni, ocele ukungavezwa, uthe ukweletwa ngumnyango imali engaphezu kwesigidi, okubalwa nemali yokuthenga izincwadi ebalelwa ku-R400 000 neyokukhokhela ugesi namanzi.Le mali ize ifinyelele kulesi samba ngenxa yokuthi umnyango uxhasa umfundi ngamunye ngemali eyevile ku-R900 ngenyanga, ikakhulu ezikoleni okungakhokhwa kuzona imali yokufunda.Lo thishanhloko uthe sekufana nesiko ukuthi njalo uma ehola, ukhipha nemali kagesi wesikole ephaketheni lakhe ukuze kukhanye."Basifikela emakhaya osonkontileka abasenzela umusa bathenga izincwadi baziletha, okumanje abakakhokhelwa. Asazi ukuthi kumele sithatheni sihlanganise nani ngoba umnyango awuyifaki nhlobo imali, futhi akushiwo nokuthi ingase ingene nini. Umnyango wagcina ukufaka imali yama-norms ngoJuni nyakenye. Kuyabheda." Uthe kudingeka bandandanise uma kuphele no-inki, bawuthenge ukuze izingane ziqhubeke zifunde."Ukube asikuthandi ukufundisa ngabe sesashiya phansi, ayikho le nto. Ukhipha nemali kagesi ephaketheni lakho ngoba kumele kukhanyile esikoleni. Kahle hle sondla uhulumeni," kusho lo thishanhloko.Inyunyana yothisha iSadtu yalulwa udaba lwale mali, yaze yavalela izikhulu zomnyango.UNobhala weSadtu eKZN uNksz Nomarashiya Caluza, uthe bathwele kanzima othishanhloko kulesi sifundazwe.Uthe umnyango ubatshela ukuthi usuzikhokhele izikole eziningi, sekusele ingcosana. "Izimfuno zethu zimile, sifuna kushaye uMeyi zibe sezikhokhelwe zonke izikole u-60% wemali yazo yango-2025. Sifuna ngekota yesithathu zikhokhelwe ingxenye engu-40% ezobe isele," usho kanje.Uthe okwamanje balwa nokuthi umnyango ukhokhe imali yangonyaka odlule, oyikweleta izikole."Okusikhathazayo ngukuthi othishanhloko bakhala ngokuthi abakhokhelwe osonkontileka abathenga bahambisa izincwadi ezikoleni ekubeni umnyango wawuthembisile. Umnyango wabhala incwadi ngoJanuwari, wathembisa ukuthi uzobakhokhela ezinsukwini ezingu-30," usho kanje.Uthe lokhu kuyabakhathaza othishanhloko ngoba bafakwa ingcindezi osonkontileka abafuna ukukhokhelwa imali yabo.Okhulumela owezeMfundo, uMnuz Muzi Mahlambi, uthe udaba lwale mali yinto abahlale bephezu kwayo ngaso sonke isikhathi bengumnyango.UMphathiswa wowezeMfundo uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka, nenhloko yomnyango uMnuz Nathi Ngcobo, bahlale bekhala emakomitini asesiShayamthetho ngezinselelo ababhekene nazo ngokwesabelomali, okubenza bangakwazi ukukhokha ngesikhathi esifanele.UHlomuka wayithinta neyokuthi uyezwa ukuthi abanye othishanhloko bagcina sebesebenzisa imali yabo ngenxa yokuthi iyaphuza ukungena imali ezikoleni.
UBUKEKA usekude ukuphela umdonsiswano nokubhekana ngeziqu zamehlo phakathi kwe-ANC ne-DA, njengoba i-DA ishaya phansi ngonyawo ithi ngeke yehlele ngezansi ekuchitheni ukunyuswa kweVAT nakuba i-ANC isivule izandla yathi izoba nezingxoxo namaqembu ahlukene kubalwa nayo i-DA ngolwale ntela.Lokhu kulandela ukuthi uNobhala Jikelele we-ANC uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, eveze ukuthi ikomiti elibhekele ukusebenza kwansuku zonke kwi-ANC, linqume ukuthi kuvulwe izingxoxo namaqembu ayingxenye nangeyona ingxenye yeGNU, okubalwa ne-DA ngodaba lokuphasiswa kwezinye izigaba zesabelomali.UMbalula uthe bazinike izinsuku ezinhlanu ukwenza lo msebenzi wokunxenxa amaqembu ukuthi abeseke ekuphasiseni izingxenye ezisele.Uthe noma i-DA ingaphuma kwi-GNU, ngeke iguqe noma kuphele ngeGNU."Okwamanje sigxile ekutheni sixoxe namanye amaqembu ukuze kuphasiswe ezinye izingxenye zesabelomali. Kulele kwi-DA ukuthi itshele abantu bakuleli ukuthi ihlaleleni kwiGNU ngoba ayisesekanga isabelomali. Ifana nabantu abazikhiphe bona kwiGNU, kodwa i-ANC ayizokhulumela noma inqumele i-DA ngokumele ikwenze mayelana nekusasa layo kuhulumeni," kusho uMbalula ekhuluma nabezindaba izolo eLuthuli House, eGoli emuva komhlangano wobuholi obuphezulu wabaholi bale nhlangano kanjalo nowekomiti elibhekele ukusebenza kwansuku zonke.UMbalula uthe imithetho efana nowezikole okunemvunge ngawo, iBela, owokuthathwa komhlaba ngaphandle kwesinxephezelo kanjalo neminye ayiyi ndawo.Ngakolunye uhlangothi umholi we-DA, uMnuz John Steenhuisen, uthe bazimisele ukubuyela ezingxoxweni ne-ANC, kodwa abajiki ekuchitheni ukunyuswa kweVAT ngo-0.5%."Ngeke sishintshe umqondo mayelana nokuchitha ukunyuswa kweVAT kuleli ngoba sisamile isizathu esenza saba yingxenye yeGNU, okuwukukhulisa umnotho nokwakha amathuba emisebenzi. Abavoti bakubeka kwacaca ukuthi alikho iqembu elilodwa okumele linqume ukuthi izwe liya ngakuphi," usho kanje. I-DA yaya enkantolo enkulu eWestern Cape, ifuna kumiswe ukunyuswa kweVAT kusuka ngenyanga ezayo.UMbalula uthe bayazi ukuthi abawinanga ngamalengiso okhethweni, abadingi ukukhunjuzwa ngalokhu."Uma inkantolo ichitha uhulumeni odabeni lweVAT, kuzofakwa isicelo sokuthi sibuyekezwe leso sinqumo. Siyazi amaqembu amaningi kuhulumeni, amanye angekho ngisho kuhulumeni kubalwa neCosatu, SACP kanjalo nabanye kwi-ANC abahambisani nokunyuswa kweVAT. Ingakho okwamanje sifuna ukuxoxa le ndaba yeVAT," kusho uMbalula.Mayelana nokuthi basayincengelani i-DA ukuthi ibe yingxenye ye-GNU ekubeni ingavotanga ukweseka isabelomali, uMbalula uthe abayincengile njengoba kukhona abathi ayihambe."Baningi abathi ayihambe ngaphakathi kwi-ANC. Hhayi ngoba simi ngayo kwiGNU, njengoba ngishilo ukuthi ingahamba, ngeke iphushwe yi-ANC."Uthe abakwenzayo bakwenzela abantu bakuleli, ngoba abafuni izwe liwe bhu."Njengasodabeni lwaseMelika, sizoya koxoxa indaba yezohwebo ngoba siyayidinga iMelika. Ngeke sithi asiyidingi ngoba sinobuzwe bakuleli kuphela, sidinga izwe liphile."
KUPHELILE ukunethwa yimvula kubagibeli baserenki yaseBallito, KwaDukuza, ngesikhathi uMasipala waKwaDukuza wethula ngokusemthethweni irenki yeqophelo eliphezulu futhi enompheme.Abagibeli bakule ndawo abajwayele ukusebenzisa irenki bathi ncinci kamjoli njengoba bekholwa ukuthi seluphelile usizi ebebezithola bebhekene nalo uma beze kuyona ngaphambilini.Omunye wabagibeli ebebesebenzisa irenki, uNkk Ntombizodwa Msimangi, uveze ukuthi imvula ibiphelela kubona kuze kumate ngisho impuphu."Bekuwusizi lodwa ukuma kule renki, imvula ibike isinethe ngale ndlela yokuthi besizwa kahle ukuthi akekho umuntu osinakile. Kodwa namhlanje siyajabula kakhulu uma kwethulwa irenki yalolu hlobo,'' usho kanjena.UMnuz Zakhele Nxumalo uthe isimo besingesihle kakhulu erenki, wathi ilanga belibashisa kakhulu ikakhulukazi uma kusehlobo."Ngikutshela ukuthi ilanga beliphelela kithina ingekho nento esingayenza,'' kusho uNxumalo.Uthe abantu abadala yibona ebebezithola bebhekene nesimo esinzima kakhulu uma beze erenki. Uthe ngathi kuyiphupho uma bebona sekunerenki enompheme futhi esemgangathweni.IMeya yakule ndawo, uMnuz Ali Ngidi, ikuqinisekisile nayo ukuthi abagibeli bakule ndawo ebebesebenzisa le renki bebethwala kanzima kakhulu ngaphambilini.Uthe imvula nelanga bekuphelela kubona, wakhala ngokuthi kubagibeli bekumata ngisho impahla abayithengile esitolo. Ngenxa yalesi simo nezinselelo ebezibonakala kule renki yingakho bebhukulile babona ukuthi mabakhe irenki esemgangathweni futhi engeke ize ibahlukumeze abagibeli.Uthe lokhu bakwenze ngoba bayabazisa futhi bayabahlonipha kakhulu abagibeli bewumasipala waKwaDukuza."Imboni yamatekisi siyayihlonipha kakhulu kanjalo nabagibeli siyabazisa yingakho senza konke okusemandleni ethu ukulungisa okungahambi kahle,'' usho kanjena.Usihlalo weDolphins Association, uMnuz Nhlanhla Lephelo, uthe bayabonga kakhulu ngomsebenzi awuchaze njengomkhulu athe wenziwe uMasipala waKwaDukuza."Baqinisile uma bethi isimo salapha besingesihle. Abagibeli bethu bebebekezela nje kodwa bekungalungile nje nhlobo. Kodwa namhlanje siyajabula uma kufezeka iphupho lethu lokuthi sibe nerenki esemgangathweni,'' usho kanjena.

"Uzicelela ukuthi angayiswa eNcome ngoba ebona engaphephile, kulo mlisa omshayelile,” kusho isihlobo, esithe, uveze ukuthi angaya nakunoma yiliphi ijele, inqobo nje uma kungekhona eNcome.Inkantolo ibe isimcacisela ukuthi amathizethize ahambisana nokuthi uzosidonsela kuphi isigwebo sakhe, ngaphansi kwamiphi imibandela, wudaba okufanele aluxoxe naboMnyango wokuHlunyeleliswa kweziMilo, hhayi nenkantolo.Siqhube sathi kubuye kwahlaluka nokuthi unesifo senhliziyo, afisa ukuthi acatshangelwe ngenxa yalobu buthakathaka.Sizwakalisa abakuzwayo njengomndeni, sithe akukho ebangakusho ngoba nazo iziboshwa zinamalungelo."Noma kubuhlungu, kodwa sizolinda ukufika kwesiphetho. Asiliqondi leli lungelo lakhe alifunayo, kodwa asifisi ukuthi bese ephathwa ngezandla ezintofontofo, ekubeni abulala isihlobo sethu,” kusho isihlobo esithe bafuna aphathwe njengezinye iziboshwa futhi agwetshwe ngesigwebo esinikwa abasuke bebulale abantu.Ngesikhathi umufi ehlaselwa, kuthiwa kwakunomcimbi kwaMlaba, nokwathi umufi nabanye bemile esangweni, belinde ukuvulelwa, uMlaba, wavele wavulela ngenhlamvu, kwalimala umufi owagcina eshonela esibhedlela. UKUKHIQIZA izimoto ezinobuchwepheshe besimanjemanje kwenza isikhondlakhondla senkampani iFord - ebigubha iminyaka eyikhulu nyakenye yakha izimoto zikanokusho eNingizimu Afrika - silibuke ngeso elihle ikusasa.ITow Like A Pro with the Ford Ranger ebiseGerotek, ePitoli, ingwe idle ngamabala ngesikhathi lesi sikhondlakhondla sidweba isithombe sokuthi siyibeke phambili impilo yamakhasimende ayo ekutheni ahlale ephephile.Ebantwini abadla izambane likapondo nabasaphupha ngokuthenga iFord Ranger Raptor neFord Ranger Platinum kufanele bazi ukuthi ngeke kubelula ukuthi bahlangabezane nezingozi ezibhuqabhuqa abantu abadonsa izinqola noma ama-caravan emigwaqweni eyakhele iNingizimu Afrika.Okwenza abakwaFord bazishaye isifuba futhi bangalibuki luvindi ikusasa lalezi zimoto izokwenza ufise ukuthi ungene kuN3 uyoyibeka eThekwini, ungezwa ukuthi ubushayela imoto engesiyona iSUV, ngenxa yokuthi izimoto zifakwe ubuchwepheshe beqophelo lesimanje obugxile ekuphephiseni impilo yomshayeli nezabanye abasebenzisa umgwaqo.Okwenza zibe kwelinye iqophelo izimoto, ukuthi uma udilike iku-Drive, izifaka yona kuPark. Ngaphambi kokuba uthathe uhambo iyakuvezela kwi-dashboard uma ungayibophelanga inqola.Zinesitering esincane sokuqondisa imoto nenqola uma upaka. Akudingeki usebenzise isitering esikhulu ngoba lokho ziyakwenzela. Okwenzayo ngesikhathi uhlehla kuvela kwikhamera ecace bha, awufuniseli.Okunye ezidlisa ngakho lezi zingqovungqovu wukuthi uma inqola ithwele sivela ngokushesha isexwayiso kwi-screen ngaphambili ukuthi yehlisa ijubane ngoba izwa ukuthi ayibambelele kahle emgwaqweni okungadalwa yizizathu ezahlukene njengomoya nokunye.Ngaphandle kwesixwayiso izehlisela ngokwayo ijubane ukugwema ingozi.Akugcini lapho, uphinde ubone ukudansa kwenqola nokuyinto engaholela ekutheni imoto iphaphalaze.Uma uzosika enye imoto iyakukhalima, ithimule esibukweni sangakwesokunxele ukuthi akukabi isikhathi esifanele sokuthi usike. Okunye okuhle ngalezi zimoto wukuthi zinekhamera ekundlala obala okwenzeka emgwaqweni okukuphephisa ekutheni ungene engozini.Okunye okukhulunywe ngakho futhi kwaxwayiswa ngakho wukuthwala umthwalo ongaphezu kwesisindo semoto okuvele ukuthi kunomthelela ekuthuntubezeni amabhreki.Kuvezwe nokuthi kwenza kube nengcindezi emathayini agcine ngokuthi adabuke kugcine sekuvalwa imizi ngobudedengu bokungalandeli indlela eyiyo egxile ku-Asiphephe.Kuphinde kwaxwayiswa abashayeli ukuthi bangamane badonse izinqola bengenawo amalayisensi anemba ngqo ngoba lokho kuphambene nomthetho futhi kungaholelaekutheni kugcine kuba nenhlekelele yengozi.
UJABULELA ukuthola ubulungiswa umndeni wowesilisa waseNhlungwana, oLundi, inkantolo ilahla inkosi yale ndawo ngecala lokumbulala. Esehlakalweni esenzeka ngoMashi 2023, Inkosi Bongani Mlaba, yadubula uMnuz Phakamani Dubazane (31) ezindaweni ezibucayi. Owesilisa, owayedubuleke wanqotshwa ukufa emva kwezinsuku ezintathu engeniswe esibhedlela. Isihlobo esicele ukungadalulwa, sichaza ngokwenzeka, sithe kwakunomcimbi kwaMlaba, izintombi nezinsizwa zendawo ziphelele khona.Sithe umufi nezinye izinsizwa zakwabo babeme esangweni ngesikhathi kuqhamuka umfowabo wenkosi, wacela ukuba zithi ukulinda ngoba usayolanda ukhiye wokuzivulela isango."Esahambile, kwaphuma umbulali weza phandle wabasho ngenkulu inhlamba abakwethu. Wase edubula ebhekise ngakubo,” kusho isihlobo. Sithe kuleso sigigaba, kwadubuleka umufi esiswini nasezimbanjeni.Sithe wathi esuka uMlaba, weza esangweni, ezothi basuka emakubo, bazodubulana esangweni lakhe.Siveza ukuthi ngaleso sikhathi abakucela kuye ukuthi akhiphe imoto iphuthumise uDubazane esibhedlela njengoba esemdubulile.Sithe uMlaba waboshwa emva kokuvulwa kwecala kodwa inkantolo yabuye yamdedela ngebheyili, icala laqulwa engaphandle njengoba seligcine limgojele."Ukulahlwa kwakhe yicala kuyasijabulisa, yize noma kungeke kusambuyisa othandiweyo wethu. Esikufisayo ukuthi athole isigwebo esikhulu, esifanele isenzo sakhe esinonya,” kusho isihlobo.Sithe njengoba elahlwe yicala, akujabule bona bodwa, kodwa kujabule nomphakathi owakhele isizwe sakhe uMlaba."Umphakathi uthi uzoke uphumule indaba yenkosi edlala ngesibhamu uma iphuzile,” kusho isihlobo esithe isibhamu ubevele ayosiqhumisa emanxiweni akubo, njalo uma ebuya ecaleni.Uthe umphakathi ukhala ngokuthi uMlaba wathola isihlalo engavuthiwe emqondweni, kodwa wavunwa ukuzalwa embethe."Ubehlale ephuma engena ejele, kuthinteka izibhamu ezingekho emthethweni, isihlalo samfica evele ewusikhotheni owaqhubeka, ngisho esesesihlalweni,” kusho isihlobo, esithe babongwa wumphakathi ngokumphosela inselelo, bemvulela icala ngokudubula umufi.Isigwebo sikaMlaba, sizophuma eNkantolo yesiFunda yasoLundi namuhla.
SEZIPHILA ngokungawashayi amathoyilethi ziphinde zeqise izinsuku zingagezi iziboshwa ezivalelwe ejele laseNcome, eVryheid.Lokhu kuza emva kokuqhubeka kwenkinga yamanzi kuleli jele, okuvela ukuthi yaqala ngasekupheleni kukaFebhuwari, kufa i-pump yesiphehlimanzi sangaphakathi ejele. Isolezwe likhuluma nesiboshwa esicele ukuthi igama laso lingadalulwa, sithe akulona iqiniso okushiwo uMnyango wokuHlunyeleliswa kweziMilo, ukuthi inkinga yamanzi isixazululekile."Namanje amanzi awekho. Siphila ngokuthi siyowakha elolini lamanzi elifika njalo ekuseni. Inkinga kuba ukuthi amanzi eliwalethayo avele aphelele endleleni, ziningi iziboshwa,” kusho umthombo. Uqhube wathi uma esephelile amanzi elolini, alibe lisathunyelwa elinye, ukuze zonke iziboshwa zigcine ziwatholile amanzi.Uthe bagcina bephoqeleka ukuthi bayowakha edamini elingaphakathi ejele, bawasebenzise ewudaka enjalo."Inqwaba iphethwe yizisu ngenxa yalokhu, abanye sebeze baba notwayi,” kusho umthombo, othe lesi simo siyabakhathaza ngoba ezinye zezifo ziyathelelana.Udalule ukuthi kuvimbanise iphunga ezitokisini, njengoba sebevele bangawashayi amathoyilethi, bonga amanzi abawathola kanzima, ukuze bawaphuze. "Asisazixaki ngokugeza zonke izinsuku. Umuntu weqisa izinsuku ezimbili, ezintathu, engagezi kanti leso simo asifanele ngoba njengoba kukhona abaphethwa utwayi, futhi siminyene, kusibeka engcupheni yokuthi sigule,” usho kanje.Uveze nokuthi kwazitsha abadla ngazo, sebezisula ngama-toilet paper ngaphambi kokuthi bayophaka."Nayo siyisebenzisa ezintweni eziningi, iyinye isula izitsha eziningi ngoba uma singayimosha, sizoba nenkinga yokungasuli ngalutho uma sizikhulula,” kubalisa umthombo.Uthe okubaphatha kabi ukutshelwa izinto ezehlukene abaphathi bejele njengoba ethi abanye babatshela ukuthi isilungisiwe inkinga ye-pump, amanzi asezobuya maduze, abanye babatshela "iqiniso" lokuthi namanje isafile, futhi kusazothatha izinyanga ukuthi ilungiswe.Phambilini okhulumela umnyango, uMnuz Thulani Mdluli, wayethe ukuphampwa kwamanzi kwiziqukathi zejele kwama ngoMashi 5 ngenxa yokufa kwe-pump. Nokho wathi inkinga isilungisiwe, njengoba kufakwe i-pump entsha ngoMashi 25, 2025, ngaleyo ndlela ukusebenza kwamanzi sekubuyele esimeni esijwayelekile. Waveza ukuthi ngesikhathi kusenale nkinga, izikhulu beziqinisekisa ukuthi iziboshwa nojele bayalethelwa amanzi nsuku zonke. Wathi ayikho imibiko ngokugula kweziboshwa abayitholile nokuyinto ebibhekwa nsuku zonke.

UKHALE izinyembezi zenjabulo, ezihlangene nezosizi umndeni wakwaKhuzwayo, KwaMaqumbi, KwaMaphumulo, uthola isihlobo esantshontshwa sinezinsuku ezinhlanu sizelwe ngo-2000.UMnuz Mxolisi Khuzwayo (25) okhule azi ukuthi unguSimphiwe Sibanisezwe Buthelezi (27), uhlangane nomndeni wakhe wangempela maphakathi nenyanga edlule.Lokhu kwenzeke emva kokuthi omunye umndeni waKwaMaqumbi, nawo owalahlekelwa yisihlobo ngendlela ecishe ifane ngo-2006, unqwamane naye ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, efuna umndeni wakhe wangempela, athe uzwa kuthiwa usendaweni efanayo.UNksz Bonabenza Khuzwayo, owayeneminyaka engu-12 ngesikhathi owesifazane othile entshontsha uMxolisi ezandleni zakhe, uthe lo mndeni wasendaweni, iwona obaxhumanisile."Ngaqale ngaba nokungabaza njengoba iminyaka yayishayisana. UMxolisi eveza ukuthi ngokukamazisi wakhe, wazalwa ngo-1998. Thina umuntu esimfunayo wazalwa ngo-2000. Kusize ukuthi ngithi akathumele izithombe zakhe, nokuthe esezithumele, wavele wafana ncamashi nathi ekhaya,” kusho uNksz Khuzwayo. Elandisa ngesigameko uthe senzeka ngesikhathi yena nonina kaMxolisi, ongudadewabo omdala, uNksz Telma Khuzwayo beye KwaDukuza beyoshayela uMxolisi isitifiketi sokuzalwa.Uthe okwenza yena wakhapha udadewabo ukuthi wayesentekenteke, emva kokuteta futhi esanda kushaywa isifo sohlangothi."Mina ngangithunywe ukuthi ngimlekelele ngokuthi ngimphathele ingane. Kwathi uma sifika emahhovisi oMnyango wezaseKhaya, sakhonjwa esibhedlela saseStanger ukuyolanda incwadi ethile eyayizosetshenziswa uma sekwenziwa isicelo sesitifiketi,” kusho uNksz Khuzwayo.Uthe kwathi sebephuma esangweni lesibhedlela, bazithela kowesifazane owayekhulelwe, owavele wabanamathela, ekhombisa ukuba nobungani."Waxoxa eyokuthi naye usezolindela ukuteta, wathi unguMaZungu-Ndlovu, ebuza udadewethu ukuthi bekunjani ukuteta,” kusho uNksz Khuzwayo, othe owesifazane wahamba nabo ibanga bebheke emahhovisi oMnyango wezaseKhaya. Uthe kwathi uma befika khona, bathola ukuthi i-system isivele yangasebenza, bayalelwa ukuthi ababhale amagama abo phansi, bahambe, babuye emva kwamahora amathathu."Sakhetha ukuyolinda erenki yamabhasi, lapho umama wethu ayenetafula khona lokudayisa. Lona wesifazane wayelokhu ehamba nathi, futhi nathi singasoli lutho ngoba wayesitshele ukuthi uqhuba isikhathi sokuthi kushaye ihora abathe akabuye ngalo naye esibhedlela,” kusho uNksz Khuzwayo.Uthe kwathi sekuzophela amahora amathathu, udadewabo, wathi uzobe ehamba ngoba isifo sohlangothi senza angakwazi ukuhamba asheshe.Uthe owesifazane, wavalelisa, ethi uzohambisana naye udadewabo, bahlukane endleleni."Kuthe emva kwesikhathi, wabuya owesifazane esethi, udadewethu uthe akazomthathela ingane ngoba iyafuneka emahhovisi oMnyango wezaseKhaya, ukuze ithathwe izithupha. Nathi ngokungazi lutho, umama wathi angihambe naye, kodwa ingane iphathwe yimi,” kusho uNksz Khuzwayo. Uthe kwathi sebesendleleni, yakhala ubumayemaye ingane, owesifazane wamnika uR10, wathi akagijime angene ngaphakathi esitolo, athenge idamu ukuze ingane ithule."Ngaphuma engasabonwa. Ngathi ngihamba ngimpampa ngimcinga, ngazithela phezu kukamama nodadewethu, bengibuza ukuthi ingane ngiyishonisephi,” kusho uNksz Khuzwayo, othe iqiniso lokuthi akukho ngane eyayifuneka emnyangweni, lafika nodadewabo owayesebuyele kunina erenki, wafike wabuza ukuthi ingane yakhe iphi, kwathi uma unina emtshela okushiwo owesifazane ukuthi ingane ayilethwe ukuze izoshaya izithupha, wavele wathwala izandla ekhanda.Uthe yabhekwa yonke indawo ingane ngosizo lwamaphoyisa, kwavulwa necala kodwa lutho ukutholakala.Udalule ukuthi yena uMxolisi uze wathola ukuthi akasiye owakwaButhelezi ngo-2021, ngesikhathi owesilisa, ayezitshela ukuthi unguyise, elaxaza ngaphandle kokuveza okuthize owesifazane (uMaNdlovu Buthelezi) ayezitshela ukuthi ungunina."Wahamba wayohlala e-Escourt, lapho adabuka khona. UMxolisi wamlandela kodwa kwafike kwangahlaleka njengoba esezihlotsheni, okuyizo ezaqhumbuza ithumba lokuthi akayona ingane kaButhelezi,” kusho uNksz Khuzwayo.Uthe kwathi uma eseyilandela indaba wathola ukuthi uButhelezi ulaxaza "unina" nje usetholile ukuthi umgqokise ijazi njengoba yena wayengenayo inzalo.Uthe kwavela ukuthi uMaNdlovu wayenazo izingane ezine zangaphambi komshado, kodwa emshadweni yangaba bikho ayitholayo, kwaze kwaba wenza imizamo "yokukhulelwa mbumbulu, kwazalwa uSimphiwe".UNksz Khuzwayo uthe uMxolisi umkhombisile isithombe sikaMaNdlovu-Buthelezi, wambona engafani noMaNdlovu owamphuca ingane, nokwenza wasola ukuthi wathenga owesifazane othile ukuthi amenzele umsebenzi wokweba ingane.Uthe kuvele nokuthi uMaNdlovu-Buthelezi wahamba emzini wakhe oseMlaza ethi "unezinyanga eziyisithupha ekhulelwe", kwathi "esezele" waqhubeka nokuhlala kubo, ezama ukuvika ukuthi uButhelezi angasoli lutho.Uthe bobabili uButhelezi noMaNdlovu sebashona. NakwaKhuzwayo uTelma washona ngo-2014."Wayelokhu ehlushwa yisifo sohlangothi, wabuye wathikamezeka nasemqondweni, esikholwa ukuthi kwakudalwa ukuthi walahlekelwa yingane. Wayengemnandi kahle kimina ngengoba wayebuye athi ngadayisa ingane yakhe ngo-R10,” kusho uNksz Khuzwayo, othe bayafisa ukuthola usizo ezinhlakeni ezehlukene ezingabalekelela ukuthi imindeni ethintekayo ilungise lolu daba, kuphinde kulungiseke nokuthi uMxolisi abuyelwe igama lakhe langempela.Uveze ukuthi ukhule kahle uMxolisi kubazali bakhe mbumbulu, izinto ziqale ukushintsha ngesikhathi esethola ukuthi akazalwa yibo. Wathi impilo uyihlanganisa ngokubamba amatoho ePinetown.

Kumele iqashwe ngelokhozi i-DA ngoba iyingozi," usho kanje. Umhlaba kumele ngabe usukubantu, hhayi indaba yokuthi kusakhulunywa indaba yawo."Uthe kumele sizibuze ukuthi bakuphi abantu abangu-11 million, abangayivotelanga i-ANC."Abelungu bavotelana bodwa, baphuma ngobuningi babo futhi. Thina kumele sizibuze ukuthi baphi laba bantu abangaka abangasivotelanga,?" kusho uNxesi.
AKHATHAZEKILE amaKhomanisi ngokuqonga kwesihlava sokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane njengoba ikhale nangokuthi amacala okudlwengula kuleli, aphezulu uma kuqhathaniswa namanye amazwe.Le nhlangano ithe kushayisa amahloni ukungaphenywa ngendlela, ukuphathwa budedengu kwamacala okudlwengula kanjalo nokudedelwa kwabasuke behlukumeze abesifazane."Iyakhathaza eyokwanda kwesihlava sokubulawa kwabesifazane nezingane kuleli. Asihabimbisani nokunyuswa kwe-VAT kodwa futhi asiyifuni i-DA kwi-GNU," kusho uMapaila.I-DA iye enkantolo enkulu emva kokuphasiswa kwesabelomali, ifuna kumiswe ukunyuswa kwe-VAT ngo-0.5% kusuka ngenyanga ezayo.Uthe uhulumeni kumele athole ezinye izindlela zokuthola imali yokukhokhela izidingo kungaze kunyuswe i-VAT."Ukunyusa i-VAT kuzoshaya abahlwempu ngenxa yokuthi kumele bakhokhe intela ethe xaxa uma bethenga impahla. Lezi zingxoxo akuzona ezokusivimba ukuthi singalungeneli ukhetho lohulumeni basekhaya ngonyaka ozayo," kusho uMapaila, ekhuluma esithangamini ngemuva komhlangano wekomiti lale nhlangano eGoli izolo.Le nhlangano inxenxe amalungu ayo ukuthi azilungiselele ukuthi bayozimela okhethweni. Uthe bayayeseka eyomshwalense wezempilo kuleli i-NHI."Siyameseka uhulumeni ngokuthi aye enkantolo ayovikela indaba ye-NHI. Lo mshwalense wezempilo uzosiza abantu bakithi abadonsa kanzima," kusho i-SACP.I-SACP igxeke isenzo sikahulumeni sokumema uMengameli wase-Ukraine, uMnuz Volodymyr Zelenskyy, owakhacwa ngumengameli waseMelika uMnuz Donald Trump. Uphinde adansele isigingci samazwe ahambisana neMelika, kanti ukuza kwakhe kuleli kungasibeka endaweni embi kwezithinta impi," kusho i-SACP.

AYIZOXHAMAZELA noma ithathe ngelukuluku i-ANC uma isinquma ngekusasa le-DA kuhulumeni wokubambisana kwamaqembu ahlukene kuleli i-GNU ngoba ukutatazela kona izinto.Lokhu kushiwo nguMengameli we-ANC nezwe, uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa, ekhuluma nabezindaba emuva kokuhambela igatsha lakhe eSoweto, eGoli.Ubekhuluma ngomhlangano wale nhlangano okumele unqume ngekusasa le-DA kwi-GNU, kulandela ukuvotela kwaleli qembu ukungaseseki isabelomali ngeledlule, ePhalamende.URamaphosa uthe yisikhathi sokuthi bacubungule ubudlelwano namaqembu ahlukene akwi-GNU."Sinxusa abantu ukuthi basinike isikhathi ngoba sicubungula kabanzi ubudlelwano namaqembu akwi-GNU ngemuva kokuthi amanye awo achitha ukuvotela isabelomali. Asifuni ukuxhamazela noma sitatazele uma sesithatha isinqumo ngoba ukuxhamazela kuyazona izinto."Uthe yingakho isigameko sangeledlule sizothulwa ezithebeni zekomiti elibhekele ukusebenza kwansuku zonke kwe-ANC, bese luya esigungwini esiphezulu sale nhlangano."Sizoxoxa kabanzi bese kuba amalungu e-ANC azonquma ngokumele kwenziwe. Sizobe sesazisa umphakathi ngesizokwenza," kuchaza uRamaphosa.Uthe bakhona osomabhizinisi abababhalele benomholi we-DA, uMnuz John Steenhuisen, bezwakalisa ukukhathazeka bethi akumele kuphele ubudlelwano be-ANC ne-DA kwi-GNU."Ngifuna ukukubeka kucace ukuthi noma ngubani angasibhalela, azwakalise ukukhathazeka ezweni njengoba abamabhizinisi benzile. UMgcinimafa uzobe esethula umbiko ngokuthi kuzokwenzeka itholakale noma igcina ngokuthi ingatholakali le mali ukuze kunganyuswa i-VAT kusuka ngenyanga ezayo."Inkiyankiya yokunyusa i-VAT iyona esuse umsindo emaqenjini ahlukene ePhalamende okuyiwona abengayizwa, ethi awafuni inyuswe ngoba izoshaya abantu abahlwempu.URamaphosa uthe kubalulekile ukuthi abaholi be-ANC bahambele amagatsha abo, bathole ukuthi enzani."Njengoba simatasa nokwakha kabusha inhlangano, sinqume ukuya emagatsheni ethu senze nezinhlelo. Sizobika ngesikwenzayo emagatsheni ethu ukuze sisondele ebantwini sizwe nezinkinga zabo njengoba sibheke nasokhethweni," kusho uRamaphosa.

UMZWILILI emculweni we-opera odabuka eSikhawini, uSiphokazi "Nonzwakazi" Maphumulo, uthole ingqayizivele yethuba lokuyoqhakambisa amagalelo oMntwana uMagogo Buthelezi kwi-14th International Cultural Festival of Symphonic Music, eBoualem Nessaih Opera House of Algiers e-Algeria, ngo-Ephreli 17. Khonamanjalo: Mkhulu umsindo emva kokuthi uMfundisi Timothy Omotoso ephunyuke emacaleni awu-32 akade ebhekene nawo. Omunye womgilwa, uNksz Cheryl Zondi, ubekhihla isililo emva kwesinqumo ethi okumhlupha kakhulu ngalesi sinqumo ukuthi njengoba engeke agwetshe baningi abantu besifazane abangazithola esimweni sakhe.
IZINGCITHABUCHOPHO ezicwaninga ngezifo ezahlukene ngokubambisana nesikhungo sezemfundo ephakeme iNyuvesi yaKwaZulu-Natal, sezidalule ukuthi uma konke kuqhubeka ngendlela ezihlela nezenza izinto ngayo - kuzogcina kuhleleke yonke into ngokunqotshwa kwegciwane lesandulela-ngculazi nengculazi uqobo.Lokho kuhlaluke esigcawini sokucobelana ngolwazi lwalesi sifo ebesise-Unite Conference Centre, khona e-UKZN ophikweni iHoward College eThekwini, izolo, lapho obekuhlangane osolwazi nabacwaningi balesi sifo ukuzohlalukisa futhi kulandiswe umphakathi nezitshudeni ngohambo oseluhanjiwe lwemizamo yokuqhamuka nekhambi lokuqeda ngengculazi.Omunye wosolwazi abayingxenye yabacwaninga ngekhambi lokuqeda ngengculazi, okubhekwe ukuthi kube sekwenzekile ngo-2030, uSolwazi Krista Dong, uthe lolu hlelo ababimbesene ne-UKZN kulona baluqala eminyakeni ewu-13 edlule esigcemeni sakwa-V, eMlaza, lapho okwahlanganwa kwabhungwa khona ngokuthi yiziphi izinto okumele zenziwe ukuqhamuka nesixazululo salolu bhubhane ezweni."Saqala lapho umbhidlango wokuhlola abantu besifazane abawu-20 esaqala ngabo, okwase kunesikhathi besebenzisa imishanguzo yokuthiba igciwane, ngoba sathola ukuthi ukuze la masampula ekhambi esasizowasebenzisa asebenze, kwakudingeka ukuthi siwahlole kubantu abaphilile nabazoba namasosha omzimba azokwazi ukumelana nengcindezi eza nalawo masampula ekhambi uma sesiqala ukubahlola ngayo,” kusho uSolwazi Dong.Eqhuba, uthe ngabe sebekude kakhulu manje ukube abaphazanyiswanga wukubhoka kweCovid-19 ngo-2020, okwabanqinda ukukwazi ukuhambela ebantwini, kwase futhi kwaba nenkinga yezibhelu zokuzitapela impahla ngo-2021, okwabathikameza kakhulu ngokuthi kwacekeleka phansi isikhungo sezempilo ababesakhele ukwenza lo msebenzi eThekwini.Uthe: "Nokho asiphelanga moya, kunalokho siyaqhubeka nokuzikhandla ngomsebenzi wethu ngoba siyazi ukuthi yini esiphokophelele kuyona. Okunye esikwenzayo ocwaningweni lwethu wukusebenzisa esikubiza nge-analytic treatment condition, okusho ukuthi laba bantu esihlola ngabo leli khambi, kudingeka ukuthi sibayekise imishanguzo okungenani inyanga yonke kuya kwezimbili ukuze sikwazi ukubona ukuthi esikwenzayo kuyasebenza yini.” Usomaqhuzu walolu hlelo, uSolwazi Thumbi Ndung’u, yena uthe okunye okudingeke ukuthi bakwenze kulolu hlelo lwabo wukuhlola imikhiqizo emithathu ababheke ngayo ukuthi iyakwazi yini ukulwa nalesi sifo.Uthe okwenze ukuthi baqale lolu cwaningo labo kubantu besifazane wukuthi ocwaningweni lwabo lwansuku zonke kuhlale kuhlaluka ukuthi yibona abahaqwe kakhulu yigciwane lesandulela ngculazi nengculazi uqobo."Nokho kuyasithokozisa ukuthi balinganiselwa kwabayisikhombisa abantu osekuvele ukuthi sebelashelwe leli gciwane laphela emzimbeni wabo emhlabeni jikelele, ingxenye yabo engeyaseMelika. Lokho kusiphosela inselelo yokuqhubeka nomsebenzi omuhle esiwenzayo ukuze sikwazi ukuhamba ezinyathelweni zabo ngalo msebenzi. Sikholwa wukuthi uma sibambisene kanjengoba kwenzekile, sizokwazi ukunqoba lesi sifo eNingizimu Afrika nasezwenikazi i-Afrika yonkana kusuka manje kuyiwa phambili,” kusho uSolwazi Ndung’u. UNkk Deli Mthimkhulu, naye okhona kuleli thimba elenza lolu cwaningo, uqinisekise ukuthi kukho konke abakwenzayo bayaqikelela ukuthi umphakathi uba yingxenye ngokugcwele, futhi bayaqikelela ukuthi ukuqonda ngokuphelele okuzokwenziwa kuwona ikakhulu kulabo besifazane okusetshenziswana nabo ukulwa nalesi sifo.Abanye abebekhona kulo mbuthwano yiSekela likaShansela wophiko lwezempilo e-UKZN uSolwazi Busisiwe Ncama, Dkt Fikile Ndlovu noNksz Colisile Mathonsi behhovisi likaNdunankulu wesifundazwe, Dkt Refilwe Molatlhegi ofundisa khona e-UKZN, Mnuz Patrick Mdletshe weCivil Society Forum, Solwazi Michelle Gordon, Solwazi Musa Mabandla, Nkk Zikhona Nyathi noMnuz Sibusiso Mngadi we-AIDS Healthcare Foundation.
SIBEKWE icala lokubulala isihlobo senkosi yaKwaXimba, eMkhambathini, uMnuz Zibuse Mlaba, owadutshulwa wabulawa ngo-Okthoba 21,2021, enxanxatheleni yezitolo, iWareings ngaphandle kwehhovisi lakhe.UMnuz Duncan Patrick Mzamo Mlaba (63) uzinikele yena emaphoyiseni ngoLwesine ekuseni, mayelana necala lokubulawa kwenkosi uZibuse. Ukuzinikela kukaMzamo emaphoyiseni kuza emva kokugonyuluka kukaFortune Dlamini (29) waseGeorgedale, eHammarsdale, omchakidile watshela inkantolo ukuthi uMzamo uyena ungqondongqondo wetulo lokusocongwa kukaZibuse. UMbuso enkantolo izolo, uveze ukuthi amaphoyisa ophiko olubhekelele ukubulawa kwamakhosi anikele emzini kaMzamo angamfica, aphinda aya kwenye indawo nakhona afica kukhala ibhungezi, abe esethola ucingo obeluvela kummeli wakhe, uArvina Arjoon, ebeliwazisa ukuthi uMzamo usezinikelile emaphoyiseni. Imantshi yeNkantolo yesiFunda eCamperdown ikuqinisekisile ukuthi uMzamo ubekwe icala elibucayi lokubulawa kukamzala wakhe uZibuse. Imantshi ithe uMzamo ubekwe icala lesibili lokuphazamisa ukusebenza komthetho njengoba athenga izibhamu okwasocongwa ngazo uZibuse. Ngesikhathi iqinisekisa lokhu imantshi, abomndeni wakwaMlaba ebehlezi kubonakala nje ukuthi banomunyu.Omunye wodadewabo bakaZibuse, uNkk Nomadlozi Mlaba, ukhihle isililo waphuma enkantolo. Eqala egonyuluka phambi kwenkantolo, uDlamini udalule ukuthi babethunywe uMzamo ukuthi kubulawe umzala wakhe.Uveze ukuthi uMzamo wabakhokhela u-R130 000 ngokwenza umsebenzi. Uveze ukuthi waqala ukujwayelana noMzamo ngo-2019, ngesikhathi eqashe indlu eseceleni komuzi wakwaMlaba. Kuleli cala uDlamini wakhalelwa ngamaSongo kaSigonyela nasolwa nabo okungoMnuz Mthobisi Tsebang Dubazana (30) waseMlaza noMnuz Nhlanhla Lungelo Hlongwa (30) waseMasukwana.UDlamini ubekade egeqa amagula evuma icala ngomlomo wommeli wakhe, uMfuneko Jili, enkantolo yesiFunda eCamperdown. Uthe emhlanganweni owawubanjelwe emzini wesihlobo sikaMlaba, uDlamini, uHlongwa, uGwala noKhanyisani Dlamini batshelwa yilesi sihlobo ukuthi simdinga efile uZibuse, kwavunyelwana ngokuthi bazokhokhelwa u-R130 000.''Ngabe sengiqala ngibheka izithombe zikaZibuse ku-google, nebala owomndeni waqinisekisa ukuthi uyena,'' echaza. Uthe ngesikhathi bengamtholi uZibuse, lesi sihlobo sanikeza uDlamini imali yokuba abekise indawo yokulala eMgungundlovu.Amagumbi amabili kuthiwa abekiswa nguDlamini endaweni i-Alexis Guest House wase ekhokha u-R5 500 ngobusuku bubodwa. Ukuhlala kwabo kule ndawo kwaqhubeka njengoba babengamtholi uZibuse.UDlamini uthe wabathumelela u-R1 500 ngo-cash send, nangosuku lwesithathu wabathumelela u-R2 000 njengoba babengamtholi uZibuse. Eqhuba, uDlamini uthe wahlangana noGwala eGateway, wamnikeza u-R120 000.Uthe ngemuva kokuba esesocongiwe uZibuse, owomndeni waphakamisa ukuthi ufuna ukuzithenga izibhamu ezibulale umufi ngo-R10 000 sisodwa."Ngampela uGwala benoKhanyisani banikezwa leyo mali kwase kuthathwa izibhamu zabo,'' kuchaza uDlamini. Ngosuku lwesine lwango-Okthoba 21, 2021, uGwala watshela uDlamini ukuthi usemtholile uZibuse.Uthe ngemuva kokuboshwa kukaGwala ngokutholakala nesibhamu esingekho emthethweni, wathola ukuthi endaweni yesigameko amaphoyisa aqoqa ubufakazi beDNA."Ngemuva kwalokho, owomndeni loyo wathi mangithole inkabi ezobulala uGwala,'' kusho uDlamini.Izolo, omele uMbuso, u-Advocate Sanele Ntombela, uthe ngeke bakwazi ukuqhubeka ngoba abanalo ikheli likaMzamo.UNomadlozi uthe kubuhlungu kuyaqaqamba ngokufa kukamfowabo."Kubuhlungu ngokubulawa kukabhuti wami owalala. Kunzima ukubona imindeni ezalanayo ibhekene ngeziqu zamehlo,'' usho kanjena. Isicelo sebheyili kuvunyelwane ngokuthi senziwe ngo-Ephreli 14.
IGCABHA isele nobukhosi bakwaMakhanya eMbumbulu, ukuba bukhalime umlisa ogxibha iSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, uMnuz Max Makhanya.AbaNtwana baseNdlunkulu, amakhosi nabadidiyeli bamabutho baphonsele inselelo ubukhosi bakwaMakhanya ukuba busukumele udaba lukaMax, ojwayele ukushiya angalazi eSilweni. Lokhu bakusho ngesikhathi benesithangami nabezindaba, eThekwini, izolo.Sekunesikhathi eside uMax, othi ungowasebukhosini bakwaMakhanya, uyaye ethi "singoMakhanya" uma esegxibha iSilo.Abantwana, amakhosi nezinduna, bafune ukwazi ukuthi kungani ubukhosi bakwaMakhanya bengakaze busho lutho ngodaba lukaMax?Bakhale nokungabi bikho kweNkosi yakwaMakhanya, uKhethukuthula kaBhekizitha, emhlanganweni wayizolo.Emhlanganweni bekukhona undunankulu wesizwe sakwaMakhanya, uMnuz Mbongeni Makhanya.UMbongeni uthe inkosi imyale ukuba angaphawuli ngalolu daba kwabezindaba, abezindaba bayalelwe ukuba baphume emhlanganweni ngesikhathi sekukhuluma yena.INkosi uThembinkosi Gadla Xulu ithe ibifisa ukuthi inkosi yakwaMakhanya izifikele mathupha emhlanganweni wayizolo."Ngiyafisa ukuzwa uvo lwenkosi yakwaMakhanya ngalolu daba."Unobhala weziNduna zamaButho esifundeni iZululand, uMnuz Muzi Nyandeni, uthe kufanele engabe isizwe sakwaMakhanya sesiyile eSilweni, sayosho ukuthi asihambisani nokwenziwa uMax."Akukho ukuthi mhlawumbe oMakhanya bebemthumile kodwa isintu sithi, uma izinkomo zakwaNgubane zidle umbila wakwaBiyela, uNgubane uyaye ahambe ayombabazela uBiyela. Ingakho ngithi kufanele engabe isizwe sakwaMakhanya sesisukumile, sayokuthi Hlanga Lomhlabathi, siyazihlukanisa nale ngane."UNyandeni uthe ukuthula kobukhosi bakwaMakhanya kwenza ukuthi abantu bacabange ukuthi buyahambisana nokwenziwa uMax."Ize ikhulume ithi 'singoMakhanya', kodwa abakwaMakhanya bathule. Ngabe uyena okhulumela abakwaMakhanya? Uma kungenjalo, bathule bathini abakwaMakhanya? Ngiyafisa ukuthi bayisukumele le ndaba kungaze kuxoveke isizwe."Umdidiyeli wamabutho kaZulu, uMnuz Sipho "Masefa" Mhlongo, uthe uyafisa ukuthi abakwaMakhanya bamlethe uMax ukuba azochaza kabanzi ngezinto ahlezi ezisho ezinkundleni zokuxhumana."Iyihlazo le nto yokuthi umfana adunge amanzi nje, bese kuba sengathi thina singabantu abanodlame. Umbuzo osalayo ukuthi isizwe sakwaMakhanya sona sithule sithini?"UMhlongo uthe kusobala ukuthi uMax uthunywa abathile ukuba athuke iSilo.UMengameli wamaBhinca, uNgizwe Mchunu, uthe umsuka ukungaxazululeki kombango wesihlalo sobukhosi bukaZulu. "Uhlanya lugiya nembazo nje, ishiywe abasendlunkulu. Konakele endlunkulu, konakele esigodlweni."Abebehambele umhlangano bathe bayamdinga uMax ukuba azoziphendulela.
KUBUKEKA isekude ukuphela eyokukhishwa phambili emacaleni ehlukene kukaMfu Thimothy Omotoso (66) ongowaseNigeria ngokudabuka.Abekade ethwese nabo amacala nguLusanda Sulani (41) kanye noZukiswa Sitho (33).Bese kuphele iminyaka engu-8 besejele. Bebebhekene namacala ehlukene alinganiselwa ku-32, kufaka phakathi awokudlwengula, ukushushumbisa abantu kanye nawokuwaka.Laba babekade bekhalelwe ngamaSongo kaSigonyela ngo-Ephreli 2017.Baningi esebezwakalise ukungagculiseki nongenami kwabo ngesinqumo seJaji u-Irma Schoeman asethule kuthangi eNkantolo eNkulu yaseGqheberha, e-Eastern Cape.Ethuba isinqumo sakhe uSchoeman ubuyekeze bonke ubufakazi obethulelwa inkantolo ngaphambilini. Wase ekhomba ngenjumbane uMbuso wathi wehluleke wencama ukuvezela inkantolo ngokusobala ukuthi abasolwa banecala ngampela futhi kumele libalahle.USchoeman wenzele ngokuthi ubufakazi obebethulwa yizisulu abuzange buphoselwe ngendlela efanele inselelo ngesikhathi sokuphicana ngokwemibuzo.Ngemuva kwalesi sinqumo ibe ningi imvunge kubantu abehlukene bekhala ngokuvunwa yinkantolo kuka-OMotoso nabeboshwe nabo.Nezisulu zizwakalise ukungagculiseki ngesinqumo seJaji. Omunye wazo uCherly Zondi uzwakalise ukungenami ngesinqumo seNkantolo.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi uNksz Zondi waba ngomunye wofakazi abagqama kakhulu ngesikhathi kuqulwa leli cala.Ukhale ngokuthi wenze konke okusemandleni ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kwenzeka ubulungiswa kodwa uthe ujabhile ukuthi bekufana nokuthi umane uthela amanzi emhlane wedada nje.Uthe uzizwa ephoxekile, ecasukile ngoba kuyona yonke le minyaka engu-8 kukhulunywa ngaleli cala ubezitshela ukuthi ubulungiswa uzobuthola.Uthe impilo yabo angeke iphinde ifane ngemuva kwaleli cala."Sakhetha ukuthi siphumele obala ngalokhu sakhohlwa nayisithunzi sethu. Kwala noma sesibizwa ngamagama kodwa saphikelela,''usho kanjena.Eqhuba uthe : "Okubuhlungu ukuthi usazoqhubeka nalento ayenze nakwabanye besifazane okuyinto ebesithi sizama ukuyinqanda. Besifuna ukuthi lento ayenzile igcine ngathi.Angeke ayiyeke ngoba lento ayenzayo isemzweni yakhe yegazi,''ekhuluma ekhala.Ungqongqoshe wezoBulungiswa eNingizimu Afrika Mmamoloko Kubayi uphumele obala wezwakalisa ukungagculiseki ngendlela elisingathwe ngakhona icala lika-Omotoso.Uthe akakholwa nje nhlobo ukuthi izinto kuleli cala zihanjiswe ngendlela obekumele ngabe zenziwe ngakhona. Ukhale ngokuthi izinqumo zalolu hlobo zizoqeda amandla nakuzisilu zokuhlukunyezwa zizizwe zingavikelekile.Uthe usecele oyiNhloko yabaShushisi kuzwelonke ukuba amdlulisele umbiko ogcwele ngokwenzekile kuleli cala.UPhiko lwezokuShushiswa iNational Prosecuting Authority (NPA) nalo lukhale kakhulu ngalesi sinqumo lwathi luzosiphosela inselelo isinqumo sale nkantolo.Kuphuma lesi sinqumo nje kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi ngaphambilini kukhona abanye ofakazi abathi bakhethe ukuthi bakhohlwe okwezeka ebese beqhubekela phambili nempilo.Ngakolunye uhlangothi u-Omotoso ubonge uNkulunkulu ngokuphunyuka kwakhe."Into nje engingayisho ukuthi ngiyambonga kakhulu uNkulunkulu. Lonke udumo ngilunikeza lona. Ngineminyaka engu-67 manje bese ngibe sejele iminyaka engu-8,'' usho kanjena.U-Omotoso wayengumholi webandla iJesus Dominion International (JDI) ayeboshwe nabo ngaleso sikhathi babengabalekeleli bakhe.Leli bandla linamagatsha amakhulu eNingizimu Afrika, eNigeria kanye nakwa-Isryel.

KUKHONA okushaya amanzi ebudlelwaneni bezithandani ebezingamathe nolimu kwiBig Brother Mzansi, u-Akhonamathemba "Sweet Guluva" Mbhele waseNquthu no-Ashley Ogle waseNewlands East. Kunezimpawu ezikhombisa ukuthi sekunomfantu othandweni lwabo. Okuqale kwashayisa amakhala ukungalandelani kwabo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, ikakhulukazi ku-Instagram.Okwesibili; kube ukushaywa ngesithende komcimbi wokwamukelwa kukaSweet Guluva ngakubo eNquthu ngu-Ashley. Ebuzwa u-Ashley ukuthi uyaya yini emcimbini kaSweet Guluva ulibeke ngembaba elokuthi akalibeki olwakhe unyawo khona."Ngenxa yothando nenhlonipho, ngeke ngiphumelele emcimbini ngoba ithuba lakhe lokuthi agqame."Eqhuba, u-Ashley uthe akafuni abantu besusa amehlo kuSweet Guluva agcine esegxile kuyena Ebuzwa ngabalandeli bakhe kwiTik Tok Live ukuthi ukuphi u-Ashley, uSweet Guluva uthe ukhona kodwa akekho naye. "Ukhona empilweni yami. Ungazikhathazi kakhulu," kuchaza uSweet Guluva.No-Ashley kwi-Engineer Your Life, uthe basathathe isinqumo sokuthandana ngasese ukuze bagxile kahle ekukhuliseni amagama abo.U-Ashley noSweet Guluva bebengave bethandana besekulolu hlelo kangangoba uSweet Guluva wakhala mi izinyembezi ngesikhathi sekukhishwe u-Ashley.Kanjalo no-Ashley ubambe elikhulu iqhaza empumelelweni kaSweet Guluva njengoba kugcine kunguye odle umhlanganiso futhi wemuka nesamba sika-R2 million. U-Ashley uyena obehla enyuka egqugquzela abantu ukuba bavote ngobuningi.IGuluva Homecoming iseNquthu Stadium kusukela ngo-10 ekuseni. Kumaciko aboshelwe kulo mcimbi, kubalwa umsakazi weJozi FM, uPenny Ntuli nabaculi bakamaskandi uFalabo, Mthandeni SK, Guzasta, Imfezemnyama nabanye. Izithameli zizobe zingena mahhala.
ZIKHALELWE ngamasongo kaSigonyela izelamani zakubo kamsakazi woKhozi, uZimiphi "Zimdollar" Biyela zisembuthanweni okuthiwa bekungowokujabulela ukufa komunye usomatekisi waseMpangeni.Kuvela ukuthi izelamani, uMnuz Vika Biyela okuthiwa wesatshiswa okwenyoka embonini yamatekisi, uboshwe kanye nomfowabo omncane uMnuz Bo Biyela.Umthombo uthe baboshwe besembungazweni omkhulu obusendaweni yabadla izambane likapondo, eMthunzini "wokusocongwa kukasomatekisi" odumile kule ndawo Isolezwe elisitholile isibongo sakhe nokuhlaluke ukuthi ukubulawa kwakhe bekuyamene nokuthi ubehamba phambili okhethweni lukasihlalo omusha wale mboni eMpangeni.OBiyela baboshelwe icala lokubulawa kukasomatekisi uMnuz Gagasi Sipho Mashiyane (49) isidumbu sakhe okuthiwa satholakala silahlwe ehlathini lasoBuka, iLuwamba, okuthiwa kwenzeka ngo-2022.Kusolwa ukuthi abambulala bamkhipha emotweni yakhe eyitekisi ayesanda kuyithenga. Kuthiwa imoto yatholakala seyikhishwe injini eduze kwakubo kwabasolwa.Owomndeni kamufi okhulume neSolezwe wacela ukuba kugodlwe igama lakhe, uthe kade azi vele ukuthi ngobani ababulala umfowabo."Ngazenzela olwami uphenyo ngathola ukuthi laba yibona ababulale umfowethu. Kodwa ngakhetha ukuzithulela njengoba labaya bantu bayingozi kabi,'' usho kanjena.Uthe okumqeda amandla ukuthi uye azibuze aziphendule ukuthi yini le engaka eyadala ukuthi abasolwa njengoba benenqwaba yamatekisi kodwa baba nomhobholo basoconga umfowabo owayenamatekisi amabili nje kuphela?Eqhuba, owomndeni uthe ngendlela okwenzeka ngayo izinto kukhomba ukuthi kunongqondongqondo bokubulawa kosomatekisi abaningi kodwa abukho ubulungiswa obenzekayo ngoba kuyivela kancane ukuthi kube khona ababoshwayo.Uzwakale umoya wakhe ushona phansi uma echaza ngakubize ngokubhuqwa komndeni wakhe uBiyela (Vika) athe wafika eshesha kubo ezobaduduza ngemuva kokuba kuzwakale izindaba zokuthi akasekho emhlabeni umfowabo."Ngamanye amagama wayengasiduduzi kodwa wayesihleka futhi esibhuqa ngokusehlele siwumndeni kamufi. Kusho ukuthi kuyena kwakumnandi ebona kufezeke icebo lakhe. Kulungile-ke kodwa uyena owaziyo ukuthi kungani enza kanjena,'' usho kanjena sakubalisa.Uthe abasolwa abalubhadanga emgcwabeni, wathi njengomndeni bafuna ukuthi ekugcineni babuthole ubulungiswa ngokubulawa kowegazi labo.Uveze ukuthi ukuboshwa kwalaba kubuyise inhlansi yethemba emndenini ngokuthi kwenzeke ubulungiswa ebese bengasakholwa ukuthi buzogcina benzekile.Isolezwe lithole ngomthombo walo ukuthi kukhona amanye amacala abucayi okungenzeka kuboshwe abanye ngawo abasembonini yamatekisi eMpangeni namaphethelo.Umthombo uthe bakhulekela ukuthi lingenzeki iphutha lokuthi bayithole ibheyili oBiyela ngoba kungachitheka izishebo uma bekhululwa.Laba ababili umthombo uthe bavelile enkantolo yaseNgwelezane, izolo. Ngaphambilini, kwake kwashiswa amatekisi awu-14 kaVika.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa aseNtambanana, avula icala lokubulala kulandela isigameko sokutholwa kwesidumbu sowesilisa odutshuliwe ngoJulayi 27, 2022, kule ndawo."Amaphoyisa asebophe abasolwa abayisithupha abaneminyaka ephakathi kuka-25 no-44, abathathu babo bebevele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMpangeni, namuhla (esho izolo) kanti laba abanye abathathu, bazovela ngoMsombuluko,” kusho uNetshiunda.

UKHALE wazithulisa uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, emva kwesibhaxu sakamumva esivulelwe uMengameli waseMelika, uMnuz Donald Trump. URamaphosa uthe isinqumo sakamumva sikaTrump sokujezisa iNingizimu Afrika sikhombisa ukuthi kusemqoka kangakanani ukuthi kusheshiswe izingxoxo zokubuyisana phakathi kwala mazwe. UTrump umemezele intela ka-30% ezokhokhwa yizinkampani zakuleli ezidayisa impahla yazo eMelika. Enza lesi simemezelo, uTrump uthe kunezinto ezimbi ezenzeka eNingizimu Afrika.Okhulumela uRamaphosa, uMnuz Vincent Magwenya, uthe isinqumo sikaTrump sizoshaya kuzwele kosomabhizinisi bakuleli abadayisa impahla yabo eMelika.UMagwenya uthe okubakhathaza kakhulu ukuthi akuzange kube nezingxoxo ngaphambi kokuthi iMelika ithathe isinqumo."Thina sizibophezele ekugcineni ubudlelwano obuhlomulisa womabili amazwe, kodwa lena yokujesiza iNingizimu Afrika izophazamisa ukuhwebelana kwethu."Kusukela uTrump engenile esikhundleni ubudlelwano beNingizimu Afrika neMelika abubuhle. Amanzi adungeke kakhulu emva kokusayinwa komthetho wokuthathwa komhlaba nempahla wuhulumeni ngaphandle kwesinxephezelo.UTrump wasola elakuleli ngokuphuca amaBhunu umhlaba ngaphandle kwesinxephezelo.Kwalandela ngokuthi uTrump ahoxise uxhaso lwezigidi zamarandi olutholwa yiNingizimu Afrika ezenhlelweni zezempilo.Imizamo yakuleli yokuba nezingxoxo noTrump ibhajiwe njengoba kuthiwa izikhulu zaseMelika kazifuni ukuhlangana nabaholi bakuleli.UMagwenya uthe izingxoxo kuphela ezizoqeda ukungaboni ngaso linye kwala mazwe."Empeleni nje lesi sinqumo sikhombisa ngokusobala ukuthi kufanele kusheshiswe izingxoxo ukuze sizokuba nesivumelwano sokusebenzisana esisha. Isivumelwano sokusebenzisana esisha kufanele sivune womabili amazwe."Akuyona iNingizimu Afrika kuphela ethole isijeziso kuTrump. UTrump umemezele intela ezofakwa empahleni eqhamuka emazweni angu-30.Kula mazwe kukhona izikhondlakhondla zase-Europe, kube khona iChina namanye amazwe asezwenikazi i-Afrika.Izwe lase-Afrika elishayeke kakhulu yiLesotho, lapho ememezele intela ka-50%. Amanye amazwe ase-Afrika athole intela ephezulu iMadagascar ethole u-47%, iMauritius inikwe eka-40%, kwathi iBotswana yona yanikwa intela ka-37%.Amazwe ase-Europe neChina ayalele uTrump ukuba ahoxise intela, asabisa ngokuziphindisela uma ingahoxiswa le ntela egxekwe nxa zonke.
ISIMBAMBAMBA esivulelwe yiMK okhethweni lokuchibiyela kuMasipala waKwaDukuza sishiye i-ANC ihlezi ngesinqa esisodwa kulo mkhandlu. Ukuhlwitha kweMK iwadi ebiphethwe yi-ANC kunciphise izihlalo zeqembu elibusayo. I-ANC ibivele iwuphethe ngencacamezelo umkhandlu njengoba ibinezihlalo ezingu-29 kwezingu-59, manje isisele nezihlalo ezingu-28.I-MK inqobe ngamalengiso ukhetho obelukuwadi 28 njengoba ithole amavoti angu-1 623, kwathi i-ANC yona yathola amavoti angu-996.I-MK ibigadla ngohlubuke kwi-ANC, uMnuz Vishnugopal Govender, okhethweni lwangoLwesithathu, kanti i-ANC yona ikhiphele isibhongo kwi-IFP okhethweni lokuchibiyela obelukuMasipala wasoPhongolo. I-ANC ithathe ithathe i-wadi, ebiphethwe yi-IFP. I-ANC ithole amavoti angu-931, iMK yathola angu-728, kwathi i-IFP yona yathola angu-622.Ukuhlulwa kwe-IFP okhethweni lwangoLwesithathu kusho ukuthi nayo isihlezi ngesinqa esisodwa kulo mkhandlu. I-IFP izosala nezihlalo ezingu-14 kwezingu-29.Okhulumela i-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Fanle Sibisi, ubonge ukuphokophela kwamalungu eqembu abekhankasela ukhetho KwaDukuza, wathi bekungelula, waveza ukuthi obemele i-ANC okhethweni, uNksz Lucia Mlondo, uqhubekile nokukhankasa yize noma ebethola izinsongo. "Siyakubonga ukuzinikela kwakhe. Umsebenzi wethu awuphelile lapha KwaDukuza. Ngesikhathi sikhankasa ziningi izinkinga abantu abasibikele ngazo. Sizokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi ziyalungiswa zonke izinkinga esibikelwe ngazo."USibisi uthe ukunqoba ukhetho kuMasipala wasoPhongolo kukhombisa ngokusobala ukuthi akukapheli nge-ANC."Ngithanda ukuncoma abantu basoPhongolo abathathe isinqumo sokunika i-ANC ithuba lokuphatha. Bazoyibona inqubekela phambili nozinzo. Ikusasa labo lisezandleni eziphephile njengoba bekhethe i-ANC."I-MK ibonge abayivotela okhethweni lwaKwaDukuza nasoPhongolo. Le nhlangano ithe imiphumela yokhetho lwangoLwesithathu ikhombisa ngokusobala ukuthi bazosobozela konke okuphambi kwabo okhethweni lohulumeni basekhaya oluzokuba ngonyaka ozayo. I-MK ithatha iwadi eliKwaDukuza nje, bekungakapheli isikhathi esingakanani ithathe enye kwi-ANC. Ngenyanga eyedlule, iMK yathatha indawo eyayiphethwe yi-ANC kuMasipala waseRichmond. Ukunqoba kweMK kusho ukuthi isinamakhansela amane KwaZulu-Natal. Le nhlangano inekhansela kuMasipala waseMzumbe, iphinde ibe nekhansela kuMasipala iRay Nkonyeni.
Page leadABATHEMBI abahlaziyi bezombusazwe ukuthi kuzophela iminyaka emihlanu usekhona umshado we-DA ne-ANC kuhulumeni wokubambisana kwamaqembu i-GNU, njengoba i-DA inqabe ukwehlela ngezansi, yaqinisa ikhanda iphikelela enkantolo enkulu ngoba ifuna kumiswe ukunyuswa kwentela efakwa uma kuthengwa impahla, iVAT.Abahlaziyi bathi akukapheli ngisho nonyaka lo mshado ukhona kodwa umfantu mkhulu phakathi kwala maqembu njengoba ezoba nemihlangano ebalulekile, lapho ezonquma ngokuthi asazokwazi yini ukuqhubeka asebenzisane noma ahlukane njengamaNdiya ephethe obhaskidi, emva kokuba i-DA ichithe ukuvotela isabelomali sezwe esinyusa iVAT ngo-0.5%.Umhlaziyi wezepolitiki oseNyuvesi yaKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Zakhele Ndlovu, uthe akanalo ithemba lokuthi kuzophela iminyaka emihlanu la maqembu esayibambile kwi-GNU.Uthe i-ANC ne-DA bayadingana nakuba imibono yabo ihlukene kakhulu."I-DA ifana nomuntu wesifazane osemshadweni ahlukumezekile kuwona kodwa angafuni ukuphuma ngoba kukhona akuzuzayo. Ziningi izinto leli qembu elingaboni ngaso linye kuzo ne-ANC, kubalwa umthetho wokubuyiswa komhlaba ngaphandle kwesinxephezelo, umthetho womshwalense wezempilo kuleli i-NHI nendaba yokuyuswa kweVAT manje," kusho uNdlovu.Uthe uma i-DA igcina iphoqeleka ukuthi iphume emshadweni we-GNU, ingabanga umsindo ngodaba lokuthi i-ANC inyuse iVAT ngo-0.5% kulo nyaka, bese ngonyaka ozayo iphinde inyuke ngomunye u-0.5%, okuzoshaya abakhokhi bentela.UNdlovu uthe i-DA ayifuni ukudeda emshadweni ngoba ingafuni ukuthi kungene amaqembu afana neMK kanjalo ne-EFF kuhulumeni.Omunye umhlaziyi uSolwazi Andre Duvenage, ucashunwe kwiSABC ethi lucace bha uqhekeko phakathi kwe-DA ne-ANC odabeni lokunyuswa kweVAT esabelweni esethulwe nguNgqongqoshe wezeziMali, uMnuz Enoch Godongwana."I-DA ingaqhubeka ihlale emshadweni we-GNU, yamukele indaba yokunyuswa kweVAT. Ingaphuma futhi kulo mshado, sibone sekungena amanye amaqembu amasha kwi-GNU," usho kanje.Uthe ubona ingcindezi izoba kwi-ANC ngokuthi ikuphi ezokwenza nge-DA emva kokuba ichithe isabelomali.Abahlaziyi basho lokhu nje, ubuholi be-DA bebuhlangene izolo ntambama, ukuqhamuka nomkhombandlela ngokuzokwenziwa yileli qembu.I-ANC ibize umhlangano ophuthumayo wesigungu esiphezulu sale nhlangano ngoMsombuluko eGoli, lapho ibizobhunga khona ngokwenzekile, bese iphuma nomkhombandlela ngezokwenza.USihlalo weFederal Council ye-DA, uNkk Helen Zille ekhuluma nabezindaba izolo ngaphandle kweNkantolo eNkulu eWestern Cape, uthe bebezohlangana izolo bewubuholi obuphezulu babhunge kabanzi ngokwenzekile, bese bephuma nomkhombandlela."Sizobheka izinto eziningi, bese sithatha isinqumo ngesizokwenza. Asizoxhamazela ngoba sifuna ukuthatha isinqumo esifanele, esizosimemezela," usho kanje. Uthe baye enkantolo ngoba befuna kumiswe ukukhushulwa kweVAT kusuka ngenyanga ezayo."Ngesikhathi sezingxoxo siyifakile eyomthetho wokubuyiswa komhlaba nodaba lweNHI ngoba kumele ixhaswe. Ziningi iziphakamiso esazenza ezithinta ezomnotho. Siyazi isinqumo esizosithatha sizoba nomthelela ezweni," kusho uNkk Zille.I-ANC ihlale ithi noma i-DA ingaphuma kwi-GNU, kodwa uhulumeni ngeke uguqe, uzoqhubeka.

BAKHALA ngokuthi izoshaya kakhulu abashonelwe eyokumiswa kwezinhlelo ezijwayelekile zikaMasipala wasoKhahlamba okubikwa ukuthi ubhekene nenkinga yemali.Ikhansela leqembu eliphikisayo emkhandlwini, i-IFP, lithe ukumiswa kwezinhlelo zomkhandlu ezejwayelekile kusho ukuthi umasipala ngeke usalukhipha usizo ojwayele ukulunikeza imindeni esemanzini.Kulolu sizo kubalwa nokuhlinzeka ngogandaganda omba ithuna.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi itshe limi ngothi kulo mkhandlu osuthathe isinqumo sokumisa zonke izinhlelo zawo ezijwayelekile kuze kungene isabelomali esisha ngoJulayi.Abasebenzi bomkhandlu kuthiwa basengcupheni yokungaholi kule nyanga njengoba kuthiwa imali ekhona yanele ukuholela u-70% wabasebenzi.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi bekubizwe umhlangano wabasebenzi, lapho betshelwe khona ngenkinga yemali.Umthombo uthe abasebenzi batshelwe ukuthi isimo sezimali sibi ngale ndlela yokuthi umasipala ungawa bhu phansi uma singase singangeni isabelomali ngoJulayi."Abasebenzi batshelwe ukuthi kuzomiswa zonke izinhlelo eziqhubeka kuma-ward. Kukhona imihlomulo abasebenzi abangeke besayithola. Kuleyo mihlomulo kubalwa i-cellphone nemihlomulo anayithola uma behamba."UMasipala wasoKhahlamba uphethwe ngokubambisana i-Apemo, ANC, EFF ne-NPA.Lo masipala ubujwayele ukuthola imibiko engenagcobho kuMcwaningi mabhuku, kodwa uthole umbiko onogcobho onyakeni wezimali owedlule.I-IFP ithe ukumiswa kwezinhlelo zomkhandlu kuzophazamisa yona kakhulu ngoba iyona enamakhansela amaningi. Ikhansela le-IFP, uMnuz Sanele Buthelezi, lithe ukumiswa kwezinhlelo zomkhandlu kusho ukuthi abantu abashonelwe ngeke besaluthola usizo."Noma thina bengakasitsheli, kodwa sizwa kuthiwa banqume ukumisa zonke izimoto zomkhandlu. Lokho kusho ukuthi uma kukhona abantu abashonelwe, ngeke umasipala uwukhiphe ugandaganda ozokumba ithuna."Njengekhansela kufanele ngikhiphe ephaketheni lami, ngithenge udizili, uma kushoniwe. Noma kunomgwaqo okungahambeki kuwo, kusho ukuthi kufanele mina ngikhiphe ephaketheni lami ukuze sithole ugandaganda ozosilungisela. Kanti sekuyimina yini umasipala uma sengizokhipha ephaketheni lami?"UButhelezi uthe ngokwemibiko eyethulwe emkhandlwini, isabelomali sishoda ngoR40 million."Saqala salethwa okokuqala isabelomali, kwatholakala ukuthi sishoda ngoR70 million. Izikhulu zomkhandlu zazama ukwenza izinguquko njengoba sesishoda ngoR40 million manje."Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kweMeya yasoKhahlamba, uMnuz Vikizitha Mlotshwa, ayizange iphumelele njengoba ucingo lwayo belukhala lungabanjwa.
UKHOLWA ukuthi uthishanhloko, angasazwani naye, wasebenzisa umfundi "owuhlupho" ukumxoshisa emsebenzini kungafanele, owesilisa obenguthisha esikoleni iMasakhaneni High, KwaMakhutha, eThekwini.UMnuz Siphelele Ngcobo, uthe wanikwa incwadi emxosha emsebenzini ngo-Okthoba nyakenye, emva kokulahlwa yicala lokudlwengula umfundi obefunda uGrade 11 nyakenye.UNgcobo uthe ngesikhathi etshelwa uthishanhloko ngo-Ephreli 22, nyakenye, wathi usolwa ngecala lokudlwengula umfundi, embona KwaMakhutha, kuwuMgqibelo ngo-Ephreli 10.Lokhu kuyavela kwamanye amaphepha anikwa wona maqondana naleli cala.Okudidayo ukuthi incwadi yokumumisa isikhashana emsebenzini, ayinikwa ngoMeyi nyakenye, yayiveza ukuthi isehlo senzeka esikoleni.UNgcobo uthe akakaze alenze leli cala, wathi ukhala nangendlela isikole nesifunda okulusingathe ngayo udaba."Ngiyakhala ngendlela okwenziwe ngayo izinto. Kuningi okungahanjiswanga ngendlela kwaze kwaba ukuthi ngiyaxoshwa,” kusho uNgcobo.Uthe esebizelwa esigcawini sokuthi izinhlangothi ezithintekayo, zibhunge ngodaba, umfundi othintekayo nomngani wakhe, okuthiwa wuye ufakazi, abafikanga.Uthe ngesikhathi sekufanele kuqalwe, wabuza umbuzo wokuthi ngabe yisigcawu esifanele yini lesi ukuthi kudingidwe udaba."Ngangibuziswa ukuthi ngokwazi kwami, uma kukhona umuntu okuthiwa uthi udlwenguliwe, kufanele kube khona icala lobugebengu elivuliwe emaphoyiseni. Kulolu daba lalingekho icala elalivuliwe, kuze kube yimanje alikho,” kusho uNgcobo.Uthe ababesingethe leso sigcawu, bagcina bethi asiguqe ngoba basafuna ukuyophenya ngesikhalo sakhe."Ngamangala sengithola incwadi ethi sengixoshiwe emsebenzini ngenxa yecala,” kusho uNgcobo othe ufuna ubulungiswa.Ukhombise Isolezwe incwadi efungelwe, lapho 'umngani kamgilwa’, ethi ngeke azihlanganise nento angayibonanga yenzeka, okushiya imibuzo ngokwenzeka kwesigameko njengoba kuthiwa uthishanhloko uthi wazibonela ngawakhe uNgcobo eqhuba umgilwa emusa kubo, lapho okuthiwa wafike wamdlwengulela khona.Uthe uyakholwa ukuthi ukuxoshwa kwakhe kwakuyinto uthishanhloko ayihlela ngobuchule ngoba efuna kungene omunye uthisha esikhaleni sakhe.Uthe lo mfundi amsebenzisile, umkhethe ukuba amenzele lokhu ngoba emazi ngokuthi uhlupha ngezidakamizwa nangokushaya amanye amantombazane esikoleni."Yena nomngani wakhe, banoxhaxha lwamacala okufanele ngabe sebaxoshelwa wona esikoleni. Ngisola ukuthi wababona bengabafundi abakahle ukuthi abasebenzisele ukungichitha,” usho kanje.Uthe ngesikhathi emiswa okwesikhashana emsebenzini, akuphelanga sikhathi esingakanani, kwafika uthisha okwathiwa usezofundisa isifundo sakhe."Kwaba yimi engiphenduka undingasithebeni, sengifundisa isifundo sakwaGrade 8 no-9, ngisuswa ekufundiseni iMathematics kwaGrade 10 kuya ku-12,” usho kanje.Uthe phambilini ubenobudlelwane obuhle kakhulu nothishanhloko, kungekho angakwazi ngaye njengoba bebehlala ngandawonye, kodwa kwabuye kwashintsha ngokuhamba kwesikhathi njengoba manje bengasabhekani.Uveze ukuthi waxoshwa ngaphandle kokuthi isigungu esilawula ukuphathwa kwesikole saziswe.Usihlalo wesigungu, uMnuz Mdu Khuzwayo uthe beyisigungu sesikole, lolu daba baluzwe emva kwendaba, sekuthiwa umnyango usulusebenze waluqeda."Sifisa luphathwe ngendlela ezogculisa zonke izinhlaka ezithintekayo. Lusingathwe ngendlela eneqiniso nebeka izinto zihlale obala ngendlela efanele. Nathi njengesigungu sicatshangelwe ukuthi siyingxenye yokuphathwa kwesikole,” kusho uKhuzwayo, ogcizelele eyokuthi, abazange babikelwa lutho ngalolu daba.Ucingo lukathishanhloko beluvaliwe noMnyango wezeMfundo awutholakalanga ukuba uphawule ngodaba.

IKHANSELA kumasipala waseGoli elibhekelele ezokuPhepha nokuVikeleka komphakathi uMnuz uMgcini Tshwaku ubehambisana namaphoyisa ophiko lweK9 kuthungathwa abadayisi nabashushumbisa bezidakamizwa eMidrand.Laba babhadame abasolwa abathathu erenki yamatekisi nenqwaba yezidakamizwa zohlobo lwe-crystal meth yenani likaR200k. UKHALA ezimathonsi ngocingo lukagesi lwepulazi eMcaki, eNdwedwe, okuthiwa selukhiphe isidumbu, umndeni wowesifazane otholwe ebambeke kulo ezintatha zayizolo.UNksz Sibongile Mdanda (60) utholwe esethule, ewele ocingweni, okuthiwa lusondele kakhulu eduze kwendlela ehamba amalungu omphakathi. Udadewabo kamufi, uNksz khanyisile Mdanda, uthe umufi ubeye komunye umuzi osendaweni, lapho ajwayele ukuyobona khona omunye wabangani bakhe. "Sisola ukuthi uwele kulona ucingo, lwamushokha washona. Ngenxa yokuhlala kwesidumbu sakhe ubusuku bonke kulona, kunezindawo lapho sidleke khona kakhulu,” kusho uNksz Mdanda. Uthe umbiko bawuthole ngomunye umakhelwane ozithele kusona, eya emsebenzini, wathi ubehlala yedwa umufi ekhaya, nokwenze kwangasheshe kwaqapheleka ukungabuyi kwakhe ekhaya ngeSonto ntambama. Uthe bayakhala ngalolu cingo ngoba ukube belungekho eduze kwendlela, ubengeke ashone kabuhlungu kanje udadewabo. "Ngesikhathi bebiya abelungu, bathi alubulali lolu cingo. Bakuphindile lokho nanamuhla (esho izilo) ngesikhathi sekulele isidumbu phansi. Sizibuza ukuthi, pho uma lungabulali, yena ufe kanjani?” kubeka uNksz Mdanda esidinda isililo, ethi akafuni nokulubona ucingo. IMeya kaMasipala waseNdwedwe, uMnuz Sam Mfeka, eyile endaweni yesigameko itshele Isolezwe ukuthi ucingo luseduze kwendlela ngempela. "Lusendaweni lapho okuhlukana khona umngcele wamapulazi nendawo ehlala abantu,” kusho uMfeka.Uthe zibe ningi izikhalazo abazithole emphakathini phambilini benguhulumeni wendawo kanjalo nobukhosi besizwe."Umphakathi ubukhala ngokuthi lusondele kakhulu nendlela ehamba abantu okukhona kubo ngisho izingane. Belubashokha kodwa nhlanhla leyo kungafi muntu, njengoba sekuphume isidumbu manje,” kusho uMfeka.Uthe bebethi uma bezama ukululwa udaba lwalolu cingo, umnikazi wepulazi abasasazele ngamasamanisi ababizela enkantolo, ethi ucingo ulufake endaweni yakhe, akumele bambangise umsindo ngalo, wathi ngesikhathi efika endaweni yesigameko uthole ukuthi umphakathi udiniwe kulandela ukwenzeka umshophi obuvele ukhathazeke ngokuthi uyogcina wenzeka. Uthe badumele ngesehlo, wathi bazosondela emndenini, bezwe uma kukhona odinga ukusizwa ngakho. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uConstable Thenjiswa Ngcobo, uthe amaphoyisa esiteshi saseMhlali avule idokodo ngokufa komuntu ukuze liphenywe kulandela isigameko lapho kutholwe khona isidumbu sowesifazane (60) e-Upper Tongaat, izolo.
UBENEZINYANGA eziyisishiyagalombili ekhulelwe, owesifazane waseLindelani, eMzinto, okuthiwa ubulawe kanye nodadewabo, bedutshulwa uyise wezingane zakhe ngeSonto.Umsolwa, uMnuz Nkanyiso Shezi, ogcine ngokuzingqokloza naye, uphinde wadubula nomunye umakhelwane, okumanje kuthiwa usesimeni esibucayi esibhedlela.Isidumbu sikaNksz Nandipha Lifana (33), esikadadewabo omncane uNksz Nangamso Lifana (29) nesikaShezi zitholwe zidindilize ndawonye emjondolo obuhlala laba besifazane.Kuvela ukuthi uShezi, obeyinkunzi yohlobo, wenza lesi sehlakalo nje, endlini yakhe kubo, ushiye owesifazane, naye obekhulewe ingane yakhe.Udadewabo wabesifazane, uNksz Nozuko Dlabom utshele Isolezwe ukuthi basola ukuthi umsolwa ubulale uNandipha edinwa ukuthi ngesikhathi emala, emva kwesikhashana emkhulelise ingane yesine, (uNandipha) wavele wangamlwisa."UNandipha wayedinwa ukuthi owesifazane amalela yena, umngani wakhe omkhulu, wakhona endaweni. Okusho ukuthi wayelindele ukuthi uzolwa, wavele wakhetha ukuzithulela,” kusho uNksz Dlabom.Uqhube wathi njengoba ebesemkhulelise eyesine, kukhona ezinye ezimbili eziphilayo, eneminyaka engu-15 neneminyaka engu-10, kuthi ebingumagcino, yashona ineminyaka emihlanu eminyakeni embalwa edlule."Sitshelwe ukuthi ngesikhathi egasela, ufike wadonsela uNandipha phandle, wathi akavalelise kodadewabo ababili abehleli nabo. Umbuze umbuzo wokuthi ufuna ukumbulala yini, wase edlubulundela, ebaleka ebuyela endlini,” kusho uNksz Dlabom.Uthe umlandele masinyane, wafika wamdubula ekhanda.Uveze ukuthi kuthe uma ethi uyamkhuza uNangamso, naye wamshaya ngenhlamvu ekhanda.Uthe omunye udadewabo obekhona endlini, uphume wabaleka. Kuthe kusenjalo, kwaqhamuka umakhelwane, obezwa umsindo wesibhamu, naye wangadabula njengoba emdubule ebusweni, nhlanhla leyo wangashona."Ube esezidubula ke naye, waphelela lapho,” usho kanje.Udalule ukuthi ngesikhathi ufika endaweni yesigameko umndeni kamufi, unina uthumele ukuthi kubizwe intombi kamsolwa abeyishiye endlini, efike yababaza yathi "kanti usembulele ngempela”."Kuthiwa ubephume endlini eshilo ukuthi uzombulala nokuyinto okuvele ukuthi ubelokhu eyisho. Sisola ukuthi bazitshele ukuthi uyazisholo nje njengenjwayelo,” kubalisa uNksz Dlabom.Uveze ukuthi isibhamu asisebenzisele ukwenza umuga esomsebenzi njengoba ebengunogada.Ube esedalula ukuthi uthando lwabo belunokuhlukumeza njengoba ebehlala ahlale amshaye uNandipha."Ubemshaya ngisho ehlangana naye endleleni. Ngesikhathi behlukana, sasithi usezophumula, kanti asazi ukuthi uzogcina ngokumbulala. Siphatheke kabi,” kusho uNksz Dlabom.Uthe balusizi ngokuthi abafi bashiye izingane ezinhlanu ezisencane njengoba noNangamso eshiye ezintathu ezineminyaka emibili, emihlanu neyisishiyagalolunye. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uConstable Thenjiswa Ngcobo uthe amaphoyisa aseMzinto avule amacala amabili okubulala, elilodwa lokuzama ukubulala nedokodo lokufa komuntu.
USADIDEKILE namanje umndeni wowesifazane waKwaZayeka, eSweetwaters, eMgungundlovu, okutholwe isidumbu sakhe sisha ubuhanguhangu esangweni lakubo ngeSonto.Kulesi sigameko esishaqise wonke umuntu endaweni, kufe ngesihluku uNksz Ncamisile Zuma (29).Ngokusho kukamfowabo, uMnuz Sphesihle Mhlongo, ugcinwe ngabomndeni ngoMgqibelo ebusuku, ephuma ekhaya ehamba. Ngithe uma ngisondela eduze ngabona ophaqa bakhe udadewethu, ngathi uma ngiphinde ngibukisisa, ngabona ingxenye yezingubo zakhe,” kusho uMhlongo othe uphuthume endlini, wabuya namanzi, wamcisha kodwa kwacaca ukuthi sekonakele ngoba ubesevele eseshonile udadewabo.Uchaze umufi njengomuntu obenakho ukuphuma ebusuku azihambele, aziyele esokeni lakhe nasezindaweni zokucima ukoma endaweni.Uthe balibuzile isoka nabakhona kulezi zindawo ukuthi uke wafika yini ebusuku ngoMgqibelo, balandula, wathi nakulo muzi obekunomcimbi khona, abakuvezanga ukuthi uphinde wabuya isibili.UMhlongo uthe isigameko sibashaqisile bewumndeni, wathi basadidekile ngokuthi isiphi lesi sitha esingaka, umufi abesenaso esikhethe ukuthi simbulale kabuhlungu kanje."Ubulawe ngesihluku esikhulu udadewethu. Yebo indawo inabo ubugebengu obejwayelekile njengokugqekezwa kwemizi yabantu, kuntshontshwe izimpahla kodwa obokushiswa kwabantu besifazane, abukaze benzeke,” kusho uMhlongo.Uthe bewumndeni bahlalele ovalweni njengoba bengabazi abasolwa futhi besagcwele amathafa.
