KUBE nenhlokomo kwaduma nehlombe, kwashaywa isiqubulo esithi abahambe abahambayo izolo ePhalamende kuphasiswa isabelomali esinyusa intela efakwa uma kuthengwa impahla, iVAT ebesichithwa yi-DA namanye amaqembu. Lokhu kwenze sashuba isimo kwi-DA njengoba ikhula ingcindezi yokuthi kuhlukane izindlela kuhulumeni wokubambisana kwamaqembu kuleli owaziwa nge-GNUemva kokuba i-DA ichithe eyokuphasisa isabelomali.Angu-194 amalungu ePhalamende avotele ukuphasisa isabelomali kwathi angu-182 asichitha.Leli qembu liyalelwe ukuthi likhethe phakathi kokuba yiqembu eliphikisayo, noma liqhubeke nokuba yingxenye kahulumeni.Enkulumeni eputshukile kaMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, kuzwakale ethi utshele umholi we-DA uMnuz John Steenhuisen, onguNgqongqoshe wezoLimo kwiKhabhinethi, ukuthi sekulele kubona ngabazokwenza mayelana nokuvotela isabelomali.Kule nkulumo uRamaphosa uzwakala ethi i-DA ayikwazi ukuba kuhulumeni iphinde ibe yiqembu eliphikisayo, ngakho kumele ikhethe okukodwa.Izolo kuvele imibiko yokuthi isigungu esiphezulu se-DA sizohlangana, sinqume ngekusasa laleli qembu kwi-GNU.Ngesikhathi amaqembu ahlukene ekhuluma ngesikhathi kunenkulumo mpikiswano ePhalamende izolo ngokuphasisa noma ukuchitha isabelomali esethulwa nguNgqongqoshe wezeziMali uMnuz Enoch Godongwana, okhulumela i-DA kwezezimali, uDkt Mark Burke, uthe baba yingxenye ye-GNU ngoba befuna ukukhulisa umnotho nokwakha amathuba emisebenzi.Uthe uma bephoqwa ukuthi baphume kwi-GNU ngenxa yezinto abakhokhelwa kuzona, bazokwenza lokho."Siyasichitha lesi sabelomali. Siyohlangana empini," usho kanje.Nelungu le-EFF uNksz Omphile Maotwe, lithe bayasichitha isabelomali ngoba sinyusa iVAT ngo-0.5%. I-VAT imi ku-15%, kanti izonyuka kusuka ngoMeyi 1."Uma siphasiswa lesi sabelomali sizohlangana enkantolo. Asihambisani nesabelo esinyusa iVAT ezoshaya abahlwempu." UMnuz Brian Molefe we-MK, uthe uma i-DA izwa kushisa kwi-GNU, kumele iphume."I-DA sengathi isalobizela ukuba yiqembu eliphikisayo kuleli. Ayikwazi ukuthi ingaba kuhulumeni, iphinde ibe yiqembu eliphikisayo. Uma kushisa kwi-GNU, ayiphume i-DA." Umholi wePatriotic Alliance uMnuz Gayton McKenzie, uthe ubelokhu enxenxa abamaqembu ahlukene ukuthi i-DA kumele ingaphumi kwi-GNU."Kodwa manje sengishintshe umbono wami ngendaba ye-DA kwi-GNU. Abahambe," kusho uMcKenzie.UGodongwana ovale inkulumo mpikiswano, uthe ukunyusa iVAT kuzongenisa u-R13.5 billion emnothweni. Uthe kumele kushintshe ukwenza ohlelweni lwesabelomali ukuze uwonke wonke abe nombono ngokuthi ikuphi okumele bakuxhase nokungamele bakuxhase.Mayelana ne-DA uthe akacabangi ukuthi ingafuna ukuchitha isabelomali bese ifuna ukuba yingxenye kahulumeni."Kumele sidwebe ulayini ngoba ngeke uchithe isabelomali, bese ngakusasa ufuna ukuba yingxenye kahulumeni ozophusha leso sabelomali," kusho uGodongwana.Sekuvotelwa isabelomali, uSotswebhu we-MK uMnuz Mzwanele Manyi, uthe bafuna kuvotwe.Amanye amaqembu aseka isabelomali kubalwa i-IFP, UDM, Al Jamah, PA, PAC, Bosa, Rise kanti asichithayo yi-MK, EFF, DA, FF Plus, ATM, ACDP.

Lawa yiMamelodi Sundowns ebibhekene ne-Esperance yaseTunisia ne ne-Orlando Pirates ebivakashele i-MC Alger e-Algeria. Iqembu lesithathu lakuleli elikulesi sigaba, kodwa lona lisemqhudelwaneni we-Confederation Cup, iStellenbosch FC ezobhekana neZamalek yase-Egypt namuhla. Sibhale lo mbono ingakabi khona imiphumela yale midlalo kodwa sibone kufanele kushayelwe ihlombe ukuphikelela kwala maqembu unyaka nonyaka ukuba abeke umaka emiqhudelwaneni yamakilabhu ngaphansi kwe-CAF kuyabathuthukisa abadlali bakithi.Bobabili iSundowns nePirates sebeke bawuthola umuzwa wokuwina umqhudelwano we-CAF Champions League ngezikhathi ezahlukene. Kulo mncintiswano kusuke kudibene izingqwele zezwekazi i-Afrika, ngaleyo ndlela iminqolo ihambela kude nayo. Kuyiqiniso ukuthi ukudlala kuleli zinga kuyakhandla kakhulu ephaketheni futhi kudinga iqembu elinebutho langempela elizohlasela ngalo ezimweni ezahlukene.Yilesi simo esilolonga abadlali bala maqembu ukuba bacijele nokuba seqenjini lesizwe. Ngakho-ke akuyena ucilo ozishaye endukwini ukuvama kwabadlali neSundowns, Pirates neStellenbosch eqenjini lesizwe iBafana Bafana. Imihuzuko abayicosha emqhudelwaneni ye-CAF ibanika amava afanele ukuthi nxa kuthiwa nanka amaklwa namahawu, akuhlaselwe, bese bethi ush'entshweni kumqeqeshi weBafana uHugo Broos.Njengoba iNingizimu Afrika imelwe amaqembu amabili esigabeni sama-quarter final eChampions League, neBafana yenza kahle. Yingakho-ke wonke amaqembu adlala kuPremiership yakuleli kumele akulwele ukuqeda endaweni enhle yeligi ukuze akhule kulo mdlalo nabadlali bawo baqokelwe kwawesizwe.
USIHLALO wekomiti lezoMhlaba nokuThuthukiswa kweziNdawo zaseMakhaya uMnuz Albert Mncwango, uveze ukuthi wathela izithelo umhlangano phakathi kweSilo samaZulu, uMisuzulu kaZwelithini neNgonyama Trust Board.Lo mhlangano owawungoFebhuwari, wawuhlose ukuthola izinselelo nokungaboni ngaso linye phakathi kweMbube, namanye amalungu ebhodi.UMncwango uthe noma besematasa nokuhlanganisa umbiko wekomiti ngabakuthola kodwa waba yimpumelelo."Saya KwaZulu-Natal siyikomiti lePhalamende, ukuyozitholela ngezinkinga ezikhona phakathi kweMbube nebhodi leNgonyama. Sasingayile ukuyogxeka othile noma ukuvuna othile kodwa ukuthola ngokushuba kwesimo. Noma singeke sikuveze okuningi ngokwavela ngoba kusadingeka sixoxe noNgqongqoshe womnyango, uMnuz Mzwanele Nyhontso, mayelana nombiko. Siyazazi izinselelo nezinkinga ezikhona kanti sizohlangana nongqongqoshe maduzane," usho kanje.Uthe bazohlangana noNyhontso kusasa bamchazele ngabakuthola kulo mhlangano.Mayelana nezindaba ezithinta ibhodi leNgonyama, uthe ngokwazi kwakhe ibhodi lisasebenza."Sizohlangana nebhodi ngawo uLwesithathu, ngakho lisasebenza. Njengoba noNgqongqoshe ahlangana neSilo ngemuva kokuba sihlangane nathi siyikomiti, sifuna ukuzwa kuyena ukuthi izinto zahamba kanjani," kusho uMncwango ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba ePhalamende eKapa, ngezinhlelo zekomiti.Usho lokhu nje sishubile isimo phakathi kweMbube namanye amalungu ebhodi esawakhomba indlela.Kwatholakala ukuthi iSilo sageja umgodi ngokuthi sixoshe amalungu ngoba asinawo amandla okwenza lokhu, amandla akuNyhontso ongungqongqoshe, ongaqoka futhi axoshe abantu.Isilo sakhala ngokuthi amanye amalungu akulula ukusebenza nawo ngoba awasazi nokuthi siyini.Uzwakalise ukukhathazeka ngokuhamba kancane kohlelo lokubuyiselwa umhlaba kubantu.Ukhale ngesinqumo senkantolo esamisa ukuthi kuqhutshekwe nezicelo ezintsha zokubuyiselwa kwabantu umhlaba wabo, zingakaphothulwa ezindala."Sikhathazekile ngokuhamba kancane kohlelo lokubuyiselwa kwabantu umhlaba wabo. Zibalelwa ngaphezu kuka-5000 izicelo ezisasilele emuva, iningi lazo liKwaZulu-Natal, Limpopo naseMpumalanga," kusho uMncwango.Usihlalo wekomiti lezokuThuthukiswa koMnotho kwiNdlu yoMkhandlu weziFundazwe uNksz Sonja Boshoff, uthe siyayidinga iMelika ngenxa yokuthi ubudlelwano leli lizwe elinabo nelakuleli lihlomulisa inqwaba yabasebenzi.Uthe ngaphansi kohlelo lwezohwebo i-African Growth and Opportunity Act, elaziwa nge-AGOA, elasayinwa neMelika, lusiza ngokwakha imisebenzi eyevile ku-107 000, emikhakheni eyehlukene okubalwa eyezolimo neminye. "Yingakho kudingeka ukuthi bulungiswe ubudlelwano phakathi kwelakuleli neMelika ukuze izinsiza ezifuze lezi zingasilahlekeli. Singabuyela emuva uma ngase bugcine ngokuphela lobu budlelwano."Usho kanje kulandela ukuthi uMengameli waseMelika, uMnuz Donald Trump, ehoxise uxhaso lwezempilo kuleli obelusiza empini yokusabalala kweHIV kuleli. UTrump wakwenza lokhu ngoba ekhala ngokuthi imithetho yakuleli icindezela abamhlophe ikakhulu amaBhunu, wathi ayabulawa futhi kunezinhlelo zokuwaphuca umhlaba.
KWENZEKE okungajwayelekile, unina wowesilisa osolwa ngecala lokudlwengula ingane esabisa unina kamgilwa phakathi emagcekeni eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseNtuzuma, izolo. Lokhu kwenzeke ngesikhathi kusalindwe ukuthi umsolwa (24), okuthiwa uyilungu leqembu lemigulukudu iWest, avele okokuqala ngaphambi kwemantshi.Umsolwa ubhekene necala lokudlwengula umgilwa (14) emjondolo okhona endaweni yaseNtuzuma, amyengele kuwona emsabisa ngeSonto."Uma nenza into nibaningi, uba nenkinga uma usuficwa usuwedwa, usubuzwa ukuthi ubuwenzani?” kumemeza unina kamsolwa efuna ukuthi amalungu e-EFF ebezokweseka umndeni womgilwa amuzwe.Ebhekise kunina kamgilwa, uthe akusizi ukuthemba imali ngoba ekugcineni iyaphela bese kuyalinganwa. Abahlaziye inkulumo kalona wesifazane, bathe basola ukuthi akushoyo ukusho ngoba abazali babakamgilwa bengabantu abanezwi emphakathini. Kusize ukuvela komphenyi wecala, wamkhuza ukuthi akayeke ukusabisa abazokweseka umgilwa.Yize kunjalo, kuthe sekuphunyiwe enkantolo, umfowabo kamsolwa waphinde wasongela unina kamgilwa, wamtshela ukuthi noma bangafunwa ngama-Etios amhlophe, abanendaba, abasabi lutho.Kuthe sekungenelela elinye ilungu le-EFF, limtshela ukuthi afuna ukukusho kunina kamgilwa akakusho nabo bezwa, wakhetha ukuhamba, wangabe esaqhubeka.Ngaphakathi enkantolo, imantshi ilihlehlisele u-Ephreli 8, icala ukuze umsolwa afake isicelo sebheyili, yathi uMbuso uzosebenzisa lezi zinsukwana ukuqinisekisa izinto ezifana nekheli lesibili, umsolwa angaphuma ayohlala kulo uma kwenzeka ekhishwa ngebheyili. Okunye, wukuthi kubhekwe ukuthi awekho yini amanye amacala aseke awenza phambilini, amgweba, noma asafunelwa wona, okanye awahambayo. Silandisa ngesigameko isihlobo sikamgilwa, sithe wehlelwe isehlo ephume kubo waya komunye umuzi osendaweni, ehambisa umyalezo othile."Endleleni, uhlangane nomsolwa, oqale wamthuma ukuthi ayombizela unina wengane yakhe. Athe ubashiye bexoxa, ngesikhathi eqhubeka nendlela yakhe,” kusho isihlobo.Siqhube sathi, uthe esebuya lapho abeye khona (umgilwa) uhlangane nomsolwa, ombuze ukuthi "wena ngane kanti usela?” Ube esemjikisa indlela yakhe, emsabisa ngokumsasazela ngezinja abehamba nazo."Kuthiwa umqukulile, wametshatha ehlombe, waya naye emjondolo wakhe. Wafike wamfaka khona ngewindi, ethi ukhiye wakhe uwukhohlwe ndawana thizeni,” kusho isihlobo.Sithe naye ungene ngewindi wabe esemdlwengula, wase emkhipha ngewindi futhi, maqede, bahlukana ngezindlela emgwaqweni.Kuthiwa lufika lolu daba kunina kamgilwa, wazise uyise masinyane, otheleke nezihlobo zakhe, bathatha umgilwa, bayombheka umsolwa. Kuvela ukuthi bambhadame emi nabangani bakhe komunye wemigwaqo endaweni, bamthatha, bayomnikela emaphoyiseni.Isihlobo sithe umsolwa ubabulale bephila njengoba umgilwa ebeyitshitshi elihlolwayo, futhi isigameko simkhahlameze kakhulu emqondweni. Siveze ukuthi isigameko sishaye kwezwela emndenini njengoba ikhona enye ingane emndenini edlwengulwe endaweni ngo-2022, maqede umsolwa waphunyuka kalula, inkantolo ithi ubufakazi abenele.Umdidiyeli we-EFF Youth Command kwiSub-region iNorth Central, uMnuz Mandla Ngubane, uthe okubasukumise phansi ukwanda kwesihlava sokudlwengulwa kwezingane."Sisukunyiswe ukuthi asifuni ukuthi leli cala liphelele emoyeni njengaleli elinye (lango-2022). Sifuna ukukhombisa umphakathi ukuthi le nto eyenzekayo asiyifuni,” kusho uNgubane. Uthe izigameko zalolu hlobo ezenza bengabazali, bahlalele ovalweni ngokuphepha kwezingane zabo zamantombazane, wathi kuyabakhathaza ukuthola ukuthi umsolwa uyilungu leWest nokuthi udayisa izidakamizwa. Uthe lokhu kubenza bazibuze ukuthi ingabe awekho yini amanye amacala aseke wawenza phambilini?UNgubane uthe abafuni adedelwe ngebheyili njengoba esekhombisile ukuthi akuphephile ukuba khona kwakhe emphakathini.
Kushone isalukazi, kwalimala kabi abantu abathathu kugqabuka ilangabi emzini ose-Edmundsbury Road, eBelverdere, oThongathi.I-IPSS Medical Rescue iphendule izicelo zosizo ezivela kumalungu omphakathi kubonakala intuthu kulo muzi."Sifike sathola abantu abathathu abakhishwe elilweni belimele kabi ngenxa yokusha. Kutholakale ubaba nendodana yakhe benamanxeba amabi okusha emzimbeni, omunye owesifazane ubelimele kabi ngenxa nxa yokuhuzuko," kusho abe-IPSS ngesitatimende.Ngeshwa bekukhona oyedwa wesifazane obeseshonile.Umlilo ucishwe abezicishamlilo ngaphansi kukaMasipala weTheku kanti bonke abalimele baphuthunyiswe esibhedlela. AMEHLO athe njo ePhalamende namhlanje njengoba kubhekwe eyokuphasiswa noma eyokuchithwa kwesabelomali esethulwe ngenyanga edlule nguNgqongqoshe wezeziMali, uMnuz Enoch Godongwana, esingendaba egudwini yokunyuswa kwentela efakwa uma kuthengwa impahla iVAT.I-DA izolo iyichithile eyokunyuswa kweVAT njengokwesiphakamiso sikaGodongwana ngo-0.5% kusuka ngoMeyi 1, 2025, kanti i-ANC ithe sizophasiswa lesi sabelo uma sekuhleli iPhalamende namhlanje.Emhlanganweni wayizolo wamakomiti ezeziMali ePhalamende, ibhungwe kabanzi eyalesi sabelomali ngamalungu amaqembu ahlukene njengoba iva ebelibangulwa bekuyindaba yokunyuswa kweVAT.Amaqembu bekumele aqhamuke namanye amasu angasetshenziswa uma kunganyuswa iVAT ngenxa yokuthi isabelomali singaphansi kwengcindezi. Izwe lidinga imali ukuze likwazi ukuhlangabezana nezidingo eziningi ezifaka ezemfundo, ezempilo, isikweletu sezwe nezinye izidingo ezidinga ukuxhaswa.UDkt Mark Burke okhulumela iDA kwezeziMali, ekhuluma emhlanganweni wasePhalamende, uthe bayasichitha isabelomali esinyusa iVAT ngo-0.5%, wathi abahambisani nokunyuswa kweVAT ngoba kuzoshaya abantu abahlwempu."Asifuni kube nokunyuswa kweVAT. Abantu abantulayo ibona abazoshayeka kakhulu ngokunyuswa kweVAT," usho kanje.Ekhuluma nabezindaba izolo ekuseni, uSotswebhu we-ANC uMnuz Mdumiseni Ntuli, uthe ngeke bashintshe izinto eziningi ebezifunwa yiDA ngoba bencenge ukuthi kuphasiswe isabelomali.Uthe baxoxa namaqembu ahlukene, amaningi awo avumile futhi ayahambisana nokunyuswa kweVAT."Besingeke sivume ukuthi kuqedwe nge-NYDA, kunikwe amandla amaningi uhulumeni waseWestern Cape ngoba uphethwe yi-DA siphinde sibuyekeze imithetho efana neyomshwalense wezempilo i-NHI nomthetho wokubuyiswa komhlaba. Uma iDA igcina ingasivotelanga isabelomali, kusho ukuthi kumele iphume kuhulumeni wokubambisana kwamaqembu ngoba ngeke ikwazi ukusebenza ngesabelo engahambisani naso," kusho uNtuli.UNobhala Jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, uthe abahambisani nokwenziwa yiDA ezama ukuzuza amaphuzu ezepolitiki, wathi uma iqhubeka kanje kuyogcina ngokuthi babuyekeze uhulumeni wokubambisana."Akuyona kuphela i-ANC neDA ekuhulumeni wokubambisana kodwa kunamanye amaqembu. Sixoxa nawo kanti sinethemba lokuthi sizophasiswa isabelomali kusasa ePhalamende," kusho uMbalula.Amaqembu ahlukene afuna ukuthi kuqhanyukwe nezinye izindlela zokuthola imali kunokuthi kunyuswe iVAT.UMbalula uthe ukunyuswa kweVAT akuzoba yinto nangunaphakade kodwa izobuyekezwa uma isimo somnotho siba ngcono.UMnuz Brian Molefe weMK, uthe abantu abahambisani nokunyuswa kweVAT kuleli.

ITSHE limi ngothi kubahlali baseThekwini njengoba umasipala uphakamisa ukunyusa ugesi namanzi. Umasipala uphakamisa ukuthi amanzi anyuswe ngo-15%, ugesi wona ngo-12.72%.Lesi siphakamiso siqukethwe kwisabelomali somkhandlu esingakaphothulwa esethulwe emhlanganweni womkhandlu obungoMsombuluko.Iphakamisa isabelomali, iMeya, uMnuz Cyril Xaba, ithe okwenza ukuthi umasipala uphakamise ukunyusa lezi zidingo zombili ukuthi zinyukile emuva lapho umasipala uzithenga khona.Inkampani ehlinzeka ngogesi, i-Eskom, inyuse ugesi ngo-11.32, inhlangano ehlinzeka umkhandlu ngamanzi, uMngeni-uThukela Water, yona inyuse amanzi ngo-13.5%.UXaba uthe nabo abahambisani nokunyuswa kwamanzi nogesi."Siyingxenye yemizamo yenhlangano yohulumeni basekhaya, iSA Local Government Association (Salga), yokuphika ukwenyuswa kwamanzi nogesi. I-Salga ixoxa noNgqongqoshe wezaManzi neNhlanzeko (uNkk Pemmy Majodina), silinde impendulo yakhe."Umasipala uphinde uphakamise ukuba kunyuswe imali yenhlanzeko ngo-13%, bese kuthi eyokuqoqwa kukadoti yona inyuswe ngo-9.9%.Lezi ziphakamiso kusazoxoxwa ngazo njengoba kusazovulwa nethuba lokuba abantu babeke uvo lwabo.I-DA iphumele obala yathi ayihambisani nokunyuswa kukagesi namanzi.Ohola iDA eThekwini, uMnuz Thabani Mthethwa, uthe ukunyuswa kukagesi namanzi kuzoshaya kuzwele ebantwini abahlwempu kanye nasemabhizinisi adonsa ngodizili."Sibona sengathi umasipala uyehluleka ukucabangela abantu. Sinxusa ukuthi abantu baseThekwini baphikisane nalezi ziphakamiso uma sekuvulwe ithuba lokuthi abantu balethe imibono yabo."UMthethwa uphinde wakhala nangokuthi amakhansela awazange anikezwe isikhathi esanele ukuthi alungiselele umhlangano wangoMsombuluko, wathi anikezwe imizuzu nje ewu-15 ukuba alungiselele ukuyokhuluma ngalolu daba.Ikhansela le-ActionSA, uMnuz Zwakele Mncwango, lithe kuzozwela kakhulu ukunyuswa kwamanzi nogesi."Abantu bavele bathwele kanzima kuyimanje, lezi zidingo ziyabiza kakhulu eThekwini uma uqhathanisa nakwezinye izindawo. Okubi ukuthi abantu babhekene nenkinga yokuhluswa amanzi nogesi."Ikhansela le-ANC, uMnuz Nkosenhle Madlala, lithe bayayeseka imizamo yokuphikisa ukunyuswa kwamanzi nogesi yizinkampani ezihlinzeka lezi zidingo."Ngaso sonke isikhathi kufanele senze isiqiniseko sokuthi abantu bayakwazi ukukhokhela izidingo zomkhandlu, siphinde senze isiqiniseko sokuthi umasipala awungeni enkingeni yokuswela imali yokukhokhela izinkampani ezihlinzeka lezidingo."Sisonke isabelomali sikaMasipala weTheku sanonyaka singu-R78 billion.
YAZI kahle kamhlophe i-ANC ukuthi amanye amaqembu akuhulumeni wokubambisana angaziphumela kulobu budlelwano ngoba engeneme ngezinto ezithile.Le nhlangano ithe la maqembu azobe ezikhiphe wona, yona ayiphethe mbazo yokuwanquma.Lokhu kushiwo nguNobhala Jikelele we-ANC uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, othe abanazo izinhloso zokukhipha amaqembu kulo hulumeni, kodwa azozikhipha wona.UMbalula uthe uma kukhona amaqembu azikhipha wona, bazoqhubeka bayibambe ishisa."Abantu bazozikhipha bona kuhulumeni, asiphethe zembe lokubakhipha. Sizimisele ngokuqhubeka namaqembu esinawo kwiGNU kodwa uma kukhona abanganeme bangashiya," kusho uMbalula.Uthe abangenanga kwiGNU ngoba bezibeka bona phambili kodwa babebeka abantu bakuleli.Uchithe nokuthi ababakhokhele abasebenza kule nhlangano."Siyakuvuma ukuthi siphuzule ukukhokhela abasebenzi. Sinezinselelo zemali kodwa lokho akusho ukuthi siwile. Abasebenzi asibakhokhelanga ngosuku okumele bathole ngalo imali yabo," kusho uMbalula.Ukusho lokhu ekhuluma nabezindaba izolo ngemuva komhlangano wesigungu esiphezulu se-ANC ngempelasonto.Uthe bayasiveza nesimo sabo sezimali kwikhomishini eyengamele ukhetho kuleli.UMbalula uthe kulo mhlangano wenhlangano zonke izinhlaka ezisanda kukhethwa kumele ziqeqeshwe."Ngisho isigungu esiphezulu sizoqeqeshwa ngoba wonke umuntu osanda kukhethwa, kumele aqeqeshwe. Noma ibuphi ubuholi obuzokhethwa buzoqeqeshwa," kusho uMbalula.UMbalula uthe bazimisele ngokuthi ungawi uhulumeni wokubambisana kwamaqembu kuhulumeni ohlanganisa amaqembu.Uthe bayixoxile nendaba yokubuyekezwa kwamadlelandawonye ahlanganisa i-ANC, SACP, Cosatu neSanco.Usho lokhu nje iSACP yamemezela ukuthi izongenela ukhetho ngokuzimela, ngenxa yokuthi ikhathele indaba yokuthi akukho zinyathelo ezithathwayo ngezithinta ukubuyekezwa kwamadlelandawonye.I-SACP ithi akusekho ukujikela emuva iyaqhubeka nalesi sinyathelo.UMbalula uveze nokuthi kuzoba nomhlangano iNational General Council (NGC), yale nhlangano yokubheka eminye yemigomo okwavunyelwana ngayo engqungqutheleni yokukhetha ubuholi bukazwelonke eyayiseNasrec."Le NGC izobanjwa kusuka kuDisemba 8 kuya kuDisemba 12, eGoli. Sizobheka ezinye zezinqumo esazithatha engqungqutheleni kazwelonke," kusho uMbalula.
INKAKHA yomculi waseMpangeni, uMaqhinga Hadebe, usaqhubeka nokuqhakambisa nokuqhakambisa umculo wakuleli phesheya kwezilwandle.Lo mculi ubeke induku ebandla eGermany ngenoni aliqophe nomethuli wezinhlelo zethelevishini wakulelizwe, uKarin Kedem elisihloko sithi Sthandwa Sami.Lo mucu ohlanganise ulimi lwesiZulu, isiJalimane nesiNgisi, ushaywe ngesigqi sikamaskandi oyi-Afro soul. Njengamanje lengoma seyiqalile ukuthakaselwa yizinhlanga ezihlukahlukene eGermany. Ngiyajabula ukuthi sikwazile ukuyenza. Abantu sebengayibheka ezinkundleni zokuxhumana okuyilapho idayisa khona," kuchaza uMaqhinga obuye asebenze neShabalala Rhythm noDavid "Qadasi" Jenkins.UKarin uthe waqala ukuchazwa wumculo kaMaqhinga mhlazane beqala ukuhlangana naye, ehamba noQadasi. "Ngonyaka owedlule ngaze ngabenzela umcimbi esontweni, owaba yimpumelelo. Baze bayodla isidlo sakusihlwa ekhaya."Uthe kubelula ukwenza leli noni noMaqhinga ngenxa yokuthi benoQadasi bazithobile. Ngaphandle komculo, uKarin uthe ubebuye axhase uMaqhinga ngezimpahla zebhola njengoba eneqembu alikhuthazayo eMpangeni."Ngakho bengithi uma ngiza eThekwini ngimphathele i-suitcase eligcwele izimpahla zezemidlalo. Noma kwenzeka eza eGermany, ngiyamphathisa zona. "UKarin usesebenze nabaculi abaningi bakamaskandi kanye nabezinye izinhlobo kuleli. Abalandeli bomculo kamaskandi baze bametha elikaJaivakazi ngenxa yokuthi usebenze kakhulu nomculi kamaskandi uMzo "Jaiva Zimnike" Khanyeza.
ASHAYA amakhala amalungu ePhalamende ngohlelo lokugunyazwa kwabokufika ababalelwa ku-3 000, ukuthi babe nezipaza. Babuza ukuthi ngabe kwalandelwa yonke imigudu yezomthetho ngaphambi kokuthola lezi zimvume?Amalungu asola ukuthi abokufika bagwaza ukuze bagunyazwe futhi asola nokuthi basebenzisa abantu bakuleli ukuthi bababhalisele izitolo.Lokhu kuhlaluke ngesikhathi uMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu, uvele ngaphambi kwekomiti lasePhalamende ngezakamuva ezithinta ukubhaliswa kwezitolo kuleli.Uhulumeni waqala uhlelo lokubhaliswa kwezitolo ama-spaza shop, emva kokushona kwezingane kusolwa ukuthi zidle ukudla okunoshevu okudayiswa kulezi zitolo.Kulo mhlangano kuvele ukuthi kwafakwa izicelo ezingu-87 407 wezicelo zokubhaliswa kwezitolo kusuka ngoJulayi 1, 2024 kuya kuFebhuwari 28, 2025.Kulezi zicelo kugunyazwe ezingu-23 072, kanti kulezi ezingu-2 977 ezabantu bokufika. Ilungu lekomiti uNkk Nombiselo Sompa-Masiu, lithe alikholwa ukuthi bonke abokufika abagunyaziwe balandele imigudu yezomthetho.Likhale nangokuthi abanye bokufika abanalezi zitolo abayikhokhi ngisho intela, inzuzo abayenzayo bayiyisa emazweni abo."Ngiyasola ukuthi akubona bonke abokufika abalandele yonke imigudu ebekiwe ukuze bathole izimvume zokuba nama-spaza shop. Sifuna ukwazi ukuthi ikuphi okuzokwenzeka kulabo abazotholakala besebenza ngaphandle kwezimvume," usho kanje.UMnuz Zwakele Mthethwa elinye ilungu lekomiti, ukhale ngokuthi awulandelwa umthetho uma kuvulwa izitolo emalokishini."Uvuka sekukhona ubhazabhaza we-container ongazi ukuthi ufike nini. Akulandelwa imigudu uma kuvulwa lezi zitolo ezithe chithi saka emalokishini."UNksz Hlengiwe Mkhaliphi we-EFF, uthe bafuna ukwazi ukuthi kwenzakalani ngalaba okwafa izingane ngemuva kokuthenga ukudla kulezi zitolo.Uthe bayazi ukuthi abanye abantu bakuleli basiza abantu bokufika ngokuthi babafakele izicelo zokuthi bavule lezi zitolo."Nentela abayikhokhi abokufika bathatha imali bayiyise emazweni abo. Sifuna ukwazi ngempela ukuthi kwenzakalani ngababulala izingane ezathenga ukudla kulezi zitolo," usho kanje.UMqondisi jikelele eMnyangweni uMnuz Mbulelo Tshangana, uthe bayazi ukuthi kukhona abakuleli abasebenzisana nabokufka ukubasiza bababhalisele izitolo.Uthe indaba yezitolo nomkhonyovu othinta ubunikazi bazo kuyinkinga enkulu ebaphathisa ngekhanda."Angicabangi ukuthi ngaphansi kwalolu hlelo esilwenzayo sizozixazulula zonke izinkinga ezikhona. Umsusa wayo yonke lento wukushona kwezingane ezindaweni ezehlukene emva kokudla ukudla okudayiswa kulezi zitolo emalokishini," usho kanje.Iningi lezicelo zama-spaza shop zivela eGauteng naKwaZulu-Natal.UTshangana uthe bazogxila kuzona zonke izitolo ezidayisa ukudla ukuze kungashoni abantu abazothenga ukudla kulezi zitolo.Uveze ukuthi ezicelweni abazitholile ezingu-32 824 ezabokufika kuleli."Abazotholakala besebenza ngaphandle kwezimvume, umthetho uzothatha indawo yawo. Kunezitolo esezivaliwe kwaboshwa nabathile kodwa lolu lwazi lusohlakeni iNational Joint Operational and Intelligence Structure (NATJOINTS).UNgqongqoshe womnyango uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa, uthe abazange basilule isikhathi sokubhaliswa kwama-spaza shop kuleli.Uthe abangazange bagunyazwe abakwazi ukuqhubeka nokusebenza kodwa basangaya komasipala bayofaka izicelo."Uma ulala uvuka usufuna ukuvula ibhizinisi, ungaya komasipala uyofaka isicelo. Uma usugunyaziwe uyakwazi ukusebenza. Nangonyaka ozayo ungakwazi ukuya kofaka isicelo sokuvula isitolo, akuvaliwe lokho," kusho uHlabisa.
OKUHLE nokumnandi ngale mboni wukuthi igabe ngamathuba ayohlale ekhona futhi okungasoze kwaphela isidingo sawo ngoba silokhu sande njalo isidingo sokuthi kwakhiwe imigwaqo futhi kulungiswe ingqalasidinza eyamene nezokwakha.”Isho njalo enye yezimenenja yoMnyango wezoKwakha wophiko lwezemigwaqo ezweni iSouth African National Roads Agency SOC Ltd (SANRAL), uMnuz Trevor Gumbi, ngenkathi ekhuthaza abantu ukuthi bangawubukeli kude umkhakha wezokwakh. Wathi awuchaze ungeminye yemiqoka ezweni nokuyohlale kunesidingo sayo emhlabeni.UGumbi ubengesinye sezikhulumi zesigcawu zokucobelana ngolwazi lwemboni yezokwakha enxanxatheleni yezitolo iBridge City, KwaMashu. Ubuyingxenye yomcimbi wombukiso wamabhizinisi waminyaka yonke iDurban Business Fair, ohlelwa wuMasipala weTheku. "Uhulumeni uzivulile izandla kosomabhizinisi bakithi abamnyama abalambele amathuba okuchuma kule mboni. Into esemqoka wukukhuthalela ukulandela yonke imigomo efanele ukuze babe sethubeni lokuthola amathuba emisebenzi azochumisa amabhizinisi abo. Okuzosiza ukuthi kufukulwe umnotho waselokishini,” kucebisa uGumbi.Esinye isikhulu seKwaMashu Business Chamber, ihlangano engenzi inzuzo ebhekele ukuxhumana nezinhlaka zikahulumeni ekufukuleni intsha yakuleli lokisishi, sithe nakuba sisithokozela isigcawu sosomabhizinisi, kodwa kusanenselelo enkulu yokuthi kuthuntuthwe akubize ngamazenze abamba abantu abasha basemalokishini.Uthe kumele kusetshenziswe lo mcimbi wombukiso wosomabhizinisi ukuthola isibalo sabantu abasha abahlala KwaMashu namaphethelo, abanye babo abebengekho emcimbini kodwa okungenzeka ukuthi bakhona abasemakwabo abebekhona emcimbini, okungathi uma kuqiniswa ukuxhumana phakathi kwabo kwazeke ngabo namathalente abo."Asivakashele abantu abasha basemalokishini lapho behleli khona ngoba kuyiqiniso elingenakuphikwa ukuthi abanye babo abasayingeni indaba yezinhlelo ezinjengalolu ngoba abasathembi lutho ehlelwa wuhulumeni. Mhlawumbe uma singaxhumana nabo lapho behleli khona, sakhe ubudlelwano nabo, kukude lapho esingaya khona,” usho kanje.Livula umcimbi ngokusemthethweni, ilungu lesigungu sophiko lwezokuhlela nokuthuthukisa umnotho kuMasipala weTheku, iKhansela uThembo Ntuli, lithe kuyabakhathaza ukubona intsha yasemalokishini nasezindaweni zasemakhya isalela emuva ngamabhizinisi ayo. Yingakho bebone kukuhle ukuqhubeka nezinhlelo zokuhambela amalokishini nezindawo ezahlukene ezakhele iTheku ukuze bacobelele osomabhizinisi abasafufusa ngamasu nolwazi lokuchumisa amabhizinisi. Ezinye izikhulumi ebezikhona kulesi sigcawu nguMnuz Sthembiso Madlala we-Association of Social Engagement Facilitators of Southern Africa, noMnuz Wonder Jaca weBlack Business Federation. Namhlanje umcimbi uzoqhubeka ngawo umbukiso wosomabhizinisi, bese kuba nesigcawu sokucobelana ngolwazi kosomabhizinisi besifazane, lapho okuzobe kunezikhulumi oNksz Fezile Mdletshe weFezile Fashion Skills Academy, Nksz Delisile Mncube wophiko lwabesifazane, intsha nabakhubazekile eMnyangweni wezemiSebenzi yoHulumeni nezoKwakha, Dkt Lindiwe Kunene ofundisa ngezamabhizinisi e-UKZN, noNksz Happy Ngidi onamava kwezokumaketha nokuxhumana.Lo mcimbi uzosongwa kusasa, kanti okuhle kakhulu ngawo wukuthi kungenwa mahhala!
UKHAMBA lubukeka lufuze imbiza kosanda kudla umhlanganiso emqhudelwaneni weBig Brother Mzansi, u-Akhonamabhele "Sweet Guluva" Mbhele ngoba uyazifela ngokucula. Kanti noyise ongasekho, uMlungisi "Waya 77" Mbhele, wayesendimeni yokungcebeleka. UWaya (23), owashonela esibhedlela iPrince Mshiyeni Memorial eMlaza ngo-2022, wayenoxhaxha lwamakhono. Ngaphandle kokucula ikwaito, uWaya wayebhala amafilimu nemidlalo yethelevishini.Yize azalelwa eMlaza, kodwa abazali bakhe bamfudukisla eMzumbe. Yilapho enza khona imfundo yakhe yamabanga aphansi.Esephothule uGrade 12, uWaya wabuyela eThekwini, eseyokwenza izifundo zokuba wungcweti wokusebenzisa ulimi eDurban University of Technology (DUT), lapho ahlangana nesihlabani sekwaito uL'vovo Derrango.Eseziphothulile iziqu zakhe zeLanguage Practice, uWaya wasebenzela kancane umlungu maqede washiya phansi ngenxa yokuthi wayebizelwe emculweni.Wakhipha icwecwe ehambisana noDJ Black nomrepha owayeyisosha uSniper, nabo abangasekho, bezibiza ngeConverse.Akagcinanga emculweni, ngo-2008, uWaya 77 ebambisene no-Andile Buwa, baqopha ifilimu esihloko sithi The Puzzle, eyayibophele uZolisa Xaluva (Smoke & Mirrors) noZakhona Sodlaka (Gqeberha).Kuleyo filimu wayelingisa enguDJ. Ngo-2009 wakhipha umucu wekwaito ehambisana nengwazi yomculo kamaskandi uPhuzekhemisi, osihloko sithi Ubuhle Bakho.Wabe eseqopha ngaphansi kwesitebela sombhali wemidlalo yeshashalazi ongasekho uMbongeni Ngema, iKZN Music House.Ezinye izingoma azakhele ngazo udumo zithi Ngiyachoma nethi Susa. Ngokubambisana noSandile Sibiya, basungula umcimbi kamaskandi ngenhloso yokubulalana kwabantu basemahostela, iKhuzimpi Maskandi Festival. Ushone esefundisa esikoleni sezibuciko se-Afro Soul, iKabawo Academy futhi engumsakazi wohlelo lwe-hip hop esiteshini somphakathi waKwaMashu, iVibe 94.7 FM.Unina kaSweet Guluva, uBongiwe Zwane, ucashunwe ethi indodana yakhe wayithola esenza unyaka wokuqala enyuvesi futhi kwamthwalisa kanzima. Uveze ukuthi indodana yakhe beyimhlupha ifuna ukungena emkhakheni wezokungcebeleka, wagcina eyivumele.
BAZOZIFAKA kunoxhaka omasipala abazobhubhudla izigidi zamarandi ezabelwe ukulungisa umonakalo odalwe izikhukhula.UMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu uthe uzoyibamba esabelweni esitholwa omasipala kuMgcinimafa yonke imali ezomoshwa yimikhandlu eyabelwe ingxenye ka-R1.4 billion ukulungisa umonakalo odalwe yizikhukhula.UNgqongqoshe woMnyango, uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa, uthe bazokuqapha ngeso lokhozi ukusebenza kwale mali.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba ePitoli, izolo. Iningi lomasipala ababelwe izigidi zamarandi basesifundazweni iKwaZulu-Natal, lapho izikhukhula zihlasele khona kulandelana.UHlabisa uthe omasipala abanikezwe imali babekelwe imibandela eqinile."Omasipala kufanele balethe imibiko yanyanga zonke, lapho bezokube bechaza khona ukuthi yini asebeyenzile. Kuleyo mibiko kufanele balethe nobufakazi basebhange obukhombisa ukuthi imalini esele. Noma ngabe imali ayikaqali ukusebenza, omasipala kufanele balethe ubufakazi obukhombisa ukuthi isekhona ebhange, ayikathintwa."UHlabisa uthe uma omasipala sebeqedile ukusebenzisa imali kuzofanele balethe umbiko okhombisayo ukuthi imali isebenze kanjani."Esizokugada ukuthi ngabe imali yenze izinto obekufanele izenze, nanokuthi ngabe ngabe uyagculisa yini umsebenzi owenziwe. Uma sike sathola ukuthi imali yenze enye into, sizoyibamba esabelweni esizotholwa iloyo masipala onyakeni wezimali ozayo."UHlabisa uthe kunezinkinga ezintathu abajwayele ukubhekana nazo uma babele omasipala imali yokulungisa umonakalo odalwe izikhukhula.Uthe inkinga yokuqala ukuthi abanye omasipala bavele baqashe abantu abazokwenza umsebenzi ongekho ezingeni; eyesibili ukuthi abanye omasipala bavele bayisebenzisele ezinye izinto imali; eyesithathu ukuthi abanye omasipala bayahluleka ukusebenzisa ngesikhathi imali abasuke beyabelwe."Kokunye ubona sebeqedile ukuthi umsebenzi obuwenziwa awukho ezingeni. Kwabanye omasipala imali iyahlala isikhathi eside ingasetshenziswa. Size sigcine sesiphoqeleka ukuthi sithi abayibuyise. Kokunye omasipala bathatha le mali baholele ngayo abasebenzi. Kwesinye isikhathi omasipala bathi bazokwakha umgwaqo ongu-3km kodwa ekugcineni kwakhiwe umgwaqo ongaphansi kuka-3km."UHlabisa uthe omasipala banikezwe kuze kube u-Agasti, ukuba basebenzise le mali, wathi abazohluleka ukuyisebenzisa ngesikhathi bazophoqwa ukuthi bayibuyise.Bangu-14 omasipala baKwaZulu-Natal abathole ingxenye yale mali, kanti sebebonke bathole uR200 million.UHlabisa uthe kudingeka u-R11 billion ukulungisa umonakalo odalwe yizikhukhula KwaZulu-Natal, Eastern Cape, Mpumalanga, Free State, naseLimpopo.Uthe ngoMeyi bazophinde futhi babe enye imali."Okwamanje iyona mali esiyitholile, sisalinde uMgcinimafa ukuba asinike enye. Uma sekuphasiswe isabelomali, sizobona ukuthi imalini enye esizoyithola."
UPHELELWE ngamandla wachiphiza izinyembezi uSphamandla Dhlomo (27) ngesikhathi iNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini izolo imgweba odilikajele abangu-7 neminyaka engu-15 nengu-10, yeleka nengu-5 ngaphezulu ngamacala okubulala eMlaza.UDhlomo ulahlwe amacala ngenxa yesehlakalo sokubulawa kwabangu angu-9 esenzeka ngo-Agasti 11, 2023, kwaQ eMlaza. Ubekade ethwesewe uMbuso amacala awu-13; kuwona okukhona ukubulala abantu abayisishiyagalolunye, amabili okuzama ukubulala, elokugqekeza nelokutholakala nesibhamu esingekho emthethweni.Utheswe amacala okubulala okuhleliwe oMlungisi Zuma, Phakamani Sibusiso Dlamini, Maxwell Sibisi, Regional Bongimpilo Ngema, Thabani Ngcobo, Mhlengi Khathi, Ayabongwa Mbayise, Sifundo Sibusiso Dlamini noSifiso Cele.IJaji u-Esther Johanna Steyn lithe limgweba odilikajele abangu-7 ngesenzo sakhe esithe saba nonya olukhulu sokubulala. Lamnikeza eminye engu-15 ngelokufa kodwa elithe kwakungahleliwe. Lamgixabeze ngeminyaka angu-10 ngecala lokuzama ukusoconga uMnuz Phiwayinkosi Sibisi nentombi yakhe uNksz Mbali Shangase.Lileke ngeminyaka engu-5 ngaphezulu ngecala lokugqekeza ezindlini zabafi. Ngemuva kwalesi sigwebo uDhlomo ubonakale eciphiza izinyembezi.Ijaji alizange liyithi nje vu eyokuthi lezi zigwebo uDhlomo uzozidonda zonke kanye kanye. Kwale noma ummeli wakhe u-Advocate Mathomane emncengela ethi ungumfanyana nje osemncane owalingwa yingcidezi yabangani wagcina esephila impilo engalungile emphakathini.Uqhubekile ummeli wakhe wathi inkantolo ingambulali kakhulu ngesigwebo ngoba inhloso yesigwebo ukuhlumelelisa isimilo kuloyo ongumoni. Uthe uDhlomo unengane anayo futhi ukukhula ngaphandle kukayise kungumnyombo wempilo agcine esezithola esengena ogibeni lwayo."Ngiyacela nkosi yenkantolo ukuba konke lokhu ukubukisise kahle,'' kusho ummeli wakhe u-Advocate Mathomana. Noma kunjalo ijaji lithe baningi abantu abakhula ngaphandle kwabazali kodwa abaphili ngokuchitha igazi labanye. Liqhubekile lezwakalisa ukuthi uDhlomo ubonakala ewumuntu ongenalo nhlobo nje uzwelo futhi ongakaze akhombise nje ukuzisola ngakwenza."Awukaze ukhombise ukuzisola futhi awukaze uzame nokuxolisa ebantwini abaningi owabazwisa ubuhlungu ngowakwenza kubona. Ungumuntu ongakukhathalele ukuthi abanye abantu baphatheke kabi kangakanani,'' lisho kanjena limbuka emehlweni uDhlomo.Likhale ngezibazi elithe zishiywe uDhlomo kumalungu emindeni yabafi. Lithe isigwebo salo sibheke kakhulu uhlobo lwecala olwenziwe uDhlomo, uzinzo emphakathini kanye nokungenzeka uma kungathiwa bayanda emphakathini abantu abenza izenzo ezifana nezikaDhlomo.UDhlomo ugwetshwa nje loyo owayengummangalelwa wesibili kuleli cala, uMnuz Zimisele Ngcongo, kuvele ukuthi wendela koyisemkhulu ngoJanuwari ngonyaka owedlule.Ngaphambi kokuba kuwe isigwebo umshushisi obemele uMbuso u-Advocate Macdonald ushayele isipikili sokugcina enxenxa inkantolo ukuba imgixabeze ngesigwebo esinesisindo uDhlomo. Okuqaphelekile ukuthi nayizolo enkantolo beziqinile kakhulu ezokuphepha. Bekugcwele amaphoyisa abefake umfaniswano nabengawufakile.Owesilisa obephethe isikhwama esikhulu egaxe isibhamu esikhulu owabonakala ngosuku lwesinqumo ubekhona futhi nayizolo.Umthombo wangaphakathi ngosuku okwakuphuma ngalo isinqumo wapotshozela Isolezwe ukuthi lokhu kumayelana nejaji elizwakalise ukuthi lizizwa lingaphephile kuleli cala.Kunabesilisa ebebezokweseka uDhlomo abezwakale bekhuluma naye bethi makakhululeke bazogoduka naye. Lokhu kakucaci ukuthi bebezokenza kanjani futhi nini.Izolo ijaji limbize ngegama owesilisa waseMlaza ohweba ngezidakamizwa osebenzisana noDhlomo lithe igama lakhe uFani Fani.Ngaphambilini kwake kwaphazamiseka ukuqulwa kwaleli cala ngesikathi uDhlomo ehlaselwa ukugula okungaqondakali waze waphuthunyiswa esibhedlela esingaphakathi ejele eWestville.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi uDhlomo ngaphambilini wawaphika wonke amacala, wathi kusezandleni zoMbuso ukuthi ulethe ubufakazi obuphathekayo bokuthi uyena owakwenza.Ezinkundleni zokuxhumana uDhlomo ubaziwa ngelikaThayelakunomoya-umshikashika. Esegwetshiwe ukhulume nabesilisa ebebezomeseka ebakineza uplastiki omnyama bazama ukukhuluma naye kwabonakala ukuthi akathandi ukukhuluma nabo.Eseqedile ukukhuluma nalaba besilisa amaphoyisa amqhubile ashona naye phansi kwaphela kanjalo ngoThayelakunomoya-umshikashika.
UMnyango Wezamafutha Nezimbiwa ukhiphe isitatimende ngokwehla kwentengo kaphethiloli okuzoqala ukusebenza ngoLwesithathu, mhla zi-2 Ephreli 2025.NgoMashi kube nokwehla okukhulu kwamanani entengo kawoyela emhlabeni wonke njengoba izimakethe zinyakaziswa izenzo zikamengameli waseMelika uDonald Trump ngezimpi zezohwebo, nokuyinto eqinise amandla eRandi.Lokhu kuholele ekuncipheni okukhulu emananini kaphethiloli ngoMashi yize kuphazamiseke kancane ngokunyuka kwezintela.Amanani azokwehliswa ngo-58 no-72 cents ilitha ku-93 no-95 kaphethroli, bese kuthi udizili uphakathi kuka-84 no-86 cents ilitha.
KUHAMBE ngamagama enkehli embukisweni wosomabhizinisi waminyaka yonke iDurban Business Fair ebisenxanxatheleni yezitolo iBridge City, KwaMashu, ngoLwesihlanu kuya ngeSonto, njengoba kuhlomule abantu abasha basemalokishini ngamathuba ehlukene.Kulo mcimbi obekuhlangene kuwona abatshalimali, amakhasimende, yizikhungo zemfundo ezahlukene nosomabhizinisi - oningi labo ngabasafufusa, bekuhlangane abantu abangaphezu kwa-9 000 ngenhloso yokufukulana emikhakheni ehlukene abakuyona.Okuqapheleke embukisweni walo nyaka wukuthi kubekwe eqhulwini ukuhlomisa osomabhizinisi ngamathuba emfundo, njengoba uMasipala weTheku ubambisane nesikhungo sezemfundo esizimele, iNew Bridge Graduate Training Institute, ngenhloso yokuhlomulisa osomabhizinisi abawu-10 abaneminyaka ephakathi kwa-18 kuya ku-35 ngomfundaze wezifunzo ze-Business Administration i-NQF Level 5. Omunye walabo somabhizinisi abawu-10 abahlomule kulolu hlelo, olunikezela ngomfundaze wokufunda ka-R50 000 osomabhizinisi ngamunye, kube wuNksz Thandeka Ntombela waseNtuzuma, othe leli thuba lizoyishintsha kakhulu impilo yakhe futhi ubona lizoba wusizo ngamacebo azomsiza ukuthi aqale ibhizinisi lakhe ngomuso.Enye yezimenenja zaseNew Bridge Graduate Training Institute uMnuz Nathi Ndlovu ugcizelele ukuthi lolu hlelo lungenye yezindlela abaphosa ngayo itshe esivivaneni ukusiza ukuthi intsha icijeke emakhonweni azosiza ukuthi ikwazi ukufukula umnotho wesifundazwe.UNdlovu uthe laba abawu-10 abahlomule kulolu hlelo bazoqala izifundo zabo ngoJuni, nonyaka, ophikweni lwabo olusePinetown noluseMusgrave, eThekwini. Okunye okuhlabahlosile okwenzeke kulo mcimbi wumbuthwano wokuthekela ulwazi lwamathuba emboni yezokwakkha, iConstruction Development Indaba okuvulwe umcimbi ngayo ngoLwesihlanu, kwaba ngowokucobela abesifazane ngolwazi lwamabhinisi emikhakha eyahlukene, obungoMgqibelo iWomen Economic Empowerment. Kuwo lo mcimbi iJunior Chamber Internatonal yethule ngokusemthethwnei omunye umcimbi, i-Africa and Middle East Conference ozoba seThekwini, ngoMeyi 21 no-22. Usihlalo wekomiti lophiko lwezokuthuthukisa umnotho nokuhlela, iKhansela uThembo Ntuli, uthe bajabule ngokuthi balokhu beqhubeke njalo ukwenza izinhlelo ezizothuthukisa osomabhizinisi abasafufusa, okuzosiza ukufukula umnotho wesifundazwe nomphakathi.
KUTHIWA isikhiphe izidumbu impi eshisa phansi phakathi kwamalungu eqembu lemigulukudu, iWest, eNanda, njengoba kuvela ukuthi abanga isikhundla sobengumholi osanda kubulawa.UMnqobi "Namba 10" Nzimande (22) waseMzomusha, eNanda, wadutshulwa amaphoyisa ekupheleni kukaJanuwari, etholana phezulu namaphoyisa eCottonlands, eVerulam. Kuthiwa wayengumholi waleli qembu lemigulukudu, ovutha ekhaleni. Ngokubika kwamalungu omphakathi asezindaweni ezehlukene eNanda, KwaMashu naseNtuzuma, leli qembu beliwuhlalise lubhojozi umphakathi ngobugebengu.Kuthiwa amalungu alo abamba inkunzi esebenzisa indlakadla, edlwengula futhi engakunqeni ukuchitha igazi. Ngokusho kwamaphoyisa ngesikhathi ethela othulini uMnqobi, kwase kuphele eside isikhathi emfundela amacala angaphezu kuka-20, athi kuwona kukhona angu-10 okubulala. Ngokuthola kweSolezwe ngomthombo walo oseNanda, emva komngcwabo wakhe, kuqale umbango wokuthi ngubani ozothatha izintambo zokuhola iqembu."Lo mbango uqale ukuthatha elinye igxathu emasontweni ambalwa edlule, sesizwa kuthiwa sebeyadubulana, babulalane, bebanga isikhundla,” kusho umthombo.Uthe esigamekweni sakamumva esenzeke eNhlungwane, ngoLwesine, kudubulane ababili, bafa. Umsunguli weNtuzuma Neighbourhood Watch, esabalale nakwamanye amalokishi eThekwini, uMnuz Andile Jali ukuqinisekisile lokhu.Uthe bezwe ngokwenzekilebesemhlanganweni wokulwa nobugebengu esiteshini samaphoyisa eNanda."Sitshelwe ukuthi amaphoyisa aphuthuma endaweni yesigameko ngoba sekubulalane amalungu eWest,” kusho uJali. Uthe akukho okunye abakutholayo ngalezi zigameko ngaphandle kokuthi babanga ukuphatha njengoba kwashona umholi wabo."Manje kuthiwa baningi abazibona befanelwe ukuthatha isikhundla,” kusho uJali.Uthe okunye abakutholile ukuthi lo mbango usuholele ekutheni bathi chithi saka ezindaweni ezehlukene, njengoba sekukhona ukungazwani kahle kubangwa isikhundla.Ukuqinisekisile ukuthi bazwile ukuthi zikhona ezinye izigameko zokubulalana ezandulela esangoLwesine. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uConstable Thenjiswa Ngcobo uthe amaphoyisa asesiteshini saseNanda aphenya amacala okubulala kulandela ukudutshulwa, kubulawe amadoda amabili eNhlungwane ngoLwesine.
KUBE ongaphansi nongaphezulu abafana bebamba imoto yemali kuM25 KwaMashu ngoMsombuluko ntambama.Kuthiwa kubonakale ngenqwaba yabasolwa abebehlome beyizingovolo bedilika ezimotweni ezimbili bamisa ngenkani imoto ebithwele imali. Ngokubika kwabenkampani yonogada ezifikele mathuphankule ndawo I reaction Unit South Africa, bathole ukuthi abasolwa banamathisele iziqhumane emotweni yemali ukuze ovuleke.a"La madoda aphuce onogada izibhamu aphinde antshontsha isamba semali esingadalulwanga. Badubule kaningi besebenzisa izikhali ezisezingeni eliphezulu ngaphambi kokuthi basuke ngesivinini esiphezulu ngeFord SUV emhlophe kanye neToyota Corolla esiliva."kusho iRUSA.Iqhubeke yathi ilungu labo belizulazula endaweni eseduze ngesikhathi libona izimoto ziphambana nendlela kuM25 lahlaba umkhosi libikela ozakwabo namaphoyisa. Kutholakale isibhambu esincane endaweni yesehlo okukholakala ukuthi ngesabasolwa.
UKHATHAZEKILE uMphathiswa wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka, ngothisha ababalelwa ku-40 000, ababhuquza emakhaya neziqu.Lokhu sekwenze waqhamuka nesu ukuze labo thisha bayeke ukujika nelanga baphinde bacoshe nesipiliyoni ngokuthi aphakamise ukuthi bafakwe ohlelweni lwabazosiza ezikoleni.Lolu wuhlelo olungaphansi kukaMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa lokuzama ukunika intsha engatohozi isipiliyoni somsebenzi, kanti lwaziwa nge-Presidential Youth Employment Initiative (PYEI).Ngaphansi kwalo kuqashwa intsha ebalelwa ngaphezu kuka-300 000 kuleli, isikhashana ukuze ifake isandla isize othisha ezikoleni. UHlomuka uthe useke wayixoxa noNgqongqoshe kazwelonke, uNksz Siviwe Gwarube eyalesi siphakamiso, egqugquzela ukuthi kufakwe okungenani labo thisha kunokuthi kugxilwe entsheni eno-matric."Cishe ibalelwa ku-35 000 kuya ku-40 000 intsha okumele ithole amathuba ngaphansi kwalolu hlelo lukamengameli eKZN. Kumele iqale umsebenzi ngoMeyi 1. Sithi ayingabhekwa eyeminyaka yomuntu uma kuthiwa kukhona uthisha oneminyaka engu-40, akafakwe ngaphansi kwalolu hlelo kungaze kuthiwe kufuneka umuntu omusha," kusho uHlomuka ekhuluma ekomitini lezeMfundo esiShayamthetho muva nje ngesabelomali somnyango.Uthe enye ingxenye yemali yokukhokhela laba basizi, izoqhamuka kuMgcinimafa esifundazweni, kuthi enye iqhamuke ngaphansi kweHhovisi likaMengameli."Besiphakamise kanje ngoba uma kukhona abantu abaneziqu kungani kungafakwa bona? Sifuna kube naleso sivumelwano ukuze silwe nenkinga yothisha abangasebenzi," kusho uHlomuka.UHlomuka ubuye wakhala ngokuhamba kancane kohlelo lokuqashwa kothisha ezikhaleni u-Post Level 1, ezazikhangiswe nyakenye."Sakhangisa izikhala ezevile ku-700, zika-Post Level 1 ngo-Agasti ngonyaka odlule. Uhlelo lokuvala lezi zikhala luhamba kancane kakhulu, abakafiki ngisho ku-60% asebeqashiwe. Lolu hlelo lubambezeleke ezigungwini ezilawula izikole okuyizo okumele zibe matasa nohlelo lokuphonsa imibuzo abazoqashwa," kukhala uHlomuka.Uthe uma lolu hlelo luhamba kancane kanje, kuzoba nezinselelo uma sekumele kuqashwe abazosiza othisha ezikoleni okumele baqale ngoMeyi.Ibamba likasihlalo wekomiti lezemfundo esiShayamthetho, uNksz Hlengiwe Mavimbela, lishaqekile ngesibalo sothisha abangasebenzi esifundazweni.UNksz Mavimbela njengoba kunesidingo sokuthi kube nabasizi bothisha ezikoleni kukhomba khona ukuthi kunesidingo sokuthi kube nothisha kulezo zikhala."Kumele kufakwe abantu abaneziqu kunokuthi kubhekelelwe abano-matric kuphela. Akuwenzi umqondo ukuthi bengathi bekhona abaneziqu kodwa bashiywe ngaphandle."Uthe labo abano-matric sebengangezwa uma kungukuthi zisekhona izikhala kulezo zikole.Ukhale nangeigungu ezilawula izikole ngokuhamba kancane kohlelo lokuqasha othisha abaku-Post Level 1, wathi lezi zigungu azibacabangeli abafundi.
OWAYENGUMENGAMELI wezwe uMnuz Thabo Mbeki, usephumele obala wathi okwenziwe yiMelika, inqamula uxhaso ezinhlelweni ezehlukene ebezisiza elakuleli kumele kube yisifundo sokuthi elakuleli, livuke lizithathe.UMbeki uthe elakuleli kumele lamukele ukuthi izinto zigaya ngomunye umhlathi manje.Ekhuluma esifundweni ngesishoshovu uMnuz Aziz Pahad, uMbeki uthe lo mholi ubezothuka ngamanga afafazwa ngelakuleli eMelika, ngoba wayehlale ezama ukuchaza okuzokwenziwa yi-ANC uma isemandleni."Njengoba uPahad wayenamava kwezithinta ezobudlelwano namazwe omhlaba, wayezothuka uma iMelika eyizwe elinamandla kangaka, likholwa ngukuthi amabhunu ahlaliswe lubhojozi kuleli, futhi kunezinhlelo zokuthi kudliwe ngenkani umhlaba wawo, njengoba ebulawa. Wachitha isikhathi esiningi ezama ukuchaza izinto ezenziwa yi-ANC njengoba isemandleni," kusho uMbeki.Uthe lo mholi wayengahambisani nemfundisoze namanga afafazwa ngezwe."Okwenziwe nguhulumeni kaTrump (Donald Trump, uMengameli waseMelika), kuyinto okumele i-Afrika iyibheke ngokuthi izinto zishintshile. Kudingeka i-Afrika ihambisane nalezi zinguquko," kusho uMbeki.Ubeke emahlombe oMnyango wezobuDlelwano namazwe oMhlaba, eyokuzama ukwakha ubudlelwano namanye amazwe. Uthe lo mnyango yiwona futhi okumele uqhamuke nenkhombandlela okumele elakuleli, liziphathe ngayo uma kuziwa kwiMelika."Umbuzo uthi ngabe uMnyango wezobuDlelwano naMazwe unawo amava okuqonda okwenzekayo? Ngabe uzokwazi ukudlulisa imigomo ethinta elakuleli emazweni omhlaba uma kungukuthi izwe elikhulu kangaka emhlabeni, likholwa amampunge okuthi kubulawa amabhunu kuleli," kusho uMbeki.Uveze nokuthi iMelika kuseyizwe elikhulu emhlabeni noma kukhona abacabanga ukuthi izenzo zikaTrump, zitshengisa ukwehlelwa amandla.Uthe okubalulekile wukuthi i-Afrika, kumele yenze okuyilungele njengoba namanye amazwe enza okuwalungele.Usho lokhu nje elakuleli lizama ukuphemba ubudlelwano nelaseMelika kulandela ukuhoxiswa koxhaso lokusiza empini yokulwa nokusabalala kweHIV.Muva nje iMelika isanda kuxosha inxusa lakuleli ebelizinze khona uMnuz Ebrahim Rasool, kulandela ukukhuluma kabi ngombuso waseMelika noTrump.Selokhu kubhede eyobudlelwano phakathi kwelaseMelika nelakuleli, kuhlukene imibono njengoba kukhona abathi akayekwe kanjalo angancengwa uTrump.Kukhona abathi kunesidingo sokuthi kuncethezwe kuTrump ngoba luyadingeka usizo njengoba iMelika kungelinye lamazwe aphezulu elakuleli elihweba nawo.

UMHOLI weMK, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, ubikelwe ngoqhekeko okuthiwa ludla lubi kule nhlangano esifundeni iMoses Mabhida. Abaholi beMK esifundeni nasesifundazweni iKwaZulu-Natal batshele uZuma ukuthi kulesi sizinda kunamalungu eMK angafuni ukwamukela ubuholi benhlangano obuqokwe ngasekupheleni konyaka ngokusemthethweni.UZuma ubehambele umcimbi obuhlelwe yinhlangano yamalungelo abantu, iSA Coalition of Civil Society Organizations eWillowfountain, eMgungundlovu izolo.Umdidiyeli weMK esifundeni iMoses Mabhida, uMnuz Mtolo, uthe kunamalungu enhlangano angafuni ukulandela imigomo."Nxamalala njengoba ngilapha ngizobika ukuthi amalungu eMK anenkinga yokuqonda umthetho weqembu. Anenkinga yokuthi alandela abanye abantu, akhonza abantu. Anenkinga yokuqonda umthethosisekelo weqembu."UMtolo ucele ukuba kube nohlelo lokufundisa amalungu eMK ngemigomo yeqembu."Ngiyacela ukuthi kube nohlelo lokufundisa amalungu ngemigomo yeqembu khona ezoqonda kangcono ukuthi kusho ukuthini ukuba yilungu leqembu," kusho uMtolo.USotswebhu weMK esiShayamthetho, uMnuz Mervyn Dirks, uthe izinto zimapeketwane esifundeni iMoses Mabhida.Uthe njengoba bekuhlelwa umcimbi wayizolo, bekukhona abanye abaholi beqembu abebezama ukuthi umcimbi ungaphumeleli."Abanye abaholi bazame ukusihlanganyela ne-ANC ebifuna ukusincisha inkundla. Abanye balibeke ngembaba elokuthi ngeke beze lana, ngempela futhi abekho lana," kusho uDirks.Umdidiyeli weMK KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Willies Mchunu, uthe inkinga yoqhekeko esifundeni iMoses Mabhida indala.Uthe le nkinga yagqama kakhulu ngesikhathi kunokhetho lokuchibiyela kuMasipala waseMsunduzi. Kulolu khetho lokuchibiyela olwaluku-ward 2 , abeMK babebanga bodwa.Amanye amalungu eMK ashintsha igama lomuntu owayekhethwe ukuba amele inhlangano, afaka igama lomuntu owayelale isibili ngesikhathi kunomhlangano womphakathi wokukhetha ozomela iMK."Saba nenkinga enkulu e-ward 2. Ngenxa yoqhekeko sahlulwa okhethweni okwakufanele silunqobe. Ingxabano ayikho kumalungu kodwa isebuholini," kusho uMchunuUZuma uthe bazozilungisa zonke izinkinga ababhekene nazo."Nakuba ukhula uMkhonto kodwa siyabona ukuthi kukhona nabangazifakile izimbadada. Page leadAKUCACI ngeyokuphasiswa kwesabelomali sezwe ePhalamende kuleli sonto njengoba i-DA imile ekutheni akukho sabelomali saphasiswa ngaphandle kwaleli qembu, ekubeni i-ANC ithi yonke into isimi ngomumo nakanjani sizophasiswa.I-DA ishaya phansi ngonyawo ithi ngeke siphasiswe isabelomali esinyusa iVAT kuleli, esathulwa nguNgqongqoshe wezeziMali, uMnuz Enoch Godongwana.Abaholi abaphezulu be-ANC okubalwa uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa noNobhala Jikelele, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, banethemba lokuthi sizophasiswa isabelomali uma sekuhleli iPhalamende ngoLwesithathu.Okhulumela i-ANC, uNkk Mahlengi Bhengu-Motsiri, utshele abezindaba izolo, njengoba bekusongwa umhlangano wesigungu esiphezulu sale nhlangano eGoli, ukuthi ibhungwe kabanzi eyokuphasiswa kwesabelomali.Uthe akafuni ukwanda kakhulu ngoba le ndaba ifana nekhasi elizovalwa."Sinethemba lokuthi isabelomali sizophasiswa yiPhalamende. Lolu daba luxoxwe kakhulu ngoMgqibelo emhlanganweni," usho kanje.UGodongwana waphakamisa ukunyusa iVAT ngo-0.5% ngenxa yezinselelo ezibhekene nezwe.Okhulumela i-DA, uMnuz Willie Aucamp, uthe i-ANC kumele yazi ukuthi akukho mnyakazo ongenzeka ngaphandle kwe-DA kuhulumeni wokubambisana."Siyiqembu lesibili ngobukhulu kuhulumeni wokubambisana kwamaqembu, ngakho akukho okungenzeka ngaphandle kwevoti le-DA. Ngeke siphase isabelomali esinyusa iVAT kuleli," usho kanje.Uthe bangavumelana nokuphasiswa kwesabelomali esinyusa iVAT ngo-0.5%, uma kungukuthi kuzoba yinto yesikhashana futhi kuphinde kwehliswe intela."Ngesikhathi singena kuhulumeni wokubambisana sazitshela ukuthi sizokwenza izinto ezizokhulisa umnotho, sakhe namathuba emisebenzi. Lukhona uhlu lwezinto esaziphakamisa kwi-ANC, ezichithe zonke," usho kanje.Uveze nokuthi i-ANC ibatshele ukuthi izolanda namanye amaqembu angekho kuhulumeni wokubambisana, isebenzisane nawo ukuze kuphasiswe isabelomali. Amanye ala maqembu uthe i-EFF.I-EFF yathi izimisele ukuxoxa ne-ANC kodwa uma ingekho i-DA ne-FF Plus kuhulumeni wokubambisana.U-Aucamp uthe bazohlangana namhlanje bakhiphe umkhombandlela ngabazokwenza ngesabelomali.I-ANC idinga ukwesekwa amanye amaqembu ukuze kuphasiswe isabelomali njengoba ingasakwazi ukuzithathela izinqumo iyodwa kulandela ukwehlelwa ukwesekwa emva kokungenzi kahle okhethweni.

SIHLABE ikhwelo komastende isikhwama esixhasa ngemali yokufunda ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme iNational Student Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS), lokuthi babambe amatomu, bangagijimeli ukuxosha abakweletayo ngoba simatasa nohlelo lokuthi bakhokhelwe ngokushesha.I-NSFAS ithe iyazazi izikhalo zomastende futhi iphezu kwazo.Okhulumela lesi sikhwama uMnuz Ishmael Mnisi, uthe ukuphendula ezikhalweni zomastende, sebesondeze usuku abazokhokhelwa ngalo.Uthe basondeze usuku lokubakhokhela njengoba phambilini bekumele babakhokhele ngenyanga ezayo."Sisondeze usuku lokukhokha lusuka ku-Ephreli 4, lwaya kuMsombuluko, uMashi 31. Lokhu sikwenza ukweseka esibaxhasile ngoba banesidingo sezindawo zokuhlala. Sinxusa omastende ukuthi bayeke ukuxosha abangakhokhile, okunalokho balandele imigomo ebekiwe yokufaka izicelo zokukhokhelwa," usho kanje.Uthe kubalulekile ukuthi kube nokubambisana ukuze izitshudeni zingagcini sezilele endle."Izitshudeni akumele zibe nexhala lokuthi zizolala endle ngenxa yokuthi imali ayikangeni ngoba lokho kuzoziphazamisa. Ngaso sonke isikhathi kumele zigxile ezifundweni zazo ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka, nokuhlukumezeka."Ubonge omastende, izikhungo zemfundo, izitshudeni nezinyunyana ngokuqhubeka kube nokubambisana."Kubalulekile ngaso sonke isikhathi ukuthi kwesekwe izitshudeni. SiyiNSFAS siyaqhubeka nokuxoxa nomastende ngokuthi kube nesixazululo ezinkingeni ezibhekene nokuhlinzekwa kwezindawo zokuhlala ezikhungweni," kuchaza uMnisi. Uveze ukuthi into ebambezela izinto wuhlelo lokuqinisekisa ukuthi yonke imigomo ilandeliwe ngaphambi kokuba bakhokhe."Ngesikhathi senza lokhu kuqinisekisa sithole ukuthi kunenqwaba yezitshudeni eziyizipoki, ezingaxhasa yiNSFAS noma ezinye zazo ezingamukelwanga ezikhungweni. Siyaphenya labo mastende abalethe imininingwane engelona iqiniso, abebezama ukuthatha amashansi benze inkohlakalo," kusho uMnisi.Uthe bayazi ukuthi omastende babhekene nezinselelo zemali ekuqaleni konyaka kodwa nabo kudingeka balandele yonke imigomo ngemali yomphakathi.Unxuse omastende ukuthi balethe imininingwane efanele ukuze kungabi nokubambezeleka ekukhokhelweni."Siyabanxusa futhi ukuthi balandele yonke imibandela ethinta nomnqamulajuqu wokuletha izinto ukuze basheshe bakhokhelwe. Ukuphuza ukuziletha kwenza kuhambe kancane izinto."Ihlale iyinkinga eyokuphuza ukukhokha kwalesi sikhwama sikhokhela omastende.Lokhu kudalwa wukuthi lesi sikhwama siyaphuza ukuphendula ngohlu lwabaxhasiwe, ikakhulu labo abasuke befake izimangalo kulandela ukuchithwa ekuxhasweni.Abanye omastende baze banqume ukuxosha abangakhokheliwe ngoba bebona izinto zihamba ngolonwabu.

Le nhlangano inikele ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ithi ithimba labo elizimele lezokushushisa alivikeli umdlwenguli osolwa ngokudlwengula."Lolu phiko lumele uJaco Pieterse onguthishanhloko waseBergview College eMatatiele. UPieterse akayena umsolwa ecaleni lokudlwengula elithinta umfundi wakulesi sikole, futhi uphiko lwamaphoyisa aseNingizimu Afrika (SAPS) alukaze lumthathe njengomsolwa njengoba esefake isicelo sawo sokuba kutholwe isampula ye-buccal ukuze kuhlolwe ulibofuzo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuqonda kwalolu phiko ukuthi uPieterse akazange axhumane nesisulu ngaphambi kokuba avule icala, futhi abukho ubufakazi bokuthi leli cala lenzeka emagcekeni esikole, kusho i-Afriforum ngesitatimende.Le nhlangano iqhubeke yathi uphiko lwayoo lwezokushushisa luphonsela inselelo i-SAPS ukuthi inikeze ubufakazi obusekela noma yiziphi izinsolo zokuthi uPieterse uyamataniswa naleli cala."Okuphawulekile ukuthi lolu phiko lutshele amaphoyisa ukuthi lokhu kuxhashazwa kwenqubo kubeka uPieterse esimeni esingemukeleki lapho ukuvumelana nesicelo sesampula kuveza izinsolo zokuthi ungumsolwa, futhi ukwenqaba isicelo kuveza izinsolo ezifanayo."
AKUTHANGA diki kuSphamandla Dhlomo (25) obethweswe uMbuso amacala angu-9 okubulala abangu-9 eMlaza esigamekweni esenzeka ngo-Agasti 11, 2023, ngesikhathi elahlwa yinkantolo ngawo wonke amacala.UDlomo ubethweswe amacala awu-13; kuwona okukhona awokubulala abantu abayisishiyagalolunye, amabili okuzama ukubulala, elokugqekeza nelokutholakala nesibhamu esingekho emthethweni. Utheswe amacala okubulala okuhleliwe oMlungisi Zuma, Phakamani Sibusiso Dlamini, Maxwell Sibisi, Regional Bongimpilo Ngema, Thabani Ngcobo, Mhlengi Khathi, Ayabongwa Mbayise, Sifundo Sibusiso Dlamini noSifiso Cele. Izolo iNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini imthole enecala lokubulala bonke abafi yaphinde yamthola enecala lokutholakala nesibhamu esingekho emthethweni nelokugqekeza.Ezinkundleni zokuxhumana uDhlomo ubaziwa ngelikaThayela Kunomoyamshikashika. Ngesikhathi iJaji u-Esther Johanna Steyn limlahla ngecala ubebonakala engenandaba uDhlomo futhi wangakhombisa nokukhathazeka okanye ukuzisola. Ubefake ijakhethi abeyifake nangoLwesibili, ulahlwa yicala nje owayengummangalelwa wesibili kuleli cala, uMnuz Zimisele Ngcongo, kuvele ukuthi wendela koyisemkhulu ngoJanuwari ngonyaka odlule. Okuqaphelekile izolo enkantolo ukuthi beziqinile kakhulu ezokuphepha. Bekugcwele amaphoyisa abefake umfaniswano nabengawufakile. Kubonakale kungena nomunye wesilisa obephethe isikhwama esikhulu egaxe isibhamu esikhulu. Umthombo wangaphakathi upotshozele Isolezwe ukuthi lokhu bekumayelana nejaji elizwakalise ukuthi lizizwa lingaphephile kuleli cala. Kwenzeka lokhu nje, kuke kwavela ukuthi uDhlomo ubesebenzela umuntu ohweba ngezidakamizwa owaziwayo eMlaza. Kuthiwa nguye okhokhela izindleko zabameli ecaleni. Ijaji limlahle ngecala uDhlomo lisebenzisa ubufakazi obehlukene obethulwa phambilini ngesikhathi kuqhubeka ukuqulwa kwecala.Liqale ngobufakazi obethulwa nguMnuz Phiwayinkosi Sibisi owayeyilungu lesigungu esilwa nobugebengu nowakhala mi izinyembezi ngesikhathi ethula ubufakazi bakhe kuleli cala. Ngesikhathi ethula ubufakazi bakhe uSibisi wayebonakala egqolozela ummangalelwa kube sengathi ufisa ukumbamba ngezandla, ekhala aze abheke phezulu azesule ngethawula izinyembezi. Abuye aphuze namanzi ayewabeke eduze kwakhe. Lithe ligculisekile ngobufakazi bukaSibisi ngoba bebungashayisani.Lithe liyabuchitha ubufakazi bukaDhlomo ngoba wayehubhuza amanga ezama ukwakha amaqhinga okuthi angaphunyuka kanjani kuleli cala."Konke owawukusho kwakungamanga kodwa wawukusho ngoba wawuzicabangela wena nje qha,'' ijaji likhuluma libhekise kuyena ngqo.Limchaze njengomuntu onamaqhinga kakhalulu abhedayo likhala ngokuthi ukhuluma okunye namhlanje kusasa asho okunye."Wena wathi umfowenu uSakhile wabulawa ngabantu abangaziwa ngesikhathi kusaqhutshwa isicelo sebheyili. Kodwa gwiqiqi uma sekuqulwa icala sewukhomba uSibisi ngenjumbane uthi uyena owabulala uSakhile,'' lisho kanjena."Inkantolo iyakulahla ngawo wonke amacala obubhekene nawo,'' kusho ijaji. UDhlomo uqhubekile nokubheka phansi kwaba sengathi akezwanga ukuthi lithini ijaji.Lincome uMbuso lathi uyivezele inkantolo ukuthi ngempela uDhlomo wayekhona endaweni yesigameko.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi uDhlomo wawaphika wonke amacala, wathi kusezandleni zoMbuso ukuthi ulethe ubufakazi obuphathekayo bokuthi uyena owabulala abantu.Ijaji likhe phezulu nasebufakazini bukaConstable Kyle Chetty osebenza esiteshini samaphoyisa saseMlaza, echaza ukuthi uyena nomunye uzakwabo abafika kuqala endaweni yesigameko.Phambilini kwake kwaphazamiseka ukuqulwa kwecala ngesikhathi uDhlomo ehlaselwa ukugula okungaqondakali waze waphuthunyiswa esibhedlela esingaphakathi ejele eWestville. Ngaphakathi enkantolo bekukhona abesilisa abayishumi ebebezokweseka uDhlomo bebelokhu bekhuluma naye, kodwa ubebaphendula ngezandla samuntu ongathandi ukukhuluma.NgoMsombuluko iJaji lithe lizowisa isigwebo sakhe.
USIHLALO wenhlangano yamatekisi iSouth African National Taxi Council (Santaco) eThekwini, kanjalo naseNingizimu 1 Bongani Nzuza, uphosele uhulumeni waKwaZulu Natal, inselelo yokuthi ubhukule ulungise izinkinga ezidala uthuthuva kule mboni.UNzuza oseyinkunzi emidwayidwa embonini yamatekisi KwaZulu Natal ukhuleme kanjena ngesikhathi kunomcimbi wakhe omkhulu wokubungaza ukuhlanganisa iminyaka engu-74, edla anhlamvana.Umcimbi owubukhazikhazi ubuseTwelve Oceans Hotel, eDoonside. Ubuhanjelwe ngamalungu omndeni, izihlobo abangani kwase kuphuma kakhulu nalabo anabo embonini yamatekisi.UNzuza uveze ukuthi usehambe ibanga elide kakhulu kule mboni. Wathi ngesikhathi engena yena ngeminyaka yawo-70, izinselelo zaziningi nemali ingeningi ngokungako. Uthe uyambonga kakhulu uNkulunkulu ngokuthi uhambe naye ibanga elide kangaka ngoba namanje usayibambile kuyona le mboniUthe iqiniso elimsulwa ukuthi amadoda ayakwazi ukubeka isinkwa etafuleni ondle imindeni ngaleli bhizinisi. Wagcizelela ukubaluleka kokuba lihlonishwe futhi yonke into ethinta lona yenziwe ngendlela efanele.Wathi noma kunjalo kodwa uhulumeni kusamele ubhukule kube khona izinto azilungisayo ukuze kugwemeke uthuthuva olungesidingo.Eqhulwini ukhulume ngodaba oselukhunywe isikhathi eside lwezimvume zezimoto okumele zihambe emgwaqweni. Uthe ukholwa ukuthi kusamele luhlalelwe phansi uhulumeni nabemboni lubhungwe kahle ukuze lungabi nazihibe.''Ngikholwa ukuthi uhulumeni awenzi ngendlela efanele uma kukhulunywa ngodaba lwezimvume zezimoto. Uma kungalunga lokho nje kuqala kuningi okungagwemeka nokungabonakala kuhamba kahle kakhulu ngaphakathi embonini yamatekisi,'' usho kanjena.Loyo oyiPhini likaNzuza kwinhlangano i-EThekwini Metro Tax Council (EMTC) uMnuz Yusuv Khaliva umethulele isigqoko uNzuza.Umncome kakhulu wathi ungumholi omayo entweni futhi akavamisile ukuguquguquka."Ukukhuluma iqiniso nje imboni yamatekisi iyabadinga kakhulu abantu abafana noNzuza. Lapha sikhuluma ngomholi osho into njengoba injalo futhi ongaqhathi abantu,'' esho.Umncomile ngokuba umholi onezimpande zakhe ezigxilile kakhulu emndenini wakhe. Uthe kuningi kakhulu okungafundwa ngabanye abaholi kuNzuza.UMnuz Phumlani Mfeka odume ngelikaNana uthe, akazi nokuthi angaqala kuphi uma engakhuluma ngeqhaza likaNzuza kweyakhe impilo.Udalule ukuthi wayekade engumshayeli wamatekisi uNzuza wamcathulisa wagcina naye esengenile embonini yamatekisi. UNzuza uhlaba umkhosi nje sekuke kwaba neziwombe ebezishiya abagibeli besele dengwane emarenki amakhulu akhele iTheku. Kungagcini lapho osomatekisi babhekana ngqo namaphoyisa befuna kukhishwe imoto zabo ezisuke ziboshiwe.
IKHABHINETHI isichithe imibiko yokuthi kunabalimi abamhlophe ababalelwa ku-72 000 abafuna ukufudukela eMelika, ngoba behleli lubhojozi kuleli.Ngokombiko woMnyango wezoLimo, iStats SA kanjalo nenhlangano yabalimi i-AgriSA, elakuleli linabalimi abangu-41 000 kuphela, ngakho akukwazi ukuthi kungaba nesibalo esingaka sabafuna ukuyobhaca eMelika.Lokhu kushiwo nguNgqongqoshe eHhovisi likaMengameli, uNksz Khumbudzo Ntshavheni, izolo, esithangamini sabezindaba ngemuva komhlangano weKhabhinethi."Sikhathazekile ngokuqhubeka kokufafazwa kwamanga ngezwe yizinhlangano iSolidarity ne-AfriForum. Abezomthetho bahlanganile ne-AfriForum mayelana nezinsolo zokuthi abantu abamhlophe bayabulawa kuleli ikakhulu abasemapulazini. Kulo mhlangano i-AfriForum ivumile ukuthi izibalo ezikhishwa nguNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa ngokubulawa kwabalimi ziqondile. Iveze nokuthi iyazi ukuthi kokunye, ukubulawa kwabalimi kwenziwa ngabanye babantu abayimindeni yabalimi," usho kanje.Uthe kungampampunge ukuthi kukhona abalimi abaningi kangaka abayozinza eMelika ngoba bemenywe nguhulumeni wakhona, ngenxa yokuthi bayabulawa kuleli.UMengameli waseMelika uMnuz Donald Trump, wavulela abalimi abamhlophe izandla zokuthi bangeza ukuzogoba amadlangala ezweni lakhe ngoba bayabulawa kuleli. Wakusho lokhu ekhala nangokuthi elakuleli lisayine imithetho ehlukumeza abamhlophe njengowokubuyiswa komhlaba ngaphandle kwesinxephezelo.UNksz Ntshavheni uthe bayaqhubeka nemizamo yokuzama ukuxoxa neMelika ngezinto ezithinta ubudlelwano phakathi kwelakuleli naleliya lizwe.Lokhu kwenza wahoxisa noxhaso lwezempilo kuleli, ebelusiza empini yokulwa nokusabalala kwe-HIV.Odabeni oluthinta ukushintshwa kwamakhadi amadala akwaSassa, kushintshelwa kwamasha asePostbank kulabo abahola izibonelelo, uNksz Ntshavheni uthe kunenhlansi yethemba njengoba umnqamulajuqu wokuwashintsha usungo-Ephreli 30, 2025."ISassa iveze ukuthi sekusele cishe abangu-800 000 abangakawashintshi amakhadi abo. Izwakalise ukuthi inethemba lokuthi kuzothi kuphela inyanga ezayo, ibe isiluphothulile lolu hlelo," usho kanje.ISassa nePostbank banesithangami namhlanje ngebanga eselihanjiwe ekushintshweni kwamakhadi.Uthe iKhabhinethi yamukele nokuboshwa kwabasolwa abangu-12 892, phakathi kukaMashi 17 noMashi 23, ngaphansi komkhankaso i-Operation Shanela."Kwababoshiwe kukhona abangu-1 753 abebefunelwa amacala afaka ukubulala, ukudlwengula, ukugqekeza, abangu-1 794 bona bebefunelwa amacala okushaya ngenhloso yokulimaza. Kuboshwe nabadayisa izidakamizwa abangu-203, abangu-115 babanjwe nezibhamu ezingekho emthethweni."Ubalule nokuthi kunemizamo yokulwa nokubhebhetheka kwesifo samatele KwaZulu-Natal."Kufakwe nabanye omasipala ngaphansi kwabazoqashwa ngelokhozi mayelana nokubhebhetheka kwesifo samatele. Omasipala abengeziwe kubalwa iBig Five Hlabisa, Mtubatuba, KwaNongoma, Lundi, Mhlabuyalingana, Jozini, Pongolo, Abaqulusi, Mfolozi, Mhlathuze, Mthonjaneni, Nquthu, Nkandla, Mlalazi neMandeni. Akukho mfuyo ezosuswa kulezi zindawo iyiswe kwezinye ngaphandle kwemvume ukunqanda ukubhebhetheka kwalesi sifo."
USONGWE ngezindaba ezimnandi unyaka odlule kuleli njengoba izibalo zeStatistics South Africa (Stats SA), ziveze ukuthi lehlile izinga labantu abangasebenzi kuleli. Lezi zibalo ezekota yokugcina yonyaka odlule.Lokhu kuvezwe ngumqondisi wezibalo zekota zabangasebenzi kwaStats SA, uMnuz Matlapane Masupye, othe kube nokunyuka okuncane kwesibalo sabantu abathole umsebenzi.Uthe izibalo zikhomba ukuthi bangu-12 000 abantu abathola imisebenzi."Izinga labasebenzayo likhule lisuka ku-10.628 million ngoSepthemba 2024 laya ku-R10.640 million ngoDisemba, wonyaka odlule. Lezi yizindaba eziletha ithemba," usho kanje. Uthe kwehle imisebenzi engu-3 000 emkhakheni efana nowokukhiqiza, owokwakha kanjalo nowezimayini.Uveze nokuthi inyukile nemali ekhokhelwa abasebenzi yaya ku-R9.5 billion."Amabhonasi akhokhelwe abasebenzi anyuke ngo-R51 billion, ngakolunye uhlangothi yehla imali ye-overtime ekhokhelwa abasebenzi ngo-R2 billion." Udalule ukuthi sinyukile isibalo semisebenzi emkhakheni ofana nowohwebo.Umbiko uveze ukuthi abantu abangu-91 000 emkhakheni ehlukene balahlekelwa yimisebenzi phakathi kukaDisemba 2023 noDisemba 2024. Umbiko uphinde waveza ukuthi cishe uhhafu wabantu bakuleli babhuqwa yindlala, kanti u-45% wabantu abasha abaphakathi kuka-15 no-34, abasenawo umdlandla wokufuna umsebenzi. UMasupye uthe izinhlelo zikahulumeni zokwakha amathuba emisebenzi esikhashana, okubalwa nohlelo lukamengameli lokuqasha abasiza ezikoleni, luyasiza nakuba lusheshe lunqanyulwe ngenxa yezinselelo zesabelomali.IStats SA idedela lezi zibalo izwe libhekene nenkinga yabantu abangasebenzi. Abanye bathola isibonelelo esaziwa ngelika-R370, zinyanga zonke ukuze bakwazi ukuphila.Kubhekwa izindlela zokuthi lesi sibonelelo sigcine sesiholwa unomphela ukubhekana nenkinga yabangasebenzi. Indaba yalesi sabelo yokuthi siyaqhubeka noma siyaphela izocaca ngasekupheleni kwalo nyaka.Amanye amaqembu ezepolitiki asephakamise ukuthi kuqedwe ngaso ngenxa yezinselelo zesabelomali.
ASHO ngazwi linye amalungu eNdlu yoMkhandlu weziFundazwe ePhalamende, ukuthi kudingeka litakulwe ibhange Ithala lingavalwa kodwa lokhu kudingeka kwenziwe ngendlela esemthethweni.La malungu amaqembu ehlukene athe akumele leli bhange elinomlando ikakhulu KwaZulu-Natal, livalwe ngoba kuzoshayeka abantu abamnyama, okuyibo abathembele kulo.Ovule inkulumompikiswano ngodaba lwaleli bhange, uMnuz Les Govender, iPhini likaSihlalo weNdlu yoMkhandlu weziFundazwe, ilungu le-IFP izolo, othe leli bhange lasungulwa ukuze lisize osomabhizinisi abamnyama.Uthe umsunguli we-IFP Inkosi Mangosuthu Buthelezi osakhothama, wabona usizi olwalubhekene nosomabhizinisi abamnyama ababengakwazi ukuthola uxhaso kwamanye amabhange."Ngeke sivume ukuthi kuvalwe ibhange uShenge alisungula. Akushayeki osomabhizinisi kuphela ngokuvalwa kwalo kodwa nabantu jikelele abanye abahola izibonelelo zikahulumeni abebehlomula kakhulu kulona."UMnuz Mxolisi Kaunda we-ANC, uthe kudingeka litakulwe leli bhange ngoba lisiza abamnyama."Leli bhange litakule inqwaba yabantu ngakho kumele kwenziwe yonke imizamo yokuthi livulwe. Llinamagatsha angu-38 eKZN yonke, lisiza abantu basemakhaya abachithwa amabhange amakhulu."Uthe bayalwamukela nophenyo lweSpecial Investigating Unit ukuze kucace uma kukhona izinto ezingahanjiswanga kahle."Zimbalwa izinto ezisele ukuthi zilungiswe kuleli bhange, cishe u-72% wazo sewenziwe ukuze lihlangabezane nemithetho. Sifuna uMgcinimafa asondele afake isandla ekutheni ibhange lingavalwa," kusho uKaunda.Noma ehambisana nokutakulwa kwebhange uMnuz Paul Swart we-DA, kodwa uveze ukuthi kumele kulandelwe umthetho.Uthe abakwazi ukweseka ibhange elingawulandeli umthetho wezwe"Kumele lilandele yonke imigomo yezomthetho ukuze imali yabantu abahlwempu ingacwili. Ibekhona imizamo yokuthi ibhange lilungise izinto zalo, kodwa kuze kube yimanje alihlangabezani nomthetho. Siyakweseka ukungavalwa kwalo uma kungukuthi lihambisana nomthetho," usho kanje.Uthe kumele Ithala lifakwe kumabhange anelayisensi yokwenza lo msebenzi.Ilungu leqembu uMkhonto weSizwe (MK), uMnuz Sibongiseni Majola, lithe kumele kugxekwe nosopolitiki ngokuthula kwabo njengoba ibhange selilengelwa yizembe lokuthi livalwe."Abanye basukume ngoba sekuthiwa seliyavalwa ekubeni babethule ngesikhathi lisazama ukuthola ilayisensi yokusebenza. Bebethuleleni bengangeneleli ngoba izinkinga zalo kade zanekwa obala?" kubuza uMajola.UMphathiswa wezokuThuthukiswa koMnotho, ezokuVakasha nezoMnotho, uMusa Zondi uthe ngeke kulahlekelwe amakhasimende kuphela ngokuvalwa kwebhange.."Ukuvalwa kwebhange kuzobeka engcupheni inkece efakwe ngabantu engu-R2.5 billion. Kuzoshaya osomabhizinisi abancane, nabantu abangenayo enye indawo yokuboleka inkece," kusho uZondi.I-FF Plus ithe kumele ibhange lihambisane nomthetho noma livalwe.Amalungu ale ndlu abuye akhala ngemali yezitokofela ebhajwe kuleli bhange.Indaba yokuvimba ukuthi kuvalwe ibhange isingenwe nayiSilo samaBandla uMisuzulu kaZwelithini, esingayizwa eyokuthi livalwe.

UMKHANDLU weTheku umema bonke osomabhizinisi abesifazane engqungqutheleni enohlonze nekhethekile ezodingida ngamathuba ezomnotho ahlose ukuthuthukisa abesifazane abasemabhizinisini.Le ngqungquthela ebizwa nge-Women Economic Empowerment Engagement, iyingxenye yombukiso wamabhizinisi wesifunda saseNyakatho, iNorth Regional Durban Business Fair. Ingqungquthela izoba seBridge City Mall KwaMashu kusasa ngo-9 ekuseni.Umgomo walo mbuthano usondele ekuhlabeleni phambili ikhwelo lokuphakamisa amalungelo abantu besifazane kanye nokuqinisekisa ukuthi abesifazane bathola amathuba anele emikhakheni eyehlukahlukene kwezama bhizinisi.Yizwa bukhoma kwabesifazane abaphumelele ebuholini abavela ezinkampanini ezehlukene, ukuze uthole ulwazi, amathiphu okukhula ebhizinisini uphinde ugqugquzeleke ukuthi banqobe kanjani izinselelo ababhekene nazo endleleni eya empumelelweni.Funda isikhangiso ukuthola imininingwane egcwele.
