UKUBONA inkinga yokushoda kwamanzi emiphakathini ehlukene, ngenye yezinto ezenze inkampani yeziphuzo, okukhona kuzo nomkhiqizo wamanzi i-aQuelle yabona kukuhle ukuthi kube khona ekwenzayo ukuzama ukuxazulula leyo nkinga.Yilokho okwenze le nkampani yanikezela ngamanzi emphakathini waKwaNdengezi, eThekwini, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imindeni yendawo, obese kungekhona okokuqala ikwenza njengoba yenza okufanayo futhi eMlaza, Thongathi, Greytown, Msunduzi, Phoenix naKwaDukuza. Le nkampani iphinde yanikela ngamathangi amanzi awu-25 emphakathini owadingayo, ithangi ngalinye lingamalitha awu-5 000, anikezela ngamanzi ahlanzekile ezikoleni nasemphakathini. Ithangi lokuqala lifakwe e-Aldinville Primary, KwaDukuza, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izingane azilovi esikoleni ngenxa yokungabi nawo amanzi.Umqondisi we-aQuelle uMnuz Michael Ngubane uthe lokhu kuyisinyathelo esihle ikakhulu njengoba kukade kuyiWorld Water Day ngoMashi 22, usuku lokugqugquzela ukuthi abantu baphuze amanzi, nokuthi kuqikelelwe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola amanzi ahlanzekile."Ukuthola amanzi ahlanzekile nokuphephile ukuwasebenzisa kuseyinselelo enkulu emphakathini wasezindaweni ezahlukene, okuphinde kwabhebhethekiswa nayinkinga yezikhukhula esezivame ukuhlasela, yingakho sibone kumqoka ukuthi kube khona esikwenzayo ngalokho ukuzama ukwenza umehluko kule nkinga,” kusho uNgubane.
ABAZI ukuthi bazothathani bese beyihlanganisa nani abasebenzi benye yezinkampani ezihlonishwayo edume ngokuthi eyempunyela uMnuz Patrice Motsepe.Inkampani i-Assmang Manganese eseCato Ridge, ngaKwaXimba, eyaziwayo eyenza imikhiqizo yensimbi okukhona ne-manganese, sekuvele ukuthi sekusele kancane ngaphambi kokuphothulwa kohlelo oluqhubekayo lokuvala thaqa ukusebenza kwayo.Omunye wabasebenzi enkampanini ongathandanga ukuthi kudalulwe igama lakhe, odalule ukuthi usesebenze kule nkampani iminyaka ewu-15, uthe isimo sibi kakhulu kubona bonke abasebenzi benkampani abangaphezu kuka-600 uma sekubalwa nabayitoho njengoba bengazi ukuthi bazomisa kanjani uma sekuvalwa le nkampani ekupheleni kukaMeyi nonyaka. Uthe ngendlela isimo esibi ngakhona akusasebenzeki kahle ngenxa yokuthi emiqondweni yabo kuduma ukuthi kuzogamanxa unyaka sebengomahlalela, kangangokuthi sekufufusa nombhikisho okuhlelwa ukuthi ube ngoLwesihlanu ukuzama izaba zokuphikisa isinqumo sabaqashi sokuvala inkampani."Nakuba saziswa ngesinqumo senkampani ngo-Okthoba nyakenye kepha yinto engakaze yamukeleke ngoba akekho noyedwa umuntu ongamukela ukuthi umsebenzi uphelile ngale ndlela. Sonke siphatheke kabi ngenxa yalokhu ngoba le nkampani ibiwusizo kakhulu emphakathini ikakhulu ebantwini abakhele u-ward 1 KwaXimba,” kusho umsebenzi.Eqhuba, uthe bafisa ukuthi kube khona izaba ezingenziwa ngabaphathi futhi kungenele nanoma wubani omunye nezinhlaka ezehlukene zikahulumeni ukusiza ukuhlenga imisebenzi."Siyakuqonda ukuthi isimo somnotho wezwe siyantengantenga futhi ziningi izinto ezingazinzile nezenza ukuthi inkampani ibe sesimeni esichazele ukuthi ikusona manje, kepha futhi kuzoba yinkinga enkulu ukulahleka kwemisebenzi engaka ngoba akuzukuba lula kulaba basebenzi ukuqasheka kwezinye izindawo ngoba baningi kakhulu,” usho kanje.Kuthintwa ikhansela lakule ndawo, uMnuz Thembo Ntuli, licele ukuthi libuye lithintwe emva kwemizuzu ewu-20, okuthe seluthintwa futhi ucingo lwalo bese lukhala, lungabanjwa muntu.Le nkampani kudume ukuthi ngekaMotsepe ngoba ngo-2008 ngenkathi kuqhume amabhodwe okupheka insimbi wazifikela mathupha ezokhuluma nabasebenzi. Ngaleso sikhathi kwahlaluka ukuthi i-African Rainbow Minerals yale mpunyela yayinamavenge angu-50 kule nkampani ewusizo ngemisebenzi ebantwini abakhele izindawo ezifana neHammarsdale, Ntshangwe, KwaXimba nakwezinye ezisondelene nazo.Kuvela lokhu nje, isimo asisihle embonini yensimbi njengoba kunezinhlelo zokuthi i-ArcelorMittal idilize abasebenzi ababalelwa ku-3 500.Kusanda kudilizwa abasebenzi ababalelwa ku-2 220 ezinhlelweni ezehlukene phakathi kweNewcastle (KwaZulu-Natal) neVanderbijlpark, Vereeninging (Gauteng). Lezi zinhlelo zizoba nomthelela omubi hhayi kubasebenzi be-ArcelorMittal kuphela kodwa ezweni jikelele. Abasebenzi base-ArcelorMittal bake babhekana nalokhu kudilizwa eminyakeni embalwa edlule, kepha manje sekukhulunywa eyokuvalwa kwenkampani.Abase-Assmang nabe-African Rainbow Minerals abatholakalanga ukuba baphawule ngalolu daba.
UNOBHALA Jikelele we-ANC uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, uxwayise ngokuthi akulula ukuthola amavoti, kuyanyukela ngakho bayadingana bengamadlelandawonye.Uthe yingakho bengakwazi ukuqinisa ikhanda, badube amaKhomanisi bathi kuwona awahambe ayozimela okhethweni.Uveze ukuthi kukhona abantu abangakhankasi kodwa abathi ayiyekwe ukuze izibone ukuthi ifana nobani iSACP ngokuphuma uqekelele izimele okhethweni."Asikwazi ukumane sithi abahambe, kunzima la ngaphandle siyadingana. Yingakho sizoyixoxa siwuKhongolose ngempelasonto eyokuzimela kweSACP okhethweni. Kumele sixoxe, sibonisane ukuthi siya kanjani phambili," usho kanje izolo ekhuluma engqungqutheleni yeDenosa eBoksburg, eGoli.Usho lokhu kulandela ukuphumela obala kwamaKhomanisi athi azozimela okhethweni lohulumeni basekhaya ngonyaka ozayo.AmaKhomanisi athi azozimela ngenxa yokuthi namanje akukho ukubuyekezwa kobudlelwano kumadlelandawonye. "Kumele sizibuze imibuzo enzima ngokuthi ukuphuma kweSACP kusho ukuthini kumadlelandawonye. Noma zingabakhona izinguquko kumadlelandawonye, kodwa isinqumo seSACP kumele senziwenjani," kusho uMbalula.Unxuse ukuthi engqungqutheleni yeDenosa zixoxwe izinto ezifuze lezi ngoba iningi labasebenzi leseka i-ANC futhi lingamalungu eSACP.Ubalule nokuthi ukwehlelwa ukwesekwa okhethweni lwanyakenye kubabeke endaweni abangasakwazi ukuthatha izinqumo bebodwa, ngoba sebesebenzisana namanye amaqembu.Uncome iqhaza labasebenzi bezempilo, abasekhaleni lokuhlenga impilo yabantu."Ayikho impilo ngaphandle kwabahlengikazi kuleli. Ngiyazi ukuthi niyayifuna imali, yilwani ukuze niyithole. Uma abasebenzi belwela amaholo, akumele unyukelwe umoya uma ungungqongqoshe ngoba yilungelo labo," kusho uMbalula.Uthe nakuhulumeni wokubambisana bazovikela imithetho ethinta abasebenzi."Abahambe baye kuDonald Trump (umengameli waseMelika), bayosiceba abacabanga ukuthi sizojikela abasebenzi. Akulona izwe likaDonald Trump leli."UNobhala Jikelele wamaKhomanisi uMnuz Solly Mapaila, ugxeke uTrump wathi utshengisile ukuthi akayishayi ndiva intando yaabantu.Uthe lo mholi uzithwele futhi akanandaba namuntu emhlabeni jikelele.Ukhale nge-ANC wathi bazizwa bedayiswe wuKhongolose kwi-DA."Yingakho kunzima manje ukuphasisa isabelomali sezwe kungenxa yalokhu kusebenzisana kwe-ANC ne-DA. Siyazibuza ukuthi i-ANC ne-DA basebenzisana kanjani ngoba banemibono engafani," usho kanje.Uthe awukaze ubekhona umhlangano ohlanganisa wonke amadlelandawonye noma i-ANC isikhale ngaphansi okhethweni."Kade sagcina ukuba nomhlangano singamadlelandawonye, sekuphele iminyaka engu-10. Ukube siyahlangana sichazelwe ngezinto, ngabe siyayeseka i-ANC. Sibi isimo, izwe lifana nento ehambile ngoba ngisho izigebengu ziyazenzela," usho kanje.Uthe bakulungele ukungenela ukhetho ngokuzimela."Noma kusasa kungeza ukhetho lokuchibiyela, sikulungele ukungenela ukhetho sisodwa. Asifuni ukubukelwa phansi yingakho sqhubekela phambili nokungenela ukhetho," kusho uMapaila.Uthe abaphumi kumadlelandawonye ngokungenela ukhetho.
UMNYANGO wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal, umeme omasipala abahlukene ngoLwesibili ntambama emcimbini obuseGreyville Convention Center, wokuklomelisa abenza kahle esifundazweni.Umcimbi obuholwa nguMphathiswa uMfundisi uThulasizwe Buthelezi, ububungaza omasipala kuso sonke isifundazwe abakhombise ukusebenza ngokuzinikela ekulethweni kwezidingongqangi. Imiklomelo ibihlelwe ngokwemikhakha ehlukene, okuhlanganisa ukuphatha okuhle, imiphumela yocwaningomabhuku, uhlelo lwentuthuko edidiyelwe olungcono kanye nedolobha/idolobhakazi elihlanzekile kunawo wonke. Ngokusho komnyango weCogta esifundazweni, lo mcimbi usebenze njengenkundla yokugqamisa inqubo engcono yokusebenza nokugqugquzela bonke omasipala ukuthi baphokophelele amazinga aphezulu ekusebenzeleni imiphakathi yabo, nokugqugquzela indawo ekahle yokutshalwa kwezimali.Idolobha laseMhlathuze lidle umhlanganiso, lihlomule umklomelo ka-R1,000,000, ukubonga ukusebenza kahle kwalo ekuphathweni komasipala nasekulethweni kwezidingongqangi. UMasipala waseMlalazi uklonyeliswe ngo-R500,000 ngokuzuza isicoco sokuba idolobha elihlanzekile kunawo wonke KwaZulu-Natal, ukhombise ukuzinikela ekunakekeleni imvelo nenhlalakahle yomphakathi. Abanye omasipala abathole izindondo yilaba:
ZISALE ziqhatha usizi izinkulungwane zabasebenzi bakomasipala ezingazange zihole.Abasebenzi bakomasipala abayisithupha ezifundazweni ezine basale bencela izithupha ngenxa yokubambezeleka kwemiholo yabo.Omasipala abangazange baholele abasebenzi bakhale ngokushoda kwemali, bathi balinde imali ezofakwa uMnyango wezeziMali.KwaZulu-Natal usizi belubhalwe emehlweni kubasebenzi bakuMasipala uMzinyathi okhungethwe izinkinga njengoba abasebenzi bakhona betshelwe ukuthi bazoholelwa uma sekungene imali eqhamuka eMnyangweni wezeziMali.Isolezwe libone isaziso esibhalwe imenenja yomkhandlu, uNkk Ntombenhle Mkhwanazi, esibikela abasebenzi ngokubambezeleka kwemiholo.Kulesi saziso uNkk Mkhwanazi uthe abakwazanga ukuholela abasebenzi ngesikhathi ngenxa yokuthi uMnyango wezeziMali uphuzile ukufaka isabelo sesigaba sesithathu sonyakamali."Sitshelwe ukuthi uMnyango wezeziMali uzoyifaka kulo leli sonto imali, alukho usuku oluqondile olubekiwe. Uma sesiyitholile imali sizokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi bonke abasebenzi bathola imiholo yabo ngokuphazima kweso."Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kokhulumela umkhandlu, uNkk Thandeka Ngobese, ayizange iphumelele njengoba ucingo lwakhe belungangeni futhi engazange awuphendule umbuzo awuthunyelwe.UMasipala uMzinyathi ukhungethwe izinkinga okubalwa kuzo inkinga yamanzi kanye nokuthola imibiko emibi yoMcwaningi-mabhuku.Muva nje lo masipala uthole umbiko omubi ngendlela engachazeki obizwa ngokuthi i-adverse.I-IFP isanda kuxosha iMeya yomkhandlu, uMfu Petros Ngubane.Inyunyana yabasebenzi bomasipala, iSamwu, ithe akubona bodwa abasebenzi bakuMasipala waseMzinyathi abagileke igoda, izolo.UNobhala weSamwu, uMnuz Dumisane Magagula, uthe abasebenzi bakomasipala ababili abasesifundazweni iNorthern Cape, okunguMasipala waseThembelihle nowaseKeis, abazange bahole.UMagagula uthe eFree State abasebenzi bomasipala ababili, owaseMafube nowaseKopanong, abazange bahole, nabakuMasipala waseMamusa, eNorth West, nabo abazange bahole.UMagagula uthe sekuyinsakavukela ukungaholelwa ngesikhathi kwabasebenzi bomasipala, wathi kwezinye izindawo abasebenzi baholelwa kanye emva kwezinyanga ezintathu.Uthe abanye omasipala babamba imali yempesheni neyama-medical aid emiholweni yabasebenzi kodwa bangayidluliseli lapho kufanele iye khona."Lokhu ukuntshontsha nje."UMagagula uthe akufanele kugxekwe omasipala kuphela ngale nkinga, wathi noMnyango wezeZimali nawo kufanele uzinuke amakhwapha.Uthe omasipala, ikakhulu labo basemakhaya, bathola izabelo ezingenele eMnyangweni wezeZimali."Ngeke sikuphike ukuthi kunenkinga yokungaphathwa kahle kwemali kodwa sifuna ukuthi ibhekisiswe indlela okwabelwa ngayo omasipala imali."
LIMCHAZE njengomuntu onesihluku nononya uSiphamandla Khumalo, iJaji uJacqueline Henriques, ngesikhathi limgweba udilikajele eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini izolo.UKhumalo (34) waKwaNongoma, ulahlwe yicala lokugwaza, anqume ngesihluku unina wengane (5) yakhe uNksz Nomfundo Msibi (30), naye ongowokuzalwa KwaNongoma, esigamekweni esenzeka enxanxatheleni yezitolo, iGateway, eMhlanga, ngo-Agasti nyakenye. UNkk Henriques, emgweba udilikajele uKhumalo uthe awukho umusa uKhumalo awukhombisa kumufi, ngakho naye awukho umusa azomkhombisa wona. Ubalule nokuthi uKhumalo akakaze akhombise ukuzisola ngecala, wathi lokhu ukubone kusukela liqala ukuqulwa.Uthe akukho lapho uKhumalo abekhombisa khona ebusweni ukuthi uyazisola ngakwenza, kunalokho ubelokhu ezimoyizelela njalo uma kuhleli icala."Ngisho nangosuku owadlalelwa ngalo okwaqoshwa amakhamera aseGateway, ngesikhathi umatasa ugwaza umufi uphindelela, awuzange ukhombise nakancane umuzwa wokuzisola. Nangesikhathi usunikwa ithuba lokuthi uzinxusele ngokuxegiselwa isigwebo, ubulokhu umoyizela, uhlafuna okuthile, uphinde uzilungisele ijakhethi yakho,” kusho uNkk Henriques.Ugcizelele eyokuthi uKhumalo wayekuhlelile ukubulala umufi njengoba wayehlomile, wamyenga nge-lay-by ebe engayiphethe imali yokuyikhipha nokumgwaza kwakhe amanxeba angu-22, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi akadabuli.Ugxeke neyoxolo alucele emndenini kamufi, lapho athe ucela umxolele ngakwenza njengoba elindele ukuthi uma ephuma ejele kube khona ukuxhumana phakathi kwakhe nawo njengoba kukhona ingane."Lokhu akukhona ukuxolisa futhi akukhona ukuzisola. Kuyisenzo nje sokuzicabangela wena,” kusho uNkk Henriques.Umalume kamufi, uMnuz Prince Dlamini, obekhona enkantolo, uthe bagculisekile ngesigwebo, wathi yize singeke sisambuyisa umshana wakhe, kodwa siyawuthoba umndeni amanxeba."Ngiyethemba ukuthi nogogo kamufi, owaqala ukuba buthakathaka emva kwesigameko, uzothobeka inhliziyo,” kusho uDlamini.Nokho uthe kubaphathe kabi ukumoyizela kukaKhumalo nokuthi akhethe ukuthi aze ayongena ekhulukuthu engagonyulukile ngesizathu esizwakalayo esaholela ekutheni abulale umufi."Besinethemba lokuthi uzogeqa amagula, achaze ukuthi wambulalelani ukuze nathi sichazele izingane zikamufi uma sezikhulile ukuthi wambulalelani unina,” kusho uDlamini, othe ngalesi senzo, nabo bambona njengomuntu ongazisoli. Udalule ukuthi ubudlelwane bukaKhumalo nomufi beminyaka eyisishiyagalolunye, babungenampilo."Ubengumuntu wezigemegeme, ehlala emshaya, amklinye aze avuvukale nentamo. Besilokhu simtshela ukuthi akamyeke lo muntu, athi usemyekile, sithi siyezwa, sebebuyelene,” kusho uDlamini, othe emva kokumbulala, babonile ukuthi bebebuyelana ngoba ubemsabisa. Uqhube wathi uthando lwabo belungafunwa nawumndeni ngoba ubehlale ebuya emshayile."Okubuhlungu ukuthi uthe esethatha isinqumo sokuhlukana naye ngempela, edlulela phambili ngothando, wavele wambulala ngempela,” kusho uDlamini.Ummeli kaKhumalo, uMnuz Phumelele Daniso, uzwakalise ukuthi bahlela ukuthi sibuyekezwe isigwebo.
UKUQONDA izinselelo ezibhekana nabasebenzi abakhubazekile nokushisekela ukuthi kube nokulingana kubo bonke abasebenzi, uMasipala weTheku usunikele ngezimoto ezizosiza ukuthi lezi zisebenzi zikwazi ukusebenza ngokukhululeka nangendlela efana neyezinye.Lolu hlelo lwalezi zimoto olubize uR1. 3 milion lwethulwe ngoLwesine, okwenziwe ngenhloso yokuqhakambisa amalungelo abantu nokulingana ebantiwni, ikakhulu ngoba izolo bekugujwa usuku lwamalungelo abantu lwaminyaka yonke iHuman Rights Day, obekungokwesi-65 lugujwa nonyaka, kusukela liqala ukugujwa ngo-1965. Akuphelelanga ezimotweni kuphela, njengoba khona futhi kulolu hlelo - uMasipala wethule nezihlalo ezihamba ngamasondo ezizosetshenziswa yilaba basebenzi, nezinye ezilungele ukusetshenziswa ngabasebeni besifazane abakhulelwe uma kunezimo eziphuthumayo.Usihlalo wekomidi elibhekele ukuphatha nokuhola abantu iKhansela Nkosenhle Madlala uthe lolu hlelo lukhombisa ukuzibophezela koMasipala ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izindawo zokusebenza ziba sesimweni esihle, nesibeka eqhulwini wonke umsebenzi nesimo sakhe. "Kuyaqala ukuthi kube nohlelo olunjena emlandweni wezwe lethu lapho kwenziwa into enhle nenkulu kangaka eqondene nabasebenzi abakhubazekile, ngakho siziqhenya kakhulu ngakho futhi siyakuqonda nokuthi kuningi okunye okuhle okusadinga ukwenziwa,” kusho ikhansela uMadlala.Okwamanje uMasipala unabasebenzi abawu-276 abakhubazekile. Omunye walabo basebenzi uMnuz Simon Zwane uthe lolu hlelo luyisinyathelo esikhulu nesihle kakhulu futhi esizobasiza beyisebenzi ezizidingayo ukuqhuba nokuphuthumisa umsebenzi."Lesi sinyathelo soMasipala sikhombisa ukukhula nokuya phambili futhi sikhombisa ukuzibophezela kwawo ukubeka wonke umuntu eqhulwini ngokwehlukana kwezigaba zethu nezimo zokuphila kwethu. Lokhu kuzokwenza umehluko omkhulu ukuqhakambisa ukulingana endaweni yokusebenza, futhi kuzokwenza ukuthi abasebenzi abakhubazekile njengami bakwazi ukufinyelela ezindaweni ezahlukene kalula,” kusho uZwane.
ISIFUNDAZWE iKwaZulu-Natal sithole uchatha ngenxa yokusebenzisa kahle imali. IKwaZulu-Natal inikezwe imali ephucwe ezinye izifundazwe ezehlulekile ukuyisebenzisa ngesikhathi.Lezi zindaba zidalulwe uMphathiswa wezeziMali esifundazweni, uMnuz Francios Rodgers, ngesikhathi ethula isabelomali.URodgers wethule isabelomali sesifundazwe esingu-R158 billion esiShayamthetho, izolo.Ngaphambi kokuba ethule isabelomali, uRodgers wemukele uhlu lwezikhalazo lwamalungu eNehawu afuna ukuthi iKhabhinethi lisichithe isiphakamiso sikaNgqongqoshe wezeziMali, uMnuz Enoch Godongwana, sokuba kwenyuse intela ngo-0.5%.URodgers uthe iKwaZulu-Natal inikezwe uchatha ka-R100 million, lena imali ethathwe ezifundazweni iGauteng, Western Cape, neFree State."Khona umuntu engimuzwe ethi u-R100 million mncane, kodwa iqiniso ukuthi iningi kabi le mali."UMnyango wezeMfundo iwona othole isabelo esikhulu njengoba unikezwe u-R66 billion, kwathi uMnyango wezeMpilo wona wabelwa u-R56 billion.IHhovisi likaNdunankulu labelwe u-R817 million.URogder uthe uhulumeni wesifundazwe uyaqhubeka nemizamo yokonga imali.Uthe uhulumeni wesifundazwe umise ukuqashelwa kwabasebenzi bakahulumeni izimoto, wathi iminyango kahulumeni izothenga izimoto ukunokuba kusetshenziswe izimoto eziqashiwe."Ngesikhathi uhulumeni wokubambisana ophethe isifundazwe ungena emandleni, kwakubikwa ukuthi uhulumeni wesifundazwe uzosebenzisa ngokweqile isabelomali ngo-R10 billion. Ngenxa yokuqiniswa kwemigomo yokuphathwa kwemali, manje uhulumeni wesifundazwe ubheke ukuthi usebenzise ngokweqile isabelomali ngo-R4.9 billion."URodgers uthe umnyango wakhe uzokwethula uhlelo oluzolandelwa iminyango kahulumeni ukuqapha ukusebenza kwezimali kanye nokukhokhelwa kwezikweletu."Lokhu kuzosiza ukuthi abaholi bekwazi ukuqapha ukusebenza kwezimali eminyangweni abayiphethe."Ebuzwa ukuthi iNdlunkulu kaZulu yabelwe imali engakanani, uRodgers uthe lokhu kuzodalulwa uNdunankulu, uMnuz Thami Ntuli.UNtuli naye unqabile ukudalula ukuthi iNdlunkulu kaZulu izokwabelwa malini, ugcine ngokuthi uhulumeni uzame okusemandleni wawo.Usihlalo wekomiti lezeziMali esiShayamthetho, uMnuz Mthandeni Dlungwane, uthe kumjabulisile ukubona kwenyuka izabelo ezitholwa iminyango eyehlukene."Kuthe ukwehla kancane ukunciphiswa kwezabelo, lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi uhulumeni uyazama."UDlungwane uthe uchatha otholwe uMnyango wezeMfundo kanye nowezokuHlaliswa kwaBantu, uzoyelekelela kakhulu leminyango ukuba ihambise izidingo kubantu.USotswebhu we-MK esiShayamthetho, uMnuz Mervyn Dirks, uthe ayikho imali eyabelwe izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa komnotho."IKwaZulu-Natal inezindawo eziningi zasemakhaya kodwa uma ubuka incane kakhulu imali eyabelwe ezolimo. Kulesi sabelo u-1.7% kuphela owabelwe ezolimo. Lesi sabelo sincane, angeke siwukhulise umnotho. Lokhu kusho ukuthi awekho amathuba emisebenzi azodaleka."
LISAZOQHUBEKA nokugqunywa ezitokisini ikhansela lakuMasipala waseMsunduzi eliboshelwe icala lokuhluba ngequpha ilungu lomphakathi.Icala likaMnuz Mshushisi Ngubane, oyikhansela le-IFP ku-ward 8, lihlehliselwe ikusasa lapho kuzoqedelwa khona isicelo sakhe sebheyili.UNgubane uwuzwe ngendaba umgubho we-IFP weminyaka engu-50 obungempelasonto njengoba esehlale ezikhindini kusukela ngoLwesithathu.Ubhekene nezinsolo zokushaya nokuthumba uMnuz Nkululeko Ngcobo, oyilungu lomphakathi.UNgubane uboshwe kanye nabanye ababili, oMnuz Bongani Ngubane, noLungani Nzama UBongani uphinde abhekane nezinsolo zokuvula icala elingamanga.Wavulela uNgcobo icala lokushaya, kodwa labuye lachithwa.Esitatimendeni uNgcobo wenza izinsolo zokuthi laba abathathu bamthumba, bayomvalela endlini thizeni ese-Elandskop.Uthe babe sebemshaya ngezibhakela.Ngokuthola kweSolezwe, abasolwa baphambanisa uNgcobo nomunye abamsola ngokukhomba umfowabo ngesibhamu endaweni yokuzijuxuza."Kukhona umuntu owayehlupha, ekhomba abantu ngesibhamu. UNgcobo wabe esephuca lowomuntu isibhamu, nakhona kuthiwa akusona isibhamu sangempela. ONgubane babengekho bona kwenzeka le nto, kusho ukuthi bona bazitshela ukuthi nangu umuntu obekhomba abantu ngesibhamu."Uqhuba umthombo uthe vele uNgubane noNgcobo abahoshelani kahle."Emini kuthiwa uNgcobo wayelokhu ethi 'asinakhansela la, bukani kunjani'. Kusho ukuthi base bemshayela nalokho."Uqhuba umthombo uthe ingxabano kaNgubane noNgcobo yaqala ngo-2022, umsindo wasuswa ukuqhuma kwe-transformer."Kwaba khona umndeni okhetha ukuzifakela wona i-transformer. Lo mdeni uzwana kakhulu noNgcobo. Inkinga umuntu owayebafakela i-transfomer wahluleka, kwagcina sekuphazamiseka ugesi kweminye imizi eminingi. Nangaleli langa kushaywa uNgcobo, kuthiwa uNgubane wayelokhu ebuzile ukuthi baphi abangani bakhe bakwa (egagula isibongo sakulo muzi owathenga i-transformer)."Abasolwa bavele kafushane eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMgungundlovu izolo, lapho becele khona ibheyili.UMbuso uveze ukuthi awusiphikisi isicelo sabo sebheyili kodwa inkantolo yanquma ukuthi icala lihlehlele ikusasa ukuze kubhekwe ukuthi ofakazi baphephile yini, kuphinde kuqinisekiswe namakheli abo.Inkantolo ifuna nokuthi umphenyi wecala abhale isitatimende esigcwele esishoyo ukuthi kungani engaphikisani nokuthi abasolwa badedelwe ngebheyili.Esitatimendeni sakhe umphenyi wecala ubevele wabhala umugqa oshoyo ukuthi akaphikisani nokuthi abasolwa badedelwe ngebheyili, wangazinikeza izizathu ezenza asho lokhu.Okhulumela i-IFP, uMnuz Mkhuleko Hlengwa, uthe bebengakawutholi umbiko.Uthe uzoke abuze ebuholini be-IFP esifundeni uMgungundlovu, bese ebuyisa impendulo, kepha kuze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela engakaphenduli.Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kokhulumela uMasipala waseMsunduzi, uNkk Ntobe Mkhize, ayizange iphumelele njengoba ucingo lwakhe belukhala lungabanjwa.Baphume benxapha bodwa abebezokweseka uNgubane enkantolo emva kokuhlehla kwecala.Bakhale ngokutapiswa iqanda lenjelwane umphenyi wecala, abamsola ngokuthi wenzele phansi uNgubane."Yini eyenze ukuthi angabhali isitatimende esigcwele? Senziwa izilima lana," kudemelayisa omunye wabantu abebezokweseka uNgubane.Abebezokweseka uNgubane banqabile ukukhuluma neSolezwe, bathi konke bazokuchaza kusasa uma sekuphume isinqumo esicelweni sebheyili.
UMENGAMELI Cyril Ramaphosa uthi akadingi ukuxhumana namanye amaqembu akuhulumeni wokubambisana kuhulumeni, ukuze athole umbono wawo mayelana nomuntu okudingeka amqoke ekubeni yinxusa laseMelika.URamaphosa uthe nguyena kuphela othatha izinqumo nonezwi lokugcina ngozoqokwa ekubeni yinxusa."Umengameli nguyena ojuba amanxusa aya kwamanye amazwe. Angidinge kuxhumana noma ukuthola umbono wamanye amaqembu, noma abantu ngokuthi ngijuba bani," kusho uRamaphosa.Ukusho lokhu ekhuluma nabezindaba ngesikhathi kuqhubeka ingqungquthela yeDenosa eBirchwood Hotel, eBoksburg, izolo.Uphawula kanje kulandela ukukhonjwa indlela kukaMnuz Ebrahim Rasool nguhulumeni waseMelika, njengoba ebeyinxusa kuleliya lizwe, ngemuva kwenkulumo ayenza ngomengameli wakuleliya lizwe, uMnuz Donald Trump, engehlanga kahle.Wayekhuluma ngokuthi kumele ishintshe indlela okumele kukhulunywe ngayo neMelika ngenxa yokuthi ubuholi bakhona bubonakala beseka amaBhunu, akhala ngokuthi ayahlukumezeka kuleli ngemuva kokuphasiswa komthetho wokuthathwa komhlaba.Kuningi ukuphawula nokuqagela ngokubhekwe ukuthi uRamaphosa amjube ukuvala isikhala sikaRasool, eMelika.Kunamagama ahlukene aphakanyiswayo abantu okuthiwa angabajuba ngoba banamava kwezobuholi. URamaphosa uthe iMelika ngelinye lamazwe amakhulu elakuleli elihwebelana nalo.Uthe akajahile ukujuba umuntu ozovala isikhala sikaRasool."Njengoba uRasool esebuyele ekhaya, asikho emjahweni wokuthi sivale isikhala sakhe. Sifuna ukujuba umuntu oseqophelweni eliphezulu ukuvala isikhala sikaRasool," kusho uRamaphosa.Udalule nokuthi bake bayixoxa kabanzi ekaTrump yokuhoxisa uxhaso lwezempilo ebelufaka isandla empini yokulwa nesandulela ngculazi kuleli."Kuyilungelo labo ukumisa uxhaso, ngoba imali yabo. Lokhu kuyisifundo kuthina ukuthi sivuke sizithathe, sithole ezinye izindlela zokuthi sikwazi ukuzimela. Kumele sithembele ezinsizeni zethu, hhayi kwezabanye abantu," kusho uRamaphosa. Ukhale ngesibalo sabahlengikazi abafudukela kwamanye amazwe bashiye kuleli."Noma sikhala kodwa lokhu kusho ukuthi amanye amazwe ayabathemba abahlengikazi bakuleli. Siyazazi izinselelo ezibhekene nezempilo kuleli. Kumele nixoxe kule ngqungquthela ngalezi zinselelo," usho kanje.Uveze nokuthi siyanda nesibalo sabantu bokufika kuleli, abangenawo amaphepha abagcwala ezibhedlela bezofuna usizo lwezempilo."Abahlengikazi bawumgogodla kwezempilo. Iqhaza labo libaluleke kakhulu. Ziningi nezinselelo ababhekana nazo nsuku zonke," usho kanje.Uthe siyehla nesibalo sabafuna ukuba abahlengikazi, wathi akazi yini eyenza lokhu ekubeni bebaningi abantu abafuna ukungena kulo mkhakha.Ngesikhathi ebuza ukuthi ngabe imali eyenza abahlengikazi bashiye, kuvungame indlu bavuma ngo-elethu ukuthi iyona eyenza bahambe."Izwe libhekene nesihlava sokungasebenzi kwabantu, ikakhulu odokotela nabahlengikazi ezifundazweni iKwaZulu-Natal, Mpumalanga, Gauteng naseLimpopo. Izibhedlela zigcwele kanti nesabelomali kasenele." Ubale neyengqalasizinda ukuthi iyinselelo enkulu ezibhedlela zakuleli.

Esitatimendeni kwi-website yayo, ithe kumele kubhukulwe ekushintshweni kwamakhadi ikakhulu njengoba amadala engasasebenzi."Kunokukhathazeka ngokuthi ngabe amaPosi azoba nayo yini imali eyenele uma abantu abangawashintshanga amakhadi sebethutheleka kuwona beyohola ngenyanga ezayo? Akufakwe imali ethe xaxa emaPosini ukuze abantu bangabuyi belambatha ngezinsuku zokuhola."Ithe nalabo asebekwazile ukushintshela emakhadini amnyama amasha, akumele babe nezinkinga uma sekumele bakhiphe imali yabo.Le nhlangano ithe iyakwamukela ukuthi kunohlelo lokuvakashelwa emakhaya kwalabo abangakwazi ukuhamba ukuze bashintshelwe amakhadi."Sifuna kuqiniswe umkhankaso kubantu bazi ukuthi yiziphi izindlela okumele bathole ngazo imali yabo kulabo abangakawashintshi amakhadi. Kumele baqinisekiswe ukuthi imali yabo bazoqhubeka bayithole noma bengakashintshi," kusho iBlack Sash.Ikomiti loMnyango wezeNhlalakahle ePhalamende, linxuse abangakashintshi ukuthi baqhubeke bashintshe amakhadi ukuze bathole amasha.Usihlalo wekomiti uNksz Bridget Masango, uthe noma engasasebenzi amakhadi amadala kodwa zikhona ezinye izinhlelo zokuthola isibonelelo.Uthe iPostbank iveze ukuthi izoshintsha amakhadi kuze kube uJuni 30, 2025. "Abangashintshile bazokwazi ukuthola imali yabo emaPosini. Siyazi ukuthi kuzoba nolayini abade emaPosini kodwa sinxusa abantu babekezele," usho kanje.I-Sassa ithe awasasebenzi amakhadi amadala ngakho abantu bangazami ukuwasebenzisa.Ithe abangashintshile bazoqhubeka nokuthola imali yabo uma sekufike izinsuku zokuhola ngenyanga ezayo."Sifuna ukwazisa abazohola emaPosini ukuthi kuzohola abangawashintshile amakhadi abo. Labo asebenamakhadi amasha asePostbank kumele bawasebenzise kuma-ATM noma ezitolo ukuthola imali yabo," kusho iSassa. Ithe umnqamulajuqu wokushintshwa kwamakhadi wawungoFebhuwari 2025, kodwa wahlehliselwa uMashi 20. UMDIDIYELI wamabutho kaZulu uMnuz Sipho Mhlongo usenxuse ibutho eliseGoli ukuthi limfune lize limthole uMax Makhanya osenesikhathi eside egxibha indlunkulu kanjalo neSilo uMisuzulu kaZwelithini.Uthe udaba lukaMakhanya selunesikhathi futhi alubaphethe kahle."Asithokozile ngenkulumo eyenziwa uMax Makhanya ezinkundleni zokuxhumana yokungahloniphi isizwe sikaZulu nendlunkulu."Uthebaxhumane nondunankulu wesizwe sakwaMakhanya uMnuz Mbongeni Makhanya lapho uMax ephuma khona, ukuthi asondezwe ukuze ayalwe ukuba aqoqe ulimi lwakhe. Bathe benze ngale ndlela ukuhlonipha isizwe sakwaMakhanya kungabi wukuthi babakhomba ngenjumbane. Kuthiwa uMax akatholakalanga ekhaya kubo futhi nalapho okwaziwa ukuthi uhlala khona eMayville nakhona kubukwa ukuthi kudala anyamalala.Kuzwakele ukuthi uzinze eGoli futhi ubuholi bebutho obuseGoli sebubikeliwe ukuthi alumsondeze kukhulunywe naye eduze.Kuthiwa ziningi izinkulumo zikaMax ezingamanyala futhi ibutho selizimisele ukubhekana naye futhi liyazi ukuthi uMax akazenzeli yena yedwa kodwa bakhona abambelethile.UMhlongo uqwashise ubukhosi bakwaMakhanya buphumele obala ngokuthi bayakweseka na lokhu okwenziwa uMax noma cha ngoba sesiside isikhathi uMax eqhuba intwala ngewisa.
KUSITHELE ilanga izolo amaphoyisa esesitholile isidumbu sowesifazane obese kuphele isikhathi esingangonyaka engaziwa ukuthi washonaphi. Isidumbu salona wesifazane owayekhubazekile ngokomgqondo simbiwe emathuneni aseLangfontein, eMolweni. Isihlobo sikamufi, okungowesilisa okuthiwa singumfundisi, sikhombe ethuneni likamshana waso, abamfihla kule ndawo ukuthi samfaka kulona uNksz Thuleleni Shabalala (53) owaduka ngonyaka odlule.Isolezwe lithintwe amalungu omphakathi izolo ekuseni abethukile ngalesi sigameko. Lona wesilisa okuthiwa uhlala nomkakhe nezingane, usolwa ngamacala amabili okubulala izihlobo zasemndenini wakhe ezikhubazekile.Umthombo weSolezwe uveze ukuthi laba banyamalala ngokushiyana akwangazeka ukuthi kwenzakaleni kubo. Omunye kusolwa ukuthi wambulala wamgqiba egcekeni kwakhe.Umthombo ulandisa Isolezwe uveze ukuthi izihlobo zaveza ukungenami kwazo ngokunyamalala kwalaba njengoba naye umsolwa wayethi akabazi ekubeni babengaphansi kweso lakhe."Uma ebuzwa wayeveza ukuthi akabazi ukuthi bashonaphi. Kula amanye amalungu omndeni anikela khona emaphoyiseni avula icala, kwaphenywa kodwa ubufakazi abangatholakala kwaze kwaba idokodo liyavalwa ngo-Agasti wangonyaka odlule."Manje sekulahleka omunye futhi naye ongowesifazane owanikwa yena (umsolwa) ezandleni ephuma esibhedlela eMariannhill, la ayelashwa khona. Kwathi kuzwakala naye akasamazi - kwasolwa ukuthi kukhona okushaya amanzi. Kula beqale khona babiza amaziko ahlukene ezindaba befuna kubuzwe lona wesilisa ngokunyamalala kwezihlobo zakhe nokugcine ngokuthi kufike amaphoyisa azomthatha ngeSonto ekuseni," kusho umthombo.Uveze ukuthi abakuzwile ukuthi lona wesilisa ngenkathi esahambe namaphoyisa ukuthi isihlobo sakhe sesibili wasingcwaba egcekeni."Ngikhuluma nawe nje sisemangcwabeni njengoba esekhombile ukuthi sikuphi isidumbu sokuqala. Kulindeleke siye ekhaya la kuthiwa lona omunye wamgqiba khona. Amaphoyisa asemkhiphile," kuchaza umthombo.Uthe okubacasula kakhulu ukuthi lona wesilisa ubeqhubeka nokubaholela imali yabo yempesheni.Ikhansela lendawo, uMnuz Siyabonga Nala, lithe kubathusile ukuvela kwalesi sigameko, lathi kodwa abakubheke kakhulu ukuthi umphakathi ungaphakamisi imimoya kumele bayeke amaphoyisa enze umsebenzi wawo.Amaphoyisa abengakaphawuli ngalolu daba.
UBELOKHU ezimamathekela, engazi nanyaka, owesilisa olahlwe yicala lokubulala ngesihluku unina wengane enxanxatheleni yezitolo iGateway, ngesikhathi enikwa ithuba lokuzicelela isigwebo esincane eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini.UMnuz Siphamandla Khumalo (34) ongowokuzalwa KwaNongoma, waboshwa ngo-Agasti 4, nyakenye, emva kokugwaza ephindelela uNksz Nomfundo Msibi (30) emhubheni obheke erenki yamatekisi ngosuku olufanayo.Isigameko senzeka emva kokuthi uKhumalo eyenge umufi ngokuthi abahlangane ezitolo ukuzokhipha ilay-by yakhe, ababeyenze ezinyangeni ezimbalwa ezedlule, besathandana. Eme okokuqala ngqa ebhokisini lofakazi, ucele uxolo enkantolo nasemndenini kamufi, wathi uyazisola ngesenzo sakhe. Lokhu ukusho emoyizela.Uqhube wathi ucela inkantolo imnike isigwebo esingaphansi kukadilikajele (okuyisigwebo esinikwa abantu abenze icala elifanayo) ngoba wuye owondla umndeni kubo, aphinde ondle nendodana (5) ayithola kumufi.Udalule ukuthi umndeni wakhe, okungodadewabo abahlanu (alahlwa nabo ngabazali babo bebancane) nezingane zabo ezintathu, sebeke balale bengadlile njengoba yena esezikhindini.Uveze nokuthi enkontilekeni yokwakha, ubenabasebenzi ebebesebenza ngaphansi kwakhe, abebeholelwa wuye, ngaleso sizathu ufisa inkantolo imcabangele uma isimgweba."Nasemphakathi wangakithi, bengiwusizo. Bengibakhela abantu ngemali encane, abanye ngibavumele ukuthi bangikhokhele sekwedlule isikhathi emva kokuxoxa,” kusho uKhumalo.Uveze ukuthi baqala ukuthandana nomufi amfica enengane eyodwa ngo-2016, bathola izingane ezimbili, eyodwa yazo yashona, basala nale ekhona.Ummeli wakhe kahulumeni, uMnuz Phumelele Daniso, umyalele ukuthi acacise eyowesilisa ayehamba naye ngosuku lwesigameko, okwavela ukuthi umfowabo, njengoba ebeseveza ukuthi uye yedwa ongowesilisa kwabo."Lowo umfowethu ozalwa ubaba omncane,” kuphendula uKhumalo. Sekuthatha umshushisi woMbuso, u-Advocate Krishen Shah, umbuze ukuthi yini abethi uyayixolisa enkantolo nasemndenini kamufi? UKhumalo uthe uxolisela isenzo sakhe esibhedayo asenza, wathi waqala ukuzisola ngaso sekuphele izinsuku ezimbili esenzile. "Emndenini kanina wengane yami ngixolisela nokuthi ngesikhathi engiyophuma ngaso, sikwazi ukuxhumana nabo njengoba kukhona ingane ekhona,” kuzicelela uKhumalo.UShah usole uKhumalo ngokuthi akanakho nhlobo ukuzisola, akushoyo ukusho ngoba egwema ukugwetshwa udilikajele."Uma umuntu exolisa, inkantolo uyivezela konke okwenzeka. Uyayitshela inkantolo nokuthi kungani enza leso sigameko,” kusho uShah.UKhumalo ube eseveza ukuthi yena wayengahlosile ukubulala umufi kodwa yinto nje eyenzeka egajwe ukudinwa, ukuthi umufi uyahluleka ukukhipha i-lay-by yakhe.Nokho uShah uthe ngaphandle kokuthi uKhumalo waya kohlangana nomufi ehlome ngohalakasha lommese, waya khona engayiphethe imali yokukhipha i-lay-by ayefuna ikhishwe nokushiya umbuzo wokuthi kanti yini ayethi abayoyihlanganela eGateway uma kwakungesiyona indlela yokumthola ukuze ambulale.UShah uphinde wathi okunye okudweba isithombe sokuthi wayehlose ukumbulala umufi ukuthi waqala wamgwaza ngesikhathi umufi eseqale ukuthatha amagxathu ehamba eya esokeni lakhe ayefike nalo ngosuku lwesigameko, uKhumalo ayesazi ngalo njengoba wake walishayela ucingo phambilini, elitshela ukuthi alihlukane nonina wengane yakhe."Wayesehamba. Wena waqala wamgwaza. Kwathi noma esebaleka, ememeza esho ukuthi nakhu umgwaza, wamjaha, wagxavuna, wamgwaza uphindelela, waze wamnquma, umnqumisa okwesilwane,” kusho uShah.UKhumalo wehlulekile ukuphawula kulokhu. Enza izethulo zokugcina uDaniso uthe uyazi ukuthi icala elenziwe uKhumalo egwaza umufi amanxeba angu-22 ngenyanga okuhlonishwa ngayo abantu besifazane, isigwebo salo udilikajele. Uthe kodwa inkantolo ayikhumbule ukuthi usemusha, uyaqala ukona, uyondla kubo, ukhule ngaphandle kwabazali waze wangasiqeda nesikole nokuthi icala wayengalihlelanga kodwa lenzeka emva kokuba egajwe ukudinwa. UShah uthe inkantolo kufanele imunike isigwebo esiqinile njengoba lize lafika ekugcineni icala engakhombisi ukuzisola, ukuxolisa kwakhe kungaphatheki, futhi ehlulekile ukusho isizathu esizwakalayo esadala ukuthi abone uNksz Msibi engafanelwe ukuphila.IJaji uJacqueline Henriques likuhlehlisele inamuhla ukugwetshwa kukaKhumalo.
INDLULAMITHI yamakhosi, uMisuzulu kaZwelithini, iveze ukuthi isezinhlelweni zokuthi kuncishiswe izindawo ezidayisa uitshwala KwaZulu-Natal, njengoba zinomthelela ekutheni intsha ingaphumeleli futhi kube nezigameko zokudutshulwa kwabantu kuzo.ONgangezwe lakhe ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi kunenkonzo akade emenywe kuyo yibandla eliholwa u-Apostole John noNkosikazi wakhe uPastor Ayanda Ngcebetsha, iSandton AOG House of Refuge.Inkonzo bibanjelwe eGrace Family Church eMhlanga, ngoLwesihlanu ebusuku. Injongo yayo enkulu bekuwukwakha ubudlelwano neNdlunkulu kaZulu, umphakathi wase-KZN kuhlanganiswe nabefundisi bamabandla ehlukene.Sikhuluma ngokuba khona kwaleli bandla, iSilo siveze ukuthi singumuntu okhulele emzini okholwayo futhi naso njengoba sisesihlalweni konke uma kwenzeka sikubhekisa kuNkulunkulu."Ngiyabonga kubaba uSbongiseni "Mageza” Mbambo okunguye owangitshela ngabafundisi abafuna ukungibona, kanti ilona leli bandla. Ngithokozile ukuba kule nkonzo namhlanje. Engikunxusayo kubefundisi ukuthi ake bakhulukele isifundazwe iKwaZulu-Natal kulezi zinsuku esihlaselwa yizinhlekelele ezehlukene zokushintshashintsha kwezulu. Angigcini ngalokho, ngifuna ke kusukunyelwe nendaba yokwanda kangaka kwezindawo ezidayisa utshwala. Uma ubheka yizona eziningi kakhulu kunamabandla. Ake kwande amabandla. Ngifuna ukuyisukumela indawo yezindawo ezidayisa utshwala ukuthi zivalwe. Izigameko zokudutshulwa kwabantu uma behlangene kulezi zindawo nazo ziyanda futhi uma zenzekile kushona abantu abaningi,” kuchaza uBayede.Ongangezwe Lakhe uphinde waphawula ngomsindo wasendlunkulu mayelana nesihlalo. Uveze ukuthi umbonile uNkulunkulu emlwela, yena besingekho isidingo sokuthi alwe futhi bonke ababemlwisa ubabonile bewa phambi kwakhe."Ngesikhathi ngithatha isihlalo esigodlweni ngasho ngathi ngiyolihola ngeBhayibheli izwe likababa. Ngamcela uNkulunkulu ukuthi angene kimi ukuze kungakhulumi mina kodwa ngibatshele iqiniso abantu, angiyena umuntu ojwayele ukuqamba amanga."ISilo siqhube ngokuthi: "Ngiyabonga ngokuthi abaleli bandla bafike kimi bezocela ukuthi bakhonze kulesi sifundazwe, ngibonga ukufika kwabo abefundisi kunabantu abahlale befika kimi bezofuna izimvume zokudayisa utshwala.” Kule nkonzo kunandise uTimothy Myeni owaduma ehola iqembu Incandweni Christ Embassadors yaseSwatini, Khaya Sibanyoni noSiyakha Khitha.
INDODANA yomsunguli weqembu i-IFP, Inkosi Zuzifa kaMangosuthu Buthelezi, ikhuze uqhekeko kule nhlangano eyasungulwa eminyakeni engu-50 eyedlule.Inkosi Zuzifa (indodana yeNkosi Mangosuthu Buthelezi) idonse ngendlebe abaholi beqembu ukuba bangavumi ukulawulwa umhobholo wezikhundla.Ikusho lokhu ngesikhathi ikhuluma emcimbini weminyaka engu-50 kwasungulwa i-IFP.Umcimbi ubusenkundleni, iPrince Mangosuthu Stadium, oLundi, izolo. I-IFP izokuba nengqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi kulo nyaka. Lena kuzoba ingqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi be-IFP yokuqala kusukela kwakhothama umsunguli weqembu, uShenge.Kukhona asebeqalile ukukhuluma ngombango wezikhundla. Inkosi Zuzifa ixwayise ngokuthi umbango wezikhundla ungaqumba phansi iqembu."Asiqaphele singaqhathwa abantu. Baningi osibhincamakhasana abahamba bekhuluma, bethi ubani akazwani nobani. Asiyiyeke indaba yamaqembuqembu."Inkosi Zuzifa ithe i-IFP akulula ukuba ishabalale ngoba yakhelwe esisekelweni esiqinile, kodwa ingawa uma abaholi bengalibala umbango wezikhundla."Izinto ezingabulala iqembu umhobholo, abaholi abangondlovukayiphikiswa, nabaholi abathanda izikhundla, okuyisifo esihlasele onke amaqembu."Inkosi Zuzifa ithe lumfikisela ngomunyu usuku lwayizolo njengoba lungamficanga umsunguli weqembu owakhothama ngasekuphelni kuka-2023."Kuyintokozo nomunyu ukuba semkhosini onjengalona. Kuyintokozo ngoba sibona ingane ezalwe eminyakeni engu-50. Ibe nezinselelo, yakhula yaze yaba ngaka. Ukunibona kusithoba amanxeba, kusinika amandla okuba siqhubeke lapho kugcine khona abebengaphambi kwethu."IPhini likaMengameli we-IFP, Inkosi Mzamo Buthelezi, licele kuShenge ukuba abe ingilosi enhle eqenjini, angavumeli ukuba kube noqhekeko. "Egameni lakho Shenge ngikhulekela ukuba sibumbane. Isitha sithule siyabuka, silinde ithuba lokugadla. Uma singabhekile, isitha sizosiqumba phansi. Shenge ungavumi ukuba abalobizela izikhundla babulale iqembu lakho. Uma sonke siyithanda i-IFP, asibumbane."Inkosi Mzamo ithe ifisa kufezeke iphupho likaShenge lokuba i-IFP ibuyisane ne-ANC."Uma i-IFP ne-ANC bengabuyisani ngeke liye phambili izwe. Nginxusa abaholi bamaqembu omabili ukuba bahlangane, ukuze kuphole amanxeba adaleka kudala."
IDONSE amehlo abaningi imashi ebihlelwe wumsakazi weVuma FM, uJacinta MaNgobese Zuma, ebiseThekwini. I-March in March, eqale epaki kuBotha yaphelela eCity Hall, injongo yayo bekuwukudlulisa umyalezo wokuthi abahambe kuleli abantu abangenazimvume abaqhamuka emazweni angaphandle. UJacinta uthe ubugebengu obudlangile eminyangweni ehlukene kahulumeni, emigwaqweni emadolobheni amakhulu nakwezinye izindawo nokudayiswa kwezidakamizwa okuningi kwenziwa ngabokufika. Le mashi ibixhaswe yiqembu lezepolitiki, i-Action SA. UMnuz Zwakele Mncwango, ongumholi waleli qembu KwaZulu-Natal, uthe bayahambisana nale mashi njengoba nabo kuyinto abayifunayo ukuthi abangenazo izimvume zokuba kuleli bahambe. "Sifuna iqine imithetho yokuthi abakuleli ngokungemthetho bathathwe babuyiselwe emazweni abo. Kungagcini lapho, sifuna uhulumeni noMnyango wezaseKhaya bayiqinise imithetho ethinta ukuba khona kwabantu bangaphandle kuleli bengenamvume. Yimashi le ehlelwe ngabantu bakuleli abakhathazekile," kusho uMncwango. Uthe bekudingeka kube khona abalusukumelayo lolu daba. UMnuz Mlungisi Ndlovu, wenyunyana yabasebenzi iPublic Servants Association of South Africa (PSA), uthe alusukunyelwe udaba lwabangaphandle abangena kuleli ngokungemthetho, wathi amaphoyisa kanjalo nababhekelele imingcele kumele banikwe izinsiza zokusebenza ezizokwenza umsebenzi wabo ubelula futhi bahlale bevikelekile. Umhleli wale mashi, uJacinta, ubonge wonke umuntu okade ekhona, wathi lokhu kusayisiqalo, balindele uhulumeni alubheke lolu daba. "Ngibonga ukuthi abantu bakwazile ukuphuma bazomasha. Unyaka nonyaka sizoyibamba imashi yalolu hlobo ngoba sonke besicabanga ukuthi isimo sizoba ngcono kodwa kuya ngokuba kubi. Abantu bebefuna ukukhuluma ngalolu daba kodwa konke bebekugcina ezinkundleni zokuxhumana kungenzeki lutho. Namanje kuyajabulisa ukubona abantu abangaka bengabi novalo lokuthi kukhona okuzobehlela uma beveza ukungajabuli kwabo," kuchaza yena. Uhlu lwezikhalazo lwamukelwe nguMnuz Sabelo Gwala obephuma eHhovisi likaNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli.
AMALUNGU eNehawu azozwakalisa ukungahambisani kwawo nokunyuswa kwentela eyengezwa ezintweni ezithengwayo, iValue Added Tax (VAT), uma sekwethulwa isabelomali saKwaZulu-Natal, namhlanje.I-Nehawu izoba nombhikisho onokuthula esiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal, lapho uMphathiswa wezeziMali, uMnuz Francios Rodgers, ezokwethula khona isabelomali sakhe sokuqala kusukela angena kulesi sikhundla.Isabelomali sikazwelonke esethulwa uNgqongqoshe wezeziMali, uMnuz Enoch Godongwana, siphakamisa ukuthi intela inyuswe ngo-0.5% kulo nyakamali ozoqala, iphinde inyuswe ngomunye u-0.5% kunyakamali olandelayo.Ziningi izinhlaka eziphikisana nalesi siphakamiso esisazovotelwa ePhalamende.UNobhala weNehawu KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Ayanda Zulu, uthe bazozwakalisa ukungenami kwabo ngesiphakamiso sokunyuswa kwentela.I-Nehawu ikhala ngokuthi ukunyuswa kwentela kuzokhinyabeza abasebenzi kanye nabantu abahlwempu.Embhikishweni wanamhlanje iNehawu izophinde izwakalise ukungahambisani nokuthi uhulumeni onge imali ngokumisa ukuqashwa kwabasebenzi bakahulumeni.UZulu uthe ukungaqashwa kwabasebenzi sekwenze ukuthi kube nezikhala eziningi eminyangweni kahulumeni esifundazweni."Siyaphikisana nalo mkhuba omubi owenziwa uMnyango wezeziMali lapha KwaZulu-Natal wokonga imali ngokungaqashi abasebenzi bakahulumeni. Lo mkhuba usuholele ekutheni iminyango ingabi nabasebenzi abenele. Ukungabi khona kwabasebenzi abanele kuphazamisa ukusebenza kweminyango, abantu abazitholi ngendlela efanele izidingo."UZulu uthe bazohlaba ikhwelo lokuthi uhulumeni uqashe bonke abasebenzi ngokugcwele."Sizohlaba nekhwelo lokuthi uhulumeni aqashe ngokugcwele onompilo njengoba iNkantolo yezaBasebenzi isanda kukhipha umyalelo wokuthi abaqashwe ngokugcwele."Selokhu uRodgers angena esikhundleni uhlale ezishaya isifuba ngokonga imali ebisaphazwa iminyango kahulumeni.I-DA KwaZulu-Natal ithe isabelomali siyithuba lokuthi uRodgers enze lokhu ahlezi ekushumayela kokuba kwabiwe ngendlela imali.Okhulumela iDA kwezezimali esiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Tim Brauteseth, uthe uRodgers uvele useqalile ukuzibonakalisa, kodwa wathi namhlanje uzoba nethuba eliyingqayizivele lokuba akhombise ukuthi akagcini ngokukhuluma kodwa uphinde enze."Namhlanje kuzoqopheka umlando KwaZulu-Natal. Kuzobe kungokwesibili umphathiswa ongelona ilungu le-ANC ethula isabelomali kusukela ngo-1994. Selokhu uRodgers engenile esikhundleni, miningi imizamo aseyenzile yokonga imali."UBrauteseth uthe bafuna uRodgers abhekane nezinkinga ezintathu ezikhungethe isifundazwe kwezezimali.Uthe inkinga yokuqala ukuthi isifundazwe asitholi isabelo esanele esabelweni sikazwelonke, wathi eyesibili ukuthi izinkampani zikahulumeni wesifundazwe azitholi isabelo esanele, wathi eyesithathu ukunyuswa kwemiholo yabasebenzi bakahulumeni ngaphandle kokuthi kwenyuswe isabelo esitholwa isifundazwe.
SEKUQUBUKE imvunge ngabane abalaliswe uyaca ngamaphoyisa ezimpambanweni zemigwaqo uDuffs noDumusani Makhaye KwaMashu, ngoLwesine. Kulesi sigameko kufe uMnuz Nathi Biyela (40) nesihlobo sakhe uMnuz Nicolas Biyela (41), Mnuz Sanele Ntuli (25) nesihlobo sakhe uMnuz Nhlakanipho Ntuli (31). Umthombo weSolezwe ocele ukungadalulwa, uveze ukuthi uNicolas ubewusihlalo wekomiti le-ward, aphinde abe wusihlalo weCommunity Policing Forum (CPF) ehostela KwaMashu. Uveze ukuthi uNathi ubewunobhala wesiyingi uMbelebeleni, kwiNorth Central, eqenjini i-IFP, kuthi uNhlakanipho abe yiphini likasihlalo eflethini elaziwa ngokuthi iseZimangweni ehostela, bese kuthi uSanele abe yinduna yakhona eZimangweni. Umthombo utshele Isolezwe ukuthi ukubulawa kwabafi akuhlangene nobugebengu kodwa kumayelana nephrojekthi yokwakhiwa kwamaflethi esesigabeni sokuqalwa kuleli hostela. "UNathi, Nico noSanele badutshulwa nje, babuya emhlanganweni wokugcotshwa ngokusemthethweni ekomitini labangu-11 abaqokelwe ukubheka ukuqhubeka ngendlela efanele kwephrojekthi,” kusho umthombo.Uthe uNhlakanipho ufele into angayazi njengoba yena okumbeke endaweni yesigameko ukuthi ubebahambise emhlanganweni ngemoto yakhe, waphinde wabalanda sebeqedile, kanti sebezohlangabezana nabakwasidlodlo.Umthombo uqhube wathi leli komiti elifaka phakathi amalungu avela ezigcemeni ezintathu zehostela (eMbelebeleni, Sulabasha neKhabazela), likhethwe emva kokuthi ikhansela lendawo liqoke abantu abangaziwa ukuba bazokwakha izilephu zamaflethi azokwakhiwa.Umthombo uthe ukufika kwalaba bantu abangaziwa kwelanywe imihlangano embalwa lapho obekuqondiswa khona lokhu, kwagcina kuzaleka ikomiti ebelifaka phakathi nabafi. "Asiyikholwa eyokuthi babulawe ngoba bekukhona amacala ebebefunelwa wona. Bebehlala ezinhlakeni zomphakathi. Abanye babo bebehlala emihlanganweni ye-CPF phakathi esiteshini samaphoyisa KwaMashu. Uma bebefunelwa ubugebengu obuthile, kungani bebengaboshwa uma bebebambe leyo mihlangano yomphakathi?” kubuza umthombo. Omunye umthombo uthe kuyabamangaza ukuthi kwangalo usuku lwesigameko, amaphoyisa awazange ababophe ehholo lomphakathi eDuffs Road, lapho ebebegcotshwa khona, akhetha ukubayeka, aze ayobadubulela ezimpambanweni zomgwaqo, sebegoduka. "Sifuna amaphoyisa achaze ukuthi kwenzakaleni. Asigculisekile ngokubulawa kwabo. Sifuna izimpendulo ukuze kuvele ukuthi ikhansela lisebenzise maphi amandla, ukuthi kwenzeke kanje,” kusho umthombo.Lithintwa ikhansela, uMnuz Sandile Gwala, lithe kalazi ukuthi umsebenzi wamaphoyisa uyishiya kanjani imibuzo ngoba asuke eselwenze aluqeda uphenyo lwawo.UGwala uthe uyamangala nokuthi lingena kanjani igama lakhe emsebenzini wamaphoyisa. Uvumile ukuthi unalo ulwazi lwephrojekthi okufanele iqhubeke ehostela, wase eveza ukuthi yena ngokolwazi lwakhe njengomholi we-ward, alukho uhlaka lwe-CPF nolwekomiti lendawo ngenxa yenkinga yabaxhaphaza izinhlaka ezibalulekile zasehostela."Laba bantu okhuluma ngabo bake bahlukumeza usonkontileka owayezolungisa kabusha inkundla yezemidlalo ngo-2023. Bezibiza nge-business forum, bafuna ngodli imali yokuvikela engu-R500 000. Lokhu kufakazela ukuthi kuyiqiniso okushiwo amaphoyisa uma ethi bebefuna imali yokuvikela,” kusho uGwala. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant Colonel Paul Magwaza esitatimendeni asithumelele abezindaba emva kwesigameko, uthe abafi bebesolwa ngamacala okuphanga, ukubulala nokufuna imali yokuvikela kosomabhizinisi.Isitatimende siqhuba sithi bavulele ngenhlamvu ngesikhathi bebona amaphoyisa, nawo abuyisela ngayo, bafa bobane, batholwa nezibhamu ezintathu. Umthombo uveze ukuthi ababili babo bebenezibhamu ezisemthethweni, owesithathu esafake isicelo sokuba naso ngokusemthethweni.
INGXABANO edalwe ukushayelisana kabi, ikhiphe isidumbu emgwaqweni uMangosuthu Highway, ngasenxanxatheleni yezitolo KwaMnyandu, eMlaza.Kulesi sigameko kufe umshayeli weveni eliyi-double cab, okuthiwa udutshulwe amahlandla amathathu ngumshayeli wetekisi, okuvela ukuthi ubeshayelisana naye kabi.Ngokusho komthombo, umufi ubehamba eshayeliswa kabi umsolwa kusukwa ngasenxanxatheleni yezitolo iMega City."Kuthiwa umsolwa ubelokhu emshayelisa kabi yonke le ndlela. Kuthe uma sebefika ngaKwaMnyandu, umufi obedinwe egane unwabu, wehla emotweni yakhe, waqonda kumsolwa etekisini,” kusho umthombo.Uqhube wathi, ufike kuye (umsolwa), wamhluba ngequpha."Uvele wabuyisela ngenhlamvu, emdubula amahlandla amathathu,” kubeka umthombo.Uthe umufi uthulele endaweni yesigameko. Abenkampani yosizo oluphuthumayo, i-ALS Paramedics Medical Services, abahambele endaweni yesigameko emva kokwenzeka kwaso ngabo-11 ekuseni, bathe umufi ubedutshulwe ezindaweni ezibucayi kwesingenhla."Abosizo oluphuthumayo bethu bafike endaweni yesigameko sekukhona namaphoyisa. Bakhonjiswe lapho bekudindilize khona isidumbu sikamufi. Bathe uma bemhlola, babona ukuthi amanxeba akhe abesezindaweni ezimbi, kungekho ebebengakwenza. Bamqinisekise njengoseshonile khona lapho,” kusho isitatimende sabakwa-ALS Paramedics Medical Services.Okhulumela i-South African National Taxi Council (Santaco) KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Sifiso Shangase, edlulisa amazwi enduduzo emndenini kamufi, uthe banxusa ukubekezelelana kubashayeli uma besebenzisa umgwaqo."Sibheke emaholidini ePhasika, imigwaqo izoba matasatasa, abantu beya ezindaweni ezehlukene. Sithi abantu abangashayelisani kabi emgwaqweni, uma sekwenzekile washayelisa noma washayeliswa kabi, udlame alusona isixazululo,” kusho yena. Kuphinde kwaba nomunyu esedalula ukuthi babambe umoya ukuthi amanye amalungu omndeni asesibhedlela angashoni nawo.UMnuz Ntethelelo Mangalo ubalise ngokudlula emhlabeni kukamfowabo uMnuz Sibusiso Mangalo. Uveze ukuthi umfowabo ushona nje ezinsukwini bese kukaningi elokhu ekhuluma ngokufa. Uthe uze wambuza ukuthi kungani elokhu ekhuluma ngokufa kulezi zinsuku? Uthe kodwa akayitholanga impendulo ecacile."Okubuhlungu nje sivelelwe yilo mshophi nje sisanda kubeka umama wethu,'' usho kanjena. Uthe uphatheke kabi uma abantwana bakhe sebembuza ukuthi uphi kanti uNkulunkulu abamkhonzayo uma sekushonwa njalo kulo mndeni. Uthe kodwa ubonile ukuthi abantwana bakhulunyiswa ukungaqondi futhi banganyelwe ubuhlungu.Uthe kuyabaduduza ukuthi ngesikhathi bebizwa enkonzweni yabaPhostoli batshelwa ukuthi ngelinye ilanga liyokhala icilongo.UNksz Phakama Mvela oyisihlobo sikaNksz Nominyaka Mvela naye oshonile uthe kuxega amadolo akuvumi nokuthi akhulume. Izinyembezi bezizehlela kuyena wachaza umufi njengowesifazane obemazisa kakhulu uNkulunkulu.UMnuz Bhekani Gumede ukhulume ngokushona kukadadwabo uNksz Lungile Gumede uthe bafe olwembiza ngoba kubo umufi bekunguyena yedwa intombazane. Uthe utholile ukuthi udadewabo udlule emhlabeni ngesikhathi abezimo eziphuthumayo bezama ukumtakula bemsusa emhosheni bezama ukumfinyelelisa phezulu emgwaqweni.Uthe uyamjabulela ukuthi ushone edlubhe izembatho zebandla labaPhostoli. Uthe ushona nje ubesanda kuthola umsebenzi wokuba nguthisha futhi ushiye emhlabeni izingane ezingamawele.Ulethe umunyu omkhulu uNksz Bonisiwe Mlambo ngesikhathi ekhuluma ngomkhokha wezingozi zomgwaqo athe bezibonakala zilandela udadewabo uNksz Jabulile Mlambo. Udalule ukuthi umufi uthathwa yile ngozi nje, ubengasenayo ingalo yangakwesobunxele ngenxa yengozi yebhasi abandakanyeka kuyona esemncane."Kuyacaca ukuthi ibimlandela le nto yezingozi, kwaze kwabuhlungu-ke kodwa ukuthi igcine imgojele,''usho kanjena.UNksz Thandazile Mdletshe uthe umufi u-Inami Zikhali uyingane kadadewabo ecele ukuba izohlala nabo ngaseThekwini isuka kubo eMbazwana."Emakhaya eMbazwana basibuzile ukuthi ishone kanjani ingane iya esontweni,'' usho kanjena.Amaculo ebehlatshelelwa lapha abevusa uhlevane kubonakala ukuthi aqondaniswe nesimo ibandla elibhekene naso. Elinye lawo belithi: "Ngembathe Moya oyiNgcwele kulawa mathunzi amnyama,'' elinye belithi: "Moya oyiNgcwele sesilinde wena".''Sebebonke abadlulile emhlabeni kule ngozi ngoThabani Mchunu, Sibusiso Mangalo, Nominyaka Mvela, Sindisiwe Mhlongo, Sihle Malwane, Lungile Gumede, Jabulile Mlambo no-Inami Zikhali.Le nkonzo ibikade izinyaziswe ukuba khona kwezikhulu ezahlukene. Phakathi kwazo okubalwa uMphathiswa wezokuThutha KwaZulu Natal, uMnuz Siboniso Duma, iPhini likaNgqongqoshe loMnyango wezokuThutha, uMnuz Mkhuleko Hlengwa, yiMeya yeLembe uMnuz Thobani Shandu neMeya yaKwaDukuza uMnuz Ali Ngidi.
BAWUSHAYE indiva umyalelo kaMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa wokuthi kungabhebhezelwa isimo esivele sishubile, phakathi kwelakuleli neMelika uma sekwamukelwa obeyinxusa elixoshiwe, uMnuz Ebrahim Rasool.Okunalokho amadlelandawonye ne-ANC okuyiCosatu, SACP namalungu e-ANC eKapa, amamukele njengeqhawe uRasool, ngesikhathi etheleka esikhumulweni sezindiza eKapa lapho amukelwe yizihlwele ngombhiyozo.URamaphosa, wayenxuse ngomlomo womkhulumeli wakhe uMnuz Vincent Magwenya, ukuthi abantu bangabhebhezeli isimo esivele sishubile phakathi kweMelika nelakuleli uma sekubuya uRasool.Lokhu kulandela ukuba iMelika imkhombe indlela uRasool yamthatha njengomuntu ongamukelekile kuleliya lizwe, ngenxa yokuthi wagxeka uMengameli Donald Trump, ngokuthi kumele kushintshe indlela elakuleli elenza ngayo izinto ngenxa yokuthi umbuso kaTrump, ubonakala weseka abamhlophe kuleli.Izolo ekhuluma nabezindaba uRasool oqale kulesi sikhundla ngoJanuwari nonyaka, uthe akazisoli ngenkulumo yakhe ngoba akushilo kuyiqiniso."Engikushilo, ngisengaphinde ngikusho noma kukuphi, ngoba kuyiqiniso futhi angizisoli ngakho. Bekunzima ukuzama ukungqongqoza eminyangweni ehlukene eMelika ukuze kube nengxoxo ngezinto eziningi ezingamampunge, ezishiwo ngezwe lethu."Uthe kubalulekile ukuthi uRamaphosa abumbe ubudlelwano neMelika."Kubalulekile ukuthi kwakhiwe kabusha ubudlelwano phakathi kwelakuleli neMelika. Ukuhlala silinde kuphele iminyaka emine (kuphume uTrump emandleni), kungaba nomthelela ongemuhle empilweni yabantu. Kungafa abantu ngenxa yokuhoxiswa kohlelo lwezempilo, lokusiza ngokusabalalisa imishanguzo yokuthithibalisa i-HIV," usho kanje.Uthe uRamaphosa kumele akhethe umuntu onamava ukumjuba abe yinxusa eMelika wathi akangakhethi ngokwebala elimhlophe ngoba uTrump emhlophe.Kunamagama osekuqalile ukukhulunywa ngawo njengabantu abangajutshelwa ukuvala isikhala sikaRasool, okubalwa uMnuz Tony Leon owayeyinxusa lase-Argentina, noMnuz Andries Nel osebe yiphini likaNgqongqoshe wezobuLungiswa isikhathi eside kuleli.Uveze ukuthi uzoya ePitoli namhlanje, lapho kulindeleke ukuthi ahlangane noRamaphosa, amnike umbiko ngezinto ezenzekile kusuka ngelanga afika ngalo eMelika.Udalule nokuthi akazimisele ngokuthi ajutshelwe kwenye indawo. UNobhala weCosatu eWestern Cape, obezokwamukela uRasool uMnuz Malvern de Bruyn, uthe banquma ngeledlule ukuthi bazomamukela lo mholi.Uthe abaneme ngendlela axoshwe ngayo wathi bayameseka ngokuthi ubekhuluma iqiniso.UNobhala weSACP kulesiya sifundazwe uMnuz Benson Ngqentsu, uthe ngeke bezwe ngeMelika ukuthi ubani okumele bamkhethe nokungamele.Uthe ubamele kahle uRasool eMelika wathi ube yiqhawe ngokumela uTrump.UNobhala we-ANC esifundeni iDullah Omar, uMnuz Mvusi Mdala, uthe bayamhlonipha uRamaphosa kodwa bazokweseka umholi wabo abamthatha njengosebenze ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima.
UMHOLI we-IFP, uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa, ufuna ukuba leli qembu elihlanganisa iminyaka engu-50 lisabalale kuyo yonke iNingizimu Afrika. UHlabisa unxuse amalungu eqembu ukuba alwele ukuthi iqembu lisabalale kuzo zonke izingxenye zezwe. Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma emcimbini wokugubha iminyaka engu-50 kwasungulwa i-IFP. Umcimbi ubusenkundleni iPrince Mangosuthu Stadium, oLundi.I-IFP ijwayele ukwenza kahle esifundazweni iKwaZulu-Natal lapho iphethe khona ngokubambisana uhulumeni kanye nenqwaba yomasipala.I-IFP iphinde ibe namalungu esiShayamthetho namakhansela eGauteng, kodwa kuvalwe ngehlahla kwezinye izifundazwe eziyisikhombisa.UHlabisa uthe: "Njengoba siphikelele eminyakeni engu-100, asikhulume nabo bonke abantu. Asikhulume nabantu abasezinkundleni zokuxhumana kanye nalabo abangekho ezinkundleni zokuxhumana. Asikhulise i-IFP kuzo zonke izifundazwe eziyisishiyagalolunye."UHlabisa uthe i-IFP ibambe iqhaza elikhulu kule minyaka engu-50 eyedlule, wabonga imisebenzi eyenziwa umsunguli weqembu, Inkosi Mangosuthu Buthelezi.UHlabisa uthe i-IFP yaqala ukusebenzela abantu bakuleli ngesikhathi kuliwa nohulumeni wobandlululo.UHlabisa uthe i-IFP yaqhubeka nokulwela abantu bakuleli nangaphansi kukahulumeni wentando yabantu.UHlabisa uthe ngesikhathi i-IFP iyingxenye kahulumeni wokubambisana wokuqala yalwela ukuthi abantu abahaqwe igciwane ingculaza bathole imishanguzo.Uthe namanje njengoba sebeyingxenye kahulumeni wokubambisana bayaqhubeka nokulwela abantu bakuleli.UHlabisa uthe njengamanje i-IFP ilwela ukuba ibhange Ithala lingavalwa.UHlabisa uchaze ukuthi kungani besekela isabelomali esinesiphakamiso sokuba kunyuswe intela eyengezwa ezintweni ezithengwayo, iValue Added Tax( VAT), ngo-0.5%.Uthe isabelomali esisazoxoxwa ePhalamende siphakamisa ukuba i-VAT ingafakwa ekudleni okuningi okuthengwa kakhulu abantu abahlwempu."Siyajabula njenge-IFP ukuthi esabelwenimali esisazodingidwa ePhalamende, kuningi ukudla okwehliswe iVAT kukho. Lokhu kuhambisana nalokhu esakusho kokuthi akwandiswe ukudla okungafakwa iVAT kukho ngoba iVAT icindezela abantu bakithi abagcina bethenga ukudla ngemali eningi. Nizobona uma ningena ezitolo ukuthi kuningi ukudla okungenayo i-VAT njengoba iVAT izonyukela ku-15.5%."UHlabisa uthe bayaphikisana nokuthi izwe liqhubeke nokutsheleka imali.UHlabisa uthe bayaqhubeka nokulwela ukuthi ibhange Ithala lingavalwa."Ezingeni likazwelonke siyaxoxisana noMengameli nongqongqoshe wezeZimali ukuba kusheshiswe ilayisensi yeThala njengoba kuvaleleke imali yenu. Siyayeseka imizamo yasenkantolo kodwa lokhu siyakuqonda ukuthi kungathatha isikhathi ukuba kuphothulwe amacala. Ingakho sifuna ukuthi udaba lweThala luphuthunyiswe. Sizokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi bathathelwa izinyathelo abayimbangela yokuvalwa kweThala. "Sizokhuluma nomphathi weBhange loMbuso (uMnuz Lesetja Kganyago), sicele ukuthi udaba lokuvulwa kweThala kube udaba oluphuthumayo. Ithala libalulekile kakhulu. Sizwelana nabantu okuvaleleke imali yabo eThala. Sizwelana nezaguga ezithembele kwiThala okwathathwa imininingwane yazo ngaphandle kwemvume, yanikezwa elinye ibhange."Amalungu e-IFP abephume ngezinkani emcimbini wayizolo.Inkundla ibigcwele phama amalungu enhlangano aqungele ilanga ebelikhipha umkhovu etsheni. Nasedolobheni uLundi bukugcwele kunyinyitheka.Umcimbi ubuhanjelwe nangabaholi be-DA KwaZulu-Natal, kanye nezicukuthwane ezivela emazweni angaphandle okubalwa ezivela eGermany, Taiwan naseChina.
OWAYEYILUNGU lebhodi leSouth African Airways (SAA) uNksz Yakhe Kwinana (60) ubhekene nengwadla yomthetho ngoba iNkantolo eNkulu yaseNorth Gauteng, isichithile isicelo sakhe sokubuyekeza isinqumo esibalulekile esathathwa yiSouth African Institute of Chartered Accountants (SAICA) sokuba akhishwe ohlwini lwama-Charted Accountant kuleli.I-Saica iyinhlangano emele izingcweti kwezezimali nokugcina isithunzi salo msebenzi inqume ukuthi akafanelekile ukuqhubeka nomsebenzi wakhe wobungcweti.Emaphepheni asenkantolo, iSaica ithe ngemuva kokukhishwa kwezijeziso, uKwinana akazange akuphikise okwatholwa yinhlangano ngenxa yokuthi yena nommeli wakhe baphuma esigcawini sokuqondisa ubugwegwe ngosuku lokuqala bangabe besabuya. Nokho uvumile ukuthi uyitholile i-email emazisa ngesinqumo seSAICA wathi lolu daba uzolulwa enkantolo. Ngesikhathi likhipha isinqumo, iJaji u-Elmien du Plessis lithe uKwinana ubukela phansi isikhundla sakhe ngokukhetha ukushiya esigcawini sokuqondiswa kwezigwegwe."Leyo bekuyinkundla efanele yokuphikisa ubufakazi beSaica kanye nezethulo zayo. Ngokungabambeki kwakhe, ikomiti lasala nobufakazi obuphathekayo futhi obungazange buphikiswe muntu ngemuva kokushiya kwakhe isigcawu," kusho ijaji uDu Plessis.ISaica ibe isikhipha isimemezelo sokuthi izoqala ngezinyathelo zokuqoqa imali engu-R6.1 million yenhlawulo kuKwinana, ngaphezu kwezindleko zecala uKwinana ayalelwe ukuba azikhokhe.Okunye okubhebhethekisa izinkinga zakhe zomthetho, uKwinana uboshwe ngoLwesithathu ngamacala abucayi amaningi, okubalwa awokuqola nokucekela phansi impahla.Sekuqubuke izinsolo ezithi uKwinana wadala udlame emiphakathini yase-East London, okubikwa ukuthi ubeqola imali ephelezelwa iqulu elihlomile wakhipha nomyalelo wokuthi akubhidlizwe imizi yezisulu zakheAmaphoyisa abophe uKwinana eMidrand, eGauteng, kulandela uphenyo olunzulu.Ngesikhathi evele kafushane eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseRandburg ngoLwesithathu, umshushisi uveze ukuthi icala lakhe lizodluliselwa e-Eastern Cape, lapho azovela khona ngoMashi 24, 2025.Akukona okokuqala uKwinana ephambana nengalo yomthetho njengoba ngoNovemba 2024, wadedelwa ngebheyili ka-R20 000 ngamacala okukhwabanisa athinta ukusebenza kwakhe eSAA.
INKAMPANI ezimele exhasa osomabhizinisi iHollywood Foundation, ihambe emazwini ayo ngokuklomelisa osomabhizinisi abawu-20 ngemali yokusimamisa amabhizinisi abo. Bathemba ukuthi uxhaso luzolekelela ukuthi achume futhi aye phambili - ukuqhuba umkhondo wayo wokukhathalela umphakathi. Lokho kwenzeke kumaBambelela Business Awards, abeseGrevyille Convention Centre, eThekwini, lapho obekuhlangene khona osomabhizinisi abawu-126, okukhethwe kubona laba abawu-20 abahlabe umxhwele ithimba ebelihlunga imingenelo yabo ngokwehlukana. Lo mcimbi, obekungokwesibili wenziwa KwaZulu-Natal, wendlalelwe wumbukiso wokukhangisa ngemikhiqizo yabo kosomabhizinisi abebengenele, okuyilapho bethole khona ithuba lokushiyelana inkundla, bedayisa amabhizinisi abo - ngethemba lokuhlabana. Isicoco esikhulu sosuku esihambisana nesheke lemali ewuR130 000 yokuxhasa ibhizinisi sihambe neNkazimulo Appled Sciences kaNksz Bathabile Mpofu, kwathi endaweni yesibili kwaba yiBakers Creationz kaMnuz Njabulo Sithole, neLitklean Chemicals kaNksz Nokwanda Cele endaweni yesithathu. Abawu-17 abalandele emva kwalapho, abaklonyeliswe ngoR40 000 wokuxhasa ibhizinisi ngalinye kube iCosmic Dreadlocks Specialists, Akili Timber, Level Innovations, BAP South Africa, Sposh Multi Dimensions, G Khula Trading, Bidy Wood Design Manufacture and Trading, Skhathi Collection, Field Tech Environmental Solutions, June D Cakes, Umphafa Berg Tours, Earth Tones Designs, Mawande Kheswa Imaging, Madame Clucks A Lot, Sinesithembiso Produce, Redd Productions neSibocali Traders.I-Let’s Talk Basket Laundry iklonyeliswe ngoR10 000 wokuhlabana emncintiswaneni wokumaketha ibhizinisi kuFacebook, iMthunzi Poultry Farm yathola uR5 000 wokuba yibhizinisi elifike kuqala emcimbini wokuzoshiyelana inkundla obungoLwesibili, kwase kuthi iPeggy’s Hair Care yakhala yemuka noR5 000 wokuba yibhizinisi elizikhangise kahle nangendlela egculisayo emabhizinisi abenezitende zokukhangisa.Enye yezimenenja zeHollywood Group uNksz Babongile Mkhize, ithe baziqhenya kakhulu ngokuba ngabanye babantu abaqhubekayo babambe iqhaza ekufukuleni osomabhizinisi abasafufusa esifundazweni, okuzosiza ukufukula umnotho wesifundazwe."Sithemba ukuthi lokhu okwenzeke namhlanje kuzosiza ukukhuthaza osomabhizinisi ukuthi babambisane futhi bafukulane ukuchuma kubhekwe phambili. Sinenkolelo yokuthi ukubambisana nokwesekana ngezinye zezinto ezisiza ukuyaphambili,” kusho uNksz Mkhize.Ethula inkulumo obekumele yethulwe wuMphathiwa woMnyango wokuThuthuka uMnotho, ezokuVakasha nezeMvelo uMfu Musa Zondi, umqondisi omkhulu walo Mnyango uMnuz Thami Zondi uthe ukuguqula umnotho kudinga ukubambisana nokusebenzisana kwezinhlaka ezahlukene ezizimele nezohulumeni. Wathi kungakho bekushayela ihlombe abakubona kwenziwa yiHollywood Foundation nezinhlaka ebambisene nazo ukufukula amabhizinisi osomabhizinisi baseKZN."Sinxusa ukuthi nabanye basike iphethini kulo msebenzi omuhle kangaka owenzeka lapha namhlanje, futhi nathi sizivulile izandla neminyango nakwabanye abafisa ukwenza izinhlelo ezinhle njengalolu ezizosiza ukufukula osomabhizinisi abasafufusa,” kusho uZondi.
