UKHALE ngesibalo esiphezulu sosonkontileka abahlinzeka ngokudla ezikoleni zaKwaZulu-Natal umqondisi jikelele eMnyangweni weMfundo eyisiSekelo, uMnuz Mathanzima Mweli, esenza abafundi bangakwazi ukudla ekuseni nasemini.UMweli uthe umnyango wesifundazwe ngeke wakwazi ukuhlinzeka abafundi ngokudla kabili ngosuku,ngenxa yokuthi uqashe osonkontileka abaningi.Uthe lolu hlelo lokudla alufani, kwezinye izifundazwe abafundi bayakwazi ukudla kabili ngosuku."Akusoze kwenzeka eKZN ukuthi abafundi bahlinzekwe ngesidlo sasekuseni, baphinde badle nesasemini ngenxa yokuthi kuqashwe osonkontileka abaningi abahlinzeka izikole ngokudla. Lokhu kwenziwa ngukuthi kubiza kakhulu ukubakhokhela," kusho uMweli, ekhuluma ekomitini lasePhalamende izolo.Uthe yingakho babefuna kwenziwe izinguquko kulolu hlelo lokudla ukuze abafundi bakwazi ukuthola into eyodwa ezweni lonke.Bangaphezu kuka-1 700 osonkontileka abaphakela izikole eKZN.Lolu hlelo luhlomulisa abafundi abangu-9.8 million, nsuku zonke.I-KZN yisona sifundazwe esinesibalo esikhulu sabafundi abadlayo nsuku zonke njengoba bengu-2.4 million. Kulandela iLimpopo ngabangu-1.6 million ne-Eastern Cape ngabangu-1.5 million. "Yingakho sasifuna ukuthi lwenziwe umuntu oyedwa ukuze songe imali. Kodwa kwagcina kubhuntshile lokho, kodwa sisenethemba lokuthi kusangenzeka," usho kanje.Uthe uNgqongqoshe woMnyango wezeMfundo uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, umatasa kwakhiwa uhlelo lokuthi kongiwe imali ngaphansi kwalolu hlelo.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi ngesikhathi ethatha izintambo nyakenye uNksz Gwarube wamisa uhlelo olubuyekeziwe lokudla ezikoleni olwaluzodla cishe uR10 billion. Kwasuka umsindo emuva kokuba kuputshuke ulwazi lokuthi ngaphansi kwalolu hlelo kwakuzohlomula umuntu oyedwa.UNksz Gwarube wathi uzolumisa ngoba kumele luphinde lubuyekezwe kahle ngoba akukwazi ukuthi kungahlomula umuntu oyedwa ohlelweni lwemali engaka kahulumeni.Amalungu ePhalamende akhale ngokuthi kwezinye izifundazwe uthola ukuthi kuthiwa abakhokhelwe abahlinzeka izikole ngokudla ekubeni ikhona imali."Kumele sichazeleke ukuthi kanti isebenza kanjani imali yalolu hlelo esuke iyi-grant (awukwazi ukuyisebenzisela ezinye izinto ngaphandle kokukhokhela ukudla). Uthola ukuthi eKZN kunezinkinga zokungakhokhelwa kwabaphakela izikole ekubeni imali ikhona," kusho uNksz Nompumelelo Gasa weqembu i-MK.Sekuyinsakavukela ukungakhokhelwa ngesikhathi kwabahlinzeka izikole ngokudla eKZN. Baze basabise ngokuthi ngeke bakuhambise ukudla uma kungukuthi umnyango awubakhokhele. Umnyango wesifundazwe uhlale ukhala ngokuthi awunayo imali eyenele njengoba imali eningi ikhokhela amaholo othisha.
Kudutshulwe kwabulawa abasolwa abathathu kwatholakala nezibhamu ezimbili eDoringkop, KwaDukuza.Udaba luqale ngesikhathi amalungu eVala Mgodi ebopha kwabasolwa ababili nokutholwa kwezibhamu ezimbili eSikhaleni, kwatholakala eminye imininingwane kwabeCrime Intelligence ngabasolwa abane abebefunelwa inqwaba yamacala okubulala KwaMsane naseMtubatuba. Imininingwane etholakele ithi abasolwa bebeshayela endaweni yaseDoringkop. Kulandelwe umkhondo wemoto abebehamba ngayo abasolwa, amaphoyisa aphikelela eDoringkop. Imoto ibonwe ngamaphoyisa eshayela emgwaqeni uDoburg, kuthe uma ezama ukuyimisa abebesemotweni bavulele ngenhlamvu bebhekise emaphoyiseni.Kuqubuke impi yezibhamu ngesikhathi kudutshulwana abasolwa abathathu bafa, nokho umsolwa oyedwa wabaleka endaweni yesigameko. Kutholwe izibhamu ezimbili ezingekho emthethweni endaweni yesigameko. Uphenyo lwamaphoyisa luveze ukuthi abasolwa bake babamba inkunzi phambilini, bangena emzini wekhehla balishaya baliphuca isibhamu. Ngenhlanhla ikhehla lisaphila livele namhlanje ngoMgqibelo, 22 March 2025 kanti selivule icala esiteshini samaphoyisa KwaDukuza.
KUCINGWA abasolwa abangaphezu kuka-16 000 abambe bembulula emuva kokukhishwa ngebheyili yizinkantolo zakuleli.Kulaba kukhona nabokufika kuleli abangu-262.Lezi zibalo zivezwe nguNgqongqoshe wezamaPhoyisa, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, ephendula imibuzo yelungu le-DA ePhalamende, uNkk Kabelo Kgobisa-Ngcaba.UNkk Kgobisa-Ngcaba ubuze kuMchunu ukuthi bangaki abakhale bemuka bangabe besabuyela ezinkantolo ukuyoqula amacala ababhekene nawo?Ubuze nokuthi kulaba bangaki abokufika, kanjalo nokuthi bangaki abanamacala aneminyaka emihlanu kuya phezulu?Ephendula uMchunu uthe sebebonke bangu-16 012 ababacingayo emva kokuphuma ngebheyili bangabe besabuyela.Uthe ibheyili ayikhishwa amaphoyisa kodwa izinkantolo zakuleli."Bangu-4 516 abanamacala aneminyaka emihlanu kuya phezulu. Abokufika bangu-262."UMchunu uthe uma laba abadle phansi amacala azovulwa kabusha uma sebebanjiwe.Uveze ukuthi badedelwa uma sekuphothuliwe ngamacala abebebhekene nawo yizinkantolo."Badedelwa uma bevunwa isinqumo saleyo nkantolo. Uma ebanjwa obebaleke emva kokuthola ibheyili ubhekana necala, akabe esabizwa ngoweqile uma esebanjiwe," kusho uMchunu.
IZOBIZA ingqungquthela eyisipesheli iSadtu, ezohlukanisa inhloko nesixhanti ngokuthi amalungu ale nyunyana yothisha azoqoma ukuvotela bani phakathi kwe-ANC neSACP okhethweni lwangonyaka ozayo.Lokhu kulandela ukuthi iSACP yanquma ukuphuma ibhodwe layo, ingabe isavota ne-ANC okhethweni lohulumeni basekhaya oluzayo.AmaKhomanisi anquma uzimele geqe ngoba ekhala ngokuthi ziningi izinto okumele ngabe i-ANC yazenza, kodwa yadembesela kuzona okubalwa nendaba yezinguquko kumadlelandawonye.Kusemahlukwana ndlela nje, abanye bacabanga ukuthi iSACP iyazisabisela nje ngokuthi ifuna ukuzimela okhethweni.I-Sadtu ithathe lesi sinqumo sokuthi kumele ibize le ngqungquthela eyisipesheli ngoba ihlale yeseka uKhongolose okhethweni. Lesi sinqumo seSACP siyihlukanisa phakathi njengoba le nyunyana ingaphansi kweCosatu, eyingxenye yamadlelandawonye okuyi-ANC, SACP, Sanco kanye nayo iCosatu.UNobhala Jikelele weSadtu, uMnuz Mugwena Maluleke, uthe emhlanganweni wesigungu esiphezulu wokuqala konyaka wale nyunyana muva nje, banqume ukuthi kumele bayibize ingqungquthela."Sinqume ukuthi sibize le ngqungquthela eyisipesheli kulandela ingqungquthela eyisipesheli yeSACP ebingoDisemba nyakenye, eyashayelela isipikili sokugcina sokuthi amaKhomanisi angenele ukhetho ngokuzimela ngo-2026. Le ngqungquthela kumele ihlale ngasekupheleni kwalo nyaka, noma ekuqaleni konyaka ozayo kodwa ngaphambi kwengqungquthela yeCosatu. Sifuna amalungu eSadtu anqume ukuthi ubani azomvotela okhethweni," kusho uMaluleke.Usho lokhu nje, amalungu amaningi eSadtu anobulungu be-ANC nobeSACP.Omunye wabo singabala uNobhala weSadtu KwaZulu-Natal, uNksz Nomarashiya Caluza, oyisikhulu seSACP esifundazweni.Abanye abaholi okubalwa oMnuz Thulas Nxesi, owayehola iSadtu uyilungu leSACP.Akungatshazwa ukuthi noma isiphi isinqumo iSadtu ezosithatha njengenye yezinyunyana ezinkulu kwiCosatu, kuzoyishaya i-ANC. I-ANC ibhekene nezinselelo njengoba yehlelwa ukwesekwa okhethweni lwangonyaka odlule.Ukukhala ngaphansi kwayo okhethweni kwenza ukuthi imeme amanye amaqembu ukuze kubunjwe uhulumeni. Angu-10 amaqembu akuhulumeni wokubambisana kuzwelonke. NaseKZN uhulumeni uphethwe ngokubambisana namanye amaqembu ngenxa yokushayeka kwe-ANC.Ubuholi be-ANC nobeSACP bebuhlangene kuleli sonto, bubhunga ngalesi sinqumo samaKhomanisi sokuzimela okhethweni.I-ANC ibizama ukunxenxa iSACP ukuthi ingaphumi ibhodwe layo ngoba iyayidinga.Emuva kwalo mhlangano, lezi zinhlangano zikhiphe isitatimende lapho ziveze ukuthi ingxoxo ibishisa phansi. Zivumelene ngokuthi kuqiniswe ubudlelwano phakathi kwazo nokuthi kwakhiwe uhlelo lokuxoxa."Kuvunyelwene ngokuthi kubuyekezwe amadlelandawonye, nokuthi zombili lezi zinhlaka zizoqale ngokubika ngokuphume kulo mhlangano ezinhlakeni zangaphakathi ngaphambi kokwazisa abezindaba."Isitatimende sithe kumele kube nobumbano, kuvikelwe intando yeningi kanjalo kungavunyelwa amanye amazwe ukuthi azenzele umathanda kuleli.
ABAHOLI bamaqembu ahlukene epolitiki bahlanganyele ndawonye nomphakathi waseSharpville kukhunjulwa abangu-69 ababulawa amaphoyisa kahulumeni wobandlululo bebhikisha bekhala ngamapasi.
INKAKHA yomculi we-jazz uDkt Madala Kunene usephosele uhulumeni inselelo yokuthi uvumele amaciko azikhethele wona umuntu ozowaphatha nozobhekela zonke izinkinga nezinselelo abhekana nazo ebucikweni bazo, athi kungenza umehluko omkhulu endimeni.UDkt Kunene usho njalo ekhuluma emcimbini wokucobelela intsha ngolwazi lwezobuciko obuseBat Centre, eThekwini ngoLwesihlanu, lapho abengesinye sezikhulumi eziqavile zosuku, ebezicobelela izihambeli ngamasu okuhlala isikhathi eside kwezobuciko.Lo mcimbi ozoze usongwe kusasa, ingqikithi yawo ibithi Resistance, Rights and Resilience - okusho ukuthi wukubekezela, amalungelo nokukukwazi ukuma entweni nakuba kukhona izingqinamba kuzona, izinto lezo obekuzokhuthazwa abantu ukuzenza ukuze bachume emikhakheni eyahlukene abagxile kuyona yezobuciko. Ekhuluma emcimbini, uDkt Kunene ukhale ngokuthi kuba nzima kubona uma sekumele bakhulume emicimbini efuze lona ukukhuthaza abantu abasha ngokumele bakwenze ukuze bahlale isikhathi eside endimeni, ngoba kwabona beyizinggqalabutho kwezobuciko bakhala amanzi njengengcuba njengoba kukuningi okubakhathaza nokubahluphayo."Kumanje sihlangene lapha nje asinalutho eziswini, siswele imali yokuziphilisa. Konke lokhu esikwenza lana sikwenziwa wuthando, akukho lutho esikwazi ukukwenza ngendlela yokuthi sikwazi ukuya phambili ngoba akekho umuntu osinakile ukuthi siphila kanjani,” usho kanje.Eqhuba, uphosele uhulumeni inselelo yokuthi unikeze amaciko ikakhulu omakadebona njengabo ukuthi ubanike ithuba lokuzikhethela bona wukuthi wobani okumele babahole, kungabi noma wubani abamangazi, okuvele kuvukwe ekuseni sebethulelwa yena."Kuyiphutha elikhulu kabi ukuthi uMnyango wobuCiko uholwa wumuntu esingamazeli lutho lwezobuciko, kuvele kuthathwe noma wubani esingamazi ukuthi uke wenzani endimeni, kuthiwe akahole umkhakha obhekele okusikhathazayo. Yizona zonke izinto okumele zilunge kusemanje ukuzama ukuthi izinto nesimo sesmo sibe ngcono kunesiyikhona endimeni."Enye futhi inkinga esibhekene nayo wukuthi uMnyango wezobuCiko uxutshwe neminye futhi imikhakha yempilo engahlangene nawo, okwenza kungabi nendlela eyodwa neqondile yokubhekela izinto eziqondene namaciko ngqo. Yizo zonke izinto lezo eziisibuyisela emuva nezidala ukuthi amaciko amadala njengathi, angazazi ukuthi ami kuphi nobuciko. Sigcina ngokuhlonishwa ngezindondo ezingasisizi lutho ukusithuthukisa,” kusho uDkt Kunene. Ezinye futhi izikhulumi ebezikhona kulo mcimbi obuhlelwe yiyona iBat Centre, bekungoPaul Sibisi, Thami Jali, Tiki Phungula, Sfiso KaMkame, Zamani Makhanya noDavid Mtsaki Msweli. Izethameli zithole ithuba lokuxoxa nala maciko, zibuze nemibuzo eyahlukene yezikudingayo, futhi bekunombukiso wemidwebo nezinto ezahlukene zobuciko.
OWASENDLUNKULU kaZulu unethemba lokuthi kuzobavala imilomo labo ababukela phansi usiko lokuhlolwa kwezintombi ukuphumelela kwenduna yezintombi ethenge unyanyavu lwemoto.UMntwana uTobhi Zulu Zungu, osethimbeni elihlela imikhosi yasendlunkulu okubalwa kuyo noMkhosi woMhlanga, uthe ukusika unyanyavu lwemoto kukaNksz Mningi Zuma, oyinduna yezintombi, kufanele kube isifundo nakulabo ababona sengathi usiko lokuhlolwa kwezintombi liwukuchitha isikhathi.UMntwana uTobhi uthe kuningi okuzuzwa izimbali zesizwe ezihamba umhlanga.UNksz Zuma (32) waqala ukuhamba umhlanga esemncane, akangagudluka kule ndlela kwaze kwaba uqokelwa kwesokuba yinduna yezintombi, ngo-2022, nokuyisikhundla aqokelwa kuso iSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini.Njengamanje uNksz Zuma uneziqu zeBsc in Biochemistry and Microbiology azithola oNgoye, uwuthisha esikoleni iMpikanina High.Ngempelasonto uthenge unyanyavu lwemoto.UMntwana uTobhi uthe ukuphumelela kukaNksz Zuma nezinye izintombi kungenxa yemisebenzi emihle eyenziwa iSilo esakhothama, uGoodwill Zwelithini kaBhekuzulu."Abanye bayafika lapha, bahluleke endleleni. Kungijabulisile ukumbona ephumelela esazigcinile. Nasesikoleni usebenza kahle njengoba isikole sakhe sathola imiphumela emihle ezifundweni azifundisayo ku-matric. Angikusho futhi ukuthi akusiyena yedwa ophumelele lapha ezintombini, sinodokotela, nonesi. Iningi lamatshitshi lihamba ngezimoto. Kuningi okwenziwa iSilo uMdlokombane, iNgonyama uMisuzulu ingena nje kuvundile."UMntwana uTobhi uthe uNksz Zuma uyisibonelo esihle ezinkulungwaneni zezimbali zesizwe aziholayo."Ngangingamazi, kodwa ngokubuka ukukhuthala kwakhe ngabe sengimsondeza eduze. Ngathola ukuthi bazihlanganela nje bengenaye umuntu obahlolayo, bazifunela umuntu ozobahlola. Ngaphinde futhi ngathola ukuthi unehlangano lapho begqugquzela ukuziphatha kahle ematshitshini, baphinde bafundisane amahubo. "Ngathola nokuthi uphinde ahlanganise nabafana abasakhula, lapho elanda khona abantu abafana neNyosi uMdletshe nomholi wamabutho, uMnuz Muzi Nyandeni, ukuba bezoluleka amabhungu asakhula. Ngenxa yobuhlakani bakhe usebizwa ngisho nakwezinye izindawo ukuba izoluleka amatshitshi. Bake nje baya ngisho esifundazweni iMpumalanga, behamba noMntwana uMukelile (kaZwelithini)."UNksz Zuma uthe ukuthenga unyanyavu lwemoto kuzokwenza umsebenzi wakhe ube lula.UNksz Zuma ungomunye wabaholi benhlangano Ubuhle Bezolo Lethu Youth Development Organisation, ekhulisa izintombi iphinde icije namabhungu asakhula.Ukhuthaze izintombi ukuba ziqhubeke nokuzigcina.
UCWANINGO olusanda kwenziwa, lwashicilelwa wuSolwazi Linda-Gail Bekker wase-University of Cape Town luveza ukuthi ukuhoxiswa kohlelo lwezempilo lwase-USA, obelusiza iNingizimu Afrika iPresident’s Emergency Plan for AIDS Relief (PEPFAR), kwangaba nakho okunye okuzosiza ukuvala leso sikhala - ingculazi izobuyela ekubeni "wumashayabhuqe" ezweni.Kuhlaluka ukuthi uma kusongwa izandla, singaphuthunywa isimo sokuhoxa koxhaso, lokho kungaholela ekutheni kufe abantu abalinganiselwa ku-601 000 ngenxa yengculazi, bese futhi kuholela ekutheni kutheleleke abantu abawu-501 000 ngalesi sifo eminyakeni ewu-10 ezayo.Lolu cwaningo lushicilelwe kwi-Annals of Medicine, emqulwini weSouth African Medical Journal (SAMJ), kulandela ukuthi ngoJanuwari kubuyele esikhundleni sokuphatha iMelika uMengameli Donald Trump, okulandelwe yilezi zinguquko, ezaziqale kungathi zizokwenzeka izinsuku eziwu-90 kuphela, kwagcina kuvalwe thaqa konke.USolwazi uBekker, umqondisi weDesmond Tutu HIV Centre nesikhulu esiphezulu seDesmond Tutu Health Foundation, uthe lezi zinguquko zizodala ukuthi kuhlakazeke yonke imizamo ebisiyenziwe yizwe ukuzama ukunqanda ukubhebhetheka kwaleli gciwane, ngenxa yokuhoxiswa kwalolu hlelo oluwusizo kakhulu emhlabeni, kubalwa amazwe awu-50 emhlabeni jikelele abesizakala ngalo."Ukungena kulolu hlelo kwaba yisinyathelo esikhulu nesaba wusizo kakhulu ukulwa ne-HIV, kanti ukubhuntsha kwalo kuza ngesikhathi esibi kakhulu lapho ukudloba kwegciwane kubonakala kushaya kuzwele ebantwini esibahaqayo. I-PEPFAR ibiwusizo kakhulu ezweni nakwamanye amazwe ewasizayo, kangangokuthi imishanguzo yaleli gciwane igcine isiba yiphilisi eliphuzwa kanye ngosuku,” kusho uSolwazi Bekker.Eqhuba, uthe nakuba ikhona imizamo ezanywayo ukulwa nalesi sifo, kodwa kuyinkinga ukuthi manje balinganiselwa ku-8 milllion abantu bakuleli zwe abaphila naleli gciwane, kuthi kubona abaphakathi kuka-1 million kuya ku-2 million abayisebenzisi imishanguzo yokusidambisa, bese kuthi abawu-400 000 abakaze bahlolele lesi sifo futhi abazi nokuthi banaso. USolwazi Bekker nabambisene nabo banikezele ngamathiphu angasiza kulesi simo:Wukuthi kwakhiwe uhlelo okuzobambisana kulona izinhlaka ezehlukene zezempilo ukuqhamuka namasu okumele asebenze manje ukunqanda ukubhebhetheka komonakalo.Wukuthi kwenziwe uhlelo lokuxhasa ezempilo emiphakathini, kuvalwe nezikhala zemisebenzi ezingenamuntu manje ezikhungweni zezempilo ukusiza ukuphuthumisa umsebenzi.Akwandiswe ingqalasizinda ezosiza ukuphuthumisa umsebenzi wansuku zonke.Akubekwe uhlelo lwesikhashana nolwesikhathi eside lokuthi kuvinjwe ukubhebhetheka kwalesi sifo okuzosiza ukuthi kushaye u-2030 isimo sesilawuleka kunesiyikhona manje.Akutholwe ezinye izinhlelo zokuxhasa ukuthi kuliwe nengculazi uqobo, yisifo sofuba nomalaleveva, bese zihlelwa ngendlela efanele. "Konke lokhu kudinga ukuthi uhulumeni wezwe ubambisane nezinhlaka ezehlukene zezempilo ukuguqula isimo ukuze kuliwe nengculazi nesifo sofuba ngoba yizona zifo eziquthula kakhulu abantu ezweni,” kucebisa uSolwazi Bekker.Kusanda kuvela izibalo zokuthi iNingizimu Afrika ihamba phamabili ngezibalo zabantu abane-HIV emhlabeni jikelele. Kulandela amazwe angomakhelwane bethu okuyi-Eswatini, Botswana, Lesotho neZimbabwe.UNgqongqoshe wezeMpilo uDkt Aaron Motsoaledi usanda kuqinisa idolo abantu bakuleli ngokuthi uhulumeni umi ngomumo ukungenelela ezinhlelweni eziphazamisekile ngenxa yokuhoxiswa koxhaso lwaseMelika. Yize-ke kunjalo, kepha ziningi izinkinga ezibikwayo emiphakathini eyehlukene njengokushoda kwemithi nezinye izinsiza zezempilo. Kukhalwa nangokushoda kwesabelomali okubangele nokuthi kumiswe izinhlelo zokuqashwa kodokotela nabanye abasebenzi bezempilo.
INingizimu Afrika igubha uSuku lwaLungelo Abantu, okulusuku olwaziwa kakhulu nge-Human Rights Day. Lo mgubho wenzeka minyaka yonke ngoMashi 21, okuwusuku olunomlando omuncu walapho izwe liphuma khona njengoba abaningi belwazisa nge-Sharpeville Day. Nonyaka lolu suku lufika esimweni lapho izwe libukeka lisezimpambanweni zendlela kuyo yonke iminxa yempilo. Lufika iningi lifunisela ngokuthi ngempela yikuphi okwenza iNingizimu Afrika izwe elibumbene nelilodwa noma lena yindidiyela yemihlathi engazani. Usuku lwamaLungelo nonyaka lufika lapho umhlaba udunguzela, nokugxabha kwamakhanda kubaholi abaqavile, kuvukuza ulaka kwabanye. Olwakusasa usuku sizolugubha sekuthanda ukuba luvindi emehlweni ukuthi kanti ukuba nayo yonke inhlobo yenkululeko namalungelo kusho ukuthini uma sizizwa sinqunu ngayo yonke indlela?Umnotho uyantenga, amathuba emisebenzi avalekile, izinkulumo ezinohlalwane nokucwasa ziqale kwa-a, ubugovu nobudlova sebephuce izakhamizi ilungelo lokuhlala likhululekile lizizwe liphephile ezweni elibuswa umthetho. Sigubha uSuku lwamaLungelo esimweni lapho imfundo esezingeni elihle, ukwelashwa okufanele nokuthola okuya ngasethunjini kuyinto yabathile abakwazi ukubhekama nezindleko zakho. MHLELI: Kwelakho elingashayi eceleni, ngithi angibike ukukhathazeka kwabantu ababizwa ngabasolwa noma, kwabanolwazi olufushane, besibiza ngeziboshwa. Iyakhathaza indaba yomthetho osebenza eNingizimu Afrika. Umuntu osolwayo kungenabufakazi ngasolwa ngakho athathwe ayobhadliswa ejele, maqede kuthiwe kusenziwa uphenyo, kusahlanganiswa ubufakazi, kuphele izinyanga neminyaka. Lowo muntu ngaleso sikhathi impilo yakhe imile nse, izinto zakhe ziyalimala, ziyamosheka. Umndeni wakhe nabantwana bakhe bayahlukumezeka. Imali iyamosheka kukhokhelwa abameli ngoba kufuneka ubulungiswa. Emva kwesikhathi noma iminyaka, kuvele ukuthi lo muntu le nto ayiboshelwe kayilona iqiniso, akunabufakazi ngayo. Kuthiwe icala liyahoxa noma liyaphela. Kuthiwani ngekhathi sakhe esilinyaziwe nesthunzi sakhe esihudulelwe phansi? Buyini ubulungiswa eNingizimu Afrika? Kungani kungaqalwa ngophenyo kuphothulwe lona bese umuntu eyaboshwa ngoba kunobufakazi bokuthi ulenzile. Bangakanani abantu abasemajele baboshelwe into ngekho? Abaseshi bathenga ofakazi bamanga ukuze kuzogwetshwa abantu bengenacala ngoba bona befuna ukukhushulelwa ezikhundleni. Bese kuzoba izinkantolo ezingafuni kusebenza, zilokhu zihlehlisa amacala njalo. Ngizokhuluma ngiqondise ngqo ngejele laseMgungundlovu, iNew Prison nokuyilona nami engaboshwa kulo ngiboshelwa into ngekho. Umseshi wangibopha wathi uyangilaya. Ngamangala ukuthi kanti muntu akaboshelwa icala alenzile linobufakazi abaseshi bazenzela umathanda ngoba befuna izikhundla. Okubi-ke ngejele lase-New Prison nengifisa ukuthi abaphathi bakhona bakwazi ukuthi iziboshwa esezigwetshiwe zikuphakela into engeke isuthise nengane eneminyaka emihlanu. Ejele kufanele ube nemali ukuze ukwazi ukumokola (ukhiphe imali yedilinki). Ukumokola-ke ejele ukukhokhela lona ophakayo kuze uzothola into ngcono. Uma ungamokoli uyothola leyo nkeshezana yophuthu nesobho elingekho. Ijele kufanele ngabe likunika izinto zokulala kodwa iziboshwa ezifikayo zidayiselwa amashidi - wona lawa oMnyango wezokuHlunyeleliswa kweZimilo - zidayiselwa ngezinye iziboshwa. Lezi ezifikayo ziyahlukumezeka ngoba kufanele zifune imali emakhaya kodwa zibe ziboshiwe. Ayikho into engadayiswa ejele. Ushukela othe xaxa u-R50, 2 i-peanut butter u-R50, amaqatha enyama u-R20, isinkwa u-R10.Konke lokhu kufanele ngabe siphakelwa khona ziboshwa. Manje laba abaphekayo bayakuthengisa ukudla kukahulumeni. Ekuseni unikezwa izingcezu ezimbili zesinkwa, nephalishi ngeke ligcwale ngisho inkomishi le ye-plastic ephuzela izingane emakhaya. Emini yiyo leyo nkeshezana yophuthu nethonsi lesishebo nezingcezu zesinkwa, usuyoze uphinde ukuthole ngakusasa . Okubuhlungu kunabantu bagulayo abanoshukela, kufanele badle amaphilisi. Emajele kunebhajethi unyaka nonyaka kodwa iziboshwa zibulawa ngendlala. Ejele ungena uphila, uphume usugula ngendlela okugcwala ngakhona. Kunezindlu ezibizwa ngama-single cell - lokho kusho kuthi leyo ndlu ilungele ukuhlala umuntu oyedwa noma ababili kodwa leyo ndlu, incane injalo, kabanqeni ukuhlohla abayisithupha noma abayisikhombisa. Bazohlala kanjani bantu kanjalo? Engani bengaphathwa yizifo lapho, ikakhulu ezithelelanayo. Mphathi wamajele ngiyacela usukumele isikhalo sami. Okokugcina, ngicela baselulekele ngabasebenzi baseshe zonke zinto ezingavumelekile ejele. Kungaba yizikhali, amaselula, izidakamizwa. Kufanele liphephe ijele, nathi siphephe sisejele. Okubuhlungu abakwenzayo ukusichithela izinto zethu esisuke sizithengelwe yizihlobo zethu uma zivakashile. Mabayeke nokusebela ugwayi wethu ngoba kawulona icala. Bayeke futhi ukushaya iziboshwa. Awukho umthetho ogunyaza lokho. Uma nginecala engilenze ngaphakathi, ngibeke icala, hhayi ukungishaya ngoba kangiyona ngane yakho, kufanele ngikuhloniphe ngokomsebenzi wakho nawe futhi nginike indawo yami.Okhathazekile E-PIETERMARITZBURG NEW PRISON

By Charlie Molepo – President: Library and Information Association of South Africa (LIASA) South African Library Week (SALW) is an annual, week-long event hosted by the Library and Information Association of South Africa (LIASA) - in partnership with the Department of Sports, Arts and Culture; Makhado Municipality; EBSCO; Ndende Technologies; Sabinet; and UKS.SALW 2025 runs from March 17 to March 23.This year’s theme - "Libraries for Sustainable Communities” - highlights libraries' transformative role in fostering sustainability, resilience, inclusivity and accessibility within communities. This theme aligns with South Africa's commitment to sustainable development and equality - reflecting libraries' contributions to sustainable cities and communities (SDG 11) and quality education (SDG 4). Libraries provide inclusive spaces and access to resources for all members of society; empowering communities through education, social support and opportunities for lifelong learning.The celebratory South Africa Library Week 2025 digimag – brought to you by LIASA – is out now. Read and download it here. Libraries are among the most inclusive institutions within communities. They are designed to serve everyone regardless of age, gender, socio-economic status or background; offering free or low-cost access to a wide range of resources and services. In communities with barriers to education and information, libraries stand as beacons of opportunity, supporting people who may otherwise face exclusion. They provide accessible spaces that are welcoming to individuals with disabilities and language barriers, as well as those from historically marginalised groups – ensuring equitable access to knowledge and tools for growth.By bridging gaps between diverse groups and encouraging social interaction, libraries foster mutual understanding, cultural awareness and respect among community members. This inclusivity strengthens social bonds vital to developing sustainable and resilient communities.Aligned with SDG 4, libraries are crucial in promoting literacy, learning and skills development across all stages of life. They provide resources for students, families and adults seeking education beyond formal settings. By offering access to books, digital resources and study spaces, libraries support traditional education while providing a foundation for lifelong learning. This is particularly valuable in under-resourced areas, where libraries often serve as the primary centres for free education and access to technology.Libraries also host literacy programmes, early childhood education sessions and adult education workshops addressing the diverse needs of their communities. These efforts empower people to improve their lives and contribute more fully to their communities. For many, libraries provide the only access to the information and digital resources needed to pursue personal and professional growth; essential to building a knowledgeable and skilled population.In an increasingly digital society, libraries are critical in bridging the digital divide by providing technology, internet access and digital literacy training. For individuals who lack access to digital tools at home, libraries are essential in ensuring that they can connect with the digital world – from conducting job searches and applying for services to participating in digital learning. By offering free access to digital resources, libraries enable everyone to benefit from technological advancements, regardless of their socio-economic background.This commitment to digital inclusion supports SDG 11 by making urban and rural communities more inclusive and resilient. By providing digital skills training, libraries prepare community members for participation in the digital economy; contributing to local and national economic sustainability. Libraries also play a valuable role in promoting environmental awareness and sustainable practices within their communities. Library programmes, workshops and information resources focused on sustainability educate individuals about climate change, recycling and sustainable living practices. This knowledge empowers communities to make informed decisions contributing to a healthier environment and a more sustainable future.Furthermore, libraries act as hubs for community engagement where individuals can come together to discuss shared challenges and solutions. This role supports social cohesion and resilience by fostering dialogue, civic participation and collaborative efforts to address community issues. In this way, libraries contribute directly to building strong, inclusive and sustainable communities.This year’s South Africa Library Week (SALW) is special as we celebrate it when South Africa assumes the presidency of the G20. The library sector is uniquely positioned to support the country in advancing its agenda with a particular emphasis on culture, community development and innovation – grounded in the themes of the SALW 2025 "Libraries for Sustainable Communities”. Strategic alignment with G20 priorities 1. Promoting cultural exchange and understandingLibraries act as custodians of cultural heritage and play a vital role in promoting cultural exchange.Through partnerships with G20 countries, South African libraries can host exhibitions, virtual forums and storytelling initiatives highlighting cultural diversity, and shared histories.Digital platforms can be leveraged to facilitate cross-cultural dialogue, mainly focusing on indigenous knowledge systems and languages.2. Advancing the sustainable development goals (SDGs)Aligned with the SALW 2025 theme, libraries drive sustainable community development by:Providing equitable access to information for all, addressing SDG 4 (Quality Education).Supporting environmental literacy programmes, contributing to SDG 13 (Climate Action).Offering safe and inclusive spaces for community engagement, addressing SDG 11 (Sustainable Cities and Communities). 3. Empowering communities through innovationIn line with the Library and Information Association of South Africa (LIASA) 2025 theme, libraries are innovation hubs that empower communities by:Facilitating skills development in digital literacy, entrepreneurship and science, technology, engineering and mathematics (STEM), particularly for marginalised groups.Collaborating with tech innovators to provide maker spaces and hackathons for problem-solving local and global challenges.Partnering with G20 nations to share best practices in library technology and service innovation.The "Libraries for Sustainable Communities” theme celebrates a library's vital role in promoting inclusivity, access to quality education, digital literacy, environmental awareness and community resilience. By offering inclusive access to information, learning opportunities and resources, libraries empower individuals of all backgrounds to improve their lives and contribute meaningfully to their communities. As centres of lifelong learning and social support, libraries are indispensable in South Africa’s journey towards creating a sustainable and inclusive future for all.

UKHALE ngokwenziwa inhlekisa ngabesifazane ababulala, wadalula nokuthi unesithembu, uLungani Thengokwakhe Mthethwa (31) obethweswe uMbuso icala lokubulala uNksz Gabrielice Zizipho ''Ntuntu'' Gabisa noNksz Anele Mbokazi.Izolo, iNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini izwe uMthethwa encwadini yakhe abegonyuluka kuyona ngakho konke okwenzeka ngosuku lwesigameko. Ukhale kakhulu ngakubize ngokumosheka kwemali yakhe ebantwini besifazane athe bagcina sebemenza inhlekisa.Kuzokhumbuleka phela ukuthi isigameko sokubulawa kwalaba esenzeke ngo-Agasti 25, eKenville, eThekwini, saba yindaba egudwini. Izidumbu zabo zatholakala zidutshuliwe emakhanda nasesifubeni. Ngemuva kwesikhashana uMthethwa nomngani wakhe omkhulum, uMnuz Sandile Alex Chili, bakhalelwa ngamasongo kaSigonyela beseSouth Beach.UChili ugcine ephunyuka kulolu gibe ngemuva kokuba echakide umngani wakhe wase eba sohlangothini loMbuso. Izolo ummeli kaMthethwa, u-Advocate Bheki Manyathi, ufunde yonke ingonyuluka ngokwenzeka ngalolu suku.Kule ncwadi uMthethwa uyilanda indaba isukela ngo-Agasti 10, okuyilapho athi bahlangana nabafi beze emcimbini wesintu owawuseNdwedwe. Uma eqhuba uthi wazizwa eshiswa uthando lukaNksz Mbokazi, wehluleka ukuzibamba wase ecela izinombolo zakhe zeselula, nebala wazithola.Uthe ngakulunye uhlangothi, umngani wakhe uChili yena wayesho amashushushu ngoNksz Gabisa naye ngokunjalo wazithola izinombolo zakhe. Uveze ukuthi abafi bobabili babekade behlala eWaterloo, ngaseVerulam. Ngemuva kwezinsuku ezimbalwa, uthe washayela ucingo uNksz Mbokazi wase evakashela umufi lapho ayesebenzela khona esibhedlela Inkosi Albert Luthuli.Ngalolu suku, uthe yamqoma intombi bavumelana ngokuthi bathandane. Ngo-Agasti 23, uMthethwa uthe waphinde washayela ucingo uNksz Mbokazi emcela ukuba amkhiphe, nebala wavuma umufi. "U-Anele wathi angathanda ukuthi afike nomngani wakhe uZizipho,'' kusho uMthethwa.Uthe kwenzeka lokho nje, uChili usemazisisle ukuthi naye kumlungele ngasohlangothini lukaNksz Gabisa umqomile. "Yilapho-ke engatshela khona uSandile ukuthi uma kunjalo-ke nabo mabasijoyine sizobe sizikhiphe ngo-Agasti 24,'' echaza.Uthe ngo-Agasti 24, wahamba wayolanda uChili lapho ayehlala khona eCornubia ehamba ngemoto yakhe iMercedes Benz, badlulela eWaterloo, sebeyolanda izintombi zabo (abafi)."UChili wathi yena akanayo imali, ngathi mina akakhululeke zonke izindleko zizoba semahlombe ami,'' usho kanjena. Uthe abafi babalanda ngezithuba zabo-2 ntambama, base beya esitolo sotshwala esise-Ottawa bathenga i-Hennesy, Ice Tropez neHeineken.Badlulela i-Eden Garden eseThekwini, lapho abathola khona okuya ethunjini. "Yimina owakhokha nalapho,'' esho. Basuka lapho base beya emzini kaMthethwa oseSherwood beyolanda i-coolerbox ukugcina iziphuzo zibanda.Baya egaraji ukuyothenga amaqhwa, base bebuyela eThekwini, lapho abahlala khona bezixoxela nje. Ngenxa yokuthi kwase kuhlwa, uMthethwa uthe uyena owaqhamuka nephuzu lokuthi bazibekisele amagumbi okulala, wavuma uNksz Mbokazi ngoba wathi vele ngakusasa akasebenzi.Kodwa uNksz Gabisa wathi ngeke kulunge ngoba uzobe esebenza ekuseni, kodwa uChili wathi ayikho inkinga ekuseni kakhulu uzomhambisa ngemoto emsebenzini. Nebala babekisa indawo yokulala eRoyal Hotel."Kwakumnandi kakhulu kangangoba u-Anele izithombe owazithatha lapho waze wazinameka ezinkundleni zakhe zokuxhumana,'' kuchaza uMthethwa. Uthe ukudla kwaqala kwashintsha epuletini ngezithuba zabo-1 phakathi kwamabili, uNksz Mbokazi esethi ufuna ukuphinda ekhaya ngoba umfowabo ukhalelwe ngamasongo kaSigonyela eshayela edle amponjwana, esenga ezimithiyo."Umakhalekhukhwini ka-Anele wase ukhala umlibe, eshayelwa ucingo ngudadewabo,'' echaza. Kuvela ukuthi uNksz Mbokazi wathi usephinda ekhaya okuyinto okuvele ukuthi yamnenga kakhulu uMthethwa. NoNksz Gabisa wabe esefuna ukugoduka nomngani wakhe, lokho kwamanenga noChili.Uthe kwagcina sekuvunyelwana ngokuthi kulungile mabaphindiswe emuva, base bayaphuma ehhotela. Maphakathi nendlela, uthe abafi babexoxa kumaselula bedane begigitheka kubonakala ukuthi kuhlekiswa ngaye (uMthethwa)."Ngavele ngazifundela kwezami ukuthi kuhlekwa mina,'' esho. Uthe wavele wakhetha ukuthi ayichezule imoto ayibhekise eKenville esecasuke kakhulu, ngaleso sikhatho uthe uChili wayebanjwe ubuthongo.Uthe baba nokuhilizisana benoNksz Mbokazi, wathi kodwa okwakumnenga kakhulu ukuthi bakhombisa ukungamhloniphi phezu kwemali engaka aseyikhiphile."Ngabo lobo busuku u-Anele wayedane ephumela emnyango ebamba izingcingo zesoka lakhe,'' esho.Ngezithuba zabo-2, uthe wakhetha ukuyimisa imoto maphakathi nendlela wayicisha namalambu, wase ebehlisa abafi wakhipha isibhamu sohlobo lwe-CZ75 9mm pistol, wabadubula emakhanda nasesifubeni."Ngabe sengitshela uChili ukuthi angene emotweni ngimbuyisele kubo,'' kusho yena. Noma babephuze amponjwana uthe kodwa okwakwenzeka ukukhumbula kahle konke.Uvumile ukuthi abafi babulawa ngamanxeba okudutshulwa. Nokuhlolwa kwezidumbu okwenziwa nguDkt S Olivier kwaqinisekisa ukuthi abafi babulawe ngamanxeba esibhamu.Wase ethi ucela uxolo emindenini ngobuhlungu ayizwise bona. Ummeli wakhe ube eseveza ukuthi kube khona isivumelwano phakathi kwabo noMbuso sesigwebo seminyaka ewu-25 kuwona womathathu amacala elokubulala oNksz Mbokazi noGabisa nelokubathumba.Kwavunyelwana ngokuthi izigwebo uzozidonsa zonke kanye kanye. Ezicelela isigwebo esincane, uMthethwa udalule ukuthi unesithembu samakhosikazi amathathu nezingane eziyisithupha, nenkampani ebhekelele ukufukulwa kwabaculi abasathuthuka.IJaji uSingh limbuzile uMthethwa ukuthi iyiqiniso yonke ingonyuluka elotshwe kwisitatimende nanokuthi yenziwe nguye, wavuma wathi kunjalo, lase lithi aliphikisi lutho konke kumi kanjalo nesigwebo sinjalo.Emva kwalokho, uMthethwa ushone emgodini, izihlobo nemindeni baphume enkantolo bekhihla isililo. Abamele yomibili imindeni bathe kabakholwa ukuthi uMthethwa ubexolisa ngeqiniso.
BASALE beshaqekile abasendimeni yebhola likanobhutshuzwayo KwaMashu ngokudlula emhlabeni kukaNkemelle "Rasta” Ntsoane obengumqeqeshi abuye abe yisikhulu sebhola kuleli lokishi.UNtsoane, ongumfowabo omncane kaTsepo Ntsoane wodumo kwiLamontville Golden Arrows ne-Orlando Pirates, waba nesandla esikhulu ekucijeni amakhono oThalente Mbatha we-Orlando Pirates noThabo Cele weKaizer Chiefs. Wadlala kwi-African Wanderers eminyakeni edlule eyibamba noMandla Ncikazi oseyiphini lomqeqeshi wePirates.UMbatha noCele, asebehlonishwa iNingizimu Afrika yonke, badlule esandleni sikaNtsoane kwiKwaMashu All Stars eyayidlala kwi-ABC Motsepe League abadlale kuyona ngaphambi kokuthola amadlelo aluhlaza.UNtsoane ushonele esibhedlela izolo kulandela ukuwa kwakhe enkundleni edlala emidlalweni yabaneminyaka engaphezu kuka-35 ezinkundleni iJohn Dory, eNewlands, emasontweni amabili adlule. Kusukela lapho uNtsoane uhlale egumbini labagula kakhulu esibhedlela kwaze kwaba kuyamenela izolo.Ukudlula emhlabeni kukaNtsoane, obengumengameli weKwaMashu Football Association, kuqinisekiswe yiqembu abelidlalela, iCrocodille FC."Ezibuhlungu azipheli. Ngokukhulu ukuzithoba sicela ukubikela wonke amaqembu kasoseshini ngezindaba ezibuhlungu zokudlula emhlabeni kukamfowethu uNkemelle Ntsoane,” kusho umyalezo othunyelelwe wonke amaqembu kalo soseshini."UNtsoane uyilwile impi yakhe kwaphela wona amandla ngoMsombuluko esibhedlela. Umndeni uthembise ukusitshela konke okuzokwenzeka mayelana nezinhlelo ngokufihlwa kwakhe,” kuphetha umyalezo othunyelelwe amaqembu."Nyakenye ngesikhathi uMbatha esayina kwiPirates, uNtsoane uhluleke nawukuzibamba yinjabulo. Kwenzeke okufanayo ngesikhathi eshaye amagoli kwiBafana Bafana. Ngesikhathi leli phephandaba likhuluma naye ngakubo KwaMashu, uthe ubona lo mdlali kumfanele ukudlala kumaligi aphezulu emhlabeni. UNtsoane uphinde wazwakwalisa injabulo edlulele ngesikhathi uCele esayina kwiChiefs ngoJanuwari. Utshele leli phephandaba ukuthi indlela uCele angene khaxa ngayo kwiChiefs, kuzogcina kudanselwa isigingci sakhe.
BAZOYITHOLA emaPosini kuphela imali yabo yezibonelelo kusuka ngenyanga ezayo okuzophela uMashi bengawashintshanga amakhadi abo amadala ayigolide akwa-Sassa, beshintshela emakhadini amasha amnyama ase-Postbank.Lokhu kuzodalwa ngukuthi ayagcina ukusebenza amakhadi amadala ayigolide akwa-Sassa kusuka ngoLwesine kuleli sonto, njengoba kuzobe sekusebenza amnyama kuphela. Lokhu kushiwo yisikhulu esiphezulu se-Postbank, uNksz Nikki Mbengashe, oqinisekise abantu ukuthi imali yabo bazoqhubeka bayithole noma sekudlule usuku ababelubekile lokuthi kuzoma ngalo ukusebenza kwamakhadi amadala.Ekhuluma esithangamini nabezindaba izolo, uthe sebeshintshe amakhadi angu-1.1 million, selokhu kwaqala uhlelo lokushintshwa kwamakhadi nyakenye."Sigqugquzela abantu ukuthi baqhubeke nokushintsha amakhadi noma usudlulile uMashi 20, 2025, okuwusuku lokugcina lokusebenza kwamakhadi amadala ayigolide. Ngemuva kwalolu suku ngeke esasebenza amakhadi amadala, kodwa abantu bazokwazi ukuthola imali yabo ePosini kusuka ngenyanga ezayo uma sekuholwa. Kudingeka umazisi kuphela ukuze bakthole imali yabo," usho kanje.Uthe abangakwazi ukuhamba bangafaka izicelo zokuthi bavakashelwe emakhaya, ukuze bashintshelwe amakhadi abo.Uxwayise ngokuthi kukhona abantu abasebenzisa lolu hlelo lokuvakashelwa emakhaya ekubeni bekwazi ukuzihambela."Sidinga ukuthi kuphathwe incwadi yasemtholampilo, eyasesibhedlela noma ekasonhlalakahle eshoyo ukuthi umuntu udinga ukuvashelwa ekhaya. Kudingeka kuyiwe emahhovisi akwa-Sassa kuyofakwa izicelo zokuvakashelwa, kuphathwe umazisi wodinga ukusizakala. Kuzobe sekwenziwa izinhlelo zokuthi avakashelwe ekhaya ayoshintshiswa ikhadi." Babalelwa ku-50 kuphela abasafake izicelo zokuvakashelwa emakhaya beyoshintshelwa amakhadi.Uthe labo ababefake izicelo zokuthi baholelwe abanye izimpesheni zabo, bangaqhubeka nokubathuma ukuthi baye ePosini nalezo zincwadi bayobaholela.UNksz Mbengashe uthe bayakwamukela ukugxekwa ngokuthi lolu hlelo luke lwaba nebatha ngenxa yokushoda kwezindawo zokushintsha amakhadi."Besihlele ukuthi lolu hlelo lokushintsha amakhadi luzothatha izinyanga eziyisithupha. Lwaqala ngoSepthemba nyakenye, lwahamba kancane ngenxa yokuthi sanika isiqinisekiso sokuthi abantu babezoqhubeka nokuthola izibonelelo zabo emakhadini ayigolide. Sasihlele ukuthi okungenani ngosuku sishintshe amakhadi angu-21 600 ukuze sibaqede bonke esidinga ukuwashintsha. Kodwa abantu abaphumanga ngobuningi, baze bathutheleka ngenyanga edlule ngoba kwase kumenyezelwe eyomnqamulajuqu, sakwazi ukukhipha amakhadi angu-30 000 ngosuku," usho kanje.Uthe ngoFebhuwari kuphela bashintsha amakhadi angu-450 000 ngenyanga eyodwa, Emasontweni amabili kuqale uMashi bashintsha amakhadi angu-200 000.UMnuz Themba Matlou, ibamba lesikhulu esiphezulu se-Sassa, uthe ngesikhathi luqala lolu hlelo babalelwa ku-2.9 million abantu obekumele bashintshe amakhadi abo.Uthe bafake isandla ekutheni lusheshe ngokutshala abasebenzi ezindaweni ezehlukene ezweni lonke."Umthetho uyavuma ukuthi abahola izibonelelo bazikhethele izindawo abafuna ukuhola kuzona. Bangahola kunoma iliphi ibhange abazikhethela lona. Sizobavakashela emakhaya labo abadinga usizo ngoba bengakwazi ukuhamba noma usudlulile umnqamulajuqu wokushintshwa kwamakhadi," usho kanje.UNksz Mbengashe uthe abalelwa ku-520 amaPosi akhona wathi kodwa akuwona wonke abantu abazokwazi ukuthola imali yabo kuwona."Kudingeke sishintshe amakhadi ukuze siqinise ezokuphepha njengoba kwenzeka kuwona wonke amakhadi asemabhange. Sisasebenzise imali engaphansi kwaleyo ebesiyihlelile ngalolu hlelo lokushintshwa kwamakhadi kuleli. Siyazi kwezinye izindawo kunezinkinga kodwa ziyalungiswa nsuku zonke," usho kanje.Uthe abantu bangashayela nenombolo yabo yamahhala noma eyakwa-Sassa uma befuna usizo ethi: 0800 601 011, noma bathumele ku:[email protected].
I-COSATU ifuna limukelwe njengeqhawe inxusa lakuleli elixoshelwe izinsolo zokukhuluma kabi ngoMengameli waseMelika, uDonald Trump.I-Cosatu esifundazweni iWestern Cape ithe izomhlangabeza esikhumulweni sezindiza, uMnuz Ebrahim Rasool, oyalelelwe ukuba aphuma aphele eMelika.URasool ungowokuzalwa eWestern Cape.Unobhala we-ANC eWestern Cape, uMnuz Malvern de Bruyn, uthe abahambisani nokuxoshwa kukaRasool eMelika."Ingakho sinqume ukuthi sinxenxe amalungu ethu ukuba aphume ngobuningi bawo, aye komamukela esikhumulweni sezindiza uma esefika lapha eWestern Cape. URasool ungomunye wethu, angeke simlahle."UDe Bruyn uthe bafuna ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika iziphindiselele ngokuxosha inxusa laseMelika kuleli."Aseneme neze ngendlela uhulumeni oholwa uTrump owenza ngayo izinto. Lo hulumeni uyaqhubeka nokuchukuluza iNingizimu Afrika. Into esiyishoyo ukuthi uhulumeni wakuleli kufanele uxoshe inxusa laseMelika uma uhulumeni oholwa uTrump uqhubeka nalo mkhuba wawo."UMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi uRasool usendleleni ebuyayo njengoba enikezwe amahora angu-72 ukuba aphume aphele eMelika."Akakwazi ukuqhubeka ahlale eMelika ngoba sebeshilo ukuthi akamukelekile khona."URasool uziqhathe ngokuthi asole uTrump ngokweseka abashumayela ivangeli lokuthi abantu abamhlophe bangcono ukunezinye izinhlanga.URamaphosa uthe uzothola kahle umbiko ogcwele ngokwenzekile uma uRasool esefikile kuleli."Ngizwile nje ukuthi bathi uxoshelwe ukuthi kunenkulumo engehli kahle ayenzile, kodwa konke sizokuthola uma esefikile. Ngifuna ukuthola umbiko ogcwele."URamaphosa uthe bayaqhubeka nokuzama ukulungisa ubudlelwano neMelika, wakuchitha ukuthi izikhulu zaseMelika zichayisa izikhulu zakuleli ezihola imizamo yokubuyisana."Lide ibanga esesilihambile, kukhona ukuxhumana okukhona. Akusilona iqiniso ukuthi bayasiziba abaseMelika. Empeleni nje uRasool ubesehambe ibanga elide kakhulu. Khona-ke kusibuyisela emuva ukuxoshwa kwakhe ngoba uyena obehamba phambili emizamweni yokubuyisana."UMnyango wezobuDlelwano naMazwe aNgaphandle uthe usezinhlelweni zokuqoka inxusa elisha.Bekungokwesibili uRasool eba inxusa lakuleli eMelika. Waba inxusa lakuleli eMelika okokuqala ngesikhathi kusaphethe owayengumengameli, uBarack Obama.Ngaphambi kwalokho uRasool wayengundunankulu wesifundazwe iWestern Cape.
NOKUBONGWA PHENYANELICISHE laphonswa emfuleni wumphakathi obudinwe uveva ebhulohweni okumuke kulo umfundi ka-matric oshone ngesonto eledlule ikhansela laseMolweni, eThekwini, uMnuz Siyabonga Nala, ngoba ulisola ngokungalusukumeli udaba lwengqalasizinda.Imvula yangesonto eledlule iphinde yadala omunye umonakalo emndenini wakwaDlamini kule ndawo njengoba ushiywe yindodakazi yawo ebifunda u-matric eTholulwazi High, uNomzamo Dlamini.UNksz Londiwe Zulu othinte Isolezwe ngalolu daba uveze ukuthi kusuka ngezikhukhula zango-2022, baqala bafuna kusukunyelwe indaba yamabhuloho amabili anenkinga okuyiwona abawasebenzisayo."Ngo-2022 kwamuka abantu ababili namanje abangakaze batholakale ngenxa yaso isimo samabhuloho angekho esimweni esikahle. Salixusa ikhansela kodwa lilokhu lithembisa ukuthi azolungiswa futhi ngisho imali yawo isikhishiwe, namanje akukaze kwenzeke lutho. Ngenxa yokwanda kwezigameko ezifana nalezi sikhethe ukuthi noLwesibili (namhlanje) singene emgwaqweni sibe nemashi ukuze kucace ukuthi sesikhathele isimo esiphila ngaphansi kwaso ngoba imvula ina iphindelela,” kuchaza yena.Uveze ukuthi abakufisayo ukuthi kufike iMeya yeTheku uMnuz Cyril Xaba izozwa izikhalo zabo futhi ibone nesimo samabhuloho ukuthi asigculisi neze."Bekumele izingane ziye esikoleni ezinye zijikile zangaya,ngoba amanzi asemaningi futhi ziyesaba ngenxa yesigameko esisanda kwenzeka,” kuchaza yena.Elinye ilungu lomphakathi elingathandanga ukudalulwa liveze ukuthi eyalo imoto isihlala emizini engaphesheya njengoba bengakwazi ukuwela ngazo uma izulu lilibi."Umphakathi ubudinwe ufile ngesikhathi kutholakala isidumbu sale ngane ngoMgqibelo, abanye bebesho ukumphonsa kuwona umfula uNala ngenxa yokulokhu ekhuluma izinto ezingahlangani, ngoba abukho ubuqiniso kuyona yonke into ayitshela umphakathi uma kunemihlangano,” kuchaza leli lungu lomphakathi.Imizamo yokuthola ikhansela ayiphumelelanga njengoba ucingo lwalo belukhala lungabanjwa.Kodwa uNala ekhasini lakhe enkundleni yokuxhumana uvezile ukuthi usebonene nomndeni wakwaDlamini."Ikhansela uNala beliyobonana nomndeni waseLower Molweni lihambisana nowayeyikhansela phambilini uSimphiwe Mncube kanye namalungu ekomiti ase-Lower Molweni beyovela emndenini wakwaDlamini okuthe ngempelasonto kwatholakala isidumbu somntwana wakhona omuke namanzi."Ikhansela lidlulise amazwi enduduzo emndenini laphinde lawazisa ngokuzimisela koMkhandlu weTheku ukulekelela lapho okungadingeka khona usizo ezidingweni zomngcwabo. Ikhansela uNala liyaqhubeka nokukhuluma noMkhandlu weTheku ukuthi uphuthumise usizo ngokushesha ukugwema ezinye izinhlekelele," kubhalwe kanje.
SIGODLIWE isinqumo esicelweni sokuqala esithinta ibhange elilengelwa yizembe, Ithala.INkantolo eNkulu yaseMgungundlovu (ebihleli eThekwini izolo) ibilalele isicelo esifakwe Ithala lapho lifuna khona ukuthi livunyelwe ukuthi liqhubeke nokusebenza ngokwejwayelekile njengoba kusalindwe ukulalelwa kwesicelo sokuba leli bhange livalwe.Isicelo sokuba kuvalwe Ithala safakwa uhlaka olungaphansi kweBhange loMbuso, iPrudential Authority (PA), lesi sicelo sizolalelwa eNkantolo eNkulu yaseMgungundlovu.I-PA yafaka lesi sicelo emva kokuba kuphele ushwele owawunikezwe Ithala wokuba lisebenze njengebhange yize lingenayo ilayisensi yokuba ibhange, lo shwele waphela ngo-2023.Selokhu iPA yafaka isicelo sokuba kuvalwe Ithala, amakhasimende ebhange angaphezu kuka-250 000 awakwazi ukuthola imali yawo nabasebenzi bebhange abaholile.Izolo abameli beThala bacele ukuba inkantolo ivumele Ithala ukuba liqhubeke nokusebenza ngokujwayelekile kuze kuba kuphuma isinqumo esicelweni sokuba livalwe.AbeThala bathe ukubhajwa kwemali yamakhasimende kudala izinkinga eziningi njengoba kukhona amakhasimende asemangalele ibhange, amanye alishiya.INkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu ibihleli eThekwini, eNkantolo yezaBasebenzi, izolo.Ngaphandle kwenkantolo amalungu eNehawu abebhikisha.AbeNehawu bathe amalungu enyunyana asebenza eThala ahlukumezeke kakhulu njengoba engazange ahole ngoJanuwari nangoFebhuwari, mancane amathuba okuthi ahole nakule nyanga.Uhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal wesekwa Ithala emizamweni yokuvimba ukuba livalwe.UMphathiswa wezeziMali KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Francois Rodgers, obesenkantolo, uthe bazokwenza konke okusemandleni abo ukuvikela Ithala.URodgers uthe basanda kwenza isicelo sokutsheleka u-R2 billion kuhulumeni kazwelonke, le mali izosetshenziselwa ukuvikela abantu abangamakhasimende eThala."Ngikhulumile noNgqongqoshe wezeziMali, uvumile ukusinika imali. Manje sekusele kuMqondisi Jikelele eHhovisi loMgcinimafa."URodgers uthe udaba lweThala belungalungiseka nje kalula, kungaze kuyiwe ezinkantolo."Uma ngibheka nje inani labameli basemajajini abebelapha enkantolo, ngiyazibuza ukuthi ngabe imalini ekhokhwe lana. Lolu udaba besingaluxoxa nje, ngaphandle kokuthi luze luye ezinkantolo. Iqiniso ukuthi vele ekugcineni siyophelela kuzona izingxoxo."URodgers uthe okunye okungenziwa ukuba kuqokwe uhlaka oluzokwengamela Ithala ukuze likuqhubeke lisebenze lize lithole ilayisensi."Into ebalulekile ukuthi abantu bathole imali yabo."
UVUME iphutha abalenza benguhulumeni uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, lokuthi bangayibeki eqhulwini eyokugxila nasekuthuthukiseni i-Early Childhood Development (ECD), emfundweni yakuleli njengoba kubathathe cishe iminyaka engu-30 ukwenza lokhu.URamaphosa uthe ukube baqala eminyakeni engu-30 edlule ngabe izingane zakuleli zikude kakhulu kwezithinta amakhono."Ngingowokuqala ukuvuma uma senze iphutha, ngiyavuma ukuthi senza iphutha ngokuthi siyishaye indiva eye-ECD ezweni. Kumele ngabe kade sagxila endabeni ye-ECD, ukuze izingane zethu zenze kahle ezikoleni, nasempilweni jikelele," usho kanje ekhuluma engqungqutheleni iBana Pele eGoli izolo. Uthe uNgqongqoshe wezeziMali uMnuz Enoch Godongwana, ngeledlule umemezele ukuthi uzotshala u-R10 billion, eminyakeni ezayo ekuphuculeni i-ECD.Uveze ukuthi nangesikhathi eqala ukuyikhuluma eyokususa i-ECD emnyangweni wezeNhlalakahle iye emnyangweni weMfundo eyisiSekelo, kwakukhona ababeshaya amakhala bekuchitha lokhu."Ngangithi uma ngikhuluma emaralini, abantu bayithakasele eyokuthi isuswe i-ECD iye kwezemfundo. Sikhathazekile ukuthi izingane ezincane azikuqondi ezikufundayo yingakho kubalulekile ukuthi i-ECD sigxile kuyona, ibekwe eqhulwini," kusho uRamaphosa.Unxuse izikhungo ezifundisa i-ECD ukuthi zibhalise nomnyango ukuze izingane zithole okuzifanele.'Kudingeka silungise amaphutha esawenza ezinganeni zethu. Akumele kube nezingane ezizosala ngaphandle kulolu hlelo okubaluleke kakhulu," kusho uRamaphosa.Uthe okunye okwakumele kwenziwe ngukuvala izikole iminyaka emibili ngemuva kokuthatha izintambo kuhulumeni wobandlululo, kuyoqeqeshwa kabusha othisha."Othisha babezokulungela ukufundisa izingane zethu, sishintshe uhlelo lwezemfundo, Ngiyazi ukuthi abafundi babezobhuquza emakhaya bengenzi lutho. Kodwa ke kuthiwa kungcono into uyenze noma sekudlule isikhathi kunokuthi ugcine ungayenzanga noma sekudlule iminyaka emingaka," kusho uRamaphosa.UNgqongqoshe weMfundo eyisiSekelo uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, uthe kunezingane ezingu-1.3 million kuleli, ezineminyaka emithathu kuya kwemihlanu, ezingafundi ezikhungweni ezingama-ECD.Ingxenye eningi yazo uthe iqhamuka emiphakathini edonsa kanzima."Lokhu kwenza kungabikhona ukulingana kuleli. Izingane eziqhamuka emiphakathini ephila kangcono zona zisemathubeni okufunda ezikhungweni ama-ECD." Uthe bafuna kuthi kushaya u-2030, zonke izingane kuleli zibe seziyithola le mfundo yasemazingeni aphansi."Asinazo zonke izimpendulo siwuhulumeni. Kumele sicabangele izingane ezingakwazi ukufunda kulezi zikhungo. Ikusasa lethu lilele ezinganeni zethu," kusho uNksz Gwarube.Uthe njengoba izwekazi i-Afrika linabantu abaningi abaneminyaka engaphansi kuka-25, kudingeka ukuthi kugxilwe entsheni okuyiyo eyikusasa."Kubalulekile ukuthi kukhuliswe umnotho ukuze izwekazi libe selikwazi ukuqasha inqwaba yabantu abangasebenzi ngo-2060. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sibambisane, sisebenze ndawonye," kusho uNksz Gwarube.

Walmaraas watshela iJaji Busisiwe Masipa ukuthi ngeke esakwazi ukuqhubeka nokubamela ngoba sebekhala ngokuphundleka ephaketheni, bathi kabasenayo imali yokumkhokhela."Nkosi yenkantolo ngizocela ukuthi ungikhulule kuleli cala, ngeke ngisaqhubeka nokubamela abasolwa ngenxa yokuthi kukhona esingasavumelanai ngakho futhi bathi kabasenayo imali yokungikhokhela,'' usho kanjena.IJaji Masipa libe nemibuzo eminingi mayelana nalokhu libuza ukuthi kungani lokhu kuzokwenzeka ngesigaba esibucayi kangaka lapho khona laba besilisa sekumele kukhishwe isigwebo sabo. Omele uMbuso uRakeshi Singh uzwakalise ukungenami nhlobo ngobekwenzeka.Lokhu obekwenzeka izolo kule nkantolo ecaleni elifanayo bese kuyimpinda yokwenzeka noJanuwari 7 ngesikhathi uWalmaraas ehoxa ekumeleni abasolwa sekufinyelelwe esigabeni sokuba kuphume isinqumo.Ngalolo suku kwaba khona umunyu nezinyembezi kumalungu emindeni yabafi njengoba babekade bekubheke ngabomvu ukuphuma kwesinqumo. Kwehlula noma uMbuso sewulwa uthi ngeke ukuvumele lokho ukuba kwenzeke kodwa iJaji uMasipa lathi iqiniso ukuthi alikwazi ukubalahla ngecala abantu abangenaye ummeli.Kodwa abasolwa babuye bashaya ungqimphothwe bambuyisa ummeli wabo. Izolo kuvunyelwane ngokuthi icala lihlehlele u-Ephreli 17 ukuze kulungiswe inkinga yommeli.Kuqhubeka leli cala nje, ihostela selaphenduka laba yikwajombigazi. Udaba lwakhona lwake lwasukunyelwa owayekade engumvikeli womphakathi owayebambile ngaleso sikhathi u-Advocate Kholeka Gcaleka kanti nowake waba umvikeli womphakathi uSolwazi Thuli Madonsela wake walivakashela ihostela.Naloyo owayengungongqoshe wamaPhoyisa, uMnuz Bheki Cele wake waya khona, kodwa bonke imizamo yabo yokuletha ukuthula ayiphumelelanga. Namabandla ngokwehlukana kwawo ake aya ehambisa izinkonzo kulona kodwa kufane nokuthi kuthelwa amanzi emhlane wedada nje, iqhubeke inganono kuphume imiphefumulo.

KUYALELWE izitshudeni ezinganeme ngokuchithwa yisikhwama i-National Students' Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS), ukuthi zisheshe zifake izimangalo, zingakapheli izinsuku ezingu-30, zithole izimpendulo.Lokhu kushiwo yi-NSFAS ethe imatasa icubungula izimangalo ezehlukene ezithinta abangalutholanga uxhaso.Abalesi sikhwama bathe bathole izimangalo ezevile ku-74 000, kanti ezingaphezulu kuka-45 000, isiphothulile ngazo."Labo abachithwe ngoba lungabafanele uxhaso ngenxa yokuthi abazali babo bahola kakhulu isimangalo sabo siyocutshungulwa uma kungukuthi ngempela abazali babo abaholi kakhulu. Siyobhekwa uma kungukuthi imali abayiholayo isiyehlile selokhu kwafakwa isicelo nokuthi uma inkantolo isikuhlonze njengomuntu ozimele, uma abazali bakho bengasakondli," kusho i-NSFAS.Sithe abachithwe ngoba bengazange benze kahle ezifundweni zabo, izimangalo zabo ziyobhekwa uma beveza ubufakazi bokuthi ubukhulelwe wase ubeletha okwadala ukuthi uphazamiseke."Sizobheka futhi uma kungukuthi waba wumgilwa wodlame, wawugula kakhulu ngesikhathi kufundwa waphazamiseka izinyanga ezimbili kuya phezulu. Uma kungukuthi kwaba nesifo ekhaya kwashona ilungu lomndeni eliseduzane nawe kanjalo nalabo abaphila nokukhubazeka kodwa isikhungo kumele silethe umbiko wezempilo, oveza ukukhubazeka ophila nakho," kuqhuba i-NSFAS.Abalesi sikhwama bathe labo abenza iziqu ezingaxhaswa yilesi sikhwama abakwazi ukufaka izikhalo zokuthi kungani bengaxhaswanga."Nalabo othola ukuthi bafake imininingwane yabazali eshayisa amakhala, noma isikhungo uma sihambise imininingwane engelona iqiniso. Abanale nkinga yokuthi izikhungo zilethe imininingwane engelona iqiniso kumele baye ezikhungweni ngqo beyofuna incazelo," I-NSFAS iphinde yanxusa izikhungo ukuthi ziqhubeke zilethe ngokushesha imininingwane lyezitshudeni ukuze kungabambezeleki ukukhishwa kwezimfanelo zezitshudeni.Lesi sikhwama sabelwe u-R55.4 billion, nguMgcinimafa onyakenimali u-2025/2026.Kuhlale kukhalwa ngezinkinga kwi-NSFAS ngalesi sikhathi sokuqala konyaka.Kuvame ukusolwa lesi sikhwama ngokuphuza ukuphendula kulabo abasuke befake izicelo zokuxhaswa.

Okunye kwakho ukubamba ngengalo lucathulise labo besifazane okusuke sekumele baqhubeke nomsebenzi wemboni yamtekisi uma sekudlule emhlabeni abayeni babo,'' usho kanjena.Ugcizelele ukuthi lolu hlaka kumele lukwazi ukuvala leyo ntuba, luhlinzeke ngosizo kuloyo wesifazane ngoba usuke eludinga ngokushesha. Ukhulume nangokuthi ziningi izinselelo abesifazane abasembonini yamatekisi abaye bezithole bebhekene nazo wathi uhlaka kungumsebenzi walo ukubhekana nazo ngqo maqede zinqotshwe.Nalu uhlu oluphelele lwabesifazane abayishumi abakhethwe ukuba babe yingxenye yohlaka. KwesikaSihlalo kube nguNksz Mhle Mjoli, iPhini uNksz Jabulisile Khumalo, Nobhala nguNksz Sihle Nkosi, iPhini likaNobhala nguNksz Gloria Mngadi, uMgcinimafa nguNksz Nokuthula Kheswa, uMxhumanisi uNksz Zibuyile Ngcobo, Obhekelele uqeqesho nguNksz Thandeka Luthuli, kwesikaChamplain kwaqokwa uNksz Cawekazi Mshengu, kwase kuba namalungu amabili angeziwe okunguNksz Phumzile Madide noNksz Sizakele Mdluli.Lolu hlaka kuhlalukile ukuthi lubunjwe ngabesifazane abavela kuzona zonke izifunda ezahlukene ezibumba i-Santaco KwaZulu-Natal.Okhulumela le nhlangano, uMnuz Sfiso Shangase, uchaze uhlaka njengolukhathula indima enkulu ezintweni ezehlukene. Uthe yilona olwenza umsebenzi omkhulu ekucathulisweni kwabafelokazi embonini uma abayeni babo sebedlulile emhlabeni.Naye uligcizelelile elithi akumele isinkwa sasekhaya siwe phansi ngoba nakhu ubaba wekhaya eselele kobandayo.
KUZOWASHUBELA abangamalungu eSadtu azibandakanya nomkhonyovu wokudayiswa kwezikhala zothisha kanjalo nalabo abasaqhubeka nomkhuba wokulala nabafundi.Lokhu kulandela ukugxekwa kwalo mkhuba okuthiwa uyanda, ugxekwa wubuholi obuphezulu bale nyunyana emhlanganweni wesigungu esiphezulu obungempelasonto.Lobu buholi buzwakalise ukukhathazeka ngokwanda kwalezi zehlakalo, ezidicilela phansi isithunzi sothisha.UNobhala Jikelele we-Sadtu uDkt Mugwena Maluleke, uthe bakhathazekile ngokwanda komkhuba wabadayisa izikhala nothisha abalala nabafundi."Siyazigxeka lezi zehlakalo esizigxeka njalo uma zivela. Lezi zehlakalo zingcolisa igama nesithunzi somkhakha wokufundisa kanjalo negama lenyunyana. Siyalwa nenkohlakalo kanjalo nezinto ezingalungile, yingakho sinqume ukuthi sizobaqondisa ubugwegwe abayotholakala benza lezi zinto," kusho uMaluleke.Ihlale ivela njalo uma kukhangiswe izikhala kwezemfundo, eyezinsolo zothisha abadayisa izikhala ezikoleni.Kanjalo nendaba yothisha abasalala nabafundi, ihlale ikhuzwa njalo ngisho umkhandlu olawula othisha kuleli i-Sace, okuyiwona othatha izinyathelo ezinqala zokususa ohlwini lokufundisa othisha abasagila lesi siga kubafundi, kodwa bayaphikelela bakwenze lokhu.Ngisho nomthetho osayinwe nyakenye nguMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa i-Bela, iyakucacisa okumele othisha bakwenze nokungamele bakwenze kodwa bakushaya indiva lokhu.Kulo mhlangano wokuqala walesi sigungu, le nyunyana ixoxe ngezinto eziningi okubalwa nendaba yokugcwala ezikoleni.Ubuholi buthe ukuvulwa kwezikole kuveze izinkinga abahlale bekhala ngazo zokugcwala ngokweqile, ukushoda kwengqalasizinda nezinselelo zayo, izinkinga zokushoda kwamanzi nokunye."Kunezinselelo zokugqekezwa kwezikole, indaba yokushoda kothisha, inkinga kagesi namanzi, izinkinga zezinto ezithutha abafundi nezinye. Lezi zinto zidinga ukulungiswa ngokushesha." UMaluleke ukhale nangesabelomali somnyango athe ingxenye enkulu yaso iya emaholweni othisha."Siyasamukela isabelomali esethulwe nguNgqongqoshe uMnuz Enoch Godongwana muva nje. U-76% walesi sabelo uya emaholweni bese kuthi inkeshezana isalela izinhlelo ezifana nokuhlinzekwa kokudla ezikoleni, izinsiza zokufunda, nokunye. Noma sisamukela isabelo kodwa asenele izidingo ezidingeka kwezemfundo," usho kanje. UGodongwana ukhale ngesikweletu sikahulumeni athe sikhulu sidlula nemali abayifaka kwezemfundo nezempilo ngoba kudingeka basikhokhele.Uhulumeni wabeka phambili ezemfundo kanti noNgqongqoshe walo mnyango, uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, uthe kubalulekile ukuthi kubanjiswane neminye imikhakha ikakhulu osomabhizinisi abanikelela umnyango ngoba kunezinselelo zesabelomali.

UKUKHONJWA indlela kwenxusa laseNingizimu Afrika yiMelika kuyinkomba yokujula komonakalo ebudlelwaneni phakathi kwala mazwe abengamathe nolimi phambilini.Ngempelasonto uNgqongqoshe wezangaPhandle waseMelika, uMnuz Marco Rubio, umemezele ukuthi uMnuz Ebrahim Rasool akasadingeki eWhite House, okuyikomkhulu leMelika. KUCHAZEKE iSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini kuqanjwa ngaso umgwaqo oya entabeni enomlando obalulekile, iSandlwana.Ukuqanjwa komgwaqo obuwaziwa ngo-P372 ngeSilo esisesihlalweni kuyingqophamlando njengoba lesi kuyisakhiwo sokuqala ukuba siqanjwe ngeNdlulamithi yamakhosi.Isimemezelo sokuthi umgwaqo usuzobizwa ngeMbube senziwe emcimbini obungoLwesihlanu, eNguthu, lapho iMbube ihlabe khona isoyi lokwakhiwa kabusha kwalo mgwaqo.Ukwakhiwa kabusha komgwaqo kubhekwe ukuthi kuphele ngasekuqaleni kuka-2027. Uma usuphelile, uyokube usubizwa ngeSilo.Intaba iSandlwana ibalulekile emlandweni kaZulu njengoba uZulu anqoba amaNgisi kuyo le ntaba, ngo-1879. INdlulamithi yamakhosi ithe kuyijabulisile ukuba umgwaqo oya entabeni enomlando ongaka uqanjwe ngaso."Isona sakhiwo sokuqala lesi esizobizwa ngegama lami, nami ngiwumuntu namhlanje. Kusho lukhulu kimi lokhu. UNkulunkulu usibusisile. Isibusiso uNkulunkulu athe wasehlisela kuthina siyasemukela ngezandla zombili."Ukwakhiwa kabusha komgwaqo kwakuyisicelo seSilo esesabuza, uGoodwill Zwelithini kaBhekuzulu."Kuyangijabulisa ukuthi namhlanje ngizoqedela umsebenzi owaqalwa ubaba wami."IMbube ithe ukuthuthukiswa komgwaqo kuzolekelela kwezokuvakasha kuphinde kuthuthukise nomnotho."Ngiyabajabulela abantu basesifundeni uMzinyathi, okuyibona abazohlomula kakhulu. Ukuxhumana sekuzokuba lula, nokuya ezibhedlela sekuzokuba lula."IMbube ithe ifisa ukuba kungabi nazihibe ekwakhiweni kabusha komgwaqo."Ngiyacela kuwo wonke amakhosi ake aphile, namabutho alwa lapha eSandlwana, elwela leli lizwe, ukuthi ubusiseke lo msebenzi, nawo amabutho awugade umsebenzi."UMphathiswa wezokuThutha, uMnuz Siboniso Duma, uthe kuwufanele lo mgwaqo ukuba uqanjwe ngeSilo."Ngiyathemba ukuthi uZulu wonke uyojabula."UDuma uthe uhulumeni ubeke eceleni u-R400 million, wathi osomabhizinisi bendawo bazohlomula u-R106 million."Imbokodo kufanele ihlomule kule mali, singayibangisi. Intsha nayo kufanele ihlomule, kanjalo nalabo ababelwela inkululeko."UDuma uthe kuzodaleka amathuba emisebenzi angu-130."Kunabantu abangu-130 esizobathatha lapha eNquthu. Bazokube besebenza kulo mgwaqo, bewugadile. Imali nje ezoholelwa abantu bendawo u-R30 million."UDuma uthe ukwakhiwa komgwaqo kuzohlomulisa abantu abaningi."Sizoshiya lapha sakhe nanemigwaqo emincane engenela ezitolo zendawo. Lona umgwaqo obalulekile ngoba uthinta indlunkulu, sizohlezi siwugadile. Njalo nje uma siqhuba uhlelo lokuhlola, sizokuza sizowuhlola lomgwaqo."
Ibhalwe ngu Louis van Vuren, iCEO yeFISA, yabe isitolikwa nguMoyomuhle Maphanga iCandidate Attorney yaseRumana Mahomed AttorneysNazi izifundo ezimbili zempilo yangempela ezibonisa izinselelo ezingavela:Isifundo sokuqalaIndoda ethile, asiyibize ngoKhaya, yayifuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umkayo uzoba nendawo yokuhlala ngemva kokushona kwayo. Incwadi yefa lakhe yayishiya lonke ifa lakhe ku-Trust okukhona kuyo amadodakazi akhe amabili kuphela njengabazohlomula kuyo, okuncike kuyo ikhaya alishiyela unkosikazi njengendawo abazohlala kuyo aze edlule emhlabeni. Kuzwakala kukuhle kuze kube manje.Akukho okunye okwakushiyelwe unkosikazi kanti lokhu kwacaca ngokudlula emhlabeni kukaKhaya nokuyinto engazange imthokozise umfelokazi. Wafaka isimangalo semali engaphezubkuka-R6m ngokumelene nefa likaKhaya ongasekho ngaphansi koMthetho Wokunakekelwa Kwabashadile Abasaphila, 27 ka-1990. Lo mthetho uhlose ukuvikela abashadikazi abasaphila ukungaphucwa ifa lezithandwa zabo lapho bengenayo enye indlela yokuzondla. Kodwa-ke, uhlulekile ukucacisa ukuthi ufika kanjani kulesi samba asifunayo. Amadodakazi amabili okuyiwona aphethe ifa ngaphansi kwe-Trust, aba nomqondo omuhle wokuqoka i-ejenti enolwazi eyayizokwenza umsebenzi wosuku nosuku wokuphatha ifa. Ngokwezikhundla zawo njengabaphathi be-Trust, amadodakazi afaka isimangalo sika-R4m ngokumelene nefa elisele sekuvela isikweletu semali eyabolekwa wuyise ku-Trust efuna ukuthenga indlu ezohlala umfelokazi wakhe ngenxa yezinsolo zokubolekwa yi-Trust kuyise ukuze athenge indlu umfelokazi athola ilungelo lokuhlala kuyo impilo yakhe yonke. Uma zombili lezi zimangalo zikhokhelwa, ifa belingeke likwazi ukukhokhela izikweletu.Umfelokazi owayengeyena umama walawa madodakazi wanikela enkantolo enkulu ukuze ikhiphe umyalelo wokuthi amadodakazi amabili akhishwe njengabaphathi befa. Uveze ukuthi banokungqubuzana kwezintshisekelo. Inkantolo ayizange ikujabulele ukuthi icala elifuze leli, ebelingaxazululwa ukube zonke izinhlangothi zenza ngendlela ephusile, lifinyelele enkantolo. Inkantolo iyalele ukuthi amadodakazi amabili akhishwe esikhundleni sokuba abaphathi befa njengoba ayexabene kakhulu ngokuthi kucutshungulwe izimangalo ezimbili eziphikisanayo ezizoba nomthelela ekutheni azohlomula kangakanani efeni likayise.Isifundo sesibiliOmunye umlisa, asithi uLiyolo, wayenomhlaba owawunendlu yezivakashi. Uphathina wakhe, uNoluvuyo, nguye owayephethe indlu yezivakashi kanti nencwadi yakhe yefa yayivumelana nalokho inqobo nje uma engahlala kule ndawo ngemva kokushona kwakhe ngaphandle kokukhokha irenti aqhubeke nokuphatha indlu yezivakashi. Umhlaba wabiwa ngokulinganayo phakathi kukaNoluvuyo nendodana kaLiyolo, u-Olwethu. Imali engenayo (inzuzo) yendlu yezivakashi yayizohlukaniswa ngokulinganayo phakathi kuka-Noluvuyo no-Olwethu. Nokho, uma u-Olwethu ekhetha ukuhlala kwesinye sezakhiwo ezikule ndawo, wayezolahlekelwa ilungelo lakhe lokuthola ingxenye yenzuzo yendlu yezivakashi. Enye ingxenye yefa nayoyahlukaniswa ngokulinganayo phakathi kuNoluvuyo no-Olwethu.Lokhu kuzwakala njengesixazululo esiqondile sokunakekela bobabili uNoluvuyo no-Olwethu. Encwadini yakhe yefa u-Liyolo uphinde waqoka uNoluvuyo kanye nomeluleki wakhe wakudala wentela, u-Thandi, njengababi befa lakhe. Ngesikhathi belawula indaba yefa eseshonile uNoluvuyo no-Thandi baba nemibono ehlukile ngodaba luka-Olwethu ngokwencwadi yefa. Benqaba futhi nokunikeza u-Olwethu ulwazi mayelana nokuphathwa kwefa kanye nemali engenayo ngokusebenza kwendlu yezivakashi, ngoba bethi indlu yezivakashi ayiyona impahla yefa. Bathi uLiyolo ukubeke ngokusobala ukuthi uNoluvuyo uyena ohamba phambili ngakho konke okumayelana nendlu yezivakashi nokuthi u-Olwethu uzozuza kuphela ingxenye yempahla ekhona hhayi indlu yezivakashi.U-Olwethu waya enkantolo ukuze abakhiphe njengabahluleli ngenxa yokungqubuzana kwezinjongo zikaNoluvuyo, nokungabi nomgogodla kukaThandi, kanye nokuthola incazelo efanele ngencwadi yefa. Inkantolo ivumelane no-Olwethu ukuthi naye ungumnikazi wendawo, unelungelo lokuthola ingxenye yenzuzo yendlu yezivakashi futhi wayezolahlekelwa yiyo kuphela uma ethuthela kwesinye sezakhiwo ezikule ndawo. Inkantolo iphinde yasusa abaphathi abalawula ifa ngenxa yokungqubuzana kwemibono nokungachemi.IsiphethoLawa macala womabili, angaphambi kwenkantolo enkulu ashiyana ngeminyaka engaphansi kwemine, abonisa amaphuzu abaluleke kakhulu:● Ingozi yokungqubuzana kwezinhloso zenzuzo igqama kakhulu uma wenza isihlobo esiseduze, oshade naye noma uphathina wakho ophilisana naye abe ngumabi wefa lakho, ngaphandle uma oshade naye ezuza lonke ifa lakho.● Thola izeluleko zochwepheshe noma nini lapho kukhona umuntu wesibili oshade naye noma izingane zasothandweni lakudala zikhona.● Thola usizo lochwepheshe ukuze ubhale incwadi yefa ukuze ugweme izingxabano mayelana nokutolikeka kwayo.● Umabi wamafa woshonile kanye nomphathiswa ku-trust babekwe esikhundleni sokwethenjwa futhi bangaphansi kwesibopho sokwenza izinto ngendlela engachemi ukuze kuzuze ifa noma i-trust nabo bonke abangase bazuze kulo. UKUGXAMBUKELA kwabantu abaseceleni abangazi lutho ngesihlalo sobuKhosi bamaZulu, ngenye yezinto okukhalwe ngayo futhi yakhuzwa ngabanewabo beSilo esesabuza iNkosi uZwelithini kaBhekuzulu. OMntwana uVulindleka kaBhekuzulu, uMntwana uMathubesizwe kaBhekuzulu noMntwana Mbonisi, bakhale ngabaxova umndeni.Basho lokhu izolo esithangamini nabezindaba e-ICC, eThekwini, ngenhloso yokubhoboka futhi bachaze ngesimo saseNdlunkulu, lapho bedalule futhi baqinisekisa ukuthi ngokwabo - zonke izinto zihamba kahle futhi akukho ukungaboni ngaso linye. Lokho kungenxa yokuthi sekukaningi kuvela izinkulumo zokuthi iNdlunkulu ihlukene phakathi ngenxa yezingxabano nokungaboni ngasolinye okuqhubekayo ngaphakathi, obekusolakala ukuthi kudalwa wumbango oshisayo ngaphakathi wesihlalo sobuKhosi, okumanje kuhleli iNkosi uMisuZulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini Zulu.Ekhuluma nabezindaba, uMntwana uVulindlela uthe nakuba bengesibo abantu abakhonze ukuqaphela nokunaka izinto ezishiwo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana kepha sekufinyelele nasezindlebeni zabo izinsolo zokuthi ayibhekani eNdlunkulu."Njengoba sihlangene kule nkundla namhlanje (esho izolo) kubalukekile ukuthi sidalule umsuka nencazelo yalapho esikhona manje. Kusukela ngesikhathi sokubuza kweSilo, umnewethu uMdlokombane, kube nomsindo omkhulu eNdlunkulu ngodaba lwesihlalo. Lowo msindo usinyove wasiqeda siyindlunkulu, kwabhebhethekiswa nawukungenelela kwabezepolitiki ezindabeni zobukhosi, oningi labo abanalwazi lomsuka wesihlalo sobukhosi bakwaZulu nokunye okweyamene naso. Yingakho sibone kusemqoka ukuhlangana, sicacise ukuthi akukho okwenzekayo okungahambi kahle futhi kungamampunge ukuthi iNdlunkulu ayibhekani ngoba thina esihlala khona nsuku zonke siyakweshama lokho,” usho kanje.Eqhuba uMntwana uVulindlela wesihlahla sozalo lomndeni wesihlalo sobuKhosi, udalule ukuthi lokho bakwenze ngoba befuna ukuthi abantu baqonde ukuthi ngobani abazalelwe ebukhosini. Kusukela embumbini wesizwe sobukhosi bakwaZulu iNkosi uShaka, kuze kuzofika kokhona manje - ukwenzela ukuthi kwazeke ukuthi ngobani okumele baphawule ngezinto zomlando wobukhosi ukugwema ukudukiswa kwabantu ngenhloso."Silapha nje namhlanje sazi kahle ngomsindo namacala ukuthi kube nomthelela ongakanani ekuzamazamiseni iNdlunkulu nesihlalo sobukhosi bakwaZulu. Yingakho injongo yethu okwamanje akukona ukukhuluma ngokuziphatha kwamazinyane ngoba lokho akuyona into yokukhulunywa esidlangalaleni. Nokho siyakuqinisekisa futhi siyakugcizelela ukuthi ukuziphatha kahle yinto esiyiqaphe ngeso lokhozi ukugwema izinkiinga,” kusho uMntwana uVulindlela.

MHLELI: Iningi labantu likhungethwe ngukuxakeka okwahlukene okudinga imali. Sizithola sesigembula ngezindlela ezahlukene okubandakanya nokwezinombolo. Okubuhlungu ngabagembuli bezinombolo wukuthi abasoze nanini bayibamba i-jackpot yezinombolo uma bengakaze bazingele ngisho izinyoni lezi. Phela umzingeli okala kahle inyoni ngesihlilingi yilowo oyikala endaweni eyodwa ngaso sonke isikhathi. Akalenzi iphutha uma ekala inyoni.Nangakusasa uma ezingela izinyoni, uyikala endaweni efanayo, okungaba yikhanda noma yisifuba. Lo mzingeli wezinyoni uyaziqeda izinyoni zeNkosi. Akagcaluzi lonke ihlathi, efunana nezinyoni. Hleze ahlangabezane nengozi.Ucutha esikhaleni esisodwa, khona ehlathini. Wazi kahle kamhlophe ukuthi nazi izihlahla namafokozi, nalapho ecuthe khona ziyeza izinyoni. Ngeke elokhu ewuka enyuka nehlathi lonke, ngoba maningi amathuba okubuya elambatha.Uma ungumgembuli ogembula ngezinombolo, ngisho ngabe luhlobo luni lokugembula kwezinombolo, kumele ugembulise okomzingeli wezinyoni. Awukwazi ukuthi namuhla ugembula ngezinombolo ezithize, ikuchithe i-jackpot okanye umshini wezinombolo, bese ngokulandelayo ugembula ngezinye izinombolo ezihlukile kulezo ezikuchithile ngokwedlule bese ucabanga ukuthi uzobamba i-jackpot yezinombolo. Awukwazi neze ukugembula ngezinombolo uma ugembula ngale ndlela. Umgembuli ogembula ngale ndlela uzimosela imali yakhe nje, ngazikhathi zonke zokugembula kwakhe. Yingakho sihlezi sikhala ngokuthi asibambi lutho uma sigembulile. Siphinde sithi kuhlula ngisho imithandazo. Angangivumela nomzingeli wezinyamazane ukuthi awukwazi ukugcogcomisa umgogo nehlathi lonke ngoba ufuna ukubamba inyamazane. Kodwa mhlawumbe omunye umzingeli angakuphika lokhu. Kumele uwucuphe esikhaleni esisodwa umgogo, futhi lapho ozwa ukuthi izodlula khona nakanjani inyamazane.Lo mgogo kamzingeli kungenzeka ungayibambi inyamazane namuhla, kusasa, nangomhlomunye. Kodwa uzogcina uyigojelile ngoba ucushwe esikhaleni esisodwa wangagcogconyiswa nehlathi lonke, nokuyisikhala lapho inyamazane ike izidlise satshanyana ngakhona. Awukwazi ukuthi uzogcogcomisa umgogo uma uzingela, ucabange ukuthi uzobamba inyamazane. Ihlakaniphe iqedile inyamazane, njengawo umshini wezinombolo. Futhi lomgogo, njengoba isiwufica kwesinye isikhala sehlathi nje, iyawazi, iyakhumbula ukuthi ike iwubone ndawana thize nehlathi.Kanjalo nomdobi wezinhlanzi, akakwazi ukugcogcomisa uthi lokudoba nolwandle noma nedamu lonke ngoba inhlanzi itshuza lapho asuka khona. Azikho izinombolo ezingaqhashi phambili ukuze ziphume phambili. Pho umgembuli wezinombolo akazilindi ngani izinombolo zakhe zekhethelo, nazo ezisemgqeni wokuphuma phambili suku lumbe. Yisikhathi somshini wezinombolo kuphela esisuke singakafiki. Umgembuli wezinombolo okwazi ukugembula ngezinombolo yilowo owazi kahle ukuthi izinombolo okugenjulwa ngazo ziyisishiyagalolunye kuphela, kusuka kunombolo 1 kuya kunombolo 9. Uwubeka eceleni kancane unombolo zero (0) okuyinombolo yokuqala kodwa engekho. Unombolo 0 akakwazi ukwakha izinombolo ezikhipha yena qobo lwakhe. Lokhu kufakazelwa ngulwazi oluthi ziyishumi kuphela izinombolo emhlabeni jikelele. Eyokuqala nguye unombolo 0, okuyinombolo engekho. Kodwa engekho enjalo unombolo 0 ubamba iqhaza elikhulu ngoba nguye olekelela unombolo 1 ukuthi akwazi ukwakha unombolo 10. Aphinde futhi alekelele unombolo 2 ukwakha unombolo 20, njalonjalo.Ukushoda kwalolu lwazi uma sigembula ngezinombolo ngokunye okwenza sikhale ngaphansi ngazo zonke izikhathi uma sigembula ngezinombolo. Ngake ngadlala umshini wezinombolo, ngadliwa ngunombolo 18, 36, 20 no-11 bephume phambili. Ngavuleka inkungu kudala ukuthi empeleni kulezi zinombolo ngidliwe ngunombolo 9 ophume phambili, kabili, ewu-nombolo 18 nonombolo 36 okungezinye zezinombolo ezakhiwa ngunombolo 9.Ngabamba ikhanda ngakhala ngomama, ngakho njalo ukuthi angikaze ngizingele ngisho izinyoni lezi!Cebolenkosi Maphumulo ENANDALo mbono kaMashimane cishe amaphisi ayawulandela. Ebesingakunakile ukuthi amasu asekuzingeleni angasebenza nasemaphatheni azama inhlanhla yokuqagela izinombolo ezingakuwinisa i-jackpot. Uthini wena mfundi ngale ndlela esinombolwe uMashimane yokucupha umgogo. - UMhleli
