NJENGENJWAYELO, ziphinde zabakhalela abakhonze amanzi amponjwana namaxhwele ngesikhathi uNgqongqoshe wezeziMali, uMnuz Enoch Godongwana, ethula isabelomali.UGodongwana umemezele ukunyuka kotshwala nogwayi ngesikhathi ethula isabelomali, ePhalamende Kapa.Kuzonyuka yonke inhlobo yotshwala kuphinde kunyuke nezinhlobo ezehlukene zikagwayi, nokusho ukuthi kuzoguga iphakethe kwababhemayo nabaphuzwayo ngenyan ga ezayo.UGodongwana umemezele ukuthi ubhiya uzonyuka ngo-16 cents, ugologo unyuke ngo-R5.95, iwayini lizokwenyuka ngo-48 cents, bese kuthi iwayini elihlohlozayo lona linyuke ngo-90 cents.Isigazu sizonyuka ngo-R8.49, inqawe izonyuka ngo-50 cents, iphakakethe likagwayi linyuke ngo-R1.40, bese kuthi uketshezi olufakwa kugwayi ophafuzwayo lona lunyuke ngo-14 cents.UGodongwana unyusa le mali nje, amaxhwele nabakhonze amanzi amponjwana bebekhalile, bemcela ukuthi abanikeze ushwele kulokhu.Inhlangano i-Tax Justice ikhale ngokuthi amaxhwele nabaphuzayo bahlezi beshayeka uma kunesabelomali.Umsunguli we-Tax Justice, uMnuz Yusuf Abramjee, uthe uhulumeni kufanele uyeke ukuqinisela isandla abantu ababhemayo nabaphuzayo, wathi uhulumeni kufanele ulwe nokusabalala kukagwayi notshwala okungekho emthethweni kuleli.U-Abramjee uthe uhulumeni angaqoqa intela ewu-R100 billion uma engaqeda ukudayiswa kukagwayi notshwala okungombombayi."Kwenyuke kakhulu ukudayiswa kogwayi notshwala obungekho emthethweni. Lokhu kwenziwa ukuthi abantu abaningi babalekela ukukhokha intela. Ukujezisa abantu abathenga ugwayi notshwala obusemthethweni angeke kusize ngalutho. Empeleni kuzokwenza ukuthi bonke abantu begcine sebethenga ugwayi notshwala obungekho emthethweni."
NKOSIKHONA CELEYAYINGENAZO izinombolo imoto eyayisetshenziswa ngabasolwa ngesikhathi behlasela e-salon KwaMakhutha besoconga ilungu eliqavile le-ANC, uMnuz Smanga Celimpilo Zulu (31).Lokhu kuvele eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini ngesikhathi kufakaza umphenyi omkhulu kuleli cala uWarrant Officer Mhlungu.Abamangalelwe wuMbuso kuleli cala ngoMnuz Sikhalo Mzulwini ongummangalelwa wokuqala, Vusimuzi Khuzwayo ummangalelwa wesibili noNkanyiso Maphumulo wesithathu.Basolwa ngokuthi yibona abangongqondongqondo bokusocongwa kukamufi. Isigameko sokubulawa kukaZulu owayephinde abe ngusomabhizinisi senzeka ngo-Okthoba 12, 2020 e-salon yakhe engaphandle kwaseCoastal College.Ngemuva kwezinsuku ezine kuya kwezinhlanu abasolwa bakhalelwa ngamasongo kaSigonyela. Ukubulawa kukaZulu kwasolwa ukuthi kwakunenhlese yezepolitiki.UMhlungu ufundele inkantolo isitatimende athe senziwa uMnuz Vincent Thwala osalala kobandayo kodwa amchaze njengowabona konke okwenzeka ngosuku lwesigameko. Kulesi sitatimende umufi uveza ukuthi wakubona konke kwenzeka futhi wambona umuntu owadubula.Siveza ukuthi kwathushuka imoto i-Nissan Almera eyabe ingenazo izinombolo futhi inamawindi afile kodwa embozwe ngoplastiki. Siqhuba sithi le moto yapaka buqamama ne-salon. Ngaphakathi kuyona kwakukhona owesilisa omkhulu ngomzimba omnyana futhi omfishane.Emotweni kwehla owesilisa egodle isibhamu nesigqoko kodwa kwathi uma esezofika e-salon isibhamu wasifihla ngesigqoko. Esesondele e-salon kulesi sitatimende umufi uthi akabuzanga mpilo owesilisa wadubula amahlandla amaningana ebhekise kwabesilisa abathathu ababehlezi ngaphandle.Kulabo besilisa uthi kwakukhona noZulu athi wayekade ehlezi nabanye besilisa bona abasinda. Uqhuba athi owayedubula wakuqaphela ukuthi kuzona zombili izandla wayefake iziphandla futhi efake nesikhindi.Umufi wathi esedubulile owesilisa wabaleka waphindela emuva emotweni eyayimlindile vele ayehle kuyona. Uthi yilapho-ke aqaphela khona ukuthi empeleni babebathathu abesilisa ababengaphakathi emotweni.Imoto okukhulunywa ngayo yiyona le okuthiwa kwabe kungekanina wommangalelwa wokuqala, uMzulwini. Ngemuva kwalokho kuthiwa imoto yashaya yachitha.Uthi wathola ukuthi uZulu kugcine kumenele kanti ayehlezi nabo baphuthunyiswa esibhedlela bagcina bewuphonsa umbalane.UMthethwa okufana nokuthi usekhuluma esethuneni, wafa ngokudutshulwa ngonyaka odlule kusolwa ukuthi wabulawa ngabathile ababezama ukuqeda ngobufakazi baleli cala.Kusetshenziswa isitatimende sikamufi nje phambilini kwasuka uthuli lwezichwe phakathi koMbuso nohlangothi olumele abasolwa olwalukuchitha ukusetshenziswa kwezitatimende zofakazi abangasekho emhlabeni kuleli cala.Enkantolo phambilini kwahlaluka ukuthi ummangalelwa wesibili uyena owanxenxa ummangalelwa wokuqala nowesibili ukuba bamlekelele ukuze kusocongwe umufi. Kulindeleke ukuthi uma kuqhubeka icala namuhla umphenyi afunde isitatimende somunye ufakazi naye osashona.
INGCABHA isele nePhalamende ngokuthi igunyaze noma isichithe isabelomali esethulwe nguNgqongqoshe wezeziMali, uMnuz Enoch Godongwana, okunemvunge ngaso ngenxa yokunyuswa kwe-VAT.IPhalamende linamandla okusibuyisela emuva lesi sabelomali kwiKhabhinethi, ukuze sibuyekezwe.Lokhu kuvezwe nguNgqongqoshe eHhovisi likaMengameli uNksz Khumbudzo Ntshavheni, othe uma kwenzeka sigcina sichithwa unomphela lesi sabelomali, zikhona ezinye izindlela ezizokwenziwa."Konke sekulele ePhalamende ngoba yilona elivotela isabelomali. Lingasichitha, sibuyele emuva kwiKhabhinethi ukuze sibuyekezwe kabusha noma sigunyazwe siqale ukusebenza. Uma sigcina sichithwa unomphela, kuzosetshenziswa isabelomali esidala, esagunyazwa yiPhalemende ngonyaka odlule, kuze kube kuvotelwa isabelomali esisha," kusho uNksz Ntshavheni ekhuluma esithangamini nabezindaba izolo ngemuva komhlangano weKhabhinethi eKapa.Usho kanje kulandela ukuthi amanye amaqembu okubalwa i-DA, EFF, MK namanye echithe isabelomali athi ngeke asivotele ePhalamende, ekhala ngokunyuswa kwe-VAT.Amaqembu okubalwa i-UDM, IFP namanye athe azoseseka isabelomali.UNksz Ntshavheni usole i-DA ngokudlala ipolitiki ngokuchitha isitatimende sikaGodongwana.Uthe i-DA ikhala ngezinto ezingahlangene nesabelomali yingakho ithe ngeke iseseke."I-DA ikhala ngokuphasiswa komthetho wokuthathwa komhlaba ngaphandle kwesinxephezelo. Leli qembu laya enkantolo lifuna kuchithwe lo mthetho, sisalinde lolo hlelo. I-DA ikhala nangendaba yomthetho wezikole i-Bela, ayifuni abafundi abamnyama bathole amathuba. Ikhala nangomthetho womshwalense wezempilo kuleli i-NHI, ngakho ukuchitha kwaleli qembu indaba yokunyuswa kwe-VAT ngo-0.5%, kumayelana nezinto ezindala ekhala ngazo," usho kanje.Uthe indaba yokuchithwa kwesabelomali akuyona into entsha emhlabeni, nakwamanye amazwe iyenzeka.Uthe iKhabhinethi iwenzile umsebenzi wayo ngokuthi kumele yethule isabelomali ngaphambi kokuqala konyakamali olandelayo. Unyakamali olandelayo uqala ngenyanga ezayo.UNksz Ntshavheni ubuye wanxusa abantu bakuleli ukuthi babeke phansi amaphaphu ngodaba lokujutshwa kwezithunywa ezizoya koxoxa nohulumeni waseMelika. "Siwuhulumeni sibeke umoya phansi, asikhathazekile ngesiphithiphithi se-DA, nezinye izinhlangano ezigijimela ukuya eMelika ziyokhuluma kabi ngezwe. Asisasinaki isiphithiphithi sibeke umoya phansi ngoba asizothumela kuphela ithimba eMelika, kodwa nakwamanye amazwe."UGodongwana ekhuluma neziteshi ezehlukene zabezindaba izolo, uthe kuhlale kuthiwa akwehliswe isibalo seKhabhinethi wathi incane kakhulu imali engongeka ngokwehlisa lesi sibalo.Uthe yena ufuna imali enkulu ngoba encane ngeke yenze mehluko.
KUBUKEKA iNingizimu Afrika ingazimisele ukuhoxisa maduze amasosha ajutshwe ezweni okusanda kushonela kulo inqwaba yamasosha akuleli, i-Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC).Elakuleli selibeke eceleni u-R5 billion wokweseka amasosha akuleli ayibambe e-DRC. Lokhu kumenyezelwe uNgqongqoshe wezeziMali, uMnuz Enoch Godongwana, ethula isabelomali eKapa izolo.Amasosha akuleli ajutshwe e-DRC njengengxenye yemizamo yokugcina ukuthula. Le mizamo iqhutshwa inhlangano yamazwe aseNingizimu ye-Afrika, iSouthern African Development Community.Ngasekuqaleni konyaka kwasala enkundleni amasosha akuleli angu-14 ngesikhathi etholene phezulu namavukelambuso eqembu i-M23.Ukushona kwamasosha akuleli kwasusa inkulumo mpikiswano, kwabakhona abaphakamisa ukuthi awabuye.Ababephakamisa ukuthi awabuye babekhala ngokuthi awanazo izinsiza ezanele ngenxa yokwehliswa kwesabelomali sombutho wezokuvikela.UGodongwana uthe le mali izosetshenziselwa ukuqhuba imizamo yokugcina ukuthula e-DRC.Kunenqwaba yamasosha akuleli asayibambe e-DRC, amanye alimala kakhulu empini asanda kubuyiselwa kuleli.UMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, uthe isimo asisihle e-DRC.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ephendula imibuzo, ePhalamende ngoLwesine."Isimo sishubile. Lezi zinto ziyenzeka uma usembhidlangweni wokugcina ukuthula. Njengamanje amasosha asesikhumulweni sezindiza, akekho umuntu owahlaselayo."URamaphosa uthe amasosha akuleli asazoqhubeka ayibambe e-DRC kuze kube kutholakala isixazululo."Sifisa ukuthi kube nezingxoxo ngoba izingxoxo kuphela ezingaqeda le mpi."Abaholi bamazwe aseNingizimu ye-Afrika bazoba nomhlangano maduze lapho bezonquma khona ukuthi kufanele yini ahoxiswe amasosha akula mazwe ajutshwe e-DRC. UGodongwana uthe bafuna ukubona kuba noshintsho ekusebenzeni kombutho wezokuvikela."Sizoqhubeka nokusebenzisana noMnyango wezokuVikela, sibheke izindlela esingashintsha ngazo ukusetshenziswa kwemali emnyangweni ukuze sikwazi ukuthuthukisa umbutho wezokuvikela. Sifuna ukuthi umbutho wezokuvikela usebenzise izindlela zesimanje."UGodongwana uthe isiyonke imali ebekelwe ukuqinisa ezokuphepha iwu-R9.4 billion, enye yabelwe uMnyango wezokuHlunyeleliswa kweziMilo.
IBHEKENE nomqansa i-ANC njengoba amaqembu amaningi esichitha isabelomali sikaNgqongqoshe wezeziMali, uMnuz Enoch Godongwana, esiqukethe isiphakamiso sokuthi kunyuswe intela eyengezwa empahleni ethengwayo, i-Value Added Tax.Amaqembu amakhulu ePhalamende asho ngazwi linye ukuthi ayaphikisana nesabelomali esiphakamisa ukuthi intela inyuswe ngo-0.5% kulo nyakamali, iphinde inyuswe ngomunye u-0.5% ngonyakamali olandelayo.Lokhu kungasho ukuthi intela izonyuka ifike ku-16%. Amaqembu azovotela isabelomali ngoMeyi 23.Phakathi kwamaqembu achitha isabelomali kubalwa iqembu lesibili ngobukhulu ePhalamende eliphinde libe ingxenye kahulumeni wokubambisana, i-DA, kube iqembu lesithathu ngobukhulu, i-MK, kanye neqembu lesine ngobukhulu, i-EFF.Umholi we-DA, uMnuz John Steenhuisen, uthe ngeke bakweseke ukuphasiswa kwesabelomali sikaGodongwana. USteenhuisen uthe benze isiphakamiso sokuthi uhulumeni angayithola kanjani le mali eshadayo kodwa isiphakamiso sabo sangashaywa ndiva."Besizimisele ukuxoxa kodwa kusobala ukuthi laba abanye bebengazimisele ukulalela. Akuwona umqondo ophusile ukuba uGodongwana ethule isabelomali ekubeni azi kahle ukuthi akanaso isibalo esanele samaqembu azovotela ukuba siphasiswe."USteenhuisen uthe umnyango wabo uzohlala uvuliwe uma i-ANC isazimisele ngokuxoxa ngalolu daba.Umholi we-MK ePhalamende, uDkt John Hlophe, uthe uhulumeni ubengenza ngezinye izindlela kunokuba anyuse le ntela ezolimaza kakhulu abantu abahlwempu."Kunenqwaba yabantu ababalekela ukukhokha intela, nampo-ke abantu okufanele engabe uhulumeni uyabalandela. Uma sekuvotwa ePhalamende sizosichitha lesi siphakamiso ngoba siyaphikisana nokunyuswa kwentela."Umholi we-EFF, uMnuz Julius Malema, uthe bazokwenza isiphakamiso sokuthi sishintshwe isabelomali sikaGodongwana."Umthetho uyasivumela njengePhalamende ukuba senze izinguquko esabelwenimali. Asilaleli yonke into esuke ishiwo ungqongqoshe. Isigaba 27 somthetho sisinikeza amandla njengamalungu ePhalamende ukuba sishintshe isabelomali uma kuwukuthi kukhona esingajabule ngakho."Umholi we-IFP, uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa, uthe bayaseseka isabelomali sikaGodongwana, wathi bancamela ukunyuswa kwentela ukunokuthi izwe lihambe liyoboleka imali.UMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, uthe ekugcineni amaqembu ezepolitiki kufanele avumelane ngento eyedwa.URamaphosa uthe kube nezingxoxo ezinde ngaphambi kokwethulwa kwesabelomali, wathi uGodongwana ubebhekene nesimo esinzima.IPhini likaNobhala Jikelele we-ANC, uNkk Nomvula Mokonyane, lithe ukwehliswa kwenani okunyuswe ngalo intela, lisuka ku-2% owawukade uhlongoziwe ekuqaleni, kukhombisa ukuthi uhulumeni oholwa i-ANC uyazilalela izikhalo zabantu.UGodongwana uthe konke sekulele kumalungu ePhalamende ukuba anqume ngesabelomali asethule izolo."Ngijabule ukuthi ngikwazile ukwethula isabelomali. Amalungu ePhalamende yiwona okufanele akhulume ngengikwethulile."USomlomo wePhalamende, uNkk Thoko Didiza, uthe njengoba sesethuliwe isabelomali amalungu ePhalamende azothola ithuba lokubeka imibono yawo."Kuzoxoxwa ngesabelomali emakomitini ehlukene ngaphambi kokuthi kuvotwe lapha ePhalamende. Leli ithuba lenu lokuthi nisibheke kabanzi isabelomali."Umhlaziyi wezepolitiki, uNkk Sanet Madonsela, uthe kuzoba nzima ukuthi amaqembu aseke isabelomali uma singakhishwa isiphakamiso sokuthi kunyuswe intela."Ngiyazi ukuthi amaqembu abusa ngokubambisana abengafisa ukuvota ne-ANC kodwa lesi simo singaphezu kwamandla awo. Kufanele amaqembu acabangele abantu abawavotelile. Abantu abaningi bathwele kanzima. Ukunyuswa kwentela kuzokwandisa umthwalo. Ingakho kuzokuba nzima ukuthi amaqembu avotele lesabelomali esiqukethe isiphakamiso sokuthi kunyuswe intela."
KUFE abasolwa ababili kwabayishumi abavinjwe amaphoyisa eLenasia, eningizimu yedolobha iGoli, ngoLwesine ekuseni.Uphenyo beluholwa uphiko lwe-Crime Intelligence ngokubambisana nezinye izihlaka zezomthetho okukhona kuzo i-SAPS Tactical Response Unit noMnyango wamaPhoyisa kaMasipala waseGoli (JMPD), bathole imininingwane ngetulo lokuqhunyiswa kwe-ATM yiqembu lamalungu ayi-10 ezigebengu eziyingozi.Abasolwa bebefunelwa amacala okuqhunyiswa kwama-ATM namanye amacala abucayi eGauteng nakwezinye izifundazwe ezingomakhelwane.IPhini likaKhomishana wamaPhoyisa, uLieutenant General Shadrack Sibiya, uncome bonke ababambe iqhaza ngobuqhawe babo bebhuntshisa itulo lemigulukudu lokuqhumisa i-ATM eProtea."Ukubambisana phakathi kwabomthetho nezinhlaka ezifanele ezifana nezokuphepha ezizimele kubamba elikhulu iqhaza ekunqandeni nasekulweni nobugebengu obunodlame ezweni,” kusho uLt General Sibiya.
AMAPHOYISA asekhiphe umehlokaboni kaR60 000 kozodedela ulwazi oluzohole ekuboshweni kwabasolwa ababili ababulala abantu abayisithupha eMlaza.Ngo-Agasti 17 2024, abagilwa okungu-Innocent Mazeka (25), Khaliphile Ntombela (37), Yamukela Mzekeli (29), Mlungisi Langa (40), Sinqobile Ngcobo (30) noDumisani Mgoza (39) babehleli ngemuva kwehostela iTehuis ngesikhathi kufika abasolwa ababili becela ugwayi."Abasolwa bahamba, baphinde babuya futhi ngemuva kwemizuzu embalwa sebeyalela abagilwa ukuthi balale phansi ngaphambi kokuba babadubule bonke," kusho amaphoyisa ngesitatimende.Bafa bonke abagilwa kwasinda abesimame abathathu abangazange balimale. Abasolwa abaziwa futhi abachazeki kahle ngoba isehlo senzeka ebusuku, yonke imininingwane esemaphoyiseni ayitheli izithelo ezinhle.Amaphoyisa anxusa noma wubani ongaba nolwazi olungaholela ekuboshweni nasekugwetshweni kwabasolwa ukuba axhumane noDetective Sergeant Jila ku-079 696 3685 noma ashayele iCrime Stop ku-0860010111.
YIZE ingangenwa ekakhaphethi obomvu okupepenyeka kuwo amalungu nezimenywa uma kunemicimbi ePhalamende, kodwa bakhona abebekhiphe unyawo ngengqephu kwethulwa isabelomali eKapa. Kungenzeka ukuthi iningi livele lisuke emakhaya lingenanhliziyo njengoba ibijamelene ngokunyuswa kwentela ekhokhwa uma kuthengwa izimpahla i-VAT. Nokho-ke ugcine eyethulile inkulumo yakhe uNgqongqoshe wezeziMali uMnuz Ecoch Godongwana
EZEMFUNDO, ezempilo nokuthuthukiswa kwengqalasizinda beziseqhulwini kwisabelomali esethulwe izolo nguNgqongqoshe weziMali uMnuz Enoch Godongwana, ePhalamende eKapa.UGodongwana umemezele ukuthi isabelomali kulindeleke ukuthi sikhule sifinyelele ku-R2.83 trillion ngonyaka wezimali u-2027/2028, sisuka ku-R2.4 trillon ngo-2024/2025.Uveze ukuthi uhulumeni kulo nyaka uzochitha u-R2.59 trillion, kanti ingqalasizinda yabelwe u-R1 trillion eminyakeni emithathu ezayo."Ingxenye enkulu yesabelomali ihlinzekelwe iminyango, owezeMfundo, owezeMpilo kanjalo nowezeNhlalakahle okhokha izibonelelo. Izifundazwe zizothola u-R2.4 trillion, kuthi uhulumeni wasekhaya, omasipala bazokwabelwa u-R115.7 billion onyakeni wemali u-2027/2028," kusho uGodongwana.Udalule ukuthi emalini yengqalasizinda babeke u-R402 billlion, wokuphucula imigwaqo, u-R219.2 billion wengqalasizinda kagesi, u-R156.3 billion wengqalasizinda yamanzi nokuthuthwa kwendle."Kwingqalasizinda yamanzi sakha amadamu kanti amanye ayalungiswa ukuze abantu babe namanzi. Sifuna ukunyusa umthamo wamanzi ebantwini baseThekwini, kanjalo nakomasipala abane KwaZulu-Natal."Kwezemfundo uthe bazofaka u-R9.1 billlion, wokukhokhela othisha ukuze kwehliswe isibalo sabafundi kuthisha oyedwa ekilasini ngalinye."Sixhasa nemfundo yamazinga aphansi i-ECD ngokufaka u-R10 billion, wokuxhasa umfundi ngamunyhe ngo-R24 ngosuku. Sizonyusa nesibalo sabenza i-ECD bafinyelele ku-700 000." Kwezempilo kuzochithwa imali emaholweni abasebenzi njengoba kwengezwe u-R28.9 billion esabelweni, ukuze kungadilizwa abasebenzi ezibhedlela nasemitholampilo."Sizobuye siqashe abasebenzi abangu-800 okubalwa odokotela nokuthenga imithi ukuze izibhedlela zingaphelelwa yimithi." Uthe iPrasa izohlinzekwa ngo-R19.2 billion, ukulungisa ingqalasizinda yayo ukuze zisheshe izitimela ezithutha abagibeli KwaMashu, nakwezinye izindawo.Omasipala bazogixabezwa ngo-R1.7 billion, ukulwa nenkinga yezinhlekelele njengoba kuyibona abasekhaleni.Kunomunye u-R4 billion, ozonikwa omasipala ukuthi kulungiswe ingqalasizinda engakalungiswa eyashayeka ngenxa yezinhlekelele.Isivumelwano samaholo abasebenzi bakahulumeni seminyaka emithathu, sabelwe u-R11 billion. Isivumelwano sizodla u-R7.3 billion, onyakeni wezimali u-2025/2026, kube ngu-R7.8 billion ngo- 2026/27 no-R8.2billion ngo-2027/28.
AMAPHOYISA avundulule ifemu elikhulu eligaya utshwala oyimbombayi eWestonaria. Kuboshwe abantu abayisishiyagalolunye, ababili baseChina, abayisithupha baseMalawi noyedwa waseMozambique.Kuleli femu amaphoyisa athole umshini osetshenziselwa ukukhiqiza utshwala, yimoto yohlobo lweNissan, imiphongolo egcwele ugologo obomvu nomhlophe wenani elingaphezu kukaR600 000, kukhona namabhokisi namabhodlela katshwala anamalebuli adumile atholakala ezitolo.
AMAPHOYISA athungatha abasolwa okungakaziwa ukuthi bangaki, kulandela isigameko sokudunwa kwemoto yemali okwenzeke emgwaqweni uNyala eNtuzuma izolo emini, okwenziwe abathile maqede bashaya bachitha nemali.Kwi-video esabalale ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, kubonakala imoto ethwala imali ilele ngohlangothi, inqwaba yabantu izitapela imali kuyona. NOKUBONGWA PHENYANEABENGADEDELI lutho oludlula emgwaqweni izolo eMaoti, eNanda, amaphoyisa ngemuva kombhikisho obe ngoMsombuluko lapho kugcine kudubuleke khona amalungu omphakathi amathathu edutshulwa izigebengu okuthiwa zihlalise kabi umphakathi.Isolezwe libike ukuthi ngempelasonto kule ndawo kudutshulwe abantu abathathu abebehlala endaweni eyaziwa ngokuthi kuseNigeria, abahlaselwe izigebengu beziphuzela zafike zababamba inkunzi.Kuthe ngeSonto umphakathi obuthukuthele ugane unwabu wavuka umbhejazana wafuna izigebengu kwaphetha ngokuthi kubulawe umfana oneminyaka engu-18, okuthiwa wayeshutha iqulu labantu elalithungatha imigulukudu.NgoMsombuluko bekungaphumi futhi kungangeni lutho kuleli lokishi umphakathi ufuna izigebengu esitikini ngenxa yokuthi ukhathele ukubulawa kwabantu nsuku zonke endaweni.Kodwa lo mbhikisho awuphethanga kahle njengoba kuvela ukuthi izigebengu zidubule zabulala abathathu okungoMnuz Bonginkosi Dladla, Simon Mofokeng noSanele Khumalo.Laba kuthiwa bebeyingxenye yamalungu omphakathi abesehlale isikhathi eside enkundleni yezemidlalo elinde izikhulu zamaphoyisa nezikahulumeni obekuthiwa ziyeza zizokhuluma nabo.Kuthiwa ngesikhathi sebebona ukuthi sebehlale isikhathi eside enye ingxenye ivele yakhetha ukuthi iye emakhaya iyodla ibuye uma kufika izikhulu.Kuthiwa kulapho izigebengu zibathole khona, zabatshela ukuthi "ziyabagcwalisela".Umthombo weSolezwe uthe okwenzekile kubathusile futhi kucace bha ukuthi izigebengu ziyabahlula bengumphakathi."Namhlanje nje akukho lutho kuthule, siyesaba abaningi bakhuluma indaba yokushiya kule ndawo. Kodwa kunabantu abakhe imizi emikhulu okungelula ukuthi bayishiye noma kanjani. Ababhekele izinhlangano zokuphepha komphakathi abenze ngamandla ngempela bakhulume nezikhulu zamaphoyisa kulethwe amasosha," kuchaza umthombo. Lo mthombo uveza lokhu nje, sekuke kwaqapheleka ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ukwanda kwemizi edayisayo eNanda.Ekhuluma neSolezwe uMnuz Zoli Zimba, osenhlanganweni elwa nobugebengu uMkhumbi kaNowa uthe bajabule ngamaphoysa abawabonayo njengoba esesha abantu emgwaqweni nezimoto ezingenayo.Uthe akukho mbhikisho okhona, sebelinde uNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa uMnuz Senzo Mchunu ukuthi afike kubo.
KUSEKUDE ukwamukela ukuthi othandiweyo womndeni akasekho emhlabeni emndenini wakwaMhlongo eNanda, eMzinyathi, enyakatho yeTheku ngenxa yokuduva emakhazeni kahulumeni kwesidumbu lo mndeni okholwa wukuthi ngesendodakazi uNksz Nolusapho Dladla, owamuka nezikhukhula zango-2022, eneminyaka ewu-17 ngaleso sikhathi.Uyise wale ntombazane, eyashona ifunda u-Grade 10 eDabeka Secondary, eMaqadini, uMnuz Delani Mhlongo uthe okwenza yena namalungu omndeni wakhe bangakutholi ukuphumula ngalesi simo wukuthi manje sekuyophela iminyaka emithathu belinde futhi befuna ukungcwaba ithambo lendodakazi yabo, kepha abakwazi ukwenza kanjalo ngenxa yokuvinjelwa wuhlelo lolibofuzo, oluphika amalungu omndeni, naye uqobo. "Inkinga enkulu wukuthi kwathi isidumbu sendodakazi yami sesitholakele emva kwamasonto amabili imukile, sagcinwa emakhazeni kahulumeni asePhoenix. Kwathi sesiya khona ukuyobheka ukuthi akusiso yini esethu, ngokwethu sabona futhi savumelana siwumndeni ukuthi yithambo lethu leli, yize sase siqala ukonakala futhi singasabonakali kahle ebusweni. Manje sivinjwe wukuthi kuthe sekwenziwa ulibofuzo lwesidumbu namalungu omndeni, kubalwa nami uqobo, lwasiphika - okwenza ukuthi abamakhaza bangakwazi ukusinika, sisingcwabe ngokuthula,” kukhononda uMhlongo.Eqhuba, uthe bakhathazeke kakhulu ngokuthi sekuyoze kuphele unyaka wesithathu belinde ukungcwaba futhi sebeguduze kuyo yonke iminyango efanele futhi kwabikwa kudala nakwabomthetho ukuthi akulandelelwe lolu daba, kepha bafika kwangqingetshe ngendaba yolibofuzo, osekucacile ukuthi ngeke kwenzeke lutho ingakalungiseki indaba yalo, noma kuvunyelwane ngandlela thize."Lesi simo siyasilimaza emoyeni futhi siyawuhlukumeza wonke umndeni, kangangokuthi kuba nomunyu wodwa kwabomndeni uma lina noma kunezikhukhula ngoba sibuya sinjengoba sinjalo isithombe sendodakazi yami eyashona ingagulanga, okumanje asikwazi ukuyingcwaba, sidlule kulesi simo esingazi ukuthi kumele senzenjani ukuze kwenzeke ubulungiswa enkingeni esibhekene nayo,” usho kanje. Uthe umndeni wonke nje uhlukumezekile ngalesi simo futhi bafisa ukuthi kube khona okwenzekayo kusukela manje, uma kukhona ongabasiza - abasize nganoma iyiphi indlela abangakwazi ukusizakala ngayo ukuze badlule kulenkinga, kuphole amanxeba eminyaka.Umndeni wakwaMhlongo usola nokuthi kubhediswa uhlelo ngamabomu ngoba wake wabhikisha emakhazeni efuna kukhululwe isidumbu. Manje ufuna amasampula olibofuzo esidumbu athathwe phambi kwawo wudokotela ozimele, ngoba awukholwa ukuthi isidumbu akusona esawo ngoba "wazibonela izimpawu zikaNolusapho emzimbeni" ngenkathi kusanda kutholakala isdumbu.Kuthintwa uNksz Nosipho Gumede, owayephethe emakhazeni kahulumeni okugcinwe kuwona lesi isidumbu, uthe njengoba engasasebenzi kuwona akakwazi ukuphawula ngezimo nezinkinga zokwenzeka esasebenza khona, andukuba mhlawumbe kube wuMnyango wezeMpilo ovumela ukuthi kube khona akushoyo ngalolu daba.Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal uMnuz Agiza Hlongwane ucele ukuthi bathunyelelwe i-email echaza ngesimo nenkinga yalo mndeni ukuze baphenye futhi babheke ukuthi kukhona yini okusengenzeka ngalo ukuze kuphunywe nesixazululo esinobulungiswa.

UNGQONGQOSHE wezeziMali uMnuz Enoch Godongwana uveze ukuthi izibonelelo zikahulumeni zabelwe izigidigidi ezingu-R284.7 ngonyakamali ka-2025/26. Kuthiwa bangu28 million abantu bakuleli abathola izibonelelo.Lokhu kusho ukuthi zizonyuka kanje izibonelelo ngokuhlukana kwazo:• Izibonelelo zabadala nokukhubazeka R130 kuya ku-R2 315 ngo-April.• Isibonelelo Sikahulumeni Sezingane R30 kuya ku-R560 ngenyanga.• Imali yesibonelelo sikahulumeni sezintandane ngama-R70.I-COVID19 Social Relief of Distress (SRD), ngendlela ekuyo njengamanje, izokwelulwa ngonyaka ukuze ekupheleni kukaMashi 2026. PHEZU kokuba uMengameli waseMelika, uMnuz Donald Trump, ehoxise uxhaso obelusiza ngasohlangothini lwezempilo kanjalo noxhaso oluthinta ukuvikelwa kwemvelo kodwa uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, uthe bayaqhubeka nokuphemba ubudlelwano nezwe lakhe.URamaphosa uthe basazoqhubeka nokujuba ithimba elizocubuza amagabade njengoba uTrump, ahoxisa uxhaso ngoba "elakuleli linemithetho ehlukumeza amaBhunu"."Inxusa lethu elizinze eMelika liyaqhubeka nezinhlelo zokuxoxa nezinhlaka ezehlukene eMelika. Sizojuba nethimba elizoya koxoxa nohulumeni waseMelika kanjalo namanye amazwe. Sethemba ukuthi izingxoxo esinazo zizothela izithelo neMelika," kusho uRamaphosa izolo, ephendula imibuzo ePhalamende.Ugxeke izinhlangano i-AfriForum ne-Solidarity ngokuya eMelika, ziyofafaza amanga ngelakuleli.Uthe izinhlaka zezomthetho okubalwa nophiko lwezokushushiswa komphakathi, kumele zibheke ukuthi zingathwesa lezi zinhlangano amacala okuvukela uMbuso."Angihambisani nokwenziwa yilezi zinhlangano, ngokuyofafaza amanga ngezwe lazo kwamanye amazwe. Ziqamba amanga ngezinto ezingenzeki, zihlukanisa phakathi izwe. Lokhu kufana nokungabi nandaba nezwe lakho," kusho uRamaphosa.Lezi zinhlangano zaya eMelika zafike zakhala ngemithetho ezathi ngeye-ANC, okubalwa owokuthathwa komhlaba ngaphandle kwesinxephezelo ukuthi uhlukumeza amaBhunu.UTrump wagxeka elakuleli waze wavula izandla kulabo abazizwa bengaphephile kuleli ukuthi baye kozinza eMelika.URamaphosa uqhubeka nezinhlelo zokuncenga iMelika nje, abanye abaholi bamaqembu ahlukene ePhalamende bamyalela ukuthi angancethezi eMelika, bathi uTrump akahambe ashone noxhaso lakhe njengoba engena egamanxa ezintweni ezingamthinti.Ebuzwa mayelana nokuhlangana kwakhe nomeluleki kaTrump, uMnuz Elon Musk, uvumile ukuthi bahlangana baxoxa naye ngezinto eziningi ezithinta uhwebo."Sihlangana siphinde sikhulume nabantu abahlukene ngezinto ezithinta ukuhwebelana. Sahlangana noMusk nyakenye, kanti sisanda kukhuluma naye muva nje. Ozakwethu esisebenza nabo bayazi ngokuhlangana kwethu noMusk," kusho yena.URamaphosa uphinde waqinisekisa amalungu ePhalamende ukuthi imali yempesheni ezosetshenziselwa ukuphucula ingqalasizinda kuleli, izoqashwa ngelokhozi.Uthe izinguquko ezenziwe esikhwameni sempesheni sivula umnyango wokuthi kuthathwe leyo mali isetshenziselwe ukuphucula ingqalasizinda."Le mali akuyona ekahulumeni ngakho kudingeka ukuthi imali esetshenziselwa ukuphucula ingqalasizinda iqashwe ngelokhozi. Kumele ibuye isinenzalo ebhekile."
I-MK isabisa ngemibhikisho uma uhulumeni eqhubeka nokunyusa intela, nokuvala ibhange Ithala.USotswebhu omkhulu we-MK ePhalamende, uMnuz Mzwanele Manyi, uthe bazomisa yonke into uma uNgqongqoshe wezeZimali, uMnuz Enoch Godongwana, eke wamemezela ukunyuswa kwentela uma esethula isabelomali, ePhalamende, kusasa.Ukusho lokhu izolo ngesikhathi kunombhikisho emahhovisi oMnyango kaMgcinimafa, ePitoli."Sizomisa yonke into eNingizimu Afrika. Sizogovuza abantu ukuba babhikishe. Sizokuba nemibhikisho enokuthula, umthetho uyasivumela ukuba sibe nemibhikisho. Sizokuba nemibhikisho enokuthula kodwa kuzokuma yonke into emadolobheni. Siyabanxusa ukuthi bangasifaki umunwe esweni. Abayeke ukwenyusa intela."Kwahlehliswa ukwethulwa kwesabelomali ngenxa yokuthi amaqembu amaningi ayengavumelani nokunyuswa kwentela ngo-2%.Imibiko yakamuva iveza ukuthi uhulumeni uhlongoza ukunyusa isabelomali ngo-0.75%.UManyi uthe ukunyuswa kwentela kuzokhahlameza abantu abantulayo."Noma kungathiwa izonyuswa ngenani elingakanani intela, simile ekutheni asivumelani nokunyuswa kwayo. Ukunyuswa kwentela kuzokhahlameza abantu abavele bathwele kanzima ngenxa yesimo somnotho esingesihle. Zikhona ezinye izindlela uhulumeni angathola ngayo lemali ayifunayo ngaphandle kokuthi anyuse intela."Emva kokubhikisha emahhovisi oMnyango woMgcinimafa, amalungu e-MK abe esedlulela emahhovisi ebhange loMbuso.UManyi uthe bayaphikisana nokuvalwa kwebhange Ithala. Uthe inkinga yeThala ingalungiseka inqobo nje uma uGodongwana engalinikeza ushwele."Kuyo yonke leminyaka Ithala belilokhu lilekelela abantu. Ithala liyaqhubeka nokusebenza kahle. Azikho izinkinga ezinkulu eThala. Inkinga nje yaseThala into engalungiseka kalula. Inkinga nje ukuthi Ithala ligxile esifundazweni esisodwa nokwenza ukuthi kube nzima ukuthi lithole ilayisensi yokuba yibhange. Umthetho uyamvumela uGodongwana ukuba anikeze Ithala ushwele. Sasingekho isidingo sokuthi uGodongwana asayine isicelo se-Prudential Authority, sokuba kuvalwe Ithala."UManyi uthe ukunyuswa kwentela, nokuvalwa kweThala kukhombisa ukuthi uhulumeni ophethe awubakhathaleli abantu abahlwempu."Siyazama ukuphikisana nalezinto ePhalamende kodwa ayikho into esingayenza ngoba yibona abaningi, bavele bathi akuvotwe. Labantu ababakhathalele abantu."
BABHEKENE nengwadla abafundi baKwaZulu-Natal, abashoda ngezikole kanjalo nangengqalasizinda njengoba lesi sifundazwe sikwezintula kakhulu.Lokhu kuvezwe nguNgqongqoshe weMfundo eyisiSekelo uNksz Siviwe Gwarube izolo, othe i-KZN nesifundazwe i-Eastern Cape yizona ezintula kakhulu uma kuqhathaniswa nezinye. Uveze ukuthi ukuphundlwa kwesabelomali soMnyango wezeMfundo yikona okudale lezi zinkinga."I-EC neKZN yizona zifundazwe ezintula kakhulu izikole nengqalasizinda kuleli. Ukuphundlwa kwesabelomali minyaka yonke kwenza singakwazi ukulungisa izikole nokuzihlinzeka ngengqalasizinda edingekayo. Sidinga u-R129 billion wokubhekana nenkinga yengqalasizinda ezikoleni zethu," kusho uNksz Gwarube ethula umbiko wengqalasizinda eNdlwini yoMkhandlu weziFundazwe ePhalamende.Uthe zikhula minyaka yonke izidingo emnyangweni ekubeni imali yehla kanti lokhu kwenza ukuthi kumiswe ezinye izinhlelo.Uchazele amalungu ngebanga elihanjiwe ukuqeda ngezindlu zangasese zomgodi ezikoleni."Sesiqede u-93% wezindlu zangasese zomgodi ezikoleni zakuleli. Kusele u-7% ukuthi siqede ngawo njengoba zazingu-3 372 phambilini. Sifuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abafundi bazikhulula ngokukhululeka. Kwezinye izindawo sinenkinga yamanzi, okuyinkinga enkulu ngoba noma kuthiwa izindlu zangasese ezishaywayo zikhona, kodwa zingagcina zingasasebenzi ngenxa yokuthi awekho amanzi endaweni okwakhiwe kuyona isikole," kusho uNksz Gwarube.Ukhale nangokugqekezwa kwezikole zicekelwe phansi wathi lokhu kubabuyisela emuva ngoba kudingeka baphinde bakhiphe imali sebezilungisa."Siyaludinga lonke usizo oluvela kwabazonikela njengoba sinenkinga yokushoda kwemali. Sishodelwa ifenisha engu-2 million ezikoleni zethu ngakho usizo lwama-deski agoqwayo, esike sagxekwa ngawo luzosisiza kakhulu. Ngiye kwesinye isikole, ngaphatheka kabi ngifica abafundi abane bempintshene edeskini elilodwa. Akufundeki kahle uma nimpintshene edeskini elilodwa."Uthe bayayibuyekeza neyesibalo sabafundi emakilasini njengoba kwamanye kugcwele kakhulu.Uveze nezibalo zezikole esezakhiwe athe zingu-705, wathi zingu-7 500 ezinamanzi kanti ezingu-1 446 zifakwe ugesi.Uveze nokuthi ezingu-2 852 zibiyelwe, ezingu-38 ziphuculwe izindawo zokuhlala abafundi."Kusenezinselelo kwezinye izikole njengoba ezingu-3 677 zingakhiwe ngendlela, ezingu-8 265 zidinga ukwengezelwa amakilasi, ezingu-6 319 azinawo amanzi," usho kanje.I-DA income uNksz Gwarube ngemizamo yakhe yokuqeda ngezindlu zangasese zomgodi nakuba kusekhona eziyingcosana ezisasele.
UFUNA ukubona ubulungiswa ngokushesha umndeni webhungu okuthiwa lishaywe ngonogada abaqapha inxanxathela yezitolo eChatsworth, eThekwini, lashona ngoba lisolwa ngokuntshontsha.UMnu Minenhle Maphumulo waseMlaza ushonele esibhedlela iPrince Mshiyeni Memorial ngoMsombuluko emva kokulimala kanzima emzimbeni nasekhanda, ngokusho komndeni nomngani wakhe uMnuz Mthokozisi Ncanana naye olimale kanzima. Lesi sehlakalo senzeke ngoMgqibelo lapho umufi nomngani wakhe bebesolwa onogada ngokuthi bebenenhloso yokweba izingubo zokugqoka esitolo i-Truworth.Ekhuluma neSolezwe ngaphandle kwesiteshi samaphoyisa eMlaza izolo, unina kamufi, uNksz Hlanzeka Maphumulo, uthe uthole ucingo luvela kwabakaNacanana okuyibo abafike kuqala endaweni yesigameko lapho bethole khona indodana yakhe nomngani wayo belimele kanzima belahlwe eduze komgwaqo. Uma onogada bembambe nezinto zokwebiwa bekumele bambophe bese uyoziphendulela enkantolo hhayi ukuthi onogada baphenduke ijaji eligweba abantu intambo benganikwanga ithuba lokuziphendulela. Ngifuna ukubona ubulungiswa ngokushesha, amaphoyisa bekumele angabe asebabophile onogada,” kukhala uNksz Maphumulo.Elandisa ngokwenzekile uNcanana uthe yena nomufi bebengaphakathi esitolo sezingubo sakwaTruworth besabheka ukuthi yini abayingathanda bese beyayithenga. Uthi babone sebengungwe ngonogada abayisithupha ababasole ngokuthi bebehlela ukuminca izingubo zokugqoka base bebathelekela ngenduku besebenzisa izinduku zamapayipi eziphathwa ngonogada. UNcanana uthi labo nogada babashaye baqeda babahudula bayobalahla eduze komgwaqo babuyela emuva. Uthi batholwe ngowesifazane obedlula obafonelele imindeni okuyiyo ebaphuthumise esibhedlela ePrince Mshiyeni ngemoto kanti izolo uzoshona uMinenhle."Akukho esikwenzile obekuphambene nomthetho futhi namakhamera abo ngaphakathi asozifakazela kanti nowesifazane osebenza kulesi sitolo ubatshelile onogada ukuthi asintshontshanga lutho. Okubi nje ukuthi ushonile umngani wami ebulawela into engekho kanti ngilimale kanzima ngento engingayazi," kusho uNcanana.
Simangaliso Ntshangase UKUQONDA ukuthi baningi kangakanani osomabhizinisi abasafufusa abadinga amathuba okuchuma, kwenze uMnyango wezokuThuthukiswa koMnotho, ezokuVakasha nezeMvelo KwaZulu-Natal, wenza umcimbi womncintiswano wohlelo lokuklomelisa abasesifundazweni ukubakhuthaza ukuqhuba amabhizinisi nokubasiza ukuwachumisa.Lokho kwenzeke ngoLwesibili ebusuku emncintiswaneni wezindondo Umyezane Awards, obuse-ICC, eThekwini, lapho kuklonyeliswe khona osomabhizinisi abasafufusa ngokwehlukana kwemikhakha eyisishiyagalolunye abebengenele kuyona. Lo mcimbi, obuqala ukwenziwa kulo nyaka, wandulelwe uhlelo lokwamukela izicelo zabafuna ukuwungenela ekupheleni konyaka odlule, kwase kuqokwa osomabhizinisi abawu-115, okugcine kuqokwe kubona abawu-30, kwahlungwa abanqobile. Ibhizinisi elidle umhlanganiso ngokwehlukana kwemikhakha lihlomule ngo-R100 000, kube wu-R80 000 endaweni yesibili no-R50 000 kwelilale isithathu - okwenziwe ngoxhaso lwe-Standard Bank. Ngaphezu kwalokho bekunendondo eyisipesheli kaMphathiswa wezokuThuthukiswa koMnotho uMfundisi Musa Zondi, ebihambisana nesheke lika-R230 000 konqobile. UNksz Manyoni weMisokuhle Construction uthe ukuhlonishwa kulo mncintiswano kuzoba wusizo kakhulu ukufukula amabhizinisi abo, wathi ujatshuliswe kakhulu wukuthi kwabanqobile kukhona nabesifazane - okuyibona abaseyingcosana emikhakheni yamabhizinisi.UMnuz Morgan Shandu weHollywood Foundation naye uthe kubajabulisile ukuhlonishwa wuMphathiswa woMnyango wokuThuthukiswa koMnotho ngomsebenzi abawenza emphakathini, waqinisekisa nokuthi bazoqhubeka lapho begcine khona ukuthuthukisa nokufukula umphakathi oswele.UZondi uthe lolu hlelo lusezinhlelweni abaqhuba ngazo ikhwelo labo lokufukula osomabhizinisi abasafufusa esifundazweni, abakholwa wukuthi luzoza nomehluko omkhulu nobonakalayo emabhizinisi abo kusukela manje kuya phambili.

KUZOPHELA ukuqagela ngokunyuswa kwentela eyengezwa ezimpahleni ezithengwayo, i-Value Added Tax (VAT), uma uNgqongqoshe wezeziMali, uMnuz Enoch Godongwana, esethula isabelomali, ePhalamende namhlanje.Amaqembu ezepolitiki amaningi, okubalwa kuwo nalawo angaphansi kukahulumeni wokubambisana, asamile ekuphikiseni ukunyuswa kwentela.Lishone elayizolo iKhabhinethi lingakasiphasisi isabelomali sikaGodongwana esiqukethe isiphakamiso sokuba kunyuswe intela.Namhlanje ekuseni kuhlelwe ukuthi kube nomhlangano weKhabhinethi, lapho kuzoxoxwa khona ngesabelomali sikaGodongwana.Ukwethulwa kwesabelomali kwabhuntsha ngemizuzu yokugcina ngenyanga eyedlule ngenxa yakho ukungavumelani ngokunyuswa kwentela.Ngaleso sikhathi kwakunesiphakamiso sokuba intela inyuswe ngo-2%, kuvela ukuthi muva nje kunesiphakamiso sokuthi intela inyuswe ngo-0.75%.Kubukeka uGodongwana engazimisele ngokuhlehla kweyokunyusa intela njengoba ekhala ngokuthi udinga imali engu-R58 billion ukuze agcwalisele lapho kushoda khona.UGodongwana uze wasabisa ngokunqamula isibonelelo sabangasebenzi uma kuwukuthi ayenyuswa intela.Uhulumeni usebenzisa imali engu-R44 billion ngonyaka ukuholela lesi sibonelelo esitholwa abantu abangaphezu kuka-10 million.IHhovisi likaMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa lithe linethemba lokuthi amaqembu abusa ngokubambisana azogcina evumelene.Okhulumela iHhovisi likaMengameli, uMnuz Vincent Magwenya, uthe izingxoxo ziyaqhubeka."Sifisa ukuthi isabelomali sikaGodongwana sesekwe yiwo wonke amaqembu ayingxenye kahulumeni wokubambisana. Kukhona izingxoxo ebezikhona ngempelasonto futhi izingxoxo zizoqhubeka kuze kube uLwesithathu ekuseni. Zikhona iziphakamiso ezikhona kodwa angikwazi ukukhuluma ngazo okwamanje."UNobhala Jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, uthe isabelomali sidinga wonke amaqembu aphethe ngokubambisana ukuba avumelane.UMbalula uveze ukuthi basanda kuhlangana noGodongwana, lapho ebatshele khona ngesiphakamiso esisha esiqukethwe yisabelomali esisha.Iqembu lesibili ngobukhulu kuhulumeni wokubambisana, i-DA, liveze ukuthi akukavunyelwana ngesabelomali, laveza nokuthi lisamile ekutheni alihambisana nokunyuswa kwentela.Namaqembu amakhulu aphikisayo, i-MK ne-EFF, nawo asamile ekutheni awavumelani nokunyuswa kwentela.I-MK ibe nombhikisho ophikisana nokunyuswa kwentela emahhovisi oMnyango kaMgcinimafa, ngoMsombuluko.USotswebhu omkhulu we-MK ePhalamende, uMnuz Mzwanele Manyi, usabise ngokuthi bazokuba nemibhikisho uma igcina inyusiwe intela.Inhlangano elwela abathola izibonelelo zikahulumeni, i-Black Sash, ithe iyaphikisana nokuthi kuvalwe isibonelelo sabangasebenzi. I-Black Sash ithe kunezigidi zabantu ezithembele kulesi sibonelelo esaqala emva kokubheduka kwe-Corona.

UNGQONGQOSHE woMnyango kaMgcinimafa, uMnuz Enoch Godongwana, uzogibela esitikini sengevu yamalungu ePhalamende namuhla ngo-2 ntambama eyokwethula isabelomali sika-2025/26. Uyoma kulesi sikhenke esisapulpiti nje, iningi labantu lifumbethe inhlalisuthi ezandleni lilindele ukuthi uma eke wathi nkente ngokwenyuka kwentela ezidingweni zabantu zansuku zonke, liyamnamatha. Lo mthwalo waqala ukuwuthwala ngokuthi anqume ukungaseneki isitatimende sezinhlelo zemali ngomhla ka-19 Febhuwari kulandela ukungavumelani kwekhabhinethi odabeni lokwenyuswa kwe-VAT.Okwalandela lapho ukuthi amaqembu ezepolitiki asePhalamende ayiphendule inyama yombhubuzo indaba yesabelomali sanonyaka nobani nobani efuna ukuzisikela iqatha elibonakalayo. UGodongwana akakufihlile ukuthi izwe lithwele kanzima, umgodla wakhe eHhovisi likaMgcinimafa awusenabo onsumbulwana abenele ukubhekana nesimo iNingizimu Afrika ekuso.Imisebenzi ayibonwa, umnotho kawugelezi usuze wembatha ithombonkala, nekhona imisebenzi iyaphela, akukho kutshalwa okusha kwemali, isibalo sabantu abathembe ukukhangezwa uhulumeni siya ngokwenyuka. Konke lokhu kuholela endlaleni esikhungethe abantu, abasakazeke izitaladi zamadolobha namadolobhana ngethemba lokuqasheka.Ayisakhulunywa-ke eyezinkinga zokushodelwa yinkece ebhekele izidingo eziyimpoqo ngokoMthethosisekelo njengemfundo, ezempilo, ukulethwa kwamanzi, ukuphakelwa kukagesi, njalonjalo.Konke lokhu kufanele uGodongwana acacise ukuthi uhlela ukukuhlinzekela kanjani, ngayiphi imali. Kumanje vele iminyango eminingi iyahayiza ngokwehliselwa isabelo. Yonke ibheke umlingo ozolethwa yileyo ndoda yesigqoko esimnyama.Olwanamhlanje usuku olusindayo kuGodongwana nasemaqenjini akuhulumeni wokubambisana. Okungazeki ukuthi lo Ngqongqoshe wezeziMali uyothi ehlala phansi, ngemuva kwenkulumo yakhe, ebe ezakhele ugazi noma esephenduke intothoviyane enukela wonke umuntu.
SEKUQUBUKE umsindo wezitshudeni zase-University of South Africa (UNISA) ebezifundela ubuthishela, nobuholi babo. Kubangwa isimemezelo okuthiwa senziwa yinyuvesi sokuthi kunemikhakha yobuthishela ezovalwa, okwenziwe ngokomyalelo woMnyango weMfundo ePhakeme. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi ingeminye yemikhakha osekubonakala ukuthi ngeke isadingeka manje ngenxa yokuguquka kohlelo lokufundisa.Lokho kususe ingebe kwabayizitshuseni zase-UNISA, kuthiwa bangaphezu kuka-3 000 ezweni abazobhekana nengqinamba yokungazi ukuthi benze njani. Kuthiwa uhlelo luzophoqa ukuthi isitshudeni ebesenza lezo zifundo siqhubeke ngendlela engaholela ekutheni kwengezwe unyaka noma emibili ezifundweni zaso ukuze kuhambisane nohlelo olusha, oluzodinga ukuthi izitshudeni zenze izifundo ezidingekayo manje.Esinye sezitshudeni senyuvesi esihlala KwaNongoma, enyakatho yaKwaZulu-Natal, esingathandanga ukuthi kudalulwe igama laso, sikhale ngokuthi uhlelo olwenziwa yinyuvesi luzosiphazamisa ezinhlelweni zaso ngoba bese sisele nesifundo esisodwa andukuba siphothule izifundo zazo. Lokho kusho ukuthi uma silandela imigomo emisha ebekwayo kuzophoqeleka ukuthi sandiselwe ngeminyaka emibili ezifundweni zaso."Lolu hlelo lwabo luzongimoshela isikhathi eside nemali eningi kabi ngoba izindleko zokufunda ngizikhokha ngokwami, okusho ukuthi uma kwengezwa unyaka noma emibili kuzophoqa ukuthi ngibe nemali yokukhokhela izifundo zami zonke abazozengeza. Kuzoshaya kuzwele ephaketheni ngoba isifundo ngasinye sibiza kusuka ku-R2 500 kuya phezulu, imali engibona kahle ukuthi angizukuba nayo nhlobo ngoba sekuyisikhathi eside ngikhokha selokhu ngafika kule nyuvesi ngo-2015. Kufanele ngabe kade ngaqeda kodwa akwenzeki ngenxa yesifundo esisodwa esingaphaseki esenza ngingakwazi ukuphothula izifundo zami, nakhu manje futhi sesitshelwa lenkatha yenkangala,” kusho isitshudeni.Esinye isitshudeni sase-UNISA esidabuka eXobho, ogwini oluseNingizimu yeKwaZulu-Natal, naso esaqala ukufunda ngo-2015 kulesi sikhungo, sithe lesi simo sesenze saba nokhwantalala ngoba asazi ngempela ukuthi kuzomele sithathe ini siyihlanganise nani. Sithi kumanje ayisekho imali yefa likayise ongasekho, ebeyisebenzisa ukuthwala izindleko zokufunda kwaso, njengoba sekunesimo esiphoqa ukuthi sikhiphe enye imali."Sifisa kube khona enye indlela okungenziwa izinto ngayo hhayi ukusiqalisa phansi nokusenzisa ezinye izifundo phezu kwazo zonke lezi ezingaka esesizenzile kuyo yonke leminyaka sifunda. Siphatheke kabi ngesimo esibhekene naso,” kukhononda isitshudeni.Kuthintwa unobhala jikelele wesigungu esiphethe abafundi base-UNISA, uMnuz Aphiwe Dlamini sithe, bayasazi futhi basiqonda ngokuphelele lesi simo esibhekene nezitshudeni, nokho kuncane kakhulu abangakwenza, ukuzama ukulungisa izinto ngendlela izitshudeni ezifisa ngayo.Uthe izitshudeni zatshelwa kusenesikhathi ngalezi zinguquko ezazizokwenziwa yinyuvesi eminyakeni emibili kuya kwemithathu edlule, ziyalelwa wuMnyango weMfundo ePhakeme. Zatshelwa ukuthi kumele zilwele ukuphasa zonke izifundo zazo ukuze kushaye lesi sikhathi umuntu singekho isifundo asalele emuva ngaso uma sekuqala izinguquko."Nokho sizamile ukuxoxisana nenyuvesi ukuthi kuvunyelwe izitshudeni ezingene kulolu gibe ukuthi zivunyelwe ukubhalisela ukuthi zizofunda ngesikweletu. Sekucacile ngempela ukuthi ayikho enye indlela okuzokwenziwa ngayo ukulungisa isimo ngaphandle kokuthi zivume ukuqhubeka zifunde ngendlela okusho inyuvesi ngayo zize ziphothule izifundo zazo bese zikwazi ukuthola izicucu zazo, ziqhubeke nempilo yazo,” kusho uDlamini.Ephuzwini lezitshudeni ezikhala ngokuthi zibanjwe yizifundo ezingakwazi ukuziphasa, uDlamini uthe enye yezinkinga eholela kulokho wukuthi kunenqwaba yamacala ezitshudeni ezabanjwa zikopela, okwenza zihosheleke emuva zingakwazi ukuphothula izifundo zazo ngesikhathi esifanele, njengoba sezilana ezikhona manje."Nokho sesizamile futhi sisaqhubeka sixoxisana nenyuvesi ukuthi kwenziwe izinhlelo zokuhambela lapho izitshudeni zihlala khona ukuthi zifundiswe futhi zilekelelwe kulezo zifundo ezizinika inkinga. Akulula ukuthi zibuthalene ezikhungweni zenyuvesi ngoba eziningi zazo ziyasebenza futhi zinezinto ezahlukene ezizenzayo empilweni. Lokho kwenza kube wumqansa ukuzilekelela lapho ezisalele khona ezifundweni zazo,” usho kanje.Kuthintwa okhulumela i-UNISA uMnuz Tommy Huma, uthe kungamanga ukuthi inyuvesi iphoqa izitshudeni ukuqala phansi izifundo zazo. Wathi kunalokho bazazisile izitshudeni ezisalelwe yizifundo emikhakheni eziyenzayo ukuthi kuzomele zenze kanjani ukuqhubekela ohlelweni lwemikhakha emisha ehambisana nezifundo zazo, ziqedele kuyona izifundo ezisele."Okunye esifuna kucace bha, wukuthi izitshudeni zethu sazasisa ngalolu hlelo ngo-2018 senzela ukuthi zibe nethuba elanele lokubhalisela izinhlelo ezintsha zokufunda eziqale ngo-2019. Besihlale sivule izandla ukuzilekelela kunoma yini eziba nenkinga kuyona, futhi namanje iminyango yethu isavuliwe ukulekelela abadinga usizo,” kusho uHuma.
LUSEZITHEBENI zamaphoyisa udaba lomfundi waseZakhe High School, KwaMashu, owatholwa 'ezilengisile' esehlweni esenzeka mhla ka-28 Febhuwari 28 ebuya esikoleni. Ngemuva kokungcwatshwa kuka-Amahle Langa (15) ngempelasonto, kuvumbuke izinkulumo eziningi ezishayisanayo nalokho okushiwo umndeni wakhe. Abaningi, okubalwa nabasesikoleni abefunda kuso nomakhelwane, bamangele sebezwa emuva kwendaba ukuthi u-Amahle ufihlwe ngoMgqibelo. Kodwa umndeni uthi bayikhaya eliswele, ngakho ukumfihla bakwenze ngalokho okuncane abebenakho.U-Amahle owaKwa-M KwaMashu, lapho ebehlala khona noninakhulu nezinye izihlobo. Umthombo okhulume neSolezwe uthe lo mfundi ushiye incwadi ebinezigaba ezimbili - kwesinye encoma indlela enhle uninakhulu amkhulise ngayo, kwesinye eveza indlela abengaphathekile kahle ngayo ezandleni zezihlobo ezithile. Kuthiwa abangani bale ntombazane yibona ababhoboze ithumba ngokuholele ekutheni ithathe isinqumo sokuzibulala. Kuvele nokukhuluma okuthi ingane ibisizithwele.Ukhuluma neSolezwe, umthombo uveze ukuthi kuthiwa ingane ibikhala ngokuhlukumezeka kwayo. Kuvela ukuthi unina akahlali ekhaya kodwa ukhona eThekwini."Ngisho esikoleni sakhe abatshelwanga ukuthi ingane ifihlwa nini. Okunye okwenzekile ukuthi ngalo usuku lokufihla ingane babetshele nomakhelwane ukuthi ngeke ifihlwe kule mpelasonto esisuka kuyo, bebengafuni kwaziwe," kusho umthombo. Uqhuba umthombo uthe: "Isiphethe kabi indaba yengane, sifuna ubulungiswa ngalesi sigameko, uNgqogqoshe wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi nezeNhlalakahle akangenelele, kanjalo namaphoyisa sifuna nawo aphenye kabanzi ngale ndaba.”Kuvele nokuthi omunye womakhelwane owafika kuqala ngesikhathi kuzwakala isidumo wakwazi ukuyishutha incwadi ingane eyayibhalile. Yilo makhelwane othi manje sekuvezwa isigaba sencwadi esisodwa kuphela esibonga uninakhulu. Ayisekho ingxenye lapho ibalise ngenhlalo engeyinhle yokunukubezwa ngokocansi.Ethintwa uNkk Cynthia Zide, onguninakhulu kamufi abehlala naye, uthe ziyamthusa izindaba esezishiwo ngokuhlukumezeka kwengane.Uthe ngokubona kwakhe ingane ithathe isinqumo esinjenganalesi ngoba unina uke wafika ngoDisemba efuna ukuhamba nayo kanti ayithandi yona."Amanga abantu lawa ashiwoyo, incwadi ikhona impela kodwa akukho lapho iveza khona ukuthi umntwana ubehlukunyezwa. Into ebiyenzeka ubethethiswa njengezinye izingane ekhaya. Nami bengihlala ngimthusa ngokuthi uma eseqalile ukulala nabafana ngiyombona, ubehlala egeza phambi kwami futhi ngingaboni lutho olubi,” kusho yena.UNkk Zide uthe ukube bekukhona ukukhulelwa kwengane okukhulunywa ngakho, odokotela basemakhazeni bebezokuveza.Uthe ekhaya baphila ngempesheni, ngakho isimo besisibi bezama izindlela zokufihla umzukulu wabo benomyeni wakhe.Iphoyisa elingagunyaziwe ukukhuluma nabezindaba eNtuzuma, likuqinisekisile ukuthi kukhona udaba oluphenywayo ngokuzilengisa kwale ntombazane.Okhulumela amaphoyisa Kwazulu-Natal, uCaptain Ntathu Ndlovu, uthe kuphenywa isigameko sokuzibulala kwale ntombazane eneminyaka engu-15, yatholakala izihengile.Okwamanje uthe baphenya isizathu esaholela kulokhu.
UMHOLI weMK, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, uthi kuyokube bafulathelwe yidlozi uma bengahlulwa okhethweni oluzayo ekubeni sebesebenzisana neqembu, i-ATM.UZuma uthe ukusebenzisana kwabo ne-ATM kumnikeza ithemba lokuthi bazolunqoba ukhetho oluzayo.Ukusho lokhu ngempelasonto ngesikhathi ekhuluma enkonzweni yebandla, iTwelve Apostles Church in Christ, ebisenkundleni iSugar Ray, eThekwini.Ngeledlule iMK ne-ATM basayine isivumelwano sokusebenzisana ePhalamende, nakuzo zonke izinhlelo ezithinta umphakathi. La maqembu asaxoxa eyokuthi azolungenela kanjani ukhetho lohulumeni basekhaya lwangonyaka ozayo.UZuma uchaze isivumelwano sokusebenzisana kwamaqembu njengengqophamlando, wathi lesi sivumelwano senza abone sengathi bazolunqoba ukhetho oluzayo."Uma uthatha lo mhlangano ebesinawo ngoLwesithathu, kusho ukuthi sesingqongqoza emnyango wenkululeko, sesifikile. Uma singakwazi ukuthatha ukhetho oluzayo kuyokusho ukuthi ngempela ngempela sifulathelwe abadala, sifulathelwe yizingelosi."UZuma uthe kubalulekile ukuthi abantu abamnyama bavote ndawonye okhethweni oluzayo. Unxuse abezenkolo nabamaqembu ezepolitiki ehlukene ukuba bavotele iqembu elilodwa okhethweni oluzayo."Wonke umuntu omnyama, uma umnyama nje uyahlupheka. Noma ungathi awuhlupheki, udukile ngoba sonke siyahlupheka. Umsebenzi wethu engicabanga ukuthi usimele manje ukuthi kusukela manje kufanele sikhulume nabo bonke abantu abamnyama. Noma ngabe bayakholwa noma abakholwa, noma ngabe baphethe amaqembu ezepolitiki, sonke thina bantu abamnyama kufanele sivotele iqembu elilodwa lezepolitiki."Uma kukhona abafuna ukubuyela emaqenjini abo emva kokhetho, ayikho inkinga bangabuyela ngoba siyokube sesilunqobile ukhetho. Lokhu kuyokwenza ukuthi sikwazi ukushintsha izwe. Sikwazi ukushintsha imithetho. Kubuhlungu ukuthi thina bantu abamnyama, esiyimsinsi yokuzimilela, siphethwe imithetho okungeyona eyethu."Umholi we-ATM, uMnuz Vuyo Zungula, uthe abantu abamnyama bacindezelekile eNingizimu Afrika.UZungula uncome isinqumo sikaZuma sokungathathi umhlalaphansi ngesikhathi ekhishwa kwesokuba umengameli ngo-2018."Omengameli abaningi uma sebephumile ezikhundleni bayaye bathathe umhlalaphansi, bazitike ngemihlomulo abayithola kuhulumeni. Uwe wedwa omile osukumile, wathi ayilungile le nto eyenzekayo ebantwini abamnyama. Abantu abacabangela abanye abantu, bazabalaza baze bayofa. Abanye abantu uma nje beke bathola imihlomulo yabo, basuke sebeqedile."
KUPHUME izidumbu ezintathu eMaoti, eNanda, izolo ngenkathi umphakathi uvuke umbhejazane ufuna kuboshwe izigebengu ezibamba inkunzi zidubule abantu udede. Kuvele ukuthi yingalesi sikhathi lapho kube nokuqhuma kwesibhamu kwalala abathathu. Kusolwa ukuthi abeqembu lemigulukudu abadumise izulu lezandla.NgeSonto kubulawe owesilisa oneminyaka engu-18, obulawe amalungu omphakathi kade kufunwa ezinye izigebengu. Isehlakalo sokubulawa kwaleli bhungu silame esokudutshulwa kwabathathu ngoMgqibelo ebusuku abafele emqashweni osendaweni.UMnuz Zoli Zimba, osenhlanganweni uMkhumbi kaNowa elwa nobugebengu, uveze ukuthi uNgqongqoshe wezamaPhoyisa kuzwelonke uMnuz Senzo Mchunu kumele angenelele kule ndaba.Ekhuluma neSolezwe uthe, izigebengu yizona esezibulale laba besilisa abathathu abashonile izolo."Izigebengu azisazi nokuthi siyini. Kumanje siyabhikisha silwa nale nto eziyenzayo kodwa zona zikhetha ukuthi zidubule zibhekise kithi. Sicela ungqongqoshe afike emphakathini azozwa ukuthi sikhala ngani. Izidakamizwa yizona ezisibeke la sikhona manje. Impi lena eqale ngalaba bantu abadayisa iwunga bebelwa bodwa, nokuthe ngokuhamba kwesikhathi baqala babamba inkunzi badubule abantu. Usuku nosuku kule ndawo kuphuma isidumbu esisodwa noma ezimbili. Akuyona impilo lena esiyiphilayo sicela usizo,” kuchaza uZimba.Uveze ukuthi okunye okubenza bangafuni lolu daba lubhekwe isifundazwe ukuthi amaphoyisa anawo amagama ezigebengu kodwa awazenzi lutho."Emaphoyiseni izigebengu ziyaziwa kodwa azenziwa lutho. Sicela amasosha kube yiwona afikayo la azolungisa lesi simo, ngoba sesiphumile kudala esandleni ukube indaba lena yasukunyelwa ekuqaleni ngabe asikho kulesi simo,” kuchaza yena.UMnuz Sam Mfeka, obekhuluma nezindaba zakwa-SABC, uveze ukuthi okubakhathaza kakhulu ukuthi uma bengumphakathi bezilwela amaphoyisa afike abophe bona."Amaphoyisa awazibophi izigebengu njengoba zaziwa kodwa uma sesizilungisela thina, kuboshwa thina. Iyakhathaza impilo esiyiphila lana sicela usizo njengoba sesisaba,” kuchaza yena.Kuze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela amaphoyisa engatholakali ukuba aphawule ngalolu daba.
USUTHEMBISE ukuthi uzosebenzisana nebandla labaPhostoli eligubuzelwe yifu elimnyama uMnyango wezokuThutha KwaZulu Natal.Lokhu kulandela ukuthi abazalwane baleli bandla abangu-9 bedlule emhlabeni engozini enyantisa igazi eyenzeke emgwaqweni uN2 phakathi kwaseMandeni naKwaDukuza enyakatho yesifundazwe iKwaZulu-Natal.Amalungu aleli bandla kuvela ukuthi abehamba ngebhasi eligingqikile. Abephuma enkonzweni enkulu yaleli bandla ebiseClermont entshonalanga yeTheku ngeSonto futhi ebihanjelwe nayilowo owayegumengameli wezwe, uJacob Zuma.Esitatimendeni esikhishwe umnyango uthembise ukuthi uzoxhumana uphinde usebenzisane kakhulu nebandla labaPhostoli kulesi sikhathi esinzima ibandla elibhekene naso.Umnyango uphinde wathembisa ukuthi uzoxhumana nemindeni ethintekayo kulesi sehlakalo.''Sizimisele ngokuthi senze konke okusemandleni ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abadlule emhlabeni banikezwa umngcwabo obafanele nosezingeni eliphezulu,'' kusho isitatimende.Siqhuba sithe uMnyango ukhulekela ukuthi uNkulunkulu abe nabo abadlulile abageze amanxeba abasele abaduduze.OnguNgqongqoshe wezokuThutha KwaZulu Natal, uMnuz Siboniso Duma izolo bekulindeleke ukuthi ahambele kule ndawo.Izinhlaka ezahlukene ezibandakanya ababhekele isiminyaminya sasemgwaqweni, ababhekele ezomlilo nezimo eziphuthumayo eMandeni basebenze ngokuzikhandla endaweni yesigameko.Ngokusho koMnyango wezokuThutha uyakuqonda ukuthi lesi yisimo esinzima kakhulu ebandleni labaPhostoli KwaZulu-Natal kanjalo naseNingizimu Afrika yonkana.
BAFUNA ligaye ngomunye umhlathi okhethweni lukazwelonke lwango-2029, njengoba befuna abavoti bayeke ukuqiqinga omazisi uma beyovota kodwa bafike basebenzise omazisi abakomakhalekhukhwini.Lezi ngezinye zezinhlelo zoMnyango wezaseKhaya njengoba nasokhethweni lohulumeni basekhaya olungonyaka ozayo, uhlele ukuthi inqwaba yabavoti ibe isisebenzisa ama-smart ID, kunokuasebenzisa omazisi abadala.Lokhu kushiwo nguNgqongqoshe wezaseKhaya uMnuz Leon Schreiber, ngesikhathi ekhuluma engqungqutheleni yezinsuku ezintathu yeKhomishini yezoKhetho kuleli, yokubheka eyokuvota kusetshenziswa ubuchwepheshe eKapa.Kule ngqungquthela kunxuswe umphakathi ukuthi uqale ingxoxo mayelana nokuvota kusetshenziswa ubuchwepheshe.USchreiber uthe kudingeka kube nezinguquko ohlelweni lokuvota kuleli."Uma sikhuluma ngezinguquko nokuthi kube nomazisi komakhalekhukhwini, sihlose ukuhambisana nesikhathi. Yingakho sifuqa umkhankaso wokuthi iningi labavoti libe selisebenzisa ama-smart ID okhethweni lwangonyaka ozayo. Ngo-2029 sihlose ukuthi kube sekusetshenziswa omazisi abakomakhalekhukhwini," usho kanje.Ukhale ngemishini ye-IEC eyagoloza ukusebenza okhethweni lwangonyaka odlule."Ngesikhathi kubhaliswa abavoti yonke into yayihamba kahle kodwa ngomzuzu wokugcina yahluleka ukwenza umsebenzi, Ngazibonela ezikhungweni kusetshenziswa amapeni namaphepha ngoba le mishini ingasasebenzi."UMnuz Sy Mamabolo isikhulu esiphezulu se-IEC, uthe lungahamba kahle uhlelo lokuvota ngobuchwepheshe uma wonke umuntu engakwazi ukuba ne-internet.Uthe abantu basemakhaya basabhekene nengwadla yokungabinazo izinsiza."Ezinye zezingxenye zezwe zisabhekene nenkinga yokuthi izinto ezifana ne-internet ziseyivela kancane. Kuba nenkinga yokuxhumana ekubeni uma sifuna lolu hlelo luphumelele kudingeka i-internet."Ubalule nokuthi buhle ubuchwepheshe kodwa kunenkinga yokuthi kukhona abavele bangene bathathe imininingwane yabantu."Kumele sikubeke kucace ukuthi asikho isinqumo esisathathiwe mayelana nokuthi kuvotwe ngobuchwepheshe. Yinto esizoyiphakamisa ePhalamende ukuthi ibhekwe." Uthe iningi intsha ethokozela ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe besimanje.Uveze ukuthi amanye amazwe aluzama uhlelo lokuvota ngobuchwepheshe kodwa agcina elulaxazile lolu hlelo.UMnuz Masego Sheburi iphini lesikhulu seKhomishini, uthe bahlale bebheka izindlela zokwenza uhlelo lokuvota lube lula.Uthe iphepha loluvota landa njalo uma kunokhetho ngenxa yabantu abasuke befuna ukuvotelwa.Okhethweni lwanyakenye i-IEC yagaya amaphepha okuvota angu-90 million, kanti uhlu lwalulude lwababevotelwa njengoba kukhona ababengenele ukhetho ngokuzimela. Umbiko weHuman Sciences Research Council (HSRC), othulwe kule ngqungquthela uveze ukuthi uma umphakathi ungaluthembi uhlelo lokuvota olukhona, kuzobanzima ukuthi weseke uhlelo lokuvota kusetshenziswa ubuchwepheshe.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi iqembu Umkhonto weSizwe, lakhala ngemiphumela yokhetho.Leli qembu lakhala ngokuthi lirojiwe laze laya enkantolo lifuna kuqale phansi kubalwe amavoti.
KULE mpelasonto esisuka kuyo besinomhlangano wabasebenzi bezempilo, ikakhulu bekungodokotela, ososayensi bezokudla, abahlengikazi, nezinye izinhla ezehlukene.Bekunoxhaxha lwezikhulumi zishiyelana inkundla eminxeni eyahlukene. Bonke bejikeleza emzimbeni wakho. Akekho noyedwa kulezi zikhulumi oke wangena wajula embangeleni yezifo ezihlasela imizimba yethu. Akekho noyedwa oke wakhuluma ngokudla okungena emzimbeni kunyakazise zonke izindawo,ezisemzimbeni.Wonke umuntu ukhuluma ngemishanguzo ekhona nezayo. Kukhulunywa ngobuchwepheshe obusha osebukhona. Ngiye ngathi ngihlezi ngibukela, benginesiqiniseko sokuthi abantu abenza le mishanguzo bayajabula bayatshakadula bebona umsebenzi abawuhlalela phansi bawubopha ukuthi cha izinto zihamba ngononina kuwona.Kuyamangalisa, empeleni kubuhlungu ukubuka abantu bakithi bekhuluma begcizelela beqhakambisa izinto ezilokhu ziqhubekile ziqinisekisa ukuthi imingcwabo ilokhu iqhubekile. Iqiniso lithi izifo lezi esafunzwa kwathiwa ngondalashe, amahlalakhona, ngosifanaye, iningi lazo liyelapheka liphele.Lapha ngikhuluma ngesifo sikashukela, lapha esichazwe njengesizolokhu siqhubekile sibulala, sivala amehlo, sidala izilonda ezinukayo, sidala amakhanda angapheli, umqondo ophundulekile, umzimba nomlomo onephunga, ukungabatholi abantwana, sibulala izinso, isikhumba sabantu bakithi siyashintsha sibe maholoholo, ngingabala ngifikephi? Ngikhuluma ngesifo somfutho wegazi ophezulu, isifo senhliziyo, ziningi lezi zifo!Akekho noyedwa omayo athi lezi zifo zidalwa ukudla esikudlayo, zidalwa ukungalali ngendlela efanele. Akekho ogcizelele ubungozi bukashukela i-fructose okuyiyona eyenza ubumnandi obuwuswidi. Akaze abe khona!Ngifisa ukuphinda ngigcizelele ngithi isifo esihamba phambili ekubulaleni abantu bakithi isifo sikashukela, kuhlanganisa nazo zonke izifo ezihambisana naso - okungaba umfutho wegazi ophezulu, isifo sohlangothi (stroke) nezinso ezingasasebenzi. Abantu bakithi abangcwatshwayo mihla le, imbangela yalokho yilezi zifo. Ngeke ngibashiye abantu abashona ngenxa yomdlavuza. Ukugcina kwami ngibona izibalo zazithi babalelwa ku-2000 abantu abashonayo ngosuku ngenxa yomdlavuza uwodwa.Iyini imbangela yokufa okungaka? Impendulo, ukudla esikudlayo okusiqedayo. Yingakho sikhuluma singesabi ukuthi:1. Ukudla kwasekuseni, kuwushevu ngokudlulele. Hlukana nako. Bamba isifociya uze uqale ukudla ngehora lesithathu ntambama. Isizathu salokhu? Isikhathi esiningi uma sidla ukudla kwasekuseni, kuba ukudla kwayizolo, izinkwa, ambhanisi, ama-cereals, amagwinya, amakhekhe, itiye okanye ikhofi elinoshukela okanye uju, ama-chips, njalonjalo. Abantu abaningi bazitika ngalokhu kudla ekuseni.Lokhu kudla kwenyusa ikhemikhali i-glucose egazini. Ukwenyuka kwe-glucose kusho ukukhiqizwa kwe-insulin ezoqoqa le glucose iyovalelwa kwandawo noma kkhiqizeke amafutha ezicutshini zomzimba nasesibindini. Yila mafutha adala isibindi sibe nesifo soqilima lwamafutha agcina edale izifo eziyisishiyagalombili. Lezi zifo zihlakazeka umzimba wonke zidale izinhlobonhlobo zezifo, okukhona kuzo nesifo somdlavuza.Njengoba sibona asikhulumi ngoshevu owenziwa yi-fructose emzimbeni namafutha adalwa yiyona esibindini. Imizimba yethu ikhathala kangaka nje yilo shukela owuswidi okuthiwa yi-fructose ebulala i-mitochondria eyinjini yamandla omzimba.2. Asehlukane nokudla sekushaye ihora lesikhombisa. Umzimba uyaphumula emuva kwaleli hora. Konke okudlayo kuzodala amafutha esibindini bese kudaleka izifo.3. Asehlukane nokuxubha ngomuthi lona othengwayo, asisebenzise umlotha wezinkuni kuphela uma sikolobha umlomo namazinyo.4. Asizifundise ukulala amahora ayisishiyagalombili zonke izinsuku, singasishintshi isikhathi sokulala sansuku zonke.5. Kuhle ukuthamela isigcaki ilanga liphuma zonke izinsuku, imizuzu engu-30.6. Asihambahambe ihora nemizuzu engu-30 zonke izinsuku endaweni evulekile.7. Kubalekele ukugqolozela ithelevishini nokuhlala ubuka umakhalekhukhwini.8. Isifo sikashukela sihamba phambili ngokubulala, uma kungukuthi bese ususijovela yiya kudokotela wakho ucele okungenani ukusebenzisa okunye. Umjovo kashukela ushevu omkhulu, uyakuqedela, udale nomdlavuza.9. Zifundise ukupha nokuxolela, kokubili kuzokuphilisa kangcono10. Hlukana nokudla ushukela nokudla okunoshukela, ngisho ngabe owahlobo luni. Khumbula ukuthi ushukela ubizwa ngamagama angaphezu kwangu-50.Mpilonde!

ZIYETHEMBISA izingxoxo phakathi koMbuso nohlangothi olumele uMnuz Lungani Mthethwa (39) othweswe uMbuso icala lokubulala amantombazane amabili eKenville, eThekwini, ngonyaka owedlule.Ukuthembisa kwezingxoxo phakathi kwalezi zinhlangothi kudalulwe omele uMbuso, uSenior State Advocate Krishen Shah ngesikhathi uMthethwa evele eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini.Usolwa ngokudubula abulale abangani ababili uNksz Anele Mbokazi (29) noNksz Zizipho Gabisa (30). Abafi batholwa emgwaqweni waseKenville, eThekwini ngo-Agasti 25.Kwathi ngakusasa amaphoyisa ase ebopha abasolwa eSouth Beach emva kokulandela umkhondo kusetshenziswa iselula kaNksz Mbokazi. UShah usukume enkantolo watshela ijaji ukuthi sezifinyelela kuvuthondaba izingxoxo phakathi kwalezi zinhlangothi zombili.Uthe ngokuzayo icala okungenani liyohlala isikhathi esiyimizuzu engamashumi ayisithupha ebese kuyagoqwa konke okuhlangenwe ngakho kuleli cala. Ekuqaleni uMthethwa wayekade eboshwe nomngani wakhe, uMnuz Sandile Chili (44) owagcina esechakida umngani wakhe ephenduka ufakazi woMbuso ngampela kwamlungela wawelela ngaphesheya.UMthethwa phambilini kwahlaluka ukuthi wayephila impilo ewubukhazikhazi egabisa ngomcebo wakhe nasezinkundleni zokuxhumana. Kwahlaluka ukuthi imali eningi uyenza ngokuhweba enkundleni i-Forex.Nayizolo izihlobo zabafi bezikhona enkantolo zizozibonela konke obekwenzeka.Phambilini imindeni yabafi yake yasola imizamo yokubambezela icala kubasolwa njengoba kwakungacaci ngommeli omele uMthethwa.Lokhu kwenzeka ngesikhathi ummeli uNksz Sibongile Khanyile, evela enkantolo ethi uthunywe nguMnuz Nyameka Jondwana ukuba azomela ikhasimende lakhe esho uMthethwa.Ngaphambilini enkantolo kwakhe kwavela izindaba ezishaqisayo zokuthi nakuba engaphakathi esitokisini uMthethwa kodwa ikhadi lakhe lasebhange liyaqhubeka nokusebenza.Lokhu kwavezwa yiMantshi u-Ashwin Singh. Ngesikhathi leli cala lisesigabeni sokuba senkantolo yeMantshi umphakathi ubujwayele ukufika ubhikishe ngaphandle uphethe izingqwembe ezinemibhalo eyehlukene.USihlalo we-ANCWL eThekwini uNksz Gugu Sibiya waze wenza isibophezelo sokuthi bazoyeseka kuze kube yisekugcineni imindeni yabafi yomibili. UMthethwa ungene enkantolo eshaye ihembe likanokusho njengenjwayelo. Ungene ebhokisini wabheka phansi wabuye waqalaza ngemuva.
UBHEKENE nengwadla uhulumeni wakuleli, okudingeka uthathe izinqumo ezinzima ngezinhlelo okumele uqhubeke uzixhase, nalezo okumele uzilaxaze. Lokhu kungenxa yezinkinga zokuthi udinga ukuthola imali yokuxhasa izinhlelo ezibalulekile ngaphandle kokunyusa i-VAT.Lokhu kushiwo nguMnuz Mmusi Maimame, usihlalo wekomiti i-Appropriations ePhalamende, oluleke uhulumeni ukuthi uthathe izinqumo ezibuhlungu futhi ezinzima.UMaimane uthe uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa kumele atshengise ukuba ngumholi ngalesi sikhathi, ngokuthi benohulumeni wakhe bazibuze imibuzo enzima.Wathi kodwa ebalulekile ngethi yiziphi izinto okumele baziyeke ukuzixhasa ukuze izwe lingacwili kakhulu ezikweletini?"Kumele bazibuze ukuthi kumele yini kuqhutshekwe nokukhokhwa kwesibonelelo sabangasebenzi, noma sivalwe? Uma kuqhutshekwa naso, uhulumeni uzokwazi yini ukuhlangabezana nomyalelo wenkantolo wokuthi sinyuswe lesi sabelo siphinde sifinyelele ebantwini abaningi," kusho uMaimane.Uthe eminye yemibuzo ngukuthi kufakwe imali embuthweni wokuvikela ukuze amasosha ayolwa impi e-DRC, noma kufakwe imali empini yokulwa ne-HIV kulandela ukuhoxiswa koxhaso lwezempilo lokulwa naleli gciwane, okwenziwe yizwe iMelika."Yingakho sithi kumele kuvunyelwane ngokuthi yiziphi izinhlelo ezizoxhaswa, nalezo ezingeke zisaxhaswa. Uma ungumholi ngeke wanelise wonke umuntu, ekubeni nemali ingekho ezweni kuphilwa ngokuboleka imali nesikweletu esikhulu," kusho uMaimane, othe basilinde ngabomvu isabelomali esizothulwa kusasa ePhalamende kulandela ukuhlehliswa kwaso ngenyanga edlule.Ukusho lokhu izolo ngesikhathi amakomiti abhekele imali ePhalamende, ekhuluma nabezindaba ngezinhlelo zawo kanjalo nangesabelomali okumele sithulwe nguNgqongqoshe wezeziMali, uMnuz Enoch Godongwana ePhalamende, eKapa.Lesi sabelo sahlehliswa kulandela ukungavumelani ngokunyuswa kwentela i-VAT ngo-2%, kukhalwa ngokuthi kuzoshayeka abahlwempu.Usihlalo wekomiti elibhekele ukusebenza kwezimali zomphakathi ePhalamende i-Scopa, uMnuz Songezo Zibi, ukhale ngokuxhashazwa kwemali ezweni nokunyuka kwesikweletu sikahulumeni.Uthe izwe likhokhela isikwetu uR30 kuya kuR32 billion ngenyanga njengoba sizofinyelela kuR1.7 trillion."Ngosuku lesi sikweletu sikhokhelwa u-R1.2 billion, okuyimali enkulu. Iyaxhashazwa imali kuleli, kukhokhelwa amahhovisi kahulumeni imali enkulu. Imali isetshenziselwa ukukhokhela amaholo abasebenzi kunokuthi kwakhiwe izibhedlela," usho kanje.Uveze ukuthi imali yesikweletu kusele kancane ukuthi idlule imali yezinhlelo ezibalulekile ezifana nezemfundo, ezempilo kanjalo nezibonelelo."Uhulumeni uzogcina esechitha imali enkulu ekukhokheleni isikweletu, kunokuthi afake imali ezinhlelweni zezemfundo, kwezempilo noma kwizibonelelo. Akukuhle uma izwe selizophila ngokuthi likhokhe izikweletu kunokuthi lenze izinhlelo ezibhekele emphakathini." UZibi uthe uma kunyuswa i-VAT akumele inyuselwe ukukhokhela izikweletu engabe kwenziwa izinhlelo ezizotakula abantu.UMaimane uthe uhulumeni ubhekene nesimo senhlekelele ezweni ngenxa yokuthi ayikho enye indlela ongayenza kulesi simo samanje sezomnotho."Izwe liphasisa imithetho engeke lisakwazi ukufaka imali kuyona. Uma kuphasiswa eyokunyuswa kwesibalo sabenza i-ECD, izoqhamukaphi imali yokwenza lokhu? Izwe ligcina seliphasisa izinhlelo ezizokwenza ukuthi zingaxhaseki," kuchaza uMaimane.Usihlalo wekomiti lezi zimali uDkt Joseph Maswanganyi, uthe uMnyango kaMgcinimafa kumele uqhamuke nezinhlelo zokwehlisa isikweletu sezwe esiphezulu.

KUNEZINTO eziba yisisekelo esihle kumuntu ofuna ukukwazi ukuba ngumuntu phakathi kwabantu kuyo yonke inhlobo yezimo. Angiqale ngokuveza ukuthi lokhu ngakufunda kugogo wami owangikhulisa, okwakuthi akakudle akufele uma uyingane enomkhuba wokucela into ngenxa yokuba nenhliziyo engaphandle. Le ntokazi yaseMaNgadini, ezala umama, yayikholelwa kakhulu ekutheni ukuze uphile kumele ukusebenzele lokho, ungajabuleli ukuphiwa. Futhi wayethi kwehlisa isithunzi ukucela ukudla. Ngikhule-ke emakhaya lapho amanzi ekhiwa emfuleni. Wayengavumi ugogo ukuthi ufike usuthela amanzi ugeze kodwa ungawakhanga. Kule ndawo sasibasa phansi ukuze kuphekwe, kuphilwa ngokulima amasimu nezingadi. Izinkuni zazilandwa kude le ehlanzeni, ukuze kulungiselelwe ukupheka. Laphaya kwakuboshelwa izinkabi ngovivi, kuphume isipani siyolima ekuthwaseni kwehlobo, kutshalwe wena mmbila, wena mabele, izindlubu, imbumba, izintanga, amabhece, okuyothi sekuvunwa kuswelakale indawo yokukubeka ngenxa yokugcwala kwezinqolobane. Amagceke nophahla lwezindlu kwakuqaqelwe amathanga, ogubungu, ojeleza, wena bhatata, kunjeyaya.Nalapho sekungena ikwindla, amabombo ayebhekiswa ezingadini ezazilinywa eduze kwamaxhaphozi sekutshalwa izivande zamaklabishi, otamatisi, amashaladi, izipinashi nokunye okuningi okuhlobene nakho. Yonke le nto, eyabe isuke ilungiselwa ukuba kudliwe, abantu bangabhekani nendlala, yayisetshenzelwa ngezandla futhi kungekho ukuthi kukhona uhulumeni ozofika azokufunza.Ngithini? Sikhalakathele esiseleni esibana sokuba yisizukulwane sokukhangezwa. Sonke, singene shi, siphila emangeni okuthi sizovuka kusasa izwe selingcono. Ngamlingo thizeni. Size sidemelayise kade silalele inkulumo kaMengameli esikhulumela ilumbo elithi uhulumeni uzoqeda indlala. Inkinga ngenkemane ukuthi iyisimo samanje sokuthi uzolala ungadlile nje kwaphela. Manje-ke inkulumo yezethembiso nesabelomali izokuletha kanjani ukudla kwanamuhla kusihlwa?Sizongenza emlandweni njengesizukulwane sabantu abayimikhovu kamagenda wepolitiki, abagijima baze babhashe bethenjiswa ukuthi bazovulelwa amathuba okuqala amabhizinisi, ekugcineni benze umsebenzi wokufukula imindeni embalwa bona ezabo izingane zisale zincela izithupha.Kuyisici esibi kithi esiphila kule mihla ukuthi sidinelwe iMelika ehoxise izimpothulo ebisikhangeza zona iminyakanyaka. Yonke le minyaka sicabanga ukuthi kukhona esikwenzayo kanti singojabulakuphakwa beMelika? Singamsola nje uMnuz Donald Trump uma sithanda, uyeke into ebiyenziwa ngokuthanda kweMelika, uma nayo isibhekene nendlala ayikwazi ukondla kweminye imizi.Kumele sizibuke thina, sibuze nakubaholi bethu ukuthi basenza omakhangezwa isikhathi eside kangaka ngoba kwenzenjani? Sengiyabona. Yile nto-ke ugogo wami ayeyibalekela - ukuthi uvame ukuphiwa uze ubabale ukhohlwe ukuthi uzenzele wena. Yingakho-ke amazwe aseNtshonalanga esibiza njengezimaku zawo ukuba sizochaza ukuthi siphethe kanjani emazweni ethu. Usho njalo phela uhulumeni wakithi - wathi usazoya eWhite House uyocacisa ngomthetho we-Expropriation Act.Ngiyiklume, ngiyavuma, kulezi zindaba zombusazwe wamazwe. Futhi angisophinde ngavuthwa ngoba namadolo aseqinile vele. Yingakho-ke ngingangeni kokuningi. Ngihleli lapha ekutheni isitha esikhulu somuntu yindlala, ngaleyo ndlela thina bantu nobuholi bethu asikhuthaze ukuzenzela, sandise ukudla kwezingane zethu ngaphambi kokuhalazelela ukunotha ngokuhweba ngalokho kudla.Okwamanje impilo yethu ingamanga. Umsebenzi kahulumeni, uma kunje, ukuvikela ukudla okukhiqizwa ezweni ngokuthi welekelele abantu basebenzise izandla enhlabathini. Lokho kuzoyimisa indlala, bese kuqhutshekwa-ke namanga amandla omnotho ngoba vele leyo sekwaba yimpilo.Le mali yesibonelelo ekhangezwa abantu kayithi shu. Abazali abaningi bayakhala ngo-R350 (ngiyazi isingaphezulu kodwa isabizwa kanjalo) ngoba entsheni ngelanga okungena ngalo le mali amathaveni nezipoti kuduma kuze kuse. Ngisho ishibhi elihlale livaliwe, liyavulwa ngezinsuku zokuphuma kwemali yesibonelelo. Angethi inganekwane, ngisho into ekhulunywa omama bezikhalela ngokubola kwesimo emakhaya.Kusho ukuthi nalabo R350 bangamanga afana nomanyolo wokwandisa ububha. Ngelinye ilanga uhulumeni iyomphelela le mali, kuyosuka umbhedukazwe abantu begwamanda le mali. Ingasekho. Ivele isiyaphela njengoba sekunconzulwa esabelweni sezingane kwezemfundo nesemithi kwezempilo. Kufanele-ke njengezwe sinqume ukuthi siyaqhubeka namanga empilo, lapho sethembisa abantu ubukhazikhazi bamahhala obusatalagu, noma sakha isizwe esenqaba ukuphendulwa okhangezile.Ngiyazi ukuthi lokhu engikushoyo akubavuni osopolitiki abasakhafula uhubhu lukabhejane namanje bethi bazoletha ushintsho ekubeni iqiniso lithi kufanele bayokhongozela kobasi bethu eMelika, emaNgisini, eChina naseRussia ukuze bafihle amanga. Ngelinye ilanga siyophaphama sesigqibeka ethuneni lobubha obunganqamuleki nasezizukulwaneni ezizayo. Lapho la mazwe asenza ibhola lomnqakiswano ayobe egigitheka njengoQalo noBilo basendulo.
INDODA eneminyaka engu-54 ubudala, igwetshwe odilikajele ababili yiNkantolo yesiFunda yaseMount Fletcher, ngokudlwengula amadodakazi ayo angamawele izikhathi eziningi esikhathini esingaphezu kweminyaka eyishumi.Inkantolo iphinde yagweba umsolwa iminyaka emihlanu emacaleni amabili okunukubeza ngokocansi. Igama lakhe ngeke ligagulwe ukuze kuvikelwe abagilwa. Elinye lamawele likhubazekile ngokomqondo.Inkantolo izwe ukuthi unina wabagilwa washona ngo-2011, amantombazane amabili, ngaleso sikhathi ayeneminyaka engu-11 ubudala, ahlala noyise ekhaya. Uqale ngokubathinta ngendlela engafanele ezithweni zabo zangasese ngaphambi kokudlwengula ephindelela iwele elilodwa. Ngo-2019, elinye iwele lathola umsebenzi kwelinye idolobha, lokho kwanika umsolwa ithuba lokudlwengula iwele elikhubazekile elalisele ekhaya. Umphathi wewele eliqashiwe wabona ukuthi aliphilile kahle ngokwengqondo, wabe eselibuza. Ladalula ukuthi uyise ubelidlwengula. Umphathi watshela udadewabo omdala wamantombazane, futhi wabhekana noyise, kodwa indoda yaphika. Nokho iwele ebelisele noyise litshele udadewabo omdala ukuthi emuva kokuqashwa kwewele lakhe, uyise waqala ukulidlwengula. Kwabizwa umhlangano womndeni, ubaba wavuma amacala akhe, okwaholela ekuvulweni kwecala ngumalume wamawele, wabe eseboshwa.Ngesikhathi kuqhubeka leli cala, waliphika icala wathi ingane ekhubazekile yayimqambela amanga ngoba ingafuni ukuthi ayigcinele imali yesibonelelo sikahulumeni yokukhubazeka. Umshushisi woMbuso, u-Advocate Thamsanqa Vinindwa, ubehola ubufakazi bomunye womphathi wewele, udadewabo omdala wewele, umalume kanye nabo abagilwa. Ephekwa ngemibuzo ummangalelwa, akakwazanga ukuchaza isizathu sokuthi kungani izingane zakhe zonke zimsola ngaleli cala.

ISIGAMEKO sakamuva, lapho i-AfriForum ne-Solidarity bekhekhezele baya eMelika (USA) ukuyokhuluma ngezindaba zaseNingizimu Afrika, siyashaqisa futhi siyihlazo. Lesi senzo sikhombisa ukuthi lezi nhlangano kazinalo ulwazi olwanele ngomlando nepolitiki yezwe lethu.Okubi kunakho konke, ukuthi ziye eMelika zingenalo ulwazi olwanele ngomthetho osanda kusayinwa nguMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ongodaba lomhlaba, owaziwa ngeLand Expropriation Act. Esikhundleni sokuthi zizihlomise ngolwazi olunzulu, abaholi bazo bafike eMelika basenga ezimithiyo ngokwenzeka eNingizimu Afrika. Bakhe isithombe esingelona iqiniso sokuthi abamhlophe abakhuluma ulwimi lwesiBhunu bayahlukunyezwa.Ngenxa yokuxhamazela, uMengameli Donald Trump, uthathe izinqumo ezingenasisekelo, wakhuluma kabi ngeNingizimu Afrika, waphinde wamemezela ukuthi uzonqamula uxhaso lwemali olusuka ezweni lakhe. Ziningi zinto ezingamaphutha kulesi senzo.Abe-AfriForum ne-Solidarity behlulekile ukufunda umgqigqo wezombusazwe. IMelika vele kayeneme ngokuthi iNingizimu Afrika yamangalela umholi waKwa-Israel, uMnuz Benjamin Netanyahu, eNkantolo yaMazwe yezoBulungiswa (International Court of Justice). Injalo nje ayijabulile neze ngobudlelwano obukhona phakathi kweNingizimu Afrika neRussia. Yingakho uTrump ebonakala ehlela izingxoxo noMengameli waseRussia, uMnuz Vladimir Putin, ngenhloso yokulungisa ubudlelwano beMelika neRussia.Okunye, ukuthi uTrump wenza konke okusemandleni akhe ukucindezela uMengameli wase-Ukraine, uMnuz uVolodymyr Zelenskyy, amchaza njengongaphethe ngokwentando yeningi. Isimemo esikhishwe nguMengameli uRamaphosa emema uZelenskyy sokuba avakashele iNingizimu Afrika, kasehlanga kahle eMelika. Ngamafuphi, i-AfriForum ne-Solidarity abayiboni ipolitiki edlalwa yiMelika. Ngaphakathi ezweni, isenzo salezi zinhlangano sikhombisa ukungabi nalo ulwazi lokuthi amazwe omhlaba asebenzisana kanjani. Abantu abanelungelo lokuxhumana nohulumeni waseMelika ngqo nguRamaphosa noNgqongqoshe wezobuDlelwano nokuBambisana naMazwe angaPhandle, uMnuz Ronald Lamula. Uma kungenjalo, uMnuz Ebrahim Rasool oyinxusa leNingizimu Afrika eMelika, nguyena onamandla okuhlela imihlangano yala mazwe amabili.Ayikho neyodwa into egunyaza i-AfriForum ne-Solidarity ukuthi baye ukuyokhuluma ngeNingizimu Afrika eMelika, ngale kokuvumelana nomengameli. Kungenzeka izinhlangano engizigagulile ngenhla zizivikele ngokuthi ne-ANC yayixhumana namazwe angaphandle ingagunyaziwe nguhulumeni ngesikhathi isalwela inkululeko. Umehluko ukuthi ngaleso sikhathi izwe lalingabuswa ngokwentando yeningi. Uhulumeni wengcindezelo wawenza umathanda kubantu abamnyama. AmaBhunu awagqilaziwe eNingizimu Afrika. Umthetho ngodaba lomhlaba awulwi namaBhunu kodwa ulwa nokuthi umhlaba usezandleni zedlanzana nokuyinto engahambisani nentando yeningi. Uma amaBhunu engenelisekile ngokuthile kufanele asebenzise izinhlaka zangaphakathi ezweni ukubeka izikhalo zazo.Ukuya kwelinye izwe ngale kokuthi zisebenzise izinhlaka zangaphakathi akuwenzi umqondo. Lesi senzo sihlukanisa izwe phakathi kungenasidingo. Isithombe okungesona esakhekayo ngesokuthi amaBhunu ayahlukunyezwa eNingizimu Afrika. Yingakho uTrump ethi amukelekile ukuyohlala eMelika. Uhulumeni kufanele ulusukumele ngokushesha lolu daba. Okubi ukuthi i-DA - eyingxenye kahulumeni we-GNU - nayo yalibangisa eMelika ngaphambi kokhetho, iyofafaza izinkulumo ezingenasisekelo. Manje sekufanele ibe yingxenye yokulungisa isimo eyasiqalayo. Lokhu okungenhla kuvivinya amandla kaRamaphosa njengoMengameli. Isizwe sibheke ukuthi uzoyisingatha kanjani le ndaba. Ukuthula kwakhe kuzomveza njengomengameli ontekenteke.Uma uhulumeni wokubusa ngokubambisana ungalusukumeli lolu daba uzolahlekelwa yisithunzi. Phezu kwalokho, uzogqugquzela abanye ukuthi benze okufanayo.
