Abahambe abafuna ukuyohlala eMelika ngoba umhlaba wona, sizowuthatha," kusho uMalema.UMnuz Wesley Marshall Douglas weqembu iMK, ugxeke uhulumeni ngokuhoxiswa koxhaso.Uthe kodwa umhlaba kumele ubuyele kubantu bawo nfisho noma kuthiwani.UMnuz Mkhuleko Hlengwa we-IFP, uthe izwe kumele lifunde ukuzimela wathi ukubuyela kukaTrump emandleni kuvuse abebelwa befuna lubuye ubandlululo."Siyazeseka izinguquko kodwa hhayi ubudlova. I-MK iyona kuphela eyahalalisela uTrump ngesikhathi eqokiwe, manje isikhuni sibuya nokhwezeli," kusho uHlengwa.Umholi wePatriotic Alliance uMnuz Gayton McKenzie, uthe abantu bazofa ngenxa yokuvalwa kwalolu xhaso.Uthe iMelika nelakuleli bayadingana wathi kodwa elakuleli elidinga kakhulu iMelika."Okumele sikwenze ngukuthi sivale abokufika bayeke ukuthola usizo lwamahhala kuleli. Abahambe," usho kanje.UMnuz Athol Trollip we-ActionSA, ugxeke i-ANC ngokwenzekile wathi nabanye abaholi abayingxenye kahulumeni wokubambisana kwamaqembu, bakhwela bayadilika kuTrump.Uthe abantu bazothwala kanzima ngoba bebethembele kulolu xhaso."Kumele uhulumeni uzinuke amakhwapha ngokwenzekile, izwe lizigwaze ngowalo. Abantu yibona abazoshayeka kakhulu ngalokhu."UMfundisi Kenneth Meshoe we-ACDP, uthe uhulumeni kumele axoxe nohulumeni waseMelika, ukuze kubuyiswe lolu xhaso.Uthe ukuvalwa kwalolu xhaso kuzoshaya abahlwempu nakuba kunesidingo sokuthi elakuleli kumele lizimele liyeke ukuthembela kwamanye amazwe.UMnuz Nqabayomzi Kwankwa we-UDM, uthe akumele sivumele elakuleli ukuthi libanjwe ngobhongwana ngamanye amazwe."Kumele siyibheke eyokuthi sinyuse intela ukuxhasa izinhlelo zokusiza abantu bakithi. Asingavumeli la bantu ukuthi basiqhele ngoba bebona ukuthi sidinga usizo lwabo," usho kanje.Umholi weRise Mzansi uMnuz Songezo Zibi, uthe kumele elakuleli lakhe ubudlelwano namanye amazwe njengoba iMelika isikhumukile kuleli.Uthe lesi sinqumo seMelika yinto engabe kade yenzeka ukuthi nje elaseMelika belilinde kungene umengameli obezokwenza lokhu."Siyacela uMengameli angayi eMelika, eWhite House ngoba sizojwayeleka kabi. Abashiywe kanjalo, sibatshengise ukuthi siyakwazi ukuzimela." IPhini lomholi weqembu iBosa uNkk Nobuntu Hlazo-Webster, lithe asikhohlwe uxhaso lwaseMelika, sifunde ukuzimela siyizwe."Asizakhele izwe lethu elizozimela likwazi ukutshengisa ukuthi alincengile. Ukuncetheza kwamanye amazwe kusenza sibukeke singakwazi ukuzenzela izinto yilabo abasixhasayo," usho kanje.UMnuz Vuyo Zungula we-ATM, uthe akukwazi ukuthi singezwa ngamanye amazwe ukuthi kumele siliphathe kanjani izwe.'Uthe kumele kulungiswe izinto ezonakala ezweni eminyakeni eminingi edlule."Asikwazi ukuzwa ngamanye amazwe ukuthi kumele sizilungise kanjani izinto. Okumbiwa phansi kumele kwenganyelwe abantu bakuleli. Kumele sizilungiselele ukuthi uTrump maduzane uzovele avale ukuhwebelana okukhona phakathi kwelakuleli nelaseMelika. Kumele ngabe iSolidarity ne-AfriForum kade babekwa amacala okuvukela umbuso, ngabe uhulumeni uwasabani amaBhunu," kusho uZungula.
UMBIKO woMcwaningi-maBhuku uveze ukuthi kukakwampunz' edla emini komasipala baKwaZulu-Natal njengoba uthole ukuthi iningi labo kaliyilandeli imigomo ebekiwe uma lisebenzisa isabelomali.Umbiko uthole ukuthi u-92% wemali eyabelwe omasipala baKwaZulu-Natal isetshenziswe ngaphandle kokulandelwa kwemigomo ebekelwe ukuphathwa kwemali yomphakathi.UMcwaningi-maBhuku, uNksz Tsakani Maluleke, ukuveze lokhu ngesikhathi ethula umbiko esiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal, izolo.Uthe yingcosana yomasipala bakulesi sifundazwe elandela imigomo ebekiwe uma isebenzisa isabelomali, wathi komasipala abangu-54 baKwaZulu-Natal, bayisikhombisa kuphela okutholakale ukuthi bayayilandela imigomo uma besebenzisa isabelomali."Uma ubhekisisa kahle omasipala abancane kuphela abalandela imigomo. Lona u-8% wesabelomali somasipala baKwaZulu-Natal. Lokhu kusitshela ukuthi u-92% wesabelomali esitholwa omasipala baKwaZulu-Natal sisetshenziswa ngaphandle kokulandela imigomo."UNksz Maluleke uthe kufanele bathathelwe izinyathelo omasipala abangayilandeli imigomo."Iningi lomasipala baKwaZulu-Natal liyehluleka ukulandela imigomo. Sonke siyazi ukuthi kubalulekile ukuthi kulandelwe imigomo. Ukungalandelwa kwemigomo kuzokwenza ukuthi abantu bengabethembi omasipala. Kufanele kuphele ukungalandelwa kwemithetho. Sekuphele iminyaka ewu-30 sathola inkululeko. Akufanele engabe sisabekezelela abantu abangayilandeli imithetho."Ngiyazi ukuthi kuhlezi kukhona abakhala ngokuthi eminye yemithetho yenza kube nzima ukusebenza komasipala. Kodwa iqiniso ukuthi akufanele sibekezelele ukungalandelwa kwemigomo. Iqiniso ukuthi-ke noma ingashintshwa le mithetho okukhalwa ngayo, sisazokuba nenkinga yokungahlonishwa kwayo leyo mithetho emisha uma sizozijwayeza ukubekezelela ukungalandelwa kwemigomo."Omasipala abathathu bathole imibiko emibi ngendlela engachazeki.UMasipala uMzinyathi noMasipala waseMzumbe, bathole imibiko ebizwa nge-adverse, kwathi uMasipala waseNdumeni wona wathola umbiko owaziwa nje-disclaimer. I-adverse uyithola uma umbiko ungelona iqiniso futhi ungekho kahle. I-disclaimer yona uma ungazange wathola umbiko wezimali ongakwenza uhlulele ngokusetshenziswa kwayo.UNksz Maluleke uthe labo masipala kufanele bashintshe ukwenza."Le mibiko mibi kakhulu, angikholwa ukuthi kukhona omasipala abasathola lolu hlobo lwemibiko."UMasipala waseMzinyathi usujwayele ukuthola lolu hlobo lombiko, muva nje, i-IFP isanda kukhomba indlela imeya yalo mkhandlu, uMfu Petros Ngubane.UMasipala waseMzumbe nowaseNdumeni bona babenezinkinga zobuholi.Umbango wobuholi eMzumbe waholela ekutheni i-ANC ixoshe inqwaba yamakhansela, kwase kuba nokhetho lokuchibiyela. ENdumeni khona i-IFP yaxosha imeya, uMnuz Siyabonga Ndlovu, ngonyaka owedlule.Omasipala abathole imibiko enogcobho, uMsunduzi, Mdoni, Mtubatuba, Nongoma, Inkosi Langalibalele, uThukela, Amajuba noMkhanyakude.Omasipala abathole imibiko emihle, iKing Cetshwayo, Mlalazi, Mhlathuze, Mvoti, Msinga, Mshwathi neRichmond.

KUNETWETWE kwabanye abahola izibonelelo zikahulumeni asebeshintshele emakhadini amnyama asePostbank, besuka kwayigolide akwa-Sassa, abahlangabezane nezinkinga zokungayifici imali ngesikhathi beyohola.Abanye kuthiwa bakhale ngokuthi imali yabo ayiphelele, kwathi abanye bakhala ngokuthi bathe befaka i-pin, kwathiwa ayisebenzi.Lezi zinkinga zivezwe amalungu ekomiti lezeNhlalakahle ePhalamende izolo, ngesikhathi iPostbank ivele phambi kwaleli komiti izochaza ngezinselelo ezibhekene nohlelo lokushintshwa kwamakhadi akwa-Sassa ayigolide, kushintshelwa kwamnyama asePostbank.Usihlalo wekomiti uNksz Bridget Masango, uthe uthole inqwaba yezikhalo kulabo asebeshintshele emakhadini amasha amnyama, ngezinkinga abahlangabezane nazo sebethi beyokhipha imali.Ubale eyokufika itshe lome inhlama imali ingekho, noma kukhona engaphelele kanjalo nokuthi i-pin akuyona."Kunengebhe kubantu abaningi abashintshile ngoba basitshela ngalezi zinto ezintathu abathi ziyenzeka. Kuvele kunetwetwe kubantu ngalolu hlelo lokushintshwa kwamakhadi okunezinkinga. Le nkinga ayisukunyelwe ngokushesha ngoba akusizi ukushintsha bese imali yakho ungayifici," usho kanje.Nelinye ilungu lekomiti uNksz Alexandra Abrahams, lithe lizitholile izikhalo kwizaguga ngenkinga yokufica imali engaphelele."Udaba esengilubikile ngisho kwa-Sassa ukuthi kunale nkinga yokuthi abanye asebehola ngamakhadi amnyama bafice imali engaphelele. Lokhu kudinga ukulungiswa ngokushesha ngoba kudala itwetwe," kusho uNksz Abrahams.UNkk Nikki Mbengashe isikhulu esiphezulu sePostbank, uthe abanye abantu uthola ukuthi amakhadi asuke ekomashonisa, bese beshesha bekhipha imali ngosuku lokuhola.Uthe abanye abantu bakhohlwa yi-pin yabo, beqeda ukuyenza bese kuthi uma sebeyokhipha imali, uthole ukuthi sebeyikhohliwe."Sinenkinga yomashonisa ngoba abanye basuke behamba nabo beyokhipha imali. Uthi angaqeda ukuyikhipha esebone ne-pin, bese ethatha ikhadi ahambe nalo umashonisa. Ngenyanga elandelayo uyikhipha yena imali. Zikhona izehlakalo lapho uthola ukuthi abahola izibonelelo bafika sebefuna ukwenzelwa amakhadi amasha ngoba amadala ekomashonisa noma sebewalahlile. Asinazo izinkinga zokuthi imali ingabikhona kuma-akhawunti abaholayo ngoba imali isuke ifakiwe," usho kanje.Amalungu ancome nomnyakazo owenziwe yiPostank, wokushintsha amakhadi.UNkk Mbengashe uthe sebezilungisile ezinye zezinkinga ebezikhona ezibandakanya ukushoda kwabasebenzi abashintsha amakhadi."Ngingasho nje ukuthi angaphezulu kuka-900 000 amakhadi aseshintshiwe kuleli. Sisasalelwe angu-1.9 million okusamele siwashintshe. Phansi amaphaphu kulabo abangakawashintshi ngoba bazoqhubeka nokuyithola imali yabo ngisho sekudlule umnqamulajuqu wokuwashintsha, ongoMeyi 20."Uveze nokuthi noma usudlulile umnqamulajuqu bazoqhubeka bawashintshe amakhadi."Ayagcina ukusebenza amakhadi ayigolide akwa-Sassa kusuka ngoMashi 20. Kodwa imali yabantu izobakhona noma wona engasasebenzi. Siyanxusa ukuthi abantu baye koshintsha amakhadi abo kube ngamnyama," kusho uNkk Mbengashe.Amalungu ePhalamende athe kumele iPostbank isebenzise izinhlelo ezehlukene ukugqugquzela abantu ukuthi bashintshe amakhadi.IPostbank ithe sekuphele izinyanga eziyisithupha lolu hlelo yaluqala kanti ithe inethemba lokuthi luzophothulwa ngempumelelo.
I-IFP iqinisekise ukuxoshwa kweMeya kaMasipala wesiFunda okhungethwe yizinkinga, uMzinyathi, uMfu Petros Ngubane.Okhulumela i-IFP, uMnuz Mkhuleko Hlengwa, uthe isinqumo sokuxosha uNgubane sithathwe emhlanganweni wesigungu esiphezulu obungoMsombuluko.UHlengwa uthe kuqale kwaba nomhlangano okhethekile wabaholi beqembu, lapho behlangane noNgubane ngeSonto.Kulo mhlangano bekubhekwa udaba lokuhanjiswa kwezidingo kuMasipala uMzinyathi.UHlengwa uthe abaholi beqembu baphakamise ukuthi uNgubane asuswe esikhundleni."Kube sekuba nomhlangano wesigungu esiphezulu ngoMsombuluko, lapho khona amalungu esigungu esiphezulu evumelene nesiphakamiso sokuthi uNgubane ehle esikhundleni."UHlengwa uthe esikhundleni sobuMeya kuzothatha iPhini leMeya, uNkk Thembisile Mchunu, wathi iphini lizobuye liqokwe."Simazisile uNgubane ngesinqumo sokumkhipha esikhundleni. Sithanda ukumbonga ngomsebenzi awenzile ephethe isikhundla."Isolezwe lisanda kubika ngesinqumo sokuxoshwa kukaNgubane.UNgubane ubesebe imeya yalo masipala iminyaka eyisishiyagalombili.UMasipala wesiFunda uMzinyathi ukhungethwe yizinkinga okubalwa kuzo inkinga endala yokushoda kwamanzi ezindaweni eziningi ezingaphansi kwalo mkhandlu kanye nokuthola imibiko emibi yoMcwaningi maBhuku.Lo masipala usuhlale isikhathi eside ungaphansi kweso lomlawuli.Umthombo ongaphakathi kwi-IFP uthe inhlangano inqume ukuxosha uNgubane ngoba inokwesabela ukuthi ingase ingawunqobi lo masipala okhethweni lohulumeni basekhaya lwangonyaka ozayo uma izokuya kulo umasipala usaphethwe uNgubane.Lena akusiyona imeya yokuqala ukuxoshwa i-IFP mumva nje le nhlangano ikhombe indlela imeya kaMasipala wesiFunda Amajuba, uMntwana uNdabuko Zulu.Umthombo ongaphakathi kwi-IFP, uthe iqembu liphume umbhidlangano wokuxosha izimeya ezahluleka ukwenza umsebenzi."Selusondele ukhetho lohulumeni basekhaya. Kufanele kuqale umkhankaso wokhetho maduze. Kunzima ukukhankasa uma unezimeya ezihlulwa umsebenzi ngoba abantu bazokhalaza ngazo uma uthi uyaqala uvula umlomo. Ingakho iqembu libona kungcono ukuthi zigudluzwe zonke izimeya ezingawenzi umsebenzi."
INkantolo yeMantshi e-Aliwal North ilihlehlisile icala elibhekene no-Anelle de Bruin, 46, unkosikazi womlimi owaziwayo wendawo, osolwa ngokuhlela ukumbulala "kube sengathi bekuhlaselwa epulazini”. Umsolwa ubhekene necala lokwakha itulo lokubulala ngemuva kokuboshwa ngomhla ka-9 Januwari 2025. Uvele kafushane namuhla, umshushisi wafaka isicelo sokuhlehliswa ukuze kuqhutshekwe nophenyo njengoba kusenezitatimende ezingakacaci, ama-albhamu ezithombe namarekhodi amaselula. Icala lizobuyela enkantolo ngomhla ka-23 Ephreli 2025, ummangalelwa usangaphandle ngebheyili ka-R2000, nemibandela eyisipesheli yokuthi angabuyeli epulazini futhi agadwe uma evakashela izingane zabo.Uboshwe ngemuva kokuthi amaphoyisa elunywe indlebe ngowesilisa okusolakala ukuthi weza kuye ukuze athole izinkabi ezizobulala umyeni wakhe oneminyaka engu-56. Ngokophenyo lwamaphoyisa, ummangalelwa wayesevele ekhokhele inkabi imali encane futhi wathembisa ukuthi uzoyikhokha yonke imali esele ngemuva kokubulala kanye nokukhokhwa komshwalense. Kuthiwa waqoshwa eyalela ukuthi ngemuva kokudubula umyeni wakhe epulazini labo, izigebengu kumele zidubule izinja zomndeni kanye namathayi emoto ukuze kubukeke sengathi "bekuhlaselwa epulazini". Kuthiwa ubephinde abikele umdidiyeli ukuthi kuzothatha isikhathi esingakanani ukuthi abalimi abangomakhelwane basukume uma bezwa kuhlaselawa. Kusolwa ukuthi ubezodla ifa lika-R50 million uma kushona umyeni wakhe.
KUKHALWA ngokungathembeki koMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal ngesikole saseThenjane, eMfume, iMgangeni Secondary, osekuphele iminyaka eyisishiyagalolunye kufundwa kanzima kusona ngenxa yesimo samagumbi okufundela angenalo uphahla, okwenza kuthikamezeke uhlelo lokufunda.Omunye wabazali bezingane ezifunda kulesi sikole, odonse iphephandaba ngendlebe ethi lingalivezi igama lakhe, uthe le nkinga yaqala ngo-2016 ngesikhathi kunemvula nesiphepho okwashiya izindonga zamagumbi esikole zidilikile, uphahla lwasala kude lena, konakala nengqalasizinda. Uthe uma kuhloma izulu othisha bayabikelwa ngoba basuke sebebona ukuthi sekuzophazamiseka ukufunda, kanti futhi noma lishisa ilanga akubi mnandi ukufunda, ukushisa kushaya okhakhayini."Isimo sibi kakhulu njengoba lungekho uphahla emagumbini amaningi esikole, kubalwa negumbi elihlala othisha, okuphoqa ukuthi uma izulu lina, bashiye bemboze izincwadi nokunye abakusebenzisela ukufunda ngoplastiki ukuze kungabi manzi ngendlela yokuthi kungabe kusalungiseka,” usho kanje.Eqhuba, uthe into ebuhlungu kakhulu wukuthi wukuphela kwesikole esinamabanga aphansi esikhona lesi endaweni, ezinye izikole zikude futhi akulula ukuthi abazali abaningi bayise izingane zabo kuzona ngoba kuzoshaya kuzwele ephaketheni."Siphatheke kabi singabazali ngoba kuphaswa kahle esikoleni, nothisha benza okungangamandla abo kepha abakwazi ukungenelela kule nkinga ngoba idinga ababhekele ukuphathwa kwesikole. "Kubuhlungu ukubona izingane zethu zifunda kabuhlungu kanjena kungekho esingakwenza. Sesize sifise nokuthi kube khona uMsamariya olungileyo ozosisiza kube nomehluko kulesi simo esibi kanjena,” kusho umzali.Lesi sikole sivame ukwenza kahle kwa-matric njengoba ngo-2023 nanyakenye kuphase wonke umfundi, futhi siwusizo emphakathini owakhele le ndawo ngoba siseduze kwemizi.Omunye wabaphethe isigungu esilawula ukusebenza kwesikole, uNksz Ayanda Sosibo, uvumile ukuthi isimo sibi kakhulu kulesi sikole, kangangokuthi uma izulu lina kakhulu baphoqeka ukuthi izingane bazigodukise ngoba akube kusafundeka nhlobo."Kuba nzima kakhulu impela uma izulu lina, kangangokuthi sekuze kwaphoqeka ukuthi kusetshenziswe namagumbi angomahambanendlwana, nawo angasizi wonke umfundi ngoba anela abaka-matric kuphela ngoba yibona ababekwa eqhulwini lokuthi kungaphazamiseki ukufunda kwabo, kodwa konke lokho akwanele ngoba ezinye izingane ziyaphazamiseka,” usho kanje.Eqhuba, uNksz Sosibo udalule nokuthi sekukaningi bezama ukulungisa isimo, kangangokuthi kwathi ngo-2023 kwafika nowayengungqongqoshe weMfundo eyisiSekelo, uNksz Angie Motshekga, wathembisa ukulungisa isimo ngokushesha, kodwa kuze kube yimanje akukho osekwenziwe ukulungisa."Nangonyaka odlule kukhona owafika ethi uthunywe ngaboMnyango wezeMfundo ukuzohlola umonakalo bese eyabuya ukuzolungisa kodwa akaphindanga wabuya, sisabambe elentulo akulungi lutho,” kusho yena.Kuthiwa ngisho amathoyilethi asesimeni esiyihlazoIsikole sinamagumbi okufundela awu-8 nothisha abayisithupha, kanti siwusizo kakhulu emphakathini esiwakhele njengoba senza izinto zibe lula ezinganeni zasendaweni.Kuthintwa okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo esifundazweni, uMnuz Muzi Mahlambi uthembise ukubuya nezimpendulo, kwaze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela engabuyelanga entathelini.
KUHLATSHWE ikhwelo ebantwini abebemukela imishanguzo yokuthithibalisa ingculazi ezikhungweni ezivaliwe kuleli ngenxa yokuhoxiswa koxhaso lwaseMelika, ukuthi bangayeki ukudla le mishanguzo njengoba bezokwazi ukuyithola emitholampilo ehlukene.Leli khwelo lihlatshwe ngokhulumela uMnyango wezeMpilo, uMnuz Foster Mohale, kulandela isinqumo sikaMengameli waseMelika, uMnuz Donald Trump, sokuhoxisa uxhaso lwemali ebifakwa ezinhlelweni zokulwa ne-HIV kuleli, ngaphansi kwe-USAID ne-Pepfar."Abantu abebelanda imishanguzo yabo kulezi zikhungo abangadikibali, bayeke ukudla le mishanguzo ngoba bethi azisekho izikhungo abebezisebenzisa. Abaye ezikhungweni zezempilo ezikhona lapho behlala khona noma emitholampilo, lapho bezokwazi ukuthola khona imishanguzo yabo," kusho uMohale.Uthe baxhumene nezifundazwe ukuthi zenze izinhlelo zokusiza labo abebethola usizo kulezi zikhungo ezivaliwe."Akekho ongeke angayithole imishanguzo yakhe ngoba isikhungo abesizakala kusona sesivaliwe. Asifuni kube khona abazoyeka ukudla imishanguzo bevika ngokuthi izikhungo zivaliwe," kuqhuba uMohale.Uveze ukuthi bazohlangana nezinhlaka ezehlukene okubalwa nezinhlangano ezingenzi inzuzo, ezishayekile ngesinqumo sikahulumeni waseMelika sokuhoxisa uxhaso."Sifuna ukuzitholela ulwazi oluthinta ukuthi ukuhoxiswa kwalolu xhaso kuzozishaya kangakanani lezi zinhlangano. Siyalincoma iqhaza lazo empini yokulwa neHIV/AIDS kanjalo neTB," kusho uMohale.Ngeledlule, lezi zinhlangano zithole izincwazi ezivela ngaphansi kohlelo lukaMengameli waseMelika, i-US President’s Emergency Plan for Aids Relief (Pepfar) ezaziveza ukuthi selunqanyulwe unomphela uxhaso.Phambilini, uTrump walumisa lolu xhaso ngoba ethi usabuyekeza izinto ezithile kulona.Ukulimisa unomphela kudale itwetwe kuleli njengoba ziningi izikhungo okubalwa naKwaZulu-Natal, ebezihlomula ngaphansi kwalolu hlelo lokusabalalisa ama-ARV emiphakathini ehlukene. Kubuyisela emuva nempi ephakwa nguhulumeni yokulwa ne-HIV njengoba lo mnyango usanda kumemezela ukuthi usezinhlelweni zokucinga abantu abangu-1.1 million, abangayidli imishanguzo yabo.Iningi labacingwayo ngabesilisa abazohlaselwa ngisho ezindaweni abagcwala kuzona okubalwa namathaveni, ukuze bamukeliswe imishanguzo yabo.
UNDUNANKULU waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, uthi azokhala zize zome amalungu e-MK asaqhubeka nokubalisela ukuthi iqembu lawo ilona okufanele engabe liqhoqhobele izintambo zoMbuso esifundazweni.UNtuli uthe uhulumeni wamaqembu abusa ngokubambisana uyaqhubeka nokusebenza kahle.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma esiShayamthetho, lapho bekunenkulumo mpikiswano ebibizelwe ukuzobhunga ngenkulumo yesimo sesifundazwe ayethule ngeledlule.I-MK yazihola phambili ngamavoti KwaZulu-Natal ngesikhathi kunokhetho lwangonyaka owedlule, kepha ayizange ithole amavoti anele ukuthi ibuse ngokuzimela njengoba yathola izihlalo ezingu-37 kwezingu-80 esiShayamthetho.Leli qembu eliholwa owayengumengameli, uMnuz Jacob Zuma,lagcina lisala ngaphandle ngesikhathi kwakhiwa uhulumeni wokubambisana ohlanganise amaqembu i-IFP, ANC, DA ne-NFP.Ngesikhathi kunenkulumo mpikiswano amalungu eMK athe iqembu lawo ilona okufanele engabe liphethe uhulumeni wesifundazwe.UNtuli uthe amalungu eMK kufanele akuqonde ukuthi iqembu lawo alizange linqobe ngamalengiso ngesikhathi kunokhetho lwangonyaka odlule."Ukuze uphathe uhulumeni wesifundazwe kufanele uthole izihlalo ezingaphezu kuka-50%. Angazi ukuthi yni enzima lapho, mhlawumbe inkinga ukuhlanganisa izibalo."UNtuli uthe uhulumeni wokubambisana uyaqhubeka nokusebenza ngaphandle kwezihibe."Ucwaningo lwakamumva lukhombisa ukuthi abantu baKwaZulu-Natal bajabule kakhulu ngohulumeni wokubambisana. Siyaqhubeka nokuletha izidingo."Amaqembu aphikisayo aphinde ayihlaba ayihlikiza inkulumo kaNtuli.I-MK ne-EFF bathe inkulumo kaNtuli igcwele izethembiso ezingeke zifezwe.Usotswebhu we-MK, uMnuz Meryvn Dirks, ukhale ngokungathathelwa izinyathelo kukaMphathiswa wezeMpilo, uNksz Nomagugu Simelane.UDirks uthe uNksz Simelane kufanele aphendule ngokushoda kwemithi ezibhedlela nasemitholampilo."Akaxoshwa ngani uNomagugu? Izibhedlela nemitholampilo azinayo imithi eyanele. Akwanele ukuthi uNtuli athi uzophenya, sifuna athathe izinyathelo. I-IFP neDA babehlezi bemgxeka uNksz Simelane ngesikhathi bengakabi ingxenye kahulumeni wokubambisana. Ngenxa yokuthanda izikhundla, uNtuli waqoka yena uNksz Simelane ukuba abe umphathiswa. Namhlanje i-IFP ne-DA bathule, abasho lutho ngenxa yokuthanda izikhundla."Ilungu le-EFF, uNksz Thobisile Nkosi, lithe babenethemba lokuthi izinto zizoshintsha ngesikhathi kungena uhulumeni wokubambisana."Kusobala nje ukuthi bahlangene ngenkohlakalo."
I-IFP ixoshe iMeya uMfu Petros ngubane kuMasipala uMzinyathi okhungethwe izinkingaIsinqumo sokuxosha uNgubane sithathwe emhlanganweni wesigungu esiphezulu, obungoMsombuluko ntambama.Isigungu esiphezulu sithathe isinqumo sokuba siyalele uNgubane ukuba ehle esikhundleni abese ehlale kuso iminyaka eyisishiyagalombili.UMasipala uMzinyathi ukhungethwe izinkinga okubalwa kuzo eyokushoda kwamanzi ezindaweni eziningi ezingaphansi kwalo mkhandlu nokuthola imibiko emibi kuMcwaningimabhuku.Lo masipala usuhlale isikhathi eside ungaphansi kweso lomlawuli. Umthombo ongaphakathi kwi-IFP uthe isinqumo sokuxoshwa kukaNgubane sizomenyezelwa maduze."Uyalelwe ukuba asule esikhundleni. Ayikho into azoyenza uma eseyalelwe ukuba asule. Uyathanda noma akathandi, kufanele ashiye. Isiphingwe enkulu manje."Ulanda umthombo uthe i-IFP inqume ukuxosha uNgubane ngoba yesaba ukuthi ngeke ikwazi ukunqoba lo mkhandlu okhethweni lohulumeni basekhaya lwangonyaka ozayo."Ziningi izinkinga ezibhekene nomkhandlu. UNgubane ufice umkhandlu ubhekene nezinkinga, zaqhubeka izinkinga noma sekuphethe yena. Empeleni selokhu angena esikhundleni kuncane kakhulu esingakubala esingathi kuhambe kahle. Ngakho-ke ayimangazanga eyokuthi akhonjwe indlela."Belukhona lolo valo lokuthi uma besingaya okhethweni sigadla ngaye besingase singabuyi. Uma ubheka nakhona okhethweni olwedlule vele sasinganqobanga ngamalengiso. Ingakho-ke manje kufuneka umuntu omusha, ozofike ashintshe izinto. Ukhetho oluzayo luzokuba ngolunzima kakhulu KwaZulu-Natal ngenxa ye-MK."Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kokhulumela i-IFP, uMnuz Mkhuleko Hlengwa, ayizange iphumelele njengoba ucingo lwakhe belukhala lungabanjwa, akazange awuphendule nomyalezo awuthunyelelwe.Kanjalo nemizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kukaNgubane ayizange iphumelele njengoba ucingo lwakhe belukhala lungabanjwa.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi enye imeya ye-IFP, uMnuz Mfananaye Mathe, yona isinde kukubi.Umthombo uthe bekunesiphakamiso sokuthi kuxoshwe uMathe, oyiMeya yaseJozini.UMathe ubizelwe phambi kwesigungu esiphezulu ukuba azochaza ngenkinga yemali eke yabikwa kulo mkhandlu."Kubukeka sengathi yanelisile incazelo afike nayo emhlanganweni wesigungu esiphezulu."I-IFP isanda kuxosha imeya kuMasipala yaseMajuba, uMntwana uNdabuko Zulu.
KWABA yishwa ukuba kuhlehliswe isitatimende sesabelomali emavikini edlule ngenxa yokungavumelani odabeni lwentela i-VAT olwaluphakanyiswa uMnyango kaMgcinimafa wezwe.Kusukela ngalelo sonto indaba epenapenwayo yiyo eyale ntela ngenxa yokuthi lesi siphakamiso sabukeka siwukugagamela ezweni lapho izigidi ngezigidi ziphila ngokukhangezwa uhulumeni imali yesibonelelo.Kwabuzeka ukuthi obeqhamuke nesiphakamiso se-VAT ubehabuleni. Isinqumo sokungamemezeli isabelomali kwakungesifanele ngoba kusobala ukuthi ubuholi bezwe babungakabi nawo amasu amasha okwenyula izwe otakwini lwenhlupheko. Ukwenyusa intela ezimpahleni ezithengwayo, yebo, kungalekelela ukufukula isikhwama sikahulumeni kodwa, ngakolunye uhlangothi, bekuzomba omkhulu umgodi kubantu bakuleli abavele badonsa kanzima ezindlekweni zansuku zonke. Iqiniso lithi kwabasebenzayo imiholo ayikhushulwa ngendlela engakwazi ukumelana nokwenyuka kwezindleko zempilo. Empeleni kweziningi izinkampani emikhakheni eyahlukene sekuneminyaka kungasenzeki ukukhushulwa kwemiholo. Abanye bayehliselwa noma badilizwe. Ngaleyo ndlela ukwenyuka kwentela ezintweni ezizothinta abantu kusho ukuthi kuzoshaya bona kanye abadonsa kanzima. Lapha asikhulumi ngempikiswano yepolitiki kodwa sisho isimo esikhona ezweni esikulo. Njengoba kulindeleke ukuthi uNqgongqoshe wezeziMali, uMnuz Enoch Godongwana, abuyele esitikini azokwethula isabelomali mhla ka-12 Mashi, sibheke ukuthi ukubonisana kweziphathimandla kumcabangele kanjani umuntu oswele nongenayo imali eyanele ukukhokhiswa intela entsha. Kungayichilo elibi uma ezobuya ezochibiyela umfantu odalekayo ngokuphela kwethemba kubantu. Kufanele ashintshe ukwenza. Abantu bafuna ukuzwa ukuthi isabelomali sihlelwe kanjani ukuze kuvuleke amathuba okuthi baphume endlaleni, bathole imisebenzi, hhayi ukwenyuka kwezindleko ngoba kayikho yona inkece.

AMATHE abuyele kwasifuba kwabebegxeka futhi becokofula umlingisi weMy Brother's Keeper, uWiseman Mncube, ngakusho ngomjolo wengqwele yeBig Brother Mzansi, u-Akhona "Sweet Guluva" Mbele nobenguzakwabo kulolu hlelo, u-Ashley Ogle. UKUJIKELWA esiswini njengotshwala ngomunye wabo yikhona okubayisa kwalasha abamangalelwa abahlanu ebebebekwe uMbuso amacala okuqotha abayisishiyagalolunye ehostela iGlebelands, eMlaza, ngo-2023.OMnuz Bongile Mabele (34), Siyamthemba Zintenteni Mthwana (32), Nkosayikhethi Njeya (35), Bongani Patrick Mboyiyana (38), noSibusiso Mkhonde (41) bonke, ababehlala kuleli hostela, bagojelwe amacala okubulala angu-8. Bonke abafi kuvela ukuthi umnyombo wokubulawa kwabo kwakunguwumbango wemibhede yokulala ehostela. Kwahlaluka ukuthi ababulali babekade bekhokhelwa u-R6 000 ngombhede ngamunye uma befaka umuntu omusha.Ijaji liveze ukuthi isinqumo senkantolo sigxile ebufakazini obethulwa nguMnuz Mfanufikile Skhosana owayekanye nabalahlwe amacala kuboshwa itulo nangesikhathi sekuhlaselwa abafi.USkhosana ebufakazini bakhe wageqa amagula ngakho konke okwenzeka. Wayekwenza lokhu ngoba wayesephenduke ufakazi woMbuso - emva kokujikela esiswini njengotshwala izimpintshi zakhe. USkhosana watshela inkantolo ukuthi ulahlwa unembeza yingakho ebona kumqoka ukuba agonyuluke ngokwenzeka.Waveza ukuthi bakuhlela bonke ngokubambisana ukubulawa kwabafi ngoba babekade becikwa ukuthi kabalaleli uma kukhulunywa izindaba zemibhede yasehotela.Ijaji lichaze ubufakazi nokugonyuluka kukaSkhosana njengobuqondile, obuqotho futhi obungasetshenziswa yinkantolo ukulahla ngecala ayekanye nabo."Inkantolo ekuqaphelile kuSkhosana ukuthi ubufakazi bakhe bebuneqiniso futhi bungashayi eceleni. Abekukhuluma konke kunjengoba kunjalo njengoba kwaphinde kwafakazelwa nangabanye ofakazi,'' lisho kanjena ijaji.Ngaphambilini, abalahlwe ngamacala bake baxosha ummeli wabo, u-Advocate J. Walmaraas, bekhala ngokuthi abasamethembi.Nokho babuye bashaya ungqimphothwe njengoba baphinde bambuyisa. Kube nokudangala okukhulu ebantwini abaningi ebebephume ngobuningi begcwele inkantolo bezokweseka amadoda agojelwe amacala.Ngemuva kwesinqumo, baphume bedangele ebusweni kubonakala nje ukuthi abasikholwa isinqumo sejaji.Ngaphambilini, abamangalelwa bekuthi uma inkantolo isaguqile baxhawule abalandeli babo, abanye baze balimise ngesihloko elokuthi bazophuma.Ngemuva kwesinqumo baphume behla bangasho lutho kulabo ebebezobeseka enkantolo.Ekuqaleni kwaqhuma isililo enkantolo kwabemindeni yabafi bekhala ngokugodlwa kwesinqumo secala ngomzuzu wokugcina.

WEPHUKE umoya omunye wemindeni yabesifazane ababili ababengabangani, ababulawa ngesihluku eKenville, eThekwini, ukubona obengumsolwa, osephenduke ufakazi woMbuso, ongaphandle ngebheyili efake isithombe sakhe kuTiktok, sihambisa nezwi elikhuluma amagama alumelayo kubona. Kulesi sithombe, uMnuz Sandile Chili, obengumsolwa wesibili kuleli cala, udlulisa umyalezo wokuthi yena "uwuphunyuka bemphethe”.Izwi eliqoshiwe elihambisana nalesi sithombe liqhubeka lithi: "Futhi ngathi ngibuya sengishisa kakhulu. Bengithi angiveze isithombe sokuthi ngisekhona”. UChili wadedelwa ngebheyili kaR5000 ngo-Okthoba ngonyaka odlule. NKOSIKHONA CELEBASALE bekhungathekile abebesenkonzweni ngesikhathi kutheleka amadoda angaziwa ngosuku lomngcwabo, ezifihle ubuso, afike avula ibhokisi ase eyaxolisa maqede ashaya achitha.Ngalolu suku, ngokuthola kweSolezwe Ngempelasonto, bekufihlwa uMnuz Zakhele Dube (40), obenamatekisi amabili. Inkonzo yomngcwabo ibisemagcekeni kubo kamufi eXobho.Umufi kuvela ukuthi uxinwe ukugula isikhathi esifishane ekhala ngekhanda kwase kuyamenela njalo.Unina kamufi uNkk Nomalanga Dube, utshele Isolezwe Ngempelasonto ukuthi inkanankana yoqobo into ayibone yenzeka kufihlwa indodana yakhe.Uma elandisa, uthi inkonzo yomgcwabo ibisinesikhashana impela iqalile ngesikhathi bebona itekisi elibomvu lima egcekeni, kwase kwehla abesilisa abane. Uthe bebephethe izibhamu kodwa kubonakala ukuthi abezile ngempi."Behle etekisini beshesha ngaleso sikhathi bekusaculwa. Bangene baqonda ebhokisini bamisa nokucula. Baxolisa nakubazalwane ngokuphazamisa inkonzo. Bavule ibhokisi baxolisa kumntanani,'' balivala base bayaphuma bahamba.Eqhuba uthe akuqaphelile kula madoda ukuthi abeyizidlakela wathi kodwa namanje kusaduma ikhanda kuyena ukuthi bahlangana kanjani nendodana yakhe.Uthe indodana yakhe ibingesiyena umuntu wodlame kodwa ibithanda ukuthi kube nokuthula noma yikuphi lapho eqhamuka khona.Uthi ukushona kwendodana yakhe kumlimazile kakhulu emphefumulweni wakhe ngoba ubesenhliziyweni yakhe kakhulu."Uyena yedwa ingane yomfana ebenginayo, ayikho futhi enye. Laba banye abathathu bangamantombazane,'' usho kanjena unina.Udadewabo kamufi uNksz Slindile Dube, uveze ukuthi ubhuti wakhe ushona nje, ngonyaka owedlule uke wathunyelelwa imiyalezo kwiselula yakhe ngenombolo engaziwa, esatshiswa."Wangitshengisa umyalezo wokuqala owawuthi uma engayiyeki le nto ayenzayo uzohamba emhlabeni. Owesibili awuthola wawumazisa ukuthi usezohamba emhlabeni ngoba kanti unekhanda eliqinile,'' usho kanjena.Uthi wambuza umfowabo ukuthi kwenzakalani? Kodwa uthi akazange ayithole impendulo eqondile kuyena. Uqhuba uthi umufi wamphendula ngokuthi akwaziyo asikho isitha anaso, naye udunguza ebumnyameni.Uqhuba uthi ngenxa yokudideka lolu daba ugcine eselubuza omunye wabangani bakamufi ukuthi kukhona yini akwaziyo ngabathile abahlela itulo lokusoconga umfowabo.''Bamangala kakhulu uma ngibabuza ngalokho, kunalokho bathi umfowethu akakaze abazise ngokuthi uthola imiyalezo emsabisayo,'' usho kanjena.Uthe kodwa ukufika kwamadoda kubashiye nemibuzo engenazimpendulo. UMfundisi Zakhele Xulu obephethe inkonzo, uthe akathandi ukuphawula kakhulu ngodaba kodwa wathi akubonile kwenzeka, uyokuxoxela amagwababa echobana ngoba ukholwa ukuthi ukhona umyalezo la madoda abewudlulisa.

IBONA imizamo yokuzinciphisela isigwebo kumhwebi we-Forex, osolwa ngecala lokudubula abulale abangani ababili besifazane, imindeni yabashonayo kuvela izinsolo zokuthi usefuna ukuvuma icala.Lokhu kuhlaluke, eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini. ngesikhathi kuvela ukuthi kukhona izingxoxo eziqhubekayo phakathi kwabameli bakammangalelwa, uMnuz Lungani Mthethwa, noMbuso.UMthethwa usolwa ngecala lokudubula abulale uNksz Anele Mbokazi (29) owayengumhlengikazi esibhedlela iNkosi Albert Luthuli noNksz Zizipho Gabisa (30) owayengusokhemisi esibhedlela esizimele eMhlanga, ngo-Agasti, nyakenye.Okhulumela imindeni, uMnuz Mvuselelo Magwaza, uthe babona ukuthi umqondo wokufuna ukuvuma icala uza emva kokubona ukuthi icala lizomgojela vele."Emva kwayo yonke imizamo ayenzile, ezama ukudedelwa ngebheyili, ima ebona manje ukuthi ufuna ukuvuma icala,” kusho uMagwaza.Uthe kuyabathusa ukuthi ummangalelwa ufike waliphika sonke lesi sikhathi icala, kwaze kwaba ngamahlandla amaningi okuhlehliswa kokulalelwa kwesicelo sakhe sebheyili, elokhu eliphike njalo."Usethi ngoba ebona ukuthi uMbuso unecala eliqinile, elingamgojela, usefuna ukulivuma. Inhloso yalokhu ukuthi ufuna ukuthola isijeziso esincane,” kusho yena.Ngaphakathi enkantolo uMshushisi woMbuso, u-Advocate Krishen Shah, ecela ukuthi kuhlehliswe icala, uveze ukuthi kunezingxoxo ezingakaphothulwa eziphakathi koMbuso nabameli bakaMthethwa.UMmeli kaMthethwa, u-Advocate Bheki Manyathi, ukuqinisekisile lokho, bavumelana ngokuthi uma izingxoxo zifika emaphethelweni, bazoyazisa inkantolo ngokuyibhalela.Ijaji lilihlehlisele uMashi 10, icala.Emva kwesigameko, izidumbu zabafi baseRiverview eVerulam, zatholwa zidindilize komunye wemigwaqo eKenville.Kwavela ukuthi babekade belandwe uMthethwa nomngani wakhe, uMnuz Sandile Chili, ngayizolo, emakubo bebakhipha.Kwavela ukuthi kwasuka ingxabano ngezikhathi zasebusuku abafi sebefuna ukugoduka, uMthethwa engafuni.Kuthiwa sebesendleleni begoduka, uMthethwa wachezuka endleleni eya eVerulam, wabheka eKenville, lapho okuthiwa wafike wadubula khona abafi wababulala.UChili ngesikhathi efaka isicelo sebheyili, waninda uMthethwa ngecala, ethi walenza phambi kwakhe.UMbuso wamdedela ngebheyili ka-R5 000 uChili, emva kwalokho, wawahoxisa wonke amacala ayebekwe wona.Khonamanjalo: Lihlehlele uMashi 10 necala lokugwazwa kubulawe umfundi owayefunda uGrade 11 eDurban Girls Secondary ngoMeyi, ngonyaka odlule.Umufi, uWandile Ngcobo, watholwa ebulewe ekhaya kubo eMlaza, isidumbu sakhe siboshwe izandla ngemumva, emlonyeni sagxishwa i-panthose.Ngaleli cala, kwaboshwa oMnuz Sfundo Bhengu noBongani Jali, kubona kukhona umakhelwane kamufi.Emva kokuvela kwabasolwa phambilini, uyise kaWandile, uMnuz Mondli Ngcobo, wakhala ngokwenzelwa phansi aboMnyango wezeMpilo esifundazweni.Lokhu kweza emva kokuthi uMbuso uveze ukuthi ngeke ulengeze icala lokudlwengula kubasolwa njengoba engekho amasampula olibofuzo athathwa esidunjini sikamufi.Elandisa ngalokhu, uNgcobo wathi amaphoyisa amtshele ukuthi ngeke kwenziwe lokhu njengoba isidumbu sasheshe sabola emakhazeni kahulumeni.Ubuzwa ngalezi zinsolo uMnyango wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal, owukhulumelayo uMnuz Ntokozo Maphisa uthe: "Udaba lomndeni wakwaNgcobo eMlaza uMnyango uyalwazi futhi ngonyaka ophelile, sixoxe kakhulu nalo mndeni ukufinyelela esisombululweni. Lokhu sikwenza ngesizotha, inhlonipho nokucabangela umndeni olahlekelwe. Ngakho asikwazi ukutshela abezindaba esikuxoxe nomndeni.”

Ukubuka isimo sezulu sangoMsombuluko nangoLwesibili, 03 - 04 Mashi 2025.Kuthiwa sizoshuba isimo ngoMsombuluko nangoLwesibili kuwelele esifundazweni i-Eastern Cape naseMpumalanga.Imvula enamandla engadala izikhukhula emgwaqweni konakale ingqalasizinda nezindlu kuholele ekukhukhulekeni kwemigwaqo nezindawo zokuhlalaKunxuswa izakhamuzi ukuba zihlale ezindlini uma zibona zingaphephile. "Ungazami ukuwela umfula noma imifudlana egcwele amanzi. Uma uvaleleke ezikhukhuleni, shiya imoto yakho uye endaweni ephakeme.”Kunxuswa izakhamuzi ukuba zixhumane nabezimo eziphuthumayo uma zibhekene nenkinga.
ABAZALWANE abahambele inkonzo enkulu yokuvulwa kwesakhiwo Isithombe: NKOSIKHONA CELENKOSIKHONA CELEKUNCONYWA isibindi sebandla labasindisiwe, iCottonland Restoration Centre elineminyaka emibili kodwa elikwaze ukwakha isakhiwo sika-R500 000.Isakhiwo saleli bandla siseMahlabathini, eVerulam, lapho obekunendumezulu yenkonzo yokuvulwa kwaso ngokusemthethweni.Umholi waleli bandla nguMfu Bonginkosi Hlophe (38) ophinde futhi abe ngusihlalo wenhlangano ehambisa izinkonzo emanyuvesi aKwaZulu-Natal, i-Jesus For Student Organization.Le nkonzo ibizinyaniswe ukuphuma ngobuningi kwabazalwane baleli bandla kanye nebebevela kwamanye amabandla.Izikhulumi eziningi ziwachome uphaphe lwegwalagwala amakholwa aleli bandla ngokuthembeka aqinisekise ukuthi uyaqalwa uze uphothulwe umsebenzi wokwakhiwa kwalesi sakhiwo.UMbhishobhi Vusi Dube, ongumholi weThekwini Community Church (ECC), uncome kakhulu umholi waleli bandla ngokuba umholi oqotho nothanda kakhulu umsebenzi kaNkulunkulu.Ulethulele isigqoko ibandla ngokuthi lithi ibandla liseneminyaka emibili nje kuphela kodwa likwazi ukumelana nenselelo yokumisa isakhiwo lisiqede."Nonke nidinga ukunconywa kakhulu ngomsebenzi eniwenze ngokubambisana niqinisekisa ukuthi lo msebenzi uyaphumelela. Lo msebenzi eniwenzile awumncane nje nhlobo. Nikhombisile ukuthi niwuthanda kangakanani umsebenzi kaNkulunkulu,'' usho kanjena.UDube uyena oqhube umsebenzi wokuvulwa ngokusemthethweni kwesakhiwo njengoba esike iribhoni sekungenwa ngaphakathi. Uphinde wagcoba ngamafutha uHlophe.UMfu Andile Majola naye ubashayele elikhulu ihlombe leli abazalwane baleli bandla nobuholi balo obuphezulu.Uthe kuyancomeka ukuthi benze umsebenzi omkhulu kangaka ngesikhathi nje esifishane ibandla elisungulwe ngaso.UHlophe ubonge ukusebenzisana okuhle athe kuyabonakala phakathi kobuholi bebandla nabazalwane.Uthe selokhu lisunguliwe ibandla abazalwane bakhonza ngeqiniso futhi bakhombisa uthando olujulile ngebandla likaNkulunkulu okuyinto athe imhlaba kakhulu umxhwele.Uthe uma konke kuqhubeka kanjena kulokoza inhlansi yethemba ngekusasa elingcono.Leli bandla ngasemaphethelweni onyaka owedlule linikelele ngegilosa kaKhisimuzi amalungu omphakathi antulayo angu-200.UHlophe waveza ukuthi basebenzise imali elinganiselwa ku-R100 000 benza loyo msebenzi.
SEKUQALE phansi ukukhathazeka kubazali bezingane zaseMdingi High, eDonnybrook, maphakathi nesifundazwe iKwaZulu-Natal, kuqala phansi izimpi zesigodi kubafundi bakulesi sikole izolo, okwenze ingxabano yabo yakapakela nasesikoleni, bebhonyaka ngezinduku nangamatshe kwakhona nabalimalayo kabi maphakathi emagcekeni esikole, kubuka ozakwabo.Elinye lamalungu omphakathi wakule ndawo, elihlala nengane efunda kulesi sikole esiku-ward 13 esigodini KwaSokhela, elingathandanga ukudalulwa ukuze livikeleke nomndeni walo, lithe bakhathazekile bewumphakathi ngokuqala phansi kwale mpi, esike yadla lubi futhi eminyakeni edlule, athe njengoba kunje besabele ukuphepha kwezingane zabo."Okubi kakhulu ngalokhu wukuthi laba bafundi bafike baxabane bengaphandle kwesikole uma behambele imicimbi yomgangela, bese labo abasuke behluliwe beqhubezele impi yabo nasesikoleni, okuzokwena kugcine kuchaphazeleka nabafundi abangahlangene nhlobo nalokhu. Sikhathazekile ngalesi simo, sifisa kube khona okwenzekayo ukusilungisa," lisho kanje.Kuthiwa laba bafundi abavame ukulwa kulezi zimpi ngasesigodini iJunction nabaKwaNomandlovu. Kwi-video esabalale ezinkundleni zokuxhumana izolo, kubonakala iqulu labafundi lilwa ngaphakathi esikoleni, kuhujwana, kujijikelwane ngamatshe, abanye beshayana nangezinduku imbala. Kuleso sibhudubhudu kubonakala abafundi abathile behlanganyela omunye umfundi eselele phansi, bemgxoba umzimba wonke. Kubonakala oqhamukayo ongawufakile umfaniswano wesikole eya ngakomunye umfundi obese elele phansi - base beyabaleka abebemthelekela.Elinye futhi ilungu lomphakathi likhale ngokuthi ukuqala phansi kwalezi zidubedube kwenza bahlalele ovalweni bengabazali ngoba akuyena wonke umfundi ohlangene nalezi zinkinga, kepha ngokwanda kwazo kungagcina kuchaphazeleka nabanye."Sifisa ukuthi kube khona abangenelelayo ukuzama ukunqanda lesi simo ngoba sekuke kwazanywa naphambili, kuhlalwa izigcawu zokukhumelana umlotha kepha njengoba sekuqala phansi manje, kukhomba ukuthi inkinga isekhona, ayikalungi," usho kanje.Ngendlela isimo ebesisibi ngayo, kuthiwa kuze kwasiza ukungenelela kwabazali nabantu abadala abezwe kuhlatshwa umkhosi, baphuthuma khona esikoleni ukuzobhula umlilo. Kubikwa ukuthi akuboshwanga muntu malungana nalesi sigameko. Kuthiwa nakuba kungafanga muntu, kepha kunabafundi abalimale kabi kulesi sigameko, baphuthunyiswa emtholampilo obude buduze nesikole. Kulindeleke ukuthi namhlanje kuhlangane abazali, ubuholi bomphakathi kubalwa nezinduna ukuzobhunga ngesixazululo.

Ikusho lokhu ngesikhathi yethula inkulumo yokuvula isiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal, eMgungundlovu, izolo.UMengameli waseMelika, uMnuz Donald Trump, usanda kuhoxisa uxhaso lwezigidi zamarandi olutholwa yiNingizimu Afrika. Lolu xhaso lwelekelela kakhulu emikhankasweni yokulwa nokusabalala kwengculazi.UTrump wahoxisa uxhaso ngoba nakhu esola elakuleli ngokuphuca amaBhunu umhlaba ngaphandle kwesinxephezelo. LIHLALELE ovalweni ilungu lebhodi leNgonyama Trust, iNkosi Sibonelo Nkosinathi Mkhize, elisolwe ngokubangisa iSilo.UMkhize uthe ukugagulwa kwegama lakhe njengomunye wabantu abadonsisana neSilo ngesikhathi kunembizo ebibizwe yiMbube, kumenza azizwe engaphephile.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba eMgungundlovu, izolo. Igama likaMkhize ligagulwe yilungu lebhodi, uDkt Thandiwe Dlamini.UDkt Dlamini usole uMkhize ngokubangisa iMbube kwesokuba usihlalo webhodi. Okwenza ukuthi uDkt Dlamini enze lezi zinsolo ukuthi uMkhize uyena osayinela imali yeNgonyama Trust ebhange. UMkhize ophethe isizwe sabaMbo eHlathikhulu, uthe lokhu okushiwo uDkt Dlamini kungenza ukuthi kube khona abamcabangela okubi.UMkhize wenze isicelo kulabo okungase kwenzeke ukuthi bacabanga ukumenzakalisa, wathi unxusa lokho bangakwenzi phambi komndeni wakhe."Uma kukhona umonakalo abafuna ukuwenza kumina sengiyocela ukuthi bakwenze ngihamba ngedwa. Iba buhlungu le nto yokuthi ulinyazwe uhamba nondlunkulu nabantwana. "Uma kuwukuthi kukhona abakwenzayo, sengizinikele ukuthi ingoba nakhu ngikhulumela isizwe sakithi, akukho okubi engikwenzile. Ngiyabazi ubuhlungu bokulahlekelwa ozakwethu. Into engiyicelayo ukuthi uma sekuqondene nami, ngicela ukuthi bakwenze ngingedwa.”UMkhize uthe okumenza asabele impilo yakhe ukuthi vele KwaZulu-Natal, zandile izigameko zokusocongwa kwamakhosi.Ubalule amakhosi amabili aqhamuka esifundeni uThukela asanda kusocongwa phambi kwemindeni yawo, inkosi Zwelakhe Ndaba nenkosi Siphamandla Khumalo."Njengoba kugagulwe igama lami lapha embizweni, uzakwethu wathi ngifuna isihlalo seSilo, abanye abantu abaphuma ezizweni zethu kanye nabanye abantu ababona sengathi uKhabazela uzenza ngcono, kungagcina kukhona into abafuna ukungenza yona.”UMkhize uthe uyasihlonipha iSilo, wathi bazana kusukela kudala."Obaba bethu babefunda esikoleni esisodwa iBhekuzulu College. Akubona ubudlelwano obuqhamuka manje. Yini ke esingenza ukuthi ngingamhloniphi oMdala?”UMkhize uthe into eyenza ukuthi kube wuye osayinela imali yeNgonyama Trust ingoba iSilo asitholakali kalula, wathi futhi akusiyena yedwa osayinayo.Lokhu kushiwo nayiphini likasihlalo webhodi leNgonyama Trust, u-Advocate Linda Zama, nesikhulu esiphezulu kwiNgonyama Trust, u-Advocate Vela Mngwengwe.INkosi uMkhize isho okucishe kufane nokusanda kushiwo uMntwana uMbonisi kaBhekuzulu Zulu emva kokuba iSilo sigagule igama lakhe, sathi uyisitha sesikhwama esigade umhlaba kaZulu, iNgonyama Trust.IMbube ithe ibhodi leNgonyama Trust lasho ukuthi alisebenzeli yona emva kokuhlangana noMntwana uMbonisi.UMntwana uMbonisi usanda kuthi imshaqisile inkulumo yeMbube, waveza nokuthi ibeka impilo yakhe engcupheni.Uthe iMbube imqhatha ngamabomu noZulu, waphika ukuthi unesandla ezinkingeni ezikhungethe iNgonyama Trust.UMntwana uMbonisi, ongumnewabo weSilo uGoodwill Zwelithini kaBhekuzulu, ukuphonsela inselelo ukuqokwa kweSilo uMisuzulu. Uyingxenye yabaNtwana baseNdlunkulu abafaka icala elaphonsela inselelo ukuqokwa kweSilo.Leli cala liseNkantolo yamaCala aDlulisiwe njengoba uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, aliphonsela inselelo isinqumo seNkantolo eNkulu ePitoli, eyachitha isinqumo sakhe sokuvuma ukuqokwa kweSilo.UMntwana uMbonisi wafaka icala eNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu, efuna isivimbelo esizonqanda iSilo ukuba sengamele ukusebenza kweNgonyama Trust kuze kuba kuphothulwa icala lokuqokwa kwaso, nokho isicelo sachithwa.
BAZOHLASELWA emathaveni nasezindaweni ezehlukene abahlanganyela kuzona abesilisa, ukwehlisa isibalo sabahaqwe yigciwane i-HIV ekubeni bengayidli imishanguzo yokuthithibalisa leli gciwane.Lokhu kuvezwe uMnyango wezeMpilo nezinhlangano ezehlukene ezifuqa eyempi yokulwa naleli gciwane ukuze kuthi kushaya u-2030, sibe sesehle ngamandla isibalo sabantu elingasaveli ukuthi banalo igciwane.Bangu-1.1 million abantu okuvela ukuthi abayithathi imishanguzo yokuthithibalisa leli gciwane yize sekuqinisekisiwe ukuthi banalo.Iningi labo ngabesilisa okuthiwa abanye babo bayiqala base beyilaxaza phakathi, abanye kuthiwa abakaze bayidle nhlobo, bagcina ngokuhlola.UNgqongqoshe wezeMpilo, uDkt Aaron Motsoaledi, uthe sekuyisikhathi sokuthi bahlasele ezindaweni lapho kugcwala khona abesilisa.Uthe abesilisa kumele babambe iqhaza empini yokulwa naleli gciwane njengoba abesifazane kuyibona ababadlula ngamalengiso ekuyithatheni imishanguzo nasekuyisebenziseni."Sihlele ukuthi ngoDisemba nonyaka, babe sebedla le mishanguzo la bantu abangu-1.1 million, okwatholakala ukuthi bahaqekile kodwa abangayidli imishanguzo. Iningi labo ngabesilisa, yingakho sizobafuna kuzona zonke izindawo abahamba kuzona, ukuze sibanike amaphasela abo,” kusho uMotsoaledi.Uthe ngoLwesibili, bathule lo mkhankaso wokubathungatha eSoweto, owaziwa nge-HIV Treatment Gap. "Abesifazane yibona abasekhaleni lokulwa naleli gciwane. Emkhankasweni wango-2010, u-65% wabahlola kwatholakala ukuthi banaleli gciwane abesifazane. Kulo mkhankaso wango-2010, sahlola abantu abangu-18 million, u-65% wabo okwakungabesifazane.” Uveze ukuthi bangu-7.8 million abantu abane-HIV kuleli, u-5.9 million udla imishanguzo ama-ARV."Sibhekene nenkinga ekuheheni abesilisa ukuthi bathathe imishanguzo. Abesilisa abayi emitholampilo futhi kuwumqansa ukubanxenxa ukuthi baye kulezi zikhungo.” Indlela athe bazokwenza ngayo njengoba bebaningi abantu okudingeka babathungathe, bazohlukanisa ngezifundazwe besebenzisana nezinhlangano eziningi ezehlukene."Izibhedlela nemitholampilo ziyabazi ukuthi bangobani labo abangayidli imishanguzo. Sizosebenzisa lolo lwazi ukubathungatha, siye lapho bekhona,” kusho uMotsoaledi.UDkt Thembisile Xulu isikhulu esiphezulu se-South African National AIDS Council (SANAC), ekhuluma neNewzroom Afrika izolo, uthe ulwazi luyabatshela ngabayeke imishanguzo kanjalo nalabo abangakaze bayidle.Uthe bayabazi abantu ababafunayo, iningi labo okungabesilisa ngoba yibona abaseqhulwini kulabo ababafuna phansi phezulu."Abesilisa abathandi ukuya emitholampilo, abanye abayi nasemasontweni. Basaba isipili nokuya ezindaweni ezigcwala abesifazane nezingane yingakho begcina bengayi emitholampilo. "Yingakho izinhlelo zethu zibheke kwabesilisa ngqo ngokuthi siye lapho bekhona, okungaba yizindawo abahlanganyela kuzona, kungaba amathaveni kanjalo nakwezinye izindawo. Abesilisa kabazothola imishanguzo yenyanga eyodwa kodwa bazothola eyezinyanga eziyisithupha ngoba abathandi ukuhambela izikhungo zezempilo,” kusho uDkt Xulu.I-Treatment Action Campaign (TAC), isike yahlaba ikhwelo lokuthi kushintshwe indlela okulandwa ngayo imishanguzo ye-HIV, ingalandwa njalo kodwa ilandwe emuva kwezinyanga eziyisithupha.

UYIKHOMBA ngenjumbane iPostbank, ngakubize ngenhlekelele ohlelweni lokushintshwa kwamakhadi akwa-Sassa kwabahola izibonelelo ngaphambi komnqamulajuqu ongenyanga ezayo, uNgqongqoshe wezeNhlalakahle uNksz Nokuzola Tolashe.UNksz Tolashe ugeqe amagula evulela isifuba amalungu ekomiti lezeNhlalakahle ePhalamende ngenkinga yokushintshwa kwamakhadi. Esingakusho nje kubantu bethu ikakhulu abadala abasahola ngamakhadi ayigolide akwa-Sassa, ukuthi siyaxolisa ngale nhlekelele, le nkinga ayidalwanga yithina,” kusho uNksz Tolashe, izolo.Ukhale ngokuthi kwezinye zezikhungo noma sebevukile abanye baze balala khona, kwenziwa amakhadi ambalwa usuku lonke."Kwesinye isikhungo esaya kusona eKapa, kwashaya u-1 emini kusenziwe amakhadi angu-12 kuphela. Umshini wabo ukwazi ukwenza amakhadi ambalwa, noma ungabacebisa abantu ukuthi benze ezinye izinhlelo basuke bengezwa lutho, becabanga ukuthi imali yabo ngeke bayithole,” usho kanje.Uqhube wathi abakwazi ukululeka abantu ukuthi baye emabhange ngoba basolwa ngokuthi bafuna ukweba amakhasimende asePostbank, bawayise emabhange amakhulu."Sagxekwa kwathiwa sicekela phansi iPostbank ngokuthi sithi zikhona ezinye izindlela abantu abangazisebenzisa, bangaze balinde ukuwashintsha ezikhungweni ezehlukene ngoba angifuni ukuqamba amanga, ziningi izinkinga kulezi zikhungo. obeyiphini likanobhala, uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka; nobengumgcinimafa, uDkt Ntuthuko Mahalaba, bonke kabalibonanga elidlalayo, bazokuba amalungu engeziwe ethimba.Ithimba lakhiwe amalungu angu-67, ngokwejwayelekile isigungu esiphezulu esifundazweni siba namalungu angu-35.Leli thimba lixube yonke inhlobo kapende njengoba kukhona izingwevu kanye nabebengabaholi bentsha.Kubaholi abadala abasethimbeni ngoMnuz Sbusiso Ndebele, Dkt Sibongiseni Dhlomo noNkk Maggie Govender.Kulabo ababengabaholi bentsha abaqokelwe ethimbeni kubalwa uMnuz Thanduxolo Sabelo noMnuz Kwazi Mshengu.Umhlaziyi wezepolitiki waseNyuvesi yaKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Zakhele Ndlovu, uthe noma bangashintshwa kuze kube bangaki abaholi, i-ANC izoqhubeka nokuhluleka izinketho.UNdlovu uthe i-ANC yaqala ukwehlelwa ukweseka kusaphethe bona laba baholi abaqokelwe ezikhundleni."Abantu abasayivoteli i-ANC ngenxa yokuthi ayizigcini izethembiso. Abantu bacasulwe ukungawatholi amathuba emisebenzi. Ukubuyiswa kwabaholi abadala kuzoyisiza ngani i-ANC? Kuzokwenza muphi umehluko emuntwini omusha ongasebenzi?”UNdlovu uthe akujwayelekile ukuqokwa kwabantu abaningi kangaka ethimbeni, wathi mhlawumbe inhloso ukuvimba ukuthi kungabi khona abaholi abazohlubukela kwi-MK.Usizi belubhalwe emehlweni kwabanye babaholi abehliswe ezikhundleni, abanye bazamile ukuziqinisa ngesikhathi bebona abezindaba.UMbalula uthe amalungu eqembu akwamukele ukuhlelwa kabusha kobuholi."Ngempelasonto, besinemihlangano kuzo zonke izifunda zaKwaZulu-Natal, lapho sazise khona amalungu enhlangano ngokuhlelwa kabusha kobuholi. Yonke imihlangano ihambe kahle. Sithanda ukubonga amalungu enhlangano ngokuziphatha kahle. Akekho umuntu ofike emihlanganweni ephethe ocelemba.”UMbalula uthe balandele yonke imigomo yeqembu ngesikhathi behlela kabusha ubuholi, wathi abacabangi ukuthi kukhona abangaya enkantolo beyophikisana nokuhlelwa kabusha kobuholi."Uma kukhona abafuna ukuya enkantolo, kulungile sesohlangana khona.”UMbalula uthe ubuholi obusha bunikezwe izinyanga eziyisithupha ukuba buvuselele izinhlaka zeqembu."Manje siphelile isikhathi sokuthi silokhu sibalisa, sekuyisikhathi sokuthi sakhe kabusha i-ANC.”Ubuholi obusha buthe buwulungele umsebenzi.URadebe uthe bazokuba nomhlangano wabo wokuqala ngoMsombuluko, lapho bezoqhamuka neqhinga lokubuyisa bonke labo abashiye inhlangano.UMdidiyeli we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Jeff Radebe, uNobhala Jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, noMgqugquzeli wenhlangano esifundazweni, uMnuz Mike Mabuyakhulu, bekhuluma nabezindaba, izolo Isithombe: Sibonelo Ngcobo/Independent MediaUNobhala Jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, wethule ithimba elizohola i-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMgqugquzeli wethimba kuzokuba uMnuz Mike Mabuyakhulu, uNkk Nomusa Dube-Ncube yena uzokuba iPhini loMgqugquzeli Isithombe: Sibonelo Ngcobo/Independent MediaKWETHULE ubuholi obusha be-ANC KwaZulu-Natal. UMENGAMELI Cyril Ramaphosa usenxenxe abaholi bomdabu ukuthi basebenzisane nophiko lwezinhlekelele kuleli, ekululekeni abantu ukuthi bangakhi ezindaweni ezihamba amanzi noma eziseduzane nemifula.URamaphosa uthe ukuguquguquka kwesimo sezulu, kushiya umonakalo omkhulu emiphakathini ehlukene.Uthe muva nje, imvula ebihambisana nezikhukhula ishiye kukhalwa KwaZulu-Natal. Idlule nemiphefumulo ecela ku-10."Iqhaza labaholi bomdabu libaluleke kakhulu ekubambisaneni nohulumeni ekuxwayiseni umphakathi ngokuguquguquka kwesimo sezulu okunomthelela ongemuhle. Imvula e-KZN icekele phansi ingqalasizinda nemizi kwashona nabantu. Sizwelana nemindeni eyehlelwe yilo mshophi,” kusho uRamaphosa ekhuluma ngesikhathi evula iNdlu yobuHoli boMdabu ePhalamende izolo.Uthe uma abantu begwema ukwakha ezindaweni ezingafanele ngeke bakhahlanyezwe yizikhukhula.URamaphosa ubuye wagxeka nezehlakalo zokusocongwa kwabaholi bomdabu."Siyazigxeka izehlakalo ezandayo zokubulawa kwabaholi bomdabu. Izinhlaka zomthetho zisebenza ngamandla ukunqanda lesi sihlava,” kusho uRamaphosa.Ubalule nokuthi abaholi bomdabu yibona abahlala emiphakathini ebhuqwa yindlala nsuku zonke."Le miphakathi iyona ethwele kanzima, ibhuqwa yindlala iphinde ibhekane nezinselelo zokuthi ayisebenzi. Izindawo zenu zibhekene nengwadla yokungathuthuki,” kusho uRamaphosa.Ukhale nangombango okhona ebuholini bomdabu."Isikhathaza kakhulu eyemibango eba khona emindenini uma sekukhotheme inkosi, sekumele kungene omunye esikhundleni. UMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu, unezinhlelo zokusiza imindeni esuke ibanga. Lolu hlelo selusize imindeni engu-16, ngokwakha uhlelo okumele lulandelwe uma kukhotheme inkosi. Ngihlaba ikhwelo emakhosini ukuthi abe yingxenye yalolu hlelo.” Uphinde wawanxusa ukuthi abe yingxenye yomkhankaso wokulwa nodlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane nezingane."Amakhosi akumele avumele ukuthi kuhlukunyezwe abesifazane nezingane, kuthiwe wusiko. Udlame akulona usiko ngakho kumele lugxekwe,” kusho uRamaphosa.Uthe kunohlelo oluholwa nguMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana, lokubuyekeza ekahulumeni wasekhaya."Ngijube iPhini likaMengameli uMnuz Paul Mashatile, ukuthi axoxe namakhosi ukuthi abe yingxenye yalolu hlelo ngoba sifuna umbono wawo.”
UMPHATHISWA emnyangweni wezokuBusa ngokuBambizana neziNdaba Zomdabu KwaZulu-Natal uMfundisi Thulasizwe Buthelezi kulindeleke ukuthi ahambele eLamontville emini namhlanje ukuhlola isimo kulandela ukubhubha kwabahlanu abamuke namanzi yakule ndawo ngoLwesibili ebusuku.Abezimo eziphuthumayo babizelwe eLamontville ngezintatha, ngemibiko yabantu abahlanu abamuke namanzi kule ndawo. UNtombikhona Mhlongo osindele ngesikhathi umama wakhe, umakhelwane nezingane zakamakhelwane zimuka namanzi utshele abezindaba ukuthi bebebheke ukuthi amanzi azoqhamuka ngasemfuleni kodwa aqhamuka ngasemseleni, nokuyinto ebafake kwenkulu ingcindezi bezama ukuwelela ngaphesheya komgwaqo endaweni ephakeme.Isithombe sicashunwe kwi-video Sibonelo Ngcobo"Umama no-Anti abakwazanga ukubambelela ezihlahleni ngoba badala futhi amanzi ebeza mawala esefika ngasemqaleni, sibabuke bemuka nezingane ezintathu. Nathi besizomuka ukube akufikanga abafana bendawo basidonsa ngentambo, sasinda kanjalo,” kusho yena.Izidumbu zalaba zitholakale emabhishi amabili ahlukene, esisodwa sitholwe e-Ansteys Beach, esinye satholakala eBrighton Beach (owesifazane), izingane ezimbili okungumfana nentombazane zona zitholakale eCuttings Beach ngaseMerebank. Besingakaqinisekiswa esowesifazane oneminyaka engu-60 omuke nalaba.Yize sisikhulu isililo kule ndawo, kodwa iLamontville akuyona yodwa ekhahlamezekile ngenxa yemvula, umnyango kaCogta uthi amathimba ezinhlekelele ahlonze nalezi zindawo njengezikhungathekile eningizimu yesifundazwe. KUBUKEKA kudungeke umlayezo odabeni olushicilelwe ngoMsombuluko ngaphansi kwesihloko esithi "Isiphakamiso sokuncisha izibonelelo zikahulumeni abangavoti", kwezwakala sengathi lokhu kungumbono wesishabasheki esifundisa ngentando yabantu, uNksz Mbali Ntuli.Empeleni indaba yezibonelelo ibingumbono othushuke ezingxoxweni ebezivutha uphondo ngesikhathi abe-Independent Electoral Commission (IEC) benomcimbi wokugqugquzela intsha ukuba ibhalisele ukuvota.Kulo mcimbi obungoLwesihlanu, eMsunduzi Athletics Club, eMgungundlovu, uNksz Ntuli owake waba yilungu lesiShayamthetho KwaZulu-Natal uphendule lesi siphakamiso ngencazelo ethi umbono onjengalowo udinga abashayi bomthetho okungamaqembu epolitiki.UNksz Ntuli, osekhaleni lenhlangano yamalungelo abantu, iGround Work Collective, wexwayise ngokuthi leli qhinga lingadala ukukhuluma."Lowo mbono ungashiya imibuzo eminingi ngoba kungabe sekusho ukuthi abantu baphoqiwe ukuthi bavote,” usho kanje uNksz Ntuli.Isikhulu sakwa-IEC esisohlakeni lezokuxhumana nezinhlaka, uMnuz Mmakgabo Ramatlhodi, sithe ukushintsha umthetho kungadinga ukuba iningi lamaqembu ezepolitiki livumelane.URamatlhodi uthe ukungaphumi ngobuningi kwabantu uma kunezinketho kunomthelela ongemuhle ekuphathweni kwezwe.Uthe kufanele kugxekwe ukungaphumi kwabantu ngobuningi okhethweni lwangonyaka owedlule ngokuhlehla kwenkulumo yesabelomali, obekufanele yethulwe uNgqongqoshe wezeZimali, uMnuz Enoch Godongwana, ngeledlule."Ngenxa yokuthi abantu abaphumanga ngobuningi, sizithola singaphansi kwesimo lapho khona isabelomali singazange sethulwe.”Isikhulu se-IEC KwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Ntombifuthi Masinga, sithe bazosebenzisana nezikhungo zemfundo ephakeme kanye nezikole ukugqugquzela intsha ukuba ibhalisele ukuvota okhethweni lohulumeni basekhaya oluzokuba ngonyaka ozayo.Isolezwe lithi yobe kuNksz Ntuli nabanye abathole umbiko wethu unganambithisiseki ekubeni lesi sithangami besimayelana nokufundisa abantu ngobumqoka bokubamba iqhaza ekuphathweni kwezwe.
INGASE igcine ezinkantolo eyamalungu ebhodi iNgonyama Trust, emuva kwezinsolo zenkohlakalo.UDkt Thandiwe Dlamini ilungu lebhodi elingamiswanga yiSilo namalungu "amiswa” angase agcine ngokuyisana ezinkantolo ngezinsolo ezenziwe nguDkt Dlamini, zenkohlakalo.UDkt Dlamini wasola amanye amalungu ebhodi ngenkohlakalo nokungaphathi ngendlela ngesikhathi ekhuluma emhlanganweni obubizwe yiSilo, eMashobeni, ngoLwesihlanu.Sikhuluma ne-Independent Media, isikhulu esiphezulu sebhodi uMnuz Vela Mngwengwe, sithe ibhodi lizohlangana maduzane lapho lizophendula ngezinsolo zikaDkt Dlamini.Akazange ayichithe eyokuthi bangase bathathe nezinyathelo zomthetho, ngezinto azisho."Sizohlangana sibheke izinsolo azisho, asikwazi okwamanje ukuqagela ukuthi sizowuthatha yini umgudu wezomthetho. Izinsolo zakhe zidicilela phansi isithunzi,” usho kanje.ISilo sachithwa ekumiseni la malungu ebhodi njengoba amandla kwathiwa akungqongqoshe wezoMhlaba.UDkt Dlamini uthe amanye amalungu ebhodi, asola iMbube ngokuthi yaziqokela ekubeni usihlalo webhodi ngoba ifuna ukuthatha ngozwane ekubeni kungamalungu ebhodi anecala lokweba.Uphinde wathi amalungu asola iMbube ngokudayisela umngani ipulazi lesikhwama eliseMhlali.UDkt Dlamini udalule igama likaMngwengwe nobhekele izezimali uSiyamdumisa Vilakazi, njengabachitha ubuholi beSilo. Wengeze ngokuthi laba bagodla imibiko yezezimali, kanti uVilakazi waqashwa kungafanele.UDkt Dlamini uveze nokuthi isikhulu esiphezulu safuna imali engu-R1 million yokwenza olunye uhlelo, kwathi obhekele izezimali wafuna u-R600 000, ngaphandle kokwazisa iSilo."Inkohlakalo eyayenzeka, iSilo kumele sivule amacala,” kusho uDkt Dlamini.UDkt Dlamini ukhale ngokuthi noma ayengahambisani nezinye izinto kodwa babemchitha ngevoti abaseka uMngwengwe noVilakazi.Usengaphansi kweso labaqaphi uDkt Dlamini emva kokuba iSilo sicele ukuthi ahlinzekwe ngonogada emuva kokuveza inkohlakalo eyenzeka kwibhodi, waphinde wadalula amagama abantu esidlangalaleni. Ezinye ngeNgonyama Trust ekhasini 8.
KUNOVALO ngokuqothwa kofakazi abawokhiye ecaleni lokusocongwa kukaloyo owabe enguSihlalo we-ANC KwaMakhutha, uMnuz Smanga Celimpilo Zulu (32).Umufi okuthiwa wayephinde abe ngusomabhizinisi, wadutshulwa wafa ese-salon yakhe engaphandle kwaseCostal College, KwaMakhutha.Isigameko kuvela ukuthi senzeka ngo-Okthoba 12, 2020 ngezithuba zantambama. Abanye ababili ababekade benaye umufi baphuthunyiswa esibhedlela bagcina bewuphonsile umbalane.Kusolwa ukuthi ukusocongwa kwakhe kwakuyamene nenhlese yezepolitiki. Ngemuva kwezinsuku ezine kuya kwezinhlanu bakhalelwa ngamasongo kaSigonyela abasilisa abathathu okuyibona abangabamangalelwa kuleli cala.Lapha sikhuluma ngoMnuz Sikhalo Mzulwini ongummangalelwa wokuqala, uMnuz Vusimuzi Khuzwayo ongummangalelwa wesibili kanye noMnuz Nkanyiso Maphumulo ongummangalelwa wesithathu.Laba basolwa ngokuthi yibona abadubula umufi wafa ngosuku lwesigameko maqede bashaya bachitha ngemoto i-Nissan Almera empunga.ENkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini bekulindeleke ukuthi liqale ukuqulwa okokuqala leli cala kodwa kwagcina kungenzekanga lokho.Kuvele ukuthi kuneminingingwane emqoka kakhulu okusamele abamele uMbuso nabameli babasolwa baqale baxhumane ngayo.Ngesikhathi bengena enkantolo abasolwa bebezifihle ubuso ngamakhuphahethi.Umthombo osondelene kakhulu naleli cala upotsholezele Isolezwe ukuthi liqala ukuqulwa nje vele sekunofakazi ababili abawukhiye esebelele kobandayo okuyinto umndeni kamufi ongeneme ngayo.Kuvela ukuthi bobabili labo fakazi babulawe ngokudutshulwa. Ufakazi wokuqala yiloyo okuthiwa wayekhona endaweni yesigameko nobekulindeleke ukuthi abe ngufakazi oqanda ikhanda uma sekuqala ukuqulwa kwaleli cala.Ufakazi wesibili kuvela ukuthi ngowesilisisa obesondelene nabo abamangalelwa futhi owatholwa nesibhamu okukholakala ukuthi sasetshenziswa mzukwane kubulawa uZulu.Wabe esegwetshwa iminyaka emihlanu kodwa wagcina esehlala ejele iminyaka emithathu nohhafu. "Kuthe esephuma ejele bamane bambulala ngoba bebazi ukuthi ungufakazi obaluleke kangakani kuMbuso mayelana naleli cala,'' kuchaza umthombo.Umthombo uveze ukuthi ummangalelwa wesibili uyena "owanxenxa ummangalelwa wokuqala nowesithathu ukuba bamlekelele kusocongwe umufi”.Umthombo ukholwa ukuthi kukhona ungqondongqondo ongemuva kwaleli cala nokunguyena owakhipha umyalelo wokuthi kusocongwe uZulu."Kodwa uzogcina etholakele ukuthi ungubani futhi lokhu kuhlela kwakungani akwenza,'' usho kanjena.Uthe ubufakazi balokhu ukuthi abamangalelwa bobathathu bamelwe abameli beqophelo eliphezulu nabanolwazi olunzulu lwezamacala asezinkantolo ekubeni bengasebenzi.Ngaphakathi enkantolo umsolwa wokuqala uMzulwini kuke kwanesikhathi lapho abebhoka khona ngolaka ekhala ngokuthi akayithandi into yokuthi uMbuso nomphenyi wecala bedane beya kunina beyomphonsa ngemibuzo mayelana naleli cala.Isolezwe litholile ukuthi lo mmangalelwa uzama ukunqanda indaba yokuthi kungahlaluki enkantolo ukuthi ngekabani imoto eyasetshenziswa ngosuku lwesigameko.Kuvela ukuthi imoto yayikade ishayelwe uyena ummangalelwa wokuqala kodwa akusiyona eyakhe ngekanina.Ngaphambilini i-ANC yezwakalisa okukhulu ukudumala ngokubulawa kukaZulu.Icala kulindekele ukuba liqhubeke namhlanje.
BASOLA isandla semfene ngengozi yomgwaqo okuthiwa idlule nomphefumulo kathishanhloko wasesikoleni iMlokothwa High, eNhlophenkulu, KwaNongoma ngoMgqibelo.UMnuz Vusumuzi Khumalo (59) waseNkonjeni, eMahlabathini, oLundi, kuthiwa ubezigijimela eceleni komgwaqo u-N2 ngaseMthunzini ngesikhathi eshayiswa yimoto engaziwa, maqede yashaya yachitha.Umthombo wangaphakathi esikoleni utshele Isolezwe izolo ukuthi basele nemibuzo ngesikhathi okwenzeke ngaso isigameko.Udalule ukuthi kwenzeka isigameko nje, ngoLwesine bekuphothulwa ukuvivinywa kwezinkampani ezifuna ukuthatha umsebenzi wokuphekela abafundi abahlala ngaphakathi esikoleni.Uthe lokhu kulandela ukungenzi kahle kwenkampani ebisiyenze lo msebenzi kusuka ngo-2002.Ebalula okunye kwakho uthe abafundi bese bengasazitholi izithelo nemifino ngendlela efanele, isikole sesithola izikhalo kubazali babafundi njengoba belukhokhela eceleni lolu hlelo.Uthe ukufakwa kwesikhangiso sethenda yalo msebenzi ngoDisemba 2024 nokuqala kokuhlunga kule nyanga akwehlanga kahle kwabanye.Ukhulume nangomdonsiswano webhasi okuthiwa yathengwa umnikazi wenkampani eyayiphekela isikole eyithengela isikole, njengokwesivumelwano sokusebenzisana."Isivumelwano sasithi uma enikwa ithenda yokuphekela izingane ezihlala ngaphakathi, kukhona okufanele akwenzele isikole. Kwavunyelwana nge-mini bus, useqedile ukuyikhokhela, kusuke umdonsiswano sekufanele alethe i-logbook yayo esikoleni, engasafuni,” kusho umthombo."Asisho ukuthi sithini kodwa nje sizibuza imibuzo ukuthi ingozi yase yenzeka ngesikhathi esibucayi kangaka lapho sekushoda ukuthi kumenyezelwe ophume phambili kwabebehlungwa bese inkampani ekhona inikwa inyanga ukuthi iphume (serve notice),” kusho umthombo.Uthe umufi uyijwayele indawo abegijima kuyo, akuwenzi umqondo ukuthi ubengaba sephutheni, aze ashayiswe yimoto.Uthe kwakhona ukuthi ithi uma imoto isimshayisile bese iyabaleka, nakho kubashiya nemibuzo yokuthi umshayeli yini ebalekile uma 'bekuyiphutha’."Asikukholwa nhlobo ukuthi lena bekuyingozi ejwayelekile,” usho kanje.Uchaze umufi njengomuntu obebizelwe ebuthisheleni.Uthe uqale ebuthisheleni ngo-2006, esebuya ekusebenzeleni izinkampani zezimali ezehlukene, okukhona kuzo ne-FNB KwaNongoma."Wagcina eshiya kwezezimali, wathi ufezekisa iphupho lokufundisa. Ubewusizo kothisha, ebapha indlebe nezeluleko uma bedinga lokho. Nakubafundi ngokunjalo, ubevele aphenduke umzali,” kusho umthombo.Ubalule ukuthi isikole besithola imiphumela engaphezu kuka-90% ebuholini bakhe, siqoqa izindondo emazingeni ehlukene, okukhona kuzo isifunda, isifundazwe nakuzwelonke.Umfowabo kamufi, uMnuz Mduduzi "Mthofi” Khumalo uthe baphatheke kabi ngesehlakalo njengoba umufi ebewuthanda umsebenzi wakhe, umndeni nenkonzo yaseLuthela lapho abewumshumayeli khona."Ubewubaba ekhaya, aphinde abe wubaba nasesikoleni,” kusho uKhumalo.Uthe bona bathintwe amaphoyisa, ebazisa ngesigameko, athi atshelwe umuntu obedlula, ombone elele phansi."Uwumuntu ojwayele ukuvuka ngabo-6 ekuseni, ahambe ayozigijimela. Esikutholile ukuthi ingozi imehlele esebuya eza ekhaya,” kusho uKhumalo.Uqhube wathi bazizwile izinkulumo zabantu abashaya amakhala ngokufa kwakhe."Asifuni ukukufaka ekhanda lokho. Sizodedela amaphoyisa ukuthi enze umsebenzi wawo. Sethemba ukuthi ngoba loya umgwaqo unamakhamera azobhekwa nawo uma sekuphenywa lezi zinsolo,” kusho uKhumalo.UNobhala we-Sadtu e-KZN, uNksz Nomarashiya Caluza uthe bafe olwembiza."NgoLweishlanu i-Sadtu ibiklomelisa izikole ezenze kahle. Isikole sakhe asisalanga. Kubuhlungu ukuhamba kwabantu abafana naye. Sidlulisa amazwi enduduzo emndenini, esikoleni nasemphakathini.”UMnyango wezeMfundo esifundazweni udlulise amazwi enduduzo emndenini.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa aseMthunzini avule icala lokubulala ngokungenhloso kulandela isigameko sokushayiswa yimoto kowesilisa obezilolonga."Imibiko ithi umsolwa uvele wabaleka, uphenyo luyaqhubeka,” kusho uNetshiunda.
INHLANGANO yabashayeli bamaloli, i-All Truck Drivers Forum Allied South Afrika ihlele ukuba nemashi ngoLwesihlanu, ezobe iseBayhead Road Old Weighbridge, eThekwini, ihambisa uhlu lwezikhalo kwaTransnet.Le nhlangano izomasha-nje ikhala ngokungenisa kwabokufika kule mboni nanokuthi iningi labo kalinazo izimvume zokuba kuleli.UMnuz Richard Bhengu ongumhleli wemashi KwaZulu-Natal ekhuluma neSolezwe, uthe njengoba bemasha bakhala ngokungena kwabokufika echwebeni okuyingxenye enkulu yomnotho waseNingizimu Afrika."Njengoba sihambisa uhlu lwezikhalazo zethu, yindlela yokubonakalisa ukuhlonipha umthetho nanokuthi siyazi ukuthi i-Transnet kungalunga okuningi uma ingenza njengoba sifuna ukuthi wonke umuntu ongena echwebeni ngeloli abe nemvume yalo, imvume enemininingwane yakhe ephelele nanokuthi uqhamuka kuliphi izwe," kusho uBhengu.Uthe kumele kwenziwe ngendlela efanayo njengakwamanye amachweba afana nelasePort Elizabeth (Gqeberha) njengoba bengasangeni abokufika."Amaloli akwazi ukungena yilawo aqhamuka emazweni awo futhi eshayelwa abokufika abasuka kulawo mazwe. Laba esisebenza nabo abaqashwa abomdabu waseNdiya, yibo esibhekana nabo ngqo ukuthi bengabe besakwazi ukungena ngale kwezimvume. "Ezintweni esibhekana nazo ezingalungile ukuthi uma kunesivimbamgwaqo amaphoyisa ehlola ukuthi izimoto zikufanele yini ukuba sengwaqweni, bona bayabaleka amaloli bewashiye kanjalo.""Engxenyeni yemashi yethu, simema wonke umuntu kungaba ungumshayeli weloli noma nabasesekayo ukuthi abaphume ngobuningi babo. "Sizophinde sibanike nomnqamulamjuqu echwebeni wokuthi izimpendulo sizidinga nini. Uma behluleka ukwenza lokho kuyophoqeleka ukuthi sinyuse igiya lethu," usho kanje.
UFUNA umthetho usebenze, anikwe isijeziso esimfanele owesilisa owamshaya eyosiza osebenza kwabezimo eziphuthumayo esibhedlela iMontebello, eNdwedwe.Umsolwa kubikwa ukuthi uzovela eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseNdwedwe, ebhekene necala lokushaya ngenhloso yokulimaza.Ngokusho kukamgilwa, uMnuz Mfanafuthi Luthuli, isigameko senzeka ngasekuphelini kuka-Okthoba, ngonyaka odlule, umsolwa waze waboshwa ngoDisemba.Elandisa ngesigameko, uthe yena nozakwabo babizelwa endaweni yesigameko eSigedleni, eNdwedwe, kulandela ukugingqika kwemoto nabantu abane.Uthe bafica abathathu belele phansi, owesine emile, engalimele ndawo."Njengenjwayelo nangokulandela indlela yokusebenza, sabheka ukuthi ubani kwabalele phansi olimele kakhulu, saqala ngaye,” kusho uLuthuli.Uthe yilapho lona wesilisa owayengalimele, wababhozomela khona, efuna ukuthi bayeke ababemsiza, baqale ngoyise kuqala."Ngathi ngizama ukumchazela ukuthi umthetho uthi kufanele ngiqale ngalo olimele kakhulu kuqala, kwabe sengizithintele, wangingena ngequpha, kwaqhuma izinhlansi,” kusho uLuthuli.Uthe lona wesilisa, wagcina ethola ukuthi wuye obeshayela imoto, waqhubeka nokumshaya, waze wamlandela nenduku."Wangidinda ngayo ngaze ngabaleka ngangena emotweni, sasuka sahamba nozakwethu wesifazane enganginaye,” usho kanje.Uthe babuye bacabanga ukuthi kuzosolwa bona ekugcineni ngokushiya abalimele kanjalo, ngakho babuyela emuva, bayobasiza.Uthe akabange esaqhubeka nokulwa lona wesilisa kodwa wayelokhu ebasabise njalo ngokubaceba ezikhulwini eziphezulu zoMnyango wezeMpilo, okukhona kuzo ngisho noMphathiswa uNkk Nomagugu Simelane, wathi emva kokuzishiya ezandleni zodokotela iziguli, wanikela emaphoyiseni eyovula icala. Udalule ukuthi udaba lwabikwa ezinhlakeni ezifanele zomnyango.Uthe umsolwa, okuvele ukuthi nakuba engowaseNdwedwe kodwa usezinze eNanda, nokuholele ekutheni kube yima eboshwa ngoDisemba, wathi uyabufuna ubulungiswa ngesigameko njengoba impilo yabo ihlale isengcupheni uma beyonikezela ngosizo oluphuthumayo."Ngiyabufuna ubulungiswa ngalesi sehlo ngoba akukho okubheke eceleni engakwenza. Ngalandela umgomo esawufundiswa, wokuthi uma sifika endaweni yesigameko, sifike sihlole iziguli ezilimele, bese siqala ngaleso esilimele kakhulu,” kulandisa uLuthuli.Uthe uyise kamgilwa wayehuzuke kancane edolweni futhi edle amanzi amponjwana."Kulaba abanye kwakukhona ababephuke ezindaweni ezibucayi. Kwakuphoqa ukuthi siqale ngabo,” kusho uLuthuli.Uqhube wathi uzwe kancane ukuthi umsolwa nomndeni wakhe sebefuna kuxoxwe, nokho wathi akasazimisele."Babenethuba lonke lokuthi bangifune baze bangithole, masinyane emva kwesigameko kodwa bangakwenza lokho. Bathule isikhathi eside.”Uthe akayikholwa eyokuthi bayaxolisa ngempela, waphinde wathi abantu kufanele bazi ukuthi nabo bangabantu futhi basuke benza umsebenzi wabo, abafundisiwe ngawo."Asikho isidingo sokuthi sishaywe. Ngokusuku lwesigameko, asifikanga sekwedlule isikhathi, safika kahle, yena wadinwa ukuthi asiqalanga ngomzali wakhe njengoba ayefuna,” kusho uLuthuli.
UKUXOLISA kuze kube kabili ngokwethuka uNobhala Jikelele weMK, uMnuz Floyd Shivambu, akuzange kuyikhiphe obishini indodakazi yomholi weqembu, uNkk Duduzile Zuma-Sambudla.I-MK iyaqhubeka nohlelo lokuthathela uNkk Zuma-Sambudla izinyathelo zokuqondiswa ubugwegwe.Lokhu kuvezwe iPhini likaNobhala Jikelele weMK, uNksz Nombuso Mkhize, ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba, eGoli izolo,UNksz Mkhize uthe umhlangano wabaholi beqembu obungesonto eledlule uvumelane ngokuthi iqembu liqhubeke nohlelo lokuthathela uNkk Zuma-Sambudla izinyathelo zokuqondiswa ubugwegwe.UNkk Zuma-Sambudla wachapha uShivambu ngenhlamba embhalweni awufaka ezinkundleni zokuxhumana.UNkk Zuma-Sambudla waze waxolisa kabili ngokwethuka uShivambu emva komyalelo womholi weqembu, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, owaveza ukuthi uzothathelwa izinyathelo zokuqondiswa ubugwegwe, aphinde akhishwe ezikhundleni uma engaxolisi ngokushesha kuShivambu.Exolisa okokuqala, uNkk Zuma-Sambudla akazange axolise kuShivambu kodwa waxolisa kuZuma nakumalungu eqembu.Wabuye walifaka igama likaShivambu ngesikhathi esexolisa okwesibili.UNksz Mkhize uthe ngesikhathi kunomhlangano wabaholi beqembu, ngoLwesithathu, uZuma wakubeka kwacaca ukuthi abaphula imigomo yeqembu kufanele bathathelwe izinyathelo zokuqondiswa ubugwegwe."UZuma ukubeke kwacaca ukuthi i-MK inemigomo ecacile, okufanele ihlonishwe yiwo yiwo wonke amalungu eqembu. Uthe uma kukhona abaphula imigomo yeqembu kufanele bathathelwe izinyathelo zokuqondiswa ubugwegwe. Ngithi angikuveze ukuthi siyawulandela loyo myalelo kaZuma. "Sesiqalile ukulandela lokho okushiwo imigomo yeqembu. Isigaba sesithupha somthethosisekelo weqembu siyasho ukuthi iluphi uhlelo okufanele lulandelwe uma kukhona ilungu leqembu elenza okuphambene. Imigomo isho nokuthi isiphi isigwebo esitholwa umuntu ophule imithetho.”UNksz Mkhize uthe ngokomthetho weMK, kufanele kuhanjiswe umbiko ehhovisi likaShivambu, ozochaza amacala kaNkk Zuma-Sambudla.UNksz Mkhize uthe emva kwalokho ihhovisi likaShivambu lizokube selihambisa umbiko ehhovisi lomshushisi weqembu."Odabeni lukaNkk Zuma-Sambudla, ngithanda ukusho ukuthi luyaqhubeka uhlelo lokuqondiswa ubugwegwe.”Ekhuluma esithangamini esifanayo, uShivambu uthe sesiphelile isikhathi sokuzenzela umathanda kwi-MK."Bazothathelwa izinyathelo bonke abenza okuphambene nomthetho. Ngeke sibabekezelele abantu abazenzela umathanda. Le nto yokungaziphathi kahle kwamalungu eqembu ibeka ikusasa leqembu engcupheni. Uma singabhekile iqembu lizoshabalala.”
USELE nenqwaba yemibuzo engenazimpendulo umndeni wowesilisa waKwaZiphethe, KwaNongoma, okuthiwa ufe ngokuzinquma intamo ngebhodlela ngoMgqibelo.Isidumbu sikaMnuz Banele Mbhele (22) kuthiwa sitholwe sidindilizile endaweni yamabhasi eSikhaleni, eMpangeni.Ngokusho kukamalume wakhe, uMnuz Hlupha Zulu, umufi okuthiwa ubenabangani abangodokotela, uthathane nabo KwaNongoma kwayiwa eSikhaleni."Elinye ilungu lomndeni lithole ucingo emuntwini othe uyiphoyisa, esazisa ngesigameko,” kusho uZulu.Uthe ziningi izinto ezikhulunywayo ngokufa kukamshana wakhe ezenza basale nemibuzo.Kuvela ukuthi babehleli kumnandi kuphuzwa notshwala ubusuku bonke."Sizwa kuthiwa uphumele emnyango entathakusa lapho bebehleli khona, ewumuntu oyochama wangabe esabuya, njengoba egcine etholwa edindilizile,” kusho uZulu.Uthe okubaxakayo ukuthi umuntu uzibulala kanjani ngokuthi azinqume yena."Kithina leyo nto ayiwenzi umqondo,” kusho uZulu.Uthe bezwe nokuthi bakhona abathi bambonile ephethe ibhodlela ezinquma, wabuza ukuthi kuthe uma bembona enza lokho, bangamnqanda ngani?.Uqhube wathi okunye okubaxakayo ukuthi kubo bonke abangani abenabo, akasekho noyedwa osesondele kubo ukuzochaza ukuthi kwenzekeni."Indawo yaseSikhaleni akuyona eyangakubo, akayijwayele. Yini ebingamenza ukuthi aphume adwanguze kuyo ngokukhululeka?” kubuza uZulu.Uphinde wabuza nokuthi bathule bathini bebona kuqhubeka isikhathi eside engasabuyi ekubeni ebebatshele ukuthi usayochama."Kuningi okushiya imibuzo lana,” usho kanje.Uthe umufi ubesebenza enkampanini evala imigodi (potholes) emgwaqweni kodwa ezwana nabantu abangodokotela.UZulu uthe bona udokotela abamazi kahle oqashe endaweni (KwaZiphethe).Uthe naye akakaze avele kubona bewumndeni, wathi abakuzwayo ukuthi uyise (kaDkt oqashile) oze wabikela amaphoyisa ngesigameko."Yini eholele ekutheni labo abenabo, kungabi yibo ababikela amaphoyisa? Yini edale ukuthi basabe ukuziyela bona emaphoyiseni?” usho kanje.Uthe bathole ukuthi ngesikhathi kusukwa KwaNongoma kubhekwe eSikhaleni, bekuhanjwa ngemoto eyodwa, okuhlale kutetemukwa ngayo uma abangani behamba izindlela zabo.Kuze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela amaphoyisa engakayiphenduli imibuzo ngalolu daba. Kuvela ukuthi kunodokotela abayiqembu elaziwayo eZululand abajwayele ukuhlangana bazijabulise ngamaphathi ezindaweni ezehlukene.
I-IFP inqumele iBhange loMbuso, i-SA Reserve Bank, ugwayi katiki ngesikhathi inombhikisho wokuphikisana nesicelo sokuvalwa kweThala.Amalungu e-IFP athe afuna kumiswe izinhlelo zokuvalwa kweThala, athi afuna nokuthi leli bhange linikezwe ilayisensi yokuba yibhange khona lizosebenza ngokukhululeka.Izinkumbi zamalungu e-IFP zibe nombhikisho eThekwini.Imashi iqale eKing Dinuzulu Park, yaze yayophelela emahhovisi eBhange loMbuso akuleli dolobha.Kume yonke into ngesikhathi amalungu e-IFP ehamba emigwaqweni esenkabeni yeTheku.Ikusasa leThala alicaci njengoba ngoLwesihlanu kuzolalelwa isicelo sokuba livalwe.Isicelo sokuba kuvalwe Ithala sizolalelwa eNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu, kanti sifakwe wuhlaka olungaphansi kweBhange loMbuso, i-Prudential Authority.Umholi we-IFP, uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa, uthe bayaphikisana nemizamo yokuvalwa kweThala.UHlabisa uthe ukuvalwa kweThala kuzokhinyabeza umnotho wesifundazwe iKwaZulu-Natal."IThala lasungulelwa ukufukula abantu abamnyama kwezomnotho ngesikhathi sobandlululo. Nangaphansi kwentando yeningi Ithala liqhubekile ngokwelekelela abantu abangakwazi ukuthola uxhaso emabhange amakhulu."IThala liyatholakala ezindaweni zasemakhaya nasemalokishini. Emadolobheni amancane Ithala kuphela ibhange elikhona. Kulawo madolobha Ithala liyithemba lokugcina ngisho kulabo abahola izibonelelo zikahulumeni.”UHlabisa uthe njengoba amakhasimende aseThala engakwazi ukukhipha imali yawo baningi kakhulu abakhahlamezekile."Sizwelana nemindeni eminingi engakwazi ukukhipha imali. Sizwelana nalabo abathola izibonelelo zikahulumeni okuvele kwathathwa imininingwane yabo ngaphandle kwemvume, yayonikezwa elinye ibhange.”UHlabisa uthe bafuna ukuthi Ithala linikezwe ilayisensi yokuba yibhange khona lizokwazi ukuqhubeka lisebenze."Sifuna ukuthi Ithala livulwe, liqhubeke lisebenze. Sifuna ukuthi iBhange loMbuso liqhamuke neqhinga lokuthi Ithala lizoqhubeka kanjani lisebenze. Asifuni Ithala lilokhu lincikiselwa, kuthiwa liyavalwa, liyavulwa.”UHlabisa unikeze iBhange loMbuso izinsuku ezingu-21 ukuba liphendule izimfuno zabo, wathi bazophikisana nayo yonke imizamo yokuvalwa kweThala."Ithala liwumgogodla womnotho waKwaZulu-Natal. Ithala liyifa esalishiyelwa nguMntwana waKwaPhindangene (umsunguli we-IFP, inkosi Mangosuthu Buthelezi. Sizolivikela Ithala kuze kube sekugcineni.”USihlalo we-IFP KwaZulu-Natal ophinde abe uNdunankulu wesifundazwe, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, uthe ngeke bavume ukuthi kuvalwe Ithala.Uhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal uyasiphikisa isicelo sokuba kuvalwe Ithala.AMALUNGU e-IFP abe nombhikisho wokuphikisana nokuvalwa kweThala Isithombe: DOCTOR NGCOBO/Independent NewspapersAMALUNGU e-IFP abeze akhase phansi emashela ukuthi lingavalwa ibhange Ithala ezitaladini zeTheku, izolo Isithombe: DOCTOR NGCOBO/Independent NewspapersAMANYE amalungu e-IFP abemashela ukuba lingavalwa ibhange Ithala enkabeni yeTheku, izolo, abephethe imishiza abegiya aqaphuze ngayo Isithombe: DOCTOR NGCOBO/Independent Newspapers
UVELE kancane enkantolo yeMantshi eTshwane umsolwa oneminyaka engu-41 osolwa ngamacala abucayi ahlanganisa amacala ayisishiyagalombili okudlwengula okuphoqiwe, ayisithupha okushaya ngenhloso yokulimaza.Kuthiwa mabili amadokodo avulelwe lo msolwa njengoba kunabagilwa abane abamvulela icala kuqala, kwase kuvela abanye nabo abesilisa ababili ngemuva kokuvela kwe-video ebizungeza enkundleni yezokuxhumana ibonisa abagilwa abahlukene bebhaxabulwa benqunu.Icala lakhe lihlehliselwa umhla ka-3 Mashi ukuze kuqhubeke uphenyo ngemininingwane yakhe yokufaka isicelo sebheyili.
UMREPHA obuye abe ngumethuli wezinhlelo zomculo kuleli uSiyabonga Themba Metane odume ngelikaSlikour uzwakalise ubuhlungu abhekene nabo eshayiswa yimoto edle phansi ngemuva kwesehlo.Lo mrepha owayeyilungu leqembu iSkwatta Camp ubezivocavoca egijima ngesikhathi ebandakanyeka engozini ngeSonto ekuseni.
