UNGQONGQOSHE wezikaGesi, uDkt Kgosientsho Ramokgopa, uvumile ukuthi kuyichilo ukuba ukucishwa kukagesi kunyuselwe esigabeni sesithupha (Stage6), ikakhulukazi njengoba elakuleli lilungiselela ukusingatha umhlangano wamazwe angaphansi kwe-G20.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba izolo. Ukucishwa kukagesi kuqale ngempelasonto.Abantu abaningi balale ukucishwa kukagesi kusesigabeni sesithathu ngoMgqibelo, baphaphama ngeSonto sekungaphansi kwesigaba sesithupha kulandela isimemezelo esenziwe kusempondo zankomo sokunyuswa kwezinga lokucishwa kukagesi.URamokgopa uxolisile kubantu bakuleli ngalesi simo."Ngifuna nje ukuqala ngokuxolisa kubantu ngokubuya kohlelo lokucishwa. Okubi ukuthi uhlelo lokucishwa kukagesi lubuye mawala. Siyazi ukuthi abantu abaningi badiniwe, futhi bacasuka kufanele. Siliphoxile izwe. Ngifisa ukusho ukuthi nathi isishayisa ngamahloni lena yokucishwa kukagesi.”Bese kuphele izinsuku ezingu-20 zilandelana kwagcina ukucishwa kukagesi.URamokgopa ukhale ngenkinga esiteshini sokuphehla ugesi iMajuba, wathi izoxazululeka maduze lenkinga, bese kuphela eyokucishwa kukagesi."Siyayisebenza le nkinga. Nginikeza isiqiniseko sokuthi kuyothi kuphela isonto siyokube sesiyilungisile le nkinga. Kunesiqiniseko sokuthi kuzokuba nesikhathi eside ugesi ungacishwa.”URamokgopa ukuchithile eyokuthi kunesandla semfene kulokhu kucishwa kukagesi."Siyakuqinisekisa ukuthi asikho isandla semfene, angeke silokhu sifunana nezaba. Inkinga siyayazi futhi siyayilungisa.”Kuke kwaphela izinsuku ezingu-300 zilandelana ugesi ungacishwa ngaphambi kokuthi lolu hlelo lobuye ngasekuqaleni kwale nyanga.Ukungacishwa kukagesi isikhathi eside kangaka kwenza ukuthi uRama athi sekusele kancane ukuthi izwe lifike esigabeni sokuyiqeda nya inkinga kagesi.Izolo, uRamokgopa uthe usamile ekutheni izophela maduze inkinga yokucishwa kukagesi."Maduze nje sizoqeda ukulungisa u-unit 6 eKusile. Babekade bethe kuzolunga ngasekuqaleni kwale nyanga kodwa babuye bakuhlehlisa. Manje sibheke ngasekuqaleni kukaMashi. Maduze nje sizoqeda ukulungisa u-unit 4 eMedupi. Lokhu kuzosinikeza ugesi othe xaxa ukunalona esinawo njengamanje. Ingakho ngithi sekusele kancane ukuba siyiqede inkinga yokucishwa kukagesi.”
UZOQHUBEKA enkundleni egxekwe yiSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini umcimbi wokuvulwa kwesiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal.Umcimbi wokuvulwa kwesiShayamthetho uzokuba senkundleni yebhola lombhoxo, eWoodburn Stadium, eMgungundlovu, ngoLwesine.Lokhu kumenyezelwe uSomlomo wesiShayamthetho, uNksz Nontembeko Boyce, ngesikhathi echaza ngamalungiselelo omcimbi.UNksz Boyce uveze ukuthi bathole isiqiniseko sokuthi iphephile inkundla, waveza nokuthi babe nomhlangano neMbube ngeledlule, lapho beyichazele khona ngezinhlelo zokuphepha.Umcimbi wokuvulwa kwesiShayamthetho ubujwayele ukubanjelwa eRoyal Showgrounds, kule minyaka emibili eyedlule umcimbi ububanjelwe e-Oval Cricket Stadium ngenxa yokungatholakali kweRoyal Showgrounds.Kulo nyaka i-Oval Cricket Stadium kayitholakalanga ngenxa yokuthi kunemidlalo yekhilikithi eqondene nosuku lomcimbi wokuvulwa kwesiShayamthetho.Kuzokube kungokokuqala lo mcimbi ubanjelwa eWoodburn Stadium, okwakusingethwe kuyo umcimbi wokufungiswa kukaNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, ngonyaka owedlule.Ngeledlule, iMbube ibhalele isiShayamthetho, ikhala ngezokuphepha kule nkundla.IMbube iyona eyaye ivule ngokusemthethweni isiShayamthetho. Encwadini ebonwe yiSolezwe, iNdlulamithi yamaKhosi ibikhala ngokuthi iWoodburn Stadium kayiphephile ngenxa yokuthi inamasango amancane okungena nokuphuma, nokuthi kunezindawo eziphakeme eduze nenkundla ezenza ukuthi umuntu ome kuzona akwazi ukubona konke okwenzeka ngaphakathi.UNksz Boyce uthe emva kokuthola incwadi yeSilo, babhalela uNtuli kanye nabezokuphepha, bebazisa ngokukhathazeka kweMbube."Lena akuyona into ebesingayithatha kancane njengoba ithinta ukuphepha kweMbube kanye nendlunkulu. Abezokuphepha baqinisekisile ukuthi inkundla iphephile. Bathe banalo iqhinga lezokuphepha abazolisebenzisa. Sibe nomhlangano neMbube ngoLwesine, lapho sinikeze khona incazelo ngalolu daba. Imbube yenelisekile ngencazelo yethu.”Umcimbi wokuvulwa kwesiShayamthetho uzolandelwa yinkulumo kaNtuli ngesimo sesifundazwe ezokuba ngoLwesihlanu.UNksz Boyce uthe umcimbi wakulo nyaka uzohanjelwa abantu abangu-2 000, kanti uzosakazwa bukhoma eziteshini zomphakathi nasezinkundleni zokuxhumana.Uthe bahlele ukusebenzisa u-R4 million kulo mcimbi."Sibonile ezinkundleni zokuxhumana kukhulunywa izinto ezingelona iqiniso, kuthiwa sihlele ukusebenzisa imali engaphezu kwaleyo esijwayele ukuyisebenzisa. Ngithanda ukuqinisekisa ukuthi angeke sisebenzise budedengu imali yomphakathi, angeke seqe ku-R4 million obekiwe.”
KUCISHE kwasa izakhamuzi zaseNtaliyane, eLindelani, eNtuzuma, eThekwini, zibhekile ilokhu isho njalo inganono ebusuku.Amaphoyisa aseThekwini aqinisekise ukufa kwabahlanu abasolwa ngokuba yizigebengu ngesikhathi bedubulana namaphoyisa eLindelani, ngeSonto ebusuku.Amaphoyisa abelandela umkhondo wabasolwa osibalo sabo esingakaqinisekiswa abebehamba ngezimoto ezimbili abebehlela ukugebenga ibhizinisi KwaMashu.Izimoto ezimbili zabasolwa bezipake ekhoneni lomgwaqo uMdubu noMelusi kanti kusolwa ukuthi abasolwa bebenokungaboni ngaso linye okuholele ekutheni badubule bodwa. Amaphoyisa azithela phezu kwaleyo ngxabano kanti abasolwa base bebhekisa izibhamu emaphoyiseni namaphoyisa aphindisela.Umthombo weSolezwe ocele ukuba igama lakhe ligodlwe uthi uzwe kuqhuma isibhamu isikhathi eside esahleli nabangani, wathi esebuyela ekhaya wathola amaphoyisa evalile amtshela ukuthi akakwazi ukudlala ngoba indawo yobugebengu. Lo mthombo uthi amaphoyisa amtshele ukuthi akayicelele komakhelwane imoto azame indlela azofinyelela ngayo ekhaya."Ngiyicelelile imoto kubangani ngabuya sengihamba ngezinyawo, nalapho kube nzima ukuthi amaphoyisa angidlulise kodwa agcine evumile. Ngithe ngidlula ngabona inqwaba yamagobolondo ezinhlamvu, kukhona nezidumbu ezidindilizile,” kusho lo mthombo.Uthi ubone nekhaladi ebelinqunu lilimele kabi ngenxa yokudutshulwa. Uthi leli khaladi lizinikele emaphoyiseni.Imibiko evela endaweni yesigameko ithi ekuseni ngoMsombuluko kufike amanye amakhaladi esezwile ngezihlobo ezilimale kuleli lokishi imibiko ikhomba ukuthi asuka eWentworth."Ngesikhathi sokudubulana abasolwa abane balimala kabi. Uphenyo endaweni yesehlo luholele ekutholakaleni kwesidumbu somsolwa wesihlanu obezama ukubaleka enamanxeba okudutshulwa. Abasolwa batholwe nezibhamu ezintathu,” kusho uColonel Robert Netshiunda okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal.Abanye abasolwa ababili abalimele ngesikhathi abasolwa bedubulana basesibhedlela. Kumanje kuthungathwa abasolwa abakwazile ukubaleka ngesikhathi kuqubuka uthuthuva. Kubikwa ukuthi alikho iphoyisa elilimele.
NKOSIKHONA CELEZIBUKEKA zilokhu ziwuzaluzile izagila ezijikijela uNobhala Jikelele woMkhonto Wesizwe (MK), uMnuz Floyd Shivambu, okungakapholi namaseko kade kukhona abamkhomba ngenjumbane eqenjini.Ngemuva kokuphebeza ukuchashwa ngenhlamba uNkk Duduzile Zuma-Sambudla ngeviki eledlule, izolo bekundiza incwadi okungacaci ukuthi ibhalwe ngubani kodwa kuyona kukhalwa ngoShivambu. Kuvela ukuthi ibhalelwe u-Advocate Dali Mpofu, kuthiwa ibhalwe ngoFebhuwari 18.Kule ncwadi kukhalwa ngokuziphatha kukaShivambu nangokusebenzisa kwakhe amandla ngendlela engafanele kubhalwe nosuku aqokelwa ngalo kulesi sikhundla.Esigabeni sokuqala kukhalwa ngokususwa kwabaholi abangumgogodla weqembu nabathile ababalulekile. Usolwa ngokugudluza uMnuz Kwazi Mbanjwa, noMnuz Thobani Zuma ezikhundleni zabo ngokwahlukana kwazo. Kukhalwa nangokugudluzwa kukaMnuz Sfiso Zuma, okuthiwa wakhishwa ngendlela engafanele.Le ncwadi isola uShivambu ngokushaya indiva izinkontileka zokusebenza zesisebenzi zaKwaZulu-Natal, nobuholi.Ithi kunalokho lezo zinkontileka waziguqula wazibeka imibandela ethile futhi engelula. Phakathi kwaleyo mibandela kubalwa ukuncishiswa kweminyaka esuka kweyesihlanu yaya kowodwa.Omabhalane wabanciphisela imiholo yenyanga ngo-R6000, kwathi ababhekelele ukuhlanza imiholo yabo wayehlisa ngo-R2000.Kuthiwa waphinda wethula kabusha umgomo wezinyanga ezintathu lapho umsebenzi asuke esasebenza engaphansi kweso lomqashi ngoba usuke esanda kuqashwa.Zonke lezi zinguquko uzenze ngaphandle kokuba aqale axoxisane nabathintekayo kumbe ke alandele imigudu efanele.Esigabeni sesithathu kuthiwa wephule izivumelwano ebezikade zikhona zokukhokhelwa kwehhovisi walaxaza ifenisha yehhovisi entsha ebisanda kuthengwa nezinto zokusebenza. Wala waphetha ukukhokha irenti. Wangaqhamuka nezinhlelo zokugcina lezi zinsiza zikhona.Ukuvalwa kwamahhovisi kuhlanganiswe nokunqwaha ukukhokhela abasebenzi abangahambisananga nezimfuno zikaShivambu.Le ncwadi ithi lokhu kuphazamise kakhulu indlela yokusebenza kwaze kwathikameza izinhlelo zeqembu zokukhankasa.Esigabeni sesine le ncwadi igxila kakhulu ekusetshenzisweni kwamandla nguShivambu ngendlela engafanele, nebonakala ivuna yena. Lapha kuvela ukuthi ukwenza kwakhe sekuholele ekutheni kube nomthelela ongemuhle ngaphakathi eqenjini. Kukhalwa ngokuthi kunezinto azenzayo esezidale uqhekeko olukhulu eqenjini. Phakathi kwazo kubalulwe ukusayinwa kwezinkontileka ezintsha, ukuhlukunyezwa kwezinye zezikhulu zeqembu.Kusona lesi sigaba kuhlatshwe kwahlikizwa ukuthi izincwadi zokuxoshwa zalaba zaqale zanekelwa izwe ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ngaphambi kokuba zifinyelele kulabo ezibhekiswe ngqo, kubona.Kuthiwa ukwenza kwakhe sekuholele ekutheni kwezinye izindawo kwehle ukuthenjwa kweqembu.Ukungenzi kahle kwakhe izinto kuthiwa yikhona okwaholela nasekutheni kube khona izinto ezibhimbayo embungazweni omkhulu wonyaka weqembu owawuseMoses Mabhida Stadium.Esigabeni sesihlanu sencwadi kugcizelelwa kakhulu ukungasetshenziswa kahle kwemali. Kuvela ukuthi ilinganiselwa ku-R25 million imali eyathathwa ngenkani ebuholini obuphezulu besifundazwe, iKwaZulu Natal.Le mali kuvela ukuthi ibe seyidluliselwa ezandleni zikaMgcinimafa. Lokhu kuholele ekutheni iqembu ligcine selihluleka ukukhokhela imiholo yezinye izisebenzi zalo.Usolwa ngokusebenzisa ubukhazikhazi bezimoto namahhotela eqophelo eliphezulu okuyinto okuthiwa kayihambisani nomgomo weqembu.Esigabeni sesithupha kukhalwa ngokusebenzisa kwakhe amalungelo ezomthetho ngendlela evuna yena. Le ncwadi inxusa ukuthi kube khona izinyathelo athathelwa zona ngokushesha uShivambu.Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kokhulumela i-MKP, uMnuz Nhlamulo Ndlela, iphunzile izolo.

WENEKELE izwe wonke amabibi ngokuqhubeka eBhodini leNgonyama Trust uDkt Thandiwe Dlamini, esola abalingani bakhe ebhodini ngokudla amandla eSilo uMisuzulu kaZwelithini ukuze "bathathe ngozwane” esikhwameni. Ngesikhathi ekhuluma uDkt Dlamini bekulokhu kunokuvungama kwabebelalele bemangele ngabakubona njengenkohlakalo ngomhlaba weNgonyama Trust. Uveze ukuthi izikhulu bezifihlela iSilo namalungu ebhodi imibiko yezimali. Ukhale kakhulu nangokuqashwa kwe-CFO athi yayingenazo iziqu ezifanele ukuphatha lo msebenzi. Kuphinde kwavela ukuthi i-CEO yazama ukuzenyusela umholo ngo-R1 million (ngonyaka) kwathi i-CFO yafuna uchatha ka-R600 million, konke lokhu bengasazisanga iSilo esinguSihlalo waleli bhodi. "Empeleni obekwenzeka laphaya kuyinkohlakalo, ngakho ngiphakamisa ukuba iNgonyama ivulele i-CEO ne-CFO amacala obugebengu,” kusho uDkt Dlamini.Echaza ukuthi njengoba ayesebhodini wayethule ethini yena, uthe wayehlale ephikisa njalo adliwe yivoti yilabo abasohlangothini lwe-CEO ezinqumweni. Ukweseka izinsolo zakhe uDkt Dlamini udlale izingxoxo aziqopha kukhulunywa ngeSilo, egcizelela ukuthi sasedelelwa, senziwa ihlaya.Ngesikhathi iSilo siqeda ngeBhodi, uDkt Dlamini owayevele igama lakhe liphakanyiswe yiSilo, akaxoshwanga. ISilo sike sadlulisela udaba lweNgonyama Trust kubameli kodwa okuningi kwajama njengoba amandla ngokwenzeka ebhodini ehleli kuNgqongqoshe wezoMhlaba kazwelonke. Ephawula egameni lebhodi, okhulumela iNgonyama Trust uSimphiwe Mxhakaza uthe ibhodi lisazobhekana nalezi zinsolo ezibhekiswe kulo ngesikhathi esifanele.

BAGWETSHWE kanzima abalisa abane abalahlwa amacala okugebenga izimoto zemali eBoksburg, eKurhuleni.Kubikwa ukuthi ngomhla ka-17 Meyi 2018, izimoto ezintathu ze-G4S zasuka edepho ye-G4S eBoksburg zilibangise e-Absa Bank, eSpartan, ziyobhanga isamba semali. Ngesikhathi zihamba ngomgwaqo u-Atlas eBoksburg, amadoda ahlome ayizingovolo ngezibhamu ezizishintshayo aphethe neziqhumane ezasetshenziswa ukuvula ngendluzula izimoto zemali, kwebiwa izikhwama zemali kanye nezibhamu zonogada.Ngokuphazima kweso, amaphoyisa abikelwa ngalesi sehlo aphuthuma khona. Ngokubambisana kwezinhlaka zamaphoyisa okubalwa kuzo oKlebe abaphenya amacala abucayi eGoli, amaphoyisa kaMasipala waseGoli (JMPD), nophiko lwamaphoyisa ezinja, izinkampani zonogada namaphoyisa kaMasipala waseKurhuleni (EMPD) alandele izigebengu, kwaze kwaboshwa abasolwa abaningi kwatholakala nemali eyebiwe nezinhlobonhlobo zezibhamu nezinhlamvu. Izigebengu ezigwetshwe uPaul Sibanda (56), Thato Gaopatwe (33), Thabo Ponatshego Molefe (43), Sibusiso Zakhe Khumalo (43), Collen Zwelakhe Hadebe (49), noThapelo Arnold Nchabeleng (35), bebebhekene namacala amaningi okubalwa awokugebenga kuhlonyiwe, ukuzama ukubulala nelokubulala, ukutholakala nezibhamu ezingekho emthethweni, ukutholakala nezibhamu nezinhlamvu. Izigwebo zabo, ezidonsa iminyaka engu-36 kuya kwengu-40 ejele, zibonisa ubukhulu bamacala abo.Umshushisi wethula ngokucophelela icala eliqinile, elichaza ukudelela kwezigebengu kanye nezindlela ezinobuchule ezisetshenziswa yizigebengu. Ukusebenza ngokuzikhandla nokuzibophezela okukhulu, abaphenyi bakwazi ukuhlanganisa ubufakazi obubalulekile obungenakungatshazwa ngakho konke okwenziwe abammangalelwa kuleli cala.UThato Gaopatswe owayengunogada ngesikhathi sesehlo waxaka abaningi ngesikhathi eqala efaka izithombe zezingubo ezibizayo nezimoto ezibizayo ebukisa nempilo yobukhazikhazi. Lokhu kwaheha amaphoyisa ukuba aphenyisise ngempilo yakhe nokuyilapho okwatholakala khona imali u-R1.2 million lapho ehlala khona.Bagwetshwe kanje; uPaul Sibanda ugwetshwe iminyaka engu-36, Thato Gaopatwe ugwetshwe iminyaka engu-38, Thabo Ponatshego Molefe ugwetshwe iminyaka engu-40, Sibusiso Zakhe Khumalo 38 kanti uThapelo Arnold Nchabeleng ugwetshwe iminyaka engu-38. Inkantolo ikhiphe umyalelo wokuthi zonke izigwebo zidonswe kanye kanye okubalwa elilodwa lokubamba inkunzi kusetshenziswa isihluku. Icala elibhekene noMnuz Collen Zwelakhe Hadebe lihlehliselwe ukuqulwa ngomhla ka-7 kuMashi 2025.

Njengamanje sinezifundazwe eziningi. SinoGauteng."Uthe isikole siyayikazela ngezifundiswa ezidlule khona okubalwa kuzo odokotela, abameli, nezintatheli.UDumakude uthe izinto ezaba wumqondo kaNtuli eBizimali nezafukula imiphumela yakulesi sikole, ukufunda ebusuku, ngezimpelasonto nangamaholidi.Uthe umphakathi awukwamukelanga kahle lokho ngoba wawukhala ngokuthi awusakwazi ukuthuma izingane futhi azisakwazi nokuyolusa izinkomo."Indaba yokufunda ebusuku neyama- extra classes yaqala layikhaya."UDumakude uthe uNtuli ushiye nyakenye isikole sinabafundi abangaphezu kuka-2 700 nothisha abawu-88."Siyabonga ukuthola ithuba lokusebenza nothishonhloko. Usikhulisile saba ngamadoda. Saba ngomama. Siyabonga ngemfundiso yakhe."Esephetha uDumakude uthe kumenywa nanoma wubani ukuba abe yingxenye yalo mcimbi wokuthulela uNtuli isigqoko esadla anhlamvana.
IYINDABA egudwini kumalungu omphakathi waseMzimkhulu, indaba yesidumbu somfundisi okuthiwa sesibhadle emakhazeni izinyanga ezine.Kuvela ukuthi ukungaboni ngasolinye phakathi kwamalungu omndeni amkhulisa uMfu Zwelabantu Vezi (48) nomndeni wakhe, yikhona osekuholele kule nkiyankiya.Kuhlaluka ukuthi umufi, owashona ngo-Okthoba 4, ubekade engumsunguli futhi eyinhloko yebandla laseZayoni, iNew Christian Church.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi umufi ukhuliswe kwaVezi kodwa isibongo sakhe sangempela uGasa.Kuthiwa umufi akazange agule kodwa wavele walala wangabe esavuka ekuseni nokuyinto futhi okuthiwa amakholwa kawayikholwa uma umkakhe, uNkk Zondiwe Vezi, ewaxoxela yona. UNkk Vezi wakhanyisa amakhandlela inyanga eyodwa ezilile, emva kwalokho wahlanza ngedela.Umthombo uveza ukuthi akuqondakali ukuthi kungani umndeni wakwaGasa ulwisa abakwaVezi ngale ndlela.Ilungu lebandla elicele ukuba ligodlwe igama lalo, lithe basola ukuthi abakwaGasa bafuna ukuthola okuthile ngokungcwaba umfundisi."Nakuba kungesiyona indaba yethu kuyindaba edinga umndeni kodwa kuyasikhathaza kakhulu ukuthi umholi wethu kuphele isikhathi eside kangaka engakangcwatshwa,'' lisho kanjena.Ilungu liithe sebezame konke okusemandleni ukungenelela kodwa kumane kufane nje nokuthi bamane bathela amazi emhlane wedada.Uthe abakwaGasa bagijima bayolanda isidumbu emakhazeni, wathi lokhu akazi nokuthi kwenzeka kanjani, nabamakhaza bakuvuma kanjani.Leli lungu lebandla liveze ukuthi abakwaGasa beba isidumbu befuna ayofihlelwa kubo eNquthu, hhayi emzini wakhe eMzimkhulu. Lithe unkosikazi kamufi nabakwaVezi kwathi uma befika emakhazeni ngo-Okthoba 11, bathola ukuthi isidumbu sesithathwe ngabakwaGasa.''AbakwaVezi baqasha inkampani yonogada kwayiwa eNquthu, ngabo lobo busuku salandwa isidumbu sase siyiswa kwamanye amakhaza,'' lisho kanjena.Kodwa lithi inkinga ekhona manje ukuthi wonke amaphepha kamufi okufaka phakathi incwadi yomshado, eyokufa, umazisi konke akukho kwaVezi.Lithe basola ukuthi likhona ngaphakathi emndenini izambane elibolile elisebenzisana nabakwaGasa elathatha lezi zinto laziyisa khona.Lithi lizwe ngamahebezi ukuthi abakwaGasa sebefake nesivimbelo senkantolo sokuthi indodana yabo ingangcwatsha uma ingeke ifihlelwe eNquthu.Kuthintwa uNkk Vezi uthe kuduma upotiyane manje kuyena ngalolu daba lomyeni wakhe. Uthe kumshiya nenqwaba yemibuzo engaphenduleki okwenziwa umndeni wakwaGasa.''Ngiyazi ukuthi njengoba benza kanjena nje, yingoba bafuna ukuthola okuthile kukamufi okuyinto abangeke bayinuke,'' usho kanjena ngentukuthelo.UMnuz Mlungisi Gasa uthe bona kwaGasa bafuna ukufihla ithambo labo ngoba abasathembi lutho ngisho indlela ashone ngayo, bathi ibenza bashaye amakhala.Ebuzwa ngokuthi kuyiqiniso yini ukuthi umufi akakhuliswanga kwaGasa, ungene ezintangeni wagcina esephendula ngokuthi lezo yizindaba zabantu abadala kunaye.Mayelana nokuthi bafake isivimbelo senkantolo, uthe kunjalo kodwa angeke anabe ngalokho akudingi intatheli.UNkk Nomalanga Vezi ongowalapho okuthiwa kwakhuliswa khona umufi, uthe ibucayi indaba kamufi nanokuthi bamkhulisa kanjani bemthola kuphi akathandi ukukuveza lokho. Uthe umufi kumele afihlelwe emzini wakhe noma kwaVezi lapho akhuliswa khona, hhayi kwaGasa.Uthe uma eyofihlwa eNquthu bayozisola abakwaGasa ngoba bayozwa sengathi bayasha kanti vele sebeshile.
IZINKINGA ohlelweni lokuhlalisa izitshudeni ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme kusuka komastende abafuna ucansi, abaxosha abangakhokhile nezinye kwenze uMnyango weMfundo ePhakeme wanquma ukubuyisela lolu hlelo ngaphansi kwezikhungo.Lolu hlelo okuhlale kunezikhalazo kuzona zonke izinhlangothi njengoba nomastende bekhala ngokungakhokhelwa, luzolambisa omastende abaningi abazophucwa leli qatha.UNgqongqoshe wezeMfundo ePhakeme, uDkt Nobuhle Nkabane, uthe lolu hlelo luzobuyela ezandleni zezikhungo ngenxa yezinkinga nezikhalazo azitholayo."Ngithola izikhalazo ngapha nangapha, ezithinta ukuphepha, inkohlakalo kanjalo nezinye izindawo ezizimele ezingekho ezingeni lokuhlalisa izitshudeni. Ngiyalele umnyango ukuthi ubheke ukuthi indaba yezindawo zokuhlala ibuyele ekwenganyelweni yizikhungo,” usho kanje izolo njengoba ebevakashele eNyuvesi yaKwaZulu-Natal.UMPHATHI wase-UKZN uSolwazi Nana Poku, uMqondisi jikelele eMnyangweni weMfundo ePhakeme uDkt Nkosinathi Sishi noNgqongqoshe woMnyango uDkt Nobuhle Nkabane ngesikhathi evakashele le nyuvesi izolo Isithombe: DHETIsikhwama esixhasa ngemali yokufunda i-NSFAS saqala uhlelo lapho sitholela khona izindawo zokuhlala izitshudeni. Phambilini izikhungo yizona ebezifunela izitshudeni indawo yokuhlala, bese izitshudeni zihlinzekwa ngamabhasi uma zikude.Muva nje kube nezikhalazo eziphenywayo zabanye omastende okuthiwa bafuna ucansi kwizitshudeni."Siyakugxeka kakhulu ukuthi izitshudeni zifunwe ucansi ukuze zithole indawo yokuhlala. Kunezikhalazo zokungaphephi kulezi zindawo yingakho sithi uhlelo olukhona manje alusebenzi,” kusho uDkt Nkabane.Obengumlawuli we-NSFAS, uMnuz Freeman Nomvalo, obeyingxenye yethimba likaDkt Nkabane, uhlabe ikhwelo ukuthi kubikwe omastende abafuna ucansi ukuze baboshwe.Abanye bafuna imali enguchatha ekubeni bayalelwa ukuthi bangayifuni imali ngoba bayakhokhelwa yi-NSFAS."Siyazigxeka izehlakalo zokuhlunyezwa ngokobulili, yingakho sifuna babikwe abenza lokhu, ukuze baphenywe bese beboshwa. Sifuna izitshudeni zigxile ezifundweni zazo zingaxakwa ezinye izinto,” usho kanje.Umnyango uzosebenzisana namalungu omkhandlu wezitshudeni ukuhlola eyezindawo zokuhlala ukuthi zisezingeni.UDkt Nkabane uxoxe nezinye izitshudeni ebezibeka izinkinga zazo.Uyalele ukuthi zisizwe ngokushesha kuphinde kululwe isikhathi sokubhalisa.Uzwe nokuthi lesi sikhungo sikweletwa imali enkulu yizitshudeni, wancoma ukuthi lesi sikhungo asiyifaki inzalo kule mali."Kuyakhathaza ukuthi ezinye izikhungo zifaka inzalo emalini ezikweletwa yona yizitshudeni ekubeni isimo somnotho sintenga. UMcwaningi mabhuku jikelele uke wakhala ngokuthi ulwazi izikhungo ezinalo alufani nolwe-NSFAS,” kusho uDkt Nkabane.
UBHONGOZA ekuhlukumezeni osomatekisi ungomunye wabantu abaqothwe ngenhlamvu ngamaphoyisa ngesikhathi ibambene phezulu ngoLwesine ntambama, endaweni yaseGcuwa, e-Eastern Cape. Ngokusho kwemithombo esondelene nodaba, ubhongoza owaziwa ngelikaMnuz Yanga "Bara” Nyalara, ungomunye wabasolwa abayisithupha abebehlome beyizingovolo ngezibhamu abayiswe koyisemkhulu. Lesi sigameko siqinisekiswe ngokhulumela amaphoyisa kulesi sifundazwe, uLieutenant Siphokazi Mawisa. UBara obenoxhaxha lwamacala abevulwa abuye asulwe eminyakeni edlule ngenxa yokuthi abebewavalile bebesaba ukufakaza noma ukubulawa, ubesatshiswa okwenyoka endaweni yaseKhayelisha. Le nsizwa ebinguthisha ofunde wagogoda beyisolwa ekufeni kwabantu abangu-18 kulesi sifundazwe.Lo msolwa odabuka eCofimvaba, kuthiwa ubebize ukhukhulelangoqo womhlangano nabemboni yamatekisi, ebeka imigomo nemibandela yezinto azifunayo, kwazise ubephila kakhulu ngokuthola imali yokuvikela. Kuthiwa ubeqoqa uR2000 njalo ngoLwesibili bese efuna uR30 000 ekupheleni kwenyanga.Kubikwa ukuthi usuke emhlanganweni watholana phezulu namaphoyisa ehamba nonogada bakhe eGcuwa, kwaba ongaphansi nongaphezulu, lwagcina lugobile kuye .
NKOSIKHONA CELEUSIZI lwenkinga yokungabi bikho kwamanzi egubazele uMasipala abaQulusi seluholele ekutheni kungenelele uMasipala wesiFunda saseZululand ngenhloso yobhekana ngqo nalesi simo.Kuvela ukuthi uMasipala abaQulusi ubhekene nengwadla yenkinga yamanzi ebangelwa ukukhahlamezeka kwengqalasizinda okwenzeka ngesikhathi sezikhukhula.Izolo, iMeya yaseZululand, uMnuz Michael Khumalo, inikezele ngosizo lwamaloli amane athutha amanzi ebaQulusini.UKhumalo ugonyuluke ngale ngwadla ebhekene nabantu bakule ndawo, wathi okuye kube buhlungu kakhulu uma kungcwatshwa imindeni iye iwadinge kakhulu amanzi.Uthe yingakho bebone kumqoka ukuba balufakele izibuko udaba lwenkinga yamanzi."Sithathe isinqumo sokuthi sinikeleke lo masipala ngamaloli amane okuthutha amanzi. Lokhu sikwenza ngoba siyaqonda ukuthi amanzi abaluleke kangakanani emphakathini," usho kanjena.Eqhuba, uthe inkinga yamanzi kule ndawo yadaleka ngemuva kwezikhukhula athe yizona ezakhahlameza ingqalasizinda yamanzi.Nakuba kunjalo, uthe bazibophezele ekutheni babhukule baqinisekise ukuthi bayayilungisa inkinga yamanzi.IMeya kuMasipala abaQulusi, uMnuz Sifiso Mkhwanazi, ibonge ukutakulwa yiZululand.UMkhwanazi uveze ukuthi nakuba befuna ukusebenzisa amaloli ngenhloso yokuphuthumisa amanzi ebantwini kodwa kukhona enye ingwadla yokungabi bikho esimweni esikahle kwemigwaqo.Ugcizelele ukuthi basembhidlangweni wokulungisa imigwaqo ukuze kuzoba lula ukufinyelela kwentuthuko emphakathini okufaka phakathi ukusatshalaliswa kwamanzi.Udalule ukuthi kunomhlangano ababe nawo noMnyango wezokuThutha KwaZulu-Natal, wokubhunga kabanzi ngokungenziwa ukulungisa inkinga yemigwaqo.Amalungu omphakathi akushayele ihlombe ukunikekelelwa ngamaloli.UNkk Ntombenhle Mchunu uthe kulokoza inhlansi yethemba ngokuthi lawa maloli azoba usizo olukhulu.Ngalo lolu suku kuphinde kwaklonyeliswa abafundi abenze kahle ku-matric bezikole ezahlukene ebaQulusini.
UBEGODLE ibhomu abezolidedela uma esethula isabelomali eyokunyuswa kwentela ekhokhwa uma uthenga izimpahla kuleli, i-Value Added Tax (VAT), uNgqongqoshe wezeziMali uMnuz Enoch Godongwana.Lesi simemezelo sigcine singenzekanga njengoba kugcine kungahlalanga ukwethulwa kwalesi sabelomali ePhalamende ngoLwesithathu ntambama, ngenxa yokungavumelani emhlanganweni wayizolo oyisipesheli weKhabhinethi ehlanganisa amaqembu ahlukene ngokuthi i-VAT inyuswe ngo-2%.Ukunyuswa kwale mali bekuzoshaya kakhulu abathengi nabantu jikelele abathenga impahla njengoba ibizosuka ku-15% iye ku-17%, kusuka ngo-Ephreli 1.I-VAT yagcina ukunyuswa isuka ku-14% yaya ku-15% ngo-2018.UGodongwana utshele abezindaba esithangamini eKapa, izolo, ukuthi ukungavumelani ngezinto ezithile, okufaka no-2% we-VAT yikhona okuhlehlise ukwethulwa kwesabelomali.Uthe akukho okubi ngokuhlehla kwesabelomali ngoba njengoba engungqongqoshe, unalo ilungelo lokwenza lokhu."Kunezinto esingavumelani ngazo yingakho kudingeke sihlehlise ukwethulwa kwesabelomali. Indaba ka-2% we-VAT ngenye yazo kodwa ayihambi yodwa ngoba bekudingeke sivumelane ngokuthi sizoyithathaphi imali yokwenza zonke izidingo. "Kumele sikhethe ukuthi siyaphinde siyoboleka imali noma sinyusa intela, noma sinqume ezinye zezinto ukuze sikwazi ukuba nemali yokwenza izinto ezidingekayo ezweni,” kusho uGodongwana.UGodongwana uthe ubeyigcine kuyena eyokuthi i-VAT izonyuswa ngamalini."Emasontweni amabili ngathulela iKhabhinethi ukuthi isimo singase sibheke kuphi ukuze sikwazi ukuthola imali. Asizange sizifake izibalo ngoba kwakusekude, le ndaba yabe isiputshuka yafinyelela kwabezindaba ngamalungu eKhabhinethi ayesemhlanganweni. Ukube sasishilo ukuthi sihlela ukunyusa i-VAT ngamalini, ngabe umsindo mkhulu kakhulu,” kusho uGodongwana.Uthe bazobuyela ezingxoxweni mayelana nesabelomali, wathi kodwa okwamanje sihlehlele ukuthi asethule ngoMashi 12, 2025.Phakathi kwezinto ebezizomenyezelwa nguGodongwana mayelana nokunyuswa kwe-VAT ngo-2%, bekuwubhekela abasebenzi bahulumeni okubalwa othisha nodokotela, ukuphucula i-Early Childhood Development (ECD), ukuvuselela olayini abahamba izitimela, ukunyusa izibonelelo zikahulumeni nezinye izinhlelo.Izwe libhekene nenkinga yokungakhuli komnotho, izibalo eziphezulu zabangasebenzi, abantu abambalwa abakhokha intela ekubeni sanda isibalo sezidingo.Kunenkinga yesikweletu esikhulu sezwe ngenxa yokulokhu kubolekwa imali ukuze kukhokhelwe izidingo ezifana nezibonelelo zabadala, abangasebenzi, isondlo sabantwana, izinkinga zemali eminyangweni ehlukene; kwezemfundo nowezempilo kanjalo nezinye izidingo.Kuleli babalelwa ku-7.4 million abantu abakhokha intela ekubeni abantu bakuleli babalelwa ku-62 million.UNGQONGQOSHE wezeziMali, uMnuz Enock Godongwana, okuthiwe kuyena yima wogane ethi uzokwethula isabelomali ebesizonyuswa iVAT ngo-2% Izithombe: SiGCINIWE
KUQOKWE noNobhala Jikelele wenyunyana yothisha i-Sadtu, ebhodini elisha lesikhwama esixhasa izitshudeni, iNational Students’ Financial Aid Scheme.Lesi sikhwama sihlangabezana nezingqinamba minyaka yonke ikakhulu ngalesi sikhathi sokubhalisa kwezitshudeni ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme.Ukuqokwa kwebhodi nguNgqongqoshe weMfundo ePhakeme uDkt Nobuhle Nkabane, kuqede ukuqagula ngamalungu abhekwe ukuthi enze umehluko.Amalungu aholwa ngusihlalo uDkt Karen Stander, ungoti wezemfundo enyuvesi yakuleli i-Unisa. Abanye abakhona kubalwa nonobhala jikelele we-Sadtu, uDkt Mugwena Maluleke.Kubhekwe ukuthi amalungu alungise izinto kulesi sikhwama esihlale sinezingqinamba ikakhulu ngesikhathi sokubhalisa ezikhungweni zemfundo.UDkt Nkabane uqoka leli bhodi nje, bese kunesikhathi esicela onyakeni lingekho ngemva kokuhlakazwa ngowayengungqongqoshe womnyango uSolwazi Blade Nzimande. Uthe amalungu amasha ebhodi anamava emikhakheni ehlukene okubalwa owezemfundo, owezokulawula neminye."I-NSFAS idinga abantu abanamava abaqotho kwezithinta ubuholi. Yingakho sifune abantu abaneziqu ezithe thuthu ukuze benze lo msebenzi,” kuchaza uDkt Nkabane.Uthe amalungu ebhodi wonke aneziqu ze-Masters, kanti uthemba ukuthi azosebenzisana akhiphe amangwevu athinta imikhakha akuwona."Izidingo zezitshudeni yizona okumele zibekwe eqhulwini. Siwumnyango sizoqinisekisa ukuthi lesi sikhwama seseka izitshudeni ezihlwempu ngendlela efanele,” usho kanje.Leli bhodi lingena nje sekumele lizibambe ziqine njengoba isiqalile imibhikisho kwezinye izikhungo zemfundo, kukhalwa nge-NSFAS.Amanye amalungu ebhodi wonnke aneziqu ezehlukene oNksz Ndileka Portia Loyilane, Advocate Richardt Tlou Ramashia, Advocate Lavandran Nanda Gopaul, Nksz Philisiwe Sibiya, Nksz Clarinda Elizabeth Simpson, Nksz Prashika Mahesh, Dkt Siyanda Mngadi, Nksz Karabo Mohale, Dkt Johanna Maphutha noDkt Marcia Socikwa, iPhini likaMqondisi jikelele emnyangweni weMfundo ePhakeme obhekele amanyuvesi, kanti umele umnyango kuleli bhodi.
SEKULINDWE uMashi 24, ukuthi iJaji leNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini, lethule ukwahlulela kwalo ecaleni lokubulala elibhekene nowesilisa okuthiwa wagwaza wabulala unina wengane enxanxatheni yezitolo iGateway, eThekwini, nyakenye.Lokhu kuza emva kokusongwa kwezethulo zokugcina enkantolo.Ummangalelwa, uMnuz Siphamandla Khumalo (35) ubhekene necala lokubulala ngokugwaza uNksz Nomfundo Msibi (30) ngo-Agasti 4.Kulesi sigameko esenzeka emhubheni osuka ngaphakathi ezitolo ubheke erenki yamatekisi, kuthiwa uKhumalo wadonsa uhalakasha lommese, wagwaza ephindelela uNksz Msibi waze washonela khona lapho.Izolo, uMbuso ngomlomo ka-Advocate Krishen Shah, wenze izethulo zawo zokugcina maqondana nephuzu lokuthi ummangalelwa wayekuhlosile futhi ekuhlelile ukubulala umufi.Enza isibonelo, uthe ummangalelwa wamgwaza umufi amanxeba awu-23."Ngisho esefile, waqhubeka wazama ukumnquma ikhanda,” kusho uShah.Uqhube wathi kwakhona ukuthi amlandelele ngesikhathi esuka ehamba umufi emva kwengxabano, kwakusakhombisa khona ukuthi wayehlosile ukumbulala.UShah uqhube wathi kuyavela ebufakazini ukuthi kwasuka ingxabano ngesikhathi umufi ethola ukuthi ummangalelwa umlethele into engekho ezitolo njengoba wafika engayiphethe imali yokukhipha i-lay-by yakhe ayethe abazoyihlanganela."Wathi uma ethatha amagxathu umufi ehamba, ummangalelwa wamlandela wamvimba, wase eqala emgwaza. Kwathi noma esebaleka, waqhubeka nokumlandela, esemhaja, wamfica, waqhubeka wamgwaza ephindelela,” kusho uShah.Ubuye wagxila endabeni yommese athe ummangalelwa, wathi eseqedile ukuwusebenzisa, wawugoqa, wawubuyisela ephaketheni."Akekho umuntu owavele wamnika ummese (ezitolo) futhi akukho lapho okuvela khona ukuthi wawuthenga khona eGateway. Ayikho nencane into ekhombisa ukuthi isenzo sokubulala savele sazenzekela nje,” kwengeza uShah.Uyivale ngelithi ummangalelwa wabuswa umcabango wokuthi "ungumnikazi” kamufi, wase eba nombono wokuthi uma yena engasakwazi ukuba naye, akekho okufanele abe naye.Ummeli kammangalelwa, u-Advocate Phumelele Daniso ezama ukuphikisa amaphuzu kaShah, uthe ummangalelwa wenganywa ukudinwa okuyinto eyamfikela ngaleso sikhathi, akukhona ukuthi wayekuhlelile ukubulala umufi.Uphinde waphakamisa iphuzu lokuthi ukube ummangalelwa wayekuhlosile ukubulala umufi wayezokwenza phambilini, bebobabili, hhayi eGateway phambi kwabantu."Sizwile ebufakazini ukuthi ngosuku abahlangana ngalo eDurban Station, waze wamlandela waya emqashweni wakhe KwaMashu. Ukube wayenenhloso yokumbulala, wayezombulala ngalelo langa, kungekho muntu obonayo,” kusho uDaniso.IJaji uJacqueline Henriques, livule amehlo labuza uDaniso ukuthi ngalokhu akushoyo uqonde ukuthi ngoba nakhu ithuba lake laziveza phambilini kodwa ummangalelwa wangalisebenzisa, kusho ukuthi wayengenanhloso yokumbulala ngosuku lwesigameko?UDaniso uphendule ngelithi ngeke akwazi ukumphendulela kulokho ummangalelwa, wathi alukho uhlangothi lukammangalelwa oluvezayo ukuthi yini ndaba ambulala umufi, okuvelayo nje ukuthi wambulala emva kokusuka kwengxabano.Ijaji lithe akukho okungaphawulwa yinkantolo kulokho ngoba ummangalelwa wuye okhethe ukuthula, angaluvezi olwakhe uhlangothi, kwaze kwaba siyaphothulwa isigaba sokwethulwa kobufakazi.Liqhube lagqamisa amaphuzu ambalwa ijaji, lithi kwakungeyona yini ingxenye yokuhlela ukumbulala umufi ukuthi ambizele eGateway ebe engayiphethe imali yokukhipha i-lay-by?"Uma wayeqonde ukuyokhipha i-lay-by, wayeyaphi pho imali engayiphethe? Kwakungeyona ingxenye yokuhlela ukubulala leyo?” kubuza ijaji.Ijaji liphinde labuza eyokuthi uma wayengahlelile ukumbulala, pho yisiphi isizathu esamenza ukuthi ahlome ngommese?UDaniso ugcine engasazi ukuthi uzophendula athini emaphuzwini abebuzwa yijaji.Ngesikhathi kuqhubeka icala, ummangalelwa obesagqoke izingubo abezifake ngoLwesibili, ubelokhu ebeka isandla ebusweni, ezivala amehlo.
BEKUQALA emlandweni wezwe selokhu kwaphela ngombuso wobandlululo, ukuthi kuhlehliswe ukwethulwa kwesabelomali sikaNgqongqoshe wezeziMali.Lokhu kushiwo izolo nguSomlomo wePhalamende uNkk Thoko Didiza, ngemuva kokuhlehliswa kwenkulumo kaNgqongqoshe wezeziMali uMnuz Enoch Godongwana, yesabelomali ngaphansi kukahulumeni wokubambisana kwamaqembu.UNkk Didiza uthe waziswe ngomzuzu wokugcina ukuthi ngeke isahlala eyokuthula isabelo sokuqala ngaphansi kukahulumeni we-GNU.Uveze ukuthi ukungaboni ngaso linye ngaphakathi kwi-GNU mayelana nezinye zezinto, yikhona okuhlehlise ukwethulwa kwalesi sabelomali ebesibhekwe ngabomvu. "Kuyaqala kuleli ukuthi kuhlehliswe isabelomali. Kuwumlando futhi ukuthi kube nohulumeni wokubambisana kwamaqembu angu-10 kuleli. Uma kukhona ukungavumelani, ungqongqoshe akakwazi ukwethula isabelomali,” kuchaza uNkk Didiza, wathi inkulumo kaGodongwana ihlehliselwe uMashi 12.UNkk Didiza uthe bebazi ukuthi yonke into izohamba ngokohlelo njengoba bekukhona namaqembu ahlukene."Ngaziswe obhekele amabhizinisi kahulumeni ukuthi ngeke sisethulwa lesi sabelomali. Kubizwe osotswebhu bamaqembu baziswa ngesinqumo sokuhlehlisa le nkulumo.” Uveze ukuthi uzoba khona umthelela ngokuhlehliswa kwale nkulumo, eba minyaka yonke ngalesi sikhathi."Uzoba khona umthelela njengoba kwehle namandla erandi. Kodwa lesi sinqumo asithathwanga kalula. Sizolinda iKhabinethi ukuthi ize kuthina nesabelomali esizoyisa izwe phambili.” Uthe noma amanye amaqembu ePhalamende abethi uGodongwana akeze azokhuluma ngabekuhlelile kodwa akukho abengakwenza obekungasiza ngoba isabelomali besingeke sisethulwa."Kudingeke ukuthi sihlehlise ukuhlala kwePhalamende ngoba bekungeke kuwakhe umqondo ukuthi siqhubeke nokuhlala ekubeni inkulumo yesabelomali ingeke isaqhubeka. Uma kunombango kuhulumeni ayikho into esingayenza siyiPhalamende ngoba isabelomali esikahulumeni, akusona esikangqongqoshe yedwa,” usho kanje.Uthe uNgqongqoshe wezeziMali usuke ezothula inkulumo ethunywe nguhulumeni.Abaholi bamaqembu ehlukene okubalwa abe-EFF, nabe-MK bebelokhu bemile bethi akuzothulwa isabelomali ngoba sekumoshwe nemali.UMnuz Marshall Dlamini we-EFF, uphakamise ukuthi kuvotwe ukuze kucace ukuthi ngobani abangahambisani nokuthi kwethulwe isabelomali.I-MK ibuze ukuthi lezi zindleko zokuhlalisa lo mhlangano ogcine ubhuntshile, ngubani ozozikhokhela?Kodwa uNkk Didiza unqume ukuthi kuhlehliswe ukwethulwa kwesabelomali kuze kube yinyanga ezayo.
IZIPHATHIMANDLA zoMkhandlu waseMajuba, eNewcastle, ziphezu kwezinhlelo zokumisa uhlelo lokuvalwa kwenkampani ekhiqiza insimbi, i-Acelor Mittal ngenhloso yokumisa uhlelo lokudilizwa kwabasebenzi abangaphezulu kuka-3 000 abaqashwe yile nkampani.Likhuluma nabezindaba ibamba leMeya eMajuba, uMnuz Thembelihle Mthembu, lithe umasipala umatasatasa nezingxoxo nohulumeni okuhloswe ngazo ukweseka abantu abaqashwe yile nkampani."Sibambisene nohulumeni wesifundazwe kulolu daba nezinye zezinhlaka ezingajklama indima enkulu ekubhekaneni nalesi simo ekutheni kube nezinye izinqumo nezindlela ezingcono kunokuthi kudilizwe abasebenzi. Uhulumeni kazwelonke ne-Acerlor Mittal South Africa (AMSA) nabo bamatasatasa nezingxoxo okulindeleke ukuthi ziphothulwe emuva kwamasonto ambalwa ezayo. Lesi simo asizoba neze nomthelela omuhle emkhandlwini waseMajuba, yingakho sizinikela ekulekeleleni,” kusho uMthembu.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi ngonyaka odlule, i-Arcelor Mittal yayithe izovala uphiko olukhiqiza insimbi esetshenziswa ezimayini, ekwakhiweni kwamabhuloho, emizileni yezitimela nakwenye intuthuko edinga insimbi eqinile.UMthembu uthe le mboni ilima indima ebalulekile emnothweni wakuleli, nakosomabhizinisi bendawo.I-National Union of Metalworkers of South Africa (Numsa), odabeni olukhishwe yileli phephandaba emasontweni edlule, nayo ithe mawehle amaphaphu ebantwini abashaywa wuvalo lokuthi bangase baphelelwe wumsebenzi.Ithe kudingeka uhulumeni alungise izikhalo zabasebenzi ukuze izohlala ivuliwe inkampani, ingavalwa ngoba akufanele kube nemisebenzi ephelayo.Phakathi kwamagatsha okuthiwa athinteka kulolu hlelo kubalwa eliseNewcastle, KwaZulu-Natal, noluseVereeniging, eGauteng.Kulindeleke ukuthi ngoLwesihlanu abasebenzi beNumsa babhikishele ukumiswa kwabasebenzi bale nkampani emahhovisini e- Industrial Development Corporation (IDC) eSandton, eGauteng.
ZISUKUME zaphuma ngaphandle kweNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini, ezinye izihlobo zowesifazane, owagwazwa, wabulawa nguyise wengane eGateway, umshushisi woMbuso eveza ukuthi sekuzodlalwa i-video yesigameko. Esigamekweni esenzeka ngo-Agasti 4, ngonyaka odlule, ummangalelwa uMnuz Siphamandla Khumalo (35), kuthiwa wagwaza ephindelela, waphinde wanqumisa okwesilwane umufi, uNksz Nomfundo Msibi (30).Ngokwe-video enyantisa igazi, isigameko senzeka emhubheni osuka ngaphakathi ezitolo, ubheke erenki yamatekisi.UMMANGALELWA uMnuz Siphamandla Khumalo Isithombe: ZIMBILI VILAKAZIUkudlalwa kwale video bekuholwa umshushisi woMbuso, u-Advocate Krishen Shah, obelokhu ekumisa, bese eyalela ufakazi woMbuso, uDetective Constable Boitumelo Phama, ongumphenyi wecala, ukuthi acacise okuvelayo.Ngesikhathi ethula lobu bufakazi uDet Const Phama uze wathi: "Ummangalelwa wamnqumisa okwesilwane umufi."Umfowabo kamufi, uMnuz Halalisani Mbatha, obesele ngaphakathi enkantolo, ubonakale elokhu ethe njo kwithelevishini ngesikhathi kudlala i-video, nakuba ubengakhali kodwa ubuso bebubhalwe ukudangala.Ngaphambi kwalokho, owethule ubufakazi eholwa uMbuso, bekuyisoka likamufi, uMnuz Mthobisi Gasela.Uveze ukuthi yena nomufi baqala ukuthandana ngoMeyi ngonyaka odlule, okwakuyisikhsthi esiyizinyanga ezintathu ngaphambi kokuthi abulawe ngo-Agasti, wathi ngesikhathi buqala ubudlelwano babo, umufi wamtshela ukuthi usehlukene noyise wengane ngoba ubemhlukumeza, emshaya.Udalule ukuthi zikhona izigigaba zokuhlukumeza ezenzeke ngisho umufi esethandana naye.Echaza ngazo uthe kukhona lapho ayehamba khona nomufi eDurban Station, ezohlangana nommangalelwa, ukuzothatha imali yengane.Uthe nakuba ummangalelwa ababona beqhamuka behamba bobabili, wakhetha ukungabi yingxenye yengxoxo yabo."Wathi eya kuye, ngawela umgwaqo ngaya ngapheshela. Bathi sebeya esitolo (ukuyokhipha imali) ngavele ngahamba ngayogibela,” kusho uGasela, othe yena wayehlala eMlaza.Uthe emva kwemizuzu engu-15, umufi wamfonela emtshela ukuthi useya emqashweni wakhe KwaMashu, kodwa ummangalelwa uyamlandela."Ngezwa ekhuluma ngemumva ethi 'yeyi wena usukhuluma nendoda yakho’," kusho uGasela.Uthe kwathi ngabo-8 ebusuku, umufi wamfonela, ekhala ethi ummangalelwa uyamshaya futhi uzombulala. Uthe yikulo lolo cingo lapho ummangalelwa wagcina ekhuluma naye (uGasela), emtshela ukuthi unina wengane yakhe lona, ucela akahlukane naye."Ngaphendula ngathi bengingazi ukuthi bayathandana, ngazi ukuthi sebahlukana, waphendula wathi unina wengane yakhe lona, ucela ngihlukane phansi naye,” kusho uGasela.Uthe wamphendula ngokuthi "Awushadile naye”, nokuyilapho amsabisa khona ngokuthi uzombulala (uzobulala uGasela).Uthe emva kwalolo suku, umufi wahlala usuku engayi emsebenzini ngoba wayemshaye wamlimaza.UGasela uthe emva kwaleso siwombe sokulandelwa, nokushawa, wabe esezohlala naye eMlaza umufi, ethi usabela impilo yakhe.Ngosuku lwesigameko uthi wagcina emphelezeya ukuyokhipha i-layby yejakhethi kamufi, owayeseze wafonela nomfowabo kamufi ethi uyayicela ukuze bahlukane ngokuthula."Ngiyacabanga ukuthi uwasola ukuthi kukhona okungahle kwenzeke ngoba wacela ukuthi angahambi yedwa umufi. Wagcina ephelezelwa yimi, umngani wakhe ematasa,” kusho uGasela.Uthe sebefika enxanxatheleni bavumelana ngokuthi bangahambisani, ukuze uma kukhona ummangalewa akwenzayo, uGasela akwazi ukusheshe abone bese efuna usizo, wathi esinye isizathu sokuthi benze kanjalo kwakuwukuzama ukugwema ingxabano ngokucabanga ukuthi uma ebabona behamba bombabili wayezodinwa.Udalule ukuthi ngaphambi kokuthi aqale amgwaze, kwaqale kwaba nokuhilizisana phakathi kwabo akuzwa ngocingo, umufi esemfonela, wamuzwa embuza ukuthi ubemsaphi kanti ezitolo uma engenayo imali (yokukhipha i-layby)."Ngabona umufi ethatha amagxathu ambalwa eza ngakimi, ummangalelwa wamvimba. Ngithe ngiyezwa ngangibona umufi ebaleka ethi 'nangu engigwaza’, ngabona kuphuma igazi ngasohlangothini,” uthe ingaleso sikhathi avele wagijima wayobiza amaphoyisa ayepake eduzane.Uthe nakuba amaphoyisa asukumela ephezulu aya esigamekweni, amfica esethule umufi. Uthe yena akabange esaya ngakhona, ngovalo lokuthi mhlawumbe naye angahle amhlasele.Ummeli kammangalelwa, u-Advocate Phumelele Daniso, uveze ukuthi ummangalelwa uthe yena akakaze ahlukane nomufi, babethandana ngesikhathi eseqome uGasela. Nokho uGasela ukuphikisile lokhu ethi, ngaphezu kokuthi umufi wayemtshelile ukuthi base behlukene, ziningi izimpawu ezazikhombisa lokhu. Phakathi kwazo kwakuyisikhathi abasichitha bekhuluma ocingweni.Ngesikhathi uGasela ethula ubufakazi, ummangalelwa ubelokhu ezimoyizelela, engazi nanyaka kodwa kuthe sekubekwa ithelevishini ebidlala i-video yesigameko phambi kobuso bakhe, washintsha, zehla izihlathi.IJaji uNkk uJacqueline Henriques lilihlehlisele inamuhla icala.

UKUZIKHANDLA ngomsebenzi wansuku zonke kugcine kuthela izithelo kwabe-University of KwaZulu-Natal, bexhaswa ngosizo oluzoletha umehluko emtholampilo wabo ogxile kwezamehlo.Lolu sizo, olunikelwe ngabe-OneSight EssilorLuxottica Foundation, luzokwenza lo mtholampilo ukwazi ukudiliva imikhiqizo nemithi emiphakathini yezindawo ezahlukene yabanenkinga yamehlo futhi luzoba wusizo futhi kwizitshudeni ezisacijelwa lo msebenzi.UDkt Naimah Ebrahim, ofundisa izifundo zomkhakha wezamehlo kulesi sikhungo, ubonge i-OneSight EssilorLuxottica Foundation ngokubona kukuhle ukufaka isandla ukuqhuba umbono wabo."Siqale ubudlelwano nabo eminyakeni embalwa edlule ngenkathi beqoke izitshudeni zethu kolunye lwezinhlelo zabo okuyilapho ababona khona umehluko esiwenzayo emiphakathini, banquma ukusisiza njengoba sekunjena manje,” kusho uDkt Ebrahim.UDOKOTELA wamehlo, uNksz Ziyanda Gali, nesitshudeni sase-UKZN, uMnuz Akieel Devraj, bephethe omunye wemishini abanikelelwe ngayo Isithombe: SETHU DLAMINI Ezintweni ezizuzwe yi-UKZN kukhona ama-frame, ama-lense, ama-trial set nama-click check okuzoba wusizo olukhulu ekuqhubeni umsebenzi nsuku zonke, kusize nangokuthi kwehlise izindleko abebhekana nazo nsuku zonke."Iziguli eziningi azikwazi ukuzithengela ngokwazo izinsiza ezahlukene ezidingwa nezisetshenziswa ukwelapha izinkinga zamehlo ngakho lolu sizo luzolekelela ngokuthi kwehle umthwalo nakuzona, okuningi sekuzoba lula manje,” usho kanje.Akupheleli lapho njengoba le nkampani izoqhubeka isize ngokuthi ezinyangeni ezintathu kusukela manje iyona esizokwengamela konke okwenzeka ema-laboratory omtholampilo.ISITSHUDENi sase-UKZN somkhakha wezamehlo, uMnuz Simo Banjwa, sikhombisa ngezinye zezinsizakusebenza abanikelelwe ngazo Isithombe: SETHU DLAMINIIbathengele nemishini yokusebenza elinganiselwa ku-R30 000 kuya phezulu, ezoba wusizo kakhulu nayo ngoba izitshudeni eziningi azikwazi ukuyithenga ngokwazo ngoba imba eqolo. ABAYIZWA eyokuthi kunyuswe intela ekhokhwa uma kuthengwa izimpahla kuleli i-Value Added Tax (VAT), uma uNgqongqoshe wezeziMali, uMnuz Enoch Godongwana, esethula isabelomali salo nyaka wezimali ePhalamende.Amaqembu ehlukene kubalwa nezinyunyana zabasebenzi bayayichitha eyokuthi uGodongwana, amemezele ukunyusa i-VAT ngenxa yokuthi isimo sezezimali singesihle ekubeni izidingo zinyuka njalo.Amakhomanisi esitatimendeni, athe awalindele ukuthi kunyuswe i-VAT uma sekwethulwa isabelomali."Asilindele ukuthi kunyuswe i-VAT njengoba yanyuswa isuka ku-R14, yaya ku-R15. Silindele uhulumeni ukuthi alwe neyokunyuka kwamanani ezinto kuleli, okuhlanganisa nokuthi ne-VAT inganyuswa,” kusho i-SACP.I-SACP ithe uMgcinimafa kumele anyuse intela kulabo abacebile."Asifuni kuthiwe kunyuswa i-VAT ukuze kubhekelwe labo abangasebenzi, abahola isibonelelo sikahulumeni. Uma kunyuswa i-VAT abahlwempu bazoqhubeka bathwale kanzima.” UDkt Mark Burke okhulumela i-DA kwezomnotho, uthe abahambisani nokunyuswa kwe-VAT kanjalo nezinye izinhlobo zentela uma sekwethulwa isabelomali.Uthe bakholwa ngukuthi lesi sabelomali kumele sitshengise abantu ukuthi izwe lizimisele ukukhulisa umnotho kulandelwa umgomo kahulumeni wokubambisana kwamaqembu."Silindele isabelomali esizokhuluma ngezinto ezithinta ingqalasizinda, amathuba okutshalwa kwemali, izinguquko kwezomnotho nokukhuliswa kwemisebenzi. Sibhekene nenkinga yezinga eliphezulu lokuphila ezweni ngakho asilindele ukuthi kuphinde kunyuswe intela.” Uthe bazolwa nokunyuswa kwe-VAT kodwa bagqugquzela eyokwakha amathuba emisebenzi.UMnuz Alan Beesley we-ActionSA, uthe bayayichitha eyokunyuswa kwentela, wathi akwehliswe imihlomulo yongqongqoshe, amaphini abo kanjalo nezinye izikhulu zikahulumeni.Uthe ugesi unyuka ngamandla ngakho abantu bazothwala kanzima uma kugcina kunyuswa intela.'Abantu bakuleli balindele uhulumeni ozoqeda ukuxhashazwa kwemali ngaphambi kokuba ufune abakhokhi bentela ukuthi bakhokhe kakhulu. Akunqandwe inkohlakalo kunganyuswa ntela ezoshaya abantulayo. Ngeke siseseke lesi sabelomali esizoqumba phansi abantu abadonsa kanzima," usho kanje.Ne-Cosatu isike yaxwayisa ngokuthi ayihambisani nokuthi kunyuswe intela, okubalwa ne-VAT uma sekuthulwa isabelomali.Lo mfelandawonye uthe uhulumeni kumele aqhamuke nezinye izindlela zokuqoqa imali, hhayi kodwa ukuyitapa kubasebenzi abavele badonsa kanzima.Okhulumela i-Cosatu, uMnuz Matthew Parks, uthe umphakathi uthwele kanzima ngakho isabelomali kumele sikuveze lokhu.Uthe kuzoba yinhlekelele uma kungukuthi kunyuswa intela."Sinezinga elingu-42% labangasebenzi ngakho umnotho awukwazi ukukhula ngendlela. Izinga lobugebengu liphezulu kanjalo nelenkohlakalo, yingakho sithi isabelomali asibhekele lezi zinto, hhayi ukunyusa i-VAT nentela.” I-Fedusa ithe kumele kubhekelwe abasebenzi okuyibo abathwele kakhulu kuleli.Le nyunyana ithe kumele kwakhiwe imisebenzi, kwehliswe izinga eliphezulu labantu ababhuquza emakhaya."Akuqiniswe uhwebo ukuze kuthuthuke umnotho kwakhiwe amathuba emisebenzi. Baningi abantu abadinga umsebenzi kuleli okuyinto ezoba yinhlekelele ngomuso.”
UNDUNANKULU waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, uthi ukwenyuka kwesibalo sabantu esifundazweni, nokufudukela kwabo bakwelikaMthaniya emadolobheni kwandisa umthwalo komasipala.UNtuli uthe ukukhula kwesibalo sabantu ikakhulu ezindaweni zasemadolobheni kwenza ukuthi abantu bangabe besazithola ngendlela izidingo zikahulumeni.Ukusho lokhu ethula inkulumo yokuvula umhlangano weKhabhinethi lesifundazwe, iLekgotla.Lo mbuthano wezinsuku ezimbili ubanjelwe eThekwini, uzophela namhlanje.UNtuli uthe imiphumela yokubalwa kwabantu yango-2022, ikhombisa ukuthi sikhulile kakhulu isibalo sabantu KwaZulu-Natal, ikakhulu ezindaweni ezisemadolobheni."Imiphumela ikhombisa ukuthi abantu abahlala KwaZulu-Natal bangu-12.4 million, siyisifundazwe sesibili ngokwesibalo sabantu abaningi. Lesi sibalo siwu-20% wesibalo sabantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Kusukela ngo-2011 isibalo sabantu KwaZulu-Natal sikhula ngo-1.9%.”Izifunda ezinabantu abaningi kakhulu iTheku elino-4.2 million, noMgungundlovu onabangu-1.2 million.Omasipala abanabantu abaningi uMasipala waseMsunduzi, owaseNewcastle, nowase-Alfred Duma.Omasipala okwanda kakhulu isibalo sabantu kubo uMasipala waseNdumeni, owaseNewcastle, nowaKwaDukuza.UNtuli uthe cishe ingxenye yabantu baKwaZulu-Natal ihlala emadolobheni, wathi iningi liseThekwini naseMgungundlovu, wathi nasemadolobheni amancane siyakhula isibalo sabantu abafudukela kuwo."KoMasipala waseNewcastle, nowaKwaDukuza isibalo sabantu sikhula ngo-3%. Ukufudukela kwabantu ezindaweni zasemadolobheni kwandisa ingcindezi ngasohlangothini lokuhlinzekwa kwezidingo, ikakhulukazi ukuhlinzekwa kwezindlu.”UNtuli uthe isabalo sabantu esikhula kakhulu esalabo abasesigabeni sokufuna umsebenzi, wathi nakho lokhu kufaka ingcindezi yokuba kudalwe amathuba emisebenzi."Abantu abasesigabeni sokusebenza bangu-66% kanti u-27% wona izingane ezineminyaka engaphansi kuka-14 ngokweminyaka. Lokhu kusho ukuthi sinyuke kakhulu isibalo sabadala uma uqhathaniswa nabancane. Ukukhula kwabantu abasesigabeni sokufuna imisebenzi kusho ukuthi nomnotho kufanele ukhule.”Ngesonto elizayo uNtuli uzokwethula inkulumo ngesimo sesifundazwe, iState of the Provinvce Address. Inkulumo kaNtuli izokuba ngoLwesihlanu, eMgungundlovu.Kuzoqala iSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini, sethule inkulumo emicimbini wokuvula isiShayamthetho, ozokuba ngoLwesine lwangesonto elizayo.UNtuli uthe bazobeka phambili eyokulwa nobugebengu kanye nokutakula omasipala ababhekene nezinkinga.

LIKHALE ngomhobholo nangokwanda kwezigameko zobulelesi iJaji izolo eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini. Ligwebe abesilisa ababili ngodilikajele ngemva kokulahlwa yicala lokubulala unogada befuna ngodli utshwala esitolo.Abagwetshiwe nguSinethemba Mtshali (27), nomngani wakhe omkhulu uSiyamthanda Melvin Gumede (29).Bobabili kuthiwa bagasela esitolo sotshwala i-Ultra Liquors, eMayville, behlome beyizingovolo befuna utshwala esigamekweni okuthiwa senzeka ngo-Okthoba 12, 2021.Kuvela ukuthi kwathi uma befica unogada uMnuz Phiwayinkosi Dladla esagweni, abangabuza lutho bamdubula ngoyaba lwezinhlamvu ngisho esecela uxolo.Kuvela ukuthi nomnikazi wesitolo uTristan Munsamy, walimala kabi ngalolu suku. IJaji uSingh likhale kakhulu ngesihluku esakhonjiswa yilaba bebulala unogada engenacala."Enakwenza kwaveza ukuthi ningabantu abanomhobholo kangakanani. Futhi naveza ukuthi aninandaba nempilo yomunye umuntu. Akukholakali ukuthi ngenxa nje yotshwala, kwakungaze kuphume isidumbu. Nakhombisa unya nokuba nomhobholo oxakayo,'' lisho kanjena likhuluma libabheka.Liqhuba ijaji lithe kune-vidiyo eyabonakala enkantolo eveza konke okwenzeka ngosuku lwesigameko.Lithe ummangalelwa wesibili uyabonakala exoxa namaphoyisa ngemuva nje kancane kwesigameko ezenza umuntu othukile naye ekubeni kanti uyena oyisigilamkhuba esikhulu.Ligcizelele ukuthi kuyacasula manje ukuthi eNingizimu Afrika ukubulawa komuntu sekuyinto nje elula efana nokugxotshwa kwentuthwane."Iqiniso ukuthi abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bakhathele manje. Inkinga abasazi nabo bazokwenza njani uma bephila ezweni elinje lapho ukubulala umuntu kulula nje,'' lisho kanjena iJaji.Lithe kuyamangaza ukuthi kuleli zwe kulula ukubopha itulo lokubulala umuntu ngoba izinswelaboya zimane zihlele zize ziliphothule.''Kungumsebenzi wezinkantolo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zenza okuthile ngenhloso yokukhulula iNingizimu Afrika kwizelelesi ezifana nani,'' usho kanjena.Ababulali bobabili bagixatshezwe udilikajele ngecala lokubulala uDladla. Kwaba yiminyaka engu-15 ngelokuhlasela indawo edayisa utshwala. Kwaba yiminyaka engu-10 ngecala lokuzama ukubulala umnikazi wesitolo.Kwathi ummangalelwa wokuqala wabhanselwa ngeminyaka engu-10 ngecala lokutholakala nesibhamu esingekho emthethweni sohlobo lwe-9mm, nemithathu ngelokutholakala nezinhlamvu. Zonke lezi zigwebo ijaji lithe bazozidonsa kanyekanye.Lithe emacaleni alolu hlobo kumele inkantolo yenza isiqiniseko sokuthi idlulisa umyalezo oshubile nakwezinye izelelesi."Kumqoka ukuthi izinkantolo zikhiphe izigwebo ezinesisindo ukuze kubonakale ukuthi baphelelaphi abenza okubi emphakathini,'' lisho kanjena.Liqhuba ijaji lithe inkantolo iye ibheke izinto ezehlukene ngaphambi kokuba igwebe abonile, yisisindo secala, umthelela elinawo emphakathini kanye nasemndenini.Lisebenzise nobufakazi obethulwa owomndeni ebalisa ngokuthi bagqemeka udume lwengozi ngokubulawa kukaDladla. Likhala ngesibazi elathi sekuyoba ngesaphakade.Bobabili ababulali bebebonakala bengathukile ngesikhathi ijaji limatasa lisafunda elikulobe phansi mayelana necala labo. Kuthe sebehla beya ezansi icala selibalahlile ummangalelwa wokuqala wabonakala ekhomba umphenyi wecala.Ngaphakathi enkantolo bekukhona amalungu omndeni akubo kwababulali abonakale echiphiza izinyembezi ngemuva kokuba inkantolo seyikhiphe izigwebo.

AZOQALA kulo nyakamali amaphoyisa ukudlubha inyufomu yawo enamakhamera ukuqinisa izinhlelo zokulwa nobugebengu kuleli.Lokhu kuvele empendulweni kaNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa kuleli, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, ephendula ilungu le-DA ePhalamende, uMnuz Mzamo Billy.UBilly ubefuna ukwazi ukuthi luqala nini uhlelo lokuthi amaphoyisa adlubhe namakhamera kwinyufomu yawo.Uthe bayajabula ukuthi uMchunu ugcine evumile ukuthi luqalwe lolu hlelo kulo nyakamali, oqala ngo-Ephreli.UMchunu uthe amaphoyisa azoqala athenge amakhamera angu-100, azodla u-R28 818 iyodwa.Uthe njengoba ezothengwa kancane kancane azokwazi ukuthi adluliselwe ezinhlakeni ezehlukene."Isabelomali samaphoyisa singaphansi kwenkulu ingcindezi ngenxa yezinye izidingo. Abalulekile ukuthi wona abekhona kodwa kubhekelwe nezinye izidingo,” kusho uMchunu.UBilly uthe ngonyaka la makhamera azodla u-R2 881 800. "Eminyakeni emihlanu kuzoba ngu-R14 409 000. Yize inkulu le mali kodwa lolu hlelo luzothela izithelo uma lusebenza ngendlela elindelekile,” kusho uBilly.Uthe noma sisincane isibalo samakhamera azothengwa njengoba amaphoyisa engu-179 000, kodwa kumele kube nezinhlelo zokuqinisekisa ukuthi lezi zinsiza azilahlekile, kazebiwa noma zilimale."Kumele kube nezindlela zokuhlale sazi ukuthi zikuphi ngaso sonke isikhathi lezi zinsiza. Sinxusa uMchunu ukuthi asheshise ukuwathenga aphinde akhishelwe amaphoyisa. Awaqeqeshwe amaphoyisa ngokuwasebenzisa ukuze kuqiniswe impi yokuvikela umphakathi.” UBilly uthe bazohlala amagqozo abaholi bamaphoyisa ukuthi baqinisekise ukuthi lolu hlelo luba yimpumelelo."Asifuni ukuthi kugcine kube wuhlelo nje olunganyakazi, bese kuphulwa isethembiso emphakathini. Sikholwa ngukuthi amakhamera azoveza konke okwenzeka nsuku zonke ukuze umphakathi ukwazi ukwethemba amaphoyisa,” kusho uBilly.Uthe azovikela ekutheni amaphoyisa aboshelwe amacala ekubeni abezivikela.Kwamanye amazwe amaphoyisa akhona ayawagqoka amakhamera.
IQEMBU le-IFP, liqinisekisile ukuthi uzofihlwa emathuneni asekhaya uMnuz Senzo Mfayela, obeyilungu lomgwamanda weqembu.UMfayela obeyisikhulu esiphezulu kuPrince Mangosuthu Buthelezi Foundation udlule emhlabeni ngeSonto, ngemuva kokuxinwa wukugula.UMchoboza wangena ePhalamende likazwelonke ngo-1994 ngesikhathi kuthatha uhulumeni wentando yeningi kuleli, kanti amagalelo akhe kwi-IFP aziwa ngabaningi eNdwedwe, nakulo lonke elakuleli.Kubikwa ukuthi umholi we-IFP, uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa, uzohola inkulumo yosuku enkonzweni yomngcwabo ezoba ngeSonto ekuseni, enkundleni yezemidlalo iMgezengwane, eMona, ngaphambi kokuba ayofihlwa emathuneni asekhaya.
UFUNA lungene enkantolo oloMnyango wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal, awusola ngokuphazamisa ubufakazi, kubola isidumbu sendodakazi emakhazeni kahulumeni, lungenziwe ulibofuzo ngecala lokudlwengula.Umufi, uWandile Ngcobo (17), obefunda u-Grade 11 eDurban Girls Secondary, kuthiwa wadlwengulwa, wagwazwa waze wafa ngoMeyi ngonyaka odlule, abasolwa asebevele kaningi ngaphambi kwenkantolo. Kubona kukhona nomakhelwane (39) okuvela ukuthi ubengaphandle ngoshwele esigwebeni seminyaka ewu-15 ngelinye icala. Isigameko senzeka ngesikhathi umufi esele yedwa kubo Kwa-Y, eMlaza. Uyise, uMnuz Mondli Ngcobo ukhale ngomnyango omhlinzele ezibini ngokubola kwesidumbu emakhazeni kahulumeni kungaqediwe ngophenyo lwamaphoyisa.Elandisa uthe, indodakazi yakhe yangeniswa emakhazeni asePark Rynie ngosuku lwesigameko.Uthe kudlule izinsuku ezine, banikela khona ukuyobheka isidumbu."Bala baphetha ukuthi siyibone ingane yami, bathi ayikahlinzwa, anginalo ilungelo lokuyibona,” kubalisa uNgcobo.Uthe batshelwa ukuthi abalindele ucingo olubabizela emakhazeni emva kwesonto. Uthe waxakeka uma sebemshayela ucingo ezinsukwini ezimbili ezandulela ingxoxo yabo. "Kwangixaka ngoba babekade bengitshele ukuthi isidumbu sendodakazi yami singasemsileni kulayini olinde ukuhlinzwa,” kusho uNgcobo.Uthe ngesikhathi eseyosithatha isidumbu nabamakhaza azimele, abamakhaza kahulumeni abafunanga nokuthi asibonele ngaphakathi, basikhipha, basifaka emotweni yamakhaza azimele, bathi usengasibheka-ke."Kwangisiza ukuthi ngithi asivulwe sonke ngisibone njengoyise. Ingane yase ibolile, igcwele izimpethu, kukhona izingxenye zomzimba esezibhucuka, inuka, kukhona ngisho nezimpukane eziluhlaza futhi ingathungiwe nakahle,” kuchaza uNgcobo.Uthe wabuza imibuzo ngaso leso sikhathi, angazange azithole izimpendulo zayo. Uthe njengoba icala lokubulawa kwendodakazi yakhe seledluliselwe eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini, selingaqulwa noma inini, ujabhile uma ethola ukuthi abasolwa ngeke balethweswe icala lokudlwengula."Kuthiwe isimo indodakazi yami eyase ikuso, kwakungeke kusakwazi ukuthi kuthathwe amasampula olibofuzo obufakazi bokuthi yadlwengulwa ngaphambi kokubulawa,” kusho uNgcobo.Uthe uthole ukuthi udokotela wasemakhazeni wathi njengoba sesibolile isidumbu, ngeke esakwazi ukwenza lolu hlobo lokuhlola."Kuthiwa wathi ngesikhathi esehlola isidumbu sendodakazi yami, sasesonakele kakhulu, sesiphuma nezinye izinhlobo zoketshezi, kungaselula ukuthi kubonakale lolu oluqondene nendaba yokudlwengulwa,” kusho uNgcobo.Uthe uzwa sengathi indodakazi yakhe ibulawe kabili, ifike yabulawa abamangalelwa, yase ibulawa abasemakhazeni ngokobulungiswa obekumele ikuthole ecaleni lokudlwengulwa kwayo."Okusho ukuthi ngenxa yobudedengu basemakhazeni, abasolwa bazophunyuka kalula kwelokudlwengula. Ibuhlungu into abangenze yona ngendodakazi yami,” kusho uNgcobo.Uthe uselufakile kubameli udaba ukuze luye enkantolo.Ngosuku lwesigameko, isidumbu sikaWandile satholwa siboshwe izandla nge-pantihose, enye ifakwe emlonyeni, sinamanxeba okugwazwa amahlanu.Kwavela ukuthi kwebiwe ithelevishini, DStv Decoder, remote control neselula kamufi.Kulandela isigameko, kwaqale kwasolwa yena uNgcobo, kwaze kwaphoqa ukuthi kuyobukwa amakhamera asemsebenzini ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ubengekho ngempela endaweni yesigameko. Umsolwa (39) ongumakhelwane, waboshwa esebhace KwaShembe, eClermont. Kwaqale kwaboshwa omunye (25) eMalukazi, etholwa neselula kamufi.Ngesikhathi beboshwa abasolwa ngoJulayi ngonyaka odlule, okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uBrigadier Jay Naicker, wayetshele abezindaba ukuthi babhekene necala lokubulala, elokudlwengula nelokweba.Icala libuyela enkantolo ngoFebhuwari 27.Kuze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela lolu daba aboMnyango wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal bengayiphendulile imibuzo abathunyelelwe yona.

Okunye ukuthi abantu abathole amaphilisi ezibhedlela, bangazithengeli bakithi. Akwenziwe into elungile ngemali, izalukazi zihole o-R3 000 manje."UMnuz Sipho Rasta Duma uthe: "Mina engingakujabulela kungqongqoshe wukukhuphuka kwemali yalaba abangasebenzi, o-R370 ibe ngu-R500 okungenani. Abafundile bagogoda banikwe o-R3 000 okwalesi sikhashana bengasebenzi. Anciphise imali yongqongqoshe neyamalungu ePhalamende futhi kuqedwe namaphini ongqongqoshe atamuza imali yethu bakhokhi bentela."Abanye bathe akunyuswe imali yokuthenga ugwayi namankwebevu, kuphinde kunyuswe nesibonelelo sabangasebenzi njengoba kunzima ukwakha amathuba omsebenzi.
Page leadISIKHUNGO esinikezela ngoxhaso kwizitshudeni zemfundo ephakeme i-NSFAS, sigxeke ukuxhashazwa kwazo ngomasitende okubalwa nokukhokhiswa ngocansi ngomastende.Lesi sikhungo sisho kanje njengoba kuqhubeka amahlebezi okuthi esikhungweni saseThekwini TVET College, izitshudeni zesifazane bezicelwa ngomasitende ucansi ukuze bazinikeze izindawo zokuhlala.Esitatimendeni esikhishwe yilesi sikhungo, sithe asikufuni ukuhlukumezwa kwezitshudeni kanye nodlame olubhekiswe kuzo banoma yiluphi uhlobo."Sigxeka kakhulu ukuxhashazwa kwezitshudeni ezisengozini kanye nanoma yiziphi izenzo zodlame olubhekiswe kuzo. Ngokubambisana noMnyango wezeMfundo ePhakeme nokuQeqesha neThekwini TVET College sizoqala ngokushesha uphenyo ngezehlakalo ezibikiwe," kusho isitatimende.Isitatimende sithe njengesikhungo bazosebenzisana nalabo abahlukumezekile."Sizosiza abahlukumezekile ukuthi bavulele abenzi bobubi amacala. Uma ngabe uphenyo mayelana nezinsolo ezibhekiswe komasitende lubonakala luyiqiniso, i-NSFAS izothatha izinyathelo ezinqala, okungabandakanya ukufakwa kwaleyo ndawo ohlwini lwamabhuku ababi kanye nokunqamula inkontileka yomasitende abathintekayo ukuqinisekisa ukuphepha kwezitshudeni.""Mayelana nodaba lwezinkokhelo ezisalele ngoJanuwari 31, i-NSFAS ikhiphe isekhula kuzo zonke izikhungo zemfundo ephakeme ngezinyathelo ezenziwe ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izitshudeni ezixhaswe yi-NSFAS ziyabhaliswa," sisho kanje.Siqhube ngokuthi mayelana nezitshudeni ezithintekayo ohlelweni lwe-Close-Out Project, okuyilapho i-NSFAS izokwazi ukukhokha imali enele, izitshudeni kufanele zivunyelwe ukubhaliswa kabusha futhi imininingwane yezithintekayo kufanele iyiswe ethimbeni le-NSFAS Servicing elikhona kuwona wonke amanyuvesi omphakathi namakolishi.
YAYIQHOSHA ngokuziphilisa ngokusoconga osopolitiki '’inkabi’’ engummangalelwa wokuqala ecaleni lokubulawa komlandeli omkhulu kaNkk Zandile Gumede, uMnuz Siduduzo Innocent Magwaza.Lokhu kuvele eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini, uMnuz Sphamandla Makhanya ongummangalelwa wokuqala evele kule nkantolo nommangalelwa wesibili, uMnuz Mxolisi Percy Hadebe.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi kwashiya abantu abaningi beshaqekile ukusocongwa kukaMagwaza owashonela esibhedlela ezintathakusa ngemuva kokuba edutshulwe ngamadoda amabili angaziwa esemzini wakhe eCornubia, ngoJanuwari 12, 2021Izolo, iJaji uSharmaine Balton, belikade lisaqhubeka nokufunda ubufakazi obehlukene obathulwa phambilini kuleli cala. Leli cala selisesigabeni sokukhishwa kwesinqumo. Kodwa isinqumo kasiphumanga izolo, njengoba belisaqhubeka ijaji lendlalela isinqumo.Kuvele ukuthi kunofakazi abathathu ngaphambilini, abatshela inkantolo ukuthi ummangalelwa wokuqala wakusho kwagcwala umlomo kubona ukuthi isizathu esimbeka eCornubia, yingoba uzokwenza umsebenzi wokusoconga osopolitiki ngoba leyo yinto naye aziphilisa ngayo.Ijaji libasho ngamagama ofakazi elithe yibona abavumelana ngokuthi ummangalelwa wokuqala washo into efanayo kubona."Kunofakazi abavumelanayo ukuthi ummangalelwa wokuqala wakhuluma kubona ngokuthi uze kule ndawo ngoba ezobulala osopolitiki,'' kugcizelela ijaji.Lithe lobu ubufakazi elikholwa ukuthi buqotho, buqondile futhi abudinge kuphonselwa nselelo ngoba alikholwa ukuthi kungaba nesizathu esingaze siholele ekutheni bonke labo fakazi bamane bakhethe ukuthi basenge ezimithiyo ngommngalelwa wokuqala.Liveze nokuthi kunofakazi okwathi esatshelwa ocingweni ngokudutshulwa kukamufi wezwa othile ngemuva kokuqhuma kwesibhamu ekhuluma ethi "sebewuphothulile umshikashika”.Lo fakazi lithe ijaji wathi useyabona ukuthi wayekhuluma ngamuphi umshikashika.Enkantolo kuhlaluke ukuthi ummangalelwa wokuqala wagonyuluka ngokuziphilisa ngokubulala osopolitiki kubantu abehlukene. Kuthiwa wakusho ngesikhathi behlangane khona eCornubia, ngo-30 Disemba 2020.Amazwi afanayo kuthiwa waphinde wawasho futhi nangakusasa esewatshela abanye futhi asebephenduke ofakazi ecaleni.Kuze kwavela nokuthi ummangalelwa wesibili kwathi uma eqaphela ukuthi ummangalelwa wokuqala akayeki ukudane "eshumayela leli vesi", wase ekhetha ukuthi aphumele naye emnyango wamkhuza emtshela ukuthi makayeke ukusho le nto ebantwini abehlukene.Kuthiwa kwathi sebebuyela ngaphakathi endlini lapho okwakuhlangenwe khona kuphuzwa, ummangalelwa wokuqala wabuya eseyimvu yenkosi engasandile ngamagama.Kuvele ukuthi ummangalelwa wokuqala kwakuthi uma esewuphothulile umsebenzi wokusoconga, bese imali ingena ebhange lentombi yakhe egagulwe ngegama enkantolo.Ijaji libuye laveza nobufakazi elithe bethulwa ngowesilisa owabona okwakwenzeka ngosuku lwesigameko. Lithe lo kwakulula ukuba abone ngoba wayesondele ngebanga elingalinganiswa namagxathu angu-10 noma ngaphezudlwana.Kuthiwe lo fakazi watshela inkantolo ukuthi wababoba abamangalelwa bobabili endaweni yesigameko ngalobu busuku."Lo fakazi wathi wasizwa isibhamu siqhuma, kwathi uma eya endlini kamufi wafike wambona edindilizile phezu kwegazi,'' lisho kanjena.Libalule nokuthi umufi kwathi esedutshuliwe wacela ukuthi abantu bamcelele ummangalelwa wesibili ukuba amphuthumise esibhedlela engazi ukuthi naye umdibimunye nabenzi bokubi.Kodwa futhi kuthiwa kukhona lapho umufi atshela khona othile ukuthi uzomtshela ukuthi ngobani abambulele kodwa lokho kwagcina kungenzekanga kwaze kwamenela esibhedlela.Seliphetha ijaji libuhlabe labuhlikiza ubufakazi obuningi obethulwa ummangalelwa wokuqala, lathi wayehhubhuza ebheca abanye futhi ubufakazi bakhe bushayisana.Abamangalelwa bobabili bebebonakala bethule begqolozele ijaji njengabantu ebebefuna ukulalela kahle konke ebelikusho.Icala liyaqhubeka.
UPHENYO lwamaphoyisa lokuqala lukhomba ukuthi abasolwa ababili abafe bedubulana namaphoyisa eNhlungwane, eNanda, banokuxhumana neqembu lemigulukudu iWest okusanda kubulawa umholi walo ngesimo esifanayo sokudubulana namaphoyisa.Ezinsukwini ezimbalwa ezedlule, amaphoyisa athole ulwazi kubahlali baseNanda, abagcina umthetho endaweni ngabasolwa abenza ubugebengu endaweni, amaphoyisa alandela lolo lwazi enza uphenyo lwawo oluveze ukuthi abasolwa bayathinteka emacaleni okubamba inkunzi eNhlungwane.BAFE ujuqu bedubulana namaphoyisa eNanda isithombe: SAPSKuthiwa batholane phezulu ngenhlamvu namaphoyisa ngoLwesibili ekuseni, ngemuva kokuthi uphiko lwezobunhloli lulandele umkhondo wabo lwaze lwabavimbezela kulo muzi abatholwe kuwo.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthi ngesikhathi amaphoyisa ememezela ukuthi akhona ngokungqongqoza emnyango, abasolwa baphendule ngenhlamvu amaphoyisa aphindisela. "Ngesikhathi kudutshulwana kulimale abasolwa ababili abafele khona lapho, kwaboshwa umsolwa oyedwa ongazange alwe namaphoyisa,” kusho yena.Uqhubeke wathi kutholakale izibhamu ezimbili endaweni yesehlo.
OWAPHUNYUKWA isikhundla sokuba imenenja kaMasipala waseThekwini, uMnuz Max Mbili, uthole amadlelo aluhlaza.UMbili obekade eyimenenja kaMasipala waseRay Nkonyeni, uqokelwe kwesokuba yinhloko yoMnyango wezokuHlaliswa kwaBantu KwaZulu-Natal.UMbili uthulwe ngokusemthethweni izolo, uMphathiswa wezokuHlaliswa kwaBantu, uMnuz Siboniso Duma.Ngo-2022, uMbili waphunyukwa iqatha emlonyeni njengoba kwala kancane ukuba aqokelwe kwesemenenja kaMasipala waseThekwini.Wayekade ephume phambili ngesikhathi kunenhlololwazi yokuqala eyayibheka ozokuba imenenja kamasipala. Kwathi sekusele kancane ukuba uMbili aqokwe, kwabuye kwavela izinsolo zokugxambukela kobuholi be-ANC. Kwaba nezinsolo zokuthi abaholi be-ANC bayalela ababeqhuba inhlololwazi ukuba baqoke uMbili.Lwabe seluqalwa phansi uhlelo lokuthungatha ozokuba imenenja kamasipala, nokwagcina ngokuthi isikhundla sithathwe uMnuz Musa Mbhele.UDuma uthe bajabule kakhulu ngokujoyinwa uMbili, wathi uMbili uyena ohambe phambi kwinhlololwazi ngesikhathi umnyango uthungatha ozokuba yinhloko yawo."Ukuqokwa kwakhe kwamukelwe nangamalungu ekomiti lasePhalamende elibhekelele ukusebenza komnyango.”UDuma uthe babheke lukhulu kuMbili athe wenze umsebenzi oncomekayo ngesikhathi eyimenenja kaMasipala waseRay Nkonyeni."Ngesikhathi ephethe kuMasipala waseRay Nkonyeni umkhandlu wawuhlezi uthola imibiko enganagcobho kuMcwaningimaBhuku, futhi umasipala wathola imiklomelo eminingi yokuba umasipala ohamba phambili. "Wathola izindondo eziningi zokuba imenenja kamasipala ehamba phambili. Wayesekhaleni lokwakhiwa kwezindlu ezingaphezu kuka-4 000 kumasipala. Lokhu wakwenza ngokusebenzisana noMnyango wezokuHlaliswa kwaBantu.”UDuma uthe balindele ukuthi uMbili aqhubeke nomsebenzi omuhle abekade evele ewenza esikhundleni sakhe abesiphethe emnyangweni.UMbili ubewumqondisi ophikweni olubhekelele uhlela ukusebenza komnyango."Siqashe yena ngoba nakhu sijahe ukubona kuphenduleka imithandazo yalabo abasivotela ngesikhathi kunokhetho. Nginesiqiniseko sokuthi uMbili ubeyilalele inkulumo eyethulwe uMengameli (uCyril Ramaphosa) ngeledlule, lapho esho khona ukuthi ziningi izinhlelo zentuthuko ezizokuza lapha KwaZulu-Natal. Sifuna ukubona kushunqa uthuli kuzo zonke izingxenye zesifundazwe.”
USUCABANGA ngokuhlukile umndeni wowesilisa waseZidulwini, eNquthu, okwatholakala ikhanda lakhe lilahliwe egcekeni ngoDisemba wangonyaka owedlule.Kuzokhumbuleka phela ukuthi saba yindaba egudwini isigameko sokutholakala kwekhanda likamufi uMnuz Siyabonga Ndlovu egcekeni, umzimba wona usegumbini ayelele kulona.Ilungu lomndeni elakhuluma neSolezwe phambilini laveza ukuthi basola ukuthi umufi ubulawe ngumfowabo abaveza ukuthi ugcwele amathafa."Ekhanda bekunenkebenkebe yengozi ekhomba khona ukuthi uqale walinyazwa kabuhlungu ekhanda ngaphambi kokuba kususwe ikhanda lakhe,'' lasho kanjena.Laze laveza nokuthi basola ukuthi laba ababili umnyombo wengxabano yabo kube ukuthi umufi wayekade ekhuza umfowabo ngokuthi usegxile kakhulu ezidakamizwweni nasophuzweni oludakayo.Leli lungu latshela Isolezwe ukuthi ngosuku lwesigameko umsolwa wayekade ehamba nqunu usuku lonke laze lashona ilanga.Kodwa manje unina wabo bobabili umufi nomsolwa , uNkk Cabangile Ndlovu useshaya amakhala ngokuthi babulalana bodwa.Uthi useqala ukusola ukuthi kukhona owahlasela amadodana wakhe wawabulala womabili.Uthi akakholwa ukuthi kunomuntu onganyamalala isikhathi eside kangaka. Ucele ukuthi bafuniswe umsolwa noma ngabe kutholakala isidumbu sakhe kuyobe kwanele."Sengibone kahle umsolwa angikholwa ukuthi uyena owabulala umfowabo. Sengiqala ukubona ukuthi empeleni kukhona umuntu othile okunguyena owangena egcekeni wazobulala amadodana ami womabili,'' usho kanjena.Uthe uyafisa ukuthi bagcine balivalile leli khasi lesigameko esabehlela kodwa uthi angeke kube lula ukuba bamane balivele indodana yakhe enye engenalo ulwazi ukuthi iyephi?Uphinde wagcizelela ukuthi uyafisa ukuthola usizo njengoba kunguyena ekuseni owakhangwa yikhanda lendodana lisegcekeni."Angazi ukuthi ubani ongangisiza ngithole ukwalulekwa ngokwengqondo. Isithombe sekhanda lendodana lami lisegcekeni akuvumi ukuthi sisuke ekhanda. Angifuni ukuqamba amanga yaze yangihlukumeza nansi into,'' usho kanjena."Singajabula kakhulu uma kungase kutholakale lo omunye ngoba manje sesiqala nokucabanga ukuthi mhlawumbe naye akasekho emhlabeni kwazi bani,'' usho kanjena.Phambilini amaphoyisa aKwaZulu-Natal awazange aphawule ngalesi sigameko.
NKOSIKHONA CELEUPHUME ngesamagundane abazalwane besho ukumqeda uMfundisi Zakhele Mthethwa, webandla labasindisiwe iNew Begining, eliseXobho. Lokhu kwenzeke ngemuva kokuthi abazalwane beqaphele isiphandla esihlakaleni sakhe sangokwesokunxele, ngesikhathi eshumayela ngeSonto eledlule.Ngokuthola kweSolezwe Ngempelasonto kusuke isidumo ngemva kokuthi kuqale kwaqaphela umzalwane oyedwa, osebuholini bebandla okunguyena okuthiwa uqhwebe omunye ethi makambukise "imihlola".Umthombo okhonza ebandleni uthi kuthe eqhubeka nentshumayelo yakhe uMthethwa, saphinde savela isiphandla."Ngikutshela ukuthi abazalwane bamane baqonda kuyena bafika bamsusa epulpiti base bemphoqa ukuba aphakamise isandla, kwakhuphuka ihembe esandleni sakhe nebala sabonakala isiphandla,'' kuchaza umthombo.Uqhuba uthi inkonzo iphazamisekile ngoba ubuholi obuphezulu bebandla bumdonsile baya naye ehhovisi ngenhloso yokuthi kubhungwe kabanzi ngesiphandla.Umthombo uthi kuthe uMthethwa esehhovisi nobuholi bebandla waphuma ngesamagundane, eshiya umkakhe nemoto egcekeni."Abazalwane bese besho ukukhiphela ulaka lwabo kumkamfundisi bemsola ngokuthi uyayazi le mpilo embaxambili, ephilwa owakwakhe kodwa kwakhona abakhuzayo,'' usho kanjena.Kuthintwa unobhala webandla uMfu Swelihle Xulu, uvumile ukuthi kube nesigameko esinjena ebandleni.Ugcizelele ukuthi badumele kakhulu bengamalungu ebandla ukuthi kanti sonke lesi sikhathi baholwa ngumuntu owenza izinto ezimbili eyedwa."Kuyimanje ubuholi bebandla bunqume ukuthi amiswe ebandleni kuze kube sithola incazelo ephathekayo kuyena uMthethwa,'' echaza.Isolezwe Ngempelasonto likhulume noMthethwa ovese walimisa ngesihloko elokuthi vele, ubesifakile isiphandla.Uthe kuyamxaka ukuthi kungani abazalwane bevuka umbhejazane kangaka ngoba kade aqala ukufaka isiphandla kodwa ukuthi ubesifihla.''Mina ekhaya sikhuliswe ngokuthi likhona idlozi kodwa futhi ukhona noNkulunkulu. Iphutha engilenzile ukushumayela kakhulu ngensindiso kubona ngangalikhuluma iqiniso lokuthi zombili lezi zinto ziyamsebenzela umuntu osadla anhlamvana,'' usho kanjena.Uthe ngeke avume ukuxoshwa ngabantu ebandleni elasungulwa nguyena."Ngizoke ngime kancane ukuya enkonzweni kodwa uma sengibuya ngizobe sengingasadle nkobe zamuntu sengifuna ibandla lami,'' usho kanjena.Ebuzwa ukuthi yini edale ukuthi acele empunzini ashiye umkakhe ngemuva, uphendule ngokuthi ubazi ukuthi bebe ngeke baze bamenze lutho umkakhe.
UFUNA ubulungiswa umndeni wowesilisa waKwaShobashobane, eZingolweni, otholwe esefile emakhazeni kahulumeni asePinetown, ngoLwesihlanu.Umufi, uMnuz Nhlakanipho "Barman" Nzama (27) ubehlala futhi esebenza eMlaza.Kuthiwa wagcina ukubonwa ephila ngoFebhuwari 2, benomfowabo, beshaywa u-renki menenja nabashayeli ababili erenki yamatekisi aKwaMakhutha, engasemgwaqweni uRussell, eThekwini.Ngokusho kwelungu lomndeni, uNksz Nolwazi Nyawose, umufi wayefike KwaMakhutha ngayizolo, ezovakashela abakwabo.Uthe ngakusasa, bobathathu baya kodayisa eMakethe, lapho okudayisa khona laba ayebavakashele."Ntambama sebegoduka, sebekhothakhothile, banikela erenki yamatekisi aKwaMakhutha, bangena bahlala bobathathu ezihlalweni ezingemuva komshayeli,” kusho uNksz Nyawose.Uthe baba nempikiswano encane, umufi nomfowabo bagcina beshaywa, wathi kwathi kusenjalo, kwaqhamuka urenki menenja nabashayeli ababili, babuzana ukuthi "yibona yini laba”. Uthe baphendulana bodwa, bevumelana ukuthi "yebo ibona”."Babe sebeyabula uBarman, bemkhiphela ngaphandle kwetekisi. Balandelisa ngokuyabula umfowethu wesibili, base bebadinda ngenduku,” kulandisa uNksz Nyawose.Uthe lo oyedwa owayesele ngaphakathi etekisini, wathi uyazama ukuphuma ayobalamulela, wabanjwa ngomunye wesifazane ngamawashingi, ethi kuyingozi ukuyolamulela abafowabo ebantwini abadinwe kanje.Uveze ukuthi kwaba ukungena kwabanye abagibeli abathathu, yagcwala itekisi, yasuka yahamba.Uthe efika KwaMakhutha lo owasala etekisini, walinda emgwaqweni ngethemba lokuthi abafowabo bazokwehla kwelandelayo bobabili.Nokho uthe kwagcina kufika oyedwa, esho ukuthi yena bamshaye waze waquleka, akabonanga ukuthi umufi bagcine bemenza njani.Uthe umndeni uhambe wayobuza erenki ukuthi baphi abahlasele abagilwa, kwangaba bikho muntu osefuna ukuzihlanganisa nodaba, wathi badlulele ehhovisi likaHlokomela eliKwaMakhutha ukuyobika, bathenjiswa ukuthi udaba luzosukunyelwa."Kuvulwe icala lomuntu odukile emaphoyiseni aseDurban Central, kwacingwa yonke indawo, lutho. Sigcine sesibhala ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, sicela ukufuniswa yena,” kubeka uNksz Nyawose. Uqhube wathi kungene ucingo ngoLwesihlanu lomuntu othe usebenza emakhazeni kahulumeni ePinetown, wathi abazobheka."Wathi kunesidumbu somuntu abathi uma besibuka, basifanise nalo esimfake ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, esithi sicela ukufuniswa yena,” usho kanje.Uthe bathe uma befika, bathola ukuthi wuyena ngempela, wathi batshelwe ukuthi watholwa ngamaphoyisa aseBrighton Beach ku-M4 uma ubheke eBluff. Uthe ulimele ekhanda, ngemuva nasezandleni."Ushayiwe. Kuphinde kubukeke sengathi wakhishwa imoto ihamba,” kusho uNksz Nyawose, othe bafuna baphenyisiswe laba abagcina ukubonakala bemshaya ngoba bewumndeni bayakholelwa ekutheni bayathinteka ekufeni kwakhe.Uveze ukuthi bathe uma behosha umoya, bathola ukuthi bobathathu abahlaseli, abasabonwa nangokhalo kule renki okwenzeka kuyo isigameko.Kuze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela ingatholakali i-Santaco neHlokomela ukuba baphawule ngalolu daba. Namaphoyisa awayiphendulanga imibuzo ayithunyelelwe ngodaba.
INDLUNKULU kaZulu isikuqinisekisile ukuthi kukhona ingoduso entsha yenkosi esibayeni, ochazwe njengongaba uNdlunkulu wesizwe samaZulu.UMntwana uSihle Mdluli ungowasebukhosini bakwaMdluli eMpumalanga, kuthiwa useminyakeni yo-20 ubudala futhi usechitha isonto lakhe lesibili kwesinye sezigodlo zenkosi enyakatho-mpumalanga yeKwaZulu-Natal. Ukuba khona kwakhe kuqinisekiswe ngobemele iSilo uMntwana uGumbela Zulu, othe lo wesifazane wethulwe ngokusemthethweni kuyena namanye amalungu omndeni wasebukhosini."Yebo, okwamanje usesibayeni sobukhosi silinde iSilo ukuthi sisinikeze umkhombandlela wokuthi ngabe uyena yini umama wesizwe. Kumele ukhumbule ukuthi njengoba iSilo sikwazi ukuganwa ngamakhosikazi amaningi, omunye wabo kumele kube ngumama wesizwe ozozala indlalifa, njengoba kwenzeka kusona futhi ilobolo layo kumele likhokhwe yisizwe samaZulu. Uma iSilo noNdlunkulu sebezigculisekile ukuthi ukufanele ukwenza lokho, izobe isicela mina noma undunankulu wayo ukuthi acele amagalelo ezizweni zakhe ukuze akhokhele ilobolo,” kusho uZulu.Ngokwemithombo yomndeni wasendlunkulu uMntwana uSihle ubekhona ngesikhathi kunomcimbi wokugcina woMkhosi wokweShwama obungesonto eledlule esigodlweni esisha, eMashobeni.Umthombo uthe ubephakathi kwequlu lezintokazi ezigqoke imvunulo yesiNdebele zidansa umdanso wesintu, uthe kodwa bambalwa abantu abamqaphelile. Umthombo uqhube wathi wethulwa eSilweni wumndeni wakubo ukuze akhe ubudlelwano nesizwe samaZulu.
ISILO uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini siyaqhubeka nokwethemba obewundunankulu kaZulu, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, njengoba simjube ukuba ahlele ukhukhulelangoqo wembizo kaZulu ezobhunga ngodaba lokuvalwa kwebhange Ithala kanye nombango wokulawula isikhwama esigade umhlaba kaZulu, iNgonyama Trust.IMbube ijube uButhelezi ukuba ahlele le mbizo ezokuba sesigodlweni eMashobeni, oPhongolo, ngoLwesihlanu.Encwadini yeSilo ebhekiswe kuButhelezi ebonwe yiSolezwe, iMbube iveza ukuthi inethemba lokuthi imbizo izokuba impumelelo uma ihlelwa uButhelezi ngoba unamava kwezithinta ubuholi bomdabu.Muva nje, iSilo siqoke uButhelezi ukuba ahole ithimba labaNtwana baseNdlunkulu namakhosi elibekelwe ukuba lilekelele uhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal emizamweni yokulwa nokuvalwa kweThala.UButhelezi uyaqhubeka nokubonakala emikhosini yesizwe eviliyela namabutho. Akakaqokwa undunankulu omusha.Ukususwa kukaButhelezi kwesikandunankulu kaZulu kwamenyezelwa owayekhulumela iSilo ngaleloso sikhathi, uMntwana uSimphiwe Zulu, nokho uButhelezi uthi kuze kube manje iMbube ayikaze imtshele ngokususwa kwakhe esikhundleni.UButhelezi uthe nangesikhathi kumenyezelwa ukuthi usekhishiwe esikhundleni, washo ukuthi uzolinda ukubhonga kweNgonyama."Ngachaza kwabezindaba ukuthi iSilo asikaze sisho lutho kumina, ngisaqhubeka la engangigcine khona. Ngisalinde iSilo ukuba kube yiso esishoyo. Kuze kube manje iSilo asikaze sisho lutho kumina, sisaqhubeka nokungithuma.”Echaza ngembizo yangoLwesihlanu, uButhelezi uthe lena imbizo ebaluleke kakhulu esizweni.Imbizo kaZulu yokugcina yayingo-2018, yayibizwe iSilo uGoodwill Zwelithini kaBhekuzulu ukuba kubhungwe ngesiphakamiso sokuba kuhlakazwe iNgonyama Trust."Emva kweminyaka eyisikhombisa, iSilo esisesihlalweni sesiphinde sabiza enye imbizo ukuba sizobonisana namakhosi ukuthi kuyoze kube nini amakhosi elokhu encikiselelwa ngomhlaba kaZulu. ISilo sinxusa uZulu ukuba aphelele njengoba sizokhipha umhlahlandlela ngalolu daba.”UButhelezi ukhale nangomthelela omubi odalwe isicelo sokuvalwa kwebhange Ithala.Amakhasimende eThala angaphezu kuka-250 000, awakwazi ukukhipha nokufaka imali.UButhelezi uthe abantu abaningi abashayekile abahlala ezindaweni zamakhosi."Abantu abakwazanga ukubuyisela izingane ezikoleni ngenxa yokuthi inkece yabo ivaleleke eThala. Osomabhizinisi abakwazi ukuqhubeka namabhizinisi abo njengoba bengakwazi ukuholela abasebenzi kanye nokuthenga izinto zokuhweba. Lesi simo siwulimazile kakhulu umnotho. Ingakho nje seseka imizamo kaNdunankulu wesifundazwe (uMnuz Thami Ntuli) yasenkantolo yokulwa nokuvalwa kweThala.”
