SEKUQUBUKE ingebhe ezikoleni zaKwaZulu-Natal, kubheduka isifo "samatele” esihlasele ezinye zezikole eThekwini.Lesi sifo esithelelanayo sihlasele kakhulu abafundi basemabangeni aphansi kanjalo nasezinkulisa.Babalelwa ku-117 abasahlaselwe yilesi sifo selokhu sibhedukile ezikoleni ezinhlanu ePhoenix, Greenwood Park naseMhlanga, eThekwini. Ziyishumi izinkulisa osekutholwe kusona lesi sifo.UNobhala wenyunyana yothisha i-Sadtu esifundazweni, uNksz Nomarashiya Caluza, uthe bakhathazekile ngokubheduka kwalesi sifo kwezinye zezikole eThekwini."Okukhathaza kakhulu ngukuthi ezinye izikole kazinawo nhlobo amanzi, ekubeni kudingeka kuhlanzwe izindawo zabafundi kuphinde kugezwe nezandla. Sibheduka nje, noMnyango wezeMfundo kawunamali yokunika izikole ukuze zikwazi ukuthenga izinsiza ezingasiza uma kuhlanzwa izandla ukuze singabhebhezeleleki,” kusho uNksz Caluza.UNksz Babongile Mhlongo wophiko lwezifo ezithathelanayo eMnyangweni wezeMpilo esifundazweni, ucashunwe kwi-SABC, ethi lesi sifo "samatele” kasifani nalesi esihlasela izilwane."Sihlasela izingane ezincane njengoba abahaqekile besezikoleni zamabanga aphansi nasezinkulisa. Sidlanga ngesikhathi sasehlobo noma uma sekusondele ubusika. "Siyakwazi ukuziphelela kodwa abazali abazihambise izingane zabo kodokotela nasemitholampilo uma zinezimpawu zomkhuhlane, ubuhlungu bomphimbo, ukukhathala, ukungakuthandi ukudla namabhanyaza abuhlungu,” kusho uNksz Mhlongo.Uxwayise ukuba angaqhumbuzwa amabhanyaza abanalesi sifo ngoba abuhlungu."Izindawo ezihlaselwa yilesi sifo yisemlonyeni, isezihlakaleni, kanjalo nasezithendeni. Sidlulela komunye umuntu ngoketshezi olusemlonyeni noma ekhaleni, kanjalo nasezindaweni ezisetshenziswa abantu abaningi. "Lesis sifo siqala ukuziveza ezinsukwini eziphakathi kwezintathu kuya kweziyisikhombisa, kanti sihlala emzimbeni izinsuku eziyisikhombisa kuya kwezingu-10.”Uveze ukuthi lesi sifo asithathelani sisuka ezilwaneni siye kubantu, wanxusa abazali, izingane nothisha ukuba baqikelele ukuthi bawasha izandla ngaso sonke isikhathi, bangavumeli izingane ukuthi zisebenzise amathoyizi awodwa.Umnyango unxuse abazali ukuthi bagcine izingane ezinalesi sifo emakhaya zize zibuye uma sezingcono.Unxuse nokuthi kwehliswe amaphaphu nakuba kunokukhathazeka ngokunyuka kwesibalo sabahaqekayo.Umnyango uveze ukuthi lesi sifo sitholakala nanoma ikuphi kuleli. Okhulumela umnyango wezeMfundo esifundazweni, uMnuz Muzi Mahlambi, ucele ukuthi kuphawule abezempilo ngalesi sifo.UMasipala weTheku uthe usiqaphile isimo ngemuva kokubheduka kwalesi sifo.Unxuse abahaqekile ukuthi bathole usizo lwezempilo."Sibe nohlelo lokucija abahloli nothishanhloko bezikole ngalesi sifo. Sihlele nokuqeqesha abezempilo ngaso. Uphiko lwezifo oluthethalayo emkhandlwini luzovakashela izikole nemiphakathi siyoqwashisa ngalesi sifo, siphinde sigqugquzele inhlanzeko,” kusho umasipala.

PHEZU kokuba siluliwe isikhathi sokushintshwa kwamakhadi ayigolide akwa-Sassa okuhola impesheni kuze kube yinyanga ezayo, kodwa kusenokukhala ngokuthi sincane lesi sikhathi esibekiwe sokuwashintsha.La makhadi bekumele ashintshwe ungakadluli umnqamulajuqu uFebhuwari 28, 2025, kodwa ngenxa yengcindezi yezinhlaka ezehlukene ebezibhekene noMnyango wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi, salulwa isikhathi kuze kube nguMashi 20, nonyaka.Ikomiti lasePhalamende likwamukele ukululwa kwesikhathi kodwa lathi kumele kube nohlelo olucacile oluzosetshenziswa ukuvuselela amakhadi.Usihlalo wekomiti, uNksz Bridget Masango, uthe ukululwa kwesikhathi ngaphandle kohlelo olucacile, kuzodala ukutatazela kulabo okumele bashintshe amakhadi."ISassa kumele ihambele izindawo zabahlala abadala, abakhubazekile kanjalo nalabo okunzima ukuthi bafinyelele lapho kushintshwa khona amakhadi, ukuze ibasizele kulezi zikhungo. Kunezikhalazo ngokushoda kwezikhungo zokushintsha amakhadi,” kusho uNksz Masango.Uthe bekuminyene ezindaweni eziningi ebekushintshwa kuzona amakhadi kusuka ngeledlule."Abantu abadala bebebambe olayini abade, abanye bajikiswa ngoba kuthiwa kwamukelwa isibalo esithile. Izinkumbi zabantu zithembele ekukhipheni imali kanti ukungabi nabasebenzi abenele ababhekele lolu hlelo, luzokwenza inqwaba idikibale ukushintsha amakhadi,” usho kanje.Ukhale nangokuthi zincane izikhungo zePosi ezweni ngenxa yokuthi eziningi zazo zavalwa."ISassa ihluleke yancama ukuhlela izinto zayo. Abantu bazoqhubeka nokuthola imali yabo nangemuva kokaMashi 20, kodwa uma amakhadi bengakawashintshi, kuyodingeka ukuthi bavakashele ePosini lapho beyothola khona imali yabo,” kusho isitatimende.Siqhube sathi kuzothunyelwa amahhovisi angomahamba nendlwana emakhaya ukusiza abantu."Amakhadi ayigolide akwaSassa, ayoma ukusebenza ngoMashi 20. Kwaphela usuku lonke bengasazisi lutho ngokuthi izinto zihamba kanjani, kwaze kwaba wumhla ka-12 abasitshela ngawo ukuthi ingane isishonile,” kuchaza uyise. "Nokho okusididayo ngalokho wukuthi encwadini efakazela ukufa komntwana akucaci ukuthi wabulawa yini, okwenza singagculiseki ngendlela abasingathe ngayo lesi simo. Konke lokho kwenza sicabange ukuthi kukhona abasifihlela khona ngokufa kwengane yethu.”Uthe bazamile ukusukumela lolu daba, bathola nommeli obekade ethembise ukubasiza kulona. Kodwa naye wabalaxaza ephuzwini lokuthi ngeke esakwazi ukuqhubeka nale nkinga.Uthe ukhathazekile ngokuthi bashonelwe yingane yabo isencane kangaka, isimo athi sesenze kwaba muncu phakathi kwakhe nonina womntwana, akusemnandi ebudlelwaneni babo bobabili. Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Nathi Olifant, ucebise lo mndeni ukuthi uxhumane nesibhedela kuqala; okungaba wumphathi waso noma owophiko lwezokuxhumana ukubheka nokuxoxisana ukuthi lungalungiswa kanjani lolu daba.
'KUFANELE iliwe yizinhlaka zomthetho, iphinde iliwe nayizinhlaka zomphakathi eyo-sugar daddy abasulela intsha esencane nge-HIV.’Lokhu kushiwo umsunguli wenhlangano elwela amalungelo ezingane nabesifazane, uThingo Crisis Centre, uNkk Sbo Ngcobo, kulandela ucwaningo oluveza ukuthi lesi sihlava siyabhebhetheka kunokuthi sibe ngcono.Ucwaningo olusanda kwenziwa nguSolwazi Rubeshan Perumal waseNyuvesi yaKwaZulu-Natal (UKZN), luveza ukuthi liyabhubha ngesibalo samantombazane asakhula asuleleke ngeHIV esikhathini esingangonyaka esedlule.Luveze ukuthi emhlabeni wonke bangu-1.3 million abasuleleke ngegciwane ngo-2023. Luqhube lwathi kulesi sibalo, kukhona abangu-150 000 baseNingizimu Afrika."Siyathusa isibalo esingu-150 000 esikhathini esingangonyaka. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kuleli, kwesuleleka abangu-410 njalo ngosuku,” kusho uPerumal.Uthe izibalo zeKwaZulu-Natal ziyakhathaza njengoba kuvela ukuthi isalokhu iqhubeke njalo nokuzihola phambili ngezibalo zabasulelekayo."IKwaZulu-Natal isalokhu iqhubeke njalo nokuba yinkinga. Esibalweni sabasulelekayo, kukhombisa ukuthi abasuleleka kakhulu abaneminyaka ephakathi kuka-15 no-24.UNkk Ngcobo uthe ngasohlangothini lwezomthetho, kufanele zingabaniki thuba ezobulungiswa o-sugar daddy abasulela intsha ngesifo, zibaphose ejele."Umuntu omdala olala nengane eneminyaka engu-15 yicala lelo. Uma eseyithelela ngegciwane, elinye lelo. Kufanele amaphoyisa angathandabuzi, ababophe ngoba basuke sebecekele impilo yengane kabili,” kusho uNkk Ngcobo.Uqhube wathi ngasohlangothini lomphakathi, kufanele isizwe sisukume, sibambisane ekulweni nesihlava."Leyo mbijana yamadoda angazibandakanyi nalokhu ayingasongi izandla ingenzi lutho, ayisukule ilwe namadoda alutha izingane ezincane bese ezithelela ngesifo,” usho kanje.Ubuye wathi nabazali abayidlale indima efanele ekukhuliseni izingane ngendlela nasekutheni benze kahle phambi kwazo ukuze zikhule zazi ukuthi indoda endala isuke ingezile ngezinhloso ezinhle enganeni uma iyitshela ukuthi iyayithanda."Uma uwumzali ushintsha abantu besilisa phambi kwengane, uthandana no-Ben 10, udweba isithombe sokuthi lokhu osuke ukwenza kuhle, ngakho nengane yakho ivele ikwenze izitshela ukuthi kuyinto engenankinga,” kwexwayisa uNkk Ngcobo.Nokho uthe indaba yokungasebenzi kwentsha nobubha, kunomthelela omkhulu ekutheni intsha esencane iluthwe o-sugar daddy abasuke beyithembisa izulu nomhlaba.UPerumal usanda kuchonywa uphaphe lwegwalagwala emiklomelweni iVice-Chancellor’s Award for Research Excellence e-UKZN ngalolu cwaningo lwakhe olufaka phakathi isifo iTuberculosis (TB) neHIV. Usebenza esibhedlela iNkosi Albert Luthuli Central.

UHLOSE ukuhlanganisa zonke izizwe zase-Afrika ngaphansi kophahla olulodwa ukuze zibumbane, owesifazane ongumhleli, ngomcimbi wemibukiso yezizwe ezehlukene ozoba sesigodlweni saKwaKhangelamankengane, KwaNongoma, ngo-Ephreli, nonyaka.USinqobile Maphisa utshele Isolezwe ukuthi ngalo mcimbi, Ubuhle Be-Africa Festival ozoba yizinsuku ezintathu, kusuka ngo-Ephreli 25 kuya ku-27, uhlose ukuthi kuvaleke igebe lokucwasana kwezizwe ezehlukene."Sinokucwasana. Size sibizane ngamagama ayiziswana. Kuze kwedlulele uma kuza kubantu bakwamanye amazwe. Ngalo mcimbi, ngizama ukuqeda leyo nto yokucwasana. Kufanele sibumbane,” kusho uSinqobile.Uthe kulo mcimbi kuzokwenziwa imibukiso eyehlukene. Kuyona uthe kuzoba khona izazi ezivela ezizweni ezehlukene, ukuzochaza kabanzi ngamasiko azo."Kuzophinde kube nomculo wesizwe ngesizwe, ukuze sifunde ngezinhlobo zomculo wazo ngokwahlukahlukana kwazo,” kusho uSinqobile.Uqhube wathi kuzophinde kudayiswe ukudla isizwe nesizwe esizigqaja ngakho."Kungagcini lapho, kuzophinde kudayiswe ingqephu yesizwe ngesizwe, ukukhombisa ukuthi isizwe esithile sikhuluma ngento enjani uma sikhuluma ngezingubo zaso,” kuchaza uSinqobile, othe bameme ngisho namakhosi ezizwe ezehlukene ukuzoba yingxenye yalo mcimbi.Uthe ngesikhathi eyokwethula lo mbono eNdlunkulu nyakenye, abazange bathandabuze njengoba bezwakalisa ukuthi noNdlunkulu uMantfombi Dlamini-Zulu, wayeyeseka imibono efana nalena, wathi unesifiso sokuthi umcimbi uqhubeke minyaka yonke ezifundazweni ezehlukene, futhi uphumele nakwamanye amazwe ase-Afrika.Uthe amathikithi alo mcimbi ayeyatholakala kubo bonke oSpar nakoTicketPro. Uthe aka-general ibiza u-R120 usuku ngalunye, esangweni abe u-R150, wathi i-package yazo zontathu izinsuku ibiza u-R300, esangweni ibe u-R400. Kuthi i-VIP ibe u-R500 usuku ngalunye, i-VVIP ibe wu-R750 usuku ngalunye.UMntwana uBambindlovu Zulu ukuqinisekisile ukuthi lo mcimbi uzokwenziwa KwaKhangela emva kokuthi iNdlunkulu iwamukele umbono ofike nethimba leNzuzo Edutainment, kwavunyelwanwa.Uthe baphezu kwawo amalungiselelo, amathikithi aseqalile ukudayiswa kanti nabazonandisa sebeqinisekisile. "Ukulethwa kwalo mcimbi KwaKhangela, sabona ukuthi kufanele ngoba iSilo siphuma khona lapha ekhaya. SiwuZulu, akufanele sikhohlwe amakhosi, lokho kufanele kwaziwe yiwonke umuntu,” kusho uMntwana uBambindlovu.Uthe lo msebenzi bawuqondanise nesikhumbuzo seNdlovukazi (uMantfombi Dlamini-Zulu), wathi kubalulekile ukuthi akhunjulwe amakhosi angasekho. Unxuse isizwe ukuthi singazikhohlwa ukuthi sivelaphi.

Olunye uphenyo luholele ithimba e-Alexandra naseTembisa, lapho kwaboshwa khona abasolwa abathathu, okuhlanganisa nomholi wale migulukudu, ngemuva kokutholwa nemali enamabala engaphezu kwezinkulungwane eziyikhulu namashumi ayisithupha (R160 000) namakhemikhali asetshenziswa ukuhlanza imali enamabala. UNksz Nxumalo uthe uMabaso wabuye wayalela uMsomi ukuba angaphinde amsize futhi amphelezele uNksz Nxumalo ngoba uyisIphukuphuku esiyimpumputhe khona ezombamba kahle."Wathi noma ngingenzani ngeke ngisizakale futhi yena akaboshwa," kuphetha uNksz Nxumalo.Ethintwa ukuba aziphendulele kulezi zinsolo, uMabaso uthe uNksz Nxumalo umbophela amanqina enyathi futhi usenga ezimithiyo ngenxa yokuthi bahlukene ngokwezinhlangano.Ube esethumelela Isolezwe isikhangiso se-MK Party lapho yayithi izodingida kabanzi kwi-TikTok ngabantu abahlukunyezwe ngamakhansela. Nodaba lukaNksz Nxumalo lwaluseqhulwini. Ebuzwa uNksz Nxumalo ngezinsolo zokuthi ubheca uMabaso ngobende ngenxa yokuthi uMabaso uyi-ANC ekubeni uNksz Nxumalo eyilungu le-MK ukuchithile lokho. UNksz Nxumalo uthe uMabaso umqambela amanga ngoba yena akacheme naqembu lezombusazwe futhi usizo ayeyolufuna ehhovisi lekhansela kwakuwufuna incwadi qha, okuyinto eyayingahlanganise lutho nepolitiki. Uthe waya kwi-MK eyoyibikela ngokungasizwa wuMabaso ngoba emsola ngokuba yilungu layo.Okhulumela amaphoyisa aKwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, ukuqinisekisile ukuvulelwa kukaMabaso icala futhi wathi amaphoyisa aseBhekithemba amatasatasa nophenyo. UNksz Nxumalo ubuye waveza ukuthi uthathele uMabaso incwadi eyisivimbelo emaphoyiseni kodwa wanqaba ukuyisayina. Akagcinanga lapho ubuye waxhumana nabameli abangaphansi kwenkampani iLegalwize ukuba bafune isinxephezelo kuMabaso. Isolezwe liyibonile iLetter of Demand ebhalelwe uMabaso wumeluleki wezomthetho wakwaLegalwize, uJulia Sekunelo. Esephetha uNksz Nxumalo uthe uzohamba aze abemfishane ngoba ufuna uMabaso ajeze ngokumhlukumeza ekubeni engumuntu wesifazane onokukhabazeka. IKHANSELA laku-ward 84 kuMasipala waseThekwini, uMnuz Msizi E. Mabaso, lisolwa ngokuhlambalaza owesifazane okhubazekile Isithombe:FACEBOOK Kwenzeka lokhu nje, bekusanda kubatshazwa udaba lowesifazane waseMtshezi, okuthiwa washawa yimeya.Umgilwa ophila nokukhubazeka, uNkk Zandile Radebe (40) ongumabhalane ehhovisi le-IFP eMtshezi, kuthiwa washaywa ngemvula yezimpama yiMeya kaMasipala iNkosi Langalibalele, uMnuz Mdududzi "Sobho” Myeza ngoJanuwari 16.Ngosuku lwesigameko kuthiwa umsolwa wasola umgilwa ngokungawenzi kahle umsebenzi wakhe, wathi uma embuza ukuthi yimuphi umsebenzi angawenzi kahle, kwabe usezithele. Kuthiwa wamsolwa ngokumfaka amagama emlonyeni, wase emthela induku, waze wawa nesihlalo ayehleli kuso.Kuthiwa umgilwa walimala, waphinde wathikamezeka nasemwondweni. Kuvela ukuthi uze walaliswa nasesibhedlela isikhashana.Umsolwa namanje ubengakaboshwa yize likhona icala avulelwa lona esiteshini samaphoyisa eMtshezi.Okhulumela i-IFP uMnuz Mkhuleko Hlengwa, ethintwa yiSolezwe phambilini, wathi bazolinda izinhlaka ezifanele zenze uphenyo lwazo ziqede ngaphambi kokuthi kube khona okushiwo yiqembu.
IZWAKALISE ukungagculiseki ngokungaqini kwecala loMbuso, iNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMbumbulu, idedela ngebheyili isishoshovu soMkhonto weSizwe Party (MKP) esisolwa ngelokudlwengula, sikhulelise indodakazi (19).Lona wesilisa waKwaMakhutha, ongagcini ngokuba yisishoshovu se-MKP kuphela, kodwa ophinde abe yilungu le-Community Policing Forum (CPF), udedelwe ngebheyili ka-R1 000.Imantshi, uNkk Moodley, ngaphambi kokumdedela ngebheyili, ithe icala loMbuso kalinaso isisindo.Lona wesilisa kuvele ngaphambilini ukuthi udla imishanguzo ye-HIV, kanti kungahle kwengezwe icala lokuzama ukubulala uma kuvela ukuthi usulele ngegciwane umgilwa."Esisenakho okwamanje ukuthi umgilwa uthi umsolwa umdlwengule waze wakhulelwa. Ngapha umsolwa uphika ulala ngomhlane. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kuseyinkombakombane njengoba nemiphumela yolibofuzo ingakabuyi,” kusho uNkk Moodley.UNkk Moodley uveze ukuthi ebufakazini kuvele ukuthi umsolwa ngaphambi kokuba adlwengule umgilwa, wathi "Ngifuna ukukufundisa ukuthi umfana nentombazane balwenza kanjani ucansi.” Kuthiwa waphinde wathi "ufuna ukuyishintsha ibe yintombazane (eqondile)” njengoba kuthiwa yase iphumele obala ngokuthi yona ithanda amanye amantombazane (lesbian).Uthe umsolwa wabuye watshela umgilwa ukuthi akangakhathazeki, ngeke akhululelwe ngokuthi ulale naye ngoba unguyise.Kuvele ukuthi wamsabisa ngokuthi uma ike yamceba indodakazi, kukhona okubi okuzoyivelela, nebala yangayithi vu."Uze wagonyuluka uma sekubonakala ukuthi ukhulelwe, nakhona lapho wangakhuluma iqiniso eliphephele futhi kwangaba bikho cala elivulwayo,” kubeka uNkk Moodley.Ube esemsola umgilwa, ethi ayikho into ephathekayo eyadala ukuthi kungabi bikho muntu ampotshozela ngesehlakalo njengoba nomsolwa wayengazange acacise ukuthi hlobo luni lwento embi ezomvelela umgilwa uma emceba.Uthe akakholwa ukuthi umgilwa uwumuntu osabayo ukuphumela obala ngezinto ezibucayi njengoba akwazi ukuphumela obala ngaphandle kovalo emndenini wakhe ngokuthi yena uphila impilo yokuthanda amanye amantombazane.Uphinde wasola nonina kamgilwa, ethi kwathi noma esetholile ngezinsolo zokuthi umsolwa udlwengule umgilwa, wangaya emaphoyiseni ukuyobika masinyane."Wamfonela, wambuza ukuthi umdlwenguleleni umgilwa? Umsolwa waphendula ngokuthi kwenzeke edle amanzi amponjwana. Uyaxolisa, ngeke kuphinde,” kusho uNkk Moodley, othe unina kamgilwa waqhubeka wangathatha zinyathelo yize umsolwa esephendule kanje."Ngoba unina kamgilwa ukwazile ukumqonda ngqo umsolwa ambuze ngesigameko, lokho kudweba esinye isithombe sokuthi akasiye umuntu abamsabayo. Okuchaza ukuthi umgilwa wayengabika ngesigameko siqeda kwenzeka, angalindi izinyanga ezintathu ngaphambi kokuba asho,” kusho imantshi.Yengeze ngokuthi okusho ukuthi ukuba wayengazange akhulelwe umgilwa, wayezogcina engabikanga ngokudlwengulwa kwakhe.Kuvele ukuthi umgilwa wacela ukuthi sikhishwe isisu ngokusemthethweni, kwathathwa umbungu wayiswa eLaboratory ePitoli, ukuze kwenziwe ulibofuzo.Phakathi kwemibandela abekelwe yona umsolwa, kuthiwe akumele alubhade lapho kuhlala ngakhona ummangali, kufanele ayosayina njalo ngoLwehlanu esiteshini samaphoyisa saseFolweni, bese engaxhumani nomgilwa nonina. Imantshi ithe uma ephula le mibandela, uzokhalelwa amasongo kaSigonyela.Umshushisi woMbuso, uMnuz Ngxongo, uthe uMbuso usadinga isikhathi ukuze uqhubeke nophenyo, imantshi yase ilihlehlisela uMashi 12, icala.
USIHLALO we-KZN Men’s Sector obuye abe yiphini lomqondisi eMangosuthu University of Technology (MUT), obhekelele inhlalonhle nokuthuthukiswa komphakathi, uDkt Mfanozelwe Shozi, uthi impilo esheshayo nokuthanda ubucwebe ngezinye zezinto ezenza abantu abasha bangene ebugebengwini.Usho kanje uShozi osebenza nafabana abasebancane ngenhloso yokubasiza ekutheni bakhule babe ngamadoda emizi kusasa. Uphawule kanje ngemva kwezigigaba ezisematheni okuthiwa zenziwa yiqembu lezigelekeqe eliphethwe ngabafana abancane elaziwa nge-West Gang, elizinze eNanda, nakwamanye amalokishi akhelene nayo.Ekhuluma neSolezwe, uthe ukuthanda kwentsha impilo ewubukhazikhazi kunomthelela omkhulu ekutheni ingene igamanxe ebugebengwini."Impilo ewubukhazikhazi idobela intsha ebugebengwini. Izingubo zikanokusho, ukufisa ukuhamba ngezimoto ezibizayo kwenza abantu abasha bafune impilo enqamulelayo. Okunye okunomthelela kakhulu yindlela umuntu akhuliswa ngayo. Abanye bakhulela ezindaweni ezibahlukumezayo, nokungabi bikho kobaba abaqotho abazokhulisa abantwana ngendlela eqondile,” kusho uShozi.Uthe esinye isihlava ngesokuthi labo abasuke bephikisana nezenzo zobugebengu emiphakathini bayabulawa."Ukubulawa kwabaholi abaphikisana nobugebengu nodlame kwenza lezi zindawo zisale zingenabaholi, okugcina sekuba yikwampunz’ edla emini, engabi bikho umuntu okwazi ukukhuza nokukhulisa abafana.”"Kuyenzeka ukuthi ingane iphile impilo abazali abangayazi ekhaya ibe yinhle kanti ngaphandle iyisilwane. Kukhona nalapho uthola ukuthi abazali bayazi ukuthi izingane zabo zenza ubugebengu kodwa bazithulele nje noma bazivikele. "Noma bengangabona ukuthi yenzani ingane ngaphandle kodwa bayabubona ubukhazikhazi nendlela (ingane) esuke isiphila ngayo nohlobo lwabangani esuke isihamba nabo,” usho kanje.Uthe nobubha bukhathula indima - okwenza intsha igcine isingene ebugebengwini ngoba ifuna ukulwa nendlala. Uthe kuyiqiniso elingephikiswe ukuthi ukududana kontanga nakho kunomthelela wokuthi intsha ingene ebugebengwini futhi unxusa amasonto, amaqoqo obulungiswa ezobugebengu ukuthi alwe nale nkinga ebhekene nezwe.Khonamanjalo: Okhulumela uMnyango wezokuHlunyeleliswa kweziMilo, uMnuz Singabakho Nxumalo, uthe amajele aseNingizimu Afrika, agcwele ngokweqile njengoba zingu-165 392 iziboshwa ezisezikhindini."Okusihlalisa kabuhlungu ukubona abantu abasha begcwele emajele. Izingane ezingaphansi kweminyaka engu-18 zingu-98, injejane yabaneminyaka esuka ku-18 kuya ku-20 - abesilisa bangu-5 576, abesifazane bangu-147. "Uma ubheka intsha yona ingaphezu kuka-36 000. La macala bawaqala kancane, kungaba ukuthi bagqekezile noma bebile. Uma sebebuya okwesibili ejele, sebebuya ngecala lokubulala, ukudlwengula namanye amacala abucayi kakhulu okwenza kube nzima ukuthi bangene ezinhlelweni ezingakwazi ukubasiza,” kusho uNxumalo.Uthe ukuhlangana kwabantu abasha babe namaqembu emigulukudu yiyo eyinkinga kakhulu ngoba itholakala emphakathini, iphinde izoziveza ngaphakathi ejele. Uthe uma umuntu esefika ejele vele eseneqembu lemigulukudu, kuphazamisa indlela yokusebenza ngaphakathi ngoba uzothi kukhona la esethatha khona imiyalelo, akasayithathi ezikhulwini zasejele nakulabo abazomsiza ukuhlumelelisa isimilo.UNxumalo ugcizelele ukuthi akukho lula ukuphuma ebugebengwini. Uthe uma unenhlanhla, uya ejele njengoba iningi ligcina ngokuphelela egodini.SINGABAKHO Nxumalo
SAGEJA umgodi Isilo samaBandla ngasohlangothini lwezomthetho, ngokukhomba indlela amalungu ebhodi leNgonyama Trust, njengoba singenawo amandla okuqoka nokuxosha la malungu.IMbube engusihlalo webhodi leNgonyama Trust, ingabizwa ngaphambi kwekomiti lezoMhlaba ePhalamende ukuzophendula ngomsebenzi waleli bhodi.Lokhu kuvezwe ngumbono wezomthetho ohlwaywe yikomiti lezoMhlaba ePhalamende, ngemuva kwesinyathelo seMbube sokukhomba indlela amanye amalungu ebhodi, ngoba singeneme ngendlela elisebenza ngayo leli bhodi.Lo mbono owethulwe ekomitini izolo, kuvele ukuthi amandla okuqoka nokuxosha amalungu ebhodi, alele kuNgqongqoshe wezoMhlaba, uMnuz Mzwanele Nyhontso.Oweluleka iPhalamende kwezomthetho, uMnuz Bulelani Simani, uthe iMbube yazinika amandla engenawo okuxosha amalungu ebhodi."Ikomiti lasePhalamende linamandla okubiza iMbube izochaza ngokusebenza kwebhodi njengoba ingusihlalo walo. Uma obizwayo egoloza, umthetho uyalivuna ikomiti ukuthi limnike amasamanisi azomphoqa ukuthi ezophendula. Lokhu kwenziwa ngoba iNgonyama Trust, ithola imali ngakho kumele iphendule ngokusebenza kwaleyo mali,” kusho uSimani.Uveze ukuthi amalungu amanye ebhodi aqokwa ngungqongqoshe emuva kokuxhumana neMbube, undunankulu wesifundazwe kanjalo nobuholi bomdabu."Noma esesuswa la malungu ebhodi amandla akungqongqoshe, okumele axhumane neMbube, undunankulu kanjalo nobuholi bomdabu. ISilo esabuza uMdlokombane, wayengusihlalo webhodi leNgonyama, kodwa wayeqoka umuntu ozongena kulesi sikhundla ukuze kube nguyena ozophendula ngokusebenza kwalo,” kuqhuba uSimani.Amalungu ekomiti athe amalungu ebhodi aseyingxenye njengoba axoshwa ngokungemthetho.Leli komiti liza KwaZulu-Natal isonto lonke ukuzozitholela okwenzekayo kuleli bhodi. Lihlele ukuhlangana neMbube ngoFebhuwari 24, bese lihlangana nebhodi leNgonyama.Lizohlangana nezinye izinhlaka okubalwa nabalimi.UMnuz Bonginkosi Madikizela we-DA, ilungu lekomiti, uthe asikho isidingo sokuthi bahlangane namalungu ebhodi leNgonyama Trust, ngoba bangabuye bahlangane nawo ngesinye isikhathi.Usihlalo wekomiti, uMnuz Mangaqa Mncwango, ubelokhu ekuphindile ukuthi akusona isinqumo sabo esivezwe abezomthetho ePhalamende kodwa bebefune umbono ngenxa yezinselelo kwiNgonyama Trust.UMncwango uthe sikhona isidingo sokuthi bahlangane neNgonyama Trust ukuze bathole isithombe esiphelele ngokwenzekayo."Ngokohlelo lwethu lwesikhashana oselugunyazwe yiPhalamende, sizobhalela iMbube sicele ukuhlangana nayo. Ngemuva kokuhlangana neSilo sizobe sesihlangana nebhodi leNgonyama Trust,” kusho uMncwango.Uthe babona kubalulekile ukuthi bahlangane noMphathiswa wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu ngoba amakhosi angaphansi kwakhe."Sizohlangana nomphathiswa ngaphambi kokuba sihlangane neSilo. Sizozwa ukuthi zithini ezakamuva kwezithinta ibhodi leNgonyama,” kusho uMncwango.
IMEYA kaMasipala waseMngeni, uMnuz Chris Pappas, ihoxe embangweni wezikhundla kwi-DA.UPappas umemezele ukuthi ngeke awungenele umjaho wezikhundla engqungqutheleni elandelayo yokukhetha ubuholi be-DA KwaZulu-Natal nakweyokukhetha ubuholi bukazwelonke.I-DA izokuba nezingqungquthela zokukhetha ubuholi kuzwelonke nasezifundazweni ngonyaka ozayo.UPappas ungomunye wabaholi abanogazi kwi-DA, kukhona abebefuna ukuthi angenele umbango wezikhundla esifundazweni abanye bebefuna ukuthi angenele umbango wezikhundla kuzwelonke.Embhalweni awufake enkundleni yezokuxhumana, i-Facebook, uPappas uveze ukuthi kukhona abafuna ukuthi angenele umbango wezikhundla ezingqungqutheleni ezizayo, wabe esethi akazijahile izikhundla."Izingqungquthela zokukhetha ubuholi be-DA KwaZulu-Natal nasesifundazweni zisekude. Ngithi angikucacise nje lokhu kusenesikhathi ukuthi ngeke ngiwungenele umjaho wezikhundla esifundazweni nakuzwelonke.”UPappas ubekade eyiphini lomholi we-DA KwaZulu-Natal ngaphambi kwengqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi besifundazwe eyayingo-2023.Akazange awungenele umbango wezikhundla kule ngqungquthela njengoba ayesanda kuqokelwa kwesobumeya, wathi ufuna ukugxila esikhundleni esasisisha ngaleso sikhathi.UPappas uthe namanje usazimisele ngokubeka phambili ukuthuthukisa abantu kunokujaha izikhundla."Angingenanga kwipolitiki ngoba nakhu ngithanda izikhundla. Into engiyithandayo mina ukuthuthukisa umphakathi, ukushintsha isimo sempilo, ukumela nokusebenzela abantu, ukushintsha imithetho eyizihibe kanye nokwenza umehluko emiphakathini.”UPappas ubonge ukwethenjwa yilabo abebefuna ukuthi aphathe isikhundla eqenjini."Zingijabulisile izingxoxo kanye nokugqugquzeleka engikuthole ebantwini abaningi. Kodwa iqiniso ukuthi ngisagxile ekuletheni ushintsho ezimpilweni zabantu. Angikayicabangi eyokujaha izikhundla kwipolitiki.”Abantu abaningi abaphawule embhalweni kaPappas bazwakalise ukuphoxeka ngesimemezelo sakhe.Abaningi bathe bebenethemba lokuthi uzophatha isikhundla esibalulekile kwi-DA, bathi bakholelwa ukuthi angakwazi ukulikhulisa iqembu.Kusukela uPappas aphatha uMasipala waseMngeni, lo mkhandlu uthola imibiko engenagcobho kumcwaningi-mabhuku.I-DA KwaZulu-Natal yayigadla ngoPappas embangweni wesikhundla sikandunankulu wakulesi sifundazwe ngesikhathi kubhekwe okhethweni lwangonyaka owedlule.Njengamanje i-DA iyingxenye kahulumeni wokubambisana ophethe isifundazwe, inabaphathiswa ababili kwikhabhinethi lesifundazwe, iphinde iphathe nesikhundla sephini likasomlomo wesiShayamthetho sesifundazwe.Nokho uPappas wanquma ukuqhubeka nesikhundla sobuMeya kuMasipala waseMngeni emva kokuthi i-DA ihlulekile ukunqoba ukhetho esifundazweni.
SELIDLULELA esigabeni esandulela ukuqulwa kwalo icala elibhekene nomsakazi woKhozi FM, uSiyabonga Mhlongo (40).Lokhu kuhlaluke ngoLwesithathu evela kafishane eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini.Lo msakazi ongaphandle ngesexwayiso ubhekene necala lokushaya alimaze kabi umlisa (29) owayeyisinqandamathe sakhe.Ngaphambilini inkantolo yaguqa ngenxa yokuthi kwakusaqoqwa ubufakazi bezitatimende ezeseka ubufakazi bommangali nommangalelwa.Omele uMbuso kuleli cala, uMshushisi uHosen Shenaaz, utshele imantshi uMnuz Mhlonipheni Sibiya ukuthi leli cala ubona kukuhle ukuba lihlehle ngoba basadingida udaba lokuthi lidlulele esigabeni esandulela ukuqulwa kwalo.Icala libe selihlehliselwa uMashi 5. "Uzobuya lapha enkantolo ngenyanga ezayo sekuzohlelwa isigaba sokulungiselelwa kokuqulwa kwecala,'' imantshi ikhuluma ibhekise kuSiya.Igama lakhe liqale labizwa enkantolo engasabeli kwaze kwaba amahlandla amabili. Kuze kwadingeka ukuthi kudlulelwe phambili kubizwe abanye abebezovela enkantolo.Inkantolo iphinde yalibiza igama lakhe ngaleso sikhathi ubesevele esengaphakathi.Ungene enkantolo ephelezelwa ngabesilisa ababili okubonakale sengathi bebezomeseka. Ubeziphihle ngezibuko ezimnyama. Ebhokisini ubedane ezilungisa efaka ihembe ngaphakathi abuye abheke phezulu. Ngaleso sikhathi ubesezikhumulile izibuko ephethe iselula ngesandla.Kuke kwavela izindaba zokuthi lo msakazi uke wanikela emahhovisi akwa-SABC ngenhloso yokucela ukubuyiselwa emoyeni kodwa abaphathi boKhozi bashaya phansi ngonyawo bathi udaba lwakhe luyoze lumunyungwe kahle uma sekuphele icala abhekene nalo.USiya ume esakaza uhlelo Ubusuku Obuhle olungena ngo-8 ebusuku phakathi nezinsuku.Ngaphambilini loyo okhulumela i-SABC, uMmoni Seapolela, waveza ukuthi uSiya uyena owazicelela ukuhoxa ekusakazeni lolu hlelo. Uhlelo lwakhe seluphenduke ubhandemtshelekwane njengoba lushayelwa abasakazi ebehlukene.Lo msakazi ungowokuqala ukuba asakazele uKhozi neMetro FM kanye kanye. Uqale ukuzakhela udumo esakaza kwiGagasi FM eminyakeni eyedlule.Kuleli cala uSiya umelwe nguSkhumbuzo Mathabela ophinde abe ngomunye wabefundisi abaziwayo KwaZulu-Natal.
IQEMBU le-Democratic Alliance KwaZulu-Natal seliveze ukuthi selibhalele iHhovisi loMkhandludolobha waseThekwini, mayelana nenkinga yamanzi ehlasele ezindaweni ezehlukene.I-DA isho kanje ngoLwesithathu, ibize isithangami nabezindaba ukuzobhunga ngezinkinga ezihlasele iTheku. Obekuseqhulwini kulesi sithangami indaba yamanzi, ugesi nengqalasizinda kanye nohlelo lokukhokhela izidingo zomphakathi (billing system).Umholi weKhokhasi yeTheku we-DA, uMnuz Thabani Mthethwa ekhuluma neSolezwe, uthe bakhathazekile ngenhlekelele yezamanzi eThekwini."Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi yonke imiphakathi yakithi inezinkinga zokuphakelwa kwamanzi eThekwini, kusukela enyakatho kuya entshonalanga kunenkinga efanayo. Sesibhalele umkhandludolobha ukuba uphinde ubeke phambili imali ukuze eningi iye kwingqalasizinda yokuphakelwa kwamanzi ngoba inkinga enkulu ukunganakekelwa kwengqalasizinda okugcina sekuqhuma amapayipi amanzi engafiki emphakathini,” kusho uMthethwa.Uthe uhlelo lokukhokhela izinsiza zikamasipala nalo luyiva emiphakathini ngoba abantu bazithola sebekhokha imali eningi kungafanele."Imiphakathi emini ikhala ngokuthi ikhokha imali eningi ikhokhela amanzi nogesi. Sesibhalile ukuthi akube nethimba elikhethekile elizobhekana nalezo zikhalazo. Siyathemba ukuthi wonke amakhansela aseThekwini kuwona wonke amaqembu ezepolitiki azoseseka ukuze kuhlangabezwane nesixazululo salezi zinkinga.”"Njengoba kule nyanga kuzoba nokubuyekezwa kwesabelomali, sifuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi sisebenzisa lelo thuba ukuthi imali eningi iyiswe kwingqalasizinda kagesi, amanzi nokuqinisekisa ukuthi ingqalasizinda yethu iyakwazi nokumelana nomthamo wabantu,” usho kanje.Uthe zonke lezi zinkinga zenzeka ebusweni bemenenja kamasipala weTheku, uMnuz Musa Mbhele nosihlalo wekomiti lezokuHanjiswa kwaManzi, iMfucuza noGesi, uMnuz Mdu Nkosi."Asiboni ukuthi kusamlungele ukuthi aqhubeke aphathe lo mkhandlu. Simemezela ukuthi ashenxe esikhundleni noma asule ngoba kuyacaca ukuthi akakulungele ukuhola umkhandlu. Akusiye yena yedwa esithi akahambe, sifuna nekhansela le-IFP, uMdu Nkosi, naye ongakulungele ukuba ngusihlalo waleli komiti ngoba akenzi lutho. Akashenxe, kufakwe abantu abazosebenza,” usho kanje.Khonamanjalo: Imenenja uMbhele ngesikhathi inengxoxo nabahleli bamaphephandaba angaphansi kwe-Independent Newspapers izolo, iyichithile eyokuhlulwa wumsebenzi nokuthi izinto zimapeketwane eThekwini"Kuningi okuhle okwenziwa umasipala, okubalwa ukuhlanzwa kwedolobha, ukudalwa kwamathuba emisebenzi, ukulungiswa kwemigwaqo kanye nokulungiswa kwamapayipi athutha indle. Abasenazo izinto abazokhalaza ngazo yingakho sebebona kungcono ukuthi balwe nami,” usho kanje.
NAMHLANJE kugujwa i-International Condoms Day, usuku lapho emazweni ehlukene emhlabeni kwenziwa imikhankaso yokuqwashisa abantu ngobungozi bocansi olungaphephile, kukhuthazwe ukuzivikela uma beya ocansini ukuze bagweme izifo ezeyamene nocansi kanjalo nokukhulelwa okungahlelelwe.Lokho kuza nje kukhona abamagange ngeValentines Day, usuku olwaziwa ngokuthi ngolwezithandani, lapho abantu abasebudlelwaneni bothando behlela izindlela ezahlukene zokuzijabulisa, okuvame ukuphelela ezithokoziseni ngocansi.Ucwaningo lwabezempilo lwaveza ukuthi esinye sezizathu ezenza kwenziwe lo mkhankaso waminyaka yonke wukuthi babalelwa ku-1 million abantu abatheleleka ngezifo ezeyamene nezocansi, phecelezi ama-sexually transmitted infections (STIs), bese ziba ko-80 million izigameko zokukhulelwa okungahleliwe emhlabeni.Ukusiza nokucebisa abantu abazozibandakanya ocansini ngale mpelasonto, isikhungo sezempilo esizimele, i-Affinity Health, sesikhiphe amathiphu angasiza ukugwema izinkinga ezinje.1. Bekani eqhulwini ukuxoxa nomuntu wakho– Ukuxoxa ngokukhululeka nomuntu othandana naye kuyisisekelo sobudlelwano obunempilo. Xoxa nesinqandamathe sakho ngezinhlelo zenu zangalobo busuku benjabulo bese nivumelana ngokuthi izinto nizozenza kanjani.2. Qoka ukudla okunempilo nokunamandla ngalelo langa– Ngabe nihlela ukwenza isidlo sakusihlwa esingqangqayo? Uma kunjalo, kungasiza ukuqoka ukudla okungenamicikilisho etheni kodwa kube nempilo njengofishi ophekwe ngendlela enempilo nesaladi ukuze nibe nomfutho namandla uma senizijabulisa.3. Phuza amanzi ngokwanele– Kuleyo njabulo yakho nesithandwa sakho ungalibali ukuphuza amanzi ukuze ungaphelelwa ngamandla - ufane nesibani esicisha sisadingeka.4. Iya ocansini ngendlela ephephile– Lesi yisikhathi esihle nesifanele ukuthi uye ocansini ngendlela ephephile ukugwema ukuthi injabulo yakho nomuntu othandana noma olale naye iphethe ngobuhlungu noma ingxabano. Sebenzisani amajazi omkhwenyana agunyazwe ngabezempilo ukuze niphephe kukho konke enikwenzayo.5. Akube nenhlanzeko kukho konke enikwenzayo– Ukuqikelela inhlanzeko ngaphambi kwakho konke ozokwenza nesithandwa sakho kungenza sibone ukuthi ubuhlelele ubusuku benu benjabulo ngakho qikelela ukuzigcina uhlanzekile, ugeze futhi unuke kamnandi, ugqoke nezimpahla ezihlanzekile.6. Gwema ukuphuza utshwala ngokweqile– Kulesi sikhathi azivamile ukusala ngaphandle iziphuzo ezinamandla kodwa ukuphuza ngokweqile kuyingozi ngokuthi kungaholela ekutheni wenze noma usho izinto ongazisola ngazo ngakusasa. Yehlisa kwezikaFaro, ujabulele ubusuku bosuku lwezithandani nomuntu wakho niphila saka.7. Yenza kube nomuzwa wemfudumalo endlini– Imfudumalo endlini ingenza kube mnandi ngokwedlule kuwena nesithandwa sakho ngakho yenza izindlela zokuthi kube njalo ngokuthi uthole amalambu akhanyisa ngokungagqamile, amakhandlela bese udlala umculo omnandi ogijima negazi.8. Phatha amajazi omkhwenyana lapho ukhona– Uma kuwukuthi indlela ozojabulela usuku lwezithandani ngayo ibandakanya nokuzijabulisa ngokocansi, qikelela ukuthi uhlale unamakhondomu kuyo yonke indawo ozobe uhamba khona bese futhi uphatha i-tissue paper noma ama-wipe nezibulalimagciwane ukuqikelela inhlanzeko kukho konke enikwenza ngaleso sikhathi.9. Ungaphoqi futhi ungenzi izinto ngendluzula– Ukuvumelana nganoma yini eyenziwayo ngaleso sikhathi kumele kube seqhulwini lenjabulo yakho nesithandwa sakho. Qikelela ukuthi ngaphambi kwakho konke enikwenzayo, niqala ngokuvumelana ukuze kungabi bikho muntu ohlukumezekayo.10. Akungabi wucansi kuphela, kuningi eningakwenza– Usuku lwezithandani akumele luphelele ekwenzeni ucansi kepha kunganisiza nokuthi nilusebenzise ukuxoxa ngezinto ezijulile eningajwayele ukuxoxa ngazo futhi nihlele okuningi enifuna ukukwenza nokukufeza ndawonye ngomuso.
IMENENJA kaMasipala waseThekwini, uMnuz Musa Mbhele, ithi ayikazukuphela manje inkinga yamanzi ekhungethe izingxenye eziningi zedolobha.UMbhele uthe inkanankana yamanzi ehlasele idolobha idinga isikhathi ukuba ixazululwe, waveza ukuthi umkhandlu unawo amaqhinga okuyiqeda.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi enengxoxo nabahleli bamaphephandaba angaphansi kwe-Independent Media."Lena akusiyona inkinga ezolungiseka ezinsukwini ezimbili ezizayo, emasontweni amabili ezayo noma eminyakeni emibili ezayo.”UMbhele uthe inkinga yamanzi ayihlasele nje iTheku, kuphela kodwa wathi ihlasele wonke amadolobha akhiwa ngesikhathi kusaphethe uhulumeni wobandlululo anenselelo efanayo.Uqhube wathi ingqalasizinda eyakhiwa uhulumeni wobandlululo yayakhelwe abantu abancane."Ingqalasizinda yayakhelwe u-30% wabantu abahlala edolobheni. Kumanje baningi abantu abahlala edolobheni ngenxa yokusondezela amathuba emisebenzi. Le nto uyibona ngokwanda kwemijondolo ukuthi sinyukile ngempela isibalo sabantu abahlala eThekwini."Eminyakeni engu-18 eyedlule bekunezindawo eziyimijondolo ezingu-120 lapha eThekwini, namhlanje sinezindawo ezingu-700 eziyimijondolo. Ngeke uyithole indawo okungakhiwe kuyo lapha eThekwini. Ngisho nasemizini yomxhaso, kwakhiwe izindlu ngemuva.”UMbhele uthe inkinga enkulu ababhekene nayo ngeyabantu abazixhumela amanzi ngokungekho emthethweni."Ngenxa yesimo somnotho esingesihle, abantu abaningi sebeyakubalekela ukukhokhela amanzi. Imizi eminigi ayiwakhokheli amanzi. Abantu bancamela ukuthenga ukudla, bakhokhele izingane ezikoleni, nokunye bashiye ukukhokhela amanzi. "Abantu bokufika yibona abaxhumela abantu amanzi ngokungemthetho, sonke siyazi ukuthi bahle kakhulu ezintweni ezithinta amanzi. Kuphinde kube khona nabantu abakhe ezindaweni ezinjengoMbumbulu, nako-Adams Mission, abanquma ukwakha izitezi bese bezixhumela amanzi.”UMbhele uthe uhlelo lokuncishiswa kwamanzi oluqalwe ngonyaka odlule nalo lwandise izinkinga. Uthe ukuncishiswa kwamanzi kulimaze ingqalasizinda yamanzi."Lokhu kudale ukuthi amapayipi amaningi aqhume. Maningi amanzi asilahlekele ngenxa yalokhu.”Udalule ukuthi banawo amaqhinga okuqeda inkinga yamanzi. Uthe banamaqhinga esikhathi esifishane okulwa nenkinga yamanzi wathi aseqalile ukuthela izithelo ezinhle.UMbhele uthe baphinde babe nesu lesikhathi eside lokuqeda inkinga yamanzi wathi lelo su ukwakhiwa kwedamu elikhulu, eMkhomazi.
KUXWAYISWA abafuna umsebenzi eMnyangweni weMfundo KwaZulu-Natal ukuthi babe mehlo mane njengoba kubanjwe umkhonyovu wozama ukuqola abafuna umsebenzi wokuba ngothisha, ebaqola imali.Lesi sexwayiso sikhishwe nguMphathiswa wezeMfundo, uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka, emuva kokuba kuvele ukuthi kukhona osebenzisa izithombe azishutha nezikhulu zomnyango, ukuzama ukuqola abafuna umsebenzi.UHlomuka uthe kumele aboshwe owenza lokhu. "Sifuna ukukubeka kucace ukuthi akekho umuntu ojutshwe ukuthi aqole abantu ebathembisa umsebenzi. Siyamgxeka owenza lokhu esebenzisa nezithombe azithatha nezikhulu zomnyango,” kusho uHlomuka.Uthe ozama ukuqola abantu ufuna ukutshengisa ukuthi angabatholela izikhala ngoba usondelene nezikhulu."Uke wasebenzisa isithombe asishutha ngisho nami uqobo, ukuze abantu bakholwe ukuthi uzokwazi ukubatholela umsebenzi emnyangweni. Ngifuna ukukuqinisekisa ukuthi asikho isikhulu somnyango esiyingxenye yalo mkhonyovu,” kusho yena.Unxuse labo asebeqoliwe ukuthi babike amacala kwabezomthetho."Ababike emaphoyiseni ngokushesha labo asebeqoliwe noma asebeke bazama ukuqolwa. Siyazigxeka izehlakalo zenkohlakalo ezenziwa ngabantu abazenza into abangeyona,” usho kanje uHlomuka.Uthe bazosebenzisana nabezomthetho ukuze akhalelwe ngamasogo owenza okubi."Sifuna kwenziwe ubulungiswa, yingakho sizosebenzisana nabezomthetho kulolu daba. Yingakho sithanda ukuxwayisa abantu ukuthi baqaphele,” kubeka yena. Uthe izinhlelo zokuqasha emnyangweni zivulelekile."Kunezindlela ezicacile zokuqasha ezikhangiswa ezinkundleni ezehlukene zomnyango. Zikhangiswa ngisho kwi-website yomnyango kubalwa nokukhangisa kwabezindaba.”Unxuse abafuna umsebenzi ukuthi baqinisekise ngokuthi baxhumane nomnyango uma kukhona into abangayiboni kahle ethinta imisebenzi ukuze bengaqolwa.
UBUHOLI obusha be-ANC Youth League (ANCYL) KwaZulu-Natal buthi buyaseseka isinqumo sokuhlela kabusha ubuholi be-ANC esifundazwe.Ubuholi be-ANC KwaZulu-Natal bulengelwa yizembe njengoba i-ANC kuzwelonke ithathe isinqumo sokuthi kufanele buhlelwe kabusha.Lesi sinqumo sithathwe emhlanganweni wesigungu esiphezulu kwi-ANC muva nje.USihlalo omusha we-ANCYL KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Ntokozo Ngcobo, uthe bayaseseka isinqumo sesigungu esiphezulu.Ukusho lokhu emva kokuqokwa kwakhe engqungqutheleni ebiseThekwini.Ubuholi be-ANC KwaZulu-Natal naseGauteng buzonyakaziswa ngenxa yokuthi inhlangano yashaya udaka kuzona zombili lezi zifundazwe ngesikhathi kunokhetho lwangonyaka owedlule.Muva nje, bekunomhlangano wekomiti elibhekelele ukusebenza kwansuku zonke kwi-ANC, lapho kwenziwe izethulo zokuthi buzohlelwa kanjani kabusha ubuholi be-ANC KwaZulu-Natal.Isinqumo sokugcina ngokuhlelwa kabusha kobuholi baKwaZulu-Natal sizothathwa emhlanganweni wesigungu esiphezulu okungakaqinisekiswa ukuthi uzokuba nini.Abanye abaholi abakhethiwe engqungqutheleni ye-ANCYL, uNksz Lulama Mabude kwesikaNobhala, Nksz Phindile Mdanda kwesePhini likaSihlalo, Mnuz Siyabonga Mzenda kwesePhini likaNobhala noMnuz Siphelele Masulu kwesikaMgcinimafa.Ingqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi ibibanjelwe eThekwini ngempelasonto, iqale sekwedlule isikhathi ngenxa yobuhixihixi ekubhalisweni kwezithunywa.Ingqungquthela kwakukade kuhlelwe ukuthi izoqala ngoLwesihlanu kodwa yaze yaqala ngeSonto ebusuku.Bese kunesikhathi eside i-ANCYL KwaZulu-Natal ingenabo ubuholi obukhethwe engqungqutheleni kulandela ukuhlakazwa kobabukhethwe engqungqutheleni yango-2017.UNobhala we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Bheki Mtolo, uncome izithunywa ngokuziphatha kahle.UMtolo unxuse ubuholi obusha be-ANCYL ukuba bubeke phambili izinkinga zabantu abasha."Abantu abasha babhekene nezinkinga okubalwa kuzo ukungasebenzi, ukungawatholi amathuba omnotho kanye nawezemfundo. Izinkinga ezibhekene nabantu abasha zidinga ubuchule. "Ubuholi be-ANCYL kufanele buqhube imikhankaso, buphinde buqhamuke namaqhinga okunqoba lezi ngqinanga ezibhekene nentsha. Sifuna ukuthi ubuholi obusha busebenze ngokuzikhandla.”UMtolo uphinde wanxusa ubuholi obusha ukuba bungabi amavaka."Silindele ubuholi obungasabi lutho obuzolwela ukuba kube noshintsho kwezomnotho, kuphinde kuthuthukiswe abantu abasha. Siyazibophezela ekwesekeni ubuholi obusha.”
NAKUBA indodakazi kaMnuz Jacob Zuma umholi we-MK, uNkk Duduzile Zuma-Sambudla, ixolisile ngokuthuka uNobhala Jikelele weqembu, uMnuz Floyd Shivambu, isixoliso sikhombisa ukuthi ayikapheli impi "yomafikizolo”, nalabo ababekhona mhlazane kusungulwa iqembu - "ingqalabutho”.UNkk Zuma-Sambudla ukubeke kwacaca ukuthi nakuba ekuxolisela ukwethuka uShivambu, kuningi angajabule ngakho okuthinta iqembu nendlela uShivambu enza ngayo izinto.UNkk Zuma-Sambudla uxolise kuShivambu ngemva kokunqunyelwa ugwayi katiki ngumholi weqembu uZuma, omyalele ukuba axolise ngokushesha.UZuma ubesabise ngokuthi uNkk Zuma-Sambudla uzomiswa eqenjini, nakuzo zonke izikhundla aziphethe uma engaxolisi.UNkk Zuma-Sambudla uzidonsele amanzi ngomsele ngesikhathi echapha uShivambu ngenhlamba ezinkundleni zokuxhumana.Emibhalweni ehlukene ayifake enkundleni yezokuxhumana i-X, uNkk Zuma-Sambudla ubize uShivambu ngomafakizolo.UNkk Zuma-Sambudla uthe ukujoyina kukaShivambu i-MK kwaba yinto embi ukunazo zonke esike yenzeka kuleli qembu, wamsola ngokungawazi umsebenzi, wababiza ngezicashalala labo ababezama ukuvikela uShivambu ezinkundleni zokuxhumana.Esixolisweni, uNkk Zuma-Sambudla uthe uyazisola ngokuchapha uShivambu ngenhlamba nokukhuluma izindaba zeqembu esidlangalaleni."Nakuba kunezinto eziningi engingejubale ngazo ngokuphathwa kweqembu, ikakhulu ezithinta yena uShivambu, ngiyakwemukela ukuthi bekufanele engabe ngizidlulisele ezinhlakeni zeqembu izikhalazo zami njengoba kusho imigomo yeqembu.”UNkk Zuma-Sambudla uthe ubengaqondile ukuthunaza isithunzi seqembu ngokwethuka inhlamba, wathi uzimisele ukubhekana nanoma yiluphi uhlelo lwangaphakathi lokuqondiswa ubugwegwe.UNkk Zuma-Sambudla uthuka uShivambu nje, ivele inkulu impi phakathi kwamalungu eMK afika ngesikhathi kusungulwa inhlangano ngoDisemba 16, 2023, nalawo afike kamuva.Amalungu afika kuqala, ama-"D23", akhala ngokuthi izikhundla zinikezwa abantu abafike kamuva. Iningi labantu abafika kuqala kwi-MK kalisekho ezikhundleni, kanti sekuphethe labo abafike kamuva.Phakathi kwabaholi abasanda kufika abagixabezwe ngezikhundla kubalwa uShivambu, iphini lomholi weqembu, uDkt John Hlophe, uSotwsebhu omkhulu weqembu ePhalamende, uMnuz Mzwanele Manyi, umdidiyeli weqembu KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Willies Mchunu, nomdidiyeli weqembu eMpumalanga, u-Advocate Busisiwe Mkhwebane.Bonke laba baholi bajoyine iqembu emva kokhetho lwangoMeyi.Kunenqwaba yabaholi ababephambili ngesikhathi kukhankaselwa ukhetho kepha engasekho ezikhundleni.Impi yabafika kuqala nabasanda kufika ibilokhu ilwa ngobumnyama kwi-MK kodwa manje kubukeka isilwa bukhoma.UMNUZ Floyd Shivambu Isithombe:TIMOTHY BERNARD/ Independent Newspapers
UKHALE ezimathonsi ngamazambane abolile embuthweni wamaphoyisa esiteshini saseNanda, umphakathi obuhambele imbizo yokubhunga ngobugebengu ehholo lomphakathi eMaoti, eNanda.Le mbizo, ebibizwe uNdunankulu wesifundazwe, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, ephelezelwa uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa esifundazweni uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, ibihlanganisa izinhlaka ezehlukene emphakathini waseNanda, KwaMashu, eNtuzuma naseVerulam.ILUNGU lomphakathi, uNkk Samkelisiwe Simelane, linxusa uhulumeni ukuthi unyuse ezokuphepha, udale namathuba omsebenzi ukuze kwehle ubugebengu Isithombe: Tumi Pakkies/ Independent Newspapers.UMnuz Zithulele Shandu waseMachobeni, obhodle umlilo maqede kwaduma ihlombe, ebuza uMkhwanazi ukuthi yisiphi isizathu esenza angamxoshi umphathi wesiteshi saseNanda?"Ngiyazibuzela nje ukuthi kungani loya muntu ongumholi kulesiya siteshi engaxoshwa?" kubuza uShandu.Uthe uhlale ebuya ebusuku emsebenzini, abone yonke imikhuba egilwa ngamaphoyisa aseMtshebheni, wathi ngamalungu omphakathi anamakotishi endaweni, athe ayizizinda zokufihla izigebengu. UNDUNANKULU waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, enxusa umphakathi ukuthi ubambe iqhaza ekulweni nobugebengu Isithombe: Tumi Pakkies/ Independent Newspapers"Ababacubungulisisi abantu ababaqashisayo. Lezi zigebengu zivele zibeke imibhede emakotishini, zihambe ziyobamba inkunzi, bese ziyabaleka endaweni," kusho uShandu.Uthe kuyakhathaza ukuthi omastende abanendaba, bajatshuliswa ukuthi umuntu usuke ekhokhe irenti kuphela.Ukhale nangezitolo zabokufika, athe kazibhalisiwe, wathi buningi ubugebengu obenzeka kuzona obufaka phakathi amaphoyisa."Amaphoyisa aseMtshebheni ahamba ngezimoto zombutho ukuyokoleka imali kulezi zotolo. Nginayo ngisho nenombolo yemoto eyayenza lokho. Mkhwanazi ngingakuthatha ngiyokubeka lapho okwenzeka khona lokhu," usho kanje.Nokho akhona amagama amaphoyisa abebalulwa umphakathi, uthi ayasebenza. Kuwona kuvele elikaDlamini (Warrant Officer BT) oke wanconywa embizweni eyayinoNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa waphambilini, uMnuz Bheki Cele. Kuleyo mbizo uCele waze wambonga ngo-R25 000 uDlamini. Muva nje, uDlamini uphinde wahlomula ngendondo esifundazweni njengoba kade kunomcimbi wokubonga amaphoyisa asebenza ngokuzikhandla. UMfu Sandile Ndlovu waseBhambayi (ngalapho umphakathi osanda kubulala khona abayisihlanu) uthe akulungiswe indaba yezinsizakusebenza ngoba bathi uma bebika ubugebengu, batshelwe ukuthi azikho izimoto."Nami ngiyayazi iveni efikayo endaweni izoletha izidakamizwa iphinde izihambise. Ngilubikile lolu daba kumphathi wamaphoyisa (esiteshini), wagcina ethi uzoyilandela, kwaphela kanjalo," kusho uNdlovu.Ukhale ngokuthi babuye bakhuzwe ngokuthi bangazijeziseli abasolwa."Into edala ukuthi abantu bazijezisele abasolwa ukuthi amaphoyisa kawafiki ngesikhathi. Ngeke ulokhu ubambe umuntu amaphoyisa engafiki, yikho abantu begcina besebenzisa ithuba abalitholayo, bezithathela umthetho ngezandla," kusho yena.OweNtuzuma Neighbourhood Watch, uMnuz Andile Jali, uphakamise ukuthi aholelwe imiholo ethe xaxa amaphoyisa ukuze ezothi uma ebanjwa enza inkohlakalo, kube yicala elibomvu."Sifisa nisheshise neyokuqashwa kwalabo abazoqapha ubugebengu emiphakathini. Sengathi leyo phrojekthi ingaqala khona la eThekwini. Lokhu kuzoshaya izinyoni ezimbili ngetshe elilodwa, kuzolungisa indaba yesibalo sabangasebenzi, iphinde ilwe nobugebengu," kusho uJali.Unxuse nokuthi abuyekezwe namalungelo anikwa izigebengu uma sebezihambise emaphoyiseni."Njengamanje liphumile izwi lokuthi uma abayizigebengu bebamba umuntu, bethola ukuthi usezinhlakeni ezilwa nobugebengu, bambulale ngoba kubulawe ubhongoza wabo. Lokho ngifuna ukukusho ngingahlonizi ngoba kungenzeka umhlangano olandelayo ufike sebebabulele abanye bethu," kubeka uJali.Kubuye kwaphakanyiswa ukuthi zithathwe izingane ezincane ezenza ubugebengu ziyogcinwa ezindaweni ezigcina izingane.Kuphinde kwavela nesiphakamiso sokuthi ithuthukiswe indawo yaseNanda, kufakwe amalambu akhanyisa kakhulu, kwakhiwe imigwaqo ekahle nezindlu ezikahle ukuze amaphoyisa akwazi ukusheshe afike emphakathini uma ebizelwa ubugebengu.Kuvele nokuthi abantu abasawabiki amanye amacala ngoba bengasizakali, kuwona kuvele ukuthi kunezimoto ezivele zime, kwehle abantu nezibhamu, bakhuthuze abahamba ngezinyawo amaselula.UMkhwanazi uthe uzoyibukela eduze eyezikhalazo ezishiwo ngesiteshi saseNanda."Ngizoke ngibheke ukuthi umasteshi waseNanda uyenza nini imihlangano nomphakathi inyanga nenyanga njengokulindelekile," kusho uMkhwanazi.Uthe sebeqalile ukuthi basebenzise ama-drone ukuqapha ubugebengu, ikakhulukazi kulezo zindawo okungangeneki kalula khona, wathi baphezu komsebenzi wokulungisa amakhamera, azobukwa ndawana thize ezokhethwa ukuze nalokho kulekelele ekulweni nobugebengu.UNtuli ephendula kokunye okushiwo umphakathi, uthe okuzosiza ukuthi umuntu nomuntu kuzofanele libe khona iqhaza alibambayo emphakathini."Lokhu kudinga wonke umuntu. Kufanele nizibophezele ukuthi indawo yenu ihlale iphephile, inokuthula. Sonke asibe amanxusa okulwa nobugebengu," kusho uNtuli.Uthe nasemakhaya, abazali abangazifuyi izigebengu, bazibike emaphoyiseni."Ekhaya kwakho uyifundisa kanjani ingane yakho, uzifundisani, uxoxani nazo ekutheni kufanele ziziphathe kanjani emphakathini," usho kanje.Uthe abangadikibali abantu ukubika amacala nokumpimpa izigebengu, wathi lokho abakwenze ngokuzifihla ezinombolweni ezifanele, bangayi eziteshini ngqo.
UMASIPALA weTheku usuveze ukuthi uyibeke eqhulwini indaba yokuhlinzekwa kwamanzi ethinta izindawo eziningi zedolobha, okuhlanganisa neyasesibhedlela iPrince Mshiyeni Memorial, eMlaza.Umasipala usho kanje ngesikhathi ngoMsombuluko kube nombhikisho, lapho inhlangano iPublic Servants Association (PSA) ibikhalaza ngaphandle kwamasango esibhedlela iPrince Mshiyeni, eMlaza. Bekungenxa yenkinga yamanzi okuthiwe isixake kwaze kwaphela amasonto amathathu.Akuyona kuphela indawo yaseMlaza okukhalwa ngayo ngamanzi njengoba naKwaMashu esigcemeni sakwa-G, kubikwa inkinga efanayo.UMnuz Andile Gumbi waKwaMashu ekhuluma neSolezwe, uthe sekuphele iminyaka amanzi ebahlupha."Sikhuluma nje, awekho. Sekuphele iminyaka emithathu amanzi ahamba. Ahamba njalo ngo-8 ebusuku. Abuyile namhlanje ekuseni (esho izolo) kodwa aphinde ahamba. Ngihlezi ngibashayela ngibika ngale nkinga, kodwa ababuyeli kimi,” kusho uGumbi.UMnuz Mongezi Bolofo waKwaMashu naye uthe alukho uhlelo umasipala onalo oluqondile abalwaziyo."Kumele engabe kunohlelo olwaziwayo ukuthi amanzi ahamba ngasiphi isikhathi, hhayi ukuthi avele aphele nje isigubhukane. Asisakwazi ukuhlela kahle ngenxa yale nkinga. Abanye abantu kumele benakekele iziguli emakhaya, bahlanze izindlu zabo, konke lokho akwenzeki ngenxa yokuthi uthi usahlela usuku lwakho uwafice esengasekho empompini. Ayibi bikho incazelo, basiphathisa okwezilwane,” usho kanje.UMnuz Thulani Colleni uthe: "KwaNgoqokazi, eNanda, amanzi sawagcina ngezikhukhula zango-Ephreli 2022. Ikhansela lihlezi libiza umhlangano lithi kuzolungiswa kodwa akukho okwenzekayo futhi nezimoto ezithwala amanzi nazo azisezi.” UMnuz Simphiwe Radebe yena uthe: "ENanda, eNhlungwane, usuphelile unyaka amanzi singawazi, kweminye imizi ayabuya, kweminye engabuyi. Kubi nje kakhulu.”UMnuz Sanele Maphumulo yena uthe: "Kusukela ngo-2013, amanzi awekho eNanda ku-wadi-108. Sitshelwa ukuthi kuyabiza ukulungisa amapayipi. Bazidlela imali nje laba, izimoto ezithwala amanzi zizifikela ngesikhathi esithandwa yizona noma zingafiki.”Abanye bathe eMlazi ka-Q naseLuganda, kunesimo esifanayo.Ngokusho kwesitatimende esikhishwe uMasipala weTheku, uthe uyibeke eqhulwini inselelo yokuhlinzekwa kwamanzi ethinta izindawo eziningi zedolobha, okuhlanganisa nesibhedlela iPrince Mshiyeni."Idolobha libhekene nokwenyuka kwesidingo samanzi selokhu kuqale isizini yasehlobo, okuholele ekutheni kube nomfutho ophansi kanye nokungatholakali kwamanzi ezindaweni ezibucayi kuzo zonke izinhlelo zokuphakelwa. "Njengengxenye yemizamo ebumbene yokulungisa lesi simo ngokushesha, singaqinisekisa ukuthi amanzi aqale ukugeleza esibhedlela isikhashana nje namuhla (ngoMsombuluko), nokho ukungenelela ukuze kusimamiswe uhlelo lwabo akukapheleli. Ithimba likamasipala likhona futhi lizoqhubeka nokuqapha ukuhlinzekwa kwesibhedlela nezinye izindawo,” kusho isitatimende.Siqhube sathi: "Kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi isidingo samanzi sihlala siphezulu kulo lonke idolobha. Lokhu kuvame kakhulu ezifundeni eziseningizimu nasenyakatho okwenziwa intuthuko kanye nokuncipha kokuphakelwa kwamanzi uMngeni-uThukela Water ngo-Okthoba, nyakenye."Isidingo samanzi njengamanje sidlula ukunikezwa kwamanzi cishe ngama-megalitha angu-100 ngosuku, okuholela enkingeni eyengeziwe ohlelweni naphezu kwezinyathelo zokungiwa kwamanzi ezikhona. Ukulawula isidingo, idolobha lizoqhubeka nokuhlinzeka ngezabelo ezindaweni ezinesidingo esikhulu. "Okunye ukungenelela kubandakanya ukuhlonza nokulungisa izindawo ezivuzayo kanye nokuhlola wonke ama-valve okulawula nokulungisa nokuwafaka esikhundleni lapho kudingeka khona. Izakhamuzi nosomabhizinisi bayanxuswa ukuthi basebenzise amanzi ngokuwonga,” sisho kanje isitatimende.
UZITHETHELELE ngokuthi isoka beliyiphika ingane owesifazane obehlala eHazelmere, eThekwini, owongokufika kuleli oboshwe ngokulahla ingane esitamkokweni.Ngokusho kwakhe, isoka belimsola ngokuphinga, lase liyiphika ingane ngesikhathi isizelwe lathi akusiyona elayo nokuholele ekutheni aze ayoyilahla.Lo wesifazane (32) wenze lesi senzo ngeSonto, lapho okuthiwa wabonakala eyofaka usana esitamkokweni elisonge ngoplastiki omnyama emgwaqweni uWick, eVerulam.Ngokusho kwesitatimende esikhiwe uphiko lakwaReaction Unit South Afrika (Rusa), omunye wonogada bayo umiswe amalungu omphakathi ayesola ukuthi kungase kube nesilwane esivimbe esitamkokweni."Ngesikhathi unogada wethu ehlola kule ndawo, uthole isikhwama somgqomo omnyama sibhajwe eduze komgodi wokudonsa amanzi. Ingane ibonakale ilenga onqenqemeni lomgodi oholela ekwehleni okungamamitha amabili esitamkokweni. Unogada ukwazile ukukhipha uplasitiki womgqomo, wahlenga ingane wase ebikela abanye onogada ukuze athole usizo,” kusho isitatimende.ONOGADA bakwaRUSA bephonsa owesifazane (ophakathi nendawo) olahle ingane ngemibuzo Isithombe: RUSASithe ngesikhathi onogada befika endaweni yesigameko basusa izingubo ezimanzi nezingcolile ebezigqokiswe ingane obekubonakala ukuthi kungeyentombazane."Umntwana ube esegqokiswa ijakhethi efudumele wayiswa esibhedlela sikahulumeni oSindisweni. Onogada bathole indwangu kakotini engalweni yengane okwenza abezimo eziphuthumayo bakholelwa ukuthi ubesanda kuphuma esikhungweni sezempilo,” sisho kanje.Siqhube sathi, ngoMsombuluko onogada babe sebelandela umkhondo ukuthola ukuthi lo wesifazane ungubani."Kutholakale ukuthi lo ungowakudabuka eLesotho. Ufudukele kuleli eminyakeni emibili edlule. Olunye ulwazi olutholakele luthi lo wesifazane ubesehlose ukubaleka kuleli. Utholwe nepasi likamngani wakhe kwaphinde kwatholwa umaki wasesibhedlela osegameni lengane,” sisho kanje.Kuphinde kwahlaluka ukuthi lo wesifazane uchazile ukuthi wangena kuleli ngokungemthetho ngo-2022. Washiya ingane eneminyaka engu-11 neneminyaka emihlanu ubudala eLesotho, ukuze azofuna umsebenzi kuleli. Okhulumela amaphoyisa aKwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe owesifazane uboshiwe ngamaphoyisa aseVerulam."Owesifazane oneminyaka engu-31 ubudala ongowokufika kuleli, uboshiwe ngecala lokulahla ingane ngemuva kokutholakala kwengane yentombazane esanda kuzalwa enkabeni yedolobha laseVerulam, ngeSonto. "Ingane itholwe yilungu lomphakathi elabikele amaphoyisa yabe isiphuthunyiswa esibhedlela ukuze iyobhekwa. Umsolwa uboshwe lapho ehlala khona eHazelmere, eVerulam, kanti uzovela eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseVerulam, maduze,” kusho uNetshiunda.
INYELEZELE endlini kwi-AfriForum, esolwa ngokusabalalisa inkoleloze ngomthetho wokuthathwa komhlaba nezakhiwo osanda kusayinwa.I-AfriForum ivulelwe icala lokuvukela uMbuso yizinhlaka ezahlukene okubalwa kuzo i-MK, amalungu e-ANC esifundazweni iWestern Cape, namalungu e-Sanco.La macala avulwe izolo, kulandela isinqumo sikaMengameli waseMelika, uMnuz Donald Trump, sokuhoxisa uxhaso olutholwa iNingizimu Afrika ngoba esola elakuleli ngokuhlwitha umhlaba nokunyathela amalungelo abathile.Nasezinkundleni zokuxhumana i-AfriForum inyamanambana ebanwini bakuleli njengoba begxeka izenzo zayo.Izinhlaka ezivule amacala zithe kunje nje ingenxa ye-AfriForum abayisola ngokuqamba amanga ngomthetho omusha wokuthathwa komhlaba nezakhiwo.Umholi we-MK ePhalamende, uDkt John Hlophe, uthe lokhu okwenziwe yi-AfriForum kuyicala elibomvu."Bahlangane nezinhlaka zangaphandle baphazamisa ukuzimela kwezwe. Le nto abayenzile ifana ncamashi nokuphazamisa ukusebenza kwezwe kanye nomnotho. Maningi amacala afana nalawa aseke athethwa lapho khona amajaji akubeka kwacaca ukuthi kuwukuvukela uMbuso ukunxenxa uhulumeni wangaphandle ukuba unswinye izwe lakho.”UHlophe uthe i-AfriForum iyaziwa ukuthi iyaphikisana nento enikeza amathuba abantu abebecindezelwe ngaphambili, wathi bafuna ukuthi ithathelwe izinyathelo eziqinile."Uma ingase iyekwe i-AfriForum baningi abanye abazobukela phansi izwe lethu. Nginxusa zonke izinhlaka ezifuna ukubona inqubekela phambili ukuba zibambisane kulolu daba.”UHlophe uphinde wagxeka ukuziphatha kukaTrump."Akusilona iqiniso ukuthi kuhlwitha umhlaba nokuthi kubulawa abalimi kuleli. UTrump uyazi ukuthi kunehhovisi lenxusa lakuleli eMelika, obekufanele axhumane nalo. Yena uvele wakhetha ukungalandeli imigudu. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi uTrump akasihloniphi.”Isikhulu esiphezulu kwi-AfriForum, uMnuz Kallie Kriel, sikuphikile ukuthi izenzo zabo ziwukuvukela uMbuso."Uphenyo luzokhombisa ukuthi ayikho le nto abayishoyo. Umbhedo nje le nto yabo, akuyona into engaze isiqwashise ebusuku. Kuwumsebenzi wethu njengenhlangano elwela amalungelo abantu ukuba sikhulume uma kukhona abantu abacindezelwayo.”UKriel uthe kufanele kugxekwe uhulumeni oholwa yi-ANC ngokuhoxiswa koxhaso, wathi kuyabamangaza nokuthi i-MK ingenye yezinhlangano ezibavulele icala."Ngesikhathi kusaphethe uZuma (umholi we-MK, uJacob) esewumengameli iningi inkohlakalo eyayenzeka kuleli nokwaze kwaholela ekutheni kusungulwe iKhomishini eyayiPhenya izinsolo zokuLawulwa koMbuso yiDlanzana.”
PHEZU kokuba ebekwe endlini yakhe yokugcina ngeSonto, uMnuz Lucky Maphalala obulawe ngesihluku waphonswa edamini eBergville, KwaZulu-Natal, muva nje, kepha akuvumi ukuba umndeni wakhe wamukele okumehlele.UMaphalala (35) ubengunesi esibhedlela i-Emmaus e-Oliviershoek, esiFundeni uThukela, ubulawe esigamekweni okusolakala kuso ukuthi bekudunwa imoto yakhe ayehamba ngayo.Ngokusho kukadadewabo uNksz Thuli Maphalala, elandisa Isolezwe, bamthole elinyazwe kabuhlungu ekhanda."Ngesikhathi simthola edamini, isimo sakhe sasingesihle. Kukhona abamshaya ngakho ekhanda. Wayevuvukele nasentanyeni kukhona ababemklinye ngakho,” kusho uNksz Maphalala.Uthe njengoba-nje aduka kwakumele ayolanda unkosikazi wakhe esikhungweni sezokushayela."NgoMsombuluko wayengasebenzi futhi nomkakhe wayeye esikhungweni sokufundela ukushayela izimoto. Wathembisa ukuthi uzoyomlanda kodwa wagcine engafikanga njengoba wathi khona la aphuthuma khona nomalume wakhe kodwa uzoqala ekhaya ebese beyahamba.”"Umkakhe waze wafika ekhaya, wathola amawindi evuliwe, umnyango uvuliwe futhi nomsakazo ukhalela phezulu. Okwammangaza ukuthi wafica umalume lo ayethe bazohamba naye, wathi uma embuza ukuthi uke wambona yini, umalume wathi cha kodwa uzwe umsindo wokuvaleka kwegaraji. Wayelokhu emshayela ucingo ebona kushona ilanga engabuyi waze wagcina esezumekile,” usho kanjena.Uthe ngokubona izinsuku zihamba bagcine sebeshayela inkampani ye-tracker yemoto ukubheka ukuthi ngabe uhambe washonaphi."Imoto yatholakala edamini uma beyibheka ngohlobo lwezobuchwepheshe futhi nabanye abambona bathi yase ingashayelwa wuyena, ishayelwa ngomunye. Bekungesiso isigameko sokuqala eduka njengoba ngelinye ilanga samthola ezintabeni imoto yakhe isiduniwe kodwa yagcina itholakala komunye umuzi egaraji isikhishwe i-number plate. Watholakala edidekile edliswe izidakamizwa,” usho kanje.Uthe kubalimaze kakhulu ukulahlekelwa nguye njengoba bekunguyena ebese bethembele kuye. Uthe uyena obesebenza kahle futhi ubesiza ugogo wabo kakhulu.Okhulumela inhlangano yamanesi i-Democratic Nursing Organisation of South Africa (Denosa), KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Andile Mbeje, uthe lesi sehlakalo sibashaye kabuhlungu."Siyakhala kakhulu ngoba abahlengikazi bavele bayashoda futhi iningi lomphakathi ngeke lisabathola ngokwanele. Lesi akusona isigameko sokuqala njengoba nyakenye kwabulawa omunye esifundeni sasoZwathini owadutshulwa,” kusho uMbeje.Uthe bacela uhulumeni aseke ngokwengqondo abahlengikazi abebesebenza noMaphalala futhi uhulumeni usebenzisane namaphoyisa ukuhlonipha abahlengikazi namakhosi ezindawo nawo awabambisane nomphakathi ukunqanda izihlava ezikanje.
SINGASE sengezelwe icala lokuzama ukubulala isishoshovu se-MKP KwaMakhutha, eThekwini, esibhekene necala lokudlwengula sikhulelise indodakazi (19).Lokhu kuza emva kokuvela kokuthi sidla imishanguzo yokuthithibalisa i-HIV ngesikhathi siqedela ukufaka isicelo saso sebheyili eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMbumbulu.Isehlo lapho umsolwa akhulelisa khona umgilwa senzeka phakathi kuka-Agasti noSepthemba ngonyaka odlule, kodwa umgilwa wangabika ngaso ngaleso sikhathi ngoba umsolwa emsabise ngokuthi uzombulala.Umndeni uze wathola ngesigameko ngoDisemba, ngesikhathi ubamba imiyalezo phakathi kukamsolwa nomgilwa. Ngokuhamba kwamasonto, kwagcina kuvela nokuthi indodakazi uyidlwengule yaze yakhulelwa.Indaba ye-HIV ivele ngesikhathi imantshi, uNkk Moodley, ibuzisisa ukuthi ummangalelwa utshele inkantolo ukuthi udla imishanguzo.Umphenyi wecala, uWarrant Officer Bhekithemba Nzama uvumile, wengeza ngokuthi umsolwa ulale nomgilwa ngaphandle ngokumvikela (ngekhondomu)."Unalo ulwazi ngesimo sikamgilwa?” kubuza uNkk Moodley.UNzama uphendule ngokuthi unina kamgilwa wayekade emtshele ukuthi umgilwa uzalwe engenalo igciwane."Angikaze-ke ngikhulume naye ngqo umgilwa, ukuthola kabanzi ngesimo sakhe,” kuphendula uNzama.UNkk Moodley ubuze ukuthi kungenzeka ukuthi umsolwa umsulele ngegciwane umgilwa, uNzama waphendula ngokuthi kunjalo.Kubuye kwahlaluka nokuthi kungenzeka ukuthi umgilwa wayengazi ngesimo sempilo sikayise ngesikhathi kwenzeka isehlakalo.Lokhu kuvele empendulweni kaNzama, ethe yize engeke akwazi ukuphendula into eqondile ekutheni umgilwa ubazi yini kodwa ngesikhathi ezethula kunina (kamgilwa) lezi zindaba, wathuka woma, wathi ubengazi.UNkk Moodley uthe lolu lwazi lusho ukuthi likhona icala elingahle lengezwe kumsolwa nakuba engaligagulanga ngegama.Ngokwejwayelekile, umuntu othelela omunye nge-HIV ezazi isimo sakhe, uye abekwe icala lokuzama ukubulala.Kuphinde kwavela nokuthi akukaziwa ukuthi imiphumela yolibofuzo izobuya nini.UNzama uveze ukuthi amasampula wawahambisa msalofu eLaboratory ePitoli, ngoFebhuwari 6.Udalule ukuthi abakhona abaphumanga nazwi lokuhlawumbisela ukuthi imiphumela izolunga nini ngesikhathi ebabuza ngalokho.Uthe bamcebisa ngokuthi afike acele umshushisi nenkantolo babhale isitatimende sithunyelwe nge-email, bagcizelele ekutheni kubalulekile ukuthi uhlelo luphuthunyiswe.Uthe nakuba bemcebise ngalokhu kodwa bale baphetha ukuphuma nezwi lokuthi kungashesha kangakanani uma kwenziwa lokho abamcebise ngakho. Bebelokhu bekhale njalo ngobuningi besibalo samasampula abawenzayo, bethi senza kweluleke isikhathi ukuthi kuphume imiphumela.Ummeli kammangalelwa, uMnuz Jadwat, unxuse inkantolo ukuthi ibe imdedela ngebheyili umsolwa, wakhala ngokuthi njengoba kusazoqhubeka isikhathi esingaziwa kulindwe imiphumelo yolibofuzo, kungakuhle ukuthi abe ngaphandle.Umsolwa akagcini ngokuba yisishoshovu se-MKP kuphela kodwa ubuye abe yilungu le-Community Policing Forum (CPF) futhi waziwa njengomuntu ongabufuni ngenhliziyo yakhe yonke abantu abenza ubugebengu.Icala lihlehle usuku lwakusasa ukuze imantshi ikhiphe isinqumo ngesicelo sebheyili.Enkantolo bekukhona izihlobo ezimbalwa, ezomndeni kamgilwa nezikamsolwa.Umsolwa obebukeka engakhathazekile, ubegqoke i-golf T-shirt ebomvu ne-jean ekhanyayo ngombala. Ubebuye aqalaze lapho okuhleli khona ebebezothamela icala.
UKUQONDA ukuthi ziningi izinkinga ezibhekene nabagibeli bezithuthi zomphakathi, ngenye yezinto ezenza omunye wabashayeli bamatekisi aseNewcastle, enyakatho yeKwaZulu-Natal, wathola indlela yokwenza bahlale befisa futhi bekujabulela ukugibela itekisi alishayelayo kunawabanye.Lowo wuMnuz Siyabonga "Bonga” Ximba, oshayela itekisi elisuka elokishini iMadadeni eliya eNewcastle, osebe nedumela ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, kusabalala ama-video akhe eqhulula amancoko namahlaya, okubonakala kuyinto ewajabulisa kakhulu amakhasimende akhe; abagibeli.Ama-video akhe avame ukuqoshwa ngabagibeli abasuke bechazwa yindlela abonga ngayo uma imali yokugibela, uma sebekhokhe bonke, ayibiza ngokuthi wumnikelo ozobasiza bangene izulu uma beqhubeka kanjena. Kwamanye ama-video uzwakala encokolisa owesilisa nowesifazane abasuke begibela etekisini lakhe, ebancokolisa ngokuthi bafanelene, nokuthi benze isinqumo esihle ngokugibela itekisi lakhe, bayeka amanye. Exoxa neSolezwe, uXimba (42) osekuyiminyaka engaphezu kwewu-20 enza umsebenzi wokuthutha abantu, uthe ukuqonda ukuthi ukuncintisana kuphezulu kuyena nozakwabo ematekisini kwenza wacabanga ukuthi angenza kanjani ukwehluka kubona.ITEKISI elishayelwa wuMnuz Ximba eMadadeni, eNewcastle Isithombe: SITHUNYELWE"Yilapho engabona khona ukuthi ukuqhulula amancoko, ikakhulu ngezikhathi zasekuseni lapho itekisi lami lisuke ligcwele khona abagibeli abaphuthuma edolobheni, kungasiza kakhulu ukuthi ngehluke kwabanye abashayeli bamatekisi. Lokho ngikwenziswa nawukuthi ngiyazi ukuthi abantu abagibela izithuthi zomphakathi banezinkinga ezahlukene ababhekene nazo empilweni, ngakho ukubancokolisa kwenza bajabule uma benami,” usho kanje.Lo mshayeli, onezingane ezintathu, izinombolo zetekisi alishayelayo zithi: 55 902 ZN. Uthe nakuba ewuthanda kakhulu umsebenzi wakhe, nokho zikhona izinselelo eziba khona, kubalwa ukubuye kungahlangani u-R1 000 abekelwe wona wumqashi wakhe ukuwuhlanganisa njalo ngosuku."Kodwa-ke ngenxa yokuthi engikwenzayo ngikwenziswa wuthando nentshisekelo yokusiza umphakathi, izingqinamba ezivela endleleni azingiphazamisi kangako. Okusemqoka kimi wukuqikelela ukuthi abagibeli bami bahlale bejabule njalo ukuze bahlale befuna ukugibela itekisi engilishayelayo,” kusho uXimba.Uthe okunye okumsiza ukuqhuba lo msebenzi, wukuthi yinto osekuyisikhathi eside ewenza njengoba aqala ukushayela amatekisi engakabi nazo ngisho izincwadi zokushayela."Manje sengibheke ukuqhubeka ngenze umsebenzi wami ngokwethembeka, ngize ngifike esigabeni lapho sengikwazi ukuzimela ngibe nezinto zami endimeni,” kusho uXimba.
BAFUNA kwenzeke ubulungiswa ngothishanhloko nomseshi basoLundi, ababasola ngokusebenzisa amandla abo ukuqinela umgilwa, bamsulisa icala kungafanele.Umgilwa, uMnuz Ndumiso Manzini (34) waseMdumezulu, oLundi, okuthiwa usesibhedlela, usanda kunqunywa izinzwane ezintathu nenye ingxenye yonyawo, okuthiwa bese kunezimpethu.Elandisa ngesigameko udadewabo, ocele ukungadalulwa, uthe isigameko sokuhlaselwa kukaManzini senzeka ngoDisemba 29, 2024."Uthishanhloko wafika ehamba nabanye abathathu, bashaqa umgilwa, bayomshayela endaweni engahambi bantu. Kuthiwa bemshaya, babembuza ukuthi uzishonisephi izimpahla (zikathishanhloko),” kusho udadewabo.Uveze ukuthi umgilwa ubevamise ukuwasha imoto kamsolwa neyomkakhe, bese beyamholela okuncane, wathi umgilwa wabatshela ukuthi wayelokhu echaze njalo ukuthi akazazi yena izimpahla.Uthe izimpahla uthishanhloko ayethe zebiwe kwakuyithelevishini, laptop, amateki nokunye."Uthishanhloko wamconsisela ngo-plastic ovuthayo ezinyaweni zombili kodwa olwalimala kakhulu olwangakwesobunxele,” kubeka udadewabo.Uthe likhona icala elavulwa emaphoyiseni emva kokwenzeka kwesigameko, umgilwa agcine elisula phakathi noJanuwari ngenxa yengcindezi."Ngithole ukuthi izihlobo zikathishanhloko zifike nomseshi ekhaya, ukuzoxoxa nomgilwa ngecala. Zibona ukuthi akayingeni, zigcine zixoxa nesihlobo esikhubazekile, zasikhohlisa ngo-R10 000. Kube sekubuya umseshi esezolanda umgilwa, kwayiwa enkantolo kumshushisi ukuyosula icala,” usho kanje.Uthe umshushisi waqale wanqaba ukulisula, embuza ukuthi ulisula kanjani elimele kanje?Uthe wabuyela ekhaya ngezinyawo, engasabonwa umseshi nezihlobo zikathishanhloko."Wathi uma efika wathola bemlindile, bamthethisa, bembuza ukuthi icala akabange esalisula ngani. Bamphindisa emuva nephepha lokulisula, umshushisi walisula ngempela embona ebuya isibili,” kusho udadewabo.Uthe kuye ngokuya unyawo lulokhu luqhubeka nokubola, waze wayiswa esibhedlela lapho okufike kwathiwa akusekho okunye okungenziwa ngaphandle kokuthi lunqunywe, kusikwe indawo esibolile."Sifuna ubulungiswa ngoba uthishanhloko uyaqhubeka nempilo yakhe sengathi akenzanga lutho olubi. Sifuna liqalwe phansi kabusha icala, khona umthetho uzodlala indima yawo, ajeze ngokukhubaza isihlobo sethu, wangagcina lapho wasebenzisa amandla akhe nemali ukusisulisa icala singafuni,” kusho udadewabo.Uthe ufuna kube khona izinyathelo ezithathwayo futhi ngomseshi, athe naye ube nesandla ekutheni umgilwa angabutholi ubulungiswa.Umsolwa onguthishanhloko ozalana nomholi oqavile oLundi, ethintwa yiSolezwe uthe: "Ngicela uze kimi, angikwazi ukukhuluma nomuntu engingamazi ngalolo daba. Udadewabo (kaNdumiso) akaqale angifonele, angitshele ukuthi kukhona abazongifonela ngalolu daba, ngale kwalokho akukho ukuphawula engizokwenza.”Kuze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela amaphoyisa engakayiphenduli imibuzo ayithunyelelwe ngalolu daba.
OBEYILUNGU le-EFF, uDkt Mbuyiseni Ndlozi, usola umholi weqembu uMkhonto weSizwe, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, ngokushaya abaholi be-EFF ngemfe iphindiwe njengoba leli qembu lalahlekelwa wukwesekwa KwaZulu-Natal, nakwezinye izifundazwe okhethweni lwangonyaka odlule. UNdlozi owayeyilungu lePhalamende futhi engomunye wabantu ababeyingxenye yokubunjwa kwe-EFF ayeyikhulumela, ukhale ngokuthi badukiswa wubuholi baleli qembu ukuthi bangayigxeki i-MK ngesikhathi kuyiwa okhethweni njengoba "bekunobudlelwano” phakathi kwayo noZuma, ekubeni phambilini babengamfuni.Engxoxweni edlalwe esiteshini sakwa-SABC izolo ekuseni, uNdlozi uthe akubanga lula ukuthi kugxekwe i-MK, kuthiwe isiyisitha ngemuva kokutheza inqwaba yabaholi kwi-EFF okubalwa nowayeyiphini likamengameli uMnuz Floyd Shivambu, osenguNobhala Jikelele kwi-MK."Sashaywa ngomqondo ”ngobudlelwano" obebubonakala bukhona phakathi kobuholi be-EFF, noZuma. Lokhu bekwenza kubonakale sengathi siyinto eyodwa, singayigxeki i-MK ngesikhathi kubhekwe okhethweni. Lokhu yikhona okwasenza sanatshiswa yi-MK okhethweni eKZN, yasidlula nangezibalo ePhalamende, sehlelwa ukwesekwa eGauteng naseMpumalanga,” kusho uNdlozi. Usho lokhu nje, ngo-2021 uMalema nobuholi be-EFF baya eNkandla, lapho (uMalema), kwavela izithombe bephunga itiye noZuma, kungathi sekuthelelwene amanzi ngoba ngesikhathi esangumengameli wezwe, i-EFF yayimphazamisa ize ikhishwe ngesidlozane ePhalamende. UNdlozi oke wasolwa wubuholi be-EFF ngokuthi ungomunye wabantu abazojoyina i-MK, uthe akakaze futhi akasoze aye kuleli qembu ngoba ubheke ukuya emkhakheni wezemfundo, noma ayoba yisishoshovu ezinhlanganweni zomphakathi ezilwela amalungelo."Ukuhamba kukaShivambu nowayengusihlalo we-EFF, u-Advocate Dali Mpofu nabanye abaholi, akubonakalanga njengokuthi badayisa umzabalazo ngoba kabayanga emaqenjini abamhlophe. Okunalokho baya kwi-MK esemkhankasweni wokulwela abantu abamnyama, abahluphekayo, abangasebenzi nabamnyama,” kuqhuba uNdlozi.Emuva kwalezi zivuvaba, uMalema usecula elinye iculo njengoba ethi akayifuni nalapho ihambe khona i-MK. "Anginalo iqhaza engizolibamba kwipolitiki yamaqembu, ngifisela okuhle kodwa ozakwethu kwi-EFF, anginanxa nabo. Ngiyikhathulile indima yami kwezombusazwe,” usho kanje.Uveze nokuthi wamiswa kwi-EFF kusele izinyanga eziyisithupha kuyiwe engqungqutheleni ebingoDisemba, lapho kwakhethwa ubuholi obusha."Ngangilokhu ngizama ukuthola ukuthi kwenzakalani ngoba ngangimisiwe. Nganquma ukuthi ngime kuyona yonke into ukuze ngigeze igama lami. Bengilokhu ngizama ukuxhumana nabaholi, ngithole nokuthi kwenzakalani kodwa kwanhlanga zimuka nomoya. Ngatshelwa ukuthi udaba lwami loze lulungiswe emva kwengqungquthela,” kusho uNdlozi, othe sibuhlungu isimo abhekana naso esolwa ngento engamanga.Uthe umbiko owasetshenziswa ebekwa amacala, wawungamanga futhi akuzange kulandelwe nomthethosisekelo weqembu."Ngangazi ngokuhamba kukaShivambu eya kwi-MK, kodwa ngamtshela naye ukuthi kumele atshele ubuholi be-EFF, ngoba kwakungeyona into okwakumele ngiye koyibika mina ngoba ngangingangeni kuyona. Ngokobuholi, kwakumele mina ngihlebe ngokuthi uShivambu uyahamba, yingakho ngaba nyambanambana,” usho kanje.Ebuzwa ngokuhamba kukaNdlozi, okhulumela i-EFF, uMnuz Sinawo Tambo, uthe bayitholile izolo incwadi yokusula kwakhe, bamfisela okuhle lapho eya khona.Uthe ngeke kube nomehluko ekuhambeni kwakhe kuleli qembu.Khonamanjalo: UTambo ukhwele wadilika kwinjinga engumnikazi wenkundla i-X, uMnuz Elon Musk ongomunye wabaqondisi eHhovisi likaMengameli waseMelika, uMnuz Donald Trump, ngokuthi uthe uMalema kumele abe yisigebengu sokuqala emhlabeni ngezinto azishoyo ngabamhlophe kule nkundla.
UNDUNANKULU waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli ephelezelwa uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa esifundazweni, uLieutenant-General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi babize imbizo yokubhunga ngobugebengu ehholo lomphakathi eMaoti, eNanda, namuhla.Lokhu kuza emva kokwanda kwezehlo zobugebengu obubucayi kule ndawo. Kubona kukhona obokubulawa kwabantu, ukudlwengulwa kwabesifazane nangokubanjwa kwabantu inkunzi.Emasontweni ambalwa edlule, kubikwa ukuthi amalungu omphakathi adiniwe, aze azithathela umthetho ngezandla, ahlahlela ngocelemba abayisihlanu ababesolwa ngokuhlalisa lubhojozi umphakathi.Le mbizo yandulela umhlangano wezinsuku ezimbili obungempelasonto lapho uNtuli nobuholi obuphezulu bezinhlaka ezilwa nobugebengu bebuvalelene emahhovisi oMnyango weMisebenzi yoMphakathi eMayville, ukudingida ngabo ubugebengu.
UMHOLI we-EFF, uMnuz Julius Malema, uthi amasosha akuleli ajutshwe eDemocratic Republic of Congo (DRC) avika ucelemba ngezandla.Ukusho lokhu ngenkathi kuqhubeka impikiswano ngodaba lwamasosha akuleli ePhalamende ngoMsombuluko."Iqiniso ukuthi amasosha ethu alwa nabantu abahlome ngezikhali zesimanje. Amavukela mbuso anolwazi lwezinhloli futhi anezikhali ezisezingeni. Amasosha akuleli awanazo izikhali zesimanje. Ayengakulungele ukubhekana nempi. Akuzange kube khona ukubambisana okuhle namasosha okwamanye amazwe. Akuzange kube nobuholi.”Amanye amqembu ahlabe ikhwelo lokuba asule esikhundleni uNgqongqoshe wezokuVikela, uNkk Angie Motshekga, nelokuba kusheshiswe uhlelo lokubuyiswa kwezidumbu zamasosha akuleli asale empini ngesikhathi kunempikiswano ngodaba lwempi eqhubeka e-DRC.Amalungu ePhalamende athe umhlulile umsebenzi uNkk Motshekga, amanye athe ukubambezeleka kokubuyiswa kwezidumbu zamasosha angu-14 asale empini kwandisa usizi emindenini eshonelwe.Ilungu le-DA uMnuz Chris Hattingh, lithe uNkk Motshekga kufanele asule esikhundleni, lathi uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, kufanele amxoshe uma engazehleli yena esikhundleni.UHattingh uthe amasosha akuleli ajutshwe e-DRC kufanele abuye ngokushesha."Sekucacile ukuthi impi ayingangabo. Amasosha aseMalawi avele asehoxile. Nawethu kufanele abuye ngokushesha.”Amaqembu i-MK, IFP ne-ANC athe ayaphikisana nokuthi amasosha akuleli ahoxiswe e-DRC.Ilungu le-MK, uMnuz Mzikayise Ntshingila, lithe amasosha akuleli kufanele aqhubeke ayibambe ishisa e-DRC.UNtshingila uthe into efunakalayo ukuba amasosha anikezwe izikhali ezanele.Uthe amasosha akuleli ajutshwe e-DRC awakaze abe nenkinga ngesikhathi kusaphethe umholi we-MK, uMnuz Jacob Zuma.Ilungu le-IFP, iNkosi Russel Nsikayezwe Cebekhulu, lithe ukuhoxa kwamasosha kungadala ukuthi abantu base-DRC babalekele kuleli."Sivele sinenkinga yabantu abaningi basemazweni angaphandle ababhace kuleli. Uma amasosha engashiya isimo sinje eDRC, baningi abazofudukela kuleli.”UNkk Motshekga uthe elakuleli linejoka lokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi kunokuthula ezwenikazi i-Afrika.UNkk Motshekga uthe amasosha akuleli aseke ajutshwa emazweni angu-23 ngenxa yakho ukuthi izwe lizimisele ngokugcina ukuthula ezwenikazi, wathi bakhathazekile ngokubambezeleka kokubuyiswa kwezidumbu zamasosha asale empini.Uthe izidumbu zisahlolwa e-Uganda."Besizitshela ukuthi bazoqeda namhlanje kodwa akwangenzeka lokho. Sinethemba lokuthi ngoLwesine bazokuba lapha.”UNkk Motshekga uthe benza isiqiniseko sokuthi amasosha ajutshwe e-DRC athola ukudla okwanele kanye nokunye akudingayo.
SEKUYALUNGA ukubuyiswa kwezidumbu zamasosha aseNingizimu Afrika asale empini eqhubeka eDemocratic Republic of Congo (DRC).Emva kokubambezeleka kohlelo lokubuyiswa kwezidumbu zamasosha angu-14 okwakufanele zibuyiswe ngesonto eledlule, kube khona umnyakazo ngempelasonto.Izidumbu zamasosha kwakude kuthiwe zizofika kuleli ngoLwesithathu, kodwa kwabuye kwaba nobuhixihixi ohlelweni lokubuyiswa kwazo oluqhutshwa yinhlangano yezizwe, i-United Nations.Okhulumela umbutho wezokuvikela kuleli, uMnuz Siphiwe Dlamini, uveze ukuthi izidumbu zamasosha sezithuthelwe e-Uganda, edolobheni i-Entebbe.Izidumbu zamasosha akuleli zithuthwe kanye nezamasosha aseTanzania nawaseMalawi, nawo asala empini ngesikhathi itholene phezulu namavukelambuso, i-M23.UDlamini uthe kuzocaca kusasa ukuthi zizodluliselwa nini kuleli izidumbu."NgeSonto kuzoqala uhlelo lokuba zihlolwe zonke izidumbu, sibheke ukuthi lolo hlelo luphothulwe ngoLwesibili.”Namhlanje kuzokuba nenkulumo mpikiswano ePhalamende lapho khona amaqembu ezepolitiki ezobhunga ngalolu daba.Isicelo sokuba kukhulunywe ngalolu daba sifakwe yi-DA ekhala ngokuthi ifuna izimpendulo ngokujutshwa kwamasosha akuleli e-DRC.I-DA ikhala ngokuthi uNgqongqoshe woMnyango wezokuVikela, uNkk Angie Motshekga, akazange anikeze izimpendulo ezigculisayo ngesikhathi evele phambi kwekomiti elibhekelele ukusebenza komnyango ngesonto eledlule.Amaqembu ezepolitiki apheka uNkk Motshekga ngebhodwe elincane, efuna ukwazi ukuthi kuyiqiniso yini ukuthi amasosha ase-DRC awanazo izinhlamu ezanele, ukudla nosizo lwezempilo.Amaqembu ezepolitiki amaningi afuna ukuthi amasosha atshalwe e-DRC abuye.Ngempelasonto bekunomhlangano womengameli bamazwe aseNingizimu ne-Afrika kanye nabasemazweni asempumalanga yezwekazi.Kulo mhlangano kuvunyelwene ngokuthi kubekwe phansi izikhali e-DRC, bese kuba nezingxoxo ezihlanganisa zonke izinhlaka ezithintekayo empini esidonse iminyaka.Abaholi abebehambele lo mhlangano obuseTanzania, banxuse uhulumeni wase-DRC ukuba ube nezingxoxo nabe-M23.Abaholi bathe bakhathazekile ngesimo esiqhubeka e-DRC lapho sekushone khona abantu abaningi, nasezibhedlela kuthiwa kugcwele.Amagama amasosha asale
