USEKHOMBE ngenjumbane abanye osonkontileka abaphakela izikole KwaZulu-Natal, ukuthi yibona ababambezela ukukhokhelwa ngesikhathi ngenxa yokuthi bafuna ukukhokhelwa imali yokudla abangakuhambisanga.Lokhu kushiwo nguMphathiswa wezeMfundo esifundazweni uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka, othe ukuze ukhokhelwe kumele kube ngukuthi uhambise zonke izinto ezisuke zidingeka kuleso sikole.UHlomuka uthe abaphakela izikole kumele baqinisekise ukuthi nakanjani lokhu okusuke kufuneka bayakuhambisa ukuze bakhokhelwe."Nike nizwe kuthiwa kukhona abaphakela izikole abangakhokheliwe, enye yezinkinga edala lokhu ukuthi abanye into abayihambise esikoleni ayihambisani. Uthola ukuthi ufuna ukukhokhelwa ukuthi uhambise amasi kodwa uthole ukuthi akazange awahambise. Uthishanhloko nalowo obhekele uhlelo lokudla esikoleni, kumele basayinele izinto ezifikile,” kusho uHlomuka.Uthe uma ala uthishanhloko ukusayina, usonkontileka ugcina ehambisa i-invoice enezinto ezingaphelele bese engakhokhelwa, bese kuthiwa umnyango awukhokhi."Imali yokukhokhela ukudla ezikoleni, imali ehlale ikhona emnyangweni, asikwazi ukuyithinta senze ezinye izinto ngayo. Asikwazi ukuyithatha sithi siyokwakha izindlu zangasese ngayo, ngoba kuyicala. "Uma umuntu engakhokheliwe, imali isuke ikhona kwi-akhawunti yomnyango ngoba asikwazi ukwenza ezinye izinto ngayo ngoba iyi-grant,” usho kanje.Ukusho lokhu ekhuluma muva nje, emhlanganweni wekomiti lezeMfundo esiShayamthetho obuseDundee, ukuyohlwaya imibono ngezikhalazo zomphakathi ngaphambi kokuqala konyakamali omusha, ngo-Ephreli.Abaphakela izikole bahlale bekhala mihla ngokungakhokhelwa ngesikhathi.Inhlangano ebamele ize isabise ngokugodla amandla, ingakuhambisi ukudla ezikoleni ngoba umnyango ungakhokhile.Umnyango uhlale ukhala ngenkinga yokuncishiswa kwesabelomali esenza ukuthi ungakwazi ukukhokha ngesikhathiNgisho kulo mhlangano abebehambele wona bebekhala ngenkinga yesabelomali, nokungafakwa kwezimali zezikole ngesikhathi okungama-norms and standards.UHlomuka uvumile ukuthi eyokuncishiswa kwesabelomali kudala izinkinga emnyangweni.Uvumile ukuthi imali yezikole abayifaki ngesikhathi ngoba kumele ngabe bayifaka kabili kodwa abayifaki kanjalo ngenxa yemali."Siyaxolisa ngendaba yama-norms and standards. Ngenxa yezinkinga zemali, asikwazi ukukhokha kabili, sinethemba ukuthi njengoba kuzothulwa isabelomali sikazwelonke ngungqongqoshe wezeziMali, ikhona imali ezofakwa noma singeke sikwazi ukubhekelela zonke izinkinga zomnyango,” kubeka uHlomuka.Uthe bayezwa nokuthi abanye othishanhloko bathatha imali yabo bayisebenzise ezikoleni, into okungamele yenzeke.
UKHALE ngamaphoyisa awuhlukumeze phakathi nesonto usenza amalungiselelo omngcwabo, aphinde awuhlukumeza ngisho usungcwaba, umndeni kaMnqobi weqembu lemigulukudu yaseNanda, iWest.UMnqobi "Hitle Namba 10” Nzimande (24) waseMzomusha, eNanda, ubulawe ngamaphoyisa eVerulam, ngoLwesine olwedlule. Ungcwatshwe ngoMgqibelo, emathuneni aseVerulam, emva kwenkonzo yokumphelezela ebisehholo lomphakathi iRedfern, ePhoenix.Umzala wakhe, uNksz Nompumelelo Mngoma, elandisa ngeziwombe ezenzeke kusuka ebulewe umufi, uthe baqala bethuswa udokotela wasemakhazeni kahulumeni, ebabuza ukuthi "bazongcwaba nini futhi kuphi?""Sazibuza ukuthi ngabe ubuzelani nokuthi ngabe yonke imindeni uyibuza le mininingwane yini uma izothatha izidumbu,” kusho uNksz Mngoma.Uqhube wathi bathole isiqiniseko sokuthi amaphoyisa ahogela ngezinhlelo zomngcwabo ngesikhathi bethola ukuthi kade esegasele nasemakhazeni azimele ebese beyise kuwo isidumbu sikamufi."Nakhona abuze okufanayo,” kubeka uNksz Mngoma.Uqhube wathi kukhulu kakhulu ukuhlukumezeka okwenziwa ngoLwesihlanu, kubuya isidumbu sikamufi."Aqale agasela singakalandwa emakhazeni, abuza ukuthi ziphi izibhamu zikaMnqobi? Akhombe omama ebebehleli emakhandleleni ngezibhamu, ebuza ukuthi siyikhalelelani inja, aze athi kanti nathi siyakwazi ukukhala?” kubeka uNksz Mngoma.Uthe ngesikhathi sekubuye ebebeye emakhazeni ukuyolanda isidumbu, aphinde abuya, ashaya kwasani, kwabesilisa ebebesesangweni belungiselela ukugeza isidumbu sikamufi amanxeba."Kushaywe, kwaze kwashaywa ngisho nobaba wakhe. Umalume wakhe obematasa ehlinza imbuzi yokuqhuba umsebenzi wokugeza amanxeba, naye amshayile, amyekisa ukuhlinza. Akhahlele ibhokisi laze lala ngohlangothi, isidumbu saphumela ngaphandle,” usho kanje.Uthe abebuza ukuthi "inja igezwa, igezwani?”Uthe okubaphathe kabuhlungu kakhulu ukusala kwaso silele kanjalo amahora ngamahora emvuleni njengoba umndeni uze wasingenisa ngaphakathi emva kwa-12 ebusuku, silokhu sihlale ngo-7 ebusuku.Uthe kwamlindelo awubange usaqhubeka njengoba eshaye phansi ngonyawo amaphoyisa, ethi akukho mlindelo "wenja" ozokwenziwa."Bashaye bonke omama abangomakhelwane ebebekhona, bathi ababuyele emizini yabo, kusale umndeni kuphela. Ebebematasa nokushayelela itende, batshelwe ukuthi, akukho tende elizomiswa ngoba awukho umlindelo ozoqhubeka,” usho kanje.Uthe bagcine benza umkhuleko omfishane, isidumbu sesingeniswe ngaphakathi, maqede bahlala, kwangaba khona mlindelo."Abesitshela emehlweni ukuthi ngokomthetho bekufanele sihlale naso size sibole isidumbu, noma sisimbele egcekeni sisigqibe, kuphele kanjalo,” usho kanje.Ngosuku lomngcwabo uthe bebebaningi ebebezimisele ngokuya enkonzweni yomngcwabo kodwa amaphoyisa ashaya phansi ngonyawo, athi akuyi muntu lapho.Uthe ngaleso sizathu kugcine kusala ngemuva abantu ebebezongena emabhasini amabili ebebewaqashile, idlanzana lathuthwa yizimoto ezihamba ngebanga ezilikhokhelwe."Abesilisa bebengavunyelwe kangangoba ubaba wakhe naye akayethamelanga inkonzo yomngcwabo. Abagcine beza, bacelelwe ukuze bezolekelela ngokubamba ibhokisi, nokugqiba,” kusho uNksz Mngoma, othe nokubacelela kube wumzukuzuku njengoba abebatshela ukuthi abazenzele bona."Uma sifika emathuneni kwathiwa asisheshise sigqibe.”Uthe emathuneni abenqaba ngisho ukuthi benze umkhuba wokuphonsa inhlabathi, bathi bayathandaza, abayekisa, ebabuza ukuthi "ubethandaza yini umufi?”"Sihlukumezekile siwumndeni. Asikwazanga ukumphelezela ngendlela ebesifisa ukuphelezela ngayo, ngisho nanemikhuba egcinwayo uma kushone umuntu, asikwazanga ukuyenza,” kusho uNksz Mngoma.Unina kamufi, uNksz Fundisile Nzimande, unanele kokushiwo uNksz Mngoma, wathi uhlukumezeke kakhulu."Kusiphathe kabi ukuthi noma eseshonile ke umntwana, besikhona yini isidingo sokuthi sihlukunyezwe njengomndeni?” kusho uNksz Nzimande."Ngikhuluma njengomzali. Akekho umzali ovuna ingane uma yenza okubi. Wonke umzali usuke efuna ukuthi ingane ibe nekusasa elihle,” kusho yena.Uthe lokhu okukhulunywayo bona abakwazi kodwa abamphikeli ngoba abazazi izinto abezenza emakhoneni, wathi bebazi ukuthi ubeyingxenye yeqembu lemigulukudu, bamkhuza.UNksz Nzimande bebethi uma bembuza ngalokhu obekushiwo ngegama lakhe, aphike athi akayazi le nto eshiwo ngaye.Umchaze njengomntwana obevame ukuzithulela, ekhonze ukuhleka bese eba nenqwaba yabangani.Umakhelwane, uNksz Jabulisile Ngidi, naye uhambe emazwini omndeni ethi bayezwa nje kuthiwa ubeyinkinga, bona bamazi eyingane ezilungele."Mina nginesitolo ngiyadayisa, bengikhululekile, ngazi ukuthi ngiphephile. Siyadideka uma kuthiwa umphakathi uyakhala ngoba asimazi ewuhlupho thina uMnqobi, ingane le ekhule phambi kwethu,” kusho uNksz Ngidi.Amaphoyisa awaphefumulanga ngalolu daba, kepha iphoyisa elingagunyaziwe ukukhuluma nabezindaba lithe abomthetho bebegwema ukuthi kugcine kunesimo esingalawuleki sokuqhunyiswa kwezibhamu nokushiswa kwezimoto ezebiwe uma kufe isigebengu.
ISABISA ngombhikisho ngokugqoza kwezindawo zokuhlala ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme inhlangano yezitshudeni, i-Sasco.Le nhlangano ithe le nkinga yaminyaka yonke, ayifuni ukuxazululeka kuleli.UMengameli we-Sasco, u-Alungile Kamtshe, uthe inkinga ibhekene nezitshudeni ezweni lonke.Ukhale ngesikhwama i-National Students’ Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS), wathi asisheshi siphendule izitshudeni ezithole uxhaso."Sinenkinga yokushoda kwezindawo zokuhlala ezikhungweni zakuleli. Iqiniso lithi izitshudeni seziqalile zilala endle, ezinye zilala emaphaseji ezikhungo ngoba zishoda ngendawo yokuhlala,” kusho uKamtshe.Uthe ngenye yezinto abaxoxe ngazo emhlanganweni wesigungu esiphezulu senhlangano, osongwe izolo.Uqhube wathi bafuna umhlangano noNgqongqoshe wezeMfundo ePhakeme, uDkt Nobuhle Nkabane, ngale nkinga."Inkinga isazokhula ngoba kusaqala ukubhalisa. Sizongena emgwaqweni uma le nkinga igcina ingaxazululeki. I-NSFAS yaqala uhlelo lokuthi ikhethe izindawo ezithile zokuhlala, kwazona ezingenele,” kusho uKamtshe.Le nkinga yokuntuleka kwezindawo zokuhlala isiphenduke insakavukela minyaka yonke.Nyakenye, izinkumbi zezitshudeni zagcina sezilala endle ngoba zixoshwe omastende abangakhokhelwe.Kwenzeka lokhu nje, kunomsindo phakathi kwenhlangano ehlinzeka ngezindawo zokuhlala ne-NSFAS.Le nhlangano ikhala ngokuthi i-NSFAS ikweleta le nhlangano u-R44 million, wanyakenye ongakhokhiwe. I-NSFAS ithi isacubungula ukuthi kumele yini ikhokhe.Abale nhlangano basabisa ngokuthi omastende bazophoqeleka ukuthi bazikhombe indlela izitshudeni ezingakhokheliwe yi-NSFAS.I-NSFAS isanda kuxwayisa omastende ukuthi bayeke ukufuna imali yerenti kwizitshudeni ezisalinde ukukhokhelwa yilesi sikhwama.Lesi sikhwama sithe uma kwenzeka isitshudeni siphucwa uxhaso yi-NSFAS ngoba sixhaswe kungafanele, leso sitshudeni ngeke sithwale ijoka lokukhokha irenti ngezinyanga esizihlalile kuleyo ndawo. Siphinde saxwayisa labo abazongena ezindaweni zokuhlala ngaphandle kokugunyazwa yi-NSFAS, ukuthi kumele bazi ukuthi lesi sikhwama singanquma ukungasikhokhi leso sikweletu."Lesi sikweletu sizowela ezandleni zesitshudeni,” kusho i-NSFAS.Izinhlangano zezitshudeni zazihlabe ikhwelo lokuthi le nkinga ingaziphindi kulo nyaka kodwa kubukeka umlando uzoziphinda futhi nakulokhu.
UBUHIXIHIXI bokubhaliswa kwezithunywa bubambezele ukuqala kwengqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi be-ANC Youth League (ANCYL) KwaZulu-Natal.Le ngqungquthela obekuhlelwe ukuthi iqale ngoLwesihlanu ize yaqala ngeSonto ntambama. Bekufanele kube usuku lokugcina lwale ngqungquthela ebanjelwe eGreyville Racecourse. Ingqungquthela ivulwe ngokusemthethweni uNobhala Jikelele we-ANCYL, uMnuz Muntuwoxolo Ngudle.Okhulumela ithimba kesikhashana elihola i-ANCYL KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Kwanda Zungu, uthe kube nenkinga ngesikhathi kubhaliswa izithunywa nokwenze ukuthi ingqungquthela ingaqali ngesikhathi."Bekunenkinga yomshini okhipha izingqwembe ezinamagama ezithunywa, ingakho siqale sekudlule isikhathi.”Umbango wezikhundla ushisa phansi kule ngqungquthela.Amagama ahamba phambili elikaMnuz Mqondisi Duma ophakanyiselwa kwesikasihlalo, nelikaNksz Lulama Mabude, ophakanyiselwa kwesikanobhala.UDuma, oqhamuka esifundeni iHarry Gwala, ungumdidiyeli wethimba lesikhashana elihola i-ANCYL KwaZulu-Natal.Igama likaDuma livela ezinhlangothini ezimbili ezibangayo.UNksz Mabude, oqhamuka esifundeni iMoses Mabhida, yena ungumgqugquzeli wethimba lesikhashana elihola i-ANCYL KwaZulu-Natal.Igama likaNksz Mabude lona livela ezinhlangothini ezintathu ezisembangweni wezikhundla.Elinye igama elivela embangweni wesikhundla sikasihlalo ngelikaMnuz Zwelisha Jeza oqhamuka esifundeni iTolomane Mnyayiza.Umthombo ozaziyo eze-ANCYL uthe kusangenzeka kuqhamuke abanye abazongenela umbango wezikhundla."Izithunywa azikaze zilithole kahle ithuba lokuxoxa. Ingakho ubona kukhona abantu abeseka uMqondisi behlukene phakathi. Bonke bafuna yena ukuthi abe usihlalo kodwa bese beyahlukana uma kuziwa kwezinye izikhundla. "Lena into ejwayelekile kwipolitiki vele uma kunezingqungquthela. Into ezokwenzeka ukuthi bazogcina bevumelana, kube khona abahoxayo embangweni wezikhundla. Kusangenzeka futhi kube khona abazovele baqhamuke esikhaleni bangenele umbango wezikhundla. Kuningi okusangenzeka.”Sekunesikhathi eside i-ANCYL ingenabo ubuholi obukhethwe engqungquthelni.Ingqungquthela yokugcina yokukhetha ubuholi be-ANCYL KwaZulu-Natal yayingo-2017.Ubuholi obakhethwa kule ngqungquthela bagcina buhlakaziwe kanye nobuholi bukazwelonke.Sekube nemizamo eminingi yokusingatha ingqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi baKwaZulu-Natal kule minyaka eyedlule engazange iphumelele.
USEMBHIDLANGWENI wokwenza konke okusemandleni ngenhloso yokuqinisekisa ukuthi abafundi baseBulwer benza kahle kwi-Maths ne-Science, uMasipala iDr Nkosazana Dlamini Zuma.Lokhu kuvezwe yiPhini leMeya kulo masipala, uNkk Kholiwe Radebe.Uveze lokhu ngesikhathi lo masipala unomcimbi omkhulu wokubungaza abafundi nezikole ezahlukene zakule ndawo ezenze kahle.Lo masipala uthe ufuna ukuthi abafundi bendawo babonakale benza kahle kakhulu kuzona zombili lezi zifundo.Kuvelile lapha ukuthi izikole eziyisithupha zakule ndawo ezithole o-100% emiphumeleni ka-matric yanyakenye futhi zenze kahle kulezi zifundo. Phakathi kwalezi zikole kubalwa iDlangani High, Dumabezwe High, Siqhoza High, Faithway High, Mqulela Secondary neMasimini High.Ngenhloso yokuqinisekisa ukuthi izikole zakule ndawo zenza kahle kulezi zifundo, umasipala unikezele ngezinsizakufundisa ezilekelela kakhulu kulezi zifundo.LAPHA kungesikhathi kunikezelwa ngezinsiza zeMaths neScience ezikoleni zaseBulwer Isithombe: SITHUNYELWEIzikole ezihlomulile ngazo kubalwa ezintathu, okuyiCentocow High, Dingeka Technical neDlangani High."Sizimisele ngokuthi senze konke okusemandleni ngenhloso yokuqinisekisa ukuthi abafundi bethu bayaphumelela kwi-Maths ne-Science. Minyaka yonke uma sinalo mcimbi siye sinikeze izikole ezenze kahle kulezi zifundo izinsiza ezizolekelela ekutheni lezi zifundo baziphumelele abantwana,'' kugcizelela uNkk Radebe.Kuklonyeliswe nabafundi abayishumi abenze kahle kakhulu ezifundweni zabo zika-matric. BACHONYWE uphaphe lwegwalagwala abaphila nokukhubazeka abebenikezwe uMasipala wasoPhongolo, ingqayizivele yethuba lokufundela imikhakha ehlukene ezikhungweni ezahlukene.Umasipala wendawo wenze indumezulu yomcimbi wokubonga ukuphothula kwabafundi wase ukulumbanisa nokuhalalisela abafundi bakamatric abenze kahle ezikoleni zendawo.Lo mcimbi ubusenkundleni yezemidlalo esigodini saseNtuthuko. AKUCACI kahle ngekusasa leqembu likaNksz Shawn Mkhize nendodana yakhe u-Andile Mpisane, iRoyal AM, ngemuva kokuthi inkantolo ichithe isicelo sabo sokunxusa umlawuli owengamele iqembu nenye impahla kaNksz Mkhize eyashaqwa yiSars, ukuba akhiphe incwadi eqinisa idolo iNational Soccer League ukuthi lingaqhubeka nemidlalo yalo yale sizini.Ngomhla ka-9 Meyi 2024 iNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu yanikeza uSars imvume yokushaqa impahla yeShandi Trust okuyimvume eyaqinisekiswa iNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini ngoNovemba 2024 ivuna iSars ekushaqeni impahla yabamangalelwa abangu-23, okukhona kubo iShandi Trust neqembu lebhola iRoyal AM Football Club okulawulwa uNksz Shawn Mkhize.NgoDisemba 2024, umlawuli okunguyena owengamele leli qembu njengoba lingaphansi kwempahla eyashaqwa uSars waba nomhlangano nabaphathi beqembu ukuxoxisana kabanzi ngesimo sezimali seqembu ukubona ukuthi lizokwazi ukungahlangabezana nezibopho zalo zesikhathi esizayo zemidlalo ka-2024/25. Ngemuva kokuxoxisana, isimo saleli qembu sezimali sabikelwa abeNational Soccer League (NSL).Ngenxa yezinselelo zezimali eqenjini, ngomhla ka-22 Januwari nonyaka i-NSL yamisa yonke imidlalo yeRoyal AM Football Club yesikhathi esizayo.Ngenxa yokumiswa kwemidlalo, leli qembu lafaka isicelo esiphuthumayo enkantolo ngomhla ka-29 Januwari nonyaka lifuna ukuba kuphoqwe umlawuli weqembu akhiphe incwadi yokududuza i-NSL, eqinisekisa ukuthi iqembu linamandla anele ezimali ukufeza imidlalo yayo yeligi. Isicelo siphinde safuna kubuyekezwe isinqumo saphambilini somlawuli weqembu sokungafuni ukukhipha le ncwadi njengesingenawo umqondo nesingekho emthethweni. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, leli qembu licele inkantolo ukuthi iphoqe i-NSL ukuthi ilivumele lidlale ingxenye esele yemidlalo yeligi yebhola neyeNedbank Cup.Ngokwesitatimende esikhishwe yiSars ngalolu daba, le nhlangano, umlawuli obhekelele leliqembu kanjalo naNSL basiphikisile lesi sicelo."Ngomhla ka-5 Febhruwari, inkantolo isichithile isicelo saleli qembu ngokuthi lihlulekile ukuveza isimo esiphuthumayo ngokuhambisana nemigomo yokusebenza kwenkantolo,” kusho iSars ngesitatimende.Ngaphezu kwalokhu, inkantolo iveze ukuthi leli qembu lizifake lona ngaphansi kwesimo esiphuthumayo ngokuhluleka ukuhlela ngendlela ngokuqonda isimo salo ngemuva kokuthi umlawuli ehluleke ukukhipha incwadi ebheke kuNSL.
IKHWELO elilokhu liqhamuka kwabayizishoshovu zezempilo lokuthi uNgqongqoshe wezeziMali uMnuz Enoch Godongwana anyuse intela kashukela, lingase lidale usizi phezu kolunye ngokusho kwabalimi bakamoba i-SA Canegrowers.Bathe akufanele iNingizimu Afrika yeseke imibono edukisayo.Izishoshovu zezempilo zithi njengoba ungqongqoshe ezokwethula isabelomali ngoFebhuwari 19 kumele ayinyuse ngokuphindwe kabili intela kashukela futhi yenabele nakumajusi enziwe ngezithelo.Abalimi bathe ngenkathi kuqalwa intela kashukela ngo-2018, kulahleke imisebenzi engaphezu kuka-16 000. Bathe Imboni ilahlekelwe u-R2 billion ngonyaka owodwa wokuqala."Ukunyuswa kwentela kashukela kuzobhebhezela isimo sokulahleka kwemisebenzi ezweni njengoba umnotho uvele untekenteke. Umphumela kuzokuba wukulamba kwabantu abaningi."Izishoshovu zezempilo zisho izinto ezidukisayo zokuthi ukunyuswa kwentela kashukela kuzonika uhulumeni imali yezinhlelo zokuphakela izingane ezikoleni. Lezi yizinto ezingahlangane,” kusho isitatimende sabalimi bakamoba.Siqhuba ngokuthi kuyimanje isimo sinzima emindenini eminingi eyakhele amapulazi, ikati lilele eziko ngenxa yokuntuleka kwemisebenzi. Kuthiwa iningi lidilizwe emva kokwethulwa kwentela kashukela.I-SA Canegrowers imele abalimi abasafufusa abangu-24,000 nabakhula ngesivinini abangu-1 200 KwaZulu-Natal naseMpumalanga. Laba batshali bangabaqashi ababalulekile futhi baneqhaza elimqoka kwezomnotho.I-SA Canegrowers ithe inxusa uNgqongqoshe uGodongwana ukuthi ayisule le ntela ngoba idala umonakalo omkhulu kunokuthi ibe yisixazululo. Uthe bayancipha abantu abakhokha intela ngenxa yokudilizwa kwabasebenzi, okwenza uhulumeni ulahlekelwe.
UZWAKALISE ukujabula umndeni wowesifazane owabulawa ngesihluku eFolweni, umsolwa owayeyisoka lakhe, elaxaza isicelo sebheyili eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMbumbuluUMnuz Mduduzi Masuku (32) bekulindeleke afake isicelo sebheyili ngecala lokuhlahlela ngocelemba, uNksz Mabongi Mkhize (32) ngoJanuwari 5.Nokho ushaye ungqimphothe, esezwakalisa ukuthi akasafuni ukufaka isicelo sokudedelwa ngebheyili.Ummeli wakhe utshele inkantolo ukuthi emva kokuxoxa kwabo, uMasuku umyalele ukuthi azise inkantolo ukuthi akasayifuni ibheyili.Usale esezwakalisa nokuthi ngeke esaqhubeka nokummela ngokuzayo njengoba bebevumelene ngokuthi uzoqhubeka nokummela uma eqhubeka nesicelo sebheyili kuphela.Imantshi ithe ilihlehlisela uMashi 5, icala lakhe ukuze amaphoyisa aqhubeke nophenyo lwawo.Uyise kamufi, uMnuz Bikela Mkhize, ozizele mathupha enkantolo yize esephelelwa amandla ngenxa yokuhamba kweminyaka, uthe kuyamjabulisa ukuthi umsolwa ayilaxaze ibheyili ngoba ubugebengu benziwa wuye."Uye owaziyisa emaphoyiseni, waze wawayalela ngisho nokuthi ubhushu awusebenzisile uwujikijele kwamakhelwane," kusho uMkhize.Uthe bekusabaxaka ukuthi yini emenza afune ukufaka isicelo sebheyili, ebe eziyise yena emaphoyiseni "ngecala alenzile”, wathi bekuzoba ukuchitha isikhathi ukufaka kwakhe isicelo sebheyili.Uhlabe kwayona eyecala elilokhu lihlehla, ethi akunasidingo njengoba umsolwa aziyisa yena emaphoyiseni."Kwabhulukwe ayeligqokile, elalinegazi, lasala khona emaphoyiseni," kubeka uMkhize.Uthe ubheke inkantolo ukuthi imnike isigwebo esinzima ngobuhlungu abazwise bona."Ufanelwe udilikajele," kusho yena kwananela nomkakhe, naye obonakale elusizi enkantolo.Umfowabo kamufi, uMnuz Phindani Mkhize, uthe kuzomele umthetho usiqise isandla kubasolwa bezigameko zokubulawa kwabesifazane ngesihluku."Isihluku esinje bengigcina ngokusibona emaphepheni, nasezindabeni, ngizitshele ukuthi yinto ekude nami. Ithe uma isibhekene nami ngqo, ngabuzwa ubuhlungu ngaphakathi enhliziyweni," kusho umfowabo kamufi.Wengeze ngelithi abasolwa bamacala abucayi njengawokubulala nawokudlwengula abesifazane akufanele engabe abasolwa bayavunyelwa ukufaka isicelo sebheyili."Njengaye nje lo. Uyena ozivumele ukuthi icala ulenzile, bengisathukile ukuthi uzoyinikwa kanjani ibheyili. Asikho isidingo sebheyili uma kunobufakazi bonke bokuthi into uyenzile ukuze nabanye bezofunda isifundo nakwabanye," usho kanje.Ngosuku lwesigameko umsolwa kuthiwa wazama ukukhuluma nomufi ngezikhathi zasemini kodwa uNksz Mkhize wathi ucela bakhulume ntambama, uma esebuye lapho ayeya khona.Kuthiwa emini umsolwa wayelokhu embelesela ngezingcingo, waze wamtshela nokuthi uyaphuza utshwala futhi ubuphuzela yena.Nokho umufi akazange azinake lezi zinsongo ezitshela ukuthi uyadlala.Kuthiwa wathi efika kwakhe ethi uyehla emotweni, umsolwa wabe emhlasela ngocelemba, emgenca ngisho engasanyakazi.Ngokuthola kweSolezwe, uNksz Mkhize wayenomunye wesilisa emotweni okuthiwa wayeyisoka lakhe, nokho umndeni wakucacisa ukuthi wona wazi ukuthi umufi wayehamba nabangani bakhe ayekade ehlezi nabo endaweni yobumnandi eMlaza.Isolezwe labuye lathola ngomthombo ukuthi umsolwa wayedinwe nawukuthi isoka likamufi elisha limgcone ngokuba nesitho sangasese esincane, waze wabuza ukuthi likwazi kanjani lokho ngoba alikaze limbone enqunu. Nakulezo zinsolo, umndeni wathi awuzazi, wasola uMasuku ngokuthi kwakumele awazise uma benezinkinga nomufi, hhayi ukuthi ambulale.
IMEYA yakuMasipala iBig 5 Hlabisa, uMnuz Comfort Khumalo, idonse abafundi ngezindlebe ngomkhuba wokuthanda ubumnandi baze bakhohlwe yinhloso yokuba semanyuvesi .UKhumalo usho lokhu ngesikhathi kuhalaliselwa abafundi abaphase ngamalengiso izivivinyo zika-matric ezikoleni ezingaphansi kukaMasipala iBig 5 Hlabisa."Ithuba lokufunda liyafika, lidlule bese usala nesikweletu enhlizweni yakho. Siyanxusa ukuba ngaso sonke isikhathi ukuthi ufunde, uqikelele uphinde ukhumbule isimo osishiye ekhaya,” kuphetha uKhumalo.UMengameli we-IFP futhi ongungqongqoshe womNyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana kuzwelonke, uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa, uhalalisele uKhumalo noMnyango wezeMfundo njengoba abafundi abangaphezulu kuka-8000 bethole imiphumela ebenza bayoqhuba izifundo zabo nasemanyuvesi.UHlabisa,odabuka kulesi sifunda, uthe ukholwa ukuthi laba bafundi bazobuya emakhaya emuva kokuphothula iziqu zabo sebezothuthukisa izindawo zasemakhaya.Izikole ezingaphansi koMkhanyakude ziphase ngo- 100% kanti uMkhandlu iBig 5 Hlabisa unikele ngama- vawusha abiza uR10 000 kumfundi ngamunye.UHlabisa uqhakambise iqhaza elibanjwa abantu besifazane emakhaya emuva kokuphumelela empilweni.UHlabisa uthe noma ungahamba izwe uliqede, umuzi onezingane ezingafundile ugqama njengembuzi emhlophe endaweni eyihlungu. "Kodwa emphakathini onezingane ezifundile awubuzi , izakhiwo uzibona udlula ukuthi ikhona ingane efundile. Izingane ezifundile azizigqaji ngemixhaso eyakhiwe emakubo. Yingakho zizinikela ekwakheni,” kusho uHlabisa.Eqhuba uHlabisa uthe amantombazane yiwo ahamba phambili ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi avuse ikhaya."Amantombazane awaqali ngokuthenga imoto, uma ethola umsebenzi kodwa abafana bagijimela zona.”Omunye wabazali, uMnuz Thokozani Mbatha uthe indodana yakhe ibihlezi iyingane ezimisela kakhulu ezifundweni zayo."Ngiyakujabulela ukusebenza ngokuzikhandla kukaThabani nokubayingane elalelayo kanti nami futhi bengimvusa. Njengoba ngizommela lapha namuhla yingoba yena useCape Town eNyuvesi yaseStellebosch lapho ayokwenza khona izifundo zakhe zobudokotela,” kusho uMbatha.

UMNDENI kabhongoza weqembu lemigulukudu iWest Gang uMngqobi Nzimande umcelele uxolo emphakathini, nakubo bonke abonayo, enkonzweni yomngcwabo wakhe.Inkonzo yomngcwabo kamufi, uMnqobi Nzimande (24) waseMzomusha eNanda, ibibanjelwe ehholo lomphakathi iRedfern, ePhoenix, namuhla.Bekuyinkonzo ebingenazo izithameli eziningi njengoba bekuwuhhafu wehholo. Kuphinde kwaqapheleka ukuthi izikhulumi ezimbalwa ezikhulumile bezidle ngokuba mfishane ezinkulumweni zazo.Akusukumanga muntu ngesikhathi sekubizwa ozokhulumela abangani.Inkonzo ithathe isikhathi esingaphansi kwamahora amabili ngaphambi kokuba kuphunywe kuyiwe emathuneni.Udadewabo kanina kamufi, ozibize ngoMakaSmah, uthe kubuhlungu ukuthi bengabazali bayalithwala icala lezingane."Izingane zethu asizithumi. Ingane uma isithi yenza into, iyayenza. Kangangoba uma ungathi uyayikhuza, ingavele ibulale wena," kusho uMakaSmah.Uqhube wathi abazi noma yibo bengabazali abasuke bengakwazi ukuhamba kahle phambi kwezingane.Ugcizelele eyokuthi akekho umzali othi uma ezala ingane, athi ufuna ibe yisigebengu.Okhulumele umndeni kababa, uthe bacela ukuxolelwa."Sicela ukuxolelwa. Ingane kamfwethu lena," kusho othe ungudadewabo kayise.Umakhelwane, othe unguMakaMduduzi uthe uMnqobi uyena owavala ukubanjwa kwenkunzi, sebephelile yizigebengu omakhelwane."Into enhle ayigqanyiswa. Sizwa kukhulunywa okuningi ngoMnqobi. Thina siyamazi singomakhelwane bakhe. Laba bantu abagcwele la, yithi omakhelwane bakhe," kusho uMakaMduduzi, okuthe sekuphunywa nebhokisi waklolodela amaphoyisa.Kuvele ukuthi ubethanda iculo elithi "Isandla Somusa," kanti kuthe sekukhishwa ibhokisi lakhe, kwaqhuma umdanso ongasukumi phansi.

UMASIPALA waKwaDukuza uveze ukuthi usuvale yonke imali ephuma kulo masipala emva kokuthi bethintwe i-ABSA ngokukhishwa kwemali yomkhandlu ngendlela esolisayo.Kuthiwa imali entshontshiwe ibalelwa ku-R35.7 million ikhishwe ngokungemthetho amahlandla amabili okuvezwe umbiko webhange othunyelelwe lo masipala emva kwesehlakalo.Kuphinde kwahlaluka ukuthi eminye imizamo yokukhipha imali eningi imisiwe ngesikhathi uphiko lokukhwabanisa lwangaphakathi ebhange lubuze kumasipala ukuthi unolwazi yini ngokwenzekayo. Kuvele ukuthi zonke izikhulu zikamasipala zisebumnyameni kwase kumiswa ukusebenza kwe-akhawunti ngokushesha.Ngokwesitatimende esikhishwe yilo masipala sithe lesi sehlakalo senzeke ngoJanuwari 31."Uphiko lwebhange lakwa-ABSA elibhekelele ukukhwabanisa luxhumane nomasipala lisazisa ukuthi kukhona ukukhishwa kwemali okusolisayo okwenzekayo kwi-akhawunti kamasipala, sibe sesiyalela ibhange ukuthi lokho kukhishwa kwemali okusolisayo abakumise."Ngesikhathi kuqhubeka uphenyo olwenziwe nguMasipala waKwaDukuza, kuvele ukuthi kungenzeka ukuthi kube nokukhishwa kwemali okungagunyaziwe kwi-akhawunti yasebhange kamasipala, kusolwa nokuthi umuntu owenze lokhu ubehlose ukuphazamisa imininingwane yasebhange kamasipala futhi ephule izinhlelo zezezimali ukuze ekwazi ukungena kwi-akhawunti yasebhange eyinhloko kamasipala," kusho isitatimende.Sithe ngenxa yobucayi balesi sehlakalo umasipala unezinyathelo ozithathile"Ngokuqaphela ubunzima bomthelela walesi simo, izikhulu zikamasipala zibe sezithatha izinyathelo ezahlukene ezisheshayo zokumisa ukukhishwa kwale mali ngokunghemthetho, okubalwa kuzo ukuyalela ibhange i-ABSA ukuthi livimbe futhi livale noma yiphi imali ephuma kwi-akhawunti nanokuthi kuvulwe icala esiteshini samaphoyisa KwaDukuza ngosuku okwenzeka ngalo isigameko," sisho kanje.Sithe okwamanje lolu daba lusaphenywa yibhange okuzothi emva kwalo uphenyo libe seliluleka umasipala ngomphumela wophenyo lwabo.Okhulumela uMasipala waKwaDukuza, uMnuz Sfiso Zulu, uthe umbiko owethulelwe imenenja kamasipala emhlanganweni wamakhansela izolo, uveze ukuthi ibhange lisaphenya ngalolu daba."Asikakabi naso isamba semali esiqinisekisiwe futhi njengoba udaba lusaphenywa nophenyo lungakaphothulwa, ngeke siqagele noma sisole ukuthi kungaba ubani noma obani abenze lokhu. Amakhansela athathe isinqumo sokuba ngaphezu kophenyo olwenziwa yibhange lakwa-ABSA, nomkhandlu kumele uqashe inkampani ezimele ezophenya," kusho uZulu.Uthe amakhansela aphinde anquma ukuthi lolu daba lubikwe eMnyangweni wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu nakuMcwaningi maBhuku Jikelele.Uphinde waveza ukuthi bakhona abasebenzi bomkhandlu abagunyazwe ukuthi bakhokhe egameni lomkhandlu. Uthe ngokubhekelela ukuphepha kwabo angeke bawadalule amagama nezikhundla zabo kwabezindaba.Khonamanjalo: UMphathiswa wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal, uMfundisi Thulasizwe Buthelezi, usigxekile lesi senzo zokuntshontshwa kwezigidi zemali.Esitatimendeni uveze ukuthi ubhalele iMeya kaMasipala waKwaDukuza, uMnuz Muzi Ngidi, ecela umbiko mayelana nalezi zinsolo okumele ulethwe engakapheli amahora awu-48. UMphathiswa uphinde waqinisekisa umphakathi waKwaDukuza ngokuthi uMnyango uzithathele phezulu lezi zinsolo.
UPHINDE wakhala ngaphansi owayengumengameli, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, emzamweni wakhe wokuzishushisela uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa.INkantolo yoMthethosisekelo ichithe isicelo sikaZuma sokuphonsela inselelo isinqumo seNkantolo eNkulu eGoli, eyachitha icala lapho ezishushisela khona uRamaphosa.INkantolo yoMthethosisekelo ithole ukuthi uZuma akazange achaze ukuthi kungani esifake sekudlule isikhathi isicelo sakhe."INkantolo yoMthethosisekelo isibhekile isicelo sokuba imzwele uZuma ngokufaka isicelo sakhe sekudlule isikhathi, yaphinde yabheka nesicelo sakhe. Inkantolo ibe isinquma ukuthi ofake isicelo akazange alethe incazelo egculisayo eshoyo ukuthi kungani efake isicelo sakhe sekudlule isikhathi,” kusho isinqumo senkantolo esibonwe yiSolezwe.Inkantolo iphinde yathola ukuthi mancane amathuba okuthi isicelo sikaZuma siphumelele."Ngakho ke sinquma ukuba isicelo sichithwe.”NeNkantolo yamaCala aDlulisiwe yamchitha uZuma.Akucaci ukuthi uZuma uzothatha siphi isinyathelo njengoba esechithwe inkantolo yokugcina.UZuma ushushisa uRamaphosa njengengxenye yecala lapho ayezishushisela khona umshushisi omkhulu ecaleni lakhe lenkohlakalo nokukhwabanisa, u-Advocate Billy Downer nentatheli yeziko lezindaba elibika ngesiNgisi.UZuma usola uRamaphosa ngokungathathi zinyathelo ngesikhathi embikela ngokwephula umthetho kukaDowner ayemshushisela izinsolo zokuputshuzela intatheli ulwazi oluyimfihlo ngempilo yakhe.Nalo icala lapho uZuma eshushisa uDowner nentatheli lachithwa yiNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu kodwa uZuma usaphikelele njengoba ekuphonsela inselelo ukuchithwa kwecala.URamaphosa wafaka isicelo sokuba lichithwe icala alivulelwe uZuma, ekhala ngokuthi uZuma ulwa impi yezepolitiki.Leli cala uZuma walifaka kubhekwe engqungqutheleni yokukhetha ubuholi be-ANC eyayingo-2022.Kwake kwaba nemizamo yokuvimba uRamaphosa ukuba angawungeneli umbango wesikhundla kule ngqungquthela ngenxa yokuthi i-ANC inomthetho othi abaholi ababhekene namacala kufanele bashenxe ezikhundleni.Nokho uRamaphosa wagcina evunyeliwe ukuba angenele umbango wesikhundla.

Kuvela nokuthi wake wamshisa ngamanzi abilayo."Ubehamba ngezinduku umbulala nje ubesaxhuga. Wayekade emshaye ngoNovemba ngemuva kwalokho wamthulisa ngokuthi uzomlobola ngoDisemba 16,'' kuchaza yena.Uphinde wachaza umsolwa njengomuntu obengadlulwa siketi. "Okunye esikutholile okusidinayo ukuthi umsolwa ubebuye aboleke imali ye-NSFAS kumufi,'' kusho yena.Uzwakalise ukukhathazeka ngokuthi kuze kube yimanje umsolwa akakaboshwa. Uveze nokuthi umufi udutshulwa nje ngayizolo wayekade exabane nomsolwa kodwa akanalo ulwazi lokuthi babebangani.Udalule nokuthi baqala ukujola ngo-2014 umufi eneminyaka engu-17 efunda u-matric. Uthe umazisi kamufi awutholakali basola ukuthi isoka lakhe lawuyisa komashonisa liyoboleka ngawo imali.

Ngaleyo ndlela kungehliswa le nkinga yokugcwala kakhulu.” Inkinga yokugcwala kakhulu kwamajele kuleli yinto okuhlale kukhalwa ngayo.Kukhalwa nangalabo abasuke besatokile nesibalo esiphezulu sabasuke belinde kukhishwe izigwebo emacaleni abo.Umnyango utshele ikomiti ukuthi udinga ukwakha indawo ezoba nemibhede engu-50 000 ngoba izinga lokugcwala lingu-46%.Ikomiti litshelwe ukuthi kudingeka kwehliswe isabelomali sengqalasizinda ngo-R1 billion, ngakho kudingeka kuthathwe imali kwezinye izinhlelo ukuze kukhaveke le mali.UNksz Ramolobeng ukhale nangesibalo esiphezulu sabokufika kuleli abasemajele."Umnyango usazisile ngezinhlelo zokubhekana nesibalo esiphezulu sabokufika kuleli, abasemajele. UXINEKILE ngokwempilo omunye wabasolwa ecaleni lokubulala ngesihluku isihlobo, maqede basigqiba ethoyilethi lomgodi eMolokohlo, eNdwedwe.Lokhu kuhlaluke eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseNdwedwe, izolo, ngesikhathi kulindeleke ukuthi bobabili abasolwa, abazalanayo, bafake isicelo sebheyili.UMnuz Enock Cele ongumsolwa wesibili, okuvele ukuthi uxinwe wukugula ejele, nendodana yakhe uMnuz Sabelo Cele, engumsolwa wokuqala kuthiwa babulala uMnuz Nkosikhona Vilakazi ngoJulayi 21, nyakenye.UMNUZ Mzi Vilakazi ngaphandle kwenkantolo uthe abafisi bathole ibheyili abasolwa Isithombe: ZIMBILI VILAKAZIIsidumbu sikamufi kuthiwa basifaka ethoyilethi lomgodi, base bediliza izindonga, bezama ukulahla umkhondo.Kuthiwa umufi wayenyamalale eya esitolo, isidumbu sakhe esase sonakele saze satholwa ngo-Agasti 24, sesikhonjwa yibo abasolwa.Kuthiwa basikhomba emva kokuthi umphakathi ubikele amaphoyisa ngokuthi kukhona ilungu lomphakathi eliveze ukuthi umufi wabonakala enomunye wabasolwa, wase enyamalala.Enkantolo izolo, ubekhona uSabelo, ekulungele ukuqhubeka nesicelo sebheyili, nokho uMbuso ucele ukuthi kungaqhutshekwa naso, kuze kuba ukuthi usifaka kanye noyise ngoba basolwa ngecala elifanayo.Ummeli wakhe uthe okucelwa uMbuso kunyathela amalungelo kaSabelo njengoba kungaziwa ukuthi uyise, okuthiwa useze walaliswa nasesibhedlela sasejele, uzosinda nini.Inkantolo igcine ilihlehlisela uFebhuwari 14 icala, yathi ngalolu suku, uSabelo uzoqhubeka nesicelo sakhe, ekhona noma engekho uyise.Ibuye yathi uyise useyosifaka esakhe isicelo uma eseluleme, esekwazi ukuza enkantolo.USabelo ubezimisele ngehembe elimnyama elinemikhono emide, nebhulukwe eli-cream. Ubelokhu ezibhekele phansi.Ngaphandle kwenkantolo umndeni kamufi uthe nakuba wazi ukuthi kuyilungelo lakhe umsolwa ukuthi afake isicelo sebheyili kodwa ufisa angayitholi.Okhulumela umndeni, uMnuz Mzi Vilakazi uthe: "Inkantolo ingalinge idedele laba bantu ngebheyili ngoba sizizwa singaphephile.”Uthe njengoba beboshiwe nje, bazizwa bephephile kakhulu futhi nobugebengu endaweni ebebevele besolwa ngabo (abasolwa) bunciphile.
NKOSIKHONA CELEBADEDELWE ngebheyili ka-R5 000 umuntu ngamunye abangu-12 abasolwa ngokuhlahlela abesilisa abahlanu bababulale bebasola ngokuhlalisa lubhojozi umphakathi waseBhambayi, eNanda. Bakhululwe yiNkantolo yeMantshi yaseNtuzuma, izolo.Sebebonke laba basolwa bangoMnuz Aphelele Nhlanganiso, Qondokwakhe Jama, Linda Mthembu, Sibonelo Ntshangase, Mmeli Makhubalo, Sandiso Godagoba, Aphelele Hlengwa, Sipho Manqele, Zanemvula Mlotshwa, Nkululeko Mhlabezulu, Zolani Zwide noBongani Nkabinde.Laba basolwa ngokuthi yibona ababengobhongoza ngesikhathi umphakathi wakule ndawo uvuka umbhejazane ngoJanuwari 16, ubulala abahlanu.Ababulawa kulesi sigameko ngoMnuz Ayabongwa Maduna, Buhle Dweshu, Nhlakanipho Ngubane, Yongema Zingwe noSenze Lemese.Laba babesolwa ngokuthi babegqekeza ezindlini balimaze abantu, bebe nempahla baphinde badlwengule abantu besifazane. Izidumbu zabo zalahlwa enkundleni yezemidlalo yakhona eBhambayi.Nakulokhu enkantolo, umphakathi wakule ndawo ubuphume ngobuningi bawo uzokweseka abasolwa. Ubucula ngaphandle kwenkantolo.Kube nokuhhumuzela ngaphakathi enkantolo kumalungu omphakathi ngesikhathi imantshi imemezela ukuthi bazodedelwa ngo-R5 000.Amalungu omphakathi abezwakala enganelisekile ngalokhu. Kudingeke ukuba imantshi ibachazele ukuthi kungani ibheyili yabo ifinyelela kule mali.Ibatshele ukuthi laba babhekene namacala abucayi okufaka phakathi awokubulala, awokuzama ukubulala nelokuthumba. Ithe lawa macala uma umuntu ededelwa kuwona ngebheyili imali ayibi ncane.Okhulumela umphakathi waseBhambayi, uNksz Blessing Nyuswa, uthe kubajabulisile kakhulu ukuthi ekugcineni bathole ibheyili laba ababesekayo.Uthe ukudedelwa kwabo ngebheyili kubathobe amanxeba.''Sijabule kakhulu ukuthi inkantolo ikwazile ukuthi ibanikeze ibheyili bonke abantu bethu. Lokhu kusho lukhulu ngoba besikhathazekile ngokuboshwa kwabo,'' usho kanjena.Uthe bazohlangana nomphakathi ukubheka umhlahlandlela ocacile mayelana naleli cala.Ugcizelele ukuthi ngabe akuzange kufikwe kulesi sahluko ukuba amaphoyisa aseNanda ayebalalela uma bekhala ngokuhlaliswa lubhojozi yizigebengu kule ndawo.Uveze ukuthi isenkulu impi ephakathi kwamalungu omphakathi nezigebengu zaseBhambhayi njengoba ethe bathola izinsongo zokuthi le mpi ayikapheli, kuseyisiqalo nje.
KUZOTHINTEKA izifunda ezinkulu ezinamadolobha amakhulu KwaZulu-Natal, ngokumiswa koxhaso lwaseMelika lokulwa nesandulela ngculazi i-HIV.Lolu xhaso olumiswe izinyanga ezintathu njengoba lusabuyekezwa, lizothinta izifunda eziyisikhombisa okubalwa neTheku. Lolu lwazi luvezwe nguNgqongqoshe wezeMpilo, uDkt Aaron Motsoaledi, izolo, ekhuluma emhlanganweni wekomiti lezeMpilo ePhalamende.Uthe: "Ezinye zezifunda ezizoshayeka kubalwa iHarry Gwala, King Cetshwayo, Ugu, Umgungundlovu, uThukela neZululand. Kuzoshayeka nabasebenzi bakulezi zifunda ngokumiswa kwalolu xhaso.”UMotsoaledi ubekhuluma ngoxhaso olumiswe nguMengameli waseMelika, lokusiza ezinhlelweni zokulwa ne-HIV.Uthe nakwezinye izifunda ezikuleli zizothinteka ngokumiswa kwalolu xhaso. Uveze ukuthi kwabangu-63 million abantu bakuleli, abangu-7.8 million baphila neHIV."Bangu-15 154 abasebenzi abakhokhelwa yiPepfar ngaphansi kwalolu hlelo. Izifundazwe ezizoshayeka kakhulu yiGauteng ngabangu-6 090, KZN ngabangu-3 079, ne-Eastern Cape ngabangu-1 585. Yizona zifundazwe ezizothinteka kakhulu ngokumiswa kwalolu xhaso,” kusho uMotsoaledi.Uthe banabo abasebenzi abaqashwe ngumnyango abaqhubeka nezinhlelo zokulwa negciwane."Bangu-256 452 abasebenzi abaqhubekayo nalo mkhankaso, awumile lo msebenzi ngenxa yokuthi kumiswe uxhaso lwaseMelika. Isifundazwe esinabasebenzi abaningi abakulolu hlelo abakhokhelwa nguhulumeni baseGauteng kanti bangu-78 685. Kulandela iKZN ngabangu-59 673 ne-EC ngabangu-31 438,” kuqhuba uMotsoaledi.Uthe onyakeni wezimali ozophela bachitha u-R46.8 billion ohlelweni lwemishanguzo yokulwa neHIV."Le mali izonyuka onyakeni wezimali ozoqala iye ku-R48 billion. Uhulumeni nguyena ofaka imali enkulu ezinhlelweni zokulwa negciwane,” kusho uMotsoaledi.Ubalule nokuthi bayalele izifundazwe ukuthi zenze izinhlelo zamanje nezesikhashana ukuze kungabi nezinkinga zokuthi abantu abasayitholi imishanguzo yabo."NgoMsumbuluko sihlanganile nenxusa laseMelika ngalolu daba loxhaso. Sikwenze lokhu nakuba singakayitholi incwadi esemthethweni mayelana nokuthi kuzomiswa lolu xhaso,” kuqhuba uMotsoaledi.Uthe basukumele lolu daba emuva kokuba lezo zikhungo ezixhaswe yiMelika, ziveze ukuthi zathola izincwadi zizazisa ngokumiswa koxhaso okuzoshaya nabasebenza kuzona abangeke bahole.Abasebenzi abazothinteka abangeke bahole abangaphansi kohlelo lwaseMelika, kuthinta odokotela, abahlengikazi, osokhemisi, abaluleka ngaleli gciwane nabanye abasebenzi.

Ngeke kudliwe ungaphelile umcimbi,” kubeka uNkk Didiza.Esicelweni se-DA sokuthi umbutho wokuvikela ungaviliyeli, uthe basidlulisele eMnyangweni wezokuVikela, ukuthi usibheke."Ngokwezinhlelo zale nkulumo umbutho wamasosha uzoviliyela ngezindiza, bese kuqhunyiswa ka-21, ukuhlonipha umcimbi. Sisitholile isicelo sokuthi kwehliswe ukuviliyela nesibalo samasosha ukuhlonipha amasosha asale enkundleni eyibambe e-DRC. Kuzoba nenkulumo mpikiswano ngenkulumo kaRamaphosa, ngoLwesibili nangoLwesithathu, bese ephendula ngoLwesine.” Lo mcimbi kuvele ukuthi kubekwe u-R6 million njengoba nanyakenye kwakubekwe imali elinganayo ukuwuhlelela.Laba baholi bathe abanankinga namaqembu abiza izithangami zabezindaba ethi enza inkulumo ebhekiswe ezweni.Bathe yinto ehlale yenzeka ngakho abayixwayi.
KUTHIWA isifudukele eBhamshela, eNdwedwe, eminye yemigulukudu yeqembu le-West, elidume ngokuchitha igazi eNanda, eThekwini.Kwenzeka lokhu nje, amaphoyisa ophiko lwe-NIU, athele othulini ubhongoza (22) waleli qembu ngoLwesine, obese kunesikhathi emfuna uthuli.I-West okuthiwa inamalungu angaphezu kuka-200 ayintsha, ibhubhisile ngobugebengu obunendlakadla eNanda, Ntuzuma naKwaMashu.Phakathi kobugebengu amalungu ayo asolwa ngabo, obokubulala abantu, ukudlwengula nokubamba inkunzi.Umthombo weSolezwe uthe mane amalungu aleli qembu atheleke eBhamshela ngoMgqibelo."Kuwona kukhona elilodwa esilaziyo ngoba lingelokuzalwa endaweni. Lifike nabanye abathathu esingabazi babulala umuntu wendawo ngeSonto,” kusho umthombo.Uthe umufi bamhlasele emgwaqweni, bamfuna isibhamu abengenaso.Uqhube wathi umphakathi unikele kubo kamsolwa wendawo njengoba bekukhona abambonile kubulawa umuntu."Kuthiwa uvele wawutshela emehlweni umphakathi ukuthi uzongena endlini aphume nesibhamu. Kuvele kwahlakazeka inqwaba,” kusho umthombo.Udalule ukuthi lo msolwa, wayehambe endaweni, ebulale umuntu.Uthe umphakathi ukhathazekile ngokubuya kwakhe neminye imigulukudu engaziwa.Ngokuthola kweSolezwe, le migulukudu isenezinsukwana ifikile kule ndawo kodwa isiqalile ukuhlalisa lubhojozi umphakathi.Ubhongoza, okuvela ukuthi ungowokuzalwa eNanda, eNewtown C, uyamaniswa noxhaxha lwamacala abucayi, okukhona kuwo nangu-10 okubulala.Phakathi kwawo kuthiwa kukhona ayisihlanu okubulala ebebelwa nobugebengu. Kubona kukhona nowayeyilungu leNtuzuma Neighbourhood Watch, uMnuz Mzwandile Mbambo (6O) okuthiwa wambulala ngoJuni nyakenye. UMbambo wadutshulwa ebuka ithelevishini nomndeni wakhe. Emva kwesigameko, kuthiwa ubhongoza wayede ebonakala epake imoto ngaphandle kwakaMbambo.Usinde ezigamekweni eziningi zokudubulana namaphoyisa, ezenzeke eminyakeni emibili edlule, lapho obekugcina kufa ozakwabo, yena aphunyuke. Phakathi kwazo kukhona esaKwaBester, eZintombini, lapho okwafa khona ozakwabo abayisithupha, betholene phezulu namaphoyisa, umphakathi wajabula uzitshela ukuthi naye ubulewe kanti ubalekile.
I-IFP ilindele ukuthi uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, akhulume ngezinhlelo zokusiza ibhange Ithala, elisengozini yokuthi livalwe uma esethula inkulumo ebhekiswe esizweni eCity Hall, eKapa.Leli qembu lithe leli bhange selisebenze iminyaka litakula osomabhizinisi abamnyama.Okhulumela i-IFP uMnuz Mkhuleko Hlengwa, uthe bathemba ukuthi uRamaphosa uzoyithinta eyeThala uma esethula inkulumo yakhe yokuqala, engumholi kahulumeni wokubambisana kwamaqembu."Simile ekutheni sifuna liqhubeke nokusebenza leli bhange eselisize inqwaba yabamnyama. Sifuna liguqulwe lisebenze njengebhange elifana namanye,” kusho uHlengwa.Leli qembu lilwa nokuthi lingavalwa ibhange okuyimpi esingenwe nayiSilo samaBandla, uMisuZulu kaZwelithini.UHlengwa uthe njengoba beyingxenye kahulumeni wokubambisana basamile ekufezeni izethembiso abazenza ngesikhathi bekhankasela ukhetho."Sizolokhu siyigcine injalo i-IFP noma siyingxenye kahulumeni. Sisebenza ngamandla ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bayazithola izidingo,” kuqhuba uHlengwa.Uthe balindele ukuthi uRamaphosa athule umhlahlandlela ocacile ngezinselelo ezibhekene nomphakathi."Silindele ukuthi ayithinte eyokwakha amathuba emisebenzi, eyokukhulisa umnotho, eyokwehlisa indlala kanjalo nezinye izinto ezibalulekile ebantwini. Abantu bathwele kanzima ngakho silindele ukuthi akhulume ngokwehlisa izinga lokungalingani.” Uthe balinde nokuzwa ngezinhlelo zokulwa nenkohlakalo ezinhlakeni ezehlukene kuhulumeni."Sizimisele ukuqhubeka nokubambisana kuhulumeni ukuze uma kunezinkinga zixazululwe ngokushesha. Sizoqhubeka nokuqinisekisa ukuthi okuyizimfuno zabantu kuyafezeka,” usho kanje.Khonamanjalo, umholi we-DA uMnuz John Steenhuisen, uncome igalelo longqongqoshe baleli qembu kuhulumeni wokubambisana.Uthe mkhulu umehluko abawenzile ezinyangeni eziyisikhombisa bephethe iminyango ehlukene kuhulumeni.Ugxeke imithetho esayinwe nguRamaphosa, edala ukuthi kube nokungqubuzana phakathi kwaleli qembu ne-ANC.Ubalule umthetho womshwalense wezempilo i-National Health Insurance (NHI), nowokubuyiswa komhlaba, athe ukusayinwa kwayo kudala uqhekeko."Le mithetho okubalwa nowe-BEE, uhlomulisa kuphela obhululu, ushiye ngaphandle abantu abajwayelekile. Kumele osomabhizinisi batshale imali emiphakathini abasebenza kuyona.” Uthe bazimisele ngokuthi uqhubeke uhulumeni wokubambisana, kodwa bayayichitha i-NHI nomthetho wokubuyiswa komhlaba."Sifuna ama-medical aid aqhubeke ngendlela enza ngayo manje. Umthetho wokuthathwa komhlaba kumele ubuyele ezithebeni zePhalamende. Abantu banelungelo lokuthi bagcine umhlaba wabo,” kusho uSteenhuisen.

IZINSONGO zikaMengameli waseMelika, uDonald Trump, zokunswinya elakuleli kanye nokushona kwamasosha akuleli empini eseDemocratic Republic of Congo (DRC), akuzange kuwaphazamise amalungiselelo enkulumo kaMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, azoyethula ePhalamende namhlanje.Okhulumela uRamaphosa, uMnuz Vincent Magwenya, uthe izinsongo zikaTrump nodaba lwase-DRC akuzange kuwathikameze amalungiselelo ale nkulumo eyaziwa nge-State of the Nation Address (Sona).Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba eCape Town izolo.Amalungiselelo enkulumo aqhubeke ngesikhathi esinzima lapho uTrump esabise ngokunswinya iNingizimu Afrika ngoba nakhu eyisola ngokuthatha ngodli umhlaba kanye nokunyathela amalungelo abathile.Phezu komsindo kaTrump kuphinde futhi kube nenkiyankiya yokushona kwamasosha angu-14 ajutshwe e-DRC.UMagwenya uthe aqhubeka kahle amalungiselelo enkulumo yanamhlanje."Sijabule kakhulu, asiphazanyiswa yilezi zimo eziqhubekayo. Siyavuma ukuthi lezi izimo okufanele sibhekane nazo, ziyingxenye yomsebenzi kamengameli. Kodwa azisho ukuthi sibhekene nenhlekelele. Siyazilungisa ngendlela okufanele sizilungise ngayo kodwa-ke azisivimbile ukuthi senze okunye.”UMagwenya uthe abantu bazobhema bakholwe namhlanje.Uzokube eqala uRamaphosa ukwethula le nkulumo kusukela kwabunjwa uhulumeni wokubambisana onamaqembu angu-10.UMagwenya uthe inkulumo kaRamaphosa izohlanganisa imibono yawo wonke amaqembu ayingxenye kahulumeni wokubambisana."URamaphosa ulalele imibono yawo wonke amaqembu ayingxenye kahulumeni wokubambisana ngaphambi kokuthi ehlanganise inkulumo yakhe. Imibono yamaqembu izofakwa enkulumweni kaRamaphosa. Kule nkulumo sizobona ukusebenza kukahulumeni wokubambisana.”Ebuyela odabeni lukaTrump, uMagwenya uthe basazimisele ngokuba nezingxoxo noTrump, ukuze bamchazele kahle ngomthetho wokuthathwa komhlaba osanda kusayinwa.UMagwenya uthe banethemba lokuthi uTrump uzoza emhlanganweni wamazwe angaphansi kwe-G20, ozoba kuleli.Uthe ukufika kukaTrump kuleli kuzonikeza uRamaphosa ithuba lokuba achaze kahle ngomthetho wokuthathwa komhlaba.UMagwenya uveze ukuthi uRamaphosa usanda kuba nengxoxo nempunyela eyazalelwa kuleli ewumeluleki kaTrump, uMnuz Elon Musk, lapho echaze khona kabanzi ngomthetho omusha.Odabeni lwase-DRC, uMagwenya uchithe eyokuthi amasosha akuleli ajutshwa ngenxa yokuthi kukhona abantu abasondelene noRamaphosa abahlomula ezimayini ezise-DRC.UMagwenya uthe amasosha aqala ukujutshwa e-DRC kusaphethe uMnuz Nelson Mandela.UMagwenya uthe kuzokuba nomhlangano wamazwe ase-Afrika eseNingizimu kanye naseMpumalanga yezwekazi, lapho kuzoxoxwa khona ngale mpi eqhubekayo.
USALE emabobokobo ebusweni nasemzimbeni umfundi (20) ka-matric wakwesinye sezikole zaseHammarsdale e-Unit 2, entshonalanga yeTheku, kulandela ukutitinywa ngamalungu omndeni wentombazane athandana nayo, okusolakala ukuthi bekuyindlela yokumphoqa ukuthi "ayeke ukukipita” nayo.Leli phephandaba lizibonile izithombe ezikhombisa umfundi, esiligodlile igama lakhe ukuze avikeleke, ukuthi ubelimele kanjani ebusweni, evuvukele umlomo futhi enemihuzuko negazi cishe kuzo zonke izingxenye zomzimba.Elandisa Isolezwe ngokumehlele, umfundi uthe isigameko senzeke entathakusa ngeSonto ngenkathi yena nentombi yakhe belele emqashweni ahlala kuwona ukusondelela isikole afunda kusona njengoba esefunda u-matric."Besilele nje sezwa umsindo wabantu bengqongqoza ngesankahlu emnyango befuna ukungena ngenkani endlini yami. Ngiqale ngala ukuvula, ngoba intombi (22) - (eyigagula ngegama), ilibeke ngembaba nayo elokuthi ayifuni ukuphindela nabo emuva, izohamba uma sekuthanda yona."Kuthe ngokuqhubeka kwesikhathi, bebona ukuthi asifuni ukuvula emnyango, odadewabo ababili abadala bentombi yami nonina, baqala ukukhahlela isicabha, befuna ukungena ngenkani, okuyilapho esibone khona ukuthi kumele sivule."Kuthe sengivulile emnyango, bangibamba, bangishaya bengihudula phansi, baye bayophumela nami ngaphandle, bengihlanganyela bobathathu, kungekho nokuthi ngingenzani ukuzama ukuzivikela kuleso simo. Baze bangiyeka ngoba sengilele phansi, sengiphelelwa amandla,” kulanda umgilwa.Eqhuba, uthe emva kwalokho bamshiye kanjalo, bathatha intombi yakhe bagoduka nayo, bayiphuca neselula njengoba kuze kuzoba yimanje akakwazi ukuxhumana nayo ocingweni. Intombi leyo ayisafundi yona, yawuqeda ngo-2021 u-matric. "Okunye okungiphathe kabi kakhulu wukuthi abangilimazanga nje kuphela, kepha bacekele phansi umfaniswano wami wesikole, futhi baklebhula nezincwadi zami zesikole, engingazi ukuthi kuhlangana kanjani nokuthandana kwami nengane yabo noma yakwabo. Ngiphatheke kabi ngokungehlele,” usho kanje.Kuthintwa omunye wabazali bomfundi, usiqinisekisile isigameko. Uthe okumphathe kabi kakhulu ngalokhu wukuthi yomibili imindeni iyazi ngokuthandana kwezingane, osekuyiminyaka emithathu zithandana. Uthe ubengalindele ukuthi uma kunenkinga izobonakala kanjena.Uthe: "Bekungangcono ukube beze kithina bazali bomfana basibikele uma kukhona okungabagculisi noma okubaphethe kabi ukuze kubonakale ukuthi kulungiswa kanjani, hhayi ukuthi benze izinto ngodlame olunjena. Ukuba kuya ngami bengizothi umfana wami akahlukane nale ntombi ukuze kube nokuthula, ngoba kuyacaca ukuthi abasafuni ukuthi athandane nayo.”Kuthintwa okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uConstable Thenjiswa Ngcobo uthe amaphoyisa aselokishini iMpumalanga aphenya amacala okushaya nokucekela phansi impahla, mayelana nesigameko sokushaywa komfundi ngabantu abaziyo nabaziwayo endaweni ahlala kuyona. Uthe okwamanje akukaboshwa muntu, basaphenya ngesehlo.

UMUNYU nesililo umndeni wowesilisa oneminyaka engu-32 ubudala, uthola isidumbu sakhe sidindilizile sigcwele igazi ngoLwesithathu ekuseni, ngemuva kokubhiyozela usuku lwakhe lokuzalwa.Ngokubika kwabeReaction Unit South Africa (RUSA) ababizwe ngamalungu omndeni sekonakele, umufi ubezalwa ngoLwesihlanu, abangani bakhe bamhlelela umcimbi ngeSonto, eTafuleni, eNanda.Kubikwa ukuthi bebehleli emzini oseduze nakubo kamufi, kubhiyozwa kusukela ngeSonto kwaze kwaba wukuthi kuphuma isidumbu ngoLwesithathu, ngo-6.14 ekuseni.Kuthiwa umufi nomnikazi womuzi babe nengxabano, wakhipha ummese umnikazi wekhaya wagwaza usingaye waze wafa.Umndeni kamufi yiwona ozitholele ngokwenzekile ngesikhathi upheka ngemibuzo abasifazane ababili namadoda amane abekhona kulo muzi. AZAZI ukuthi zizothathani zihlanganise nani izaguga ebezihola ebhange elilengelwa yizembe, Ithala, njengoba zingazange zihole izolo yize bekunesethembiso sokuthi imali yazo zizoyithola ebhange i-FNB.Inqwaba yezaguga ebezihola eThala ibuyele emakhaya ilambatha yize bekwenziwe izinhlelo zokuthi ihole e-FNB.Izaguga ezingaholanga zithe zitshelwe ukuthi inhlangano eholela izimpesheni, i-SA Social Security Agency (Sassa), ayikayifaki imali yazo.Abantu ababehola izibonelelo eThala bangaphezu kuka-65 000, okukhona kubo abahola eyokuguga, eyezintandane nesibonelelo sezingane.I-Sassa isanda kumemezela ukuthi izaguga ebezihola eThala zizohola e-FNB njengoba amakhasimende aseThala engakwazi ukukhipha imali yawo.I-Sassa yabe isihlaba ikhwelo lokuthi bonke abebehola eThala abaye kolanda amakhadi e-FNB.Omunye wabangazange bahole oLundi, uMnuz Lungani Buthelezi, uthe uphanjanelwe yikhanda ngesikhathi ethi ukhipha imali ingaphumi.UButhelezi uthe wenza ikhadi lase-FNB ngoLwesihlanu, wathenjiswa ukuthi uzohola izolo.UButhelezi uthe bekunezinye izaguga ezibalelwa ku-500 ezicoshe ubala egatsheni le-FNB elisoLundi."Abantu bebeshaye ujenga, cishe loluyajenga lulingana nenkundla yezemidlalo. Ilanga belikhipha umkhovu etsheni, amazinga okushisa abewu-37 lapha oLundi. Okubuhlungu ukuthi iningi labantu abebemi laphaya bebeyitshelekile imali yokugibela. Abanye babo bebengenayo ngisho imali yokuphindela emuva.”UButhelezi uthe okumphatha kabi ukuthi yena ubevele engafuni ukuhola e-FNB."Mina bese nginesivumelwano nelinye ibhange, bese ngenze ngisho ikhadi lakhona. Ngathi uma ngiya kwa-Sassa, bafike banqaba ukungishintshela kuleli bhange ebese ngilikhethile. Bathi angilinde ngiqale ngihole kuqala. Abakwa-Sassa kufanele basichazele ukuthi kwenzekani ngoba ibona abenza isivumelwano ne-FNB. Lesi sivumelwano basenza ngaphandle kokukhuluma nathi kuqala. Manje siyabehlula isivumelwano sabo.”Omunye, uNkk Ntombenhle Ntombela, uthe kubaphathe kabi ukungaholi izolo."Abanye bethu sebaphathwa izifo. Uyabona nje sivele sakhushukelwa oshukela no-BP. Abanye bahlale kwaze kwaba yileyo ndaba belindile ngenxa yokuthi bebengenayo imali yokuphindela emuva. Kuyimanje asazi ukuthi kufanele senzenjani.”Nasezinkundleni zokuxhumana besisikhulu isililo sabantu abebekhala ngokuthi omama nogogo babo abaholanga.Izimamo yokuthola ukuphawula kokhulumela i-Sassa, uMnuz Paseka Letsatsi, ayizange iphumelele njengoba ucingo lwakhe belukhala lungabanjwa futhi engazange ayiphendule imibuzo ayithunyelelwe.Ithala likhungethwe izinkinga njengoba kunesicelo sokuba livalwe, amakhasimende awakwazi ukukhipha imali.Muva nje uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, ujube uphiko oluphenya amacala enkohlakalo, i-Special Investigating Unit (SIU), ukuba luphenye izinsolo zenkohlakalo kuleli bhange.Uphenyo lwe-SIU luzogxila ekukhishweni kwethenda ka-R34.97 million yokuthuthukisa ezobuchwepheshe.Le thenda eyakhishwa ngo-2020 yanikezwa inkampani i-Tech Mahindra.UNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, ukwamukele ukujutshwa kwe-SIU.UNtuli uthe unethemba lokuthi uphenyo lwe-SIU luzoholela ekutheni bathathelwe izinyathelo abathinteka enkohlakalweni.Ithala linamakhasimende angaphezu kuka-250 000.ISIU izophinde iphenye izinsolo zenkohlakalo kuMasipala iGreater Kokstad.
