Uma kuwukuthi asazoqhubeka ahlale, yini azoyihlalela laphaya ikakhulukazi emva kwale nto embi kangaka esanda kwehla?”Ilungu le-MK, uNkk Mabel Rweqana, libuze ukuthi yini inhloso yokujutshwa kwamasosha akuleli e-DRC."Sitshelwa ukuthi amasosha ethu ayogcina ukuthula e-DRC kodwa siwabona eselwa namanye amasosha. Yini lena abayoyivikela e-DRC? Nihlezi nisitshela ukuthi ayikho imali uma kufuneka ukuthi kuthuthukiswe abantu kodwa ninayo imali yokuthumela amasosha ukuba ayovikela izimayini.”Ilungu le-FF Plus, uNksz Tamarin Breedt, libuze ukuthi kuyiqiniso yini ukuthi amasosha akuleli ajutshwa e-DRC ngenxa yokuthi uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, noma abantu asondelene nabo bayahlomula ezimayini ezise-DRC?UNksz Breedt ufune nokwazi ukuthi ngabe amasosha alimala ayaluthola yini usizo olwanele lwezempilo.UNkk Motshekga uthe akusilona iqiniso ukuthi amasosha ajutshwa e-DRC ngenxa yokuthi uRamaphosa noma asondelene nabo bayahlomula ezimayini.UNkk Motshekga uthe isinqumo sokujuba amasosha sathathwa emhlanganweni wamazwe ase-Afrika eseNingizimu."Ufuna ukungitshela ukuthi omengameli bamazwe angu-15 bahlangana, bathatha isinqumo sokujuba amasosha ngoba benzela la bantu okuthiwa bahlomula ezimayini? Le nto ngiyibona iwukubukela phansi omengameli bakwamanye amazwe.”UNkk Motshekga uthe ukushona kwamasosha e-DRC akufanele kufake itwetwe kubantu bakuleli, wathi izwe lisaphephile.Izidumbu zamasosha ashonele e-DRC zizolethwa kuleli namhlanje.
ALINDELE lukhulu amaqembu ahlukene ezepolitiki enkulumweni ebhekiswe esizweni, ezokwethulwa nguMengameli wezwe @CyrilRamaphosa, ngoLwesine ebusuku ePhalamende. #SONAIzinga eliphezulu lokungasebenzi, ukukhula komnotho, ukwakha amathuba emisebenzi, indlala esabhuqa abantu, ukuhoxiswa kwamasosha akuleli e-DRC, ngezinye zezinto amaqembu azilinde ngabomvu kule nkulumo.Kulindeleke ukuthi uRamaphosa akhulume nangemithetho asanda kuyisayina equbule imvunge kwamanye amaqembu ayingxenye kahulumeni wokubambisana.Umthetho wakamuva asanda kuwusayina osuse imvunge owokuthathwa komhlaba nezakhiwo.Umholi weqembu i-BOSA uMnuz Mmusi Maimane, uthe balindele lukhulu enkulumweni kaRamaphosa."Silinde ukuthi amemezele izinhlelo ezibambekayo abazozenza kuleli hlandla likahulumeni wokubambisana, besebenzisa isabelomali ukuthuthukisa abantu bakuleli. Sifuna ahoxise namasosha akuleli ase-DRC njengoba kunangu-14 asale enkundleni.” UNkk Khusela Sangoni-Diko we-ANC, uthe nakanjani uRamaphosa uzomemezela izinhlelo zokuphucula impilo yabantu bakuleli.Uthe kuzoba nomhlangano omkhulu we-G20 ngasekupheleni konyaka, ngakho kumele amemezele izinhlelo zokuqhubeka kwezwe ukwenza kahle njengoba libambisene namanye amazwe."Uhulumeni unezinhlelo zokulungisa isimo esithinta abantu abangasebenzi. Eyokukhulisa umnotho ukuze abantu bathole imisebenzi ngenye yezinto ezoba seqhulwini enkulumweni ebhekiswe esizweni,” usho kanje.UNksz Karabo Khakhau okhulumela i-DA, uthe balindele ukuzwa uhlelo lokukhuliswa komnotho ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuthola imisebenzi."Indlala ebhuqa abantu, izinga eliphezulu labangasebenzi nezinye ngezinye zezinto esilindele ukuzwa kabanzi ngazo,” kusho uNksz Khakhau.Uveze ukuthi umholi we-DA uMnuz John Steenhuisen, uzobalula amaphuzu abawalindele kule nkulumo namhlanje.Iqembu uMkhonto weSizwe lihlele ukwenza eyalo inkulumo ebhekiswe esizweni namhlanje kodwa yayihlehlisela isonto elizayo. UMnuz Wouter Wessels we-FF Plus, uthe balindele uRamaphosa ukuthi akhulume ngezinto ezizobumba isizwe ngoba kunabantu abakuleli abangazizwa beyingxenye yezakhamuzi."Uwumengameli wawo wonke umuntu, hhayi oweqembu elithile ngakho silindele ukuthi abumbe isizwe. Sifuna akhulume ngezinto ezizoletha ithemba kwabahlala kuleli, abazibona bengeyona ingxenye yezakhamuzi. Nendaba yokushoda kwemisebenzi, nokukhula komnotho ngezinye zezinto esizibheke ngabomvu.”UMnuz Brett Herron we-Good Party, uhambe emazwini ozakwabo wathi balindele izinto eziningi kuRamaphosa ikakhulu ekutakuleni ababhuqwa yinkemane.UMnuz Athol Trollip we-ActionSA, uthe abanalo ithemba kule nkulumo kaRamaphosa ngoba isimo asikashintshi selokhu kwangena uhulumeni wokubambisana.
SIKHULU isililo kubathandi bebhola ngenkinga yeminyaka yokulinyazwa kwezimoto uma kunemidlalo ezinkundleni ezahlukene kuleli.Ithumba libhoboke ngesikhathi omunye umlandeli efake izithombe ezinkundleni zokuxhumana eveza okwehlele abanikazi bezimoto befica kukhishwe amabhampa nezimoto ezimotweni zabo. Lokhu kwenzeke emva komdlalo we-Orlando Pirates ne-Kaizer Chiefs obuse-FNB Stadium, eNasrec ngoMgqibelo.Ngokwemibiko evelayo, lo mkhuba wande kakhulu ezinkundleni ezifana neLoftus Versveld lapho ingekho khona indawo eqondile yokupaka izimoto nakwezinye izinkundla lapho abantu bekhetha ukupaka emgwaqweni.UTrevor Baker wafaka i-video bephuma enkundleni iLoftus bedlula imoto eyi-VW ikhunyulwe ubhampa uhleli phansi, ihlunsulwe namalambu angaphambili.UMsomi Gasa uthe wake wabhekana nesimo esifanayo efica imoto yakhe i-Toyota Fortuner ilimele iwindi."Kwake kwangehlela lokhu ngiyobukela ibhola eMbombela ngabuya iwindi lemoto liphahlazekile.”UThandiswa Kumbaca uthe bafice imoto abebehamba ngayo igqekeziwe kodwa bebekhona onogada begcwele.UBertie Globbelaar we-Stadium Management South Africa, eyengamele ne-FNB Stadium, uthe udaba lokuhlunsulwa kwezimoto zabalandeli ngoMgqibelo lubikiwe kubona.Uthe bazokuba nomhlangano nazo zonke izinhlaka ezithintekayo okuhlanganisa namaphoyisa e-SAPS bese bekhipha imininingwane eqondile ngokwenzekile.[email protected]
I-MK isiphenduke iqaqa kwi-EFF kangangoba umholi we-EFF, uMnuz Julius Malema, akafuni ngisho nokuthi abe-MK babeke imicondo yabo emingcwabeni yamalungu eqembu lakhe.UMalema uthe indlela angafuni ngayo ukuthi kube khona into emhlanganisa ne-MK useze wayalela abaholi bale nhlangano eholwa owayengumengameli, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, ukuba bangazihluphi ngokuza emingwabeni yamalungu e-EFF.Ukusho lokhu ekhuluma nabezindaba izolo, lapho ebememezela khona izinqumo ezithathwe emhlanganweni wesigungu esiphezulu.I-EFF ne-MK bebengamathe nolimu emva kokhetho lwangoMeyi, la maqembu avota ngokubambisana ngesikhathi kukhethwa uMengameli noSomlomo, ePhalamende.Kepha ubudlelwano bubuye bonakala emva kokuhlubuka kwabaholi abaqavile be-EFF, okubalwa kubo uMnuz Floyd Shivambu, Advocate Dali Mpofu no-Advocate Busisiwe Mkhwebane, bonke asebethole izikhundla ezibalulekile kwi-MK.UMalema uthe indlela angafuni ngayo ukuba sendaweni eyodwa nabaholi be-MK uze waqoka ngisho ukungayi kobuka umdlalo webhola lapho bekududulana izinkunzi zaseSoweto, i-Orlando Pirates ne-Kaizer Chiefs."Asifuni ukuzithola sesizithela phezu kwabo. Kulo mdlalo uthuka usuhlangana nenqwaba yabantu ongafuni ukuhlangana nabo."UMalema uthe nasePhalamende abasebenzisani ne-MK."Into ekhona nje ukuthi bahlala eduze kwethu. Kodwa lokho akusho ukuthi siyasebenzisana nabo. Uma kukhona into okuphikiswana ngayo ePhalamende, asilindi ukuzwa umbono wabo, sisho lokho thina esikucabangayo. Kuyenzeka kwesinye isikhathi kube ukuthi umbono wabo uyefana nowethu."Umhlangano wesigungu esiphezulu kwi-EFF bekungowokuqala kusukela le nhlangano yaba nengqungquthela yokuqoka ubuholi.UMalema uthe banqume ukujuba inqwaba yamalungu esigungu esiphezulu ukuba alekelele KwaZulu-Natal.I-EFF ayizange yenze kahle KwaZulu-Natal ngesikhathi kunokhetho lwangonyaka owedlule.Kubaholi abajutshwe KwaZulu-Natal, kukhona uSihlalo wale nhlangano kuzwelonke, uNkk Nontando Nolutshungu, kanye nobeyiphini likanobhala jikelele, uNksz Poppy Mailola Poppy Mailola."Uma uqhathanisa nezinye izifundazwe uzobona ukuthi sijube abaholi abaningi KwaZulu-Natal. E-KZN, kudingakala abaholi abazosebenza ngokuzinikela. Isimo ngeke sihlale sinje KwaZulu-Natal, zisazoshintsha izinto. Siyabathemba abaholi esibajube. Nathi sizokuba baningi khona KwaZulu-Natal.”
YIZE indawo yaseNanda, idume ngobugebengu obuphezulu nezidakamizwa kodwa konke lokho akuthi ndiki kuNkk Thembi Ndlovu, onguthishanhloko wesikole samabanga aphezulu samantombazane, iNanda Seminary.UNkk Ndlovu onesipiliyoni kwezemfundo, uthe waqala ukusebenza kulesi sikole ephuma ekolishi waveza nokuthi amava akhe yiwo amsize ukuthi aze afinyelele lapho ekhona manje. Uthe into azigqaja ngayo kakhulu ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izingane zifinyelela kalula emfundweni esezingeni.Ekhuluma neSolezwe, uthe wenza ngakho konke okusemandleni ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izingane ezifunda kulesi sikole ziyavikeleka."Isikole engisengamele sisendaweni edlange kakhulu ngobugebengu kodwa senza ngakho konke okusemandleni ukubeka ukuphepha kwezingane eqhulwini. Sinocingo lukagesi esibiyele ngalo nhlangothi zonke. Futhi njengoba kuba nesiphithiphithi ehhostela eliseduze nesikole, saphinde salikhuphula ucingo esibiyele ngalo ukuze izinkinga singabi nazo,” kusho uNkk Ndlovu.Uthe noma kuke kwaba nesigameko lapho kwangena khona abafana ngo-2022, kodwa akekho owalimala."Enye into esisizayo ukuthi kunabasebenzi besikole abahlala ngaphakathi abenza izinto zibe lula kithina. INanda iyindawo enobugebengu nokuletha ukukhathazeka kubazali ngokuphepha kwamadodakazi abo. Njengesikole senza isiqiniseko sokuthi sikhuthaza ubudlelwano obuqinile nomphakathi futhi sibambe iqhaza elikhulu emaqenjini abeka phambili ezokuphepha endaweni. Ngizibophezele ukugcina isikole siphephile,” usho kanje.Uthe uxhaso abaluthola kuMotsepe Foundation lwenza ukuthi baqinise izingxenye ezithile zesikole."Lo mnikelo womusa wasivumela ukuba sithuthukise izindlela zethu zokuphepha, okuhlanganisa ukufaka amakhamera okuqapha eduze kwesikole kanye nokwengeza ucingo lukagesi lokubiya eduze kwalolu olukhona. Ukuze siqhubeke nokuqinisa imizamo yethu, sisungule ukugada okungahleliwe kwe-SAPS kanye nophiko lokuphendula ngezikhali enkampanini yethu yonogada. Lezi zinyathelo ezihlanganisiwe zibonisa ukuzibophezela kwethu okungantengantengi ekuhlinzekeni indawo ephephile nevikelekile emphakathini wethu wesikole,” ubeke kanje.Uthe uzibophezele ekugcineni umgqigqo wesikole usezingeni njengoba wathatha izintambo komunye obese enguthishanhloko iminyaka engu-20 kuso lesi sikole.
AMAPHOYISA aKwaZulu-Natal aqinisekise ukufa komsolwa oyedwa onukwa kwelokugetshengwa kwemoto yemali kuN2 eningizimu yeTheku ngoLwesibili ekuseni.Lo msolwa usale enkundleni edubulana namaphoyisa eGlenwood ngoLwesibili emini.Amaphoyisa alandele umkhondo wabasolwa ngemuva kokuba babaleke besuka endaweni okugetshengwe kuyo imoto yemali nokuyilapho abone khona imoto ehlonzwe njengenye ebisetshenziswa abasolwa emgwaqweni eGlenwood. "Amaphoyisa azame ukuyimisa imoto kodwa abasolwa bevulela ngenhlamvu bebhekise emaphoyiseni. Umsolwa oyedwa udutshulwe wafa omunye waphuthunyiswa esibhedlela enamanxeba okudutshulwa,” kusho uColonel Robert Netshiunda.Uthi uphenyo lokuqala luveza ukuthi laba basolwa bathinteka ecaleni lokubulawa kwabathathu endaweni yaseNtambanana ngoJanuwari nonyaka namanye amabili okubulala enzeka ngoJuni 2024 kuyo le ndawo."Kubuye kwatholakala enye imoto ebisetshenziswa esigamekweni sasekuseni kugetshengwa imoto yemali. Kuthiwa le moto idunwe KwaMakhutha yasetshenziswa kulobu bugebengu yatholakale ilaxazwe eMarianhill kukhona nokubonakala njengezikhwama zemali phakathi.”Uthi amaphoyisa asaphenya ngalokhu.[email protected]
UZWE ubuhlungu obuphindaphindiwe umndeni wakwaCebekhulu oThini eNtambanana, eMpangeni, kudutshulwa kufa izihlobo, usemakhandleleni elungu nalo elihambe ngokudutshulwa.Kulesi sigameko esenzeke ngeledlule, kuthiwa kushone oMnuz Mbongiseni Cebekhulu (53), Mzamo Cebekhulu (26) noBandile Cebekhulu (23).Isihlobo ebesikhona kwenzeka isigameko, esicele ukungadalulwa sithe bebesemakhandleleni ngokushona kukaMnuz Nuh Cebekhulu, obedutshulwe eNewcastle ngoLwesithathu olwedlule."Mina nabanye, besikade siqeda kuhlanza igceke, njengoba besilungisela umngcwabo kaNuh ngesikhathi kufika abavulele ngenhlamvu besesangweni. Badubule babhekisa ngakuMzamo noBandile. Sithe sisamangele, kwaphuma uMbongiseni endlini ezobheka ngoba ezwe isibhamu esiqhumayo, kanti naye bazovele bamdubule,” kusho umthombo.Uthe bonke bavele babaleka bagcwala izinkalo kodwa abasolwa babajaha baze babafica, baqhubeka babadubula.Bobathathu bashonele esigangeni esibudebuduze nasekhaya.BANDILE CEBEKHULUUcacise ekutheni abanalo ulwazi lokuthi obekulungiselelwa umngcwabo wakhe udutshulelweni fthi edutshulwa ngubani.Nokho uthe abasolwa abadubule abafi abathathu, bebeke bazama ezinye izihlobo esigodini saseNdundwana, khona eNtambanana."Bebeqeda kusuka ekhaya, kade sinabo, base bevalelisa begoduka. Kwathi besesendleleni, bahlaselwa abasolwa, kodwa basinda ngokulambisa. Emva kwalokho abasolwa banikele ekhaya, bafike babulala abathathu,” kusho umthombo.MZAMO CEBEKHULU Uveze ukuthi nakuba bengeke balimise ngesihloko elokuthi bayabazi abasolwa, kodwa munye umndeni osendaweni, obahlalise lubhojozi ngempi athe akazi ukuthi yasuswa yini."Yaqala ngo-2009 lapho kwalala khona inqwaba yezidumbu, nhlangothi zombili, kudutshulwana, kodwa singazi ukuthi kwakubangwani,” kusho umthombo.Uthe ohlangothini lwabo, kwabulawa abayisikhombisa ngalesosikhathi, wathi kulo omunye umndeni akasazi kahle isibalo sabashona."Yayiyimbi ngoba kwagcina sekubulawa nabangahlangene, ababezama ukuyilamula. Kubona kukhona namaphoyisa ayezama ukuphenya ngoba nawo ayengawendawo. Ubukhosi bendawo nezinduna, bayishiya ilenga, besaba ukwenziwa isilo sengubo,” kusho umthombo othe leyo mpi yagcina idamba emva kokwenziwa kwezaba ezithize.Uthe njengoba isivuka manje, isivuswa yizingane ezincane ngoba abesilisa ababeyiqalile ngo-2009, iningi labulawa ngazo lezo zikhathi."Sisovalweni ngoba asazi ukuthi yini esazosehlela. Sifisa i-NIU (amaphoyisa) ingenelele ukuze idambe le ntuthu esiqala phansi manje,” kusho umthombo.Kushaye isikhathi sokushicilela izolo ebusuku amaphoyisa engakayiphenduli imibuzo ayithunyelelwe ngalolu daba.
I-CENTRAL Energy Fund (CEF) egameni loMnyango wezaMandla nokuMbiwa Phansi, iqinisekisile ukuthi intengo kaphethroli nodizili izonyuka ngoLwesithathu.Zombili izinhlobo zikaphethroli u-93, no-95 intengo yazo izonyuka ngo-82 senti ilitha.Intengo kadizili (50ppm) izonyuka ngo-R1.05 ilitha kuthi engu-500ppm yona inyuke ngo-R1.1 senti.Ngenyanga edlule intengo kaphethroli inyukile. Inyuke ngemali ephakathi kuka-12 no-19 wamasenti, kwathi ekadizili yanyuka ngemali ephakathi kuka-7.5 no-10.5 wamasenti ilitha ngokwehlukana.I-CEF ithe intengo kaphethroli, dizili nopharafini emhlabeni jikelele inyukile phakathi kukaDisemba 27, noJanuwari 30Ithe nerandi lehlelwe ngamandla uma liqhathaniswa ne-dollar lase-USA njengoba belihweba ngo-R18.73 ekubeni ngokudlule belihweba ngo-R18.11
AYASHABALALA amathemba okuthi sizoba ngcono isimo sezezimali esibhekene noMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, njengoba sekusele izinyanga ezimbili kuqale unyakamali omusha.Leli themba liqedwe wuhlaka lwesikhashana lwesabelomali sonyakamali ozoqala ngo-Ephreli nonyaka, oluveza ukuthi isimo sizocishe sifane phezu kokuba sizonyuswa lesi sabelo.Lolu hlaka lwethulwe yisikhulu esibambile sezezimali emnyangweni, uNkk Ntokozo Mlaba, asethule eDundee ngeledlule njengoba ikomiti lezemfundo belihambele kule ndawo ukuyovezela umphakathi ukuthi sizoma kanjani isabelo esisha. UNkk Mlaba uveze ukuthi isabelomali sizonyuka siye ku-R65 billion, kodwa kusenomgodi olokhu wavuleka ngo-2021, wokwehliswa kwesabelomali osekufinyelele ku-R21 billion."Sinezikhala zothisha ezingu-3 829 esingakwazi ukuzikhokhela. Kodwa ngenxa yokuthi bakwi-persal, imali yabo bayakhokhelwa sithanda singathandi, bese singakwazi ukwenza ezinye izinhlelo. Kungabonakala sengathi imali yenyukile kodwa ngenxa yokuthi imali yokunyuswa kwamaholo yangonyaka odlule yayingafakiwe nguMgcinimafa, kwadingeka siyithathe kwezinye izinhlelo ukuze sipheshe.” Uthe ngendlela isimo esibi ngayo, abakwazi ukukhokhela abahambisa izincwadi esikoleni ngesikhathi.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi inkampani ehambisa izincwadi ezikoleni iNdabase, ayikhokheliwe yonke imali njengoba umnyango usayikweleta phezu kokuba yazihambisa izincwadi ne-stationery ngaphambi kokuvalwa kwezikole ngoDisemba."Asikwazi ukukhokha ezinsukwini ezingu-30 ezibekiwe ukukhokha. Sekuphele iminyaka emibili singakwazi ukukhokha ngesikhathi. Asikwazi ukukhokha imali yezikole yama-norms and standards, asikwazi ukukhokhela ugesi namanzi okwenza kuze kuvalwe ezikoleni,” usho kanje uNkk Mlaba.Uveze ukuthi kulikhuni satshe ezikoleni ukuthi zisebenze ngoba nasemnyangweni kunezikhala ezingavaliwe, ngenxa yakho ukushoda kwemali."Asikwazi ukunyusa imali yama-norms and standards, sekuphele iminyaka engu-10 sikhokha imali encane ngomfundi ngamunye uma uqhathanisa nezinye izifundazwe, kanjalo nemali engabe siyayikhokha. Asikwazi ukuqapha ukusebenza kahle komnyango ngenxa yemali.” Uzwakalise ithemba lokuthi uma sekunyuswa amaholo abasebenzi, uMgcinimafa uzowufaka lowo chatha wamaholo ungayekeli kulo mnyango ukuthi uzibonele ukuthi uyithathaphi le mali.Lo mnyango uhlale uphambana nenyunyana yothisha i-Sadtu, abahlinzeka izikole ngokudla abahlale bekhala ngokungakhokhelwa ngesikhathi.I-Sadtu ihlale ivalela izikhulu zomnyango ifuna ukwazi ukuthi ikhokhwa nini imali yezikole.UMphathiswa woMnyango, uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka, uthe kungabonakala sengathi mkhulu u-R65 billion, wesabelomali esizonyuka cishe ngo-R2.846 billion, kodwa ingxenye eningi iya emaholweni abasebenzi.Kule mali kuvele ukuthi ngaphezu kuka-R56 billion uya emaholweni abasebenzi."Enye imali ifakwa ezikoleni. Likhulu ibanga eselihanjiwe ukukhokha imali yezikole noma kunezinselelo,” kusho uHlomuka.Ubongele nesifunda uMzinyathi esiphucule imiphumela yaso ka-matric wancoma nesifundazwe ukuthi senze kahle kakhulu kule miphumela phezu kwalezi zinselelo.
ZINETHEMBA lokuthi umhlangano ezibe nawo noNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, ngoMgqibelo, uzothela izithelo ezinhle ekulweni nobugebengu izinhlaka ezilwa nobugebengu emiphakathini eThekwini.UNtuli ubize lo mhlangano ngenhloso yokuxoxa, kuqhanyukwe nemibono engalekelela emizamweni yokulwa nobugebengu ezindaweni okukhona kuzo iNanda, Ntuzuma, KwaMashu, Phoenix noMlaza.Omunye ongumholi weNtuzuma Neighbourhood Watch, uMnuz Andile Jali, uthe baphume benethemba lokuthi izocabeka indlela eya phambili."Okukhulu kunakho konke ukuzwa undunankulu elikhipha ngomlomo wakhe elokuthi uyazibophezela ekusebenzisaneni nezinhlaka ukuze kuliwe nobugebengu. Siphume sinethemba lokuthi kokuwu-10 esikuphakamisile, kukhona okumbalwa azosilekelela kukho, bese umehluko uyabonakala,” kusho uJali.Phakathi kwezinto ezihlaluke emhlanganweni ukuthi izinhlaka eziqapha ubugebengu zizokwenzelwa uhlelo lokuqeqeshwa ukuthi zilwa kanjani nabo ngendlela ephephile.Uthe kuphakanyiswe neyokuthi zinezelwe izimoto izinhlaka ezizisebenzisa ukuhamba kalula emphakathini uma ziqaphe ubuhebengu."Undunankulu uthe asibhale phansi konke esikufunayo ngokwehlukahlukana kwethu, bese siletha kuye, acubungule, bese eyasinika, angasinika khona,” kusho uJali.Uthe bakuvezile nokuthi bayafisa ukuthi isifundazwe, sikopele uhlelo lwama-wardens aqapha ubugebengu eGauteng, olwethulwa uNdunankulu Panyaza Lesufi. Uthe baphakamise ukuthi uma selwenziwa lolu hlelo luqale eThekwini, futhi kubekwe phambili amalungu ezinhlaka ezivele zilwa nobugebengu, kungathathwa noma ngubani.Ephawula ngokukufa komholi weqembu lemigulukudu iWest, ngoLwesine eNanda, uthe kuchwaze zonke izindawo zaseNanda, KwaMashu naseNtuzuma.Umufi (22) okuthiwa ubeyindlondlo yobugebengu obunzima kula malokishi, usale enkundleni ngesikhathi betholene phezulu namaphoyisa eVerulam.Kuvele ukuthi ubebuya kolanda izidakamizwa. Uyamaniswa noxhaxha lwamacala abucayi, okukhona kuwo nangu-10 okubulala."Ngisho nasezinkundleni zokuxhumana abantu bebekikiza. Bethi banethemba lokuthi kuzoke kushaye umoya ngokufa kwakhe,” kusho uJali.Umufi kuthiwa ubengowokuzalwa eNewtown C, eNanda.Phakathi kwamanye amacala abesolwa ngawo, kwaba ngelokudubula owayeyilungu leNtuzuma Neighbourhood Watch, uMnuz Mzwandile Mbambo (6O) ngoJuni, nyakenye. UMbambo wadutshulwa ebuka ithelevishini nomndeni wakhe. Emva kwesigameko, kuthiwa umufi wayede ebonakala epake imoto ngaphandle kwakaMbambo.Usinde ezigamekweni eziningi zokudubulana namaphoyisa, ezenzeke eminyakeni emibili edlule, lapho obekugcina kufa ozakwabo, yena aphunyuke. Phakathi kwazo kukhona esakwaBester, eZintombini, lapho okwafa khona ozakwabo abayisithupha, betholene phezulu namaphoyisa, umphakathi wajabula uzitshela ukuthi naye ubulewe kanti ukwazile ukubaleka.Isolezwe libuye lathola ngomunye umthombo walo ukuthi ayisihlanu amalungu ezinhlaka ezilwa nobugebengu awabulele kulesi sibalo esishiwo amaphoyisa. "Le ngane ibingazwile. Ibibabulala emini kubuka noma ubani. Kuthiwa nomalume wayo owayeyilungu le-foramu, yaqala ngaye,” kusho umthombo.Uthe izalwa usomabhizinisi onendawo yokucima ukoma edumile eThekwini. "Ibiyinkinga kakhulu le ngane. Kukhona abantu ebibathuthisa ngisho nasendaweni. Ngisho noyise ubeseyisaba kabi, ingasahlali kubo,” kusho umthombo.Ubalule nesigameko sokubanjwa kwenkunzi ematekisini okuke kwadla lubi ematekisini akwaBester, wathi ngisho nosomatekisi bebeyisabisa okwenyoka. UNtuli, uthe lona bekuwumhlangano obaluleke kakhulu."Udaba kwezinsizakusebenza zokubalekelela, nalo sisazoxoxa ngalo kabanzi. Abanye banomcabango wokuthi ukunikwa izimoto, iyona kuphela into engabalekelela balwe nobugebengu, abanye babalule ukubaluleka kokunikwa imadlana,” kusho uNtuli.Uthe into egqamile nacabanga ukuthi ibalulekile, ukuqeqeshwa kwabo ukuze banikwe ikhono lokulwa nobugebengu.
ODUME emisakazweni emincane uMgugundlovu 106.7 FM neMUT Radio, uLungelo "Qhikiza” Zondi, wenze isicelo ebandleni lamaNazaretha nakumholi walo, uNyazilwezulu, ukuba amukelwe njengenkosazane. ULungelo (31) waseWillowfontein, eMgungundlovu, uthe usekhathele ukuhlala nabantu besilisa uma eyothamela inkonzo yebandla ethempelini langakubo eThulani, kodwa usefuna ukuhlala namakhosazane. Ekhuluma neSolezwe Ngempelasonto, uLungelo oyintokazi emuva kokuguqula ubulili bakhe, uthe useneminyaka ekhonza kuleli bandla ngenxa yokuthi uyalithanda kanye noNyazi. Uthe nakuba esamile ukukhonza ngenxa yokucwaseka ahlangabezana nakho kodwa uyaqhubeka nokuphathisa unina umnikelo nokugcina imithetho yeSabatha ngemiGqibelo. ULungelo uthe akucela kubaholi bebandla ukuba avunyelwe ukuba agqokise okwentombazane futhi aphinde ahlale namakhosazane ngoba useyiyo naye. "Nginovalo (lokuvele ngiyohlala namakhosazane) ngoba ngokubukeka kwami nginjengomuntu wesilisa) abanye enkonzweni bazothi angiyohlala namadoda ekubeni mina ngingasiyona indoda. Nabo ngiyazi bazobe besho ngoba bengibuka ngokweso kodwa bekhohlwe uthando enginalo ngale nkolo kanye nokukhonza,” kusho uLungelo owaqala ukwaziwa kuleli ngesikhathi evela ekhalela indoda eyayimbhangqile ohlelweni olusakazwa kuMoja Love, iSiyajola 9/9.Uthe uke wakhonza ethempelini langakubo eThulani, kodwa wagcina esekhonzela ekhaya ngenxa yokuthi ubehlaliswa nenhlalisuthi ebibuye imkluluze kabi. "Angiyi ethempeleni ngoba indawo yami angiyiboni, ngizizwa ngeqiwa uvalo olukhulu uma ngicabanga ngendlela ekungasuka ngayo izibhelu uma ngingabonakala ngise bandleni ngifake umfaniswano wabesifazane ngoba amajaji angasukumela phezulu ngakhona." Okhulumela ibandla lakwaShembe, eBuhleni, uThokozani Mncwabe, unxuse intatheli ukuba imxhumanise noLungelo ukuze baludingide kahle lolu daba.
BAHLALELE ovalweni abafundi basesikoleni samabanga aphezulu iLakehaven Secondary eNewlands, eThekwini, ngenxa yomfundi osatshwayo okuthiwa udayisa izidakamizwa futhi ubhema insangu isidana nomunye wothisha emagcekeni esikole.Kuthiwa lo mfundi owenza u-matric kulesi sikole akagcini ngokuphilisa ezinye izingane kabuhlungu, kepha nothisha ubenza basebenze ngokungakhululeki. Isolezwe liphinde lathola ukuthi lo mfundi usolwa ngokudayisa izidakamizwa isidana ngaphakathi esikoleni.NgoLwesine ushaye kanzima unogada ngaphakathi emagcekeni esikole.Encwadini Isolezwe eliyibonile, omunye umfundi uthe kubonakale "ibhoklolo” lishaya unogada ngoba emcebile kuthishanhloko ukuthi kade ebhema esikoleni. Uthe kwale noma izingane sezibiza uthishomkhulu ukuthi azolamulela unogada kodwa uvele waphuma wazibukela nje maqede waphindela ehhovisi lakhe.Encwadini, umfundi uphinde waveza ukuthi uthishomkhulu ufike emakilasini abo wathi bangahambe bepepeza ngesigameko esenzekile ngoba kasihlangene nabo.Omunye wabazali ekhuluma neSolezwe, uthe uthishomkhulu wakulesi sikole ongowomdabu waseNdiya naye uyamsaba lo mfundi futhi uphinde abandlulule abanye othisha abamnyama."Uma enza izinguquko esikoleni akabazisi abanye othisha, ikakhulukazi laba abamnyama. Ukhetha iphela emasini. Uma abafundi abamnyama bekhala ngalo mfundi ohluphayo, uyabaziba. Sigcine sesimtshela ukuthi angambuyisi lo mfundi esikoleni ngokucabangela ukuphepha kwezingane zethu, kodwa yena wenza okuphambene nehlombe," kusho umzali ocele ukungadalulwa.Uqhube ngokuthi esigamekweni esenzeke ngoLwesine, unogada wesikole ubekhuza lo mfundi "owuhlupho" njengoba ebebhema ugwayi okuhlaza (insangu) ezongena emagcekeni esikole, unogada wamnqabela."Ungene ngenkani njengoba kuthiwa uxhumene nomunye uthisha womdabu waseNdiya abadayiselana naye izidakamizwa - bahuqe nensangu. Lo thisha ube esemyisa ehhovisi lakhe wamvalela khona, kodwa uthe esephuma lapho lo mfundi waqonda kunogada wafike wamgxoba kanzima."Emva kwalesi sigameko, uthishomkhulu uthathe lo mfundi wayomvalela ehhovisi lakhe. Abanye abafundi basibonile lesi sehlo senzeka futhi uma bethi bafuna ukubhala isitatimende ngokwenzekile, uthishomkhulu uyabasabisa. "NgoLwesihlanu, izingane zisibhalile isitatimende esizonikwa amaphoyisa zathi zizomumela lo nogada ngoba uwumuntu olungile futhi owenza umsebenzi wakhe ngokwethembeka," usho kanje.Uthe unogada ulimele kakhulu njengoba nasesibhedlela kwembulwa kwembeswa kuye. Uthe izingane zithukile kakhulu ngokuxhimfwa kukanogada aze agandaywe kanzima womunye umfundi. Lo mzali uphinde wathi abakwasidlodlo bafikile bezothatha lo mfundi bamyisa esteshini samaphoyisa esiseWestville.Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Muzi Mahlambi, uthe azifunakali iziqhwaga ezikoleni."Amabhoklolo asiwafuni. Uma eboshiwe siyajabula kakhulu. Akahambe eyohlala nontanga bakhe futhi siyathemba ukuthi ubulungiswa buzotholakala. Lolu daba sizolufakela izibuko futhi sifisela unogada ukululama okusheshayo," usho kanje.Kuze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela amaphoyisa engayiphenduli imibuzo esiwabhalele yona mayelana nalolu daba.
IZIKHUNGO eziqeqesha amaphoyisa ombutho we-South African Police Service (SAPS) zizokwamukela intsha engu-5 500 kuleli sonto.Lokhu kuvezwe uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa kuzwelonke, uGeneral Fannie Masemola, izolo, esithangamini sabezindaba lapho abezokwethula khona okwenziwe ngamaphoyisa ngesikhathi samaholidi okuphela konyaka.UMasemola uthe lokhu bakwenza ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bayasandisa isibalo samaphoyisa emiphakathini ukuze kuqiniswe ezokuphepha.Uthe intsha ezoqeqeshwa, izohlukaniswa kabili."Siyathokoza ukuthi eminyakeni emithathu edlule, siqeqeshe, sase sitshala amaphoyisa angu-20 000 ezindaweni ezahlukene, ukuzama ukulwa nobugebengu,” kusho uMasemola.Kulesi sibalo kukhona nangu-2 699 ajoyine umbutho ngoDisemba 2024.Uqhube wathi bangu-244 951 abasolwa ababoshelwe amacala ehlukene eNingizumu Afrika ngesikhathi samaholidi kaKhisimusi.Ucasise ukuthi abasolwa baboshwe kusuka ngo-Okthoba 11, 2024, lapho okuqale khona ngokusemthethweni umkhankaso wabo, kuya kuJanuwari 31, 2025.Uthe bangu-4 501 ababoshelwe amacala okubulala nawokuzama ukubulala, kwathi abangu-3 983 baboshelwa amacala okudlwengula nokuzama ukudlwengula.Uqhube wathi abangu-27 640 baboshelwe ukushaya ngenhloso yokulimaza, kwathi abangu-17 311 baboshelwa awokuhlasela."Abangu-4 675 baboshelwe ukuhweba ngezidakamizwa, kwathi abangu-27 376 baboshelwa ukutholakala nazo,” kusho uMasemola.Uqhube wathi abangu-10 042 baboshelwe ukuhweba ngotshwala ngokungekho emthethweni, wathi abangu-1 952 zibakhalele emva kokutholakala nezibhamu ezingekho emthethweni, kwathi abangu-1 380 baboshelwe ukutholakala nezinhlamvu bengenamvume."Abangu-9 540 baboshelwe ukushayela bephuzile,” kusho uMasemola, othe baphinde babopha abangu-25 950 bokufika, ebebekuleli ngaphandle kwezimvume.Udalule ukuthi kusuka ngo-Okthoba 1 kuya kuDisemba 31, bangu-9 908 abagwetshiwe ngamacala ehlukene.Uthe kubuye kwaboshwa nabangu-30, ngokubulala amaphoyisa. Kusuka ku-Okthoba kuya kuDisemba, ayisishiyagalolunye amaphoyisa abulewe esemsebenzini, kwathi angu-12 abulawa engekho emsebenzini.UMasemola uthe abayisikhombisa balahlwe amacala okubulala amaphoyisa, bagixabezwe ngodilikajele neminye iminyaka ngaphezulu.Uthe bavale izindawo zokucima umoya ebezisebenza ngaphandle kwezimvume ezingu-6 547.Udalule ukuthi zingu-2 198 izibhamu ezingekho emthethweni abaziqoqile, wathi kuzona kukhona izibhamu ezincane ezingu-1 731, oqhwasha abangu-154, ezinkulu ezingu-211, bese kuba ama-shotguns angu-102."Isibalo esikhulu sezibhamu eziqoqiwe siKwaZulu-Natal, Gauteng, Eastern Cape naseWestern Cape. Izibhamu ziseyinkinga enkulu eNingizimu Afrika njengoba izigameko eziningi zokubulala zenziwe ngazo,” kusho uMasemola.Isibalo sezinhlamvu abazishaqile, uthe singu-37 658.
KUZOVUSELELWA kabusha isigodlo seSilo uShaka kaSenzangakhona KwaBulawayo, eShowe.Isigodlo saKwaBulawayo sinomlando ojulile njengoba kunedolobha eliqanjwe ngaso ezweni elingumakhelwane, iZimbabwe.Umbhidlango wokuvuselela kabusha isigodlo seLembe uzoqhutshwa izinhlaka zikahulumeni ezahlukene kanye nenhlangano yokugcinwa kwamagugu, i-Amafa Research Institute.Ngeledlule izinhlaka ezithintekayo zibe nomhlangano nabaNtwana baseNdlunkulu kaZulu, lapho kubhungwe khona ngezinhlelo zokuvuselelwa kabusha kwesigodlo.UMphathiswa wezobuCiko namaSiko KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Mntomuhle Khawula, uthe kuyabakhathaza ukubona isigodlo sisesimweni esingagculisi."Umuzi wenkosi lona udume umhlaba wonke. Uzokhumbula ukuthi eZimbabwe kunedolobha elikhulu okuthiwa kuKwaBulawayo. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi uMzilikazi kaMashobane kwathi uma ebalekela izono zakhe lapha waze wayofika eZimbabwe. "Wabe eseqamba umuzi wakhe ngokuthi kuKwaBulawayo, ngenxa yokuthi wayekhumbule ekhaya. Bathi-ke abaseZimbabwe uma sebecosha inkululeko babe sebeqamba idolobha ngokuthi kuKwaBulawayo. Kodwa akusiwo uBulawayo wangempela loya, uBulawayo wangempela ulapha. Kuyasihlaza ukuthi uBulawayo uhlonishwa kangaka emhlabeni kodwa lapha awunakiwe."UKhawula uthe izinhlaka zikahulumeni okukhona kuzo uMasipala iKing Cetshwayo noMasipala waseMlalazi zizobambisana embhidlangweni wokuvuselela isigodlo."Kukhona esesiqalile ukukwenza. Siyabheka ukuthi ikuphi lapho okonakala khona nokuthi sizobambisana kanjani ukuya phambili. Izinhlaka zikahulumeni zizoqoqa izinsiza zokusebenza bese siqhubeka nomsebenzi.”UMntwana omkhulu waseHabeni uSiyanda Zulu, uthe kubajabulisile ukuqala kwemizamo yokuvuselelwa kabusha kwesigodlo seLembe. "Le ndawo isemehlweni abantu abaningi okungagcini nje lapha KwaZulu-Natal kuphela. Siyasibona ke isimo sala ukuthi njengamanje asisihle kangakanani. Isimo asihambisani nombumbi wesizwe samaZulu, asikho ezingeni leLembe, okuyilona esaziyo ukuthi libaluleke kangakanani emlandweni kaZulu.”UMntwana uSiyanda uthe banethemba lokuthi ukuvuselelwa kwesigodlo kuzofukula umnotho wendawo.Uthe umlando wesigodlo saKwaBulawayo unothe udlula ngisho ingcebo embiwa phansi.
I-DA isinxenxe iPhalamende ukuthi lihoxise umbukiso wokuviliyela kwezindiza zoMbutho wokuVikela kuleli, uma uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, esethula inkulumo ebhekiswe esizweni eKapa.Leli qembu libhalele uSomlomo wePhalamende uNkk Thoko Didiza, noSihlalo weNdlu yoMkhandlu weziFundazwe, uNkk Refilwe Mtsweni-Tsipane, libanxenxa ukuthi behlise isibalo samasosha azohambela lo mcimbi ozoba ngoLwesine ebusuku eCape Town City Hall. Lo mcimbi uhambisana nokuvulwa kwePhalamende ngokusemthethweni kanti kuba nemibutho ehlukene, okubalwa nowokuvikela, osuke uviliyela ngezindiza emoyeni.Okhulumela i-DA kwezokuVikela uMnuz Chris Hattingh, uthe inhlekelele eyenzeke eDemocratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), kusala enkundleni amasosha angu-14, akuleli ayebhekene nezihonga ze-M23, yenze babona ukuthi kumele ahlonishwe la masosha ngokuthi kwehliswe isibalo sazohambela umcimbi.Uthe bafuna kumiswe nokuviliyela kwezindiza zalo mbutho kuhlonishwe amasosha atshalwe kuleliya lizwe."Isimo sibi eDRC ngakho ngeke kube kuhle ukuthi sisishaye indiva isimo esinzima amasosha atshaliwe abhekene naso, sifune kube namasosha azonandisa emcimbini ozobe uhanjelwe nguhulumeni nezimenywa. Amasosha ashoda ngezinsiza nokwesekwa ngakho ngeke kube kuhle ukuthi kube nazonandisa kulo mcimbi,” usho kanje.Uthe njengoba kukhona amasosha asale enkundleni, kuzofana nokuthi uthimiselwa ngamathe umsebenzi walawo asale enkundleni."Kuzobe kungasho lutho ukuviliyela kwamasosha ePhalamende ekubeni kufana nokuthi kuziliwe. Akusona isikhathi sokujabula kodwa esokuzinuka amakhwapha sibheke lapho bekumele siqinise khona izinto.”Uthe yisikhathi sokuthi kuhlonishwe kuphinde kukhunjulwe abasale enkundleni."Silinde impendulo kasomlomo kulolu daba. Sinethemba kodwa lokuthi uzokwenza okufanele,” kusho uHattingh.NgoLwesithathu uNkk Didiza noNkk Mtsweni-Tsipane, banesithangami nabezindaba lapho bezokhuluma ngamalungiselelo enkulumo kaRamaphosa ebhekiswe esizweni, nokuvulwa kwePhalamende.Kulo mcimbi oqala ngokuthi kube nokhaphethi obumvu lapho kuhamba khona izimenywa namalungu ePhalamende asuke eshiyana ngomshefezo ngakwezengqephu, kufika nababengomengameli bezwe bakuleli.UMnyango wezokuVikela ugcine uwadedela amagama amasosha asale enkundleni okungoStaff Sergeant William Eddie Cola, Staff Sergeant Molahlehi Ishmael Molahlehi, Staff Sergeant Shwahlane Theophilus Seepe, Corporal Matome Justice Malesa, Corporal Rinae Nemavhulani, Lance Bombardier, Itumeleng Macdonald Moreo, Lance Corporal Tseke Moffat Molapo, Lance Corporal Metse Stansly Raswiswi, Rifleman Sebatane Richard Chokoe, Rifleman Derrick Maluleke, Rifleman Tshidiso Andries Mabele, Rifleman Calvin Louis Moagi, Rifleman Mokete Joseph Mobe noPrivate Peter Jacobus Strydom.
UBUHOLI be-ANC KwaZulu-Natal bubukele ebuholini bukazwelonke bawubambela enkundleni encane umcimbi wokugubha usuku okwasungulwa ngalo le nhlangano.Umcimbi waKwaZulu-Natal ubuKwaCaluza, eMgungundlovu, enkundleni encane kunezinkundla ezijwayele ukusetshenziswa i-ANC uma yenza imicimbi yalolu hlobo.Uma i-ANC inomcimbi walolu hlobo eMgungundlovu ibivamise ukusebenzisa inkundla iHarry Gwala.IBIGCAGCELE esokeni ebaholini be-ANC emgubhweni weJanuwari 8 KwaZulu-Natal obuKwaCaluza, eMgungundlovu izolo. Esithombeni obeyisikhulumu sosuku uNkk Nomvula Mokonyane (iPhini likaNobhala Jikelele, Mnuz Zizi Kodwa oyilungu lesigungu sikazwelonke noSihlalo e-KZN uMnuz Siboniso Duma Isithombe: DOCTOR NGCOBO/Independent NewspapersUmcimbi kazwelonke nawo wawusenkundleni encane, elokishini iKhayelitsha, eCape Town.Lena bekuyiJanuwari 8 yokuqala lapha KwaZulu-Natal kusukela le nhlangano yagileka igoda okhethweni lwangoMeyi.I-ANC yasuka ekubeni iqembu elibusayo yaba yiqembu lesithathu ngobukhulu, isuka ku-54% yaya ku-17% emiphumeleni yokhetho.UBUHOLI be-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, kuhamba phambili uSihlalo wayo uMnuz Siboniso Duma noNobhala uMnuz Bheki Mtolo, kujatshulwa emgubhweni wesifundazwe weJanuwari 8 KwaCaluza, eMgungundlovu, izolo Isithombe: DOCTOR NGCOBO/Independent NewspapersIPhini likaSihlalo we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uNksz Nomagugu Simelane, lithe bebehlelele abantu abancane kakhulu kunalabo abafikile emcimbini wayizolo.UNksz Simelane uthe bona bebehlelele abantu abangu-5 000, kodwa wathi kugcine kufika abangu-25 000."Besithi nje thina sizozixoxela nabantu abangu-5 000, kodwa bantu balapha eMgungundlovu bathi sinamanga, bavele bafika ngezinkani. Abantu abalapha enkundleni kanye nangaphandle kwenkundla bangu-25 000.”UNksz Simelane uthe besaqala ukuhlela umcimbi babethi bazosebenzisa ihholo, uthe baphoqelekile ukuba bashintshe izinhlelo zabo ngemizuzu yokugcina."Ubuholi be-ANC esifundeni iMoses Mabhida basexwayisa ngesikhathi sisahlela. Bathi yebo singasho ukuthi sifuna abantu abangu-5 000, kodwa kungenzeka kufike abantu abangaphezu kuka-5 000 ngoba abantu balapha bayayithanda i-ANC. La matende siwafake manje ekuseni ngoba sibona ukuthi ilanga liyashisa nokuthi abantu baningi.”Amalungu e-ANC aqungele ilanga ebelikhipha umkhovu etsheni izolo.Obhazabhaza bamatende amabili abesenkundleni abegcwele phezulu, kukhona nabantu abebehleli ngaphandle kwawo.Bekuphinde kube netende elincane ebelihleli izicukuthwane.Nokho abantu abaningi bahlulekile ukubekezelela ilanga njengoba abanye behambe umcimbi ungakapheli, abanye bebekhosele ngaphansi kwezihlahla ezingaphandle kwenkundla.Umcimbi ubuhanjelwe abaholi be-ANC ezingeni likazwelonke, esifundazweni kanye nabaqhamuka ezifundeni.AMALUNGU e-ANC abeze azimboze amakhanda ezama ukuzivikela elangeni ebelikhipha umkhovu etsheni emgubhweni wale nhlangano weJanuwari 8 KwaZulu-Natal obuKwaCaluza, eMgungundlovu izoloIsithombe: DOCTOR NGCOBO/Independent Newspapers
UMNDENI wakwaGumede, esigodini saseDanganya, eMgababa, sewuzokwazi ukulala ubuthongo njengoba ngoLwesibili uzofihla umzukulu wawo, uLethokuhle Simphiwe Gumede. Ngokusho kwesimemezelo salo omndeni esithunyelelwe Isolezwe, uLethokuhle (14) uzofihlwa emathuneni asekhaya kule ndawo emuva kwenkonzo ezokuba kwa-No 214730, emgwaqweni uR102 Main Road, eDanganya, eMgaba Area 5 kusukela ngo-9 ekuseni.Lo mndeni bewungasabuthi quthu ubuthongo emuva kokuphazanyiswa kwezinhlelo zawo zokufihla uLethokuhle obefunda uGrade 8 eMkomaas Secondary. Umufi kufanele ngabe ufihlwe ngesonto eledlule kodwa kwaphazamisa ukufika komunye umndeni obusola ukuthi isidumbu sikaLethokuhle ngesawo. "Wabhaliswa ngoLwesibili (olwandulela olwedlule), kwafika umyalezo othi kunabanye abathi nabo banomuntu obalahlekele eThekwini.” Lo mthombo uthe lwenziwe ulibofuzo ngoMsombuluko owedlule, kwacaca ukuthi isidumbu esitholakele ngesikaLethokuhle. ULethokuhle waseDanganya, eMgababa, wamuka olwandle ngenyanga eyedlule kade ezama ukuhlenga umngani wakhe owayegwiliza. Umkhulu kamufi, uMnuz Sindile Gumede, wathi uLethokuhle watholakala elinyazwe kabi wulwandle."Umndeni nezihlobo basathukile futhi akukamukeleki ukuhamba kwakhe umfana. Nokho-ke sibonga ukumthola." ULethokuhle waphenduka iqhawe ehlenga umngani wakhe owayemuka kodwa yena akabange esaluthola usizo, wagcina ehambe kanjalo namagagasi. Ngokusho kukaGumede, umzukulu wakhe wamukiswa ngamagagasi asolwandle olungasemtholampilo eDanganya Area 5A."Zathi izingane zakwamakhelwane zazinyenyile ziyobhukuda. Kwabe sekumuka ingane yakwaMsomi engumngani wabo. OLetho nabanye basala ngenkathi abanye beyobiza umzali walo omukayo, yilapho uLetho aba nozwelo, wangena wakhipha umngani wakhe. Ngebhadi yena akabange esakwazi ukuphuma. Bathi bambona esephakamisa isandla, efuna usizo, ngebhadi bona abakwazanga ukumsiza.""Silusizi emndenini wakwaGumede ngomzukulu wethu okunguyena omdala kunabanye ekhaya," kuphetha uGumede.
INTATHELI YESOLEZWEUMENGAMELI Cyril Ramaphosa ubhekene nenselelo yokuthi ancetheze futhi alume ephephetha kuwo wonke umuntu enkulumweni yakhe ebhekiswe esizweni (Sona) ngoLwesine.Uzoyethula phambi kwezindlu zonke zePhalamende eCape Town City Hall ngo-7 ebusuku.Inkulumo kamengameli ilandela iLekgotla yeKhabhinethi yangesonto eledlule, ebeke uhlelo lukahulumeni lokusebenza lonyaka yize kungekho ukuthula njengoba kunomdonsiswano ngemithetho ngaphansi kukahulumeni wokubambisana kwamaqembu.Umhlaziyi wezepolitiki, uSolwazi Andre Duvenhage wase-University of North West uthe kufanele umengameli akhulume awacwecwe amagama akhe ngoba le yinkulumo yakhe yokuqala kuhulumeni wokubambisana kwamaqembu. Eqinisweni umengameli ubhekene nenkinga yokuthi kufanele acabange ukuthi uzincengela kanjani kwamanye amaqembu ebe eluma ephephetha kwabe-ANC namadlelandawonye,” kusho osolwazi."Izinselelo ziningi kwezomnotho nakwinhlalonhle yabantu ebhebhezelwa wukungakhuli komnotho nezibalo eziphezulu zabantu abangasebenzi. Ngakho kulindeleke ukuba nomengameli akuthinte lokhu okuhlanganisa izinkinga zePosi, Eskom, Transnet nezamanye amabhizinisi kahulumeni. Umengameli uzophinde enabe ngokuthi izokweqelwa kanjani inkinga kagesi ezweni ngokulandelwa komthetho i-Energy Action Plan and the Electricity Regulation Amendment,” usho kanje."Ngeke zisale izinhlelo zokuthi uhulumeni uzobhekana futhi uyixazulula kanjani inkinga yokuntuleka kwamanzi ezweni okucindezela amalungelo abantu nomnotho.”Ubalule nokuthi njengoba iNingizimu Afrika izosingatha i-G20 ngoNovemba - umengameli uzokhuluma ngayo kakhulu."Umengameli uzonxusa wonke umuntu waseNingizimu Afrika ukuba enze isiqiniseko sokuthi umhlangano we-G20 uba yimpumelelo. Inhloso enkulu wukuthi lo mhlangano ulethe ushintsho impilweni yabantu abadonsa kanzima emhlabeni jikelele.”

ZIBAMBE umoya izitshudeni ezikhokhelwa yi-National Students’ Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS), wokuthi zingalali endle ngenxa yokuthi lesi sikhwama sihlale siba nezingqinamba zokukhokha ngesikhathi uma kuqala unyaka. Lokhu kushiwo okhulumela inhlangano yemikhandlu yezitshudeni emanyuvesi, i-South African Union of students (SAUS), uMnuz Asive Dlanjwa, okhale ngokuthi sekuphenduke insakavukela ukuthi njalo uma kuqala unyaka lezi zitshudeni ziba nale nkinga. Usho kanjena nje, kuleli sonto izitshudeni ziyabhalisa ezikhungweni zemfundo ezehlukene.UDlanjwa uthe i-NSFAS kayikakhokheli nenhlangano yomastende abazimele, i-Private Student Housing Association, imali yanyakenye."Njengoba kuqala umshikashika wokubhalisa, omastende kumele bazivumele lezo zitshudeni ezizoxhaswa ukuthi zilale ngoba kusuke kukhona okuphathekayo okushoyo ukuthi zizoluthola uxhaso lwe-NSFAS. Asifuni kube nezehlakalo lapho sithola izitshudeni sezilala endle ngoba zingakakhokhelwa ekubeni zizoluthola uxhaso,” kusho uDlanjwa.Uthe ne-NSFAS kumele isheshise uhlelo lokukhokhela omastende esabakweleta.Usho lokhu nje, uNgqongqoshe weMfundo ePhakeme nokuQeqesha, uDkt Nobuhle Nkabane, ubehlangene nomastende kanjalo nezinhlaka ezehlukene ukuzwa izinkinga ngaphambi kokuqala ukubhalisa.Isikhulu esiphezulu se-Private Student Housing Association, uMnuz Kagisho Mamabolo, siveze ukuthi maningi amathuba okuthi ezinye izitshudeni zizolala endle ngenxa yokuthi i-NSFAS isabakweleta.UMamabolo uthe i-NSFAS isabakweleta u-R44 million, abahlinzeka ngezindawo zokuhlala."Sihlanganile siyinhlangano mayelana nalesi sikweletu se-NSFAS esingakakhokhwa. Kule mpelasonto omastende baqalile ukwamukela izitshudeni kanti kufika nalezo okumele zixhaswe yi-NSFAS kodwa ezingakaphendulwa. Okubuhlungu ukuthi sizozichitha lezo okungaveli ukuthi zixhasiwe, okusho ukuthi zizolala endle,” kusho uMamabolo.Phambilini, okhulumela i-NSFAS, uMnuz Ishmael Mnisi, wathi bazocubungula bonke omastende abakhala ngenkokhelo ukuthi bahlalisa izitshudeni ezifanele bese bekhokha.Kuvele ukuthi okwamanje bamatasa nalolo hlelo.UMamabolo uthe omunye womastende oyilungu lenhlangano yabo, utshelwe okufanayo yi-NSFAS, ukuthi isematasa ibheka ukuthi bonke abakweletayo bafanele ukukhokhelwa yilesi sikhwama.Ubuye wakhala nangokuthi akumele bakhokhise izitshudeni bengomastende uma kukhona izinto ezifile."Imibandela ye-NSFAS ithi akumele sifune imali ye-diphozithi uma isitshudeni sifika sizohlala. Akumele futhi ukuthi sifune imali kwisitshudeni uma sesiphuma endaweni ebesihlala kuyona, uma sishiye umonakalo,” kusho uMamabolo.Ukhale nangesivumelwano esikhishwe yi-NSFAS, esingavezi ukuthi bazokhokhelwa malini."Izidingo zezitshudeni kungenzeka ziphazamiseke njengoba zingatholi uwaya waya we-Wi-Fi lapho zihlala khona noma ugesi namanzi okuwumlibe ngenxa yokuthi akwaziwa ukuthi malini esizokhokhelwa wona kodwa kumele sisayine. Hhayi ngoba sifuna ukukhokhelwa imali enkulu kodwa sifuna ukwazi ngoba amanzi, ugesi nama-rates, kanjalo ne-Wi-Fi kuyakhokhelwa,” kusho uMamabolo.Uthe bazimisele ukuxoxa ne-NSFAS ukuze kuxazululwe izingqinamba ezikhona.

IMPUMALANGA yeDemocratic Republic of Congo enothe ngezimbiwa phansi ikhungethwe yizingxabano zeminyaka engaphezu kwengu-30, kusukela ekubulaweni kwabantu eRwanda ngo-1994.IGoma isemngceleni weRwanda kanye nogu lwe-Lake Kivu, iyindawo ebalulekile yokuhweba nezokuthutha eseduze namadolobha anezimayini ahlinzeka ngezinsimbi nama-minerali adingeka kakhulu njengegolide, i-coltan namanye, okuyingxenye ebalulekile yamaselula namabhethri ezimoto zikagesi.YINI IM23?I-M23 iholwa ngamaTutsi, athi kudingeka kuhlonywe ngezikhali ukuze avikele amalungelo alabo abahlwempu.Bathi kunezivumelwano ezathathwa ezikhathini ezedlule zokuqeda impi kodwa zangahlonishwa ngendlela, igama M23 lisukela esivumelwaneni sokuqeda udlame esasayinwa ngomhla ka-23 kuMashi 2009.Leli qembu ladlondlobala lisanda kusungulwa ngo-2012, lakwazi ukushaqa i-Goma nokuyinto eyasusa omkhulu umsindo emhlabeni jikelele, kanti lisolwa ngokuphaka impi nokuhlukumeza amalungelo abantu. Lokhu kwayiphoqa ukuba ihoxe eGoma, nokwaba yisiqalo sezinkinga zayo iM23 ithola ingcindezelo nokuhlukunyeza amasosha ombutho waseCongo ebambisene nombutho we-UN. Yahlakazeka lapho, amasosha ayo ajoyina umbutho wezwe.Ivuke kabusha ngo-2021, abaholi bayo beveza ukuthi izethembiso abathenjiswa zona kazigcinwanga.ITHINTEKA KANJANI IRWANDA KULE MPI?Phambilini, izwe elingumakhelwane iRwanda, laphika ukuthi leseka i-M23, kodwa uhulumeni waseDR Congo, i-USA neFrance bahlonze iRwanda njengeyeseka leli qembu. Ngonyaka odlule, umbiko wongoti be-UN wathi amasosha aseRwanda afinyelela ku-4 000 ayelwa ehambisana neM23.NGOBANI ABASIZA UHULUMENI?Ibutho elaziwa nge-Monusco lakhiwe ngamasosha angaphezu kwe-10 000, lisebenza njengeForce Intervention Brigade kuphela evunyelwe ukwenza imisebenzi ehlasela amaqembu ahlomile. Yiwo lo mbutho owasiza ukunqoba i-M23 ngo-2013. IMonusco isebenza ngokubambisana neSouthern African Development Community (Sadc), okuyinhlangano yamazwe angu-16, nayo ithumele amasosha empumalanga ye-DR Congo, kodwa yehlulekile ukumisa amavukelambuso.IMPI yaseDRC iqhathe uRamaphosa nozakwabo waseRwandaINingizimu Afrika ilahlekelwe amasosha angu-13 abulewe ngesikhathi elwa namavukelambuso ezama ukuvimba ukuhlasela eGoma. Kuphinde kwabulawa amasosha amathathu aseMalawi. I-UN iveze ukuthi i-Uruguay ilahlekelwe ngelinye lamasosha ayo eliyingxenye yebutho leMonusco.Ngemuva kwezindaba zokubulawa kwamasosha akuleli, uMengameli uCyril Ramaphosa noMengameli waseRwanda, uPaul Kagame, babe nezingxoxo esithe ngesimo saseDRC okugcine sekuvela ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ukuthi uKagame akaneme ngokushiwo uRamaphosa nezikhulu zikahulumeni kwabezindaba ngengxoxo yabo.UKagame uthe uRamaphosa akwenzile wukucela kuye: "uxhaso ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi umbutho aseNingizimu Afrika unogesi owanele, ukudla namanzi, okuyinto esizosiza siyikhulume.”UKagame uthe osekukhulunywe ngezingxoxo zakhe noRamaphosa kwabezindaba yizikhulu zaseNingizimu Afrika kanye noRamaphosa uqobo, "kunokuhlanekezela okuningi, ukuhlasela ngamabomu, ngisho namanga".Ubukeka ecasulwe kakhulu wuhulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika othi iRwanda yeseka iM23 nokuthi iM23 neRwanda yibo abasuse impi yakamuva ngokuhlasela ithimba leSouthern African Development Community (SADC) (SAMIDRC) amasosha e-SANDF ayingxenye yawo, nakuba amanye esembuthweni we-UN ogcina ukuthula iMonusco. UKagame uphinde wacasulwa ukuthi izikhulu zaseNingizimu Afrika zichaza iSAMIDRC "njengebutho lokugcina ukuthula”.UKagame uthe: "Okushiwo ngalezi zingxoxo kwabezindaba yizikhulu zaseNingizimu Afrika kanye noMengameli Ramaphosa uqobo kuqukethe ukuhlanekezela okuningi, ukuhlasela ngamabomu, ngisho namanga. Uma inkulumo ishintsha kangaka kusukela engxoxweni ukuya esitatimendeni somphakathi, kusho lukhulu mayelana nokuphathwa kwezindaba ezibaluleke kangaka."Ulwazi lutholakale BBCAfricaSilandele kuzo zonke izinkundla zokuxhumana uzithole zishisa kweliwela umfula ugcwele
INKANTOLO ibigcwele phama. Emagcekeni eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini bekuphithizela abalandeli be-MK Party, beviliyela sakuqholosha. Nemibala yaleli qembu elinonyaka bekuyiyo egqamile ngaphakathi nangaphandle kwenkantolo. Ngaphakathi ku-Court 12, ibhentshi elingemuva kukaNkk Duduzile Zuma Sambudla beligqishe osondonzima baleli qembu. Bekukhona kubo uyise kaDudu, ehleli noSihlalo we-MKP uMnuz Nathi Nhleko noNobhala Jikelele uFloyd Shivambu namanye amalungu esigungu esikhulu sikazwelonke. Kukule nkantolo yeMantshi lapho aqala khona kugqigqa izinkantolo uMengameli we-MKP uMsholozi, ongubaba kaDudu. SEKUQUBUKE okukhulu ukungezwani engxenyeni yomphakathi waseZibomvu, eMondlo, KwaZulu-Natal, ngenxa yokugconana kwamanye amalungu akhona, ethukana ngezifo ezithile osekutholakale ukuthi aphila nazo.Lokho kuthiwa kudalwe wukusabalala nokusaphazeka kwamafayela eziguli zakomunye wemitholampilo yakule ndawo, eSiyakhathala okukholakala ukuthi kudalwe "wukuba budedengu” kwabasebenzi bakhona.Umthombo weSolezwe odonse intatheli ngendlebe ukuthi ingalivezi nangephutha igama lawo, uthe isisusa sale nkinga eyenzeke emasontweni amabili edlule, bude buduze nalo mtholampilo, kwatholakala amafayela eziguli esaphazekile."Kuqale kanjalo-ke abantu bezitapela amafayela eziguli ezithile zakhona endaweni, kwaze kwafika lapho abanye emphakathini sebegconana ngakho lokho ngoba bazi ukuthi umuntu unesifo esithile. Singamalungu omphakathi sikhathazekile ngokuthi uma lesi simo siqhubeka kanjena, le nto ingagcina ibhebhethekisa udlame nokungezwani emalungwini omphakathi,” kusho umthombo.Uqhuba, uthe ngendlela isimo esesishube ngayo endaweni, udaba seluze lwangenelwa nawubuholi bomphakathi kodwa izingxoxo zafika kwangqingethe ngenxa yokuthi akulula ukuphuca abantu amafayela, njengoba abe maningi kakhulu futhi akwaziwa ukuthi ingxenye yawo ikobani.Kuthintwa isazi sezomthetho esizimele, u-Advocate Mpumelelo Zikalala, sithe wumsebenzi wawo wonke umuntu obhekelele imininingwane yeziguli ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ayifinyeleleli emehlweni, ezindlebeni nasezandleni zabantu abangafanele. UZikalala uthe umthetho olawula ukusebenza kwezikhungo zezempilo nomthetho ovikela imininingwane yabantu i-Protection of Personal Information Act yango-2013, akukuvumeli ukuthi abesebenzi bezikhungo zezempilo benze iphutha elinjena."Ngakho kungaba yiphutha elikhulu ukuthi imininingwane ebucayi njengalena ifinyelele ebantwini okungafanele ukuthi ifinyelele kubona. Esimweni esinjena lapho sekwenzeke iphutha elinjena khona, lowo othintekayo noma obona ukuthi ilungelo lakhe lihlukunyeziwe, angabhalalela isikhungo sezempilo esithintekayo, noma athathe izinyathelo zomthetho. "Nokuthi-ke uma sekunjena, kusuke sekukuncane kakhulu okungenziwa ukulungisa omonakalo owenzekile, ngaphandle kokuthi abesikhungo esithintekayo baxolise kwabathintekayo, bazibophezele ukungaliphindi iphutha elinjena,” kusho uZikalala. Imizamo yokuthinta ikhansela lakule ndawo, uMnuz Linda Mtshali, ayiphumelelanga njengoba ucingo lwalo belukhala umlibe, lungabanjwa futhi langawuphendula umyalezo elithunyelelwe nge-WhatsApp.Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMpilo esifundazweni, uMnuz Nathi Olifant, uthembise ukubuyela entathelini uma sekukhona angakuphawula ngalolu daba.

Bamfice umama elele ephaseji, ingane ilele ezinyaweni zakhe ngenxa yokuthi yakhala yaze yazumeka kuye,” kuchaza uNelo.Uthe okubaxaka kakhulu ukungathathwa kwezinto ezisendlini, nokuveza ngokusobala ukuthi umbulali ubehlose impilo kanina."Ekhaya kwakhe kwangena izigebengu kudala kwaba khona ezikuthathayo, kodwa kulokhu ngisho ucingo lwakhe belukhona. IBANDLA lakwaShembe liyaziphendulela ebantwini abakhwele badilika kulo emuva kokusabalala kwezithombe zamalungu alo eshadelwa ngamatshitshi abukeka eseyizingane. UNALEDI Aphiwe okhombise ukungahambisani nokushadwa kwezintombi ngamakhehla akwaShembe Isithombe: FACEBOOKEkuqaleni kwaleli sonto kuqubuke umsindo, abantu bekhwela bedilika kuleli bandla belisola ngokuhlukumeza izingane. Abanye baze balibeka ngembaba elokuthi ngabazali balezi zingane baganisa amadodakazi abo namakhehla ngenxa yokuxakeka. Omunye wabashiye abangalazi kuleli bandla ngumculi we-Afro pop, uNaledi Aphiwe (18), osanda kukhipha ingoma ethi Romeo and Juliet. Izinkulumo zikaNaledi zisabalalele ezinkundleni zokuxhumana. "Awathathwe nje la makhehla eyolahlwa e-Old Age Home, ahlukane nodadewethu... Awu ngeke into engashona noma inini, sengizoba wumfelokazi-ke ngimncane kanje...Ngeke ngingayingeni phela ngiyokwenza i-hospitality, kumele ngijove la makhehla anoshukela...Ngizonijaja nize nidivose... Uthi uyavuka ekuseni nali ikhehla lakho lilokhu lihleka eceleni,” kubhala uNaledi.Ethintwa uNaledi, ophendule ucingo lwakhe uthe ngeke aphawule futhi ufuna uNaledi angafakwa ezindabeni zalolu hlobo. "Ngicela ungabhali lutho bandla,” kusho umphathi kaNaledi elingatholakalanga igama lakhe.Okhulumela leli bandla, ohlangothini lwaseBuhleni, uMnuz Thokozani Mncwabe, uqale ngokugxeka amaNazaretha ngokusabalalisa lezi zithombe ezinkundleni zokuxhumana. Uthe lokhu akuvumelekile ebandleni kangangoba kwake kwavalwa ukushuthwa kwezithombe emihlanganweni yebandla. Uthe uNaledi ukhuluma into angayazi ngoba akazi ukuthi buyini ubuntombi.UMncwabe uthe kungamampunge ukuthi amatshitshi aqonyiswa ngabazali bawo ekubeni wona engafuni. Uthe abazali basuke bengazi lutho futhi abahlangene nokuqonyiswa kwamadodakazi abo. Uthe insizwa ifike ikhulume nentombi kungekho mzali futhi abazali baze bazi ngomkhwenyana wabo ngoba eselobola noma esezombesa. "Intombi ikhethwa eSipholi seyikhulumile futhi yavumelana nesoka layo. Kusuke kuyinhlanhla uma intombi ikhethwa wumuntu osuke aziwa ngabazali.” UMncwabe uthe okwenzeka kaShembe akwehlukile kokwenzeka emphakathini."Uma insizwa ibona intombi emgwaqweni, ikhuluma nayo noma ikhuluma nabazali bayo kuqala?” Uthe ngisho ikhethwa intombi, abazali basuke bengazi. "Ithatha lezi zipho ezitholile izikhombise abaphathi bazo. Bona bazibona sebesendlini ekhaya.” UMncwabe uthe kungamampunge ukuthi kunamakhehla akhetha izintombi ezineminyaka engaphansi kuka-18. Uthe umthetho wakwaShembe uthi insizwa ayikhethe intombi esineminyaka eyevile ku-18 ngoba isuke seyikwazi ukuzicabangela. UMncwabe uthe kusho ukuthi abantu bayakuthokozela ukubona izintombi zikhuleliswa ngamaphara bese engazihlawuli. "Abantu abayikhulumi leyo kodwa bagxeka into enhle eyenzeka kwaShembe.”Esephetha, uthe kungamanga ukuthi kunezintombi ezingamaNazaretha ezithi ziqonyiswa ngenkani. Enye intokazi okusolwe ukuthi iqome ikhehla ineminyaka ewu-14, u-Esethu Jali, kodwa yena uveze ubufakazi bokuthi wenza unyaka wesibili eMangosuthu University of Technology futhi uneminyaka engaphezu kuka-18 kulo nyaka. Abanye bakhala ngokuthi izintombi zibuye zikhethwe ngabantu besilisa asebengomakadebona kangangoba banamakhosikazi amaningi nenqwaba yezingane, okubeka izintombi engcupheni yokutheleleka ngesifo socansi ekubeni zona bezizigcinile.

KUBIZWE umhlangano wamazwe ase-Afrika eseNingizimu ozobhunga ngempi eseDemocratic Republic of Congo (DRC).Umhlangano wabaholi bamazwe angaphansi kwenhlangano i-Southern African Development Community (SADC) uzokuba seZimbabwe.Lo mhlangano ubizwa nje sishubile isimo e-DRC njengoba kusanda kushona inqwaba yamasosha okukhona kuwo nangu-13 alapha eNingizimu Afrika.Abaholi bala mazwe kubhekwe ukuthi baqhamuke nesixazululo kule mpi esidonse isikhathi eside.Impi isiqhathe amazwe asezwenikazi i-Afrika, umdonsiswano ogqame kakhulu uphakathi kweNingizimu Afrika neRwanda.Umdonsiswano ophakathi kwala mazwe uthathe elinye igxathu izolo ngesikhathi uMengameli waseRwanda, uPaul Kagame, esonga ngokuthi iNingizimu Afrika izoyithola impi uma iyifuna.La mazwe ahlukene phakathi ngempi ese-DRC.INingizimu Afrika ijube amasosha ayingxenye yokugcina ukuthula asebenzisana namasosha akwamanye amazwe.Inhloso yokujutshwa kwamasosha ukuba ayovimba iqembu lamavukelambuso, i-M23, ukuba lingagwinyi izindawo ezingaphansi kwe-DRC.Ngakolunye uhlangothi iRwanda isolwa ngokuthi iqeqesha iphinde ihlomise ngezikhali i-M23.Kuleli sonto uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, ube nezingxoxo noKagame.Kubukeka lezi zingxoxo zingazange zithele izithelo ezinhle njengoba zilandelwe ukusongelana kwabaholi bakula mazwe.Izinsongo ziqale ngoLwesithathu, lapho uNgqongqoshe wezokuVikela kuleli, uNkk Angie Motshekga, etshele abezindaba ukuthi amasosha akuleli angu-13 ashone e-DRC athelwe amachaphazelo ngesikhathi kutholene phezulu amasosha ase-DRC nawaseRwanda.UNkk Motshekga uthe amasosha aseRwanda nawase-DRC ayedubulana eduze nenkambu yamasosha akuleli, ezinye izinhlamvu zawela lapho kunkanise khona amasosha akuleli.UNkk Motshekga ube eseqhuba ngokuthi sebewaxwayisile amasosha aseRwanda ukuthi uma eqhubeka nokulwa eduze kwenkambu yamasosha akuleli lokho bayokuthatha ngokuthi iRwanda ibizela elakuleli esitikini.Le nkulumo icasule uKagame, osole uRamaphosa ngokusenga ezimithiyo.UKagame uthe uRamaphosa uhlanekezele ingxoxo yabo."Kuningi okungamampunge kule zinto ezishiwo uRamaphosa kanye nabaholi baseNingizimu Afrika. UKagame uthe azimethusi izinsongo zabaholi baseNingizimu Afrika, wathi uma befuna impi bazoyithola.Ihhovisi likaRamaphosa belingakaphawuli ngokushiwo uKagame.

Ayilungile le nto yokuthi sihlaliswe usuku lonke.”UNdlovu uphikile ukuthi ubebize umhlangano ngoLwesibili, wathi yena umhlangano awubizile uzokuba ngesonto elizayo.Uthe ubekade ehlele ukuthi umhlangano ube ngoMsombuluko, kodwa usewushintshele uLwesithathu"Angazi ukuthi bakuthathaphi lokhu kokuthi bekunomhlangano obekufanele ube khona izolo (ngoLwesibili).”UNdlovu usole labo abambangisa isikhundla ukuthi basaqhubeka nomkhankaso wokumnyundela."Bafuna ngivele njengomuntu ongasebenzi, obiza imihlangano bese engabe esaya kuyona. ISAZOQHUBEKA nokubhajwa imali yamakhasimende angaphezu kuka-250 000 ebhange Ithala njengoba sihlehlele isikhathi esingaziwa isicelo sokuba kuvalwe leli bhange.Isicelo sokuba kuvalwe Ithala bekufanele silalelwe eNkantolo eNkulu yaseMgungundlovu.Kepha asibange sisalalelwa isicelo esifakwe uhlaka olungaphansi kweBhange loMbuso, i-Prudential Authority (PA), emva kwesinqumo esithathwe emhlanganweni kaMengameli wamaJaji KwaZulu-Natal, iJaji Thoba Portia Poyo-Dlwati, nabameli bezinhlaka ezithinteka odabeni.Kulo mhlangano obungoLwesithathu, izinhlaka ezithintekayo zinikezwe isikhathi sokuba zifake amanye amaphepha.I-PA iyalelwe ukuba ifake amaphepha aphendula abaphikisa isicelo sabo ngoFebhuwari 7.Emva kwalokho kuyobe sekuba nomhlangano wazo zonke izinhlaka ezithintekayo, lapho kuzovunyelwana khona ngosuku lokuba kulalelwe isicelo se-PA.Isicelo sokuba kuvalwe Ithala sidale utalatiya njengoba amakhasimende engakwazi ukukhipha noma ukufaka imali.Nabasebenzi baseThala abaholile njengoba kujame yonke into ethinta leli bhange.Ukujama kwezinto eThala kuphazamise izinhlaka ezahlukene okubalwa kuzo nosomabhizinisi abancane.Okhulumela inhlangano yabaphakela izikole KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thabang Mncwabe, uthe kuzobalimaza kakhulu ukuhlehla kwecala.Kulolu hlelo lokuphakelwa kwezikole kuhlomula abafundi abangaphezu kuka-2.4 million.UMncwabe uthe iningi labantu abaphakela izikole basebenzisa Ithala."Cishe u-60% wabantu abaphakela izikole basebenzisa Ithala. Izivumelwano zabo ziyabaphoqa ukuthi baqhubeke nokubhanga eThala.”"Isimo sibi kosomabhizinisi njengoba kufanele baqhubeke nokuphakela izikole yize bengayitholi imali yabo. Uliqhuba kanjani ibhizinisi ungakhokhelwa? Le nto ibeka engcupheni osomabhizinisi.”UMncwabe uthe bafuna ukuthi uhulumeni uqhamuke nohlelo lwesikhashana olufana nolwenzelwe abathola izibonelelo zikahulumeni, lokuthi osomabhizinisi ababhanga eThala bakwazi ukuthola imali yabo kwamanye amabhange.Inyunyana yabasebenzi, i-Nehawu, ithe isicelo sokuba kuvalwe Ithala akufanele simise ukukhokhelwa kwabasebenzi.Amalungu e-Nehawu abe nombhikisho emahhovisi eBhange loMbuso aseThekwini, lapho ememezele ukuba kuholelwe abasebenzi beThala.UNobhala we-Nehawu esifundeni iTheku, uMnuz Prince Mthalane, uthe abasebenzi baseThala abakaze bayithole imiholo yabo okwakufanele bayithole ngoJanuwari 20.Ukuhlehliswa kwesicelo kubhuntshise umbhikisho obuhlelwa amakhosi.Amakhosi abehlele ukuba nombhikisho obuzoholwa izinduna zamabutho.USihlalo weNdlu yobuHoli boMdabu KwaZulu-Natal, Inkosi Sifiso Shinga, uthe umbhikisho wabo usuzokuba ngosuku olusha lokulalelwa kwesicelo olusazonqunywa.UShinga uthe abahambisani nokuthi kuvalwe Ithala.
