UMSOLWA okuthiwa ubefunwa uthuli ngamaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal ufe ujuqu ezwanamandla ngenhlamvu namaphoyisa ngoLwesine emini.Umufi oneminyaka engu-22 kuthiwa ngumholi odatshwayo weqembu osatshwayo, iWest Gang, ubenabangani bakhe ababili ngesikhathi beficwa ukufa eCottonlands, eVerulam.Bafe ujuqu abebegadulisana namaphoyisa ngenhlamvu isithombe: SAPSAmaphoyisa alunywe indlebe ngokuthi lo msolwa ubelibangise eMhlanga uyolanda izidakamizwa nezikhali. Nebala amaphoyisa anikela khona."Sebephuma eMhlanga, abasolwa bashintshe imoto abebehamba ngayo kanti amaphoyisa ahleli ezithendeni zabo abuka yonke into, abalandele baze bapaka eceleni komgwaqo uVincent Dickison, eCottonlands,” kusho amaphoyisa.Kuthiwa ngesikhathi amaphoyisa asondela kule moto abasolwa bavele bavulela ngenhlamvu, lwaqala lapho uthuthuva.Bafe ujuqu abebegadulisana namaphoyisa ngenhlamvu isithombe: SAPSUmufi ufe nomngani wakhe oneminyaka engu-27 ubudala bafele khona lapho, kwathi omunye wacela empunzini."Amaphoyisa athungatha umsolwa wesithathu obalekile, futhi asazoyiseshisisa kahle imoto ebihamba abasolwa, kodwa sitholakele isibhamu esisodwa ebeiphethwe umholi wemigulukudu ofile.”
KUNOMLANDO wokungahoshelani kahle phakathi kowesilisa waseShayamoya, KwaDukuza, ovulele imeya kamasipala wale ndawo nabaqaphi bayo icala lokushaya.UMnuz Thami Chiliza uvulele iMeya yaKwaDukuza uMnuz Ali Ngidi icala lokushaya ngoMgqibelo, ngesigameko okuthiwa senzeka ngoDisemba 26, 2024. Uthe ubelandela umyalelo wabameli bakhe njengoba eze walivula muva nje icala.Elandisa Isolezwe uthe ngosuku lwesigameko, wayehamba ngemoto yakhe emgwaqweni odlula ngasemzini kamsolwa.Uthe kwaqondana nokuthi nomsolwa uyaphuma ngemoto, wafuna ukuthi yena ame ukuze kungene yena kuqala, ahambe phambi kwakhe."Angizange ngivume ngoba yimi owayenemvume yokuthi ngiqhubeke ngihambe. Kwabe sengonile ke, wangijaha nonogada bakhe,” kusho uChiliza.Uthe bagcina bemfica, i-Toyota Hilux eyayihamba onogada yamvimba ngaphambili, kwathi i-BMW eyayihamba umsolwa, yama ngemumva."Kwehla yona ngqo imeya, ngazitshela ukuthi izongibuza imibuzo, kodwa ngamangala isingithela impama,” kusho uChiliza.Uthe wayesathi uyabuza ukuthi kungani umsolwa emthela ngenduku ngesikhathi kungenelela onogada bakhe, bemkhipha emotweni.Uveze ukuthi kwaze kwalimala isicabha semoto, ezabalazela ukuphuma onogada bemdonsa ngendluzula.Uthe emva kokumkhipha emotweni, babe sebemnaphaza ngenduku."Ngisho sengilele phansi abazange bangiyeke,” kusho uChiliza, othe onogada bagcina beshaya ngisho nomfowabo ayenaye emotweni, owayethi uzama ukulamula.Uveze ukuthi bangena emotweni yabo (onogada), bashayela eyakhe imoto, kwabhekwa esiteshini samaphoyisa eMhlali, lapho afike wavulelwa khona icala lokushayela ephuzile.Uthe baqale bazama ukuvula elokushayelisa kabi umsolwa, okwathi uma liphikwa yikhompyutha, base bemvulela elokushayela ephuzile njengoba "ayekhothakhothile”, kuyisikhathi samaholidi.Uthe wahlala izinsuku eziyisishiyagalombili esitokisini waze wadedelwa ngoJanuwari 2.Udalule ukuthi kwathi uma eseyokhipha imoto yakhe, wathola ukuthi wawungasekho u-R20 000 owawuphakathi ngesikhathi onogada beyithatha ngaphandle kwemvume yakhe ngosuku lwesigameko. Uveze ukuthi ubudlelwano phakathi kwakhe nomsolwa ayekade engamathe nolimu naye kusukela bebancane, baphela ngesikhathi bencintisana kwesobukhansela okhethweni olwalungo-2021. Uthe kwagcina kuphumelela yena umsolwa.Uthe okunye okubuye kwenza isimo saba sibi, ukuvunwa yinkantolo kolukamasipala odiliza imijondolo yabo endaweni athi babeyinikwe uye umsolwa ngo-2022, esethathe esobukhansela."Wasinika yona. Wathi asakhe khona imijondolo yethu,” kusho uChiliza.Uthe umasipala wabanxusa ukuthi abangaqale baqhubeke nokwakha, balinde ukuthi bafakelwe ingqalasizinda yamanzi.Uthe emva kokulinda unyaka wonke (2023) kungenzeki lutho, bakhetha ukuvele baqhubeke nokugxumeka imijondolo yabo ngo-2024."Besilokhu sidilizelwa, siphinde sizivuse izakhiwo. Kuthe sekungena yena (umsolwa) kwesobumeya ngo-Okthoba (2024), kwangabe kusaba ukudilizelwa kuphela, kwaboshwa nabantu,” kusho uChiliza.Uthe ilapho beye khona enkantolo beyofaka isicelo sesivimbelo, yafike yavuna bona encwadini eyikhiphe ngasekuqaleni kukaDisemba.Uthe njengoba ebuye abe ngusihlalo wenhlangano engenzi nzuzo, iKwaDukuza Business Forum, eyizwi labantu bakule ndawo, bafaka isikhalo ngomsolwa engakabi yimeya, bethi akawenzi umsebenzi wakhe.Uthe baqala bazifaka kumasipala izikhalo zabo, nokwathi uma bebona ukuthi kuhamba isikhathi bengaphendulwa, badlulela phambili eMnyangweni wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu ezingeni lesifundazwe."Impendulo ebuya emnyangweni, iyalela usomlomo kamasipala ukuthi athathe izinyathelo ngalokhu, nayo impendulo ibuye ngawo uDisemba. Ngibona ukuthi konke lokhu kuvele kwayicasula kakhulu imeya,” kusho uChiliza.Uthe yena ufuna ubulungiswa, kuboshwe umuntu osezibona emkhulu kunomthetho.Imizamo yokuthola uNgidi ayiphumelelanga. Namaphoyisa awayiphendulanga imibuzo ayithunyelelwe ngodaba.Okhulumela umasipala uMnuz Sifiso Zulu uthe nakuba imeya ingeke ikwazi ukuphawula kakhulu ngodaba olusenkantolo, kodwa akukho okushiwo uChiliza.Uthe ngosuku lwesigameko uChiliza wathikameza izimoto zemeya kodwa kwathi uma onogada besala ukulungisa leso simo, njengenjwayelo, imoto eyayihamba imeya yangama."Kwasala onogada, okwathi uma bebona ukuthi uphuzile uChiliza, babiza amaphoyisa kamasipala, okuyiwo ahamba ayomvulela icala,” kusho uZulu.Uthe lusha kubona nodaba lwencwadi yenkantolo evumela oChiliza ukuthi bahlale emhlabeni kamasipala ngokungemthetho."Esiyaziyo incwadi eyango-2022, eyayithi umasipala awuyidilize noma inini imijondolo egxunyekwa kule ndawo, yaqhuba yathi ungalekelelwa ngisho nangamaphoyisa uma sewenza lokho,” kusho uZulu.Olwencwadi ethunyelwe uMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu, nalo uthe akakaze ezwe ngalo ngehhovisi likasomlomo.Ubalule nokuthi ngoDisemba 2023, uChiliza wayephambili ebantwini abacekela phansi isango lomuzi wemeya, bangena bashisa amathayi egcekeni, kwaze kwavulwa icala, namanje asalihambayo enkantolo.Uphethe ngelithi imeya ithi ayikhumbuli kuba khona lapho inyathelana khona amakhona noChiliza.
KUVULELWE intululwane yamacala owesilisa waseTownview, eMooi River, osolwa ngokudlwengula ephindelela izingane ebeziqashwa enkulisa yakubo.Umthombo osondelene nalolu daba uveza ukuthi lo wesilisa oneminyaka engu-21, zingaphezulu kwezinhlanu izingane okusolwa ukuthi uzigilile.Umthombo uthe lo wesilisa kusuke isidumo ngemuva kokuba ngoLwesine olwedlule, ebhadanywe ngomunye umzali eqhoqhobele ingane yakhe."Lo mzali akabuzanga lutho, umane waqonda nje ngqo emaphoyiseni eyovula icala,'' kusho umthombo.Uthe ngosuku olufanayo bathole ukuthi empeleni ziningi izingane esezigilwe yilo wesilisa ezinye zazo ezigonyulikile ngalokhu. Kuvela ukuthi inkulisa yasungulwa ngabazali bakamsolwa eminyekeni edlule."Agcine eseyisihlanu esewonke amacala avulelwe lo wesilisa kodwa okusikhathazayo ukuthi kuze kube yimanje ubengakaboshwa. Isizathu salokho kasisazi,'' usho kanjena.Kuvela ukuthi kule nkulisa kuhlala izingane eziqala eminyakeni embili kuze kufike ezinganeni ezineminyaka engu-12 ezishiywa abazali uma benezindlela. Kuthiwa umsolwa ubeqhoqhobala labo abaneminyaka engu-12.Omunye wonina wabagilwa eligodliwe igama lakhe uthe namanje akuvumi ukuthi akwamukele lokhu okwenziwe umsolwa enganeni yakhe yentombazane.''Angeke ngize ngikuthole ukuphumula lo mfana engazange aboshwe. Kumele aphelele ejele ngoba uzihlukumezile futhi kakhulu izingane zethu,'' usho kanjena.Uthe bebeyithemba le nkulisa kanti kabazi ukuthi bamane bayazikhohlisa nje.Nomunye umzali obethukuthele egane unwabu uthe bafuna ubulungiswa ngokuthi akhalelwe ngamasongo kaSigonyela umsolwa njengoba egcwele izinkalo emva kokubanjwa oqotsheni.Uchaze isenzo somsolwa njengesinyantisa igazi, wathi uma ecabanga ngaso umane evukwe uhlevane."Ibuhlungu inhliziyo yami ngale nto eyenzeke enganeni yami futhi akusavumi nokuthi ngilale ebusuku,'' usho kanjena.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi umphakathi uvuke umbhejazane ufuna ukungqongqisa umuzi wakubo kamsolwa nenkulisa kodwa uyise kamsolwa waxolisa emphakathini."Sigcine singazange siwushise umuzi wakhe ngenxa yokuthi indlela axolise ngayo isenze sabona ukuthi lokhu akwenzayo kusuka ekujuleni kwenhliziyo yakhe,'' usho kanjena umthombo.Uthe okudala ukuthi umphakathi ucasuke ukuthi umsolwa akaziwa ukuthi ukuziphi izinkalo."Thina simfuna ephila lo mfana ukuze ezosichazela kahle njengomphakathi ukuthi yini le ayenzayo ezinganeni zethu,'' usho kanjena.Amaphoyisa aKwaZulu-Natal athunyelelwe imibuzo mayelana nalolu daba kusuka ngoLwesihlanu kodwa awazange aphendule.Akucacanga nokuthi inkulisa ibhalisiwe yini ngaphansi koMnyango wezeNhlalakahle.
AYAVEVA amalungu ekomiti lezoMhlaba nokuThuthukiswa kweziNdawo zaseMakhaya ePhalamende, 'ngokumiswa’ ukuthi ahambele KwaZulu-Natal ukuzohlangana neSilo samaBandla uMisuzulu kaZwelithini, ukuzozwa ngezinselelo ezibhekene nebhodi iNgonyama Trust.IMbube nebhodi babhekene ngeziqu zamehlo emva kokuhlakazwa kwaleli bhodi yiMbube, eyaxosha namanye amalungu.La malungu akhomba ngenjumbane uSomlomo wePhalamende uNkk Thoko Didiza, ovumelane noSihlalo wale Ndlu, ukuthi awabambe amatomu angezi kulesi sifundazwe kuze kudlule inkulumo ebhekiswe esizweni kamengameli wezwe uCyril Ramaphosa.Usihlalo wekomiti uMnuz Mangaqa Mncwango, uthe kwakumele bahambele iMbube nyakenye, kungakabheduki izinkinga kodwa ngenxa yokushayisana kwezinto, kwagcina kungenzekanga.Uthe bebezohambela nezinye izindawo kulesi sifundazwe ngasekupheleni kwale nyanga njengoba kwakuhleliwe nyakenye, okubalwa nokuhlangana nabaholi bomdabu.Ukhale ngokuthi ngomzuzu wokugcina kuthiwe ngeke besakwazi ngoba noNgqongqoshe womnyango uMnuz Mzwanele Nyhontso, akekho kuleli uhambele eGermany. UNyhontso, wathi iMbube ayinalo ilungelo lokuhlakaza ibhodi, amandla akuyena."Kuthiwe kukhona nezinto ezibucayi kulolu daba ngakho asithi ukuma kancane. Kubalulekile ukuthi sibonane neMbube ukuzozizwela ngokwenzekayo, hhayi kodwa ukuthi sizoyiqulisa,” usho kanje.UMnuz Bonginkosi Madikizela, ilungu le-DA, uthe okubi ngukuthi lo mhlangano kwakuhlelwe ukuthi ubekhona ngaphambi kokubheduka kwezinkinga phakathi kwebhodi neMbube.Uthe kubalulekile ukuthi bagcine befikile eKZN bezokotha iMbube bazizwele beyikomiti ngezinkinga.UMnuz Andile Mngxitama ilungu leMK, uthe: "Akumele iMbube ingahlonishwa yingakho nathi sizoyihambela, sizoyotha ukuze sithole umnyombo wezinkinga.” UMnuz Mlindi Nhanha we-DA, uthe ngendlela isimo esishube ngayo phakathi kwebhodi neNgonyama, sekuyaphuthuma ukuthi bazizwele ngokwenzekayo."Asizile ukuzoqulisa iMbube kodwa ukuzothola nje kuyona ukuthi kwenzekani. Nebhodi 'elihlakaziwe’ sizolihambela ukuzwa olwalo uhlangothi,” usho kanje.UMnuz Sam Matiase we-EFF, uthe bekungamele banqatshelwe ukuzokwenza umsebenzi wabo ngoba kulindwe uRamaphosa abuye lapho ekhona."Ngokomthetho bekumele ngabe iMbube siyibona kusasa (namhlanje), njengoba ibithe inaso isikhathi kodwa asikwazi ukuyibona. Kubalulekile ukuthi sisheshe siyibone iMbube ngoba lolu daba luyaphuthuma,” kusho uMatiase.UMncwango uthe kumele babhale incwadi beyikomiti baxolise kwiMbube ukuthi abasakwazi ukuyibona namhlanje."Inhloso yethu akukhona ukuthi sithatha uhlangothi oluthile. Sifuna ukuzwa kuzona zonke izinhlangothi ezithintekayo kulolu daba,” kusho uMncwango.Kugcine kuvunyelwene ngokuthi leli komiti lizohambela eKZN kusuka ngoFebhuwari 24 kuya kuFebhuwari 28, 2025.
KUSOLWA inhlese yezepolitiki ngokushushiswa kukaNkk Duduzile Zuma-Sambudla, oyindodakazi yomholi we-MK, uMnuz Jacob Zuma.Uzovela eNkantolo yeMantshi eThekwini namuhla ngecala lezibhelu zangoJulayi 2021.Okhulumela i-MK, uMnuz Nhlamulo Ndhlela, uthe abameli bakaNkk Zuma-Sambudla bathunyelelwe uhlu lwamacala ngesonto eledlule.UNdhlela uthe uNkk Zuma-Sambudla umsulwa, wathi kunenhlese yezepolitiki ekushushisweni kwakhe.Njengoba evela enkantolo namuhla uNkk Zuma-Sambudla, amalungu e-MK ahlele ukuba nombhikisho onokuthula ngaphandle kweNkantolo yeMantshi eThekwini.UNkk Zuma-Sambudla usolwa ngokugqugquzela izibhelu ezaqubuka emva kokuboshwa kukayise, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, owaboshelwa icala lokwedelela umyalelo weNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo.Izibhelu ezaqubuka emva kokuthi uZuma ezinikele ejele eliseMtshezi zaholela ekucekelweni kwempahla kanye nokuzitapela.Lezi bhelu zadala umonakalo ka-R50 billion emnothweni wakuleli, inqwaba yalahlekelwa imisebenzi.Kwashona abangu-345 kulezi zibhelu ezahlasela KwaZulu-Natal nasezingxenyeni zeGauteng.Ngesikhathi kuqhubeka izibhelu uNkk Zuma-Sambudla wayefaka imibhalo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana eyahunyushwa ngokuthi uncoma ababeyingxenye yezibhelu.UNkk Zuma-Sambudla wayelokhu efaka ekhasini lakhe le-X, izigameko ezazenzeka, zihambisana nombhalo othi "siyanibona”, bese esho igama lendawo okwenzeke kuyo isigameko.Ngesikhathi kunesigcawu seKhomishini yamaLungelo Abantu, i-SA Human Rights Organisation, esasiphenya ngezibhelu, omunye wabantu abethula ubufakazi wakhala ngokuthi uNkk Zuma-Sambudla wayekhombisa ukuthi uyakujabulela okwakwenzeka ngesikhathi sezibhelu.UMnuz Jean le Roux, wenhlangano i-Forensic Research Lab, wathi imibhalo kaNkk Zuma-Sambudla yayikhombisa ukuthi ukushayela ihlombe okwakwenzeka.Nokho uNkk Zuma-Sambudla akazange aboshwe ngo-2022 ngesikhathi kuboshwa abanye abantu abangu-20 ababoshelwa ukugqugquzela izibhelu.Ngaleso sikhathi oKlebe bakuqinisekisa ukuthi uNkk Zuma-Sambudla uyaphenywa.UNkk Zuma-Sambudla uyilungu lePhalamende aphinde futhi abe usihlalo wamazwe aseNingizimu ne-Afrika ePhalamende lase-Afrika.I-MK inxuse amalungu ayo ukuba aphume ngobuningi azokweseka uNkk Zuma-Sambudla."Sicela ukuba nigqugquzele nabanye ukuba bezokweseka uNkk Zuma-Sambudla ozovela enkantolo.”Ubuholi be-MK esifundeni iTheku bumemezele ukuthi buzokuba nombhikisho onokuthula ngaphandle kwenkantolo.
KUZOPHELA amahlathi okucasha kulabo abasebenzisa ngokungemthetho amabhilidi angasasebenzi aseThekwini, njengoba umasipala uchitha angu-157.Lokhu kuvezwe yiMeya yeTheku, uMnuz Cyril Xaba, izolo, ngesikhathi ikhuluma engqungqutheleni iBuild KZN Better e-ICC.UXaba wenza lesi simemezelo nje, bese ziningi izikhalazo mayelana namabhilidi akule ndawo asephendulwe imihhume yabaphangi.Okunye okuvelile ukuthi iningi lamabhilidi lihlala abantu bokufika futhi abangena kuwo ngenkani bengenazo nezincwadi ezibagunyaza ukuba kuleli.Phakathi kobugebengu okuvela ukuthi buyenziwa kuwona kubalwa ukuhweba ngezidakamizwa, kwamanye kukhandwa izitifiketi ezahlukene ezingombombayi. Amanye ayizidleke zomahosha.Inhloso enkulu yale ngqungquthela kuhlalukile ukuthi bekuwukudingida kabanzi ngezinto ezingenziwa ngenhloso yokuqinisekisa ukuthi iyaxazululeka ingwadla yamabhilidi akhahlamezekile. Le ngqungquthela ibikade ihlelwe uMnyango wezeMisebenzi yoMphakathi ngokubambisana nawo uMasipala weTheku.Ikhuluma lapha iMeya yeTheku, ithe babone kungcono ukuthi bamane bawachithe ngoba awasabalekeleli ngalutho.UXaba akazange awasho ngamagama amabhilidi abawachithayo."Asikho nje isidingo sokuthi siqhubeke nokuwagcina wonke la mabhilidi esikholwa ukuthi singawadedela futhi kungabi nankinga. Uma nje lokho kuzosilekelela kumele sikwenze,'' usho kanjena.Uveze ukuthi kuzokuba nohlelo oluvulelekile lapho okuzobe kuhloswe khona ukuthi basondele eduze labo abanentshisekelo yokuwathola, wagcizelela ukuthi bakholwa ukuthi akhona namanye amabhilidi abasazowachitha ngokuhamba kwesikhathi.UMartin Meyer onguMphathiswa wezeMisebenzi yoMphakathi neNgqalasizinda KwaZulu Natal, udalule ukuthi kunamabhilidi amathathu asemgangathweni abazonikezela ngawo kuMasipala weTheku. Ubale lawa alandelayo i-Palm Beach Hotel, West Point Lodge ne-Siemens Rest Institute.Uthe ukholwa ukuthi ukusebenzisana okuhle phakathi komnyango awuholayo neTheku kuzodala ukuthi bakwazi ukubhekana nenkinga yamabhilidi.Ebuzwa mayelana nomthetho i-Land Expropriation, uthe akukho angakusho ngawo ngoba ukholwa ukuthi lolu wudaba oluzophelela enkantolo.Uveze ukuthi seziyisikhombisa manje izikhulu zomnyango wakhe esezimisiwe ngenxa yokusoleka ekubandakanyekeni kwinkohlakalo.UNgqongqoshe wezeMisebenzi yoMphakathi neNgqalasizinda, uMnuz Dean Macpherson, uthe kumqoka kakhulu ukuba ibhekwe ngeso elijulile indaba yamabhilidi amadala.Unxuse ukuthi abantu baKwaZulu-Natal banikezwe amathuba omsebenzi. Le ngqungquthela izoqhubeka namhlanje njengoba izobe seyisongwa.
LIHLEHLISELWE usuku olungakaziwa icala lombango wokuba kuvalwe ibhange elilengelwa yizembe Ithala, obekufanele lilalelwe uLwesihlanu.Isicelo sokuba kuhlakazwe Ithala esifakwe uhlaka olungaphansi kweBhange loMbuso, i-Prudential Authority (PA), bekufanele silalelwe eNkantolo eNkulu yaseMgungundlovu.Isinqumo sokuba kuhlehliswe isicelo sithathwe emhlanganweni kaMengameli wamaJaji KwaZulu-Natal, uJaji Thoba Portia Poyo-Dlwati, nabameli bezinhlaka ezithintekayo.Kulo mhlangano obungoLwesithathu, kunikezwe izinhlaka ezithintekayo isikhathi sokuba zifake amaphepha asenkantolo.I-PA inikezwe umnqamulajuqu wokuba ifake amaphepha aphendula izinhlaka eziphikisa isicelo ngoFebhuwari 7.Emva kwalokho kuyokuba nomhlangano lapho kuzovunyelwana khona ngosuku okuzolalelwa ngalo isicelo.Isicelo sokuvalwa kweThala sidale utalatiya njengoba amakhasimende engakwazi ukukhipha noma ukufaka imali kuleli bhange.Abasebenzi basebhange nabo abaholile.
IYAVEVA inhlangano emele abahlinzeka izikole ngokudla KwaZulu-Natal, i-National School Nutrition Programme (NSNP) Service Providers Association, ngokubanjiswa udonga wuMnyango wezeMfundo esifundazweni, ogcine ungasifezanga isethembiso sokukhokhela bonke obakweletayo ngaphansi kwalolu hlelo ngoLwesibili.Le nhlangano ithe idumele ngoba labo sonkontileka abakweletwa ngumnyango, bathe bethi ngqu kuma-akhawunti abo, bafica itshe lome inhlama, ingabonwa imali abayithenjiswe wumnyango.Umnyango wawuthembise ukuthi ngoJanuwari 28, izobe isifakiwe kuma-akhawunti abo.UMnuz Thabang Mncwabe wale nhlangano, uthe umnyango ubaqambele amanga wathi uzobakhokhela labo obakweletayo kodwa akuzange kwenzeke lokho.Uthe lesi sithembiso samanga siqeda ukwethembana phakathi komnyango nabaphakela izikole."Umnyango uhluleka ukubeka phambili abaphakela izikole. Lokhu kubanjiswa udonga kwabahlinzeka izikole ngokudla kubeka engcupheni ukuphakelwa kwabafundi, abanye babo abathembele kukona nsuku zonke,” kusho uMncwabe.Uthe sekunesikhathi behlaba ikhwelo lokuthi kuphuculwe indlela okukhokhwa ngayo ngokuthi abenza lo msebenzi babe yingxenye yezingxoxo ukuze kutholakale isixazululo."Sesifuna kungenelele ungqongqoshe kazwelonke wezeMfundo odabeni lokudla ezikoleni zase-KZN. Sifuna abakweletwayo bakhokhelwe ngokushesha ngoba uma kungenjalo kuzoba nokuphazamiseka kokuhlinzekwa kokudla ezikoleni.” Uthe kumele kube nenkundla ezohlanganisa izinhlaka ezehlukene ukuze kulungiswe izinkinga ezikhona.Ubalule ukuthi abafundi yibona ababalulekile ukuthi baqhubeke bathole ukudla nsuku zonke ezikoleni zesifundazwe.Okhulumela umnyango uMnuz Muzi Mahlambi, wathi bayalwazi udaba lwabahlinzeka izikole ngokudla abangakhokheliwe, waveza ukuthi udaba abalulungisayo wathembisa ukuthi bazobakhokhela ngoJanuwari 28, okuyinto engenzekanga. UMphathiswa woMnyango wezeMfundo, uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka, wakhipha isitatimende lapho axolisa khona ngokubambezeleka ekukhokheleni abahlinzeka izikole ngokudla."Siyabuncoma ubudlelwano esinabo nabenza imisebenzi nomnyango, ikakhulu abahlinzeka ngokudla ezikoleni ukuze abafundi baqhubeke nokuthola ukudla. Inhloso yalolu hlelo ukuqeda indlala ebhuqa umphakathi, igqugquzele ukuthi abafundi beze ezikoleni nsuku zonke,” kusho uHlomuka. Sekufana neculo ukukhala komnyango ngemali okwenza ungakwazi ukukhokhela ngesikhathi osonkontileka.
UKHOMISHANA wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant-General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, ufunga uyagomela ukuthi akukho okungamenza athi akuyekwe uphenyo lwamaphoyisa oluqhubekayo, oluvundulula amazambane abolile embuthweni.UMkhwanazi ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi enenkulumo ekhethekile nesiteshi sethelevishini, i-eNCA.Ukhulume kanje ngemva kokusabalala kwezinkulumo eziqoshiwe ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, wathi ziyimizamo yokudicilela phansi isithunzi sakhe.UKHOMISHANA wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uLt-Gen Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi uthe akanavalo Isithombe: SIGCINIWEUMkhwanazi udalule ukuthi emacaleni abawaphenyayo, kukhona amabili athinta ozakwabo abasebenza ekomkhulu lamaphoyisa."Siye sithi uma siphenya amacala, kuvele amagama ozakwethu abasemazingeni aphansi, kungenzeki lutho. Kodwa uma sithi senza olunye uphenyo, oluphumela ngaphandle kwesifundazwe oluthinta abasemazingeni aphezulu, bese kuqhamuka izinto ezikanje,” kusho uMkhwanazi.Uthe lokhu kuwuphawu lokuthi uphenyo lwabo lusuke luhamba ngomgudu ofanele impela uma sekusabalala izinkulumo. Enaba kafishane ngalokhu, uthe uphenyo lwabo luqale esifundazweni, lwaya ngokuya lwenabela ngaphandle kwesifundazwe."Mabili acala esiwasebenzayo athinta abasehhovisi elikomkhulu lamaphoyisa. Ngeke ngibagagule ababili abathintekayo abangamazambane abolile embuthweni,” kusho uMkhwanazi.Uthe konke lokhu kuyimizamo yokumthulisa nokumsabisa, wathi nokho akumfaki nhlobo amanzi emadolweni."Amazambane abolile, azovela maduze,” usho kanje.Uqhube wathi izandla uzivulile ukuthi bonke abamsola ngenkohlakalo, bamyise enkantolo. Ukhumbuze abantu ngokuthi akukhona okokuqala kuphunywa naye iqhubu."Kwake kwahlohlwa zonke ezobunhloli ngokuthi zithi njo kimina ngo-2011 ngoba kwakunefayela etafuleni lethu ngosopolitiki emkhulu,” kusho uMkhwanazi.Uthe waze wahlaliswa ekhaya unyaka wonke engasebenzi ngoba babethinta abantu "abangafanele”."Sasivundulula amazambane abolile embuthweni, kwaze kwathinteka nosopolitiki abathile. Ngaleso sikhathi asizange siguqe, ngeke siguqe manje,” kusho uMkhwanazi.
IZOKWESEKWA amalungu e-MKP indodakazi yomholi weqembu, uNkk Duduzile Zuma-Sambudla, ezovela enkantolo ngecala lezibhelu zango-2021.Amalungu e-MKP ahlele ukuba nombhikisho onokuthula ngoLwesine, ngaphandle kweNkantolo yeMantshi eThekwini, lapho kuzovela uNkk Zuma-Sambudla, oyindodakazi kaMnuz Jacob Zuma.Ubuholi be-MKP esifundeni eThekwini, bumemezele ukuthi buzokuba nombhikisho onokuthula ngaphandle kwenkantolo.
ZINGU-27 izifunda ezizoshayeka kakhulu ngokumiswa okwesikhashana koxhaso lokulwa ne-HIV obelukhishwa nguhulumeni waseMelika, olumiswe nguMengameli waleliya lizwe uDonald Trump.UTrump umise lolu xhaso njengoba esalubuyekeza kanti aluthinti elakuleli kuphela kodwa luthinta namanye amazwe ase-Afrika.UNgqongqoshe wezeMpilo, uDkt Aaron Motsoaledi, utshele abezindaba eGoli izolo ukuthi basenza ucwaningo lokuthi ungakanani umonakalo ozodalwa yilesi sinyathelo sikaTrump.Uthe kuleli yizifunda ezingu-27, kwezingu-52 eziyingxenye yezisizwa yilolu hlelo lwaseMelika."I-Afrika yilona lizwe kuphela emhlabeni elisabalalisa imishanguzo ebantwini abaningi abahaqwe yi-HIV. Bangu-5.5 million abadla le mishanguzo kuleli. Sisebenzisa u-R44 billion kulolu hlelo,” kusho uMotsoaledi.Uthe abakayitholi incwadi evela eMelika ebazisa ngokumiswa koxhaso."Sisezwe ngalabo abathola uxhaso okuyi-Wits, okuyiyona ethola ngqo lolu xhaso esebenzisana nemitholampilo ehlukene kuleli. Sisabheka ukuthi ungakanani umonakalo ozodaleka ngalesi sinqumo. "Izifundazwe ezizoshayeka kubalwa i-KZN enezifunda eziningi ezweni njengoba ziyisikhombisa ezisizwa yilolu hlelo. Kulandela i-Eastern Cape ngezinhlanu, zine eGauteng kwezinye izifundazwe zintathu bese kuthi eLimpopo zibe mbili,” kusho uMotsoaledi.Uthe sekuneminyaka eyevile ku-20 kusetshenziswana neMelika ukulwa nezifo ezehlukene kuleli.Ngokwezibalo ze-Pepfar, bangu-21 million abantu basemazweni angu-55 abahlomula ngokohlelo lwale nhlangano lwemishanguzo yokuthithibalisa ingculazi. Ngakolunye uhlangothi uNobhala Jikelele we-ANC uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, uthe asikho isivumelwano abasenza namaqembu ababambisene nawo kuhulumeni, ukuthi kumele baqale bavumelane nawo ngaphambi kokuba kuphasiswe imithetho kuleli.UMbalula uthe indaba yokusayinwa komthetho wokubuyiswa komhlaba, akuwona umthetho omusha njengoba umthetho sivivinywa udlule ezinhlakeni ezehlukene okubalwa nePhalamende."Umengameli usayine into ebivele isezithebeni zakhe. Akukho lapho savumelana khona ne-DA noma namanye amaqembu esibambisene nawo kuhulumeni wokubambisana, ukuthi sizozwa ngawo kuqala ngaphambi kokuphasisa umthetho,” kusho uMbalula.Uthe bayaqhubeka nokudla umhlaba ngaphandle kwesinxephezelo njengoba ususayiniwe umthetho. Udlulise amazwi enduduzo emindenini yamasosha ashone e-DRC.Uthe la masosha ayengayile kuleliya lizwe ukuyolwa kodwa ayeyoqinisekisa ukuthi kunokuthula.UMbalula uveze ukuthi kuzoba nesithangami nabezindaba lapho uMnyango wezokuVikela uzochazela isizwe ngokwenzekile."Afe engamaqhawe la masosha asale enkundleni. Abengayile e-DRC ukuyovikela izinto ezithile kodwa abeyoqinisekisa ukuthi kunokuthula,” kusho uMbalula.
BAYINQWABA abahola izibonelelo zikahulumeni abasenkingeni yokungaholi kule nyanga ngenxa yesimo esihlasele ebhange elilengelwa yizembe, Ithala.Uhulumeni uzama ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abangaphezu kuka-65 000 abahola eThala, bangakwazi ukuvula ama-akhawunti eFNB, ukuze bathole izibonelelo zabo zangenyanga ezayo ngesikhathi.Izibonelelo zabangasebenzi kepha abasebenzisa Ithala, zizobambezeleka.Lokhu kushiwo okhulumela inhlangano eholela izibonelelo zikahulumeni, i-SA Social Security Agency, uMnuz Paseka Letsatsi.ULetsatsi uthe ebantwini abangaphezu kuka-65 000 kukhona abahola eyobudala, eyezintandane, eyezingane, neyabangasebenzi.Abantu basezifundazweni iKwaZulu-Natal, nengcosana eMpumalanga, Eastern Cape, Gauteng, Free State, North West naseWestern Cape.Amakhasimende eThala awakwazi ukukhipha imali yawo. Ikusasa leThala lisengcupheni ngoba kunesicelo esifakwe wuhlaka olungaphansi kweBhange loMbuso, i-Prudential Authority, sokuba livalwe.Isicelo sokuba kuvalwe Ithala sizolalelwa kusasa eNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu.ULetsatsi uthe njengoba ikusasa leThala lingacaci, sebevumelene ne-FNB ukuba ivulele amakhasimende eThala ama-akhawunti, ukuze akwazi ukuthola izibonelelo zawo."Sinxusa amakhasimende aseThala ukuba abeke phansi amaphaphu. Sizoqinisekisa ukuthi izibonelelo bazithola ngesikhathi. Abantu abazothinteka yilabo abathola isibonelelo sabangasebenzi. Izibonelelo zabo zangoJanuwari zizobambezeleka. Bazobuye bakhokhelwe uma sekulungiswe konke.”ULetsatsi uthe i-FNB ibathembisile ukuthi abantu abazofaka izicelo bazothola amakhadi abo ngokushesha.Indaba yokulengelwa yizembe kweThala, iyaqhubeka nokufaka itwetwe ezinhlakeni ezahlukene.Uhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal, namakhosi banxuse uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, ukuba angenelele.UNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, uveze ukuthi ube nengxoxo noRamaphosa, emcela ukuba angenelele kule nkiyankiya esiholele ekutheni abantu abasebenzisa Ithala, bangakwazi ukuthola imali yabo.Amakhosi aKwaZulu-Natal, ahlabe ikhwelo lokuthi uRamaphosa angenelele ngokushesha.UNtuli uthe uRamaphosa uthembise ukulusukumela udaba lweThala."Ngingasho ukuthi ingxoxo yami noRamaphosa ihambe kahle kakhulu. Uthembisile ukuthi uzoyibeka eqhulwini indaba yeThala.”Ithala noHulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal, bahlangabezane nembibizane ngesikhathi isicelo ala abebesifakile sikhishwa ohlwini lwamacala.Isicelo seThala, noHulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal, bekufanele silalelwe izolo kodwa sakhishwa ohlwini ngenxa yokuthi ijaji obekufanele lisilalele kuthiwe lisathathe ikhefu.Namhlanje kuzokuba nomhlangano wabameli lapho kuzonqunywa usuku olusha.USihlalo weNdlu yobuHoli boMdabu KwaZulu-Natal, Inkosi Sifiso Shinga, uthe udaba lweThala ludinga yena uqobo uRamaphosa, uNgqongqoshe wezeziMali uMnuz Enoch Godongwana, nomphathi weBhange loMbuso, uMnuz Lesetja Kganyago.UShinga uthe sebethathe isinqumo sokugovuza imiphakathi ukuba ibambe imibhikisho yokuphikisana nesinqumo sokuvalwa kweThala.
LIHLEHLELE uMashi 19, icala lokubulala owayeyisishoshovu se-MKP eCato Crest, eThekwini, elibhekene nabesilisa abathathu.Abamangalelwa abebevele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini, basolwa ngokudubula babulale uMnuz Mxolisi Zungu eCato Crest, ngoJuni, nyakenye.Kubamangalelwa kukhona uMnuz Sphamandla Vulindlela Hlongwane (41), okuthiwa ungumsolwa wokuqala. Kuvela ukuthi uphinde abeyinyanga, uneshibhi futhi unezindawo eziqashisayo.Ummangalelwa wesibili, uMnuz Ngcebo Treasure Luthuli (33), naye oneshibhi.Owesithathu uMnuz Thokozani Emmanuel Luthuli, yena kuthiwa uziphilisa ngokudayisa emgwaqweni.Ngesikhathi bevela izolo, uMbuso wenze isicelo sokuthi lihlehliswe njengoba kuvele ukuthi kusekhona uphenyo olushodayo.Imantshi ibe isilihlehlisela uMashi 19 icala, ukuze amaphenyi baqhubeke nophenyo.Ngosuku lwesigameko umufi wadutshulwa ngezikhathi zasekuseni, ehamba nenkosikazi yakhe emgwaqweni.Babebuya ukuhambisa ingane yabo enkulisa ngesikhathi ummangalelwa wokuqala ebaqhamukela ngemuva, wafika wadubula umufi, owavele washonela khona lapho.Ngaleso sikhathi, zaqina izinsolo zokuthi ukubulawa kwakhe kumayelana nezepolitiki njengoba kwakusanda kufa elinye ilungu le-MK kwenye ingxenye yeMayville, ngendlela engaqondakali, lisha nendlu.Nokho emva kokuboshwa kwabasolwa, kwabe sekuvela ukuthi ukubulawa kwakhe kuyamene nombango webhizinisi lokudayisa utshwala endaweni.
I-MK ithi ayizithathi kancane izinsolo zocansi ezibhekene nephini lomholi wenhlangano, uDkt John Hlophe.Okhulumela i-MK, uMnuz Nhlamulo Ndhlela, uthe izinsolo ezibhekene noHlophe zibucayi, wathi angeke bazizibe.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabe-Newsroom Afrika izolo.UHlophe usolwa ngokufuna ucansi kowayengumdidiyeli we-MK eMpumalanga, uNkk Mary Phadi.UNkk Phadi ufake isikhalazo asibhekise kumholi we-MK, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, lapho ekhala khona ngokuthi uHlophe wamthumela umyalezo phakathi kwamabili, embizela ehhotela.UHlophe wayekade ejutshwe eMpumalanga ukuba axazulule umdonsiswano wokuhola i-MK esifundazweni.UDKT John HlopheEmva kwalo mhlangano, i-MK yathatha isinqumo sokuxosha uNkk Phadi esikhundleni, kwafakwa u-Advocate Busisiwe Mkhwebane.UNkk Phadi ukholelwa ukuthi waxoshelwa ukuthi wanqaba ukuyolala noHlophe.Nokho uNdhlela uthe uHlophe uyaziphika izinsolo abekwa zona, kodwa wathi basalindele incazelo egcwele."Uthe awukho umyalezo awuthumelayo. Usazosichazela kahle okwenzeka. Ukuthi nje udaba luvele lwasehla ngaphezulu, sangalithola ithuba lokuthi asichazele konke okwenzeka. Zibucayi lezi zinsolo ezenziwe, sifuna ukuthola umnyombo wale ndaba.”UNdhlela uthe akufanele izinsolo ezibhekene noHlophe ziyamaniswe nokuxoshwa kukaNkk Phadi.UNdhlela uthe uNkk Phadi waxoshelwa ukunqwaha nemali etholwa yiqembu esiShayamthetho nokungaziphathi kahle."Kuyishwa ukuthi uNkk Phadi wala waphetha nemali yeqembu. Kwakungezona kuphela izinsolo zokungaphathi kahle imali yeqembu kodwa kwakukhona nezinsolo zokuthi wayesabisa amalungu e-MK. "Kuthiwa wayefika emihlanganweni nezinkabi, kukhona nezinsolo zokuthi wathengela amanye amalungu eqembu izinkabi. UNkk Phadi akekho msulwa. Into okufanele sizibuze yona ukuthi kungani le nto eyikhuluma manje? Ubekade ethuleleni sonke lesi sikhathi?”UNkk Phadi akagudluki ezinsolweni azenzile, njengoba ethe uzimisele ngisho ukufakwa emishinini ohlola ukuthi umuntu ukhuluma iqiniso yini.UNkk Phadi uthe akanendaba noma uHlophe engamumangalela enkantolo."Mhlawumbe leyo kungaba into enhle ngoba kungavela okuningi.”UNkk Phadi uthe ufuna ukuthi uHlophe athathelwe izinyathelo, kanti waziwa kakhulu embonini yezamaloli. Unenkampani yezokuthutha iBasadi Logistics.Uke wabamba izikhundla ezahlukene ezinhlanganweni zabamaloli okubalwa kuzo ukuba umengameli we-Truckers Association SA, ukuba usihlalo we-SA Network of Women in Transport, kanye nesokuba umkhulumeli we-Coal Transporters Forum.Akanawo umlando obambekayo kwezepolitiki. Uqale ukugqama ngesikhathi eqokelwa kwesokuhola i-MK eMpumalanga nasesiShayamthetho sesifundazwe.
UKUNYUKA kwezibalo zabafa ezingozini zomgwaqo eNingizimu Afrika, kwenze ukuthi abantu bazwakalise imibono ehlukene ngezindlela zokukunqanda.UNgqongqoshe wezokuThutha kuzwelonke uNkk Barbara Creecy, ekhipha izibalo kuleli sonto uthe kufe abantu abangu-1 502 emigwaqweni ngamaholidi nokuyisibalo esinyuke ngo-70, uma siqhathaniswa no-2023.Uthe abashayeli abangu-3 840, baboshelwe ukushayela bephuzile kwathi izimoto ezingu-16 000, zatholakala zingekho sesimeni sokuba semgwaqweni.Iphini likaCreecy, uMnuz Mkhuleko Hlengwa likhuluma kwiNewzroom Afrika kuleli sonto, liphakamise ukuthi kube khona intela eyengezwayo entengweni kaphethroli ezongena esikhwameni esinxephezela abalimala ezingozini zomgwaqo iRoad Accident Fund, nasemikhankasweni yezokuphepha.UHlengwa uthe uma wenza abantu bangene bagamanxe emaphaketheni bazocabangisisa ngendlela abaziphatha ngayo ngokuthi baphuza kuphi futhi kanjani.I-Automobile Assiciation (AA) ithe izingozi zidalwa nawukushoda kwezindlela zokuthutha, nokuguga kwemigwaqo."Uma kubhekwa le nkinga, kusemqoka ukuthi uhulumeni utshale imali engqalasizindeni yezokuthutha, unyuse amazinga omgwaqo futhi ukhuphule ukusebenza kwezinhlelo zokuqinisekisa ukulandelwa komthetho emgwaqweni. Lezi zinto zibalulekile ekuqinisekiseni isimo esinciphisa ukufa kwabantu okudalwa yiphutha labashayeli.”Ithe okunye wukuthi kube yimpoqo ukuhlolwa kwezimoto minyaka yonke okuhambisana, nokuvuselelwa kwamalayisensi.I-Retail Motor Industry Organisation (RMI) nayo ihambe emazwini e-AA ngokuthi kumele kuhlolwe izimoto ngaso sonke isikhathi.Isikhulu sayo uMnuz Ipeleng Mabusela, sithe kumele kushintshwe indlela abashayeli abaziphatha ngayo kuqine nomthetho."Ngaphezu kokufundisa okuqhubekayo, ukushintsha indlela abashayeli abaziphatha ngayo, sikholwa wukuthi kuningi okumele kwenziwe ikakhulu okuthinta ukunakekelwa kwezimoto nokuba esimeni esifanele sokuba semgwaqweni,” kusho uMabusela.
UMHOLI osanda kuqokwa njengelungu lePhalamende elimele iMK Party futhi owayengumholi weSA Rainbow Alliance (SARA), uNkk Colleen Makhubele, uthi waqala ukulaxaza iqembu lakhe, wajoyina iMKP ngoba womabili aqembu anombono ofanayo. Ngokusho kukaMakhubele, wasungula iSARA ngombono wokuhlanganisa amaqembu abantu nabaholi abampisholo ngokukhuluma ngezwi elilodwa. Nakuba kunjalo, uthe iqembu lalingakwazi ukufeza leli phupho.Engxoxweni abenayo ngoLwesine, uMakhubele uchazile ukuthi wahehwa yiMKP ngoba inemibono efanayo nokuzibophezela kwimigomo yoguquko, ubulungiswa kwezomnotho, inhlalakahle nenqubekela phambili.Uchazwe wubuholi beqembu, ikakhulu uMengameli weMMP uMnuz Jacob Zuma, nesifiso sokuhlanganisa zonke izinhlaka nabaholi abanenqubekela phambili.KWETHULWE amalungu amasha esigungu esiphezulu seMK Party KwaZulu -Natal, okuwumcimbi obuseCoastlands Hotel, eMhlanga ngoLwesihlanu. Bekukhona nabaholi abaphezulu okubalwa nomengameli waleli qembu uMnuz Jacob Zuma Isithombe: SIBONELO NGCOBO"Umbono ofanayo ukuthi iSARA inombono ofanayo ongihehele kwiMK Party...isifiso sabo ukubumba nokuhlanganisa amazwi abantu abamnyama,” kusho uMakhubele. Ungomunye wabazofungiswa njengamalungu ePhalamende ngoLwesibili. Okhulumela iMKP, uMnuz Nhlamulo Ndhlela, uthe uMakhubele uyisisebenzi somphakathi esineziqu zeMBA, ngakho uzoletha amava ekuphathweni kukahulumeni nobuholi. Uke waba nguSomlomo womkhandlu nosiHlalo wosiHlalo kwiCity of Johannesburg, waba wusihlalo weBhodi leMetropolitan Trading Company futhi waba yiNon-Eecutive Director nosiHlalo weBhodi le-South African Post Office (SAPO).UNdhlela uthe uMakhubele nozakwabo, u- Adil Nchabeleng, abazofungiswa, bazoqhubekisela phambili umbono weMKP wokufukula umnotho nenhlalo yabantu futhi bagxile ekuthathweni komhlaba ngaphandle kwesinxephezelo, ukufukulwa kwentsha nokunye. Lezi zikhala zivuleke emuva kokumiswa kwamalungu ePhalamende awu-18.Khonamanjalo, u-Advocate Dali Mpofu uqokwe njengosihlalo weKomiti lokuQondisa ubuGwegwe, kwathi iPhini likaMengameli uDkt John Hlophe laqokwa njengosihlalo weKomiti lokuDlulisa amaCala. UNOBHALA Jikelele we-ANC uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, usekhumbuze amaqembu ababambisene nawo kuhulumeni ukuthi asikho isivumelwano abanaso sokuthi kumele baqale bavumelane nawo ngaphambi kokuphasisa umthetho.UMbalula uthe asikho isidingo sokuthi kusuke umsindo ngokusayinwa komthetho wokubuyiswa komhlaba."Asinaso isivumelwano sokuthi kumele sivumelane namaqembu esibambisene nawo kuhulumeni ngaphambi kokuba umengameli asayine umthetho. Asikho isidingo sokuthi kube nomsindo ngoba lo mthetho wadlula kuzona zonke izigaba,” kusho uMbalula.Ukusho lokhu ekhuluma esithangamini nabezindaba ngokuphume emhlanganweni weLekgotla.Ubuye wadlulisa amazwi enduduzo emindenini yamasosha ashone eDRC.Uthe la masosha ayengayile kuleliya lizwe ukuyolwa kodwa ayeyoqinisekisa ukuthi kunokuthula.UMbalula uveze ukuthi kuzoba nesithangami nabezindaba lapho uMnyango wezokuVikela kuleli, uzochazela isizwe ngokwenzekile."Afe engamaqhawe la masosha asale enkundleni. Abengayile eDRC ukuyovikela izinto ezithile kodwa abeyoqinisekisa ukuthi kunokuthula,” kusho uMbalula.
I-IFP izoqhakambisa igalelo lomsunguli wenhlangano, Inkosi Mangosuthu Buthelezi, ochungechungeni lwemicimbi yokugubha iminyaka ewu-50 yasungulwa.Imicimbi izoqala ngenyanga okwasungulwa ngayo i-IFP, uMashi, bese idonsa unyaka wonke.Lokhu kushiwo uMengameli we-IFP, uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa, ngesikhathi ethula ngokusemthethweni izinhlelo zokugubha iminyaka ewu-50 kwasungulwa inhlangano, eThekwini ngoMsombuluko.UHlabisa uthe kule micimbi bazoqhakambisa okuhle okwenziwe iqembu kanye noButhelezi.I-IFP yasungulwa ngoMashi 21, ngo-1975, KwaNzimela, eMelmoth.Imigubho ye-IFP izoqala khona KwaNzimela, ngoMashi 21.UHlabisa uthe bazokuba nomkhuleko kule ndawo ozolandelwa ukubekwa kwezimbali elibeni lengqalabutho yenhlangano, uBishop Alphaeus Zulu, owabamba iqhaza elikhulu ekusungulweni kwe-IFP.Umcimbi omkhulu weminyaka ewu-50 uzokuba soLundi, ngoMashi 23, enkundleni yezemidlalo iPrince Mangosuthu Buthelezi Stadium."Leli kuyokuba idili likaMkhipheni. Kuyokuba ingqayizivele lapho siyokube khona sibonga abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ngokwethemba i-IFP kanye nombono woMntwana waKwaPhindangene.”UHlabisa uthe phakathi kukaMashi noMeyi bazokuba nemigubho kuzo zonke izifunda zalapha KwaZulu-Natal, bese kuthi ngoJuni kube nemicimbi yentsha."Ngo-Agasti kuzokuba nemicimbi yophiko lwabesifazane lapho khona sizokube sikhumbula iqhaza elabanjwa abantu besifazane ngesikhathi kulwelwa inkululeko.”Omunye umcimbi omkhulu ozokwenziwa i-IFP uzokuba ngoJulayi 5, eNgwavuma.UHlabisa uthe kulo mcimbi bayokube bebonga igalelo likaButhelezi owalwela ukuthi le ndawo ingafakwa ngaphansi kwezwe elingumakhelwane, iSwatini."Uhulumeni wobandlululo wase udize ngayo iNgwavuma, wayinika izwe iSwatini. UMntwana waKwaPhindangene walwa, kwaba necala elaze laphelela eNkantolo yamaCala aDlulisiwe. Ukube uMntwana waKwaPhindangene akazange alwe ngabe iNgwavuma ingaphansi kweSwatini. Abantu baseNgwavuma ngabe abanabo ubuzwe balapha eNingizimu Afrika.”Kuzophinde kube nemicimbi ezokwenziwa eGoli, lapho kuzokhunjulwa khona labo abashona ngesikhathi kunodlame lwezepolitiki.Iqembu lizophinde lihloniphe izinqalabutho zalo.UHlabisa uphinde wamemezela ukuthi usuku lokuzalwa kukaButhelezi, u-Agasti 27, sebezolugubha minyaka yonke.Uthe ngo-Agasti 27 abaholi benhlangano bazonikela ngesikhathi sabo emphakathini, belekelela ngalokho abangalekelela ngakho.INKOSI MANGOSUTHU BUTHELEZI
UPHIKO oluphenya amacala akhethekile iSIU luzophenya ngamathenda amathathu kaMasipala waKwaDukuza.Ngokwesaziso esikwigazethi kahulumeni ngoLwesihlanu, i-SIU izobheka ukukhishwa kwamathenda amathathu bese iphenya ukuthi lolu hlelo beluhambisana yini nomthetho futhi luqhutshwa ngendlela.Lapha kubalwa amathenda ango-2018 no-2019, inkontileka yokulungiswa komgwaqo kaMasipala waKwaDukuza (KDM) kusukela ngo-2018 kanye nezinkontileka ezimbili zokuhlinzeka ngogesi kusukela ngo-2019.Sekuhlangene, amanani amathenda afinyelela emashumini ezigidi zamarandi.I-SIU iwuhlaka lombuso olwakhelwe ukuphenya "izinsolo ezibucayi zenkohlakalo, ukungenzi ngendlela efanele kanye nokuba budedengu ekuphathweni kwezikhungo zikahulumeni,” okuhlanganisa omasipala.
KUSINDA kwehlela kwezinye zezikole KwaZulu-Natal, ezisabhekene nenkinga yokungabinamali ngoba uMnyango wezeMfundo esifundazweni, usazikweleta imali yama-norms and standards.Kulezi zikole kuthiwa kusize imiphakathi esike izikhotha zotshani ngenxa yokwena ukuze kuvulwe izikole kubukeka.Othishanhloko kuthiwa benza imizamo kanti abanye basebenzisa imali yabo ukuze kusebenzeke ezikoleni.UNobhala we-Sadtu KwaZulu-Natal, uNksz Nomarashiya Caluza, uthe umnyango usakweleta izikole le mali njengoba ungakazikhokheli.Uthe kusadonswa ngodizili ezikoleni futhi kusize imiphakathi yasika utshani, othishanhloko bashaya amaphakethe ukuze kusebenzeke.Abanye uthe baye komashonisa ukuze bakwazi ukusebenza ngoba ugesi namanzi akukhokhelwe."Saba nomhlangano nomnyango ngalezi zinto ngaphambi kokuba kuvulwe izikole kodwa wasithembisa ukuthi okungenani ekupheleni kukaMashi, uzobe usukhokhe yonke into ngaphambi kokungena kwesabelomali esisha. Zikhona nezinye izinto esavumelana ngazo nomnyango ukuze izikole ziqale ukusebenza,” kusho uNksz Caluza.Uthe bazoba nomunye umhlangano ngesonto elizayo ukuthola inqubekela phambili kuwona."Sifuna ukuthola ibanga eselihanjiwe emizameni yokuthola imali. Kunzima ezikoleni angifuni ukudlala ngawe, othisha basebenza noma kunzima.”Ubuye wakhala nangosopolitiki abasesiShayamthetho, abajahe ukuvakashela izikole ngeledlule bemosha imali engabe iye kwezemfundo.Uthe opolitiki bayazi ngosizi lo mnyango njengabantu abaphasisa isabelomali somnyango kodwa akukho abakwenzayo ukusombulula inkinga."Siyazi uhlelo lokuvakashela izikole kuyalalwa, kusetshenziswa izimoto abakhokhelwayo ngokuthi bahambe ngazo beya ezikoleni. Leyo mali bekumele iqoqwe bese ifakwa ezikoleni kunokuthi kwehliwe, kwenyukwa ekubeni kunenkinga enkulu ezikoleni zesifundazwe,” kusho uNksz Caluza.Uthe yingakho beyiSadtu bebenemibhikisho ezindaweni ezehlukene ngeledlule lapho bekuhambele khona amalungu esiShayamthetho.Minyaka yonke uSomlomo wesiShayamthetho kubalwa namalungu kanjalo nabaphathiswa nondunankulu, bahambela izikole beyohlola ukuthi kuvulwe kanjani.Nakulo nyaka kube esifanayo njengoba amalungu abeholwa nguSomlomo neKhabhinethi abehambele ezikoleni ezehlukene.Kuzoqoqwa umbiko ozothulwa esiShayamthetho ukuze kubhungwe okutholwe yilawa malungu.Inhloko yomnyango uMnuz Nathi Ngcobo, ihlale ikuveza ukuthi babhekene nengwadla yemali emnyangweni.
KUKHALWA ngezigidi zamarandi ezisetshenziswe uNgqongqoshe wezokuVikela, uNkk Angie Motshekga, ehambela amazwe ahlukene ekubeni amasosha ajutshwe eDemocratic Republic of Congo (DRC) efele ngaphansi kwezimo ezimbi.I-ActionSA ithe kuyashaqisa ukuthi uNkk Motshekga usebenzise imali engaphezu kuka-R10 million ezinyangeni ezine ekubeni kunezinsolo zokuthi amasosha ashonele eDRC aphelelwe yizinhlamvu ngesikhathi etholene neqembu lamavukela-mbuso, i-M23.Kushone amasosha akuleli ayisishiyagalolunye, kwalimala angu-15, ngesikhathi etholene ne-M23.USotswebhu we-ActionSA ePhalamende, uNkk Lerato Ngobeni, uthe kuyabaxaka ukuthi uNkk Motshekga usebenzise imali engaka ekubeni kunemibiko yokuthi amasosha akuleli ashoda ngezinsiza eDRC.UNkk Ngobeni uthe impendulo kaNkk Motshekga yasePhalamende iveza ukuthi usebenzise u-R10.4 million ehambela amazwe ahlukene ezinyangeni ezine."Kule mali kukhona u-R4 million kukhokhelwa amabhanoyi ngesikhathi ehambele amazwe angaphandle, u-R2.1 million wokuqasha izimoto kanye nenye imali ayisebenzise ehambela izindawo ezahlukene lapha eNingizimu Afrika. "Akwamukelekile ukuthi amasosha ethu athunyelwa empini enganazo izinsiza ezanele, ngapha ungqongqoshe uhamba etetemuka. Imindeni eyisishiyagalolunye isemanzini njengoba sikhuluma kuyimanje.”UNkk Ngobeni uthe bafuna kubuyiswe amasosha asele eDRC kuphinde kumiswe ukujutshwa kwamasosha kwezinye izindawo.Isimo sishubile eDRC njengoba i-M23 isanda kukhipha umyalelo wokuba amasosha aseDRC nawakuleli atshalwe kuleliya zwe ukuba abeke izikhali edolobheni iGoma.I-M23 ithe isilidlile leli dolobha.Maningi amaqembu aseyalelele ukuba kubuyiswe ngokushesha amasosha akuleli ajutshwe eDRC.Kula maqembu kubalwa i-MK, EFF ne-DA. I-DA ifuna ukuba uNkk Motshekga achaze ePhalamende ngokuqhubeka eDRC.UNkk Motshekga ubehambele amasosha ajutshwe eDRC, ngeledlule.Okhulumela umbutho wezokuVikela wakuleli, uMnuz Simphiwe Dlamini, uthe uNkk Motshekga uzoqala azise uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, ngakubonile ohambweni lakhe.UDlamini uthe ngokwazi kwabo, amasosha ajutshwe eDRC aphephile."Ngikhulumile nomunye wokhomanda washo ukuthi basenkanjini yabo, wathi baphephile.”
ALUGOBI uphondo kuNgqongqoshe wezeMpilo, uDkt Aaron Motsoaledi, yize iqonga ingcindezi efakwa odokotela abangaqashiwe ezweni.Kusuka ngeledlule esifundazweni iMpumalanga nase-Eastern Cape odokotela abangaqashiwe baqale imibhikisho. Nayizolo bebebhekisha abaKwaZulu-Natal enhlokodolobha yesifundazwe i-Pietermaritzburg. Ndawo zonke bami ngelokuthi bagxoba itoyitoyi ngoba kushoda abasebenzi kwezempilo okubeka engcupheni impilo yeziguli ezisuke zifuna usizo ezikhungweni zikahulumeni.UMotsoaledi uthe ukuze baqashe odokotela kumele bavunyelwe yizimo."Sibhekene nengwadla yokunciphisa izindleko, ukuncishiswa kwesabelomali kukhinyabeza kakhulu amandla ethu okuqasha odokotela futhi kusithikameza ezintweni eziningi."Yebo, siyavumelana nezikhalo zodokotela kodwa ekugcineni awukwazi ukunikeza umsebenzi ungenazo izindlela zokukhokhela abantu, manje yileso simo esikuso,” usho kanje.Ngokusho kukaMotsoaledi, abafundi abafundele ubudokotela abaphothule i-internship nomsebenzi womphakathi bangodokotela abaphelele abangaya noma yikuphi bayophanta umsebenzi."Uma uMbuso ukhangisa izikhala ungasifaka isicelo. Uma umsebenzi ukhangiswa emkhakheni ozimele, ungafaka isicelo. Nxa ufuna ukuvula indawo yakho uzimele njengodokotela, ungakwenza nalokho.”UMotsoaledi ukukhabe ngazo zombili ukuthi kufanele odokotela baqashwe wuhulumeni nxa sebeqede uhlelo lokusebenza emphakathini ngokwe-internship.Okhulumela i-SA Medical Association Trade Union (Samatu), uDkt Kenneth Sithole, uthe ngemashi yayizolo eMphithi bahlose ukuthola izimpendulo ngokubhuquza kwabo emakhaya neziqu zobudokotela.Uthe inkinga wukuthi kunesidingo sodokotela esisephezulu kakhulu ezweni.Uthe ukungaqashwa kwabo kusho ukuthi iziguli eziningi zisazophucwa ilungelo lazo lokuthola usizo lwezempilo.Babalelwa ku-630 odokotela asebeqeqeshwe ngokugcwele abangaqashiwe ezweni.INGXENYE yodokotela abangaqashiwe abangaphansi kwenyunyana iSamatu Isithombe: SITHUNYELWE
ZIKHALA ezimathonsi izisulu zasezingxenyeni ezahlukene zaseNanda ezithi sezike zagileka ngenxa yobugebengu obudla lubi kule ndawo.Isolezwe Ngempelasonto likhulume nezisulu ngemuva kwesigameko esibe sematheni sokubulawa kwabayisihlanu ngeledlule ebebesolwa ngokuhlaliswa lubhojozi komphakathi waseBhambayi, eNanda.Umphakathi uvuke umbhejazane wazibambela mathupha kulaba. Kwabe sekuboshwa abangu-12. UMnuz Zakhele Hlongwane wakhona eBhambayi uthe ngonyaka odlule kwagqekezwa kwakhe kwathathwa yonke into.Uthe izinswelaboya kazigcinanga lapho zaphinde zamshaya zamlimaza kabi waze wabuya nasesibhedlela."Ngathi uma ngiyovula icala emaphoyiseni angitshela ukuthi mangibuye ngibuye asematasa nokuthile. Ngathatha isinqumo sokuthi ngingabe ngisabuya ngavele ngaduba,'' usho kanjena.UMswawenkosi Ndimande waseMaoti uthe okwamehlela uyokuxoxela amagwababa echobana.Uveze ukuthi ngoJuni ngonyaka odlule kwangena abasolwa abayisikhombisa emzini wakhe bambhaxabula kabuhlungu, bangagcina lapho bathatha nemali yakhe engu-R6000."Okungiphatha kabuhlungu ukuthi akukho amaphoyisa angisiza ngakho. Lavulwa icala kwathi ngemuva kwezinyanga ezimbili kwathiwa selisuliwe leli cala,'' usho kanjena.Omunye wesifazane ocele ukuba ligodlwe igama lakhe uthe kubo ngoJanuwari kwagasela abesilisa ababili babaphoqa ukuba bakhumule. Uveze ukuthi ungumhlali waseBhambayi,Uthe vele bahlala bathathu bangabantu besifazane. Uthe basinda ngokulambisa ngoba omakhelwane bezwa bekhala bafika bazosiza."Namanje akuvumi ukuthi ngilukhohlwe loluya suku. Sobathathu sase sikhunyuliswe izingubo kwasiza khona ukufika komphakathi,'' kuchaza owesifazane.Úlimise ngesihloko elokuthi itshe limi ngothi eNanda. Uchaze le ndawo njengegubuzelwe yizinswelaboya ezinesihluku futhi ezingenandaba namuntu.UMnuz Mzwandile Dube waseMaoti uveze ukuthi eminyakeni eyedlule bangaphezulu kuka-59 abantu ababe yizisulu bebanjwa inkunzi njalo ekuseni uma beya emsebenzini.Uthe kungcono manje ngenxa yokuthi baba nomhlangano bewumphakathi bavumelana ngokuthi makube khona abesilisa abaphelezela abantu uma beya emsebenzini.Kunomunye wesilisa oyingxenye yabasolwa abangu-12 ababoshelwe ukubulala abahlanu okuvela ukuthi bangena emzini wakhe badlwengula amadodakazi akhe amabili phambi kwakhe.
UHLAKA olubhekelele ukusebenza kwemigwaqo ezweni, i-South African National Roads Agency SOC Limited (SANRAL), selumemezele ukuthi kuzovalwa umgwaqo u-N3 eduze kwePeacevale Interchange ngenxa yohlelo lokuwulungisa.Isazi sohlaka olubhekelele ukwakha nokulungisa imigwaqo kwa-SANRAL, uMnuz Jason Lowe, sithe lolu hlelo luzoqala ngoLwesine lukaFebhuwari 13 phakathi kuka-2:30 kuya ku-3 ntambama, ohlelweni lokulungisa u-N3 i-Section 2 Realignment Project.ULowe uthe ukuvalwa kuka-N3 kuzokwenzeka phakathi kwalapho okwehlukana khona u-M13 no-N3 noHammarsdale Interchange. Kuzokwenzeka okufanayo naphakathi kwe-Meadway Road ne-Thousand Hills Street Intersection nakwi-Peacevale Interchange."Ithimba lethu lesiminyaminya esenzeka emigwaqeni, libambisene nohlaka oluqondene nokusebenza komgwaqo, lizobe likhona ukuqapha isimo nokuqinisekisa ukuthi akubi bikho ukuphazamiseka emigwaqeni ngalezi zinsuku,” kusho uLowe.Selulonke uhlelo lokuvala imigwaqo lumi kanjena:NgoLwesine ngoFebhuwari 13 kuzovlwa u-N3 ngo-2:30 kuya ku-2:45 ntambama, kuthi kusukela ngo-2:45 kuya ku-3 ntambama kuhlanzwe u-N3 bese uyavulwa ngokuphelele ngo-3 ntambama.ULowe uthe umgwaqo u-R103 wona uzobe usebenza, nokho okulindeleke ukuthi abazowusebenzisa bambazeleke ngenxa yokuthi ngeke ukwazi ukumumatha umthamo wezimoto okulindeleke ukuthi zibe kuwona ngaleso sikhathi.Uthe nokho kungenzeka kube nezinguquko ezikhathini abazovala le migwaqo ngazo, kuncike ekutheni isimo semvula siyobe sinjani ngalelo langa."Sicela ukuthi abashayeli bezimoto babekezelelane ngaleso sikhathi futhi bagweme ukuba kule migwaqo uma kungekho okubaphoqayo ngaleso sikhathi,” kusho uLowe.
UMNDENI womfundi waseMkomaas Secondary, uLethokuhle Simphiwe Gumede, ugqemeke udume lwengozi kungakapholi nezilonda zokudlula kwelungu lalo emhlabeni. Ngokusho komthombo ongaphakathi emndenini, bese ziphothuliwe izinhlelo zokufihlwa kukaLethokuhle (14) kodwa kwathi ngomzuzu wokugcina kwafika omunye umndeni wathi kungenzeka ukuthi isidumbu esitholakele ngesawo."Wabhaliswa ngoLwesibili, kwafika umyalezo othi kunabanye abathi nabo banomuntu obalahlekele eThekwini. Umndeni uzokwenza ulibofuzo emakhazeni ngoMsombuluko. "Kwathiwa uma sinaye udokotela wethu ozimele singayisa amasampula ethu, nohulumeni emakhazeni uzothatha awakhe amasampula olibofuzo. Ngakho sisalinde into efana naleyo. Kunzima-ke ngoba bese sizitshela ukuthi sesikhale sadela kwase kuvela isimo esifana nalesi,” kusho owomndeni ocingweni, kodwa elingatholakalanga igama lakhe ngenxa yokuthi ubesaxinekile. Uthe uzoze akhulume kahle ngalolu daba namhlanje. Isidumbu sikaLethokuhle waseDanganya, eMgababa, size satholakala ngoLwesibili ngezithuba zawo-11.50 ekuseni, emuva kokuba emuke nolwandle ngeSonto eledlule, ngezithuba zabo-12.20 emini.Umkhulu kamufi, uMnuz Sindile Gumede, uthe uLethokuhle utholakale elinyazwe kabi wulwandle."Umndeni nezihlobo basathukile futhi akukamukeleki ukuhamba kwakhe umfana. Nokho-ke sibonga ukumthola." ULethokuhle uphenduke iqhawe ehlenga umngani wakhe obemuka kodwa yena akabange esaluthola usizo, wagcina ehambe kanjalo namagagasi. Ngokusho kukaGumede, umzukulu wakhe umukiswe ngamagagasi asolwandle olungasemtholampilo eDanganya Area 5A."Zithi izingane zakwamakhelwane bezinyenyile ziyobhukuda. Kube sekumuka ingane yakwaMsomi engumngani wabo. OLetho nabanye basalile ngenkathi abanye beyobiza umzali walo omukayo yilapho uLetho ebe nozwelo, wangena wakhipha umngani wakhe. Ngebhadi yena akazange esakwazi ukuphuma. Bathi bambone esephakamisa isandla, efuna usizo, ngebhadi bona abakwazanga ukumsiza.""Silusizi emndenini wakwaGumede ngomzukulu wethu okunguyena omdala kunabanye ekhaya," kuphetha uGumede. Kuze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela kungakatholakali okhulumela umndeni omunye nokuthi ungowakwabani.
UHLELO lokufunda nokufundisa selufana nokuqwala intaba iKilimanjaro esikoleni saseMandeni, eMachibini iTshana High School, ngenxa yesimo esibi isikole esikusona.Umthombo othembekile nowazi konke okwenzeka kulesi sikole esakhele u-ward 10, uhlebele Isolezwe Ngempelasonto ukuthi isisusa sezinkinga sidalwe yizikhukhula ezahlasela ekupheleni kuka-2022, nezashiya zicekele phansi uphahla lwaso, okwenza ukufunda kungenzeki ngendlela efanele nejwayelekile."Leso simo sadala umonakalo omkhulu kakhulu esikoleni, kangangokuthi kwacekeleka phansi cishe wonke amagumbi esikole, kubalwa negumbi eligcina izincwadi zesikole ezisetshenziswa ngabafundi ukufunda. Lokho kuphoqa ukuthi ubuholi besikole buhlale bufaka ama-oda ezincwadi njalo uma kuqala unyaka, nazo ezifika zingeneli wonke umfundi."Okunye futhi wukuthi njengoba kwacekeleka phansi uphahla lwesikole, akufundeki kulama gumbi onakala, okwenza ukuthi uhlelo lokufundela komahambanendlwana abafika naboMnyango weMfundo, nalo lungasizi kangako ngoba abafundi abeneli kahle kubona, futhi uma kushisa ilanga kakhulu, abafundi abalawuleki kahle, bekhala ngokushisa,” kulandisa umthombo.Uqhuba umthombo, udalule ukuthi okunye okufane nokuthela upelepele esilondeni, wukuthi ngonyaka odlule kube nenkinga endaweni, kuqhuma isiphehlimandla sikagesi, okudale ukuthi kungabi bikho ugesi kulesi sikole kusukela ngoJuni nyakenye. "Lokho nakho kuphazamisa kakhulu izinhlelo zokufunda ngazo zonke izinsuku njengoba njalo uma kunento okumele yenziwe edinga ugesi, kuphoqeleka ukuthi kuthunywe izingane ziyoyenza kwamakhelwane owayenguthisa wakhona kulesi sikole, okubeka impilo yabafundi engcupheni njengoba uma beya lapho abasuke beyogaya amaphepha noma yini okunye, basuke bephethe ama-laptop esikole,” kusho umthombo.Omunye wabazali bezingane ezifunda kulesi sikole, naye ocele ukungadalulwa, uthe nakuba uMnyango weMfundo uzamile ukulungisa izinto ngokunikela ngamagumbi okufundela angomahambanendlwana, kepha akwanele ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukufunda kwezingane kuhleleke.Uthe: "Nokuthi enye inkinga enkulu ekhona wukuthi njengoba lama gumbi okubambisa enganeli wonke umfundi, kukhona abafundi abafunda kuwo lamagumbi angenalo uphahla, esingazi ukuthi kuphephe kangakanani njengoba kungakalungiswa. Nalokhu kukagesi kubi kakhulu njengoba kwenza izinhlelo zokufundisa abafundi zingenzeki kahle, kubalwa nezinhlelo zabafundi baka-matric abafunda ubusuku bonke okungasenzeki.”Lesi sikole sikweziphasa kahle ku-matric eMandeni kwisekethe yazo, njengoba nyakenye silale endaweni yesithathu ngo-86% kanti futhi eminyakeni emithathu sihlale sikhona ezikoleni ezinhlanu ezihamba phambili kwabebanga lokugcina endaweni.Ngonyaka odlule besinabafundi abawu-952, nothisha abawu-25.Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kwekhansela lendawo okwakhiwe kuyo isikole, uMnuz Simphiwe Mdunge, kanjalo naboMnyango weMfundo eyisiSekelo, igcine ingaphumelelanga.
UWUSOLA ekhaya umkhuba umndeni wowesifazane wasoNgoye, eMpangeni, onguthisha okuthiwa unyamalale ngasekupheleni konyaka odlule eya kwinhlolokhono.UNksz Gloria Fikile Nxele (54) kuthiwa wagcinwa umndeni wakhe ngoNovemva 22, nyakenye, eya kwinhlololwazi eyayizokuba ngo-10 ekuseni eNgalangala Primary, eSikhaleni.Indodana yakhe, uMnuz Nduduzo Mzimela ilandisa Isolezwe, ithe kwenzeka okungajwayelekile ngesikhathi unina engabuyi kwinhlololwazi, ekubeni ebashayele ucingo wathi akulethwe isikhwama semali esinekhadi lempesheni likanina, uNkk Elsie Nxele (84)."Okwasixaka ukuthi afone ngenombolo efihliwe (private number) ngesikhathi ethi akuthunyelwe ingane (16) ilethe lesi sikhwama ngaseNyuvesi yaseZululand (oNgoye). Wakucacisa ukuthi umuntu ozothatha isikhwama enganeni akuyena kodwa owesilisa, amchaza ukuthi ugqoke kanjani,” kusho uMzimela.Uthe yathunyelwa ingane, yamnika lona wesilisa, okuthiwa wavele waphela emehlelweni, esiphithiphithini sezitshudeni zenyuvesi."Akabanga esabuya umama. Imali yempesheni kagogo yakhishwa yonke ezinsukwini ezimbalwa ezalandela,” kubeka uMzimela, othe babe sebekhethe ukulivala ikhadi lempesheni kagogo.Uqhube wathi babe sebethola izingcingo zivela kowesilisa ongaziwa, ethi abamfakele u-R15 000 ukuze adedele uNksz Nxele."Kwathi uma ebona ukuthi kuqhubeka izinsuke singawufaki, washaya ucingo wathi umama sesiyomthola emfuleni okhona ngasoNgoye, iMangezi, umbulele wamfaka khona,” usho kanje, wathi amaphoyisa abheka lapho kodwa lutho ukumthola unina.Ube eseveza ukuthi nakuba unina engenazitha kodwa sikhona isihlobo abasisolayo, esingazange siphatheke kahle, ugogo wakhe esikhomba indlela emva kokungaziphathi kahle ekhaya."Sinayo imizindlo yokuthi mhlawumbe ubengamenzakalisa umama, ukuze ugogo ezwe ubuhlungu ngoba nguye kuphela ingane yentombazane anayo,” usho kanjena.Uthe ukhona umuntu olapha ngamanzi, unina agonyuluka kuye, eyolanda ichibi ngaphambi kwenhlololwazi, ukuthi nakuba ezoya kuyo kodwa ushiywa yigazi, wathi bagcina bethola nokuthi ayikho inhlololwazi eyayikhona eNgalangala ngosuku lwesigameko. Kodwa umthumbi wasebenzisa nje ulwazi analo lokuthi umgilwa kade ayefaka ama-CV ezikoleni ezehlukene.Uveze ukuthi wayekade esefundise iminyaka eyevile kwengu-15, kodwa walahlekelwa umsebenzi ngo-2021, emva kokushaya kanzima ingane."Isitifiketi sakhe kasidatshulwanga, yikho ebesaqhubeka nokufaka ama-CV omsebenzi ezikoleni ezehlukene,” kusho uMzimela.Uthe bayafisa owenze lokhu akhulule unina abuye eze ekhaya ngoba abakutholi ukuphumula njengoba engaziwa ukuthi ukuphi.Uveze nokuthi kungenzeka ukuthi indaba inemali yefa lendodana kagogo, uMnuz Msawenkosi Nxele, eshone nyakenye, kade isebenza eTronox."Yize umalume eshone enezingane ezine kepha nogogo kukhona imadlama ayitholile ngoba umalume ubemondla. Manje sisola nokuthi umuntu othumbe umama ulobizela le mali encane etholwe wugogo,” kusho uMzimelaUthe ngenxa yokuthunjwa kukanina impilo kayiseyinhle kuninakhulu, uhlukumezeke kakhulu. Uthe nezifo ezingamahlalakhona sezimi ngenhla kuye futhi usekhohlwa kakhulu kunakuqala.Kushaye isikhathi sokushicilela amaphoyisa engakaphenduli ngalolu daba.
INYUNYANA emele odokotela kuleli i-South African Medical Association Trade Union (Samutu) izoba nemashi namuhla ikhala ngokukhula kwesibalo sodokotela abangaqashiwe ezweni.Le nyunyana izoba nemashi namuhla eMgungundlovu njengoba ikhala ngokuthi ukungaqashwa kodokotela kuleli kunomthelela wokungalethwa kahle kwezidingo zezempilo.Okhulumela le nyunyana, uDkt Kenneth Sithole ekhuluma neSolezwe, uthe ngale mashi bahlose ukuthola izimpendulo mayelana nokungasebenzi kodokotela."Kufanele sithole izimpendulo ezifanele nezicacile mayelana nokungasebenzi kodokotela ekubeni isidingo sodokotela sisephezulu kakhulu. Kuzosiza ukukhanyisela umphakathi wonkana ngezinkinga ezibhekene nomkhakha wezempilo nokuthi uhulumeni akukho akwenzayo ukubhekana nalezi zinkinga," kusho uSithole.Uthe ukungaqashwa kodokotela kusho ukuthi iziguli eziningi zisazophucwa ilungelo lazo lokuthola usizo lwezempilo."Iziguli eziningi zisazolinda isikhathi eside ngoba bambalwa odokotela abakhona. Lokhu kusho ukuthi iziguli zisazoshona ngenxa yezizathu zokufa ezingagwemeka ngenxa yokungabi bikho kodokotela ngezikhathi zezimo eziphuthumayo. Uhulumeni akenzi lutho ukubhekana nokushoda kwabasebenzi emkhakheni wezempilo," usho kanje.Uthe imashi isemqoka kakhulu."Le mashi ibalulekile ngoba akuyona nje kuphela eyokulwa nokuntuleka kwemisebenzi yodokotela kodwa eyokukhulumela iziguli emakhaya okuyizo ezibhekene nemiphumela emibi ehambisana nalezi zinkinga ezingaxazululwa," ubeke kanje.Uthe balindele ukuthi le mashi ibe nomthelela ikakhulukazi ekuqwashiseni umphakathi ngokunganaki kukahulumeni ekuxazululeni izinkinga ezibucayi futhi kwenze nohulumeni abone isidingo sokuthatha izinqumo ezifanelekile.Babalelwa ku-630 odokotela asebeqeqeshwe ngokugcwele abangaqashiwe ezweni.

UMHOLI we-MK oqavile usolwa ngokuqhuba umkhankaso wokugudluza esikhundleni owesifazane owanqaba ukuba baye ocansini.Obewumdidiyeli we-MK eMpumalanga, uNkk Mary Phadi, usole umholi wenhlangano osePhalamende ngokuqhuba umkhankaso wokuba akhishwe esikhundleni ngenxa yokuthi wanqaba ukulala naye.Lokhu ukusho encwadini ayibhekise emholini weqembu, uMnuz Jacob Zuma.UNkk Phadi usanda kuxoshwa kwesokuba umdidiyeli we-MK eMpumalanga, kwase kufakwa u-Advocate Busisiwe Mkhwebane. Le nhlangano yaphinde yamxosha uNkk Phadi ekuholeni iqembu esiShayamthetho saseMpumalanga.Nokho uNkk Phadi wakuphonsela inselelo ukukhishwa kwakhe kulezi zikhundla, inkantolo yavumelana naye.Nokho kunomdonsiswano ngokubuyela kwakhe ezikhundleni njengoba i-MK isiphonsela inselelo isinqumo senkantolo.Encwadini ebonwe yiSolezwe, uNkk Phadi uthe izinkinga zakhe zaqala mhla enqaba ukuya ocansini nalo mholi.UNkk Phadi uthe lo mholi wamcela ukuba bachithe ubusuku ehhotela emva komhlangano weqembu owawuseNelspruit, ngo-Agasti.Uthe lo mholi wamthumelela umyalezo ebusuku ngo-10:54.UNkk Phadi uthe akazange awuphendule lowo myalezo."Akuzange kwehle kahle kimi ukuthola lo myalezo. Njengomholi we-MK ngiyazi ukuthi kufanele sibeke phambili ubuqotho nokwethembeka. Ngakhetha ukungaphenduli ngoba nginqena ukuthi ngizosuke ngimphendule kabi.”UNkk Phadi uthe emva kwalesi sigameko kwabe sekuqala imizamo yokumgudluza esikhundleni."Njengomuntu wesifazane ngibona ngihlaselwa ngenxa nje yokuthi nganqaba ukuchitha ubusuku naye. Ziningi izinto ezingelona iqiniso ezikhulunywa ngami. Sekuyangicacela manje ukuthi lo mkhankaso wokungcolisa igama lami uphekwa uyena.”Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kukaNkk Phadi, kanye nokhulumela i-MK, uMnuz Nhlamulo Ndhlela, ayizange iphumelele.Lukhulu uqhekeko ebuholini be-MK esifundazweni iMpumalanga.Amalungu eqembu ahlukene phakathi njengoba amanye eseka uNkk Phadi, bese kuthi amanye angaku-Advocate Mkhwebane.I-MK iyiqembu lesibili ngobukhulu eMpumalanga.
KUBA yinjabulo uma kuhlanganiswa imishado ebandleni lakwaShembe, eBuhleni. Kulolu hlobo lomshado abashadayo baqale bamiswe ngababili, omunye ame eduze kowakhe, bashaye ujenga. Abakwamakoti babe sebemundlalela isicephu sakhe, ngaphezu kwaso kulandela esikamkhwenyana asendlalelwa abakubo naye. Abazali babo bama ngemumva kwabo, abefundisi abasuke besebenza ngokubambisana, bababuze ngabanye ngabanye ukuthi bayavuma yini ukuthi bahlanganiswe abantwana babo. Emva kwalokho kube sekubuzwa bona abashadayo ukuthi bayavuma yini ukuthi bahlanganiswe. Kulandele ukufungiswa ukuthi ngeke balahlane. Umzali wentombazane ube esethatha isandla sendodakazi yakhe asibeke phezu kweBhayibheli, ngaphezu kwaso, umkhwenyana abeke esakhe, bese kuyakhulekwa, babekwe kuNkulunkulu. Emva kwalokho bafakana izindandatho, bese umakoti eshuquliswa umqwazo wenkonzo owakhiwe ngobuhlalu. Kuthiwa lokhu kuwuphawu lokubakhipha ebuntombini befakwa ebufazini. I-SOUTH African Qualifications Authority (SAQA), isixwayise abafuna izikhala zokuqhuba izifundo zabo ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme, ukuthi baqaphelele ukuthi zibhalisiwe yini nalo mkhandlu.Lo mkhandlu ukhipha lesi sexwayiso njengoba kunezikhungo ezingombombayi ezenzisa imikhakha engabhalisiwe.Ezinye zazo noma zibhalisiwe kodwa azivumelekile ukwenzisa eminye imikhakha.UNksz Nkosingiphile Nyalungu we-SAQA, uthe abafuna izikhala kumele babheke ukuthi zibhalisiwe yini noMnyango weMfundo ePhakeme.Uthe izikhungo kumele zinike abafuna izikhala ulwazi oluveza ukuthi zibhalisile."Abafuna izikhala kumele bafune inombolo isikhungo esibhalise ngayo kwi-SAQA, ukuze bakwazi ukuthola ukuthi sibhalisiwe. Ngaleyo ndlela kuzobalula ukubona ukuthi leso sikhungo sibhalisile,” kusho uNksz Nyalungu.UDkt Mimmy Gondwe, iPhini likaNgqongqoshe eMnyangweni wezeMfundo ePhakeme, useke waxwayisa ngezikhungo ezingombombayi eziqola abangazi ngalesi sikhathi.Usanda kuveza ukuthi bayazivala izikhungo ezisuke zingabhalisiwe kodwa ezinye ziphinde zivumbuke.Wanxusa abafuna izikhala ukuthi babheke izinto ezifana nendawo okufundelwa kuyona, ukubheka ukuthi izinto ezifana nomtapowolwazi nezinye ukuthi zikhona."Uma lezi zinto zingekho kumele uqale uzibuze ukuthi isikhungo esinjani esingenawo amagumbi okufundela kanjalo nomtapowolwazi? Ulahlekelwa yimali nesikhathi uma wenza iziqu ezingekho emthethweni. Uphinde ungakwazi nokuthola umsebenzi ngoba lezo ziqu zisuke zingabhalisiwe,” kuxwayisa uDkt Gondwe.Kwenzeka lokhu nje, zimbalwa izikhala ezikhona ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme kuleli njengoba zibalelwa ku-207 000 ezikhungweni zemfundo ekubeni abafundi abaphase u-matric nge-Bachelor, bengaphezu kuka-350 000.Abafuna ukubheka ukuthi iziqu zibhalisiwe bangaya ku-www:saqa.org.za. Abafuna ukubheka ukuthi isikhungo sibhalisiwe bangaya ku:www.dhet.org.za.
LIVUKA ogqokweni itshwayi kusongelana amaqembu abusa ngokubambisana emva kokusayinwa komthetho i-Expropriation ogunyaza ukudliwa kwempahla nomhlaba wuhulumeni.Ukusayinwa kwalo mthetho nguMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, kuqhathe abaholi bamaqembu abusa ngokubambisana.Iqembu lesibili ngobukhulu kuhulumeni wokubambisana, i-DA, lisabisa ngokungaseseki isabelomali uma uRamaphosa ephikelela nalo mthetho.I-DA iphinde isabise ngokuphonsela inselelo umthetho omusha enkantolo. Umthetho omusha wasayinwa nguRamaphosa ngeledlule.Inhloso yomthetho ukunikeza uhulumeni amandla okuthatha umhlaba uma kunesimo lapho kuphazamiseka ukuhanjiswa kwentuthuko.Ngaphansi komthetho omusha uhulumeni uzokwazi ukudla umhlaba uma ungavumelani nomnikazi wendawo lapho khona uhulumeni ufuna ukuqhuba uhlelo lwentuthuko okungaba umgwaqo, ingqalasizinda yamanzi nokunye.Nokho i-DA namanye amaqembu ayaphikisana nokusayinwa kwalo mthetho.Akukhona okokuqala i-DA iphikisana nokusayinwa kwemithetho njengoba sekuke kwenzeka ngesikhathi kusayinwa umthetho wezikole, iBela, kanye nangesikhathi kusayinwa umshwalense wempilo, i-NHI.Umholi we-DA, uMnuz John Steenhuisen, uthe sebeyibekezele kwanele i-ANC.USteenhuisen uthe abe-ANC kufanele bakwamukele ukuthi angeke bathole yonke into abayifunayo ngoba abazange bathole izihlalo ezanele ukuthi babuse ngokuzimela.USteenhuisen uthe bazofaka isikhalazo ngokusemthethweni ohlakeni oludalelwe ukuxazulula izinkinga kuhulumeni wokubambisana.Uthe angeke baseseke isabelomali uma isikhalazo sabo singakaxazululwa.Ngakolunye uhlangothi, abaholi be-ANC bona bathe bazoqhubeka nawo lo mthetho.UNobhala Jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, uthe i-DA yazigwaza ngowayo ngesikhathi kunezingxoxo zokubusa ngokubambisana.UMbalula uthe i-DA kwakufanele isho ukuthi imiphi imithetho engahambisani nayo ngesikhathi kunezingxoxo.Abaholi bala maqembu bayaqhubeka nokubambana ngezihluthu.IPhini likaMengameli, uMnuz Paul Mashatile, lize laphimisa amazwi okuthi ilungu le-DA eliwuNgqongqoshe wezeMisebenzi yoMphakathi neNgqalasizinda, uMnuz Dean Macpherson, kuzomele lisule esikhundleni uma liphikisana nalo mthetho.Umnyango kaMacpherson iwona okufanele ube sekhaleni lokuthathwa komhlaba.UMashatile uthe akekho ungqongqoshe ozokwenza umathanda."Bonke ongqongqoshe baqokwa ngumengameli, akekho ungqongqoshe ozokwenza okuthandwa uyena.”UMacpherson uthe ngeke atshelwe uMashatile ukuthi kufanele ehle esikhundleni."Akekho umuntu ozongitshela ukuthi kufanele ngehle esikhundleni ngaphandle komholi weqembu lami (i-DA).”UMacpherson nephini likangqongqoshe emnyangweni, uMnuz Sihle Zikalala, abakhulumi ulimi olulodwa ngodaba lwalo mthetho.UZikalala, oyilungu le-ANC, ukushayele umthetho ukusayinwa komthetho, wathi bakulungele ukulandela okushiwo umthetho.Amanye amaqembu ayingxenye yohulumeni wokubambisana aphikisana nokusayinwa komthetho yi-IFP ne-FF Plus.Umhlaziyi wezepolitiki, uMnuz Bongani Mahlangu, uthe umsindo wakamumva akaboni uzodala ukuthi kugqabuke igoda emaqenjini abusa ngokubambisana.UMahlangu uthe i-DA ayizange isho ukuthi izohoxa kuhulumeni wokubambisana, wathi lokho kuyizinkomba zokuthi izimisele ukuthi luxoxwe lolu daba.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabe-Newsroom Afrika."Akukhona okokuqala bephikisana nemithetho esayinwa uRamaphosa. Empeleni akukhona ukuthi baphikisana nawo wonke umthetho, kepha nje izingxenye ezithile zomthetho abangahambisani nazo. Kwakuyisimo esifanayo kw-iBela nakwi-NHI. Ngicabanga ukuthi bazohlala phansi, babonisane ngalolu daba.” Amanye amaqembu amakhulu aphikisana nokusayinwa komthetho i-EFF ne-MK.La maqembu akhala ngokuthi ukusayinwa kwalo mthetho ngeke kwenze mehluko, athi akukho okusha okuqukethwe umthetho osayinwe ngeledlule.
ZIHLUKENE phakathi izangoma ngokuyoseka uzakwabo, uMakgotso "Gogo Maweni” Mofokeng njengoba ebuyela eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseProtea, eSoweto ngoMsombuluko. GOGO SKHOTHENIYize izinyanga zaseThekwini, uBhongolethu "Dr Khehlelezi” Mzozo no-Andile "Mzimbokhalimali” Dlamini, ziphumele obala ngokuyokweseka uMaweni ngalolu suku kodwa ozibiza ngomngani kaMaweni, uTumi "Gogo Skhotheni” Motsoeneng, uthe bayaphapha ozakwabo ngoba abasiye nomngani kaMaweni. Uthe yini zingangeni ezindumbeni zazo ziyophahla hhayi ukuthi zize ziye enkantolo. Eqhuba uSkhotheni uthe uMaweni uzophuma ngaphandle kosizo lwezangoma ezihluleke zancama ukubona ukuthi uMaweni uzoboshwa. "Umngani wami lo? Akusiye umngani wenu.” Ubuze ukuthi lezi zangoma esezifuna ukuyingena manje lempi yabo bezithuleleni ngesikhathi begadlana ezinkundleni zokuxhumana. "Kuyasho ukuthi aniboniswa nina. Ukuba beniboniswa ngabe niyibone isekude namthatha namfaka endumbeni ukuze amaphoyisa angamboni...Ngiyameseka umngani wami kodwa hhayi ezinkundleni zokuxhumana kodwa endumbeni," kuchaza uSkhotheni. ”Bekufanele enkantolo kuze isangoma esisodwa sizokhipha umngani wami.Bekuvunyelwe abezindaba ukuba babike ukusuka nokuhlala ngokwenzeka enkantolo.Ugogo Maweni (39) uvele enkantolo ngecala lokushaya ngebhodlela ngenhloso yokulimaza omunye umuntu wesifazane ngo-2019. Isolezwe Ngempelasonto lithole ukuthi inkantolo beyigcwele phama, kunomndeni wakwaMofokeng ngakolunye uhlangothi lwenkantolo. Icala lihlehliselwe uMsombuluko wangoJanuwari 27, ukuze umsolwa acele ibheyili. Nakuba kunjalo akuthanga diki kumsolwa esebuyela esitokisini. Ugogo ukhalelwe ngamasongo kaSigonyela ekwakhe ngeSonto ngezithuba zabo-3 ntambama, eboshwa ngamaphoyisa angamalungu eGauteng Province Cold Case Investigation Unit, naweGauteng Counter Intelligence Investigation, maqede waphonswa esitokisini esiteshini saseMondeor, eGoli, lapho elale khona ebaliwe.Ngokusho kwesitatimende samaphoyisa, ugogo uMaweni uqale ukulandelwa ephenywa kusukela ngo-2019.Siqhubeka isitatimende sithe ugogo uMaweni uyathinteka nasezigamekweni zokubulawa kwabantu ezenzeka e-Eldorado Park, eMondeor, e-Orange Farm, naseBekkersdal phakathi kuka-2020 no-2024, okungamacala asaphenywa. Ukuboshwa kukaMaweni kulandela izinsolo ezadalulwa wuzakwabo kodwa oseyimbangi yakhe uSkhotheni, ngesikhathi lezi zangoma zixabana kwi-TikTok. USkhotheni waveza nokuthi phakathi kwabanye abantu ababulawa kubalwa nomyeni wobengumngani wakhe omkhulu, uJabu Mahlangu. USkhotheni wathi izindaba uMaweni waziphahluka kwabomndeni wakhe ngesikhathi eseqiwe yizinkamba futhi umfowabo ubesehamba ecula ngalezi zehlakalo.Nakuba kunjalo ngesonto eledlule uSkhotheni, noMaweni baveze ukuthi sebekhumelene umlotha. Baze baxabane nje, ngo-2023 uSkhotheni waveza ukuthi uMaweni ukopela izitayela zakhe, nensipho yakhe.Ugogo Maweni, oshade noSabelo Mgube nyakenye, uqale ukuzakhela udumo emuva kokuvela kwezindaba zokuthi ubethandana nowayengumlingisi weThe Queen, uSthembiso "SK" Khoza, kanye nowayengumdlali weMamelodi Sundowns uSiyabonga Zulu. Ubezishaya isifuba ngokuthi obethandana naye kodwa emhlukumeza, ubembika endumbeni bese amadlozi akhe ebhekana naye. KING BHAKADR KHEHLELEZIMZIMBOKHLIMALI

Awube khona umehluko owenzayo, ngisho ngabe u-2%,” kusho uNkk Ndlozi, othe kumjabulise kakhulu ukuthi umsebenzi wakhe utuswe ezingeni lomhlaba wonke.Uveze ukuthi uneminyaka eyisithupha kuphela eqalile emkhakheni wezemfundo njengoba eyishumi nanye yangaphambilini, wayesebenza kowezezimali, akhetha ukuwuyeka, afundele ubuthisha esezwa usumcoba (owezezimali).Uthe osekusele ukuthi angabe esabheka emumva, aqhubeke nokutshala uthando lwe-Coding ne-Robotics kubafundi basemakhaya njengoba ekholelwa ekutheni ukushintsha kwesikhathi kusho ukuthi lesi sifundo sizohamba sihambe sifundiswe ngokugcwele kuzo zonke izikole, ukunikezela ngekhono lokwakha izinto ezehlukene eziyamaniswa nezobuchwepheshe.
INDAWO yokusebenzela isiphenduke isizinda sokuphathwa wukhwantalala kubasebenzi esibhedlela sabagula ngengqondo, eKuhlengeni Psychiatric, eZimbokodweni, eThekwini, ngenxa yezimo zokusebenza ezingagculisi.Umthombo ozazi zonke ezenzeka kulesi sikhungo odonse ngendlebe intatheli ukuthi igama lawo lingadalulwa ukuwuvikela, udalule ukuthi inkinga enkulu wukuthi izinsizakusebenza azinakwa futhi azilungiswa uma seziphelelwe yisikhathi.Uthe isimo sibi kakhulu kwabasebenza ekhishini ngenxa yokuthi yilapho umonakalo omningi ukhona, okugcina kwenza abasebenzi bangakuthokozeli nhlobo ukuya emsebenzini."Into ehlupha kakhulu wukuthi emakhishini asinazo izinsizakusebenza ezisemqoka njengezinqola zokuhambisa ukudla emagunjini okudlela azikho nhlobo, okuphoqa ukuthi uma abasebenzi behambisa ukudla iziguli zibe sengcupheni yokulimala ngoba basuke bephethe nezinto ezishisayo,” kusho umthombo.Uthe ingaphakathi lesibhedlela emagunjini ehlukene okusebenza, kulenga izintambo zikagesi ezixebukile, okubeka impilo yawo wonke umuntu osesikhungweni engozini."Akupheleli lapho njengoba kubuye kwenzeke nokuthi kuqhume amapayipi emagunjini okuzikhulula, okwenza iphunga lendle likapakele ngalapho kusebenza khona abasebenzi basekhishini. Kuba yisimo esibi impela nje, engibona ukuthi akekho umuntu ongathokozela ukusebenzela endaweni enjeyana,” usho kanje.Udalule nokuthi sekukaningi lezi zinkinga, aqale ukuziqaphela ngo-2023 zithulwa kubaphathi besibhedlela ukuthi bazilungise, kodwa kulokhu kunhlanga zimuka nomoya, mncane kakhulu umehluko."Izisebenzi ziyawuthanda umsebenzi wazo, kepha isimo ezibhekene naso senza kube muncu, futhi kudala nokuthi izisebenzi zizibone zingahloniphekile,” kusho umthombo.Kuthintwa isikhulu esiphezulu sakulesi sibhedlela, uMnuz Mzwandile Zondo, ucele ukuthi kuthintwe abakhulumela uMnyango wezeMpilo esifundazweni, ezeseka ngokuthi umthetho wokusebenza awuvumi bakhulume nabezindaba. Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Nathi Olifant, uthe abasebenzi abanezikhalo ezithile ngendawo abasebenza kuyona kumele babhale incwadi yezikhalo ebhekiswe kubona, okuzothi bangayibona bese bebuya nombiko ophelele mayelana nokubakhalisayo. Izilinganiso ezisekelwe ocwaningweni zibonisa ukuthi cishe ikota yabasebenzi baseNingizimu Afrika batholakala benengcindezi ngenxa yezimo zokusebenza. Nokho, phakathi kuka-15% kuya ku-25% kuphela ofuna ukuthi uthole usizo.Ngokombiko wesibili we-Annual Mental State of the World 2021 ovela kwa-Sapien Labs, owashicilelwa ngoMashi 2022, iNingizimu Afrika ibalwa namazwe amabi kakhulu mayelana nokunakekelwa kwempilo yengqondo kubasebenzi.
AYITHI vu i-ANC namadlelandawonye ayo KwaZulu-Natal, ngesinqumo se-ANC kuzwelonke sokunyakazisa ubuholi base-KZN naseGauteng ngokushaya udaka okhethweni lwangongoMeyi, wanyakenye.Lokhu kulandela okushiwo nguNobhala Jikelele wale nhlangano, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, okhiphe umyalelo ocacile ukuthi akekho okumele aphawule ngodaba lokunyakaziswa kobuholi kulezi zifundazwe ngaphandle kwakhe.UMbalula uthe akafuni kukhulunywe izinto ezizoshayisana njengoba kuyima kuzohlangana ikomiti elibhekele ukusebenza kwansuku zonke kwe-ANC, ukuze linqume ngendlela ezosetshenziswa uma sebunyakaziswa lobu buholi.Abaholi baziswe ukuthi bazokwazi ngesonto elizayo indlela ezosetshenziswa bese kujutshwa amalungu esigungu esiphezulu, okuyiwo azobe echazela amagatsha nezifunda indlela okuzokwenziwa ngayo lolu hlelo.Esithangamini sabezindaba izolo, eThekwini, emuva komhlangano wamadlelandawonye e-ANC, okuyi-Sanco, Cosatu, SACP nayo i-ANC, uNobhala we-ANC esifundazweni uMnuz Bheki Mtolo, uthe ngeke bakhulume ngalesi sinyathelo."Ubuholi obuphezulu yibona obuzophefumula ngalolu daba njengoba kunqume isigungu esiphezulu senhlangano. Asifuni ukuthi kube nokuphambana kwemiyalezo kulolu daba,” kusho uMtolo ngamafuphi.NoNobhala wamaKhomanisi e-KZN, uMnuz Themba Mthembu, uthe okwamanje ngeke baphefumule ngalolu daba ngoba abazi nokuthi ikuphi le nhlangano ezokwenza kuzwelonke ngobuholi base-KZN."Sizolinda kuze kuphothulwe lolu hlelo lwe-ANC, ngoba asazi ukuthi yini le abazobe beyenza. Kuseva ukuthi singasheshe siphawule ekubeni singakaboni ukuthi ikuphi abazokwenza, sizophawula uma sekucaca ukuthi yikuphi okuzokwenziwa,” kusho uMthembu.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi bekunomhlangano wokuhlelela irali ezoba ngoFebhuwari 2, lapho okuzobe kugujwa iJanuwari 8, eba minyaka yonke.Le rali kulindeleke ukuthi ibe sezinkundleni zemidlalo KwaCaluza, eMgungundlovu. Kwenzeka lokhu nje, uMbalula uphakamise ukuthi kume ukwenziwa kwale micimbi kulezi zifundazwe zombili, kuze kuphothulwe uhlelo oluzokwenziwa wubuholi bukazwelonke.UMbalula wakuveza ukuthi bashaywa banaba ubuholi base-KZN yiqembu eliholwa ngowayengumengameli we-ANC nezwe, uMnuz Jacob Zuma.Wabuye wakhala nangokuthi amagatsha ase-KZN afana nento engekho, yingakho kudingeka ukuthi kwenziwe okuthile ukulungisa isimo kulesi sifundazwe.
ZIZOPHENDUKA omantunta nendishi izitshudeni ezikhokhelwa izindawo zokuhlala yisikhwama i-National Students’ Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS), uma singabakhokheli omastende abathi bakweletwa imali yanyakenye.Inhlangano i-Private Student Housing Association (PSHA), inxenxe i-NSFAS ukuthi ikhokhe uma ingafuni ukubona izitshudeni zilala emnyango.Isitatimende esikhishwe yinhlangano, sithe omastende bayo bahlinzeka izitshudeni ezevile ku-80 000 ngonyaka ngendawo yokuhlala.Isikhulu esiphezulu senhlangano uMnuz Kagisho Mamabolo, sithe minyaka yonke isikhwama siyahluleka ukukhokha imali egcwele ezindaweni ezigunyazile."Omastende abangaphansi kwe-PSHA bakweletwa u-R44 million yi-NSFAS. Le mali eyangonyaka odlule. Uma imali ingakhokhwa ezinsukwini ezingu-14, izitshudeni zizozithola zingenayo indawo yokuhlala uma sezibuya. Lokhu kuzophazamisa izifundo zazo,” kusho uMamabolo.Uthe ukungakhokhelwa komastende kwenza bangakwazi ukubhekela lezi zindawo ngendlela efanele."I-NSFAS iyasixhaphaza. Sikhathazekile ngezitshudeni kodwa akukho esingakwenza uma isikhwama singakhokhi.”Uqhube wathi i-NSFAS isanda kutshela omastende ukuthi benze umusa bahlalise mahhala izitshudeni kule nyanga."I-NSFAS ayibacabangeli omastende ngoba ayibakhokheli ngoDisemba nangoJanuwari. Siyazama ukuxhumana ne-NSFAS kodwa kunhlanga zimuka nomoya ngoba izingcingo aziphendulwa kanjalo nama-emails.” Uveze nokuthi isikhwama asikakuvezi nokuthi sizokhokhela isitshudeni malini kulo nyaka ngezindawo zokuhlala."Okwamanje isitshudeni sikhokhelwa u-R50 000 ngonyaka. Sifuna ukwazi ukuthi manje izonyuswa yini le mali njengoba kuke kwaba nokukhala kwezinye izikhungo ukuthi ayenele.” Okhulumela i-NSFAS uMnuz Ishmael Mnisi, uthe omastende abangakhokhelwe kumele babathumele uhlu lwezitshudeni ezihlala ezindaweni zabo, ukuze bathumele abacwaningi abazobheka futhi baqinisekise lokhu.Uthe bafuna ukuthola ukuthi izitshudeni zikhokhelwa yibona yini noma ezifunda ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme kodwa ezizikhokhelayo."Asikwazi ukumane sikhokhe singazi noma sikhokhela umuntu oxhaswa yithina noma ngumuntu esingamxhasi. Imali yabakhokhi bentela ngakho asikwazi ukumane senze umathanda ngayo ngoba singangena enkingeni,” usho kanje.Uthe bahlangana nale nhlangano nyakenye kanjalo nabanye ozakwabo ukuxoxa ngalezi zinkinga."Siyayixoxa ukuthi inkinga siyixazulula kanjani kodwa uma siphuma lapho bese kungenziwa lokhu esisuke sivumelene ngakho. Kuba nokusabisa ukuthi bazoxosha izitshudeni uma kungakhokhiwe ekubeni kungalandelwanga imibandela esiyibekile,” kuqhuba uMnisi.Uthe bazimisele ukukhokhela izitshudeni ezifanele ezihlala ezindaweni ezigunyaziwe.
