NJENGOBA kuqala unyaka abafundi abaningi abaphothule u-matric nyakenye bazobe begcwele izinkalo zonke ezweni befuna izikhala zokufunda ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme ikakhulu emanyuvesi. Nokho iqiniso elingephikwe ngalokhu wukuthi akusibo bonke abafundi, ngisho noma ngabe bephase kahle kanjani, abazoba nenhlanhla yokwamukelwa kwezicelo zabo zokufunda emanyuvesi abacele ukufunda kuwona.Kunjalo nje, enye inkinga ekhona ezweni ngeyokuthi ngisho umfundi esefunde wagogoda, kodwa akunasiqiniseko sokuthi lokho kuzomsiza ukuziphilisa njengoba ilokhu iqhubeke njalo indlala yamathuba emisebenzi ezweni.UMnuz Shawn Theunissen we-Property Point, ebhekele ukuthuthukisa osomabhizinisi abasafufusa ukuze bachume emikhakheni eyehlukene abakuyona, uthe izikole kumele zibeke eqhulwini ukwethula izindlela zokwenza abantu bangene emikhakheni eyehlukene ezolungisa izinkinga ezibhekene nezwe."Izwe lethu libhekene nezinkinga eziningi njengokungabi bikho kwezindlu ezanele ezakhiwe kahle, ukungabi sesimweni esihle kwengqalasizinda nokunye okweyamene nalokho. Ngakho imisebenzi esingabala kuyona eyokuba wu-plumber, umsebenzi sokushisela nokwakha ngeminye yemikhakha ebukelwa phansi kodwa ibe ibalulekile. Kumele kukhuthazwe abantu ukuthi baqeqeshelwe yona ngoba inekusasa,” kusho uTheunissen.Eqhuba uthe uma intsha ingaqala manje ikhethe izifundo ezizogxila emakhonweni nezizoyisiza ngamasu okuqala amabhizinisi, ingalungiseka inkinga ebhekene nezwe yesibalo esingaphezu kuka-40% sentsha engasebenzi."Ngokugxila emakhonweni afanele nabaluleke kakhulu esikhathini esiphila kusona manje, izwe lethu lingathuthuka. Sekuyisikhathi sokuthi kutshalwe imali emfundweni ehlanganisa ubuchwepheshe nezamabhizinisi ukusiza ukuqinisekisa ukuthi isizukulwane esizayo sifika kunekusasa elihle,” usho kanje.Imenenja yophiko olubhekele ukusebenza eMomentum Group, uNksz Tshego Bokaba, icebise ngokuthi uhulumeni kumele ubambisane nezinkampani ezizimele ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izikhungo zezemfundo ezahlukene zicija abafundi nezitshudeni ngolwazi ngendlela ehambisana nezidingo zesikhathi samanje."Amakolishi amakhono nawo awenze izivumelwano zokusebenzisana nezinkampani ezizimele. Lokhu kuzosiza ngokuthi izitshudeni ezidlule esandleni sawo, zingabi nenkinga yokuthola amathuba okuchuma ngamakhono azo. Kuzokhuthala nabaseceleni abazofuna ukuzocijwa kuwona ngoba bebona ukuthi kuyaphumeleleka ngokungena kuwona,” usho kanje.UNksz Bokaba uthe kumele kukhathaze wonke umuntu ukuthi okwamanje, entsheni engu-10 eneminyaka ephakathi kuka-15 kuya ku-34 engasebenzi, kunabane kuyona, abangafundi futhi okubukeka sebephelelwe yithemba lempilo engcono."Ukulwela ukuthi wonke umuntu athole amathuba alinganayo empilweni ngenye yezinto eziseyinselelo enkulu ezindaweni zasemakhaya. Ukuze kube noguquko olubonakalayo kudingeka ukuthi ingqalasizinda namathuba kunikwe kakhulu intsha lapho ikhona hhayi ukuphoqeka ukuthi ize iye emadolobheni ukuze kulunge ekufunayo,” kusho yena.
AKHALA ezimathonsi amakhasimende ebhange Ithala njengoba engakwazi ukuthola imali yawo futhi engatshelwa ngokuqhubekayo ngaleli bhange.Iningi labantu abasebenzisa igatsha laleli bhange eliku-Anton Lembede Street, enkabeni yeTheku, bafice kukhala ibhungezi kuleli bhange. Bekuvaliwe, kungekho ngisho nabasebenzi, kukhona unogada kuphela.Abanye bebekhala ngokuthi akukho ukuxhumana leli bhange elikwenzayo ukuze baqonde ukuthi kwenzakalani, bengezwa ngamahlebezi.Isolezwe lixoxe nabanye abasebenzisa leli bhange ukuzwa imizwa yabo ngalokhu.UNkk Ellen Khumalo obesuka eMaoti, eNanda, uthe ubezobheka imali yakhe kuleli bhange njengoba ezwe ukuthi kunezingqinamba ezithinta Ithala."Ngifice kungekho muntu, kukhona unogada kuphela. Ithemba sinalo njengoba kuthiwe asilinde sizwe ukuthi isinqumo sikahulumeni sithini. Uma kuthiwa ayilungi inkinga yebhange, ngizocela nathi basazise kumaselula ethu ukuze sizokwazi ukuthi sithathe imali yethu siyiyise kwamanye amabhange,” kusho uNkk Khumalo.Uthe kubuhlungu kubona uma bezwa izindaba ezithi ibhange lizovalwa."Asikujabuleli ukuvalwa kwebhange. Ngokomthetho bekufanele sililwele njengoZulu omnyama ngoba selisivikele izikhawu eziningi. Besibeka kahle imali yethu zingekho izinkinga. Sesiyaxakeka manje ukuthi kwase kuba khona izingqinamba ezingaka,” usho kanje.Uthe waqala ngo-2017 ukusebenzisa Ithala futhi unxusa abantu ukuthi balilwele."Bengicela ukuthi silimele ibhange lethu ngoba siyazi sidlala izitikofela, sifundisa ngalo izingane zethu, sakha ngalo imizi, sithenga ngalo izimoto, kuze kube khona omasingcwabisane. "Asingadikibali ngalo ngoba siyakwazi okuhle elisenzele khona. Sikhulekela ukuthi uhulumeni angathi alibuye ibhange lethu ngoba liyithemba kuthina,” ubeke kanje.UMnuz Sandile Memela ongusomabhizinisi naye uzwakalise ukungenami ngezindaba ezithinta Ithala."Ngiqale ukusebenzisa ibhange Ithala ngo-2012. Ibuhlungu kakhulu le nto eyenzakalayo ngoba okunye nokunye asikwazi, sikuzwa ngabantu. Sinemali evaleleke kuleli bhange, abasebenzi bami angibaholelile, abasebenzisana nenkampani nabo angibakhokhelile, kunzima kakhulu. Uhulumeni akangenelele adedele imali yethu,” usho kanje.UMnuz Zamo Ndlovu yena uthe: "Sikhungathekile njengoba imali yethu ivalelekile. Asikwazi ukunakekela izingane zethu futhi nasendlini indlala isikhungethe. Asazi ukuthi sizokwenza njani futhi azikho izimpendulo esizitholayo,” usho kanje.Uthe umshado wakhe naleli bhange waqala ngo-2005 kuze kube yimanje ubesathembekile kulo. Uthe sebelinde isinqumo ukuzwa ukuthi kuthiwani mayelana nekusasa laloKhonamanjalo: Udaba lwesicelo sokuthi kuvalwe Ithala sizolalelwa kusasa eNkantolo eNkulu yaseMgungundlovu. Uhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal nezinye izinhlaka sezikuveze kaningi zeseka Ithala, azihabisani nokuthi livalwe.
KUTHIWA kuphume isidumbu umlisa waseMlaza ebhadanywa ngunina wengane yakhe ecambalele nenye intombi ngoMsombuluko entathakusa.Isolezwe lithole ngomthombo walo osondelene kakhulu nalolu daba ukuthi iyindaba egudwini eyesehlakalo salo wesilisa okuthiwa usenze phambi kwentombi yona okuthiwa iphume yabaleka.Kuvela ukuthi umsolwa uMnuz Phakamani Sithole (39) uhlinze unina wengane yakhe, uNksz Princess Thembelihle Mokoana (34). Umthombo uthe umsolwa ubekade emxwayisile unina wengane yakhe ukuba angalokothi alubhade endlini yakhe."Umsolwa umshayele ucingo unina wengane yakhe emtshela ukuthi angalinge alubhade endlini. Ngicabanga ukuthi yilokho impela okugcine kudala ukuthi afike efuna ukubona ukuthi kungani kuthiwa angafiki endlini ngalolu suku,'' usho kanjena.Umthombo uthe uNksz Mokoana utheleke endlini kayise wengane kanti uzombhadama elele nenye intombi, wathi lokhu kumcikile kakhulu umsolwa, wabe esembuza umufi ukuthi kungani efika ekubeni emxwayisile ngokuthi angalenzi iphutha lokufika endlini."Lo ongumsolwa kumcikile kakhulu ukubona unina wengane yakhe efika endlini engashilo. Kuthe uma umsolwa ebuzwa uNksz Mokoana ukuthi kungani elele nentombi, umsolwa wase evuka umbhejazane,'' kusho umthombo.Uma uqhubeka uchaza, uthe umsolwa uvukile wayolanda ummese ekhishini wangabuza lutho, waqonda ngqo kunina wengane yakhe wamgwaza amanxeba amaningi."'Yigama nje leli lokuthi umgwazile, eqinisweni nje ubemhlinza. Ibe buhlungu kakhulu leya nto eyenzekile egameni nje lothando,'' kusho umthombo.Omunye umthombo uveze ukuthi laba ababili bese kuphela isikhathi eside benokungaboni ngaso linye yize bebesaqhubeka nokuthandana.Ilungu lomphakathi elikhulume neSolezwe lacela ukuba kugodlwe igama lalo, libabaze isihluku elithe sikhonjiswe ngumsolwa."Ibikhona enye indlela abengenza ngayo kunokuthi aze akhethe ukubulala unina wengane yakhe pho. Okubuhlungu kakhulu kunakho konke ukuthi lokhu ukwenze ngenxa nje yentombi,’’ lisho kanje.Ethintwa owomndeni kamufi walile ukuphawula ngalolu daba, wavala ucingo.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uConstable Thenjiswa Ngcobo, usiqinisekisile isigameko. Uthe amaphoyisa aseMlaza, abophe owesilisa oneminyaka engu-39 ngecala lokubulawa kowesifazane okwenzeke kwa-U, eMlaza. Umsolwa uvele enkantolo izolo.Uveze ukuthi lo wesifazane obulewe kuvela ukuthi isidumbu sakhe sitholakale sinamanxeba okugwazwa.
KUTHUNGATHWA owokufika odabuka ePakistani ngecala lokubulala isisebenzi enkabeni yedolobha iVerulam ngoLwesine ebusuku.Onogada benkampani iReaction Unit South Africa (RUSA) babizelwe emafulethini kuThompson Lane ngo-19:58 ngemibiko yokudutshulwa kwabantu."Sifike kule ndawo sathola owesilisa wasePakistani oneminyaka engu-24 ubudala enamanxeba amathathu okudutshulwa esifubeni. Ngeshwa ushonele khona lapho ngenxa yokulimala kabi. Kuthiwa umsolwa umnikazi wesitolo esikhanda amaselula emgwaqweni uWick futhi uhlala nezisebenzi zakhe ezimbili eziyizihlobo zakhe efulethini elingaphezu kwesitolo.”isithombe: RUSAKuthiwa umsolwa ufike efulethini wadubula omunye wabasebenzi bakhe obemi ngaphandle, ngemuva kwalokho waphendukela kowesibili okwazile ukubaleka. Umsolwa ubaleke weba imoto yohlobo lweHyundai Sonata ebisemgwaqweni egcine itholakala e-Old Main Road, e-Ottawa.Imoto eyebiwe umsolwa egcine itholakala isithombe: RUSAImbangela yokuhlaselwa kwakhe laba bantu ayikaziwa kodwa amaphoyisa ayaphenya.
IYAQONGA impi yokulwa nokuvalwa kwebhange elilengelwa yizembe, Ithala, KwaZulu-Natal njengoba lolu daba selungenwe ngamadlelandawonye ne-ANC esifundazweni. La madlelandawonye, okuyiSanco, Cosatu, SACP ne-ANC, azonikela enkantolo eyozwakalisa ilaka lawo mayelana nalo mnyakazo wokuvala Ithala.Lezi zinhlangano zisole ipolitiki emizameni yokuthi kuvalwe leli bhange ngoba abasebenzi bazolamba. UNobhala we-ANC e-KZN, uMnuz Bheki Mtolo, uthe bebehlangene bengamadlelandawonye bebhunga ngezinto ezehlukene ezifaka nezinselelo ezibhekene neThala.Uthe bafuna kuqiniswe ukusebenza kwaleli bhange, hhayi ukuthi livalwe ngoba amakhasimende alo angu-270 000 azothwala kanzima."Leli bhange lisiza abantu abamnyama ngokubaboleka imali yokukwazi ukusiza amabhizinisi abo. Asihambisani nemizamo ye-Prudential Authority yokuya enkantolo ifuna livalwe. Imindeni yabantu abangu-270 000 izovalekelwa imali okuzokwenza ukuthi ingakwazi ukwenza lutho. Sizobhikisha eNkantolo eNkulu yaseMgungundlovu ngoLwesihlanu uma sekulalelwe lolu daba,” kusho uMtolo esithangamini sabezindaba izolo eThekwini.UNobhala weCosatu e-KZN, uMnuz Edwin Mkhize, uthe bakhalela abasebenzi ababalelwa ku-400 abazophelelwa ngumsebenzi ngenxa yesinyathelo sokuzama ukuvala leli bhange."Ngeke sisonge izandla kodwa sizolwa nalesi sinyathelo. Uma kukhona inkohlakalo eyenzekile eThala, izinhlaka zomthetho aziphenye kodwa kungaze kuvalwe thaqa ibhange ngoba baningi abantu abangeke bazi ukuthi bazosizakala kuphi uma befuna ukuboleka imali,” kusho uMkhize.UNobhala wamaKhomanisi esifundazweni, uMnuz Themba Mthembu, ukuchithile ukuthi ukuvalwa kwaleli bhange kwenzelwa ukuvikela imali yamakhasimende."Amanga lawo. Kunenhlese yezepolitiki ekuvalweni kwebhange Ithala. Kunomlando kuleli lizwe wokuzama ukuvala wonke amabhange amancane, okwenziwa amabhange amakhulu ezweni. Lokhu okubikwayo akukhona ngoba kudala sakubona ukuthi lokhu kuhambisana nemizamo yokushaqa amakhasimende aye kwamanye amabhange amakhulu,” kusho uMthembu. Amadlelandawonye aphinde aphefumula ngesimo esenzeka emayini, i-ArcelorMittal, eNewcastle lapho ethe ukuvalwa kwale mayini kuzoqeda imisebenzi engu-1 300."Lokhu kuzokwandisa izinga lokungasebenzi elivele lidlangile esifundazweni. Umkhakha wezimoto, othembele emkhakheni wensimbi, uzoshayeka kakhulu ngokuvalwa kwale femu,” kusho uMtolo.Uthe bazoqinisa umbhikisho oqhubekayo ngaphandle kwale mayini kusasa.Uveze ukuthi ngempelasonto bazohlangana nomphakathi ohlala endaweni eyayinezimayini eDannhauser lapho bezolalela khona izikhalazo zabo.
UTHI uzobona ukuthi kukhona umkhoshosho okhona uma naleli sonto liphinde liphela ingaboshiwe imeya eyamxebula ngezimpama ngeledlule, owesifazane okhubazekile osebenza ehhovisi le-IFP eMtshezi.Umgilwa, uNksz Zandile Radebe kuthiwa washaywa yiMeya kaMasipala Inkosi Langalibalele, eMtshezi, uMnuz Mduduzi Myeza ngoLwesine olwedlule ngesikhathi ezolanda ama-voters roll ehhovisi leqembu kule ndawo njengoba kuvotelwa ubuholi obusha emagatsheni.Ngaleso sikhathi Isolezwe lathola ukuthi umsolwa wafika kuleli hhovisi ehamba nephini lakhe kumasipala, wasola umgilwa ngokungawenzi kahle umsebenzi wakhe.Kuthiwa umgilwa wambuza umsolwa ukuthi yimuphi umsebenzi athi akawenzi kahle, wamsola ngokumfaka amagama emlonyeni, wase emshaya.Umgilwa ekhuluma neSolezwe izolo uthe uqeda kuphuma esibhedlela emva kokulaliswa amahora ambalwa odokotela bezama ukwehlisa umfutho wegazi ophezulu."Ngiyakholwa ukuthi unyuswe yiso isigameko ngoba selokhu senzekile, angizizwa kahle,” kusho uNksz Radebe.Ukhale ngokuthi umsolwa namanje akaboshiwe wathi akazi ukuthi kubambeni ngoba uyaziwa."Ukhona, uyaziqhubekela nje nempilo yakhe, ungathi akwenzeke lutho. Nasendaweni akabalekile, ukhona uyabonakala,” kusho uNksz Radebe.Uthe uke wezwa kancane kumseshi ukuthi ubeye esibhedlela eyofuna ifomu (J88) eligcwaliswa yilowo osuke elinyazwe ukushaywa."Uthe udokotela uthe alikho akakaligcwalisi. Ngixakwa ukuthi ngambona eligcwalisa phambi kwami ngesikhathi ngiye khona emva kwesigameko.”"Kodwa ngikhetha ukwehlisa umoya okwamanje. Ngifuna ukuthi ke ngiyinike isikhathi le nto, ngibone ukuthi kwenzekani. Kodwa uma kuphela leli sonto engaboshiwe, ngizoshaya amakhala, ngibone ukuthi kukhona umkhoshosho okhona,” kusho uNksz Radebe.Ngesikhathi kwenzeka isigameko, uMyeza kuthiwa wamqhulula ngenqwaba yezimpama ezaziza ngesankahlu umgilwa waze wawa nasesihlalweni ayehleli kuso.Umgilwa phambilini uveze ukuthi umsolwa vele uhlale emchapha ngenhlamba uma ekhuluma naye, nokuyinto abese eyibekezelele isikhathi eside.Okhulumela i-IFP uMnuz Mkhuleko Hlengwa uthe bazwile ngezinsolo. Uthe okwamanje kuseyizinsolo, wathi bazodedela uphenyo luqhubeke ngendlela efanele ngaphambi kokuthi kube khona abakushoyo noma abakwenzayo. Ucingo lwemeya, nayizolo belukhala lungabanjwa.
KUNGAKAPHELI isikhathi esingakanani, uMengameli uCyril Ramaphosa, uzithola engaphansi kwenye ingcindezi yokuba athathele izinyathelo omunye ungqongqoshe okwiKhabhinethi yakhe.Amaqembu ezepolitiki afuna ukuthi uRamaphosa axoshe owuNgqongqoshe eHhovisi likaMengameli, uNksz Khumbudzo Ntshavheni, ophenyelwa inkohlakalo.Ikhwelo lokuba kususwe uNksz Ntshavheni esikhundleni liza nje akukapheli isikhathi eside kukade kukhulunywa udaba olufanayo ngobewuNgqongqoshe wezoBulungiswa ngaleso sikhathi, uNksz Thembi Simelane.Kwaze kwaphoqa ukuthi uRamaphosa ashintshele uNksz Simelane eMnyangweni wezokuHlaliswa kwaBantu, emva kwengcindezi ayithola emaqenjini aphikasayo ayefuna ukuthi akhishwe esikhundleni ngenxa yezinsolo zenkohlakalo.IKhabhinethi kaRamaphosa alikaqedi ngisho unyaka liqokiwe kodwa kuvele sekunongqongqoshe ababili abasolwa enkohlakalweni.UNksz Ntshavheni uphenyelwa inkohlakalo yokukhishwa kwethenda ka-R2.5 million, eyakhishwa uMasipala waseBa-Phalaborwa.Ngesikhathi kukhishwa ithenda ngo-2009, uNksz Ntshavheni wayeyimenenja yomkhandlu.OKlebe basanda kuqinisekisa ukuthi sebeluphothulile uphenyo lwabo ngalolu daba, bathi sekulele enhlanganweni yezokushushisa, i-National Prosecuting Authority (NPA), ukuthi iyamshushisa yini uNksz Ntshavheni.I-MK, EFF, ne-DA bathe basabela ukuthi uNksz Ntshavheni engagxambukela ophenyweni uma evunyelwa ukuba aqhubeke nokuphatha isikhundla sakhe.UNksz Ntshavheni ubhekelele ezezinhloli aphinde akhulumele iKhabhinethi.Okhulumela iMK, uMnuz Nhlamulo Ndhlela, uthe kuyasingcolisa isithunzi seKhabhinethi ukuqhubeka kukaNksz Ntshavheni nokuphatha isikhundla."Sihlaba ikhwelo lokuba amiswe emsebenzini ngokushesha. Empeleni siyazibuza ukuthi wayekade eqokwe kanjani kwakhona kwasekuqaleni ngoba vele umlando wakhe awumuhle. Igama lakhe liyavela embikweni weKhomishini eyayiPhenya izinsolo zokuLawulwa koMbuso yiDlanzana.”Okhulumela i-EFF, uNksz Leigh-Ann Mathys, uthe inkinga enkulu ukuthi uRamaphosa akabathatheli izinyathelo labo ababephambili emkhankasweni wakhe wokuhola i-ANC."Siyazi ukuthi uNksz Ntshavheni wayephambili emkhankasweni kaRamaphosa wango-2017. Ingakho agixabezwa ngesikhundla. Uhlulekile ukuphatha eminyangweni ake aqokelwa kuyona. Kusobala ukuthi uRamaphosa ugxosha kuphela labo abangazange bameseke ngesikhathi ekhankasela ukuhola i-ANC.”Ilungu le-DA, uNkk Dianne Kohler Barnard, lithe sebebhalele uRamaphosa bemnxusa ukuba asuse uNksz Ntshavheni esikhundleni."Akakwazi ukuphatha isikhundla njengoba ebhekene nophenyo olubucayi ngale ndlela. Siyazi ukuthi lona akusiye ungqongqoshe wokuqala obhekene nezinsolo zenkohlakalo. Kusho ukuthi inkulu inkinga lapha kwiKhabhinethi.”Okhulumela i-ANC, uNkk Mahlengi Bhengu-Motsiri, uthe amaqembu aphikisayo athatha ngamawala.UNkk Bhengu-Motsiri uthe uNksz Ntshavheni akakabekwa icala, wathi i-ANC ingakwazi kuphela ukumthathela izinyathelo uma engase abekwe icala ngokusemthethweni."Amaqembu aphikisayo ayazi ukuthi i-ANC inomgomo othi abaholi ababhekene namacala kufanele bashenxe ezikhundleni. Baningi abaholi abashenxile ezikhundleni emva kokuthweswa amacala. Ngicabanga nje ukuthi amaqembu aphikisayo azama nje ukubukwa.”
ZIMKHALELE owokufika kuleli obezama ukubhalisa emkhandlwini olawula othisha kuleli iSouth African Council for Educators (SACE), esebenzisa incwadi engumkokotelo yaseMnyangweni wezaseKhaya.Ngokwesitatimende seSACE, owesifazane uboshwe amaphoyisa ezama ukubhalisa ekomkhulu lalo mkhandlu eCenturion, eGoli.Isitatimende siveze ukuthi ubezama ukubhalisa ukuze athole isitifiketi kwiSACE.Ukuze ukwazi ukufundisa kuleli kumele ube nesitifiketi esiveza ukuthi ubhalisile kwaSACE."Uboshwe amaphoyisa aseLyttleton. Selokhu kuqale unyaka babili abantu asebeboshiwe abebezama ukubhalisa ngeziqu zomgunyathi. Basuke bethatha amashansi bezama ukungena emkhakheni wokufundisa,” kusho iSACE.Ithe uzobekwa amacala okuzama ukuqola esebenzisa imiqingo engumgunyathi."Sinxusa ukuthi abantu bangafaki izicelo besebenzisa izinto ezingumkokotelo. BASOLA uNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli nezinhlangano ezingakhokhelwa ezilwa nobugebengu emphakathini, ngobulelesi obungalawuleki eNanda, eThekwini.Lokhu kuza emva kwesigameko esinyantisa igazi, esenzeke ngoLwesihlanu olwedlule, lapho kuthiwa amalungu omphakathi abedinwe egane unwabu, ahlahlele amalungu ayisihlanu eqembu lemigulukudu ehlalise lubhojozi umphakathi.Ngalesi sigameko kugcine kuboshwa amalungu omphakathi angu-12, avele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseNtuzuma, ngoMsombuluko, icala lahlehlela uJanuwari 29, ukuze bafake isicelo sebheyili.UMnuz Andile Jali weNtuzuma Neighbourhood Watch, eqale ukuqapha ubugebengu eNtuzuma kodwa yagcina isabalala neTheku lonke, uthe uNtuli wenze okubaxakayo ngasekupheleni konyaka odlule, ethatha izimoto "zabo” ezingu-50, ezinika amaphoyisa.Uthe ngasekupheleni kuka-2023, undunankulu wesifundazwe wangaphambilini, uNkk Nomusa Dube-Ncube, wababizela enkundleni yezemidlalo eHammarsdale, basayina ukuthi uhulumeni ubanike izimoto zokulekelela beqapha ubugebengu ezingu-95."Sathola ezingu-45, ezahlukaniswa ngokwezindawo. KUKHONA okusina kuwajeqeza amalungu e-MK ahhewule umdidiyeli wale nhlangano KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Willies 'Makhuz’emoyizela’ Mchunu, ngeSonto eledlule.I-MK isinqumele ugwayi katiki labo abahhahhameza uMchunu ngaphandle kwasenkantolo ukuba baxolise.Ilungu lethimba elihola i-MK KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Sibusiso Hadebe, lithe azothathelwa izinyathelo zokuqondiswa ubugwegwe la malungu enhlangano uma engaxolisi.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba emva kokuvela enkantolo kwesikhulu senhlangano eyengamele ukhetho, i-Independent Electoral Commission, esiboshelwe ukwephula imigomo yokhetho.UMnuz Musawenkosi Mnikathi, owayeyimenenja ye-IEC elokishini iMbali ngosuku lokhetho, ubevele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMgungundlovu, lapho ebhekene khona necala lokwephula imigomo yokhetho.Ngesikhathi uMnikathi evele enkantolo ngeledlule, uqhekeko kwi-MK luhlale obala.Amalungu e-MK aphazamisa uMchunu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nawo, athi afuna ukuba kubuyiswe abaholi beqembu abasanda kumiswa.I-MK isanda kumisa amalungu esiShayamthetho, uMnuz Thobani Zuma, Dkt Kwazi Mbanjwa, noNksz Cebisile Zuma.UMbanjwa umiselwe amacala amabili, elokuqala liphathelene nokungaphathwa ngendlela kwezigidi zamarandi ezitholwa i-MK njengengxenye yamaqembu ameleleke esiShayamthetho, umiswe noZuma kuleli cala.Elesibili umiselwe izinsolo zokuthi waba nesandla esiphithiphithini esenzeka ngesikhathi kunokhetho lokuchibiyela eMsunduzi lapho kwakhishwa khona igama lomuntu owayeqokwe umphakathi ukuthi amele i-MK okhethweni, kwafakwa igama lomuntu owayelale isibili ngesikhathi kukhethwa ozomela le nhlangano.Kuleli cala uMbanjwa umiswe noNksz Zuma.UMchunu akazange abe khona izolo enkantolo.URadebe uthe i-MK inomthetho okufanele ulandelwe yiwo wonke amalungu enhlangano."Sibanikeze ithuba lokuthi baxolise. Uma bengaxolisi sizothatha izinyathelo ngokulandela imigomo ye-MK.”Icala elibhekene noMnikathi lihlehlile ngenxa yokuthi ushintsha ummeli.Icala lihlehliselwe uFebhuwari 19, lapho khona ummeli omusha ezonikezwa yonke imininingwane yokusuka nokuhlala kwecala, bese kuqokwa usuku okuzoqhubeka ngalo icala.UMnikathi waboshwa emva kokuthi etholwe ehambisa amaphepha okuvota engagadiwe amaphoyisa.URadebe uthe ukushintsha kukaMnikathi abameli kukhombisa ukuthi uyabona ukuthi icala lizomgojela.URadebe uthe basamile ekutheni kwantshontshwa amavoti abo okhethweni lwangonyaka owedlule.Uphinde wathi abakalilahli ithemba lokuthi bazophatha uhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal."Uhulumeni wokubambisana ophethe iKwaZulu-Natal uzobhdlika. Ngeke uketulwe ithina, ibona abazoxabana bodwa ngoba nabo abazazi ukuthi benzani.”Willies Mchunu
UMHOLI webandla lakwaShembe ohlangothini lwaseBuhleni, Inkosi uMduduzi "Unyazilwezulu" Shembe, ugonyuluke ngesigameko lapho yena namaNazaretha besinde beshaywa ngumphezulu.UNYAZILWEZULU lugonyuluke ngokusinda luhlaselwa yizitha ngomphezulu endleleni eya eKhenani Isithombe:SIGCINIWEUNyazi lukhulume ngalesi sehlakalo ngesikhathi lwethula intshumayelo yokuvala umhlangano entabeni yaseKhenani, oZwathini ngempelasonto. Luchaza ngalesi sigameko, uNyazi luthe bebesanda kuqala uhambo oluya eKhenani ngesonto eledlule."Sasisuke lilihle izulu lingelibi kodwa selithe ukukhiza kancane, lingelibi ngalolo hlobo. Sahamba indaba yonakala sesingena konkosi eSazisweni, okuyisiteshi sethu sokuqala uma sisuka emzini waseBuhleni. Lashintsha izulu. Lathi ukuthi banibani kancane. Zabekwa izitsha, saphumula."UNyazi luthe akuphelanga nemizuzu emibili lungene endlini."Ngithe ngisendlini, angazi yini eyangitshela ukuba ngiphumele emnyango. Uma ngiphumela emnyango, ngiyalibona izulu liphonsa imibani. Sengithi mina kwinkosazane eseduze kwami 'gijima utshele abefundisi, abathwala izitsha nabashumayeli baphume phansi kwezihlahla baphumele ngaphandle, bashiye izitsha ngoba ziwuNkulunkulu uqobo lwakhe."UNyazi luthe kwathi uma beqeda ukuphuma lashaya izulu lapho bebehleli khona."Siyabonga kubabamkhulu ngoba ayenzekanga ingozi. Kwakuyintando yomuntu. Niyabona le nto kaShembe, anobatshela nabanye ukuthi , akusiyo into yokudlala. Hhayi ukuthi laliqala ukushaya izulu ngaloluya hlobo. Lashaya liphindelela laphaya. Nami ngaze ngathuka ngisendlini. Belunzima lolu hambo lwethu."UNyazi luthe lutholile ukuthi bekuyizulu ebelithunyelwa ngabantu ebebefuna ukubhubhisa umuzi waseBuhleni."Akulula. Akulula impela. Bahlulekile-ke, bebefuna mina. Uyazi umuntu uyisilima kabi ngoba uyathanda ukufaka isandla emlilweni uvutha. Angazi-ke ukuthi (izulu) selisukile ukuzoshaya thina laqondaphi."UNyazi luthe luyazi ukuthi kukhona umuntu osebenzisana nezitha zalo ozitshelayo ngamathuba okugadla."Njengalaphaya akekho owayazi ukuthi sesikonkosi, sesiphumule. Isitha sisebenza ngomunye umuntu okhona eduze kwethu.Ukushumayela akuwona ushukela, akuwona uswidi..." UNyazi luthe abanye bayazenzisa bashaya sengathi bayaluthanda kodwa izinhliziyo zabo zikude nalo."Sike saluthwala usizi maNazaretha. Ngabonga uma sesifika la. Ngathi siyabonga Bhombela. Konke abebekuzama abantu. Elabantu leliya zulu. Ngelinye ilanga niyoyizwa indaba ngoba indaba ayihlali phansi. Ukuthi lalithunyelwe ngubani kuyozwakala. Leliya zulu walithumela owalithumela kodwa alithintanga muntu."Luqhuba uNyazi luthe kufanele abantu bafunde ukuhlukanisa. "Siyafana ngenyama kodwa wena uwedwa, mina ngimadoda amahlanu."UNyazi luthe akuqali ukuhlaselwa kukaShembe ngomphezulu.Luthe izulu lake lashaya entabeni endala kusewumholi, Ilanga Lamalanga (Inkosi uJohanes Galile Shembe). "Nyanga thize noma umthakathi wangakhona owayezama ukuzwa amandla kaShembe. Anobheka maNazaretha, uShembe akasiyo into yokudlala. UShembe ucela ingane uyithole. Ucele imoto uyithole. Ucele umsebenzi uwuthole. Akusiyo into yokudlala." Uthe lo mthakathi wabe eselihlomisa izulu maqede walijikijela entabeni iNhlangakazi, imibani iphambana khona."Kuthiwa (ubabamkhulu) waphumela emnyango, wakhumula isigqoko wasiphatha ngesandla. Imibani ejikijelwa yile ndoda, yaphambana kuyena. Wama nje wabuka. Wabe esehosha isambulela wasikhomba lapho (imibani) liqhamuka ngakhona."UNyazi luthe kwabonakala sekuvutha umuzi wale ndoda kwasha yonke into. Luthe ngakusasa le ndoda yavukela kwiLanga nenkabi yenkomo, iyocela uxolo. Nomsunguli webandla lakwaShembe, uMqaliwendlela (uMphrofethi Isaiah Shembe) kuthiwa wake wahlaselwa yindoda eyayihlome ngomkhonto kanti uzotshelwa yiZwi ukuthi akangalali ohlangothini ayevamise ukulala ngakululo etendeni.UNyazi luthe yafika le ndoda ebusuku yafike yagwaza inhlabathi."Uma ivuka le ndoda iyobheka, nangu uBhombela ezelula. Yashayeka phansi. UShembe akasiyo into yokudlala maNazaretha," Seluphetha uNyazi lukhale ngababuye bazitike ngocansi entabeni eyiNgcwele lwathi bangcolisa umhlangano."Kodwa noma esebanjiwe lowo muntu angifuni ashaywe. Ukushaya akulungisi. Kufanele umuntu umyale, umfundise umthetho ngoba uzothi uyamshaya avele ashone," kuphetha uNyazi.
IPHINI likaNdunankulu kaZulu, iNkosi Phathisizwe Chiliza, lithi iSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini sizohluba udlubu ekhasini ngezisematheni okukhona kuzo nomgcagco waso uma sesithula inkulumo yaso eMkhosini waseSandlwana.UMkhosi waseSandlwana, uzogujwa namhlanje, eNquthu.Inkulumo yeMbube yakulo nyaka ibhekwe ngabomvu njengoba kulindeleke ukuthi iNgonyama icacise ukuthi uzoqhubeka yini umgcagco wayo ngeSonto, iphinde iphawule nangodaba lukaNdunankulu kaZulu.Iseyinzukayikeyi eyomgagco weSilo noNdlunkulu uNomzamo Myeni, okufanele ube ngeSonto njengoba kuke kwavela incwadi okuthiwa ibhalwe oNgangezwe, ethi umgcagco uhoxisiwe.UChiliza uthe abantu kufanele balinde izwi leNgonyama kulolu daba."Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bakhumbule ukuthi lapha kwaZulu iNgonyama yinye. Zonke lezi zinto ebezikhulunywa ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, akukho nelilodwa ilanga lapho kuke kwazwakala iBhubesi libhonga ngezindaba ezithinta lona. "Lapha kwaZulu umlilo wasendlunkulu awuwothi ngesifuba, kufanele ufingqe izinyawo. Kufanele ulinde kuze kukhulume iNgonyama njengomnini walolu daba okukhulunywa ngalo njengoba kukhulunywa ngomgcagco. Ingakho kuze kube namhlanje engekho othi uthunywe iNgonyama ukuba amemezele umgcagco.”Indida ngokukhuphuka kodwendwe lweMbube iyindaba egudwini kwabaningi.UChiliza uthe yonke imibuzo izophenduleka namhlanje uma iBhubesi selibhongwa phezu kweSandlwana."Sonke silinde uMkhosi waseSandlwana.”Ngaphandle kodaba lomgcagco, kulindeleke ukuthi iMbube iphinde ithinte udaba lukaNdunankulu kaZulu.Sekuphele isikhathi eside engekho uNdunankulu kaZulu kulandela ukuxoshwa kukaMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, oxoshwe ngenyanga eyedlule.UButhelezi uxoshwa nje, wayekade emenyezelwe ukuba athathe lesi sikhundla eMkhosini waseSandlwana wangonyaka owedlule.Umkhosi wakulo nyaka awenziwanga ngempelasonto njengoba bekujwayele ukwenzeka, kepha uqondaniswe nosuku okwatholana ngalo uZulu namaNgisi.UChiliza uthe konke sekumimi ngomumo."Njengoba sonke sazi ukuthi ngoJanuwari 22, ngo-1879, usuku uZulu anqoba ngalo amaNgisi, umgubho wakulo nyaka uqondene nalo usuku lwempi. Onke amabombo abheke eSandlwana.”Ingxenye yebutho likaZulu ilokhu yafika ngeSonto eSandlwana, njengoba ilindele ngakhona.Izolo bekunomcimbi owandulela, lapho uMasipala wesiFunda uMzinyathi ubuwenze isifundo ngempi yaseShiyane.UZulu watholana namaNgisi eShiyane, emva kwempi yaseSandlwana.
UGXEKIWE ngokuphonsa umbono wakhe entweni angayiqeqeshelwe, ufakazi kwelokubulawa kowayengunozinti we-Orlando Pirates neBafana Bafana, uSenzo Meyiwa, ngesikhathi ephendula imibuzo eNkantolo eNkulu yasePitoli.Ufakazi, uBrigadier Bongani Gininda, ongumphenyi omkhulu kuleli cala, ubephonswa imibuzo, ummeli kammangalelwa uMuzikawukhulelwa Sibiya, u-Advocate Charles Mnisi.UGininda ubebuzwa ngokuya kukammangalelwa wesibili, uMnuz Bongani Ntanzi, kudokotela wamazinyo, emva kokuboshwa kwakhe ngoJuni 2020.Wenabe ngokuthi into eyayiyiselwa uNtanzi kudokotela wamazinyo ukuthi ayohlolwa njengoba kukhona ofakazi ababeveze ukuthi omunye kubasolwa abangena endlini wayenezinyo legolide.UMnisi ubuze uGininda ukuthi yini ke eyatholwa odokotela, waphendula ngelithi bathola ukuthi akukho lapho okukhombisa khona ukuthi kukhona izinyo legolide aselikhiphile."Waveza ukuthi akakaze abenalo izinyo legolide,” kusho uGininda.Uthe esethi uqhubeka nomunye umbuzo uMnisi, uGininda wathi ucela ukuqhubeka achaze kakhudlwana ngendaba yezinyo legolide, wavele wamphebeza uMnisi."Awume Brigadier! Uyasiphazamisa. Uma kukhona ofuna ukukucacisa, uzokwenza lokho uma usuhlonywa imibuzo uMbuso, ngesikhathi sawo sokukubuza imibuzo isibili. Sengidlulela kokunye mina manje. Angazi ngempela ukuthi inkinga ikuphi,” kubhoka uMnisi.Kungenelele umshushisi woMbuzo, u-Adv George Baloyi, othe kufanele uGininda avunyelwe ukuthi enabe uma enomuzwa wokuthi kufanele acacise okuthile.Inkantolo imvumele, wase ethi ufuna ukuveza ukuba kungenzeka ukuthi owayelifakile izinyo legolide, wayengalifakwanga ngendlela ehlelekile yodokotela, wathi uma eselikhipha, wasebenzisa indlela efanayo."Uyangiphoqa-ke manje ukuthi ngikubuze ukuthi njengoba uyiphoyisa, ukuqeqeshelwe yini ukuthi uphikise okutholwe udokotela? Akuvezile udokotela ukuthi izinyo legolide alikaze libe khona!” kushaya phansi uMnisi.Uqhube wathi lokhu osekwenziwa uGininda, kuwukubeka umbono komuntu oyiphoyisa, ongakaze nangelilodwa ilanga abe wudokotela.UGininda uyena fakazi ohlale isikhathi eside ebhokisini lofakazi njengoba aqala ukwethula ubufakazi ngo-Okthoba, nyakenye.Kokunye okugqame kakhulu ebufakazini bakhe, ukuveza kwakhe ukuthi wayenze isicelo sokuboshwa komculi uKelly Khumalo. Wathi lokhu wakwenza ngoba ekholelwa ekutheni nguye owayehamba bambili etulweni lokubulawa kukaMeyiwa.UGininda akagcinanga lapho, waphinde waveza ukuthi uKelly wakhokhela abamangalelwa abaphambi kwenkantolo imali engu-R45 000 ukuthi babulale uMeyiwa.
ISEYINSUMANSUMANE eyokukhuphuka kodwendwe lweSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini noNdlunkulu uNomzamo Myeni.Nakuba inkantolo isichithile isicelo sokuba umiswe umgcagco ozokuba ngeSonto, ukuqhubeka kwawo kungase kususe omunye umdonsiswano wasezinkantolo.Abameli bakaNdlunkulu uNtokozo Mayisela Zulu, obefake isicelo sokuthi umiswe umgcagco, bathe uNdlunkulu uKaMayisela angase athathe izinyathelo zomthetho uma zigcine ziwushayile kwiNdlulamithi yamakhosi ngeSonto.Lokhu bakusho ngesizathu sokuthi iMbube iphike yalala ngomhlane ukuthi izogcagcelwa ngeSonto.Lokhu ikusho encwadini yasenkantolo efungelwe efundwe abameli bayo ngesikhathi kulalelwe icala eNkantolo eNkulu yaseMgungundlovu, izolo.Umgcagco weMbube wamenyezelwa obeyikhulumela osanda kuqheliswa, uMntwana uSimphiwe Zulu, isimemezelo saze safakwa ngisho ekhasini elisemthethweni leMbube elisezinkundleni zokuxhumana.INdlulamithi yamakhosi ithe ayikaze isho ukuthi izogcagcelwa, yathi ngesikhathi kwenziwa isimemezelo yona yayisemgonqweni njengoba kwakuqhubeka uMkhosi woSelwa.Lokhu kushayisana nokushiwo iMbube ngeSonto, lapho itshele khona iziko lezindaba eliwuzakwabo weSolezwe, i-IOL, ukuthi umgcagco uzoqhubeka.IMbube ibisho kanje ngesikhathi ichitha incwadi okuthiwa iyibhalile eveza ukuthi umgcagco uhoxisiwe.Ummeli kaNdlunkulu uKaMayisela, uMnuz Melusi Xulu weDonda Attorneys, uthe bazoqapha ukuthi luyakhuphuka yini udwendwe ngeSonto."Uma uzokhuluma enkantolo ufungile, uthi awuzukushadelwa bese uyashadelwa, kuzokuba nenkinga lapho ngoba lokho kuyokusho ukuthi ukhohlise inkantolo. UNdlunkulu sekuyofanele ukuthi asitshele ukuthi iziphi izinyathelo okuyafanele sizithathe ngoba kuyobe kuphulwe imithetho.”UXulu uthe umthetho awuvumi ukuthi umuntu oshade umshado omhlophe athathe isithembu.Kepha ungoti wezomthetho, uMnuz Mpumelelo Zikalala, uthe alikho icala uma iMbube iqhubeka nomgcagco wayo.UZikalala uthe into engafaka iMbube enkingeni ukuba ubhaliswe ngokusemthethweni umgcagco wayo."Ayikho into eyisivimbelo senkantolo ethi iMbube ayingaqhubeki nemicimbi emibili ehleliwe, inqobo uma kuwukuthi umshado angeke ubhaliswe ngokusemthethweni.”Inkantolo isichithile isicelo sikaNdlunkulu uKaMayisela, yathi asiphuthumi.IJaji uSidwell Mngadi lithe uNdlunkulu uKaMayisela wavuma ukuthi iMbube ithathe isithembu, baze bavumelana ngokuthi kushintshwe umshado wabo omhlophe ube ngowesintu, ukuze iMbube izokwazi ukuthatha abanye ondlunkulu."Naze naqala uhlelo lokushintsha umshado wenu kodwa lwabuye lwamiswa. Ngokubuka kwami, lwamiswa ngenxa yokuthi izinto zabuye zangahamba kahle emshadweni njengoba sekufakwe nesicelo sokwehlukanisa.”UMngadi uthe akazi ukuthi kungani uNdlunkulu uKaMayisela bese efuna ukuvimba iMbube ekutheni ithathe abanye ondlunkulu ekubeni avuma ukuthi iMbube ithathe isithembu.
KUZOCACA emva kwesonto ukuthi buzonyakaziswa ndlelani ubuholi be-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, obashaya udaka okhethweni lukazwelonke olwalungoMeyi, nyakenye. Lokhu kuvezwe nguNobhala Jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, oqede ukuqagela ngekusasa lobuholi be-ANC e-KZN naseGauteng, njengoba isigungu esiphezulu sale nhlangano sinqume ukuthi bunyakaziswe ngenhloso yokuqiniswa ubuholi balezi zifundazwe.UMbalula udedele lesi sinqumo esithangamini sabezindaba eGauteng, izolo.Uveze ukuthi abaholi abaphezulu bale nhlangano bazophuma nesu lokuthi uhlaka oluzolandelwa ukuqinisa lezi zifundazwe luzoma ndlelani njengoba sesiphumile isinqumo."Umbiko wohlaka oluzosetshenziswa oqhamuka kubaholi abaphezulu bazwelonke uzothulwa ekomitini elibhekele ukusebenza kwansuku zonke kwe-ANC ngoMsombuluko ozayo. Kuzobe sekujutshwa abaholi abasesigungwini esiphezulu senhlangano ukuthi baye emagatsheni, bayowachazela ngokuthi iyiphi indlela ezosetshenziswa. "Amalungu namagatsha awalinde kuze kube yisonto elizayo njengoba sizokhipha umkhombandlela. Ngizobhalela zonke izifunda, amagatsha nezifundazwe ukuthi balinde size sibuyele kubona ngesonto elizayo mayelana nezindlela ezizosetshenziswa kulezi zifundazwe,” kusho uMbalula.Uthe bekushubile emhlanganweni okuthathwe kusona isinqumo sokuthi kunyakaziswe ubuholi."Bekungelula, bekunzima kodwa siphume nezwi lokuthi ikuphi okumele sikwenze. Sivumelene ngokuthi ngeke sibuthinte ubuholi kuhulumeni, esizokwenza ukubhekana nobuholi be-ANC,” usho kanjena. Inkulumo kaMbalula isho ukuthi ngeke athintwe uMnuz Panyaza Lesufi kwesokuba nguNdunankulu waseGauteng.UMbalula uthe konke abazokwenza bazosebenzisa uMthethosisekelo wale nhlangano, waveza ukuthi kwezinye izifundazwe basaphethe amandla kanti kulezi ezimbili bashaywe bancama. E-KZN yiqembu uMkhonto weSizwe eliholwa ngowayengumengameli we-ANC nezwe, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, elabadlisa ngamapayipi. "Inhloso yethu enkulu ukufaka isandla siqinise ubuholi kulezi zifundazwe, silungise nesimo. Sizozinza kulezi zifundazwe kuye ngokuthi mungakanani umsebenzi okumele wenziwe.” kusho yena.Uthe nasemhlanganweni wesigungu esiphezulu, amalungu abuzile ukuthi kuzothatha isikhathi esingakanani lokhu kungenelela okuzobakhona.I-ANC e-KZN yathola u-17%, isuka ku-54%, manje isiyiqembu lesithathu ngobukhulu esiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal.Kanjalo naseGauteng, i-ANC yahluleka ukunqoba ukhetho ngamalengiso njengoba yathola u-36%, isuka ku-50%.UMbalula ubuye waluleka izifundazwe ukuthi zibambe amatomu zingajahi ukwenza imicimbi eyaziwa nge-Januwari 8, okusuke kuhlahlwa indlela nezinto le nhlangano ezogxila kuzona kulowo nyaka.Ukusho lokhu kulandela uqwembe olukhishwe wubuholi be-ANC esifundazweni lapho iveza uSihlalo uMnuz Sboniso Duma, ukuthi uzobe ekhuluma kulo mgubho ozoba ngoFebhuwari 2 eCaluza Sports Ground, eMgungundlovu."Noma singekho isinqumo esikhishiwe mayelana nama-rali, kodwa nginganxusa ukuthi kumiwe ngawo, angenziwa okwamanje. Ngingaphakamisa ukuthi aze enziwe uma sekuchazelwe izinhlaka ngokuzokwenzeka,” kusho uMbalula.UMNUZ Panyaza Lesufi ozoqhubeka nokuba nguNdunankulu waseGauteng yize i-ANC izonyakazisa ubuholi besifundazwe Isithombe SIGCINIWEUKUNYAKAZISWA kwe-ANC KwaZulu-Natal kuhambisane nomyalelo wokuthi kumiswe izinhlelo zeJanuwari 8, lapho bekuhlelwe ukuthi kukhulume uMnuz Sboniso Duma ngoFebhuwari 2, eCaluza Sports Ground, eMgungundlovu Isithombe: Tumi Pakkies
KUPHUME ezishaqisayo eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini, kuvela ukuthi ikhadi lasebhange likammangalelwa obecela ibheyili ecaleni lokubulawa kwabesifazane ngesihluku, liyaqhubeka nokusebenza ngokujwayelekile yize yena evalelwe ngaphakathi.Lokhu kuvezwe iMantshi u-Ashwin Singh ngaphambi kokunqaba nebheyili kuMnuz Lungani Mthethwa (31), ongummangalelwa wokuqala ecaleni lokubulawa kukaNksz Anele Mbokazi (29) noNksz Zizipho Gabisa (30) nyakenye.Izidumbu zabafi, ababedutshulwe ezindaweni ezibucayi zatholwa zidindilize emgwaqweni eKenville ngo-Agasti 25.Kwaboshwa uMthethwa nomngani wakhe, uMnuz Sandile Chili osephenduke ufakazi woMbuso, amacala akhe ahoxiswa.Ngesikhathi uSingh enza izethulo zokunqaba nebheyili, ubalule izinto ezimbalwa athe zenza abone ubufakazi, uMthethwa acele ngabo ibheyili, bungaqinile futhi bushiya imibuzo.USingh ubuye wabalula nokuthi ayikho into ebambekayo uMthethwa ayisho encwadini yakhe efungelwe, ngaphandle kokuthathisela okuningi kokwavezwa uChili ngesikhathi ecela eyakhe ibheyili nyakenye.UMMANGALELWA uMnuz Lungani Mthethwa Isithombe: ZIMBILI VILAKAZI"Ikhadi lakho lasebhange, kuvela ukuthi liyaqhubeka nokusebenza yize wena uboshiwe. Kunokungena nokuphuma kwemali kwi-akhawunti yakho okwenzeke wena usuvalelwe. Lokhu kushiya imibuzo yokuthi ngabe lisetshenziswa umuntu ongaphandle onemininingwane yakho noma uwena oneselula ngaphakathi ejele, yikho ukwazi ukwamukela imali ethize, uphinde ukhiphe ethize yize uvalelelwe,” kusho uSingh.Enza isibonelo uthe ngoNovemba kungene imali engu-R210 000 ebhange likaMthethwa, kwathi ezinsukwini ezimbalwa ingenile leyo mali, u-R100 000 wayo wakhishwa, uthunyelwa komunye umuntu."Lokhu kushiya imibuzo uma kuza kokubhalwe encwadini efungelwe, lapho ubalule khona ukuthi ukugqunywa kwakho ngaphakathi (kusathethwa icala), kuyakuthikameza ebhizinisini lakho lokuhweba ngemali njengoba udinga ubuchwepheshe bamaselula ukuze uqhubeke nokuzisebenza,” kusho uSingh.UMMANGALELWA uMnuz Lungani Mthethwa Isithombe: ZIMBILI VILAKAZIUbuye wabalula nokuthi inkantolo ayibutholanga ubufakazi obenele obukhombisa ukuthi izingane eziyisithupha, athe ngezakhe futhi uyazondla, lokho ukwenza ngempela."Ezitifiketini zokuzalwa ozilethile, asikho nesisodwa esinegama lakho kuso ukuveza ukuthi zingezakho ngempela. Noma kungathiwa ezakho ngempela kushiya imibuzo ukuthi yini eyayidala ukuthi onina bangabi nayo imininingwane yakho ukuze bayifake ezitifiketini ngesikhathi beyozibhalisa eMnyangweni wezaseKhaya,” usho kanje.Uthe naye uMthethwa ukuba wayengumuntu ozikhathalele izingane zakhe, wayeyoziyela ngokwakhe emnyangweni, ayofaka imininingwane yakhe njengobaba."Esitatimendeni sakho sasebhange, akukho lapho okuvela khona ukuthi uyondla njengoba ushilo encwadini efungelwe,” kusho uSingh.Okhulumele imindeni yabagilwa ngaphandle kwenkantolo, uMnuz Mvuselelo Magwaza uthe kubajabulisile ukuthi angayitholi ibheyili."Siyabona ukuthi njengoba enqatshelwe ibheyili, akubanga yimbobo yenaliti kodwa kube yingcaca,” kusho uMagwaza.Njengenjwayelo inkantolo ibigcwele phama. Kukhona imindeni, ebebezoyeseka, okukhona kubo nabe-ANCWL.Ngesikhathi esesukunyisiwe uMthethwa, uSingh ethula isinqumo sakhe, ubebonakala ethe njo kuye, ngethemba lokuthi kuzokwenzeka isimanga, adedelwe ngebheyili. Abebethamele icala bebelokhu benxaphe njalo uma kuvela okubadinayo ngommangalelwa. Icala lizobuyela ngoLwesine eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini lapho selidluliselwe khona.
UFUNA ukuyibona ikhalelwa amasongo kaSigonyela iMeya kaMasipala Inkosi Langalibalele, eMtshezi, owesifazane ophila nokukhubazeka oyisola ngokumbhubhisa ngesibhaxu ngoLwesine.Elandisa ngesigameko umgilwa, uNksz Zandile Radebe, uthe senzeke emahhovisi e-IFP, umsolwa uMnuz Mduduzi Myeza, ezothatha ama-voters roll njengoba kuvotelwa ubuholi obusha emagatsheni.Uthe ngesikhathi engena uMyeza, ehamba nePhini lakhe kulo masipala, umsole ngokungawenzi kahle umsebenzi wakhe."Ngithe uma ngimbuza ukuthi imuphi umsebenzi athi angiwenzi kahle, wangisola ngokumfaka amagama emlonyeni. Wase engishaya,” kusho uNksz Radebe.Uthe umqede ngenqwaba yezimpama, ebeziza ngesankahlu."Ngize ngawa nasesihlalweni ebengihleli kuso,” kusho uNksz Radebe, othe akekho omlamulele ehlaselwa uMyeza, kulabo ebebekhona.Lona wesifazane uthe useneminyaka eyisithupha engumabhalane ehhovisi le-IFP kule ndawo, waveza ukuthi ngesikhathi eqashwa, umsolwa wayengakabi nayimeya.Uthe ngesikhathi umsolwa esengene kwesobumeya, esejwayele ukufika ehhovisi le-IFP, ubekhombisa ukungamuzwa kahle."Njalo uma efika ehhovisi, uhlale esebenzisa indluzula kimi. Ubebuye angithuke ngisho nokungithuka. Ukungithuka nje bese kuyisinkwa semihla ngemihla,” kusho uNksz Radebe, othe kulokhu ukhethe ukuyivulela icala imeya ngoba ize yambeka isandla.Uthe okumkhathazayo ukuthi akasikhumbuli isigigaba angathi samenza waba nyamanambana kumsolwa."Ngifisa aboshwe ngoba lokhu kungihlukumeza kwakhe kungidalela ukhwantalala. Sengiyamesaba kakhulu kunakuqala njengoba engishayile nje,” kusho uNksz Radebe.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa ase-Estcourt aphenya icala lokushaya nelokwehlisa isithunzi kulandela ukuthi owesifazane (40) eshawe ngesandla. "Umsolwa umuntu amaziyo, umhlasele emsebenzini ngoLwesine. Kuvela nokuthi umsolwa ubuye wamthuka umgilwa,” kusho uNetshiunda. Ucingo lwemeya belungangeni. Olokhulumela i-IFP, uMnuz Mkhuleko Hlengwa, belukhala lungabanjwa kwaze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela.
INGXENYE yebutho likaZulu iqede ukuthela othulini inkunzi yase ibhekisa amabombo eSandlwana, eNquthu, lapho kunesikhumbuzo sempi kaZulu namaNgisi ngesonto elizayo.Elinye iqoqo lebutho lizolandela kusasa. Ibutho eliphambili lizokube liyolindela ngakhona njengoba ngoLwesithathu kuzokuba nomkhosi wokukhumbula isigameko esenzeka entabeni, lapho uZulu anqoba amaNgisi.Ibutho lichithwe ngoLwesine esigodlweni eMashobeni, kwaNongoma, lapho bekunoMkhosi woSelwa, kanti bese lihlale isonto lonke esigodlweni lenza yonke imikhuba eyenziwa uma kunoMkhosi woSelwa, okubalwa nokubamba, kushumpulwe inkunzi.Bekuqala ukuba kwenziwe uMkhosi woSelwa selokhu iSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini, sangena esihlalweni emva kokukhothama kweSilo uGoodwill Zwelithini kaBhekuzulu.Okhulumela iSilo, uMntwana uSimphiwe Zulu, uthe umkhosi ube yimpumelelo."Lona umkhosi omdala owawenziwa amakhosi endulo. Wagcina ukwenziwa iSilo sasoNdini, uCetshwayo, wase ubuya uvuselelwa yiSilo esibuzile uMdlokombane. Kuthe esebuzile-ke uMdlokombane, wathi ukuma kancane umkhosi. Okokuqala kwenziwa lo mkhosi sekuphethe iSilo esisesihlaweni,” kuchaza uMntwana uSimphiwe."Kuyasithokozisa thina njengendlunkulu ngoba lo mkhosi selokhu uqalile ngoDisemba 14, yonke into ihamba kahle. Selokhu uqalile kukhombisa ukuthi abanikazi bawo nendlunkulu yonke bawuvumile. Namanje kusakhombisa ngoba silokhu sithi siyathinta esikuthintayo, livele line. Imvula ikhombisa ukuthi umkhuleko weNgonyama uhambe ngendlela okuyiyo.”UMntwana uSimphiwe ukuqinisekisile ukuthi uMkhosi weMpi yaseSandlwana, uzokuba ngoLwesithathu, wathi iSilo sicelile ukuthi yonke imigubho yenziwe ngosuku okwenzeka ngalo isigameko ngqo, kungashintshelwa kolunye usuku."NoMkhosi waKwaDukuza bese kuvamisile ukuthi wenzeke ngoMgqibelo. Kulo nyaka, iNgonyama icelile nawo ukuthi wenziwe ngoSeptemba 24, ophakathi nezinsuku.”Umdidiyeli wamabutho uMntwana uVanana Zulu, uthe ibutho elizoyolindela eSandlwana, lizosuka oLundi ngeSonto."NgoMsombuluko sizokube siseShiyane.”Kwenzeka lokhu nje, akukacaci ukuthi uzoqhubeka yini umgcagco weSilo ohlelelwe isonto elizayo.IMbube kuhlelwe ukuthi igcagcelwe nguNdlunkulu uNomzamo Myeni, kodwa kunesicelo sasenkantolo esivimba umgcagco.Lesi sicelo sifakwe nguNdlunkulu uNtokozo Mayisela Zulu, okhala ngokuthi iMbube ayinalo ilungelo lokuthatha omunye undlunkulu ngoba yashada umshado omhlophe naye.Isicelo sikandlunkulu sizolalelwa eNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu, ngoMsombuluko.
BAWOTHA ubomvu abazali basesikoleni samabanga aphansi iBlessed Luanda esiseDonnybrook endaweni yase-St Charles, KwaZulu-Natal, njengoba bekhala ngokungabi bikho kwendawo yokuzikhulula kulesi sikole.Kubikwa ukuthi izingane zizikhulula ngemuva kwamathoyilethi emigodi amadala asemagcekeni aso lesi sikole.Omunye wabazali utshele Isolezwe ukuthi nyakenye uze waphela unyaka amathoyilethi engabonwa."Induna yendawo yaphakamisa ukuthi akuqoqwe abafana bambe imigodi ukuze kulungiswe amathoyilethi, kodwa uthishomkhulu wakuchitha lokho, wathi usezinhlelweni zokuthi alungiswe," kusho umzali ongathandanga ukudalulwa ngoba evikela ingane yakhe efunda kulesi sikole.Uthe sekuze kwagcwala omahambanendlwana abebesetshenziswa."Ekumiseni kwakhe ukuthi alungiswe, wathi uzobambisa ngawomahambanendlwana kodwa nawo selokhu afika awakazwe athululwe, agcwele. Kwale noma sekufika ugandaganda ukuzogumba imigodi wawujikisa esangweni.""Izingane sezizikhulula esikhotheni ngaphandle kwabo omahambanendlwana, okubeka impilo yazo engcupheni ngoba zingashaywa nayizinyoka. Waphinde wakhipha umyalelo kuthina njengabazali ukuthi asikhiphe imali engango-R100 ukuze, kwakhiwe amathoyilethi. Ababenayo bayikhipha kodwa namanje kusathulekile, akazwe kwenzeke lutho," ubeke kanje.Omunye wabazali uthe abaxakiwe indaba yamathoyilethi kuphela, kodwa banenkinga nangendaba yemifaniswano yesikole."Uthishomkhulu uyawushintshashintsha umfaniswano wesikole. Ngonyaka afika ngawo wayishintsha njengoba manje besekugqokwa isiketi esibomvu namashethi amhlophe sajabula singabazali. Gwiqiqi nyakenye wathi sekuneshethi lesikole elimhlophe okumele lithungiswe elizoba nebheji lesikole nomugqa obomvu, saphinde savuma singabazali. Kube sekuphuma umyalelo wokuthi uma kuqala lo nyaka kumele izingane zibe sezigqoka lowo mfaniswano, kodwa manje uthishomkhulu usesitshela ukuthi leli shethi akasalifuni, usefuna isikibha esi-navy esinombala obomvu, nejezi lesikole nalo walishintsha. Singabazali siyazibuza ukuthi njengoba eza nalezi zinguquko ezingaka, thina sizoyithathaphi imali?""Okubuhlungu kakhulu ukuthi useze wakhipha nomyalelo wokuthi amashethi amhlophe akasawafuni ngoba abazali bayahluleka ukuwasha. Leyo nto iyasinenga singabazali ngoba ayifiki kahle kuthina ukuthi ingashiwo umuntu ophethe isikole," uphethe kanje.Uthe kuke kwahlongozwa umhlangano nesigungu esilawula isikole ukuze kubhungwe ngayo le ndaba yomfaniswano njengoba ungatholakali ezitolo ezidumile.Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Muzi Mahlambi, uthe isikole sinawo amathoyilethi, okuhlukile ukuthi angomahambanendlwana."Ukuba khona komahambanendlwana kusho ukuthi sikwazile ukuhlinzeka isikole ngamathoyilethi, okusho ukuthi lawa ababewasebenzisa ngaphambilini anenkinga. Ukushintshashintsha imifaniswano yesikole angikholwa ukuthi uthishomkhulu usithatha yedwa isinqumo. Kunesigungu esangamele isikole uthishomkhulu abonisana naso ebese kuphunywa nesinqumo futhi kuyinto eqale iyodingidwa nasemhlanganweni wabazali," kusho uMahlambi.Ugcizelele nokuthi njengoba uthishomkhulu wathi abazali abakhiphe imali engu-R100, unalo ilungelo lokwenza lokho ngoba ekugcineni usuke engaphoqe muntu, ubiza umhlangano kudingidwe ngodaba olusuke lusematheni, bese kuyavunyelwana.
IZINDUNA zamabutho sezithumele isexwayiso esishubile kodume ngokugxibha iSilo uMisuzulu ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, uMnuz Max Makhanya.Izinduna zamabutho zithe uzokubona okwakhweza ikati emthini uMakhanya uma eqhubeka nokunephuza iSilo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana.Sekunesikhathi eside uMakhanya ekhwela edilika eSilweni, aze aphimisele elokuthi uZulu awunayo inkosi selokhu kwakhothama iSilo uGoodwill Zwelithini kaBhekuzulu.Muva nje, uMakhanya ungene ezinkundleni zokuxhumana wagxeka isinqumo seSilo sokwehlukanisa nondlunkulu othile nesokugcagcelwa uNdlunkulu uNomzamo Myeni."ISilo esinjani esilobola omabezingane zabanye abafana? ISilo esinjani lesi esidivosa izingane zabantu? Thina sazi ukuthi ayikho idivosi.”UNobhala weziNduna esifundeni iZululand, uMnuz Muzi Nyandeni, uthe uMakhanya uzibizela amabhadi ngale nto ayenzayo, wamyalela ukuba ayiyeke."Akayiyeke le nto ayenzayo. Uma yena engayifuni iNgonyama, kulungile akazihlalele kubo, adle uphuthu lwakubo. Uzokuba neshwa uma eqhubeka nale nto. Ubeyini yena, ungubani ukuba azokhuluma izindaba ezingamdingi? Uhlulwa izindaba zakubo, uzogijimela izindaba ezingamdingi. Akakuyeke lokuhlakanipha kwakhe kungaze kuphele.”UNyandeni uthe nakuba yena neningi labadidiyeli bamabutho bengekho ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, bese bebikeliwe ngodaba lukaMakhanya."Ikhona impela imvunge. Ekugcineni le nto iyaye iveze umuntu ukuthi uphuma ekhaya elinjani nokuthi ukhuliswe kanjani. Angazi noma kuyimpoqo yini ukuthi ukuze abantu badume ezinkundleni zokuxhumana kufanele bathuke abanye. Ungathi kukhona isidakamizwa abasidlayo, esibenza baqhulule inhlamba.”Umdidiyeli wamabutho kaZulu, uMntwana uVanana Zulu, uthe uMakhanya udlalela ezitsheni ezifayo, wathi abafuni ukuqophisana naye kakhulu."Asifuni ukukhuluma kakhulu izindaba zabantu abahlanyayo, abakhulunyiswa utshwala. Asifuni ukunaka indaba yabantu abahambe bekhuluma izindaba ezingaphezu kwabo. Njengoba ekhuluma izindaba zasendlunkulu, ezingaphezu kwakhe, kufanele vele akhulume umsangano."Thina-ke asikwazi ukuphikisana nalaba bantu. Akukwazi ukuthi uma behlanya, nathi bese siyahlanya. Akukwazi ukuthi uma bedakwa, bese nathi siyadakwa. Okwamanje sisathule nje siyabuka.”Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kukaMakhanya ayizange iphumelele, akazange awuphendule umyalezo awuthunyelwe ezinkundleni zokuxhumana.
KULALWE ngeSonto abemithombio yezindaba beshayisana ngamakhanda ngendaba ebukeka iwukumbiswa iqanda lenjelwane ngencwadi okuthiwa ikhishwe yiSilo sihoxisa umgcagco nengoduso yaso uMaMyeni. Izolo iMbube, noNdlunkulu uNomzamo Myeni bathe luzokhuphuka udwendwe ngeSonto njengokohlelo olwamenyezelwa.ISilo nengoduso uMaMyeni bathe bazihlalele eSigodlweni eMashobeni. UMaMyeni uphinde waveza nokuthi akazi lutho ngokuhoxiswa kwabaqaphi bakhe nemihlomulo ayithola kuhulumeni.IMbube noNdlunkulu uMaMyeni basho kanjena nje, ngempelasonto kuputshuke incwadi okuthiwa isayinwe oNgangezwe, eveza ukuthi umgcagco usuhoxisiwe."Incwadi yeMbube" ebhekiswe kuMqondisi Jikelele eHhovisi likaNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uDkt Nonhlanhla Mkhize, ithe iNdlunkulu kaZulu ithathe isinqumo sokuhoxisa umgcagco ngenxa yezizathu ezingaphezu kwamandla.Kule ncwadi iMbube iyalela uDkt Mkhize ukuba enze isiqiniseko sokuthi kuhoxiswa bonke abaqaphi nemihlomulo etholwa uNdlunkulu uMaMyeni.Engxoxweni yocingo, iMbube ivele yaphela yinsini uma ibuzwa ngokuhoxiswa komgcagco, yathi ziyawushaya ngeSonto."Engingakusho nje ukuthi ngiyamthanda umkami futhi ngizomshada ngenkani.”IMbube ithe kuzokuba nomhlangano waseNdlunkulu, yathi bazolandelela nokuthi lezi zincwadi ziqhamuka kuphi.Eshaya ngezimfishane, uNdlunkulu uMaMyeni uthe: "Ngizihlalele nomyeni wami (iSilo) lapho sihlala khona, okunye angikwazi.”UNdlunkulu uMaMyeni ukhuluma kanjena nje, Isolezwe lithole ukuthi abakwaMyeni bamatasa namalungiselelo odwendwe.Kuzoqala umkhehlo ngoLwesihlanu, kwaMyeni, eJozini, bese kuba umgcagco ngeSonto, esigodlweni KwaKhangelamankengane.Umthombo okhulume neSolezwe uthe abakwaMyeni bamatasa namalungiselelo omkhehlo.Okhulumela iHhovisi likaNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Bongani Gina, uthe bebengakayitholi incwadi eyalela ukuba kuhoxiswe imihlomulo etholwa uNdlunkulu uMaMyeni.Indaba yomgcagco iphenduka indida nje kuvele kukhona isicelo sokuba umiswe. UNdlunkulu uKaMayisela ufake isicelo esiphuthumayo eNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu, ekhala ngokuthi iSilo asikwazi ukuthatha omunye uNdlunkulu ngoba sashada umshado omhlophe ngo-2021.Isicelo sikaNdlunkulu uKaMayisela sizolalelwa namhlanje.Ummeli kaNdlunkulu uKaMayisela, uMnuz Melusi Xulu weDonda Attorneys, uthe bazoqhubeka nesicelo sabo abasifake enkantolo namhlanje.Phezu kwencwadi ehoxisa umgcagco, kuphinde futhi kube nencwadi exosha okhulumela iSilo, uMntwana uSimphiwe Zulu, waKwaMinyamanzi.Incwadi ebonwe yiSolezwe ixosha uMntwana uSimphiwe ekukhulumeleni iSilo kanye nasekumeleni iMbube endlini yobuholi bomdabu.Kule ncwadi iMbube ikhale ngokuthi uMntwana uSimphiwe akatholakali uma abezindaba befuna ukuphawula kwakhe.Ithe miningi imbiko ebucayi eshicilelwe abezindaba lapho khona uMntwana uSimphiwe engazange atholakale ukuba aphawule.Imizamo yokuthola uMntwana uSimphiwe ayizange iphumelele njengoba ucingo lwakhe belukhala lungabanjwa. Abasendlunkulu bathe abasazi ukuthi babambe kuphi.Owasendlunkulu ocele ukuba igama lakhe lingadalulwa, uthe nabo abazi ukuthi ikhona kuyikuphi okuyiqiniso."Namhlanje sivuka ngokunye, kusasa sitshelwe okunye.”Lo mthombo uthe izinto zoniwa kakhulu yilabo ababanga ukusondela eduze kweSilo."Kukhona uhlangothi olufuna ukusondela eduze kweSilo, olungamfuni uMdolomba (uNdlunkulu uMaMyeni), kube khona uhlangothi oluhambisana noMdolomba. Lezi zinhlangothi ziyalwa, hhayi kancane. Kukhona abaziyo ukuthi uma umgcagco ungase uqhubeke, kuyokube kuphelile ngabo. Nalabo abahambisana noMdolomba bayazi ukuthi uma ungase ungaqhubeki umgcagco, kuyokube kuphelile ngabo.”ISILO Misuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini

Njengoba sinyakazisa ubuholi be-ANC kodwa ubuholi obuthinta uhulumeni asizobuthinta,” kuchaza uMbalula.Uthe inhloso yokunyakazisa ubuholi ukufaka isandla, baqinise ubuholi kulezi zifundazwe."Singenelela ukulungisa isimo esibhekene nalezi zifundazwe. Sizozinza kulezi zifundazwe kuye ngokuthi ungakanani umsebenzi okumele wenziwe kuzona,” kusho uMbalula.Uthe emhlanganweni wesigungu esiphezulu amalungu abuzile ukuthi kuzothatha isikhathi esingakanani ukungenelela okuzobakhona.Isimo besilokhu silutsheku ebuholini bezifundazwe selokhu bashaya udaka okhethweni.UMbalula uthe abazi noma kukhona yini abazoya enkantolo ngoba bengeneme ngalesi sinyathelo sesigungu esiphezulu senhlangano esinamandla.

ISIMO silutsheku ebuholini be-ANC KwaZulu-Natal eyashaya udaka okhethweni lwangoMeyi, ne-ANC Gauteng, njengoba kuchithwe isiphakamiso sokuthi bungathintwa ubuholi be-ANC kulezi zifundazwe.Lishone elayizayo amalungu esigungu esiphezulu kwi-ANC esephikisana ngokuthi ayabuhlakaza noma ajuba amalungu esigungu esiphezulu ukuba ayolekelela ubuholi bakulezi zifundazwe.Ngesikhathi uqala umhlangano wesigungu esiphezulu bekukade kunanombono wokuthi buyekwe ubuholi, kepha ugcine uchithwa lo mbono.Lokhu kushiwo okhulumela i-ANC, uNkk Mahlengi Bhengu-Motsiri, obekhuluma nezintatheli ngesikhathi kuqhubeka umhlangano oqale ngoMgqibelo.UNkk Bhengu-Motsiri uthe amalungu esigungu esiphezulu avumelane ngokuthi kukhona okufanele kwenziwe ngobuholi bakulezi zifundazwe okuyizona ezinabantu abaningi ababhalisele ukuvota."Abaholi be-ANC bafike bethula umbiko ekomitini elibhekelele ukusebenza kwansuku zonke enhlanganweni, kwase kwethulwa umbono esigungwini esiphezulu. Imibono ibimithathu kodwa wabuye wachithwa lona omunye.”I-ANC ayizange yenze kahle KwaZulu-Natal njengoba yathola u-17%, isuka ku-54%, manje isiyiqembu lesithathu ngobukhulu esiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal.Kanjalo naseGauteng i-ANC yahluleka ukunqoba ukhetho ngamalengiso njengoba yathola u-36%, isuka ku-50%.UNkk Bhengu-Motsiri uthe amalungu esigungu esiphezulu avumelane ngokuthi kukhona into okufanele yenziwe kulezi zifundazwe."Kusobala ukuthi kunezinkinga. Kuyabonakala ukuthi kunenkinga yokuhanjiswa kwezindingo kuzona zombili izifundazwe. Yingakho-ke manje sesixoxa ngalena emibili imibono, sibheka ukuthi ikuphi okungcono phakathi kwalezi zinto zombili. Kufanele kube khona ushintsho kulezi zifundazwe, asikwazi ukuqhubeka ngale ndlela.”Kuze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela izolo, amalungu esigungu esiphezulu engakavumelani ngokuthi ikuphi okufanele kwenziwe phakathi kwale mibono emibili.UNobhala Jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, uthe bazoqala ngokwazisa amagatsha enhlangano kuqala ngesinqumo sabo, ngaphambi kokuthi bazise abezindaba.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba, ngoMgqibelo.UMbalula uthe kubalulekile ukuthi okwenziwayo kuzona zombili izifundazwe, wathi abafuni ukulahlekelwa yilezi zifundazwe unomphelo njengoba kwenzeka ngeWestern Cape.I-ANC yagcina ukuphatha eWestern Cape ngaphambi kokhetho lwango-2009, kusukela lapho isifundazwe silokhu siphethwe i-DA futhi i-ANC ayikhombisi ukuthi isazobuya.
IBHANGE Ithala selithembise ukuthi lizokhipha wonke amangwevu ukuzivikela ekuvalweni kokusebenza kwalo ngemuva kwesiphakamiso sokuthi alimiswe. Ngakolunye uhlangothi Inkatha Freedom Party (IFP) ibhoka iyakhahlela ngalesi sinyathelo esithatha "njengochuku” kwabasiqhubayo. Iyalele uhulumeni wesifundazwe ukuba uthatha izinyathelo ezisemthethweni ukumisa lesi sinqumo.Esitatimendeni esikhishwe yi-IFP, leli qembu likhuze umhlola lathi lokhu kufana nokubuyisela emuva intuthuko yabamnyama."Ithala lasungulelwa ukubhekela izidingo zabahlwempu abashiywe dengwane amabhange amakhulu. Imizamo yokulivala kufana nokukhomba ngeklwa ukuvikeleka kwezezimali zabamnyama,” kusho isitatimende. AbeThala bakhiphe isitatimende lapho beveze khona ukuthi bathatha izinyathelo zomthetho ukuzama ukuphikisana nesicelo esifakwe yiBhange Ngodla ngoLwesine, sokuthi livalwe.Esicelweni esifakwe yiBhange Ngodla eNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu, kudalulwe ukuthi ukuvalwa kwebhange Ithala kungasiza ukuvikela abantu abangaphezu kuka-257 000 abalondoloze imali yabo kuleli bhange.Esitatimendeni, Ithala likhale ngokuthi nakuba seliqale ukuxoxisana nabePrudential Authority (PA) ukuze likwazi ukuqhubeka nokusebenza, kodwa iRepayment Administration (RA) iyaqhubeka nekhwelo lokuthi kumiswe ukufakwa nokukhishwa kwemali ebhange labo, elikuchaze ngokuthi kuyisenzo esingenabo ubulungiswa."Sekuyizinyanga eziwu-13 kwangenelela abe-RA ukuzama ukulwisana nathi kulolu daba, kodwa nakuba kunjalo sisalokhu siqhubeke njalo nokwenza umsebenzi ngendlela esihlale senza ngayo. Futhi kuze kuze kube yimanje akukaze kutholakale ubufakazi obukhombisa ukuthi kukhona icala esilenzile,” kusho Ithala.Liqhuba, lithe ikhwelo lokuthi kunqanyulwe ukusebenza kwabo lifika ngesikhathi esibi lapho kuqala unyaka, izakhamuzi zakuleli zilungisela unyaka omusha, futhi kukuningi okubabhekile okudinga imali okuzokwenza baphazamiseke kakhulu uma izinto ziqhubeka ngale ndlela okwenzeka ngayo manje."Sesithathe izinyathelo zomthetho ngalolu daba, ukulwisana nekhwelo le-RA, futhi sesixhumene nehhovisi likaNgqongqoshe wezeziMali uMnuz Enock Godongwana, ukuthi kutholakale ezinye izixazululo zesikhashana ukuvumela amakhasimende ethu ukuthatha imali yabo, bayifake kwamanye amabhange kuze kuze wukuthi sekunesinqumo esiphelele,” kusho isitatimende.Bakhale nangokuthi ukuvalwa kweThala kungabeka engcupheni imisebenzeni elinganiselwa ku-400, futhi kungaba nomthelela omubi kubantu basezindaweni zasemakhaya abathembe bona ukusizwa ngezezimali, kubalwa nokuhola izibonelo zikahulumeni.I-IFP yexwayise ngokuthi abe-Prudential Authority baphonsa inselelo bayibhekise kuyo. "Uma besibiza udede nathi sesingangabo, asenqeni ukungena ezitaladini. Sizozifikela mathupha emnyango kubo.”

"Yingakho sithole umphumela ka-matric owu-58%, okwenze isikole saba semsileni.” Uthe ngenxa yokuthi isikhathi besisincane akagxilanga kakhulu kulolu daba kodwa kuzodingeka balusukumele ngoba luphazamisa ukufunda nokufundisa esikoleni. Ungqongqoshe ubehambisana nobuholi baseMshwathi, obuhlanganisa iMeya uMandla Zondi, iPhini leMeya uNokuthula Mdunge, uSomlomo uSibongile Mbatha-Ntuli namanye amakhansela akulo masipala, abahloli abaqhamuka emnyangweni wezeMfundo nabasebenzi bomnyango wokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi.Phakathi kwezikole abazivakashele kubalwa, iGeorgenau Combined eku-ward 2 , iCool Air Combined eku-ward 7, ezithole imiphumela engemihle kule ndawo, neMphelandaba High eku-ward 3 ehlabane ngo-100%.Inhlosongqangi yokuhambela izikole bekuwukuncoma, nokuhlonza izingqinamba eziphazamisa ukuphasa kwabantwana.UNkk Chikunga uvumbulule ukuthi eGeorgenau Combined ebhacazile, kunocwasana ngokwebala phakathi kwabamnyama nabomdabu waseNdiya. Wathi lokhu kwenza kungabikhona ukubambisana kwamalungu esigungu esilawula isikole. Uthe isikole sinayo yonke ingqalasizinda ebingenza abafundi baphumelele ngamalengiso. Ezinye izinkinga azihlonze ezikoleni ukungabikhona kwamagumbi okufunda anele, imitaphoyolwazi, amakilasi okufunda ngesayensi nezobuchwepheshe, wathi uzobikela umnyango wezokuXhumana kuleli ukuba uyisukumele.UNkk Mbatha-Ntuli ubonge ungqongqoshe ngokuthi abeke eqhulwini izikole zaseMshwathi, ngenxa yentshisekelo nothando lokuthuthukisa abantu abasha abawukukhanya nekusasa leNingizimu Afrika.
ISIPHENDUKE insumansumane eyokuhoxiswa komgcagco weSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini njengoba iMbube noNdlunkulu uNomzamo Myeni bethi luzokhuphuka udwendwe ngeSonto.IMbube noNdlunkulu uMaMyeni bathe bazihlalele esigodlweni eMashobeni, bathi umgcagco uzoqhubeka njengoba kuhleliwe.UNdlunkulu uMaMyeni uphinde waveza nokuthi akazi lutho ngokuhoxiswa kwabaqaphi bakhe nemihlomulo ayithola kuhulumeni.Thola Isolezwe ngoMsombuluko ufunde kabanzi ngalolu daba
OWESILISA waseShowe, usola uMasipala waseNkandla, ngokuba yimbangela yokushona komkakhe, athi ushone elwa eyencwadi ekokoteliwe yokwesula emsebenzini.Umufi uNkk Zandile Madlala, kuthiwa ushone ngoJuni 2023, ngemva kokuphuma engena ezibhedlela isikhathi eside.Ngokusho komyeni wakhe uMnuz Dumisani Madlala, konke kuqale ngo-2021, umufi engenwa ukugula."Uhlale ekhaya engayi emsebenzini kusuka ngo-Okthoba 2021 kwaze kwaba uJuni 2022, elandela umyalelo kadokotela. Lesi sikhathi udokotela ubuye wengenza ngezinsuku, kubonakala ukuthi akakalulami,” kuchaza uMadlala.Uqhube wathi bekunguJulayi 2022, bethola ukuthi kunesikhangiso sesikhundla sakhe kwelinye lamaphephandaba."Lokhu kwasithusa ngoba akukho umqashi ayemtshele khona,” kusho uMadlala.Uthe baqale ukusukuma ngo-Agasti 2022, ngesikhathi ungasangeni umholo womkakhe. Uthi bathi uma beya kumasipala, umphathi wakwandaba zabantu wabatshela ukuthi umufi ufake incwadi yokwesula."Wehluleka ukusikhombisa leyo ncwadi yokwesula ngaso leso sikhathi. Sathi uma sesiyithola ngokuqhubeka kwesikhathi, sathola ukuthi ine-signature ekokotelwe futhi ngosuku okuvela ukuthi yahanjiswa ngalo, umkami wayesesibhedlela,” kulandisa uMadlala.Uthe ngemva kokwenziwa kophenyo abakwa-bargaining council, banquma ukuthi abuyiselwe umkakhe emsebenzini, aphinde akhokhelwe yonke imali yezinyanga lapho umqashi ayesemthatha khona njengomuntu osesulile emsebenzini.Uthe umsipala wakhokha ingxenye yemali, enye yagcina ingakhokhwanga."Ngokungambuyiseli kwabo emsebenzini, sagcina singabi nawo amandla okukhokhela zindleko zesibhedlela esizimele. Wagcina elala kwesikahulumeni, esasikhala ngokungabi nayo eminye imishini yokubhekana nesimo sakhe,” kuqhuba uMadlala.Uthe waphetha ngokushona umkakhe. Uthe ngisho eseshonile kunezimali zemishwalensi ezagcina zinqwamba ngenxa yenkinga."Ngisola umasipala ngokufa kwakhe. Ukube abenzanga incwadi ekokoteliwe yokumesulisa emsebenzini engazi ngabe usaphila. Yamhlukumeza le nto emoyeni, nokunqwamba kwe-medical aid eyayisiza ngokukhokhela isibhedlela nakho kwamlimaza,” kusho uMadlala.Uthe ufuna bathathelwe izinyathelo abathintekayo, kukhokhwe zonke izimali zemishwalensi yomkakhe.Uthe phakathi kwabantu abebazi ngalolu daba kubalwa umphathi omkhulu kwandaba zabantu kamasipala, umphathi wakhe emaphoyiseni kamasipala, imeya esanda kushona nabanye.Lolu daba lufakwe eNkantolo eNkulu yaseMgungundlovu.UMasipala waseNkandla uthintiwe kodwa kwaze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela ungaphumelelanga ukuphawula.
KUXWAYISWE abafundi abafuna izikhala emakolishi azimele ukuthi baqaphele lawo angombombayi azobaqola imali ebafundisa iziqu ezingabhalisiwe.Lesi sexwayiso sikhishwe yiPhini likaNgqongqoshe eMnyangweni weMfundo ePhakeme uDkt Mimmy Gondwe.UDkt Gondwe uthe ngalesi sikhathi la makolishi amatasa azama ukuqola abafundi nabazali abangazi lutho ngezikhungo ezingabhalisiwe.Uthe ngaphambi kokuba abafundi babhalise ekolishi elizimele, kumele babhekisise izinto eziningi."Ezinye zazo ukubheka ingqalasizinda yalelo kolishi ukuthi akhona yini amakilasi okufundela, umtapo wolwazi kanjalo nezinye izinto ezizoveza ukuthi yindawo yokufundela. Kumele babheke nesitifiketi esiphanyekwa ezindongeni uma ungena emahhovisi, uma zingekho lezi zitifiketi bazibuze ukuze babone ukuthi ngempela leso sikhungo sibhalisiwe,” kusho uDkt Gondwe, ekhuluma nesiteshi sethelevishini i-eNCA izolo.Uthe uma kukhona okusolisayo ngesikhungo, abafundi bangafonela inombolo yomnyango, ukuze bathole ngaleso sikhungo ukuthi sibhalisiwe yini nomnyango."Sinalo uhlu lwezikhungo ezibhalisiwe kanjalo nalezo ezingabhalisiwe. Sizokwazi ukukutshela ukuthi sibhalisiwe noma baleka kakhulu, asibhalisiwe ungaze uqoleke.” Uthe zibalelwa ku-100 izikhungo ezingabhalisiwe kuleli."Siyalwa nale nkinga yokungabhaliswa kwezikhungo. Siyazibika kwabezomthetho ukuze zivalwe. Uma usibikela ngesikhungo esingabhalisiwe, siqale siphenye bese sibhalela leso sikhungo incwadi sisazisa ukuthi kumele sibhaliswe. Uma siqhubeka nokusebenza ngenkani, sibe sesivula icala, kuqale izinhlelo zokusivala,” kusho uDkt Gondwe.Uthe abazali balahlekelwa yimali abayikhokha ezikhungweni ezingabhalisiwe."Abafundi balahlekelwa yisikhathi sabo befunda into engeke ibayise ndawo ngoba ngeke bathole ngisho nomsebenzi ngeziqu abebezenza ezikhungweni ezingabhalisiwe. Abantu bakithi asifuni balahlekelwe yimali abayisebenze kanzima bekhokhela into engeke ibayise ndawo ngomuso.”Ihlale iyinkinga eyezikhungo ezingabhalisiwe nomnyango kanjalo nezinye othola ukuthi nakuba zibhalisiwe, kodwa eminye imikhakha eyenziwa kuzona ayibhalisiwe nomnyango.UDkt Gondwe uthe abafuna ulwazi ngezikhungo ezingabhalisiwe bagashayela inombolo yomnyango ethi: 0800872222.Bangangena nakwi-website yomnyango ethi: www.dhet.gov.za ukuze bathole ngezikhungo ezibhalisiwe kuleli.Ubalule nokuthi bangathumela ne-email eza ngqo kuyena ngezikhalo zabo ethi: [email protected].
SEKUBUNJWE uhlaka lwamadoda aseNkandla, azohamba phambili uma kunabesilisa abafisa ukuganwa kodwa bengenawo amandla okukhokha imali eyanele ekhweni.Kuthiwa umsebenzi wohlaka kuzoba ukuhambela imindeni ohlangothini lwabesifazane, kunxenxwe ukuba ingabi nkulu imali yelobolo.Lokhu kubhungwe kabanzi emhlanganweni omkhulu obusehholo lomphakathi obuseMcakweni, eNkandla.Umsunguli nohamba phambili kulolu hlelo nguMnuz Gregory Biyela, ophinde abe nguthisha.Uthe okudale ukuthi afinyelele kulo mcabango ukuthi baningi abesilisa abafisa ukuganwa kodwa abazithola bebhekene nengwadla yokungabi nayo imali eyenele yokulobola.Uthe akumele bavinjwe ababili abasuke bethandana kodwa bagcine sebekipita ngenxa yokuthi owesilisa akanayo imali eyanele yokukhokha amalobolo.Wathi ukholwa ukuthi ukubunjwa kohlaka kuzodala ukuthi zenziwe zibe emthethweni izinto kunokuthi kukipitwe."Lena yindlela esizama ngayo ukuthi kube khona esikwenzayo ngenhloso yokuthi sinciphe isibalo sabantu abakipitayo eNkandla. Lokhu sicabanga ukuthi kuzohamba ibanga elide kakhulu ekuletheni ukukhanya kule ndawo,'' usho kanjena uBiyela.Amadoda amaningi azwakalise imibono yawo ehlukene ngalolu daba. Iningi lawo lithe kunokuthi kukipitwe kungcono ukuthi kujutshwe uhlaka lungenelele bese kubhungwa ngokuthi loyo wesilisa angakwazi ukuthi akhiphe imali engakanani.Induna yakule ndawo, uMnuz Mahaye ithe kumqoka kakhulu ukuthi kubhungwe kabanzi ngezinto zalolu hlobo.Uthe bekumqoka nokuthi bahlanganiswe abesilisa namadoda emizi aseNkandla, yikhona ezokwazi ukuzwakalisa imizwa yayo ehlukene mayelana nokubunjwa kwohlaka.Kubhungwa ngalokhu nje, ohlelweni lweMoja Love kukhona abesilisa abathi bafisa ukulanda amalobo abo kwabesifazane okusuke kungahambanga kahle othandweni nabo.
SESISEZANDLENI ezintsha isikole ebesiphethwe yisilomo somsakazi woKhozi FM ongasekho emhlabeni, uBheka 'BK’ Mchunu, iKZN Matric School Excellence.Isikole esasungulwa ngumsakazi ngo-2007, saziwa ngokulekelela abafundi abasuke bengaphumelelanga umatric nalabo abasuke behlose ukulungisa kabusha izifundo zabo.UNksz Buhlebemvelo Langa, ongunina wengane ka-BK uthe isikole esise-ML Sultan, eThekwini, siyaqhubeka yize engasekho emhlabeni uBheka.Uveze ukuthi bafisa ukuhlonipha umsakazi ngokuthi baqinisekise ukuthi lokhu akushiya akufadabali kodwa kunalokho kudlondlobale.Uqhube wathi ungomunye walabo abasebuholini obusha besikole. "Sizimisele ngokuthi senze konke okusemandleni ngenhloso yokuqinisekisa ukuthi awufadabali umsebenzi kaBK,'' usho kanje uNksz Langa.Wathi inhloso kaBK ngesikole kwakuwukuthi aklame indima yokuqinisekisa ukuthi bayasizakala abafundi baKwaZulu Natal, abasuke beqhuzukile ku-matric."Okwethu manje ukuthi siqinisekise ukuthi awufi umbono kaBK ngokuhamba kwakhe emhlabeni. Thina esisele kumele senze konke okusemandleni ukuqinisekisa ukuthi konke kuhamba ngendlela,'' usho kanjena.Unxenxe bonke abafundi abavela ezingxenyeni ezahlukene zaKwaZulu Natal, ukuba basondele bazobhalisela ukwenza kabusha umatric wabo.Uthe esikoleni benza zonke izifundo ezikhona kumatric futhi bahlome ngothisha beqophelo eliphezulu.Udalule ukuthi bathathe isinqumo sokuthi balivale igatsha lesikole ebeliseMfolozi TVET College, eSikhaleni ngenxa yezizathu ezithile."Sifuna ukugxila kakhulu lapha eThekwini,'' egcizelela uNksz Langa.
