LISENGCUPHENI ikusasa likaNdlunkulu uNomzamo Myeni njengoba sekuvele incwadi ehoxisa umgcagco kanye nabaqaphi bakhe.UNdlunkulu bekufanele agcagcele iSilo ngeSonto, kodwa kuvele ukuthi udwendwe seluhoxisiwe.Lokhu kuvele encwadi lapho khona iSilo sihoxisa onogada bakaNdlunkulu kanye nemihlomulo ayitholayo.Le ncwadi ehoxisa onogada bakaNdlunkulu ibhekiswe kuMqondisi Jikelele eHhovisi likaNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uDkt Nonhlanhla Mkhize.Incwadi iyalela ukuba abaqaphi kanye nemihlomulo kaNdlunkulu ihoxiswe lingakashoni elangoMsombuluko.Umgcagco uhoxiswa nje bekuvele kunesicelo esifakwe uNdlunkulu uNtokozo Mayisela Zulu sokuka umiswe.Khonamanjalo, iMbube iphinde yaxosha loyo obeyikhulumela, uMntwana uSimphiwe Zulu. Incwadi ebonwe yiSolezwe iphinde uMntwana uSimphiwe nasekumeleni iSilo endlini yobuholi bomdabu.Kule ncwadi iMbube ikhala ngokuthi uMntwana uSimphiwe akatholakali kwabezindaba uma befuna aphawule ngezithinta indlunkulu.
IBANDLA lamaLuthela i-Evangelical Lutheran Church, elizinze eThekwini, kulindeleke ukuthi ligcobe ngokuphelele uDean Elect, uMengameli uNjabulo Sithole, enkonzweni ezobe ikusasa ebandleni lase-African Congregational Church of South Afrika, eCliffdale.UMENGAMELI uNjabulo Sithole ozogcotshwa ihlandla lesibili ebandleni lamaLuthela UMengameli uSithole uzogcotshwa nguMbhishobhi uNkosinathi Myaka, enkonzweni ezoqala ngo-8:30 ekuseni.Omele abefundisi bamaLuthela esiFundeni saseThekwini, uMfundisi Sabelo Mkhathini, ekhuluma nephephandaba ecacisa ngenkonzo uthe isikhundla siyavotelwa."UMfundisi Sithole usebuya ihlandla lesibili kulesi sikhundla. Le nkonzo yenziwa kanye emva kweminyaka eyisithupha. Inesasa elikhulu ngoba osuke ekhethiwe esikhundleni abazalwane basuke betshengise uthando abanalo ngaye kanye nokumethemba,” kuchaza uMfundisi uMkhathini.Uthe njengoba uDean Elect uMfundisi Sithole ezothatha izintambo, uzokwengamela ingxenye ethize yebandla ngaphansi koMbhishobhi."Wengamele ingxenye yeSouth Eastern Diosis, ekhava iKwaZulu-Natal, ingxenye ethize yase-Eastern Cape ukuya eMthatha, naseFreeState, kuze kuyofika Harrismith,” usho kanje.UDean Elect uMengameli Sithole, uthe ukuqokwa futhi kuyena kuyithuba eliyingqayizivele."Umuntu uyaye angazi ukuthi uzoqale athini. Ngiyazibuza ukuthi yini abantu abayibonile kimi ukuze bangikhethe futhi ngoba lokhu akuyona into eyandele bani,” kusho uMengameli.Uthe unezifiso eziningi ngebandla futhi uzoqinisekisa ukuthi njengoba engumongameli uzofeza okuningi."Lapha esifundeni saseThekwini, asikakabi nayo indawo yethu lapho esingakwazi ukuthi sibabembele izinkonzo zethu ezinkulu. Siyayidinga kakhulu ukuze sikwazi ukubambela kuyo izinkomfa,” usho kanje.Uthe akusikhona kuphela ukuthi kwakhiwe isikhungo sesifunda kodwa ibandla lidinga ubuholi obuqotho, obuzophatha ibandla ngokweqiniso
ISABALELE ezinkundleni zokuxhumana i-vidiyo yomhlengikazi osolwa ngokunqaba ukusiza isiguli esidabuka eZimbabwe, esikhungweni sezokwelapha eMidrand, eGauteng.Kulesi siqeshana, kuzwakala owesifazane oqophayo enxusa umhlengikazi ukuthi ahlole izinga lomfutho wegazi wakhe. Uzwakala ethi ufike esibhedlela emuva kwamahora ambalwa engasizwanga."Kuthiwa kufanele ungibhalele incwadi engidlulisela phambili kodwa uyenqaba ... angisakwazi ukulinda. Ngicela ukuya kudokotela," kusho owesifazane.Nokho, umhlengikazi uthi owesifazane wenqabile ukusizwa. Isimo sashuba ngokushesha lapho umhlengikazi ephendula ngokucasuka. "Memeza ugcine lapho othanda khona, ngeke ngikubhalele incwadi. Ngisho ungathatha isithombe, ungibophe wenze okuthandayo, ngizokumangalela," kusho umhlengikazi ebonisa ukudinwa. Lesi siguli siqhubekele kwabanye abantu sibika usizi lwaso sabuyela kuye umhlengikazi sithi kuthiwe akasithathe iBP kodwa umhlengikazi wathi akakwenzi lokho umsebenzi wakhe wukudla, sathi isiguli yingakho ukhuluphele udla njalo.
UTHELE izithelo umkhankaso wamaphoyisa wokulwisana nokukhiqizwa, nokusatshalaliswa kwezithombe zezingane ziya ocansini. Lokhu kwenzeke ngoLwesihlanu, esikhathi kuboshwa owesilisa oneminyaka engu(35) eRosa Royal Estate, eMidrand.Umlisa utholakale namakhophi angu-10 million ezithombe nama-vidiyo ocansi lwezingane emishinini ehlukene endlini yakhe okukholakala ukuthi uyisebenzisela ukuzisabalalisa.Ukuboshwa komlisa kulandela okwangoDisemba, lapho kwaboshwa owesilisa oneminyaka engu-(41) onguthishanhloko ePitoli, nomunye oneminyaka engu-(49) eVanderbijlpark.Okhulumela amaphoyisa, uLieutenant Colonel Amanda van Wyk, ukuqinisekisile ukuboshwa komlisa."Silunywe indlebe ozakwethu bakwamanye amazwe bethola ukuthi ulapha eNingizimu Afrika, umuntu osabalalisa izithombe zocansi ezinkundleni ezahlukene,” kusho yena.Uqhubeke wathi kungenzeka kuboshwe abanye abantu ngoba uphenyo lusaqhubeka futhi kusaseshwa nakwezinye izindawo.
BEKUTHI uma ecela uyise ukuthi amthengele okuthile njengendodakazi yakhe, amphendule ngokumbuza ukuthi yena yini azomnika yona ekugcineni, umgilwa okuvela ukuthi uyise umdlwengule waze wamkhulelisa ngasekupheleni konyaka odlule.Isolezwe lizwe lokhu ngesihlobo sikamgilwa (19) waKwaMakhutha, eThekwini, izolo ecaleni ebeliseNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMbumbulu, lapho bekuvela khona (ummangalelwa) ezocela ibheyili.Kuhlaluke ukuthi umlisa uyisishoshovu esivutha ekhaleni kwi-MK Party endaweni futhi oyilungu le-Community Policing Forum (CPF) elingabubheki ukubugebengu endaweni.Ngesikhathi evela ngaphakathi enkantolo, kuvele ukuthi kusasilele ukuqinisekiswa kwekheli alilethile, athe angayohlala kulo uma kwenzeka ededelwa ngebheyili.Ngaleso sizathu inkantolo ibe isikuhlehlisela ukuthi kulalelwe ngoLwesithathu oluzayo ukucela kwakhe ibheyili.Silandisa ngesehlakalo isihlobo sithe, isehlo lapho umsolwa akhulelisa khona umgilwa senzeka phakathi kuka-Agasti,noSepthemba ngonyaka odlule, kodwa wangabika ngaso ngaleso sikhathi."Ingane wayeyisabise ngokuthi uma ike yasho uzoyibulala,” kuchaza isihlobo.Sithe baze basola ukuthi kukhona okwenzekile ngoDisemba, ngesikhathi umndeni ubamba izinkulumo zikamgilwa nomsolwa kwiselula.Sithe kwabanjwa umyalezo umgilwa ayewuthumela uyise ethi: "Inkinga wena baba uma ngikuvakashela uvele ufune ukulala nami."Sithe kuyo le ngxoxo bathola ukuthi umgilwa wayecela isikibha sesikole umsolwa wambuza ukuthi uma emthengela sona yena uzomnikani.Sithe ngaleso sikhathi umgilwa akavezanga ukuthi uyise umdlwengulile, kanti uyise kwathi uma ebuzwa, waphika walala ngomhlane.Uthe bagcine bethola kule nyanga ukuthi umsolwa wamdlwengula umgilwa ngesikhathi bebamba ukuthi ukhulelwe, wase egonyuluka ngokuthi ukhuleliswe nguyise. Isolezwe lithole ukuthi ngosuku okuthiwa kwenzeka ngalo isehlo, umsolwa waqamba amanga wathi ucela umgilwa ake avakashe ngoba kukhona abanye abazala bakhe abakhona ekhaya."Yaya ingane, yafica ehleli yedwa, wayidlwengula lapho," kusho isihlobo.Siveze ukuthi ngesonto eledlule umgilwa ugcine elekelelwa ngabezempilo ukuthi asikhiphe isisu njengoba esabise ngokuthi uzozibulala uma esigcina ngenkani aze azale ingane yokudlwengulwa. "Usibulale siphila, ingane ibizigqaja ngobutshitshi bayo, ize isho ukuthi ifuna ukuzigcina ize ibe neminyaka engu-21,” kusho isihlobo.Isihlobo siveze ukuthi isehlakalo simthikameze ngisho nasesikoleni umgilwa njengoba kufanele engabe useqalile ukufunda u-Grade 12.Enkantolo bekugcwele amalungu e-MK. Kuwona bekukhona abezokweseka umgilwa, amanye ezokweseka umsolwa.UMnuz Mandla Chiliza, onguSihlalo wenhlangano edlelana ne-MK, i-Progressive Civics Congress (PCC) uthe bazwelana nomgilwa."Asihambisani nezimo ezinjena. Asisho ukuthi kukhona isinqumo esesifike kusona esithi kufanele noma akufanele. Sizokweseka umgilwa ngoba kulichilo okwenzekile kodwa sizoyeka ingalo yomthetho isebenze,” kusho uChiliza.Uthe ziyabakhathaza izigemegeme ezifuze lezi. Uqhube wathi balinde amaphoyisa ukuthi enze umsebenzi wawo, angayinikwa ibheyili umsolwa uma kutholakala ukuthi uyingozi."Uma uyilungu lenhlangano akusho ukuthi unelungelo lokuhlukumeza. Njengobuholi siyaziqhelisa nezehlakalo ezinje. Noma angaba yilungu lomphakathi noma leqembu, umthetho kufanele usebenze,” kusho uChiliza.
ISIPHENDUKE indaba egudwini oFafa, eXobho, eyokungahlali endaweni kwenkosi yabo ethi isabela ukuphepha kwayo kwayibangisa ubukhosi.Abantu basoFafa bathe ukungahlali endaweni kweNkosi uVela Dalicebo Ndlovu kujamise imisebenzi eminingi yesizwe.Abantu basendaweni abakhulume neSolezwe, bathe sebefunga yena uNdlovu njengoba behlawumbekisela ukuthi wagcina ukuhlala endaweni ngo-2018.Abasebukhosini bathe nabo uNdlovu usebehlule, kanti yena uNdlovu ukhala ngokuthi uyanyundelwa yilabo abambangisa isihlalo sobukhosi.Isakhamuzi esicele ukuba igama laso lingadalulwa, sithe sekunesikhathi eside uNdlovu engabonakali esizweni."Sinenkinga lapha yokuthi sekuneminyaka inkosi singayazi. Inkosi ihambe ihlala, ihlala noma ikuphi. Sike sizwe ikhonjwa koKokstad, ibuye ikhonjwe ngapha koMandeni. Uma kwenzekile yaqhamuka lapha, isuke nje idlula."Njengoba ingekho nje, kunezinto eziningi ezimile. Sizibona sisele dengwane njengesizwe. Inkosi ayisazibizi izimbizo, ayiwahambeli amacala. Kuningi nje engasakwenzi.”Esinye isakhamuzi sithe inkosi ayisabonakali ngisho emcimbini waminyaka yonke owenziwa ngoDisemba, obizwa ngegusha."Ngonyaka owedlule sasikhona isihlalo sayo inkosi kodwa yangafika. Undlunkulu (umama omdala wenkosi) waze washo ukuthi nabo sebehlulekile, wathi asizibonele ukuthi senza njani.”Lesi sakhamuzi sithe sebezamile ukulubika udaba ebuholini bomdabu KwaZulu-Natal kanye naseMnyangweni wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu, kodwa abalutholi usizo.UNdlovu wangena esihlalweni ngo-2016, ethatha kuNdlunkulu uThokozile Nene Ndlovu, owabamba ubukhosi balesi sizwe iminyaka engu-25.Undlunkulu uvumile ukuthi kunezikhalazo ngenkosi, wathi nabo njengomndeni sebechithe amanzi."Siyazama nathi singamalungu omndeni kodwa uyasehlula. Inkosi ayizi kwakhona enkantolo futhi ayibakhathalele abantu. Ngingasho nje ukuthi akayinikwanga noma akayiphiwanga le nto yokusiza abantu ngoba uyazihlalela nje ekubeni abantu besenkingeni.”Undlunkulu uthe uNdlovu kuyenzeka nje afike ekhaya, alale usuku olulodwa bese eyadlula. Uthe uNdlovu uvele avike ngokuthi ubangiswa ubukhosi uma bethi bazama ukumbonisa.Ethintwa yiSolezwe, uNdlovu uthe akusilona iqiniso ukuthi akawenzi umsebenzi wakhe.Uvumile ukuthi sekunesikhathi eside engahlali endaweni ngenxa yokuthi usabela ukuphepha kwakhe, kodwa wathi lokhu akumphazamisi ekutheni enze umsebenzi wakhe."Ngiyaqhubeka nokuhambela imihlangano yanyanga zonke, ngiyaya emacaleni. Ngeke ngiye emacaleni uma engekho. Ngiyaqhubeka nokuhambela imihlangano yamakhosi.”UNdlovu usole undlunkulu namanye amalungu omndeni ngokukhuluma kabi igama lakhe.Uthe vele yena wakhula ecashisiwe, ehlala komalume eMandeni, emva kokubulawa kwenkosi emzalayo."Namanje angizizwa ngiphephile ekhaya. Le nto ngayichaza.”Okhulumela uMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Senzelwe Mzila, uthe basazophenya ngalolu daba.Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kukaSihlalo weNdlu yobuHoli boMdabu KwaZulu-Natal, iNkosi Sifiso Shinga, ayizange iphumelele njengoba ucingo lwakhe belungangeni.
UMPHAKATHI waseGamalake ku-ward 5 ePort Shepstone uthi uphila esimweni esibeka impilo yabantu engozini ngenxa yokuthi sekuphele izinyanga udoti ungaqoqwa kule ndawo.Ukungaqoqwa kukadoti kulandela ukuthi abasebenzi bakaMasipala iRay Nkonyeni bedube ukusebenza ngenxa yemali abathi bayikweletwa yilo mkhandlu ongaphansi kwesifunda uGu.Amalungu omphakathi, angathandanga ukudalulwa amagama awo, atshele iphephandaba ukuthi amalungelo abo awanakiwe."Akusiyo into okufanele engabe iyenzeka lapho kuhlala khona abantu ngoba izodala izifo ngenxa yokungcola okuxakile. Ukunganakwa kwamalungelo ethu njengomphakathi kuyadumaza kakhulu," kusho isakhamuzi.IMFUCUZA esaphazeke emgwaqeni ePort Sheptone Isithombe: SITHUNYELWEBathe kukhona ababekade bezama ukuziqoqela udoti kodwa bahlangana nezimbila zithutha."Into embi nje eyehlele elinye ilungu lomphakathi ngesikhathi bezama ukuziqoqela udoti, lihlaseliwe, kwashiswa umuzi walo, lihlaselwa abasebenzi abatelekile. Uthe babukelwa phansi kodwa bebe bevota kanti okubi wukuthi nezikole zivuliwe njengoba kuqhubeka isimo futhi sizogcina sixosha osomabhizinisi endaweni.Ikhansela lendawo, uMnuz Rodney Gumbi, lithe ngeke liwasole amalungu omphakathi ngokunengeka ngalesi simo esiyinkinga."Abantu uma bephatheke kabi ngeke ngibasole. Sinethemba lokuthi kuleli sonto sizophuma nesivumelwano nenyunyana yabasebenzi. Ngiyaxolisa, isimo besingaphezu kwamandla ami, ngiyazithoba kakhulu emphakathini futhi ngiyaxolisa kakhulu. Umasipala uke waqasha imoto kodwa amalungu omphakathi ayishisa," kusho uGumbi.Uthe kulezi zinsuku ezedlule ubehamba namavolontiya beshisa wona udoti futhi bayafaka okwenzekayo nasezinkundleni zokuxhumana eziningi ukubeka abantu esithombeni ngokuqhubekayo.
"UBENGAZE amqobe pho?”Lona umbuzo ophume emlonyeni kanina wowesifazane waseMangamazini Reserve, eFolweni, uNkk Thembisile Mkhize, zehla mi izinyembezi ngaphandle kweNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMbumbulu.Bekuvela uMnuz Mduduzi Masuku (32) obeyisoka likaNksz Bongekile Mkhize (32) ngecala lokugenca ambulale emzini wakhe (umufi) eMangamazini ngoJanuwari 5.Bekulindeleke ukuthi uMasuku aqale ukucela ibheyili nokugcine kungasenzeki.UMbuso uveze ukuthi amaphoyisa asadinga ukunikwa isikhathi esithe xaxa, ukuze aqinisekise ikheli umsolwa athe angaphuma ayohlala kulo uma kwenzeka ededelwa ngebheyili.UMUFI uNksz Bongekile Mkhize UMbuso uphinde waveza nokuthi uma esecela ibheyili, uzokuphikisa lokho.Ngaphakathi enkantolo bekukhona umndeni kaNksz Mkhize, obuzozibonela umsolwa emva kokubulala ngesihluku ilungu lawo.Izinyembezi kunina kaNksz Mkhize, zehle engaphakathi enkantolo ngesikhathi ebona umsolwa ebhokisini labamangalelwa.Isikhafu esimnyama abesembethe, siphenduke iduku lokusula izinyembezi ngenxa yobuhlungu abebuzwa ebona owesilisa osolwa ngokubaphuca othandiweyo wabo ngesihluku.Amehlo abebomvu nakwamanye amalungu omndeni, kubonakala ukuthi nakuba eziqinisa kodwa izinyembezi zigcwele amehlo. Abanye babo, kube ukuphuma nje ngaphandle kwenkantolo, basikhihla isililo.Umfowabo kamufi omncane, uMnuz Siyabonga Mkhize, ekhuluma neSolezwe ngaphandle kwenkantolo uthe okubazwisa ubuhlungu kakhulu indlela ambulale ngayo."Waqhubeka wamgenca ngisho eseshonile,” kusho uMkhize.Uqhube wathi okunye okubazwisa ubuhlungu ukuthi umsolwa wayengenza okungcono kunokuthi ambulale, ngisho noma ngabe babebhekene nanoma iyiphi inkinga. "Uyasazi, uyabazi nabazali bethu. Wayengezi ngani kithina azobika ukuthi banenkinga noMabongi kunokuthi akhethe ukumbulala?” kubuza uMkhize.Ngokuthola kweSolezwe ngesikhathi kusanda kwenzeka isigameko, umsolwa wayekade efuna ukukhuluma okuthile nomufi ngenkani ngezikhathi zasemini ngosuku lwesigameko.Kwavela ukuthi umufi wamtshela ukuthi unendlela, abakhulume kahle uma ebuya.Kuthiwa ngezikhathi zasemini wamthumela umyalezo omsabisa ngokumbulala, angawunakanga, ezitshela ukuthi uyadlala.Isolezwe lathola ukuthi wabe esemcuthela kwakhe (umufi), kwathi uma ehla emotweni ayehamba ngayo ebuya endaweni yobumnandi, wamgenca.Kwavela ukuthi wadinwa ukuthi wabuya kuleyo ndawo ehamba nesoka lesibili, kodwa umndeni wakuchitha lokhu uthi empeleni wayehamba nabangani.Kwavela nezinsolo zokuthi umsolwa wathukwa isoka likamufi lesibili, ngokuthi unomphambili omncane, nokho umndeni wathi nalokhu awunalwazi lwakho.Imantshi ilihlehlisele uJanuwari 22 icala, lapho umsolwa ezoqala khona ukucela ibheyili, emva kokuthi amaphoyisa esenikwe ithuba lokuyoqinisekisa ikheli lakhe.
BAKHALA bayazithulisa abazali abaqolwe inqwaba yemali ngowesilisa ongaziwa, obezenza uthishanhloko wesikole saseNkandla, iBizimali High. Kuthiwa umlisa ubamukela ngokungemthetho imali yezingane ebezifuna ukuyofunda okokuqala kulesi sikole.Isolezwe lithole ngoNksz Nkeletseng Tshehlo waseMorningside, eThekwini, ongomunye wabazali abaqoliwe ukuthi konke lokhu, umsolwa ubekwenza esebenzisa inombolo yeselula ayifake online, eshaya sengathi eyesikole.Isolezwe liphinde lathola ukuthi balinganiselwa ku-105 abazali abashawe ngemfe iphindiwe, kukhona nabasuka eGauteng. Isiyonke imali okusolwa ukuthi umlisa uyiqole abazali ilinganiselwa ku-R315 000.Elandisa ngesehlakalo esibashiye bebambe ongezansi, uNksz Tshehlo uthe iningi labo lithole ukuthi belibanjiswe udonga ngoMsombuluko ngesikhathi litheleka emasangweni esikole nezingane, nemithwalo, ngethemba lokuthi sezizoqala ukufunda.Uthe kuduma ikhanda ngoba uqolwe u-R3 500, uthi umlisa wamyalela ukuthi akawufake kwi-akhawunti yaseTyme Bank ngoSepthemba nyakenye, eqeda kuthola inombolo yakhe online."Ngishaye imoto ngibheke eNkandla ngethemba lokuthi uzofike angene ngaphakathi uTumelo (Tshehlo), alindele ukuvulwa kwezikole namuhla (esho izolo). Kuse ngokunye esikoleni sebengitshela ukuthi uTumelo akekho emabhukwini esikole,” kuchaza uNksz Tshehlo."Ngesikhathi sixoxa naye lo muntu, wazibiza ngothishonhloko, wathi akufakwe imali kwi-akhawunti yesikole. Sakwenza lokho, sazitshela ukuthi konke sekumi ngomumo ngoba ingane isisitholile isikhala,” kuchaza uNksz Tshehlo.Uthe ube eseqhubeka nezinye izinhlelo ezinjengokuthenga umfaniswano wesikole, ukudla nokunye obekuzodingwa yingane uma isihlala ngaphakathi eBizimali.Uveze ukuthi ngesikhathi sebefikile esikoleni, othisha babatshele ukuthi akuqali ukuthi kuqolwe abazali ngale ndlela.Uthe uphithene ikhanda ngenxa yesimo angazi ukuthi uzosilungisa kanjani."Ngilahlekelwe imali yokugcina ngikhokhela uthishanhloko-mbumbulu, ngithenga nomfaniswano nokunye. Ngiphethwe nayikhanda ngoba ngihleli nengane engenasikole. Ngithatha ngiyabeka ukuthi ngizoyithini indaba yayo ngoba kulesi (isikole) ebifunda kuso, yanikwa incwadi eyigunyaza ukuthi iyofunda kwesinye isikole,” usho kanje.Uveze ukuthi ibifunda u-Grade 9, iphasele uGrade 10.Uthishanhloko wesikole iBizimali, uNkk Ntuli, uthe inkinga yokuqolwa kwabazali iqale nyakenye ngoJuni."Isinesikhashana iqalile. Saze senza nencwadi efungelwe emaphoyiseni, safaka nezaziso ezinkundleni zokuxhumana zesikole ngenhloso yokuqwashisa abazali,” kusho uNkk Ntuli.Uthe izicelo abazamukeli online noma ngeselula."Umthetho wesikole uthi abazali kufanele bazifikele mathupha nezingane esikoleni. Kumele baphathe amaphepha abo, awabantwana, bese siwabukisisa ngaphambi kokuthi sithathe umfundi,” kuchaza uNkk Ntuli.Uthe lokhu bakwenzela nokuthi bambone ngamehlo umfundi osuke efunelwa isikhala, babhekisise ukuthi ngeke yini abe wuhlupho."Sitholile ukuthi kukhona umuntu oqola abazali esebenzisa igama lesikole, ethembisa ukuthatha izingane. Siyabanxusa abazali ukuthi baqaphele imiyalezo esiyifaka ezinkundleni zokuxhumana zesikole, lapho siqhwashisa khona ngalo mkhuba,” usho kanje.Uqhube wathi bayibikile inkinga eMnyangweni wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal.Isolezwe lizamile ukuyishayela inombolo yomlisa oyiqola izikhawu kodwa yangena ku-voicemail.IBizimali idume ngokwenza ezibukwayo ngemiphumela ka-matric, okudala ukuthi inqwaba yabazali, ilangazelele ukuthi izingane ziyofunda khona.Nyakenye iphinde yagila izimanga njengoba ithole u-93.6%. Kuwona kukhona abaphase ngama-Bachelor abangu-300, kwathi abaphase ngama-Diploma babangu-80 kwathi abaphase ngo-Higher Certificate babangu-32.Kuze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal engatholakali ocingweni.
AZOKANISA izinyangana ezimbalwa ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme amahhovisi angomahamba nendlwana esikhwama esixhasa ngemali yokufunda ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme, i-National Students’ Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS), ukusiza abanezinkinga ngesikhathi sokubhalisa.Akuzoba amahhovisi kuphela azoba sezikhungweni kodwa nezikhulu zoMnyango wezeMfundo ePhakeme zizohambela izikhungo ezehlukene zihlola isimo uma sekubhaliswa.Lokhu kuvezwe nguNgqongqoshe wezeMfundo ePhakeme, uDkt Nobuhle Nkabane, emcimbini wokuhalalisela abafundi baKwaZulu-Natal abenze kahle kwa-matric eThekwini muva nje.UDkt Nkabane udalule ukuthi sebekulungele ukwamukela izitshudeni ezizofunda kulezi zikhungo kulo nyaka.Ukubhalisa ezikhungweni eziningi kuqala ngasekupheleni kwale nyanga. Ukufunda nokufundisa ezikhungweni kuqala ngenyanga ezayo."Njengoba izitshudeni zizoya ezikhungweni zemfundo zizowafica amahhovisi angomahamba nendlwana e-NSFAS. La mahhovisi azozinza kulezi zikhungo asize labo abanezinselelo uma sekubhaliswa. Abasebenzi ababili be-NSFAS abazobe besezikhungweni bazogxila ezintweni ezithinta izindawo zokuhlala.” Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi indaba yokuhlala izitshudeni ike yaba inkinga ezikhungweni ezehlukene. Izitshudeni eziningi bezigcina zixoshwa omastende ngoba zingakhokheliwe futhi zingazitholi izimpendulo ngesikhathi kwi-NSFAS.UDkt Nkabane uthe njengoba ukufaka izicelo zoxhaso kwi-NSFAS kwavalwa ngoDisemba 15 ngonyaka odlule, bathola izicelo ezingu-895 916."Kulezi zicelo sisaxhase abangu-676 317, simatasa nabasele ngoba sisalinde izinto ezithile. Siyibeke eqhulwini eyokuxazulula eyabangakazitholi izimpendulo zoxhaso.” Uveze nokuthi bathole izicelo ezingu-17 246 zalabo abaziwa nge-missing middle, abazali babo abahola kakhulu ngakho abangakwazi ukuthola umfundaze kwi-NSFAS.Uthe laba bazobolekwa imali yokufunda, wathi bahlela ukuthi babe sebebaphendulile ngenyanga ezayo."Siyibeke phambili nendaba yalabo abafake izimangalo ngoba bengaxhaswanga yi-NSFAS. Sihlela ukuphothula indaba yabo ngasekupheleni kukaMashi ngoba asifuni kube khona abazosala.” Izinhlangano zezitshudeni sezikhale kakhulu ngendaba yokuphuza ukuphendula kwe-NSFAS kulabo abasuke befake izimangalo.UDkt Nkabane unxuse abebenza u-matric ukuthi bakhethe imikhakha ezobenza ukuthi bakwazi ukuvula amabhizinisi abo ukuze babe abaqashi."Ngiyanxusa kwabebenza u-matric ukuthi bakhethe imikhakha ehambisana nokudingwa ngumnotho wakuleli. Ngaleyo ndlela sizokwazi ukuvala igebe elikhona, sakhe namathuba omsebenzi. Eminye yale mikhakha ngethinta ukuvula amabhizinisi ukuze ngomuso nikwazi ukuba abaqashi,” kusho uDkt Nkabane.
ISISEZITHEBENI zoMnyango weMfundo eyisiSekelo, eyomkhuba wezikole "wokuvimba” abafundi abangenzi kahle ukuthi badlulele kwa-matric ngoba zifuna ukuthola imiphumela emihle.Lo mkhuba wokuvalela ngaphandle abangenzi kahle wenziwa izikole ukuze bangazidonseli phansi uma sebefeyila bese "bengcolisa” igama elihle lezikole ikakhulu lezo ezihlale zithola o-100% kwa-matric.Umnyango usuwuqaphe ngelokhozi lo mkhuba ngoba usuyazi ukuthi ezinye izikole ziyawenza.Umqondisi jikelele emnyangweni uMnuz Mathanzima Mweli, uthe bawuqaphe ngelokhozi lo mkhuba owenziwa izikole.Uthe lezi zikole zikwenza lokhu ngoba zifuna "ukubukeka kahle” uma sekukhishwa imiphumela ka-matric."Inkinga enkulu esibhekene nayo kwezemfundo, akuyona eyokulaxaza isikole kwabafundi bagcine bengafinyelelanga kwa-matric, kodwa yizinga eliphezulu lokufeyila. Liphezulu futhi izinga labafundi abaphinda ibanga uma kuqhathaniswa namanye amazwe,” kusho uMweli.Uthe liphezulu izinga lokuncintisana ezikoleni njengoba bebaningi abaphasayo.UMweli usho lokhu nje, minyaka yonke kuhlale kukhalwa ngokuthi baba ngaphezu kuka-1.2 million abafundi abaqala uGrade R, kodwa uma sekubhalwa izivivinyo zika-matric basuke sebebalelwa kuhhafu noma ngaphezudlwana.Nyakenye bangaphezu kuka-700 000 abafundi ababhale u-matric.UMweli uthe akusoze kwenzeka ukuthi abafundi abasuke beqale kwa-Grade R, bafinyelele kwa-matric ngonyaka owodwa.Uveze ukuthi ziningi izizathu ezenza lokhu okubalwa abaphinda ikilasi kanjalo nabashiya phansi isikole bengaqedanga.Ubale nalabo abagcina sebeya emakolishi amakhono ama-TVET, beyoqedela khona izifundo zabo."Kunohlelo esinalo lokududula abafundi abasuke bengaphasanga baye kwamanye amabanga kanjalo nakwa-matric. Laba bafundi bagcine sebegila izimanga kwa-matric, abanye baphase ngama-Bachelor bakwazi ukuya emanyuvesi,” kusho uMweli.Uveze ukuthi abanye abafundi bagcina sebebhala u-matric ngasese.Nyakenye bangu-155 948 abebebhalisele ukuthi bazobhala ngasese kodwa kugcine kubhale abangu-106 584 kuphela.UNgqongqoshe walo mnyango, uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, uthe kudingeka kube nohlelo lokukwazi ukuhlonza ukuthi bakuphi abafundi abalaxaze isikole bangaqeda."Ulwazi esinalo alukwazi ukuveza ukuthi ukuphi umfundi ngamunye ongasiqedi isikole. Kudingeka kube nokusebenzisana kweminyango ukuze sazi ukuthi laba bafundi bakuphi,” kusho uNksz Gwarube.
LIDUME ladlula kulabo abebelinde ngabomvu imiphumela yabo ka-matric yango-2024.Abanye bajabulile ngokwenza kahle, abanye bayakhala bafisa engabe benze kahle kanti abanye bakhale ngaphansi.Abangaphumelelanga lisekhona elinye ithuba lokuthi baphinde babhale izivivinyo zokuchibiyela ngoJuni, nonyaka.Abaya ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme, abayoqala uhambo olusha, siyabahalalisela, sithi abazibambe ziqine ngoba ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme lizogaya ngomunye umhlathi njengoba bezobe bengaluswa othisha, kodwa izinto eziningi bazobe bezenzela.Sihalalisela isifundazwe iKwaZulu-Natal ngokwenza kahle emiphumeleni yaleli banga, siphinde silala endaweni yesibili sishaya ezinye izifundazwe.Le miphumela ikhomba khona ukuthi othisha basebenze kanzima, befundisa ngamaholidi nangezimpelasonto ukucija abenza u-matric.Minyaka yonke le miphumela iyanyuka okuyizinkomba zokuthi ukuvuthwa kohlelo lokufunda nokufundisa, yikhona okwenza kube nozinzo kwezemfundo.Uma uhlelo lokufunda sekuneminyaka lukhona, kuba lula ngoba kusuke kwaziwa okulindelekile.Le miphumela yesifundazwe engu-89.5%, iqhamuka nje kunezinselelo ezibhekene nomnyango ezithinta imali.Umnyango uyahluleka ukufaka ngesikhathi imali yezikole, eyaziwa ngama-norms and standards. Uhluleka nokukhokhela ngesikhathi abenza imisebenzi nalo mnyango.Phezu kwalezi zinkinga kodwa ukuzinikela kothisha bafundise noma insimbi ishisa, kwenze lesi sifundazwe saba nemiphumela emihle.Asigcinanga nje ngokukhiqiza imiphumela emihle kodwa kwande nesibalo sabafundi abaphase ngama-Bachelor, okusho ukuthi bazokwazi ukuya emanyuvesi.Lesi sifundazwe sizishaye zonke ngabafundi abaningi abaphase ngamalengiso.Okujabulise kakhulu ngukuthi isifunda uMkhanyakude osemakhaya, yisona esenze kahle sizishaya zonke ezinye ezisemadolobheni. Ngisho kuzwelonke lesi sifunda sihlonishwe ngemiphumela emihle, okusho khona ukuthi noma usemakhaya kodwa ungakwazi ukudlubulundela uphumelele.
KUSE ngokunye ngoLwesine kuboshwa inkabi ethinteka ecaleni lokubulawa kwephoyisa.Lo mlisa oneminyaka engu-36 uvinjezelwe oKlebe eMpolweni, eMgungundlovu.Ukuboshwa komlisa kulandela okwephoyisa laseMzimkhulu, elaboshwa lisemsebenzini ngoNovemba 25, 2024 ngesikhathi kuphenywa icala lokubulawa kwengoduso yalo eyiphoyisa uSergeant Ntombi Mbanjwa (33). Bobabili babesebenza esiteshini samaphoyisa eMzimkhulu.USergeant Ntokozo Mngqithi (34) ubhekene necala lokubulala ingoduso yakhe eyatholakala idindilizile ngemuva kokubulawa ngumsolwa ongaziwa ngo-Ephreli 2024.Kuthiwa ngo-Ephreli 11, umufi wayesendlini yakhe eMzimkhulu, ngesikhathi edutshulwa ngumuntu ongaziwa. Akekho owayekhona ngesikhathi kwenzeka isigameko waze watholwa nguSergeant Mngqithi ngesikhathi ebuyela ekhaya ngalobo busuku. Icala lokubulala labikwa esiteshini samaphoyisa eMzimkhulu, ladluliselwa koKlebe ePort Shepstone. Kwenziwa uphenyo olunzulu kwalandelwa umkhondo wabasolwa. Lokhu kuholele ekuboshweni kukaSergeant Mngqithi. Leli phoyisa lavela kancane eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMzimkhulu, lagcinwa esitokisini kuze kube wukuthi licela ibheyili. Icala lahlehliselwa kuDisemba 3, 2024 ukuze acele ibheyili.Inkabi eboshiwe ibekwe icala lokubulala kanti izovela enkantolo yeMantshi eMzimkhulu ngoJanuwari 17.
LIZA ngenye indlela icala lokubulawa kwekhansela lakuMasipala waseMngeni, uMnuz Nhlalayenza Ndlovu, njengoba sekuboshwe umsolwa wesibili, inkantolo yaphinde yachitha isicelo sebheyili sommangalelwa wokuqala.INkantolo yeMantshi eHowick, ichithe isicelo sebheyili sikaMnuz Thobane Mashobo Hlongwa, owaboshelwa leli cala ngonyaka owedlule.Ngesikhathi kuthulwa isinqumo esicelweni sebheyili, uHlongwa ubevele noMnuz Khayelihle Shabalala, ongummangalelwa wesibili kuleli cala.UShabalala uboshwe ngesonto elidlule, ubengakasifaki yena isicelo sebheyili. Icala labo lizobuyela enkantolo ngoMashi 11.Izolo bekugcwele amalungu e-DA enkantolo ngesikhathi kwethulwa isinqumo esicelweni sikaHlongwa sokudedelwa ngebheyili.Imantshi u-Elizabeth Wilkens ithe uHlongwa uyingozi emphakathini, yathi ubufakazi obethulwe uMbuso ngesikhathi kulalelwe isicelo sebheyili buveza ukuthi uHlongwa uyingxenye yeqembu lemigulukudu elihlalise lubhojozi abantu baseMgungundlovu."Ummangalelwa akazange abuphikise lobu bufakazi. Ukuba kwakhe ingxenye yeqembu lemigulukudu kubeka engcupheni ukuphepha kofakazi kuleli cala. Angathumela ngisho abangani bakhe ukuthi bayolimaza ofakazi.”UNdlovu owadutshulwa wabulawa phambi komndeni wakhe, ngo-2023, kukholakala ukuthi wabulawelwa ukulwa nokukokotelwa kukagesi elokishini iMpophomeni.Imantshi uWilkens ithe ukusocongwa kukaNdlovu phambi komndeni kukhombisa ukuthi uHlongwa nayehamba nabo banesihluku kangakanani.Imantshi ikhale nangokuthi uHlongwa akazange azinikele emaphoyiseni ngesikhathi ezwa ukuthi ayamfuna.Ngokomphenyi wecala, amaphoyisa aqala ukufuna uHlongwa ngoDisemba 2023, njengoba eze amthola ngo-Okthoba wangonyaka owedlule."Umphenyi wecala uthe amaphoyisa aya kaningi kubo kaHlongwa, afica owazichaza ngokuthi uwugogo wakhe. Umphenyi wecala uthe bebelokhu beshiya umyalezo, becela uHlongwa ukuba axhumane namaphoyisa kodwa akangakwenza lokho. Nakuba uze waboshwa amaphoyisa athi kwasiza ilungu lomphakathi elawahlebela ukuthi ukhona ekhaya ngalelo langa.”Umholi we-DA KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Francois Rodgers, uthe kunikeza ithemba okwenzeka kuleli cala."Sijabule ukuthi kukhona umsolwa wesibili oboshiwe futhi sijabule ukuthi ummangalelwa wokuqala unqatshelwe ibheyili.”URodgers uthe basenezikhalazo ngendlela okuqhubeka ngayo uphenyo.Uthe amaphoyisa aphethe uphenyo awaxhumani nomndeni kaNdlovu, wathi futhi awafuni ukusebenzisana nabo."Sinobufakazi bethu esinabo, amaphoyisa awafuni ukubamukela.”URogders uphinde wakhala nangesinqumo sikaNgqongqoshe wezamaPhoyisa, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, sokuhlakaza ithimba lamaphoyisa eliphenya izigameko zokubulawa kosopolitiki KwaZulu-Natal.URogders uthe lesi sinqumo sithathwe ngesikhathi esibi lapho kubhekwe okhethweni lohulumeni basekhaya, nokuyisikhathi khona lapho zijwayele ukwanda izigameko zokubulawa kosopolitiki.
KUQALE ngegiya eliphansi ukufunda kwezinye izikole KwaZulu-Natal, ngenxa yezinselelo zokungabikhona kwezincwadi zokufunda kanjalo namanzi. Lezi zikole ezizithengela izincwadi zibhekene nenkinga yokuthi kusadingeka zilinde kuze kufike iizincwadi ngenxa yokuthi uMnyango wezeMfundo esifundazweni awuyifakile imali yazo ozikweleta kusuka nyakenye.UNobhala we-Sadtu esifundazweni, uNksz Nomarashiya Caluza, uthe ezikoleni ezizithengela izincwadi kuqale ngegiya eliphansi ukufunda njengoba labo abazozithenga, bebesahlwaya imali ukuze bazithenge ngoba umnyango awuayifakanga imali.Uthe le mali yezikole eyangonyaka odlule kanti umnyango wagcina ukhokhele izikole izikhawu ezimbili kuphela ekubeni kwakumele ukhokhe izikhawu ezingu-8, wase ubika izinkinga zemali."Kwezinye ezithengelwa nguhulumeni izincwadi zikhona, ukufunda kuyaqhubeka. Cishe uzinzo kahle sizolubona ngesonto elizayo esifundazweni. Othisha banelukuluku lokufundisa okuyinto esibagqugquzela ukuthi bayenze noma kunezinkinga bayaqhubeka bayibambe ishisa,” kusho uNksz Caluza.Uthe bayaqhubeka nokuthola imibiko yezinto ezibe yizinselelo ezikoleni.UMphathiswa wezeMfundo esifundazweni uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka nenhloko yomnyango uMnuz Nathi Ngcobo, bavakashele izikole eGroutville izolo beyohlola isimo njengoba bekuvulwa izikole.UNgqongqoshe weMfundo eyisiSekelo, uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, uthe noma kungekho ukuphazamiseka okubikiwe okwenze kwangafundwa, kodwa kunezifundazwe ezisabhekene nezinselelo.Ubale iKZN wathi ngesinye sezifundazwe ezinezinselelo zesabelomali."Njengoba ngise-Eastern Cape lapho ngihlola khona ukuthi izikole zivulwe kanjani, uMqondisi jikelele uMnuz Mweli (Mathanzima), uyangibikela ngezinselelo ezikhona ezifundazweni ezehlukene. Indaba yemali iseyinkinga eKZN,” kusho uNksz Gwarube.USIPHOSETHU Zulu (7) nozakwabo afunda nabo eClarence Primary eThekwini, bejabulela usuku lokuqala lokuvulwa kwezikole izolo Isithombe: Tumi Pakkies/ Independent Newspapers.Uthe njengoba uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ezothula inkulumo ebhekiswe esizweni ngenyanga ezayo, ufisa ukuthi uhulumeni abeke eqhulwini indaba yokuxhasa ezemfundo."Sidinga imali siwumnyango ngoba izinkinga eziningi esibhekene nazo zithinta imali. Sethemba ukuthi uMengameli uzoyithinta eyokuxhasa ezemfundo, ngoba sesikhalile kuyena ngale nkinga,” kusho uNksz Gwarube.Uthe bafuna nokuphucula imfundo kwaGrade R."Sizogxila kwaGrade R ngoba yilapho sifuna ukuphucula khona izinto. Ukuze abafundi bethu benze kahle emabangeni aphezulu, kubalulekile ukuthi siqinise kwaGrade R,” kusho uNksz Gwarube.Amaqembu ahlukene okubalwa i-ANC, IFP namanye afisele abafundi okuhle kodwa njengoba kuvulwe izikole.I-IFP ithe kunesidingo sokuthi kwandiswe isibalo sothisha, kulungiswe inkinga yokugcwala kakhulu emakilasini ukuze abafundi bathole imfundo esezingeni.
UHLELA ukwenza iziqu zobudokotela umfundi ongowokufika kuleli, odabule ngo-A ezifundweni eziyisishiyagalombili, kweziyisishiyagalolunye abezenza eMevamhlophe High, eMpangeni.U-Anna Amuli (19) wase-DRC, uthi ukungalithathi ikhefu uma esesikoleni yikhona okumsizile ukuthi enze kahle kwa-matric.Uthi bekuthi uma kuyisikhathi sekhefu, ahambe ayobuza kothisha uma kukhona angakuqondisisi kahle."Bengihlale ngiziphusha ukuthi ngifuna ukwenza kahle ezifundweni zami. Bengixhumana nothisha njalo ngesikhathi sekhefu lokudla ngiyobuza lapho engisuke ngingaqondisisi kahle khona,” kuchaza u-Anna.Uqhube wathi wafika kulesi sikole ezokwenza u-Grade 10, ekade efunda ngesiNgisi."Ngifike ngizofunda isiZulu njengolimi lwebele, ekubeni ngingeyena umZulu, ngisuka eCongo. Ngazalelwa eCongo, ngafika eSouth Africa ngineminyaka emithathu kuphela,” kulandisa u-Anna.Uthe ubenezinselelo esiZulwini kodwa lokhu akuzange kumthene amandla."Bengigqugquzeleka ukuthi ngizikhandle ngoba bengihlele ukwenza kahle ezifundweni zami. Kuthele izithelo ukusebenza kanzima kwami.”Uthole o-A kwi-Dramatic Arts, Geography, Life Sciences, Physical Sciences, Maths, LO, Accounting nakwi-English."Ngilinde izimpendulo zokuthi bayangamukela yini eNyuvesi iWits lapho ngafaka khona isicelo sokufundela ezobudokotela. Ngihlose nokuthola umfundaze ongangisiza ngikwazi ukuqhuba izifundo zami ngoba abazali bami ngeke babe nemali yokungiqhuba.” Uthe unina unendwo yokucwala izinwele ngakho ngeke akwazi ukumkhokhela imali yokwenza lezi ziqu. Uveze nokuthi akanabo nobuzwe bakuleli ngenxa yokushoda ngemali.Ubonge ithuba lokuthola imfundo kuleli njengoba enze kahle kwa-matric.Waphetha ngokuthi noma kuthiwa uqhamuka kuliphi izwe uyakwazi ukufeza amaphupho akho.Lesi sikole esisemakhaya sihlale senza kahle kwa-matric nakulokhu sizitholela o-100%.
IKOMITI lePhalamende elibhekelele ukusebenza koMnyango wezoMhlaba nokuThuthukiswa kweziNdawo zaseMakhaya, lifuna ukuba nomhlangano ophuthumayo neSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini. Inhloso yomhlangano wukudingida umdonsiswano wokulawula isikhwama esigade umhlaba kaZulu, iNgonyama Trust.Ikomiti lithathe isinqumo sokubhalela iMbube, licela umhlangano ophuthumayo.Lokhu kudalulwe ngusihlalo wekomiti, uMnuz Albert Mncwango, esitatimendeni asikhiphe ngemva komhlangano wekomiti.NgoLwesibili ikomiti lihlangane noNgqongqoshe woMnyango, uMnuz Mzwanele Nyhontso, lapho ezwakalise khona ukukhathazeka ngomdonsiswano wokulawula iNgonyama Trust.Sibi isimo kwiNgonyama Trust njengoba iMbube, engusihlalo webhodi, yabhala izincwadi ezimisa wonke amalungu ebhodi, nezinye izikhulu zesikhwama.Nakuba uNyhontso abhalela iMbube, eyitshela ukuthi ayinawo amandla okumisa amalungu ebhodi, umdonsiswano uyaqhubeka ngoba abaqokwe yiSilo ukuba balawule ukusebenza kweNgonyama Trust, bayaqhubeka nokukhipha imiyalelo kubasebenzi beNgonyama Trust.UMncwango uthe abazokugcina nje ngokuhlangana neSilo kuphela, wathi bazophinde baxoxe nazo zonke izinhlaka ezithintekayo."Sifuna ukuthola umsuka walo lolu daba. Sizozifikela mathupha, sizozwa.”UMncwango uthe bakhathazekile ngokuthi ukumiswa kwamalungu ebhodi kungase kuphazamise ukusebenza kweNgonyama Trust."Siyazi ukuthi iNgonyama Trust ibambe iqhaza elibalulekile ezizweni zamakhosi ezakhe ezindaweni ezingaphansi kweNgonyama Trust.”UNyhontso utshele amalungu ekomiti ukuthi wenza isicelo sokuba nomhlangano ophuthumayo neSilo, kodwa lokho akwangenzeka ngenxa yokuthi iMbube ibigonqile ngoba bekuqhubeka uMkhosi woSelwa.UNyhontso uthe abameli abaqokwa yiMbube bayaqhubeka nokukhipha imiyalelo yize yena akubeka kwacaca ukuthi ukuqokwa kwabo akukho emthethweni.Amalungu ekomiti athe udaba seluhambe kakhulu, athi kufanele kungenelelwe.Ilungu le-EFF, uMnuz Sam Matiase, lithe inkinga enkulu lapha ukuthi iMbube imile ekutheni inamagunya okumisa amalungu ebhodi ekubeni umthetho usho okunye."Manje lesimo senza kube sengathi thina siqophisana neSilo. Kufanele sikugweme ngakho konke okusemandleni ethu ukuphikisana neSilo. Kodwa lokho akufanele kusivimbe ekutheni siphenye izinsolo zokungahambisi kahle kulesi sikhwama.”Ilungu leDA, uMnuz Mlindi Nhanha, lithe kubukeka sengathi alikho elingashoni nezalo lapha kwiNgonyama Trust."Usuku, nosuku kuqhamuka okusha. Kufanele sihlale sigadile ukuthi ikuphi okusha okwenzakalayo.”UNhanha uthe ikomiti kufanele licele iMbube ukuthi ike ithi ukuma kancane ukubhala izincwadi zabameli, kuze kube ihlangana namalungu ekomiti.
ISINTU sithi udwendwe aluhlehli umakoti engadukile kodwa ongoti bezamasiko bathi umgcagco weSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini okuhlelwe ukuba ube sekuphele kwenyanga, uzohlehla uma kuwukuthi asiyi koshaya indesheni kuNdlunkulu uNtokozo Mayisela Zulu.Izazi zamasiko zithe iSilo asikwazi ukuphambana nezinkantolo, zathi into engalekelela ukuba iMbube iye koncenga uNdlunkulu uKaMayisela ukuba ayivumele ukuthi iqhubeke ishadelwe nguNdlunkulu uNomzamo Myeni.Kusathombe ukhiye namanje ngomgcagco okuhlelwe ukuthi ube ngoJanuwari 26, nonyaka, njengoba uNdlunkulu uKaMayisela efake isicelo sokuba umiswe.Emaphepheni awafake eNkantolo eNkulu yaseMgungundlovu, uNdlunkulu uKaMayisela uthe iMbube ayinalo ilungelo lokuthatha omunye undlunkulu ngoba yashada umshado omhlophe naye.UNdlunkulu uKaMayisela uthe njengoba beshade umshado omhlophe, umthetho awuvumi ukuthi omunye wabo aphinde ashade omunye umuntu.UKaMayisela neMbube bashada umshado omhlophe ngo-2021, eNquthu, ufuna ukuthi isicelo sakhe silalelwe ngoMsombuluko.Emaphepheni asenkantolo, uKaMayisela uthe akayivimbi iNdlulamithi yamakhosi ukuba ithathe omunye undlunkulu kodwa wathi ufuna ukuthi iqale ixoxwe le ndada.Ongoti bezamasiko bathe into engasiza iSilo ukuthi sixoxe noKaMayisela.USolwazi waseNyuvesi KwaZulu-Natal, uSihawu Ngubane, uthe indaba yonakala ekuqaleni ngesikhathi iSilo sishada umshado omhlophe."Ukuba iSilo saqala ngawo umshado wesintu ngabe siyakwazi ukuqhubeka sibathathe abanye.”UNgubane uthe izinkantolo yizona ezinamandla kulesi sikhathi esiphila kuso."Inkinga lana kuhlangene isilungu nesintu. Kutholene phezulu inkantolo nesiko, asazi ukuthi iyiphi eyogoba uphondo.”UNgubane uthe yena ubengaluleka ngokuthi iSilo sike sithi ukubamba amatomu.USolwazi Jabulani Maphalala uthe iSilo kufanele silalele umthetho wezinkantolo."ISilo asikwazi ukwenza okuphambene nezinkantolo ngoba kungasuka ukukhuluma, bese kuthiwa sizibona ukuthi singubani sona ukuthi singenza okuphambene nezinkantolo.”Ungoti wezomthetho, uMnuz Mpumelelo Zikalala weZikalala Attorneys, uthe iMbube ingazithola iboshwa noma ihlawuliswa uma ingenza okuphambene nomyalelo wenkantolo."Uma kungaphuma isinqumo esithi umgcagco awungaqhubeki, bese iSilo siyangena esigcawini, kobe sesiphule umyalelo wenkantolo. Lokho kungenza ukuthi siye ejele noma sihlawuliswe. Angicabangi ukuthi leyo into ayifunayo undlunkulu.”UZikalala uthe yena ngokwakhe ubengaluleka ngokuthi lolu daba luxoxwe ngaphandle kwenkantolo.Nakuba lingakabi bikho igama elisemthethweni eseliphumile lokuthi uyaqhubeka noma uyahlehla umgcagco, Isolezwe lithole ukuthi uNdlunkulu uMaMyeni uyaqhubeka namalungiselelo.Umthombo wasendlunkulu uthe uMaMyeni uhambe esho ukuthi uzoshada kumnyama kubomvu.
UMCULI we-Afro pop, uWinnie "Dwinky Dwinky" Khumalo, uchazwe njengomunye wababambe elikhulu iqhaza ekuhlanganiseni i-ANC ngesikhathi yayilaxazwe khona ngabaholi ababeqavile.Lokhu kuvezwe ngowayeyinhloko yezomgomo yenhlangano ngo-2008, uMnuz Jeff Radebe, enkonzweni yesikhumbuzo sikaWinnie eMarket Theatre, eNewtown, eGoli. URadebe uthe babeshiwe ngabaholi ababenohlonze abanjengoMnuz Mosiuoa Lekota, uMnuz Mbazima Shilowa noMnuz Smuts Ngonyama."Ngakho kwakufanele ngiqhamuke neqhinga." URadebe uthe waxhumana nophrojusa uSello Chicco Twala, ukuba kuqoshwe izingoma ezazizogqugquzela abantu ukuba baqhubeke nokweseka i-ANC. Kubaculi ubale uDeborah Fraser, uNothi Ntuli, uPeter Mokoena noWinnie. Uthe wabe esenikela emzini yaloyo owayengumengameli we-ANC, uMnuz Jacob Zuma eNkandla, lapho uZuma achazwa khona ingoma eyayihlatshelelwa nguWinnie ethi Mina Ngiyohlala Nginje, Ngiyi-ANC." Esephetha uRadebe, uthe lengoma yafike yagila izimanga kwiJanuwari Statement eKhayelitsha, e-Eastern Cape, kanti ikuphindile lokho nakule nyanga.UChicco uvumelane noRadebe ngeqhaza likaWinnie ekubumbeni i-ANC. Izingane zikaWinnie, uThando noRethabile Khumalo, zivalelise kunina ngezingoma kwachazeka izithameli.Uhlelo lwenkonzo beluphethwe nguNtombeningi noSomizi Mhlongo, kanti kwabaduduze izithameli kubalwa uKholeka, Themba, Khulekani noPu2ma. Phakathi kosaziwayo ebebekhona kubalwa u-Ebony, Ihhashi Elimhlophe, DJ Cleo, uDJ Oskido, Thembinkosi Nciza nabanye.

Abangu-51 kubo bakhishwe sebeshonile.Ukuhlukaniswa kwabo ngobuzwe kumi kanje:AbaseMozambique: 67AbaseLesotho: 26AbaseZimbabwe: 11AbaseNingizimu Afrika: 2Osekwenzekile kusukela ngo-Agasti 2024 kuya ngeSonto, 12 Januwari 2025:▶️Ukuboshwa:Bangaphezu kuka-1 576 abavukuzi abangekho emthethweni asebeboshiwe ngaphambi kokuthi kuqalwe umsebenzi wokumba. Ababoshiwe bahlanganisa lezi zizwe ezilandelayo: Abangu-997 ababoshiwe ngabaseMozambique, abangu-427 ngabaseZimbabwe, abangu-118 badabuka eLesotho, abangu-21 ngabaseNingizimu Afrika, kanti oyedwa ungowaseMalawi, omunye ungowaseCongo. Abavukuzi abangu-1 540 abangekho emthethweni basagcinwe esitokisini samaphoyisa.Abavukuzi abangu-121 abangekho emthethweni sebebuyiselwe emazweni akubo okungukuthi abaseMozambique abangu-80, abaseBasotho, abangu-30, abantu baseZimbabwe abangu-10 kanye noyedwa waseMalawi.Abangu-46 sebevele betholwe benecala lokumba izimayini ezingekho emthethweni, ukuphazamisa ukusebenza komthetho kanye nokwephula umthetho wabokufika. Inkantolo ikhiphe isigwebo sika-R12 000 noma izinyanga eziyisithupha ezilengiswe ngokuphelele ejele iminyaka emihlanu ngaphansi kwemibandela yokuthi bangatholwa benecala elifanayo.️Impahla eshaqiwe selokhu kwaqala ukusebenza eStilfontein (Disemba 2024) zihlanganisa ngaphezu kuka-640 kg wempahla enegolide, u-6.2 kg wegolide elicwengiweyo, iziqhumane, izibhamu, nemali elinganiselwa kuR52.49 million.
NJENGOBA kuvulwa izikole, uMphathiswa wezokuThutha nokuHlaliswa kwaBantu KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Sboniso Duma, ehlole amabhasi angu-150 kanye namatekisi athutha izingane zesikole eMgungundlovu, ngoLwesibili.Ngesikhathi kuhlolwa lezi zimoto, kuvele ukuthi amabhasi angu-47 asusiwe emgwaqeni ngoba awakulungele ukuba athuthe izingane zesikole.Esitatimendeni esikhishwe yiloMnyango sithe: "Noma sigculisekile ngokuba sesimeni esihle sezimoto esizihlolile, kodwa sinxenxe uphiko lwe-Road Traffic Inspectorate (RTI) kanye nezomthetho esifundazweni ukuthi babe mehlomane behlole izimoto ababonayo ukuthi zingase zingabi sesimweni,” kusho isitatimende.Ukuhlolwa kwezimoto ezithutha izingane zesikole kuzokwenziwa yithimba lezomthetho eliseqopheleni eliphezulu lakwaRTI elizobe linkanise eziteshini ezingu-26 ezingomahambanendlwana.
IMANTSHI uVincent Hlatshwayo ihlabe isenzo sabasolwa ababili kwabahlanu ecaleni lokubulawa komrepha u-AKA nomngani wakhe owayengusomabhizinisi uTibz, ngokuthi kuwukumosha isikhathi senkantolo ukulokhu befaka isicelo sebheyili bephindelela kuleli cala ababhekene nalo.UHlatshwayo usho njalo eNkantolo yeMantshi eThekwini, ngoLwesithathu, ngenkathi echitha isicelo sikaMnuz Muziwethemba Gwabeni noMnuz Lindokuhle Ndimande, abangabasolwa ababili kwabahlanu, abasolwa ngokubulala u-AKA no-Tibz, esigamakweni esenzeka ngoFebhuwari 2023, ngaphandle kwendawo yokudlela esemgwaqeni uFlorida, eThekwini.Bese kungokwesithathu oGwabeni noNdimande befaka isecelo sebheyili, njengoba baqale basifaka ngoMeyi wanyekenye, sachithwa, kwala ngisho sebesidlulisela eNkantolo ePhakeme.Bezofaka kabusha isicelo sabo ngesonto elidlule, babeveze ukuthi banemininingwane emisha, abakholwa wukuthi yanele ukuthi iMantshi icubungule kabusha isicelo sabo sebheyili.UGwabeni ubekhale ngokuthi ukweleta uR100 000 esikoleni okufunda kusona enye yezingane zakhe, nokuthi enye ingane yakhe nonkosikazi wakhe baulekwa ngokomqondo, okudinga ukuthi abe seduze nabo ukubeseka. Wathi lokho kudinga imali, akakwazi ukukwenza njengoba evalelwe esesitokisini.UNdimande yena wakhala ngokuthi impilo inzima emndenini wakhe ngenxa yokulimala kwetekisi yakhe elaba sengozini, angakwazi ukulilungisa njengoba esesitokisini, nokuthi umndeni wakhe uyasokola ezimalini njengoba yena engekho, futhi wuye obhekele izindleko zamakhosikazi kayise ongasekho emhlabeni.UHlatshwayo ukhale ngokuthi isicelo salaba basolwa sebheyili sifana nokuhlukumeza iNkantolo, ikakhulu ngoba izethulo zabo uzibona zifananaseke bakusho esikhathini esedlule, bechithwa."Ngakho inkantolo ayikwazi ukubanika ibheyili kube bungekho ubufakazi obusha obungenza yenze lokho, nokuthi kuyabonakala ukuthi akukho okungavimba umsolwa wokuqala ukuphazamisa ofakazi becala, njengoba ubufakazi obusenkantolo kufakazela ukuthi useke wazama ukwenza lokho,” kusho uHlatshwayo.Icala lizobuyela eNkantolo ngoFebhuwari 7, lapho okulindeleke khona ukuthi abasolwa bethulelwe umqulu wamacala ababekwe wona andukuba kuqale ukuqulwa kwecala.
KWANDE izinkinga esikhulwini esixoshelwe inkohlakalo kaR1.1 billion eMnyangweni wezeMisebenzi yoMphakathi KwaZulu-Natal.UMphathiswa wezeMisebenzi yoMphakathi, uMnuz Martin Meyer, uvulele isikhulu icala emaphoyiseni.Isikhulu sixoshwe umnyango ngesonto eledlule ngemva kophenyo, sisolwa ngokuba nesandla ekunikezweni kwenkampani eyodwa inqwaba yamathenda wumnyango.Inkampani ethintekayo kuthiwa yanikezwa amathenda angu-29 eminyakeni emibili edlule.UMeyer uthe umnyango uphinde wavulela amacala ezinye izikhulu ezintathu nazo ezisoleka enkohlakalweni."Ngeke siyibekezelele inkohlakalo lapha emnyangweni. Lesi sinyathelo kufanele sithumele umyalezo oqinile ezinkampanini ebezicabanga ukugwazela izikhulu zomnyango. Sizowalekelela ngakho konke akudingayo amaphoyisa ophenyweni lwawo.”
IZIZWA ithunukala amanxeba imindeni yabafundi ababulawe ngoyise bezingane zabo ngesihluku sebefunda u-matric nyakenye.Phakathi kwabafi kukhona uMandisa Cele (21) waseSiqungeni, eMthwalume, owabulawa nguyise wengane (3) yakhe ngoJulayi, nyakenye.Isidumbu sikaMandisa owayefunda eSinokubonga Junior Secondary, satholwa simbozwe ngengubo phezu kombede egumbini lakhe lokulala, ikhanda libokozela ukushawa.Ngaleso sikhathi, Isolezwe lathola ukuthi wayehlale exabana nomsolwa, efuna ukubuyiselwa ingane yakhe, okwavela ukuthi wayiphucwa umndeni kamsolwa.Isolezwe likhuluma noyise, uMnuz Mzwandile Dlungele ngeSonto, uthe uyathunukala ngendodakazi yakhe njengoba kuphuma imiphumela ka-matric."Ngiyazi ukuthi ubezothola o-distinction abambalwa ngoba ubehlakaniphe kakhulu. Ngisho nothisha abebemfundisa bakhala kakhulu ebulelwe, bethi umbulali unqamuleze impilo yomuntu obenekusasa eliqhakazile,” kusho uDlungele.Uthe othisha babeye bamcele, afundise abanye abafundi ngempelasonto."Nangempelasonto yesigameko babemcelile ukuthi ayosiza. Bekwaziwa ukuthi uma uthisha engekho, uMandisa uzobasiza abanye ozakwabo,” kusho uDlungele.Uthe ngisho nasendlini yakhe, lapho abulawelwa khona, kwakugcwele izincwadi.Mandisa Cele Omunye umfundi owabulawa ngesihluku ngo-Ephreli, umndeni wakhe othi ubusalindele lukhulu kuye uZinhle Khathi waKwaDumisa, eMzinto.UZinhle owayefunda eSiphapheme High, ehlala noninakhulu (78), watholwa ethule egumbini ayelala kulo. Kwathiwa umsolwa umbulale ngokumshaya nokumklinya.Udadewabo uNksz Sandisile Khathi, uthe wayezithanda izincwadi zakhe, engalali engafundanga."Wayeze avuke ebusuku ngo-12, afunde yize ayehleli ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima ezifaka phakathi ukuhlukunyezwa wuye umsolwa,” kusho uNksz Khathi.Uthe abangabazi ukuthi ubezophasa.Uveze ukuthi wayethe uma eseqede uzokwenza izifundo zodokotela bezilwane ngoba wayezithanda.
LIKHUPHUKILE izinga lokuphasa lika-matric KwaZulu-Natal njengoba lisuke ku-86.4% ngo-2023 laya ku-89.5% ngo-2024.Leli zinga lenyuke phezu kwezingqinamba eziningi ezibhekene nomnyango esifundazweni.Le miphumela imenyezelwe ngoMsombuluko ebusuku nguNgqongqoshe weMfundo eyisiSekelo uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, eGoli.UNksz Gwarube udalule ukuthi iKZN isesendaweni yesibili, ilandela iFree State.Nyakenye i-KZN yayisendaweni yesibili kanti iFree State ikuphindile lokho ngokuthi iqhubeke ihlale endaweni yokuqala, ishaya zonke izifundazwe zakuleli.Umnyango wesifundazwe ngomunye weminyango emikhulu kuleli ngesibalo sabafundi. Ngisho kwababhala u-matric iKZN iyona ehlale inesibalo esiphezulu sabafundi ababhala leli banga.Umnyango waseKZN ubhekene nengwadla yokushoda kwemali ngenxa yokunqanyulwa kwesabelomali.Le nkinga yenza ukuthi kube nokungqubuzana phakathi kwezikhulu zomnyango, kanjalo nezinyunyana zothisha ngenxa yokuthi azivalwa izikhala zothisha abasuke beya emalivini ngenxa yokushoda kwemali.Ekhuluma esidlweni sasekuseni nabafundi abenze kahle ku-matric uNksz Gwarube uncome laba bafundi ngokwenza kahle phezu kwezinselelo eziningi.Uthe leli qoqo elibhale u-matric lathwala kanzima ngesikhathi kuhlasele ubhubhane iCovid-19 kuleli."Kwavalwa izikole ngenxa yeCovid kodwa nabekezela nafunda, manje niphase kahle. Izinselelo ezibakhona aziyona imigoqo yokukuvimba kodwa eyokuthi ukwazi ukudlulela phambili,” kusho uNksz Gwarube.Uthe iningi labafundi abenze kahle aliqhamuki emizini ecebile."Okubalulekile ngukuthi abafundi bethu abangu-13 million bathole imfundo esezingeni. Kumele siqhubeke nokubeka ezemfundo phambili,” kusho uNksz Gwarube.Uthe kudingeka kuliwe nesihlava sentsha engasebenzi kuleli."Lokhu singakwenza uma imfundo yethu isezingeni. Qhubekani nenze okuhle nalapho niya khona.”Unobhala weSadtu esifundazweni, uNksz Nomarashiya Caluza, uthe bebelindele ukuthi imiphumela inyuke ngoba othisha basebenze kanzima.Uthe othisha bebezikhandla befundisa ngamaholidi nangezimpelasonto."Zikhona izinselelo kodwa othisha basebenze kanzima yingakho izinga linyukile. Othisha babeka phambili abafundi bavolontiye noma bazi ukuthi ngeke bathole lutho. Okubajabulisayo ukubona imiphumela emihle.”
BEBEGCWELE uvalo yize bebenokuzethemba abafundi abane abagile izimanga baseSibusisiwe Comprehensive Tech High, eMbumbulu.Lesi sikole sithole u-100%. Abafundi abathole o-A abangu-8 ngu-Asanda Dube (18), Akhona Shange (18), Mandisa Mapumulo (18) no-Uyanda Khwela (17).Bobane izifundo abaziphase ngamalengiso kube yiMaths, Physical Science, Accounting, Life Sciences, Geography, isiZulu, English neLife Orientation.Bekhuluma neSolezwe bobane bathe bebenovalo olukhulu ngokuthi imiphumela izohamba kanjani. Okuqaphelekile ukuthi bobane baveze intshisekeyo abanayo yokuba ngodokotela.U-Uyanda Khwela uthe bebesebenza ngokuzikhandla okukhulu nsuku zonke. "Angifuni ukuqamba amanga benginovalo kodwa ngijabule kakhulu ukuthi ngiphase kahle kangaka," usho kanjena.Uthe ufake isicelo sokuyokwenza iMedicine eNyuvesi iKwaZulu Natal.UMandisa uthe belumxinile uvalo ngemiphumela wathi kodwa ubazi ukuthi usebenze kanzima. Ubethulele isigqoko bonke othisha bakulesi sikole ngokusebenza ngokuzikhandla okukhulu."Iyamangalisa indlela othisha bethu abasebenze ngayo ngokuzikhandla. Bebenza konke okusemandleni abo ngenhloso yokuqinisekisa ukuthi siyaphumelela. Bebekhathazeka kakhulu uma kukhona into ababonayo ukuthi kasiyiqondi kahle," echaza.Uveze ukuthi kukhona amakilasi abengena ngo- ntambama aphume ngo- 9 ebusuku athe ukholwa ukuthi aklame indima enkulu ekutheni benze kahle ezifundweni zabo.Uthe ufake isicelo sokwenza iMedicine neComputer Science ezikhungweni ezahlukene.U-Akhona uqale waveza ukuthi uvalo belumxine kangakanani. Uthe ukuzimisela kothisha kubasizile njengabafundi ekutheni benze kahle kakhulu emimphumelweni yabo. Wathi uyokwenza iMedicine, eNyuvesi iPitoli.U-Asanda obaqwaqwade bonke kulesi sikole uthe wemukeliwe eNyuvesi iKapa ukuyokwenza iMedicine."Ngijabule kakhulu ngokuthi konke kuhambe kahle kodwa nami belungibulala uvalo," echaza.Uthishanhloko wesikole uMnuz Mzwakhe Duma uncome ukusebenza kanzima kothisha.Wancoma nesisekelo esiqinile kakhulu athe sabekwa uthishanhloko waphambilini uMnuz Sipho Khomo.
UMA ungeneme ngemiphumela yakho ka-matric, ucabanga ukuthi kabalenzanga iqiniso, zikhona ezinye izindlela ongazenza ukuze ugcine wenelisekile.Kulezi zindlela kufaka ukuthi ucele ukuphinde umakelwe kabusha izifundo zakho, noma ufune ukubona iphepha olibhalile ukuthi limakwe kanjani.Ngokolwazi olukhishwe nguMnyango wezeMfundo eyisiSekelo, uma ufuna ukubheka ukuthi iphepha limakwe kanjani, noma ufuna ukulibona lonke lelo phepha olibhalile kuzokudla u-R230. Uma ufuna ukumakelwa kabusha kubiza u-R120.Izicelo zokwenza lokhu zivulwe namhlanje kanti kuvalwa emva kwezinsuku eziyisikhombisa kudedelwe imiphumela ka-matric.Ulwazi luveza ukuthi imiphumela yokuphinde umakelwe kabusha izokhishwa ngoMashi 7, 2025. Le miphumela izotholakala esikhungweni obhalele kusona.Kulabo abafuna ukuphucula izifundo zabo, bangafaka izicelo zokuthi babhale izivivinyo zokuchibiyela ezingoMeyi/Juni nonyaka.Usuku lokuvala ukufaka izicelo zokuphinde ubhale uFebhuwari 7.Labo abangakwazanga ukubhala izivivinyo zabo ngoNovemba nyakenye, ngenxa yezizathu ezehlukene, nabo bazofakwa ohlelweni lokuthi babhale ngoMeyi/Juni."Abangabhalanga kumele balethe ubufakazi obukhomba ukuthi ababhalanga ngenxa yokuthi babegula, kwakushoniwe ekhaya noma ezinye izizathu ezinqala. Ukuze babhalise kumele babe namamaki aziwa nge-School Based Assessment (SBA),” kusho umnyango.Nalabo ababhala u-matric omdala, kusuka ngo-2008 kuya manje, abafuna ukuphucula imiphumela yabo, basenalo ithuba lokwenza lokhu ngokuthi babhale ngoMeyi/Juni nonyaka.Abafuna ukuphinda u-matric ngokugcwele bangabhalisa ezikoleni uma kungukuthi baneminyaka engaphansi kuka-21.Kumele abhalise izifundo eziyisikhombisa, kubalwa ne-Life Orientation.Bangabhalisa njengomuntu ophindayo kwi-Public Adult Education Centre.Bangaya ngisho emakolishi amakhono angu-50 kuleli.
BAVEZE ukuthi bangompetha nasekilasini abafundi basesikoleni saseMgungundlovu esidume ngokwenza kahle kwezemidlalo, i-Edendale Technical School, njengoba nemiphumela yabo ka-matric ibe seqophelweni elicokeme.Abafundi abane bakulesi sikole baklaye ngo-A kuzona zonke izifundo zabo eziyisishiyagalombili.Abenze kahle bebenza izifundo i-Mathemetics, Life Science, Physical Science, Tourism, Engineering Graphics and Design, Life Orientation, English nesiZulu.Bekungekhona ukuthi bekulula kulaba bafundi abaphase ngamalengiso. Endleleni ebheke empumelelweni bekunezingqinamba ezehlukene abathe abazange bazivumele ukuba zishabalalise amaphupho abo.UMawande Phungula (17), othole o-A kuzo zonke izifundo zakhe, uthe ukuxinwa yisifo samathambo kucishe kwaphazamisa iphupho lakhe lokuphasa ngamalengiso."Lo nyaka ubunzima kakhulu kimina, ngibe umntwana ohlushwa ukugula. Kube khona izinsuku lapho ngigcine ngingasakwazi ukuya esikoleni.”UMawande uthe isifo samathambo besimqinisa kakhulu ebusika, wathi kunamaphepha amabili okuhlolwa kwaphakathi nonyaka angakwazanga ukuwabhala.Uthe into emsize kakhulu ukufunda noma esekhaya.UMawande uthe kumumangazile ukubalwa kubafundi abenze kahle. Uthe ufisa ukwenza izifundo ze-Medicine, wathi ufake izicelo zokufunda e-University of Cape Town, University of KwaZulu-Natal nase-University of Pretoria.ULANGELIHLE Dlamini othole o-A abayisishiyagalombili Isithombe: SITHUNYELWEULangelihle Dlamini (17), naye othole o-A kuzo zonke izifundo zakhe, uthe ukushona kukanina ngaphambi kokuthi aqale u-matric kwenze kwaba nzima kuyena.Unina, uNksz Zamandwandwe Nxumalo, washona ngoDisemba ngo-2023."Bese ngisele nogogo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi bese kumele ngisebenze kanzima ukuze ngithole izinto engizifisayo. Ngizizwe ngijabule ukuthola imiphumela emihle ngoba lona bekuwunyaka onzima kakhulu kumina.”ULangelihle uthe ufisa ukuyokwenza izifundo zobudokotela, wathi ufake izicelo eWits, University of Cape Town, University of KwaZulu-Natal nase-University of Johannesburg.ULAURA Phiri naye ogile izimanga emiphumeleni ka-matric Isithombe: SITHUNYELWE ULaura Phiri (17), odabule o-A kuzo zonke izifundo, uthe kumsebenzele ukudela ubuthongo."Umsebenzi ubumningi, ngakho bengingasalali. Bengijwayele ukulala ngo-12 ebusuku noma ngo-1. Bese ngivuka ngiya esikoleni.”ULaura uthe ufisa ukuyofundela ubudokotela, wathi ufake nesicelo sokwenza izifundo ze-Computer Scienece.USiphokuhle Ndlovu (18), naye odabule o-A kuzo zonke izifundo zakhe, uthe okumsize kakhulu ukuya ezifundweni zasebusuku kanye nezangempelasonto. USiphokuhle uthe ufisa ukwenza izifundo ze-Aucturial Science, wathi ufake isicelo sokufunda e-University of Cape Town.Ngesikhathi Isolezwe lihambele esikoleni izolo, abazali nabafundi bebengena belakanyana, bezofuna izikhala zokufunda ngenxa yedumela lalesi sikole.
BASHAYE into ecokeme abafundi baKwaZulu-Natal, abahlonishwe nguNgqongqoshe wezeMfundo eyisiSekelo, uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, ngokwenza kahle kwa-matric.Laba bafundi bachonywe uphaphe legwalagwala ngokuqwaqwada abanye emakhanda.Emcimbini obuyizolo ebusuku eGoli, laba bafundi bamenyezelwe njengabanye abenze kahle kuzwelonke, kanti nasesifundazweni, baphumelele ngamalengiso.Omunye wabo uFanelesibonge Ngema obefunda eVukile High KwaMaphumulo, uphakamise igama lalesi sikole esisemakhaya.Ukhulele eNqobeni khona KwaMaphumulo, kanti ubesizwa wukungalali njengoba enze kahle.Ulandise Isolezwe ukuthi ubebuya esikoleni enze imisebenzi yasekhaya, ngaphambi kokulala amahora amabili kuya kwamathathu bese evuka, ushe umshikashika wokufunda."Bengize ngibanxuse ekhaya ukuthi bangivuse uma sengilale amahora amabili kuya kwamathathu. Bengivuka ngabo-10, ushe umsebenzi ngize ngilale ngabo-2 ezintatha ngoba bekudingeka ngiphinde ngilale ngivuke ngo-5 ekuseni, ngilungiselele ukuya esikoleni.”Uthe usizwe nawukufunda esebenzisa ezinye izinkundla ezifana neYouTube."Lezi zinkundla zingisize kakhulu ezifundweni zami nasekwenzeni kahle. Abafundi ababeke umoya phansi, bazimisele uma sebefunda.”Uthole o-A abayisishiyagalombili ezifundweni zakhe abezenza okuyisiZulu, English, Life Orientation (LO), Life Sciences, Accounting, Maths, Geography ne-Physical Science.Ufuna ukwenza iziqu zobudokotela eNyuvesi yaseKapa.Omunye wabafundi ophase ngamalengiso u-Owethu Aphile Shangase waseManguzi, obefunda eJohn Wesley Kosi Bay Private, lapho aphinda khona u-Grade R ekubeni awufunda eGadokuwayo Primary ngo-2013, uthe ukuzimisela nokuhlale ephokophele okukhulu yikhona okumenze wenza kahle.U-OWETHU Aphile Shangase waseManguzi, obefunda eJohn Wesley Kosi Bay Private, ohlonishwe nguNgqongqoshe wezeMfundo eyisiSekelo kuzwelonke, uNksz Siviwe Gwarube ngokwenza kahle kuleli Isithombe: FACEBOOKU-Owethu uhlale ezitapela izitifiketi nezindondo kusuka kwa-Grade 3.Uhlale ezigijimela ku-90% ezifundweni zakhe kanti uthanda kakhulu i-Maths.Ngisho nakwi-sekethe afunda ngaphansi kwayo, uke wadla umhlanganiso emqhudelwaneni we-Maths.Ekhuluma neSolezwe njengoba ehlonishwe nguNksz Gwarube, uthe ukufaka umfutho kwi-Maths kuthele izithelo."Besifunda sibe ngamaqoqo okungisize kakhulu ezifundweni zami. Bengisebenzisa namaphepha amadala abhalwa kwa-matric ngiwaphendule. Bengiwabhala kube sengathi ngibhala izivivinyo bese ngizimakela, bengingafundi umbuzo bese ngibuka izimpendulo,” kusho u-Owethu.Uthe nethimba abefunda nalo bebefonelana ngisho ebusuku uma kukhona abangakuboni kahle esifundweni esithile.Ubonge kakhulu abazali bakhe ngokumeseka njengoba enze kahle.Uthole o-A abayisishiyagalombili ezifundweni iLO, isiZulu, English, Tourism, Accounting, Life Sciences, Physical Science neMaths.Uhlela ukwenza iziqu ze-Actuarial Science eNyuvesi yaseKapa."Ngisalinde imifundaze phezu kokuba i-NSFAS isingiphendulile. Ngibonga umama nobaba, umama uyazama phezu kokuba bebaningi ababhekile.”
INDLUNKULU kaZulu kayikazi noma isingalungiswa yini imithombo yokuvubela kuhlelelwa umgcagco weSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini, okufanele ube ekupheleni kwenyanga njengoba kunesicelo esifakwe eNkantolo uNdlunkulu uNtokozo Mayisela Zulu, sokuba umiswe.IHhovisi leSilo lithe lisalinde iNdlulamithi yamakhosi ukuba isho ukuthi kusazoya ngamagama enkehli yini ngomchanguzo kaNdlunkulu uMaMyeni.Abasendlunkulu bathi isicelo sikaNdlunkulu uKaMayisela sibehle ngaphezulu, ngaleyo ndlela abanalo izwi elilodwa.ISilo kufanele sigcagcelwe nguNdlunkulu uNomzamo Myeni ngoJanuwari 26. Umgcagco wamenyezelwa ngokusemthethweni ngokhulumela iSilo, uMntwana uSimphiwe Zulu, ngesonto eledlule. Kepha umshado usufakelwe isivimbelo sasenkantolo ngemva kokuthi uNdlunkulu uKaMayisela efake isicelo sokuba umiswe.ISILO uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini noNdlukulu uNtokozo Mayisela ofuna kumiswe umgcagco wasoEmaphepheni awafake eNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu, uNdlunkulu uKaMayisela uthe iMbube ayinalo ilungelo lokuthatha omunye undlunkulu ngoba yashada umshado omhlophe naye.UNdlunkulu uKaMayisela uthe njengoba beshade umshado omhlophe umthetho awuvumi ukuthi omunye wabo aphinde ashade omunye umuntu.UKaMayisela, neMbube bashada umshado omhlophe ngo-2021, eNquthu.Ethintwa yiSolezwe izolo, uMntwana uSimphiwe, uthe abazi ukuthi uzoqhubeka yini umgcagco njengoba kuhleliwe."Lolu udaba luthinta abantu ababili, luphakathi kukaNdlunkulu uKaMayisela neNgonyama. Silinde ukuthi kube yibona abashoyo ukuthi kuzokwenzakalani njengoba isimo sinje. INgonyama ibingakasho lutho, ngakho-ke asazi ukuthi kuzokwenzakalani.”UMntwana uSimphiwe uthe iMbube iyaqhubeka nomsebenzi wesizwe yize ibhekene nalesi simo. Uthe njengamanje iSilo simatasa noMkhosi woSelwa oqhubekayo esigodlweni eMashobeni."Ibutho lifikile izolo (ngoMgqibelo), lizophuma namhlanje (izolo) liyogawula usekwane. Lizobuya kusasa (namhlanje) lizobika inhlambeko.”Umthombo osendlunkulu uthe nabo bayazibuza, bayaziphendula ukuthi iyozala nkomoni."Okwenza izinto zibe nzima ukuthi kunomkhosi oqhubekayo, iNgonyama igonqile. Kunzima nanokuthi kube nomhlangano. Okuyinkinga kakhulu ukuthi nawo umgcagco ususeduze. Ngicabanga ukuthi okuningi sizokwazi uma sekuphele umkhosi."Akekho obeyilindele into eyenziwe undlunkulu. Yebo, besazi ukuthi kunezinkinga kodwa besingalindele ukuthi udaba lungaze lungene enkantolo. Into ebesiyilindele ukuthi kube nomhlangano obuzoxoxa lolu daba.”UNdlunkulu uKaMayisela ufuna ukuthi isicelo sakhe silalelwe ngoJanuwari 20.Ungoti wezomthetho, u-Advocate Abigail Ngobene, uthe iMbube ayikwazi ukuthatha omunye undlunkulu ekubeni ingakahlukani noNdlunkulu uKaMayisela. Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabe-Newsroom Afrika."Umthetho ukubeka kucace ukuthi umuntu oshade umshado omhlophe akavumelekile ukuthatha isithembu. Umshado wabo awufani nomshado wesintu ovumela isithembu.”UNDLUNKULU uNomzamo Myeni
UNGQONGQOSHE wemfundo eyisisekelo uNksz Siviwe Gwarube uncome abafundi ababekeze kwaze kwaba yisekugcineni ekhipha imiphumela ka-matric wango-2024.Imiphumela inyukile isuka ku82.9% ngo-2023 kuya ku-87.3% ngo-2024. Okuncomekayo wukuthi zonke izifundazwe zenzekahle kakhulu iFree State iyona ehamba phambili.Ngokombiko kaMalusi bangu-880 209 abafundi ababhalisela leli kilasi ezikoleni zikahulumeni, kodwa bangu-810 900 abakwazile ukubhala izivivinyo zabo.Imiphumela ngokwezifundazwe:Amadolobha ahamba phambili, iJohannesburg West eGauteng, iFezile Dabi eFree State noMkhanyakude KwaZulu-Natal ngokulandelana kwawo
KUHLASELE uthuli lwezichwe eNdlunkulu kaZulu njengoba uNdlunkulu weSilo, uNtokozo Mayisela Zulu, efake isicelo esiphuthumayo sokuvimba umshado weMbube, noNdlunkulu uNomzamo Myeni.Kulesi sicelo asifake eNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu, ufuna kuvinjwe umshado weSilo ozokuba sekupheleni kwenyanga, waphumela obala ngezinto eziningi.Emaphepheni abonwe yiSolezwe Ngempelasonto, uNdlunkulu uKaMayisela, uthe iMbube ayinalo ilungelo lokuthatha omunye undlunkulu ngoba yashada umshado omhlophe naye.UNdlunkulu uKaMayisela uthe njengoba beshade umshado omhlophe umthetho kawuvumi ukuthi omunye wabo aphinde ashade omunye umuntu.Nakuba ethe akananxa nokuthi iSilo sithathe omunye undlunkulu, ukhale ngokuthi ezinye izinqumo zeMbube zihlambalaza iSilo.Encwadini ayibhekise kubantwana basendlunkulu eyingxenye yamaphepha awafake enkantolo, uNdlunkulu uKaMayisela uthe ezinye izinqumo zeSilo zibulala isintu, wathi zenza ukuthi iMbube ithukwe ngabantu.UNdlunkulu uKaMayisela ufuna ukuthi isicelo sakhe silalelwe ngoJanuwari 20, 2025, kanti uthi bashada umshado omhlophe ngo-2021, eNquthu.IMbube ihlele ukugcagcelwa uNdlunkulu uMaMyeni ngoJanuwari 26, kuhlelwe ukuba kuqale umkhehlo ngoJanuwari 24.Undlunkulu uKaMayisela uthe ukhona umhlangano ohleliwe wokuxoxa ngomshado weSilo kodwa ungenyanga ezayo ngoFebhuwari."Ngaleso sikhathi lizobe selidume ladlula njengoba umshado uzobe usudlulile. Umshado wesiLungu esiwushadile kawuvumi ukuthi iMbube ithathe isithembu,” kusho uKaMayisela.Uveze ukuthi ngesikhathi kufika uNdlunkulu Nozizwe waseSwatini, bavumelana neSilo ukuthi bawushintshe umshado wabo bawenze owesintu."Safuna izeluleko kubameli ngalokhu, basiluleka ukuthi zimbili izindlela zokwenza lokhu. Eyokuqala ukuhlukanisa bese sibhalisa owesintu, okuyinto eyayizoba yihlazo ngoba kuphambene nosiko ukuthi iSilo sihlukanise umshado. Eyesibili wukufaka isicelo enkantolo ukuthi uguqulwe, okunesithunzi futhi izokwenza indlela yesintu ibe namalungelo afanayo nowesiLungu. Savumelana neNgonyama ngokuthi sithathe uhlelo lwesibili, sathi sisephakathi nalo, iMbube yathi asilumise lolu hlelo ngaphandle kwezizathu,” kusho uKaMayisela.Uveze ukuthi usenovalo ngokuphepha kwakhe kanjalo namazinyane eSilo ahleli nawo."INgonyama ayikaze ingibikele ukuthi ithatha undlunkulu noma ngiyibuza iyakuphika lokhu. Ngisahleli esigodlweni nabantwana bami, iNgonyama iyafika izosibona. Umshado obikwayo noMaMyeni awukwazi ukwenzeka kungalungisiwe izinto ngendlela. Anginqabi ukuba iNgonyama iganwe kodwa isizwe nosiko kanye nendlunkulu kufika kuqala, ngikholwa ngukuthi kumele kuvikelwe,” kuchaza uKaMayisela.Ummeli kaNdlunkulu uKaMayisela, uMnuz Melusi Xulu weDonda Attorneys, ukuqinisekisile ukufakwa kwamaphepha."Uma ushade umshado omhlophe awukwazi ukuthatha isithembu.”IMbube ihlela umshado nje, ivele isifake isehlukaniso nomunye wondlunkulu baso.UXulu uthe isicelo sokwehlukaniswa esisanda kufakwa yiMbube, asiyigunyazi ukuthi ithathe omunye undlunkulu, wathi kufanele ilinde kuze kuphothulwe isicelo sokwehlukanisa."Awukwazi ukuthi uyehlukanisa ngapha, ziyawushaya ngapha.”Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kokhulumela iSilo, uMntwana uSimphiwe Zulu waKwaMinyamanzi, ayizange iphumelele ngoba zombili izingcingo zakhe bezingangeni.Kanjalo nemizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kwabameli beSilo, abeCavanagh and Richards Attorneys, ayizange iphumelele ngoba izingcingo zabo bezikhala zingabanjwa.ISILO uMisuzulu kaZwelithini noNdlunkulu omisa umshado weMbube uNtokozo Mayisela Zulu Isithombe: Bongani Mbatha /African News Agency (ANA)
KUTHOKOZE abaningi ngemiphumela ka-matric yezikole ezizimele njengoba isikhishiwe.Imiphumela ka-2024 ingu-98.47%, nokuyizinga eliphezulu kakhulu eminyakeni emihlanu kulezi zikole. Bangu-16 304 ababhale izivivinyo zokuphela konyaka. Kunabafundi abangu-14,990 abafunda ngokugcwele kanye nabangu-1,314 abangafundi okwesikhashana, ababhale izivivinyo ezikhungweni ezingu-275 eNingizimu Afrika yonkana.IGauteng yiyona ehamba phambili (9 567), ilandelwe iKwaZulu-Natal (2 392) neWestern Cape (2 072).Bangu-128 kuphela abafundi ababhale ezikoleni ezi-3 eNyakatho yeKapa, ​​kwehle kusukela kwezingu-305 zangonyaka odlule. IFree State inabafundi abangu-188, isuka ku-178 ngonyaka odlule.Isikole esiku-Upper Highway, eThekwini, iKearsney College, sizuze izinga lokuphasa ngo-100% nokungunyaka we-12 ilandelana sithola le miphumela ngale kwalokho abafundi balesi sikole bathole u-98,5% wathola i-bachelor degree.Siyabonga Mayibongwe-Nkomo from the class of 2024, is one of many who achieved excellent results in the matric IEB examinations. He shares his best memory from his matric year pic.twitter.com/QlFHHym317— St Davids Marist Inanda (@InandaSpirit) January 13, 2025
UBONGE ukuthola ithambo likamufi umndeni wowesifazane waKwaNyanta, eHlokozi, okuthiwa ubulawe ngesihluku ngowesilisa owayengumphathi wakhe ngoKhisimusi.Isidumbu sikaNksz Ayabonga Mjilo (24), simbiwe amaphoyisa egcekeni lakubo kamsolwa, uMnuz Mfanafuthi Kunene (37) ngoJanuwari 4.Lokhu kuthiwa kwenzeke emva kokugonyuluka ngesenzo sakhe emaphoyiseni, maqede zamkhalela.UNksz Mjilo wagcina ukubonwa ephuma nomsolwa endaweni yokudlela eseMhlanga, ngoDisemba 24, kanti kubikwa ukuthi bangena emotweni eyodwa, bahamba.Emva kwalokho ubelokhu ebikwa njengomuntu odukile kwaze kwaba kutholwa isidumbu sakhe egcekeni lakubo kamsolwa.Ekhuluma enkonzweni yomngcwabo wakhe ebisekhaya ngoMgqibelo, umalume wakhe, uMnuz Mthetheleli Mjilo, uthe sebebonga khona ukuthi bakwazile ukuwathola amathambo akhe, ukuze bawafihle ngendlela enesizotha.INDODAKAZI kamufi, uNksz Ayabonga Mjilo, iphethe isithombe sikanina enkonzweni yomngcwabo wakhe"Noma bekubuhlungu ngoba sithole ukuthi umzimba ubusuvele wonakele. Isimo nje esibuhlungu,” kusho uMjilo.Uthe ikhanda belingabonakali nhlobo ngesikhathi beyobheka isidumbu emakhazeni, wathi kube yingalesi sizathu inkonzo yomngcwabo wakhe yenziwe yaba mfishane.INKONZO yomngcwabo kaNksz Ayabonga MjiloUthe bayafisa ukuthi umthetho udlale indima yawo ngendlela efanele, kwenzeke ubulungiswa."Umsolwa uzivumele yena icala, akanikwe isigwebo esimfanele,” kusho uMjilo.UNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, obewuhambele lo mngcwabo uthe isihlava sokubulawa kwabesifazane silokhu siqhubekile nokukhathaza."Kunezingxoxo okufanele sibe nazo ezinhlakeni ezehlukene emiphakathini, ezifaka phakathi izinhlaka ezibhekelele ezokuphepha emphakathini kanjalo nasemaphoyiseni ukuze kuboniswane ngalesi sihlava,” kusho uNtuli.Uthe bahlongoza nanokusungula i-app ezosetshenziswa abesifazane kumaselula, abazoyiciphiza, ikhale emaphoyiseni uma bezizwa besengozini.Uthe kuyo le nyanga, bazoya nasezindaweni ezithathwa njengalezo okuhlasele kakhulu kuzo lesi sihlava, ukuyoxoxa nezinhlaka ezehlukene, ukuze wonke umuntu kube khona indlela angenelela ngayo ekulweni naso.Uthe ngoLwesithathu ulindele ukuthola umbiko ogcwele esiShayamthetho ngokusebenza kwe-laboratory ehlaziya ulibofuzo emacaleni obugebengu."Kufanele kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ubufakazi obusuke budingeka enkantolo buphelele ukuze kusetshenzwe ngendlela efanele amacala athinta ukuhlukunyezwa kwezingane nabesifazane ukuze kugwetshwe abasolwa,” kubeka uNtuli.Uthe ukubambezeleka kwemiphumela yolibofuzo kubuye kube nomthelela omubi kudedelwa abasolwa, wathi ukhona umhlaba osukhonjiwe ukuthi kungakhiwa kuwo i-laboratory yesifundazwe njengoba kwaziwa ukuthi okwamanje, ulibofuzo lusenziwa ePitoli.UKunene uvele okokuqala eNkantolo yeMantshi ngoMsombuluko, icala lakhe lahlehlela uFebhuwari 26, njengoba ekhethe ukusilaxaza isicelo sebheyili.

UHLABELA phambili uhulumeni owakhiwe amaqembu ehlukene kuleli kanjalo ne-ANC, mayelana nokusebenza komthetho wezikole okunemvunge ngawo, i-Basic Education Laws Amendment (Bela), noma kukhona abashaya amakhala ngawo.Lokhu kushiwo nguMengameli wezwe ne-ANC, uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa, ekhuluma emgubhweni we-ANC oba minyaka yonke wokukhipha umkhombandlela ngezinto okuzogxilwa kuzona kulowo nyaka, iJanuwary 8.Le nkulumo ayethule eKapa, ngempelasonto, uRamaphosa uthe uyazi kusekhona abashaya amakhala ngendaba yalo mthetho, wathi kudingeka kubanjiswane ngoba inhloso kahulumeni ngalo mthetho, ukuphucula imfundo ezweni."Siyaqhubeka ne-Bela noma kukhona abangahambisani nalokhu. Kanjalo neyomshwalense wezempilo i-National Health Insurance (NHI), siyaqhubeka nayo siwuhulumeni,” usho kanje.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi yasusa umsindo eye-Bela kwaze kwadingeka ukuthi uRamaphosa amise ukuqala ukusebenza kwezigatshana ezimbili, ngoba kusaxoxiswana ngazo.NgoDisemba, uyalele ukuthi uqhubeke usebenze lo mthetho, noNgqongqoshe weMfundo eyisiSekelo uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, wakuqinisekisa ukuthi uzosebenza.Bekuhlukene imibono njengoba kukhona abebethi inhloso yalo mthetho wukuphuca amandla izigungu ezilawula izikole odabeni oluthinta ulimi lokufunda nokufundisa kuleso sikole kanjalo nokunquma uma isikole sesigcwele.I-EFF ihlabe ikhwelo lokuthi uqale usebenze lo mthetho njengoba kuvulwa izikole.Leli qembu lithe inhloso ngukuthi kumele kuqedwe ngemigoqo evimba abanye abafundi ukuthi baye ezikoleni ezithile."Le migoqo ivimba olunye uhlanga ukuthi luye ezikoleni ezithile. Luhlukanisa phakathi abafundi, abanye bazibone bengcono kunabanye,” kusho okhulumela leli qembu uNksz Leigh-Ann Mathys.Uthe akumele kube nomfundi ozoxoshwa ngoba ekweleta imali yesikole.UNksz Gwarube wathi imigomo yalo mthetho izothunyelwa ezikoleni kule nyanga, wabalula ukuthi le migomo izosiza izikole kanjalo neminyango yezifundazwe ngokuthi ezinye zezigatshana zalo mthetho zisebenza kanjani.
ZIBHEKENE nengwadla ezinye zezikole zaKwaZulu-Natal ezizithengela izincwadi zokufunda kanjalo ne-stationery, njengoba zizovulwa ngezinkinga uma kungukuthi uMnyango wezeMfundo esifundazweni ugcina ungayifakanga imali.Lezi zikole eziziphathela imali, ezaziwa ngo-Section 21, kuthiwa namanje umnyango awukayifaki imali eyaziwa ngama-norms and standards ukuze zithenge izinsiza ngaphambi kokuvulwa kwezikole ngoLwesithathu.Ngakolunye uhlangothi ezikoleni ezingu-Section 20, eziphathelwa ngumnyango imali, zifikile izincwadi ne-stationery ngenxa yokuthi zithengelwa inkampani eyathola lo msebenzi, iNdabase.Isolezwe lithole nokuthi kwayona iNdabase, ayikhokhelwe kodwa ithenge izincwadi ngesikweletu yazihambisa ezikoleni.Umnyango usanda kukhipha isitatimende uveza ukuthi u-76% we-stationery, wahanjiswa ezikoleni sekusele inkeshezana eqale ukuyiswa ezikoleni namhlanje, kanti-u-99% wezincwadi wahanjiswa nyakenye.Izinyunyana zothisha i-Sadtu ne-Natu zithe kungase kuvulwe ngezinkinga ngenxa yokuthi imali yezikole ayifakiwe ukuze zikwazi ukuthenga izincwadi.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi ngaphambi kokubhalwa kwezivivinyo zamabanga aphakathi, i-Sadtu yavalela izikhulu zomnyango ifuna kufakwe le mali ukuze izikole zibhalise abafundi izivivinyo.Umnyango wagcina uyifakile imali yezikole kodwa nakhona emuva komzukuzuku.UNobhala we-Sadtu KwaZulu-Natal uNksz Nomarashiya Caluza, uthe ziningi izikole ezingakhokheliwe ezingakwazanga ukuzithengela izincwadi ne-stationery.Uthe akaboni ukuthi kuzofundwa kulezi zikole uma kuvulwa izikole imali yama-norms and standards ingakhokhiwe."Siyi-Sadtu asizikhulumeli izinkampani ezenza imisebenzi nomnyango, kodwa singasho ukuthi inkampani esabalalisa izincwadi ezikoleni kwayona ayikhokheliwe. Lokhu kuqinisekiswe ngumnyango emhlanganweni ngoba uthi awunayo imali yokukhokha. Umnyango ukuvezile ukuthi unxuse owenza nabo imisebenzi ukuthi baqhubeke benze izinto noma bekweletwa ngumnyango.”Uthe umnyango kumele uyibeke phambili eyokuhlinzeka izikole ngemali.I-Natu esitatimendini ikhale esifanayo ngokuthi kuzoba nzima ukufundisa ezikoleni ezingayitholile imali nokuthi zisebenze ngaphandle kwezinsiza kufundisa, okuyizincwadi ne-stationery.Ithe zonke izikole ezizithengela izincwadi aziyitholanga imali yazo yathi lokhu kwenze zangakwazi ukuthenga izincwadi."Lokhu kusho ukuthi abafundi basezikoleni ezevile ku-1 200 esifundazweni ngeke babe nezincwadi uma sekuvulwa izikole. Kuyihlazo ukuthi lo nyaka uzoqala ngezinkinga. Sinxusa umnyango ukuthi ufake imali ezikoleni ngokushesha ukuze lezi zikole zizithengele izincwadi,” kusho iNatu.Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula komnyango izolo ayiphumelelanga njengoba kuze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela engaphendulile uMnuz Muzi Mahlambi okhulumela umnyango.Inkinga yemali emnyangweni ayiyintsha njengoba cishe zinyanga zonke ukhala esifanayo.

ENYE yezindaba ezibe egudwini kuleli sonto ngeyokuchithwa kwesicelo ebesifakwe yi-Information Regulator (IR) enkantolo, sokuthi imiphumela yabafundi baka-matric bangonyaka odlule ingashicilelwa, okugcine kungaphumelelanga.I-IR ibikhala ngokuthi ukushicilelwa kwemiphumela yabafundi kuphambene nelungele labo lokungavezwa kwezinto ezithinta bona ngaphandle kwemvume yabo. Ithi okungcono wukuthi kube wumfundi ovumile nohambisana nalokho okuzoshicilelwa imiphumela yakhe emaphephandabeni ezweni.Omunye wabafundi ba-matric abalinde imiphumela yabo, u-Azande Nkwanyana (18) obefunda eKing Bhekuzulu High, KwaNongoma, enyakatho yeKwaZulu-Natal, uthe ngokwakhe ayikho inkinga ngokushicilelwa kwemiphumela yabo ngoba kufakwa ama-exam number, hhayi amagama nezibongo zabo."Into edala inkinga wukuthi abazali bethu bayathanda ukukhuluma, bachome ngathi emphakathini, okwenza ukuthi uma izinto zingasahambi kahle, ingcindezi enkulu ihlale kithina. Nokho ngithemba ukuthi sizophasa kahle ngoba sizikhandle kakhulu kusukela unyaka uqala,” kusho u-Azande ofake isicelo sokuyofunda izifundo zomthetho nezobuthisela nonyaka.USinenhlanhla Ntshangase (23) obefunda u-matric eKhathi High, eMthwalume, ukhale ngokuthi ukuphuma kwemiphumela yabo emaphephandabeni kwenza babe nengcindezi enkulu, ikakhulu ngoba ngisho ungayifihla inombolo yakho kodwa ihlale izoba khona indlela eyenza kube khona abayaziyo, nabayibonayo."Singabafundi nje sisodwa siyazana izinombolo zethu ngoba uma sihleli emagunjini okuhlolwa, uyakwazi ukubona inombolo yomfundi ophambi kwakho nosemva kwakho. Kanti abanye bakusebenzisa kabi labo, benze inhlekisa ngabanye abafundi okusuke kungabahambelanga kahle. Kungangcono ukuthi kwenziwe uhlelo lokuthi wonke umfundi ayithole (imiphumela) ngokwakhe ocingweni lwakhe,” kusho uSinenhlanhla ofake isicelo sokwenza i-Public Management eMUT, eMlaza.UNondumiso Dlamini (19) obenza u-matric eMpoqabulungu Senior Secondary, eMandeni, uthe kuyena uqobo nje akwenzi mehluko ukushicilelwa nokungashicilelwa kwemiphumela yabo, nokho uyayiqonda ingcindezi okungenza ibhekana nozakwabo."Nokho ukube kuya ngami, ngingathi ayingabe isashicilelwa emaphephandabeni ngoba akuyena wonke umuntu okwazi ukubhekana nengcindezi yalokho, ikakhulu uma kungenzeka kubhimbe uhlelo,” kusho uNondumiso ofake isicelo sokwenza izifundo ze-Radiography eNyuvesi iFree State nonyaka.NgoMsombuluko uNgqongqoshe weMfundo eyiSisekelo, uNksz Sindi Gwarube, uzomemezela imiphumela ka-matric ngokokuthi izifunda nezifundazwe kwenze kanjani, bese ngoLwesibili ekuseni imiphumela itholakale emaphephandabeni ehlukene.
