KUZOBA nokukhala nokugedla kwamazinyo kwabazokhala ngaphansi bangazitholi izikhala zokufunda kulo nyaka emanyuvesi aKwaZulu-Natal, njengoba zimbalwa izikhala.Zibalelwa ku-20 000 izikhala ezikhona zabazokwenza unyaka wokuqala ekubeni zingu-500 000 izicelo ezitholwe amanyuvesi.Kuyaziwa ukuthi abafuna izikhala zeziqu ezehlukene bafaka izicelo ezikhungweni ezehlukene.ENyuvesi yaKwaZulu-Natal kunezikhala ezingu-8 600 kuphela zabazokwenza unyaka wokuqala.Okhulumela inyuvesi uNksz Normah Zondo, uthe bathola izicelo ezingu-290 600, ekubeni benezikhala ezingu-8 600.Uthe iziqu ezinezicelo eziningi i-Bachelor of Education, Bachelor of Nursing, ne-Bachelor of Social Science."Kubhaliswa online nakulo nyaka. Kanjalo nohlelo kulabo abashintsha umqondo ngeziqu asebezozenza, kuzokwenziwa ngohlelo lwe-online,” kusho uNksz Zondo.Uveze ukuthi labo abazokwamukelwa ukufunda kule nyuvesi, bazobahlinzeka nge-data ukuze basizakale uma sebebhalisa."Nalabo ababuyayo bazonikezwa i-data. Akekho ozovunyelwa ukuthi aye enyuvesi engabhalisile futhi abamukelwa abazofika bezofuna izikhala.”Unxuse abafuna izikhala ukuthi baqaphele amaqola abathembisa izikhala ukuze bawakhokhele."Izikhala azidayisi e-UKZN. Sinxusa umphakathi ukuthi uqaphele abazama ukubaqola, bababike emaphoyiseni. Inyuvesi izobathathela izinyathelo abazosebenzisa igama, i-logo yenyuvesi ukuqola abantu,” kusho uNksz Zondo.Unxuse umphakathi ukuthi uthembe okufakwe yinyuvesi kwi-website yase-UKZN ethi:www.ukzn.ac.za, nasezinkundleni zokuxhumana.Ukufunda kule nyuvesi kulindeleke ukuthi kuqale ngenyanga ezayo.E-Durban University of Technology (DUT), zingu-211 087 izicelo ezafakwa ekubeni izikhala zabazokwamukelwa abazokwenza unyaka wokuqala zingu-9 454.Iziqu ezithandwa kakhulu yi-Nursing, Bachelor of Education kwi-Senior Phase & Further Education and Training Teaching: Languages, i-Diploma in Hospitality Management, Bachelor of Journalism, Diploma in Tourism Management, Diploma Management Sciences: Business Law nezinye. IMangosuthu University of Technology (MUT), ithole izicelo ezingu-103 483 zabazokwenza unyaka wokuqala ekubeni kunezikhala ezingu-3 223.Sekusele izikhala ezingu-1 599 kuphela. UNKk Zama Sishi, ibamba elibhekele ukuxhumana nezokumaketha e-MUT, uthe iziqu ezande kulabo abafake izicelo yi-Diploma in Information Technology (ECP).Uthe ababamukeli abazozifikela mathupha bezofuna izikhala zokufunda.Siye koshicilela iNyuvesi yaseZululand, ingaphendulanga.
UBHUNTSHE ngomzuzu wokugcina umbhikisho obuzokwenziwa ngokuthula ngamabutho kaZulu ngoLwesihlanu, ngaphandle kwamaHhovisi eNgonyama Trust, eMgungundlovu.Isolezwe Ngempelasonto lithole ukuthi ukuhoxiswa kwemashi ebizoholwa nguMntwana waKwaMinyamanzi, uVanana, kubangelwe wumyalelo yeNhloko yesikhwama, u-Advocate Vela Mngwengwe. Kuthiwa utshele abasebenzi abangaphansi kwakhe ukuba bangalubhadi emsebenzini ngenxa yokusabela ukuphepha kwabo.UMngwengwe uthumelele abasebenzi bakhe imiyalelo ngoba ekhala ngokuthi abaziswanga ngendlela ngalo mbhikisho. Kuthiwa amahhovisi azoze avulwe ngoMsombuluko, okuphoqe amabutho ukuba ahoshe imfe ngoba abezofika kukhala ibhungane.Okubangele ukuba amabutho amashele kula mahhovisi ukunengwa wukuphikiswa kwesinqumo sesiSilo sokuhoxisa amalungu ebhodi ngoba uNgqongqoshe woMnyango wokuThuthukiswa kweziNdawo zasemaKhaya, uMnuz Mzwanele Nyhontsho, ashaya phansi ngonyawo. Amabutho awaneme ngokuphikiswa koMlomo Ongathethimanga.Kuze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela kungatholakalanga ukuthi omunye umbhikisho uzobuye ube nini noma sewuhoxiswe unomphela.
BESE zimbili izincwadi zesivimbelo ezenzelwe umzukulu ogcine enquma uninakhulu, wamqoba, washisa izinsalela zesidumbu sakhe eNsuze, eKranskop.Umufi, uNkk Fikile Mkhize (72) kusolakala ukuthi umsolwa (29) umbulale kuzosa kube uLwesibili olwedlule, ngoba indodakazi yakhe imgcine ngoMsombuluko odlule ntambama.Ngokusho kwendodakazi kamufi, uNkk Delisile Fulela baqale ukuqaphela ngawo uDisemba 31 ukuthi kukhona okushaya amanzi."Kwakumele afike kodwa kwangenzeka. Ntambama ngathumela izingane ukuthi ziyombheka, zangamthola. NgoJanuwari 1, ngithumele umyeni wami ukuthi ayobheka naye, wabuya elandula, ethi akekho,” kusho uNkk Fulela, othe umyeni umtshele ukuthi uqaphele ukuthi umbhede ubungandluliwe.Uthe ngoJanuwari 2 unikele khona mathupha, wafica umbhede ungakandlulwa."Ngimbuzile umsolwa ukuthi uphi umama, waqale waqamba amanga wathi akamazi, ubezitshela ukuthi ukwami,” kusho uNkk Fulela.Uthe uvele waphuma wayohlaba umkhosi komakhelwane, abambheke yonke indawo umufi.Uthe baphinde babuya bezocingisana ekhaya, nokuyilapho bebone khona amachaphazelo egazi echosheni lombhede kamufi naphansi."Endlini edilikile, engasasebenzi, sizithele phezu kwenqwaba yamathambo angagcwala isaka lempuphu eliwu-25kg. Abesolisa, nomlotha wakhona ubungajwayelekile,” kusho uNkk Fulela.Uthe ngeleso sikhathi umphakathi ubusumvimbezele, kulindwe amaphoyisa.Kuthe ebuzwa amaphoyisa ngamathambo, wathi awengulube."Ziyime emthumeni amaphoyisa esethi akaveze ibhodwe abeyipheka ngalo. Ugcine evuma kuwona ukuthi umbulele,” kusho uNkk Fulela.Echaza ngezincwadi zesivimbelo, uthe zombili ezanyakenye."Eyokuqala, kwaqala kwaba sengathi uyayihlonipha kodwa kwathi sekuwusuku lwasenkantolo - wangafika, kwakhishwa eyesibili. Yingemva kwayo ke lapho evele wamkhiphela khona ummese, wathi uzomnquma,” kusho uNkk Fulela.Uthe yilapho evele wamthatha khona unina ukuthi azohlala naye lapho eganele khona."UKhisimusi nje uwudle kwami umama. Kodwa emva kwawo uqale wezwakalisa ukuthi akathandi ukuthi owakhe umuzi usewushiyile,” kusho uNkk Fulela.Uthe bagcine bevumelana ngokuthi ekhaya uzoya eseyolala ngoba sikhona esinye isihlobo esisuke sesibuyile emsebenzini ebusuku."Ngosuku lwesigameko, isihlobo besiziyele kubangani njengoba bekuyisikhathi sobumnandi, ulithole lapho ithuba lokubulala umama,” kusho uNkk Fulela.Uthe umsolwa uzalwa udadewabo, kodwa ukhuliswe wuye emva kokushonelwa unina emncane.Uveze ukuthi ubebhema insangu.
UNDLUNKULU weSilo, uNtokozo Mayisela Zulu, ufake isicelo sokuvimba umshado weSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini noNdlunkulu uNomzamo Myeni.UNdlunkulu uKaMayisela ufake isicelo esiphuthumayo eNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu, lapho efuna khona ukuthi kuvinjwe umshado weSilo ozokuba sekupheleni kwenyanga.UNdlunkulu uKaMayisela ufuna ukuthi isicelo sakhe silalelwe ngoJanuwari 20, 2025.Emaphepheni abonwe yiSolezwe Ngempelasonto, uNdlunkulu uKaMayisela uthe iMbube ayinalo ilungelo lokuthatha omunye undlunkulu ngoba yashada umshado omhlophe naye.UNdlunkulu uKaMayisela uthe njengoba beshade umshado omhlophe umthetho kawuvumi ukuthi omunye wabo aphinde ashade omunye umuntu.Ummeli kaNdlunkulu uKaMayisela, uMnuz Melusi Xulu weDonda Attorneys, ukuqinisekisile ukufakwa kwesicelo.UNdlunkulu uKaMayisela neMbube bashada umshado omhlophe, ngo-2021, eNquthu.IMbube ihlele ukugcagcelwa uNdlunkulu uMaMyeni, ekupheleni kwale nyanga.Umgcagco uzoba ngoJanuwari 26, kuzoqala umkhehlo ngoJanuwari 24.
KUKHULU ukuqagela ngekusasa lobekhulumela i-EFF, uDkt Mbuyiseni Ndlozi, oshiye ekubeni yilungu lePhalamende elimele le nhlangano.Umthombo obuphambili emkhankasweni wokuba uNdlozi aqokelwe kwesephini lomholi we-EFF, uthe akusensuku zatshwala uNdlozi ashiye kule nhlangano.Umthombo uthe maningi amathuba okuthi uNdlozi uzojoyina inhlangano elwela amalungelo abantu.Izindaba zokushiya kukaNdlozi ePhalamende zimenyezelwe izolo yi-EFF.UNdlozi usule kanye nelinye ilungu lePhalamende, uMnuz Yazini Tetyana.Okhulumela i-EFF, uNksz Leigh Ann-Mathys, uthe uNdlozi benoTetyana babhalele uNobhala Jikelele weqembu, uMnuz Marshall Dlamini, becela ukushiya njengamalungu ePhalamende."Iqembu lizamukele izicelo zabo zokuba sibakhulule ezikhundleni abebejutshwe kuzo. Ezincwadini zabo babonge iqembu ngokubanikeza ithuba lokuthi balimele. Basebenze ngokuzikhandla ngesikhathi bejutshwe ezikhundleni. Sibafisela inhlanhla.”Ukwesula kukaNdlozi akuzange kumangaze ngoba wayizwa ngendaba ingqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi beqembu ebingenyanga edlule.Kunemibiko yokuthi uNdlozi wayeyalelwe ukuba angalubhadi kule ngqungquthela, akazange aqokwe ngesikhathi sekukhethwa amalungu esigungu esiphezulu.Ngaphambi kwengqungquthela kwakukade kunamalungu e-EFF ayeqhuba umkhankaso wokuthi uNdlozi aqokelwe kwesephini lomholi wenhlangano kepha lowo mkhankaso wabuye waphelela emoyeni ngemva kokuvela kwamahlebezi okuthi uNdlozi umisiwe eqenjini.UNdlozi uqale ukuba nyamanambana eqenjini ngemva kokuhlubuka kowayeyiphini lomholi kwi-EFF, uMnuz Floyd Shivambu, osenguNobhala Jikelele we-MK.Kunezinsolo zokuthi uNdlozi ungomunye walabo abazi kuqala ukuthi uShivambu uyashiya kwi-EFF, kuthiwa iphutha lakhe kwaba ukungamtsheli umholi weqembu uMnuz Julius Malema, ngale ndaba.UMalema usekusho kaningi ukuthi ngeke aphinde abathembe abangazange bamazise ngezinhloso zikaShivambu zokulaxaza iqembu.Umthombo owawuyingxenye yomkhankaso wokuthi uNdlozi angene esikhundleni esashiwa nguShivambu, uthe uNdlozi uzoshiya noma nini."Akakaphumeli obala ngokuthi uzoya kuphi kodwa kukhona ukukhuluma okuthi angase aye enhlanganweni elwela amalungelo abantu. Ayisekho into asayihlalele kwi-EFF.”UNdlozi waqala ukuba yilungu lePhalamende ngo-2014.Umthombo uthe i-EFF ilahlekelwe kakhulu."Ubenza umsebenzi omuhle ePhalamende naseqenjini. Ubethandwa kakhulu ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme. Ngesikhathi ejutshwe KwaZulu-Natal, i-EFF yakhombisa ukukhula.”
UMBUSO uveze ukuthi usunabo ubufakazi be-vidiyo ekhombisa omunye wabasolwa abahlanu ecaleni lokubulawa komrepha u-AKA, obumveza elandela umculi efika esikhumulweni sezindiza iKing Shaka International Airport, ngosuku abulawa ngalo.Lokhu kuhlaluke ngoLwesine eNkantolo yeMantshi eThekwini, ngenkathi kuvele oMnuz Muziwethemba Gwabeni, noMnuz Lindokuhle Ndimande, abangabasolwa ababili kwabahlanu abasolwa ngokubulawa kuka-AKA nomngani wakhe owayengumpheki nosomabhizinisi uTebello "Tibz” Motsoane. Bebevele ngaphambi kwenkantolo ukuzofaka kabusha isicelo sokudedelwa ngebheyili.Umshushisi wombuso u-Adv Elvis Gcweka, uthe sebuhlangene ubufakazi obugcwele nobuveza ngokuphelele uGwabeni eba ezinyathelweni zika-AKA, kusukela efika esikhumulweni sezindiza ngezithupha zabo-3 ntambama."I-vidiyo yobufakazi bethu imveza ngendlela ecacile umsolwa elandela umufi ibangana elincane kusukela efikela kubangani bakhe abase bemlindile esikhumulweni sezindiza. Uyabonakala ebalandale kancane, baze bafike lapho ababezothatha khona imoto ababeyiqashele ukuhamba ngayo. Ubalandela njalo ngezinyawo, aze ayogibela imoto yohlobo iBMW, ede ekhuluma nocingo, exhumana nomunye wabasolwa kuleli cala uLindani Ndimande, kuze kube umufi nabangani bakhe bafika ehhotela ababebhukhe ukuzolala kulona eliseMhlanga, eThekwini,” kulanda umshushisi uGcweka.OGwabeni, noNdimande bavela phambi kwenkantolo nje, yingoba bebezoveza izethulo zokwenza bakholwe wukuthi bafanelwe wukunikezwa ibheyili ukuze balungise abakubize ngezinkinga ezisale zabhekana nemindeni yabo selokhu baboshwa.UMNUZ Muziwethemba Gwabeni, noLindokuhle Ndimande, abangabanye babasolwa ngokufa kuka-AKA nomngani wakhe uTips Isithombe: SIMANGALISO NTSHANGASEUmmeli wabasolwa u-Adv Cryil Mlotshwa, utshele imantshi ukuthi okwenza uGwabeni acele ibheyili kabusha wukuthi abashushisi baveze ukuthi ukuphenywa kwabo sekuphelile, ngakho ubona ingekho indlela angaphazamisa ngayo uphenyo."Okunye okuyinkinga yakhe wukuthi ukweleta u-R100 000 esikoleni okufunda kusona enye yezingane zakhe, nokuthi enye ingane yakhe nonkosikazi wakhe belulekwa ngokomqondo, okudinga ukuthi abe seduze nabo ukubezeka. Konke okudinga imali akakwazi ukukwenza ngenxa yokuthi uvalaleleke esitokisini, okwenza angakwazi ukuqhuba ibhizinisi lakhe lemayini."NakuNdimande kunzima ngokuthi itekisi lakhe eliwusizo emndenini wakhe libe sengozini, akakwazi ukulilungisa ukuze liqhubeke lisebenze, libeke esinkwa etafuleni emndenini. Umndeni wakhe uyasokola ezimalini njengoba engekho, okwenza isimo sibe muncu ekhaya ngoba ubhekelele nezidingo nezindleko zamakhosikazi kayise ongasekho,” kuchaza uMlotshwa.Umshushisi omkhulu u-Adv Lawrence Gcaba, uthe izethulo zommeli wabasolwa kazanele ukuthi zingenza ukuthi banikwe ibheyili nokuthi uma bededelwa ngebheyili ngeke bebe nesiqiniseko sokuthi ngeke baphazamise ukuqhubeka kwecala.Imantshi uVincent Hlatshwayo ithe ubufakazi nezethulo okubekwe phambi kwayo kuningi kakhulu, ngakho kuzodinga ukuthi iyokufunda futhi ikucwaningwe ngaphambi kokuthi kuphume isinqumo, yaphetha ngokuthi isinqumo sayo izosigodlela uLwesithathu oluzayo.

UCHAZWE njengomuntu owalinganisa amaholo othisha kuleli, uSolwazi Sibusiso Bengu, njengoba othisha abamhlophe besilisa babehola kakhulu ukudlula bonke abezinye izinhlanga.Lokhu kushiwo yiPhini likaNgqongqoshe lezeMfundo eyisiSekelo, uDkt Reginah Mhaule, oveze ukuthi uBengu owaba ngungqongqoshe wokuqala omnyama eMnyangweni wezeMfundo ngaphansi kukahulumeni wentando yeningi, nguyena owakha yonke imithetho ekhona manje kwezemfundo.UDkt Mhaule uthe ngesikhathi uBengu ethatha izintambo kulo mnyango, iminyango yezemfundo yayihlukene kawu-19.Uveze ukuthi kukhona owawumele abelungu, amaNdiya, amaKhaladi, kukhona owozimele geqe, okwakufaka nowaKwaZulu."Nemiholo yothisha yayingafani. Abesilisa abamhlophe babehola kakhulu, kulandele abesifazane abamhlophe. Abesilisa bamaKhaladi babehola eyabo imali, kulandele abesifazane bamaKhaladi. Abesilisa bamaNdiya nabo babehola eyabo imali, kulandele eyabesifazane bamaNdiya. "Abesilisa abamnyama babehola kakhulu kunabesifazane abamnyama. Thina besifazane abamnyama sasihola imali encane kakhulu kunabo bonke othisha. Sayilwa noBengu le nto, samtshela ukuthi sifuna amaholo alinganiswe. Wakwenza lokho, kothisha abasha abase belandela, noma kuthiwa abaluphi uhlanga base behola imali efanayo njengoba namanje kusenzeka,” kusho uDkt Mhaule.Ukusho lokhu izolo ekhuluma enkonzweni yesikhumbuzo kaBengu, ebiseShowe.UBengu ufihlwa namhlanje enkonzweni yomngcwabo ezoba seNyuvesi yaseZululand.Uhlonishwe nguMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, ngesigaba sesibili somngcwabo kahulumeni.UDkt Mhaule uncome amagalelo kaBengu, wathi umthetho wezikole wasungulwa nguyena."Ngifuna ukumazisa njengoba eselele namhlanje, ukuthi siyiphothulile eyezinguquko kwezemfundo ngezichibiyelo emthethweni okunomsindo ngawo kwezemfundo i-BELA. Kukhona abathi sifuna ukuqeda ngomthetho i-South African Schools Act, okungelona iqiniso kodwa sengeza kuwona. "UBengu wavala induku, kodwa kwangashiwo ukuthi oqhubekayo nokuyisebenzisa uzothola siphi isigwebo. Manje i-BELA iyacacisa ukuthi wenziwani uma usasebenzisa induku ezikoleni. Iyaphela futhi nokuthi kuvinjwe abanye abafundi bangakwazi ukuyofunda ezikoleni ezithile ngenxa yolimi abalukhulumayo, ngokwe-BELA bazofunda noma ikuphi,” kusho uDkt Mhaule.UNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, uncome iqhaza likaBengu, nangendlela ayenza ngayo izinto.Umchaze njengomuntu owayenobuhlakani, owayehleli ebeke phambili lokho akholelwa kukhona.UDkt Sibongeni Dhlomo owafunda KwaDlangezwa High, okuyisikole esasiphethwe nguBengu, umncome ngokuthi wayehlale ebafundisa ukuthi kumele baphendule ngezenzo zabo.Owayekhulumela umengameli wezwe uMnuz Thabo Mbeki, uMnuz Bheki Khumalo, unxuse ongqongqoshe namaphini abo ukuthi bahloniphe abantu abasebenza nabo."Ngiyazinxusa lezi zikhulu ukuthi zihloniphe abantu abazisebenzelayo. Abangakhulumi noma yikanjani nabo. UBengu wayehlonipha noma ngubani.” IPhini likaMengameli wezwe, uMnuz Paul Mashatiile, nguyena okulindeleke ukuthi athule inkulumo kahulumeni emngcwabeni kaBengu.
BEBEWUHLALISE lubhojozi umphakathi waseMlaza futhi benonya abesilisa ababibili ababoshelwe icala lokudubula babulale iphoyisa okuvele ukuthi belilungiselela ukulobola ngoJanuwari.Iphoyisa, uSergeant Nkululeko Kenneth Mbambo (48), lihlaselwe labulawa ngabesilisa ebebehlomile esigamekweni esenzeka kwa-N, eMlaza, emgwaqweni uMabhunu Sabela ngoDisemba 31.Ngemuva kwalokho kube sekuboshwa u-Asanda Msomi (20) noSthembiso Gumede (22) ebebevele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMlaza izolo.Isolezwe lithole ngomthombo osondelene nomndeni ukuthi umufi ubezolobola ekupheleni kwephezulu."Okubuhlungu kakhulu ukuthi uMbambo ubulawa nje ubesemalungiselelweni okuthi alobole ekupheleni kwenyanga,'' usho kanjena.UMsomi noGumede kuvela ukuthi babulala uMbambo begqekeza emzini wakhe.Kuvela ukuthi ngalolu suku ebusuku, omunye wodadewabo bakamufi wabona isithunzi sowesilisa emnyango owayephethe isibhamu wase azisa umufi ukuthi kukhona akubonayo ngaphandle.Kuthiwa umufi wathatha isibhamu kanti ngaleso sikhathi abasolwa bazokhahlela kuqala isicabha sangemuva bangene ngaphakathi endlini base bemdubula amahlandla amaningi emzimbeni wonke. Kuthiwa uMbambo washonela khona lapho endlini.Kuhlaluka ukuthi abasolwa babaleka nomakhalekhukhwini kamufi, isibhamu sakhe kanjalo nethelevishini eyayibukwa endlini.UMshushisi uLungelo Mkhithi ucele iMantshi uLungelo Kheswa ukuba lihlehliswe icala ukuze abasolwa bacele ibheyili kanyekanye.Imantshi ikuvumile lokho yabe seyihlehlisa icala ukuthi libuyele enkantolo ngoJanuwari 15.Bafike enkantolo beboshwe izinyawo ngamakentanga. Bebebonakala bethukile kakhulu. Bebelokhu beqhwebana kukhona abakukhulumayo behleba.Umsolwa wokuqala, uMsomi, ubefake isikibha esibomvu esinezimbobo eziningi nebhulukwe elimnyama elifishane nalo ebelinezimbobo. Ubenamanxeba amaningi engalweni yangakwesobunxele. Ubelokhu eyibuka ingalo yakhe abuye ayithinte. UGumede ubefake ijakhethi emnyama nayo ebinezimbobo. Okuqaphelekile ngaye ukuthi ubethuke kakhulu, amehlo akhe ebomvu futhi egcwele izinyembezi. Bobabili bebehlezi besondelene kakhulu.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi basolwa ngokuthi bebewuhlalise lubhojozi umphakathi waseMlaza. Kuthiwa bebegqekeza ezindlini beba izimoto, amathelevishini, ama-laptop nokunye okuningi. Kubatshazwa unya kubona njengoba kuthiwa bebebashaya kanzima abantu ababaficayo ezindlini uma begqekeza.Kuvela ukuthi ngesikhathi behlasela emzini kaMbambo babebane njengoba vele beyiqembu "lemigulukudu labafana abancane abane” abaziwayo. Kuthiwa umphakathi uhlale ubabaza unya lwezingane ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-2k (okusho ukuthi zizalwe ngemuva konyaka u-2000.Laba abanye ababili kuvela ukuthi namanje basagcwele amathafa. Kuthiwa ingaphezulu kwengu-20 imizi abayihlaselile bayigqekeza ezigcemeni ezahlukene eMlaza.
LIWUKHOMBA egcekeni lakubo kayise womfundi umkhuba, uhlangothi lwakubo kanina, kulandela ukutholwa kwakhe edindilizile kubo ngeSonto.U-Esihle Mhlongo (15) waseNtshanga, ngaseHammarsdale, kuthiwa utholwe eshonile kwenye yezindlu kubo kayise eNtukusweni, KwaXimba.Ngokusho kukanina omncane, uNksz Nomvula Mhlongo, umufi ubelokhu ehleli kubo kayise, evakashile kusuka ngoNovemba, eqeda ukubhala izivivinyo zokuphela konyaka esikoleni.Uthe ngeSonto bathole ucingo ebusuku, lubazisa ukuthi umufi utholwa engasanyakazi."Sithe uma sifika sathola ukuthi utholwe umzala wakhe endlini engulawondi engakaqali ukusebenza njengoba isakhiwa. Ubethule ethe du, ibhulukwe nesikhindi sakhe sangaphansi bekwehlisiwe kwabekwa emadolweni,” kusho uNksz Mhlongo.Uthe bathole ukuthi ngezikhathi zasemini ngaphambi kokuthi kwenzeke isigameko, umufi uke wangabona ngaso linye noyise omncane, oze wamphusha, wawa kabi ekhishini."Kuthiwa ukhalile, wayobikela uyise obekhothakhothile. Uthe uma ebona ukuthi akasizakali, wedlulela kubabekazi wakhe onomuzi eduze kwakubo. Uzile wazokhuza umsindo, kwangathi uyadlula,” kubeka uNskz Mhlongo.Uthe kube sekwenzeka lesi sigameko sokutholwa kwakhe esethuli ebusuku, wathi baxakwe ukuthi ngesikhathi umndeni wakhe ufika endaweni yesigameko, uyise kamufi omncane obekhona, uvele waphela emehlweni."Sihlale eside isikhathi kulindwe imoto yasemakhazeni. Kuthe uma isifikile, isisithatha isidumbu sika-Esihle, waqhamuka, wazibuzisa ukuthi yini kwenzekani lapha ekhaya? Lo mbuzo akazange awuphendulwe muntu,” usho kanjena.Unxuse amaphoyisa ukuthi enze umsebenzi wawo ngesigameko ngoba kuningi abakusolayo ngokufa kwengane, wathi kabakholwa ukuthi izishonele, kanti nokwehliswa kwezingubo zakhe kwesingezansi, kwenza basole ukuthi udlwenguliwe.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi kuleli khaya abantu abakhona emva kokudlula emhlabeni kukaninakhulu kamufi; nguyise okuthiwa uvame ukuziphuzela futhi obuye abe nokuthikamezeka okuncane emqondweni, okumhlasele sekukudala azala umufi; kube uyise omncane okusolwa ukuthi usebenzisa izidakamizwa, kanti uhlale engena ephuma ejele ngamacala ahlukene.Omunye okhona umzala kamufi naye osafunda isikole, okunguye ozithele phezu kwesidumbu, ethi uyokhiya indlu.U-Esihle ubephasele u-Grade 11 esikoleni iRietvallei Combined.Isolezwe lithinta owomndeni kayise kamufi, uNksz Siza Mkhize, ubhoke ngolaka wathi bakhathele bona manje ukukhuluma ngalolu daba, wathi ngokomthetho abafune kukhuluma ngesigameko.Wephucwe ucingo ngomunye womndeni ogqagqamuke wathi udaba lusemaphoyiseni."Bhalani lokho enithanda ukukubhala. Akukho thina esifuna ukukusho ngoba umndeni ka-Esihle usufinyelele esiphethweni sokuthi simbulele. Bhalani lokho enikufunayo ke, nihlukane nathi phansi,” kusho leli lungu, livala ucingo.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uConstable Thenjiswa Ngcobo, uthe amaphoyisa aseMsunduzi aphenya idokodo lokufa komuntu. "Lokhu kuze emva kokutholwa kwesidumbu sentombazane (15) sinezibazi ezibonakalayo ngeSonto," kusho uConst Ngcobo.
SIKHONJWE indlela isikhulu soMnyango wezemiSebenzi yoMphakathi KwaZulu-Natal esithinteka enkohlakalweni yezigidi zamarandi.Umnyango uxoshe umqondisi wophiko olukhipha amathenda othinteka enkohlakalweni ka-R1.1 billion.Lesi sinqumo simenyezelwe izolo uMphathiswa wezemiSebenzi yoMphakathi, uMnuz Martin Meyer.Lesi sikhulu umnyango ongazange usigagule ngegama, sisolwa ngokuba nesandla ekunikezweni kwenkampani eyodwa inqwaba yamathenda emnyangweni.Inkampani ethintekayo kuthiwa yanikezwa amathenda angu-29 eminyakeni emibili eyedlule.Amathenda anikezwa le nkampani kuthiwa angu-60% wesabelomali somnyango.UMeyer uthe lokhu kusho ukuthi inkampani ethintekayo ibizitamuzela nje amathenda emnyangweni.Isipheshethwa besikade silokhu sihamba uhlelo lokuqondiswa ubugwegwe, samiswa emsebenzini ngonyaka odlule.UMeyer uthe eminye yemisebenzi ebalulekile obekufanele yenziwe yilesi sipheshethwa bekuwukuqikelela ukuthi awukho ugcobho uma umnyango unikeza izinkampani amathenda."Kepha ngoSepthemba kwavela okuningi okuphambene nomthetho obekwenziwa yilesi sikhulu ikakhulukazi okuthinta inkampani eyodwa. Kwavela ukuthi le nkampani ibibuye ilethe amaphepha angaphelele uma ifaka isicelo somsebenzi. Kwesinye isikhathi impahla eyayilethwa yile nkampani yayingafani neleyo eyayisuke ikhokhelwe umnyango.”Umphathiswa uthe lesi sikhulu siphinde salahlwa nayicala lokwehluleka ukwenza uhlu lwawo wonke amaselula umnyango owathengela abasebenzi.UMeyer uthe ngenxa yokungabi khona kohlu umnyango ugcine usuzithola ukhokhela amaselula angu-57 abantu abangasasebenzeli umnyango."Uphinde walahlwa nayicala lokuzinikeza amaselula amane. Umnyango ubulahlekelwa u-R192 000 njalo ngenyanga ngenxa yalokhu.”UMeyer uthe bayakwamukela ukuxoshwa kwesikhulu."Okusijabulisa kakhulu ukuthi lusheshile uhlelo lokuqondisa ubugwegwe. Lolu hlelo ludonse izinyanga ezimbili kuphela, nokusho ukuthi sisheshe safika esiphethweni. Okunye futhi kulandelwe yonke imigomo. Isikhulu esithintekayo sinikeziwe ithuba lokuthi siziphendulele, sakhetha ukungazikhaleli ngesikhathi sekuthathwa isinqumo.”Ziningi ezinye izikhulu zalo mnyango ezibhekene nohlelo lokuqondiswa ubugwegwe.Emva kokungena kukaMeyer esikhundleni ngonyaka owedlule, kunenqwaba yezikhulu zomnyango ezamiswa emsebenzini.
UKUGQEKEZWA nokungaphephi kwezinye zezikole KwaZulu-Natal, kwenze ukuthi ezinye zezinsiza zokufunda nokufundisa zingathunyelwa ekupheleni konyaka odlule.Lezi zinsiza okuyi-stationery, zizothunyelwa ezikoleni uma sekuvulwa ngesonto elizayo, ukuze ziphephe.Lokhu kudalulwe nguMphathiswa wezeMfundo e-KZN uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka, njengoba kuvulwa izikole ngoLwesithathu oluzayo.UHlomuka uthe ingxenye eningi yezinsiza zokufunda okuyizincwadi ne-stationery, kwathunyelwa ezikoleni ngaphambi kokuthi zivalwe ngonyaka odlule.Uthe kwathunyelwa u-99% wezincwadi ezikoleni wathi kwi-stationery, kwahamba u-76%."Ezinye zezikole zibhekene nezingqinamba zokuthi aziqinile ezokuphepha kuzona, okwenze aasangakwazi ukuzihambisa. Izinsiza zalezi zikole zizohanjiswa kuze kushaye uLwesihlanu oluzayo,” kuchaza uHlomuka.Nyakenye izikhulu zomnyango zihambele esikhungweni okugcinwa kusona izincwadi eManzimtoti, ukuyobheka ukuthi uhlelo lokuthunyelwa kwazo luhamba kanjani.UHlomuka uthe basebenzisana nezinhlaka zezokuphepha, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izikole ziphephile ngamaholidi.Sikhulu isililo njalo uma kuzovulwa izikole kuleli ngoba ezinye zisuke zigqekeziwe, kwathathwa impahla ehlukene.Owayengungqongqoshe womnyango kuzwelonke uNkk Angie Motshekga, wayehlala ekhala njalo ngokuthi kuba nezinselelo njalo ngamaholidi futhi basuke behlalele ovalweni lokuthi zizogqekezwa.Kwezinye izikole kuthathwa nokudla okuphekelwa abafundi, igesi okuphekelwa ngayo abafundi kanjalo namabhodwe.Odabeni oluthinta imali yezikole eyaziwa ngama-Norms and Standards, uHlomuka uthe bamatasa nodaba ukuze izikole zithole izimfanelo zazo.Uthe bafuna ukufunda kuqale ngosuku lokuqala kuvulwe izikole."Asifuni kube nabazosalela emuva yingakho simatasa nodaba lwemali yezikole. Imfundo yezingane yiyona esiyibeke phambili.” Usho lokhu nje, kusuke umsindo ngasekupheleni konyaka odlule, i-Sadtu yavalela izikhulu zomnyango emahhovisi ifuna kukhokhwe le mali yezikole.I-Sadtu yayikhala ngokuthi umnyango awuyifaki ngesikhathi esifanele imali yezikole.Okwakukhalisa inyunyana wukuthi imali izikole ziyisebenzisela ukwenza izinto ezehlukene, okubalwa nokubhalisa izivivinyo zamanye amabanga.Umnyango kwadingeka ukuthi ugobe uphondo uthembise ukuthi uzoyifaka imali izikole zingakavalwa.I-Sadtu ayiphazamisanga kuphela ukubhalwa kwezivivinyo zika-matric, kodwa ezamaphakathi nonyaka zaphazamiseka kwezinye izikole ngenxa yemibhikisho yenyunyana.
NAKUBA kunongabazane kwezomnotho emhlabeni ngenxa yemithetho engase ishaywe nguMengameli wase-USA, uMnuz Donald Trump, kodwa osomnotho bagcwele ithemba lokuthi izokwehla ngo-25 basis point imalimboleko kule nyanga.Isikhulu esiphezulu se-Debt Rescue SA, uMnuz Neil Roets, sithe nokho ukukhathazeka kumele kube khona ngokuthi kungabe indlela uTrump azophatha ngayo izoba nomthelela onjani futhi ongakanani ngesinqumo esizothathwa ngenzalo yemalimboleko."Nakuba iBhange loMbuso lithatha izinqumo zalo ngokubheka izimo zomnotho wezwe, kepha izinto ezenzeka kwamanye amazwe omhlaba nazo ziba nomthelela kulokhu,” usho kanje.Uqhube wathi izimiso zikaTrump zokuthi kuhwetshelwane kanjani namazwe omhlaba kungenzeka zithikameze indlela okuhwetshelwana ngayo emhlabeni, kwenze umnotho ungakhuli ngokushesha, futhi kungenza nokuthi inyuke kakhulu intengo yezinto nemikhiqizo ehlukene ezindaweni ezehlukene."Konke lokho kungaba nomthelela ezimakethe zaseNingizimu Afrika, okungenza ukuthi iBhange loMbuso licophelele kakhulu indlela elithatha ngayo izinqumo ezithinta imali. Okwamanje, ukwehla nokwenyuka kwamandla emali kusahamba kahle ezweni, futhi kusahambisana nokuhlelwe yiBhange loMbuso njengoba kuphakathi kuka-3% kuya ku-6%, okungasho ukuthi kunethuba lokuthi kuphinde kwehle imalimboleko futhi nonyaka,” usho kanje.URoets uthe i-Bloomberg Economics iqagela ukuthi kungenzeka sibone kwehla imalimboleko ngo-50 basis point ngoMashi. Nokho iBhange loMbuso likubeke kwacaca ukuthi isinqumo salo sizoncika ezintweni eziningi zokwenzeka emhlabeni jikelele, kubalwa nokusebenza kwemithetho kaTrump.Isikhulu sophiko lokutshalwa kwemali e-Anchor Capital, uMnuz Nolan Wapenaar, sithe babheke ukuthi imalimboleko yehle kathathu ngo-25 basis point kulo nyaka, okokuqala akuchaze ngokuthi ngokuzoguqula izinto ingakapheli le nyanga."Sicabanga ukuthi iBhange loMbuso alizukukunaka kangako okwenziwa wuTrump, nokho kubhekeke ukuthi liqaphe ngeso lokhozi okuzokwenzeka kwi-US Federal Reserve,” usho kanje.USolwazi Raymond Parsons wophiko lwezomnotho eNorth West University Business School, uthe imithetho kaTrump isidale ukuthi kungacaci ukuthi izinto zizokwenzeka kanjani ezimakethe.Usomnotho omkhulu we-Old Mutual Group uMnuz Johann Els uthe ukunqoba kukaTrump okhethweni obelungoNovemba kudale izinxushunxushu eziningi kwezomnotho."Imithetho kaTrump ingase iholele kwingcindezi yokwehla nokwenyuka kwamandla emali, okungenza ukuthi i-Federal Reserve ibe manqika ukwehlisa inzalo kakhulu,” usho kanje.
I-ACTIONSA isiveze ukuthi phezu kokuthi ongqongqoshe be-DA bengazisebenzisi izimoto eziphayiza amalambu aluhlaza, kodwa kwezikaNgqongqoshe wezoLimo uMnuz John Steenhuisen afakiwe.USteenhuisen uphinde abe wumholi we-DA ekuhulumeni wokubambisana.Kuthiwa uSteenhuisen uhamba nge-Audi Q7, BMW X5 neToyota Prado.I-Action SA ithe ephendula umbuzo wayo ePhalamende, uSteenhuisen uthe izimoto zakhe zinamalambu aluhlaza nokunye kokuxwayisa abanye abashayeli.Phambilini uSihlalo we-DA, uNkk Helen Zille waveza ukuthi akekho ungqongqoshe wabo osebenzisa amalambu aluhlaza."Yize uSteenhuisen ake azama ukuziveza njengomuntu ohamba nge-Toyota (Corolla) Cross, impendulo yakhe iveza ukuthi uhamba ngezimoto ezintofontofo ezingama-SUV akwaNokusho amathathu. "Yize lokhu kungahlukile kuSteenhuisen, lobu bukhazikhazi obunikezwa ongqongqoshe lapho izindawo zokupaka izimoto ezifana nezasePhalamende zifana negaraji elidayisa ubutsetse bezimoto kunokuba yisikhungo esigxile ekubekeni eqhulwini imisebenzi yabantu baseNingizimu Afrika,” kusho i-Action SA.Ithe ngesikhathi amaphoyisa engakwazi ukuhlinzeka iziteshi ngezimoto nokuphazamisa amandla wo okulwa nobugengu obudlangile nokushiya abantu baseNingizimu Afrika besengcupheni, iKhabhinethi ihlala ngokunethekeza futhi inonogada abakhokhelwa ngabakhokhi bentela abaphoqeleka ukuthwala kanzima.Ithe okunye okuthwalisa kanzima abakhokhi bentela yimali echithwa ngongqongqoshe ngokuya phesheya abaphelezelwa ngamaphini abo nabasebenzi abaningi.Ithe izolwa kanzima nalokhu.
ISEHLUKANISO asizange siziphazamise izinhlelo zeSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini.Ihhovisi leSilo limemezele ukuthi ziyaqhubeka izinhlelo zeMbube yize ibhekene nesehlukaniso nomunye wondlunkulu bayo.Phakathi kwezinhlelo ezimenyezelwe ihhovisi leSilo kubalwa ukugcagcelwa kweSilo kanye nemikhosi emibili ezokwenziwa kule nyanga.Okhulumela iSilo, uMntwana uSimphiwe Zulu, uveze ukuthi iNdlulamithi yamakhosi iyaqhubeka nokwenza umsebenzi wesizwe.UMntwana uSimphiwe uthe sekunamasonto amabili iMbube isemgonqweni njengoba kuqhubeka uMkhosi wokweShwama."Emasontweni amabili uqalile umkhosi esigodlweni eMashobeni. Njengamanje umkhosi uyaqhubeka, iNgonyama igonqile. Umsebenzi uhamba kahle futhi sibona ngisho nemvula noma indlela uNkulunkulu asikhumbula ngayo ukuthi umkhosi kaZulu uhamba ngendlela.”UMntwana uSimphiwe uthe ibutho lizofika ngoMgqibelo esigodlweni eMashobeni, wathi ngeSonto liyobe seliphuma liyogawula usekwane."Ngomhla ka-13 kubikwa inhlambeko, kuyothi mhla ka-14 ebusuku, kuzokusa kube umhla ka-15, lapho kugcwala khona inyanga, izinsizwa ziyokube sezibamba inkunzi njengoba sazi-ke ukuthi lolo siko luyaye lugcinwe. Ngomhla ka 16 kuyokube sekuba iladi lapho kuyobe sekuphothulwa umsebenzi.”UMntwana uSimphiwe ukhumbuze ibutho ukuthi ngosuku lokuphothulwa komkhosi ibutho livunula ngamashoba ahamba emahlombe, wathi aziphathwa izagila nodonkana."Siphatha izinduku ezimnyama. Abantu bayayazi imithi eba mnyama uma isivuthiwe.”UMntwana uSimphiwe uthe emva kwalo mkhosi kuyobe sekuqalwa amalungiselelo oMkhosi waseSandlwana.Umkhosi uzokuba ngoJanuwari 22."INgonyama ithe ayifisi ukuthi imikhosi ebalulekile kanje yenziwe ngosuku okungelona olwesigameko. Siyazi ukuthi umhla ka 22 ilona suku uZulu atholana ngalo namaNgisi. INgonyama icelile ukuthi umkhosi wenziwe ngomhla ka 22 yize uphakathi nezinsuku.”UMntwana uSimphiwe uthe iSilo sicelile ukuthi umkhosi wenziwe ngosuku olufanele.Ngeleldlule kuvele izindaba zokuthi iSilo sifake isicelo sokwehlukanisa nomunye wondlunkulu baso.Emaphepheni afakwe eNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu iNdlulamithi yamakhosi ikhale ngokuthi umshado wayo nondlunkulu ngeke usalungiseka, yaveza ukuthi sekuphele unyaka behlala ngokwehlukana.Ngalo eledlule kuphinde kwavela izindaba zokuthi iSilo sizogcagcelwa uNdlunkulu uNomzamo Myeni.UMntwana uSimphiwe umemezele ukuthi iSilo sizogcagcelwa ngoJanuwari 26, kuzoqala umkhehlo ngoJanuwari 24."Lona umsebenzi omkhulu odinga kuphelele sonke isizwe namakhosi.”
UZOMELWA u-Advocate Charles Mnisi ummangalelwa wokuqala, uMnuz Muzikawukhulelwa Sibiya, ecaleni lokubulawa kowayengunozinti we-Orlando Pirates neBafana Bafana, uSenzo Meyiwa.Lokhu kuvele, eNkantolo eNkulu yasePitoli, ngesikhathi kuhleli leli cala.Kusongwa unyaka ngoDisemba, abameli babamangalelwa bacela ukunikwa ithuba lokuthi bayodla amathambo engqondo ukuthi ngubani phakathi kwabo ozophakamisa isandla, amele uSibiya.Lokhu kwenzeka emva kokuthi uSibiya eshonelwe ummeli wakhe, u-Adv Thulani Mngomezulu, emva kokugula isikhashana.Eveza ukuthi wuye osezomela noSibiya, uMnisi uthe uceliwe ukuthi alekelele."Ngivumile. Kodwa kusekhona okusashodayo ngokwamaphepha okusafanele sikulungise. Ngikholwa ukuthi uma sibuya ngoJanuwari 20, konke okushodayo kuzobe sesikulungisile noSibiya,” kusho uMnisi.Ebuzwa yiJaji uRatha Mokgoatlheng ukuthi uyazi yini ngalokhu, uSibiya uvumile wathi uyazi nomndeni wakhe uyazi futhi uvumile.UMokgoatlheng ube esebeka umbono wokuthi, uma efuna uMnisi, angacela ukubheka amanothi kaMngomezulu, athasisele kuwona uma esehloma ngemubuzo uBrigadier Bongani Gininda okunguye osethula ubufakazi enkantolo."Ngizobuza umndeni kaMngomezulu ukuthi asekhona yini, ukuze uma ekhona, awasebenzise,” kusho uMnisi.Kulindeleke ukuthi uma liqhubeka leli cala ngoJanuwari 20, kuqhubeke u-Adv Zandile Mshololo, ngokupheka ngemibuzo uGininda.Kuzothi uma eqeda, bese kuthatha uMnisi, amphonse imibuzo esegqoke isigqoko sokumela uSibiya.
KUTHIWA ubenamadoda amabili owesifazane waseMangamazini, eFolweni, okuthiwa uqotshwe yisoka lakhe, lambulala, ezintatha zangeSonto, limsola ngokulijolela.Ngokuthola kweSolezwe, umufi uNksz Bongekile Mkhize (32) kuthiwa uhlaselwe umsolwa, uMnuz Mduduzi Masuku (32) ngesikhathi efika emzini wakhe nesoka lakhe elisha."Bebephuma kwaMax (eMlaza). Uthe evula isicabha umufi ngasohlangothini lomgibeli emotweni, wabe emhlasela ngocelemba umsolwa,” kusho umthombo.UMUFI uNksz Bongekile Mkhize Uthe isoka elisha, liphume lapho, labaleka.Umthombo uveze ukuthi indodana kamufi (12) nowesifazane omsiza endlini, baphumele emnyango bezwa umufi ekhala."Bafice kukhala ubhushu, umsolwa egenca umufi, babaleka babuyela endlini,” kusho umthombo.Udalule ukuthi okunye okuthiwa kudine umsolwa ukuthi isoka elisha likamufi belibuye limfonele limngcofe ngokuthi unenduku encane.UMUFI uNksz Bongekile Mkhize "Ubebuza ukuthi isoka likamufi elisha lazi kanjani ukuthi ubuntu bakhe buncane ngoba akakaze alikhumulele, umuntu amkhumulelayo uye (umufi),” kusho umthombo.Isolezwe lithinta umfowabo kamufi, uMnuz Phindani Mkhize, uthe bewumdeni abayazi indaba yokuthi umufi ubebhangqe amadoda. Uthe kwayona indaba kamsolwa nomufi, yena njengomfowabo (kamufi) ubengayazi, wathi bona abakutholile ngesikhathi bephuthuma endaweni yesigameko emva kokushayelwa ucingo ingane kamufi, bathole ukuthi ubekade ezihambele nabangani."Emotweni ubenabangani bakhe ababili. Umbulali ubecashe ngama-blocks abekwe egcekeni,” kusho uMkhize.Uthe ngesikhathi befika endaweni yesigameko bafice isimo esinyantisa igazi, umufi engasanyakazi."Ubenenhloso yokumbulala. Le nto uyihlele enesikhathi. Ubhushu ubewulolile. Ugence kulo lonke ikhanda. Ubevika ngezandla ngoba nazo ziphelile nezingalo. Kubuhlungu ngale ndlela,” kuzikhalela uMkhize.Uveze ukuthi bekukhona izinsongo umsolwa azenze kumufi ocingweni."Ngesikhathi zasemini, umufi ehamba, uzamile ukuthi bakhulume kodwa umbulali wathi bazoxoxa esebuya. Sibone imiyalezo ocingweni ethi uyamphuzela (utshwala) futhi umlindile,” usho kanje.Ukhale ngobudedengu kumufi, ngokungazithatheli phezulu izinsongo zikamsolwa zasemini."Ukube usitshelile singabafowabo, noma abikele amaphoyisa, besizofika, sibe baningi egcekeni, mhlawumbe ubengeke ambulale,” kubeka uMkhize.Uthe ubengenalwazi lodlame phakathi kukamufi nomsolwa kodwa bathe uma sebebheka iselula, babona ukuthi bese zikhona izigxabano, eziqinisekiswe nangabangani bakhe, wathi umufi ubewuhlobo lomuntu wesifazane ozimele, wathi umsolwa akanalo ulwazi lokuthi ubesebenza kuphi.Umsolwa, okuthiwa uzinikele emaphoyiseni ngalo usuku lwesigameko, uvelile eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMbumbulu, izolo, ngecala lokubulala.Engena ebhokisini labamangalelwa uqale waveza ukuthi akamdingi ummeli ngoba vele icala uzolivuma.Ugcine eshintsha umqondo, ngesikhathi imantshi iveza ukuthi icala abhekene nalo libucayi, lidinga awazi umthetho uma ezozimela.Lihlehlele uJanuwari 15, ukuze afake isicelo sebheyili.Ubegqoke ijini emnyama nesikibha esimpunga. Ubebukeka ezingcolele, ebusweni, engakhombisi ukudinwa noma ukudangala.
KUSINDA kuyehlela emndenini wakwaMbatha eMaqeleni, oLundi, ovuke izolo inqwaba yemfuyo yekhaya iyizigingqane ifile egcekeni. Zingaphezu kwezingu-12 izimvu ezifile, ngokusho kukaMnuz Mbhekeleni Mbatha oyinhloko yekhaya. Uthe lezi zimvu bezikhosele ngaphansi kwezindlu ngoba izulu belina, zibalekela udaka nomquba esibayeni, kwezakala ngezinja zikhonkotha ebusuku, kwasa izimvu zakhe zifile.Uthe akazi uzothatha ini ahlanganise nani njengoba yena nomndeni wakhe beziphilisa ngokudayisa yona imfuyo ukuze balale bedlile."Ngilimele kakhulu ngoba angisebenzi, sekuphele izinyanga ezinhlanu ngamiswa emsebenzini. Izingane bezifundiswa yizo lezi zimvu esikoleni. Bese ngidayise izimvu ezingu-10, manje angisazi ukuthi ngenzeni ngoba lezi zimvu yizo ebese ziphilisa umuzi wakuleli khaya. "Angazi ngizothatha ini ngihlanganise nani. Impilo imile njengoba kungekho nosebenzayo. Sithembele kuyo le mfuyo ukuthi uma ngabe kukhona okuvelayo sikwazi ukuthi izingane zikwazi ukuphila njengoba nginezingane nabazukulu abangu-12," kusho uMbatha.Uthe okudidayo wukuthi izimvu beziklinyeke emqaleni nje kuphela, kungekho lapho ezitshengise ukuthi zilunywe izinja khona."Izimvu bezilele ngomhlane ezibalelwa kwezingu-12 ezibulewe yizinja. Ngesikhathi ngihamba egcekeni ngifice eyodwa isifile, ezimbili zisaphefumula ngase ngikhangwa ezinye zilele uyaca. "Kuthiwa izinja bezikhonkotha kwase kubonakala izimvu zilele kwamakhelwane. Ebezimithi beziyisishiyagalolunye, kwaphuma amazinyane amathathu. Izinja beziziklinya bese ziziyeka kanjalo, zingazidli. Uma ngithi ngiyalandela kwazona izinja lezo angizitholi," usho kanje.Ikhansela lendawo, uMnuz Sikhumbuzo Khuzwayo, lithe lesi sigameko sibathusile bonke."Sisashaqekile, sizibuza imibuzo yokuthi ukhona kodwa umuntu ongalahlekelwa imfuyo engaka ngelanga elilodwa nangendlela esingayiqondi. "Ngokusho kukaMbatha, izimvu zibulawe yinto ethi ayifane nenja kodwa umbuzo osalayo wukuthi yini ingasalumi neyodwa, ibulale nje kuphela. Ngokubona ubucayi bodaba, ngizamile ukuthi ngixhumane nomasipala ukubazisa ngalokhu nanokuthi mhlampe yini esingayenza njengabantu abakhele indawo sihambe siyovela sibone ukuthi singalekelela kanjani njengoba lezi zimvu eziphilisa ngazo," kusho uKhuzwayo.Uthe banethemba lokuthi uma sebesihlolile isimo, bazobe sebebona ukuthi umndeni ulekeleleka kanjani. Uthe le nto iyaqala ukwenzeka khona endaweni yaseMaqeleni, ukuthi kungavele kufe imfuyo ngendlela engaqondakali kanje ngoba uma bekuyisimo sezulu esizibulele, bezingeke zife zonke, bekukhona ezizosala. Ugcizelele ukuthi nemeya yendawo uyithintile wayazisa ngawo lo mshopi.Intengo yezimvu ezifile icela ku-R50 000.CAPTIONIZIMVU zomndeni wakwaMbatha ezife ngendlela engacacile oLundi Isithombe: SITHUNYELWE
UPHUME ujabhile futhi unxapha izolo eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseNtuzuma umndeni wowesifazane waseLusaka, eNanda, okuthiwa waphahlazwa yisoka lakhe ngesitini wafa ngonyaka odlule njengoba liphinde lahlehla icala.Umufi, uNksz Mbali Mokokone (29) kuvela ukuthi wabulawa ngesihluku yisoka lakhe elingumpheki, uMnuz Zimisele Dlulisa (39) obevele enkantolo.UDlulisa ubekwe icala lokubulala nelokuhlela ukubulala. Lesi sigameko kuvela ukuthi senzeka emqashweni wabo lapho babehlala khona bobabili.Ngosuku lwesigameko kuvela ukuthi umufi wayengekho endlini uDlulisa wamyenga ngokuthi akeze bazogubha usuku lwakhe lokuzalwa.Nebala kuthiwa wafika umufi kanti bazoxabana okwaholela ekutheni uDlulisa amphahlaze ngesitini.Ngaphambilini enkantolo kwahlaluka ukuthi isidumbu sasinezinkomba zokuthi umufi uqale waklinywa.UDlulisa kuthiwa kwathi esembulele umufi waqhubeka wadla izibiliboco eduze kwesidumbu kwaba sengathi akonakale lutho.Izolo umshushisi elingatholakalanga igama lakhe utshele iMantshi uSmanga Mthethwa ukuthi kunobufakazi obusadingeka kuleli cala obungakahlangani.Ngenxa yaleso sizathu uthe ucela ukuthi icala liphinde lihlehle. Ngesikhathi ligcina leli cala ngoDisemba kwakumele enkantolo kufundwe izitatimende ezenziwa ngabantwana ababili abaneminyaka eyisithupha okuvela ukuthi babekhona endlini ngosuku lwesigameko.Owomndeni kamufi ocele ukuba ligodlwe igama lakhe uthe sebeqala ukunengeka manje yile nto yokuhlehla njalo kwecala."Awungitshele nje okwesingakhi manje leli cala kuthiwa liyahlehla namhlanje. Sesikhathele manje sifuna ukuthi kwenzeke into eyodwa kuleli cala,'' usho kanjena.Uthe sebeqala nokulilahla ithemba lokuthi bayoke babuthole ubulungiswa ngesiga esenzeka."Thina sifuna into eyodwa nje ukuthi uDlulisa alahlwe yicala. Kungagcini lapho futhi agwetshwe abhadle ejele ukuze ajeze ngento embi ayenza emndenini simethemba,'' usho kanjena.UDlulisa uvele ungaphakathi njengoba inkantolo yasichitha isicelo sakhe sokuba ngaphandle ngebheyili.Inkantolo yamchitha noma esebeka isizathu sokuthi ufuna ukuba ngaphandle ukuze aqhubeke nokunakekela izingane ngoba unina akasekho.Encwadini ayenza efungelwe eyayifundwa ummeli wakhe, wathembisa ukuthi uzoyigcina yonke imibandela yakhe yebheyili.UDlulisa ubebonakala elokhu eqalaza emuva samuntu obheka othile abemlindele ukuba afike enkantolo. Icala lihlehliselwe uFebhuwari 5.
UMENGAMELI we-ANC, uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa, uthi bazozinqoba izinkinga ababhekene nazo.Uthe bazovuka bazithathe emva kokuhluleka ukunqoba ukhetho lukazwelonke ngonyaka owedlule.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ehambele ejele elisesiqhingini, iRobben Island, okwakuboshwe kulo izishoshovu ze-ANC nabanye ababelwela inkululeko.Kubaholi abadonsa isikhathi eside kuleli jele kubalwa nowayengumengameli wokuqala woMbuso wentando yabantu, uMnuz Nelson Mandela, nabanye abaholi.URamaphosa uthe ukuhambela eRobben Island kubavuselele kakhulu, wathi bazobukela kubaholi ababeboshwe kuleli jele.URamaphosa uthe abaholi ababeboshwe kuleli jele banqoba izinkinga ababebhekene nazo ngesikhathi belwela inkululeko."Sithumela umyalezo othi noma ngabe iziphi izinkinga esibhekene nazo, sizodlula kuzo njengoba senza phambilini. Njengoba kwenza abaholi ababeboshwe lapha, abakwazi ukunqoba izinkinga ababebhekene nazo, nathi sizodlula kulezi zinkinga esibhekene nazo."Uhambo lwalapha lusivuselela kabusha njengenhlangano, siyagqugquzeleka. Uhambo lwanamhlanje lusikhumbuza ukuthi ababeboshwe lapha banqoba kunzima, nathi sizonqoba njengoba nabo baphumelela.”URamaphosa uthe bazimisele ukwakha kabusha i-ANC, wanxusa ukuba kube nobumbano enhlanganweni."Abaholi ababeboshwe lapha babekwazi ukubaluleka kokubambisana. Babazi kahle ukuthi babengeke bakuthole ababekulwela ukube abazange babe yimbumba.”I-ANC izoba nomcimbi wokugubha usuku eyasungulwa ngalo.Lo mcimbi obizwa ngeJanuwari 8 uzokuba ngoMgqibelo, esifundazweni iWestern Cape, eKhayelitsha. Kulo nyaka kuphela iminyaka engu-113 kwasungulwa i-ANC.Lena kuzokuba iJanuwari 8 yokuqala kusukela i-ANC yahluleka ukunqoba ukhetho olwedlule ngamalengiso njengoba isibusa ngokubambisana namanye amaqembu angu-10, futhi kusanda kuphela iminyaka engu-30 i-ANC yathatha izintambo zoMbuso.URamaphosa uthe embikweni wakhe azowethula ngoMgqibelo uzochaza ngabakwenzile kule minyaka engu-30 bephethe."Kulesi sitatimende sizophinde siveze esizokubeka eqhulwini kulo nyaka siphinde sinxuse amalungu e-ANC ukuba abe ingxenye yombhidlango wokushintsha impilo yabo. Sibheke eminyakeni engu-114. Sizimisele ukuqhubeka sisebenzele abantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Ngeke siphumule uma kusekhona abantu abangakayitholi inkululeko yezomnotho.”
UNOBHALA Jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, uthi gede kumholi we-MK, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, osabisa ngokuthatha izinyathelo zomthetho uma i-ANC ingahoxisi isinqumo sokumxosha.UMbalula uthe uZuma akenze akuthandayo, wathi ngeke bezwe ngaye.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba emva kokuhambela ejele okwakuboshwe kulo izingqalabutho ezazilwela inkululeko, iRobben Island.UZuma uthumelele i-ANC incwadi yabameli, eyiyalela ukuba ihoxise isinqumo sokumxosha.Encwadini yabameli uZuma ukhale ngokuthi akuzange kulandelwe imigomo ngesikhathi exoshwa kwi-ANC.Unikeze i-ANC umnqamulajuqu wasekupheleni kwale nyanga ukuba ihoxise isinqumo sokumxosha, wathi uzothatha izinyathelo zomthetho uma kungenzeki lokhu.UMbalula usole uZuma ngokufuna ukubukwa."Kwalandelwa yonke imigomo. Sakhuluma naye ngesikhathi kuqhubeka uhlelo lokumqondisa ubugwegwe. Ngokomthethesisekelo we-ANC, uZuma akaselona ilungu le-ANC. Ingakho singeke siyinake indaba yakhe."Uzama nje ukusiphazamisa njengoba sibheke emcimbini wokugubha usuku okwasungulwa ngalo i-ANC. Ubenesikhathi sonke sokuba asithumelele le ncwadi yakhe. Ukhethe ukuyithumela namhlanje ngoba ufuna ukuphazamisa umcimbi wethu. Ufuna kukhulunywe indaba yakhe. Lena iyona ndlela uZuma asebenza ngayo. Uzicabangela yena yedwa.”UMbalula uthe uZuma uwuHubhu kaBhejane, wathi sebekhathele uyena edukisa abantu."Akasiyise enkantolo, akenze noma yini abona imlungele. Sizoziphendulela. Siyazi ukuthi sayilandela yonke imigomo ngesikhathi kuqhubeka uhlelo lokumqondisa ubugwegwe.”UMbalula uthe siphelile isikhathi sokuthi abaholi bazenzele umathanda kwi-ANC."Naye uZuma kulesi cagogwana aziqalele sona, uhlezi ebaqondisa ubugwegwe abaphula imithetho. Nalapha kwi-ANC bazothathelwa izinyathelo abenza okuphambene nemigomo.”UZuma waxoshwa kwi-ANC emva kokuba ekhankasele i-MK eyayincintisana ne-ANC okhethweni olwedlule.Encwadini yabameli, uZuma ukhale ngokuthi ikomiti eliqondisa ubugwegwe kwi-ANC lanqaba isicelo sakhe sokuthi azifikele mathupha esigcawini sokuqondiswa ubugwegwe, kungasetshenziswa ezobuchwepheshe.Uphinde wakhala nangokuthi akazange anikezwe ithuba lokuthi abeke uhlangothi lwakhe ngesikhathi eshushiswa.Ikomiti elilalela amacala adlulisiwe kwi-ANC nalo lachitha isicelo sikaZuma sokuba kubuyekezwe isinqumo sokumfaka amasondo.Fikile Mbalula

UMalembe unxuse amaphoyisa aseKranskop ukuba alusebenze ngokushesha loludaba ukuze umndeni kamufi uzothola ubulungiswa.
UNYAKA uqale ngezindaba ezimbi kubasebenzi njengoba kuzodilizwa inqwaba kule nyanga ezimbonini ezehlukene.Izinkampani neminyango kahulumeni bazodiliza izinkulungwane zabasebenzi ekupheleni kwenyanga.Isikhondlakhondla senkampani yensimbi, i-ArcelorMittal, sizodiliza abasebenzi abangu-3 500, uMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu uzodiliza izinkulungwane zabasebenzi.Ukudilizwa kwabasebenzi kuzoshaya kuzwele kakhulu KwaZulu-Natal njengoba iningi labasebenzi abazodilizwa i-ArcelorMittal kungabaseNewcastle.Nakulabo abazodilizwa uMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu kukhona inqwaba yalapha KwaZulu-Natal.Umnyango uzodiliza inqwaba yabasebenzi abangaphansi kohlelo lwemisebenzi yomphakathi.Abasebenzi abazodilizwa umnyango ilabo abaneminyaka engaphezu kuka-55.Umnyango uthe lesi sinqumo usithathe emva kokwehliswa kwesabelomali sawo ngo-R400 million.Ngaphansi kwalolu hlelo kuqashwe abasebenzi abangu-255 000, akucaci ukuthi bangaki abaneminyaka engaphezu kuka-55.Kubasebenzi abangu-3 500 abazodilizwa i-ArcelorMittal, abangaphezu kuka-2 000 basebenzela eNewcastle, abanye abazodilizwa basebenzela eVereeniging, eGauteng.I-ArcelorMittal ikhiqiza insimbi esetshenziswa uma kwakhiwa noma kubiywa.Le nkampani ithe izovala olunye uphiko lwayo ngenxa yesimo somnotho esingesihle, ukungabi khona kwezitimela zokuthutha impahla, ukuhlupha nokubiza kukagesi. Sikhulu isililo kwabaseNewcastle ngokudilizwa kwenqwaba yabasebenzi.UNksz Thabisile Thwala, waseMadadeni, uthe i-ArcelorMittal ibibambe iqhaza elikhulu ekuxosheni indlala endaweni yangakubo."Thina sikhule kuyiyona nkampani enkulu lapha endaweni. Abazali bethu bebesebenza khona. Miningi imindeni ebiphiliswa yile nkampani. Wonke umuntu ubefisa ukusebenza khona.”UMphathiswa wezokuThuthukiswa koMnotho KwaZulu-Natal, uMfu Musa Zondi, uthe ukudilizwa kwenqwaba yabasebenzi ophikweni oluseNewcastle kuzophazamisa ukukhula komnotho wakule ndawo."I-ArcelorMittal ingenye yezinkampani eziqashe abantu abaningi eNewcastle futhi iyinsika yomnotho endaweni. Imindeni eminingi incike kule nkampani. Ukudilizwa kwenqwaba engaka kuzoshaya imindeni eminingi.”UZondi uthe usebhalele uNgqongqoshe wezoHwebo, iziMboni nokuNcintisana, uMnuz Parks Tau, ecela uhulumeni kazwelonke ukuba ungenelele kulolu daba."Ukudilizwa kwabasebenzi akuzukukhinyabeza nje kuphela umnotho waseNewcastle kodwa kuzophinde kukhubaze umnotho wesifundazwe nozinzo. Sinxusa ungqongqoshe ukuba azame ngakho konke okusemandleni akhe ukunqanda le simo.”Izinyunyana zabasebenzi namaqembu ezepolitiki bazwakalise ukukhathazeka ngezinhlelo zokudilizwa kwabasebenzi.UNobhala Jikelele wenyunyana yabasebenzi bensimbi, i-Numsa, uMnuz Irvin Jim, ugxeke uhulumeni ngezinkinga ezikhungethe i-ArcelorMittal.UJim uthe sekunesikhathi eside i-ArcelorMittal inezingxoxo nohulumeni lapho bekuxoxwa ngezinkinga eziyikhungethe."Mhlawumbe ihhovisi likamengameli kufanele lisitshele ukuthi yini lena eyenza ukuthi lihluleke ukuthola isixazululo kule ndaba.”UJim uthe bayaphikisana nokuthi kudilizwe abasebenzi.Okhulumela i-MK, uMnuz Nhlamulo Ndhlela, uthe bafuna kushaywe umthetho ozovimba ukuba kungene kuleli impahla yensimbi eshibhile ekhiqizwe emazweni angaphandle.Ilungu le-ActionSA, uMnuz Alan Beesley, lithe ukudilizwa kwabasebenzi kukhombisa ngokusobala ukwehluleka kukahulumeni ophethe ukulungisa izinkinga eziphazamisa ukukhula komnotho.
KUPHELILE ukuqagela ngokushicilelwa kwemiphumela ka-matric emaphephandabeni ngesonto elizayo njengoba inkantolo ichithe isicelo esiphuthumayo ebesifakwe yi-Information Regulator (IR), ebifuna kumiswe ukushicilelwa kwale miphumela.I-IR ibifuna uMnyango wezeMfundo eyisiSekelo uqale uthole imvume kubafundi ababhale leli banga ukuthi ishicilelwe imiphumela.INkantolo eNkulu yaseGauteng izolo isichithile lesi sicelo, yathi asiphuthumi okusho ukuthi umnyango uzoqhubeka nokushicilela imiphumela ngoLwesibili.USihlalo we-IR, u-Advocate Pansy Tlakula, uthe udumele ngesinqumo seJaji uRonel Tolmay, sokuchitha isicelo sabo.Uthe bazimisele ukuxoxa nomnyango ngezinto abangaboni ngaso linye kuzona."Sidumele ngesinqumo senkantolo ngoba besivikela ulwazi lwabafundi. Asihambisani nokuthi kuthiwe le miphumela ishicilelwa kusetshenziswa kuphela izinombolo zabo zokubhala ngoba kwazona ziwulwazi lomuntu othile,” kusho u-Advocate Tlakula.IJaji uTolmay likhiphe ohlwini lwamacala aphuthumayo lesi sicelo."Kumele kucaciswe ukuthi asikho isizathu esinqala esiveziwe esenze kwafakwa lesi sicelo njengesiphuthumayo. Udaba oluthinta ukushicilelwa kwemiphumela lwaqala ngo-2022 ngakho abebekhalaza kumele ngabe kade baziveza izizathu, bangalindi kuze kube wumzuzu wokugcina. Kumele kubekwe phambili amalungelo abafundi abathintekayo,” kusho iJaji Tolmay.Ijaji liveze ukuthi akukho okusezithebeni zakhe okuveza ukuthi bekuzobeka engcupheni abafundi uma kushicilelwa le miphumela."Akukho ngisho isikhalazo esisodwa esivela kubafundi mayelana nokuthi ingashicilelwa le miphumela. Sekuphele iminyaka emithathu le miphumela idedelwa ngale ndlela, kushintshephi kulo nyaka?” kubuza ijaji Tolmay.Ijaji lichithe nezindleko zalesi sicelo.UNgqongqoshe woMnyango wezeMfundo eyisiSekelo, uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, uzomemezela imiphumela ka-matric ngoMsombuluko ntambama bese ngoLwesibili iminyango yezifundazwe iyidedele bese abafundi bekwazi ukuyithola.Okhulumela umnyango, uMnuz Elijah Mhlanga, uthe bebevele behlabela phambili nokushicilela le miphumela ka-matric ngoba baphoqwa yisinqumo senkantolo sango-2022, sokuthi le miphumela ishicilelwe emaphepheni kusetshenziswa izinombolo zabo zokubhala, hhayi amagama nezibongo.Uthe abananxa ne-IR, wathi yinhlangano entsha esadinga ukucathuliswa ngezinye zezinto."Ezinye zezinto zisazoxoxwa kodwa siyaqhubeka nokushicilela le miphumela emaphephandabeni njengoba besivele senza kule minyaka edlule. Okubalulekile ngukuthi umfundi akwazi ukuthola imiphumela yakhe noma kuthiwa uakuphi nendawo,” kusho uMhlanga.Uthe abafundi balanda imiphumela yabo lapho bebhalele khona.
SEZIPHENDUKE insakavukela umchilo wesidwaba izigameko zokusha ubuhanguhangu kwemijondolo ezindaweni ezahlukene ezweni nokuyaye kudlule nemiphefumulo yabahlali.Ngokocwaningo olusanda kukhishwa yi-United Nations, iNingizimu Afrika iseqhulwini ohlwini lwamazwe anenselelo yokuqubuka komlilo oshiya kukhihlwa isililo emijondolo cishe zonke izinsuku. Le ngwadla yandisa inhlupheko nosizi ebantwini ngoba kuyenzeka kuphume izidumbu okanye kulimale abantu kanzima ngenxa yokusha. Abanye basala bengenalutho, kudingeke bayiqale phansi impilo.Kuvela izizathu ezehlukene njengembangela yomlilo kuleli okubandakanya ubudedengu kubahlali, izidakamizwa, ugesi wezinyokanyoka nokuminyana kwezakhiwo.Ngonyaka odlule kwacishe kwavalwa ngehlahla emndenini wakwaXaba kwaF eMlaza ngesikhathi kushona izingane ezimbili zamantombazane.UMHLALI wasemjondolo uNksz Salome Mogale ephethe usana bomphakathi wabahlali basemjondolo eSeacow Lake ubalule izizathu ezehlukene athe ziyimbangela yokusha kwemijondolo.Eqhulwini ubalule inkinga yokuxhunywa kukagesi wezinyokanyoka."Inkinga enkulu yalo gesi ukuthi uhamba noma yinini. Kuba nobudedengu obukhulu bokuthi uma uhamba ugesi abantu bakhohlwe ukucisha izitofu bese kuthi uma ubuya ugesi kudaleke umonakalo,'' usho kanjena.Eqhuba uthe kungaba yiqhinga elihle ukuthi umuntu abe nogesi wakhe yedwa osendlini. Ubale ukuminyana nakho njengembangela enkulu yokusha kwezakhiwo eziningi uma kuke kwasha esisodwa. "Lokhu kudala ukuthi ngisho abezicishamlilo kube lukhuni satshe ukuthi bangene basize uma sekuqubuke umlilo,'' kuchaza yena.Uphonsele umasipala inselelo yokuthi uthathe abantu ubayise ezindaweni ezingcono kunasemijondolo.IZINDLU okusanda kufakwa kuzo abahlali baseMasinenge abasanda kushelwa imijondolo Isithombe: SITHUNYELWE NgoDisemba uMphathiswa woMnyango wezokuHlaliswa kwaBantu esifundazweni, uMnuz Siboniso Duma ehambisana noNgqongqoshe walo mnyango uNkk Thembi Nkadimeng banikezele ngezindlu ezingu-63 kwabasemijondolo yaseMasinenge, eThekwini. Lokhu kwenzeka emva kokusha kwemijondolo yabo ngoDisemba 26.UDuma wathi basezinhlelweni zokuthi bagcine benikezele ngezindlu kubahlali abangu-882 abasasele kule mijondolo.Sekuyinsakavukela ukuthi njalo ngesikhathi samaholidi okuphela konyaka imijondolo ishe ubuhanguhangu ezindaweni ezehlukene ezweni. E-Western Cape abantu baseVrygrond, ngaseMuizenberg bagilwa umlilo kwasha imijondolo engu-16. Bashelwa yikho konke ababenakho. Muva nje basanda kunikwa izinto zokwakha kabusha.Kwesinye isehlakalo ezakhiweni ezidume ngokuthi iseNomzamo, e-Orlando East, eSoweto, indoda ihilwe yintuthu yashona ngoKhisimusi. Lapha kusale abantu ababalelwa ku-600 bengenazo izindawo zokufihla ikhanda.NaseMgungundlovu kunezindawo ezinjengaseMasukwana lapho bese kwaziwa ukuthi kuhlale kuqubuka umlilo emijondolo yakhona.Inkinga yokusha kwemijondolo akusikona ukuthi abaphethe kabayazi. Basukuma kuphela uma kusanda kusha indawo ethile, bakhiphe izinto zokwakha bese kuqhutshekwa nempilo.Inselelo enkulu wukuthi ukwakhiwa kwemijondolo akulawulwa wumuntu okwenza kube yisidlidli esingenazindlela okanye imigwaqo. Ngisho imithetho yezokuphepha kwezakhiwo kayilandelwa ayisaphathwa-ke eyezempilo. Uhulumeni uhlale uveza izifiso zokuqeda imijondolo kepha sekucacile ukuthi iyiqatha elimbindayo ngenxa yokuhluleka wukuqeda inhlupheko nokungalingani ebantwini.
IPHINI likaMengameli we-ANC, uMnuz Paul Mashatile, lithwale kanzima ngesikhathi lisembhidlangweni wokunxenxa abantu ukuthi bahambele umcimbi wokugubha usuku okwasungulwa ngalo i-ANC.Ingxoxo yakhe nomndeni awuvakashele elokishini, iKhayelitsha, iphazanyiswe isixakaxaka esisuke phakathi kwabaqaphi bakhe nelungu lomndeni eligcine liphimisela amagama okuthi uMashatile nabehamba nabo abaphume baphele emzini wakubo.Kuthe noma sesiphelile isixakaxaka ilungu lomndeni, ebelikhuluma noMashatile, lavele laqhakambisa i-DA.UMashatile ubehambe engena imizi yaseKhayelitsha enxenxa abantu ukuthi bahambele umcimbi ozokuba ngeSonto khona kuleli lokishi.Uhambo lukaMashatile luqale ukunyomfeka ngesikhathi abaqaphi bakhe bevimba ilungu lomndeni ebelingaphandle ngesikhathi engena endlini.Abaqaphi bakaMashatile banqabele le ndoda ebiphethe ingane ukuba ingene endlini kepha le ndoda yadlubulundela yaze yafika lapho obekuhlezi khona uMashatile nabanye abaholi be-ANC.Kulesi sigameko, ebesisakazwa bukhoma kwithelevishini, kubonakale le ndoda ibhoka ngolaka ithi uMashatile nahamba nabo abaphume baphele emzini wakubo."Akekho umuntu ozongivimba ukuthi ngingene emzini kamama wami. Nonke nina enilapha, hambani. Hambani khona manje, hhayi kusasa.”Abaqaphi bakaMashatile bagcine beyikhiphele ngaphandle le ndoda.Emva kwesigameko uMashatile uxolisile, wathi abaqaphi bakhe bebengazi ukuthi le ndoda ngeyakulo muzi abebekuwo.Ngesikhathi uMashatile exoxa nelungu lomndeni emva kwesixakaxaka, livele laqhakambisa i-DA.Lo mndeni unohlelo lokuphakela abantu endaweni.Ilungu lomndeni lithe i-DA iyona eyanikela ngokudla nokunye ukuze ukwazi ukuqhubeka nalolu hlelo.UMashatile uzibophezele ukuthi bazolweseka uhlelo lwalo mndeni lokusiza umphakathi.I-ANC ne-DA bayinkukhu nempaka kulezi nsuku.Ngesikhathi uMashatile ehambele eKhayelitsha ngeSonto, usole uhulumeni waseWestern Cape oholwa i-DA ngokungazinaki izindawo ezihlala abantu abamnyama.Le nkulumo kaMashatile icasule uSihlalo woMkhandlu weDA, uNkk Helen Zille, osole uMashatile ngokusenga ezimithiyo.UNkk Zille uthe abantu baseKhayelitsha yibona abahlomula kakhulu ezinhlelweni zikamasipala uma kuqhathaniswa nezitholwa abaseCamps Bay okuyindawo yeziqumama.Izolo uMashatile uwaphindile amazwi akhe wathi: "Ngiyabona ukuthi inkulumo yami imcasulile uNkk Zille. Kodwa bengikhuluma iqiniso. Yena ukhuluma kanjena nje yingoba akazi. Wagcina nini eKhayelitsha?”
UCHAZWA njengegeza "elizitshelayo ngokubukeka kahle kwalo futhi elingadlulwa yisiketi” umlisa onukwa ngokubulala intombazane ayigqibe eNanda, eThekwini, ngoKhisimusi.UMnuz Mfanafuthi Kunene (37) ubevele eNkantolo yeMantshi eThekwini, ngecala lokufa kukaNksz Ayabonga Mjilo (24).Isolezwe lithole ngomthombo oke wasebenza naye uKunene eNutun ukuthi (lo mbhemu) uwuhlobo lomuntu ozitshelayo, ozaziyo ukuthi uyabukeka futhi udume ngokushela kwasani kubasebenzi abakhwishiza ngaphansi kwakhe.Omunye umthombo uthe uKunene uyinsizwa eyaziwa ngobusoka, ebinganqeni ukuthenga izipho ezibizayo nxa izifela ngowesifazane. Uthe bamangele ngento eyenzekile futhi bayathemba ukuthi uzogonyuluka achaze imbangela ngoba abayikholwa into anukwa ngayo.UNDUNANKULU wesifundazwe, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, ekhuluma nabezindaba ngaphandle kwenkantolo Isithombe: ZIMBILI VILAKAZIYize omunye umthombo udalule ukuthi emaphaseji ase-call centre ixoxelwa phansi eyokuthi umsolwa nomufi bebethandana kepha abebesondelene noNksz Mjilo bathi amampunge lawo ngoba ubenesoka lakhe abengasabi ngalo.Kuthiwa uNksz Mjilo wayefake isithombe sesoka lakhe abalaziyo kwi-status sika-WhatsApp ngosuku abulawa ngalo. Lokhu kuvezwe omunye wabangani bakhe obesenkantolo.Umufi nomsolwa babegcine ukubonwa ndawonye endaweni yokudlela eseMhlanga, iCappello, ngoDisemba 24.Umngani kaNksz Mjilo, uNksz Asanda Shabane, othe bese beneminyaka emibili bengabangani, umufi usebenze izinyanga ezinhlanu e-call centre i-Nutun, eMhlanga, lapho uKunene abeyi-Operations Manager khona."Ezinyangeni ezimbili ezedlule, ushintshile wayosebenza e-Webhelp, ushona nje ubesaqeqeshwa,” kusho uNksz Shabane.Uthe kabazi ukuthi umsolwa nomufi bebehlanganiswa yini."Ubenalo isoka u-Ayabonga. Njengoba ebenyamalele, besimbheka nalo. Sishaqekile ukuthi ubulawe omunye umuntu wesilisa,” usho kanje."Into yokugcina ayi-phosta, kwakuyisithombe sakhe nomuntu wakhe. Washona ngoKhisimusi,” kubeka uNksz Shabane oveze ukuthi wayelindele ukumbona emsebenzini ngoDisemba 26, nokwagcina kungenzekanga.Umchaze njengomuntu obevulelekile, ethanda ukuxoxa, enenhliziyo enhle kodwa engakwazi ukuthula nento uma imdina."Sitholile ukuthi ephuma eCappello wayediniwe, elwa naye umlisa,” kusho yena.Uthe bathi uma beyilandelela iselula yakhe, bathola ukuthi igcine ukudonsa kubo kamsolwa kodwa bathi uma bebuza ababafica khona, baphika ukuthi bake bambona uNksz Mjilo, umsolwa bangamfica. Kuthiwa eNanda yikwaninakhulu kaKunene kanti yena ubezinze eVerulam.Umalume kamufi, uMnuz Mthetheleli Mjilo ekhuluma noNdunankulu waseKZN, uMnuz Thami Ntuli naye obezifikele mathupha ukuzothamela cala, uthe izinhlaka zikahulumeni azivuselele izindlela zokukhuliswa kwabantu ukugwema izigameko lapho amadoda ebulala ngesihluku abesifazane."Kuningi engifisa ukukusho kodwa ngeke ngikusho ngoba amadoda okufanele ezwe lo myalezo awekho la,” kusho uMjilo.Uveze ukuthi bahlobene nabomndeni wakwaKhambule, okwaqothwa kuwo abayisikhombisa ngoSepthemba, nyakenye."Kubuhlungu kuthi njalo sihlale sivela kwabezindaba ngezigameko ebezingagwemeka,” usho kanje.Uthe nango-2020 kukhona esinye isihlobo sabo, esabulawa ngendlela efanayo, wakhala ngokuthi bancane abasolwa abagcina beboshwa ngezigameko zokubulawa kwabesifazane.Udadewabo kamufi, uNksz Nontobeko Mjilo okhulume nabezindaba zigobhoza izinyembezi, uveze ukuthi umsolwa uzikhombele lapho egqibe khona umufi.Ubonge amaphoyisa aseGreenwood Park, athe alulandele kwaze kwaba uyaboshwa umsolwa udaba.UNtuli ekhuluma nabezindaba ngaphandle kwenkantolo, uthe kuyakhathaza ukwanda kwezigameko zokubulawa kwabesifazane nezingane esifundazweni.Ucele izinhlaka ezahlukene ukuthi zisukume, ukhuzwe lo mhlola wodlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane nezingane."Kukhona ubulwane obukhona ebantwini besilisa, bokuthi kufanele kuze kuphume umphefumulo. Laba bantu bebesebenza bonke, uyazibuza ukuthi isizathu sokuthi aze abulale umuntu abesebenza naye isiphi?” kubuza uNtuli.Imantshi, uMnuz Scelo Zuma, ilihlehlisele uFebhuwari 26 icala emva kokuthi umsolwa ecele ukumelwa ngummeli kahulumeni. Kuvele ukuthi ngeke ayicele ibheyili.Umshushisi woMbuso, uNkk Desiree Boyang Mlondo, uthe ophenyweni lwamaphoyisa kusashoda ezinye izitatimende, umbiko wokuhlolwa kwesidumbu nomphumela wolibofuzo.Umsolwa ungene enkantolo exhuga, edumbile nasebusweni. UMHOLI weMK, uJacob Zuma, uyalele i-ANC ukuba ihoxise isinqumo sokumxosha, wasabisa ngokuthatha izinyathelo zomthetho uma engabuyiselwa kule nhlangano ake waba umengameli wayo iminyaka eyishumi.Lokhu ukusho encwadini yabameli ebhekiswe kunobhala jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula.Kule ncwadi yabameli, uZuma uthe akuzange kulandelwe imigomo ngesikhathi exoshwa.Ukhale ngokuthi ikomiti eliqondisa ubugwegwe kwi-ANC lanqaba isicelo sakhe sokuthi azifikele mathupha esigcawini sokuqondisa ubugwegwe, kungasetshenziswa ezobuchwepheshe.Uphinde wakhala nangokuthi akazange anikezwe ithuba lokuthi abeke uhlangothi lwakhe ngesikhathi eshushiswa.Ikomiti elilalela amacala adlulisiwe kwi-ANC nalo lachitha isicelo sikaZuma sokuba kubuyekezwe isinqumo sokumxosha.UZuma unikeze i-ANC umnqamulajuqu wasekupheleni kwenyanga ukuba ihoxise isinqumo sokumxosha."Uma kungenzeki lokho ngiyophoqeleka ukuba ngithathe izinyathelo zomthetho."Okhulumela inhlangano kaZuma engenzi nzuzo, iJacob G Zuma Foundation, uMnuz Mzwanele Manyi, uthe banethemba lokuthi abaholi be-ANC bazokwenza into elungile.
KUKHIHLWE isililo kwanokunengeka ngaphakathi eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini, singaphumi isinqumo ecaleni labamangalelwa abahlanu ababhekene necala lokusoconga abayisiyishiyagalolunye ehostela eGlebelands, eMlaza, ngo-2023.Abamangalelwa kuleli cala ngoMnuz Bongile Mabele (34), Siyamthemba Zintenteni Mthwana (32), Nkosayikhethi Njeya (35), Bongani Patrick Mboyiyana (38), noMnuz Sibusiso Mkhonde ( 41) bonke ababehlala ngaphakathi kuleli hostela.Kuvela ukuthi laba badubula babulala oMnuz Phakamani Lukhozi, Thamsanqa Helman Shongwe, Mpilo Christopher Khumalo, Lungani Sikobi, Yandisa Ennox Msungubali, Nkululeko Freedom Lukhozi, Bongani Petros Mkane, Mxolisi Comfort Mthethwa noMnuz Mandla Bhodloza Mncaka.Kuthiwa abafi basocongwa behlezi ndawonye ngobusuku bangoJuni 2, 2023 eBlock 57 kulona leli hostela.Abamangalelwa babekwe amacala ayisishiyagalolunye okubulala kanjalo namane okuzama ukubulala nawokutholakala nezibhamu ezingekho emthethweni.Bonke bangaphakathi njengoba inkantolo ngaphambilini yazichitha izicelo zabo zebheyili.Ababebulawa, kuhlaluke ukuthi babedutshulwa ekhanda, entanyeni nasesifubeni.Bonke laba kuvela ukuthi umnyombo wokubulawa kwabo kwakuwumbango wemibhede owawudla lubi eGlebelands bengakaboshwa abamangalelwa.Kuvela ukuthi abamangalelwa babekhipha abathile emibhedeni yabo ngodli, bese befaka abangani babo. Kuthiwa abamangalelwa babekade bekhokhelwa u-R6 000 umbhede ngamunye.Izolo bekukade kulindeleke ukuthi inkantolo ikhiphe isinqumo ngokuthi laba liyabalahla noma liyabathetha icala.Kodwa kunalokho, kuvele kwasukuma ummeli wabo, u-Advocate J. Walmaraas, watshela iJaji uMasipa ukuthi angeke esakwazi ukuthi aqhubeke nokumela laba ngoba sebekhala ngokuphundleka ephaketheni, bathi kabasenayo imali yokumkhokhela."Nkosi yeNkantolo ngizocela ukuthi ungikhulule kuleli cala ngenxa yokuthi ngeke ngisakwazi ukubamela ngenxa yokuthi kabasenayo imali yokungikhokhela. Ngenxa yalokho ngeke ngisakwazi ukuthi ngibe yingxenye yaleli cala,'' usho kanjena.Kuthe esanda kuqeda ukukhuluma kwase kungena umshushisi, u-Advocate Singh obezwakala egcwele intukuthelo."Nkosi yeNkantolo lawa ngamaqhinga nje abamangalelwa okulibazisa leli cala. Yini edala ukuthi bafune ukuzohoxisa ummeli wabo icala selize lafinyelela kulesi sigaba? Angivumi ukuthi lokhu kwenzeke namhlanje,'' usho kanjena.Uqhubekile umshushisi wathi akumele izimo ezinjengalezi zivunyelwe ukuba zenzeke emacaleni abucayi njengalawa, ikakhulukazi uma icala selize lafinyelela kulesi sigaba.Ube eselimisa ngesihloko elokuthi akakwamukeli ukuchithwa kommeli kulesi sigaba ngoba lokho kuzobambezela icala kungenasidingo.Yize enze lezo zethulo unshushisi kodwa iJaji uMasipa lithe ngeshwa akukho okungenziwa ngoba angeke likwazi ukuqhubeka nokukhipha isinqumo ebantwini abangesenaye ummeli.Ngemuva kwalawa mazwi ejaji, kunabesifazane okuvele ukuthi bayizihlobo zabafi ababonakale bekhihla isililo ngaphakathi enkantolo.Ijaji libabuzile abamangalelwa ukuthi kuyiqiniso yini ukuthi sekuhlukana inhloko nesixhanti phakathi kwabo nommeli wabo, bonke bavuma.Enkantolo bekugcwele kakhulu abangani nezihlobo zabamangalelwa. Bekuthi njalo uma inkantolo isaguqile isikhashana babonakale beba nenguyazana yokubhunga kabanzi ngokuqhubeka ecaleni."Ake sihlangane wemadoda sithi ngqumungqumu,’’ kusho omunye wesilisa obebonakala kunguyena obedane ekhuluma uma sekuhlanganiswe amakhanda.Ngesikhathi icala liguqa okokuqala ekuseni, ebebezoseka abamangalelwa baze baxhawula bekhombisa ukubajabulela okukhulu.Omunye wesilisa uzwakale ekhuluma ebhekise kubona ethi: "Khululekani namhlanje bafana sibuyela nani emakhaya, namhlanje elamanqamu. Niyaphuma namhlanje siphinda nani emuva."Ngaphakathi enkantolo beziqinile ezokuphepha njengoba bekugcwele amaphoyisa amaningi abehlome ngezibhamu ezinkulu, eqaphe konke obekwenzeka.Ijaji libe selihlehlisela leli cala ukuthi libuyele ngoJanuwari 23, okuyilapho abamangalelwa abayobe sebezofaka isicelo sokuthi bathole abameli bamahhala.
