UMENGAMELI Cyril Ramaphosa uxwayise ngokuthi ukungenela kwe-SACP ukhetho ngokuzimela kungenza ukuthi i-ANC namadlendawonye ayo balahlekelwe amandla okuphatha izwe.URamaphosa uthe ukungenela kwe-SACP ukhetho lohulumeni basekhaya ngokuzimela kuzokwenza ukuthi i-ANC namadlelandawonye babe buthaka.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma emcimbini wokukhumbula ingqalabutho ye-SACP, uMnuz Joe Slovo, owashona eminyakeni engu-30 eyedlule.I-SACP ibilokhu yeseka i-ANC okhethweni olwedlule, muva nje ithathe isinqumo sokuthi izongenela ukhetho lohulumeni basekhaya oluzokuba ngonyaka ozayo."I-ANC ne-SACP bangamawele, ukwehlukana kwabo kuzophazamisa umbhidlango wokuthuthukisa abantu abebecindezelekile phambilini. Sinamandla kakhulu uma sibambisene.”URamaphosa uthe i-ANC ishaywe kakhulu ukuhlubuka kwezinhlangano, wathi uma i-SACP ingaphuma ibhodwe layo kungaba nzima kakhulu."Kule minyaka eyedlule, kusukela ngo-1960, kuya ku-2000, sibonile kulokhu kuba khona amaqembu ahlubuka kwi-ANC. Lokhu kwenze i-ANC yaba buthaka kakhulu. Muva nje sonke sizibonele umthelela wokuhlubuka kwamaqembu."Kufanele sizibuze ukuthi ngabe sisafuna yini ukuqhubeka nokuphatha uMbuso. Uma sisafuna ukuphatha amandla oMbuso akufanele sihlukane. Uma sike sahlukana kufanele sikhohlwe ukuthi siyoke siphinde siphathe uhulumeni.”UNobhala Jikelele we-SACP, uMnuz Solly Mapaila, usivikele isinqumo sabo sokungenela ukhetho oluzayo.UMapaila uthe abaqondile ukwenza ukuthi amadlelandawonye abe buthaka okhethweni oluzayo."Empeleni sifuna ukuthi amadlelandawonye abe namandla kakhulu okhethweni oluzayo. Inhloso yethu enkulu ukuthuthukisa impilo yabantu. Sifuna ukubuyisa amandla omnotho. Ngeke sikwazi ukukwenza lokho uma sisonge izandla.”UMapaila uthe ukungangeneli kwabo ukhetho kwenza ukuthi bangabi nalo izwi kuhulumeni."Ngisho iDA inamandla amaningi kunathi kuhulumeni. IDA inongqongqoshe abayimele kwikhabhinethi. Yebo akhona amalungu ethu angongqongqoshe, kodwa iqiniso ukuthi asemseni we-ANC.”UMapaila uthe ukungenela kwabo ukhetho akusho ukuthi baxabene ne-ANC."Asisoze siyilahle i-ANC. Mina nje ngiyilungu le-ANC, futhi ngesikhathi ngithatha ubulungu be-ANC ngasho ukuthi ngiyofela kuyona. Sizoqhubeka nokusebenzisana ne-ANC.”
UMFELOKAZI usethembele eNkantolo eNkulu yaseGauteng ePitoli ukuthi imnikeze ubunikazi bembewu yomyeni wakhe ongasekho egcinwe emtholampilo.Lona wesifazane usefuna ukuyisebenzisa ukuze athole ozolama indodakazi yakhe eyodwa.Umyeni wakhe kwatholakala ukuthi unomdlavuza wase elulekwa ngabezempilo ukuthi ngaphambi kokuqala ukwelashwa akanikele ngembewu yakhe igcinwe emtholampilo ukuze isetshenziswe uma efuna ukuthola abantwana ngomuso. Nangempela owesilisa wanikela ngembewu yakhe yagcinwa emtholampilo ngo-2014. Lona wesifazane wakhetha ukukhulelwa ngokuthi afakwe imbewu yomyeni wakhe.Ubhale emaphepheni asenkantolo ukuthi ngenxa ye-chemotheraphy, abakwazanga ukuthola izingane ngokwemvelo.Uchaze wathi umyeni wakhe wanikela ngembewu emtholampilo wenzalo ukuze igcinwe futhi kwagcinwa ama-straw angu-13.Kuyena kwakhishwa amaqanda angu-16 kodwa ayisishiyagalolunye ayevuthiwe. Amanye alahlwa ngoba ayengekho esimeni sokujovwa ngembewu.Kulokhu kuthathwa imbewu eyodwa ifakwe eqandeni ngomjovo. Ngesikhathi kwenziwa, kwasetshenziswa ama-straw amabili kwasala angu-11 ukuze agcinwe. NgoMashi 2016 wakhulelwa, kwaholela ekutheni abelethe indodakazi yakhe ngoFebhuwari 2017.Uthe umyeni wakhe washona ngemuva kwezinyanga ezimbili kuzelwe indodakazi engashongo encwadini yefa ukuthi kwenziweni ngama-straw esidoda asele. Uthe kodwa washo ukuthi wonke amafa akhe uwashiya kumkakhe.Uthe ukuze andise umndeni kumele asebenzise ama-straw angu-11 asele.Ukugcinwa kwembewu kulawulwa wumthetho i-National Health Act, Children’s Act nemithetho emayelana nokukhulelwa ngokujova.Eminye yemithetho ikubeka kucace ukuthi ngemuva kokujovwa, ubunikazi busala nojovayo, kulokhu umfelokazi. Uphinde uthi ngaphambi kokujova, ubunikazi bembewu kuba ngobowesilisa onikelile.Owesifazane ufuna inkantolo inqume ukuthi ubunikazi bembewu budluliselwe kuyena ngoba emtholampilo bathi umthetho awucacisile ukuthi sebungobakhe.
ISIKHWAMA esixhasa ngemali yokufunda ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme i-National Student Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS), sixwayise omastende ngokuthi bazophucwa igunya lokuhlalisa izitshudeni uma izindawo zabo zingekho ezingeni futhi zingahambisani nemigomo ebekiwe.Lesi sexwayiso sikhishwe njengoba i-NSFAS ivule ithuba lokuthi abafuna izindawo zokuhlala, bafake izicelo ukuze babekise izindawo zokuhlala kulo nyaka. Isitatimende se-NSFAS sithe lesi sikhwama siyaqhubeka nokuqapha ngelokhozi izindawo ezihlala izitshudeni ukuthi ziyahambisana yini nemigomo ebekiwe."Sibheka ukuthi imigomo ebekiwe okumele ibekhona kulezi zindawo ukuthi iyalandelwa. Uma ingalandelwa sizoziphuca izitifiketi negunya lokuthi zihlalise izitshudeni ezixhaswe yi-NSFAS,” kusho isitatimende. Isitatimende siqhube sathi ithuba elivuliwe lizovalwa uma sezigcwele zonke izindawo zokuhlala.Kwenzeka lokhu nje, ngesonto elizayo kulindeleke ukuthi kudedelwe imiphumela ka-matric, bese kuqala ukubhalisa ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme.Kube nezikhalo phambilini ngezinye zezindawo ezihlalisa izitshudeni ezingekho ezingeni futhi ezingahlangabezani nemibandela ebekiwe.Nyakenye kuke kwaba nezinkinga ngohlelo lwalesi sikhwama lwezindawo zokuhlala.Omastende nabo bagcina bekhala esifanayo njengoba abanye babengakhokhelwa ngesikhathi, okwenza baxosha izitshudeni ezasala zingenayo indawo yokuhlala.Lokhu kwenza umlawuli walesi sikhwama uMnuz Freeman Nomvalo, wahambela izifundazwe ezehlukene, lapho ayehlangana khona nabahlinzeka ngezindawo zokuhlala ezwa izikhalo nezinselelo ababhekene nazo.Isitatimende se-NSFAS sithe inhloso ngukuhlinzeka izitshudeni ngezindawo zokuhlala ezisezingeni."Izitshudeni kumele zihlinzekwe ngezindawo zokuhlala ukuze zenze kahle, futhi zigxile ezifundweni zazo. Kumele izindawo ezihlala izitshudeni zihambisane nemali ekhokhelwa lezi zindawo,” kusho i-NSFAS. I-NSFAS isanda kuyalela omastende ukuthi baqinisekise ukuthi isitshudeni abasamukelayo sixhasiwe yilesi sikhwama.Lokhu kwenzelwa ukuthi kungabi nezinkinga uma sekumele bakhokhelwe kutholakale ukuthi asixhasiwe.Kuke kwakhalwa nangokuphuza ukuphendula kwe-NSFAS kulabo abasuke befake izicelo zoxhaso.I-NSFAS yathembisa ukuthi izosheshe iphendule izitshudeni ezisuke zifake izicelo kanti kwazona izitshudeni ezifake izicelo zayalelwa ukuthi zisheshe zibike uma kukhona izinto ezidingwa yilesi sikhwama ngesikhathi zisalinde izimpendulo zoxhaso.Abafuna ukufaka izicelo zezindawo zokuhla bangaya ku:https://www.nsfas.org.za/content/accommodationprovider.
I-ANC izothathela abaholi bayo abaqavile izinyathelo zokuqondiswa ubugwegwe ngezinto abazisabalalisayo ezijivaza isithunzi seqembu.UNobhala Jikelele, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, uveze ukuthi bazothathela izinyathelo zokuqondisa ubugwegwe abebengamalungu esigungu esiphezulu, uMnuz Obed Bapela noMnuz Tony Yengeni.UMbalula ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba izolo, lapho ebekhuluma khona ngamalungiselelo omcimbi wokugubha usuku okwasungulwa ngalo i-ANC.Bobabili laba baholi bazobhekana namacala okufaka inhlangano ehlazweni.UYengeni, obeyilungu lesigungu esiphezulu kwi-ANC ngaphambi kwengqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi be-ANC eyayingo-2022, waziwa ngokweseka umholi we-MK, uMnuz Jacob Zuma.UYengeni uyena owayemele uZuma ngesikhathi evele phambi kwekomiti eliqondisa ubugwegwe kwi-ANC.Leli komiti lathatha isinqumo sokuxosha uZuma kwi-ANC.Manje uYengeni usezophinde avele kuleli komiti, kulokhu uzokube eyoshushiselwa amacala akhe njengoba esolwa ngokugxeka i-ANC ezinkundleni zokuxhumana. UYengeni unokufaka imibhalo egxeka uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa.UMbalula uthe sebembekezelele kwanele uYengeni, wathi manje sekuyisikhathi sokuthi aphendule."UYengeni uthanda ukubukwa. Ubhala noma yini ayithandayo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana. Uhlezi encoma i-MK. Kubukeka sengathi akazazi ukuthi umi kephi. Ngimbhalele umyalezo, ngamtshela ukuthi sizombizela phambi kwekomiti eliqondisa ubugwegwe. Kufanele asichazele ukuthi ngabe useyilo yini ilungu le-ANC.”UMbalula uthe uBapela uzoshushiselwa ukuqamba amanga athi umele i-ANC emcimbini owawuseMorocco.UBapela wazidonsela amanzi ngomsele emva kokukhuluma emcimbini owawuseMorocco, lapho kuthiwa khona wathi ufuna ukuthi kube nokusebenzisana kwezomnotho phakathi kweNingizimu Afrika neMorocco, waze wathi uyaleseka nekhwelo lokuthi iMorocco ibuyiselwe enhlanganweni yamazwe ase-Afrika, i-African Union.I-ANC ayihambisani neMorocco ngenxa yombango wendawo iWestern Sahara.I-ANC ikholelwa ukuthi indawo ebangwayo akufanele ibe ngaphansi kweMorocco, ifuna ukuthi izimele.UMbalula uthe baningi abanye abazothathelwa izinyathelo zokuqondiswa ubugwegwe, wathi kunomkhuba odlangile kwi-ANC lapho khona amalungu afike ankunke utshwala bese ebhala ukuthanda ezinkundleni zokuxhumana."Kunezinto abantu abazibhala phakathi kobusuku, sebedakwe utshwala. Bonke laba bantu bazothathelwa izinyathelo.”
OSANDA kuxoshwa kwesikaNdunankulu kaZulu, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, uchayise abameli abaqokwe yiSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini ukuba bengamele izindaba ezithinta isikhwama esigade umhlaba kaZulu, iNgonyama Trust.UButhelezi uchithe isicelo senkampani yabameli, i-Van Rensburg Kruger Rakwena Attorneys, sokuba nomhlangano naye.Utshele isikhulu sale nkampani ezinze eMpumalanga, ukuthi ayinalo ilungelo lokukhuluma izindaba ezithinta umhlaba kaZulu.Lokhu kushiwo uButhelezi ngesikhathi ehlangene namakhosi oLundi, ngoLwesihlanu.UButhelezi ubebize umhlangano wamakhosi njengoMphathiswa wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu.Utshele amakhosi ukuthi uthole incwadi eqhamuka esikhulwini senkampani yabameli athe sizibize ngoRakwena, wathi kule ncwadi abenkampani yabameli bacele ukuhlangana naye njengomphathiswa ukuze bezoxoxa ngezinto ezithinta umhlaba."Ngimangalile ukuthi ummeli waseMpumalanga uqala ngaphi ukukhuluma izindaba zakwaZulu nomhlaba wamakhosi. Ngimphendulile lowo mmeli othi uwuRakwena, ngathi akangene ezindabeni zikaZulu, amakhosi alawula umhlaba."UButhelezi unxuse amakhosi ukuba aqhubeke nokuvikela umhlaba kaZulu, wathi uZulu awuyilutho ngaphandle komhlaba.Izinto zimapeketwane kwiNgonyama Trust kulandela imizamo yeSilo yokumisa amalungu ebhodi.IMbube, enguSihlalo weBhodi leNgonyama Trust, yathi imisa amalungu ebhodi ngenxa yokuthi isiqale uphenyo ngokunyamalala kwezigidi zamarandi kulesi sikhwama.Nokho uNgqongqoshe wezoMhlaba nokuThuthukiswa kweziNdawo zaseMakhaya, uMnuz Mzwanele Nyhontso, wathi iSilo asinawo amandla okumisa noma ukuxosha amalungu ebhodi.Khonamanjalo: UButhelezi umemezele ukuthi umnyango uzobuyisela emakhosini imali engu-R34.1 million.Lena yimali ebiqoqwa ezizweni zamakhosi ebilokhu igcinwe wumnyango emabhange ehlukene.UButhelezi uthe imikhandlu yamakhosi izonikezwa le mali ukuze iqale izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa iminotho ezindaweni zamakhosi."Lesi sinqumo siyingqophamlando ngoba sibuyisela emakhosini amandla okulawula nokuthatha izinqumo eziphathelene nokusebenza kwemikhandlu yamakhosi. Ngisho noma umkhandlu udinga ukushintsha ifastela eliphukile noma ukuthenga ama-desk okusebenzela, kudinga ukuthi kubhalwe incwadi iye eMgungundlovu, kucelwe, ekubeni inkece le akusiyo ekahulumeni, eyamakhosi."
ONGOTI bezamasiko bathi iSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini sivunwa yisikhathi esiphila kuso ukuba sicele isehlukanisa nomunye wondlunkulu baso.Izazi zamasiko ezikhulume neSolezwe zithe nakuba kungokokuqala emlandweni kaZulu ukuba osesihlalweni acele isehlukaniso, indlela okuphilwa ngayo manje yehlukile kunaleyo okwakuphilwa ngayo emandulo. IMbube isanda kucela ukwehlukanisa nomunye wondlunkulu bayo.Isicelo sifakwe eNkantolo eNkulu yaseMgungundlovu.Esicelweni sesehlukaniso iMbube ikhale ngokuthi umshado wayo ngeke usalungiseka, yaveza ukuthi sekuphele isikhathi esingaphezu konyaka behlala ngokwehlukana nondlunkulu.ISilo sithe sizimisele ukukhipha isondlo sika-R20 000 ngenyanga.Ongoti, oSolwazi Sihawu Ngubane noJabulani Maphalala, bathe ngokwesintu asikho isehlukaniso kodwa bathi isikhathi esiphila kuso siyayivumela iMbube ukuba icele ukudivosa.UNgubane uthe kuqala unkosikazi wayengalahlwa ngisho noma ngabe kwakuthiwa ubanjwe esephutheni elingakanani."Wayakhelwa ngaphandle komuzi, aqhubeke nokukhulisa izingane ngoba le nto yokuganiselana ijulile. Uma owesifazane eyogana kukhona imikhuba eyenziwayo. Akugcini nje ngokuthi kuhlanganiswe abasuke beganana, kodwa kuyaye kuhlanganiswe nemindeni. Ukwenda kusuke kusho ukuthi owesifazane uyofela lapho egane khona.”UNgubane uthe leso sikhathi sesadlula."Uyena ozwayo ukuthi imbiza imshisa kangakanani, kufanele sihloniphe isinqumo sakhe.”UMaphalala uthe kuningi osekushintshile ezweni, wathi iSilo asikwazi ukuphambana nesikhathi esiphila kusona.UMaphalala uthe izinto eziningi zaqala ukushintsha ngesikhathi uZulu unqontshwa amaNgisi, nokwalandelwa ukushintsha kwendlela okwakuphilwa ngayo."INgonyama ayikwazi ukusebenzisa imithetho eyayisebenza kudala. Umthetho ubopha thina sonke, nayo iNgonyama ayikwazi ukwehluka. Ngisho wona lo mshado okukhulunywa ngawo umshado wasimanje. "Kwashadwa ngokwemithetho emisha, ngakho-ke kufanele iNgonyama ilandele yona imithetho uma ifuna isehlukaniso. Kulula ukuthi abantu bakhulume kodwa iqiniso ukuthi lesi isihluku esizithola sikusona njengoZulu ngenxa yamaNgisi afika ashaya imithetho yawo.”ISilo sicela isehlukaniso nje kuvela ukuthi sizogcagcelwa undlunkulu omusha ekupheleni kwenyanga.ISilo sizogcagcelwa uNdlunkulu uNomzamo Myeni.

KUVELA inhlese yokunqakisana kwabaholi ngokubhuntsha kwezinhlelo zenkonzo yomngcwabo ebihlelwa wuMnyango wezokuThutha KwaZulu-Natal.Bekuhlelwe ukuthi kube nenkonzo yabashonile abangu-8 eMahlayizeni, eNkandla, izolo, kepha kwajika izinhlelo ngemizuzu yokugcinaa. Kushone amalungu emindeni ayisishiyagalombili okungoDudu Majola (54), Ntombifuthi Majola (51), Nokubonga Majola (31), Colile Khanyile (51), Busisiwe Khanyile (49), Slindile Khanyile (34), Nomfundo Khanyile (30) noMbali Biyela (30).Amakhosi, izinduna, abaholi kumasipala nomphakathi kuphela babe yingxenye yenkonzo yomngcwabo womndeni wakwaKhanyile nowakwaBiyela bodwa, njengoba kuvele ngaboMnyango wezokuThutha izolo ukuthi bona banqatsheliwe ukuba yingxenye yomngcwabo abebehlela ukuthi uhlanganise bonke abashonile. Akubange kusavela ukuthi uqhubeke kanjani umngcwabo wabakwaMajola.Isitatimende esikhishwe wuMnyango wezokuThutha e-KZN, sithe "kuyadabukisa ukuthi umnyango ngeke ube yingxenye yenkonzo yomngcwabo”."Kuyadabukisa kakhulu ukuthi umnyango ngeke ube yingxenye yomngcwabo ngenxa yezingqinamba ezivezwe yimindeni ebithi iyalelwe ngoyibamba leMeya kaMasipala waseNkandla, uNkk Nonhlanhla Nzuza, ukuthi bangalubhadi enkonzweni enkulu yomngcwabo kodwa bazifihlele bona emakhaya ngabodwana," kusho isitatimende.Sithe nomphakathi ubuyalelwe ukuthi ungayi "enkonzweni yomnyango”."Kungokokuqala emlandweni ukuthi umnyango ubhekane nesimo esinjena. Yize umnyango uyixhasile imindeni ukuze ifihle kahle, nokuthi abathandiweyo bathunwe ngesizotha ngaphandle komsindo, umnyango uqoke ukubeka inhlonipho phambili, utshengise ukuzotha," sisho kanje.Isitatimende siphinde saveza ukuthi uMphathiswa wezokuThutha nokuHlaliswa kwaBantu, uMnuz Sboniso Duma, uphatheke kabi ngenxa yalo myalelo onqabela imindeni nomphakathi ukuthi babe yingxenye yenkonzo. UDuma uthe bafisa ukuxolisa emindenini, emphakathini, kubefundisi nakubazalwane abebebeka imindeni eshonelwe emkhulekweni, futhi bona njengomnyango bagwema ukunqakisana ngamazwi njengoba imindeni isemanzini.UNkk Nzuza uthe kukhona lapho uhulumeni wesifundazwe ojombe khona isigaba."Uhulumeni ujombile, ikakhulukazi isigaba sabaholi bomdabu, okuyinkosi yesizwe okuyiyona evelelwe umshophi ongaka ngabantu bayo. Induna enkulu ephethe izinduna lapha eMahlayizeni ayaziswanga ngohlelo lwenkonzo. Kuthiwa kufike uMphathiswa uDuma kodwa akaxhumananga nenkosi nabaholi bomdabu okuyizinduna," kusho uNkk Nzuza.Uthe Inkosi Bhekizizwe Biyela ibe nokudumala ngalesi senzo sikaDuma."Inkosi ibe isinquma ngodaba. Nathi sibe sesilandela umyalelo wenkosi ngoba yinkosi ephethe abantu futhi nomhlabathi ebesizonyathela kuwo ngowayo" usho kanje.Uthe indaba yonakale ngesikhathi uDuma engakhuleki komkhulu okwenze inkosi yaphuma nalesi sinqumo. Uthe bebengaziswanga ukuthi umphathiswa uzofika endaweni yakwaBiyela futhi ngamampunge ukuthi uyena (uNkk Nzuza) oyalele imindeni ukuthi ichithe umnyango njengoba yena ubedlulisa amagama ashiwo yinkosi.

IGCINE ixazululiwe inkinga yamanzi ebese kuphele iminyaka eyisikhombisa ikhona e-Eastbourne Farm ngaphansi kukamasipala wesiFunda iMajuba.Lokhu kuza ngemuva kokuba iBamba likaMeya kulo masipala, uMnuz Thembelihle Mthembu, livule umpompi wakule ndawo ngemuva kweminyaka eyisikhombisa kungaphumi ngisho iconsi kuwo.Ngokwenza kanjalo uMthembu ubegcina isethembiso asenza ekupheleni kwenyanga eyedlule.Amalungu omphakathi akule ndawo athe ncinci kamjoli ngokuxazululeka kwenkinga yamanzi.Athe bese kuphele isikhathi eside kakhulu ebhekene nale ngwadla yokuhluphekela amanzi.UNkk Mabaso, igama lakhe elingatholakalanga, wakhona e-Eastbourne Farm ukushayele elikhulu ihlombe leli okwenziwe yibamba lemeya."Bese kuphele isikhathi eside sibhekene nenkinga yamanzi kule ndawo. BABABAZA ubulwane kowesilisa owayengumphathi wowesifazane waseLovu, kutholwa isidumbu sakhe sigqitshwe egcekeni eMaotana, eNanda, ngoMgqibelo.Kuvela ukuthi umsolwa (37) umbulale ngokumklinya uNksz Ayabonga Mjilo (24) ngaphambi kokuba amgqibe esikhotheni esingemumva komuzi wakhe.Egcina ukubonakala ephila uNksz Mjilo, kuthiwa wayephuma endaweni yokudlela eseMhlanga, i-Cappello ngoDisemba 24. Kithina sonke, akekho ake wamxoxela ngalona wesilisa. Asazi ngempela ukuthi yini ebihlanganisa umsolwa nodadewethu,” kusho uNksz Mjilo.Uchaze umufi njengomuntu obekhululeka ukuhamba izindawo zobumnandi uma ehamba nabantu abethembayo."Kusobala ukuthi nalo mlisa ubemthemba. Mhlawumbe usebenzise ukuthi ubengumphathi wasemsebenzini wakhe wakudala, base behamba ke ndawonye,” usho kanje.Uqhube wathi kwakhona lokho ukuthi agcine emenzakalisa kanje, kade emphethe emsebenzini, kubashiye nesilonda.Uthe umlisa ubemphethe e-call centre iNutun eMhlanga, kodwa kwenzeka isigameko nje ubesesebenza e-call centre iWebhelp, nayo eseMhlanga, wathi kubashiye nesilonda ukuthi umufi abulawe ashiye indodakazi yakhe eneminyaka emine."Njengoba siqhubeka nezinhlelo zomngcwabo, ilokhu isibuza ukuthi unina uzobuya nini. Silokhu siyitshela ukuthi uyeza. Asazi sizoyikhohlisa kuze kube yinini,” usho kanje.Uthe bafuna umsolwa abolele ejele ngabenze kona, wathi abafuni anikwe ngisho nebheyili.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, utshele abezindaba ukuthi mathathu amacala abekwe umsolwa, kuwona kukhona elokuthumba, elokubulala nelokuvimbela ukusebenza kwengalo yomthetho.Uthe kulindeleke avele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini, namuhla.Umndeni kamufi uthe ubeqashe eQuarry Heights, kanti baqaphele ukuthi kukhona okushaya amanzi ngesikhathi engafiki emngcwabeni wesihlobo, futhi engatholakali nasocingweni.Izihlobo zakhe zibhale ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, zicela ukufuniswa yena, nokuyilapho okuvele khona abathi bambona e-Cappello.
IPHINI likaMengameli we-ANC nezwe, uMnuz Paul Mashatile, ligxibhe iqembu elibusa ngokubambisana ne-ANC, i-DA, liyisola ngokushaya indiva izindawo ezihlala abantu abamnyama esifundazweni iWestern Cape.UMashatile uthe i-DA ayizinakile izindawo ezihlala abamnyama.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ehambele eWestern Cape njengengxenye yokulungiselela umcimbi wokugubha usuku okwasungulwa ngalo i-ANC.Umcimbi obizwa ngeJanuwari 8, uzokuba selokishini iKhayelitsha, ngeSonto.Isifundazwe iWestern Cape siphethwe i-DA, kusuka emva kokhetho lwango-2009.UMashatile uthe uhulumeni waseWestern Cape awuziyisi izidingo emalokishini afana neKhayelitsha."Sebezikhohliwe izindawo zasemalokishini nezasemijondolo. Banake kakhulu izindawo ezihlala omacaphuna kusale.”UMashatile uthe uhulumeni uzoqhamuka nezinhlelo zokufukula izindawo ezinganakiwe."Sizobuya lapha njengohulumeni kazwelonke, sibone ukuthi sizozilekelela kanjani lezi zindawo ezinganakiwe. Bonke abantu kufanele bathole izidingo.”Abaholi be-ANC bebesezingxenyeni ezehlukene eWestern Cape, lapho bebehambe benxenxa abantu ukuthi bahambele umcimbi wangeSonto.Abaholi abahambele izindawo ezehlukene uNobhala Jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, uSihlalo, uMnuz Gwede Mantashe, kanye namalungu esigungu esiphezulu.Ngokwejwayelekile iJanuwari 8 iyaye ibe senkundleni yezemidlalo enkulu, kepha kulo nyaka i-ANC ikhethe ukuyiyisa enkundleni encane.IKhayelitsha Stadium okuzoba kuyo umcimbi wanonyaka ingena abantu abangu-2 000.UMashatile uthe baqoke le nkundla ngenxa yokuthi abafuni ukuthi umcimbi uhlezi uba sendaweni efanayo."Njengoba nazi ukuthi umcimbi uhlezi uba sezindaweni ezahlukene, ubulokhu uba kwezinye izifundazwe, kulo nyaka yithuba leWestern Cape. Nakhona lapha eWestern Cape bekufanele ukuthi senze isiqiniseko sokuthi umcimbi awenzelwa endaweni osuke wenzelwa kuyo phambilini.”UMashatile uthe likhulu isasasa ebantwini abathembisa ukuthi bazoba ingxenye yomcimbi wangeSonto.Lena kuzokuba iJanuwari 8 yokuqala kusukela i-ANC yehluleka ukunqoba ukhetho.Okokuqala emlandweni kusukela elakuleli lathola inkululeko, i-ANC yehluleka ukunqoba ngamalengiso ukhetho njengoba yathola u-40%.Njengamanje i-ANC ibusa ngokubambisana namanye amaqembu ayishumi.UMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, kulindeleke ukuthi achazele amalungu e-ANC ngokwabenza basungula uhulumeni wokubambisana uma esethula inkulumo emcimbini wangeSonto.

UMENGAMELI Cyril Ramaphosa uhloniphe owayengungqongqoshe wokuqala wezeMfundo ngaphansi kwentando yabantu, uSolwazi Sibusiso Bengu, ngomngcwabo kahulumeni.UBengu (90) uhlonishwe ngomngcwabo wesigaba sesibili.Ushone ngoDisemba 30, kanti umngcwabo wakhe uzoba seNyuvesi yaseZululand, edume ngoNgoye ngoLwesihlanu.Okhulumela uRamaphosa, uMnuz Vincent Magwenya, uthe umengameli uhloniphe uBengu ngalo mngcwabo ngeqhaza lakhe kwezemfundo.Uthe uBengu uke waba nayinxusa lakuleli eGermany kusuka ngo-1999 kuya ku-2003.Ilokhu ingena ingenile imiyalezo yenduduzo emndenini kaBengu.

Kuthi phakathi nezinsuku sibe neka-9 ebizwa ngokuthi uVuka Nathi, bese kuba eka-6 ntambama eyaziwa ngokuthi uLala Nathi,” kusho uMncwabe.Ugqamise ukuthi okuningi umholi wabo abenzisa kona, usuke elawulwa yizwi."Kuya ngokuthi izwi lithini ngaleso sikhathi. Usuku, isikhathi okuphunywa ngakho kukhishwa yizwi. Kuvamile ukuthi kuguquguquke minyaka yonke,” kusho uMncwabe.Uthe uma usumemezile umbhobho ukuthi izwi lithi sekuyaphunywa, abantu banikwa ihora lokuthi baqoqe abazokudinga ohambweni, bese kuyaphunywa.Lolu hlangothi, yilo kuphela oluhlala inyanga yonke entabeni njengoba luneyalo lodwa intaba.AbaseBuhleni abaholwa yiNkosi uMduduzi Shembe uNyazilwezulu, banyuke izolo, bazoze babuye ngoJanuwari 24.

Ababulawe emva komfundi bebedutshulwa.Lokhu kugcine kuholela ekutheni abafundi abalinganiselwa ku-50 basoNyango basiyeke isikole besaba ukwenzakaliswa. Kuvela ukuthi isikole samabanga aphezulu sisodwa kule ndawo, iSihlahla Senkosi, kanti siKwaMusi, obekwenza abazali babafundi basoNyango babe nokwesaba.

KUPHELE amahlathi kubasolwa abathathu abavinjezelwe yithimba eliqapha ezokuphepha emigwaqweni, i-Gauteng Traffic Wardens STT.Leli thimba lithole umbiko mayelana nemoto eyebiwe kusukela enkampanini iCartrack.Ngokubambisana nabaseshi bale nkampani, laba baqaphi banikele kule ndawo baythola imoto kwaboshwa amadoda amathathu abekwa icala lokutholakala nemoto eyebiwe.
Abaningi bayamangala uma ngithi ushukela uyingozi kangangokuba abaningi abantu bakithi sewabaphuca injabulo yokuba nabantwana.Bengikhuluma enkonzweni ebiseNdlangubo, ngaphandle kwaseMpangeni, ngathi uma uthatha okwenziwa ushukela emzimbeni ukuqhathanisa nokwenziwa utshwala, noma ungathini, utshwala abuliboni elidlalayo.Imisebenzi eyingozi kashukela iphuma lena ngamalengiso, ngikhuluma ngendlela ushukela nakho konke okunoshukela okuyingozi ngakho emizimbeni yethu.Noma kunjalo abantu bakithi bayaqhubeka noshukela, izinkwa, nama-chips, iziphuzo ezihlohlozayo, ijusi, amakhekhe nakho konke okwenziwe ngofulawa, abantu bayaqhubeka nokudla izidlo ezithengwa ezitolo ezidayisa ukudla okubandisiwe okumele ukufudumeze, basaqhubeka nokudla kwasezitolo ezidayisa ukudla okusheshayo, siyaqhubeka nokudla olamthuthu, ama-braai pack, inyama ethoswayo neshiswayo, sidle inyama esibandisiwe yakhishwa i-fibre bafaka amakhemikhali bese bethi basishisela yona. Sesiyojabula nathi sibambe olayini abade, olayini bokuyozikhunga, sizimbele imigodi. Kwenzenjani sizwe sakithi, yini sikhethe ukuziqobela ogodweni ngisho sesibona pho?Namhlanje asikhulume ngalo shevu owushukela nakho konke ukudla okufakwe ushukela, sibukisane lapha sekubangela ukuthi abantwana bangatholakali. Isimo esibuhlungu lesi ngokuphindiwe, ikakhulukazi uma uzolokhu uya uphindaphinda bakutshele ukuthi konke kuhamba kahle, abayiboni inkinga. Kuhamba kahle kanjani ube wena inkinga ingamandla? Uma uyisiguli usuke udinga okungenani uchazelwe kuthiwe nansi imbangela noma nakhu esicabangela ukuthi kungumsusa. Kulungile uma bezothi ngeke sikwazi ukukusiza kodwa hhayi kuthiwe konke kuhamba kahle, ngibe mina nginenkinga engaka?Ngeshwa abantu abaningi kuba yiyona mpendulo abayitholayo, abanye sebaphila nayo le mpendulo yaze yaba umngani wabo. Yisimo esinjena esenza ukuthi ngihlushwe umxhwele othi akulungile uma kuzoba nje. Kwesinye isikhathi basuke bengakuphumulisanga abasemzini besina bezibethela kuwe okanye nje nawe usuhlushwa ngunembeza ozothi "mina...kanjani nje?Imbangela enganakiwe ekungatholini abantwana kungaba ngowesifazane noma owesilisa, wukuhluleka okanye ukuzabalaza okudlulele kwenhlayiyana ebizwa ngokuthi yi-homorne, ukungenisa ngaphakathi esibayeni sakhona izingcwecwana zikashukela. (Siyazibona izinkinga zikashukela nokunoshukela kungaba noma yini). Lokhu kuholela ekutheni inhlayiyana esithe yi-homorne, igcwale ezindaweni ezahlukene bese idala ukugula. Ezinye zezindawo ezigxishelana kuyo inhlayiyana, isidleke esipheka amaqanda kowesifazane. Inhlayiyana ifike yenyuse ukukhiqizwa kwenye yezinhlayiyana eziyimbewu yesilisa. Imbewu yesilisa izokusondeza esiliseni yingakho abanye besifazane abangabatholi abantwana ubuso buba neziboya zabesilisa, izwi lishintshe libe yisihosho, kumile ihwanqa nezinye iziboya, kwande izinduna ezinenkani ebusweni.Ngifisa ukugcizelela ukuthi akuyena wonke umuntu onengqinamba yokungabatholi abantwana abazoba nalezi zimpawu futhi azibikhona zonke ngesikhathi esisodwa. Isifo lesi sibizwa ngokuthi yi-PCOS (Polycystic Ovarian Syndrome). Kubalulekile ukuthi sikhumbuzane ukuthi uma ungabatholi abantwana, sewuphuma wangena isikhathi, hamba uye kudokotela ozokusebenza ngokuvulelekile, akuhlolisise, hhayi umuntu ozovele agijimele ukukuthatha lawo magazi ekugcineni ungasizakali.Abantu bakithi abafunde ukuyilwela into abayifunayo, odokotela bangabantu bangaba sephutheni.Kwabesilisa kubona kuba kabili; ukwenyuka kwenhlayiyana egazini nayo ebangwa ukudla okusashukela kakhulu nawo uqobo ushukela, kudala imbewu yesilisa ingaqini okanye imbewu ibe ncane ngamanani, ingabi nayo imisila kokunye ingabi nawo amakhanda. Le mbewu ayifiki ndawo futhi ngeke ikwazi ukuchamselisa iqanda lesifazane.Okwesibili; lezi nhlayiyana ziyasuka ziyovala imithambo ezohamba igazi eliya endukwini bese induku ingavuki kokunye iwele phakathi kowesifazane, ihluleke ukuqhubeka. Asikhumbule ukuthi induku ivuswa yigazi elingena endukwini bese iyaqina.Ngiyafisa sisekulesi sihloko sikhumbuzane ngenye yezimbangela yokungabatholi abantwana, yona ebangwa yikhemikhali lena okuliwa ngayo ukhula ezitshalweni. Igama layo kuthiwa yi-Glyphosate. Le khemikhali igcina ingene emizimbeni yethu ijikeleze ngaphakathi. Ngendlela eyingozi ngayo igcina idale owesifazane nowesilisa angasazitholi izingane. Okubi ukuthi abalimi emazweni amaningi esihwebelana nawo kanti nathi uqobo siyayisebenzisa le khemikhali elwa nokhula. Ekugcineni uma sidla izinto ezithengwayo, siyayithola. Isisombululo: masidle esizitshalele khona.Mpilonde!

UDIDEKILE umndeni wowesilisa waseMzimkhulu, kudutshulwa kubulawa inhloko yekhaya ehlaselwe isemzini wayo ngeSonto kusihlwa.Umufi uMnuz Muzikayifani Zulu (64), kuthiwa udutshulwe ngabesilisa abamdubule ehamba egcekeni lakwakhe kungazalele muntu.Umthombo ocele ukungavezwa, uthe kufike imoto yohlobo lwePolo elimhlophe, kwehla amadoda amabili abengazifihlile ebusweni, avulela ngenhlamvu kuZulu, waphelela khona lapho.UNksz Nomaswazi Zulu oyindodakazi kamufi, utshele Isolezwe ukuthi bekuyizithuba zabo-10 ebusuku ngesikhathi kupaka iPolo egcekeni.''Leli Polo silibonile liqhamuka phesheya komgwaqo likhanyise amalambu lihamba kancane. Kuthe kungekudala salibona lisondela lizongena lapha ekhaya,'' usho kanje.Uthe ubabonile abesilisa ababili abehle kulona kodwa ubeqala ngqa ukubabona empilweni yakhe futhi akaboni nanokuthi angakwazi ukuphinde abakhombe."Engikuqaphelile nje ukuthi kukhona obefake ivesti, kanti omunye yena ubefake isikibha esibomvu nesigqoko ekhanda. Ngabe ngiqamba amanga aluhlaza uma ngingathi ngake ngababona labaya bantu."Uthe akababuzanga lutho, behle emotweni kwathi obefake ivesti wakhuluma amazwi athi: "Ya ubucabanga ukuthi kuyadlalwa uma bekutshela ukuthi uzobulawa?"Uthe yilawa mazwi abenza basole umkhwenyana kadadewabo ngoba ubehleli esongela umufi uma emkhuza ngokuthi akahlukane nokuhlukumeza indodakazi yakhe."Umkhwenyana ubehlukumeza udadewethu, emshaya ebese ebuya ezosho kubaba. Muva nje, udadewethu ubalekele ekhaya. Umkhwenyana wase eyafika wathi uzolanda umakoti wakhe ngodli. Kuthe uma ubaba enqaba wayesethi alibambe lingashoni, ziyobe ziningi izinsuku ezine ephila,'' usho kanje.Uthe nebala kaziphelanga izinsuku ezine uyise edla anhlamvana. Uveze ukuthi okubaxaka kakhulu manje ukuthi umkhwenyana akatholakali ocingweni."Sithe uma siya eXobho okuyilapho aganwe khona ngudadewethu, samfica engekho. Udadewethu usitshele ukuthi akabuyanga ekhaya emuva kokuba kade ezoxabana nobaba,'' usho kanje.Isolezwe likhulume noNkk Mbali Khumalo okusolwa umyeni wakhe (elingeke lidalulwe igama lakhe) ngalokhu, wathi akathandi ukukhuluma kakhulu ngalo. Kodwa ukuqinisekisile ukuthi ngampela umyeni wakhe umsongelile uyise."Kubuhlungu ukuthi kubulawe ubaba ongizalayo ngendlela engaqondakali ngalolu hlobo. Kodwa sengilinde ukuthi lo omsongelile abuye eze ekhaya, mhlawumbe kukhona azongitshela khona,'' kusho uNkk Khumalo ngamafuphi.Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kwamaphoyisa ayiphumelelanga, kuze kwashaya esokushicilela.
ANGAZITHOLA ekhishwa ePhalamende umholi we-MK, uDkt John Hlophe, uma kungaphumelela isiphakamiso senhlangano i-Council for the Advancement of the South African Constitution (Casac).I-Casac ithe izokwenza isiphakamiso sokuthi iPhalamende lishaye umthetho ovimba labo asebeke bakhishwa ezikhundleni ukuba babe ngamalungu ePhalamende.Kumalungu ePhalamende ake akhishwa ezikhundleni kukhona umholi we-MK, uHlophe, owaxoshwa kwesokuba umengameli wamajaji esifundazweni iWestern Cape.Udaba lukaHlophe ePhalamende lususe umsindo ngesikhathi eqokelwa ekomitini eliphakamisa amagama abazokuba amajaji, i-Judicial Service Commission (JSC).Izinhlangano okukhona kuzo i-DA zikuphonsela inselelo ukuqokelwa kukaHlophe ekomitini.Inkantolo yagcina ikhipha isivimbelo esinqanda uHlophe ukuba ahambele imihlangano ye-JSC kuze kuba kuphuma isinqumo esicelweni sokuthi akhishwe kuleli komiti.Isikhulu esiphezulu kwi-Casac, uMnuz Lawson Naidoo, sithe bafuna ukuthi umthetho ungabavumeli abakhishwe ezikhundleni ukuba babe amalungu ePhalamende."UMthethosisekelo awuvumeli umengameli okhishwe esikhundleni ukuba aphinde aphathe esinye isikhundla. Ngebhadi-ke awukho umthetho ovimba abakhishwa ezikhundleni zokuba amajaji ukuba baphathe ezinye izikhundla. Lena yinto okufanele ilungiswe.”Omunye ongathelwa amachaphazelo u-Advocate Busisiwe Mkhwebane osanda kujoyina i-MK ehlubuka kwi-EFF abeyimele ePhalamende. U-Adv Mkhwebane wachithwa ekubeni wuMvikeli woMphakathi.
ZIZOTHWALWA uhulumeni izindleko zomngcwabo wabayisishiyagalombili ababhubhe engozini yomgwaqo eMandaba, eNkandla ngoMsombuluko.Lokhu kuvezwe uMphathiswa woMnyango wezokuThutha KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Siboniso Duma ngoLwesine ehambele imindeni yabashonile eMatshana, eZimpisini, khona eNkandla.ISALE oboqoke kanje itekisi ebithwele abayisishiyagalombili abashone engozini eMandaba, eNkandla Kwabashonile, okuvele ukuthi bonke bahlobene, kukhona uDudu Majola (54), Ntombifuthi Majola (51), Nokubonga Majola (31), Xolile Khanyile (51), Busisiwe Khanyile (49), Silindile Khanyile (34), Nomfundo Khanyile (30) noMbali Biyela (30).Kuthiwa abafi, bonke abangabesifazane, behlelwe yingozi beya emshadweni wesihlobo ngasendaweni yesigameko.Kubikwa ukuthi itekisi ebibathwele ishayisene nenye ebinenkinga yamabhuleki, yagingqika, yaphenduka amahlandla amaningi endaweni eyehlelayo eceleni komgwaqo.Eduduza imindeni uDuma, uthe bayakuqonda ukuthi ukulahleka kwemiphefumulo yalaba besifazane obekuthenjelwe kubo kuza nosizi nobunzima emindenini."Yingakho siwumnyango sithi sizolekelela ngazo zonke izindleko zomngcwabo, siqinisekise ukuthi abahambile baphelezelwa ngendlela enesizotha,” kusho uDuma.Uphinde wathi uMnyango wezeMpilo abasebenzisana nawo kulolu daba uzolekelela ngokuthi uqinsekise ukuhlinzwa kwezidumbu ngokushesha.Uthe imindeni izophinde inikezwe nosizo lokwelulekwa ngokomqondo, ngesikhathi kusondezwa eduze nabe-Road Accident Fund ukuzothatha imininingwane mayelana nezinxephezelo zabashone ngengozi.Okhulumela umndeni wakwaMajola, uMnuz Vezi Majola uthe bayaluthakasela usizo abazolunikwa uhulumeni."Siyabonga ukulekelelwa okufaka phakathi uxhaso lokudla, kanjalo nokuthwalelwa izindleko zomngcwabo njengoba uhulumeni ethembisa,” kusho uMajola.Umngcwabo wabafi, okulindeleke ukuthi wenziwe inkonzo eyodwa, uzoba ngempelasonto.
BAWUQALE kabi unyaka abahlali basemijondolo esemgwaqweni uForeman, eClare Estate, eThekwini, beshelwa izakhiwo zabo ngoNcibijane.Kulesi sigameko, kushe kwangqongqa imijondolo engu-43, kwasala abantu abangu-83 bengenazo izindawo zokufihla amakhanda.Okhulumela uMasipala weTheku, uMnuz Mdu Ncalane uthe uphiko lwezinhlekelele eThekwini luzophenya kabanzi ngembangela yomlilo oshiye kukhalwa. ISHE yangqongqa imijondolo esemgwaqweni uForeman, eClare Estate, eThekwini Isithombe: SIGCICNIWENgokusho kwakhe, kwabakhahlamezekile kukhona nezingane ezincane."Ngenhlanhla abekho okubikwe ukuthi bashonile noma balimele,” kusho uNcalane.Uqhube wathi abezimo eziphuthumayo benze konke okusemandleni ukucima umlilo nokulekelela labo abakhahlamezekile."Okwamanje ayikaziwa imbangela yomlilo, abethimba lezinhlekelele basazoyiphenya,” kusho uNcalane.Uveze ukuthi bakhona abezinhlangano ezingenzi nzuzo abese besondele kule ndawo ukuzonikezela ngosizo olwehlukahlukene kulabo abagilekile.Uthe inombolo yokubika ngezigameko eziphuthumayo kumasipala ithi 031 361 0000, kanti umphakathi ungayisebenzisa noma inini.
UMENGAMELI Cyril Ramaphosa udlulise amazwi enduduzo emndenini wowayengungqongqoshe, uSolwazi Sibusiso Bengu (90).UBengu, owaba ngungqongqoshe woMnyango wezeMfundo wokuqala ngaphansi koMbuso wentando yeningi, ushone ngoMsombuluko elele emzini wakhe.URamaphosa uthe izwe lilahlekelwe umholi oqavile ngokushona kukaBengu."Sizwelana noMama uFuneka (unkosikazi kaBengu) kanye nomndeni wonke kulesi sikhathi esinzima.”Umengameli uthe uBengu wenza izinguquko ezinqala ngesikhathi ephethe uMnyango wezeMfundo."Wasivulela indlela. Ngesikhathi kungena uhulumeni wentando yabantu, kuningi ukucwasa okwakukhona kwezemfundo. "Kwakungafundwa into eyodwa ezikoleni. UBengu wafika nezinhlelo ezaholela ekutheni kufundwe into eyodwa ezikoleni. Siyohlezi siwakhumbula amagalelo akhe.”Ngaphandle kokuba ungqongqoshe, uBengu uke waba inxusa lakuleli eGermany, phakathi kuka-1999 no-2003.Izinhlelo zomngcwabo bezingakamenyezelwa.
UMASIPALA weTheku uthi bazojeza labo abavele bachame okanye bazikhulule ezindaweni ezingafanele.Usho kanje ngenxa yokwanda kwabantu abavele bechame esidlangalaleni, bayeke ukungena emathoyilethi. Abanye abayinkathazo abalahla itshe lentaba emakhoneni nalabo abadacaza udoti noma ikephi.Njengoba iTheku linezindawo ezithaphukayo okulenza liphenduke isithuvi ngenxa yobudedengu babantu abangamanuku, umasipala uzophoqelela ukusebenza kwemithetho elawula ukuziphatha edolobheni.Ukungcola kweTheku kwenza idolobha lehlelwe yisithunzi okunomthelela ekutheni abavakashi nabatshalimali bahambele kude okwelanga lasebusika.Okhulumela uMasipala weTheku, uNkk Gugu Sisilana, uthe abazotholwa benza okuphambene nomthetho edolobheni bazoyikhotha imbenge yomile."Otholakala enecala lokuchama noma ukuzikhulula endaweni yomphakathi, ngaphandle kwasezindaweni ezibekiwe uzohlawuliswa u-R500," kusho uNkk Sisilana.Umasipala uphinde waphonsela inselelo umphakathi ukuba uqinisekise ukuthi uyayilandela imithetho ukuze idolobha lihlale lihlanzekile ngaso sonke isikhathi.Umthetho kamasipala wezindawo zomphakathi nokuziphatha wango-2015 ukubeka obala ukuthi noma yimuphi umuntu olahlwe yicala ngaphansi kwawo angahlawuliswa imali efinyelela ku-R40 000 noma ukugqunywa ejele isikhathi esingeqile eminyakeni emibili, noma kube inhlawulo kanye nokuboshwa.
KUMISWE abaholi abaqavile be-MK besolwa ngokungaphathi ngendlela imali yeqembu.I-MK imise amalungu esiShayamthetho, uDkt Kwazi Mbanjwa noMnuz Thobani Zuma, kanye nemenenja ye-MK esiShayamthetho, uMnuz Sifiso Zuma.Isinqumo sokumisa laba baholi sithathwe yisigungu esiphezulu kwi-MK.Basolwa ekubhubhudleni izigidi zamarandi ezitholwa yiqembu esiShayamthetho.Okhulumela i-MK, uMnuz Nhlamulo Ndhlela, uthe abamisiwe bazobhekana nekomiti lokuqondiswa ubugwegwe."Bazonikezwa ithuba lokuba benze izethulo. Udaba lwabo ludluliselwe kumshushisi kazwelonke."UNdhlela uthe uMbanjwa umisiwe ekubeni yilungu lesiShayamthetho nasekubeni usotswebhu omkhulu weqembu, wathi nabanye bamisiwe kuzo zonke izikhundla zabo.
UPHITHENE amakhanda umndeni wowesifazane waseLovu, eThekwini, kulandela ukunyamalala kwakhe kwenye yezindawo zokudlela eMhlanga.UNksz Ayabonga Mjilo (23) kuthiwa ugcine ukubonakala eCappello ngoDisemba 24.Ngokusho kwesihlobo, uNksz Zinhle Mjilo, baqale ukuqaphela ngawo uDisemba 24 ntambama ukuthi kukhona okushaya amanzi ngo-Ayabonga, engafiki ekhaya futhi engatholakali nasocingweni.UNKSZ Ayabonga Mjilo "Bekunesihlobo ebesingcwatshwa, sonke sihlangene njengomndeni, u-Ayabonga wangafika. Simzamile ocingweni, kodwa saluthola lungangeni,” kusho Nksz Mjilo.Uthe baqhubeke nomlindela ukuthi uzovela ngoKhisimusi, kodwa kwangenzeka nokuyilapho besukume khona.Uthe ubhale ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, esho ukuthi badukelwe yisihlobo."Kukhona abaphawulile kulowo mbhalo, bethi ubonakale eMhlanga ehamba nabangani ababili besifazane,” kusho uNksz Mjilo.UNKSZ Ayabonga Mjilo Uthe okubaphatha kabi ukuthi labo bangani abangaziwa abasaveli ukuzochaza ukuthi kwenzekeni emva kokuba ndawonye.Uthe bakhathazwa nayizinto ezehlukene ezishiwo abantu, abangasazi noma ziyiqiniso noma zingamanga.Phakathi kwazo kukhona nokuthi wabonakala exabana nabesilisa bokufika baseNigeria kuyo leyo ndawo yokudlela.Kuthiwa babebukela bezijabulele ndawonye, kodwa kwabuye kwasuka uthuthuva, u-Ayabonga wabonakala esukuma, ehamba, bamlandela nabo."Kodwa asazi ukuthi lokhu kuyiqiniso noma cha,” kugcizelela uNksz Mjilo.Uthe abaningi babangani bakhe, sebexhumene nomndeni, besho ukuthi bona bamgcine nini. Uthe bonke bakhathazekile ngoba ukuvele anyamalale nje akufani naye.Uthe bayile endaweni yokudlela ukuyocela ukubukiswa okuqoshwe amakhamera kodwa bangabona kahle njengoba izithombe zakhona bezingacacile.Uthe bawabikele amaphoyisa ngokunyamalala kwakhe, kodwa bekungakabi bikho mnyakazo abawubonayo.Echaza u-Ayabonga, uthe uwuhlobo lomuntu ongenaso isibindi sokuhamba izindawo zobumnandi yedwa."Kuze kube ngcono, akhombise ukukhululeka uma ehamba nabangani,” usho kanje.Uqhube wathi okubathusa kakhulu ukuthi akalona uhlobo lomuntu ovele athule nje, uvame ukuxhumana nomndeni njalo, futhi uyabika ngeminyakazo yakhe."Nocingo akaze aluvale. Manje njengoba sekuphele izinsuku engayi nasemsebenzini, futhi nocingo lwakhe luvaliwe, engasho lutho, sinovalo lokuthi ingabe usesimweni esikahle yini lapho ekhona,” kusho uNksz Mjilo.Phakathi kwezinto angabonakala ngazo emzimbeni, i-tattoo yembali esemhlane, enye engasohlangothini lwesokunxele ebhalwe u-2001, okuwunyaka azalwa ngawo, enye ebhalwe ukuthi 11/2019 okuyisikhathi okwashona ngaso unina.Imenenja yaseCappello, uMnuz Shilesh Visran, ithe banalo ulwazi ngalolu daba, yathi namaphoyisa afikile endaweni yabo, bawanikeza okuqoshwe amakhamera."Asikwazi ukudalula okuningi ngoba lokho kungahle kuphazamise uphenyo kodwa siyasebenzisana kahle namaphoyisa kulolu daba," kusho uVisran. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uColonel Robert Netshiunda uthe amaphoyisa aseGreenwood Park avule idokodo lokulahleka komuntu emva kokubikelwa ngokuduka kowesifazane oneminyaka engu-23."Owesifazane obeqashe eQuarry Heights kuthiwa wagcina ukubonwa endaweni yokudlela eseMhlanga ngoDisemba 24. Uphenyo lwamaphoyisa lusaqhubeka,” kusho uNetshiunda.
UZOBATHATHELA izinyathelo uMnyango wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal abashayeli bama-ambulensi ababili, ababanjwe benza okuphambene nomthetho esifundeni saseThekwini ezinsukwini ezimbalwa ezedlule.Esigamekweni sokuqala uMphathiswa wezeMpilo, uNkk Nomagugu Simelane-Mngadi, uthe babikelwe nge-ambulensi ebipake ngaphande kwendawo yokucima ukoma amahora amaningi.Uthe esigamekweni sesibili, babikelwe nge-ambulensi yasesifundeni uGu, ebonakale isuka eThekwini ithwele izimpahla izokwakha."Lokhu akuvumelekile nakancane. Akudwebi nje kuphela isithombe sokungaziphathi kahle kwezisebenzi zethu ezithenjwe ngalezi zimoto, kodwa kubuye kuveze ukuxhashazwa kwezinsizakusebenza ezivele zincane,” kusho uNkk Simelane-Mngadi.Uthe ama-ambulensi awokuhlenga impilo futhi asize labo abasosizini, akuwona awokuxhashazwa."Sifuna ukuwuqinsekisa umphakathi ukuthi sizoziphenyisisa lezi zigameko, bese sibathathela izinyathelo ezifanele abathintekayo,” usho kanje.Unxuse umphakathi ukuthi uqhubeke nokuba yizindlebe namehlo abo uma kunezisebenzi ezixhaphaza izinsizakusebenza."Sibagqugquzela ukuthi bangapholisi maseko, babike ngaso leso sikhathi ababona ngaso okungalungile. Baqinisekise ukuthi bathatha izinombolo zayo i-ambulensi kanjalo nemibhalo emzimbeni wayo (i-ambulensi) ukuze kube lula uma sekwenziwa uphenyo,” kusho uNkk Simelane-Mngadi.
ISAWUKHATHAZA namanje uMnyango wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal inkinga yokukhululwa kwamantombazane asemancane esifundazweni.Lokhu kushiwo uMphathiswa wezeMpilo e-KZN, uNkk Nomagugu Simelane-Mngadi, ngoLwesithathu emukela izingane ezizalwe ngoNcibijane esibhedlela iPrince Mshiyeni Memorial eMlaza.UMPHATHISWA woMnyango wezeMpilo e-KZN, uNkk Nomagugu Simelane-Mngadi noMphathiswa woMnyango wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi uNksz Mbali Shinga benikezela ngezipho komunye womama abatete ngoNcibijane esibhedlela iPrince Mshiyeni MemorialUveze ukuthi yize bejabule ngezingane zangoNcibijane, kepha iyabakhathaza eyezingane ezithola abantwana."Kulokhu sinomama abane abathole abantwana beneminyaka engu-16. Oyedwa wabo utete esibhedlela i-Charles Johnson Memorial eNquthu. Ukhuleliswe owesilisa oneminyaka engu-22. Kuthi laba abanye abathathu batete eHarry Gwala Regional,” kusho uNkk Simelane-Mngadi.Uthe kuphinde kwaba khona amantombazane amabili aneminyaka engu-17, namane aneminyaka engu-18 athole izingane."Lezi zibalo ziyasikhathaza ngoba ziveza ukuthi la mantombazane akhulelwe emancane kakhulu. Sikhathazwa ukuthi ukukhulelwa kwamantombazane esemancane, impilo yawo iguquka unomphela,” usho kanje.Ngo-12:30 emini, umnyango uveze ukuthi bese zingu-63 izingane esezizelwe ezibhedlela ezehlukene esifundazweni.Kuzona kukhona amantombazane angu-38 nabafana abangu-25.UNkk Simelane-Mngadi uthe ingane yokuqala, okube ngeyomfana, izalwe ngo-00:05 esibhedlela saKwaHlabisa.Uthe ilandelwe eyesibili, nayo engeyomfana, esibhedlela esifanayo ngo-00:07.Ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba ekuseni eMshiyeni uthe isibhedlela saKwaHlabisa bese samukele izingane ezinhlanu, zibe zine eMshiyeni, eSt Mary’s eMariannhill zibe yisikhombisa, esibhedlela iHarry Gwala Regional (Edendale) zibe yisithupha, kuthi iNewcastle zibe yisihlanu.UMnyango wezeMpilo ubambisene nowezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi nowezaseKhaya baqinisekisa ukuthi zithi ziphuma esibhedlela izingane ezizelwe zibe sezinezitifiketi zokuzalwa, ezivumeleke ukuthi zibhaliselwe isibonelelo sikahulumeni, zibhalise khona lapho.
UMENGAMELI Cyril Ramaphosa utusa umsebenzi owenziwe uhulumeni wokubambisana onyakeni wawo wokuqala uphethe.URamaphosa uthe uhulumeni wokubambisana owakhiwe amaqembu angu-10 ukwazile ukwenza okuningi esikhathini esifishane usemandleni.Ukusho lokhu emyalezweni wakhe wokufisela abakuleli unyaka omusha onezibusiso.Emyalezweni wakhe, uRamaphosa uthe isheshe yathela izithelo imisebenzi kahulumeni wokubambisana ongene emva kokhetho lwanyakenye."Umnotho wethu uyakhula, baningi abantu abathola imisebenzi. UMHOLI we-MK, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, ufunga ngokuthi basazoqhubeka nokubhincisela nganxanye amanye amaqembu nakulo nyaka owethwese.UZuma uthe i-MK izoqhubeka lapho igcine khona ngonyaka owedlule.Ukusho lokhu emyalezweni wakhe wokufisela abakuleli unyaka omusha onezibusiso.I-MK ifike kwezwakala njengoba yalala isithathu okhethweni lukazwelonke olwalungoMeyi, yahamba phambili ngamavoti esifundazweni iKwaZulu-Natal.UZuma uthe i-MK yafohla bezama ukuyivimba okhethweni lwanyakenye."Sasifisa ukunqoba ukhetho ngamalengiso kodwa akwangenzeka ngenxa yokuthi savinjwa yilabo ababengafuni ukusibona siphumelela. Nakuba bazama ukusivimba, sakwazi ukufika lapho esikhona njengamanje. Yize sinonyaka sifikile, amaqembu amaningi ezwa ngathi.”Uqhube ngokuthi kuningi abazokwenza kulo nyaka, wabalula kakhulu ukufeza izethembiso abazenza ngaphambi kokhetho.Uphethe ngokunxusa abantu bakuleli ukuba baqhubeke nokulwela ukuba kufezwe izidingo zabo.
ISIMO sakhe sempilo asizange simvimbe ukuthi aqhubeke nokufeza iphupho lakhe lokuba umlimi, owesifazane wasoYaya eShowe onesifo esingajwayelekile.UNksz Thandeka Nkwanyana (36) wahlaselwa yi-fibrous dysplasia, okuyisifo sokukhula kwamathambo mawala.Lesi sifo okuthiwa asejwayelekile futhi aselapheki, senza wonke amathambo asemzimbeni womuntu avuvukale.Amalunga omzimba okusheshe kugqame kuwo ukuthi umuntu uphethwe yilesi sifo yizandla noqukula, okuvele kuvuvukale bese kuyagoba.Kuthiwa umuntu ophethwe yiso, uhlale esezinhlungwini ngenxa yokuthi ehlale enkenketha amathambo.UNksz Nkwanyana uthe siyinto eyamqala esanda kuzalwa kodwa yaya ngokuba yimbi esekhulile."Ngangifisa ukuba usonhlalakahle, okwagcina kungenzekanga ngoba ngagcina ngisiyeka isikole ngoba ngangihlale ngilaliswa esibhedlela,” kusho uNksz Nkwanyana.Uqhube wathi uthando lwezolimo lwatshaleka ngesikhathi kushabalala iphupho lokuba usonhlalakahle."Ngaqala ngalima udedangendlale wensimu onalo lonke uhlobo lwemifino ukuze ngikwazi ukuziphilisa. Angigcinanga lapho, ngaphinde ngaphemba isibaya sezinkomo nesezimbuzi,” kusho uNksz Nkwanyana.Uthe isivuno sakhe uye asidayise bese ethola imali yokuziphilisa.Nokho uthe izinkinga ezifana nesomiso nokungabi bikho kwamanzi enele endaweni kumbuyisela emumva."Bese nginezinkomo eziyishumi, kodwa sengisele neziyisithupha kulandela ukufa kwezine. Izimbuzi zona kusele eziyisithupha, kade nginezingu-12,” kusho yena.Uveze ukuthi ukhathazekile nangensimu yakhe, athi akanawo amandla okuyibiya, nathi kumbuyisela emumva uma ukugula kumlalisa esibhedlela."Ngibuya kungene izinkomo ensimini,” usho kanje.Uthe uyawuthanda umsebenzi wokuba wumlimi, wathi umsiza ukuthi aziphilise aphinde akhokhele nezindleko ezidalwa wukugula.

Sithanda ukugcizelela ukuthi iSABC News ilawulwa yimigomo, izimele futhi izinqumo ezithinta zonke izindaba zithathwa lapho kusebenzela khona izintatheli, akugxambukeli ongasebenzi khona,” kusho uMmoni.I-IOL enguzakwabo weSolezwe, ibike ukuthi iFlySafair, ithe lo wesifazane isimfake ohlwini lwabantu abavaliwe ukugibela amabhanoyi ayo.Kwi-vidiyo uNobuntu uzwakala efaka negama le-ANC.Esitatimendeni, i-ANC ikugxekile ukuziphatha kwakhe yaziqhelelanisa nesenzo sakhe, yathi azihambisani nemigomo yenhlangano."Ngisho ngabe uyilungu le-ANC kodwa sithanda ukukubeka kucace ukuthi akukho muntu onelungelo lokuziphatha ngale ndlela engamukelekile ikakhulu esebenzisa budedengu igama le-ANC. Sesijube uphenyo ngobulungu bakhe. Noma kuqinisekiswa ukuthi uyilungu kodwa ukuziphatha kwakhe akwamukelekile futhi kuyahlambalaza,” kusho i-ANC esitatimendeni.Ekhasini okuvela ukuthi ngelakhe uNobuntu, bekufakwe umbhalo osuphinde wasuswa othi ubehlaselwa. Uthe udaba selusezandleni zabameli bakhe.

Njengengxenye yomkhankaso ka 2024/2025 i-"For Every Kind of Tough”, igama yezicathulo ehamba phambili i-Toughees inikeza imindeni yase South Africa ithuba lokuwina ingxenye yayo engu R200,000 womklomelo ongukheshi.Kusuka manje kuya kumhlaka 14 February 2025, noma ubani othenga ipheya lezicathulo zesikole ama-Toughees, estolo noma online, angangenela lomcintiswano azibeke ethubeni lokuwina kakhulu.Lena kuyingxenye yomkhankaso ojabulisayo wamaToughees i-"For Every Kind of Tough”. Kodwa-ke ukuzimisela nokuzinikela emsebenzini wakhe kumenze wafinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu kwambeka endaweni ephezulu emdlalweni wombhoxo eNingizimu Afrika, ukusuka eqenjini elisemazingeni aphansi e-club rugby waze wafinyelela ezingeni lamazwe ngamazwe neqembu lamaBhokobhoko.Ama-Toughees e-"For Kind Of Tough” akhiqizwa ngokuziqhenya umkhiqizi iBata Loskop ezintabeni zase Drakensberg.Sekuyiminyaka engaphezu kwengu-70 loluhlobo lwezicathulo luthenjwa abazali ngezinga yalo ephakeme, nokuhlala isikhathi eside, nokuqina ngokwanele ukuze lumelane nobunzima bendawo okudlalwa kuyo nasekilasini.UTrevor Mkhize oyi-Brand Manager for School eBata South Africa, uthe abazali babheka izicathulo zesikole ezingakhululekile ekukhuleni kwezinyawo kuphela kodwa futhi eziqinile, ongazethemba nezihlala isikhathi eside. Sehlile isibalo sezingane ezibelethwe ngosuku lukaKhisimusi kuleli uma kuqhathaniswa neminyaka edlule.Umnyango wezeMpilo kuleli uveze ukuthi kulo nyaka, zingu-1 360 izingane ezibelethiwe ezikhungweni zezempilo kuleli.Esitatimendini uveze ukuthi ngo-2023, zingu-1 708 izingane ezabelethwa ngoKhisimusi."Ayisithupha amawele amukelwe ngempumelelo ngalolu suku. Ingane yokuqala ibelethwe esibhedlela oSindisweni eThekwini ngo-12 ebusuku, elandelayo yabelethwa kusadlule umzuzu owodwa kushaye u-12 ebusuku, esibhedlela iNkhensani, eLimpopo.”Isitatimende sithe isifundazwe iGauteng isona esibe nesibalo esiphezulu sezingane ezibelethiwe ngezingu-393.Silandelwa i-Eastern Cape, ngezingu-196, bese kuthi iWestern Cape neLimpopo zibambane ngezingane ezingu-172, isifundazwe ngasinye. EMpumalanga zingu-152, eNorth West zingu-102, eFree State zingu-79, kuthi iNorthern Cape zibe ngu- 49.Izibalo zezingane ezibelethiwe bezimi ku-42 KwaZulu-Natal, njengoba bekusalindwe izibalo zokugcina. Kube nesikhalo ngezingane ezibelethe zincane.

Uhlabela phambili uMnyango weMfundo eyisiSekelo kuleli ngokushicilela imiphumela ka-Matric emaphephandabeni.Umnyango ukwenza lokhu phezu kokuba i-Information Regulator, isifake isicelo esiphuthumayo enkantolo sokuvimba ukushicilelwa kwale miphumela.Lesi sicelo sizolalelwa enkantolo ngoJanuwari, 7, 2025. Okhulumela umnyango uMnuz Elijah Mhlanga, uthe bayitholile incwadi ye-Information Regulator, mayelana nokuvimba ukushicilelwa kwemiphumela.Uthe ngasohlangothini lo mnyango zonke izinhlelo zokuyishicilela zisami kanjalo njengoba kuhleliwe. "Sizolinda kuze kuphume esinye isinqumo senkantolo esizothi asingayishicileli imiphumela ngoba isinqumo esisilandelayo, esango-2022, lapho saphoqwa ukuthi siyishicilele,” kusho uMhlanga.Uthe i-AfriForum, yaya enkantolo ifuna ukuthi ishicilelwe, yingakho belandela lesi sinqumo."Siyolalela okushiwo yinkantolo ngalolu daba. Kodwa okwamanje imiphumela sizoyishicilela emaphepheni,” kusho uMhlanga.UNgqongqoshe walo mnyango uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, uyomemezela imiphumela ka-matric ngoJanuwari 13, 2025, bese izifundazwe ziyikhipha ngakusasa ngoJanuwari 14, 2025.Abafundi bayilanda ezikoleni ngoJanuwari 14, 2025.I-Information Regulator ifuna ukuvimba ukushicilelwa kwale miphumela ngoba ufuna umnyango uqale uthole imvume kuwona wonke umfundi obhale leli banga, yokuthi ishicilelwe imininingwane yabo.Umnyango uvele ushicilela kuphela izinombolo zabafundi ababhalile, awusasebenzisi amagama abo.

Ukushuba kwesimo eMozambique sekwenze inkampani yamabhanoyi i-Airlink, iyamisa ukuhamba kwamabhanoyi asuka kuleliya lizwe eza kuleli.
