I-ANC Youth League (ANCYL) ifuna konke kucace bha okwekati elimhlophe ehlungwini mayelana no-R500 million ozosetshenziswa ukuxhasa izipaza zaseNingizimu Afrika.Lolu phiko lwentsha luthe akukacaci ngohlelo lwalabo abazohlomula kule mali, lwathi lokhu kwenza kube nongabazane ngenqubo ezosetshenziswa. Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa umemezele ngenyanga edlule ukuthi kuzosungulwa isikhwama sika-R500 million esizosiza osomabhizinisi abancane emalokishini nabasemakhaya, okuhlanganisa nezipaza. Lesi kuzoba yisikhwama esihlanganyelwe esizobe siphethwe wuMnyango wezoHwebo, iziMboni, nokuNcintisana noMnyango wokuThuthukiswa kwamaBhizinisi amaNcane.I-ANCYL ifuna kucaciswe izinto nje, yingoba phambilini abantu baseNingizimu Afrika, bebone lukhulu ngenkohlakalo nxa kufakwa imali ezinhlelweni ezithile wuhulumeni. Ngesikhathi kuhlasele ubhubhane lwe-Covid-19 kwasala kukhalwa ngenkohlakalo, izizumbulu zemali sezehliswe ngemilenze.UNobhala we-ANCYL eGauteng, uNksz Mpume Sangweni, uthe ingxenye yalolu xhaso kumele iye kwizipaza eziphethwe yintsha."Kuyinto ebaluleke kakhulu ekubhekaneni nokuntuleka kwemisebenzi entsheni nasekubekeni abantu abasha njengababambe iqhaza ekufukuleni umnotho. Lesi sinyathelo kufanele sibe yimbangela yoguquko oluphusile kwezomnotho ezinguquko kwezenhlalo. I-ANCYL eGauteng itusa uhulumeni ukuthi afake isandla ngokushesha aguqule indlela yokusebenza kwezipaza nokuthi zibhaliswe" kusho uNksz Sangweni.Uthe uphiko lwentsha lukhathazekile ngezinselelo zokubhalisa izipaza nesikhathi ebesinqunyiwe njengoba sigcine sihlehliselwa uFebhuwari 28."Nakuba inhloso yokubhaliswa kwezipaza incomeka, ukubulawa kwabantu kube yinhlekelele kwezokuphatha, eveza nenkohlakalo, ukungasebenzi ngendlela kukahulumeni ezingeni lomasipala. Yize kungathi ukulandelwa komthetho kubukeka kuyikhambi, kodwa iziphathimandla ziyaqhubeka nokushaya indiva imigoqo yesakhiwo ephazamisa ukukhula komkhakha ongekho emthethweni," usho kanje.Uthe okukhathaza kakhulu izigameko zezakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika ezibhalisa amabhizinisi egameni labantu bangaphandle abangenazo izincwadi. Uthe lokho kuveza obala ukungalingani emnothweni nokungabi namthetho kwezwe.Khonamanjalo, uNgqongqoshe wezokuThuthukiswa koMnotho eGauteng, uMnuz Lebohang Maile esitatimendeni asikhiphe muva nje, uthe ukuhlomula okuhle kwemiphakathi yaseNingizimu Afrika yinto esemqoka kuhulumeni."Yize sizibophezele kakhulu ekukhuliseni umnotho, kodwa sizimisele nakakhulu ukuthi lokhu kukhula kuhlanganise wonke umuntu futhi kungashiyi ngaphandle izakhamuzi zezwe lethu. Ukugcizelela kwethu ukuthi kulandelwe imibandela kuncike ezinhlosweni zokwakha umnotho okhulela ezandleni zemiphakathi yaseNingizimu Afrika, futhi lokhu kudinga ukulandelwa ngokuqiniswa komthetho, ongagcini ngokuvikela kuphela kodwa ohlomisa nezakhamuzi ngamandla," kusho uMaile.Uthe uhulumeni waseGauteng uyalwazi usizi abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ababhekene nalo kulesi simo somnotho esinzima.Cishe zonke izifundazwe zinenselelo yokuvela kwezinsolo zokuthi kunabantu abadakuka kukeli abazama ukuzisa abokufika ukuba babhalise izipaza. Abanye bayazibhalisa bese beziqashisela abokufika futhi okuthiwa basezweni ngokungemethetho.
BEZIYINSAKAVUKELA izigameko zokubulawa kwabesifazane ngesihluku kulo nyaka. Bezibonakala ezingxenyeni ezahlukene KwaZulu-Natal.Nokho ezigqame kakhulu yilapho abesilisa bebebulala abathandana nabo bese lokho beyokunameka ezinkundleni zokuxhumana kubonwe yizwe lonke.Iphoyisa loMkhandlu weTheku, uConstable Sizwe Ngema (27) laba sematheni ngoMashi nonyaka ngesikhathi "libulala" intombi yalo ngesihluku, uConstable Biancha Khuzwayo (24) lase linameka imizuzu yakhe yokugcina ezinkundleni zokuxhumana.NKSZ Bongeka Makhathini nendodana yakhe u-Okuhle MakhathiniKule-vidoe eyathusa wonke umuntu, uConst Khuzwayo wayebonakala ephuma igazi ngamakhala nangomlomo, egcwele igazi esifubeni.Lesi sigameko senzeka efulethini likamsolwa, enkabeni yeTheku. Muva nje uMnuz Sibusiso Lawrence Ntaka (32) waseMalangeni, eMzinto, wenze okufanayo, egwaza, ebulala ingoduso yakhe uNksz Nontobeko Cele (24) waseMandawe, ngaseScottburgh, maqede naye wazikhunga.Ngaphambi kokuba azikhunge uNtaka, ugonyuluke ngathe kuholele ekutheni abulale uNksz Cele. Lokhu ukwenze nge-video ayinameke ezinkundleni zokuxhumana. NKSZ Nontobeko CeleKule-video, lapho ebonakala esagcwele khona igazi ebusweni, uphimisele amazwi athi "nizothi nginesihluku..." bese kuthi ngasekupheleni kwayo, aveze uNksz Cele edindilizile, enamanxeba entanyeni. Lesi sigameko silanywe ngesowesilisa waseDanganya, eMgababa okuthiwa ugwaze wabulala unina wengane yakhe uNksz Bongeka Makhathini (22) nendodana yabo u-Okuhle Makhathini (3). Naye ugcine ngokuzikhunga. Yena kuthiwa wenze inkulumo eqoshiwe (i-voice note) wayithumelela umalume wakhe ngo-WhatsApp emtshela ukuthi uzobafica kuphi. Kuyona kuthiwa uveze ukuthi usekhathele ukuhlushwa unina wendodana yakhe.Kukhulunywe kakhulu ngesigameko esenzeke ekupheleni kuka-Agasti lapho, uMnuz Siphamandla Khumalo (34) abhokoda khona ngommese unina wengane yakhe (4) uNksz Nomfundo Msibi (30) phambi kwabantu eGateway, eMhlanga.Kwavela ukuthi wamyenga ngokuthi uzomkhiphela i-lay-by yakhe, kanti uzothi uma esefikile, akhiphe uhalakasha lommese, amgwaze, ambulale.UNKSZ Nomfundo MsibiOwesilisa ongumpheki, uMnuz Zimisele Dlulisa (29) kuthiwa wabulala unina wezingane zakhe, uNksz Mbali Mokokane (29) maqede wadla ukudla eceleni kwesidumbu, kwaba sengathi akwenzekanga lutho.Isigameko kuthiwa senzeka eLusaka, eNanda lapho babehlala khona bobabili.Lwaba yindaba egudwini udaba lwabesifazane ababili ababengabangani, uNksz Anele Mbokazi (29) nomngani wakhe uNksz Zizipho Gabisa (30) okwatholakala izidumbu zabo zidindilizile eKenville.ABANGANI uNksz Anele Mbokazi noNksz Zizipho Gabisa UDkt Manqoba Myeni ungudokotela oweluleka ngezengqondo, eThekwini, usihlabe wasihlikiza isenzo sabesilisa ababulala abathandana nabo bese benameka ezinkundleni zokuxhumana."Izinkundla zokuxhumana nazo zinendima embi eziydlalayo kulesi sihlava esikhona manje. Laba besilisa abanamekayo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana basuke behlambalaza. Ngempela kungani ubulale umuntu bese lokho uyakusakaza,” kusho uDkt Myeni. Uthe okubi ngalesi sihlava ukuthi kuye kuzwakale kuphela uhlangothi lowesilisa echaza ngomnyombo wesinqumo asuke esefinyelele kusona."Asibe sisaluthola uhlangothi lowesifazane naye sizwe kuyena ngoba usuke esebulewe,” usho kanje.Wexwayise abesifazane ukuthi mabasheshe baziqaphele izimpawu zomuntu wesilisa okungenzeka ngelinye ilanga agcine esembulala."Akekho umuntu wesilisa ongaqhamuka esekubulala nje engazange akuhlukumeze phambilini. Ngokujwayelekille ukubulala kwenzeka emva kochungechunge lomlando wokuhlukumezeka kowesifazane kodwa abekezele,” usho kanje.Eqhuba uthe kumele intsha ifundiswe ukuthi othandweni izinto zihamba kahle ziphinde ziguquke futhi okungasho ukuthi kukhona osekumele abulawe.Uphose inselelo kwabasuke besondelene nowesifazane ohlukunyezwayo wathi abamlekelele ukuthi abike emaphoyiseni futhi ahambe abeluleki ukuze abone ukuthi kufanele aphume ebudlelwaneni obumhlukumezayo ithuba lisekhona.UNksz Nombuso Sibisi wenhlangano, iWomen of uMthwalume uthe kuyethusa ukubona lezi zigameko zanda kangaka."Abantu besilisa bakhuliswa kabi, ukuthi kugcina izwi labo. Uma esaliwa uvele abone sengathi owesifazane usenamandla kunaye bese embulala,” kusho uNksz Sibisi.Uthe kusadingeka ukuthi imiphakathi nezinhlangano ezilwa nalesi sihlava zisukumele eyokufundiswa kwabantu besilisa ngokuthi izimfundiso zasemandulo zokuthi abesilisa babe 'ozwi lami’ azisenandawo kulesi sikhathi okuphilwa kuso.Uthe kumele kukhishwe insila esemiqondweni yabesilisa yokungafuni ukwamukela ukuthi nabesifazane banalo ilungelo lokuphumela obala ngabangakufuni.
USALE udidekile umndeni wowesilisa waseXobho okuthiwa ubulale umfowabo emnuka ngokujola nentombi yakhe.Kuvela ukuthi umsolwa elingeke lidalulwe igama lakhe engakaveli enkantolo ubulale umfowabo, uMnuz Siyanda Nxumalo (26) emsola ngokuthi umthathele intombi.Udadewabo kamufi uNksz Slindile Nxumalo utshele Isolezwe ukuthi bekungesikhona okokuqala abafowabo bexabana kubangwa le ntombi acele ukuba lingagagulwa igama layo.Uveze ukuthi intombi yomsolwa ijwayele ukuvakasha izolala kubo njengoba sekuphele iminyaka emithathu bethandana.Uthe intombi igcine seyijwayelana kakhulu noSiyanda futhi nabo bengaliboni iphutha kulokho njengomndeni."Ekuqaleni konyaka owedlule umsolwa washaya walimaza kabi umufi ebafice behlezi bobabili bebuka ithelevishini. Wayemsola ngokuthi usemthathela intombi yakhe. Umama wathwala kanzima ebalamula,'' usho kanjena.Uthe ngoJuni umsolwa waphinda waqongqotha umfowabo ngesidunu sesibhamu ekhanda nakhona emsola ngokuthi ujola nentombi yakhe.Esigamekweni sokubulawa kukaSiyanda uthe uphinde wabafica behlezi bebuka ibhola yena ephuma emsebenzini ngeSonto ntambama wavele waqonda ekhishini wadonsa ummese wamgwaza ephindelela. Kuthiwa intombi yavele yaphuma yahlaba ngejubane ibona umuntu wayo ehlasela umfowabo."Umgwaze amanxeba amabili entanyeni nasesifubeni kwale noma esexolisa kodwa waqhubeka wamgwaza. Ibuhlungu kabi le nto eyenzeke ekhaya,'' usho kanjena.Uthe akazi nokuthi umsolwa wayekuthathaphi ukuthi umfowabo umudla izithende. "Mina le nto yokuthi umfowethu acabange ukuthi umufi umudla izithende angiyazi ukuthi iqale kuphi futhi kanjani. Ngesikhathi embuza yona okokuqala ngonyaka odlule ngangicabanga ukuthi umane uyazincokelela nje kanti akunjalo,'' usho kanjena.Uthe umsolwa kuyimanje ugcwele amathafa wathi yize eyigazi labo kodwa bamdinga ezikhindini."Kumele amaphoyisa amthole aboshwe, yimbi kabi le nto ayenzile. Akusho lutho ukuthi ungowasemndenini uma nje wonile kumele ukujezele lokho,'' usho kanjena.Amaphoyisa aKwaZulu Natal kuze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela engaphendulanga mayelana nalesi sigameko.
UBEBEKEZELELA ukuhlukunyezwa owesifazane waseMpophomeni, okuthiwa ugwazwe yisoka lakhe wafa ngemuva kwengxabano ebishubile phakathi kwabo.Umufi, uNksz Amanda Malaza, kuthiwa ubulawe yisoka lakhe elisagcwele amathafa namanje.Isolezwe likhulume nomalume kamufi, uMnuz Nkosinathi Mhlabunzima Xaba, okuveze ngokusobala ukuthi umshana wakhe ubesesandleni sendoda engumhlukumezi.Uqale ngokuveza ukuthi umnyombo wengxabano yalaba ukuthi umufi ubefuna ukuyovakashela o-anti bakhe eMbali, umsolwa eshaya phansi ngonyawo wagcina ngokumbulala.Uqale ngokudalula ukuthi laba ababili bebekipitile futhi sekuphele isikhathi eside bethandana, wathi umshana wakhe ikhanda lakhe beselitobozela njengotamatisi njengoba umsolwa kuvela ukuthi uqale ngokumngqubuza odongweni ngaphambi kokuba amgwazwe ambulale.Uveze ukuthi umfowabo kamsolwa naye uthelwe ngamachaphazelo ngoba isimo sakhe sisibi kakhulu esibhedlela njengoba naye bemgwazile ngesikhathi ezama ukulamula.Uthe bathole ucingo obelubazisa ukuthi umshana wakhe usephuthunyiswe emtholampilo kanti vele bese bephuthumisa isidumbu, wathi ziningi izikhawu eziwubufakazi bokuthi umshana wakhe ubebekezelela ukuhlukunyezwa kulolu thando."Kukhona lapho ake amqongqotha khona ngesando engalweni. Ushona nje umshana wami ingalo yakhe ibingasasebenzi nje nhlobo ngenxa yokuthi wamlimaza kabi,'' usho kanje.Uveze ukuthi kwesinye isikhathi umsolwa ubeke akhiyele umufi endlini izinsuku engafuni ukuba aye kubo."Uyabona nje, kukhona isikhathi lapho umshana wami kwakufanele ayovakashela khona o-anti bakhe abahlala eMbali kodwa kwagcina kungenzekanga lokho ngoba bamvalela endlini,'' usho kanjena.Uthe kukhona isikhathi lapho umshana ayesethole khona itoho kwezinye zezitolo ezinkulu eMbali, kodwa wasebenza kancane wayeka ngemuva kokuba isoka lamyekisa, lingafuni asebenze khona.Ugcizelele ukuthi bafe olwembiza ngokubulawa kukamshana wakhe amchaze njengentombazane ebihlonipha futhi ibazisa abantu abadala.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe kalukho udaba olufuze lolu oluke lwabikwa emaphoyiseni.Kwenzeka lokhu nje, bekusabatshazwa isihluku sowesilisa (uMnuz Mlondi Cele) ogwaze unina wengane yakhe uNKSZ Bongeka Makhathini nendodana yakhe u-Okuhle Makhathin i(3), maqede wazikhunga eMgababa, eThekwini ngoLwesihlanu.Lesi sehlo silame esaseMzinto, lapho uMnuz Sibusiso Lawrence Ntaka (32) waseMalangeni, egwaze wabulala umama wengane yakhe uNksz Nontobeko Cele (24) waseMandawe, maqede wazikhunga ngoLwesithathu.Ngaphambi kwalokho, bekubatshazwa isihluku eCliffdale, ngaseHammarsdale, sowesilisa okuthiwa ubabulale obomndeni namaphoyisa amasonto elandelana.Esigamekweni esenzeke ngeledlule kulungiselelwa umlindelo kaNobuhle Majola (16) noNksz Nomfundo Majola (23), okuthiwa umsolwa wababulala ekuqaleni kwenyanga eClermont, ngasePinetown, kuvela ukuthi ubulale uNkk Thulile Majola (67) noNksz Phindile Majola (38).Akagcinanga lapho, wabulala amaphoyisa amabili asesiteshini saseHammarsdale, abebizelwe endaweni yesigameko, uCaptain Naveen Pather obengumphathi siteshi noWarrant Officer Dumisani Ndlovu obengumphathi wabaseshi.
LIGIXABEZE amalungu omphakathi angu-250 ngokudla ibandla labasindisiwe, iCottonland Restoration Centre.Umcimbi wokunikezela ngokudla ubuqhubeka esakhiweni esisha saleli bandla esiseMahlabathini eVerulam.Umholi walo uMfu Bonginkosi Hlophe uveze ukuthi lo msebenzi bawenze ngokubambisana neWolrd Light Church eholwa uMfu Daniel Abera.UHlophe uthe bashumayela ivangelo lezenzo yingakho benza lo msebenzi.Uthe njengebandla bakubone kumqoka ukuthi belule isandla njengoba kuyisikhathi samaholidi kakhisimuzi nje."Siyakholelwa ekutheni ibandla likaNkulunkulu kumele nakanjani libonakale lenza umehluko ezimpilweni zabanye abantu. Yingakho sibone kukuhle ukuthi namhlanje sikhombise uthando kumalungu omphakathi ngokuthi siwathengele igilosa kakhisimuzi,'' usho kanje.Uthe ibandla likaNkulunkulu akumele nje ligcine ngokushumayela kuphela kodwa kumele libuye libonakale lifaka isandla ngenhloso yokulekelela umphakathi elikuwona.UMFU Bonginkosi Hlophe ekanye noMfu Daniel AberaIkhansela lakule ndawo, uMnuz Fakazi Mdletshe ulincomile kakhulu leli bandla wathi mkhulu umsebenzi elibonakala liwenza kule ndawo."Minyaka yonke leli bandla liyayenza lento siyabonga kakhulu kulona kanjalo nakumholi walo uHlophe. Lokhu kusenza sibone ukuthi kuhle kangakanani ukuba nebandla likaNkulunkulu emphakathini wethu,'' usho kanjena.Omunye wabahlomulile lapha, uNkk Zandile Nxumalo uthe bayabonga bayanconcoza kuleli bandla ngokubakhumbula njengoba kuyisikhathi samaholidi kakhisimuzi.
UKHUTHAZA izinsizwa ezisencane ezisindisiwe ukuba zingabi madolonzima uma kukhulunywa ngokushada uMfundisi obebopha elikasofasilahlane.UMfu Smanga Mavuma ongumholi webandla labasindiswe elisoThongathi, iRestoration Family Church ubeshadelwa nguNksz Mandisa Mavuma.Umcimbi obuhanjelwe ngamalungu aleli bandla ubuseMtubatuba. Kube nomshado omhlophe kwase kuba nowesintu wasesigcawini.UMavuma unikezwe ithuba lokuba enze zethembiso kumkakhe."Ngiyathembisa ukuthi ngiyohlale ngikuthanda impilo yethu yonke. Ngizokunakekela ngiphinde ngenze nesiqiniseko esikhulu sokuthi okudingayo uyakuthola,'' usho kanje ngesikhathi emfaka indandatho emunweni.Uthe kuyinto emqoka kakhulu ukuthi izinsizwa ezisencane ikakhulukazi ezisindisiwe zisike iphethini zihambe ezinyathelweni zalaba abashadayo."Ngithanda ukuzikhuthaza zonke izinsizwa ezisencane ezikhona ebandleni likaNkulunkulu ngokuthi zishade zingesabi nje nhlobo. Kumele zazi ukuthi umshado uyisibusiso esivela kuNkulunkulu uqobo,'' usho kanjena.Uthe ibandla likaNkulunkulu liyadinga ukuthi lishumayele ngokubaluleka kokuba abantu bashade.Uthe yingakho ibandla baliqamba ngokuthi yiRestoration Family Church ngoba bakholwa ukuthi ukwanda kwemishado yikhona kanye okungabumba imindeni.Ugcizelele kakhulu ukuthi bayibandla elikholelwayo kakhulu ekubunjweni kwemindeni futhi enokuthula nozinzo.UMavuma waziwa kakhulu ngezintshumayelo zakhe ezinohlonze nezithakaselwa kakhulu ngabantu abehlukene.Ibandla aliholayo lijwayele ukuba nezinhlelo ezahlukene lapho elisuke lihlose ukulekelela umphakathi ohlwempu ngezindlela ezahlukene. Liphinde linikezele ngosizo kogogo nomkhulu ngamagilosa.
UGXEKE isenzo sabesilisa ababulala izinqandamathe zabo ngesihluku bese bephanyeka ama-video ezinkundleni zokuxhumana uNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal uMnuz Thami Ntuli.UNtuli ukhulume kanje ngesikhathi eduduza enkonzweni yomngcwabo kaNksz Nontobeko Cele (25) ehholo lomphakathi iMkakwa eMandawe izolo.UNDUNANKULU waKwaZulu Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli ogxeke ukuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nokunamekwa kwama-video ezinkundleni zokuxhumanaUNksz Cele ubulawe ngesihluku umyeni wakhe uMnuz Sibusiso Lawrence Ntaka (32), naye ogcine ezibulala ngokuzihilela.UNtuli ubuze umbuzo wokuthi kufikwe kanjani kulesi simo?"Kukhona okungahambi kahle ebantwini uma bebulala umuntu maqede bafake isidumbu sakhe ezinkundleni zokuxhumana. Uyephi unembeza? Bushonephi ubuntu kanti?” kubuza uNtuli.Uthe kubuhlungu ukuthi njengoba kusasa kuzobe kugujwa uKhisimusi, okuwusuku lokuphana, uthando, ukuthula nenjabulo kodwa umndeni wakwaCele uzobe uhlezi emanzini."Ngeshwa, umndeni wakwaCele nomphakathi wakwaCele, bazolugubha begubuzelwe yifu elimnyama lolu suku. Injabulo izobe ingekho ngenxa yokuthi othandiweyo wabo, uNontobeko, uhambe emhlabeni ngesihluku, ethathwa yisandla somuntu owafunga wagomela ngelinye ilanga ukuthi uyomthanda amvikele kukho konke,’’ kusho uNtuli.BEKUKHONA nowayengungqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa kuleli, uMnuz Bheki Cele emngcwabeni kaNksz Nontobeko Cele obulawe yisokaUthe kuyakhathaza ukuthi ngoDisemba 10 bebehambele esifundeni uGu, okukhona kuso nendawo yaseMzinto, beyokwethula umkhankaso wezinsuku ezingu-365 wokulwa nokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane."Namuhla sisesifundeni esifanayo, sizobabaza ukubulawa kukaNontobeko ngesihluku, washiya indodakazi yakhe esencane, ezokhula ingasenaye unina,’’ usho kanjena.Unxuse abasondelene nabagilwa ukuthi bangasongi izandla babukele uma kuvela izimpawu zokuhlukumeza othandweni."Ukuba kukhona okwenziwa ngesikhathi kuvela izimpawu zokuhlukumeza, mhlawumbe uNontobeko ngabe usaphila. Mhlawumbe ubezowugubha nathi lo Khisimusi ukuba kukhona okwenziwa ukumhlenga ekuhlukunyezweni okuthiwa ubebhekene nakho,’’ kusho uNtuli.Uphinde wanxusa nabahlukunyezwayo othandweni, wathi abangapholisi maseko, abaphume besaphila, ukugwema ukuthi baphume ngebhokisi.Induna yendawo, uMnuz Delani Ntobela ithe sesifikile isikhathi sokuthi umphakathi uvume ukuthi kukhona okonakele futhi okudinga ukulungiswa masinyane."Kuyabonakala ukuthi inkinga ikhona futhi inkulu. Thina sikhula, bekuthiwa ngeke umbeke isandla umuntu wesifazane ngoba umakoti akusiye owakho, owamakhehla. Ngisho kungathiwa wenze iphutha elinjani,” kusho uNtobela.Uthe umuntu owenza nje, usuke ekhombisa ukuthi ngisho noma ngabe ubezophila, ubengathi uma ebhekana nezinkinga emshadweni wakhe angabi namandla okuzithwala.OwayenguNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa kuzwelonke uMnuz Bheki Cele obehleli nomndeni usukume wathi, uke wayithi fahla emndenini kamufi eyokuthi akumele ishiywe ilenga eyengane yabafi, okuvele ukuthi unina ubulawelwe ukuthi ibinomunye uyise kokunye abulawelwe kona."Kufanele le mindeni yomibili ihlanganiswe, ilungiswe le ndaba ngoba kuzothi kusuka, zibe zifika kuyona lezi zindaba bese zidala umonakalo omkhulu kakhulu,” kusho uCele.Bekunzima kuzo zonke izihlobo zikamufi, bezisukuma zisho amabili, amathathu, zixakwe yizinyembezi, zihlale phansi.Undunankulu ubabaza eyokubulawa kwabantu kunekwe ezinkundleni zokuxhumana nje, yinto ebingaqali ukubonakala ngoNtaka.Iphoyisa likaMasipala weTheku, uConstable Sizwe Ngema (27) laba sematheni ngoMashi ngesikhathi "libulala" intombi yalo ngesihluku, uConstable Bianca Khuzwayo (24) lase linameka imizuzu yakhe yokugcina ezinkundleni zokuxhumana.Kwi-vidoe eyathusa wonke umuntu, uConst Khuzwayo wayebonakala ephuma igazi ngamakhala nangomlomo, nasesifubeni ebomvu tebhu yigazi.NoNtaka wenze okufanayo, egwaza, ebulala ingoduso yakhe uNksz Cele, maqede naye wazikhunga.Ngaphambi kokuba azilengise uNtaka, ugonyuluke ngathe kuholele ekutheni abulale uNksz Cele. Lokhu ukwenze nge-video ayifake kwi-Facebook.Ubonakala emanaphanapha yigazi ebusweni, ehefuzela ethi "nizothi nginesihluku..." bese kuthi ngasekupheleni kwayo, aveze uNksz Cele edindilizile, enamanxeba entanyeni.
UNGQONGQOSHE wezamaPhoyisa, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, uthi bangu-13 679 abasolwa asebeboshiwe ngamacala ehlukene okubalwa awokubulala, ukudlwengula nokushaya kusukela kwethulwa umkhankaso wezokuphepha ngala maholidi okuphela konyaka.Umkhankaso wethulwe ngo-Okthoba 11 eGauteng.Ekhuluma e-Eastern Cape kuthangi, uzwakalise ukugculiseka ngendlela okuqhubeka ngayo umkhankaso. Izolo ubuqhubeka eMthunzini, KwaZulu-Natal, lapho ethembise ukwandisa ukubonakala kwamaphoyisa yonke indawo ngesikhathi samaholidi."Amaphoyisa agcwele yonke indawo eqinisekisa ukuthotshelwa komthetho nokulwa nayo yonke inhlobo yobelelesi,” kusho ungqongqoshe.Wengeze ngokuthi amaphoyisa asanda kujoyina umbutho angu-2 699 ango-constable nawo enza umsebenzi oncomekayo ezindaweni ezehluekene ezweni ngokuqinisekisa sokuthi izivakashi ziphephile.Amaphoyisa amasha angu-526 atshalwe eziteshini ezehlukene nasemathimbeni amaphoyisa ase-Eastern Cape ukulwa nobugebengu.UMchunu uthe akangabazi ukuthi amaphoyisa amasha azokhathula indima emqoka ekulweni nobugebengu ezweni.Uthe abomthetho babheke kakhulu ubugebengu obuxakile ezweni okubalwa kubo ukuhlukunyezwa kwabantu ngokobulili, ukubanjwa kwenkunzi, ukudunwa kwezimoto nokugqekezwa kwemizi nezindawo zamabhizinisi.Uthe abomthetho bazokwenza lokhu ngokubambisana namaphoyisa omasipala futhi nasemingceleni yezwe kuzokube kunkanise amaphoyisa nezinye izinhlaka.Eqhuba, uzwakalise ukukhathazeka ngokwanda kwezingozi zomgwaqo ikakhulu esifundazweni i-Eastern Cape. Uthe amaphoyisa azosebenzisana kakhulu noMnyango wezokuThutha ukuze kuncishiswe ukuchitheka kwegazi emigwaqweni. Uthe amaphoyisa azobonakala ezulazula emigwaqweni emikhulu nakuleyo ejwayele ukuba nezingozi ezidlula nemiphefumulo yabantu.Uthe selokhu kuqale umkhankaso wabo ngo-Okthoba sekuvalwe inqwaba yezindawo ezihweba ngejiki ngokungekho emthethweni futhi kwaboshwa abanye ngamacala abucayi okubalwa awokudlwengula nawokubulala.NaseMthunzini izolo, uMchunu uthe sekuboshwe amakhulu abantu abatholwe nezibhamu kanye nezinhlamvu okungekho emthethweni.Uthe amaphoyisa athole nezimoto ezintshontshiwe ezingu-298 ngokunjalo nezimpahla ezingeniswa ezweni ngokungemthetho, ezingombombayi.Ugcizelele ukuthi izinhlelo zabo zokulwa nobugebengu zesekwa yizinhlaka zobunhloli ngakho izigebengu ngeke zibe nantuba ngoba bathola ngobugebengu obuningi bungakenzeki, bese beyabunqanda.
BAFUNA akhalelwe amasongo kaSigonyela omakhelwane, umyeni wowesifazane wakwa-A eSiyanda, KwaMashu, ozwakale emshaya entathakusa ngoMgqibelo, kwasa ekuseni eseshonile.UNkk Nontobeko Ntshangase uqinisekiswe njengoseshonile emtholampilo wendawo, i-Poly.Ngokusho komthombo ocele ukungadalulwa, bamzwile umyeni kamufi emshaya phakathi kwamabili, embuza ikhadi lakhe lasebhange."Ubelokhu esho into eyodwa umufi ukuthi akalazi ukuthi likuphi. Kuzwakale eshaywa, bese ezwakala ekhala,” kusho umthombo.Uqhubeka nokulandisa ngodaba umthombo uthe kuze kwavela ukuthi ushonile uNkk Ntshangase ngesikhathi kuquleka obelungisa uphahla lwendlu ngabo 11 ekuseni."Kuthiwe akuvuswe yena uNkk Ntshangase azosiza njengoba ebebuye asebenze nodokotela abehlukene, kwavela ukuthi ulele embhedeni, akavuki,” kusho umthombo.Uthe umyeni uvele wamfaka emotweni umufi, wamphuthumisa ePoly."Ufike wakhuluma eyokuthi akavuki, akazi ukuthi yini ndaba. Kuthiwa uyalele umhlengikazi ukuthi akaphuthume abize abamakhaza abazimele ukuze bazothatha isidumbu,” kusho umthombo.Uqhube wathi ngaphambi kokuthi enze lokho, umhlengikazi uqome ukuthi ahlole isidumbu sikamufi wathola ukuthi unengozi entsha ehlanzwe igazi."Wale waphetha ukubiza abamakhaza, wathi njengoba ebona ingozi, uzoqale abize amaphoyisa,” kusho umthombo.Uthe kuthe uma sebeyokhalisa umndeni, bathola udaba lokuthi umyeni umgqimuze ebhokisini lomshado (kist) umufi ngesikhathi bexabana.Uqhube wathi bathole nokuthi lophele phansi igazi likamuf emva kokushawa kodwa umyeni wabiza umfowabo ukuthi azomhlanzisa lona."Kuthiwa umbambe naye, wamlalisa kahle embhedeni,” kusho umthombo.Uveze izinsolo zokuthi bese kukudala yaqala indaba yokuhlukunyezwa kukamufi umyeni."Kukhona omakhelwane ebebeze bemcele ukuthi akashiye ayofuna enye indawo yokuhlala ngoba lo muntu uzogcina embulele,” kusho umthombo.Uqhube wathi umufi ubesecwile ngisho nasophuzweni oludakayo, kuthi uma bembuza ukuthi kungani, aphendule ngokuthi "ukuthi anazi”.Ikhansela lendawo uMnuz Nhlanhla Sibisi livumile ukuthi libikelwe ngesigameko."Impela umphakathi oseduze uthe owesifazane ubulawe umyeni wakhe,” kusho uSibisi, othe bazoya ukuyohlanganisa amehlo nomndeni ukuze bezwe ukuthi kwenzekeni.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uColonel Robert Netshiunda uthe amaphoyisa aKwaMashu avule idokodo lokufa komuntu ukuze liphenywe emva kokuthi owesifazane eqinisekiswe njengoshonile emtholampilo wendawo."Ngesikhathi amaphoyisa efika, atshengiswe isidumbu sikamufi ebesinamanxeba esiphundu nezibazi emzimbeni,” kusho uNetshiunda. Uthe ngokombiko wamaphoyisa umyeni kamufi uthe uthole umbiko wokuthi umkakhe utholwe elele emgwaqweni, kwathi uma efika kuye wamthola ephefumulela phezulu, wase emphuthumisa emtholampilo."Akukaziwa ukuthi yini eholele ekutheni alimale aze ashone," usho kanje.
ABADAYISI abangosomabhizinisi abancane erenki yamatekisi yaseSydenham, esenkabeni yeTheku, bakhala ngokuthi sebelahlekelwa amakhasimende ngenxa yokuvalwa kwezindlu zangasese eziseduze nalapho bedayisela.Lezi zindlu zangasese zikakwe yizindawo zokudla okubalwa kuzo izitolo ezinkulu ezidayisa ukudla i-Boxer ne-Check Save, bese kuba osomabhizinisi abancane abadayisa ukudla khona erenki nokunye. Uma uqhamuka nje, ukhangwa yiphuma lomchamo elithaphukayo, amanzi amnyama agelezayo kanye nendawo lapho abesilisa asebechama khona ngaphandle kwazo izindlu zangasese, babodwa nabazikhululayo. Abadayisi bakhala ngokuthi bebeze behambe ibanga beya kwamanye amarenki befuna ukuyochama noma ukuyozikhulula.Exoxa neSolezwe, uNksz Thulisile Mathunjwa onekhishi elidayisa ukudla, uthe kusukela ngo-Okthoba, izindlu zangasese zivaliwe."Njengoba amathoyilethi avalwa ngoOkthoba-nje, abantu bayazikhulula baphinde bechame ngaphandle okwenza lowo mchamo ugcine usugeleza uyongena ekhishini lami. Siyagula futhi kuze kuphoqeleke ukuthi sisebenze sifake isifonyo. "Sesibekezele kwanele, asisazi ukuthi yini ekumele siyenze njengoba umasipala usikhokhisa imali yezimvume zokudayisa engu-R1 200 ngonyaka. Silahlekelwa amakhasimende ayinqwaba ngenxa yephunga elingabekezeleleki" kusho uNksz Mathunjwa.UNksz Mandisa Mthethwa naye odayisa ukudla uthe: "Sigcine sesiya ezindlini zangasese eziku-Commercial noma erenki yaKwaMashu. Sibulawa iphunga elinukayo, ukungcola namanzi amnyama agelezayo. Njengoba sisuke sipheka mihla namalanga kumele sihlezi sinoshibhoshi. Sitshelwa ukuthi izindlu zangasese zifile, kuqhume amapayipi, yingakho evaliwe," kusho uNksz Mthethwa.UMnuz Sthembiso Mkhize ophethe abadaysi kuyo le ndawo uthe babhekene nenkiyankiya njengoba bengabadayisi."Abantu abebethenga kabasezi. Uma sithola, sizwa kuthiwa umasipala akamuholelile umqashi oqashe labo abahlanza izindlu zangasese. Abantu baxakekile, abathengi abasasondeli ngoba kunuka umchamo nendle," kusho uMkhize.Uthe umasipala waletha omahamba nendlwana bamathoyilethi kodwa babanqaba ngoba bayanuka futhi nendawo abebezowubeka kuyo iyabheda ngoba bebezowubeka lapho kusebenzela khona abantu. Uthe ngeke ubeke phambi komsebenzi womuntu indle, bacela ukuthi bawabuyisele kwenye indawo ngoba awakwazi ukusebenza kule ndawo.UMnuz Siyabonga Mkhize osebenza erenki yamatekisi aseSydenham yena uthe njengoba lezi zindlu zangasese zingaphansi kwerenki yaseSydenham, uMasipala weTheku ubungasazikhokheli izikhulu okuphoqeleke ukuthi bezivale izindlu zangasese. Uthe akusebenzeki ngendlela futhi bayacela uhulumeni angenelele.Okhulumela uMasipala weTheku uMnuz Mduduzi Ncalane, uthe ukuvalwa kwamathoyilethi kungenxa yenkontileka nomhlinzeki obekumele benze umsebenzi."Njengesinyathelo sesikhashana, izindawo zangasese ezingomahamba nendlwana zihlinzekiwe ukuze zisize labo abazisebenzisayo. Umsebenzi wokuhlanza ojulile uhleliwe ukubhekana nephunga elingahlanzekile elibangelwa abantu abachamela odongeni. Umasipala uyaxolisa kakhulu ngokuphazamiseka okudalwe kubasebenzisi abathintekile,” usho kanje.
IZIGEMEGEME ezenzeke kwezepolitiki kulo nyaka zikhombisa ngokusobala ukuthi osopolitiki kabafuni ukusibona sithule.Siqale ukubabaza unyaka uqala, saqhubeka nokukhexa kwaze kwaba uyaphela unyaka. U-2024 ube nezinketho emazweni ehlukene, imiphumela yashiya abantu abaningi bebambe ongezansi.Ibhola lisuke lahlala ngokhetho lwezifundazwe nozwelonke ngoMeyi. Imiphumela yokhetho nokwenzeka emva kwalo kushiye abantu abaningi bemangele.Okugqame kakhulu ukwehluleka kwe-ANC ukuthola izihlalo ezanele ukube iphathe ngokuzimela. Bekuqala kusukela elakuleli lathola inkululeko ngo-1994, ukuba i-ANC yehluleke ukunqoba ukhetho ngamalengiso, njengoba ithole u-40% wamavoti.JACOB ZUMAAbahlaziyi nabanye abaholi be-ANC bathi imbangela yokwehlulwa kwabo ukusungulwa kweqembu eliholwa owayengumengameli, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, i-MK.I-MK yafika kwezwakala okhethweni njengoba yaba iqembu lesithathu ngobukhulu, yahamba phambili ngamavoti esifundazweni iKwaZulu-Natal.Ukwehluleka kwe-ANC ukuthola izihlalo ezanele ukuthi ibuse ngokuzimela kwayiphoqa ukuthi iqale umkhankaso wokweshela amaqembu ezobambisana nawo.Sekuwumlando ukuthi i-ANC yagcina ikhetha ukusebenzisana namaqembu ayekade enesivumelwano sokuyikhipha emandleni emva kokhetho.Amaqembu ayingxenye kahulumeni wokubambisana, i-DA, IFP ne-FF Plus, ayenesivumelwano sokusebenzisana asisayina ngaphambi kwalolu khetho.La maqembu ayefuna ukushiya ngaphandle i-ANC uma sekwakhiwa uhulumeni wokubambisana, kodwa ukwehluleka kwawo ukuthola amavoti anele kwagcina kuwaphoqa ukuthi abuyele kuyona i-ANC.Ukwakhiwa kukahulumeni wokubambisana nakho kwaba nezimanga, sabona amaqembu anezihlalo ezincane ePhalamende ezisikela kwelinonile ngesikhathi kwabiwa izikhundla.Amaqembu amancane, iningi lawo anezihlalo ezingaphansi kwezinhlanu, anezikhundla zongqongqoshe.I-PAC yathola isihlalo esisodwa okhethweni, umholi wayo, uMnuz Mzwanele Nyhontso, unguNgqongqoshe wezoMhlaba nokuThuthukiswa kweziNdawo zasemaKhaya.I-Al Jama-ah, yathola izihlalo ezimbili, umholi wayo, uMnuz Ganief Hendricks, uyiPhini likaNgqongqoshe wokuThuthukiswa kwezingu-80, i-EFF yona inezimbili. UDIDEKILE owesifazane waseLovu, eningizimu yedolobha iTheku, okhala ngenkinga yokungakwazi ukwenzela indodana (16) yakhe umazisi, ngenxa yokuvela kwegama lowesifazane angamazi wase-Eastern Cape, okuthiwa wunina.Exoxa neSolezwe uNksz Khomibisile Mhlongo ngalolu daba, uthe uze ubhekana nale nkinga nje, indaba yonakala ngezikhukhula zango-2019, ezacekela phansi umuzi wakubo, kwacekeleka nempahla okubalwa nezitifikezi zokuzalwa zezingane zakhe ezine."Kwathi sengiyozama ukwenza izitifiketi ezintsha, esoyedwa omdala saphuma sesinemininingwane yowesifazane, okuvela ukuthi ungumXhosa engingamazi, okuthiwa uwunina. Into engidida kakhulu wukuthi kwenzeka kanjani lokhu njengoba mina nalona wesifazane sivela singonina sobabili."Sekuyisikhathi eside ngigqigqa eMnyangweni wezaseKhaya ukuzama ukulungisa lolu daba, kodwa kunhlanga zimuka nomoya njengoba kwathi ngigcina ukuya ngatshelwa ukuthi akukho abazokwazi ukukwenza ngalolu daba ngaphambi kokuthi kube wukuthi mina ngithola owesifazane ngiye naye kubona,” usho kanje.Isolezwe lisibonile isitifiketi salo mfana neminye imininingwane ekhombisa ukuthi uNksz Mhlongo useyilandele isikhathi eside kangakanani le nkinga, osekuphele iminyaka emihlanu ingalungi.Eqhuba, uthe okumkhathaza kakhulu manje wukuthi indodana yakhe, efunda kwesinye sezikole zaseMbumbulu, iyofunda u-matric ngonyaka ozayo, okusho ukuthi ngeke akwazi ukuyenzela umazisi kuze kube ulungisa inkinga abhekene nayo."Ngikhathazekile kakhulu. Kuzoze kushaye isikhathi sokuvulwa kwezikole ngonyaka ozayo, okungenza umntwana wami abe nenkinga njengoba sazi ukuthi kwa-matric kufuneka umazisi ukuwusebenzisa ezintweni ezehlukene zesikole,” kusho yena.Omunye futhi onenkinga kamazisi wuNksz Zandila Gazu (43) waseShowe, kodwa osezinze eMalvern, eThekwini. Elandisa Isolezwe ngosizi lwakhe, uthe izinkinga zakhe zaqala ngenkathi eshonelwa wunina ngo-2004, emshiya engakamenzeli umazisi.Uthe sekuphele iminyaka ewu-20 egqigqa eMnyangweni wezaseKhaya, kodwa lutho ukuthola umazisi. Uthe bafike bamtshele ukuthi akobuye abuye, kuthi uma ebuya, bamfune imininingwane eyahlukene kanina ongasekho, nayo engasizi ukuthola umazisi."Le nto iyangiphazamisa futhi yenza impilo yami ime ndawonye njengoba ngingakwazi nokusebenza umsebenzi osile, ngihlale ngibamba amatoho angatheni. Ngikhathazeke nangokuthi izingane zami ezimbili ziyakhula, okuzogcina kuyinkinga uma sekudingeka ngizenzele izinto ezidinga umazisi. Sengiqala nokuphelwa yithemba ngempilo,” kusho uNksz Gazu.Ukushaya umazisi yinto ethatha isikhathi esingaphansi kwehora bese kulindwa amasonto amathathu kuya kwamahlanu ukuthi uphume.Kuthintwa okhulumela uMnyango wezaseKhaya, uMnuz Siyabulela Qoza, ucingo lwakhe belukhala umlibe lungabanjwa, futhi wangawuphendula nomyalezo awuthunyelelwe kwi-WhatsApp.
UKHALE ngobulwane ezigebengwini uNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa kuzwelonke, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, kungcwatshwa iphoyisa elabulawa nomphathi siteshi eHammarsdale. UWarrant Officer Moses Dumisani Ndlovu, obengumphathi wabaseshi esiteshini samaphoyisa eHammarsdale, wadutshulwa wabulawa noCaptain Danasegran Pather eCliffdale, ngoMgqibelo odlule. Kulesi sigameko kwaphinde kwabulawa owesifazane uNkk Thulisile Majola nendodakazi (67) yakhe uNksz Phindile Majola (38). Laba abane badutshulwa nje, kwakulungiselelwa umlindelo kaNobuhle Majola (16) noNksz Nomfundo Majola (23), okuthiwa umsolwa ofanayo wayebadubule KwaBhontshisi, eClermont, ngempelasonto eyayendulela eyesigameko. Emngcwabeni kaW/O Ndlovu kuvele ukuthi ubesesebenze embuthweni wamaphoyisa iminyaka engu-36. Umngcwabo ubuhanjelwe nawuKhomishana wamaPhoyisa kuzwelonke, uGeneral Fannie Masemola, Isekela lakhe uLieutenant General Tebello Mosikili noKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi. USIZI belubhalwe ebusweni emaphoyiseni abethamele inkonzo yokuphelezela uWarrant Officer Moses Dumisani Ndlovu oshone nomphathi siteshi wakhe eHammarsdale, behambele indawo yesigameko okubulawe kuso ababiliUMNGCWABO kaWarrant Officer Moses Dumisani Ndlovu ubuhanjelwe wuKhomishana wamaPhoyisa kuzwelonke, uGeneral Fannie Masemola, isekela lakhe uLieutenant General Tebello Mosikili, uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi
NJENGOBA unyaka sesiwuphetha kuningi kakhulu okubonakale kwenzeka ezinkantolo ezahlukene zakuleli. Isolezwe Ngempelasonto libuyekeza amacala agqamile, ikakhulu lawo abekade eqhubeka ezinkantolo zaKwaZulu Natal.Libe yindaba egudwini icala labasolwa abayisihlanu eliqhubeka eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini, ababoshelwe ukubulawa kukamrepha owayengaconsi phansi kubalandeli bakhe, uKiernan 'AKA’ Forbes, nomngani wakhe omkhulu uTebello 'Tib’ Motsoane.Abasolwa kuleli cala nguMnuz Lindokuhle Thabani Mkhwanazi (30), Mnuz Lindani Zenzele Ndimande ( 35), Mnuz Siyanda Eddie Myeza (21), Mnuz Mziwethemba Harvey Gwabeni (36) noMnuz Lindokuhle 'Lindo’ Ndimande (29).Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi iMantshi uMnuz Vincent Hlatshwayo yabanqabela ibheyili. Sethusa abaningi isigameko sowesilisa okuthiwa washumpula ikhanda likaninakhulu maqede waligenda njengebhola.UMnuz Thabo Ntokozo Nzimande (31) wakhalelwa ngamaSongo kaSigonyela icala lakhe liqhutshwa eNkantolo yeMantshi yasePinetown.Uthweswe icala lokubulala ngesihluku uNkk Beatrice De Lange (80) esigamekweni okuthiwa senzeka ngoJuni nonyaka. Washaya ungqimphothwe watshela iMantshi uWendolyne Robinson, ukuthi akasafuni ukufaka isicelo sebheyili.Khona enkantolo yeMantshi yasePinetown, bekuqhubeka icala likathisha osolwa ngokudlwengula ephindelele abafundi abathathu egcekeni lesikole.Enkantolo yeMantshi yaseNtuzuma kungene icala lowesilisa ongumpheki uMnuz Zimisele Dlulisa (29), okuthiwa waphahlaza ngesitini uNksz Mbali Makokone (29), owayeyintombi yakhe wase edla ukudla eceleni kwesidumbu kwaba sengathi akonakele lutho.Isigameko kuthiwa senzeka eLusaka, eMaoti okuyilapho ababehlala khona bobabili.Bekubanabantu ababhikishayo njalo ngaphandle kwenkantolo yeMantshi yaseMlaza uma kuvela uthisha ofundisa esikoleni esiseThekwini, obhekene necala lokudlwengula umfundi wentombazane ophila nokukhubazeka.IPHOYISA loMkhandlu weTheku uMnuz Sizwe Ngema ngesikhathi livele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini, ngecala lokubulala intombi yalo ngommese uBianca Khuzwayo Isithombe: ZIMBILI VILAKAZILo mfundi kwavela ukuthi okwamehlela kwaholela ekutheni angabe esaba yingxenye yoMkhosi woMhlanga wakulo nyaka obuseNyokeni, KwaNongoma.Ukunyamalala kukathisha wesifazane, uNkk Gugu Mchunu (50), obhekene necala lokusoconga umyeni wakhe kugcine sekuholela ekutheni inkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini, ikhiphe incwadi egunyaza ukuboshwa kwakhe.UNkk Mchunu usolwa ngokuba ungqondongqondo wetulo lokusocongwa komyeni wakhe uMnuz Jabulani Mchunu (54), owayesebenza eyisicishamlilo edepho yasePinetown, ngaphansi koMkhandlu weTheku.UNkk Mchunu ungummangalelwa wesibili kuleli cala ngoba owokuqala kunguMnuz Lindani Phungula (30) onguBen 10, okuthiwa wayethandana naye futhi okusolwa ukuthi balihlela bobabili itulo lokusoconga umufi.Umufi wahlaselwa wadutshulwa ngo-Ephreli 10, 2022, ngamadoda angaziwa esemzini wakhe oseMariannhill.Kwasuka esinamathambo enkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini ngesikhathi kuvela iphoyisa loMkhandlu weTheku, uMnuz Sizwe Ngema (27) owabonakala kwividiyo egwaza ephindelela intombi yakhe, uNksz Bianca Khuzwayo (24).Lesi sigameko kuthiwa senzeka eflethini ababehlala kulona eThekwini. Enkantolo kwasuka umsindo ngesikhathi izihlobo zikamufi zibuza abomndeni kamsolwa ukuthi zizofunani enkantolo?Muva nje ukhale ngotshwala wathi yibona obamdukisa, usonhlalakahle uSithembile Nkosinathi Mthimkhulu (39) ngesikhathi iNkantolo eNkulu yaseMgungundlovu, imgweba odilikajele abayisithupha ngecala lokusoconga izihlobo zakhe eziyisithupha.Esigamekweni esenzeka ngoFebhuwari 6, 2021 eNkanini, eShowe, uMthimkhulu kuthiwa wadubula wabulala uNkk Octavia Khumalo (65), Mnuz Christopher Khumalo (77), Nksz Mbali Khumalo (37), Thabo Khumalo (10), Nothile Sphelele Khumalo (17) no-Elihle Sigampu (8).UMENGAMEL,I weSafa uDkt Danny Jordaan, nobeyiCFO yeSafa uGronie Hluyo nosomabhizinisi uTrevor Neethling bevele eNkantolo yeMantshi ePalm Ridge, eGoli ngecala lokukhwabanisa nokuntshontsha imali engu-R1.3 million Isithombe: ITUMELENG ENGLISH/INDEPENDENT NEWSPAPERS Elinye elibe sematheni ngelomengameli weSafa uDkt Danny Jordaan owavela eNkantolo yeMantshi ePalm Ridge eGoli, kulandela ukubekwa icala lokukhwaba nokuntshontsha imali engu-R1.3 million.UCONSTABLE Minenhle Makhaye obhekene namacala ehlukene okumbandakanya nawokukhwabanisa Isithombe: ZIMBILI VILAKAZIKukhulunywe kakhulu ngecala eliqhubeka enkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini lephoyisa elisebenza esiteshini samaphoyisa saseCator Manor, eMayville uConstable Minenhle Makhaye (27) okuthiwa watholakala nenqwaba yamakhadi.Ubekwe amacala okweba, elokukhwabanisa, elokuphazamisa ukusebenza kwengalo yomthetho nelokutholwa nempahla okusolwa ukuthi yebiwe.USphamandla Dhlomo (25) obhekene namacala okubulala abayisishiyagalolunye esigamekweni esenzeka eMlaza ngo-Agasti, 11, 2023 icala lakhe beliqhubeka eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini.Ubekwe icala lokubulala okuhleliwe oMnuz Mlungisi Zuma, Mnuz Phakamani Sibusiso Dlamini, Mnuz Maxwell Sibisi, Mnuz Regional Bongimpilo Ngema, Mnuz Thabani Ngcobo, Mnuz Mhlengi Khathi, Mnuz Ayabongwa Mbayise, Mnuz Sfundo Sibusiso Dlamini noMnuz Sfiso Cele.
KUQHUME iqupha, kwandiza nezinhlamba emoyeni ebandleni leZayoni laseXobho, Ukukhanya Kwezizwe, ngesikhathi umholi webandla elazisa esepulpiti ukuthi uhlela ukuthatha unkosikazi wesibili.Ngokuthola kweSolezwe Ngempelasonto uMfundisi Saziso Mchunu (46), wazise ibandla ngezinhlelo zakhe eqeda nje ukushumayela.Kuthiwa okususe udungunyane ukuthi wenza isimemezelo nje, sekuphele isikhathi esingangezinyanga ezimbili umkakhe uNkk Nomaswazi Mchunu (umaCele), engabonwa enkonzweni.Umthombo okhona ngaphakathi ebandleni uthi kube khona abazalwane abavele bamchapha ngenhlamba uMchunu abanye besho nokuzifikela kuyena mathupha bembuza ukuthi usithathaphi isibindi sokukhuluma ngendaba yesithembu engakaze akubhunge nekomiti eliphezulu lebandla."Kunezinsizwa ezimbili ezingabavangeli ezimane zaqonda ngqo kuyena, eyodwa yamsakaza ngempama kwase kusuka isidumo ebandleni ngoba kube khona abebengahambisani nesenzo salawa madoda kanti kukhona abanye abebevikela umfundisi,'' kuchaza umthombo.Uqhuba uthi okubone ngeSonto uyokuxoxela amagwababa echobana, ibandla lihlukana phakathi ngenxa yesimemezo sikaMchunu.Uveze ukuthi kube khona abanye abesilisa abaphuthume bayoshaya lawa madoda abeshaya uMchunu kwagcina sekudunyelwana ngesibhakela nokho yashesha yalanyulwa."Leya nto esiyibone yenzeka ibe yimbi kabi ngoba ithunaze isithunzi sebandla yasiqeda nje nya! Angazi ngempela ukuthi kuzokwenzekani ngemva kwale nto eyenzekile,'' kusho umthombo.Kuvela ukuthi uMchunu ugcine ephuma ngesamagundane enkonzweni engasavalelisanga. Ethintwa yiSolezwe ngeMpelasonto uvumile ukuthi kube khona isixakaxaka enkonzweni ngeSonto kodwa wathi akathandi ukwanda kabanzi ngaso.Ebuzwa ukuthi ngabe ucabanga ukuthatha isithembu yini futhi yilokho yini okususe udunguyane enkonzweni? Waphendula ngokuthi ngokwazi kwakhe alikho icala uma indoda engumZulu icabanga ngesithembu.Wathi kuyamxaka ukuthi kungani abazalwane bevuka umbhejazane uma ekhuluma indaba yesithembu.Ebuzwa ukuthi uphi unkosikazi wokuqala waphendula ngokuthi akudingi intatheli lokho ngoba akalotsholwanga yiyona (intatheli). Ube esevala ucingo engakaqedi ukukhuluma nentatheli.Unobhala webandla obuye abe ngumkhulumeli walo uMfu Zakhele Ngidi, uthe kuzoba nomhlangano uma kuqala unyaka wokubhunga ngokuthi ithini inqubekela phambili kulolu daba.Uthe okubadidayo nabafuna izimpendulo ngakho kuMchunu ukuthi umshonisephi unkosikazi wakhe wokuqala ngoba akasalubhadi enkonzweni nje.Isolezwe Ngempelasonto ligcine limtholile uNkk Mchunu wadalula ukuthi akuseko okumhlanganisa nebandla noMfu Mchunu ngoba ukhethe ukuhamba ngenye indlela ababengazange bavumelana ngayo ngesikhathi beshada ngo-2013.Ubuziwe ukuthi iyiphi leyo ndlela ababengazange bavumelane ngayo ekuqaleni waphendula wathi : "Ngangingeke mina ngigane umuntu ozongifaka esithenjini, ngisizonda kabi. Mina ngiyayazi imigilingwane eyenzeka esithenjini lokho ngakubona ngoba ubaba wami wayenamakhosikazi amathathu. Ngakho angiyifuni into engeke inginikeze ukuthula enhliziyweni nasemphefumulweni wami,'' usho kanjena.Ebuzwa ukuthi uhlela ukwenza njani futhi kungani engasalubhadi enkonzweni uthe okwamanje kukhona lapho asapholisa khona ikhanda. Uma kuqala unyaka uzocabanga kahle ngendaba yesahlukaniso.
UBENGAFUNI nokuyizwa eyabantu besilisa ababulala abesifazane abathandana nabo uthisha waseMalangeni, eMzinto, ogcine egwaza ebulala ingoduso yakhe, wase ezihilela.Kulesi sigameko kushone uNksz Nontobeko Cele (24) waseMandawe, ogwazwe wafa ngumyeni wakhe, uMnuz Sibusiso Lawrence Ntaka (32) obefundisa eZiphozethu Primary eLindelani, KwaDukuza.Isidumbu sikaNksz Cele sitholwe esigangeni, endaweni eqhelile emizini yabantu eMalangeni. EsikaNtaka sitholwe silenga ehlathini elingekude nalapho okutholwe khona esikaNksz Cele.Umngani omkhulu kaNtaka, uMnuz Siya Mzobe, exoxa neSolezwe izolo uthe umufi ubengayifuni eyokubulawa kwabantu besifazane."Bekuthi noma sixoxa ngalesi sihlava sokubulalana othandweni , asigxeke, ubone ukuthi le nto akayifuni ngenhliziyo yakhe yonke. Ubeze ayifanise nedimoni indaba yokubulawa kwabesfazane,” kusho uMzobe.Uthe yikho ethuke woma, esebona i-video ebiphanyekwe umufi ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ikhombisa yena egcwele igazi ebusweni."Angibange ngisafuna nokuqhubeka nokuyibuka. Ngiphuthume ekuphawuleni kwabantu, ngabona ukuthi konakele, ngamfonela, kodwa ucingo lwakhe bese lukhala lodwa,” kusho uMzobe.Uphinde waveza ukuthi umngani wakhe ubewasaba ibhadi amaphoyisa kangangoba uvele wabona ukuthi maningi amathuba okuthi usezibulele naye ngesikhathi esemfonela engamtholi.Nokho ubalule ukuthi ukwenzeka kwalesi sigameko, kumfundise ukuthi umngani wakhe ubezivalela esifubeni izinkinga zakhe."Ngabe ngikhuluma iphutha uma ngingathi wake wagonyuluka kithi njengabangani bakhe ukuthi ubudlelwane bakhe buhaqwe yizinkinga. Thina besibabona bezithandanela kamnandi uma bendawonye, kungekho okusolisayo esikubonayo, noma okubi akushoyo,” kusho uMzobe.Udalule ukuthi ukugodla kukaNtaka izinkinga zakhe zothando kuqale esethandana noNksz Cele, ebudlelwaneni bakhe baphambilini, wayebhoboka uma kukhona okungahambi kahle."Ngaleso sikhathi zase zikhona izinsolo zokuthi isithandwa sakhe asiziphethe kahle, baze babekana izandla. Ilapho esahlala naye phansi, sambonisa ukuthi kuhle bakhululane uma bebona ukuthi sebefike ekubekaneni izandla,” kusho uMzobe.Uthe unesiqniseko sokuthi ukube ubevuleleka kubo ngokuthi ubudlelwane bakhe noNksz Cele bunezinkinga, bebezokwenza konke okusemandleni ukuthi kungafinyeleli lapho okugcine kufika khona.Uveze ukuthi yena nomufi baqala ukuba abangani besakhula, befunda futhi bedlala ibhola ndawonye."Akakaze abe umuntu womsindo nempi. Ipero kaSbu, mina angiyazi. Ngithuke ngempela uma sengibona engikubone ezinkundleni zokuxhumana,” kusho uMzobe.
LIBONGA uNkulunkulu ngokuhlangana kweminyaka eyishumi lasungulwa ibandla, iRoyal Priestwood Ministries International.Leli bandla belinendumezulu yenkonzo yokugubha ukuphela kwale minyaka lasungulwa.Inkonzo ibihanjelwe ngabefundisi bakwamanye amabandla futhi ibihlelelwe esizindeni esiseWaterloo, eVerulam.Umholi webandla, uMfundisi Nhlanhla Makhoba, uveze ukuthi lasungulwa ngo-2014 kanti kuningi abadlule kukhona kule minyaka edlule.Elanda uthe kubekhona izikhathi ezinhle, kwabakhona nezikhathi lapho obekubanzima khona. Ubonge abazalwane bebandla ngokuma noma izinto zinzima. Ekhuluma ebhekise ngqo kubazalwane bebandla uthe:"Namhlanje ngithanda ukuthatha ithuba nginibonge kakhulu ngokuthi nimile naqhubeka nokuleseka ibandla, kuyona yonke iminyaka eyishumi likhona.''Uthe kule minyaka ehola ibandla uqaphele izinto eziningi futhi ezahlukene. Phakathi kwezinye zazo uqaphele ukuthi akuhlale kukuhle njalo nje kodwa buyafika ubunzima maphakathi nendlela.UMakhoba uthe noma kunjalo kodwa okumjabulisayo kakhulu ukuthi ibandla likwazile nokuthi lilekelele umphakathi elikuwona ngezindlela ezahlukene.Uthe bayibandla elikubeka phambili ngaso sonke isikhathi ukubaluleka kokuba umphakathi unakekelwe njalo nje.Ukhulume nangezemfundo waveza ukuthi bayaziqhakambisa kakhulu kuleli bandla.UMfu Nomathemba Makhoba, ogane umholi webandla uze wahlengezela izinyembezi echaza kabanzi ngohambo olude lwebandla.Uthe ukuba nohlobo lwamakholwa abekezelayo yikhona kanye okugcine kudala ukuthi baphikelele phambili.
INGWAZI yomshayisibhakela eseyathatha umhlalaphansi u-Elijah Tap Tap Makhathini eneMeya yaKwaDukuza, uMnuz Ali Ngidi : ISITHOMBE : SITHUNYELWENKOSIKHONA CELEUSEMBHIDLANGWENI wokufaka isandla ngenhloso yokufukula umdlalo wesibhakela umasipala waKwaDukuza enyakatho yesiFundazwe saKwaZulu Natal.Lokhu kudalulwe yiMeya yakule ndawo, uMnuz Ali Ngidi obekhuluma ngesikhathi kunomqhudelwano wesibhakela wokuhlonipha ingwazi kwezamankomane, u-Elijah Tap Tap Makhathani (82) owake wahlonishwa nge-Oder of Ikhamanga ngokuvelela kwezamankomane.Lo mqhudelwane obuhlanganisa abesilisa nabesifazane ubukade uqhubeka ehholo lomphakathi lakhona KwaDukuza.UMakhathini kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi wazakhela olukhulu udumo lolu kwezamankomane njengoba ayeshaya isibhakela esiqhwiza umentshisi."Sifuna ukusebenzisana nenhlangano kaTap Tap ngenhloso yokuvundulula amakhono abashayisibhakela abasebancane balapha KwaDukuzza,'' kusho iMeya.Iqhuba iMeya ithe kulokoza inhlansi yethemba ngokuthi lolu hlelo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi luzobonakala luthela izithelo ezinhle kakhulu.Ithe yingakho nje sebethathe isinqumo sokuthi lo mqhudelwane ube khona minyaka yonke. Mayelana nokuthi basebenzisane nenhlangano kaTap Tap uthe bakhethe yona ngoba le ngqalabutho iyahlonishwa kakhulu.UMakhathini uthe uyajabula kakhulu ngokuthi kube nomqhudelwane okuhloswe ngawo ukumhlonipha.Ukuchaze njengento emqoka kakhulu ukubaluleka kokuba kuvundululwe amakhono abantu abasha abanentshisekelo ngezamankomane.Kafishane ngoTap Tap ngokuzalwa ungowaseShowe. Waqala ukulwa izimpi zakhe KwaDukuza.Yaba sematheni impi yakhe nomshayisibhakela waseBrasil, uJauarez de Lima eyayiseRand Stadium nalapho uTap Tap anqoba khona ngamaphuzu.Enye impi yakhe eyaba sematheni nayo ayinqoba ngamaphuzu ingesikhathi etholene phezulu nebhokisa lase-US Virgin Island, u-Emile Griffith empini eyayise-Orlando Stadium, eSoweto.
KUBUKEKA sengathi siyahlaba isihlalo sobumeya kuMasipala waseMajuba njengoba sekuphinde kwashiya enye imeya.Imeya yalo mkhandlu, uMntwana uNdabuko Zulu, yesule izolo emva komyalelo wesigungu esiphezulu se-IFP.UZulu wesula kulesi khundla nje ubengakahlali isikhathi eside.Waqokelwa esihlalweni ngo-2022, ethatha emva kokuxoshwa kukaNkk Vuselwa Bam, naye ongazange azinze kulo mkhandlu.UNkk Bam wayekade eqokelwe kwesobumeya emva kokhetho lohulumeni basekhaya lwango-2021, wabe esedilizwa esikhundleni esahlale unyaka.Okhulumela i-IFP, uMnuz Mkhuleko Hlengwa, uthe uZulu ubehlangane namalungu esigungu esiphezulu izolo."Emva kwezingxoxo, isigungu esiphezulu sithathe isinqumo sokuthi siyalele imeya ukuba yehle esikhundleni ngokushesha. Nangempela uMntwana uNdabuko ube esesula esikhundleni njengokomyalelo.”UHlengwa akazange asidalule isizathu esenze bagcina benquma ukudiliza uZulu esikhundleni.UHlengwa uthe iPhini leMeya, uNksz Thembelihle Mthembu, yilona elizobamba isikhundla sobumeya."Amakomiti afanele kwi-IFP iwona azoqhuba uhlelo lokuqokwa kwemeya entsha.”Ngaphansi kobuholi bukaZulu, umasipala ubukhungethwe izinkinga okubalwa kuzo noqhekeko emakhanseleni eqembu.Lolu qhekeko lugqame kakhulu ngesikhathi umasipala uzama ukumisa emsebenzini imenenja yomkhandlu, uMnuz Mpumelelo Manqele.UManqele wamiselwa izinsolo zenkohlakalo nokukhwabanisa.Wabuye wabuyiselwa emsebenzini emva kokuthi amanye amakhansela e-IFP ephikisane nokumiswa kwakhe. Amanye amakhansela asola uZulu ngokusebenzisa budedengu amandla akhe.Umasipala uphinde ubhekane nenkinga endala, inkinga yamanzi. Izindawo eziningi ezingaphansi kwalo masipala ziswele amanzi. Lapha kubalwa iNewcastle, Madlangeni naseDannhauser.
ZISHIYE kukhalwa ezingxenyeni eziningi zezwe izehlakalo zokushona nokugula kwabantu ikakhulu izingane, okukholakala ukuthi kudalwe ukudla ezisuke zikuthenge ezitolo, okugqame eziphethwe ngabokufika kuleli.Izibalo ziveza ukuthi bangu-41 abantu asebeshonile phakathi kukaSepthemba, noNovemba kulo nyaka, kanti kubona zingu-38 izingane ezineminyaka ephakathi kwemihlanu no-11. Isigameko esivule abaningi amehlo, esenzeke ngo-Okthoba, e-Gauteng, elokishishini eliseSoweto, i-Naledi. Kushone khona izingane eziyisithupha okukholakala ukuthi kwaba ngenxa yamashibusi ezaziwathenge esitolo sowokufika wasePakistan.UMNUZ Joseph Sethekge, ubaba kaMonica Sebetwana ephethe isithombe sendodakazi yakhe eshone emva kokudla abebekuthenge esitolo nabangani bakhe, Isithombe: ITUMELENG ENGLISH/INDEPENDENT MEDIA UZinhle Masilela, Isago Mabote, Monica Sathege, Njabulo Msimango noKarabo Rampou impilo yabo isheshe yadlula ngenxa yale nhlekelele. Imiphumela yokuhlolwa kwezidumbu zabagilwa, iveze ukuthi badla uhlobo oluthile lwekhemikhali eyingozi yokubulala izinambuzane esetshenziswa abalimi, i-organophosphate. Izigameko zokushona kwezingane zisabalale nakwezinye izindawo njengoba kuthe ngo-Okthoba 30, kwashona izingane ezintathu, ezimbili zandawonye okungu-Owami (6) noHope (9) okukholakala ukuthi zathenga okudliwayo kodayisa esikoleni abebefunda kuso eSonqoba Primary, esiseKatlehong, ngaphansi kukaMasipala waseKurhuleni.Abafundi abangu-43 basesikoleni iNgaqa Primary, eMtubatuba, bangeniswe esibhedlela begula emva kokuthi kuthiwa belunywe yizisu. Kusolakala ukuthi bebedle amashibusi ababewathenge komunye umdayisi wasemgwaqweni othengisela abafundi ngokudla kulesi sikole. Babuye badedelwa esibhedlela emva kokwelashwa.Abafundi abayisikhombisa basesikoleni iBongucele Secondary eMthwalume, bangeniswe esibhedlella ngenyanga edlule kusolwa ukuthi babethenge amashibusi kwesinye isitolo esiseduze nesikole kodwa babuye badedelwa emva kokwelashwa.U-Ayanda Ndlovu (2), no-Okuhle Ndlovu (6) baseCabhane ngaphansi kukaMasipala uMzumbe, kuthiwa bashonela ekhaya emva kokukhishwa yizisu okukholakala ukuthi badla okuthile okunobuthi. Ilungu lesithathu lomndeni okunguCebo Ndlovu (11) kuthiwa ushone emva kokungeniswa esibhedlela nogogo wakhe oneminyaka engu-64, osindile.Yilezi zigameko nezinye eziningi nakwezinye izifundazwe eziholele ekutheni uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, azimemezele njengenhlekelele. Umemezela nje, uhulumeni wesifundazwe iGauteng, ubusuvele umise bonke abadayisa ezikoleni. Kube nemibhikisho eminingi abantu bevala izitolo zabokufika okuyizona ezigqamile ekushoneni kwezingane okuthiwa zisuke zithenge kuzona.Ukuvalwa kwabadayisa ezikoleni kulesiya sifundazwe, akwehlanga kahle ezinhlanganweni eziningi ezimele umphakathi nosomabhizinisi abancane.Uhulumeni wakuleli ushaye umthetho wokuthi bonke abezitolo ezincane, nabamabhizinisi alungisa abuye aphathe ukudla, kumele babhalise ngokusemthethweni izindawo. Wathi lokhu kuzoqinisekisa ukulandelwa kwemigomo zikangakapheli izinsuku eziwu-21 ukusuka ngoNovemba. Lo mnqamulajuqu ubukulona leli sonto welulelwe kuFebhuwari 28, emva kwezikhalo eziningi zosomabhizinisi abebekhononda ngobuncane besikhathi abanikwe sona nokugcwala kwezindawo zokubhalisa.Uhulumeni wakulesi sifundazwe, umemezele imigomo eqinile okumele ilandelwe omasipala ukulawula uhlelo lokubhaliswa kwalawa mabhizinisi nokungena kwempahla ngokungemthetho iqhamuka kwamanye amazwe.Yize umonakalo sewenzekile, kodwa abakuleli banethemba lokuthi imizamo kahulumeni ukugwema lezi zehlo izothela izithelo.INHLANGANO yomphakathi i-Delf isanda kuba nombhikisho ikhala ngezipaza ezidayisa ukudla okonakele. Lo mbhikisho ube nesandla ekutheni kuphoqelelwe obezitodlwana ukuba bazibhalise kabusha Isithombe: LEON LESTRADE / INDEPENDENT MEDIA
IZINHLANGANO ezimele osomatekisi abaxakwe izikweletu ziphakamisa ukuba kube nezinguquko ohlelweni lokuqedwa kwamatekisi amadala.Abamatekisi bafuna kunyuswe imali abayitholayo uma behambisa izimoto ezindala ziyofahlazwa, baphinde baphakamise nokuthi kushintshwe nombandela othi izimoto ezisuka ku-2006 kuya le kuphela ezamukelwayo ukuba zifahlazwe.Uhlelo lokuqedwa kwamatekisi amadala athathwa ngokuthi awaphephile, lwaqalwa ngo-2006.Ngesikhathi luqala imoto yayikhokhelwa u-R50 000, yalokhu inyuka yaze yafika ku-R151 000.Abamatekisi bathe bafuna ukuthi imali abayinikwayo okungenani ilingane nehhafu wemali yemoto entsha.Okhulumela i-Santaco, uNksz Mmatshikhidi Rebecca Phala, uthe kunzima ukuthenga amatekisi amasha ngenxa yokuthi amabhange awabathembi."Le mali esiyitholayo uma sihambisa izimoto zethu incane kakhulu uma uyiqhathanisa nentengo yemoto entsha. Kufanele kube nohlelo oluzokwenza ukuthi amabhange asethembe uma sizofuna isikweletu.”UNksz Phala uthe bafuna nokuthi kusheshiswe uhlelo lokukhishwa kwezimvume zokusebenza.Okhulumela i-National Taxi Alliance, uMnuz Theo Malele, uthe kabajabule ngohlelo olulandelwa amabhange uma ebheka izicelo zabafuna izikweletu zokuthenga amatekisi.UMalele uthe abamatekisi bagcina sebenikezwa imibandela eyenza ukuthi kube nzima ukuthi bakhokhele izimoto zabo."Ake sibheke emzileni lapho khona itekisi lenza u-R600 ngosuku. Lokhu kusho ukuthi imoto yenza uR3 000 ngesonto. Lapho kusafanele kukhokhelwe umshayeli. Ekugcineni umnikazi wemoto usala no-R2 800 ngesonto. Lokho kusho ukuthi ngenyanga uthola u-R11 000. Le mali incane kuno-R18 000 ofunwa ibhange. Incane kakhulu.” UNgqongqoshe woMnyango wezokuThutha, uNkk Barbara Creecy, usanda kusho ukuthi bayazi ukuthi abanikazi bamatekisi bakhokha imali enkulu kunale abayitholayo.UNkk Creecy uthe indaba yamatekisi angaphephile kufanele ibukwe ngeso elibanzi, wathi nabashayeli imbala abafuni ukushayela izimoto ezingaphephile.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma emsakazweni i-702.UMalele uthe imali abayithola uma behambisa amatekisi amadala kufanele inyuswe ibe okungenani u-R225 000, athe uwuhhafu wemali yetekisi elisha."Abamatekisi kufanele basale nesikweletu sika-R225 000 okungenani. Bangakwazi ukukhokha u-R12 000 ngenyanga, akufanele imoto bayikhokhele isikhathi esingaphezu kwezinyanga ezingu-60.”
KUYABHUJWA emigwaqweni yaseNingizimu Afrika ngalesi sikhathi samaholidi okuphela konyaka kwazise sekushone abantu abangu-512 ezingozini zomgwaqo ezingu-426 kusukela ekuqaleni kukaDisemba.Iningi labantu abashonayo abasuke behamba ngezinyawo njengoba bewu-45%.Lezi balo zesikhashana zikhishwe uNgqongqoshe wezokuThutha, uNkk Barbara Creecy, eTouws River eWestern Cape."Kuyishwa ukuthi phezu kwayo yonke imizamo esiyenzayo kodwa kuyakhuphuka ukushona kwabantu nezingozi zemigwaqo. Izibalo zakamuva zikhomba ukukhuphuka ngo-3% uma kuqhathaniswa nesikhathi esifanayo ngonyaka odlule,” kusho uNkk Creecy.Kusukela ngoDisemba 1 kuze kube izolo, bawu-98 abantu ababoshelwe ukuwela kuthelawayeka endaweni engagunyazelwe lokhu.IEbantwini ababhubhe emgwaqweni, abangu-70%, bakhonjwa KwaZulu-Natal, Gauteng, Western Cape, Eastern Cape naseLimpopo.Ungqongqoshe uthe lokhu kudalwa nawukuthi lezi fundazwe zinezibalo eziphezulu zabantu abahlala kuzona.NgoLwesibili ebusuku lo mnyango ube nomhlangano nabaphathiswa abaqhamuka ezifundazweni nabezinhlaka zokuthutha.Kuthathwe izinyathelo ezinqala esinye sazo okuwukuhlukanisa phakathi amaphoyisa aqaphe isimo emigwaqweni engu-20 emikhulu ezweni nalawo azogada emincane nengopotsho."Lokhu kuzokwenza sikwazi ukuqapha isimo ezindaweni okuhlala kuzona abantu futhi sinqande nokuwelwa kwemigwaqo emikhulu ezindaweni eziyingozi okwenziwa abantu. Sifuna omasipala abakhulukazi basilekelele sigade le migwaqo,” kusho ungqongqoshe.Uveze ukuthi ukushayela imoto uphuze utshwala yicala elibomvu futhi yizinto ezimbili ezingahlangani.Kuthiwa kuzobe kuphithizela iphoyisa elifuthisa abantu ukuhlola izinga lotshwala kulabo abazobe beshayela bedle amanzi amponjwana.Ungqongqoshe uthe njengoba kuvalwa emisebenzini eminingi namuhla, kuzobe kuphithizela kakhulu emigwaqweni yezwe ngale mpelasonto. Isimo esifuze lesi uthe sizophinde siqale ukubonakala ngoJanuwari 2.Uthe kuwumsebenzi wawo wonke umuntu ukuphepha emgwaqweni."Kumele silandele imithetho yomgwaqo, sifase amabhande, ungashayeli uphuze utshwala. Hamba ngejubane eligunyaziwe kuleyo ndawo, singahambi ngezinyawo emgwaqweni onguthelawayeka, uma uhamba ngezinyawo ebusuku gqoka impahla emhlophe ukuze ubonakale. Shayela ngokucophelela ukuze ufike uphephile lapho uya khona,” kusho ungqongqoshe.Abakwa-Automobile Association bafuna uhulumeni enze kube usikompilo ukuphepha kwabantu emgwaqweni kungabekelwa izikhathi ezithile.I-AA ithe akuqwashiswe abantu ngokuphepha emgwaqweni nsuku zonke kuze kungene emiqondweni yabo bakuphile.
BAKHALA ezimathonsi abafuyi baseMakhuzeni, eHighflats, belahlekelwa yizinkomo ezingu-31 esikhathini esingangesonto, zihlinzwa amasela okusolwa ukuthi asuke efuna ukuyozidayisa.Ngokuthola kweSolezwe, kutholwe izikhumba zezinkomo ezinhlanu izolo, ezingu-19 zihlinzwe ngoLwesibili, kwathi eziyisikhombisa zahlinzwa ngoMgqibelo.Kuchaza omunye wabalahlekelwe, uMnuz Nkomozomlungu Ngubo uthe zihlinzelwa emadlelweni endaweni yaseMapulazini naseMphambanyoni.Uveze ukuthi yena ulahlekelwe ezinhlanu, esehlakalweni sokuhlinzwa kwezingu-19 esenzeke ngoLwesibili.Elandisa ngaso uthe bashayelwe ucingo abanye omakhelwane ebebeyobheka imfuyo yabo emadlelweni."Bavele bazithela phezu kwezinsalela zazo. Bese kusele izinhloko, izikhumba, imilenze, nezisu,” kusho uNgubo, othe nomswane ubugcwele yonke indawo.Uthe amasela bese ekhale emuka, akekho owabonile.IZINSALELA zezinkomo ezebiwe zahlahlelwa, amasela athatha inyama Isithombe: SITHUNYELWE "Bese kusele nje amaloba ezimoto, kucaca ukuthi inyama yezinkomo zethu ikudekude,” kusho uNgubo.Uthe basola ukuthi amasela asuke eyozidayisela abamabhusha naboshisanyama abagqugquzela lobu bugebengu ngokuthi bayithenge le nyama.Ukhale ngesihlava athe sibhilitile futhi sesiyiqedile imfuyo yabo."Ifike yenzeke izikhathi zilandelana ezindaweni ezehlukene. Kubuye kuthule. Kuphinde kuqale phansi njengoba kubukeka sengathi kuqale phansi njengamanje,” kusho uNgubo.Uphinde wakhala nangokusondela kwebhizi kaDisemba, ethi mhlawumbe nayo inomthelela ekubulaweni kwemfuyo yabo.Uphinde wathi: "Basibulale siphila. Sifuna ukuqhamuka neqhinga lokulwa nalesi sihlava siwumphakathi. Mhlawumbe kungasiza uma singaba nomhlangano sicobelelane ngokuthi singenzenjani. Siyafuna nokuthi amaphoyisa angenele, asisize.”Induna yendawo uMnuz Bhekani Phungula ithe ibikelwe ngezigameko."Ngikhuluma nawe nje, ngibuya kwenye indawo lapho kuhlinzwe khona eziyisikhombisa. Yinto esijwayele ukwenzeka lena, kodwa kusishaqisile okwalezi ezingu-19,” kusho uPhungula.Uthe ezinye izaba ezingenziwa ukuthi imfuyo ingayekwa yodwa isikhathi eside emadlelweni ngoba amasela aba nesikhathi sonke eyihlinza, eyilayisha ezimotweni."Mhlawumbe nokubonakala kwamaphoyisa ezulazula kungenza umehluko. Mhlawumbe bangagcina bebanjiwe,” kusho uPhungula.Kuze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela amaphoyisa engakaphefumuli ngalolu daba.
IBHODI leNgonyama Trust lithi liyalwamukela uphenyo olujusthwe iSilo uMisuzulu kaZwelithini oluzophenya ngokunyamalala kuka-R41 million kulesi sikhwama esigade umhlaba kaZulu.Iphini likasihlalo webhodi, u-Advocate Linda Zama, lithe nabo bafuna ukwazi ukuthi kwenzekani ngalo R41 million.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba esidlweni sasekuseni izolo.ISilo, esibuye sibe usihlalo webhodi, sisanda kuveza ukuthi sizojuba uphenyo oluzopequlula konke ngokusebenza kwemali yeNgonyama Trust.U-Advocate Zama uthe kunemali eyasetshenziswa ibhodi eledlule okungacaci ukuthi yashonaphi."Iningi lenu lihlezi lifunda ngalo R41 million, nathi sifuna ukwazi ukuthi washonaphi . Ngeke siyiphike indaba kaR41 million ngoba igcwele kwabezindaba.”U-Advocate Zama uthe ike yaba khona imizamo yokuqala uphenyo phambilini kodwa yabuye yavinjwa."Eminyakeni emine eyedlule ungqongqoshe wazama ukuqala uphenyo kodwa imizamo yakhe yavinjwa ibhodi eledlule. Nansi iphinda futhi isiqala phansi le ndaba. Ngithi angikucacise ukuthi ekuqaleni kwakungungqongqoshe owayefuna ukuthi kube nophenyo, manje sekuwusihlalo webhodi ofuna ukuthi kuphenywe. "Isinqumo esihle lesi esithathwe usihlalo webhodi, futhi siyasincoma. Ukunyamalala kwale mali kwenza ukuthi sibe nemibuzo eminingi. Le nto idala isithombe sokuthi kuningi okungahambi kahle. Esimweni esinjalo kubalulekile ukuthi kuphenywe konke. Thina asinankinga inqobo nje uma kuwukuthi uphenyo luzolandela imigudu yomthetho ebekiwe. Uphenyo kufanele lulandele imigudu ebekiwe.”U-Advocate Zama uthe bafuna nokwazi ukuthi ubani ozothwala izindleko zophenyo.Encwadini, iSilo sasikade sicele uNgqongqoshe wezeMihlaba nokuThuthukiswa kweziNdawo zasemaKhaya, uMnuz Mzwanele Nyhontso, ukuba alekelele ekukhokhelweni kwezindleko zecala.Phezu kophenyo iSilo siphinde sifune nokuthi kuhlakazwe ibhodi elikhona njengoba sikhala ngokuthi alifuni ukusebenzisana naso.U-Advocate Zama uthe udaba lokuhlakazwa kwebhodi ludinga ukuba kulandelwe umthetho.Uthe uNyhontso angalihlakaza ibhodi uma kunesidingo.
LIBABAZE umhobholo wemali iJaji uKalvin Gounden ngesikhathi ligweba udilikajele uNonhlanhla Mbhele (48) odume ngelikaMama Webhantshi, ngamacala okubulala izihlobo nabangani ayekade ebathathele imishwalense yokufa ebhange i-Capitec.Ubekade evele eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini, kanye nommangalelwa wokuqala uMthofi Msipha, abakha naye isikimu sokubulala abantu bese befaka izicelo zomshwalense.UMsipha yena kuvela ukuthi iqhaza lakhe kwakungukuthola izinkabi, azikhokhele imali ebese ezinikeza imiyalelo yokuthi abazobulawa bazobulawa nini, kanjani futhi kuphi nendawo.Phakathi kwabantu abagcine beba ngabagilwa balaba, kubalwa uNksz Susan Xolo ongudadewabo kaMama Webhantshi, uMnuz Thamsanqa Mthembu owayeyindodana yomngani wakhe omkhulu ayekade ekhonza naye ebandleni lama-Afrika eliseMlaza, noMnuz Thulani Cele owayengusibali wakhe.UMUFI uSusan Xolo naye owabulawa ngudadewabo Isithombe: SITHUNYELWEUNksz Xolo wabulawa ngo-2019, kwathi uCele noMthembu bobabili babulawa ngo-2020. Kwavela ukuthi bonke ayebabulala uMama Webhantshi wayehlafuna imali engaphezulu kuka-R50 000 umuntu ngamunye.Phambilini, enkantolo kwavela ukuthi bonke laba wayekade ebathathela imishwalense engazange abazise.Kwathi uma umshwalense wase-Capitec sewuvuthwa uMama Webhantshi ahlanganise amakhanda noMsipha, bathunge itulo lokuba kubulawe lowo osegameni lakhe ngokushesha.Kukhona idlozi labo elabagidela ngakubona, basinda imishwalense yabo isivuthiwe. Kubona kubalwa uNksz Nozipho Mdlalose, Nksz Nonkululeko Hadebe noNksz Sthembile Hadebe.UMama Webhantshi noMsipha bagixatshezwe ngodilikajele ngamacala amathathu okubulala, namathathu okuthunga itulo lokubulala.UMama Webhantshi uphinde wagixatshezwa ngeminyaka engu-15 ngamacala amathathu okukhwabanisela ibhange i-Capitec."Nibe nomhobholo oxakayo. Nikhombise ukuthi ningenza noma yini egameni lemali. Kinina imali iyikho konke ngaphezulu kwezinto zonke ezikhona emhlabeni. Ngenxa yaleso sizathu isigwebo sikadilikajele yisona esinifanele,'' kusho ijaji.UGounden uthe kungumsebenzi wezinkantolo zaseNingizimu Afrika ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bayasuswa emphakathini abantu abacabanga ngokubulala abantu ukuze bacebe."Kumele bafunde isifundo nabanye abacabanga ukubulala abanye abantu ukuze bacebe. Ngokugwetshwa kwenu mhlawumbe nizogcina ningabantu abangcono kunalabo enibonakala niyibo njengamanje."Ababulali bafike enkantolo beswenkile. UMama Webhantshi ubefake ingubo kanokusho enombala ogqamile eziphihle ngezibuko.Ubebonakala engathukile ngesikhathi kuqhubeka icala. Babonakale bengathuki futhi nangesikhathi inkantolo ibagweba.Yize laba ababili sekuphele iminyaka emine bebhadle ejele, uGounden uthe lokho kakusho lutho futhi angeke kumenze ukuthi ehlise isigwebo ebantwini abanonya futhi abangakaze bakhombise ukuzisola phambi kwenkantolo.Kuvelile ukuthi phambilini, uMsipha wake wazama ukweqa ejele kodwa yaphantsha imizamo yakhe.Enkantolo kufundwe isitatimende sikanina kaMama Webhantshi, uNkk Dorris Mbotho, owatshela inkantolo ukuthi akekho umuntu wasemhlabeni ongalungisa umntananke, nguNkulunkulu kuphela ongamenza aguquke abone ukukhanya namaphutha akhe awenzile emhlabeni.Kufundwe nesikadadewabo, uNksz Khumbuzile Mbotho, lapho ebenxenxa khona inkantolo ukuba imgixabeze ngesigwebo esinesisindo udadewabo.Ukhale ngezibazi ezishiywe ngudadewabo emndeninim wathi akusekho ukuthembana emndenini ngenxa yezenzo zakhe. Ngisho esekhuluma nezintatheli sekuphele icala, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi mkhulu umonakalo oshiywe udadewabo emndenini.Ngaphakathi bekugcwele abomndeni nabomphakathi.
KUMTHOBE amanxeba unina wowayeyisishoshovu esilelwa amalungelo abantu abahlala emijondolo owabulawa, ukunikelelwa ngendlu. Le ndlu enikelelwe umndeni kaMnuz Lindokuhle Mnguni (28) owayeyilungu lenhlangano Abahlali baseMjondolo, kuthiwa yakhiwe ngabakwa-National Housing Finance Corporation (NHFC) emva kwesicelo esifakwe inhlangano yakhe.UNkk Thembi Mnguni ekhuluma neSolezwe izolo, emva kokumukeliswa ngokusemthethweni isikhiye sendlu, emcimbini obuseWartburg, KwaSwayimane, uthe nakuba kwavuleka isilonda esisenkathi ukuphola kubulawa indodana yakhe, kodwa inhlangano ayeyimele ayizange ibalahle, beyilokhu inabo bewumndeni."Ngijabule kakhulu, ngiswele amaphiko okundiza. Kufana nokuthi ngihlala eMhlanga ngikhona lapha emakhaya ngendlela indlu enhle ngakhona. Lezi zingane azizange zingilahle, bezilokhu zimi nami kusuka ngosuka okwenzeka ngalo isigameko,” usho kanje.Inamagumbi amabili okulala, ikhishi negumbi lokuphumula kanye nendawo yokugezela.Isikhulu esiphezulu kwa-NHFC, uNksz Azola Mayekiso, sithe kuyabathokozisa ukuthola ithuba lokubonisa ubuntu ngokuthi banikelele umndeni wakwaMnguni umuzi."Lokhu kuyinto ebaluleke kakhulu kithina ikakhulu ngoba umufi wayesekhaleni ekulweleni ukwakhelwa kwabantu izindlu ezibanikeza isithunzi esibafanele. Njengenkampani i-NHFC ezinye izinhlelo zethu ukulekelela ngemali yokwakha ekhonekayo okubalwa kuzona nokuphucula isimo semijondolo,” kusho yena.UMengameli wenhlangano Abahlali baseMjondolo, uMnuz S’bu Zikode, uthe kusuka eminyakeni ewu-19 eyedlule, le nhlangano isaqhubeka nomkhankankaso wokuthi abantu banikezwe umhlaba, bakhelwe izindlu ezibanikeza isithunzi esifanele."Phakathi kwezinselelo eziningi ezibhekene nomphakathi kubalwa ukungalingani, izinga eliphezulu lokungasebenzi nesidingo sokuthi bakhelwe izindlu. Yilokho esidinga ukukuzuza. Yevile ku-4 279 imijondolo kuleli, kanti balinganiselwa ku-2 million abantu abahlala kuyo,” usho kanjeUMnguni owayengusihlalo wenhlangano Abahlali baseMjondolo eCato Manor, eThekwini, wadutshulwa ngo-Agasti 2020, ehlaselwa esendlini yakhe ngabasolwa abathile ekuyo le ndawo. Kulesi sigameko kwalimala kabi intombi yakhe eyathelwa amachaphazelo njengoba wayenayo endlini ngobusuku besigameko. Wayehlala nonina namanye amalungu omndeni kuyo le mijondolo ngesikhathi edutshulwa. UNkk Mnguni uthe ngesikhathi indodana yakhe ibulawa, umndeni wawusuvele uthole indawo eWartburg, uhlela ukwakha, okuyilapho afihlelwa khona.
BETHUKE kwaphela nasozwaneni ozakwabo bakaMnuz Sibusiso Lawrence Ntaka (32) ebenguthisha esikoleni iZiphozethu Primary eLindelani, KwaDukuza, bezwa ukuthi ubulale ingoduso ngesihluku, wase ezibulala naye.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi uNtaka ubeneminyaka eyisithupha ejoyine lesi sikole abefundisa kuso isiNgisi. Kuvela ukuthi ngaphambi kwalokho, uke wafundisa esikoleni esiKwaNongoma iminyaka embalwa.Othisha ababili ebebesebenza nomufi, abacele ukuthi bangadalulwa njengoba bengavumelekile ukukhuluma nabezindaba, bavumelane ngazwi linye ukuthi isigameko asiyona into ebebengayilindela kuNtaka.Ephawula uthisha wokuqala uthe uNtaka ubengumuntu obahlonipha kakhulu abantu kanjalo nomsebenzi wakhe."Ubehlale ezihlekela. Asimkhumbuli nangelilodwa ilanga ediniwe,” kusho uthisha wokuqala.Owesibili uthe ayikho into abeyithanda njengomsebenzi wakhe, wathi ubehlale ehamba phambili ngisho nakwezemidlalo esikoleni, aphinde ahlale ekulangazelela ukufunda izinto ezintsha."Ubungeke umthinte esifundweni abesifundisa, isiNgisi. Silahlekelwe kakhulu esiNgisini, ubenguthisha waso ohamba phambili,” kusho uthisha wesibili.Nokho bobabili baveze ukuthi baluqaphele ushintsho kuyena sekuzovalwa izikole.Bathe uvele washintsha waba wumuntu othula ngendlela engajwayelekile kodwa bangacabanga ukuthi kukhona abhekene nakho."Besingazi ukuthi lokhu kuthula kwakhe bekukhomba ukuthi kukhona into abhekene nayo empilweni yakhe. Sithuke sesibona ngesigameko ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, sashaqeka,” kusho uthisha wesibili.Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal uMnuz Muzi Mahlambi edlulisa amazwi enduduzo emindenini elahlekelwe uthe baphatheke kabi ngesigameko."Siqeda kuba nomkhankaso wezinsuku ezingu-16 wokulwa nesihlava sokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane. Kubuhlungu ukuthi silahlekelwe abantu ngale ndlela,” kusho uMahlambi.Omunye uthisha obefundisa noNtaka uthe ubeke wabhoboka ngezinkinga zakhe komunye uzakwabo. Uthe bekunezinhlelo zokuthi alekelelwe ngokwelulekwa ngengqondo uma sekuvulwa izikole uma utalatiya obelumembethe beluzobe lungakasonjululwa.
BAZOLUTHEZA olunenkume abakuleli okuzotholakala ukuthi balekelela abokufika ukubabhalisa nokubaqashisela izitolo ezibiza bona njengoba kuqhubeka uhlelo lokubhaliswa kwazo nezindawo zokugcina futhi zisabalalise ukudla ngokusemthethweni, okulindeleke luphele ngonyaka ozayo.Esithangamini songqongqoshe abehlukene nabezindaba ebesisePitoli izolo, owoMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu, uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa, umemezele ukwelulwa komnqamulajuqu obekelwe lolu hlelo ekutheni bonke abezitolo babhalise obekulindeleke ube kuleli sonto, njengoba usungoFebhuwari 28.Ekhipha isexwayiso esibhekiswe emphakathini, obambe njengomqondisi eMnyangweni wezasaKhaya, uMnuz Albert Matsaung, uthe bazothathelwa izinyathelo okuzotholakala ukuthi baqhuba inkohlakalo yokubhalisa izitolo kulolu hlelo bese beziqashisela abokufika ngenhloso yokwenza imali."Okuzotholakala ukuthi baphambene nomthetho bazoboshwa bashushiswe. Siyasebenzisana nomasipala futhi kukhona ulwazi esisebenza ngalo olusuka komasipala okuthiwa bakhona kubo abenza lo mkhonyovu. Luzolethwa kithina njengomnyango bese sisebenzisana namphoyisa kulokho,” usho kanje.Uthe lesi isexwayiso esicacile ebantwini bakuleli wukuthi bangagxambukeli ekuqhubekeni kwalolu hlelo futhi bangasizi labo okungamele ngabe bayabasiza.Ekhuluma kulesi sithangami, uHlabisa uthe mningi umsebenzi osuwenziwe kusuka uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ememezele ukuthi kumele kuqale lolu hlelo phambili obekuthiwa luzokwenziwa ezinsukwini ezingu-21 kuphela, njengoba umnqamulajuqu bekulindeleke ukuthi ubengoLwesibili."Kuzwelonke, kuvulwe izikhungo ezingu-392 zokubhalisa abamabhizinisi. Zingu-42 915 izicelo zokusebenza ezifakwe ngabantu bezipaza nezindawo eziphatha ukudla. Kuzona, ziwu-19 386 eziphumelele. Lokhu sikuthatha njengomsebenzi omkhulu osuwenziwe ezinsukwini ezingu-21. Emva kwalo mnqamulajuqu wangoFebhuwari ngonyaka ozayo, uhulumeni uzoqhubeka nezinhlelo zokuqinisekisa udaba lokudla okuphephile okudayiselwa abantu nezinhlelo zokulwa kokungena kwempahla ngokungemthetho ezweni,” usho kanje.IPhini loMkhuzi wamaPhoyisa, uLieutenant General Tebello Mosikili, lithe akhona amacala aphenywa amaphoyisa mayelana nokufa kwabantu okukholakala ukuthi basuke bedle okunobuthi abakuthenge ezitolo."Bangu-41 manje asebeshonile ngenxa yokudla okunobuthi, kanti abangu-38 kubona izingane. Emacaleni akamuva akekho osaboshiwe, ngaphandle kokuthi kukhona abathathu ababoshiwe abahamba inkantolo kodwa bona baboshwe ngaphambi kukaSepthemba. Amacala akamuva asaphenywa ngamaphoyisa njengoba kwaziwa ukuthi uphenyo lufaka phakathi ukuthathwa kwamasampula ayohlolwa. Seyikhona imiphumela yokuhlolwa kwezidumbu kodwa abekho okwamanje abasayamaniswe namacala,” usho kanje.Umsuka oholele ekutheni kubhalise izitolo zokudla ezincane iningi lazo ezingabokufika, kungenxa yoxhaxha lwezigameko zokufa kwabantu ikakhulu izingane okuthiwa zigula emva kokuthenga okudliwayo ezitodlwana. Isigameko esabawundabamlonyeni, esokushona kwezingane eziyisithupha zaseNaledi, eSoweto, emva kokudla ama-chips okuthiwa zaziwathenge esitolo esidayisa ngokudla sowokufika esikhona endaweni.
UZONGCWATSHWA namhlanje loyo obeyimeya kaMasipala waseNkandla, uMnuz Mbhekiseni "Bhejane” Biyela, oshone ngoMsombuluko.Inkonzo yokugcina kaBiyela izokuba seNkantolo yeNkosi, eMahlayizeni.UBiyela ushone emva kokuxinwa ukugula okumbambe isikhathi eside.Lo mholi uzalwa ebukhosini baseMahlayizeni, obuphethwe Inkosi uBhekizizwe Biyela, khona eNkandla.Umngcwabo wakhe kulindeleke ukuthi uhanjelwe izikhulu eziqhamuka emikhakheni eyehlukene okubalwa abaholi bezepolitiki nabaholi bendabuko.UNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal futhi onguSihlalo we-IFP KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi uzowuhambela umngcwabo kaBiyela.UBiyela wathatha isikhundla sobumeya emva kokushiya kukaNtuli, owayeseqokelwe kwesemeya kuMasipala iKing Cetshwayo ngaphambi kokudlulela kwesokuba ngundunankulu.UNtuli uthe balahlekelwe kakhulu ngokushona kukaBiyela."UMasipala waseNkandla nohulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal ulahlekelwe, kuzozwela kakhulu ebantwini baseNkandla. Egameni likahulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal sifisa ukudlulisa amazwi enduduzo emndenini, abangani nakubo bonke abantu baseNkandla kulesi sikhathi esinzima.”UNtuli uthe uBiyela ubezinikele emsebenzini wakhe."Njengemeya yaseNkandla ebiphinde futhi ibe unobhala wesifunda, uBiyela ubesebenza ngokuzikhandla, akekho esimfanisa naye. Ukuqotho bakhe, ukuziphatha kahle kanye nokuba isibonelo esihle kwenze ukuthi babe baningi ababukela kuyena."Ubehlezi efuna ukubona indawo yaseNkandla ithuthuka, efuna ukubona impilo yabantu baseNkandla zithuthuka. Siyohlezi simkhumbula ngokuzinikela kwakhe kanye nangokulwela kwakhe ukushintsha impilonhle kubantu.”UBiyela ubeyikhansela le-IFP. Amaqembu i-IFP ne-ANC ancome amagalelo akhe.
UMNYANGO wezokuThutha ukholwa wukuthi ukuya kweziphathimandla zawo emphakathini, zixoxe nabagibeli, kungase kulekelele ekunciphiseni isibalo sezingozi nokufa kwabantu emigwaqweni.Lokhu kuvezwe uMnuz Mkhuleko Hlengwa oyiPhini likaNgqongqoshe wezokuThutha eNingizimu Afrika.Usho kanje ngesikhathi ehambele emarenki amabhasi nawamatekisi amabanga amade eMnambithi ngoLwesithathu.IPHINI likaNgqongqoshe wezokuThutha, uMnuz Mkhuleko Hlengwa lishumayele ivangeli lokuphepha emgwaqweni eMnambithi izolo Isithombe: SITHUNYELWE "Sixoxisana nabantu abathinekayo odabeni lwezokuphepha. Lokhu kubandakanya abashayeli, abagibeli nabasebenza khona emarenki abahwebayo,” kusho uHlengwa.Uveze ukuthi minyaka yonke kushona abantu abalinganiselwa ku-12 000 ngenxa yezingozi zomgwaqo.Uqhube wathi u-10% wabafayo babhubha ngesikhathi samaholidi kaDisemba.UHlengwa ubekade eshumayela ivangeli lokuphepha emgwaqweni ehambisana neziphathimandla namaphoyisa omgwaqo aqhamuka kuzona zonke izinhla zikahulumeni.."Njengomnyango sijube amaphoyisa iNingizimu Afrika yonke. Akuyo yonke imizila okuyiyona esiyibonile ukuthi inobungozi obusezingeni eliphezulu,” kusho uHlengwa.Ukhale ngophuzo oludakanayo wathi kunabantu okuthi uma sebedle amanzi amponjwana bangene emgwaqweni.Uveze ukuthi u-45% wabantu abashona emigwaqweni yakuleli abasuke behamba ngezinyawo.Uthe yingakho kubalulekile ukuthi bakhulume nabo ngqo."Sikhuza umkhuba wabantu abashayela namaselula esandleni beko-WhatsApp bephendula nemiqhafazo. Bese kuba yilaba ababizwa ngama-influencer abasuke benza ama-content. Ucwaningo luthi uma ushayela uphethe iselula esandleni, umqondo uyaphazamiseka ngemizuzwana,” kusho uHlengwa.Uthe lokhu kwenza ukuthi lowo okumele ngabe uthatha isinqumo esiqondene nokuphepha emgwaqweni agcine ephazamiseka angabe esakwazi ukwenza.Uthe awuyekwe lo mkhuba odlangile.Ukhuthaze abashayeli, ikakhulukazi abahamba amabanga amade ukuthi njalo emva kwamahora amabili noma kuka-200 km baphumuze umqondo nomzimba kuthole umoya.Ugcizelele ukuthi abantu abafunde ukugcina isikhathi."Enye yezinto esiyibonayo eyokuthi abantu bazama ukukhava isikhathi ngokugijima. Ukuhluleka ukuhlela isikhathi sakho kunomthelela ekutheni izimoto zihamba kanjani emgwaqweni,” kusho uHlengwa.Uthe abantu abafunde ukuhamba emizileni efanele ngejubane elisuke libekelwe khona. Uthe umzila wakwesokudla owezimoto ezigijimayo.Uthe kubekwa imigomo yejubane ngesizathu emgwaqweni ukuze ukuhamba kwezimoto kungaphazamiseki wakhuza athe banenkani futhi bayaqhenya abathatha imoto ehamba kancane bayifake emzileni wezimoto ezigijimayo.Uthe lokhu kugcina sekuphazamisa ezinye izimoto ziphoqeleke ukuthi zisike ngakwesokunxele, okuyinto ephambene nemigomo yokushayela emgwaqweni.
IPHUME ijabhile futhi ithukuthele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini imindeni yamantombazane amabili abulawa ngesihluku eKenville, eThekwini, ngesikhathi kuhoxiswa amacala abhekene nomsolwa wesibili.Abafi, uNksz Anele Mbokazi (29) nomngani wakhe omkhulu, uNksz Zizipho Gabisa (30), badutshulwa bafa esigamekweni esenzeka ngo-Agasti 25.Emuva kwalokho bakhalelwa ngamasongo kaSigonyela oMnuz Lungani Mthethwa (38) nomngani wakhe, uMnuz Sandile Chili (29).Izidumbu zabafi zatholakala zidindilizile emgwaqweni waseKenville.
