Kwavela ukuthi babekade belandwe abamangalelwa emakhaya eRiverview Park, eVerulam, ngo-Agasti 24.Izolo inkantolo ithe iyawahoxisa amacala abekade ebhekene noChili yase iveza ukuthi usezophenduka ufakazi omkhulu woMbuso uma sekuqala ukuqulwa kwaleli cala ngonyaka ozayo.Ubekade ethweswe amacala amathathu elokubulala, elokubamba inkunzi kuhlonyiwe nelokutholakala nesibhamu esingekho emthethweni."Inkantolo iyawahoxisa amacala obukade ubekwe wona, usungakhululeka,'' kusho imantshi ibhekise kuChili.UChili ube esesuka ebhokisini ephumela emnyango ehambisana nommeli wakhe.Ubebonakala emamatheka kungabuzwa ukuthi lezi zindaba ziyefana noju kuyena.Ngaleso sikhathi uMthethwa ubonakale emgqolozela uChili waze wayophuma ngomnyango kubonakala nje ukuthi akayikholwa le nto eyenzekayo eshiywa ngumngani wakhe ebhokisini.Lesi sinqumo senkantolo silethe enkulu intukuthelo kwabemindeni yabafi.UMnuz Mvuselelo Magwaza, okhulumela umndeni ka-Anele, usole inkantolo ngokuba budedengu ngokudedela uChili."Ibheyili le abamnikeza yona ekuqaleni beyenele, hhayi le nto asebeyenza manje. Ibuhlungu le nto eyenziwa yinkantolo. Umdedela kanjani umuntu owayekhona kuhlelwa kwenziwa yonke into? Ngaphezulu kwalokho wangawabikela amaphoyisa ngokuthi kukhona abantu asebebulewe,'' usho kanjena.Ulimise ngesihloko elokuthi kabahambisani nhlobo nesinqumo senkantolo.UMnuz Mondli Gabisa, wakubo kukamufi uNksz Gabisa, naye ukhale ezimathonsi ngesinqumo senkantolo sokudedela umsolwa wesibili.Ngaphambilini uChili wamchakida umngani wakhe, etshela inkantolo ukuthi nguyena (uMthethwa) owadubula wabulala ephindelela abafi.UChili watshela inkantolo ukuthi abafi bababhukhela eRoyal Hotel, waveza ukuthi umsolwa wokuqala nguyena owayebhekelele zonke izindleko.Waveza ukuthi ebusuku lwalukhala umlibe ucingo lukaNksz Mbokazi okuyinto eyagcina seyimnenga uMthethwa. UNksz Mbokazi watshela uMthethwa ukuthi izingcingo zivela kubo.Ngokobufakazi bukaChili, uMthethwa wathi mabaphindiselwe emuva abafi maphakathi nendlela, wathi yena wazumeka waphaphama imoto seyiseKenville okuyilapho uMthethwa ayalela khona abesifazane ukuthi mabakhale phansi.Ngemuva kwalokho uChili uthi uMthethwa wabe esebadubula bafa.Waveza ukuthi babekade behlangene ngo-Agasti 10 emcimbini owawukade use-Escourt kwase kushintshwana ngezinombolo zezingcingo.Izolo bekulindeleke ukuthi kungene isicelo sebheyili sikaMthethwa kodwa lokho kwagcina kungenzekanga njengoba ummeli wakhe, u-Advocate Clinton Shoot, ekhale ngokuthi kunesitatimende okumele siqale sifinyelele kuyena ngaphambi kokuba kwenziwe ibheyili.Uphakamise ukuthi ukufakwa kwesicelo sebheyili kuhlehliswe ngoba ukholwa ukuthi ngeke size senzeke kahle ngaphandle kwalesi sitatimende.Inkantolo ibe seyilihlehlisela uJanuwari 13 icala.Njengenjwayelo nakulokhu inkantolo ibigcwele phama amalungu emindeni yabafi nawomphakathi.Bekukhona nabesifazane bophiko lweMK Party abashaye amakhala ngokuhoxiswa kwamacala kaChili.UNksz Pearl Gasa, obekhulumela lolu phiko, uthe kabaneme neze ngesinqumo senkantolo sokudedela umuntu obemdibimunye nombulali ngesikhathi sesigameko.
LUKHUZA ibuya uhlelo oluvame ukuhambisana nezinkulumo lukaMasipala waseThekwini lokunikezwa amavawusha okudla izaguga eziqhamuka emiphakathini eyakhele lo mkhandludolobha.Minyaka yonke iHhovisi likaSomlomo, uMnuz Thabani Nyawose, likhipha amavawusha liwanikeze amakhansela emawadini angu-11, aseThekwini.Kuba yilawa makhansela aqoka lezo zaguga ezisuke ziludinga kakhulu uxhaso bese edluliselwa kuzona ukuze zicoshacoshe ukudla zenzela uKhisimusi.Esikhathini esedlule yilapho ubukade uqala khona umsindo, uma sekwabiwa la mavawusha, kuvele nezinsolo zokuthi anikezwa abantu abangezona izaguga.Abanye babesola ukuthi kunikezwa labo abasuke besondelene nosuke esemandleni okuphatha emphakathini ngaleso sikhathi.Umasipala uthe la mavawusha ayindlela yokuhlonipha izaguga futhi uqinisekise ukuthi ziyasithokozela lesi sikhathi sonyaka.UNyawose uthe amakhansela azokhetha izaguga ezizonikezwa amavawusha."Sizokhipha la mavawusha siwanikeze wonke amawadi awu-111. Siyakuqoda ukuthi la mavawusha okudla ngeke atholwe yiwona wonke umuntu oyisaguga ewadini, yingakho kuzonikezwa lezo eziswele kakhulu. Zizokwazi ukuwasebenzisa ezitolo ezithandwa yizona,” kusho uNyawose.Kulo nyaka umasipala awushongo isibalo samavawosha ozowakhipha nokuthi iyinye ivumeleke ukuthi ithenge ukudla kwentengo engakanani.Uzishaye isifuba uNyawose wathi bawumkhandlu onakekelayo futhi bazibophezele ekutheni benze abantu abadala bajabule ikakhulukazi ngasikhathi sikaKhisimusi.Ugcizelele uNyawose ekutheni izaguga ziwumthombo wolwazi nobuhlakani lapho imiphakathi engathembela khona ekukhuliseni intsha.Esikhathini esifanayo ngonyaka owedlule, kwavela ukuthi umasipala wakhipha amavawusha okudla awu-500. Ngayinye wawukwazi ukuthenga ngayo ukudla okubiza u-R650.
IBHODI lesikhwama esigade umhlaba kaZulu, iNgonyama Trust, lifuna ukuba nenhlambuluko neSilo uMisuzulu kaZwelithini.Ibhodi selijube amakhosi ukuba alihlanganise neSilo ukuze lizothola kahle ngomsuka wokuthi alisebenzisana kahle neSilo.IMbube iwusihlalo webhodi, isike yakusho esidlangalaleni ukuthi ibhodi alifuni ukuyamukela njengosihlalo walo.Ngenxa yobudlelwano obungebuhle, iNdlulamithi ifuna ukuthi lihlakazwe leli bhodi elaqokwa ngonyaka owedlule kepha iphini likasihlalo webhodi, u-Advocate Linda Zama, lithe abayazi ukuthi isukaphi eyokuthi abezwani neMbube.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba esidlweni sasekuseni ebesihlelwe yibhodi, izolo.ISilo besingekho kulesi sidlo sasekuseni, kanti u-Adv Zama uthe bebesazisile iSilo ngesidlo sayizolo kodwa wathi bayakuqonda ukuthi iSilo simatasa."Ngeke ulindele ukuthi iSilo sizohambela yonke imihlangano yebhodi ngoba simatasa. Ngisho imihlangano yasePhalamende asikwazi ukuyihambela yonke.”U-Adv Zama uthe ngokwazi kwabo basebenza kahle neMbube ethathe esokuba ngusihlalo webhodi ngasekuqaleni konyaka."Ngizophendula ngokwethembeka la. Uma iSilo silapha, ubudlelwano bethu buba ngobejwayelekile. Akukaze kube khona ukungezwani phakathi kwethu. Ingakho kuyaye kuthi uma kukhona esikubonayo, siyaye sinqume ukungaphenduli, sikhethe ukuthuma amakhosi ukuba asicelele ukuba sihlangane neSilo. "Ngisho kuMdlokombane (iSilo uGoodwill Zwelithini kaBhekuzulu), ubudlwelano bethu babungobejwayelekile. Uma iSilo silapha, ngiyaye ngiselekelele kwezinye izinto uma ngibona ukuthi siyasala, asikaze singiphoxe. Ngokwethembeka, ngifuna ukusho ukuthi ubudlelwano bethu bungobejwayelekile. Ngaphandle-ke uma kukhona abantu abagovuzayo, engingazi ukuthi baphehlani.”U-Adv Zama uthe bajube amakhosi ayingxenye yebhodi, oNkosi Mabudu Tembe, Sibonelo Mkhize noPhallang Molefe, ukuba ahlele umhlangano neSilo lapho khona bezovulelana izifuba."Ngenxa yokukhathazwa izinto esizizwayo, sikhethe ukuba sicele ukuba nomhlangano neSilo. Sinenhlanhla yokuthi sinamakhosi ayingxenye yebhodi. Amakhosi ayazi ukuthi imiphi imigudu okufanele ayilandele.”Amakhosi aseke aya esigodlweni KwaKhangelamankengane kodwa angayifica iMbube."Ngenxa yalokhu engikushilo kokuthi iSilo simatasa, amakhosi awakwazanga ukusibona ngaleli langa. Amakhosi azoqhubeka nemizamo yawo.”
UQOME ukungabe esaqhubeka nomshado ayehlele ukuthi uzoba kuyo le nyanga uthisha waseMalangeni, eMzinto, obulale ingoduso yakhe ngesihluku ngoLwesibili, maqede waphanyeka i-vidiyo yesigameko kwi-Facebook.Kulesi sigameko esenzeke eMalangeni, uMnuz Sibusiso Lawrence Ntaka (32), ugwaze wabulala uNksz Nontobeko Cele (24) waseMandawe.Isidumbu sikaNtaka sitholwe ngoLwesithathu, silenga esihlahleni ehlathini elibude buduze nendawo yesigameko abulalele kuyo uNksz Cele.Udadewabo kaNtaka, uNkk Snoxolo Ngubo, oveze ukuthi bebesondelene kakhulu, uthe ezinyangeni ezimbalwa ezedlule umfowabo wamtshela ukuthi uyawuhoxisa umshado ngoba banezinkinga ezingalungiseki noNksz Cele.Uveze ukuthi waze wamtshela ukuthi ngemali ayeseyibekile yomshado uzozithengela into ezoba yinhle kuye, nokwaba yimoto, waveza ukuthi bobabili bebekwazi ukuvuleleka kuyena kanti bazivumela ukuthi ubudlelwano babo bese bufike ezingeni lapho bese bezwisana khona ubuhlungu.Udalule ukuthi umfowabo ugcine ebatshela ngendaba yokuthi ingane (3) obekwaziwa ukuthi unayo noNksz Cele, empeleni akuyona eyakhe."Kodwa uyondle kusukela izalwa, eyithengela ubisi, amanabukeni, afake ngisho nemali engu-R2 500 njalo ngenyanga,” kusho uNkk Ngubo.Nakuba kunjalo, uNtaka ulobole waqeda nyakenye, wembesa waphinde wathembisa umshado ngoFebhuwari nonyaka, noNksz Cele, wahambisa umbondo.Uveze nokuthi maphakathi nonyaka, umfowabo umshayise ngemoto uNksz Cele kade evakashele ekhweni."Sezwa ukuthi babehleli, kwangena umyalezo angawuthandanga uNtobe, kwasuka umsindo. USbu wakhetha ukuphuma ahambe kodwa uNtobe elokhu emi phambi kwemoto waze wagcina eshayiseka,” kusho yena.Uveze ukuthi ukhona owesifazane umfowabo abesemtholile kodwa bagcina behlukaniswa nguye uNksz Cele ngeselula.Uthe uNksz Cele bamgcine ngoDisemba 8, efika ehamba noNtaka."UNtobe uze wacela abantu abadala basekhaya ukuthi njengabazali babeseke, kuthi uma beletha inkinga njengezingane, babaxazululise yona njengabazali,” kubeka uNkk Ngubo.Uthe umfowabo umgcine ngeSonto, lapho amtshele khona ukuthi izinkinga zakhe sezingaphezu kwamandla, ebonakala nasebusweni ukuthi kukhona okungahambi kahle."Waze wathi ngisho utshwala abusamsizi, washo ukuthi ukube kuya ngaye ngabe uthola isidakamizwa esinamandla ukuze ezozizwa engcono, wathi ucela ngifundise uNtobe ubufazi, ayeke utshwala nabangani,” usho kanje.Uveze ukuthi uNksz Cele ubemgada uNtaka, engafuni ukuthi ayophuza nabangani, aze aphoqe ukuthi amshayele nge-video call.Isolezwe lihambela kubo kaNksz Cele, bazichithile zonke izinsolo ezishiwo umndeni wakwaNtaka.Udadewabo kaNksz Cele, uNksz Hlo Cele, uthe ingane ngeyabo bobabili."USbu uyazazi izinto. Uma ebenezinsolo zokuthi akuyona eyakhe, kungani engalwenzanga ulibofuzo?” kubuza uHlo othe batholana eseyintombi nto umufi efunda eMlaza, eCoastal College ngo-2020.Uyikhombe kuye uNtaka eyokulawula uNksz Cele, ethi wuye obehlala emlusa, efona ngawo ama-video call, kokunye ashaye imoto kushunqe uthuli esuka KwaDukuza ebheke eThekwini, uma engamtholi ocingweni.Ephawula ngodaba lokulimala kukaNksz Cele, uthe akulona iqiniso ukuthi babephuzile, wavuma ukuthi babexabana."Uhlale izinyanga ezimbili esibhedlela. Nakuba ubesephumile kodwa ubengakabi bikho esimweni esikahle kangangoba ubesalekelelwa kokuningi. Futhi njengoba emgwaze amanxeba embulala, ubesapholisa amadala okumlimaza ngemoto,” kusho uHlo. Wathi uyasola ukuthi ubezibhekile emalini yakwa-Road Accident Fund abeyifakele isicelo, nathe bebengakalwazi usuku lokuphuma kwayo.Uveze ukuthi yilesi sigameko uNksz Cele agcine emalela sona uNtaka, ebona ukuthi uyingozi.Elandisa ngokubulawa kwakhe uninakhulu kaNksz Cele, uNkk Mano Cele, uthe uNtaka ufike wazobathatha ekhaya nengane ethi abaye olwandle bese beyothengela ingane.Uthe ngesikhathi sebebuya, wathi ayehle ingane nesinye isihlobo, asale uNksz Cele."Kubone omunye umuntu ukuthi bayalwa phakathi emotweni. Uthe uma ezositshela lapha ekhaya, eselandelelwa, uficwe esembulele,” kusho uNkk Cele.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi owesilisa oziqophe i-vidiyo evuma ukuthi usebulele owesifazane wase eyiphanyeka ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ngoLwesibili, utholwe ezibulele naye ngoLwesithathu."Utholwe elenga esihlahleni eMalangeni, eMzinto, bude buduze nendawo yesigameko lapho ebulalele khona owesifazane,” kusho uNetshiunda.
UTHANDO lwabafi oMnuz Sibusiso Lawrence Ntaka noNksz Nontobeko Cele belugubuzelwe yizinkinga nesikhwele esingalawuleki. Bobabili kuvela ukuthi bebengathembani, bekhwelezelana, omunye ehlala efuna ukuthi omunye aveze ubufakazi bokuthi lapho ekhona akenzi lutho olubheke eceleni. Bekushunqa intuthu yokuthi nakuba uthando luhambe lwaze lwafika ekutheni babe umyeni nengoduso kodwa ingane eyavela bethandana akuyona eyabo bobabili. NgoMeyi nonyaka umyeni wayishayisa ngemoto ingoduso, emva kwengxabano, yalimala kanzima yaze yayolala esibhedlela. Kuvele nangesigameko okuthiwa senzeka emqashweni kathisha KwaDukuza lapho umndeni wengoduso uthe wayikhiphela ummese, owomyeni uthi ingoduso yawutshela ukuthi usacaze ipuleti phansi ediniwe, wangayikhuluma eyokukhishelwa ummese.UMUFI uNksz Nontobeko CeleUMUFI uMnuz Sibusiso Lawrence Ntaka
UMNDENI unuka ingoduso okuthiwa isacanasa ngaphandle, ngokufa kwesoka elinguthisha. Isidumbu sesoka sitholwe sinenxeba lokugwazwa entanyeni sidindilize phezu kwegazi, emqashweni abebehlala kuwo KwaSwayimane, emasontweni adlule.UMnuz Thandokuhle Ngcobo (31) waseBhamshela, ngaKwaMaphumulo, obefundisa esikoleni samabanga aphakeme KwaSwayimane, kuthiwa ugwazwe emva kwengxabano nengoduso yakhe okuthiwa ifundisa kwesinye sezikole esiseHowick. Kuthiwa bobabili bese benesikhathi eside bethandana futhi behlala ndawonye emqashweni.Ilungu lomndeni kamufi elingathandanga ukudalulwa elikhulume neSolezwe, lithe kuyabakhathaza ukuthi umsolwa usazicanasela ngaphandle ekubeni kunezinkomba eziqinile zokuthi kukhona akwenza kumufi."Ngosuku lwesigameko sashayelwa ucingo (ingoduso), isitshela ukuthi bebexabana noThandokuhle, wazigwaza wafa. Okusididayo ukuthi inxeba lisentanyeni ngemuva okwenza kube nzima ukuqonda ukuthi uzigwaze kanjani. Amaphoyisa amthathile ngosuku okwenzeke ngalo lesi sehlo ayomhloma ngemibuzo kodwa abuye amdedela,” usho kanje.Uthe umsolwa onengane eneminyaka emihlanu nomufi, uvuke ekuseni waqoqa izimpahla zakhe emqwashweni wahamba kanti bakholwa ukuthi wanikela kubo eRichard’s Bay. Yize eveze ukuthi umndeni awunalo ulwazi ngengxabano yezithandani ekutheni kwakubangwani kodwa omunye wabasondelene nazo uthe yasuswa yisikhwele."Owesilisa ubesola ukuthi ingoduso yakhe kukhona esimbhangqe naye, osebenza nayo. Lokhu kuthiwa kuqale ngokuthi abhadame izithombe beshuthe bendawonye kwiselula. Umsindo ususwe ukuthi owesifazane alethwe osolwa ngokuba umakhwapheni emqashweni ahlala kuwo nesoka lakhe kanti likhona endlini,” usho kanje.Lo mthombo uthe owesifazane ubephuzile ngalelo langa, kwakukade kunomcimbi wokuvala unyaka esikoleni afundisa kuso, okukholakala ukuthi ngesikhathi bexabana uthathe ummese wamgwaza."Okubuhlungu ukuthi nakuba ekuveza ukuthi umufi uzigwaze yena kodwa kwaze kwadingeka ukuthi kubizwe i-ambulensi, kulindwe yona ekubeni umtholampilo useduze kakhulu kangangoba khona ngaphakathi emqashweni kunabantu abanezimoto abebengalekelela kodwa umsolwa kuthiwa wayesexosha wonke umuntu. Abe-ambulensi beyingasekho into abangayenza ngoba bafike esevele eseshonile,” usho kanje.Uqinisekise ukuthi umsolwa ufikile emngcwabeni kamufi ehambisana nodadewabo nengane yabo kodwa akuphelanga mizuzu mingaki ekhona, wabuye wanyamalala washiya afike nabo ekhala ngokungaphephi ngoba abantu bekholelwa ukuthi uyena obulele.Kuthiwa owesilisa ubengaqali ukulimala uma bexabana ikakhulu uma bephuzile ngoba nangomunye unyaka kukhona lapho umsolwa amgqema khona ingozi ngepani maqede wamkhiyela endlini yokuhlamba wavulela umsakazo kakhulu waqhubeka nokuphuza utshwala. Lo mthombo uthe umgilwa kwamphoqa ukuthi aphume ngewindi okuyilapho kwabonakala khona ulimele.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa aseWartburg, avule idokodo lophenyo ngokufa komuntu, emva kokufa kowesilisa oneminyaka ewu-31 okusolwa ukuthi uzibulale ngokuzigwaza.
UMASIPALA waKwaDukuza uchithe eyokuthi bekukhona utshwala emotweni yephini lemeya ebandakanyeke engozini yomgwaqo.Okhulumela umasipala, uMnuz Sifiso Zulu, uthe i-cooler box ebonakale ezithombeni zemoto yephini lemeya ebandakanyeke engozini yomgwaqo, ibingafakile utshwala.Imoto yePhini leMeya KwaDukuza, uMnuz Njabulo Cele, ibandakanyeke engozini, ngoLwesibili ntambama.Ingozi yenzeke eMandeni, imoto kaCele kuthiwa ilale ngohlangothi ngesikhathi izama ukuvika imoto okuthiwa ibizama ukudlula inqwaba yezimoto endaweni okungavumelekile ukuthi izimoto zidlulane kuyo.Ezithombeni ezisabalale ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, kubonakala i-cooler box emotweni kaCele. Lokhu kwenze ukuthi kube khona abathi bekuphuzwa emotweni yalo mholi.Kepha uZulu uthe i-cooler box ibifake amanzi njengoba ilanga libalela kakhulu kulezi nsuku."Sithanda ukuqinisekisa umphakathi ukuthi uCele akabuphuzi utshwala.”UZulu uthe uCele ubengekho emotweni ngesikhathi kwenzeka ingozi."Imoto ibihamba abaqaphi bakhe. Abaqaphi abazange balimale engozini.”Echaza ngengozi, uZulu uthe imoto iphaphalaze ngesikhathi izama ukuvika ukushayisana mahlanze nemoto ebidlula ezinye izimoto endaweni engavumelekile."Lo muntu ubezama ukudlula inqwaba yezimoto okubalwa kuzo neloli. Kuleli jika kunemidwebo ekhombisayo ukuthi akuvumelekile ukuba izimoto zidlulane. Imoto yephini lemeya iphaphalaze yaya esigangeni, yabe isiphenduka.”UZulu uthe umshayeli wemoto edale ingozi akazange ame ukwelekelela ababandakanye engozini, ubalekile, wabe esehujwa omunye umshayeli obonile ngesikhathi kwenzeka ingozi.Uthe amaphoyisa agcine ekwazile ukumbopha."Uthweswe icala lokushayela budedengu, elokungami ahlole umonokala kanye nabalimele emva kwengozi nelokungabalekeleli ababandakanyeke engozini.UCele usanda kungena kulesi sikhundla sephini lemeya.Kuke kwaba nomsindo wokuthi uhamba ngemoto eqashiwe, kepha umasipala wazithethelela ngokuthi kukhona okungalungile emotweni yomkhandlu okufanele ayisebenzise.
AMAPHOYISA ashanela kwasani eyisigebengu nesaphulamthetho emgwaqweni nasemiphakathini ngaphansi komkhankaso wawo, i-Operation Shanela, ngalesi sikhathi samaholidi.Abakwasidlodlo bathe ukuxhaphaka kotshwala nemali ngoDisemba kunomthelela ekwandeni kokuphulwa komthetho.Amaphoyisa athe kusukela ngo-Okthoba kuze kube sekupheleni kukaJanuwari, sizoqina isandla ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ugcinwa njengoba unjalo umthetho futhi uyanciphisa umhlaba wezigilamkhuba.IPhini loMkhuzi wamaPhoyisa, uLieutenant General Tebello Mosikili, lithe abanye abasebenzi basuke bebhonasile, abantu behlukanisa izitokofela futhi kunemali ekade ilondoloziwe unyaka wonke esuke isisetshenziswa."Elakuleli lingelinye lamazwe akleliswe phezulu elisebenzisa kakhulu amanzi amponjwana okugcina kubeka impilo yabanye abantu engcupheni yokwenzakaliswa. Abantu abaphuze ngendlela efanele futhi bazinakekele,” kusho usigaxamabhande.Uveze ukuthi umkhankaso wabo, i-Operation Shanela ukhuculula kwasani ephambene nomthetho futhi bengamaphoyisa basebenza ngokubambisana neminyango yezokuphepha nobulungiswa.Uthe ngalesi sikhathi samaholidi balwa kakhulu nohlobo oluthile lobugebengu obuvame ukugqama ngalesi sikhathi sonyaka.Uveze ukuthi amacala athinta udlame lwasemindenini nawobulili, ukushushumbiswa nokuhweba ngezimpahla zomgunyathi, ukuvikelwa nokuphepha kwemingcele nokuphepha emgwaqweni kuseqhulwini.Uthe bazophinde balwe nobugebengu bokufunwa ngodli kwenkokhelo yemali ngabantu abathunjiwe okanye ngemisebenzi yamathenda."Sizolwa nanokugqekezwa kwemizi. Abantu abaye emaphoyiseni basho ukuthi bazobe bengekho emakwabo ngala maholidi khona kuzothi uma amaphoyisa eseqapha ubugebengu, agxile kakhulu nangasemizini abangekho abanikazi bayo. Sizolwa nanobugebengu bokudunwa kwezimoto,” kusho u-Lt General Mosikili.Ube esexwayisa abantu emalokishini nasemakhaya wathi kuzobe kuphithizela iphoyisa.Amaphoyisa athe abona ngesikhathi somvalelandlini owadalwa wukubheduka kobhubhane i-Covid 19 kwanda izigameko ezibikwayo zodlame lwasemindenini, ngakho azokube emehlo mane.U-Lt General Mosikili uthe kazibaniki ukuphumula izigameko zokubulawa kwabantu emiphakathini."Senza ngakho konke okusemandleni siwumbutho wamaphoyisa nohulumeni ukubopha abasolwa futhi senze isiqiniseko sokuthi kuba nobulungiswa.”
LINGASHODELWA ugesi nophethroli elakuleli uma ingapheli ngokushesha imibhikisho ezweni elingumakhelwane, iMozambique.UNgqongqoshe wezoBudlelwano naMazwe aNgaphandle, uMnuz Ronald Lamola, uthe elakuleli lilanda u-oyela okwenziwa ngawo uphethroli nokunye echwebeni laseMozambique.ULamola uthe bakhathazekile ngokuthi uma iqhubeka imibhikisho eMozambique ingase ibeke engcupheni ukuthunyelwa kwale mpahla.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ehlangene nabaholi baseMozambique.Umhlangano wabo eMpumalanga.IMozambique ibhekene nemibhikisho equbuke emva kokhetho lwango-Okthoba.Imibhikisho iphazamise ukungena nokuphuma kwezimoto eMozambique.ULamola uthe uma iqhubeka imibhikisho eMozambique, kuzophazamiseka ukungena nokuphuma kwemphahla ebalulekile kule lizwe.Elakuleli kunenqwaba kagesi eliwulanda eMozambique."Kulo mzila waseMozambique kuthunyelwa izinto ezibalulekile ezifana neogesi, uphethroli ne-gas. Isimo esiqhubekayo singabeka engcupheni ukuthunyelwa kwale mpahla. "Emhlanganweni sikukhulumile ukuthi imibhikisho eqhubekayo iphazamisa umnotho. izinkampani zilahlekelwe imali enkulu ngenxa yemibhikisho. Uma iqhubeka imibhikisho kungase kuphazamiseke nokuthunyelwa kokudla.”ULamola uthe ngaphandle kwale mpahla kuningi ukuxhumana okukhona phakathi kweMozambique nelakuleli."Enye impahla ithunyelwa ngezitimela enye ithunyelwa ngamaloli, enye ihamba ngemikhumbi. Ngaphandle kwalokho kuphinde kube nenqwaba yabantu abahamba phakathi kwala mazwe. Kunenqwaba yezivakashi njengoba kunamaholidi kaDisemba. Bonke laba bantu ngeke bakwazi ukuhamba ngokukhululeka uma kunemibhikisho.”Okhethweni lwangoMeyi kwanqoba inhlangano iFrelimo, okuyiyo ebilokhu iphethe kusukela iMozambique yathola inkululeko.Abaseka uMnuz Venâncio Mondlane, owayengenele ukhetho ngokuzimela, abafuni ukwamukela imiphumela yokhetho.Abalandeli bakaMondlane bakhala ngokuthi kwaba nokukhwabanisa okhethweni lwango-Okthoba.Abanganelisekile ngemiphumela yokhetho sebefake isikhalo enhlanganweni yakhona iConstitutional Council ukuba ixazulule lo mbango.ULamola unxuse bonke abathintekayo ukuba bamukele imiphumela yokhetho."Iqiniso ukuthi uma kunokhetho kuhlezi kuba khona ubuhixihixi. Akukaze kwenzeke ukuthi yonke into ihambe kahle. IMozambique seyike yabhekana nesimo esinzima. Asifuni ukuthi kuphinde kube nenye impi eMozambique.”ULamola uthe bazoqhubeka nemizamo yokuthi ingaphazamisi kakhulu imibhikisho eqhubekayo."Sifuna kuqhubeke ukuthunyelwa kwezimpahla phakathi kwala mazwe.”
UKHUZA ibhadi uNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal ngomkhuba wabesifazane osuphenduke insakavukela, wokuvula amacala bese bewasula uma sebekhokhelwe imali.UMnuz Thami Ntuli ubekade ekhuluma izolo, ngesikhathi enikezela ngezimoto eziwu-36 emaphoyiseni aKwaZulu-Natal. Kuvezwe ukuthi kudle u-R14 million ukuthengwa kwazo. UNtuli uthe kulokoza inhlansi yethemba empini yokulwa nobugebengu ngenxa yezimoto abezinikela.Kodwa ubabaze izenzo athi sezivbamile lapho abesifazane bemukeliswa imali njengendlela yokucima amacala abasuke bewafakile.Ulimise ngesihloko elokuthi lo mkhuba kawumuhle futhi unjalo nje ukhinyabeza impi okumele inqotshwe yokuhlukunyezwa kwabantu besifazane nezingane."Le nto isithanda ukusikhathaza impela nje, ngikholwa ukuthi kukhona okumele sikwenze ngenhloso yokunqanda lo mkhuba,'' usho kanjena.Ngokusho kukaNtuli, kuvele ukuthi lo mkhuba uqale ukwanda ePort Shepstone, wathi kumele unqandwe ngaphambi kokuba uze ugcine sewusabalala kusona sonke isifundazwe."Abantu besifazane kumele bazi ukuthi ukuvula icala kuyinto okungamele badlale ngayo futhi akumele basebenzise yona ukuzuza imali,'' usho kanjena.UNtuli ukhuluma kanjena nje, nasezinkundleni zokuxhumana kunasebejwayele ukuntela ngokuthi: "Ngishaye ngivule icala ebese ngilisula uma sewungikhokhele.'' Ezinkundleni zokuxhumana kuvela ukuthi nabesilisa banomkhuba wokuchukuluza abanye bese bevula amacala emaphoyiseni ukuze bawasule ngenkokhelo esuka ku-R4 000. Kuthiwa abanye bafuna ngisho u-R10 000 nxa beshayiwe ukuze besule amacala.UNtuli uthe kuyakhathaza ukuthi ukuvulwa kwamacala abesifazane sebekuphendule umdlalo ekubeni ziqhubeka nokwanda izigameko zokuhlukunyezwa kwabo.Ubalule ukuthi ekwateni yesithathu senyuke ngo-25.8% isibalo samacala okuzama ukudlwengulwa kwabesifazane esibikwe eziteshini ezehlukene.Ugcizelele ukuthi isiteshi saseNanda, uMlaza nesasePlessislaer, ngezinye zeziteshi okubikwe kuzoma amacala amaningi okuzama ukudlwengula.Uveze ukuthi angu-1 428 esewonke amacala okubulala avuliwe kwase kuboshwa abangu-558, wabalula ukuthi izigameko eziningi zokubulawa kwabantu zenzeka emakhaya nasemalokishini.Iningi labantu ababulewe uthe ngabesifazane njengoba kuvela ukuthi kubulewe abangu-186 uma kuqhathaniswa nangesikhathi esifanayo nyakenye.Kube nezigameko ezingu-71 lapho obekusuke kubulawa khona abantu abaningi ngesikhathi esisodwa okugcine kuholela ekutheni kuphume izidumbu ezingu-164 kulezo zehlakalo.Uthe halamuzi nangokwanda kwezigameko zokwebiwa kwemfuyo, waveza ukuthi zande kakhulu ezindaweni ezisemakhaya.Ubale iziteshi okukhona kuzo iMpendle, Mondlo, Mpangeni naseMadlangeni, wathi kwande kakhulu ukwebiwa kwemfuyo kuzo.Amacala okuzama ukubulala anyuke ngo-3.9% okusho ukuthi kunezezeleke angu-66 uma kuqhathaniswa nesikhathi esifanayo sangonyaka owedlule.Amacala okusashaya ngenhloso yokulimaza anyuke ngo-7.5% okusho ukuthi anyuke ngangu-534.
UVUMA eyempi ebamele ngenhla yezinswelaboya ezihlela ukubulawa kwabantu zingaphakathi emajele, uKhomishana wamaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, u-Lieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi.UMkhwanazi ugonyuluke ngalokhu eMayville, eThekwini, ngesikhathi ehambisana noNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, kwethulwa izimoto ezingu-36 ezizosetshenziswa amaphoyisa ukulwa nobugebengu.UMkhwanazi uthe isiqala ukubakhathaza manje indaba yeziboshwa ezikwazi ukuhlela konke kodwa zingaphakathi emajele."Lena yimpi esibhekene nayo nje ngqo okumele silwe nayo size siyinqobe. Ukukhuluma iqiniso nje sekuyakhathaza ukuzwa ngezigameko okutholakala ukuthi zisuke zihlelwe ngabantu bengaphakathi emajele,'' usho kanjena.Uthe kwesinye isikhathi abasemajele bahlela ukubulawa kwabantu abasuke bengofakazi emacaleni abucayi ngethemba lokucisha ubufakazi bamacala abo.''Kumele kube khona esikwenzayo ukuze siyinqobe le mpi esizithola sibhekene nayo manje,'' usho kanje.Uphonsele amaphoyisa inselelo yokuba aqhubeke nokusebenza ngokuzikhandla yize kunezimo ezifuze lezi ezibonakala zibathwalisa kanzima.UMkhwanazi ukhuluma kanjena nje, ziningi izigameko zokubulawa kwabantu lapho obekuvela ukuthi umyalelo ubusuke uvela kumuntu osezikhindini.UFaith Nongcebo Ntombela, osanda kugwetshwa ngecala lokusoconga umyeni wakhe uCaptain Zwelakhe Ntombela owayesebenzela uMkhandlu weTheku, kwagcina kuvelile ukuthi umyalelo wayewunikezwe yinkabi engaphakathi, uKhulani Cele.Odabeni lowesilisa owayehamba ngesihlalo esinamasondo owadutshulwa ngoyaba lwezinhlamvu eMlaza ekuqaleni konyaka kwavela nakhona ukuthi ababulali babeyalelwe ngumuntu osejele ukuba "basuse” umufi.UMkhwanazi ubuye wezwakalisa ukukhathazeka okukhulu ngokwanda kwezigameko zamaphoyisa abulawa yizigebengu.Uthe kuleli sonto nje lilodwa abe mathathu amaphoyisa adutshulwe afa yizinswelaboya. Amabili awo abulawe esigamekweni esenzeke eCliffdale, ngaseHammarsdale."Kuyasikhathaza kakhulu ukuthi kubulawe abantu ababeqashelwe ukuthi bazovikela umphakathi. Ayikho into esingafuni ukuzwa ngayo njengeyezigameko zokubulawa kwamaphoyisa,'' usho kanjena.Ngesonto eledlule kubanjwe izinto ezingavumelekile ukuba semajele eWestville. Kutholwe amaselula namashaja, izidakamizwa nezikhali. Osibhincamakhasana bathi ngisho ubugebengu obujulile njengokubanjwa kwezimoto zemali inkunzi buhlelwa emajele ngoba iziboshwa zinesikhathi sonke sokuhlela nokucabanga ubugebengu ubusuku nemini.
KUZOVUKA iminjunju kukhunjulwa iNkosi yesibili yebandla lamaNazaretha, iNkosi Johannes Galile Shembe, Ilanga, njengoba kuqala inkonzo yesikhumbuzo sayo namuhla emzini wayo eNelisiwe, eShowe.AmaNazaretha ngaphansi kobuholi beNkosi uMduduzi Shembe uNyazilwezulu, aseqalile ukuthutheleka eShowe njengoba kunenkonzo enkulu yeNkosi Ilanga.INKOSI uMduduzi Shembe, Unyazilwezulu, oluhola inkonzo yesikhumbuzo seNkosi Ilanga esingathelwe eNelisiwe, eShowe, kuleli sonto Isithombe: SIGCINIWEOkhulumela amaNazaretha ngaphansi komholi uNyazilwezulu, uMnuz Thokozani Mncwabe, uthe kuzoba yinkonzo enkulu le futhi, iNkosi Ilanga ingenye yamakhosi ahlonishwa kakhulu Ekuphakameni."Wonke amakhosi akaShembe aphiwe amandla kodwa kuhluka izindlela asebenza ngazo. INkosi Ilanga yaphrofethwa nguMqaliwendlela ukuthi kuza inkosi enkulu kwaShembe ezolandela emva kwakhe. Asazi ke ukuthi wayesho ukuthini uMqaliwendlela ngalokho, kodwa kuningi okwenziwa yiLanga okwakufakazela ubukhulu balo. AMANAZARETHA akhumbula iNkosi yesibili yakwaShembe, iNkosi Johannes Galile Shembe, Ilanga Isithombe: FACEBOOK"Ibithi uma ingena Ekuphakameni kuhayize abantu kuphume ufufunyane namadliso kwabanawo. Ngisho nezibongo zayo kukhona izinhlamvu ezithi: ”Ungumehlo awabhekani nawomuntu". Lokho kungenxa yokuthi yayiyinkosi ongakwazi ukuyibuka eziqwini zamehlo. Ngelinye ilanga yathinta emahlombe indoda eyayisebenzisa izigqabo isesontweni, yavuma phansi,” kusho uMncwabe.Uthe ngisho nenkakha yemidlalo yeshashalazi engasekho, uMbongeni Ngema, yacelwa kuyona iNkosi Ilanga, yazalwa inesandla esigoqene. "Abazali baMbongeni bamphindisela kulona Ilanga beyokhala ngokuthi ingane ibingaphrofethwanga ukuthi izozalwa inesandla esigoqene. Lavele lahleka labatshela ukuthi sizobuye siqonde kodwa sigoqene ngoba ifihle izinto zayo okungamele zibonwe yizwe. Nangempela uMbongeni kwahamba isikhathi, isandla saqonda njengoba egcine esevelele emidlalweni yeshashalazi,” usho kanje.Eqhuba uMncwabe, uthe nagosuku okwakhothama ngalo Ilanga baningi abashiya ukukholwa ngoba babengazitsheli ukuthi ukufa kungathatha Ilanga. INkosi Unyazilwezulu, nayo yake yashumayela ngesimanga seNkosi Ilanga lapho abamhlophe base bekhiphe isinqumo sokuthi ngeke ubekhona umhlangano kaJulayi ngomunye unyaka ngenxa yokuthi kwakuxake isomiso. Amanzi ayekhona Ekuphakameni kuthiwa bawahlola bakhala ngokuthi awaphephile ukuthi angaphuzwa abantu. Ilanga kuthiwa lathi umhlangano uzoqhubeka, base belibizela eThekwini, Ilanga ngoba bekhala ngokuthi leqa umyalelo wabo ngamanzi. Kuthiwa lathi uma lifika emahhovisi eThekwini, alizange likhulume lutho kodwa kwatatazela abelungu, balinga nokuguqa ngamadolo bekhuleka kulona. Kuthiwa bagcina sebebuzana bodwa ukuthi ubani obize uShembe ukuthi eze kubona. Emva kwalokho, kuthiwa yibona abavele bathi bazowalethela amaNazaretha amanzi azowaphuza, awuqhubeke umhlangano kaJulayi.INkosi Ilanga yahola ibandla lamaNazaretha kusuka ngo-1935 ineminyaka engu-30 yaze yakhothama ngoDisemba 19,1976, emva kweminyaka engu-40 ingumholi wamaNazaretha.UMncwabe uthe ngoLwesithathu kuqale inkonzo kufakazwa ngemisebenzi yeLanga bese kuba nemigidi eyahlukene ngokuhamba kwezinsuku.
OWESILISA waseManyiseni, eNgwavuma, osolwa ngecala lokugwaza abulale usinganina obenguthishanhloko ngeSonto eledlule, kuthiwa wayalela umsolwa ayehamba naye ukuthi angamlokothi umntanakhe owayekhona kubulawa uthishanhloko.Lokhu kuvezwe umthombo olwazi ukusuka nokuhlala udaba lokubulawa ngesihluku kukaNkk Busisiwe Mathenjwa (60). Umufi obenguthishanhloko eManyiseni Primary ufihlwe ngesizotha ngoMgqibelo.Umthombo ulandisa Isolezwe uthe umsolwa (39), ozalwa umyeni kamufi ugasele kubo ehamba nomunye umsolwa, othe uma ezama ukulimaza ingane ezalwa umfowabo, wathi "umntanami ungamthinti”."Lokhu wayekusho ngomzukulu kamufi (ozalwa umfowabo kamsolwa) oneminyaka elinganiselwa ku-16 obehlala nomufi,” kusho umthombo.Umthombo uveze ukuthi kwenzeka lesi sigameko nje, umyeni kamufi ubesanda kunikela enduneni eyocela ukuba imlekelele ahlanganise umndeni wakhe."Bekuyinyanga edlule eya enduneni eyokwenza lesi sicelo. Kuvela ukuthi wafike waveza ukuthi odadewabo bayamnyakazisa yena nomkakhe njengoba bona bebaningi, yena engowesilisa yedwa,” kulandisa umthombo.Udalule ukuthi amalungu omndeni "abesebenzisa" izingane ”ukumnyakazisa” njengoba kugcine sekwenzeka lesi sigameko sokubulawa kukaNkk Mathenjwa.Ubuye waveza ukuthi basabamba amakhanda namanje emphakathini ngesenzo sikamsolwa njengoba ebebhukuda emafutheni, kungekho umufi nomyeni wakhe ebebengamenzeli kona."Ubeyiqanda, bamfundise wagogoda. Wathola umsebenzi kwa-Transnet, wabuye wawuyeka ethi ngeke elokhu esebenzela umlungu yena. Bamthengela ogandaganda ababili ukuthi azisebenze njengoba wabatshela ukuthi uthanda ezolimo, nakho kwamhlula, kumanje bahleli ogandaganda,” kusho umthombo.Uveze ukuthi ubesenesipaza esincane kodwa ebhema insangu. Uqhube wathi abazi ngempela ukuthi umsolwa ubengenwe uSathane muni, ebulala umuntu obewusizo olungaka emphakathini.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi njengoba ebenguthishanhloko, ubewusizo kubafundi bendawo. Kuvela ukuthi ubengagcini lapho, nasesontweni eSheshi lapho abenezikhundla ezehlukene khona, ubephinde abe wusizo."Nasemphakathini nje, ubengowesifazane omnene, ubebizwa asabele. Ngisho kunemingcwabo, ubumfica ehamba phambili ngokusiza,” kwenaba umthombo.Ethintwa umyeni kamufi, uMnuz Bhekinkosi Mathenjwa, uvumile ukuthi umsolwa yindodana yakhe."Yebo, uzalwa yimi kodwa phela ukwenzile-ke lokhu akwenzile,” kusho uMathenjwa ngamafuphi.Uqhube wathi akukho okuphathekayo akwaziyo obekungaholela ekutheni indodana yakhe isoconge umkakhe.Uthe njengoba aphawula ngokuthi yinto yasemndenini ukubulawa kukamufi, wayekusho ngoba azi ukuthi umsolwa usekhaya.Ngosuku lwesigameko kuthiwa umsolwa wafuna umnikelo wesonto nokwathi uma umufi emnika wakhala ngokuthi mncane, wase emgwaza.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, eqinisekisa isigameko uthe amaphoyisa aseNdumo, abophe owesilisa (39) kulandela isigameko sokubanjwa inkunzi kowesifazane ngaphambi kokuba abulawe.Uthe umsolwa uvelile eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseNgwavuma ngoLwesithathu olwedlule, kanti uzovela futhi kusasa.
INYUNYANA yamaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, iPolice and Prisons Civil Rights Union (Popcru) igxeka izigameko zokubulawa kwamaphoyisa evile kwamane, okwenzeke esifundazweni esikhathini esifushane.Esigamekweni sakamumva, kudutshulwe kwafa amaphoyisa amabili eCliffdale, ngaseHammarsdale ngempelasonto.Abafi oCaptain Naveen Pather obengumphathi siteshi noWarrant Officer Dumisani Ndlovu obengumphathi wabaseshi ebebesebenza esiteshini samaphoyisa iHammarsdale, bebebizelwe endaweni yesigameko.Kuvele ukuthi badutshulwe bafa umsolwa obesedubule esinye isihlobo sabebezongcwatshwa, nabo okuthiwa ubabulale ngeledlule eClermont.Kwesinye isigameko, okuthiwa senzeke eMpangeni, kudutshulwe kwafa elinye iphoyisa.UNobhala we-Popcru KwaZulu-Natal uNkk Nthabeleng Molefe uthe banxusa wonke amaphoyisa ukuthi aqikelele ukuphepha kwempilo yawo kanjalo nomphakathi uma ebona ubungozi.Constable WD Hulley"Awazisebenzise ngokushesha izibhamu zawo uma ebona ingozi iseduze. Ukubulawa kwamaphoyisa kudala ukuthi kungabi bikho ukuphepha emphakathini, kuphinde kungabi nazinzo,” kusho uNkk Molefe.Ugcizelele ukuthi ukubulawa kwamaphoyisa kufanele kuthathwe njengecala elinzima futhi kuyafana nokuthi owenza leso senzo usuke evukela uMbuso.Uthe banxusa abanegunya lokuchibiyela umthetho ukuthi bawubuyekeze ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha kwamaphoyisa.Uphinde washaya indesheni emphakathini, ethi awusebenzisane namaphoyisa, ungapholisi maseko ukubika izehlakalo zobugebengu."Siyawunxusa ukuthi uphinde usukumele nomsuka wodlame nesihluku okubonakala kubhebhetheka emiphakathini. Le nkinga ingalunga uma sonke singabambisana ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imiphakathi yethu iyindawo ephephile kuwo wonke umuntu,” usho kanje.Nokho uthe bakushayela ihlombe ukuthi amaphoyisa aqinisekisile ukuthi umsolwa oyedwa uyaboshwa, kwathi omunye amthela othulini.Esigamekweni saseCliffdale, bekulungiselelwa umlindelo kaNobuhle Majola (16) noNksz Nomfundo Majola (23), okuthiwa umsolwa ubebadubule kwaBhontshisi eClermont ngoMgqibelo odlule. THE AVBOB Group delivered exceptional results for the reporting year. While socio-economic challenges and inequality persist in the country, AVBOB remains encouraged by signs of political stability and an improving business outlook.Through its shared value business model, AVBOB has declared a R13.1 billion cash bonus to its members. The AVBOB 65Alive Cash Benefit is set to launch in January 2025. The previous AVBOB Reward Account centenary bonus will be replaced by the new cash benefit.Members of AVBOB are entitled to share in the profits of the business. These profits are shared as member benefits, which are provided over and above the contractual policy benefits. Profit allocations are made from time to time at the discretion of the directors.Chairman of the Board Jannie Venter, at AVBOB’s 73rd annual general meeting held at the group’s head office in Irene Link, described the substantial bonus declaration at the group financial results presentation as a demonstration of the importance of value creation for society."A shared national commitment to sound economic policy support helps to accelerate and drive sustainable benefit to society. Our shared value model, which fosters inclusivity and innovation, benefits all members and is a testament to the strong foundation of our mutual society,” said Venter.This historic financial declaration is underpinned by the group’s mission to provide meaningful and tangible support to its members. With the new declaration, AVBOB 65Alive, members are eligible for payment on request on or after the first policy anniversary after the main insured person reaches age 65, subject to their policy having a minimum term of 10 years in force.Growth and strategyAVBOB CEO Carl van der Riet said despite prevailing economic pressures, the growth strategies of the business are gaining traction, strengthening its market position. He credited this to the resilience of the AVBOB business and its continued innovation."AVBOB is pleased to declare this substantial bonus to its members, which affirms our commitment to sharing the society’s success. Leveraging our mutual status allows us to return value to our members, through our combined insurance and funeral service offerings,” he said.Van der Riet explained that the core focus of the business remains sustainable growth and strategic differentiation. AVBOB is also strengthening its stakeholder engagement by expanding its digital channels and introducing high-impact self-service platforms.The member-centric approach of the business continues to shape AVBOB’s offerings. The newly launched AVBOB Member Rewards programme has seen unprecedented interest from AVBOB members and has generated renewed, and positive, brand energy. With more than 300 000 members currently benefiting from the programme, it stands as a testament to AVBOB’s ongoing commitment to value creation and sharing.AVBOB achieving a Level 1 B-BBEE rating in the year under review highlights its commitment to transformation. For the business, the collective benefit of all communities forms a key part of its operations. And with over 2.7 million policyholders and nine million individual lives assured, AVBOB aims to continue to uphold its legacy as a household brand to millions of South Africans across the country.The 2023/2024 financial highlightsIn the financial year ending June 30, 2024, AVBOB achieved the following:• The group paid out R2.9bn in policy benefits• Premium income increased by 9.0% to R6.8bn• Net new business sales increased by 30.2% to R1.3bn• Increased the national footprint of funeral service, insurance and client service to a total of 380 offices• Members received R498.9m in FREE funeral benefits provided by AVBOB Funeral Service• AVBOB donated its 70th container library and 500 trolley libraries to underserved schools, as part of its investment in literacy and education• Choice Awards• The 2024 Best Funeral Service category in the Best of Mossel Bay Readers’ Choice Awards• The 2024 PMR.africa Gauteng Provincial Survey Business Excellence Awards• Die Burger newspaper Readers’ Choice Awards "Jou Keuse” 2024 "Begrafnisdienste” category• The 2024 Sunday Times GenX Awards, Coolest Insurance Brand

KULIMALE inqwaba yabafana ngesikhathi behlaselwa yinkunzi esigodlweni seSilo saseSwatini eLudzidzini Royal Palace, ngoLwesithathu ekuseni.Kuthiwa laba bafana, ababizwa ngama-ngatja ngolimi lwakhona, bebenza usiko lokubamba inkunzi lapho kufanele bayibulale ngezandla.Ukubulawa kwenkunzi kuyingxenye yomcimbi oqhubekayo obizwa ngokuthi, Incwala. Namuhla kugujwa iholidi leNcwala kuleliya zwe.Ngokubika kweSwaziland News, kuthiwa iSilo uMswati III sijwayele ukwenza usiko kuyona inkunzi ngokulala nayo nokuyingakho izibongo zakhe zithi "uchamela enkhomeni uchamele nakumuntfu”.Iqhube yathi kujwayele ukwenziwa usiko kuyona ngaphambi kokuthi ibulawe ngabafana futhi kuthiwa cishe minyaka yonke abanye bayafa esibayeni bebulawa yiyo le nkunzi.Ezintatha ngoLwesithathu ngabo 2 ekuseni kuphuthunyiswe inqwaba yabafana esibhedlela futhi abanye basesimeni esibucayi.ISwaziland News ishicilele i-vidiyo eveza abanye beqhuga.Ukuphawula kwendlunkulu akutholakalanga.
KUDINGEKA ngaphezu kukaR16 billion ukuze uMnyango weMfundo eyisiSekelo uqinisekise ukuthi zonke izikole kuleli zinengqalasizinda efanele kanjalo nothisha bakwaGrade R.U-R12 billion kule mali ngowengqalasizinda ethinta ukwakha amakilasi ezikoleni ezingenawo, kanjalo nokuphucula amakilasi ezikoleni ezinawo. U-R4.6 billion ngowokuholela othisha baleli banga, okufaka nokulinganisa amaholo abafundisayo abahola imali engalingani nothisha abaqashwe ngokugcwele.Lokhu kuvezwe nguMnuz James Ndlebe obhekele ezokuphatha emnyangweni, otshele amalungu ekomiti lezemfundo ephalamende, ukuthi badinga le mali uma kuphasiswa izichibiyelo ezenziwe emthethwenisivivinywa, iBasic Education Laws Amendment Bill (Bela). Ngokwalo mthethosivivinywa, leli banga lizoba yimpoqo njengoba phambilini bekuwuGrade 1 oyimpoqo.Okunye okuqukethwe wumthethosivivinywa yisigwebo abazali okumele basinikwe uma benqabela izingane zabo ukuthi zifunde, eyokuvalwa kwenduku, eyokudayiswa kotshwala ezikoleni uma kunemicimbi yokuqoqa imali, eyokunika amandla inhloko yomnyango wezemfundo ngolimi oluzofundwa esikoleni kanjalo noma isikole sesigcwele. UNdlebe uthe zingu-14 780 izikole ezinamakilasi kaGrade R, ezingu-7 888 zidinga ukwakhelwa lawa makilasi.Uthe bangu-6 177 othisha abaqashwe ngokugcwele abafundisa leli banga, abangu-19 767 baqashwe yiminyango yezifundazwe ebakhokhela imiholo engalingani."Sinabafundi abevile ku-760 000 kwaGrade R. Ngokwesiphakamiso esikhona uthisha oyedwa uzofundisa ikilasi labafundi abangu-40. Othisha abaqashwe ngokugcwele kwaGrade R bakhokhelwa uR2.6 billion, ngakho ukuze silinganise umholo walabo abaqashwe yizifundazwe ngokwehlukana, sidinga omunye uR2 billion. Lokhu kusho ukuthi isiyonke imali esiyidingayo yokuholela othisha bakwaGrade R inguR4.6 billion,” kusho uNdlebe.Uthe njengoba uGrade R ungene ngaphansi komnyango wabo, usuka kowezenhlalakahle bebengalixhasi leli banga.Kuphakame imimoya emhlanganweni amalungu e-DA uMnuz Baxolile Nodada noNksz Marina van Zyl nelungu le-ACDP uNksz Marie Elizabeth Sukers, adube aphuma emhlanganweni ekhala ngosihlalo wekomiti uNkk Bongiwe Mbinqo-Gigaba, ukuthi uhlabela phambili nomhlangano ekubeni kunezinto abakhala ngazo.Kudingeke ukuthi uNkk Mbinqo-Gigaba, awuhlehlise umhlangano njengoba besingavumi isibalo sokuthi uqhubeke ngoba amalungu ePhalamende abesemahlanu, ekubeni ukuze kuthathwe izinqumo kudingeka abe yisithupha.UNodada ukhale ngokuthi zibalelwa ku-32 000 izethulo zomphakathi nezinhlangano ezizimele ezenziwe ngalo mthethosivivinywa kodwa zincane ezisacutshunguliwe."Ngeke sivume ukuthi kuqhubeke lutho zingabhekiwe iziphakamiso zomphakathi. Lo mthetho kuhloswe ngawo ukuphuca amandla izikole, ngeke sivumele i-ANC ukuthi ibulale imfundo.”
SELULELWE unyaka ozayo isikhathi sokubhalisa ngokusemthethweni amabhizinisi abo kwabezipaza nabadayisa emigwaqweni.Bekulindeleke ukuthi uLwesibili kube wusuku lokugcina lokuthi bonke abanalolu hlobo lwamabhizinisi bawabhalise komasipala abahweba kubo, kodwa sebephinde banikezwa elinye ithuba. Esithangamini songqongqoshe beminyango ehlukene nabezindaba ePitoli, owoMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa, uqinisekise ukuthi lolu hlelo lokubhaliswa kwamabhizinisi sekuhlehliselwe uFebhuwari 28.UHlabisa uthe umsebenzi wokuqinisekisa ukuphepha kwezindawo ezidayisa ukudla nokungena kwempahla ngendlela engekho emthethweni, uzoqhubeka nangesikhathi sokudlula kwalo mnqamulajuqu osubekwe uhulumeni."Abazothola izimvume ezibagunyaza ukudayisa, kuzoqhutshekwa nokubhekwa ukuthi bayayilandela imigomo ebekiwe, ephephile yokuphatha nokudayisa ukudla. Ukubhaliswa kwala mabhizinisi, kwenzelwe ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abanikazi bayayihlonipha imigomo ebekiwe kungakhathalekile ukuthi phambilini bebesebenza kanjani,” usho kanje.Uthe mningi umsebenzi osuwenziwe esikhathini esiyizinsuku ezingu-21, emva kokuthi uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ememezele ukuthi kubhaliswe. UHlabisa uthe kuzwelonke, zingu-392 izikhungo zokubhalisa ezivuliwe. Zingu-49 915 izicelo ezifakiwe phakathi kukaNovemba 15 noDisemba 17. Kuzona, ezingu-19 385 sezigunyaziwe ukuqhubela nokuhweba. UHlabisa uthe lokhu kusho umsebenzi omkhulu osuwenziwe oqhubekayo, esikhathini esiyizinsuku ezingu-21.Ukubhaliswa kwamabhizinisi kudalwe ukufa nokugula kwabantu okukholakala ukuthi badla abebekuthenge ezitodlwana ezithile, okugqame kakhulu ukushona kwezingane.

YISIKHATHI samaholidi, kwabaningi, lokho kusho ukuthi yisikhathi sokuphumula nokungcebeleka nomndeni nabangani. Kulapho futhi abakhwabanisi beqinisa imizamo yabo ngoba abantu abaqaphile futhi ukuthola amabhonasi kubenza bakhululeke kakhulu ngemali.Ngokombiko we-South African Banking Risk Information Centre’s (SABRIC) 2023 Annual Crime Statistics Report, ukwanda kobugebengu bezezimali kwenze ezomnotho zalahlekelwa yimali elinganiselwa ku-R3.3million. Lokhu kwenziwa ukunyuka kakhulu kobugebengu obenziwa nge-internet. Izigebengu seziqalile ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuthuthukisiwe njenge-generative AI ukuze zenze izinhlelo eziningi neziseqophelweni eliphezulu zokukhwabanisa, ezihlanganisa ama-email omgunyathi enziwe sengathi aphuma ezinkampanini ezinkulu kanjalo nama-sms athunyelwe komakhalekhukhwini anama-link.Abakhwabanisi ngokuvamile bazama ukuthola i-PIN yakho noma i-password yesikhashana (OTP) ukuze bantshontshe imali kwi-akhawunti yakho yasebhange noma benze uveze imininingwane yakho siqu ukuze ufake isicelo semalimboleko egameni lakho.UGavyn Letley, ovela enkampanini ebolekisa ngemali eyisipesheli i-DirectAxis, uthe: "Ngenxa yokuthi izigebengu zihlala zishintsha ayikho indlela 'engenangqondo’ yokugwema imikhonyovu. Wonke umuntu usengozini, kodwa unganciphisa amathuba okuba ubanjwe ngokuqapha.”Nakhu okufanele ukubheke nezinye izindlela zokugwema imikhonyovu evamile:Qinisekisa ngaphambi kokwethemba:- Hlola ubuqiniso bezingcingo, imiyalezo, noma ama-email ashaya sengathi avela emabhange, abathengisi, noma abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo ngaphambi kokukhipha noma yiluphi ulwazi. Ungakhiphi imininingwane yakho siqu ocingweni ngisho noma ofonayo ethi uvela ebhange noma inkampani ye-IT.- Ungachofozi ama-link kuma-email noma imilayezo ye-SMS. Xhumana nabo usebenzisa imininingwane yokuxhumana esemthethweni, hhayi leyo enikezwe emilayezweni. - Ungakhohliswa ngemilayezo ethi uwine umklomelo, imali oyizuza njengefa, noma ufanelekile ukubolekwa imali enenzalo encane.Ungabelani ngolwazi lomuntu siqu:– Ungalokothi unikeze noma ubani ipasswordi yakho, i-PIN noma i-OTP, ngisho noma ethi uvela ebhange noma enkampanini enegama elihle.– Ungabelani ngenombolo yakho kamazisi, ikheli, noma olunye ulwazi lomuntu siqu ezinkundleni zokuxhumana.– Ungawalahli amaphepha aqukethe imininingwane yomuntu. Wadabule lapho kunemininingwane kamazisi noma uwashise.Hlakanipha ngezinkundla zokuxhumana:– Thenga kuphela kuma-website ahloniphekile anezindlela zokukhokha ezivikelekile (bheka okuthi 'https’ kwi-URL nesithonjana se-padlock).– Sebenzisa amagama ayimfihlo kuma-akhawunti akwi-internet okuyinhlanganisela yezinhlamvu ezinkulu nezincane, izinombolo, nezimpawu.– Nika amandla ukuqinisekisa kwezinto ezimbili lapho kunokwenzeka khona okungaba yinombolo yeselula ne-email.– Gcina amakhadi akho asebhange nama-divice eselula kuphephile. Ikakhulukazi lawo asetshenziselwa ukubhanga nge-internet. Bika futhi uvimbele noma imaphi amakhadi alahlekile noma antshontshiwe ngokushesha.– Ungavuli ama-app ebhange lakho noma imininingwane eyimfihlo kwi-internetlapho usebenzisa khona i-Wi-Fi yomphakathi. Sebenzisa i-VPN uma kudingeka.– Qinisekisa ukuthi ufaka i-software ethembekile yokulwa namagciwane ekhompyutheni noma kwiselula yakho.– Ungalokothi uvumele abantu abangagunyaziwe ukuthi bafinyelele kuma-divice akho bekude.– Ungavumeli abantu abangagunyaziwe ukuthi bangene endlini yakho noma kuma-divice ngisho noma bethi bangochwepheshe.Qapha lokhu:– Qaphela izicelo zokukhokha eziphuthumayo zezimpahla noma amasevisi ongazange uwa-ode, nezindlela zokukhokha ezingavamile njengamakhadi esipho, i-cryptocurrency, noma ukudluliselwa ngezintambo. Lezi ezivame ukusetshenziselwa imikhonyovu.– Abakhwabanisi basebenzisa ukuthakazelelwa ngezicelo zezinhlangano ezisiza umphakathi ezingelona iqiniso. Nikela ngokuqondile ezinhlanganweni ezaziwayo esikhundleni sokuphendula izicelo ezingahleliwe.– Qaphela izicelo zokukhokha kusengaphambili zezimpahla, namasevisi noma ukukhulula imiklomelo noma ezinye izimali.– Bheka amaphutha okupelwa kwamagama, ama-logo aphelelwe yisikhathi, amakheli e-email angajwayelekile noma izizinda ze-email okungezona ezebhizinisi njenge-G-mail kwezokuxhumana.Hlala ubheka isimo sakhe sezimali:– Hlola njalo ama-akhawunti akho asebhange kanye nemibiko yezikweletu ukuze uthole okwenziwayo okungagunyaziwe noma izinguquko ezingalindelekile. Amathuluzi amahhala afana ne-Pulse (https://www.directaxis.co.za/pulse) akuvumela ukuthi uhlole isilinganiso sakho sesikweletu kaningi ngokuthanda kwakho.– Bika noma yimuphi umsebenzi osolisayo ebhange lakho noma umhlinzeki wosizo lwezezimali. Iminyango yokukhwabanisa ingasiza ekuphenyeni nasekuvaleni ama-akhawunti omkhonyovu noma ama-website.Ngolunye ulwazi olwengeziwe ngena ku-https://www.directaxis.co.za/make-a-plan/how-to-spot-a-scam

Abasemapulazini akufanele bahole imali engaphansi kwalena ebekiwe.”Uphinde wamemezela ukuthi ngonyaka ozayo kuzoba nomhlangano lapho kuzokhulunywa khona ngesimo sezwe.Khonamanjalo, uNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, wethule inkulumo emcimbini wokukhumbula impi yaseNcome.UNtuli uthe isifundazwe sidlule ezigamekweni eziningi zodlame okubalwa kuzo udlame lwezepolitiki nezigameko zakamuva zokubulawa kwamalungu emindeni amaningi.Uthe kubalulekile ukuba kube nokubuyisana." Ngihlala ngisho ukuthi ukubulalana akusona isixazululo. Siyakukhuza lokho.”

nangokukuphendlela amanye amathuba okungelula ukuzitholela wona ngokwakho endimeni,” kucebisa uVuyo.UNothando Ngcobo wodumo lukaHlelo emdlalweni ongeminye yehamba phambili ngababukeli ezweni, Uzalo, esemqoka nesizayo wukuhlale uzinakekela njalo, ugcine umzimba wakho nephimbo lakho kusesimweni esifanele ukusiza ukuthi uma sekuvela amathuba okuya kwinhlolokhono ethile ukwazi ukuhlaba umxhwele abasuke behlola ikhono lakho, okuzokwenza ukuthi ne-agent yakho ikhuthale ukukufunela nokukwazisa ngeminye imisebenzi endimeni,” kusho uNothando.Kuwo futhi lo mbuthwano kukhuthazwe abangakagqami kule ndima phecelezi ama-background actor, ukuthi bangapheli moya, kepha basebenzise lawo mathuba amancane abawatholayo ukuzakhela igama nokufunda okuningi ngezokulingisa.Kunxuswe nokuthi abalingisi baqhubeke basebenzise zinkundla zokuxhumana ukukhulisa nokusabalalisa umsebenzi wabo wobuciko, ukusiza ukwandisa amathuba okuqasheka endimeni.Ezinye izikhulumi ebezikulo mbuthwano ngoCassandra Garofallou, Shaun Stander, noLondiwe Shange obengumqondisi wohlelo. AZIXAZULULWE ziphele izinkinga eziholele esitelekeni sabamatekisi ahamba ibanga elide esidonse isikhathi esingaphezu kwesonto.Ekupheleni kukaNovemba, inqwaba yabagibeli isale dengwane emva kokuthi abamabanga amade bemise ukusebenza kwamatekisi abo.Isiteleka siqale ngesikhathi esibi, kuwuLwesihlanu lokuphela kwenyanga.Lapha abantu abaningi bebezimisele ngokuya emakhaya, kunenqwaba yezingane zesikole ezivakashayo nezibuyela emakhaya (lezo ezifunda kude nasemakhaya) emva kokuqeda ukubhala, isitshudeni nabagibeli nje jukelele.Abanye bajika, abanye bazama ezinye izindlela zokufinyelela lapho abebephokphele ukuya khona.Abanye balabo abaphokophela, babeke impilo yabo engcupheni njengoba abanye babo bebehambe bemisa izimoto ezincane ezidlulayo njengoba kukuningi okubi okungakuvelela ngesikhathi uzama ukumisa izimoto ezincane kuthelawayeka.Ungashayiswa izimoto, ubanjwe inkunzi usamile emgwaqweni noma uthunjwe abantu bezimoto ezincane.Mhlawumbe sekuyisikhathi sokuthi kube khona ezinye izindlela zokuthutha zomphakathi ezihamba ibanga elide. Sikhule kukhona amabhasi ahamba amabanga amade, kukhona nezitimela.Mhlawumbe sesifikile isikhathi sokuthi uhulumeni ulungise imizila yezitimela, kunikwe izimvume zokusebenza amabhasi amabanga amade ngoba kusobala ukuthi isazoqhubeka inkinga yamatekisi.Umbhikisho wakamumva uphazamise nokusebenza komnotho njengoba ababhikishi bebevimba umgwaqo onguthelawayeka, u-N3.Udaba lwezimvume zokusebenza nokuboshwa kwezimoto nguShanela seluphenduke icala lenduna, umhlezi ekhona.Kuyaye kube nemibhikisho, kuhlalwe phansi, kuthiwe izinkinga zizoxazululwa. Emva kwesikhathi umbhikisho uqala, kukhalwe ngezinto ezifanayo.Kusobala ukuthi izinkinga ezidala imibhikisho ziyaye zishiywe zilenga, zingalungiswa. Uma le nkinga yabamatekisi nomnyango ingalungiswa ingase iphume esandleni njengoba isiqalile ukuhlukanisa phakathi abamatekisi.Ukungaboni ngaso linye kwabemboni ngalolu daba kuhlale obala emhlanganweni obungeledlule, eMgungundlovu.Umhlangano ubuhanjelwe uNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, uMphathiswa wezokuThutha esifundazweni, uMnuz Siboniso Duma, nabaholi bososeshini abehlukene.Okugqamile nokho ukungalubhadi kwabenhlangano iDurban Long Distance Taxi Association, abaholi bale nhlangano njengoba kuyibona abahola umbhikisho oqhubekayo.Abebesemhlanganweni bazwakalise ukungahambisani nombhikisho oqhubekayo.UMnuz Velanto Thwala weSizwe Transport Association, uthe bona abazange baziswe lutho ngombhikisho. ISizwe Transport Association isebenza phakathi kweGoli neTheku."Sinenkinga eDurban Station. Sinenkinga yokuthi sekuvele kwamiswa izimoto zethu. Sekungokwesibili kulo nyaka kwenzeka. Izimoto zethu zivele zamiswa singazange sitshelwe lutho. Asazi ukuthi zimiselweni. Kusiphazamisile emiphefumulweni yethu lokhu.”UThwala uthe bazamile ukukhuluma nabeDurban Long Distance Taxi Association kodwa ubuholi bayo banqaba ukuhlangana nabo.Abatelekile bakhala ngezimvume zokusebenza noShanela.Kepha uThwala uthe izimvume ziyashesha ukutholakala lapha KwaZulu-Natal, wathi inkinga isesifundazweni iGauteng, esebaze baluleka izikhulu zoMnyango wezokuThutha eGauteng ukuba bazothekela ulwazi lapha kwelikaMthaniya.Ngalo isonto eledlule, omunye wabaholi kwiDurban Long Distance Taxi Association, uMnuz Mavava Sikhakhane, uthe labo abaphikisana nesiteleka bengaqhubeka besebenze."Siyababongela bona abakwazi ukubanika izimvume kodwa sinombuzo wokuthi thina sasala kanjani bangasinika izimvume? Kodwa ke ngoba bona banazo izimvume, abaqhubeke bathuthe abantu beze lapha eThekwini. Kodwa kusho ukuthi mhla nathi sinquma ukuqhubeka nokusebenza, engabe siyoqhubeka yini silayishe nabo?”Lezi nkulumo zikhombisa ukuthi le ndaba izophela kabi uma ingalungiswa ngokushesha.ABAGIBELI basala dengwane ngesikhathi kunesiteleka sabamatekisi ahamba ibanga elide Isithombe esigciniwe: SIBONELO NGCOBOImboni yamatekisi iphuma esikhathini esibi lapho khona bekuchitheka igazi ngapha nangapha. Ziningi izinsizwa elilele phansi ngenxa yodlame lwamatekisi, kwavalwa nemizi.UNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, uthe ukhathazekile ngodlame lwezamatekisi."Sizolusukumela udaba, sibuke ukuthi sizolusebenza kanjani ukuze abantu baKwaZulu-Natal babenethemba lokuphepha. Akusesona isikhathi sokusebenzisa isibhamu lesi uma kukhona ukungaboni ngaso linye. Isikhathi lesi sokuba kuhlalwe phansi. Uma kukhona abangafuni ukuhlala phansi, bikelani umnyango. Siyezwa ukuthi niyafuna ukuhlala nabo phansi, bona abafuni.”Nango-Okthoba, bekunomunye umbhikisho wabamatekisi amabanga amade odonse izinsuku, lapho bebekhala khona ngazo izimvume noShanela.Ukuqubuka kabusha kwalo mbhikisho kungakapheli sikhathi esingakanani kukade kunomunye umbhikisho owamiswa emva komhlangano wabemboni yamatekisi noDuma, kukhombisa ukuthi isazoqhubeka ibe iphela endlebeni imibhikisho yabamatekisi abakhala ngezimvume.Emhlanganweni wabamatekisi noDuma, kwaze kwaqokwa ithimba okwathiwa lizoxazulula izinkinga.Kuphinde kwaqokwa elinye ithimba futhi emva kombhikisho wakamumva.Sethemba ukuthi leli thimba lakamumva lizokwazi ukuqhamuka nesixazululo.Inkinga enkulu ukuthi abamatekisi basola uMnyango wezokuThutha ngokungazikhiphi izimvume zokusebenza, ngakolunye uhlangothi umnyango wona uthi abamatekisi abazilande izimvume.Ngokusho komnyango, zibalelwa ku-5 000 izimvume eziduvile emahhovisi, abamatekisi bona bathi batshelwa ukuthi azikho izimvume uma beyozifuna emahhovisi omnyango.Abamatekisi nabo babuye basolane bodwa. Abanye, ikakhulukazi labo abanamatekisi amancane bayaye basole labo abamatekisi amaningi ngokungalandeli imigudu efanele.Umnyango nabamatekisi abaxazulule izinkinga zabo, begweme isimo esizophinde siphazamise impilo yabantu nokusebenza komnotho.

IQEMBU lezepolitiki i-Democratic Alliance, lisola izinga lokuqeqeshwa amaphoyisa, kudalulwa izigidi ezilahleka kufakwa izimangalo ngabathile ababoshwa kungalandelwe imigudu. Ephendula imibuzo ePhalamende ngesonto eledlule, uNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa kuleli uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, uthe zingu- 46 000 izicelo zokunxeshezelwa kwabathile okukholakala baboshwa kungafanele phakathi kuka-2018 no-Okthoba 31, kulo nyaka. Kuvele ukuthi imali okumele ikhokhwe ngalezi zinxephezelo u-R56 billion kanti uMchunu uveze ukuthi ayiphumi eMnyangweni wamaPhoyisa kodwa ehhovisi likaMgcinimafa kuleli.UNksz Lisa Schickerling we-DA ekhuluma nabezindaba emsakazweni i-SAFM, uthe amaphoyisa kumele ahlinzekwe ngokuqeqeshwa okusezingeni elingcono ukuze akwazi ukubhekana nezimo zomsebenzi wawo ngendlela efanele ukugwema ukulahleka kwemali yabakhokhi bentela."Uma ubuka amacala uwahlaziya indlela awenzeke ngayo, uzobona ukuthi amanye akhombisa ukungaqeqesheki ngendlela kwamaphoyisa nokungalandelwa kwemigudu efanele uma ebopha. Amanye kungenxa yenkohlalo, ukungaziphathi ngendlela kwamaphoyisa nokusetshenziswa budedengu kwamandla,” usho kanje.Uthe yinqwaba yamaphoyisa asebenza ngendlela efanele nenza umsebenzi wawo ngokuthemebeka elandela imigudu efanele, bese kuba khona ingcosana engongoma uyayona. I-DA inxuse uMchunu ukuthi aqinise isandla kulawo maphoyisa aphuma eceleni ukuze kugwemeke izenzo ezifuze lezi.UNksz Schickerling uthe ikomiti elibhekelele ukusebenza kwamaphoyisa ephalamende lenza umsebenzi oncomekayo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kusetshenzwa ngendlela. Uthe ukuthathelwa izinyathelo kwamaphoyisa enza okuphambene kungalekelela kulesi simo, kodwa waveza ukuthi kumele kuqalwe phezulu kosigaxamabhande kwazise kwesinye isikhathi inkohlakalo iqala kulesi sigaba.Isibalo esikhulu sezimangalo ngokusebenza kwamaphoyisa kuthiwa sivela ezifundazweni iLimpopo, i-Eastern Cape, i-Gauteng neKwaZulu-Natal.Nakhu okunye okushicilelwe kwi-website yamaphoyisa umuntu oboshwayo onelungelo lakho;– Ukutshelwa ukuthi uboshelwani– Unelungelo lokuthula ungasho lutho mayelana necala ngesikhathi uboshwa– Akumele uphoqwe ukuvuma icala ngesikhathi uboshwa, ngoba lobo bufakazi bungasetshenziswe uma sekuqulwa icala.– Oboshiwe unelungelo lokuvela enkantolo ngesikhathi esithile esinqunyiwe emva kokuboshwa kwakhe, kodwa kungadluli emahoreni awu-48.

UMNUZ SANELE MKHIZENgokusho komthombo osondelene nababulewe, umhlaseli ufike emini wafuna ukuphuziswa utshwala kodwa banqaba ukumsahisa."Ubuyile ntambama wafike wadubula omunye wabo. Empeleni abanye ababulewe bebengekho kuxatshanwa emini. Kukhona odutshulwe ezibuyela emsebenzini kanti omunye udutshulwe ezilalele, engazi lutho. Ubuye wadubula nomakhelwane," kusho umthombo.UMNUZ SICELO MATHONSI Omunye umthombo uthe osinde kulesi sibhicongo ngobezikhulula endlini yangasese ngoba uthe uma ezwa kuqhuma izibhamu wavele wangabe esaphuma."Nguyena obesechazela umphakathi ukuthi ngubani obeqotha abantu ngenhlamvu," kuphetha omunye umthombo.Kwabadlule emhlabeni kubalwa uMnuz Sanele Mkhize, uMnuz Sicelo Mathonsi noDlibhiza Mathonsi kodwa obezibiza ngoXaba ezinkundleni zokuxhumana.Okhulumela amaphoyisa aseGauteng, uLieutenant Colonel Mavela Masondo, usiqinisekisile lesi sigameko."Amaphoyisa ayakuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abahlanu badutshulwe bashona kwathi abathathu balimala kabi eDenver Hostel ngobusuku bangoDisemba 7. Amaphoyisa avule icala lokubulala nelokuzama ukubulala. Okwamanje akukaboshwa muntu," kuphetha uMasondo.
UBUKEKA ebuye ngezinkani eduze kweSilo uMntwana omkhulu wasoNkweni, u-Africa Zulu. Ubuya nje, iyaqina eyetulo lokugudluzwa kukandunankulu kaZulu, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi.UMntwana u-Africa uke wathi ukunyamalala emehlweni abantu emva kokuxoshwa kwakhe esikhundleni sokukhulumela iSilo uMisuzulu kaZwelithini.Waxoshwa emva kokuqokwa kukaButhelezi njengondunankulu kaZulu, uButhelezi waqoka ukuzibambela ekukhulumeleni iNgonyama.Muva nje, uMntwana u-Africa ubonakala eseduze kweSilo, kuthiwa ubamba imihlangano emide neNdlulamithi yamakhosi.Ngakolunye uhlangothi uButhelezi ulengelwa yizembe ngoba kuthiwa kukhona abapheka itulo lokuthi axoshwe.Ngokuthola kweSolezwe Ngempelasonto, muva nje uMntwana u-Africa ubambe imihlangano emide neNdlulamithi yamakhosi.Ezinkundleni zokuxhumana kusabalale izithombe zeSilo noMntwana u-Africa, lapho bebezikhululekele khona.Umthombo utshele Isolezwe Ngempelasonto ukuthi maningi amathuba okuthi uMntwana u-Africa abuyele ehhovisini leSilo."Noma ngingazi ukuthi uzokwenzani khona kodwa yena uzobuya. Uhlezi ekusho ukuthi uyabuya. Kula masonto edlule usebe nemihlangano emibili neSilo. Imihlangano yakhona idonsa isikhathi eside, nokusho ukuthi kukhulu okusuke kuxoxwa."Empeleni nje, bayazwana kakhulu neSilo. Nangesikhathi exoshwa waqhubeka nokuxhumana neNgonyama. INgonyama iyakholelwa kakhulu kuyena. Sekukaningi ima naye uma kunezinkinga.”Ebuzwa ukuthi ngabe usebuyile yini ehhovisini leSilo, uMntwana u-Africa uthe kukhona into asayilindile ngaphambi kokuthi aphawule ngalolu daba.Ubethembise ukubuye ashayele intatheli uma esekutholile lokhu akulindile.Ngesikhathi exoshwa esikhundleni uMntwana u-Africa wenza izinsolo zokuthi uxoshelwe ukulwisana nalabo abazama ukulawula iSilo.UMntwana u-Africa kuzokube kungekhona okokuqala ekhuza ibuya ehhovisi leSilo.Wake waxoshwa njengomkhulumeli weSilo emva kokuxabana nowayengundunankulu kaZulu ngaleso sikhathi, inkosi Mangosuthu Buthelezi.Nokho kwathi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi wabuye wabuyiswa esikhundleni.Ukungaboni ngaso linye kukaMntwana u-Africa, noMntwana wakwaPhindangene kwaqhubeka noma uMntwana u-Africa esebuyiselwe esikhundleni.Kwaba nezikhawu lapho ababekhipha khona imibiko eshayisanayo ngezindaba ezithinta isihlalo.
USIHLALO we-IFP KwaZulu-Natal ophinde abe uNdunankulu wesifundazwe, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, akaboni kuyinto okufanele imqwashise ebusuku ukungahoshelani kukaMphathiswa wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, nabaholi be-ANC.UNtuli uthe ayikho inkinga etheni phakathi kukaButhelezi nabaholi be-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, wakhala ngokuthi le ndaba yenziwa ihaba ezinkundleni zokuxhumana.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba eThekwini izolo.UNtuli usho kanjena nje kunemibiko ethi abanye abaphathiswa baKwaZulu-Natal abasamuzwa kahle uButhelezi, kuthiwa abanye bayingxenye yetulo lokuthi akakhishwe kwesokuba uNdunankulu kaZulu.I-ANC KwaZulu-Natal yaphumela obala, yakhala ngokuthi uButhelezi usebenzisa budedengu isikhundla sakhe. Yathi kayeneme ngokungenela kwakhe komasipala abaphethwe yiyo.UNtuli uthe izinkulumo zabaholi be-ANC azisho ukuthi kunenkinga okufanele azikhathaze ngayo."Ezinye zalezi zinto siyaye sizibone zikhulunywa ezinkundleni zokuxhumana. Uyaye uthi uma usuzilandele, ubone ukuthi akukho nkinga etheni lana. Nalana ngesikhathi ziqala izinkulumo, ngakhuluma nabo bonke abathintekayo. Ngathola ukuthi incane inkinga ekhona.”UNtuli uthe kulindelekile ukuthi kube nokuphambana kwemibono kubaphathiswa abakwiKhabhinethi yakhe ngoba baqhamuka emaqenjini ahlukene."Amaqembu esiqhamuka kuwo anemigomo engafani. Ngisho kuphethe iqembu elilodwa, kuba khona ukwehlukana ngemibono. Lena into ejwayelekile.”UNtuli uthe ujabule ngabo bonke abaphathiswa abayingxenye kahulumeni wesifundazwe."Bonke abaphathiswa basebenza ngokuzimisela nangokuzikhandla. Ukubambisana nokusebenzisana kahle kubuyisa ithemba ebantwini baKwaZulu-Natal. Njenge-IFP siyaqhubeka nokubamba iqhaza elibalulekile kuhulumeni wesifundazwe, sibeka phambili ukuxazulula izinkinga ezikhungethe abantu.”UNtuli uthe sebeqalile ukulungiselela ukhetho lohulumeni basekhaya oluzokuba ngo-2026.I-IFP yabuya ngamandla okhethweni lohulumeni basekhaya lwango-2021, yanqoba komasipala abaningi baKwaZulu-Natal.Le nhlangano iyaqhubeka nokwenza kahle okhethweni lokuchibiyela oselube khona esifundazweni.UNtuli uthe bahlose ukuphinda benze kahle okhethweni oluzayo.Uthe akubathusi ukufika ngamandla kwe-MK, eyathola amavoti amaningi KwaZulu-Natal ngesikhathi kunokhetho lwangoMeyi."Ukufika kwe-MK akusikhathazi. Siyayihlonipha njengoba sihlonipha wonke amaqembu ezepolitiki abevele ekhona. Kodwa iqiniso lithi i-IFP iyaqhubeka nokwenza kahle okhethweni lokuchibiyela esesibe nalo KwaZulu-Natal emva kokhetho lwangoMeyi.”
IPHINI likamengameli we-ANC, nezwe uMnuz Paul Mashatile, lithe isinqumo seSACP sokungenela ukhetho ngokuzimela, akumele sihlakaze ubumbano lwamadlelandawonye.UMashatile uthe amadlelandawonye kumele ahlale ebumbene, noma kuthiwa kwenzakalani. Uthe bayasihlonipha lesi sinqumo beyi-ANC."Ngeke sime endleleni yeSACP yokuthi ingenele ukhetho ngokuzimela ngoba siyasihlonipha lesi sinyathelo. Noma kuthiwa kwenzakalani, akumele kodwa kube nokuhlakazeka kwamadlelandawonye ngenxa yalesi sinqumo,” kusho uMashatile.Ukusho lokhu izolo ekhuluma engqungqutheleni yeSACP eqhubeka eGoli. Uthe lolu daba bazoluxoxa ngonyaka ozayo, ne-SACP."Sizoba nomhlangano ngalolu daba emuva kwale ngqungquthela. Akekho kodwa kwi-ANC ovimba lesi sinqumo. Ngoba busuka kude ubudlelwano esinabo ne-SACP, sizoxoxa ukuthi sizoba namthelela muni lesi sinqumo sokuzimela kweSACP okhethweni,” kuqhuba uMashatile.NePhini likamengameli weCosatu uMnuz Mike Shingange, lithe abayesekanga iSACP okhethweni lwango-2021, ngenxa yokuthi sasingekho isinqumo sengqungquthela ngalolu daba.UShingange uthe njengoba sekunesinyathelo esinje, bazohlala phansi bewumfelandawonye babhunge ngaso nomthelela waso kumadlelandawonye."Noma kuthiwa kwenzakalani lesi sinqumo akumele sidale uqhekeko kumadlelandawonye. Amadlelandawonye kumele ahlale ebumbene ngaso sonke isikhathi.”UMashatile uchazele izithunywa kule ngqungquthela ebezicula ukuthi aziyifuni i-GNU (Government of National Unity) okuwuhulumeni ohlanganise amaqembu.Uthe bayingxenye kalohulumeni ngoba i-ANC yashayeka okhethweni yathola u-40%."Sasingalindele ukuthi sasingehla ngaleya ndlela size sifike ku-40% okhethweni. Sasithi uma sishaya izibalo sizibone sigijima ngaphezu kuka-57%, abanye babeze bathi sizoba ngaphezu kuka-60%. Sathuka uma sithola ukuthi sehle ngaleya ndlela,” kuqhuba uMashatile.Uthe yingakho bakhuluma nawo wonke amaqembu ukuze kwakhiwe uhulumeni."Ziningi izinto esazixoxa, ezinye ezithinta nokuthi sibe yiqembu eliphikisayo, okuyinto eyachithwa amanye amalungu e-ANC. Sanquma ukuthi sakhe lo hulumeni, angu-10 kuphela amaqembu avuma ukuthi sisebenzisane, amanye awayingenanga. Safika kanjalo ekutheni sibe nohulumeni wokubambisana,” kuqhuba uMashatile.UShingange uthe i-ANC akumele ibagxeke uma bengayifuni iGNU."Asiyifun iGNU ngoba kunamaqembu asizondayo kuwona. Asikwazi ukuthanda abantu abangasifuni. I-DA yamashela emahhovisi eCosatu isichitha, ikhala ngeCosatu. Sinenkinga ne-DA hhayi i-ANC kuhulumeni,” kuqhuba uShingange.Odabeni oluthinta umthetho wezikole okunemvunge ngawo iBela, uMashatile uthe umnikile uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, umbiko mayelana nezingxoxo ezibekhona njengoba kwajutshwa ithimba ukubhunga ngezikhalazo ezikhona ngalo mthetho."Sekulele kuRamaphosa ukuthi amemezele umkhombandlela njengoba umnqamulajuqu ngezigatshana ezimbili ezamiswa ukuze kubhungwe ngazo kulo mthetho, uphela namhlanje (izolo).”
KUHLATSHWE ikhwelo ebantwini bakuleli lokuthi babeke eqhulwini ezokuphepha njengoba kuqala amaholidi okuphela konyaka.Lokhu kuvezwe yibamba lokhulumela uhulumeni, uNksz Nomonde Mnukwa.UNksz Mnukwa uthe abantu kumele babeke eqhulwini ezokuphepha emigwaqweni nasezindaweni zomphakathi.Uthe abaphephe nasemicimbini ehlukene abazobe beyihambele."Ngalesi sikhathi abanye bajabula kuze kweqe. Abanye bahambela izindawo ezehlukene, abanye benze imicimbi yingakho uhulumeni ebacela ukuthi babhiyoze bazibheke.”Ukhumbuze abashayeli ukuthi abalandele imithetho yomgwaqo."Abashayeli kumele bangashayeli budedengu, bangaphuzi bashayele noma basebenzise izidakamizwa. Abangagijimi noma basebenzise omakhalekhukhwini emigwaqweni,” kusho uNksz Mnukwa.Unxuse abazali ukuthi baqikelele ngaso sonke isikhathi ukuthi izingane zabo ziphephile."Izingane kumele zibhekwe ngaso sonke isikhathi ukuthi zikuphi. Azivikelwe ezintweni ezehlukene.”Uthe uma kuhanjwa nezingane ezimotweni kumele zifake amabhande."Ezindaweni zomphakathi kumele ziqashwe ngelokhozi ukuze zingaduki, noma zehlelwe umshophi wokuthi zilimale.”Kuxwayiswe nangalabo abazothola intuba yokuqola abantu."Kukhona abazobona ithuba njengoba kungamaholidi bazame ukuqola abanganakile. Akubikwe izehlakalo zobugebengu kwabezomthetho.”Uveze ukuthi nabashayela budedengu kumele babikwe.Ufisele bonke abantu abazobe besebenzisa imigwaqo ukuphepha."Akube nokuthula, ukuthandana nokuzwana noma ikuphi lapho kuzobe kubhiyozwa khona. Asibambisane ekutheni kube nokuphepha nokuthi kuqale unyaka abantu babuye bephelele,” kusho uNksz Mnukwa. Kuzotshalwa amaphoyisa omgwaqo emigwaqweni ehlukene ezweni.Kuzokanisa namaphoyisa ezindaweni ezehlukene lapho kuzoseshwa khona abantu kanjalo nezimoto ngalesi sikhathi samaholidi.
NJENGOBA inyanga kaDisemba kuyinyanga yokuqwashisa ngegciwane lesandulela ngculaza i-HIV, kubikwa ukuthi izigameko zezifo ezithathelana ngocansi kubashayeli bamaloli ziphezulu. Ngokudlanga kwe-HIV kwabathengisa ngomzimba, abashayeli bamaloli basengcupheni yokuchayeka ngaleli gciwane, futhi imiphumela ayithinti bona kuphela, kodwa ithinta ophathina babo, imindeni kanye nomphakathi wonkana.Inhlangano engenzi nzuzo iLiwe Care Foundation izoba nomkhankaso wokuqwashisa abashayeli bamaloli ahamba amabanga amade ukuthi bengakushalazeli ukuyohlolela lesi sifo ozobe useMontrose Ultra City Truck Shop ngo-23 Disemba.Ngokusho kwesitatimende esibhalwe yile nhlangano sithe: "Abashayeli bamaloli ahamba amabanga amade bangabasebenzi ababalulekile emnothweni waseNingizimu Afrika. Babhekana nezingqinamba eziningi ezibenza ezibenza babe sengcupheni yezingozi zomgwaqo kanye nobungozi bezempilo njenge-HIV/AIDS."Lomkhankaso siwubhekise kakhulu kubo abashayeli bamaloli ukuze sigqugquzele ukuphepha kanye nezimpilo zabo, ukuze senze okuzozuzisa umphakathi,” sisho kanje.Obekuseqhulwini ngawo lomkhankaso ukuqwashisa ngokuphepha emgwaqeni kanye nokuvinjelwa kwe-HIV/AIDS kubashayeli bamaloli amabanga amade. Ukukhuthaza ukuhlolwa njalo kwezempilo, ukuziphatha okuphephile kokushayela kanye nezindlela zokuvimbela i-HIV kanye nokugxilisa usiko lokuzibophezela nokuphepha emkhakheni wezokuthutha.UMxumanisi womphakathi nabezindaba kuLiwe Care Foundation, uNksz Ayanda Mthembu, uthe kulomkhankaso bazobe bembambisene ne-Transport Education and Training Authority (TETA) ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abashayeli bayaqwashiswa ngaso lesi sifo, nalabo asebephila naso bethole ulwazi ngokuthi bazihlenga kanjani kuleso simo ukuze baqhubeke bephile kade.
UMHOLI we-EFF uMnuz Julius Malema uhlengezele izinyembezi echaza ngemizamo yabathile ngaphakathi kuleli qembu yokuqeda ngaye kanjalo nangeqembu. UMalema obethula inkulumo yokuvula ingqungquthela yaleli qembu eqhubeka eNasrec eGoli izolo, uthe leli qembu libhekene nengwadla yabantu abafuna ukuqeda ngalo.Uthe noma kunzima kodwa uzoqhubeka ayibambe ishisa ngenxa kagogo wakhe ongasekho, okunguyena oyisibani esimkhanyiselayo ebunzimeni, simgqugquzele noma esefuna ukushiya phansi izinto, simqinise idolo."Ngeke baphumelele labo abazama ukuqeda nge-EFF nangami. Kunemizamo yokuqeda ngaleli qembu ngabantu abangaphakathi. Ngeke ngililahle ithawula, ngizoma nje ngingawudayisi umzabalazo ngoba ugogo wami ongasekho, nguyena ongenza ngiqine idolo,” kusho uMalema.Ubonge nonkosikazi wakhe, athe sekuphele iminyaka engu-10, eme naye noma isimo sinzima.Uveze ukuthi ngoDisemba 27 bazobe begubha iminyaka eyishumi, babophe elikasofasilahlane. Ngesikhathi ekhuluma kanje, ubelokhu esula izinyembezi ngeduku njengoba izinyembezi beziziphumela. Kule ngqungquthela yesithathu yaleli qembu kulindeleke ukuthi kukhethwe ubuholi obusha.UMalema ukhale ngokuthi izingqungquthela zaleli qembu, zenzeka esikhathini esisuke sinzima."Engqungqutheleni yokuqala yango-2014, kwabulawa abavukuzi eMarikana, eNorth West. Nakule ngqungquthela ibanjwe emva kokhetho lwangoMeyi, lapho leli qembu lilahlekelwe ngukwesekwa okokuqala.” Leli qembu libhekene nengwadla yokushiywa ngabaholi abaphezulu, abajoyine iqembu uMkhonto weSizwe, eliholwa owayengumengameli wezwe uMnuz Jacob Zuma.Abaholi asebeshiye leli qembu baya kwi-MK, kubalwa uMnuz Floyd Shivambu, owayeyiphini likaMalema, ummeli u-Advocate Dali Mpofu nowayenguMvikeli woMphakathi u-Advocate Busisiwe Mkhwebane.Isikhundla esibhekwe kakhulu ngomuntu ozosivala esikaShivambu, sephini likamengameli.UDkt Mbuyiseni Ndlozi akabonakalanga nangokhalo kule ngqungquthela.Ngaphambi kwengqungquthela bekunemibiko yokuthi uNdlozi uvaliwe ukuthi athamele le ngqungquthela.UNdlozi kanjalo naleli qembu alikaze lithi vu ngendaba yalo mholi, okuvela ukuthi wayesondelene noShivambu.UNobhala jikelele we-EFF uMnuz Marshall Dlamini, ekhuluma nabezindaba kule ngqungquthela, uthe ngeke bakhulume ngomuntu oyedwa (Ndlozi), kule ngqungquthela ekubeni emaningi amalungu ayihambele.Uthe akubuzwe uNdlozi uqobo ngoba abakwazi ukukhuluma ngomuntu oyedwa nezizathu zakhe zokuthi angezi engqungqutheleni.Namhlanje kulindeleke ukuthi kuphakanyiswe abasembangweni wezikhundla eziphezulu kule ngqungquthela.
UMNDENI ufuna athathelwe izinyathelo owokufika onesitolo oSizweni, eNewcastle, kulandela ukuphenduka kolimu lomfana lube mnyama, eqeda kuphuza idrinki emnyama okwaziwa ukuthi ikhiqizwa yinkampani yase-USA ehlonishwayo emhlabeni. Kulesi sigameko esenzeke ngoLwesibili, kugule umgilwa, uThokozani Mokoena (17), waphuthuyiswa esibhedlela.Uninomncane, uNksz Buhle Mchunu uthe umgilwa uthenge idrinki esitolo sowokufika maqede wayiphuza, wase ethi ukudlala kancane.Uthe emva kwalokho uqaphele ukuthi ulimu lwakhe lushintsha umbala."Usibikele lokhu kodwa sazitshela ukuthi uyazidlalela ukuthi uphuze idrinki, besizitshela ukuthi uphuze i-sweet aid,” kusho uNksz Mchunu.Uthe kudlule isikhathi lwavele lwaba mnyama kakhulu kunakuqala ulimu, maqede umgilwa wazibhonqa, ejuqwa yisisu."Uthe esuka wabe ephalaza, ulimu selumnyama kakhulu,” kusho uNksz Mchunu.Uthe bamphuthumise esibhedlela lapho efike walaliswa khona.Uthe bakhathazekile ngesitolo esidayisele umgilwa idrinki emgulisile.Udalule ukuthi nakuba umnikazi wesitolo enazo ezinye izitolo ezindala eNewcastle kodwa lesi okuthenge kuso umgilwa sinezinyanga eziyisithupha kuphela sivuliwe.Uveze nokuthi ukhona omunye owesilisa osanda kukhala ngokuthi udayiselwe isinkwa esonakele.Emasontweni ambalwa edlule kwasuka umsindo kukhalwa ngokufa nangokugula kwezingane ezidle ezisuke zikuthenge ezitolo zabokufika.Uthe likhona icala abalivulile emaphoyiseni.Lezi zigameko bezibikwa ezindaweni ezehlukene ezweni lonke.UMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa uze wakhuluma nesizwe ngalokhu, ethi zonke izipaza aziqale phansi zibhaliswe kabusha komasipala.URamaphosa wathi lokhu kwenzelwa ukuthi kubhekwe ukuthi zikufanele yini ukudayisela abantu izimpahla.Amaphoyisa abengakayiphenduli imibuzo ayithunyelwe nomnikazi wesitolo akatholakalanga.
UMPHATHISWA woMnyango wezeziMali KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Francois Rodgers, useqale uphenyo ngezindleko ze-airtime ne-data okusetshenziswa yizikhulu zikahulumeni wesifundazwe okuthiwa zifinyelela ezigidini ngonyaka.Esitatimendeni esithunyelelwe abezindaba wumnyango wakhe, uRodgers uthe wu-R600 million imali ye-data ne-airtime okumele ikhokhwe wumnyango aphathiswe wona kulo nyaka, okuyisamba esishaqisayo.Uthe kungenzeka ukuthi lezi zindleko zifaka nezabantu abangasebona abasebenzi bakahulumeni."Uphenyo lwesikhashana luveza ukuthi kungenzeka ezinye izindleko zigcina sezikhokhwa kaningi esikweletini esifanayo. Kungenzeka futhi ukuthi kukhokhelwa abantu abangasasebenzi kuhulumeni, abanye abangasekho emhlabeni. Senginxuse ithimba ehhovisi likaMgcinimafa esifundazweni ukuthi liphenye ukuze kunqandwe lokhu kuchitheka kwemali yomphakathi, ngendlela engenasidingo,” usho kanje.Uthe lesi sifundazwe njengezinye kuleli, sibhekene nokuncishiselwa isabelomali sonyaka ngenxa yesimo somnotho ezweni ngakho ukuchitha izigidi zamarandi kwi-airtime ne-data akuyona indlela elungile yokwenza izinto.URodgers uthembise ukuthi emva kokuphothula lolu phenyo kuzokwaziswa umphakathi ngokutholakele.Lo mphathiswa usanda kuphumela obala eseka isinyathelo sikaNdunankulu wesifundazwe, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, sokwenqabela uMphathiswa woMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu, uMfundisi uThulasizwe Buthelezi, sokuthi kube khona amahhovisi omnyango wakhe oLundi, okuthiwa bekuzokwandisa izindleko.
UCHONYWE uphaphe lwegwalagwala ukhomishana wamaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, emcimbini obubanjelwe ePitoli, muva nje.Lo mcimbi ubuhanjelwe ukhomishana wamaphoyisa kuzwelonke uFanie Masemola, umongameli we-Institute for Risk Management eNingizimu Afrika, uMnuz Bheki Gutshwa nesikhulu esiphezulu uNksz Yvonne Mothibi.UMkhwanazi uhlonishwe ngendondo yeRisk Influencer of the Year ngomsebenzi wakhe wokuvikela abantu, isithunzi nenzuzo ngenkathi enciphisa ubungozi ekukhuthazeni ukuphepha nentshisekelo ngezwe.Isitatimende esikhishwe amaphoyisa sithe: "Le ndondo iwubufakazi bokuthi uLt Mkhwanazi usebenza kanzima ukugqugquzela usiko lokuqwashisa ngobungozi kanye nokuqina ngaphakathi kwesifundazwe saKwaZulu-Natal kanye naseNingizimu Afrika yonkana.”Sithe ngaphansi kobuholi bakhe, isifundazwe iKwaZulu-Natal siqhamuke namasu amaningi okulwa nobungozi, aqinisekisa ukuphepha nokukhululeka komphakathi.Ebonga ngokuhlabana ngayo le ndondo uMkhwanazi uthe: "Le ndondo ihlonipha ukuzinikela kwamaphoyisa ekulawuleni ubungozi kanye nokuzibophezela kwethu ekudaleni indawo ephephile nevikelekile kuwo wonke umuntu.” UMasemola, ubongele uMkhwanazi ngokuthola lendondo."Le mpumelelo iwukubonakalisa ubuholi obuvelele nekhono lokukhuthaza nokugqugquzela amalungu ukuthi abeke eqhulwini ukulawulwa kwezinhlekelele, aqinise umthetho futhi agxilise ukuzethemba emandleni okulwa nobugebengu,” kusho uMasemola.Uthe bayamubongela uLt Mkhwanazi ngokuhlonishwa futhi bamubheke ngamehlo abomvu ukuthi aqhubeke nobuholi bakhe kulesi sifundazwe saKwaZulu-Natal esibucayi.

Sinenkinga enkulu la eJozini yemigwaqo yasemakhaya ngakho ukuba nemishini yalolu hlobo kuzokwenza omkhulu umehluko kubantu,” kuchaza yena.
