Paper shredders are an essential tool for securing privacy and preventing identity theft. However, despite their widespread use in offices and homes alike, many misconceptions surround their functionality and efficiency. Below, we debunk some of the most common myths about paper shredders.Myth 1: All Paper Shredders Are the SameOne of the most common myths is that all paper shredders for sale offer the same level of performance and security. In reality, paper shredders come in various types, designed for different needs.There are strip-cut, cross-cut, and micro-cut shredders, each offering a different level of security. Strip-cut shredders produce long, thin strips of paper, while cross-cut shredders create smaller confetti-like pieces, offering a higher level of data protection.Micro-cut shredders take security to the next level by reducing documents into tiny particles, making it virtually impossible to reconstruct sensitive information.Different shredders also vary in speed, capacity, and features like auto-feed, so it’s important to choose a shredder that matches your specific needs.Myth 2: Paper Shredders Can Only Handle PaperAnother common myth is that paper shredders for sale are only designed for, well, paper. While their primary function is indeed to shred documents, many modern shredders can handle much more than that.Some shredders are built to handle CDs, DVDs, credit cards, staples, and paper clips. This feature is particularly useful in businesses and offices that often need to dispose of various forms of sensitive information stored on different media types.When purchasing a shredder, it's a good idea to check its capabilities beyond paper, especially if you require the disposal of non-paper materials.Myth 3: Paper Shredders Are Prone to JammingPeople often avoid using shredders because of the belief that they jam frequently. While older models or low-quality shredders might jam more easily, modern shredders are designed with anti- jamming technology.Many shredders now include sensors that detect when the machine is overloaded, automatically stopping the shredding process to prevent jams. Some also come with a reverse function, allowing users to clear any potential blockages.Regular maintenance, such as oiling the blades, can further minimize the risk of jams and keep the shredder running smoothly.Myth 4: Shredding Is Only for Large BusinessesThere’s a perception that shredding is primarily for large businesses that deal with massive amounts of confidential information. While businesses certainly benefit from shredding, individuals and small offices should also prioritize shredding sensitive documents.Personal documents such as bank statements, bills, and medical records contain valuable information that could be used in identity theft and to access bank accounts if not disposed of properly.A small, affordable shredder can be a simple solution for protecting your personal information at home.Myth 5: Shredding Isn’t Environmentally FriendlySome people assume that shredding creates unnecessary waste, but the truth is that shredded paper can be recycled. In fact, many recycling centres prefer shredded paper for its easier processing.Just make sure the shredded material is free from plastics, metals, or other non-paper items, and you’re doing your part for the environment.Final ThoughtsIn today’s technology age, paper shredders are diverse and useful tools that go beyond shredding paper. With advancements in technology, modern shredders are more efficient and user-friendly than ever, making them an essential asset for both businesses and individuals alike. By debunking these common myths, we hope to encourage more people to adopt secure and responsible document disposal practices.

Bathi ukuhoxiswa kwale khemikhali kumele kwenzeke zingakapheli izinyanga ezintathu.Umbiko wokuhlolwa kwezidumbu zezingane eziyisithupha zaseNaledi eSoweto, ezishone emva kokudla ezazikuthenge esitolo sabokufika ngo-Okthoba, uveze ukuthi kwatholakala le khemikhali kuzona.Ukukhula kwesibalo sabantu abashonayo nabagulayo emva kokuthenga okudliwayo ezitolo ezincane imvamisa okungezabokufika okugqame kakhulu izingane, kuphoqe uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ukuthi amemezele lezi zigameko njengenhlekelele. Abezitolo ezincane zokudla nabadayisa emgwaqweni banikezwe izinsuku ezingu-21 ukuthi babhalise ngokusemthethweni amabhizinisi abo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi alandela yonke imigudu yezenhlanzeko, kanti kusasa ngumnqamulajuqu walolu hlelo.
USUPHENDUKE insakavukela umkhuba wabantu abazifaka ngamabomu ezimotweni ukuze bathole izinxephezelo esikhwameni semali yabalinyazwe yizimoto, i-Road Accident Fund (RAF).Lokhu kuvezwe okhulumela lesi sikhwama, uMnuz McIntosh Polela, esitatimendeni asithumelele abezindaba nalapho khona ebebehluba udlubu okhasini mayela nalo mkhuba.UPolela ulimise ngesihloko elokuthi ngeke besanxeshezelwa labo bantu abakuhlelayo ukulinyazwa yizimoto benzela ukuthi bathole isinxephezelo semali kwi-RAF.Kuvela lezi zindaba nje, kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi ngaphambilini, kuke kwathiwa sikhula mawala minyaka yonke isibalo sabantu abathola isinxephezelo sokulinyazwa yizimoto emigwaqweni.Eqhuba, uveze ukuthi kukhona izicelo ezike zafakwa ngaphambilini kodwa zachithwa ngenxa yaso isizathu sokuthi ababandakanyekayo kwatholakala ukuthi bazifaka engozini ngenhloso."Kuvela ukuthi laba bantu abenza lo mkhuba ngenhloso baye balinde imoto ihambe kancane ngaphambi kokuba bazifake kuyona. Bayilinda ize ihambe kancane ukuze bezoba nesiqiniseko sokuthi bayalamila kuphela kodwa abagcini ngokushona,'' kusho uPolela.Eqhuba, ukhale kakhulu ngokuthi lona ngumkhuba ongemuhle nhlobo futhi ogcina ngokuletha ingcindezi yemali ngokungenasidingo kulesi sikhwama.Ukugcizelele ukuthi abakwa-RAF ngeke besayikhipha imali yomuntu ozifake engozini ngenhloso, kungakhathaleki noma ngabe ugcine elimala kabi kangakanani."Noma ngabe loyo muntu ugcine eshona, uma nje kutholakele ukuthi ubezifaka ngamabomu emotweni ayikho imali ezokhokhwa,'' usho kanjena.Uthe kumele kusetshenziswane ngaso sonke isikhathi ngenhloso yokuqinisekisa ukuthi kubekwa eqhulwini ukuphepha kwabantu emgwaqweni zikhathi zonke.Kuvela ukuthi izicelo ezilinganiselwa ku-49 631 zachithwa eminyakeni eyedlule ngenxa yezizathu ezifuze lezi.Eminyakeni eyedlule, eNingizimu Afrika kuhlaluka ukuthi bekufa abantu abalinganiselwa ku-7 987 emigwaqweni ngesikhathi samaholidi kaKhisimusi. Izingozi ezilinganiselwa ku-84% zibangelwe ngamaphutha abantu.Ungoti owelapha eziphathelene nomqondo, uDkt Manqoba Myeni osebenza esibhedlela esizimele esisenkabeni yeTheku, i-Durdoc, ukhombe indlala nokungabi bikho kwamathuba emisebenzi njengomnyombo ongagcina sewuholela ekutheni abantu bacabange ngezindlela ezingalungile zokuthola imali.Nakuba kunjalo, kodwa uthe lokhu abakwenzayo ngeke kwashiwo ukuthi bakwenza ngoba bephazamisekile emqondweni."Phela umuntu ophazamisekile emqondweni uma enza into usuke engayihlelanga futhi engabheke kuthola nzuzo kuyona. Kodwa laba bayakuhlela lokhu futhi benenhloso eyodwa okungukuhlomula ngemali ngokuhamba kwesikhathi,'' echaza.Omunye umshayeli weloli obekhuluma emsakazweni, uthe wake washayisa umuntu ebusuku okwathi nxa sekuphenywa kwatholakala ukuthi umuntu mumbe lowo ubezitshela ukuthi yimoto encane ezayo, waziphonsa ngenhloso yokuthola isinxephezelo kwi-RAF kanti uzoshona.
ANQUNYELWE ugwayi katiki amalungu eMK aphethe izikhundla eziningi.Amalungu eMK anezikhundla kuhulumeni, nasenhlanganweni ayalelwe ukuba akhethe isikhundla esisodwa.Encwadini ebhalwe ngumgqugquzeli weqembu osanda kuqokwa, uMnuz Joe Ndhlela, amalungu eMK akhunjuziwe ukuthi iqembu linomgomo othi abanezikhundla kuhulumeni, abavumelekile ukuphatha izikhundla eqenjini.Kule ncwadi ebonwe yiSolezwe, uNdhlela uyalele labo abaphethe izikhundla ezimbili ukuba badedele esisodwa."Njengoba sisembhidlangweni wokukhulisa nokwakha kabusha inhlangano, ngithanda ukunazisa ukuthi umthethosisekelo weqembu ukubeka kucace ukuthi akekho umuntu ovumeleke ukuphatha izikhundla ezimbili ngesikhathi esisodwa."Ngiyazi ukuthi kungenzeka ukuthi abanye benu bebengaqondile okubi ngesikhathi bethatha izikhundla ezimbili. Kodwa-ke kubalulekile ukuthi silandele imigomo yeqembu. Zonke izinhlaka zeqembu kufanele zilandele imigomo ebekiwe.”UNdhlela uthe ulindele ukuthi basule ngokuphazima kweso labo abancelisa amawele."Isigungu esiphezulu saphasisa lokhu okwashiwo umholi (uMnuz Jacob Zuma) kokuthi akekho umuntu ovumeleke ukuphatha izikhundla ezimbili. Lokhu kusho ukuthi lo myalelo usuwumgomo weqembu."Sinxusa bonke labo abaphethe izikhundla ezimbili noma ezingaphezulu kwalokho ukuba basule ngokuphazima kweso. Lokhu kuzosisiza ukuthi sikwazi ukuhlela kabusha izinhlaka zeqembu.”Baningi abaholi beMK abazithola bephethe izikhundla ezimbili ngemva kokhetho lwangoMeyi, abanye babo babuye basula, abanye badilizwa.Kubaholi abanezikhundla ezimbili kukhona iPhini likaMengameli, uDkt John Hlophe, ophinde abe umholi weqembu ePhalamende. Akucaci ukuthi ngabe naye uHlophe uzokwesula yini njengokomyalelo.Okhulumela inhlangano, uMnuz Nhlamulo Ndhlela, uphinde abe yilungu lePhalamende. UNdhlela (Nhlamulo) usanda kumemezela ukuthi uzokwesula ePhalemende, azogxila emsebenzini wokukhulumela iqembu.Abanye abaholi ababenezikhundla ezimbili ababuye basula noma badilizwa kubalwa owayengunobhala jikelele weqembu, uMnuz Sihle Ngubane, owasula emva kokuthi efungiswe njengelungu lePhalamende, kube amalungu esiShayamthetho KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thobani Zuma, noDkt Kwazi Mbanjwa, abasanda kudilizwa ekuholeni inhlangano esifundazweni.Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kukaNdhlela (Nhlamulo) ayizange iphumelele njengoba ucingo lwakhe belungangeni.
AYAQINA amahlebezi okuthi uNdunankulu kaZulu, uMfundisi Thulasizwe Buthelezi, uzodilizwa esikhundleni.Kuvela eyokuthi konomkhankaso oshisa phansi wokuketula uButhelezi, kuthiwa kunemihlangano ebanjawo lapho kuthungwa khona itulo lokukhipha uButhelezi esikhundleni.UButhelezi uvumile ukuthi uyazi ngetulo.Ngokuthola kweSolezwe sekube nemihlangano emithathu ebihanjelwe abasondelene nesihlalo sobuKhosi bukaZulu, lapho bekuthungwa khona itulo lokugudluza uButhelezi.Umthombo osondelene nodaba uthe umkhankaso wokugudluza uButhelezi waqala ngo-Agasti."Itulo lakhiwa emhlanganweni wokuqala owawungo-Agasti. Kwabuye kwaba sengathi kuyathuleka. Muva nje sekube neminye imihlangano emibili, owakamuva ubukuyona le nyanga, ukhona omunye owaba ngenyanga eyedlule.”UButhelezi waqokelwa kulesi sikhundla ngonyaka owedlule.Kulesi sikhathi esifishane uButhelezi enguNdunankulu kaZulu, usebe neziwombe ezishiye abantu bebambe ongezansi.Isiwombe abantu abangeke basikhohlwe esombango wombhobho esenzeka emcimbini wokukhumbula iSilo uDinuzulu kaCetshwayo.Kulo mcimbi owawuhanjelwe yiSilo, noMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, uButhelezi waphucwa umbhobho owayenguMphathiswa wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi ngaleso sikhathi, uMnuz Siboniso Duma futhi onguSihlalo we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal.UNDUNANKULU kaZulu olengelwa yizembe, uMfundisi Thulasizwe Buthelezi, neSilo uMisuzulu kaZwelithini Isithombe: SIGCINIWENgalena kwalokho, uButhelezi uke wajikijelana ngamazwi nabaholi be-ANC, okubalwa kubo uNobhala we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal uMnuz Bheki Mtolo, nowayengungqongqoshe wezoLimo ngaleso sikhathi, uNkk Thoko Didiza, kubangwa indaba yeNgonyama Trust.Umthombo uthe kunabaholi bezepolitiki abafuna ukuthi uButhelezi aqindwe amandla. UButhelezi ubuye abe uMphathiswa wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu."Ufike ngesivinini emnyangweni wakhe, wamemezela izinhlelo ezimakhela ugazi ikakhulukazi ebuholini bomdabu. Kodwa ngale kwalezo zinhlelo futhi kukhona izinqumo azithathile ezingehlanga kahle kubaholi bamanye amaqembu.”Muva nje, uButhelezi usanda kuzama ukuthuthela amahhovisi omnyango wakhe oLundi, ayosebenzela esiShayamthetho esidala.Umcimbi wokuvulwa kwamahhovisi ayezosebenzela kuwo wahlehliswa ngemizuzu yokugcina, wawuzobusiswa yiNgonyama uMisuzulu kaZwelithini.Ethintwa yiSolezwe, uButhelezi uthe uyazi ngetulo lokumketula kodwa wathi uyaqhubeka nokuthembeka eSilweni.Okhulumela iSilo, uMntwana uSimphiwe Zulu waKwaMinyamanzi, uthe abazi lutho ngetulo lokuketula uButhelezi. Uthe ngokwazi kwakhe akukho ukungahoshelani phakathi kweSilo, noButhelezi."NgeSonto eledlule besisemhlanganweni eThekwini, kukhona iSilo naye uButhelezi. NangoLwesibili uButhelezi ubekhona lapha (ngesikhathi umholi wamaNazaretha uNyazilwezulu, ezobusisa isigodlo seSilo) noma esheshe wahamba. ISilo sibikile ukuthi uzosheshe ahambe ngoba kukhona lapho esimthume khona, kwasala (iPhini likaNdunankulu kaZulu, Inkosi Phathisizwe) Chiliza.”
INYUNYANA yezisebenzi zomasipala, i-Independent Municipal & Allied Trade Union (Imatu), ithi inethemba elikhulu lokuthi izolinqoba icala labasebenzi balo abangu-34 abebebhikisha benqunu ngeledlule.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi ngoLwesine olwedlule abasebenzi abayingxenye yale nyunyana bebebhushuzela ngaseDurban City Hall, bekhala ngokuxoshwa wuMasipala weTheku.Laba babesola lo mkhandlu neMeya uCyril Xaba ngokubashaya ngemfe iphindiwe.Babekhala ngokuthi bamiswa emsebenzini ngoJulayi kuthiwa ayikho imali yokubaholela, bethenjiswa ukuthi ukumiswa kwabo yinto nje yesikhashana.Ngesikhathi bebhikisha kwaze kwafinyelela lapho amaphoyisa agcina esebabopha khona. NgoLwesithathu bavele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini.UMnuz Joe Mabaso, we-Imatu, uthe bayethemba ukuthi ekugcineni bazophuma phambili ecaleni."Le mpi sizoyinqoba, ngeke siphele amandla. Asididekile, simile ekutheni simsulwa, sizoqhubeka siwalwele amalungelo ethu. Ebantwini abasha abaqashiwe kukhona nabanye okuthiwa abekho esimeni esikahle sokuthi bangasebenza kodwa baqashiwe,'' usho kanje.Uthe bazolwa ngakho konke okusemandleni kuze kube abasebenzi bayabuyiselwa emsebenzini.Uthe kuyabaxaka ukuthi bonke abasebenzi babekwe icala lokuthi babengagqokile ekubeni kukhona ababegqokile. "Uyabona-ke ukuthi bamane bayafunisela nje, abazi ukuthi benzani,'' usho kanje.Unxuse ukuthi kube khona ubumbano nokusebenzisana kukhona konke abakwenzayo ukuze bezonqoba kalula.IMantshi u-Ashwin Singh iveze ukuthi kunophenyo olusaqhubeka mayelana naleli cala yase ilihlehlisela uFebhuwari 12."Kukahle kakhulu futhi uma lihlehliselwa unyaka ozayo ngoba angifuni ukuthi uma sibuya lapha kube kukhulunywa ukuthi kukhona ulwazi olungekho mayelana necala,'' kusho uMabaso.Kulaba ababoshiwe, abesifazane bakhale ngokuthi amaphoyisa esilisa ayebaphathapha okuyinto abathi ayibajabulisanga.
SIFUNA abolele ejele umzukulu waso isaguga saseDodoza, eFolweni, osolwa ngecala lokubulala ngesihluku unina, esigamekweni okuthiwa senzeke ngeledlule, lapho kugwazwe kwabulawa uNksz Muhle Ndlovu (52).Amaphoyisa abe esebopha indodakazi yakhe (18) ephasele u-matric, uyise wengane yayo okuvela ukuthi uyinyanga nomunye wesilisa. Kuvela ukuthi kusekhona omunye wesilisa osagcwele amathafa.Kuthiwa ingane kamufi ibigaqele imali ye-policy kanina, yahlangana nesoka layo, wabulawa.Isolezwe likhulume nesaguga, esingunina kamufi futhi esingugogo kamsolwa, uNksz Dolly Ndlovu, sithe, sisekude ukulikhohlwa igoda esiligilwe umzukulu waso ebesimthemba kakhulu."Athe ezomthatha amaphoyisa ngoLwesihlanu, eqeda kubuya ukothenga ukudla komngcwabo kanina, asizange sikholwe. Lo mntwana ubengumuntu wokugcina ebesingamsola ngokubulala unina,” kusho uNksz Ndlovu.Uthe umsolwa ubeyingane ehloniphayo, emthanda unina, enza wonke umsebenzi wasekhaya futhi ehlakaniphile nasesikoleni."Bengingakulindele ukuthi kungathiwa wuye ongabulala ingane yami kuwukuphela kwayo,” kukhala uNksz Ndlovu.Elandisa ngesigameko, uthe umufi obesebenza eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseManzimtoti, uhlaselwe eqeda kubuya emsebenzini."Uthe efika wayengena ekameleni lakhe njengenjwayelo. Ngimbhucabhuce izinyawo njengenjwayelo, waze walala. Ngimshiye lapho ngaya egunjini lokuphumula ngayobuka ithelevishini,” usho kanje.Uthe uvele wabona ngowesilisa angamazi, esemi phambi kwakhe, ephethe ummese noplastiki omnyama, efuna ukumboza ubuso."Ungixwayise ngokuthi uma ngike ngabanga umsindo, uzongigwaza,” kusho uNksz Ndlovu.Uthe ubesathuswa yilona wesilisa ngesikhathi ezwa umuntu ekhala ekhishini, maqede lona wesilisa (waphuma wabaleka)."Ngisukume ngaya ekhishini, ngafica indodakazi yami isilele phezu kwegazi. Igwazwe entanyeni. Ngamemeza ngifuna usizo. Kusona leso sidididi, umsolwa obesuka khona ekhishini, uhambe wayobiza omakhelwane,” kusho yena.Uqhube wathi bafikile omakhelwane, umufi waphuthunyiswa esibhedlela esizimele eSiphingo, esimdlulisele kwesiseThekwini iCity, nokuyilapho eshonele khona ngezintatha.Uthe ummese wasekhaya okubulawe ngawo umufi bawuthole phezu kwefriji unegazi, uhlephuke isiphatho, wathi ngesikhathi amaphoyisa eqhubeka nophenyo abelokhu ekuveza kancane ukuthi umkhuba usekhaya, esabisa nangokuthi azobabopha bonke.Uveze ukuthi umzukulu ubengakhombisi ukuthi uyasoleka, ephansi phezulu, enza amalungiselelo okufihlwa kukanina. Uthe ngisho nangosuku lwesigameko, uye owavolontiya kuqala ukuthi uzohamba ne-ambulensi, eyayimyisa esibhedlela, wathi nokuthi ngabo-10 ebusuku ngosuku lwesigameko, isoka lakhe lafika ekhaya, libakaza.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa aseFolweni abophe abasolwa abathathu abaneminyaka ephakathi kuka-18 no-36 ngecala lokubamba inkunzi njengoba kwebiwa amaselula nelokubulala. "Bavele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseNsimbini, ngoMsombuluko, icala labo lahlehliselwa uDisemba 19," kusho uNetshiunda.Uthe kusekhona umsolwa oyedwa osagcwele amathafa.
I-MK isophe ukuhlanganisa amaqembu aphikisa uhulumeni wokubambisana emcimbini wayo wokugubha unyaka yasungulwa.Le nhlangano eholwa owayengumengameli, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, imeme onke amaqembu aphikisa uhulumeni wokubambisana (GNU) ukuba abe ingxenye yomcimbi wayo ozokuba ngeSonto, enkundleni yezemidlalo iMoses Mabhida.Lokhu kushiwo uNobhala Jikelele we-MK, uMnuz Floyd Shivambu, ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba.Akucaci noma onke amaqembu aphikisa uhulumeni wokubambisana azowuhambela yini lo mcimbi.Muva nje, ubudlelwano be-MK ne-EFF abubuhle kulandela ukuhlubuka kwabaholi abaqavile eqennjini eliholwa uMnuz Julius Malema, baya kwi-MK.UShivambu akazange aphumele obala uma ebuzwa ukuthi abe-EFF bazofika yini, kepha uthe onke amaqembu aphikisa uhulumeni wokubambisana amenyiwe."Abaholi bamaqembu aphikisa uhulumeni wokubambisana sizobanika ithuba lokuthi kube khona abakushoyo emcimbi wethu. Laba abantu esisebenzisana nabo, babalulekile kakhulu kuthina.”UShivambu uthe ubuholi be-ATM kuphela asebeqinisekisile ukuthi buzowuhambela umcimbi, wathi basalinde amanye amaqembu ukuthi aqinisekise."Asigqugquzeli abaholi bamaqembu kuphela ukuthi beze emcimbini, sifuna nokuthi amalungu ezinhlangano eziphikisa uhulumeni wokubambisana nawo eze emcimbini.”UShivambu uthe kubalulekile ukuthi amaqembu aphikisa uhulumeni wokubambisa abe yimbumba, wathi bafisa ukuthi la maqembu avote ngokubambisana ezinkethweni ezizayo."Uma ulalela kahle uZuma lapho ekhuluma khona, uhlezi egcizelela eyokuthi ufisa ukuthi thina esicindezelekile sivotele iqembu elilodwa. Siphezu kombhidlango wokuhlanganisa amaqembu aphikisa uhulumeni wokubambisana. Lokhu kuzogqama kakhulu okhethweni lohulumeni basekhaya oluzokuba ngo-2026.”UShivambu uthe abasoze bewemukele uhulumeni wokubambisana ophethe, wathi bayaqhubeka necala lapho bephosela khona inselelo imiphumela yokhetho.UShivambu uthe sebethole ubufakazi obusha athe bazobethula enkantolo ngonyaka ozayo.USihlalo we-MK, uMnuz Nathi Nhleko, uthe ubufakazi obusha ababutholile buveza ngokusobala ukuthi kwantshontshwa amavoti abo ngesikhathi kunokhetho lwangoMeyi.Uthe amavoti e-MK anikezwa amanye amaqembu."Kuneqembu nje okwaziwayo ukuthi lesekwa amakhalathi, i-PA. Leli qembu lathola amavoti ezindaweni lapho okungekho khona amakhaladi. Lathola amavoti ngisho eMsinga.”
UKHONGOLOSE KwaZulu-Natal uthi ibambe ngakho ngokuhamba komholi wayo obhekene nenkohlakalo, uMnuz Ndodephethe Mthethwa, osejoyine iqembu eliholwa owayengumengameli, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, i-MK.UNobhala we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Bheki Mtolo, uthe uMthethwa ushiye kwi-ANC elandelwa yifu elimnyama.UMthethwa uke wabamba izikhundla ezibalulekile kwi-ANC.Engqungqutheleni edlule yokukhetha ubuholi be-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, wakhethelwa esigungwini esiphezulu esifundazweni futhi ubeyilungu lesiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal ngaphambi kokhetho lwangoMeyi.UMthethwa uke waba usihlalo we-ANC esifundeni iNokuhamba Nyawo, futhi uke waba yimeya kuMasipala waseJozini. Ngasekuqaleni konyaka uMthethwa waboshelwa amacala enkohlakalo nokukhwabaniswa kuka-R5 million okuthiwa kwenzeka kuMasipala waseJozini ngesikhathi esayimeya khona.Leli cala lashabalalisa amathuba akhe okubuyela esiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal emva kokhetho, njengoba i-ANC inomthetho othi onke amalungu ayo abhekene namacala kufanele ashenxe ezikhundleni.UMtolo uthe uMthethwa ubengavumelekile ukuzihlanganisa neqembu njengoba ebhekene namacala."Samyalela ukuba ashenxe esikhundleni ngenxa yakho njalo ukuthi asiguquki empini yethu yokulwa nenkohlakalo. Ubengavumelekile ukuba ingxenye yemihlangano nanoma imiphi imicimbi ethinta iqembu ngenxa yokuthi bekufanele ageze igama lakhe kuqala. "Isenzo sethu sikhombisa ukuthi sikuphokophele kangakanani ukuthathela izinyathelo onke amalungu enhlangano asolwa enkohlakalweni. Sisembhidlangweni wokubuyisa isithunzi se-ANC, senze nokuthi abantu babuyelwe ukusethemba.”UMtolo uthe bamfisela inhlanhla uMthethwa, wathi bazoqhubeka nokuthathela izinyathelo labo abasolwa enkohlakalweni."Sizimisele ukwakha kabusha inhlangano. Sinxusa onke amalungu enhlangano ukuba abambisane nathi embhidlangweni esiwuqalile wokufuna abaholi abathembekile nabangazibandakanyi ezenzweni zenkohlakalo.”Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kukaMthethwa ayizange iphumelele njengoba ucingo lwakhe belungangeni.Abaholi abaqavile be-ANC bayaqhubeka nokufudukela kwi-MK.Muva nje, owayengundunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Willies Mchunu, ujoyine i-MK.
UMHOLI wamaNazaretha eBuhleni, uMduduzi "Nyazilwezulu” Shembe, ubusise isigodlo seSilo uMisuzulu kaZwelithini esisha.UNyazi luhambise umkhuleko esigodlweni eMashobeni, KwaNongoma, ngoLwesibili ntambama.ISILO uMisuzulu kaZwelithini nomholi wamaNazaretha eBuhleni, uMduduzi 'Unyazilwezulu’ Shembe esigodlweni eMashobeni, KwaNongoma Isithombe: FACEBOOKIsigodlo esisha sizosingatha uMkhosi woSelwa ngoJanuwari, kuzokube kungokokuqala kwenziwa lo mkhosi kusukela kwakhothama iSilo uGoodwill Zwelithini kaBhekuzulu.Okhulumela iSilo, uMntwana uSimphiwe Zulu waKwaMinyamanzi, uthe umkhuleko woNyazi uyingxenye yamalungiselelo oMkhosi woSelwa."Into ebiyaye yenzeke phambilini ukuthi uNyazi belufike luhambise umkhuleko esigodlweni eNyokeni ngoNovemba, bese kulandela uMkhosi woSelwa ngoDisemba noma ngoJanuwari. UNyazi lawuhambisa umkhuleko eNyokeni ngoNovemba, kodwa luthe aliwuhambise naseMashobeni, lapho kuzokuba khona uMkhosi woSelwa. Luthe ngoba sesikhona isibaya esigodlweni eMashobeni, aluye kosibusisa.” Ukwakhiwa kwesigodlo esisha kuqale kuwo lo nyaka. When operating a funeral home, the reliability and functionality of mortuary fridges play a vital role in preserving the dignity of those who have passed and providing a professional service for grieving families.These specialized cooling units maintain optimal preservation conditions, so it’s essential to select the right equipment for your needs. Here are the top five considerations to keep in mind when purchasing mortuary fridges for your funeral home.1. Capacity and Size RequirementsThe first thing to consider when considering mortuary fridges is its capacity and size. Funeral homes vary in the volume of cases they handle, so it is important to select a unit that can accommodate your needs.Consider whether a single-door fridge will suffice or if you require a larger multi-door unit to store several bodies. Also, check the dimensions of the fridge to ensure it will fit within your facility’s designated space. Oversized units may offer more storage but could be challenging to position or access within your premises.2. Temperature Control and Cooling PerformanceThe main function of mortuary fridges is to provide consistent and reliable cooling to preserve bodies for an extended period. Look for units that offer precise temperature control, typically between 2°C and 4°C to prevent rapid decomposition. Investing in a fridge with a built-in temperature monitoring system can also provide peace of mind, alerting staff to any temperature fluctuations that may require attention. Reliable cooling performance is critical in maintaining the integrity and dignity of the deceased.3. Energy Efficiency and Operational CostsMortuary fridges operate 24/7, so energy efficiency is a significant factor to consider for funeral homes that want to keep operational costs under control. Look for energy-efficient models with eco- friendly refrigerants and optimal insulation. Units with energy-saving features, such as auto-defrost functions and power-saving modes, can help reduce electricity bills while minimizing environmental impact. Make sure to compare energy ratings to find a model that balances performance and affordability.4. Build Quality and DurabilityMortuary fridges are a long-term investment, and selecting a model made of durable materials is essential to ensure longevity. Stainless steel interiors and exteriors are popular due to their resistance to corrosion, ease of cleaning, and ability to maintain hygiene standards.Also check for strong doors and reliable sealing mechanisms to prevent air leakage and maintain consistent internal temperatures. Durability reduces the likelihood of frequent maintenance and replacement costs over time.5. Compliance and Safety StandardsLastly, it is critical to ensure that any mortuary fridge you purchase complies with industry regulations and safety standards. Be sure to check with local health and safety authorities to ensure the fridge you select meets all necessary standards.Some models may include added safety features, such as anti-microbial coatings and internal lighting systems, which can increase operational safety and hygiene.Final ThoughtsBy weighing these factors, you can invest in a unit that provides for the preservation and care of the deceased, maintains operational efficiency, and upholds the high standards expected by grieving families.Balancing functionality with reliability and efficiency will help you provide the best possible service and care for those who entrust you with their loved ones.

Emuva kokukhishwa kwesigwebo, eseqhutshwa ebheke ezitokisini, uLethiwe unyonkoloze kabi uSibiya obehlezi ngemuva kwakhe enkantolo. UKHALE ngotshwala usohlalakahle egwetshwa odilikajele abayisithupha ngecala lokubulala amalungu omndeni wakhe awu-6.Esehlakalweni esenzeka ngoFebhuwari 2021, eNkanini, eShowe, uMnuz Sthembile Nkosinathi Mthimkhulu (39) wavulela ngenhlamvu wabulala uNkk Octavia Khumalo (65), Mnuz Christopher Khumalo (77), Nksz Mbali Khumalo (37), Thabo Khumalo (10), Nothile Sphelele Khumalo (17) no-Elihle Sigampu (8).Izolo iJaji uKate Pillay limgwebe odilikajele abangu-6 uMthimkhulu lakhala ngonya alukhombisa ngosuku lwesehlo njengoba kuthiwa bonke ababulala wayebadubula ekhanda.Ngaphambi kokuba likhiphe isigwebo, ummeli kaMthimkhulu, u-Advocate Siseko Madikizela utshele inkantolo ukuthi uMthimkhulu uthi akwenza kungenxa yokuthi wayephuze kakhulu utshwala ngelanga lesehlo.Ijaji likuchithile lokho libuza ukuthi kungani lokho uMthimkhulu ezokuveza manje ekubeni wahluleka ukukuveza kusona sonke lesi sikhathi icala liqhubeka enkantolo.Ijaji lithe azikho izizathu eziphathekayo ezingaholela ekutheni lehlise isigwebo elingasinikeza uMthimkhulu. "Isigwebo sikadilikajele yisona esimfanele umuntu onesihluku njengawe,'' lisho kanje.Liqhubeka ijaji lithe akulungile ukuthi uMthimkhulu acashe ngotshwala ekubeni engusonhlakakahle. "Umsebenzi owenzayo ubungakwenza ucabange kangcono kakhulu kunalokho owakwenza. Umsebenzi wakho uwodwa nje wawungadala ukuthi ungabulali muntu,'' lisho kanjena.Kuleli cala inkantolo isebenzise kakhulu ubufakazi bengane (9) eyasinda njengoba yacasha ngemuva kwekhethini.Ingane yachazela inkantolo konke eyakubona ngosuku lwesehlo nenkantolo yagculiseka ukuthi ubufakazi bayo ingabusebenzisa ukumlahla ngecala ummangalelwa.Ingane yatshela inkantolo ukuthi yambona uMthimkhulu ngoba wayengazifihlile ebusweni.Yaveza nokuthi yamuzwa uMthimkhulu ebuza abomndeni ngaphambi kokuthi ababulale ukuthi bamthakathelani futhi bambulalelani uyise?UMshushisi uMbongeni Chamane ngaphambi kokuba kuphume isigwebo ubekade enze izethulo zakhe zokugcina enxenxa inkantolo ukuba imgixabeze ngesigwebo sikadilikajele uMthimkhulu.Ukhale ngobuhlungu athe budalwe uMthimkhulu enganeni eyabona konke ngosuku lwesehlo."Indlela umntwana ahlukumezeka ngayo ngosuku lwesehlo yinto ongeke uyifisele omunye umuntu. Isigwebo sikadilikajele yisona esimfanele umuntu onesibindi sokwenza into enjena,'' kuchaza yena.UMthimkhulu kuvela ukuthi wabulala abagilwa ngoba ebasola ngokuthi bayathakatha futhi yibona ababa nesandla ekubulaweni kukayise, uMnuz Bheki Mthimkhulu owabulawa ngo-2019.Kuvela ukuthi uMthimkhulu (Bheki) wahlangana nabantu ephuma e-tavern abamshaya bambulala, ngakusasa isidumbu sakhe satholakala eceleni komuzi wakwaKhumalo.Kusolakala ukuthi ukutholakala kwesidumbu sikaMthimkhulu eduze komuzi wakwaKhumalo yikhona okwenza ummangalelwa wacabanga ukuthi banesandla ekufeni kwakhe.Kuvela ukuthi ummangalelwa phambilini wake wakuveza emndenini wakhe ukuthi uyabasola ngokufa kukayise kodwa loyo mlilo wabuye wabhulwa ngemuva kwezingxoxo ezaba khona ngaphakathi emndenini.Enkantolo bekukhona amadoda amabili abehlezi ekhoneni uMthimkhulu abonakele ewabingelela. Ngemuva kokugwetshwa izintatheli zizamile ukukhuluma nalawo madoda abebonakala ecwebe izinyembezi anqaba."Akukho esizokusho asithandi ukukhuluma. Thina singabafowabo bakaSthe,'' basho kanje bebonakala nasebusweni ukuthi bakhungathekile.Ngesikhathi kuqhubeka icala enkantolo uMthimkhulu obefake izingubo ezimnyama ubebheke phansi engafuni ukuvusa ikhanda.
SINCONYWE njengesenzo sokuqhakambisa iqhaza labesifazane kwezobuholi esokujutshwa ihlandla lesibili komphathi we-Unisa, uSolwazi Puleng LenkaBula.Inyuvesi imemezele ukuthi ivuselela inkontileka yomholi owaqopha umlando ngokuba owesifazane wokuqala, ukubamba isikhundla sokuphatha le nyuvesi.USihlalo wekomiti leMfundo ePhakeme ePhalamende uMnuz Tebogo Letsie, uncome lesi senzo wathi uSolwazi LenkaBula, usebenze kanzima ngehlandla lokuqala lokuhola inyuvesi enomlando ojulile kuleli nase-Afrika.Uthe bayakwamukela ukuphinde ajutshelwe kulesi sikhundla."Usebenze ngokuzikhandla kanti wenze kwaba nozinzo kule nyuvesi. Waqopha umlando ngokuba owesifazane wokuqala ukubamba izintambo zokuba umphathi e-Unisa.” Uthe ihlandla lakhe lesibili liqala ngoJanuwari, wonyaka ozayo."Usebenze ngokuzikhandla emkhakheni ogcwele abesilisa. Sinxusa zonke izinhlaka enyuvesi ukuthi zimeseke njengoba esemkhankasweni wokwenza le nyuvesi ihambe phambili emhlabeni,” kusho uLetsie.Isitatimende senyuvesi siveze ukuthi emuva komhlangano womkhandlu obungoDisemba 9, kunqunywe ukuthi abuyiselwe ihlandla lesibili kulesi sikhundla.Sithe uzohlala iminyaka emihlanu kulesi sikhundla."Umkhandlu wenyuvesi wanelisekile ngendlela uhlelo lokubheka ukusebenza kwakhe oluhambe ngayo. Kulandelwe yonke imigomo ebekiwe kanti nomthetho wemfundo ephakeme uyakuvuma ukuthi umphathi wenyuvesi angajutshwa elinye ihlandla lesibili,” kusho isitatimende senyuvesi.Sithe ngaphansi kobuholi bakhe kube nezinto eziningi ezinhle ezenzekile."Kube nezinto ezinhle kwezithinta ukufunda nokufundisa, ucwaningo, ukukleliswa kwenyuvesi kanjalo kwaba nemali engenayo enyuvesi. Abasebenzi bebezinikele ngaphansi kwakhe.” USolwazi LenkaBula, ucashunwe esamukela isinqumo somkhandlu wathi uzimisele ukubeka phambili inyuvesi. Uthe uzoqhubeka nokwakha amathuba kwizitshudeni kanjalo nakubasebenzi."Ngizimisele ukuqhubeka ngisebenzisane nezinhlaka ezehlukene enyuvesi. Makhulu amaphupho enginawo ngale nyuvesi.” Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi ngesikhathi kusaphethe uDkt Blade Nzimande njengoNgqongqoshe weMfundo ePhakeme, le nyuvesi yafakwa ngaphansi komlawuli ozimele ngenxa yezinkinga ezazikhona. USolwazi LenkaBula waya nasenkantolo ezama ukuvimba uNzimande ukuthi ajube umlawuli ozimele.Inkantolo yasePitoli yayalela uNzimande ukuthi achithe ukufakwa kwenyuvesi ngaphansi komlawuli.
KUZOLIBAMBEZELA icala lokubulawa kowayengunozinti we-Orlando Pirates neBafana Bafana uSenzo Meyiwa, ukushona kommeli u-Advocate Thulani Mngomezulu.Lokhu kushiwo yisazi sezomthetho u-Advocate Mpumelelo Zikalala, engxoxweni neSolezwe.UMngomezulu ongowokuzalwa eNkampani, ePiet Retief, eMpumalanga kuthiwa ushonele esibhedlela entathakusa, emva kokuphuthunyiswa esibhedlela ngoMsombuluko.Bese kunesikhathi uMngomezulu engekho enkantolo ngenxa yokugula.Ngesikhathi kuqala ukugula kwakhe, wayelokhu ecela ukuthi kuhlehliswe ukuqulwa kwecala ngenxa yokungazizwa kahle. Ijaji uRatha Mokgoatlheng ubeye akhombise ukunengwa yilokho.UMngomezulu ugcine ecela ozakwabo ukuba bamumele, exinwa ukugula, engasakwazi ukuya enkantolo.Ubeye akhale ngekhanda nangokugodola.UZikalala uthe akubuzwa ukuthi ukushona kukaMngomezulu kuzoba nomthelela omubi ecaleni."Kufanele ummangalelwa wokuqala (uMuzikawukhulelwa Sibiya) athole ummeli omusha, ozongena endaweni kaMngomezulu. Lowo mmeli, nakanjani uzofuna ukunikwa isikhathi,” kusho uZikalala.Uthe isikhathi azosicela ummeli omusha esokuthi afunde osekwenziwe enkantolo nesokuxoxa nommangalelwa."Maningi amathuba okuthi athi esekufundile osekwenziwe enkantolo bese ecela ukuthi kuphinde kubizwe ofakazi abathize, ukuze abahlome ngemibuzo uma kukhona lapho engagculisekile khona,” kusho uZikalala.Uqhube wathi uma ofakazi sebephonswa imibuzo, kungenzeka basho izinto ezizodala ukuthi abanye abameli abebevele bekhona nabo bafune ukuphinde baphonse imibuzo ngokusha okuzobe sekuvela kofakazi.Okungacishe kube ngcono ukuthi kubuye u-Adv Sipho Ramosepele, kodwa nakhona, naye usengasho ukuthi ucela ukunikwa isikhathi sokuthi abuyekeze ubufakazi obuthile obuqondene nommangalelwa obemelwe uMngomezulu."Angabeka iphuzu lokuthi ngesikhathi kukhona uMngomezulu, ubenake lokho obekuthinta ikhasimende lakhe, hhayi elikaMngomezulu, ngakho udinga isikhathi ukubuyekeza okuthinta lona uma sekufanele ukuthi kube wuye olimelayo,” kusho uZikalala.Uthe lokhu yinto engeke ibalekeleke njengoba uSibiya kufanele abe naye ummeli ozomumela futhi kufanele ummeli wakhe omusha anikwe ithuba lokubuyekeza ubufakazi ukuze ummangalelwa angasho ukuthi abenzekanga ubulungiswa ekuqulweni kwecala.Okhulumela imindeni yabamangalelwa, uNksz Sinqobile Maphisa, uthe kubuhlungu ukushona kukaMngomezulu, wathi bebenethemba lokuthi yize esamile ukuya enkantolo, uzobuya, aqhubeke nomsebenzi abewenza."Ubelithanda leli cala, enza konke okusemandleni ukuthi abamangalelwa bathole ubulungiswa," kusho uNksz Maphisa.
UMFELANDAWONYE wezinyunyana zabasebenzi i-Cosatu ulindele ukuthi amaKhomanisi aphume neqhinga lokuqinisa ubudlelwano kumadlelandawonye ahlanganisa i-ANC, Cosatu kanjalo nayo i-SACP.Lo mfelandawonye uthe amaKhomanisi kumele aqhamuke nomkhombandlela wokulwa nenkinga yokuncishiswa kwesabelomali ebhekene neminyango ehlukene kahulumeni.Okhulumela i-Cosatu uNksz Zanele Sabela, uthe babheke lukhulu engqungqutheleni ye-SACP, eqala namhlanje ize iphothulwe ngoMgqibelo, eBirchwood Hotel and OR Tambo Conference Centre, eBoksburg, Ekurhuleni, eGauteng.Kule ngqungquthela okuzobuyekezwa kuyona eminye yemigomo yale nhlangano, kulindeleke ukuthi kubhungwe kabanzi ngodaba olusematheni lokungenela ukhetho ngokuzimela, ingasebenzi ne-ANC okhethweni lohulumeni basekhaya ngo-2026.I-ANC isike yaxoxa ne-SACP kodwa izingxoxo zizoqhubeka ngonyaka ozayo ngodaba lokungenela ukhetho ngayodwana.UNksz Sabela uthe bayifisela impumelelo i-SACP njengoba izoba nale ngqungquthela."Sethemba ukuthi izophuma namasu okuqhubeka kubunjwe abasebenzi kanjalo namadlelandawonye. Kubalulekile ukuthi kubuyiswe ithemba emphakathini nasezinhlakeni ezehlukene,” kusho uNksz Sabela.Uthe emlandweni wayo i-SACP ihlale iyithemba labasebenzi futhi ilwa nezinto ezifana nenkohlakalo kanjalo nokulawulwa koMbuso yidlanzana.I-SACP ihlale igxeka ukwehliswa kwesabelomali seminyango okwenza kube nzima ukusebenza kuhulumeni.Ihlale ifuqa imikhankaso yokukhulisa umnotho, ukulwa nokungalingani ezweni, ukulwa nendlala, ukungasebenzi nezinye izinto ezithinta abantu.Selokhu i-ANC yehlelwa ukwesekwa okhethweni lwangoMeyi, uNobhala jikelele we-SACP uMnuz Solly Mapaila, uhlale egxeka ekahulumeni wokubambisana kwamaqembu kuzwelonke.I-ANC yaphoqeleka ukuthi isebenzisane namaqembu angu-9, kuhulumeni ngenxa yokwehlelwa ukwesekwa.Ekhuluma nabezindaba emuva komhlangano wekomiti elibhekele ukusebenza kwansuku zonke kwi-ANC uNobhala jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, uthe bazothumela iPhini likaMengameli uMnuz Paul Mashatile, ozokwethula inkulumo engqungqutheleni yeSACP.UMbalula uthe abazokubasusa ongqongqoshe be-SACP abakuhulumeni nakuba le nhlangano ihlongoza ukuzimela okhethweni.Muva nje, ekhuluma ne-Newzroom Afrika, uMapaila, uthe abukapheli ubudlelwano phakathi kwe-SACP ne-ANC.Uthe amanye amalungu e-SACP athe uma isiphakamiso sokungenela ukhetho kwale nhlangano ngayodwana, sigunyazwa engqungqutheleni kumele behle ezikhundleni ongqongqoshe be-SACP."Sibatshelile ukuthi abekho ongqongqoshe be-SACP ngoba balapha ngokujutshwa yi-ANC. Okwamanje sithe ababambe amatomu, bangasuli. Bakhona abazimisele ngokushiya uma lesi siphakamiso sigunyazwa,” kusho uMapaila.
KWENZIWE isiphakamiso sokuthi kushintshwe imithetho elawula ukugembula ngenxa yokwenyuka ngamandla kwezibalo zabakwenzayo.Iziphakamiso zenziwe wumsunguli we-Banker X, uMnuz Koshiek Karan, obhalele iPhalamende incwadi.Kule ncwadi uthe ucwaningo olwenziwe yi-National Gambling Board of South Africa lukhomba ukuthi phakathi kuka-2023/2024 kugenjulwe ngo-R1.1 trillion, okuyimali enyuke ngo-40% uma kuqhathaniswa nonyaka odlule."U-27% wabagembulayo uthembela esibonelelweni sikahulumeni, u-31% uthathwa njengabantu abanenkinga yokugembula nokukhomba ukunyuka ngo-500% kusuka ngo-2017. Ukugembula akusekhona okokuzijabulisa kodwa sekubonakala njengento yokwenza imali futhi u-40% wabadlalayo ophinde ugembule ngemali oyiwinayo isikhathi esiningi udliwe. Izibalo ezibalulekile ziveza ukuthi lokhu kudlange kwabaneminyaka ephakathi kuka-24 no-34 kanjalo nasebesempeshenini," kubhala uKaranUKaran, odume enkundleni yokuxhumana i-X ngokukhuluma ngezinto ezithinta imali, wenze iziphakamiso ezingu-15 athe zizovikela abadlayo, ukwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi imithetho yakuleli iyahambisana neyaphesheya nokuthi izinkampani zilandela imithetho.Phakathi kwazo ubale ukuthi kunyuswe iminyaka evunyelwe ukuqala ukugembula ibe wu-21, ukunciphisa izindawo zokugembula kuma-app asemabhange, ukuba nomkhawulo kwabagembula ngemali yesibonelelo, ukuba nesikali sezikhangiso zokugembula ngezikhathi lapho abaningi bengazibona khona, ukukhipha izikhangiso zezinkampani zokugembula emajezini amaqembu ezemidlalo, ukubekwa kwesikali sokuthi umuntu angagembula ngamalini ngosuku, ngesonto noma ngenyanga bese izinkampani zenza isiqiniseko sokuthi lokho kuyalandelwa nokunye.
UZOFIHLWA ngoMgqibelo umholi we-MK KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Canaan Mdletshe, oshone engozini yemoto ngeledlule.Okhulumela umndeni, uMnuz Mdu Mdletshe, uthe umngcwabo uzokuba seMtubatuba.Inkonzo yakhe yokugcina izokuba sesontweni, oGunjaneni Lutheran Church, uzofihlwa emangcwabeni esonto.Uthe kule nkonzo bazokhumbula amagalelo kaMdletshe."Lapha sizobe simvalelisa okokugcina. Sifisa ukuthi imisebenzi yakhe isigqugquzele sonke ukuba siqhubeke lapho egcine khona.”UMdletshe uficwe ingozi yemoto ephuma kokhankasela ukhetho lokuchibiyela obeluseMtubatuba.Imoto yakhe yashayisana neloli emgwaqweni ophakathi kwaseMtubatuba naseHluhluwe.UMdletshe uthe abaqinisa idolo amazwi enduduzo alokhu engena kusukela kwavela izindaba zengozi."UMdletshe ubengumuntu wabantu. Ubewuthanda umndeni wakhe futhi ehlezi elwela abantu. Uwusebenzele ngokungakhathali umphakathi. Ubelwela ukuthi kube nokulingana nobulungiswa. Ukushona kwakhe kushiye isikhala esikhulu ikakhulukazi ezinganeni zakhe nakubona bonke abathandiweyo bakhe.”UMdletshe ubesanda kuqokelwa ethimbeni lesikhashana elihola i-MK KwaZulu-Natal.Ubesuka kwi-NFP, lapho ebengunobhala jikelele wale nhlangano.Ngaphambi kwalokho wayekhulumela umholi we-NFP ongasekho, uNkk Zanele Magwaza-Msibi, ngesikhathi eseyiphini likangqongqoshe wezeSayensi nezobuChwepheshe.Ngaphambi kwalokho wayeyintatheli, wasebenzela amaphephandaba amaningi ahlukene.Uthe uMdletshe usebenze ngokuzinikela kuzo zonke izikhundla abeziphethe.Uthe kwezobuntatheli uMdletshe wazakhela igama."Wanqoba izindondo eziningi lapho aklonyeliswa ngokuveza inkohlakalo. Wasebenza iminyaka engaphezu kwengu-20 esebenzela amaphepha amakhulu ahlonishwayo. Waphatha izikhundla zokuphatha ezahlukene kwabezindaba."Wayebhala kakhulu ngezithinta ipolitiki nezithinta impilo yabantu. Ubehlonishwa kakhulu futhi ngoba bekwaziwa ukuthi ubehlezi efuna ukuveza obala iqiniso. Asisoze siwakhohlwe amagalelo abe nawo ebuntathelini, kuhulumeni nasemphakathini.”UMdletshe ushiye emhlabeni unkosikazi wakhe, uNkk Mphile MaButhelezi Mdletshe, izingane ezintathu, unina nabafowabo ababili.
UBAMBA uyayeka umndeni wowesifazane, isidumbu sakhe okuthiwa sitholwe sisongwe ngengubo yokulala sinodume lwengozi ekhanda, esigamekweni esenzeke eSwapo, eCopsville, kuMasipala waseMsunduzi.Isidumbu sikaNksz Lerato Thotsejane (33), kuthiwa sisaduve emakhazeni njengoba kungekho osebenzayo emndenini.Abakubo basola isoka ngokubulawa kwakhe okuvela ukuthi lisagcwele amathafa.Eceleni kwaso kuthiwa kwatholwa isando okukholakala ukuthi sasetshenziswa ukubulala umufi.Ngokulandisa kukanina omncane kamufi uNksz Makelelo Lesuma, bangabokudabuka eMatatiela esifundazweni i-Eastern Cape.,Umufi ubenomuzi wakhe nomsolwa onguyise wengane yakhe eneminyaka emithathu."Zontathu izingane zikaLerato zihlala nami kubalwa nezimbili ezineminyaka ephakathi kuka-10 no-14 angazizali kuleli soka, kanti bona bebehlala bobabili bakhe indlu buqamama nalapho sihlala khona. Ngesikhathi enye yezingane zakhe ikhala ngendlala, ngiyithume endlini kanina ukuze ibheke okungaphekwa. Kuthe ibuya, yaveza ukuthi ingene uyise (umsolwa) ezimboze ngengubo elele. Kuhambe isikhashana yabuyela yafica sekunonina kamsolwa namaphoyisa yathunywa ukuthi ingibize, ngadideka nje ukuthi kwenzenjani,” usho kanje.Uthe ngesikhathi efika uhlangatshezwe wumlingani wakhe wamazisa ukuthi indodana yakhe imtshele ukuthi seyibulale unina wengane, nebala kuthe uma engena endlini embula ingubo, wathola ukuthi yindodakazi yakhe embozwe ngengubo. Uthe beyinengozi ekhanda kanti eceleni bekunesando okukholakala ukuthi sisetshenziselwe ukuyibulala.Uthe selokhu kwenzeke lesi sigameko, akukho abakutholayo emaphoyiseni nasemndenini kamsolwa. Abakwaziyo ukuthi umsolwa usagcwele amathafa kanti nabo ngakolunye uhlangothi abanawo amandla okufihla ithambo labo njengoba kungekho nobejoyine umasingcwabisane baziphilisa ngokubamba amatoho angatheni.Kwenzeka lokhu kuvele kuqhubeka umkhankaso wezinsuku eziwu-16 wokuqwashisa ngesihlava sokubulawa kwabesifazane nezingane oqale ngenyanga edlule, osongwa namhlanje.Ngenyanga edlule, ethula izibalo zobugebengu zekota yesibili yonyakamali u-2024/2025 uNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, uthe bangu-957 abesifazane ababulewe phakathi kukaJulayi noSepthemba.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uColonel Robert Netshiunda uthe amaphoyisa aseMountain Rise aphenya icala lokubulala, kanti imbangela yakho okwamanje ayikaziwa.
IPHINI likaMengameli we-ANC, uMnuz Paul Mashatile, lithalalise amahlebezi okuthi buzohlakazwa ubuholi bale nhlangano KwaZulu-Natal.UMashatile uthe ukungenzi kahle kwe-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, naseGauteng, akusho ukuthi sekufanele kuhlakazwe ubuholi bezifundazwe.Ukusho lokhu ekhankasela ukhetho lokuchibiyela oluzokuba ku-ward 2 eSweetwaters, kuMasipala waseMsunduzi ngesonto elizayo.UMashatile uthe abakasithathi isinqumo sokuhlakaza ubuholi be-ANC kuzona zombili izifundazwe."I-ANC ayizange yenze kahle ezindaweni eziningi ngesikhathi kunokhetho lwangoMeyi, sathola u-40%. Njengobuholi be-ANC kuzwelonke siyabheka ukuthi sehlulwa kanjani okhethweni. Yingakho sihlangane nobuholi be-ANC kuzona zombili lezi zifundazwe. "Lesi akusona isikhathi sokuba sisolane. Ngiyazi ukuthi abantu abaningi bacabanga ukuthi njengoba sibize ubuholi be-ANC KwaZulu-Natal naseGauteng, sifuna ukubahlakaza. Iqiniso ukuthi thina sifuna nje ukubuka izimo ezaholela ekutheni singenzi kahle okhethweni.”Ubuholi be-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, nobaseGauteng bulengelwa yizembe ngenxa yokuthi inhlangano ayizange yenze kahle kuzona zombili izifundazwe okhethweni lwangoMeyi.KwaZulu-Natal i-ANC yathola u-17%, isuka ekutholeni u-55% okhethweni lwango-2019. Njengamanje i-ANC iyiqembu lesithathu ngobukhulu KwaZulu-Natal.EGauteng khona i-ANC yathola u-33%, isuka ku-50% eyawuthola okhethweni lwango-2019.I-ANC ihlehlise umhlangano obekufanele unqume ngekusasa lobuholi be-ANC kuzona zombili izifundazwe.Umhlangano wesigungu esiphezulu kwi-ANC obekufanele ube kule mpelasonto, uhlehliselwe unyaka ozayo.UNobhala Jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, uthe bakhethe ukuhlehlisa umhlangano wangempelasonto ngenxa yokuthi kumatasa kwezepolitiki."Kunomengameli bakwamanye amazwe abazohambela kuleli. Lokho kudinga uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa nongqongqoshe. Kuphinde kube khona ingqungquthela yedlelandawonye lethu, i-SACP.”Kulo mhlangano ikomiti elibhekelele ukusebenza kwansuku zonke kwi-ANC, i-National Working Committee, belizokwenza izincomo esigungwini esiphezulu ngesinqumo okufanele sithathwe ngekusasa lobuholi benhlangano eKZN, naseGauteng.Phakathi kweziphakamiso, kukhona esokuhlakaza ubuholi be-ANC kulezi zifundazwe, kube khona nesokujuba abaholi ukuba bayoqinisa ubuholi kuzona zombili izifundazwe.Ikomiti lisanda kuhlangana nobuholi be-ANC kuzona zombili izifundazwe, lapho kukhulunywe kabanzi ngemiphumela yokhetho.Kule mihlangano ubuholi be-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, naseGauteng benze izethulo ngemiphumela yokhetho.UMbalula ugcizelele eyokuthi abakasithathi isinqumo ngekusasa lobuholi be-ANC kuzona zombili izifundazwe."Abukho ubuholi obuhlakaziwe. Ubuholi be-ANC kuzona zombili izifundazwe buzoqhubeka busebenze kuze kuba kuthathwa isinqumo ngoJanuwari.”
BAKHALA ngamaphoyisa esilisa kaMasipala weTheku, abathinta bengagqokile ngesikhathi ebabophela ukungaziphathi kahle emphakathini abebesebenza ohlelweni i-Expanded Public Works Programme (EPWP).Abasebenzi abalinganiselwa ku-150, bebebhikisha ngaphesheya kwe-Durban City Hall ngoLwesine, befuna ukubuyiselwa emsebenzini.Kulesi sibalo, kugcine kuboshwa abangu-34, okukhona kubo abesifazane abangu-26, nabesilisa abayisishiyagalombili.Badedelwe ngebheyili yamahhala ngoMgqibelo kanti kulindeleke ukuthi bavele okokuqala eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini namuhla.Umholi wabo, uNksz Slindile Sokhela uthe bahlukumezekile ngokuthi kuthi kugujwa i-16 Days of Activism, okuhloswe ngayo ukulwa nodlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane nezingane, bona bebe behlukunyezwa ngalolu hlobo."Siphatheke kabi kakhulu ukuthi kuthi kuyi-16 Days of Activism, kube kwenzeka kanje kithina. Siyabona ukuthi lena yimikhankaso nje abayisungulayo, maqede ingagcinwa. Liyashunyayelwa ivangeli kodwa abomthetho yibo kanye abasihlukumezayo njengoba enzile amaphoyisa esilisa, ebamba abantu besifazane benqunu,” kusho uNksz Sokhela.Ubuze ukuthi bese eshonephi amaphoyisa esifazane ukuze ababophe.Ukhale ngokuthi iTheku ligcwele abantu abadayisa ngomzimba, abahlale bengagqokile kodwa ababoshwa."Kuzocindezelwa abantu abalwela amalungelo abo, abantu abondla imindeni, abaphelelwe umsebenzi ngendlela engekho emthethweni,” kusho uNksz Sokhela.Uthe indaba ye-16 Days of Activism bona bayibona njengento engasebenzi.Uthe basaxoxa nommeli wabo ngalokhu njengoba befuna ukuvulela amaphoyisa esilisa amacala ngokubathinta bengagqokile.Laba basebenzi bayingxenye yabangu-4 000 abatshelwe ukuthi umsebenzi uphelile ngoJulayi.Bakhala ngokuthi umasipala uvele wabamisa bengazelele, batshelwa ukuthi ayisekho imali yokubaholela.Bathe badidwe ukuthi kungakapheli isikhathi esingakanani bemisiwe, kuqashwe abanye abantu ezikhaleni zabo.Baveze ukuthi bese besebenze iminyaka engaphezu kuka-11.Kuthintwa okhulumela ihhovisi leMeya kaMasipala weTheku, uMnz Mluleki Mntungwa uthe akulona iqiniso ukuthi baxoshiwe.Uphinde wathi akulona iqiniso nokuthi umasipala wabeka isizathu sokuphela kwemali ngesikhathi bemiswa."Uhlelo ababeqashwe ngalo oluphelelwe yisikhathi. Ngesikhathi beqashwa babetsheliwe ukuthi bazosebenza iminyaka emibili kuphela bese beyashintshwa, kufakwe abanye,” kusho uMntungwa.Uthe ngesikhathi beqashwa, besayina, lokhu kusuke kubhaliwe phansi.Ebuzwa ukuthi kwenzeke kanjani ukuthi basebenze iminyaka engaphezu kuka-11 ekubeni inkontileka yayithi bazosebenza iminyaka emibili, ucele ukuthunyelelwa i-email ngoba akanalo ulwazi oluphelele phambi kwakhe mayelana neminyaka abayisebenzile.Kubuyelwa kuNksz Sokhela ngalokhu uthe kuyiqiniso ukuthi kwakubhalwe iminyaka emibili enkontilekeni, kodwa wabuza umbuzo wokuthi uqhubeke kanjani umasipala nokubasebenzisa iminyaka eminingi kangaka uma ukwazi ukubaluleka kokubhalwe enkontilekeni."Bayiphula bona imibandela yenkontileka, basigcina eminyaka engaphezu kwengu-11. Basisebenzise iminyaka, manje ngoba sebedelile, sebekhumbula imibandela yenkontileka, sebeyasilaxaza,” kusho uNksz Sokhela.Okhulumela amaphoyisa kaMasipala weTheku uMnuz Boysie Zungu ukuqinisekisile ukuthi babophe abanye bababhikishi ngecala lokungaziphathi kahle emphakathini.Uzichithile izinsolo zokuthi abesifazane bathintwa amaphoyisa esilisa."Njengoba kubona kwakukhona abesifazane nabesilisa, nasemaphoyiseni ethu kwakunjalo. Awesifazane ayebhekene nabesifazane, awesilisa ebhekene nabesilisa. Ayikho le nto abayishoyo,” kusho uZungu.
