USETHOLAKELE usonkontileka olungisa inkinga yesifuthefuthe esidalwa wukungasebenzi kwama-air conditioner eNkantolo yeMantshi yasePinetown, okwenza kuhlehliswe amacala.Isolezwe lisanda kubika ngenkinga esingenela esontweni lesithathu yokushisa okungabekezeleki kule nkantolo esiholele nasekutheni kuhlehliswe amacala.Intatheli yaleli phephandaba yayikhona enkantolo ithamele icala mhlazane iqala le nkinga ngoMsombuluko wangoNovemba 25.Emuva kokuthi ilalele izikhalazo zabasebenzi basenkantolo ngenkinga elethwa wukungasebenzi kwama-air conditioner, Isolezwe libe selithinta uMnyango wezoBulungiswa nokuThuthukiswa koMthethosisekelo.Lo mnyango uphendule ngokuthi udaba selusezithebeni zawo, uyalumunyunga ukuze uqhamuke nekhambi.UNksz Kgalalelo Masibi okhulumela lo mnyango uthe: "Siyalusebenza udaba lwale nkantolo ngokushesha ukuze kugwemeke ukubambezeleka endleleni okusetshenzwa ngayo enkantolo.”Uqhube wathi ibhilidi leNkantolo yeMantshi yasePinetown liwela ezandleni zoMnyango wezemiSebenzi yoMphakathi neNgqalasizinda.UNksz Masibi uqhube ngokuthi bayaxoxa nalo mnyango okuyiwona oqondene nomsebenzi wokulungiswa nokugcina ibhilidi lisemeni esikahe.UMnuz Lennox Mabaso okhulumela uMnyango wemiSebenzi yoMphakathi ushaye ngamafuphi wathi usonkontileka ubekade ekhona enkantolo ngesonto eledlule ukuze alungise i-air conditioner."Uma konke azokudinga kukhona, umsebenzi wokulungisa uzobe usuphothuliwe ekupheleni kwesonto elizayo (esho leli sonto eliqalayo),” kusho uMabaso.Kwakukade kuqulwa icala lokubulala nokukhomba ngesibhamu elithweswe isosha lombutho wezempi kuleli, uMnuz Lwanda Zungu, ngesikhathi umshushisi ekhala ngesifuthefuthe enkantolo.UZungu usolwa ngokubulala umkakhe uNkk, Tania Msani-Zungu, ngoJanuwari nonyaka.Imantshi uMuntu Khumalo yaliguqisa okwesikhashana icala ngenhloso yokuba kuphenywe ukuthi ukushisa kwakubangelwa yini.Inkinga kayilungisekanga ngaleso sikhathi, kwaphoqa uKhumalo ukuthi icala alihlehlisele u-Ephreli, ngonyaka ozayo.
ABAMELI bazombiza bona ufakazi ozoveza ukuthi owayengunozinti we-Orlando Pirates neBafana Bafana, uSenzo Meyiwa, wadutshulwa ngephutha, uma uMbuso uphetha ngokungambizi.Lokhu kuvezwe ummeli kammangalelwa wesihlanu, uFisokuhle Ntuli, u-Advocate Zandile Mshololo, izolo, ngesikhathi eqhubeka nokuphonsa ngemibuzo ufakazi, uBrigadier Bongani Gininda.UGininda osedonsile esitikini sofakazi, ungumphenyi omkhulu kuleli cala.U-Adv Mshololo udalule ukuthi ufakazi abazombiza uMnuz Mlungisi Hlophe, ongumkhweyana wakwaMeyiwa.Uveze ukuthi kukhona isitatimende esabhalwa nguHlophe ngo-Ephreli 7, 2015, uGininda engakaqokwa ukuthi aphenye icala."Wasibona lesi sitatimende edokodweni owawuliphethe?” kusho u-Adv Mshololo."Yebo, ngasithola isitatimende. Kanti kukhona nesinye okuthiwa salahleka. Kuthiwa sanyamalala, kwasolwa mina ngokuthi ngasithatha,” kusho uGininda.Esitatimendeni, uHlophe uveza ukuthi washayelwa ucingo nguMnuz Tumelo Madlala, owayengumngani kaMeyiwa, emva kwesigameko.Siqhuba sithi wayefuna ukuthi kwenzekeni ngosuku lwesigameko, ngoba kwakukhulunywa izinto ezingafani ngokubulawa kukaMeywa."UTumelo wangitshela ukuthi uZandi wayexabana nesoka lakhe, uSenzo ezama ukubahlukanisa, kwaqhuma isibhamu, kwadubuleka uSenzo ngephutha,” kusho isitatimende.Siqhubeka sithi, uHlophe wamangala ukuthi uTumelo asho kanje ngoba kwabezindaba wayethi kwaba nesigameko sokubanjwa kwenkunzi.Echaza, uGininda uthe ithimba labaphenyi layilandela indaba yalesi sitatimende ngo-2015, kodwa langakuthola okuphathekayo."Ngo-2016, siyithimba lamaphoyisa ayisishiyagalolunye, sanikela kwaMeyiwa, siyothola kabanzi ngendaba yalesi sitatimende. Umndeni wakhala ngokuthi awazi ukuthi yini enzima ekusombululeni leli cala ngoba bukhona ubufakazi bokuthi akuzange kungene zigebengu endlini,” kubeka uGininda.Uthe kwaba nzima ukukhuluma noHlophe ngqo, enqaba ukukhuluma naye, kodwa wagcina ekhuluma nathi, wakuqinisekisa lokhu."Kodwa sathi uma sesiya kuMadlala, waphika, wathi akakaze akusho lokhu kuHlophe,” kuphendula uGininda.Kuvele ukuthi kulesi sitatimende, kukhona inqwaba yemali engene ebhange likaMadlala, kanti basola ukuthi uthengwe ngemali ngumuntu othile owayebandakanyeka ekudutshulweni kukaMeyiwa.UGininda uthe ngebhadi, yize uHlophe ekhomba ababesendlini kodwa ubufakazi ababuthola bona ngesikhathi bephenya, bukhoba ukuthi kukhona abangena endlini.Icala liyaqhubeka namuhla.
KUNXUSWE ukuthi azibambe ziqine ukubhekana nezinselelo zomsebenzi wawo amaphoyisa kuMasipala weTheku asengamathwasa abethulwa ngokusemthethweni ngoMsombuluko.Umcimbi obuvulelekile wokwethulwa kwamaphoyisa angu-500 kulo masipala asanda kuphothula ukuqeqeshwa kwawo, ubusenkundleni yezemidlalo i-Kings Park, eThekwini. UKhomishana wawo uMnuz Sibonelo Mchunu ugcizelele ukuthi izinga lokuqeqeshwa kwawo lenza akulungele ukubhekana nezinselelo zomsebenzi wokuvikela umphakathi njengoba kuqala isiphithiphithi samaholidi okuphela konyaka."Namuhla wusuku lukuvuna izithelo zokusebenza kanzima niqeqeshelwa izinselelo enizobhekana nazo esikhathini esizayo. Imindeni yenu izojabulela amaholidi okuphela konyaka ngaphandle kwenu. Uma nibuyela emakhaya, nizobuya nikhathele niphumule amahora ambalwa nibuyele emsebenzini wokuvikela isizwe,” usho kanje.Ugcizelele ukuthi izinkumbi zabantu zizothutheleka kuleli dolobha ngesikhathi samaholidi, ngakho zithembele kuwo ukuthi aqinisekise ukuphepha kwazo.IMeya uMnuz Cyril Xaba, ikhuluma kulo mviliyelo, ithe kunesinqumo esenziwa sokuthi unyaka nonyaka kuqashwe amaphoyisa evile ku-400 kuze kube isibalo sawo sifinyelela ku-5000. Uthe lokhu kuzobuyisa ithemba kuwona wonke umuntu, ekulweni nesihlava sobugebengu.Lo masipala uthe ulindele ukumumatha izivakashi ezingu-1.3 million ezizohambela ezingxenyeni zawo ziphuma ezindaweni ezehlukene ukuzochitha amaholidi kaDisemba. Ngu-R6.3 billion imali okulindeleke uyiqoqe kanti angu-11 000 amathuba omsebenzi okuthiwa avulekile ngalesi sikhathi sonyaka. Zingu-170 izimoto ezintsha zamaPhoyisa kuMasipala weTheku ezithuliwe okuthiwa zizolekelela ukwenza umsebenzi wawo ubelula.Phambilini umasipala uqinisekise ukuthi wonke amabhishi asevuliwe.
AMADODA amabili okufika abekholwa wukuthi abantu akufanele balubhade emanyuvesi nokuthi akumele bafunde ngokuzikhandla ukuze bathole umvuzo, kepha beze kuwona nemali ukuze babagixabeze njengabafundileyo ngeziqu zasenyuvesi yize bengakaze bawubone umbombo we-lecturer, acushelwe umgoga ngamaphoyisa zawakhalela.La madoda abengagcini ngokuthengisa iziqu kuphela, kodwa abethengisa omazisi, izincwadi zokushayela nezitifiketi zika-matric. Abanjwe ngeledlule, engazi nanyaka, eqhuba njengenjwayelo umshikashika wawo wokudayisa nencwadi kadokotela eVerulam, eThekwini. Kuhlaluke ukuthi eyodwa idabuka eZimbabwe kanti enye ingeyaseMalawi.Emva kokukhalelwa ngamasongo kaSigonyela, aveze ubuso eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseVerulam, ngoLwesihlanu, kwase kuthiwa awabuyele enkantolo efanayo ngoLwesihlanu olulandelayo ezocela ibheyili.Athweswe icala lokukhwabanisa.Kwenzeka lokhu nje, amaphoyisa asanda kubhadama ihhovisi loMnyango wezaseKhaya eliwumbombayi ebhilidini eliseGreyville, eThekwini.Kulelo hhovisi kuthiwa bekwenziwa yonke into etholakala emahhovisi oMnyango wezaseKhaya angempela.Bekuhamba phambili umsebenzi wokushadiswa kwabantu bokufika nabesifazane abayizakhamuzi ezisuke zilahlekelwe omazisi bazo ngemali esuka ku-R18 000. Abasolwa okungamadoda amabili asePakistan nase-India bangaphandle ngebheyili.Esehlakalweni sakamuva, Isolezwe lihabule ngomthombo walo olwazi ukusuka nokuhlala udaba, othe abasolwa bebekade benendawo eyi-internet cafe eVerulam Center, lapho bebeqhuba khona umshikashika wabo.Kuthiwa la madoda abebhekwe ngeso lokhozi amaphoyisa kusukela ngoNovemba.NgoLwesithathu acushelwe umgoga amaphoyisa afumbathise umuntu imali, amthuma ukuthi ayothenga isitifiketi sika-matric nelayisensi yokushayela imoto obekukade kubiza u-R4 500 kukokubili.Isithunywa samaphoyisa sifike sanikezwa isaphulelo sika-R500 sagcina sikhokha u-R4 000 sabuya "nebesikufuna"."La madoda kusolakala ukuthi abekade edayisa kwasani kusukela komazisi, izincwadi zokushayela imoto, iziqu ama-Degree nama-Diploma, izitifiketi zaka-matric ngisho nezincwadi zikadokotela,” kusho umthombo.Kuthiwa amaphoyisa kuthe uma ebona abemthumile ebuya nalezi zinto angena kule ndawo ehlome nangamaphepha awagunyaza ukuba ayiseshe.Kuthiwa afike apequlula esesha kwasani, avuka nezinto eziningi okukhona amakhompyutha, ama-laptop, ama-hard drive, keyboards, imishini okungama-printer, scanners, nama-photocopying machines.
BANIKEZWE isexwayiso esishubile abagovuza umbhikisho okuhloswe ngawo ukuba kuphoqwe uMengameli, uCyril Ramaphosa, ukuba ehle esikhundleni.Uhulumeni uthe bazoyikhotha imbenge yomile abazozama ukuphazamisa ukusebenza kwezwe babhikishe.Ikhwelo lokuba uRamaphosa ehle esikhundleni liqale emva kwenkulumo yakhe ehunyushwe ngokuthi uvumela abaseNigeria ukuba bathutheleke ngobuningi kuleli.Ngeledlule uRamaphosa umemezele ukugxegiswa kwemigomo ebekelwe abaseNigeria abafuna ukuvakashela kuleli.URamaphosa uthe abaseNigeria abafuna ukuza kuleli sebezovumeleka ukuthi benze izicelo ze-visa ngaphandle kokuthi baze baphathe ama-passport abo.Le nkulumo icasule abantu abaningi ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, kwaze kwaba nekhwelo lokuba kube nombhikisho namhlanje, ozokube umayelana nokuthi uRamaphosa ehle esikhundleni.Embhalweni ofakwe ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, uhulumeni wakuleli uxwayise abagqugquzela umbhikisho ngokuthi bazowukhomba umuzi onotshwala."Siliqaphelile ikhwelo lokuba kumiswe nse ukusebenza kwezwe. Inhloso yaleli khwelo ukuthusa abantu ezweni. Njengohulumeni ngeke sivume ukuthi kube nodlame noma ukusatshiswa kwabantu okuzophazamisa imizamo yethu yokuletha uzinzo. Abazozama ukuphazamisa abanye noma abazozama ukuvala imigwaqo nokucekela phansi impahla bazobhekana nengalo yomthetho. Sinxusa abantu ukuthi babikele amaphoyisa uma bebona ukuphulwa komthetho.”UNobhala Jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, uligxekile ikhwelo lokuba uRamaphosa ehle esikhundleni.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba ngoLwesihlanu.Uthe bazomvikela uRamaphosa kwabathi akehle esikhundleni."Lena imizamo nje yokudala uqhekeko. URamaphosa uwumengameli, wakhethwa, uzoqhubeka nokuphatha. Wakhethwa ngaphansi kwentando yabantu. Abahlasela uRamaphosa bahlasela thina sonke.”UMbalula uthe abaphambili kuleli khwelo bahlanekezele inkulumo kaRamaphosa."URamaphosa akazange asho ukuthi awasezofuneka ama-passport ebantwini baseNigeria abafuna ukuza kuleli. Into ayishilo ukuthi bangakwazi ukufaka izicelo zama-visa ngaphandle kokuthi baze baveze ama-passport. Ama-passport bayobuye bawalethe uma sekufanele kuqinisekiswe yonke into.”UMbalula unxuse uhulumeni ukuba ubathathele izinyathelo abazophula imithetho.
ITHIMBA eliqokelwe ukweluleka uNdunankulu kaZulu, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, lifuna ukubeka ubukhosi bukaZulu ezingeni lobukhosi bamaNgisi.Leli thimba elimenyezelwe izolo, lithe lifuna ukuthi ubukhosi bukaZulu bube sebukwelinye izinga eminyakeni emihlanu kuya kwengu-10 ezayo.Leli thimba elibizwa ngoBhoko lukaZulu lididiyele abaqhamuka emikhakheni ehlukene okubalwa kubo abaNtwana baseNdlunkulu, amakhosi, ongoti bezamasiko, osomabhizinisi nongoti bezomthetho.Ithimba labantu abangu-27 lethulwe ngokusemthethweni eThekwini, izolo.UButhelezi uthe leli thimba lizomeluleka emisebenzini yakhe ajutshwe kuyo iSilo uMisuzulu kaZwelithini."Ithimba lizosebenza ezinhlakeni eziyisithupha ezehlukene. Sizokuba nohlaka oluzobhekelela ezezimali nokuthuthukiswa komnotho, elizobhekelela umlando, ulwimi nezemfundo, elizobhekelela ezobuchwepheshe ezokuxhumana nabezindaba, elizobhekelela ezokuphatha namasiko, elizobhekelela ezolimo, umhlaba nokudla nezempilo.”UButhelezi umemezele ungoti wezamasiko waseNyuvesi yaseJohannesburg, uSolwazi Gugu Mazibuko, njengosihlalo wethimba.USolwazi Mazibuko uthe inhloso enkulu yoBhoko lukaZulu ukuthuthukisa ubukhosi kanye nesizwe."Sifuna ukwakha isizwe esisimeme, esinomnotho waso futhi esaziwa umhlaba wonke. Sifuna ukuthi ubukhosi bukaZulu bufane nobukhosi baseNgilandi. Sizohamba sithekela kwezinye izindawo ebukhosini obudlondlobele, sibuke ukuthi ikuphi abakwenza kahle.”Ikomiti lizohlangana kane ngonyaka, uSolwazi Mazibuko uthe bazokweluleka uButhelezi ngazo zonke izinto ezithinta ukuthuthukiswa kwesizwe nobukhosi."Njengoba ithimba lihlanganise abantu abaphuma emikhakheni eyahlukene, kukhulu esizoqhamuka nakho.”Kwabasendlunkulu abaqokelwe kuleli thimba umfowabo weSilo, uMntwana uBambindlovu kaZwelithini, kube khona noMntwana uPat kaThandayiphi kaSolomon.Amakhosi ayingxenye yethimba iNkosi yaseMahlayizeni, uBhekizizwe Biyela, iPhini likaNdunankulu kaZulu, uPhathisizwe Chiliza, uSihlalo weNdlu yoBuholi boMdabu KwaZulu-Natal, uSifiso Shinga, iNkosi yaKwaNgenetsheni uLangalethu Zulu, neNkosi yakwaMadlala.Ethimbeni elimenyezelwe uButhelezi kukhona uqweqwe lwenyosi, uMnuz Buzetsheni Mdletshe, owangumsakazi oKhozini FM, uNksz Nongcebo McKenzie, ummeli odumile u-Advocate Zandile Mshololo.Izingcithabuchopho eziyingxenye yethimba uDkt Nqobile Sithole, Solwazi Xoli Mkhize, Dkt Lungile Bhengu-Baloyi, Solwazi Thokozani Nzimakwe, Dkt Malindi Kunene, Solwazi Smangaliso Khumalo, Dkt Sphamandla Zondi, Solwazi Pearl Sithole, Dkt Sanele Gumede noDkt Delani Mthembu.Amanye amalungu ekomiti, uNksz Zibu Sibiya, Nksz Thandi Ngxongo, Mnuz Johnny Mhlungu, Lawrence Mthombeni, Mnuz Pat Muridili, Mpumelelo Mnguni noNjabulo Hadebe.
IYAQONGA intukuthelo edalwe ukubuyiselwa kwelakubo kowasoconga owayengunobhala jikelele we-SACP, uMnuz Chris Hani.Uyaveva umndeni kaHani namaqembu ezepolitiki ngokubuyiselwa ePoland (kwelakubo) kukaJanusz Waluś.Umfelokazi kaHani, uNkk Limpho Hani, SACP, ANC ne-EFF, bathe kuyishwa ukuthi uWaluś uze wabuyela kwelakubo engakaze agonyuluke ngokubulala uHani.UWaluś wadonsa iminyaka engu-28 ejele emva kokulahlwa icala lokubulala uHani.Wadedelwa ngoshwele ngo-2022, isigwebo sakhe siphele ngoLwesihlanu, nokwenze ukuthi abuyiselwe kwelakubo njengoba engenawo amaphepha amgunyaza ukuthi abe kuleli.UHani wabulawa ngo-1993 ngesikhathi elakuleli lilungiselela ukuya okhethweni lokuqala olukhululekile. Ukubulawa kwakhe kwacishe kwanyomfa amalungiselelo okhetho.Okhulumela i-SACP, uDkt Alex Mashilo, uthe uNkk Hani kanye ne-SACP bafuna kuqalwe uphenyo ngokubulawa kukaHani.Uthe leli khwelo balihlabe behlangene nobuholi bukahulumeni ngeledlule, lapho baziswe khona ngesinqumo sokubuyiselwa kukaWaluś kwelakubo.UMashilo uthe ukubuyiselwa kukaWaluś kwelakubo kuwukhubazile umoya kaNkk Hani."Ucele ukuba angaphawuli kulolu daba kwabezindaba noma esidlangaleni. Lolu daba lumphethe kabuhlungu yena kanye nomdeni.”Isinqumo sokuthi uWaluś adedelwe ngoshwele sathathwa iNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo ngo-2022.Owayegwetshwe noWaluś, uClive Derby-Lewis, wabulawa umdlavuza.UMashilo uthe bona bebefisa ukuthi uWaluś noDerby-Lewis bagugele ejele."Saphikisana nokuthi banikezwe ushwele owawunikezwa abalahlwa amacala odlame lwezepolitiki njengoba nakulokhu sisaphikisana noshwele onikezwe uWaluś. Unikezwa kanjani ushwele umuntu ongazange alikhulume iqiniso? Ukudedelwa kwalo mbulali kukhombisa ukuthi ezobulungiswa zibuthaka.”UNobhala Jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, uthe ukubuyiselwa kukaWaluś ePoland kubathunuke amanxeba angakapholi."Salahlekelwa umholi oqavile. Amanxeba asansonsotha namanje. Iyasithunuka eyokuthi uWaluś ubuyiselwe kwelakubo engakaze alikhulume iqiniso.”Okhulumela i-EFF, uNksz Leigh-Ann Mathys, uthe okubaphatha kabuhlungu ukuthi uNkk Hani ngeke aphinde alithole iqiniso eliphelele ngokubulawa komyeni wakhe."Ababebiza uHani ngeqabane labo badedele umbulali owamsoconga ngesihluku. Okubuhlungu ukuthi kunabaholi abahambe bethi bazi izimfihlo ngetulo lokusoconga uHani kodwa abafuni ukusitshela ukuthi kwenzekani.”
IZIHLATHI zivakashele izindlebe ngesikhathi amatekisi ahamba amabanga amade eThekwini, ebuyela emsebenzini emva kwesiteleka ebese sidonse isonto lonke.Isiteleka bese siyinkinga kubafundi, izitshudeni, abasebenzi, kubadayisi basemarenki nakubagibeli jikelele.Izikhulu zamatekisi ahamba amabanga amade bezingqubuzana noMnyango wezokuThutha KwaZulu-Natal, ngendaba yezimvume noShanela (uphiko lwamaphoyisa omgwaqo) obopha izimoto zabo.Abagibeli abaxoxe neSolezwe ngoMsombuluko, baveze ukuthi bayakuthakasela ukubuya kwamatekisi.UNksz Phumelele Mthembu ongumdayisi wezingubo, uthe konke bekumile njengoba amatekisi abengahambi."Siyajabula njengoba amatekisi esehamba-nje ngoba bengiwasebenzisa kakhulu uma ngizothenga engikudayisayo la eThekwini ngisuka eMandeni. Ngiyathemba ukuthi ngeke isabakhona into efana nale,” kusho uNksz Mthembu.UNksz Zanele Zibula odayisa ukudla erenki yase-YMCA, uthe ubesesokole kakhulu."Kumanje sijabule kakhulu. Ukubuya kwamatekisi kuzoletha ushintsho olukhulu empilweni yethu ngoba indlala ibisibulala. Ukudayisa lokhu siphila ngakho. Abagibeli nabashayeli yibona abaphathi bethu ngoba bayaseseka kakhulu. Njengoba kade sihleli zonke lezi zinsuku, bekunzima,” kusho uNksz Zibula.UMsizi Mbuyazi oyisitshudeni sase-Durban University of Technology uthe: "Umoya wami uthokoza kakhulu njengoba konke sekubuyele esimweni esejwayelekile. Ngijabule kakhulu ngoba njengoba sikhuluma nje, ngibheke ekhaya. Bese kukubi kuthina bafundi njengoba bese sisebenzisa imali engekho sirenta.” Ongumshayeli wetekisi elashiya abagibeli abasuka eThekwini beya eMandeni, uMnuz Sabelo Maphumulo, uthe noma bengakahlanganisi lutho olutheni kodwa uyathemba konke kuzohlangana njengoba umsebenzi uqhubeka.UMnuz Bhekisisa Nzuza onguSihlalo we-Durban Long Distance Taxi Association, uthe esithangamini ababenaso noMphathiswa wezokuThutha bavumelane ngokuthi bazobuyela emsebenzini."Konke kuhamba kahle. Ezingxoxweni esibe nazo noMphathiswa sivumelane ngokuthi umzabalazo siwubeke phansi. Nabashayeli njengoba bebekhala ngokungasebenzi-nje, bafana nabanikazi bezimoto ngoba uma bengasebenzanga abaholi okuyikona obekwenza ukuthi sibeke amathuluzi phansi ngoba uShanela ububalwisa kakhulu,” kusho uNzuza.Khonamanjalo: UMphathiswa wezokuThutha nokuHlaliswa kwaBantu KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Sboniso Duma, uthe bavumelene ngokuthi amaphepha okusebenza akhona, izikhulu aziye emnyangweni ziyowalanda.
NKOSIKHONA CELEBACHONYWE uphaphe lwegwalagwala othisha basesikoleni iQiniselani Primary, eMbumbulu, ngomsebenzi wabo wokufundisa ngokuzikhandla kusukela unyaka uqala.Uthishanhloko wakulesi sikole, uMnuz Sibongiseni Kunene, wenze indumezulu yomcimbi wezindondo zokubonga othisha bakulesi sikole ngomsebenzi wabo. Lo mcimbi ubukade usehholo lomphakathi laseMbumbulu.Lo mcimbi ubuhlanganiswe nokuvaleliswa kwabafundi bakulesi sikole ebebenza uGrade 7.UMnuz Sibongiseni Kunene onguthishanhloko wakulesi sikole, uthe kumqoka kakhulu ukuthi babongwe othisha abafundisa amabanga aphansi.Ubancomile ngendima abayiklamayo ekutshaleni imbewu yothando lwezemfundo kubantwana abasakhula. Ugcizelele ukuthi kungaba yiphutha ukuhlaba inhlali umsebenzi omkhulu wothisha bamabanga aphansi."Ngikubone kumqoka kakhulu ukuthi kube khona lolu hlobo lomcimbi okhona namhlanje. Bengifuna ukuthi ngibabonge ngokwami othisha ngomsebenzi wabo,’’ usho kanje.Uthe othisha abafundisa amabanga aphansi mkhulu umsebenzi abawenzayo becathulisa abantwana abancane, wathi sesifikile isikhathi sokuba bahlonishwe futhi liqhakanjiswe iqhaza lothisha bamabanga aphansi."Ukusebenza kwenu ngokuzikhandla kuyinto engeke ize izibeke noma sesithanda. Kuncane lokhu enginibonga ngakho namhlanje. Ukube kuya ngami, ngabe nginibonga ngokungaphezulu kwalokhu kwanamhlanje,'' usho kanjena.Lo mcimbi ubukade uzinyaziswe nawukuba khona kwabazali babafundi ebebephume ngobuningi babo beze emcimbini.
KUFUKULWE ngolwazi abafundi basezikoleni zaseThekwini ngomkhankaso obizwa nge-16 Days of Activism, okuhloswe ngawo ukuphikisana nodlame olubhekiswe kubantu besifazane nezingane.Ezikoleni ebezibambe iqhaza kubalwa iZiphathele High yaseClermont, iNingizimu Special School yaseMontclair, iFulton School for the Deaf yaseGillitts neTholamandla Primary yaKwaMashu.Omunye wabagqugquzeli balo mcimbi, uBeverley Mothlabane, uthe inhlosongqangi ukuqwashisa ngokuhlukunyezwa kwabantu besifazane nezingane ngokusebenzisa ubuciko nomdanso. UMGQUGQUZELI womkhankaso obizwa nge-16 Days of Activism eBat Centre, uBeverley Mothlabane, uthi kusemqoka ukuba intsha ifundiswe ezikoleni ngezobuciko Isithombe: TUMI PAKKIESNgokwezibalo zakamuva bangu-957 abantu besifazane nezingane ababulawe ezinyangeni ezintathu ezedlule kuleli. Abanye besifazane asebeke babulawa ngesihluku kuleli ngoTshegofatso Pule (28), owayenezinyanga ezingu-8 ekhulelwe, futhi isidumbu sakhe esatholakala silenga esihlahleni eRoodepport, ngo-2020; u-Uyinene Mrwetyana, owabulawa ngo-Agasti, 2019, ngesikhathi ezama ukulanda iphasela ePosini laseCape Town noNksz Hillary Gardee (28), oyindodakazi yobengunobhala we-EFF, uMnuz Godrich Gardee, watholakala efile.UBeverley ubuye wathi bagqugquzela ukuba intsha ifundiswe ngokudweba isesezikoleni ukuze ikwazi ukuphila ngamakhono.Esephetha, uBeverley uthe lo mkhankaso uzoqhubeka nangenyanga ezayo sekukhona nezinye izikole.Omunye wababambe iqhaza kulo mcimbi umdwebi owaziwayo, uXola Mlandu.
NKOSIKHONA CELEKUBATSHAZWA ukulunga kuthishanhloko wasesikoleni saseMpumalanga, eHammarsdale iSkhethuxolo High School, odutshulwe wabulawa ngaphandle kwesikole ngoLwesine ntambama.Umufi uMnuz Busani Khomo (57) kuvela ukuthi udutshulwe wabulawa engaphandle kwesikole ngabantu abangaziwa.Umfowabo kamufi omdala, uMnuz Mvunge Khomo, uthe bewumndeni bafe olwembiza ngokubulawa kukaKhomo.Ubabaze ukulunga kwakhe wamchaza njengenjini yomndeni wakwaKhomo."Ubelungile loya muntu futhi esiza bonke abantu. Angazi ngampela ukuthi umuntu onjengaloya ubulawa kanjani,'' usho kanje.Uncome indlela abeyazisa ngayo imfundo wathi ubekhipha amangwevu njalo efuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bashaya into ecokeme abafundi bakaGrade 12 bakulesi sikole."Kwesinye isikhathi ubeze akhiphe imali kwelakhe iphakethe efuna ukulekelela abafundi,'' usho kanjena.Uveze ukuthi umfowabo ubezifela nge-African National Congress (ANC) futhi eyilungu lokuqina leSouth South African Democratic Teachers Union (Sadtu)."Ubeze ayikhankasele ngendlela abekade eyithanda ngakhona. Silimele kakhulu ngokubulawa komuntu onjengalona,’’ echaza.Uthe bayile endaweni yesigameko waveza ukuthi umfowabo bamdubule kakhulu ekhanda. "Kusobala ukuthi bebefuna ukuqeda ngempela ngaye,'' esho.Uthe badukuza ebumnyameni ngokubulala kukamfowabo. Ngokusho kwabo asikho isitha abebesazi sikamufi. "Ngabe ngiqamba amanga uma ngingathi kukhona isitha sakhe ebesisazi lapha ekhaya. Kodwa ke kuyacaca ukuthi kukhona abebemdinga efile,’’ esho.Ikhansela lakule ndawo, uMnuz Luthando Jali, lithe ukudutshulwa kukaKhomo kubashiye bethuthumela futhi bedidekile bewumphakathi.Uncome ukulunga kukaKhomo wathi ubengumuntu obelungile kakhulu futhi ebazisa abanye abantu.Uthe ubewumuntu wabantu futhi enombono ojulile kakhulu mayelana nokuthuthukiswa kwesikole abesihola.Nasezinkundleni zokuxhumana abafundi abaningi abake bafunda kulesi sikole bebebaza ukulunga kukaKhomo bencoma nendima ayiklamile ekuthuthukiseni ezemfundo. Bebelimisa ngesihloko elokuthi ufe olwembiza umphakathi waseHammarsdale ngokubulawa kukaKhomo.UMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu Natal ukhiphe isitatimende uqinisekisa ukubulawa kukaKhomo. UNgqongqoshe wezeMfundo KwaZulu Natal uzwakalise ukudumala kakhe ngokubulawa kukaKhomo. Wadlulisa namazwi enduduzo emndenini.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, ukuqinisekisile ukubulawa kukaKhomo.Uthe owesilisa oneminyaka elinganiselwa ku-57 udutshulwe wabulawa esemotweni yakhe esigamekweni esenzeke eMpumalanga, eHammarsdale."Lo obulewe uthole ukudubuleka ezindaweni ezahlukene emzimbeni wakhe. Inhloso yokubulawa kwakhe beyingakaziwa,'' usho kanjena.
ISILO uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini, sifuna kuphenywe izinsolo zokunyamalala kukaR41 million esikhwameni esigade umhlaba kaZulu, iNgonyama Trust.Imbube ihlela ukuqoka uphenyo oluzimele oluzopequlula ngokusebenza kwezimali zeNgonyama Trust.Lokhu sikuvezwe ezincwadini esiyibhalele ibhodi leNgonyama Trust, kanye nesiyibhalele uNgqongqoshe wezeMihlaba nokuThuthukiswa kweziNdawo zasemaKhaya, uMnuz Mzwanele Nyhontso.INdlulamithi yamakhosi iyona engusihlalo webhodi leNgonyama Trust, inobudlelwano obungebuhle nebhodi elaqokwa ngo-2023.Encwadini iSilo esiyibhekise kuNyhontso, sithe sekukaningi sicela ibhodi leNgonyama Trust ukuba lisihlinzeke ngemibiko yokusebenza kwezimali zesikhwama. "Ibhodi lihlulekile ukunginika le mibiko nokwenza ukuthi kube nzima kumina njengosihlalo ukuba ngichazele umnyango wakho nePhalamende ukuthi izimali zesikhwama zisebenze kanjani. Lokhu abakwenzayo kuphambene nemithetho elawula ukuphathwa kwezimali futhi iphazamisa ukusebenza kwami. Yingakho ngifuna ukuthatha izinyathelo ngokushesha.”ISilo sithe sifuna uphenyo lupequlule ukungena nokuphuma kwezimali esikhwameni kanye nokuphathwa kwazo."Nginxusa ukuba ungeseke kulesi sinqumo engisithathile. Umthetho uyangivumela ukuba ngithathe lesi sinqumo ngaphandle kokukhuluma nawe. Kodwa ngibone kubalulekile ukuba ngikwazise ngaphambi kokuba ngiqoke inkampani ezophenya. Lokhu ngikwenzela ukuthi ngifuna sihambisane kulolu hambo, ngifuna futhi ukuthi zilandelwe zonke izincomo zophenyo.”Encwadini esiyibhaleli ibhodi, iSilo sazise ibhodi ukuthi sizojuba uphenyo. Siphinde sachazela leli bhodi ukuthi silifaka ngaphansi komlawuli.Encwadini, iMbube iveze ukuthi isiqoke ummeli, uMnuz Stephen Jabulani Rakwena, wenkampani iVan Ransburg Kruger Rakwena Attorneys, ukuba azobukisisa ukuphathwa kwezimali."UNyhontso sengimazisile ngesinqumo sami. Lesi sinyathelo engisithathile siyaphuthuma ngendlela eyisimanga. Njengosihlalo weNgonyama Trust ngihlalelwe umsebenzi wokuqinisekisa ukuthi izimali zesikhwama ziphathwa ngendlela.”Izinhlaka zikahulumeni ezahlukene okubalwa iPhalamende, azeneme ngokuphathwa kwezimali kwiNgonyama Trust.Eqhulwini kokungenami ukunyamalala kukaR41 million okufanele uthuthukise izizwe zamakhosi.Ikomiti lasePhalamende elibhekelele ukusebenza koMnyango wezeMihlaba nokuThuthukiswa kweziNdawo zasemaKhaya lisanda kuzwakalisa ukukhathazeka ngokwehluleka kweNgonyama Trust ukuletha ngesikhathi imibiko yokusebenza kwezimali.Usihlalo wekomiti, uMnuz Albert Mncwango, uthe sekujwayelekile ukuthi iNgonyama Trust ingayilethi ngesikhathi imibiko yokusebenza kwezimali.Uthe bathathe isinqumo sokuba beze KwaZulu-Natal, bezozizwela ngezinkinga ezibhekene nalesikhwama.
AWUSIZWA umndeni isixoliso selungu laso eligixabezwe odilikajele abahlanu, emva kokuvuma amacala okubulala izihlobo zalo elazibhokoda ngommese eBethany, eBergville, ngo-Okthoba, nonyaka.UMhlengi Khoza (28) ugwetshwe yiNkantolo eNkulu yaseMgungundlovu, ngoLwesihlanu, emuva kokuthi egonyulukile wavuma amacala wase ecela intethelelo emndenini wakhe.Egonyuluka, uKhoza usole ukuthi kukhona owafaka okuthile esiphuzweni sakhe ejoyintini ayebuka khona ibhola ngosuku olwandulela olwesigameko.Ngosuku lwesigameko u-Okthoba 12, uthe wayekubo, kwafika ubabekazi wakhe ebavakashele nomndeni wakhe.Uqhube wathi babehleli egumbini lokuphumula ngesikhathi unina emnika ukudla, wadinwa wakwenqaba ngoba esola umzali wakhe ngokumthakatha."Ngaya ekhishini ngahosha ummese ngabuya ngagwaza izihlobo zami okungowesilisa oyedwa, ababili besifazane nezingane ezimbili. Ngaqeda lapho, ngabaleka endaweni ngiphethe ummese engangiwusebenzisile,” kuchaza uKhoza.Uvumile ukuthi ayekade ekwenza kwakuphambene nomthetho futhi uyaxolisa ngaso uyazisola.UNksz Phindile Khoza ongudadewabo kaKhoza, owasinda ngokulambisa nengane yakhe, uthe okwamanje akalwemukeli uxolo lukamfowabo."Ngisabuzwa ubuhlungu namanje. Umama useluleme futhi uyajabula ngoba unikezwe isigwebo esimfanele, ngeke esaphuma (ejele) eze kuthina,” kusho uNksz Khoza.Uveze nokuthi bewumndeni bebehlalele ovalweni lokuthi angase aphume.Uzichithile njengamampunge izinsolo ezenziwe uKhoza zokuthi unina wayemthakatha, ethi ubesemane enza izaba nje enkantolo, ecabanga ukuthi izomdabukela bese imthambisela isigwebo."Asikwazi thina lokho ukuthi umama wayethakatha, sikuqala ngaye. Ngonyaka ozayo sifuna ashushiselwe nalawa amanye amacala okuzama ukubulala umama nengane,” kubeka uNksz Khoza ezwakala ukuthi ukhululekele ngaphakathi emoyeni.Enkantolo umshushisi, u-Advocate Zinhle Sokhela, ufundele inkantolo izitatimende zemindeni yalabo ababulawa.Izingane zomunye owababulawa, zithe unina wayengumuntu onothando. Ziveze nokuthi seziphila ngokusokola, ukuswela nokuthuthumela futhi isithombe sesidumbu sikanina wazo esasidindilizile siyohlala sisemqonqweni wazo.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi uKhoza wayibonga ibheyili ngo-Okthoba, evele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseBergville. Okhulumela uphiko lezokushushisa i-National Prosecuting Authority KwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Natasha Ramkisson-Kara, uncome umsebenzi wethimba labashushisi namaphoyisa, engeza ngokuthi wumsebenzi wabo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abagilwa bathola ubulungiswa."Sinethemba lokuthi izigwebo ezifana nalezi, zizoveza ukuzimisela kwethu empini yobugebengu,” kusho i-NPA
UMPHENYI omkhulu ecaleni lokubulawa kukaSenzo Meyiwa uphinde wagcizelela ukuthi bukhona ubufakazi bokuthi uKelly Khumalo ungungqondongqondo ekuhlelweni kwetulo.UGininda ubephekwa ngemibuzo ngummeli womsolwa wesihlanu kuleli cala, u-Advocate Zandile Mshololo, omele uFisokuhle Ntuli.UMshololo ulandela uzakwabo, u-Advocate Zithulele Nxumalo, omele umsolwa wesineEkhuluma eNkantolo eNkulu yasePitoli, izolo, uMshololo uthe uNtuli uzokuphika ukuthi waba wumbimbi nasolwa naye ngesikhathi kuhlelwa ukubulawa kwalo nozinti ehostela laseBasuthu, ngo-Okthoba 26, 2014 njengoba kubikiwe enkantolo.UGininda ukugcizelele ukuthi bukhona ubufakazi obuthi uNtuli wahlangana nozakwabo bayobulala uMeyiwa maqede babuyela ehostela. Uthe okufakazela lokho amazibithi uHH noJJ. "Okunye okutholakalayo kuJJ, izinsolo ezithi ungqondongqondo wakho konke lokhu nguNksz Kelly Khumalo. Okunye okusekela lokhu, ingxoxo eyatholwa ngungoti wamaselula ngezingcingo ezenziwa eziyamanisa umsolwa wesihlanu noNksz Kelly Khumalo," usho kanje.UGininda uthe abasolwa babaleka ngemoto iVW Polo, kodwa uMshololo wathi uNtuli akakaze washayela imoto yalolu hlobo.
UCHAZWE njengeqhawe umholi we-MK KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Canaan Mdletshe, oshone engozini yomgwaqo.Okhulumela i-MK, uMnuz Nhlamulo Ndhlela, uthe balahlekelwe umholi obezinikele ekulwelweni abantu abahlwempu.UMdletshe obeyingxenye yethimba lesikhashana elihola i-MK KwaZulu-Natal, ushone engozini yomgwaqo emehlele eJozini.UMdletshe uficwe ile ngozi ephuma kokhankasela ukhetho lokuchibiyela obeluseMtubatuba.UNdhlela uthe uMdletshe ubezinikele kakhulu emsebenzini wakhe."Umkhonto wegwala ufela etsheni, uMdletshe ubengelona igwala. Wathatha owakhe umkhonto, walwela abantu bakuleli abahlwempu nabanganakiwe. Asisoze siwakhohlwe amagalelo akhe.”UNdhlela uthe basashaqekile ngokushona kukaMdlesthe."Ayikhulumeki le ndaba. Sifisa ukudlulisa amazwi enduduzo emndenini wakhe. Sifisa ukuwuqinisekisa umndeni ukuthi sizoweseka kulesi sikhathi esinzima.”Kuthiwa uMdletshe ubehamba yedwa emotweni ngesikhathi ehlelwa ingozi.UMdletshe ushona nje, amalungu e-MK alungiselela umcimbi wokugubha unyaka kwasungulwa le nhlangano.Umcimbi wokugubha unyaka kwasungulwa i-MK uzokuba ngesonto elizayo, eMoses Mabhida.UMdletshe usanda kuqokelwa ethimbeni elihola i-MK KwaZulu-Natal, lapho efike wanikezwa khona umsebenzi wokuxhumanisa le nhlangano nabezindaba.Wajoyina i-MK emva kokulaxaza i-NFP, emva kwesinqumo sayo sokujoyina uhulumeni wokubambisana ophethe isifundazwe iKwaZulu-Natal.UMdlesthe wakhala ngesinqumo se-NFP sokukhetha ukusebenzisana ne-DA, akhala ngokuthi sicindezela abantu abamnyama.UMdletshe wayefuna ukuthi i-NFP ibambisan ne-MK, okuyiyo eyathola izihlalo eziningi esiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal.Phambilini, uMdletshe wayengunobhala jikelele we-NFP, nokuyisikhundla aqokelwa kuso engqungqutheleni yokukhatha ubuholi eyayingo-2019.Akazange ahlale ngokunethezeka kuleso skhundla ngenxa yombango wobuholi, njengoba ubuholi aqokwa nabo bahlakazwa yisinqumo senkantolo ngo-2021.UMdlesthe uke wakhulumela umholi we-NFP ongasekho, uNkk Zanele kaMagwaza-Msibi, kanti phambilini wayekade eyintatheli.Akusikhona okokuqala amalungu e-MK eshona engozini yemoto.Kuwo lo nyaka kwashona amalungu e-MK ayisithupha ayebheke emcimbini wokubungaza usuku lokuzalwa likaNkk Sizakele MaKhumalo Zuma, owunkosikazi womholi we-MK, uMnuz Jacob Zuma.La malungu e-MK ayesuka eMtshezi, asha angqongqa ngesikhathi itekisi ayeyigibele igingqika ngaseKranskop.Naye uZuma uke wabandakanyeka engozini yemoto ngesikhathi kubhekwe okhethweni, kodwa akangalimala.
UNGQONGQOSHE woMnyango wokuThuthukisa amaBhizinisi amaNcane ezweni, uNkk Stella Ndabeni-Abrahams, udalule ukuthi bazoba enkingeni abantu bakuleli zwe abasiza abantu bokufika ngokuthi benze amabhizinisi ngokumthetho ezweni.Usho kanjalo izolo ekhuluma nabezindaba emva kokuvula ngokusemthethweni umcimbi wombukiso wosomabhizinisi, iDurban Business Fair, ebuya ihlandla lesi-26 kulo nyaka, wohlelo i-Inner West, e-Anderson Sportsground, ePinetown.UNkk Ndabeni-Abrahams uthe kuyabakhathaza ukuthi nakuba esengaphezu kwa-2 000 amabhizinisi eThekwini, asukumele phezulu ekhelweni likaMengameli Wezwe lokuthi abhaliswe ngokusemthethweni, kodwa kubaphatha kabi ukuthi awu-5% kuphela aholwa ngabantu bakuleli zwe, kuthi wonke lawa amanye angabokufika kanti iningi labo lisizwe yizakhamuzi zezwe."Ngixwayisa bonke abantu bakuleli zwe abephula umthetho ngokubhalisa amabhizinisi abo sengathi bazenzela bona, kanti yindlela yokusiza abantu bokufika ukuthi babe namabhizinisi kuleli zwe ngokungemthetho. Lokho kuphambene nomthetho ngoba umuntu ovumeleke ukuba nebhizinisi ezweni wodabuka kulona, nokuleli zwe ngokusemthethweni,” kuchaza uNgqongqoshe.UNGQONGQOSHE woMnyango wokuThuthukisa amaBhizinisi amaNcane, uNkk Stella Ndabeni-Abrahams, noSihlalo weKomiti lokuThuthukisa umnotho kuMasipala weTheku, iKhansela Thembo Ntuli, bevula ngokusemthethweni umcimbi wombukiso wosomabhizinisi izolo, e-Anderson Sportsground, ePinetown Isithombe: SIMANGALISO NTSHANGASEEqhuba, wexwayise ngokuthi bonke abantu abephula umthetho bazobhekana nezinyathelo zomthetho, njengoba yena nethimba lakhe sebeqalile uhlelo lokuhlonza ukuthi laba bantu bokufika abanamabhizinisi ngokumthetho, bangobani futhi badabuka kumaphi amazwe ukuze kubhekwane nabo ngqo."Lokho sikwenza ngoba sifuna ukuvikela abantu bakuleli zwe futhi siqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu onebhizinisi ezweni uthola ithuba lokuchuma ngalo, angaphazanyiswa ngabantu bakwamanye amazwe, abasizwa yizakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika ukwenza lokho,” kusho uNkk Ndabeni-Abrahams.Uthe nokho kumjabulisile ukubona osomabhizinisi bemikhakha namakhono ahlukene, behlangene ukuzokhangisa ngamabhizinisi abo. Lokhu kuzosiza babe ethubeni elihle lokuchuma futhi basizakale nangokudoba amakhasimende amasha.Izinhlelo ezahlukene zomcimbi ziyaqhubeka namhlanje nakusasa, kanti kulindeleke ukuthi baqhubeke nokuthuthelana osomabhizinisi abangaphezu kwa-80 abazokhangisa kuwona.
UMNYANGO wezokuThutha KwaZulu-Natal ufuna ukunciphisa izibalo zezingozi zomgwaqo zamaholidi kakhisimusi ngo-5% esifundazweni.Lokhu kudalulwe nguMphathiswa womnyango, uMnuz Siboniso Duma izolo eVan Reenen’s Pass, ngesikhathi kwethulwa ngokusemthethweni umkhankaso wezokuphepha emgwaqweni ngamaholidi.UDuma uthe, bathe uma bebuka izibalo zeminyaka emibili edlule u-2022/2023 no-2023/2024, babona ukuthi zakhombisa ukwenyuka.Uthe ngo-2022/2023, kwaba nezingozi ezingu-201, ezadlula nemiphefumullo yabantu abangu-240.Kwathi ngo-2023/2024 kwaba nezingozi ezingu-206, ezadlula nemiphefumulo yabangu-250."Lokhu kusho ukunyuka kwesibalo ngo-2.49% ngo-2022/2023 uma uqhathanisa nonyaka ongaphambi kwalowo, kwathi ngonyaka odlule, sanyuka ngo-4.17% uma uqhathanisa nesangonyaka ongaphambi kwalowo,” kusho uDuma.Uqhube wathi ngokocwaningo lwabo, bathole ukuthi izingozi ezinyantisa igazi zenzeka phakathi kuka-6 ekuseni kuya ku-10 ekuseni, ziphinde zenzeke phakathi kuka-7 ebusuku kuya ku-1 entathakusa.Uthe kuzo zonke, imbangela kusuke kuwukugijima ngesivinini eseqile, ukushayela uphuzile, ukukhathala nokuhamba ngezimoto ezingekho esimweni esikahle.Udalule ukuthi angu-2 745 amaphoyisa azotshalwa ezindaweni ezehlukene zesifundazwe bese kwengezwa izimoto zawo ezingu-808."Usuku nosuku sizobe sisemgwaqweni, sinkanise ikhona, nekhona ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imithetho yomgwaqo iyahlonishwa,” kuxwayisa uDuma.Uveze nokuthi eVan Reenen’s Pass, bazoba nesiteshi samaphoyisa esingumahamba nendlwana ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ezokuphepha zisezingeni eliphezulu.UDuma uqhube wathi babonile ukuthi ziningi izingozi ezenzeka kule ndawo, okuthi uma sezenzekile, kube nzima ukuthi amaphoyisa asheshe afike khona."Yingakho sibone ukuthi akuvele kube khona isiteshi esingumahamba nendlwana esizosibeka kule ndawo ukuze uma kwenzeka ingozi, amaphoyisa asheshe afike ngoba azobe esuka eduzane,” kusho uDuma.Uthe nyakenye kwashona abangu-14 eVan Reenen’s Pass ezingozini, wathi okunye okudala lokhu ukuthi lo mgwaqo uvele ube nesiminyaminya sezimoto eziningi ezihamba kuwo ngamaholidi.Wexwayise ngokuthi bazoba nanezivimba mgwaqo ezindaweni ezehlukene, wanxusa abasebenzisa umgwaqo ukuthi baziphathe kahle, bayihloniphe imithetho yomgwaqo, kungenjalo, bazolutheza olunenkume.
UMHLAZIYI wezepolitiki ubona ukungenzi kahle kwe-MK okhethweni lokuchibiyela obelungoLwesithathu, kuyizinkomba zokuthi seliphelile isasasa elaholela ekutheni leli qembu eliholwa owayengumengameli, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, limangaze abantu abaningi ngesikhathi kunokhetho lukazwelonke.Umhlaziyi wezepolitiki waseNyuvesi yaKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Zakhele Ndlovu, uthe abantu abaningi abavotela i-MK okhethweni lwangoMeyi, bayivotela ngoba kwakunesasasa ngeqembu elisha eliholwa owayengumengameli.I-MK ayizange inqobe ngisho eyodwa i-ward okhethweni lokuchibiyela obeluthe chithi saka kuzwelonke, ngoLwesithathu.Okhethweni lokuchibiyela obeluKwaZulu-Natal, kuMasipala waseNkosi Mtubatuba, i-MK ikhombise ukwehlelwa ukwesekwa.Le nhlangano ithole u-13% ngesikhathi kunokhetho lokuchibiyela ku-ward 16.Ngesikhathi kunokhetho lwangoMeyi i-MK yathola u-36% wamavoti kule ward.Kugcine kunqoba i-IFP, ebivele iphethe kule ndawo.UNdlovu uthe uma kuwukhetho lohulumeni basekhaya abantu abayi ngesasasa."Abantu bayazi ukuthi isasasa ngeke libasize ngalutho, babheka kakhulu izidingo zabo endaweni. Abantu bafuna ukuhlinzekwa ngamanzi, ugesi, ukusikelwa utshani nokunye. Ingakho abantu bayaye babheke iqembu elinomlando uma bezovota okhethweni lohulumeni basekhaya. Ingakho eMtuba bevotele i-IFP ngoba sebeyayazi.”UNdlovu uthe enye inkinga ukuthi abantu abamela i-MK okhethweni lokuchibiyela kabaziwa."Enye inkinga ukuthi i-MK iyona eyathola amavoti amaningi lapha KwaZulu-Natal ngesikhathi kunokhetho lwangoMeyi, kodwa akuyona ephethe uhulumeni wesifundazwe. Yehluleka ukuheha amanye amaqembu ukuthi asebenzisane nayo. Lokhu kungenza ukuthi umuntu owayekade eyivotelile ngoMeyi, azibuze ukuthi kungani kufanele aqhubeke nokuyivotela uma ingaphethe ekubeni yavotelwa ngobuningi? Bahlulwa ukwenza into elula.”Uphiko lwentsha kwi-IFP KwaZulu-Natal, i-IFP Youth Brigade, lubonge bonke abavotele i-IFP.Usihlalo wophiko esifundazweni, uMnuz Mncedisi Maphisa, uthe ukunqoba kwe-IFP kuzoqinisekisa ukuqhubeka kokuhanjiswa kwezidingo.Okhethweni lokuchibiyela obelukwezinye izifundazwe, i-ANC inqobe ezindaweni eziningi.Le nhlangano inqobe kuma-ward angu-10 kwangu-12 akuMasipala waseThabazimbi, eLimpopo.Lo mkhandlu wahlakazwa emva kombango wangaphakathi.Inhlangano i-Labour Party ne-DA banqobe i-ward iqembu ngalinye kulo mkhandlu.Okhulumela i-ANC, uNkk Mahlengi Bhengu-Motsiri, uthe ukunqoba kwe-ANC kuma-ward amaningi kukhombisa ukuthi abantu basakholelwa kule nhlangano.
AMANAZARETHA aseGinyezinye ngaphansi komholi walolu hlangothi lwakaShembe, Inkosi uMudliwamafa Shembe, akhala ngoNgqongqoshe wezamaPhoyisa, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, ngokuwenzela phansi odabeni lokunyuka intaba iNhlangakazi njengoba esezonyuka kugcina kunezinye izinhlangothi.Lokhu kuza emva kwesinqumo seNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini esiyalele ukuthi abaseGinyezinye bazonyuka kugcina kade kuyibona abebesekuqaleni ohlwini ngaphambi kokuthi kufakwe isicelo enkantolo.UNgqongqoshe wezamaPhoyisa ubefake isicelo ngohlelo abelwenzile lokuthi izinhlangothi zakwaShembe zizoshintshana kanjani ukunyuka intaba.UMvangeli Doda Ngcobo okhulumela abaseGinyezinye, uthe benzelwe phansi amaphoyisa ngokuthi bagcine bebekwe ekugcineni ekunyukeni intaba."Okwenzeke enkantolo sikuthatha njengesekisi nje futhi ungqongqoshe uyena osenzele phansi. Uhambise uhlu obelusibeka phezulu ukuthi yithina esizonyuka kuqala kodwa uma sesiguqulwa yinkantolo lesi sinqumo, akabange esaya enkantolo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kuhamba ngokohlelo lwakhe. "Thina besingazange sifake maphepha okuphikisa udaba oluyiswe enkantolo kodwa ijaji lavele lanquma ngaphandle kokubheka zonke izinhlangothi. Nakhona linqume lisebenzisa umlando wokuthi laba abanyuka kuqala bavunwa wumlando wokuthi ibandla elasekuPhakameni, ngakho kumele kube yibona abanyuka kuqala. Njengoba linqume ngalolu hlobo nathi sinawo umlando osivunayo ukuthi sibe ngabesibili ukunyuka intaba njengoba sebesibeke ekugcineni nje,” kusho uNgcobo.Uthe ngokomlando bona bebeba ngabesithathu ukunyuka intaba belandela abaseBuhleni."Njengoba abaseBuhleni sebathatha isinqumo sokuthi banyuke eyabo intaba, lokho kusenza sibe ngabesibili ukunyuka intaba. Ukube besiwafakile amaphepha lokho bekuzovela. Ingakho sithi ijaji alikubhekanga lokho ngoba bekumele liwafune amaphepha aqhamuka ohlangothini lwethu ukuze bezwe uvo lwethu njengoba lithathe isinqumo lisebenzisa umlando wabasekuPhakameni abathi kufanele banyuke kuqala ngezizathu abazibekile,” usho kanje.Ijaji ebelisingethe leli cala liphinde lanxusa ukuthi zonke izinhlangothi ziluxoxe zodwa lolu daba ukuqhamuka nesixazululo ngezinhlelo zeminyaka elandelayo njengoba selinqumile ngohlelo lwangonyaka ozayo.UMvangeli Ngcobo uthe ngeke bakwazi ukuthi babe yingxenye yezingxoxo ezizoyiswa kumxazululi ngoba nazo zizodla imali yabazalwane kungenasidingo. Uthe bona bahlangene ngokukholwa futhi abajatshuliswa ukuhamba amacala azodla imali yabazalwane kungenasidingo. Uthe okusezinhlelweni zabo ukuthi bafake isicelo sokubuyekeza lolu daba ngonyaka ozayo uma sekubuywa entabeni. UMchunu usanda kuzihlangula emsakazweni Ukhozi FM, wathi akangene ngqo odabeni lwakaShembe kepha amaphoyisa asebenzisa isikhundla sakhe ezintweni zasenkantolo njengoba kunguye ophethe umnyango.Ngokohlelo olusha emva kwesinqumo senkantolo, abasekuPhakameni abaholwa yiNkosi Vukile Shembe Incoyincoyi, bazonyuka ngoJanuwari 2, babuye ngoJanuwari 8, abaseBuhleni abaholwa yiNkosi uMduduzi Shembe uNyazilwezulu, bazonyuka ngoJanuwari 5, baze babuye ngoJanuwari 24, kuthi abaseThembezinhle abaholwa yiNkosi Phinda Shembe Ukukhanyakwelanga, banyuke ngoJanuwari 9, babuye ngomhlaka 15, bese kugcina iGinyezinye eholwa iNkosi Mudliwamafa Shembe ezonyuka ngoJanuwari 16, ibuye ngomhlaka 22.
BAMASHE ngapheshela kwe-Durban City Hall benqunu abebengabasebenzi be-Expanded Public Works Programme (EPWP) abalinganiselwa ku-150 abayingxenye yabangu-4 000 abamiswa emsebenzini ngoJulayi, nonyaka.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi akade bemasha bebesebenza ezindaweni ezehlukene ngaphansi kukaMasipala weTheku.Umholi wabo, uNksz Slindile Sokhela, uthe njengoba bemasha benqunu nje, lokhu kuwuphawu lokuthi bahlukumezekile emqondweni.Uthe laba abamashayo sebexoshwe nawomastende ngenxa yokuthi kabasasebenzi, kabanayo imali yokurenta.Elandisa ngodaba lwabo, uthe ngesikhathi bemiswa emsebenzini abazange baziswe kusanesikhathi ukuthi umsebenzi uzophela."Savuka ekuseni seza emsebenzini, safike satshelwa ukuthi umsebenzi usuphelile. Alikho ithuba abasinikeza lona ukuthi nathi sihlele izinto zethu. Satshelwa ukuthi imali iphelile emkhandlwini, ayisekho imali yokusiholela,” echaza.Uthe kuthe kusenjalo, babona sekuqashwa abanye abantu ezikhundleni zabo."Kwaqashwa abantu abangu-800, sabona ke kuthi akusilo iqiniso ukuthi imali ayikho kodwa inkinga yithina. Abanye bazame ngisho ukuzibulala ngenxa yalesi simo,” usho kanje.Uveze ukuthi babe nomhlangano neMeya yeTheku, uMnuz Cyril Xaba, ngoJulayi, wabathembisa ukuthi kuzoba yinyanga eyodwa kuphela bengasebenzi, bese beyabuyiselwa.Uthe bebona kuhamba isikhathi, bazamile ukubuyela kuyena kodwa wabaziba. Uthe emveni kwalokho, banikele kuNdunankulu wesifundazwe, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, bathola ukuthi naye uXaba uyambalekela.Ukhale ngosizi athe lubengeme njengoba bebhekene nengwadla yokungasebenzi."Usibulele siphila umasipala ngendlela owenze ngayo. Sesiphila njengabantu bokufika ezweni lethu. Sifuna umkhandlu wenze ubulungiswa, sibuyiselwe emsebenzini ngoba kusobala ukuthi imali ikhona emkhandlwini,” usho kanje.Uzwakalise ukungenami ngokuthi abaqashiwe manje bahola imali ephindaphindiwe kule bona ebebeyihola."Laba abaqashiwe baholelwa u-R12 000 ekubeni thina besiholelwa u-R3 500 kuphela,” echaza.Ukhale ngokuthi bese beneminyaka eyevile engu-10 besebenzela umkhandlu weTheku.
KUZOBASHELA abantu bakuleli ababhalisela abantu bokufika izipaza njengoba bezobhekana ngqo nophiko oluqoqa intela kuleli i-SARS nabezomthetho.Lesi sexwayiso sikhishwe nguNgqongqoshe eHhovisi likaMengameli, uNksz Khumbudzo Ntshavheni, ekhuluma nabezindaba eKapa, izolo, emva komhlangano weKhabhinethi.Uthe umthetho ucacile ukuthi uma ungowokufika kuleli, kumele uveze ubufakazi bokuthi utshale u-R5 million, kulelo bhizinisi."Akubona kuphela abantu bokufika ababhalisa izipaza komasipala. Kulokhu, bebambisene netsha yendawo, benze umbukiso wefilimu efundisa ngokongiwa kwemvelo. Batshala nezihlahla,” kusho uNksz Luthuli.Lezi zivakashi ezivela ezindaweni ezehlukene emhlabeni wonke, ziye zenze izinto ezehlukene ukuzijabulisa ezintabeni zoKhahlamba.Phakathi kwazo ukuqwala izintaba, ukubuka izimpophoma ezehlukene ezikhona kulezi zintaba, ukulala esigangeni njalo njalo."Izivakashi zethu azigcini nje ngokuthi zishaywe umoya ezindaweni zethu, kodwa ziphinde zixhase omama bendawo, abenza umsebenzi wezandla, ziwuthenge.Emalini abayikhokha esangweni uma befika, siphinde siyithathe, siyokwenza imisebenzi ehlukene yomphakathi,” kusho uNksz Luthuli.
KUKHALWA ngokufa konembeza kubantu besilisa, amaphoyisa aKwaZulu-Natal, ededela izibalo ezishaqisayo zababoshelwe amacala okudlwengula abesifazane nezingane ngoNovemba.Ngokusho kokhulumela amaphoyisa esifundazweni, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, bangu-235 ababoshelwe amacala okudlwengula ngenyanga edlule.Umsunguli wenhlangano engenzi nzuzo, elwela abesifazane nezingane, uThingo Crisis Centre, uNksz Sbo Ngcobo, uthe isifundazwe sinenkinga yokuba nenqwaba yabesilisa abangenawo unembeza.Uthe ikhona nekhona lesifundazwe linomuntu wesilisa okuthola kulula ukuthi adlwengule umuntu wesifazane nengane."Isimo sibi kangangokuthi sesinabantu besilisa abathi uma bexabene nezinqandamathe zabo, bakhiphele isibhongo ezinganeni zabo bazidlwengule ngenhloso yokuzwisa ophathina babo ubuhlungu,” kusho uNksz Ngcobo.Uthe kokunye basuke baliwe ngonina bezingane zabo, abesilisa abadlwengula lezi zingane, bese bekhiphela isibhongo kuzo.Uqhube wathi okunye akubonayo ukuphela kobuntu kwabesilisa."Umuntu usethi uma ebuka ingane kamakhelwane wakhe noma eyasendaweni, kanjalo nowesifazane ongumakhelwane noma wendawo, angambuki njengesihlobo sakhe kodwa ambone njengomuntu angamdlwengula,” usho kanjena.Uqhube wathi akubuyekezwe izinhlelo ezizobhekana ngqo nentukuthelo egcwele kubantu besilisa, ukuze kuliwe nomnyombo wesihlava.UNksz Ngcobo uthe imikhankaso yezinhlangano nohulumeni iyawenza umehluko kodwa wathi ukhalo luselude. Uqhube wathi abesifazane nezingane kabakhululekile nhlobo, wakhala nangokungahlinzekwa kwabophiko oluphenya amacala okuhlukunyezwa ngokocansi ngezinsiza-kusebenza ezanele.Uthe useneminyaka eyevile kwewu-25 esebenzisana nabaphenyi balolu phiko, ekubonela eduze ukushoda kwabaphenyi, izimoto zokusebenza nokunye."Kwenza ukuphenya kwabo amacala kuhambe ngonyawo lonwabu. Kokunye lokhu kuholela ekutheni amacala angabi nabo ubufakazi obenele uma esefika ezinkantolo. Kwesinye isikhathi bathathe isikhathi eside ukufinyelela kubagilwa, kuze kuba ukuthi bayaliphonsa ithawula bengabutholile ubulungiswa ngokuhlukunyezwa kwabo.” Nokho uthe indlela asebenza ngayo uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa eKZN, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, ibuyisa ithemba lokuthi ubugebengu buzoya ngokuya behla.Uphinde wakhala ngokusebenza kwezinkantolo, ethi ukudedela kwazo abasolwa ngokudlwengula kuyabenza abagilwa balahlekelwe yithemba.Ubuye wakhala nangodilikajele okugwetshwa ngawo abalahlwe amacala, ethi uma ubalisisa kahle iminyaka yakhona, kungabe iwudilikajele ngempela yini?Ocubungula izigameko zokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane, uNkk Lisa Vetten, uthe ubuningi bezigameko zokudlwengulwa kwabesifazane nezingane ezindaweni zasemjondolo kungenza ukuthi kubangelwa ukungaqini kwezokuphepha kulezi zindawo."Kulula ukuthi umuntu akhahlele umnyango angene, adlwengule. Akukhanyi ugesi, umuntu ubanjwa kahle ebumnyameni. Akufani nasesilungwini lapho ezokuphepha ziqinile, abantu bahlala ezindlini ezikhiywa kahle, imizi ebiyiwe, kuphinde kube nonogada abazungezayo emigwaqweni,” kusho uNkk Vetten.Uthe notshwala bunomthelela ekwenzekeni kwalezi zigameko emalokishini nasemijondolo ngoba budayiswa budlabha, akekho onakekela ukuqiniswa kwemithetho elawula ukudayiswa kwabo kulezi zindawo.Uthe uhulumeni uhluleke wancama ukwenza umsebenzi wokulwa nobugebengu.

Abantu abakwazi ukuhlala ngokukhululeka uma kuzovele kungene umuntu, behlezi endlini, afike avulele ngenhlamvu. Le nto ivezae uZulu kabi kwezinye izizwe. Iveza uZulu njengesizwe esazi ukubulalana kuphela.”UMhlongo uthe akusilo ihostela laseVosloorus kuphela elingenalo uzinzo."Siyile naseThokoza, safike sathola ukuthi nakhona alukho uzinzo. Usuku nosuku kubulawa umuntu. Abantu babulawa ebusuku.”UMhlongo uthe okubakhathaza kakhulu ukuthi isikhathi esiningi igcina ingatholakalanga imbangela yokubulawa kwabantu."Uma usuthi uyalandela, awulitholi iqiniso. Kokunye kusuke kuyintuthu esuka le emakhaya.”UMhlongo uthe balinde ukuthi uNdunankulu kaZulu ayokhulekela imbizo eSilweni."Le nto kufanele ikhulunywe yizo zonke izinhlaka. Kufanele kube khona amakhosi, izinduna zamabutho, izimeya nezinye izinhlaka.”UButhelezi useqoke ithimba lezinduna elizobheka ukusebenza kwebutho eGauteng.Ithimba lezinduna laqokwa emhlanganweni wangoMgqibelo.

Konke lokhu sikususela ekufiseni ukuthi umlando weNgonyama ungashabalali, ikakhululazi iNgonyama ibuse iminyaka eminingi, yabona nezinguquko ezilethwe yizinkathi ezehlukene ephile ngazo. Konke lokho kuzokwenziwa kuhlanganiswa nosuku lweNgonyama uMdlokombane.”

UZOFIHLWA ngoMgqibelo emathuneni asekhaya oHlange, emva kwenkonzo ezoba senkundleni yezemidlalo iJL Dube, umzukulu kaDkt John Langalibalele Dube, ongasekho, uMnuz Zenzele Mfundo "States” Dube.UDube (72) obehlala ekhaya elikhulu lalo mndeni elisoHlange, eNanda, udlule emhlabeni esibhedlela saseThekwini iCity, ngoMgqibelo.Ngokusho kukamfowabo, uMnuz Lunga Dube, umufi athe ugule inyanga yonke, ubenesifo sezinso.Uthe umufi bazomkhumbula ngothando lwentsha nezwe laseNingizimu Afrika. Ubehlala ahlale ayiqoqe, abe nezingxoxo ezakhayo nayo,” kubeka uDube.UMNUZ Zenzele Mfundo 'States’ DubeUthe wamfuza wangamshiya uMafukuzela, ngokungasabi nokungabi namahloni ngokuhola phambili, ukuhlonipha abantu nokunye,” kusho uDube.Uthe bewumndeni balimele kakhulu ngokuhamba kwakhe.USihlalo we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Siboniso Duma nabanye abaholi benhlangano, bahambe bayohlanganisa amehlo nomndeni ngoLwesithathu.USIHLALO we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Siboniso Duma (ongowesibili uma usuka ngakwesokudla) nabanye abaholi benhlangano, bahambe bayohlanganisa amehlo nomndeniEduduza umndeni, uDuma uthe angakusho ukuthi uma kuvuka izivunguvungu, bavuse uJesu, wathi kwesinye isikhathi kuba nzima ukududuza umuntu oshonelwe ngoba usuke ungabuqondi ubuhlungu abhekene nabo."Uye ufise ukuthi uzame (ukududuza) ngamazwi, ufune nezinto ezehlukene ongazisho, kanti uma uthi nivuse uJesu, kusuke sekwanele," kusho uDuma, oqhubeke nokukhumbula amagalelo kamkhulu kamufi enhlanganweni ye-ANC.
UPHUTHUNYISWE esibhedlela exinwe wukugula owesilisa obhekene namacala okuqotha abayisishiyagalolunye eMlaza, ngo-Agasti 2023.UMnuz Sphamandla Dhlomo (25) utheswe amacala okubulala okuhleliwe oMnuz Mlungisi Zuma, Mnuz Phakamani Sibusiso Dlamini, Mnuz Maxwell Sibisi, Mnuz Regional Bongimpilo Ngema, Mnuz Thabani Ngcobo, Mnuz Mhlengi Khathi, Mnuz Ayabongwa Mbayise, Mnuz Sifundo Sibusiso Dlamini noMnuz Sifiso Cele.Ngaphambilini enkantolo, kwavela ukuthi bonke laba ababulawa esigamekweni sango-Agasti, badutshulwa ekhanda nasentanyeni.NgoLwesithathu eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini, bekulindeleke ukuthi kuqale izethulo kodwa kuthe zisuka nje ummeli kaDhlomo, u-Advocate Masibonge Mathomane, wasukuma wacela eJajini uSaphia Steyn ukuba kujike izinhlelo ngoba ummangalelwa engaphilile."Bengicela ukuthi namhlanje lingaqhubeki icala ukuze engimumele ezolashwa abe ngcono,'' kuchaza ummeli.Ngesikhathi echaza kanje ummeli, uDhlomo ubeqhaqhazela, iso lakhe langokwesobunxele livalekile nelinye nalo likhombisa ukuba bomvu. Ubengaliphethe iphepha nepeni okuyinto ebingapheli esandleni sakhe njalo uma eze enkantolo. Akucacanga ukuthi isimo sikaDhlomo sidalwe yini ngoba ubengabukeki engumuntu oshayiwe. Ubethothobele elokhu eqhaqhazela. Isimo sakhe besehluke kakhulu entweni abehlala evela eyiyo enkantolo njengoba ebehlale eziveza njengeshinga ngokubuka abantu kabi futhi engafuni ukuthwetshulwa izithombe ngabezindaba. UMbuso uthe: "Izethulo zanamhlanje kumele zenzeke ephilile ummangalelwa futhi akuqonde kahle konke okuqhubeka enkantolo. Ngakho-ke kuwumbono ophusile ukuthi lihlehle icala.”Ijaji libe selihlehlisela uLwesine icala. Kuvelile ukuthi uDhlomo uzophuthunyiswa esibhedlela esingaphakathi ejele eWestville.Ngaphambilini, uDhlomo ngomlomo wommeli wakhe, watshela inkantolo ukuthi ufakazi kuleli cala, uMnuz Phiwayinkosi Sibisi, wadubula wabulala umfowabo.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi uSibisi wayekade eveze ukuthi umazisi kaDhlomo wawuyisa emaphoyiseni emveni kokuba ethe wawuthola eduze kwezidumbu ezintathu zababulawa bephuma e-tavern ekwa-Q, eMlaza, ngoMashi 27, nyakenye.Kuleso sigameko kwabulawa umfowabo kaDlomo ayekade ehilizisane naye ngayizolo kade bephuza, uMnuz Sakhile Ndlovu. USakhile ungumfowabo kammangalelwa, bazalwa umama oyedwa, bahlukene ngobaba.Abanye ababili ababulawa kuleso sigameko nguMndeni (isibongo sakhe esingatholakalanga) noDani Ndlebe.USibisi waveza ukuthi ngoMashi 26, babephuza kanti kuzosuka uthuthuva phakathi kukaNdlovu noDlomo kubangwa ukuthi kukhona umuntu owafa lapho ababekade beye khona bobabili.USibisi wachaza lesi sigameko sangoMashi njengomnyombo wesigameko sango-Agasti. Waveza ukuthi uDhlomo wahlasela kubo ngo-Agasti ngoba ezofuna ngodli umazisi wakhe.Ekantolo, usizi belubhalwe ebusweni kowesifazane ohlale ephathele uDhlomo opulastiki abanezinto ezimnandi ngesikhathi kuchazwa ngokungaphili kwalo msolwa. Le ntokazi ibingene enkantolo ihefuzela ngaphambi kokuqala kwezinkulumo.
SINQUNYELWE ugwayi katiki isikhwama esixhasa izitshudeni ngemali ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme i-NSFAS, ukuthi sisheshe siphendule izitshudeni ezisuke zifake izimangalo emva kokuchithwa uxhaso.Umbiko woMcwaningi-maBhuku Jikelele othulwe ePhalamende ngoLwesithathu, udalule izinselelo ezibhekene nalesi sikhwama odabeni oluthinta ukuxazula eyezimangalo zezitshudeni njengoba onyakeni wezimali u-2022/2023, zibalelwa ku-195 000 izikhalazo ezafakwa.Uveze ukuthi ukuhamba kancane kwalolu hlelo kwenza ezinye izitshudeni zifake inqwaba yezimangalo njengoba kukhona ezafaka ezingu-70. Udalule nokuthi zingu-26 000 izimangalo ezazikhuluma ngento eyodwa."Ezinye zalezi zimangalo zathatha izinsuku ezingu-205 ukuthi zixazululwe. Ezinye zathatha izinsuku ezingu-465, okusho ukuthi kwaphela ngisho unyaka isitshudeni silinde izimpendulo ngezithinta uxhaso,” kusho abamele uMcwaningi maBhuku jikelele. Lokhu kwenze usihlalo wekomiti loMnyango weMfundo ePhakeme ePhalamende, uMnuz Tebogo Letsie, wathi ezinye zezitshudeni zisuleleka ngezifo ngoba zilala nama-blesser ngoba zilinde umnyama ongenafu kwi-NSFAS."Kuyakhathaza ukuthi kugcina sekuhlupheka izitshudeni, ezinye zixoshwa omastende ebusuku ngenxa yokuthi azikhokhile. Ezinye zangishayela ucingo ebusuku, zithi azinayo indawo yokuhlala ngenxa yokungakhokhelwa yi-NSFAS. Ibuhlungu le nto ngoba kusuke kunemali esiyivotele siyikomiti lasePhalamende ukuthi ikhishelwe izitshudeni, egcina ingafikanga ngesikhathi kuzona,” kusho uLetsie.Uthe ezinye izitshudeni zigcina zenza izinto ezifana nokulala nabantu abazozondla ukuze zikwazi ukuthenga ukudla, nemali yokuphila ngenxa ye-NSFAS.Umlawuli we-NSFAS, uMnuz Freeman Nomvalo, uthe bakhathazekile ngokuhamba kancane kohlelo lokuphendula izitshudeni ezintweni zoxhaso.Uthe yingakho besheshe bevula uhlelo lokuthi kufakwe izicelo ukuze basheshe baziphendule, zithole uxhaso."Ezinye zezitshudeni zimane zilaxaze ukufunda ngenxa yokuthi aziphendulwa ngesikhathi. Senza konke okusemandleni ukuthi siyixazulule le nkinga ebhekana nezitshudeni,” kusho uNomvalo.UNgqongqoshe weMfundo ePhakeme, uDkt Nobuhle Nkabane, uthe sebemi ngomumo ngokusiza izitshudeni ezizofunda ngonyaka ozayo.Uthe lusamile uhlelo lokukhokhela ngqo izitshudeni ngenxa yecala eliqhubekayo eNkantolo e<kulu eWestern Cape."Sibhalele uNgqongqoshe wezoBulungiswa sifuna asheshe aqoke ngokushesha ozohlulela ecaleni elafakwa yinkampani eyayithole umsebenzi wokukhokha imihlomulo yezitshudeni. Sisalinde izimpendulo zokuthi angase aqokwe nini njengoba sanquma ukuthi siziphuce umsebenzi lezi zinkampani,” kusho uDkt Nkabane.Uthe konke abakwenzayo kumele balandele umthetho.Okunye okuvelile ukuthi bambalwa abasebenzi be-NSFAS abasebenza udaba lwezitshudeni ezisuke zifake izikhalazo ekubeni emaningi amacala okumele abhekisiswe bese kukhishwa isinqumo ngawo.

Icala lihlehliselwe uLwesithathu ngesonto elizayo ukuze acele ibheyili,” kusho uBrig Mathe.
