SIHLATSHISWE ikhefu emsebenzini isikhulu esiphezulu esikhungweni esiholela izimpesheni kuleli, i-South African Social Security Agency (Sassa), ukuze kuphenywe indlela esaqashwa ngayo kulesi sikundla.UNgqongqoshe wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi, uNksz Nokuzola Tolashe umhlabise ikhefu emsebenzini uNkk Busisiwe Memela-Khambula.Isikhulu esimisiwe sizoqhubeka siwuthole uphelele umholo waso ngesikhathi sisekhefwini. Kuvele ukuthi isikhulu sizomiswa kuze kuphothulwe uphenyo oluqhubekayo mayelana nokuqashwa kwaso.Izintambo zizobanjwa nguMnuz Themba Matlou, ongumphathi we-Sassa eGauteng, kuze kube luyaphothulwa uphenyo.Esitatimendeni esithunyelwe abezindaba ngoLwesithathu, ungqongqoshe uthe uMvikeli woMphakathi uveze izinto eziningi athe kazihambi kahle ka-Sassa.Uthe yikhona okumenze wasukuma wathatha isinqumo sokumisa uNkk Memela-Khambula."Ngimumise emsebenzini ukuze kungabi khona izithiyo noma ukuphazamiseka ophenyweni oluzobe lwenziwa. Ukumiswa kwakhe emsebenzini kumqoka ukuze kuvikelwe isithunzi se-Sassa,” kusho ungqongqoshe.Uphinde wancoma intobeko ekhonjiswe yisikhulu esimisiwe emsebenzini ngesikhathi sethulelwa izindaba zokuthi siyamiswa. Umnyango uthe isinqumo sikanqongqoshe sithathwe ukuze i-Sassa iqhubeke isebenze kahle futhi sibhekelela izidingo zezigidi zabantu abaphila ngemali yesibonelelo sikahulumeni."Ngesikhathi sisabhekene nezingqinamba ezikhungethe i-Sassa, sifuna ukuthatha izinqumo ezizoqinisekisa ukuthi ukusebenza kwethu kuvulelekile futhi kuba yimpumelelo,” kuchaza ungqongqoshe.Uvale ngokuthi i-Sassa iyisikhungo sikahulumeni aqinisekisa ngaso ukuthi abantu ababulawa indlala nobubha.
KULINDELEKE ukuthi uNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli noMphathiswa wezokuThutha nokuHlaliswa KwaBantu KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Sboniso Duma bahlangane nezikhulu zamatekisi asesitelekeni namuhla eMgungundlovu, eCity Hall, ngenhloso yokuxazulula ukungqubuzana okukhona ngodaba lwezimvume zamatekisi.Isiteleka esesingenele osukwini lwesikhombisa sishiye abagibeli besele dengwane bengenazo izimoto zokuhamba eThekwini. Erenki yase-YMCA, Durban Station neyaseMgungundlovu namanye, amatekisi abengekho nayizolo. Izikhulu zamatekisi zikhala ngokufaka izicelo zezimvume zijike zingazitholi eMnyangweni wezokuThutha zikhala nangoShanela (uphiko lwamaphoyisa omgwaqo) obopha izimoto zazo.Esitatimendeni esikhishwe yiHhovisi likaNdukankulu kuthiwa bazohlangana nezikhulu zale mboni ngenhloso yokuxazulula izinkinga ezibhekene namatekisi."Abamatekisi bazibophezele ukuqhubeka nesiteleka sabo njengoba bekhala ngendlela uShanela osebenza ngayo, ubopha izimoto ezingenazo izimvume. Lokhu sekwenze ukuthi kube nokuphazamiseka okubandakanya ukuvalwa kwemigwaqo emikhulu u-N3 eThekwini, Hluhluwe, Vryheid, Mondlo, Babanango, Dalton naseNkandla, nokushiye izinkulungwane zabagibeli zisele dengwane zingakwazi ukuya eThekwini nakwamanye amadolobha,” kusho isitatimende.Isitatimende sithe: "UNdunankulu uyaqonda ngomthelela lesi siteleka esinawo kwezomnotho, emphakathini nasemabhizinisini njengoba imizila esemqoka ihlezi ivaliwe. Abantu baKwaZulu-Natal kanye nabagibeli beza kuqala, akukwazi ukuqhubeka ukuthi kube nezinkumbi zabantu ezisala dengwane zingafinyeleli lapho ziya khona”.UNdunankulu uhlangana nezikhulu zamatekisi nje, uSihlalo we-IFP Youth Brigade, ophinde abe yilungu lePhalamende KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Mncedisi Maphisa ubephonsele inselelo uNdunankulu ethi akangenele kulolu daba.Esitatimendeni asikhiphe kwabezindaba, uMnuz Maphisa ubecele uNdunankulu ukuthi akangenele ngokushesha."Lesi siteleka uma singanakwa, sizokwenza kube nokuntengantenga komnotho, sivimbele abaxhasi bese sehlisa isithunzi sesifundazwe njengendawo ethembekile yomhlaba wonke yezohwebo nezokuvakasha ikakhulukazi ngesikhathi samaholidi kaDisemba. "UNdunankulu utshengise ukuhola okunzulu ekulweni nezinye izinkinga ezifana nenkinga yezipaza. Siyamncenga ukuthi asebenzise amandla nokuzimisela okufanayo kulolu daba ukuze kube nozinzo KwaZulu-Natal,” kusho uMaphisa.Uthe okudabukisa kakhulu wukuthi kunabafundi basemanyuvesi abaqhethile ezikhungweni abangazi ukuthi bazoyaphi njengoba amatekisi engahambi."Le ntsha, vele isengozini futhi ayiphephile njengoba ingakwazi ukuhamba iyohlangana nemindeni yayo ngalesi sikhathi esibucayi sonyaka,” kusho uMaphisa.Uthe abamatekisi kumele baxoxe nohulumeni."Abamatekisi njengoba besola uMnyango wezokuThutha ukuthi ugodle izimvume futhi ushaqa izimoto zabo, kumele behlangane ngokwakhayo kuxazululwe izinkinga. Kanjalo nawo umnyango kumele ucacise futhi uphumele obala ngezinhloso zawo ukuxazulula lenkinga ngokushesha,” usho kanje.Uthe lesi akusona isikhathi sokuphikisana ngezepolitiki nokubambezela njengoba izinkulungwane zabagibeli, abasebenzi kanye nabafundi kuyibo abalimalayo ngesiteleka. Uthe uhulumeni wesifundazwe kumele ubeke eqhulwini izidingo zabantu ukuze kube nesisombululo salesi siteleka ngokushesha.
LUTHELA izithelo uhlelo lwesikole esinomlando wokuhlale sithola u-100% kwa-matric, iMenzi High eMlaza, eThekwini, sabafundi abafundisana bodwa.Lesi sikole okufundwa kuze kuphothulwe izivivinyo zika-matric, siqwaqwade zonke izikole zakuleli ezingu-Quintile 3 (abafundi abangayikhokhi imali esikoleni), ngokuhlabana ngendondo yokuba yisikole esenza kahle kuleli qoqo lezikole.Nyakenye, sizigqaja ngokuthola o-Distinction abangu-593 emiphumeleni ka-matric.Uthishanhloko walesi sikole, uNkk Nozipho Ndlanya, okunguye obuye nale ndondo emcimbini obuhlelwe nguMnyango weMfundo eyisiSekelo kuzwelonke muva nje obuseGoli, uthe bajabule ngokuthi umnyango, uyawubona umsebenzi owenziwa kulesi sikole.Uthe ukuzinikela kothisha abambisene nabo yikhona okwenza bahlale benemiphumela emihle minyaka yonke. "Ngaphandle kothisha abazinikelayo, ngabe asiyitholi le miphumela, ukunconywa nezindondo. Yibona abawumgogodla wakho konke. Nokuzinikela kwabafundi kuyasisiza ngoba kwenza umsebenzi wethu ube lula.”Uthe banezinhlelo eziningi abazenzayo ukuze abafundi babo benze kahle.UTHISHANHLOKO waseMenzi High eMlaza, uNkk Nozipho Ndlanya, nendondo abuye nayo emcimbini obuhlelwe nguMnyango weMfundo eyisiSekelo, ngokuqwaqwada zonke izikole zakuleli eziku-Quintile 3 ngokwenza kahle Isithombe:SITHUNYELWE "Sinabafundi abayisikhombisa abaphase ngamalengiso, bathola o-A kuzona zonke izifundo kwa-matric. Kukhona nabadabule ithothali kwi-Accounting. Abafundi abangu-40 kwa-matric nyakenye, bathole u-80% kuya phezulu ezifundweni zabo.” Uthe okunye okubasebenzelayo ukuthi kuthi kuqala unyaka ube uqala umshikashika wokufundisa ukuze kushaye u-Agasti, babe sebebuyekeza."Siyaluncoma nohlelo lokufukula abafundi abakwazi ukuzimela. Kunabafundi abathatha izintambo bafundise abanye ozakwabo uma uthisha engekho. Lokhu kwenza ukuthi bakwazi ukuqonda izinto ezithile.” Uthe abafundi bakwaGrade 9, bafundisa abakwaGrade 8, wathi ngale ndlela kuba lula ukuqonda izinto ezifundwayo.UNkk Ndlanya ubalule nokuthi inqwaba yababefunda kulesi sikole, bayabuya uma sebeqeqeshelwa ukufundisa bazokwenza lo msebenzi kulesi sikole. "Abanye bagcina sebeqashwa ngoba bazi nendlela isikole esenza ngayo izinto. Cishe u-30% kuya ku-40% wothisha abafundisa eMenzi, babefunda khona,” kuqhuba uNkk Ndlanya.Lesi sifundazwe sibuye nenqwaba yezindondo ezinye zazo bekungezokubungaza iqhaza labaqondisi bezifunda zomnyango.Abanye babo kubalwa owaseMkhanyakude, uMnuz Mjozi Motha.UMphathiswa wezeMfundo esifundazweni, uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka, uhalalisele izikole nabaqondisi bezifunda ababuye nezindondo kulo mcimbi.UHlomuka ubeyingxenye yalo mcimbi ehamba nenhloko yomnyango, uMnuz Nathi Ngcobo.
KUHLALE obala ngoLwesithathu ukuthi ummeli kammangalelwa wesine ecaleni lokubulawa kowayengunozinti we-Orlando Pirates neBafana Bafana, uSenzo Meyiwa, umfuna esitikini uKelly Khumalo.Lokhu kuvele ngesikhathi ummeli, u-Advocate Zithulele Nxumalo, eqhubeka nokuphonsa ngemibuzo ufakazi woMbuso, ongumphenyi omkhulu kuleli cala, uBrigadier Bongani Gininda.Eqala ukuveza lokhu uNxumalo, ubuze uGininda ukuthi kahle hle uKelly uyini kuleli cala? Ngabe uwufakazi noma ungumsolwa?UGininda uphendule ngokuthi ngokwakhe ungumuntu ayembukela eduze ngehlo lokuthi kufanele ajoyine abasolwa."Akasiye umsolwa ohleli ngaphambi kwenkantolo njengamanje kodwa ngangisenzile isicelo sokuthi aboshwe. Ngangimbuka njengomunye wabasolwa, yikho ngaze ngenza isicelo sokuthi naye aboshwe,” kusho uGininda.UNxumalo usole uGininda ngokuthi lwamhlula uphenyo kuleli cala."Ngokohla lwamacala (indictment), uKelly wayengomunye wabasolwa, ngakolunye ungummangali ngoba wantshontshelwa iselula,” kusho uNxumalo."Kakade uzobizwa nini vele yena uKelly?” kubuza uNxumalo.Kungenelele uMshushisi woMbuso, u-Adv George Baloyi, ethi ukubizwa kukaKelly akuwona umbuzo uNxumalo angawuphosa kuGininda ngoba ukubizwa kwakhe akuhlangene naye."Ukukuphendula, sesiyichaze kaningi indaba kaKelly ukuthi ngeke simbize, asinazinhlelo zokumbiza,” kucacisa uBaloyi.Ngokuqhubeka kwesikhathi, uBaloyi ubuye wafunda ingxenye yesitatimende esenziwa udadewabo kaKelly, uZandi Khumalo-Gumede, lapho ayechaza ngokuthi abangena endlini bathatha iselula kaKelly."Into engixakayo ukuthi lolu lwazi luvela esitatimendeni somuntu oseceleni, hhayi umnikazi weselula okukhulunywa ngayo. Umnikazi wale selula uyaphila, akafile kodwa akukho lapho yena azikhulumela khona ngalokhu,” kubhoka uNxumalo.IJaji uRatha Mokgoatlheng ugcine emkhumbuza uNxumalo ukuthi unalo ilungelo lokumbizela esitikini uKelly uma efuna."Njengoba usho nje ukuthi usaphila, akafile, unalo ilungelo lokumbiza,” kusho uMokgoatlheng.Ngaphambi kwalokho, kuvele ukuthi u-R45 000 okuthiwa uKelly owawukhokhela abasolwa wahlukaniswa kabili. Kwaqale kwangena u-R30 000, kwase kungena u-R15 000 kumsolwa wesibili, uMnuz Bongani Ntanzi, ifakwa umsolwa wesihlanu uFisokuhle Ntuli.Nokho uGininda ube esechaza ukuthi ngokobufakazi basebhange, akukho lapho okuvela khona imali iphuma ebhange likaKelly iya ebhange lomunye wabasolwa, agcine ethi usola ukuthi kwasetshenziswa imali ewukheshi.Icala liyabuyela namuhla.
INTAKA ibekelwe amazolo KwaPata, eMgungundlovu, namhlanje njengoba kuphothula ithwasa elimhlophe elafakwa ugqozi wumengameli wokuqala wentando yabantu uNelson Mandela.Yize zanda izangoma ezimhlophe kodwa uMnuz Gary "Dabulamafu" Bedell (70), odabuka eCanada, uhlukile kozakwabo ngenxa yobudlelwano bakhe nababeyizishoshovu zomzabalazo kuleli.Phakathi kwabaholi bakuleli abangasekho kubalwa umengameli wokuqala omnyama waseNingizimu Afrika, uMnuz Nelson Mandela, owayengunobhala jikelele we-SACP uMnuz Chris Hani nowayengunobhala jikelele we-ANC uMnuz Walter Sisulu.UDabulamafu, uzophothula ubungoma emuva kweminyaka ewu-30 athwasa, wahlangana noMandela ngo-Ephreli 1990 emuva kwezinyanga ezimbili ekhululwe etilongweni. Isolezwe lithole ukuthi uDabulamafu wahlela uhambo lokuqala lwaseCanada lukaMandela futhi wamphelezela kulolo hambo. Ubuhlakani bakhe bamchaza uMadiba kangangoba waze wambambisa iqhaza ethimbeni labaqaphi bakhe ngesikhathi elibangise e-United States.Kuthiwa uMadiba wagcina enxuse undunankulu waseCanada, uMnuz Brian Mulroney ngo-Agasti 1990 ukuba avumele uDabulamafu ukuba abambe iqhaza ezingxoxweni ezaziphakathi kwabo nohulumeni kaMnuz FW de Klerk. Ubudlelwano bukaDabulamafu noMadiba baqina kakhulu kangangoba wagcina esesiza uMandela ukuxhumana noMengameli wase-USA, uMnuz George W Bush. UBedell wabuye wabamba elikhulu iqhaza ekuqinisweni konswinyo kuhulumeni wobandlululo.UDabulamafu uveze ukuthi nguMandela owamsiza ukuze ahlangane nogobela wakhe wokuqala waseSoweto ongasekho emhlabeni, uMnuz Horatio Zungu. UDabulamafu uchaze uZungu, oshone ngo-2020, njengesangoma esamfundisa ukubhula ngamathambo. Uthe wathwasa iminyaka emibili wabe esephoqeleka ukuba abuyele eCanada ngenxa yokuphoqwa wumsebenzi. Yize kunjalo uthe wayelokhu emvakashela uMandela agcina ukubonana naye ngoJulayi 2010.Uthe ngomngcwabo wayekhona njengongoti wesiteshi saseCanada, i-CTV.Uthe okumenze wabuyela ekuthwaseni ukuthi amadlozi akhe abesamdinelwe njengoba alaxaza ukuthwasa ngo-1992.NgoNovemba 2022 wahlaselwa wumdlavuza wagcina ephoqelekile ukuba abuyele eNingizimu Afrika ukuthola omunye ugobela uMnuz Senzo Ngubane waseMgungundlovu."Ngangingakaze ngizitshele ukuthi ngiyoke ngithande ugobela njengoba kwenzeka kuZungu, kwaze kwaba ngihlangana noNgubane. Ufana nobaba kimi," kuphetha uDabulamafu.
UYAZIHLANGULA ummangalelwa wokuqala kwabayisithupha ababhekene necala lokusoconga ikhansela likaMasipala uMdoni elalibuye libe wugobela, uMnuz Qedukwazi Theodore Mzimela.UMnuz Mcebisi Mfezeko Mdeni ubaphendukele esiswini njengotshwala aboshwe nabo wabachakida, ezikhipha ngokuthi yena akazi lutho kodwa yibona abangongqondongqondo betulo lokusocongwa kukamufi namathwasa akhe amabili.UMdeni lokhu ukuveze ngomlomo wommeli wakhe u-Advocate Shelembe njengoba ebekade ecela ibheyili izolo eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini.Aboshwe nabo ngoMnuz Mthokozisi Goodman Mqadi, Bheki Sibiya, Ayabongwa Tshibane, Mduduzi Mthethwa noPhilane Sanele Hlongwane.Umufi kuthiwa wabulawa ngoMashi 15 nonyaka ehamba namathwasa akhe amabili oMnuz Senzo Ngema (34) noPhumlani Hopewell Mbutho (28) esigamekweni esenzeka eSpringfield, eThekwini.Isidumbu sikaMzimela namathwasa zatholakala ngaphansi kwebhuloho eliseMngeni zayiswa emakhazeni asePhoenix.Kwase kunesikhashana kuzungeza isithombe sikaMzimela ezinkundleni zokuxhumana kuthiwa unyamalele kungaziwa ukuthi ushonephi.Elandisa inkantolo ngokwenzeka uMdeni, uthe umufi wayekade enqaba ukubuyisela ummangalelwa wesibili uMqadi imali yakhe ayekade emkhokhele yona ngesikhathi emthwasisa."UMqadi wacela mina ukuthi ngiyenge uMzimela ngiqambe amanga ngokuthi ngigulelwa yimfuyo yami, makasuke eMzinto ezongilekelela ngokuthi ayelaphe ingafi. UMzimela ubedume ngokuthi uyakwazi ukwelapha imfuyo,'' kuchaza yena.Eqhuba uthe nebala wamshayela ucingo uMzimela wamtshela ukuthi imfuyo yakhe ayikho esimweni esikahle, ucela ukuthi aphuthume eThekwini namakhathakhatha."UMzimela wavuma ngokushesha ngoba ubewuthanda umsebenzi wokwelapha izilwane. Uyena futhi owathi makuhlanganwe eSpringfield,'' kuchaza yena.Uthe uMzimela esefikile eSpringfield wayephelezelwa ngamathwasa akhe amabili."Sabathatha sahamba nabo saya endlini eseKenville. Kwathi uma sifika khona uMduduzi Mthethwa wabakhomba ngesibhamu. Ngemuva kwalokho wathi mabalayishwe emotweni kuhanjwe okuyilapho esagcina simisa imoto ebhulohlweni eliseMngeni,'' kusho yena.Uthe sebefikile khona uMqadi noMthethwa babehlisa bobathathu emotweni. Uthe uMthethwa wamguqisa phansi uMzimela wamdubula kathathu ekhanda nasentanyeni.Ngemuva kwalokho uthe wajikela emathwaseni ewabuza ukuthi ayazi yini ukuthi kungani ebulawa uMzimela. "Amathwasa aphendula ngokuthi sinye isitha sikagobela wawo asaziyo okunguMqadi osekuphele isikhathi eside efuna ukubuyiselwa imali yakhe,'' kusho uMdeni.Uthe ngemuva kwalokho uMthethwa nawo amathwasa wawaguqisa phansi wawadubula ashonela endaweni yesehlo.Uthe akukho yena akwenza ngaphandle kokuthi wayenga uMzimela ngokuthi azokwelapha imfuyo nakhona lapho uthe wayengazi ukuthi bazomdubula.Uveze ukuthi uMqadi wabe esethatha amakhadi amabili, elase-Capitec nelase-Standard Bank esikhwameni sikaMzimela ngoba wayesembuzile inombolo eyimfihlo wayokhipha imali egaraji eNewlands naseDurban North.Ugcizelele ukuthi uzoyihlonipha yonke imiyalelo yenkantolo uma kwenzeka imnikeza ibheyili.Kuvele ukuthi uMzimela wayemkhokhise u-R17 500 uMqadi ngokumthwasisa.Ukulalelwa kwesicelo sebheyili kuyaqhubeka namhlanje.
KUPHENDUKE usizi nomunyu ukugula kukamshushishi sekumele imantshi yahlulele ecaleni lokubulala elithweswe iphoyisa eladubulala kwafa owayekade encike emotweni yalo.Bekulindeleke ukuthi imantshi uMuntu Khumalo yeNkantolo yesiFunda yasePinetown ikhiphe isinqumo sokuthi liyamgojela noma uphuma phambili uSergeant Sibonelo Shangangu izolo.Kodwa akazange alubhade enkantolo umshushisisi, uMnuz Rowen Souls, obike ukuthi uyagula wase eyaphutha emsebenzini.Lokhu kwenze imantshi ukuthi ikuhlehlisele uJanuwari 21, 2025, ukukhishwa kwesinqumo.UShabangu wathela othulini ngenhlavu uMnuz Qaphela Mdima ngoNovemba 2022. Babekade beqale ngokuhilizisana besendaweni yobumnandi eyaziwa ngokuthi iCasablanca Lifestyle, eMolweni, eThekwini.UMnuz Qiniso Mdima ongumfowabo kamufi, uthe bese bezitshelile bewumndeni ukuthi uzowudlela ejele uKhisimusi uShabangu."Besilindele ukuthi uzogwetshwa namhlanje (izolo). Mina nomndeni wami bese sesizitshelile ukuthi siza okokugcina enkantolo, ngeke siphinde sibuye. Angijabulile ngendlela okwenzeka ngayo,” kubalisa uMdima.Ubekade efike enkantolo nabazali bakhe, izihlobo nabangani bemagange ukuthi bezwe isinqumo sikaKhumalo.UShabangu naye ubebukeka engaphathekile kahle kuhlehliswa icala kule nkantolo okuqhubekayo ukugasebenzi kwama-air conditioner ayo.UMdima uthe ihlangene iminyaka emibili begqigqa enkantolo ngecala elingapheli."Ayikho inqubekela phambili yaleli cala ngoba nesizathu esihlehliselwe lona asizwakali kahle. Silovele ubala emsebenzini. Uzakwabo (kaSouls) ubengambambela ngoba ayikho into akade esazoyikhuluma yena, okwakhe bese kuwukulalela imantshi ikhipha isinqumo,” kuchaza uMdima.
UKHOMISHANA wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, uthe abantu abangakhathazwa isiteleka samatekisi ahamba amabanga amade ngoba asibandakanyi abanye ososeshini.UMkhwanazi usho kanje ngesikhathi kunesivimbamgwaqo eMariannhill Toll Plaza, izolo, ngenhloso yokuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abasebenzisa imigwaqo yaKwaZulu-Natal baphephile.Ekhuluma nabezindaba, uthe isiteleka sabamatekisi ahamba amabanga amade esiqhubekayo kasikho emthethweni."Lesi siteleka asikho emthethweni futhi iningi lososeshini bamatekisi abavumelani naso. Kunedlanzana labantu elithanda ukuhlupha, bamise amaloli nezimoto bavimbe umgwaqo,” kusho uLt Mkhwanazi.Uthe izikhulu zamatekisi ezingazilandile izimvume alizilande."Izikhulu zamatekisi ezinezimvume ezihleli emnyangweni kumele zenze isiqiniseko sokuthi ziyazilanda. Sebengaxoxa ngezinye zezicelo abanazo kanye nalezo abanganeme ngazo,” usho kanje.Uthe bonke laba abavimba imigwaqo bazoboshwa."Wonke umuntu ozophula umthetho sizombopha, ngeke simhlawulise. Abantu kumele besebenzise izithuthi zomphakathi ngokukhululeka futhi behambe nanoma yikhuphi lapho abafuna ukuhamba khona ngoba iningi lososeshini aliyona ingxenye yesiteleka,” ubeke kanje.Kusasa kulindeleke ukuthi uNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli noMphathiswa wezokuThutha nokuHlaliswa kwaBantu KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Sboniso Duma, behlangane nezikhulu zamatekisi eMgungundlovu, eCity Hall, ukuzobhunga ngenhloso yokuphuma nesixazululo njengoba sekuphele izinsuku amatekisi ahamba amabanga amade etelekile.
KUMISWE izinhlelo zikaMphathiswa wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, zokuyosebenzela oLundi.Izinhlelo zikaButhelezi zimiswe ngenxa yokuthi kunemithetho engazange ilandelwe ngesikhathi kuthathwa isinqumo sokuthi ayosebenzela esiShayamthetho esidala.Lokhu kushiwo uNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, obekhuluma nabezindaba ebebehambele iPhalamende labantu abaphila nokukhubazeka, obuseRichmond, izolo.ISIKHANGISO somcimbi wokuvulwa kwamahhovisi obuzokuba kusasa Isithombe: FacebookAmahhovisi amasha asoLundi abezovulwa iSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini, kusasa.Kepha uNtuli uthe umcimbi ngeke usaqhubeka ngenxa yokuthi kunemithetho okufanele ilandelwe ngaphambi kokuthi uButhelezi aye kosebenzela oLundi."Njengohulumeni wesifundazwe sibuke ukuthi kukhona izinto okufanele siqale sizilungise ngoba kukhona okunye okuqopheke phansi kwemithetho okufanele sidlule kahle kukhona ukuze wonke umuntu okuhulumeni ahambisane kahle nathi. Sibambisene nongqongqoshe, sinqume ukuthi siwuhlehlise umcimbi ukuze sidlule kahle kulokhu.”UNtuli uthe umqulu olawula ukusebenza kukahulumeni uyawuvumela umnyango ukuthi ube namahhovisi ezindaweni ezimbili.Uthe kula mahhovisi kungaba ileli eliseMgungundlovu, bese kuba khona elesibili okungaba uMphathiswa okhethayo ukuthi lizokuba kuphi nendawo."Yizo zonke le zinto esifuna ukuthi sidlule kahle kuzona ukuze kungabi khona abantu abazothi kukhona izinto esingazange sizilandelele kahle.”UNtuli uthe ukuhlehla komcimbi akusho ukuthi uButhelezi ngeke esaya kosebenzela oLundi."Usuku lokuba livulwe luzobuye luqoshwe kahle, bese umsebenzi uqhubeka njengesifiso somnyango. Ngithi angikuchaze lokhu ngoba ngiyazi ukuthi abantu abamenyiwe, abanye bese bebuza ukuthi ngabe kukhona inkinga ekhona yini. Cha ayikho inkinga. Amalungiselelo nje kanye nemigudu ethile esibone ukuthi kufanele siyilandele kuqala. Ngithi angithathe leli thuba ngikucacise ukuthi kuzoqhubeka ukuvulwa kwamahhovisi omnyango njengokuvumelana kwami nongqongqoshe, kodwa usuku luzobuye lumenyezelwe.”Okhulumela uMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu, uMnuz Senzelwe Mzila, uyalele ukuba yonke imibuzo ibhekiswe ehhovisi likaNtuli ngesikhathi ebuzwa ngemali esetshenziswe umnyango ulungiselela umcimbi wakusasa nokuthi kungani umnyango uhlele umcimbi ekubeni kunemithetho engalandeliwe.Okhulumela uMphathiswa wezeZimali, uMnuz Francios Rodgers, uMnuz Nkosikhona Duma, uthe bayasamukela isimemezelo sikaNtuli.UDuma uthe ukhona umthetho ochaza kabanzi ukuthi abaphathiswa bangaba namahhovisi amangaki."Kubukeka sengathi undunankulu ubuke lokho.”Isinqumo sikaButhelezi sokuyosebenzela oLundi sisuse imvunge kwabanye abebekhala ngokuthi lokhu kuzokwandisa izindleko njengoba kuzodinga ukuthi abasebenzi bomnyango basebenzele eMgungundlovu nasoLundi.
UMNYANGO wezeMfundo eGauteng ukhathazekile ngokwanda kwezigameko zodlame ezikoleni. Lokhu kulandela umbiko wokuhlaselwa kwebamba likathishanhloko esikoleni iNorthview esiseduze neBalfour Mall eGoli.Usihlalo wesigungu esilawula isikole, u-Aron Malepe, utshele abezindaba ukuthi abasolwa ababili bafike kulesi sikole ngoLwesibili bezenza abantu abazofuna amanani omsebenzi wokusika izihlahla.Abasolwa bafike ehhovisi lebamba likathishanhloko balidubula izikhawu eziyisithupha ngaphambi kokuba babaleke. Umgilwa uphuthunyiswe esibhedlela esesimweni esibucayi njengoba egcinwe egumbini labagula kakhulu.UMnuz Malepe ubonga ubufakazi obuqoshwe amakhamera obudinga kuphela ukuthi amaphoyisa ahlale phezu kwabo kubanjwe abasolwa.Umnyango wezeMfundo eGauteng ukhiphe isitatimende uzwakalisa ukushaqeka ngokwenzekile kuhlaselwa ibamba likathishanhloko.
ZISOLA ukuthi ayadembesela amaphoyisa izihlobo zabane abadutshulwa, babulawa emshadweni ngo-Ephreli nonyaka, eMzunga, eNdwedwe. Kuleso sigameko esenzeka ngo-Ephreli 21, kwashona uMnuz Msawenkosi Gcabashe, Saziso Gcabashe, Veli Gcabashe noBhekisisa Gcabashe owashonela emtholampilo.Ngokusho komthombo osondelene nodaba, ocele ukungadalulwa, uveze ukuthi kukhona isibhamu esawa kubasolwa endaweni yesigameko, sacoshwa yisihlobo esaziwayo.Uthe isihlobo sagoduka naso, kwathi ngo-Ephreli 28, bezwa kuthiwa kufike abantu abaziwayo endaweni, bazosifuna, bethi umnikazi waso uyingozi."Lolu lwazi saluyisa emaphoyiseni. Uma sizwa, kuthiwa ahamba ayosilanda kodwa awangabopha muntu,” kusho umthombo.Udalule ukuthi umndeni awuhlalisekile kahle ngalokhu okwenzekayo kangangokuthi abakubo kaMusawenkosi, njengoba abafi babehlukene ngezindlu, sebevele bathutha endaweni."Bazizwa bengaphephile, ikakhulukazi ngoba kuwuye okusolakala ukuthi wayefuneka. Esingakuqondi ukuthi kwenzeka kanjani ukuthi amaphoyisa anikezwe lonke ulwazi kodwa kungabi bikho lutho alwenzayo ngalo,” kusho umthombo.Uqhube wathi bona ababekulindele ukuthi amaphoyisa aqale ngokubopha isihlobo esathatha isibhamu endaweni yesigameko."Bese elandela ngalaba abeza bazosithatha esihlotsheni besabisa ngokuthi umnikazi waso uyingozi. Lowo mkhondo wawuzohamba uze uyofika kubasolwa abadubula abafi,” kusho umthombo.Uthe bafisa kungenelele izikhulu eziphezulu zamaphoyisa kulolu daba ngoba bayabufuna ubulungiswa.Ngosuku lwesigameko kwakushada uNksz Phumzile Gcabashe waKwaCibane, noMnuz Msizi Shangase waseMzunga.Isigameko senzeka ezintatha kuzoba nodwendwe, kade kunomshado omhlophe ngayizolo. Abafi bahlaselwa kwamkhwenyana, endlini okwakulaliswe kuyo abakubo kamakoti.Kuthiwa abahlaseli bangena baqonda ngqo kuMsawenkosi, bamdubula. Kuvela ukuthi abanye abagcina bedutshulwa nabo befa, ababezama ukungenelela.Umthombo uthe basola ukuthi abahlaseli babesuka esigodini saKwaCibane, bakholwa ukuthi ulwazi babelupotshozelwa omunye owayekhona kule ndlu okwenzeka kuyo isigameko.
INKANTOLO yeMantshi yaseThekwini izolalela isicelo sebheyili sabesilisa abayisithupha baKwaMashu, ababhekene necala lokusoconga uQedukwazi Theodore Mzimela owayeyinyanga eyayiphinde ibe yikhansela le-ABC eMzinto.Umufi wasocongwa ngoMashi 15, kuwona lo nyaka, ehamba namathwasa akhe amabili uMnuz Senzo Ngema (34) noMnuz Phumlani Hopewell Mbutho (28) esigamekweni esenzeka eSpringfield.Isidumbu sikaMzimela namathwasa zatholakala ngaphansi kwebhuloho eliseMngeni zase ziyiswa emakhazeni asePhoenix.Kwase kunesikhashana kade kuzungeza isithombe sikaMzimela ezinkundleni zokuxhumana kuthiwa unyamalele akaziwa ukuthi ushonephi.Imantshi u-Ashwin Sing izwakalise ukunengeka njengoba omunye wabameli babasolwa engalubhadanga enkantolo nokuholele ekutheni kuhlehliselwe inamhlanje ukulalelwa kwebheyili kwalaba.Abasolwa kuleli cala nguMnuz Mcebisi Mfezeko Mdeni, Mnuz Mthokozisi Goodman Mqadi, Mnuz Bheki Sibiya, Mnuz Ayabongwa Tshibane, Mnuz Mduduzi Mthethwa noMnuz Philane Sanele Hlongwane.Kuvela ukuthi oyedwa wabasolwa wayekade ethwasiswa ngumufi, uMzimela nowamkhokhisa imali engu-R17 500 ngaloyo msebenzi.Kuthiwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, lo msolwa wakhala ngokungagculiseki ngomsebenzi awenzelwe ngumufi. Kuvela ukuthi wafuna ukuba umufi ambuyisele imali ngodli.Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi umsolwa owayethwasiswa - okungakaveli ukuthi ubani phakathi kwabasolwa, wagcina eseshayela ucingo uMzimela emnxusa ukuba mabahlangane eSpringfield, ukuze bezobhunga kabanzi ngalolu daba.UMzimela kuthiwa wavuma wabe esehamba eyohlangana nalaba ephelezelwa ngamathwaswa akhe amabili.Abasolwa kuvela ukuthi abachithanga sikhathi, bamdubula bambulala uMzimela base bedubula bebulala namathwasa akhe amabili. Kakuqondakali ukuthi izidumbu zabo zagcina sezifinyelela kanjani ngaphansi kwebholoho laseMngeni.Laba abathathu kuvela ukuthi babulawa ngesihluku njengoba kuvela ukuthi izidumbu zabo zontathu zatholakala ziboshwe izandla nezinyawo.UMzimela ngesikhathi ehamba kuthiwa wayehamba ngemoto yakhe iToyota Corolla emhlophe, i-tracker yayo kuthiwa yagcina itholwa eGreenwood Park.Kuvela ukuthi inkosikazi kaMzimela nayo eyayikade iyinyanga yasocongwa ngonyaka owedlule.Ngaphambilini, Isolezwe lakhuluma nosondelene nomndeni owazibiza ngokuthi unguKing nowazwakalisa ukudumala ngokusocongwa kukaMzimela.Izolo bekugcwele enkantolo, kuthe uma imantshi ilihlehlisa icala kwakhona abesifazane abanikina amakhanda bekhulumela phansi, bethi inkantolo yenza kancane.Kakucaci ukuthi laba besifazane bebezoseka abasolwa okanye basohlangothi lomndeni wabagilwa.I-ABC yakhipha isitatimende idlulisa amazwi enduduzo emndenini, yachaza uMzimela nobebeka phambili umphakathi futhi esebenza ngokuzikhandla okukhulu.

UKHALA ngokudembesela kwamaphoyisa, umsolwa ecanasa, umndeni wowesifazane waKwaNdengezi, eThekwini, emva kokugwazwa yisoka lakhe emasontweni amathathu edlule.Kuthiwa uNksz Nomfundo Pamela Khoza (26) wagwazwa umsolwa ngoNovemba 10 eMakatini, eDamini emzini womngani. Ushonele esibhedlela ngoLwesine.Umamkhulu kamufi, uNksz Dudu Khoza, uthe ngesikhathi kwenzeka lesi sehlakalo lezi zithandani zazihleli nabangani.Uthe zaxabana okungatheni, umsolwa wasuka wahamba."Abangani basala bamzamela indawo yokulala uNomfundo, okwathi eselele, umsolwa wafika, wamngena ngommese emgwaza,” kusho uNksz Khoza.Uthe wamgwaza amanxeba amathathu ezindaweni ezibucayi, ngenhla kwebele langakwesobunxele, ngezansi kwalo nangemumva ohlangothini lwangakwesokudla.Uveze ukuthi emva kokuthintwa abangani, baphuthuma endaweni yesigameko, bamyisa esibhedlela eMariannhill."Bamdlulisela eRK Khan bebona ubucayi besimo sakhe, bathi udinga ukuhlinzwa. Emva kokuhlinzwa waquleka kwaze kwaba uyadlula emhlabeni ngoLwesine,” kuchaza uNksz Khoza.Uthe okubakhalisayo ukuthi umsolwa ngowasendaweni, kodwa namanje akaboshiwe."Uyabonakala ezihambela ngokukhululeka endaweni, afonelwe amaphoyisa, atshelwe ukuthi nangu kodwa ahudula izinyawo,” kusho uNksz Khoza.Uthe sikhona nesitatimende emaphoyiseni, esabhalwa umngani, owabona umsolwa egwaza umufi."Okubuhlungu ukuthi silahlekelwe umntwana thina kodwa amaphoyisa awenzi lutho. Sifuna ubulungiswa,” usho kanje.Uthe bakhathazwa nawukuthi angaqhubeka aphinde ahlasele nabanye njengoba aziwa njengomuntu oyingozi futhi onomlando wokuhlasela abantu.Uqhube wathi ngisho nabakubo kamsolwa baya esibhedlela umufi esaphila, beyokhuza umhlola. Umufi nomsolwa kuvela ukuthi bese kuphele unyaka bethandana.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe uma ebheka kwi-system yamaphoyisa, ubona kuvela ukuthi kuvulwe icala lokuzama ukubulala.
IZOTHATHA izinqumo ezinzima i-ANC ngekusasa labaholi bale nhlangano KwaZulu-Natal, njengoba amanye amagatsha kulesi sifundazwe efaniswe nento engekho.Abaholi bale nhlangano esifundazweni bafaniswe nabantu abahamba ngemoto iToyota Conquest ekubeni kudingeka imoto egijimayo iFerrari.Lokhu kushiwo nguNobhala Jikelele wale nhlangano uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, ekhuluma nabezindaba izolo, emuva komhlangano wekomiti elibhekele ukusebenza kwansuku zonke kwale nhlangano eGoli.UMbalula uthe isinqumo ngokuthi bazokwenzenjani ngobuholi baseKZN, sizothathwa emhlangangweni wangesonto elizayo waleli komiti.ABAHOLI abaphezulu be-ANC emhlanganweni wekomiti elibhekele ukusebenza kwansuku zonke kwale nhlangano ebelihlangene nobuholi be-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, mayelana nekusasa labo emuva kokushaya udaka okhethweni Isithombe: ANC/XUthe ikomiti lizobe seliphakamisa ekomitini eliphezulu lale nhlangano, ngokuthi kumele kwenzekenjani ngobuholi baseKZN nobaseGauteng."Sizothatha izinqumo ezinzima ngoba sakha kabusha inhlangano. Okusetafuleni ukuthi sibuhlakaze ubuholi base-KZN naseGauteng noma sibuqinise noma senze izinguquko ebuholini,” kusho uMbalula.Uthe eKZN balahlekelwe wuMasipala omkhulu iTheku, kanjalo neMoses Mabhida, okusingenye sezifunda ezinkulu zale nhlangano."Awukwazi ukuthi ungathi izinto zihamba kahle ekubeni okhethweni eKZN i-ANC ibhaxabulwe yathola u-17%. Ungathini nje uthole lesi sibalo esincane kanje? Yinto engaqhathaniseki nezinye izifundazwe ezehlelwe wukwesekwa eKZN naseGauteng, silahlekelwe amandla,” kuqhuba uMbalula. Uthe nabo bewubuholi bukazwelonke bavuma ukuthi izinto zibe ngaphezu kokwenza njengoba le nhlangano yehlelwa ukwesekwa."Udaba lweqembu likaZuma (Mnuz Jacob) i-MK, ibe nomthelela ekutheni kwehle ukwesekwa. Kodwa akusona kuphela lesi sizathu esenze lokhu. Sikhulumile namagatsha e-KZN njengoba sike saya khona izikhawu ezehlukene, siyazi kwenzakalani. Sekulula manje ukuthi sithathe isinqumo ngekusasa labaholi baseKZN. Asizoncenga muntu ngoba esikwenzayo ukwakha kabusha i-ANC eKZN naseGauteng.” Uthe isinqumo abazosithatha ngalezi zifundazwe bazimisele ukusivikela kuze kuphele ihlandla labo lokuphatha kule nhlangano.UMbalula uveze ukuthi ubatshelile abaholi baseKZN ukuthi bathule du, bangathi vu, nguyena ozokhuluma ngezinqumo ezithathiwe."Imina ozokhuluma ngezinqumo ezithathiwe, abanye bazisiwe ukuthi bangathi vu. Umuntu oyophambana nalo myalelo uyozibona ukuthi ufana nobani,” kusho uMbalula.Uthe labo abebecabanga ukuthi izolo bekumele kuphume isinqumo ngekusasa lobuholi base-KZN naseGauteng, bekuyinto ebisezingqondweni zabo."Kumele ngaphambi kokuthatha izinqumo ulandele imigudu efanele. Kodwa engingakusho ukuthi i-ANC izobuya isinamandla kakhulu ngoba ukuhlehla kwenqama kusuke kuwukolanda amandla.” Mayelana ne-SACP ememezele ukuthi izongenela ukhetho ngayodwana, uthe le nhlangano ibazisile wathi abaphikisani nesinqumo sayo, wathi basazoxoxa nayo ngonyaka ozayo ngalolu daba.
BAPHITHENE amakhanda abazali bosana olunezinyanga ezine, oluthunjwe ngamadoda amabili angaziwa emva kokugasela emjondolo wabo eBottlebrush, eChatsworth, bekhala ngokuthi bakweletwa imali "nguyise”.Unina kaThingoluhle Shozi (othunjiwe), uNksz Londeka Shozi, uthe ngaphambi kokuthi kuthunjwe indodakazi yakhe, kuqale kwafika abesilisa, abangqongqoze emnyango, bazibuzisa uSimphiwe.Lesi sehlakalo senzeke ngoLwesine ebusuku."Angizange ngivule, ngilandulile ngingaphakathi ngathi angimazi uSimphiwe, base beyahamba,” kusho uNksz Shozi.Uthe kuphele isikhashana, walungiselela ukulala nawo womabili amadodakazi akhe, ethunjiwe nenye eneminyaka emine."Kufike ubuthongo, ngezwa kukhona onyakazisa isicabha, samuntu ovulayo. Ngivulile ngisebuthongweni ngizitshela ukuthi sekubuya uyise wabantwana kodwa ngathi uma ngibona ingalo ngaqaphela ukuthi akuyena, ngazama ukuphusha isicabha. Akuzange kusize ngoba bavele basidudula ngamandla, bangena ngaphakathi,” usho kanje.UThingoluhle Shozi othunjiweUthe sebengaphakathi, yize bebekhanyise ngeselula, ukwazile ukubona ukuthi oyedwa uhlome ngesibhamu futhi abazigqokile izigqoko ezifihla ubuso."Ubelokhu engitshela ukuthi ufuna imali yakhe kubaba womntwana, uNjabulo. Bengithi uma ngizama ukuchaza ukuthi ubaba womntwana akusiye uNjabulo, angisabise ngokuthi uzongidubula. Ugcine ethi uNjabulo akoshayela ucingo uSphe, amtshele ukuthi imali isilungile, bese ema nayo emgwaqweni ngezikhathi zasekuseni (ngoLwesihlanu).Uthe uzobe eseyithola ke ingane uma esekhokha imali,” kusho uNksz Shozi.Uthe akakwazanga nokubuza ukuthi imalini yona leyo ekweletwayo njengoba bebelokhu bemsabisa ngesibhamu.Udalule ukuthi bashiye bembophe yonke indawo, baze bambopha ngisho nomlomo nge-sello tape, eze yaqaqwa uye uyise wengane uMnuz Lwazi Zungu ofike ngabo-10 ebusuku, ebuya emsebenzini.Uthe usola ukuthi abantu abazibuzise uSimphiwe nabathathe indodakazi yakhe abantu ababodwa.Uqhube wathi usola ukuthi baphambanise izinkomishi uma bethatha indodakazi yakhe ngoba uyise akusiye uNjabulo."Akukho muntu amkweleta imali, akekho nomuntu amaziyo okuthiwa uSphe,” kunezela uNksz Shozi othe unesiqiniseko salokhu ngoba akukho angakwazi ngoyise womntwana wakhe.UZungu naye ekhuluma neSolezwe, uthe ushaqekile ngoba akakweleti muntu."Uma kwenzekile ngaxakeka, ngiye ngiboleke komakhelwane bethu. Angisiye nomuntu okhonze umsindo, ngaleyo ndlela anginazo izitha okungathiwa zifuna ukungizwisa ubuhlungu,” kusho uZungu.Uthe bezwe ngabantu bendawo ukuthi emva kokuthatha ingane, abasolwa ebebezihambela kahle, bengasolisi.Kuthiwa bahambe bayongena etekisini eyayimi ngaphesheya komgwaqo maqede yakhala amaphepha.Bathe bayafisa indodakazi yabo ibuye iphephile njengoba lesi sehlo singaphezu kwamandla abo.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa aseChatsworth, avule icala lokuthumba kulandela isigameko sokuthunjwa kwengane enezinyanga ezine.Uthe bathole umbiko wokuthi owesifazane ubelele namadodakazi akhe amabili emjondolo osemgwaqweni u-Link ngoLwesine, wezwa kukhona umuntu ovula umnyango."Kungene amadoda amabili, enye yawo ihlome ngesibhamu. Bamvale amehlo, base bethatha ingane ngenkani, bahamba,” kusho uNetshiunda.
UNQUME ukulaxaza isikole waduba nezivivinyo washintsha nendawo yokuhlala umfundi kaGrade 7 waseSawoti eXobho, okuthiwa wadlwengulwa umsolwa owaziwayo ovele wadedelwa, kwathiwa akukho okumyamanisa necala.Umgilwa (13) okuvela ukuthi ubeyintombi ehlolwayo, kuthiwa wehlelwa yisigameko ngo-Okthoba 14, ebuya kotheza.Elandisa ngesigameko unina kamgilwa, uthe kuthathe isikhathi ukuthi ezwe ngokwenzekile ngoba kube nzima ukuthi indodakazi yakhe isheshe ibabikele.Uthe uqale ukubona ushintsho kuyona ekupheleni kuka-Okthoba."Njalo uma ngifika ngiphuma emsebenzini, bengifika ezivalele ekameleni. Uma ngimbheka, ngimbone ukuthi amehlo abomvu, kade ekhala," kusho unina kamgilwa.Uthe bekusobala ukuthi kukhona okungahambi kahle kodwa kuthi uma embuza ukuthi kwenzenjani, athi konke kuhamba kahle.Uthe wavele wamqhuba, wamyisa kunomehlo, owafike waveza ukuthi konakele."Ngangithi uma ngimbuza ukuthi woniwe ubani, avele asikhihle isililo. Wavele wacela uyise ukuthi kube wuye ongenelayo. Wavele wamgagula ngegama kuyise umsolwa, esho nokuthi wambamba esechezuke ngendlela eza ekhaya, esehamba yedwa," kusho unina kamgilwa.Uthe wamtshela ukuthi umsolwa wamqhamukela ngemuva, wamphusha nenyanda ayeyithwele, wawa nayo."Wathi wamfaka isidwedwe emlonyeni, wase emdlwengula. Kwathi eseqedile, wakhipha ummese, wawubeka kuye entanyeni ethi uma eke washo, uzomnquma kanye nomndeni wakhe," kusho unina kamgilwa, othe uyaqonda ukuthi kungani indodakazi yakhe yakhetha ukungabiki ngesigameko.Uthe icala baze balivula ngoNovemba, umsolwa bayomkhomba ngoNovemba 20, waboshwa kodwa ngakusasa wadedelwa, amaphoyisa ethi abukho ubufakazi obumyamanisa necala."Siphoqeleke ukuthi sisuke ekhaya, sibona singaphephile ngoba wasabisa ngokusibulala. Siyakholwa ukuthi angakwenza ngempela njengoba wake wadonsa isigwebo ngokubulala umuntu endaweni, aphinde abe yisigebengu esaziwayo," kusho unina kamgilwa.Uthe lokhu kuholele ekutheni umgilwa ayeke isikole yize bese eqalile ukubhala izivivinyo zokuphela konyaka."Ngibona sengathi abaseshi bangidayisa kumsolwa ngoba ngesikhathi eboshwa, saya komkhomba, uboshwa nje nathi sikhona. Ekugcineni sebeyamdedela. Abusafiki ubuthongo kithina ngoba asazi ukuthi uzosenzani," kusho unina kamgilwa.Uthe kubuhlungu ukubona ingane yakhe iyeka isikole ngenxa yokuzizwa ingaphephile.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe uphiko lwamaphoyisa iKokstad Family Violence, Child Protection and Sexual Offences Unit (FCS), lubophe umsolwa oneminyaka engu-33 ecaleni lokudlwengula intombazane eneminyaka engu-13 ngo-Okthoba 14, eSawoti."Umsolwa uvelile eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseXobho ngoNovemba 22. Imibiko iveza ukuthi umgilwa wayebuya ukuyotheza izinkuni ngesikhathi edlwengulwa umsolwa," kusho uNetshiunda.
ZIYANDA izinkinga ezibhekene ne-ANC njengoba i-SACP isitshele le nhlangano ukuthi izimisele ukungenela ukhetho ngokuzimela ngo-2026.Lokhu kuvezwe nguNobhala jikelele wamaKhomanisi uMnuz Solly Mapaila, izolo esithangamini nabezindaba.AmaKhomanisi abenomhlangano wekomiti eliphezulu wokuhlelela ingqungquthela eyisipesheli ezoba ngoDisemba 11 kuya kuDisemba 14, eBirchwood Hotel eGoli. UMapaila uchazele izintatheli ngabakuxoxa nobuholi be-ANC."Lo mhlangano ne-ANC wathatha cishe uhhafu wosuku. Siyazisile i-ANC ukuthi sizimisele ukungenela ukhetho sisodwa. Sigcine sivumelene ngokuthi kumele sibuye sihlangane ngaphambi kokuphela kukaJanuwari, wonyaka ozayo ukuze sixoxe kabanzi,” kusho uMapaila.Usho lokhu nje akuqali ukuthi le nhlangano isabise ngokuthi izongenela ukhetho ngokuzimela ngoba ingeneme ngezinto ezithile.AmaKhomanisi asabisa ngalokhu nje, i-ANC isenkingeni kulandela ukwehlelwa ukwesekwa okhethweni lwalo nyaka lukazwelonke.Ukufika kweMK kwehlise ukwesekwa kwe-ANC kuzwelonke kwathi KwaZulu-Natal, yaphuma emandleni.IKZN isiphethwe ngokuhlanganyela namanye amaqembu okubalwa i-ANC, IFP, DA neNFP. Esikandunankulu siphethwe yi-IFP.AmaKhomanisi ahlale evota ngokuhlanganyela ne-ANC okhethweni.Uma egcina engenela ukhetho, lokhu kuyosho ukuthi i-ANC izoqhubeka nokulahlekelwa ukwesekwa."Sathatha isinqumo sokungenela ukhetho sisodwa ngonyaka odlule, kodwa sabuye sasimisa savota ne-ANC. Siyalungenela nakanjani ukhetho lohulumeni basekhaya ngo-2026,” kugcizelela uMapaila. UMapaila ubuye wakhala ngezinto ezihlupha abantu okuyindlala, ukungasebenzi, ubugebengu, udlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane, nezinye.Ubalule ukuthi bafuna uqhubeke umthetho wezikole osayiniwe iBela okunomsindo ngawo."Sifuna uqhubeke nomthetho womshwalense wezempilo. Sifuna le mithetho iqale isebenze ngokushesha.”Umengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ekhuluma izolo eThabazimbi eLimpopo, lapho bekunerali njengoba kulungiselelwa ukhetho lokuchibiyela kulandela ukuhlakazwa komkhandlu, uthe uma kuphela le nyanga singekho isivumelwano ngolwe-Bela, bazoqhubeka nalo mthetho njengoba unjalo.Uthe isivumelwano esisayinwe nguNgqongqoshe weMfundo eyisiSekelo uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, nenhlangano iSolidarity, asinamthelela ezinhlelweni eziqhubekayo zokuzama ukuthola isisombululo odabeni lwalo mthetho."Ngisamile ekutheni uma kuphela uDisemba, singekho isivumelwano mayelana nalo mthetho njengoba ngamisa okwesikhashana ukusebenza kwezigatshana ezimbili, uzoqhubeka njengoba wasayinwa. Ngifuna kulandelwe imigomo eqondile ukuthola isisombululo esithinta lo mthetho,” kusho uRamaphosa.Inkulu ingcindezi yokuthi lo mthetho uqale usebenze njengoba unjalo ezinhlakeni ezehlukene ezihambisana nawo.
BASAZOQHUBEKA nokuthwala kanzima abagibeli abasebenzisa amatekisi ahamba amabanga amade KwaZulu-Natal njengoba singenele osukwini lwesine isiteleka sawo.Osomatekisi bathi basalinde uMnyango wezokuThutha esifundazweni ngezikhalo zabo njengoba kusaqhubeka umdonsiswano wezimvume nokuboshwa kwezimoto zabo nguShanela.Isiteleka esiqale ngoLwesihlanu sishiye inqwaba yabagibeli isele dengwane.Abanye abagibeli bakhale ngokuthi baphuthwe izinto ezibalulekile obekumele bazenze.Abanye bekulindeleke ukuthi baye kwizinhlolokhono, emingcwabeni nakwezinye izindawo, kodwa bagcina bengahambanga ngenxa yokungabibikho kwezimoto.USihlalo we-Durban Long Distance Taxi Association, uMnuz Bhekisisa Nzuza, utshele Isolezwe ukuthi balinde abomnyango ukuthi bayafika yini ukuzobhunga ngalolu daba olusezithebeni."Lokhu abakhala ngakho abathi asikuqoqe ukuze sithole izimvume, sihlezi sikwenza. Siyazihambisa izinto kodwa singakutholi esisuke sikulindile. Njengoba sitelekile nje bathi asiqoqe wona amaphepha afanelekile, kodwa namanje azikaze ziphume izimvume. Njengoba sisalinde izimvume, uMphathiswa woMnyango uDuma (Siboniso) ukhipha amaphoyisa athi awayobopha izimoto zethu," kusho uNzuza.Uthe umnyango awubuye kuhlalwe phansi kuxoxiswane."Umphathiswa wazivumela yena ukuthi umnyango wakhe usephutheni. Umthetho uthi uma imoto uyibopha kumele uyinike ithikithi, kubhalwe ukuthi yikuphi okungekho emthethweni ekuphulile, uma umuntu engawulandeli lowo mthetho, kube sekukhishwa amaphoyisa ayobopha."Uthe isinqumo sokuthi bateleke saphuma esithangamini ababenaso eShowe ngoLwesithathu olwedlule. Uqhube wathi akusiwona usoseshini wase-Durban Station owaphuma naleso sinqumo kodwa kwaba inhlanganisela yososeshini nosomatekisi abalwa nale nkinga. Okhulumela uDuma, uMnuz Ndabezinhle Sibiya, ekhuluma ne-SABC, uthe zikhona izimvume zamatekisi ezingalandiwe."Ngo-Okthoba sikhiphe uhlu sicela ukuthi kulandwe izimvume. Ngingasho ngingananazi ukuthi zingu-5 000 izimvume ezingalandiwe emnyangweni. Kusezandleni zabamatekisi ukuthi balandele umthetho," kusho uSibiya.Uthe njengomnyango abanaso isizathu sokusenga ezimithiyo mayelana nalolu daba."Kunezikhulu zamatekisi ezisebenzisa umzila osuka eThekwini uya eGoli, nosuka eGoli uza eThekwini esezicele ukuhlangana nomphathiswa ngoba ziyaziqhelisa nalesi siteleka. Umphathiswa uphinde wahlangana nenhlangano eyengamele amatekisi i-Santaco, badingida kabanzi ngezinkinga ezithinta le mboni," usho kanje.Uthe iwindi lokufaka izicelo zezimvume livuliwe. Ubalule ukuthi izikhulu zamatekisi kumele zifike ne-PRDP yomshayeli wetekisi, isitifiketi esikhombisa ukuthi itekisi ikulungele ukuba semgwaqweni, i-log book kanye nemvume yaserenki eqhamuka kumasipala ukuze bathole izimvume zabo.
BABANJWE oqotsheni abasolwa abathathu endaweni yaseMadresini, eMondlo behlinza izinkomo ezebiwe.Ngokubika kwamaphoyisa aseMondlo abasolwa babanjwe behlinza izinkomo ezine ezebiwa esibayeni emzini oseMvunzini, eMondlo ngoLwesine mhla ka-28 Novemba 2024Amaphoyisa abikelwa ngokwebiwa kwale mfuyo, uphenyo lwawo lwawaholela emzini oseMadresini lapho kubanjwe khona abasolwa abathathu abaneminyaka engu-27, 38 no-39 bematasa.Bazovela enkantolo yeMantshi eFilidi ngoMsombuluko.
KUYAQHUBEKA ukungqubuzana phakathi kwezikhulu zamatekisi ahamba amabanga amade eDurban Long Distance Taxi Association, eDurban Station, eThekwini, noMnyango wezokuThutha KwaZulu-Natal. Izolo abamatekisi bakhethe ukungasebenzi bekhala ngokuboshwa kwezimoto zabo nguShanela kanye nokungalungi kwezimvume.ABAGIBELI bamatekisi amabanga amade besele dengwane erenki eDurban Station Isithombe: NHLAKANIPHO MNQAYIAbagibeli baphinde basala dengwane nemithwalo belinde ukuya ezindaweni ezahlukene kodwa lutho amatekisi, abezimele engalayishi.Iphini likaSihlalo weDurban Long Distance Taxi Association, uMnuz Mcabangeni Nala, likhuluma nabezindaba lithe, isinqumo sokumisa ukusebenza izolo siphume esithangamini ababe naso ngoLwesithathu."Sithathe isinqumo sokuthi sime ngoba sasikade sifake isicelo sokuthi asikhishelwe izimoto eziboshiwe, noShanela nawo ume ukubopha ukuze sithole izimvume kodwa lokho akwangenzeka. Into esiphatha kabi ukuthi sekunezimoto zawo amaphoyisa esezithutha abantu. Siyazibuza ukuthi zona zisuke seziyithole kuphi imvume. Okunye okusiphatha kabi wukuthi siyaboshwa thina kodwa kukhona abantu abathatha abantu kodwa izimvume bengenazo bangaboshwa,” kuchaza uNala.Uthe uMnyango wathi izimvume zikhona ebhodini kodwa uma bethi bayozilanda kuthiwa azikho."Uma bekhuluma kubantu bathi izimvume zikhona okuyinto eshayisanayo phakathi komnyango kanye nathi bamakhumbi. Asikakaphumi nesinqumo ukuthi sizoma kuze kube inini. Sizohlala phansi sixoxe nebandla, sibone ukuthi sifikaphi."Siyazwelana kakhulu nabagibeli ngoba abantu esiphilisana nabo. Nathi kusiphatha kabi uma sebethululiwe bemiswe emgwaqweni imoto ingafiki. Akukho nathi okusiphatha kabi njengalokho ngoba siyabathatha, bafike endleleni bethululwe phansi bangacatshangelwa nawuyena lo hulumeni thina sibe sibacabangela. Siyaxolisa ukuthi kugcina kuze kufike kulesi simo ukuthi kuhlukumezeke bona kungafanele. Asinachashaza nje nabo,” usho kanje.Uthe bacela uhulumeni akhiphe izimoto eziboshiwe ngoba ziyakhokha njengoba nabo befuna eyabo imali uma imoto beyibophile. Uthe izimoto zabo zigcine sezikhokha kathathu okuyinto engahlali kahle kumphathi wekhumbi. Uthe uma nje kungase uShanela ume ekubopheni izimoto zabo bephinde bethole izimvume ngeke behluphe muntu bengasebenza inguna phakade.UMnuz Reginald Jokweni ongumgibeli osuka eClermont, eya eNquthu, uthe kumphatha kabi ukuthi izimoto azihambi."Selokhu ngifike ekuseni namanje ngisalindile futhi angazi kuzoze kube into yanini. Ekhaya bangilindile njengoba kunomcimbi engiwuhlelayo kwazise ngiwumuntu othuthukisa amakhono. Uhulumeni kumele axoxisane nezikhulu zamatekisi ngoba ekugcineni thina siba yizinkuni zomlilo siyabaseka, sishe silimale ngenxa yokungqubuzana kwabo,” kusho uJokweni.Uthe ngeke babagxeke abamatekisi uma benza kanje ngoba banezimfuno zabo, izidingo zabo kanye nendlela ababuka ngayo. Abantu abalimalayo ekugcineni yibona. Eqhuba uthe kunabantu abebebiziwe kunhlolokhono kodwa abakwazi ukuya ndawo."Asazi sizoma la isikhathi esingakanani, siyalimala kakhulu njengosomabhizinisi kanye nabantu abasiza umphakathi”.Khonamanjalo uMphathiswa wezokuThutha nokuHlaliswa kwaBantu KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Sboniso Duma, uthe emhlanganweni odlule owabakhona nezikhulu zeDurban Long Distance Taxi Association, kwaba nethimba elajutshwa ukuthi licubungule konke okwakudingidwe esithangamini."Izinto iDurban Long Distance Taxi Association eyayikhale ngazo ziyacutshungulwa. Kunombiko okhona emnyangweni othi izimoto ezashaqwa yingoba zatholwa zisebenza zingenazo izimvume. Yingakho kuvele ukuthi lolu daba akuselona elomnyango kodwa selungaphansi komnyango wezoMthetho,” kusho uDuma.UMphathiswa uthe yingakho kubalulekile ukuthi lolu daba lusingathwe wumnyango futhi kubalulekile ukuthi lusingathwe ngobunono kube nezindlela zokuxoxisana njengoba azibophezela ukuthi kube khona ukusebenzisana.
INHLANGANO iTreatment Action Campaign (TAC) ifuna kuthi kuphela unyaka ube usukhona umhlahlandlela wokuthi luqala nini uhlelo lokunikezelwa kwemishanguzo yeHIV yezinyanga eziyisithupha, kulabo abayisebenzisayo ukuthithibalisa leli gciwane.Lokhu kuvele ohlwini lwezikhalo obelulethwe ile nhlangano koyiPhini likaMengameli uMnuz Paul Mashatile noNgqongoqshe wezeMpilo uDkt Aaron Motsoaledi, enkundleni yezemidlalo iSisa Dukashe, eMdantsane, e-Eastern Cape, lapho bekugujwa khona iWorld Aids Day.Ngaphambi kokunika uMashatile uhlu lwezikhalo, i-TAC imashe ngokuthula okwenze ukuthi uMashatile noMotsoaledi baqale bakhulume nabo ngaphambi kokuyokhuluma kulo mgubho kule nkundla. UNksz Belinda Setshogelo weTAC, uthe iningi labantu abaphila negciwane liyayiqala imishanguzo kodwa bese lima endleleni."Impi yethu yokulwa negciwane iphoxwa ukungasebenzi ngendlela efanele kwezempilo kuleli. Imitholampilo yethu ayikho esimeni. Sivuka ngovivi siye emitholampilo, kodwa kuze kushone ilanga kuyima sibonwa abezempilo,” kusho uNksz Setshogelo.Uqhube wathi okunye abahlangabezana nakho ukuthi uma beya emitholampilo kuthatha isikhathi eside ukuthi amafayela abo atholakale, amanye asuke eselahleke unomphela."Kulabo abasuke bephuthwe yizinsuku zabo zokulanda imishanguzo,kuthi uma sebeya, bathethiswe, babuyiselwe emuva kulayini okuyindlela yokubajezisa,” kusho uNksz Setshogelo, oveze nokuthi labo abathandana nabobulili obufana nobabo, abasebenzisa izidakamizwa nabadayisa ngomzimba, bacwaswa kubuka wonke umuntu."Abaningi bagcina beyeka ukuyolanda imishanguzo ngenxa yalezi zimo ezehlisa isithunzi. Yinye into egqamayo, ukuthi akekho umuntu ofuna ukuya emtholampilo njalo ngenxa yalezi zimo,” kusho uNksz Setshogelo.Uthe bafuna abasebenzisa imishanguzo banikwe eyesikhathi eside ukuze bengalokhu behla benyuka emitholampilo.Uthe lokhu kuzolungisa izinto eziningi, okukhona kuzo, ukugcwala kwemitholampilo, ukuma isikhathi eside umuntu elinde usizo nokumosheka kwemali umuntu egibela eyolanda imishanguzo njalo.Ephendula uMashatile uthe okufunwa yiTAC kuyawenza umqondo."Lokho kusho ukuthi uhulumeni uzoyenza le nto enikhala ngayo,” kusho uMashatile.Uthe uMotsoaledi useshilo ukuthi kungalekelela ekutheni babhekane kalula nomgomo wabo wokuthi kuthi kushaya u-2030, babe sebengu-95% abatheleleke ngegciwane, abadla imishanguzo.Kuvele ukuthi okwamanje ku-95% wabathelelekile, bangu-79% kuphela abayidlayo.UMashatile uthe bazimisele ukuthi kuthi kushaya u-2030 bebe sebeyinqobile impi yeHIV."Uma kusenalezi zinkinga, kusho ukuthi ngeke sikwazi ukufinyelela kwesithi sizimisele ngakho,” kusho uMashatile.Bangaphezu kuka-8 million abantu abanegciwane leHIV eNingizimu Afrika.UMotsoaledi unxuse abeTAC ukuba bangabanqumeli ogodweni ngomnqamulajuqu oseduze wokuthola izimpendulo ngoba kuningi okufanele kubhungwe ngakho.Uveze nokuthi kumele kukhuthazwe amadoda ezindaweni ajwayele ukuzihambela njengasezindaweni zokucima ukoma ukuthi ahambe ayohlolwa igciwane ngoba yiwona abalekayo.

KUNZIMA emndenini womfana wasoKhalweni, eMid Illovo, osekuphele amasonto amabili untanta eduze kolwandle ulinde ukuthi ludedele isidumbu sendodana yawo eminze ngeledlule eBrighton Beach, eManzimtoti.Umndeni kaPhiwokuhle Shandu (17), uthi kumanje awusabulali nobuthongo ngoba uvuka uyohlala olwandle zonke izinsuku ulinde isidumbu sendodana yawo.Umfana ominzile kuthiwa ubeye kobhukuda olwandle nabangani bakhe ngesikhathi ethathwa yigagasi emva kokucela abangani bakhe ukuthi bamshuthe ividiyo esemanzini.Udadewabo kaPhiwokuhle, uLondi Shandu, uthe akukho abangakwenzile bengumndeni ukuze kutholakale umfowabo."Umfowethu washona ehambe nabangani bakhe beyobhukuda olwandle. Bebeke baye olwandle kodwa kulokhu asazi kwenzekeni. Ngelanga amuke ngalo nolwandle, abangani bakhe bathi ucele ukuthi bamshuthe ividiyo esemanzini. Bathe ngesikhathi besamshutha kuvele kwaqhamuka igagasi elikhulu elivele lamthatha. Besamangazwe yilokho bambonile esentanta emanzini, kwasho ukuthi nabo bayasaba ukungena emanzini ngendlela okwenzeke ngayo. Bathe kuze kwaba khona ikhaladi elalibhukuda nalo ngalolo suku elizamile ukuyombamba. Lifike kuyena lacela ukuthi abambelele kulona kodwa amanzi abaxaka bobabili lagcina lumthathile ulwandle ngoba nalo ikhaladi bese liphelelwe amandla,” kusho uLondi.Okhulumela amaphoyisa kwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda uthe: "Uphiko lwamaphoyisa iSearch and Rescue yaseThekwini, ibizwe eBrighton Beach ngomhlaka 19 Novemba 2024, emva kokuthi kunowesilisa obenenkinga ebhukuda, waminza. Ukuthungatha lo wesilisa kuqale kuGarvies kuya ebhishi eMkomazi, nokuthathe izinsuku ezinhlanu. Kuze kwalethwa neDrone ne-helicopter nama-vessel, ukuthungatha ominzile kodwa wangatholakala. Kugcine kumisiwe ukuthungathwa kwakhe kuze kubakhona okusha okuvelayo ngaye,” usho kanje.ULondi uthe iyaqala ukwenzeka lento emndenini wakhe. Uveze ukuthi okubuhlungu kakhulu, ukuthi kuke kwabakhona umtshuzi ozimele ongene emanzini ngenhloso yokubheka phansi emanzini wafica isidumbu abakholwa ukuthi esikamfowabo."Umtshuzi lo udlule simile eduze kolwandle wangena emanzini. Uma esebuya ubuze ukuthi silindeni. Simtshelile ukuthi kuminze umfowethu. Ube esesitshela ukuthi sikhona isidumbu asibonile phansi emanzini sowesilisa ogqoke isikhindi esibomvu wagunda nesiChicco, futhi ulimele ebusweni. Uthe sigaxele ematsheni kodwa akakwazi ukusikhipha ngoba kunemithetho elawula ukukhishwa kwabantu emanzini,”kuchaza yena.Uthe njengoba behlala besolwandle baguduza yonke indawo kanti nemoto kamasipala ike ibalekelele ukubahambisa ezindaweni lapho ulwandle luhlala lukhafulela khona okusuke kumukile kodwa isidumbu sikamfowabo alukasidedeli njengoba bengasitholi.UPhiwokuhle kuthiwa ungumagcino ezinganeni zakwabo eziyisikhombisa.
NKOSIKHONA CELEUSHAYE phansi ngonyawo izolo eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini, uNongcebo Faith Ntombela owavuma icala lokubulala umyeni wakhe, wathi akafuni ukugwetshwa phambi kwezingane zakhe ezintathu.UFaith wahlela ukubulala umyeni wakhe uCaptain Zwelakhe Thomas Ntombela owadutshulwa esemzini wakhe okwa-S, eMlaza ngoMeyi 3 ngonyaka odlule. IMBIBIZANE kumaNazaretha aseGinyezinye, abezimisele ngokuqwala kuqala intaba eNgcwele iNhlangakazi ngoJanuwari, echithwa yiNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini, njengoba sekumele kube yiwona anyuka kugcina.INkantolo eNkulu ichithe isicelo sikaNgqogqoshe wamaPhoyisa waseNingizimu Afrika, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu esicelweni abesifake enkantolo ngohlelo lokunyuka intaba kwamaNazaretha ngoJanuwari.Ngokwesicelo sikangqongqoshe, bese kunohlelo obelwakhiwe obelubeka phambili abaseGinyezinye, ukuthi yibona abazonyuka kuqala.Kulesi sicelo ungqongqoshe ubenxusa nokuthi kuhlelwe izinsuku zokunyuka intaba ngokushintshana kuze kufike u-2030. Lokho kungenxa yokuthi njalo uma sekumele kunyukwe intaba kuba nomsindo ngozonyuka kuqala.Ngemva kwezethulo ezenziwe ngabameli enkantolo izolo, begqamisa ukubaluleka kwalolu hambo, bakubeke kwacaca ukuthi ungqongqoshe akakwazi ukuthathela amaNazaretha isinqumo.Ijaji ebelisingethe leli cala, uMuzikawukhelwana Ncube, lizamukele izethulo zabameli lase likhipha isinqumo."Asikho isidingo sokuthi kwenziwe uhlelo oluzoze lufike ku-2030. Okwamanje singakhuluma ngo-2025 kuphela ngoba asizazi izimo ukuthi zizobe zinjani eminyakeni elandelayo. Asikwazi ukuthi sinqume ukuthi uhlelo lume ngale ndlela okucelwa ngayo ekubeni ikusasa lingaziwa,” kusho iJaji uNcube.Libe selikhipha isinqumo sokuthi abebengabesibili banyuke kuqala, lase liyalela amaNazaretha ukuthi ahlale phansi axoxisane ewodwa ngalokho ngenxa yokuthi uhambo lwasentabeni lungolwamakholwa.Ngokohlelo olusha emva kwesinqumo senkantolo, abasekuPhakameni abaholwa yiNkosi Vukile Shembe Incoyincoyi, bazonyuka ngoJanuwari 2, babuye ngomhlaka 8, abaseBuhleni abaholwa yiNkosi uMduduzi Shembe uNyazilwezulu, bazonyuka ngoJanuwari 5, baze babuye ngomhlaka 24, kuthi abaseThembezinhle abaholwa yiNkosi Phinda Shembe Ukukhanyakwelanga, banyuke ngoJanuwari 9, babuye ngomhlaka 15 bese kugcina iGinyezinye ezonyuka ngoJanuwari 16, ibuye ngomhlaka 22.AbaseBuhleni banalezi zinsuku ezikhethekile ngoba vele abasayi entabeni iNhlangakazi, kodwa iNkosi uNyazilwezulu lwahlonza iKhenana lamaNazaretha, okuyintaba entsha azonyukela kuyona ngoJanuwari amaNazaretha angaphansi kwakhe.Okwenza amaNazaretha oNyazi abe sohlwini lwezingxoxo kungenxa yokuthi wonke amaNazaretha asebenzisa indlela eyodwa uma kuyiwa entabeni bese wona ehluka uma esenyukela eKhenana.Kuthintwa uMfundii Joseph Mhlongo waseGinyezenye, uthe okwamanje akukho abazokuphawula ngesinqumo kuze kube abameli babo babathulela lonke udaba oluqhubeke enkantolo.Inhlalisuthi yoNyazilwezulu, uMnuz Lizwi Ncwane, uthe bajabule kakhulu ngesinqumo."Okuphinde kusijabulise kakhulu ukuthi usuku ebesithe sizonyuka ngalo aluzange luphazamiseke. Isicelo sikangqongqoshe sihlehliselwe usuku olungaziwa,” kusho uNcwane.UMshumayeli Thetha Ngiba wasekuPhakameni, uthe abaseGinyezinye bazoba ekugcineni njengoba vele behlala beba ekugcineni uma kunyukwa intaba. Sethemba ukuthi noma sesixoxisana singamakholwa, abaseKuphakameni, bazohlala kuyibona abanyuka kuqala intaba njengoba kuhlala kwenzeka," kusho uMshumayeli uNgiba.
BAKHALIMA iminyango kahulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal, esaqhubeka nokusaphaza izabelomali. Muva nje, kubikwe ukuthi iminyango kahulumeni wesifundazwe izosebenzisa ngokweqile izabelo zayo ngo-R8 billion.Amalungu esiShayamthetho athe ukusebenzisa kweminyango ngokweqile izabelo zemali kukhombisa ukungaphathwa ngendlela kwezimali zomphakathi.Lokhu akusho ngesikhathi kunenkulumo mpikiswano esiShayamthetho, lapho bekubhekwa umbiko wamaphakathi nonyaka wokusetshenziswa kwezimali emnyangweni kahulumeni wesifundazwe. Umbiko uveze ukuthi uMnyango wezeMpilo uzosebenzisa ngokweqile isabelomali sakulo nyaka ngo-R4.7 billion.UMnyango wezeMfundo wona uzosebenzisa ngokweqile isabelomali sawo ngo-R2.3 billion.Ilungu leMK, uMnuz Phumlani Mfeka, lithe iyathusa indlela iminyango ephethe ngayo izimali, lathi bafuna zithathelwe izinyathelo izikhulu eziphatha budedengu izimali zomphakathi."Laba bantu bafike bethula isabelomali sabo lapha esiShayamthetho, bese siyaphasiswa. Kuthi uma sebesitholile, bese bengasisebenzisi ngendlela. Akusibona yini ubugebengu lobu? Sifuna aboshwe amaqili ngoba phela akukho qili lazikhotha emhlane.”UMfeka uthe ezinye izikhulu eziphethe iminyango aziwazi umsebenzi wazo."Abanye babo abawuhloniphi umsebenzi, abantu abafuna ukuxoshwa nje.”Ilungu le-EFF, uMnuz Mongezi Thwala, lithe okubakhathazayo ukuthi azithathelwa izinyathelo izikhulu ezihluleka ukusebenzisa izimali ngendlela."Kuyaqhubeka ukungalandelwa kwemithetho kodwa asingaze singezwa kuthiwa kukhona abathathelwe izinyathelo.”Ilungu le-IFP, uMnuz Satishrai Bhanprakash, lithe iminyango kahulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal kufanele ibophe izifociya."Ikakhulukazi ngoba nakhu uMnyango kaMgcinimafa kuzwelonke usushilo ukuthi ayikho imali eyengeziwe ozosinikeza yona. Iminyango kufanele ibeke phambili izinto ezibalulekile.”Ilungu leDA, uMnuz Tim Brauteseth, lithe kufanele isiphulwe nezimpande zayo inkohlakalo eholela ekubhubhudlweni kwezimali zomphakathi.UMphathiswa wezezimali, uMnuz Francios Rodgers, uthe bakhathazekile ngokusetshenziswa ngokweqile kwezimali eminyangweni kahulumeni wesifundazwe.Uthe bazolekelela iminyango owezeMpilo, nowezeMfundo inciphise imali ezoyisebenzisa ngokweqile."Ngibe nomhlangano nezikhulu zomnyango wami. Odabeni loMnyango wezeMpilo nowezeMfundo, ngingasho ukuthi kukhona okwenzekayo. Ngingasho ukuthi isinciphile imali okubhekwe ukuthi bayisebenzise ngokweqile. Ngibonga kakhulu kubo bonke abaphathiswa esibambisene nabo, abasebenza ngokuzikhandla, benza isiqiniseko sokuthi uhulumeni wesifundazwe awuguqi ngamadolo.”
NKOSIKHONA CELEUTUSA uNkulunkulu ngokuqokwa kohlelo lwakhe lwezenkolo kowezindondo umsakazi weVuma 103 FM, obuye abe nguMfundisi, uPhumlani Nkwanyana.Uhlelo lukaNkwanyana olwenza kahle kakhulu iMega Grace Hour, luqokwe kwiNgoma Gospel Awards kumunxa weBest National Radio Show.Abafisa ukuvotela uhlelo olujwayela ukuba nabefundisi abehlukene bangathumela umusho othi:NATIONAL RADIO SHOW-MEGA GRACE HOUR,' enombolweni ethi: 34155.Lolu hlelo lungena njalo ngoMsombuluko kuya kuLwesihlanu ngehora lesihlanu kuya kwelesithupha.Echaza kabanzi ngohlelo, uNkwanyana uthe lubuyisa ithemba ebantwini ngezintshumayelo ezahlukene ezisuke zenziwa ngabefundisi bamahlelo ehlukene.''Lwaziwa kakhulu ngokuba nezinceku zenkosi ezahlukene ezisuke zizoshumayela ngenhloso yokubuyisa ithemba ebantwini zisebenzisa izwi leNkosi,'' usho kanjena.Uveze ukuthi uhlelo lwaqala ukuba khona ngoDisemba 23, 2019. Uthe kusukela lapho abantu bayaluthanda kakhulu.Uveze ukuthi sekuhlangene iminyaka emihlanu uhlelo lwabakhona futhi luthakaselwa ngabantu abaningi kakhulu. "Inhloso enkulu yalo ukukhuthaza abantu ukuze bavuke ekuseni begcwele ukuzethemba,’’ echaza uNkwanyana.Uthe luzoba nendumezulu yenkonzo yokugubha ukuqeda iminyaka uhlelo lwasungulwa. Umcimbi wokugubha lokhu ubizwa ngokuthi yi-Ebenezer uzoba eThekwini.''Kuyangijabulisa kakhulu ukuqokwa kowezindondo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abantu bayawubona umsebenzi wami omuhle engiwenzayo,'' usho kanje. Ubonge nabaphathi beVuma ngokumethemba.Umcimbi omkhulu wokuklonyeliswa kwabenze kahle uzokuba ngoDisemba 8, esontweni iCommunio, eMbombela.
UMNYANGO weMfundo eyisiSekelo uzoqhubeka nokushicilela imiphumela yabafundi baka-matric emaphephandabeni ngonyaka ozayo.Lokhu ukwenza phezu kokuba uhlaka i-Information Regulator, lwakhipha umyalelo wokuthi lo mnyango uyeke ukushicilela imiphumela emaphepheni ngoba akuhambisani nomthetho othinta ukugcinwa kolwazi lwabantu, i-Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA).Lolu hlaka lufuna ukuthi umnyango uqale uthole imvume yokuthi idedelwe le miphumela emaphepheni kubona bonke abafundi noma abazali babafundi abenza u-matric.UNgqongqoshe walo mnyango, uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, uthe bayaqhubeka njengokujwayelekile okungukushicilela imiphumela emaphepheni.Uthe bakwenza lokhu ngoba kunesinqumo senkantolo, esaphoqa umnyango ukuthi uyishicilele.I-AfriForum yaya enkantolo ifuna umnyango uqhubeke nokushicilela imiphumela emva kokuba umnyango wanquma ukuthi uyeke ukuyishicilela.Le nhlangano yathi abafundi basuke bekude nezikole zabo, abanye basuke bengekho ngisho ezifundazweni zabo ngakho kubalulekile ukuthi imiphumela ishicilelwe."Sihlabela phambili nokushicilela imiphumela kuze kube kuguqulwa isinqumo senkantolo eyathi kumele siyishicilele. Asiqinisi amakhanda noma sidaza inkani ngokuyishicilela kodwa silandela umthetho wezwe,” kusho uNksz Gwarube.Uthe uma inkantolo inquma ukuthi ingashicilelwa, bayolandela lowo myalelo.Uveze ukuthi ukushicilelwa kwale miphumela akukhona ngoba behlose ukudalula imiphumela yabafundi."Asidedeli lonke ulwazi lwabafundi njengoba amagama abo singawakhiphi. Sikhipha kuphela izinombolo abebebhala ngazo.” Uthe abafundi bayakwazi ukuthola imiphumela yabo noma bekuphi ngokuyishicilela."Baningi abasizakala ngalolu hlelo ngoba abanye abafundi basuke bengekho eduzane nalapho befunda khona. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukuyithola noma bekuphi,” kuqhuba uNksz Gwarube.UDkt Rufus Poliah obhekele izivivinyo emnyangweni, uthe bathole umbono wezomthetho mayelana nalolu daba lwemiphumela.Uthe lo mbono uhambisane nabakhokhelwa kukhona ukuthi baqhubeke nokuyishicilela le miphumela."Abafundi abakude bayakwazi ukuyithola noma bekuphi. Akekho umuntu okwazi ukubona imiphumela yomunye noma seyishicileliwe,” kusho uPoliah.Uthe baphoqwa ngumthetho ukuthi baqhubeke nokuyishicilela.Kwenzeka lokhu nje, uMphathiswa wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka, uthe zihambe kahle izivivinyo kulesi sifundazwe.Uthe sekubhekwe ohlelweni lokumakela u-matric okuqala ngeSonto."Akubanga nokuputshuka kwamaphepha noma izinto ezimbi ezenzekile. Siyajabula ukuthi lezi zivivinyo ziphothulwe ngaphandle kwezihibe,” kusho uHlomuka.
KUQASHWE abasebenzi ababalelwa ku-15 000 abazobhekisisa ukuthi amakwe ngendlela amaphepha aka-matric.Laba bayingxenye yabasebenzi ababalelwa ku-70 000 abaqashelwe ukusebenza ezikhungweni zokumakela u-matric kuleli, njengoba kuqale uhlelo lokumaka ngempelasonto.Kulaba kunothisha abamakayo abangu-52 395.Lokhu kuvezwe nguDkt Rufus Poliah, isikhulu esibhekele izivivinyo eMnyangweni weMfundo eyisiSekelo, othe bafuna kungabikhona amaphutha emaphepheni amakiwe."Siqashe laba basebenzi ukuze basize ngalesi sikhathi esibucayi sokumaka. Angu-14 million amamaki azofakwa emakhompyutheni ngakho akumele kube nephutha,” kusho uPoliah, othe zingu-181 izikhungo zokumakela ezweni.Ukusho lokhu izolo, ekhuluma esithangamini sabezindaba mayelana nokubhalwa kwezika-matric.Namhlanje ingcosana yabafundi kuleli izophinde ibhale izivivinyo ze-Computer kanjalo neze-IT ngenxa yokuthi yaphazamiseka ngesikhathi kubhalwa okokuqala lezi zivivinyo.Ingxenye eningi yabafundi abaphindayo baphazanyiswa ngugesi ngesikhathi bebhala lezi zivivinyo kanti minyaka yonke umnyango unohlelo lokuthi laba abaphazamiseka baphinde babhale uma sekuphothulwa lezi zivivinyo.Umqondisi jikelele emnyangweni, uMnuz Mathanzima Mweli, uthe batholele enye indawo yokubhalela abanye abafundi base-Eastern Cape abakhahlanyezwa yizimpi zezigodi, wathi bakwenza lokhu ngoba bafuna wonke umfundi athole ithuba lokubhala izivivinyo zabo. UNgqongqoshe walo mnyango, uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, uthe sebengena kwelinye igiya elibalulekile lokumakela u-matric.Uveze ukuthi umshikashika wokubhala kwabafundi abevile ku-800 000, uphothuliwe izolo."Zibekhona izehlakalo ezingezinhle ezigubuzele izivivinyo okubalwa ukudlwengulwa kwabafundi ababezobhala e-Eastern Cape. Kunabafundi abaphazamiseka ngenxa yokuthi bagula, omunye kwadingeka athole usizo lozombhalela emuva kokulimala esandleni, okwenza wangakwazi ukuzibhalela.” Uthe kwezinye izindawo kwaba nemibhikisho yomphakathi, wathi e-EC bangu-319, abafundi abaphazamiseka ngenxa yezikhukhula."Laba bafundi benzelwa ezinye izinhlelo zokuthi babhale. Kwasiza amathimba ezinhlekelele ezindaweni ezehlukene.” UNksz Gwarube uthe bazoqapha ngelokhozi izinto ezithinta ukudla ezikhungweni zokumaka ukuze kunqandwe ukugula kwabazobe besebenza.Uthe abashodi abamakayo ezikhungweni zokumakela.UPoliah uthe zikhona izehlakalo lapho kwagula khona ababemaka."Sikhona isehlakalo lapho kwashona khona owayemaka. Sizoqapha ngelokhozi ukuthi azikho izehlakalo ezimbi ezenzeka ezikhugweni zokumaka,” kusho uPoliah. Unxuse abafundi ukuthi babhiyoze bazibheke njengoba bephothule u-matric."Siyabanxusa ukuthi bangazihlanganisi nemibhiyozo yokuwisa amapeni bephothula ukubhala u-matric. Bangabhiyoza kodwa bakwenze lokhu bephephile,” kusho uNksz Gwarube.UDkt Reginah Mhaule oyiPhini likaNgqongqoshe lihambe emazwini kaNksz Gwarube ngokuthi abafundi kumele baziphathe kahle uma sebebhiyoza.Uthe likhona elinye ithuba lokuthi baphinde babhale uma bengenzanga kahle.

Nabo kufanele bahlomule ezinhlelweni zentuthuko.”UButhelezi uthatha isinqumo sokuyosebenzela oLundi nje ahlukene phakathi amaqembu aphethe ngokubambisana ngodaba lokubuyela kwesiShayamthetho oLundi.Ngesikhathi kubhekwe okhethweni lwangoMeyi amaqembu i-IFP neNFP ayethembise ukuthi isiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal sizobuyela oLundi.I-ANC neDA bayaphikisana nombono wokuthi isiShayamthetho sibuyele oLundi.Ngesikhathi ikhabhinethi laKwaZulu-Natal liyokotha iSilo, uNdunankulu, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, wathi basazoluxoxa lolu daba.

Sifuna baboshwe nalabo abadayisa ukudla okubulala nokugulisa abantu bethu, ikakhulu izingane. Sifelwa yizingane eziguliswa ukudla okungalungile okudayiswa ezitolo ezehlukene,” kusho uNksz Tolashe.Ukusho lokhu kukhukhulelangoqo wemashi ebihlelwe yilolu phiko ehlanganisa namanye amaqembu ezepolitiki ahlukene, izinhlangano ezehlukene nezentsha kanti ibibhekiswe ezindlini zoMbuso ePitoli, ukulwa neyodlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane.Uthe baneme ngendlela uhulumeni alusukumele ngayo udaba lwabokufika abangenazo izimvume."Sihlaba nekhwelo lokuthi kubhekisiswe indaba yezibhamu ezingekho emthethweni. Lwenze kahle ukuthi lumashe ukuze kuliwe nesihlava sokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane,” kusho uMbalula.UNgqongqoshe ehhovisi likamengameli obhekele abesifazane, intsha nabantu abaphila nokukhubazeka, uNkk Sindisiwe Chikunga, uncome umkhankaso wophiko lwabesifazane lwe-ANC ngokumasha ukulwa nalesi sihlava sokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane kuleli.Uthe lolu dlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane lwenziwa abantu esisondelene nabo."Sincane kakhulu isibalo sabesifazane ababika amacala okuhlukunyezwa. U-2% kuphela wabesifazane abahlukunyezwayo ababikayo. Babalelwa ku-7.8 million abesifazane abahlukunyezwayo kuleli,” kusho uNkk Chikunga.Uthe bakhona nabesifazane abahlukumeza abesilisa kodwa ababaningi."Ayiphele eyalolu dlame noma kuthiwa kwenziwa ngabesifazane noma ngabesilisa. Yimpi okumele siyilwe ize iqedwe.”Uncome uphiko ngokubamba imashi ngesikhathi sezinsuku ezingu-16, zokulwa nesihlava sokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane.

SITHI Halala! kulaba bafundi beSolezwe asebeziwinele amavawusha egilosa akwaSPAR enani lika-R 2 500 umuntu ngamunye, uyozititilizela ngamanani aphansi eBlack Friday. KUGQUGQUZELWA abantu ukuba bakhithize babuye nganeno endalini yeBlack Friday ezoqala ngoLwesihlanu, ize iphele ngesonto elizayo.Ngokusho kukaMnuz Carl Velusamy onguMphathi weMancosa School of Public Administration, ngonyaka odlule abantu baseNingizimu Afrika, bathenga izikhawu eziwu-1.4 million endalini yeBlack Friday bangenisa uR1.39 billion. Lokhu kusho ukuthi bathenga kakhulu uma kuqhathaniswa no-2022 lapho basebenzisa uR1 billion.Ubalule ukuthi ucwaningo lweBankServ Africa, luveza ukuthi abantu bakuleli baqala ukuthenga phakathi kwamabili uma kuzosa kube wuLwesihlanu lweBlack Friday njengoba bathenga izikhawu eziwu-30 770, online, kwathi phakathi kuka-10 ekuseni kuya ku-11 emini bathenga izikhawu eziwu-93 814.UNkk Nidia Lourens oyiSenior Actuary eMetropolitan, ucele abantu baseNingizimu Afrika, ukuba bakhithize babuye nganeno ngoba ezinye izipesheli zisuke zingezona izipesheli zangempela.Ubalule ukuthi uma umuntu wayengahlosile ukuthenga ngeBlack Friday akufanele adidiswe yizipesheli ezikhangiswayo bese ethenga konke okusesipeshelini.Abantu kufanele bacabangisise uma bezothenga ngosuku lweBlack Friday, baluthathe njengezinye izinyanga ezijwayelekile. Uthi kumele baqinisekise ukuthi babeka imali abayonga nyanga zonke, babeke eyezidingo nenye abahlale bezihlelele yona."Abantu kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi izipesheli bayazibhekisisa ngoba izitolo zenza isiqiniseko sokuthi zizoheha abathengi ngoba zisuke zihlose ukwenza inzuzo yangempela. Kufanele impahla ofuna ukuyithenga uyibheke kusaqala unyaka ukuthi iyimalini ukuze uma sekufika iBlack Friday uzobona ukuthi isesipeshelini sangempela yini,” kweluleka uNksz Lourens.Uqhube wathi esikhundleni sokukhithiza, onezikweletu kufanele akhokhele zona noma ayofaka imali esikhwameni esizomenzela inzuzo ngokuhamba kweminyaka.Uthe zonke izinhlelo abantu abafisa ukuzenza kufanele bazinameke obondeni noma efrijini ukuze bezozikhumbula bese bezifeza.Udonse abantu ngokuthi bangathengi lutho ngesikweletu ngoBlack Friday ngoba lokhu kuzobadalela izinkinga.Inkampani elwa nokuqolwa kwabantu iPositive Technologies ixwayise abantu ukuba baqaphele uma bethenga kumakhompyutha (online) ngoba iNingizimu Afrika, ihamba phambili ekuqolweni kwabantu ngamakhompyutha ngo-22% e-Afrika, bese ilandelwa yi-Egypt ngo-13%. Kuvela ukuthi ama-website abantu abasuke behlela ukuqola ngawo maningi aqola abaseNingizimu Afrika, ngoba awu-25%, kulandela iNigeria ngo-18%, kuze i-Algeria ngo-13%.Uthe izigebengu ezintshontsha imininingwane ezinkampanini zikahulumeni zigadla kakhulu eNigeria 27%, Algeria 17%, Ethiopia 12% naseNingizimu Afrika 12%.UMnuz Chris Boxall, oyiNhloko yezokuthenga ngamakhadi eFNB obuye alwe nokuqolwa kwabantu, uthe abantu kufanele baqaphe uma bethenga ngamakhadi online ngoba namaqola ahlale efuna intuba yokubaqola.Uthe abantu kufanele bazijwayeze ukuthenga besebenzisa ama-virtual cards online ngoba wona ashintsha njalo iCard Verification Value (CVV) okuyizinamba ezisekugcineni ezihambisana nekhadi lomuntu, nomuntu.Ucele abantu ukuthi bangakhiphi imininingwane yabo eyimfihlo okubalwa ama-pin, password, OTP nokunye okusuke kwaziwa yibona bodwa.Uthe akufanele bangene kuma-links athunyelwe online, nakuma-sms.

YINQWABA yabasolwa abafe bedubulana namaphoyisa ezigamekweni ezehlukene ezenzeke KwaZulu-Natal, phakathi kuka-Agasti noNovemba kulo nyaka.Ekhuluma esithangamini nabezindaba eThekwini, uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa kulesi sifundazwe, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, uthe bangu-45 abasolwa abafe ezigamekweni ezingu-22 kudutshulwana. SITHOLE uchatha kaR10 million isikhwama esibhekelele izidingo zeSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini nendlunkulu kaZulu, iZulu Royal Household Trust.IZulu Royal Household Trust inikezwe imali eyengeziwe ukuze ikhokhele izindleko zabameli beSilo, ibhekane nezindleko zokwanda kohlu lwabahlomula esikhwameni.Ukwengezwa kwemali kumenyezelwe nguMphathiswa wezeZimali, uMnuz Francios Rodgers, ngesikhathi ethula isabelomali saphakathi nonyaka wezimali, asethule izolo esiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal.Ekuqaleni konyaka wezimali isikhwama sabelwa u-R77.5 million ngesikhathi uNdunankulu uMnuz Thami Ntuli, ethula isabelomali sehhovisi lakhe.URodgers uthe amacala ombango wesihlalo sobukhosi bukaZulu enze ukuba isikhwama sidinge imali eyengeziwe.Uthe nokufakwa kondlunkulu beSilo uMisuzulu ohlwini lwabahlomulayo nakho kwandise izindleko.Isikhwama siphinde sibhekelele izidingo zondlunkulu nabantwana beSilo uGoodwill Zwelithini kaBhekuzulu.URodgers uthe umthetho uyabaphoqa ukuba bazikhokhele lezi zindleko.Uqhube wathi ukuba kuya ngaye ngabe indlunkulu izingenisela imali ngamabhizinisi, nathe bekuzokwenza ukuthi ingalindi ukunikwa imali uhulumeni."Yingakho nje kade nginomhlangano neMbube, lapho sikhulume khona ngezithinta ezamabhizinisi. Kusukela ngiseseqenjini eliphikisayo, bangihlezi ngiyishumayela eyokuthi kubalulekile ukuthi iSilo sibe namabhizinisi ukuze singezukulinda osopolitiki."Ngikholelwa kakhulu kwezolimo, nezokuvakasha. Ngifuna sibe nezinhlelo zokubuyisa izivakashi eziqhamuka eBritain. Lezi zivakashi bezifika lapha, zivakashele eThekwini, eziqiwini kanye nalapho kwalwa khona izimpi zamaNgisi. Ngifuna zibuye lezo zivakashi,” kuchaza umphathiswa.URodgers uqhube wamemezela ukuchathazelwa kweminyango ehlukene.Umnyango wezeMfundo wengezelwe ngo-R95 million ukubhekelela uhlelo lokuphakelwa kwabafundi ezikoleni.URodgers uthe imali eyabelwe lolu hlelo ayanele ukubhekelela bonke abafundi abahlomula ngaphansi kohlelo.Umnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana kanye neziNdaba zoMdabu wengezelwe ngoR69.3 million.Kule mali kukhona uR35.1 million wokuqedela uhlelo lokukhokhwa kwesikweletu sezinduna, noR30 million wokulungiswa kwamatransformer kagesi ezindaweni esezihlale isikhathi eside zingenawo ugesi.Lawa matransformer angaphezu kuka-200 aseThekwini, uMgungundlovu, Ugu, ILembe, naseMkhanyakude.URodgers uthe uhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal uthathe isinqumo sokukhokhela amatransformer ngenxa yokwanda kwemibhikisho yabantu abakhala ngokuhlala isikhathi eside bengenawo ugesi. Uphethe ngokuth ngenxa yesimo sezimali esingesihle, abakwazanga ukwengezela yonke iminyango ebicele ukwengezelwa.
