SICHITHIWE isicelo sokuba kuhoxiswe amacala awu-18 okubulala ebesifakwe yisiboshwa esisolwa ngokuba ungqondongqondo ekubulaweni kwabafi eNgobozana, eLusikisiki, ngoSepthemba nonyaka.Ummangalelwa wesikhombisa, uMzukisi Ndamase, osehlale ejele kusuka ngo-2007 ngokubulala iphoyisa, uvele nabanye abayisithupha eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseLusikisiki, ngoLwesibili.UMNUZ Songezo 'Mashiya’ Vuma ofunwa amaphoyisa ase-Eastern Cape ngezinsolo zokuthi uyathinteka ekubulaweni kwabantu abangu-18 eLusikisiki Isithombe: SAPSUsukume wama ngezinyawo ebhokisini labamangalelwa, wazikhulumela ngomlomo wakhe, ecela ukuthi uMbuso uwahoxise wonke amacala athweswe wona."Sengihlale ejele kusukela ngo-2007, kuze kube manje akaze ngiphume ngiye ngaphandle. Bengilokhu ngisejele okuyindawo kahulumeni. UMbuso uyazi ukuthi ngangikuphi ngosuku kwenzeka isigameko, angizange ngiye kwenye indawo,” kusho uNdamase.Sichithiwe isicelo sikaNdamase uMbuso. Umshishisi utshele imantshi ukuthi lesi siboshwa sichaza indaba endala futhi eyaziwayo.Utshele inkantolo ukuthi uMbuso uhlabela phambili nokushushisa uNdamase kuwona wonke amacala athweswe wona.Amaphoyisa ase-Eastern Cape athi asekhiphe umehlokaboni ka-R50 000 afuna umsolwa wesishiyagalolunye uMnuz Songezo 'Mashiya’ Vuma anenkolelo yokuthi sekushoda yena kuphela.Beziqiniswe amaphoyisa nojele ezokuphepha enkantolo. UNdamase ufike enkantolo efaswe izandla ngozankosi, zaboshelwa okhalweni ngamaketango abeze ayobopha nezinyawo.Usevalelwe ejele elingelinye lagadwe kakhulu eBhongweni, eKokstad. Usolwa ngokukhanda itulo esejele lokubulawa kwabantu abangu-18 ababelungisela umcimbi wokumbulwa kwetshe.
UMPHATHISWA wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, ubheke ukuthi amaphoyisa aqhubeke nokukhuculula kuMasipala waKwaNongoma.UButhelezi uthe uyakwamukela ukuboshwa kwabaholi bomkhandlu iMeya, uMnuz Mshangane Ndabandaba, iPhini leMeya, uMnuz Sabelo Nkosi, uSomlomo, uNkk Babongile Sithole nezikhulu zomkhandlu.Lokhu ukusho izolo ngesikhathi enomhlangano namakhansela akulo mkhandlu.UButhelezi uthe bewumnyango abahambisani nenkohlakalo, wancoma amaphoyisa ngokubopha laba baholi abasolakala enkohlakalweni."Siwashayela ihlombe amaphoyisa ngokubopha abantu abaphambene nomthetho. Siyathemba ukuthi ingalo yomthetho izobenza ubulungiswa, size sithole umyombo wale nto. Siyawakhuthaza amaphoyisa ukuthi aqhubeke nokukhuculula ngoba thina njengohulumeni sinesibopho sokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi intuthuko iya ebantwini ngaphandle kwenkohlakalo.”UButhelezi uthe kuyaqala emlandweni wakuleli lizwe ukuba kuboshwe imeya, iphini lemeya nosomlomo. Laba baholi baqhamuka kwi-NFP, EFF ne-ANC.Amaqembu abo azwakalise ukubeseka ngesikhathi bevele enkantolo kepha uButhelezi uxwayise amakhansela akulo mkhandlu ukuba ayeke ukuhambe ezwakalisa ukweseka abaholi ababoshiwe.UButhelezi uthe amakhansela awanalo igunya lokuhamba ekhuluma izindaba zomkhandlu.Abaholi bomkhandlu baboshwe nesikhulu sezezimali, uMnuz Njabulo Dludla, isikhulu sophiko olukhipha amathenda uMnuz Khulekani Manqele, nosomabhizinisi, uMnuz Vukani Gumede.Babhekene namacala enkohlakalo awu-57 asukela ekukhishweni kwethenda lika-R800 000. Bazobuyela enkantolo kusasa, lapho bezofaka khona isicelo sebheyili.UButhelezi wethule uMnuz Mpumelelo Mnguni, njengebamba lemenenja yalo masipala obhekene nezinkinga.Inkantolo isanda kuchitha ukuqokwa kwemenenja yalo mkhandlu ebibambile, uMntwana uNhlakanipho Zulu nokuqokwa kwesikhulu sezezimali esibambile, uMnuz Brian Dube.UButhelezi uthe uZulu akavumelekile ukuba aqhubeke nokusebenza njengemenenja yomkhandlu, waxwayisa ngokuthatha izinyathelo zomthetho uma uZulu ephikisa umyalelo.UButhelezi uthe uMnguni uzobuyisa uzinzo ngokubambisana nezinye izikhulu zomnyango ezijutshwe ukuba ziyokwelekelela kuMasipala waKwaNongoma."Abantu bakwaNongoma kufanele baqhubeke, bathole izidingo. Kufanele abantu baqhubeke nokuthola amanzi.”UButhelezi uthe isimo sezimali simapeketwane kulo mkhandlu. Uthe umasipala usuyisebenzisile yonke imali oyithola kuhulumeni omkhulu ekubeni ungakaqedi ukwenza izinhlelo ezabelwe le mali."Lapha kwaNongoma aniguqile ngamadolo kodwa nilele ngezisu,” kusho uButhelezi.
ABEHLOME ezingovolo amaphoyisa abephelezela ithimba eliqoqa intela ebeliyovundulula ubufakazi bokungakhokhwa kwentela emzini kamacaphunakusale waseThekwini, uNksz Shauwn "MaMkhize” Mkhize okuvela ukuthi ukweleta intela kaR37 million.Izolo ithimba leSouth African Revenue Service (Sars) ligasele emzini kaMaMkhize oseLa Lucia, eThekwini, namaphoyisa ahamba ngamaveni, ahamba ngeloli eliqapha imibhikisho nezinye izimo zodlame abefake amajazi okuvikela izinhlamvu, egqoke amabharethi ephethe nezinhlokohlela zezibhamu.Lawa maphoyisa abeqaphe ithimba lakwaSars ebelingena ngaphakathi livumbuke namafayela abefakwe ezikhwameni eziluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka nakuma-suitcase. Kufike nezinkampani zomavulakuvaliwe ebezizolekelela ukuze zivule lapho bekukhiywe khona. Emuva kwaleli thimba abakwaSars bebengena bengenile babuye nemiqingo yamaphepha.Bekukhona yonke inhlobo yephoyisa iSARS igasela kwaMaMkhize isithombe Sibonelo NgcoboLowo owayengumyeni kaMaMkhize, uMnuz Sbu Mpisane ubonakale ngasophikweni lwakhe lomuzi, wasondela emaphoyiseni wakhuluma nawo kancane wabuyela ngaphakathi. Ubuye wabonakala eshaya isiphuzo esibandayo kodwa ngesikhathi amakhamera esebheka ngakuye, wabuyela ngaphakathi. Uhlale ngaphakathi aze ahamba amaphoyisa.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi ithimba lakwaSars beliqoqa ubufakazi kuyo yonke imizi kaNksz Mkhize kusukela koseThekwini, oseGoli nosepulazini eliseMgungundlovu.Akusikona okokuqala uNksz Mkhize ebhekana nezinkinga zokukhokha intela ngoba ngo-2020 kwavela ukuthi inkampani yakhe iZikhulise Cleaning Maintenance and Transport, ikweleta intela kaR204 million.Izolo abantu akade behamba emgwaqweni odlula ngakwaMaMkhize bebethatha izithombe namavidiyo bebuza ukuthi kwenzakalani, abanye bebehleka uma bebona amaphoyisa kanti abanye iningi labo abamhlophe bebenikina amakhanda.UKhomishana weSARS uMnuz Edward Kieswetter, uthe bagasele kwaNksz Mkhize ngoba belwa nababalekela ukukhokha intela nobugebengu ezweni.Uthe inkantolo ibanike igunya lokuphenya bashaqe nempahla belandela umthetho we-Tax Administration Act 28 ka-2011, begxile esigabeni 163."ISars izoqhubeka nokwenza umsebenzi wayo ngaphandle kokusaba nokwenzelela kungakhathaleki ukuthi umuntu unasiphi isikhundla emphakathini. Akekho umuntu ongaphezu komthetho. Umsebenzi wanamhlanje uyakhombisa ukuthi akukho okuzosivimba ukuba senze umsebenzi wethu wokuqoqa intela esiza abampofu, ilwe nendlala nokusweleka komsebenzi.”Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kukaMaMkhize ayiphumelelanga ngoba ucingo lwakhe belungangeni kanti olomuntu omkhulumelayo uNksz Nikiwe Nyembe, belukhala lungabanjwa.
UPHONSELE inselelo kwamanye amaphoyisa esifazane ukuthi azimisele emsebenzini wawo ngenkathi echonywa uphaphe wuphiko lweVisible Policing and Operation echwebeni lwemikhumbi eThekwini, emcimbini wokuklonyelisa ngezindondo amaphoyisa enze kahle onyakeni ka-2023 no-2024 eMhlanga, muva nje.UConstable Phyllis Kubeka (42) waseNewlands West, eThekwini, ekhuluma neSolezwe, uthe ngokuhlabana ngesitifiketi se-Best Perfoming Member B Arrest, okuwuhlobo lwamacala athinta izimoto ezingenawo amalayisensi, amaphepha omgunyathi nokudla osekudlulelwe yisikhathi, kusho ukuthi abesifazane sekuyisikhathi sokuthi bazethembe."Ngigqugquzela wonke amaphoyisa esifazane ukuthi asebenze ngokuzimisela futhi ngiwabonise ukuthi yonke into iyenzeka uma nje umqondo wakho usesimwemi esikahle,” kusho uConst Kubheka.Uthe abesifazane abaqale bona bezethembe."Abesifazane kumele bezethembe bona kuqala ngaphambi kokuthi uhulumeni eze enze okuthile. Yibona okufanele babhukule, bazijube. Lokho kuzokwenza ukuthi isibalo samaphoyisa abesifazane sikhule,” usho kanje.Uthe ngokuhlabana ngalesi sitifiketi, kuningi asazoqhubeka akwenze."Usamkhulu umsebenzi okusamele wenziwe ezweni lethu ukuze kuvikelwe intsha. Ngokubopha abantu, senza isiqiniseko ukuthi ikusasa labo livikelekile ngoba uma kungenziwa lutho, kuzoba nomthelela ekusaseni laleli lizwe,” ubeke kanje.Uthe njengoba sekuphele iminyaka engu-13 esembuthweni wamaphoyisa kuningi asekufundile futhi uyakhula ngokomsebenzi. Uthe mihla namalanga ufunda amaqhinga ahlukene ezikhulwini zakhe.Amanye amaphoyisa aklonyelisiwe emunxeni weBest Perfoming Member A no-B Arrest kubalwa oSergeant K Moodley, N Ramlall, DJ Naidoo nabanye. UKHALA ngezomthetho ezithambisa kakhulu isandla kubasolwa, umndeni womfundi waKwaMajomela, KwaNongoma, okuthiwa ugwazwe yisihlobo wafa, sadedelwa ngebheyili.Esigamekweni okuthiwa senzeke ngoNovemba 16, nonyaka, kushone uSmiso Sithole (14) obefunda uGrade 8 eMthombowesizwe High.Ngokusho kukamamncane kamufi, uNksz Zandile Sithole, umufi ubehamba nezinye izihlobo ezimbili ngesikhathi behlangana nomsolwa nabanye besifazane bakwabo ababili."Bebebuya ukukhapha unina obeya enkonzweni kwaShembe. Nebala babagudluza, bathi uma sebephendula laba, umsolwa wakhipha i-screwdriver emabeleni, wagwaza umufi kanye esibeleni,” kusho uNksz Sithole.Uthe uphuthunyiswe esibhedlela lapho afike washonela khona, wathi bewumndeni baphatheke kabi ukuthi iNkantolo yeMantshi yaKwaNongoma, ivele yamdedela kalula ngebheyili umsolwa."Bavele bamkhipha ngo-R2 000 ekubeni ebulele umuntu. Waphuthunyiswa esibhedlela lapho owafika washona khona,” kusho uNetshiunda.
UMGCINIMAFA we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uDkt Ntuthuko Mahlaba, unxuse amalungu enhlangano ukuba angavumi ukuba izincelebane zabaholi.UMahlaba uthe amalungu e-ANC kufanele apheze ukulwa izimpi zabaholi angahlangene nazo.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma namalungu e-ANC abehambele umhlangano wokuvuselela kabusha le nhlangano, obuseNewcastle.Sekuwumkhuba ojwayelekile kwi-ANC uma kubhekwe ezingqungqutheleni zokukhetha ubuholi ukuba amalungu enhlangano agxibhe abaholi asuke engafuni ukuthi bakhethwe.Kulo nyaka nasekuqaleni konyaka ozayo i-ANC izokuba nezingqungquthela zokukhetha ubuholi ezifundeni okubalwa kuzo iTheku, neMoses Mabhida.Kulindeleke ukuthi bathelane ngodaka abazobe bencintisana ngezikhundla kulezi zingqungquthela.UMahlaba uthe umkhuba wokusetshenziswa kwamalungu ukuba alwe izimpi zabaholi awumuhle.Uthe amalungu e-ANC kufanele abeke phambili inhlangano, angavumi ukuba yimikhovu yabaholi abalwela izikhundla."Lento ngeke sikwazi ukuyenza uma singezokukuqonda ukuthi singamalungu e-ANC ngaphambi kwenye into. Uyabona uma sisazoba amalungu amanye amalungu, sizoba nenkinga. Uzothi uhleli lana, uthole umyalezo bafune ukukusebenzisa ukulwa izinkinga zabo. Bazofuna kube nguwena olwa izinkinga zabo kulaba bantu abahleli lana. Ningavumi, mntwana wasekhaya, ungavumi, ngiyala nawe. Uma bethi bayasondela, ungavumi.”UMahlaba uthe kokunye amalungu e-ANC abuye adukiswe oXovizwe abahambe bebatshela ukuthi abaholi abathile abazwani."Abanye nje bahlezi bekhuluma besho ukuthi abaholi abathile abazwani. Uma sekuhlangenwe, sebesibona sizixoxela bese beyazibuza ukuthi kanti iqhamukaphi lena yokuthi asizwani."Angithi utshelwa oXovizwe. UMnuz Oliver Tambo (owayengumengameli we-ANC) wasexwayisa ukuba sibaqaphele laba abahlezi bephehla udweshu. Okufanele sikwazi ukuthi i-ANC yakhelwe esisekelweni sobumbano.”UMahlaba uthe i-ANC isesigabeni sesibili somzabalazo.Uthe isigaba sokuqala kwabe kuwukuthola inkululeko, wathi esesibili ukuthola inkululeko yezomnotho."Angeke sithi sesiyitholile inkululeko uma singakayitholi inkululeko yezomnotho.”
UBHOKE ngolaka umholi we-EFF, uMnuz Julius Malema, ngesikhathi ebuzwa ngezinsolo zokuthi ilungu lesigungu esiphezulu, uDkt Mbuyiseni Ndlozi, alivumelekile engqungqutheleni yokukhetha ubuholi beqembu ezokuba ngenyanga ezayo.UMalema uchaze izinsolo zokungavumeleki kukaNdlozi engqungqutheleni njengomgosi wasemashibhini angeke awuphendule.Lokhu ukusho ngesikhathi eyohlola indawo okuzobanjelwa kuyo ingqungquthela yangenyanga ezayo, iNasrec Expo Centre, eseGoli.Kukhona amalungu e-EFF akhankasela ukuba uNdlozi abe yiphini lomholi we-EFF.Kepha kunemibiko yabezindaba eveze ukuthi isigungu esiphezulu kwi-EFF simise uNdlozi kuzo zonke izinto ezithinta iqembu, nokusho ukuthi ngeke akwazi ukungenela umbango wezikhundla engqungqutheleni.Ebuzwa ngezinsolo, uMalema uthe akayikhulumi indaba yamawongowongo."Angazi ukuthi kungani nifuna ukuthi ngikhulume ngoNdlozi. Angikaze ngisho lutho ngoNdlozi. Nifuna ngiphendule umgosi wasemashibhini? Ngeke ngikhulume ngento enihleba ngayo emathoyilethe. Ukuba kukhona into esifuna ukuyisho ngoNdlozi ngabe senze isimemezelo. Ngakho ke ngicela ningiyeke ngomgosi,” kusho uMalema.Kunamalungu e-EFF asabisa ngokuthi azobhikisha uma uNdlozi egcine engavunyelwanga ukuba angenele umbango wesikhundla.Kepha uMalema uthe alikho ilungu le-EFF elizobhikisha."Kule mpelasonto besinemihlangano nezithunywa eziya engqungqutheleni. Akukho lapho okube khona nombhikisho. Akukho lapho okube nemibuzo ngalolu daba. Lokho kukhombisa ngokusobala ukuthi ngeke kube khona abantu abazobhikisha engqungqutheleni. Ukuba kunabantu abafuna ukubhikisha besizobona kule mihlangano ebingempelasonto. Phela inhloso yale mihlangano bekuyikho vele ukuzwa amanzi ngobhoko.”Kukholakala ukuthi into edalela uNdlovi amazinyo abushelelezi ukuthi akazange ababikele abaholi be-EFF ngesikhathi ethola ukuthi owayeyiphini lomholi ngaleso sikhathi, uMnuz Floyd Shivambu, uhlela ukushiya.UNdlozi kukholakala ukuthi ungomunye wabaholi owalunywa indlebe nguShivambu ngezinhlelo zokushiya.UMalema uwagxekile amalungu enhlangano angazange abubikele ubuholi ngesikhathi ezwa ngezinhlelo zikaShivambu zokushiya."Utshelwa indaba engaka wena bese unquma ukuthula, ungasitsheli. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi awethembekile kuthina. Angikwazi ukushaya sengathi konke kuhamba kahle ekubeni kukhona abantu abakwazi ukwenza kanje. Lento ikhombisa ukuthi kunenqwaba yabantu abangathembekile lapha phakathi kwethu.”
LIHLEHISELWE unyaka ozayo icala lempunyela esolwa ngokukhwabanisa.I-Accountant eyayiyilungu lebhodi le-South African Airways (SAA), uYakhe Kwinana, ivele ngaphambi kweNkantolo elalela amaCala aKhethekile ngezinsolo zokuqola i-SAA.Amacala asukela ekuhlulekeni kwakhe ukudalula ubudlelwano bezinkontileka zesikhathi esidlule nezinkampani ezimbili, i-PricewaterhouseCoopers (PwC) neNkonki Incorporated ezathola ithenda ebiza u-R59 million njengabacwaningi mabhuku abahlangene.I-Accountant eyayeyilungu lebhodi le-South African Airways (SAA), uYakhe Kwinana, ivele ngaphambi kweNkantolo elalela amaCala aKhethekile ngezinsolo zokuqola i-SAAI-Auditor-General South Africa (AGSA) okuyiyona ejutshwe ngokoMthethosisekelo ukuba icwaninge amabhuku ezinkampani zikahulumeni yanquma ukungawacwaningi awe-SAA ngonyaka wezimali ka-2011-2012. NgoSepthemba 15, 2011, i-SAA yabikela i-AGSA ngokuqokwa kwe-PwC ne-Nkonki Incorporated ukwenza lo msebenzi. I-AGSA yasamukela lesi saziso ngombhalo owathunyelwa nakusihlalo weziphathimandla zezimali e-SAA ngayo leyo nyangaNgokwesigaba 50(3) se-Compliance and Reporting Framework (PFMA), ilungu lebhodi linesibopho sokubika noma lidalule ubudlelwano elinabo nomsebenzi noma wangasese nanoma iyiphi inkampani efuna umsebenzi noma ithenda futhi lihoxe ekubeni yingxenye yabazothatha izinqumo mayelana nale nqubo.Umbuso uthi uKwinana, esikhundleni sakhe njengosihlalo wekomiti lokucwaninga amabhuku e-SAA kanye nelungu lebhodi, wehluleka ukuthobela ngokugcwele umsebenzi ayewuthweswe yimigomo yeSigaba 50 se-PFMA. Kusolwa ukuthi wehlulekile ukudalula iPwC, uNkonki noma ibhodi labaqondisi beSAA noma ikomiti labacwaningi mabhuku lakwaSAA. ukUkwehluleka kwakhe ukuphumela obala kuphazamise abanye osomabhizinisi abanelungelo lokubamba iqhaza kwinqubo yokuncintisana ngamathenda okuhambisana ngokugcwele nezimiso zoMthethosisekelo.Ngemuva kokulalelwa kwesicelo sakhe sebheyili, inkantolo inqume ukumnika ibheyili ka-R20 000. Icala lizobuyela enkantolo ngomhlaka-29 Januwari 2025 ukuze uMbuso udalule okuqukethwe yidokodo.
BABEKWE uxhaxha lwamacala enkohlakalo abaholi nezikhulu zikaMasipala waKwaNongoma ababoshwe ngoLwesihlanu.Okhulumela inhlangano yezokushushisa KwaZulu-Natal, i-National Prosecuting Authority, uNkk Natasha Ramkisson-Kara, uveze ukuthi abaholi nezikhulu ezivele eNkantolo yeMantshi KwaNongoma, babhekene namacala awu-57 okukhwabanisa.Kwababoshiwe kukhona iMeya, uMnuz Mshangane Ndabandaba, iPhini leMeya, uMnuz Sabelo Nkosi noSomlomo, uNkk Babongile Sithole.USomlomo kumasipala waKwaNongoma, uNkk Babongile SitholeIPhini leMeya KwaNongoma, uMnuz Sabelo Nkosi UNkk Ramkisson-Kara uthe icala labo liyamaniswa nethenda ka-R800 000.Baboshwe nesikhulu sophiko lwezezimali, uMnuz Njabulo Nzuza, isikhulu sophiko olukhipha amathenda, uMnuz Khulekani Manqele nosomabhizinisi, uMnuz Vukani Gumede.Icala labo lihlehliselwe uLwesihlanu lapho khona bezofaka isicelo sebheyili.Laba baholi abaqhamuka emaqenjini e-NFP, EFF ne-ANC, baboshwa ngoLwesihlanu besemhlanganweni wesigungu esiphezulu.Amalungu e-NFP nawe-ANC abegcwele enkantolo ezokweseka uNdabandaba naboshwe nabo.IPhini likaMengameli we-NFP, uMnuz Milton Sokhela, lithe bazomeseka uNdabandaba kodwa lathi bafuna ukuboshwa kwakhe kungaphazamisi izinhlelo zomkhandlu."Sizimisele ukumeseka kuze kube kuyaqinisekiswa ukuthi lokhu ayamaniswa nakho kunjalo ngempela yini. Uzokuba msulwa kuze kube inkantolo iyaphimisela ukuthi kukhona ichashaza athinteka kulona. Siyayihlonipha ingalo yomthetho, sizoziphatha kahle.”USokhela uthe uma kwenzeka uNdabandaba engayinikezwa ibheyili, bazohlangana babone ukuthi bathatha siphi isinqumo."Sizobuka ukuthi ngesikhathi simeseka, singenza kanjani ukuthi kungaphazamiseki ukusebenza komkhandlu. Sizobhekelela ukuthi abantu baKwaNongoma bengalimali, sifuna ukuthi ukuhanjiswa kwezidingo nokuzinza komasipala kuqhubeke, kube seqhulwini.”Usihlalo we-ANC esifundeni iMzala Nxumalo, uMnuz Sibusiso Mhlongo, uthe bazoqhubeka nokweseka abaholi ababoshiwe nemindeni yabo."Silandela umgomo othi wonke umuntu umsulwa kuze kuba inkantolo imthola enecala.”UMhlongo uthe bafuna ukuthi kungaphazamiseki ukusebenza komkhandlu.UMasipala waKwaNongoma ukhungethwe izinkinga njengoba inkantolo isanda kuchitha ukuqokwa kwezikhulu eziphezulu zakulo mkhandlu.INkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu ichithe ukuqokwa kwimenenja kamasipala ebambile, uMntwana uNhlakanipho Zulu nokuqokwa kwesikhulu sezezimali esibambile, uMnuz Brian Dube.UMphathiswa woMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, uzokuba nomhlangano namakhansela akulo mkhandlu namhlanje, lapho kuzobhungwa khona ngalezi zinkinga.
UNGQONGQOSHE wamaPhoyisa kuleli, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, uthe amacala okuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane, angamanye emacaleni abhekwe kakhulu ngamaphoyisa.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ememezela izibalo zobugebengu zekota yesibili onyakeni wezimali u-2024/2025, esithangamini nabezindaba ebesiseGoli, izolo.Yize izibalo ziveze ukwehla kwezigameko zobugebengu emacaleni ahlukene kodwa isibalo sokubulawa kwabesifazane nezingane kuzwelonke, sikhuphukile.Ngokwezibalo ezishicilelwe wuMnyango wamaPhoyisa, bangu-965 abesifazane ababulewe kuzwelonke esikhathini esiyizinyanga ezintathu nje kuphela, phakathi kuka-Julayi noSepthemba kulo nyaka. Lokhu kusho ukukhula kwesibalo ngo-8.6% uma kuqhathaniswa ngesikhathi esifanayo ngonyaka owedlule.UMchunu uthe lesi sihlava sodlame lwezobulili wuhlobo lobugebengu oselubhekwe kakhulu ngamaphoyisa."Ngesikhathi singena kuleli hhovisi, besinombono ocacile wokulwa nobugebengu ezweni ukuqinisekisa ukuphepha kwabantu bonke. Yilowo myalelo owenza sizinikele ukwakha izwe eliphephile lapho izingane zethu ziyokhula khona ngaphandle kokugubuzelwa yifu lodlame empilweni yazo, nalapho ubulungiswa bungakhethi, bulungele wonke umuntu,” usho kanje.Zingu-315 izingane ezibulewe ekoteni edlule okuwukukhula kwalesi sibalo uma kuqhathaniswa no-293 wezibulawe ngesikhathi esifanayo nyakenye.Amacala okuzama ukubulala abesifazane nezingane nawo anyukile, kwathi awokushaya ngenhloso yokulimaza abesifazane ehla kancane ngo-0,2 % kanti awokushaywa ngenhloso yokulimaza izingane wona anyuka ngo- 6,8 %.UMchunu uveze ukuthi izigameko zokubulawa kabantu kuzwelonke zehle ngo-5,8% ekoteni edlule. Amacala okudlwengula abikiwe ehle ngo-3.1%, kanti aphathelene nocansi ehle ngo- 2.5%.Uveze ukuthi amacala okubamba inkunzi kuzwelonke nawo ehle ngo-8.8.Isifundazwe iKwaZulu-Natal silele isibili ngamacala okubulawa kwabantu kusetshenziswa isibhamu, silandela i-Gauteng.Kuvele ukuthi ingxabano edaleka uma abantu bephuze utshwala, ngenye yezimbangela zamacala okubulawa kwabantu abikwe emaphoyiseni. Mathathu amaphoyisa abulewe kulesi sifundazwe phakathi kuka-Julayi noSepthemba, kanti amabili kuwo abengekho emsebenzini.
KUSOLWA umsindo wokulahleka kwezinkomo kudutshulwa kubulawa izihlobo ezimbili eBhokweni, oLundi, ngoMgqibelo.Kulesi sigameko kubulawe uMnuz Muziwokuphiwa Khanyile (70) nomzukulu uMnuz Mlando Khanyile (20). Kuphinde kwadutshulwa nesinye isihlobo, okuthiwa singeniswe esibhedlela, sabuye sakhishwa emva kokwelashwa.Kuthiwa abafi bahlaselwe bezihlalele ngaphansi kwesihlahla, beluse izinkomo ebeziphuza amanzi echibini ngasesitolo kwaNxele.Okuvelayo ngabazibonele isigameko, kuthiwa bababonile abasolwa ukuthi baphume komunye wemizi yakwaKhanyile endaweni, futhi bebengazifihlile. Kuthiwa isigameko senzeke phambi kwezingane ezincane, ezinye zazo ezibaleke zagibela esihlahleni.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi abasolwa baqale badubula uMlando ngaphambi kokujikela kuMuziwokuphiwa.Isihlobo esicele ukungadalulwa, sithe lesi sigameko selama esokubulawa kukaMfu Khanyile okuthiwa ubekhonza kwaShembe."Yena udutshulelwe ekhaya ngoLwesibili. Abahlaseli bangena bamdubula ezibukela ithelevishini,” kusho umthombo.Uqhube wathi esigamekweni sokufa kukaMfu Khanyile, kunukwe abafi, yize lezi zinsolo zishiye imibuzo emphakathini.Uthe abantu bazibuza ukuthi uMuziwokuphiwa ubengadubula bani njengoba ebengasenamandla atheni?Ubuye wathi abanye baxakwa ukuthi uma bekuyibo abahlasele umfundisi bebengaya kanjani ukuyohlala bakhululeke ngasesitolo ngoba kuseduze komuzi wakhe? Uqhubeka nokuchaza umthombo, uthe esinye isihlobo salahlekelwa yizinkomo ezingu-12 eminyakeni eminingi edlule."Kuthe sekwakhohlakala ngesigameko, kunomcimbi komunye wemizi yakwaKhanyile eminyakeni embalwa edlule, kwakhona isihlobo esathi sesiphuzile siyazazi sona izinkomo ukuthi ziphi. Sathi ziseMsinga, sathembisa ukuthi sizozibuyisa kodwa kwangenzeka,” kusho umthombo.Uthe kwaqala lapho ke ukudutshulwa kwabantu emndenini."Sekuthi uma kubulewe othile, uhlangothi oluthile, ludubule lowo olumsolayo,” kusho umthombo.Uveze ukuthi njengoba kubulewe uMlando manje, nyakenye kwabulawa uyise, uMnuz Siqu Khanyile.USiqu kuthiwa walanywa omunye uKhanyile okuthiwa wadutshulwa ebuya kolanda ingane esikoleni, wabekelwa izinguzunga zamatshe emgwaqweni, wathi uma ehla ewasusa, wadutshulwa waphelela lapho.Umthombo uveze ukuthi udaba lwezinkomo seluke lwangenwa nayizinduna nenkosi yendawo kodwa bayabona ukuthi kunhlanga zimuka nomoya ngoba kusaqhubeka ukuqothwa kwabantu.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa aseMahlabathini, aphenya amacala amabili okubulala nelilodwa lokuzama ukubulala kulandela isigameko sokudubula oBhokweni, oLundi, ngoMgqibelo.Uthe izidumbu zabafi amaphoyisa azifice phansi kwesihlahla esiseduze nechibi, wathi amaphoyisa ayaphenya.
IFANA nenkomo yomqhoyiso indaba yePhala Phala, babodwa bathi ayilale, babodwa abathi gede ayivuke, iqembu le-Economic Freedom Fighters (EFF) linikele enkantolo yoMthethosisekelo ukuphikisa isinqumo esenziwa yiPhalamende sokungaqhubeki nophenyo mayelana nalolu daba.Leli qembu eliholwa uMnuz Julius Malema lifake amaphepha kule nkantolo likhala ngokuthi i-African National Congress isebenzise ubuningi bayo ePhalamende ukuvukela umengameli uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa.Leli qembu lithi kwakungukuphula umthetho lokhu okwenziwa yi-ANC ukuthi ihluleke ukuvula ithuba lokuthi uRamaphosa aphendule ngokuthi kungani angabikanga ngokulahleka kwemali epulazini lakhe.Leli qembu lifuna inkantolo yoMthethosisekelo iphoqe iPhalamende ukuba kusetshenziswe ngokusemthethweni imigomo yombiko owakhishwa ngowayengumengameli wamajaji uSandile Ngcobo ngalolu daba olwavela ngoFebhruwari 2020 ngokwebiwa kwamakhulu ezinkulungwane zamaDola epulazini likamengameli iPhala Phala.Ekhuluma nabezindaba ngoMsombuluko, uMalema uthe: "Sizolwa nenkohlakalo ngesikhathi sikaZuma siphinde silwe nayo engasekho uZuma. UZuma ukhohlakele sasingadidisekile ngenkohlakalo kaZuma. UCyril Ramaphosa uKhohlakele, sasingadidisekile ngokukhohlakala kukaCyril Ramaphosa. Sizobe sisemgwaqweni ngoLwesibili silibangise eNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo.”
ZIYAKHATHAZA izigameko zokugetshengwa kwabagibeli kanjalo nabashayeli beBolt, okungenye yama-app ezimoto ezikhokhelwa ngebanga ezilihambile.Ubugebengu obunyantisa igazi benzeka nhlangothi zonke, kubagibeli kanjalo nakubashayeli.Sekukaningi Isolezwe libika ngezigameko zokubulawa kwabashayeli balezi zimoto, abasolwa kube ngabantu ebebezenza abagibeli.Ukwenza isibonelo nje, ngasekuqaleni kukaJulayi nonyaka, uMnuz Lungisani Cele (28) owayehlala eLindelani, eThekwini, engowokudabuka ePort Shepstone, watholwa eshiswe nemoto yekhe iTotoya Corolla Cross emva kokuphuma ebubusuku eyothatha ikhasimende.Ngesikhathi Isolezwe likhuluma nezihlobo zakhe, zaveza ukuthi ikhasimende lalithe akeze azolilanda kwa-E eNtuzuma, nokuyilapho isidumbu sakhe satholwa khona.Izihlobo zathi umufi wayelaliswe ezihlalweni zangemuva nokwabenza basola ukuthi uqale wabulawa ngaphambi kokuthi ashiswe nemoto. Baphinde bathi banezinsolo eziqinile zokuthi umuntu obecele ukuthi azomthatha uyathinteka ekubulaweni kukamufi.Isolezwe lake labika nangesinye isigameko esehlela owesifazane waseMatendeni eNanda owagetshengwa nomngani wakhe wumshayeli walezi zimoto nomngani wakhe ngesikhathi becee ukuhanjiswa ndawana thize.Waveza ukuthi ngosuku lwesigameko babiza imoto nomngani wakhe befuna ibathathe eMatendeni, ibayise enkabeni yeTheku.Wadalula ukuthi wafika kahle umshayeli, wabathatha ngale kokuthi basole ukuthi 'yisigebengu’.Wathi kwathi imoto isihambe ibangana, umshayeli wacela ukumisa imoto ekhala ngokuphiswa umchamo, bethuka bacishe boma esebuya nomngani wakhe behlome ngezibhamu, babafuna amaselula ngodli ngaphambi kokubehlisa emotweni ngesidlozana bakhala amaphepha.UMnuz Simphiwe Nzuza wakwaP eMlaza, oke waziyisebenzisa le-app kodwa wakhetha ukuyilaxaza emuva kokusinda emlonyeni wengwenya, akalukhohlwa namanje usuku acishe afa ngalo.Elandisa Isolezwe uthe, kwakunguJuni 2020, ethola isicelo somuntu ofuna ukususwa emgwaqweni u-Anton Lembede (Smith Street) eThekwini, ayiswe eClermont."Ngathi uma ngifika, ngathola ukuthi abesilisa ababili, abagqoke kahle, abangasolisi ngalutho. Endleleni babehamba bezixoxela ngokuthi nabo banazo izimoto ezenza lo msebenzi, bexoxa nangezingqinamba umsebenzi oza nazo,” kuchaza uNzuza.Uthe ngabe uhubhuza aluhlaza uma engathi yayikhona into eyayikhombisa ukuthi ulayishe izigebengu ezizomenzakalisa kungekudala."Indaba yaqala sesizofika ngakulo muzi ababethe baya kuwo. Baqala benza izingcingo ezingaqondakali, ezikhomba ukuthi ngeke ngisabehlisa kulowo muzi. Bagcina bethi bacela ngithi ukuqhubeka kancane ngemoto ngoba sebefuna ukwehla ngaphambidlana,” kusho uNzuza.Uthe wathi uma eyimisa nje imoto, ofeleba badonsa izibhamu, bamtshela ukuthi "bayasebenza manje”.Uthe bambopha izandla nezinyawo, bamshutheka okuthile emlonyeni, bamvala namehlo, bamphosa ebhuthini, zaya."Ngasizwa ukuthi ukhona ubaba owabona bengiqhuba beyongifaka emjondolo, engagcina ngithola ukuthi iseKK khona eClermont. Weza wazongikhulula, kwayima ngibika ukuthi imoto iduniwe,” kusho uNzuza.Uthe kwathi uma ibanjwa, kwaficwa amaselula ayisikhombisa nama-laptop ayisihlanu, athi wathola ukuthi abasolwa basala basebenzisa i-app yakhe ukwamukela izicelo zabagibeli, ababethi uma sebengaphakathi, babagebenge.Uthe kuningi okungenziwa abanikazi be-app ukunciphisa ubugebengu.Enza isibonelo uthe kufanele babe nohlelo lokuqinisekisa ngokushutha isithombe kungazelelwe ukuthi umshayeli kusewuye yini lo okubhalwe phansi ukuthi usebenzisa imoto."Akuthi uma umshayeli ehluleka ukwenza lokho, icinywe i-app, angakwazi ukuyisebenzisa. Akungabi lula ukuthi umuntu asebenzise imininingwane yomunye umshayeli noma ahambe ngemoto engabhalisile ngaphansi kwegama lakhe kwi-app. Akube wumthetho ukuthi umgibeli afake imininigwane yakhe yasebhange noma ezosebenzisa imali engukheshi ukuze athi noma enza ubugebengu kulandeleke ukuthi ungubani,” kusho uNzuza.Kubagibeli, ikakhulukazi abesifazane, abavame ukuba yizisulu, uthe kukhona okufanele bakubheke okusuke kuyizinkomba zokuthi bangase bagetshengwe."Musa ukuyigibela imoto engafani nale okhonjiswe yona ngesikhathi umshayeli amukela isicelo sakho sokugibela. Musa ukugibela uma ubona umshayeli owehlukile kunalo obesesithombeni ngesikhathi wenza isicelo. Uma umshayeli efika ehamba nomunye umuntu, ungangeni kuleyo moto. Uma uhlangabezana nokukodwa kwalokhu, ungalokothi ugibele,” kwexwayisa uNzuza.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uColonel Robert Netshiunda uthe amaphoyisa axwayisa abasebenzisa izimoto ezikhokhelwa ngebanga ezilihambile ukuthi baqaphele uma bezisebenzisa.Uthe abagibeli akufanele bagibele emotweni abayibona isolisa."Kubalulekile ukuthi uthumele imininingwane yemoto ekuthathayo neyomshayeliesihlotsheni, nokuthumela ubufakazi bokuthi imoto isikuphi nendawo (live location), nakho kubalulekile,” kusho uNetshiunda.Uphinde wexwayisa ngokuthi okunye okufanele bakugweme ukusebenzisa lezi moto bephuze uphuzo oludakayo ukugwema ukuba ngabagilwa bobugebengu kalula."Uma uphuzile, kungcono ukuthi ucele umuntu omaziyo ukuthi akakugoduse. Kubashayeli balezi zimoto nabo kufanele baqaphele ukuthi bangabagibezi abantu abasolisayo. Ukuphepha kwabo kufanele bakubeke phambili, kunokugijimisa imali esheshayo,” kusho uNetshiunda.Wengeze ngokuthi bonke abasebenzisa lezi zimoto kufanele babe nezinombolo zamaselula nezezingcingo (landline) zabaphathi beziteshi ezisondelene nabo ukulungiselela ukubashayela ucingo noma inini uma kunesimo esiphuthumayo.

IZINKUMBI zamakhasimende anezinkinga zezigubhu zikagesi osebenzisa ikhadi nayizolo bezisaqhubeka nokutheleka emahhovisi ase-Eskom ehlukene, yize le nkampani ibisimemezele ukuthi abantu abathenge ugesi ezitolo bafake izinombolo ezizobashintshela ohlelweni olusha.Izolo, bekuwusuku lokugcina lokuthi amakhasimende athole izinombolo ezitholakala ngokuthi uthenge ugesi wekhadi. AMANYE amakhasimende kaMasipala weTheku eSiphingo, abeme kulayini ngoMgqibelo. ngaphambi komnqamulajuqu wokushintshela ohlelweni olusha lokuthuthukisiswa kwezigubhu zikagesi lwaka-Eskom ISITHOMBE: PHILI MJOLI I-Eskom ithe amakhasimende athengile uzokwazi ukuwasiza kusukela namahlanje ngoba azobe esenazo izinombolo.EThekwini inqwaba yamakhasimende athi awanazo izigubhu, akokotele ugesi, nalinde izigubhu ezintsha kumasipala, athutheleke emahhovisi kamasipala kagesi aseSiphingo ngobuningi ngoLwesihlanu nangoMgqibelo.Amaningi aphume emahhovisi ephoxekile ngoba ethi kuthiwe akabhalise amagama awo, bese eshayela inombolo yamahhala abike kuqala. UMnuz Senzo Maluleka waseMlaza, uthe sekuphele iminyaka egqigqa kuMasipala weTheku ebika ngesigubhu sakhe esifile, ubenethemba lokuthi uzothola usizo ngengoba sekushintshelwa ohlelweni olusha."Isigubhu asikhanyi kuneminyaka kunjalo. Ngabika kwafika usonkontileka owayethunywe umasipala wangixhumela, wathi okwesikhashana. Uma sekunezigubhu ezintsha uzobuya. Ngagcina nami sengijwayele ukuthi ugesi angiwuthengi futhi awupheli. Ngisukume manje ngoba ngizwa kuthiwa uzocishwa,” kusho uMaluleka.UMnuz Mduduzi Mngoma uthe: "Isigubhu safa nyakenye, ngemuva kokubika ngahlala ngalinda kwangafika muntu wakwamasipala. Kubuhlungu manje ngoba kuthiwa singase sikhokhe inhlawulo esuka ku-R6 000” kusho yena.Abanye abangathandanga ukukhuluma kubantu ebebekulayini bathe abanazo izigubhu ugesi bawukokotela ngoba behluleka ukuwuthenga, bazoziceba kumasipala. UNkk Gugu Sisilana okhulumela uMasipala weTheku, uthe kade baluphothula uhlelo lokuthuthukisa izigubhu, akanalo ulwazi ngabebegcwele emahhovisi abo aseSiphingo."Akhona amakhasimende ka-Eskom aseThekwini angenalo ulwazi lokuthi owawo ugesi awuthola kwa-Eskom. Kuze kubonakale ngoba sesithole imininingwane yabo ukuthi awekho kwi-system yethu. Ngicela athumele e-email sizowaphendula kusasa (namhlanje),” kusho yena.UNkk Daphney Mokoena okhulumela, u-Eskom, uthe abantu abathenge ugesi ezindaweni ezivumelekile bazosizakala emahhovisi kusukela namhlanje kuya phambili.Uthe amakhasimende kuzomele athenge ugesi ukuze athole iziliphu ezimbili ezinezinombolo zokuthuthukisa ubuchwepheshe obusesigubhini sikagesi. "Izigubhu zizophelelwa isikhathi namhlanje (Novemba 24) kodwa uma uwuthengile ugesi wathola lezo zinombolo uzokwazi ukusizakala kodwa. Uma ungakwenzanga lokho kuzomele kushintshwe isigubhu okuzomele ikhasimende lisikhokhele,” kuchaza yena. Kulolu hlelo kubalwa nabebengawuthengi ugesi abanezigubhu.

AMAKHOMANISI asamile ekuphikisaneni kwayo nokufakwa kwe-DA kuhulumeni wokubambisana oholwa yi-ANC.I-SACP ithe ayisoze yawushintsha umqondo ngokufakwa kwe-DA kuhulumeni wokubambisana.Lokhu kushiwo okhulumela le nhlangano, uDkt Alex Mashilo, obekhuluma ngesikhathi kuqhubeka umhlangano wabaholi be-ANC ne-SACP obubizelwe ukuzobhunga eyokungaboni ngaso linye kwalezi nhlangano ngodaba lokufakwa kwe-DA kuhulumeni wokubambisana.Kuke kwaba nezikhawu lapho abaholi be-ANC nabe-SACP bejikijelana ngamazwi esidlangalaleni, lapho bebephikisana khona ngendaba yokufakwa kwe-DA kuhulumeni wokubambisana.Abe-SACP bakhala ngokuthi i-DA inemigomo ephikisana nokuthuthukiswa kwabantu abamnyama.UMashilo uthe abasoze bahambisane nokufakwa kwe-DA kuhulumeni wokubambisana ngoba banemigomo engahambisani."Uzokhumbula ukuthi ngesikhathi kuyiwa okhethweni, besikhankasela i-ANC. Sasiyigxeka i-DA. Ngaleso sikhathi i-DA yona yayikhankasela ukukhipha i-ANC emandleni. Namanje sisamile ekugxekeni kwethu i-DA. Izinto esikholelwa kuzona kazifani."Thina sasikhankasela ukuthi kuphasiswe umthetho womshwalense wezempilo, bona babephikisana nawo. Sikhankasela umthetho wezikole i-Bela, bona babephikisana nawo. Ngakho ke uyabona ukuthi kungakanani esingavumelani ngakho.”UMashilo uthe bazofike bakuveze ukuphikisana kwabo ne-DA emhlanganweni wabo nobuholi be-ANC."Lana sizofike siveze umehluko okhona phakathi kwethu. Lana akusiyona nje inkinga yokuthi sizimisela noma cha ukwamukela ukufakwa kwe-DA kuhulumeni wokubambisana. Inkinga enkulu ukuthi akukho nanokukodwa esivumelana ngakho ne-DA.”UMashilo uthe unethemba lokuthi bazokwazi ukuthola isisombululo kulolu daba."I-ANC iyidlelandawonye lethu elidala. Kuningi esikwenze ndawonye nayo. Angeke siyeke ukuxoxa nayo. Sizolokhu sixoxa nayo kuze kube sithola isixazululo.”Okhulumela i-ANC, uNkk Mahlengi Bhengu-Motsiri, uthe bazimisele ukulungisa ubudlelwano babo namadlelandawonye abo."Uma sibumbene namadlelandawonye ethu sizokuba namathuba amaningi okufeza zonke izethembiso esizenzile ngesikhathi sikhankasela izinketho. Amadlelandawonye abalulekile embhidlangweni wethu wokuthuthukisa izwe.”
BAXWAYISWE ngokuthi bangazithola beboshelwa amacala abangawazi abakuleli abazobhalisela abokufika izipaza uma kwenzeka kuba khona abantu ababulawa noma abaguliswa ukudla okuthengwe kulezi paza.Imeya kaMasipala wase-Alfred Duma, uMnuz Zama Sibisi, ithe ukufa nokugula kwezingane kuzobuzwa kubantu okubhaliswe ngabo izipaza.Ukusho lokhu esitatimendeni exwayisa khona abantu bakuleli ngengozi yokubhalisela abantu bokufika izitolo.USibisi uthe ababhalisela abokufika izitolo bazibeka engcupheni."Kunemibiko eveza ukuthi abantu bakuleli baqashisa ngezakhiwo zabo, bazinikeza abantu bokufika abangenazo izimvume zokuba kuleli. Abantu bakuleli ababhalisela abokufika izitolo kufanele bazi ukuthi ibona abazothwala amacala uma kwenzeka ukuthi le zitolo ezibhaliswe yibo ziphula imithetho. Uma kwenzeka kuba khona isigameko esenzekayo, okubhaliswe ngabo izitolo ibona abazophendula.” USibisi uthe ababhalisela abokufika izipaza abagcini ngokubeka bona engcupheni wathi kodwa babeka bonke abantu bakuleli engozini."Abantu bakuleli bakhulume kwazwakala, bagxeka uhulumeni ngokungagcinwa kwemithetho elawula izitolo. Abantu bakubeke kwacaca ukuthi ukungalandelwa kwemithetho elawula izitolo yikho okuyimbangela yokuthi kwenzeke le nhlekelele."Manje uhulumeni useqhamuke nohlelo lwezinsuku ezingu-21 lokuthi kubhaliswe kabusha zonke izipaza. Inhloso yalolu hlelo yikho kanye ukulwa nale nkinga yokudla okunobuthi esidlule nenqwaba yemiphefumulo yezingane.”USibisi uthe bazoqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izipaza ziyayilandela imigomo."Nathi sisabela kwikhwelo likahulumeni kazwelonke lokuba sigasele ezitolo, siyobheka ukuthi ngabe iyalandelwa yini imigomo yezempilo neyokuphepha. "Sithanda ukuqinisekisa ukuthi sizothumela abezempilo, abahlola izakhiwo kanye nabahlola amalayisensi ezitolo ukuba bahambe beyobheka ukuthi iyalandelwa yimi imigomo njengoba kuqhubeka uhlelo lokubhalisa. Sizozihlola zonke izipaza ezilapha e-Alfred Duma futhi zizovalwa zonke izipaza ezizohluleka ukubhalisa ezinsukwini ezingu-21 ezibekiwe.”Uhlelo lokubhaliswa kabusha kwezipaza lwamenyezelwa uMengameli, Cyril Ramaphosa, ngeledlule.Udaba lokufa nokugula kwabadle okunobuthi lusanda kuhlonzwa njengenhlekelele.
BAVUMBUKE emkhankasweni wokutakulwa kwabavukuzi ababhajwe emayini engasebenzi eStilfontein, eNorth West osomathuba abafuna ngodli ukukhokhelwa u-30%.UMFUNDISI Mzwandile Molo nabaholi bamabandla emayini eStilfontein, eNorth West ngempelasonto Isithombe: SithunyelweBavele bezwa ukuthi uhulumeni usebenzisa cishe imali engu-R1 million ngosuku eqasha ochwepheshe abasebenza ngemishini emikhulu kutakulwa, osomathuba babona zimbiwe insele.Okhulumela amaphoyisa aseNorth West, uBrigadier Sabata Mokgwabone, uthe amaphoyisa abezitshela ukuthi asebenzisana namalungu omphakathi ajwayelekile ngenhloso yokukhipha abavaleleke emathunjini omhlaba, kwase kuvumbuka osomathuba.Ukuchaze ngokuthi amanzi amancane okwenziwa yilaba bantu, yinto amaphoyisa azoyisombulula ngokushesha.UNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa uMnuz Senzo Mchunu usanda kuhambela kuleya ndawo wathi umbutho awuholayo uzosebenzisana nezinye izinhlaka zikahulumeni kutakulwe izinkulungwane zabavukuzi okukholakala ukuthi basavalelekile.La bantu basanda kubhala incwadi becela ukudla nama-ARV okuyimishanguzo ethithibalisa isandulela-ngculazi nengculazi.Ushaye phansi ngonyawo uNgqongqoshe wezeMpilo uDkt Aaron Motsoaledi wathi ama-ARV akuwona ama-panado athengwa esitolo.Uveze nokuthi umuntu uqale ahlolwe wudokotela noma ngunesi ngaphambi kokuthi anikwe wona.Ngempelasonto uMkhandlu wamaBandla uhambele kule ndawo uyokweseka izinhlelo zokuthi kukhishwe abavukuzi.Unobhala weSouth African Council of Churches (SACC), uMfundisi Mzwandile Molo, uthe kumele kutholakale indlela yokukhipha la bantu bephila."Silapha singamabandla sizothi yikuphi esingalekelela ngakho. Sikhuthaza amasonto akhona eStilfontein ukuthi bangaluthathi njengolujwayelekile usuku iSonto. Imithandazo yethu kumele izwakalise usizi abantu ababhekene nalo kulendawo,” kusho uMolo.Uthe abantu abanezihlobo ezivalelekile kule mayini engasasebenzi bazobuyelwa ithemba uma abamabandla bemi nabo."Kunzima ukuba wumama onengane angakaze ayibone izinsuku ezingu-30 ngoba ivaleleke kule ndawo angase ayithole isishonile. Uphila kanjani nento enjalo?” kubuza uMolo.UMolo ubehamba nabaholi bamabandla abebeqhamuka ezingxenyeni ezehlukene zezwe nasemazweni angaphandle.
KUHLAKAZWE isizinda sokudayiswa kwezimpahla zomgunyathi ezishaqwe amaphoyisa ezingabiza u-R8.6 million eGoli ngempelasonto.Ukushaqwa kwalezi zinto kwenzeke ngokwehlukana eLanglaagte naseHoneydew.AMAKHA awumbombayi avundululwe amaphoyisa eLanglaagte eGoli Isithombe: SAPSOkhulumela amaphoyisa aseGauteng uColonel Dimakatso Nevhuhulwi, uthe lo mkhankaso ubuqhutshwa wuphiko iSAPS Gauteng Counterfeit Unit, Brand Protectors nohlaka olulwa nobugebengu emphakathini.Ulandise wathi ngoLwesihlanu eLanglaagte kushaqwe amakha awumgunyathi angabiza ngaphezu kuka-R5.3 million."Abebewadayisa bakhokhiswe inhlawulo ehambisana nokuhweba ngezimpahla eziwumbombayi,” kusho uCol Nevhuhulwi.Uqhube wathi umkhankaso wamaphoyisa wokulwa nobugebengu uwaholele eHonedew, ngoMgqibelo.Kubikwa ukuthi lapha kushaqwe izinto ezihambisana namafoni, izimpahla zokugqoka nezicathulo okuwumbombayi, ama-LED lights konke okungabiza u-R3.3 million.Losigaxamabhande ube esekhipha isexwayiso esibhekise emphakathini wathi kuyicala elibomvu ukuhweba ngezinto eziwumgunyathi.Uveze nokuthi abantu abazimbandakanya nale ndlela yokuphulwa komthetho basuke bekhinyabeza ukusimama komnotho wezwe."Yingakho izinhlaka zokuphepha eGauteng zizoqhubeka nokuhlakaza lezi zidleke okudayiswa kuzona izimpahla zomgunyathi,” kuchaza uCol Nevhuhulwi.Umphakathi uyacelwa ukuthi ubikele amaphoyisa nganoma yini ethinta izenzo zobugebengu ngokuthi bashayele enombolweni yeCrime Stop ethi: 08600 10111.Bangabika nakwi MySAPS app bayigodle imininingwane yabo uma bethanda.
Izinkinga zesidoda, ukukhuluphala ngokweqile, ukubhema notshwala kungezinye zezizathu ezidala ukungazali kwabesilisa.Ucwaningo lweBMJ Public Health Journal, olwenziwe nyakenye lwakhishwa ngoLwesibili, okuhambisana nosuku lwamadoda emhlabeni, i-International Men's Day, luveza ukuthi u-50% wabathandanayo ubhekana nenkinga yokungazitholi izingane, emhlabeni."Ukungazali akusona isifo esizimele, kodwa wuphawu lwezimo ezikhona noma izinkinga zempilo ezingase zidinge ukuhlolwa nokwelashwa,” kusho udokotela wezokubelethisa nodokotela wezifo zabesifazane uDkt Chetna Jain.Uthe ezinye izinto eziwumthelela yimithi ethile yokwelapha, ufuzo, imvelo nendlela yokuphila.Uqhube wathi zikhona izimpawu ezisobala ezifana nokungaphumi kwesidoda noma ubuhlungu esikhwameni samankwahla.I-Varicocele: Ukuvuleka kakhulu komthambo oya esikhwameni samankwahla, okuphazamisa ukuphola okudingekayo emankwahleni, okuholela ekwehleni kwezinga lesidoda nenani laso.Amagciwane: Uthe i-Orchitis (ukuvuvukala kwamankwahla ), i-epididymitis, noma izifo ezithathelana ngokocansi njenge-gonorrhea zingase zibangele ukulimala kwamankwahla, ukuvaleka kwesidoda, noma ukuncipha kwenani lesidoda.Inkinga yokukhipha isidoda: Ukubuyela emuva kwesidoda sigelezele esinyeni esikhundleni sokuphuma endukwini. "Kungase kube ngenxa yesifo sikashukela, ukulimala komgogodla, noma ukuhlinzwa kwendlala yesinye noma esinyeni,” kusho ungoti.Izinkinga zesidoda: Izinkinga ezifana nesidoda esingasebenzi kahle, ukungabibikho kwesidoda oketshezini oluphuma kowesilisa i-azoospermia, kanye nesidoda esincane (oligospermia) kungaholela ekutheni ungazali.Ukuphazamiseka kwamahomoni: Ukungabikhona kwe-testosterone eyanele, i-pituitary gland kungehlisa izinga lokukhiqizwa kwesidoda nokungalangazeleli ukuya ocansini.Ufuzo: Enye yezimbangela zokungatholi abantwana kwabesilisa i-Klinefelter syndrome, okuyisimo lapho owesilisa ene-chromosome yobulili engu-X eyengeziwe. Lokhu kungenzeka kuphazamise ukukhula kwamankwahla, ukukhiqizwa nokusebenza kwesidoda.Amasosha omzimba e-Antisperm: "Amasosha omzimba ahlasela isidoda ngephutha, okuholela ekwehleni kokuhamba nokusebenza kwesidoda,” kusho uDkt Jain.Ukwelashwa komdlavuza: Ukwelashwa komdlavuza njenge-chemotherapy, imisebe (radiation) , noma ukuhlinzwa kungakhinyabeza ukukhiqizwa kwesidoda.UDkt Radhika Potluri owungoti esikhungweni eselapha izinkinga zenzalo, i-Oasis Fertility, uthe izinkinga zenzalo zidala ingcindezi nokhwantalala emadodeni.Uthe ucwaningo olwenziwe i-StatPearls luveza ukuthi u20% wezinkinga zenzalo udalwa izinkinga zabesilisa."Inkinga yokungazali kufanele ikhulunywe ngozwelo ngoba inomthelela engqondweni, ukwesekwa nokuzinakekela kubalulekile kulolu hambo ,” kwengeza uPotluri.

KULINDWE iKhabhinethi yaKwaZulu-Natal ngesinqumo esicelweni sesikhwama esibhekele izindaba zeSilo uMisuzulu, iZulu Royal Household Trust, esidinga ukwengezelwa ngochatha kaR10 million, esabelweni saso.Ukwanda kohlu lwabantu abahlomula ngaphansi kwaso kwenze ukuthi sifune ukwengezelwa imali.Isikhwama sisabhekele amazinyane noNdlunkulu beSilo esabuza, uMdlokombane, kanti ngemuva kokugcotshwa kweSilo uMisuzulu, kwengezwe abantu abahlomulayo kusona okubalwa amazinyane akhe, nondlunkulu ababili.UNdunankulu wesifundazwe uMnuz Thami Ntuli, wamemezela ngesikhathi ethula isabelomali sehhovisi lakhe, ukuthi isabelomali sesikhwama singu-R77.5 million kulo nyaka wezimali. Le mali ibhekele ukwenza izinto eziningi endlunkulu okubalwa ukulungisa izigodlo, ukubamba imicimbi ebalulekile esizweni okubalwa nemikhosi emikhulu, ukufundisa amazinyane kaMdlokombane, naweMbube esesihlalweni.UDkt Nonhlanhla Mkhize, uMqondisi jikelele ehhovisi likandunankulu, utshele amalungu ekomiti lezezimali esiShayamthetho sesifundazwe eMgungundlovu, ukuthi ngemuva kokugcotshwa kweSilo uMisuzulu, kwengezwe ohlwini abanye abazobhekelelwa okubalwa ondlunkulu baso ababili, namazinyane.Uthe kwenzeka lokhu nje bebesaqhubeka nokubhekela amazinyane asafunda kaMdlokombane, noNdlunkulu bakhe nabanye endlunkulu.Umphathi wezimali zesikhwama uMnuz Sipho Buthelezi, ucacisile ngemoto okumele ithengelwe omunye wondlunkulu beSilo uMisuzulu, ezodla ngaphezu kwesigidi. Uthe le moto ebesekunesikhathi beyilindile ukuthi ifike, kulindeleke ukuthi ilethwe ngenyanga ezayo."Le moto ibingekho kodwa isiyathengwa. Kulindwe kuphela ukuthi ilethwe ngoDisemba, kanye kuzoba ngeyomunye wondlunkulu,” kusho uButhelezi.Kuvele nokuthi isikhwama sesisebenzise ngaphezu kuka-70% wesabelomali ekubeni kusasele izinyanga ezibalelwa kweziyisithupha ngaphambi kokuphela konyaka wezimali.UMnuz Tim Brauteseth we-DA, uthe bayayeseka indlunkulu wathi kodwa kudingeka kuboshwe izifociya ngoba kayikho imali. Uthe abanankinga nemali enguR10 million, okulindwe impendulo yeKhabhinethi.Ufakazelwe ngusihlalo wekomiti uMnuz Mthandeni Dlungwana, othe kumele kuqiniswe izifociya ngoba imali kayikho.UBrauteseth ufune ukwazi ukuthi imali engu-R3.5 million, ebibekelwe ukuhlanganisa izingcithabuchopho kuphunywe nesu lokuthi isikhwama singazifakela kanjani inzuzo ukuze singathembeli kuhulumeni, yenzeni?UMnuz Mervyn Dicks weMK, uthe ziningi izindlela zokuthi lesi sikhwama singenise imali njengoba kukhona izinkampani ezinikwe amathuba okuthi zigumbe umhlaba weSilo ngenxa yezimayini."Ziningi ezinye izinto zokwenza imali emhlabeni weSilo. Kumele zibhekwe lezo zindlela ukuze isikhwama singenise imali.”UDlungwana uthe isikhwama asikwazi ukusebenzisa imali esingenayo."Njengomuntu ophethe imali kumele uthathe izinqumo ezinzima. Okusinika ithemba ngukuthi kunezinhlelo zokuthi isikhwama sizenzela imali kunaphambilini lapho kwakufakwa nje imali bese kungabikhona izinhlelo zokuthi izobuya kanjani,” kusho uDlungwana.UButhelezi uthe zikhona izinto aseke bazenza njengokuzama ukuthenga izitolo zakwa-Spar, kodwa bathola ukuthi lezi zitolo aziyenzi imali."Sibheka manje izitolo ezintsha ukuze sikwazi ukutshala imali kuzona, bese kubuya inzuzo ezongena esikhwameni.”

SEKUSEMOME ukuthi zihlonzwe njengenhlekelele izehlakalo zabantu abaguliswa nabashona ngenxa yokudla okunobuthi okuthengwa ezitolo ezehlukene kuleli.Lokhu kuvezwe nguNgqongqoshe wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu kuzwelonke uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa, esithangamini nabezindaba soNgqongqoshe abahlukene.UHlabisa uveze ukuthi kunemigomo esalandelwa nguhulumeni ngaphambi kokuba lezi zehlakalo zibe yinhlekelele.Namaphoyisa axwayise ngokuthi ngeke ananaze ukubathathela izinyathelo abazophazamisa izinhlelo zikahulumeni zokunqanda lesi sihlava.Kunxuswe abantu ukuthi bangaphazamisi abafuna ukubhalisa izipaza."Uhulumeni usalandela imigomo ethile ngaphambi kokuhlonza lezi zehlakalo njengenhlekelele. Le migomo yenza ukuthi kube nokusebenzisana kweminyango ehlukene kahulumeni ngalesi sihlava esibhekene nezwe.” UHlabisa uthe abantu abangalindi kuze kuphele izinsuku ezingu-21, ezibekwe ngumengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, ngaphambi kokubhalisa izipaza zabo.Uthe isikhathi sisekhona kodwa siyahamba abanye belokhu benqikaza ukuyobhalisa.UKhomishana wamaphoyisa uGeneral Fannie Masemola, uxwayise ngokuthi abazophazamisa amaphoyisa ekwenzeni umsebenzi wawo, bazoyikhotha imbenge yomile.Uthe kunamathimba azophuma engena esiza abahlola izindawo ezidayisa nezigcina impahla."Silindele ukuthi wonke umuntu abambisane nathi. Sizoqhubeka nokuhambela izindawo okugcinwa kuzona impahla, izitolo ezidayisa ukudla nezipaza. Asifuni kube nezinto ezingalungile ezizongena ezweni,” kusho uMasemola. Abantu banxuswe ukuthi babhalise izipaza zabo komasipala ukuze bathole usizo.UNgqongqoshe wamaBhizinisi amancane, uNkk Stella Ndabeni-Abrahams, uthe amabhizinisi ahambisana nayo yonke imigomo azobhaliswa.Uthe abazogxila kuphela kumaspaza kodwa bazowabheka nalawo amakhulu adayisa ukudla."Sifuna ukuthola ukuthi kwenzekani ngakho ngeke sigxile emabhizinisini amancane kuphela. Ungalenza ibhizinisi kuleli noma ungowangaphandle kodwa uma unazo zonke izimfanelo.”Uthe ucwaningo luveze ukuthi zibalelwa ku-150 000 izipaza ezikhona kuleli. "Noma ngubani onebhizinisi kungaba isedolobheni, emakhaya noma elokishini kumele abhalise. Kungaba ibhusha noma iliphi elinye ibhizinisi kudingeka ubhalisile nomasipala.” UNgqongqoshe wezobuLungiswa uNksz Thembi Simelane, uthe kusuka ngoSepthemba nonyaka, zingaphezu kuka-890 izehlakalo ezibikiwe ezithinta ukudla okunobuthi."Kuzoqokwa ithimba labezempilo elizobheka imigomo nezinto okumele zenziwe ukunqanda le nkinga ezweni. Indaba yokushoda kwabezempilo abahamba behlola, yinto esiyisukumele ngokushesha kuzona zonke izindawo,” kusho uNksz Simelane.
USIHLALO wekomiti elibhekelele ukusebenza kwemali yomphakathi ePhalamende, uMnuz Songezo Zibi, akaneme ngokucotha kophenyo lwamacala okushushumbiswa kwemali nalawo athinta imali esetshenziswa ukulekelela abashokobezi.Kuleli sonto uZibi utshele uphiko lwezokushusha kuleli i-National Prosecuting Authority (NPA) ukuba izinuke amakhwapha ngokubekwa endaweni embi kweNingizimu Afrika uma kubhekwa ukuphenywa nokujeziswa kwabashushumbisa imali.Ukhale ngokuthi i-Financial Action Task Force (FATF) ithole ukuthi kulula ukushushumbisa imali esetshenziswa ngabashokobezi eNingizimu Afrika futhi abenza lo mkhuba abashushiswa masinyane."Angineme neze ukuthi i-NPA ishaya ngonyawo lonwabu uma kufanele ijezise abashushumbisa imali njengoba kuthiwa leyo mali igcina ixhasa abashokobezi. Sidinga i-NPA isebenze ngamandla ishushise abashushumbisa imali ukuze izwe lethu lizobukeka kahle kwi-FATF. Uma izwe likleliswe endaweni embi yi-FATF akulula ukuthi lithole abatshalizimali,” kusho uZibi.IPhini loMqondisi wamacala omphakathi kwiNPA, u-Advocate Rodney de Kock, lithe sebelungise izikhalo eziwu-16 kweziwu-22 ezazifakwe yi-FATF.Ubalule ukuthi beza kahle ekushushiseni abashushumbisa imali esengcupheni yokusetshenziswa ngabashokobezi njengoba amacala abagwebayo eyela ku-80%.Uthe ngokwakhe iNingizimu Afrika iyasebenza kulo mkhakha futhi zizobonakala izithelo ezinhle zomsebenzi abawenzayo.UZibi uthe uDe Kock umane uvikela i-NPA nje ngoba ukube isebenza ngokuzikhandla ngabe i-FATF ayizange ithathe isinqumo esinzima ngezwe.Uthe uma zilungiswa zonke izikhalo ze-FATF izwe kufanele liphume ohlwini lamazwe okulula ukushushumbisa imali kuwo ngoMeyi wonyaka ozayo.
KUYIPHULE izinhliziyo imindeni yabagilwa ukushaya unqimphothwe kommangalelwa wokuqala kwelokubulawa kwabangani eKenville, eveza ukuthi usefuna ukufaka isicelo sebheyili ayengasifuni.Abangani, uMnuz Lungani Mthethwa ongummangalelwa wokuqala noMnuz Sandile Chili owesibili bebevele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini kuleli sonto.Basolwa ngokubulala abangani uNksz Anele Mbokazi (29) owayengumhlengikazi esibhedlela iNkosi Albert Luthuli noNksz Zizipho Gabisa (30) owayengusokhemisi eMhlanga, ngo-Agasti 25.Abafi badutshulwa bekade belandwe abamangalelwa emakhaya eRiverview Park eVerulam ngo-Agasti 24, bebakhipha. UChili ungaphandle ngebheyili kaR5000 emva kokugonyuluka ngakho konke okwenzeka, eninda uMthethwa. Okhulumela umndeni kaNksz Mbokazi, uMnuz Mvuselelo Magwaza uthe: "Kusizwisa ubuhlungu ukuthi nakuba ummangalelwa wesibili wagonyuluka konke phambilini, ummangalelwa wokuqala, kunokuthi avume icala ukuze sisheshe sidlule kule nto, yena ufaka isicelo sebheyili.”Uthe yize uChili eninda uMthethwa, bakholwa ukuthi naye uyathinteka kokwenzeka ngoba babehamba ndawonye.Uthe uma enganikwa ithuba lokukhuluma noChili, angambuza ukuthi ukube kwakuyingane yakhe eyabulawa phambi kwakhe, wayezoqhubeka yini axoxisane nombulali. Abamangalelwa bebeswenke beconsa.UMthethwa eshaye isudi nehembe likanokusho, uChili efake ihembe elimhlophe qwa, waze waleleka ngewashi elibukeka kungelemali eshisiwe.Njengenjwayelo, inkantolo ibivale ngomuntu emnyango, abantu ebebezokweseka imindeni yabafi.Icala lihlehlele uDisemba 18, ukuze uMthethwa afake isicelo sebheyili.
LINGASE ligaye ngomunye umhlathi uma kuphasiswa umthetho wezemishado njengoba abesifazane abakipitile sebefuna ukuvikelwa ngumthetho, bangaphumi bezishayela uma ucu lungasahlangani noma sekushona omasihlalisane babo. Bafuna kube nesigatshana emthethweni esizobanika ilungelo lokuthi bathole indlu nezingane uma kukhona okwenzekayo ngoba basuke bechithe isikhathi sabo kulowo mkipito.Lezi ngezinye zezinto ezigqamile eziphakanyiswe ezigcawini ezehlukene, zokuthola imibono yomphakathi wasesifundazweni iGauteng kuleli sonto.Ikomiti loMnyango wezaseKhaya ePhalamende lisemkhankasweni wokuthola ukuphawula komphakathi ngoMthethosivivinywa wezemishado.Njengoba kuphothulwe izigcawu eGauteng, ngonyaka ozayo lizoqhubeka nazo kwezinye izifundazwe.USihlalo wekomiti, uMnuz Mosa Chabane, uthe iphuzu lokuthi abakipitile kufanele bahlomule, ngelinye ebelisematheni eGauteng.Uthe bakhale ngokuthi njengoba kulezi zinsuku imishado kuyilanga elingashisi noma ngubani, kubalulekile ukuthi bangaphumi beshwiba izandla abesifazane nezingane uma kuhlukanwa."Bakhale ngokuthi bagcina besele dengwane nezingane zabo uma kwenzeka kuhlukanwa yingakho befuna umthetho ubabhekelele ngesigatshana esizothinta umuzi kanjalo namanye amalungelo njengoba kwenzeka kulabo abasuke beshadile. Lesi siphakamiso sizosibheka uma sesihlanganisa yonke into ethinta imibono yomphakathi,” kusho uChabane.Uthe kuhlukane imibono kwezinye zezinto ebeziphakanyiswa njengoba abanye bebethi akunyuswe iminyaka yomuntu ovumeleke ukushada ibe ngu-18, abanye bethi ayibe ngu-21, kanti abanye bathe ayibe ngu-25."Abanye bebethi mncane umuntu ona-18 ukuthi angavunyelwa ukushada ngoba usuke esafunda. Abanye bebethi akube yicala ukushada nengane engaphansi kuka-18.” UChabane uveze ukuthi abanye bebefuna kubekwe imigomo ethile ezobhalwa phansi ngaphambi kokuba kuphothulwe ezithinta umshado wasesithenjini."Kuphakanyisiwe nokuthi kumele kuqiniswe umthetho kulabo abafuna ukushada abantu bangaphandle. Bafuna kulindwe isikhathi esingangonyaka, kwenziwe nophenyo olunzulu ngaphambi kokuba kugunyazwe lo mshado. Abanye bathe kumele kwakhiwe amathuba emisebenzi ukuze abantu bakuleli bangajahi ukushada nabantu bangaphandle ngoba befuna imali,” kuqhuba uChabane.Uthe abanye bakhale ngokuthi uMthethosivivinywa wezemishado awusho lutho ngosiko lokuthwalwa kwabesifazane, abathathwa ngenkani emakubo beyoganiswa."Abantu abaningi bathe kumele lichithwe leli siko ngoba liphoqa amantombazane asemancane ukuthi ashadiswe ngenkani nabantu abadala.” UChabane uthe bafuna kube nomthetho owodwa ozolawula imishado futhi uhlanganise amasiko nezinkolelo zezenkolo ezehlukene. Uveze ukuthi abezenkolo bayakuchitha ukuthi umthetho ube wodwa bakhala ngokuthi uzobukela phansi amanye amasiko nezenkolo. "Abanye bakhala ngokuthi abasebenzi boMnyango wezaseKhaya ngeke besakwazi ukunqaba ukushadisa abantu ngoba bengahambisani nezinto abakholelwa kuzona. Lokhu bakubona njengokuthi kushaywa indiva izinkolelo zabo.”
AMAQEMBU aphethe ngokubambisana uhulumeni KwaZulu-Natal azifanise nephupho izinsongo zeMK zokuhlwitha uhulumeni wesifundazwe.I-IFP, ANC, DA neNFP bathe iMK angeke ize iwuphathe uhulumeni wesifundazwe. Wonke la maqembu athe uhulumeni ophethe isifundazwe awuyi ndawo.Lokhu akusho ngesikhathi kunenkulumo mpikiswano esiShayamthetho izolo.Inkulumo mpikiswano ibigxile ekubhekeni umsebenzi owenziwe uhulumeni wesifundazwe kusukela wasungulwa ezinyangeni ezine ezedlule.Amalungu eMK asebenzise le nkulumo mpikiswano ukuveza izifiso zawo zokuphatha uhulumeni wesifundazwe.IMK iyona enezihlalo eziningi esiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal.Ilungu leMK, uMnuz Mervyn Dirks, lize laveza nokuthi bazimisele ukusebenzisana ne-ANC."Sizimisele ukusebenza ne-ANC kulesi siShayamthetho inqobo nje uma i-ANC izoqhamuka nohlelo olubambekayo lokuthuthukisa abantu baKwaZulu-Natal. Ningawubanga nje umsindo nize nigcine lapho nithanda khona kodwa iqiniso ukuthi iMK izophatha maduze lapha KwaZulu-Natal. Kusele kuyona i-ANC ukuthi iyavuma yini ukubambisana nathi.”Ilungu le-ANC, uMnuz Mafika Mndebele, lithe angeke nangeshobolo baze basebenze neMK.UMndebele uthe iMK iphethwe umkhapheli, wafanisa umholi wayo, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, noJudas Iscariot owajikela uJesu."UZuma wajikela i-ANC okuyiyona eyamnikeza isikhundla. UZuma wajikela amakhosi, wajikela nabantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Manje uZuma usejikele i-EFF. Wathi kwabe-EFF akube nobumbano kodwa namhlanje uwola bonke abaholi be-EFF.”Ilungu le-IFP, uMnuz Mntomuhle Khawula, lithe isifana nenganekwane eyokuthi uhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal uzokhishwa emandleni.UKhawula uthe labo abaphikisana nohulumeni wokubambisana baqala bathi uzophatha izinsukwana."Bashintsha bathi uzohlala amasonto nje ambalwa. Bathi besuka babethi angeke uyiqede inyanga. Zinhlanu izinyanga manje futhi siyaqhubeka nokusebenza kahle. Bayoqhotha baze bafike kwaMtshekula labo abalinde ukuthi ubhidlike uhulumeni ophethe isifundazwe.”Ilungu leDA, uMnuz Martin Meyer, lithe abeMK kufanele bakwamukele ukuthi abazange bathole izihlalo ezanele ukuthi baphathe uhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal.UMeyer ululeke abeMK ukuba balinde ukhetho oluzayo, oluzokuba ngo-2029, babone ukuthi angeke yini bathole amavoti anele ukuthi babuse ngokuzimela."Angiboni-ke kodwa ukuthi kukhona abantu abazovotela iqembu elingawuhloniphi uMthethosisekelo ukuba liphathe.”Ilungu leNFP, uNksz Mbali Shinga, nalo lithe angeke basebenze neMK.

KUSHONE elayizolo kusabalele imibiko yokuthi kushone abantu ababili abebemi kulayini wokuyovuselela izigubhu zabo ohlelweni lokuvuselela izigubhu zikagesi wekhadi oluqhutshwa yi-Eskom olubizwa nge-Key Revision Number (KRN2).ENewcastle, KwaZulu-Natal kushone owesifazane (70) ngabo 6 ekuseni obemi kulayini omude wokuyovuselela isigubhu sikagesi wekhadi.Ngokuthola kweSolezwe owesifazane ubemi kulayini kusukela ngo-2 entathakusa ngoba ubengafuni ukuthi kushaye umnqamulajuqu kaNovemba 24 isigubhu sakhe singangenanga ohlelweni lweKRN2.UColonel Robert Netshiunda wamaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uthe amaphoyisa aseNewcastle avule idokodo emuva kokuthi owesifazane (70) ewile washona.Uthe amaphoyisa asaphenya ngembangela yokushona kwakhe.Isiteshi sezindaba sethelevishini iNewzroom Afrika sibike ukuthi kushone owesilisa naye obemi kulayini wokuvuselela isigubhu sakhe sikagesi wekhadi eSoweto.Isolezwe lizamile ukuthinta abase-Eskom ukubabuza ukuthi bayazi yini ngalezi zigameko nokuthi yini abazoyenza ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abadala abashoneli kolayini.Ithimba elibhekele abezindaba likuqinisekisile ukuthi liyitholile imibuzo yeSolezwe lathembisa ukuthi lizoyiphendula.Okwamanje umnqamulajuqu kaNovemba 24 usamile njengoba i-Eskom ithi wuhlelo olungakwazi ukuhlehliswa lolu ngoba uma sekudlule usuku olunqunyiwe izigubhu ezingangenanga ohlelweni olusha zizocima.Izolo abantu bebekhala ngolayini abade ezikhungweni zase-Eskom besho nokuthi uthola ukuthi isikhungo sinabantu ababili abasebenzayo ikakhulu ezindaweni zasemakhaya okubalwa oMtubatuba nezinye eziseNyakatho yeKwaZulu-Natal.ISouth African Local Government Association igqugquzele omasipala ukuba balekelele abantu ukuba bangene kulolu hlelo olusha.Ithe selokhu kwaqala uhlelo lwe-Token Identifier (TID) ibibheka ukuthi bangaki abantu asebeshintshele ohlelweni lwe-KRN2.Iveze ukuthi njengamanje zingaphezulu kuka-2 million izigubhu ezidinga ukungena ohlelweni olusha.UDkt Silas Mulaudzi oyisazi samandla eSalga uthe izigubhu eziningi ezingakangeni ohlelweni olusha yilezo abanikazi bazo abakokotele ugesi.Uthe bakhona nalabo abawuthengayo ugesi abangazi noma izigubhu zabo sezingenile yini ngaphansi Bashaqwe oKlebe besemhlanganweni wesigungu esiphezulu ngoLwesihlanu abaholi bakamasipala waKwaNongoma okuthiwa basolwa ngenkohlakalo ethinta amathenda. Kuvelwa ukuthi kushaqwe imeya eyilungu leNFP, iphini layo le-EFF nosomlomo we-ANC.La baholi amagama abo angeke adalulwe ngenxa yokuthi abakaveli enkantolo, baphenyelwa izenzo zenkohlakalo.Kuthiwa basolwa ngokugwazelwa inkampani eyathola ithenda emkhandlwini.Umasipala okuboshwe kuwo lezikhulu uphethwe ngokubambisana iNFP, ANC ne-EFF.Akucaci ukuthi labaholi bathathelwe ukuyohlonywa ngemibuzo noma bazothweswa amacala ngokusemthethweni.Okhulumela oKlebe KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant Colonel Simphiwe Mhlongo, uthe ubengakezwa ngokushaqwa kwalezi zikhulu.Umthombo obuKwaNongoma uthe abantu bebemi izixongololo ngaphandle kwamagceke omkhandlu behleba ngayo le ndaba yokuthathwa kwezikhulu.
IZIHLATHI zivakashela izindlebe kwabanezikweletu njengoba iBhange loMbuso, iSouth African Reserve Bank (Sarb) liphinde layehlisa ngo-25 basis points imalimboleko.Lokhu kusho ukuthi izosuka ku-11.5% iye ku-11.25%.Umphathi weSarb uMnuz Lesetja Kganyago, uthe wonke amalungu athatha izinqumo ngemalimboleko avumele ukuba yehliswe ngo-25 basis points.Njengoba imalimboleko yehla isiwu-11.25% kusho ukuthi inzalo ekhokhwa ngabanezikweletu isizoqala ku-7.5% njengoba ibiwu-8%.UKganyago uthe abazange baluphathe nakanye udaba lokwehlisa imalimboleko ngo-50 basis points."Akusikona ukuthi sifuna ukuntswinya abantu bakuleli kodwa izinqumo esizithathayo sisuke sizenzela bona. Yebo amandla emali ayadlondlobala njengoba eseku-2.8% kodwa sibheka nokunye okwenzeka ezweni nasemhlabeni jikelele. Sisakhathazekile ngokuthi ugesi uyabiza. Siyabheka nezimpi eziqhubeka kwamanye amazwe ezinomthelela emnothweni womhlaba jikelele,” kusho uKganyago.Isazi somnotho saseFNB, uNkk Mamello Matikinca-Ngwenya, sithe bebevele belindele ukuthi imalimboleko izokwehla ngo-25 basis points ngenxa yokudlondlobala kwamandla emali.Uthe balindele ukuthi yehle ngomunye u-25 basis points emihlanganweni elandelayo yeSarb kuze kube wuMeyi wonyaka ozayo.UMnuz Bradd Bendall wenkampani ebolekisa ngemali kwabathenga izindlu iBetterBond, naye uthe bebewulindele u-25 basis points okwehliswe ngawo.Uthe lokhu kuyizindaba ezinhle ngoba kuzolekelela abakhokhela imizi abangazange babe nohlelo lokukhokha imali ethile namabhange abo (fixed rate).Ubalule ukuthi lokhu kuzogqugquzela nabafuna ukuthenga imizi ukuthi bangene emakethe njengoba ukwehla kwemalimboleko kusho ukuthi ngeke bakhokhiswe inzalo enkulu.
ZIMBILI VILAKAZIUdedelwe ngebheyili ka-R5000, yiNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini, owaseMsinga osolwa ngokudubula ayebasola ngokumubamba inkunzi. UMnuz Muzi Phungula (38) ongowokudabuka eMsinga kuthiwa wadubula uMnuz Mthobisi Mnguni nabanye ababili abangaziwa ngo-Okthoba 24 nonyaka.Ummeli kaMuzi, uMnuz S Phungula efunda incwadi kamsolwa efungelwe emcelela ibheyili uthe ngosuku lwesigameko, umsolwa wayemi nabanye abathathu ngaseMusgrave, bephethe amabhodi abhalwe ukuthi baya eMgungundlovu. "Kwehla abasolwa ababili emotweni eyiSuzuki 7 seater, batshela umsolwa ukuthi bazothatha yena yedwa ngoba ezikhaleni ezisele basazogibeza abanye abahamba nabo ngendlela," kusho uPhungula.Uqhube wathi, imoto yathi uma isingaseSherwood, bamshintshela, bamthuka, bamkhiphela izibhamu bathi bayasebenza manje."Ngenhlanhla umsolwa wakwazi ukuthi adonse esakhe kuqala wabadubula bonke, ngisho ngomshayeli," kusho uPhungula.Udalule nokuthi ngesikhathi esedubule nomshayeli, imoto yaphaphalaza, yayoshayisa enye."Umsolwa waphuma emotweni wahamba, waya endlini yakhe," kusho uPhungula.Kuvele ukuthi uMuzi waboshwa emva kwezinsuku ezine isigameko senzekile, esezinikela emaphoyiseni ngosizo lommeli wakhe.Uzama ukubeka amaphuzu okuthi angayinikwa ibheyili uMbuso, ngomlomo kamshushisi uMnuz Calvin Govender uthe, nakuba kuzwakala okubekwa umsolwa kodwa kukhona okunye okushaya amanzi."Wabaleka endaweni yesigameko, amaphoyisa awawaficanga amagobolondo ezinhlamvu, umsolwa wawaqoqa wawayisa kubo eMsinga. Okunye nezibhamu athi wayehlaselwa ngazo, azitholakalanga ngakho akekho onolwazi lokuthi lokhu akushoyo kuyiqiniso," kusho uGovender.Uqhube wathi abafi babenamanxeba ngemuva okusho ukuthi babengesiyo ingozi kuye.Ebhola izimbobo emaphuzwini kaGovender, uPhungula uthe kungenzeka ukuthi izibhamu zabafi zantshontshwa abantu abafika kuqala kunamaphoyisa endaweni yesigameko. Nokho uGovender elekelelana nomphenyi wecala, uWarrant Officer Xolani Mlungwana, obesenezela ubufakazi bakhe ngomlomo uthe, umnikazi wemoto eyaphaphalazelwa yimoto yabafi esitatimendeni sakhe uveza ukuthi abekho abantu abafika bathinta indawo yesigameko ngaphambi kwamaphoyisa. Esitatimendeni sakhe kuthiwa uveza nokuthi wambona ummangalelwa ehla emotweni ebaleka ngezinyawo, wathi uma esondela kuyo, wabona ukuthi inabantu asebedutshulwe bafa.UMuzi kuthiwa wakucacisa ngesikhathi ezinikela emaphoyiseni ukuthi abafi wabadubula ngoba ezivikela. Wathi okwenza wabaleka futhi wangabika emaphoyiseni ngokushesha ukuthi wayethukile kodwa ukuzinikela kwakhe wakwenza ngoba azi ukuthi akanancala njengoba ababulala ezivikela.IMantshi uMnuz Ashwin Singh emdededela ngebheyili uthe ubufakazi bakhe buyamukeleka."Inkantolo ikudedela ngebheyili ka-R5000. Ukube awuzinikelanga emaphoyiseni ngabe namanje akuboshwe muntu ngaleli cala. Ukhombisile futhi ukuthi uzimisele ngokusebenza namaphoyisa ngoba uzinikele kuwo waze waletha namagobolondo ezinhlamvu," kusho uSingh.Icala lizobuyela enkantolo ngoFebhuwari 4, 2025.
Amaphoyisa aKwaZulu-Natal abophe abane abasolwa ngokuba ngabavukuzi abangekho semthethweni abatholwe namatshe akhipha igolide angabiza ngaphezu kuka-R3 million eNtumbane, oPhongolo ngoLwesine.Laba basolwa abaneminyaka ephakathi kuka-27 no-40 batholwe bematasa bezama ukukhipha igolide.Indawo lapho bekwenziwa khona igolide oPhongolo Isithombe: SithunyelweOkhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa athole ngokuvuza okungekho semthethweni okwenzeka endaweni, nokuthe uma efika abhadama abasolwa bematasa nomsebenzi wabo."Batholakale nemishini yasemayini ehlanganisa neziqhumane,” kusho uNetshiunda.Uthe abasolwa bazovela eNkantolo yeMantshi yasoPhongolo ngoLwesihlanu.
ABAWUBAMBELE amagqubu umndeni womsolwa obulawe ngesihluku ngamalungu omphakathi, ngezinsolo zokuthi unqume ingane waphuza igazi layo ngesonto eledlule eMkholombe, ePort Shepstone.UNksz Thami Qhoboshiyane onguninomncane kaPhumelele (2), isidumbu sakhe esatholwa sihlohlwe ebhakedeni singenalo ikhanda emjondolo osendaweni, uthe kuyisifiso somndeni ukuthelelana amanzi noka-Aphile Ngesi (16), obulawe ngesihluku ngamalungu omphakathi ngemva kokubhadanywa nesidumbu sengane sihlukaniswe nekhanda. Kuthiwa ngaphambi kokufa, u-Aphile wagonyuluka ngokunquma umgilwa eveza ukuthi uphuze negazi lakhe."Unina ka-Aphile (umsolwa), uthumele othile exolisa ngesenzo sendodakazi yakhe. Asiwubambele magqubu umndeni, wamukelekile ukufika emngcwabeni kaPhumelele ozokuba ngempelasonto eLusikisiki. Siyakuqonda ukuthi ingane wayengayithumile. Kubuhlungu okwenziwa yindodakazi yakhe kanjalo nokwenziwa wumphakathi kuyo kodwa ngeke kusabavusa ngakho impilo kumele iqhubeke,” usho kanje.Ukusho lokhu nje, umsolwa ona-17 ongumngani ka-Aphile okukholakala ukuthi wuyena owathumba uPhumelele emdoba ngokumthengela ama-chips, izolo uvele eNkantolo yeMantshi yasePort Shepstone. Inkantolo kuthiwa ilihlehlisele kusasa icala. Kuvele ukuthi izethameli bezingavunyelwe ngaphakathi enkantolo ngenxa yeminyaka yomsolwa, ngaphandle kukanina womsolwa.UNksz Qhoboshiyane uthe akeneme ngomndeni womsolwa ophilayo, wathi unina uzame ukumvikela ngokumphikela ukuthi icala ulenzile, gwiqiqi kwezwakala ukuthi yena umphelezelile ngesikhathi ezinikela emaphoyiseni."Kusiphatha kabi ukwenqatshelwa ukuthi singene enkantolo sizibonele umsolwa owenze lesi sihluku. Noma kunjalo, ukuboshwa kwakhe kusinika ithemba lokuthi sesizokwazi ukuthola ukuthi ngubani owayethume lezi zingane ukuthi zenze isihluku esinje. Kumanje sinezindleko esingazi sizozigcina ngani kwazise akekho osebenzaayo lapha ekhaya,” usho kanje.Uthe unina kamsolwa oboshiwe ngokubona kwabo, akakhombisi ukuzisola ngoba kwahlula noma sebezifikele mathupha kwakhe, kunalokho wavuka indlobane engafuni ukuzwa lutho ngesenzo okusolelwa kuso indodakazi yakhe.Imizamo yokuthola imindeni yabasolwa ayiphumelelanga njengoba abebekhuluma nentatheli bebezilandula izinombolo zayo.
UKHIPHE ingonyuluka kumalungu ePhalamende umqondisi jikelele eMnyangweni weMfundo eyisiSekelo, uMnuz Mathanzima Mweli, mayelana noputshuka kwamaphepha ka-matric minyaka yonke.UMweli utshele amalungu ukuthi amaphepha ka-matric awaputshuki ezinkampanini ezithole umsebenzi wokuwagaya kodwa aputshuka kwi-Government Printing Works.Ukusho lokhu kulandela ikhwelo lokuthi kumele kusetshenziswe lolu hlaka lukahulumeni ukugaya amaphepha ka-matric, njengoba ezifundazweni eziningi kusetshenziswa izinkampani ezizimele."Akumele ngabe ngiyayisho le, kodwa ukuputshuka kwamaphepha ka-matric kuleli, kwenzeka kwi-Government Printing Works. Iminyango yezifundazwe iyona eqoka izinkampani ezizogaya amaphepha ka-matric. Lokhu zikwenza ngenxa yezokuphepha,” kusho uMweli.Uthe amaphepha ka-matric kumele aqashwe ngelokhozi angaputshuki ngoba lokho kubeka engcupheni izinga lalezi zivivinyo.Uchithe nendaba yokuthi basebenzisa imali enkulu ukugaya amaphepha ka-matric.Uveze ukuthi u-R3.6 billion uhlanganisa lonke uhlelo lokubhalwa kwezivivinyo, kusuka ekukhokheleni abamakayo, ukukhokhela ukudla abazokudla, ukuhambisa amaphepha, ukuwagaya kanjalo nokunye okuhlanganisa lezi zivivinyo.NoNgqongqoshe walo mnyango, uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, ukuchithile ukuthi bakhokha imali enkulu ukugaya aka-matric.Bakusho lokhu ngesikhathi bevele ngaphambi kwekomiti lasePhalamende muva nje.Odabeni oluthinta ukuhanjiswa kwezincwadi nama-workbooks ezikoleni, uMweli uthe abazihambisi zonke ngesikhathi ngenxa yokuthi ziyebiwa. 'Asikwazi ukuwahambisa wonke kanye kanye ezikoleni ngoba sinenkinga yokuthi izikole ziyagqekezwa, bese kwebiwa. Yingakho ama-workbooks, siwahambisa kancane kancane ukuze engebiwa," kusho uMweli. Uthe kwesinye isikhathi kuke kushiswe isikole, ngakho abafuni ukuthi balahlekelwe yikhona konke okuyizinsiza zokufunda.Amalungu ePhalamende akhale ngokuthi kungani umnyango ugxile KwaZulu-Natal, ekubeni nezinye izifundazwe zibhekene nezinselelo ezifanayo?UNksz Gwarube uthe iKZN isenkingeni enkulu, ifana nesemgodini."Isenkingeni iKZN, sigxile kuyona ngenxa yezinkinga ezinkulu ebhekene nazo. Umnyango waseKZN ucwilile, kunezinkinga ezinkulu. Ziyalungiswa lezi zinkinga njengoba uMweli ebehambele kulesiya sifundazwe ezama ukulungisa izinkinga,” kubeka uNksz Gwarube.Uthe iKZN idinga lonke usizo oluvela kuwonke wonke njengoba sekungenelele noMengameli wezwe uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa noMgcinimafa kuzwelonke.UMweli uthe umnyango wesifundazwe uhluleka ukukhokhela izinto eziningi okubalwa osonkontileka, izikole, uchatha wothisha nokunye.
I-MK izosebenzisa umgubho wayo wokuhlanganisa unyaka, ozokuba eThekwini, ukugovuza abantu baKwaZulu-Natal ukuba bakhiphe uhulumeni wokubambisana ophethe isifundazwe.Le nhlangano ithe izogqugquzela izinkumbi zabantu, okulindeleke ukuthi zihambele umcimbi wayo ozokuba enkundleni iMoses Mabhida, ukuba zibe yingxenye yomkhankaso wokuketula uhulumeni oholwa yi-IFP.Umcimbi wokugubha unyaka kwasungulwa iMK uzokuba ngoDisemba 15.IMK iyona eyathola izihlalo eziningi esiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal kepha yasala ngaphandle ngesikhathi kwakhiwa uhulumeni wesifundazwe okubambisene kuwo i-IFP, ANC, DA neNFP.Oyinhloko ehhovisi likamengameli weMK, uMnuz Magasela Mzobe, uthe bewubuholi abakwazi ukusonga izandla ekubeni intando yabantu abaningi baKwaZulu-Natal abavota ingafezekile."Iqiniso ukuthi abantu baKwaZulu-Natal bazikhethela ukuthi bafuna ukuphathwa yiliphi iqembu. Imiphumela yokhetho ikuveza ngokusobala ukuthi yiliphi leli qembu. Ngakho-ke lona kuzokube kungesiwona nje umgubho ojwayelekile."Lapha sizogovuza abantu ukuthi balwele amavoti abo. Sifuna ukuthi balwele ukuthi iqembu okuyilona elathola amavoti amaningi okhethweni, kube yilona eliphathayo.”UMzobe uthe bafuna ukuthi uhulumeni ophethe ukhishwe singakashayi isikhathi sokuphasisa isabelomali sangonyaka ozayo."Lento abayenzayo yokuntshontsha imali kuhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal iyagcina ukwenzeka ngalesi sabelomali esikhona njengamanje. Kulesi sabelomali esizoqala ukusebenza ngo-Ephreli kuzokube sekuphethe iMK lapha KwaZulu-Natal.”Ebuzwa ukuthi yimaphi amaqembu abazobambisana nawo ukuphatha uhulumeni wesifundazwe njengoba bengenazo izihlalo ezanele ukuthi babuse ngokuzimela, uMzobe uthe i-ANC neNFP izobalekelela.I-ANC isanda kusho ukuthi azikho izingxoxo enazo neMK ngodaba lokuphathwa kohulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal.UNobhala jikelele weMK, uMnuz Floyd Shivambu, uthe bakhethe ukuletha umgubho eThekwini, ngenxa yokuthi bathola amavoti amaningi khona kanye nakwabanye omasipala baKwaZulu-Natal, ngesikhathi kunokhetho lwangoMeyi. UShivambu uthe iMK iyona eyazihola phambili ngokwamavoti komasipala abaningi baKwaZulu-Natal."Lapha eThekwini sathola amavoti angaphezu kuka-600 000. Abasilandelayo bathola amavoti angaphezu kuka-200 000. Igebe likhulu kakhulu.”UShivambu uthe bazokuba neminye imicimbi yokugubha unyaka kusukela kwasungulwa iMK.Ukusungulwa kweMK kwamenyezelwa ngokusemthethweni umholi wenhlangano uMnuz Jacob Zuma, ngoDisemba 16 nyakenye.UShivambu uthe ngoDisemba 16 kuzokuba nesidlo sakusihlwa e-Olive Convention Centre, lapho uZuma ezokwethula inkulumo.Kuzophinde kube nemihlangano yemiphakathi eGauteng, naseMpumalanga ezokwenzeka ngaphambi komcimbi omkhulu.
I-IFP ithi ibheke ukuthi ikhansela layo eliqokelwe kwesobumeya kuMasipala waseNdumeni, uMnuz Mcebo Mkhize (26), lidale amathuba amasha azothuthukisa abantu abakhele lo mkhandlu.Okhulumela i-IFP kuzwelonke, uMnuz Mkhuleko Hlengwa, uthe bamethembile uMkhize ukuthi uzokwazi ukuyilawula ngendlela inqola aqokelwe ukuba ayishayele.UMkhize uqokwe emhlanganweni womkhandlu obungoLwesibili.UHlengwa uthe bafuna ukubona umkhandlu ukhula ebuholini bukaMkhize."Kusijabulisile ukubona uMkhize eqokelwa esikhundleni sokuphatha umkhandlu. Sijahe ukubona eshayela le nqoba, ethatha umkhandlu ewubeka endaweni engcono kunalena okuyona.”UHlengwa uchaze uMkhize njengomholi ozimisele ngomsebenzi."Simfisela inhlanhla njengoba eqala umsebenzi wakhe. Sinethemba lokuthi amagalelo akhe azokhulisa umkhandlu adale namathuba amasha azothuthukisa umkhandlu. "Sifisa ukuthi ubuholi bakhe budale ushintsho empilweni yabantu buphinde buthuthukise impilo yabantu. Sifisa ukuthi asebenze ngokuzikhandla, ngobuhlakani, aphinde abeke phambili izidingo zabantu baseNdumeni.”UMkhize uphekwe enhlanganweni yabafundi edlelana ne-IFP, iSadesmo, uke wasebenza ehhovisi lentsha kuMasipala wesifunda uMzinyathi.Ukuqokwa kwakhe ukuba abe imeya yalo masipala okhungethwe izinkinga ezifana nesikweletu esikhulu umkhandlu osikweleta i-Eskom, kugxekwe amaqembu aphikisayo.I-ANC ne-ABC bathe bekufanele kuqokwe umuntu onesipiliyoni ukuba aphathe isikhundla, bakhala ngokuthi kuzomthatha isikhathi uMkhize ukuba afunde umsebenzi.Kepha uHlengwa uthe ukuqokwa kukaMkhize ukuba aphathe kukhombisa ukuthi i-IFP imuthembe kangakanani.Umhlangano owawubizelwe ukuzoqoka imeya ngeledlule wabhuntsha emva kokuthi kubikwe ukuthi kunebhomu emahhovisi omkhandlu.Izinja zamaphoyisa ezabizwa ukuba zizobheka ibhomu azizange zithole lutho.UMkhize ungena esikhaleni esivuleke emva kokwesula kukaMnuz Siyabonga Ndlovu, owesule ngenyanga edlule emva kokuthi iqembu elibambisene ne-IFP kumasipala, iDA, lifake isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bakhe.Ngalo uLwesibili, uNdlovu, ufungiswe njengekhansela kuMasipala wesifunda uMzinyathi.
UFAKAZI ecaleni lowesilisa othweswe icala lokubulala owesifazane isidumbu sakhe esatholakala silahliwe komunye umuzi KwaMashu ngonyaka odlule uveze ukuthi ummangalelwa wagonyuluka kuyena ngakwenzile.UMnuz Sphiwe Mkhize (36) ubevele enkantolo yeMantshi eNtuzuma ngecala lokubulala uNksz Noluthando Shezi (23). Ummangalelwa wakhalelwa ngamasongo kaSigonyela ngemuva kokuba ezinikele emaphoyiseni.Ufakazi igama lakhe eligodliwe izolo utshele inkantolo ukuthi uMkhize wagonyuluka kuyena ngokuthi uthathe ngenhliziyo wabulala umufi ngoba ecikwe ngabazali bakhe."Ngalo usuku anyamalala ngalo umufi uMkhize weza kimina wangitshela ukuthi kukhona into embi aseyenzile,'' usho kanje.Uthe wamncenga ukuthi amtshele ukuthi yini leyo ayenzile kodwa uMkhize wanqaba ukusho wahamba waze wabuya ngakusasa esozomtshela ukuthi ubulale owesifazane."Wangitshela ukuthi ukhethe ukuthi abulale umufi ngoba abazali bakhe babengasafuni ukumkhokhela imali yakhe. Ngambuza ukuthi yimalini le edala ukuthi aze akhiphe isidumbu wagcina engazange angitshele,'' kuchaza yena.Ngesikhathi ufakazi ekhuluma ummangalelwa ubemgqolozele emehlweni kwesinye isikhathi ubebuye abonakale esenikina ikhanda.Omunye ufakazi owabona isidumbu silahlwe egcekeni, uthe sasiboshwe umlomo ngendwangu emhlophe futhi sinamanxeba ehlukene entanyeni nasezingalweni.Utshele inkantolo ukuthi akubona ngalelo langa kwamhlukumeza kakhulu ngoba njalo kuyabuya emqondweni wakhe. "Empilweni yami ngangiqala ngqa ukubona isidumbu sowesifazane silahlwe ngaleya ndlela,’’ usho kanje.Unina kamufi, uNkk Nomalanga Shezi, utshele Isolezwe ukuthi ufuna ukubona ummangalelwa ebolela ejele ngesihluku asikhombisa endodakazini yakhe.Icala liyaqhubeka.
AWUZANGE ulubhade enkantolo, umndeni womsolwa ona-17 obhekene necala lokubulawa ngesihluku kwengane eneminyaka emibili isidumbu sayo esitholwe sihlohlwe ebhakedeni singenekhanda, eMkholombe ePort Shepstone ngesonto eledlule.Lo msolwa okuvela ukuthi ungowokudabuka eMasinenge ngaseMargate, kuthiwa uzinikele emaphoyiseni ephelezelwa wunina ngempelasonto, ubevele eNkantolo yeMantshi yasePort Shepstone ngoMsombuluko.Ubhekene necala lokubulawa ngesihluku kukaPhumelela Qhoboshiyane (2), okukholakala ukuthi wathunjwa edlala nomzala wakhe wathenjiswa ukuthengelwa ama-chips wumsolwa oboshiwe. Isidumbu sikaPhumelela satholwa sifakwe ebhakedeni emqashweni womsolwa. Amalungu omphakathi ayethukuthele, kuthiwa agxoba ngamatshe u-Aphile Ngesi (16), umngani womsolwa oboshiwe waze wafa. U-Aphile kuvela ukuthi wabhadanywa nesidumbu sengane, wathi uphuze igazi layo emva kokuyibulala kanti ikhanda latholakala emgodleni ayeselungiselele ukuhamba nawo.Umsolwa oboshiwe okuwuyena osolwa ngokuthi wathumba uPhumelela, wayengasabonwa ngesikhathi kubulawa umngani wakhe. Uzinikele emaphoyiseni emva kokufunwa uthuli wumphakathi.UPHUMELELA Qhoboshiyane isidumbu sakhe esitholwe sishumpulwe ikhanda, sifakwe ebhakedeni Isithombe: SITHUNYELWEEvela kule nkantolo, obekungavunyelwe ukuthi kube nezethameli kuyo ngenxa yeminyaka yakhe, kuthiwa kudingeke ukuthi inkantolo iyalele ukuthi avele namhlanje umsolwa ngenxa yokuthi abakubo abazange balubhade enkantolo okusolwa ukuthi basaba ulaka lomphakathi ngokusoleka komsolwa kulesi sehlo. Ilungu lekomiti elilwa nobugebengu eMasinenge lapho kudabuka khona umndeni kamsolwa, elingathandanga ukudalulwa, lithe ubeyingane ewuhlupho kusuka esemncane."Uyeke isikole eneminyaka ewu-12 efunda u-grade 4. Kusuka lapho ubesehamba ehlala, ethandana nabantu bokufika kuleli kwesinye isikhathi okuyibo abebemqashela indawo yokuhlala. Kwenzeka lokhu nje, kuthiwa bekusaphele izinyanga ezimbili kuphela efikile kule ndawo abeqashe kuyo,” usho kanje.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uColonel Robert Netshiunda uqinsekise ukuthi umsolwa uvelile enkantolo ngoMsombuluko wathweswa icala lokubulala.
