INHLANZI izoshelwa ngamanzi kwabakokotele ugesi wekhadi njengoba i-Eskom ithi ngeke lululwe uhlelo lokuvuselela izigubhu oseludume ngolweKey Revision Number (KRN)2.Izolo isikhulu esibhekele ukusebenza kwemali e-Eskom, uMnuz Calib Cassim sitshele abezindaba ukuthi ongavuselelanga isigubhu sakhe sikagesi ngeke abe nogesi ngoNovemba 25 njengoba umnqamulajuqu wokuvuselela ungoNovemba 24.Uthe iningi labanenkinga yilabo abakokotele ugesi.Amazwi akhe ananelwe wuNgqongqoshe kagesi uDkt Kgosientsho Ramokgopa odonse ngendlebe abantu ukuba bavuselele izigubhu zabo ngoba bazoba senkingeni ngesonto elizayo."Ngeke sikwazi ukulula usuku lomnqamulajuqu ngoba lwalubekwe yiStandard Transfer Specification Association (STSA). Ongakwazi ukuvuselela isigubhu sakhe sikagesi kusho ukuthi usenkingeni ngoba ngeke abe nawo. Sizocima isigubhu esingafakiwe iKRN. Ukuthola isigubhu esisha kuzodla imali eningi.” kusho uRamokgopa.I-Eskom ithe isigubhu esisha sibiza uR12 000 yathi abantu kufanele basebenzise leli thuba ukuvuselela izigubhu zabo.Abazoba senkingeni yilabo abakokotele ugesi ngoba i-Eskom izophenya ukuthi kungani isigubhu singasawamukeli ugesi wekhadi bese kuphenywa ukuthi ubelithenga yini ikhadi.URamokgopa uthe zisahamba kahle izinhlelo zabo zokuqinisekisa ukuthi izwe linogesi owanele njengoba zingekho ezokuwucima kuleli hlobo.Uthe ugesi ongeke ube khona ngesikhathi kusakhandwa imishini uwu-6 900MW kodwa ngeke ucime ngenxa yokuthi vele ugesi okhona mningi kakhulu.Ubalule ukuthi bonge ngaphezu kukaR15 billion ngezindleko zikadizili njengoba bengakhanyisi ama-generator. UCHAZWE njengesibani ebesikhanyisela wonke umhlaba, uMfundisi Mzwenkosi Ephraim Gcwensa (73), webandla lamaNazaretha oNyazilwezulu, enkonzweni yomngcwabo wakhe ebisemzini wakhe eMaphephetheni, eNdwedwe.Izikhulumi ebezifakaza ngempilo yakhe, bezithi akekho obengafisi ukusondela eduze kwakhe ngendlela abenothando ngayo. Omunye wabafundisi bamaNazaretha, uMfundisi Ntombela ohambe naye isikhathi eside, uthe ngisho umuntu obengakholwa ubefisa ukungcwatshwa wuMfundisi uGcwensa uma eshona.BEKUGCWELE kunyinyitheka kungcwatshwa uMfundisi Mzwenkosi Ephraim Gcwensa (73) webandla lamaNazaretha oNyazilwezulu, ebisemzini wakhe eMaphephetheni, eNdwedwe izolo Isithombe: SIBONELO NGCOBO"Ubengathandwa ebandleni lamaNazaretha kuphela kodwa nabangakholwa bebemthanda ngenxa yesihe abenaso ebantwini. Ngisho abaphuzayo ububezwa bethi uma sebeshonile bafisa ukungcwatshwa uyena. Mina ngishayeke kakhulu ngokuhamba kukaMfundisi Gcwensa ngoba bese sifana namawele. Sagcotshelwa ubufundisi sibancane naye sigcotshwa yiNkosi Ilanga. Ukube bengingahambi nezingane zami ngesikhathi ngithola umbiko wokuthi uMfundisi Gcwensa useshonile ngabe nami ngishonile. Ngihlulekile ukubekezela ngizwa lezi zindaba ngacishe ngawela emanzini. Mina bengijwayele ukuthola umbiko wokuthi akaphilile ngiye kombona sixoxe kubuye kudlule,” kusho uMfundisi Ntombela. Uqhube wathi njengoba bekufihlwa uMfundisi Gcwensa, bengabafundisi babizwe yiNkosi uMduduzi Shembe uNyazilwezulu ngoLwesibili lubatshela ukuthi bonke abafundisi abaye emngcwabeni kaMfundisi Gcwensa kungabikhona mfundisi ozosala.Obephethe uhlelo uMfundisi Madondo, uthe yena ukhuliswe wuMfundisi Gcwensa enkolweni futhi ubebukela kuyena. Uveze ukuthi ngisho nokushadisa waqeqeshwa uyena. Umzukulu kaMfundisi Gcwensa, uLungisani Gcwensa uthe: "Njengoba uhambile mkhulu akube wukuthi usuke emehlweni ethu nje kuphela kodwa uhlale unathi usigadile,” usho kanje maqede wakhihla isililo.Kuphinde kwafundwa nencwadi ebhalwe ngunkosikazi kaMfundisi Gcwensa, uMaSibiya ongunkosikazi wesithathu nokunguyena osaphila emakhosikazini akhe. Encwadini uMaSibiya uchaze indlela abebejabule ngayo ngezinsuku zokugcina eyobona umyeni wakhe esibhedlela."Kuthe uma ngifika ngabuza ukuthi uyangibona yini. Uvele wakhombisa injabulo wangibiza ngegama. Kungithokozisile lokho ukuthi uyangibona. Njengoba usungishiyile myeni wami ngicela ukhumbule ukuthi ungishiye ngimncane. Ngicela ungisingathe wenze isiqiniseko sokuthi ngiba wunkosikazi oqotho ukunakekela umndeni wakho,” kusho uMaSibiya.UMphathiswa wezokuThutha nokuHlaliswa kwaBantu kwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Siboniso Duma, ethula inkulumo kule nkonzo uthe: " Njengoba inhloso yethu enkulu kungukwakha isizwe esibumbene esithuthukayo, simunye, ibandla lamaNazaretha lingumthombo wethu wogqozi ukufezekisa le nhloso,” usho kanje.Kwabebehambele umngcwabo kaMfundisi Gcwensa singabala, ubuholi bukahulumeni okukhona kubona, uSotswebhu we-ANC ePhalamende uMnuz Mdumiseni Ntuli, uNdunankulu wakwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, uDkt Zweli Mkhize, uMbhishobhi Vusi Dube nabanye. Kulo mngcwabo bekugcwele kunyinyitheka kubonakala ukuthi bekungowomuntu onohlonze nobethandwa ngabantu.Umfundisi Gcwensa ushiye emhlabeni abantwana abangu-11, abazukulu abangu-63 nabayisikhombisa abayisizukulwane sakhe nonkosikazi wakhe uMaSibiya. Wayezalwa nguMshumayeli M Gcwensa nomkhokheli uMaNgidi Gcwensa.

KUPHAZAMISEKE ukusebenza kuMasipala iRay Nkonyeni abasebenzi bebasela imali abayikweletwa umkhandlu.Abasebenzi bomkhandlu bathe bazoqhubeka nombhikisho wabo baze bakhokhelwe imali abayikweletwayo baphinde banyuselwe nemiholo.I-SA Local Government Bargaining Council (SALGBC) yanquma ukuthi uMasipala iRay Nkonyeni kufanele unxephezele abasebenzi bawo ngenxa yokuthi bahola imali engaphansi kwaleyo okufanele engabe bayayihola.Esinqumweni esakhishwa ngoSepthemba, iSALGBC yaphinde yayalela umasipala ukuba unyuse imiholo yabasebenzi abathintekayo. Kepha kuze kube manje abasebenzi abakaze bakhushulelwe imiholo, futhi abakaze basithole nesinxephezelo.Ngokwesinqumo seSALGBC, abasebenzi baseRay Nkonyeni kwakufanele banyuselwe imiholo isuke esigabeni sesine iye kwesesihlanu ngesikhathi kuhlanganiswa uMasipala waseZinqoleni nowaseHibiscus, ngo-2016.ISALGBC yanquma ukuthi umasipala kufanele unxephezele abasebenzi ngomholo wezinyanga eziyisithupha bese benyuselwa imiholo kule nyanga.Omunye wabasebenzi abebebhikisha, uMnuz Bongani Gcaba, uthe bashaqeke baphela ngesikhathi kungena imiholo yabo yale nyanga."Sasilindele ukuthi sizothola imiholo esifanele, kodwa kwavele kwangena yona le mali esijwayele ukuyithola. Ingakho ke namhlanje sithathe isinqumo sokuthi sihlangane, bese siyofuna izimpendulo ebuholini bomkhandlu.”UGcaba usole imenenja kamasipala, uMnuz Khetha Zulu, ngokwenqaba ukubanxephezela."Ubuholi bomkhandlu bathatha isinqumo sokuthi kufanele sikhokhelwe imali yethu. Kwaze kwaba nomhlangano womkhandlu lapho kwavunyelwana ngokuthi kufanele sikhokhelwe. Sathuka emva kwalokho sesizwa kuthiwa uZulu uthe uzosiphonsela inselelo isinqumo esithi kufanele sithole isinxephezelo.”UGcaba uthe bazoqhubeka nombhikisho wabo baze bathole izimpendulo.Okhulumela uMasipala iRay Nkonyeni, uMnuz Simon April, uthe ubuholi bomkhandlu buzoxoxa nabasebenzi abatelekile.U-April uthe kunesivimbelo senkantolo esinqanda umasipala ukuba ukhokhe isinxephezelo noma ukhuphulele abasebenzi imiholo."Imenenja kamasipala yaya enkantolo yayothola isivimbelo ngoba ifuna ukuphonsela inselelo isinqumo esithi abasebenzi kufanele bakhokhelwe isinxephezelo nokuthi kufanele banyuselwe imiholo.”

Uphiko lwezobunhloli lwamaphoyisa lulandele umkhondo wemoto ebiduniwe lwaze lwafika ehostela iKlaarwater, eMariannhill, kanti imininingwane ikhomba ukuthi abasolwa bebelayisha impahla ebiduniwe evenini.Ngesikhathi amaphoyisa efika kule ndawo abone iveni ehlonziwe akhombisa umshayeli ukuthi akame, nokho umshayeli wakhetha ukungayinaki imiyalelo yamaphoyisa wabe esesuka ngesivinini amaphoyisa amjaha. Kufe abasolwa abathathu abatholwe benamanxeba okudutshulwa ngesikhathi sokudubula kanti batholakale nezibhamu ezimbili, kanye nezinhlamvu eziningi, Kusho amaphoyisa ngesitatimende.Ngaphandle kwemoto yamaphoyisa ebinezimbobo zezinhlamvu kwibhonethi, alikho iphoyisa elilimale ngesikhathi kudutshulwana.

AMA-CHIPS anamaphilisi okuthiwa ingane (12) ibiwathenge esitolo sowokufika eSolezwe KwaMashu Isithombe: SITHUNYELWE"Amasuphamakethe amakhulu awabakweleteli abadla imbuya ngothi, laba bokufika bayakweletisa.Thina esikufunayo ukuthi uma beqhubeka nokusidayisela, badayise ukudla okusezingeni elifanele,” kusho uMamle othe okunye abakunxusayo ukuthi nasemva kokubhaliswa kwabo, kulokhu kugasela abazohlola ukuthi abezitolo benza okulindelekile.Enza isibonelo ngesigameko esisanda kwenzeka endaweni, uthe kukhona ingane (12) okuphume amaphilisi ephaketheni lama-chips ebiwathengile."Ezigamekweni ezikanje, abezitolo kufuneka baqonde ngqo lapho abathi bawathenga khona lama-chips bayobuza imibuzo yokuthi angene kanjani amaphilisi emkhiqizweni,” kusho uMamle.Uthe abanye emphakathini abafune nakuyizwa eyokuthi baze baqale bazibhalise izitolo zabo kulolu hlelo olumenyezelwe."Badinwe yilezi zigameko ezenzekayo zokugula kwezingane nokushona kwazo. Abasafune nakuyizwa indaba yokuthi ziqhubeke zisebenze, bathi azivalwe,” kusho yena.Omunye wesifazane onesitolo endaweni, ongowokuzalwa kuleli, uNkk Rosemary Ratau, uthe ayifakelwe izibuko indaba yezimpahla ezidayiswa ngabokufika."Ezitolo lapho esithenga khona thina impahla, asize singababona. Sisola ukuthi bayazenzela bona ndawana thizeni,” kusho uNkk Ratau.Uthe nendlela abathenga ngayo izindimbane zezimpahla ishiya imibuzo ngendaba yokwedlulelwa kwazo yisikhathi."Ngokwesifiso sethu, ngabe zivele zivalwe ngoba bazosibangisa vele abayikhokhi intela, thina siyayikhokha,” kusho Nkk Ratau.Uthe okunye okwenza ezabo izitolo zingakutholi ukwesekwa ngokuthengwa kakhulu kwempahla abayenzayo ukuthi bona bathenga ezindaweni ezifanele, okwenza ezabo izimpahla zibize. Kanti abokufika njengoba kunezinsolo zokuthi bayazenzela, basola ukuthi yileso isizathu esenza zidayise ngemali ephansi ezabo bese zithengwa kakhulu.Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kwabezitolo zabokufika ayiphumelelanga. Eziningi Isolezwe elizihambele ezigcemeni ezehlukene kuleli lokishi, lithole abokufika abebedayisa kodwa bethi akuzona ezabo, ezabafowabo.Abanye bekubuye kube nzima nokuqonda ukuthi Isolezwe lithini njengoba bebengayizwa kahle imibuzo ebibuzwa ngesiZulu nangesiNgisi.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi kukhona izitolo zabokufika ezihlaselwe eNanda, abantu bazitapela kuzo izimpahla. Nokuthi yimina owamisa indaba yokwakhiwa kwamadokodo kungamanga aluhlaza lokho, angihlangani ngalutho nezinto zamathenda. KUNENGEBHE yokuthi bangase baphuze ukukhokhelwa abazomakela u-matric KwaZulu-Natal njengoba uMnyango wezeMfundo esifundazweni umatasa uhlwaya imali. Lokhu kuvezwe nguMqondisi jikelele woMnyango weMfundo eyisiSekelo, uMnuz Mathanzima Mweli, obephendula amalungu ePhalamende muva nje, ethi kusafunwa imali yokubakhokhela.UMweli uthe iNhloko yoMnyango wezeMfundo esifundazweni, uMnuz Nathi Ngcobo, imazise ukuthi ezintweni ezisasilele emuva okumele bathole imali yokuzikhokhela kubalwa imali yezikole eyaziwa ngama-norms and standards neyokukhokhela abazomakela umatric."IKZN ibhekene nezinkinga zemali. Ayikazikhokheli izikole imali yazo eyaziwa ngama-norms and standards, ayikawufaki uchatha wothisha ka-1.5% wokuphucula amaholo kanjalo nemali yabafundisa uGrade R. UNgcobo uveze ukuthi kunenhlansi yethemba ngezinye zezinto abazoqala ukuzikhokhela kanti ezizosala ngezithinta imali yokukhokhela izikole kanjalo nemali yokukhokhela abazomakela u-matric,” kusho uMweli.Uthe kodwa umnyango wezezimali esifundazweni nowezemfundo isebenza kanzima ukuze kutholakale isixazululo. NoNgqongqoshe weMfundo eyisiSekelo, uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, ukhale esifanayo ngenkinga yemali ebhekene nomnyango wesifundazwe.Utshele amalungu ukuthi amehlo abo athe njo kulo mnyango ngenxa yezinselelo obhekene nazo."Sizama ngawo wonke amandla ukulungisa isimo ngoba umnyango waseKZN ubhekene nezinselelo ezinkulu uma uqhathanisa neminye iminyango ezifundazweni. Kuze kwavalelwa izikhulu zomnyango inyunyana yothisha ingeneme ngokuhamba kancane kwezinto emnyangweni,” kusho uNksz Gwarube.Umnyango wesifundazwe ubhekene nezinkinga njengoba nasesiShayamthetho sesifundazwe uhlale ukuveza ukuthi awukwazi nokukhokhela ngesikhathi osonkontileka ngenxa yemali.Abamakayo bajwayele ukuthola imali yabo ungakashayi uKhisimusi.UMphathiswa wezeMfundo esifundazweni, uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka, watshela Isolezwe ukuthi abasebenzi abanenkontileka nabo bayobakhokhela njengoba behlale benza.Bangaphezu kuka-10 000 abasebenzi abazobe besebenza ezikhungweni zokumaka esifundazweni.Kulaba abamakayo bangu-7 615, ama-Senior Markers angu-1 517, ama-Deputy Chief Markers angu-300. Ama-Chief Markers angu-67, ama-Internal Moderators angu-87.Kuzoqashwa ama-Centre Managers angu-32, ama-Deputy Centre Managers angu-64, nama-Exam Assistants angu-2 100.Ukumaka kuqala ngoDisemba 1 kuphothulwe ngoDisemba 10. Imiphumela iyokhishwa nguNksz Gwarube ngoJanuwari 15, 2025 bese itholakala ezikhungweni zokubhalela ngakusasa, ngoJanuwari 16.
OSOMABHIZINISI emkhakheni wezokwakha baneke usizi nezinselelo ababhekene nazo engqungqutheleni iCrime Free Construction Sites, e-ICC, eThekwini. Bakhala ngokuxhashazwa yizinkamani ezinkulu abasuke besebenza ngaphansi kwazo ezibakhokhela amakinati futhi sekudlule isikhathi.Baveze nokuthi banqanyulelwa izinkontileka kungazelelwe nokuthi imisebenzi ethile isabekelwa uhlanga oluthile losomabhizinisi.Labo somabhizinisi bafuna kuphenywe namaphoyisa abawasola ngenkohlakalo. Bafuna ukwazi ukuthi bangazibika kuphi izinkinga abasuke bebhekene nazo.Bebekhuluma beshintshana betshela abasemagunyeni kuhulumeni kusukela kokazwelonke kuyoshaya phansi komasipala engqungqutheleni. Labo somabhizinisi bathi uma sebefuna okungokwabo, yilapho ke benikwa khona igama lokuthi bangama-construction mafias babizelwe amaphoyisa afike abasuse ngoshova lapho kwakhiwa khona.Obekushiwo yilabo somabhizinisi bekulalelwe ongqongqoshe, amaphini abo, abaphathiswa, izimeya, amaphoyisa nabanye ababambe iqhaza kulo mkhakha.UNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, uthe zibeka engcupheni impilo yabantu emphakathini izidubedube zokumiswa kokwakhiwa nokuthuthukiswa kwengqalazisinda okuthiwa kwenziwa ababizwa nge-construction mafia.UNGQONGQOSHE wamaPhoyisa uMnuz Senzo Mchunu nowezeMisebenzi yoMphakathi neNgqalasizinda uMnuz Dean MacPherson bese-ICC eThekwini Isithombe: SITHUNYELWE"Kusezandleni zethu ukuthi sikhetha izwe elizinzile noma elinodlambedlu. Lezi zigameko ezingekho emthethweni, zokusabisa nodlame emkhakheni wezokwakha, azamukelekile futhi ziyisithiyo,” kusho uMchunu.Ubalule ukuthi lo mkhuba umandla ezifundazweni iGauteng, KwaZulu-Natal, Western Cape naseEastern Cape eziyizizinda zomnotho wezwe.UMchunu uxwayise abadala udungunyane emkhakheni wezokwakha wathi abawuyeke lo mkhuba ngoba izinsuku zabo zibaliwe.UNgqongqoshe wemiSebenzi yoMphakathi neNgqalasizinda, uMnuz Dean MacPherson, uwuchaze ngengqophamlando lo mbuthano okuhloswe ngawo ukulwa ne-construction mafia wathi sekwanele."Ngeke sisaxoxisana nezigebengu ukuze imisebenzi iqhubeke. Silapha nje sizobuyisela umthetho emkhakheni wezokwakha. Lezi zingqinamba zixosha osomabhizinisi, kulambe abantu imisebenzi ingekho, zikhinyabeza umnotho wezwe nentuthuko yomphakathi,” kusho uMcPherson.Iphini likaMacPherson, uMnuz Sihle Zikalala, lithe luyafuneka ushintsho emkhakheni wezokwakha, kushaywe imithetho ezohlomulisa wonke umuntu futhi kugwenywe ukuhlangana kwezinkampani ezinkulu zivalele ngaphandle ezincane.UNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thamsanqa Ntuli, uthe miningi imisebenzi emisiwe eKZN, eminyakeni engu-10 kumosheke izizumbulu."Imibiko ithi esikwazi nge-construction mafia kwaqala kungabantu ababenentshisekelo yokungena kulo mkhakha ngokuhamba kwesikhathi kwakhona abazibumbayo bazenza osomabhizinisi baphathe izibhamu bayomisa ukwakhiwa. Ayikho indawo yabafuna inkokhelo ngodli nama-constructon mafia eKZN,” kuxwayisa uNtuli.USomlomo kaMasipala weTheku, uMnuz Thabani Nyawose, uthe lo mkhandludolobha ubhekene nenkinga yokumiswa kwemisebenzi yokwakhiwa kwengqalasizinda."Lezi zigameko eziwubugebengu zidala ingcindezi ekukhuleni komnotho wedolobha futhi zibeke engcupheni ezokuphepha zezwe,” kusho uNyawose.

UCWANINGO lokuqala ngqa eNingizimu Afrika olubheka udlame lobulili luveza ukuthi 33% wabesifazane okuwu-7 million (7 310 389) uke wahlukunyezwa ngokodlame.Kuvela ukuthi kulezi zinyanga eziwu-12 ezidlule bangaphezu kuka-1 million abesifazane ababike ukuthi bayahlukumezeka.USolwazi Khangelani Zuma weHuman Sciences Research Council (HSRC) obehola ucwaningo, uthe kuyaqala ukuthi kube nocwaningo olugxile odabeni lokuhlukumezeka ngokobulili olwenziwe ezweni jikelele.Uthe lolu cwaningo alubheki abesifazane kuphela kodwa belubheka namadoda, bekukhulunywa nabagilwa nabahlukumezi.UDkt Nompumelelo Zungu naye obenza ucwaningo, uthe bebebheka udlame lokushaywa, olokuhlukunyezwa ngokocansi, olokuhlukumezeka emoyeni nolokuhlukunyezwa ngokomnotho.Uveze ukuthi oyedwa kwabesifazane abayisishiyagalolunye uke washaywa kanti oyedwa kwabawu-40 uke wahlukunyezwa ngokocansi.Emadodeni ,eyodwa kwawu-42 ike yashaywa kanti eyodwa kwawu-43 ike yahlukunyezwa ngokocansi.Uthe ucwaningo lwenziwe kubantu abaneminyaka ewu-18 kuya phezulu nabaneminyaka engaphezu kuka-50.Kubuye kwavela ukuthi amadoda ayisikhombisa kwawu-10 akholwa wukuthi abesifazane kufanele balalele umthetho wawo.Akholwa nawukuthi kufanele awajabulise ekamelweni noma kunini inqobo nje uma owesifazane elotsholiwe.UDkt Zungu uthe u-64% wabesifazane uyabika ngezigameko zokuhlukunyezwa emndenini nakulabo osondelene nabo kanti u-33% awubiki.U-7.8% ubikela abaholi benkolo, u-6.2% uthola usizo losonhlalakahle kanti u-30.7% uke waya ezibhedlela nasemaphoyiseni ngezinkinga zokuhlukunyezwa.Izigameko zokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane ziphezulu kakhulu kwabakipitile nabangafundile kakhulu.Kuvela ukuthi abesifazane abakipitile bahlukunyezwa kakhulu ngokodlame nangokocansi ikakhulukazi abeneminyaka ewu-23 kuya phezulu.Kuthiwa sincane isibalo sabesifazane abashadile ababika ukuthi bayahlukunyezwa.Abesifazane abafunde bagcina ku-matric bahlukunyezwa kakhulu kunozakwabo abaneziqu zemfundo ephakeme.Ngokobuhlanga abesifazane abamnyama abahlala emadolobheni yibona ababika ukuthi bahlukunyezwa ngokodlame nangokocansi.Phakathi kwezizathu ezenza abantu bahlukumeze abanye kubalwa izinkinga abake baba nazo othandweni kudala, izinkinga zotshwala nezidakamizwa, ukuhlukumezeka beseyizingane, ukuchukuluzwa nokungabi namandla.IHSRC iphakamise ukuthi kufanele kusungulwe ithimba elizoza namasu azosiza abantu ukuze baziphathe kahle.Umbiko udluliselwe kuNgqongqoshe woMnyango wezaBesifazane, iNtsha nabaphila ngokuKhubazeka, uNkk Sindisiwe Chikunga othe imiphumela yocwaningo ishayisa ngamahloni.Uthembise ukuthi bazoyisebenzisa ezinhlelweni zabo zokulwa nodlame lobulili baqinisekise nokuthi abahlukumezayo bajeziswa kanzima.
KUBHIMBA uhlelo ngothisha ababalelwa ku-45 000 abangatohozi KwaZulu-Natal, njengoba uMnyango wezeMfundo ungakwazi ukuvala izikhala zabangu-3 800 ngenxa yezinkinga zemali.Lo mnyango usasebenza ngesibalo sothisha sango-2008, kanti awukwazi ukwandisa isibalo sabo ngenxa yokuthi awunayo imali.Lokhu kuvezwe nguMphathiswa wezeMfundo esifundazweni, uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka nenhloko yomnyango uMnuz Nathi Ngcobo, ngesikhathi bevele ngaphambi kwekomiti lezezimali esiShayamthetho sesifundazwe.Bebephendula imibuzo njengoba bekwethulwa isabelomali salo mnyango nezinselelo ezithinta ukusebenzisa imali ngokweqile.UDkt Andile Biyela we-IFP ubuze ukuthi ikhona yini inhlansi yethemba yokuthi bayoke baqashwe othisha abangatohozi esifundazweni, abahlala bekhala ngomsebenzi?Uthe labo thisha bahlale bebuza ukuthi kwenzakalani ngezithinta ukuqashwa emnyangweni?UHlomuka uthe noma kuthiwa banayo imali eyenele kodwa ngeke bakwazi ukuqasha bonke labo thisha abakwi-database yesifundazwe.Uveze ukuthi abanye babo abadabuki ngisho esifundazweni kodwa baqhamuka kwezinye izifundazwe, kanti basebenzisa imininingwane yabantu baseKZN."Sinezikhala ezingu-3 800 ezingavaliwe zothisha esifundazweni. Sinenqwaba yothisha abangaqashiwe abakwi-database. Abafuna umsebenzi wothisha kumele bazi ukuthi akuwona kuphela uMnyango wezeMfundo oqashayo. Othisha bayadingeka nakweminye iminyango ngakho nakhona kumele bazifake izicelo.” UNgcobo uthe ngeke amqambele amanga uBiyela athi likhona ithemba ngokuqashwa kwabanye othisha njengoba sisibi isimo sezimali emnyangweni.Embikweni othulelwe ikomiti kuvele ukuthi umnyango awukwazi ukuvala inqwaba yezikhala zothisha ezikoleni."Uma uthishanhloko esethatha umhlalaphansi, sinyusa iphini lakhe ukuthi libambe bese singasivali leso sikhala sephini. Ngokomthetho kumele sisivale okwesikhashana ngomunye uthisha ukuze kungashodi abantu esikoleni kodwa ngenxa yezinkinga zemali asikwazi ukwenza lokhu,” kusho uNgcobo. Uthe abakwazi ukuvala nezikhala zabaya emalivini, ezezinye izisebenzi ezijwayelekile ngenxa yezinkinga zemali.Kulo mhlangano kuvele nokuthi ngeke zakhiwe izikole ezintsha ngenxa yale nkinga."Ukube bekuyinkampani ezimele ngabe sidiliza isibalo esithile sothisha abazovumelana nesabelomali esinaso, bese sisala nalabo esizokwazi ukubakhokhela. Ngebhadi asikwazi ukudiliza othisha ngoba sandisa izifundo ezintsha ezidinga sengeze othisha,” kuqhuba uNgcobo.Kulo mhlangano kuvele ukuthi isabelomali somnyango sidliwa yimiholo yabasebenzi.Ukungaxhaswa ngemali kohlelo lokunyusa amaholo abasebenzi ngo-4.7%, ngezinye zezinto ezenze lo mnyango wangena khaxa obishini lwezimali. Kulindeleke ukuthi weqise cishe ngo-R1 billion esabelweni ngenxa yokungafakwa kwemali yokunyusa amaholo abasebenzi.Izinkinga zemali zenze izikhulu zomnyango zavalelwa amalungu enyunyana yothisha iSadtu, abefuna kufakwe imali yezikole, kukhokhwe uchatha ka-1.5% wokuphucula amaholo othisha okwaziwa nge-pay progression, kanjalo nokukhokhelwa kwabafundisa uGrade R.

Isiphelele yaba uR45 000 owafakwa izigaba ezimbili,” kusho uGininda.Ubephikisa amaphuzu kaRamosepele, obemtshela ukuthi uNtanzi uzokuphika ukuthi uyazana noKelly kanjalo netulo elahlanganiswa ukuze kubulawe uMeyiwa."Kulezi zitatimende, uzivumela yena ukuthi wuye umsolwa wesibili, owayemude, egqoke ijakhethi enesigqoko,” kusho uGininda.URamosepele uqhubekile nokuhlohla amaphuzu akhe kuGininda ethi: "Ummangalelwa wesibili uzokuphika ukuthi wayenolwazi ngetulo lokubulala.”"Kodwa izitatimende zisho okuphambene nalokhu okushoyo,” kuphendula uGininda.Ubebuye eseke ubufakazi bakhe ngezitatimende zabanye ofakazi ezininda abasolwa. Kuzona kukhona esikaCol Lambertus Steyn, Mnuz Makhosonke Buthelezi, Constable Sizwe Zungu nabanye.Sekufike emaphethelweni ukuphekwa ngemibuzo kukaGininda wuRamosepele, ubeke inkulumo eshubile, eyibhekise ku-Adv Charles Mnisi, ongummeli kammangalelwa wesithathu, uMthobisi Mncube, okunguye osezomhloma imibuzo."Njengoba sengizohlonywa imibuzo u-Adv Mnisi, ngizocela ukuthi sihloniphane. Ngesikhathi ngethula ubufakazi ngiholwa umbuso, ubelokhu engenela athi 'phendula inkantolo’. Lokho ngikubona njengophawu lokudelela,” kusho uGininda.Uqhube wathi yena akakaze akukhombise ukudelela ku-Adv Mnisi."Ngizocela ke ukuthi sikubeke ezingeni elifanele ukuhloniphana kule nkantolo ngoba uma ngingahlonishwa, nami ngizokwehla ngiye kulelo zinga lokungahloniphi,” kusho uGininda.Icala lizoqhubeka ngoLwesine.
ULIEUTENANT General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi ekhuluma ngaphandle kweNkantolo yaseNtuzuma izolo lapho bekuvele abesilisa abasolwa ngokuhlalisa lubhojozi umphakathi waKwaMashu Isithombe : SIBONELO NGCOBO/INDEPENDENT MEDIAKUBOSHWE nobhongoza oneminyaka engu-20 phakathi kwabesilisa abasolwa ngokuba yingxenye yeqembu lemigulukudu ebelihlalise lubhojozi umphakathi waKwaMashu.Lokhu kuvele izolo eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseNtuzuma ngesikhathi kuvela abesilisa abathathu kwabayisithupha ababhekene noxhaxha lwamacala okuthiwa bawenze kuleli lokishi.Amagama abasolwa ngeke adalulwe okwamanje ngoba kusazoba nohlelo lokubakhomba. Kuyamangaza ukuthi ezigamekweni ezahlukene sekuyinto ejwayelekile ukubandakanyeka kwabesilisa abasebancane ngokweminyaka,'' usho kanje.Uthe bayafisa ukuthi inkantolo isebenzisane nabo ibagcine ngaphakathi bonke abasolwa ukuze umphakathi uzohlala ngokukhululeka.Izolo laba besilisa uMbuso ubafundele wonke amacala ababekwe wona.Phakathi kwawo kubalwa elokubulala uMnuz Mxolisi Biyela okuthiwa balenza ngoFebhuwari 26 khona KwaMashu. Kuvelile ukuthi angu-11 esewonke amacala okubulala abayamaniswa nawo.Amanye amacala ababekwe wona ngelokuzama ukubulala oMnuz Siphiwe Ntshalintshali, Nksz Nondumiso Ntshalintshali, Mnuz Zakhele Thango, Mnuz Thobani Luthuli noMnuz Zamokuhle Mazibuko.Emacaleni okuzama ukuphanga kuthiwa baphanga uMnuz Sphamandla Ndlovu i-laptop namaselula amabili. Baphanga noMnuz Asanda Nzama imoto iSuzu emhlophe, noMnuz Siphiwe Mtshali abamduna imoto iBMW emhlophe esigamekweni okuthiwa senzeka ngoFebhuwari 21 elokishini. Bathe bazosebenzisa abameli bakahulumeni.Icala lihlehliselwe uNovemba 25 ukuze bafake isicelo sebheyili.
ABAKAYIKHOLWA namanje into abayibone ngamehlo abo, kudindiliza izidumbu zabangani ababili, eHazelmere, eVerulam ngoMgqibelo.Kule sigameko, kushone uMnuz Mthethowakhe Malinga (33) emva kokugwazwa umngani wakhe, ogcine exhifwa wumphakathi ngamatshe waze washona.Ngokuthola kweSolezwe, umsolwa uqale wahlasela omunye umngani endaweni, ophuthunyiswe esibhedlela, ngaphambi kokuthi ahlasele uMalinga.Ngokusho kukanina kaMalinga, uNksz Ntombenhle Khanyile, isigameko senzeke egcekeni, bengazelele besanda kuvuka.Uthe ubesaziphumulele endlini yakhe ngesikhathi kungena ingane yasemndenini ikhala ithi umalume (uMalinga) usebulewe."Ngiphuthume endlini yakhe masinyane. Angikukholwanga engikubone ngamehlo ami, ngimbona edindilize eduze komsolwa,” kusho uNksz Khanyile.Uthe ngesikhathi embheka ubesawavulile amehlo, kodwa engasacwayizi futhi engasanyakazi wathi umsolwa ubelele ebheke phansi, elimele."Ngibone igazi ligobhoza lisuka endlini yendodana yami ngabona ukuthi ukuhlasela kuqale khona,” kusho uNksz Khanyile, othe ngenxa yokwethuka, uvele waquleka.Uthe ngesikhathi esephaphama utshelwe ukuthi indodana yakhe igwazwe amanxeba amathathu ezindaweni ezibucayi okuyisesiswini, enhliziyweni nasentanyeni.Uthe nakuba ubengeze angayinaka impilo yendodana yakhe, athe isikhathi esiningi ibiza endlini yakhe uma izodla bese iyohlala endlini yayo noma ebanganini, uzwile ukuthi kuthiwa bebezwana nomsolwa."Ngisamangele ukuthi yini le engaka ebebeyibangile, yaze yaholela ekutheni amgwaze ambulale,” kusho uNksz Khanyile.Uthe ubegcine ukuyibona iphila ntambama ngoLwesihlanu indodana yakhe ngesikhathi ebuya emsebenzini."NgoLwesihlanu ebusuku akezanga endlini enkulu futhi nami nganganaka, ngicabanga ukuthi hleze usebanganini. Ngiphatheke kabi sengimbona esethule ekuseni izolo (esho ngoMgqibelo),” kusho uNksz Khanyile.Isolezwe lizamile ukuzwa ukuthi bekubangwani kuMnuz Mdeyi Mdizwa, onguyise wowesilisa okuthiwa uphuthunyiswe esibhedlela kodwa walandula.Uthe ubengakakwazi ukuxoxa naye, ezwe ukuthi imbangela yokuhlaselwa bekuyiyiphi.Uqinisekise ukuthi bobathathu abathinteka esigamekweni bebengamathe nolimu. Wathi isikhathi esiningi bebebonakala behamba ndawonye.Ikhansela lendawo, uMnuz Fakazi Mdletshe lithe liyile endaweni yesigameko, lathola isimo esinyantisa igazi.Ukhuze ukusetshenziswa kwezidakamizwa entsheni, njengoba ethe uzwe kuthiwa umsolwa ubephuzile."Okubuhlungu ukuthi lo ambulele ubengadakiwe. Siyakukhuza ukusetshenziswa kwezidakamizwa entsheni ngoba zidala ukuthi kungabi nokubekezelelana,” kusho uMdletshe.
KUBOSHWE omakhelwane ngokubulawa ngesihluku kwesalukazi nomzukulu abebengcwatshwa ngeSonto, okuthiwa bebesinuka ngokuthakatha emva kokushona kwezihlobo zabo.UNksz Busisiwe Ntombela (65) nomzukulu wakhe uSimangaliso (2), kuthiwa bahlaselwe ngabasolwa basendaweni ebusuku belele ngesonto eledlule. Abasolwa kuthiwa baqale bakinatela isicabha ngocingo ngaphambi kokuthi bokhele indlu ngomlilo obekulele kuyo uNksz Ntombela nabazukulu bakhe ababili abehlala nabo abaneminya ephakathi kwemibili nengu-14.Kuthiwa ukwazile ukuphuma ngewindi nabazukulu bakhe, okuthe uma abasolwa bembona bamlandela, bamcoboshisa yena noSimangaliso. Umzukulu ona-14 kuthiwa ubaleke wayongena kamakhelwane, wababikela osekwenzekile.Kuboshwe abasolwa abaneminyaka ephakathi kuka-24 no- 40 okuthiwa bawomakhelwane nalo mndeni; okungoMnuz Celi Khulu, uMnuz Thembinkosi Nkosi noMnuz Simon Mbatha. Bebevele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseNquthu ngoLwesihlanu, kanti kulindeleke ukuba babuyele enkantolo efanayo kuleli sonto ukufaka isicelo sebheyili. Umsolwa wesine udedeliwe emva kokungatholakali kobufakazi obumhlanganisa necala.Ilungu lomphakathi elingathandanga ukudalulwa elikhulume neSolezwe, lithe ngemva kokubika kwengane ngosekwenzekile, akupholiswangwa maseko, kwahlatshwa umkhosi kwanikelwa endaweni yesigameko."Sifika indlu abebeshiswa nayo ibisavaliwe kodwa amawindi evuliwe. Ebangeni elingelide kakhulu ukusuka kulo muzi, umphakathi uzithele phezu kwesidumbu sikaMaNtombela nomzukulu wakhe. Bengibajwayele kakhulu futhi akukho mina ebengike ngezwa kuthiwa kunabangazwani nabo,” lisho kanje ilungu.Elinye ilungu lomphakathi lithe komakhelwane ababoshiwe, bebenuka uNksz Ntombela ngokuthakatha njengoba kuthiwa kunabemindeni yabo abashona eminyakeni embalwa edlule emva kokugula."KwaKhulu kwashona isalukazi sakhona, emva kwalokho omunye ubaba khona endaweni wahlohla uCeli (24), wathi uninakhulu ufe ngenxa yokuthakathwa umgilwa. Nomsolwa wakwaNkosi, washonelwa yingane yakhe, kwasolwa lesi salukazi kangangoba wayeze aphumisele ethi usazoziphindiselela kowabulala ingane yakhe. KwaMbatha kwashona ubaba wekhaya, iminwe bayikhomba kuNksz Ntombela,” kusho ilungu lomphakathi.Kuthiwa abasolwa ababili baboshwe ngalo usuku lwesigameko emva kokuthi oyedwa kubona efike endaweni yesigameko wazidlisa satshanyana kusangungiwe kumangelwe, amaphoyisa aqaphela okuthile, zamkhalela. Alandele umkhondo kwaboshwa nomsolwa wesibili. Ababili kuthiwa zibakhelele ngakusasa kodwa omunye kubona wadedelwa emva kokuthi kubekhona akuvezile ukuthi ubengekho, okuthiwa kwenzeke ngesikhathi egonyuluka ngokwenzekile.Imizamo yokuthola umndeni ayiphumelelanga ngoba izingcingo intatheli ebinikezwe zona bezingangeni. Kodwa kuvelile ukuthi umngcwabo bewuqhubeka khona izolo.UMnuz Nkosinathi Mavundla oyikhansela nenduna yendawo, uthe isigameko esinje asiqali ukwenzeka njengoba ekuqaleni konyaka kubekhona abazame ukushisa nendlu yesalukazi nekhehla abaphume benezibazi zokusha kodwa kwangabakhona ofayo."Udaba lokunukana lufikile kithina salukhuza ngoba akunabufakazi obuphathekayo. Sasithi sigwema igazi elingase lichitheke, nakhu ke sekwenzeka. Abagilwa abangcatshelwanga KwaNkobe, bathathwe wumndeni wabo okwesinye isigodi KwaNkabane. Nakuba kunzima kodwa siwumphakathi sizidelile, saya emngcwabeni yize isigameko esinje sisinemba kabi siwumphakathi futhi singenalo ulwazi ukuthi umndeni uzosamukela kanjani. Uthe amadodana kamgilwa ayasebenza, ubezihlalela nabazukulu.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe abasolwa babhekene namacala amabili okubulala, elokuzama ukubulala nelokushiswa kwempahla.
KUYAPHELA ngokuvulwa ubusuku nemini kweminye imitholampilo KwaZulu-Natal, ngenxa yezinkinga zemali ezibhekene noMnyango wezeMpilo esifundazweni.Akuzogcina ngokuthi kwehliswe amahora okusebenza kwale mitholampilo ngenxa yezinselelo zemali, kodwa neminyango ehlukene kahulumeni isizokhokhela ukuqasha ama-ambulensi asuke elindele izimo eziphuthumayo uma iminyango yenze imicimbi ehlukene emiphakathini. UMPHATHISWA wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal uNksz Nomagugu Simelane, othe kuzophela ukuvula amahora angu-24 kweminye imitholampilo esifundazweni Isithombe:KZN Department of HealthLokhu kudalulwe nguMphathiswa wezeMpilo esifundazweni, uNksz Nomagugu Simelane, ekhuluma emhlanganweni wekomiti lezezimali esiShayamthetho ngoLwesihlanu. Uthe lezi ngezinye zezindlela zokuzama ukwehlisa izindleko ezibhekene nomnyango.Uveze ukuthi baqhamuke nalezi zinhlelo ezibalelwa ku-35, abazozenza ngoba befuna ukungeqi esabelweni semali njengoba ebalule ukuthi kungenzeka beqe ngoR4.7 billion kusona."Asizovele sehlise amahora asetshenzwa kule mitholampilo kodwa sizobheka ukuthi isibhedlela sikude kangakanani nalowo mtholampilo. Sizobheka nokuthi noma ivalwa kodwa uma kwenzeka kunezimo eziphuthumayo kube okungenani nomhlengikazi oyedwa ozosiza ngoba kweminye yayo kusuke kunezindawo zokulala abahlengikazi,” kusho uNksz Simelane, othe izovulwa ekuseni ivalwe ntambama.Uveze ukuthi okwamanje abakazi nokuthi mingaki imitholampilo abazokwehlisa amahora okusebenza kuyona ngenxa yokuthi basazohlala phansi babheke izinto eziningi.Abebesebenza kuyona bazovala izikhala kwezinye izindawo lapho bedingeka khona.UNksz Simelane uthe babuyele nasohlelweni lokuthi iminyango ikhokhele ama-ambulensi uma yenze imicimbi emphakathini."Ukumisa i-ambulensi usuku lonke ingasebenzi kusidla imali. Kudingeka kukhokhelwe uphethroli kuphinde kukhokhelwe abasebenzi ngokusebenza isikhathi esengeziwe. Yingakho iminyango isizokukhokhela ukuthi ikhiphe emgwaqweni i-ambulensi yangasebenza ngenxa yokuthi iye emcimbini.”Uthe ezinye zezinto abazozenza ngukumisa uhlelo lokuthenga izimoto ezintsha emnyangweni."Okunye esizokwenza ngukuthi isisebenzi ngeke sisaba nekhompyutha yasehhovisi, i-laptop, tablet kanye nocingo. Uma ene-laptop ngeke esaba nezinye zalezi zinto ezibandakanya i-tablet nekhompyutha ngoba kwenza umsebenzi owodwa,” kuqhuba uNksz Simelane.Ukhale ngokuthi ukubanjelwa imali ebalelwa kuR1 billion kwisabelomali somnyango yikhona okudale le nkinga.Uveze ukuthi le nkinga bayidlulisele nakuNgqongqoshe wezeMpilo kuzwelonke uDkt Aaron Motsoaledi. "Njengoba umengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ebehambele imbizo muva nje, kube nomhlangano ohlanganisa iKhabhinethi obekukhona kuyona noNgqongqoshe wezeziMali kazwelonke, lapho kuxoxwe khona ngale nkinga ebhekene nomnyango.”URamaphosa uyibalulile eyezinselelo ezibhekene nalo mnyango kanjalo nowezemfundo esifundazweni.Le minyango iyona okuhlale kukhalwa ngokuthi ibhekene nengwadla yokuthi ayikwazi ukungaqashi abahlengikazi kanjalo nothisha ngoba bayadingeka, phezu kokuba kunezinselelo zokushoda kwemali.
I-JOHANNESBURG Stock Exchange (JSE) imhlawulise u-R500 000 uNksz Thabi Leoka owaqamba amanga ngeziqu zakhe.UNksz Leoka ubebizwa ngo-Dkt Thabi Leoka oyisazi somnotho njengoba iningi labantu belazi ukuthi uneziqu azithola eNyuvesi yaphesheya i-London School of Economics kodwa le nyuvesi yaphika ukuthi wathola lezi ziqu.I-JSE ithe kufanele ahlawule u-R500 000 ngokuqamba amanga ngeziqu zakhe, ibuye yammisa ukuba semabhodini ezinkampani ezihweba eJSE iminyaka emihlanu.Esitatimendeni esikhishwe yi-JSE, ithe izamile ukukhuluma noNksz Leoka kusukela ngoJanuwari, ngesikhathi kuvela izinsolo zokuthi waqamba amanga ngeziqu zakhe.Ithe ubelokhu eyiziba, engaphefuni ukuyilekelela ophenywe lwayo, yaveza ukuthi emuva kokuvela kwemibiko yokuthi uNksz Leoka uqambe amanga ngeziqu, yamcela ukuthi azoxoxa nayo ngalolu daba kodwa waziba.Ubeyilungu lamabhodi ezinkampanni ezinkulu okubalwa i-Remgro, Anglo American Platinum, Netcare nezinye."UNksz Leoka uhlulekile wukusilethela ubufakazi obuphikisana nezinsolo ebezibikwa ngaye. Uphenyo lwe-JSE luthole ukuthi uphule imithetho elandelwa ngabasemabhodini ezinkampani ezihweba kuyo okubalwa u-Schedule 13, okubeka kucace ukuthi abantu akufanele baqambe amanga ngeziqu zabo,” kusho iJSE.Ithe uNksz Leoka ubengenandaba nemibiko evele ngaye, akazange afune nokuziphendulela yize azi kahle ukuthi i-JSE nezinkampani ezihweba kuyo kufanele zithembeke emphakathini.Kungenxa yalesi sizathu ehlawuliswe u-R500 000 futhi ezovinjwa ukuba semabhodini ezinkampani iminyaka emihlanu.
UMNYANGO wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal usuxwayise abafundi abaphothula izivivinyo zabo zika-matric, ukuthi bangazibandakanyi nemicimbi kanjalo nemibhiyozo yokuphothula lezi zivivinyo edume nge-Pens Down.Lo mnyango uthe amaphathi kulindeleke ukuthi enzeke kusuka namhlanje njengoba elinye iqoqo liphothula izivivinyo zalo.UMphathiswa womnyango, uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka, uyale abafundi ukuthi bangazihlanganisi nala maphathi ngoba ayaphazamisa.Uthe kula maphathi kunkunkwa utshwala esidlangalaleni, abafundi baziphathe ngendlela engafanele.Uveze ukuthi abanye babhala imifaniswano yabo okuyinto engahambisani nokuziphatha okulindelekile kubafundi."Kunokuthi kubhalwe umfaniswano wesikole, sinxusa ukuthi unikelwe esikoleni ukuze udluliselwe kwabawudingayo. Siyazi ukuthi kusho lukhulu ukuphothula izivivinyo zika-matric kodwa siyanxusa ukuthi ababhiyozayo bakwenze lokhu ngenhlonipho,” kusho uHlomuka.Unxuse abazali kanjalo nemiphakathi ukuthi basebenzisane nezikole ukunqanda imibhiyozo ehambisana nokuqeda ukubhala."Abafundi kumele bakhumbule ukuthi indlela abaziphatha ngayo, isuke ikhomba indlela abaziphatha ngayo emakhaya noma ezikoleni.” Uthe okungcono akwenziwe imibhiyozo ezogqugquzela ukuziphatha ngendlela futhi ibe nenhlonipho.Abanye abafundi namhlanje babhala iphepha lokugcina le-LIfe Sciences. NgoLwesine, abanye babhala iphepha lokugcina le-Geography kanti abanye baphothula izivivinyo zabo ngoLwesihlanu ngephepha lokugcina le-Accounting.Abanye abafundi bavame ukunikela eThekwini, ezindaweni ezehlukene okungamabhishi ukuze bezobhiyozela ukuphothula u-matric.Amaphoyisa ajwayele ukuqinisa ezokuphepha esifundazweni uma sekuphothulwa lezi zivivinyo. Intombazane ngiyayazi kodwa akusiyo intombi yami, yona ngiyayazi, ngazi ngisho usizi lwayo.”Sithe yeza emcimbini ngoba izoziphosa enkosini yayo njengoba ifuna usizo nokungenye yezinto okumele azenze njengomholi."Ngizonisiza ngoba ngiyinkosi yesizwe, ingaphansi kwami njengoba ingeyakwaNgcobo. Ngizokhuluma nenkosi yamaQadi ukuze isizakale le ngane ngoba isenkingeni, kodwa ngeke ngizikhulume izinkinga zayo ngoba lokho akulungile. Engizokusho ukuthi kubuhlungu lokhu okwenzeka ngaloluya suku njengoba kwenziwa yilaba balapha ekhaya engizalwa nabo, abaphikisa indaba yeSihlalo, intombi yabo-ke le.”Indlulamithi iveze ukuthi lolu daba bazolusebenza njengoba efuna kuphume lonke iqiniso linjengoba linjalo. Ithe okwenza akhulume ngalolu daba yize bebengezele lona, ukuthi wonke umuntu ukhuluma akuthandayo ngalo.Okhulumela inkosi yamaQadi, uMnuz Skwa Ngcobo, uthe abamazi owesifazane kodwa bazolusukumela udaba lwakhe. "Ngeke silinde iSilo size kithi ukuze sisukumele udaba lowesifazane, thina okwethu njengoba sekuphume izwi ukuthi simfune size simthole ukuze athole usizo.” Uthe ngoba iSilo sishilo ukuthi siyamazi, bazohlangana naso ngokushesha ukuze kuvele ukuthi kwenzekani.Okhulumela amaNazaretha ohlangothini lwaseBuhleni, uMnuz Thokozani Mncwabe, uveze ukuthi akwaziyo ukuthi owesifazane uhamba inkonzo yomama njengoba esenomtwana."Anginaso isiqiniseko sokuthi uyiNazaretha lakuliphi ithempeli, kodwa umyalezo esingawukhipha ukuthi uma kukhona abakhokheli abamaziyo, abahlale naye phansi bakhulume bamyale ngendlela yokuziphatha kwabesifazane abangamaNazaretha,” kuchaza yena.
UNGQONGQOSHE woMnyango wezokuHlaliswa kwaBantu kuleli, uNksz Mmamoloko Kubayi, uthe izinhlangano ezakha izindlu zokuqashisa kufanele zibabhekelele nabahola kancane.UNkk Kubayi ubekhuluma emhlanganweni nezinhlangano ezakha izindlu zokurenta ezibizwa ngama-Social Housing Institutions (SHI) ngempelasonto, eKempton Park, eGauteng."Njengoba abantu beya emadolobheni ukuyofuna impilo engcono, kusho ukuthi nesidingo sezindlu zokurenta siyanda. Kubalulekile ukuthi ama-SHI asebenzisane nohulumeni ukubhekelela abantu abahola imali ephakathi kuka-R1 850 no-R22 000 ngenyanga.”Ubalule ukuthi abanye abantu basuke bengadingi indlu abazohlala kuyona isikhathi eside kodwa basuke befuna ukusondela ngasemathubeni omnotho nokuyinto eyenza ukuthi barente.Uchaze ama-SHI njengezinhlangano ezingayenzi inzuzo ezilekelela abahola kancane ukuthi babe nendawo yokuhlala lapho besuke bekhona.Uthe badinga izindlu zokuhlala zokurenta eziwu-300 000 ezizosiza abantu ukuthi bakwazi ukuhlala endaweni abakwazi ukuyikhokhela."Sizimisele ukusebenzisana nani ukuze sishintshe indlela yokuhlaliswa kwabantu eyayihlelwe wuhulumeni wobandlululo. Ngikhulumile nane-Banking Association of South Africa ukuthi igqugquzele amalungu ayo ukuba atshale imali kwintuthuko yezindlu ezosiza umphakathi.”Uthe basebenza ngokuzikhandla ukuphendula amabhilidi aqhwagwe yizigebengu ezihlalisa abantu ezimweni ezingaphephile, ukuba bawenze amabhilidi aphephile ukuhlala abantu kuwo wonke amadolobha amakhulu kuleli.Ubuye wakhumbuza abantu ukuthi uhulumeni unezinhlelo zokuxhasa abangenayo imali ukuba bazithengele imizi yabo emabhange nokuthi bazithengele iziza zokwakha.

UMNDENI ufuna ahlanze iqiniso uma sekuqulwa enkantolo icala owesilisa osolwa ngokubulala owesifazane waKwaQwabe Location (eTsheni), eMthwalume. Kunezinsolo zokuthi umbulale ngesihluku kubangwa ukudayiselana ngocansi.Kulesi sigameko, uNksz Mbali Ndaba (38) kuthiwa uxhifwe ngetshe, waklinywa, wayophoswa emhosheni ngumsolwa (18), ngesikhathi bebuya emcimbini obusendaweni.Ngokusho komthombo, kuthiwa umlisa uhambe wayoziceba emndenini wakhe ngemva kokwenza isigameko. Kuthiwa uthe ubethenge ucansi kumufi.Kuthiwa bayile ocansini esikhotheni okokuqala, kwathi uma esethi abaphinde, umufi wamshintshela wathi uzombophisa ngecala lokumdlwengula, wavele wabona kungcono ambulale.Umzala kamufi, uNksz Khangisile Shabane uthe bewumndeni abalukholwa udaba "lokudayiselana” ngocansi."Yini ebizodala ukuthi avume okokuqala, bese esabisa ngokumbopha uma esethi abaphinde? Kithina lolu hlangothi aluwenzi umqondo. Sikholwa ukuthi ubemdlwengula, wase embulala uma esezwa ethi uzombopha,” kusho uNksz Shabane.Uqhube wathi ukutholwa kwengubo kamufi yangaphansi endaweni yesigameko, nokutholwa kwakhe egqoke ibhulukwe lagcina ngezansi kwezinqe, liphendukezelwe kubashiye nemibuzo."Yini ebizokwenza ukuthi agqoke ibhulukwe uhhafu aphinde alihlanekezele? Yini ebizokwenza akhohlwe ukugqoka ingubo yakhe yangaphansi, ayishiye endaweni yesigameko? Lokhu thina kusidwebela isithombe sokuthi umgqokise yena, esembulele,” usho kanje.Elandisa ngokuthola kwabo ngesigameko, uthe bathole ngaso ngoMsombuluko, sebevele beqalile ukukhathazeka ngokuthi kungani ehambe waya emcimbini ngeSonto wangabuya."Kufike iphoyisa lenduna, lihamba namaphoyisa omthetho, bezobikela umndeni ngokuthi umsolwa usewabikele ngesenzo sakhe, waze wayowakhombisa nendawo yesigameko,” kusho uNksz Shabane.Uthe bathole ukuthi umsolwa wehlulekile ukufihla isigameko, waziceba emndenini wakhe, umalume wakhe wavuka inja ebomvu wathi akahambe ayoziceba emaphoyiseni."Indlela enze ngayo umalume siyishayela ihlombe siwumndeni. Kodwa siyafuna ukuthi le ngane igonyuluke ngokuthi yini le engaka eyenze ukuthi ize imbulale uMbali. Sisamangele futhi sishaqekile ngesenzo sayo. Ukube imbulale maqede yangaziceba, besingeke nhlobo sisolele ngakuyo ngendlela encane ngayo futhi iphinde ibe ngumakhelwane,” usho kanje.Owenhlangano elwela abantu besifazane nezingane, iWomen of uMthwalume, uNksz Nombuso Sibisi uthe buyashaqisa ubulwane obenziwe ngumsolwa ebe emncane ngeminyaka."Kuyasikhathaza ukuthi ubugebengu obuhlasimulisa umzimba kanje benziwe yingane encane kanje ebesinethemba lokuthi izokhula ibe yindoda yangempela,” kusho uNksz Sibisi.Uthe lokhu kubanika isithombe sokuthi mhlawumbe lobu bulwane intsha ibubukela emadodeni asekhulile, wathi bazoweseka umndeni, balibheke nangamehlo abomvu icala uma seliqhubeka enkantolo.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda uthe amaphoyisa aseMsinsini, abophe owesilisa ngecala lokubulala owesifazane eQwabe Location."Kubikwa ukuthi isidumbu sikamufi sitholwe emfuleni sinamanxeba okulinyazwa,” kusho uNetshiunda.Uthe umsolwa uvele ngoLwesine eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseTurton. Icala lihlehliselwe uLwesibili.
INHLANGANO ebhekelele abadayisa emgwaqweni nabezitolo ezincane, i-National Informal Traders Alliance of South Africa (Nitasa), ikhala ngomnqamulajuqu wesikhathi esinikezwe abezitolo ukuthi bazibhalise kabusha ukuqinisekisa ukulandelwa kwemigomo yezempilo.Ekhuluma nezwe ngoLwesihlanu ngegxathu elithathwa uhulumeni ukulwa nokubhebhetheka kwabashona emva kokudla ukudla okunobuthi, uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, uthe bonke abezitolo ezincane banezinsuku eziwu-21 kuphela ukubhalisa ngokusemthethweni.UNkk Rosheda Muller onguMengameli we-Nitasa ephawula emva kwenkulumo kaRamaphosa, uthe emva kwezigameko ezikhathazayo zokufa kwezingane okukholakala ukuthi zisuke zidle ezikuthenge ezitolo ezincane, uhulumeni ufuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi uqhamuka namasu okulwa nalesi sihlava, kodwa isikhathi esibekelwe abezitolo kasenele."Uma kumele izitolo zibhalise, kudingeka izikhulu zomasipala noma abezempilo ukuthi bahambele ezitolo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imigomo yezempilo iyalandelwa. Omasipala ngeke bakwazi ukwamukela umthamo wabantu abazothutheleka emahhovisi ukuzobhalisa lawa mabhizinisi ezinsukwini eziwu-21 kuphela, kungathatha cishe unyaka ngenxa yemigudu elandelwayo,” usho kanje.Uthe iningi labadayisi basemgwaqweni kuwona wonke amadolobha akuleli, bangabokufika abavela kwamanye amazwe, ngakho uhulumeni unomsebenzi omkhuu wokuqinisekisa ukuthi banawo yini amaphepha okuba kuleli nokwenza ibhinisi.UNkk Muller uthe abantu abathenga ezitolo ezincane emalokishini nasemakhaya abahluphekayo, abangazi nokuthi ukudla kuthengwe kuziphi izindawo. Uveze ukuthi kubalulekile ukuthi kuqiniswe umkhankaso wokuhlolwa kokulandelwa kwemigomo nasezindaweni okugcinwa kuzona ngaphambi kokuthi kuthengiselwe abezitolo.Ngesikhathi ekhuluma nesizwe, uRamaphosa uthe zonke izitolo ezingabhalisiwe ezinsukwini eziwu-21 nezingayilandeli imigomo yezempilo, zizovalwa. Uthe amathimba ahlanganisa izinhlaka ezehlukene azohambela kulezi zitolo, yilapho kugcinwa khona ukudla nalapho kwakhiwa khona, ukuhlola indlela yokusebenza, wathi izitolo okuzotholakala ukuthi ziyathinteka ekudayiselweni kwabantu ukudla okunobuthi noma kugcinwa kuzo amakhemikhali ayingozi, zizovalwa.URamaphosa uthe umkhankaso wokungena isitolo nesitolo nokuvakashela abadayida ukudla emgwaqweni uzoqala eGauteng, waveza ukuthi ukuhlola zonke izitolo kuzothatha inyanga eyodwa.I-IFP kuzwelonke ithe iyakuxhasa lokhu kungenelela kukahulumeni ekulweni nalesi sihlava.Oyikhulumelayo, uMnuz Mkhuleko Hlengwa, uthe kuyancomeka ukubeka phambili impilo yabantu bakuleli, okwenziwa uhulumeni wokubambisana."I-IFP inxusa abezomthetho ukuthi basebenze ngokushesha ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imigomo ebekiwe iyasetshenziswa ukulwa nalesi sihlava,” usho kanje.

Ufike eBrazil ngoMgqibelo ebusuku, kanti ingqikithi yomhlangano ithi: "Building a Just World and a Sustainable Planet”.Isitatimende esivela eHhovisi likaMengameli sithe elakuleli lizonikwa isikhundla sikasihlalo kusuka ngo-Disemba 1, 2024. LIHLOSE ukwenza konke okusemandleni alo ukusebenzisa umthandazo ukuze kudambe ubugebengu eNanda, ibandla labasindisiwe iShepherd’s Heart Ministries.Lokhu kudalulwe ngumholi walo obuye abe ngudokotela uMfundisi Benzi Gumede. Leli bandla lingaphansi kwe-Apostolic Faith Mission of Southern Africa (AFMSA).Leli bandla linesizinda endaweni yaseTafuleni, eNanda, okuyilapho ubugebengu obudla khona lubi."Ukukutshela iqiniso nje, alukho uhlobo lobugebengu olungekho kuleya ndawo. Kubulawa abantu kuyebiwa futhi kuyagqekezwa. Kwenziwa yonke into ongayicabanga engalungile emphakathini esikuwona,'' usho kanjena umfundisi.Uqhube wathi bakholwa ukuthi uNkulunkulu unamandla ngaphezulu kwesimo abazithola bebhekene naso eNanda.Uveze ukuthi basanda kuba nendumezulu yenkonzo kuyona le ndawo lapho obekuzokhulekelwa khona zonke izinhlobo ezahlukene zezinkinga ezibonakala zikhungethe le ndawo.Uthe njengebandla likaNkulunkulu abagcini nje ngokushumayela kuphela kodwa bayazibandakanya nezinto ezenzeka emphakathini abakuwona.Uthe yingakho bekubeka eqhulwini ukubaluleka kokuthi kube khona abakwenzayo ngenhloso yokulwa nobo ugebengu obudla lubi kule ndawo."Sikholwa ukuthi uma sonke singabambisana nakanjani singakwazi ukuthi siyinqobe impi kasathane ebonakala idla lubi lapha eNanda,'' usho kanje umfundisi.Uthe minyaka yonke bazozijwayeza ukuthi bazihlele izinkonzo zokulwa nobugebengu kule ndawo.Mayelana nebandla aliholayo, uthe likholelwa kakhulu ekushumayeleni uNkulunkulu ngeqiniso futhi likhuthaza kakhulu imfundo kubona bonke abantu abasha abakulona.
ZIHLABELA phambili izinhlelo zikahulumeni zokufuqa eyomshwalense wezempilo kuleli, iNational Health Insurance (NHI), nakuba kunokungaboni ngaso linye emaqenjini abambisene kuhulumeni.Lokhu kuvezwe nguNgqongqoshe wezeMpilo kuleli, uDkt Aaron Motsoaledi, othe abakhohlwe labo abacabanga ukuthi izomiswa eyalo mshwalense ngoba kuhlukene imibono.Ephendula imibuzo yamalungu ePhalamende ngoLwesithathu ebusuku, uthe indaba yokuthi lo mshwalense uzodla malini izocaca uma usuqala ukusebenza."Kukhona abahlale befuna ukwazi ukuthi lo mshwalense uzodla malini. Konke lokhu kuzocaca kahle uma usuqala ukusebenza.” Uthe kuzophuculwa ingqalasizinda, kubhekwane nodaba lwabasebenzi kanjalo nokuphuculwa kwezimo ukuze lo mshwalense usebenze."Kuzoba nezinkundla ezehlukene zikahulumeni lapho kuzoxoxwa khona eyokungaboni ngaso linye ngezinye zezinto ezithinta iNHI. Sekuwumthetho manje owasayinwa ngumengameli ngakho uzosebenza.” Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi amaqembu, okubalwa kuwo neDA, ashaya amakhala ngeyalo mshwalense njengoba eyichitha nakuba usungumthetho owasayinwa.Uveze ukuthi iNHI ihlose ukuhlinzeka abantu bakuleli ngosizo lwezempilo olulinganayo.Ubuye wakuchitha ukuthi lo mshwalense uzodla uR3 trillion, wathi le mali yakhiwe abathile emiqondweni yabo.Usho lokhu emuva kokuba ilungu leDA, uDkt Karl Willem Du Pré Le Roux, ebelokhu ebuzile ukuthi uzodla malini lo mshwalense.Unxuse amalungu ePhalamende ukuthi aye ezibhedlela ezizimele afune ukwazi ukuthi kungabiza malini ukusoka."Bazokutshela ukuthi kuzobiza uR18 000 ekubeni udokotela angakusoka ngoR1 800. Yinto esingeke siyivume ukuthi kukhokhwe imali enkulu kangaka ekubeni kungakhokhwa imali encane ukwenza into eyodwa,” kusho uMotsoaledi.Ukhale ngokuthi baningi abebekhokhela ama-medical aid iminyaka eminingi kodwa uma sekumele bahlinzwe bese uthola ukuthi iyanqaba ukukhokha."Yingakho sithi wonke umuntu kumele athole usizo lwezempilo angaze akhokhe izizumbulu.”Odabeni oluthinta ukugula nokushona kwezingane ezidle izinto ezithengwe eziphaza nakubadayisi, uthe usethumele ithimba labaseshi ukuphenya ukuze lifinyelele emnyombeni wale nkinga."Sifuna ukuthola ukuthi ngabe kukhona ubudedengu obenzekile na. Le nkinga ingaphezu kwezitolo eziyiziphaza kanjalo nakubadayisi. Uphenyo luzoveza uma kukhona imigomo engalandelwanga, kungaba eyezempilo noma eyezolimo.”
INCWADI yemeya yaseNdumeni esanda kushiya iveza ukuthi i-IFP yagwazela iDA ngezizumbulu ukuze ivote nayo kulo mkhandlu okungekho qembu elathola izihlalo ezanele ukuthi libuse ngokuzimelaIncwadi ebhalwe uMnuz Siyabonga Ndlovu, oshiye kwesobumeya eNdumeni ngeyedlule, iveza ukuthi i-IFP yagwazela iDA kwaze kwaba izikhawu ezimbili ukuze iqhubeke nokuyeseka.Nokho abaholi be-IFP nabeDA bathe abazi lutho ngemali uNdlovu athi yakhokhwa.UNdlovu ushiye isikhundla emva kokuthi iDA ifake isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bakhe.Esiphakamisweni sayo iDA yakhala ngokuthi uNdlovu akawazi umsebenzi, yathi uyalova noma ahuqe ubuthongo emihlanganweni yomkhandlu.Kepha uNdlovu uthe iDA ifake le siphakamiso ngenxa yokuthi ibifuna ukuphinde igwazelwe.Ukusho lokhu encwadini ebhekiswe esigungwini esiphezulu se-IFP nasekomitini elijuba abaholi ezikhundleni kanye nelilusa abaholi abajutshwe ezikhundleni.Kule ncwadi ebonwe yiSolezwe, uNdlovu uthe i-IFP yanikeza iDA uR100 000 ngo-2022, yaphinde yayinikeza uR120 000 ngo-2023."Ngiyazi ukuthi bafuna enye imali. Iqiniso ukuthi anginayo leyo mali, umkhandlu awunayo imali, ne-IFP ayinayo leyo mali.”UNdlovu uthe kwashaqisa ukuthi iDA ifake isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bakhe, wathi ngesikhathi kuphethe yena izinhlelo zentuthuko eziningi zenzeke ewadini ephethwe iDA.UNdlovu ukhale ngokuboshelwa amanqina enyathi abaholi be-IFP athe wayebanga nabo isikhundla sobumeya, abanye wathi bacasulwa ukuthi wanqaba ukuqasha izihlobo zabo.Okhulumela i-IFP, uMnuz Mkhuleko Hlengwa, uthe abazi lutho ngemali uNdlovu athi yanikezwa iDA."Mhlawumbe uNdlovu uyena okufanele achaze ukuthi wayeyithathephi le mali nokuthi wayinika bani. Thina asikaze simthume.”UHlengwa uthe kuzoba nomhlangano wesigungu esiphezulu ngoMsombuluko, wathi mhlawumbe bazoxoxa ngencwadi kaNdlovu."Ngokwesivumelwabo sokusebenzisana namanye amaqembu, ayikho into ekhuluma ngokunikezana imali.”Umholi weDA KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Francios Rodgers, uthe abazi lutho ngemali uNdlovu athi yanikezwa iDA.URodgers unxuse uNdlovu ukuba avule icala emaphoyiseni uma enobufakazi."Nathi sizovula icala emaphoyiseni uma sithola ubufakazi. Asikho isivumelwano esithi i-IFP kufanele isikhokhele imali ukuze sivote nayo eNdumeni.”Unobhala we-ANC esifundeni Inkosi Bhambatha, uMnuz Lucky Khumalo, uthe okuqukethwe incwadi kaNdlovu kukhombisa ngokusobala ukuthi i-IFP neDA bakhohlakele."I-IFP yenza noma yini ukuze ingaphumi emandleni. Manje sesiyabona ukuthi kungani iDA isijikele umuntu ebihlezi imvikela. Iyona ebihlezi ivikela lo Ndlovu, kodwa namhlanje isithi akawazi umsebenzi.”Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kukaNdlovu ayizange iphumelele njengoba ucingo lwakhe belungangeni.
UMHOLI we-EFF, uMnuz Julius Malema, uyihlomise wayebhekisa kumholi we-MK, uJacob Zuma.UMalema uthe usakhathele ukuhleka noZuma ekubeni emudla izithende, wathi azihlabane amalunda.Ukusho lokhu kwi-Podcast ye-EFF, lapho ebekhuluma khona ngamalungiselelo engqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi bale nhlangano.UMalema ukhuluma kanje, i-MK isanda kutheza abaholi abaqavile kwi-EFF.Kulaba baholi kukhona owayeyiphini lomholi kwi-EFF, uMnuz Floyd Shivambu, owayengusihlalo wenhlangano, u-Advocate Dali Mpofu, owayenguMvikeli woMphakathi, u-Advocate Busisiwe Mkhwebane noMnuz Mzwanele Manyi.I-EFF ne-MK bayingxenye yamaqembu aphikisana uhulumeni wokubambisana ePhalamende.Kubukeka sengathi ubudlelwano bala maqembu buzothinteka njengoba uMalema eveze ukuthi angeke esahleka nabantu abamhamba ngemumva.UMalema uthe ubecabanga ukuthi uZuma uwumngani wakhe, wathi usebonile ukuthi ihlekisana ihlomelene."Angeke ngibe nabangani abaphazamisa ukukhula kwe-EFF. Angibasabi bonke nalaba asebenza nabo.”UMalema uthe iningi labantu abahlubuke kwi-MK bawovila voco."Kodwa ke ngibafisela inhlanhla kukho konke abakwenzayo.”Ukuvela kwe-MK kuyilimazile i-EFF njengoba ilahlekelwe amavoti okhethweni olwedlule.I-EFF isuke ekubeni iqembu lesithathu ngobukhulu ePhalamende njengoba isiyiqembu lesine ngobukhulu.
INKANTOLO eNkulu yasePitoli ikhiphe umyalelo wokuthi kuvulwe indlela yokungena emayini yaseStilfontein ukuze kuvunyelwe abezimo eziphuthumayo bafinyelele kubavukuzi abasele emgodini wemayini engasasebenzi. Lokhu ngemva kokuba iNhlangano iSociety for the Protection of Our Constitution, inikele enkantolo ukuze kutholakale isisombululo salolu daba.Le nkantolo ithe noma ngabe yimuphi umvukuzi ovaleleke emgodini kumele akwazi ukuphuma. Amanye amalungu omphakathi anezihlobo ezingabavukuzi abangekho emthethweni bakhala ngokuthi noma ngabe kubi abakwenzayo futhi kuphambene nomthetho kodwa njengamanje wonke umuntu unelungelo lokuphila nokuthola usizo lokuvikelwa umthethosisekelo.Amaphoyisa ankanise kule ndawo eqaphe isimo, nawo abebhekene nenkinga yokuzikhulula emahlathini agcine elethelwe amathoyilethi angomahambanendlwana ngemuva kwamasonto afika kule ndawo.
INHLANGANO exazulula izinkinga zabantu bakuleli zemali, iNational Financial Ombud (NFO) isixwayise abantu ukuthi bangazifaki ezikweletini ngoba befuna ukutitiliza endalini yeBlack Friday, ezoba sekupheleni kwale nyanga.UMnuz Howard Gabriels oyiCredit Division Lead Ombud yeNFO, uthe iBlack Friday isuke inezipesheli ezihlukene ngakho abantu akufanele bayokhithiza ngaphandle kokuzihlelela."Njengoba kuza iBlack Friday siyacela abantu bayiphathe kahle imali. Uma kungukuthi bebehlele ukuthenga impahla ethile kufanele kube ukuthi kade bayibeka eceleni imali yaleyo mpahla. Asithandi badidwe yizipesheli bagcine sebekhithiza noma yini.”Uthe abantu abakhithiza izipesheli zeBlack Friday ngaphandle kokuzihlelela bagcina sebengene ezikweletini abebengazihlelile."Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bazi ukuthi imali abazothenga ngayo endalini ezayo izovelaphi. Bangasebenzisi ama-credit card ngoba bedidwa yizipesheli. Ukuthenga ngesikweletu kuza nenzalo ezoshiya umuntu enezikweletu ikakhulukazi uma ethenga angakuhlelelanga.”Ubalule ukuthi iBlack Friday yinhle ngokuthi izitolo zisuke zinezipesheli kodwa kolunye uhlangothi yimbi ngoba abasuke bengenamali bagcina beboleka imali ukuze bayotitiliza izipesheli.Ucele abantu ukuthi babeke imali ezobasiza ngomuso, okungaba ngeyokuthenga umuzi, eyokufunda nokufundisa izingane, eyomhlalaphansi nezobabhekelela uma kunezimo eziphuthumayo.Uthe indali yeBlack Friday nayo idinga ukubhekisiswa ukuze abantu bazihlelele babone ukuthi izitolo zinezaphulelo ngempela."Indali esuke ikhona abantu kufanele bayiqhathanise nokuthi leyo mpahla abayifunayo isuke iyimalini unyaka wonke. Uma bezihlelele kahle sebengathenga. Esikugqugquzelayo wukuphatha kahle imali. Asifuni abantu bakhithize ngeBlack Friday nangoDisemba bese beswela imali yokuya emsebenzini ngoJanuwari.”Ube esekhumbuza abantu ukuthi iNFO ikhona ukubasiza uma benezinkinga zemali ezingaxazululeki, okubalwa ezokuboleka imali kubabolekisi abancane, amabhange, ezezikweletu zezitolo, ezefenisha nezamaselula.Abantu bangafaka nezikhalo uma benqatshelwa ukukweleta ngaphandle kwesizathu esizwakalayo noma kunomuntu ongcolise igama labo osebikiwe kodwa igama labo lokukweleta lisangcolile.INFO itholakala ngokungena ku- https://nfosa.co.za nangokushayela u-0860-800-900, uWhatsApp: 066 473 0157 nangokuthumela i-email [email protected]
BABONA kuwumbango wemali yempesheni owesilisa waseLower Molweni, eThekwini, eboshelwa ukubulala unina, okuthiwa umgqibe emjondolo osegcekeni.Kulesi sigameko okuthiwa senzeke ngoLwesine kodwa saze savela ngoLwesihlanu, kubulawe uNkk MaMkhize Zindela.Umthombo uthe umndeni nomphakathi uthole ngesigameko ngoLwesihlanu, umsolwa esezame ukufihla isigameko, wathi umuntu osole ukuthi kukhona okushaya amanzi ngumfowabo kamsolwa, naye ozalwa umufi, okuvela ukuthi usebenza amahora amade emsebenzini."NgoLwesine kuthiwa wabuya ebusuku kakhulu njengenjwayelo. Wazitshela ukuthi unina uselele. Kodwa uqale ukusola ukuthi kukhona okungahambi kahle ngoLwesihlanu ezintatha, evuka elungiselela ukuya emsebenzini, waqaphela ukuthi unina akakavuki,” kusho umthombo.Uthe umfowabo kamsolwa uhambe wayongqongqoza egumbini likanina lokulala, nakhona wangasabela."Uvele wavula egumbini likanina lokulala, wafica into elaliswe kahle embhedeni wakhe, nokuthe uma eyimbula, wathola ukuthi kulaliswe imicamelo. Ubuze umfowabo ukuthi uphi unina, ophendule ngokuthi uhambile waya emakhaya,” kuqhuba umthombo.Udalule ukuthi udaba lokuya emakhaya kukanina akalukholwanga nokwenze ukuthi athi uma esesemsebenzini, ashayele esinye isihlobo ukuthi ake siphenye."Isihlobo sihambile saya ekhaya, savula zonke izindlu, okukhona kuzo nomjondolo ongavamile ukuvulwa. Kuwona siqaphele ukuthi kunenhlabathi ebikhombisa ukuthi isanda kumbiwa. Sithathe igeja samba, kwavela izitini. Sathi uma siqhubeka, kwavela icansi. Sase siyeka, sabiza umphakathi namaphoyisa. Yiwo athe uma emba, athola isidumbu sikamufi,” kuchaza umthombo.Uveze ukuthi ngaleso sikhathi umsolwa ubezihambele waziyela edolobheni ePinetown.Umthombo uveze ukuthi ushayelwe umsolwa ucingo, wabuyiswa ngaphandle kokusola ukuthi kukhona asebekutholile, wathi uma efika, zamkhalela."Kuthiwa umbulalele impesheni. Asazi kodwa ukuthi bekuqalephi ize ibangwa,” kusho umthombo othe umsolwa ubengabonakali ukuthi angenza okubi kangaka, wathi abamazeli nezidakamizwa.Isihlobo elingatholakalanga igama laso, sithe umndeni ngeke ukwazi ukukhuluma ngesigameko okwamanje.Ikhansela lendawo, uMnuz Siyabonga Nala, livumile ukuthi libikelwe ngesigameko, lahamba laze layofika khona."Amaphoyisa amumbe sikhona umufi. Engingakusho nje ukuthi siwushaqise wonke mphakathi isigameko. Abantu abaningi bababaza isihluku, bamangazwa nawukuthi umsolwa ubulale unina,” kusho uNala.Umsolwa uvelile enkantolo ePinetown ngoMsombuluko, icala lahlehliselwa uLwesibili oluzayo.
'KUVELE ukuthi aneminyaka engu-16 no-17 amantombazane ayamaniswa nesiga sokunqunywa kwengane, isidumbu sagxishwa ebhakedeni eMkholombe, ePort Shepstone ngoMsombuluko. Kuthiwa lo owabanjwa esepakishe ikhanda lengane emgodleni una-17. Nguye owabanjwa umphakathi wakhandwa ngamatshe waze wafa. Owesibili, okusolwa ukuthi wathumba ingane eneminyaka emibili wayedlulisela kumngani wakhe, usagcwele amathafa.Le ntombazane ena-16 okuthiwa idabuka eMasinenge, ngaseMargate, kuvela ukuthi ifunwa uthuli ngokuthumba ingane uPhumelele Qhoboshiyane, okuthiwa wamheha ngokuthi ngama-chips. Abazifikela mathupha kusanda kwenzeka le nsambatheka bathi wathi angayinquma ingane, waphuza negazi layo. UNksz Constant Mayikwa osekomitini lomphakathi eMkholombe, uthe amalungu omphakathi aphume inqina aze afika kubo kukamsolwa emva kokuhogela umkhondo ngemvelaphi yakhe."Sifice uninakhulu oveze ukuthi sekunesikhathi eside agcina ukumbona. Naye uthi abezwani, kubangwa ukuthi ufuna abuyele esikoleni. Kunabantu bendawo abathe bambonile ehamba emgwaqweni ngoMsombuluko,” usho kanje.Uthe uninakhulu kamsolwa uveze ukuthi uzwa ngendaba uma ekhona endaweni njengoba engazihluphi ngokungena ekhaya. Unina kaPhumelele, uNksz Thami Qhoboshiyane, uthe bazama ukuhlangana nomndeni kamsolwa okuthiwa usadukile ukuze bathole iqiniso."Njengoba ungithinta nje, sibheke khona eMargate ngoba nathi sifuna ukukhuluma nomndeni wakhe usilekelele ukuthi atholakale, ukuze sithole iqiniso ukuthi ikhanda lengane laliyiswa kephi. Sizwile ukuthi kuthiwa umsolwa useke wabonakala eMargate kodwa akazange afike kubo," usho kanje.Uveze ukuthi umsolwa obulewe wumphakathi bathole ukuthi ngowaseBhobhoyi khona ePort Shepstone kodwa wayekhohlise abaqashe lapho ayevakashele khona wathi usuka e-Eastern Cape.Ikhansela lendawo uMnuz Xolani Gasa, uthe bayile emndenini kaPhumelele ukuyobhonga emsanweni."Kukhona abalekelelwa ngakho ukufihla, kodwa okhulumela umasipala onelungelo lokwenaba kulokho. Izigameko zokulahleka kwezingane endaweni azikho ebesike sazizwa kuyaqala nje ngalesi esibuhlungu kangaka," usho kanje.Ukusho lokhu nje, phambilini ngesikhathi Isolezwe likhuluma ngelinye ilungu lomphakathi, laveza ukuthi umsolwa obulewe wathi ikhanda babezolihambisa ezangomeni ezikhona endaweni, futhi baningi abenza lo msebenzi.
UMENGAMELI wezwe, uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa, uthe sebethathe isinqumo sokunqanda ukubhebhetheka kokufa kwezingane emuva kokudla ukudla okunobuthi. URamaphosa uthe bakhiphe umyalelo wokuthi wonke amathilomu athinteka ekufeni kwezingane kufanele avalwe ngokuphazima kweso. Ubuye wathi wonke ama-spaza shop adayisa ukudla nalezo zindawo ezinokudla abhaliswe ngokusemthethweni ngaphansi komasipala kungakapheli izinsuku ezingu-21. "Nanoma yisiphi isitolo esingabhalisiwe ngokusemthethweni emuva kwezinsuku ezingu-21 noma esingahlangabezani nemigomo yabezempilo sizovalwa." URamaphosa uthe abanikazi bezitolo abazoqhubeka bahwebe ngisho bengasavumelekile bazowuchama, bawuphuze ngoba abakwasidlodlo bazongena bephuma kuzozonke izitolo bezobheka ukuthi zonke izitolo aziyiphulile yini imigomo ebekwe wuhulumeni.Eqhuba uRamaphosa uthe yonke imithi yokubulala izilwane ayisadingakali kubadayisi basemigwaqweni.Uthe lomkhankaso wokuqinisekisa ukuthi izitolo ezigunyazwe ukuba zidayise into edliwayo kuphela ezivumeleke ukuhweba, uzoqala KwaZulu-Natal naseGauteng.Uthe inhlosongqangi ukunqanda ubhubhane oseludlule nenqwaba yemiphefumulo kuleli.Umengameli uphinde wakuchitha ukuthi izitolo ezidayisa ukudla okunobuthi ngezabantu bokufika kuphela.Uthe uMnyango wezeMfundo yamabanga aphansi uzoqinisekisa ukuthi izikole ziyaqikelela ukuthi abantu abalethela abafundi ukudla nababadayiselayo bayayilandela imithetho.URamaphosa uthe kunomkhankaso ozophunywa ukuqwashisa umphakathi ngalobubungozi. Uthe kunesikhwama esizosungulwa sikaR500 million ngenhloso yokuxhasa abantu abafuna ukuba nezitolo. Unxuse abantu abalamela ukudla osekudlulelwe yisikhathi nokuwumbombayi ukuba bathinte abeNational Consumer Commission ku-012 065 1940. Uthe kuzofanele izingane ziqeqeshwe ukuze zikwazi ukubona ukudla osekudlulelwe yisikhathi nokuwumbombayi.Omasipala badonswe ngendlebe ukuba bachabe, babhushe futhi bacente izindawo okungenzeka ukuthi zifuye amagundane.Uthe uNgqongqoshe wezeMfundo bazohlonza imithi okungafanele isetshenziswe ezikoleni. Umengameli ubuye wazwelana kakhulu nezingane ezihlaselwe wukugula kanye nemindeni eshonelwe.
UBAZIWA njengomntwana waseZulwini uMfundisi Mzwenkosi Ephraim Gcwensa (73) oshone kuleli sonto ngoba watholakala ngesiphrofetho somholi wamaNazaretha wesibili, inkosi Johannes Galile (JG) Shembe Ilanga.Okhulumela amaNazaretha angaphansi komholi inkosi Mduduzi Shembe uNyazilwezulu, uMnuz Thokozani Mncwabe, uthe umfundisi watholakala ngesiphrofetho senkosi Ilanga."Silahlekelwe ngomfundisi Gcwensa. Nguyena obebekwe ethempelini eBuhleni futhi kunguye owazi konke okwenzeka khona. Umlando esinawo ngaye owokuthi abazali bakhe babebhekene nenkinga yokungabatholi abantwana. Baya enkosini Ilanga beyocela ukuthi babe nomntwana. Uma befika inkosi Ilanga yabatshela ukuthi, okhalweni lakwaGcwensa ngeke isabakhona ingane. Ngaleso sizathu inkosi yathi kungcono izobanika umntwana waseZulwini ngoba abasenamntwana ozobakhona enzalweni yabo” kusho uMcwabe.Uthe wakhula wangena kuzona zonke izinhlaka zenkonzo kwaze kwaba ukhushulelwa esikhundleni sobufundisi.Indodana kamfundisi Gcwensa, uMshumayeli Sihle Gcwensa, ithe balahlekelwe kakhulu ngokushona kukayise."Ubaba ubengumuntu wenhlonipho engawufuni umsindo. Silahlekelwe kakhulu. Siyizingane zakhe singu-16 sesisonke. Wayenamakhosikazi amathathu. Amabili amadala okunguMaShange noMaLuthuli sebashona. Sekusele unkosikazi omncane uMaSibiya. Ubengumuntu owukhathalele umndeni wakhe. Nasenkolweni ubezinikele kakhulu nathi esifundisa ngayo inkolo,” kusho uMshumayeli Gcwensa.Umfundisi Gcwensa ungowaseMaphephetheni eNdwedwe. Ubengomunye wezethenjwa zomholi webandla lamaNazaretha.Kuthiwa kulindeleke ukuthi angcwatshwe ngoLwesithathu khona eMaphephetheni.EBuhleni ungomunye wabefundisi abebehlonishwa kakhulu. Wonke amathempeli abika khona eBuhleni lapho bekuhola khona umfundisi Gcwensa. AmaNazaretha akhihla esikaNandi ngokushona kwakhe. Ukushona kwakhe kukhulunywa ngakho ngisho nasezinkundleni zokuxhumana.

UNkk Diko uthe siyamkhathaza isinqumo sikaMalatsi "odukisiwe” futhi sikhomba ukushabalala kweSABC."Izinkinga ezibhekene neSABC zidinga ukuxazululwa ngokushesha. Ungqongqoshe usitshengisa amandla anawo futhi uphazamisa uhlelo oseluqaliwe,” kusho usihlalo wekomiti.UGungubele ubhale ezinkundleni zokuxhumana wathi isinqumo sikaMalatsi sizobhebhethekisa inkinga yokuntula kweSABC imali.Uqhube wathi akusadingeki iSABC iqhubeke nenkinga yemali enayo ngakho izichibiyelo kumele zenziwe.Ngakolunye uhlangothi iDA ithe ibambe ngakho iyasamukela isinqumo sikaMalatsi esincomile yathi siphusile futhi kuhloswe ngaso ukuqondisa izinto ngononina.Ilungu leDA ePhalamende, uNkk Tsholofelo Bodlani libonge uMalatsi ngokusebenzisa amandla esikhundla asiphethe ukuze kusindiswe iSABC enkingeni yemali.Uthe okufunwa yilo mthethosivivinywa ukunika ungqongqoshe amandla amaningi, nokugxambukela emsebenzini weSABC."Kulindeleke iSABC ilahlekelwe uR590 million onyakeni wezimali u-2024/25 isuka kuR1.1 billion oyakeni ofile. Sesilinde ukuzwa kungqongqoshe ukuthi ikuphi okuzokwenziwa ekuletheni isisombululo enkingeni yemali ebhekene neSABC,” kusho uNkk Bodlani.Amahlelo ehlukene emphakathini okubalwa i-AfriForum neSANEF abeshaya amakhala ngeSABC Act.
KUDLA ephaketheni likahulumeni phakathi kuka-R3 800 kuya ku-R4 000, ukugaya amaphepha akwa-matric abhalwa umfundi ngamunye.Le mali eyazo zonke izifundo eziyisikhombisa kuya phezulu ezibhalwa abafunda u-matric.Lokhu kuvezwe okhulumela umnyango uMnuz Elijah Mhlanga.UMhlanga uthe kudla imali ukugaya amaphepha ka-matric abhalwa abafundi mahhala.Uthe cishe kudla u-R2.9 billion ukugaya amaphepha njengoba abafundi ababhala u-matric ngokugcwele bebalelwa ku-727 121, kulo nyaka."Uma uhlanganisa nabangu-155 215 ababhala u-matric ngasese, kudla u-R3.6 billion, uma imali isihlanganisiwe. Kuyabiza ukubhalisa izivivinyo,” kusho uMhlanga.Ukusho lokhu echitha imibiko yokuthi umnyango uchitha imali enkulu ubhalisa izivivinyo.NoMqondisi jikelele eMnyangweni wezeMfundo uMnuz Mathanzima Mweli, uthe kuyabiza ukubhalisa izivivinyo.Uthe amanye amaphepha agaywa yizinkampani ezizimele ngoba zinohlelo lokuthi amaphepha angaputshuki."Eminye iminyango yezifundazwe isebenzisa izinkampani ezizimele ukugaya amaphepha ka-matric. Le nkampani kahulumeni yenza neminye imisebenzi kahulumeni.”UMweli obekhuluma namalungu ePhalamende izolo, uthe abazikhetheli izifundazwe ukuthi ziwagaye kuphi amaphepha ka-matric.Udalule nokuthi izinselelo zemali emnyangweni zenza bangakwazi ukuphothula eminye imisebenzi."Sibhekene nezinkinga ezithinta imali okwenza singakwazi ukukhokha ngesikhathi. Lokhu kwenza singakwazi ukukhokhela izinsiza eziningi silinde kuze kungene imali.”Usho lokhu nje le nkinga yemali emnyangweni isisezandleni zikaMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa.URamaphosa ukhulume kabanzi ngenkinga yemali ebhekene nomnyango.Uveze ukuthi uMgcinimafa uyingxenye yohlelo lokuthi kutholakale isixazululo enkingeni yemali ebhekene noMnyango wezeMfundo.
IYASHUBA phakathi kukaNgqongqoshe weMfundo eyisiSekelo, uNksz Siviwe Gwarube nenyunyana yothisha iSadtu KwaZulu-Natal, njengoba esephumele obala wathi uzokwenza umsebenzi wakhe ngaphandle kokusatshiswa.UNksz Gwarube uthe uzoqhubeka enze umsebenzi wakhe ngaphandle kokwenzelela, wachitha nokuthi le nyunyana yamxosha ngesikhathi ezama ukukhuluma namalungu ayo ayebhikisha ngeledlule ngesikhathi ehambele eThekwini, kwesinye sezikole esakhiwayo."Ngeke ngiphazamiseke emsebenzini wami, engiwenza ngaphandle kokusaba nokwenzelela. Ngazama ukuyokhuluma namalungu eSadtu ayebhikisha, angafuna ukungilalela ngagcina ngihambile,” kusho uNksz Gwarube.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ephendula imibuzo yamalungu ePhalamende, ambuze ukuthi kungani iSadtu yamxosha wangakwazi ukukhuluma nayo?UNobhala weSadtu esifundazweni, uNksz Nomarashiya Caluza, ekhuluma nabezindaba kuleli sonto, uveze ukuthi ngeke bamlalele uNksz Gwarube, owahluleka ukuhlonipha uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, ngokungawuhambeli umcimbi wokusayinwa komthetho wezikole i-Bela.Uthe ngeke bamlalele umuntu ongahloniphi ekubeni ephethe umnyango obaluleke kangaka."Ngeke simlalele ngoba akahloniphanga umengameli wezwe. Kumele azi ukuthi akayena uNgqongqoshe we-DA kodwa unguNgqongqoshe wawo wonke umuntu,” kusho uNksz Caluza.Kuma-video afakwa ezinkundleni zokuxhumana zeSadtu, kuvele uNksz Gwarube, ehambisana nephini lakhe uDkt Reginah Mhaule, owayezama ukumcubuzela amagabade ukuthi amalungu ale nyunyana amlalele.Kwaze kwangenelela uMphathiswa wezeMfundo esifundazweni, uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka, owathi bazohamba ngoba la malungu ayala ukhasha, engafuni kumuzwa.Kwathi uma esehamba aqhubeka eziculela ethi akahambe, awafuni ukumlalela.I-DA esifundazweni isabise ngokuthi izophoqeleka ukuya enkantolo uma kungukuthi iSadtu iyaqhubeka nokuchukuluza uNksz Gwarube, uma esesifundazweni.ISadtu esifundazweni, isemkhankasweni wokulwela izikole ezingayitholile imali yama-norms and standards ukuze zikwazi ukuthenga izinsiza zokubhalisa izivivinyo.Ilwela nokuthi othisha bathole uchatha wabo ka-1.5% we-pay progression, wokuphucula amaholo abo okumele ngabe yangena ngoJulayi, nonyaka.Umnyango wesifundazwe uthembise ukuthi le mali izongena ngenyanga ezayo.Odabeni lwemali yezikole, ikhona esifakiwe ezikoleni kodwa enye isashoda.UNksz Gwarube, useke wakhala ngezinkinga ezibhekene noMnyango zeziMali.Lo mnyango ubhekene nengwadla yokungakwazi ukukhokhela osonkontileka ngesikhathi. Inkinga idalwa nawukuthi awukwazi ukuvala izikhala ezibalulekile ngaphakathi emnyangweni.Muva nje, uveze ukuthi ngeke sishintshe isibalo sothisha abasezikoleni nakuba sikhula minyaka yonke isibalo sabafundi ngenxa yezinkinga zokushoda kwemali.
UHULUMENI KwaZulu-Natal, uthi uzosebenzisana neziphathimandla zabaqaphe imingcele ehlukanisa isifundazwe namanye amazwe, ukuqinisekisa akukho mpahla noma umuntu ongena ngokungemthetho.Ngesikhathi ekhuluma emhlanganweni nezimeya zomasipala abehlukene kulesi sifundazwe eThekwini, uNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal uMnuz Thami Ntuli, uthe ukuqiniswa kwemingcele engenela esifundazweni kungelinye lamaqhinga uhulumeni wesifundazwe azogxila kuwo, ukuqinisekisa ukuphepha kwabantu.Inhloso yomhlangano bekungukunikeza umhlandlandlela komasipala, emva kwesimemezelo sokushicilelwa komthetho oqukethe imigomo okumele ilandelwe womasipala ekuqiniseni isandla ngokudayiswa kokudliwayo. Lesi simemezelo senziwe nguNgqongoshe woMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana nobuHoli boMdabu uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa kuleli sonto.Lokhu kulandela ukudlanga kwezigameko zokugula nokushona kwezingane okusolakala ukuthi zisuke zithenge okudliwayo ezitolo nakwabathile abadayisayo, ezibikwa ezifundazweni ezehlukene."Ukudla nezimpahla okungena esifundazweni kuzohlolisiswa ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kukulungele ukungena kuso. Esikutholayo ukuthi abezitolo imvamisa okungabofika, bahlala ngokugcwele ngaphakathi ezitolo ngoba kuthiwa balala khona, bageze benze nezinye izinto ngaphakathi endaweni abasebenzela kuyo, okuyinto ekhathazayo uma kubhekwa ngokwezenhlanzeko,” usho kanje uHlabisa.Phakathi kwezinhlelo azibalulile uhulumeni ukuthi uzoziqinisekisa, ukufundisa nokuqeqesha abanikazi bezitolo ezincane nababasebenzelayo ngokuphathwa kokudla, ukukugcina nezindlela zokukupheka. Uthe kuzoba nemikhankaso yokuqwashisa umphakathi ngezinto okumele uziqaphele uma uthenga okudliwayo ezitolo nokuthi ibikwa kanjani indawo edayisa ukudla engayilandeli imigomo ebekiwe. UHlabisa uqhube wathi ababhekelele ezempilo bazohambela ezitolo ezidayisa ukudla ngenhloso yokuhlola ukulandelwa kwemigomo. Omasipala kuthiwa bazosebenzisana nezinhlangano ezisiza umphakathi ezingenzi nzuzo ekulweni nalesi sihlava.UNtuli uthe inhloso yemikhankaso akukona ukulwa nabokufika kuleli kodwa uhulumeni uzama ukugwema ukubhebhetheka kwalesi sihlava.Siyakhula isibalo sabantu abashona ngemva kokudla abasuke bekuthenge ezitolo kuleli, okugqame kakhulu kwezabokufikaEzinye izifundazwe seziqalile ukuqinisa isandla, njengoba eGauteng, kumiswe ukudayisela abafundi ukudla ezikoleni. Kumasipala iKing Sabata Dalindyebo e-Eastern Cape, bekungenwa ezitolo ezincane kushaqwa ukudla okutholalaka ukuthi kuphelelwe yisikhathi ngenhloso yokuthi kulahlwe.Esifundazweni iWestern Cape, eCape Town, kuboshwe abasolwa abahlanu abangabokudabuka eSomalia, abebevele enkantolo izolo ngemva kokubhadanywa bekhanda ama- sausage ngendlela engagunyaziwe futhi bengenamvume, endaweni engahlanzekile okuthiwa adluliselwa ezitolo ezincane zabokufika.

IZONO zobuholi be-ANC esifundazweni iGauteng seziwele ebuholini be-ANC yaKwaZulu-Natal njengoba iDA inqaba ukusiza i-ANC komasipala baKwaZulu-Natal.Ubuholi beDA KwaZulu-Natal buthe ngeke buyisize i-ANC komasipala baKwaZulu-Natal ngenxa yokuthi i-ANC yakhipha imeya yeDA kuMasipala waseTshwane, uMnuz Cilliers Brink.Umholi weDA KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Francios Rodgers, uthe ngeke bayilekelele i-ANC komasipala baKwaZulu-Natal, uBrink engakabuyiselwa esikhundleni sakhe."Abakwazi ukusicela ukuthi sibalekelele ekubeni bona bekhipha izimeya zeDA kwezinye izifundazwe.”Kuke kwaba nenhlansi yethemba lokuthi i-ANC neDA bazosebenzisana komasipala baKwaZulu-Natal emva kokuthi lama qembu eqale ukusebenzisana kuhulumeni wesifundazwe.Kwaze kwaqala izingxoxo zokuthi lama qembu abambisane kuMasipala waseThekwini, iDA yayithenjiswa isikhundla sikasihlalo wekomiti kulo mkhandlu.Nokho izingxoxo zagcina zifinyelela kwangqingetshe, nokwaholela ekutheni isikhundla esasithenjiswe iDA sigcine sinikezwa i-EFF.Mumva nje iDA ayizange iyeseke i-ANC ngesikhathi kuqokwa imeya entsha kuMasipala waKwaDukuza, kunalokho iDA yazama yahluleka ukukhipha usomlomo we-ANC kulo mkhandlu, uNkk Dolly Govender, ngevoti lokungabethembi ubuholi bakhe.Le senzo sacasula ubuholi be-ANC KwaZulu-Natal.Usihlalo we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Siboniso Duma, wasigxeka kakhulu isenzo seDA ngesikhathi i-ANC inesithangami nabezindaba.Nokho uRodgers uthe i-ANC yashaya isikhala ngokugxeka esidlangaleni amaqembu ebambisene nawo kuhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal."Kwaba ishwa ukuthi i-ANC ihlasele iDA ne-IFP ngesikhathi inesithangami nabezindaba.
