I-ESKOM ikhumbuza abantu ukuthi babheke izigubhu zabo ukuthi ziyahambisana yini nohlelo olusha kungakashayi uNovemba 24 ngoba uma sekushaye lolu suku isigubhu singabhalisiwe kabusha ngeke siwamukele ugesi wekhadi.Esitatimendeni sakwa-Eskom KwaZulu-Natal, kuvele ukuthi abantu kufanele babhalise kabusha izigubhu zabo ngaphansi kohlelo lweStandard Transfer Specification Association (STSA).UNksz Joyce Zingoni okhulumela i-Eskom KwaZulu-Natal, uthe uma abantu bengazibhalisile izigubhu zabo ohlelweni olusha ngeke bakwazi ukufaka ugesi wekhadi.Kufanele bazibhalise ngokufaka izinombolo ezibizwa nge-Key Revision Number (KRN)2. Konke lokhu kufanele bakwenze kungakadluli uNovemba 24.Uthe izinamba zokubhalisa isigubhu ohlelweni olusha zitholakala uma abantu bethenga ikhadi likagesi.Uveze ukuthi bathola izinombolo eziwu-20 okufanele bazifake esigubhini sikagesi."Abantu kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi izigubhu zabo sezibhalisiwe yini ohlelweni olusha ngaphambi kokucela usizo kwi-chatbot yethu ebizwa ngo-Alfred noma ngaphambi kokuya emahhovisi ethu. Ukubheka ukuthi isigubhu sibhalisiwe kufanele abantu bafake le namba 1844 6744 0738 4377 2416. Uma le namba ingasebenzi kufanele bacindezele lezi ezilandelayo,”-L&G(E460)-i057 enter-L&G(PLC2)-i057-Conlog-#005#-Voltex-005 enter-Nyamezela-cindezela ibhathini elibomvu, ulibambe kuze kuvele amadothi bese ufaka u-005 enterUthe uma isigubhu siveza u-2 kusho ukuthi sesibhalisiwe ngaphansi kohlelo olusha kanti uma siveza u-1 kusho ukuthi kufanele sibhaliswe.Abantu bangabhalisa imininingwane yabo kwi-chatbot yakwa-Eskom ebizwa ngo-Alfred ngokungena ku-www.alfred.eskom.co.za/chatroom bese bekhetha isihloko esithi "update my details”.Bangaya nasemahhovisi akwa-Eskom aseduze nabo ukuze basizakale.
LIZOLALELWA ngoFebhuwari ngonyaka ozayo, eNkantolo eNkulu yaseMgungundlovu, udaba lombango wobukhosi baKwaNodunga, KwaDukuza.Lokhu kuza emva kokufakwa ngokusemthethweni kwamaphepha enkantolo, Isolezwe eliwabonile, aqukethe yonke imininingwane ngombango walesi sihlalo.UMntwana uMlungisi Zulu, ofake udaba enkantolo, uthe akasakwazi ukulinda ukuthi lolu daba lungene enkantolo.Uthe usejahe ukuthi kwenzeke ubulungiswa, ubukhosi bubuyele ezandleni ezifanele."Ngiyafisa ukuthi umthetho uklame indima yawo kulolu daba ngakho konke okwenzeka okungahambanga kahle, kumele kulungisiwe ngoba yimi engiyinkosana kababa okwakumele iqokwe. Isihlalo asibuyele ezandleni ezifanele,” kusho uZulu.Elandisa ngokwenzeka, uthe uyise omzalayo, inkosi Goodwill Qedisono Zulu, yashona ngoDisemba 17, 2016, kwalindeleka ukuthi kube wuye owayezothatha izintambo."Ngathi ngibona, kwakuqhamuka umfowethu (Nkanyiso Zulu), egadwe onogada nosomatekisi ababephethe izinhlokohlela zezibhamu, kwathiwa wuye ogaqele isihlalo,” kusho uZulu.Uthe kwavumbuka incwadi eyayingasayiniwe futhi ingena-date, kwathiwa yabhalwa wuyise okhotheme, ithi umfowabo uNkanyiso ngozothatha izintambo."Ngesikhathi ngizama ukulandelela udaba, kwavela ukuthi incwadi yayinkonkoshelwe. Nakuba okuningi kwakungivuna njengenkosana futhi nobaba ayesengifundise wonke umsebenzi wesihlalo, kodwa angiphumelelanga,” kusho uZulu.Uthe kuningi okwavela, phakathi kwakho kwaba ukuthi umfowabo ukhiphe intshontsho, wagwazela izikhulu zikahulumeni ukuze kube wuye oqokwayo."Ngenxa yokwesabela impilo yami, nabasondelene nami bangexwayisa ngokuthi kuyingozi ukulusukumela ngaleso sikhathi lolu daba njengoba wayesezungezwe abantu abayingozi,” kusho uZulu.Uthe esinye isizathu esenza ukuthi kweluleke isikhathi engalusukumeli udaba ukuthi kwakufuneka ahlanganise izindodla zemali yokululwa ngezinkantolo.Echaza ngokuzaleka kwenkosi esesihlalweni njengamanje, uthe bazalwa ubaba oyedwa, komama abehlukene, kanti wuye ongowokuqala kuyise.Kuthintwa inkosi, uNkanyiso Zulu ukuthi iphawule, ikhale ngokuthi isemhlanganweni, maqede yalivala ucingo.UMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu ugcine ungayiphendulanga imibuzo othunyelwe yona ngodaba.
OWESIFAZANE owagonyuluka ngokuhlela itulo lokusoconga umyeni wakhe oyiphoyisa uvezele inkantolo ukuthi wafinyelela kulesi sinqumo ngoba esekhathele ukuhlukunyezwa ngumyeni wakhe."Kwasekuqaleni, ummangalelwa wayefuna ukuvuma icala futhi efisa nokuveza ukuthi lokhu wakwenziswa ukuthi wayekade ehlukumezeka.' Ngodaba oluphelele thola Isolezwe lanamhlanje.
I-NATIONAL Stokvel Association of South Africa isidonse ngendlebe abadlala izitokofela ukuthi bangakhiphi imali emabhange ngenhloso yokuyoyihlukanisela ndawana thize ngoba izigebengu sezibabhobhele.Le nhlangano ebhekele okwenzeka ezitokofeleni zakuleli, ithe abantu kufanele bahlukanise imali ebhange ngokuthi bayithunyelelwe kuma-akhawunti abo bangahambi nokheshi.Kuphuma lesi sixwayiso njengoba sekusondele amaholidi kaKhisimusi lapho abadlala izitokofela besuke behlukanisa khona imali.Ngalezi zinsuku izitokofela ezihlukanisa imali emizini ethize ziyahlaselwa yizigebengu ezisuke zihoshe umoya wokuthi kuzohlukaniswa imali.UMnuz Andrew Lukhele onguSihlalo weNational Stokvel Association, uthe abantu kufanele baqaphele ukuthi imali bayihlukanisela kuphi.Uveze ukuthi ngokujwayelekile abantu baye bahlangane emzini othile bese behlukanisa imali yestokofela.Uthe kufanele amalungu estokofela aqinisekise ukuthi imali ihlukaniswa ngendlela ephephile.Ubalule ukuthi amalungu estokofela kufanele ahlangane asho ukuthi imali azoyihlukanisa ngezindlela zesimanje, okuwukuyifaka kuma-akhawunti asebhange.Uthe izinkinga ziqala uma umuntu sekufanele ayokhipha isamba semali ebhange bese elandelwa yizigebengu.Lo mkhuba uthe kufanele uphele ngoba ubeka abantu engcupheni yokuqolwa.
UMPHAKATHI waseNgodini kwaHlabisa ukhale kumasipala iBig Five Hlabisa ukuthi ungenelele ekuxhaseni abafundi abenze kahle ezifundweni zabo kodwa abangenawo amandla okukhokhela izindleko zokufunda emanyuvesi.Lokhu kuza emva kokuthi kube nezikhalo eziningi ngenxa yesikhwama esixhasa abafundi iNSFAS okuthiwa sinezinkinga eziningi nokwenza abafundi bagcine bengaxhaswanga ukuthi baqhubeke nokufunda. Lesi sikhalo somphakathi sivele ngesikhathi kwethulwa izinhlelo zentuthuko eNgodini.Kuthiwa yinqwaba yezingane okuthiwa zenza kahle esikoleni kule ndawo kodwa zigcina zihleli emakhaya yobunzima bokuthoka uxhaso.Kumanje isikhwama iNSFAS sikesabhekane nezinkinga nosekuphoqe ukuthi ukuthi kungenelele uNgqongqoshe weMfundo ePhakeme, uSolwazi Blade Nzimande ukuze kulungiswe izinto.IMeya yaseBig 5 Hlabisa, uMnuz Comfort Khumalo, ithe bayaziqonda izinkinga zesikhwama iNSFAs, yingakho bethathe isinqumo sokuthi babeke eceleni imali engu-R100 000 ukusiza abafundi abasuke befuna ukuya emanyuvesi ngonyaka ozayo."Siyazi ukuthi iNSFAS ihlale inezinkinga ezigcina zilimaza abafundi abasuke befuna ukuqhubekela ezikhungweni eziphakeme zeMfundo. Nokho engingakusho ukuthi thina njengomasipala sesiyibekile imali engu-R100 000 yokusiza abafundi abaswele nabasuke bephase kahle," kusho uKhumalo.Uqhube wathi njalo ekuqaleni konyaka banezinhlelo zokuklomelisa abafundi nothisha abenze kahle kuMatric ukubagqugquzela ukuthi baqhubeke nemfundo.Uveze nokuthi lokhu bakwenza ngenhloso yokuthi akwazi ukuqhubeka ayofundela lokho akuthandayo ngaphandle kwenkinga yemali.Kwenzeka lokhu nje abafundi bakamatric bamatasa nezivivinyo zokuphela konyaka ezikoleni ezahlukene.
IZINKUMBI zabantu abahola isibonelelo sabangatohozi kuleli sebeyalelwe ukuthi behlise amaphaphu, njengoba bezoqhubeka nokuthola lesi sibonelelo nangonyaka ozayo wezimali.Lokhu kuvezwe nguNgqongqoshe eHhovisi likaMengameli, uNksz Khumbudzo Ntshavheni, ekhuluma nabezindaba, ngemuva komhlangano weKhabhinethi.Uthe abantu abangadideki njengoba noNgqongqoshe wezeziMali, uMnuz Enoch Godongwana, esezinhlelweni zokuthi siqhubeke lesi sibonelelo nangonyaka ozayo u-2025/2026."Abantu badidekile mayelana nalesi sibonelelo. Kunethimba elibunjiwe elibheka eyezinhlelo ezithinta eyalesi sibonelelo. Uma zingekho izinhlelo ezintsha ezizongena esikhaleni salesi sibonelelo, abantu bazoqhubeka nokusithola ngoba uhulumeni uyakubona ukubaluleka kwaso.” Bangaphezu kuka-17 million abantu abafaka izicelo zokuhola lesi sibonelelo.Kwenzeka lokhu nje, kunengebhe yokuthi kungenzeka siqedwe lesi sibonelelo emuva kokuba uGodongwana, athi babheka ezinye izinhlelo zokuthi bafake abahola le mali ezinhlelweni zemisebenzi kunokuthi baqhubeke nokukhokha lesi sibonelelo.UNksz Ntshavheni uveze nokuthi uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa uzobiza "umhlangano womndeni” lapho ezokhuluma khona nesizwe ngezinhlelo zikahulumeni zokunqanda izehlakalo zokushona kwezingane ezisuke zidle ukudla okunobuthi, okusuke kuthengwe ezipaza noma kwabadayisa ngaphandle kwezikole.Uthe uRamaphosa uzokhuluma nesizwe maduze, ngeke liphele leli sonto."Angifuni ukuqagela ukuthi uzokhuluma nini nezwe kodwa kuzoba yileli sonto. Uma sekuphothulwe yonke into kungaba ikusasa (namhlanje) kodwa yena uzokhuluma nezwe ngalesi sihlava,” kusho uNksz Ntshavheni.Usho lokhu kulandela ukushona nokugula kwezingane ezindaweni ezehlukene kuleli.Phezu kokuba kunekhwelo elivela emphakathini ukuthi kujutshwe amasosha ukuze kubhekwe lezi zitolo kodwa uNksz Ntshavheni, ukuchithile lokhu."Azikho izinhlelo zokuthi kujutshwe amasosha ekutheni ayobheka izinto ezidayiswa kulezi zitolo. Kukhona okwenziwa yithimba longqongqoshe ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kuyabhekwana nale nkinga.” Uthe kunethimba elihlanganisa ongqongqoshe bezokuphepha odabeni lwezipaza, wathi yingakho singekho isidingo sokujuba amasosha.Uveze ukuthi abayotholakala ukuthi banesandla ekuguleni nasekufeni kwezingane bayothathelwa izinyathelo.Ubuye waveza nokuthi uNgqongqoshe wezokuXhumana, uMnuz Solly Malatsi, akazange ayithole imvume yokuhoxisa uMthethosivivinywa wakwa-SABC, osePhalamende.I-SABC ibhekene nezinselelo ezithinta imali kanjalo nezithinta ukusebenza kwale nhlangano."Lo Mthethosivivinywa wakwaSABC wagunyazwa yiKhabhinethi ukuthi uyiswe ePhalamende. Akuwona okangqongqoshe kodwa oweKhabhinethi. Akakwazi ukuwuhoxisa engazange avumelane neKhabhinethi.”
KWAYEKELELWA ezandleni ze-National Prosecuting Authority (NPA) ukwengezwa komculi uKelly Khumalo ohlwini lwabamangalelwa abayisihlanu abasolwa kwelokubulala owayengunozinti we-Orlando Pirates neBafana Bafana, uSenzo Meyiwa.Lokhu kuvezwe umphenyi omkhulu kuleli cala, uBrigadier Bongani Gininda njengoba eqhubeka nokuphoswa imibuzo ummeli u-Advocate Sipho Ramosepele eNkantolo eNkulu yasePitoli, izolo.UGininda uthe emva kokuhlaziya ubufakazi obehlukene, okukhona kubo nobemiqhafazo uKelly ayeyithumelele udadewabo uZandy Khumalo-Gumede, wakubona kufanele ukuthi uKelly engezwe njengomsolwa wesithupha.Uveze ukuthi le miqhafazo, uKelly wayeyithumele uZandy esikhathini esingangonyaka ngaphambi kokubulawa kukaMeyiwa.UMeyiwa wadutshulwa wabulawa kubo kaKelly ngo-Okthoba 2014.Emiqhafazweni kukhona othi: "Ngizizwa ngikhathazeka emoyeni, uSenzo ufike empilweni yami nefu elimnyama, uNkulunkulu sengathi uyangijezisa ngokugcina le ndoda empilweni yami.”Omunye uthi: "Ngiyazisola ngakho konke. Ngabe kungcono ukuthi ngangingamlethanga empilweni yami (uSenzo). Amanga akhe asenomthelela kithi sonke.”Omunye uthi: "Angikwazi ukulinda usuku engasekho empilweni yami.”Omunye uthi: "Sengiyasondela osukwini engizokhululeka ngalo.”UGininda ube esethi ukuvela kwale miqhafazo ebalelwa kwewu-12, okwabuye kwamenza wabona kufanele ukuthi enze isicelo sokuthi aboshwe noKelly ngecala lokubulala nelokuhlanganisa itulo lokubulala (uSenzo).Uthe lokhu wakwenza ngaphambi kokuthi abamangalelwa bayovela okokuqala enkantolo kodwa abashushisi bathi ngeke aboshwe uKelly okwamanje."Mina njengephoyisa ngangingenamandla okuphikisa lokho. Nakuba i-NPA ingakugunyazanga ukuthi kwenzeke lokhu kodwa ngifuna ukucacisa ukuthi kwakungasho ukuthi ayivumelani, kwaba ukuthi kwakungakabi yisikhathi esifanele,” kusho uGininda.Ubuye waveza nokuthi ukudonsa kweselula kaKelly abika ukuthi yebiwe abangena endlini, embhoshongweni iMoleleki, osondelene nehostela (Abasuthu) okuvele ukuthi kwakuhleli kulo abasolwa ngaphambi nangemumva kwesigameko, kuyaziqinisa izinsolo zokuthi bayathinteka.Uthe uma ngabe isitatimende sokuthi iselula yebiwa sasingamanga, ngabe iselula yadonsa kanye namanye abo bonke ababesendlini esibhedlela, okuthiwa baya kuso emva kwesigameko."Iselula ayikwazi ukuzihambela, yafika ngomuntu eduze kombhoshongo iMoleleki,” kwengeza uGininda.Ubuye wathi nokufakazelana kwezinye zezitatimende zofakazi, kuyaziqinisa izinsolo zokuthi abasolwa bayathinteka.Phakathi kwazo, ubalule esikaConstable Sizwe Zungu, owaveza ukuthi yena wababona abasolwa ehostela emini ngaphambi kwesigameko nasebusuku, emva kwaso. Kulesi sitatimende, uZungu uveza ukuthi ummangalelwa wesibili, uMnuz Bongani Ntanzi, wangena egqoke ijakhethi emnyama enesigqoko ebusuku kodwa wabuye wayikhumula wafaka enye engomunye umbala.Uphinde wayamanisa isitatimende sokugonyuluka kwakhe uNtanzi, lapho eveza khona ukuthi wayenommangalelwa wesithathu nowesihlanu endaweni yesigameko."Lesi sitatimende sifakazelwa esikamakhelwane wakwaKhumalo, uNthabiseng (Phiri), othi wabona abantu abathathu abadlula begijima ngokwehlukana emva kokuqhuma kwesibhamu izikhawu kwaKhumalo, ngesikhathi ehleli nomngani wakhe emotweni ngaphesheya kwakaKhumalo ngesikhathi okwenzeka ngaso isigameko,” kusho uGininda.
AYALULAMA amaphoyisa amabili adutshulwe yilungu lomphakathi okuthiwa lizenze umuntu ofuna usizo emaphayiseni ase-Alexandra ngoLwesine.Kuthiwa lo msolwa oneminyaka engu-26 ubudala ufike esiteshini ekhala ngokuthi kukhona ofuna ukumbulala. INYUNYANA yabasebenzi bensimbi iNational Union of Metalworkers of South Africa (Numsa) isola abaphathi be-ArcelorMittal South Africa (Amsa) ngokuba nenhliziyo embi nokungabacabangeli abasebenzi ngoba le nkampani imemezele ukuthi izodiliza abasebenzi abawu-107.UNkk Phakamile Hlubi-Majola okhulumela iNumsa uthe njengoba kudilizwa abawu-107 manje bebesanda kuphothula olunye uhlelo lokudilizwa kwabasebenzi oluqale ngo-Agasti."Isikhulu esiphezulu sase-Amsa, uMnuz Kobus Verster silwa nabasebenzi. Basazise ngo-Agasti ukuthi bazovala ifemu yabo eyenza ama-Coke Battery okuwu-section 6 no-7. Asihambisani nokudilizwa kwabantu futhi nje wumqashi ongenandaba nabantu onquma ukubadiliza kuza uKhisimusi.”Uthe babona sengathi i-Amsa ayibanikezi yonke imininingwane ukuze bakwazi ukuza nesisombululo ekudilizweni kwabantu.Uveze ukuthi abasebenzi sebeyahlukunyezwa njengoba umqashi ebasusa ezindaweni abasebenzela kuzona ngoba umqashi ethi bangase babe nodlame.Uthe abasebenzi abathole izincwadi zokudilizwa bazogcina emsebenzini ngesonto lesibili kuDisemba.Ukhale ngokuthi i-Amsa ayifuni ukuvula ithuba lokuthi abafuna ukushesha bathathe umhlalaphansi basheshe bathole imali yabo kodwa idiliza abasebenzi abayizishoshovu.Uthe i-Amsa izobuye iphuce abasebenzi abawu-200 ophikweni lwayo olwenza insimbi imihlomulo yabo njengoba kuthiwa bazofakwa kweminye iminyango."Sikhathazekile ukuthi uma abasebenzi beyiswa kweminye iminyango kusho ukuthi nemiholo izoncipha. Umqashi akafuni ukusindlalela konke. Okwamanje sixoxa nabameli bethu ukuze sibone ukuthi sibhekana kanjani nale mpi ebhekiswe kubasebenzi,” kusho uNkk Hlubi-Majola.Uphethe ngokuthi bazoba nemihlangano nabasebenzi futhi bazoqhubeka nokubavikela.
USHONE le nale wangayiphendula ngqo imibuzo ebimcindezela ngokuthi kungani esawuNgqongqoshe wezoBulungiswa nokuThuthukiswa koMthethosisekelo, uNksz Thembi Simelane, ekubeni aboleka imali ebhange eselawa i-VBS.Le mibuzo ibivela kumalungu ePhalamende, abelokhu ebuzile ukuthi kungani esami phambi kwawo ekubeni ngabe ibhantshi selagcwala umoya?La malungu abefuna ukwazi ukuthi akaboni yini ukuthi kumele asule ngoba waba ngabanye babantu ababoleka imali kuleli bhange okwakulondolozwa kulona imali?Ilungu le-DA, u-Advocate Glynnis Breytenbach, libuze ukuthi usasiphethe kanjani lesi sikhundla ekubeni enza into efuze le?UNksz Simelane akazange amnike impendulo eqondile kodwa umane washaya ngezimfushane, wathi usayilungu lePhalamende.Nelungu le-MK ePhalamende, uMnuz Sibonelo Nomvalo, limbuze ukuthi ngabe ubona ukuthi lezi zinsolo ezibhekiswe kuyena zingezinye zezindlela zokuzama ukumsusa kwiKhabhinethi?Umane wathi: "Umbuzo omusha lo sihlalo, awuhlangene nombuzo wokuqala, ngakho ngeke ngiwuphendule,” kusho uNksz Simelane.Konke lokhu bekwenzeka ngesikhathi amalungu abebuza imibuzo kongqongqoshe abehlukene.Kunefu eligubuzele uNksz Simelane owaveza ukuthi waboleka u-R575 000 enkampanini iGundo Wealth Solutions, eyayisebenzisana nebhange i-VBS.Le mali wayisebenzisa ukuthenga indawo edayisa ikhofi, kanti usayikhokha yonke. UMnuz Makashule Gana weRise Mzansi, ubuze uNksz Simelane ukuthi ikuphi akwenzayo ukushintsha imicabango yabantu yokuthi isondo liyaphuza ukujika ezikhulwini zikahulumeni nakosopolitiki.Ephendula uthe umnyango wakhe uhlose ukuqinisekisa ukuthi uwonke wonke uyabuthola ubulungiswa.Ingcabha ikuMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, okunguye okumele anqume mayelana nekusasa likaNksz Simelane.UNksz Simelane wenza izethulo kuRamaphosa mayelana nodaba lokuboleka imali kule nkampani eyayisebenzisana ne-VBS.URamaphosa wathi usayicubungula ekaNksz Simelane, wathi uyolazisa izwe uma esethathe isinqumo mayelana nodaba lwakhe.Kwenzeka lokhu nje, ilokhu ikhula ingcindezi yokuthi akhonjwe indlela kulesi sikhundla ngenxa yokuthi wengamele umnyango obaluleke kakhulu ofaka uphiko lwezokushushisa kanjalo nezobulungiswa.
USELE nemibuzo engenazimpendulo umndeni kasomabhizinisi odumile KwaMashu nezindawo eziwakhele, uthola ngokubulawa kwakhe ngesihluku ngeSonto.Isidumbu sikaMnuz Mandla Sibaya (54) obedutshuliwe, kuthiwa sitholwe sigamanxe ngaphandle kwemoto yakhe ebishile ngaphakathi eBhambayi, eNanda, kwabikelwa amaphoyisa.Umufi ubengowakwa-N, KwaMashu, kanti ubenesitolo esidume iminyaka endaweni iMasakhane, aphinde adayisele ezinye izitolo amaqanda KwaMashu, Ntuzuma naseNanda.Kuthiwa esitolo sakhe ubenomuntu omdayisela khona bese kuthi ebhizinisini lamaqanda azibambele yena mathupha.Kuvela ukuthi kusukela ngeminyaka ka-2000 ubehamba phambili ezinhlakeni ezilwela amalungelo osomabhizinisi basemalokishini, aphinde abe umxhumanisi phakathi kwabo nezinhlaka zikahulumeni. Kuthiwa ubebuye alekelele bonke abasafufusa emabhizinisini ekutheni basimame.Udadewabo, uNkk Hlengiwe Sibaya-Mchunu, uthe namanje basenemibuzo kokubulawa kukamfowabo ngesihluku.Uthe izihlobo ziqale ukuqaphela ukuthi unyamalele ngoLwesihlanu emini ngesikhathi zingamtholi kumakhalekhukhwini."Kwathi kuhlwa, umndeni wawusukhathazekile ngokuthi ucingo lwakhe luvaliwe, okuyinto engajwayelekile, naye futhi engabonwa,” kusho uNkk Sibaya-Mchunu.Uthe baqala basabalalisa ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ukuthi bacela ukucingiswa, baya nasemaphoyiseni ukuyobika."NgeSonto, sithole ucingo emaphoyiseni aseNanda, ethi asiyobheka emakhazeni kahulumeni ePhoenix ngoba kukhona umuntu ongaziwa otholwe ebulewe emotweni eBhambayi. Sifike sathola ukuthi wuye ngempela,” usho kanje.Uthe namanje basazibuza ukuthi ubani lona obenenhloso yokumenzakalisa ngesihluku."Indlela abewusizo ngayo emphakathini, kosomabhizinisi nasesontweni. Wonke umuntu, omdala nomncane ubazi ukuthi uma eza kuye, uzoluthola usizo alufunayo. Simangele. Kuzo zonke izihlobo zethu, uyena muntu esasingakaze siphuphe ukuthi angahamba ngesandla somuntu,” usho kanje.Uthe ngisho nasebandleni, i-Methodist Church of Southern Africa, kusukela emncane ubephambili ezinhlakeni ezehlukene zebandla. Uthe ushona nje ubesanda kuqokwa njengeGosa leSekethe i-Ntuzuma-Verulam."Sinemibuzo eminingi ngokubulawa kwakhe. Siyazibuza ukuthi ingabe ubulawe ubani, ebangani naye?” kubeka uNkk Sibaya-Mchunu.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa aseNanda aphenya icala lokubulala kulandela ukutholwa kwesidumbu sikamufi ongaziwa sinenxeba lokudutshulwa emotweni ebisemfuleni.
IZIHLATHI zivakashela izindlebe kuMphathiswa wezokuThuthukiswa koMnotho, ezokuVakasha neMvelo KwaZulu-Natal, uMfundisi Musa Zondi emuva kokuthi izinkampani ezisebenzela kulesi sifundazwe zizotshala u-R76 billion.Lezi zindaba zivele engqungqutheleni yezinsuku ezimbili yohwebo ebihlelwe yiTrade and Investment KwaZulu-Natal, eNkosi Albert Luthuli International Convention Centre (ICC),eThekwini.UZondi uthe zimnandi lezi zindaba ngoba ngeke zigcine ngokuthuthukisa umnotho kodwa zizodala nenqwaba yamathuba omsebenzi, zithuthukise nobuchwepheshe.Izinkampani ezizibophezele ukufaka lo R76 billion emnothweni waKwaZulu-Natal zithe zizokwenza lokhu kule minyaka emibili ezayo.Phakathi kwazo kubalwa iSappi Southern Africa, Sortor Investments, Devmco Group, P&G Construction, Toyota South Africa, Tinley Leisure, Edison Property Group, Collins Residential, Natal Portland Cement, Moolman Group, Insimbi Ridge, Richards Bay Minerals, Defy, Edstan Group neGrowth Point.Bekukhona nenkampani ezokwakha imishini yokushaja izimoto ezihamba ngogesi ebizwa nge-Zero Carbon Charge."Lezi zinkampani zikhombisa ukuthi ziyasithemba futhi zizimisele ukufukula umnotho nokuthuthukisa impilo yabantu balesi sifundazwe. UHLASELWE wumphakathi wamgxoba ngamatshe waze wafa owesifazane okuthiwa unqume ingane eneminyaka emibili waphuza igazi layo eMkholombe, ePort Shepstone, ngoMsombuluko.Isidumbu sikaPhumelela Qhoboshiyane kuthiwa sitholwe sigxishwe ebhakedeni sihlukaniswe nekhanda emjondolo okuqashe kuwo umngani kamsolwa, okukholakala ukuthi bebesebenzisana ukugila lo mkhuba.Ingane kuthiwa ibidlala emnyango nomzala wayo oneminyaka emine ngesikhathi kufika owesifazane eyiheha ngokuthi uyomthengela ama-chips, wayibeletha wahamba nayo. Elandisa Isolezwe, uMnuz Nhlanhla Somhlaba osekomitini elilwa nobugebengu endaweni, uthe owesifazane amaziyo oqashe umjondolo khona endaweni, kuthiwa nguyena othumbe uPhumelela (ingane) wamdlulisela kumngani wakhe obevakashile. Kuvela ukuthi ubonwe womakhelwane elola ummese ngesikhathi esele endlini."Owesifazane othathe ingane uyaziwa endaweni njengoba ubesenesikhathi eqashe umjondolo kanti kuthiwa ungowase-Port Edward. Kuthiwa ingane uyidlulisele kumngani wakhe okuvela ukuthi ungowase-Eastern Cape, okuthiwa ubevakashile, okuwuyena otholwe nesidumbu,” usho kanje.Uthe ithumba liqhumbuke ngesikhathi omunye womakhelwane kulo mqasho ebona owesifazane oqashile engena nengane endlini. Kuthiwa uphumile, okuthe emva kwesikhathi kwaphuma umngani wakhe ovakashile wavala umnyango esegqoke ezinye izingubo abengazigqokile. Ebuzwa abebekhona, kuthiwa uthe useyahamba ubuyela kwelakubo. Indodakazi kamastende imbone egqoke izingubo zayo eyayizishiye endlini yabo, yamcela ukuthi azikhumule. Kuthiwa umsolwa ungene endlini wavala umnyango okuphoqe ukuthi indodakazi kamastende itibule iwuvule ngenkani. Kuthiwa izithele phezu kwegazi ebelisebhakedeni. Kuvela ukuthi ngesikhathi ebuzwa, uthe elikamnikazi wendlu amvakashele, ubephuphunyelwe yisisu, kukhona lapho asaphuthume khona. Kuthiwa indodakazi kamastende ibikele umakhelwane, okuthe bebuya igazi ebelisebhakedeni lingasekho. Uma bembuza kuthiwa uthe uliphuzile, nokuyilapho behlabe umkhosi beshaqekile, kwafika amalungu omphakathi athola ikhanda lengane emgodleni abewupakishele ukuhamba nawo. Kuthiwa ngesikhathi epequlula, aphinde athole isidumbu sengane esingenalo ikhanda sivalelwe ebhakedeni sambozwa ngengubo yokulala okuyilapho egxotshwe ngamatshe waze wafa. Unina omncane kaPhumelela, uNksz Thami Qhoboshiyane, uthe ingane iduke ngabo-10 ekuseni, kodwa kuthe ngabo-3 ntambama, bathola umbiko wokuthi kukhona isidumbu sengane esitholwe emiqashweni ebuqamama nalapho behlala khona."Ngesikhathi ngifika, amalungu omphakathi abeqhubeka nokushaya lo wesifazane. Ngikhonjiswe indlu enesidumbu sengane, ngithe uma ngingena ngazithela phezu kwekhanda libekwe ngasemnyango. Ngibone isidumbu sisesebhakedeni sisele ngentamo, okuyinto namanje okuthi uma ngiyicabanga ngifikelwe ukwesaba kakhulu,” usho kanje.Uthe ngesikhathi umsolwa eshaywa wumphakathi, uthe uthunywe izangoma ezikhona endaweni afe engakawavezi amagama azo. Kuthiwa ngesikhathi bemshaya uveze ukuthi noma bangambulala kodwa baningi endaweni abenza lo msebenzi.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa ase-Port Shepstone, aphenya icala lokubulala emva kokuthi owesifazane otholakale nezicubu zesidumbu sengane eshaywe wumphakathi waze wafa.

Manje siyalubona lolo shintsho.”UDlamini uthe umasipala uzobeka phambili olwengqalasizinda yamanzi.Umasipala unesabelomali sika-R1.5 billion, uDlamini uthe kulo nyaka babeke eceleni u-R703 million abazowusebenza ezinhlelweni zamanzi.UMNUZ Bhekinkosi Thwala uqokwe njengeMeya kaMasipala wasoPhongolo Isithombe: FACEBOOKOPhongolo kuqokwe uMnuz Bhekinkosi Thwala, naye obevele ebambe njengemeya.UThwala uthe muva nje oPhongolo izingane ezifunda esikoleni samabanga aphansi, iSimunye, ziphuthunyiswe esibhedlela emva kokuguliswa ukudla okunobuthi.UThwala uthe emva kwalesi sigameko bagasele ezitolo eziningi."Sifike savala inqwaba yezitolo zabokufika esithole ukuthi aziyilandeli imigomo. Sisazogasela nakwezinye izitolo eziphethwe abokufika, sibheke ukuthi azikho yini ezidayisa ukudla okunobuthi.”UThwala uqokelwe kulesikhundla emva kokushiya kukaNksz Velephi Sikhosana.UThwala uthe ukhathazekile ngokwanda kwezingozi emgwaqweni owuthelawayeka, uN2.Uthe iningi lalezi zingozi lidalwa imfuyo engaluswa, wanxusa abantu ukuba baqinisekise ukuthi imfuyo yabo ayibi uvanzi emgwaqweni.
UKUNUKA komlomo isimo esijwayelekile eseyamaniswa nokungaxubhi kodwa ongoti benhlanzeko yomlomo bathi kuyenzeka singadalwa ukuthi awuxubhi kodwa sidalwe ukudla okudlayo nezinye izimo.Ongoti bezempilo bathi ezinye izinto ezivame ukudala iphunga emlonyeni ngaphandle kokungaxubhi ukudla okuthile, umlomo owomile noma izimo zempilo kodwa akhona amakhambi abantu abangawazama ekhaya ngaphambi kokuya kodokotela.UDkt wamazinyo, uDkt Nompilo Ndwalane, uthe: " Abantu abaningi bahlala ibematasatasa, kuyenzeka bakhohlwe ukuxubha ngaphambi kokuyolala okuyiphutha elikhulu. Ukuxubha kususa kahle izinhlayiya zokudla ezinamathele emazinyweni nasonqenqemeni (plague). Lezo zinhlayiya zinomthelela ekwakhekeni kwamagciwane adala iphunga. Ukukhohlwa ukuxubha kungaholela ekutheni amagciwane emlonyeni ande, okuholela ekutheni umuntu ekuseni abe nephunga elibi,"Uqhube wathi okunye okudala ukunuka komlomo ulimu ngoba luyikhaya lamagciwane ngakho kubalulekile ukuthi umuntu avame ukuluhlanza.Uthe ukudla okungadala iphunga elibi kuvamise ukuthi kube u-anyanisi no-garlic okuvame ukudliwa ngabantu begwema izifo ezithile kodwa abanye abantu abaseduze naye bezwa iphunga elibi.Isifo sikashukela esidala ukungagayeki kukashukela egazini i-diabetes mellutus, i-sinusitis zingezinye zezifo ezidala ukunuka komlomo.Uthe ungasebenzisa izinsiza zokuhlanza ulimi noma i-cotton pad ene-glycerine ukuze uhlanze ulimu lwakho kahle. Lokhu akusizi nje ukugcina ulimu lwakho lunombala opinki onempilo kodwa futhi kunciphisa ukunqwabelana kwamagciwane emlonyeni.Amathiphu okuhlanza ulimu: Hlanza ulimu lwakho njalo ekuseni ngaphambi kokudla noma ukuphuza. Yiba mnene, gwema ukukhuhla ngamandla, ngoba lokhu kungalimaza ulimu lwakho. Gxila ngemuva kolimu lwakho lapho amagciwane ejwayele ukunqwabelana khona.I-Mint mouthwash: Bilisa amaqabunga e-mint emanzini, uwayeke aphole, futhi uyisebenzise njengokokugeza umlomo izikhathi eziningana ngosuku. I-Mint inezithako ezibulala amagciwane futhi ishiya ukunambitheka okuqabulayo emlonyeni.Ukugeza umlomo ngolamula noju : Hlanganisa ithisipuni loju nejusi kalamula emanzini afudumele. Ubumuncu bukalamula bunganciphisa umoya omubi, uju lunezinto ezilwa namagciwane.I-Eucalyptus oil mouthwash: Faka amaconsi angu-2-3 kawoyela we-eucalyptus engilazini yamanzi angagcwele bese uhahaza imizuzwana engu-30. Amafutha e-Eucalyptus aziwa ngokunciphisa amagciwane.Ukuphuza amanzi amaningi usuku lonke kugcina umlomo wakho umanzi futhi kunciphisa ukunqwabelana kwamagciwane adala iphunga.- Phuza amanzi njalo, ikakhulukazi ngemva kokudla.- Uma uzwa ukuthi umlomo wakho uyoma, thatha ingilazi yamanzi esikhundleni seziphuzo ezinoshukela noma ikhofi, okungase kuphazamise umlomo wakho owomile.Ukuhlafuna imbewu ye-fennel noma ama-cloves ngemva kokudla kungasiza ukuvuselela umoya wakho kuthuthukise ukugayeka kokudla. I-fennel iyakwazi ukulwa namagciwane kwesinye isikhathi okuyiwo adala ukunuka komlomo.Indlela yokusebenzisa imbewu ye-fennel ukuze uthole umoya unuke kahle: Hlafuna isipuni esincane sembewu ye-fennel ngemva kokudla. Ungakwazi futhi ukwenza itiye le-fennel ngokufaka imbewu emanzini ashisayo imizuzu embalwa bese uyiphuza ngemva kokudla.
INHLANGANO yabelaphi i-National Unitary Professional Association for African Traditional Health Practitioners of SA (NAPUTSA) ikhuza abelaphi baKwaMashu naseNtuzuma abalahla izilwane abebegeza ngazo abantu emifuleni yakule ndawo budedengu.Le nhlangano ithi umphakathi waKwaMashu naseNtuzuma owakhe eduze kwemifula nemihosha, ubabikele ukuthi awusakwazi ukusebenzisa imifula noma ukudlula kuyo ngoba ufica kunezinkukhu, izimbuzi namakhandlela ahlobonhlobo kuyo noma endleleni eseduze kwayo ugcine sewesaba ukuhamba ngoba awazi ukuthi kubekelweni. UMnuz Mlungisi Mlaba weNAPUTSA uthe kungukubeka impilo yomphakathi engcupheni ukushiya izilwane ezinezinalithi nezinye izikhali endleleni noma emfuleni obuye usetshenziwe umphakathi."Imifula isetshenziswa ngabalimi abatshala eduze kwayo abasebenzisa amanzi banisele izitshalo zabo, abanamatende bawageza khona. Eminye kunqamula kuyo abafundi nomphakathi. Uma silahla izilawane sithi umphakathi awenze njani ngoba usuke ususaba ukuwela ngoba uyazi ukuthi izinkukhu nezimbuzi ezimnyama ezokulahla ibhadi. Ingasaphathwa eyabahlala eduze kwale mifula ababulawa iphunga. Lo mkhuba uqale wakhuzwa emabhishi eThekwini, manje abelaphi sebewenza emifuleni esezindaweni ezihlala abantu," kukhuza uMlaba.Uthe umphakathi obabikele ohlala eduze komfula iGobhogobho eNtuzuma noseduze kwasesikoleni iSibonelo High KwaMashu. Uthe okunye okwenziwa abelaphi ukuthi bafake lezi zilwane kopulastiki abamnyama bazifake emigqomeni ethululwa ngabasebenzi bakamasipala nakho okuyingozi."Abelaphi abageza abantu banenkolelo yokuthi ibhadi ebelikhishwa kumele lithathwe ngomunye umuntu, ingakho izilwane zishiywa lapho kuzodlula khona abantu noma emigqomeni ezoqoqwa ngabantu. Siyinhlangano siyabafundisa ukuthi uma kudingeka ukuthi umuntu agezelwe endleleni okungenani umelaphi akambe umgodi agqibe eceleni kwayo indlela ngoba ukushiya izikhali nezilwane kuyingozi" kusho uMlaba.Uthe abakukhuthaza kakhulu ukuthi umelaphi abe nendawo kwakhe eyakhelwe ukugeza abantu ukuze kugwenywe ukuthi kube nemithi nezinye izinto ezilahlwa budedengu ezindaweni zomphakathi."Inkinga esibhekana nayo ukuthi abanye abelaphi abekho ngaphansi kwezinhlangano ngakho uma kufundiswa abelaphi basuke bengekho. Omunye umkhuba osudlangile owokuthi abelaphi bafake izilwane emadamini, bethi bakhunga abanikazi bamadamu (izinyoka). Lo mkhuba kasiwazi, musha ugcolisa amadamu amanye awo awamanzi asuke ezohlanzwa aphuzwe umphakathi," usho kanje.

UYeni kuthiwa ufe ngesandla sikazakwabo oyiphoyisa lesifazane okukholakala ukuthi udubule waqondisa ngalapho bekungakhona umufi nabanye ozakwabo ezitshela ukuthi bayahlaselwa emva kokuqhuma kokusabhomu lesandla.Umfowabo kamufi, uMnuz Mdu Yeni, ekhuluma kule nkonzo uthe umsolwa ufikile ukuzozendlala emndenini kodwa kwangaba kuhle kwazise into yokufa komfowabo abakayemukeli ngakho kufane nokuthi ubathunuka amanxeba asabhibha."Kubuhlungu kakhulu ukuthi ubulawe nguzakwabo. Siyile endaweni yesigameko ukuyoqhuba usiko. Ngeso lami lokungawazi umthetho, laphaya akubonisi ukuthi kukhona umuntu owayengakwazi ukubona omunye. Izindlu ziphezulu okusho ukuthi umuntu owenza umonakalo wayembona kahle. Babegqoke umfaniswano wamaphoyisa besemsebenzini,” usho kanje. Uthe omunye umbuzo abanawo ukuthi noma kwakuthiwa kwaba nento eqhumayo, kungani iphoyisa eliwufundele umthetho wesibhamu nomsebenzi walo ladubula sakuhlwayela, lingaboni ukuthi lidubula bani. UYeni uthe bafisa kusheshiswe uphenyo ukuze umndeni uthole izimpendulo, ukwazi ukuphola.Uveze ukuthi ngokuthola kwabo umsolwa umnkantshubomvu ekuphatheni nasekusetshenzisweni kwesibhamu njengoba kuthiwa usekhaleni lokuqeqeshwa kwamanye amaphoyisa ngokudubula.Uphiko oluphenya ngokuziphatha kwamaphoyisa, i-Independent Police Investigative Directorate, liqinisekise ukuthi lolu daba luyaluphenya.UYeni kuthiwa ubeseneminyaka ewu-20 esemaphoyiseni. Udubuleka nje kuthiwa amaphoyisa ayethole umbiko owawuwabizela esigamekweni okuvela ukuthi kwakunozenza ibhoklolo eshaya kabuhlungu intombi yakhe eyivalele endlini emqashweni khona eBhobhoyi. Kuthiwa abekomiti elibhekelele ukulwa nobugebengu endaweni babizwa bafika kodwa lo wesilisa owayengaphakathi nentombi wasonga ngokuthi akangene ngaphakathi ozizwayo, okwaphoqa ukuthi bajokole, okuyilapho kwabizwa khona amaphoyisa. Kulesi sigameko kwadubuleka nelinye iphoyisa elangeniswa esibhedlela liphuke ingalo. Ngokuthola kweSolezwe, endaweni yesigameko kwatholakala amagobondo ezinhlamvu zesibhamu esikhulu i-R5 awu-12. Kuthiwa ayeyisishiyagalombili amaphoyisa ayephuthume kule ndawo, okukhona kuwo amabili ophiko lwezinja.
OMASTENDE bakhala ngenkani yesele kwabokufika abaqashe ukuba badayisele emagcekeni abo eMgababa, ngesikhathi bebavalisa izitolo emuva kokuphuthunyiswa esibhedlela kwengane exinwe ukugula emuva kokudla ama-chips ewathenge kwesinye sazo. Ingane igule ngoMgqibelo, izitolo zavalwa ngeSonto. Kuvalwe izitolo ezingu-45 zabantu bokufika okuthiwa bagoloza ukuza emhlanganweni bezochaza ukuthi bayithengaphi impahla abadayisela umphakathi emuva kokugula kwengane edle ama-chips.Kuvela ukuthi kusuke udungunyane kule ndawo njengoba abantu bokufika bebengafuni zivalwe izitolo, baze babiza abaqaphi babo.Nokho kuvela ukuthi lugcine lugobile uphondo kubona zagcina zivaliwe izitolo zabo.Umzali wengane ocele ukuba kugodlwe igama lakhe, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi ingane yakhe igulile ngemuva kokudla ama-chips abewathenge esitolo sabokufika."Yebo, kwenzekile kuyiqiniso kodwa ngiyesaba ukukhuluma ngakho ngisabela impilo yami kwazise ngiwumuntu ohlala yedwa,'' usho kanjena.Kule ndawo kuvela ukuthi kunenhlangano ezibiza ngokuthi Bavukile Omasitende Tuckshops.Le nhlangano ngeyabanikazi bemizi baseMgababa kodwa abaqashisa abantu bokufika ukuze badayisele emagcekeni abo.Usihlalo wale nhlangano, uMnuz Nkululeko Vincent Ngobese, uthe bafinyelele kulesi sinqumo ngemuva kokuba sekuphele amasonto amabili benxusa ukuthi babe nomhlangano nalaba badayisi kodwa bengazihluphi."Besibabhalela izincwadi kodwa kumane kufane nje nokuthi siyadlala. Yingakho nje sibone kungcono ukuba simane sibangenele sibakhiphe ngemuva kokuba sekugule ingane,'' usho kanje.Uveze ukuthi kulo mhlangano ebebewucele ukuba nawo nabadayisi bebefuna ukuthola ukuchazeleka kabanzi ngokuthi lezi zinto abazidayisayo bazithenga kuphi njengoba zigulisa abantu nje."Angeke size sithule sigoqe izandla sibukele abantu bebulala umphakathi wethu. Ukuthi bayarenta kuthina akusho ukuthi sekumele sibatotose,'' usho kanje.Ukhale ngokuthi abantu bokufika banenkani yesele. "Wake wakuzwaphi ukuthi ugolezelwe umuntu egcekeni lakho? Uma umxosha ekutshele ukuthi yena akayi ndawo ngoba uyakukhokhela,'' usho kanje. Kuthiwa abokufika bakhokha irenti ephakathi kuka-R700 no-R2000.Uthe bona babeka eqhulwini ukuphepha komphakathi. "Mhlawumbe singaxoxa emva komhlangano uma bevuma ukuza kuwona ebese besitshela ukuthi zithathwa kuphi kanti lezi zinto abazidayisayo,'' usho kanjena.UNgobese uthe bathandazela ukuthi ingashoni ingane okuthiwa idle ama-chips.Kunabanye abantu basemphakathini ababalisa ngokuthi abasazi ukuthi bazothenga kuphi njengoba sekuvalwe izitolo zabokufika."Kubi lokhu abakwenzayo kokudayisela abantwana bethu izinto eziyingozi. Kodwa bekubalula ukuthenga kukhona bona ngoba besingekho isidingo sokuba sigibele siye eThekwini,'' kuchaza uMnuz Bhekithemba Mkhungo oyilungu lomphakathi.
ISUSE umsindo inkulumo kaNgqongqoshe wezobuChwepheshe nokuXhumana eZimbabwe, uTatenda Mavetera, yokuthi abengamele ama-group kaWhatsApp kumele bakhokhele amalayisensi abiza imali ephakathi kuka-$50 (R881) no-$2 500 (R44 065).Lesi simemezelo usenze ngesonto eledlule emcimbini. Uphinde wasishicilela ekhasini lakhe le-LinkedIn kwasuka ukukhuluma.NgeSonto ushaye ungqimphothwe wathi uyaziqhelelanisa nalezi zinkulumo. Uthe le mali abayifuni kwabangayiqoqi imininingwane yabanye ngenhloso yokwenza ibhizinisi."I-Personal Identifiable Information (PII) yinoma yiluphi ulwazi olungasetshenziswa ukuhlonza umuntu kusuka egameni lakhe, ikheli, inombolo yocuko, eye-passoirt nekamazisi," kusho uMavetera.Uthe akakaze asho ukuthi kuzohlawuliswa abengamele ama-group kaWhatsApp noma ezinye izinkundla abangayiqoqi imininingwane yokuhlonza abantu.UChipo Sibongile Mapungwana ubuze ukuthi kungani abantu kumele bakhokhele uWhatsApp ngoba akuwona okahulumeni? Ubuze nokuthi bazobathola kanjani abaphethe ama-group.UMukuru uthe ubone abantu bemtinyela manje useshaya ungqimphothwe.URoyal uthe ubeseqala ukukhathazeka.
KUPHOTHULIWE ukulalelwa kobufakazi ecaleni lephoyisa eligada umengameli elisolwa ngokudubula libulale owayekade encike emotweni yalo eMolweni, eThekwini.INkantolo yesiFunda yasePinetown isonge ngokuthi ilalele ubufakazi bukamsolwa, uSergenat Sibonelo Christopher Shabangu.Usolwa ngokubulala uMnuz Qaphela Mdima ngaphandle kwendawo yobumnandi eCasablanca Lifestyle, ngoNovemba 2022.UShabangu ugcizelele ukuthi waba nengxabano eyaqalwa wukuthi wacela umufi anganciki emotweni yakhe."Umufi wakhuluma ukweyisa futhi edelela. Saxabana ngendlela yokuthi kwashoda umuntu owayezogadla kuqala,” kusho uShabangu.Usho lokhu nje, ubesebhokisini lofakazi, ekhulumela phansi, elalelwe abesilisa afike nabo enkantolo kukhona nomfowabo kamufi nabezokweseka umndeni wakhe.UShabangu obebukeka ezikhululekele, uthe wayezivikela ngoba ebona impilo yakhe isengcupheni edubula umufi ayeqhelelene naye ngebanga elingu-12 wamamitha.Uthe wafayela izinhlamvu ebhekise kumufi esebaleka futhi ethukile ngesibhamu somsebenzi esasilayisha izinhlamvu ezingu-17.Umbiko kadokotela owahlola isidumbu futhi owafakaza enkantolo, uthe umufi wadutshulwa kanye esifubeni ngasenhliziyweni, kabili ngemuva emilenzeni nasezinqeni.UShabangu uthe wayesazoqhubeka adubule ukube aziphelanga izinhlamu esibhamini ayesiphethe."Ngaqale ngokuthi ngidubule kabili ngibhekise kumufi ngimxwayisa eza kumina, emva kokuthi sihlukanisiwe abantu abahamba naye waphulukundlela wabuya. Ngangisaba ngithi uphethe isibhamu engingasibonanga ngoba sasingasuki okhalweni isandla sakhe sixabana,” kusho uShabangu.Namuhla, inkantolo izolalela izethulo zokugcina ngaphambi kokuthi ikhiphe isinqumo sokuthi iyamlahla noma imkhipha phambili ecaleni uShabangu.Imantshi ithe vele uShabangu uzivumele ngokwakhe nguye owadubula umufi, umbuzo okumele uphendulwe owokuthi kwakufanelekile yini akwenza kumufi?Ibikade iqale yabuza uShabangu ukuthi ngesikhathi ebona ukuthi kunengxabano phakathi kwakhe nomufi, kungani engangenanga emotweni wahamba?Akacacisanga ngaphandle kokuthi wayezitshela ukuthi isiphelile ingxabano umufi esuswa abantu eduzane kwakhe.
BAKHALA ngokuxhaphaka kwezibhamu endaweni kudutshulwa kubulawa isaguga ebese singasenamandla nendodakazi ekhubazekile eNgonyameni, eLoskop, eMtshezi, ngoMgqibelo.Kulesi sigameko kushone uNkk Lindeni Mpembe (82) nendodakazi yakhe, uNksz Thangithini Ntshalintshali (59).Ngokusho kwendodana kaNkk Mpembe, uMnuz Nele Mpembe, abafi bahlaselwe wumsolwa ongaziwa ngabo-6.45 ebusuku.Uthe ngesikhathi behlaselwa bebehleli egumbini lokuphumula, bebuka ithelevishini."Kuthiwa kungene umuntu ongaziwa, obefake ikepisi nesifonyo. Waqale wadubula phezulu, izingane zabaleka. Wabe esedubula umama. Kuthiwa uphumele emnyango isikhashana, waphinde wabuya esezodubula udadewethu,” kusho uMpembe.Uthe phakathi kwezingane ebezikhona kukhona neneminyaka eyisithupha efunda uGrade 1 nenye eneminyaka engu-15.Udalule ukuthi batshelwe isihlobo ebesisocingweni noNksz Ntshalintshali ngesikhathi kwenzeka isigameko ukuthi abaphuthume ekhaya kuyonakala.UNKSZ Thangithini Ntshalintshali"Isihlobo sethu sisishayele ngokuphazima kweso, sithi asiphuthume ekhaya ngoba umama nodadewethu ngathi bayahlaselwa. Sisitshele ukuthi besixoxa nodadewethu njengenjwayelo ngesikhathi sizwa sekuqhuma isibhamu, sase sizwa bekhala, maqede kwathi nyampu ucingo,” kusho uMpembe.Uthe bathe beqambe befika ekhaya bese konakele."Sisadidekile ukuthi ubani ongaba nenxa nogogo osephuma ekhaya kuphela uma eyolanda amaphilisi akhe okugula ngenxa yobudala, aphinde aphume uma eyohola impesheni. Nodadewethu ubephila nokukhubazeka, ehamba kanzima, naye asiboni ukuthi yisiphi isitha obekungathiwa unaso,” kusho uMpembe.Ukhale ngezibhamu ezithe chithi saka endaweni nezigameko zokubulawa kwabantu ngesihluku."Zolo lokhu, kade kuhlaselwe abantu abayisihlanu, bezidlela inyama emcimbini, badutshulwa, babulawa. Ziningi izibhamu ezigcwele kule ndawo okubulawa ngazo abantu,” usho kanje.Esinye isihlobo esicele ukungadalulwa, sikhale ngamaphoyisa esiteshi, Amangwe esithe awasebenzi, alibala ukuphuza utshwala nezigebengu nezidakwa zendawo.Ikhansela lendawo, uMnuz Mvikeleni Kubheka, likufakazele ukwanda kwezibhamu nokubulawa kwabantu endaweni."Kusuka ngo-2019, zevile ku-300 izigameko zokubulawa kwabantu. Abantu bahlaselwa emakhaya emini kwabha, kokunye bahlaselwe uma kuhwalala, behleli bedla noma bebuka amathelevishini,” kusho uKubheka.Ukhale ngombango wobukhosi endaweni namaphoyisa angenele kanjalo nezinsiza kusebenza, wathi uma kungalungiswa konke lokhu, hleze bungancipha ubugebengu bokubulawa kwabantu endaweni.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa asesiteshini Amangwe aphenya amacala amabili okubulala kulandela isigameko sokudutshulwa kubulawe abesifazane ababili, oneminyaka engu-59 nonengu-82."Badutshulwe umsolwa ongaziwa eNgonyameni, eLoskop ngoMgqibelo,” kusho uNetshiunda.Uthe ngokwemibiko etholwe amaphoyisa, abafi bebezihlalele bezibukela ithelevishini nezinye izihlobo ngesikhathi umsolwa engena ngomnyango obungakhiyiwe."Umsolwa obegqoke isifonyo ukuzifihla ubuso, uvulele ngenhlamvu kubagilwa, waphuma waya emnyango, waphinde wabuya, waghubeka nokubadubula,” kusho uNetshiunda.Uthe abagilwa bahlonzwe njengabashonele endaweni yesigameko, wathi imbangela yokubulala ayikakaziwa, kanti amaphoyisa asathungatha umsolwa.
ULALA obenyoni umndeni wekhansela lakuMasipala waseMngeni, uMnuz Nhlalayenza Ndlovu, eladutshulwa labulawa ngonyaka owedlule.Umndeni usuze washiya ikhaya lawo okwabulawelwa kulo uNdlovu ngenxa yokwesaba.Lokhu kuvezwe umphenyi wenhlangano, i-Afri-Forum, uMnuz Andrew Leask, ojutshwe ukuba alandele icala lokubulawa kukaNdlovu.UNdlovu wabulawa phambi komndeni wakhe."Namanje basakhathazekile kakhulu ngokuphepha kwabo. Baze baphoqeleka ukuba bathole enye indawo yokuhlala. Nakuba sesenze izicelo eziningi zokuba umndeni uhlinzekwe ngezokuphepha, ayikho impendulo eqondile esiyitholile.”ULeask ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba ngaphandle kweNkantolo kaMantshi eHowick, ngoLwesihlanu.Umsolwa oboshelwe leli cala, uMnuz Thobane Masobho Hlongwa, uvele kule nkantolo ngalo uLwesihlanu.Icala lakhe lihlehliselwe uNovemba 25, njengoba kusaqhubeka uphenyo.ULeask uthe umndeni ukhathazekile ngokungaboshwa kukangqondongqondo ecaleni lokubulawa kukaNdlovu.Kusaboshwe uHlongwa kuphela kuleli cala, akukacaci ukuthi wabamba liphi iqhaza ekubulaweni kukaNdlovu.Ngesikhathi uHlongwa egcina ukuvela enkantolo, uMbuso wawuveze ukuthi kukhona abanye abasolwa abasazoboshwa.ULeask uthe kubukeka uphenyo luhamba ngolonwabu."Njengamanje sibona sengathi basabamba ofishi abancane, abakafiki kungqondongqondo. Ukungaboshwa kwabanye abasolwa kuyasikhathaza. Nanamhlanje umsolwa uvele yedwa. Siyazibuza ukuthi ngabe bakuphi laba abanye ayesebenzisana nabo? "Okukhathaza kakhulu ukuthi kubathathe isikhathi eside ukuthi babophe kwasayena lona oboshiwe njengamanje. Cishe kubathathe unyaka wonke ukuba babophe lona oyedwa oboshiwe. Asazi ukuthi kubambephi ngempela.”ULeask uthe kunemikhondo eminingi amaphoyisa angafuni ukuyilandela."Izinhloli zahlonza enye induna yesigodi njengongqondongqondo kuleli cala kodwa kuze kube manje leyo nduna ayikaze iboshwe. Sesize sabhalela nanoNgqongqoshe wezamaPhoyisa, kodwa naye akasiphenduli.”UNdlovu kukholakala ukuthi wabulawela ukulwa nokwebiwa kwempahla kagesi yomkhandlu. Le mpahla kagesi okubalwa kuyo nama-transformer, kuthiwa yayidayiselwa imiphakathi.Amalungu e-DA abegcwele enkantolo ngesikhathi kulalelwe icala.
KUVUSELELWE uhlelo iVirtual Remand System (VRS) lokuba iziboshwa ezitokile futhi ezihlehliselwa amacala, zivele ezinkantolo kusetshenziswa ubuchwepheshe besimanje ekubeni zona zisaboshiwe.UNkk Thembi Simelane onguNgqongqoshe wezobuLungiswa nokuThuthukiswa koMthethosisekelo ubeseNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini ngoLwesihlanu eyohlola ukusebenza kwalolu hlelo.Ubephelezelwe yiphini lakhe uMnuz Andries Nel, iNhloko yamaJaji KwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Thoba Portia Poyo-Dlwati, aboMnyango wezokuHlunyeleliswa kweziMilo kanye nowamaPhoyisa.Luyavuselelwa lolu hlelo lokuba iziboshwa zixhumane nenkantolo kusetshenziswa ithelevishini kule nkantolo.Umnyango uthe esikhathini esidlule inkantolo ibe nenkinga nezokuxhumana okwenze yasilela emuva ekusebenzeni kwalolu hlelo.UNkk Simelane uze wahlala phansi enkantolo, walalela amanye amacala eziboshwa ebezivela kwithelevishini yenkantolo ekubeni zisejele eWestville.Ubalule ukuthi uhlelo lusiza uma kuzohlehliswa namacala athinta ubugebengu eziboshwa ezitokile."Lusiza ekutheni kungabi khona ukweqa kweziboshwa uma sezisezinkantolo noma zisendleleni eya khona noma zibuya khona. Lulekelela nasekutheni isiboshwa esisuke siye enkantolo singakwazi ukushushimbisa izikhali nezinto ezingavumelekile ukuba siziphathe uma sesisezitokisini,” kusho ungqongqoshe.Luvele luyasebenza lolu hlelo kwezinye izinkantolo eziningi KwaZulu-Natal.Kuvele ukuthi asengu-169 amacala alalelwe kusetshenziswa uhlelo eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini. IZINHLAKA zikahulumeni eziqinisekisa ukuthi umphakathi udla ukudla okuphephile okusezingeni eliyilo zehlulekile ukwenza umsebenzi wazo.Lokhu kushiwo izishoshovu zomphakathi kulandela izigameko zezingane ezigule ngemuva kokudla ukudla okunobuthi okuthengwe ezitolo zabantu bokufika kuleli.Emasontweni amahlanu kufe izingane ezingu-11 zibulawa ukudla ukudla okunobuthi iningi lakho okungama-snacks athengwe ezitolo zabokufika.UNksz Busi Seabe oyisishoshovu esibhekelele impilo nenhlalakahle yomphakathi, uthe izinhlaka zikahulumeni ezifana noMnyango wezeMpilo, Consumer Commission ne-South African Bereau of Standards (SABS) zehlulekile ukwenza umsebenzi wazo."Lezi zinhlaka zazisungulelwe ukuthi ziqiniseke ukuthi yonke imikhiqizo esetshenziswa umphakathi iphephile, abekho oqhibukhowe bemikhiqizo esabalele ezweni lonke engaziwa ukuthi ikhiqizwa ngobani, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kuba nabahloli abahlola izitolo ukuthi zilandela yonke imigomo ebekiwe. Lesi simo esibhekene naso manje sisitshela ukuthi lezi zinhlaka zehlulekile. Kungani sinemikhiqizo eqhamuka emazweni athile eminye ekhiqizwa khona lapha kwelakithi engahloliwe kube kunezinhlaka zikahulumeni ezibheke lokho? Zenzani lezi zinhlaka?" kubuza uNksz Seabe.Uqhube wathi ukube lezi zinhlaka ziyawenza umsebenzi wazo ngabe imikhiqizo eyingozi ayifinyeleli ezitolo, iyabanjwa. Uthe njengamanje iningi labantu lithi kumele iNingizimu Afrika imenyezelwe njengezwe elibhekene nenhlekelele noma kuvalwe zonke izitolo eziseduze.UMnuz Bongani Mdluli naye oyisishoshovu samalungelo abantu eSoweto, uthe ngesikhathi kuhlolwa izitolo eSoweto, kutholakale imithi yokwelapha okumele ngabe itholakala emakhemisi kuphela idayisa kuzo lezi zitolo."Akucaci ukuthi lezi zitolo zigunyazwe ngubani ukuthi zidayise imithi esezigabeni ephezulu netholakala emakhemisi kuphela. Ngicabanga ukuthi nomphakathi kumele ufundiswe ukuthi kunemithi ongeke uyithenge ezitolo oyithola ekhemisi kuphelam," kusho yena.UDkt Mvuyisi Mzukwa owusihlalo wehlangano yodokotela, i-South African Medical Association (SAMA), uthe inkinga yemithi edayisa ezipaza isezweni lonke."Kule mithi kukhona nengeyona, esiyonakele, egcinwe ngendlela engafanele, ukuyisebenzisa okungabeka engcupheni impilo yabantu. Abantu abangaqeqeshelwe ukuphatha imithi badayisa imithi. Siyejabula ukuthi isikhungo esilawula ukusetshenziswa kwemithi kuleli sesithintiwe ngemithi etholakele kodwa sithi uhlelo lokuhlola alwenziwe ezweni lonke. UMnyango wezeMpilo nezinhlaka ezifanele aziphakamise izinyawo ukuze kunqandwe ingozi,” kusho uMzukwa.
IBHEKENE nengwadla intsha ekwezemidlalo ezindaweni zasemakhaya ngenxa yombani wezulu ophazamisa imidlalo yokuhlungela amaSalga Games azoba ngoDisemba kwaZulu-Natal.Lokhu kuvele njengoba komasipala abaningi kunemidlalo yokuhlunga ebingeSonto emini.Kuze kwaphoqeleka ukuthi kuncishizwe izikhathi zokudlala eHluhluwe Primary ngaphansi koMkhanyakude ukuze kubalekelwe izulu ebese liqalile lihloma.USne Mdluli obeyingxenye yababukeli nabathandi beNetball, uthe iyabakhathaza indaba yaleli zulu ngoba umbani wakhona ushiya izidumbu."Ngikhuluma nawe nje uma like lahloma sonke sishawa uvalo futhi thina esithanda ezemidlalo siba senkingeni ngoba eminye igcina isihoxisiwe njengoba liduma kabi kuthi awuqede abantu. Ngikhulima nawe nje sisathuswe umfundi waseMgungundlovu eHilton College obeyodoba nabangani bakhe elimshaye washona, muva nje," kubalisa uNksz Mdluli.IMeya kamasipala waseBig 5 Hlabisa, uMnuz Comfort Khumalo ithe, bakhathazekile njengoba izikhathi sebevele bazinciphisa ukuze kusheshe kuqedwe uma kudlalwa."Uyabona nje kuNetball bekubekwe imizuzu engu-30 kodwa sisehlisile isikhathi sabeka imizuzu engu-15 ngapha nangapha, ngoba sibona ukuthi leli zulu lizosifica lapha nezingane zabantu zilimale. Le midlalo ibalulekile ngoba ihlungela iqembu esizolikhanda liyosimela esiFundeni uMkhanyakude kuze kufikwe kumqhudelwano wokuvala unyaka wamaSalga ozoba ngoDisemba," kusho uKhumalo.Uthe bazama nokuthi ezindaweni eziningi kube nezikhonkwane kodwa ngenxa yesimo banxusa umphakathi ukuthi uhlome ngazo zonke izindlela nangemithi yezinyanga yokuphebeza izulu ngoba isimo sibi.Ngesonto eledlule abakwaSouth African Weather Service baxwayise ngokuthi lizoba libi izulu kuze kufike esigabeni esiyingozi.Kuleso sigaba kuthe uma lifika lashiya kukhalwa njengoba lihlasele umndeni wakwaMkhize, eMooi River kwashona owesilisa obeneminyaka engu-37 kwasinda ingane nonina abasale benamanxeba amabi okusha.
I-ANC KwaZulu-Natal izoqala umkhankaso wokunxenxa abantu ukuba bangayithengi impahla engekho emthethweni ezipaza njengoba zanda izigameko zokushona nokugula kwezingane ezidle okunobuthi.I-ANC esifundazweni isiyalele wonke amakhansela ayo ukuba abize imihlangano yomphakathi lapho kuzonxenxwa khona abantu ukuthi bayeke ukuthenga impahla ewumbombayi.Lesi sinyathelo se-ANC KwaZulu-Natal siza emva kokuthi uNobhala Jikelele wale nhlangano, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, eyalele uhulumeni kazwelonke ukuba avale zonke izipaza, bese ziqala phansi ukubhalisa.Lokhu uMbalula ukusho ngesikhathi ehola umbikisho ePitoli, ngoLwesihlanu.Zidla lubi izigameko zokufa nokugula kwezingane ezidle okunobuthi.Lezi zigameko zande kakhulu eGoli, lapho kubikwa ukuthi sekushone izingane ezibalelwa ku-12.Izigameko ezisabikiwe lapha KwaZulu-Natal, kubalwa esokugula kwabafundi abangu-43 besikole iNgaqa Primary, eMtubatuba, nesokugula kwabafundi abayisikhombisa basesikoleni iBongucele Secondary, eMthwalume.UNobhala we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Bheki Mtolo, uthe bayahambisana nombono kaMbulula."Ikakhulukazi lona wokuthi izipaza zivalwe zonke, bese ziqala phansi zibhalise. Lokhu kuzokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi abantu abadayisayo bakufanele ukwenza lo msebenzi. Sifuna nokuthi kuqiniswe imithetho elawula izipaza.”UMtolo uthe sebeyalele zonke izimeya zemikhandlu ephethwe i-ANC ukuba zenze isiqiniseko sokuthi omasipala baqhuba imikhankaso yokuqinisekisa ukuthi abanikazi bezipaza bayayilandela imigomo."Abaholi be-ANC abajutshwe komasipala bazogasela kungazelele ezitolo lapho bezofike bahlole ukuthi imithetho iyalandelwa yini.”UMtolo uthe bayalele usihlalo wekomiti elibhekelele ukusebenza koMnyango wezokuThuthukiswa koMnotho esiShayamthetho, uMnuz Mafika Mndebele, ukuba aqinisekise ukuvikelwa kwabathengi."Sifuna abathengi bavikeleke, bangadayiselwa ukudla okuwumbombayi nokubolile.”UMtolo uthe bafuna nokuthi abaPhathiswa be-ANC KwaZulu-Natal babe ingxenye yomkhankaso.Uthe bafuna ukuthi uMphathiswa wezeMfundo, uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka, aqinisekise ukuthi labo abadayisela abafundi bayayilandela imithetho.UMtolo uthe bafuna ukuthi uMphathiswa wezeMpilo, uNksz Nomagugu Simelane, aqhube imikhankaso yokuxwayisa abantu abantu ezikhungweni zempilo.Uthe bafuna ukuthi uMphathiswa wezokuThutha, uMnuz Siboniso Duma, aqinisekise ukuthi kuba nezivimbamgwaqo ezizonqanda ukuthuthwa kwempahla ewumbombayi.
UNOBHALA Jikelele we-MK osanda kuqokwa, uMnuz Floyd Shivambu, usecula iculo elihlukile ngomholi wale nhlangano, uMnuz Jacob Zuma.UShivambu ongomunye wabantu ababegxeka uZuma ngesikhathi esaphethe izwe, uthe wadukiswa ukuba azonde uZuma. Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi enengxoxo ekhethekile neSABC, izolo.Osukwini lwayizolo uShivambu umenyezelwe njengoNobhala Jikelele we-MK. Uthatha isikhundla esishiywe nguDkt Sifiso Maseko, obuyele emsebenzini eMnyangweni wezeMpilo eGauteng.UMaseko ubekade emisiwe kulo msebenzi ngenxa yophenyo lwezinsolo zokubhubhudlwa kwemali yokuthengwa kwezinsiza zokulwa nokusabalala kobhubhane iCorona.Ngesikhathi uShivambu eseyilungu le-EFF, ubehlezi egxeka ubuholi bukaZuma kepha izolo, uShivambu uveze ukuthi wayesagcwele inkungu emehlweni ngesikhathi egxeka uZuma."Kunabantu abathile ababephume umkhankaso wokungcolisa igama likaZuma. Thina sasuke sakholwa ilabo bantu, sase zizonda uZuma.”UShivambu ubalule abezindaba nowayenguMvikeli woMphakathi, u-Advocate Thuli Madonsela, njengabantu abenza ukuthi uZuma azondelwe ubala."Ikakhulukazi uma uzobuka u-Advocate Madonsela. Izinto azenzayo njengamanje zenza sibone ukuthi wayephume umkhankaso wokungcolisa igama likaZuma.”UShivambu uthe lokhu akakusho ngoba nakhu eseyilungu le-MK."Kade ngaqala ukukusho ukuthi sadukiswa. Le nto ngaqala ukuyisho ngisekwi-EFF.”UShivambu ungowesine ukubamba isikhundla sikaNobhala Jikelele kwi-MK esikhathini esingaphansi konyaka kusukela uZuma amemezela ukuthi uzovotela le nhlangano.Ngaphambili, lesi sikhundla sasiphethwe oyilungu lePhalamende njengamanje, uMnuz Sihle Ngubane, owalandelwa uMnuz Arthur Zwane.UShivambu uthe akanalo uvalo lokuthi angase angahlali isikhathi eside kusona isikhundla."UZuma uyayazi into ayenzayo. Akavele nje avuke ekuseni, bese enza izinguquko ebuholini. Kusuke kunesizathu esiholela ekutheni enze izinguquko.”Kusukela uShivambu ajoyina i-MK ngo-Agasti, baningi abaholi be-EFF abamlandelile okubalwa kubo owayengusihlalo we-EFF, u-Advocate Dali Mpofu nababengamalungu ePhalamende, uMnuz Mzwanele Manyi no-Advocate Busisiwe Mkhwebane.UShivambu uthe akekho embidlangweni wokunxenxa abaholi be-EFF ukuba bajoyine i-MK, kodwa wathi uzobamukela ngezandla ezimhlophe uma benquma ukujoyina."Mina abantu engabanxenxa ukuba bajoyine i-MK abantu abavotayo. Uma kuwukuthi abaholi bamanye amaqembu nabo bafuna ukujoyina, angeke ngibavimbe.”
NKOSIKHONA CELEAMALUNGU ekhwaya laseZayoni eliqokelwe kumaCrown Gospel Awards, Abantwana Bezithunywa, akholwa ukuthi ukuba nomyalezo kwezingoma zawo yikhona okuholele ekutheni aqokwe kulezi zindondo.Lokhu kudalulwe ngumholi wekhwaya, uSabelo Qiniso Khumalo odume kakhulu ngeleSikhiye Sasejele.Le khwaya iqokwe emunxeni weBest Zion Album. Abafisa ukubavotela bangathumela umqhafazo othi: Crown 23 kwinombolo ethi: 34069. Isihloko se-Album abaqokwe ngayo sithi Abafileyo Bayovuswa.UKhumalo uthe lokhu kusho lukhulu kubona ngomculo wabo. Uthe futhi kubanikeza umdlandla omkhulu wokuthi baqhubeke nokusebenza ngokuzikhandla emculweni wabo ngaso sonke isikhathi."Siyabonga kakhulu ukuthi siqokwe nathi sibe yingxenye yamaCrown akulo nyaka. Lokhu ngikholwa ukuthi kuzowanikeza ugqozi olukhulu lokuqhubeka nokusebenza amalungu aleli khwaya,'' usho kanje.Ugcizelele kakhulu ukuthi bakholelwa kakhulu kuhlobo lomculo olushiya umyalezo kuloyo muntu osuke elalele ngaleso sikhathi.Uveze ukuthi i-albhamu yabo abaqokwe ngayo inezingoma ezingu-14 ezahlukene futhi uthe igxile kakhulu ekududuzeni abasanezilonda ezibhibhayo ngokushiywa yizihlobo zabo.UKhumalo ube esechaza kabanzi ngokuthi sisho ukuthi lesi sihloko."Uma sithi abafileyo bayovuswa sihlose ukukhumbuza labo abasaphatheke kabi ngokushiywa yizihlobo zabo ukuthi nakanjani uma sekukhala icilongo bayovuswa nabathandiweyo babo,'' usho kanje.Uveze ukuthi le yi-albhamu yabo yesibili njengoba eyokuqala uthe yayisihloko sithi Ungambulali Uzomdinga.Unxuse bonke abathandi bomculo, kungakhathaleki ukuthi abaluphi uhlobo, ukuba babavotele ukuze bezonqoba nakanjani.
Inkinga yamanzi eGoli iphazamise ukulalelwa kwamacala eNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo kusuka kuqala uNovemba 1.Lokhu kuvezwe yiHhovisi leNhloko yamaJaji elithe kusuka kuqale uNovemba abakwazi ukulalela bukhoma amacala ngenxa yenkinga yokuphakelwa kwamanzi enkantolo."Imbangela yalokhu kuhlupha kokuphakelwa kwamanzi ayaziwa yize kubukeka sengathi iyinkinga eseHillbrow lapho inkantolo ikhona. Kutholwe nokuthi kunamanzi avuzayo enkantolo nokuphinde kuthikameze ukuphakelwa kwamanzi,” kusho ihhovisi leNhloko yamaJaji.Lithe u-plumber othunyelwe wuMnyango wemiSebenzi yoMphakathi neNgqalasizinda noMnyango wezobuLungiswa ngokuThuthukiswa koMthethosisekelo ukulungisile ukuvuza."Yize inkantolo inethangi lasezindlini zangasese kodwa lokho kwanele usuku olulodwa kanti uMasipala waseGoli awukwazi ukuligcwalisa ngokushesha nsukuzonke ukuze inkantolo isebenze ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka.
