IYINZUKAZIKEYI indaba yezigameko zezingane ezidle ukudla okunobuthi zagula muva nje.Umphakathi usola uhulumeni ngokudedela abantu bangaphandle ukuthi bavule izitolo badayise ukudla, okusolwa ukuthi yikho okunobuthi obugulisa abantu ikakhukazi izingane. Ngaphezu kwalokho usolwa ngokuthi awulwenzi uhlelo lokuhlola ukuthi izitolo ziyayilandela yini imigomo. Uhulumeni ngakolunye uhlangothi uyavuma ukuthi imithetho alawula ama-Tuckshop ayikho yize ikhona eminye imithetho. Ukhomba umphakathi, uthi unamandla okukhetha ukungathengi ezitolo uma usola ukuthi zidayisa ukudla osekonakele noma okunobuthi. Abazali kuthiwa yibo ababeka izingane engcupheni ngokuzinika imali yokuthenga. Amaqembu ezepolitiki athi uhulumeni akaqhamuke nesu elizonqanda le nkinga. Usoseshini wezitolo eziseduze nabantu iSpaza and Tuckshop Association, uthi abanikazi bezitolo bangaphandle bathenga ukudla okungombombayi okukhiqizwa ezindaweni ezingafanele okufana nokukhiqizwa yizinkampani ezinkulu ezikuleli.UMnuz Sibusiso Ngcobo weSpaza and Tuckshop Association, uthe lo soseshini uqale ukubona izinkinga emkhakheni wokudayisa ezitolo eziseduze ngo-2016. Ngaleso sikhathi bebebona abangaphandle abanezitolo bedayisa imikhiqizo efana neyabo ngemali encane.Uthe bekulokhu kuthiwa osomabhizinisi bangaphandle bathenga ngokuhlanganyela ema-wholesale kanti akunjalo, bathenga ezindaweni ezaziwa yibo kuphela ezizikhiqizela imikhiqizo yakuleli ngokungemthetho."Akuwona ama-snacks kuphela yonke into ongayicabanga. Besikhuluma nohulumeni ngalokhu kunganakwa manje sekuvele obala. Ama-snacks okusuke kuthiwa agulise izingane anamagama afana nakhiqizwa kuleli kodwa agulisa izingane asuke ethengwe ezitolo zabokufika okuchaza kona ukuthi kusuke kungewona awangempela kufana iphepha nokubukeka kwawo kodwa bona bazakhele awabo,” kusho uNgcobo.Uthe okunye abakutholile ukuthi iningi lalabo somabhizinisi alinawo amaphepha okuba kuleli, kodwa kuyenzeka izitolo eziyisithupha zisebenzise iphepha elilodwa lokuhweba.Emasontweni amahlanu kuleli kufe izingane ezingu-11 zibulawa ukudla okunobuthi. Kuzo ezingu-10 ezaseGauteng eyodwa e-Eastern Cape. KwaZulu-Natal nakhona zikhona izigameko zezingane eziphuthunyiswe ezikhungweni zezempilo ngemuva kokudla ama-snacks ahlukene kodwa ayikho eshonile. Ezigamekweni eziningi kubalwa ukuthi izingane zidle ama-snacks, uswidi namabhisikidi. Inqwaba yabafundi iphuthunyiswe ezikhungweni zezempilo ezehlukene ezifundazweni ezehlukene okuyiGauteng, KwaZulu-Natal, Free State ,iMpumalanga neLimpopo. Isikhungo esibhekele ukuphepha i-Institute of Security Studies, ocwaningweni lwayo mayelana nokudla okunobuthi lwanyakenye kuvele ukuthi kubantu abangu-100 000, bangu-43 ababulawa ukudla okunobuthi kuleli ngonyaka. Umbiko kaNgqongqoshe wezeMpilo, uDkt Aaron Motsoaledi uveza ukuthi izingane eziyisithupha ezife ngemuva kokudla ama-chips eNaledi, zibulawe i-organophosphate okuyikhemikhali etholakala kwizibulali magciwane. Eminye imibiko iveza ukuthi nyakenye kuvele ukuthi ezinye izingane zibulawe umuthi oyimpushana obulala amagundane i-halephirimi eyaziwa ngojuqu, owavalwa kuleli, kodwa osetshenziswa kwamanye amazwe angomakhelwane, okusolwa ukuthi ungena ngokungemthetho kuleli.UMotsoaledi, uthe basahlola ukuthi i-organophosphate ingene kanjani kuma-snacks adliwe izingane wathi sebekhulumile ngoNgqongqoshe wokuBusa ngokuBambisana kuleli , uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa ngokuthi kusungulwe imithetho ngokushesha. UNgqongqoshe wezeMpilo eGauteng, uNkk Nomantu Nkomo Ralehoko nethimba ebelihlola ezinye izitolo zabokufika eGauteng, bathole ukuthi kulezi zitolo akuhlanzekile. Izimpahla emashalofini ziyahlanganiswa. Izinto zokuhlanza zihlangana nokudla, okunye ukudla kubekwa phansi, kuyo leyondlu okudayiselwa kuyo umnikazi wesitolo ulala khona.UMnyango weMfundo eyisiSekelo, okwamanje uthe abukho ubufakazi obukhomba ukuthi ukudla okudliwe ezikoleni yikho okugulise abafundi, njengoba ezinye izingane bekuthiwa zidle esikoleni. Kunalokho kuvela ukuthi zibuye zathenga ama-snacks adayisa kubadayisi bangaphandle kwesikole. Kwezinye izikole kusathathwe amasampula okudla. Inhlangano yezigungu ezilawula izikole imemezele ukuthi abazali abenze isiqiniseko sokuthi izingane azithengi ezitolo ezingamathilomu.UDkt Karen Muller weChild Witness Institute, uthe uyezwa ukuthi abantu abaningi bakhala ngohulumeni nomthetho kodwa ngokwakhe umthetho ngeke uyinqande le nkinga."Inkinga esibhekene nayo ngeyabazali abangazi ukuthi izingane kumele bazikhulise kanjani. Uma umzali enika ingane imali usuke ethi ayithengeni. Njengoba sekunalezi zigameko kunabazali abathi nabo bakhule bephiwa imali ababoni ukuthi sekumele bafundise izingane ngenye indlela. Ezinye azinikwa imali kodwa azikwazi ukunqaba uma ziphiwa ezinye ukudla. Kungalunga uma sifundisa izingane ukuthi awuyidli into ongaphumanga nayo ekhaya,” kusho yena
Ikhiphe incwadi egunyaza ukuboshwa kwenkabi esolwa ngokuhlasela amawele iNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMpumalanga.Lokhu kumenyezelwe okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uColonel Robert Netshiunda esitatimendeni asithumelele abezindaba.Ngokusho kukaNetshiunda, uphiko lwamaphoyisa olulwa nobugebengu bodlame lwamatekisi ezingeni lesifundazwe, iKwaZulu-Natal Provincial Taxi Violence, lucela usizo lomphakathi ukufuniswa uMnuz Mpiyakhe Thobani Mbatha (25).Uthe ufunelwa icala lokudubula, abulale usihlalo kasoseshini wamatekisi iFredville, uMuz Mphilisi Ngubane (35) nelokuzama ukubulala iwele likaNgubane. Kuvele ukuthi ngoSepthemba 13 nonyaka, amawele ayehamba ngomgwaqo uShezi Main elokishini iMpumalanga (Hammarsdale) ngesikhathi ehlaselwa amadoda amathathu ayehamba ngeVW Polo e-brown."Amadoda avulela ngenhlamvu kubagilwa, kwafa uNgubane (Mphilisi). Iwele lakhe lakwazi ukuphunyuka, labaleka,” kusho uNetshiunda.Uthe kwavulwa icala lokubulala nelokuzama ukubulala esiteshini samaphoyisa saseMpumalanga, idokodo lakhona ledluliselwa ophikweni oluphenya amacala odlame lwasematekisini, iProvincial Taxi Violence ukuthi luphenye."Uphenyo lwaveza ukuthi uMbatha wayengubhongoza ekwakheni itulo lokuhlasela kanti akwaziwa ukuthi uphi njengamanje. Kuvela ukuthi ungowokudabuka eGreytown kodwa kukholakala ukuthi ubuye ahlale naseNtshanga,” kusho uNetshiunda.Uthe incwadi egunyaza ukuboshwa kwakhe ikhishwe inkantolo kanti amaphoyisa acela ukuthi noma ubani ongaba nolwazi ngokuthi ukuphi, athinte umphenyi uSergeant Khuyana ku-031 325 6393 noma kweyokubika ubugebengu ethi: 08600 10111.Uthe umphakathi uvumelekile ukuthi ulethe imininingwane ngokuyimfihlo.
UKHONJWE indlela esigungwini esilawula uMasipala waseGoli owayeyimeya yawo, uMnuz Kabelo Gwamanda (39).Kubukeka ziqonga izinkinga zikaGwamanda obemisiwe emsebenzini wakhe wokuba umphathi ophikweni olubhekele ukuthuthukiswa komphakathi eGoli.Ukhonjwe afika ngayo nguMnuz Dada Morero ngempelasonto njengoba ebhekene namacala afaka phakathi inkohlakalo yomshwalense wokungcwaba ngo-2011 no-2012, eSoweto.INkantolo yeMantshi yaseGoli idedele ngebheyili uGwamanda ngenyanga eyedlule.UMorero waqala ngokuthi amise emsebenzini uGwamanda ukuze kuqalwe uphenyo lwangaphakathi kumasipala.Lolu phenyo luphethe ngokuthi uMorero axoshe emsebenzini uGwamanda obeseyiqaqa kubantu abakhele lo mkhandlu kusuka eseyimeya.Isitatimende esivela ehhovisi likaMorero siveze kuthi ukususwa kukaGwamanda esikhundleni kuhloswe ngakho ukuqinisekisa ukuthi akubi khona ukuphazamiseka ekuhlinzekeni umphakathi izidingongqangi.UMorero uthe bafuna ukwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi abakwenzayo kubeka eqhulwini izidingo zomphakathi.Imeya ibe isiqoka uMnuz Tobogo Nkonkou weqembu iPatriotic Alliance ukuba athathe izintambo."Ukuqoka kwami uNkonkou kunginika ithemba lokuthi uzohola lolu phiko ngokuzinikela ekutheni iyathuthukiswa impilo yabahlali baseGoli,” kubeka uMorero.UMorero uthe lo mkhandlu-dolobha uzoqhubeka nokuthi uhlinzeke izakhamizi ngentuthuko esezingeni.UGwamanda oyikhansela le-Al Jamaah wehliswa esikhundleni emuva kwemibhikisho nezikhalazo okwakuvela kubantu ezinhlakeni ezehlukene emphakathini.Babekhala ngokufadabala komkhandlu ngaphansi kobuholi bakhe nokukhushulwa ngemali ephezulu kwentengo kagesi okwamphendula iqaqa emphakathini.
SIFE ujuqu isalukazi esishaywe ngesinye sakwamakhelwane ngento ecijile esiphongweni phambi kwabantu.Umsolwa oneminyaka engu-62 uboshelwe ukubulala umakhelwane wakhe oneminyaka engu-82 esehlakalweni esenzeke ngoLwesihlanu ntambama eBolobedu, eTzaneen eLimpopo.Umsolwa uzovela nngoMsombuluko enkantolo yemantshi yendawo ngecala lokubulala.Kuthiwa umufi uye kwamakhelwane wakhe ongumsolwa ngenhloso yokuyobingelela abanye abantu abebekade besegcekeni.Kungazelele muntu, kuthiwa umufi uhlaselwe umsolwa omshaye ephindelela ngento ecijile esiphongweni wawa phansi.Okhulumela amaphoyisa esifundazeni eLimpopo, uBrigadier Hlulani Mashaba, uthe amaphoyisa abikelwe ngalesigamek aphuthuma khona. Yilapho efike akhonjiswa umgilwa elele phansi ngomhlane."Ubelele phezu kwegazi lakhe ebeligcwele phansi enamanxeba avulekile esiphongweni. Kubizwe abosizo oluphuthumayo abafike bamhlonza njengomuntu oshonele endaweni yesigameko,” kusho uMashaba.UKhomishana wamaPhoyisa eLimpopo, uLieutenant Thembi Hadebe unxuse imiphakathi ukuba ivikele abangakwazi ukuzivikela emphakathini okubalwa kubona abantu besifazane, izaguga nabathandana nobulili obufana nobabo.
OWAYENGUMSAKAZI woKhozi FM, uNgizwe Mchunu, uwuzwe ngendaba umcimbi wangoLwesine lapho bekwembulwa umfuziselo weSilo saKwaDukuza uShaka kaSenzangakhona, eKing Shaka International Airport, eThekwini, emuva kokukhishwa ngoshova ngamaphoyisa. Ngokusho komthombo, uNgizwe ufikile emcimbini ehola isigejana samabutho ebesivunule siconsa, kodwa yena wayalelwa ukuba ahambe kulo mcimbi obuthanyelwe nanguMengameli wezwe, uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa neSilo samabandla, uMisuzulu kaZwelithini. Umdidiyeli wamabutho aseKing Cetshwayo, uMnuz Senziwanjani Xulu, uzishaya isifuba ngokuthi nguye oyalele amaphoyisa ukuba amxoshe umengameli wamabhinca, owagcotshwa yiSilo ngoba wadelela amakhosi. Bekungekhona okokuqala uXulu emkhipha ngoshova uNgizwe emcimbini. Wenze okufanayo nasemembesweni obusendaweni yakwaMadlebe, eMevamhlophe ngempelasonto edlule. Kuthiwa uXulu ugxavule uNgizwe maqede wamyalela ukuba ahambe ngoba amabutho amthukuthelele ngoba wazwakala ebiza amakhosi ngezidakwa ezinkundleni zokuxhumana. Kulo mcimbi, obuhanjelwe ngamakhosi ezizwe eziningi, inkosi yaseMacambini, uMthokozi Mathaba, beyihambise umkhehlo nomembeso endodakazini yenkosi yaseMevamhlophe, uZenzo Zungu, uNksz Sinqobile Zungu. Umthandazi uThulani "Dr 3 Seconds” Nkwanyana, uthe kuyadabukisa okwehlele uNgizwe emcimbini osemqoka kangaka esizweni samaZulu. Uthe awukho umcimbi wesintu azobuye awuhambele uNgizwe uma engakazehlisi emakhosini. Uthe imvunulo izogcina seyiphenduke amaphijamu kuye ngoba uzogcina eselala ngayo njengoba kungekho mcimbi asezowuhambela. "NaseGoli siyofona sibazise ukuthi bamxoshe akadingakali. ” Nomculi kamaskandi ongumzala kaNgizwe, uSaliwa Ndunakazi, uthe akusiyo neze into enhle eyehlele umuntu onamagalelo njengoNgizwe kulo mcimbi. UXulu uthe ukube akamxoshanga uNgizwe bekuzokonakala umcimbi ngoba kunamabutho abezimisele ngokumudla luhlaza emuva kokubiza amakhosi awo ngemigodoyi nangezidwedwe.UXulu uthe ukuziphatha nezinkulumo zikaNgizwe kwenza bazibuze imibuzo eminingi ngokuqokwa kwakhe njengokuthi, waqokwa ngaliphi futhi nangamaphi amagalelo anawo esizweni.Yize uNgizwe engatholakalanga ukuba aphawule ngesigameko saseKing Shaka International Airport kodwa uphike walala ngomhlane ukuthi uxoshiwe eMevamhlophe. Wenze i-vidiyo wathi yena ubesevele esehamba emuva kokubingelelana namakhosi ngoba ubemenyiwe. Uthe usenga ezimithiyo uXulu, ambize ngoKweqeliphalishi, ukuthi ubengafunwa kuloya mcimbi. Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kokhulumela iNdlunkulu kaZulu ayiphumelelanga. Kwamanye ama-vidiyo uNgizwe uzwakala ebiza amakhosi ngemigodoyi futhi ewasola ngokulala nondlunkulu bawo emadokodweni akwaShembe.
KUMANGALE abazalwane umholi wamaNazaretha, inkosi Mduduzi 'uNyazilwezulu’ Shembe, ememezela ukuthi makungavunyelwa muntu okhonza eThembezinhle, ukuthi ajoyine abaseBuhleni. Uthi kuzobe kufana nokuthi bavulela amabululu azobalimaza.UNyazilwezulu belushumayela ngeSabatha eledlule ngesikhathi luvala umhlangano waseJudiya eShowe. Libuye laxwayisa ngokuvumela abaseThembezinhle, ukuthi babe yingxenye yabo.Isolezwe Ngempelasonto linayo intshumayelo yoNyazilwezulu eqoshiwe lapho beliveza khona lezi zindaba."Uma ngabe wawuthunywe abakini ukuthi uzokhonza uShembe, bona bakephi manje uma wena usuphumile. Laba abaphuma ngo-Ephreli 3 ngo-2011, ningabavumeli babuye. Ngeke ulande imamba noma ibululu noma imfezi ehlathini bese uzoyifuya. Izothi ingafudumala bese iyashaya. Omunye athi hhayi mina ngizocela intethelelo. kumele umbuze ukuthi uphumaphi. Uzothi omunye hhayi mina bengihleli ekhaya, kuzomele umtshele ukuthi hhayi phindela ekhaya ngoba uzosona. Umuntu uma eke waba yiphewula abupheli ubuphekula kuye. Ngakho ngiyanicela maNazaretha, noma nikhuluma nabo kodwa ningababuyisi. Bangangeni phakathi kwenu bazonona. Bafica uphelele umkhumbi uholwa ngubaba uThingolwesazana baphuma, ngoba bethi bahlakaniphile. Akuyi ngakuhlakanipha lapha, nguShembe ohlakaniphile. Ubani owake wabhekana noShembe waphasa? Ngiyacela nalamaphekula acashe lapha eBuhleni, aphenduke alazi uNyazi luyini. Ngithe nina nisebancane umhlaba wonke usazombatha ingubo emhlophe. Ongakafiki lapha uyeza," kusho uNyazilwezulu.Ngesikhathi lukhipha lesi simemezelo kukhona abebebabaza okukhomba ukuthi bathukile futhi kungathi bebengasilindele ukuthi luzoyisho.Inkosi uNyazilwezulu isho kanjena nje, bakhona abebehamba phambili ngasohlangothini lwaseThembezinhle, osekuke kwavela ukuthi sebengaphansi kwayo.Okhulumela amaNazaretha noNyazilwezulu, uMnuz Thokozani Mncwabe uthe uyizwile intshumayelo kodwa ibingachazi lokhu abantu abakucabangayo."Inkosi uNyazilwezulu iyathethelela futhi akekho engeke imthethelele uma efuna ukubuya azoba yingxenye yamaNazaretha aseBuhleni. Into ebishiwo ubaba uNyazi ukuthi noma sebebuya abantu bangangeni ngesibhobo kodwa abeze baqonde. Akumele bavele bazibuyele nje bese beqhubeka nokukhonza sengathi konke bekuvele kuhamba kahle. Kumele baqale enhlambulukweni ngokuthi bazocela uxolo kulona uNyazilwezulu, noma babikele isigungu sabefundisi esihola ibandla bahlambuluke kusona. Kumele basho nezizathu ezenza bahamba nokuthi kungani sebebuya manje,” kuchaza uMncwabe.
AMALUNGU ePhalamende axoshwa yi-MK afuna isinxephezelo kuleli qembu nakumholi walo, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, aphinde afune nemali yawo ayifaka kwi-akhawunti kaZuma. Amalungu eMK axoshwa maphakathi nonyaka athi ukuxoshwa kwawo ePhalamende kwawaphuca isinkwa emlonyeni, afuna isinxephezelo ngalokho.La malungu afake icala lapho efuna kumiswe ukusebenza kwe-akhawunti ye-MK nekaZuma kuze kuba kulalelwa icala lapho efuna isinxephezelo.Abafake icala uMnuz Thami Khuzwayo, Mnuz Isaac Menyatso, Mnuz Citron Motshegoe, Mnuz Augastina Qwetha, Nksz Nomado Mgwebi, Nksz Ntombenhle Mkhize, Mnuz Sydwell Masilela, Mnuz France Mfiki, Mnuz Senzo Dlamini, noNksz Agnes Mogotsi.Bonke laba baxoshwa kwi-MK, besolwa ngokuthi bangena ngopotsho ohlwini lwamalungu eMK ajutshwe ePhalamende. Bazama ukukuphonsela inselelo enkantolo ukuxoshwa kwabo kodwa iNkantolo eNkulu eWestern Cape yabachitha.Manje la malungu asefake elinye icala eNkantolo eNkulu eGoli. Emaphepheni asenkantolo, uKhuzwayo uthe bebehola o-R102 000 ngenyanga ngesikhathi bengamalungu ePhalamende.Uthe babekade beshiye imisebenzi yabo ngesikhathi beqokelwa ukuba babe amalungu ePhalamende.UKhuzwayo uthe ukuxoshwa kwabo kubashiye belambatha, befana nezinkukhu ezibaleka zinqunywe amakhanda."Lesi simo sisidalele izinkinga kwezezimali thina nemindeni yethu. Ukuba uZuma akazange agile le mikhuba ngabe asikho kulezi zinkinga zemali esibhekene nazo. Lesi simo yiso esisiphoqa ukuba sifune ukunxephezelwa emalini ezotholakala kwi-akhawunti yeMK nakwekaZuma.”UKhuzwayo uthe akuzange kulandelwe imigomo ngesikhathi bexoshwa.Esicelweni sawo, amalungu aphinde abalise ngo-R10 000 athi babafaka kwi-akhawunti kaZuma.UKhuzwayo uthe onke amalungu eMK ePhalamende ayenxenxwe ukuba afakele uZuma o-R10 000 emva kokuhola."Le mali sasiyifaka njengophawu lokwethembeka kuZuma. Sasinethemba lokuthi uZuma uzoyisebenzisa ngendlela elungile le mali. Ngeshwa ke uZuma usebenzise yona le mali ukuhlakaza iqembu.”Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kokhulumela iMK, uMnuz Nhlamulo Ndhlela, ayizange iphumelele. Nemiyalezo athunyelwe yona akayiphendulanga.I-MK inikezwe kuze kube uNovemba 15, ukuba ifake amaphepha aphikisa isicelo sala malungu.Icala lizolalelwa ngoNovemba 19.
UMHOLI we-EFF, uMnuz Julius Malema, udalule ukuthi osanda kujoyina iMK, u-Advocate Dali Mpofu, wayefuna ukuthi i-EFF ivalwe bese belandela umholi weMK, uJacob Zuma.UMalema uthe ngaphambi kokhetho uMpofu waqhamuka nesiphakamiso sokuthi i-EFF, namanye amaqembu aphikisayo ahlakazwe bese wonke eseka uZuma. Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma kwiPodcast ye-EFF.UMpofu, owaba ngusihlalo wokuqala we-EFF, ngoLwesine umemezele ukushiya kwakhe kuleli qembu. Ukushiya kwakhe kulandela ukushiya kowayeyiphini lomholi kwi-EFF, uMnuz Floyd Shivambu, uMnuz Mzwanele Manyi, no-Advocate Busisiwe Mkhwebane, bonke asebejoyine iMK.UMalema uveze ukuthi ngesikhathi kunomhlangano wamaqembu aphikisayo owawubizwe nguZuma ngaphambi kokhetho lwangoMeyi, uMpofu wethula isiphakamiso sokuthi kuhlakazwe wonke amaqembu aphikisayo.Ngaleso sikhathi uZuma wayengakamemezeli ukuthi uzokweseka iMK okhethweni.UMalema uthe abaholi ababehambele umhlangano kwakungumholi we-ATM, uMnuz Vuyo Zungula, umholi we-UDM, uMnuz Bantubonke Holomisa nomholi wePAC, uMnuz Mzwanele Nyhontso."Mina angizange ngiye kulowo mhlangano, kwaya uFloyd noMarshall (Dlamini, unobhala jikelele we-EFF). Uyamazi ke nawe uMarshall ukuthi akukhulumi kakhulu, ukhuluma uma kunesidingo. UFloyd nguyena owayekhuluma kakhulu. Wayichitha indaba yokuthi kuhlakazwe i-EFF. Kwakungawenzi umqondo ukuthi sizovala i-EFF bese silandela uZuma. Ngaleso sikhathi wayengakasunguli ngisho iMK.”UMalema uthe emhlanganweni uZungula wafike waphakamisa ukuthi okungenani wonke amaqembu aphikisayo aseke i-EFF."UZungula wathi i-EFF yilona qembu elikhulu kulawa ayesemhlanganweni. UZuma waphikisana nalawo mbono, wathi abantu abadala ngeke baze bayivotele i-EFF.”UMalema uthe uZuma waphinde wambizela emhlanganweni ngaphambi kokuthi asungule iMK, lapho aphinde enza isiphakamiso sokuthi kuhlakazwe i-EFF namanye amaqembu."Ngamtshela uZuma ukuthi ukhetho selusondele. Ngathi into engcono engiyibonayo ukuthi yena amemezele ukuthi uzovotela i-EFF, bese okunye sikuxoxa emva kokhetho. Kulapho angitshela khona ukuthi uzoqala iqembu lakhe.”UMalema uthe akazisoli nakancane ngokuphikisa isiphakamiso sikaZuma. Uphinde wathi akananxa noMpofu.
ONGUMPHENYI omkhulu ecaleni lokubulawa kowayengunozinti we-Orlando Pirates neBafana Bafana, uSenzo Meyiwa, uBrigadier Bongani Gininda, ufuna umculi uKelly Khumalo ajoyine abasolwa eNkantolo eNkulu yasePitoli ngoba ukholwa wukuthi wayewumbimbi nabasolwa.Efakaza ngoLwesihlanu, uGininda uthe wayefuna uKelly abe ngumsolwa wesithupha, ngenxa yobufakazi babanye abasolwa.Uthe uyazikhumbula izitatimende zikaSifiso "Gwabini" Zungu nesomunye umsolwa, ziveza ukuthi ukubulawa kukaSenzo kwakungekhona ukuyobamba inkunzi kodwa kwakuyitulo elalihlelwe ngabasolwa abayisithupha, okubalwa noKelly. OWAYENGUNOZINTI weBafana Bafana uSenzo Meyiwa osekuphela iminyaka eyishumi adutshulwa wafa ekubo kwentombi yakhe uKelly Khumalo Ephekwa kabanzi ngemibuzo wu-Advocate Sipho Ramosepele (ongummeli womsolwa wesibili, uBongani Ntanzi), uGininda uthe njengoba ayesebophe abasolwa abahlanu ngoNovemba, wayesenza isicelo sokuba uKelly abe wumsolwa wesithupha ngenxa yobufakazi obashiwo ngumsolwa wokuqala (uMuzikawukhulelwa Sibiya) noNtanzi bokuthi uKelly wayewumbimbi ngesikhathi kwenziwa itulo lokubulala uSenzo. Uthe isitatimende sikaColonel Lambertus Steyn siveza ukuthi umsolwa wesithathu (uMthobisi Mncube) wayexhumana noKelly (ayembiza ngoSistas).Uthe leso sitatimende savezwa futhi nabameli babasolwa basithola.UGininda ubuye waveza ukuthi uColonel Lambertus Steyn wathola ukuthi uKelly wayenezinombolo eziyisithupha zomakhalekhukhwini ayezisebenzisa ekubeni yena waveza izinombolo ezimbili kuphela emaphoyiseni, okungeyantshontshwa neyasetshenziswa ku-downloadwa imininingwane yakhe. Uthe akazihluphanga ngokubuza uKelly noLongwe ngesithombe esasinoplastiki owawunemali esatholakala ocingweni lukaMncube, nokwavela ukuthi lo plastiki wawuvela kuKelly nakuLongwe Twala.Ngaphambi kokuqala kwecala, ummeli womsolwa wokuqala, u-Advocate Thulani Mngomezulu, ucele ukuphuthuma ekhaya ngenxa yokuthi ubengazizwa kahle.IJaji uRatha Mokgoatlheng lithe aliboni ukuthi yini engenza linqabele uMngomezulu ukuba ayolulamela ngasekhaya. Ummeli uyalelwe ukuba abukele leli cala esekhaya.Ummeli womsolwa wesine, u-Advocate Zithulele Nxumalo, uthe uzosiza uMngomezulu ngakho konke okuzobe kudingeka kuye.USenzo wabulawa ngokudutshulwa evakashele owayeyintombi futhi engunina wengane yakhe, uKelly, kubo eVosloorus, eGauteng, ngo-Okthoba 26, 2014. Emasontweni ambalwa edlule, bekuhlangane iminyaka eyishumi lo mdlali abulawa. Udadewabo kaKelly, uZandi, ucashunwe kwesinye seziteshi zethelevishini enowayeyinkosikazi kaSenzo shaqa, uMandisa Mkhize, ekholwa wukuthi uMandisa kumele engabe naye usahlatshwa imibuzo ngoba uSenzo washona bengasazwani.UZandi uveze nokuthi enye into eyayenza ukuthi uSenzo angayi emcimbini wokuzalwa komngane wakhe, owawungempelasonto yesehlakalo, kwaba wukuthi wayazi ukuthi uMandisa umenyiwe naye. Ngenxa yokuthi babengasabhekani, wangalubeka, wancamela ukuzihlalela kubo kaKelly.
UMENGAMELI wezwe uCyril Ramaphosa, uyishiye kubazali ingcabha yokuvikela izingane ezibulawa ukudla okunobuthi.URamaphosa uthe abazali kufanele benze isiqiniseko sokuthi izingane zabo zithenga ezindaweni eziphephile. Ukusho lokhu ngoLwesihlanu ngesikhathi ekhuluma embizweni yakhe ebiseMgababa.URamaphosa uthe abazali kufanele bayisukumele eyokuphepha kwezingane."Njengabazali kufanele sizihluphe, siqinisekise ukuphepha kwabantwana bethu. Kufanele senze isiqiniseko sokuthi izingane zithenga ukudla ezindaweni eziphephile. Kufanele sonke sibambisane kule mpi, siqinisekise ukuthi izingane zethu ziphephile,” kweluleka uRamaphosa.Siyanda isibalo sezingane ezishona noma eziguliswa ukudla okunobuthi ezikuthenga ezitolo zendawo nasezikoleni.Izigameko zande kakhulu eGauteng, lapho kunemibiko yokushona kwezingane, nalapha KwaZulu-Natal zikhona izigameko ezibikiwe.URamaphosa uthe bakhathazekile ngokwenyuka kwesibalo sezingane ezishonayo nezigulayo."Kuyinto embi kabi ukushona komuntu osemncane, obenamaphupho abesafisa ukuwaveza. Sizwelana nabo bonke abazali kanye nemindeni elahlekelwe abathandiweyo bayo.”URamaphosa uyalele ukuba kube nomzuzu wokuhlonipha bonke abashonile. Ukhombe ngenjumbane abanikazi bezitolo wathi babudedengu."Bagcina amakhemikhali ayingozi ezitolo zabo. Kukhona asebeboshiwe amaphoyisa.”URamaphosa uthe useyalele iminyango eyehlukene ukuba iqhamuke neqhinga lokuqeda le nkinga. Iminyango ayibalile owamaPhoyisa, owezokuBusa ngokuBambisana kanye neziNdaba zoMdabu, owezeMpilo nowezoLimo.URamaphosa uthe uzokwenza isimemezelo maduze ngezinyathelo ezizothathwa nguhulumeni."Ngiyalele bonke ongqongqoshe abathintekayo ukuba babheke ukuthi yini okufanele yenziwe ukulwa nalesi simo. Sizokuba nomhlangano wabo bonke ongqongqoshe abathintekayo ngesonto elizayo. Emva komhlangano ngizokwazi ukwenza isimemezelo.”Uphinde waveza ukuthi kunemithetho elawula ukusebenza kwezitolo zendawo ezoqala ukusebenza maduze.
OWAYEYIPHINI lomholi we-EFF, uMnuz Floyd Shivambu, uqokelwe kwesikaNobhala Jikelele weMK.Ukuqokelwa kukaShivambu kulesi sukhundla kumenyezelwe yihhovisi likamengameli weMK esitatimendeni ngeSonto ekuseni.Esitatimendeni esithunyelwe kwabezindaba uJacob Zuma uqoke uShivambu ukuba aphathe lesikhundla emva kokwesula kukaDkt Sifiso Maseko, oshiye ngoLwesithathu.UMaseko usule ngenxa yokuthi usebuyela emsebenzini wakhe eMnyangweni wezeMpilo esifundazweni iGauteng.UMaseko ubekade emisiwe kulo msebenzi ngenxa yophenyo lwezinsolo zokubhubhudlwa kwemali yokuthengwa kwezinsiza zokulwa nokusabalala kobhubhane icorona.I-MK ithe uShivambu uyena osezokwenza yonke imisebenzi ebiyenziwa uMaseko.UShivambu ujoyine iMK ngo-Agasti, wafike wanikwa isikhundla sokuba uMgqungquzeli kaZwelonke okuyisikhundla esingakavalwa.
NKOSIKHONA CELESIKHULU isililo ngokudlula emhlabeni koMfundisi obephinde abe ngusomabhizinisi owaziwayo, uMfu Vusi Erick Mkhungo (64).UMkhungo ongowaseMthwalume, ngaphambilini wayekade engumholi webandla i-New Power Ministry kodwa ugcine esejoyine ibandla i-Family Worship Centre ekwa-E, eMlaza, eholwa nguMphostoli Mbambo.Uzakhele olukhulu udumo ngokulekelela abantulayo ngezindlela ezahlukene. Ubephinde aziwe ngokufundisa abantu ngezamabhizinisi.Kuvele ukuthi uMkhungo ushone engazange agule, esemzini wakhe eMthwalume.UMengameli webandla i-Gadner Mvuyana African Congregational Church, uMfu Bonginkosi Ngcobo ongumngani omkhulu kamufi, uthe bagqemeke engeqiwa ntwala ngomshophi owehlile.Uchaze uMkhungo njengoMfundisi obemazisa kakhulu uNkulunkulu futhi ekuthanda ukukhuleka. Uthe kuyena bafunde ukuthi kumqoka kangakanani ukuthanda abantu nokuthanda uNkulunkulu."Silimele kakhulu ngokudlula emhlabeni kukaMkhungo. Ubeyindoda ebimazisa kakhulu uNkulunkulu. Ubengenza noma yini inqobo nje uma imayelana noNkulunkulu,’’ usho kanje.Umncomile wathi uyibekile induku ebandla ebandleni likaNkulunkulu kanjalo nasemabhizinisini ehlukene abekade enawo.Indodakazi kamufi uNksz Lihle Mkhungo ithe bagqekeme udume lwengozi, yathi lo mshophi ubehle ngaphezulu bengawulindele nje nhlobo.UNksz Mkhungo uthe uyise ubemthanda kakhulu uNkulunkulu kodwa futhi esemnkantshubovu kakhulu kwezamabhizinisi."Kuyinto ebuhlungu ukushiywa ngubaba emhlabeni. Kodwa siyambonga kakhulu uNkulunkulu ngokusiboleka umuntu onjengaye,'' usho kanje.Uthe bancele kogwansile kuyise ikakhulukazi uma kukhulunywa ngezamabhizinisi.Kafishane ngoMfu Mkhungu, ubengusihlalo wenkampani iMoyeni Engineering ebiphakela ngezinsimbi izinkampani ezahlukene okufaka kuzona iToyota, Lovu Sugar, Mondi Paper nezinye eziningi.
LIKUBEKE eqhulwini ukubaluleka kokudaleka kwamathuba omsebenzi ibandla, iLight For Africa, yingakho liqeqesha abantu ngokuthunga KwaMashu.Lokhu kudalulwe yiNhloko yebandla uMfundisi Jeremiah Mdlalose. Ubekhuluma ngesikhathi isikole sebandla, iLight For Africa School of Sewing sihalalisela abafundi abaso abaphothule izifundo.Benze umcimbi wokubagqokisa amajazi abaphumelele. Umcimbi ubusesizindeni salo esikwa-K, KwaMashu.UMdlalose uthe inhloso yesikole ukunikezela ngoqeqesho lokuthunga ebantwini abanentshisekelo ukuze baziphilise ngakho.Uthe uhlelo alukhethi iphela emasini, yize kungelebandla kodwa lufaka phakathi namalungu omphakathi."Obekumqoka ukuthi njengebandla kube khona esikwenzayo ukuze siqeqeshe abafisa ukungena bagxile kwezokuthunga,'' echaza.Uveze ukuthi abaphumelele oqeqeshweni bayabathatha basebenzisane nabo ngoba lesi sikole sithungela izikole zamabanga aphansi zakuyona le ndawo.Uveze ukuthi uhlelo luphumelela nje, yingoba bathole uxhaso kubefundisi abaphinde babe ngosomabhizinisi baseSpringfield Missouri United State of America (USA).Uthe ubonga kakhulu kubona bobabili abefundisi okunguMfundisi Chuck Eastman noMfundisi Gary Larimore abebeyingxenye yomcimbi.U-Eastman ugcizelele ukubaluleka kokuba ibandla likaNkulunkulu libonakale lenza umehluko emphakathini elikuwona."Savumela phezulu ngesikhathi uMdlalose esazisa ngomcabango anawo wokusungula isikole sokuthunga esizoqeqesha sigcine sesidala namathuba omsebenzi,'' esho.Uthe bethemba ukuthi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi bazoba baningi abantu ababonakala behlomula kulona.Kulo mcimbi bekunandisa iqembu lesicathamiya iWhite Mambazo.

UCWANINGO lwakamuva olwenziwe kwiJohannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE), yiJust Share luveze ukuthi zinhlanu kuphela izinkampani ezikwi-JSE Top 40 ezinamabhodi aphethwe ngabesifazane.Lezo zinkampani yi-Impala Platinum, Shoprite Holdings, Sasol, Standard Bank Group neCapitec.Zine kuphela izinkampani ezinkulu kuleli eziphethwe ngabantu besifazane okuyi-FirstRand, Bidvest Group, Clicks Group ne-Exxaro Resources.Ziyisishiyagalombili kuphela izinkampani ezikwi-JSE Top 40 ezikwazile ukungenisa isibalo esanele sabesifazane emabhodini azo okuyi-Bidvest Group, British American Tobacco, Discovery, Exxaro, Impala Platinum, Investec PLC, Investec Ltd neNortham Platinum.Zimbili kuphela ezikwazile ukuletha isibalo esanele sabesifazane ezikhundleni zokuphatha okuyi-Bidvest Group neBHP Group.Zintathu kuphela izinkampani ezizimesele ukufaka isibalo sabesilisa nabesifazane esilinganayo emabhodini azo futhi ezimemezele lezo zinhlelo, okuyi-AngloGold Ashanti, Impala Platinum neWoolworths.Kusukela ngonyaka odlule iBidvest Group iyona yodwa inkampani ekwi-JSE Top 40 ebe nesibalo esithe xaxa sabesifazane ebhodini layo okuwu-64% nasezikhundleni zokuphatha okuwu-58%.Abesifazane abekho ezikhundleni zokuphatha ezinkampanini ezidayisa ukudla njengoba bewu-18% kuphela, lesi sibalo sehle ngo-23% uma siqhathaniswa nesangonyaka odlule. IJust Share iveze ukuthi ezinkampanini ezinkulu ezihweba eJSE ezibizwa nge-JSE Top 40, wu-36% kuphela wabesifazane abasemabhodini azo. Kuthiwa abesifazane abasezikhundleni zokuphatha kulezi zinkampani benza u-23% kuphela yize abesifazane benza u-46% wabantu abasebenzayo.Ithe lokhu kusho ukuthi kulo nyaka lezi zinkampani azenzanga kahle ekukhuphuleni abesifazane njengoba ngo-2023 umbiko weJust Share wathola ukuthi wu-36% wabesifazane owawusemabhodini ezinkampani ezikwi-JSE Top 40 okusho ukuthi lesi sibalo sinyuke ngo-1% kulo nyaka. Ngonyaka odlule bebewu-25% abasezikhundleni zokuphatha kulezi zinkampani.Ithe ngisho ukunyuka kancane kwesibalo sabesifazane abasemabhodini ezinkampani ezikwi-JSE Top 40 akudalwa wukuthi kungene abanye kodwa kudalwa wukuthi sinciphile isibalo samadoda asemabhodini.Ithe lezi zibalo zihambisana nokwenzeka emhlabeni jikelele kodwa okungcono wukuthi kuleli abesifazane bakhona emabhodini inkinga isasezikhundleni zokuphatha izinkampani.Kubuye kwavela ukuthi u-80% wezinkampani ezikwi-JSE Top 40 awunayo imithetho yokufaka zonke izinhlanga zakuleli emsebenzini.UMnuz Kwanele Ngogela obheka izindaba zokungalingani eJust Share, uthe kufanele abaphethe izinkampani ezihweba eJSE baqinisekise ukuthi kunokulingana kwezobulili futhi kuqashwa zonke izinhlanga zakuleli.Uthe neJSE kufanele ilandelele ukuthi imithetho eyibekile yokulingana nokuqashwa kwazo zonke izinhlanga iyalandelelwa ezinkampanini ezihweba kuyo.
IPHINI likaNgqongqoshe weMfundo ePhakeme,uDkt Mimmy Gondwe, lithi isizoba wumlando indaba yokungashicilelwa ngesikhathi kwezitifiketi zamakolishi.UNkk Gondwe usho lokhu ngesikhathi ehambele Elangeni TVET College, ePinetown ngoLwesine."Ngisemkhankasweni wokuhambela wonke amakolishi akuleli ukuze ngibone ukuthi iziqu ezitholakala kuwo ziyadingeka yini ezimbonini nokuthi izitshudeni ziyakwazi yini ukuzivulela amabhizinisi azo. Ngiqale eFree State, ngadlulela eNorth West, Northern Cape, Western Cape nase-Eastern Cape. Njengoba sengilapha KwaZulu-Natal yikolishi lami lesithupha leli engilihambelayo. Ngithole ukuthi izitshudeni zinenkinga yokungazitholi ngesikhathi izitifiketi zazo uma seziqede ukufunda. Le nkinga sesiyixazululile ngoba isitshudeni sinikezwa incwadi eqinisekisa ukuthi sesiziphothulile zonke izifundo zaso. Ziyashicilelwa nezitifiketi manje.”Uthe kuyena impumelelo yoMnyango weMfundo ePhakeme ayincikile ekutheni bakhiqiza izitshudeni eziningi ezineziqu zemfundo ephakeme kodwa incike ekutheni ngabe lezo zitshudeni ziyawuthola yini umsebenzi noma ziyakwazi yini ukuthola amathuba ebhizinisi.Ubalule ukuthi wakhe ubudlelwano ne-Old Mutual ukuze izitshudeni zamakolishi zivakashelwe yizimboni ezihlukene, zizazise ngamathuba omsebenzi akhona.Maduze uthe uzomemezela ubudlelwano abakhile ne-Microsoft ezohlomisa izitshudeni ngamakhono akusasa njengoba umhlaba wonke ususebenzisa ubuchwepheshe besimanje.UDkt Gondwe ukugcizelele ukuthi amakolishi abalulekile emfundweni ephakeme futhi kufanele uphele umkhuba wokuwabukela phansi.Uveze ukuthi abanezinkinga ezikhungweni zeMfundo ePhakeme bayakwazi ukushayela ihhovisi lakhe ukuze lilekelele.Phakathi kwezinkinga azitholile ngezokungashicilelwa ngesikhathi kwezitifiketi nezokungatholakali koxhaso lweNational Student Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS) emakolishi.Uthe lezi zinkinga uyazixazulula ngoba umphathi weNSFAS uyatholakala futhi uzimisele ukusebenza.Udonse abantu bakuleli ngendlebe wathi bangawabukeli phansi amakolishi kodwa bazigqugquzele izingane ukuba ziye kuwo ukuze zibe nekusasa eliqhakazile.
USHAYA amakhala umndeni wabesilisa ababili baseNtambanana, eMpangeni, abadutshulwe babulawa amaphoyisa eMahlabathini, oLundi, okuthiwa bebebuya kolanda ucu entombini ngoLwesithathu.Kulesi sigameko, Isolezwe lithole ukuthi kubulawe uMnuz Nkosinathi Khwela (25) nomzala wakhe, uMnuz Sandile Zimu (27).Ngokwesitatimende esithunyelwe amaphoyisa kwabezindaba, abafi bebesolwa ngobunkabi. Amaphoyisa athe bebesendleleni ukuyobulala usomatekisi eMahlabathini.Uyise kaNkosinathi, uMnuz Qhubekela Khwela, uthe abafi bebesuke ekhaya ekuseni belibangise eNhlungwana, oLundi, ukuyolanda ucu entombini ebisivume uNkosinathi."Bahlaselwe ntambama sebebuya khona. Uhlaselwe eshayela ucingo esinye isihlobo acishe alingane naso ngeminyaka nge-video call. Sisitshele ukuthi ubengeve ejabule, esichomela ngokuthi sesisele sodwa emjolweni, yena usezomiselwa iduku ngoba intombi isimnike ucu,” kusho uKhwela.Uthe amaphoyisa abahlasele besakhuluma nge-video call, abathuka, abayalela ukuthi balale phansi.UMNUZ Nkosinathi Khwela"Bathe bangaqeda ukulala phansi, acisha i-video call. Mina ngithole ucingo luvela kuye lo obeshayelwa ucingo nge-video call, engitshela ukuthi asiphuthume kulo mgwaqo siyobheka ukuthi kwenzekani ngoba ugcine behlaselwa amaphoyisa, emva kwalokho akasabatholi ezingcingweni,” kusho uKhwela.Uthe bathe uma befika endaweni yesigameko, amaphoyisa abese ala ukhasha, engafuni basondele endaweni yesigameko yize bewatshela ukuthi bawumndeni wabagilwa.Udalule ukuthi bobabili abafi bebenezibhamu ezisemthethweni, wathi kulezi ezithwetshulwe amaphoyisa ezithombeni, esisodwa sazo esikaZimu, kanti esikaNkosinathi, abazi amaphoyisa asishonisephi ngoba lesi esivezwayo akusona esakhe."Esesithathu asisazi nokuthi esikabani. Sixakwa ukuthi uma bebeyobulala, bangakwenza kanjani ngezibhamu zabo ezisemthethweni? Futhi sibuza ukuthi sishonephi esikaNkosinathi isibhamu esisemthethweni abesiphethe?”Ukhale ngeNational Intervention Unit (NIU) enesihluku, wathi uma ifuna umuntu, ayimbophi, ivele idubule."Ivele idubule wonke umuntu bese ithi yibo abadubule kuqala,” kusho uKhwela.Uthe imoto ebebehamba ngayo bekungeyomngani wakhona eNtambanana. "Akukho esibazela khona. Kumangele wonke umuntu endaweni ukuthi izingane bezenzeni. Sifisa ukuthi ilunge indaba ye-NIU ngoba ayibophi, iyabulala,” usho kanje. Isihlobo okuyiso esishayelwe nge-video call, esicele ukuba igama laso ligodlwe, sithe sizibonele ngo-see, iphoyisa liphuca uNkosinathi iselula, labathuka, lathi abalale phansi."Ngilibuzile ukuthi benzeni njengoba libalalisa phansi nje, labona ukuthi ngisekhona ocingweni, lakitakita iselula, laze laphumelela ukuluvala ucingo. Emva kwalokho angibange ngisabathola. Ngaze ngathumela obaba ukuthi abahambe bayobheka ngoba mina ngihlala kude,” kusho isihlobo.Isihlobo sithe uNkosinathi ubezisebenza, enemoto ekhokhelwa ngebanga elihambile. Sathi uZimu ubengusomathenda, ethola amathenda okwakha. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe abafi badutshulwe babulawa emva kokudubulana namaphoyisa.Uthe abelandela umkhondo ngabo ukuthi bayobulala usomatekisi."I-VW Polo abebehamba ngayo ibonakele emgwaqweni u-P700, amaphoyisa asebenzise amalambu aluhlaza ne-siren ukubamisa. Umshayeli ume phakathi nomgwaqo. Ngokuphazima kweso, abebesemotweni badubula bebhekise emaphoyiseni, nawo abuyisela ngayo inhlamvu, bafa bobabili,” kusho uNetshiunda.Uthe kutholwe izibhamu ezintathu nezinhlamvu. Uthe esisodwa sazo sabikwa ukuthi sintshontshiwe eMacekane Reserve, eMtunzini, ngoJanuwari.Uthe awekho amaphoyisa alimele esigamekweni, wathi izibhamu ezitholwe amaphoyisa zizoyohlolwa ukuthi awekho yini manye amacala ezithinteka kuwo.
IKHATHAZEKILE i-ANC ngesenzo sikanobhala jikelele we-SACP uMnuz Solly Mapaila, sokuhlale egxeka le nhlangano nokuphuma iqhubu nomengameli Cyril Ramaphosa odabeni lokubambisana kwamaqembu kuhulumeni.Le nhlangano ithe ayifuni ukutshela iSACP ukuthi kumele ikhulume kanjani nokuthi ithini, kodwa manje isimo sibonakala singahambi kahle.Unobhala jikelele we-ANC uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, uthe sebebize umhlangano ophuthumayo ozoba phakathi kwabo ne-SACP.Uthe bayayihlonipha i-SACP noMapaila, kodwa manje babona ukuthi uyanhlanhlatha."Ugxeka abaholi be-ANC aphume iqhubu noRamaphosa okuyinto esikhathazayo. Aseneme ngendlela uMapaila enza ngayo izinto mihla le, yokuthi ukhwela adilike kubaholi be-ANC, ikakhulu umengameli,” kusho uMbalula. Selokhu i-ANC yehlelwa ukwesekwa okhethweni lwalo nyaka, yanquma ukubumba uhulumeni ohlanganisa amaqembu, i-SACP ayineme ngalesi sinyathelo.Uhlale egxeka i-ANC lapho ekhuluma khona ngokuchitha lo hulumeni.UMbalula uthe namanye amalungu e-ANC ayengeneme ngendaba yalo hulumeni kodwa manje aseyaqonda.Useke wakusho phambilini ukuthi ukuba bawina ukhetho ngokugculisayo ngabe abawadingi amanye amaqembu ukuthi babambisane.UMbalula ugxeke noNkk Helen Zille we-DA, ngokulokhu egxeka uRamaphosa efuna ukuhlakaza le nhlangano."Uma i-DA ifuna ukuphuma kuhulumeni, yamukelekile. Sizoqhubeka siyibambe, ngeke siyincenge i-DA, kusho uMbalula ekhuluma esithangamini nabezindaba eGoli izolo.Uthe bayichitha i-DA eyayifuna kube yi-ANC nayo kuphela kuhulumeni."Sakuchitha lokhu sathi sifuna namanye amaqembu abe yingxenye kahulumeni. Asikhathazekile ngokwenziwa ongqongqoshe be-DA, abasemkhankasweni wabo wokuziveza ukuthi bayasebenza. Uma ongqongqoshe be-ANC belele, kumele sikhulume nabo. Uma abe-DA besebenza emehlweni abantu yinto enhle leyo ngoba abantu bafuna izidingo,” kusho uMbalula.Mayelana nesimangalo esifakwe owayengumengameli wale nhlangano uMnuz Jacob Zuma, ofuna kuguqulwe isinqumo sokuxoshwa kwakhe kwi-ANC, uthe balinde isinqumo sekomiti ebelicubungula isinqumo sokumxosha. "Ngokwethu uxoshiwe, kusami kanjalo mayelana noZuma. Silinde isinqumo sekomiti elibuyekeza isinqumo sokuxoshwa kwakhe,” kusho uMbalula.Mayelana nomthetho wezikole okunomsindo ngawo iBela, uMbalula uthe uRamaphosa ubeke izinyanga ezintathu ukuthi kubhungwe ngezigatshana ezimbili, ezimiswe ukusebenza.Uthe emashini ebihlelwe yizinhlangano ezehlukene ne-DA ebiyingxenye yayo ngalo mthetho, bekuphethwe namafulegi amadala ezwe."Kusaxoxwa mayelana nalezi zigatshana zomthetho kodwa kukhona abasabisayo ngamafulegi ezwe amadala. Siyaqhubeka nalo mthetho wezikole,” kusho uMbalula.
OBHEKENE namacala okuqotha abayisishiyagalolunye eMlaza ngo-Agasti 11, 2023, usola omunye wofakazi ngokuthi nguyena owadubula wabulala umfowabo esigamekweni esenzeka ngoMashi 26.NgoLwesine, eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini, ummangalelwa uSphamandla Dlomo (25) ngomlomo wommeli wakhe, u-Advocate Masibonge Mathomane, utshele inkantolo ukuthi ufakazi kuleli cala, uMnuz Phiwayinkosi Sibisi, wadubula uMnuz Sakhile Ndlovu."Ikhasimende lami lizokutshela ukuthi uwena owadubula wabulala umfowabo, uSakhile Ndlovu. Angikaze ngimbulale mina umfowabo. Naye uyakwazi lokho. Uma ekwazi lokho, pho yini le eyadala ukuthi angayi emaphoyiseni ukuyongibika?'' kuziphendulela uSibisi.UDlomo utheswe amacala okubulala okuhleliwe oMlungisi Zuma, Phakamani Sibusiso Dlamini, Maxwell Sibisi, Regional Bongimpilo Ngema, Thabani Ngcobo, Mhlengi Khathi, Ayabongwa Mbayise, Sifundo Sibusiso Dlamini noSifiso Cele.Umshushisi izolo, uveze ukuthi bonke abasocongwa esigamekweni sango-Agasti badutshulwa ekhanda nasentanyeni.Nayizolo ummangalelwa ubematasa eqobela phansi bonke ubufakazi obebuthulwa enkantolo.Icala lizobuyela enkantolo ngoMsombuluko.
I-SOUTH African National Roads Agency (SANRAL) ithembisa ukuthi uzovulwa ekupheleni kwale nyanga umgwaqo owuthelawayeka u-N2 ngaseSiphingo.Lokhu kuvezwe yiPhini likaNgqongqoshe wezokuThutha kuzwelonke, uMnuz Mkhuleko Hlengwa, izolo.UHlengwa ubehambele le ndawo emva kokukhahlamezeka kwebhuloho eziMbokodweni kulandela imvula ebina ngamandla ngoLwesibili."AbakwaSANRAL bazimisele ngokuthi umgwaqo uvulwe esikhathini esilinganiselwa emasontweni amathathu kuya kwamane ezayo," kusho uHlengwa. Uthe ngokombiko abawuthole emva kokuthi ochwepheshe bakwaSANRAL behlole umonakalo, bathole ukuthi ukukhahlamezeka kwalo kudalwe ukuthi seligugile.Uthe lineminyaka engu-64 lakhiwa, wathi abakwaSANRAL bathe umonakalo awumubi kangako.Uthe phakathi kwezindlela abangazisebenzisa ukulungisa umonakalo ukuthi liphakanyiswe. "Okungenziwa masinyane yikho ukuthi liphakanyiswele phezulu ngoba emva kokuhlolwa komonakalo kubonakele ukuthi awumubi kangako,” kusho yena. Uthe bafuna ukuqinisekisa umphakathi ukuthi kuzoshaya uDisemba usulungisiwe umonakalo ongatheni odalekile. Udalule ukuthi belisanda kuhlolwa ngoFebhuwari nonyaka, u-98% wokuhlolwa kwalo waveza ukuthi konke kusahamba kahle ngalo. Abashayeli bezimoto ezisebenzisa umgwaqo ovaliwe kanye neminye esondelene nawo, bakhale ngokubambezeleka isikhathi eside uma behamba kule migwaqo.Omunye wabo uMnuz Sabelo Nxele, othe kungaba ngcono uma uhulumeni wesifundazwe noma uMasipala weTheku bengatshala amaphoyisa ukuthi azolawula isimo.IPHINI likaNgqongqoshe wezokuThutha kuzwelonke, uMnuz Mkhuleko Hlengwa (phakathi nendawo phambili), ehambele ibhuloho eziMbokodweni njengoba likhahlamezwe yimvula Isithombe: SITHUNYELWE "Uma kungaba khona amaphoyisa ezimpambanweni zale migwaqo, mhlawumbe ungabonakala umehluko, mhlawumbe kungalawuleka ukunyakaza kwezimoto," kusho uNxele.Omunye, uNkk Nokuthula Phungula waseBhekulwandle, eManzimtoti, uthe bathwala kanzima uma sebebuya emsebenzini.Uthe usebenza enkabeni yeTheku, wathi ngoLwesithathu kucishe kwaphelile amahora amathathu evaleleke esiminyaminyeni kule ndawo.IPHINI likaNgqongqoshe wezokuThutha kuzwelonke, uMnuz Mkhuleko Hlengwa, ehambele ibhuloho eziMbokodweni njengoba likhahlamezwe yimvula Isithombe: SITHUNYELWE "Namuhla ngizamile ukuthi ngisheshe ngishayise emsebenzini ngethemba lokuthi ngizohamba kangcono kodwa kubukeka kuzifanela ngoba sekuyophela amahora amabili ngibambeke la," kusho uNkk Phungula.Uthe okunye okudala isiminyaminya ukuthi abashayeli bamatekisi bavele baphendule umzila owodwa, ube yimizila emibili noma emithathu.

INKANTOLO iwachaze njengabantu abazenza oNkulunkulu empilweni ka-Andile "Bobo” Mbuthu (16) amadoda ambulala ngokuthanda kwawo futhi esebenzisa indlela eyayinesihluku nonya olwesabekayo.Lokhu kushiwo yimantshi uSanele Hlatshwayo ngesikhathi igweba o-Andile Nhleko (32), Mncedisi Mzobe (32), Lindani Ndlovu (26) noMalusi Mthembu (32) ngoLwesine.IZIHLOBO zikamufi, u-Andile 'Bobo’ Mbuthu oNkk Zodwa Jali ongumamncane wakhe noMnuz Ntobeko Ngidi ongumalume ngaphandle kweNkantolo yeMantshi yaseVerulam Isithombe: Simphiwe Ngubane INkantolo yeMantshi yaseVerulam igwebe uNhleko, uMzobe, noNdlovu isigwebo sikadilikajele umuntu ngamunye ngecala lokubulala, yababhansela ngeminye emithathu ngokuthumba umufi.UMthembu ugixabezwe ngesigwebo seminyaka engu-12 ngecala lokubulala neminye emithathu ngelokuthumba. Kuthiwe wabamba iqhaza elincane kwenziwa icala."Indlela enenza ngayo nayeka ukuba abantu ngosuku lwesigameko. Nenza isihluku futhi anikhombisanga ukuzisola ngakho enkantolo. Nibambezele inkantolo iminyaka emine ngento ebikade isobala ukuthi nayenza njengoba namanje nisaphika ukuthi nabulala,” kusho uHlatshwayo.Izolo, la madoda asole uzakwabo owaphenduka ufakazi woMbuso, athi ngokukhahlela kwakhe umufi esifubeni akholelwa wukuthi kwambulala. Wona athe amthintathinta nje.Phambilini, icala alisulela ngoMnuz Mlungisi Thabethe, osewashona futhi ochazwe yinkantolo ngomphehli wakho konke okwenzeka, athi nguyena owayalela ukuthi ashaywe uBobo.UHlatshwayo ukuthathe njengembudane okushiwo yiwona, wathi umufi wayeshaywa kusetshenziswa imvubu, induku yegalofu neye-hockey futhi ekhahlelwa okwenzeka eside isikhathi enganikwe thuba.Uthe la madoda asishaya indiva isicelo sikadadewabo kamufi owafika eshaywa ukuba ayiswe emtholampilo.Azikhalelile ecela ukuthanjiselwa isigwebo athi asemancane, ayaqala ukulahlwa yicala, awakaze agwetshwe phambilini futhi anezingane azinakekelayo.UHlatshwayo uthe lokhu kuyizizathu ezijwayelekile futhi ezingenaso isisindo uma kuqhathaniswa nendlela enonya okwabulawa ngayo uBobo.Inkantolo ithe izigwebo ngeke zimbuyise umufi kodwa ziqinisekisa ukuthi buyenziwa ubulungiswa. Imantshi ikhale ngokwanda kwamacala okubulala, yathi abawenzayo bayakhohlwa ukuthi abagilwa bangabantu nabo.Ithe kuwumsebenzi wenkantolo ukususa emphakathini ababulali, inqande abebesacabanga ukwenza amacala afanayo futhi ibuyise ithemba kubantu ngomsebenzi wezinkantolo. Uhambe emazwini kamshushisi uMnuz Ntuthuko Mngadi ocindezele la madoda ngobufakazi kwaze kwaba ayagwetshwa.UBobo washaywa washona endaweni yobumnandi eMagagula Lounge, eyayiseHambanathi, esolwa ngokweba utshwala.Isidumbu sakhe safakwa ebhuthini yemoto kwayiwa naso ephathini kaThabethe, kwayobhiyozwa, kwase kudlulelwa eBhamshela, lapho esashiswa khona ubusuku bonke.Ngakusasa ekuseni, izinsalela zaso zahlakazwa ngepiki zafakwa ezikhwameni nezitina zaphonswa emfuleni.Yavusa uhlevane nomunyu i-video yango-2020 eyayikhombisa uBobo eshaywa elele phansi egxiza igazi emabokobo.Umalume kaBobo, uMnuz Ntobeko Ngidi, uthe bayasijabulela isigwebo futhi umufi uzilwelile ngisho engasekho emhlabeni kwaze kwaba ababulali bakhe bayagwetshwa.UNgidi uthe bebelukhulekela lolu suku kwaze kwaba luyafika."Besiphila ngomthandazo ubusuku nemini. Sibonga ukwesekwa esikuthole ebantwini abasonta nonina kaBobo, umphakathi waseHambanathi neNingizimu Afrika yonkana. Isenzima impilo kadadewethu obekade engekho enkantolo ngoba yamhlukumeza kakhulu indlela okwathathwa ngayo impilo yendodana yakhe, eyayinobuhlakani,” kuchaza uNgidi.Amakholwa nabomndeni basijabulele isigwebo, bathi inkantolo ibenzile ubulungiswa.
KUVIYILEYE amabutho kwaqhuma nomkikizo izolo ngesikhathi iSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini, Ndunankulu Thami Ntuli noMengameli uCyril Ramaphosa bevula umfuziselo weLembe esikhumulweni sezindiza, iKing Shaka International Airport.Imikikizo neziqubulo beziqhuma isikhumulo sezindiza sonke ngesikhathi uZulu ujabulela ukuvulwa komfuziselo wombumbi wesizwe, uShaka kaSenzangakhona.Izikhulu zithe ukuvulwa komfuziselo kuzoheha izivakashi kuleli leNdlovukazi uMthaniya. Akugcinanga lapho, ngizwe sengathi umbumbi weSilo, iLembe, nalo linathi. ISilo esingizalayo neLembe banathi ngokwemimoya.”ISilo sincome iqhaza elabanjwa iLembe ngesikhathi libumba uZulu. Sithe iLembe kufanele linconywe ngokuvikela umhlaba. Indlulamithi yamakhosi iphinde yazibophezela ekuvikeleni umhlaba kaZulu. "Ngiyazibophezela kulabo abangasekho, abaphilayo nabangakazalwa ukuthi ngizolivikela izwe likaZulu impilo yami yonke. Nxa ngisaphila ngeke balithinte nina beSilo. Umhlaba uyikho konke kuZulu.”ISilo siphinde sakhala ngokuthi umlando awukuvezi ukuthi iLembe lalibuhlonipha ubuholi besifazane.URamaphosa uthe ukuvulwa komfuziselo kuzothuthukisa ezokuvakasha KwaZulu-Natal."Ngonyaka owedlule, baningi abantu abavakashela lapha KwaZulu-Natal bezobona ubuhle okukhona kubo ulwandle, ezemvelo nokuzofunda ngobukhosi. Lo mfuziselo awuzukugcina nje ngokuheha izivakashi eziqhamuka kuleli kodwa uzoheha neziqhamuka kwamanye amazwe.”URamaphosa uthe umlando weLembe wahlanekezelwa ngabamhlophe, wathi ufuna ukuthi ushintshwe.Kuke kwasuka isiphithiphithi ngesikhathi kuqhubeka umcimbi, lapho owesifazane ongaziwa ezame ukudlubulundela aye lapho bekuhleli khona iSilo noRamaphosa.KUBE nesiphithiphithi ngesikhathi owesifazane ezama ukuya lapho bekuhleli khona iSilo Isithombe: SIBONELO NGCOBOLona wesifazane obegqoke kahle uvinjwe abezokuphepha abagada uRamaphosa.Uwaqedile ngezimpama amaphoyisa kaMasipala weTheku ngesikhathi emhudula, emsusa phambi kwezicukuthwane.Ugcine edluliselwe kwabezempilo, abathe ukukhuluma naye kancane, babuye bamdedela.ISILO uMisuzulu kaZwelithini noNdunankulu kaZulu, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, emcimbini wokuvulwa komfuziselo weLembe Isithombe: SIBONELO NGCOBOUNDUNANKULU uThami Ntuli kuvulwa umfunziselo weLembe Isithombe: SIBONELO NGCOBOUMENGAMELI wezwe uCyril Ramaphosa esemcimbini wokuvulwa kwemfunziselo weLembe Isithombe: SIBONELO NGCOBOAMABUTHO ethe shaye ngesikhahti kuculwa umfunziselo weSilo uShaka izolo Isithombe: SIBONELO NGCOBO
