UMNYANGO wezeMfundo eGauteng usuyalele izikole ukuba zikumise ukudayiselwa kwabafundi ukudla ezikoleni nasezindaweni ezizizungezile.Umnyango uthi lesi sinqumo usithathe emuva kokwanda ngendlela exakile kwezigameko ezibikiwe zokugula kwabafundi abadle abasuke bekudayiselwe.Esitatimendeni osithumele abezindaba, lo mnyango oholwa uMnuz Matome Chiloane, uveze ukukhathazeka onakho ukuthi lezi zigameko sezikhiphe izidumbu, abanye bavuka ezibhedlela."Siqhamuke nohlelo olusheshayo oluzoqinisekisa abafundi ukuthi baphephile kuqinisekiswe nezempilo ezikoleni. Izikole nomkhandlu wabazali olawula isikole bayalelwe ukuba baqaphe futhi balawule abadayisa ukudla, izitolo nezinye izindawo ezidayisela abafundi ukudla,” kuchaza umnyango.Izikole zinikwe umyalelo wokuthi zivumele kudayiselwe abafundi ukudla okunempilo kuphela futhi okungaphelelwe yisikhathi kwafakwa emaphaketheni amasha.Kunxenxwa bonke abadayisa ukudla ukuthi balandele uMgomo 638, wangoJuni 22, 2018, wezokuphepha futhi ocacisa ngokudla okwamukelekile ezikoleni.Kuyalelwe abadayisa ukudla ezikoleni ukuba babe nesitifiketi esiyimvume esitholakala eMnyangweni wezeMpilo esibagunyaza ukuthi bahwebe ngokudla.UChiloane ukhuthaze ukuthi ilandelwe le migomo, wagqugquzela abazali benzele abafundi ukudla abazokudla esikoleni kunothi babanikeze imali yokuthenga. "Kumele bakwenze lokhu kuze kube isichitshiyelwe imigomo elawula abadayiswa kokudla ezikoleni,” kusho umphathiswa.Ukhuthaze kube imihlangano phakathi kwezikole nabamahlelo ehlukene emphakathini ukuze kugwenywe izehlo zokufa nokuphuthunyiswa kwabafundi ezibhedlela.Kushone abafundi abangu-12 eGauteng esikhathini esiyinyanga abadle ukudla okusolakala ukuthi bekunobuthi.
UMHOLI we-MK, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, uncome iqhaza loqweqwe lommeli wodumo u-Advocate Dali Mpofu, oshiye i-EFF ngeqhaza alibambile ekusungulweni kwe-MK, nasekuhlanganiseni amaqembu abamnyama. UZuma uthe uMpofu kudala esemkhankasweni wokuthi kuhlangane la maqembu ukuze kulwelwe abantu abamnyama. Usho lokhu emuva kokuba uMpofu ethuse abaningi, ememezela izolo ukuthi useshiyile kwi-EFF, wajoyina i-MK.UMpofu uzivumele ukuthi wayeyingxenye yokusungulwa kwe-MK.Ukushiya kukaMpofu kwi-EFF kuyizinkomba zokungenisa komfula kwi-EFF muva nje, eshiywa ubuthaphuthuphu abaholi abahlukene.Emuva kokushiya kukaMpofu, umholi we-EFF uMnuz Julius Malema, ubhale ku-X ukuthi uyazi kukhona izintandokazi zabaholi ababili abasasele, wathi kodwa bazoqhubeka bayibambe.UZuma unxuse amalungu e-MK ukuthi amukele uMpofu."UMpofu uthembekile, uzinikele futhi kudala esemzabalazweni. Ubambe elikhulu iqhaza ehlanganisa amaqembu amnyama, nangaphambi kokusungulwa kwe-MK. Inhloso yokuhlanganisa amaqembu amnyama ukulwa nokubuswa idlanzana labamhlophe,” kusho uZuma esitatimendini.Uveze ukuthi uMpofu kade aqala ukulwela inkululeko njengoba ayibamba esemncane. UMpofu ekhuluma neziteshi ezehlukene zethelevishini, uthe akananxa noMalema, waveza ukuthi kunesikhathi lapho yena noZuma kwakuyibona kuphela bantu ababazi ngokusungulwa kwe-MK."Yinto esaqala ukuyixoxa emuva kwengqungquthela ye-ANC ngo-2022. Saxoxa ngokwakumele kwenzeke.”Uthe unqume ukuthi ajoyine i-MK ngoba yilona qembu akholwa ukuthi lizokwazi ukubumba abantu abamnyama."Engikwenzile ngikwenzela abantu. Anginanxa noMalema, angizange ngimtshele ngesinqumo sokushiya kwami. Besingekho isidingo sokumazisa. Sisazohlangana naye ngoba akukho okubi, asixabene,” kusho uMpofu. UMpofu uyaziwa ngokumela i-MK emacaleni ahlukene enkantolo.Phakathi kwabaholi abalaxaze i-EFF bajoyina i-MK, kubalwa uMnuz Floyd Shivambu owayeyiphini likamengameli, uMnuz Mzwanele Manyi nowayenguMvikeli woMphakathi u-Advocate Busisiwe Mkhwebane.UMpofu uke waba ngusihlalo we-EFF iminyaka emihlanu kusuka ngo-2014. Umhlaziyi wezepolitiki, uSolwazi Ntsikelelo Breakfast, ucashunwe ethi akamangalanga ngalesi sinqumo sikaMpofu ngenxa yokuthi usondelele noZuma.Uthe abanye abantu abakwi-EFF kabeneme ngendlela uMalema enza ngayo izinto."Kuyacaca ukuthi kukhona ezinye izinto angafuni ukuphefumula ngazo ngezithinta i-EFF. Iyashayeka i-EFF ngokuhamba kwabaholi, ikakhulu abantu abebesezikhundleni eziphezulu.” Uthe i-EFF kumele izinuke amakhwapha izihlole ukuthi ifuna ukuthatha yiphi indlela ikakhulu njengoba izoba nengqungquthela yokukhetha abaholi, ngenyanga ezayo.
I-ACTION SA idalule ukuthi abantu bokufika bakweleta izibhedlela ezimbili zaseGauteng, uR1.1 billion ngokulashelwa umdlavuza.UNkk Emma More okhulumela i-ActionSA kwezempilo eGauteng, uveze ukuthi imali esetshenziswa ukwelapha abokufika ingasiza abantu bakuleli njengoba uMnyango wezeMpilo ungenayo imali eyanele."Asisho ukuthi abantu abangalutholi usizo lwezempilo kodwa kufanele ohulumeni bamazwe abo bakhokhele izindleko zokulashwa kwabo. Lapha sikhuluma ngabantu bokufika abakuleli ngokomthetho nalabo abasuke befikele ukulashelwa umdlavuza bese bebuyela emazweni abo. Isibhedlela iSteve Biko Academic sikweletwa uR400 million, iCharlotte Maxeke Academic ikweletwa uR700 million. Kufanele ohulumeni bamazwe anabantu abalashwa kuleli bakhokhe,” kusho uNkk More.Uthe abantu bokufika abalashelwa umdlavuza kuleli ngabaseZimbabwe, Lesotho, Malawi, Nigeria, Somalia, Congo, India, Rwanda, Pakistan nabanye."Asikwazi ukuqhubeka lesi simo kufanele uMnyango wezaseKhaya ulekelele owezeMpilo ukubheka ukuthi abantu abalashelwa umdlavuza nabathola ezinye izinsiza zempilo baphuma kumaphi amazwe. Emuva kwalokho kufanele kuxoxwe nohulumeni bamazwe abo ukuba bakhokhele izindleko zabo. Singalwenza nohlelo lokuthi abasuke bezolashelwa umdlavuza kube nemali abayikhokhayo ngaphambi kokulashwa. Kuyishwa ukuthi abantu abasuke sebelashwe izinyanga eziyisithupha bavele banyamalale njengoba uMnyango wezeMpilo uveze ukuthi ababe besatholakala emuva kokulashwa.”UNkk More uthe akakhulumi ngabantu bokufika abasuke beze kuleli ngoba bebalekela izimpi emazweni abo kodwa ukhuluma ngalabo abaze kuleli ngenhloso yokuthola usizo lwezempilo kodwa abasebenzisa izibhedlela zikahulumeni ngaphandle kokukhokha.Uthe kukhona abakuleli ngokusemthethweni nalabo abakuleli ngokungemthetho bonke bayalashwa mahhala ezibhedlela zikahulumeni.Akusikhona okokuqala kuvela ukuthi izindleko zabokufika ziyawusinda uMnyango wezeMpilo ngoba ngo-2022 uNdunankulu waseLimpopo, uDkt Phophi Ramathuba, wakhala ngokuthi baningi kakhulu abesifazane baseZimbabwe, abeza kuleli ngenhloso yokuzobeletha mahhala ezibhedlela zikahulumeni bese bebuyela emuva.
BASOLA ukuthi ugajwe yisikhwele kumholi we-ANC odubule wabulala isoka lentombi okusolwa ukuthi ibimbhangqile.Umsolwa ongusihlalo wegatsha le-ANC eliseVryheid, udubule wabulala uMnuz Mnotho Mbatha, ngeSonto ebusuku.Umsolwa obeyikhansela kuMasipala wasebaQulusi, kuthiwa ufike wavulela ngenhlamvu kuMbatha nasentombini (igama layo eligcine lingatholakalanga).Intombi kuthiwa isesimweni esibucayi esibhedlela esiseMgungundlovu.Isigameko senzeka emijondolo edume ngokuthi kuse-Dumping Site.Umsolwa kuthiwa uzinikele emaphoyiseni emva kwesigameko, kanti uzovela enkantolo namhlanje.Umalume kaMbatha, uMnuz Pilious Sikhosana, uthe badumele ngokubulawa komshana wakhe.USikhosana uthe bebengakatholi kahle ukuthi kwenzekeni kodwa wathi banethemba lokuthi bazothola konke uma umsolwa esevele enkantolo."Inkinga ukuthi uhlala kude, thina siseNquthu, yena ubehlala eVryheid.”Lo msolwa igama lakhe elingeke lidalulwe ngenxa yokuthi akakaveli enkantolo, ubeyikhansela le-IFP kodwa wabuye washiya wajoyina i-ANC.Njengamanje umsolwa kuthiwa usebenzela eminye yeminyango kahulumeni.USotswebhu we-DA kuMasipala wasebaQulusini, uMnuz Swelakhe Shelembe, ubabaze isihluku esenziwe umsolwa.UShelembe uthe bekukhona ingane eneminyaka emithathu endlini ngesikhathi kwenzeka isigameko."Umunyu esiwuficile, isimo esisificile, senza ukuthi kuhlengezele izinyembezi. Into yokuqala esiyitholile, ukuthi ngesikhathi edubula laba bantu ababili bekukhona ingane eneminyaka emithathu. Le ngane kuthiwa iphume yeqa isidumbu, yahamba yayotshela abantu ukuthi nangu u (emgagula ngegama) edubula ubaba nomama.”UShelembe unxuse ubuholi be-ANC esifundeni iMzala Nxumalo ukuba buthathele umsolwa izinyathelo."Siyafisa ukuthi i-ANC ithathele izinyathelo zangaphakathi lomuntu owenze isihluku esinje ekubeni ephethe isikhundla sokuhola emphakathini. Uyena okufanele engabe uvikela umphakathi kodwa ukwazi ukubulalala umuntu wesifazane ngenxa nje yokugajwa ile nto ebimgabhile.”UShelembe uthe umsolwa ubewuhlalise lubhojozi umphakathi."Umphakathi njengamanje uthi uhlalele ovalweni ngoba uthi lo mlisa ubehlezi eqhumisa isibhamu. Siyalwa nokuthi athole ibheyili ngoba umphakathi ngeke uzizwe uphephile.”Unobhala we-ANC esifundeni iMzala Nxumalo, uMnuz Ntokozo Nxumalo, uthe bese beluzwile udaba kodwa wathi ubengakayitholi imininingwane ephelele.UNxumalo ucele ukuba abuye ashayelwe uma esesehhovisi, kepha akabange esalubamba ucingo eseshayelwa futhi.Amaphoyisa aseKZN agcine engayiphendulanga imibuzo athunyelelwe ngayo ngalesi sehlo.
AKAZIBONI exolela owayeyintombi yakhe eyazama ukumbulala owesilisa, eyamchathisa nge-acid ithi isiwasho, yamphuzisa yona ngenkani, yagcina imbhunyela ngayo ibona ukuthi akafi, wabucuka ubuso nomzimba.Usho kanje uMnuz Phakamani Sibiya (34) emva kokugojelwa ngamacala kukaPrincess Lethiwe Mthimkhulu (30).INkantolo yeMantshi yaseVerulam ilahle uLethiwe ngecala lokuzama ukubulala nelokweba iselula kaSibiya esehlakalweni esenzeka ngo-Ephreli 13, 2022 oThongathi, eThekwini."Uxolo alukho futhi asikaze sikhulume indaba yokuthi sengimxolele. Okwamanje uxolo lwakhe angilwamukelile, kuyongithatha isikhathi eside ukuthi ngidlule kule simo engikusona manje,” kuchaza uSibiya.Ubalule ukuthi njengamanje ugqigqa kodokotela, uyahlinzwa ukuze asizakale okuyiyona nto emsizayo. Ufuna ajeze uLethiwe ngamenza khona kanti uthe noma angavalelwa ejele kulungile sekuyoba inkantolo ebona isigwebo esimfanele.Umalume kaSibiya, uMnuz Mduduzi Mtshali, uthe: 'wawuphuma uhlukumezekile esibhedlela eNkosi Albert Luthuli uma uzobona umshana wakhe "owayeyisilwane” futhi "ebolile”Uthe bahlukumezekile futhi akanabo ubuntu kodwa unobulwane uLethiwe ofanelwe isigwebo esiqine kakhulu. Uveze ukuthi bahlangane nomndeni kaLethiwe ngoLwesihlanu uzocela uxolo."Ubulungiswa obungatholwa uPhakamani obokuthi athole i-plastic surgery futhi alulekwe ngokwengqondo, abuyelwe isithunzi abe wumuntu. Uma kwenzeka athole umsebenzi angathembeli komunye umuntu,” kusho uMtshali othe bayethuka abantu uma bebona umshana wakhe.Uveze ukuthi inhloso kaLethiwe kwakuwukuthi abulale uSibiya futhi afele endlini yakhe kube sengathi ubeyedwa ezichathela.IMantshi uSanele Hlatshwayo ithe izogweba uLethiwe ngoDisemba 11. Ummeli kaLethiwe uMnuz Denver Reddy umcelele ukuthi akangagwetshwa izolo. Isizathu kube wukuthi unezingane ezimbili ezisencane nokuthi kusamele kwenziwe umbiko wosonhlalakahle nowoMnyango wezokuHlunyeleliswa.Ngeledlule uLethiwe watshela inkantolo ukuthi uSibiya wayemhlukumeza futhi emshaya nokuthi ngosuku lwesehlakalo wumgilwa owajikijela yena kuqala nge-acid wazivikela ngokuthi ayiphindisele, yamshisa.Ushaye ungqimphothwe izolo wavuma icala, waxolisa kuSibiya wathi wayefuna ukumbulala elekelelwa uMnuz Moses Jobe ogcwele izinkalo, agcina ukumbona kwenzeka isigameko. ULethiwe uthe wayehlala noJobe endlini eyodwa eflethini futhi bengebona abangani kodwa behlanganyela irenti eyayimba eqolo. Uthe icala ubeliphika ngoba esaba ukuboshwa ashiye ingane yakhe esencane. Kuvele ukuthi enye yezingane akhuluma ngazo inonyaka, wakhulelwa futhi wateta sesadlula kudala isigameko.Uthe sebeyakhuluma noSibiya futhi usemxolele okuyinto ayihleke usulu enkantolo uSibiya.Uvumile wathi uyazisola ngesenzo asenza egajwe yintukuthelo, wayehlose ukumbulala uSibiya. Enye into athe imvumise icala wubufakazi obuqanda ikhanda obebumcindezela.Imantshi ithe igculisekile futhi iyabemukela ubufakazi obethulwe uMbuso obuholwe umshushisi uMnuz Ntuthuko Mngadi.Ngosuku lwesigameko kuthiwa uLethiwe wavakashela uSibiya kwakhe kuvunyelwene, wafike wamnikeza uchatho wathi lunesiwasho kanti yi-acid. Kwathi uma ezichatha uSibiya wezwa i-acid imshisa esiswini.USibiya wafuna usizo lokuba aphuthunyiswe emtholampilo, uLethiwe wathatha ifoni yakhe (uSibiya) ewumuntu ozofonela umshayeli wemoto ekhokhelwa ngebanga elihambile.Emva kwesikhathi kwafika umshayeli uMcineka, owayazana noLethiwe wabathatha bobabili wahamba nabo."Endleleni ebheke emtholampilo, uLethiwe wayalela uMcineka ukuthi angabe esaya emtholampilo kodwa abaye eflethini lakhe lapho bagibeza khona owesilisa (uSibiya noMcineka) ababengamazi owayefake isigqoko ezimboze ubuso. Esegibele owesilisa, imoto kwathiwa ayiye ngasesitebeleni samahhashi esingasesikhumulweni sezindiza,” kusho uHlatshwayo.Uqhube wathi sekufikiwe kule ndawo, uLethiwe nale ndoda okuvela ukuthi wuJobe, baphuma emotweni baxoxa kancane babuyela emotweni.Kuthiwa uLethiwe watshela uMcineka ukuthi ashayele imoto kuyiwe lapho kuhlala khona uSibiya, nokuyilapho afike abashiya khona wathi akasayingeni indaba yabo, wahamba.Kuthiwa uSibiya wangena endlini wayolala embhedeni, kanti uLethiwe noJobe bazombamba bamcindezele embhedeni bamphuzise ngenkani i-acid eyayimshisa emlonyeni, ezindebeni nasemakhaleni kodwa wasukuma walwa.Kwathi lapho uSibiya noJobe bebambene belwa, uLethiwe walanda ibhakede elalinenye i-acid wabhunyela ngalo umgilwa washa lonke uhlangothi lwangakwesokunxele kusukela ekhanda.Kuvele ukuthi umgilwa wavala amehlo, waphuthaza umnyango wendlu waphumela ngaphandle wamemeza efuna usizo komakhelwane.USibiya kuthiwa waphuthunyiswa esibhedlela oSindisweni, wadluliselwa e-Addington nakhona bamdlulisela eNkosi Albert Luthuli lapho ahlala khona izinyanga eziyisithupha elashwa. Uthe uSibiya walimala kabi kwasuka nendlebe izibazi zibonwa iwona wonke umuntu.ULethiwe ubuvumile lobu bufakazi wathi i-acid wayinikezwa uJobe futhi uyena owathi akangayiswa esibhedlela uSibiya. Uphikile ukuthi weba ifoni kamgilwa.Eselahlwe yicala eseyiswa ezitokisini, ukhihle isililo kwaze kwasondela unina. Emuva kwekhefu ube esencengelwa ummeli ukuba adedelwe ngoba unezingane ezincane. Yeluliwe futhi yengezwa ibheyili adedelwe ngayo eselahlwe yicala uLethiwe yaba uR3 000 isuka ku-R1 500. Unina oyisangoma nezihlobo zakhe batatazele kuhle kwekhehla liganwa beyihlanganisa bagcina begoduke naye.
LIDUME lawathatha egwetshwa odilikajele amadoda amathathu, kwamane, athumba abulala u-Andile "Bobo” Mbuthu (16) ngesihluku oThongathi, eThekwini.OWAYENGUMFUNDI ka-matric, u-Andile 'Bobo’ Mbuthu owashaywa washona esolwa ngokweba utshwala Isithombe: SigciniweINkantolo yesiFunda yaseVerulam igwebe o-Andile Nhleko (32), Mncedisi Mzobe (32) noLindani Ndlovu (26) ngoLwesine emini.IMantshi uSanele Hlatshwayo iphinde yabagweba iminyaka emithathu umuntu ngamunye ngecala lokuthumba.UMalusi Mthembu ugwetshwe iminyaka engu-12 ngecala lokubulala nemithathu ngelokuthumba. Inkantolo ithi wabamba iqhaza elincane ngosuku lwesigameko.UHlatshwayo uchaze la madoda njengabantu abangasakulungele ukuphatha isibhamu impilo yawo yonke, wayalela ukuthi uma enezibhamu, izinhlamvu nelayisensi yakho amaphoyisa akushaqe.Akhombise ukudangala egwetshwa la madoda, uNhleko noMzobe behlafuna into engapheli. UNdlovu obefake isifonyo ubelokhu egebisa ikhanda, uMthembu ebukeke ekude ngomcabango egqolozele uHlatshwayo.Ummeli wabo uMnuz Mondli Ndlela, uthe uyalelwe yilawa madoda ukuthi akuphonsele inselelo ukulahlwa kwawo ngecala nesigwebo.UMthembu uzobuya kule nkantolo ngoDisemba 3, ezofaka lesi sicelo. Abagwetshwe odilikajele bona bayalelwe ukuthi baye eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini, uma befuna ukwenza okufana nokukaMthembu.Izigwebo zabo bazozidonsa kanyekanye.Inkantolo ibigcwele abantu abebevela ezinhlangothini ezimbili okungabebezokweseka umndeni kamufi nezihlobo zamadoda agwetshiwe.Ngaphandle kwenkantolo amakholwa nabomndeni kaBobo bavele bahlabelele bebonga uMdali. Bathe sibageze ngaphakathi isigwebo.UBobo washaywa wafa eMagagula Lounge, eHambanathi, ngo-2020, esolwa ngokweba utshwala. Washiswa ubusuku bonke, ngakusasa ekuseni izinsalela zesidumbu zahlakazwa ngepiki zafakwa ezikhwameni ezaphonswa emfuleni.Yavusa uhlevane nomunyu i-video eyayikhombisa uBobo eshaywa elele phansi egxiza igazi emabokobo.
INDUNA esidonse isikhathi eside iphethe ihostela elinomlando iDenver eGoli, igubhe usuku lwayo lokuzalwa okokuqala ngqa, ihlanganisa iminyaka engu-88 idla anhlamvana.UShalazile Mbatha, osebe yinduna yakuleli hostela isikhathi eside, ubegubha usuku lokuzalwa okokuqala selokhu aba khona emhlabeni.Uthe wayengakaze azibone egubha usuku lwakhe lokuzalwa kodwa ukujabulele ukuthi akubanga khona ngisho nomsindo kuleli hostela, wathi kuyaziwa ukuthi ukuqhuma kwezibhamu kuyimpilo yakhona. Uthe ubeqala ngqa ukugubha usuku lokuzalwa selokhu abakhona."Kufike uLesedi Badisang woBuhle Bamabhinca, obuze ukuthi sengineminyaka emingaki yobudala. Ngimtshele ukuthi angiyazi iminyaka yami, wabheka umazisi engicabanga ukuthi ubone kuwona ukuthi ngimngakanani. Emva kwalokho ungazise ngosuku okuzogujwa ngalo usuku lwami lokuzalwa. Njengenduna esinesikhathi eside ikuleli hostela bengingazi ukuthi kumnandi kangaka ukugubha usuku lokuzalwa. Kade ngaba yinduna kanti nasehostela sengineminyaka ngihlala khona futhi baningi nabaculi bakamaskandi abahlale khona ngiphethe njengenduna yakhona. Okungijabulisile usuku lwami lokuzalwa lube yimpumelelo ngoba akekho ngisho noyedwa oke waqhumisa isibhamu,” kusho uShalazile.UShalazile uyinduna esinesikhathi eside futhi waziwa njengenduna yasehostela ehlonishwayo. Udabuka eBhubesini, eMsinga, kanti waqala ukuba yinduna ngesikhathi sodlame phakathi kwe-IFP, ne-ANC. Ihostela iDenver, linomlando onothile ngoba baningi abaculi bakamaskandi abake bahlala kulona. Phakathi kwabo singabala Ikhansela elalize licule ngaleli hostela, uThokozani Langa, Izingane Zoma, uMtsheniseni "Indidane” Gcwensa nabanye.Leli hostela lagqama nangokuthi kuqoshelwe kulona umdlalo wethelevishini wamahlaya, Umuzi Wezinsizwa. ULesedi Badisang woBuhle Bamabhinca uthe kummangazile ukuthi uMbatha akakaze alugubhe usuku lwakhe lokuzalwa selokhu abakhona, wase ehlela ukuthi alugubhe.
IDEDELWE ngebheyili kaR20 000 indoda edabuka ePakistan ebinehhovisi loMnyango wezaseKhaya eliwumgunyathi eGreyville, eThekwini.UMnuz Khalid Hoosen (58) nesisebenzi sakhe uMnuz Sirajbhai Patel (56) wase-India, basolwa ngokuzenza abasebenzi balo mnyango futhi bakhiqize ngokungemthetho amaphepha endaweni engagunyaziwe ukwenza lo msebenzi.Kusolakala ukuthi ihhovisi labo belisiza abokufika abanye babo abebeze bashadiswe nabesifazane bakuleli imishado eqala kuR18 000.Bavele okwesibili eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini ngoMsombuluko kulandela ukuboshwa kwabo ngesonto eledlule.Baboshelwe ehhovisi abebekade besebenzela kulona ebhilidini elisemgwaqweni uMatthews Meyiwa eGreyville, eThekwini.Ngokwamaphepha asenkantolo, umshushisi akasiphikisanga isicelo sokuba abasolwa badedelwe ngebheyili.Kunalokho uphakamise ukuthi uma begcina benikwa ibheyili, kumele kube ngekaR50 000 umuntu emunye. UHoosen wafika ngo-1999 eNingizimu Afrika esuka ePakistan njengoba manje eseyisakhamuzi. Phambilini kuvele ukuthi wafika washada nowesifazane wakuleli, wathola ubuzwe, wase efaka incwadi yesehlukaniso somshado, wase elanda inkosikazi yakhe ayeyishiye ePakistan.UPatel kuthiwa usenegunya lokuba seNingizimu Afrika ingunaphakade.Kuvele nokuthi abasolwa awekho amacala ake abalahla esikhathini esidlue futhi alikho elinye icala abalihambayo enkantolo ngaphandle kwalawa ababoshelwe wona manje.Imantshi u-T. Mathibe ibanike ibheyili kaR20 000 umuntu emunye yase ibeka umbandela wokuthi baye kosayina esiteshini samaphoyisa iDurban Central kanye ngesonto.Kulindeleke nokuthi banikeze umphenyi izincwadi zabo zokuhambela amanye amazwe.Enkantolo kuvele nokuthi icala abathweswe lona liqukethe isigwebo senhlawulo noma iminyaka emibili umuntu ebhadla ejele.Icala lihlehlele uFebhuwari 15, 2025.
I-DA isidonse ngendlebe abantu bakuleli ukuba baqhubeke nokulwa nezinhlelo ze-Eskom zokunyusa ugesi ngemali eningi ngoba le nkampani imosha imali.UMnuz Kevin Mileham okhulumela iDA kwezamandla nogesi ePhalamende, uthe i-Eskom imoshe uR840 million yakha izindlu ezazizohlala abasebenzi bayo eWilge eMpumalanga kodwa manje azinamuntu."Sithole ukuthi izindlu zaseWilge zashiywa kanjalo, uphahla lubhodlokile futhi akukho okukhombisa ukuthi kukhona umuntu oyoke ahlale kuzo yize zadla uR840 million. I-Eskom yayithe izokwakha idolobha elincane elizoba seduze nesiteshi iKusile kodwa manje asikuboni kwenzeka lokho.”Uthe ngonyaka odlule i-Eskom ilahlekelwe wu-R24 billion kodwa ayizange ichaze kabanzi ngalokhu njengoba ingasaphoqwa wumthetho iPublic Finance Management Act ukuba idalule konke ngemali yayo."Abantu kufanele bangavumi ukuthi i-Eskom inyuse ugesi ngoba lokhu kuzonyusa izindleko zikagesi ngo-40%. Vele uyabiza kuyimanje kanti i-Eskom imosha imali bese ifihlela umphakathi. Sifuna iyochaza ePhalamende ngalo R840 million omoshwe kwakhiwa izindlu ezingahlali muntu. Sifuna kuqiniswe izinhlelo zokusebenza kwemali kule nkampani kahulumeni,” kusho uMileham.I-Eskom ayizange iyiphendule imibuzo yeSolezwe ngalolu daba.Khonamanjalo i-Eskom ithe ngeke kuphazamiseke ukuphehlwa kukagesi emuva kokuqubuka komlilo esiteshini sikagesi iKriel.Kuvele ukuthi ngeSonto ntambama kuye kwaqubuka umlilo emuva kokuqhuma kwepayipi elinamafutha ashisayo asuke esetshenziswa wumshini ophehla ugesi obizwa nge-unit 6.Lo mshini uphehla ugesi owu-275MW kanti uye wayeka ukusebenza emuva kokuthi ungasawatholi amafutha njengoba kuqhume ipayipi.UNksz Daphne Mokwena, okhulumela i-Eskom, uthe ukungasebenzi kwalo mshini akusho ukuthi ugesi usuzonqamuka njengoba izinhlelo zabo zokuphehla ugesi zizoqhubeka njengokujwayelekile."Akekho umsebenzi olimele ngesikhathi kuqhuma ipayipi lamafutha okudale umlilo eKriel. Abasebenzi basilungisile isimo njengoba kuwumshini owodwa kuphela othikamezekile. Siyabathembisa abantu ukuthi ukungasebenzi komshini ngeke kuphazamise ukuphehlwa kukagesi,” kusho uNksz Mokwena.
NAKUBA ikushayela elikhulu ihlombe ukudutshulwa kwezinkabi eziqotha abemboni ngamaphoyisa i-South African National Taxi Council (Santaco), kodwa ifisa sengathi kungakhona noma oyedwa osalayo ukuze acule.Lokhu kushiwo umphathi wehhovisi leSantaco KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Sfiso Shangase, kulandela isigameko sokudutshulwa kubulawe izinkabi ezine ngamaphoyisa ngoMsombuluko.UShangase uthe bayawuncoma kakhulu umsebenzi wamaphoyisa uma ebulala izinkabi eziqotha osomatekisi.Uthe akekho umuntu onelungelo lokuthatha umphefumulo womunye umuntu embonini, wathi noma ngabe kukhona ukungaboni ngaso linye, kufanele ingabe kuhlalwa phansi, ilungiswe ngomlomo."Uma sebelandelwa amaphoyisa efuna ukubabopha, bona bajike badubule, sithi iso ngeso. Yize sikujabulela lokhu kodwa siye sibe nesifiso sokuthi engathi kungasala noma oyedwa ukuze ezosho ukuthi ubani osuke ebathumile,” kusho uShangase.Uthe ukufa kwabo bonke abasolwa kwenza ukuthi ligcine lingaphumanga iqiniso lokuthi basuke bethunywe ubani ukuthi bayobulala osomatekisi.ISIBHAMU esikhulu esitholwe amaphoyisa emva kokuqotha izinkabi Isithombe: KZN SAPS "Uma umsuka usasele, usuke usengabheka ezinye izinkabi, uqhubeke nokuzikhokhela ukuze ziqhubeke nomsebenzi omubi. Kodwa ke akukho okusuke kungenziwa amaphoyisa ngaphandle kokudubula abulale uma nawo ehlaselwa ethi ayobopha,” kubeka uShangase.Esitatimendeni esithunyelwe okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, isigameko sokudutshulwa kwezinkabi senzeke eMooi River.Uthe omunye wezinkabi ezibulewe ubefunelwa ukubulala osomatekisi baseBergville ezigamekweni ezehlukene ezenzeke kulo nyaka."Ubefunelwa amacala okubulawa kukasihlalo kasoseshini wamatekisi (eBergville) nesekela lakhe ngoFebhuwari nangoJuni kulo nyaka. Ubefunelwa nanesigameko sokudutshulwa komunye usomatekisi erenke yaseBergiville lapho okwaze kwadubuleka khona nomgibeli, owashawa inhlamvu eyayindiza emoyeni,” kusho uNetshiunda.Uthe le nkabi ibifunelwe nanesigameko sokuzama ukubulala usomatekisi waseWinterton ngoJuni nonyaka.Uthe emva kwesiwombe, amaphoyisa athole izibhamu ezimbili; esikhulu nesincane kanjalo nezinhlamvu."Izibhamu zizoyohlolwa ukuze kubhekwe ukuthi azibandakanyeki yini kobunye ubugebengu obunodlame esifundazweni nasezweni lonkana,” kusho yena.Ubalule ukuthi nakuba imoto ebihamba amaphoyisa iphelile yizinhlamvu kodwa alikho iphoyisa elilimale.Uthe kwenzeka lesi sigameko nje, amaphoyisa abelandela umkhondo wokuthi abasolwa baseMooi River. Uthe athe uma emisa imoto ebebehamba ngayo, kuthelawayeka uN3, umshayeli uvele wabaleka ngesivinini wayojika umgwaqo obheke eMtshezi, uR103. Uthe bathe besuka badubula bebhekise emaphoyiseni, nawo ase ebuyisela ngenhlamvu.
UKHALE mi izinyembezi oyilungu lesigungu esilwa nobugebengu emphakathini, ethula ubufakazi mayelana necala lokuqothwa kwabayisishiyagalolunye eMlaza, elibhekene nowesilisa oneminyaka engu-25.UMnuz Phiwayinkosi Sibisi ubethula ubufakazi eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini, lapho obekuvele khona ummangalelwa, uMnuz Siphamandla Dlomo.UDlomo uthweswe amacala awu-13; kuwona okukhona ukubulala abantu abayisishiyagalolunye, amabili okuzama ukubulala, elokugqekeza nelokutholakala nesibhamu esingekho emthethweni.UDlomo uvele wawaphika wonke amacala, wathi kusezandleni zoMbuso ukuthi ulethe ubufakazi obuphathekayo bokuthi uyena owakwenza.USibisi obe ngufakazi wesibili ecaleni, uqale wachaza ngobudlelwano bakhe noDlomo, athe babukade bubuhle ngaphambilini.Uvele wakhihla esikaNandi ngesikhathi esechaza ngosuku lwesigameko sango-Agasti 11, 2023.Ubebonakala ebuka ummangalelwa kube sengathi ufisa ukumbamba ngezandla, ekhala aze abheke phezulu azesule ngethawula izinyembezi. Abuye aphuze namanzi abewabeke eduze kwakhe.IJaji uSophia Steyn limbuze kaningi uSibisi ukuthi ukahle yini ukuthi angaqhubeka nokuthula ubufakazi?Uvukwe kakhulu umunyu ngesikhathi esechaza kabanzi ngokwenzeka ngalolu suku."Ngambona uSphamandla ephethe isibhamu ngaphakathi endlini encike ngehlombe odongweni. Mina ngangingemuva kwakhe. Ngalwela ukuthi akaphenduke ukuze ngimbambe isandla aphethe ngaso isibhamu,'' usho kanje.Zimane zazehlela kakhulu izinyembezi kuyena ngesikhathi esechaza ukuthi babanga isibhamu waze walimala esandleni.Uthe kwatholakala amagobolondo ezinhlamvu ezimbili ngaphakathi ejakhethini yakhe ayekade eyigqokile."Ngambuza ukuthi ufunani lana, wangiphendula ngokuthi uzolanda umazisi wakhe,'' echaza.USibisi ubekade eqale wachaza ukuthi umazisi kaDlomo wawuyisa emaphoyiseni emveni kokuba ethe wawuthola eduze kwezidumbu ezintathu zababulawa bephuma ethaveni ekwa-Q, eMlaza, ngoMashi 27 nyakenye.Kuleso sigameko kwabulawa umfowabo kaDlomo ayekade ehilizisane naye ngayizolo kade bephuza, uMnuz Sakhile Ndlovu. Abanye ababili ababulawa kuleso sigameko nguMndeni (esingatholakalanga isibongo sakhe) noDani Ndlebe.USibisi uthe uDlomo ufike eMlaza ngoJanuwari 2023, esuka eMbumbulu, ezohlala kubo elethwa uNdlovu.Uthe ngoMashi 26, babephuza kanti kuzosuka uthuthuva phakathi kukaNdlovu noDlomo kubangwa ukuthi kukhona umuntu owafa lapho ababekade beye khona bobabili.USibisi uthe kwathi uma ewuthola lo mazisi eduze kwezidumbu wabona ukuthi akawuthathe awuyise kubaphenyi."Ngamshayela ucingo uDlomo ngisendaweni yesigameko okwakubulawe khona abantu abathathu, ngimbuza ukuthi uSakhile nomazisi wakhe (uDlomo) ukephi. Waphendula umbuzo owodwa, wathi umazisi wakhe usekhaya,'' usho kanje.Uthe ngemuva kwalokho, wabona ukuthi asikho isidingo sokuthi aphinde axhumane naye ngoba wambona njengomuntu ongathembekile.USibisi uthe yiloyo mazisi ke uDlomo ayesewufuna ngodli ngosuku lwesibhicongo sango-Agasti 11.Kusolakala ukuthi isibhamu okwaqothwa ngaso abathathu ngoMashi, saphangwa uMnuz Buhle Freedom Zuma.UDlomo ubebukeka ekhulelekile njengoba ubephethe ipeni nephepha njengabameli eqopha konke obekukade kwethulwa ofakazi.Ngaphambi kwalokho uDlomo, ubukane nowesifazane okusolakala ukuthi uyisinqandamathe sakhe, maqede bamamatheka bobabili. Uphinde wabonakala ecifelana iso nomunye wesilisa okukholakala ukuthi uhlobene naye.UDlomo ubebabuka ngeso elibi bonke abantu angabazi ebebesenkantolo.Ngaphambi kukaSibisi, kuqale kwafaka iphoyisa uConstable Kyle Chetty osebenza esiteshini samaphoyisa saseMlaza, echaza ukuthi uyena nomunye uzakwabo abafika kuqala endaweni yesigameko.Kuvele nokuthi uDlomo wazama ukubulala uSibisi nentombi yakhe uNksz Zandile Shangase. Wazama nokugqezeka umuzi kaSibisi.Utheswe amacala okubulala okuhleliwe oMlungisi Zuma, Phakamani Sibusiso Dlamini, Maxwell Sibisi, Regional Bongimpilo Ngema, Thabani Ngcobo, Mhlengi Khathi, Ayabongwa Mbayise, Sifundo Sibusiso Dlamini noSifiso Cele.Owayengummangalelwa wesibili kuleli cala, uMnuz Zimisele Ngcongo, kuvele ukuthi wendela koyisemkhulu ngoJanuwari nonyaka.Icala liyaqhubeka namhlanje.
INDODAKAZI yomholi weMK, uJacob Zuma, uNkk Duduzile Zuma-Sambudla, iqokelwe esikhundleni esibalulekile ePhalamende lase-Afrika, iPan African Parliament.UNkk Zuma-Sambudla uqokelwe kwesikasihlalo wezithunywa eziqhamuka emazweni aseNingizimu yezwekazi.Uqokwe emhlanganweni wePan African Parliament oqhubekayo, wehlule uSotswebhu omkhulu ePhalemende lakuleli, uMnuz Mdumiseni Ntuli, ngamavoti angu-17 kwangu-12.IPhalamende lase-Afrika lihlukaniswe kahlanu, isifunda esiseNingizimu, esiseNhla, esiPhakathi, esiseMpumalanga nesiseNtshonalanga.Emazweni aseNingizimu kukhona iBotswana, Eswatini, Malawi, Mozambique, Namibia, Ningizimu Afrika, Lesotho, Zambia neZimbabwe.UNkk Zuma-Sambudla ubhale ekhasini lakhe enkundleni yezokuxhumana i-X, ezwakalisa ukujabula kwakhe."Ngivumeleni ukuba ngiphinde ngizethule kini, usihlalo omusha wezithunywa zamazwe aseNingizimu ezijutshwe kwiPan African Parliament, gwaza Mkhonto.”INingizimu Afrika inezithunywa ezine ePhalamende lase-Afrika, okunguNkk Zuma-Sambudla, Ntuli, uMnuz Vuyani Pambo we-EFF noMnuz Mergan Chetty weDA.Okhulumela iMK, uMnuz Nhlamulo Ndhlela, uthe kusho lukhulu ukuqokwa kukaNkk Zuma-Sambudla."Ubuholi beMK buyakholelwa ebuholini babantu besifazane. Siyakholelwa ekutheni abantu besifazane kufanele baqokelwe ezikhundleni ezibalulekile ezwenikazi. Njengeqembu siyabuthemba ubuholi bukaNkk Zuma-Sambudla, asikungabazi ukuthi uzowenza ngendlela encomekayo umsebenzi wakhe. "Siyazi ukuthi uzobeka phambili izidingo zabantu basemazweni aseNingizimu yezwekazi. Simufisela inhlanhla njengoba ezothatha uMkhonto wakhe ayolwela abantu abacindezelekile.”UNdhlela uthe le sikhundla simfanele umuntu weMK."Kuyasijabulisa ukuthi sithi singakaqedi nonyaka sasungulwa, bese sithola isikhundla sikasihlalo wamazwe aseNingizimu ye-afrika. Njengeqembu elibeka phambili izidingo zabantu base-Afrika, igcagcele esokeni ngokunikwa ithuba elifana naleli. Le sikhundla sisinika ithuba lokuthi sizakhele igama.”
UNGQONGQOSHE wamaPhoyisa kuleli uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, unxusa amaphoyisa ukuthi aqaphele uma eqhuba umsebenzi wawo. Lokhu kwenzeka ngemva kwesigameko okusolwa ukuthi iphoyisa lidubule ngephutha ozakwabo ngesikhathi kuphunywe inqina ukuyobopha obeshaya intombi ngeSonto ebusuku, eBhobhoyi, ePort Shepstone.Esigamekweni esishiye abaningi bebambe ongezansi, kuthiwa amaphoyisa ayisishiyagalombili anikele endaweni yesigameko. Kuthiwa kuthe uma amathathu abehamba phambili ekhahlela isicabha engena ngaphakathi endlini, kusolakala ukuthi kukhona kuwo eliphonse ngaphakathi okusabhomu yesandla eyisisi esikhalisa unyembezi. Ngesikhathi kunokuqhuma kushunqa intuthu, kusolwa ukuthi iphoyisa lesifazane ebelingaphandle lidubule labhekisa ngalapho kungene khona ozakwabo, okuthiwa belisola ukuthi bayahlaselwa. Kulesi sigameko kushone iphoyisa elilodwa elingu-sergeant, kwathi elinye langeniswa esibhedlela lilimele.Esitatimendeni esithunyelelwe abezindaba yihhovisi likaMchunu, uthe kubalulekile ukuthi amaphoyisa alandele imigudu yokusebenza.Umbhalo ngokwesitatimende sehhovisi likaMchunu, uthi: "Kumele kuqinisekiswe ukuxhumana okucacile nezinga eliphezulu lokuphepha lamaphoyisa nomphakathi abawusebenzelayo. Sazisiwe wuphiko oluphenya amacala enziwa ngamaphoyisa i-Independent Investigative Directorate, ukuthi uphenyo ngalolu daba luyaqhubeka. Sinxusa lolu phiko ukuthi luqinise uphenyo ukuze kucaciswe ngalesi sigameko, nabathintekile bazi ngokwenzekile.”Ungqongqoshe uthe uphenyo lwe-Ipid lubaluleke kakhulu ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abathintekayo bayaphendula kanti luzoba yisifundo esibalulekile ukuvikela lo mshophi ukuthi ungenzeki ngesikhathi esilandelayo.UMchunu udlulise amazwi enduduzo emndenini wephoyisa elidlule emhlabeni, wafisela elingeniswe esibhedlela ukwelulama okusheshayo.

UMKHONTO ugwaze ekhaya iphoyisa libulala uzakwabo ngephutha, kwathi omunye wangeniswa esibhedlela elimele, okwenzeke eBoboyi, ePort Shepstone, ngeSonto ebusuku.Kuthiwa amaphoyisa ayisithupha ophiko lwe-Public Order Policing namabili ophiko lwezinja abizelwe endaweni yesigameko lapho kuthiwa owesilisa ubeshaya kabuhlungu intombi yakhe ahlala nayo emqashweni eyivalele endlini.Umthombo weSolezwe, obukhona ngesikhathi kwenzeka isigameko, uthe besekunesikhathi eside owesifazane obeshaywa ekhala okuthe uma iziqashi zizama ukuncenga owesilisa ukuthi amyeke, kwanhlanga zimuka nomoya."Amalungu omphakathi abize abasekomitini elilwa nobugebengu endaweni. Kuthe uma befika, owesilisa wabatshela ukuthi ngeke avule. Uthe uma kukhona ozithembayo, akakhahlele isicabha angene khona ezozibona ukuthi ufana nobani. Abekomiti badikilile bathi akubizwe amaphoyisa,” usho kanje.Uthe ngesikhathi amaphoyisa efika, amathathu abehamba phambili afike akhahlela isicabha. Kukholakala ukuthi aphonse ngaphakathi ibhomu lesandla lesisi esikhalisa unyembezi ngenhloso yokukhipha owesilisa. Kuthe uma kuqubuka intuthu uzakwabo wesifazane ongaphandle wathuka ezitshela ukuthi abangaphakathi babhekene nenkinga, wadubula ebhekise ngasendlini nokuyilapho kudubuleke khona iphoyisa eliwusayitsheni lashonela endaweni yesigameko, kwathi uzakwabo wadubuleka emlenzeni waphuthunyiswa esibhedlela.Ngokuthola kweSolezwe ngomthombo walo osondelene namaphoyisa, endaweni yesigameko kutholwe amagobolondo ezinhlamvu awu-12 esibhamu esikhulu sohlobo i-R5. Lo mthombo uveze ukuthi owesilisa obeshaya intombi uthathwe wayohlonywa imibuzo kodwa wabuye wadedelwa. Uthe kutholwe umkhonto eceleni kwesidumbu sephoyisa okukholakala ukuthi bekungowalo wesilisa obeshaya intombi.UMnuz Baya Mseleku, owusihlalo wesigungu esilwa nobugebengu endaweni, uthe emva kokuthi bezame ukunxusa lezi zithandani ukuthi zivule endlini, bathole izinsongo kowesilisa."Uthe akungene ozithembayo, sabona ukuthi ayisengangathi sekumele kungenelele amaphoyisa. Abiziwe kodwa afike ikomiti elilwa nobugebengu selihambile ngakho besingekho ngesikhathi sokudutshulwa kwamaphoyisa, nathi sizwe sesixoxelwa abebekhona,” usho kanje.UMnuz Phaladi Shuping, okhulumela uphiko oluphenya amacala enziwa ngamaphoyisa, i-Independent Police Investigative Directorare, uthe lolu phiko luphenya icala lokubulala ngokungenhloso nelokusetshenziswa budedengu kwesibhamu."Kusolwa ukuthi amaphoyisa abematasa nomsebenzi wawo wokuzama ukubopha obebandakanyeka odlameni lwasekhaya. Kuqhume ibhomu lesandla endlini amaphoyisa abekuyo, kukholakala ukuthi uzakwabo obengaphandle uvulele ngenhlamvu ecabanga ukuthi bayahlaselwa,” usho kanje.

SEKWALE uhlanga kusuka uthuthuva kwabe-ANC KwaZulu-Natal noMphathiswa wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal, uMfundisi Thulasizwe Buthelezi. ISIKHULU sikahulumeni wase-Equatorial Guinea, sibhekene nengwadla yezinsolo zocansi ngemva kokuputshuka kwenqwaba yamavidiyo amkhomba ngenjumbane yokulala namakhosikazi abantu.UBaltasar Ebang Engonga, ongumqondisi jikelele we-Anti-graft National Agency for Financial Investigation (ANIF), ukhungethwe yihlazo elivele ngesikhathi ephenywa ngamacala okukhwabanisa. Uphenyo luvundulule amavidiyo anamanyala, amanye akhombisa abantu abaqavile nabashade nezikhulu, eya nabo ocansini.Izikhulu zithole amavidiyo angaphezu kuka-400 ano-Engonga nabesifazane abehlukene, okuhlanganisa nezihlobo zezikhulu zikahulumeni, ngesikhathi zisesha umuzi nehhovisi lakhe njengengxenye yophenyo.Lawo atholakale ehhovisi lakhe, kubikwa ukuthi ahlanganisa amakhosikazi ezikhulu ezimbalwa, njengodadewabo kamongameli, unkosikazi womqondisi jikelele wamaphoyisa, namakhosikazi ongqongqoshe abalelwa ku-20, phakathi kwabanye. Konke lokhu kuthiwa kwaqoshwa ngemvume yabo bonke abebenza umkhuba futhi kwaqoshwa ezindaweni ezihlukene, okubalwa ihhovisi lakhe, amahhotela nezindlu zangasese.Likhuluma ngalokhu, iPhini likaMongameli uTeodoro Nquema linikele enkundleni yezokuxhumana i-X, lithi azivumelekile izenzo zocansi ezindaweni zokuphatha. UNquema ukhiphe isexwayiso esiqinile, egcizelela imiphumela yanoma yikuphi ukwephulwa komthetho okunjalo"Ngenxa yezinto eziwukuhlukumeza ezivela ezinkundleni zokuxhumana e-Equatorial Guinea kulezi zinsuku, kumele kukhunjulwe ukuthi ongqongqoshe babizelwe umsebenzi wokuphatha ekusekeleni intuthuko yezwe, abuvumelekile ubudlelwane bocansi emahhovisi," kubhala iphini likamengameli.Uqhubeke wathi zikhona izindlela zokulawula izimo ezifana nalezi futhi umuntu ozophula lo mthetho uzoqondiswa ubugwegwe ngokuziphatha okungafanele futhi angaxoshwa emsebenzini.
ASEZOLIPHENYA kahle ibheshu kuMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, amaqembu aphikisayo ePhalamende, uma sekubunjwe ikomiti azovela kulona ezophendula imibuzo.La maqembu athe bese kunesikhathi ehlaba ikhwelo lokuthi kusungulwe ikomiti elifuze leli, ukuze uMengameli aphendule ngezinqumo azithathayo.Kwenzeka lokhu nje, kulandela isinqumo sekomiti lemigomo ePhalamende, elinqume ukuthi kumele kube nekomiti lapho ezophendula khona imibuzo.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi kusuka ngo-1994, akukho komiti umengameli wezwe aphendula kulona ePhalamende mayelana nezinto nezinqumo azithathayo.Akwenzayo ukuphendula kuphela imibuzo yamalungu ePhalamende naweNdlu yoMkhandlu weziFundazwe.UNksz Hlengiwe Mkhaliphi we-EFF, okungelinye lamaqembu abefaka ingcindezi yokuthi kube naleli komiti, uthe ibambe ngakho njengoba umengameli esezovela ekomitini lasePhalamende, aphendule khona imibuzo yamalungu.Uthe bebehlale bekhala ngokuthi bekunganele nje ukuthi aphendule leyo mibuzo uma kuhleli iPhalamende."Sijabule ngalesi sinqumo ngoba besifuna ukuthi siphasiswe ukuze aphendule emphakathini. Umengameli ubezithathela izinqumo bese kungabikhona ozombuza noma aphendule ngalezo zinqumo okuyinto ezophela manje,” kusho uNksz Mkhaliphi. Uthe ngeke bakuvumele ukuthi kube neqembu elizoba yingxenye yekomiti elizozama ukuvikela umengameli ekuphenduleni imibuzo.USotswebhu weMK ePhalamende, uMnuz Mzwanele Manyi, uthe uRamaphosa ubezenzela umathanda engaphenduli kumuntu.Uveze ukuthi yingakho kwaze kwasungulwa leli qembu ukulwa nezinto ezifuze lezi."Alikho ikomiti lapho ebephendula khona ngokuqoka ongqongqoshe, ngokufaka iminyango ethile nezinkampani ngaphansi kwehhovisi lakhe. Kuyaphela lokho manje ngokuthi kube nekomiti azophendula kulona ngoba sincane isikhathi sokuphendula imibuzo.”UNksz Mkhaliphi uthe i-ANC kuphela engahambisani nokubunjwa kwaleli komiti. Akuyona kuphela le migomo ezobhekwa kabanzi kodwa nokuthi ongqongqoshe kumele baphendule ngokugcwele imibuzo."Ilungu lizobuza umbuzo liphendulwe, uma lingeneme liphinde libuze omunye umbuzo. Lizokwazi ukubuza umbuzo lize ligculiswe izimpendulo,” kusho uNksz Mkhaliphi.Okhulumela iPhalamende, uMnuz Moloto Mothapo, uthe kuvunyelwene emhlanganweni wemigomo ukuthi kuqiniswe ukusebenza kukahulumeni ngokuthi kubhekwe eyokuthi kube nekomiti elizoqapha ukusebenza kukamengameli.Uthe kuzobhekwa kabanzi eyokwakheka kwaleli komiti.
KUXWAYISE abaphathi bamanyuvesi ngokusheshe bagxumele ekumiseni izitshudeni noma abasebenzi uma kunokungaboni ngasolinye.Lesi senzo kuthiwa siba nomthelela ekutheni kuchithwe enkulu imali kugijinyiswana ezinkantolo kungenasidingo.Lokhu kushiwo usihlalo wekomiti lo mnyango weMfundo ePhakeme ePhalamende, uMnuz Tebogo Letsie, enkulumweni yakhe yokuhalalisela ukugcotshwa ngokusemthethwe kuka-Vice-Chancellor waseMangosuthu University of Technology, uSolwazi Nokuthula Sibiya emcimbini obukule nyuvesi ngoLwesihlanu.ULetsie uthe abaphathi bamanyuvesi kumele baqinisekise ukulandela imigudu efanele uma bethatha lezi zinyathelo futhi kube yinto yokugcina abayenzayo ukugwema ukulahleka kwemali."Izitshudeni eziningi ezifunda emanyuvesi zixhaswe uhulumeni. Ngakho yithina esisuke sikhulume ePhalamende ukuthi kumele kufakwe imali emnyangweni ukubhekana nezidingo, kodwa akuzwakali kahle ukuthi imali igcine seyisetshenziswa ukulwa amacala abengagwemeka ngoba nakhu umphathi wenyuvesi esexoshe izitshudeni noma abasebenzi,” usho kanje.Ehalalisela uSolwazi Sibiya, uthe u-80% wabaphathi bamanyuvesi kusengabantu besilisa, okukhombisa ukuthi isenkulu inselelo ekutheni lezi zikhungo ziphathwe abesifazane.Uthe akangabinawo amahloni okuthatha inyuvesi ayikhuphulele kwelinye izinga.USomlomo kuMasipala weTheku, uMnuz Thabani Nyawose, unxuse ukuthi uma kungenakho ukungaboni ngasolinye phakathi kwezitshudeni nenyuvesi, kuhlalwe phansi kuxoxwe kugwenywe ukuvalwa kwemigwaqo."Phambilini, le nyuvesi beyikhungethwe izinkinga, asingabazi ukuthi ngokugcotshwa kukaSolwazi Sibiya, uzokwazi ukuhola inyuvesi ngobuqotho,” usho kanje.UMhlengi Ngubo owumengameli womkhandlu wezitshudeni kule nyuvesi, unxuse ubumbano nokusebenzisana nokuthi kubekwe eqhulwini uhlelo lokuxhaswa kwezitshudeni ngokwezimali okuyilona oluvamise ukudala ukungaboni ngaso linye.Ekhuluma kulo mcimbi, uSolwazi Sibiya ubonge abebemeseka kwizinselelo adlule kuzo kuze kuba uqokelwa kulesi sikhundla."Lolu hambo angilihambanga ngedwa kodwa kukhona abebenami, bekholelwa kimi bengeseka, ngiyabonga. Kungenxa yenu njengoba ngimi lapha, ebeningixhasa ngakho sengikulungele ukuhola inyuvesi nokusebenza ngokuzinikela. Ngingakusho ngokungananazi ukuthi ukuqokwa kwami kulesi sikhundla, kuyisiqalo esisha. Njengokuba owesifazane wokuqala ukuqokelwa kulesi sikhundla kule nyuvesi, lokhu kuwubufakazi bokuthi seligaya ngomunye umhlathi,” usho kanje.Phakathi kwezikhulumi ebezishiyelana inkundla kulo mcimbi, uMnuz Sandile Zungu owushansela kule nyuvesi, uDkt Marcia Socikwa osemnyangweni weMfundo ePhakeme, usihlalo we-Institutional Forum uDkt Thembi Kweyama nephini likashansela wase- University of Zululand, uSolwazi Xoliswa Mtose.USolwazi Sibiya uqokelwe kulesi sikhundla ngoJulayi walo nyaka, aqale ukusebenza ngokusemthethweni kuso ngo-Agasti, njengoba ubegcotshwa ngoLwesihlanu.Ungumuntu wesifazane wokuqala ukuphatha lesi sikhundla kule nyuvesi eneminyaka ewu-45 ebisalokhu ikhungethwe yizinkinga. Uthathe lesi sikhundla phambilini obekubambe kuso uSolwazi Marcus Ramogale owasuswa kuso emva kwezinsolo zenkohlakalo.
UFUNA izimpendulo umndeni wesitshudeni esibulawe yisoka emagcekeni esikhungo, iCoastal Tvet College, ophikweni lakwa-V eMlaza, ngokuthi udlule kanjani umsolwa wayobulala ingane yawo phambi kwezinye izitshudeni ekubeni kugadiwe.Umndeni kaNksz Nothando Mnyandu (27) wase-Adams, ukhala ngezokuphepha kuleli kolishi njengoba ukholwa ukuthi ukube beziqinile ezokuphepha, ngabe ingane yawo obuthembele kuyona isaphila.Umsolwa osebenza njengosicabha ematekisini aseGalleria (igama lakhe eligodliwe kuze kube kuqinisekiswa ukuvela kwakhe enkantolo), kuthiwa udlule konogada abebegade esangweni ngoLwesine, waqonda kumufi abanengane naye eneminyaka eyisikhombisa, wafike wambhokoda ngommese.UNOTHANDO Mnyandu, isitshudeni saseCoastal College eMlaza okusolwa uyise wengane ngokufa kwakhe UNksz Mnyandu ubenza unyaka wokugcina kwi-Civil Engineering kulesi sikhungo.Unina kamufi uNkk Nomusa Mnyandu ekhuluma neSolezwe, uthe akwehli kahle kubona njengomndeni ukwenzeka kwalesi sigameko ekubeni isikhungo sinonogada.Uthe kucacile ukuthi impilo yezitshudeni isengozini ngenxa yezokuphepha ezingekho ezingeni."Okusididayo ukuthi kwenzeke kanjani ukuthi umuntu ongafundi esikhungweni azingenele ngaphakathi agwaze isitshudeni ekubeni kunonogada? Sifisa kwenzeke ubulungiswa ngoba lesi sigameko sikhombisa ukuthi izitshudeni aziphephile,” usho kanje.Uthe basola umona kumsolwa kwazise indodakazi yakhe ibike imbikele ukuthi uyayihlukumeza, athi izibona ingcono ngoba nakhu ifundile, isizoqeda."Ubehlala eyihlukumeza ethi isifunde kakhulu. Ingane yami ibisanda kumtshela ukuthi ayisamfuni, ngiyasola ukuthi esinye sezizathu ezenze wayibulala.”Kuthiwa umsolwa emva kokugwaza umufi, uzame ukubaleka kodwa izitshudeni zamjaha zambamba, okuyilapho eboshwe khona amaphoyisaOkunye okukhalisa uNkk Mnyandu, ukuthi batshelwe ukuthi indodakazi yabo ibisaphila kodwa kwaba nomyalelo wokuthi ayingathintwa, akulindwe amaphoyisa."Afike isivele isithule ekubeni esikhungweni kunezimoto ebezingayiphuthumisa emtholampilo. Silimele singumndeni ngoba akukho muntu osebenza ngokugcwele la ekhaya.”Uthe bonke bazibambela amatoho kanti bese kubhekwe umufi ukuthi aqede, asebenze bese ebondla.Izigameko zalolu hlobo seziyinsakavukela kulesi sikhungo njengoba ngo-2020 ophikweni lwaseMbumbulu, kwadutshulwa izitshudeni ezintathu ngaphakathi esikhungweni. Kulesi sigameko kwashona uSimanga Zulu, kwathi ababili ayehleli nabo bangeniswa esibhedlela. Kwaboshwa abasolwa abahlanu. Ngawo u-2020 ophikweni lwaseMbumbulu, kwabulawa uMnuz Lindinkosi Mazibuko, owayeyiNhloko ophikweni lokuThuthukiswa kweNgqalasizinda esikhungweni. Wadutshulwa abasolwa abangabonwanga esemotweni yakhe endaweni okupaka kuyo izimoto kulesi sikhungo.IPhini likaNobhala wenhlangano yezitshudeni i-South African Students Congress KwaZulu-Natal, uNksz Noxolo Ntshangase, lithe nakuba bebengakawutholi umbiko ngalolu daba, kodwa udaba lokuphepha ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme yinto ebakhathazayo kakhulu."Izigameko ezithinta ukuphepha ezikhungweni enye yezinto esikhathazayo, kodwa uma kwenzeka isigameko esinjalo siyasisukumela ngokusebenzisana nobuholi bezitshudeni kuleso sikhungo nobesifunda,” usho kanje.Okhulumela isikhungo uMnuz Thami Ngcobo, uqinisekisile ukuthi lesi sigameko senzekile, wathi okwamanje kusenophenyo lwangaphakathi ekolishi.Uthe uphenyo luhlanganisa nenkampani yonogada, eqapha ezokuphepha esikhungweni.Kushaye isikhathi sokushicilela amaphoyisa engakayiphenduli imibuzo athunyelelwe yona ukuqinisekisa ukuboshwa kukamsolwa.
I-ESKOM imemezele ukuthi isiyonge u-R13.7 billion, ngezindleko zikadizili kulo nyaka njengoba sekuphele izinyanga eziyisikhombisa ugesi unganqamuki.Le nkampani iye iphoqeleke ukuthi isebenzise udizili uma ugesi unqamuka ngenxa yokufa kwemishini njengoba kunemishini ephehla ugesi ngodizili esetshenziswa uma kunezimo eziphuthumayo.UNkk Daphne Mokwena obhekelele ezokuxhumana e-Eskom, uthe ugesi okhona ezweni njengamanje ungaphezu kuka-70% futhi nemishini edinga ukulungiswa, ilungiswa kahle ngaphandle kokuthi kuphazamiseke izinhlelo zokuphehla ugesi.Ubalule ukuthi abalindele ukuthi kube nokuphazamiseka ezinhlelweni zokuphehla ugesi ehlobo ngenxa yokuthi zonke izinhlelo zihamba kahle."Sinciphile isibalo semishini ecima singalindele njengoba isiwu-25.3% isuka ku-33.6% ebikuwo ngo-Ephreli. Siyayikhanda imishini edinga ukulungiswa, okusho ukuthi ugesi ongekho ngenxa yokulungiswa kwemishini uwu-6 094MW. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi singabikhona isidingo sokunqamula ugesi ehlobo.”Uthe ugesi uyacima kwezinye izindawo ezinama-transformer asindelwayo ngenxa yokuthi sebebaningi abantu abasebenzisa ugesi kanti ingqalasizinda yayakhelwe isibalo esithile."Sinenkinga yabantu abaxhuma ugesi wezinyokanyoka kuma-transformer ethu, abanye bakokotela ama-meter, beba ugesi, babuye bawuthenge kubantu abangagunyaziwe. Konke lokhu kudala izinkinga kwingqalasizinda ngoba kufanele siwucime ugesi ukuze ama-transformer engezukusha. Sicela umphakathi obona izinto ezisolisayo noma ukukokotelwa kukagesi, ubike ku-0800 112 722 noma ku-Whatsapp 081 333 3323.”Khonamanjalo: Inyunyana yabasebenzi i-General Industries Workers Union of South Africa (Giwusa), ithe asikho isidingo sokuthi i-Eskom icele ukuba kunyuswe ugesi ngemali enkulu uma izinhlelo zayo zokonga ugesi zihamba kahle.
UMFUNDISI webandla lodumo eMtubatuba, obesekhathele ngumyeni ojolayo, umphuzise umchamo ngokuwufaka enkomishini yetite 'emjezisa’ ngokubukisa ngaye njengoba kuthiwa ujola isidana.Umyeni kaMfundisi Siphelele Khumalo (40), ohola ibandla iHope of Christ, uthe uma eceba unkosikazi wakhe esigungwini sebandla ngokumphuzisa umchamo, isigungu sakhetha ukumxosha ebandleni. Kuthiwa umyeni uMnuz Bongani Khumalo (55), utshele isigungu ukuthi asithathe isinqumo ngonkosikazi wakhe ngoba ' umhlukumezile’."Okuyikhona okufike kwacika kakhulu isigungu sebandla ukuthi avume ebese ezeseka ngokuthi ubemlaya. Avele athukuthela kakhulu amalungu esigungu uma umfundisi evuma nje kalula engathi wenze into encane,’’ usho kanjena.Umthombo uveza ukuthi bese kunesikhathi eside bungahambi kahle ubudlelwano phakathi kwabo bobabili kangangoba, sekuze kwaba amahlandla amathathu owesifazane esikaza ukufaka incwadi yesehlukaniso.Isolezwe Ngempelasonto lithinte umfundisi waqale wabuza ukuthi intatheli iluthole kanjani udaba.Emva kwalokho uthe akazisoli ngakwenzile kumyeni wakhe. Uthe uma engathola elinye ithuba angaphinda akwenze lokhu."Usengaze agijime aye emaphepheni ngomchamo nje kuphela. Kukangaki yena engona? Umbuzile ukuthi usekhulelise kangaki ngaphandle komshado selokhu sashada," ubuze kanjena.Uchaze umyeni wakhe njengowesilisa ofanelwe yisijeziso esingaphezulu kwalesi somchamo. Usole isigungu sebandla ngokuthi sicheme nomuntu wesilisa."Vele phela bebengeke baze bangilalele mina ngoba ngingumuntu wesifazane," usho kanje.Uveze ukuthi uthuthile nasemzini wabo oseMtuba, waphindela kubo eNtuzuma.Umyeni uthe uzizwa engento yalutho njengoba ephuziswe umchamo. Wathi kuthe eliphuza itiye wezwa ukuthi umchamo. Uthi kwathi uma embuza umkakhe wavuma wase ethi usengaze akhalele ukuthi uphuziswe umchamo nje, ekubeni yena ezitika ngocansi nabesifazane abehlukene."Akusiyena umfundisi loya muntu wesifazane, uthunywe ngusathane nje kimina. Futhi ngiyalingwa,’’ usho kanje.Wadalula nokuthi sebehlukene futhi akazimisele ngokuthi kube khona abakuxoxayo. "Ayikho into engizoyikhuluma naye ngoba vele akafuni nokuzala uthi uyesaba,’’ usho kanje.Ilungu elisesigungwini sebandla elicele ukuba kugodlwe igama lalo likuqinisekisile ukuthi bamxoshile umfundisi ebandleni.
UNGQONGQOSHE wezaManzi nokuThuthwa kweNdle uNksz Pemmy Majodina, usekhwele wadilika komasipala abangayitshali imali ukulungisa ingqalasizinda yamanzi.UNksz Majodina uthe lokhu kwenza ukuthi umphakathi ungawatholi ngendlela amanzi ekubeni izwe lingakafiki esimeni sesomiso.Uveze ukuthi izwe lisenamanzi enele kodwa kuzoba yinkinga uma kungukuthi ayinqandwa inkinga yokuvuza kwamapayipi amanzi aphelele emhlabathini. Ubalule ukuthi inkinga yokuvuza kwamapayipi amanzi ihlasele kubona bonke omasipala. '"Siyalele omasipala ukuthi bathathe imali bakhokhele izinhlaka ezibaphakela amanzi. Sibayalele ukuthi basukumele nenkinga yokuvuza kwamanzi ezweni. Uma le nkinga ingalungiswa, noma singenzani amanzi ayoshoda.” Uthe basebenzisana noMnyango wokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu kanjalo nenhlangano iSalga, ukuze omasipala bakhokhele amanzi abawakweletayo.Uthe imali eqoqwa omasipala bakhokhela ngayo ezinye izinto bayeke ukulungisa izinto ezithinta amanzi."Eminye imikhandlu yaxwayiswa ngokuthi yandise ingqalasizinda yamanzi ngenxa yokukhula kwesibalo sabantu. Eminye yale mikhandlu yakushaya indiva lokhu okwenza manje kube nenkinga yokushoda kwamanzi ezindaweni ezehlukene,” kusho uNksz Majodina ekhuluma ngesimo samanzi ezweni izolo nesiteshi sethelevishini i-eNCA. Uthe kukhona isikhathi eKapa lapho kwase kusele cishe izinsukwana ngaphambi kokuphela kwamanzi. Ubalule nokuthi nezakhamuzi kumele zibambe iqhaza, zisize omasipala."Nezakhamuzi kumele zikhokhele izidingo. Azikhokhele amanzi eziwatholayo. Kodwa uma umphakathi ungawatholi amanzi, uzoba manqika ukukhokhela amanzi, ngeke uyikhokhele into ongayitholi,” kuqhuba uNksz Majodina.Ephendula imibuzo ePhalamende ngeledlule,oyiPhini likaMengameli uMnuz Paul Mashatile, ingxenye yezimpendulo beyimayelana nenkinga yamanzi ezweni.Ukuvezile ukuthi iyabakhathaza indaba yokuvuza kwamapayipi amanzi adala ukuthi amanye angafinyeleli emphakathini.Wahlaba ikhwelo emphakathini lokuthi ukhokhele izidingo ukuze nomasipala baqhubeke nokukhokhela izinhlaka ezihlinzeka ngamanzi.NoMcwaningi Mabhuku jikelele ePhalamende, ukhale esifanayo ngenkinga yokuvuza kwamanzi ezindaweni ezehlukene ezweni.Wenza isibonelo ngomasipala weTheku wathi cishe u-58% wamanzi awufinyeleli emphakathini ngenxa yokuthi uphelela emhlabathini.
INHLANZI izoshelwa amanzi kwababalekela isondlo sezingane njengoba sekunesivumelwano sokuthi bafakwe ohlwini lwabantu abanamagama amabi ezikweletini.UNgqongqoshe wezoBulungiswa nokuThuthukiswa koMthethosisekelo, uNksz Thembi Simelane, usayine lesi sivumelwano sokufakwa kwi-credit bureau kwabangondli ngempelasonto.Lesi sivumelwano esibizwa ngeMaintenance Online Listing of Defaulters (Mold) sisayinwe nezinkampani eziqoqa imininingwane yezikweletu zabantu bakuleli.Kusho ukuthi umuntu ongayondli ingane usezozithola esenkingeni ukwenza isikweletu esisha uma engakayikhokhi imali yesondlo."Sifuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abazali bayazondla izingane zabo. Isivumelwano esisisayinile sisho ukuthi ohlwini lwezikweletu zomuntu sekuzovela ukuthi akondli uma engayikhokhi imali yesondlo. Lokhu kungamvibela ukuba athenge imoto, umuzi nanoma yini asuke efuna ukuyithenga ngesikweletu. Asibhekile kuphela abesilisa ngoba umthetho wethu awuhambi ngokobulili.”Uthe okubenze bathatha lesi sinyathelo wukuthi u-70% wabantu abasuke bondliswa izingane ngenkantolo, unomkhuba omubi wokungayikhokhi imali yesondlo, okusho ukuthi basuke bephula umthetho i-Maintenance Act ka-1998."Uma ingane iza emhlabeni kuhlangana abazali ababili ababusiswa ngengane yomfana noma yentombazane. UMthethosisekelo uthi bobabili kufanele bayondle leyo ngane. Siyazi ukuthi isikhathi esiningi izingane zisala nomama kodwa bakhona nobaba abazikhulisela izingane ngabodwana. Kubalulekile ukuthi abazali bondle. Umthetho uzolandela bonke abangodli, kungaba abesilisa noma abesifazane. Bazolandelwa nabalaxaze izingane kogogo ngoba ogogo bayakwazi ukufaka isicelo sesondlo enkantolo.”Ucele abesifazane ukuba bangabenqabeli ithuba lokubona izingane zabo abesilisa ngoba abanye bagcina bengazondli ngoba bekhala ngokuthi bayanqatshelwa ukuzibona.Utshele abesilisa ukuthi akusisona isinqumo esihle ukungondli ingane ngoba benqatshelwa ukuyibona, esho nokuthi kufanele balungise lokhu ngokubika enkantolo.Uphethe ngokuthi abangondli ngeke bagcine ngokungcolelwa amagama ezikweletini kodwa kunemihlomulo yabasebenzi abangeke bayithole njengoba bezosebenzisana noMnyango wezabaSebebenzi.Ngeke bathole nemali yabo yentela njengoba kuzobizwa ne-South African Revenue Service (Sars), ukuze igodle imali yabangondli.Ungoti wezomthetho, uMnuz Mpumelelo Zikalala ekhuluma kwi-SABC, uthe yisinqumo esihle esithathwe wuMnyango wezoBulungiswa ngoba uzoqinisekisa ukuthi abangodli abakwazi ukunyakaza bengakazilungisi izindaba ezithinta isondlo.Uthe izindaba zesondlo kufanele zilandelelwe kusetshenziswa ubuchwepheshe besimanje ngoba abantu bashintsha imisebenzi namakheli okudinga ukulungiswa nakumarekhodi enkantolo.Ubalule ukuthi uma kusetshenziswa ubuchwepheshe besimanje, kuzokwazeka uma umuntu eshintsha imininingwane kusheshe kubonakale kwifayela lakhe.
BAZONGENA bagamanxe emaphakatheni abashayeli bezimoto kusukela ngoLwesithathu kunyuka uphethroli.Lokhu kuqinisekiswe uMnyango wezaMandla nokuMbiwayo ngoMsombuluko.Intengo kaphethroli i-93 ne-95 unleaded izonyuka ngo-25c ilitha. Intengo kadizili inyuswe ngo-20c kanye no-21c ilitha, kuye ngokuthi isibabuli singakanani.Intengo kapharafini izokhuphuka ngo-21c ilitha, kanti intengo yegesi ye-LP izokwenyuka ngo-36c i-kg."Umthelela omkhulu walokhu yimpi ephakathi kweMiddle East nokungqubuzana phakathi kwe-Iran ne-Israel," kusho uMnyango esitatimendeni.
UMNYANGO weMfundo eyisiSekelo usudonse ngendlebe abafundi ababhala u-matric, abafika bezobhala bephethe omakhalekhukhwini ukuthi abavumelekile. Lo mnyango ubayalele ukuthi bawashiye emakhaya futhi bayeke ukufika bephethe imbuzi ngoba behlose ukukopela.Lesi sexwayiso sikhishwe ngokhulumela lo mnyango, uMnuz Elijah Mhlanga, oveze ukuthi bakhathazekile ngabafundi abafika bephethe omakhalekhukhwini.Uthe abanye bafika beqiqinge umphako ngenhloso yokukopela."Siyaphinde siyabaxwayisa abafundi ukuthi bayeke ukwenza lezi zinto ngoba uma bebanjwa, bangaphucwa ithuba lokubhala izivivinyo ezintathu. Ima nse impilo uma ubanjwe ukopela u-matric ngoba nemiphumela ayiphumi.” kusho uMhlanga.Uthe kunabafundi ababanjwa eminyakeni edlule bekopela, namanje abasalinde imiphumela yabo.Ubuye wakhuthaza abazali ukuthi benze konke okusemandleni ukulekelela izingane zabo ekubhekaneni nokhwantalala njengoba kuqhubeka ukubhalwa kwezivivinyo zokuphela konyaka zika-matric.NoNgqongqoshe walo mnyango, uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, wanxenxa abazali ukuthi bangaqheli kubafundi ababhalayo, kodwa babeseke."Kungenzeka ukuthi ukubhala kudala ukhwantalala noma ezinye izinto ezibaphazamisayo njengoba kuqhubeka ukubhalwa kwezivivinyo. Abazali abasondele kakhulu kubona ngalesi sikhathi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi akukho okubaphazamisayo,” kusho uMhlanga.Uveze nokuthi bathole nokuthi baningi abafundi ababhala lezi zivivinyo besezibhedlela.Phakathi kwezinye izigameko, ubalule udaba lomfundi waleli banga obezithwele, okuthiwa ubelethe ekuseni kwaqondana nesikhathi sokubhala, kodwa wahlelelwa ukuthi abhale ntambama ngosuku abelethe ngalo. Uveze ukuthi omunye ubandakanyeke engozini yemoto, wabhalela esibhedlela ngosizo lwabebemlekelela. UMhlanga uthe abafundi ababhala besezibhedlela abaphoqwa kodwa basuke bezicelele bona futhi beqinisekisa ukuthi bakulungele ukubhala.Ugcizelele ukuthi isabambe ngakho ngokubhalwa kwezivivinyo zaleli banga, ngaphandle nje kokuphazamiseka kwabafundi abangu-319 esifundazweni i-Eastern Cape, abangakwazanga ukubhala isifundo se-Computer Applications Technology, ngenxa yezikhukhula ezigasele kulesiya emasontweni adlule okuphoqe ukuthi ukubhalwa kwalesi sifundo kuhlehliselwe uNovemba 28. Angu-88 kwawu-200 amaphepha asebhaliwe. Namhlanje ukubhalwa kwalezi zivivinyo kungena esontweni lesithathu, kanti kuzoba yisonto elimatasa kakhulu kubafundi baleli banga njengoba kubhalwa izifundo ezithathwa njengezilukhuni. Ekuseni namhlanje kubhalwa iphepha lesibili le-Mathematics, i-Mathematical Literacy ne-Technical Maths.Kusasa kubhalwa iphepha lokuqala le-Geography, bese kuthi ngoLwesihlanu baphethe isonto ngokubhala iphepha lesibili le-Physical Sciences.

APHELILE amahlathi okucasha kodokotela abasebenza ngaphandle kwemvume ngoba umkhandlu wabo, iHealth Professions Council of South Africa’s (HPCSA), usembhidlangweni wokuhlola odokotela abasebenza kuleli.IHPCSA ihambela zonke izindawo zodokotela ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kusebenza odokotela abanemvume yokusebenza futhi abangenawo amacala athile.Kuleli sonto iHPCSA ibophe uMnuz Vincent Ngubane, owayengudokotela kodwa owamiswa ukuba asebenze ngo-2015.UNgubane uboshwe esebenza endaweni kaDkt Tebogo Kgoa esePostmansburg, eNorthern Cape."Sithole ukuthi uNgubane uqale ukusebenza ngoDkt Kgoa ngo-Agasti walo nyaka, simchazelile ukuthi akavumelekile ukusebenza njengoba wamiswa. Uye waboshwa ngaphansi kwesigaba 17(1) seHealth Professions Act, No. 56 ka 1974. UDkt Kgoa, ongudokotela wamazinyo uzobikwa kwiMedical and Dental Board ngokuqasha uNgubane omisiwe,” kusho iHPCSA esitatimendeni.Ibuye yaveza ukuthi kuboshwe uMnuz Lungelo Khumalo, obengumsizi kadokotela wamazinyo endaweni kaMnuz Aubrey Mkhize oyi-dental therapist, eMaruping Village, eKuruman, eNorthern Cape. UKhumalo uboshelwe ukusebenza ngaphandle kwemvume evela emkhandlwini wodokotela bamazinyo. UMkhize ubikwe ebhodini lodokotela abajwayelekile, nabamazinyo ngokuqasha umuntu ongenayo imvume yokusebenza ngokusiza abanezinkinga zamazinyo.IHPCSA ithe uyaqhubeka umkhankaso wayo wokuhlola ukuthi bonke odokotela abasebenza kuleli banemvume yokusebenza nokwelapha izifo ezihlukene abathi bayazilapha.Ithe lokhu kwenzelwa ukuvikela umphakathi kodokotela bomkokotelo nokuqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenza emkhakheni wezempilo banemvume yokwenza umsebenzi abawenzayo.Iveze ukuthi umkhankaso wayo uyaqhubeka kuzo zonke izifundazwe, ingagasela noma kunini endaweni kadokotela ukuqinisekisa ukuthi unayo imvume.

UMHOLI wamaNazaretha, Inkosi uMduduzi "Unyazilwezulu" Shembe, ubalise ngokuphila kanzima ngenxa yobuthakathi obudla lubi eBuhleni.UNYAZILWEZULU lukhala ngabathakathi abafuna ukuqeda ngabaholi bakwaShembe Isithombe:SIGCINIWE UNyazi lukhulume kanje ngesikhathi luvala umhlangano waseJudiya, eMpangeni muva nje.Lo mholi uthe ukuvika abathakathi kuleli bandla kuqale kusaphila uyisemkhulu, Inkosi uJohanes Galile 'Inyangayezulu’ Shembe. Wasuka phakathi kwethu. Ngoba uShembe uma esevukelwa, akavukelwa ngamaRoma. Akavukelwa ngamaWeseli, uvukelwa yithina."Unxuse amaNazaretha ukuba aphume ezinganeni zakwaShembe, zibe zodwa ngoba uma ezijoyina azidlisa ushevu."Kukhona into engike ngayisho ukuthi umuntu, mhlazane efika lapha wayezokwenzani. LIVELE lahwaqabala ebusweni, amehlo aphenduka abomvu samuntu ofuna ukukhala, iphoyisa eliboshelwe ukutholakala nekhadi lasebhange lomgilwa owayedunwe imoto ngasekuqaleni kwenyanga edlule, imantshi ilinqabela ibheyili.UConstable Minenhle Makhaye (27) osebenza esiteshini samaphoyisa saseCato Manor, eMayville, obhekene namacala amane, ubevele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini, ukuzozwa ngesinqumo sesicelo sakhe.Emacaleni abhekene nawo kukhona elokweba, elokukhwabanisa, elokuphazamisa ukusebenza kwengalo yomthetho nelokutholwa nempahla okusolwa ukuthi yebiwe.Imantshi, uMnuz Ashwin Singh enqaba nebheyili, ithe uMakhaye uyiphoyisa eliwazi njengoba lizazi umthetho, ngakho ke kungaba lula ukuthi aphazamise ubufakazi kanjalo nofakazi.Uthe lokhu ukusho njengoba kuqhubeka uphenyo ngelinye icala elingahlangene naleli, okungeke kumangaze uma eba wumsolwa kulo.Lelo cala elokushiswa kwehhovisi lasesiteshini sakhe, okuthiwa laligcine bonke ubufakazi obabuzosetshenziswa uma eseqondiswa ubugwegwe njengoba ewuhlupho emsebenzini.Phakathi kwezinto okuthiwa uhlupha ngazo uMakhaye, kuthiwa ucwila kuze kweqe ezinkambeni zikaFaro futhi ulova njalo.USingh uqhube wathi akugcinanga ngokuthi kushiswe ihhovisi kodwa kwaphinde kwagqekezwa namahhovisi amaphoyisa amathathu okuvela ukuthi ayezoba yingxenye yokuqondiswa kwakhe ubugwegwe."Lolu daba kufanele lufakelwe izibuko, kubhekwe ukuthi ngabe kwavele kwaziqondanela nje noma uyathinteka kulo,” kusho uSingh.Ubuye wathi inkantolo ibuye yabheka nokuthi maningi amathuba okuthi athikameze ofakazi njengoba kubona, kukhona nabangani bakhe, ababekhona ngesikhathi ethenga ngekhadi.Ubuye wathi iyamangaza indaba yokuthi uMakhaye athi eyiphoyisa kodwa athathe ikhadi lasebhange emotweni ethathwa njengezibithi ecaleni lokuduna."Kuzofanele icubungulwe indaba yokuthi uthi walithatha ngephutha, nokungaba yiqiniso. Umbuzo osalayo owokuthi ikhadi walibona ngoSepthemba 12 ukuthi akulona elakho, ngesikhathi ulisebenzisa ukukhokhela utshwala? Kuyamangaza ukuthi wakhetha ukuqhubeka uhlale nalo amasonto amathathu wonke njengoba waze waboshwa nalo ngo-Okthoba 4,” kubeka uSingh.Uthe isenzo sikaMakhaye sishiya imibuzo, wathi kwakufanele okungenani alinike abaphathi bakhe masinyane ikhadi, asho ukuthi ulithathe ngephutha."Awusiye umuntu nje, uyiphoyisa, umthetho uwazi njengoba uzazi. Isenzo sokuthatha ikhadi, ozivumele wena ukuthi kwaba yiphutha, sikhombisa ukuthi ungakwazi ukucekela phansi ubufakazi ngempumelelo."Ngalezo zizathu, ngiyakwenqabela ibheyili,” kusho uSingh, othe icala lizohlehliselwa uDisemba 10, ukuze kuqhutshekwe nophenyo.Inkantolo ibuye yamsola ngamakhadi awu-272 atholwa ekameleni lakhe ngesikhathi eboshwa.Phambilini, umsolwa uveze ukuthi abuya nomkhulu wakhe osewashona njengoba ayesebenza umsebenzi wokuhambisa impahla.
