IPHINI likaMengameli wezwe, uMnuz Paul Mashatile, lizoxoxa nomasipala kuleli ukuthi bangazivaleli izibhedlela, izikole nemitholampilo amanzi ngoba ayisidingo esibalulekile.UMashatile uthe ukhathazekile ngokuthi omasipala bagcina sebevalela lezi zikhungo zikahulumeni amanzi ngenxa yokuthi zisuke zikweleta omasipala imali yamanzi.Uthe nomasipala abakhokhelwa imali abasuke bekweleta, wathi kudingeka kugqugquzelwe isiko lokuthi kukhokhelwe izidingo. "Amanzi abalulekile futhi ayisidingo ngakho akumele izikole, izibhedlela noma imitholampilo kuvalelwe amanzi. Yinto esizoyixoxa nomasipala ngoba iyasikhathaza eyokuthi lezi zikhungo zivalelwe amanzi,” kusho uMashatile.Ukusho lokhu izolo ngesikhathi ephendula imibuzo ePhalamende.UMashatile ukhale ngengqalasizinda endala engalungiswa yamanzi kuleli, ezodala inkinga yokuthi kuphele amanzi uma ingalungiswa.Uthe ithimba elajutshwa ngumengameli ukubhekana nenkinga yamanzi, limatasa lenza umsebenzi walo.Umholi weBosa, uMnzu Mmusi Maimane, ukhale ngokuthi kukhulu okuza kunyelela kuleli ngenhlekelele yamanzi, wathi njengoba kwenzeka ngenkinga kagesi, kanjalo nenkinga yamanzi iyeza."Abantu abantulayo bazogcina bengenawo amanzi ngenxa yenkinga yokungalungiswa kwengqalasizinda yamanzi. Le nkinga kumele isukunyelwe ngokushesha isimo singaze siphume esandleni,” kusho uMaimane.UMashatile uthe okushiwo nguMaimane kubaluleke kakhulu ngoba akumele kufike isimo lapho kuphela khona amanzi ezweni."Siyizwe elishoda ngamanzi nakuba okwamanje esekhona emadamini kodwa ukuvuza kwamanzi aphelela emhlabathini ngenye yezinto izinto ezisikhathazayo,” usho kanje.Izindawo ezifana naseThekwini zibhekene nezinkinga ezithinta amanzi. Lo mkhandlu usuze wehlisa umthamo wamanzi ohlinzekwa umphakathi ohlala kuleli dolobha.NoMcwaningi maBhuku Jikelele - kuleli sonto - embikeni othulwe ePhalamende, ukhale kakhulu ngenkinga yokuvuza kwamanzi emapayipini eThekwini agcina engafinyelelanga emphakathini.UMashatile uthe zikhona izinhlelo zokusiza omasipala abafana neTheku, ngenkinga yokuvuza kwamanzi emapayipini, wahlaba ikhwelo komasipala ukuthi baqikelele mayelana nendle egelezela emifuleni, ingcolise le mifula."Baningi omasipala abashushiswayo mayelana nendle echithekela emifuleni. Yingakho sithi akulungiswe ingqalasizinda nokuvuza ukuze le ndle ingachithekeli emifuleni,” kubeka uMashatile.Ukhale ngezikhukhula ezahlasela eThekwini eminyakeni edlule ukuthi zalimaza izinto eziningi kwingqalasizinda.Uqinisekise izakhamuzi ngethemba lokuthi izinto ziyalunga kuleli dolobha.
LISHESHE laguqa icala lokubulawa kowayengunozinti we-Orlando Pirates neBafana Bafana, uSenzo Meyiwa, eNkantolo eNkulu yasePretoria ngenxa yokuthi bekufanele abasolwa badlane indlebe nabameli babo mayelana nesicelo esiphuthumayo okufanele basifake.NgoLwesihlanu kuphinde kwavela ukuthi umsolwa wesihlanu, uFisokuhle Ntuli uyena owayengumdidiyeli nomxhumanisi kaKelly Khumalo nabanye abasolwa, okunguMuzikawulahlwa Sibiya, uBongani Ntanzi, uMthobisi Mncube noMthokoziseni Maphisa.Okunguye ohola ithimba labaphenyi kuleli cala, uBrigadier Bongani Gininda, ukuvezile enkantolo ukuthi ngesikhathi kwenziwa ama-download ezithombe efonini kaMncube, kwavela uplastiki (oveza okungaphakathi), uqukethe imfumba yemali. UGininda uthe akabuzwanga uMncube ukuthi lezi zizumbulu kwakungezokwenzani.YIZO lezi zinsizwa ezisolwa ngokwenza itulo lokubulawa kukaSenzo Meyiwa Isithombe: Oupa Mokoena/ African News Agency (ANA)UMncube uyena lo mlisa wama-dreadlocks osolwa ngokungena kubo kaKelly Khumalo eVosloorus ngo-Okthoba 26, 2014 maqede wadubula wabulala uSenzo. Kuthiwa wayephelezelwa umsolwa wesihlanu uFisokuhle Ntuli, okunguye osolwa ngokuba wumxhumanisi wababulali noKelly. UColonel Lambertus Steyn uyena owayephenya ukuthi kwakukhona yini ukuxhumana kukaMncube noNtuli. Esethathe umhlalaphansi uSteyn, uLieutenant-Colonel Gideon Gouws nguye owavumbulula ukuthi kwabakhona ukuxhumana ngezingcingo phakathi kukaMncube noNtuli. Kuthiwa ukuxhumana kwalaba basolwa kwaqala ngo-Okthoba 24, 2014 kwaze kwaba nguJanuwari 2015.Kuphinde kwafundwa isitatimende esenziwa uSteyn esasiqinisekisa ukuthi uKelly waxhumana amahlandla ambalwa noNtuli ngendlela ye-internet. Kuvela ukuthi uLongwe waphuthunyiswa esibhedlela sase-East Rand ukuyokhishwa inhlamvu kodwa amarekhodi asesibhedlela kuthiwa akanabo ubufakazi. Icala liyaqhubeka ngoMsombuluko.
LISEMBHIDLANGWENI wokufundisa abazalwane ngokuphathwa kwezezimali ibandla iCity Church International (CCI), osekuphele iminyaka engu-15 lasungulwa.Lokhu kudalulwe ngumholi webandla owaziwa ngezintshumayelo zakhe ezinohlonze, uMphostoli Phumlani Ngcobo, odume ngelikaPD.UNgcobo uveze ukuthi basebenzisana nebhange iFNB, ngenhloso yokuqinisekisa ukuthi lokhu abakwenzayo kuthela izithelo ezinhle."Kuyinto emqoka kakhulu ukuba abazalwane bafundiswe kabanzi ngokuphathwa kwezezimali. Abanye baze bangene ezinkingeni ngenxa yokuthi baphila impilo engaphezulu kweholo labo,'' echaza uMphostoli.Ukhulume nangobumqoka bemfundo ebantwini abasha. Uthe kuleli bandla bakhuthaza abantu abasha ukuthi bafunde bagogode bangagcini nje ngeDiploma, ebese becabanga ukuthi sekwanele."Funda uthole iMasters, kulungile inqobo nje uma ufunde ngokwanele,'' echaza.Ugcizelele ukuthi bayakholelwa ekulandweni kwabantu wathi yingakho bezoba nemvuselelo enkulu ngoNovemba 11 kuya ku-17, kwa-J, eMlaza NgoNovemba 30, uhlaka lwamadoda lwaleli bandla iKingdom Men's league, lizokuba nesigcawu lapho elikhonzela khona kusukela ngo-9 ekuseni. Likhonzela ku-32 Melbourne Road, eThekwini.NgoDisemba 13 kuya ku-15, lizobe linendumezulu yenkonzo yokubongwa komholi walo.Kafushane ngebandla lisungulwe ngo-2009. Ligxile kakhulu ekukhuthazeni ubungcwele emalungwini alo. Likholelwa ekubunjweni kwemindeni.Lishumayela kakhulu ngombuso. Selizakhele igama emphakathini ngohlaka lwalo lwangaphakathi lokunakekela abaswele olubizwa ngokuthi yiCare Givers.UNgcobo uphinde abe nguSihlalo wenhlangano esabalalisa ivangeli eNingizimu Afrika yonkana, iKings Dominion Mandate (KDM).
KUKHULEKELWE isihlava sokuzibulala kwindumezulu yenkonzo ebise-INkosi Albert Luthuli International Convention Centre (ICC), eThekwini muva nje.Le nkonzo ibizinyaziswe ngabefundisi bamahlelo ehlukene ebebeshiyelana inkundla bekhuthaza nabantu ukuba baphumele obala ngezinkinga ezibakhungethe emindenini yabo kunokuba bakhethe ukuzibulala.Le nkonzo beyihlelwe yinhlangano Ungazibulali ekhona kuzona zonke izifundazwe eNingizimu Afrika. Le nhlangano yaziwa kakhulu ngezinhlelo zokulekelela abaswele ngezindlela ezahlukene.Kuvelile kule nkonzo ukuthi inhlosongqangi yayo ukubuyisa ithemba kubantu ukuze bangazibulali.Umsunguli wale nhlangano, uNkululeko Khanyi uveze ukuthi wayisungula ngemuva kokuba naye ecishe ezibulala. Echaza ngalokhu uthe : "Nami ngingomunye wabantu abacishe bazibulala ngenxa yezimo ezahlukene engangizithola ngibhekana nazo empilweni yami. Ngazama ukuzibulala kwaze kwaba kabili. Ngiyambonga uNkulunkulu ngokuthi wangilonda.''Unxuse osomabhizinisi ukuthi bayeseke le nhlangano nangoxhaso lwemali ukuze iqhubeke nezinhlelo zokubuyisa ithemba kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika.Uthe ukholwa ukuthi le nhlangano ingasebenza kahle kakhulu uma ingase ithole ukwesekwa ekudingayo."Iqiniso lithi le nhlangano kunesidingo esikhulu sokuthi ibe khona kulesi sikhathi esikusona. Ziningi izizathu ezidala ukuthi abantu bagcine sebecabanga ngokuzibulala,'' usho kanje.Abazalwane ebebekule nkonzo bebevela ezifundazweni ezahlukene eNingizimu Afrika.
LIKHUTHAZA abesifazane ukuthi bazimele ibandla labasindisiwe iVictory City Centre, elingaphansi kwe-Apostolic Faith Mission of Southern Africa (AFMSA).Lokhu kudalulwe ngumholi walo uMphostoli Lulama Yalo (35), othi kuningi ababhekene nakho empilweni abesifazane kodwa ukusebenza ngokuzikhandla nokuzimela, kwenza impilo ibe ngcono. Uqhube wathi abesifazane yibona abafundisa izingane, ukuba sesimweni esigculisayo nangokomqondo kwabo, kwenza bakwazi ukudlulisela izimfundiso ezifanele ezinganeni. Leli bandla linesizinda eFolweni eningizimu yeTheku, lizoba nezinkonzo ngenhloso yokuvuselela ukuzethemba kwabesifazane.Izinkonzo zizoqala ngoNovemba 4 kuya ku-10 nonyaka. Zizobe zigabe ngezikhulumi ezinohlonze ezizofundisa abesifazane ngezinto eziningi. Ngaphezu kwakho konke lokho, kuzobe kuqiniswa owesifazane nangokomphefumulo. UMphostoli Philani Zikhali we-African Gospel Church, owaziwa ngezinkulumo ezinohlonze, uzobe eyingxenye yalezi zinkonzo. Uthe bayakholelwa ekutheni abesifazane kumele bakwazi ukuphila impilo engcono."Kuleli bandla siyabazisa kakhulu abantu besifazane. Sifuna ukubabona bedlondlobala empilweni futhi bengena nakwezamabhizinisi. Yingakho nje nakulezi zinkonzo intshumayelo ngokuthi owesifazane azazi lapho ebukhali khona izobe iseqhulwini,'' usho kanje uZikhali.Uthe bayakholelwa kakhulu nasekukhuthazeni imfundo kuwona wonke amalungu ebandla."Imfundo iyisikhali esimqoka kunazo zonke yingakho sikholelwa kakhulu kuyona futhi siyikhuthaza,'' usho kanje.Uqhube wathi njengoba naye esangumfundisi osamncane ngokweminyaka uyakukhuthaza ukubaluleka kokuba abantu abasha babe nentshisekelo yokuba nekusasa elihle."Sifuna ukuba nabantu abasha abacabanga ngempumelelo ngaso sonke isikhathi,’’ usho kanjena.Uveze ukuthi okunye okuseqhulwini kubona ukulekelela umphakathi abakuwona ngezindlela ezahlukene."Siyibandla elikholelwayo ekutheni kumele kube khona elikwenzela umphakathi okulona. Yingakho nje sinezinhlelo zokusiza imindeni entulayo,'' usho kanje.Uthe bakholwa ukuthi ibandla likaNkulunkulu akumele lishumayele kuphela kodwa kunalokho kumele lenze okuthile ukulekelela abadinga usizo.
KUJUTSHWE abaholi bamaqembu ahlukene okubalwa nosihlalo weFederal kwi-DA uNkk Helen Zille, ethimbeni elizobheka izikhalo ngomthetho wezikole okunemvunge ngawo iBela.Kuleli thimba kukhona nephini likangqongqoshe emnyangweni wokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu uDkt Cornelius Mulder weFreedom Front Plus; UMnuz Brett Herron weGOOD Party noSotswebhu we-ANC ePhalamende uMnuz Mdumiseni Ntuli. Lokhu kuvezwe yihhovisi lePhini likaMengameli uMnuz Paul Mashatile.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi uhulumeni wokubambisana kwamaqembu wabumba uhlaka lokubheka izinkinga ezizovela ezithinta imigomo nokunye.Leli thimba liholwa nguMashatile, kanti belihlangene ngoLwesithathu, lapho linqume ukuthi kusungulwe ithimba elizobheka izikhalo.Umengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, wamisa izigatshana ezimbili kulo mthetho ukuthi zisebenze ngenxa yezikhalo zamanye amaqembu okubalwa ne-DA.I-DA yakhala kakhulu ngalo mthetho kanti noNgqongqoshe wayo wezeMfundo uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, waduba umcimbi wokusayinwa kwalo mthetho nguRamaphosa.UNkk Zille ngomunye wabaholi abebekhala ngalo mthetho.Ihhovisi likaMashatile, lithe kubalulekile ukuthi udaba lwalo mthetho lulungiswe ezinyangeni ezintathu ezibekwe nguRamaphosa."Abaholi bamaqembu abehlangene bavumelene ngokuthi kwakhiwe ithimba labaholi abambalwa ukuze babhekana nezikhalo ezithinta umthetho. Linikwe amasonto amabili ukwenza lo msebenzi bese liletha umbiko ohlakeni lweGNU (Government of National Unity), olubheka indaba yomthetho.” Ihhovisi likaMashatile lithe kuzobhungwa ngezigatshana ezimbili kulo mthetho, okuyisigaba sesine nesesihlanu. "Okunye okuvunyelwene ngakho ukuthi amaqembu kumele abeke eceleni izinto akholelwa kuzona ukuze kutholakale isisombululo kungqingetshe ngalo mthetho. Lokhu kwenzelwa ukuthi kusizakale abantu,” kusho uMashatile.
INHLANZI ishelwe amanzi kowasePakistan obevule ihhovisi eliwumbombayi loMnyango wezaseKhaya, eshayela abantu izitifiketi, omazisi nama-visa futhi ekwazi ukushadisa ngo-R18 000.Amaphoyisa athole ngezobunhloli anikela ebhilidini elisemgwaqweni uMatthews Meyiwa, eGreyville.Kuboshwe umnikazi wale ndawo oseyikhehla, amaphoyisa athe wafika eNingizimu Afrika ngo-1999 ngokuthi ashade ngokungemthetho nowesifazane oyisakhamuzi sakuleli maqede wamlaxaza esethole ubuzwe, wase elanda umkakhe owayesele ezweni lakubo. Ungaze ufunge ukuthi ihhovisi loMnyango wezaseKhaya ngoba emnyango kunegama lenkampani eliwumbombayi, ngaphakathi kuphanyekwe nesithombe sikaNgqongqoshe wezeMpilo uDkt Aaron Motsoaledi obephethe lo mnyango phambilini.La bantu kuthiwa bebefike bantshontshe umazisi wakho bese bekushadisa ungazi.Umsolwa uboshwe nabanye ababili okukhona nowesifazane okuthe uma ebona amaphoyisa waklebhula amanye amaphepha wawalahla emgqonyeni eshabalalisa ubufakazi.Amaphoyisa nabasebenzi bomnyango bawavundulule khona emgqonyeni amaphepha, umsolwa wabekwa icala lokuphazamisa ukusebenza kwengalo yomthetho.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe abasolwa bebefike bantshontshe umazisi wowesifazane oyisakhamuzi sakuleli."Uma sebewutholile umazisi, abasolwa bebekushadisa ngemali eqala ku-R18 000 nowokufika abanye babo bengekho ngisho eNingizimu Afrika. Oseshadisiwe ube esefaka isicelo esibizwa nge-spousal visa, ukuze angene kule lizwe njengowesilisa oshadelwe umuntu wesifazane wakule lizwe,” kusho uNetshiunda.Uthe uma oshadisiwe esefikile eNingizimu Afrika ufaka incwadi yesehlukaniso somshado nasuke eshadiswe naye, bese elanda umuntu wakhe wangempela ngoba usuke esenobuzwe bakuleli.UNetshiunda uthe bathole nokuthi kunomsebenzi womnyango obesebenza nala bantu, ebathumelela nama-screenshot ezinto zasemsebenzini nokuyinto engavumelekile."Lo msebenzi ubeze ababuze abasolwa ukuthi sebehambe ibanga elingakanani ngesicelo salowo osuke eshadiswa ngokungemthetho. Sesiyamazi ukuthi ungubani lo msebenzi osekusele ukuthi aboshwe,” kusho uNetshiunda.Amaphoyisa ashaqe konke obekusetshenziswa abasolwa namaphepha ezicelo "ebezingakagunyazwa”Amaphoyisa athi okwamanje awakwazi ukusho ukuthi inesikhathi esingakanani le ndawo isebenza kodwa sesiside.Awafunanga ukusho ukuthi ayivundulule kanjani kodwa athi ezobunhloli eziyitholile. "Umnikazi wale ndawo washada ngokungemthetho nomuntu wesifazane wakuleli ngo-1999. Wabe eselanda inkosikazi yakhe ePakistan, wadivosa owakuleli abeshade naye. Le nto wayenza eminyakeni engu-25 edlule, uyacabanga-ke ukuthi singakanani isikhathi yenzeka le nto,” kusho uNetshiunda. Amaphoyisa ebekukhona nakaMasipala weTheku abengahleki engathi nsi esesha le ndawo kukhona naweSAPS ephethe izinhlokohlela zezibhamu.Abasolwa bebelokhu bechaza into engapheli futhi engezwakali bephonswa imibuzo abasebenzi bomnyango namaphoyisa. Bekuphethwe nomshini obuqinisekisa ubunikazi bomazisi abebesemaphepheni atholakale kuleli hhovisi.Bese liyozilahla kunina amaphoyisa ephuma nabasolwa kuleli bhilidi abafaka ezimotweni, akhala amaphepha nabo. Lawo abekade ephethe izinhlokohlela zezibhamu alandele ngemuva kwazise abelawula nokuhamba kwezimoto emgwaqweni ngesikhathi kuphunywa nabasolwa beyofakwa ezimotweni.
ZIYAVEVA izinhlangano ezilwela abampofu emuva kokuthi uNgqongqoshe weMali, uMnuz Enoch Godongwana, ememezele ukuthi ngeke sivuselelwe isibonelelo sikaR370 sabangasebenzi ngonyaka ozayo.UGodongwana uthe uR370 uzogcina ukungena kuma-akhawunti abantu ngoMashi wonyaka ozayo bese emuva kwalokho abangasebenzi bazoba yingxenye yezinhlelo zokubaxhumanisa namathuba omsebenzi. Ukuvula lawo mathuba omsebenzi kuzosetshenziswa uR370 abawutholayo.UNkk Evashnee Naidu, ongumphathi weBlackSash KwaZulu-Natal, uthe bashaqekile ukubona ukuthi imali yezibonelelo zomphakathi yehlisiwe futhi ayikho ekaR370 obhekelele abangasebenzi.Ukhale ngokuthi kufanele uhulumeni abonisane nezinhlangano ezilekelela abampofu nomphakathi wonkana ngoba baningi kakhulu abantu abampofu abalekelelwa wuR370 wabangasebenzi.Ubalule ukuthi izinkinga ezibhekene nabangasebenzi zikhombisa ngokucacile ukuthi siyadingeka isibonelelo sabangasebenzi esizobasiza ukuphila kangcono esibizwa ngeBasic Income Grant.Izolo uGodongwana utshele izintatheli ukuthi okwamanje iNingizimu Afrika ngeke ikwazi ukuba neBasic Income Grant ngoba ayikho imali.UMnuz Dalli Weyers, we-Institute for Economic Justice (IEJ), uthe kuyimanje basenkantolo balwela ukuthi kunabantu abakhishwa ngaphandle esibonelelweni sabangasebenzi ngakho ukungatholakali kwaso kuyosho ukuthi u-8 million wabasiholayo uzobulawa yindlala."Asiqondi ukuthi uhulumeni uzolwa kanjani nendlala nobuphofu uma eqeda isibonelelo sabangasebenzi. Uhulumeni kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi ulekelela bonke abantu abaswele, kuyimanje siyalwa enkantolo ukuthi wonke umuntu ongasebenzi athole lesi sibonelelo sika-R370. Sifuna sinyuswe sibe yimali umuntu azokwazi ukuthenga ngayo igilosa,” kusho uWeyers.Uthe bazoqhubeka nokulwa nokuthi uhulumeni afake imali ezobhekelela abampofu njengoba esemkhankasweni wokubopha izifociya.Uzwakalise ukukhathazeka nangokuthi zonke izicelo zezibonelelo zikahulumeni sezizokwenziwa kumakhompyutha esho ukuthi akusiwo wonke umuntu one-internet neselula esezingeni lokuthatha izithombe ezidingeka uma ufake isicelo.Uphethe ngokuthi uhulumeni uzobe ejezisa abampofu uma ebaphuca isibonelelo sabangasebenzi nezinye.
UMSHUSHISI ubabaze unya kwabesilisa abane ababhekene necala lokunquma uqhoqhoqho owayefundisa eMangosuthu University of Technology (MUT).UMshushisi oMkhulu, u-Advocate Krishen Shah, ubabaze unya ngesikhathi enxusa iNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini ukuba ibagwebe laba abane.Abamangalelwa, oMnuz Siyabonga Freeman Mahaye (35), Thobani Mhlongo (23), Kwanele Makhaye (29) noSihle Mkhize (23), bathweswe icala lokuthumba, elokweba nelokubulala.Kuvela ukuthi umufi, uChanlall Dwarika (63), wathunjwa yilaba besilisa bemsusa emzini wakhe osemgwaqweni uMaynard, eThekwini, bamfaka emotweni yakhe, iHonda emnyama, bafika bamnquma uqhoqhoqho ehlathini kwamaFuya eNanda ngoMeyi 28.Enkantolo kuvele ukuthi umufi wayekade ecele laba besilisa ukuba bahlale emzini wakhe bawuqaphe njengoba kwakungahlali muntu kuwona.Ngesikhathi kwenzeka lesi sigameko kuvela ukuthi umufi wayesezinhlelweni zokuthi awudayisele uMfundisi Miya (elingatholakalanga igama lakhe) umuzi.UMiya uphinde waba ngomunye wofakazi kuleli cala. Umshushisi usebenzise ubufakazi bakhe njengoba kuvela ukuthi waze wavukwa yisibibithwane ngesikhathi echazela inkantolo ukuthi abamangalelwa bamnquma kanjani uqhoqhoqho umufi."Unya olwakhonjiswa yilaba lwahlala obala ngesikhathi uMiya ethula ubufakazi bakhe njengoba waze wavukwa yisibibithwane lapha enkantolo,'' usho kanje.Ummangalelwa wesine kuleli cala, uMkhize, ethula ubufakazi ngaphambilini watshela inkantolo ukuthi waphoqwa ukuba abe yingxenye yetulo lokusocongwa kukamufi.Lokhu ukuchaze njengembudane yoqobo umshushisi ebuza ukuthi kungani pho ngemuva kwesigameko uMkhize engayanga kolubika emaphoyiseni udaba."Uma esho kanjalo kwakumele kube khona akwenzayo ukuveza ukuthi kwenzakale lesi sigameko,'' usho kanje.Abameli babamangalelwa banikezwe ithuba lokuthi babancengele ukuthi inkantolo ingabagixabezi ngesigwebo esinzima kakhulu.Akucaci ukuthi umufi nabamangalelwa babazana kanjani njengoba waze wabacela ukuthi babheke umuzi wakhe.Ngaphambi kokuba bamsoconge umufi, bamphoqa ukuba abanikeze ipin yasebhange ukuze bezokhipha imali.Icala lihlehliselwe uNovemba 28 lapho okuzobhungwa khona ngosuku okuzophuma ngalo isinqumo.Enkantolo bekukhona abomndeni kamufi.
IDLIWE yizembe iMeya kaMasipala waKwaDukuza, ebisolwa ngokugoloza ukwehla esikhundleni, uNksz Lindile Nhaca.UNksz Nhaca ukhishwe ngevoti lokungabethembi ubuholi bakhe emhlanganweni womkhandlu, izolo.Isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNksz Nhaca sifakwe ngusotswebhu omkhulu emkhandlwini, uMnuz Humphrey Mbatha."Ngifake lesi siphakamiso ngenxa yokuthi iningi lamakhansela alisamethembi uNksz Nhaca ukuthi angakwazi ukuhola kahle lomkhandlu.”Isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNksz Nhaca sesekwe amakhansela e-ANC, EFF ne-IFP.UNksz Nhaca obengekho emhlanganweni wayizolo, kuvela ukuthi ufake isixoliso. Ukhishwa ngevoti lokungabethembi ubuholi bakhe nje, i-ANC yayikade imyalele ukuthi asule esikhundleni.Ubuholi be-ANC baqale bamumisa esikhundleni ngaphambi kokuthi bumyalele ukuthi ehle esikhundleni.Nokho uNksz Nhaca akazange avume ukwehla esikhundleni, uzame wehluleka ukuthola isivimbelo senkantolo ebesizonqanda ukuthi kulalelwe isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bakhe.Unobhala we-ANC esifundeni iGeneral Gizenga Mpanza, uMnuz Siphesihle Zulu, uthe uNksz Nhaca usazoqhubeka nokuba yikhansela emkhandlwini."Kubuhlungu ukuthi kuze kwafika lapho sikhipha esikhundleni omunye wethu ngevoti lokungabethembi ubuholi bakhe. Amalungu e-ANC kufanele akwamukele ukuthi inhlangano iyona eqokayo, nephinde yehlise abaholi ezikhundleni.”UZulu uthe bafuna ukuthi imeya entsha iqokwe ngesonto elizayo.Kuvela igama likaMnuz Njabulo Cele, embangweni wesikhundla. Emhlanganweni okuzoqokwa kuwo imeya kuzophinde kuqokwe nephini lemeya.Iphini lemeya kulo mkhandlu alikaze likhethwe kusukela kwashona uMnuz Thulani "Mbazo” Ntuli, ngonyaka owedlule.Njengamanje uMasipala waKwaDukuza uphethwe ngokubambisana yi-ANC, AIC ne-ATM.Ukuvota kwe-IFP ne-ANC izolo kuqubule amahlebezi okuthi lawa maqembu angase asebenzisane.Kusukela lawa maqembu aqala ukusebenzisana kuhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal, aseqalile ukubambisana kweminye imikhandlu yakulesi sifundazwe.Njengamanje amaqembu abambisene kuMasipala waseThekwini nowaseMzumbe.Emhlanganweni wayizolo kuphinde kwabhuntsha imizamo yokukhipha esikhundleni usomlomo womkhandlu, uNkk Dolly Govender.Isiphakamiso sokukhipha uNkk Govender ebesifakwe yiDA asizange siphumelele.
INGCINDEZI nokuhlala edlinza ngokuvalwa kwenyuvesi, wabe esehlala ekhaya ngesikhathi sokubheduka kobhubhane lweCovid-19, kuzale ibhizinisi kowesifazane waseMpangeni.UNksz Thembelihle Mathaba ongumsunguli wenkampani ekhiqiza uju lwezinyosi, iThothelihle Bee Farming, uthe wazithola esebhuquza ekhaya ngo-2020 ngoba inyuvesi i-Durban University of Technology (DUT) yabe ivaliwe, nebhizinisi lakhe lokudayisa izimpahla zokugqoka namakha nalo selishabalele ngoba bekungavumelekile ukuba uvanzi.UJU olukhiqizwa yinkampani esungulwe ngowesifazane obenesithukuthezi ngesikhathi seCovid-19 ISITHOMBE: SITHUNYELWE Ngesikhathi ehleli ekhaya wathatheka ebona uyise nomngani wakhe ababechitha isizungu ngokutapa amakhekhe ezinyosi emahlathini."Bona babedayisa amakhekhe ezinyosi, nami ngaqale ngahamba nabo senza okufanayo. Ngesikhathi ngihamba nabo ngafunda ukuthi uzilalisa kanjani izinyosi uma sekushaye isikhathi sokuthi uvune, uthathe amakhekhe azo ngale kokulimala. Ngafunda ukuthi uziheha kanjani ukuze ziye emabhokisini akhelwe ukuthi uzobuye uvune amakhekhe. Ngathatheka uma ngibona indlela imvelo esebenza ngayo," kuchaza uNksz Mathaba.Uthe wabona ithuba lebhizinisi lokudayisa uju olusemabhodleleni esikhundleni samakhekhe njengoba uyise nomngani wakhe ababenza ngayo.UNksz Mathaba ungomunye wosomabhizinisi abancane ebebekhangisa ngomsebenzi wabo embukisweni wosomabhizinisi abancane obuhlelwe uMasipala weTheku, obisenxanxatheleni yezitolo KwaMnyandu, ngesonto eledlule. Uthe ubeqala ukuthola ithuba lokukhangisa ibhizinisi lakhe embukisweni, ejwayele ukudayisa ezimakethe ezidayisa imikhiqizo yezolimo.Le ntokazi ithi ithole amakhasimende amaningi kulo mbukiso, yabonwa nayisikhungo i-DUT, okuyisona esayisiza ukuthi ilungise umbono wayo webhizinisi, ngokwelulekwa uphiko lwayo olwaziwa nge-Innobiz Enterprenuer Centre."Ngiphothule izifundo zami zePost Graduate kwi-Human Resources Management (HR) ngo-2023. Kulo nyaka ngisakhokha umoya. Lokho kwenze ukuthi ngingabikhona kumakhompyutha aseDUT akhomba ukuthi ngiyisitshudeni sakhona kodwa uma sebengibona bakhumbulile. Kwavuleka ithuba lokuthi bangitshele uma benemibukiso okungena kuyo abantu abaphekwe ilesi sikhungo. Kumanje ngikomunye umbukiso ngenxa yalokho," ehleka.Uthe kulo nyaka ukhiqize u-50l woju ngamabhokisi angu-20 abanawo.Uqhube wathi kuningi asekufundile kulo mkhakha njengokuthi uma usuwenza ibhizinisi kumele ubhalise ebhodini elithile, eliqale libheke ukuthi uma uvunyelwa ukufuya izinyosi endaweni ethile okungaba isepulazini noma esiqiwini, ngeke ubeke abasebenza khona engozini. Kubhekwa nokuthi kwawena uphephile yini? Kuqinisekiswa ukuthi ngeke uhlaselwe yizinyosi ngoba usuqeqeshiwe ukuthi zisetshenzwa kanjani."Ngisaphezulu kwalowo mkhankaso ukuze ngikwazi ukuya emapulazini ngiyocela ukufuya khona ngoba khona kunezihlahla ezithile izinyosi ezincela kuzo uju bese zakha amakhekhe akhipha uju olunhlobonhlobo. Abanye abalimi bakubiza bona ngoba izinyosi ziyasebenza zisabalalise impova (pollen) ezitshalweni zabo, ukuze zithele kakhulu kodwa kudingeka ulithathe lelo thuba uma unawo amaphepha efanele," kusho yena.Uthe useqale nokwenza insipho esebenzisa lona uju kodwa isahlolwa ukuthi iphephile yini, akakayidayisi ezitolo.
OWAYENGUNGQONGQOSHE wezeMidlalo kuleli, uMnuz Zizi Kodwa, uveze ukuthi kwakunzima ngesikhathi ehla esikhundleni sokuhola umnyango ukuze abhekane namacala enkohlakalo, agcine ehoxisiwe. UKodwa nabebekwe naye icala uMnuz Jehan Mackay, ongusomabhizinisi, bajabule ngesikhathi inkantolo yemantshi ePalm Ridge, ihoxisa amacala abebebekwe wona.Lokhu kulandela ukuthi uPhiko lwezokuShushisa, linqume ukuhoxisa amacala ngoba lingeke liphumelele ekubashushiseni.UKodwa ubesolwa ngokwamukela uR1.6 million kuMackay ngo-2015, ukuze uKodwa amcubuzele amagabadi ngokumkhulumela ngoba lo somabhizinisi wayegaqele ithenda yezobuchwepheshe komunye weminyango kahulumeni. Le mali uKodwa kuthiwa wayisebenzisa ngokuthenga unyanyavu lwemoto nokukhokhela izindawo ezibizayo zokuhlala. Ngaleso sikhathi wayengumkhumeli we-ANC.Ephefumula ngokuhoxiswa kwamacala, uthe kwakunzima ngesikhathi enxusa uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, ukuba amdedele ukuze abhekane namacala."Ngazicelela ukuhoxa ngaphandle kwengcindezi ukuze ngibhekane namacala. Ngesikhathi kwenzeka amacala ebengibekwe wona, ngangikhulumela i-ANC, ngingenamandla okuthi ngingatholela umuntu ithenda.”Uthe wangena evenini yophiko loKlebe eyovela enkantolo okokuqala, ngoba ekuqonda ukuthi noma ngubani kumele abhekane nomthetho."Baningi abangisekile ngesikhathi ngihamba leli cala. Ngashayelwa ngisho abaholi abaphezulu be-ANC, bengigqugquzela ukuthi ngiqine. Ngasekwa ngisho nawuphiko lwentsha lwe-ANC Youth League.”Uthe kwi-ANC akekho ogiya ngethambo lomunye ngoba ebhekene nobunzima."Ngiyabonga ukuthi iNPA ibonile ukuthi akukho okubambekayo. Kunzima uma usuwedwa ubhekene namacala, yingakho ngibonga ukwesekwa.” Mayelana nekusasa lakhe, uthe uzobuyela ensimini eyokwenza umsebenzi kaKhongolose."Angisebenzi manje, ngingenza noma yini. Ngingaba ngisho intatheli,” kusho uKodwa.Ummeli kaKodwa, uMnuz Zola Majavu, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi amacala ahoxisiwe. Uthe kwakunzima kuKodwa emtshela ukuthi angathi vu kwabezindaba mayelana necala."Ngiyajabula ukuthi amacala ahoxisiwe, usekhululekile. Uzovuka azithathe, ngimfisela okuhle kodwa.”Okhulumela iNPA uNksz Phindi Mjonondwane, uthe abakwazi ukudalula izinto eziningi ezenze bahoxisa amacala. Uthe kukhona ubufakazi obusha obuvelile wathi bebengeke besakwazi ukushushisa ngempumelelo leli cala yingakho belihoxisile."Asikwazi ukudalula ubufakazi obusha obuthulwe nguKodwa noMackay kwiNPA. Abangeneme ngesinqumo sokuhoxiswa kwecala bangafaka isicelo sokuthi kubuyekezwe lesi sinqumo,” kusho uNksz Mjonondwane.Uthe uma beshushisa amacala babuka ubufakazi ababuki isiqu somuntu.
INKANTOLO eNkulu yaseMtubatuba igixabeze uLindokuhle Mhlongo (33) ngodilikajele ababili neminyaka emihlanu ngaphezulu emva kokumlahla ngecala lokubulala uZanokuhle Khumalo (7).Lesi sehlo senzeka emzini obudebuduze nakubo kamufi eDumisani Makhaye, eMpangeni, ngoJulayi.Isidumbu sikamufi satholwa sishuthekwe ngoplasitiki ngaphansi kombhede egumbini elaliqashwe uMhlongo kwamakhelwane kaZanokuhle.Emva kwesehlo, uMhlongo wakhala wemuka, wabe esethumela umyalezo esihlotsheni salapho ayeqashe khona, ethi ingane abayibheke ngaphansi kombhede.Kwavela ukuthi uyibulale ngoba yanqaba ukuthi ayidlwengule.Ngosuku lwesigameko kwavela ukuthi umufi wayephume kubo ewumuntu oyodlala nokwathi uma esebhekwa, kwavela ukuthi umasitende kaMhlongo, wayekade emthume amaphilisi ezinhlungu esitolo.Ezinsukwini ezimbalwa ezalandela olwesigameko, umphakathi owawudinwe ugane unwabu wangqongqisa umuzi kamasitende kaMhlongo.
BAPHITHANE amakhanda ngesikhathi owesilisa waseLindelani, eThekwini, egqoma unina nomalume wakhe ngepiki entathakusa ngoLwesine, okuphethe ngokuthi abulawe umphakathi.Kulesi sigameko kushone uNkk Tholakele Khanyile nomfowabo uMnuz Bhekuyise Zondi (77) bebulawa uMnuz Lindani Khanyile (43).Esinye isihlobo esiphiselwe ngepiki engalweni kuthiwa sisesibhedlela. Isolezwe libuye lakhonjiswa esinye isihlobo esikhulelwe, ebesihuzuke emadolweni. Kuthiwa silimale ngesikhathi seqa uthango lwakubo kanti sizovele siwe.Silandisa ngesigameko isihlobo, uMnuz Jabulani Zondi, okufe uyise kulesi sehlo, sithe bekungabo-4.30 ekuseni bevuswa umsindo wokukhala kukaNkk Khanyile.Uthe bavuke bonke kubo okungumuzi obhekene nokababekazi wakhe. "ULindani obebhongisa okwesilwane esingasazi, uvele waliphisela kubaba ipiki obaleke wayowela esangweni ekhaya. Ubeza ngqo kuwo wonke umuntu obezama ukusondela kuye,” kusho uZondi.INDLU okufele kuyo uNkk Tholakele Khanyile Isithombe: SIMANGALISO NTSHANGASEUthe ngesikhathi umsolwa esalibele ukugijimisa ezinye izihlobo ebezithi ziyosiza unina, basale babona ukuthi unina akasanyakazi."Nakuba besibona ukuthi balinyazwe kabi futhi akuthembisi ngempilo yabo, siqhubekile ngokwenza izaba, sayofuna imoto ezobayisa esibhedlela,” kusho uZondi, othe kubuye kwabonakala ukuthi ngeke bayiswe esibhedlela ngoba sebephangalele.Uthe ngesikhathi bedidizela ngomshophi obusuvele, bathole ukuthi umphakathi, nawo ovuswe umsindo ngenxa yobekwenzeka, uvele wambamba, wamtitinya waze wafa umsolwa emgwaqweni oseduze.Usizi belubhalwe ebusweni ngesikhathi echaza amanxeba awabonile kwabaphangalele."Ubaba ubenodume lwengozi okhakhayini. Enye ibisenhlafunweni. Ubabekazi nakuye bezisekhanda nasebusweni ezakhe izingozi ezivulekile,” kusho uZondi.Uthe endlini lapho okubulawelwe khona ubabekazi wakhe igazi beligcwele yonke indawo."Beligijima ngisho nangaphansi kumata, elinye lisaphazeke ezindongeni,” kuchaza uZondi, othe ubabekazi wakhe uphelele ngaphakathi ekamelweni lakhe eduze komnyango.Uthe namanje abazi ukuthi ubengenwe yini umzala wakhe ngoba ubemthanda unina nomndeni wonke, ngisho nomalume ambulele.Uthe badidwa nawukuthi ubengesiye umuntu wodlame nezidakamizwa.Uthe kwenzeka lo mshophi nje, umzala ubefike ngoLwesibili, ezobheka yena unina njengenjwayelo njengoba ezihlalela emqashweni eMlaza."Ubezohamba ngoMgqibelo, eseyongena ePhoyinti (South Beach) lapho asebenza khona njengonogada,” usho kanje.Uchaze kafishane ukuthi uNkk Khanyile ubulawa nje bese ewumuntu osezihlalela emakhaya.Uthe ubenezinyanga ezintathu ebuyile eThekwini ezolungisa yona le ndlu abulawelwe kuyo eyayikhahlanyezwe yizikhukhula ngo-2022."Bebeyilungisa bobabili. Bezwana. Engekho obenenkinga nomunye. Ukuthi kwenzeke kanjani agcine esembulala, asazi,” kusho uZondi.Uthe ipiki belisetshenziswa abakhi abebakha yona indlu.Uthe bebelala kuyo njengoba bese kulaleka kuyo.
IZIKHULU zamatekisi ahamba amabanga amade iDurban Long Distance Taxi Association, zithi kusezandleni zikaMphathiswa wezokuThutha nokuHlaliswa kwabantu uMnuz Siboniso Duma, ukuthi babuyele emsebenzini ngoba izimvume bayile ukuyozilanda ebhodini kepha abazitholanga. NgoLwesithathu osomatekisi obese kuwusuku lwesithathu bepake amatekisi, bengalayishi, ekuseni bapake amatekisi emgwaqweni uMngeni, kwadaleka isiminyaminya. KUNGENELELE amaphoyisa osomatekisi befuna ukuvala imigwao ngaseDurban Station emuva kokuphazamiseka kweminye imigwaqo ebivaliwe bekhala ngezimvume Isithombe: DOCTOR NGCOBO/Independent NewspapersErenki yaseDurban Station, lapho abajwayele ukupaka khona babhekane ngeziqu zamehlo namaphoyisa kodwa kwabuye kwadlula. Osomatekisi bakhala ngokuboshwa wuphiko lwezokuthutha uShanela, ngoba bengenazo izimvume. USihlalo weDurban Long Distance Taxi Association, uMnuz Bhekisisa Nzuza, uthe umphathiswa ubekhuluma ihaba uma ethi izimvume zikhona.KUNGENELELE amaphoyisa osomatekisi befuna ukuvala imigwaqo ngaseDurban Station, emuva kokuphazamiseka kweminye imigwaqo ebivaliwe bekhala ngezimvume Isithombe: DOCTOR NGCOBO/Independent Newspapers"Azikho, azikho izimvume asizitholanga. Umphathiswa utshele izwe izolo (ngoLwesibili) ukuthi izimvume zikhona, sathi uma sifika ebhodini siyozilanda, bathi azikho. Umphathiswa utshele izwe into engekho. Siyazibuza ukuthi yini ndaba ekhulume into eyihlazo kangaka," kusho uNzuza.Uthe konke kusezandleni zikamphathiswa ukuthi bayabuyela emsebenzini noma bangabuyeli."Lento isisezandleni zakhe ngoba thina sifuna izimvume, abasiniki, basikhombe ebhodini bethi asiyozilanda, sifike zingekho. Izimoto zimile azilayishi," usho kanje.Isitatimende esikhishwe yihhovisi likaDuma, sithe bajabule ukuthi ekugcineni izikhulu zamatekisi beziyolanda izimvume."Kumele beveze amaphepha asemthethweni okungakapheli izinyanga ezintathu esethifayiwe. Lezo zincwadi eze-PRDP yomshayeli wetekisi, iCOR yemoto, ilogbook kanye nesitembu saserenki semvume esiqhamuka kuMasipala weTheku," sisho kanje isitatimende.Sithe emhlanganweni ababenawo nabamatekisi ngoSepthemba okwakukhona kuwo noMkhuzi wamaphoyisa uLt Gen Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi kwavunyelwana ukuthi izimvume bazozilanda."Kwakunezimvume ezingu-115 ngalesiya sikhathi. Ezingu-84 zase zizophelelwa yisikhathi emva kwezinsuku ezingu-60, eziyisishiyagalolunye zase zivele ziphelelwe yisikhathi kwathi ezingu-170 zase zikhishiwe."Sizibophezele ukugcina uzinzo embonini yamatekisi ngoba kubalulekile ekuqiniseni ukuthuthukiswa komnotho KwaZulu-Natal. Sizokwenza konke okusemandleni ukuvikela osomatekisi abasebenza ngobuqotho embonini futhi abalandela umthetho," sisho kanje.Siqhube sathi uphiko oluqaphe ukusebenza kwamatekisi uShanela, luzoqhubeka nokuvikela abagibeli futhi luqinisekise ukuthi abagibeli basebenziza amatekisi akulungele ukuba semgwaqweni futhi anamaphepha asemthethweni.Okhulumela amaphoyisa eTheku, uColonel Boyzie Zungu, uthe isimo basiqaphile."Isimo sisibhekile ngoba baqale bavala umgwaqo uM4 no-Victoria Embarkment eThekwini, kodwa manje (esho izolo) sekuvulekile. Amaphoyisa asiqaphile isimo yonke indawo. Impi ayibhekene nathi njengoMasipala waseThekwini kanye namaphoyisa akwaMetro, kodwa banenkinga noMnyango wezokuThutha," kuchaza uColonel Zungu.Uphinde waqinisekisa ukuthi abekho ababoshiwe.
IZIBHINCISELE nxanye izinkampani ezinkulu zakuleli inkampani yaKwaZulu-Natal, ephethwe ngumuntu omnyama. Le nkampani inesitifiketi sokugaya izinto ezibucayi ezweni, ezinjengamaphepha okuvota, amasheke asemabhange kanjalo namaphepha okudlala i-lotto.Le nkampani iProcess Litho eseRedhill, eThekwini, ibuye nendondo yegolide yashaya izinkampani ezinkulu emcimbini wokuklonyeliswa kwezinkampani ezigaya izinto ezehlukene kuleli.Ithole indondo yegolide ngaphansi komkhakha wokugaya amaphephabhuku abenyezelayo.Umnikazi jikelele wenkampani uMnuz Muziwakhile Ntombela, uthe ukusebenza kanzima yikhona okubenze bahlabana ngale ndondo.Uthe indondo ababuye nayo eSandton ngempelasonto, iklonyeliswa inkampani esuke idle umhlanganiso ezinkampanini ezehlukene ezisemkhakheni wokugaya.Ubalule ukuthi banesitifiketi sokugaya izinto ezibucayi ezinjamaphepha okuvota, amaphepha okudlala i-lotto kanjalo namasheke asemabhange."Sekuyisikhathi sokuthi abantu abamnyama abaphethe amabhizinisi baphakame emkhakheni abakuyo. Kubalulekile nokuthi uma sinikwe imisebenzi ethile, siyenze ngobuqotho futhi namakhasimende akwazi ukuthembela emabhizinisini aphethwe abamnyama,” kusho uNtombela.Uthe bahlule izinkampani ezinkulu eziphethwe ngabamhlophe ngoba kule ndima yibona abasashaya amaphiko."Ukuthola izitifiketi kwenza nabanye osomabhizinisi belinye ibala basihloniphe njengosomabhizinisi abamnyama. Nathi sinawo amava okugaya izinto ezibucayi ezweni,” kuqhuba uNtombela.UNtombela odabuka eBabanango, uthe abaqali ukuhlabana ngezindondo zokwenza kahle."Eminyakeni edlule sike sahlabana ngendondo okusho khona ukuthi siwubeka phambili umsebenzi esiwenzayo. Siyinkampani egxile ekufukuleni nentsha ikakhulu kulesi sikhathi sokushoda kwamathuba emisebenzi.”Ubonge abasebenzi bakule nkampani ngokuzinikela emsebenzini wabo.Uveze ukuthi ngaphandle kokuzinikela kwabo bebengeke babuye nale ndondo bahlule nezinkampani ezihlonishwayo kuleli.
BABONGA bayanconcoza abaqoqa imfucuza eNew Germany, eThekwini, njengoba kungeke kusadingeka ukuthi baze bazifikele mathupha lapho okulahlwa khona imfucuza ngenhloso yokuthi iphinde isetshenziswe.Lokhu kuhlaluke izolo ngesikhathi inkampani iBig Start Training and Development yethula inqola ezohambela emphakathini waseNew Germany, namaphethelo ukuze ilekelele ekunciphiseni ibanga elihanjwa yilabo abasuke beletha imfucuza.Ekhuluma neSolezwe uNkk Maureen Hadebe, oqoqa imfucuza uthe ujabule kakhulu ngale nqola."Siyafa ukuthwala sizilethela thina imfucuza kuyo lendawo. Sisuke sithwele izinto ezisindayo okunye sigcine singakulethanga. Ngemfucuza engisuke ngiyilethile ngijwayele ukwenza imali engango-R120, R150 noma uR200 kushiyana ukuthi ngilethe izinto ezingakanani. Lemali engiyitholayo iyangisiza ngikwazi ukubeka isinkwa etafuleni ngithenge ngisho ugesi," kuchaza uNkk Hadebe.Kanti uNkk Sphiwe Myaka uthe inqola izosiza ngoba nasemilenzeni akaphilile kahle."Ukuthwala bese kungilimaza kakhulu. Lento engiyezayo yokuletha imfucuza ngisuke ngenzela izingane zami ukuthi zithole isinkwa. Bese ngizibuza ukuthi laba abathathelwa yizimoto abanjani, mina ngibe ngithwala kangaka kuze kube buhlungu intamo," kusho uNkk Myaka.Uthe imali ayenzayo ilinganiselwa ku-R150, no-R100. Uthe akubonga kakhulu kunakho konke ukuthi izingane zakhe zilala zidlile ngoba ngaleyo madlana encane uyakwazi ukuthenga impuphu.Ongumsunguli aphinde abe ngumqondisi kwaBig Start, uNkk Thozeka Letuka, uthe ukunikelelwa ngenqola kusho lukhulu."Ukuthola le nqola kusho lukhulu ngoba izosisiza kakhulu. Ukusebenzisana nabanye abantu kuzokwenza nomsebenzi ube lula kithina. Amalungu omphakathi nginesiqiniseko sokuthi azoyithakasela kakhulu," kusho uNkk Letuka.UNksz Elizabeth Nkewane oqhamuka kwaPolyco, okuyinkampani ekhiqiza uplastiki, uthe ukwethulwa kwale nqola kuzonciphisa igebe ngoba izofinyelela kalula emphakathini wonkana."Le nqola izosiza ngoba izoya kubo ngqo ngoba amanye amalungu omphakathi kubabiza imali ukusuka lapho abahlala khona bezoletha lemfucuza eBig Start. Kunabantu abadala asebekhulile abahlala kude abahlangabezana nezingqinamba uma belethe imfucuza," kuchaza uNksz Nkewane.Uthe inqola ine-solar power, nesikali. Amalungu omphakathi azothi uma eseyilethile imfucuza akwazi ukuthi akalelwe akhokhelwe ngokushesha njengoba ezothola isiliphu angakwazi ukuthi ayosishintsha ezitolo ukuze basebenzise imali. Uthe okudingekayo amagama omuntu aphelele, inombolo yocingo kanye neminyaka yakhe.Ugcizelele nokuthi lokho kuzosiza inkampani uBig Start, ukuthi ibone isibalo sabantu abezile ukuzokala nokuthi bangaki inkampani ebakhokhelile.
BASOLA ubuthi obuphoswe emanzini abesethangini lamanzi emvula kufa izelamani ezisencane ezimbili KwaNdelu, eMthwalume.Kulesi sigameko kushone umfanyana, u-Ayanda Ndlovu (2), nomfowabo, u-Okuhle Ndlovu (6).Ngokusho kwelungu lomndeni, uNksz Balungile Ndlovu, unina uNkk Sibongile Ndlovu (54), nomzukulu wakhe, ongumfowabo omdala wabafi, u-Emihle Ndlovu (11), basesimweni esibucayi esibhedlela.Elandisa ngesehlo uNksz Ndlovu, uthe ukugula kuqale kudadewabo ongunina wabafi, uNksz Simangele Ndlovu, ngoMsombuluko."Ungishayele ucingo engitshela ukuthi uyafa ukuphalaza nokukhishwa yisisu. Sivalelisane ngazi ukuthi nguye ongaphathekile kodwa nginethemba lokuthi akukubi kangako,” kusho uNksz Ndlovu.Uthe uthuke wacishe woma udadewabo esemshayela ucigo ngoLwesibili ekuseni emtshela ukuthi sekushone u-Ayanda."Uthe naye uthathwe yiso isisu nokubuyisa. Ube esengazisa ukuthi empeleni bagula bonke, nguyena, umama namanye amadodana akhe amabili.”"Ngithe sengiza nabamakhaza sizolanda isidumbu sika-Ayanda, ngafica sekushone no-Okuhle,” kusho uNksz Ndlovu.Uthe ngaleso sikhathi unina, udadewabo no-Emihle bebegula kakhulu, bekhishwa yiso isisu bephalaza.Uthe ubabizele i-ambulensi ebathathe yabasa esibhedlela.Wathi unina wabafi udedelwe izolo ekuseni kubonakala sengathi usengconywana, unina no-Emihle basegunjini labagula kakhulu esibhedlela."Sisola ukuthi uphoyizeni ufakwe ethangini lamanzi ngoba lisemnyango kanti amanzi alo siwasebenzisela ukwenza yonke into okukhona ukupheka nokuwaphuza,” kusho uNksz Ndlovu.Uthe bayabona ukuthi uyingozi ngempela uphoyizeni odliwe umndeni wakhe ngoba kuze kwafa nenja edle umphalazo wabafi.Uthe yena usindiswe ukuthi akahlali ekhaya."AboMnyango wezeMpilo bafikile bazothatha amasampula amanzi bayowahlola ukuthi kanti anabuthi buni,” usho kanje.Ikhansela lendawo, uMnuz Bhekani Mngoma, litshele iSolezwe ukuthi liyile emndenini emva kokubikelwa ngesehlakalo.Liveze ukuthi umndeni ulitshele ukuthi usola amanzi asethangini njengoba kuthathwe namasampula.Uthe useqalile ukulekelela ngezinhlelo zomngcwabo ezifaka phakathi ukudla abazokusebenzisa kulindwe umngcwabo, izindleko zamakhaza, itende nokunye.Uveze ukuthi abantu basathukile kangangokuba nalabo abazokhalisa abafuni ngisho ukuthinta izitsha zakhona.Uthe sebethandazela ukuthi laba abalaliswe esibhedlela bawuphose umbalane.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa aseHibberdene abhalise amadokodo amabili okufa kwabantu ukuze aphenywe."Kulandela isigameko lapho izingane, eneminyaka emibili neneyisihlanu, zikhale ngokuphathwa yisisu ngoLwesibili. Kuzohlolwa izidumbu ukuze kutholakale ukuthi zibulawe yini,” kusho uNetshiunda.
KUBAMBEZELE ukukhishwa kwesigwebo ecaleni lokubulala, elokuzama ukubulala nelokuthumba iphoyisa, ukungabibikho kombiko wosonhlalakahle ngomunye wabamangalelwa owayesemncane ngesikhathi kwenzeka isigameko, obekulindeleke unekelwe inkantolo.Bekubhekwe ukuthi iNkantolo yeNkulu yaseThekwini, igwebe uMuzikayifani Ndebele olahlwe ngecala lokuzama ukubulala uConstable Zuma okuthiwa wamdubula, noSibusiso Ndlela ngelokumbulala nokumthumba njengoba ubufakazi obunekelwe inkantolo buveza ukuthi umgilwa wafa ngenxa yokusha nokuxhelwa yintuthu, esigamekweni esenzeka eTshelimnyama, eMariannhill ngesikhathi sezibhelu zangoJulayi 20221.IJaji uCarol Sibiya emva kokunqakisana ngamazwi nomshushisi wenkantolo u-Advocate Krishen Shah, linqume ukuthi icala lihlehlele ukuze kuzocaca ukuthi bagwetshwa nini.Ijaji likhononde ngokuthi umshushisi wayeqoke ukuthi icala lihlehlele usuku lwayizolo kodwa wangakubhekisisa ukuthi ngalesi sikhathi umbiko wosonhlalakahle uzobe sewulungile yini, okuthe ngokubonakala ukuthi awukafiki abameli babamangalelwa nenkantolo bavumelana ngokuthi lihlehle ukuze kubhekwe wona ngaphambi kokukhishwa kwesigwebo."Lesi senzo sokuhlehla kwecala silimaza umndeni okuyiwona ozithola ugibela uza enkantolo kugcine kungenzeki ngendlela okulindeleke ngayo. Akungaphindi okufanayo, kumele kube usuku lokugcina lokuthi kuphothulwe leli cala,” lisho kanje.UZuma wadutshulwa amahlandla amabili, wagoqwa ngoplastiki kadoti, wafakwa ebhuthini yemoto yakhe, eyatholwa kwenye indawo ingqongqiswe nesidumbu sakhe.Ubufakazi obunekelwe inkantolo, buthi uNdebele wadubula umgilwa amahlandla amabili, kwathi uMnuz Nzuzo Mngadi osengufakazi woMbuso noNdlela bamfaka kuplastiki wokulahla udoti, bamvalela ebhuthini yemoto yakhe kwahanjwa naye ngaphambi kokuthi kungqongqiswe ngomlilo imoto. UNdlela wayeneminyaka engu-19 ngesikhathi kwenzeka leli cala. Yize kuvele ukuthi uNdlela noMngadi akusibona abangqongqisa imoto kodwa abenza lokhu basagcwele amathafa, kodwa inkantolo yamlahla kwelokubulala uNdlela ngenxa yobufakazi bakhe okuthiwa abusilona iqiniso futhi wayenethuba lokuziqhelelanisa nababulali kodwa wakhetha ukuba mdibi nabo. Inkantolo iveze ukuthi iyabethemba ubufakazi bukaMngadi.
ISIFO sokwakheka koketshezi esikhwameni samankwahla asilona ilumbo, isifo esikhona esivamile kubantu besilisa asebekhulile.Lokhu kushiwo uDkt Thulani Nkosi owungoti wezifo ezithinta umgudu womchamo kwabesilisa, i-Urologist esibhedlela iLennmed La Verna Private Hospital eseMnambithi, obehola ithimba lodokotela abahlinze uMnuz Ntando Mhlongo (30) waseNanda, obese kuphele iminyaka eyisithupha egqigqa ezikhungweni zezempilo engalutholi usizo.UMhlongo ubengasasebenzi ngenxa yokuthi uketshezi oluhambisana nokusanyama namafutha belugcwala ngokushesha, engasakwazi ukuhamba kahle ngenxa yesigaxa ebesenza ukuthi abantu baphenduke naye uma bembona.Ngemuva kokuphumela kwakhe obala ezinkundleni zokuxhumana nasemsakazweni Ukhozi FM ecela usizo kunoma ngubani ongamsiza, uDkt Nkosi ukhulume nabaphathi besibhedlela ukuze ahlinzwe mahhala.Ukuhlinzwa kwakhe nokwelashwa athe kungabiza uR140 000 kuya ku-R180 000, kwenziwe ngoMsombuluko. Izolo bese elulama, uNkosi uthe ugculisekile ngesimo sakhe. "UMhlongo une-hydrocelectomy isifo esikhona esilaphekayo, okungajwayelekile ngale kaMhlongo ukuthi ayijwayelekile kubantu abancane abangangaye. Akulona ilumbo ngoba lona leyamaniswa nobuthakathi kanti lesi isifo esaziwayo," kusho uNkosi.Uthe uMhlongo usekhishiwe egumbini labanakekelwa ngokuthe xaxa, usesewodini elijwayelekile. Odokotela balindele ukuthi aphole ngokuphelele emasontweni amabili kuya kwamathathu. Njengamanje isilonda sakhe siyaphola, asophi okuyizinkomba zokuthi uyalulama.UMhlongo, izolo ubengakakhulumi nezintatheli kodwa ngaphambi kokuthi ahlinzwe ubonge isibhedlela ngokumsiza ngokubuyisela impilo yakhe esimeni.UDkt Nkosi, uthe lesi sifo singadalwa izinto eziningi okungaba isifo sofuba, izigaxa zomdlavuza, ukulimala esithweni sangasese, kwesinye isikhathi umsuka waso awaziwa."Uketshezi, okusanyama namafutha okukhishwe kuMhlongo kube ngu-20L. Ukumhlola kwethu kuveza ukuthi ngeke sisabuya. Sibuyisele inyama yesikhwama ebese sinwebekile, ubuntu bakhe busazosebenza kahle futhi usazokwazi ukuba nezingane (ukukhulelisa). Asilindele ukuthi aphinde ahlinzwe kodwa umbiko ophelele sizowukhipha ngemuva kwamasonto amathathu," kuqinisekisa uDkt Nkosi.
PHEZU kokuba uMnyango weMfundo eyisiSekelo ubhekene nengwadla yokushodelwa isabelomali kodwa kudingeka izikhala eziwu-250 000, ukuze kwanele bonke abafundi bakwaGrade R.Lokhu kuvezwe nguNgqongqoshe weMfundo eyisiSekelo, uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, ephendula umbuzo welungu le-FF Plus ePhalamende, uDkt Johannes Boshoff.Usho lokhu nje, umnyango ubhekene nengwadla yokushoda kwemali njengoba izikhulu zawo zihlala zikhala ngenkinga yokungeneli kwemali.Lokhu kwenza ukuthi kwezinye izifundazwe singeke sandiswe isibalo sothisha ngenxa yenkinga yemali."Babalelwa ku-1 million abafundi abazoqala uGrade R ezikoleni. Sidinga izindawo eziwu-250 000 ukuze abafundi bakwaGrade R, banele bonke.” Uthe ezifundazweni ezifana neMpumalanga, KwaZulu-Natal nezinye, othisha bafundisa abafundi abevile ku-30. Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi uGrade R usanda kungena ngokuphelele eMnyangweni wezeMfundo, usuka eMnyangweni wezeNhlalakahle.Umthetho osanda kusayinwa wezikole i-Bela, wenza kube yimpoqo ukuthi uGrade R ube sezikoleni. Abafundi sebezoqala kwaGrade R ezikoleni. Phambilini, bekuyimpoqo ukuthi abafundi baqale isikole kwaGrade 1.Izinyunyana zothisha zikhala njalo ngokungabhekelelwa ngendlela kothisha abafundisa uGrade R.UNksz Gwarube uveze ukuthi bangu-749 957, abafundi abenza uGrade R okwamanje kuleli.Ubalule ukuthi iKZN yisona sifundazwe esinabafundi abaningi abenza leli banga."Bangu-167 000 abenza uGrade R eKZN, kulandele iLimpopo ngabangu-117 000, kuze iGauteng ngabangu-113 000. INorthern Cape iyona enesibalo esincane sabafundi abenza uGrade R ngabangu-19 253,” kusho uNksz Gwarube. Sekube nesikhalo ngabafundi abasala endleleni kuleli, abangafinyeleli ka-matric.Minyaka yonke babalelwa ku-700 000 ababhala u-matric ekubeni bebalelwa ku-1 million abasuke beqale uGrade 1.

LIKHATHAZEKILE ihhovisi likaMcwaningi Mabhuku jikelele kuleli, ngesibalo esiphezulu samanzi angafinyeleli emphakathini waseThekwini, ngoba ephelela emhlabathini.La manzi aphelela emhlabathini ngenxa yokuvuza kwamapayipi ngenxa yokungalungiswa kwengqalasizinda ngesikhathi.UNksz Nomalungelo Mkhize, wehhovisi likaMcwaningi mabhuku KwaZulu-Natal, uveze ukuthi u-58% wamanzi athengwa nguMkhandlu weTheku ugcina ungafinyelelanga ezakhamuzini."Asisabuthi quthu ubuthongo ngale nkinga yamanzi ebhekene nezakhamuzi zaseThekwini. Amanzi agcina engafikanga emphakathini ngenxa yokuthi aphelela emhlabathini,” kusho uNksz Mkhize.Ukusho lokhu izolo ethula umbiko ekomitini elibhekele ukusebenza kwezimali zomphakathi ePhalamende iScopa, ngocwaningo lwezimali olwenziwe kuMasipala weTheku onyakeni wezimali u-2022/2023.Sekuyisinkwa semihla kwezinye izakhamuzi zakuleli dolobha ezibhekene nengwadla yokushodelwa ngamanzi nsuku zonke. Kulezi zindawo umasipala uthumela izimoto ezithwala amanzi ukuyophakela umphakathi osuke udinga amanzi. Umasipala usuke wayiveza eyokuvuza kwamapayipi okwenza kulahleke amanzi aphelela emhlabathini. Kunemikhankaso ehlukene yokuzama ukunqanda ukuvuza kwamanzi.UNksz Mkhize uveze nokuthi abanye abakweleta umasipala bayahluleka ukukhokha izikweletu zabo."Okuvelile ngukuthi umasipala washayeka kakhulu ngesikhathi kuhlasele izikhukhula, izikhawu ezehlukene. Ibingalungiswa ingqalasizinda okwenze kwaba nzima kakhulu uma sekugadla izikhukhula.”Ubalule nokuthi bathole ukuthi incane imali ebekelwe ukulungisa ingqalasizinda okwenza kube nzima uma kuba nezinhlekelele ezenza kudingeke ingqalasizinda esezingeni.Ubalule nokuthi amanye amakhansela enza imisebenzi nomkhandlu."Kuyasikhathaza singabacwaningi ukuthi umkhandlu ugcina uhluleka ukuthola umbiko ongenagcobho wezimali ngoba kunezinto esilokhu sikhala ngazo ezingalungiswa. Ezinye zazo zithinta indaba yokuthengwa kwempahla, akulandelwa imigomo efana nokuthi ufune ama-quotation amathathu uma ufuna ukuthenga izinto ezithile kanjalo neyamakhansela enza imisebenzi nomkhandlu.”Ubalule ukuthi ngonyaka odlule wezimali inguR3.6 billion imali esebenze ngokungafanele eThekwini.Kubuye kwavela nokuthi kunemali yokulungisa imigwaqo ngaphansi kohlelo lwamabhasi okunongqingetshe kulona, engasetshenziswa.Usihlalo weScopa, uMnuz Songezo Zibi, ucele amalungu ukuthi abhale imibuzo ngombiko othulwe nguMcwaningi Mabhuku jikelele, ukuze ayiphendule ngokuthi abhale ngenxa yokuthi isikhathi bese sisincane.

SIBONGE ummeli sathi sizozimela sona enkantolo isiboshwa esidonsa udilikajele esisolwa ngokuba wungqondongqondo ekwakheni itulo lokuqothwa kwabantu abangu-18 eNgobozana, eLusikisiki.UMzukisi Ndamase (46) uvele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseLusikisiki ngoLwesine ekuseni.Yena nabanye abayisithupha babhekene namacala okubulala angu-18 nawokutholakala nezibhamu ezingekho emthethweni.Bekuqiniswe ezokuphepha engena enkantolo uNdamase, efake i-ovaroli ebomvu efaswe wakinatelwa ngozankosi nangamaketango izandla nemilenze kwahlanganiswa.Bekunzima nokuzisula umjuluko ngenxa yendlela abekinatelwe ngayo, enyakanyakaza egebisela ikhanda emaceleni futhi ebumbe umlomo.UMZUKISI Ndamase oyisiboshwa esidonsa udilikajele osolwa ngokuba wungqondongqondo ekwakheni itulo lokuqothwa kwabangu-18 eNgobozana, eLusikisiki Isithombe: NPA/EASTERN CAPEInkantolo ibigcwele izihlobo zabagilwa nabantu abebezozeseka.UMbuso usola uNdamase ngokwakhaa itulo esejele abekade evalelwe kulona eMthatha njengoba esesusiwe wayovalelwa kwelaseBhongweni, eKokstad KwaZulu-Natal.Umshushisi uthe kushoda ubufakazi bamarekhodi asemabhange akhombisa ukuthi kwakukhokhelwana kanjani imali.Kusukela ngo-2007, uNdamase udonsa isigwebo sikadilikajele neminyaka engu-15 ngaphezulu ngecala lokubulala nelokuphanga.Utshele inkantolo ukuthi okwamanje uyayibonga ibheyili ngoba vele usejele ngakho akuzokwenza mehluko ukucela ukuba adedelwe.Uphikisane nemantshi ebone ubucayi bamacala athweswe wona yathi akatholelwe ummeli wamahhala kodwa yena wathi usebenzisa ilungelo lakhe elikuMthethosisekelo lokuba azimele.Icala lihlehliselwe uNovemba 26 lapho uNdamase ezobuyela enkantolo efanayo noSiphosoxolo Myekethe (45), Zenande Paya (38), Mawethu Nomdlwembu (36), Aphiwe "AP” Ndende (25), Lwando Anthony Abi (33) noBonga Hintsha (32).Bonke abasolwa bayibonga ibheyili.
LUPHETHWE wuphiko loKlebe oluphenya amacala abucayi nahleliwe olwezigameko ezintathu zokubanjwa kwenkunzi izimoto ezithwala imali KwaZulu-Natal, izinsuku zilandelana.Lokhu kudalulwe ngokhulumela oKlebe KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant Colonel Simphiwe Mhlongo.Ezigamekweni ezimbili ezenzeke ngoMsombuluko, kubanjwe imoto ethwala imali kuthelawayeka uN2 eThekwini, kwathi esinye senzeka kuthelawayeka uN11 phakathi koMnambithi, neNewcastle.NgeSonto kubanjwe imoto yemali oPhondweni, KwaMhlabuyalingana.UMhlongo uthe eThekwini, imoto yemali ibanjwe inkunzi eduze nomgwaqo uHigginson Highway."Kuvele kwavumbuka amadoda alinganiselwa ku-30, adubula imoto yemali yakwaFedility yaze yama. Babe sebeyiqhumisa ngeziqhumane abebeziphethe, babaleka nemali eyisamba esingaziwa,” kuchaza uMhlongo.Uthe kulesi sigameko abasolwa bathathe izibhamu ezimbili konogada abebehamba ngale moto."Okwamanje akekho oboshiwe, uphiko lweSerious Organised Crime Investigation lwaseThekwini, luphenya icala lokubanjwa kwenkunzi imoto yemali,” kusho uMhlongo.Ngawo uMsombuluko, uthe imoto yakwaFedility ethwala imali ihlaselwe abasolwa ihamba emgwaqweni owuthelawayeka uN11 phakathi koMnambithi, neNewcastle."Bayidubule yaze yama. Base beyiqhumisa ngeziqhumane ebebeziphethe ngebhadi yangaqhuma indawo ehlala imali,” kusho uMhlongo othe bagcine behamba nezibhamu ezimbili zonogada kuphela.Uthe abekho ababoshiwe, wathi isigameko siphenywa uphiko lwe-Organised Crime Investigation lwaseNewcastle.KwesasoPhondweni, uthe abasolwa bazame ukubamba imoto yemali yakwaG4S phakathi kweBhambanana, neJozini."Bavele bayivukela emgwaqweni, bayidubula yaze yaphantshelwa amasondo, yama. Bazame ukuyiqhumisa ngamabhomu kodwa ngeshwa isisefo semali asangaqhuma nokwenze bagcina behamba belambatha,” kusho uMhlongo.Nakulesi sigameko, uthe abasolwa baphuce onogada izibhamu ezimbili, wathi nakuso akukaboshwa muntu.Udalule ukuthi baphinde badubula amaphoyisa abezidlulela ngesikhathi kwenzeka isigameko.Uthe uphiko lweSerious Organised Crime Investigation oluseRichards Bay, luphenya icala lokuzama ukubamba inkunzi imoto yemali nelokuzama ukubulala amaphoyisa.
SIKHULA ngamandla isikweletu sikahulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika, njengoba sesifinyelele kuR6.05 trillion sisuka kuR5,2 trillion. Lezi zindaba zidalulwe izolo nguNgqongqoshe weziMali uMnuz Enoch Godongwana.Uveze ukuthi kulo nyaka izindleko zokukhokhela isikweletu sezwe zizofinyelela kuR388.9 billion. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma uhulumeni enoR1 usebenzisa u-22 cents ukukhokhela isikweletu.Ubuye waveza ukuthi bazoqhubeka nezinhlelo zokubopha izifociya ukuze kwehliswe isikweletu sikahulumeni. Wathi kulo nyaka balindele ukuthi umnotho ukhule ngo-1.1% okusho ukuthi ngeke ukhule kahle njengoba babethe uzokhula ngo-1.3% ngoFebhuwari.Intela ezoqoqwa nonyaka uGodongwana uveze ukuthi izokwehla ngoR22.3 billion emalini ababelindele ukuthi ingene ngesikhathi bethula isabelomali sangoFebhuwari.Ubalule ukuthi bazoqhubeka nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa ingqalasizinda ezizodala amathuba omsebenzi ngoba kuyimanje kunezinhlelo ze-Operation Vulindela ezihamba kahle.Kuzona kukhona oluletha ugesi owu-22 500 MW, ukwehliswa kwedata ewu-1GB ngo-50%, ukwehliswa kwesikhathi sokuthola ilayisensi yokusebenzisa amanzi kusuka esikhathini esiwunyaka siya ezinsukwini eziwu-90 nokutholakala kwama-e-visa emazweni awu–34.Uthe isigaba sesibili se-Operation Vulindlela sizoqinisekisa ukuthi kunogesi owanele ezweni, ophehlwa ngezindlela ezihlukene.Ubalule ukuthi kuzochitshiyelwa nemithetho yokusebenzisana phakathi kukahulumeni nezinkampani ezizimele. Uhulumeni uzoqinisekisa ukuthi imithetho yokusebenza naye iyagazethwa ngonyaka ozayo ngoba uzosebenzisa uR1.5 trillion kule minyaka emithathu ezayo.Uthe kuzovuselelwa ingqalasizinda yamanzi eThekwini, kwakhiwe izindawo zokuhlala abafundi ezikhungweni zemfundo eziphakeme eziyisithupha, kuzolungiswa umzila wesitimela kusukela eWatloo kuya eGqeberha, kulungiswe ingqalasizinda yechweba laseCape Town, kwakhiwe nezibhedlela ezimbili eLimpopo.UGodongwana ubalule ukuthi uhulumeni uzoqinisekisa ukuthi yonke into isiyenziwa ngokobuchwepheshe besimanje njengomazisi, ukufaka izicelo zomsebenzi, ezezibonelelo zikahulumeni namakhadi asezibhedlela. Lokhu kuzosiza uma sekusebenza uhlelo lweNational Health Insurance.Ucele omasipala neminyango kahulumeni ukuba ukhokhele omasipala ngezinsiza ozithola kubo ukuze nabo bakwazi ukukhokhela i-Eskom nezinhlangano zamanzi imali yazo.UGodongwana uthe babakhathalele abantu bakuleli njengoba beqhubeka nokukhokha isibonelelo sabangasebenzi, benemali ebhekelele izinhlekelelele nezibonelelo zokuvuselela ingqalasizinda yezikole.
KUBUNJWE ithimba elizoxazulula izinkinga zezimvume embonini yamatekisi noMnyango wokuThutha eKZN ukugwema ukuphazamiseka komsebenzi. Lesi kube ngesinye sezisombululo okuqhanyukwe nazo emhlanganweni obuseMusgrave eThekwini obuphakathi koMphathiswa womnyango, osomatekisi nezinye izinhlaka ezithintekayo. Umhlangano ubekhona emuva kokuthi kube nesiteleka sezinsuku ezintathu samatekisi ahamba amabanga amade, iDurban Long Distance Association, osomatekisi bekhala ngokungazitholi izimvume ebhodini lomnyango nobekuholela ekutheni uphiko lwamaphoyisa kaShanela lubophe amatekisi abo. Lesi siteleka esiqale ngoMsombuluko saphela ngoLwesithathu ntambama siphazamise abagibeli abebengakwazi ukuthatha uhambo lwabo ngoba amatekisi epakile. UMphathiswa woMnyango uMnuz Siboniso Duma ekhuluma emuva komhlangano, uthe kuvunyelwene ngokuthi kumele kusetshenziswane. Uthe kubunjwe ithimba elizohlangana uma kunezinkinga kungaze kulindwe ukuthi kube khona umhlangano. Uvumile ukuthi uyazi ukuthi ngeke kuhlale kunokuvumelana wathi kodwa ukuba khona kwaleli thimba kuzolekelela ukuthi lisheshe lihlangane ukuze kuqhanyukwe nezisombululo. UDuma uthe umnyango uhlale uzivulile izandla. "Ngizohlangana naleli thimba ukuzwa ukuthi kuhamba kanjani. Ngicabanga ukuthi isisombululo sitholakele sizokwazi ukuqhubeka sisebenzisane,” usho kanje.USihlalo weLong Dstance Taxi Association, uMnuz Bhekisisa Nzuza, uthe bayabonga ukuthi umhlangano ubekhona."Noma kukhona esingeneme ngakho kahle hle. Kunethimba eliqokiwe okuzosetshenziswana nalo. Nathi sibe sesithembisa ukuthi sizoletha konke okudingekayo ukuze indaba yezimvume ilunge,” usho kanje..Ukuphela kwesiteleka nokuqala ukusebenza kwamatekisi izolo ekuseni kujabulise abagibeli. Abagibeli bavuke ngovivi beyogibela beya ezindaweni ezehlukene njengoba abanye bese bevele bebambezelekile ngenxa yesiteleka. UNksz Andiswa Zungu obesuka eThekwini eya KwaNongoma, uthe:"Kuhle ukuthi ekugcineni kube nesisombululo. Ngingumfundi ogcine esephuthwa izivivinyo zokuphela konyaka njengoba ngifunda ekolishi-nje ngenxa yokungahambi kwezimoto. Umbono wami uthi, kungakuhle uma into enje ingeke iphinde ibekhona.” UMnuz Linda Nsele naye obesuka eThekwini eya KwaNongoma, uthe bekumele ahambe ngoLwesithathu njengoba eshonelwe umzali wakhe."Kuyangithokozisa noma phela sengishiywe isikhathi. Bekumele ngihambe izolo (ngoLwesithathu) njengoba ngishonelwe umama . Angikwazanga ukuhamba, kudingeke ukuthi ngilinde kuze kube yinamuhla (izolo). Bengingenalo ithemba nokho, kodwa ngiyajabula ngoba nakhu sezibuyile izimoto okukhomba ukuthi konke kuzohamba kahle.” UMnuz Cabbira Nxumalo obesuka eThekwini eya eVryheid, uthe bese behlupheke kakhulu."Siyathokoza ukuthi kugcine kuvuliwe ukuthi izimoto zihambe. Abantu bese behlukumezeke kakhulu. Siyabonga ukuthi kuhlaliwe phansi yakhulunywa le ndaba,” kusho uNxumalo.Umshayeli wetekisi esuka erenki yaseThekwini eya eMgungundlovu, uMnuz Dumisani Sithole, uthe bebengaphathekile kahle ngalesi siteleka ngoba kuhlukumezeke abagibeli nabo bashayeka.
AZIZANGE zithakamezeke izinhlelo zeSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini, ngemva kwengozi yemoto.Siqhubekile nezinhlelo zosuku lwayizolo emva kokubandakanyeka engozini yemoto eyenzeke ngoLwesibili ebusuku. Imbube iphume ingenamyocu kule ngozi eyenzeke emgwaqweni uR34, eVryheid.Ngemva kwengozi, uNdunankulu kaZulu, uMfundisi Thulasizwe Buthelezi, ubike ukuthi iNdlulamithi yamakhosi izoqhubeka nezinhlelo zayo."Ngikhulume neSilo izolo (ngoLwesibili) ebusuku futhi besikahle emoyeni sangitshela ukuthi ingozi bekuyinto encane. Egameni lendlunkulu, ngifuna ukuqinisekisa isizwe ukuthi akumele sikhathazeke ngesimo seSilo,” kusho uButhelezi.Ngokusho komthombo, iMbube iphuthunyiswe esibhedlela esizimele ngemva kwengozi. Umthombo osebenza esibhedlela esikhona eVryheid, uthe iSilo sifike saxilongwa, kwatholakala ukuthi asilimalanga.UButhelezi uthe imbangela yengozi ibingakaziwa."Amaphoyisa eSouth African Police Service, azokwenza uphenyo njengenjwayelo ukuthola ngembangela yengozi yayizolo,” kusho uButhelezi.Ngokusho kwabazibonele, imoto ebihamba iSilo ishayisane nemoto yamaphoyisa kaMasipala wabaQulusi.Kuthiwa imoto ebihamba iSilo iphaphalaze yaze yayobhajwa emseleni osepulazini eliseduze nomgwaqo. Kuthiwa kuphoqe ukuthi onogada basikhiphe iSilo emotweni ebesihamba ngayo, safakwa kwenye.INdlulamithi yamakhosi ificwa yile ngozi nje ibilungiselela umcimbi wokuvulwa ngokusemthethweni kwenxanxathela yezitolo eyethiwe ngoMntwana uMkabayi kaJama, iPrincess Mkabayi Mall, eseVryheid.Izolo iSilo siqhubekile nokuyovula inxanxathela yezitolo emcimbini obuhanjelwe yinqwaba yabantu.Ngesikhathi kuqhubeka umcimbi iSilo besibonakala sikhululekile. Kunamavidiyo akhombisa iSilo ngesikhathi sifika emcimbini wayizolo kepha ibingabonakali imoto esijwayele ukuhamba ngayo.
AKAFUNI bashaywe induku eyodwa unyaka nonyaka eMnambithi umphathiswa. Njalo uma liyidliva imvula ehlobo, idolobha lintanta emanzini.Usho kanje uMfundisi Thulasizwe Buthelezi onguMphathiswa wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu eMnambithi. Umnyango oholwa uButhelezi ubuzonikela ngamaloli athutha amanzi amabili kuMasipala wesiFunda uThukela onenkinga yamanzi.Lo mnyango ukholelwa wukuthi ukunikela kwawo ngamaloli kuzokwehlisa umthwalo wemali komasipala abangaphansi koThukela kwazise abashayeli bazokhokhelwa iwona."Ngibuze uMasipala i-Alfred Duma ukuthi iluphi uhlelo ozolusebenza uma idolobha ligcwala amanzi khona sizofaka imali kwakhiwe izindlela ezintsha zokuhambisa amanzi. Bathe alukho lolo hlelo. Ngakho ngizolucela ukuze ngitshale imali kulona,” kusho uButhelezi.Ugcizelele ukuthi uyalufuna uhlelo khona kuzohlelwa kabusha imigudu ehambisa amanzi edolobheni uMnambithi.Uqhube wathi uma bewumnyango behlulekile ukunakekela idolobha, bayobe bashayeke udume lwengozi ngoba liyisizinda okuhlanganyela kusona bonke abantu."Njengoba kuza imvula, asikwazi ukushaywa induku eyodwa unyaka nonyaka. AbaseSpar bakhale ngezimpahla ezintanta emanzini, abantu bangakwazi ukungena edolobheni futhi izitolo zingenwa amanzi kube nomonakalo,” kusho uButhelezi.Umphathiswa uthe uyalufuna uhlelo olucacisa ngemigudu emisha ezohambisa amanzi ukuze baluxhase.Sekujwayelekile ukuthi idolobha lintante emanzini uma liyidliva. Ligcwala amanzi asuke echitheka emfuleni iBellspruit abantu batakulwe abezimo eziphuthumayo nabezinhlekelele.Zadlula nemiphefumulo yabantu abacela ku-10 izikhukhula ezahlasela eMnambithi ngoDisemba ngonyaka odlule.Abantu ababehamba ngeveni emgwaqweni uN11 bebuya emcimbini baguguleka batholwa ngezinsuku ezahlukene.UButhelezi uthe uzobuya kungekudala kule ndawo ukuze babhunge kabanzi ngezinhlelo zamanzi emawadini.
UNOBHALA jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, ukhalima iphini likaMengameli uMnuz Paul Mashatile, ukuba lingakhulumi ngokugaqela kwalo isikhundla sokuhola i-ANC.UMbalula uthe akekho umholi we-ANC okufanele akhulume indaba yokugaqela izikhundla.I-ANC izokhetha ubuholi obusha ngo-2027.UMashatile usanda kutshela abezindaba ukuthi uzowungenela umbango wesikhundla sikamengameli we-ANC uma igama lakhe liphakanyiswa amagatsha.UMbalula uthe asikafiki isikhathi sokuthi kukhulunywe ngombango wezikhundla, wathi amalungu e-ANC kufanele agxile ekukhankaseleni ukhetho lohulumeni basekhaya oluzokuba ngo-2026.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba, lapho ebethula khona izinqumo ezithathwe emhlanganweni wesigungu esiphezulu.UMbalula uthe umhlangano wesigungu esiphezulu unqume ukuthi kuvinjwe amalungu ukuthi akhulume ngombango wezikhundla."Ngokwemigomo ye-ANC, asiyifuni into enje. Asifuni ukuthi kube nabaholi be-ANC abazophendula imibuzo emayelana nombango wezikhundla. Wonke amalungu e-ANC kufanele azikhathaze ngokuhanjiswa kwezidingo ebantwini, ukwehliswa kwezindleko zokuphila, nokunye. Sizofika isikhathi sokukhuluma ngombango wezikhundla. Akukwazi ukuthi siqale manje ukukhuluma ngombango wezikhundla. "Njengamanje kufanele silungiselele ukhetho. Kufanele sibhekane nokwakha kabusha i-ANC. Sithole imbibizane okhethweni olwedlule. Uma sizogxila embangweni wezikhundla, izosiphinda imbibizane. Ngeke sikwazi ukuyivika uma sizogxila embangweni wezikhundla,” kuxwayisa uMbalula.UMbalula uthe bazothathelwa izinyathelo abaholi benhlangano abazokhuluma ngombango wezikhundla."Sidwebe umugqa, bazozibona ukuthi bafana nobani abazozama ukuweqa. Ngisho uphiko lwentsha, olwabesifazane namadlelandawonye, sizobatshela nabo ukuthi abavumelekile ukukhuluma ngombango wezikhundla. Alikho ilungu le-ANC elivumeleke ukukhuluma ngombango wezikhundla.”UMbalula uthe bakhulumile noMashatile ngololu daba."Akukho okubi akwenzile. Ubuzwe umbuzo, wawuphendule. Ubuzwe ngalento, namfaka ngekhanda. Nimbuze ukuthi uzowungenela yini umbango wokuhola i-ANC, waphendula ngokuthi uzovuma uma kuphakamiswa igama lakhe. Sixoxile naye, saluxazulula udaba. Unikeze incazelo, nganeliseka. Eqinisweni akukho okubi akushilo, inkinga nje ukuthi inkulumo yakhe ingasusa umbango wezikhundla.”
UNdunankulu waseKZN uMnuz Thami Ntuli namaphoyisa, izolo beqhubeka nomkhankaso wokukhuculula iTheku abawuqale emasontweni edlule Isithombe: SithunyelweAMAPHARA aseqale phansi akha amanye amadokodo okuhlala e-Albert Park, emuva kokususwa ngaphansi kwebhuloho elingaphesheya kwepaki ISITHOMBE : SIMPHIWE NGUBANEAMANYE amaphara azihlalela ezihlalweni ezisenkundleni yebhola, ayapheka abeke nezipontshi zokulala ISITHOMBE: SIMPHIWE NGUBANEABUYE ngezinkani ngaphakathi e-Albert Park, amaphara okuthe emasontweni edlule, asuswa esidlekeni sawo esingaphansi kwebhuloho u-M4, eThekwini.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi uNdunankulu wesifundazwe iKwaZulu Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli nezinhlaka ezahlukene zamaphoyisa, aboMnyango wezeMpilo, owezokuHlunyeleliswa kweziMilo nowezokuPhepha koMphakathi eKZN, bagasela kule ndawo kungazelele muntu, bashisa izakhiwo zamaphara, bawashaqa, kwasala kuhlanzekile.Izolo, Isolezwe lihambele kule ndawo lafica amaphara esethutheleke ngaphakathi epaki. Kuyona le paki kubonakala sengathi sekukhala isicathulo sawo.Ngaphesheya kwayo, bekukhona amaphoyisa aphithizelayo okubonakala sengathi aqaphe konke okwenzekayo.Kuyona le paki kukhona nabantu abasuke bezivocavoca.Njengoba izulu bese liqala ukuna, amanye abehlezi enkundleni yezemidlalo lapho okuhlala khona abazobukela kudlalwa. Bekukhona umdlalo obuqhubeka ngaphakathi enkundleni yebhola.Kodwa amaphara bekubonakala ukuthi azihlalele nje lapho okuhlala khona izihlwele, awanendaba nebhola ebelidlalwa.Kunalokho, kukhona abebonakala ebhema, amanye epheka.Eduze kwale ndawo, kukhona nesiteshi samaphoyisa kaMasipala weTheku obekukhona kuso amaphoyisa. Ikhansela lakuWard 32 eThekwini, uMnuz Protas Mngonyama, lizwakalise okukhulu ukukhathazeka ngokuthi amaphara asevele azogweva nepaki. Uthe abantu manje sebeyesaba ukusebenzisa le paki ngenxa yokuthi sekugcwele amaphara."Angifuni ukuqamba amanga, ingiphethe kabi kakhulu le nto yokuthi ipaki into abantu abayithanda kangaka isivele yaphenduka isizinda samaphara,'' usho kanje uMngonyama.Uthe yena wayecabanga ukuthi kukhona lapho azoyiswa khona kanti akunjalo.Uthe uyazi ukuthi laba ababesusa amaphara babethi bayalungisa, wathi kodwa njengamanje kubonakala sengathi sekuvele konokala kakhulu kunasekuqaleni.UNtuli waveza ukuthi bahlela ukuwatholela indawo azohlala kuyona. Kodwa wakuveza ukuthi bazimisele ngokuwasiza lawo maphara azimisele ngokuthi athole usizo.Isizathu sokugasela kwabo kule ndawo wathi yingoba bahlose ukuqinisekisa ukuthi idolobha iTheku liba sesimweni esamukelekile nesibonakala siheha kakhulu izivakashi.Ngaphambilini zadilizwa zokhelwa ngomlilo izakhiwo awasezakhile ehlala kuzo, kodwa manje aseqale phansi akha ezinye izakhiwo ngoplastiki nangoseyili.Uma udlula kule ndawo ukhangwa yinqwaba yawo eyaluza. Amanye aneke izingubo zokugqoka ocingweni lokubiya.Lawa maphaqa asebuye nje, uyaqhubeka umkhankaso kaNtuli wokuzama ukukhuculula iTheku, njengoba izolo ubekade esenkabeni yeTheku namaphoyisa, bengena ezitolo bebheka abaqashe abokufika abangenawo amaphepha okuba kuleli. Kulo mkhankaso kuboshwe abokufika abangu-30. UNtuli ube esekhipha isexwayiso esishubile njengoba kubhekwe emaholidini okuphela konyaka."IKwaZulu Natal ayisona isidleke sezigebengu futhi amaphoyisa azokwenza konke okusemandleni ukunqanda izenzo zobulelesi,'' usho kanje.Inhloko yezokuXhumana kuHulumeni, uMnuz Bongani Gina, ithe bazoyilwa indaba yalawa maphara kuyoze kugcine bona."UNdunankulu uzophinde abuyele kuleya ndawo. Angeke kuze kugcine wona. Azoze azi ukuthi akusiyona indawo yawo yokuhlala,'' usho kanje.Uthe abazoqhubeka badayise izidakamizwa emaphareni bazolutheza olunenkume njengoba uNdunankulu efuna ukuqeda ngalesiya sidleke.
UMNYANGO wezaseKhaya ubikele iPhalamende ukuthi uzohoxiswa umazisi wentokazi enguzime uChidimma Onwe Adetshina, nokanina wakhe u-Anabela Rungo.Ngokusho komnyango bobabili banikezwe ithuba lokuthi bachaze ukuthi kungani kungafanele ukuba kuhoxiswe omazisi babo bathathwe njengabangekho emthethweni, kodwa kuze kwashaya usuku olungumnqamlajuqu lwezimpendulo, bengaphendulile.Lokhu kuza ngemuva kokuthi betholwe benecala lenkohlakala.
