BAVELA namhlanje eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMtshezi abasolwa abahlanu abebefunwa uthuli ngamaphoyisa ngamacala okuqothwa kwabahlanu besemcimbini, okwenzeke eMtshezi ngeSonto ntambama.Emva kokuthi amaphoyisa ephume inqina ebathungatha, akuphelanga sikhathi esingakanani kwathi ngoMsombuluko ntambama ababhadama bebhace emzini mumbe eMnambithi, kwabashela. Bebefunwa ngamacala okubulawa kukaMnuz Dumisani Mazibuko, indodana yomfowabo, uMnuz Khuzani Mazibuko, nomshana wakhe, uMnuz Dela Zondi, abaqothwe ngesikhathi behambele umcimbi wesintu emzini wakwaMazibuko owumakhelwane, abangahlobene nawo.Kulesi sigameko kuthiwa kushone noMnuz Buhle Ndaba nendodana yakhe, uMnuz Mqedeni Ndaba, nabo okuthiwa badutshulwe ngabasolwa bekuwo lomcimbi.UMnuz Mgigiyeli Mazibuko, womndeni obunomcimbi, uthe kusenzima ukukhohlwa okwenzekile, ikakhulu ezinganeni ezazikhona zibuka kubulawa abantu."Bese kuntambama nje sekubuswa ngesikhathi kuma imoto eyiveni kwehla abasolwa badubula bebhekise ngalapho bekuhleli khona abagilwa. Kubukeka sengathi abasolwa bebazi ukuthi wobani ababafunayo ngoba bavele baqonda ngqo. Asikwazi okubangwayo kodwa sisola ukuthi bebeqonde abomndeni wakwaMazibuko ngoba yibona abaningi abadutshuliwe, okusasishiya sididekile,” usho kanje.Okhulumela umndeni wabagilwa bakwaMazibuko, uNkk Lilly Mazibuko, uthe okwamanje basadunguza ontwini ngalolu daba."Sisadidekile ukuthi kungani behlaselwe nokuthi bekuqondwe bona yini noma bashayeke ngengxaphephe. Azikho izingxabano noma ukungezwani nemindeni ethile okuke kwabakhona ngakho sisadidekile,” usho kanje.Sebeyisithupha abasolwa asebeboshiwe njengoba oyedwa esesibhedlela ngaphansi kweso lamaphoyisa emva kokudubuleka kulesi sehlo nokusolwa ukuthi uphuthunyiswe esibhedlela ngozakwabo. UNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, uhambele imindeni eshonelwe nowalapho kwehle khona lo mshophi.Uthembise ukuthi bewuhulumeni wesifundazwe bazobuyela kuleya ndawo njengoba kuvele ukuthi ikhungethwe ubusela bemfuyo nokuxhaphaka kwezibhamu ezingekho emthethweni.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant Robert Netshiunda, uthe abasolwa batholwe nezibhamu ezine okukhona kuzo ezimbili ezinkulu, nezincane ezimbili kanti esisodwa sazo kuthiwa sithathwe kumgilwa ngesikhathi edutshulwa esehlakalweni sangeSonto."Abasolwa ababoshiwe kukholakala ukuthi bayathinteka nasekwebiweni kwemfuyo eMangwe nasezindaweni ezisondelene nayo,” kusho uNetshiunda.
IMEYA kaMasipala waKwaDukuza ebhekene nezembe, uNksz Lindile Nhaca, ifuna kumiswe ukulalelwa kwesiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bayo.UNksz Nhaca ufake isicelo senkantolo sokuba kumiswe umhlangano wakusasa ozolalela isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bakhe.Lesi sicelo esiphuthumayo sifakwe eNkantolo eNkulu yaseMgungundlovu ngoLwesibili.UNksz Nhaca unikele enkantolo emva kokuthi i-ANC ingayiphendulanga incwadi yabameli lapho ebeyalela khona i-ANC ukuba ihoxise isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bakhe okufanele kubhungwe ngaso kusasa.Kule ncwadi uNksz Nhaca ubeyalele i-ANC ukuba izibophezele ekutheni angeke iqhubeke nesiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bakhe, ubeyinikeze umnqamulajuqu wangoMsombuluko.UNksz Nhaca uphinde ayalele i-ANC ukuba ihoxise isinqumo sokummisa emsebenzini.Lokhu ukusho encwadini ayithumele unobhala we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Bheki Mtolo, nosomlomo womkhandlu waKwaDukuza, uNkk Dolly Govender.UNksz Nhaca wamiswa emsebenzini ngoSeptemba, i-ANC yathatha isinqumo sokumisa ubulungu bakhe enhlanganweni emva kokuthi eshaye indiva umyalelo wokuthi asule esikhundleni.Kuhlelwe ukuthi umhlangano womkhandlu wakusasa ulalele isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNksz Nhaca.Isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNksz Nhaca sifakwe yi-ANC.Encwadini yabameli, abeMnguni and Associates, bathe isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNksz Nhaca siphambene nemigomo."Esiphakamisweni sokungabethembi ubuholi bakhe azikho izizathu ezihambisana nobufakazi, ezishoyo ukuthi kungani kufanele akhishwe esikhundleni.” AbeMnguni and Associates bathe ukumiswa kukaNksz Nhaca kwi-ANC akukho emthethweni."Akaze anikezwe ithuba lokuthi aziphendulele ngezinsolo abekwa zona. Kwakufanele anikezwe amahora awu-48 ukuthi aphendule ezinsolweni abekwa zona. Izinsolo abekwa zona azikho bucayi ngendlela yokuthi kufanele amiswe emsebenzini. Kuze kube manje akakabekwa cala, akazi ukuthi umiselweni.”UNksz Nhaca ukuphonsela inselelo ukumiswa kwakhe, wabhalela unobhala jikekele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, emnxusa ukuba angenelele kulolu daba.AbeMnguni and Associates bathe uNksz Nhaca akufanele akhishwe esikhundleni kuze kuba uMbalula ubuyisa impendulo.Okhulumela i-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Mafika Mndebele, uthe bayaqhubeka nezinhlelo zokukhipha uNksz Nhaca esikhundleni."Njengamanje asikho isinqumo senkantolo esivimba ukuthi simkhiphe ngakho-ke siyaqhubeka.”Okhulumela uMasipala waKwaDukuza, uMnuz Sifiso Zulu, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi bawatholile amaphepha asenkantolo, wathi basalinde isinqumo sayo.
INYUNYANA yabasebenzi bakahulumeni iPublic Servants Association (PSA) icele uNgqongqoshe weziMali, uMnuz Enoch Godongwana ukuba angayinciphisi imali ayabela iminyango ehlukene uma esethula isabelomali namuhla.UMnuz Reuben Maleka wePSA, uthe balindele ukuthi uGodongwana athule isabelomali esizoqinisekisa ukuthi ayikho imisebenzi elahlekayo eminyangweni kahulumeni ngenxa yokuncishiswa kwemali."Siyibonile iminyango ehlukene kahulumeni imemezela ukuthi izophoqeleka ukudiliza abasebenzi nokuyeka izinhlelo ezibalulekile ezisiza umphakathi ngenxa yokuthi ayinamali. Akukwazi ukuthi ezweni elinabantu abaningi abangasebenzi nobugebengu bese uhulumeni enezezela izinkinga ngokunciphisa isabelomali. Silindele ukuthi uGodongwana akhiphe imali ezoletha impilo engcono kubantu,” kusho uMaleka.Ubalule ukuthi uGodongwana kufanele akhiphe imali ezovuselela ingqalasizinda yamanzi, eyemigwaqo, amachweba, izikole nokunye okugugile. Uthe ukulungiswa kwengqalasizinda kudala amathuba omsebenzi futhi kuvuselela nomnotho wezwe.Inhlangano yosomabhizinisi iFree Market Foundation (FMF), ithe uhulumeni kufanele anciphise isikweletu sezwe ngoba uhulumeni wobumbano unongqongqoshe abaningi abadla izindodla ngemiholo.UMnuz Martin van Staden oyiNhloko yenqubomgomo yeFMF, utshele izintatheli ukuthi kufanele kunciphe ikhabhinethi uma uhulumeni ezimisele ngokonga.IFMF ibinesithangami nabezindaba izolo yacela uhulumeni ukuba aphathe imali yezwe ngendlela, aqinisekise ukuthi intela ikhokhwa kahle futhi izinkampani zikahulumeni azidayisele osomabhizinisi abazimele noma asebenzisane nabo."Akuhambi kahle emabhizinisinisi kahulumeni, ahlale edinga ukutakulwa. Kungangcono ukuthi anikwe izinkampani ezizimele noma uhulumeni asebenzisane nosomabhizinisi ukuze izinkampani zakhe zizokwenza kahle. Uma izinkampani zikahulumeni zenza kahle kuzodaleka amathuba omsebenzi nomnotho ukhule. Akufanele alokhu ekhuphula amaholo ngendlela engahlelekile. Kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi isikweletu sezwe asiphumi esandleni,” kusho uVan Staden.
IHLALELE ovalweni imenenja kaMasipala waseNdumeni, uMnuz Sithembiso Ntombela, okudutshulwe kwabulawa umqaphi wayo ngezinhlokohlela zezibhamu.Umqaphi kaNtombela, uMnuz Ndumiso Ncolwane, udutshulwe ngentululwane yezinhlamvu, ngoMgqibelo.Kuthiwa uNcolwane udutshulwe ngamadoda amane abephethe izibhamu ezine ngaphandle komuzi wakubo eMtshezi.Udutshulwa nje uNcolwane, imibango yangaphakathi emkhandlwini ishisa phansi.Kunesiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bemeya, uMnuz Siyabonga Ndlovu, kuphinde kube nezinsolo zenkohlakalo ezibhekiswe ezikhulwini zomkhandlu.UMasipala waseNdumeni uphethwe ngokubambisana i-IFP neDA, iDA iyona efake isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNdlovu.Nakuba uNtombela ethe akafuni ukuyamanisa ukudutshulwa kukaNcolwane nokwenzeka emkhandlwini, uthe kumthusile ukubulawa kwakhe okwenzeke ngesikhathi isimo simazonzo emkhandlwini.UNtombela uqhube wathi uNcolwane uditshulwa nje, emasontweni amabili edlule utshelwe ngelinye ikhansela ukuthi kunenkabi esithengiwe ukuthi ilisoconge."Kungabuhlungu uma kungathiwa lo mdonsiswano usuze wafika kuleli zinga lokuthi kube khona abagudluzwayo endleleni. Khona kubukeka sengathi isize yafika kulelo zinga. Siyathemba ukuthi amaphoyisa azokwazi ukuphenya,”kusho uNtombela.UNtombela uqhube wachaza ukuthi uNcolwane ubengakaze abike lutho ngaphambi kwesigameko sangoMgqibelo. Uthe into abeyazi nje ukuthi kunomfowabo owabulawa ngakho ukudutshulwa ezinyangeni ezimbili ezedlule.Echaza ngokubulawa kukaNcolwane, uNtombela uthe bagcine ukubonana ngoLwesihlanu."Sahlukana engumuntu oya ekhaya. Uma bengilandisa ekhaya bangitshele ukuthi wadutshulwa ephuma edolobheni, ngoMgqibelo ekuseni. Bangitshele ukuthi kwavele kwavumbuka amadoda amane ayefulathele, abe esevulela ngentululwane yezinhlamvu. La madoda ayephethe izibhamu ezinkulu.”Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, (comment pending). Ikhansela laseNdumeni, elicele ukuba igama lalo lingadalulwa lithe, iyathusa indlela uNcolwane abulawe ngayo."Uyabona ukuthi bebefuna ukwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi bamshiya efile. Lokhu ke kushiya imibuzo yokuthi ngabe yini le engaka ayenzile ukuthi usengaze abulawe ngesihluku esinje? Kungenzeka ukuthi abantu abambulele bebefuna ukuthumela umyalezo oqinile. Asazi-ke ukuthi lowo myalezo ubhekiswe kubani.”
UVUKWE usizi nomunyu unina wowesifazane owagwazwa amanxeba angu-25 wafa, ngesikhathi imantshi ingafiki enkantolo ukuzogweba umbulali.UNksz Lindiwe Mbhele odabuka eDondotha, eMpangeni, uhambele ubala eya eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini.Imantshi ayifikanga enkantolo, kwaphoqeleka ukuthi kuhlehliselwe kusasa ukugwetshwa kowake wathandana nomufi futhi owavuma icala, uMlamuli Michael Qaba (43).UQaba wabulala uNksz Zama Girlie Mthembu ngoSuku lokuBuyisana uDisemba 16 ngonyaka odlule, emijondolo yaseKenville, eThekwini,Uboshwe ngoJanuwari esebalekele e-Eastern Cape, lapho aficwa khona egeza ngokwesintu enyangeni futhi wakhipha nommese abulala ngawo umufi."Kubuhlungu ngoba senginesifo somfutho wegazi (i-BP) esaqala mhlazane ngibulawelwa ingane yami. Ngihambele ubala enkantolo, ngemali engiyipatanisile yokugibela. Ngishiye amaphilisi ami emuva, manje ngizolala ezihlotsheni eThekwini, ngoba anginayo imali yokubuyela ekhaya,” kusho uNkk Mbhele ngosizi.Ubalise ngokuthi uqhatha usizi nezingane zikamufi ezimbili zabafana eneminyaka engu-20 ebhala izivivinyo zaka-matric zokuphela konyaka nenye eneminyaka engu-12 efunda uGrade 6.Uthe umufi wayehlala eThekwini ukuze asondelane nomsebenzi futhi wayeyinsika yekhaya ebondla."Impilo inzima, siyapatanisa ekhaya. Ngelinye ilanga siyalala singadlile. Umufi uyena obemele ikhaya. Ngoba ngigula nje, ngabe ubesengiyisile kodokotela. Uthunjana kamufi ungiphathise incwadi ayibhalele umshushisi esithembayo izofundwa enkantolo,” kuchaza uNkk Mbhele.Phambilini, uQaba ongiyise wezingane ezinhlanu, wavuma icala ngesitatimende esifungelwe esafundwa enkantolo, wathi yena nomufi babekade behlala eKenville ngokwehlukana. Ngosuku lwesigameko wayekwi-braai nabangani bakhe.Le ndoda yathi yezwa izwi likamufi kweminye yemijondolo eyayidlula ngakuwona ngesikhathi isendleleni ibheke endlini yayo, yase ingena phakathi."Ngafica umufi exoxa nabesilisa ababili, ngamcela ukuba siyokhulumela phandle. Safike saxabana, enye yalawa madoda yeza kuthina, yangikhomba ngomunwe ingikhuza ukuthi ngingakhulumi kabi nomufi. Yabe isingiphusha ngawa phansi,” kuchaza uQaba esitatimendeni.UMbuso wathi uQaba wayexakazisa umufi ngencwadi yisivimbelo senkantolo ayemenzele yona.UQaba wathi wathukuthela waveva kangangoba waze waya endlini yakhe wayohloma ngommese."Ngangifuna ukubuyela ngiyobhekana naleya ndoda eyayikade ingiphushele phansi. Ngesikhathi ngisasendlini yami, ngabona umufi edlula, ngase ngiyamlandela saze sayongena lapho ayehlala khona. Wawubona ummese owawusokhalweni ushuthekwe ebhulukweni. Wazama ukuwuthatha, sabangisana ngawo ngamehlula ngamandla,” echaza.Uthe esewele phansi waqala wamgwaza esifubeni nasemzimbeni wasedla phansi.
LIZIMISELE ngokuyothola usizo esikhungweni esisiza abantu abanenkinga yokusebenzisa izidakamizwa ngokweqile iphoyisa lasesiteshini esiseCato Manor, eMayville, elisolwa ngokweba ikhadi lasebhange lomgilwa ngesikhathi liyolanda imoto eyayiduniwe.UConstable Minenhle Makhaye (27), uvele izolo eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini, eqhubeka nesicelo sebheyili.Ubhekene namacala amane elokweba, elokukhwabanisa, elokuvimba ukusebenza kwengalo yomthetho nelokutholwa nempahla okusolwa ukuthi yebiwe.UCONSTABLE Minenhle Makhaye evela eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini izolo Isithombe: SIBONELO NGCOBOUdaba lokuya kwakhe esikhungweni esisiza abantu abanenkinga yokusebenzisa ngokweqile izidakamizwa ludalulwe ummeli wakhe, uMnuz Zolani Duma, othe lokhu kuwumyalelo awuthathe kuye.Umshushisi uMnuz Sandiso Mngonyama, uthe okuvezwa umsolwa kubeka ngokusobala ukuthi ungumuntu owuhlupho yikho ekhetha ukuyozigquma esikhungweni uma engadedelwa ngebheyili.Ngaphambi kwalokho uMngonyama utshele olusasilele olokuthi ayesekulungele yini ukusebenza.Kuke kwasuka inkulumompikiswano umshushisi ebuza kummeli ukuthi kwakungashiwongo yini ukuthi ufakazi ozolethwa phambi kwenkantolo, umnikazi wekheli Goldstone, oqhubeke nokugcizelela lokhu ngisho imantshi isimtshela ukuthi wayekhona ngeledlule, inkantolo ilihlehlisela leso sizathu icala.Ubuye waveza ukuthi umyeni wakhe wayengumshayeli wamaloli amakhulu, kwaze kwaba uyamphelela ngo-2019. USOTSWEBHU omkhulu ePhalamende, uMnuz Mdumiseni Ntuli, uthe abazisoli ngokusungula uhulumeni wokubambisana owakhiwe amaqembu ayishumi.UNtuli uthe bajabule ngomsebenzi owenziwa uhulumeni wokubambisana, wathi amaqembu asebenzisanayo abambisene kahle.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi enengxoxo ekhethekile neSolezwe, lapho ebekhuluma khona ngomsebenzi owenziwe uhulumeni wokubambisana ezinsukwini eziwu-100 ezedlule."Angiboni kukhona inkinga engenza ukuthi sizisole noma sihlalelwe ovalweni. Kuboniswene kahle. Yebo kuzokuba khona ukushayisana kwemibono ikakhulukazi phakathi kwe-ANC neDA, kodwa ikhona indlela yokuxazulula izinkinga. Sisakwazi ukuba nendlela yokuthi sixoxe, size sivumelane.”UNtuli uthe kulezi zinsuku eziwu-100 zokuqala kuphethe uhulumeni wokubambisana kukhona okuhle abakubonile.Ubalule ukungacishwa kukagesi izinsuku eziwu-200 zilandelana nokwehla kulandelana kwentengo kaphethroli.UNtuli uthe lokhu kuyimiphumela yokusebenza ngokuzikhandla kongqongqoshe abakuhulumeni wokubambisana.UNtuli ukhale ngokuthi amanye amaqembu abambisene nawo kuhulumeni azama ukuzigqamisa ngezinto ezinhle ezenzeka eminyangweni abayiphethe.Uthe imisebenzi emihle eyenzeka eminyangweni kahulumeni yaqalwa kusaphethe ongqongqoshe be-ANC."Abanye bafuna kube sengathi lokhu okuhle esikubonayo kwenziwe ibona. Iqiniso ukuthi into eqalwe ngongqongqoshe abasha okufanele ibungazwe.”UNtuli uthe ukubambisana namanye amaqembu kuhulumeni angeke kuyivimbe i-ANC ukuthi ifeze izethembiso eyazenza ngaphambi kokhetho."Angeke sihlehle ezintweni esazibophezela kuzona ngesikhathi sibheke okhethweni.”UNtuli uthe amalungu e-ANC kuhulumeni nasePhalamende kufanele asebenze ngokuzimisela njengoba le nhlangano ingasaphethe ngokuzimela."Lesi simo sisho ukuthi akufanele sicwayize. Iqiniso ukuthi akusona isimo esiyisifiso sethu lesi, noma izifiso zabantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Lesi isimo nje esisehlele. Ngakho ke kufanele sisebenze ngokuzimisela ukuze i-ANC izobuyela emandleni.”UNtuli uthe adlala ngesikhathi sawo amaqembu ezepolitiki asonga ngokuthi uhulumeni wokubambisana uzohlakazeka."Abantu abaningi emaqenjini aphikisayo namanje basasho ukuthi sizoxabana. Ngesikhathi kwakhiwa uhulumeni wokubambisana babeze basinqumele izinyanga ezimbili, bethi sizoxabana ngoba imigomo yethu njengamaqembu abambisene ayifani."Ngibona bezimoshela isikhathi laba abalokhu bethi uhulumeni wokubambisana uzohlukana. Laba bantu bakhombisa ukuthi abalithandi izwe. Angiboni ukuthi kuyalilekelela izwe ukuthi silokhu sijikijelana ngamazwi.”

Uma usuya edolobheni kumele ukhokhe imali enkulu yerenti okungaholela ekutheni ibhizinisi lakho lingakhuli noma liwe," kusho uNkk Reddy.

IKHEMIKHALI esetshenziswa ngabalimi ukubulala izinambuzane ezicekela phansi isivuno emapulazini, iyona eyimbangela yokufa kwezingane eziyisithupha zaseNaledi eSoweto eGauteng. KUSOLWA umbango webhizinisi lotshwala ngokubulawa kwabathathu okukhona kubona nowayeyilungu loMkhonto weSizwe (MK) Party, okusolwa kukho inyanga engumastende futhi ebolekisa ngemali eMayville, eThekwini.Umsolwa wokuqala uMnuz Sphamandla Vulindlela Hlongwane (41), ubhekene namacala awu-11, okungamathathu okubulala oMnuz Titus Khethana Sosibo, Khanyisani Ndlovu noMxolisi Zungu (owayeyilungu le-MK), awokuhlela itulo lokubulala, ukubamba inkunzi kusetshenziswa indlakadla nokutholwa nezibhamu nezinhlamvu okungekho emthethweni. NgoLwesihlanu, eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini, uHlongwane ufake isicelo sebheyili. Ukwenze lokhu nasolwa nabo oMnuz Ngcebo Treasure Luthuli (33) noThokozani Emmanuel Luthuli.Kuthuke amalungu e-MK, abekade egcwele enkantolo ezokweseka imindeni yabagilwa ezwa kufundwa ubufakazi obushaqisayo bomphenyi wecala, uSergeant Masande Majikijela obufundwe wumshushisi uMnuz ZT Nzama.Kuthiwa ngoFebhuwari 29 nonyaka, ngabo-5 ekuseni eCato Crest, eMayville, uSosibo owayengunogada wayehamba emgwaqweni nozakwabo beya emsebenzini kanti uzodutshulwa abulawe kwathathwa iselula yakhe, uzakwabo wasindiswa ukubaleka."USosibo noHlongwane babenamashibhi ayekade ebhekene eCato Crest. Ibhizinisi likamufi laliletha amakhasimende amaningi, lokho okungazange kuhlale kahle kuHlongwane. Waqala watshela amakhasimende kamufi ukuthi angayi ukuyothenga utshwala khona,” kusho uNzama.Emva kwalokho, kubikwa ukuthi uHlongwane wasongela ngokufa uSosibo ethumela omunye wabantu abazoba ofakazi enkantolo. UMbuso uthi uSosibo wabulawa ngoba kwakubangwa indaba yeshibhi."UHlongwane wakhipha nesibhamu okwabulawa ngaso uSosibo esimeshayo nezinhlamvu ezatholakala endaweni yesigameko. Wakhomba nendawo yesigameko futhi wabhala phansi ukuvuma kwakhe icala,” kusho uNzama.UMbuso uthi ngoMashi 23, ngabo-8 ebusuku kwadutshulwa uNdlovu washona ebulawa uHlongwane noNgcebo emijondolo yaseCato Crest. Kuthiwa wabulawelwa endlini kaHlongwane kwatholakala amagobolonde ezinhlamvu awu-13.UMbuso uthi uHlongwane noNdlovu babekade bazana futhi imizi yabo ingaqhelelene kakhulu."Inkosikazi kaSosibo yahlangana nomuntu wesilisa engamazi owamkhombisa isithombe sikaHlongwane esasikuselula ayeyiphethe. Lo muntu wesilisa owayekade engaziwa, wayehamba ebuza ngoHlongwane. Kwase kuthi unkosikazi kaSosibo wahamba wabikela uSosibo ukuthi uhlangane nale ndoda,” kusho uNzama.Umshushisi uqhube wathi uHlongwane wayekholelwa ukuthi uNdlovu wayekade akha itulo lokumbulala wase ethatha isinqumo sokuthi agadle kuqala.Kuthiwa abasolwa babonwa ofakazi bebulala uNdlovu abaqeda bamsesha izimpahla ayezigqokile bathatha isikhwama semali neselula yakhe. Kuvela ukuthi uHlongwane waphinde wayosongela abantu abambona egila le migilingwane, omunye wabo okwakuyisiqashi sakhe.UNzama uthe umbiko womphumela wokuhlolwa kwesibhamu esatholakala kuHlongwane uveze ukuthi sasetshenziswa nangesikhathi kubulawa uZungu.Kuvele ukuthi uZungu owayeyilungu le-MK, wabulawa ngabo ngoJuni 5, ngabo-9:30 ekuseni, ehamba nenkosikazi yakhe bebuya ukuhambisa ingane yabo enkulisa. Kuthiwa wadutshulwa ekhanda nasemzimbeni kwatholakala amagobolondo esibhamu amahlanu endaweni yesigameko.UMbuso uthi unofakazi owabona kudutshulwa uZungu owaphucwa isibhamu sakhe esisemthethweni.Kuvele nokuthi uNdlovu wayengumngani osondelene kakhulu noZungu."Okutholwe umseshi ophenyweni lakhe ukuthi uZungu wayebulawelwa ukuthi uHlongwane noNgcebo babekholelwa ukuthi uzophindisela ngokufa kukamngani wakhe futhi ayekade esebenza naye uNdlovu,” kulandisa uNzama.Kubikwa ukuthi uThokozani wakhonjwa omunye wofakazi emaphoyiseni ngokuthi wayekhona kubulawa uZungu owabhala nesitatimende evuma icala.UHlongwane waboshwa ngoSepthemba, 27 wuphiko lwamaphoyisa iNational Intervention Unit (NIU).Kuthiwa watholakala nesibhamu nezinhlamvu okungekho emthethweni. Lesi sibhamu kuthiwa isona okwabulawa ngaso abafi. UThokozani kuthiwa naye waboshwa ngosuku olufanayo.Umshushisi uthe abanganikwa ibheyili abasolwa ngoba bayingozi emphakathini futhi bangenza amanye amacala kwazise bagila le migilingwane phambi kwabantu.Uveze neyokubulawa kwabantu abathathu esikhathini esiyizinyanga ezine kusetshenziswa izibhamu, wathi ayikho imibandela yebheyli engavimbela ukuthi abasolwa bangenzi amanye amacala. Uthe abasolwa bangalibalekela icala ngoba bayazi lihamba nezigweboo ezingodilikajele futhi bazosabisa ofakazi bashabalalise ubufakazi.Enkantolo abasolwa bebebukeka bezikhululekele, babuye bazisule ubuso bahlome amakhanda phansi njengoba bethe bamsulwa bona.Bathe badindwa ngenduku amaphoyisa mhlazane beboshwa futhi bavunyiswa amacala abangawenzanga, bebhecwa.Baveze nokuthi babekade bebazi abafi, bengakaze baxabane nabo futhi ababulawanga yibona ngakho uMbuso ubadidanisa nokuyibona babulali. Bonke abasolwa bathe bayizinsika emakhaya abo, ziyalamba izingane zabo njengoba beboshiwe, amabhizinisi abo amile. UHlongwane uthe uyinyanga, umastende, ubolekisa ngemali futhi ungusomabhizinisi othola u-R20 000 ngenyanga.Icala lihlehliselwe uNovemba 4.
UKHALA ezimathonsi umvangeli webandla lamaNazaretha ethempelini eMbonisweni, KwaMashu, othi uboshelwe amanqina enyathi waxoshwa ethempelini esolwa ngokuhlambalaza uMfundisi omkhulu uMdletshe emaphephandabeni.UMvangeli Mzizi uthi waziswe kuleli sonto ukuthi akasadingakali ethempelini ngezinsolo angazazi."Kumanje kuyachwaza KwaMashu, emva kokusabalala kwezindaba zokuthi sengixoshiwe ethempelini. Ngisolwa ngento engingayazi ngoba kuthiwa mina ngihlambalaze umfundisi uMdletshe emaphephandabeni. Isimemezelo sokuthi angidingeki ngisithole kuleli sonto kwathiwa yisinqumo esithathwe wubaba uNyazilwezulu. Anginasiqiniseko sokuthi ngempela ubaba ukushilo yini lokho kodwa ngitshelwe kanjalo. "Ingiphethe kabuhlungu lento ngoba angikaze ngimhlambalaze umfundisi Mdletshe. Engikwaziyo ukuthi ngahlukumezeka ethempelini akulona. Esibonakalisweni ngaze ngaxoshwa kulona. Lokho kwangiphatha kabuhlungu kangangoba ngaze ngalaliswa esibhedlela nginokhwantalala. Ngithe uma sengibuya ngayokhonza eMbonisweni, lapho okuthiwe nakhona angisadingeki,” kusho umvangeli Mzizi.Okhulumela amaNazaretha ngaphansi kobuholi benkosi uMduduzi Shembe uNyazilwezulu, uMnuz Thokozani Mncwabe uthe umuntu akaxoshwa kanjalo ebandleni."Uma kungukuthi akukho cala elihlalile kwaqulwa icala lakhe uMvangeli Mzizi akaxoshiwe. Ukusabalalisa izindaba zokuthi uxoshiwe kuyindlela nje yokumethusa. Okwesibili ubaba uNyazilwezulu aluxoshi muntu ebandleni. Uma kungukuthi udaba lwakhe belubikwe kubaba ubengeke athathe isinqumo engambizanga ukuzozwa uhlangothi lwakhe. Okunye ukuthi nokuxoshwa akusona isinqumo okufinyelelwa kalula kusona, mhlawumbe ukube bekuqulwe icala ubengagcina ehlawulisiwe noma imbuzi uma kungukuthi utholakale enecala,” kuchaza uMncwabe.Uthe nodaba alufelayo uMzizi uyalwazi walubona ephephandabeni, akukho lapho kwavela khona igama lakhe ehlambalaza umfundisi Mdletshe.UMncwabe uthe akekho umuntu onelungelo lokuxosha umuntu kwaShembe. Uveze ukuthi kwakhona ukuthi kuxoshwe umuntu ngaphandle komyalelo woNyazilwezulu kungukulibukela phansi, ngoba awukwazi ukuthi uyisihambi uphinde uxoshe esinye isihambi kwaShembe, ubaba wakhona engakhulumile, okuwuNyazilwezulu.
KUSHENXISWE emsebenzini izikhulu ezimbili zoMnyango wemiSebenzi yoMphakathi neNgqalasizinda KwaZulu-Natal, mayelana nethenda ka-R79 million yokulungiswa kophahla lwezibhedlela ezine.UMnuz Steve Bhengu ongumkhulumeli womnyango noMphathiswa uMnuz Martin Meyer, uthe imibiko yesikhashana iveza ukuthi lezi zikhulu ziyabandakanyeka odabeni lokungahanjiswa ngendlela efanele yethenda.UBhengu uthe ithenda eyokushintsha itsheboya (asbestos) ezibhedlela ezine esifundazweni."UMnyago uthole umbiko ngalo msebenzi kwavela ukuthi kunezinsolo ezikhona. UMphathiswa uMeyer ube esejuba ukuba kuqalwe uphenyo, izikhulu ezimbili zamiswa emsebenzini,” kubeka uBhengu.Kuvela ukuthi kunengede enike umnyango umbiko ngo-Okthoba 17, owabe usudluliselwa kuMeyer ukuba awufakele izibuko.Kubikwa ukuthi emva kwezinsuku eziyisishigalolunye kucutshungulwa umbiko, inhloko yomnyango ibe isimisa emsebenzini izikhulu ngoLwesihlanu ukuze kuqalwe uphenyo olunzulu."Lokhu kuwubufakazi bokuthi uMeyer uzimisele ekutheni kwenziwe izinto ngokuvuleleka nangendlela eqotho emnyangweni. Ubonga izingede ezihlinzeka umnyango ngemininingwane emqoka,” kusho uBhengu.Uqhube wathi uMeyer uzibophezele ekutheni kuvikelwe futhi kwesekwe izingede ezilekelela ummyango ukulwa nenkohlakalo nokungahanjiswa ngononina kwezinto.Lo mnyango uthe izindaba zivele ngesikhathi lapho uqinisa izinhlaka zokulwa nenkohlakalo futhi uqhamuka namasu amasha azokwenza kube lula ekutheni izingede zibike ngokukhululeka.Kuvela ukuthi uMeyer uzokwethula ngokusemthethweni lezi zinhlelo kungekudala.UMeyer usanda kuphumela obala wathi bazothwala kanzima abantu okuyotholakala ukuthi bayathinteka ezenzweni zenkohlakalo nobugebengu kulo mnyango, wabalula nokuthi sesiphelile isikhathi salabo abamisa imisebenzi yokwakhiwa futhi kuthuthukiswe izakhiwo ngoba befuna intshontsho.
UYAQINA unqwazi kwabakholelwa kuhulumeni wokubambisana kwamaqembu ahlukene owaziwa ngeGovernment of National Unity (GNU), ohola izwe kuleli. Muva nje uhulumeni uphothule izinsuku ezingu-100, usezintanjeni zokuhola izwe. Njengoba abantu bengayi nganxanye bengemanzi, izimbangi nalabo abangayizwa eyeGNU, basahlalele ethembeni lokuthi kusazohlukana inhloko nesixhanti uma kuphuma emandleni ohola i-ANC, uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa.Abanye kuyona i-ANC abahambisani neGNU ngoba kuze kwashiya enye ingwevu eyayingundunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Willies Mchunu ikhala ngale GNU.AmaKhomanisi ayihlabe ayihlikiza eyeGNU, alwa nokuthi i-DA, ayibiza njengeqembu labacindezeli, iyingxenye kahulumeni. I-ANC eyamema amanye amaqembu ukuthi abe yingxenye kahulumeni, iyakuveza ukuthi yakwenza lokhu emva kokuba abavoti beyehlise ezitezi, yangathola amavoti enele ukuthi ingabusa futhi ibumbe uhulumeni iyodwa.UKhongolose ubambisene neDemocratic Alliance, Patriotic Alliance, Inkatha Freedom Party, GOOD, Pan Africanist Congress of Azania, Vryheidsfront Plus, United Democratic Movement, Rise Mzansi ne-Al Jama-ahEzinsuku ezevile ku-100, uhulumeni wokubambisana usemandleni kukhona ukunconywa ngokuthi ubambe ngakho futhi kunokusebenzisana kwamaqembu.Kubunjwe namakomiti azoxazulula izinkinga ezivumbuka kwiGNU. Elinye lawo lisezingeni lePhalamende, liholwa yiPhini likaMengameli lezwe ne-ANC, uMnuz Paul Mashatile.Leli komiti ebelihleli ngoLwesine, belibhunga ngezinto ezingungqingetshe kwiGNU, okubalwa ukungavumelani ngemithetho eyaphasiswa ehlandleni eledlule likahulumeni.Le mithetho ibala owezikole iBela, okumiswe izigatshana ezimbili kuwona ukuze kuxoxwe ngazo, kuvunyelwane ngaphambi kokuba ziqale ukusebenza ngokugcwele. Omunye eyomshwalense wezempilo, iNHI, okusuke umsindo ngayo.Abaholi bamaqembu akwiGNU bazwakalise ukuyithakasela eyokuba yingxenye kahulumeni. Baze balimise ngesihloko elokuthi ngeke uwe lo hulumeni futhi izophela iminyaka emihlanu usemandleni.Laba baholi bayakuveza ukuthi nakuba beyingxenye kahulumeni kodwa basazoqhubeka nokugxeka izinto abangahambisani nazo.Kulindelekile ukuthi uma kuhlangene imihlathi eyalanayo, kuzobakhona ukwehluka kwemibono. Nabaholi bamaqembu bayakusho ukuthi bahlukene ngokwemibono kodwa bayasebenzisana futhi bayahloniphana.Abahlaziyi bezombusazwe bayayincoma iGNU, baze bathi kumele idlulele nakomasipala abanezinkinga zombango."Omasipala kumele basike iphethini, idlulele kubona eyezinkinga zombango ezenza kuze kugqoze eyokuhanjiswa kwezidingo. Ibambe ngakho kuhulumeni kazwelonke kanjalo nowezifundazwe esifana neKwaZulu-Natal, lapho kunohulumeni wokubambisana kwamaqembu,” kusho uDkt Levy Ndou, umhlaziyi wezombusazwe. UNdou ubalule ukuthi ibuyise ithemba eyeGNU ezweni kanti neyezinhlaka zokuxazulula izinkinga izokwenza ukuthi izinto zingaphumi esandleni kuze kuhlakazeke uhulumeni ngenxa yokungaboni ngaso linye.Omunye wabahlaziyi bezombusazwe uSolwazi Dirk Kotze, uhambe emazwini kaNdou, wathi izinkinga ziyohlale zikhona kuhulumeni uma kubanjiswene kodwa okubalulekile ukuthi zisheshe zilungiswe.UMENGAMELI Cyril Ramaphosa ekhuluma namalungu e-EFF okubalwa nomengameli weqembu uMnuz Julius Malema, abangeyona ingxenye kahulumeni wokubambisanaKanjalo nenhlangano i-Institute of Race Relations, ithe iGNU ilethe uzinzo yenza abantu bomhlaba balithemba elakuleli ngokubambisana kwamaqembu esikhathini esifushane kudlule ukhetho.I-IFP ephethe esikandunankulu esifundazweni, ithe abakhohlwe labo abacabanga ukuthi kuzophela ngeGNU.Umengameli weqembu uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa, uthe ekahulumeni wokubambisana ibuyise ithemba ebantwini bakuleli, nabakwamanye amazwe."Lapho sihamba khona emazweni omhlaba abaholi bakhona bancoma eyokubunjwa ngokushesha kukahulumeni wokubambisana. Kubuye ithemba ngokubunjwa ngokushesha kwalo hulumeni nokubambisana okukhona,” kusho uHlabisa.Uthe kulo hulumeni wokubambisana kukhona ukuhloniphana kwabaholi bamaqembu ahlukene."Siyaqhubeka nokufuqa umkhankaso odabeni lweNgonyama Trust nokufukulwa kwamakhosi nokuthi iBhange Ithala lisebenze ngokugcwele. Lezi ngezinye zezinto esathembisa abantu bakuleli ukuthi sizozenza uma singena kuhulumeni,” kusho uHlabisa.URamaphosa uthe okubalulekile ngukuthi kunokuhloniphana phakathi kwabaholi abakwiGNU, nokusebenzisana kongqongqoshe bamaqembu ahlukene. UMENGAMELI Cyril Ramaphosa nabaholi bamaqembu abayingxenye kahulumeni wokubambisanaUmholi we-DA uMnuz John Steenhuisen, uzwakalise ithemba ngohulumeni wathi abazisoli nakancane ngokuba yingxenye yawo.Uveze ukuthi okuseqhulwini kuhulumeni kanjalo nakwi-DA, ukukhula komnotho, ukwakha amathuba emisebenzi nokuqeda indlala nokubuyisa ithemba kubantu bakuleli.Ukuvezile ukuthi basayichitha eyemithetho iBela neNHI.UDkt Pieter Groenewald, umholi weFF Plus, ekhuluma ngezinsuku ezingu-100 zeGNU, uthe abantu bakuleli bazozuza lukhulu uma kuqhubeka ukubambisana.ABAHOLI bamaqembu ahlukene ezombusazwe bedla isidlo nomengameli wezwe ne-ANC uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa Abanye abaholi bazwakalise ukuthi uma kubanjiswene, izwe lizothuthuka liye phambili. Akwaziwa mbhantshi kujiya ngokuthi ngabe izophela yini iminyaka emihlanu isabambisene kwiGNU ngoba osopolitiki omalala bephenduka.
USUBIZELWE ePhalamende uMnyango wezaseKhaya ukuba uyochaza ngesamba sika-R52 million okuthiwa usetshenziswe ezinyangeni eziyisithupha kubuyiselwa abokufika abacela ku-19 000 emazweni abo.Lokhu kuvezwe uMnuz Mosa Chabane ongusihlalo wekomiti elibhekele ukusebenza kwalo mnyango ePhalamende.Lokhu kuvele emuva kokuthi i-Economic Freedom Fighters ibuze iPhalamende ngokusebenza kwalolu hlelo nokunye okuthinta abantu bokufika kuleli ngokungemthetho.UChabane uthe beyikomiti basanda kuhambela isikhungo iLindela Repatriation Centre lapho kugcinwe khona abokufika ngokungemthetho abasuke bezobuyiselwa emazweni abo."Amalungu ekomiti elakhiwe amaqembu ehlukene azwakalise ukukhathazeka kwawo. Yingakho sifuna incazelo egcwele emnyangweni, uzochaza kabanzi ukuthi isetshenziswe kanjani le mali engaka,” kusho uChabane.Uveze ingqinamba yokungena kwabokufika kuleli ngokungemthetho, wathi kumba eqolo uma sebebuyiselwa emuva.UChabane usho kanje ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabeziko lezindaba i-eNCA ngempelasonto.Uthe ambalwa amazwe okubalwa kuwona iKenya alekelelayo ngemali ekutheni kubuyiswe izakhamuzi zawo."Kumele kwazeke ukuthi kumba eqolo ukubuyisela emuva abokufika kusetshenziswa ibhanoyi nangamabhasi. Kuyakhathaza ngoba le mali kumele ngabe isetshenziselwa ukuphucula ukusebenza komnyango futhi kuqiniswe ezokuphepha emingceleni,” kusho uChabane.Uhlaka oluqaphe imingcele, i-Border Management Authority (BMA), ivamise ukukhala ngokugqoza kwezinsiza kusebenza nabantu abaqapha imingcele.Ifuna kwengezwe isabelomali ukuze kunqandwe labo abangena ngopotsho eNingizimu Afrika.UChabane uncome umsebenzi owenziwa yi-BMA, wathi kunemithetho abazoyishaya ePhalamende ezophendula enkingeni yabantu abatheleka eNingizimu Afrika bengenazo izimvume.
UKWANDA kwabaholi be-ANC abanukeka enkohlakalweni sekuholele ekutheni le nhlangano iqale izifundo zokuziphatha eziyimpoqo kuwo wonke amalungu ayo.UMengameli, Cyril Ramaphosa, uthe abaholi be-ANC bazofundiswa ngokuziphatha nangobuqotho.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ethula inkulumo yokuvala umhlangano wesigungu esiphezulu, ophothulwe ngeSonto.Kuyiwe kulo mhlangano kunenqwaba yabaholi be-ANC abasolwa ngenkohlakalo.Phakathi kwabaholi be-ANC abasanda kuvela phambi kwekomiti lobuqotho kubalwa iphini likamengameli, uMnuz Paul Mashatile, noNgqongqoshe wezoBulungiswa, uNksz Thembi Simelane.URamaphosa uthe bazokwethula ngokusemthethweni izifundo ezizonikwa amalungu e-ANC ngoMsombuluko.Uthe umhlangano wesigungu esiphezulu uthathe isinqumo sokuthi bathathelwe izinyathelo bonke abaholi beqembu abangazange baye kovela ekomitini lobuqotho emva kokuthi amagama abo evele embikweni wekhomishini eyayiphenya izinsolo zokuLawulwa koMbuso yiDlanzana.URamaphosa uthe i-ANC izogxila ekuzakheni kabusha."Sizogxila kakhulu emagatsheni. AMAPHOYSA afuna uthuli abasolwa abahlanu okukholakala ukuthi bayathinteka ekuqothweni kwabagilwa abane eMtshezi. AMAPHOYSA afuna uthuli abasolwa abahlanu okukholakala ukuthi bayathinteka ekuqothweni kwabagilwa abane kwathi owesihlanu wangeniswa esibhedlela elimele, okuthiwa bahlaselwe besemzini othile obekunomcimbi kuwo, eNyezane eMtshezi izolo ntambama.Kuvele ukuthi umsolwa wesithupha ubhadanywe amaphoyisa esengeniswe esibhedlela okukholakala ukuthi ushushumbiswe wozakwabo emva kokudubuleka esifubeni waphuka nengalo, kanti uqashwe ngamaphoyisa. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uLieutenant Colonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe akucaci okwamanje ukuthi umsolwa ushaywe yinhlamvu yabebehamba nabo noma beyisuka esixukwini sabebekhona emcimbini.."Ngokolwazi olusanikwe amaphoyisa okwamanje, abasolwa abayisithupha abebezimboze ubuso bephethe izibhamu ezinkulu nezincane bangene kulo muzi obekunomcimbi wesintu kuwo bavulela ngenhlamvu kubantu abebesemcimbini. KUVELA ukuthi lathungwa ngowayesejele itulo lokubulawa kukathisha wesifazane wasePhikiswayo Primary eNtuzuma A, eThekwini, owahlasela wabulawa ngoJulayi nonyaka, esikoleni phambi kwabafundi.Lokhu kuvezwe yisitatimende samaphoyisa ebesiqinisekisa ukuboshwa kwabasolwa ababili; oneminyaka ewu-36 nonewu-41 okuthiwa baboshwe ngamaphoyisa ophiko lweProvincial Serious and Violent Crimes ngoLwesine.UNksz Dudu Khumalo (46) owayesanonyaka efundisa uGrade R kulesi sikole, wadutshulwa wabulawa phakathi egcekeni laso ngabalisa ababili abangaziwa ngoJulayi 29, nonyaka.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda edalula izindaba zokuboshwa kwabasolwa, uthe amaphoyisa ahlanganise ubufakazi obuqanda ikhanda ukuthi umufi wabulawa ngoba engufakazi ecaleni elibandakanya isiboshwa esisejele laseWestville."Lesi siboshwa singungqondongqondo ekubulaweni kwalona wesifazane. Kulesi sehlo, kuphinde kube khona abanye ababili, okukhona kubo lo owadubula, kwathi omunye wabamba iqhaza lokukhomba umufi,” kusho uNetshiunda.Uthe ngoLwesihlanu, emva kokuboshwa kwabasolwa, amaphoyisa athole isibhamu okukholakala ukuthi sasetshenziswa ukudubula endlini yowesilisa okusolwa ukuthi uye owadubula."Nejakhethi okuthiwa wayeyigqokile ngosuku lwesigameko, nayo ayitholile amaphoyisaa,” kusho uNetshiunda.Udalule ukuthi amaphoyisa athole ukuthi lesi sibhamu saphangwa kumnikazi waso owayesibhalise ngokusemthethweni eSherwood, eSydenham, ngo-Ephreli 2023."Abasolwa ababili bazovela enkantolo kusasa (esho namuhla) ngecala lokubulala nelokubopha itulo lokubulala,” kubeka uNetshiunda.Uqhube wathi umsolwa wesithathu, ovele ungaphakathi izikhindini naye uzobekwa amacala ngendlela efanele bese evela naye enkantolo ngesikhathi esifanele.Ngosuku lwesigameko kuthiwa abasolwa ababili bagasela kungazelelwe kulesi sikole, bacela ukubona umufi.Kuthiwa baqonda ngqo kuye, bafike bamdubula, bephindelela ngaphambi kokuthi bakhale amaphepha.Wathulela endaweni yesigameko, kanti kwathi uma kuvela ukuthi kungenzeka ukuthi ubulawelwe ukuthi ubengufakazi ecaleni elifaka esiboshwa, idokodo lecala lakhe ladluliselwa ophikweni lweProvincial Serious and Violent Crimes.Imizamo yokuthola umndeni kamufi kayiphumelelanga. UMphathiswa wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka, uthe bayakwamukela ukuboshwa kwabasolwa."Nakuba ukushona kukaNksz Khumalo kwasihlukumeza, kodwa siyajabula ukuthi ingalo yomthetho izoza nobulungiswa nokuthula kithina, imindeni eyathinteka, ozakwabo nabafundi," kusho uHlomuka.
UKWANDA kwezimboni ezitshala imali eMkhambathini, kunika ubuholi bendawo ithemba lokuthi idolobha lizophenduka isizinda somnotho ngokushesha.Imeya kaMasipala waseMkhambathini, uMnuz Nhlakanipho Ntombela, ithe bafuna ukuthi idolobha libe seliyisizinda somnotho ngo-2040.Ziningi izimboni nezinkampani ezakhiwayo eMkhambathini, muva kusanda kuvela ukuthi isikhondlakhondla senkampani kabhiya iHeineken, izokwakha isikhungo sokuvubela ubhiya eMkhambathini.Isikhungo sokuvubela ubhiya esizokwakhiwa eMkhambathini kuthiwa singase sidle imali elinganselwa ku-R6 billion.UNtombela uthe basembhidlangweni wokweshela ezinye izinkampani ukuba zitshale izimali eMkhambathini. Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi umasipala unesidlo sasebusuku sokweshela abatshali bezimali, ngoLwesine ebusuku."Siyidolobha elincane, elisemakhaya kodwa maningi amathuba akhona lapha endaweni yethu. Yingakho sinxusa abatshali zimali ukuthi beze lapha endaweni yethu,” kusho uNtombela.UNtombela uqhube wathi ukwanda kwezimboni kuzohlomulisa abantu baseMkhambathini."UMkhambathini wakhelwe izindawo zasemakhaya. Awekho amathuba emisebenzi lapha. Abantu abaningi baseMkhambathini basebenza emadolobheni anjengakoThekwini, Mgungundlovu namanye. Ukwakhiwa kwezimboni kuzohlomulisa abantu baseMkhambathini.”UNtombela uthe ziningi izinhlelo abazenzayo njengomasipala ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zabatshali zimali."Sifuna ukwenza ukuthi izimboni zikwazi ukusebenza ngaphandle kwezihibe uma sezifikile lapha. Njengamanje simatasa nohlelo lokuphathwa komhlaba.”UNtombela uthe into ebanikeza inselelo njengomkhandlu ukungabi khona kwengqalasizinda yokuthuthwa kwendle."Uma uzobheka amathoyilethe esinawo awomgodi, asinayo ingqalasizinda yokuthuthwa kwendle. Lokhu kuphazamisa izinhlelo zezimboni. Yingakho emcimbini wanamhlanje simeme noMnyango wezaManzi neNhlanzeko. UMfu Zulu kuthiwa akabuzanga lutho wabiza abanye abantu baqonda kulo wesilisa bamngenela ngenduku nangezagila waphelela khona lapho."Kwale ngisho esecela uxolo esho ukuthi ukhonza khona ebandleni, uZulu wathi makashaywe abulawe ngoba vele uyisela,'' kuqhuba umthombo.Umthombo uthi lesi sehlakalo sesilihlukanise phakathi ibandla njengoba kukhona abasola uZulu ngokukhombisa unya ekubeni kukhona abanye abamesekayo.''Kumapeketwane. Sibucayi ngempela isimo lapha ebandleni. Lento asazi ukuthi izolithatha ilibeke kuphi ibandla. Lihlukene phakathi lokhu kwangempela,'' kulandisa umthombo wangaphakathi.Omunye umthombo uthe kuyimanje kumele kuqhubeke amalungiselelo omngcwabo kodwa akwaziwa ukuthi yimuphi umfundisi wamaLuthela ozoba nesibindi sokuzongcwaba isidumbu esikhishwe yibona."Umbuzo phela uthi bazomngcwaba kanjani umuntu obulewe yibona? Bazoshumayela bathini phambi kwabantu? Bazokhuluma ngamuphi uNkulunkulu phambi komndeni kamufi,'' kuqhuba lo mthombo.Lithintwa ilungu lakubo kukamufi elicele ukuba kugodlwe igama lalo, lithe kube buhlungu okwenziwe kumufi, ikakhulukazi kwenziwa uMfundisi.Ethintwa uMbhishobhi uMyaka, uvumile ukuthi isehlakalo senzekile. Uthe kodwa akanalo ulwazi olugcwele lokuthi kwenzekeni."Kuyimanje ngisaya khona ngiyohlangana nabo. Ngicabanga ukuthi yima ngizothola kahle ukuthi kwenzekeni. Okudala ukuthi ngingazi kahle wukuthi ngishonelwe ngimatasa namalungiselelo omngcwabo wasekhaya,'' uphendule kanjena.Ubuye wathumela umyalezo obuthi: "Mhlonishwa, ungadinwa mayelana nodaba obufisa ngiphawule ngalo, anginayo imininingwane ngalo okwamanje.”Kuthiwa njengoba kusondela uNovemba nje, okuyinyanga yokushintshwa kwabefundisi kumaPherishi, kukhona abafuna ukuthi uZulu asuswe kwiPherishi yaKwaMaphumulo.NgoLwesihlanu uZulu uvele enkantolo yaKwaDukuza nabanye abane okukholakala ukuthi bamlekelela ngesikhathi kubulawa umzalwane webandla.Leli bandla ngaphambilini lake laba sematheni ngemuva kokuba kuvele izindaba zokuthi "kuduke'' izindodla zezimali zebandla ngendlela engaqondakali.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uColonel Robert Netshiunda ukuqinisekisile ukuthi kunowesilisa oshaywe wafa eMphumulo esakhiweni sebandla.Uthe ababoshiwe baneminyaka ephakathi kuka-27 no-39 ubudala.Uthe amaphoyisa aKwaMaphumulo aphenya icala lokushaya nokubulala.

Uhulumeni unemigomo yakhe ethinta ezobudlelwano namazwe angaphandle."AbeDA kufanele bakhumbule ukuthi abazange balunqobe ukhetho. Bona uma befuna ukushintsha imithetho kufanele banqobe ukhetho. Umengameli njengoba esuke ekhuluma, usuke emele uhulumeni.”Umhlangano wesigungu esiphezulu kwi-ANC oqale izolo, uzodonsa izinsuku ezine.Kulo mhlangano kulindeleke ukuthi kukhulunywe izindaba ezithinta abaholi abasolwa enkohlakalweni.Phakathi kwabaholi okulindeleke ukuthi kukhulunywe ngabo kubalwa iphini likamengameli uMnuz Paul Mashatile, noNgqongqoshe wezoBulungiswa, uNksz Thembi Simelane.UMashatile, noNksz Simelane basanda kuvela phambi kwekomiti lezobuqotho kwi-ANC.
KUSUNGULWE isikhwama samakhosi okuthiwa izinkampani ezizimele zifuna ukutshala kuso izigi zamaRandi.UNdunankulu kaZulu ophathiswe uMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, umemezele ukusungulwa kweSandlwana Holdings, okuyisikhwama samakhosi.UButhelezi uthe kunezinkampani ezimbili ezizimele ezifuna ukutshala imali esikhwameni esisha.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi enomhlangano namakhosi, oLundi, ngoLwesine.ISandlwana Holdings isungulwe emva kwekhwelo leSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini lokuba amakhosi azimele, angathembeli kuhulumeni.UButhelezi uthe ibhange i-African Bank nabakwaVodacom babeke eceleni izigidi zamaRandi abazozitshala kulesi sikhwama.UButhelezi uthe abakwa-African Bank babeke eceleni u-R3.6 billion abazowutshala kulolu hlelo.Abakwa-African Bank bebemelwe uMnuz Sibongiseni Ngundze, oyisikhulu esiphezulu sezokubhenga, emhlanganweni wayizolo.UButhelezi uthe abakwaVodacom bona bafuna ukutshala u-R80 million kulolu hlelo."Bakhethe ukuthi isikhwama iSandlwana Holdings, kube yisona abafuna ukusebenzisana naso ukuthuthukisa izindawo zamakhosi. Ziningi izinhlelo abaziphethe ezizothuthukisa izindawo zamakhosi.”AbakwaVodacom bebengekho emhlanganweni wayizolo kepha uButhelezi uveze ukuthi isikhulu esiphezulu kule nkampani, uMnuz Sitholizwe Mdlalose, sibe nomhlangano nosihlalo wendlu yobuholi bomdabu KwaZulu-Natal, inkosi Sifiso Shinga, kulo leli sonto.Kuzoguga amaphakethe emakhosini afuna ukujoyina isikhwama esisha njengoba ezongena ngo-R100 000.UButhelezi unxuse wonke amakhosi ukuthi ajoyine, waxwayisa ngokuthi kuzohamba kube nesikhathi lapho kuzovalwa khona ukujoyina isikhwama."Ngeshwa, makhosi ukuze sibuzwe ubuhlungu, kumele kube khona esikufakayo njengoba nabo kukhona abazokufaka. Inkampani isisunguliwe, kusele ngakini makhosi. Inkosi kumele izinqumele yona ukuthi nasi isitimela siyahamba, ngiyajoyina yini. Kulokhu esikubonile, sakucubungula nabameli, kuyisifiso seNgonyama ukuthi kungabi khona inkosi ezosala ngaphandle.”UButhelezi uthe imali ezongena kulesikhwama izosetshenziselwa ukuthuthukisa izizwe zamakhosi."ISilo, makhosi asendlunkulu, sinombono wokuthi thina makhosi aKwaZulu-Natal, sikwazi ukuzimela kwezomnotho. Lapha KwaZulu-Natal kukhona yonke inhlobo yengcebo engenza ukuthi amakhosi azimele. Kufumaniseka ukuthi alukho uhlelo oluqondile olungenza ukuthi amakhosi akwazi ukuzimela kwezomnotho. "Le nkampani isungulelwe nina makhosi ukuthi zonke izinto eziyizifiso zokuthuthukisa imiphakathi yamakhosi, kungalokhu kulindwa uhulumeni. Njengoba ukhetho lungekho, sibona ngokuthi singawuboni uhulumeni ezindaweni zamakhosi. Mhla kwamenyezelwa usuku lokhetho sibona ngokuthi zigudlane ezindololwaneni, zonke zifisa ukuzibika emakhosini. Akusiyo impilo ukuthi silinde uhulumeni ngoba naleli bhodwe likahulumeni liyancipha.”
BAMVALELE ekhoneni uSomlomo wePhalamende uNkk Thoko Didiza, abeMK nabe-EFF, befuna izimpendulo zokuthi uzoqala nini ukusebenza umthetho wezikole okunemvunge ngawo, iBela osayinwe nguMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ngenyanga edlule.La maqembu akhale ngokuthi akukwazi ukuthi kungavunyelwa i-DA, ichachaze emakhanda amanye amaqembu ePhalamende ngoba ingeneme ngokuthile. Uzame kaningi ukubhula umlilo uNkk Didiza emhlanganweni wayizolo wekomiti lokuhlela ukusebenza kwePhalamende, elihlanganisa nephini lakhe, osotswebhu bawo wonke amaqembu nezikhulu zePhalamende ezihlanganisa nezazi zomthetho. Usotswebhu weMK uMnuz Mzwanele Manyi, uthe uNgqongqoshe weMfundo eyisiSekelo, uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, owaduba ukuba yingxenye yokusayinwa komthetho, namanje akakagaguli ukuthi umthetho uqala nini ukusebenza."Akumele sibanjwe ngobhongwane yi-DA, ngoba ingeneme ngezinto ezithile bese imisa nse yonke into. Lo mthetho wasayinwa yiPhalamende lehlandla lesithupha, kumele ngabe usuyasebenza kodwa dololo.”Uthe kuyacaca ukuthi nangomuso eminye imithetho izoma nse, ngenxa yokuthi i-DA ayeneme.UNksz Hlengiwe Mkhaliphi we-EFF, ukhale esifanayo wathi ngokomthetho kumele ngabe lo mthetho usuyasebenza."Sifuna ukwazi ukuthi umengameli usebenzise siphi isigaba soMthethosisekelo, ukusayina bese emisa okwesikhashana izigatshana ezithile zomthetho? Abantu bakuleli okubalwa nayo i-DA baba yingxenye yohlelo lwezigcawu iPhalamende lehla lenyuka lifuna izethulo kodwa manje asazi kubambephi. Sizwa kuthiwa kuzolindwa izinyanga ezintathu kusabhekwa lezi zigaba, yimuphi umthetho ovuna lokhu?” kubuza uNksz Mkhaliphi.UManyi uthe bafuna uNksz Gwarube azochaza ngaphambi kwaleli komiti.UMnuz Nqabayomzi Kwankwa we-UDM, uthe uma umthetho ususayiniwe alikho iqembu okumele libukeke sengathi linamandla ngokuthi likhale ngezinto ezithile bese kumiswa yonke into."Asikho isidingo sokuthi kube nokubambezeleka ngenxa yokuthi umthetho wasayinwa. Ngiyavumelana nozakwethu ukuthi kumele ngabe usuqalile ukusebenza.”UNkk Didiza uze wabiza oluleka uRamaphosa kwezomthetho ePhalamende, uDkt Willem Koornhof, othe kusabhekwa izigatshana ezithile kodwa umthetho wasayinwa.Uthe umengameli ubuka izinto ezimbili ngaphambi kokuphasisa umthetho okungukuthi kulandelwe yonke imigudu yasePhalamende nokuthi uyahambisana yini noMthethosisekelo wezwe."Zombili lezi zigaba zaphasa, yingakho wasayinwa. Ungqongqoshe nguyena okumele azise umengameli ukuthi uzoqala nini ukusebenza umthetho ngoba usuphasisiwe. Lo mthetho awubuyeli ePhalamende, ngoba wasayinwa.”UNkk Didiza uthe abakwazi ukubiza ungqongqoshe ngoba umsebenzi wekomiti lezemfundo lowo.
BAVULELWE icala abahlengikazi ababili basesibhedlela saseNdwedwe, oSindisweni abasolwa ngokuphula isiguli umlenze bekhala ngokuthi siyabahlupha.Ngokuthola kweSolezwe abahlengekazi baxabane nesiguli uNkk Matozi Dube (81) bagcina sebemphula umlenze.Kuvela ukuthi umnyombo wengxabano kube ukuthi abahlengikazi bebekhala ngokuthi isiguli sizimoshela njalo bese kudingeka ukuthi sishintshwe yibona.Umthombo uthe abahlengikazi babuze isiguli ukuthi kuzoze kube nini bona bemela le nto yaso yokuthi sizimoshele. Kuthiwa bebekhala ngokuthi bona sebekhathele ukwenza into eyodwa njalo."Ingxabano kuthiwa isuke lapho njengoba nesiguli kuthiwa sibaphendulile abahlengikazi. Kuthiwa bacikeke kakhulu basilamaza emlenzeni,'' kuchaza umthombo.Umthombo uthe akucaci ukuthi yini abayisebenzisile belimaza isiguli.Lolu daba kuthiwa lugcine selungenelelwa yisikhulu sesibhedlela okuthiwa sixolisile emndenini wesiguli ngokwenzekile.Owomndeni okhulume neSolezwe, uNkk Ntombifuthi Ngcobo obethuthumela, uthe akakaze asibone isihluku esinjena."Mina ngazi ukuthi uma isiguli sisemtholampilo siyanakekelwa futhi akekho umuntu onelungelo lokusilimaza. Engikubone oSindisweni kuyangixaka futhi kusiphethe kabi njengomndeni wesiguli,'' kusho yena.Uthe ngeke baze bathule bagoqe izandla ngokwenziwe abahlengikazi kodwa bazosukuma ukuze kwenzeke ubulungiswa ngalesi sehlo."Ngabe senza elikhulu iphutha uma singalusukumeli lolu daba. Phela lokhu ukwehliswa isithunzi somndeni nesesiguli. Sifuna ukuthi bajeze laba bahlengikazi. Asibadingi abahlengikazi abanonya olunjena ezibhedlela zethu,’’ usho kanje.Uthe isiguli besihlengezela izinyembezi ngesikhathi sichaza ngokuhlukunyezwa abahlengikazi."Mina kuyangixaka ukuthi abahlengikazi abanjani abakwazi ukuhlukumeza ugogo omdala kangaka kudlule lapho aze agcine esebhandisha umlenze pho,'' usho kanjena.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda ukuqinisekisile ukuthi kunecala elivuliwe esiteshini samaphoyisa saseVerulam mayelana nalesi sehlakalo.Echaza kabanzi ngaso uNetshiunda uthe : "Kusolakala ukuthi abahlengikazi ababili balimaze isiguli ebesilaliswe esibhedlela. Kuthiwa baxabane ngesikhathi besigeza. Isiguli silimale kabi emlenzeni.''
LIZIHOLA phambili ngezibalo zobugebengu iTheku uma liqhathaniswa nezinye izifunda zaKwaZulu-Natal.Lokhu kuvezwe uNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa kuzwelonke, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, esiteshini samaphoyisa saseNanda, izolo.UMchunu, uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa kuzwelonke uGeneral Fannie Masemola, uNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa esifundazweni, uLieutenant-General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, iMeya yeTheku, uMnuz Cyril Xaba, iNhloko yamaPhoyisa kaMasipala weTheku, uSibonelo Mchunu nabanye, bebehlangene ukuzosayina isivumelwano sokusebenzisana ekulweni nobugebengu.UNDUNANKULU waseKZN, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, uNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu noKhomishana wamaPhoyisa kuleli, uGeneral Fannie Masemola, ngesikhathi kunomcimbi wokusayina isivumelwano sokusebenzisana ukuqikelela ezokuphepha ngesikhathi samaholidi eNanda Isithombe: Sibonelo Ngcobo Baphinde bayohlanganyela nezinhlaka ezilwa nobugebengu enkundleni yezemidlalo, iJL Dube, oHlange, lapho bekuyokwethulwa khona umkhankaso wokuphepha ngamaholidi kaKhisimusi.UMchunu uthe ezibalweni zobugebengu esifundazweni sonke, iTheku liqengqeleza phambili ngo-42%, nathe kuyinto ekhathazayo.Uthe izakhamuzi ezingaphezu kuka-3 million zaseThekwini, zicabanga kabili uma kufanele zibeke unyawo ngaphandle kwalapho zihlala khona, wathi zenza okufanayo ngisho zingaphakathi ezindlini zazo ngoba ukuhlaselwa yinto engenzeka noma inini. Uphinde wenza isibonelo sokuthi ngisho nezingane azisakwazi ukudlala ngenkululeko ngoba nazo ziba abagilwa bobugebengu.Uvumile ukuthi abanawo amaphoyisa enele ukulwa nobugebengu obungu-42%, wathi yikho bevumelane ngokuthi amaphoyisa eSAPS naweTheku awahlangane, alwe nobugebengu ngokubambisana."Sizohlukanisa iTheku izigaba ezintathu njengoba sazi ukuthi njengamanje uyedwa uKhomishana wesifunda seTheku (uMajor General Makhosazana Kheswa). Ukulihlukanisa kathathu iTheku kuzolekelela ekutheni nezinsiza zihlukaniseke kahle,” kusho uMchunu.Uqhube wathi bahlela nokususa ukusebenza kwamakhamera kaMasipala weTheku ngaphansi kophiko lwezinhlekelele bakuyise ngaphansi kwamaphoyisa kamasipala.IMEYA yeTheku, uMnuz Cyril Xaba (ohleli phansi), uNdunankulu waseKZN, uMnuz Thami Ntuli noKhomishana wamaPhoyisa esifundazweni, uLt General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, ngesikhathi kunomcimbi wokusayinwa kwesivumelwano sokubambisana ukulwa nobugebengu Isithombe: Sibonelo Ngcobo Uthe lokho kuzolekelela ekutheni uma sebejaha izigebengu, bese bebheka ukuthi yikuphi lapho angekho khona amakhamera, babone ukuthi yiziphi izinsiza abazoziyisa kulezo zindawo.UNtuli uthe lesi sivumelwano sibalulekile njengoba kubhekwe emaholidini kaKhisimusi."Ngesikhathi samaholidi, iKwaZulu-Natal ivula iminyango ezivakashini ezisuka kwezinye izingxenye zezwe, ezinye ezivela nakwamanye amazwe. Kubalulekile ukuthi siqinisekise ukuthi ziphephile,” kubeka uNtuli.Uthe ubugebengu abulimazi nje kuphela ukuphepha kwabantu, bubuye buzwele nasemnothweni njengoba abatshalimali nezivakashi, bayayishalazela indawo enobugebengu obuphezulu besabela ukuphepha.Unxuse zonke izinhlaka, ngisho nezomphakathi ukuthi zisukume zibambisane ukulwa nobugebengu.UMkhwanazi ukhale ngobuningi bezindawo zokucima ukoma eThekwini, nathe zinomthelela omkhulu ezibalweni eziphezulu zobugebengu kulesi sifunda.Uthe ezibhaliswe ngokusemthethweni zingu-2 628, kanti amaphoyisa aqaphe ubugebengu iTheku lonke angu-5 480, wathi izinsiza zokusebenza azenele kodwa unethemba lokuthi isivumelwano sokusebenzisana sizokwenza umehluko.Kuthulwa lo mkhankaso nje, iNanda ivela ohlwini lweziteshi eziyishumi eNingizimu Afrika ezihamba phambili ngobugebenguLe ndawo ike yaba sematheni ngamaqembu emigulukudu aphilisa lubhojozi umphakathi phakathi kwawo kukhona nelizibiza ngeWest.Muva nje, kuke kwanda izigameko zokudubulana kwamaphoyisa nezigebengu ezingxenyeni ezahlukene zaKwaZulu-Natal.

Akukho ebesikusayinile phansi okusenza sisebenzisane, sagcinana ngalolo suku, asiphindanga sabonana. Angimazi nje nakahle ukuthi ungumuntu onjani ngakho ngeke ngize ngilokhu ngikhuluma ngaye. Sibe sesilandela umkhondo osikhombe eDobsonville lapho kuphinde kwaboshwa abanye abasolwa,” kuchaza yena.UMthombeni uthe obunye ubucwebe obuthathiwe bakwazile ukubuthola.
UVUMBUKE kwiMK owayengundunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Willies Mchunu, osanda kushiya kwi-ANC.UMchunu umenyezelwe njengomdidiyeli weMK KwaZulu-Natal ngesikhathi kunesithangami nabezindaba.UMchunu ushiye kwi-ANC ngasekuqaleni kwenyanga, ekhala ngesinqumo sikaKhongolose sokusebenzisana neDA kuhulumeni wokubambisana.Unobhala weMK, uDkt Sifiso Maseko, uthe uMchunu uzodidiyela zonke izinhlaka zeMK KwaZulu-Natal."Uyena ozoqoka abazohola iMK ezifundeni zeMK KwaZulu-Natal.”UMaseko uphinde wamemezela ukuqokwa kowayenguMvikeli woMphakathi, u-Advocate Busisiwe Mkhwebane, njengomdidiyeli weMK eMpumalanga.U-Advocate Mkhwebane usanda kulaxaza i-EFF njengoba esevela kwiMK.Ngesikhathi kuqhubeka isithangami nabezindaba, kunamalungu eMK abebhikisha ngaphandle, ekhala ngokuqokelwa ezikhundleni kwabantu abafikayo kwiMK.
KUSHONE iziguli ezimbili ezingozini ezintathu ezehlukekene ezenzeke KwaZulu-Natal.Ezingozini ezimbili; ama-ambulensi ashayise izinkomo agingqika, kwesisodwa isiguli sizokhele ngomlilo kwasha iwodi. Esehlakalweni sokuqala esenzeke esibhedlela eClairwood; isiguli ebeselashelwa isifo sokuphazamiseka komqondo sizishise ngesihlanzimagciwane, sashona.ABEZIMO eziphuthumayo basebenze ngokushesha becisha umlilo osuswe yisiguli esizokhele ngomlilo sashona ewodini esibhedlela eClairwood, izolo ISITHOMBE: SITHUNYELWE Kwesesibili, ibhasi elithwala iziguli ebelisuka eManguzi ebelithwele iziguli ezingu-62, lishayise inkomo eMbazwana, lagingqika, kwashona isiguli esisodwa, ezinye ebezikuyo zalimala okungatheni. Esitatimendeni esithunyelelwe abezindaba wuMnyango wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal, uthe isiguli esingowesifazane oneminyaka engu-41 ebesilaliswe ngokwehlukana nezinye iziguli, sizishise ngomlilo wasabalalela nakwamanye amawodi."Ngesikhathi kuqubuka umlilo abasebenzi bethu bakwazile ukuphuthuma bahlenge ezinye iziguli ezingu-23 ebezisewodini, ngeshwa abakwazanga ukusihlenga lesi siguli esisuse umlilo," kusho umnyango.Inyunyana yabasebenzi, i-Public Servant Association (PSA), ikushayele ihlombe ukusebenza ngokushesha kwabasebenzi abahlangule iziguli, bacisha nomlilo kodwa yathi kuyakhathaza ukuthi kuze kwaba nesigameko esinjengalesi esibhedlela ekubeni bekumele kugwenywe ukuthi isiguli sisondelane nezinto eziyingozi.UMnuz Mlungisi Ndlovu we-PSA KwaZulu-Natal, uthe: "Siyakutusa ukuthi abasebenzi basesibhedlela bakwazile ukuhlenga iziguli ngokushesha nangempumelelo kodwa lesi sigameko sikhombisa ukwehluleka kwesikhungo ukufeza isibopho sokuqinisekisa ukuphepha kwalabo esibanakekelayo. Ukusiza ngokushesha enhlekeleleni akunakuthatha indawo yokuyivimbela inhlekelele. Akwamukelekile ukuthi isiguli ewadini labagula ngengqondo sikwazi ukufinyelela ezintweni eziyingozi," kusho yena.UDkt Imran Keeka owusihlalo wekomiti lezempilo esiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal, uthe izikhungo zezempilo eziningi e-KZN zidinga ukulungiswa, kumele kubhekwe ukuthi ngabe lokhu akunawo yini umthelelela ekusabalaleni komlilo.Esehlakalweni sesithathu; umnyango uthe i-ambulensi ebithwele iziguli eziyizingane isuka eTshelejuba, eNkandla, iya eNgwelezane, ishayise inkomo yagingqika ngenhlanhla kwangashona muntu."Umnyango ufisa ukudlulisa amazwi enduduzo ezihlotsheni zabashonile kulezi zigameko,” kusho isitatimende.
KUKHUTHAZWE intsha yasemalokishini ukuba izimele inganciki kuhulumeni, ngesikhathi kuvulwa umbukiso wamabhizinisi wezinsuku ezine, iDurban Business Fair: South Region enxanxatheleni yezitolo KwaMnyandu eMlaza. UDkt Bongumusa Ntuli we-The German Cooperative and Raiffeisen Confederation, uthe izinhlelo ezifuze lolu zizolekelela ukushumayela ivangeli lokuthi intsha ayizimele. Umbukiso uzophethwa ngeSonto, kanti uzobe ugabe ngezikhulumi eziqhamuka emikhakheni ehlukene ukuhlomisa osomabhizinisi abasafufusa ngamasu okuchumisa amabhizinisi abo.UNtuli ucebise abantu ukuthi abahlangane emphakathi abawakhele, babambisane bafukulane emabhizinisini abo ukugwema ukulindela yonke into kuhulumeni."Njengoba uMlaza unabantu abalinganiselwa ku-898 000, sizohlaba ikhwelo lokuthi abantu bakuleli lokishi abahlangane, babeke okungenani uR20 umuntu emunye ngenyanga, okuzokwenza ukuthi benze uR13 million, okuba wuR165 million ngonyaka. Yimali leyo engasiza ukuqala nokufukula amabhizinisi abo ngaphandle kokukhangeza kuhulumeni,” kucebisa uNtuli.Umhlaziyi we-Co-operative Banks and Development Agency uNksz Khuthala Lengisi, ukhale ngokuthi osomabhizinisi abaningi banenkinga yokuswela ulwazi ngemigudu okumele bayilandele ukuze amabhizinisi abo aqhubeke ngendlela efanele."Yizinselelo ezinjalo okumele kubhungwe ngazo, kucetshiswane ngokuthi yikuphi lapho okumele kulungiswe khona ukugwema amaphutha esibona eyingxenye yezizathu eziholela ekutheni osomabhizinisi abaningi bangaxhaseki,” kusho uNksz Lengisi.Usotswebhu wekomiti lokuThuthukiswa koMnotho nokuHlela kuMasipala weTheku, uNksz Busi Ndlovu, uthe wethemba ukuthi lolu hlelo luzobasiza kakhulu osomabhizinisi ukuchumisa amabhizinisi abo, okuzosiza ukufukula umnotho wasemalokishini nasedolobheni iTheku namaphethelo.Kulo mbukiso kuzohlangana osomabhizinisi abawu-130 abazokhangisa ngamabhizinisi abo kuqhubeke nezingxoxo zokubahlomisa ngolwazi lokuwathuthukisa.
ABASEBENZI benkampani kahulumeni ekhiqiza izikhali, iDenel bafuna ukunyuselwa amaholo ngo-15%.Laba basebenzi bathe sekuphele iminyaka emihlanu benganyuselwa amaholo futhi inkampani ingabafakeli imali esikhwameni somhlalaphansi.Izolo baqhinqe ngaphandle kwamahhovisi eDenel, ase-Irene, eGauteng.UMnuz Mbuso Ngubane, oyiPhini likaNobhala Jikelele weNational Union of Metalworkers of South Africa (Numsa), uthe kunomkhankaso wokuwisa iDenel ngamabomu owenziwa ngabafuna ukuyidayisela osomabhizinisi abazimele.Ubalule ukuthi abasebenzi baqale ukuthwala kanzima ngesikhathi amabhizinisi kahulumeni esaphethwe nguMnuz Pravin Gordhan, ongasekho."Abasebenzi bafuna ukunyuselwa amaholo ngo-15%. Bafuna kubuyiswe imihlomulo yabo yempesheni ngoba umqashi wayeka ukuyikhokha ngesikhathi ethi lokhu kwenzelwa ukuhlenga iDenel. Njengoba abanye abasebenzi betomula imali esezikhwameni zempesheni, abasebenzi baseDenel abakwazi ukutomula. Bathwele kanzima ngoba amaholo abo awanyuki.”Uthe okwamanje abasebenzi basaqhinqile okusho ukuthi basebenzisa ikhefu labo lokudla, ukuzwakalisa ukungenami kodwa uma IDenel ibaziba bazowuqinisa umkhankaso.Uhlu lwezikhalo lwamukelwe yisikhulu esiphezulu saseDenel, uMnuz Tshepo Monaheng, othembise ukuthi bazolubheka bese bebuyela kubasebenzi.UNgubane uveze ukuthi iDenel iyawathola ama-oda kodwa idinga uhulumeni ayilekelele ngoR3 billion ukuze ikwazi ukwenza inzuzo.Uthe iDenel iyawathola ama-oda njengoba ngo-2019 yathola aka-R19 billion kwathi ngonyaka olandelayo aya kuR30 billion alokhu enyuka minyaka yonke ngakho iyadinga ukwesekwa ukuze ikwazi ukubuyela esicongweni.Wakhala ngokuthi njengoba uhulumeni engayinakile, abasebenzi baseDenel bathathwa kwamanye amazwe nakwezinye izinkampani ngenxa yamakhono abo ayivela kancane.
UKHALA ngamaphoyisa umndeni wowesifazane owashona emlilweni, kusha imijondolo eKenville, eThekwini, ngoJulayi nonyaka.UNksz Nomthandazo Dawood (30) waseMbazwana, KwaMhlabuyalingana, wayenezinyanga eziyisishiyagalombili ezithwele ngesikhathi umjondolo wakhe uthungeleka ngomlilo ngezintatha zangoJulayi 14.Lo wesifazane uye yedwa owashona kulesi sehlo, abanye bashelwa imijondolo engaphezu kuka-270.Udadewabo, uNksz Nompumelelo Nxumalo, utshele Isolezwe, ukuthi kusuka ngoJulayi 14 kuze kube yimanje, izihlobo zakhe zisahleli ematilasini.Ukhale ngamaphoyisa enza into engaqondakali ngemiphumela yolibofuzo lukamufi, ekubeni ayethembisile ukuthi azophuthuma."NgoJulayi 17 emva kwesigameko, abaseshi bafika ekhaya eMbazwana, bezothatha amasampula olibofuzo kumama. Bathembisa ukuthi imiphumela izobuya ngokushesha ngoba udadewethu uye yedwa oshone emlilweni,” kusho uNksz Nxumalo.Uthe aze athembisa nokuthi kuzojutshwa iphoyisa elilodwa ethimbeni lawo ukuthi liwahambise lona amasampula ePitoli.Uthe kwaphela amasonto amabili kuthule, kuthe ngo-Agasti 1, bathola ukuthi ima ezowahambisa umsheshi amasampula."Umseshi, obeseziba izingcingo zethu, uze washayela ucingo isihlobo ngo-Okthoba 10, ethi asilethe umama eRichards Bay, ukuze ezothatha amanye amasampula ngoba lawa awathatha ngoJulayi angenwa yizintuli,” kusho uNksz Nxumalo.Uthe lokhu kubahluthulile, bazibuza nemibuzo eminingi."Sibuhlungu ngokuthi kuthathe isikhathi eside kangaka ukuthi sisizakale, ukuze sizofihla udadewethu ngesizotha,” kukhala yena.Uthe okunye okubaphatha kabi ukuthi babethenjisiwe ukuthi kuzoshesha njengoba kungafanga abantu abaningi, kwaba udadewabo kuphela."Uma sekwenzeka ngale ndlela, sesisola ukuthi akazange wawahambisa ngokushesha amasampula awathatha ekuqaleni aze angenwa ukungcola njengoba esho. Kungenzeka futhi ukuthi wawalahla,” kubeka uNksz Nxumlo.Uthe okubuhlungu nje ukuthi izalukazi zomndeni ezihleli etshalini, sezize zingenwa ukugula ngenxa yobude besikhathi.Uthe ngokosiko lwabo, abakwazi ukushiya umatilasi, baqhubeke nempilo bengakangcwabi."Okunye okubuhlungu ukuthi ingane (12) kamufi yokuqala isizame ukuzibulala kathathu ngenxa yalokhu,” usho kanje.Uthe banxusa izikhulu zamaphoyisa ukuthi zilulandele udaba, ukuze bakwazi ukufihla isihlobo sabo ngesizotha, esesihlale emakhazeni izinyanga ezintathu.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe imiphumela yolibofuzo eyenziwa yabuya inogcobho."Kwabonakala isidingo sokuthi kuphinde kuthathwe amanye amasampula emasontweni amabili edlule, aphinde athunyelwe okwesibili. Amaphoyisa asalinde imiphumela yalapho,” kusho uNetshiunda.
USENOVALO umndeni wowesilisa waseLouis Botha, eMnambithi, osalwela impilo yakhe esibhedlela emva kokuphuziswa i-acid abasolwa okuvela ukuthi babethunywe unina kubangwa amafa.Lo wesilisa (26) ongeke adalulwe ukumvikela, uphuziswe i-acid ngo-Okthoba 12. Ngemuva kwalesi sigameko, kwabe sekuboshwa unina kamgilwa, uNkk Sindi Mbatha nomunye wesilisa, uMnuz Msizi Mbhele, okuvela ukuthi unama-metered taxi, okusolwa ukuthi wayehlanganisa naye itulo lokusoconga umgilwa.Isihlobo esiseduze nomgilwa esicele ukuba kugodlwe igama laso, siveze ukuthi bese kuyophela iminyaka emibili umgilwa nonina beyinkukhu nempaka.Sithe lokhu kuza emva kokushona kukagogo kamgilwa ngoFebhuwari 2022, okuvela ukuthi uzala unina kamgilwa.Isihlobo sithe umgilwa nengane yakwabo efunda uGrade 11 bashiyelwa ifa ugogo."Yize noma ngingeke ngande kakhulu ngolwazi olujulile ngalokhu ngoba lonke sesiluhambise emaphoyiseni kodwa ibiyinde kakhulu ingxabano phakathi kwabo. Kukhona nezinkulumo eziqoshiwe ezingcingweni zabo bobabili,’’ kusho sona.Siqhuba, sithe nakuba bebemagange ukuthi kutholwe abasolwa abenzakalisa isihlobo sakhe kodwa bethuke boma sekuboshwa unina."'Sasizitshela ukuthi kuzoboshwa abantu esingabazi. Sethuka kakhulu uma sekuboshwa unina kamgilwa,’’ sisho kanje.Siveze ukuthi babenayo imibuzo ngesigameko kwazise abasolwa abagqekezanga, bavele bazingenela kalula.Okwesibili, sithe abazange bathathe lutho, abakwenza ukumhlasela umgilwa kuphela.Elandisa ngesigameko, isihlobo sithe abasolwa bangena behlome ngezibhamu, baqonda ekameleni okwakulele kulo umgilwa nentombi yakhe, bacaphuna yena baya naye egumbini lokuphumula."Bafike bamphuzisa ngenkani ukentshezi esingalwazi ukuthi lwaluyini olwalusesigujini sika-2litre. Umgilwa wayelokhu eluphimisa baze babiza intombi yakhe ukuthi izomphuzisa, nayo bayiphoqa,’’ kuchaza isihlobo esiveze ukuthi uketshezi lwamlimaza ngaphakathi umgilwa kanjalo nasentanyeni, esifubeni, ezingalweni nasezinyaweni.Sithe wangeniswa esibhedlela engaboni lutho waze wangeniswa egumbini labagula kakhulu, kanti usephumile egumbini labagula kakhulu nakuba isimo sakhe singakagculisi."Akekho umuntu ovumeleke ukumvakashela ngaphandle kukayise ngoba sisabela ukuphepha kwakhe,’’ kusho sona.Omunye umthombo uveze ukuthi unina kamgilwa kukhona naye akuhlomula efeni likagogo kodwa wakhombisa ukunganeliseki.Udalule nokuthi emva kwesigameko sikamgilwa bagcine sebeshaya amakhala ngokufa kukagogo."Ngosuku ashona ngalo ugogo wayegule isigubhukane kulandela ukudla amasi ayekade ewenzelwe unina kamgilwa. Washona ngosuku aqala ngalo ukugula. Manje uma sekwenzeka nje, sesiyazibuza ukuthi akanaso yini isandla ekufeni kukagogo?’’ kusho umthombo.Uveze ukuthi unina kamgilwa ushaqwe nalona wesilisa ezitolo kulandela ukuthola kwamaphoyisa ngezingxoxo zabo befunana inkokhelo ngokuphuziswa kukamgilwa i-acid."Owesilisa ubesefuna ngodli imali yakhe ngomsebenzi, unina kamgilwa engayizwa leyo, eveza ukuthi umsebenzi awenzekanga ngoba umgilwa akashonanga,’’ esho.Kuvela ukuthi umgilwa nengane yakwabo efunda uGrade11 batholwa ngunina ngaphambi kokuthi ayoshada. Bobabili bebeyizingane ebezikhuliswa ugogo okuvela ukuthi wayeyiphini likathishanhloko.Imithombo ithe izihlobo zikamgilwa zifuna ukubona ubulungiswa.Abasolwa kuvela ukuthi baboshwa ngo-Okthoba 14, bavela okokuqala eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMnambithi, ngo-Okthoba 16.Bebevele ngoLwesibili icala labo lahlehliselwa u-Okthoba 29 no-30 ukuze bafake isicelo sebheyili.
UZOFIHLWA ngomngcwabo wezinga likaHulumeni owayengungqongqoshe wezabaSebenzi uMnuz Membathisi Mphumzi Shepherd Mdladlana.UMdladlana (72) uhlonishwe ngomngcwabo wesigaba sesibili yibamba likamengameli wezwe uMnuz Paul Mashatile. UMnuz Keith Khoza, okhulumela uMashatile, uthe uMdladlana oshone ngoLwesihlanu olwedlule, uzofihlwa ngoMgqibelo eKapa, kanti umngcwabo uzobe wenganyelwe wuphiko lwamaphoyisa akuleli. Uthe amafulegi aqale ukundizela phansi kusuka izolo ekuseni koze kube wusuku lomngcwabo.Ubalule ukuthi le ngqalabutho yangena ePhalamende ngaphansi kukahulumeni wentando yeningi ngo-1994. Wayenguthishanhloko futhi engomunye wabasunguli benyunyana yothisha iSadtu.Waqokwa kwiKhabhinethi kaMadiba njengongqongqoshe wabaSebenzi, nabanye omengameli abalandela bamgcina kulesi sikhundla. Labo mengameli oMnuz Thabo Mbeki, Kgalema Motlanthe noJacob Zuma.Waba yinxusa lakuleli eBurundi, wajutshelwa nakwesika-High Commissioner eCanada.EPhalamende waqokelwa emakomitini ahlukene okubalwa elomnyango wezaseKhaya namanye.Izolo ntambama bekunenkonzo yesikhumbuzo sikaMdladlana lapho umengameli weSadtu uMnuz Magope Maphila, ehloniphe le ngqalabutho ngeqhaza layo kwezemfundo. Inkonzo ibihlelwe yi-ANC esifundeni iDullar Omar eKapa, ezinkundleni zemidlalo iGugulethu Sports Complex.ISadtu ithe uMdladlana walwela amalungelo othisha ikakhulu abesifazane.Ithe ungomunye wabantu abalwela ukuthi othisha besifazane bangaxoshwa uma bekhulelwe njengoba kwakungavumelekile ukuthi bakhulelwe besebenza.Imncome ngokuthi ungomunye wabantu ababa nesandla ekusungulweni komkhandlu obhunga ngezinto ezithinta othisha kuleli.
UKUZITSHWA wumasipala akuzange kumqede amandla esifisweni sakhe sokusiza abafundi namalungu omphakathi abewela kanzima uma umfula ugola izintethe, owesilisa waseNzala eMabomvini, ngaphansi kukaMasipala waseMvoti. Muva nje, uphenduke iqhawe ngokwakha ibhuloho labahamba ngezinyawo ekhipha ephaketheni lakhe.UMnuz Vumani Shelembe, oziphilisa ngebhizinisi lokushisela endaweni exoxa neSolezwe, uthe ukubuka abantu bangakubo behlupheka ikakhulu abafundi nabantu abagulayo, bewela kanzima ukuya ezikoleni nasemtholampilo ongaphesheya komfula iNadi, obuye ungenise kumenze waphokophelela ukulekelela ekuguquleni isimo. UShelembe uthe ukuhlela ukwakha leli bhuloho nokulakha, kumthathe iminyaka emibili, emva kokufaka izicelo kumasipala njengelungu lomphakathi elikhathazekile efisa ukuthi ubonelele abantu nabafundi abebethwala kanzima uma kungena ihlobo, kuyisikhathi semvula.BEKUYINJABULO yodwa kubafundi besikole samabanga aphakeme i-Somahhashi, kuMasipala Umvoti, bewela ngokukhululeka umfula iNadi obugola izintethe emva kwemvula. Leli bhuloho lakhiwe yilungu lomphakathi uMnuz Vumani Shelembe Isithombe:SITHUNYELWE"Izingane zami zifunda eSomahhashi, okuyisikole samabanga aphakeme esingaphesheya komfula. Uma lina kakhulu bengizilanda ngemoto ngisebenzisa indlela ethathelayo. Bengizama ukuthatha ezinye izingane zomphakathi kodwa ngehluleke ngoba ziningi kakhulu bengingeke ngiziqede. Kubuhlungu uwumzali ukubona izingane ziwela ngezinyawo umfula oyingozi,” usho kanje uShelembe.Uveze ukuthi kunezigameko ezimbalwa zokwemuka kwabathile abangamalungu omphakathi abadlula emhlabeni emva kokuzama ukuwela lo mfula ugcwele ngenxa yokungabikhona kwebhuloho.Uthe ngesikhathi ebona ukuthi alukho usizo alutholayo, unqume ukusukuma asebenzise ulwazi analo ekushiseleni izinsimbi, waqoqa izinsimbi ezinye zazo ezindala esebenzisa nemishini yakhe yokushisela ngenhloso yokuthi kusizakale umphakathi. Uthe kwesinye isikhathi bekudingeka ayothenga izinsimbi ezitolo, aqashe nomshini wokumba nabantu abazomlekelela ukuthi kwakhiwe leli bhuloho, waveza ukuthi kumudle imali u-R50 000 obuphuma ephaketheni lakhe.Uqhube wathi ngaphandle kwabafundi abasizakele ngokwakhiwa kwalo, bekubanzima ukubona umuntu oxinwe ukugula ehamba ngendlela ethathelayo eya emtholampilo ongaphesheya komfula noma ezama ukuwela obekuba yinkinga kakhulu uma liyidliva. Leli bhuloho athe lingamamitha awu-20, uthi ukwakhiwa kwalo kuphothulwe ezinyangeni ezimbalwa ezedlule kanti usizo lwalo lugqame kakhulu kuleli sonto njengoba isifundazwe besihlaselwe yimvula enamandla kugcwala imifula, okuqondane nokubhalwa kwezivivinyo zika-matric.Yize ngokuvuleka lilincane ngenxa yokuthi ubengenazo izinsiza ezanele, uShelembe uthe leli bhuloho wenze isiqiniseko sokuthi liphephile njengoba linezinsika eziyisishiyagalombili, kukhona kuzo nezihamba ngambili athe yena nabebemlekelela benza isiqiniseko sokuthi zimbelwe zafakwa ngendlela eqinisekisa ukuphepha. Linendawo yokubambelela abawelayo nakuba isohlangothini olulodwa."Ziningi izindawo lapha kwelakithi umphakathi othwala kanzima uma uwela ngenxa yesimo esifanayo. Ngiyafisa ukulekelela kodwa amandla awekho ngoba engikwenzile bekuphuma ephaketheni lami emva kokuthi umasipala ukhombise ukungayingeni indaba yokusiza,” kusho uShelemba.Emva kokufakwa kwe-vidiyo yabafundi bethakasile bewela kuleli bhuloho ku-Facebook weSolezwe, iningi labantu lincome isenzo sikaShelembe.UNtombifuthi Buselaphi uthe: '’Into enhle iyanconywa, uNkulunkulu akwandisele lapho uthathe khona."UMfundo Ntombiyasemabheleni Ntuli uthe:"Kungcono avotelwe abe yimeya, muhle umsebenzi awenzile.”USthembile Ngubane uthe:"Siyabonga baba uShelembe wenze okwehlula umasipala.”
IZIHLATHI zivakashela kwandlebe kwaboMngeni-uThukela Water emuva kokuthi inhlangano ebheka ukuphathwa kwezinkampani emhlabeni jikelele iFitch, iyiklelise njengenkampani eyiphethe kahle imali.IFitch iklelise uMngeni-uThukela Water ngokohlelo lwe-AA+ okusho ukuthi le nhlangano iziphethe kahle izimali zayo futhi ilawulwa ngendlela eyiyo.Ngunyaka wesibili uMngeni-uThukela Water ukleliswa ngale ndlela ngoba nangonyaka odlule ubekwe kulesi sigaba.IFitch yinhlangano ezinze eLondon, ebheka izinkampani emhlabeni ukuthi ziziphethe kanjani izimali nokuthi zilawulwa noma ziphethwe kanjani.Ukukleliswa yiyo kusho ukuthi leyo nkampani iba negama emhlabeni jikelele. Abatshalizimali nababolekisa ngemali bayakwazi ukubheka ukukleliswa kwayo ukuze bathathe izinqumo ngayo.IFitch iveze ukuthi uMngeni-uThukela Water uyakwazi ukuboleka ngendlela awuboleki imali enkulu kakhulu kunalokho okufanele ukwenze futhi uzikhokhela ngesikhathi izikweletu zawo.Lokhu kusho ukuthi uzokwazi ukuboleka imali ozosiza ukuba uthuthukise izinhlelo zayo zengqalasizinda.UNgqongqoshe waManzi neNhlanzeko, uNksz Pemmy Majodina, uthe kuyamjabulisa ukuthi uMngeni-uThukela Water ukleliswe ngo-AA+ ngoba lokhu kusho ukuthi uziphethe kahle izimali.Uzwakalise ukukhathazeka ngokumosheka kwamanzi avuza kwingqalasizinda yomasipala abahlukene abathola amanzi eMngeni-uThukela Water.Wakhala nangokubambezeleka kwezinhlelo zengqalasizinda yamanzi, wabalula ukuthi kungase kube nomthelela omubi ekuklelisweni koMngeni-uThukela Water eminyakeni ezayo.UMngeni-uThukela Water uyazama ukulekelela omasipala ukuze bakwazi ukuthuthukisa ingqalasizinda yabo yamanzi nokuthi banciphise amanzi amosheka ngenxa yamapayipi avuzayo nokunye.
UZOHLALA ngoDisemba umhlangano wokuqala ohlanganisa amaqembu abambisene kuhulumeni wakuleli, wokuhlelela ingxoxo ngesimo sezwe.Lokhu kuvezwe yiPhini likaMengameli uMnuz Paul Mashatile, ngoLwesine eKapa ngesikhathi ehlangene nabaholi bamaqembu ayingxenye kahulumeni wokubambisana.UMashatile uthe kuzoba nomhlangano oyisipesheli weKhabhinethi, ngelizayo ukubhunga ngendaba yomhlangano ngesimo sezwe."Umhlangano ngesimo sezwe ozobe uhlanganisa amaqembu abambisene kuhulumeni uzoba ngoDisemba 16 nonyaka. Kulo mhlangano sizobe silungiselela umhlangano ngesimo sezwe ozoba ngonyaka ozayo,” kusho uMashatile.Uthe umhlangano wangoLwesine wabaholi abayingxenye kahulumeni bekungowokubhunga ngodaba oluthinta umthetho wezikole okunemvunge ngawo iBela.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, wamisa ukuqala kokusebenza kwezigatshana ezimbili kulo mthetho, ngenxa yokuthi kusamele kuboniswane ngazo.I-DA nezinye izinhlangano eziphikisa eyalo mthetho, zanxusa ukuthi kubhungwe ngalezi zigatshana, ngoba zingeneme ngazo.Usihlalo womkhandlu iFederal kwi-DA uNkk Helen Zille, uye enkundleni i-X izolo, wakhala ngokuthi i-ANC, ithatha izinqumo ngaphandle kokuxhumana nabo.Uthe i-ANC izithathela yona izinqumo emva kokuba uMashatile ekhulume ngomhlangano othinta ingxoxo ngesimo sezwe."Indaba yengxoxo ngesimo sezwe, kumele ihlanganise zonke izinhlaka ezibambisene kuhulumeni. I-ANC izithathela yona izinqumo yenza sengathi yawina ukhetho,” kusho uNkk Zille.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi eyengxoxo ngesimo sezwe yamenyezelwa nguRamaphosa, emuva kwesiphakamiso sokuthi kumele kuxoxwe ngezinkinga zezwe.Kule ngxoxo kuzobakhona zonke izinhlaka zomphakathi kanti kuzokhulunywa nganoma yini. Kule ngxoxo bekukhona abamele amaqembu okubalwa owe-DA uMnuz Dean McPherson, uGeneral Bantu Holomisa we-UDM, Kenny Kunene we-PA, Magashule Gana weRise Mzansi, Corne Mulder weFF+, Brett Herron weGOOD, Ysuf Dalwai we-Al Jama-ah nokhulumela i-IFP uMnuz Mkhuleko Hlengwa.
