IKOMITI lezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi ePhalamende linikeze uMnyango wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi ne-South African Social Security Agency (Sassa) izinsuku eziwu-30 ukuba kuphenye udaba lwenkohlakalo yesibonelelo sika-R370 wabangatohozi.Lokhu kuza emuva kokuthi iPhalamende limeme izitshudeni ezimbili zeComputer Science zeNyuvesi yaseStellenbosch, uJoel Cedras noVeer Gosai ukuba zizothula umbiko wazo othole ukuthi kulula ukukhwabanisa u-R370 wabangasebenzi.Lezi zitshudeni zithole ukuthi uhlelo lokubhalisa izibonelelo nge-internet (online) okuthiwa lwenzelwe ukuvimbela ukukhwabanisa lwenza kube lula ukuthi abantu bakhwabanise u-R370 wabangasebenzi.Zithole ukuthi yize zona nozakwabo abawu-60 bengakaze babhalisele isibonelelo sabangasebenzi kodwa izinombolo zabo zomazisi ziyavela kubantu abahola isibonelelo sabangasebenzi.I-DA ike yakhala ngalolu daba isho nokuthi kufanele uMnyango wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi ne-South African Social Security Agency (Sassa) balusukumele.Usihlalo wekomiti lezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi ePhalamende, uNkk Bridgette Masango, uthe banqume ukunikeza uMnyango wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi ne-Sassa izinsuku eziwu-30 ukuba uphenye ngezinsolo zokukhwatshaniswa kwemali yesibonelelo sabangasebenzi."Ukuzwa ukuthi uhlelo lwa-online ebesitshelwe ukuthi luvikela ukukhwabanisa nalo kulula ukuba kwenziwe inkohlakalo nokuthi kukhwatshaniswe kulo kufanele sikusukumele phezulu. Yingakho sinikeze uMnyango wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi ne-Sassa izinsuku eziwu-30 ukuba baluphenye. Silindele ukuthi emuva kophenyo kulethwe umbiko ozobe uchaza ngokutholakale.”UNgqongqoshe wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi, uNksz Sisisi Tolashe, uthembise ukuthi bazokwenza uphenyo ngenkohlakalo okuthiwa yenzeka ezinhlelweni zesibonelelo sika-R370 sabangasebenzi."Sizoyisukumela ngokuthi siqale uphenyo ngezinsolo zokuthi kunabadla imali yabampofu. Kufanele sazi ukuthi lesi silwane esikhwabanisa imali sesidle kangakanani emalini yethu encipha nsukuzonke,” kusho uNksz Tolashe.
BAKHONONDA ngomfundisi omkhulu wamaNazaretha, Embelebeleni KwaMashu, okuthiwa uxova leli thempeli njengoba kusuke izibhelu kwajahwa nabagcotshwa abebezokwethula uMshumayeli noMkhokheli ababexoshwe wumholi webandla, iNkosi Mduduzi "Nyazilwezulu” Shembe.Kulesi sigameko kugwazwe nethayi lomunye wabagcotshwa, amakholwa evuke indlobana ejahana ethempelini emasontweni amabili edlule.Kuthiwa kumanje amaNazaretha kuleli thempeli asekhonza egadwe amaphoyisa ngoba besaba ukuthi kungasuka impi noma yinini.Imithombo yangaphakathi kuleli thempeli ithe inkinga enkulu ngumfundisi omkhulu wakhona obizwa ngoMdletshe okuthiwa wenza izinto ngendlela yakhe ukuxova amakholwa.Kuthiwa lo mfundisi akasangeni naseThempelini elikhulu eSikhumbuzweni okuyilona eliphethe wonke amathempeli aKwaMashu, ngenxa yokuthi waxoshwa enukwa ngokuthakatha.Kukhona nomunye wabagcotshwa okuthiwa usevuka nasesibhedlela ngenxa yokhwantalala okuthiwa ludalwe wukuxoshwa ngumfundisi uMdletshe eMbelebeleni 'engonanga’ lutho."Inkinga enkulu umfundisi Mdletshe oxova leli thempeli. Uqambe amanga wasebenzisa abagcotshwa ukuthi abazomemezela ukuthi ubaba uNyazilwezulu selubabuyisele esontweni okuyinto engekho. Nangesikhathi laba bagcotshwa bethula inkulumo bebezenza ubaba befuna amakholwa amukele inkulumo yabo ngendlela amaNazaretha ayamukela ngayo uma kukhuluma uNyazilwezulu ngoba bethi bathunywe yilona ngqo, okuyinto engekho. Kumanje lo mfundisi akangeni eSikhumbuzweni okuyithempeli elikhulu njengoba esolwa ngokuthakatha. Ukusolwa ngokuthakatha yinto eyaziwayo nje KwaMashu futhi iyakhulunywa nje,” kusho umthombo.Kuthintwa uMfundisi Mdletshe ucingo lwakhe belukhomba ukuthi luvaliwe. Nomyalezo athunyelelwe wona akawuphendulanga kwaze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela.Omunye wabagcotshwa (esiligodlile igama lakhe) othe ube yisisulu sikamfundisi Mdletshe, uthe usevuka esibhedlela ngenxa yokhwantalala oludalwe yindlela aphathwe ngayo yilo mfundisi."Ngingeniswe esibhedlela eNtabeni ngalaliswa isonto lonke ngenxa yakhe lo mfundisi. Ungixoshe ngingonanga lutho. Phezu kwalokho bengivele ngiphila kanzima ngaphansi kobuholi bakhe, ubungathi ngisejele ngibe ngisesontweni. Kuningi nje akwenzayo okuyinkinga okulukhuni ukukubekezela. Kumanje sengikhonza kwelinye ithempeli khona KwaMashu ngenxa yakhe,” kusho lo mgcotshwa.Okhulumela amaNazaretha ngaphansi kweNkosi uNyazilwezulu, uMnuz Thokozani Mncwabe uthe udaba lwaseMbelebeleni ngeke lulungiseke uma lusingethwe ngumfundisi Mdletshe kuphela."Siyayazi indaba yaseMbelebeleni, kodwa ukuze ilunge kudingeka ilungiswe umfundisi Mdletshe alekelelwe wuMfundisi Gumede, noMfundisi Mathenjwa abangabanye abafundisi abakhulu abaphethe amathempeli aKwaMashu. Uma konke kusingethwe wuMdletshe, akukho lutho oluzolunga,” kusho uMncwabe.Mayelana nokuthi abagcotshwa abamemezele ukubuyiswa komshumayeli nomkhokheli eMbelebeleni, uMncwabe uthe ngeke akuqinisekise ukuthi bebethunywe wuNyazilwezulu ngempela ngoba akanabo ubufakazi.
KUBUKEKA sekuphenduka insakavukela umchilo wesidwaba ukubulawa kwabantu abaningi ngesikhathi esisodwa ezindaweni zamakhosi.Muva nje, iningi labantu elisuke libulewe ngabesifazane, nezingane.Zivamisile ukwehluka izizathu abantu ababulawelwa zona okanye umbulali afe nemfihlo noma ayobhadla ejele aqome ukuzithulela. Lezi zehlakalo ziyaye zitshale ukudideka nengebhe emphakathini, uthole abantu sebehamba bejeqeza ubala. KUSETSHENZISWA kakhulu izibhamu ezingekho emthethweni ukuqotha abantu eNingizimu Afrika Isithombe: SIGCINIWEKuvamisile ukuthi kuthiwe ubugebengu obusuke buhleliwe, nokwanda kwezibhamu ezingekho emthethweni kuba yimbangela enkulu ezehlakalweni zokuqothwa kwabantu abaningi ngesikhathi esisodwa.UMKHUZI wamaPhoyisa uGeneral Fannie Masemola, uyavuma ukuthi iyinkinga eyezibhamu ezingekho emthethweni ebantwini Isithombe: SiIGCINIWEMuva nje, kubikwe izigameko zokusocongwa kwabantu abaningi behleli ndawonye KwaZulu-Natal, nase-Eastern Cape.Lesi sihlava sikhuza ibuya, sike sabhebhetheka emiphakathini eyakhele isifundazwe iKwaZulu-Natal, naseGauteng ngo-2022. Ngaleso sikhathi abantu babesocongwa ngapha, nangapha uma bezijabulisa ezindaweni zokucima ukoma. Abanye abantu babeze bakuphendule ihlaya lokhu ezinkundleni zokuxhumana bethi uma ufuna indlela esheshayo yokufa, hamba uye ejoyintini ebusuku.NgoSepthemba, kushiye umphakathi ushaqekile ukubulawa kwamalungu ayisikhombisa akwaKhambule, eHlokozi, eHighflats. Ababulali bomndeni bathelwe othulini ngenhlamvu bedubulala namaphoyisa ngoLwesibili.Abantu bathuke koma nasozwaneni kuhlaselwa futhi kubulawa abozalo abangu-18 belungisela umcimbi wokwembulwa kwetshe eNgobozana, eLusikisiki.Bawu-15 abesifazane abaphangalala kulezi zigameko ezimbili. Amaphoyisa abophe indoda ebingaphandle ngoshwele onikezwa iziboshwa okuthiwa, yayibaqotha nge-AK47.Kusabatshazwa lo muga, kuhlaselwe abayisithupha eQumbu, e-Eastern Cape besemhlanganweni olwa nobugebengu bokwebiwa kwemfuyo.Igazi liqhubekile nokugobhoza KwaZulu-Natal, ngeledlule ngesikhathi kuhlaselwa umama, indodakazi nomzukulu eMatimatolo, eGreytown.Kuvale ngesehlakalo lapho owesilisa egwaze ngommese amalungu omndeni wakhe ayisikhombisa, kwashona abayisihlanu eBethany, eBergville ngempelasonto. UDkt Johan Burger ozimele, ongungcoti kwezobugebengu ngamafuphi, uthe imbangela yokuqothwa wabantu ngale ndlela kungenxa yobugebengu obusuke buhleliwe.UMqondisi wenhlangano iGun Free South Africa, uNkk Adele Kirsten, uthe izwe ligubuzelwe wubugebengu futhi bangu-33 abantu ababulawayo nsukuzaphuma.Uveza ukuthi ubugebengu buxake kangangokuthi umgilwa kulula ukuthi aphucwe isibhamu kunokuthi asisebenzise ezivikela uma ehlaselwa.Ngokusho kukaNkk Kirsten phakathi kweminyaka u-2018 no-2023, amaphoyisa alahlekelwe yizibhamu ezingu-3 299. Kunabantu emphakathini abaphatha izibhamu ezisemthethweni abalahlekelwa ezingu-33 495."Abantu abantulayo ikakhulu ababa yizisulu zalobu bugebengu futhi abavela emiphakathini engathuthukisiwe lapho kwentuleka imisebenzi. Ukungalingani nokuvalelwa ngaphandle kwezomnotho yikhona okukhuphula ubugebengu nodlame,” kusho uNkk Kirsten.Okushiwo yiGun Free South Africa yimpilo eyenzeka ebantwini abahlala emalokishini nasemakhaya. Akuvamisile ukuthi uzwe kuthiwa ezindaweni zomtakabani kulaliswe uyaca ngenhlamvu.Izibhamu ezilahleka amaphoyiseni nakubanikazi bazo emphakathi ziphelela ezandleni zezigebengu bese zicishwa izinombolo zazo zisetshenziswe ezenzweni zobugebengu obuhlanganisa ukubulawa kwabantu.Kubalulekile ukuvuselelelwa kwezinhlaka ezilwa nobugebengu emphakathi futhi kuqiniswe ukusebenzisana kwabantu namaphoyisa ngenhloso yokulwa nobugebengu.Abantu kubalulekile ukuthi bahlinzeke amaphoyisa ngolwazi. Nawo amaphoyisa kumqoka ukuthi avikele abantu abahlinzeka ngolwazi khona abantu bezobika ngokukhululeka.UKhomishana wamaPhoyisa, uGeneral Fannie Masemola uyavuma ukuthi izibhamu ezingekho emthethweni ezisebantwini ziyiva elingabanguleki wathi akhona amathimba abhekele ukuguqula lesi simo.UMasemola uthe ezinye zalezi zibhamu okubulawa ngazo abantu ngale ndlela ezazikhona nangesikhathi sezimpi ngobandlululo.Indlela okubulawa ngayo abantu nsuku zonke eNingizimu Afrika, ungafunga ukuthi izwe elisempini. Kuba nzima kakhulu uma sekuqothwa abantu abaningi ngesikhathi esisodwa okuyaye kushiye izintandane noma amakhaya engasenabani.UNdunankulu kaZulu ophinde abe nguNgqongqoshe woMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal, uMfundisi Thulasizwe Buthelezi, usanda kubabaza lo muga wokuqothwa kwabantu owenzekae ezindaweni zamakhosi.UButhelezi kanye nondabezitha bazigxeke kakhulu lezi zigameko abazichaze njengezibe wubuwula.Babe sebephonsela inselelo umphakatthi ukuba uhlinzeke izinhlaka zezomthetho ngemininingwane ezolekelela ekutheni kuboshwe ababulali.Ikhwelo elifanayo lisanda kuhlatshwa nayinkosi yamaMpondo, uDaluxolo Sigcau. Yanxenxa labo bantu abaphatha izibhamu ezingekho emthethweni ukuba baziyise emaphoyiseni, ikhala ngokuthi siyaphela isizwe.Ukulwa nobugebengu kuqala ngomuntu ngamunye. Uma wazi umuntu oyisaphulamthetho emphakathini, mbike emaphoyiseni. Ungakubona kukuncane lokhu kodwa kungenza omkhulu umehluko ekuhlengeni izimpilo zabantu.Kumele umbutho wamaphoyisa uvuselele uphiko lwawo lwezobunhloli, ngenhloso yokunqanda ubugebengu bungakenzeki kunokuthi kusukunywe selidume ladlula nabantu.Izinkantolo kumele zikhiphe izigwebo eziqinile kwabalahlwa ngamacala okubulala abantu. Lokhu kuyaye kuthumele umyalezo oshubile kwabanye abantu abasuke becabanga ukwenza amacala afanayo.
UYABALISA umndeni wakwaNgubo eMakholweni, e-Underberg, ngezulu elishaye labulala imfuyo yawo, kwadaleka umonakalo nasezindlini.Kuvela ukuthi izulu lishaye labulala izinkomo ezinhlanu nezimbuzi ezinhlanu zakulo muzi.Indlu enkulu kuthiwa iphephukile. LIYAYIKAZELA ngokunukwa ngezigemegeme ezishaqisayo iphoyisa lasesiteshini saseCato Manor, eMayville, elisolwa ngokweba ikhadi lasebhange lomgilwa ngesikhathi liyolanda imoto yakhe eyayiduniwe.Lokhu kuvele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini, ngesikhathi lifaka isicelo sebheyili.UConstable Minenhle Makhaye (27) uboshwe ngasekuqaleni kwanyanga, emva kokutholwa nekhadi lasebhange lowesifazane owadunwa imoto kwaze kwafa nengane (11) yakhe eMalvern, eThekwini, ngoSepthemba.Ingane kamgilwa kuthiwa yaphuma yacasha ngaphansi kwemoto kanti kuzothi uma sebekhala amaphepha abasolwa, bayishayise, ishone.Umsolwa ubhekene namacala amane; elokweba, elokukhwabanisa, elokuvimba ukusebenza kwengalo yomthetho nelokutholwa nempahla okusolwa ukuthi yebiwe.Efaka isicelo sebheyili izolo, umphenyi woKlebe, uWarrant Officer Sivan Naidoo, udedele ibhomu eveza ukuthi empeleni awu-272 amakhadi atholwa ehleli ngebhokisi elibomvu ekamelweni likamsolwa okungawase-Capitec, Absa, African Bank, FNB namanye amhlophe okungacaci ukuthi awakuphi. Phambilini, bekuvele ukuthi watholwa namakhadi awu-105. Amakhadi abalisiswe kahle ngoLwesithathu olwedlule.IPHOYISA laseCato Manor, uConstable Minenhle Makhaye, livele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini, ecaleni lokusolwa ngokweba ikhadi lasebhange lomgilwa ngenkathi lilande imoto yakhe eyayiduniwe Isithombe: SIBONELO NGCOBOUthe kusona leso sidididi sokutholwa namakhadi, kuvela ukuthi wabuye watholwa nelomngani wakhe kuye emzimbeni, okuthiwa (umngani) wayelibike ukuthi limlahlekele ngo-2021.Emakhadini atholwa kumsolwa kuvele ukuthi ayishumi kuphela asahloliwe ebhange i-Capitec, okuthiwa athathwa enxanxatheleni yezitolo i-Bridge City, KwaMashu, ngezibhelu zango-2021.Kuthe imantshi uMnuz Ashwin Singh isalalele lokho, uNaidoo waveza ukuthi icala seliza eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini nje, lisuswa eNkantolo yeMantshi yasePinetown. UNaidoo uthe izihlobo zikamsolwa ezisezikhundleni eziphezulu emaphoyiseni zazama ukuthi licishwe ohlwini lwamacala ayezolalelwa kuleya nkantolo."Noma ngingeke ngiveze okuningi ngalokhu kodwa esinye isihlobo sakhe sisebenza esiteshini samaphoyisa saseNanda, esinye sisebenza esiteshini saseMbilo,” kusho uNaidoo.IPHOYISA laseCato Manor, uConstable Minenhle Makhaye, livele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini, ecaleni lokusolwa ngokweba ikhadi lasebhange lomgilwa ngenkathi lilande imoto yakhe eyayiduniwe Isithombe: SIBONELO NGCOBOUbe eseveza umlando wokunyamalala kwamacala kamsolwa, athe nango-2021 ngezibhelu zokutapa, wabanjwa kwisivimbamgwaqo yinkampani yonogada ngaKwaMashu, ehamba ngemoto eyayinezimbobo zokudutshulwa.Bamsoka ukuthi wayekhothe amasica, engazazi nokuthi ungubani, egqoke umfaniswano wamaphoyisa, ephethe nesibhamu sombutho."Inkampani yonogada yamthatha isithombe, yayobika udaba lwakhe esiteshini samaphoyisa ePinetown. Baxakeka onogada uma sebeyobuza ngalelo cala emaphoyiseni ezinsukwini ezimbalwa ezilandelayo, sebethola ukuthi alikho ndawo icala."Ngiyazibuza nje ukuthi njengoba izihlobo zakhe zizame ukuthi icala lakhe lingaveli ohlwini lwamacala ePinetown, azenzanga yini okufanayo ukuthi kunyamalale lela cala lango-2021?” kusho uNaidoo. Unuke umsolwa ngokuba yisigebengu esicashe ngombutho wamaphoyisa.Ngesikhathi eqhulula amabhomu uNaidoo, umsolwa ubelokhu embuka, ebukeka efuthelana.Imantshi uSingh ukhombise ukushaqeka, ummeli kamsolwa uMnuz Zolani Duma ethi uNaidoo akamtshele ikheli lalapho ahlala khona."Ikheli lomphenyi alikaze lidalulwe enkantolo. Ayikho into eke idinge ukuthi umphenyi adalule ikheli lakhe,” kubabaza uSingh.NoNaidoo uthe: "Eminyakeni ewu-30 esengiyisebenze emaphoyiseni, ngiyaqala ukubuzwa ikheli lami.”Kubuye kwavela ukuthi ngo-2021, kukhona isehlo sokudubulana kwamaphoyisa nezigebengu ngasesibhedlela iNkosi Albert Luthuli, kwafa esisodwa, ezimbili zabaleka."Iphoyisa elinegama elifana ncamashi nelikamsolwa, kwavela ukuthi yilo elilekelele lezi zigebengu ukuthi zibaleke,” kusho uNaidoo.Uphinde waveza nokuthi umsolwa uwumuntu onomlando wokuphuza utshwala emsebenzini aphinde alove angabiki, abuye athi uyagula kangangoba, uboshwa nje, bekusaqhubeka uphenyo lwangaphakathi esiteshini ngaye."Okumangazayo ukuthi ngazo lezo zinsuku zokuphenywa kwakhe, kwashiswa ihhovisi kulesi siteshi elalinayo yonke imininingwane ebizosebenza uma esevela esigcawini wokuqondiswa ubugwegwe. Kwaphinde kwagqekezwa amahhovisi amaphoyisa amathathu abezoba sekhaleni lophenyo,” kusho uNaidoo othe kusazophenywa ukuthi umsolwa akathinteki yini kulokhu. Uphinde wathi nakuba esaboshelwe icala lokutholakala nekhadi lasebhange lomgilwa, bayaphenya ukuthi akabandakanyeki yini esigamekweni sokudunwa kwemoto, yize wayengekho kuso siqu sakhe.Echaza ngekhadi lomnikazi wemoto eyayiduniwe, kuthiwa wabanjwa nalo emva kokuvela kwe-video yakhe ekhokha ngalo esitolo esidayisa utshwala enxanxatheleni yezitolo eSouthway, eSeaview.Kuthiwa wayelithepha, njengoba lalivuma ukuthi enze lokhu uma ethenga izimpahla zika-R1 000 kuya phansi."Ukuze akwenze ngempumelelo lokhu, wakhokha izikhawu ezintathu ezahlukene kwaze kwaphelela u-R1 000. Wayazi ukuthi uma ethenga kanyekanye, ikhadi lizomfuna inombolo eyimfihlo,” kusho uNaidoo.Ezithethelela ngomlomo wommeli wakhe, uMakhaye uthe yena ngesikhathi ethatha ikhadi emotweni yomgilwa wayezitshela ukuthi ngelakhe.Uthe waze waqaphela emva kokuthenga ngalo utshwala, engasawutholi umbiko wasebhange kwiselula yakhe umazisa ukuthi usekhokhile. Uthe wazibuza waziphendula ukuthi ikhadi elikabani nokuthi ulithathephi.Ubuye wabalula indaba yakhe yokuphuza kakhulu utshwala, ethi yiyo edala angazikhumbuli ezinye izinto ukuthi zenzeke kanjani, wathi kodwa akasho ukuthi usola bona ngamacala abekwe wona. Uthe ubona kungaba yisu elikahle ukuthi avele abuyisele umgilwa u-R1 000 wakhe athenga ngawo utshwala enxanxatheleni yezitolo.Enkantolo kuhlaluke ukuthi usesebenze embuthweni iminyaka emihlanu. Kuthiwe unengane esencane ethembele kuye. Icala libuyela enkantolo ngo-Okthoba 28.

UMNYANGO wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal umise uthishanhloko wasesikoleni saseMnambithi, iDr Joseph Shabalala osanda kuphuma ngesamagundane ngesikhathi abazali befuna ukumudla luhlaza bemsola ngokudla isamba sikaR2.3 million. Okhulumela umnyango, uMnuz Muzi Mahlambi, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi uNkk Jabulile Mbhele unikezwe ikhefu ukuze kuphenywe. "Yebo umisiwe njengesinyathelo esinqala sokuthi umnyango uphenye ngezinsolo abekwa zona,” kuphetha uMahlambi. Ngesonto eledlule abazali bagasele kulesi sikole esiqanjwe ngomsunguli weLadysmith Black Mambazo befuna uNkk Mbhele nabanye othisha ukuba baphume baphele emagcekeni esikole. NgoMsombuluko baqungele imvula ebiyidliva baqhinqa ngaphandle kwesikole bangabhikisha kwazise bekukhona amaphoyisa abenkanise ngaphandle.Okhulumele abazali bakulesi sikole esasaziwa ngeKlipriver High ngaphambi kokuguqula igama ngo-2016, uMfu Lindokuhle Kubheka, uthe njengabazali bebehlele ukuyoyinyomfa ngoMsombuluko ukuze kuphazamiseke nokubhalwa kwezivivinyo zika-matric kodwa babuye bakuhoxisa lokho.UKubheka uthe izinkinga kulesi sikole ziqale ngesikhathi kutholakala ukuthi kunezindodla zemali ezehliswe ngomlenze nguthishanhloko uNkk Mbhele nabanye othisha.Uthe babizwa usihlalo wesigungu esilawula isikole ebazisa ukuthi kukhona okungahambi kahle esikoleni."NgoJanuwari uthishanhloko wasazisa ukuthi imali ekhona kwi-account yesikole ngu-R2.3 million. Kwathi uma sebebheka amabhuku ngo-Ephreli walo nyaka kwavela ukuthi sekusele u-R47 000." Uthe imali ibiphuma inikezwa abanye othisha njengemali-mboleko.Uthe uthishanhloko ubuye wathenga ibhasi lesikole ngemali ebalelwa kuR500 000 ngaphandle kokuthola igunya esigungwini sesikole, wathenga ifenisha yehhovisi lakhe ebiza uR75 000 ne-branding ka-R600 000. UKubheka uthe akunamanzi esikoleni kanti nogesi bewucishwa.Uthe njengamanje kunothisha nabanye abasebenzi basesikoleni ababhuquza emakhaya ngenxa yokungakhokhelwa ngoba ingasekho imali."Okwamanje kusetshenziswa imali yesabelo sezingane ezizobe zifunda ngonyaka ozayo."Uthe baze bathatha isinqumo sokugasela esikoleni ngoba bebona izikhalo zabo zingasukunyelwa.Kuze kwasiza ukutheleka kwabakwaSidlodlo abafike bashushumbisa uNkk Mbhele bambalekisa ngemoto yabo bedlula kubazali ebebethukuthele begane unwabu. Ngesikhathi eseshushumbiswa ngamaphoyisa, abazali nabanye abafundi bebekikiza bethakasela ukuthi useyahamba kulesi sikole. UNkk Mbhele uke waba yiMeya kuMasipala iNkosi Langalibalele.

Uthe ngokwazi kwakhe bebezoqeda ukubhala ngoNovemba.Uthe uthole ukuthi bebehambe beyisishiyagalombili, kanti kubona bekukhona abasesikoleni iNogabisela High neSandlwana High, wathi baneminyaka engu-13 no-14.Uthe kusukela kwenzeke isigameko, balokhu bevuka beza olwandle, ngethemba lokuthi uzotholakala umntanakhe.Iphini lemeya kuMasipala waseMlalazi, uMnuz Mbongeleni Ngema, lithe okubaphatha kabi ukuthi ukucingwa komfundi kumisiwe ngenxa yobubi besimo sezulu."Ulwandle lunamagagasi aphezulu futhi lugcolile. Abatshuzi bethu eMlalazi besebenzisana nabezinye izinhlangano bathe akuphephile ukuthi baqhubeke nokucinga,” kusho uNgema.Uthe bayakhathazeka ngokuqhubeka kwezinsuku umfundi engatholakele.Uthe bezwile kancane kukhulunywa eyokuthi abafundi bebeyobungaza ukuqeda ukubhala kodwa abangakuqondi ngoba bekungakaqedwa ukubhala."Sikholwa ukuthi bavele bahlangana, bayozijabulela olwandle. Sikhathazwa ukuthi bebengacelanga imvume kubazali,” kusho uNgema, othe bayawukhuza lo mkhuba ezinganeni.Wathi noma sekuqedwe ngempela ukubhala, bayayikhuza eyemibungazo yokuqeda ukubhala ngoba ivame ukuphetha kabi.Zivame ukwanda izigameko zokufa kwabafundi uma kuqedwa ukubhalwa. Kwesinye esenzeka eNewcastle nyakenye, kwafa abafundi abathathu, imoto ababehamba ngayo ibandakanyeka engozini.Kwezinye izigameko zaphambilini, abafundi baye bashone bebulawa izidakamizwa ezingaziwa abasuke bezisebenzisa kuleyo mibungazo. Kwesinye izigameko esenzeka e-Eastern Cape, kwafa abangu-21 endaweni yokucima ukoma, nakhona babebungaza ukuqeda ukubhala.

Ngokwesitatimende esidluliselwe kwabezindaba esibhalwe yiNkosi yesizwe sakwaButhelezi, uMntwana uNtuthokoyesizwe Zuzifa Buthelezi ongumfowabo, kuvela ukuthi bekusaphele isonto engeniswe esibhedlela e-Cape Town emva kokuxinwa ukugula, okumbambe ngesikhathi ehambele ukuhlala kwePhalamende. Nakuba impilo yakhe beyintekenteke kule minyaka ngenxa yokugula kodwa lokhu okubuhlungu kangaka kwenzeke ngokushesha singakulindele,” kubhalwe esitatimendeni.Ubewumntwana omncane kunabo bonke, kubantwana abayisishiyagalombili abazalwa wuMntwana uMangosuthu Buthelezi noNdlunkulu u-Irene Audrey Thandekile Buthelezi. Ukudlula kwakhe emhlabeni kusikhumbuza ukuzinikela komndeni wakwaButhelezi ekulweleni impilo engcono kubantu nenkululeko.”I-ActionSA KwaZulu-Natal nayo idlulise amazwi enduduzo emndenini wakwaButhelezi.I-NFP ithe izomkhumbula njengoba ebewukhuthalele umphakathi abewusebenzela.I-EFF KwaZulu-Natal nayo ithumele amazwi enduduzo, ifisela umndeni ukuqina kulesi simo obhekene naso.Kubikwa ukuthi unkonzo yomngcwabo wakhe izokuban ngoMgqibelo ekuseni KwaPhindangene.

SEKUNTWELA ezansi ngokuthi uDiwali ube yiholidi eNingizimu Afrika njengoba kuleli sonto izinhlangano ezazilwela ukuthi lolu suku lube yiholidi zithole impendulo yokuthi uMnyango wezaseKhaya uzolubhekisisa.Ngaphambi kokuthi usuku lwenziwe iholidi uMnyango wezaseKhaya uye udlulisele lolo daba kuMengameli ukuze aluse ePhalamende nasesizweni sonke ukuba siphawule ngalo. SIKHALE ngomlando wodlame kumsolwa isihlobo sowesifazane waKwaNoganga, eHarding, obulawe ngesihluku, eshawa ngensimbi, washokhwa nangogesi ngoMgqibelo.Umufi, uNksz Hlengiwe "Mahlengi" Sikosana (24) kuthiwa utholwe esethule endlini kamsolwa, obeyisoka lakhe eMkangala.Ngokusho kwesihlobo esicele ukuthi singadalulwa, umufi ubulawe ngesikhathi evakashele isoka lakhe okuvela ukuthi lingusomatekisi endaweni."Ngishayelwe ucingo yisihlobo sithi siqeda kuthola ucingo kumakhelwane kamsolwa, esitshela ukuthi othandiweyo wethu usebulelwe ngumsolwa ngesihluku,” kusho isihlobo.Sithe abasheshe baphuthuma endaweni yesigameko, bazithele phezu kwensimbi okuvele ukuthi umsolwa ubemgqema ngayo umzimba wonke umufi, sathi babuye bathola nokuthi uphinde wamthela nangamanzi umzimba wonke ngaphambi kokuba amshokhe ngezintambo ezivulekile (open wire) zikagesi ezificwe endaweni yesigameko."Ngesikhathi etholwa, umsolwa ubesekhale wemuka. Besisalindele lukhulu kuye,” kubeka isihlobo.Sithe sifuna ukubona amaphoyisa elima indima yawo ekuboshweni kukamsolwa njengoba bengazimisele ngokuzithathela umthetho ngezandla njengomndeni.

IZOBHUNGWA emkhandlwini wokuxazulula ungqingetshe nezivuka emaminithini ngaphansi kukahulumeni wokubambisana kwamaqembu iGovernment of National Unity (GNU), eyemithetho yezwe okunemvunge ngayo, neyenguyazana ngesimo sezwe.Kulo mkhandlu kuzobhungwa nangazo zonke ezinye izinselelo ngaphansi kwalo hulumeni ohlanganisa amaqembu angu-10, abambisene.Lokhu kudalulwe yihhovisi lePhini likaMengameli wezwe uMnuz Paul Mashatile, elingumholi wezamabhizinisi kahulumeni ePhalamende.Indaba yomthetho wezikole osuse umsindo usayinwa muva nje, iBela ngenye yezinto okuzobhungwa ngazo emhlanganweni womkhandlu ozoba ngelizayo.UMashatile uthe babe nomhlangano wokuqala womkhandlu kuleli sonto. Uthe umkhandlu wasungulwa nguMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, ukuze kuxazululwe izinkinga ezikhona kwiGNU."Emhlanganweni wokuqala esibe nawo kubekwe uhlaka lwemigomo okuzosetshenzwa ngayo ezogunyazwa emhlanganweni ozoba ngoLwesine, ePhalamende. Kwenzeka lokhu nje iGNU ibigubha izinsuku ezingu-100 ibambisene kuhulumeni.Amaqembu ngokwehlukana kwawo aveze izinto ezenziwe ngalesi sikhashana engene emandleni ikakhulu lawo abambisene.Amanye aphikisayo asaqhubeka nokugxeka uhulumeni wokubambisana.Iqembu eliphikisayo ePhalamende iMK, lithe ukufika kwalo emuva kokhetho, kuhlalise ngesinqa esisodwa uhulumeni wokubambisana, kwabavusa emaqandeni ongqongqoshe.Lithe ngesikhathi i-MK ingakafiki, ongqongqoshe bebezenzela umathanda.Lichithe ukuthi kukhona okuhle okwenziwe uhulumeni wokubambisana.

Benze umsebenzi oncomekayo, benza lokho,” kusho uDuma.Uthe kulesi sikhathi esinzima, ufisa imindeni yabafi iduduzeke njengoba ibeka endaweni yokugcina abathandiweyo babo.Kulo mngwabo bekukhona namaphoyisa omgwaqo asaqeqeshwayo, okuthiwa azojoyina asenesikhathi endimeni yezokuphepha.UDuma uphinde washayela ihlombe izinhlaka ezehlukene zomphakathi ngokuhlanganyela nomnyango ukududuza imindeni elahlekelwe.Esigamekweni esadlula nemimphefumulo yabafi yayibandakanya iToyota Avanza ababehamba ngayo neloli okuthiwa kwashayisana mahlanze, kwashona abayisishiyagalombili.
UMENGAMELI we-IFP, uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa, usephumele obala wathi uNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, akaphindeli esikhundleni sakhe sokuba yimeya kuMasipala iKing Cetshwayo.UHlabisa uthe uNtuli ungundunankulu wesifundazwe ngakho akukho ukubuyela emuva eKing Cetshwayo.Ukusho lokhu kulandela imibiko yangempelasonto eveze ukuthi asikavalwa isikhala sakhe ngenxa yokuthi umathintanyawo ngohulumeni wokubambisana ukuthi ungase uwe bhu, bese ehlala engenaso isikhundla."Ngiyawuqinisekisa umphakathi ukuthi akukho ukubuyela kukaNtuli eKing Cetshwayo. Wahamba kulo masipala njengoba engundunankulu, uzobusa iminyaka emihlanu. Kukhona ibamba lemeya, awukho umbango, silandela imigomo ebekiwe yokuqoka imeya entsha. Uhlelo lokuqoka imeya seluya ngasemaphethelweni. Okusijabulisayo ngukuthi ibamba lemeya liyasebenza, lisemphakathini, liyaqhubeka nomsebenzi omuhle oshiywe nguNtuli.”UHlabisa uthe uNtuli ushiye umbiko wokusebenza kwezimali zomphakathi.Uthe maduzane bazowazisa umphakathi ngokuzokwenzeka eKing Cetshwayo.Mayelana nengqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi kwi-IFP, uthe uhlelo lokuphothula ucwaningo lwamagatsha kumele luphothulwe ngoDisemba.Uveze ukuthi ngoJanuwari usuke unzima, ngakho kubukeka ingqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi izobanjwa ngaphambi kwezinyanga ezingu-12, kuzoba nokhetho lohulumeni basekhaya."Sibheke ukuthi le ngqungquthela ibe kusuka kuJuni, Julayi noma ngo-Agasti, ngonyaka ozayo. Ngeke udlule u-Agasti ingabanjwanga le ngqungquthela ngoba kumele silungiselele ukhetho,” kusho uHlabisa.Uveze ukuthi ngoMashi 21, ngonyaka ozayo, kuzoba nomgubho obalulekile nomkhulu wokubungaza iminyaka engu-50, leli qembu likhona."Amaqembu amaningi uma egubha iminyaka engu-50, asuke esezoba ngumlando ngeqhaza alibambile. Siyiqembu abantu abathembele kulona nabahlale befuna ukwazi ukuthi kwenzakalani kulona ngenxa yokuthi liphethe isifundazwe,” kusho uHlabisa.Uthe bafuna ukwandisa omasipala abazophathwa yileli qembu kuleli.
WAYENGAZIBONI ephila ngokupheka uNksz Nompumelelo "Mpruedie” Nkosi (30), oseyisilomo sokupheka ezinkundleni zokuxhumana.UNksz Nkosi odume ngelika Mpruedie utshele Isolezwe ukuthi wafundiswa ngukhulu wakhe ukupheka ngoba wayetshelwa ukuthi intombazane kufanele ikwazi ukupheka."Ngikhule ugogo engifundisa ukupheka ngoba bekuyimina ngedwa intombazane. Ngangingazi ukuthi ngelinye ilanga ngizoziphilisa ngokupheka ngoba kwakungeyona into engangiyikhonzile. Ngangipheka ngoba ugogo wayethi kufanele abantu balale bedlile ngakho intombazane ayipheke.”Uthe njengoba esephila ngokupheka, uyambonga ukhulu wakhe ngoba izinto amfundisa zona sezimngenisela imali.Le ntokazi yakwa-E eMlaza, ithe yafunda e-Interfellowship Christian School, yabe isidlulela eMangosuthu University of Technology lapho yenza khona izifundo ze-Financial Accounting kodwa yazishiya phakathi ingasenayo imali yokuqhubeka, yabe isidlulela eNyuvesi yaKwaZulu-Natal iyokwenza ezeCriminology kodwa nazo yazishiya phakathi emuva kokuphelelwa yimali.Ibe isizama amatoho, yashaya umshini kwesinye isitolo esidayisa ukudla nezimpahla zokugqoka yadlulela nakuma-call centre ahlukene.Ithe ibikuthanda ukuba sezinkundleni zokuxhumana yenze amahlaya kanti iqale izidlalela ukufaka izithombe zokudla."Ngiqale ngifaka amahlaya ezinkundleni zokuxhuma ngase ngishintsha ngifaka izithombe zokudla engikuphekayo ngoba ngiye ngasuka ekhaya ngaya eGoli, ngahlala nabangani. Kuthe ngo-Agasti wonyaka odlule ngafuna indawo yami nginethemba lokuthi uNkulunkulu uzongisiza ngala mavidiyo okupheka engiwafaka ezinkundleni zokuxhumana.”Uthe uma esepheka uye achazele umuntu ukusuka nokuhlala kokudla akuphekayo, amkhombise eqoba, asho izithako azisebenzisayo, aze aveze noma ukudla sekuvuthiwe."Kubalulekile ukufaka amavidiyo njalo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana. Uma ungumuntu othanda ukupheka faka amavidiyo okupheka ukuze uhehe abantu ozosebenzisana nabo. Njengamanje sengisebenzisana nezinkampani zokudla ezihlukene ezabona umsebenzi wami ezinkundleni zokuxhumana. Okungisebenzelayo wukungayeki ukufaka amavidiyo. Ngisho ngigodukile ngiye ngifake okungenani amavidiyo amathathu ngesonto.”Uthe njengamanje useyakwazi ukuziphilisa ngalokhu, uncome nokuchuma kwezinkundla zokuxhumana njengenye yezinto eyenze impilo yakhe yangcono.Ukusebenzisana nezinkampani ezikhiqiza okuphathelene nokudla, ngenye yezinto emfakela imali. Kodwa uthi nazo zisebenzisana naye nje yingoba zazibona amavidiyo akhe nenqwaba yabalandeli asenabo.UMpruedie uzobe eyingxenye yabapheki abazohambela umbukiso wosomabhizinisi obizwa ngeSouth Regional Durban Business Fair ozobe usenxanxatheleni yezitolo, KwaMnyandu, eMlaza.Lo mbukiso uzoqala ngo-Okthoba 24 uphele ngo-Okthoba 27.Kuzobe kunesithangami sokucobelelana ngolwazi esibizwa ngeCo-operative Development Indaba nezithangami zokupheka nokunye okuningi.Ukubekisa isikhala kwiBusiness Indaba, ungathinta uNksz Thandekile Tembe [email protected] noma ushayele u-031 322 9686.

SEBESOLA igama lesiNgisi okwaqanjwa ngalo isikole iFranklin, eKokstad, eNingizimu yeKwaZulu-Natal ukuthi kungenzeka ukuthi linomthelela ekwehliseni izinga lesikole osekuholele ekutheni singahlomuli ngendlela efanele kwisabelomali sonyaka kuhulumeni. Umlando waso uveza ukuthi siyisikole esizimele esasifunda amakhaladi ngezikhathi zobandlululo.Lokhu kudalulwe uthishanhloko wesikole i-Franklin High, uMnuz Bambezakhe Mbutho, emcimbini wokuthandazela izingane njengoba zilungiselela izivivinyo zika-matric eziqale namhlanje.Lo mcimbi ubuhanjelwe uNobhala we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Bheki Mtolo, obegqugquzela abafundi ukuthi bazimisele kwezemfundo baphase ngamalengiso nalapho ephinde wabapha nezijumbana zokudla njengoba abanye bebekhempe ezikoleni belungiselela izivivinyo.Uhambo lukaMtolo luqale esikoleni samabanga aphakeme eKokstad, iShayamoya.Ethula inkulumo yakhe kulo mkhuleko, uMbutho ukhale kakhulu ngengcindezi abanayo yokuhlomula emalini kahulumeni njengoba ethi esikoleni sakhe kufundwa mahhala, izidingo zaso zibhekelwa ngemali kahulumeni."Inkinga esinayo nje ukuthi thina kulesi sikole sabekwa ngaphansi kwezikole ezisezingeni lesithathu esikhundleni sokuba sezingeni lokuqala njengoba kuyisikole somphakathi ohlwempu, isikole sasemapulazini lesi lapho abantu bakhona bephila ngemali yesibonelelo sikahulumeni, abanye basebenza emapulazini,” kusho uMbutho.Uthe noma kunjalo bayaxoxisana nabazali kubekhona imali abayikhiphayo njengoba leyo abayithola kuhulumeni ingafiki ngesikhathi futhi ingalingene izidingo zabo ngenxa yokuthi babekwa ezingeni okungesilona elesikole.UMbutho udalule ukuthi sebebhalele uMnyango wezeMfundo eMgungundlovu kaningana, bekhala ngalolu daba kodwa abakaze bathole impendulo kumbe kufike umuntu ozophenya ngodaba lwesikole. Uthe kwafika umlungu thizeni kwangaba khona ukulandeleka kodaba."Esikhundleni salokho kuvela ukuthi siyisikole samakhaladi futhi sesisola ukuthi naleli gama lesikole iFranklin, kungenzeka ukuthi linomthelela kodwa thina siyisikole sabantu abadla imbuya ngothi,” kusho uMbutho.Okhulumela umnyango wezeMfundo uMnuz Muzi Mahlambi, uthe isikhalo sesikole bazosidlulisela kwababhekele ukuhlela emnyangweni ukuze basicubungule kabanzi, bese belungisa.Uthe phambilini bekwenzeka uthole ukuthi kukhona ukukleliswa kwezikole ngendlela engafanele."Bekuthi uma isikhalo esifuze lesi sesifike emnyangweni, sisisukumele bese siyalungisa,” kusho uMahlambi.

UMLINGISI wodumo lakwiRed Ink ne-Outlaws, uNirvana Nokwe-Mseleku usenikele ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, wagonyuluka ngesigameko athi senzeke esemsebenzini, sokuhlukunyezwa ngothile ayesebenza naye. Lokhu kuza ngemva kweziqephu ezisanda kukhonjiswa emdlalweni wakwiSABC 1 iSkeem Saam, ezishiye abaningi bengawuvali umlomo futhi benemibono ehlukene ngazo.Embhalweni awufake ekhasini lakhe lakwi-X, uNirvana uthe iziqephu zeSkeem Saam yizona ezenze wabona kufanele naye ukuthi akhulume ngokwamehlela. Uthe walivula icala malungana nokwamehlela, wayiswa eziteshini zamaphoyisa ezinhlanu, ngenhlanhla kuzona zonke lwezwakala udaba lwakhe, ngaphandle kwesisodwa lapho engasizakalanga khona.Uthe okumphatha kabi kakhulu ngalokhu wukuthi ayekucelile ukuthi elulekwe ngokumehlele futhi nokuthi lowo othintekayo esigamekweni axolise ngokwenzeka, kugcine kungenzekanga."Lesi simo siveza ubunjalo bezingqinamba esibhekana nazo kule ndima nasezweni lonkana, futhi sibeka obala ubumqoka bokuziveza ukuze kubuyiswe ubuntu ebantwini,” usho kanje uNirvana.UNirvana uveze nokuthi isehlakalo sithikameze ukuzethemba kwakhe futhi senza azizwe engaphephile uma esemsebenzini, nokuthi kwamdumaza ukuthi abantu abengamele lolu daba bakhombisa ukulukhahlela ngezinyawo, balufela ngamathe.Enaba ngokwamehlela, uthe yena nozakwabo amsolayo babenza isiqephu eseyamene nocansi, wamchazela ngezindawo ayengafuni ukuthi amthinte kuzona, nayengamthinta kuzona. Uthe wamchazela ngokucacile ukuthi angamthinti emathangeni. Uthi kwathi sebesebenza, uzakwabo lowo wawephula umgomo ayembekele wona, wamthinta ezindaweni okungafanele azithinte lokho kwenza wazizwa edelelekile futhi ehlukumezeke kakhulu."Lesi sigameko senzeka kusebusuku ngaleli langa esasisebenza ngaso, esikhathini lapho okwakulindeleke khona ukuthi wonke umuntu enze izinto ngendlela efanele nenenhlonipho. Sobabili sasikuqonda ngokuphelele okufanele nokungafanele,” usho kanje.Uthe okumcika kakhulu wukuthi uzakwabo wakhuluma ngendlela ' ebolile’ ngemuva kwalokhu. Uthe wathi kuyena 'abasiqhubeze’ lesi siqephu ababesiqopha. Ngamanye amazwi wayesefuna ukuthi benze abebekwenza kulesi siqephu okwangempela.
ZICELA enkulungwaneni izikhungo ezithathwa njengeziyingozi eziphucwe igunya lokubhalisa izivivinyo zika-matric kuleli.Izivivinyo kulezi zikhungo zizokwenganyelwa wuMnyango weMfundo eyisiSekelo ngenxa yezehlakalo zokukopela kwabafundi kuzona.Umqondisi jikelele emnyangweni, uMnuz Mathanzima Mweli, uveze ukuthi zingu-987 lezi zikhungo kuleli.Uthe lezi zikhungo zisengozini yokuthi kukotshelwe kuzona yingakho beziphuce igunya lokuthi zizibhalisele izivivinyo."Izivivinyo kulezi zikhungo zenganyelwe ngumnyango ukuze kungabikhona izehlakalo zokukopela. Ezinye zazo siziklelise zaba sengozini yokubhalisa lezi zivivinyo ngoba zizobe ziqala ukwengamela izivivinyo, ngakho asizazi ukuthi ziphethwe kanjani.” Ukusho lokhu ekhuluma esithangamini sabezindaba ePitoli, izolo, ngamalungiselelo okubhalwa kuka-matric.UNgqongqoshe walo mnyango, uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, uxwayise abafundi ukuthi bangakopeli.Uthe uma bekopela bazibeka engcupheni yokuthi bangayitholi imiphumela yabo.Kulesi sithangami kuvele nokuthi kuzosiza nombutho wezokuvikela ukuhambisa amaphepha ka-matric ezikoleni uma kwenzeka kuba nezinhlekelele ezifana nezikhukhula njengoba kuqale ukubhala.UNksz Gwarube uthe lezi zivivinyo zibaluleke kakhulu yingakho kunokubambisana nezinhlaka kanjalo neminyango ehlukene."Siqaphe ngelokhozi isimo ikakhulu uma kuba nezinhlekelele. Asifuni kube nokuphazamiseka kwabafundi ngenxa yesimo sezulu.”UDkt Reginah Mhaule oyiPhini likaNgqongqoshe walo mnyango, uthe baqaphe isimo ikakhulu KwaZulu-Natal, nase-Eastern Cape, lapho kungase kube khona isimo esingesihle sezulu."KwaZulu-Natal kungenzeka kube nemvula ehambisana nezikhukhula ngakho umbutho wezokuvikela umi ngomumo ukufaka isandla. Lo mbutho uzohambisa amaphepha nangezindiza ezinophephela emhlane,” kusho uDkt Mhaule.UMweli uthe basibheka nsuku zonke isimo sezulu njengoba kubhalwa."Ngiyingxenye yabantu abahlala ethimbeni lezinhlekelele ukuze siqaphe isimo sezulu ngaso sonke isikhathi. Zibaluliwe zonke izinhlelo zokusiza uma kwenzeka kuba nezinhlekelele.” UNksz Gwarube uveze ukuthi bangu-727 121 abafundi ababhala ngokugcwele kuthi abangu-155 215, babhala ngasese.Lokhu kusho ukuthi bangu-882 336 ababhala u-matric.Uveze ukuthi bangu-16 400 ababhala izivivinyo zasezikoleni ezizimele ezaziwa nge-IEB.UDkt Barney Mthembu ongumqondisi jikelele obhekele uhlelo lokufunda emnyangeni, uveze ukuthi abafundi ababhalayo bakhahlanyezwa wubhubhane iCovid-19.Uthe ngo-2020, la bafundi babenza uGrade 8 okuyisikhathi lapho leli gciwane lalidlange khona. Kulesi sithangami kuvele nokuthi azobe eqashwe ngelokhozi amaloli azobe ehambisa amaphepha.Kunxuswe nomphakathi ukuthi ungadubeli ezivivinyweni ngokuthi ubhikishe ukhala ngezidingo."Umphakathi unelungelo lokubhikisha kodwa siyawunxusa ukuthi ungaphazamisi izivivinyo. Nginxusa nozakwethu ePhalamende nakumaqembu aphikisayo ukuthi bangagcaluzi ezikoleni beyohlola ukubhalwa kuka-matric kuze kuphothulwe ngoba asifuni abafundi baphazamiseke,” kusho uNksz Gwarube.
UMPHENYI wecala lokubulawa kowayengunozinti we-Orlando Pirates neBafana Bafana, uSenzo Meyiwa, uBrigadier Bongani Gininda, uphinde wakuqinisekisa ukuthi ababephakathi endlini ngosuku okwabulawa ngalo, abanacala. UGininda ungomunye wofakazi ababalulekile kuleli cala eliqulwa eNkantolo eNkulu ePitoli.Uthe ucingo lukaKelly Khumalo olwantshontshwa ngabasolwa nolibofuzo olwathathwa esigqokweni esashiwa ngabasolwa kwaqinisekisa ukuthi akekho owayesendlini kubasolwa.ISIGQOKO okusolwa ukuthi sashiwa ngababulali bakaSenzo Meyiwa Isithombe:SIGCINIWE Uthe waqhathanisa ulibofuzo lwabantu ababesendlini kwatholakala ukuthi ulibofuzo lwasesigqokweni luyabaphika ababesendlini. Uthe isampula likaZandile latholakala esivalweni seSmirnof kuphela kanti olukaGladness Khumalo latholakala esicabheni. Uthe kubantu abakhishiwe kuwo wonke amasampula ngoKelly Khumalo, Tumelo Madlala, Mthokozisi Khumalo noLongwe Twala.Uthe phakathi kwezinto azithola edokodweni ezamenza wabona ukuthi kukhona abangena endlini, ukuvela kombiko wokwebiwa kweselula kaKelly Khumalo.Uthe ngokombiko wenkampani yamaselula, kwavela ukuthi wonke amaselula ababesendlini, ayedonsa embhoshongweni owodwa, emva kwesigameko futhi wonke ayedonsa embhoshongweni osesibhedlela okwayiswa kuso uMeyiwa, kodwa iselula eyantshontshwa kaKelly, yona yabe isidonsa embhoshongweni iMoleleki. Ebalula amaphoyisa amhlamuka ngamagama, uthe uWarrant Officer Meshack Makhubu, noCaptain Joyce Buthelezi, wathi yibo ababengayikholwa eyokuhlasela kwabasolwa.Uveze ukuthi amaphoyisa amabili, agcina ekulaxaza ukusebenza naye, ngale ngokumtshela ngokusemthethweni."Kwavele kwahlukana inhloko nesixhanti, kwagcina kuvulwa idokodo lesibili, u-375 ngo-2019,” kusho uGininda.Uthe kwathi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi wathola ukuthi leli dokodo lavulwa uMakhubu.Eqhubeka nokubalula ezinye zezinto ezamenza wabona ukuthi kukhona abasolwa abangena endlini, kwaba ukungatholakali kolibofuzo lwababesendlini esigqokweni okuthiwa sawa kumsolwa.Uveze ukuthi ne-tracker yemoto kaLongwe Twala yaveza ukuthi wasuka nababesendlini walibangisa esibhedlela. "Nesibhamu sikaSello Twala (uyise kaLongwe owayesendlini), sathi uma sihlolwa, kwatholakala ukuthi asihambisani negobolondo lenhlamvu elatholwa endlini,” usho kanje.UBrig Gininda uthe wake wezwa ukuthi uMnuz Hlophe wathi watshelwa Tumelo Madlala (ongumngani kaSenzo owayesendlini) ukuthi uSenzo wadubuleka ngephutha kodwa lokhu uTumelo wakuphika. Ubuye waveza ukuthi ngesikhathi ummangalelwa wokuqala, uMuzikawukhulelwa Sibiya evuma icala, waveza nokuthi bona bambulala uMeyiwa, bethengwe intombi yakhe uKelly."Lokhu wakusho esiteshini samaphoyisa eVosloorus, ngaphambi kokuba adluliselwe kuColonel Mbotho,” kusho uGininda.Uthe lokhu kuvuma icala, kwahambisana nokukhomba kwakhe indawo yesigameko, athi uSibiya wathi, yize engeke alazi ngekhanda ikheli lendawo yesigameko kodwa angakwazi ukuyibona, nowakwenza ngempela ngesikhathi kuthiwa akayoyikhomba.
USOMLANDO onezincwadi ezilanda izingxabo zobukhosi kwaZulu, uSolwazi Jabulani Maphalala, uthi kukhona okushaya amanzi ngokuqhubeka kwesizwe samaHlubi ukulwela ukuthi inkosi yawo ibe sezingeni lobuNgonyama.UMaphalala ubephawula ngamathuba empumelelo esicelo amaHlubi asifake eNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo esizolalelwa namhlanje sokuthi Inkosi uMzwenkosi Johannes Hadebe (iNkosi uLangalibalele II) ibe yiSilo.Esicelweni sawo, amaHlubi athi Inkosi Langalibalele II ifanelwe ukuba yiSilo ngoba iphethe izizwe eziningi ezikhonza ngaphansi kwayo.Kodwa uMaphalala uthi umlando uyawaphikisa amaHlubi."Abakaze babe neNgonyama. Angazi ukuthi igunya lokuthi bayiNgonyama balithathaphi. Angazi ukuthi bazofike bathini enkantolo kodwa akukho lutho okuyisimanga okuvelayo emlandweni wabo.”UMaphalala uthe ngesikhathi iSilo uShaka kaSenzangakhona sibumba isizwe samaZulu, sawagwinya amaHlubi."ILembe lalibathatha labo abangalilwisi, babe yingxenye kaZulu. Akuzange kube nempi eyayiziwombe, lapho babebiza iSilo uShaka iqhude. Bazingenela bona ngaphansi kombuso kaZulu.”UMaphalala, owacwaninga ngomlando wamaHlubi encwadini yakhe ethi "Umlando Wamakhosi eSifundazweni saKwaZulu-Natal” (Umqulu I), uthe emva kokuba amaHlubi esekhonza kwaZulu, aba nebutho okwakuthiwa iZinyendane zikaNandi."Babefaka amabheshu amade ayakhiwe ngesikhumba sembuzi. Babelwa njengawo wonke amaZulu uma kunezimpi.”UMaphalala uthe amaHlubi aseke ammema izikhawu ezintathu emigubhweni yesizwe. Kukule migubho lapho athi wafike wawatshela amaHlubi ukuthi awakaze abe nobuNgonyama."Kwaba sengathi bayangizwa. Angazi ukuthi ngubani lo osebafake lo moya njengoba sebeqhubeka nje.” Imigubho emikhulu yamaHlubi yenziwa eMahlutshini, eMtshezi, nokuyilapho kunesigodlo esikhulu sesizwe.Akusikhona okokuqala amaHlubi efaka isicelo sobuNgonyama.Afaka isicelo sobuNgonyama ngesikhathi kunekhomishana eyayiholwa uSolwazi Thandabantu Nhlapho, eyayiphenya ngobukhosi bomdabu.Ikhomishini kaNhlapho yathola ukuthi ziyisikhombisa izizwe ezinobuNgonyama kuleli. KwaZulu-Natal kwavela ubukhosi bukaZulu kuphela obunobuNgonyama.Ayengu-11 amakhosi alapha KwaZulu-Natal ayefake izicelo zobuNgonyama ngesikhathi kunekhomishini kaNhlapho.Izicelo zala makhosi zacasula iSilo esesakhothama uGoodwill Zwelithini kaBhekuzulu, owafanisa isenzo samakhosi nokuvukela umbuso kaZulu.UMaphalala uthe la makhosi ayevele edlala ngegeja kuziliwe."Nalapho ngawakhuza lawo makhosi. Kubukeka sengathi kukhona abantu ababehamba bethembisa amakhosi ubuNgonyama ngesikhathi kunekhomishini. Ukhona impela umuntu owayepheka lelo bhodwe.”
KUNXUSWA amahlelo ahlukene ukuthi akhulekele abafundi baKwaZulu-Natal, abaqala izivivinyo zika-matric ngoMsombuluko.Leli khwelo lihlatshwe yinhloko yomnyango wezeMfundo esifundazweni, uMnuz Nathi Ngcobo.UNgcobo unxuse abamabandla ukuthi kule mpelasonto bakhulekele laba bafundi abazobhala."Abafundi abaphume baye emahlelweni ahlukene bedlubhe umfaniswano wabo ngale mpelasonto ukuze bayokhulekelwa. Akukhulekelwe ukuthi babhale kahle izivivinyo,” kusho uNgcobo.Usho lokhu nje izolo kube nemicimbi ezifundazweni ezehlukene lapho abafundi abazobhala bebesayina khona isibopho sokuthi ngeke bakopele.Lesi sibopho abasisayina minyaka yonke, sihlose ukuthi sibuyise onembeza kulabo abazolingeka bakopele uma sekubhalwa.UNgqongqoshe weMfundo eyisiSekelo kuzwelonke uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, unxuse abafundi ukuthi baziphathe kahle uma sebebhala.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma emcimbini wokusayinwa kwalesi sibopho, ePretoria Central High.Ufundele abafundi bakulesi sikole isibopho lapho bebelibeka ngembaba elokuthi ngeke bazibandakanye nezehlakalo ezingalungile ngalesi sikhathi.Abazali banxuswe ukuthi behlise nomsebenzi abawunika abafundi abazobhala. Banxuswe nokuthi babeseke ngalesi sikhathi esinzima.USihlalo wekomiti lezeMfundo ePhalamende uNksz Joy Maimela, ufisele ukubhala okuhle abakwa-matric. Unxuse uwonke wonke ukuthi weseke abafundi abazobhala wathi yisikhathi esinzima kubona."Yisikhathi esibucayi nesifaka ingcindezi ngoba ufunda iminyaka engu-12, bese kudingeka ubhale lezi zivivinyo. Abafundi badinga ukwesekwa kakhulu ngalesi sikhathi.”KwaZulu-Natal kwenziwe izinhlelo zokusiza kungaphazamiseki izivivinyo uma kwenzeka kuba nezinhlekelele ezifana nezimvula ezihambisana nezikhukhula.Izimoto ezingama-4x4 zizobe zimi ngomumo ukusiza zifinyelele ezikoleni okuzoba nzima ukuya kuzona uma kwenzeka kuba nezimvula.Kunxuswe nomphakathi ukuthi ungadubeli ezivivinyweni ngoba kukhona izinto ongeneme ngazo ezithinta intuthuko.Abezomthetho bazobe besiqaphe ngelokhozi isimo njengoba kuqala lezi zivivinyo.Abafundi banxuswe ukuthi baphumule, bangazigxishi kakhulu ngencwadi.Banxuswe nokuthi balale ngokwanele, bahlele indlela yokufunda kuye ngokuthi isiphi isifundo abazosibhala. NgoMsombuluko kuqalwa ngephepha lesithathu lesiNgisi, bese ntambama kubhalwe iphepha lesithathu lesiBhunu.

UNOBUHOLI obusha umkhandlu wamabandla eNingizimu Afrika kulandela ingqungquthela yamabandla okukhethwa kuyona ubuholi esongwe.UMbhishobhi Sithembele Anton Sipuka ukhethwe waba umengameli omusha weSouth African Council of Churches engena endaweni ka-Archbishop (Dr) Thabo Makgoba.Iphini likamengameli lokuqala, uNksz Lulama Ntuta we-Anglican Church of Southern Africa, elesibili nguMfundisi (Dr) Nioma Venter weDutch Reformed Church.UMfundisi Mzwandile Molo weMethodist Church of Southern Africa, ukhuphukele kwesikanobhala ebesiphethwe uMbhishobhi Malusi Mpumlwana osethatha umhlalaphansi.Ingqungquthela ibiseKempton Park, eKurhuleni eGauteng.Enkulumweni yakhe yokuvalelisa, uMakgoba ubonge uMpumlwana ngokuzinikela kwakhe emsebenzini kaNkulunkulu nowezwe ngomzabalazo wezitshudeni ngeminyaka yo-1960."Usize kakhulu ekutheni nathi sibe nezwi elibalulekile uma kudingidwa izinto ezithinta izwe. Ngibonga nawe Molo ngobukwenza umeseka futhi ngiyakuhalalisela esikhundleni sakho esisha,” kusho uMakgoba.Ukhuthaze izithunywa zamabandla ebezikule ngqungquthela wathi kumele ziqinisekise ukuthi iyakhulunywa eyentsha ebhuquza emakhaya ngenxa yokuntula imisebenzi.Ubalule nokuthi qhaza lini elingabanjwa yibandla ekutheni kunakekelwe izidingo zabesifazane, izingane, abaphila nokukhubazeka nabathandana nabobulili obufana nobabo.UMakgoba uthe esinye sezinqumo okumele sithathwe wumkhandlu esokuthi kuqalwe uhlelo lokweseka ngokusemthethweni izwe iPalestine."Kumele siqhamuke nezinhlelo ezizolekelela ekutheni kukhululeke abantu basePalestine ngokuthi sibhekane nalabo abahlinzeka izwe i-Israel ngezikhali. Elinye lamazwe eseka i-Israel, yi-United States, okuyiyona ephethe ukhiye wokunqanda le lizwe ekutheni lime ekuqotheni abantu basePalistine,” kusho uMakgoba.

UPHIKO oluphenya amacala athinta inkohlakalo i-Special Investigating Unit, luthi longe u-R8 billion onyakeni wezimali u-2023/2024, okuthiwa kuwumphumela wokusheshiswa kophenyo emacaleni nokuqoqa imali esuke ikhwatshanisiwe.Inhloko yophiko u-Advocate Andy Mothibi, ngesikhathi yethula umbiko phambi kwekomiti elibhekelele ubuLungiswa nokuThuthukiswa koMthetho-sisekelo ePhalamende mayelana nokusebenza kwalo onyakeni wezimali odlule, ibalule iqhaza elibanjwe wuphenyo lwe-SIU ezinkampanini zikahulumeni okubalwa kuzo u-Transnet, u-Eskom nesikhwama esixhasa izitshudeni, i-National Student Financial Aid Scheme.UMothibi uveze ukuthi ukubuyiswa kwemali engu-R2.28 billion ebikhwatshaniswe ngabathile, yimali enkulu kunazo zonke esezike zaqoqwa eminyakeni ewu-27 edlule."Lolu phiko luphinde lakwazi ukuvika ukulahleka kwemali engu- R2.32 billion, lwaqoqa u-R1.6 billion okukholakala ukuthi akuhanjiswanga ngendlela ngesikhathi kwenziwa izivumelwano. Ngosizo lwe-Special Tribunal neNkantolo ePhakeme kuleli, kuhoxiswe izinkontileka zika- R2.13 billion okutholakale kwabanaphutha ekunikezweni kwazo,” usho kanje.Lolu phiko luthi luqoqe imali eyivile ku-R710 million ekhwabaniswe enkampanini u-Transnet, kube wu-R500 million oqoqwe kwa-Eskom. Yisamba sika-R191 million ophenyweni nge-Nsfas ngo-2023/2024. UMothibi ugcizelele impumelelo yalolu phiko ekuhlonzweni kwemali engu-R1.98 billion okukholakala ukuthi yakhatshwaniswa kumangalelwa izibhedlela ngamacala obudedengu awombombayi.I-SIU ithi phothule uphenyo emacaleni angu-1,919, yadlulisela kumengameli imibiko yophenyo engu-26. Kule mibiko kubalwa owophenyo nge-National Lotteries Commission, Passenger Rail Agency South Africa (Prasa), yiHhovisi lika-Master nolwe-Nsfas.Zingu-297 izikhulu kuhulumeni ezidluliselwe ezikhungweni ezingaphakathi zikahulumeni yilolu phiko, ukuthi ziqondiswe izigwegwe ngokwenza okungalungile.Umbiko we-SIU uveza ukuthi angu- 583 amacala obugebengu adluliselwe ophikweni lwezokuShushiswa koMphakathi aphenywa yilolu phiko.
OWAYEYIPHOYISA oboshelwe ukushaya abulale unina, uthe umufi washayeka ngephutha kudedeleka ipulangwe elinezipikili ababekade bebangisana ngalo.Lokhu kuqukethwe esitatimendeni sikammangalelwa, owayengu-constable, uMnuz Lungisani Xaba, esifundwe ummeli wakhe eNkantolo yesiFunda yasePinetown, izolo.UXaba uboshelwe icala lokubulala unina, uNkk Grega Xaba (81) ngoMeyi 6, 2022, kubo KwaDabeka, eClermont.Esitatimendeni, uXaba uthe unina wagalela kuyena ngepulangwe, kwathi ngesikhathi bebangisana ngalo kwase kushayeka umufi ngephutha."UXaba uthi into eyasusa umsindo wezwa kunuka ugwayi endlini, wangibuza umufi ukuthi wubani obhemayo ngoba wabe azi ukuthi angibhemi,” kuchaza ummeli.UXaba usole unina osekobandayo, wathi nguye owaqala wadonsa ijakhethi ayeyiphethe, walandela ngokuthi ashaye ngepulangwe leli alibamba.Kulokho kujijimezana, uXaba uthe ingalo kanina yagaxela esihlalweni esinamasondo ayekade ehamba ngaso, yabambeka.UXaba uphakamise isandla, wathi womiwe, wacela imantshi ukuba imtholele umuntu ozomzamela amanzi okuphuza.Osebenza enkantolo uwadonse eduzane kujeke, wayomthelela engilazini, wawaphuza wawashiya uhhafu, ingilazi wayibeka phansi eceleni kwalapho abehlezi khona ebhokisini labasolwa.Bese zigcwele amehlo izinyembezi kudadewabo kamufi ezwa ubufakazi obushaqisayo bokuthi unina wayekade opha, ephuke ingalo futhi esevuvukele enezingozi.Ummangalelwa uthe ugesi wawucima kukhanya ngalobo busuku futhi akasakhumbuli ukuthi kwenzakalani endlini, kodwa ekugcineni wabona unina eselele phansi, wathi uyaphuma ngomnyango uyomfunela usizo, wazithela kozakwabo sebevimbe emnyangweni.UXaba ukuphikile ukuthi wayenesibhamu ngesikhathi kwenzeka isigameko. Uthe salahleka mhlazane ebanjwa inkunzi.Lo msolwa waboshwa ngozakwabo esiteshini samaphoyisa saKwaDabeka ayesebenzela kusona.Ufakazi woMbuso, uNksz Nonjabulo Ntombela, uthe amanga aluhlaza lawa, umufi wayengenawo amandla, engakwazi nokusukuma azithathele into, ecela yena amlethele amanzi okuphuza.Ukuchithe njengamampume okushiwo uXaba, ethi yinto engenzekanga asezikhandela yona manje.Ngeledlule, lo fakazi wathi uXaba waqala ngokushaya unina ekhanda ngejakhethi, emkhaca ngenhlamba ethi umise impilo yakhe ngoba enqabe ukuthi asebenzise iselula yakhe.Ufakazi uthe yena nengane encane babalekela kamakhelwane eyofuna usizo, uXaba eseqalile eshaya unina."Wasala wavala umnyango, kwacima ugesi, washaya ugogo (umufi) ngamapulangwe ebumnyameni ngoba wayengafune kubonwa muntu,” kusho ufakazi.Icala lihlehliselwe uNovemba 6, nonyaka, ukuze kubizwe omunye ufakazi.
UFUNA kungabhekwa kude uma sekuphenywa uyise wentombazanyana etholwe isifile ngoLwesithathu emva kokuduka ngoMsombuluko emijondolo yaseZinkawini, eClermont.Isidumbu sikamufi, uNonkanyiso Mathonsi (3), kuthiwa sitholwe ngemuva komjondolo osondelene nowakwamngani (4) wakhe agcine ukubonwa edlala naye ngoMsombuluko. Kuthiwa besinengozi esiphongweni.Uyise, uMnuz Muziwendoda Mathonsi exoxa neSolezwe uthe, umseshi uqeda kubatshela ukuthi umufi udlwenguliwe.Uthe nasemakhazeni baqaphela ukuthi umufi unenye ingozi eyophele ngaphakathi enhlafunweni. Wathi inkulu kunale ebebeyibone esiphongweni ngoLwesithathu. Echaza ngokunyamalala kukamufi uthe, unina obelokhu emqalaza bude buduze nasemjondolo wabo, lapho abedlala khona, ukuqaphele ngabo-5 ntambama ngoMsombuluko ukuthi unyamalele."Sithole ukuthi umngani (4) wakhe abedlala naye ufike wazothathwa enye ingane (6) yakubo baya komunye umjondolo oqhelile. Sizwa kuthiwa ubebalandela kodwa ingane (6) imtshela ukuthi akaphindele emumva,” kusho uMathonsi.Uthe ubhekwe khona lapho umufi, belekelelwa nawomakhelwane, befuna yonke indawo."Kuthe uma engatholakali, sabikela amaphoyisa, afika nawo azosibhekisa,” kusho uMathonsi.Uthe baze baya ngisho nakulo mjondolo okuthiwa kuye kuwo umngani kamufi nengane yakubo, bafika kukhiyiwe.Uthe umufi uphinde wafunwa yonke indawo nangoLwesibili kodwa wangatholakala, wathi uze watholwa ngoLwesithathu, ebekwe ngemumva komjondolo osondelene nowakubo kamngani wakhe."NgoLwesithathu umphakathi uphinde wahlangana ngenhloso yokuqhubeka nokufuna. Kulokhu kwavezwa ukuthi sizojoyinwa amaphoyisa ahamba nezinja futhi kuzovulwa yonke imijondolo kubhekwe phakathi,” usho kanje.Uthe bebesacinga kolunye uhlangothi lwendawo ngesikhathi bethola umbiko wokuthi ingane isitholakele."Lapho itholakale khona sibhekile ngoMsombuluko nangoLwesibili. Kusixakile ukuthi itholakale khona ngoLwesithathu,” kusho uMathonsi.Uthe bakholwa ukuthi umsolwa ukhona endaweni futhi uzwile ngesikhathi kukhulunywa indaba yamaphoyisa nezinja nokuthi kuzovulwa yonke imijondolo kufunwe phakathi."Uthe kusho ukuthi kuthe uma ebona kuyoqalwa kolunye uhlangothi, wasala wayikhipha endlini, wayibeka lapho igcine itholwa khona,” kusho uMathonsi.Uthe nakuba bedidekile ukuthi ubani umuntu obazwise ubuhlungu obunje kodwa unesiqinieko sokuthi umuntu oseduze.Uthe bakhona ababili afisa amaphoyisa abaphenyisise."Amaphoyisa uma esephenya, sengathi angangabashiya,” kusho uMathonsi.Lokhu kufakazelwe nayilungu lomphakathi ebelisekhaleni lokufuna umufi, uMnuz Sibusiso Zibula, othe akungabhekwa kude uma sekuphenywa.Amaphoyisa akakwazanga ukuphendula imibuzo ngalolu daba bekhala ngokuhlushwa uhlelo lwabo lokubheka amacala avuliwe.
ZISHAQISE abantu abaningi izindaba zokudlula emhlabeni kukaNgqongqoshe woMnyango wabaSebenzi kuHulumeni wentando yeningi, uMnuz Membathisi Mphumzi Shepherd Mdladlana. Ngokusho kweSABC News Channel umufi (72) udlule emhlabeni ekwakhe eCape Town, ngoLwesihlanu ntambama. Okhulumela umndeni uMnuz Mayibuye Sokupa utshele iSABC ukuthi uMdladlana ushone emuva kokugula isikhashana.UMdladlana waba ngungqongqoshe ngoJulayi 1998 emuva kukamufi uMnuz Tito Mboweni, oshone ngo-Okthoba 12. Umufi wazalelwa eKeiskammahoek. e-Eastern Cape. Waqala waba nguthisha efundisa eVukukhanye Primary ngo-1972 ngaphambi kokungena ezinyunyaneni zothisha phakathi kuka-1984 no-1994. Waba ngomunye wabasunguli nomengameli wokuqala wenyunyana yothisha iSouth African Democratic Teachers' Union (Sadtu). UMengameli wakuleli, uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa, uthe zimphathe kabi izindaba zokushona kukaMdladlana.
INHLANGANO elwela amalungelo abantu i-Black Sash, seyizwakalise ukukhathazeka, ngokucwila kwezaguga ezihola impesheni kahulumeni nabesifazane abathola isibonelelo sezingane ezikweletini zomashonisa.Embikweni wale nhlangano, kuthiwa kuwumkhuba womashonisa ukununusela ngemali ezalayo abathola izibonelelo zikahulumeni, ikakhulu izaguga nabesifazane abanezingane ezithola lesi sibonelelo.Kuthiwa omashonisa bagcina amakhadi empesheni noma omazisi balabo abasuke beboleke imali ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bayaqhubeka nokuba amakhasimende abo ahleze ekhokha inzalo emba eqolo.UNksz Amanda Rinquest we-Black Sash, ekhuluma ne-Newzroom Afrika, uthe ocwaningweni lwale nhlangano lweminyaka emithathu, baxoxisane nabevile ku-200 abasezinhlakeni zomphakathi, nokuyilapho beqoqe khona ulwazi ngengcindezi elethwa womashonisa kulabo abahola imali yesibonelelo."Ngesikhathi kuqhubeka lolu cwaningo, udaba olungolunye lwezibuhlungu kakhulu esizitholile, olwenzeke e-Zeerust (esifundazweni i-North West), lapho sithole ukuthi omunye obecwilile, umashonisa ubemkhiphela imali amthengele impuphu ewu-10kg namathambo enyama yenkomo bese yonke imali esalayo ayithathe,” usho kanje.Uthe bona njengenhlangano bayakuqonda ukuthi kungani abathola lesi sibonelelo bezithola bekulesi simo ngenxa yokuthi imali abayitholayo ayenele.Le nhlangano ithe ithole ukuthi abathola izibonelelo zikahulumeni abakwazi ukuboleka imali ezindaweni ezigunyaziwe njengoba beyaye batshelwe ukuthi abahlangabezani nezidingo kwazise kubhekwa lezi zikhungo njengamabhange, zibheka ziboleke abantu abasebenzayo.Embikweni wale nhlangano, iphakamise ukuthi kube nokusebenzisana eminyangweni kahulumeni, ubalule iHhovisi likaMgcinimafa, owezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi noMnyango wezaseKhaya ukubhekana nale nkinga ekhona emphakathini.Esinye isiphakamiso esokuthi uhlaka olubheka abacwile ezikweletini i-National Credit Regulator ne-National Financial Ombud Scheme SA besebenzisane ukuqhuba imikhankaso ezifundazweni ezehlukene ukufundisa abantu, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abagcini betsheleka imali komashonisa ababolekisa ngokungemthetho.Okhulumela i- South African Social Security Agency KwaZulu-Natal uNksz Sandy Godlwana, uthe izibonelelo zikahulumeni okubalwa nesezingane, zenzelwe ukwehlisa izinga lobubha."Kuyakhathaza ukuthi kwabathola lesi sibonelelo kukhona abasisebenzisa njengendlela yokuboleka imali, okuyinto eshayisanayo nenhloso yokunikezwa kwalesi sibolelo. I-Sassa iunomthwalo wokuqinisekisa ukuthi izibonelelo zisetshenziswa ngendlela eyiyo,ikakhulu esezingane ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zihlangabezana nezidingo zazo, ” usho kanje.
IMANTSHI ikhombise ukunganami ngenxa yokubambezeleka ekutheni igwebe amadoda amane eyawalahla ngecala lokuthumba nokubulala ngesihluku u-Andile "Bobo” Mbuthu owayesolwa ngokweba utshwala ngo-2020.UMnuz Sanele Hlatshwayo, weNkantolo yeMantshi yaseVerulam, uthe akasakudingi okunye ukubambezeleka kuleli cala ngakho ufuna kufinyelelwe esiphethweni."Kumele kuzanywe ngayo yonke indlela ukuthi kugwenywe ukubambezeleka okungenaso isidingo kuleli cala eliqale ukulalelwa ngo-2021,” kusho uHlatshwayo.Ubekade ephendula ummeli omusha futhi ongowamahhala, uMnuz Mondli Ndlela osemele o-Andile Nhleko, Mncedisi Mzobe, Lindani Ndlovu noMalusi Mthembu.UNdlela ubephakamise ukuthi kulandwe obemele lama doda, mhlazane liqala liqulwa icala laze lawalahla, uMnuz Chris Gounden.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi ngo-Okthoba 2 nonyaka, ashintsha ngomzuzu wokugcina sekumele agwetshwe lama doda atshela uHlatshwayo ukuthi asemulaxazile uGounden.Ayemsola ngokuthi uwahlinzele ezibini kuleli cala. Owayemele uGounden ngalolo suku wathi uhoxile ngoba akasezwani nalama doda.Acela inkantolo ukuthi iwatholele ummeli omusha futhi ongowamahhala, kwase kufika uNdlela izolo.Zisuka amadaka uNdlela ukhale ngokuthi udukuza ebumnyameni ngaleli cala, akazi muva naphambili.Uphakamise ukuthi kulandwe uGounden asale eseliqedela ngoba vele sekusele ukuthi uHlatshwayo awise isigwebo.Kubukeka sengathi uNdlela ulandelwe ukuthi azocelela lama doda kuHlatshwayo ukuthi awathambisele izigwebo, awashaye ngoswazi oluncane."Njengamanje asikho isinqumo esikhona sokuthi kuzokwenzekani ngoba mina angazi lutho ngaleli cala. Siphakamise ukuthi kubuyiswe ummeli omdala azoqedela ngoba vele sekusele isigwebo kuphela,” kusho uNdlela.UMshushisi uMnuz Ntuthuko Mngadi utshele inkantolo ukuthi sezikhona izitatimende okungesivela kosonhlalakahle nesasemnyangweni wezokuhlumelelisa izimilo.UHlatshwayo ulihlehlisele uNovemba 7 icala wathi wusuku ayoqala ngalo ukuwagweba.Ayibhekani enkantolo phakathi kwabantu abasuke bethamele icala abeseka umndeni kamufi nabasuke beze ukuzokweseka abanecala.Lokhu kufakazelwa nawukuhlala kwabo ngokwehlukana emabhentshini enkantolo, ngaphandle nangaphakathi.Amadoda alahlwe ngecala abebukeka ezikhululekele, abuye ajeqeze amamatheke uma ebingelelana nabantu abebezoweseka.UBobo washaywa washona esolwa ngokweba utshwala endaweni yobumnandi eyangqongqiswa wumphakathi iMagagula Lounge, eHambanathi, oThongathi, ngo-2020.
BASHAYELELA isipikili sokugcina bavuma ngo-elethu abaholi bamaqembu abambisene kuhulumeni eyokunyuswa kwesibalo samalungu eKhabhinethi yakuleli.Lokhu kuvezwe nguMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa izolo ephendula umbuzo welungu lePhalamende uMnuz Mmusi Maimane.UMaimane ubuze ukuthi kungani angaxoshi amaphini ongqongqoshe kwiKhabhinethi yakhe ngenxa yokuthi izwe libhekene nenkinga yezimali engenza ukuthi kunqanyulwe isibalo sothisha ezikoleni.URamaphosa uthe ngaphambi kokwethula iKhabhinethi ehlanganisa wonke amaqembu angu-10 abambisene, wayisa uhlu kubaholi bamaqembu."Abaholi bavuma eyeKhabhinethi esinayo manje. Isimo sezimali sisiqaphe ngelokhozi kanti le ndaba ayiqali ukususa umsindo. Maduzane uNgqongqoshe wezimali uzothula umbiko mayelana nesabelomali sezwe, nokuyinto esiyiqaphe ngelokhozi,” kusho uRamaphosa.Usho kanje izwe libhekene nenkinga yokuncishiswa kwesabelomali eminyangweni ehlukene.Iminyango eshayeke kakhulu ngalokhu kubalwa owezemfundo, ongeke ukwazi ukwandisa isibalo sothisha ngonyaka ozayo ngenxa yale nkinga.Mayelana nodaba lokususwa esikhundleni kukaNgqongqoshe wezobuLungiswa uNksz Thembi Simelane, mayelana nemali 'ayiboleka ebhange’ eselawa i-VBS Mutual, uRamaphosa uthe usalucubungula udaba lwakhe."Maduzane ngizokwenza isimemezelo. UNksz Simelane usevele ngisho ngaphambi kwekomiti lezobuqotho kwi-ANC mayelana nalolu daba.Mayelana nokusebenzisana kuhulumeni wokubambisana uRamaphosa uthe yonke into isahamba kahle."Awukho umlingo mayelana nokusebenza ngokubambisana kuhulumeni. Into ekhona ngukuthi wonke amaqembu asebenza ngokuzikhandla, nangokubambisana,” kusho uRamaphosa.Ubalule ukuthi bayazeseka izikhungo zikahulumeni ezilwa nenkohlakalo ngaphandle kokuchema nokwenzelela.Umholi weqembu eliphikisayo ePhalamende Umkhonto weSizwe, uDkt John Hlophe, ubuze uRamaphosa ngemali engamaDola, eyatholakala epulazini lakhe iPhala Phala eLimpopo, angazange ayiveze.Ephendula uRamaphosa uthe njengoba lolu daba selusezithebeni zenkantolo yoMthethosisekelo, kungcono kulindwe inkantolo inqume ngalo.Uthe uhulumeni uzibophezele ekulweni nenkohlakalo wathi izikhungo eziphenya lokhu kumele zisebenze ngaphandle kokuthikanyezwa.
KUXWAYISWE umphakathi ongeneme ngokucotha kwentuthuko KwaZulu-Natal, ukuthi ungalinge udubele ezivivinyweni zika-matric eziqala ngesonto elizayo.Umphakathi unxenxwe ukuthi ungaphazamisi izivivinyo ngoba ziyikusasa lezingane zawo.UMphathiswa wezeMfundo uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka noNdunankulu wesifundazwe uMnuz Thami Ntuli ngesikhathi kunesithangami ngamalungiselelo okubhalwa kwezivivinto zika-matric esifundazweni Isithombe: SITHUNYELWELesi sexwayiso sikhishwe nguMnyango weMfundo esifundazweni kanjalo noNdunankulu wesifundazwe.UMphathiswa wezeMfundo uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka, uthe akukho ukuphazamiseka okuzobakhona okuzonqinda ukubhalwa kwezivivinyo.Uthe kukhona okusina kubajeqeza abazophazamisa izivivinyo njengoba abomthetho bezobe beqaphe ngelokhozi.UHlomuka obekhuluma esithangamini nabezindaba eThekwini izolo noMnuz Thami Ntuli onguNdunankulu, uthe konke sekumi ngomumo ngalezi zivivinyo."Asikho isikole esizophazamiseka ngenxa yokuthi amanzi nogesi akukho. Ezemfundo akuzona ezikahulumeni kodwa ezomphakathi ngakho siyawunxusa ukuthi ungaphazamisi.” Uthe baxoxe nomasipala ngoba bawuhulumeni owodwa ngokuvalwa kwezidingo ezifana namanzi nogesi ezikoleni ngalesi sikhathi. UNtuli uhlabe ikhwelo elifanayo lokuthi umphakathi awungaziphazamisi lezi zivivinyo."Noma kuthiwa kukhona ukungenami ngezinto ezithile kodwa akumele kuphazanyiswe izivivinyo zika-matric. Sizokanisa ezindaweni ezehlukene sibheke ukubhalwa kwalezi zivivinyo,” kusho uNtuli.Uthe akuzona kuphela lezi zivivinyo ezibalulekile kodwa nalezo ezisethwa ezikoleni eziqalile ukubhalwa nazo zibalulekile ngakho akumele ziphazanyiswe.Uzwakalise ukwethemba isikhungo okugaywa kuso amaphepha ka-matric ukuthi sisezingeni, wathi akukho phepha elingaputshuka.Uveze ukuthi cishe ukube wayengekho kulesi sikhundla wayengeke azi lapho kugaywa khona amaphepha ka-matric."Njengoba ningazi nje lapho kugaywa khona imali, kanjalo nalapho kugaywa khona amaphepha angicabangi ukuthi ngangizokwazi ukube angiyena undunankulu. Sethemba ukuthi sizoba nezivivinyo ezingenagcobho.”Ubalule nokuthi zizoqashwa ngelokhozi izikhungo okwakotshelwa kuzona nyakenye."Sinye isikhungo esifuze lesi eMajuba, ePinetown zingu-11, eHarry Gwala zine, eMkhanyakude ziyisithupha, oThukela ziyisithupha, eMzinyathi zingu-19, eMlazi zingu-19. EZululand zingu-8, eKing Cetshwayo nakhona zingu-8, oGwini ziyisikhombisa, kwiLembe ziyisikhombisa kuthi eMgungundlovu zingu-18.”UHlomuka uthembise ukuthi bazokhokhela abamakela u-matric."Sinenkontileka nabasebenzi ngakho bazohola. Sihlale sibakhokhela abasebenzi esinenkontileka nabo.” UNtuli uveze ukuthi namhlanje kuzoba nomcimbi wokusayinwa kwesibophezelo sokuthi ngeke bakopele abafundi abenza u-matric.Umnyango uhlela ukuphucula imiphumela ka-matric nyakenye isuka ku-86% iya ku-100%. Kodwa uma kwenzeka ingawutholi lo-100% ihlele ukuthola u-90%.UNgqongqoshe kazwelonke weMfundo eyisiSekelo uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, uzodedela imiphumela ngoJanuwari 15, 2025.Esifundazweni izodedelwa ngoJanuwari 16, 2025.
AKUKHO okumele ukwenze ekhaya uma ulunywe inyoka ngaphandle kokuphuthuma esibhedlela noma ufonele umuntu owungoti wezinyoka akuyalele isibhedlela esikwaziyo ukwelapha uphoyizeni.Ongoti bezinyoka bathi okumele ukwenze uma ulunywe inyoka ukuphuthuma esikhungweni sezempilo futhi ube nolwazi lokuthi inyoka ekulumile iyinhloboni noma uyichaze ukuthi injani, ukuze esibhedlela bazi ukuthi kumele bakunike muphi umuthi.Njengoba sekuqale isikhathi sokuthi izinyoka zibonakale ngemuva kokuthi kade zicashile izinyanga ezine, ongoti bezinyoka bathi kunezinkolelo ezithi kumele ubophe ngenhla kwenxeba, uphuze amanzi noma ugcabe bese umunca uphoyizeni. Bathi konke lokho kuyizinkolelo azilona iqiniso kunalokho izona ezingaholela ekutheni olunywe inyoka afe noma alahlekelwe yilunga lomzimba ebelingeke limlahlekele.UMnuz Fortune Sibiya wenhlangano ebamba izinyoka izisuse emphakathini, iCobra Reptile Conservation Centre, uthe: "Izinyoka zinobuthi obuhlukene kabili obenza ukuthi kuphume igazi kuzo zonke izindawo eziyinezimbobo emzimbeni, obuholela ekutheni isikhumba silimale kube sengathi ushiswe ngamanzi. Izinyoka ezivamile ezifana nebululu zinobuthi obudla isikhumba. Uma ubopha ngenhla kwenxeba usuke uzidalela ukuthi kubole yonke ingxenye engezansi kwenxeba okuholela ekutheni unqunywe lelo lunga lomzimba. Ukugijima noma ukuphuza amanzi kuholela ekutheni inhliziyo ishaye ngamandla okuholela ekutheni igazi ligijime kakhulu lihambise ubuthi enhliziyweni," kusho yena.Uqhube wathi yize ishoda imithi yokubulala ubuthi egazini kuleli, ekhona isengawenza umehluko."Inkinga esibhekene nayo ukuthi kwezinye izibhedlela abasebenzi bakhona abazi lutho ngezinyoka. Isimo sesiguli sishintsha singaphakathi esibhedlela abasebenzi belokhu bebamba beyeka bengazi ukuthi kumele basenzenjani isiguli," kusho uSibiya.Uqhube wathi esikhathini sanamhlanje ukusebenzisa izibiba nakho akusaphephile ngoba abanye abelaphi abazazi izinyoka."Kuqala abelaphi babezazi izinyoka kwakungenzeki ukuthi akunike isibiba esingahambisani nenyoka ekulumile. Ngisanda kufica umuntu elunywe inyoka ekumelaphi nayo inyoka emlumile eyibulele. Umelaphi wayethi imamba esencane, kungeyona,” kusho yena. Uthe izinyoka ezivame ukuluma abantu ngalesi sikhathi imfezi, ibululu nemamba eluhlaza."Imamba emnyama ayivamile ukuthi noma ikuluma ikhiphe ubuthi ngoba iyazi ukuthi umuntu akakona ukudla kwayo. Ushevu iyawonga. Isuke imethusa nje ngoba izivikela. Uthe kunezinyoka ezijwayelekile ezifana nomzingandlu nenyoka yasekhaya ezivame ukutholakala emakhaya ezidla izibankwa. "Lezo zinyoka azinabo ubuthi uma zikulumile kufana nokuthi ulunywe umiyane. Abanye abantu badidwa imibala yazo ngoba inyoka yasekhaya iluhlaza ungaze ucabange ukuthi imamba uma ungenalo ulwazi kahle,” kusho yena.

Ubengishayela njalo, engibuza ngezinto ezenzeka eqenjini, bese naye ebeka imibono yakhe. Kuningi ebesikhuluma ngakho naye okubalwa kukho ukwakhiwa kohulumeni wokubambisana.”Izinhlaka ezahlukene okubalwa kuzo ezamabhizinisi, ziyaqhubeka nokuncoma amagalelo kaMboweni.
BAZOJEZISWA kanzima osonkontileka abaqala imisebenzi bangayiqedi.Lokhu kudalulwe nguMphathiswa wezeMisebenzi yoMphakathi neNgqalasizinda KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Martin Meyer.Ukusho lokhu izolo ngesikhathi kuvulwa ngokusemthethweni isakhiwo sesifunda iLembe esisekhoneni lomgwaqo uTownview noSaunders KwaDukuza esakhiwe ngo-R63 million.Kulesi sakhiwo kuzoba namahhovisi okuzokwenziwa kuwo imisebenzi eyehlukene yesiFunda iLembe.Kuvele ukuthi angu-32 esewonke amahhovisi angaphakathi kulesi sakhiwo.UMeyer uthe selokhu engenile ehhovisi lakhe kulezi zinsuku ezingu-100, uthole izikhalo eziningi mayelana nezakhiwo ezingaphothulwa ngenxa yengwadla yosonkontileka abaqala umsebenzi bangawuqedi."NjengoMnyango wezeMisebenzi yoMphakathi sifuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi siyayiqeda indaba yosonkotileka abangazimisele ngokusebenza,'' usho kanje.Uthe bonke osonkontileka abake banikezwa umsebenzi bangawuphothula bazofakwa ohlwini lwabangasebenzi kahle futhi bangabe besanikezwa eminye imisebenzi ngokulandelayo.Uthe uma befuna ukusiphosela inselelo leso sinqumo alikho icala ngokwenza kanjalo kodwa wathi okumqoka ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izakhiwo ziyaphothulwa.UMeyer udalule nokuthi uhlela ukuba nohlelo olukhuthaza ukunikeza abesifazane ithuba lokuthi bangene emkhakheni wezokwakha.Lokhu ubekusho ngemuva kokuvela kokuthi isakhiwo ebesivulwa sakhiwe yinkontileka yowesifazane wakuyona le ndawo."Lokhu kuveza ngokusobala ukuthi abantu besifazane bayakwazi ukusebenza uma benikezwa ithuba,'' echaza.USomlomo woMkhandlu waKwaDukuza uNkk Dolly Govender, uthe baningi abantu abathole amathuba omsebenzi ngokuvulwa kwalawa mahhovisi.
OWANGUMVIKELI woMphakathi, u-Advocate Busisiwe Mkhwebane, uthi akanankinga nokujoyina iqembu eliholwa owayengumengameli, uJacob Zuma, iMK.U-Advocate Mkhwebane, oshiye kwi-EFF, uvumile ukuthi iMK kade yaqala ukumeshela kodwa wathi ubengakasithathi isinqumo.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma kwipodcast, iSMWX, lapho ememezele khona ukushiya kwakhe kwi-EFF.Ukushiya kuka-Advocate Mkhwebane kwi-EFF kufika kungakapheli isikhathi eside kushiye owayeyiphini likamengameli kule nhlangano, uMnuz Floyd Shivambu, nowayeyilungu lePhalamende, uMnuz Mzwanele Manyi.UShivambu noManyi sebengamalungu eMK.Ngesikhathi beshiya kwi-EFF beya kwiMK, kwaba namahlebezi okuthi baningi abanye abazobalandela.U-Advocate Mkhwebane, uthe abeMK baqala ukumeshela ngaphambi kokuthi kuze kushiye uShivambu."Kodwa ngabatshela ukuthi kuningi engangisafuna ukukwenza kwi-EFF. Ayikho into engingathi angiyithandi ngeMK. Konke kulele kubona, uma kuwukuthi basangifuna, ngizobona.”U-Advocate Mkhwebane waziwa njengomunye wabantu abazwelana noZuma, umkhwenyana ka-Advocate Mkhwebane, uMnuz David Skosana, uyilungu le-MK.Encwadini yokwesula, u-Advocate Mkhwebane ukhale ngokuhlukumezeka ngesikhathi esenguMvikeli woMphakathi.U-Advocate Mkhwebane wakhishwa singakapheli isikhathi sakhe.Uthe akazange akuthole ukuphumula ngesikhathi ephethe isikhundla."Kule minyaka eyisikhombisa eyedlule ngizithole ngicindezeleka, ngicindezelwa yizinkantolo, yiPhalamende , uhulumeni uqobo, kanye namaziko ezindaba abesetshenziswa ukungilwisa. Ukuhlukumezeka kwami kuqhubekile noma sengikhishiwe esikhundleni. Lokhu obekwenzeka kule minyaka kungenze ngabona ukuthi asikayitholi inkululeko esayilwela kanzima kangaka.”Imibiko eminingi eyakhishwa u-Advocate Mkhwebane ngesikhathi esenguMvikeli woMphakathi yachithwa yizinkantolo.Encwadini, u-Advocate Mkhwebane, uthe ukhethe ukwesula kwi-EFF ukuze akwazi ukuchitha isikhathi nomndeni wakhe.Kodwa ngesikhathi ekhuluma kwipodcast u-Advocate Mkhwebane, uthe ushiye kwi-EFF ngoba engajabule ngendlela okuqhutshwa ngayo kule nhlangano eholwa uMnuz Julius Malema.U-Advocate Mkhwebane uthe kwi-EFF kulandelwa okushiwo ubuholi."Angisho ukuthi ngiyayigxeka indlela okuqhutshwa ngayo kwi-EFF, kodwa kukhona izinto nawe oke ubone ukuthi lena akusiyo eyami.”
KUYA ngamagama oMkhuzi wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal emuva kokuboshwa kwamaphoyisa amabili athweswe icala lokuphanga indawo yebhizinisi.Ngo-Agasti uMkhwanazi wakugcizelela ukuthi amaphoyisa alwa nalo lonke uhlobo lobugebengu futhi asebenza ngaphandle kokwesaba nokwenzelela.Waqhuba wathi bazobopha ngisho ozakwabo ngaphakathi embuthweni wamaphoyisa okuyotholakala ukuthi bayathinteka ezenzweni zobugebengu bese bebhekana nengalo yomthetho.Muva nje kuboshwe amaphoyisa amabili, asebenza ezingeni lesifundazwe eMgungundlovu, athweswa amacala okuphanga indawo yebhizinisi.Isolezwe lihoshe ukuthi amaphoyisa kusolakala ukuthi asebenzise iVW Polo yomsebenzi, anikela esitolo sowokufika, okuthe uma usomabhizinisi egoloza ukuwavulela, angena ngendluzula egqekeza isitolo esebenzisa izindlawu.Kuvela ukuthi athathe u-R1 000 nogwayi ongabiza u-R1 800, ashaya achitha. Kuthiwa abanjwe oqotsheni nokusolwa ukuthi akuthathile, aboshwa.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda ukuqinisekisile ukuboshwa kwamaphoyisa esehlakalweni athe senzeke ekhoneni lomgwaqo uMasukwana noPrince Alfred, eMgungundlovu ngoLwesihlanu ebusuku.UNetshunda uthe umgilwa utshele amaphoyisa ukuthi webelwe imali nogwayi.Avele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMgungundlovu ngoMsombuluko icala lahlehliswa.Lesi sehlo silandela esokuboshwa kwephoyisa elingu-constable elisebenzela esiteshini samaphoyisa eCato Manor, eThekwini.Ligqigqa enkantolo emuva kokutholakala namakhadi asebhange angu-105, nelikamgilwa okwadunwa iToyota Fortuner yakhe kwashona ingane eneminyaka engu-11 eyacasha ngaphansi kwemoto ngesikhathi kwenzeka isehlo, kanti abasolwa bazosusa imoto yabe isishayiseka. Ngenyanga edlule oKlebe babophe amaphoyisa ayisikhombisa nelungu lomphakathi ePhoenix, eThekwini. La basolwa bagqigqa enkantolo ngecala lokufuna ngodli imali kumnikazi wesitolo. Babefuna kuyena uR100 000 kodwa unkosikazi womninisitolo wakwazi ukuhlanganisa engaphezudlwana kuka-R70 000.Ngo-Agasti kuboshwe iphoyisa elinye lashona kanye nabantu ababili okusolakala ukuthi baphanga isitolo esiseRichmond Farm, eThekwini.Kuthiwa abasolwa badubulana namaphoyisa lapho babebhace khona emzini oseLindelani, eThekwini.UDkt Johan Burger ongungoti wezobugebengu ozimele, uthe wakubeka kwacaca izikhawu eziningi uMkhwanazi ukuthi ngeke azibekezelele izigebengu embuthweni wmaphoyisa uma yena esaphethe."Nginombono wokuthi ukwanda kwezigameko zokuboshwa nokushushiswa kwamaphoyisa, sekwenza kubukeke sengathi maningi amacala obugebengu obenziwa amaphoyisa. Kumele singakhohlwa ukuthi amaphoyisa agqigqa ezinkantolo asuke eboshwe ozakwabo embuthweni wamaphoyisa,” kusho uBurger.
