IWUNDABA mlonyeni indaba yevidiyo yowesilisa nomlobokazi wakhe abebebanga ummese ophathwa ngumlobokazi ngelanga lomgcagco wabo abebezama ukuphucana wona.Kule vidiyo kuvela umkhwenyana ephuca kabi umakoti lo mmese obizwa ngesinqindi, esigcawini kuze kuchwaze izethameli kucaca ukuthi akafuni ngempela ukumnika.Kukhona ababuza ukuthi ngabe isho ukuthini into ebiyenziwa yilaba bashadikazi ngoba bekubonakala bewubanga phakathi esigcawini.Kukhona abaveza ukuthi bekumele amphuce umlobokazi ummese ukuze akwazi ukuthatha unkosikazi wesibili ngoba uma engawuthathanga kusho ukuthi ngeke esakwazi ukushadelwa ngomunye unkosikazi.UMLOBOKAZI wakwaShembe ephethe ummese obizwa ngesinqindi Isithombe: SIGCINIWELaba abavela kwividiyo bahlobe ngendlela yamaNazaretha ngosuku lomgcagco wawo. AmaNazaretha ayaziqhelelanisa nalesi senzo athi akuyona indlela okwenziwa ngayo kuleli bandla lwakwaShembe.Baze bathumela nezinye izintshumayelo zabefundisi bebandla begxeka indaba yokuphucwa kwabalobokazi isinqindi uma unqume ukusinelwa ngokohlelo lwebandla.Okhulumela amaNazaretha ngaphansi koNyazilwezulu, uMnuz Thokozani Mncwabe uthe akulona uhlelo lwamaNazaretha ukuphuca umlobokazi isinqindi."Ividiyo yowesilisa ephuca umlobokazi isinqindi siyibonile kodwa akuyona into esingayihlanganisa nenkolo yobuNazaretha. Sekuyinto ejwayelekile ukuthi kubonakale abantu benza lo mkhuba bese bewuyamanisa namaNazaretha. Bayasho nokuthi uma bephuca umlobokazi isinqindi basuke befuna ukuthatha unkosikazi wesibili. Ngokwenkolo yobuNazaretha, akuvumelekile ukuthatha isithembu. KumaNazaretha umfundisi uyanibuza ngosuku lomshado ukuthi nishada ngokukaNkulunkulu yini noma ngokwesintu. Uma uthi ushada ngokukaNkulunkulu usuke usho ukuthi ngeke umthathe unkosikazi wesibili kodwa uma ukhetha owesintu usuke uveza ukuthi kusengenzeka uthathe unkosikazi wesibili. Isinqindi umlobokazi uyasiphatha ngosuku lomgcagco kumaNazaretha kodwa akaphucwa sona. Usisebenzisa ukukhomba inxeba lapho kuzobhotshozwa khona inkomo bese kufakwa ubuhlalu kuleyo ndawo ayikhombile. Ukuphatha isinqindi kusuke kuwuphawu lokuthi umlobokazi usesesigabeni sokuthi usengakwazi ukusikela abanye omama inyama uma kuhlatshiwe ekhaya esegcagcile,” kuchaza uMncwabe.Isazi samasiko uSolwazi Sihawu Ngubane, uthe empeleni isinqindi yinto yesintu kodwa akuwona wonke umuntu okholelwa kuyona."Kuya ngendawo okhulele kuyona ukuthi sithathwa njengento ebalulekile yini isinqindi noma cha. Kwezinye izindawo yinto enganakwa. Ngaleyo ndlela ngeke sathi siyisiko kodwa singumkhuba nje, owenziwa abantu. Uma bemphuca sona esigcawini kusuke kuwuphawu nje lokuthi usafuna ukuthatha kodwa okungasho ukuthi akasenaso isinqindi lowo osuke egcagca naye. Emva komgcagco uyambuyisela sona kodwa aqhubeke nokuthatha unkosikazi wesibili uma esazimisele,” kucacisa uSolwazi Ngubane.
KUKHONA ubufakazi inkantolo esabuqoqa mayelana necala likathisha okuthiwa wadlwengula umfundi ophila nokukhubazeka, wagcina engayanga eMkhosini woMhlanga owawesesigodlweni eNyokeni, kwaNongoma ngenyanga edlule.Lo thisha okuthiwa ufundisa kwesinye sezikole esiseThekwini, kuthiwa wadlwengula umfundi ophila nokukhubazeka emagcekeni esikole esigamekweni okuthiwa senzeka ngo-Agasti.Izolo ngesikhathi uthisha evele enkantolo kuvele ukuthi kunobufakazi obuwukhiye okusamele inkantolo ibuqoqe ukuze icala liqhubeke.Lokhu kudalulwe yiMantshi elingatholakalanga igama layo."Kunobufukazi obubalulekile kakhulu obuthinta leli cala okusamele buhlanganiswe. Ngeke sikwazi ukuthi siqhubeke lobu bufakazi bungakahlanganiswa ngendlela efanele,'' isho kanje iMantshi.Icala libe selihlehliselwa uNovemba 20 nonyaka. IMantshi ithe iyethemba ukuthi ngaleso sikhathi lobu bufakazi obudingekayo buyobe sebuhlanganiswe bonke.Ngesikhathi uthisha evela ngenyanga edlule kwaba khona ababebhikisha ngaphandle kwenkantolo bekhononda ngothisha. Kwabakhona nabagonyuluka badalula ukuthi lo thisha wadlwengula namadodakazi abo.Bafunga bagomela ukuthi lolu daba lwakhe bazolusukumela. Nayizolo bebekhona bebhikisha.Omunye wabazali uthe bahlela ukuyovula amacala sebe bonke ngoba kukhona abanye abazali abasabalindile abasebenza ngaphandle kwesifundazwe."Sifuna ukuthi uma sesiyovula lawa macala kube yinto enesisindo futhi kucace ukuthi sibaningi esimvulela wona,'' kusho lo wesilisa.Umzali kamgilwa uthe ukhathazekile ngokuthi luhamba ngonyawo lonwabu icala. Uthe okusenhliziyweni yakhe ukuthi ufuna ukubona leli cala liqulwa ukuze uthisha ezothola isigwebo esimfanele."Ukukhuluma iqiniso nje angijabulile neze ngendlela leli cala elihamba ngonyawo lonwabu ngakhona. Mina ngifuna ukubona liqulwa ebese eyagwetsha lo muntu ozibiza ngokuthi unguthisha,'' usho kanje.Kunenkulumo eqoshiwe lapho okukhuluma khona iphimbo okukholakala ukuthi ngelikathisha encenga khona umfundi."Ngiyakucela phela we..... (emgagula ngegama umgilwa) ungaluvezi lolu lokuthi ngilale nawe. Phela mntanami uma wenze kanjalo uzongiphelela umsebenzi wokuba nguthisha bese kulamba umndeni wami,'' lizwakala kanje leli phimbo.
UMPHATHISWA wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana kanye neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal, uMfundisi Thulasizwe Buthelezi, ukushayele ihlombe ukuboshwa kowasendlunkulu osolwa ecaleni lokwebiwa kwempahla yezigidi zamaRandi emayini eseRichards Bay.UButhelezi uthe ukuboshwa kukaMntwana uLungalomndeni Zulu, noMnuz Richard Malinga, kukhombisa ukuthi ingalo yomthetho ayisinisi mahleza.UMntwana uLungalomndeni ungowasendlini yakwaZiphethe, ungomunye wabeseka uMntwana uSimakade Jackson kaZwelithini, embangweni wesihlalo sobukhosi bukaZulu.Ngakolunye uhlangothi uButhelezi ubuye abe ngundunankulu kaZulu, usohlangothini lwabeseka iSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini.UMntwana uLungalomndeni, noMalinga basolwa ecaleni lokwebiwa kwempahla embiwa phansi ebalelwa kuR26 million.Emayinini iRichards Bay Minerals, kuthiwa lokuntshontshwa kwempahla bese kwenzeke iminyaka eminingi ilandelana.Ngokuthola kweSolezwe, uMntwana uLungalomndeni, noMalinga baboshwa ngeledlule, yithimba lamaphoyisa elilwa nokwebiwa kwempahla ezimayini, i-Operation Vala Umgodi.Bobabili bangaphandle ngebheyili kaR50 000.Icala lizophindela eNkantolo yeMantshi eMpangeni, ngoNovemba 4.UButhelezi uthe ukuntshontshwa kwempahla eRichards Bay Mineral kuhluphekisa abantu abathembele kule mayini."Siyakuncoma ukuboshwa kwabasolwa ngoba kuthumela umyalezo oqinile wokuthi amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, alwisana nazo zonke izinhlobo zobugebengu. BATHUKILE izihlobo zingqongqa nendlu okusolwa ukuthi ithungelwe KwaNyuswa Location eZinqoleni, ePort Shepstone ngoMsombuluko, umndeni usazilele inhloko yekhaya esanda kubulawa ngokudutshulwa.Kulesi sigameko kushone umfelokazi uNkk Hloniphile Nzama (56), indodakazi yakhe uNksz Mbalenhle Nzama (30) nonina wengane yendodana yakulo muzi, uNksz Zanele Mngongoma.Kuvela ukuthi kwabasindile kukhona izingane ezimbili ezineminyaka eyishumi, neyodwa eneminyaka emibili, okumanje zisalaliswe esibhedlela.Kuthiwa zikhona ezinye izingane ezimbili eziphume zingenamyocu.Elandisa ngesehlo oyisihlobo, uNksz Fisani Nzama onomuzi eduze kwendawo yesigameko, uthe uvuswe omunye udadewabo, naye ohlala khona endaweni."Uthe asiphuthume khona ngoba uvuswe umsindo wabantu abakhalayo becela usizo, kuthe uma ethi uyaphuma emnyango, wathuka woma ebona ukuthi kusha esihlotsheni,” kusho uNksz Nzama, othe naye akakukholwanga akubone ngesikhathi elunguza ngewindi.UMUFI uNksz Zanele Mngongoma Uthe kuthe uma befika khona bathola amadodana akulo muzi amathathu, alala endlini engaphandle, etakula izingane ezintathu ezigcine ziphuthunyiswa esibhedlela."Bebezikhipha ngesikhala esincane. Laba abathathu abadala abakwazanga ukuphuma, baphelele ngaphakathi endlini ebisha ubuhanguhangu.Uthe kwenzeka lo mshophi nje, bebesazikhotha amanxeba ngenhloko yekhaya, uMnuz Thulani 'Sobhuza’ Nzama (61) odutshulwe wabulawa abantu abangaziwa ngoSepthemba 3.UMUFI uNksz Mbalenhle Nzama"Bagasela ekhaya, bazenza abantu abaxoxa naye, bathi besuka bamdubula, wafela khona lapho,” kusho uNksz Nzama, othe kwababulewe manje, kwakukhona uNksz Mngongoma kuphela.Uthe uNksz Mngongoma akababonanga abasolwa, ngakho akakholwa ukuthi kungenzeka ukuthi isigameko samanje siwukucisha ubufakazi noma sihlobene nesangoSepthemba.Uthe bayasola ukuthi umlilo wokhelwe umuntu, uma bebuka indlela obuvutha ubuhanguhangu ngayo, wathi ubumandla ophahleni lwendlu, kungathi kukhona okuwuketshezi oluvuthayo okutheliwe."Sididekile ukuthi kwenzekani futhi sithukile. Azikho izitha esizaziyo zabadala kwabashonile,” kusho uNksz Nzama.Ukhale ngokuthi onjani umuntu oshisa izingane ezincane nendlu.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa aseZinqoleni avule amacala okubulala nelokuthungela ngomlilo kulandela isigameko lsokungqongqiswa kwendlu abantu abangaziwa KwaNyuswa Location."Izihlobo ezintathu zishe zangqongqa emlilweni kwathi ezinye ezintathu zasala namanxeba okusha,” kusho uNetshiunda.
INHLANGANO evikela abathengi, iNational Consumer Commission (NCC), ithi bazojeza kanzima osomabhizinisi abadayisa impahla ebolile nengekho emthethweni.UKhomishana osabambile we-NCC, uMnuz Hardin Ratshisusu, uthe bayaqhubeka nomkhankaso wabo wokuhlola impahla edayisa eziphaza kanti bathole ukuthi lezi zitolo ziphula iConsumer Protection Act (CPA no 68 ka-2008) neminye imithetho yabathengi.Uthe isigaba 55 seCPA sikubeka kucace ukuthi abantu kufanele badayiselwe impahla ephephile futhi ekhiqizwe ngendlela efanele."Osomabhizinisi abadayisa impahla edlulelwe yisikhathi bazohlawuliswa uR1 million noma u-10% wemali abayenzayo, kuya ngokuthi iyiphi imali enkulu kulezi. Sizoqhubeka nokuhlola ukudla okudayiswa ezitolo ukuvikela abantu,” kusho uRatshisusu.Uveze ukuthi bahlole izitolo eziseNaledi, eSoweto, nezise-Eastern Cape abathole ukuthi zidayisa ukudla okubolile, okunye akunawo amalebuli achaza ngakho nabhalwe ngezilimi zakwamanye amazwe. Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi kushone izingane eziyisithupha eNaledi okusolakala ukuthi zidle amachips eziwathenge ezitolo zabokufika.Ukudla okutholwe ukuthi kudayiswa noma sekubolile okwezingane, oswidi, amajusi, noodles, amachips, amakhekhe nokunye okudliwayo.Ubalule ukuthi ukudla okudayiswa sekudlulelwe yisikhathi kubeka engcupheni impilo yabantu njengoba kungabagulisa.Uma beyohlola ukudla okudayiswa ezitolo, uRatshisusu uthe basuke behambisana namaphoyisa, uMnyango wezeMpilo, owezaseKhaya, owezabaSebenzi nezinye izinhlangano ezivikela amalungelo abathengi.Ubalule ukuthi ezinye izitolo zidayisa ngisho inyama edlulelwe yisikhathi kanti abanikazi bazo abanikezani amarisidi uma umuntu eqeda kuthenga.Ucele abantu ukuthi baqaphele uma bethenga impahla ezitolo, bayibheke ukuthi idlulelwa nini isikhathi baqaphele nokuthi yenziwe kuphi ngoba zonke lezi zinto zibalulekile ukubavikela.

IZIMEYA zaKwaZulu-Natal zifuna kushintshwe umthetho owenza ukuthi amakhosi abe izibankwa ezabonwa undunankulu kaZulu ongasekho, inkosi Mangosuthu Buthelezi, emihlanganweni yomasipala.Izimeya zomasipala basesifundazweni zithe ukungavunyelwa kwamakhosi ukuba avote emihlanganweni yemikhandlu kwenza ukuthi afane nezibankwa.Zisho lokhu emva kwesimemezelo soMphathiswa wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, sokuthi amakhosi asezovumeleka ukuhlala emihlanganweni yekomiti elithatha izinqumo ezibalulekile komasipala, isigungu esiphezulu.UButhelezi wenze lesi memezelo ngesikhathi ekhuluma emhlanganweni wakhe nezimeya, obuseThekwini.Amakhosi abevumeleke ukuba ingxenye yemihlangano yomkhandlu kuphela.Izinqumo eziningi komasipala zithathwa emihlanganweni yesigungu esiphezulu.Nakuba izimeya zikushayele ihlombe ukuvunyelwa kwamakhosi emihlanganweni yesigungu esiphezulu, zikhale ngokuthi ngeke kwenze mehluko omkhulu ngoba amakhosi azobe engavumelekile ukuvota uma sekuthathwa izinqumo.UButhelezi uthe uzothumela bonke omasipala baKwaZulu-Natal izincwadi, ebazisa ukuthi amakhosi asezoba ingxenye yemihlangano yesigungu esiphezulu.UButhelezi uthe akulungile ukuthi amakhosi angabi ingxenye yemihlangano ethatha izinqumo ezibalulekile."Amakhosi azomelwa inkosi eyodwa emihlanganweni yesigungu esiphezulu.”Iphini likasihlalo wenhlangano yohulumeni basekhaya KwaZulu-Natal, inkosi Ntandoyenkosi Shabalala, lithe kufanele kushintshwe umthetho ukuze amakhosi ezokwazi ukuvota."Ukuhlala kwamakhosi emihlanganweni yesigungu esiphezulu akusho lutho ngoba awanawo amandla okuvota. Kubuhlungu ukuthi omasipala bathathe izinqumo ezibalulekile, amakhosi angakwazi ukuvota ekubeni esuke ekhona emihlanganweni.”Imeya kaMasipala waseMhlathuze, uMnuz Xolani Ngwezi, ithe umnyango kaButhelezi kufanele unxenxe umengameli ukuba ashintshe umthetho."Le simo senza ukuthi amakhosi aqhubeke nokuba izibankwa. Yake yakhulunywa eyokushintshwa kwalo mthetho ngesikhathi sikaZuma (Jacob).”Imeya kaMasipala waseMlalazi, uNkk Queen Xulu, ithe amakhosi akufanele egcine esezizwa engabalulekile emihlanganweni."Akufanele amakhosi ahlale lapha agcine esezibuza ukuthi abezokwenzani emihlanganweni.”Imeya kaMasipala waseMsunduzi, uMnuz Mzimkhulu Thebolla, inxuse izimeya ukuba zingayixhamazeleli eyokushintshwa komthetho.Uthe lolu daba kufanele baqale baluxoxe nemikhandlu abayimele.Iphini likasihlalo wendlu yobuholi bomdabu KwaZulu-Natal, inkosi Ngqayizivele Sithole, likwamukele ukuvunyelwa kwamakhosi ukuba ahlale emihlanganweni yesigungu esiphezulu."Kubalulekile ukuthi amakhosi abe khona emihlanganweni yekomiti elithatha izinqumo ezibalulekile nezithinta abantu bawo. UMntwana wakwaPhindangene wayehlezi ekusho ukuthi amakhosi ayizibankwa emihlanganweni yomkhandlu. Kubuhlungu ukuba isibankwa emihlanganweni yomkhandlu.”USithole uthe ukuvunyelwa kwamakhosi ukuba abe ingxenye yemihlangano yesigungu esiphezulu kuzokwenza amakhosi asebenzisane kahle nomasipala.

NgoNovemba 4 sizocela ukuthi icala lihlehle size sithole umbiko esiwufunayo."UMagaqa wasocongwa ngo-2017, wadutshulwa ebuya emhlanganweni wamakhansela kuMasipala waseMzimkhulu.UMagaqa kukholakala ukuthi wabulawelwa ukulwa nenkohlakalo.
AKEKHO obengacabanga ukuthi ezinye izinto ezihambisana nempucuzeko yizona ezingasiphendukela zisilimaze noma zibe yingozi emizimbeni yethu. Eqinisweni kuningi esasicabanga ukuthi kuyasithuthukisa kanti kusiphendula ibhola lalabo abenza imali ngathi. Siyagula, imizimba iyaphunduleka, sigcine sesikhombana sodwa sithi siyathakathana, imindeni ayisabhekani, kubi kubi! Enye yalezi zinto kwaba ukushintsha singaphoqwe muntu, sayeka ukuxubha amazinyo ngendlela ephephile eyayingagulisi muntu, sathutheleka kulezi zinhlanganisela zemithi ngoba sithi silandela impucuzeko. Namhlanje kunezinhlobonhlobo zezihlanzi esizibiza ngokuthi imithi yokuxubha noma izihlanzi mlomo iningi lazo esingazi ukuthi zithakwe ngani. Zona lezi zithako zinomphumela muni emizimbeni yethu. Imithi yokuxubha ithakwe ngekhemikhali ebizwa ngokuthi yi-fluoride, yilesi sithako esinguphoyizeni, umbulalazwe woqobo osibhuqabhuqayo siyisizwe.Inselelo ukuthi le khemikhali ingena okungathi akwenzeki lutho emzimbeni kanti awazi uyaphela ngaphakathi. Ngeshwa abantu abaningi bendlu yakithi baze bayongcwatshwa bengazi nokuthi yini le eyayibagulisa nomsusa wayo. Inkinga enkulu le okumele siyilwe nxazonkana, sidlulile isikhathi lapho sibeka khona izinqumo ngezimpilo zethu kwabanye abantu, kube yibo okungathi bayakucabangela baze bangafuni nokuthi wazi ukuthi kwenzekani ngaphakathi kuwe emzimbeni. Mhlawumbe abanye abangizwa, thina singodokototela asifuni nokuthi umuntu abuke ifayela lakhe uma elalisiwe esibhedlela. Sike sizibuze nje ukuthi kuphula muphi umthetho ukufunda ifayela lami, elikhuluma ngami, kuyimina engilaliswe esibhedlela? Size impela sitshele iziguli sithi, 'akuvunyelwe ukufunda ifayela, uma kukhona ofuna ukukwazi buza kudokotela wakho’. Ubuza udokotela ekuphi, uyomthola nini lowo dokotela?Umuthi wokuxubha unekhemikhali okuthiwa yi'flouride’ eyinkinga enkulu emizimbeni yethu. Mangisheshe ngicacise ukuthi umuthi wokuxubha akusiwo wodwa esithola kuwo iflouride, zikhona nezinye izinto ezifana namapani athile okupheka, amanzi komasipala abathile namakhemikhali okuzimotamota. Senza isibonelo ngomuthi wokuxubha ngoba yiwona oxhaphakile nosetshenziswa kakhulu ngabantu bakithi. Empeleni isikhathi esiningi umuthi wokuxubha usetshenziswa kabili ngosuku okuchaza ukuthi iflouride ekuwo iyona esiyithola kakhulu. Iflouride ingena emzimbeni ithathe izindawo zamanye amakhemikhali ngenxa yokuthi yona iyisilenda, ithi tshobe ingene. Ngiyacabanga sesiyazibuza ukuthi yiziphi lezi zindawo emzimbeni iflouride engena ngokushesha kuzona idale umonakalo?Kunendlala elapha emphinjeni ebizwa ngokuthi yi-thyroid gland. Le ndlala isebenza nge-protein okuthiwa yi-thyroglobulin. Ngokwendalo i-thyroglobulin isebenzisana ne-Iodine ukuze kwenzeke umsebenzi ngendlela efanele. Kodwa lokho ngeke kwenzeke uma kukhona iflouride emzimbeni ngoba ngokokwakheka iflouride incanyana, ilula kune-Iodine ngaleyo ndlela iflouride ivele iyozithi shwathe endaweni ye-Iodine. Ngale ndlela kuyaphazamiseka ukusebenza kwethyroid bese umuntu uyaqala uphathwa yikhanda elibuhlungu elingapheli, isiyezi, ibhalansi ilahleke ugcine usuhamba untengezele, izinyawo zivendlezele zishayisane, uqhaqhazele ushaywe uvalo olungakuyeki, ikhanda kube ngathi ungalibamba ulixukuze, abanye isikhumba siyashintsha sigqwale, uqumbelane kugcwale umoya esiswini, kube nomsinjwana ezindlebeni, ukhathale kakhulu kuvele kungathi ungadla ulele, amalunga omzimba abe buhlungu wonke nezicubu kusukela ekhanda kuya ezinyaweni.Iflouride iyangena igeleze ngegazi ize itheleke nasebuchosheni ikakhulu kule ndawana elawula ukukhiqizwa kwekhemikhali imelatonin umsebenzi wayo okungukwenza silale ngokwemvelo. Abantu asebengenwe yiflouride ababe besakwazi ukufikelwa ubuthongo okanye kube nzima satshe ukulala. Kumele sizibuze ukuthi sesingaze singalali, siqhaqhazele, sihlale sikhathele ngenxa yokungafuni ukuhlukana nomuthi wokuxubha sibuyele ekuxubheni ngomlotha nangelahle, ukuhlanganisile uma uthanda.Iflouride yansondo ayizibheki izidleke zokwakha amaqanda kwabesifazane nalezo zokuphehla imbewu yesilisa. Kunabantu abangabatholi abantwana ngenxa yokubakhona kweflouride ezidlekeni zamaqanda abo, uma beyohlola kuthiwe akukho olubi olutheni olubonakalayo kodwa bebe bengazitholi izingane. Umuntu ofuna izingane makahlukane nomuthi wokuxubha bese efuna udokotela ozokwazi ukumelapha iMitochondrio DysfunctionUthi bewazi nje ukuthi iflouride esuka emuthini wokuxubha iyakwazi ukuhamba iye kusinyaka, ipancreas; ishintshe ukusebenza kwalesi sikhondlandla sokulawula ushukela emzimbeni bese ziqala izinkinga ngosinyaka. Okuzolandela wukuhluleka ukulawula ushukela, kwabanye kube ngumdlavuza kasinyaka; izinkinga zande ngenxa yokwehluleka kwethu ukwehlukana nokuxubha ngomuthi ngisho sesibazi ubungozi bawo.Ngiyaphinda ngiyagcizelela ukuthi umthombo weflouride akuwona umuthi wokuxubha kuphela. Kukithi ukunakekela izimpilo zethu. Ukuhlukana nomuthi wokuxubha, uxubhe ngomlotha akuyona into enzima. Ukhuni lukhipha ilahle nomlotha, abantu bakithi emandulo babesebenzisa umlotha nelahle, benganukelwa mlomo futhi akaze babikwe ukugula. Yini ezoshintsha uma sekuyimi nawe?Mpilonde!!

Nabulala ingane ngesihluku. Nifanelwe ukufela ejele nina.”UNgcobo uthe kusenzima ukwamukela indlela okwabulawa ngayo indodakazi yakhe eyayinephupho lokuba ngusomabhizinisi ogxile kwezolimo."Indokazi yami encane, elama uWandile, ihamba odokotela, ithola ukweluleka ngokwengqondo ngenxa yesimo esasehlela. Kwamina angikho kahle emoyeni. Lona ofaka ibheyili sifuna angayinuki, balunge besejele,” kusho uNgcobo.Isidumbu sikaWandile, owayengumfundi kaGrade 11, eDurban Girls Secondary, satholakala kubo ngoMeyi nonyaka, siboshwe izandla nge-pentihose, elinye lifakwe emlonyeni, sinamanxeba amahlanu okugwazwa. Kusolakala ukuthi wadlwengulwa.Kuthiwa umufi wayengabhali izivivinyo ngosuku lwesehlo, eyedwa kubo. Esebulewe, kuthiwa kwebiwa iTV, iDStv decoder, i-remote neselula kamufi.Yiyona iselula abaphenyi okuthiwa bayithola kuJali kwase kuboshwa noBhengu owayesebhace KwaShembe, eClermont.Ngesikhathi sesigameko uBhengu wayengaphandle ngoshwele onikwa iziboshwa ngecala ayelidonsela.
KUCHITHEKE uphoko izolo ngesikhathi abazali bezingane ezifunda eCopesville Secondary School, eMgungundlovu, bevala amasango esikole ngenxa yombango wesikweletu samanzi nogesi sikamasipala sika-R3.6 million.Abazali bakhetha ukubhikisha nje sekuphele izinyanga ezimbili iCopesville ivalelwe amanzi nogesi wuMasipala Umsunduzi. Izolo othisha nabafundi bagcine ngokubuyela emakhaya ngenxa yalo mbhikisho. Obekulo mbhikisho, uMnuz Mxolisi Nxumalo ongumzali, uthe uma uMnyango ungaqhamuki nesixazululo kulolu daba, bazophoqeleka ukuthi namhlanje bavukele emasangweni esikole benze okufanayo.Isikole sekuneminyaka sikhungethwe yinkinga yamanzi nogesi. Isolezwe like labika phambilini kunezikhalo ngokungasebenzi kwamathoyilethi ngenxa yokungabi khona kwamanzi obekuphoqa ukuthi isikole siphume ngo-10 ekuseni. Sekuphindile futhi. Efakazela lokhu, uMnuz Nxumalo uthe: "Vele izingane ayikho into eziyifundayo ngoba zingena ngo-8, ngabo- 10 seziyadedelwa ziya emakhaya ngoba amanzi awekho. Isimo othisha abafundisa ngaphansi kwaso sibi. U-matric yiwona olimala kakhulu, yingakho sinqume ukusukuma ukuze kusizakale izingane nothisha,” usho kanje.USihlalo wesigungu esilawula isikole, uMnuz Mthuthuzeli Gasa, uthe kuyiqiniso ukuthi isikole siyawukweleta umasipala, kodwa ngesikhathi bevezelwa isamba bathuke boma."Emva kokuthi umasipala uvale amanzi ngo-Agasti, kuvele ukuthi isikole sikweleta u-R3.6 million walezi zidingo. Besigcine ngonyaka odlule ngoJuni ukukhokha. Imvamisa imali ebesiyikhokha u-R20 000 ngenyanga, kodwa umasipala uma ubheka amaphepha, uyinyuse yaba wu-R200 000 ngenyanga okuyinto esishaqisayo ukuthi yenzeka kanjani,” usho kanje.Uthe uMnyango ubayalele ukuthi yena nothishomkhulu basayine encwadini efungelwe ukuthi isikole sikweleta le mali ukuze ukhokhele umasipala okuyinto abayenqabile. Uthe ukuvuma kwabo kuzobe kusho ukuthi isikole sizohlala iminyaka ewu-15 singasitholi isabelomali esiphelele njengoba uMnyango uzothi usakhokha lesi sikweletu. Uveze ukuthi ngesikhathi kufika aboMnyango wemiSebenzi kaHulumeni, bakuvezile ukuthi kungenzeka ukuthi kunamapayipi avuzayo okumele ambiwe kufakwe amasha."Okwenza sibone ukuthi kunokungahambi kahle ngale mali okuthiwa ikweletwa yisikole, kuthe ngoSepthemba sekuvalwe amanzi nogesi sihambela emahhovisi kamasipala, sathola ukuthi isikole sekuthiwa sesikweleta u-R4 million. U-R400 000 ngaphezulu ungene kanjani ekubeni lezi zidingo bese zivele zivaliwe” kubuza uMnuz Gasa.Kuthintwa okhulumela uMasipala Umsunduzi, uNkk Ntobeko Mkhize, uthe zikhona izikole ebezikweleta umasipala ebezivalelwe lezi zidingo kodwa ngokungenela koMnyango, kwavulwa."Umasipala uyasebenzisana noMnyango wezeMfundo. Uma sisekhona isikole esivalelwe lezi zidingo, sicela beze kumasipala uma kukhona izikhalo bazibeke obala ukuze kutholakale isixazululo,” usho kanje.Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Muzi Mahlambi, unxuse abazali ukuthi babekezele bangaphazamisi uhlelo lokufunda kulesi sikole."Sinazo izinhlelo esinazo njengoMnyango, ukuthi njengoba izingane zisheshe ziphume sizokwenzenjani ukulekelela. Njengomnyango sisuke sazi ukuthi uma kube nokuphazamiseka, yikuphi okumele sikwenze ukuze kuhlangatshezwe isikhathi esilahlekile,” usho kanje.Kusuka lesi siphithiphithi nje, ngeviki elizayo kuzoqala izivivinyo zika-matric zokuphela konyaka.

UKUQOKWA kobuholi obusha bebhodi lenkampani ephehla amandla kagesi u-Eskom, ngenye yezinto ezibe nomthelela omuhle ekushabalaliseni uhlelo lokucishwa kukagesi ngenhloso yokuwokunga kuleli.Lokhu kudalulwe izolo nguNgqongqoshe woMnyango kaGesi naMandla uDkt Kgosientsho Ramokgopa, esithangamini nabezindaba eFree State. URamokgopa ubenekela abezindaba ngezinhlelo namaqhinga asetshenziswa yile nkampani njengoba bekuwusuku luka-201 uhlelo lokucishwa kukagesi ngenhloso yokuwonga lamiswa.Leli bhodi elisha laqokwa nguMengameli kuleli uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa ngo-Okthoba 2022, kanti uRamokgopa uthe amagalelo alo nokusebenza ngokuzikhandla ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinga lokuphakelwa kwamandla kagesi kuleli liya ngokuba ngcono, kuyabonakala."Bakhombisile ukuthi bayayazi into abayenzayo ngokuqinisekisa ukusebenzisa ulwazi abanalo ukuze kusizakale izakhamizi zakuleli. Uma kukhona izinselelo, bahlale bekhona ukusilekelela,” usho kanje uDkt Ramokgopa.Kuvele ukuthi ugesi omosheka ngokungahleliwe ubengu-25% phakathi kuka-Ephreli 1, 2024 no-Okthoba, 10, 2024. Abakwa-Eskom bathi lokhu kwenze ngcono isimo ngo-34.03% uma kuqhathaniswa ngesikhathi esifanayo nyakenye. Kuthiwa ukwehla kokulahleka kukagesi kulekelela ngo- 8,6% ekuphuculeni isimo sokuphakelwa kwamandla kagesi.URamokqopa uthe ngu-5 521MW wamandla kagesi ahlelelwe ukulungiswa kwengqalasizinda kagesi ngoba kungene ihlobo nokuqinisekisa ukuthi iziphehlimandla zikagesi zisebenza kahle uma sekungena ubusika ngonyaka ozayo nangale kwabo.Amandla kagesi ami ku-63,1% phakathi kuka-Ephreli 1, 2024 no-Okthoba 10, 2024 okuthiwa akhule ngo- 7,7% uma ukuqhathanisa nangesikhathi esifanayo ngonyaka odlule lapho abengu- 55,4%.Uma kubhekwa amandla kagesi isonto nesonto, le nkampani iveze ukuthi angu-60.0%, akhuphuke ngo-3,6% uma kuqhathaniswa namasonto okuqala alonyaka wezimali.

UKUSHAYELE elikhulu uhlombe ukusebenza kwamaphoyisa uNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, kulandela ukubulawa ngamaphoyisa kwabanye abasolwa ababili ngoMgqibelo, abathinteka esigamekweni sokuqothwa komndeni eHlokozi.Abasolwa kuthiwa basale enkundleni emva kokudubulana namaphoyisa eMlaza, eThekwini. Kuvela ukuthi abasolwa batholana phezulu namaphoyisa nje, bebesendleleni ukuyogeza isinyama enyangeni eMlaza. Kubona kuvela ukuthi kukhona nesihlobo ebesisolwa ngokuba sekhaleni esibhicongweni esadlula nemiphefumulo yabayisikhombisa ngasekuqaleni kukaSepthemba. Kubona kwakukhona umama wekhaya uNkk Bahlakaniphile Khambule (64), indodakazi yakhe uPhilile (39), umalokazana uNompilo (34), isihlobo uSikhumbuzo Khambule nabazukulu uLisa (9), Siphosethu (9) noZemvelo (5).UNtuli uthe uyakuncoma okwenziwe izinhlaka zomthetho ngokubulala abanye abasolwa."Muhle umsebenzi owenziwe amaphoyisa. Ithimba lamaphoyisa eliboshelwe ukusebenza leli cala, lenze umsebenzi oncomekayo,” kusho uNtuli.Nokho uveze ukuthi kusafanele aqhubeke nokusebenza amaphoyisa ukuze kutholakale labo ababethume abasolwa ukuthi bayoqotha imbokodo nesisekelo kwaKhambule, wanxusa nomphakathi ukuthi usebenzisane namaphoyisa kuleli cala ukuze kwenzeke ubulungiswa obuphelele.Ngokusho kokhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshuinda, abasolwa badutshulwe emva kokuba bevulele ngenhlamvu emaphoyiseni esikhundleni sokuma njengoba abebayalele ukuthi bamise imoto ebebehamba ngayo endaweni yesigameko."Kuvele imibiko yokuthi bebesendleleni beyogeza, babhadanywe amaphoyisa besesemgwaqweni u-Old South Coast, eMlaza,” kusho uNetshiunda.Uthe amaphoyisa ngesikhathi esesha imoto yabasolwa athole izibhamu ezimbili, okuthe uma zibhekwa, zayamaniswa nesigameko saseHlokozi.NgoLwesibili olwedlule, omunye umkhondo wamaphoyisa ngenhlekelele yaseHlokozi, waholela ekutheni amaphoyisa adubule abulale abasolwa ababili. Kuleso siwombe kwagcina kushona nowesifazane owayesemotweni yabasolwa, kwathi umsolwa oyedwa owayesemotweni naye, wadla phansi. Nakuso lesi sigameko amaphoyisa aveza ukuthi abasolwa bavele badubula bebhekise kuwo ngesikhathi ebamisa, nawo ase ebuyisela ngalo izulu lezandla.Ucingo lwesihlobo, uNksz Dudu Khambule, lukhale lwaze lwayeka sithintwa ukuze siphawule.Umthombo weSolezwe, uthe kuye ngamagama enkehli, amaphoyisa ethela othulini nesihlobo ngesikhathi kunokudubulana phakathi kwawo nabasolwa eMlaza.
ICALA lenkohlakalo nokukhwabanisa elibhekene nowayengumengameli, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, nenkampani yezikhali yaseFrance, lizophinde libuyele eNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu, ekuqaleni konyaka ozayo.Icala lizobuya ngoFebhuwari nje, lo nyaka kanye nowedlule ize yaphela golokoqo kungaqaliwe ukuqulwa kwalo.Njalo uma icala belisenkantolo, bekufika kube nemidonsiswano yezemthetho, lize liguqe bengakaze babizwe ofakazi.Noma selibuya ngonyaka ozayo, ngeke liqale ukuqulwa njengoba kuzolalelwa isicelo esiseceleni, okuzothatha isikhathi eside ukuthi siqedwe.Maningi amathuba okuthi nawo unyaka ozayo uzophela golokoqo icala lingaqulwanga.Okwenzeka ecaleni kukwenza uzibuze ukuthi libhekephi, nokuthi ngabe izwe liyoke lazi nje ukuthi ngempela kwenzekani esivumelwaneni sokuthengwa kwezikhali esingundabamlonyeni.Izwe lasayina isivumelwano sokuthengwa kwezikhali sikaR30 billion, emuva kokusayinwa kwalesi sivumelwano kwabe sekuba nezinsolo zenkohlakalo.Ukungena kwecala enkantolo kwanikeza ithemba lokuthi izwe lizokwazi ukuthi kwenzekani ngalezi zigidi zamaRandi.Nakuba uZuma athweswa icala ngokusemthethweni okokuqala eminyakeni engu-20 eyedlule, akukaze kuqale ukuqulwa kwalo.Into esiyibonile kule minyaka icala lisezithebeni zenkantolo, imidonsiswano ebambezela ukuqala kokuqulwa kwalo.Kuleli cala uZuma umangalelwe nenkampani ekhiqiza izikhali yaseFrance, iThales, eyahlomula ngesikhathi elakuleli lithenga izikhali eminyakeni engu-20 eyedlule.UZuma usolwa ngokwamukela intshontsho likaR500 000 laminyaka yonke kule nkampani.Owayengumeluleki wakhe wezezimali, uMnuz Schabir Shaik, wagwetshelwa icala lenkohlakalo eliyamaniswa nale thenda.Ngesikhathi icala livuswa ngo-2018, kwakunethemba lokuthi lizoqulwa liqedwe ngokushesha.Ukuqulwa kwalo kuzonikeza uMbuso ithuba lokubiza ofakazi, uveze nabo bonke obunye ubufakazi onabo.Kuzophinde kunikeze noZuma ithuba lokuthi achaze akwaziyo. Usekusho kaningi uZuma ukuthi uyafisa ukuthola ithuba lokuziphendulela enkantolo.Indlela leli cala elihambe ngayo kulo nyaka, kucacile ukuthi luselude ukhalo.Leli cala ligcine ukungena eNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu ngenyanga edlule, lizobuya ngasekuqaleni konyaka ozayo.Uma icala selibuya ngonyaka ozayo kuzolalelwa isicelo sikaZuma lapho ephonsela inselelo isinqumo senkantolo esachitha isicelo sokuba kushenxe umshushisi omkhulu ecaleni, u-Advocate Billy Downer. Isicelo sokuthi kushenxe uDowner sathathwa iJaji Nkosinathi Chili, ngasekuqaleni konyaka. Lesi bese kuyisicelo sesibili sikaZuma sokuxhenxisa uDowner.UZuma wenza isicelo sokuqala sokuba kushenxe uDowner, ngo-2021.Wenza lesi sicelo nje uMbuso wase uvivele ukuba kuqale ukuqulwa kwecala.Ufakazi wokuqala woMbuso, uNkk Patricia de Lille, wayekhona enkantolo ngalolu suku, elungele ukugibela ebhokisini lofakazi.UNkk de Lille, onguNgqongqoshe wezokuVakasha, uyena owabhoboza ithumba ngenkohlakalo esolwa esivumelwaneni sezigidi zamaRandi sokuthengwa kwezikhali.Nokho u-De Lille akazange agibele ebhokisini lofakazi njengoba isicelo sikaZuma sasho ukuthi kufanele kumiswe ukuqulwa kwecala.Esicelweni sakhe uZuma wayesola uDowner ngokuchema nongokuputshuzela izintatheli ulwazi ngaleli cala.Isicelo sikaZuma sachithwa iJaji Piet Koen, kepha kwabambezeleka ukuqulwa kwecala ngenxa yokuthi uZuma wasidlulisela phambili isinqumo senkantolo.Emva kwalokho icala lalilokhu libuya enkantolo, lifike lihlehliswe ngenxa yokuthi kwakusalindwe iNkantolo yokuDlulisa amaCala ukuthi inqume esicelweni sikaZuma.INkantolo yokuDlulisa amaCala yamchitha uZuma.UZuma waphikelela, waya eNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo, nokwasho ukubambezeleka futhi kwecala.Ngesikhathi uZuma echithwa iNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo, wafaka isicelo sesibili sokuba kushenxe uDowner.Lapha uZuma wayefuna ukuthi uDonwer ashenxe ngenxa yokuthi kwakunecala lapho uZuma ayezishushisela mathupha uDowner.Kuleli cala elaliseNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu, uZuma wayeshushisa uDowner nentatheli yeziko lezindaba, wayesola uDowner ngokuputshuzela intatheli ulwazi oluyimfihlo ngempilo yakhe.Nokho icala elifakwe uZuma lachithwa yiyo le nkantolo, waphinde wachithwa nayiNkantolo yokuDlulisa amaCala.Njengamanje uZuma ufake isicelo eNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo, lapho ephonsela inselelo ukuchithwa kwecala lapho ezishushisela uDowner nentatheli.Ukuphonsela kukaZuma ukuhoxiswa kwecala yikho okube imbangela enkulu yokungaqali ukuqula icala kulo nyaka.Ngenyanga eyedlule uChili wethula izizathu zakhe zokuchitha isicelo sikaZuma sesibili sokuba kushenxe uDowner.UChili wathi uZuma usebenzisa amaphuzu aseke wachithwa kuwo izinkantolo ngaphambilini."Awekho amathuba okuthi enye inkantolo ingafinyelela esinqumweni esehlukile kunaleso engifinyelele kuso.”Njengamanje zombili izinhlangothi zilungiselela amaphuzu ezizowasebenzisa uma uZuma esefaka isicelo sokudlulisela phambili isicelo sikaChili.Icala lizobuyela enkantolo ngoFebhuwari.UMbuso usuvele usushilo ukuthi uzosiphikisa isicelo sikaZuma.Njalo uma kubambezeleka ukuqulwa kwecala, kuhlezi kunenkombankombane, uMbuso nabameli bakaZuma besolana ngokubambezela icala.UMbuso uhlezi usola uZuma ngokusebenzisa amaqhinga okubambezela, abameli bakaZuma bona bahlezi bethi kufanele kugxekwe uMbuso ngokubambezeleka kwecala.Abameli bakaZuma bahlezi bethi ukuba uMbuso uyavuma ukushenxisa uDowner ngabe kade icala laqulwa laqedwa.Kuzobonakala kulo nyaka ukuthi kuzoqala yini ukuqulwa kwecala.
IROAD Accident Fund (RAF) isamukele isigwebo esinikezwe owayeyisisebenzi sayo ngemuva kokulahlwa amacala enkohlakalo.NgoMsombuluko mhla ka-14 Okthoba 2024, iDurban Specialised Commercial Crime Court igwebe uNobuhle Magwaza (45) ngecala lenkohlakalo eyenzeka ngesikhathi eqashwe yiRoad Accident Fund (RAF). NgoNovemba 2019, uMagwaza waqashwa njenge-claims and legal officer. Ngesikhathi esebenza wafuna imali engu-R500 000.00 kumgilwa. Wacela u-R50 000.00 ukuba akhokhwe ngokheshi kuthi imali esele engu-R450 000.00 ifakwe kwi-akhawunti yakhe yasebhange uma isicelo sesiphelile.Lesi sikhulu sacela ukubongwa umgilwa ukuze sisheshise ukucutshungulwa nokugunyazwa kwesicelo sika-R2.7 million okwakufanele umgilwa awuthole. Icala lenkohlakalo labikwa emalungwini oKlebe ophikweni lwe-Durban Serious Corruption Investigation kwase kwenziwa umkhankaso owumshoshaphansi.UMagwaza waboshwa ngoFebhuwari 2020 wadedelwa ngebheyili. Uvele kaningi enkantolo kwaze kwaba wukuthi utholwa enecala. Ugwetshwe iminyaka engu-12 ebhadla ejele iminyaka emibili yalengiswa iminyaka emihlanu. Ngaleyo ndlela uMagwaza uzodonsa iminyaka engu-10 ebhadla ejele.Isikhulu esiphezulu se-RAF, uCollins Letsoalo, sithe: "Isigwebo siyisiphetho esifanelekile sesikhwama kanye namaphoyisa. Kukhomba ukuthi imizamo yethu yokuqeda inkohlakalo ngaphakathi nangaphandle kwesikhungo sethu ithela izithelo. I-RAF izoqhubeka nokuqapha inkohlakalo eyenziwa abasebenzi, abafake izicelo, abameli, ochwepheshe bezokwelapha nabanye abathintekayo.”Uqhubeke wathi kwenziwa uphenyo lwangaphakathi olwaholela ekumisweni kwabasebenzi abayisikhombisa (7) phakathi kuka-2020/21 kanye 2022/23. Abasebenzi abayisithupha (6) bashiya emsebenzini ngesikhathi kuqhubeka uphenyo noma ukulalelwa kwecala kusukela ngo-2020/21 kuya ku-2022/23.
I-MK imunyunga eyokuzishushisela mathupha uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, ngecala lokwebiwa kwezishaqane zamaDola aseMelika epulazini lakhe, iPhala Phala.Inhlangano yezokushushisa, iNational Prosecuting Authority (NPA), isanda kuthatha isinqumo sokungamshushisi uRamaphosa, ikhala ngokuthi mancane amathuba okuthi ashushiswe ngempumelelo.USotswebhu we-MK ePhalamende, uMnuz Mzwanele Manyi, ubuze abe-NPA ukuthi bazosikhipha yini isitifiketi esishoyo ukuthi ayizukumshushisa uRamaphosa?UManyi ubekhuluma ngesikhathi kuqhubeka umhlangano wekomiti lasePhalamende elibhekelele ukusebenza koMnyango wezoBulungiswa.Ukukhishwa kwesitifiketi kuzonikeza i-MK ithuba lokuthi izishushisele uRamaphosa.URamaphosa wavulelwa icala ngowayengumphathi wezinhloli, uMnuz Arthur Fraser, owayemsola ngokungawabikeli amaphoyisa ngokuntshontshwa kwemali ewu-$580 000 (R10 million) eyantshontshwa ngo-2020.Ngeledlule i-NPA ithe ubufakazi bukaFraser abubambeki.Ekhuluma emhlanganweni wangoLwesihlanu, uManyi ugxeke isinqumo se-NPA sokunqaba ukushushisa uRamaphosa, wacela i-NPA ukuba ikhiphe isitifiketi ngokushesha khona uRamaphosa ezoshushiswa eceleni.Inhloko ye-NPA, u-Advocate Shamila Batohi, ithe loyo ofuna isitifiketi sokuthi i-NPA angeke imshushise uRamaphosa kufanele afake isicelo esisemthethweni.U-Advocate Batohi ube esekhipha isexwayiso esishubile."Lesi simo siveza obala ubungozi bokuzishushisela mathupha. Kufanele senze isiqiniseko sokuthi kunemithetho evimba ukuthi abantu bangasebenzisi indaba yokuzishushisela mathupha ukulwa izimpi zabo. Njengathi nje siyi-NPA, kunemithetho esisebenza ngaphansi kwayo.”Isinqumo se-NPA sokungashushisi uRamaphosa sigxekwe amaqembu ezepolitiki amaningi.Umholi we-DA, uMnuz John Steenhuisen, uthe bafuna impendulo egcwele kwi-NPA ngalolu daba, wathi bafuna ukuthi i-NPA ibizelwe phambi kwekomiti lasePhalamende izochaza ngesinqumo sayo.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba, ngoLwesihlanu."Isinqumo esinjengalesi kufanele sichazwe kahle ngoba sithinta abantu abasezikhundleni eziphezulu.”Udaba lwasePhala Phala luyaqhubeka nokuba iphela endlebeni kuRamaphosa.Umholi we-MK ePhalamende, uDkt John Hlophe, uveze ukuthi uzombuza uRamaphosa ngalolu daba uma esephendula imibuzo ePhalamende ngoLwesine.Ngenyanga ezayo kuzongena icala elifakwe yi-EFF eNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo.I-EFF ifuna kuchithwe isinqumo sePhalamende esachitha umbiko weJaji esalathatha umhlalaphansi, uSandile Ngcobo, owathola ukuthi kungenzeka ukuthi kukhona imithetho ayiphulayo uRamaphosa.
BALALE bebaliwe abasebenzi bakuMasipala waseMsunduzi ababanjwe oqotsheni beba upethroli womkhandlu.Abasebenzi ababili bomkhandlu bazithele phezu kukanoxhaka ngoLwesihlanu, ngesikhathi bethulula izigubhu zikapethroli elolini lomkhandlu, bezifaka evenini okungesilona elomkhandlu.Laba basebenzi baboshwe nabanye abasolwa abathathu abangasebenzeli umasipala.Oyedwa umsebenzi uqashwe wumasipala ngokugcwele, omunye uyitoho.Kuthiwa laba basebenzi bese bekwenze kwayinto yabo ukuntshontsha upethroli njalo ngoLwesihlanu, kuthiwa ababuzanga elangeni ngoLwesihlanu olwedlule, njengoba bebecushelwe unoxhaka.Imenenja kamasipala ebabambile, uNkk Nelisiwe Ngcobo, ithe bese kunezinyanga bephenya ngokusetshenziswa ngokweqile kukapethroli.UNkk Ngcobo uthe njalo ngoLwesihlanu, abasolwa bebethatha inqwaba kapethroli, bethi uzosetshenziswa ezimotweni zomkhandlu.UNkk Ngcobo uthe ithimba elihlanganisa izinhlaka zezokuphepha ezahlukene libe selinquma ukucuphela abasolwa umgogo."Uphiko lwezokuphenya lwangaphakathi eMsunduzi lukwazile ukulandela iloli ebihamba abasolwa. Abophiko lwezokuphenya bafice iloli limile e-Edendale. Abasolwa bebematasa behlisa izigubhu zikapethroli elolini, bezifaka evenini.”UNkk Ngcobo uthe baphinde bamisa abasebenzi bomkhandlu abathathu njengoba kusaqhubeka uphenyo ngokuntshontshwa kophethroli womkhandlu."Abasebenzi abathathu bamisiwe kuze kube kuphothulwa uphenyo. Inhloso yophenyo ukuthola ukuthi ngabe wande kangakanani umkhuba wokwebiwa kopethroli. Sifuna ukuthola bonke abathintekayo kulo mkhuba siphinde sithole ubufakazi obanele esingakwazi ukubusebenzisa ezinkantolo uma sesivulela abathintekayo amacala okweba.”UNkk Ngcobo uthe bazothathelwa izinyathelo bonke abathinteka enkohlakalweni."Sifuna ukuthumela umyalezo oqinile kubasebenzi bethu nomphakathi wonkana, wokuthi akekho umuntu ongaphezu komthetho. Umasipala uyaqhubeka nokulwa nenkohlakalo, ukukhwabanisa nazo zonke izinto eziphambene nomthetho ezenzekayo.”UNkk Ngcobo uthe izenzo zenkohlakalo nokukhwabanisa ziphazamisa ukuhanjiswa kwezidingo."Ukuntshontshwa nokucekelwa phansi kwempahla yomkhandlu kuphazamisa ukusebenza komkhandlu, kwenza ukuthi umkhandlu ungakwazi ukuhambisa izidingo ngokushesha. Ingakho sinxusa amalungu omphakathi ukuba abe yizindlebe namehlo ethu. Sinxusa amalungu omphakathi ukuthi abike uma ebona izinto eziphambene nomthetho.”Okhulumela amaphoyisa eKZN uColonel Robert Netshuinda, uthe amaphoyisa abophe abasolwa abahlanu bavela enkantolo ngoLwesihlanu.
UFIHLWE esebuya ezweni iNigeria owesilisa wakwa-G eMlaza, kuphambana izidumbu emakhazeni aseThekwini, i-Wyebank Funeral Services.UMnuz Sifiso "Ncence” Zibane (50) obekumele angcwatshwe ngoMgqibelo, ugcine esengcwatshwa ngeSonto. Umufi washona engozini yomgwaqo enkabeni yeTheku, evukwa isifo sokudlikiza eshayela. Indodakazi yakhe, uNksz Olwethu Zibane, ithe umndeni ithole ngale nsambatheka ngoLwesihlanu ntambama, izihlobo ziyolanda isidumbu."Bafike bakhonjiswa isidumbu somuntu esingamazi, ebese silungisiwe, safakwa kahle ebhokisini. Babone zisuka nje ukuthi akusiye ubaba,” kusho uNksz Zibane.Uthe emva kokuveza ukuthi abamazi lo muntu, izisebenzi ebezikhona zishayele esinye esalanda uZibane emakhazeni kahulumeni ePhoenix, sona sathinta umnikazi wamakhaza, kwavela izinsolo zokuthi uyiswe eNigeria.INDODAKAZI kamufi, uNksz Olwethu Zibane, ichaza ukusuka nokuhlala kokuphambana kwesidumbu sikayise nesomuntu waseNigeria Isithombe: SIBONELO NGCOBOUNksz Zibane uthe abamakhaza bagcine beqinisekisa ukuthi wuye uZibane oyiswe eNigeria, wathi kuvele ukuthi wahamba ngoLwesibili. Uthe udlule ezikhumulweni zezindiza ezehlukene, okukhona kuzo iKing Shaka, OR Tambo nesaseNigeria."Ngesikhathi okuvele ngaso ukuthi kuhanjiswe umuntu ongafanele, sizwe kuthiwa ubeqeda kufika esikhumulweni sezindiza saseNigeria,” kubeka uNksz Zibane.IBHOKISI elinomufi uMnuz Sifiso Zibane etendeni eSikhumbuzo Primary lapho obekuqhubeka khona inkonzo yomngcwabo Isithombe: SIBONELO NGCOBOUthe kuphoqe ukuthi kuxhunyanwe nge-video call ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi wuye ngempela uyise lo ozobuyiswa eNigeria.Ukhale ngobudedengu obungachazeki kwabamakhaza."Izihlobo zike zaya emakhazeni ekuqaleni kwesonto, zabuya zigculisekile ngokuthi unombolwe kahle ephepheni elifakwa kubhozo wesidumbu. Belinemininingwane eqondile kababa, ukuthi kwenzeke kanjani ukuthi agcine eseyiswa eNigeria, asazi,” kusho yena.IBHOKISI elinomufi uMnuz Sifiso Zibane likhishwa emotweni yamakhaza i-Wyebank Funeral Services, siyofakwa etendeni eSikhumbuzo Primary, lapho obekuqhubeka khona inkonzo yomngcwabo Isithombe: SIBONELO NGCOBOUphinde wathi okunye okwenza basole abamakhaza ngobudedengu, ukuthi lesi sidumbu somuntu waseNigeria, bathole ukuthi wayefe ngokudutshulwa."Bamphambanisa kanjani umuntu onamanxeba okudutshulwa nomuntu ofe ngengozi yemoto?” kubuza uNksz Zibane.Uphinde wahlaba eyokuthi bathole ukuthi lona waseNigeria wayelokhu efakwe kula makhaza ngoSepthemba, ewumuntu ongaziwa.UMUFI uMnuz Sifiso Zibane Isithombe: SITHUNYELWE"Bamphambanise kanjani nomuntu ongeniswe emakhazeni ngo-Okthoba futhi obaziwa ukuthi ungubani wakwabani?” Uthe okubaphatha kabi ukuthi bezwe kuthiwa izihlobo zikamufi waseNigeria bezihlela ukuthi zifike zimshise "othandiweyo wazo” uma efika."Bacishe bashisa ubaba. Asazi besizoba yini ukube kugcine kwenzeke kanjalo,” usho kanje.Uphinde wakhala ngokungasingathwa ngozwelo kodaba sekutholakele ukuthi kwenzeke iphutha, ethi kukhona lapho esinye isisebenzi esivele sabatshela ukuthi "Uma ebuya, uyabuya. Uma engabuyi, uyobe akabuyi”.Uthe kuphoqe ukuthi baqhinqe emahhovisi amakhaza kuMoore Road, nakuba sisheshe sabuya isidumbu sikayise.Udalule ukuthi ngaphambi kokuthi umndeni, abangani nosomatekisi (njengoba umufi ebesembonini) bavuke umbhejazane, basabise ngokulingqongqisa ngomlilo ihhovisi lamakhaza, bebetshelwe ukuthi kuzothatha isonto lonke ukuthi umufi abuyiswe."Sifuna ukubafaka icala ngabakwenze kithi. Bukhulu ubuhlungu abasizwise bona. Izihlobo esezikhulile kumanje ziyagula ngenxa yalesi sigameko. Nobaba wethu bamhlukumezile bemehlisa bemenyusa. Thina singabantu abamnyama, siyayazisa indaba yokuhlonishwa komuntu osethule,” kubeka uNksz Zibane.Uveze nokuthi umndeni uzoligqabula igoda leminyaka lokusebenzisa phakathi kwawo nabamakhaza.Kuthintwa abamakhaza bathe sebelulekwe uphiko lwawo lwezomthetho ukuthi bathunyelelwe ulwazi iphephandaba elinalo ngodaba nge-email okuze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela ingakaphendulwa.
UBANJWE ebhace emfuleni onehlathi elincane owesilisa obhokode ngommese unina nabanye bomndeni abayisithupha eBethany, eBergville, ngoMgqibelo ebusuku, kwashona abahlanu.Kubikwa ukuthi lo wesilisa oneminyaka engu-33, uhambe nomalume wakhe baya emzini ongumakhelwane.Kuvela ukuthi baphinde babuya, kanti umsolwa uzofica unina ehleli egumbini lokuphumula namanye amalungu omndeni."Umsolwa ubone ummese obukade ukusofa, wawuthatha wagwaza unina ngawo kodwa wakwazi ukuphuma endlini abaleke. Ube esejikela kumalume wakhe, wamgwaza washona ezama ukubalekela emzini kamakhelwane,” kusho okhulumela amaphoyisa eKZN, uColonel Robert Netshiunda.UNetshiunda uthe umsolwa uphinde wagwaza wabulala owesifazane obekade ephila nokukhubazeka nezingane ezimbili - eneminyaka emibili neneyisithupha. Kuthiwa umsolwa ubuye wagwaza wabulala owesifazane osekhulile obevakashele kubo. "Unina kamufi nengane yentombazane eneminyaka emine bagwazwe amanxeba amaningi kodwa basindile. Udadewabo kamsolwa nengane yakhe enonyaka basinde ngokulambisa,” kusho uNetshiunda.Uthe umsolwa uboshiwe wathweswa amacala amahlanu okubulala namabili okuzama ukubulala. Kulindeleke ukuthi avele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseBergville, ngoLwesibili.Ikhansela lendawo, uMnuz Tito Khoza, lichaze umsolwa njengomuntu obhema insangu, ohluphayo futhi onezigigaba zokuhlupha.UKhoza ulandise wathi ushayelwe ucingo ngowomndeni ngabo-9 ebusuku, emazisa ukuthi umsolwa uyabagwaza bayisikhombisa.Ikhansela lithe lifike emuva kwemizuzu emithathu kulo muzi obiza isibongo esifana nesalo, elakhelene nawo futhi eliwuthatha njengomndeni."Bekucishwe ugesi abantu bonke bengaphandle, unina kamsolwa nengane eneminyaka emine bopha. Bangitshele ukuthi umsolwa usengaphakathi endlini, ngangena nabantu ekade ngihamba nabo samcinga, sangamthola,” kuchaza uKhoza.Uthe bacinge amaswishi kagesi bawathola, base bekhanyisa, nokuyilapho bebone khona ababulewe belele phansi kodwa besashisa ngoba bekuyinto ebikade isanda kwenzeka.Uyichaze indawo yesigameko njengebinyantisa igazi."Kwabashonile kube umamkhulu kamsolwa, umalume wakhe, owesifazane okhubazekile nabashana bakhe ababili. Ingane encane ebulewe ibisafaka inabukeni, igwazwe amathumbu ayo aphumela ngaphandle, ilele phansi ngakusofa. Enye eneminyaka eyisithupha ibilele kuvelanda, ubona ukuthi ibizama ukubaleka kwangenzeka,” kulandisa uKhoza.UKhoza uthe eduzane kukasofa bekunesidumbu sikamamkhulu nesowesifazane ohamba ngesihlalo esinamasondo, esikamalume kamsolwa sisephaseji eliphumela kwamakhelwane.Ikhansela lithe libe seliphuthumisa emtholampilo wendawo unina kamsolwa nengane eneminyaka emine ebekade belimele kanzima."Ngibuye lapho saqhubeka sacinga umsolwa. Angilalanga elokhu ecingwe izolo (ngoMgqibelo) size samuthola (ngeSonto) ngokubambisana nomphakathi.Ubecashe emfuleni onehlathi elincane. Ubonwe umfana olusa izinkomo kwawuyena ohlaba ikhwelo, kwasho ukuthi sicingela ngakhona, sakwazi ukumbamba nalaba ebengihamba nabo ngemoto, amaphoyisa abeseduze,” kuchaza uKhoza.IMeya kaMasipala wasoKhahlamba, uMnuz Vikizitha Mlotshwa, ikuchaze njengenhlekelele okwenzeke kulo mndeni.UMlotshwa uthe uzoyithinta iminyango kahulumeni ukuze iluleke umndeni, othisha nezingane zesikole eThokoza High eyakhelene nomuzi."Sizoya kohlanganisa amehlo nomndeni ngoMsombuluko. Sekuyinhlekelele lena, into engejwayelekile. Umasipala kumele usukume ulekekele kuze kuyofika ekufihlweni. Sifuna (umsolwa) anganikwa ibheyili aboshwe, abolele ejele,” kusho uMlotshwa.
ITHUSE noMengameli wezwe, uCyril Ramaphosa, eyokushona ngokuzuma kowayengungqongqoshe wezeziMali, uDkt Tito Mboweni, okuthiwa ubekhombisa ukuba umqemane.URamaphosa uthe indlela uMboweni abenomfutho ngayo ibingakhombisi ukuthi izinsuku zakhe sezibaliwe."Indlela abexhumana ngayo nabantu baseNingizumu Afrika yenza ukuthi kusithuse ukushona kwakhe eneminyaka engu-65.”La mazwi ananelwe owayeyimeya kaMasipala waseGoli, uDkt Mpho Palatse, othe uMboweni ubekhombisa ukuba umqemane ngesikhathi benomhlangano emasontweni amabili edlule."Wayenomfutho lo esimazi ngawo. Wanginikeza izeluleko ezibalulekile. Ngangingazi ukuthi sengimbona okokugcina.”UMboweni ushonele esibhedlela ngoMgqibelo ebusuku, emva kokugula isikhashana.Umfowabo kaMboweni, uMnuz Alto Mboweni, uthe umfowabo ushone engungwe asondelene nabo."Njengomndeni sicela ukunikezwa ithuba lokuba sizile. Izinhlelo sizozimemezela ezinsukwini ezizayo.”UMboweni waba ungqongqoshe wezeziMali ngo-2018, wasula ngo-2021.Ngaphambi kwalokho, uke waba umphathi weBhange loMbuso, i-SA Reserve Bank, wayengungqongqoshe weziSebenzi ngaphansi kohulumeni wokuqala ngaphansi kwentando yeningi.URamaphosa uthe izwe lilahlekelwe lukhulu ngokushona kukaMboweni."Silahlekelwe isishoshovu, walwela amalungelo abasebenzi futhi ubeqhamuka namaqhinga okuthuthukisa umnotho. Ngesikhathi ephethe eBhange loMbuso, nangesikhathi ewungqongqoshe wezeziMali, wayehlezi egcizelela eyokuphathwa kahle kwezimali zomphakathi nokulingana kwezomnotho. Uzibonikalisile ezinkampanini ezizimele futhi ubeliphakamisa igama leNingizimu Afrika emhlabeni uma kuziwa kwezomnotho.”Amazwi enduduzo abengena elakanyana izolo.Izinhlangano zepolitiki, izinyunyana zabasebenzi, nabezamabhizinisi badlulise amazwi enduduzo.Okhulumela i-ANC, uNkk Mahlengi Bhengu-Motsiri, uthe nakuba uMboweni ahlala isikhathi esifishane kwesokuba ungqongqoshe wezeziMali, uthe mkhulu umsebenzi awenza.UNkk Bhengu-Motsiri uthe kuyabakhathaza ukushona kwabaholi abayimithombo yolwazi.Okhulumela i-DA, uNksz Karabo Khakhau, uthe uMboweni ubewuhlonipha umsebenzi wakhe nabantu bakuleli."Ubesebenza ngokuzikhandla, elwela ukuthi isimo somnotho sibe ngcono. Ubelwela ukuthi impilo yabantu ibe ngcono.”Okhulumela i-EFF, uNksz Leigh-Ann Mathys, uthe nakuba kunezikhathi eziningi lapho bebezithola bephikisana nemibono kaMboweni yezomthetho, uthe kukhona abebevumelana ngakho.Uthe uMboweni ubekholelwa ekutheni iBhange loMbuso lifakwe ngaphansi kukahulumeni neyokuthi kusungulwe ibhange likahulumeni, nokuyizinto i-EFF ekholelwa kuzona.
NKOSIKHONA CELESIYINDABA egudwini kumalungu omphakathi waseXobho, isenzo senyanga yakule ndawo okuthiwa ilande ilobolo layo ngodli ekhweni layo icikwa ukuthi bayiganisela umuntu wesifazane ongabatholi abantwana. Isolezwe Ngempelasonto lithole ngomthombo walo ukuthi uMnuz Mzikawupheli Xabhashe oyinyanga eyaziwayo kule ndawo uvuke umbhejazane wahamba nabaqaphi bakhe bayolanda ngodli izinkomo zelobolo eHighflats.Inyanga kuthiwa beyicikwa ukuthi umkayo uNkk Zethulile Xabhashe (uMaChamane) akafuni ukumtholela abantwana.Kuvela ukuthi inyanga beyicikwa ukuthi sekuphele iminyaka eyisithupha umama engabatholi abantwana futhi isola ukuthi lokhu ukwenza ngamabomu.Kuvela ukuthi bafikile kubo kukamakoti base becela ukuthi babuyiselwe zonke izinkomo abazishiya mhla belobola.Umthombo uthi ekhweni babavumelile ukuthi bakwenze lokho. "Ekhweni bamane behlisa umoya, babavumela ukuthi bathathe izinkomo zabo eziyishumi ababekade belobole ngazo,'' usho kenjena.Uqhuba umthombo uthe ubaba kamakoti uthe akakuthandi ukukhuluma yingakho ebavumelile.Isolezwe Ngempelasonto likhulume nayo inyanga, yavumela phezulu ukuthi vele iyile ukuyolanda izinkomo zayo."Uyithathephi inombolo yami? Lalela ke ngoba vele uyazithanda izindaba zabantu, ngiyile vele ukuyolanda izinkomo zami. Angeke phela ngize ngidlale umuntu wesifazane ongafuni ukuzala,'' esho.Intatheli imbuzile ukuthi kungani ecabanga ukuthi umkakhe akathandi ukuthola abantwana?Ithe waqale wamtshela ukuthi ucela ukuthi bangasheshi babathole abantwana ngoba usafuna ukuthi bahlale bodwa emzini wabo bajabulele ukushada.Uthi kuthe ebona kuphele isikhathi eside engazali wambuza umkakhe ukuthi kanti kwenzakalani?"Wangiphendula ngokuthi yena ngeke aze azale ngoba uyazivocavoca futhi akakulungele ukuthi angaba nesisu esikhulu ekubeni enomzimba omuhle,'' echaza.Inyanga ithi lo wesifazane waze waphakamisa nokuthi kulandwe umakoti wesibili kube nguyena ozalayo ngoba yena akasiyona inhlobo ethanda ukungalali ebusuku ibangelwa umsindo umntwana.''Mina ngaganwa yisilwane somuntu wesifazane, into ebona sengathi usana yinto enesicefe nje. Ngazama ukukhuluma nabazali bakhe kodwa nabo behluleka,'' isho kanje inyanga.Ithe iyabona ukuthi isuke imane izidlalela nje uma izithokozisa ngokocansi nomkakyo ngoba kukhona amaphilisi awadlayo.Isolezwe Ngempelasonto limshayele ucingo uMaChamane, wavuma ukuthi kulandwe izinkomo kubo, wathi lokhu kumphethe kabi.Udalule nokuthi seligqashukile igoda phakathi kwabo bobabaili. "Ayikho into engingayikhuluma nomuntu ongihlambalazile phambi kwabazali,'' usho kanjena.Uveze ukuthi babekade bevumelene nomyeni wakhe ukuthi baqale ukuthola abantwana okungenani ngemuva kweminyaka eyisikhombisa."Lokhu ngakucela ngoba kukhona izinto ebengifuna ukuthi ngiqede ukuzenza ngaphambi kokuba ngikhulelwe,'' usho kanjena. Uveze ukuthi unguthisha ngokomsebenzi kodwa wala waphetha ukuveza ukuthi ufundisa kusiphi isikole.
SIMUNCU isimo ethempelini lamaNazaretha eMbelebeleni elizinze ehostela KwaMashu emva kokuhlaselwa kwabefundisi abamemezele ukubuya komshumayeli obexoshiwe.Isolezwe lithole ngomthombo walo ongaphakathi eMbelebeleni, ukuthi abefundisi baseBuhleni baphume ngesamagundane behlaselwa amakholwa ngempelasonto, emva kokwenza isimemezelo sokubuyela kukaMshumayeli Makhelwane Shandu esikhundleni.Kuthiwa ngendlela okubemuncu ngayo kuze kwagwazwa namathayi emoto yomunye wabaholi obezokwenza isimemezelo, amaNazaretha evuke umbhejazane.Kuthiwa njengoba kuza iSabatha akwaziwa ukuthi isimo sizobanjani njengoba kubhekenwe ngeziqu zamehlo."Kukhona abahambisana nokubuyiswa kukaMshumayeli Makhelwane Shandu nabangafuni abuyiswe. Inkinga kube wukuthi umshumayeli uShandu wamiswa ebandleni ngo-2022 noMkhokheli uMaMkhize. Icala labo kwaba wukusolwa ngokukhuluma kabi ngomholi uNyazilwezulu. Ngesikhathi sekuthathwe isinqumo sokuthi bamiswe kwamenyezelwa ebandleni nabo bebengasabonakali. Kugcine sekugcotshwa abanye abazoba ngabaholi khona eMbelebeleni. Baqale ukubonakala kulo nyaka beza esontweni, amaNazaretha anganeliseka ngokubonakala kwabo. Okufike kwabhebhethekisa isimo kube isimemezelo sokuthi babuyiselwe ezikhundleni zabo, kulapho kusuke khona umsindo,” kusho umthombo.Uqhuba umthombo uthe ngesikhathi bechithwa enkonzweni ngo-2022 kwaba nesigungu esiphezulu esasihlalele udaba lwabo, esasihlanganisa iNkosi yamaQadi uMqoqi Ngcobo, inkosi yakwaZwane neNkosi yaseMthandeni uGumede. Uthe nezincomo zayiswa yiwona lama khosi kumholi uNyazilwezulu, abuyisa impendulo ethi luthathe isinqumo sokuthi bamiswe esontweni.Uthe okucasule amakholwa ukuthi akuzange kubonakale neyodwa kulama khosi efakazela le nkulumo eshiwo ngabagcotshwa ukuthi uNyazilwezulu selubavumele ukuthi babuyele esontweni, nokuyikhona okususe umsindo."Njengoba kuza isabatha asazi ukuthi kuzokwenzekani uma bephinda bebonakala laba okusuke umsindo ngokubuyiswa kwabo ngoba namanje akekho oseke wafika wafakazela le nkulumo yabafundisi abababuyisile. Inkinga enkulu ukuthi leli thempeli lisehostela lapho kuvamise ukuthi kusuke khona impi kalula. Akuyona into esiyithandayo ukuthi siveze izindaba zesonto emaphepheni kodwa kunabantu esibona bengaphephile ngoba kusithusile esikubone kwenzeka,” kuqhuba umthombo.Leli phephandaba linalo izwi eliqoshiwe lapho kumenyezelwa khona ukubuya kukaMshumayeli Shandu noMkhokheli uMaMkhize. Kukhona nelinye elinxusa amaNazaretha ukuthi afake umnikelo ukunxephezela umgcotshwa olinyalelwe yimoto ngesikhathi zidudulana esontweni.Imizamo yokuthola uMshumayeli Makhelwane Shandu ayiphumelelanga. Ucingo lwakhe belukhala lungabanjwa. Okhulumela uNyazilwezulu, uMnuz Thokozani Mncwabe uthe luyamethusa lolu daba ngoba ubengalwazi."Sizokhuluma nabo abaseMbelebeleni ukulungisa isimo. Ngokomthetho kumele udaba lusukunyelwe yibona abakuleli thempeli ngoba kunamakomiti akhona ngaphakathi. Ngenxa yokuthi kubonakala sengathi ahlulekile kumele kube ubuholi obuphezulu obungenelelayo ngoba ngeke bakwazi ukuxazulula inkinga ebathinta bonke. Uthe abakwenzayo kululaza isithunzi sebandla noNyazilwezulu, futhi yibona abayisa udaba emaphepheni ngoba intatheli ayizange ibekhona lapho bekuliwa khona,” kusho uMncwabe.

NGEKE zibe khona izingqungquthela zokukhetha ubuholi eqenjini eliholwa owayengumengameli, uJacob Zuma.UZuma uthe abasiboni isidingo sokuba nezingqungquthela zokukhetha ubuholi, wathi ezingqungqutheleni kukhona abantu abathenga izikhundla.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba ngoLwesihlanu, lapho khona ubuholi be-MK bebuthula izinqumo ezithathwe emhlanganweni wesigungu esiphezulu weqembu wakamumva.I-MK ayikaze ibe nayo ingqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi, ubuholi beqembu njengoba obukhona baqokwa wuye uZuma.UZuma uthe bazoqhubeka nokuziqokela ubuholi, wathi akasiboni isidingo sokubiza ingqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi."Angisiboni isidingo sengqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi. Ayikho into enhle engike ngayibona yenzeka ezingqungqutheleni. Uma ngibuza abantu ukuthi sikuphi isidingo sokuthi silokhu siba nezingqungquthela zokukhetha ubuholi, abantu bayaye bangitshele ukuthi ingoba siphila ngaphansi kwentandoyeningi. "Kodwa iqiniso lithi ezingqungqutheleni kuqokwa abantu abasuke benemali yokukhankasela izikhundla. Kunabaholi abaphethe izikhundla ezibalulekile kodwa abangawazi umsebenzi. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi bayazithenga izikhundla. Indaba yezingqungquthela ivuna abantu abanemali. Uma sisho kanje, asikhulumi ngento esingayazi. Nathi sesike sazibonela lento yenzeka phambi kwethu.”UZuma uthe bazogcina ngokuba nezingqungquthela zokubonisana kuphela."Sizokuba nezingqungquthela lapho khona sizohlanganisa zonke izifundazwe, lapho sizobonisana khona ngezinto ezithinta iqembu. Kulezi zingqungquthela, sizocobelelana ngolwazi.”I-MK yethule umthethosisekelo wayo, izolo.Osebuholi obuphezulu be-MK, uMnuz Floyd Shivambu, uthe asikho isigaba somthethosisekelo weqembu esithi kufanele kube nengqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi."Lokhu sikwenze ngamabomu. Sibonile ukuthi izingqungquthela zidala uqhekeko emaqenjini. Ingakho singazange siyifake indaba yengqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi ngesikhathi sibhala umthethosisekelo. "Lesi sinqumo sizosisiza nasekuqedeni amandla labo abavimba abanye abafuna ukujoyina i-MK. Labo abavimba abanye bazobona ukuthi asikho isidingo sokulokhu bevimba abantu ngoba angeke zibe khona izingqungquthela.”UShivambu uthe maduze bazomemezela ubuholi be-MK ezifundazweni nasezifundeni.Uthe bazothathelwa izinyathelo labo abangeke babuhloniphe ubuholi obuzomenyezelwa."Sikuqaphelile ukuthi kunabantu abaningi abazibiza ngabaholi, nababangayo. Uma sekumenyezelwe ubuholi, angeke sikubekezelele ukuthi kuqhubeke kube khona abantu abangisa ubuholi obuqokiwe.”

ABANTU baseNingizimu Afrika balokhu beye njalo ebhodweni lezikhwama zempesheni njengoba sebefinyelele ngaphezu kwesigidi okuqinisekiswe ukuthi sebekwenzile lokho.Uphiko oluqoqa intela kuleli, iSars, iveze ukuthi yize kunenqwaba yabanyulile kodwa futhi baningi abahambe olukamabuyaze bethi bayonyula. Bathi lokhu kwenziwe wukungahambisani kwemininingwane yabo neyalolu phiko okubalwa kuyo izinombolo zabo zentela ezabhaliswa abaqashi, yizinkinga zomazisi nabanye abakweleta lolu phiko imali.Ngokwesitatimende esikhishwe yi-Sars, imali esiphumile yaya kubantu kusukela ngoSepthemba 1, nonyaka, izikhwama sezikhokhe uR21.4 billion.Lolu phiko luthi baningi abantu bakuleli okungathanda zisuka nje babe befaka izicelo, kodwa balindile baze bazifaka emuva kwezinsuku ezingu-20 kuvulwe lolu hlelo lokunyula. Kodwa abanye bazifaka ngalo usuku okuvulwe ngalo.Kunxuswe abasebenzi abasafuna ukunyula ukuthi baqinisekise nalolu phiko ukuthi izinombolo zabo zentela yizona yini lezi ezibhaliswe ngaphansi kwezikhwama zempesheni abazikhokhelayo. Kubalulekile nokubheka ukuthi lolu phiko awulukweleti yini ukuze ungathi uyenyula, imali yakho ifike ingene emgodini wesikweletu sakaSars.UKhomishana wakwaSars, uMnuz Edward Kieswetter, uthe kuyadumaza nokho ukuthi lolu hlelo luvundulule abakhokhi bentela abebengathembekile. Abebesho amaholo amancane kuSars ukuze lolu phiko lubabambele imali encane."Ngebhadi uma wenza lokhu, usuke wephula imithetho yakwaSars, ungazithola uboshwa noma uhlawuliswa ngalesi senzo,” egcizelela.
ULAXAZE isicelo sebheyile umsolwa oboshelwe icala lokusocongwa kwekhansela leDA, kuMasipala waseMngeni.UMnuz Thobane Masobho Hlongwa, obhekene necala lokubulala uMnuz Nhlalayenza Ndlovu, ushaye ungqimphothwe ngomzuzu wokugcina, wayeka ukufaka isicelo.UHlongwa, bekulindeleke ukuthi afake isicelo sebheyili ngoLwesihlanu ngesikhathi evele eNkantolo yeMantshi eHowick.Ummeli wakhe uMnuz Zwelani Duma, utshele inkantolo ukuthi uHlongwa ukhethe ukungasifaki isicelo sebheyili."Emva kwezingxoxo ezinde, sibe sesibonisana ukuthi okwamanje akangasifaki isicelo sebheyili.”UDuma uthe kungenzeka ukuthi uHlongwa abuye anqume ukufaka isicelo sebheyili ngokuqhubeka kwecala. Icala libe selihlehliselwa uNovemba 8.UHlongwa waboshwa amaphoyisa aphenya izigameko zokusocongwa kosopolitiki KwaZulu-Natal. Ezokuphepha beziqinile enkantolo, uHlongwa ufike egadwe amaphoyisa abaphethe izinhlokohlela.UHlongwa ubebukeka ethukile ngesikhathi esebhokisini labamangalelwa, kanti abezindaba bayalelwe ukuba bangamshuthi.Umshushisi u-Advocate Elvis Gcweka, uthe kukhona abanye abasolwa abasazoboshwa kuleli cala.UNdlovu, owayengusotswebhu weDA eMngeni, wabulawa phambi komndeni wakhe ngonyaka owedlule.Amalungu eDA abebhikisha ngaphandle kwenkantolo. Umholi weDA KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Francios Rodgers, uthe kuyabajabulisa ukuthi kukhona umsolwa oseboshiwe."Sekunesikhathi eside kwabulawa uNdlovu, besikhathazekile njengoba bekubukeka sengathi akukho okwenzekayo. Sijabule ukubona ukuthi kukhona okwenzekayo.”Nokho uRodgers uthe bakhathazekile ukuthi kusaboshwe umuntu oyedwa."Kubukeka sengathi ngeke sifike ekujuleni kwale ndaba. Esikwaziyo thina ukuthi lo muntu oboshiwe wayeyingxenye yabantu abasoconga uNdlovu. Manje ke kuyasikhathaza ukuthi kusaboshwe umuntu oyedwa kuphela.”Imeya yoMasipala waseMngeni, uMnuz Chris Pappas, ithe okubakhathazayo ukuthi amaphoyisa aphenya icala awafuni ukuxhumana nabo."Abafuni ukuxhumana nathi kanye nomndeni. Thina sinolwazi esifuna ukulidlulisela kubona. Sizolibika kungqongqoshe wamaphoyisa lolu daba.”UPappas uthe bafuna ukuthi uHlongwa ajeze."Sizolilandela leli cala. Sishilo ukuthi lapha KwaZulu-Natal amakhosi namakhansela ayabulawa. Thina asifani nabanye, ngeke sihlale phansi. Mhlawumbe kuyenzeka kwamanye amaqembu. Thina lapha kwiDA, siyavikelana. Sifuna abolele ejele.”UPappas uthe banethemba lokuthi ukuboshwa kukaHlongwa kuzoholela ekuboshweni kwabanye abasolwa."Kusinika ithemba uma sibona kukhona umuntu oboshiwe yize sinemibuzo yokuthi ngubani lona.”

UDudu Mhlongo ongomunye wabakhulumela umndeni kaNandi, uthe bajabule kakhulu ngokwenzekile."Ukumbulwa kwetshe lakhe bekuhambisana nokwethulwa ngokusemthethweni kwesikhumbuzo sikaNandi esizobakhona njalo ngo-Okthoba 10, okuwusuku ashona ngalo. Njalo ngalolu suku sizoba nesikhumbuzo sakhe kuze kube u-2027, lapho sizoba nomcimbi omkhulu wokugubha impilo kaNandi njengoba ezobe ehlanganisa iminyaka engu-200 ashona,” kusho uDudu.Echaza kafushane ngomlando kaNandi, uDudu uthe ngokomlando wabo bengabakwaMhlongo, uNandi wayeyinkosazana yaseLangeni kodwa eleNdlovukazi wahlonishwa yindodana yakhe uShaka kaSenzangakhona (uMlilwana) ngalo.Ngisho etsheni leliba lakhe uNandi kubhaliwe ukuthi uyinkosazana kodwa wahlonishwa ngesobuNdlovukazi.Kwabebehambele ukumbulwa kwetshe likaNandi bekukhona umphathi wesikhungo iKCap, u-Edmund Mhlongo ongomunye oyilungu lomndeni kaNandi elisaphila, uMakhosi Mhlathuze Mhlongo wasesiBhambeni kaMhlongo, uDudu Mhongo wakulo mndeni, umculi uZawadi Yamungu nabanye.UNandi wazalwa ngo-1760 washona ngo-1827. Emlandweni omfishane obhalwe kulona kuthiwa "Lapha kulele inkosazane yaseLangeni, uNandi, kaBhebhe kanti unina kwakunguMfunda kaKhondlo kaQwabe, ozala iNgonyama neSilo saKwaDukuza uShaka owamphakamisa ngokumenza iNdlovukazi yoMbuso wesizwe saKwaZulu. Uhlonishwa umhlaba wonke njengeNdlovukazi uNandi okuwuphaphe lwegwalagwala aluchonywa ngenhlonipho indodana yakhe uShaka (ayembiza ngoMlilwana).”Umndeni wakwaMhlongo kudala ukhala isililo sokulungiswa kwedlinza likaNandi obuthi laliyihlazo njengoba kuthiwa bekungabonakali nokuthi kulele kulona indlovukazi eyazala iSilo uShaka esabumba isizwe samaZulu.Kulokhu umndeni uthe uzizwa upholile emoyeni emva kokuthi isifiso sawo esikhulu sigcine sifezekile ukunika uNandi inhlonipho ngokuzala umbumbi wamaZulu.Nasemlandweni kuyavela ukuthi uNandi uyena owapheka iSilo uShaka sisakhula ukuthi sigcine sifike ezingeni esakhothama sesikulona.
Usekhalelwe amasongo kaSigonyela owesilisa oneminyaka engu-33 osolwa ngokugwaza amalungu omndeni ayisikhombisa kwafa amahlanu eBethany, eBergville ngoMgqibelo ebusuku.Lona wesilisa kuthiwa uzovela eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseBergville ngoLwesibili ebhekene namacala amahlanu okubulala namabili okuzama ukubulala.Kubikwa ukuthi umsolwa nomalume wakhe bavakashele omakhelwane nokuthe uma bebuya bathola unina ehleli kusofa."Imibiko iqhuba ithi umsolwa uthathe ummese kusofa wagwaza unina okwazile ukuphuma abaleke endlini. Ngemuva kwalokho ubheke kumalume wakhe oshonele ephaseji ezama ukubalekela komakhelwane. Umsolwa ube eseqhubeka wagwaza wabulala izingane zamantombazane ezimbili, eneminyaka emibili neneminyaka eyisithuba,” kusho okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda.Uqhube wathi umsolwa ube esegwaza ebulala owesifazane obekhubazekile kanjalo nomunye osekhulile obevakashile.Unina womsolwa nenye intombazanyana eneminyaka emine basindile benamanxeba okugwazwa amaningi emzimbeni.Uthe udadewabo womsolwa ukwazile ukubaleka nengane yakhe enonyaka. Iminyaka yabagilwa ibingakaqinisekiswa."Uphenyo lwamaphoyisa luqinisekise ukuthi umsolwa uke wavulelwa inqwaba yamacala okushaya kodwa asulwa.”

UKUFIKA kwabakhongi bezocela isihlobo esihle ekhweni kwanele ukunika owesifazane ilungelo lokulawula amafa alowo olobolayo, okuchaza ukuthi abomndeni kamkhwenyana abasenazwi uma engadlula emhlabeni ngaleso sikhathi. Lokhu kuvezwe yisinqumo somxazululi wezinkinga zomshwalense, uNkk Denise Gabriels oyi-Lead Ombud ye-Life Insurance, oyalele ukuba kuvunwe owesifazane obechithwa abomshwalense ngokuthi akazilanga futhi akahlalanga emakhandleleni kushone umyeni wakhe. Lo wesifazane isinqumo sithi kufanele ayithole imali yomshwalense. Lesi sinqumo, esingase sishukumise imindeni eminingi yabamnyama ebhekana nezimo ezinje, sithi okudingayo njengobufakazi yizincwadi zamalobolo noma izithombe zemicimbi eyenziwa kulotsholwa ukuze uphebeze izihlobo zomyeni ekugweveni namafa. UNksz Wendy Cele, wenkampani yabameli iWendy Cele & Associates, uthe umthetho awusho lutho ngokuzila nokuhlala kumatilasi kodwa ukubeka kucace ukuthi owesifazane olotsholiwe, kwaba nencwadi yesivumelwano yemindeni, kwaphethwa wonke amasiko esintu kwaze kwembeswa, uyinkosikazi."Yebo, inkantolo iyasidinga isitifiketi somshado kodwa uma singekho incwadi yamalobolo, eyezibizo, izithombe nokunye okwenziwe ngokwesintu, kuba wubufakazi obusiza owesifazane uma sebemchitha abathile ukuthi ube yinkosikazi,” kusho uNksz Cele.Udonse ngendlebe abesifazane ukuthi bahlale bewagcinile amaphepha asayinwa umndeni nabakhongi futhi bazi ukuthi uma sebelotsholiwe kufana nokuthi bashadile. UNksz Cele weluleke ngokuthi uma abantu bengafuni ukuhlanganisa amafa kumele basayine isivumelwano esicacisayo ukuthi umshado uhlukanisa amafa zingaqali izingxoxo zamalobolo. "Uma lesi sivumelwano singasayinwanga, umshado usuke uhlanganisa amafa,” usho kanje.UMMELI uNksz Wendy Cele othi ukungahlali kumatilasi uma kufe indoda yakho akusho ukuthi awuyena unkosikazi ezincwadini zomthethoOdabeni obelufakwe yilo wesifazane (igama lakhe eligodliwe) umshwalense ubunqwahe nemali kamasingcwabisane ubalula ukuthi akazange azilele umyeni futhi ebengesiye unkosikazi osemthethweni kamufi njengoba ebengenaso isitifiketi somshado kodwa enencwadi yamalobolo.Bebenezingane ezimbili, umufi abezondla nyanga ngokufaka imali kwi-akhawunti yasebhange yalona wesifazane. Bebehlala ndawonye kusukela ngo-2011, futhi nonina kamufi ukufakazele lokhu.Uthe yize bebengasahlali ndawonye futhi engamzilelanga kodwa lokhu akusho ukuthi umufi ebengesiye umyeni wakhe.Umxazululi, uNkk Gabriels akazange ayikhiphe imininingwane yokuthi umufi ushone nini, owakuphi nokuthi umndeni ubuzothola malini njengoba ihhovisi lakhe lingakwenzi lokhu. Kodwa ukuvezile ukuthi umufi ushone ngokugula.Owesifazane uye wachaza ukuthi wathuthela kwesinye isifundazwe emuva kokuthola umsebenzi ongcono kodwa ubevakasha ekhaya likamufi ayokwenza okulindeleke kuye njengomfazi.Umshwalense ubulokhu umile ekutheni ngeke ukhokhe ngoba uma uphenya uthole ngabathile ukuthi unkosikazi akazange amzilele ngokuhlala kumatilasi umyeni.Oyisazi samasiko, uSolwazi Jabulani Maphalala, uthe akusilo isiko ukuhlala kumatilasi noma emakhandleleni uma owesifazane eshonelwe umyeni futhi ukungakwenzi lokhu akufanele kubukwe njengehlazo. "NgokwesiZulu, inkosikazi eshonelwe wumyeni yayingasigqoki isicholo, ingazilungisi izinwele. Yayibonakala kanjalo ukuthi ishonelwe ngumyeni. Ngisho amakhosikazi ayeganele esithenjini ayenza lokhu. Umndeni wawunquma isikhathi sokuzila bese kuba nehlambo, kugezwe wonke amalungu omndeni nenkosikazi eshonelwe wumyeni. Emuva kwalokho, yayigqoka isicholo sayo ilungise nezinwele,” kusho uMaphalala.
Amaphoyisa adubule abulala ababili abebezama ukuwadubula efuna ukubabopha eMlaza ngoMgqibelo ntambama njengoba bebebesolwa ngokuba nesandla ekuqothweni kwamalungu omndeni ayisikhombisa eHighflats ngenyanga edlule.UKhomishana wamaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, wabumba ithimba elizothungatha ababulali ngemuva kwesigameko esashiya umphakathi uthuthumela.Isibhamu okuthiwa sitholakale emotweni yabasolwa Isithombe: SithunyelweUkudutshulwa kwalaba basolwa kulandela ukufa kwabanye ababili ababetholene phezulu namaphoyisa ngoLwesibili oyedwa waphela emehlweni.Ngesikhathi amaphoyisa elandela umkhondo ngoMgqibelo, athole ukuthi abanye abasolwa ababili basendleleni bayogeza ngokwesintu eMlaza.Ngesikhathi amaphoyisa ebabona behamba ku-Old South Coast Road futhi ezama ukubamisa, bavele bavulela ngenhlamvu amaphoyisa aphendula baphelela endaweni yesigameko.Okhulumela amaphoyisa eKZN, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe abasolwa batholakale nezibhamu ezimbili osekuqinisekisiwe ukuthi ziyathinteka esigamekweni saseHlokozi.Uthe alikho iphoyisa elilimele.Esigamekweni, esasukumisa ngisho uNdunankulu wesifundazwe uMnuz Thami Ntuli ngenyanga edlule, kwashona umama wekhaya uBahlakaniphile Khambule (64), indodakazi yakhe uPhilile (39), umalokazana uNompilo (34), isihlobo uSikhumbuzo Khambule nabazukulu uLisa (9), Siphosethu (9) noZemvelo (5).
KUNTWELA ezansi kwabalinde izimpendulo zokuchithwa wuxhaso yisikhwama, iNational Students’ Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS), njengoba sebembalwa abalindile.Lokhu kuvezwe nguNgqongqoshe weMfundo ePhakeme, uDkt Nobuhle Nkabane, ephendula umbuzo welungu le-EFF ePhalamende.UMnuz Mandla Shikwambana we-EFF ubuze ukuthi luphothulwa nini uhlelo lokuphendula labo abachithwa yilesi sikhwama ekutholeni uxhaso base befaka izimangalo.Ubuze nokuthi njengoba babebalelwa ku-90 000 abafaka lezi zimangalo, bangaki abasele njengoba ususongwa unyaka ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme. UDkt Nkabane uthe iNSFAS yathola izimangalo ezingu-103 071.Uveze ukuthi u-84% wazo usuwenziwa kanti kusele kuphela u-16% ongakaphothulwa."Kusele ezingu-16 419 ezingakaphothulwa ngale nyanga. Kulezi ezingu-8 930 okulindwe ukuthi izikhungo zilethe ulwazi oluveza ukuthi zaphasa ngonyaka odlule. Ezingu-1 375 ezidinga ukuthi izitshudeni zilethe olunye ulwazi ukuze ziphothulwe, ezinye zisezigabeni ezehlukene njengokuthi kulindwe isinqumo sokuthi zixhaswe noma zingaxhaswa.”Uthe kulezi ezidinga ulwazi olwevile kwizitshudeni, zivala namhlanje.Ezinye ezidinga ukuthi kungenelele abathile, uveze ukuthi zivalwa ngo-Okthoba 18, 2024. Ephendula imibuzo ePhalamende kuleli sonto, uDkt Nkabane uthembise ukuthi bagijima ngamandla ukuxazulula izinselelo ezibhekene neNSFAS.Uthe bafuna kuthi kuqala unyaka zonke izinto ezithinta lesi sikhwama zibe sezilungisiwe.Ubalule neyokuqokwa kwebhodi elisha lalesi sikhwama, elizobe seliqoka izikhulu ezizosilawula.Umnyango wafuna kuphakanyiswe amagama abantu abazoba ngamalungu aleli bhodi.Kula malungu kufuneka abantu abancwadile, abasemkhakheni ehlukene yempilo ukuze kulungiswe izinkinga ezihlale zigabhe lesi sikhwama.Ihlale iyindaba egudwini njalo uma kuqala unyaka eyokuphuza ukuphendulwa kwezitshudeni ezisuke zifuna uxhaso kulesi sikhwama.Lezi zinkinga zidala ukuthi izitshudeni zingazi noma ziqhubeke zifunde noma zingafundi ngenxa yokuthi zisuke zingazi ukuthi kwenzakalani.Ekuqaleni konyaka kube nezinkinga omastende bejikijela emnyango lezo zitshudeni ebezingakhokhelwe yiNSFAS.
AZOBE engayihleki into engahlekisi amaphoyisa ngesikhathi samaholidi okuphela konyaka uma eseqinisa ezokuphepha elwa nayo yonke inhlobo yobugebengu.Lesi yisixwayiso esivele kuMkhuzi wamaPhoyisa, uGeneral Fannie Masemola, ngesikhathi ethula umkhankaso i-Safer Festive Season Operations eMamelodi, ePitoli izolo.Uxwayise kakhulu abantu abaphula umthetho ngokuthi bahlukumeze abesifazane nezingane, wathi yinto amaphoyisa angeke axoxe namuntu ngayo, abenzi bobubi bazolala bebaliwe.Ube esekhuluma ebhekisa ezigebengwini ezibhilitayo ngokuthi ziphange ngamaholidi kaDisemba, wathi ukuthi zisuke zihlome ziyizingovolo ngezinhlokohlela zezibhamu, ngeke kusho lutho ngoba nabo bazilindele.UMasemola uzixwayisile wathi zizofika zigawulwe zabekwa kwazise namaphoyisa azobe ehlome ephelele ngemijojantaba yezibhamu."Izigebengu zisuke zingaphethe imishanelo uma zenza amacala, ziphatha izibhamu ezinkulu ngokunjalo namaphoyisa azobe eziphethe,” kusho uMasemolaUNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, ukhuthaze abashayeli bezimoto, wathi abashayele ngokucophelela emigwaqweni.UMchunu uthe umuntu akangashayeli ngenhloso yokubukisa ukuthi imoto yakhe inesivinini esingakanani ekubeni engajahe ndawo."Inhloso akukhona ukuthi abantu bashone ngoDisemba. Abanye benu bazobe bethatha uhambo nezingane ezidinga ukuba nizinakekele. Shayela ngokuphepha futhi ningashayeli niphuze utshwala,” kusho uMchunu.Naye uxwayise izigebengu athe zisuke zinenhloso yokwenza amabhonasi, wathi zizolutheza olumanzi.IPhini likaNgqongqoshe wezokuThutha, uMnuz Mkhuleko Hlengwa, lidluliswe amazwi enduduzo emndenini wabayisishiyagalombili ababhubhe engozini enyantisa igazi eMandeni, KwaZulu-Natal, entathakusa izolo.
UMFELANDAWONYE wezinyunyana, iSouth African Federation of Trade Unions (Saftu) usugxeke izitolo ezingayehlisi intengo yokudla yize kungasabizi kakhulu lapho zikuthenga khona.UNobhala Jikelele weSaftu, uMnuz Zwelinzima Vavi, uthe abanikazi bezitolo abananembeza ngokunyusa ukudla yize bengasabhekene nezindleko.Ubalule ukuthi nyangazonke igilosa iyabiza kanti nombiko weCompetition Commission uyakufakazela lokhu."Abanikazi bezitolo kufanele babe nonembeza bangajahi inzuzo kuphela. Isibonelo nje isikhulu saseWoolworths sihola uR123 million ngonyaka, esaseShoprite sihola uR65 million ngonyaka bese kuthi esaseSpar sihole uR25 million ngonyaka. Lama holo ayakhombisa ukuthi inzuzo iyaphi yingakho ukudla kubiza.”Uthe bazolwa nodaba lokubiza kokudla ngokuhlanganisa abantu bakuleli ukuba balwe nongxiwankulu abangenandaba nabasebenzi nabampofu.

Phela ukuze nibe yigatsha elisesimweni, kufanele kube ukuthi ninamalungu angu-100. Anikwazi ke ukuthi bese nihlulwa ukuthola amavoti angu-100 uma ngempela kuwukuthi ninamalungu awu-100 e-EFF ngakini. Ngakho ke into esiyenzile ukuthi siwameme la magatsha ukuze azobona nje ukuthi asiwafuni amavila kwi-EFF.”I-EFF ayenzanga kahle KwaZulu-Natal okhethweni olwedlule njengoba yathola amavoti angu-79 211, isuka ekutholeni amavoti angu-363 832 okhethweni lwango-2019.Yize kunjalo, uMalema uchithe amahlebezi okuthi kuzohlakazwa ubuholi be-EFF esifundazweni.UMalema uthe banelisekile ngencazelo abayithole ebuholini be-EFF KwaZulu-Natal ngokwenzeka okhethweni olwedlule."Sanelisekile ngobuholi be-EFF KwaZulu-Natal. Iqiniso ukuthi babebhekene nesimo esinzima lapha KwaZulu-Natal, benza ngakho konke okusemandleni abo ukuthi sithole amavoti amaningi. "Angeke sibuhlakaze ubuholi baKwaZulu-Natal ngoba ayikho into ekhombisa ukuthi sihlulwe ngenxa yobuvila noma yokungakhankasi kwabo. Sinomuzwa wokuthi kuhle ngoba naye ufe kabuhlungu njengo-Amanda,” kusho uNksz Phungula.Uqhube wathi ngakolunye uhlangothi, abagculisekile ngoba bebesalinde ukuthi kuphenduleke imibuzo abanayo ngokubulawa kwesihlobo sabo uma sekuqulwa icala enkantolo."Besisafuna asichazele kahle ukuthi wambulalelani, asho ukuthi yini le engaka ayesemenze yona ukuthi wayengaze ambulale, aphinde achaze nokuthi yini kahle hle eyayibahlanganisa?” usho kanje.Uthe bezwa ubuhlungu ngokuthi usevele wakhetha ukuyongena egodini nezimpendulo zale mibuzo abanayo.Ngokusho kukaNksz Phungula, umufi waficwa ukufa esathi uya ezitolo endaweni, ehamba ngezinyawo.Kusolwa ukuthi umenzi wobubi waqale wamdlwengula umufi ngaphambi kokuba amklinye, ambulale.Umndeni kamufi waziswa amaphoyisa ngesigameko. Kuvela ukuthi amtshela ukuthi utholwe umuntu obezidlulela, engagqokile kwesingezansi, ibhulukwe lakhe libekiwe ngaphezulu.Emva kwesigameko kwabe sekuvela ukuthi kukhona abavame ukuzihlalela ngasezitolo, abatshele amaphoyisa ukuthi babone owesilisa ehamba nomufi, kwathi emva kwamahora ambalwa, bambona esebuya ehamba yedwa.Umndeni wawutshele Isolezwe ukuthi awukholwa ukuthi bukhona ubudlelwano bokwazana obebukhona phakathi kukamufi nomsolwa njengoba umufi obengumuntu ongavamile ukuzihlanganisa nabantu kulandela isigameko sokuthunjwa kwakhe ngo-2020, eneminyaka engu-16.Kuleso sigameko, umufi wadedelwa abathumbi emva kokusatshalaliswa kwezithombe zakhe sekuphele amasonto amathathu ethunjiwe.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi amaphoyisa ambopha owesilisa (44) ngecala lokubulala. Uthe umufi wayenamanxeba abukeka sengathi awokugwazwa. "Umsolwa uvele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini ngoMsombuluko, icala lakhe lahlehliselwa uLwesithathu oluzayo, ukuze afake isicelo sebheyili,” kusho uNetshiunda. Akayiphendulanga imibuzo ngokuzibulala komsolwa esitokisini.

Leli khasimende lihambile emva kwale ngxabano," kusho umthombo.Uthe isisebenzi sihambe saya ngaphakathi ebhange ukuyobika osekwenzekile kumenenja webhange."Ngesikhathi sisematasa sichaza, liphinde labuya ikhasimende, seliphethe ummese esandleni, laphinde laxabana naso. Kubikwa ukuthi isisebenzi sesilisa besizama ukuxazulula isimo ngesikhathi ikhasimende lingenela kulayini we-ATM. Ikhasimende lishaye sengathi liyahamba kodwa labuya selihlome ngommese, laphinde laxabana nabagilwa, labagwaza, kwafa oyedwa, omunye walimala," kusho uNetshiunda.
