UMKHONDO wamaphoyisa ukhomba ukuthi kukhona okudla amantshontsho emsamo ecaleni lokuqothwa kwabayisikhombisa bomndeni wakwaKhambule eHlokozi, eHighflats, ngenyanga edlule. Lokhu kuvele izolo kulandela isiga sangoLwesibili lapho amaphoyisa edubule abulala abasolwa ababili kwabane abayamaniswa nesibhicongo esenzeka kwaKhambule ngoSepthemba.Kuleso sigameko, esasukumisa ngisho uNdunankulu wesifundazwe uMnuz Thami Ntuli ngenyanga edlule, kwashona umama wekhaya uBahlakaniphile Khambule (64), indodakazi yakhe uPhilile (39), umalokazana uNompilo (34), isihlobo uSikhumbuzo Khambule nabazukulu uLisa (9), Siphosethu (9) noZemvelo (5).Ekudubulaleni kwakuthangi, kuvela ukuthi abebesolwa bebehamba ngeToyota Corolla eSt Faiths okuthe amaphoyisa ebamisa bagoloza.Kuthiwa bavele badubula bebhekisa emaphoyiseni, nawo abuyisela ngezulu lezandla. Kulowo mgqashiyo wezinganono kufe abasolwa ababili nowesifazane obehamba nabo. Kuthiwa kunoyedwa wesine othe nyawo zami ngibelethe, ongakatholakali namanje.Kubasolwa abashonile, oyedwa kuthiwa udlala eqenjini lebhola likamsolwa ohamba phambili esibhicongweni, omunye abe yisigcwelegcwele esisatshwayo eNdwebu, okuyindawo ewumakhelwane neHlokozi.Umthombo weSolezwe ulipotshozele ukuthi owesilisa obalekile yisihlobo okuthiwa sifunwa uthuli ngokusocongwa kwabakwaKhambule.Uveze ukuthi kunohide lwezingxabano nezigememe ezidida ikhanda emndenini."Konke okwenzeka manje kusuka esigamekweni sokufa kukababa wekhaya, uPro Khambule, okuthiwa igazi lakhe lakhonjwa esihlotsheni sakhe senyama kodwa esagcina singaboshwanga,” kusho umthombo.Kuvela ukuthi kwake kwaba khona nokugagazisana ngezibhamu kwaze kwadutshulwana uyise wekhaya waphetha ngokushona esibhedlela.Kuthiwa kwathalaliseka ngaleso sigameko, kwabaningi okwathatheka ngokuthi uKhambule (owayengusomatekisi) uhlaselwe ngabantu abangaziwa.Umthombo uveze ukuthi lelo gqubu kalizange liphele emndenini njengoba sekulokhu kunezivuvaba ezingaqondakali ezidla ekhaya. Kwenzeka imbedumehlwana ngenyanga edlule nje, abaziyo bathi kuqhubeka lona ukhondolo lokubulalana ngesibhamu kwezihlobo. Kulolu chungechunge kuze kwachaphazeleka nengoduso yomunye wakuleli khaya. Ababekhona emngcwabeni wengoduso kuthiwa umyeni wafunga wathi uzoziphindiselela kubenzi bokubi ngoba uyabazi.Kufa laba abayisikhombisa nje, kwakungakapholi maseko kade kuphume lezo zinsongo emngcwabeni.Ezinsukwini zesigameko sokubulawa kwabayisikhombisa kunendodana ebisanda kuboshwa ngecala lezibhamu. Le ndodana kuthiwa yaphuma ngebheyili sekusondele umngcwabo wabayisikhombisa. Emuva komngcwabo yabe isiyanyamalala. Esigamekweni sokudubulana kwabasolwa namaphoyisa ngoLwesibili, ubunini bemoto abebehamba ngayo bukhonjwa esihlotsheni esiseduze salo mndeni nosekuvela ukuthi yiso lesi esibaleke ngezinyawo ngesikhathi bedubulana namaphoyisa.Kuthintwa isihlobo, uNksz Dudu Khambule, sithe yize bazi ukuthi uyise wabulawa kodwa abakaze batshelwe kabanzi ngesigameko njengoba senzeka besebancane.Uthe ngeke aphawule kangako ngezinye izigameko okuthiwa zenzeke kubo njengoba zenzeke yena esagana, esezihlalela kwakhe.Uthe bebengakaziswa ngokudutshulwa kwabasolwa ngamaphoyisa.Kuthintwa okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, wale waphetha ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umsolwa ohamba phambili esibhicongweni sakwaKhambule uyisihlobo."Kithina singamaphoyisa umsolwa ngumsolwa, ubuhlobo abusho lutho,” kusho uNetshiunda othe uma ebuzwa ngomnikazi wemoto ebihamba abasolwa, wathi "isesithombeni esisikhiphile”.
LIZOGAYA ngomunye umhlathi ezikoleni ezingu-114 zaKwaZulu-Natal, eziphucwe amandla okubhalisa izivivinyo zika-matric ngenxa yezehlakalo zokukopela kwabafundi. Izivivinyo zika-matric kulezi zikole zikahulumeni nezingu-57 ezizimele zizokwenganyelwa nguMnyango wezeMfundo esifundazweni.Lokhu kushiwo nguDkt Ray Penniston, isikhulu esibhekele izivivinyo emnyangweni wesifundazwe izolo, ngesikhathi uMphathiswa walo mnyango uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka, ememezela izinhlelo zokulungela ukubhalwa kwalezi zivivinyo, eWestville, eThekwini.UPenniston uveze ukuthi bazihlonze kathathu izikhungo ezisengozini yokuthi kukotshelwe kuzona njengoba kukhona ezisezingeni eliphansi, eliphakathi kanjalo nalezo ezizokwenganyelwa ngumnyango. Kulezi ezisezingeni eliphansi ezingu-1 258, nezimaphakathi ezingu-338, kuzonquma ihhovisi lesifunda ukuthi ngubani ozokwengamela izikhungo. "Inhloso yokuziklelisa kanje nokuziqapha ngelokhozi yingoba singafuni ukuba nezivivinyo kanjalo nemiphumela ka-matric enogcobho. Lezi zikhungo zizoqashwa ngelokhozi ngoba asifuni kungcoliswe igama lomnyango wesifundazwe,” usho kanje.Izifunda uMlaza, noMzinyathi yizona ezinezikole ezingu-19 isifunda ngasinye esinezikhungo ezizophuca amandla okubhalisa ezika-matric. Zingu-18 eMgungundlovu naseZululand, Pinetown 11, eMajuba sisodwa. Ihlale iyiva eyokukopela kwabafundi kwa-matric cishe ezweni lonke ngoba kunomkhuba wokuthi kukopele inqwaba yabafundi kanye kanye, kungabi yidlanzana. Kwezinye izehlakalo kuthinteka othisha okuyibo abasuke betshela abafundi izimpendulo, kokunye kube abafundi ababanjwa 'bephethe umphako wezimpendulo’. UHlomuka uthe ababanjwe bekopela noma bekopelisa abafundi bayajeziswa.Izigwebo zifaka ukuthathwa njengento engekho imiphumela yaleso sifundo, umfundi ajeziswe ngokuthi ahlale iminyaka engazibhali lezi zivivinyo.Uveze nokuthi bami ngomumo ukubhalisa lezi zivivinyo ezizobhalwa abafundi abangu-172 433, ababhala ngokugcwele nabangu-18 019, ababhala ngasese. Babalelwa ku-56 abazobhala izivivinyo ezikhungweni ezehlukene zokuhlunyeleliswa kwezimilo."Sizogaya amaphepha angu-30 million kanti sizimisele ukuthola u-100%. Uma kwenzeka iphupho lethu lingaphumeleli, asifuni ukuthola ngaphansi kuka-90% njengoba sifuna ukunyuka sisuke ku-86%.” Uthe akekho ongeke angabhali ngenxa yokuthi isikole sakhe sakhahlanyezwa yizimvula noma isiphepho.Uveze ukuthi babe nezinhlelo zokufundisa abafundi ababalelwa ku-98 975 ngamaholidi, ezikhungweni ezingu-1 001. Zingu-32 izindawo zokumaka kanti kuqashwe abazobe besebenza ngesikhathi sokumaka abevile ku-9 000. Ukumaka kuqala ngoDisemba 1, kuphothulwe ngoDisemba 10.UNgqongqoshe kazwelonke uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, uzomemezela imiphumela ka-matric ngoJanuwari 15, 2025. "Esifundazweni imiphumela ngizoyikhipha ngoJanuwari 16, 2025 uma ngizobe ngisawuMphathiswa walo mnyango. Abafundi bazoyithola ngaleli langa ezikoleni. Sinezinhlelo esizenzile uma kungukuthi siyashintsha isimo sezulu uma kubhalwa ngasohlangothini lokulandwa nokuhanjiswa kwamaphepha,” kusho uHlomuka. Uncome nesikhungo esigaya amaphepha ezivivinyo ngezinga eliphezulu lezokuphepha njengoba kungangeni ngisho umakhalekhukhwini ngenxa yokuthi abafuni kube nephepha elizoputshuka.

KUZOBAMBEZELEKA ukuhlinzekelwa kwemiphakathi ngezidingo KwaZulu-Natal, ngenxa yesimo esibi sezimali kuhulumeni wesifundazwe.UNdunankulu uMnuz Thami Ntuli, uthe ezinye izethembiso ezenziwe uhulumeni wesifundazwe angeke zifezwe ngesikhathi esibekiwe ngenxa yesimo sezimali abazithola bengaphansi kwaso.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ethula umbiko ngezinsuku ezingu-100 zokusebenza kohulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal. Uhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal wamenyezelwa ngoJuni.UNtuli nabaphathiswa beminyango eyahlukene benza izethembiso ezinqala ngesikhathi bethula izabelomali zeminyango yabo.Ekhuluma esithangamini nabezindaba, uNtuli udwebe isithombe esingesihle ngesimo sezimali kuhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal."Uhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal awunayo imali eyanele. Lokho kusho ukuthi ngeke sikwazi ukufeza zonke izidingo esazenza ngesikhathi esibekiwe. Yize kunjalo, sizokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi siqhamuka namaqhinga amasha khona sizokwazi ukwenza okuncane ngalokhu esinakho.”UNtuli uthe babhekene nesimo lapho inyuka ngesivinini imali esetshenziswa uhulumeni wesifundazwe, bese kuthi eqoqwayo yona inciphe.Uthe uhulumeni wesifundazwe ukweleta izinkampani u-R10 billion, wathi kunesikweletu sika-R5, 5 billion okufanele sikhokhwe kulo nyaka wezimali.UMphathiswa wezeZimali, uMnuz Francios Rodgers, uthe inkinga yezimali KwaZulu-Natal idalwa ukuphundlwa iminyaka ilandelana kwesabelomali sesifundazwe uhulumeni kazwelonke."Ngihlezi ngikusho ukuthi asizifakanga thina kulesimo esikuso. Kule minyaka emine eyedlule uhulumeni kazwelonke unciphise isabelo saKwaZulu-Natal ngo-R66 billion. Kule minyaka emine ezayo isabelomali saKwaZulu-Natal sizoncipha ngo-R12 billion,”kusho uRodgers.URodgers uthe umsebenzi ababhekene nawo awulula."Akekho othe kuzokuba lula. Kuzokuba nzima kakhulu kulo nyaka kodwa lokho akusho ukuthi kufanele siphose ithawula.”Uhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal ubophele amaqembu ehlukene, amanye awo abeyinkukhu nempaka ngaphambi kokhetho, i-IFP, ANC, DA neNFP.UNtuli, obephahlwe abaphathiswa abaqhamuka kula maqembu ngesikhathi ekhuluma, uthe kunozinzo kuhulumeni wokubambisana ophethe isifundazwe.Uthe ukuhlangana kwezinsuku ezingu-100 kukhombisa ukuthi uhulumeni wokubambisana awuyi ndawo."Abanye babethi ngingundunankulu wesikhashana nje kodwa buka manje ukuthi sikuphi. Siyaqhubeka nokusebenza.”Lawa mazwi ananelwe abaphathiswa abaqhamuka kwamanye amaqembu, uMnuz Siboniso Duma, we-ANC, noNksz Mbali Shinga, weNFP.

Uthe umhlangano wabo nobuholi bukazwelonke bekuwumhlangano nje owejwayelekile."Umhlangano wethu uhambe kahle futhi sithanda ukubonga ukwesekwa esikuthola ebuholini bukazwelonke. Ngikholwa ukuthi kuseyizinsalela zesidumbu esisodwa nalezi ezitholwe ngoLwesihlanu,” usho kanje.Omunye wamalungu omphakathi ozidayisela okudliwayo ebangeni elingatheni ukusuka lapho zitholwe khona, uthe ngesikhathi efika ekuseni bekuvimbanise iphunga, kunzima nokusebenza."Ababulale lo muntu banesihluku esimangalisayo. Ngendlela ayiyo, kuyabonakala ukuthi uhlahleliwe wahlukaniswa. Akungabazeki ukuthi ngezomuntu oyedwa nalezi ezitholwe ngesonto eledlule. Njengoba sidayisa ukudla namhlanje ibhizinisi alihambi kahle ngenxa yalesi simo,” usho kanje.UMnuz Mbongeni Phewa, osekomitini elilwa nobugebengu endaweni, uthe bakholwa ukuthi umuntu ubulawelwe kwenye indawo. Uthe ukholwa ukuthi ababulali balokhu bezilaxaza mancozu izitho zomzimba wakhe athi kungenzeka ukuthi ezomuntu oyedwa nezitholwe phambilini.UMnuz Prem Balram wenkampani yonogada i-Reaction Unit of South of Africa, uthe ngesikhathi onogada befika kule ndawo bathole lezi zitho zomzimba zigoqwe ngengubo e-cream white kanye neshidi eli-pink."Ngesikhathi abasebenzi besondela behlolisisa lezi zicubu, bathole ukuthi umgogodla ubungekho. Izitho zomzimba ezitholakele bese ziala ukunokala. Okwamanje akukaqinisekiswa ukuthi lezi zitho ezandawonye nezitholwe ngoLwesihlanu,” usho kanje.Nakuba lezi zinsalela zisayohlolwa ukuqinisekisa ukuthi azizona ezandawonye, uma kungezandawonye kuzobe kusho ukuthi izitho ezingakatholakali okwamanje ingxenye yomzimba ukusuka eqolo kuya emadolweni, izandla nezitho zangaphakathi.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenat Colonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa aseNanda aphenya ngokutholakala kwezitho zomzimba womuntu zisongwe ngengubo yokulala zabekwa eceleni komgwaqo.
AMAPHOYISA athele othulini abathathu izolo, etholene phezulu nabesilisa abasolwa ngokuqotha umndeni wabayisikhombisa eHlokozi eHighflats.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uRobert Netshiunda, uthe kwabathathu abashonile kukhona nowesifazane otholwe kamumva, sekuseshwa imoto abebehamba ngayo.Elandisa uNetshiunda, uthe abesilisa ababili ebebehamba ngemoto bebeyamaniswa nokubulawa komndeni wakwaKhambule okukhona kuwo nezingane ezintathu ngoSepthemba 11."Abasolwa badutshulwe bafa ngesikhathi bedubulana namaphoyisa emgwaqweni uSt Faiths,” kuchaza uNetshiunda.Uthe amaphoyisa abelandela umkhondo ngesikhathi eqaphela imoto efana nobekuthiwa ihamba abasolwa."Azamile ukumisa umshayeli wayo kodwa esikhundleni sokuthi ame, bavele badubula bebhekise emaphoyiseni, nawo akhethe ukubuyisela ngayo inhlamvu,” kusho uNetshiunda.Uthe abasolwa ababili bafele khona lapho, kwathi uma sekubhekwa emotweni, kwatholwa owesifazane, naye esephangalele.Udalule ukuthi ngesikhathi sekuseshwa abasolwa, kutholwe isibhamu esikhulu nesiyi-pistol okuvele ukuthi ngesamaphoyisa."Amaphoyisa asaqhubeka nokucinga omunye umsolwa, okuthiwa ubaleke ngezinyawo,” kusho uNetshiunda.UPhilile Khambule ongounye wabantu abashona behlaselwa isithombe: SithunyelweEsigamekweni sakwaKhambule, kwabulawa umama wekhaya uNkk Bahlakaniphile Khambule (64), indodakazi yakhe uNksz Philile Khambule (39), umalokazana uNkk Nompilo Khambule (34), isihlobo uMnuz Sikhumbuzo Khambule nabazukulu uLisa Khambule (9), Siphosethu Khambule (9) noZemvelo Khambule (5).Abafi bahlaselwa ekhaya. Umndeni waveza ukuthi emasontweni ambalwa ngaphambi kwenhlekelele, kwakukhona abantu abangaziwa ababelokhu befika emzini wendodana yakwaKhambule eboshiwe, bezoyifuna ngodli. Kuthiwa babelibeka ngembaba elokuthu bafuna ukuyidubula. Kwavela ukuthi uNkk Bahlakaniphile Khambule ezama ukusindisa umalokazana wakwakhe nabazuluku, wathi abeze bazocasha ekhaya elikhulu, ukuze baphephe, nokuyilapho abagcina behlaselelwa khona babulawa nawo wonke umuntu owayekhona.
IZWE libhekene nobugebengu obehlukene okuhlale kubikwa ngabo nsuku zaphuma kwabezindaba, nasemphakathini ngokwehlukana kwezindawo.Nakuba ziningi futhi zehlukene izizathu ezibhebhethekisa izenzo zobugebengu emphakathini kodwa enye yezinkinga ezibhekene nezwe, yizinga eliphezulu lokusetshenziswa kwezidakamizwa. Ziningi izigebengu okuvela ukuthi zithola isidindi sokwenza izenzo zobulwane ngenxa yezidakamizwa. USolwazi Christian Bezuidenhout wophiko olucwaninga ngezobugebengu eNyuvesi iPretoria, ukholwa wukuthi ukusetshenziswa kwezidakamizwa nokutholakala kwazo kalula iyona nkinga enkulu ebhekene nezwe. "Inkinga enkulu wukuthi lezi zidakamizwa ezisetshenziswa ngabantu ngokweqile ikakhulu entsheni, zenza ukuthi izingane zigcine zingasayi ngisho ezikoleni. Lezi zidakamizwa zithengwa ngemali, ongene kuzona engasebenzi ugcina efuna izindlela ezilula zokuthi azithole. Ayeke isikole aqale ubugebengu bokondla umkhuba wakhe wezidakamizwa. Umuntu ugcina esenza noma yiluphi uhlobo lobugebengu, inqobo nje uma luzomnika imali yokuthi athole into yakhe. Ukuntshontsha, ukubulala umuntu, ukugqekeza emizini yabantu konke kugcina kuyinto elula nje,” usho kanje uSolwazi. Eqhuba, uthe ocwaningweni abasanda kulenza ezikoleni ezahlukene ezweni lonke, bathole ukuthi enye inkinga enkulu edala ukuthi kwande abantu abasebenzisa izidakamizwa ngokweqile, wukuthi u-60% wezingane ukhula ungahlali nabazali, okwenza zikhule zingalawuleki, lokho okwenza zilutheke kalula.ONGOTI bathi izidakamizwa zinomthelela omkhulu ebugebengwini obubonakala budla amagalane eNingizimu Afrika"Okunye okukhathazayo wukuthi lena akuyona inkinga ebhekene nohlanga oluthile kuphela, njengoba abanye abantu becabanga ukuthi kunjalo. Yinkinga esihluphayo ezweni lonke nokudinga ukuthi isukunyelwe ukuze ilungiseke. Okunye okusibeke lapha esikhona manje wukujwayela ukusebenzisa udlame ukulungisa izinkinga, okwenza ukuthi umuntu okhule kanjalo, azitshele ukuthi yindlela elungile yokwenza izinto, okwenza kube lula ukuthi ahlukumeze abanye abantu,” kusho uBezuidenhout.Ungoti wezomthetho ophikweni oluzimele, i-Institute for Security Studies, uNksz Lizette Lancaster, uthe ukusetshenziswa kwezidakamizwa ngokweqile ezweni ngenye yezinkinga okudingeka ukuthi ifakelwe izibuko ngokushesha ngenxa yokuthi inomthelela omubi kakhulu kwinhlalakahle yomphakathi.ABANYE kuthiwa baqala ngensangu bese bedlulela ezidakamizweni ezimba eqolo ezibenza benze noma yini ukuze bazithenge"Yinkinga yethu sonke lena, okudingeka ukuthi sibambisane nohulumeni ukuyilungisa. Kodwa ingcabha enkulu ngiyiphosa kuhulumeni, engikholwa wukuthi akakenzi okwanele ukuvimba ukushushumbiswa kwezidakamizwa, iningi lazo ezingekho emthethweni nezingena kuleli zwe zisuka kwamanye amazwe ngokungemthetho. Zibulala intsha yethu futhi ziholela ekutheni kuhlukumezeke umphakathi wakithi,” kusho uNksz Lancaster. UBezuidenhout uxwayise nangokuthi akumele ishaywe indiva eyokusetshenziswa ngokweqile kwezidakamizwa okusemthethweni ukuzisebenzisa, kubalwa utshwala nensangu."Ucwaningo esengike ngalwenza lwaveza ukuthi abantu abagcina beyimilutha yezidakamizwa ezingekho emthethweni, basuke beqale ngensangu. Ngeke sikubalekele futhi ukuthi abanye abantu baqala ngokusebenzisa izidakamizwa 'ukuthatha isibindi’ andukuba benze izinto ezihlukumeza amalungelo abanye abantu emphakathini,” kusho uBezuidenhout.
UGXEKE ukubulawa kwezinduna ezimbili ezehlakalweni ezehlukene KwaZulu-Natal uMphathiswa woMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi.KwaNondayana KwaCeza, ngoMsombuluko kudutshulwe kwafa induna yobukhosi bakwaButhelezi, KwaPhindangene, uMnuz Sibongiseni Wilson Buthelezi (51).Kuthiwa abasolwa bamhlasele esendleleni eya esigcawini samacala enkantolo yesizwe, kuthiwa kwale ngisho esezama ukubaleka, bamkaka bambulala. Kulesi sigameko kulimale nomunye owesilisa abehamba naye, okumanje usesibhedlela.NgoMgqibelo, kudutshulwe kwabulawa uNkk Jabulile Joyce Makgosi (78), ohlaselwe ekhaya eSleevdonald eDannhauser. Kuvela ukuthi kugasele abasolwa abangaziwa, bavulela ngenhlamvu. Kugcine kulimala nomunye owesilisa ophuthunyiswe esibhedlela.UMfu Buthelezi uthe kuyamkhathaza ukuthi izigameko zalolu hlobo zishiyane ngezinsuku ezimbalwa."Kudweba isithombe esingesihle ngodlame,” kusho uMfu Buthelezi.Uthe badangele ngokubulawa kwenduna uButhelezi, wathi badlulisa amazwi enduduzo enkosini uZuzifa Buthelezi.Ephawula ngokubulawa kukaNkk Makgosi, uthe kuyamkhathaza ukubulawa kwabesifazane ngesihluku.Unxuse zonke izinhlaka zamaphoyisa nomphakathi ukuthi basebenzisane ukuze abenzi bobubi babanjwe bese bebhekana nengalo yomthetho.Inkosi yakwaButhelezi, uZuzifa Buthelezi, uthe kuyakhathaza ukubulawa kwabaholi bomdabu nsuku zonke."Cishe ayikho inkosi engakaze yehlelwe yilokhu endaweni yayo. Egameni lethu sonke singamakhosi ngithi lokhu akubekezeleki,” kusho uButhelezi.Uqhube wathi basalishaya namanje ikhwelo emaphoyiseni ukuthi awaphenye bese eyabopha."Ingalo yomthetho mayibonakale, izwakale ukuthi ikhona iyasebenza. Kuyajabhisa ukubona izinga lobugebengu obunesihluku nezinga lokubopha ababulali kushiyana kakhulu. Iyingcosana impumelelo yokubopha kunezinhlekelele ezibikwa nsuku zaphuma,” kusho uButhelezi.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uColonel Robert Netshiunda eqinisekisa isehlakalo saseDannhauser, uthe amaphoyisa aphenya icala lokubulala nelokuzama ukubulala kulandela isigameko sokudutshulwa kwababili ekhaya labo eSleevdonald ngoMgqibelo."Owesifazane (78) ushonele endaweni yesigameko, kwathi owesilisa waphuthunyiswa esibhedlela emva kokulimala. Imbangela yokubulala ayikaziwa,” kusho uNetshiunda.Kwesokubulawa kukaButhelezi, uthe KwaCeza amaphoyisa aphenya icala lokubulala nelokuzama ukubulala emva kokudutshulwa kwababili, kwashona oyedwa ngoMsombuluko."Abagilwa bebesemotweni ngesikhathi kuthushuka abasolwa abangaziwa, bavulela ngenhlamvu, owesilisa (51) washonela khona lapho,” kusho uNetshiunda.Uthe olimele udubuleke edolweni, waphuthunyiswa esibhedlela kanti imbangela yokudubula ayaziwa.Isifundazwe iKwaZulu-Natal sibhekene nengwadla yokubulawa kwabaholi bomdabu njengoba kunezinduna namakhosi angaphezu kuka-50 asesocongiwe kusukela ngo-2019.
IKHULUNYELWA phansi eyezinsolo zokuthakatha kudutshulwa, kubulawa abomndeni abathathu eMbulwane eMatimatolo ngeledlule.Kulesi sigameko esenzeke ngoLwesine kushone uNkk Sibongile Mpungose (60), indodakazi yakhe uNksz Noluthando Mpungose (34) nomzukulu uZekhethelo Mpungose (6).Kusinde izingane ezimbili, eyodwa eneminyaka engu-14, okubikwa ukuthi isesibhedlela, bese kuba eneminyaka eyisithupha, okuthiwa iphume ingenamyocu.Kwesinye isigameko esenzeke emva kwalesi, kudutshulwe kwabulawa umakhelwane, uNkk Ngubane, okuvela ukuthi uhlala ngezansi kwakaMpungose.Inkosi yesizwe, uMnuz Mpendulo Cele uthe uwuvakashele kabili umndeni wakwaMpungose kulandela isigameko kodwa lutho ukudalula ukuthi basolani ngenhlekelele."Noma umndeni ungakaze usitshele ukuthi kwenzekani kodwa into ekhulunywayo emphakathini, kuthiwa bayathakatha,” kusho uCele.UMUFI uNksz Noluthando MpungoseUthe njengoba egcine eqothwa nendodakazi yakhe nomzukulu uNkk Mpungose, bese kungokwesithathu ehlaselwa ngokudutshulwa."Kulezi zikhawu ezimbili ezedlule ubelokhu esinda. Esinye sazo senzeka eminyakeni emihlanu edlule, kwathi esinye senzeka eminyakeni eminingi ngaphambi kwalokho, nami ngangisafunda enyuvesi, ngingakahlali esihlalweni,” kusho uCele.Nokho uthe uyawukhuza umoya wokunukana kwabantu ngokuthakatha endaweni, wathi kufanele bayiyeke inkoleloze yokuthi uma omunye umuntu engcono, bese kucatshangwa ukuthi uyathakatha.UMUFI uZekhethelo Mpungose Uqhube wathi ubize imbizo kule ndawo ngoLwesihlanu ukuze kuzobhungwa ngesigameko kanjalo nenkolelo yobuthakathi endaweni.Isihlobo esicele ukungadalulwa sithe basadidekile ukuthi izothiwani indaba yezingane ezimbili ezisinde esigamekweni njengoba zisencane futhi zifunda endaweni."Asikakazi ukuthi uma sithi aziqhubeke zihlale kuleli khaya zizohlala nobani njengoba abantu abadala abebekhona bebulewe,” kusho isihlobo.Uthe basadidekile ukuthi abafi babulawelweni, wanxusa amaphoyisa ukuthi enze umsebenzi wawo ukuthola abenzi bobubi.UMphathiswa woMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, uthe bayasigxeka isehlakalo."Ukubulawa kwabesifazane ngesihluku esinje kukhombisa ngokusobala ukuthi kuningi okonakele emphakathini futhi kudinga ukulungiswa masinyane. Sinxusa amaphoyisa ukuthi enze konke okusemandleni ukuthola abasolwa,” kusho uButhelezi.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa aseMatimatolo aphenya amacala amathathu okubulala nelilodwa lokuzama ukubulala."Imbangela yokubulala ayikaziwa okwamanje, amaphoyisa aphansi phezulu acinga abasolwa,” kusho uNetshiunda.
UBE mayoywana ukugxekwa ezinkundleni zokuxhumana umculi wokholo, uWinnie Mashaba ofike ngendiza encane eyobhonga emswaneni ekhaya likazakwabo osanda kudlula emhlabeni, uSolly Moholo eRustenburg.Abantu bebegxeka lo mculi bethi kucacile ukuthi iphakethe lakhe liqumbile, ukwazi ukuqasha indiza eya eRustenberg ekubeni uMoholo ebesenkingeni edinga imali yokuhlinzwa esibhedlela kunzima.UWINNIE Mashaba ugxekwe ngokuthanda ukubukwa efika ngendiza ezimele eyobhonga emswaneni kazakwabo uSolly MoholoBathi bekumele lo mculi ahambe phambili ekufakeni imali yezindleko zesibhedlela. UWinnie ugxekwa nje yingoba unameke i-video yakhe esendizeni ethwishile imilenze, esho ukuthi ubeyobhonga emswaneni emndenini kazakwabo.Kule video uthe ujabule kakhulu ukuthi ubeyobona unina kamufi, wathi ujabule kakhulu uma embona." Yini ebiyenza ukuthi ungathathi leyo mali oqashe ngayo indiza, usize uzakwenu obeseshilo ukuthi uxakekile,” kubuza omunye ophawule kule video ebinanyekwe kuX.Abanye bebethi lo mculi bekumele kuthi noma ehambe ngendiza, anganameki ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ngoba lokhu kubukeka sakuchoma. Bamsole nangokuthanda ukubukwa ngezikhathi ezingafanele.Kodwa abanye bebemvikela, bethi asaziwa isizathu esenze ukuthi akhethe ukuqasha indiza. Mhlawumbe ubephuthuma kodwa efuna ukuyobhonga emswaneni kazakwabo.UWinnie phambilini uchaze umufi njengobefana nomfowabo, abenze naye izinto eziningi ebeziyinqubekela phambili.
ULIKHOMBE kumsolwa wokuqala icala lokubulala abesifazane ababengabangani, umsolwa wesibili efaka isicelo sebheyili eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini ngoMsombuluko.UMnuz Sandile Chili (44) ongumsolwa wesibili oveze ukuthi uqale ukwazana nomsolwa wokuqala, uMnuz Lungani Mthethwa (38) ngo-2022, emfundisa ukuhweba ngemali, ubevele naye phambi kwenkantolo.Babhekene necala lokudubula babulale uNksz Anele Mbokazi noNksz Zizipho Gabisa baseRiverview, eVerulam. Baphinde babhekane necala lokubamba inkunzi kuhlonyiwe, bese kuthi uChili abhekane nelokutholakala nesibhamu esingekho emthethweni nezinhlamvu.Abafi batholwa bedindilizile emgwaqweni waseKenville, eThekwini.UMthethwa osenommeli omusha, ukhethe ukusilaxaza isicelo sebheyili okwamanje.Efaka isicelo sebheyili uChili, udalule ukuthi umuntu owadubula abafi ephindelela uMthethwa.Bekungemumva kokufundwa kwencwadi yakhe efungelwe lapho engene khona ebhokisini lofakazi, wachaza ukusuka nokuhlala kokwazana kwabo nabafi.Uveze ukuthi baqala ukwazana (nabafi) emcimbini wakubo e-Escourt ngo-Agasti 10, kwashintshwana ngezinimbolo zamaselula, kwase kuxoxwa ezingcingweni."Ngo-Agasti 24, ngesikhathi siyobalanda eRiverview, sasibabona okwesibili," kuchaza uChili, othe yena wayeseqonywe uNksz Gabisa, kuthi uMthethwa aqonywe uNksz Mbokazi.Uthe kwatetenyukwa kwayodliwa endaweni yokudla ephambili, kwathengwa utshwala, kwase kubhukhwa eRoyal Hotel."Uye umsolwa wokuqala owayenza yonke into ngoba ngisho imoto esasihamba ngayo kwakungeyakhe, konke okukhokhelwayo, okukhona kukho ukudla, utshwala nokubhukha, konke kwakhokhelwa wuye," kusho uChili.Uveze ukuthi ngezikhathi zasebusuku, kwaba khona ukunengeka kuMthethwa ebona ucingo lukaNksz Mbokazi lukhala into engapheli."Wachaza uNksz Mbokazi ukuthi izingcingo zazivela kubo, umfowabo usethathe imoto yakhe waya ezindaweni zobumnandi, waboshwa," kusho uChili.Uthe yilapho uNksz Mbokazi aveza khona ukuthi usezobiza imoto ekhokhelwa ngebanga elihambile, nokho yena wancenga uMthethwa ukuthi akuzwakali kahle ukuthi bafike bathathe "izingane" emakubo bese beyazilaxaza.Uqhube wathi bathi uma sebedlula ngasebhulohweni, iTollgate (Berea), uNksz Mbokazi waveza ukuthi inkinga yokuboshwa kukamfowabo nemoto yakhe isixazululekile."Ngozela ngalala, ngaphaphama sesiseKenville, ngathi uma ngimbuza uMthethwa ukuthi siyaphi, wathi siya kumngani wakhe ukuyoxilonga imoto ngoba uyizwa iqhaqhazela," kusho uChili.Uthe wathi esaxakwe yilokho, wabona uMthethwa eseyimisa imoto, ephuca uNksz Mbokazi iselula yakhe, wafuna ngodli nekaNksz Gabisa.Uthe wabe esebatshela ukuthi abakhale phansi."Nami ngavele ngehla. Yaqhubeka ingxabano phakathi kwabo. UMthethwa ethi akakholwa ukuthi ibikhona inkinga eyehlele umfowabo, yena akubonayo ukuthi banamanye amasoka. Ngamtshela ukuthi kodwa asikho isidingo sengxabano, ngase ngiwelela ngaphesheya komgwaqo ngiyochama nokuyilapho ngezwa isibhamu siqhuma kabili," kusho uChili.Uthe waqale wagoba engazi noma bayahlaselwa yini kodwa wathi uma ebuka ngaphesheya, wabona abesifazane sebelele phansi."Kwavele kwanqamuka nomchamo, ngabuyela khona. Waphinde wabaphinda ngezinye izinhlamvu ezimbili, wathi angingene emotweni, sihambe," kusho uChili.Uthe sebehamba endleleni, uMthethwa wamdonsa ngendlebe ethi: "Awubonanga lutho futhi awuhlangani nalokhu okuqeda kwenzeka la".Uthe wamcela ukuthi amgodukise nokwathatha isikhathi njengoba waqale wayoshintsha imoto endlini yakhe eSherwood, wabuye wayolanda izimpahla zakhe ehhotela.Uthe wafika kwakhe walala njengoba ayephuzile futhi ozela.UMbuso umsolile nokho ubuza ukuthi yini eyadala ukuthi abe nesibindi sokulala, eqeda kubona kubulawa abesifazane ngesihluku.Uzithethelele ngokuthi wayengenayo i-airtime yokufonela amaphoyisa futhi wayesaba ngoba uMthethwa wayengamenzakalisa nomndeni wakhe.Uphinde wamsola uMbuso ngokusenga ezimithiyo, uthi njengoba bagcina bebanjwa bobabili eSouth Beach ingoba icala balihlela, balenza bobabili.Waphendula ngelithi, into eyamyisa kuMthethwa ukufuna ukuyozwa ukuthi iyiphi indlela ekahle yokulubika lolu daba emaphoyiseni.Udalule ukuthi baboshwa nje, zazisayime emthumeni emva kokuthi ephikise itulo likaMthethwa lokuthi kungcono amaphoyisa bawatshele ukuthi abafi baphume bahamba ehhotela beyogibela imoto ekhokhelwa ngebanga elihambile."Saphikisana kakhulu ngalokhu, ngimtshela ukuthi amakhamera akhona, ikhona nekhona ehhotela, kuzovela ukuthi baphume behamba nathi," kusho uChili.Uveze ukuthi ushadelwe, unezingane eziyisikhombisa, unendlu emaflethini eCornubia ayithola ngo-2018, uziphilisa ngokubamba amatoho okuba umqaphi.Ngesikhathi ethula ubufakazi uChili ubelokhu ebheke phansi, ebonakala engahlalisekile. UMthethwa obesebhokisini labasolwa ubebonakala enyukubele, eqalaza lapho bekuhleli imindeni. Inkantolo imdedele ngebheyili kaR5000, ibalula ukuthi ubufakazi abethulile bumbeka njengomuntu owayesendaweni engafanele, ngesikhathi esingafanele.Inengekile imindeni yabafi nabayesekayo, uChili enikwa ibheyili.Emuva kokuthi enikwa ibheyili basukume bangana abomndeni wakhe. Icala liyabuyela enkantolo ngoNovemba 21.
IKHATHAZEKILE ikhomishini yezokulingana ngokobulili ngabafundi abasebancane abakhulelwa besezikoleni kuleli.La bafundi abanye babo abaneminyaka engu-10 kuya ku-19, kuthiwa basaba ngisho ukuya emitholampilo noma ezibhedlela beyohlela imindeni ngokulanda amaphilisi okuhlela umndenia noma bayojova ngoba besaba amehlo abantu.Abanye kuthiwa basaba ngisho ukuyoxukuza njalo ngenyanga ngoba besaba. Lokhu kuvezwe ngumcwaningi wale khomishini uNksz Lieketseng Mohlakoana-Motopi, ekhuluma muva nje enkundleni yokubonisana ebihlelwe yikhomishini yezokhetho kuleli.Uveze ukukhathazeka ngoba sinyuka njalo isibalo sabafundi abakhulelwayo njengoba nyakenye bebengu-136 000.Uthe lesi sibalo sinyuke sisuka ku-87 000 sabaneminyaka engu-10 kuya ku-19, abakhulelwe."Kumele abafundi abaneminyaka engu-10 uma sebeyobeletha kufunwe ababakhulelisile ngoba ukudlwengula lokho. Ukulala nomuntu ongaphansi kuka-16, kuyicala ikakhulu uma kungabantu abadala ababakhululelisile,” usho kanje.Uthe abanye ababelethile ababe besabuyela esikoleni.Ugxeke umgomo owawusetshenziswa nguMnyango weMfundo eyisiSekelo, ngabafundi abakhulelwe."Lo mgomo owawuthi umfundi kumele ahlale ekhaya iminyaka emibili esakhulisa ingane, wenza inqwaba yabafundi balaxaza isikole. Abanye bamane banqena ukubuyela esikoleni emva kokubeletha ngenxa yokuthi babezobuyela ekilasini abashiya belifunda. Bakhala ngokuthi bazobuyela ekilasini ababelifunda sebefunda nezingane ezibalamayo,” kusho uNksz Mohlakoana-Motopi.Ugqugquzele abazali ukuthi bakhulume nezingane zabo bazixwayise ngocansi."Nami nginengane yomfana eneminyaka engu-10, kodwa angikhumbuli ngimxwayisa ngezocansi. Kubalulekile ukuthi sishintshe indlela esenza ngayo, sikhulume nezingane zethu ngocansi nobungozi balo uma zisencane.” UNksz Mohlakoana-Motopi ubuye wakhala ngothisha abakhulelisa abafundi bese bejaha ukuyokhokha inhlawulo ukuze bavale amacala abo.Uthe abanye abazali ababiki uma ingane yabo ikhuleliswe ngumuntu omdala ngoba lowo muntu eyisa ibhodwe eziko.Umgomo omusha womnyango mayelana nabafundi abakhulelwe ugqugquzela abakhulelwe ukuthi bafunde kuze kusondele izinsuku zabo zokubeletha.Uma sebebelethile bayagqugquzelwa ukuthi basheshe babuyele ezikoleni, bezoqedela.Umengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, muva nje ekhuluma kugujwa usuku lo thisha emhlabeni, uzwakalise ukukhathazeka ngabafundi abangasiphothuli isikole abashiya phakathi.
ABASEBENZI bafuna uhulumeni angenelele avimbe izinkampani ezisebenzisa isigaba somthetho u-189 sokudiliza abasebenzi. Basola ukuthi basuke bebajezisa uma kukhona lapho bephakamisa ukungeneliseki ngokuthile okwenziwa ngabaqashi.Lokhu kuvele ohlwini lwezikhalo zabasebenzi, emashini yezinyunyana ezingaphasi kwemifelandawonye, iCongress of Trade Unions neFederation of Unions of South Africa ebiseThekwini, izolo.Lezi ziteleka zabasebenzi ebeziholwa yiCosatu, beziqhubeka nakwezinye izifundazwe. Efunda uhlu lwezikhalo uNobhala weCosatu KwaZulu-Natal uMnuz Edwin Mkhize, uthe lesi sigaba somthetho esigunyaza ukudilizwa kwabasebenzi, kunabaqashi asebesisebenzisa ngenhloso yokwenyusa nje inzuzo noma ukuziphindiselela uma kukhona lapho abasebenzi bekhala ngokunganeliseki."Sinalo uhlu lwezinkampani ezizimele ezixhaphaza abasebenzi zisebenzisa lolu hlelo. Sifuna uhulumeni angenelele ,ukunqanda lesi sihlava njengoba bebaningi abantu abaphelelwa imisebenzi, abadilizwa kungenasidingo,”usho kanje.Kulolu hlu, abasebenzi baphinde baveza ukukhathazeka kwabo ngesimo somnotho kuleli abathi sicindezela abantu abahluphekayo. Bakhale ngokufakwa ngaphansi kwezinkampani ezizimele kwamabhizinisi kahulumeni, ukugida ndawonye kwamaholo namanani okudla, ugesi namanzi amba eqolo.BEBEYIBHIKLA kanje abasebenzi izolo ngesikhathi kuqhubeka imashi yamalungu eCosatu neFedusa , eThekwini Isithombe: SIBONELO NGCOBO/INDEPENDENT MEDIAIzikhulu zekhomishini ebhekelele ukuxazulula ukungaboni ngaso linye phakathi kwabaqashi nabasebenzi i-Commission for Conciliation, Mediation and Arbitration (CCMA), nazo bezikhona ukwemukela uhlu lwezikhalo. Le khomishini ayisalanga ngaphandle ekugxekweni, njengoba abasebenzi bekhala ngokuchema kwayo nomqashi uma kumele ixazulule ukungaboni ngasolinye. Bathi bafuna okhomishana abahlalela amacala, baveze izinkampani abacheme nazo okukholakala ukuthi zibanika intshontsho ekuqinisekiseni ukucindezelwa kwabasebenzi.Kugxekwe noMasipala iTheku ngohlelo lwawo lokudiliza abasebenzi, izinyunyana zibanqumela ugwayi katiki ngokuthi babuyiselwe emsebenzini. Kukhalwe ngohlelo lokwenyuka kwamanani kagesi namanzi kulo masipala. Isibalo sabebeyihambele imashi eseThekwini besisisincane ukuqhathanisa nezifanayo eminyakeni edlule. Abebemasha bebehlukene amaqoqo amathathu, kuze kwaqaala izinkulumo elinye iqoqo lisayibhikla emgwaqweni.Phakathi kwezinhlangano ebezimelelekile ukuxhasa lesi siteleka, yi- South African National Civics Organisation, South African Communist Party neCongress of South African Students.Bonke abebekhuluma egameni lezinhlangano, bagxeke uhulumeni wobumbano, beveza ukuthi iqembu elibusayo alizange libafake ezingxoxweni okwakudingidwa ngokubunjwa kwawo. Kwabamukele uhlu lwezikhalo, uNgqongqoshe woMnyango wezeSayensi nobuChwepheshe Dkt Blade Nzimande obemele uhulumeni kazwenke, uMfundisi Thulasizwe Buthelezi onguMphathiswa woMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana KwaZulu obemele uhulumeni wesifundazwe, yiMeya kuMasipala iTheku uMnuz Cyril Xaba, abebemele i-CCMA nabebemele inhlangano yosomabhizinisi.
I-DA igqugquzele abahola izibonelelo zikahulumeni ukuba bavule ama-akhawunti asebhange emuva kokuthola ukuthi abaningi abakwazi ukuthola imali yabo eposini.UNkk Bridget Masango okhulumela iDA kwezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi ePhalamende, uthe bathole izikhalo kubantu abahola impesheni emaposini njengoba bengayitholi.Uveze ukuthi abantu batshelwa ukuthi ngeke bayithole imali yabo bengakashintsheli emakhadini amnyama asePostbank noma bayalelwe ukuthi abayohola ezitolo.Lokhu uthe kudala izinkinga kubantu abadala akade bejwayele ukuyohola eposini ngaphansi kwePostbank."Ukushintsha kwezinhlelo zePostbank kusho ukuthi abantu abadala abazitholi izibonelelo zabo emaposini. Sithole ukuthi abantu batshelwa ukuthi mabashintshele emakhadini amasha amnyama asePostbank bashintshe lawa anombala osagolide akwaSouth African Social Security Agency (Sassa). Sibona ukuthi umlayezo wokushintshwa kwamakhadi awuzange ufinyelele kubantu ngesikhathi yingakho sebekhala uma bechazelwa ukuthi kufanele bashintshe amakhadi,” kusho uNkk Masango.Uthe bazokhuluma noNgqongqoshe wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi, uNkk Sisisi Tolashe ngalolu daba ngoba luphazamisa abadala abasuke beyohola impesheni yabo kahulumeni.Ubalule ukuthi yize amakhadi anombala osagolide eSassa esasebenza njengoba ezophelelwa yisikhathi makuphela lo nyaka kodwa kubukeka sengathi abanye abasebenzi baseposini abakwazi lokhu."Sicela abantu bashintshele ukuhola izibonelelo zabo emabhange ngoba izinkinga zaseposini ziphazamisa ukuholwa kwezibonelelo. Kunzima ngoba iposi liwusizo kakhulu emakhaya lapho kungekho khona izinxanxathela zezitolo. Njengamanje abantu batshelwa ukuthi abayohola isibonelelo ezitolo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi bazogibela ukuze bafinyelele kuzo. Kunzima ngoba abanayo nemali yokugibela.”Ubuye wakhala ngokuthi izibonelelo zikahulumeni azisaholwa uma kuqala inyanga nakho lokhu kwandisa umthwalo kwabaziholayo njengoba belindela ukuthola imali uma kuphela inyanga.Uthe encwadini abayibhalile bafuna uNgqongqoshe aqinisekise ukuthi abasebenzi baseposini bayakuqonda ukuthi amakhadi akwaSassa asasebenza futhi abantu bayayithola imali yabo noma bengakawenzi amakhadi amnyama.Abafuni kube nomuntu ojikiswayo eposini ngenxa yokuthi akakalishintshi ikhadi kodwa wonke umuntu kufanele asithole isibonelelo sakhe.Bafuna kubhekwe nezinye izindlela abantu abangathola ngayo izibonelelo zabo njengoba benezingqinamba emaposini asemakhaya.Uphethe ngokuthi abafuni kube nezithiyo ezivimba abantu ukuba bathole izibonelelo.
LUGOBILE uphondo eqenjini Umkhonto weSizwe ePhalamende izolo, ihoxisa umholi wayo ePhalamende uDkt John Hlophe, ekubeni yilungu lekomiti eliphakamisa amagama abantu abazoba amajaji kuMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, i-Judicial Service Commission (JSC).UHlophe usule ekubeni yilungu leJSC kulandela ukuchithwa kwesicelo saleli qembu, sokuzama ukuvimba ukuhlala komhlangano weJSC, oqale izolo wokuphonsa imibuzo abantu abazoba amajaji. UHlophe wavinjwa yinkantolo enkulu yaseWestern Cape ukuthi abe yingxenye yeJSC njengoba axoshwa njengejaji.Okhulumela iMK uMnuz Nhlamulo Ndhlela, uthe babhalele noSomlomo wePhalamende, uNkk Thoko Didiza, bemazisa ngesinqumo. UNdhlela uthe bafuna uNkk Didiza azise uSihlalo weJSC, oyinhloko yamajaji uMandisa Maya, ngalesi sinqumo."Silihoxilise ngokushesha igama likaDkt Hlophe kwiJSC. Asifuni igama lakhe lihlanganiswe nohlelo olungekho emthethweni lweJSC. Simile ekutheni ukuchithwa kukaHlophe kuleli komiti kufana nokuphula isigatshana u-178, soMthethosisekelo wezwe.” UNdhlela uthe libukelwe phansi ilungelo likaHlophe lokuba yingxenye yaleli komiti nakuba akhethwa ngokusemthethweni. Isolezwe liyibonile nencwadi ebhalelwe uNkk Didiza nguSotswebhu waleli qembu ePhalamende uMnuz Mzwanele Manyi, emazisa ngokusula kukaHlophe kwi-JSC.UManyi uthe iMK iyamhoxisa uHlophe kwiJSC wathi akwaziswe uJaji Maya. Kwenzeka lokhu nje kuyaqhubeka namhlanje ukuhlala umhlangano weJSC njengoba iMK ihoxise nombhikisho wayo ebewuhlelile ukuthi izowubamba eSandton, lapho kuqhubeka khona lesi sigcawu.UNdhlela ubelokhu ekhale njalo ngokuthi lolu hlelo lweJSC lokuphonsa imibuzo lwe-JSC lubanjwa ngaphansi kwefu elimnyama ngenxa yokunqatshelwa kukaHlophe kwiJSC. Umhlangano weJSC kuhlelwe ngawo ukuvala izikhala ezingu-21 ezinkantolo ezehlukene kuleli. Bangu-54 abazophoswa ngemibuzo yokuvala lezi zikhala. Okhulumela i-JSC uMnuz Mvuzo Notyesi, uthe bebefisa ukuthi wonke umuntu okhethwe ukuba yingxenye ye-JSC, abekhona kuyona yonke imihlangano.Uveze ukuthi lolu hlelo aluqhubeki ngaphansi kwefu elimnyama ngenxa yokuthi uHlophe akekho."Kumele sikusho ukuthi le mihlangano iqhubeka ngendlela ehleliwe njengoba anele amalungu e-JSC. Ngokwethu sifisa ukuthi wonke umuntu okhethelwe kwi-JSC, abe yingxenye kodwa sinemithetho yezwe okumele siyilandele,” kusho uNotyesi.Uthe kubalulekile ukuthi zivalwe izikhala ezivuleke ezinkantolo ezehlukene ukuze usebenze ngendlela umthetho."KwaZulu-Natal ziyisithupha izikhala ezikhona, kanjalo nakwezinye izifundazwe kudingeka izikhala zivalwe. Maningi amacala asilele emuva ngenxa yokuthi amajaji ayashoda,” kusho uNotyesi
INHLANGANO yepolitiki i-South African Communist Party (SACP) ikhala ngomkhuba omusha ongenisile wokukhokhiswa kwabesifazane imali yokubavikela ukuze bangadlwengulwa. Le nhlangano ithe lo mkhuba usuwande e-Eastern Cape, njengoba abesifazane bakhona bethi indaba ye-protection fee, isithathe elinye igxathu. UNobhala jikelele weSACP, uMnuz Solly Mapaila, uthe le nkinga yokukhokhiswa kwabantu imali yokubavikela, usungene kwelinye igiya e-EC njengoba sekukhokhiswa abesifazane ukuze bangadlwengulwa.Uthe kudingeka balwe nalesi sihlava ngoba wukuhlunyezwa kwabesifazane."Asikwazi ukuthi singahlaliswa lubhojozi yizigebengu ezweni lethu. Siyaya e-Eastern Cape, ukuyolwa nalo mkhuba omubi okuthiwa wenzeka kulesiya sifundazwe, lapho abesifazane bekhokhiswa khona imali ukuze bangadlwengulwa,” kusho uMapaila. Ukusho lokhu izolo, ekhuluma ngesikhathi ethula umkhankaso waminyaka yonke weSACP, i-Red October, eMpumalanga.Ngaphansi kwalo mkhankaso, le nhlangano isuke ilwa nezinto eziningi okubalwa imisebenzi, indlala, ubugebengu nezinye.I-SACP isho lokhu nje, usabalele ezindaweni eziningi lo mkhuba wokukhokhiswa kosomabhizinisi imali yokuthi bavikelwe.Kukhokhiswa abanezitolo, abanezindlu zokuqashisa kanti e-Eastern Cape naseKapa, kuthiwa kukhokhiswa ngisho abadayisa emigwaqweni.UMapaila uthembise nokushubisela uhulumeni wokubambisana kwamaqembu kuleli njengoba ethe bazowunyakazisa. Uthe bazokwenza lokhu ngoba abanye ongqongqoshe bafuna izinkampani namabhizinisi angaphansi kukahulumeni, awele ezandleni zomkhakha ozimele."Muva nje, uNgqongqoshe wezokuXhumana (Solly Malatsi) uveze ukuthi bafuna ukufaka ingxenye yePosi ngaphansi komkhakha ozimele. Labo ngqongqoshe bacabanga ukuthi yonke into engaphansi kukahulumeni kumele inikezwe umkhakha ozimele ukuze isebenze.”Uthe bazophoqa uhulumeni ukuthi usheshise eyomshwalense wezempilo, i-National Health Insurance, ngoba isingumthetho."Akumele ilokhu ixoxwa ukuthi izoma kanjani noma kubuyekezwe okuthile kwi-NHI ngoba sekuwumthetho. Ongxiwa abeneme ngolwe-NHI yingakho befuna kuphinde kuxoxwe ngezinye zezinto kulo mthetho.”UMapaila akayizwa eyohulumeni wokubambisana njengoba ethi abawufuni."I-DA iqembu labacindezeli, kalimele abantu abamnyama. Sizibuza ukuthi kungani i-ANC yanquma ukungena emshadweni ne-DA? Asiwufuni lo mshado ngoba ngeke ubasize ngalutho abantu.”
UMENGAMELI Cyril Ramaphosa, usethembise ukuthi uMgcinimafa uzoyisukumela eyezingqinamba zemali ezibhekene noMnyango weMfundo eyisiSekelo.URamaphosa uthe uNgqongqoshe wezeziMali, uMnuz Enoch Godongwana, kumele azibambe ziqine njengoba inkulu impi ebhekiswe kuyena yiminyango efuna imali ethe xaxa.Usho lokhu nje uMnyango weMfundo eyisiSekelo, ubhekene nezingqinamba zokushodelwa yimali, okuzophoqa ukuthi kwezinye izifundazwe zingavalwa izikhala zothisha.UNgqongqoshe weMfundo eyisiSekelo uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, ukuvezile ukuthi uzohlangana noGodongwana, ayohlwaya uxhaso ngoba babhekene nengwadla."UNgqongqoshe uNksz Gwarube, uyivezile eyezinselelo ezibhekene nomnyango, wathi uzoya nakuGodongwana ayofuna uxhaso. Siyazi uMgcinimafa uzoyisukumela eyezinselelo ezibhekene nomnyango ngoba imfundo sisayibeke phambili. Kumele wesekwe umsebenzi owenziwa ngothisha ezikoleni,” kusho uRamaphosa ekhuluma emcimbini wokuhlonipha othisha abenze kahle eBoksburg ngempelasonto. Njengoba bekugujwa nosuku lothisha emhlabeni wonke, uhloniphe iqhaza labo ekubumbeni isizwe.URamaphosa ubuye wehlisa amaphaphu emkhakheni wezemfundo ngokuthi kukhona ukungqubuzana kuhulumeni wokubambisana ngenxa yokusayinwa komthetho wezikole okunemvunge ngawo, iBela muva nje.Uthe njengoba amisa ukuqala ukusebenza kwezigatshana ezimbili kulo mthetho, ezinye zazo ziyasebenza."Umthetho uqalile ukusebenza kumanje nakuba simise izinyanga ezintathu ukuqalisa ukusebenza kwalezi zigatshana ezimbili. Akukho ukungqubuzana kwiKhabhinethi ngenxa yalo mthetho,” kusho uRamaphosa.Uthe lo mthetho uzoqinisa imigomo kwezemfundo wathi yingakho beqhubeka nawo."Nginxusa abantu ukuthi baweseke lo mthetho ukuze abafundi bathole imfundo esezingeni. Ezinye zezinto ezizokwenziwa ngumthetho ngukuqinisa amazinga aphansi emfundo, kuzoba nokulingana, abazali bazobamba iqhaza kuthi labo abaphula imigomo ebekiwe bajeze,” kusho uRamaphosa.Ukhale ngezinga eliphezulu labafundi abangasiphothuli isikole ekubeni kufundwa mahhala.Uthe othisha kumele babalandelele abafundi ukuthi bakuphi, benzani uma bengezi ezikoleni."Uthisha kumele alandelele umfundi osekuphele izinsuku elovile ukuthi ukuphi, wenzani. Uma kunesidingo aye nasekhaya ayombheka umfundi. Lokhu kungasiza kwehlise izinga labafundi abalaxaza isikole bengafikanga kwa-matric.”Uveze ukuthi ngonyaka babalelwa ku-1.5 million abaqala isikole kodwa uhhafu kuphela ofinyelela kwa-matric.Nekomiti lezemfundo ePhalamende lizwakalise ukukhathazeka ngokuthi abafundi abaningi abafiki kwa-matric.
BAMCHAZE njengomuntu oyingozi emphakathini owesilisa wokufika okhalelwe amasongo kaSigonyela ngoLwesihlanu, ngezinsolo zokudlwengula abulale owesifazane ngoLwesithathu, eYellowood Park, eThekwini.Isidumbu sikaNksz Amanda Phungula (19) wakuyo le ndawo, sitholwe onqenqemeni lomgwaqo uCoedmore, eduze kwesiqiwi, i-Kenneth Stainbank Nature Reserve ngoLwesithathu.Ubulawa ngoLwesithathu nje, ubezogubha usuku lwakhe lokuzalwa ngoLwesihlanu.Umndeni wakhe uthe waziswe amaphoyisa asesiteshini saseMontclair ukuthi abophe owokufika ngoLwesihlanu, okulindeleke avele enkantolo namuhla.Ngokusho kukamalumekazi kamufi, uNksz Zethu Phungula, ngosuku abulawe ngalo umufi, ubehambe ekhaya eya ezitolo khona endaweni."Kwesinye isikhathi uye aziyele ezitolo emini, ehamba ngezinyawo ngoba kuseduze. Ngosuku lwesigameko, ngithole ucingo emaphoyiseni, ethi angiphuthume emgwaqweni uCoedmore, kumayelana no-Amanda,” kusho uNksz Phungula.Uqhube wathi, uthe uma efika khona wazithela phezu kwenqwaba yezimoto zamaphoyisa nethephu yamaphoyisa izungeze indawo yesigameko.Uthe amaphoyisa amtshele ukuthi umufi utholwe ebulewe, kwakhona abawanika inombolo yakhe njengowomndeni.Uthe basola ukuthi uqale wadlwengulwa ngaphambi kokuba abulawe ngokuklinywa, njengoba ibhulukwe abeligqokile, belibekwe ngaphezu kwesingezansi sesidumbu sakhe."Amaphoyisa asitshele ukuthi umufi utholwe umuntu obezidlulela, wase ewashayela ucingo,” kusho uNksz Phungula.Uthe kuboshwe owesilisa wokufika emva kokuthi kukhona abavame ukuzihlalela ngasezitolo, abatshele amaphoyisa ukuthi bambone ehamba naye umufi, kwathi emva kwamahora ambalwa, bambona esebuya ehamba yedwa."Sifuna ubulungiswa ngesihluku abulale ngaso isithandwa sethu. U-Amanda ubengumuntu okhonze ukuzithulela, ubengafanelwe ukuthi abulawe ngesihluku esinje. Sisola nokuthi ubengaqali ukwenza lokhu umsolwa, ngakho akumfanele ukuhlala nomphakathi,” kusho uNksz Phungula.Uthe abakholwa ukuthi bukhona ukudlelwano bokwazana obebukhona phakathi kukamufi nomsolwa njengoba umufi obengumuntu ongavamile ukuzihlanganisa nabantu kulandela isigameko sokuthunjwa kwakhe ngo-2020, eneminyaka engu-16.Udalule ukuthi kuleso sigameko, umufi wadedelwa abathumbi emva kokusatshalaliswa kwezithombe zakhe sekuphele amasonto amathathu ethunjiwe.Uthe ngaleso sikhathi kwavela ukuthi abathumbi babemgqume eMayville, kanti lelo cala lagcina liphelela emoyeni nokuyinto eyamlimaza kakhulu umufi emqondweni.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa aseMontclair aphenya icala lokubulala kulandela ukutholakala kwesidumbu sowesifazane oneminyaka engu-19 emgwaqweni uCoedmore ngoLwesithathu."Isidumbu sakhe besibukeka sinamanxeba okugwazwa. Imbangela yokubulala okwamanje ayikaziwa,” kusho uNetshiunda.Nakuba amaphoyisa esho kanje, uNksz Phungula ukugcizelele ukuthi batshelwe ngumseshi ukuthi umsolwa uboshwe ngoLwesihlanu ngaleli cala.
BASALE bebalisa abanye besifazane abayingxenye yesitokofela esisabhanoyi, okukhokhwa kuso uR300, owesifazane athenjiswe igilosa kaR5 300 emuva kwezinyanga eziwu-12.Lesi sitokofela esinenqwaba yamakhasi ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, saziwa ngeWomen Against Poverty and Hunger. Owesifazane uba yingxenye yaso ngokwenza iqeqebana kuWhatsApp, bangene kwi-link bese bekhokha oR300. Kuvela ukuthi abasunguli baso abesifazane abayisishiyagalolunye abazinze eGoli, kodwa banamalunga kuzo zonke izifundazwe zakuleli.Inhlangano evikela abathengi, i-National Consumer Commission (NCC), ithe uma iphenya yathola ukuthi le nhlangano iqola abesifazane.UKhomishana osabambile kwi-NCC, uMnuz Hardin Ratshisusu, uthe leli bhanoyi lizenza isitokofela sokudla njengoba liqoqa imali kwabesifazane."Lokhu kuyakhombisa ukuthi i-WAPH ibiphula isigaba 43(2)(a) somthetho i-Consumer Protection Act njengoba ibikhohlisa abantu ngenzuzo abazoyithola. Kuyasikhathaza ukuthi abantu basangena emabhanoyini yize sibaxwayisa ngawo. Kuyicala ukusungula ibhanoyi futhi kuyicala nokuheha abanye ukuthi bangene ebhanoyini.”Ubalule ukuthi abantu kufanele bazibuze ukuthi uma bekhokhe u-R300, uzobe usuphumaphi u-R5 310 wokubathengele igilosa emuva kwezinyanga eziwu-12?Uthe baye eNkantolo eNkulu eGauteng ukuze kubanjwe ama-akhawunti omsunguli walo, uNksz Kelebogile Precious Khumo odume ngelika Mme Lebo, nabanye abayisishiyagalombili asebenzisana nabo.I-WAPH iheha abantu ekhasini layo lika-Facebook elibizwa ngeWomen Against Poverty and Hunger (WAPH).
