Ngokwenza lokhu ibiphula isigaba 43(2)(a) nesigaba 43(4) somthetho ovikela abathengi i-Consumer Protection Act. Ngaphandle kwabantu akade befaka u-R300 wokungena kwi-WAPH, labo abathola abantu abazongena kuyo bebethenjiswa umklomelo ka-R1 000. Udaba sesiludlulisele ophikweni lokushushisa i-National Prosecuting Authority (NPA).”URatshisusu ucele abantu ukuthi bangangeni emabhanoyi esho nokuthi uma uthenjiswa imihlomulo engakholakali kufanele ubone ukuthi yibhanoyi lelo.ESITHOMBENI ngamalungu eWAPH emcimbini obuseKempton Park, eGauteng, ngoLwesihlanu Isithombe: facebook weWAPH
BATHATHU asebakhalelwe ngamasongo kaSigonyela, ngesigameko esiwundabamlonyeni sokubulawa kwabangu-18 abaqothwe eNgobozana, eLusikisiki, esifundazweni i- Eastern Cape.Lokhu kumenyezelwe nguNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, enkonzweni yesikhumbuzo yalaba ababulewe, ebiseLusikisiki, izolo.Ekhuluma nabebethamele le nkonzo, uMchunu uveze ukuthi owokuqala obekumenyezelwe ukuthi uthathwe ngamaphoyisa ukuyohlonywa imibuzo, ubuye wadedelwa, kanti bathathu asebeboshiwe abayamaniswa naleli cala okulindeleke ukuthi bavele enkantolo khona namhlanje."Leli zwe liphethwe ngomthetho, ngakho umsebenzi wamaphoyisa ukuqinisekisa ukuthi uyalandelwa. Sizokwenza konke okusemandleni ukubhekana nobugebengu,” usho kanje.Uveze ukuthi bakhona abasazoboshwa ngalawa macala, kanti umsolwa amaphoyisa asevele ayamazi, usengaboshwa noma kunini kusuka manje.Ukhale ngezigameko zokuphathwa budlabha kwezibhamu ezingekho emthethweni kuleya ndawo, wathi kodwa umphakathi uyabazi abenza lokhu ungababiki emaphoyiseni. UMchunu uthe akuzogcina kuphela ngokuboshwa kwabathinteka ecaleni lobulawa kwalaba abangu-18 okwenzeke ngoSepthemba 28, kodwa kukhona nabanye abathintekayo emacaleni okubulawa kwabantu abebesacanasa, amaphoyisa asezithendeni zabo.Kulesi sigameko esashiya abantu bemangele sokubulawa kwabantu behlangene, kuthiwa singesikhulu kunazo zonke kwesezike zenzeka kuleya ndawo. Kusona kudlule emhlabeni uNksz Thobeka Sinqina (37), uNksz Samantha Sinqina (26), uNkk Mathembisile Mayekiso Sinqina (64), uNksz Nancy Sinqina (59), uNksz Dimpho Sinqina (30), uNksz Thali King Sinqina (26),uSmomoza Sinqina (14), uNksz Ruth King (21), uNksz Nonkanyiso Dukuza (19), uNksz Nombuliso Dukuza (32), uNksz Mandisa Dlokweni (59), uNksz Lungiswa Gawulakana (51), uMnuzThandeka Mhlaluvele (46), uNksz Nobelungu France (59), uNksz Themi Vimba (41), uNksz Nomazwi Ndleleni (59) uNksz Themi Vimba (41) noMnuz Sigobodo Gxobela (59).Inkonzo yesikhumbuzo beyihanjelwe amalungu omphakathi, yizihlobo nemindeni yabagilwa, izikhulu zikahulumeni, ubuholi bomdabu, osigaxamabhande emaphoyiseni nabamabandla ezenkolo ahlukene.Abajutshwe ukukhulumela imindeni, baveze ukuthi imindeni izofihla ngoLwesihlanu nangoMgqibelo.Kulesi sigameko, abangu-13 badutshulwa babulawa besemzini owodwa. Kukholakala ukuthi ababulali badlulela komunye umuzi okhona endaweni, baqothwa abane.
UMNYANGO wezokuThutha KwaZulu-Natal usubophele ithimba elizophenya ngembangela yengozi edlule nemiphefumulo yabantu abahlanu emgwaqweni u-R102 eDarnall, KwaDukuza, ngoMgqibelo.Lokhu kudalulwe uMphathiswa walo mnyango, uMnuz Siboniso Duma, izolo.Uphenyo olungaphothuliwe luveza ukuthi izimoto ezimbili ebezihamba ngesivinini esiphezulu, zishayisene mahlanze, kwashona abayisihlanu.Edlulisa amazwi enduduzo emindenini, uDuma uthe ithimba elihlanganisa abeRoad Traffic Inspectorate (RTI) neSouth African Police Service (SAPS), bayaphenya ngale ngozi ukuzama ukubheka imbangela yayo."Sizoqinisekisa ukuthi siyasondela eduze kwemindeni yabashonile njengoba ibhekene nalesi simo esinzima,” kusho uDuma.Uthe nokho kuyishwa ukuthi ingozi yalolu hlobo yenzeke emva kokuba umnyango wenze ukhukhulelangoqo womkhuleko, kukhulekelwa ezokuphepha emgwaqweni, wathi emva kwalo mkhuleko kuvunyelwenwe ukuthi kuzoqiniswa ezokuphepha emigwaqweni ukusuka manje kuze kuyoba amaholidi kaNcibijane."Kuzokwenziwa izaba ezehlukene, okukhona kuzo nezivimbamgwaqo ezindaweni ezehlukene lapho abomthetho bezobe beqinisekisa khona ukuthi abashayeli bayawugcina umthetho womgwaqo njengokuthi abashayeli kabaphuzile, nokuthi bahamba ngezimoto ezikufanele ukuba semgwaqweni nokunye,” kusho yena.Kwenzeka lesi sigameko nje, umnyango nezinye izinhlaka zezokuphepha ubuwenze isivimbamgwaqo e-Oribi Toll Plaza, esifundeni Ugu.Ebala phakathi kwezinto ezitholakele, ubalule abashayeli abangu-50 ababoshelwe amacala ehlukene kulandela ukumiswa nokubhekwa kwezimoto ezingu-671."Amatekisi ayisithupha ayiswe ephawundeni, kutholakala ukuthi athwele abantu ngaphandle kwezimvume,” kusho uDuma.Uqhube wathi kuphinde kwaboshwa nomshayeli oyedwa oyiphoyisa elisebenza esikhumulweni sezindiza i-King Shaka International Airport ngokushayela lidle amanzi amponjwana, wadalula nokuthi izimoto ezine zimisiwe ukuhamba emgwaqweni kuvela ukuthi azikho esimweni esikahle."Kuphinde kwaboshwa abayisihlanu ngokuba kuleli ngokungemthetho,” kusho uDuma.
IBHANGE lombuso, i-South African Reserve Bank, lihlawulise amabhange aphula umthetho izigidi njengoba lisemkhankasweni wokuvikela abantu bakuleli.ISarb imemezele ukuthi iPrudential Authority (PA) okuwuphiko lwayo oluqapha ngeso lokhozi ukusebenza kwezikhungo ezisebenza ngemali luhlawulise i-HSBC Bank Plc u-R9.5 million ngokungalandeli umthetho iFinancial Intelligence Centre (FIC) Act 38 ka-2001. Kule nhlawulo kulengiswe uR4 million izinyanga eziwu-36 kusukela ngoJuni 10 walo nyaka.I-PA ithe iHSBC iye yasebenzisana nayo ngesikhathi iphenywa, yalungisa izinkinga obekukhalwa ngazo.Ibuye yahlawulisa iBidvest Bank uR5 million ngokungalandeli isigaba 38 seFIC Act.Kulesi sigwebo uR2.5 million ulengisiwe izinyanga eziwu-12 kusukela ngo-Agasti 23 2024.I-PA idonse ngendlebe izinkampani ezihlawulisiwe ukuba zingatholakali zenza amacala afanayo ngoba uma ziwaphinda zizojeziswa kanzima.NgoSepthemba iSarb ihlawulise i-Old Mutual uR10 million ngokungalandeli imibandela ethize ngaphansi kweFIC Act.Lesi sigwebo besiwu-R15.9 million kodwa kwalengiswa uR5.9 million izinyanga eziwu-36.ISarb ithe iPA inamandla okuqapha zonke izikhungo ezisebenza ngemali ezingaphansi kweso layo ukuze ivikele abantu baseNingizimu Afrika.Ithe izinhlelo zokuqapha zonke izikhungo ezingaphansi kweso layo ziyaqhubeka njalo futhi izinkampani ezisuke ziphenywa ziyasebenzisana nayo, zilungise lokho okusuke kukhalwe ngakho bese zikhokha nenhlawulo.
Kudutshulwe kwabulawa abantu abayisithupha abavikela umphakathi kuQumbu, e-Eastern Cape, ngeSonto ebusuku.Kuthiwa lesi sigameko senzeke ngabo-10.45 ebusuku lapho amadoda ayisishiyagalombili abehlome ngezibhamu evulele ngenhlamvu equlwini labantu abazulazula emphakathini ngenhloso yokuwuvikela.Kufe abayisithupha abane baphuthunyiswa esibhedlela. "Kuthiwa abagilwa bebesesikoleni sendawo belungiselela ukuphuma baqalaze emphakathini ngesikhathi behlaselwa. Abasolwa abangaziwa basagcwele amathafa futhi imbangela yokudubula kwabo ayikaziwa,” kusho okhulumela amaphoyisa e-Eastern Cape, uWarrant Officer Majola Nkohli esitatimendeni.UKhomishana wamaphoyisa kulesiya sifundazwe uLieutenant General Nomthetheleli Mene usigxekile lesi sigameko."Sikhiphe zonke izinsiza zethu futhi sikhathazekile ngalabo abasiza amaphoyisa ngoba bayahlaselwa. Sizokwenza konke okusemandleni ukuthi abadubulile baboshwe. Njengombutho siyasigxeka lesi sigameko futhi sidlulisa amazwi enduduzo emindenini yabafi. Sithanda nokufisela abalimele ukululama okusheshayo,” kusho uLt Gen Mene.
INHLANGANO emele osomabhizinisi i-Busness of South Africa (Busa), ithi ikhathazekile ngokugunyazwa kukakhukhulelangoqo wesiteleka sabasebenzi kuzwelonke esiholwa umfelandawonye wezinyunyana i-Congress of South African Trade Unions, okulindeleke ukuthi sibe namhlanje.Le nhlangano ithi lesi sitelekeka kunokuba silungise, sizoqhubezela kakhulu umonakalo emnothweni wakuleli ovele untengantenga. Isikhulu esiphezulu sale nhlangano, uMnuz Cas Coovadia, esitatimendeni esithunyelelwe abezindaba, uthe yinkulu ingcindezi ezodalwa yisiteleka."Akukho okuzokwenziwa yisona ukulekelela ekugcineni isimo somnotho singcono. Iziteleka ezinjengalesi zinqinda imizamo yokukhulisa umnotho nokubhekana nesimo sokuntuleka kwamathuba emisebenzi. Sidinga izinto ezizolekelela ekuqinisekiseni ukuzinza komnotho ngalesi sikhathi, kunezizolimaza amabhizinisi,” usho kanjeLe nhlangano ithi iyalihlonipha ilungelo labasebenzi lokuteleka kodwa bakholwa ukuthi izinto eziphakanyiswa i-Cosatu kumele zenziwe kulandelwa imigudu efanele kuxoxwe nezinhlaka ezithintekayo.UNobhala weCosatu KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Edwin Mkhize, engxoxweni neSolezwe, uveze ukuthi akekho umsebenzi ozothathelwa izinyathelo wumqashi ngokuzibandakanya kulesi siteleka njengoba sivikelwe wumthetho wezabasebenzi kwisigaba 77 soMthethosisekelo."Sinxusa bonke abasebenzi ukuthi babambe iqhaza kulesi siteleka, baphume ngezinkani. Labo abangeke bekwazi ukufinyelela eThekwini, bengesabi ukuqhinqa nje ngaphandle kwezindawo abasebenzela kuzo, noma bengalubhadi emsebenzini, bazihlalele emakhaya begodle amandla,” usho kanje.Nakuba i-Cosatu iqinisekisa ukuba semthethweni kwesiteleka sanamhlanje ngokwesigaba salo mthetho kodwa i-Busa ithe sekuyisikhathi sokuthi lo mthetho ubhekisiswe kwazise ikholwa ukuthi izinyunyana ziwusebenzisa ngendlela elimaza amabhizinisi.Phakathi kwezinto uMkhize aveze ukuthi abasebenzi bazozwakalisa ilaka labo kuzo, yisimo sezomnotho okubukeka sicindezela kakhulu abantu abahluphekayo, wudaba lokwenyuswa kwamaholo ikakhulu kubasebenzi bakahulumeni okuvela ukuthi umqashi usalokhu emile ekuwenyuseni ngo-3% kuphela. Le nyunyana ikhala nangohlelo lokudilizwa kwabasebenzi ngokwesigatshana somthetho u-189, eveza ukuthi abaqashi sebesebenza le ndlela ngenhloso yokuzenzela nje inzuzo noma ukujezisa abasebenzi uma kukhona lapho abaveze ukungeneliseki kwabo.Udaba lomthetho othinta ukwenyulwa kwemali ezimpeshenini zabasebenzi aluzosala ngaphandle njengoba le nyunyana iveza ukuthi nakuba ihambisana nalokhu kwazise kwakuyisiphakamiso sayo kodwa kuningi okwengeziwe kulo mthetho ngakho bafisa luphinde luyobuyekezwa.Lezi ziteleka kulindeleke izibe kuzona zonke izifundazwe kanti KwaZulu-Natal imashi izoqala epaki e-King Dinuzulu iphelele e-City Hall, eThekwini.
IQEMBU Umkhonto weSizwe likhala ngokunyathelwa kwamalungelo omholi walo ePhalamende uDkt John Hlophe, ngokungavunyelwa ukuba sekomitini eliphakamisa amagama abantu abazoba amajaji kumengameli wezwe uCyril Ramaphosa.Leli qembu lithe lidumele ngokuthi inkantolo ichithe isicelo sayo esiphuthumayo sokumisa ukuhlala komhlangano waleli komiti i-iJudicial Service Commission (JSC).Ligxeke neqembu i-DA ngokulwa izimpi zezepolitiki ezinkantolo.Okhulumela iMK, uMnuz Nhlamulo Ndhlela, uthe uHlophe wakhethwa yileli qembu ukuthi alimele kwiJSC, ngakho badumele ngokuthi inkantolo ayimvumelanga ukuba yingxenye yalo.Usho lokhu nje kusuka namhlanje kuze kube yisonto elizayo iJSC izobe ihlangene okokuqala selokhu kwaba nokhetho lukazwelonke, lapho kuzobe kuphonswa khona imibuzo abantu abangu-50, abagaqele izikhundla zokuba amajaji kuleli.Ijaji enkantolo enkulu yaseSouth Gauteng, uJames Wilson, ngoMgqibelo lichitha iMK lithe iJSC izobe imelelekile noma kuthiwa uHlophe akekho.UWilson uchithe nezindleko lesi sinqumo wathi izinhlangothi zizozikhokhela ngokwehlukana izindleko. Uveze ukuthi amanye amalungu amahlanu eJSC avela ePhalamende azobe eyingxenye yomhlangano ngakho akukho ukungameleleki kwePhalamende ngoba uHlophe engekho.Kwenzeka lokhu emva kokuba inkantolo enkulu eWestern Cape, yakhipha isivimbelo kuHlophe ukuthi angawuthameli umhlangano weJSC. I-DA, Corruption Watch neFreedom Under Law (FUL), zafaka izicelo ngokwehlukana zivimba uHlophe ukuthi abe semhlanganweni weJSC ozokhetha amajaji ngoba waxoshwa kwesokuba yijaji.Amanye amalungu eJSC kubalwa umengameli wamajaji uMandisa Maya ongusihlalo, amanye amajaji, uNgqongqoshe wezobuLungiswa uNksz Thembi Simelane, abameli, osolwazi bezomthetho kanjalo namalungu ayisithupha ePhalamende asuke ekhethwe amaqembu. Kukhona namalungu amane eNdlu yoMkhandlu weziFundazwe. I-DA isincomile isinqumo senkantolo sokuchitha isicelo seMK yathi umuntu ofana noHlophe ubeka engozini ezobulungiswa zakuleli. UNdhlela uthe balinde kuphothulwe necala elithinta ubulungu bukaHlophe kwiJSC njengoba ekhethwe ngokohlelo lwasePhalamende, olwaluvulelekile futhi luhambisana nentando yabantu.
KUKHALWA ngamaphoyisa angobhululu bezigebengu, umphakathi waseSidakeni, KwaSithebe, eMandeni, uzithathela umthetho, ubulala owesilisa osolwa ngokubulalisa omunye.Kulesi sigameko, uMnuz Mnguni, igama lakhe elingatholakalanga, kuthiwa ushawe wumphakathi waze wafa ngoLwesihlanu. Isidumbu sakhe saze satholwa ngoMgqibelo esigangeni.Umthombo olwazi ukusuka nokuhlala udaba uthe, umphakathi udinwe yisenzo sikaMnguni sokuwushonisa le, nale umphakathi."Lokhu ukwenze emva kokugonyuluka kwakhe ngokuthumela izigebengu ezaziwayo ukuthi ziyothumba uMnuz Ayanda Silawula ngoLwesine ebusuku, isidumbu sakhe esize satholwa ngoMgqibelo ehlathini elisendaweni,” kusho umthombo.Ulandisa ngesisusa sodaba, uthe bekukhona izinsongo okuthiwa zenziwa nguMnguni kuSilawula esikhathini esifishane esedlule kulandela ingxabano yabo ngentambo kagesi."UMnguni wafika ezoqasha kubo kaSilawula ngo-2022, owagcina emdayisela indawo eseduze kwakubo maqede wamxhumisa nogesi. Emasontweni ambalwa edlule, kube nomngcwabo kwamakhelwane wabo, kwabizwa ugandaganda uzolungisa indawo kanti kuzolimala intambo,” kusho umthombo.Uthe lokho kwaholela ekutheni ugesi uwise iswishi kubo kaSilawula, owagcina eyalela uMnguni ukuthi athenge intambo ukuze aqhubeke amxhumele ugesi."Akayizwisisanga kahle le uMnguni, wathi okungcono akabuyiselwe imali yakhe ayikhokha ngesikhathi emxhumela ugesi okokuqala, wala waphetha uSilawula,” kusho umthombo.Uthe iqale lapho ke ingxabano yabo, uMnguni waze wasabisa ngokuthi uzomthumelela abantu abazomthumba bese beyambulala.Uqhube wathi kuthe esethunjwa ngempela uSilawula, esecingwa ngoLwesihlanu, engasatholakali, umphakthi wakhumbula ukuthi uMnguni ubeke wamsongela, maqede wamlanda, wamtitiya ngenduku, uthi akakhulume iqiniso."Ugcine elikhuluma, esho ukuthi uye obathumile ukuthi bayomthumba, wathi kodwa yena akashongo ukuthi abambulale. Ubelokhu ekhomba amahlathi ehlukene, ethi akucingwe kuwo okuyinto ewudine kakhulu umphakathi,” kusho umthombo.Uthe esekhombe ihlathi lesithathu, umphakathi uhlukane kabili, omunye waya kulelo hlathi ofike wamthola ngempela kulo uSilawula, omunye wasala utitinya yena uMnguni ngenduku, wamshiya efile."Amaphoyisa ethu awenzi lutho. Ngisho siwabikela awenzi lutho yikho umphakathi uvele wenza nje,” kusho umthombo.Ikhansela lendawo, uMnuz Xolan Mathonsi lithe umphakathi awuhleli kahle ngenxa yezigebengu ezizicanaselayo endaweni.Uthe okudina umphakathi ukuthi zize ziwuchomele ngokuthi zona zingabangani namaphoyisa."Zize zibonakale, zizipholele nawo,” kusho uMathonsi, othe kwenzeka lesi sigameko nje, umphakathi uhlongoza imashi ozoyibhekisa esiteshini samaphoyisa endaweni.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uConstable Thenjiswa Ngcobo uthe amaphoyisa aseNyoni, aphenya icala lokubulala kulandela isigameko lapho kutholwe khona owesilisa oneminyaka engu-45 efile eManzamnyama Reserve ngoMgqibelo.
ONOGADA nabasebenzi abahlanza izakhiwo zikahulumeni basibise ngokukhipha i-IFP KwaZulu-Natal uma bengaqashwa ngokugcwele.Onogada nabasebenzi abahlanza izakhiwo zikahulumeni bathe bazoyifundisa isifundo i-IFP okhethweni olulandelayo uma bengaqashwa ngokugcwele iminyango kahulumeni wesifundazwe.Lokhu bakusho ngesikhathi benemashi abebeyibhekise ehhovisi likandunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, eMgungundlovu, ngoLwesihlanu.Laba basebenzi bathe bafuna ukuthi yonke iminyango kahulumeni wesifundazwe iqashe ngokugcwele onogada nabahlanza izakhiwo.Bathe bafuna ukuthi kuqedwe uhlelo lwamathenda, zingavuselelwa izinkontileka zazo zonke izinkampani ezinikezwe amathenda okugada nawokuhlanza izakhiwo zikahulumeni.Omunye wabasebenzi, uMnuz Elvis Mncwango, uthe uhlelo lwamathenda lucindezela abasebenzi.UMncwango uthe abasebenzi bahola imali encane, wathi uhlelo lwamathenda lunothisa abanikazi bezinkampani.Uveze ukuthi basebenza ezimweni ezinzima, wathi kujwayelekile ukuthi bangaholelwa ngesikhathi.Usabise ngokuthi bazolwela ukuthi i-IFP ikhishwe KwaZulu-Natal uma kuze kufika ukhetho olulandelayo bengakaqashwa ngokugcwele.UMncwango uthe bamtshela nowayengundunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Nomusa Dube-Ncube, ukuthi i-ANC angeke ibuyele emandleni uma bengaqashwa ngokugcwele ngesikhathi kubhekwe okhethweni lwangoMeyi."Sathi uma simtshela uNkk Dube-Ncube, waziqhenya, washaya izinqa. Uma uNtuli engase enze iphutha elifanayo naleli elenziwa uNkk Dube-Ncube, bazongena emgodini owodwa. Sizoyikhipha i-ANC njengoba sakhipha i-ANC. Nayo i-IFP sizoyilahlisa okwenyongo yenyathi. U-2026 (wokhetho lohulumeni basekhaya) ususeduze kakhulu.”UMncwabe uthe ulaka lwabo bazolikhiphela nasemaqenjini abambisene ne-IFP kuhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal.I-IFP ibambisene ne-ANC, DA neNFP KwaZulu-Natal.Obefunda uhlu lwezimfuno, uMnuz Cyril Gcwensa, uthe bafuna uhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal uhloniphe isinqumo esathathwa ePhalamende labasebenzi ngo-2021 esithi azingavuselelwa izinkontileka zezinkampani ezinamathenda okugada nakuhlanza izakhiwo zikahulumeni."Sicela ukuthi iminyango kahulumeni isiqashe ngokugcwele futhi sicela ukuthi zingakhangiswa izikhala zemisebenzi ngoba sikhona vele, siyasebenza.”Umbhikisho ubuxhaswe amaqembu ezepolitiki iMK, EFF ne-ActionSA.Lamaqembu akhale ngokungafiki kukaNtuli ezokwamukela uhlu lwezikhalazo.Owemukele uhlu lwezikhalazo, uMnuz Brian Ntuli, uxolisele uNtuli ngokungafiki kwakhe.UNtuli uthe bazokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi uhlu lwezikhalazo luyafika kuNtuli."Undunankulu uwumuntu olalelayo, ngiyathemba ukuthi nizoyithola impendulo yenu kulesikhathi enisibekile.”
NKOSIKHONA CELESISHAYELWE ihlombe isinyathelo sikaMasipala waseJozini, sokuxhasa abafundi bakamatric, okumanje balungiselela izivivingo zalo nyaka, ngokudla ukuze babhekane nezincwadi kuphela, bangakhathazeki ngabazolala bekudlile.Lo Masipala uthi ukwenza lokhu ngoba uqondisisa ukuthi kweminye imindeni enabafundi abenza leli banga, ikati lilele eziko. Lokho kukodwa kungadala ukhwantalala kumfundi obhala umatric.UMnuz Mfananaye Mathe, iMeya yakulo Masipala uthe bewuMasipala baqhamuke nohlelo lokuthi izikole ziphekele abafundi ikakhulu labo abafunda amahora engeziwe nabafunda ebusuku.UMathe uthe yize abanye bebagxeka ngokuhambisa lokhu kudla kodwa yena uqobo uyabazi ubuhlungu bokungadli esikoleni, nomthelela okuba nakho ezifundweni. "Ngikhule ngaphansi kwesimo esinzima. Ngakho ukufaka isandla kubafundi kuwukuthi basizakale ngemfundo yabo. Mina ngazimisela esikoleni ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima ngoba ngangifuna imfundo. Namanje ngiyazi kukhona izingane ezihamba zingadlile, ngakho lokho sifuna ukukuqeda. Sixhasa ikusasa lezwe lakithi njengoba singabaphathi nje, konke kulindeleke kithi,” kuchaza uMathe.Ube esedonsa abafundi ngendlebe ukuthi bazimisele njengoba bona bezinikele ukuthi babasize.UMqondisi wesiFunda uMkhanyakude eMnyangweni wezeMfundo, uMnuz Thanduyise Motha, uthe bewuMnyango bayasithakasela isenzo sikaMasipala. UMotha ubeyingxenye yokuhanjelwa kwezikole ezahlukene kulesi sifunda, kuhanjiswa ukudla. Uveze ukuthi iningi labafundi uma kubhalwa umatric, lichitha isikhathi esiningi esikoleni, okwenza kubaluleke ukuthi lithole okuya ngasethunjini.Okwesibili ukuthi lo Masipala wenza lo msebenzi."Umqondo womfundi usuke uthwele okuningi ngalesi sikhathi sezivivinyo. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuthi kwehle umthwalo futhi bazimisele ezifundweni zabo, baze baqede ukubhala. Umfundi ophase kahle futhi wahamba phambili ngonyaka odlule, uphuma khona eMkhanyakude. Lokhu kuveza indlela abafundi abajabula ngayo uma kukhona ukulekelelwa abakutholayo,” kuchaza uMotha.Kulo mkhankaso wokusiza izikole ngokudla, lo Masipala uhlanganise nokuhambela umtholampilo waseJozini, nalapho onikelele khona inhlangano esiza iziguli ezisuke zize kulo mtholampilo ngezinto okubalwa kuzo ukuthi zidle zisalinde ukunyangwa. IJozini Clinic Support Group, nayo ithole ukuxhaswa ngokudla ukuze iphekele iziguli.--
BAKHATHAZWA ukwanda kwezigameko zokutholwa kwezidumbu zilahlwe ngasemgwaqeni eSiyathuthuka, eKenville, eThekwini, okuthiwa sekuyinsakavukela.UMnuz City Nkosi osekomitini lomphakathi endaweni ophinde abewuSihlalo we-ANC wegatsha, elandisa Isolezwe, uthe umphakathi usuhlala ngokwethuka ikakhulu uma udlula kule ndawo osekubikwe kuzo izigameko eziningana zokubulawa kwabantu nokutholwa kwezidumbu zilaxazwe khona. Ubekusho lokhu emva kokuthi kuthiwe kutholakale isidumbu sowesilisa ngoLwesihlanu ekuseni okukholakala ukuthi ugxotshwe ngamatshe waze washona. Kukholakala ukuthi umgilwa ungowokudabuka KwaMaphumulo. Utholwa nje, bekusaphele inyanga kutholwe izidumbu zabesifazane zilaxazwe endaweni efanayo okunguNksz Anele Mbokazi (29) obengumhlengikazi esibhedlela Inkosi Albert Luthuli noNksz Zizipho Gabisa (30) okuthiwa yena ubengusokhemisi kwesinye sezibhedlela esiseMhlanga. Kulesi sigameko kuboshwe uMnuz Lungani Mthethwa (38) noMnuz Sandile Chili (44) abasagqunywe esitokisini.UNkosi uthe cishe bevile ku-30 abantu asebetholwe befile endaweni efanayo esikhathi esingaba yiminyaka emibili kuya kwemithathu."Siyakuqonda ukusebenza ngokuzikhandla kwamaphoyisa asesiteshini i-Greenwood Park. Nakuba kunjalo sibona kungenele njengoba indawo ithe ukuqhela esiteshini. Yingakho naphambili sike sanxusa ukuthi kwakhiwe isiteshi esiwumahamba nendlwana esikholwa ukuthi kuzolekelela kakhulu kulezi zigameko zokubulawa kwabantu, " usho kanje.Uthe bakholwa ukuthi abanye babulawelwa kwezinye izindawo bese izidumbu zabo zilahlwa lapha, kanti zikhona nezigameko ezikhombisa ukuthi abanye basuke bebulawe kuyo le ndawo, okuyinto eyethusa kakhulu umphakathi ohlala ngakhona.Kushaye isikhathi sokushicilela amaphoyisa engakaphenduli mayelana nesidumbu esitholwe izolo.
NKOSIKHONA CELEOWESIFAZANE waseNquthu, umangaze abaningi ethumelela umndeni kamufi isimemo somshado, ethi uzoshada nebeyisoka lakhe elashona lingamlobolile futhi kungekho zinhlelo zomshado. Ugcine eshade ngempela.UNksz Nompumelelo Ntuli odume ngelikaYayo, uhlele umshado wathumela amakhadi ezimemo emndenini kamufi, ewutshela ukuthi ushada nowayeyisoka lakhe uMnuz Hezekia Naledi Masiteng. Wabatshela ukuthi umshado uzokwenzeka emagcekeni asemzini’, yize bengazi lutho.Umufi owayesembonini yamatekisi, wadutshulwa washona esendleleni ebheke emzini wakhe ngoJuni 5, 2020.LAPHA kubonakala indodakazi endala kaNksz Yayo Ntuli, uNksz Rithabile ifaka unina izindandatho zombiliLo mshado ochazwe abomndeni njengesekisi uqobo lwalo, uqhubekile emagcekeni alo mndeni kamufi.Kuthiwa kuqale kwagxunyekwa inkunzimalanga yetende, okulandelwe wukuthi kufike izinkumbi zabantu, okungabangani nomndeni kaNksz Ntuli ekhaya likamufi.Kuthiwa ubedlubhe ingubo yomshado kanokusho, ebanjwe ngengalo omunye wosomatekisi odumile endaweni, wena owabona indodakazi ibanjwe nguyise ngesandla iyoshada. Indodakazi yakhe endala kuthiwa yiyona emfake izindandatho zombili.Kuthiwa iqale yamfaka eyodwa kwesobunxele okuthiwe ngekamufi, yase imfaka enye esandleni sangokwesobunxele okuvele ukuthi ngeyakhe umakoti, abezoyifaka esandleni sikamufi ukube ubesadla anhlamvana.Kuvela ukuthi umfowabo kaYayo obemshadisa ekubeni engesiyena umfundisi.Ilungu lomndeni kamufi elikhulume neSolezwe Ngempelasonto, uNksz Lebatshi Masiteng libabaze isibindi salo wesifazane sokuthi aqhubeke nalesi simanga somshado. "Iyasicika lento ayenzayo futhi asikaze thina siwubone umsangano onje. Kuyacaca ukuthi bese kuwukusidelela lokhu okunenkani phakathi,'' kukhalaza leli lungu.Umufi kuthiwa washona enenqwaba yamatekisi, okumanje amile ngoba izimvume zokuba semgwaqeni azivuselelwe. Kudinga zivuselelwe owomndeni noma unkosikazi wakhe.Liqhuba lithe lifuna ukubona ke ukuthi njengoba eseshadile lokhu kuzomkhipha yini enkingeni abhekene nayo yokuma kwamatekisi kamufi.Lama tekisi kuthiwa lo 'makoti’ wawashaqa, angakuye. "Nanka amehlo akake umbombo, sifuna ukubona ke ukuthi lo mshado wakhe uzomsiza kuphi futhi kanjani,'' lisho kanjena.Kuvela ukuthi emshadweni bekungena kuphela abamenyiwe. Ezokuphepha beziqinile, ngaphandle kumi amadoda amahlanu abehlome ngezinhlokohlela zezibhamu.Imizamo yokuxhumana nalo wesifazane ayiphumelelanga. Ucingo lwakhe lubanjwe ngunina wathi akekho eduze kwakhe. Phambilini uNksz Ntuli wathi lokhu ukwenza ngaphansi kombandela wesintu."Wena angithi unguMzulu? Le nto ngokwesintu ike yenziwe. Kodwa ngeke ngitshele wena ukuthi kungani ngenza lo mshado,'' waphendula kanje ecikeka.Isazi sezomthetho, u-Advocate Mpumelelo Zikalala sakuchitha lokhu sathi ngeke ibe khona incwadi yomshado ngoba kumele kube ukuthi abantu ababili abasadla anhlamvana, bavumelene ukuthi bayashada.
UBABAZA unya umphakathi ngemva kokutholakala izicubu zomzimba womuntu zifakwe ko-plastiki abehlukene abasetshenziswa ukufaka imfucuza elahlwayo, zilaxazwe endaweni okulahlwa kuyo imfucuza eMawoti, eNanda ngoLwesihlanu.Lesi sigameko esishiye abaningi bedangele, kuthiwa ilungu lomphakathi ebeliziqhwandela libheka okulahliwe elingase likusebenzise, lizithele ku-plastiki okufakwe kuwo ikhanda lomuntu kanti buqaqama, bekukhona omunye ofakwe imilenze emibili eqotshwe yahlukaniswa kabili kusuka emanyongeni nangezansana kwamadolo. Leli lungu lihlabe umkhosi, kwabikelwa abenkampani yonogada i-Reaction Unit of South Africa namaphoyisa.Nakuba umphakathi ubusashaqekile ngalesi sigameko kodwa ukholwa ukuthi umufi ubulawelwe kwenye indawo wayolaxazwa abathile endaweni ngenhloso yokudukisa umkhondo.UMnuz Mbongiseni Phewa osekomitini elilwa nobugebengu endaweni, ekhuluma neSolezwe, uthe iningi lamalungu omphakathi afikile ukuzozibonela umufi ngoba ubuso bakhe bebusabonakala kodwa kwacaca ukuthi akekho omaziyo."Isimo esinjengalesi sesiqala ukujwayeleka lapha eMawoti, othola khona ukuthi abantu babulawa bezolaxazwa khona. Lokhu kugcina kudumisa kabi indawo yethu evele ibatshazwa ngobugebengu. Sikholwa ukuthi ubulawelwe kwenye indawo ngoba uma ubheka alikho igazi kanti nezinsalela zesidumbu bezingakonakali okukhombisa ukuthi yinto obekusaphele amahora ambalwa yenzekile,” usho kanje.Ngesikhathi Isolezwe litheleka endaweni yesigameko, amalungu omphakathi abesami izixongololo bebodwa abebesababaza, abanye besondela ngenhloso yokubona ukuthi akusiyena yini umuntu owaziwayo noma isihlobo.Okunguyena okuthiwa uthole lezi zicubu ubengasekho endaweni yesigameko njengoba kuthiwa utholwe abanye babahlala emgwaqweni.Okhulumela abakwa-Rusa, uMnuz Prem Balram, uthe ngesikhathi onogada babo betheleka endaweni yesigameko ngabo-8 ekuseni emva kokubizwa, amalungu omphakathi abakhombise oplastiki ebafakwe lezi zingxenye zesidumbu."Izingozi ekhanda likamufi zikhombisa ukuthi uqale washaywa ngaphambi kokuthi abulawe. Imilenze beyiqotshiwe, kanti ebangeni elingaphansi kwamamitha awu-500 ukusuka lapho kutholwe khona lezi zingxenye zomzimba, kutholakale esinye isicubu sesitho sangasese sowelisa silaxaziziwe,” usho kanje.Uveze ukuthi eduze kwezinsalela zesidumbu, kutholwe ijakheti yengane encane nengubo yokusonga ingane enegazi.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda uthe amaphoyisa aseNanda, aphenya icala lokubulala emva kokutholakala kwezingxenye zomzimba zomuntu ongaziwa. Uthe abasolwa abakaziwa okwamanje.
IGQEMEKE udume lwengozi i-ANC KwaZulu-Natal ngokulaxazwa ngenye yezingwevu uMnuz Willies Mchunu, eyayiwundunankulu wesifundazwe.Lokhu kushiwo nguNobhala wale nhlangano esifundeni iTheku uMnuz Musa Nciki, kulandela ukusula kukaMchunu ekhala ngokuthi usegawule zaphuka, akaboni kukhona angasakwenzela le nhlangano. UNciki obekhuluma nesiteshi sethelevishini sakwaSABC ngoLwesihlanu, uthe bagqemeke udume ngokusula kukaMchunu.Uthe bathole incwadi evela kuMchunu ngoLwesine ntambama, ayithumele nasegatsheni lakhe u-wadi 33 khona eThekwini."Sizoya kuMchunu njengomuntu esimhlonipha kakhulu, nobewumbele ogwansile ebesincela kuwona ulwazi, siyoxoxa naye mayelana nalesi sinqumo sakhe. Siyasihlonipha isinqumo sakhe kodwa sikholwa ngukuthi singamguqula umqondo. Asikwazi ukulahlekelwa umthombo wolwazi ofana naye ikakhulu ngalesi sikhathi,” kusho uNciki.Encwadini esabalele ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, uMchunu ayithumele nakunobhala we-ANC esifundazweni, uyakuveza ukuthi waphakamisa eminye imigudu inhlangano eyayingayithatha emuva kokungenzi kahle okhethweni.Uphinde akhale ngokugxekwa akutholile ngokuveza umbono wakhe ngohulumeni wokubambisana kwamaqembu, kuzwelonke nasesifundazweni.Uveze ukuthi nakuba agcina eyamukele ekahulumeni wokubambisana kwamaqembu kodwa ukugxekwa akuthola kwamphatha kabuhlungu."Kwaze kwathiwa angazi nokuthi yini ubuKhomanisi. Kweminye yemihlangano yesigungu esiphezulu se-ANC esifundazweni, ngabuzwa nokuthi ngiwubani mina ukuthi ngingatshela abaholi ukuthi benzeni odabeni oluthinta uhulumeni wokubambisana,” kusho incwadi kaMchunu, owaba ngundunankulu wesifundazwe kusuka ngo-2016 kuya ku-2019.Kule ncwadi uMakhuzemoyizela okuyigama abizwa ngalo, uveze nokuthi uselahlekelwe yithemba ezithembisweni ze-ANC zokukhulula abantulayo nokubhekela abasebenzi.Uveze nokuthi uyazi ukuthi ukusula kwakhe kuzomlahlekisela ngabangani, aphinde agxekwe kodwa ubuhlungu azobuzwa engaphandle kule nhlangano, kungcono kunabuzwayo engaphakathi.Ubonge ubuholi namalungu e-ANC asebenze nabo.Owayengumholi wentsha ye-ANC uMnuz Thanduxolo Sabelo, ubhale kuFacebook ezwakalisa ukuphatheka kabi ngesinqumo sikaMchunu.Uthe ngeke asamukele lesi sinqumo wathi abanye babaholi be-ANC okubalwa ababengoNdunankulu besifundazwe oMnuz Sbu Ndebele, Senzo Mchunu, Dkt Zweli Mkhize, nabanye abaholi okubalwa uMnuz Mike Mabuyakhulu, Dkt Blade Nzimande, oNkk Peggy Nkonyeni, Weziwe Thusi, Sipho Gcabashe kumele bangenelele. UMchunu uke waba ngusihlalo wamaKhomanisi esifundazweni.Kwenzeka lokhu nje ukufika kweqembu eliholwa ngowayengumengameli we-ANC nezwe uMnuz Jacob Zuma, Umkhonto weSizwe, kuguqise i-ANC esifundazweni.
UNGQONGQOSHE weMfundo eyisiSekelo kuleli, uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, usexwayise othisha abasaqhubeka nokubhaxabula abafundi ukuthi bazobhekana nengalo yomthetho njengoba umthetho osanda kusayinwa wezikole, ukubeka kucace okufanele kwenziwe kwabasaqhubeka nalo mkhuba omubi. UNksz Gwarube uthe bahlabela phambili nalo mthetho iBela, osayinwe muva nje nguMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa.Uthe udlame olubhekiswe kubafundi lwande kakhulu ngasohlangothini lothisha abasaqhubeka nokusebenzisa induku ezikoleni nakuba yavalwa kudala.Uveze ukuthi bahlabela phambili nakuba kusanezingxoxo ngezinye izigatshana ezimbili, ezingeke ziqale ukusebenza okwamanje."Ngaphansi kwalo mthetho ubekwa amacala uma uqhubeka nokushaya abafundi,” kusho uNksz Gwarube.Ukusho lokhu izolo ngesikhathi ehambele KwaZulu-Natal, ukuzohlanganisa amehlo nobuholi bomnyango esifundazweni. Ngesikhathi ethatha izintambo emnyangweni wakuveza ukuthi uzohambela izifundazwe ezehlukene ahlanganise amehlo aphinde ezwe izinkinga ezikhona.Ukhuluma kanje ngalo mthetho uvele unyambanambana kwezinye izinhlaka kwezemfundo kulandela ukuduba umcimbi wokusayinwa kwawo, owawusezindlini zoMbuso ePitoli.Kukhona abafuna uRamaphosa, amkhombe indlela ngokuduba lo mcimbi njengoba iqembu lakhe i-DA, lingahambisani nalo mthetho.URamaphosa wabeka uhlelo lwezinyanga ezintathu zokuthi kubhekwe kabanzi lezi zigatshana ezimbili, uma kungavunyelwani ngazo wathi kuzoqhutshekwa njengoba esayinile.UNksz Gwarube uthe bekubalulekile ukuthi beze eKZN ukuze babhunge ngezithinta inkiyankiya yokushoda kwemali kwezemfundo.Uthe bathemba ukuthi kukhona ukuntwela ezansi okuzokwenzeka ngezinkinga zemali emnyangweni."Asifuni kube nokuphazamiseka kokufunda nokufundisa ngenxa yale nkinga. Kubalulekile ukuthi kube nothisha ngaso sonke isikhathi phambi kwabafundi.” Uveze ukuthi izinkinga zemali aziqali manje emnyangweni kodwa kunesikhathi zikhona."Sinabafundi abaningi eKZN futhi kuyisifundazwe esisithatha njengaleso esisemakhaya ngoba izikole eziningi zisemakhaya. Zithembele kuhulumeni ngezinsiza.” IPhini likaNgqongqoshe uDkt Reginah Mhaule, lihambe emazwini kaNksz Gwarube, lathi iKZN iyona enesibalo esikhulu sothisha."Uma kunyuswa imali yabasebenzi kodwa ingekho imali esiyinika umnyango waseKZN, nakanjani uzothwala kanzima ngoba kudingeka uhlwaye imali kwezinye izinhlelo. Yingakho kubalulekile ukuthi isifundazwe esifana nalesi sibhekelwe ngezimali.”
USELE nemibuzo engenazo izimpendulo umndeni kayise wengane (4) okuthiwa idlwengulwe yisihlobo (18) sikanina esiboshwe saphinde sadedelwa.Ngokusho kwesihlobo sikamgilwa ngasohlangothini lukayise kwa-E KwaMashu, babone ngesonto eledlule, ngesikhathi umgilwa ebavakashele ukuthi kukhona okushaya amanzi.Sithi uninakhulu kamgilwa (ozala uyise) uzwe kukhona iphunga elingaqondakali kuye, watshela uyise ukuthi akasondele, bambheke."Uqaphele ukuthi kuphuma uketshezi esithweni sakhe sangasese, wamgeza, wanikela kugogo (ozala unina) wayo khona kwa-E KwaMashu,” kusho isihlobo.Sithi wabuya edinwe eqhuma, ugogo wayo ethi "ihlakaniphile ingane, ukube kukhona oyidlwengulile, ngabe imtshelile”.Kuvela ukuthi uvamise ukuhlala nogogo wakhe nomalume, unina esemsebenzini.Kuvele ukuthi bayiyisa kudokotela ozimele, owafike waqinisekisa ukuthi idlwenguliwe, wathi uthola ukuthi isikekile futhi yesuleleke nangesifo esithathelana ngokocansi.Udalule ukuthi umgilwa watshela udokotela ukuthi ngumalume, (amgagula ngegama) omthinte esithweni sangasese."Saya esiteshini samaphoyisa ukuyovula icala. Satshelwa ukuthi umntwana uzohlolwa udokotela kahulumeni ngoba umphumela kadokotela ozimele awusebenzi uma kuvulwa icala lokudlwengula,” kusho isihlobo.Sithi nokahulumeni udokotela wathola konke okutholwe yilo ozimele, balivula icala, waboshwa umsolwa.Udalule ukuthi emva kwezinsuku ezimbili eboshiwe umsolwa, umseshi wababizela esiteshini kodwa wangasho lutho olutheni."Wacela ukukhuluma nengane yodwa,” kusho isihlobo.Siveza ukuthi esebaphindisa ekhaya, umseshi wabatshela ukuthi ingane ishilo ukuthi umalume uyenzeni, wathi ishilo nokuthi yamtshela ugogo (ozala unina) ngalokhu."Wasidida esethi kungenzeka umsolwa adedelwe ngoba siyashoda isitatimende sikamgilwa. Samangala uma sesithola enkantolo ngakusasa ukuthi ngempela umsolwa udedeliwe,” kusho isihlobo.Uthe batsheliwe ukuthi nokho umsolwa uzobuyela enkantolo ngo-Okthoba 16, wathi kodwa abenelisekile ngoba abazi ukuthi udedelwe ngaliphi."Uma bethi isitatimende siyashoda, basho ukuthini ngoba okushiwo yingane kwesekelwa ngisho nayimiphumela yodokotela abayihlolile,” kukhalaza isihlobo.Isihlobo sithe bakhathazekile nangomgilwa abathi usahlala ngaphansi kophahla olulodwa nomsolwa.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa aKwaMashu, abophe owesilisa (18) ngecala lokudlwengula ingane yentombazane (4) ngoSepthemba 26."Umsolwa uvele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseNtuzuma, ngo-Okthoba 2, icala lahlehliselwa u-Okthoba 16,” kusho uNetshiunda.
BABANJWE yiMantshi ukuthi bazibiza ngamagama ehlukene abasolwa abathathu ababhekene noxhaxha lwamacala okweba izimoto kodwa abahlale bephunyuka bagcine bengazange bagwetshwe.Abasolwa okukhulunywa ngabonguZwelethu Ngcobo, Cryil Zuma noNkululeko Shandu.Bakhalelwe ngamasongo kaSigonyela emasontweni edlule. NgoLwesine bebevele eNkantolo eNkulu yeMantshi eThekwini.Bebezolalela ukuthi inkantolo iyakugunyaza yini ukuthi baphume ngebheyili.Kuthe lisaqhubeka icala, iMantshi uMnuz Zuma yathi kukhona ekusolayo kodwa engenaso isiqiniseko sakho.Ithe laba basolwa usola sengathi bake bavela ngaphambilini kule nkantolo ngawo amacala okweba izimoto. Yathi kodwa amagama abo kwakungesiwona lawa ababizwa ngawo manje.Ibe seyicela ukuthi kuyiwe ekhefini ukuze ithole ukuthi ngempela kwenzekani.Sekubuywa ikuqinisekisile ukuthi kuyavela emabhukwini ukuthi ngempela bake bavela enkantolo ngamacala okweba izimoto kodwa bezibiza ngamanye amagamaNgenxa yaleso sizathu iMantshi ithe akusaqhubeki ukulalelwa kwesicelo sebheyili futhi iyabanqabela nebheyili ngoba ikholwa ukuthi kuningi okumele ikuvundulule ngalaba balisa abathathu."Ngikholwa ukuthi kuningi okumele kubhekwe ngalaba bantu abaphambi kwenkantolo ngala macala,'' isho kanje.IMantshi ithe ayifuni nokubanikeza ithuba lokuthi bavume kumbe baphike kulokhu ebikusho.Ngesikhathi iMantshi ikhuluma kanjena bebebonakala sabantu abadidekile bengazi ukuthi kukhulunywa ngani.Njengoba beboshiwe kuvela ukuthi baboshelwe amacala ehlukene okweba izimoto eMlaza, eNtuzuma naseNanda.Ummeli wabo uzamile ukubakhulumela kodwa iMantshi yathi iyaphela indaba yebheyili.Ithe icala ilihlehlisela isonto elizayo lapho okuzobe sekukuningi ekubhekile mayelana nabasolwa.Umthombo okhulume neSolezwe ngemuva kwecala, uthe abasolwa bangophunyuka bemphethe."Sekukaningi la madoda eboshwa ngecala lokweba izimoto. Kodwa njalo agcine ephume phambili uma sekuqulwa amacala. Kodwa manje kubukeka sengathi sebefike kwangqingetshe,'' kuchaza umthombo.
INGASE ichithwe iMeya kaMasipala waseNdumeni, uMnuz Siyabonga Ndlovu, ejikelwe yiqembu elibambisene ne-IFP emkhandlwini, i-DA.Ikhansela le-DA, uMnuz Mohamed Abdool, lifake isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNdlovu, likhala ngokuthi uyehluleka ukuhola umkhandlu.Kulesi siphakamiso, u-Abdool usola uNdlovu ngokwehluleka ukwenza umsebenzi wakhe, ukugxambukela, ukusebenzisa budedengu izinsiza zomkhandlu nezinsolo zenkohlakalo.U-Abdool ungusihlalo wekomiti elibhekelele ukusebenza kwemali yomphakathi kulo mkhandlu.I-IFP ayizange ithole izihlalo ezanele ukuthi ibuse ngokuzimela eNdumeni, ithembele kwi-DA.U-Abdool ufuna ukuthi isiphakamiso sakhe silalelwe emhlanganweni womkhandlu olandelayo obekungakanqunywa ukuthi uzohlala nini.Esiphakamisweni esibonwe yiSolezwe, u-Abdool uthi uNdlovu ufika ngesikhathi asithandayo emihlanganweni yomkhandlu."Sekuyinto eyejwayelekile ukuthi imeya ivele izihuqele ubuthongo emihlanganweni. Sekuyinto ejwayelekile ukuthi imeya iphume isikhathi eside, ishiye imihlangano yomkhandlu iqhubeka. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi ayizimisele kanjani ngomsebenzi.”U-Abdool uthe uNdlovu usebenzisa budedengu izinsiza zomkhandlu, wathi selokhu kwangena uNdlovu umkhandlu usukhokhe u-R440 000 wokuqasha izimoto."Lana ayibaliwe imali kapethroli. Imibiko ikhombisa ukuthi umasipala ukhipha u-R30 000 kapethroli osetshenziswa yizimoto zemeya. Lapha akusikhona ukuthi ihamba izindlela zomkhandlu, izihambela izindawo zayo.”U-Abdool ubalule ukuthi kunezinsolo zenkohlakalo ezibhekene noNdlovu.Umholi wekhokhasi ye-IFP eNdumeni, uMnuz Xolani Msezane, uthe lolu daba sebelubike ebuholini obuphezulu beqembu."Kusidumazile ukuthi abafwethu esisebenzisana nabo bafake lesi siphakamiso. Udaba silubikile ebuholini obuphezulu. Sinethemba lokuthi kuzothi kufika umhlangano olandelayo udaba lube seluxazululiwe. Ukufakwa kwabo isiphakamiso kukhombisa ukuthi ubudlelwano bethu kabuhambi kahle. Sinethemba lokuthi konke kuzolungiswa.”Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kukaNdlovu ayizange iphumelele.Ngesikhathi eshayelwa ucingo okokuqala, ukhale ngokuthi ubengakasiboni isiphakamiso, wacela ukunikwa isikhathi.Uphinde washayelwa, wacela ukuthunyelwa imibuzo agcine engayiphendulanga futhi akabange esalubamba ucingo ngesikhathi esethintwa emva kwalokho.Ngaphandle kwamakhansela e-IFP nawe-DA, kuphinde kube namakhansela e-ANC nele-ABC eNdumeni.
USAZIWAYO okusanda kuvela izinsolo zokuthi wadlwengula omunye uzakwabo, uNhlamulo odume ngelikaNota Baloyi, uzinikele emaphoyiseni izolo.UNota uziyise yena uqobo emaphoyiseni aseRandburg. Usolwa wuzakwabo owumlingisi u-Itumeleng Bokaba ngokumdlwengula. Lezi zindaba ziqale zavezwa wugobhoza onesigcwagcwa kosaziwayo njengoba enganqeni ukuveza izindaba zabo esidlangaleni, uMusa Khawula.Lezi zinsolo uzinameke ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, okwenze uNota waba sematheni isonto lonke. Bebodwa abakholwa 'yisisulu’, abanye bethi uNota uqanjelwa amanga. Naye uNota kuleli sonto uke waziphendulela, washo ukuthi okuvezwe yilo gobhoza kuyiqiniso, zikhona izinsolo zalolu hlobo ezibhekiswe kuye. Wathi okungelona iqiniso wukuthi wadlwengula.Uthe empeleni unobufakazi obukhomba ukuthi lo omsola ngokumdlwengula, uyena owazicelela ucansi kuye, wase emnika. Wathi imiyalezo izoba wubufakazi azobunika inkantolo.Izolo uNota ubhale emakhasini akhe asezinkundleni zokuxhumana ecela abalandeli bakhe ukuthi bambeke emkhulekweni njengoba ebhekene nalezi zinsolo. "Ngicela ningibeke emikhulekweni. Lolu wusuku olubi ukuzedlula zonke empilweni yami," ubhale kanje.Uthe okumenze wakhetha ukuyozinikela emaphoyiseni, wukuthi uzama ukuthi yonke lento isheshe kungaze kumosheke izinsiza zikahulumeni.Ukuqinisekisile ukuthi kuze kube manje ubengakaze abekwe cala, kodwa igama lakhe lilokhu limpazile nje ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, eyamaniswa nokudlwengula.Amaphoyisa akuqinisekisile ukuthi lo soziwayo uzovela enkantolo ngoMsombuluko.UCaptain Mavela Masondo, okhulumela amaphoyisa eGoli, uthe owesilisa oneminyaka ewu-34, owusaziwayo uzinikele emaphoyiseni ngoLwesihlanu. Uthe ube esebekwa icala lokudlwengula, uzovela enkantolo yeMantshi eRandburg ngoMsombuluko.
KULINDELEKE ukuthi luqale ngesonto elizayo uhlelo lokuncishiswa kwamanzi eThekwini ngenhloso yokuwonga.Lokhu kudalulwe yiMeya yeTheku uMnuz Cyril Xaba esithangamini nabezindaba izolo, eThekwini, lapho idalule nokuthi ukunciphisa ukuhlinzekwa kwamanzi kwenzelwa ukuthi ehlezi ekhona uma kwenzeka kufika isikhathi sesomiso noma kuna imvula encane.Ekhuluma nabezindaba, uthe uhlelo lokuncishiswa kwamanzi oluzoqala ngo-Okthoba 10, luzoqhubeka izinyanga ezingu-12."Izakhamuzi ziyanxuswa ukuthi zonge amanzi ngoba kunesikali samanzi esibekelwe Umgeni-uThukela Water angahlanzwa noma adonswe ohlelweni loMgeni-Water System. Lokhu kwenza ukuthi amanzi angapheli ahlezi ekhona ngisho nangezikhathi zemvula encane kunalena ejwayelekile,’ kusho uXaba.Uthe uma singekho isikali samanzi esibekiwe, ngeke idolobha libe namanzi anele."Uma uMgeni-Uthukela Water uthatha isinyathelo sokunciphisa amanzi kancane kancane njengoba kuhleliwe, umsebenzi wokuhlinzeka amanzi uzoqhubeka uzinze ngisho noma kunemvula encane. Umnyango kazwelonke wamanzi nokukhucululwa kwendle ukhiphe umyalelo wokuthi kuncishiswe amanzi adonswa ohlelweni loMgeni-Uthukela ukuthi abuyele esikalini esigunyaziwe,” usho kanje.UXaba uthe kudingeke ukuthi uhlelo lokuncishiswa kwamanzi lwenzeke kancane kancane ezinyangeni ezingu-12 ezizayo.Uveze ukuthi isilinganiso samanzi esidonswe kuMgeni-Uthukela Water ezinyangeni ezingu-12 ezedlule siwu-1 406 mega litres ngosuku.IMeya iveze ukuthi ngokomyalelo woMnyango wezaManzi lesi silinganiso kumele sehliswe sibe ngu-1 287 mega litres ngosuku, ukuze uMgeni-Uthukela Water uhambisane nelayisensi yawo. Umasipala uveze ukuthi ukuze wenze isiqiniseko sokuthi izakhamuzi azithikamezeki kakhulu, uzofaka okokulawula ukuphuma kwamanzi emamitheni. Uzofaka amamitha kumakhasimende angenawo. Uzosheshisa ukulungiswa kwamapayipi avuzayo ngokuthi kusetshenziswe abalungisa amapayipi abaqhamuka emawadini ehlukene.
SELUQALILE ukusefa ulwandle kwabachithwe yisikhwama iNational Student Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS).Lokhu kwenzeka nje akukapheli sikhathi esingakanani kuvulwe ithuba lokuthi bafake izicelo abafuna ukuxhaswa.Ithuba lezicelo livulwe ngenyanga edlule uSepthemba 20, kanti livalwa ngoDisemba 15, 2024. Selokhu kuvulwe ithuba izicelo zingu-235 780 izicelo ezifakiwe kulesi sikhwama.Isitatimende seNSFAS, siveze ukuthi kulezi zicelo zingu-202 044, esezigunyazwe okwesikhashana ukuthi sezixhasiwe. Lezi zicelo ezalabo abathola isibonelelo sikahulumeni kwaSassa."Ezicelelweni ezifakiwe kuze kube yimanje, ezingu-60 021 zisacutshungulwa, ezingu-3 660 zihoxisiwe kuthi ezingu-1 862 zichithiwe. Sisekhona isikhathi sokuthi abafuna uxhaso bafake izicelo njengoba ithuba lizovalwa ngoDisemba,” kusho iNSFAS.Ithe isifundazwe esinesibalo esikhulu sabafake izicelo yiKwaZulu-Natal."Zingu-109 026 izicelo ezifakwe yiKZN, kulandele iGauteng ngezingu-31 491 neLimpopo ngezingu-21 234. INorthern Cape iyona enesibalo esincane sabafake izicelo ngabangu-849.”INSFAS ithe kuyimpoqo kuwona wonke umuntu ongasiholi isibonelelo seSassa, ukuthi asayine ifomu."Sinxusa nalabo abafunda uGrade 9 kuya kuGrade 12, ukuthi bafake izicelo bangaze balinde imiphumela yokuphela konyaka. Lokhu kuzobanika isikhathi sokuthi kubhekwe imininingwane yabo ukuthi ikahle yini.” Abalesi sikhwama bathe kulula ukufaka isicelo njengoba uvula i-myNSFAS profile, bese ugcwalisa okudingekayo bese ufaka isicelo.UNgqongqoshe weMfundo ePhakeme uDkt Nobuhle Nkabane, wathi balindele izicelo ezibalelwa ku-1.2 million, zabafuna ukuxhasw ngemali yokufunda ezikhungweni zemfundo ngonyaka ozayo.Ukuze uxhaswe ngomfundaze kulesi sikhwama umndeni wakho kumele uhole kusuka kuR350 000 ngonyaka kuya phansi.Abaxhaswayo bathola imali yokubhalisa, eyokufunda, eyezincwadi, imali yokuphila, eyokugibela noma eyendawo yokuhlala. Kwabazobolekwa imali yokufunda kulesi sikhwama kumele abazali babo bahole kusuka kuR350 000 kufinyelele kuR600 000 ngonyaka.Abafaka izicelo banxuswa ukuthi bafake imininingwane eqondile yabazali njengoba imininingwane abayilethile izoqinisekiswa yiminyango ehlukene kahulumeni okubalwa owezaseKhaya nezinhlaka ezifana nohlaka oluqoqa intela kuleli iSARS.
UDUMELE umndeni ka-Andile 'Bobo’ Mbuthu, ngenkathi uzwa ababulali bendodana yawo belaxaza ummeli wabo ngesikhathi sekumele bagwetshwe eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseVerulam ngoLwesithathu.Kujabhe namakholwa abekade ezokweseka lomndeni ezwa o-Andile Nhleko, Mncedisi Mzobe, Lindani Ndlovu noMalusi Mthembu bethi ithibelene phakathi kwabo nobengummeli wabo, uMnuz Chris Gounden.Lamadoda alahlwe yicala lokuthumba nelokubulala ngokuhleliwe ngoJulayi, yahoxiswa ibheyili ase egqunywa ezitokisini alinda isigwebo.Athe kawaneme ngoGounden, amsola ngokuwahlinzela ezibini ngesikhathi secala, abe asecela inkantolo ukuthi iwatholele ummeli wamahhala ongase abone izinto ngeso elihlukile.UNksz Zodwa Jali ongumamncane kaBobo, uthe kubuhlungu ngoba izolo bese bezitshelile ukuthi sekufike ekugcineni, ababulali bazogwetshwa."Siyadinga ukulivala leli khasi manje, ukuze siqhubekele phambili nempilo yethu emile. BATHI kwehlisa ingcindezi kubona, ukusebenza ngokuzikhandla kwamaphoyisa abamakomiti alwa nobugebengu emphakathini.Lokhu kungenxa yezigameko zokufa kwabasolwa okuthiwa basala enkundleni emva kokudubulana namaphoyisa asuke ezama ukubavalela.Kuthe ngezintatha zayizolo, amaphoyisa athela othulini abasolwa ababili okuthiwa bebefunwa ngamacala okubamba inkunzi nokubulala okuvele ukuthi babhadanywe amaphoyisa bebhace emzini othile kwa-E, eNtuzuma. Yize kunjalo, ekhasini elisemthethweni lwamaphoyisa kaMasipala weTheku enkundleni yokuxhumana u-Facebook, elibizwa nge-Durban Metro Police Service, bakuqinisekisile ukubulawa kwalaba basolwa. SELUQUBULE indida udaba lwamalungu omndeni ashone ngemuva komsebenzi emzini wakwaChiliza KwaMgayi, eMthwalume. Isolezwe libike ngalolu daba izolo nokuthe khona izolo izintatheli zahambela kuleya ndawo kwatholakala kukhala ibhungezi emzini okuthiwa bekunomsebenzi kuwo. Kube sekuvela izindaba ezingaqinisekisiwe zokuthi kukhona nabanye asebeshonile abangebona abomndeni. Kuthiwa amalungu omndeni aqale aphuma igazi ngamakhala. Mina sengiphuma nakudokotela. UNkulunkulu angisize,'' kubalisa omunye wesifazane.Elinye ilungu lomphakathi elificwe yiSolezwe limi nomakhelwane bemi isixongololo libuzwa ngalo mndeni liphendule kuqala lathi : "Nifuna lapho okushone khona abantu abaningi kade kunomcimbi?'' Kuthe uma intatheli ivuma lase liqala likhuluma. "Ibuhlungu leya nto eyenzeke kuloya muzi. Futhi inkulu le nto ebifakwe kuleya nyama yenkomo. Uma kuyisandla somuntu cha, ayi ukhona bo,'' lisho kanje.Iqhubekile intatheli yambuza ukuthi ubekhona yini emcimbini wavuma wathi ubekhona. "Njengoba usibona simi lapha nje sonke besikhona futhi sikhuluma ngayo le ndaba,'' lisho kanje.Kube sekunanela omunye wesifazane othe: "Ningobani nina? Noma nizobasiza ngani laba bantu ngoba phela kubi ikakhulukazi emndenini obuhlele umcimbi,'' libuza.Liqhuba lizwakale selikhulumela phansi selithi: " Eyi madoda kodwa ngomngani wami uBe.''Kulapho intatheli ebabuze khona ukuthi bayabazi yini ngamagama abantu bomphakathi abashonile. Babe sebebagagula ngamagama.Baveze nokuthi kunomunye ubaba obesanda kufika endaweni oshonele egcekeni lakwakhe esanda kubuya nje emcimbini."Siyamlibala isibongo sakhe loya baba kodwa yena usanda kufika endaweni,'' bephundula kanye kanye.Isolezwe liphinde lahlangana nabanye futhi abesifazane abebehlezi eceleni komgwaqo nabo abaqinisekisile ukuthi bayalwazi lolu daba."Uma nje ningasiza ngokuthi lolu daba lufinyelele nakuhulumeni kungaba ngcono kabi. Phela le nto akumele iphelele lapha nje endaweni kube sekubhujwe kangaka,'' usho kanje.Isolezwe lihabule ukuthi eminyakeni eyedlule kuke kwabhujwa futhi kule ndawo ngemuva kokuba abantu bephuze utshwala emcimbini."Sesikhathele manje yile nto, phela ekuqaleni abantu babhubha kade bephuze utshwala komunye umcimbi,'' kubalisa elinye ilungu lomphakathi.Isolezwe lihambe laze lafinyelela emzini lapho okuthiwa bekunomcimbi khona kodwa lafica kukhala ibhungezi.Izolo Isolezwe lizame lancama ukuthola ubuholi bendawo ukuze buphawule ngalolu daba. Kuvela ukuthi amalungu omphakathi ashonile wona abekhukhunyalelwa yizisu ngaphambi kokushona. Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMpilo eKZN uMnuz Ntokozo Maphisa, uthe ngokwamabhuku abo bagcina ngo-Agasti ukufikelwa abantu ababesolwa ngokudla ushevu esibhedlela eGJ Crooks. Ababengeniswe khona baxilongwa badedelwa.
IQEMBU lepolitiki i-ActionSA lidalule ukuthi ingu-R277 billion imali izinkampani nabantu abayikweleta abaqoqibentela, iSouth African Revenue Service (Sars).Kuthiwa lezi zizumbulu zikweletwa yizinkampani eziwu-2 901 ezisilele emuva ekukhokheni uR216 billion.Kuvela nokuthi bangu-1 156 abakhokhi bentela abakweleta iSARS, uR62 billion okwenza ibalelwe ku-90% imali ekweletwayo.Lokhu kudalulelwe abezindaba esitatimendeni esithunyelwe ilungu lePhalamende le-ActionSA, uMnuz Alan Beesley.UBeesley uthe lezi yizimpendulo azitholile ePhalamende emuva kokubuza ukuthi zingaki izinkampani nabantu abakweleta iSars imali engaphezu kukaR10 million."Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi ngoJulayi, i-ActionSA yakhala ngokuphundlwa kwesabelomali sikaR1.3 billion seSars. Lokhu kwenziwa yize iSars ingenisela uhulumeni imali engaphezu kuka-90%,” kusho uBeesley.Uveze ukuthi abakuthole ePhalamende kuyabamangaza futhi kwenzeka esikhathini lapho iminyango ehlukene kahulumeni ingase ibophe ibhande ngenhloso yokonga imali.UBeesley uthe kuyajabhisa ukuthi kunemali engu-R277 billion abantu abayikweleta iSars esikhathini lapho uMnyango wezeMpilo kuya kowezemfundo, ubhekene nesimo esimazonzo othisha abaneziqu belengela eweni lokuphelelwa yimisebenzi.Uthe ukuphundlwa kwesabelomali eMnyangweni wezeMfuno kuzoba nomthelela ongemuhle kwezemfundoLeli qembu lithe kumele ilekelelwe iSars khona izokwazi ukuqoqa le mali ekweletwayo."Sizoqhubeka sisebenzise ikomiti elibheke ukusebenza koMnyango wezeziMali sinxenxe ukuthi kuhoxiswe ukuncishishwa kwesabelomali seSars ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi isebenza kahle ngendlela elindelekile,” kusho uBeesley.Umdidiyeli wemidlalo yethelevishini, uDuma KaNdlovu ungomunye wabantu abathweswe icala lokusilela emuva ekukhokheni intela kaR25 million. Udedelwe yinkantolo ngebheyili kaR100 000.
UHULUMENI waKwaZulu-Natal uzosungula uhlaka oluzokwenza kube lula ukuthi izinhlaka ezehlukene zikwazi ukubhunga kabanzi ngokungenziwa ngodaba lokuguquguquka kwesimo sezulu.Lokhu kudalulwe nguNdunankulu wesifundazwe, uMnuz Thami Ntuli esithangamini sabezindaba ngoLwesine.UNtuli uthe akungatshazwa ukuthi umthelela wokuguquguquka kwesimo sezulu awuseyona nje inganekwane kodwa uyinto eyenzeka ngempela.Wathi siphelile isikhathi sokuthi benze sengathi konke kuhamba ngendlela eyejwayelekile.UNDUNANKULU waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli umemezele izinhlelo zesifundazwe ngokuguquguquka kwesimo sezulu esithangamini sabezindaba Isithombe: SITHUNYELWE UNtuli uchithe isonto lonke eNew York, ngasekupheleni kukaSepthemba, lapho bekuhlangene abaholi bezinhlaka ezehlukene emhlabeni jikelele ukuzobhunga ngokufanele kwenziwe ngokuguquguquka kwesimo sezulu.Phakathi kwezinyathelo athe isifundazwe sizozithatha, ukusungula iKwaZulu-Natal Climate Change and Sustainability Council ezoba yinkundla yokuxoxisana kwezinhlaka ezehlukene ngokuguquguquka kwesimo sezulu.Uthe lolu hlaka bazolwethula emasontweni amane ezayo.Wathi kulona kukhona uhulumeni wesifundazwe, ubuholi bomdabu, iSouth African Local Government Association (SALGA), uhulumeni wamazinga aphansi, izinhlangano ezizimele, ezomphakathi, abamabhizinisi, abezindaba, abezemfundo nongoti."Sizoba nezingxoxo lapho sizobiza zonke izinhlaka ngaphansi kophahla olulodwa, ukuze siqhamuke nezisombululo ngokubambisana esifundazweni,” kusho uNtuli.Uthe kuwumsebenzi wabo ukuhlanganisa kahle izisombululo ezizodala ukuthi unciphe umthelela omubi wokuguquguquka kwesimo sezulu.Uthe izisombululo zabo zizohambisana nokushicilelwe emthethweni osanda kucikicwa nguMengameli wezwe, uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa, iClimate Change Act 22 of 2024."Lo mthetho uyigxathu elifanele elithathwe yizwe ukuzibandakanya emizamweni yokunciphisa umonakalo odalwa ukuguquguquka kwesimo sezulu,” usho kanje.Uthe isifundazwe kufanele sizilungiselele kunoma yini engenzeka, phakathi kokunye, wabala ukulungiswa kwezitamkoko, kuqikelelwe ukuthi zisebenza ngendlela efanele."Siyagcizelela nakubaholi bomdabu ngokubaluleka kokubeka abantu ezindaweni eziphephile, bagweme ukubabeka ezindaweni eziyingozi njengaseduze kwemifula,” kweluleka uNtuli.Ugqugquzele abantu ukuthi bazithathele phezulu izexwayiso ezikhishwa ngabesimo sezulu ukugwema ukuzifaka ebungozini.Isifundazwe iKwaZulu-Natal, siyisibonelo esifanele uma kuziwa odabeni lokuguquguquka kwesimo sezulu.Siphuma ezikhukhuleni ezadlula nemiphefumulo yabangaphezu kuka-450 ngo-2022.Ngemva kwalokho sibe nezinye izikhukhula ebezishiya kukhalwa ezindaweni ezehlukene.Muva nje oThongathi kuke kwaba nesiphepho esaphephula inqwaba yemizi kanti emasontweni amabili edlule, kube nenqwaba yezimoto ezivaleleke emgwaqweni uN3 noN11, izinsuku ezimbili kuhlasele iqhwa.
BEKUPHUME osondonzima be-MK ngesikhathi kulalelwa icala lesikhulu senhlangano eyengamele ukhetho, i-Independent Electoral Commission (IEC), esiboshelwe ukwephula imigomo yokhetho.Ubuholi be-MK okubalwa kubo umholi wale nhlangano ePhalamende, uDkt John Hlophe, nomgqugquzeli we-MK KwaZulu-Natal, uDkt Kwazi Mbanjwa, bebezifikele mathupha eNkantolo yeMantshi eMgungundlovu, izolo.Le nkantolo ibilalele icala elibhekene nesikhulu se-IEC, uMnuz Musawenkosi Mnikathi, obhekene necala lokwephula imigomo yokhetho.UMnikathi wayeyisikhulu se-IEC elokishini iMbali, ngosuku lokhetho.Waboshwa emva kokutholakala ehambisa amaphepha okuvota engaphelezelwe ngamaphoyisa.Izolo, kuqala ukuqulwa kwecala, inkantolo ibize ofakazi ababili.Labo fakazi, uMnuz Bonginkosi Mbethe, noMnuz Nkosiphendule Mthembu, babeqashwe i-MK ukuba bagade izimoto eziphumayo nezingenayo eziteshini zokuvota ngosuku lokhetho.Bobabili batshele inkantolo ukuthi uMnikathi waphuma nemoto eyayilayishe amabhokisi anamaphepha okuvota esiteshini sokuvota esise-Unit 13, khona eMbali.Bathe bamvimba njengoba ayengaphelezelwanga amaphoyisa.UMthembu uthe uMnikathi wazama ukubashayisa ngemoto kodwa bangasuka endleleni."Wazama ukuqhubeka ahambe, ngama phambi kwemoto. Ngamtshela ukuthi akangishayise.”UMthembu uthe babiza amaphoyisa ayesesikhungweni sokuvota, afike aphuca uMnikathi ukhiye wemoto.Uthe emva kwalokho, kwabe sekuyiwa esiteshini sokuvota, lapho uMnikathi avulelwa khona icala.UMbethe uthe uMnikathi walanyulelwa yibona olakeni lwabantu ababesesikhungweni sokuvota, abase bemi ngezinyawo.Uthe kwasukuma abantu abaqhamuka emaqenjini ehlukene ngesikhath bebona uMnikathi ezama ukudlubulundela."Kwasukuma ngisho abantu abaqhamuka kwamanye amaqembu ezepolitiki, okubalwa neDA.”Kusasa, ummeli kaMnikathi uzohloma uMthembu ngemibuzo.Amalungu e-MK aphume ngaphakathi enkantolo eshayela phezulu.Umgqugquzeli we-MK esifundeni iMoses Mabhida, uMnuz Ntuthuko Mkhize, uthe ukuqala ukuqulwa kwaleli cala kuzokwelekelela umbhidlango wabo wokuphonsela inselelo imiphumela yokhetho lwangoMeyi."Sihlezi sisho ukuthi amavoti ethu antshontshwa. Besihlezi sizibonela nathi amavoti ethu eyolahlwa lapho kulahlwa khona udoti lapha eMsunduzi. Njengoba icala seliqulwa nje, izwe lizobona ukuthi amavoti ethu antshontshwa ngempela.”UMkhize uthe banethemba lokuthi uMnikathi uzothola isigwebo esiqinile."Uma ubheka ofakazi abakhulumile namhlanje, bonke bakhuluma into efanayo, futhi bakhulume kahle. Sinethemba lokuthi ijaji lizothatha isinqumo esikahle.”
KUPHAZAMISEKE ukwakhiwa komgwaqo u-P77, onqamula ku-ward 2 no-ward 3, eZembeni, ngaphansi kukaMasipala uMdoni, kubhikisha amalungu omphakathi izolo, okuthiwa akhala ngokungaqashwa kwabantu bendawo ngendlela efanele ohlelweni lokwakhiwa kwalo mgwaqo. Lawa malungu abebhikisha, aveza ukuthi sekukaningi enxusa ukuthi kwenziwe ubulungiswa, kunikezwe abanye ithuba emsebenzini wokwakhiwa kwalo komgwaqo, onikezwe inkampani i-Afriscan. Aveze ukuthi ngesikhathi kuqala lo msebenzi kwakuvunyelwene ngokuthi abaqashiwe bazosebenza izinyanga eziyisithupha bese badedele abanye.UNksz Gugu Cele osekomitini lomphakathi, uthe okuthukuthelisa umphakathi ukuthi kunabasebenze isikhathi eside, abangakaze bamiswe selokhu kwaqala ukwakhiwa kwawo ngo-2022."Kukhona abantu asebesebenze izinyanga ezevile ku-20, futhi abazimisele ukuphuma. Umphakathi unqume ukuveza ilaka lawo ubhikishe. Abukho ubulungiswa ekuqashweni kwabantu ngoba abekho asebeke bamiswa, kwaqashwa kabusha njengesivumelwano esasivezwe emphakathini. Kukhona abantu okungebona abendawo abasebenzayo ekubeni singazi ukuthi baqashwe kanjani,” usho kanje.Uthe umphakathi usola amakhansela ngokwenzelela uma kuqashwa kangangoba ohlwini olusha bafuna usonkontileka alubheke uma eseqasha kabusha, lwenziwe yiwona umphakathi ngqo ngokusizwa ubuholi bomdabu. Bathe basebenzise izinduna zendawo ngoba yizona ezazi abantu basendaweni nesimo semindeni ehlukene njengoba befuna umsebenzi unikezwe labo abaphuma emakhaya okungekho muntu osebenzayo.Ikhansela lendawo, uMnuz Mthokozisi Madlala, lithe nakuba belingaziswanga ngombhikisho kodwa liyazazi izikhalo zomphakathi."Ngesikhathi umphakathi uveza lezi zikhalo, siphakamise ukuthi ukhethe ikomiti elizokwazi ukuthi lithathe zonke izikhalo zawo likwazi ukusinikeza ngoba sibona ukuthi umphakathi ugcina ungakwazi ukukhuluma nathi njengamakhansela ngokukhululeka. Kokuvunyelwene ngakho, ukuthi kukhona izinkontileka zabo obekumele ziphele izolo, abanye ziphela ekupheleni kwenyanga, engigcine ngingakazi noma inkampani ikwazile yini ukuqasha abanye njengokwesivumelwano somphakathi nekomiti,” lisho kanje.UMadlala uvumile ukuthi kukhona asebesebenze isikhathi eside njengoba bengakaze bashintshwe, wathi okwenza amakhansela agcine esebayeka, ukuthi ngesikhathi kusenziwa iziphakamiso abanye babethi akube yizinyanga ezintathu, kanti abaqashiwe babekhala ngokuthi zincane. Uthe abanye bebekhala ngokuthi eziyisithupha nazo zincane, okugcine sebeyekela kodwa okuyiphutha abazimisele ukuthi lilungiswe, kuqashwe abantu abasha.Kuqhubeka umbhikisho nje, lo masipala ophethwe yi-ANC kuthe ngoMsombuluko, uMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu esifundazweni wamemezela umlekeleli omusha, kukhalwa ngokugqoza kokulethwa kwezidingo kubantu.
KUKHISHWE isexwayiso esishubile kothisha abangamalungu eSadtu ukuthi bangalokothi batholakale bedayisa izikhala eMnyangweni wezeMfundo, bangathathi ngozipho emalini yezikole, bangebi ukudla kwabafundi nokuthi bangalinge babanjwe bebhaxabula abafundi.Lesi sexwayiso sikhishwe ubuholi obusha bale nyunyana obubuyiselwe ngo-elethu engqungqutheleni yakamuva ebiseGoli.ISadtu yethule nomkhankaso wokulwa nokuncishiswa kwesabelomali sezemfundo. Kuyaziwa ukuthi icala ukudayisa izikhala ngakho asilindele ukuthi kuzoba nelungu leSadtu elizobanjwa lenza lo mkhonyovu,” kusho uMaphila.Uthe okunye, indaba yokuthi othisha babandakanyeke ekudliweni kwemali yesikole, ukwebiwa kokudla kwabafundi kanjalo nalabo abasashaya abafundi."Kumele sibakhumbuze othisha ukuthi kuyicala ukusebenzisa induku ezikoleni ngoba yavalwa.
