UNGQONGQOSHE wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka unxuse abafundi baka-matric ukuba baqinise ezifundweni zabo njengoba sekusondele izivivinyo. UNgqongqoshe usho kanje ngesikhathi evakashele esikoleni eNdukwenhle High, eMlaza, ngoLwesibili ehambisana nenkampani kaphethroli iShell Downstream South Africa beyothula uhlelo lwemifundaze kubafundi abaphasa ngamalengiso njengoba sekusele izinsuku ezingu-19 kuqale izivivinyo zika-matric zokuphela konyaka. Ezinye zezikole ebeziyingxenye yokuthamela ukwethulwa kwemifundaze kubalwa iVelabahleke High kanye neMenzi High okuyizikole ezenza kahle esifundeni saseMlaza.Ekhuluma nabezindaba, uthe uma sekusondele izinsuku zezivivinyo izingane ziyathuka."Abanye abalali nasebusuku futhi noma ungathandaza, kodwa uma ungafundanga ngeke uphase ngoba uNkulunkulu usiza ozisizayo. Abafundi kumele basize uNkulunkulu ngokuthi bafunde futhi uma abafundi bethandaza, kumele bathandazele ukuthi babe nothisha abakwazile ukubafundisa baphinde bathandazele nokuthi abakufundile bangakukhohlwa,” kusho uHlomuka.Uthe uma abafundi bezoba uvanzi bangafundi bazovuna lokho abakutshalie."Uma abafundi bezogcwala imigwaqo, baye ezindaweni zokucima ukoma, bese ekugcineni bezitshela ukuthi bazophasa, lokho ngeke kwenzeke. Yingakho sinicela ukuthi niqhubeke nomgqigqo obekwe yilaba abebephambi kwenu ukuthi kuphase wonke umuntu futhi niphase ngamalengiso,” usho kanje.Uqhube wathi uhlelo lwemifundaze olulethwa yinkampani iShell, lunomthelela omuhle emiphumeleni ka-matric."Umntwana owaziyo ukuthi uzothola umfundaze uzoba nesiqiniseko sokuthi uyaphasa ukuze axhaswe. Ngeke axakeke engazi ukuthi uzoshonaphi ngoba uyazi ukuthi uma enze kahle nakanjani uzokuthola ukwesekwa ukuze aqhubeke nezifundo zakhe,” ubeke kanje.Isikhulu esiphezulu e-Shell Downstream South Afrca, uMnuz Aluwani Museisi, sithe abafundi bayikusasa lezwe."Njengoba silapha namuhla sizoninika ithuba lokuthi nizitshele ukuthi ngemfundo ningasishintsha isimo enibhekene naso. Njengenkampani iShell, sizibona singabantu abakha isizwe ngoba isizwe asakhiwa umuntu oyedwa, kodwa sakhiwa ngokubambisana,” kusho uMuseisi.Uthe ukusiza omunye umuntu kuyingqayizivele futhi ayikho into enhle edlula ukushintsha impilo yomunye umuntu. Uthe njengoba kusele izinsuku ezingu-19 kuqale izivivinyo, abafundi abazimisele, kube semqondweni wabo ukuthi njengoba bezophasa ngamalengiso-nje, iShell izobe ikhona izobasiza ukuze bafeze amaphupho abo.Khonamanjalo, uNksz Ntokozo Shandu owenza izifundo ze-Science, eMenzi High, uthe uzizwa ehloniphekile ngokunikwezwa leli thuba ngabaseShell."Ngizolisebenzisa ngokukhulu ukuzimisela futhi ngikulungele ukubhala izivivinyo. Isikhathi sami samaholidi bengisichitha ngendlela enhle ngenzela ukuthi uma sekufika izivivinyo zingifice ngilindele,” kusho uNksz Shandu.UNksz Lwandile Ngcongwane waseVelabahleke High, uthe isikhathi esiningi usichitha ngokufunda futhi akafundi kuphela izincwadi zesikole kodwa nezinye uyazifunda ngenhloso yokuzithuthukisa ngolwazi. Uthe uma eseqede u-matric ufisa ukuyokwenza izifundo ze-Aviation abe yi-Commercial Pilot.
BAKHALA ngokwemukwa abebeziphilisa ngakho yinkosi yesizwe, abathwebula izithombe zabantu abasuke bedlula ngasenxanxatheleni yezitolo eTugela Ferry, eMsinga, okuvela ukuthi ibaxoshile, abanye yabaphuca amakhamera abasebenza ngawo okudingeka ukuba bahlawule inkomo, uma befuna ukubuyiselwa wona.Kuthiwa laba besilisa okuvele ukuthi isibalo sabo sevile eshumini, bacutha emasangweni ale nxanxathela ukunxenxa abasuke bedlula ngakhona ekutheni babathwebule izithombe bese bebadayisela zona. Kuthiwa othwetshuliwe uma ekhombise ukusithanda isithombe athathwe sona enganakile, bamdayisela sona okuyindlela abazenzela ngayo imali.Nakuba lokhu bekuchaza njengokuzenzela ibhizinisi lokuziphilisa njengabantu bendawo, kodwa kuthiwa emasontweni amabili adlule, kufinyelele kwangqingetshe ngesikhathi iNkosi yesizwe uDaba Mthembu, ithumela amadoda endawo ukuthi abasuse. Kuthiwa kuthathwe amakhamera kwabathathu abaficwa bematasa besebenza, kuvela ukuthi abanikazi bawo kumele bahlawule ngenkomo noma ngo-R10 000 umuntu ngamunye, ngokudelela umyalelo wenkosi okuthiwa sekunesikhathi izama ukubasusa.Encwadini ebhalwe ngoJuni, esayinwe yinkosi, Isolezwe eliyibonile, okuvela ukuthi yayiqondiswe emaphoyiseni asesiteshini esisendaweni, inxusa amaphoyisa ukuthi alekelele ekususweni kwabafana abathwebulayo ngasezitolo nanoma iyiphi indawo engaphansi kwesizwe sabaThembu. Nokho asikho isizathu esibekiwe ngaphandle kokuthi iveza ukuthi akuzwenwe."...isimo phakathi kwethu nabo asisihle. Sibanga indawo namalungelo,” okunye okubhalwe kuyo.Kuthintwa inkosi ikuqinisekisile ukuthi ikhona inhlawulo okumele bayikhokhe ngokudelela umyalelo wayo, bethi banamalungelo okuziphilisa. "Emva kokuthola izikhalo kwiziphathimandla zenxanxathela yezitolo ngabahweba eduze kwalesi sakhiwo ngokungemthetho, sibayalele ukuthi basuke. Bengilokhu ngizama ukukhuluma nabo kodwa uma ngiqhamuka bebebaleka, okuthe ekugcineni ngathumela amadoda ukuthi abasuse emva kokuthi sibhalele emaphoyiseni sicela ukuthi adlulisele incwadi ebazise ngokuthi angibafuni kuleya ndawo,” isho kanjena.Inkosi ithi kunezinsolo zokuthi abathwebuli babuye basebenzele abathile ukudayisa izidakamizwa endaweni, yathi ayifuni ukubabona benza lo msebenzi endaweni yayo.Omunye wabo okhulume neSolezwe, onxuse ukungadalulwa, uthe okwezidakamizwa kuyamshaqisa."Ngeke ngikhulumele abanye ngoba sibaningi esenza lo msebenzi, mhlawumbe kukhona abasake bakubona. Ngineminyaka emithathu ngizishuthela abantu kodwa angikaze ngibone muntu kwesisebenza nabo edayisa izidakamizwa noma enza nje obunye ubugebengu. Sisebenzisana namalungu omphakathi futhi abesixhasa kakhulu kangangoba uma kuyizinsuku ezimatasa, besikwazi ukwenza imali ephakathi kuka– R150 no-R250 ngosuku,” usho kanje.Uthe ukuthathwa kwekhamera yakhe kumphazamise kakhulu ngoba imali abeyithola ubeyisebenzisa ukondla kubo. Uveze ukuthi enye imali ubeyibekela ukubhalisa esikhungweni semfundo ephakeme njengoba ethe unephupho lokuqhuba izifundo zakhe ngonyaka ozayo aselibona lishabalala. Uveze ukuthi phambilini ngenxa yokungaqondi, bebesebenzela ngaphakathi enxanxatheleni yezitolo kodwa emva kokukhalaza kwabaphathi bayo banqume ukuphuma basebenzele ngaphandle, bengaphazamisi muntu.Omunye uthe akasakwazi ukuthengela ingane yakhe ubisi kwazise usebhuquza ekhaya emva kwalesi sigameko, ekubeni nakubo bebethembele kuye."Ngokwakhiwa kwezitolo, besazi ukuthi kuletha intuthuko kuwona wonke umuntu, ikakhulu kithina bantu bendawo. Akukho esikonile, asibambi nkunzi kodwa siyazizamela ngento futhi engaphazamisi muntu ngoba nabantu bayawuthokozela umsebenzi wethu. "Esikufisayo ukuthi sibuyiselwe amakhamera ethu ngoba asigcini ngokuthwebula ngasezitolo kodwa sibuye siqashwe uma kunemicimbi endaweni ukuyoshutha sizenzele imali kwazise imisebenzi ayikho. Silindele ukuthi abaholi kubeyibona abakhuthaza thina njengentsha ukuqala amabhizinisi kodwa okwenziwa yinkosi kusiqeda amandla,” kubalisa yena. Uthe bawabikelile amaphoyisa kodwa athi ngeke enze lutho ngoba athathwe ngomyalelo wenkosi endaweni yayo.
IYAQONGA ingcindezi kuNgqongoshe wezoBulungiswa, uNksz Thembi Simelane, ukuba ehle esikhundleni njengoba isiphenduke iphela endlebeni eyokuthola kwakhe izishaqane zemali enkampanini eyahlomula enkohlakalweni eyaguqisa ibhange iVBS.UNksz Simelane uvulelwe icala emaphoyiseni, izolo. Isinqumo ngekusasa lakhe kulindeleke ukuthi sithathwe emhlanganweni olandelayo wesigungu esiphezulu kwi-ANC.Ngeledlule uNksz Simelane uvele phambi kwekomiti lezobuqotho kwi-ANC, lapho echaze khona ngalezi zishaqane azithola ngesikhathi eseyimeya kuMasipala wasePolokwane.UNksz Simelane wathola imali engu-R575 600 enkampanini iGundo Wealth Solution, okuyinkampani okuthiwa yaba nesandla ekutheni uMasipala wasePolokwane utshale imali eVBS ngesikhathi kusaphethe uNksz Simelane.NgokukaNksz Simelane, le mali wayeyitshelekile.I-ActionSA imvulele icala lokwehluleka ukugwema inkohlakalo.Icala livulwe esiteshini samaphoyisa, ePolokwane.Ohola i-ActionSA ePhalamende, uMnuz Athol Trollip, uthe banqume ukuvulela uNksz Simelane icala emva kwezinsolo zokuthi wakokotela isivumelwano sokuboleka imali kwiGundo."Ngesikhathi evele phambi kwekomiti lasePhalamende elibhekelele ukusebenza komnyango, wanqaba ukusinikeza isivumelwano sokuboleka imali. Manje sekuvela izinsolo zokuthi isivumelwano sasayinwa emva kokuthi imali eseyibolekile ukuze kubukeke sengathi le nto ababeyenza yayisemthethweni.”UTrollip uthe banqume ukuvula icala emaphoyiseni ngenxa yokuthi kubukeka sengathi uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, uSomlomo wePhalamende, uNkk Thoko Didiza, noMvikeli woMphakathi, u-Advocate Kholeka Gcaleka, bahudula izinyawo ngokuthathela uNksz Simelane izinyathelo ezifanele."Ngenxa yobucayi bezinsolo uNksz Simelane abekwa zona kanye nomthelela omubi ongaba khona uma eqhubeka nokuhlala esikhundleni, sibona kufanele athathelwe izinyathelo. Sinxusa uRamaphosa ukuba amise uNksz Simelane kuze kuphothulwe noma iluphi uphenyo ngaye. Siphinde sicele naye uNksz Simelane ukuba ashenxe esikhundleni ukuvikela isithunzi sehhovisi aliphethe.”I-ANC ibingakasithathi isinqumo ngekusasa likaNksz Simelane.Umhlangano wesigungu esiphezulu ozokuba kule nyanga kulindeleke ukuthi ubhunge ngombiko wekomiti lezobuqotho eliphakamisa ukuthi abashenxe noma cha abaholi be-ANC abasolwa ngenkohlakalo.
ICEBO lokufihlwa kwesibhamu okwasocongwa ngaso unobhala wegatsha le-ANC KwaNdengezi, kusolakala ukuthi lenziwa ejele laseWestville, ngesikhathi indodana ivakashele uyise ongumbulali.Uqweqwe lukamshushisi, u-Advocate Lawrence Gcaba, ubekade ehloma ngemibuzo ufakazi ongummangalelwa wesihlanu, uMnuz Lindokuhle Mbonambi.UMbonambi, uyise uFelokwakhe Ndlovu nowakwakhe uNkk Sibongile Ndlovu (usingamama kaMbonambi) basolwa ngokugwazela ababengamaphoyisa, oMnuz Bonginkosi Dlamini noKhephu Ndlovu, ukuze kulahleke ubufakazi.Bobahlanu bagqigqa iNkantolo yesiFunda yasePinetown, ecaleni eliqalwe ukuqulwa ngo-2021.Bathweswe icala lokuphazamisa ukusebenza kwengalo yomthetho nelokugwazela amaphoyisa ngo-R120 000 ukuze kulahleke ubufakazi ecaleni lango-2018, lokubulawa kukaMnuz Thulani Nxumalo.Lelo cala ligcine ligojele uFelokwakhe owayeyinduna endaweni eduze naKwaNdengezi, wagwetshwa udilikajele.NgoLwesibili, uGcaba uphice ngemibuzo uMbonambi, wamtshela ukuthi ubufakazi obusenkantolo buveza ukuthi isibhamu esabulala uNxumalo sanikwa yena nguyise uFelokwakhe.Kuvele ukuthi leso sibhamu sadluliselwa kuMnuz Sphephelo Ndlovu ukuba asifihle emveni kokuthi amaphoyisa eyeseke afika ezosifuna kuMbonambi angasithola.UMbuso uveze ukuthi uMbonambi wavakashela uyise ejele wamazisa ngobekufunwa amaphoyisa, emva kwalokho isibhamu sanikezwa uNdlovu sagcina sitholakala kuyena, zamkhalela.Eseboshiwe uSphephelo, kuvele ukuthi wagqunywa esitokisini esisodwa noFelokwakhe ejele laseWestville."USphephelo watshela inkantolo ukuthi wabuzwa ummangalelwa wesithathu (uFelokwakhe) ejele ukuthi utheni emaphoyiseni ngesikhathi etholwa nesibhamu. Waphendula wathi wamtshela ukuthi isibhamu ngesakhe (uSphephelo), ummangalelwa wesithathu wathi 'ibambe kanjalo ke” kusho uGcaba.USphephelo waboshwa wase eyadedelwa waphenduka ufakazi woMbuso, kwagcina kuboshwe uMbonambi ongaphandle ngebheyili.UMbonambi utshele uGcaba uyakweshwama ukuthi wadayisa ngoSphephelo ngoba evikela uyise ngokufihla isibhamu.Uthe wayengamvikela kanjani uyise umuntu okwakujwayelekile ukuthi aboshwe aphinde adedelwe?Uthe uyakweshwama ukuthi wanika isibhamu uSphephelo ukuba asifihle ngoba akazani nasibhamu yena.Icala lihlehlele uDisemba, nonyaka, ukuze uMbuso nabameli benze izethulo zokugcina ngaphambi kokuthi imantshi uMuntukayise Khumalo, ikhiphe isinqumo.Enkantolo bekukhona abantu abebezokweseka abamangalelwa abebebukeka bezikhululekele.
UPHELE sekumuncu umcimbi womndeni wakwaChiliza obungempelasonto, KwaMgayi, eMthwalume, abomndeni bejuqwa yizisu kwaze kwagcina sekushona abesilisa abathathu.Kuvela ukuthi abekade edle inyama yenkomo ebihlatshwe ngayizolo.Umcimbi kuthiwa ubuhanjelwe omakhelwane namalungu omphakathi futhi kujatshulwe.Injabulo kuthiwa igcine seyiphenduka izinyembezi ngesikhathi amalungu alo mndeni ayisishiyagalombili ezibhonqa, ekhala ngokujuqwa yizisu aze ephuthunyiswa esibhedlela.Omunye obeyisimenywa emcimbini, uthe abathathu bashonele esibhedlela saseScottburgh, ngemuva kwesikhashana kade bengenisiwe. Abahlanu kuthiwa basesimweni esibi esibhedlela. "Bekungakapheli nesikhathi esingakanani beqeda kudla inyama yenkomo, bakhala ngokujuqwa yizisu bonke emndenini. Sonke simane saxakeka ukuthi kwenzakalani ngoba nathi siyidlile kodwa besingaguli,'' echaza.Namanje uthe basamangele ukuthi kwenzakaleni ngenyama egcine igulisa amalungu omndeni kuphela."Namanje sisamangele ngento esiyibone yenzeka. Siyazibuza siyaziphendula ukuthi ngabe kwenzakaleni.'' Uveze ukuthi zimapeketwane izinto kulo mndeni ngenxa yalesi sigameko."Kukhona olunye uhlangothi lomndeni olusola sengathi kukhona okushaya amanzi ngalesi sehlo. Lukholwa ukuthi cishe umhlola usekhaya,'' echaza.Omunye wabaholi bakule ndawo ocele ukuba kugodlwe igama lakhe, uthe uzwile ngesigameko."Ngizwile ngale nto okhuluma ngayo. Ngithole nokuthi abaphuthunyiswe esibhedlela bebephuma igazi nangamakhala,'' usho kanje.Isehlakalo kuthiwa siyindaba egudwini kumalungu omphakathi akule ndawo njengoba wonke ebuzana ukuthi kwenziwe yini ukuthi izisu zijuqe kuphela amalungu omndeni.Ikhansela lakule ndawo, uMnuz Sebelo Zuke, lithe lizwile ukuthi kunabantu abagcine beshonile ngemuva kokuba bedle inyama yenkomo yomcimbi."Ngitholile ukuthi kugcine kuphuma izidumbu ngemuva kokuba labo bantu kade bedle inyama yenkomo yomcimbi obukhona ngempelasonto. Kodwa angazi kahle ukuthi bekungumcimbi wani,'' lisho kanjena.Lithe likhathazekile kakhulu ngalesi simo esivelile endaweni.Owomndeni okhulume neSolezwe obezwakala ekhala ongakwazanga ukusho igama lakhe, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi kuphume izidumbu."Bathathu abantu abasashonile okwamanje. Sikhathazekile kakhulu ngoba asazi ukuthi le nyama ibifakwe ini,'' usho kanje.Uveze ukuthi isimo sibi nakulaba abalaliswe esibhedlela.
KUSENZIMA namanje ezinganeni zowesifazane owagwazwa wabulawa owesilisa owayeyisoka lakhe enxanxatheleni yezitolo iGateway, eThekwini ngasekuqaleni kuka-Agasti.Lokhu kuvezwe umalume kamufi, uMnuz Prince Dlamini ngoLwesibili ngesikhathi umsolwa, uMnuz Siphamandla Khumalo (34) evele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini.Umufi, uNksz Nomfundo Msibi (30) kuthiwa wagwazwa uKhumalo ephindelela ngo-Agasti 4 emva kokumdoba nge-lay-by yejakhethi ayethe akeze azomkhiphela yona.UDlamini uthe indodana (4) kamufi ayithola kumsolwa ihlale ibuza ukuthi uphi unina."Njalo sihlale siyikhohlisa sithi unina useThekwini ngoba asazi sizoyichazela kanjani ukuthi ngeke iphinde imbone ngoba washona,” kusho uDlamini.Uthe indodakazi (10) esikwazi ukuqonda ukuthi kwenzekani, ihlale ikhala, ithi iyamkhumbula unina.UDlamini uthe kwabona bebadala emndenini basakuthola kunzima ukwamukela ukuthi umufi akasekho.Uthe akamangalanga ngesikhathi ebona umsolwa okokuqala enkantolo, wathi wambona ewusikhotheni, okumfanele ukuthi enzakalise umufi."Uma umbuka nje, uyambona ukuthi usikhotheni lona. Ngathi ngimbona okokuqala, ngasho ngathi kodwa nomshana wami naye uyaqoma kodwa. Usikhotheni phela lona,” kusho uDlamini.UMUFI uNksz Nomfundo Msibi Isithombe: SITHUNYELWEUthe ukhona umuntu othi uma umbuka uthi lento ayimfanele, uze uzibuze ukuthi ngabe bekwenzakaleni.Ukhale ngokuthi elokufa alitsheli ngoba ukube babazi, babengeke bamvumele umufi ukuthi aye ukuyokhipha leyo lay-by."Ngikhumbula udadewethu emtshela umsolwa ocingweni ukuthi, 'kungabi ukuthi uyobulala ingane njalo’ njengoba ayethi ayiye enxanxatheleni yezitolo,” kusho uDlamini.Uthe umsolwa wakuqinisekisa kudadewabo ukuthi ngeke enze lutho, waze wathi uzothumela umfowabo ayomthathela ijakhethi ngoba yena uya emsebenzini."Yathi iyafika ingane, yathola ukuthi naye ukhona. Yathi uma isithi iyogibela, wayikhiphela uhalakasha wommese, wayigwaza wayibulala,” kusho uDlamini.Uthe abakulindele ukuthi umthetho udlale indima yawo ngoba umsolwa kusobala ukuthi wayekuhlelile ukubulala umufi njengoba waze wamphathela nommese ayezomgwaza ngawo."Siyazi ngeke esabuya umshana kodwa uma engagwetshwa udilikajele, nathi singagezeka izinhliziyo, sazi ukuthi ngobuhlungu asizwisa bona, naye uyabuzwa esedonsa isigwebo ngaphakathi,” kusho uDlamini.IMantshi uMnuz Ashwin Singh ilihlehlisele uNovemba 13 icala, yathi kusazoqhubeka uphenyo.Ngaphambi kokuthi uSingh ahlehlise cala, umshushisi uMnuz Calvin Govender uveze ukuthi ophenyweni lwamaphoyisa kusashoda imiphumela yokuhlolwa kwesidumbu.Uphinde wadalula nokuthi kusashoda ukuthi kugezwe izithombe kwi-footage eyalethwa abenxanxathela yezitolo, ekhombisa ukusuka nokuhlala kokwenzeka kwesigameko njengoba kwaqoshwa amakhamera.Ngesikhathi evela enkantolo umsolwa ubelokhu ebeke isandla esihlathini.Ngesikhathi umufi ebulawa, kwase kuphele izinyanga ezimbalwa emalile umsolwa, emsola ngokuba nodlame, kulandela ukumshaya.Kuvela ukuthi umsolwa wayengayizwa eyokwaliwa njengoba ayehamba emcinga umufi lapho ayesehlala khona, nokwathi uma engasamtholi, waphoqa ukuthi ayomkhiphela ijakhethi yakhe ayekade esebenzise umazisi wakhe ukuyi-lay-by.
Ashaye ungqimphothwe sekumele agwetshwe amadoda amane avele axalaza ummeli wawo, afuna ukumelwa omunye wamahhala ecaleni alahlwe ngalo lokuthumba nokubulala ngesihluku u-Andile "Bobo” Mbuthu (16).U-ANDILE Bobo Mbuthu owashaywa washona esolwa ngokweba utshwala eMagagula Lounge, eHambanathi, ngo-2020 Isithombe: SigciniweLokhu kuqale ngokuthi ummeli wala madoda, uMnuz Chris Gounden, engafiki eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseVerulam, ngoLwesithathu, wabanjelwa uzakwabo.Uzakwabo utshele imantshi uSanele Hlatshwayo ukuthi useyahoxa ecaleni uGounden ngoba sebeyinkukhu nempakha nalawa madoda okungo-Andile Nhleko, Mncedisi Mzobe, Lindani Ndlovu noMalusi Mthembu.Imantshi ibe isibuza indoda ngayinye kulawa amane alahlwe ngamacala ukuthi kuyiqiniso yini lokhu ekuzwa ngezindlebe zayo?Nebala avumele phezulu, athi uGounden uwaholele oPhathe manje asefuna ummeli wamahhala.Bavele badangala abantu akade bezokweseka umndeni kaBobo abebesola ukuthi lena ngenye yezindlela zokubambezela ukuphothulwa kwecala.Enkantolo bekukhona nebhungu uHlatshwayo okuthiwa ubufakazi buliveza njengomuntu owabamba iqhaza elikhulu ekuthunjweni nasebulaweni kukamufi ngesihluku.Le ndoda yaba wufakazi woMbuso, bekulindeleke ibeke izizathu zokuthi kungani yona kungamele ishushiswe.UBobo washaywa washona esolwa ngokweba utshwala endaweni yobumnandi eyangqongqiswa wumphakathi eMagagula Lounge, eHambanathi, oThongathi, ngo-2020.
INTSHA evela emathempelini ebandla laManazaretha (KwaShembe) iye eNkosini uMduduzi "Nyazilwezulu” Shembe, eBuhleni yayocela isibusiso ukuze isungule isikhwama ehlose ngaso ukufukula amalungu ebandla adonsa kanzima.Ngalesi sikhwama le ntsha ihlose ukuqala izinhlelo zokuzisebenza futhi idale imisebenzi ezofukula abantu ngomnotho ngaphakathi esontweni kuhlomule abaswele.Bafuna nokuthi kulekeleleke intsha ithole imali ingene ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme nokunye.UMnuz Zibonele Ngcobo waseNdwedwe ungelinye lamalungu asesigungwini sentsha asophe ukuqala lesi sikhwama.Uveze ukuthi isonto lizohlonishwa umhlaba wonke uma sekuthela izithelo abahlose ukukwenza osekufike isikhathi sokuba bakuqale."Kumele silethe ushintsho oluzoba yingqophamlando. Okuzosilekelela ukuthi sisungule isikhwama sebandla lapho nabaxhasi bezonikela khona bese sethula izinhlelo zemfundo, ezemidlalo, imifelandawonye nokucijwa kwabantu ngamakhono emisebenzi nezolimo,” kusho uNgcobo.Uveze ukuthi baningi abantu abanamakhono esontweni kodwa abakwazi ukuwaveza ngoba kabanalo utho.ngeSonto, intsha iye eBuhleni yafike yanikela yase icela kuShembe ukuthi lo msebenzi ube yimpumeleloUdaba lubikelwe umfundisi ebandleni obe eseya kolwethula enkosini uNyazi.Intsha ithe baningi osomabhizinisi abakhona ebandleni abangafaka isandla ukuze kusizwe abaswele. Igama lesikhwama bathe bazocela enkosini kube iyona ebabusisa ngalo futhi libe nomlando wesonto.Okhulumela ibandla lakwaShembe eBuhleni, uMnuz Thokozani Mncwabe, uncome intsha wathi kabanakiwe abafelokazi, izintandane nentsha esezikoleni.UMncwabe uthe intsha ihamba emazwini oNyazi oluhlale lugquguquzela ukuthi ibandla alisizane."Siyakubonga okuqhamuka nentsha kuhle. Kuke kushone iNazaretha uthole ukuthi alinamali sehle senyuka sicele iminikelo kubantu bangaphandle beze babuze ukuthi 'leli bandla elingaka, yini eyenza lihlulwe ukusiza iNazaretha?’” kusho uMncwabe.Ubonge intsha wathi kodwa uyazi ukuthi luzongena unyawo lwemfene ludunge lolu hlelo okuzokwenziwa abantu athe bathanda imali esontweni."KunamaNazaretha axakekile kodwa awasizakali ngalutho. UNkulunkulu sengathi angayisimamisa intsha kungabi khona idimoni lalabo abathatha imali ngoba uma ike yangenwa ibona, okuzanywa yintsha kuyobe kuphelile,” kusho uMncwabe.
I-DA igxeka isinqumo sokuncishiswa kwamanzi ezindaweni ezikuMasipala waseThekwini.I-DA ithe ukuncishiswa kwamanzi eThekwini kuzophazamisa impilo yezakhamizi zakulo mkhandlu dolobha.Isinqumo sokuncishiswa kwamanzi simenyezelwe imeya yomkhandlu, uMnuz Cyril Xaba, ngesikhathi ikhuluma emhlanganweni womkhandlu, obuyizolo.UXaba uthe ukusetshenziswa kakhulu kwamanzi eThekwini okuholele ekutheni bathathe isinqumo sokuwanciphisa."Sihlezi sizikhalela kubantu, sikhala ngokuthi amanzi asetshenziswayo angaphezulu kwalawo esiwatholayo. Okudala lokhu ukuthi baningi kakhulu abantu abafudukela edolobheni lethu, kuphinde kube nenkinga yengqalasizinda endala. Le ngqalasizinda yenza ukuthi amapayipi avuze, silahlekelwe amanzi amaningi.”ITheku lithola amanzi enhlanganweni Umgeni-Thukela Water.UXaba uthe amanzi abawathenga eMgeni-Thukela Water kufanele anciphe ngo-8.4% ukuze Umgeni-Thukela Water uhlangabezane nombandela welayisensi yawo."Kungakho uMnyango wezaManzi unqume ukuthi kuncishiswe amanzi.”UXaba uthe ukuncishiswa kwamanzi kuzoqala ngo-Okthoba 10, kuzokwenzeka kuze kuphele izinyanga eziwu-12."Sifisa ukusho ukuthi sizame konke okusemandleni ukuvimba ukuncishiswa kwamanzi. Sizamile ukubhalela umnyango siwucela ukuthi umise kancane uhlelo lokuncishiswa kwamanzi ukuze siqale uhlelo lokubhekana nesibalo esiphezulu samanzi asilahlekelayo, kodwa ke sikulesi simo esibhekene naso manje.”UXaba uthe bazoqhamuka nezinhlelo zokunciphisa amanzi alahlekela umkhandlu.Ikhansela leDA, uNksz Yogis Govender, lithe abantu baseThekwini bafela izono abangazazi.UNksz Govender uthe sekunesikhathi eside umkhandlu uhluleka ukunciphisa umthamo wamanzi ophelela enhlabathini."Uphiko lwezamanzi luhlezi lwenza izethembiso zokulungisa le nkinga. Lolu phiko selusebenzise izigidi zamaRandi luzama ukulwa nale nkinga, kodwa namhlanje silapha."Iqiniso ukuthi uphiko lwezamanzi luhlulekile ukulungisa inkinga. Manje bonke abantu baseThekwini sebezoncishiselwa amanzi. Abantu sekufanele bathembele ezimotweni zamanzi."UNksz Govender uthe ukuncishiswa kwamanzi kungase kuphazamise nokuthuthwa kwendle.UNksz Govender uthe ziningi iziphakamiso zokuxazulula inkinga yamanzi abazenzile, wakhala ngokuthi zonke zashaywa indiva.Uyalele umkhandlu ukuba uqhamuke nezinhlelo zokulungisa le nkinga ngokushesha.
UKUBAMBEZELEKA kokuphothulwa kwesikole samabanga aphansi, saseNtuzuma, iFaith Mlaba, iminyaka ewu-22 kugxekwe nguMphathiswa wezeMisebenzi yoMphakathi neNgqalasizinda, uMnuz Martin Meyer.UMeyer ubekade ehambele kulesi sikole njengoba sekuyela ngasemaphethelweni ukwakhiwa kwaso.Kuvele ukuthi sekukaningi kuvinjwa ukwakhiwa kwaso. Ezinye zezizathu okuvele ukuthi bezibangela ukuvinjwa kokuqedelwa kokwakhiwa kwaso umbango womhlaba okusona, ukungakhokhelwa kwababasebenzi nokunye okuningi.UMeyer uthembise ukuthi umnyango wakhe uzokwenza konke okusemandleni ngenhloso yokuvimba konke okuthikameza imisebenzi yokwakhiwa kwezikole KwaZulu-Natal."Kubi ukuthi kungathatha isikhathi eside kangaka ukuphothulwa kwesikole. Lokhu kulimaza umphakathi, kungagcini lapho kulimaza kakhulu nabantu abasha bakule ndawo,'' usho kanjena.Uthe kumhlaba umxhwele ukuthi ekugcineni lesi sikole sesize saphothulwa.Wancoma zonke izinhlaka ezahlukene okuyizona ezingenelelile ukuze kugcine kuxazululeka izinkinga ezahlukene ebese zibambezele ukuphothulwa kwaso iminyaka yaze yaba miningi kangaka.Uthe angeke bakubekezelele nhlobo ukuphazanyiswa kokukwakhiwa kwezikole ngoba lokho kusho ukuphazanyiswa kwekusasa lezingane.Lesi sikole sizokuba namagumbi okufundela awu-15. UMnuz Sipho Khathi onguthishanhloko waso, uthe bese kuqala ukubakhathaza kakhulu ukubambezeleka kokuphuthulwa kwaso."Mina angikaze ngiyibone into enjengalena ukuthi kungaphela iminyaka eminingi kangaka isikole singaphothulwa ukwakhiwa,'' usho kanjena.Uthe bayabonga ukuthi ekugcineni sekuze kwalunga. Uveze ukuthi yonke le minyaka abafundi bebefundela esikoleni esisesimweni esingagculisi.UMeyer uvele usembhidlangweni wokuhambela zonke izikole ezibhekene nengwadla yokubambezeleka kokwakhiwa kwazo. Muva nje, kade evakashele eMenzi High, eMlaza.UNkk Faith Mlaba okuqanjwe ngaye lesi sikole, uthe inhliziyo yakhe igcwele ukuthokoza okukhulu ngokuthi isikole esiqanjwe ngaye sesize saphothulwa.
UMNDENI awanelisekile ngesigwebo esinikezwe owayeyiphoyisa, uMthokozisi Nene, ogwetshwe ngecala lokubulala unkosikazi owayenguthisa, uNkk Thobeka Nene.Udadewabo kaNkk Nene, uNksz Halala Msomi, uthe sincane isigwebo esinikwe uNene uma kubhekwa icala agwetshwe ngalo.UNene ugwetshwe iminyaka engu-25 ebhadla ejele.Isigwebo sakhe sethulwe iJaji Simon Hadebe, eNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu, ngoMsombuluko.UNene wadubula wabulala uNkk Nene ngo-2022 emva kwengxabano eyenzeka emzini wabo oseNtshanga.Ingxabano kuthiwa yasuswa ukuthi uNene wafika nentombi emzini wabo.UNksz Msomi uthe uNene ufanelwe isigwebo esingaphezu kwalesi asitholile."Wadubula umuntu wesifazane, walimala waphela ebusweni. Lo muntu wenza isihluku esinjena ekubeni eyiphoyisa.”UNksz Msomi uthe okubacasula kakhulu ukuthi uNene ucele ukusiphonsela inselelo isigwebo sakhe.Isicelo usifake emva kokwethulwa kwesigwebo sakhe.UNksz Msomi uthe uNene ukhombisa ukungazisoli."Njengoba engafuni ukuyodonsa iminyaka engu-25, ufuna ukudonsa iminyaka emingaki? Ufuna ukudonsa iminyaka eyishumi? Usemncane kabi lo muntu, akadonse iminyaka yakhe ewu-25, bese eyaqhubeka nempilo.”Inkantolo ibigcwele phama ngesikhathi kwethulwa isigwebo.Abebezolalela icala bebelokhu betinyela uNene ngamazwi uma inkantolo isaguqile.Unina kaNkk Nene, uNkk Thandekile Msomi, uphume enkantolo esebanjiwe ngesikhathi kuqhubeka ukwethulwa kwesigwebo.UNksz Msomi uthe ukubulawa kukadadewabo kumhlukumezile uNkk Msomi.UNksz Msomi uthe unina osebheke izingane zikaNkk Nene ezimbili.Uthe nazo izingane zikaNkk Nene zihlukumezekile."Azenzi kahle esikoleni. Lona ofunda ibanga lesibili sebeze basitshela esikoleni ukuthi asimkhiphe ngoba simosha imali yethu. Nalona omunye bathi akhona amathuba okuthi angaphumeleli.”Ethula isigwebo, uHadebe uthe uNene akazange akhombise ukuzisola ngesikhathi kuqhubeka icala njengoba ayelokhu emile kwelokuthi umsulwa.UHadebe uthe uNkk Nene wabulawa ngesihluku, wathi isigwebo senkantolo sizothumela umyalezo oshubile ikakhulukazi njengoba isihlava sokubulawa kwabesifazane sibhebhetheka kuleli."Wadubula umufi ebusweni, eseduze. Umufi wabulawa ngesihluku, ummangalelwa akanandaba nempilo yomunye umuntu. Kubuhlungu ukuthi wabulala unkosikazi wakho kabuhlungu kanjena wangabe usacabangela nezingane zenu. Ummangalelwa unesihluku. Njengephoyisa uyena okufanele engabe uvikela umkakhe kanye nomphakathi wonke jikelele.”UHadebe uthe kunofakazi abaveze ukuthi uNene ubehlukumeza unkosikazi wakhe nangaphambi kwesigameko njengoba izingane zabo ezimbili bese zihlala komalume.Ngo-2019, uNkk Nene wafaka isicelo sesihlukaniso kodwa baqhubeka bahlala ndawonye.Ummeli kaNene, u-Advocate Shane Matthews, uthe enye inkantolo ingamnika isigwebo esincane uNene.UMatthews uthe kunobufakazi obungashayi khona okwakufanele ukuthi inkantolo ingabumukeli.Uthe ubufakazi bukaMnuz Nxumalo, owathi ungumakhelwane, kwakufanele buchithwe ngoba kwavela ukuthi akakhelene kakhulu nomuzi kaNene.Uthe nobufakazi bukaNksz Nothile Dladla kwakufanele buchithwe ngoba akazange abone kudutshulwa umufi, wezwa ukuqhuma kwesibhamu.Kepha umshushisi, u-Advocate Lauren Marias-Myeni, uthe awekho amathuba okuthi uNene anganikwa isigwebo esingaphansi kwalesi asinikiwe.Inkantolo izonquma ngoDisemba 13 nonyaka ngalesi sicelo.
Kuqopheke umlando uMasipala wesifunda uMzinyathi usayina isivumelwano sokuthi ushintshe igama ungabe usabizwa ngoMzinyathi kodwa ubizwe ngokuthi iPrince Mangosuthu District Municipality.Le ngqophamlando yenzeke KwaPhindangene eMahlabathini ngoLwesibili lapho ubuholi bukaMasipala, amakhansela namakhosi buphume ngobuningi kuzosekwa lo mbono.Umasipala uMzinyathi uqale izingxoxo zokushintshwa igama ngo-2020 kodwa ukuqhutshwa kwazo kwaphazamiseka ngenxa yokubheduka kweCovid 19. UMntwana waKwaPhindangene ukhothame sezifikile kuye lezi zindaba. Inkosi yaKwaButhelezi esesihlalweni uNtuthukoyezwe Zuzifa kaMangosuthu Buthelezi ithe bewumndeni bayavuma ukuba uMzinyathi ungaqhubeka nalezi zinhlelo."Sithobeke kakhulu ukuba beze lapha ekhaya siluxoxe udaba yize sebake bayithumela incwadi phambilini. Yize siye sakuveza kubona ukuthi uMntwana wayengayithandisisi into yokuthi ahlonishwe ngenxa yepolitiki abanye belwisana nalokhu kanti phela abantu bebemhlonipha ngokweqiniso bebona imisebenzi yakhe. IMangosuthu University of Technology yakwenza lokhu kwaqanjwa neminye yemigwaqo ngaye. Bekusanda kufika abanye nje lapha ekhaya beqembu lezithuthuthu befisa ukubiza iqembu labo ngoMtwana," kubeka iNkosi.IMeya yoMzinyathi uMnuz Petros Ngubane uthe uMntwana kuningi akwezele isizwe, akwenze eMzinyathi."Sibe sesihlala siwumkhandlu woMzinyathi savumelana nokuthi ahlonishwe. Sijabulile siswele imilomo yokubonga emndenini kusuka manje siyaqhubeka nezinhlelo silandela yonke imigudu efanele. UMntwana imisebenzi yakhe iyomhlala imlandela noma esesithele kithi eMzinyathi kakukho abengasiseki uma sikwenza sivula amanzi ubebakhona, kwiPrince Mangosuthu Ultra Marathon eba khona yonke iminyaka esiseka. Ukumhlonipha yinto ekade sasiyifisile siyabonga ukuthi umndeni namhlanje uthi masiqhubeke wenziwe lo msebenzi," kusho uNgubane.
UYAVEVA umlimi osola uMasipala wesiFunda iZululand ngokugweva ukumkhokhela imali yezinkomo umkhandlu owayikhipha ngesikhathi kugcotshwa inkosi yaseMbongobongweni, uMzamo Buthelezi, nowakhalisa ngayo umndeni wenkosi yakwaMpungose oLundi ngesikhathi kushona indodana yenkosi. UMnuz Siphiwe Sithole uthe sekuphele isikhathi eside umasipala ungafuni ukumkhokhela imali yalezi zinkomo.USithole uthe wahlinzeka umasipala ngenkomazi ngesikhathi kugcotshwa uButhelezi, waphinde wenza okufanayo nangesikhathi umasipala uyokhalisa inkosi yakwaMpungose.Uthe sezihlangene lezinkomo zibiza u-R42 000.USithole uthe usegqigqe emahhovisi omkhandlu waze wakhathala."Uma ngiya khona ngifike ngiyiswe le, nale. Okubuhlungu ukuthi bona bayahola, mina angikhokhelwa. Njengoba kukade kuwumhlaka-25 nje, bona baholile, mina angitholanga lutho. Bona bayaqhubeka nezimpilo zabo, mina ngilinde ukukhokhelwa imali yami.”Umcimbi wokugcotshwa kwenkosi yaseMbongobongweni wawuhanjelwe nayiSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini kanye nezikhulu zikahulumeni.USithole uthe okumcasulayo ukuthi umasipala wafike wanconywa ngokuletha inkomo ongasafuni manje ukuyikhokhela."Angithi babefuna ukuyobukwa, manje ke abasafuni ke ukukhokha.”USithole uthe ukungakhokhelwa kwalezi zinkomo kuphazamisa ibhizinisi lakhe.Uthe uziphilisa ngokuthenga izinkomo ezindalini eDundee, Newcastle, Mooi-River, naseVryheid."Ngiyaye ngizithathe lezi zinkomo, ngizozidayisa lapha oLundi. Uyacabanga ukuthi ngabe yimalini esengiyenzile ngalo-R42 000 abangafuni ukungikhokhela wona kulezi zinyanga ezine? Kubuhlungu ngoba sicindezelwa yiwo umkhandlu singabantu abamnyama. Uma beyothenga emabhunwini, bafike bakhokhe ngaso leso sikhathi, kuthina bantu abamnyama abakhokhi.”USithole uthe nasekhaya impilo ayihambi kahle."Izingane zami azikhokhile ezikoleni. Kukhona efunda eMooi River. Njengoba kuzovulwa izikole nje kuthiwe ingabuyi ingakhokhile. Angazi ukuthi kufanele ngenze njani manje.”USithole uthe akasafuni ukuphinde asebenzisane nalo mkhandlu."Into nje engiyifunayo ukuthi bangikhokhele imali yami bese ngiyaphuma kubona.”Umasipala uthe uSithole uzokhokhelwa maduze, wathi empeleni kufanele engabe kade akhokhelwa.Ngokwempendulo, umasipala uthe inkinga idalwe ukuthi uSithole washintsha imininingwane yasebhange ngesikhathi uhlela ukumkhokhela."Saxoxa naye izikhathi eziningi, elokhu ephika ukuthi ushintshe imininingwane. Besilokhu simncenga ukuthi akalethe okukhombisa ukuthi useshintshe imininingwane yasebhange. Useze wakuletha konke, imali yakhe uzoyithola maduze."
BAKHOLWA ukuthi kuzokwenza omkhulu umehluko kwezokuphepha eMpendle ukuvulwa kwehhovisi lamaphoyisa omgwaqo nokudluliswa kwezimoto zokusebenza.Lokhu kushiwo yiMeya yalo masipala, uMnuz Buyisani Mlaba ngoMsombuluko ngesikhathi kunomcimbi wokwethula ihhovisi nezimoto.UMlaba uthe bese siside isikhathi lingekho leli hhovisi kulo masipala."Kusuka ngo-2021, ngaqala umsebenzi wokuthi kwakhiwe leli hhovisi njengoba lo msebenzi sesiwuphetha manje," kusho uMlaba.Uthe bekuba nzima uma kunezinkinga ezehlukene ezidinga isandla sephoyisa lomgwaqo.Uthe umsebenzi olandelayo owokuthi kube nesikhungo sokuhlolela amalayisensi okushayela ukuze izakhamuzi ziphumule ejokeni lokuhamba ibanga elide, ziya eMgungundlovu ziyozenza.AMAPHOYISA omgwaqo eviliyela ngesikhathi kuvulwa ihhovisi lamaphoyisa omgwaqo eMpendle Isithombe: SITHUNYELWE Uthe okwamanje isikhungo sizoqala ukusebenza ngamaphoyisa amane, bese kuthi maduzane, kuqashwe amanye athe xaxa. Zintathu izimoto zamaphoyisa ezinikelwe uMphathiswa wezokuThutha esifundazweni, uMnuz Siboniso Duma.UMnuz Mawo Khumalo wemboni yezokuthutha endaweni, obekhona emcimbini, uthe bayakujabulela ukuvulwa kwaleli hhovisi nokulethwa kwamaphoyisa azosebenza kulo."Sizimisele ukusebenza ngokubambisa namaphoyisa futhi siyacela ukuthi ezinhlelweni zawo, angakhohlwa ukusifaka ukuze sibenzisane kahle," kusho uKhumalo.
UMPHAKATHI waseSection 6, eMadadeni, eNewcastle, uthi liphume nobomvu kubulawa ngesihluku ubhongoza weqembu lemigulukudu ezintatha zangeSonto.U-Asanda Dube oneminyaka elinganiselwa kwengu-19, kuthiwa abasolwa baqale bamxhifa ngesitini ngaphambi kokuba bamgwaze bambulale.Ilungu le-foramu elwa nobugebengu endaweni, Abaqondisi, elicele ukungadalulwa, lithe umsindo uqale ngesikhathi amalungu eqembu likamufi, iWest, eyohlasela abantu bakomunye umuzi endaweni."Kuthiwa bafike bashawa, kwacaca ukuthi bayahlulwa. Kuthiwa babone kungcono ukuthi bayovusa yena umufi elele, bembikela ngokuthi bayashawa,” kusho umthombo.Uqhube wathi, ngempela umufi uvuke wanikela khona kanti yilapho naye abese ezohlaselwa khona.Uthe umthombo ujabule umphakathi ngokubulawa kukamufi njengoba ebesewuhluphe isikhathi eside umphakathi."Umphakathi uphumule, bekuhlale kukhalwa lapho abehamba khona,” kusho umthombo.Uthe phambilini, umphakathi wake waya emndenini kamufi uyonxusa abazali ukuthi bamkhuze umufi ngokuwuhlukumeza kodwa kwanhlanga zimuka nomoya.Isihlobo sikamufi, uMnuz Surprise Dube ubhale ekhasini lakhe le-Facebook, ezwakalisa ukuthi babuhlungu ngokushonelwa yisihlobo."Ngenhliziyo ebuhlungu nangobuhlungu obungabekezeleleki, simemezela ukudlula ngesihluku kukamfowethu omncane. Ubulawe ngesihluku ezintatha zamanamuhla (esho ngeSonto),” kusho uDube.Uqhube wathi uyazi ukuthi kulabo abamaziyo nabakhula naye, izinhliziyo zabo zibuhlungu, wathi isibani sikamfowabo sicishwe singakafiki isikhathi kodwa imicabango ngaye nothando lwakhe ngeke lwedlule."Uyohlale esezinhliziyweni zethu,” kusho uDube, othe ingathi kungaba khona ubulungiswa.Isolezwe lisanda kubika ngamaqembu emigulukudu ahlalise lubhojozi umphakathi. Lapho imithombo iveze khona ukuthi Osizweni, maphakathi noSepthemba, abulala abantu abayisithupha.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa aseMadadeni aphenya icala lokubulala nelokuzama ukubulala kulandela isigameko lapho abesilisa begwazwe yiqulu labasolwa."Bobabili abagilwa ebebenamanxeba okugwazwa baphuthunyiswe esibhedlela lapho omunye efike washonela khona," kusho uNetshiunda othe okwamanje imbangela yokubulala ayikaziwa.
KUKHALWA ngesihluku okuthiwa sikhonjiswe yisoka ngesikhathi libhokoda owesifazane ebelithandana naye ngommese amahlandla angaphezulu kwayisikhombisa.Siyindaba egudwini kumalungu omphakathi waseNhlanhleni, eMakholweni, e-Underberg isenzo sesoka okuthiwa likhalelwe ngamasongo kaSigonyela njengoba lihlasele uthisha emqashweni, e-Underberg lamgwaza kubuka wonke umuntu.Uthisha uNksz Moshoeshoe (igama lakhe eingatholakalanga) kuvele ukuthi yena nomsolwa, baneminyaka engu-50.Umthombo obukhona ngesikhathi kwehla isehlo uveze ukuthi bazwakale bexabana ngaphakathi endlini.Kuthiwa bekuzwakaka ukuthi nemimoya iphezulu."Ngemuva kwesikhashana sibone owesifazane esephumela emnyango egijima ebaleka kodwa esegcwele igazi namandla okubaleka engasenawo. Isoka liqhubekile lamjaha lamfica laqhubeka lamgwaza esedindilize phansi,'' kuchaza umthombo.Ngemuva kwalokho owesilisa kuthiwa ugcwale amathafa kodwa ngenhlanhla amaphoyisa ashesha athola umkhondo wakhe wase ekhalelwa ngamasongo kaSigonyela.Uqhuba uthi laba ababili bese kunesikhathi eside bethandana.Kuvela ukuthi isoka belikujwayele ukufika emqashweni lizovakashela owesifazane.Kuthiwa akuqondakali ukuthi baxatshaniswe yini.Kuvela ukuthi uthisha akusiye owendawo njengoba eqashile nje. Kuthiwa ubefundisa esikoleni eNhlannhleni Combined.Elinye ilungu lomphakathi elizwakalise ukukhathazeka okukhulu ngalesi sehlakalo, lithe bayakweshwama abakubonile."Endaweni yakithi angikhumbuli nje sibona umuntu wesifazane ebulawa ngesihluku esingaka. Hheyi yaze yaba nesihluku nansi indoda. Futhi kusekude kabi ukuthi ngikukhohlwe engikubone namhlanje,'' lisho kanjena.Likhale ngokuthi kwale noma owesifazane esekhala kabuhlungu ememeza ecela uxolo kodwa owesilisa wavuka umbhejazane esho ukumqeda."Kubuhlungu kabi ukuthi angabulawa ngesihluku esingaka umuntu owusizo olungaka emphakathini wethu obefundisa izingane zethu ngokuthembeka nangesineke,'' kuqhuba ilungu lomphakathi.Kuvela ukuthi isoka lingumuntu owaziwa ngokuba yisixhwanguxhwangu.Kuthiwa kunabanye vele abebeshaya amakhala ngokuthandana kwabo bekhala ngokuthi owesifazane unomoya ophansi ekubeni isoka laziwa ngokuthanda ukulwa ngaso sonke isikhathi.Ikhansela laseNhlanhleni kuWard 2, uMnuz Basil Ntshiza, uthe bashaeke kakhulu ngokwenzekile.Uthe kule ndawo akakhumbuli kuba nesehlo salolu hlobo.Ugcizelele ukuthi abafisi ukuthi kuphinde kube nesehlakalo salolu hlobo ngokuzayo.Uthe babonga kakhulu amaphoyisa akulendawo asukume ngokushesha kwabanjwa umsolwa.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa abophe owesilisa oneminyaka engu-50 ngecala lokubulala owesifazane naye oneminyaka engu-50."Kubikwa ukuthi owesilisa ugwaze owesifazane amanxeba amaningi washonela khona lapho. Owesilisa uzovela enkantolo kusasa (namhlanje),'' usho kanjena.
KUQUBUKE umsindo emuva kokuvela kwezindaba zokuthi owayeyimeya yaseGoli, uDkt Mpho Phalatse, uhlukanise nobengumyeni wakhe uBrutus Malada, washada emuva kwezinyanga ezine ehlukanisile.Ngokubika kweSunday World, uPhalatse noMalada bekungakapheli neminyaka emibili beshadile.Kuthiwa manje ushade noMfundisi Gerald Nxumalo webandla iJubilee Global Ministries ngo-Agasti 31.UPhalatse (47) kuyahlaluka ukuthi akacucuzi ekuthatheni isinqumo ngomshado njengoba esedivose kabili. KUZOSUSA umthwalo emahlombe abashayeli bezimoto ukwehliswa kwentengo kaphethroli nekadizili ngemali engaphezu kukaR1 kusuka ngoLwesithathu.Ilitha likaphethroli i-93 unleaded lizokwehla ngoR1.06 cents, i-95 yehle ngoR1.14 cents.Kumenyezelwe nokwehla kwelitha kapharafini ngoR1.11 cents bese udizili wehla ngoR1.12 noR1.14 centsAbantu abathenga igesi bazofaka uchatha ka-23 cents emalini abathenga ngayo i-kilogram layo.Lokhu kusho ukuthi kusukela ngo-Okthoba 2, ilitha kaphethroli izobiza uR21.05 cents ekadizili ibe nguR18.45 cents ezifundazweni ezimaphakathi nezwe kubalwa neGauteng.Ezifundazweni ezigudle ugu, uphethroli uzobiza uR20.26 cents ilitha kuthi udizili ubize uR17.66 cents ilitha.Ukuqina kwamandla erandi uma liqhathaniswa nedollar lase-United States of America nokwehla kwentengo kaphethroli, udizili nopharafini emhlabeni ikhona okube nomthelela kulokhu kwehla.UMnuz Layton Beard we-Automobile Association, uthe kube yizindaba ezinhle kubashayeli ukwehla kwentengo osekuyihlandla lesihlanu kusukela kuqale unyaka."Lokhu kusho ukuthi sebezokhokha iimali encane kunalena abebeyikhokha ezinyangeni ezedlule. Wonke umuntu uzojabula ngalokhu kwehla,” kusho uBeard.Ngesonto eledlule uBeard uveze ukuthi ukwehla kwentengo kawoyela ongahluziwe emhlabeni kube nomthelela omkhulu kulokhu kwehla.I-AA ifuna uhulumeni ulwenze luvuleleke kuwona wonke umuntu uhlelo lokunyuswa kwentengo yezimbiwaphansi futhi ungazivaleli ngaphandle izinhlaka ezimqoka uma kuza kwezithinta uwoyela nentengo yawo.UMphathi wehhovisi lenhlangano yamatekisi iSantaco KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Sfiso Shangase, uthe kuyabajabulisa ukwehla kwentengo kaphethroli nodizili."Siphila ngomusa kaThixo (embonini yamatekisi) ngoba nakhu siyakwazi ukukhokha isikweletu semoto sondle imindeni yethu. Alusisizi ngokwenza inzuzo uhlelo esilusebenzisayo lokunyusa imali yokugibela ngoR1. Nakuba wehla uphethroli kodwa imali yokugibela itekisi ngeke yehle,” kusho uShangase.Uthe izindleko zokugcina itekisi lihamba emgwaqweni zimba eqolo .
IZIKHALO ngokuhanjiswa kwezidingo kubantu nemibhikisho yamalungu omphakathi ekhala ngokugqoza kwentuthuko, kuthiwa ngezinye zezimbangela eziholele ekutheni uMnyango wokuBusa ngokuBambisana neNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal umemezele umlekeleli kuMasipala Umdoni ngenhloso yokuwutakula.UMphathiswa walo mnyango uMfundisi Thulasizwe Buthelezi, kuthe izolo wamemezela uMnuz Dhanpalan Devaraj Naidoo njengomlekeleli, emva kokuthi kuthiwa isigungu esiphezulu kuhulumeni wesifundazwe sivumelene ngokuthi ufakwe ngaphansi kwesigaba somthetho u-154(1) woMthethosisekelo, olawula ukuthi kulekelelwe umasipala okubonakala ukhungethwe yizingqinamba.Ethula uNaidoo, uButhelezi umchaze njengonamava adingekayo njengoba ethe uneminyaka eyevile ku-30 esebenza komasipala okubalwa owesifunda Ugu noMdoni."Kuke kwaba nemibhikisho kulo masipala abantu bekhala ngokugqoza kwentuthuko, ukuntuleka kwamanzi, amaholo angefani kubasebenzi nokunye. Isigungu esiholwa wuNdunankulu uMnuz Thami Ntuli sithathe isinqumo sokuthi uhulumeni wesifundazwe ungenele kulo masipala ngaphansi kwesigaba somthetho 154 (1). U-Naidoo usemnkantshubomvu emsebenzini othinta omasipala ngakho amava akhe awangabazeki,” kusho uButhelezi.Uthe lo masipala ukwabahamba phambili kwezokuvakasha ngakho kumele uphathwe ngendlela kuphinde kuhanjiswe izidingo kubantu okuyilokho abatshalizimali abafuna ukukubona.Umasipala uphethwe yi-ANC okuthe ngokhetho lohulumeni basemakhaya ngo-2021, yathola izihlalo ezingu-18.UButhelezi obehambisana neMeya uNkk Mbali Cele-Luthuli, uthe ukungenela kwesigungu esiphezulu sikahulumeni wesifundazwe kwamukelwe ngezandla ezimhlophe yiwona wonke amaqembu.Kwenzeka lokhu nje ezinyangeni ezimbili ezedlule i-DA beyihlabe ikhwelo ifuna kufakwe lo masipala ngaphansi kweso lomlawuli, ngokwesigaba somthetho u-139(1)Phakathi kwezinto leli qembu ebelikhala ngazo, ukugqoza kokuhanjiswa kwezidingo nokungalungiswa kwengqalasizinda.Okhethweni lokuchibiyela ku-ward 15 kuwo lo masipala obelungenyanga edlule, i-DA iyibuyisile le ward njengoba yayinqobe ngo-2021.

KUBUYISE ithemba ukuphuma ngobuningi kwabantu besilisa beyohlolwa umdlavuza wamankwahla eMlazi Com-Tech, eMlaza, ngoMgqibelo.Lokhu kushiwo uSihlalo wePatients Affairs kwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Dumisa Pakkies, othe kubahlabe umxhwele ukuqhamuka kwabesilisa ezindaweni ezehlukene.UPakkies wasinda emva kokutholakala kwalo mdlavuza ngo-2020.Uthe ngokubambisana nenhlangano engenzi nzuzo, iProstate Cancer Foundation, bebelethe odokotela abaseqophelweni eliphezulu bezohlola abesilisa baphinde baxoxisane nabo ngokubaluleka kokunakekela isimo sabo sezempilo."Indoda kufanele ihlolwe. Siyabagqugquzela ukuthi bahlolwe unyaka nonyaka ngoba ngesikhathi umuntu eqala ebona izimpawu, umdlavuza usuke usuhambe ibanga elide, esemancane amathuba okuthi welapheke,” kusho uPakkies.Uthe ngokujwayelekile uma umuntu ezijwayeza ukuhlolwa unyaka nonyaka, uma enawo ubanjwa usasesigabeni sokuqala nesesibili bese kuba lula ukuthi welashwe.Uthe bagqugquzela ukuthi bonke abesilisa abaneminyaka engu-40 kuya phezulu, bazibandakanye nalokhu, wathi kulabo abanemindeni enomlando wawo, kufanele baqale ukuwuhlola okungenani uma beba neminyaka engu-35.UNKK Nelisiwe Mdlalose exoxela amadoda ngobunzima abhekana nabo emva kokushona komyeni wakhengomdlavuza wamankwahla ngoFebhuwari ngesikhathi kunomkhankaso wokugqugquzela amadoda ukuthi ahlolwe umdlavuza wamankwahla eMlazi Com-tech Isithombe: TUMI PAKKIES/ INDEPENDENT NEWSPAPERSUMnuz Dumisa Ngidi (59) waseMlaza ongomunye wabahloliwe, uthe ngokujwayelekile abantu besilisa abazwani nokunakekela impilo yabo."Imvamisa singamadoda asikhulumi. Sibhekana nezimo sodwa, singatsheli muntu. Imikhankaso efana nale iyasiza ngoba iyasifundisa ukuthi sivuleleke ukuze sithole ukwesekwa okwenele,” kusho Ngidi.UMnuz Sithembiso Cele (64) waseLamontville, uthe iningi labesilisa lesaba ukuthi uma umuntu esetholwe nomdlavuza kusuke sekuphelile ngaye."Sidinga imikhankaso efana nale ukuze sifunde okuningi, akuyiwe emphakathini, kukhulunywe ngomdlavuza emisakazweni nakumathelevishini, kugqugquzelwe ukuthi sihlole,” kusho uCele.
UMENGAMELI wezwe, uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa uqinise idolo imindeni yabantu abangu-18 ababulawe eNgobozana, eLusikisiki wathi amaphoyisa azobathola ababulali.Uphawule kanje izolo emuva kokuthi amaphoyisa ase-Eastern Cape ethe alandela umkhondo futhi anethemba lokuthi azobabopha maduze abasolwa.URamaphosa uzwakalise ukudabuka kwakhe, wadlulisa amazwi enduduzo emindenini eshonelwe wase ebafisela ukululama okusheshayo abagilwa abasindile.Kulokhu kuhlasela kwangempelasonto, ezigamekweni ezimbili, kushone abantu besifazane abangu-15. Usana olunezinyanga ezimbili lusindile lwatholwa lulele phezu kukanina obesebanda.Kuthiwa lugcinwe osonhlalakahle endaweni ephephile. Izolo izihlobo zabagilwa eziqhamuka ezindaweni ezikude zihlanze indawo yesigameko ebigcwele igazi."Ngeke sivumele ukuthi kugcine izigebengu. Sibuzwa sonke ubuhlungu obulethwe yilesi sehlo esinonya futhi sihlangene ekusibabazeni nasekugxekeni abenzi baso abazosijezela,” kusho umengameli.Umphakathi wakule ndawo uthe usuhlalele ovalweni ngoba seziphenduke insakavukela izigameko zokubulawa kwabantu kule ndawo kodwa okwakamuva kwenze kwabanda amathumbu.URamaphosa ubaqinise idolo wathi amaphoyisa ayasebenza futhi ayakwazi ukusombulula ngisho amacala obugebengu obuhleliwe futhi unethemba lokuthi azosithola isisombululo ngesigameko saseLusikisiki.Ube esenxenxa amalungu omphakathi wathi kumele akhululeke, aludlulisele kubaphenyi ulwazi analo olungalekelela ekutheni kuboshwe abahlaseli ukuze abe nobufakazi obuqanda icala enkantolo.Kulandwe nochwepheshe babaphenyi nabacubungula indawo yesigameko abavela kuzwelonke nasesifundazweni i-Eastern Cape ukuba baphenye.Ihhovisi likamengameli lithi ngaphandle kwesigameko sakamuva, bangu-38 abantu ababulawe ezehlakalweni ezifuze esaseLusikisiki esikhathini esiyiminyaka emibili, kwaboshwa abasolwa abangu-25.
SELULWE ngamasonto amabili isikhathi sokufakwa kwezicelo zoxhaso lokulekelelwa ngemali kwabalimi uMnyango wezoLimo KwaZulu-Natal.Lokhu kuvezwe uMphathiwa walo mnyango, uNkk Thembeni KaMadlopha-Mthethwa.Phambilini, umnyango wawuthe ukufakwa kwezicelo kuzovalwa namuhla, kodwa muva nje usuveze ukuthi sekuzovalwa ngo-Okthoba 15 ngo-4 ntambama.Amabhizinisi avumekele ukuthi afake izicelo ilawo asebenza kulesi sifundazwe, abhalise ngokusemthethweni ukuthi enza izinto ezithinta ezolimo.Lolu xhaso olonyakazimali ka-2025/2026.UNkk KaMadlopha-Mthethwa uthe ngalolu xhaso, umnyango wakhe uhlose ukuvula amathuba kwezolimo."Lokhu kuzosilekelela ekutheni siqinisekise ukuthi nathi siyisifundazwe siyayiklama eyethu indima ekutheni elakuleli lihlale linokudla okwenele,” kusho uNkk KaMadlopha-Mthethwa.Uthe akuzogcina nje ngalokhu kuphela kodwa kuzolekelela nasekudalekeni kwamathuba omsebenzi kuphinde kukhulise nomnotho njengoba behlela ukulekelela lawo mabhizinisi akhombisa intshisekelo yokwenza umehluko emnothweni.Uthe amabhizinisi afisa ukuhlomula kuzofanele ukuthi aqinisekise ukuthi ayayilandela yonke imigomo nemibandela ebekwe kwifomu yokungenela."Uxhaso lwehlukene kabili. Kukhona oluzofinyelela ku-R300 000 lwama-subsistence producers (abazikhiqizelayo). Bese kuba olungafinyelela ku-R2 million lwama-smallholder and commercial producers (abakhiqizela izitolo),” usho kanje.Uthe amafomu okungenela ayatholakala emahhovisi ezolimo komasipala abehlukene, wathi abuye atholakale nakwi-website yomnyango.Wathi labo abazofaka izicelo bavumelekile ukuyobuza ukuthi bawagcwalisa kanjani ngendlela efanele amafomu.Uthe kubalulekile ukuthi abafaka izicelo baqinisekise ukuthi wonke amaphepha afunekayo ezicelweni zabo, bayawafaka ukuze bangakhishelwa ngaphandle ngenxa yokungenzi okufanele.Uxwayise ngokuthi ngaphambi kokuthi lwedluliselwe lolu xhaso kulabo abazophuma phambili ezicelweni zabo, kuyohanjelwa izindawo zabo, lapho abenza khona amabhizinisi abo ezolimo ngenhloso yokuzohlola ukuthi abakushilo ngesikhathi befaka izicelo kuyiqiniso.
I-ANC imise iMeya kaMasipala waKwaDukuza, uNksz Lindile Nhaca, esolwa ngokugoloza ukwehla esikhundleni.I-ANC KwaZulu-Natal ithe inqume ukumisa uNksz Nhaca emva kokuthi engawulandelanga umyalelo wokuba ehle esikhundleni.UNksz Nhaca wayalelwa ukuba ehle esikhundleni ngenyanga eyedlule, isinqumo sokuthi akhishwe esikhundleni sathathwa emhlanganweni wesigungu esiphezulu kwi-ANC KwaZulu-Natal.UNksz Nhaca akazange asule esikhundleni, kepha wavele wabhalela uNobhala Jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, emcela ukuthi angenelele odabeni lokuxoshwa kwakhe.Encwadini yakhe eyabonwa yiSolezwe, uNksz Nhaca wakhala ngoNobhala we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Bheki Mtolo, emsola ngokumbophela amanqina enyathi.UNksz Nhaca ubesaqhubeka nokubonakala enza umsebenzi wakhe njengoba ngeledlule ubekhona eMkhosini weLembe.Okhulumela i-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Mafika Mndebele, uthe uNksz Nhaca umisiwe njengelungu le-ANC."Akavumelekile ukuhambela imihlangano yamakhansela e-ANC emkhandlwini nemihlangano yomkhandlu. Akavumelekile nokubiza imihlangano yomphakathi.”UMndebele uthe uNksz Nhaca uzobhekana nohlelo lokuqondiswa ubugwegwe."Sithanda ukukhumbuza bonke abaholi abajutshwe ezikhundleni ukuthi basemseni we-ANC. Bonke abaholi abajoyina i-ANC kufanele bahloniphe imigomo yeqembu."Abaholi kufanele babeke phambili izidingo zenhlangano, bakhohlwe izidingo zabo. Zonke izinto ezishiwo nezenziwa abaholi be-ANC kufanele zihambisane nemigomo ye-ANC.”Udaba lokwehliswa kukaNksz Nhaca selususe umsindo ezinhlakeni ze-ANC.Uphiko lwabesifazane nolwentsha kwi-ANC esifundeni iLembe luyaphikisana nokuxoshwa kwakhe.Nokho uMafika uthe akuqali ngoNksz Nhaca ukuba athathelwe izinyathelo."Ngaphambilini, i-ANC ike yathathela izinyathelo abaholi abaphambana nomthetho futhi ayikho into ezosivimba ukuthi siqhubeke nokwenza lokhu."Sesimbhidlangweni wokuzihlela kabusha, ngakho ke sizoqhubeka nokubhekana nalabo abaphula imigomo. Indlela uNksz Nhaca aziphethe ngayo ayamukelekile futhi ilimaza i-ANC.”UNksz Nhaca bese kunesikhathi eside elengelwa yizembe.NgoJulayi kwaputshuka inkulumo kaMtolo, lapho ayethi khona kufanele uNksz Nhaca asuswe esikhundleni bese kufakwa elinye ikhansela le-ANC, uMnuz Njabulo Cele.Le nkulumo eqoshiwe uMtolo wayenza ngesikhathi ekhuluma namakhansela e-ANC kulo mkhandlu.UMasipala waKwaDukuza ungeminye yemikhandlu enesabelomali esikhulu lapha KwaZulu-Natal njengoba ngonyaka wezimali owedlule ubunesabelomali esingu-R2.7 billion.
BASALE nabebekugqokile osonhlakahle abangasebenzi abaqhinqe eHhovisi likaNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, emva kokukhuthuzwa amaphara.Labo sonhlalakahle abangaphezu kuka-20 balahlekelwe yikho konke ngesikhathi bekhuthuzwa ngoLwesihlanu, belele ngaphandle kweHhovisi likaNdunankulu eliseMgungundlovu.Osonhlalakahle abangasebenzi ilokhu baqala ukuqhinqa eHhovisi likaNdunankulu ngo-Agasti, njengoba bekhala ngokungaqashwa.NgoLwesihlanu bekuhlangana izinsuku ezingu-35 belala ngaphandle kweHhovisi likaNdunankulu.Omunye walabo sonhlalakahle abangaphezu kuka-20,, abaqhinqe eHhovisi likaNdunankulu, uNksz Nonkululeko Mdiniso, uthe bonke baficwe ubuthongo ngezintathakusa zangoLwesihlanu, baphaphama amaphara esebaleka nezimpahla zabo."Sivuswe omunye uzakwethu esememeza. Sithe uma sivuka sabona elinye iphara seliyosithela nesikhwama esigaxwa emhlane. Sizamile ukulilandela, sangalifica.”UNksz Mdiniso uthe bantshontshelwe izinto ezibalulekile ezifana nomazisi, izincwadi zokushayela kanye nemali."Sisale nalokhu ebesikugqokile. Bashanele konke obekusezikhwameni zethu. Bathathe ukudla esikuphiwa abantu okukhona kukho impuphu namaqanda. Bathathe nemali yokugibela kwazise njalo ngoLwesihlanu siyaye siye emakhaya, size sibuye ngeMisombuluko.”UNksz Mdiniso uthe bekungokokuqala ukuba babhekane nalesi simo kusukela baqala ukuqhinqa eHhovisi likaNdunankulu.UNksz Mdiniso uthe isigameko sangoLwesihlanu angeke sibaqede amandla, wathi bazoqhubeka nokuqhinqa."Sifuna ukuthola impendulo eqondile. Akukwazi ukuthi kusukela ngo-2013 umnyango ulokhu usitshela into eyodwa, ukuthi ayikho imali yokuqasha osonhlalakahle.”UNksz Mdiniso uthe okubakhathaza kakhulu ukuthi uMnyango wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi KwaZulu-Natal awubanikezi zimpendulo."Uma sithumela ama-email abasiphenduli. Kunemibiko ekhombisa ukuthi umnyango wabelwa imali yokuqasha osonhlalakahle, wakhetha ukuyisebenzisa kwezinye izindawo.”Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe bekungakaboshwa muntu ngalesi sigameko esiphenywa amaphoyisa asePietermaritzburg.Okhulumela uMnyango wezokuThuthukiswa koMnotho nezeNhlalakahle, uMnuz Thuba Vilane, uthunyelwe imibuzo ngodaba lokuqhquna kwalabo sonhlalakahle, okushaye isikhathi sokushicilela engakayiphenduli. Ngesikhathi labo sonhlalakahle beqala umbhikisho wabo, kwamiswa umhlangano weKhabhinethi, uNdunankulu, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, nabaphathiswa, baya kolalela izimfuno zalabo sonhlalakahle.
NKOSIKHONA CELEASABISA ngokuduba ibandla amalungu ebandla akhala ngokuthunazeka kwesithunzi sawo ngemuva kokuba abefundisi balo ababili bebambane ngesidlozana bebanga intombi.Ngokuthola kweSolezwe Ngempelasonto kume yonke into ngeledlule ebandleni Izethembiso Faith Church eMtubatuba ngesikhathi abaholi balo ababili betholana phezulu ngesibhakela phambi kwabanye abazalwane.Lesi sigameko kuthiwa senzeke esigodlweni saleli bandla khona eMtubatuba.Kuvela ukuthi uMfu Ndabenhle Dlamini nomngani wakhe uMfu Zakhele Malinga kubonakale ngabo sebehluthana ngesibhakela egcekeni ngesikhathi inkonzo ngaphakathi iqhubeka.Kuthiwa uDlamini uyena umholi webandla, bese kuthi uMalinga abe sesigungwini esiphezulu esilawula leli bandla.Amalungu ebandla akhulume neSolezwe Ngempelasonto athe ezwe sekundiza emoyeni igama likaNoluthando Mpinga, okhonza kuleli bandla."UMalinga ubebuza uDlamini ukuthi uthandana kanjani noNoluthando ekubeni azi kahle ukuthi uhlela ukumlobola,'' kulandisa umthombo.Uqhuba, uthe kugcine sekulamula amakholwa njengoba bekubonakala ukuthi uMalinga uyamgojela uDlamini njengoba ebesephezu kwakhe esho nokusho ukuthi yena "akenziwa njalo”."Thina besingazi nokuthi laba babanga intombi. Baze basihlaza naba abantu,'' usho kanjena.Kuthiwa ngesikhathi behluthana ngesibhakela, uNoluthando ubengakafiki enkonzweni. Kuthiwa ugcine engasabonakalanga nangakhalo ekubeni engumuntu ongaphuthi enkonzweni."Sisola ukuthi kukhona omshayele ucingo wamazisa ngesigameko wase ebona ukuthi makangabe eseza,'' kuchaza umthombo.Isolezwe Ngempelasonto likhulume noMalinga, wathi kumphatha kabi ukuthi ibandla lakhe lizovela emaphephandabeni ngodaba olubi kangaka."Wohhe, bhala mfowethu ngoba vele ngiyazi utshelwe yibona laba engisonta nabo. Silwile noDlamini kodwa ukuthi besibangani anginawo amandla okukhuluma lokho nawe,'' usho kanjena.UDlamini yena uncenge intatheli ukuthi noma ilubhala udaba kodwa iligodle igama lebandla futhi igodle namagama abo.Uvumile ukuthi kube nento enjengalena, wathi kodwa akekho sesimweni esikahle sokuthi angakhuluma ngaso.Elinye ilungu lebandla lithe kuze kwenzeka lesi sehlakalo nje, sekunesikhathi bebabuza uMalinga noDlamini ukuthi kanti baganwa nini.Ethintwa uNoluthando, uvele wanxapha wathi akanaso isikhathi sokukhuluma ngomsangano, wavala ucingo.Umthombo uthi kunabazalwane abaningi abacabanga nokuphuma ngenxa yesigameko abathi sibacikile.Isolezwe Ngempelasonto lithole ukuthi uMalinga noDlamini babe nomhlangano ngoLwesine nesigungu sebandla."Asazi nokuthi ubani obize lowo mhlangano kodwa sithole ukuthi uDlamini uphume waduba ungakapheli,'' kusho ilungu lebandla elicele ukuba kugodlwe igama lalo.Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kwabasesigungwini sebandla igcine iphunzile kwaze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela.
INHLANZI izoshelwa amanzi kwizaphulamthetho, nasemigwaqweni engothelawayeka eThekwini, emva kokwengezwa komacekeceke bezimoto zamaphoyisa ezinesivinini esiphezulu.ITheku lengeze izimoto eziwu-50 okubalwa kuzona ama-VW Golf 8 GTI, ama-Ford Ranger namaveni kwa-Isuzu.Ngonyaka owedlule, ngoNovemba, la maphoyisa ethule izimoto zawo ezintsha amaToyota Cross awu-50.Sezizonke izimoto ezintsha zalawa maphoyisa ezithengiwe zingaphezu kuka-150.UKhomishana wamaPhoyisa kaMasipala waseThekwini, uSibonelo Mchunu, uthe bazokhuculula izigebengu, abantu abashayela budlabha nalabo abafunwayo.Uqhube wathi inhloso enkulu ukuba banciphise ubugebengu futhi amaphoyisa abonakale kulezo zindawo ezithathwa ngokuthi zinobugebengu obuxakile.Udalule ukuthi iTheku lihleli endaweni yesithupha komasipala abakhulukazi emhlabeni jikelele ngokuba nesibalo esiphezulu sobugebengu. Uthe ufuna kushaye unyaka ozayo usubonakala umehluko, sebengale kukanombolo 20."Njengamanje singaphansi kwamadolobha iGoli, iTshwane noMgungungundlovu ohleli endaweni yokuqala. Asihleli siyasebenza. Sifuna ukwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi buyancipha ubugebengu,” kuchaza uMchunu.Mayelana nokuqashwa wamaphoyisa amasha alo mkhandlu, ukwengeza esibalweni esikhona, uMchunu uthe iyabhubhudla inkezo.Phambilini uMchunu watshela Isolezwe ukuthi umasipala ungemuva esibalelweni samaphoyisa okumele ngabe unawo. UMchunu uthe njengamanje babalelwa ku-487 abaqeqeshwayo emakolishi okuzothi uma kuqala amaholidi kaDisemba, babe sebesensimini besebenza.Uhlawumbisele esikhathini esingamasonto ayisithupha kusukela manje, wathi lawa maphoyisa azobe eseluphothulile uqeqesho.Kwenzeka lokhu nje, uNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, iMeya yeTheku uMnuz Cyril Xaba, ubuholi bamaphoyisa eSAPS kuzwelonke, esifundazweni naweTheku, buhlanganise amakhanda buzama ukuthola ikhambi lobugebengu obuxakile eThekwini.
I-DA income umsebenzi owenziwe ongqongqoshe bayo kuphela izinsuku ezingu-100 kwasungulwa uhulumeni wokubambisana ophethe izwe.Umholi weDA, uMnuz John Steenhuisen, uthe mkhulu umsebenzi owenziwe ongqongqoshe baleli qembu abajutshwe eminyangweni ehlukene ezinsukwini ezingu-100 ezedlule.Amalungu eKhabhinethi likaMengameli, Cyril Ramaphosa, amenyezelwa ngoJuni 30, kanti ayeqhamuka emaqenjini ezepolitiki ayishumi.Ukwakhiwa kukahulumeni wokubambisana akuzange kube lula njengoba kwakunokuklwebhana emaqenjini ezepolitiki.I-DA yake yasikaza ukungangeni kuhulumeni wokubambisana kubangwa ukwabiwa kwezikhundla.Echaza ngokungena kwabo kuhulumeni wokubambisana, uSteenhuisen uthe babeka phambili izidingo zezwe."Sasibhekene nezinto ezimbili lapha. Okokuqala; kwakuwukuthi siyeke kube nohulumeni wokubambisana owawuzokuba ne-EFF ne-MK. Lo hulumeni wawuzoguqisa umnotho wezwe. Okwesibili; kwakungukuthi thina singene kuhulumeni wokubambisana, bese sikhulisa umnotho. Sakhetha ukukhulisa umnotho.”Ezinsukwini ezingu-100 ezedlule akuzange kube lula kuhulumeni wokubambisana.Kuke kwaba nezikhathi lapho i-DA isabisa ngokushiya kubangwa imithetho efana nowezemfundo, iBasic Education Laws Amendement Act, nowomshwalense wezempilo, i-National Health Insurance.UNgqongqoshe wezeMfundo oyilungu le-DA, uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, akazange alubhade mhla kusayinwa umthetho wezemfundo njengoba i-DA ingajabule ngezinye izigaba zomthetho.I-DA iphinde ingajabuli nge-NHI, eyaphasiswa ngaphambi kokhetho.I-DA yathola izikhundla ezibhekile kuhulumeni wokubambisana njengoba inongqongqoshe abayisithupha, namaphini ongqongqoshe ayisithupha.USteenhuisen uthe ongqongqoshe baleli qembu babeke phambili ukuthuthukiswa komnotho nokudalwa kwamathuba emisebenzi."Ukungena kwethu kuhulumeni wokubambisana kwabuyisa ithemba lekusasa elingcono nokukhula komnotho. Kulezi nsuku ezingu-100 zokuqala senze izinto ezibonakalayo. Into egqame kakhulu ekusebenzeni kukahulumeni wokubambisana ukukhula komnotho nokuncipha kwesibalo sabantu abangasebenzi. "Lena into esiyibeke phambili njenge-DA. Eqinisweni sifuna ukuthi bonke ongqongqoshe bethu baqhamuke nezindlela zokuthuthukisa umnotho nezokudala amathuba emisebenzi eminyangweni abajutshwe kuyo. Ongqongqoshe bethu sebeqalile ukwenza lo msebenzi.”USteenhuisen uthe ongqongqoshe be-DA sebeqalile ukuhoxisa izinhlelo zikahulumeni ezingabasizi ngalutho abantu bakuleli."Ongqongoshe bethu bakuqaphe ngelokhozi ukusetshenziswa kwemali yeminyango abajutshwe kuyo. Asikwazi ukuqhubeka nokusebenzisa imali entweni engabasizi ngalutho abantu bakuleli.”USteenhuisen uthe ongqongqoshe be-DA baphenya nangenkohlakalo eminyangweni abayiphethe, wabalula uMnyango wezeMisebenzi yoMphakathi neNgqalasizinda.

sezezimali nabaqondisi ababili okukhona kubo obhekelele uphiko olukhipha amathenda.UMphathiswa woMnyango, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, ukushayele ihlombe ukumiswa kwalezi zikhulu."Ukumiswa kwazo kuthumela umyalezo oshubile futhi kubuyisa isiko lokuphatha imali yomnyango ngendlela nelikuqinisekisa ukuthi bathathelwa izinyathelo labo abephula imithetho.”UButhelezi ungene kulo mnyango emva kokhetho lwangoMeyi.Uke wakuveza ngaphambilini ukuthi kuningi okushayisa amakhala akufice emnyangweni.Ngesikhathi uButhelezi ejikijelana ngamazwi noNobhala we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Bheki Mtolo, waveza ukuthi kunophenyo aseluqalile emnyangweni.UButhelezi wathi yiningi imali yomnyango eyasetshenziswa ngendlela engaqondakali ngesikhathi kubhekwe okhethweni.Waveza ukuthi uphenyo oluqhutshwa umnyango lungase luholele ekutheni kube khona abantu ababoshelwa amacala enkohlakalo.Ngaphandle kokuphenya izinsolo zenkohlakalo, uButhelezi ufike kulo mnyango waguqula izinqumo ezathathwa engakafiki.Ngesikhathi efika emnyangweni, uButhelezi washintsha abalawuli abajutshwe wumnyango komasipala okubalwa kubo owesifunda uThukela, uMkhanyakude nowaseNkosi Mtubatuba.UButhelezi waphinde likaMengameli, uDkt Cassius Lubisi, lamenyezelwa ngonyaka owedlule, kodwa kwaze kwashaya ukhetho lingethuliwe emkhandlwini.Kwakunezinsolo zokuthi amakhansela e-ANC awavumelani nesinqumo sokujutshwa kwaleli thimba.Kumiswa izikhulu zalo mnyango nje, noMnyango wezeMisebenzi yoMphakathi neNgqalasizinda esifundazweni nawo usanda kumisa izikhulu eziphezulu.Lo mnyango oholwa uMnuz Martin Meyer, oyilungu leDA, usanda kumisa izikhulu ezine ezisolwa ngenkohlakalo.Kuzona kukhona inhloko yomnyango, isikhulu sezezimali, nomqondisi ophikweni olukhipha amathenda.

Kuvela ukuthi lo mfana wathi uma evuka, wezwa izinhlungu endaweni yokulahla itshe lentaba futhi egcotshwe ngamafutha khona. Kuthiwa eduze kwakhe kwakukhona umqeqeshi, enqunu, wathi akazange amenze lutho.Isisulu sasikade silele nomngani waso yena ongazange adlwengulwe. Ngakusasa umqeqeshi wabathatha bobabili abafana waya nabo enkonzweni kwaba sengathi akwenzekanga lutho.Isisulu sabhoboka ngale ndaba kumngani waso, wasiyala ngokuthi singathuli kodwa lolu daba siludlulisele kunina.Unina wavula icala lokudlwengula, nokwaholela ekutheni kuboshwe le ndoda edume ngokushumayela iqekebule enkonzweni.Phambilini lesi sigameko saba yindaba egudwini kumalungu omphakathi waseWaterloo namaphethelo, owawusabisa ngokumudla luhlaza lo mqeqeshi uma inkantolo imdedela ngebheyili.Ngaphambi kokuthi aboshwe, wayiswa esibhedlela kwazise umphakathi wawuqale ngokumtitinya.Ngesikhathi egqigqa enkantolo kwavela ukuthi ubhekene namanye amacala amane okunukubeza ngokocansi abafana abaneminyaka engu-12 kuya phezulu khona eWaterloo.Kwahlaluka nokuthi uMfundisi abagilwa wayeqala ngokuthi abaphuzise unemenayidi okukholakala ukuthi wayesuke esewuthake nesidakamizwa esithile esasibenza bazumeke, bese eyabadlwengula.Kuthiwa wayebasabisa ngokuthi uzobenzakalisa uma beke bathi nkente ngalolu daba.Kwavela nokuthi abazali abaningi bebemethemba kakhulu lo mfundisi emphakathini.

BAZWAKALISE indumalo abe-MK inkantolo ivimba umholi wale nhlangano, uDkt John Hlophe, ukuthi ahambele imihlangano yekomiti eliluleka umengameli ngezobulungiswa.INkantolo eNkulu eWestern Cape ikhiphe isivimbelo sesikhashana esivimba ukuthi uHlophe ahambele imihlangano yekomiti iJudicial Service Commission kuze kuba kuphuma isinqumo esicelweni sokuthi akhishwe kuleli komiti.Isinqumo senkantolo kuleli cala elifakwe i-DA nezinye izinhlangano ezifuna uHlophe achithwe ekomitini, sikhishwe ngoLwesihlanu.Nakuba i-MK ithe asiyethusanga isinqumo senkantolo, izwakalise ukudumala."Akusimangazi lokhu okwenzekile ngoba sihlezi sisho ukuthi izinkantolo ziqhoqhobelwe abathize. Leli yiqhinga lezepolitiki lokuvimba ukuthi uHlophe abe ingxenye yekomiti,” kusho isitatimende esikhishwe i-MK.I-MK iqhube yathi into eyenza ukuthi i-DA ingafuni ukuthi uHlophe abe ingxenye yaleli komiti eliphakamisa amagama okufanele babe amajaji, ukuthi ifuna uHlophe angaphazamisi ukuqokwa kwalabo abafunwa i-DA kwesenhloko yamajaji eWestern Cape."Bayazi ukuthi uHlophe akasinisi amahleza, lapho kukhona yena akudlalwa.”UHlophe wayeyinhloko yamajaji eWestern Cape, wachithwa emva kombiko walo leli komiti.I-DA nezinye izinhlangano zikhala ngokuthi uHlophe akakwazi ukuphinde abe ingxenye yekomiti elamchithayo.Okhulumela i-DA, uNksz Karabo Khakhau, uthe isivimbelo senkantolo sisho ukunqoba kubona."Isinqumo senkantolo sihambisana nalokhu ebesihlale sikusho futhi sihambisana nemizamo yethu yokuqinisekisa ukugcinwa kwesithunzi nobuqotho kwezobulungiswa. Ijaji elakhishwa esikhundleni emva kokwephula imithetho alikwazi ukuthi lingahlala ekomitini eliphakamisa amajaji liphinde liqinisekise ubuqotho kwezobulungiswa.”UNksz Khakhau uthe bazoqhubeka nokulwela ukuzimela kwezobulungiswa."Isinqumo sanamhlanje siyisiqalo nje. Ukuvumela uHlophe, owakhishwa esikhundleni emva kwempi yomthetho ende, ukuba abe ingxenye yokuqokwa kwamajaji bekuzokwenza ukuthi abantu baseNingizimu Afrika balahlekelwe ukwethemba ezobulungiswa."Isinqumo sanamhlanje sisho ukunqoba kubo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika abafuna ukubona ezobulungiswa ezizimele. Isinqumo siqinisekisa ukuthi labo abanikwa umsebenzi wokuqoka amajaji kufanele kube abantu abaqotho.”Isinqumo senkantolo sisho ukuthi uHlophe ngeke abe ingxenye yemihlangano yekomiti ezokuba ngenyanga ezayo.

BEBEHLEKA baze baqhephuke uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, noNgqongqoshe wezobuCiko, amaSiko nezeMidlalo, uMnuz Gayton McKenzie, ngesikhathi beqhosha ngokusebenza kukahulumeni wokubambisana ophethe izwe.Labaholi bathe uhulumeni wokubambisana awuyi ndawo, uMcKenzie uze wathi ngeke avume ukuhlonyekiswa yilabo abathi akashiye uhulumeni wokubambisana.Bakusho lokhu ngesikhathi bekhuluma emcimbini wokwamukelwa kwamathambo ezishoshovu zomzabalazo ezangcwatshelwa emazweni angomakhelwane iZambia neZimbabwe.Umcimbi wokwamukelwa kwamathambo alezi zishoshovu ezingu-42 ubuseFreedom Park, ngoLwesihlanu.URamaphosa noMcKenzie bangabaholi bamaqembu ayingxenye yohulumeni wokubambisana, i-ANC nePatriotic Alliance.Bekuqhilika izihlathi kula baholi ngesikhathi bekhuluma ngokusebenzisana kwabo.UMcKenzie uthe ngeke abalalele labo abamhlohlayo, abathi akashiye uhulumeni wokubambisana."Bayangihlomekisa laba, bafuna ngixoshwe. Abazi ukuthi kumnandi kanjani lapha kuhulumeni wokubambisana. Labo abangeyona ingxenye yohulumeni wokubambisana bayaphuthelwa. Wonke amaqembu amenywa ukuba abe yingxenye yohulumeni wokubambisana, anqaba. Abathule-ke labo abanqabayo.”NgeSonto kuphela izinsuku ezingu-100 kwasungulwa uhulumeni wokubambisana.URamaphosa uthe bonke ongqongqoshe bakubeke eceleni ukuthi baqhamuka emaqenjini ezepolitiki ahlukene."Ubani obengacabanga ukuthi ungqongqoshe ongelona ilungu le-ANC (uMcKenzie) angaqhubeka nomsebenzi owaqalwa ungqongqoshe we-ANC? Miningi iminyango ebambe iqhaza emcimbini wanamhlanje. Le minyango iholwa ongqongqoshe abaqhamuka emaqenjini ehlukene. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi sonke sifuna into eyodwa, ukusebenzela abantu,” kusho uRamaphosa.Phakathi kwabaholi okubuyiswe amathambo abo, kubalwa lowo owayengunobhala jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Duma Nokwe, nezinye ezishoshovu ezifana noMnuz Bafana Nsele, Jackson Khuzwayo noVincent Khumalo.URamaphosa uthe asazolandwa amathambo amanye amaqhawe omzabalazo."Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika kufanele bazi ukuthi angobani la maqhawe alwela inkululeko. La maqhawe anikela ngezimpilo zawo. Amagama abo azoqoshwa emlandweni lapha eFreedom Park khona singeke sibakhohlwe.”
INJABULO ibibhalwe ebusweni kosomabhizinisi abancane njengoba benikelelwe ngezinsiza zokusebenza nguMphathiswa wezokuThuthukiswa kwamaBhizinisi Amancane, uNksz Stella Ndabeni-Abrahams, eThekwini ngoLwesine.Labo somabhizinisi bebekhala ngezingqinamba ezahlukene okubalwa kuzo ukuba nefriji elincane bagcine bengakwazi ukugcina inyama eningi noma iziphuzo.UNkk Thobekile Makhoba onekhishi lokudayisa ukudla enkabeni yeTheku ekhuluma neSolezwe, uthe ahlomuhle ngakho kuzomsiza kakhulu."Ngihlomuhle, ngesitofu segesi, ibhodwe, ifriji kanye netafula okuzongilekelela kakhulu ekutheni ibhizinisi lami liqhubeke liye phambili okuzogqugquzela nabanye ukuthi bafake izicelo ukuze bahlomule,” kusho uNkk Makhoba.Uthe ziningi izingqinamba ahlangabezana nazo ngoba ubengenazo ezinye zezinsiza."Kwesinye isikhathi amakhasimende ami abefuna iziphuzo, uthole ukuthi anginazo ngenxa yokuthi ifriji lami lincane futhi bengithenga inyama njalo ngoba bengingakwazi ukuthenga eningi,” usho kanje.UMnuz Thalente Ndlovu oqhamuka eSiyathuthuka Madoda Multi-Purpose Cooperative ezinze eJozini abambisene kuyo noMnuz Hlobisani Thabede, banebhizinisi lokwenza ama-tissue, uthe njengoba behlomule ngeloli kubasize kakhulu lokho ngoba bebengakwazi ukuzilandela impahla."Iloli lizosisiza kakhulu ngoba besingakwazi ukuzilandela impahla eSappi ngoba umthamo wempahla esiwuthengayo mkhulu kakhulu okwenza singakwazi ukulayisha, sigcine sesiliqasha iloli,” kusho uNdlovu.Uthe ukuqasha iloli elizobathuthela impahla kubiza kakhulu."Bekumba eqolo sikhokha imali ecishe ifike ku-R15 000 ngokuqasha iloli.
