Kusinde abantu abayisithupha okungabantu besifazane abane nowesilisa,”kusho uBrig Mathe.Uqhube wathi ubangwa nezibi esibhedlela owesilisa osekhulile osinde edutshulwa. Uveze nokuthi bekukhona ingane enezinyanga ezimbili kuhlaselwa, ephume ingenamyocu."Ingane iyiswe esibhedlela ukuze ithole ukunakekelwa okudingakalayo. Kusiphatha kabi okwenzekile,” kusho uBrig Mathe.Amaphoyisa athi bangu-15 abesifazane abasocongiwe kanye namadoda amabili.Uveze ukuthi uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa uGeneral Fannie Masemola usehlanganise ithimba eliphezulu lamaphoyisa azophenya ezi zigameko.Njengamanje uthe bamatasa nomsebenzi wabo abaphenyi futhi kunamathimba amabili ochwepheshe bendawo yesigameko avela ePitoli ajutshwe ukuba ahlwaye izimpendulo."Kutshalwe inqwaba yamaphoyisa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bayatholakala abantu abenze lobu bugebengu. Sikhuthazwa ukuthi ezigamekweni zokudubula esezibe khona kulesi sifundazwe, amaphoyisa akwazile ukubopha abasolwa,” kuchaza uBrig Mathe.Udalule nokuthi kuyabakhathaza ukuthi amacala okubulawa kwabantu aphezulu e-Eastern Cape.Uthe lesifundazwe sivalwe ukubalwa nezintathu ezihamba phambili ngamacala okubulawa kwabantu uma sekukhishwa izibalo zobugebengu.
KUYAQHUBEKA ukubhekana ngeziqu zamehlo phakathi kukaNgqongqoshe weMfundo eyisiSekelo, uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, nenyunyana yothisha iSadtu.Le nyunyana inqume ukungamumemi engqungqutheleni yeshumi kazwelonke yale nyunyana, eqhubeka eBoksburg, eGauteng, esongwa kusasa.Kule ngqungquthela kuzobhungwa ngezinselelo kwezemfundo, kukhethwa nabaholi abasha abazophatha iminyaka emihlanu.Sekufana nesiko ukuthi izinyunyana zabasebenzi uma zinezingqungquthela, zibize uNgqongqoshe obhekele lowo mkhakha.Le nyunyana ibingalenzi iphutha lokungamumemi obenguNgqongqoshe womnyango, uNkk Angie Motshekga, yize yake yangabona ngaso linye naye yaze yambhikishela.Kulokhu ibize kuphela iPhini likaNgqongqoshe wezeMfundo uDkt Reginah Mhlaule, ukuzothula inkulumo evela kumqashi.Abanye abakhulumile kubalwa abaholi bamadlelandawonye, okuyiCosatu okukhulume uMengameli walo mfelandawonye uNksz Zingiswa Losi, uNobhala jikelele weSACP, uMnuz Solly Mapaila, nezinye izinhlaka.Ingqungquthela ivulwe yiPhini likamengameli lezwe nele-ANC, uMnuz Paul Mashatile. NoMashatile ushilo ukuthi kubalulekile ukuthi uNksz Gwarube, abe nobudlelwano neSadtu ngoba iyona enkulukazi kwezemfundo."Kumele ngabe ukhona uNgqongqoshe weMfundo eyisiSekelo kule ngqungquthela kodwa angimboni. Kuyadingeka azizwele izinselelo zothisha futhi uyadinga ukwakha ubudlelwano neSadtu,” kusho uMashatile.Le nyunyana inamalungu angu-275 500 kwezemfundo.UMengameli weSadtu uMnuz Magope Maphila, utshele amalungu ahambele ingqungquthela ukuthi akamenyiwe uNksz Gwarube.Kuqhume ihlombe kwashaywa amakhwela ngesikhathi etshela amalungu ukuthi akulona iphutha njengoba engekho ingoba akamenyiwe.Uthe kumele anikwe imiyalelo emine okuzomele ayilandele ngoba akaziphethe ngendlela."Imiyalelo ithi, kumele aqhubeke nomthetho wezikole osayiniwe, iBela Act, ngokushesha. Kumele athande iSadtu ngenhliziyo nangomqondo, ayithande le nyunyana aphinde afune izeluleko kule nyunyana ngaso sonke isikhathi.”Ugxeke okwenziwa yi-DA eWestern Cape, ngokudiliza othisha abevile ku-2 000 ngenxa yezinkinga zemali ekubeni nezinye izifundazwe zibhekene nezinkinga ezifanayo."Ngesikhathi sihlangana naye wathi asibeke eceleni indaba yepolitiki, wathi uzosithinta afune izincomo ngezinto eziningi kwezemfundo. Samtshela kwezikabhoqo ukuthi sasingamfuni ngoba uvela kwi-DA, engayifuni iSadtu. Wabukela phansi uMengameli eduba umcimbi wokusayinwa komthetho ngoba ehambisana nokufunwa iqembu lakhe i-DA,” kusho uMaphila.UNksz Gwarube uvumile ukuthi akamenywanga engqungqutheleni yeSadtu. "Angimenywanga engqungqutheleni yeSadtu, sinabo ubudlelwano obuhle nale nyunyana. Okubalulekile ngiyabazisa ngezinto engizozenza emnyangweni, angibashiyile ngaphandle,” kusho uNksz Gwarube ekhuluma nesiteshi sethelevishini izolo ekuseni.
UZOYIVALA kusenesikhathi uMnyango wezokuThutha KwaZulu-Natal eminye yemigwaqo ezokhahlanyezwa ukukhithika kwezulu kulesi sifundazwe.Lokhu kushiwo uMphathiswa walo mnyango, uMnuz Siboniso Duma ngoLwesine ngesikhathi enesithangami esiphuthumayo nabezindaba eGreyville eThekwini.UDuma ubize lisithangami ngenhloso yokuzochazela izakhamuzi ukuthi isifundazwe sikulungele kangakanani ukubhekana nokukhithika kwezulu okuthiwa kuzoba khona ngoMsombuluko nangoLwesibili. Phakathi kwezindawo okuthiwa zizokhahlamezeka kukhona uMnambithi, Underberg, Drakensburg, Giant’s Castle nezinye izindawo eziphakeme ezakhele lezi zindawo. Kuvele nokuthi lokhu kungahle kulandelwe yimvula enamandla kulezi zindawo, eThekwini, nakwezinye.UDuma uthe phakathi kwezinto abazimisele ngokuzenza ukuthi bayivale imigwaqo esezindaweni okuphume isexwayiso sokukhithika kuzo."Kulokhu sizoyivala ngempela imigwaqo futhi ngeke sisithambise isandla kubashayeli,” kusho uDuma.Uveze ukuthi ngempelasonto eyedlule ngesikhathi kuhlasele inkinga efanayo, kube khona ukungabambisani kahle phakathi kwabo nabashayeli ababekhombisa ukungayizwa eyokuthi imigwaqo iyavalwa ngenxa yeqhwa.Uthe balungise nogandaganda abangu-23 ukuthi bame ngomumo ukuze bayogugula iqhwa emigwaqweni ezokhahlamezeka."Sibankanise ezindaweni ezehlukene okuvele ukuthi zizoba nale nkinga,” kusho uDuma.Uveze nokuthi bankanise namathimba ezinhlekelele anesipiliyoni, ukutze akulungele ukuthi uma sesiqala isimo, akwazi ukuqala umsebenzi olindeleke kuwo. Uthe lama thimba aphinde acijwa ukuthi azowenza kanjani lo msebenzi ngokushesha.Ubalule nokuthi bavivise namaphoyisa omgwaqo ukuthi nawo ame ngomumo ukunika umhlahlandlela emigwaqweni ezokhahlamezeka ukuze kulawuleke isimo nabashayeli.Uthe imigwaqo eseqhulwini kuleyo abazoyiqapha ngeso lokhozi, uN3 ngaseHarrismith, umgwaqo uTugela, uR617 phakathi kweKokstad ne-Underberg, iMooi River neminye.Ephawula ngenhlekelele eyenzeke ngempelasonto, uthe bafunde isifundo sokuthi kufanele bahlele baphinde bazilungiselele kusenesikhathi.Uthe bayaqonda ukuthi okunye ngeke kume ngomumo masinyane njengoba elakuleli liyizwe elisathuthuka, wathi izinto ezifana nemishini efanele nengqalasizinda kuzothatha isikhathi ukuthi kufinyelele ezingeni."Okukhulu kunakho konke esikufundile ukuthi izexwayiso zezulu kufanele sizithathele phezulu sonke. Abantu abaningi uma zikhishwa lezi zexwayiso, abazikholwa,” kusho uDuma.Uqhube wathi okwenzeke ngeledlule kufanele kukhumbuze abantu ukuthi indaba yokuguquguquka kwesimo sezulu yinto okufanele bazi ukuthi iyinto yangempela futhi isiyingxenye yempilo yezakhamuzi zakuleli.Uxwayise nangokuthi kulezi zinsuku okulindeleke ngazo ukukhithika, abantu bayanxuswa ukuthi uma uhambo lungaphuthumi, abangaluthathi, kuze kudlule isimo esibi sezulu.Esigamekweni sokuvaleleka kwezimoto emgwaqweni ngempelasonto, kwashona abagibeli ababili ngenxa yokungenwa amakhaza kakhulu.Zingaphezu kuka-1 800 izimoto ezavaleleka emgwaqweni uN3 noN11 kuleso siwombe.
UYOTHOLOZA ejele owaqashwa ezikhundleni ezehlukene eHhovisi likaNdunankulu KwaZulu-Natal, esebenzisa iziqu zomkokotelo.UMlekeleli Masondo (45), ulahlwe amacala amahlanu okukhwabanisa ngoLwesine, yiNkantolo yesiFunda eMgungundlovu. UMasondo wafaka isicelo somsebenzi esikhundleni sokuba yi-Project Manager ngo-2010.Waqashwa kulesi sikhundla, kwathi ngo-2019, waphinde wafaka isicelo sokuba yiPhini likaMqondisi, okuyisikhundla aqashelwa kusona.Okhulumela oKlebe, uLieutenant Colonel Simphiwe Mhlongo, uthe inkinga iqale ngo-2021, ngesikhathi uMnyango weziSebenzi zikaHulumeni, usuwenza ucwaningo ngeziqu zikaMasondo.Uthe zayima emthumeni njengoba ahluleka ukuhambisa imiqingo yeziqu eyayidingeka. "Kwabe sekutholakala ukuthi iziqu zakhe ziwumkokotelo, wabe esehamba uhlelo lokuqondiswa ubugwegwe. IHhovisi likaNdunankulu lakhwatshaniselwa u-R3.7 million,” kusho uMhlongo.UMhlongo uveze ukuthi kwavulwa icala esiteshini samaphoyisa sakhona eMgungundlovu."Idokodo labe selidluliselwa ophikweni loKlebe bePietermaritzburg Serious Commercial Crime Investigation, zamkhalela uMasondo ngoFebhuwari, nyakenye. Wavela izikhawu eziningi enkantolo waze walahlwa amacala ngoMeyi 9, 2024.” Uthe ugwetshwe iminyaka eyisithupha; ngamacala amabili okukhwabanisa, wagwetshwa iminyaka emibili ngamacala amabili okukokotela, eminye iminyaka emibili ngamacala amabili okuhambisa imiqingo engumgunyathi."Le minyaka uzoyidonsa kanye kanye” Inhloko yoKlebe esifundazweni uMajor General Lesetja Senona, usamukele isigwebo esinikwe uMasondo, wahalalisela amalungu ophiko lwamaphoyisa ngomsebenzi omuhle awenzile.
EYOKUNQANYULWA kwesabelomali emnyangweni weMfundo eyisiSekelo, ikhwelo lokuthi asule esikhundleni ungqongqoshe walo mnyango kanjalo nokulungiswa kwezimo zokusebenza zothisha ziseqhulwini engqungqutheleni yeSadtu eqhubeka eGoli.Kule ngqungquthela esongwa kusasa lapho kuzomenyezelwa nabaholi abasha bale nyunyana, amadlelandawonye ne-ANC afuqe umkhankaso wokuthi kuliwe nenkinga yokunqanyulwa kwesabelomali nokuthi kungabikhona uthisha ozodilizwa ngenxa yale nkinga.UNobhala jikelele weSACP uMnuz Solly Mapaila, uthe bazoma neSadtu ekutheni kungabikhona uthisha ozodilizwa."Sifuna kufakwe imali kwezemfundo ngoba yilona thuluzi elibalulekile lokukhulula abantu ebubheni. Sizoyilwa eyemizamo yokudiliza othisha ngenxa yale nkinga.” Nomengameli weCosatu uNksz Zingiswa Losi, uhambe emazwini kaMapaila, wathi ngeke bavume ukuthi kudilizwe abasebenzi.Uthe ziningi izinto okusamele zilungiswe kwezemfundo okubalwa ingqalasizinda, ukuphepha kothisha nabafundi nezinye."Ngeke sivume ukuthi izinkinga zemali ziholele ekutheni kudilizwe abasebenzi. Asebekuhulumeni wokubambisana abavela kwamanye amaqembu, sebeyazimangalisa manje ukuthi izinselelo zokunqanyulwa kwesabelomali zinomthelela onzima emikhakheni ehlukene,” kusho uNksz Losi.Uthe laba bamaqembu asebengongqongqoshe, bebehlale beshumayela ivangeli lokuthi kuncishiswe isibalo sabasebenzi."Manje njengoba sebekuhulumeni sebebona ngenye indlela, sebefuna kufakwe imali okuyinto esasihlala sikhala ngayo. Uma kudilizwa othisha sizokwanda isibalo sabafundi abazosala dengwane emakilasini.” UMapaila uthe kumele uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, asule esikhundleni ngokuduba ukuhambela umcimbi wokusayinwa komthetho wezikole iBela Act."Sizowuvikela lo mthetho kuze kube sekugcineni. UMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa kumele ngabe usamxosha emnyangweni uma ngempela kuwuyena oqasha aphinde adilize ongqongqoshe,” kusho uMapaila.Ekhuluma nesiteshi sethelevishini izolo uNksz Gwarube, uzivikele wathi uRamaphosa wayazi ukuthi ngeke abe khona kulo mcimbi."Njengoba sikuhulumeni wokubambisana kuzoba khona ukuhluka kwemibono. Akumele ngoba umuntu uqhuzukile bese esheshe exoshwa,” kusho uNksz Gwarube ezithethelela njengoba bebaningi abathi akaxoshwe.ISACP ixwayise neKhomishini yezoKhetho kuleli, ukuthi ingavumeli ukutshelwa abathile ukuthi ingabaqashi othisha beSadtu uma kunokhetho ezweni.Uthe abanye babantu abasuke bengamele ukhetho basuke bengazi ngisho nomthetho ngakho kubalulekile ukuthi abasebenzi babe yingxenye yokwengamela ukhetho."ISadtu kumele iqhubeke nokusebenza ngesikhathi sokhetho njengabo bonke abasebenzi kuleli. Ayingavalwa ngenxa yokuthi kunabantu abasuke befaka ingcindezi.” Usho kanje, amanye amaqembu ezepolitiki okubalwa ne-EFF, ahlale ekhala ngokuthi awafuni iSadtu ilawule ukhetho.
WABOSHWA ngesikhathi engumphathi wesiteshi samaphoyisa eBhekithemba, eMlaza obesebe yiphoyisa iminyaka engu-32 obhekene necala lokufumbathiswa uR120 000 ukuze kunyamalale idokodo likamfowabo.UMnuz Khephu Ndlovu, osule ngonyaka odlule embuthweni wamaphoyisa esenguLieutenant Colonel, ugqigqa eNkantolo yesiFunda yasePinetown nabanye abane.Uthweswe icala lokufumbathiswa imali nelokuphazamisa ukusebenza kwengalo yomthetho okungamacala awaphikayo.UMbuso usola uNdlovu (ongumsolwa wesine) ukuthi wamukela uR120 000 owawufakwe esikhwameni semali epaki yezimoto esiteshini samaphoyisa eDurban Central.Le mali kuthiwa yayivela kuNkk Sibongile Ndlovu (umsolwa wesibili) ngomyalelo womyeni wakhe ongumfowabo kaNdlovu, uFelokwakhe Ndlovu (ongumsolwa wesithathu).Kuthiwa imali kwakucubuzwa ngayo amagabade ukuze uNdlovu asebenzise isikhundla ayesiphethe emaphoyiseni ayalele uKaputeni Bonginkosi Dlamini (ongumsolwa wokuqala) kulahlwe ubufakazi becala lokubulala. Lagcina lisusiwe kuDlamini lelo cala.UDlamini wayephenya uFelokwakhe ngecala lokubulala uMnuz Thulani Nxumalo owayengunobhala wegatsha le-ANC KwaNdengezi.Limgojelile ngoMeyi wakulo nyaka lelo cala uFelokwakhe wagixabezwa ngesigwebo sikadilikajele.UNdlovu (Khephu) uthe akazani nemali okukhulunywa ngayo futhi akamazi uDlamini wayengakaze ambone empilweni yakhe.Uthe wahlangana noNkk Ndlovu, abesilisa ababili, obizwa ngomkhulu omunye ngoMpofu ukuze kudingidwe izinto ezithinta umndeni.Lezo zinto uthe wayefuna umkhulu amboleke abafana ababeseqenjini lakhe lengoma ukuze banandise emcimbini womndeni owawuzokuba ngo-Okthoba 2019 kwaNdlovu, eMgungundlovu.Lo fakazi uthe uyakweshwama ukuthi babehlangene ngenhloso yokumnikeza imali ukuze kulahleke ubufakazi ecaleni elalibhekene noFelokwakhe.Ubuzwe umshushisi u-Advocate Lawrence Gcaba ukuthi wayefunani emsebenzini ngoMgqibelo ekubeni isikhundla ayesiphethe sasimdinga emsebenzini phakathi nezinsuku."Sasisekhempini eDurban Central, sicija ikhwaya yamaphoyisa engangiphethe isikhundla khona eyayizoya komela isifundazwe emcimbini owawuzokuba seBloemfontein. Akukho esasikuxoxa okwakuyimfihlo,” kusho uNdlovu.Enkantolo bekukhona owayengumkhulumeli wamaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uVincent Mdunge ezokweseka uNdlovu (Khephu) othe wayeyibamba lomphathi siteshi eboshwa.UDlamini nabaganene bakwaNdlovu bagqunywe ezitokisini. Ungaphandle ngebheyili uNdlovu (Khephu) nomsolwa wesihlanu oyindodana yabaganene uMnuz Lindokuhle Ndlovu.Bebebukeka bezikhululekele abasolwa futhi bexoxa namalungu emindeni yabo abezobeseka enkantolo uma iMantshi uMuntukayise Khumalo isaliguqisile icala.Kuyaqhubeka ukwethulwa kobufakazi namuhla.
'UKUSHAYISANA kosopolitiki nomphakathi ikakhulu ezindaweni zasemakhaya - ezinye zazo ezisaphethwe ngamakhosi - ngenye yezinto ezenza kube nzima ukufukula omasipala basemakhaya.’Sisho njalo isazi sezokuvakasha, uDkt Bandile Mkhize, sikhuluma engqungqutheleni yokuzocebisa omasipala ngezindlela zokuphatha nokubafukula, iMunicipal Strategy Conference, ebisePremier Hotel, eMhlanga, izolo. Le ngqunguthela engeyokuqala yalolu hlobo - ezosongwa namhlanje - ihlelwe yinkampani ezimele iNsikayezwe Management Consultants, eholwa wuMnuz Erick Sithole.Eqhuba, uDkt Mkhize uthe kufanele ngabe ziningi izinhlelo ezenziwa ngabaholi bezepolitiki komasipala ababaholayo ukuze bathuthuke kodwa akwenzeki ngenxa yokuthi akubanjiswene."Okunye okuhluphayo wukuthi osopolitiki bazitshela ukuthi bahlakaniphile kunabaholi bomphakathi nabelaphi bendabuko, bekhohlwe wukuthi yibona labo bantu abaneqhaza ekutheni kwenzekani emphakathini abawakhele. SEBUPHELE nya ubudlelwano kumaqembu ayehlangene nge-ANC ngaphambi kokhetho, i-DA ne-ActionSA.Isipikili sokugcina ekuchithekeni kobudlelwano bawo sishayelwe ngesikhathi i-ActionSA ihlamuka i-DA kuMasipala waseTshwane.I-ActionSA ivote namaqembu aphikisayo ukuba kukhishwe iMeya ye-DA kulo mkhandlu, uMnuz Cilliers Brink, emhlanganweni womkhandlu, obuyizolo.UBrink ukhishwe ngevoti lokungabethembi ubuholi bakhe emva kokuthi i-ActionSA ivote ne-ANC ne-EFF.Amakhansela angu-120 avotele ukuthi uBrink akhishwe, kwathi angu-80 wona avotela ukuthi angakhishwa.ObeyiMeya yaseTshwane uMbuz Cilliers Brink Isithombe: Oupa MokoenaNgaphambi komhlangano wayizolo, i-ActionSA ibikade ibambisene ne-DA emkhandlwini njengoba i-ActionSA iphethe isikhundla sephini lemeya, iphinde ibe nesikhundla esigungwini esiphezulu esilawula umkhandlu.Bobabili i-DA ne-ActionSA bebephinde bebe ingxenye yamaqembu abefuna ukukhipha i-ANC ngaphambi kokhetho lukazwelonke Uqhekeko kula maqembu luqale ukugqama emva kokhetho, ngesikhathi i-DA ijoyina uhulumeni wokubambisana oholwa yi-ANC.I-ActionSA yasigxeka isinqumo se-DA, yathi siphambene nesivumelwano esasayinwa ngaphambi kokhetho.Muva nje, i-ActionSA isanda kusebenzisana ne-ANC kuMasipala waseJohannesburg, yachayisa i-DA.Amalungu e-DA abenombhikisho wokuzwelana noBrink ngesikhathi kuqhubeka umhlangano wayizolo, athi i-ActionSA icasulwa ukuthi ayizange yenze kahle okhethweni lwangoMeyi.Umholi we-DA eGauteng, uMnuz Solly Msimanga, uthe ukuba i-ActionSA yenza kahle okhethweni lwangoMeyi, i-DA yayingeke isebenzisane ne-ANC."Bathola amavoti amancane kakhulu nokwenza ukuthi singakwazi ukwakha uhulumeni wokubambisana.”UMsimanga uthe ukukhishwa kukaBrink kuzophazamisa imizamo yokubuyisa uzinzo emkhandlwini.Umholi we-ActionSA, uMnuz Herman Mashaba, uthe bakhethe ukukhipha i-DA ngenxa yokwehluleka kukaBrink ukuphatha umkhandlu."Izinto bezingahambi kahle lapha emkhandlwini ngesikhathi kuphethe uBrink. Sonke siyazi ukuthi isimo sezezimali asisihle lapha emkhandlwini. Umkhandlu uthole umbiko ongemuhle kuMcwaningi maBhuku kanti futhi uyehluleka ukuhambisa izidingo kubantu.”UNobhala we-ANC eGauteng, uMnuz TK Nciza, uthe liphume nobomvu."Sijabule ukuthi uBrink ukhishiwe, ubezenzela umathanda lapha. Ngibongela abantu abamnyama asebezothola izidingo. Abantu abamnyama bebenganakiwe ngesikhathi kuphethe uBrink.”Imeya entsha yomkhandlu izoqokwa emhlanganweni womkhandlu ozobizwa maduze.
ABE-SOUTH African Weather Service (SAWS) bakhiphe isexwayiso sokuthi kuzophinde kubuye okwesibili ukukhithika okubonakale ngempelasonto edlule.OweSAWS uNkk Celeste Fourie, uthe izifundazwe ezizothinteka ikwaZulu-Natal, Free State ne-Eastern Cape kusukela ngeSonto kuya kuLwesibili. UNkk Fourie uthe yize kuzoba nalokhu kukhithika, ngeke kube kubi njengalokhu okubonakele ngempelasonto eyedlule."Isimo sezulu esihambisana nokukhithika kulindeleke ukuthi sishintshe kakhulu njengoba amazinga okushisa ezokwehla abe ngaphansi kuka-10 degrees. Amazinga okushisa azoqala ukwehla kakhulu eWestern Cape ngeSonto. Lokhu kuzodlulela e-Eastern Cape naKwaZulu-Natal ngoMsombuluko nangoLwesibili,” kusho uNkk Fourie, othe lokhu kuzobe kuhambisana nemvula nomoya onamandla.Uqhube wathi okwamanje ngokomhlahlo wabo, abalindele ukuthi uN3 okukhona kuwo iVan Reenen’s Pass ungathikamezeka kangako.Uthe isimo sizoqala ukuba ngcono ngoLwesibili ntambama, lapho umoya obandayo uzobe usuthanda ukwehla.Uthe bazolokhu besiqaphile isimo sezulu, bese beyabazisa abantu uma kukhona okusha abakutholayo.Ubanxusile ukuthi bangahlukani nokulalela umsakazo babuke ithelevishini ukuze bathole ulwazi olufanele ngesikhathi.Uthe abangakhohlwa nawukubheka kwi-website yabo ethi www.weathersa.co.za kanjalo nasekhasini labo le-X elithi @SAWeatherServic ukuze bathole ulwazi lwakamumva ngesikhathi esifanele.
UZIBUZA uyaziphendula ukuthi kwenzekani ngosuku lwesehlo udadewabo wowesifazane oboshelwe icala lokubulala indodakazi yakhe eyayineminyaka engu-14 emzini okwa-D KwaMashu.Owesifazane, ongathandanga ukuthi kudalulwe igama lakhe, usho kanje emuva kokuvela kukaNksz Ncamisile Hlophe (43) eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseNtuzuma ngoLwesithathu.Usolwa ngokubulala uLuvuyo Tafadzwe Bera isidumbu sakhe esasinamanxeba amathathu okushaywa ngento ethile esiphundu futhi sinezibazi zokuklinywa.Wanqatshelwa ibheyili ngo-Agasti imantshi yakhala ngendlela enesihluku okwabulawa ngayo umufi owayehlala nomsolwa."Asazi nathi ukuthi kwenzekani ngoba babehlala bobabili ekhaya. Asikholwa namanje ukuthi uyena oboshelwe leli cala ngoba asimazi engumuntu ongenza into efana nalena aboshelwe yona,” kusho udadewabo kamsolwa.Uveze ukuthi umufi uhlale okokuqala nonina ngonyaka odlule emuva kweminyaka elishumi ekade ehlala noyise eGauteng.Uthe ngeke aphawule ngokuthi bebunjani ubudlelwano bengane nonina ngoba ubengahlali nabo."Sisamangele nathi ukuthi kwakwenzenjani? Asazi noma baxabana noma wayekade engenwe okuthile (umsolwa). Njengoba siza lapha enkantolo yingoba sifuna ukuthola izimpendulo,” kusho owesifazane obephathele umsolwa okuya ethunjini.Phambilini evela enkantolo umsolwa, omakhelwane bakhe bathi abamazi enjena, bebemazi engumuntu olungile ngakho kumele akhulume iqiniso ukuthi kwenzekani.Uyise wengane ubekhona enkantolo izolo ehamba nowesifazane obefake indandatho. Laba ababili bahlale ngokwehlukana enkantolo nodadewabo kamsolwa. Ngenxa yokuphuthuma owesilisa akakwazanga ukukhuluma nentatheli wacela ukuthi imshayele ucingo.Kuthe uma ethintwa ngocingo wacela ukuba abuye afonelwe.Kuthiwa ngoJulayi 22 nonyaka umsolwa watshela amaphoyisa ukuthi umufi waphuza amaphilisi ekhanda wawa phansi esuka embhedeni ayelele kuwona.Kodwa emuva kokuhlolwa kwesidumbu kwabe sekuvulwa icala lokubulala sekutholakele ukuthi umufi akazishonelanga.Icala lihlehlele u-Okthoba 8 nonyaka ngenxa yokuthi kalifikanga enkantolo idokodo. Kuvele nokuthi icala liphenywa abaseshi ezingeni lesifundazwe.
KUGQAME ubumbano kubaphathiswa baKwaZulu-Natal abake bajamelana phambi kweSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini noMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa.Undunankulu kaZulu ophathiswe uMnyango wokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu, uMnuz Thulasizwe Buthelezi, noMphathiswa wezokuThutha, uMnuz Siboniso Duma, bakhombise ubumbano ngesikhathi kugujwa uMkhosi weLembe.UButhelezi noDuma baba nesiwombe esibi ngasekuqaleni kwalo nyaka ngesikhathi kunomcimbi wokukhumbula iSilo uDinuzulu kaCetshwayo.Kulowo mcimbi owawukwaCeza, uDuma wayabula kabuhlungu umbhobho ngesikhathi uButhelezi ethula inkulumo.Emva komcimbi uButhelezi noDuma baphenduka inkukhu nempaka.Kepha eMkhosini weLembe konke bekukuhle kulaba baholi.Ubumbano lwabo lugqame kakhulu ngesikhathi uButhelezi encoma uDuma phambi kwezinkumbi ebezithamele umkhosi obungoLwesibili.Ngesikhathi uButhelezi ethula iSilo, uncome umsebenzi owenziwe uDuma ukwelekelela abantu abebebhajwe emgwaqweni njengoba belikhithikile ngempelasonto.Laba baholi baqhamuka emaqenjini ezepolitiki ehlukene, uButhelezi uyilungu lesigungu esiphezulu kwi-IFP, uDuma uwusihlalo we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal.Baqale ukubuyisana emva kokubambisana kwamaqembu abo kuhulumeni wokubambisana ophethe isifundazwe. Bake baba nomhlangano wokuthelelana amanzi.Nakuba sekunesikhathi bathelelana amanzi, uDuma ubesanyamanambana emabuthweni abefuna ukuthi ashweleze eSilweni.Ngesikhathi kunomcimbi wokuvulwa kwesiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal, amabutho acula ingoma egadla kuDuma.Muva nje uDuma usanda kushweleza eSilweni. Ekhuluma eMkhosini weLembe, uDuma uthe konke sekuhamba kahle.UDuma uthe uze washutha isithombe esihle nomholi wamabutho owayehamba phambili ecula iculo elimgadlayo ngesikhathi kuvulwa isiShayamthetho, uMntwana uNkinobho Zulu.Obambe njengondunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Thembeni kaMadlopha-Mthethwa, uthe basebenzisana kahle kuhulumeni wokubambisana.UKaMadlopha-Mthethwa uthe abakhohlwe abacabanga ukuthi uzohlakazeka uhulumeni ophethe isifundazwe.UKaMadlopha-Mthethwa uthe ukwakhiwa kukahulumeni wokubambisana kuyafana nokwenziwa iSilo uShaka kaSenzangakhona ngesikhathi sibumba isizwe samaZulu."ILembe labumba isizwe esihlonishwayo nesisatshwayo ngokuhlanganisa amakhosi ahlukene. Ungafunga ukuthi iLembe lalazi ukuthi ngelinye ilanga esifundazweni salo kuyoba nohulumeni wokubambisana, inhlosongqangi yawo, Silo Samabandla, ngukubumbana nokuhloniphana ukuze silethe intuthuko kubantu bonke beSilo."Nokho bakhona Hlanga Lomhlabathi abaphuma eceleni njengojosaka – abafunga bagomele ukuthi lo hulumeni wokubambisana uzoshabalala okwelanga libona amazolo. Njengokuyalela kwakho Silo Samabandla, siyabezwa kodwa asibalaleli.”
ABAZALI nothisha kuzomele bavivele ukudonsa ngejoka lensimbi ngenxa yezindleko zemfundo ngemuva kokugejulwa kwesabelomali soMnyango wezeMfundo eyisiSekelo.Lona ngumbono kaMengameli wenyunyana yothisha i-National Teachers Union, uMnuz Sibusiso Malinga, othe ukuncishiswa kwesabelomali kuzogcina sekushaya kuzwele nakubazali.UMalinga ubenanela inkulumo kaNgqongqoshe woMnyango wezeMfundo eyisiSekelo, uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, obephawula ngalesi simo esithangamini nabezindaba ePitoli izolo.UNksz Gwarube uthe izifundazwe ezahlukene kuleli, zidinga imali ephakathi kuka-R350 million no-R3.8 billion ngonyakamali, ukuvala izikhala zothisha ezivulekile.UMalinga uthe: "Ukungatholi kwezikole izincwadi ezanele, kuphoqa ukuthi abazali bathenge izincwadi ukugcwalisela. Isimo semisebenzi siyabheda, lokho kusho ukuthi uma abazali bengakwazi ukuthenga izincwadi ingcindezi enkulu isala nothisha. Ukungaqashwa kothisha kuphinde kwengeze umsebenzi kwabasuke besebenza njengoba begcina sebefundisa izifundo ezengeziwe okungathikameza imiphumela ezikoleni.” UNgqongqoshe uthe inhloso yesithangami ukuvezela umphakathi izinkinga lo Mnyango obhekene nazo kulandela ukwehliswa kwesabelomali onikwa sona.UNksz Gwarube uthe emasontweni edlule iminyango yezemfundo ezifundazweni iveze ukuthi ibhekene nengcindezi enkulu ngenxa yokushoda kwemali."Ingcindezi isibekhona iminyaka ngenxa yokwehliswa kwesabelomali esinikwa le minyango. Isimo somnotho esingesihle nokungaphathwa ngendlela kwemali kuhulumeni kugcina kuba nomthelela omubi ezikoleni. Ukuncishiswa kwemali enikezwa iminyango kuholela ekwehleni kwesibalo sothisha abaqashwayo, ukuncishiswa kwezincwadi zesikole, ukuncipha kwesibalo sabasebenzi abalekelela ngemisebenzi yasemahhovisi ezikoleni okuholela ekutheni othisha bazenzele lowo msebenzi, okulimaza isikhathi sokufundisa. Konke lokho kubeka ikusasa lezingane engcupheni,” usho kanje.Ukusho lokhu nje, uMnyango wezeMfundo esifundazweni i-Western Cape usuvele umemezele isinqumo sokwehliswa ukuqashwa kothisha ngonyaka ozayo ngenhloso yokuhambisana nesabelomali esincishisiwe, okusho ukuthi othisha kuzodingeka bafundise ikilasi elinesibalo esikhulu sabafundi.UNksz Gwarube uthe ngeshwa lokhu sekukapakela nakwezinye izifundazwe ngenxa yesizathu esifanayo.Uthe eminyakeni emibili noma emithathu ezayo, iminyango ezifundazweni izothola kunzima ukuvala izikhala zothisha ezivulekile ngesabelomali enaso, ngaphandle uma kukhona imizamo engenziwa ukugwema lesi simo."Isibonelo nje ngonyakamali u-2025/2026, izifundazwe ezine zizobhekana nobunzima ekuqashweni kothisha, ngo-2026/2027 zizoba nhlanu bese kuthi ngo-2027/2028 zibe yisikhombisa izifundazwe ezizobhekana nalesi simo,” usho kanje.UNksz Gwarube uthe eminyakeni emihlanu eyedlule, isibalo sabafundi sikhule ngo-292 820, kanti ukukhula kwesibalo sabafundi esothisha singakhuli kuphazamisa izinga lemfundo etholakala ezikoleni.Nakuba kunjalo, uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, ngenyanga edlule ukhangise izikhala zothisha ezevile ku-700, ukufakwa kwezicelo okuvalwe ngoLwesihlanu.UNksz Gwarube uthe ukubhekana ngqo nalesi simo, uhlangane nabaphathiswa bomnyango kuzona zonke izifundazwe ukubheka ukuthi yiziphi izinselelo isifundazwe nesifundazwe esibhekene nazo. Uthe ucele umhlangano ophuthumayo noNgqongqoshe woMnyango wezeziMali.Ukhale ngokukhula kancane komnotho kuleli okuthiwa kungaphansi kuka-1%, nenkohlakalo okuthiwa isidle imali engu-R1.5 trillion phakathi kuka-2014 no-2023 okunomthelela omubi emnothweni. Uthe uhulumeni kumele ubeke eqhulwini iminyango ebalulekile inikezwe isabelomali esithe xaxa ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ikhipha imiphumela egculisayo.

UMENGAMELI wezwe, uCyril Ramaphosa, utuse uhulumeni wokubambisana ophethe iNingizimu Afrika ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabaholi bamazwe omhlaba.URamaphosa uthe uhulumeni wokubambisana ongene emva kokhetho lwangoMeyi, usuqalile ukusombulula izinkinga ezibhekene nezwe.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma emhlanganweni wenhlangano yezizwe i-UN General Assembly oqhubeka eNew York, eMelika.Kuleli sonto kuphela izinsuku ezingu-100 kwakhiwa uhulumeni wokubambisana.Bekungokokuqala ukuba uRamaphosa ahambele eMelika kusukela kwakhiwa uhulumeni wokubambisana.URamaphosa uthe isiqalile ukubonakala imisebenzi yohulumeni wokubambisana."Isimo somnotho wethu sesingcono kakhulu kanti futhi nabatshalimali babuyelwe ithemba. Ikusasa lezwe libukeka liqhakazile. Uhulumeni wokubambisa uzosiyisa endaweni engcono, ezweni lesethembiso.”URamaphosa uthe ukwakhiwa kohulumeni wokubambisana kukhombisa ukukhula kwentando yeningi eNingizimu Afrika."INingizimu Afrika yathola inkululeko eminyakeni engu-30 eyedlule. Namhlanje iNingizimu Afrika iyizwe elikhululekile. Sisanda kuba nokhetho lwesikhombisa ngaphansi kombuso wentando yeningi."Imiphumela yokhetho lwakamumva iyona eyenze ukuthi sigcine siba nohulumeni wokubambisana. Uhulumeni wokubambisana wakhiwe amaqembu ayishumi afuna ukukhulisa umnotho, ukudala amathuba emisebenzi, nokuqeda indlala.”URamaphosa nabanye ongqongqoshe ilokhu batheleka eNew York ngeledlule lapho bexoxa khona nabaholi bamazwe omhlaba nabatshalimali.URamaphosa uphinde wesebenzisa enye yezinkulumo zakhe ukunxusa ukuba izwekazi i-Afrika limeleleke ngendlela emkhandlwini wezokuphepha kwi-UN.URamaphosa uthe akulungile ukuthi i-Afrika ingabi naso isihlalo emkhandlwini wezokuphepha.Uthe bakhathazekile ngezinxushunxushu eziqhubeka emazweni omhlaba, wabala impi ephakathi kwelaKwa-Israel neHamas.Sekuyophela unyaka kwaqubuka le mpi esidlule nemiphefumulo engaphezu kuka-40 000.URamaphosa uthe akwanele okwenziwe amazwe omhlaba ukuqeda le mpi."Abantu basePalestine babhekene nodlame oluyisihluku esinzima. Sekuneminyaka abantu basePalestine becindezelwe yi-Israel. Thina njengeNingizimu Afrika siyazi ukuthi kunzima kanjani ukuphila ngaphansi kwengcindezelo. "Saphila ngaphansi kobandlulo. Sahlupheka kabi ngesikhathi kuphethe uhulumeni wobandlululo. Ingakho singeke sithule uma sibona kukhona abancindezelekile. Ingakho sifuna ukuthi kuqiniswe imithetho, kuthathelwe izinyathelo labo abenza okuphambene.”
SINCIPHE kancane isibalo sabantu abane-HIV KwaZulu-Natal njengoba sisuke ku-1.99 million ngo-2017 saya ku-1.98 million ngo-2022.Lokhu kuvezwe wucwaningo lwakamuva lwe-Human Sciences Research Council (HSRC).USolwazi Khangelani Zuma obehola ucwaningo lwe-SAHRC, uthe ngo-2022, i-HIV ibitholakala kakhulu kulabo abaneminyaka ephakathi kuka-25 kuya ku-49 njengoba ibiku-31.1%, kwabesifazane ibiwu-38.4%, bese kuthi kwabesilisa ibe wu-21.5%.Uthe iKwaZulu-Natal ayisahambi phambili ngokusabalala kwe-HIV njengoba isibalo sayo siku-16%, sekuhamba phambili iMpumalanga lapho kutholwe khona ukuthi ukusabalala kwe-HIV kuku-17% okubeka abantu abaphila ne-HIV kulesiya sifundazwe ku-890 000.Ubalule ukuthi yize ukusabalala kwe-HIV KwaZulu-Natal kwehlile kodwa lesi sifundazwe sisenabantu abaningi abaphila ne-HIV ngenxa yokuthi vele sinabantu abaningi (high population numbers).Uthe okuhle wukuthi u-87% wabantu abane-HIV udla imishanguzo futhi u-87% uyidla kahle imishanguzo. Lokhu kuholela ekuthithibaliseni igciwane nokuthi bangalidluliseli kwabanye.Uzwakalise ukukhathazeka ngokuthelelana nge-HIV kubantu abaneminyaka ewu-15 kuya ku-24 athe yibona abasengcupheni yokutheleleka nge-HIV nokungayidli imishanguzo njengoba bengakukhuthalele ukuzihlola. Nalabo abaneminyaka ewu-45 kuya ku-49, kuvele ukuthi bayatheleleka nge-HIV ngenxa yendlela yokuziphatha (sexual behaviour).Uthe kufanele kuqalwe phansi imikhankaso yokuqwashisa nge-HIV, ihambe phambili njengoba kwakwenzeka ngesikhathi kuqwashiswa ngeCovid-19.Ugqugquzele abantu ukuthi baye ocansini oluphephile ngoba ocwaningweni kuvele ukuthi kwehlile ukusetshenziswa kwamakhondomu.Amadoda uthe kufanele asokwe ngoba kufanele kusetshenziswe zonke izindlela zokunqanda i-HIV.
UFUNA kusondele uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant-General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi nezakhe umphakathi wasoSizweni, eNewcastle, kuqala phansi amaqembu emigulukudu ahlalisa abantu lubhojozi.Lokhu kulandela ukubulawa kwabantu abayisihlanu ezehlakalweni ezehlukene, okuthiwa babulawe ngezindlela ezehlukene. Kusolwa ukuthi babulawe amaqembu emigulukudu.Ilungu lomphakathi elicele ukungadalulwa, liveze ukuthi amaqembu emigulukudu ahlalisa lubhojozi umphakathi anamalungu ayizingane ezincane.Lithe amalungu alama qembu aneminyaka ephakathi kuka-15 no-20.Lithe ababili, babulawe esehlakelweni esisodwa, kwantshontshwa isibhamu soyedwa wabafi, bamdubula ngaso, kwathi umngani wakhe, bamgwaza."Omunye owayezama ukulwela umphakathi, bamhlasela kubo, bangena ngewindi, bamgwaza phambi kwabazali bakhe. Omunye bamhlasela ezihambela emgwaqweni, bamgwaza,” kusho umthombo.Uthe ngenxa yalezi zigameko, abantu abaningi abasahambi bakhululeke, wathi kuba nzima kakhulu uma sekuhwalele.Uthe okubuhlungu ukuthi akukho okutheni abangakwenza njengoba bebaningi ngendlela yokuthi ababaleki.Ubalule nokuthi kwathi sekusondela impelasonto yoMkhosi woMhlanga, kwasiza inkampani yonogada yomunye wonomehlo, besho ukuziqeda izintombi nto, befuna ukuzidlwengula."Ezinyangeni ezedlule, bangene emtholampilo wendawo, bakhuthuza abahlengikazi neziguli ebusuku. Ngaleso sizathu uke wavalwa eside isikhathi umtholampilo, kuthe noma usuvulwa, satshelwa ukuthi ngeke usavulwa ebusuku, usuzosebenza emini kuphela,” kusho umthombo."Uma kungafika uMkhwanazi neNIU, siyakholwa ukuthi kungaba ngcono,” kusho umthombo.Uthe okunye okubakhathazayo yimithetho yakuleli evuna izingane ezineminyaka engaphansi kuka-18 ezenza ubugebengu."Zenza ubugebengu obunzima, zibulala abantu. Ziboshwe, zibuye zidedelwe ngoba kuthiwa zincane,” kusho umthombo.Ngo-2021, le ndawo ike yahlaselwa elinye iqembu lemigulukudu elalaziwa ngokuthi 'ama-last warnings’.Kuthiwa laze lanqotshwa ukungenela kukangqongqoshe wamaphoyisa ophumile nosomatekisi bendawo okuthiwa bazivikela ngokwabo kulona.Ikhansela lendawo, uMnuz Vusumuzi Sibeko ukuqinisekisile ukuthi umphakathi awuhlalisekile kahle ngenxa yamaqembu emigulukudu.Uthe kahle hle ziyisithupha izidumbu zababulewe imigulukudu, athe iyazicanasela emphakathini."Lezi zingane zincane kodwa zibulala ngempela. Abanye babo basafunda, abanye basiyeka isikole. Uma beqhamuka kuyacaca ngoba bahloma ngemimese, izizenze, obhushu futhi bahamba beyiqembu mhlawumbe babe ngu-30 bagcwale umgwaqo," kusho uSibeko.Uthe bahlasela emini ilanga libalele, wathi bagqihe nangamabhande athile."Okusiphatha kabi ukuthi kukhona abazali abasenkingeni yokuzisaba lezi zingane, ngesikhathi abanye beziphikela," usho kanje.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uCol Robert Netshiunda, uthe uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa ubuqaphile bonke ubugebengu kulesi sifundazwe, kodwa uma umphakathi unomuzwa wokuthi udinga usizo oluthe xaxa, kufanele ukuveze lokho kumphathi siteshi wendawo."Uma behluleka, badlulele esifundeni, nakhona uma bengasizakali, bese beza kukhomishana wesifundazwe," kusho uNetshiunda.
KUYAPHELA ngezinombolo ozifonela uma udinga usizo oluphuthumayo kuleli okuyi-10111, 10177 kanjalo no-107.Lezi zinombolo zifonelwa uma udinga usizo lwamaphoyisa, udinga usizo lwama-ambulensi kanjalo nolunye usizo.IKhabhinethi isigunyaze ukuthi lokhu kukhishelwe umphakathi ukuze uphawule ngokuvalwa kwaezinombolo.Inhloso ngukuthi kube nenombolo eyodwa ezosetshenziswa abantu bakuleli uma benezinkinga.Esithangamini sakamuva emuva komhlangano weKhabhinethi, uNgqongqoshe ehhovisi likamengameli, uNksz Khumbudzo Ntshavheni, uthe umphakathi uzonikwa ithuba lokuthi uphawule ngokuvalwa kwalezi zinombolo.Uthe inhloso kahulumeni ngukuthi kube nenombolo eyodwa, okuzobalula ukuthi abantu bayikhumbule.Inombolo entsha ezosetshenziswa ithi: 112."Kubanzima ukukhumbula izinombolo eziningi uma ufuna usizo lwamaphoyisa noma usizo lwezempilo. Yingakho kumele kube nenombolo eyodwa ezoba mfishane okuzobalula ukuyikhumbula,” kusho uNksz Ntshavheni.Sekuke kwabakhona izikhalo ngenombolo yokucela usizo emaphoyiseni i-10111.EPhalamende amalungu ekomiti lamaPhoyisa ake akhala ngokuthi le nombolo ayisheshi ukuphendulwa.Kwesinye isikhathi kuthiwa le nombolo imane ivaleke esikhaleni ofuna usizo engazelele.Okunye okukhalwe ngakho yindaba yokushoda kwabasebenzi lapho kufonelwa khona, okwenza izingcingo zingabanjwa ngesikhathi. Ngesikhathi uMnuz Bheki Cele esengungqongqoshe wamaphoyisa, waveza ukuthi kusuka onyakeni wezimali u-2018/2019, zibalelwa ku-14.9 million kwezingu-56.99 million, izingcingo ezingaphendulwanga ezazifonela i-10111. Waveza nokuthi lesi sikhungo kumele ngabe sinabasebenzi ababalelwa ku-3 344 kodwa sinababalelwa ku-1 315.Ukunqanyulwa kwesabelomali seminyango ehlukene kuleli kube nomthelela ekutheni ezinye izikhala zingavalwa eminyangweni ehlukene.Ngokwamaphoyisa le nombolo isetshenziselwa ukubika amacala aphuthumayo.Isebenza amahora angu-24, kanti ifonelwa mahhala uma usebenzisa i-landline. Uma usebenzisa iselula kudla imali ejwayelekile. Zonke izingcingo ziyaqoshwa.Kuhlale kunxuswa umphakathi ukuthi ungadlaleli kule nombolo ngokubika amacala angekho.

NGOKUSHO kwamalungu omphakathi, kuthiwa liziphephise ngokuzinikela esiteshini samaphoyisa liyobhaca khona libalekela ulaka lwawo (umphakathi) obulifuna uthuli, ikhehla laseMpophomeni, eHowick, okuputshuke i-video lizithokozisa ngocansi nentombazane okukholakala ukuthi ineminyaka engaphansi kuka-16.Lesi sigameko esenzeke ngeSonto, kuthiwa umphakathi waseMagwababeni, eMpophomeni, uvuke umbhejazane wanikela emzini wale ndoda (igama layo eligodliwe emva kokuthi ingatholakalanga ukuthi iziphendulele) okuvele ukuthi ineminyaka eyevile ku-60, emva kokuthi kuthe ngoLwesihlanu, kwaputshuka i-video yayo izitika ngocansi nomfundi yasabalala ezinkundeni zokuxhumana.Ilungu lomphakathi elihlala khona endaweni elingathandanga kudalulwa lilandisa Isolezwe, lithe ngendlela le ndoda ebithenjwe ngayo emphakathini, kuwethusile ukubonakala kwe-video yayo yenza amanyala."Uwumuntu ozihlalela yedwa kubo, kanti bakhona abebembuza ukuthi njengoba esekhulile kungani engethathi unkosikazi kodwa ubelokhu engena ezintangeni kanti yena uyazi ukuthi wenzani. Izingane zethu zamantombazane ezincane aziphephile, besifisa ukuthi aboshwe ajeze ngoba lesi senzo sifaka indawo yangakithi ehlazweni,” lisho kanje.Ilungu lomphakathi lithe akaqali ukunukeka ezenzweni zokunukubeza ngokocansi izingane ezincane njengoba kuyisigameko abeke wasoleka ngaso eminyakeni eyishumi eyedlule lapho wayesolwa ekunukubezeni ezabafana kodwa icala elalivuliwe lagcina liphela.Kwi-video, Isolezwe eliyibonile, kubonakala owesifazane osemncane ngeminyaka ebusweni engakhombisi ukuthokozela okwenziwa kuye ngesikhathi lo wesilisa emphenduphendula, okwenza amanye amalungu omphakathi asole ukuthi kungenzeka kwakungayona intando yakhe kodwa wayeyikhohlise ngokuyinika okuthile.Nakuba kunjalo, elinye ilungu lomphakathi liveze ukuthi ngesikhathi kuhlaselwa le ndoda, owesifazane uveze ukuthi bayathandana waphinde wagxeka umphakathi ngokugxambukela ezindabeni zabo. Kuthiwa ngesikhathi eziphendulela owesilisa, uveze ukuthi owesifazane uneminyaka ewu-20 futhi unawo umazisi wakhe oveza lokho, okuyinto eshayisanayo nokushiwo wumphakathi. Kuthiwa uphinde waveza ukuthi baneminyaka emithathu bethandana futhi kuyaziwa nakubo. Ecacisa ngokusabalala kwe-video yabo bezitika ngocansi, kuthiwa uthe ulahlekelwe yiselula yakhe ngoLwesihlanu, usola ukuthi abayitholile yibona abasabalalise le video, okuyikhona okumdonsele amanzi ngomsele. Nakuba kunjalo, kuthiwa ukuqinisekisile ukuthi yayithathwe ngokuvumelana nathandana naye, okuqinisekiswe nawukuthi owesifazane aveze ukuthi alikho icala azomvulela lona. Elinye ilungu lomphakathi elikhulume neSolezwe, lithe bakholwa ukuthi intombazane isadungeke umqodo futhi okubuhlungu ukuthi kwi-video esabalele, ayisetshenzisiwe ikhondomu okubeka impilo yengane engcupheni.Imizamo yokuthola izinombolo zalaba bobabili noma izihlobo zabo ayiphumelelanga Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant Colonel Robert Netshiunda, uqinisekise ukuthi kalikho icala elivulwe emaphoyiseni aseHowick, nawaseMpophomeni.

Esinye sezitshudeni ebezifunda kulesi sikhungo, esicele ukuthi lingadalulwa igama laso ukuze siphephe, sithe sishaqeke kwaphela nasozwaneni sithola lezi zindaba, sizizwa ngabanye abathole imiyalezo, okuthiwa isatshalaliswe ngezinkundla zokuxhumana ngabasebenzi basekolishi."Ngathintwa ngocingo ngabekolishi ngo-Agasti 21, bengazisa ukuthi umcimbi wethu wokuthweswa iziqu uzoba kusasa, ngahlela yonke into ngoba yinto okukade ngiyifisa empilweni. Bengilokhu ngilindele ukuthi bangithumelele isimemo nge-email njengokuthembisa kwabo, nakhu manje sengizwa ngalokhu. Ngiphoxeke kakhulu ngoba ngisebenze kanzima ukuze ngifike kulesi sigaba esikusona manje,” kusho isitshudeni.Siqhuba, sisole abaphathi bekolishi ngokungasingathi lolu daba ngendlela efanele, nangokungena ezintangeni ngesizathu esenze kwahoxiswa umcimbi ngomzuzu wokugcina, sekuhlelwe konke."Ngizwe ngesonto eledlule ukuthi umcimbi awusezukuba khona, ngaqale ngangakholwa, ngizitshela ukuthi abantu bayaphosisa. Kuthe ngithinta isikhungo ngibuza, baqale bangitshela ukuthi uhlehliselwe u-Okthoba, nalapho futhi bangacacisa ukuthi yini isizathu salokho. Yeka ukusebenza kwethu kanzima,”’ sisho kanje.Isolezwe liyibonile eminye yemiyalezo, lapho ingxenye yalezi zitshudeni, ize yenza i-group kaWhatsApp, ishayana ngamakhanda, kubhungwa ukuthi kungani isikhungo sihoxise umcimbi ngemizuzu yokugcina.Liyibonile futhi imiyalezo ethunyelwe ngokuthiwa ungomunye wabaphathi bakuleli kolishi, azisa izitshudeni ukuthi umcimbi awusezukuba khona, engachazi ukuthi kungani uhoxisiwe.Esinye isitshudeni, naso sikhale ngokuthi lezi zindaba bezingamukeleka kalula ukuba baziswe ngazo kusenesikhathi, futhi ngendlela efanele, hhayi ukuthunyelelwa imiyalezo ehamba ibhuza ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, bedluliselana yona."Okubuhlungu kakhulu wukuthi bese sihlele yonke into, abanye bethu baze bakhokhela nezindawo zokulala eziseThekwini ngoba behlala kude, futhi bengeke bakwazi ukufika emcimbini, bese begoduka ngosuku olulodwa. Ngizwe nokuthi kunesitshudeni esiseDubai, lapho ebesisebenza khona, ebese sikhokhele ngisho amathikithi ebhanoyi ukuza emcimbini,” kusho isitshudeni.Kuthintwa uMnuz Mthokozisi Ndlovu, osezinhlakeni zobuholi kuleli kolishi, ubuze intatheli ukuthi inombolo yakhe iyithathe kuphi, wacela ukuthi kuthintwe owophiko lwezokuxhumana, athe nguyena ozoba nezimpendulo eziqondile ngalolu daba.Ethintwa owophiko lwezokuxhumana, uMnuz Thami Ngcobo, ucingo lwakhe belukhala umlibe lungabanjwa, wangawuphendula umyalezo awuthunyelelwe nge-WhatsApp.

Ugwetshwe udilikajele ngecala lokuzama ukubulala nokudlwengula owayeyisosha ongamtshelanga ayethandana naye ukuthi uphila negciwane lengculaza agcina emthelela ngalo.ULeon Santos Conga ugwetshwe eNkantolo yeMantshi ePitoli eyamthola enecala ngoJuni.Umgilwa, u-Antoinette Ndishishi, obemelwe wuphiko lwezokushushisa lwe-AfriForum wabika lolu daba kulo ngo-2018.I-AfriForum yaphoqa iSouth African National Defence Force (SANDF) ukuthi ikhiphe umlando wezempilo kaConga owaveza ukuthi wayazi ngokuthi unegciwane kusuka ngo-2007.Ithe ukunqaba kweSANDF ukuthi ikhiphe umlando kaConga kwenza ukuthi uphiko lwezokushushisa umphakathi, iNational Prosecuting Authority (NPA), iluhoxise kabili udaba enkantolo.UMGILWA u-Antoinette Ndishishi Isithombe: SITHUNYELWEEsitatimendeni, i-AfriForum yathi imantshi yathola uConga enecala lokudlwengula ngoba uNdishishi wavuma ukuthi baye ocansini ngoba azi ukuthi akanalo igciwane. Ithe inkantolo ibamukele ubufakazi bukaNdishishi bokuthi ukuba uConga wasidalula isimo sakhe, wayengeke avume ukuthi balale njengoba lezi zithandani zakhuluma ngalolu daba kodwa uConga wayigodla imininingwane.UConga watholwa enecala lokuzama ukubulala ngoba wathelela uNdishishi ngegciwane azi ukuthi unalo futhi wangamtshela.UNdishishi ubonge i-AfriForum, wathi ngaphambi kwayo ubesekwa wunina kuphela.
NAKUBA lingahambisani nohlelo lokunqunywa kwezimpondo zobhejane ngokugcwele iPhini likaNgqongqoshe wezaMahlathi, ukuDoba nezeMvelo, uMnuz Narend Singh, kodwa lithe liyakweseka.USingh sho kanje ngeSonto, eHluhluwe Imfolozi Park (HiP), ngesikhathi ehambele ukubungazwa kosuku lobhejane.Kulo mcimbi, abezeMvelo KZN Wildlife, bakhombise uSingh ukuthi lwenziwa kanjani uhlelo lokunqunywa kobhejane izimpondo ngenhloso yokubavikela kulabo ababazingelela izimpondo zabo.USingh uthe lolu hlelo akalweseki ngokugcwele ngoba uyakholelwa ekutheni obhejane badalwa nezimpondo ngenhloso ethile."Kodwa ngoba kuzanywa ukuthi kuxoshwe labo ababazingelayo kuphinde kuqinisekiswe nokuthi akube kusaba khona ukubaluleka kwabo uma sebekhishwe izimpondo, yikho lusunguliwe,” kusho uSingh.Uthe kusukela abezeMvelo beluqalile, sehle ngamandla isibalo sokuhlaselwa kwabo."Siyafisa ukuthi le nto kungabi yinto esizoyenza unomphelo kodwa kube ukuthi sithola ezinye izindlela zokulwa nalobu bugebengu bokuzingelwa kwabo,” kusho uSingh.Uthe bakhathazekile ngokuzingelwa kobhejane, wathi bakhala nangalabo abasekhaleni lalokhu, athe yibo abakhipha imali eshisiwe, bakhokhele labo abahamba bayozingela lezi zilwane, bazibulalele izimpondo zazo."Namuhla sikhumbula amakhulu ngamakhulu obhejane, ababulawe ngesihluku. Sigubha nohlelo oluqhamuke nabezeMvelo ngohlelo lokukhishwa kwezimpondo zabo,” usho kanje.Isikhulu sezemvelo KZN Wildlife, uMnuz Sihle Mkhize, sithe banezinhlelo eziningi ukuzama ukulwa nesihlava sokubulawa kobhejane."Olunye lwazo, olokusebenzisana nemiphakathi eyahlukene. Sisungula amabhodi emiphakathini ehlukene, ukuze akwazi ukusilekelela ngomsebenzi wokuvikela ezemvelo,” kusho uMkhize.Uthe sebesungule nezemidlalo ezindaweni ezehlukene lapho okudlalwa khona ibhola lezinyawo nebhola lomnqakiswano, kube kufundiswa abantu ngokubaluleka kokuvikelwa kobhejane.Ubuye wathi kwezinye izinhlelo, baqasha wona umphakathi ukuthi ugade izingcingo ezibiye iziqiwi."Sibuye sibe nanohlelo lokumpimpa ngokuzingelwa kwabo obhejane ukuze sikwazi ukulwa nalolu bhubhane,” kusho uMkhize.Uhlelo lokunqunywa kobhejane izimpondo kuqalwe ngo-Ephreli nonyaka. Ngokwezibalo zangoMeyi nangoJuni nonyaka, kuvela ukuthi kubulawe obhejane abangu-21 (Meyi 2024) no-22 (Juni 2024), uma kuqhathaniswa nesibalo sabangu.42 (Meyi 2023) nabangu-34 (Juni 2023) nababulawa ngesikhathi esifanayo nyakenye.

KUHLATSHWE ikhwelo kwabafundi bakwa-matric ukuthi bangapholisi maseko bafake izicelo zoxhaso esikhwameni iNational Students’ Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS).Lokhu kulandela ukuvulwa ngokusemthethweni kohlelo lokufaka izicelo zoxhaso lokufunda ngonyaka ozayo.Isifundazwe iKwaZulu-Natal yisona esihamba phambili ngezicelo ezitholwe yilesi sikhwama ngesikhathi siqala ukwamukela izicelo ngoLwesihlanu.Kuthe kushona ilanga ngoLwesihlanu bese bebalelwa ngaphezu kuka-172 000 abese befaka izicelo.UNgqongqoshe weMfundo ePhakeme, uDkt Nobuhle Nkabane, unxuse abafuna uxhaso ukuthi abangawapholisi amaseko. "Sivule lolu hlelo ukuze izitshudeni zikwazi ukusheshe zifake izicelo zokuxhaswa yi-NSFAS. Usuku lokuvala ukufaka izicelo nguDisemba 15, nonyaka kodwa izitshudeni nabafundi abangalindi kuze kube ngumzuzu wokugcina ngaphambi kokufaka izicelo.” Uthe nabafundi abenza u-matric abaqala izivivinyo zabo, abafake izicelo manje."Nalabo abenza u-matric abazobhala sithi abafake izicelo zoxhaso zangonyaka ozayo bangaze balinde kuze kuphume imiphumela yabo. Silindele ukuthi kuvalwa uhlelo lokufakwa kwezicelo sibe sesithole ezibalelwa ku-800 000,” kuqhuba uDkt Nkabane.Uthe abagcini ngokuxhasa ngemali yokufunda labo abazali babo abahola kusuka ku-R350 000 kuya phansi."Siboleka nemali yokufunda nalabo abazali babo abahola kusuka ku-R350 000 kuya ku-R600 000 ngonyaka. Leli qoqo laziwa nge-missing middle kanti siyazi kukhona nabanye ababalelwa ku-161 000, abafunda ngemifundaze ehlukene abangathembele kwi-NSFAS.” Lolu hlelo lokufawa kwezicelo lwenziwe nasezikoleni eziyisishiyagalolunye kuleli. KwaZulu-Natal lwenziwe e-Edendale Technical High, eMgungundlovu.Umlawuli we-NSFAS, uMnuz Freeman Nomvalo, uthe iKZN yisona sifundazwe esinesibalo esiphezulu esiqale safaka izicelo. Uthe kubalulekile ukuthi izitshudeni zilethe izimfanelo ezifanele neziqondile uma zifaka izicelo.Uqhube wathi ngeke uxhaswe uma kungukuthi awamukelwanga esikhungweni semfundo ephakeme.Uveze ukuthi abahola isondlo sabantwana bayaxhaswa, akukho mgadagada eminingi edingeka kubona."Kwabafaka izicelo zoxhaso kumele bangene kwi-website ye-NSFAS, bagcwalise imininingwane bese befaka ulwazi oludingekayo. Sihlela ukuthi kuphele unyaka sibe sesibaphendulile abazoxhaswa,” kusho uNomvalo.Uthe imininingwane okufakwe ngayo izicelo bayibheka ezinhlakeni ezifana nesikhwama esiqoqa intela iSARS, ukuthi iyahambisana.

BAHLAZEKILE abelaphi bendabuko asebezakhele udumo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana kuvela izindaba zokuthi bawaka abantu futhi abasuke bekuveza kungamanga ngenhloso yokuheha amakhasimende.Lezi zindaba zivele kuleli sonto kuxabane owayengumsakazi weZululand FM noseyintatheli yekhasi leYouTube, Inyoni TV, uGwajo Zungu nomelaphi, uZamokwakhe "King Bhaka” Nzama.UGwajo uhlambalaze uKing Bhaka ngama-video aqoshiwe, lapho abethi yena akakaze aye emzini walo melaphi eHillary, eThekwini, futhi abakaze bahlangane. Uze wambiza ngomfana omncane angamesabi.UKing Bhaka naye uvele waya ekhasini lakhe waveza bonke ubufakazi bokuthi bayazana noGwajo nokuthi usake wafika emzini wakhe. Uphinde wasabalalisa nezinkulumo eziqoshiwe ekhuluma noGwajo, ezisholo yena ukuthi zonke lezi ziqephu ezike zibonakale ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ekhuluma nabelaphi bendabuko, zingamanga. Kule nkulumo uGwajo uzisholo yena ukuthi zisuke zisungulwe nguyena, bese eqeqesha izinyanga ukuthi zilingise kanjani.UGWAJO Zungu othi ubona ikusasa lakhe limfiliba emva kokuvela kwezindaba zokuthi kusuke kulingiswa uma kushuthwa 'izimanga’ okuthiwa zenziwa yizinyanga ezivela esiteshini sakhe Inyoni TV Isithombe: FACEBOOK Izinyanga okuvela amagama azo ngokuhubhuza amanga ngoDr Khehlelezi, Dr Mabalengwe noDr 2+2. KuMabalengwe uveze udaba alushutha lapho lo melaphi ayesenkantolo kwacisha ugesi ngenxa yokucimasakuwonga kodwa wathi uyena owenze kwacisha ugesi esebenzisa amandla akhe obunyanga. Lokho kuthiwa yinto abavele bayisungula noGwajo ngoba bebona kucisha ugesi enkantolo. KuKhehlelezi, uveze ukuthi ngesikhathi kushuthwa le nyanga ithi ilanda imali emanzini, kwakuyinto engekho, eyayakhiwe. Uze waveza ukuthi isiteshi se-online i-Real TV eyayishutha uKhehlelezi, ayikwazanga ukuhlunga kahle i-video ukuze ikholakale. Uphinde waveza ukuthi nesimo sale nyanga asisihle, isilahlekelwe amakhasimende ngoba kukhona asebebonile ukuthi ayikho into yayo. Uthe kumanje isimo sayo sinzima kwezezimali, ize ifune ngisho neziliphu ima ithume umuntu esitolo ngoba isigade lonke isenti eliphumayo.UMENGAMELI wenhlangano yabelaphi bendabuko, i-Traditonal Healers Council, uMnuz Sazi Mhlongo othi izinyanga zezinkundla zokuxhumana sezidlale kakhulu ngabantu Isithombe: SIGCINIWEKu-2+2, uthe isiqephu abasanda kusishutha lapho bekuvela khona uGwajo eyoxolisa ngenkomo ethi usenenkinga ngoba uxabane nale nyanga, singamanga. Uthe nenkomo yokuxolisa bekuvele kungeyakhe u-2+2.Kuthintwa uKing Bhaka ngenhloso yakhe yokusabalalisa lezi zindaba, uthe akaxabene noGwajo kodwa uyena ongungqondongqondo ekusunguleni izikeshi ku-Facebook ukuze kudayiswe imikhiqizo yezinyanga ezikhohlisa abantu."Kudala ngizixwayisa lezi zinyanga ukuthi zingadlali ngabantu. Ngigcine ngibonile ukuthi kungcono ngivele ngiyiveze imikhuba yazo. Inkinga ukuthi le nto eziyenzayo ilimaza igama lobunyanga bese kuba sengathi wonke umuntu wenza le nto eziyenzayo,” kusho uKing Bhaka.Kuthintwa uGwajo, uthe imlimaze kakhulu indaba yokuvela kwalezi zindaba."Kuyaziwa ukuthi mina ngiphila ngawo lo msebenzi. Ngakhile futhi ngisanda kulobola unkosikazi wami ngawo lo msebenzi. Uma sekwenzeka kanje angazi yinto engizoyithini. Le nto ilimaze ngisho nekusasa lami ngoba ngelinye ilanga benginesifiso sokuthi ngisebenzele iziteshi ezinkulu njengeSABC kodwa sengibona amathuba engasekho. Angisazi isizathu esenze uBhaka enze kanje. Okwamanje ngisanqena ngisho nokuvela kubantu ngendlela okwenzeke ngayo,” kusho uGwajo.Bonke abelaphi abathintekayo kulolu daba, bashayelwe izingcingo kodwa izingcingo zabo bebengaziphenduli. Nemiyalezo abathunyelelwe yona abayiphendulanga.Umengameli wabelaphi bendabuko i-Traditional Healers Council KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Sazi Mhlongo, uthe yize bengahambisani nokuvela kwalezi zindaba ngezinkundla zokuxhumana, kodwa bayabonga ukuthi sekuvezwe obala lokhu."Kudala sibona ukuthi kudlalwa ngabantu kusetshenziswa izinkundla zokuxhumana kodwa engekho umuntu okhulumayo ngale nto. Kuyiqiniso, laba abagcwele khona ezinkundleni bethi bayelapha, iningi labo zigebengu. Kunenqwaba yabo abahamba amacala okudlwengula ngoba bafike bethi basiza abantu bese beyabadlwengula. Abanye baveza izinyoka. Ekwelapheni awukwazi ukuveza inyoka bese uthi ungumelaphi. Inyoka iyaluma futhi ayikho into enhle eyamaniswa nenyoka. Abantu abaqaphele izigilamkhuba ezizibiza ngezinyanga,” kusho uMhlongo.

KUPHELILE ngezikhaftini ezibizayo zakwaTupperware njengoba abanikazi bale nkampani e-United States befake amaphepha aveza ukuthi abanamali enkantolo.Le nkampani ivale ifemu yayo yokugcina e-United States kulo nyaka kwahlukumezeka abasebenzi abangu-150 abadiliziwe.Ngokombiko weReuters, le nkampani ifake amaphepha okuthi ayinamali ngoLwesibili, kanti kuvele ukuthi ikweleta u-R12 billion engakwazi ukuwukhokha.Kuvele ukuthi ngonyaka odlule iye yakhala ngokwehla kokuthengwa kwezitsha zayo.Ize yaxosha obeyisikhulu sayo uMnuz Miguel Fernandez, isikhala sakhe savalwa nguNksz Laurie Ann Goldman njengoba isifake amaphepha okuthi ayinamali.ITupperware yasungulwa ngo-1946, emuva kokuthi umsunguli wayo uMnuz Earl Tupper ekhiqize isikhaftini esinesivalo esingakuchithi ukudla kodwa esivuleka uma sesivulwa wumuntu.Lezi zikhaftini kuthiwa zaba nedumela elikhulu kwabesifazane okuyibona ababenzela abayeni ukudla abazokuphatha emsebenzini, babe sebeqala ukuzidayisa benza nemicimbi okwakusuke kuhlangenwe kuwo ukuheha abanye ukuba badayise izikhaftini.Kuthiwa kule minyaka ewu-80, i-Tupperware ibincike kakhulu kubantu abayidayisela imikhiqizo yayo ngaphandle kokuthola uqeqesho oluthile, iningi labantu abawu-300 000 abadayisa i-Tupperware kuthiwa bekungabesifazane.Ezinkundleni zokuxhumana kuhlukene imibono njengoba usaziwayo wakuleli, u-Anele Mdoda, enze ihlaya lokuthi abantu abangapheki yibona abawise i-Tupperware njengoba ubusetshenziselwa ukuphatha ukudla.Abanye bamphendule ngokuthi kulesi simo somnotho kaRamaphosa otshekile sebefaka ukudla esikhaftinini zika-ice cream, abanayo nemali yokuthenga i-Tupperware.Abanye bathe kungcono ngoba abazali kade babewuthenga ukuthi uhlobise ngakho usazoba khona.
USUNOVALO umndeni wowesifazane wasePhase 4, eMbali, eMgungudlovu, osekuphele inyanga engabonakali emva kokuyovakashela uyise wengane oyiphoyisa.UNkk Zodwa Ngubo onguninakhulu kaNksz Tina Ngubo (35), uthe bathole ukuthi wahamba ngo-Agasti 16, eMayville, eyovakashela uyise wengane (14) oyiphoyisa esiShayamthetho eMgungundlovu."Bekungu-Agasti 20, sithola ucingo kuzakwabo wasemsebenzini, ebuza ukuthi akekho yini ekhaya njengoba sekunezinsuku engezi emsebenzini. Sivele sathuka ngoba besazi ukuthi usemsebenzini. Yilapho agcine esesitshela khona ukuthi wayehambe ebizwe nguyise wengane,” kusho uNkk Ngubo.Uthe lona wesifazane wabatshela ukuthi ucingo lukayise wengane lwangena phambi kwakhe, waze wathi uNksz Ngubo akayiboleke imali yokuza, uzomnika uma esefikile.Eqhubeka nokulandisa uNkk Ngubo, uthe isihlobo simshayele ucingo uyise wengane, simbuza ukuthi uNksz Ngubo uphelelephi njengoba kuvela ukuthi unyamalele kade evakashele yena.Uthe uyise wengane wathi umgcine ngo-Agasti 19, emphelezela eyogibela, ebuyela eThekwini.Uqhube wathi waphinde wamshayela naye (uNkk Ngubo) uyise wengane egcizelela into efanayo, wathembisa ukulandelela ukuthi uphelelephi, bese ephinde ebuyela kuNkk Ngubo, into agcina engasayenzi, eseziba nezingcingo zabo."Ngigcine ngiya khona esiShayamthetho, ngiyombuza ukuthi uzizibelani izingcingo zami? Ngifike engekho, ngakhulunyiswa nomphathi wakhe, othe uma emshayela ucingo wakhuluma inkulumo eshayisanayo,” kusho uNkk Ngubo.Uthe waqale wathi uNksz Ngubo wamshiya esangweni lasesiteshini samaphoyisa ePlessislaer, ukuyovula icala lokulahlekelwa umakhalekhukhwini.Wathi kuthe uma umphathi wakhe esethi uzonikela ePleassislaer, ayocela bamvulele amakhamera angalolo suku, kubonakale ukuthi wamshiya khona ngempela yini, washintsha wathi wamgodukisa wamyisa ePhase 4.UNkk Ngubo uthe ugcine eya ePlessislaer ngoSepthemba 10, ukuyobika ukuthi uNksz Ngubo udukile."Ngikhathazekile ngale ngane njengoba sekuphele isikhathi eside kangaka ingatholakali. Ngifisa liphenywe iphoyisa ngokuduka kwayo. Akungeni ngisho ukudla uma ngicabanga ukuthi lokhu sekungiphinda isibili esikhathini esifishane,” kubeka uNkk Ngubo.Echaza ngesigameko saphambilini, uthe ngoJulayi 28 ubengcwaba omunye umzukulu wakhe, uMnuz Mlondi Ngubo (23), owagcina ukubonwa ngoJanuwari 1.Uthe kuleso sigameko wathola ucingo lukamakhelwane wakhe emakhaya eMpendle, ethi nangu uNgubo engena ngendlovu iyangena kwakhe.Uthe wamtshela ukuthi mhlawumbe uphuzile njengoba kwakukade kuhlukaniswa unyaka, wathi uma ebahlupha, abambizele amaphoyisa, bambophise."Kwadlula amahora ambalwa, waphinde washaya ucingo (umakhelwane), ethi akasekho esihlahleni akade emkhuleke kuso (uNgubo), wathi usola ukuthi uqaqwe abangani bakhe, bahamba naye,” kusho uNkk Ngubo.Uveze ukuthi nalolo daba walubika emaphoyiseni kodwa wangabuthola ubulungiswa.Udalule ukuthi okwagcina kwenzeka ukuthi ashayelwe ucingo ngamaphoyisa aseBulwer ngoJuni, emtshela ukuthi athola amathambo omuntu owagqitshwa, akeze azofanisa."Noma kwase kungamathambo kodwa yayisabonakala kancane i-trunk yakhe esiyaziyo, esihlakaleni kusekhona izihlilingi ayehlale ezifakile, emazinyweni kukhona elihlephuke njengelakhe ngaphambili,” kulandisa yena.Uthe imiphumela yolibofuzo eyenziwa yaqinisekisa ukuthi wuye uNgubo."Ngalokhu okwenzeka manje, ngilimala isibili, esilondeni esingakapholi ngoba nakuMlondi, ngangilokhu ngihlalele ethembeni lokuthi ingane iyangena, kanti ngizoyithola isingamathambo,” kusho uNkk Ngubo.Amaphoyisa abengakayiphenduli imibuzo athunyelwe yona ngodaba lokuduka kukaNksz Ngubo.
KUBE yinjabulo ngoLwesine kuvulwa isikole samabanga aphezulu esilungiswe kabusha, saba nobuchwepheshe besimanje obusezingeni, i-Dr J.L Dube High, KwaMashu, okubikwa ukuthi kudle imali elinganiselwa kuR75 million ukusilungisa.Ekhuluma emcimbini wokwethula lesi sikole emphakathini osakhele, uMphathiswa wezeMfundo uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka, ushayele ihlombe zonke izinhlaka ezibambe iqhaza ekutheni silungiswe, ikakhulu inkampani exhasile ukwakhiwa kwaso i-Cotton on Foundation, eminyakeni emibili edlule."Sibonga uhulumeni ukubeka phambili imfundo yezingane zethu ngokuthi kungabi yizikole zasemadolobheni kuphela eziba sezingeni eliphezulu njengalesi. Okunye okusijabulisayo wukuthi lesi sikole asizokuba sihle kuphela, ngoba siyaziwa ngokukhiqiza imiphumela emihle, njengoba senzile ngonyaka odlule kuphasa wonke umfundi kamatikuletsheni kusona,” kusho uHlomuka.Uthishanhloko wesikole, esasungulwa ngo-1979, futhi esinabafundi abawu-1 325 nonyaka, uMnuz Sipho Magwaza, uthe uswele amaphiko okundiza ukukhombisa ukuthi ujabule kangakanani ngomsebenzi omuhle owenziwe kusona."Lokhu kuzosilekelela kakhulu ukuthi sikwazi ukukhiqiza imfundo esezingeni eliphezulu njengoba isikole sethu sesenziwe ngendlela yokuthi sihambisane nobuchwepheshe esikubona kwamanye amazwe njengoba kuzofundwa ngamakhompytutha, ukusiza ukuthi abafundi esibakhiqizayo baphume sebekulungele ukubhekana nezimo zempilo esiyiphilayo manje,” usho kanje.Ikhansela elakhele ku-ward 40, lapho okwakhiwe khona lesi sikole, uMnuz Siyezwana Mzimela, uthe umsebenzi owenziwe kulesi sikole uzosiza kakhulu ukukhiqiza abafundi abazoba nekusasa eliqhakazile, babuye benze umehluko emphakathini.Omunye wabazali bezingane ezifunda kulesi sikole, uMnuz Bongani Majola, naye ubonge kakhulu umsebenzi owenziwe, athe uzolekelela kakhulu izingane zabo ukuba nekusasa elihle.UMagwaza ugcizelele ukuthi kumanje sebeqedile ngohlelo lokubhalisa abafundi abazofunda esikoleni sabo ngonyaka ozayo, ukukhombisa ukuhleleka nokubeka imfundo phambili.UMPHATHISHWA wezemfundo KwaZulu-Natal nosihlalo wekomiti lokuThuthukisa uMnotho eThekwini, uMnuz Thembo Ntuli bevula ngokusemthethweni isikole esilungisiwe, iDr J.L Dube High, KwaMashu, izolo Isithombe: SITHUNYELWE
WEHLILE umthwalo kwabanezikweletu njengoba iBhange loMbuso, i-South African Reserve Bank (Sarb), liyehlise ngo-25 basis points imali mboleko.Izolo umphathi we-Sarb, uMnuz Lesetja Kganyago, uthe amalungu athatha izinqumo ngemalimboleko avumelane ngokuthi yehle ngo-25 basis points (amaphuzu) isuka ku-8.25% ibe wu-8%. Imalimboleko yagcina ukwehla eminyakeni emithathu edlule, njengoba ibilokhu inyuka umlibe.Lokhu kusho ukuthi i-prime lending rate, okuyinzalo ekhokhiswa abantu uma beboleke imali emabhange isizoba wu-11.5%. Isuka ku-11.75%.USolwazi Bonke Dumisa oyisazi somnotho nezomthetho esizimele, uthe yizindaba ezinhle lezi ngoba vele bebelindele ukuthi izokwehla imali mboleko."Besazi ukuthi imalimboleko izokwehla njengoba amandla emali ekhombise ukudlondlobala ngo-Agasti, aba wu-4.4%. Ebesingenaso isiqiniseko sakho wukuthi izokwehla ngo-25 basis points noma ngo-50 basis points. Kuvelile ukuthi namalungu athatha izinqumo ngemalimboleko abexoxa ngokuthi ayehliswe ngo-50 basis points kodwa agcina evumelene ngo-25 basis points,” kusho uDumisa.Uthe abakhokhela izindlu, izimoto nezinye izikweletu abangangenanga ohlelweni lokuthi zinganyuki uma kunyuka imalimboleko, bazojabula ngoba kunemali esizosala uma bekhokhela izikweletu zabo."Le mali ngicela abantu bangayibhubhudli ezintweni ezingenasidingo. Kufanele bayibeke noma baqhubeke nokukhokha imali ethe xaxa ezikweletini zabo. Kubalulekile ukuthi songele izinsuku ezinzima ngoba ngesikhathi imalimboleko inyuka ngo-2021, baningi abantu abazithola sebeklinywa yizikweletu.”UNkk Annaline van der Poel wenkampani esiza abacwile ezikweletini, i-Debt Rescue, uthe akwanele ukwehliswa kwemalimboleko ngo-25 basis points ngoba abantu bavele bathwele kanzima ngenxa yokubiza kwempilo.Ubalule ukuthi ayikho into engabizi kusukela kugesi, ukudla, uphethroli nezinye izidingo zabantu nokuyikho okubenza bangene ezikweletini.Uthe uyathemba ukuthi ngoNovemba, iBhange loMbuso lizoyehlisa ngesikalo esibonakalayo imalimboleko.UKganyago uthe abantu bazobona ngoNovemba ukuthi imalimboleko yehla kangakanani kodwa wazwakalisa ukukhathazeka ngezimpi eziqhubeka emhlabeni okubalwa i-Israel nePalestine, eyeseRussia ne-Ukraine, athe ziba nomthelela ekuntengiseni amandla emali.
BESABA ukuthi bangase balahlekelwe amasimu abo omoba abalimi baseMpangeni abangakwazi ukukhokha imali yokukhonzela amasimi. Laba balimi bomoba abathi bayizakhamuzi zesizwe saKwaMadlebe eMpangeni, abahlala eMevamhlophe, eNdabayakhe naseNqutshini bathi sebenqunyelwe ugwayi katiki wokuthi uma behluleka ukukhokha le mali ngoNovemba bazophucwa amasimu omoba enomkhiqizo.Omunye wezakhamuzi oneminyaka engaphezu kuka-60, ongathandanga ukudalulwa, uthe insimu abayilimayo engamahektha amabili yayilinywa uyise owayengakaze ayikhonzele kodwa ngoJuni batshelwe ukuthi abakhokhe imali eyevile kuR20 000.Ngokuthola kweSolezwe le mali iphakathi kukaR20 000 no-R100 000 "Induna yasibizela emhlanganweni yathi komkhulu kuthiwe sekunesikhathi eside silima singawakhonzeli amasimu sibe senza ibhizinisi ngawo. Kulo nyaka kumele sikhokhe. Sanqunyelwa ugwayi katiki kwathiwa kumele sikhokhe ungakashayi uNovemba. Uma sehlulekile iyadliwa insimu," kusho isakhamuzi.Esinye isakhamuzi ebesikhala ngento efanayo emsakazweni Ukhozi FM , sithe abakwazi ukukhala ngalokhu ngoba basaba ukwenzakaliswa."Kunamadoda asegade ukuthi singawuhlahli umoba ukuze kudliwe amasimu enomkhiqizo. Konke okwenziwayo kwenziwa ngesihluku. Siyasatshiswa. Akugcini lapho uma kuke kwafika ekutheni wena ufuna udaba lwakho luye enkosini uyabulawa nokubulawa. Asenzi imali eningi ngomoba uyakalwa. Ngokubona kwethu inkosi ifuna ukuwadla amasimu ngoba iyazi ukuthi baningi abazohluleka ukukhokha ingakho ifuna ukuthi sikhokhe singakahlahli kunokuthi ithi asikhokhe uma sesikhokhelwe, " kusho isakhamuzi.UNdunankulu wakulesi sizwe uMnuz Mbhoyi Zungu, uthe amasimu omoba ayibhizinisi bonke abanalama simu bayawakhonzela."Umhlaba uyakhonzelwa ezindaweni zamakhosi. Akuyona into entsha. Kusekhona inkosi endala ewuyise wale ekhona kwakuvele kunjalo. Akuliwa kuba isivumelwano esenziwa naye umuntu avume. Kuyakalwa kuqinisekiswe ubungako bomhlaba. Kuyaxoxiswana ngoba phela ngabantu besizwe laba akuliwa. Uma ekhala luyenziwa uhlelo. Asikho isikhalo esifike kimi njengondunankulu ngemali yokukhonzela amasimu. Inkosi ayihlangene nokuklanywa kwamasimu nemali yokukhonzela amasimu. Into eyenziwa izinduna. Leyo mali iya kwi-Trust isetshenziselwa ukuthuthukisa isizwe," kusho undunankulu.Uthe awekho amasimu agadwe ngamadoda aphuma komkhulu."Abagadene ilabo abaqashe umhlaba kwabanye, asihlangene nalezo zivumelwano thina. Siyacela abalimi ukuthi uma benezikhalo beze kimi sizame ukuyilungisa inkinga. Umhlaba owabantu besizwe bonke sinejoka lokuthi siwabe ngokufanele," kusho uZungu.UMnuz Senzelwe Mzila woMnyango wokuBusa ngokuBambisana KwaZulu-Natal, uthe lolu daba belungakafiki kubo basazofuna imininingwane ephelele ngaphambi kokuthi baphawule ngalo.
UMNIKAZI wendawo yokudlela i-AuthentiQ, esemgwaqweni uFlorida, eThekwini, uMnuz Ndumiso Mncwabe, usegxeke abezindaba nabantu ngakubize ngokwakha isithombe esibi ngezindawo zokudlela eziholwa ngosomabhizinisi abamnyama.Lokhu kuza emva kwesehlakalo sangoMsombuluko ekuseni sokushona kukaNksz Zamangwane Bija (26), obesebenzela kule ndawo yokudlela, odutshulwe yisoka lakhe ebeliyiphoyisa, uMnuz Nhlakanipho Mkhize, naye ogcine eshona kulesi sigameko emva kokudutshulwa ngamaphoyisa abeqaphe isimo.UMncwabe uthe kuyamkhathaza ukuthi nakuba kuhlale kwenzeka izigameko ezifuze lezi kwezinye izindawo zokudlela eThekwini namaphethelo, kodwa akuvamile ukuthi kubikwe ngazo kwabezindaba."Ngikhuluma ngento engiyaziyo njengoba kusanda kugwazwa umngani wami kwenye indawo yokudlela eseDavenport, futhi kuhlale kwenzeka nakwezinye izindawo eziseMhlanga ukuthi kubulawe abantu, kodwa angikaze ngibone kukhulunywa ngakho kwabezindaba. "Isimo esinjengalesi esenzekile akuyona into ehlale yenzeka, futhi lokhu kuyinto esingenayo indlela ebesingayivimba ngayo ngoba yenzeka ngaphandle, kwaba wukuthi usisi ushonela phakathi endaweni yethu yokusebenzela."Ngiyafisa ukuthi kungagcini ngezindaba ezibuhlungu kuphela, kwenziwe okufanayo ngokuthi kukhulunywe ngemisebenzi emihle esiyenza ngamabhizinisi ethu ehlukene” usho kanje.

ASEWU-42 amacala athweswe owesilisa osolwa ngokudlwengula ekhombe abesifazane ngesibhamu noma ummese bese ebaphanga nomazisi babo.Umsolwa uMnuz Khethani Khoni (31), oshadelwe nonabantwana abathathu, uvele eNkantolo yeMantshi eMlaza, izolo, ecela ibheyili.Umphenyi wecala, uSergeant Mndeni Mzila, uthe babophe uKhuboni ngo-Agasti 27, endlini yakhe esehostela eGlebelands, eMlaza.Ephikisa ukuthi anikwe ibheyili, uthe umsolwa akaqali ukuboshwa."Uthweswe amacala angu-20 okudlwengulwa, amanye awu-20 okuphanga esebenzisa udlame namabili okushaya,” kusho umphenyi.Umsolwa kuthiwa uhlanganiswa ulibofuzo, amaselula awebela abagilwa nokuxhumana kwakhe nabagilwa ngezingcingo.UMzila uthe indawo okwakwenzeka khona isigameko iyodwa, isenkundleni yezemidlalo eGlebelands.Kuthiwa umsolwa wayesebenzisa uzinkundla nokuxhumana u-Facebook no-WhatsApp enze ubuhlobo nabagilwa."Wayecela ujuhlangana nabo, abaqashele u-Uber uma esethole ukuthi bangobani futhi bahlalaphi. Babefika kwaJeena, esebalindile uKhuboni,” kuchaza UMzila.Kuthiwa wayetshela abagilwa ukuthi uthunywe umuntu abekade exoxa naye kumakhalekhukhwini ukuba azomlanda ngoba yena umatasa.Kusolakala ukuthi uKhuboni wayehamba nomgilwa, uma esethi dundu kule nkundla aqale izimanga."Wayedonsa ummese noma isibhamu akhombe umgilwa bese eyadlwengula, uma eseqedile aphange umakhalekhukhwini womgilwa. Abagilwa ngokungayazi indawo babeya egaraji eliseduzane bacele usizo. Abanye abagilwa uKhuboni wayefika nabo ngo-Uber, enze esifanayo, " kuchaza uMzilaUmphenyi uthe akanalo ulwazi noma bayazana yini abagilwa kodwa imiphumela yolibufuzo eyisikhombisa isiqinisekisile ukuthi nguKhuboni owadlwengula. Kusalindwe eminye imiphumela.Kuvele nokuthi ngoJulayi 2022, waboshwa uKhuboni wabekwa icala lokushaya nokuphuca owesifazane i-weave (izinwele zokufakelwa).Kwathathwa ulibofuzo lwakhe lwathunyelwa ePitoli, wakhululwa ngebheyili.NgoJanuwari nyakenye, wasolakala ekudlwenguleni nasekwebeni i-laptop, kwaphinde kwathathwa ulibofuzo lwakhe.Kuthiwa wayezishintsha amagama ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, uma ebona ukuthi sekuyambhedela.Kuthiwa kwathathwa amasampula akubagilwa athunyelwa e-laboratory ayohlolwa, kwavela ukuthi uKhuboni umsolwa, amaphoyisa amthungatha amthola ehostela.Ngakolunye uhlangothi, uKhuboni uvumile ukuthi ushadelwe, unabantwana abathathu futhi nguye kuphela owondla umndeni njengoba inkosikazi ingasebenzi.UKhuboni othe uno-matric, udalule ukuthi umndeni wakhe wondliwa uninakhulu ogulayo ngoba yena uboshiwe.Uthe uhlele ukuwaphika wonke amacala aziswe ngawo eboshwa. Uthe ngeke abe yingozi kofakazi nasemphakthini uma ededelwa futhi angakwazi ukukhokha ka-R20 000 ukuze adedelwe.Uthe uzobuveza ubumsulwa bakhe uma sekuqulwa icala futhi ungusomabhizinisi onenkampani eyakha ifenisha yepulangwe.Ubekade ebukeka ezikhululekele, elokhu ejeqeza emaceleni nangemuva kwayo, ibuke sakusabisa abebethamele icala abebegqoke izimpahla ze-EFF.Icala liqhubeka ngoMsombuluko.
IKHALA ngesiqiwi saseSwatini esiphilisa kabuhlungu umphakathi wezigodi ezakhele iNgwavuma, imindeni yabathathu abatholwe befile, betakwe ndawonye.Ngokuthola kweSolezwe, uMnuz Mfanomncane Nyawo, Mnuz Mbongi Mtshali noMnuz Lindani Mtshali kuthiwa badutshulwe babulawa abaqapha isiqiwi ngoLwesibili.Kuthiwa imindeni yabo ibathole behudulwe babekwa ndawonye kubonakala ukuthi badutshulwe amahlandla amaningi. Kulesi sigameko okuthiwa kusinde oyedwa kusona, kuvela ukuthi ubehamba nabafi ngosuku lwesigameko, yena udubuleke esithweni, ngenhlanhla wakwazi ukubaleka, wahlaba umkhosi wokuthi abehamba nabo babulewe.UMnuz Duncan Nyawo oyisihlobo sikaNyawo, oshonile, uthe abagilwa basuka emakhaya beyobheka inkomo ebidukele esiqiwini."Bahlaselwe besayibheka. Ababange besaqeda,” kusho uNyawo.Uveze ukuthi sekunesikhathi lesi siqiwi singabahlalisile kahle."Kusuka ngo-2017, isiqiwi singasihlalisile kahle. Safike sadayiswa ngendlela esingayiqondi kahle. Emva kwalokho kwaqala ukubulawa kwezinkomo zethu, kokunye zithathwe ngendluzula,” kuchaza uNyawo.Uthe bekuye kuthi uma bezama ukuthi zibuyiswe, kube nhlanga zimuka nomoya.Uphinde wadalula ukuthi nesigameko sowesilisa owabulawa yizindlovu nyakenye, basola abalesi siqiwi."Indlovu ezazigcwele esiqiwini sabo, bazixosha ngendiza enophephela emhlane, baziwelisela engxenyeni engaphesheya, lapho umphakathi unamadlelo khona."Sibuhlungu ngendlela esiphethwe ngayo siwumphakathi. Abakwenzayo kukhombisa ukuthi kasiyinto yalutho futhi siyizinyamazane okufanele zibulawe,” usho kanje.IKhansela lendawo, uMnuz Mbalekelwa Nkosi, liqinisekisile ukuthi libikelwe ngokwenzekile, laze laziyela lapho kwenzeke khona isehlo, lathola ukuthi bonke abafile bebedutshulwe emakhanda."Kukhulu ukukhathazeka emphakathini. Abantu bafisa kube khona ukuxoxa phakathi kweSwatini neNingizimu Afrika, ikhulunywe le nto,” kusho uNkosi.Echaza ngendaba yesiqiwi uthe iyinsumansumane."Savele savuka sekuthiwa kunesiqiwi. Leya ndawo kusukela kudala, sikhule kudla izinkomo kuyo. Ucingo lwaseSwatini lwaluphansi kodwa manje sizwa sekuthiwa umngcele ususondele ezintabeni,” kusho yena.Uthe umuntu ozihambelayo, ongazi, ayikho into emkhombisayo ukuthi useqe umngcele."Okusiphatha kabi ukuthi bafe bengaphethe lutho, kwazinyamazane lezo ebebeyozizingela, bebengakazitholi,” kusho uNkosi.Kushaye isikhathi sokushicilela amaphoyisa angakayiphenduli imibuzao athunyelwe yona.
AMALUNGU omkhandlu wezifundazwe ePhalamende afuna incazelo ephelele kwiMeya yeTheku ukuthi yini ebambe ukusebenza kohlelo lwamabhasi iGo! Durban elinesabelo sika-R9 billion okwakumele luqale ukusebenza ngo-2016?Lokhu kuvezwe uMnuz Mzamo Billy, onguSotswebhu wamalungu eNational Council of Provinces (NCOP) aqhamuka KwaZulu-Natal.Uthe bayile ukuyohlola la mabhasi ngoLwesithathu, amile awasebenzi."UMasipala weTheku nabantu bamatekisi abavumelani ngokusebenza kweGo! Durban. Ziyabola izinto ezibekwe lapha nemigwaqo eyakhiwe ngenxa yokuthi umasipala uyahluleka ukuvumelana nabamatekisi," kusho uBilly.Uqhube ngokuthi beyi-NCOP ngeke bahlale basonge izandla babukele izinto ngendlela ezenzeka ngayo, bazofuna umbiko ophelele kwiMeya, uMnuz Cyril Xaba.Uveze ukuthi imeya izibophezelile ukuthi izohlanganisa izinhlaka ezahlukene, baqhamuke nesu lokuyilungisa into yokungaboni ngaso linye."Amabhasi eGo! Durban azolekelela abantu abahluphekayo futhi abadinga ezokuthutha eziqondile. Abantu baKwaMashu, eClermont nakoNew Germany bayawadinga la mabhasi," kuchaza uBilly.Kuleli sonto, amalungu eNCOP abehambele izifundazwe eyobheka angase alekelele ngakho.Bathole ukuthi kunemisebenzi engaqhubeki ephelelwe yimali, ishiywe dengwane, kayiqediwe, eminye imiswe abafuna ngodli u-30% wemali.Leli thimba liye naseHammarsdale liyohlola isikhungo esihlanza inyubathi okuthiwa kumisiwe ukwakhiwa kwayo."Kunemibiko ethi kumile ukwakhiwa kwayo ngenxa yokuthi kunabantu abaphazamisayo. Kuthiwa usonkontileka akanawo amandla okwenza lowa msebenzi," kusho uBilly.Kudlulelwe nasesikoleni iMenzi High eMlaza, lapho bekunemibiko ethi kumisiwe ama-construction mafia ukwakhiwa kwesikole.Uthe beyi-NCOP ngeke bavumele izimo lapho abantu abafuna ibhizinisi babeke izimfuno zabi phambili kunekusasa labafundi balesi sikole esikhiqiza o-100% bemiphumela ka-matric minyaka yonke.Lwaqala ngoJuni 2022, uhlelo lokunweba lesi sikole ngamakilasi awu-13 nezinye izinto ngesabelo sika-R37 million.Bekumele luphothulwe ngoDisemba 2024, lolu hlelo kodwa sekuzoba uMashi 2025, okuyinto ekhalisa i-NCOP nomphathiswa wemiSebenzi yoMphakathi eKZN, uMnuz Martin Meyer, abathe kuzokwanda izindleko.Unobhala wenhlangano yabhizinisi abamnyama i-Black Business Federation, UMnuz Wonder Jaca, ukhale ngabamisa imisebenzi wathi bonela nabo.
KUTHIWA uphele emehlweni umshayeli wemoto ekhokhelwa ngebanga ngemuva kokushayisa amatekisi amabili kuM25 ngaseDube Village.Abezimo eziphuthumayo basendaweni yesehlo, bathathu abagibeli okubukwa ukuthi balimele, kodwa akekho osesimweni esibucayi.
