"Umbiko engiwuthole komunye wabanikazi bamatekisi alimalile wukuthi umshayeli wemoto encane ubehamba nomphathi wakhe okuthe ngemuva kwengozi wabaleka umshayeli washiya umphathi wakhe elimele, ” kusho uKubheka. Uqhubeke wathi umnikazi wemoto encane kuthiwa wehle ku-ambulensi ebimhambisa esibhedlela wathi akakwazi ukushiya imoto yakhe eyodwa engazi ukuthi kuzokwenzekani kuyo. Le ngozi ilandela enye eyenzeke kuM25 ngaseCrossini lapho kushayisane khona izimoto ezincane ezimbili zaphonseka emanzini. Amaphoyisa nabezimo eziphuthumayo basendaweni yesigameko.
UMENGAMELI uCyril Ramaphosa, uthi abakhuluma kabi ngowayengungqongqoshe wezamaBhizinisi kaHulumeni, uMnuz Pravin Gordhan, bebedla ngenkohlakalo eyenzeka eminyangweni kahulumeni.Kuhlangane imihlathi eyazanayo emngcwabeni yowayenguNgqongqoshe weZimali uMnuz Pravin Gordhan e-ICC eThekwini izolo. Lapha uSihlalo we-ANC uMnuz Gwede Mantashe ubonakala encokola nabalingani bakhe uNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, iPhini likaNgqongoshe WezokuXhumana noBuchwepheshe likamengameli uMnuz Mondli Gungubele noNobhala we-ANC eKZN uMnuz Bheki MtoloIsithombe: DOCTOR NGCOBO/Independent NewspapersURamaphosa uthe uGordhan uzondelwa ukuthi ubengahambisani nenkohlakalo.Lokhu ukusho enkonzweni yomngcwabo kaGordhan ebiseNkosi Albert Luthuli Convention Centre, izolo.URamaphosa uthe uGordhan walwa ngesikhathi kukhona abazama ukuzitamuzela emalini yomphakathi."Ngesikhathi izwe lethu libhekene nesikhathi esinzima, lapho khona abasondelene nababesezikhundleni ngaleso sikhathi befuna ukubhubhudla imali, uGordhan walwa. Akazange avume ukuthi kudliwe imali yomphakathi."Walwa ngisho esebona ukuthi izenzo zakhe zimqhatha nanabantu aqhamuka enhlanganweni eyodwa nabo ababenza okungalungile.”URamaphosa uthe uGordhan wathukwa kakhulu ngesikhathi elwa nemizamo yokuLawulwa koMbuso yiDlanzana."Labo ababezama ukulawula uMbuso bamzonda kakhulu. Babemusho ngazo zonke izinhlamba. Babefuna akhishwe esikhundleni. Ezinye zezinhlamba ayethukwa ngazo zazinokucwasa ngokobuhlanga. "Nokho izinhlamba azizange zimehlise isithunzi emphakathini, kunalokho zavula abantu amehlo, babona izinhloso zalabo ababefuna ukuzenzela emalini yomphakathi.”URamaphosa uthe izwe lilahlekelwe umholi obezithobile ngokushona kukaGordhan."Ubekholelwa ekutheni izishoshovu akufanele zilwele ukuzicebisa zona, kufanele zilwele abantu ukuthi baphile impilo engcono.”UGordhan ushone ngeleldlule emva kokuxinwa ukugula.Ushona nje, ubevele esethathe umhlalaphansi kwezepolitiki emva kokuphatha izikhundla okukhona kuso ukhomishana we-SA Revenue Services (Sars), uMnyango wezeziMali nowezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu.Umngcwabo kaGordhan ubuhanjelwe abaholi abahlukene okubalwa kubo ongqongqoshe abaphethe manje nababengongqongqoshe.Izikhulumi ebezishiyelana inkundla emngcwabeni wakhe zimchaze njengomholi obeqotho.UNobhala Jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, uthe ingcabha isele kubona ukuba baqhubeke nokulwa nenkohlakalo njengoba uGordhan engasekho.USihlalo we-SACP, uMnuz Blade Nzimande, uthe akazi ukuthi uGordhan uthukelwani ngoba watakula amabhizinisi kahulumeni amaningi awafica eseguqe ngamadolo ngesikhathi eqokelwa kwesikangqongqohse woMnyango wamaBhizinisi kaHulumeni.Owayeyinhloko yamajaji, iJaji uRaymond Zondo, uthe uGordhan uzondelwa ukuthi akazange avume ukuthi kwenzeke inkohlakalo phambi kwakhe.
AMADODAKAZI wowayengungqongqoshe wezamaBhizinisi kaHulumeni, uMnuz Pravin Gordhan, athi abazi ukuthi bakhuluma ngani labo abagxeka ubaba wawo.Amadodakazi kaGordhan athe ubaba wawo akafanelwe izinhlamba achashwa ngazo. Lokhu akusho enkonzweni yomngcwabo wakhe ebise-ICC.Indodakazi kaGordhan, uNksz Anisha Gordhan, ithe ubaba wayo akufanele agxekelwe ukungenzi kahle kwezinkampani zikahulumeni ezifana ne-SAA, Denel nezinye ebezingaphansi komnyango abewuphethe ngaphambi kokhetho lwangoMeyi.Uthe ubaba wakhe wazama ngakho konke okusemandleni akhe ukuhlenga lezi zinkampani ngesikhathi enikezwa lo mnyango ngo-2018."Iqiniso ukuthi imali emabhizinisini kahulumeni yaqala ukubhubhudlwa ngo-2009, kwaze kwaba u-2018. Ubuholi obangena ngo-2018 bafica amabhizinisi kahulumeni ebhekene nezinkinga. Abaholi abangena ngalesi sikhathi bazame ngayo yonke indlela ukulungisa izinkinga abazificile.”UNksz Anisha uthe ukuhlaselwa kukaGordhan kubeke impilo yabo engcupheni njengoba ethe kube nezikhathi lapho bebethola khona izinsongo ezibhekiswe kubona bewumndeni.Enye indodakazi kaGordhan, uNksz Priyesha Gordhan, ithe abantu bakuleli akufanele bavume ukudukiswa ilabo abakhuluma izinto ezingelona iqiniso ngoGordhan."Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika kufanele baqhubeke nokubuka ngeso elijulile izinto ezenzeka phambi kwabo, bengavumi ukudukiswa ilabo abakhuluma abakuthandayo.”Uthe uGordhan ubewubaba onothando ekhaya, wathi ubengaziphakamisile emphakathini.Umngani kaGordhan owayeyiphini lakhe eMnyangweni wezeZimali, uMnuz Mcebisi Jonas, uthe uGordhan ubethukwa kakhulu ilabo ababefuna ukucekela phansi igama lakhe."Inhloso yabo enkulu babefuna ukuthi uGordhan noMnyango woMgcinimafa behlelwe isithunzi khona babezokwazi ukuzitamuzela emalini yomphakathi.”UJonas uthe baningi abantu abaqhelile kuGordhan ngenxa yokulwa kwakhe nenkohlakalo."Ubenombono owehlukile ikakhulu uma kukhulunywa indaba yokwakhiwa kabusha kwe-ANC. Lokhu bekumenza ukuthi abe inkomo edla yodwa.”UJonas uchaze ngokugula kukaGordhan.Uthe ngoJulayi, wabatshela ukuthi uphethwe umdlavuza."Wathi isimo sakhe sibi, wathi utshelwe ukuthi uzophila izinyanga ezintathu kuphela.”UJonas uthe uGordhan ukhombise ukuba nesibindi ngesikhathi ebhekene nokugula.
UMPHATHISWA wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi eKZN, uNkk Mbali Shinga, uzwakalise ukudumala ngabakuthole esikhungweni esingenzi nzuzo, i-ABH Children’s Home esizinze eChatsworth, KwaZulu-Natal.Umphathiswa usho kanje kulandela ukuthi ngoJulayi, kuqubuke izinsolo zokuhlukunyezwa kwezingane, zihlukunyezwa ngabanye babasebenzi kulesi sikhungo abagcina bexoshiwe.NgoLwesibili, uhlangane nebhodi lesikhungo njengoba ebezoletha umbiko emva kophenyo oluthathe amaviki amathathu.Ekhuluma nabezindaba uthe benza isithembiso ukuthi inhloko yomnyango izokwenza uphenyo ukubheka ukuthi izinsolo ezazibikiwe ziyiqiniso ngempela yini."Siwudluliselile umbiko futhi njengomnyango sidumele kakhulu ngezinto esizitholile ngaphakathi esikhungweni. Ngempela abantwana bazisholo bona ukuthi bebeshaywa, bejeziswa ngezindlela ezehlukene futhi bewashiswa nezitsha ngamanzi abandayo,” kusho uNkk Shinga.Uthe abanye bebehlukunyezwa ukuthi bebebuka abanye beshaywa."Ngokomoya nangokomqondo uma ulokhu ukhunjuzwa ukuthi njengoba ulapha watholakala uhluphekile noma usesimweni esithile ngakho-ke yamukela noma yini, lokho kuyakuhlukumeza. Ngakho njengomnyango lezo zinto azisiphethe kahle yingakho silapha,” usho kanje.Uthe kunethimba elizoqapha iThekwini Monitoring Unit Evaluation elizosebenzisana nalesi sikhungo elizobabikela ukuthi ukhona yini umehluko okhona.Inhloko yomnyango, uNkk Nelisiwe Vilakazi, ithe isikhungo asibabheki abasebenzi baso ukuthi bakhona yini ohlwini lwabahlukumeza izingane."Umthetho uthi uma uzosebenza endaweni enabantwana kufanele ubhekwe ukuthi awukho yini la okubhalwa khona abantu abenze amacala ebantwaneni. Uma ukanjalo uyaye ungabe usaqashwa kuleyo ndawo, ngakho-ke sitholile kulesi sikhungo ukuthi abantu ababhekwa kuleyo rejista ebizwa ngo-Part-B, yokuvikela izingane,” kubeka uNkk Vilakazi.Uthe banxusa ukuthi wonke umuntu osebenza esikhungweni ukuthi abhekwe kuleyo rejista, uma etholakala, aqheliswe ngoba ungathola ukuthi omunye unenkinga yokuhlukumeza abantwana. Uqhube wathi balindele ukuthi izinkinga zilungiseke masinyane ukuze izingane ziphephe.Isikhulu esiphezulu sase-ABH, uMnuz Ray Naguran, sithe bayawamukela umbiko futhi basazowufunda."Sisanda kuwuthola umbiko, asibanga naso isikhathi sokuwufunda. Sizochitha izinsuku ezimbalwa siwetshise emva kwalokho bese siyaphawula. Okwamanje izinto zisahamba kahle ngaphakathi esikhungweni,” kusho uNaguran.
ISIKHULU esiphezulu seRoad Accident Fund (RAF), uMnuz Collins Letsoalo sithi asiyindawo futhi sisazimisele ukusebenzela abantu baseNingizimu Afrika.NgoMsombuluko, uLetsoalo utshele izintatheli ukuthi yize le nhlangano esiza abalimele ezingozini zomgwaqo ibhekene nezingqinamba kodwa ikhokhele abantu uR45.1 billion kulo nyaka.Ukhale ngokuthi abakwazanga ukufeza zonke izinhlelo akade benazo kwazise intela ekhokhwa abetha uphethroli isahleli ku-R2.18 ilitha ebikuwo kule minyaka emithathu edlule.Uveze ukuthi le ntela ibangenisele u-R48.6 billion ngonyaka wezimali ka-2023/24."Sikwazile ukukhokhela abantu u-R45.1 billion yize sinezingqinamba. Sifike le nhlangano kubukeka sengathi izowa kodwa sakwazi ukuthi sinciphise isikweletu njengoba safika siwu-R19 billion kodwa manje sesiwu-R8.71 billion.”Inkinga yethu enkulu kuseyizindleko zabameli ngoba yize songe u-R24 billion kulo nyaka kodwa zisami ku-R3.899 billion, okusho ukuthi bazinciphise ngo-R4.89 billion.Ubalule ukuthi ukube abaqalanga izinhlelo zabo zokonga ngabe lezi zindleko zingaphezulu kuka-R50 billion onyakeni wezimali u-2027/28.Uthe bathole izicelo zokunxeshezelwa eziwu-79 377, sebekwaze ukuvala eziwu-63 000.Babuye bakhokha no-R12.7 billion kubantu abafake izicelo zokunxeshezelwa ngaphansi kwesigaba esibizwa nge-general damage. Ufanise le mali njengokuthi eyokuxolisa kubantu.Ugqugquzele abalimala ezingozini zomgwaqo ukuthi bazithintele bona iRAF ngoba ikhona ukubasiza kuzo zonke izingqinamba ababhekana nazo emuva kokulimala. Bangayithinta ngokushayela u-087 820 1 111, ngoMsombuluko kuya kuLwesihlanu ngo-7.45 ekusenu kuya ku-4 ntambama. Bangangena nakwi-website yayo ethi www.raf.co.za.
UKHALE ngokungagqizwa qakala kwesicelo sokudilizwa kwezakhiwo eziyingozi endaweni umndeni womfana (10) owelwe wudonga lwaseposini washona KwaBester, eThekwini.USiyamthanda Ngcongo (10) ushonele endaweni yesigameko emva kokuwelwa udonga lwaseposini elidala akade edlala kulo nabangani bakhe.Kusale kumuncu emuva kokuwa kodonga lweposi elingasasebenzi KwaBester eThekwini lapho okushone khona uSiyamthanda Ngcongo (10) Isithombe: Sibonelo Ngcobo Kulesi sigameko, kulimale nenye ingane okuthiwa iphuthunyiswe esibhedlela.Lifika endaweni yesigameko Isolezwe, lithole sekugcwele umphakathi nezinhlaka ezehlukene ukuzobabaza isehlo.Phakathi kwazo bekukhona ikhansela lendawo nobuholi beMK endaweni, obebusondele kakhulu noyise kamufi, uMnuz Sbo Ngcongo.UYISE kaSiyamthanda Ngcongo owelwe udonga, uMnuz Sbo Ngcongo (ofake ihembe elimhlophe) esendaweni yesigameko lapho okushone khona indodana yakhe Isithombe: Sibonelo Ngcobo Ekhuluma kanzima uNgcongo, uthe unemibuzo eminingi angazi ukuthi izophendulwa ubani."Wonke umuntu ufika esiphethweni sokuthi kuwe udonga ngenxa yemvula. Kungani wonke umuntu ecabangele emvuleni,” kubuza uNgcongo, othe ushayelwe ucingo esemsebenzini, etshelwa ngesehlo.Uthe kuyamcasula ukuthi wonke umuntu usefuna ukusola imvula ekubeni kwaziwa kahle ukuthi kunesikhalo ngezakhiwo ezingekho esimweni, ezindala, ezingasasebenzi neziyingozi emphakathini."Ingane yami le elahlekile. Iyangicasula le nto yokuthi kucatshangelwe emvuleni, ukube lwasuswa udonga, ngabe asizange sifike la,” kusho uNgcongo.Ubuze ukuthi njengoba sekwenziwa izinhlelo zokuthi lususwe, bekulindweni."Yini abayenzile ukuze kungakenzeki lesi sigameko? Bahlale bezidlula lezi zakhiwo, bengenzi lutho ngazo,” usho kanje.Ugcizelele ngelithi ucasulwa abantu abenza sengathi bayamkhathalela, kodwa kade kungenziwa lutho sonke lesi sikhathi, kwaze kwaba ukuthi yena ulahlekelwa yingane.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi sekuphele iminyaka engaphezu kweyishumi abasebenzisa izidakamizwa balicekela phansi iposi, bekhipha amabhokisi okwakufakwa kuwo izincwadi kwasala udonga lodwa.Lithole ukuthi izingane zendawo bezihlale zidlala kulona, kwesinye isikhathi zize zigibele phezulu.Izolo kuthiwa ngesikhathi luwa, ezinye zikwazile ukusheshe zibone zabaleka, kodwa ezimbili zahluleka, okugcine kuholele ekutheni umufi aphangalale.Umphakathi uphinde wakhala nangehholo eliseduze kwendawo yesigameko, wathi nalo liyingozi ezinganeni ezidlala kulo.Ikhansela lendawo, uMnuz Ntshangase, lithe alifuni ukungena ligxile kwezithinta ipolitiki, lathi isigameko senzekile washona umntwana."Yinto ebingenzeka noma ikuphi, noma nini, awukwazi ukulivimba icebo likaNkulunkulu,” kusho uNtshangase.Uthe akafuni ukungena entweni yodonga ngoba lokho kuzoba sengathi kufunwa umuntu ozosolwa ngesigameko kanti siyintando kaNkulunkulu."Okunye nokunye siyokubona ngezikhathi zamavoti. Uma singabantu kwesinye isikhathi kufanele sibukhombise ubuntu. Isidumbu sengane njengamanje silele lapha phansi, kufanele uma singabantu sizifundise ukuthi kukhona izinto okungafanele sidlalele kuzo,” kusho uNtshangase.Uthe isigameko esifana nalesi njengoba kade lina, besingenzeka ngisho nasekhaya, izingane zithi ziyadlala, kuwe udonga, luzimboze."Okubalulekile ukuthi sibheke ukuthi umndeni uhlangatshezwa kanjani ukutheni umntwana afihlwe ngesizotha,” kusho uNtshangase.Uthe banezinhlelo zokuthi ihholo, okungesilo elikamasipala, elikaSection 21, lilungiswe uMsamariya olungileyo."Akulona lodwa mabili. Ukube bekuyindlu kamasipala ngabe kade salilungisa, manje elikaSection 21,” kusho uNtshangase.

USHAYE ungqimphothwe esefike enkantolo, wakubonga ukufaka isicelo sebheyili okwamanje, umlisa osolwa ngokushumpula ikhanda likaninakhulu waligenda njengebhola lezinyawo ePinetown, eThekwini.UMnuz Thabo Ntokozo Nzimande (31) ubekade evele eNkantolo yeMantshi yasePinetown.Uthweswe icala lokubulala uNkk Beatrice De Lange (80) ayekade ehlala naye ngoJuni nonyaka.Ngesonto eledlule, uNzimande uvele enkantolo efanayo ngohlelo lwethelevishini yena esejele laseWestville.Wabuza iMantshi uWendolyne Robinson ukuthi angakwazi yini ukufaka isicelo sebheyili?Imantshi yamqinisekisa yathi uvumelekile. NGEKE uzilethele amabhadi uma ubhala incwadi yamafa. Lokhu kushiwo nguMnuz Stephen Mofokeng weLegal Aid South Africa obegqugquzela abantu ukuthi babhale izincwadi zamafa mahhala kuleli sonto.ILaw Society of South Africa yeza nohlelo lokuthi abantu babhale izincwadi zamafa mahhala kanye ngonyaka kusukela ngoSepthemba 16 kuya kuSepthemba 20.UMofokeng uthe kunabantu abacabanga ukuthi ukubhala incwadi yefa kuhambisana namabhadi noma mhlawumbe kuzokwenza basheshe bashone."Ukubhala incwadi yefa ngeke kukulethele amabhadi, kuzoqinisekisa ukuthi impahla yakho ishiyelwa labo obathandayo ngendlela obufisa ngayo. Iyabavikela futhi ibalulekile kulesi sikhathi esiphila kuso.”Uthe uma usunayo incwadi yefa ungathatha leli thuba ukuyibukisisa kabusha wenze isiqiniseko sokuthi zonke izinto zisahamba ngohlelo.Ugqugquzele abantu ukuthi uma bebhala incwadi yefa basebenzise amagama aqondile angeke adide abantu uma sekwabiwa ifa.Ubalule ukuthi incwadi yefa ivimba imibango nezinye izinkinga ezenzekayo uma oshonile ebengayibhalanga.Abafisa ukubhalelwa izincwadi zamafa kufanele baye kubameli abayingxenye yohlelo lokwenza izincwadi zamafa mahhala bephethe omazisi, babhale impahla abanayo, babe namagama nezinamba zomazisi balabo abafuna ukubashiyela ifa.UMofokeng uthe kubalulekile ukukhetha umabi wamafa othembekile, ohlelekile futhi ozokwazi ukumelana nalo msebenzi.Uthe kubalulekile nokuchaza kahle abashiyelwa ifa ukuthi bangobani amagama, izinamba zabo zomazisi, ukuthi bahlobene kanjani nomnikazi wefa ukuze ugweme amaphutha uma sekwabiwa ifa.Imininingwane yabameli abazobe besiza ngokubhala incwadi yamafa mahhala kuleli sonto itholakala ngokuvakashela u: LSSA National Wills Week – LSSA
KUSOLWA ukuthi belingafuni ukwamukelwa ukwaliwa iphoyisa elisolwa ngokudubula unina wengane yalo endaweni yokudlela abesebenzela kuyona i-Authentiq, esemgwaqweni uFlorida, eThekwini, ngoMsombuluko ekuseni.Lokho kushiwo wuyise kamufi uNksz Zamangwane Bija (26), uMnuz Thulani Khanyile waKwaNyuswa, othe usola ukuthi ubaba womzukulu wakhe, naye wasendaweni, uMnuz Nhlakanipho Mkhize, ugajwe yisikhwele sokungafuni ukwamukela ukuthi indodakazi yakhe isiqhubeke nempilo.UMUFI, uNksz Zamangwane Bija odutshulwe nguyise wengane yakhe oyiphoyisa washona esemsebenzini Isithombe: SITHUNYELWEUMkhize obeyiphoyisa eHillcrest, naye ushonile kulesi sigameko okukholakala ukuthi ugasele lapho obekusebenzela khona uNksz Bija, wambizela emnyango wamdubula. Kwale ngisho ezama ukubaleka engena ngaphakathi emsebenzini, waqhubeka wamdubula, wafela khona lapho, kwalimala nabanye ababili. Elandisa Isolezwe ngakholwa wukuthi kuholele kulesi sigameko, uKhanyile uthe ngasekuqaleni kwalo nyaka kuke kwaba nesehlo lapho uMkhize agijimisa khona uNksz Bija ngesibhamu endaweni, efuna ukumlimaza."Kwaze kwafika abomndeni wakhe ekhweni lami bezoshweleza ngesenzo sendodana yabo. Saqhubeka nempilo ngoba sizitshela ukuthi sekudlulile. Besingazi ukuthi kuzofika lana, futhi sengiyazisola ngokwamukela uxolo lwabo. Ukube sabika emaphoyiseni ngaleso sikhathi ngabe kungcono,” kusho yena.Eqhuba, uthe bakholwa wukuthi uMkhize wehlulwe wukwamukela ukuthi indodakazi yakhe ibisiqhubeke nempilo njengoba ngokwazi kwakhe, laba bobabili abanengane yentombazane eneminyaka emine, bahlukana nyakenye.Lokho kushiwo wuyise kamufi uNksz Zamangwane Bija (26), noyise wengane yakhe okunguyena othathe impilo yakhe uMnuz Nhlakanipho Mkhize Isithombe: FACEBOOK"Sizwa kuthiwa uZama ubeke afake izithombe zakhe nesoka lakhe elisha ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, eveza ukuthi ujabule kangakanani empilweni yakhe. Kungenzeka ukuthi lokho ngenye yezinto eziholele ekutheni abulawe."Sibona manje ukuthi kwakumele siyisukumele kusanesikhathi lento, njengoba sazi ukuthi uze usebenza lapho afele khona nje, washiya kwenye indawo yokudlela ayesebenzela kuyona eHillcrest ngoba enzela ukuqhelelana naye. Nakhu manje esefika lapho abesesebenzela khona, wambulala,” kusho uKhanyile.Uthe okunye okubaphatha kabi wukuthi bezwe kuthiwa amaphoyisa aqapha ngakule ndawo athe akaphumele emnyango ayokhuluma naye."Ngiyawasola ngokuba budedengu kulesi simo ngoba kuthiwa atsheliwe ukuthi lo muntu obesemnyango unodlame kodwa awanganaka njengoba kuze konakala kanje,” kukhala uMkhize.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa aseBerea aphenya icala lokubulala nelokuzama ukubulala."Kubikwa ukuthi lo mlisa oyiphoyisa ebelingekho emsebenzini, uye lapho okusebenzela khona intombi yakhe, wayicelela emnyango wase eyidubula ngesibhamu somsebenzi, kwathi izama ukubaleka waqhubeka wayidubula amahlandla amaningi, yashona. Amaphoyisa kaMasipala abeqaphile kule ndawo adubule lo mlisa, waphuthunyiswa esibhedlela wafike washonela khona. Okwamanje imbangela yokubulala ayikaziwa,” kusho uNetshiunda. Ngesikhathi Isolezwe lihambele e-AuthentiQ, bekuvaliwe kanti imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula komnikazi wale ndawo ayiphumelelanga, ucingo lwakhe belukhala umlibe lungabanjwa, wangawuphendula nomyalezo athunyelwe wona kuWhatsApp. Abantu abakhulume neSolezwe abebekule ndawo baveze ukuthi izigameko zalolu hlobo ezilokhu zenzeka kule ndawo zizodala ukuthi abantu babe novalo lokuyihambela. Nyakenye ngakuyo lendawo kwadutshulwa umrepha u-AKA nomngani wakhe uTibz bashona bephuma eThe Wish, eyagcina ivaliwe.
UMNDENI wowayenguNgqongqoshe wezamaBhizinisi kaHulumeni, uMnuz Pravin Gordhan, uthi uqiniswa idolo yimiyalezo yenduduzo elokhu iqhubekile nokungena.Okhulumela umndeni, uMnuz Adrian Lackay, uthe nakuba kunzima ukwamukela ukushona kukaGordhan, isibalo esiphezulu sabantu abazwelana nabo sibethula umthwalo.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma emzini kaGordhan, eGauteng."Kusithoba amanxeba ukuzwa abantu bencoma iqhaza elibanjwe uGordhan ngesikhathi kulwelwa inkululeko kanye nangesikhathi kuqalwa uhulumeni wentandoyeningi. UGordhan wanikela ngempilo yakhe.”NgoLwesibili umndeni nezihlobo babe nomcimbi wangasese wokubona isidumbu sikaGordhan.Isidumbu sikaGordhan singene okokugcina kulo muzi wakhe.Ibhokisi ebelinesidumbu sikaGordhan besigoqwe ngefulegi elinemibala ye-ANC, okuyiqembu abeyilungu lalo.Bekuwumunyu wodwa ngesikhathi isidumbu sikaGordhan sesishiya umuzi wakhe, sesibuyela emakhazeni.Isidumbu sikaGordhan sifike eThekwini, ngoLwesithathu ntambama.Umngcwabo wakhe uzoba seNkosi Albert Luthuli International Convention Centre, ngoLwesihlanu.ULackay uthe uGordhan udlule emhlabeni ekhathazekile ngekusasa leNingizimu Afrika."UGordhan walwela ukuba bonke abantu bakuleli bathole impilo engcono. Akazange azabalazele ukuthi kube khona abantu abazozinothisa bodwa. Ubehlezi esigqugquzela ukuthi sonke silwele ukuba izwe lethu libe ngcono.”Ngaphandle kwemiyalezo yenduduzo, kuhlelwe imicimbi eyahlukene yokukhumbula uGordhan.ngoLwesibili ntambama kube nenkonzo yokumkhumbula ebisehholo ledolobha eGoli.Le nkonzo ibihlelwe yi-ANC esifundazweni iGauteng.Izikhulumi ebezishiyelana inkundla zincome amagalelo kaGordhan.Namhlanje ntambama kuzokuba nenye inkonzo yokukhumbula uGordhan ezokuba seThekwini.Le nkonzo ihlelwe yi-ANC KwaZulu-Natal.UGordhan ushonele esibhedlela esiseGoli ngeledlule, emva kokugula isikhathi eside. UGordhan uhlonishwe ngomngcwabo osezingeni likahulumeni wesigaba sesibili.UMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, uzokwethula inkulumo emngcwabeni kaGordhan.Phakathi kweminyango uGordhan ake wayiphatha kubalwa owezeziMali nowezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu.Ngaphambi kwalokho, wayengukhomishana weSA Revenue Service (Sars), wamemezela ukuthatha kwakhe umhlalaphansi kwezepolitiki ngaphambi kokhetho lwangoMeyi nonyaka.
IMINDENI yabesifazane ababili ababulawa ngesihluku ngenyanga edlule, basola imizamo yokubambezela icala kwabasolwa, kungacaci ngommeli omele omunye wabo eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini.Umsolwa wokuqala uMnuz Lungani Mthethwa (38) nowesibili, uMnuz Sandile Chili (44) bekulindeleke ukuthi bafake isicelo sebheyili ngecala lokudubula babulale uNksz Anele Mbokazi (29) nomngani wakhe uNksz Zizipho Gabisa (30).Laba besifazane batholwa bebulewe emgwaqweni waseKenville eThekwini, ngo-Agasti 25. Ngakusasa amaphoyisa abopha abasolwa eSouth Beach emva kokulandelwa komkhondo kusetshenziswa iselula kaNksz Mbokazi.Ngesikhathi bevela izolo enkantolo ebigcwele phama imindeni yabathintekayo nomphakathi, imantshi uMnuz Scelo, Zuma izwakalise ukungenami ngabameli bakaMthethwa.Lokhu kwenzeke ngesikhathi ummeli uNksz Sibongile Khanyile, othe uthunywe uMnuz Nyameka Jondwana ukuthi azomela ikhasimende lakhe uMthethwa.UNksz Khanyile uveze ukuthi abakulungele ukuthi kuqhutshekwe nesicelo sebheyili njengoba bezinikwe ngoSepthemba 9, izitatimende ababezicele ngesikhathi abasolwa begcina ukuvela.UMSOLWA wokuqala uMnuz Lungani Mthethwa nowesibili, uMnuz Sandile Chili (wejakhethi enombala obomvu) ngesikhathi bevele enkantolo Isithombe: ZIMBILI VILAKAZIUZuma uthe yize esho kanje uNksz Khanyile kodwa ubona ukungahleleki kubameli balo msolwa, wexwayisa ngokuthi selihlehla okokugcina icala ngenxa yabo.Ummeli kaChili, uMnuz B Ngcongo, yena uveze ukuthi ukulungele ukuqala isicelo sebheyili, kodwa uZuma wathi icala alihlehlele u-Okthoba 7, ukuze abasolwa basifake kanyekanye isicelo sebheyili.UMnuz Mvuselelo Magwaza okhulumela umndeni kaNksz Mbokazi, uthe lena indlela yokuqhamuka namaqhinga ngecala.UMPHAKATHI ubhikishe ngaphandle kweNkantolo yaseThekiwni, kuvela abasolwa ngokubulala abangani Isithombe: ZIMBILI VILAKAZI"Njengoba kudideke inkantolo nathi sididekile. Kuyasixaka ukuthi okwani lokhu kubambezela okungaka okulethwa uhlangothi lwabo (abasolwa),” kusho uMagwaza, othe banethemba lokuthi umthetho uzothatha indawo yawo.Udadewabo kaNksz Gabisa, uNksz Thobile Gabisa, uthe ngokubona kwabo, abasolwa bazama ukubaxukuza umqondo beyimindeni yabagilwa."Mhlawumbe bacabanga ukuthi sizophosa ithawula kanti cha ngoba sifuna ubulungiswa ngezingane ezibulawe zincane, zisanekusasa eliqhakazile,” kusho uNksz Gabisa.Uthe kwabanenga ukuzwa ukuthi abasolwa bahlela ukuliphika icala."Ungaliphika kanjani icala bonke ubufakazi bukhomba kuwena? Laba bantu babenenhloso yokubulala ngakho ke abagwetshwe,” kusho uNksz Gabisa.Iphini likaSihlalo we-ANCWL eThekwini, uNksz Gugu Sibiya, lithe bayazibophezela ekutheni bazoyeseka imindeni yabagilwa njengoba bengahambisani nokubulawa kwabesifazane nezingane."Bababulele ngesihluku, badala ukuthi izingane zabo zikhule zingenabo onina. Umthetho awuthathe indawo yawo. Abantwana abasazi ukuthi uma behamba emakhaya bazobuya yini,” kusho uNksz Sibiya.Bekukhona nabenhlangano i-LifeLine, nabo bezokweseka imindeni.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi uMthethwa ungowokudabuka eKukhanyeni, eNdwedwe.UMthethwa ungene enkantolo eshaye ihembe likanokusho elinombala omnyama nosagolide nebhulukwe lejini nezicathulo zikanokusho. Ubehlala ahlale ahlanganise izandla ebusweni samuntu othandazayo.UChili yena ubefake ijakhethi elinombala omnyama nobomvu egcina emadolweni, ibhulukwe elimnyama, isikibha esibomvu namateki akhathele.Ngaphandle kwenkantolo bekubhikisha umphakathi obufike ngenqwaba yamatekisi ukuzokweseka imindeni yabagilwa.

KUYAVULWA ngoLwesihlanu ukufakwa kwezicelo za-online esikhwameni esixhasa izitshudeni ngemali yokufunda, iNational Student Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS).Lokhu kushiwo nguNgqongqoshe weMfundo ePhakeme, uDkt Nobuhle Nkabane, ngesikhathi kunesithangami sabezindaba.Izicelo ezizofakwa kusukela ngoLwesihlanu ezokukhokhela ukufunda ngonyaka ozayo, u-2025.Ukuvulwa kokufakwa kwezicelo bekumele kuqale izolo kodwa ungqongqoshe wathi kuzoqala ngoLwesihlanu. UDkt Nkabane uthe kusukela ngesonto eledlule ngoLwesine bekunezigcawu zokubonisana nezinhlangano zezitshudeni, abaphathi bamakolishi nezikhungo zezemfundo ephakeme mayelana nokuxhaswa kwabafundi yilesi sikhwama.Uthe eminyakeni eyedlule isibalo sezitshudeni ezithembele kulesi sikhwama ukuze sizixhase ngemali yokufunda sikhule kakhulu, okuhambisana nokuthi uhulumeni uvulele ithuba nezitshudeni eziphuma ezindaweni ebezinganakiwe phambilini, okuyizingane ezizalwa ngabazali abantulayo nabahola imali encane."Kubalulekile ukuthi iNSFAS izilungiselele ngokwanele ngokwezinsiza kanye nohlelo oluzokwazi ukuhlangabezane nesibalo esikhulayo," kuchaza uDkt Nkabane.Uthe ngesikhathi kunezigcawu zokubonisana kuvelile ukuthi izinxushunxushu ezukhungweni eziphezulu zezemfundo zisuswa yizinkinga zeNSFAS."Izitshudeni eziningi zizwakalise ukuphatheka kabi ngokubambezeleka kokukhokhwa kwemali yokufunda ezikhungweni nokungasebenzi kahle kwezinhlelo zeNSFAS," kusho ungqongqoshe.Uqhube wathi iNSFAS kulindeleke ukuthi yethule inqwaba yezinhlelo zokubhekana nezinye zezinselelo ezivezwe yizinhlangano zezitshudeni. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuthi kwenziwe lula uhlelo lokubhalisa online.Okunye athe kuvelile ngesikhathi kunezigcawu zokubonisana wukubambezeleka kokukhokhelwa kwezitshudeni ezifunda ngeNSFAS, nokukhishwa kwemiphumela kamatric okuholela ekutheni nezinqumo zokuthi bazoluthola yini uxhaso kulesi sikhwama nakho kuhlehle. Indlela esetshenziswayo yokuxhasa izitshudeni nokusebenzisana kweNSFAS namaSETA. Ukubaluleka kokuthi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izitshudeni zihlala ezindaweni eziphephile. "Kungumbono wami ukuthi kumele kube nezingxoxo eziqhubekayo phakathi kwezinhlaka zezitshudeni kanye nezinhlangano zezombusazwe ukuze kubunjwe ikusasa nenqubomgomo yemfundo ephakeme esebenzayo, ikakhulukazi mayelana nosizo lwezezimali," kusho uDkt Nkabane.
BAZOVELA eNkantolo yeMantshi eRichards Bay namuhla abasolwa abangu-30 ngezinsolo zokudayisa izincwadi zokushayela zomgunyathi.Laba basolwa abakhalelwe ngamasongo kaSigonyela basebenza esikhungweni sokushayela saseMelmoth ngaphansi koMasipala waseMthonjaneni.Esitatimendeni esikhishwe wuMnyango wezokuThutha nokuHlaliswa kwaBantu, kuvela ukuthi bebedayisa izincwadi ngo-R2 500."Ngaphambilini, uphiko oluhlola izimoto emnyangweni nophiko loKlebe babophe abantu abangu-9, abahloli ababili nabafake izicelo zamalayisensi abangu-10 abahlomulile. Umnyango usuwahoxisile wonke amalayisensi akhishwa yilabo ababoshiwe,” kusho isitatimende.Siqhube sathi lokhu kuyinkomba ecacile yokuzimisela komnyango ukuqeda ngeqembu lezigebengu, okuhlanganisa abahloli, abanikazi bezikole zokushayela nabafaka izicelo."Umyalezo wethu uthi abashayeli mbumbulu abenze izivivinyo zokushayela zomgunyathi bazosuswa emigwaqweni yethu, baboshwe futhi bavalelwe ejele. Lokhu sikwenzela ukuqeda izingozi emigwaqweni yethu futhi sisindise impilo yabantu abangenacala,” sisho kanje.UMphathiswa wezokuThutha nokuHlaliswa kwaBantu KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Siboniso Duma, uncome ukuboshwa kwalaba basolwa.UDuma uncome umsebenzi omuhle owenziwa uphiko loKlebe namaphoyisa omgwaqo, waphinde wancoma ukuzikhandla kwabasebenzi balo mnyango."Laba basebenzi bayaqinisekisa ukuphepha kwabashayeli emgwaqweni kanye nokuphepha komphakathi. Umnyango uzoqhubeka ukhuculule ukungcola ezikoleni zokushayela nasezindaweni zokuhlola ezahlukene,” usho kanje.Umphathiswa uthe labo abashayela izimoto bengenazo izincwadi, amalayisensi abo azothathwa ebese beyaboshwa babhadle ejele ngoba izingozi eziningi emgwaqweni zidalwa ukuthi abantu abaningi bashayela bengenazo izincwadi futhi nokuqeqesheka okusezingeni abakutholanga. Uqhube wathi umnyango uqinisekisa ukuthi usebenze ngokuzikhandla ukuvikela umphakathi uphephe ezingozini zemigwaqo.
AMAPHOYISA aseKZN asekhiphe incwadi egunyaza ukuboshwa kowesilisa waseMariannhill, eThekwini osolwa ngamacala okukhokhisa imali yokuvikela.Ngokusho kokhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uColonel Robert Netshiunda, umsolwa uMnuz Linda Hlengwa, odume ngelikaPutin nelinye elithi Mjinja, wayeboshwe ngoJulayi 2020.UNetshiunda uthe lo msolwa oyingozi wayeboshelwe icala lokutholakala nesibhamu esingekho emthethweni nezinhlamvu."Wadedelwa esitokisini kusalindwe imiphumela yokuhlolwa kwesibhamu. Kusuka lapho uwashaya indiva amasamanisi ambizela enkantolo ukuthi ayobhekana namacala ayebekwe wona,” kusho uNetshiunda, othe incwadi egunyaza ukuboshwa kwakhe ikhishwe yiNkantolo yeMantshi yasePinetown ngoSepthemba 9.UNetshiunda uphinde wadalula nokuthi lona wesilisa ufunelwa noxhaxha lwamacala okufuna ngoshova imali yokuvikela eMariannhill.Uthe amaphoyisa anxusa noma ngubani ongaba nolwazi ngokuthi uHlengwa ukuphi awathinte ngokushesha enombolweni ethi 08600 10111.

BAFUNA lusukunyelwe phezulu abazali olwabafundi abafuna ngoshova o-R100 okuyimali yokuvikela abanye esikoleni iMsebe Primary eMlaza, kwa-H.Lokhu kudalulwe ngomunye wabo, uMnuz Sithembiso Lamjola, kulandela ukuya kwabo kulesi sikole izolo, beyofuna izimpendulo.Elandisa, uLamjola uthe uthole ngempelasonto ngokwenzeka kulesi sikole, ehlangana nomzali wengane efunda khona."Uthe ukhathazekile ngengane yakhe ethi ayisafuni ukuphinde ilubhade esikoleni ngoba ikhathele ukukhokha imali yokuvikelwa,” kusho uLamjola.Uveze ukuthi uthe uma esenza olwakhe uphenyo endaweni, wathola ukuthi ziningi ezikhala esifanayo.Uthe bathole ukuthi sekunesikhathi iqeqebana labafundi abafunda uGrade 6 no-7 kulesi sikole abazibiza ngeQwabe Protection, befuna imali kubafundi abafunda amabanga angaphansi kwawabo."Kuthiwa babeka isamba sika-R100 ukuthi umfundi ngamunye akasikhokhe. Kuvela ukuthi babeka umthetho othi umfundi ngamunye angakhokha phakathi kuka-R1 kuya ku-R5 nsuku zonke ukwehlisa isikweletu sakhe sika-R100 aze asiqede,” kusho uLamjola.Uthe abafundi abakhala ngokuthi abanayo le mali, baphila impilo yokushawa ngezimpama zonke izinsuku yileli qeqebana "labavikeli”.Uthe engxogxweni ababe nayo nothishanhloko wesikole, bathole ukuthi isikole siyazi ngodaba kodwa akukho zinyathelo ezitheni esesizithathile."Sikhonjiswe uhlu lwaleli qeqebana elenza lo mkhuba, satshelwa ukuthi bake bashawa, kodwa kwangabe kusaba khona okunye okwenziwayo ngabo,” kusho uLamjola.Udalule nokuthi abafundi abakwaziyo ukukhokha le mali yokuvikelwa yiqeqebana libasabisa ngokuthi uma bebika kothisha noma kubazali, bazophela yinduku.Uthe isimo sesiphumile esandleni njengoba sekukhona abafundi bezikole ezingomakhelwane, abalinda leli qeqebana ngaphandle kwesikole.Uveze nokuthi sebekhona nabanye abazali abaqhinqa ngaphandle kwesikole ukuzobheka "amabhoklolo” ahlukumeza izingane zabo."Sifuna ilungiswe masinyane le nto ingaze yonakale kakhulu. Asinazo izingane ezizoyeka isikole ngenxa yeqeqebana labavikeli futhi asiludingi udweshu oluzosuka ngaphandle kwesikole ngenxa yale nto,” kubhoka uLamjola.Uthe bafune umhlangano ophuthumayo nesigungu esilawula isikole, iSchool Governing Body (SGB), ukuze ichaze ukuthi yini isikole esiyenzayo ukulwa nesihlava?Uthe sebelubikile udaba nakumphathi wesiteshi samaphoyisa endaweni, ukuze amaphoyisa angenelele ngokubheka ukuthi imali eqoqwa iqeqebana kubafundi liyayidla lona noma kukhona abantu abadala abangaphandle kwesikole eliyisa kubo.Usihlalo weSGB, uMnuz Zakhele Khumalo, uthe akulona iqiniso ukuthi kunenkinga efana nale esikoleni, wathi lokhu okushiwoyo, yinto nje esetshenziswa amaqembu epolitiki afuna ukuzitholela amaphuzu emphakathini.Uthe ukube kukhona into efana nale esikoleni ngabe sebeyazi ngayo njengoba abafundi nabo abazali bevulelekile ukubika ngezinto ezingahambi kahle esikoleni.Uvumile ukuthi kukhona isigameko lapho kuke kwaba khona abafundi abayishumi nanye, ababelindwe ngabanye ngaphandle kwesango lesikole."Sathola ukuthi ingxabano yayisuswe ukulwa kwababili ngempelasonto ngakubo. Yase ingenelelwa abangani bangaphandle, abazoqhinqa ngaphandle kwesikole,” kusho uKunene, othe babiza amaphoyisa ukuzolekelela abangaphakathi ukuthi bagoduke bephephile.Uveze nokuthi bakhipha isexwayiso esiqinile kulaba abangaphakathi ukuthi uma kuke kwezwakala ukuthi balwile, bazoxoshwa esikoleni.Uvumile ukuthi uhlu lwabafundi luzibiza ngeQwabe Brothers, kodwa uma bebuzwa ngaleli gama, bavele bashona le nale.Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal uMnuz Muzi Mahlambi uthe bazothumela imenenja yesekethe ukuthi iyolubheka lolu daba."Sizocela isikole sisebenzisane nabazali. Ngeke sikubekezelele ukuhlushwa kwabafundi ngabanye ezikoleni zethu ngoba kufanele zibe yizindawo eziphephile,” kusho uMahlambi.

SEKULELE ezandleni zazo ukuthi ziyawasebenzisa yini amathuba ezikhonjiswe wona izitshudeni zaseDurban University of Technology (DUT) eziphothule uhambo lwamasonto amabili esifundazweni iFujian, eChina, ngoLwesihlanu.Lezi zitshudeni ezingu-17 ezenza izifundo zolimi lwakhona iMandarin, zifulathele elakuleli ngoSepthemba 2, ukuyothamela i-summer camp ehlelwe yi-DUT Confucius Institute neFujian Agriculture and Forestry University (Fafu).Kusuka zifika kuleliya zwe belungekho usuku lokuphumula njengoba bezehla zenyuka zihambela izigcinamagugu zifunda ngomlando waseChina, ikakhulukazi eFujian. Bezihamba nezitshudeni zaseFafu, lapho zifunde kabanzi ngomlando wenyuvesi.Zihambele nezindawo eziningi ezigcina umlando okubalwa kuzo enomlando wemisebenzi kamengameli wezwe, uMnuz Xi Jinping eFujian, ngaphansi kohlelo olubizwa nge-3820.Zibuye zayofundiswa ngomsuka wetiye i-jasmine tea njengoba itiye liyingxenye enkulu yomlando waseChina.Zifunde nangokusetshenziswa kobuchwepheshe be-juncao okuwutshani obukhiqiza amakhowe osebalethwa naKwaZulu-Natal ngo-2005.UMQONDISI we-DUT CI, uMnuz Frank Lin Wu Isithombe: Fanelesibonge BenguEzinye izindawo ezihanjelwe kubalwa nezinye izikhungo zemfundo ephakeme ukuyochazelwa ngamathuba akhona.Njengoba iChina yaziwa njengezwe eliseqhulwini ngakwezobuchwepheshe, izitshudeni ziyiswe eChina Fujian VR Experience Center. Khona kutshenziswa ubuchwepheshe be-virtual reality ukwenza ezemfundo zibe lula kanjalo nezikaqedisizungu okuthi uma ufake izibuko zakhona kube ngathi uyingxenye yakho.Ziye nasesikhungweni i-Brickz PartNIR Innovation Center nasembukisweni wamabhizinisi iChina International Fair for Investments & Trade.Bezingagcini ngokufunda kuphela kodwa beziphinde zidle nokudla kwakhona.Yize izitshudeni zikhombise ukukujabulela ebezifundiswa ngakho kodwa kuhambe izinsuku kwaba nokuhhumuzela, kokunye zithengelwe ukudla okusheshayo kwasezitolo ezikhona eNingizimu Afrika ngoba sezikhathele ezingakujwayele kwakuleliya zwe. Nokushisa bekungazibekile phansi kwazise yisehlobo nobekudala abanye bekhale ngokukhathala.Zonke zibuye ziphephile yize kuke kwaba novalo lokuthi esinye sizogcina siyohlolwa ngoba besikhala ngezinhlungu ngasenhliziyweni.Umqondisi we-DUT CI, uMnuz Frank Lin Wu ekhuluma nezitshudeni, uzigqugquzele ukuthi ziwathathe amathuba ezikhonjiswe wona."Uma ninamaqhinga okuqhamuka nezinto nokuqeqeshelwa amabhizinisi, nikhululeke nisazise ukuze sizobona ukuthi sinisiza kanjani,” kusho uWu.
UHLONISHWE yizizwe uZulu kugujwa iminyaka ewu-40 kwavuselelwa uMkhosi woMhlanga.Izizwe, okukhona kuzo nezangaphandle kwaleli, aziwuvali umlomo ngobuhle ezibubone esigodlweni eNyokeni, ngempelasonto.Umkhosi wakulo nyaka ubuhanjelwe abasebukhosini bezinye izizwe okubalwa kubo iNdlovukazi yamaPedi, uManyaku Thulare, iNgonyama yesizwe esise-Uganda, uPapa Sande, nabasebukhosini baseSwatini.Okuqaphelekile emkhosini wangempelasonto ukubonakala kwesibalo esiphezulu soNdlunkulu namazinyane eSilo uGoodwill Zwelithini, esake sabonakala emikhosini yaseNdlunkulu kusukela kwaphatha iSilo uMisuzulu kaZwelithini.Umkhosi ubuhanjelwe oNdlunkulu abane bakaMdlokombane, okuwuNdlunkulu waKwaKhethomthandayo, uSibongile Winnifred Dlamini Zulu, uNdlunkulu waKwaDlamahlahla obeqala ukubonakala emkhosini omkhulu okukhona kuwo Indlulamithi, uBuhle Mathe Zulu, uNdlunkulu waKwaLinduzulu, uThandekile Ndlovu, noNdlunkulu wasoNdini, uZola Mafu Zulu.Izimbali zesizwe beziphume ngobuningi emkhosini wakulo nyaka, umkhosi ubuwubukhazikhazi njengoba izintombi bezihlobe ngemibala eyehlukene.Lize lashona elangoMgqibelo izintombi zilokhu zihambisa umhlanga esigodlweni.AbaNtwana uZelamile noNontethelelo kaMisuzulu bahole izintombi ebezihambisa umhlanga eSilweni.Kushintshe izulu lana ngesikhathi iSilo siphuma esigodlweni siya enkundleni lapho ebesiyokhuluma khona nezinkulungwane zamatshitshi, kuphinde kwenzeka okufanayo ngesikhathi iMbube isithula inkulumo.INdlovukazi uManyaku ithe uZulu uyisibonelo esihle kwezinye izizwe zase-Afrika."Ngiyajabula ukuba iSilo singimeme ukuba ngizobuka lobuhle obungaka bezintombi ezizigcinile. Sibukela kunina ukuthi izintombi ziziphatha kanjani, futhi sifunda lukhulu lapha.”INdlovukazi ithe bafuna ukuvuselela ubuhlobo bukaZulu namaPedi obaqala kubusa iSilo uCetshwayo neNgonyama uSekhukhune."Uma nisibona lapha ningethuki, ubudlelwano bethu busuka kude kakhulu.”INdlovukazi ithe bayaseseka iSilo uMisuzulu kaZwelithini."Laba abathanda iSilo ngiyabathanda nami, labo abazonda iSilo ngiyabazonda nami.”INgonyama uPapa Sande ithe usiko kuphela olukwazi ukuhlanganisa abantu ngale ndlela abebehlangene ngayo eNyokeni.USande uhole amakhosi angaphansi kwenhlangano i-African Kingdom Diaspora Alliance adlulisele isitifiketi sokuqokwa kweNdlulamithi njengosihlalo ngokuhlonishwa wale nhlangano egqugquzela ubumbano nokuthula ezwenikazi i-Afrika.Okhulumela iSilo, uMntwana uSimphiwe Zulu, uthe ukuqokelwa KweNdlulamithi kulesi sikhundla kusho ukuthi ivunywa yizo zonke izizwe."Ngalesi sitifiketi bathi bayavuma ukuthi beseZimbabwe, beseMalawi, bese-Uganda, kodwa uma bengamaZulu bathi inkosi yabo iyodwa nina beSilo. Bathi inkosi yabo ile ephambi kwethu. Manje base bethi angeke kulunge ukuthi bakhulume ngomlomo kuphela, base beletha isitifiketi esishoyo ukuthi Ingonyama yethu yiyo yona lena, akekho omunye."Nathi siyavuma Ngonyama ukuthi ubani nje omunye ongathi uma ezokhuluma bese kuna imvula, athi uma eqeda ukukhuluma bese iyaphela? Ilona ophambi kwethu nina beSilo. Akekho omunye okungenzeka kuye lapha kwaZulu.”
IHHOVISI lePhini likaMengameli, uMnuz Paul Mashatile, lithi uphile njengosheleni emuva kokuquleka ethula inkulumo emcimbini obuseTzaneen, eLimpopo, ngoMgqibelo.Okhulumela uMashatile, uMnuz Keith Khoza, uthe uMashatile uqulekiswe ukuphelelwa amanzi emzimbeni okubangelwe amazinga okushisa abekade ephezulu.UKhoza uthe amaphaphu phansi ezweni, uMashatile ungumqemane, ubonane nodokotela wakhe okunguye oveze lezi zindaba.Itshale ingebhe kubantu i-video ezungezayo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ekhombisa uMashatile, obekade eyisikhulumi sosuku, efumbeka phansi esesteji.Ubekade eyisicukuthwane emcimbini owaziwa ngokuthi iN’wamitwa Day esigodini iValoyi.UKhoza uthe ngesikhathi uMashatile ethula inkulumo yakhe uzizwe eba lula ephelelwa amandla obekade kudalwa wukushisa kakhulu."Singakuqinisekisa ukuthi iphini likamengameli lisesimweni esikahle emuva kokuxilongwa odokotela,” kusho uKhoza.I-Economic Freedom Fighters (EFF) ikhiphe isitatimende lapho ebikade ifisela khona ukwelulama okusheshayo uMashatile.Leli qembu lichaze uMashatile ngomuntu oqavile kwipolitiki yaseNingizimu Afrika futhi nguye owengamele amabhizinisi kahulumeni ePhalamende."Ungumuntu obalulekile ekuxhumaniseni amaqembu ezepolitiki aphikisayo nongqongqoshe. Uphinde aqinisekise ukuthi labo abasezintanjeni zoMbuso bayawenza umsenzi ababekelwe wona,” kusho i-EFF.I-EFF ithe yizindaba ezinhle ukuzwa ukuthi uMashatile welulama kahle, yathi ungumholi ozithobile, ovulelekile, otholakalayo futhi owenza kahle umsebenzi wakhe.
IZANGOMA zezulu zikhiphe isexwayiso ngemvula enamandla ehambisa nokuduma ezindaweni ezahlukene KwaZulu-Natal, enyakatho ye-Eastern Cape, engxenyeni yempumalanga yeNorthern Cape, eFree State nasezingxenyeni zaseNorth West.
NAKUBA baziwa ngokuba ngenye yezinkampani ezihamba phambili ngokukhiqiza izikhali zombutho wezempi kuleli zwe nasemazweni omhlaba, kodwa babona kungakeneli asebekwenzeile uma kuqhathaniswa nabasakufisa kule ndima.Labo yinkampani iMilkor, esizakhele udumo umhlaba wonke selokhu yasungulwa ngo-1981, ngokuba yinkampani ethenjwayo ekukhiqizeni izikhali, iziklebhe nama-drone kobuchwepheshe besimanje.ABANYE babasebenzi beMilkor beqhuba umsebenzi Isithombe: SITHUNYELWEUMnuz Daniel Du Plessis wale nkampani, ikomkhulu layo elisePitoli, futhi enamahhovisi okusebenzela eGoli naseKapa, uthe ukuhlale beshisekela ukwenza okukhulu, kwenza babone umsebenzi asebewenzile unganele futhi ungakapheli."Singabantu abahlale bezihlupha ngokuthi singenzanjani ukuthi umsebenzi esiwenzayo uhlale usezingeni elicokeme, okwenza kuthi noma amakhasimende ethu esincoma nabantu bengawuvali umlomo ngesikwenzayo, kodwa singaboni sesifanelwe wukuhudula izinyawo. Sihlale sifuna okukhulu,” kusho yena.Eqhuba, uthe balapha abakhona manje nje, indaba yaqala ngokuthi benze iziqhumane ezisetshenziswa ngabombutho wezempi, okuthe ngo-1994 benabela emazweni omhlaba."Kuthe ngo-2017 sadlondlobala kakhulu ezweni, sase sandisa nezinto esizenzayo njengoba manje sesikhiqiza nezimoto ezinkulu ezisetshenziswa empini. Sisanda kukhiqiza nohlobo lwe-drone eyenziwe ngobuchwepheshe besimanje bezinga eliphezulu futhi enkulu kunawo wonke akhona e-Afrika."Sesidayise imikhiqizo yethu engaphezu kwa-62 00 emazweni omhlaba angaphezu kwa-50 emhlabeni wonke kule minyaka ewu-43 sikhona. Kanti asimile njengoba sisafuna ukuqhubeka senze okukhulu, futhi sandise amathuba omsebenzi ikakhulu kubantu abasha ngoba bayikusasa,” kusho uDu Plessis.I-Milkor inabasebenzi abawu-500, okuhlanganisa abawu-320 ebaqashe eKapa.UDu Plessis ucebise abantu abafuna ukungena endimeni yabo ukukhuthalela ukwenza izifundo zobunjiniyela bamakhemali nezobuchwepheshe besimanje.
ISILO uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini sifuna uZulu uyozikhombisa amandla eGoli emva kokuzikhombisa eMkhosini woMhlanga obuyingqophamlando.ISilo sithe inselelo ehlalele uZulu ukuba uyozikhombisa amandla eGoli emva kokuzibonakalisa ngoMkhosi woMhlanga obuseNyokeni, ngempelasonto.Imbube ithe nakuba eGoli kunezizwe eziningi, uZulu iwona omningi kuleli dolobha eliyisizinda somnotho wezwe.Lokhu sikusho ngesikhathi sikhuluma nezimbali zezwe, izolo.Kulo nyaka bekugujwa iminyaka ewu-40 kwavuselelwa kabusha uMkhosi woMhlanga.Izintombi beziphume ngobuningi emkhosini wakulo nyaka.Imbube ithe kuzokwenziwa uMkhosi woMhlanga waseGoli lapho uZulu uzozikhombisa khona amandla.Beziphume ngobuningi izintombi zaseGoli emkhosini wakulo nyaka, kepha zakhala ngokuthi zikhishwa inyumbazane."Ukuze siqede lezi nkulumo, kufanele siye eGoli. Nibonile ukuthi izintombi zaseGoli beziningi kanjani? IGoli linezizwe eziningi. Nathi sibaningi eGoli, eqinisweni ithina esibaningi kunabo.”ISilo sithe umkhosi wakulo nyaka uvunywe yizulu.Indlulamithi yamakhosi ithe isimo sezulu sikhombise ukuthi umkhosi wakulo nyaka uhambe kahle.Izulu beliguqubele kwaNongoma, lishaye izihlambi ngesikhathi iMbube iphuma namabutho bephuma esigodlweni beya enkundleni, nangesikhathi iSilo sikhuluma nezinkulungwane zamatshitshi abeseNyokeni.ISilo sithe isimo sezulu sikhombisa ukuthi umkhosi wamukeliwe amadlozi aseNdlunkulu."Kusho ukuthi namakhosi amadala ayejabula. Thina balapha eNdlunkulu sizosala sibonge ukuthi umkhosi uhambe kahle. Kodwa sizojabula kahle uma sesizwa ukuthi nonke nifike niphephile emakhaya. Ngiyahlukumezeka kancane ngenxa yamaloli agcwele emigwaqweni. Ilesifunda kuphela esinale nkinga yamaloli, awekho kwezinye izifunda.”Izolo izintombi ezingu-28 zivalelise eSilweni.Lezi zintombi ezigide okokugcina eMkhosini woMhlanga njengoba sezibheke emendweni.Imbube ihalalisele lezi zintombi, yazinika izibusiso.ISilo sinxuse izimbali zesizwe ukuba ziqhubeke nokuzigcina.Imbube ifisele izintombi ezizobhala izivivinyo zokuphela konyaka ukuba zibhale kahle, saphonsela inselelo ababhala ibanga leshumi ukuba benze kahle njengoba kwenza abalapha esifundazweni ababebhala ngonyaka odlule."Laba bangonyaka odlule benza saziqhenya ngabo. Ningavumi ukuphazanyiswa izinto eziseceleni, nihambe niqonde kahle ngoba niyazi lapho niya khona.”ISilo siphinde sazwakalisa ukukhathazeka ngobugebengu obudlangile esifundazweni.Imbube ithe ukwanda kwezigameko zokubulawa kwabantu nokuhlukunyezwa kwabantu besifazane kunika iKwaZulu-Natal igama elibi."Yithi esihamba phambili ngalobu bugebengu ezwenikazi, angisasho ezweni. Le nto isinikeza igama elibi.”ISILO uMisuzulu kaZwelithini simemezele ukuthi uMkhosi woMhlanga usuzokwenziwa naseGoli Izithombe: SIBONELO NGCOBO
USELE yedwa notavatava lokugebenga nokuntshontshela uyise uLongwe Twala, ogqunywe esitokisini ngemuva kokudedelwa komfowabo uSello ayeboshwe naye ngamacala okugqekeza nokweba.ULongwe uvele kancane enkantolo yeMantshi yaseRandburg, ngoMsombuluko, ngamacala okugebenga nokweba. Le nsizwa yaboshiswa uyise uChicco Twala ngemuva kokufica kwakhe kugqekeziwe, kwebiwe nemishini yakhe ebiza izinkulungwane. UChicco wanikela esiteshini samaphoyisa eDouglasdale, wavulela amadodana akhe amabili, uLongwe noSello, amacala okugqekeza nokweba.USello wadedelwa yinkantolo ngomhla ka-12 kwephezulu ngemuva kokuba kuvele enkantolo ukuthi abukho ubufakazi obanele obumyamanisa nalawa macala.ULongwe oneminyaka engu-39 ubudala, uthole ummeli woMbuso ocele inkantolo ukuba imnikeze isikhathi sokuthola imininingwane eyanele ngalo.Imantshi u-Abdul Khan itshele uLongwe ukuthi ngeke bakwazi ukuqhubeka necala ngemuva kokuthi ummeli wakhe ecele ukuthi icala lihlehliswe."Mnumzane Twala, udaba luzobuyela enkantolo ngoSepthemba 25. Ummeli wakho ucele isikhashana ukuze athole ulwazi olwanele ngecala. Ucele uMbuso isikhathi sokulilungiselela icala lakho, uzohlala esitokisini uze uzwe ngebheyili yakho ngesonto elizayo,” kusho yona.
Indlala ezweni elingumakhelwane iZimbabwe isidale ukuthi kuqhanyukwe nohlelo lokuthi kuzingelwe izindlovu ezingu-200 ukuze zidliwe ngabantu.UNgqongqoshe wezeMvelo eZimbabwe, uMnuz Sithembiso Nyoni, ucashunwe kwiBulawayo24, ethi uhulumeni ucabanga ukunqanda ukungqubuzana phakathi kwezilwane nabantu ngokuthi kuzingelwe izindlovu ezigcwele ngokweqile ezweni. Lokhu kuhloswe ngakho ukuqeda indlala nokunciphisa izindlovu."IZimbabwe inezindlovu eziningi kunezidingayo. Sinezindlovu ezidlula amahlathi ethu. Njengohulumeni sikhuluma neZimParks (Zimbabwe Parks and Wildlife Authority) neminye imiphakathi ukwenza okwake kwenziwa yiNamibia ukuze sibulale izindlovu bese sinxenxa abesifazane ukuthi bomise inyama, bayipakishe bese benza isiqiniseko sokuthi ifika emiphakathini edinga umsoco,” kusho uNyoni.Kuthiwa indlala eZimbabwe idalwa yisomiso esihlasele kuleliya zwe.
INGXABANO phakathi kukanomehlo nekhansela iholele ekutheni izintombi nto zaKwaMashu, zingayi emhlangeni.Unomehlo uthi ikhansela lamsongela ngokuthi lizombamba ngoba uvotele i-MK, kuthe uma selingasamniki amafomu agcwalisayo wabona ukuthi beliqinisile, langamtshela nangemihlangano. NgoLwesihlanu, umhloli webhasi uthe kuvumeleke ukuthi agibelise izintombi eziyisikhombisa ekubeni abanye onomehlo bebegibelisa ezingu-15.Izintombi ezihlolwa uNkk Thulisile Ngema, uMaBiyela, zijike esitobhini. Zahamba nabazali ziyobuza edepho ukuthi kungani kuthiwa azibe yisikhombisa, kwathiwa azibuze ikhansela, kube yilo elizocacisa. Kuthiwa ikhansela lishayelwa ucingo, lathi aliyingeni indaba yomuntu owavotela i-MK.Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ikhansela lithi aliyanga koxazulula lokhu kudideka ngoba belimatasatasa futhi onomehlo babetsheliwe ukuthi unomehlo ngamunye uzohamba nezintombi eziwu-15, kodwa uNkk Ngema wafika nenqwaba.UNkk Ngema uthe ezinye izintombi bezizohamba ngenye imoto, ezingu-15 zingene ebhasini. Kuphoqeleke ukuthi zingabe zisahamba zonke. "Ngangicabanga ukuthi uyazisholo nje uma ethi uzongibamba ngoba ekloloda ngesikhathi sokhetho, nakhona angazi ukuthi wayeze athi ngivotele i-MK nje, walibonaphi ivoti lami? Ikhansela liqale langanginika amafomu, lanikeza omunye unomehlo, lingishiya ngiwumakhelwane. Lowo nomehlo wanginika amafomu. Ngamangala ukuthi amafomu sengiwanikwa umuntu wakwesinye isigceme ekubeni ikhansela liwumakhelwane," kusho yena.Ikhansela uNksz Mafiki Zondi ezihlangula, uthe ubengeke aye edepho ayosayinela ibhasi njengoba bekusho uNkk Ngema ngoba umasipala ubesewakhokhele amabhasi ahambayo. "Angimzomdi uNkk Ngema, umakhelwane wami. Uma eyi-MK nayo angiyizondi. Ngiyile ekuseni (ngoMgqibelo) ngayobachazela ukuthi uhlelo lokuya emhlangeni beluthini. Omama bezingane ngibachazelile ngoba bagcine behleli nezingane kwaze kwaba uMgqibelo. Angihlangene nohlelo lonke, yebo amafomu afikela kimi ekhaya. Nganikeza omunye unomehlo, wamnika. Kwase kumele baqhubeke batshelane ngokuzolandela. Bengingeke ngiye kubantu abese belwa besedepho ebusuku," kusho yena.
UMASIPALA weTheku unxusa abantu ukuthi bahlale besiqaphile isimo sezulu kulandela isixwayiso sabakwa-South African Weather Service ngoMsombuluko.Lo mkhandlu omkhulukazi KwaZulu-Natal uthi izangoma zezulu zikhiphe isixwayiso esiphuzi, esisesigabeni sesibili ngesimo sezulu esibi esithinta iTheku nezinye izingenxe zesifundazwe.Esitatimendeni umasipala uthe kulindeleke ukuduma kwezulu okuhamba nesichotho, umoya nemvula enamandla ngoMsombuluko.Kuthiwa lokhu kungaholela ekutheni kube nezikhukhula ezindaweni eziyimijondolo, emigwaqweni, ezindaweni eziphansi namabhuloho kugcwale amanzi.Kube sekunxuswa abantu ukuthi bahlale beqaphile bangazitholi sebelimala.Kamuva izulu selishiya kukhalwa eThekwini, kusukela ngezikhukhula ezagadla ziphindelela kwabhubha inqwaba yabantu ngo-2022.Abanye balabo bantu abakaze batholakale kuze kube manje.
SIYANGENA isikhumbuzo senkosi yamaNazaretha yesithathu esakhothama, inkosi Amos Kula Shembe Inyangayezulu, eBuhleni ngoSepthemba 24.Njengoba kuhlala kwenzeka minyaka yonke, kuzokhunjulwa imisebenzi yeNyangayezulu ngenkonzo yayo ekhethekile ebakhona njalo uma kuyilesi sikhathi sonyaka.KUZOBA nomgidi wezintombi emva kwenkonzo yesikhumbuzo seNyangayezulu ezoba sebandleni lamaNazaretha eBuhleni Isithombe: SIGCINIWEOkhulumela umholi wamaNazaretha, inkosi Mduduzi Shembe, uMnuz Thokozani Mncwabe, uthe amaNazaretha asuke ezilile ngaphambi kokungena kwenkonzo yeNyangayezulu."Uma kuzoba yinkonzo yesikhumbuzo yeNyangayezulu, akudliwa into eshisayo noma ngabe lolu suku alukho ngeSabatha. Kuzoba nenkonzo ezoqala ngoSepthemba 25 khona eBuhleni iqhubeke nangakusasa ngomhlaka 25. Umhlaka 24 yilona suku inkosi Inyangayezulu eyayidunguzela kakhulu ngalo yakhothama ngomhlaka 25 Septhemba. Uma kunenkonzo yesikhumbuzo yayo kusuke kuwumunyu wodwa amaNazaretha asuke ekhihla nesililo ekhumbula imisebenzi yenkosi. Abanye basuke bebonga abakwenzelwa yinkosi nezibusiso abazinikwa iyona,” kusho uMncwabe.Le nkonzo izokwenzeka kanye nomgidi wezintombi oba njalo ngoSepthemba kumaNazaretha nozoqhubeka emva kwenkonzo yesikhumbuzo.Kulungiselelwa le nkonzo nje uNyazilwezulu lusanda kubuya eNtabazwe (eHarrismith) okuyindawo okuqhamuka kuyona uMqaliwendlela, inkosi u-Isaiah Mloyiswa Mdliwamafa Shembe ongumsunguli webandla lamaNazaretha.UMncwabe uthe bakujabulele ukuvakashela le ndawo bengamaNazaretha nathe inomlando omude ngobuNazaretha."Inkosi uNyazilwezulu seluzihambele izindawo eziningi ezingamagugu ebandla lamaNazaretha. Indawo esisele ukuthi lungene eKuphakameni okusenzima ukungena kule ndawo ngenxa yombango owabakhona. Nalo uNyazilwezulu lunesifiso sokuthi lungene eKuphakameni. Indawo yasekuPhakameni inomlando ojulile njengoba igetsemane (ithuna) likaMqaliwendlela neleLanga likule ndawo. Ngisho Inyangayezulu ngaphambi kokuthi ikhothame yake yasho ukuthi asithandaze sibheke eKuphakameni ngesikhathi sivakashele kwabhekabezayo (emathuneni amaNazaretha). Yasho ukuthi inesifiso ukuthi wonke umuntu anyathele khona ngaphakathi njengoba le ndawo ilele abasunguli bebandla kube nemicimbi eyenziwa khona. Ngisho nobaba uNyazi angayithenga uma kungavela lelo thuba ngenxa yokubaluleka kwayo le ndawo,” kuqhuba uMncwabe.
NOMA ungaba umuntu wesifazane ozithandayo izindawo zobumnandi kodwa yiba nemali yakho yokuzijabulisa, ungathembeli kubantu besilisa ukuthi bakuthengele izidlo.Lesi yisexwayiso esivezwa wongoti kwezokwelukelwa ngokomqondo kanjalo nabezinhlaka zamadoda nalezo ezilwela amalungelo abesifazane.Bakhulume kanje kulandela ukwanda kwezigameko zokubulawa kwabesifazane ngabesilisa abasuke bechitha nabo isikhathi ezindaweni zobumnandi.Esigamekweni sakamuva esenzeke ngesihluku, abesilisa ababili, uMnuz Lungani Mthethwa (38) noMnuz Sandile Chili (44), okumanje bagqigqa enkantolo, basolwa ngokudubula babulale uNksz Anele Mbokazi (29) nomngani wakhe uNksz Zizipho Gabisa (30).Izidumbu zabafi baseVerulam, eThekwini, zatholwa wumphakathi komunye wemigwaqo eKenville, eThekwini.ABANGANI, uNksz Anele Mbokazi (29) noNksz Zizipho Gabisa (30) abatholwa befile, benamanxeba okudutshulwa ebusweni eKenvilleAbafi, omunye owayengumhlengikazi esibhedlela Inkosi Albert Luthuli, omunye engusokhemisi esibhedlela esizimele eMhlanga, babehambe nabasolwa kukuhle.Sebebulewe kwavela izinsolo ezahlukene, kuzona kwakukhona nezokuthi abasolwa badinwa ukuthi abafi babengasayizwa eyokuya ocansini nabo yize base bechithe inqwaba yemali bebathengela izidlo.Kwabaningi lokhu kwadweba isithombe sokuthi ngisho umuntu wesifazane angaba nemali eyenele ukuthi azijabulise kodwa uhlale ukhona umuzwa wokufuna ukutotoswa ngemali umuntu wesilisa.Manje ongoti bayawukhuza lo moya, njengoba izikhathi sezishintshile. Abantu besilisa sebekuthatha njengento ewubala ukubulala abesifazane.Ungoti wezokwelulekwa ngokomqondo, uDkt Manqoba Myeni uthe kudala kwakungewona umsebenzi onzima ukuxwayisa abesifazane ukuthi bamxwaye umuntu wesilisa abangamazi."Kodwa manje izikhathi zishintshile, sekwaba khona ngisho nezimoto ezikhokhelwa ngebanga ezilihambile, umuntu ayibiza ukuthi imthathe imyise endaweni ethile, abe nesibindi sokwethemba ukuthi owesilisa ongumshayeli uzokwenza lokho owesifazane akulindele. Kuba lula nokwethemba ukuthi lona wesilisa uyiyo ngempela lento athi uyiyona,” kusho uMyeni."Ngokomthetho, akufanele engabe bathemba abantu abangabazi ngale ndlela njengoba kuhlale kukhulunywa ngezigameko ezinyantisa igazi zokuhlaselwa kwabo nsuku zonke,” kusho uMyeni.Uthe into engalekelela ukuthi kuncishiswe isihlava wukuthi abesifazane abathanda ubumnandi bazihlinzeke ngemali yabo abazoyisebenzisa ebumnandini."Ababe nemali yabo abazoyidla, ababe nemoto yabo abazohamba ngayo, bahambe babe yiqoqo. Ngesikhathi uvumela owesilisa ukuthi akuthengele izidlo, yilapho osuke usuzibeka khona engcupheni yokungena kunoxhaka wamadoda ayingozi, asebenzisa imali ukudoba abesifazane ukuze kuyiwe ocansini,” kusho uMyeni.Ufanise indaba yabesilisa abanunusela abesifazane ngemali ukuze baye nabo ocansini njengento engafanele kodwa egcwele emiqondweni yabesilisa abaningi."Ezindaweni zobumnandi lugcwele lolu hlobo lwabesilisa,” kusho uMyeni.Ubuye wathi enye into eyophephisa abesifazane ukuthi bamsabe umuntu abangamazi, babuswe umcabango wokuthi umuntu ongamazi uyingozi futhi angabenzakalisa.UNksz Nombuso Sibisi wenhlangano yabesifazane, iWomen of uMthwalume, uthe inkinga enkulu izwe elibhekene nayo, abantu besilisa abazibona benamandla ngaphezu kwabesifazane, okwenza bazizwe bedeleleka uma owesifazane engavumelani nento asuke eyisho.Uthe babuye badinwe nawukuthi abesifazane bayawaqhakambisa amalungelo abo, bese abesilisa bezama ukukhombisa ubudoda babo ngendlela engafanele."Amadoda awawukhiphe emqondweni lo mcabango wokuthi sekufanele ahambe naye noma alale naye uma kade emthengele utshwala. Uma wenzela umuntu wesifazane into, musa ukulindela ukuthi akukhokhele ngocansi. Uma ungowesilisa onalowo mqondo, kuhle uvele uye ngqo kulabo abaludayisayo,” kusho uNksz Sibisi, othe kuyadingeka abeluleka abantu ngokomqondo ukuthi bangenelele ukuqeda le ndlela yokucabanga emadodeni.Uthe okulukhuni wukuthi akulula ukubona ngeso umuntu wesilisa onezinhloso ezimbi."Into elula wukuthi umuntu wesifazane azihlinzeke, angabheki ukwenzelwa owesilisa, ukuze ezizophephisa,” kusho uNksz Sibisi.Uthe bona bafisa ukuthi sibuye isigwebo sentambo kwabesilisa abenzakalisa abesifazane ngalolu hlobo.UMbhishobhi Bhekimpi Mchunu onguSihlalo wenhlangano iSukuma Sakhe Ndoda, uthe yize bekukhuthaza ukuboshwa kwabasolwa ezigamekweni zalolu hlobo kodwa akakholwa ukuthi kukodwa kungenza umehluko."Sihlale siphakamisa ukuthi izinhlangano ezifana neyethu, zinikwe ithuba lokuthi zihlale nabo phansi uma sebegwetshiwe, sibanike ithuba, bachaze olwabo uhlangothi lwesigameko, ukuze ukwazi ukulwisana nomnyombo walobu bulwane abasuke bebenzile kwabesifazane,” kusho uMchunu.Uthe okubanqinda amandla yimithetho ebekiwe, eyenza kube nzima ukuthi babe nalezi zingxoxo nabasuke belahlwe yila macala.Uphinde wakhala ngokuthi kufanele kusungulwe izinhlelo zokubhekana ngqo nolaka olugcwele kwabesilisa. Uthe umuntu wesilisa uvele enganywe wulaka ngento encane, umqondo ubuye esembulele owesifazane.

Ngayikhokha le mali izikhawu ezintathu, ngayibuyisa nenzalo isingu-R800 000 ngayifaka kwi-akhawunti yeGundo, angikaze ngiboleke imali ngqo kwiVBS.”Uthe akukho akufihlayo, wathi noma esezichaza kuRamaphosa, uzobe esakhuluma udaba olufanayo.Ukuchithile ukuthi uzoba nomthelela ekutheni ashushiswe yi-NPA nakuba ingaphansi kwakhe."Angikwazi ukutshela i-NPA ukuthi ishushise noma ingashushisi. Akukho okuzokwenzeka okuthinta ukucindezelwa kokushushiswa labo abathinteka ekuweni kwe-VBS.”Uthe ibhizinisi alivula lawa ngesikhathi kuhlasele ubhubhane iCovid-19 emhlabeni jikelele nakuleli.Uveze ukuthi ngaphambi kokuwa kwe-VBS, umasipala ayewuhola wase uvele usuhoxile ekutshaleni imali kuleli bhange.Ubalule ukuthi bathatha lesi sinqumo ngaphambi kokufika komyalelo kaMgcinimafa wokuthi bonke omasipala kumele bayeke ukutshala imali yabo ebhange i-VBS.
USAYINWE ngaphansi kwemibandela umthethosivivinyo olawula ukusebenza kwezikole iBela Bill ukuthi ube ngumthetho. UMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, usayine lo mthetho esidlangaleni yize kunamaqembu amane abephikisana nokusayinwa kwawo.Lama qembu okuyi-DA, iPatriotic Alliance (PA), i-Al Jama-ah neFreedom Front Plus abengekho emcimbini wokusayinwa kwalo mthetho, kuhlanganisa noNgqongqoshe woMnyango weMfundo eyisiSekelo, uNkk Siviwe Gwarube, obusezindlini zoMbuso ePitoli. La maqembu aphikisana nezingxenye ezithile zalo mthetho osekuphele iminyaka eyevile eshumini udingidwa. URamaphosa uthe kunamaqembu akholwa wukuthi kumele kube nezingxenye ezithile ezishintshayo kulo mthetho."Kuze kwaba imizuzu yokugcina lama qembu ethi angingasayini kuze kulungiswe lokhu akhala ngakho. Ngathi cha, ngizowusayina umthetho bese nginikeza abakhalayo izinyanga ezintathu zokuthi sibonisane ngabakhala ngakho. Uma kukhona okubambekayo, ngemuva kwezinyanga ezintathu kuzolandelwa indlela efanele. Uma kungekho, okukulo mthetho kuzoqhubeka kulandelwe kunjengoba kunjalo," kusho uRamaphosaOkuqukethwe yilo mthetho ukuthi uGrade R uzoba yimpoqo, amanye amandla okubalwa ulimi lokufunda ezikoleni kanjalo nokugcwala kwesikole kubekwe enhlokweni yomnyango kuleso sifundazwe, awasezukuba sesigungwini sabazali sokuphathwa kwesikole, iSchool Governing Body (SGB).Abazali bazobekwa amacala uma kungukuthi banqabela izingane zabo ukuthi ziye esikoleni. Uhlelo lokufundela ekhaya seluzolawulwa uMnyango wezeMfundo kuphinde kube nezinhlelo zokuluhlola ukuthi lwenzeka ngendlela yini.URamaphosa uthe: "Ziningi izinselelo ezibhekana nabafundi ezizoxazululwa yilo mthetho. Kunabafundi abebenqatshelwa ezikoleni ezithile ngenxa yolimi abalukhulumayo. Abanye bangakwazi ukubhala izivivinyo ngoba bengakhokhanga imali yokufunda. Izinto ezinjengalezo kumele ngabe kade sazilungisa ukuze sinikeze izingane zethu imfundo elinganayo kodwa kungcono ukuba ngemuva kwesikhathi kunokungenzi."IPhini likaNgqongqoshe weMfundo eyisiSekelo, uDkt Regina Mhaule, uthe lo mthethosivivinyo ufike ePhalamende ngo-2022 ngenhloso yoluthi kulungiswe izinkinga zokufunda.Unobhala we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula ephawula ngokunikezwa kwamaqembu akhalayo ithuba, uthe akukhona ukuthi i-ANC ivikela uhulumeni wokubambisana iGovernment of National Unity (GNU) kodwa wukwenza izinto ngendlela ehloniphekile yokubambisana. "IGNU ayisho umshado, uma ukubambisana namaqembu akhona kuphela, akusho ukuthi uhulumeni ngeke ube khona. Zikhona ezinye izihlelo ezingalandelwa”.

NJENGOBA zonke izindlela ematshitshini akuleli zibheke kwindumezulu yomkhosi waminyaka yonke, uMkhosi woMhlanga oqeda iminyaka ewu-40 wavuselelwa esigodlweni saseNyokeni, KwaNongoma, iyaqaqamba inhliziyo yomfundi (17) wasesikoleni sabanokukhubazeka eThekwini. Lo mfundi esingeke silidalule igama lakhe ngenxa yokuvikela isithunzi sakhe, useneminyaka ehamba lo mkhosi kodwa kulo nyaka ngeke aye kulandela ukudlwengulwa esigamekweni okusolwa kuso uthisha wakhe. Lo thisha kuthiwa uqale ukudlwengula lo mfundi kulo nyaka izikhawu eziningi ngaphambi kokuthi unina athole ngalo mkhuba kathisha. Unina wale ntombazane ehlala eningizimu neTheku, uthe indodakazi iphatheke kabi kakhulu ngokungakwazi ukuhlanganyela nezinye izintombi ekubeni kade yalilungiselela lolu suku njengoba beyize yathenga nemvunulo. Umzali (40) uthe waqala ukushaya amakhala ukuthi kukhona okungahambi kahle enganeni yakhe ngesikhathi ebona othisha bemncisha amehlo ngesikhathi ezolanda umntwana wakhe kulesi sikole okufundelwa khona imisebenzi yezandla.Uthe ngaphambi kokuba abuyele ekhaya nomntwana kwaqala kwaba nomhlangano omude phakathi kweziphathimandla zesikole nendodakazi yakhe."Wathi sewuphelile umhlangano wothisha nengane yami, ngambuza umntwana ukuthi bekukhulunywa ngani, wathi bebemkhumbuza nge-homework."Uthe yena waze wathola ukuthi ingane yakhe idlwengulwe wuthisha ngoba uthisha esethumelele indodakazi yakhe umyalezo nge-voicenote, eyinxusa ukuba ingavumi ukuthi ubezitika ngayo ngocansi.Umzali uthe uthisha wabuye wamfonela umntwana emnxenxa ukuba aze angalokothi avume ukuthi bake baya ocansini ngoba uzolahlekelwa yitoho bese nomfundi exoshwa esikoleni njengoba kungavumelekile ukuya ocansini nentombazane eneminyaka engaphansi kuka-18. Isolezwe Ngempelasonto liwuzwile umyalezo nezinkulumo zikathisha, esabisa ngokuthi uzozibulala uma lo mfundi evuma esikoleni ukuthi walala naye.Umzali uthe wathatha indodakazi yakhe wayiyisa esibhedlela ePrince Mshiyeni Memorial, eMlaza lapho kwatholakala khona ukuthi indodakazi ilaliwe. Uthe wabe esevulela uthisha icala lokudlwengula khona esibhedlela ngo-Agasti 12.Umzali uthe ufuna uthisha abolele ejele ngalesi senzo sakhe ngoba indodakazi yakhe beyihamba uMhlanga futhi ibisithenge nemvunulo njengoba amabombo ezintombi zonke ebheke eNyokeni, KwaNongoma ngale mpelasonto. Uthe okumphethe kabi ukuthi indodakazi yakhe beyizimisele ngokuya eMhlangeni ngoba beyibukhonzile ubuntombi bayo. Isolezwe Ngempelasonto lithole ukuthi uthisha osolwa ngokunukubeza lo mfundi ukhalelwe ngamasongo kaSigonyela futhi kulindeleke ukuba ayobingelela iNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMlaza, esigcemeni sakwaGG ngoMsombuluko.Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kokhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal nokhulumela amaphoyisa kulesi sifundazwe ayiphumelelanga kusukela ngoLwesine kwaze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela.
ISAKHAMUZI saseNigeria siboshelwe ukutholakala nezidakamizwa ebizithusheke kuma-headphones esikhumulweni sezindiza i-OR Tambo, eGoli.Le ndoda okuthiwa idayisa izimpahla emgwaqweni iboshwe ngoLwesihlanu ebusuku ngesikhathi yehla endizeni ebikade isuka eSao Paulo, eBrazil izothatha enye ilibangise eNigeria.Lo mlisa waseNigeria kuthiwa wehle endizeni wahlangana nomsebenzi ohlanza le ndawo wanikeza yena lama-headphones asetshenziswa endizeni.Amaphoyisa asole ukuthi kukhona okushaya amanzi phakathi kwalaba bobabili asondela, aqaqa lama-headphones athola icocaine igxishwe phakathi.Kuthiwa lo msebenzi ukwazile ukuphunyuka kulesi sidididi wadla phansi njengoba ethungathwa amaphoyisa.Amaphoyisa athi umsolwa ungomunye wabantu abayisishiyagalolunye ababoshwe kulezi nyanga ezimbili betholwa nezidakamizwa ezingabiza ngaphezu kukaR13 million. Leli nani lifaka phakathi neCocaine engabiza uR12 million eshaqwe e-OR Tambo International Airport.UKhomishana wamaPhoyisa uGeneral Fannie Masemola uthe iNingizimu Afrika akuyona inkundla yokugcwaneka izigebengu.Ushayele ihlombe amaphoyisa abophe umsolwa wagcizelela ngokuthi izaphulamthetho zizobhekana kanzima nengalo yomthetho.
AJIKISIWE amabhasi awosigedlemba abecuthele ukuthutha izimbali zezwe eziya eMkhosini woMhlanga wakulo nyaka oyingqophamlando njengoba kuphela iminyaka engu-40 lomkhosi wavuselelwa kabusha.Abanikazi bamabhasi okutholakale ukuthi awekho esimweni batshelwe ukuba balethe amanye amabhasi alungele ukuthutha amatshitshi alibangise esigodlweni eNyokeni, KwaNongoma.Angu-31 amabhasi okutholakale ukuthi awakulungele ukuba semgwaqeni.Lokhu kudalulwe uMphathiswa wezokuThutha, uMnuz Siboniso Duma, obekade eyohlola amabhasi azothutha izintombi.UDuma uthe emabhasini angu-177 ahloliwe, angu-146 okutholakale ukuthi akulungele ukuba semgwaqeni."Lokhu kusho ukuthi sikwazile ukusindisa imiphefumulo engenacala njengoba sikhiphe lamabhasi angu-31 emgwaqeni. Kusobala ukuthi lamabhasi angamathuna ezihlalele. Abanikazi bala mabhasi sebetsheliwe ukuthi abalethe amanye amabhasi akulungele ukuba semgwaqeni.”UDuma uthe baphinde bahlola namatekisi, wathi onke amatekisi ahloliwe atholakale ekulungele ukuba semgwaqeni."Siyabonga kubanikazi bamatekisi ngokulandela imithetho yomgwaqo.”UDuma uthe babeke phambili ukuphepha kwezimbali zesizwe ikakhulukazi njengoba umkhosi wakulo nyaka uyingqophamlando. "Njengoba nonke nizokhumbula ukuthi siqale inyanga yamagugu ngokubamba umhlangano obalulekile neSilo uMisuzulu kaZwelithini. Emhlanganweni, iSilo sigcizelela kakhulu eyokuphepha kwezintombi. "Kule minyaka engu-40 eyedlule uMkhosi woMhlanga ukhulile kakhulu njengoba usuhanjelwa ngisho nangabantu abaqhamuka emazweni angaphandle. Likhulu isasasa elikhona ngomkhosi wakulo nyaka njengoba izindawo zokulala sezigcwele esifundeni iZululand.”UDuma uthe amaphoyisa omgwaqo azokube ephume ngezinkani kule mpelasonto."Amaphoyisa azobonakala emisa izimoto namabhasi, ehlola ukuthi akulungele yini ukuba semgwaqweni.”UDuma uthe banezingxoxo nabanikazi bamaloli, wathi bafisa ukuthi amaloli ayigweme imigwaqo emikhulu ezosetshenziswa abantu ababheke eNyokeni.Phakathi kwemigwaqo ayibalulile osuka uR66 phakathi koLundi noNongoma, R66 phakathi kweGingindlovu noLundi, R66 phakathi koPhongolo noNongoma, uR618 phakathi koNongoma noHlabisa kanye noR618 phakathi koNongoma neVryheid.Izimbali zezwe ziqale ukutheleka eNyokeni izolo, umkhosi uzophela ngeSonto.Kulindelwe izintombi ezingaphezu kuka-40 000 emkhosini wakulo nyaka.UMkhosi woMhlanga wavuselelwa kabusha iNdlovukazi uShiyiwe Mantfombi Dlamini Zulu ngo-1984, ngesikhathi kubusa iSilo uGoodwill Zwelithini kaBhekuzulu.
SEBEZOSIBHALISA beqeda ukuteta isibonelelo sezingane ababeletha esibhedlela iPrince Mshiyeni, esiseMlaza.UNksz Sandy Godlwana ophethe ezokuxhumana nezokukhangisa eSassa KwaZulu-Natal uthathwe noNksz Ntombifuthi Sikhakhane obhekelele ukusebenza kweSassa eThekwini Isithombe:SithunyelweIzolo iSouth African Social Security Agency (Sassa) ivule amahhovisi azosiza ukubhalisa isibonelelo sezingane. Ukuvulwa kwehhovisi kusho ukuthi umzali uzoteta, enzele ingane isitifiketi sokuzalwa bese eyibhalisela imali yesibonelelo sikahulumeni khona esibhedlela iPrince Mshiyeni.Uphethe ngokuthi bazoqinisekisa ukuthi lolu hlelo luba khona nakwezinye izifunda zaKwaZulu-Natal ukuze abazali baphume ezibhedlela sebenakho konke okudingwa yizingane.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi izinhlangano ezibhekelele amalungelo ezingane zikubeke kwacaca ukuthi isibonelelo sezingane siyasiza ukulwa nobuphofu emindenini.
