IMIDLINZO nokunukana ngokuthakatha emndenini, kutholakala amathambo 'kababa wekhaya’, ehlathini eliseduze komuzi wakhe okuthiwa besekuphele iminyaka ewu-15 kwabikwa ukuthi unyamalele.UMnuz Themba Njapha (87) waseNkanyisweni, eMbumbulu, kuthiwa umndeni bewusumcinge wahlanza ngedela kusuka ngoNovemba 2009, kanti ubesenzelwe ngisho imicimbi yesintu yokumkhuphula.Ngesonto eledlule, ligaye ngomunye umhlathi emndenini wakwaNjapha, umzingeli okuthiwa ubezicuphela izinyamazane ehlathini elisendaweni esawa ngezansi komuzi, ezithela phezu kwamathambo elaliswe ehlokozini, wahlaba umkhosi.UMnuz Dalisu Njapha ongowomndeni, uthe basondelile ukuzozibonela isimanga, bathola ukuthi izinsalela nebala ezikayise emva kokubona izimpahla ayenyamalale ezigqokile."Wayegqoke ibhulukwe lesisosha, isikibha esibomvu namabhuzu. Yize isikibha besingasabonakali kahle, kodwa ibhulukwe namabhuzu bekugqamile okwenze kwabalula kithina ukubona ukuthi amathambo akhe. Sizolinda imiphumela yolibofuzo njengoba kuthathwe igazi kwamanye amalungu omndeni, nakuba singangabazi ukuthi wuye,” usho kanjeUveze ukuthi atholwa nje, kuvele kukhona ukubhekana ngeziqu zamehlo phakathi kwemindeni yoyise njengoba yakhelene, kanti kunezinsolo eziqinile zokuthi abesendlini kayise omncane kukhona abakwaziyo ngokunyamalala kukayise, aveze ukuthi umgilwa unguyise omdala olamana namzalayo. Kuthiwa yomithathu imizi yoyise yakhelene kangangoba ihlukaniswe wuthango, kanti isimo sibe muncu kakhulu emva kokutholwa kwamathambo.Elandisa Isolezwe ngezinsolo abanazo, uthe ngosuku olwandulela okwalahleka ngalo umufi, emzini kayise omncane kwakunomcimbi owawungaqondakali, kufike izangoma. Kwathi ngakusasa umufi wanyamalala wangaphinde watholwa, wathungathwa kwaze kwayekwa.Ugcizelele ukuthi okuqinisa izinsolo ezithi wabulawela endaweni okutholakale kuyo amathambo - okukholakala ukuthi awakhe - iyenyukela kakhulu, njengoba eminyakeni ayesekuyo wangesenawo amandla okuhamba endaweni enjalo ngenxa yokukhula. Uveze ukuthi kunesipikili esingene ethanjeni, nocingo abasola ukuthi waboshwa ngalo, kanti izinsalela zitholwe zidindilizile, okukhombisa ukuthi wayengagqitshiwe.Uthe emva komhlangano womndeni awubize ngo-Ephreli kulo nyaka - ohlanganisa izindlu ezintathu zoyise - zaqina kakhulu izinsolo zokuthi wenzakaliswa."Kulowo mhlangano, kwavela ukuthi izangoma ezazikhona zazizoqinisa igceke ngoba kuthiwa kunomuntu omubi emndenini obathakathayo. Bathi bacupha kanti izangoma zaveza ukuthi owenza lokhu kukhona okuzomehlela, okuthe ngakusasa kwanyamalala ubaba,” kusho yena.Uthe okubadidayo ngisho sekutholwe amathambo, uyise omncane akazange alubhade ukuzobabaza nje ekubeni sekunguyena kuphela koyise osadla anhlamvana.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa aseMbumbulu, avule idokodo lophenyo ngokufa komuntu.
KUSOLWA ukuziphindiselela kwelokubulawa kwabakhongi, kudutshulwa kubulawa abayisikhombisa bomndeni womunye wabasolwa eChibini, eHlokozi, ngoLwesithathu.Lo mndeni kuthiwa uhlaselwe sekuhwalele, ngesikhathi ubuka ithelevishini. Kuthiwa kugasele abantu bavulela ngenhlamvu kwabebehleli egumbini lokuphumula.UNDUNANKULU wesifundazwe, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, eduduza umndeni wabayisikhombisa abadutshuliwe Isithombe: SIBONELO NGCOBOPhakathi kwabashonile kukhona umama wekhaya uBahlakaniphile Khambule (64), indodakazi yakhe uPhilile Khambule (39), umalokazana uNompilo Khambule (34), isihlobo uSkhumbuzo Khambule nabazukulu oLisa Khambule (9), Siphosethu Khambule (9) noZemvelo Khambule (5).USiphosethu noZemvelo bazalwa umufi uNompilo, endodaneni yakulo muzi okuvela ukuthi iboshiwe, kuthi uLisa azalwe nguPhilile.Ngokuthola kweSolezwe ngemithombo elwazi ukusuka nokuhlala udaba, indodana kaBahlakaniphile engumyeni kaNompilo, isoleka ecaleni lokudutshulwa kwezelamani zakwaDlamini ezabulawa ngaphandle kwasekhweni ngenyanga edlule. Zaziyokhongela umfowabo. Lezi zelamani, uThando noMzwandile Dlamini, zahlaselwa zisakhuleka ngaphandle kwesango lasekhweni.Kuvela ukuthi kuhlaselwa kubo nje ubesanda kuboshwa. Abasolwa ngokwenzakalisa umndeni wakhe kuthiwa bebelokhu befika emzini wakhe okhona endaweni ukuzombheka ukuthi uyadedelwa yini ngebheyili "ukuze bamsoconge”.Umsolwa oboshiwe, oyilungu lomndeni wakwaKhambule, kuthiwa uyamaniswe nokubulawa kwabakhongi ngophenyo lwamaphoyisa olwathola izinkulumo zakhe nabanye abasolwa ngokudubula abakhongi ababehamba ngamaPolo. Kuvele ukuthi labo basolwa bePolo bashonile emva kokudutshulwa esehlweni esingahlobene nalesi ePort Shepstone emasontweni edlule. Kuvela ukuthi ilungu lomndeni wakwaKhambule eliboshiwe lihlanganiswe nabasolwa ngezinkulumo zamaselula.Ilungu lomndeni, elingafunanga ukwanda kakhulu ngenkulumo uma libuzwa ngalezi zinsolo, uNksz Dudu Khambule, likuqinisekisile ukuthi ngempela umfowabo uboshiwe."Unamasonto amathathu eboshiwe," kusho uDudu ongachazanga ukuthi ivala abekwe lona lithini.Udalule ukuthi kuhlaselwa kubo nje bekunezinsongo zokusoconga umfowabo ebese zinesikhashana zikhona."Emzini wakhe bekulokhu kufika abantu abangaziwa behlome ngezibhamu bezomfuna ngesankahlu," kusho uDudu.Uveze ukuthi kwenzeka umshophi nje unina (uBahlakaniphile) ubembizile uNompilo nezingane ukuthi bazoquba ekhaya elikhulu, esaba ukuthi bazosocongelwa emzini wabo njengoba bebehla benyuka nezibhamu okuthiwa bebemfuna.Uthe kusajame ingqondo uma ecabanga ngokubehlele, ubuhlungu ababuzwayo, wathi okukhulu kunakho konke ukuthi basovalweni bona abasele (ebebengekho).UNdunankulu wesifundazwe, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, ubafanise nezilwane abasolwa ngesihluku abasikhombise emndenini wakwaKhambule."Sizwa ubuhlungu nathi njengoba sila. Uma sizwa iminyaka yezingane ezibulewe, siyazibuza ukuthi abantu abanesihluku esingaka bavelaphi. Labo bantu bafanelwe ukususwa emphakathini ngoba bayizilwane," kusho uNtuli.Uthe noma ngabe bekuyisiphi isizathu, besingekho isidingo sokuthi kubulawe abantu.Uthe uhulumeni ezingeni lesifundazwe, nasesifundeni iHarry Gwala ngaphansi kweMeya uMnuz Zamo Nxumalo, bazosondela ngokuhlanganyela emndenini ukuzolekelela ngakho konke abakudingayo okufaka phakathi izindleko zomngcwabo nosizo lokwelulekwa ngokwengqondo.Unxuse amaphoyisa ukuthi enze konke okusemandleni ukubamba abasolwa ngokushesha.IMeya kaMasipala waseHarry Gwala, uNxumalo, ithe bakhathazekile ngalesi sigameko nezinye ezenzeke kule ndawo kusuka ngenyanga edlule.UKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLt Gen Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, uveze ukuthi angu-25 amagobolondo ezinhlamvu atholwe endaweni yesigameko.Uthe okubacacelayo bengamaphoyisa ukuthi lokhu kubulala bekuhleliwe futhi abasocongi bebefuna ukwenza uthulamsindo njengoba abafi bedutshulwe emakhanda."Sesihlanganise ithimba ezingeni lesifundazwe elizosebenzisana namaphoyisa esifunda ukuphenya ngesigameko," kusho uMkhwanazi othe okushiwo wumndeni okwamanje basakuthatha njengamampunge njengoba uphenyo lwabo lusephansi.Umndeni wakwaKhambule kuthiwa uziphilisa ngebhizinisi lamatekisi.
AKAZIMISELE ukuphindisela kubantu athi bamenze isilo sengubo wagcina eboshwa uMnuz Paseka 'Pastor Mboro’ Motsoeneng.Usho kanje esithangamini nabezindaba eqeda kudedelwa ngebheyili kaR3 000 eNkantolo yeMantshi yasePalm Ridge, ngoLwesine.Unogada kaMboro, uMnuz Vincent Baloyi udedelwe ngesixwayiso, bobabili bayalelwa ukuthi babuyele enkantolo efanayo ngo-Okthoba 21.Babekelwe imibandela yokuthi bangaxhumani nofakazi noma ngabe iyiphi indlela futhi bangalubhadi esikoleni okwehla kusona isehlo."Angizimisele ukuphindisela noma ukulimaza abangihlasela. Ngifuna kube khona ukuthula nokubuyisana. Mina ngiwuMboro futhi ngingenza okuningi,” kusho uMboro.Uthe ufuna kuhlalwe phansi kuxoxwe bese abantu abamonile becela uxolo ngento abamenza yona.UMboro uthe uzobiza isithangami nabezindaba namuhla achaze kabanzi ngokumehlele egqunywe ejele okuyinto ezonyakazisa izwe."Noma ngabe yini oyenzayo ungabanjwa futhi ungenzi into ezokwenza ubanjwe. Indodana yami cishe yezwa kuthiwa uMboro ufele ejele. Ijele aliyona into yokudlala, akuna-clever laphayana,” kuchaza uMboro.Uthe ujabule ethola ibheyili khona ezokwazi ukuvikela umndeni wakhe, aqhubeke nomsebenzi kaNkulunkulu nowokwakha izwe aphe abantu uthando.Ngenyanga edlule uMboro, indodana yakhe uMnuz Revival Motsoeneng noBaloyi baboshwa bathweswa amacala angu-12 okukhona nawokusabisa, ukuthumba nokukhomba ngesibhamu.Lokhu kusukela esehlakalwenii lapho bangena ngodli esikoleni esiseKatlehong, eGauteng behlome ngocelemba nesibhamu 'esiyithoyizi’ basabisa othisha maqede bathatha izingane ezimbili ezingabazukulu bakaMboro.Wavuka inja ebomvu umphakathi wangqongqisa isonto lakhe eseboshiwe.
UGWETSHWE odilikajele ababili neminyaka emihlanu ngaphezulu ebhadla ejele owesilisa waseFolweni, owabulala intombazane ayephuza nayo.Izolo, iNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini, igwebe uSamkelo Victus Dube (33) owayengumshayeli wamatekisi asuka eFolweni eya eThekwini.Ecaleni lokuqala lokushaya ngenhloso yokulimaza, umngani kamufi, uNksz Thandi Princess Shange, ugwetshwe iminyaka emihlanu.Kwathi kwelokubulala uSbahle Faith Biyela (17) wagwetshwa udilakajele. Udilakajele wesibili uwuthole ngecala lokudlwengula umufi.Esigamekweni esenzeka ngo-Okthoba 5, 2020, kuthiwa uDube wayekade ehlezi nomufi endlini yakhe noNksz Shange.UMUFI uNksz Sbahle Faith Biyela owabulawa ISITHOMBE: SITHUNYELWEKuthiwa wabathengela utshwala ngemuva kwalokho kuthiwa wadlwengula wabulala umufi.Isidumbu sikamufi satholakala sinenqwaba yamanxeba okugwazwa, sasidindilize sibheke phezulu nesitho sangasese sihlezi obala.Wakhalelwa ngamasongo kaSigonyela ngo-Okthoba 13, ebhace kubo kukanina eChesterville.Wawaphika wonke amacala inkantolo ebimbeke wona uDube.Umshushisi, u-Advocate Khatija Essack, uveze ukuthi umufi wayenekusasa eliqhakazile njengoba wayebuye alingise emdlalweni wethelevishini, Isidingo. Wanxusa inkantolo ukuba imnikeze isigwebo sikadilakajele uDube.IJaji uBroos Beddersson likhale ngesihluku esasetshenziswa nguDube ngesikhathi edlwengula ephinda ebulala umufi."Isigwebo sikadilikajele yiyonanto ekufanele. Indlela owambulala ngayo lo wesifazane ibe nesihluku esikhulu. Lesi yisigwebo esikufanele kunazo zonke,'' kugcizelala ijaji.Liqhuba, lithe izigwebo zalolu hlobo zingaklama indima enkulu ekwehliseni izehlakalo zalolu hlobo zokudlwengula nokubulawa kwabesifazane elithe seziphenduke insakavukela.Ijaji lisukumise abazali bakamufi lase lidlulisa amazwi enduduzo kubona. "Sengathi ningathobeka amanxeba. Kuyabonakala ukuthi umufi ubenekusasa eliqhakazile,'' kusho ijaji.Ngemuva kokuba inkantolo seyiwise isigwebo, unina kaDube obesenkantolo igama lakhe eligcine lingatholakalanga, ubonakale ekhala.Usukumile waya kuDube wakhuluma naye wase eyamqabula. "Ngiyakuthanda yezwa mfana wami futhi ngiyohlezi ngikuthanda,'' usho kanje. Uphendulile uDube ngamazwi afanayo.Ngaphandle kwenkantolo, unina kaDube ucele ukukhuluma nabazali bakamufi kodwa benqaba."Yini azoyikhuluma nathi njengoba bengakaze bezoxolisa futhi abakaze beze nasemngcwabeni wengane yami,'' kuchaza unina kamufi, uNksz Zonke Mabhida.Ubonge inkantolo ngokugixabeza uDube ngesigwebo esinesisindo.
INHLANGANO eqoqa intela kuleli, iSouth African Revenue Service (Sars), ithi isiqoqe uR4.1 billion kubantu abafuna ukunyula imali yabo yempesheni.Esitatimendeni uKhomishana weSars, uMnuz Edward Kieswetter, uthe ingu-161 607 imiyalelo yokuqoqa intela abayitholile okukhona kuyo ewu-159 853 yalabo abafuna ukunyula imali yempesheni.Lokhu kusho ukuthi ngosuku iwu-17 964 imiyalelo yokuqoqa intela etholwa yiSars."Imiyalelo yokuqoqa intela ithunyelwa ngabaphathi bezikhwama ezihlukene okuyibona abashoyo ukuthi kufanele sithathe intela engakanani kumuntu ngamunye. Abantu abakweleta intela kufanele bakhumbule ukuthi iSars izoyiqoqa emalini abafuna ukuyinyula. Uma benze isivumelwano sokulandela uhlelo oluthile lokukhokha isikweleti imali ezothathwa izobe ilandela lolo hlelo,” kusho uKieswetter.Uthe uhlelo lokuqoqa intela luyashesha ngoba aluthathi amahora angaphezu kuka-24.Uveze ukuthi abantu bazokwazi ukuthola ulwazi ngentela okufanele bayikhokhe ngokuvakashela kwi-website yakwaSars naku-whatsapp wayo otholakala ku-0800 11 7277.Phakathi kwezizathu ezibekwa ngabantu abasuke befuna imali yempesheni kubalwa idivosi, ukufudukela kwesinye isikhwama noma ukudinga imali.Uthe iSars izokhipha eminye imininingwane ngokuhamba kwesikhathi njengoba isimo sishintsha njalo uma abantu benyula imali yabo.
BESIMUNCU isimo kuwo wonke umuntu obehambele emzini wakwaKhambule eChibini, eHlokozi, okudutshulwe kuwo kwabulawa abomndeni abayisikhombisa okukhona kuwo nezingane ezintathu. Abantu abaningi endaweni bebelokhu bethutheleke njalo kulo muzo ukuzobabaza umhlola owehlile.Baningi ebebevukwa umunyu uma kuphathwa eyokuthi ababulali badubule ngisho ingane eneminyaka emihlanu.Ngesikhathi umuntu esondela kuwona, ububona ukuthi umuzi ongaswele njengoba kubiywe kahle ngocingo, kwakhiwa nezindlu ezinhle ezinkulu norawondi.Uma ungena egumbini lokuphumula, okwenzeke kulo isigameko, ubuqaphela ukuthi lona umndeni obunawo amandla okukwenza ikhaya lawo libukele kahle.Nokho kuqaphelekile ukuthi kunamathuna ayisikhombisa aklele ngezansi kwezindlu. Isolezwe lithole ukuthi kuwona (amathuna) kukhona indodana yakhona uMnuz Phumlani Khambule okuthiwa yadutshulwa yabulawa nyakenye. Libuye (Isolezwe) lathola ukuthi kukhona nelikababa wekhaya okuthiwa wadutshulwa eminyakeni eyedlule.
INHLANZI ishelwe amanzi kobefunelwa icala lokubulala umuntu eMzingazi, eRichards Bay, eboshwa yiphoyisa elimnike u-lift esebaleka eyobhaca.Indoda eneminyaka engu-19 kulindeleke ukuthi ivele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseRichards Bay ngoLwesihlanu.Isolwa ngokugwaza ibulale uMnuz Khanya Mthembu ngeSonto. Ikhalelwe amasongo kaSigonyela ngoLwesithathu ebusuku.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda elandisa uthe, ngoLwesithathu ebusuku amaphoyisa asophikweni iRichards Bay Crime Prevention alunywe indlebe ngendoda ebikade isemgwaqeni ifuna u-lift."Ubekade efuna u-lift eseMadlankala, eSikhaleni, efuna ukubaleka ayobhaca KwaNongoma. Kube sekuthunyelwa iphoyisa nemoto engabhaliwe lapho obekunomsolwa khona lafika lamnikeza u-lift,” kuchaza uNetshiunda.Kuthiwa iphoyisa liyishaye yazula imoto laqonda egaraji lokwetha uphethroli, lapho elibe selixhumana namanye amaphoyisa lihlaba umkhosi, afika wase eyaboshwa umsolwa.UNetshiunda uthe imininingwane esemaphoyiseni iveza ukuthi umsolwa nomgilwa babe nengxabano ethaveni.Kubikwa ukuthi ngesikhathi umgilwa esegoduka, ulandelwe umsolwa, ofike wamgwaza washona eduze kwenkundla yezemidlalo.
IFISA kungapheli ngoMkhosi woMhlanga itshitshi elina-73 elisaqhubeka nokuya kulo mkhosi ohlanganisa iminyaka ewu-40 wavuselelwa kabusha.UNksz Ngipheni Ngcobo, waseMgungundlovu, uthe ufuna ukuthi uMkhosi woMhlanga uqhubeke nokudlondlobala akubone kule minyaka ewu-39 eyedlule.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma neSolezwe ngaphambi komkhosi wakulo nyaka ozoba sesigodlweni eNyokeni, ngempelasonto."Sengathi ungaqhubeka, ungapheli umhlanga, uze uficwe nayizizukulwane ezizayo. Izizukulwane ezizayo ziyojabula uma ziyifica le nto enhle kanjena.”UMkhosi woMhlanga wavuselelwa kabusha iNdlovukazi uMantfombi Shiyiwe Dlamini-Zulu ngo-1984.UNksz Ngcobo uthe uMkhosi woMhlanga usudlondlobele kakhulu uma uqhathaniswa nezikhathi owavuselelwa ngazo kabusha. "Kwakungelula ngesikhathi uqala. Thina saqala ukuwuhamba kusewusizi. Lo buhle osebukhona esigodlweni babungakabi bikho. Ngisho namatende esesihlelelwa wona, ayengekho. Amatende esasilala kuwo amanye wawubona nje ukuthi alethwe abantu bendawo. Abantu babengebangaka. Manje usuyaduka emhlangeni uma ungaliqaphelanga itende enihlaliswe kulona.”UNksz Ngcobo uthe eminyakeni eyedlule kwakuphuma imoto eyodwa ngakubo eyayihambisa izintombi emhlangeni, wathi manje sekuphuma inqwaba yamabhasi.Nokho ukhalile ngokuthi mumva sithanda ukuncipha isibalo samabhasi akhishwa yizinhlaka zikahulumeni.UNksz Ngcobo uthe ukukhula komkhosi nokushintsha kwezikhathi kudale izinkinga eziningi."Kwakunenhlonipho kuqala, izingane zazingakachwayizi kanje. Inkinga ukuthi izingane zikuthanda konke, zithanda ukuba izintombi zibuye zithande nobudala. Ngibuye ngisole onomehlo ngalokhu. Kuqala zazingenzeki le zinto esezenzeka manje."Manje sekuke kugobe umhlanga ezinganeni. Nginesiqubulo esithi 'umhlanga awugobi, kugoba intombi'. Noma ngabe kunomoya ongakanani umhlanga awugobi. Phela umhlanga into engcwele okufanele uyiphathe uze uyofika nayo esigodlweni. Laba bamanje bayaqhubeka bawuhambise umhlanga noma usugobile."UNksz Ngcobo uthe uzobe ekhona nasemkhosini wakulo nyaka.Ngesikhathi ekhuluma neSolezwe izolo ubematasa namalungiselelo.ISilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini sakhipha umyalelo wokuthi uNksz Ngcobo akangabe esahamba ngamabhasi athutha izimbali zesizwe ngenxa yeminyaka yakhe.Imbube yayalela uMnyango wezobuCiko namaSiko ukuba uhlelele uNksz Ngcobo imoto ezomlanda uma kunomkhosi.Ngonyaka odlule UNksz Ngcobo wahamba ngalolu hlelo.Izolo uthe abomnyango bebengakaqinisekisi ukuthi uzolandwa yini nakulo nyaka, wathi uzogibela amabhasi uma abomnyango begcine bengamlandanga.
UNDUNANKULU waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, uthi balinde umnyama obungenafu labo abathi uzophuma maduze esikhundleni sakhe.UNtuli uthe uzoyiqeda iminyaka emihlanu abekelwe yona ekulesi sikhundla angene kuso ngoJuni nonyaka.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma embizweni yokulwa nobugebengu ebiseMgungundlovu, ngoLwesibili.I-MK ihlezi isongela uNtuli ngokuthi uzophuma maduze esikhundleni, futhi ihlezi imbiza ngondunankulu wesikhashana.I-MK iyona eyathola izihlalo eziningi esiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal, uNtuli wangena kanzima esikhundleni sakhe njengoba ahlula ilungu leMK, iNkosi Phathisizwe Chiliza, ngamavoti angu-41 kwangu-39.UNtuli uthe uyazizwa izinkulumo ze-MK, wathi ike yafika nasehhovisi lakhe ihola umbhikisho wabantu ababekhalaza ngokuphucwa ama-transformer, wathi nangalo leli langa yafike yakhuluma ulimi olufanayo."Into eyangimangaza uma sengifika ekhaya, ngixoxelwa unkosikazi, wangibuza ukuthi kanti ngingundunankulu wesikhashana. Wangitshela ukuthi uzwe kukhona abebekhuluma, bethi beze kundunankulu wesikhashana. "Lolu limi ngiyalwazi. Lapha esiShayamthetho lukhulunywa ilaba abangafuni ukwamukela lohulumeni ophethe. Abafuni ukwamukela ukuthi ithina esiphethe nokuthi sizohlala iminyaka emihlanu sihola, sisebenzela abantu baKwaZulu-Natal.”Uhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal wakhiwe amaqembu abeyinkukhu nempaka ngaphambi kokhetho, i-IFP, ANC, DA ne-NFP.UNtuli uthe basebenzisana kahle kuhulumeni wokubambisana, wathi uhulumeni owakhiwe ila maqembu awuyi ndawo."Labo abanethemba lokuthi lohulumeni uzobhidlika, abakhohlwe. Thina siyayazi into esangena kuyona. Asingenanga kuhulumeni wokubambisana ngoba nakhu sijahe izikhundla. Indlela abantu abavota ngayo iyona eyenza ukuthi kube nohulumeni wokubambisana. Ukuze ukwazi ukuphatha uhulumeni wesifundazwe kufanele ube nezihlalo ezingaphezu kuka-50%. Akekho lapha esiShayamthetho onezihlalo ezingaphezu kuka-50%."Indlela abantu abavota ngayo yasinika ithuba lokuthi sixoxe, sibuzane ukuthi wena uyafuna yini ukuba kuhulumeni wokubambisana. Ongasondelanga, wawungeke umphoqe ngoba wayenesizathu sokungasondeli.”UNtuli unxuse abantu ukuba baqaphele ukungadukiswa ilabo abakhetha ukungabi ingxenye yohulumeni wokubambisana."Akekho okufanele ayogovuza abantu ngaphandle, athi akube neziteleka zonke izinsuku. Kufanele sihlangane, sibatshele labo abafuna ukusigovuza ukuthi kade sadlula okhethweni. Manje sekuyisikhathi sokusebenzela abantu.”
I-DA isisabise ngokuthi ngeke iqhubeke nokuba yingxenye kahulumeni wokubambisana kwamaqembu ahlukene, uma i-ANC iwisa umnotho noma ibukela phansi uMthethosisekelo.Leli qembu lithe lingamane liphume kulokhu kubambisana ngoba ngaphandle kwalo uhulumeni awunakho ukwesekwa okwanele.Lokhu kushiwo ngumholi walo uMnuz John Steenhuisen ekhuluma ne-Cape Town Press Club, eKapa.Usho lokhu nje kunokuzamazama kulo hulumeni wokubambisana njengoba leli qembu linxenxe uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ukuthi angawusayini uMthethosivivinywa wezikole okunemvunge ngawo iBela Bill.Leli qembu lifuna kulungiswe ezinye izinto elingeneme ngazo kulo Mthethosivivinywa."Ukungavumelani ngezinto ezithinta nemigomo akusho ukuthi sekukhona ukusabisa ngokuthi aluzobakhona uzinzo kuhulumeni wokubambisana. Kodwa lokhu akusho ukuthi siyohlala unomphela noma kuthiwa kukhona izinto esingeneme ngazo, Okubalulekile kwi-DA ukukhulisa umnotho, sakhe namathuba emisebenzi. Uma lo hulumeni ehluleka ukwenza lokhu, asikho isidingo sokuthi siqhubeke nokuba yingxenye yawo,” kuxwayisa uSteenhuisen. Uthe uma i-ANC ifuna ukuwisa umnotho nokungahloniphi uMthethosisekelo leli qembu liyophuma kuhulumeni."Uma i-ANC ibukela phansi izinhlaka ezizimele okubalwa ibhange loMbuso, noma iqeda izinto ngezinto ezithile, ngeke siqhubeke nokuba kuhulumeni.”Uthe ngaphambi kokuphuma kuyoxoxwa, uma kungavunyelwana bese bephuma."Siyazi ngeke sithole esikufunayo ngaso sonke isikhathi kodwa kanjalo ne-ANC ngeke ihlale ithola ekufunayo. Abantu bakuleli babaluleke kakhulu kunemizwa yosopolitiki,” kugcizelela uSteenhuisen.Odabeni oluthinta iBela Bill, uthe uma egcina ngokusayina, bazobheka ezinye izindlela abazozenza."Siyayichitha eyeBela Bill, ngoba ibeka engcupheni izinto ezithinta ulimi lwebele ezikoleni. Ngihlanganile noRamaphosa ngamnxenxa ukuthi angasayini. Kuhulumeni wokubambisana kumele abaholi bazibheke izikhalo zabanye,” kusho uSteenhuisen.Kwenzeka lokhu nje iyaqonga ingcindezi yokuthi uRamaphosa awusayine umthetho.Izinhlangano ezehlukene okubalwa uphiko lwentsha lwe-ANC, umfelandawonye wezinyunyana zabasebenzi iCosatu, iqembu i-EFF, nezinyunyana zothisha bafuna uRamaphosa awusayine umthetho ngoba waphasiswa nayiPhalamende.Bezivele zikhala ngokuthi azazi kubambeni ngoba waphasiswa yihlandla eledlule lePhalamende.USteenhuisen uthe ezinye zeziphakamiso abazozenza ngukuthi imali eholwa abangatohozi nyanga zonke okunguR370, iphendulwe ibe isibonelelo sabafuna umsebenzi.Okunye ngukuthi ukukhula kwamaholo abasebenzi bakahulumeni kuhambisane neCPI.
KUSADLA lubi ukufunwa ucansi kwezitshudeni ukuze zigixabezwe ngamamaki, ukuhlukunyezwa ngokocansi ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme kanjalo nodlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane nokushaywa indiva kwemigomo yezokulingana kwabesilisa nabesifazane.Lezi ngezinye zezinto ezigqame emhlanganweni wekomiti lemfundo ePhakeme ePhalamende izolo, ebelithola umbiko kwiKhomishini yezokuLingana ngokobulili nebanga eselihanjiwe ukufukula abesifazane kulezi zikhungo. Usihlalo wekomiti uMnuz Tebogo Letsie, uhlabe ikhwelo lokuthi zivikelwe izitshudeni zesifazane ezisafunwa ucansi ukuze zithole amamaki. Ukhale ngesihlava sokuhlukunyezwa kwezitshudeni zesifazane athe kumele kuqedwe ngaso."Izikhungo zemfundo yilapho izitshudeni okumele zizizwe ziphephile khona, noma kuthiwa zihlala ngaphandle noma zihlala ngaphakathi. Iyakhathaza eyokufunwa ucansi kwezitshudeni ukuze zithole amamaki.”UMnuz Tsietsi Shuping obhekele ezomthetho kwikhomishini, uthe izikhungo kumele ziyilandele imigomo ebekiwe ethinta ukulingana ngakwezobulili, ziqinisekise ukuthi izitshudeni ziphephile.Uthe ezinye zezikhungo zibhekene nezinselelo ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi le migomo iyalandelwa."Ezinye zezikhungo aziyilandeli imigomo ethinta ukulingana ngokobulili, kusagcwele isiqhoqho samadoda ezikhundleni eziphezulu. Nemigomo ethinta ukufukula abaphila nokukhubazeka nabathandana nobulili obufanayo ishaywa indiva ezikhungweni.”Uthe ezinye zezikhungo azifuni ukubuyekeza imigomo ethinta ukuhlukunyezwa ngokocansi ukuze ihambisane nemigomo ethinta ukuqasha.Umqondisi jikelele eMnyangweni weMfundo ePhakeme, uDkt Nkosinathi Sishi, uthe bazoqinisekisa ukuthi umbiko wekhomishini izikhungo ziyawulandela.Uthe imigomo ekhona okubalwa eyokulwa nesihlava sokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane, ihlose ukuqeda ngale nkinga ezikhungweni zemfundo.IPhini likaNgqongqoshe walo mnyango, uDkt Mimmy Gondwe, lithe izikhungo kumele kube yizindawo eziphephile kwizitshudeni.UDkt Gondwe uthe yizinto abazibeke eqhulwini bengumnyango ukulwa nesihlava sokuhlukunyezwa kwezitshudeni ezikhungweni.Owayengungqongqoshe walo mnyango, uDkt Blade Nzimande, wakhipha umbiko wethimba elaliluleka ngezithinta amacala okuhlukumeza ngokocansi kanjalo nodlame olubhekiswe kwizitshudeni ezikhungweni.Leli thimba laphakamisa ukuthi kube nendawo lapho kuzoqoshwa khona amagama alabo abalahlwe amacala okuhlukumeza ngokocansi nawodlame ukuze kungathi uma sebexoshwe esikhungweni esithile, bavumbuke kwesinye isikhungo.
ITSHE limi ngothi ngesimo sama-ambulensi ezibhedlela ezisesifundeni iKing Cetshwayo ngemuva kwezivuvaba lapho iziguli zilinda amaviki ukufika kwama-ambulensi, ezinye zigcine zishona zingafinyeleli ekusizakaleni okufanele. Imindeni ekwaziyo ukukhokhela ama-ambulensi ezinkampani ezizimele nokuqasha izimoto yiyo kuphela esindayo ngoba idlulisela izihlobo zayo kwezinye izikhungo zezempilo.Ngokuthola kweSolezwe kusukela ngoJulayi ama-ambulensi ayashoda engxenyeni yalesi sifunda ehlanganisa iMelmoth, iKhombe naseNkandla. Isikhathi esiningi kawekho nhlobo. Muva nje umndeni wakwaKhuzwayo, eMelmoth, uphoqeleke ukuthi ukhokhele i-ambulensi ezimele u-R9 000 ukuze uhambise isihlobo sawo, uMnuz Simphiwe Khuzwayo, esibhedlela eNgwelezane. UKhuzwayo ubedutshuliwe waphuthunyiswa esibhedlela KwaMagwaza, eMelmoth. Kuphele izinsuku ezimbili elindile kulesi sibhedlela kanti bekumele ahlolwe amehlo abopha nokuvuvukala ekhanda.Udokotela wakhe wayembhukhele ukuthi aye esibhedlela iChief Albert Luthuli, eThekwini. Akakwazanga ukuya ngoba akafikanga ngesikhathi eNgwelezene wafika isimshiyile i-ambulensi.Umthombo waleli phephandaba osehhovisi elilawula ama-ambulensi eNkandla, eMelmoth naseKhombe, uthe abanawo ama-ambulensi, wonke afile. Bathembela kwawakwezinye izindawo ezifana naseShowe naseMpangeni ukuthi abasize.Uthe le ngxenye yesifunda inama-ambulensi angu-13 namabhasi ahambisa iziguli amahlanu. Wonke afile, ase-workshop. Kuwo kukhona aseduve izinsuku ezingaphezulu kuka-100 engalungisiwe."Ngenyanga edlule nje kuphela, iziguli ezevile ku-700 azikwazanga ukuya ezikhungweni zezempilo ebezidluliselwe kuzo ngesikhathi ebezidluliselwe ngaso ngenxa yale nkinga. Okubuhlungu ukuthi kulezi ziguli kubalwa izingane eziphukile, abadutshuliwe nezinye iziguli ezisuke zidinga izinsiza ezisuke zingekho ezikhungweni eziseduze kwazo. Ama-ambulensi kahulumeni abhekele ukusiza umphakathi ontulayo ongakwazi ukukhokhela ama-ambulensi azimele,” kuchaza umthombo. Uthe izikhulu zoMnyango eziphethe iSifunda zabikelwa kodwa kuze kube manje azikaqhamuki nasisombululo."Inkinga esibhekene nayo ukuthi izikhulu ezikhipha igunya lokuthi i-ambulensi ikhandwe, noma ingakhandwa zishaya ngonyawo lonwabu uma kumele zithathe isinqumo. Kuyenzeka ukukhandwa kwe-ambulensi kuthathe izinsuku ezingu-200 ngalesi sikhathi nebikhona isuke isifile. Inkinga ayidalwa ukuthi isifunda asinayo imali, kumanje sinayo imali yokukhanda. Inkinga ngabantu abaqashiwe abadonsa izinyawo uma kumele bathathe isinqumo, ” usho kanje.UMnuz Mlungisi Ndlovu wenyunyana yabasebenzi, iPublic Servants Association (PSA), uthe inkinga yokushoda kwama-ambulensi ibhekene nesifundazwe sonke kodwa okwase-King Cetshwayo sekungaphezu kwamandla. "Sifisa ukuthi uMphathiswa wezeMpilo noNdunankulu bangenelele kulolu daba ngoba sekunesikhathi ludingidwa emazingeni aphansi, singaphumi isixazululo. Ekugcineni umphakathi ongaqondi ukuthi kwenzekani ulwa nabasebenzi bezempilo uzitshela ukuthi bayavilapha,” kusho yena. UDkt Imran Keeka, obhekele ezempilo kwi-DA, uthe ukushoda kwama-ambulensi yinkinga yesifundazwe sonke."Sibhalele uMphathiswa wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal (uNkk Nomagugu Simelane), sicela ukuthi asinike izibalo zama-ambulensi akulesi sifundazwe nokwabiwa kwawo. Ezindaweni zasemakhaya inkinga inkulu kakhulu kodwa naseThekwini iziguli zilinda i-ambulensi zize ziqashe azimele. "Lokhu akwamukelekile. Siyazi ukuthi inqwaba yamabhasi ahambisa iziguli zisuka kwezinye izikhungo zezempilo ziya kwezinye, namanye ama-amabulensi aduve ema-workshop ayokhandwa ngoba asemadala. Amanye asehlale izinyanga eziyisithupha kulawo ma-workshop,” kusho uDkt Keeka. UMnuz Ntokozo Maphisa okhulumela uMnyango wezeMpilo KwaZulu -Natal, uthe isiguli okuthiwa saziqashela i-ambulensi ezimele asikwazanga ukulinda imizuzu engu-15 , i-ambulensi yafika sesihambile. Akabange esangena esimeni sokushoda kwama-ambulensi eKing Cetshwayo.
INKANTOLO eNkulu yaseThekwini imlahle ngamacala umshayeli wetekisi owadlwengula wabulala ayephuza naye.USamkelo Victus Dube (33) ubebhekene necala lokudlwengula aphinde abulale umufi, uNkzs Sbahle Faith Biyela (17) eFolweni, ngo-Okthoba 5, 2022.Ubebekwe necala lokushaya alimaze umngani kamufi ophinde waba ngufakazi kuleli cala, uNksz Thandiwe Princess Shange.UDube kuthiwa wayeshayela amatekisi asuka eFolweni eya eThekwini. Sebegoduka umufi noNksz Shange kuthiwa wavuka umbhejazane wakheqa umufi emnqabela ukuthi ahambe waze wamgwaza esiphongweni nge-screwdriver.Izolo, iJaji uBroos Bedderson limthole enecala lokushaya, lokudlwengula nelokubulala."Inkantolo ikuthola unecala lokushaya ngenhloso yokulimaza futhi ikuthola unecala lokudlwengula nelokubulala. Kungumsebenzi wezinkantolo ke ukubasusa emehlweni omphakathi abantu abafana nawe,’’ kusho ijaji.UDube wakhalelwa ngamasongo kaSigonyela ngo-Okthoba 13, esecashe emzini kanina oseChesterville.Kuvele nokuthi uDube ngaphambilini, wake wadlwengula intombazane engumakhelwane wakhe ngokuhamba kwesikhathi agcina esethandana nayo.Amalungu omndeni kamufi asishayele ihlombe isinqumo senkantolo.Namhlanje kulindeleke ukuthi inkantolo imgwebe uDube.

KUBOSHWE abaganene emva kokutholakala kwesidumbu seshende lenkosikazi sidindilize esikhotheni, sinamanxeba okugwazwa KwaNdelu, eMthwalume, ngeSonto. Ngokuthola kweSolezwe, isidumbu sikaMkhohliswa Duma (52), obedume ngoMabhilidi, kuthiwa sitholwe ngumuntu ozithele phezu kwaso eduze kwendlela edlula ngaphandle komuzi wabasolwa ngoMsombuluko.Kuthiwa amaphoyisa abashaqe ngokwehlukana abasolwa njengoba kuboshwe owesifazane (48) kuqala emva kokuvuma ukuthi nguye ombulele umufi.Kuthiwa aphinde abuya azolanda umyeni wakhe (85) njengoba kukholakala ukuthi umlekelele ngesikhathi enza umshophi.Nakuba umufi bese kuneminyaka ehlala kule ndawo, kuthiwa izihlobo zakhe azikaveli njengoba kuvela ukuthi ubehambe ehlala emizini yabantu lapho abebamba khona amatoho okukhelela abantu amanzi.Umthombo ocele ukungadalulwa uthe udaba lokubulawa kukamufi luwundabizekwayo endaweni.Ulandisa ngesigameko uthe: "NgeSonto umsolwa nomufi, abebephila ngokuhlale beziphuzele, bagcine ukubonwa belandelana eshibhini lendawo. Kuthiwa umsolwa wayelokhu etshela umufi ukuthi akangalokhu emlandela, ephethe ibhodlela lotshwala.”Uqhube wathi lona wesifazane wagcina ehamba nebhodlela lakhe, umufi waqhubeka wamlandela."Asazi-ke ukuthi babangeni njengoba etholwe esebulewe ngoMsombuluko,” kusho umthombo odalule ukuthi emva kokutholwa kwesidumbu sikamufi, uma ebuzwa umsolwa ukuthi uphi umufi, waphendula ngelithi "ngimbulele”.Umthombo uveze ukuthi umsolwa njengoba ebeshendeza nomufi ubenaye umyeni kodwa ogugile."Ungunkosikazi wesithathu wekhehla njengoba bashona ababili abangaphambi kwakhe. Ngisho nezingane zekhehla, ezihlala eThekwini, ziyazi ngakho konke lokhu futhi zikubeka kucace ukuthi azimfuni umsolwa,” kusho umthombo.Ikhansela lendawo, uMnuz Mngoma (igama lakhe elingatholakalanga) lithe libikelwe ngodaba olushaqisayo kodwa belingakayi endaweini ukuyothola imininingwane."Ngithintiwe ngemikhuba yalo mama obengaziphethe kahle. Kodwa angikwazi ukuphawula kakhulu ngingakayi khona ukuyothola ulwazi olugcwele,” kusho uMngoma othe uzoya namuhla kule ndawo.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa aseMsinsini abophe abasolwa ababili, oneminyaka engu-48 nonengu-85."Ukuboshwa kwabo kulandela isigameko lapho kutholwe khona owesilisa (52) esikhotheni eMlamula ebulewe. Ubenenqwaba yezingozi ekhanda,” kusho uNetshiunda.Uthe abasolwa bekulindeleke ukuthi bavele eNkantolo yeMantshi yasoThuthwini izolo.
SISHUBILE isimo phakathi komholi we-DA uMnuz John Steenhuisen noMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ngezinhlelo zokusayinwa koMthethosivivinywa wezikole iBela Bill ibe ngumthetho. USteenhuisen usabise ngokuthi aluzobakhona uzinzo kuhulumeni wokubambisana uma uRamaphosa eqhubeka nalo mcimbi wasesidlangaleni, wokusayina ozoba seziNdlini zoMbuso ePitoli kusasa.UMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa Isithombe: Henk Kruger / Independent NewspapersURamaphosa ushaya phansi ngonyawo akajiki ekutheni uyaqhubeka nokusayina kanti uthe ubevele elindele ukuthi kuzoba nemvunge.Uxwayise ngokuthi akumele uma kukhona ukungavumelani, bese abaholi bamaqembu abambisene kuhulumeni, basabise ngokuthi aluzobakhona uzinzo.USteenhuisen uthe ufuna ukuhlangana noRamaphosa ukuze amnxenxe ukuthi angasayini."Uma eqhubeka nokusayina uzobe ephula umongo wokusebenzisana kuhulumeni wokubambisana. Ngesikhathi kubhungwa eyokubumba uhulumeni, samtshela kwezikabhoqo ukuthi asiwamukeli lo mthetho ngendlela oyiyo okwamanje, sathi akawubuyisele ePhalamende ukuze kwenziwe izichibiyelo,” kusho uSteenhuisen.Uthe uzohambisa izichibiyelo abafuna zenziwe kulo mthethosivivinywa ngoba uRamaphosa unawo amandla okuwubuyisela ePhalamende."Uma enqaba uzobe ebeka engcupheni eyokusebenzisana kuhulumeni. I-ANC iyazi ukuthi akumele ithathe izinqumo ngayodwana.” Okhulumela uRamaphosa, uMnuz Vincent Magwenya, esithangamini nabezindaba izolo eKapa, uthe umengameli uyaqhubeka nokusayina umthetho.Uthe okumkhathazayo umengameli abaholi abakuhulumeni wokubambisana, abasabisa ngoqhekeko uma kukhona abangahambisani nakho."Umengameli akakhathazekile ngokuthi uzohlukana phakathi uhulumeni wokubambisana. Kuyakhathaza kodwa ukuthi lokhu kusabisa akubhekile kuphela kumengameli wezwe, kodwa nakubantu bakuleli. Uhulumeni awubunjelwanga iqembu elithile, kodwa ubunjelwe abantu bakuleli.” Uthe umengameli akawusayini kuphela umthetho uma kungukuthi awuhambisani noMthethosisekelo, hhayi ngezizathu zepolitiki. "Lo mthetho udlule kuzona zonke izigaba okubalwa nePhalamende yingakho ezowusayina. Asikho isidingo sokuthi umengameli avumelane nabaholi bamaqembu ngaphambi kokusayina umthetho,” kusho uMagwenya.Uthe kuzoba nezinhlelo zokuzama ukuxazulula ukungaboni ngaso linye kuhulumeni wokubambisana."Amaqembu ayakwazi ukuthi ePhalamende afune kube nezichibiyelo emthethweni. Nakulokhu azokwazi ukufaka izichibiyelo uma ususayiniwe.”Uthe umengameli ukulindele ukuthi kusazobakhona ukungaboni ngaso linye kubaholi kuze kuphele ihlandla likahulumeni wokubambisana. Neqembu i-ActionSA lisabise ngokulandela umgudu wezomthetho uma uRamaphosa esayina umthetho.NoNgqongqoshe weMfundo eyisiSekelo uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, wanxusa uRamaphosa ukuthi angawusayini umthetho ngoba kukhona ezinye izinto angeneme ngazo.Okuqukethwe yilo mthetho wukuthi uGrade R uzoba yimpoqo, amanye amandla okubalwa ulimi lokufunda ezikoleni kanjalo nokugcwala kwesikole, kubekwe enhlokweni yomnyango kuleso sifundazwe. Abazali bazobekwa amacala uma kungukuthi banqabela izingane zabo ukuthi ziye esikoleni.
Kulindelwe izivakashi eziqhamuka emazweni ehlukene ezingu-1.3 million eThekwini njengoba kuzongena ihlobo.Lokhu kuhlaluke ngesikhathi kwethulwa umkhankaso iDurban Tourism Summer, eCoastal Lounge Resort, eMgababa izolo ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: The Endless Wave of Tranquility obuhanjelwe abaqhamuka emkhakheni wezokungcebeleka njengoba bekukhona oDJ abadumile okubalwa kubo oDJ Sox, T’zozo uDJ Bongs nabanye.IMeya yaseThekwini, uMnuz Cyril Xaba, yethule ngokusemthethweni lo mkhankaso yathi inhloso yawo ukugcina iTheku lisemiqondweni yezivakashi."Ngalo mkhankaso sifuna ukuqhakambisa izindawo zaseThekwini ezingamagugu anomlando ocebile. BAFUNA umkhuzi wamaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, abalekelele engakehlisi "isivinini ahamba ngaso”, abantu baseMgungundlovu abaxakwe abantu bokufika.Abantu baseMgungundlovu banxuse uMkhwanazi ukuba angenelele ngokushesha odabeni lobugebengu obenziwa ngabantu bokufika enkabeni yedolobha.Lokhu bakusho ngesikhathi kunembizo yokuxoxa ngobugebengu ebibizwe uNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, izolo.UMnuz Gobizizwe Zondi waseMbali, uthe abantu bokufika bayazenzela ezakhiweni ezisedolobheni, wabalula kakhulu ezisemgwaqweni uPietermaritz."Siyocela kule sivinini onaso, ukuba ungenelele kulolu daba ungaze ukhathale. Akuhambeki kuPietermaritz, amaPakistan ayazenzela. Angazi ukuthi anasiphi isivumelwano nomasipala. Sicela ungenelele kungaze kungenelele thina siwumphakathi.”Nakuba uZondi encome amagalelo kaMkhwanazi ekulweni nobugebengu, ukhalaze ngesiteshi sangakubo eMbali.Uthe eminyakeni emibili edlule, kwadutshulwa indodana yakhe ngezinhlamvu eziwu-17 ngaphandle kwesiteshi samaphoyisa, kwangaphuma ngisho iphoyisa elilodwa.Abantu abaningi abakhulume embizweni bakhale ngokungabibikho kwezimoto eziteshini zamaphoyisa angakubo, ukwebiwa kwemfuyo nokuhlala ngobumnyama ngenxa yokungabi bikho kweziphehli zikagesi, ama-transformer.UNksz Nombulelo Gumede wakwaMafunze, uthe bayaye batshelwe ukuthi izimoto azikho uma beshayela ucingo esiteshini samaphoyisa.UMnuz Mzothule Mchunu waseMooi River, uthe imfuyo yabo iyantshontshwa, wathi iningi lemfuyo entshontshwayo iphelela oThongathi nakwaMaphumulo."Okuxakayo ukuthi amaphoyisa asuke esekuphi? Kungani engaze angazifuna izimvume zokuthuthwa kwemfuyo?”Ephendula izikhalazo zezakhamizi, uNtuli uncome igalelo likaMkhwanazi ekulweni nobugebengu.UNtuli uthe uMkhwanazi uyisibonelo esihle emaphoyiseni, wathi abantu bakwezinye izifundazwe bayafisa ukuba nabakhuzi bamaphoyisa afana noMkhwanazi."UMkhwanazi ngimhloma uphaphe lwegwalagwala. Abantu bathi uma bonke abakhuzi bamaphoyisa bakwezinye izifundazwe bengase befane naye, ubugebengu bungaphela.”UNtuli uthe babambisene kahle noMkhwanazi, wathi bazoyinqoba impi yobugebengu."Lo mkhankaso wokulwa nobugebengu lapha KwaZulu-Natal angeke ube inganekwane noma iphupho lasebusika. Sizokulwa nobugebengu, asikhathalele ukuthi benziwa ubani.”UNtuli uthe bazowukhomba umuzi onotshwala labo abazonqaba ukuboshwa."Kufanele abantu baKwaZulu-Natal bazi ukuthi uma bekhipha isibhamu besibhekisa emaphoyiseni, amaphoyisa ngeke ahlale angazivikeli.”UNtuli uthe bazoqhubeka nomkhankaso wabo abawubhekise ebantwini basemazweni angaphandle abangenazo izimvume zokuba kuleli."Kulabo abangaphandle abangenazo izimvume zokuba kuleli, ngithi kubo uyeza uMkhwanazi.”
UBENGOWESILISA obewaziwa ngemigilingwane umthandazi ogixabezwe ngodilikajele elahlwa ngecala lokudlwengula ephindelela umzukulu wakhe ophila nokukhubazeka.Lo wesilisa oneminyaka engu-50 elingeke lidalulwe igama lakhe ukuvikela umgilwa, ugixabezwe yiNkantolo yesiFunda yaseNtuzuma isigwebo sikadilikajele ngemuva kokuba ngeledlule imlahle ngecala lokudlwengula umzukulu wakhe izikhawu ezine.Kuvele ukuthi ngoNovemba 2022, wadlwengula umzukulu wakhe owayeneminyaka eyisishiyagalombili, ekhaya eLindelani.Umshushisi u-Advocate Naushaad Haripersadi unxuse inkantolo ukuba imgwebe lo wesilisa.Uveze ukuthi akaqali ukubandakanyeka ezigamekweni ezingezinhle, waveza ukuthi eminyakeni eyedlule, wake walahlwa ngecala lokushushumbisa izidakamizwa, waphinde walahlwa ngamacala amathathu okushaya ngenhloso yokulimaza, wabhadla ejele izinyanga eziyisithupha.Umshushisi uthe onecala wasinda kukubi abesilisa abangomakhelwane bakhe besho ukumqeda benengwa umkhuba wakhe wokuthi njalo ubavezela isitho sakhe sangesese ebachomela ngokuthi sinamandla kunezabo.Uke wabhekana nanecala lokubizela izinkabi umndeni wakhe. Kuvele nokuthi uke wagwaza amalungu omndeni amahlanu."Izenzo zakho zonke zikuveza ngokusobala ukuthi ungumuntu onjani. Leli cala lokudlwengula lifakazela ukuthi ungumuntu onjani,'' kugcizelela uMshushisi.Ubuze lo wesilisa ukuthi ngaphambi kokuba inkantolo iwise isigwebo kukhona yini okusenhliziyweni angathanda ukukusho?"Ngicela inkantolo inganginikezi udilikajele ngoba lokho kuyongikhinyabeza empilweni yami. Kuyoholela ekutheni nomsebenzi wami wokuqopha amafilimu ungaphinde ube khona,'' echaza.Umshushisi umbuzile ukuthi angamenzanjani owesilisa okungathiwa udlwengule indodakazi yakhe."Loyo muntu kungamele athole isijezo esifanele,'' kuphendula lo wesilisa.Umshushisi uthe kuyacaca ke ukuthi naye kumele athole udilikajele. "Ayi phela mina awungifanele udilakajele ngoba ngimsulwa,'' kuphendula yena.Imantshi, uNkk Mpunguse, uthe ummangalelwa ukhombise ukungazisoli ngoba akakaze alivume icala."Isigwebo sikadilikajele yisona esikufanele,'' kusho imantshi. Ithe igama lalo wesilisa lizofakwa ohlwini lwabantu abake badlwengula futhi lizofakwa ohlwini lwabantu okungafanele ukuba bagunyazwe ukusebenzisana nezingane.Iqhuba, ithe ukugwetshwa kwakhe kusho ukukhululwa komgilwa emaketangweni engcindezelo. "Phela umgilwa ubengeke esakwazi ukuqhubeka ahlale nawe endlini. Uyakwesaba,'' isho kanje.Imantshi ikhale nangokuba yinsakavukela kwamacala okudlwengula ngaphakathi emindenini, yathi okubuhlungu ukuthi imindeni eminingi ijwayele ukuwafihla amacala alolu hlobo.Unina kamgilwa ocele ukuba lingadalulwa igama lakhe, uthe namanje akuvumi ukuthi akholwe ukuthi umuntu wasegcekeni wenze umonakalo onjengalona enganeni yakhe yentombazane.Ngemuva kwesigwebo, ukhihle isililo phakathi enkantolo.
IHEALTH Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) okuwumkhandlu olawula odokotela, usudonse ngendlebe abantu ukuba baqinisekise ukuthi baya kodokotela abanemvume yokusebenza.Lokhu kulandela ukuboshwa komsizi kadokotela wamazinyo obesebenza ngaphandle kwencwadi emgunyaza ukuba enze lo msebenzi eLonehill, eGoli.IHPCSA iveze ukuthi ngesikhathi ihlola izindawo okusebenza kuzo odokotela, ithole uNksz Dorothy Shunmugam obesebenza njengomsizi kadokotela wamazinyo yize engenayo imvume yokwenza lo msebenzi.IHPCSA iveze ukuthi incwadi yokusebenza kaNksz Shunmugam yasulwa ngo-2006 emuva kokuthi engayikhokhanga imali yokuyivuselela ekhokhwa kanye ngonyaka.UNksz Shunmugam uboshiwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 17 se-Health Professions Act lapho ebhekene necala lokusebenza ngaphandle kwemvume.Esitatimendeni sabezindaba iHPCSA ithe uDkt Kow-Der Yeh ongudokotela wamazinyo onemvume yokusebenza eNingizimu Afrika kusukela ngo-2019, obeqashe uNksz Shunmugam usebikwe kwi-Medical and Dental Professions Board lapho ezobhekana necala lokuqasha umuntu ongenayo imvume yokusebenza."Bonke odokotela kufanele babe nemvume yokusebenza ekhishwa yiHPCSA. Lokhu sikwenzela ukuvikela umphakathi. Kuyicala ukuqasha umuntu ongenayo imvume yokusebenza bese umvumela ukuba alaphe abantu. Umphakathi kufanele ubabike odokotela abasebenza ngaphandle kwemvume ngokuthumela i-email [email protected].”IHPCSA ithe kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baye kodokotela abanemvume yokusebenza ukuze bahlale bephephile. Abafuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi odokotela banemvume yokusebenza bangangena kwi-website ye-HPCSA bese bebheka ngaphansi kwesihloko esithi register. Bangashayela ne-HPCSA bephethe imininingwane kadokotela ku-012 338 9300/1.

UMNDENI wowesifazane okuthiwa udutshulwe wabulawa ngobeyisoka lakhe eHighflats, ngoMsombuluko, wase ezibulala naye, uveze ukuthi ubemsongela ngokumbulala emva kokumala.Kuvela ukuthi bese kuphele izinyanga ezimbili umgilwa, uNksz Mandisa Mgenge (33) atshela umsolwa, uMnuz Dumisani 'Bhejane’ Msomi, naye okuthiwa uzibulalele endaweni yesigameko, ukuthi ucu alusahlangani.Kuthiwa umgilwa wakubeka kwacaca ukuthi uqeda ubudlelwano ngoba engaliboni ikusasa nomsolwa njengoba eganiwe aphinde abe nonina wezingane.Isihlobo sikaNksz Mgenge, esicele ukungadalulwa sithe umndeni ubunalo ulwazi ngezinsongo zokubulala kodwa ungazithatheli phezulu, uzitshela ukuthi umsolwa uyazisabisela nje.Uveze ukuthi bese kuphele izinyanga ezimbili umgilwa amala umsolwa kodwa engafuni nakuyizwa leyo.Uthe umgilwa wayebeka yona indaba yokuganwa kukamsolwa ukuthi idweba isthombe esicacile sokuthi bona bobabili alikho ikusasa elingaba khona phakathi kwabo."Ukuveze kaningi ukuthi ngeke avume ukuhlukana naye, waze walimisa ngesihloko elokuthi uzombulala okungcono bese eyazibulala naye, nokuyinto agcine eyenza ngempela,” kusho isihlobo.Sithe lokhu ubekusho kuye umgilwa, aphinde akusho nakomunye udadewabo kanjalo nakubazali bakamgilwa uqobo, okuthiwa ubebashayela ucingo uma esesonga.Isihlobo siphinde sasola amaphoyisa ngokuhluleka ukumvikela umgilwa, kwaze kwaba ubulawa ngempela."Nakuba abazali bengazithathelanga phezulu izinsongo ezazenziwa umsolwa, umgilwa wazisukumela. Waze waya ngisho emaphoyiseni ukuyobika kodwa amchilizela izandla, ethi akukho angamsiza ngakho ngoba umsolwa akaze ambeke isandla, umsabise ngamazwi kuphela,” kusho isihlobo.Uthe lokhu abaphoyisa akwenza phezu kokuba umgilwa ewachazele ukuthi umsolwa uke wamkhomba ngesibhamu, wathi ukuba enza okuthize ngezinsongo, mhlawumbe ngabe umgilwa usaphila.Ubuye wathi bewumndeni kubadinile ukuthi uMsomi aphendule izingane zikamgilwa ezisencane - azithola ebudlelwaneni baphambilini - izintandane."Lo muntu ubenomfazi wakhe, eganiwe. Ubebuye aphinde abe nonina wezingane. Isidingo sokuthi abulale isihlobo sethu besingekho,” kusho isihlobo.Sichaza ngokuthiwa kwenzeke endaweni yesigameko, sithe umsolwa ufike wavulela ngenhlamvu kumgilwa esendlini adayisela kuyo imithi kayise, owaziwa ngelikaMgenge, inyanga edumile yaseMzinto.Uthe emva kokudutshulwa ebusweni, entanyeni nasesifubeni, umgilwa uzamile ukuphuma abaleke, kodwa wawa esabaleke ibanga elifishane.Uthe kuphele amahora amabili ephila engalutholi usizo, amaphoyisa ethi akulindwe umndeni wakhe, nothe uma usufika umphuthumisa esibhedlela, wafike washona.Isihlobo sikamsolwa, uMnuz Thabani Msomi, uthe kulukhuni ukuthi bakhulume kakhulu ngesigameko ngoba abazi ukuthi bekubangwani."Sisola ukuthi bebexabene. Thina sazi ukuthi bebethandana, cishe sekuphele iminyaka emithathu bethandana,” kusho uMsomi.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa aseHighflats, aphenya icala lokubulala emva kwesigameko sokudutshulwa kubulawe owesifazane oneminyaka engu-33, ngumuntu wesilisa amaziyo."Imibiko ithi lona wesilisa naye uzidubulile,” kusho uNetshiunda.
UKUQEMBUKA kowayengumengameli we-ANC nezwe, uMnuz Jacob Zuma evula iqembu lakhe Umkhonto weSizwe, kushayele isipikili sokugcina ezinkingeni ezibhekene noKhongolose ikakhulu KwaZulu-Natal. Lokhu kuvezwe abahlaziyi bezepolitiki abangeze nokuthi ezinye zezinkinga zikaKhongolose zidalwe ukuklwebhana nombango wangaphakathi, ukukhathala kwabantu ukuvotela into eyodwa, nokuhlukana kwangaphakathi.Basho kanje kulandela ukuphefumula kukaSihlalo we-ANC kuzwelonke, uMnuz Gwede Mantashe, othe i-ANC esifundazweni ifile, kudingeka yakhiwe kabusha.Yize esho kanje uMantashe, kodwa ukuchithile ukuthi bazohlakaza ubuholi besifundazwe njengoba umlando wabafundisa ukungaxhamazeli bahlakaze ubuholi ngoba kuba nzima kakhulu uma usuwakha kabusha.UNobhala Jikelele we-ANC uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, uke wayithinta eyezinxushunxushu ngaphakathi nokufika kwe-MK njengezinto ezenze le nhlangano yehlelwa ukwesekwa.I-MK ikhiphe i-ANC emandleni esifundazweni njengoba kuphethe uhulumeni wokubambisana kwamaqembu ahlukene. Kuzwelonke i-MK iyiqembu eliphikisayo kanti yathola izihlalo ezingu-58 ePhalamende.Umhlaziyi wezepolitiki oseNyuvesi yaKwaZulu-Natal (UKZN) uMnuz Zakhele Ndlovu, uthe umdonsiswano wangaphakathi kwi-ANC nokuqembuka kukaZuma yikhona okudonsele amanzi ngomsele i-ANC.Esifundazweni, uthe uZuma ube nomthelela ekutheni le nhlangano ilahlekelwe amandla."I-ANC yashaya isikhala ngokuyibukela phansi indaba yokushiya kukaZuma, kwakumele iyilawule ngendlela. Ukuhlukana kwangaphakathi ngezinye zezinto ezenze le nhlangano ishayeke kanje.”Uthe kodwa izinkinga ze-ANC zaqala eminyakeni eyevile kwengu-10 edlule."Indaba yaqala engqungqutheleni yango-2007, yasePolokwane, lapho kwagqama khona ukwehlukana kuxoshwa owayengumengameli we-ANC nezwe, uMnuz Thabo Mbeki. UZuma wathatha izintambo, kwathi uma eseshiya kwi-ANC wakhala ngokuthi i-ANC kaRamaphosa ayisafani. Lokhu kubhebhezele kakhulu izinkinga zale nhlangano, abantu bayishiya bahamba noZuma.”USolwazi Siphamandla Zondi ongumhlaziyi ekhuluma nesiteshi sethelevishini, ubale ukufika kwe-MK nokwehlukana kwangaphakathi njengezinto ezilimaze le nhlangano.Uthe abanye abantu sebekhathele ukuvotela abantu ababodwa yingakho babuye bavotela amanye amaqembu.Uveze ukuthi sekuphele iminyaka eyevile ku-15 le nhlangano yehlelwa ukwesekwa."Ukuyamaniswa kwe-ANC nenkohlakalo, i-MK ngezinye zezinto ezenze le nhlangano yagajwa abavoti. I-MK izalwa yi-ANC kanjalo neCope okungamaqembu ayilimazile le nhlangano.”Uthe ngisho emawadini abantu bayayilaxaza le nhlangano.
SEKUQUBUKE ukukhathazeka ngokwanda kwabantu abadala (50-54), abane-HIV eGauteng, okuvele ukuthi isibalo sabo sesinyukele ku-32.2% ngo-2022, sisuka ku-20.8% ngo-2017.USolwazi Khangelani Zuma we-Human Sciences Research Council (HSRC), okuwuyena obehola lolu cwaningo, uthe abakutholile wukuthi abantu abane-HIV sebephila isikhathi eside ngenxa yokuthi badla imishanguzo yalesi sifo."Okusikhathazayo wukuthi njengoba sanda isibalo sabantu abadala abane-HIV kusho ukuthi - ngaphandle kwalabo abadla imishanguzo yabo - kukhona nabanye abasuke beqala ukuthola ukuthi bane-HIV. Lokhu sikusho ngoba isibalo sabo sikhuphukile kuleso sango-2017.”Uthe ucwaningo lwenziwe kubantu baseTshwane, Ekurhuleni, eGoli, Sedibeng naseWest Rand."Abantu abadla imishanguzo banyuke bafinyelela ku-73.4% eGauteng, ngo-2017 lesi sibalo sasiku-56.0%. Kuvela ukuthi abesifazane yibona abadla kakhulu imishanguzo njengoba isibalo sabo siku-75% bese esamadoda sibe ku-66.3%. Sibuye sathola ukuthi kusenabantu abangazihloli i-HIV njengoba u-61.8% wabantu abaneminyaka ewu-25-49 bethe abazihloli.”Uthe phakathi kwezinto ezenza sinyuke isibalo sabaphila ne-HIV wukushesha uzimbandakanye nocansi njengoba abanye abacwaningiwe beveze ukuthi baqale ukuya ocansini beneminyaka engaphansi kuka-15.Okunye wukulala nabantu abahlukene nokungenzi ucansi oluphephile.Ubalule ukuthi u-70% wabacwaningiwe uthe awuwasebenzisi amakhondomu noma uwasebenzisa ngezikhathi ezithile.Ugqugquzele uhulumeni ukuba andise imikhankaso yokuqwashisa nge-HIV, agqugquzele abesilisa ukuba basoke, andise imikhankaso yokusetshenziswa kwePreP. Uphinde wanxusa ukuthi kufundiswe nabesifazane namantombazane ngezindaba ze-HIV njengoba kuseyibona abangenwa kakhulu yiyo.
BAZIPHONSE kunoxhaka abebecushelwe wona woKlebe abantu ababili okukhona kubona nongumsebenzi kaMasipala eMfuleni, eGauteng ababoshelwe icala lokuthatha ngodli imali emphakathini.Abasolwa ababili abaneminyaka engu-39 no-51 baboshwe ngoLwesibili.Kuthiwa bagqunywe ezitokisini kanti kulindeleke ukuthi bavele enkantolo maduze njengoba kusaqhubeka uphenyo.Okhulumela oKlebe, uColonel Katlego Mogale, uthe ithimba lamaphoyisa lisebenze ngokushesha eSharpville emuva kokuthola umbiko ngabantu abakhokhisa abanye imali."Ithimba lamaphoyisa libe selihlela umhlangano obukade ugunyaziwe nabasolwa lapho kushintshanwe khona ngemali. Emuva nje kwalokho, bakhalelwe amasongo kaSigonyela abasolwa,” kusho uCol Mogale.Uthe abasolwa batholakale bephethe imali abadotshwe ngayo enye ebikade isemotweni yabo.Udalule ukuthi abasolwa kulindeleke ukuthi bavele okokuqala enkantolo maduzane.Kwenzeka lokhu nje kukhalwa nkalozonke ngabakhokhisa imali ngodli osomabhizinisi nabantu emiphakathini.Kunekhwelo lokuba iPhalamende lenze izichibiyelo emthethweni olawula i-extortion khona sizoqina isandla kwabagila le migilingwane.Amaphoyisa akhuthaza abantu ukuthi bawabikele ngalabo ababahlalise ngesinqe esisodwa bephula umthetho.
AKHALE ngezifo ezingamahlalakhona amaphoyisa efuna ibheyili eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini. Laba basolwa babhekene necala lenkohlakalo emva kokuba kuthiwa bazame ukuqola usomabhizinisi wasePhoenix isamba sika-R79 500 abemgwazisa ngeSonto.U-Warrant Officer Matheng Mashabelu (54), uSeargent Zakhele Makhubele (45), uSeargent Xolani Sishi (50) noMnuz Deon Naidoo (48) bakhale ngokuxinwa yizifo ezingamahlalakhona befuna inkantolo ibabonelele.UMashabelu noMakhubele bangamaphoyisa esiteshini esiseBryanston, eGoli, kanti uNaidoo kuthiwa usebenza njengengede ophikweni lwezobunhloli olukhona eGoli.USishi nozakwabo aboshwe nabo, oConstable Stallone Sing (31), Seargent Nicholus Nxuza (50), uSeargent Thamsanqa Dlamini (43) noSeargent Phiwayinkosi Zulu (41) bangamaphoyisa esiteshini esiseNtuzuma. Ngaphandle kukaSingh, oboshwe nabasolwa baseGoli ngeSonto, bonke abasolwa abangamaphoyisa esiteshini esiseNtuzuma bazinikele emaphoyiseni khona izolo.Bekhulunyelwa ngabameli babo, bonke abasolwa baveze ukuthi abakaze baboshwa phambilini, abanabo ubungozi kofakazi, banamakheli aqondile futhi bazimisele ngokuliphika icala abebekwe lona.Baboshwa nje kuthiwa ngeSonto bazame ukugwazisa usomabhizinisi onesitolo ePhoenix okuvela ukuthi bambhadame namabhokisi amathathu kagwayi abathe awukho emthethweni. Kusolwa ukuthi ubagwazele ngo-R400 babuyisa ushintshi okuthe emva kwesikhashana behambile, babuyela esitolo basesha ngaphambi kokuthi bashaqe ugwayi abewudayisa futhi baphoqa ukuthi umgilwa abanike nesibhamu sakhe. Kuthiwa bamthathe baya naye esiteshini esisePhoenix baphoqa ukuthi abanike u-R100 000. Umgilwa kuthiwa ufonele unkosikazi wakhe oveze ukuthi uzokwazi ukukhokha u-R79 500 kuphela. Kuhlelwe indawo lapho kuzohlanganwa khona, balalelwa unyendle baboshwa ngalo iSonto.Inkantolo ibadedele ngebheyili ka-R7000 umuntu emunye. Ebakhulula ngebheyili, uMnuz Ashwell Singh oyimantshi ephethe leli cala, ubadonse ngendlebe ngokuhlonipha imibandela yebheyili."Uma kukhona oshintsha indawo ahlala kuyo, azise umphenyi wecala. Anivumelekile ukuxhumana nommangali noma nofakazi nanoma ngayiphi indlela. Ukwephula imibandela yebheyili kuyoholela ekutheni imali eniyikhokhile ingqwambe, nibuyiselwe esitokisini,” usho kanje.Inkantolo ikusho lokhu emva kokuba umphenyi wecala, uCaptain Zanele Xulu, osebenza ngaphansi kophiko loKlebe, eveze ukuthi akanankinga nokukhululwa kwabo ngebheyili. Yize eveze ukuthi amakheli abasolwa abengakaqinisekiswa wonke kwazise abanye bazinikele izolo kodwa unesiqiniseko sokuthi amakheli abawanikezile ayiqiniso nokuthi kuzothi kushaya usuku lwakusasa esewabhekile.Ngaphambi kokuqala kokulalelwa kwesicelo sebheyili kube nobuhixihixi abameli befuna izintatheli zingathathi izithombe, okuchithwe yinkantolo. Kuphinde kwadingeka ukuthi inkantolo iguqe okwesikhashana abameli besabhunga emva kokuthi kuvele ukuthi bekungamele kusetshenziswe inkantolo eseThekwini kwazise icala lenziwe ePhoenix ngakho kumele libe seVerulam kodwa babuye bashaya ungqimphothwe bavumelana ngokuthi libe kuyo le nkantolo. Icala lihlehliselwe uNovemba 7 nonyaka kusaqhubeka uphenyo njengoba uCaptain Xulu ethe basalindele obunye ubufakazi nezitatimende.
INHLANGANO eyenza ucwaningo ngakho konke okuthinta izingane, iChildren’s Institute, eseNyuvesi yaseCape Town, isiphakamise ukuthi uhulumeni anyuse isibonelelo sezingane esiwu-R530 okungenani sibe phakathi kuka-R760 no-R1 500.Lolu cwaningo, olubizwa nge-Child Gauge, luveze ukuthi u-71% wezingane zakuleli uphila emakhaya aswele.Ingane eyodwa kweziwu-25 iyashona ngaphambi kokugubha unyaka izelwe.UNkk Lori Lake we-Children’s Institute uthe bathole ukuthi ingane eyodwa kwezine ayikhuli ngendlela efanele ngenxa yokungadli ukudla okunomsoco nokungatholi imfundo efanele.Uthe imfundo yasenkulisa ibalulekile kanti nokudla kuhambisana nokukhula kwengqondo nomzimba. Uthe izingane ezivela emakhaya angenakho ukudla okwanele ziyabonakala ukuthi zilambile nokwenza ingqondo nomzimba kungakhuli kahle.UNkk Lake uthe isibonelelo sezingane yisona esilwa nobuphofu obubhekene nezingane ngakho ukunyuswa kwaso kuzoletha impilo engcono ezinganeni.Ubalule ukuthi nabesifazane kufanele balekelelwe ukuthola umsebenzi nokudla njengoba kuyibona ababhekelela izidingo zezingane.Ngonyaka odlule bezingaphezu kuka-13 million izingane ezihola isibonelelo sikahulumeni.Ikhwelo lokuthi kunyuswe isibonelelo sezingane aliqali ukukhishwa yiChildren’s Institute njengoba uMnuz Mervyn Abrahams, wenhlangango eyenza ucwaningo ngokubiza kokudla nesimo senhlalo, iPietermaritzburg Economic Justice & Dignity Group, ehlale ecela uhulumeni ukuthi anyuse isibonelelo sezingane ukuze zizokwazi ukudla okunomsoco.Uthe ukudla kwezingane ezineminyaka emithathu kuya kweyisishiyagalolunye kubiza u-R825.00 bese kuthi okwengane eneminyaka ewu-10 kuya kwewu-13 kubize u-R898.01UNkk Hlengiwe Zondi, waseMpola ngaphandle kwasePinetown, onezingane ezihola isibonelelo sikahulumeni, uthe bangajabula uma uhulumeni engasinyusa ngoba ukudla kuyabiza."Kuyabiza ukuthengela izingane ukudla okunomsoco ikakhulukazi lezo eziya enkulisa. U-R530 awaneli, sigcina sesigcwalisela ngemali yokudayisa oswidi nokunye esizama ngakho. Kufanele uhulumeni asizwele ngoba noR370 wabangasebenzi ukhetha ibala.”Ubalule ukuthi uma ethola isibonelelo sezingane uthenga u-2kg kapolony owu-R66.65, u-3kg wama-aphula owu-R45.71, u-4kg kabhanana owu-R58.60, u-7kg wama-orintshi owu-R62.46, amaqanda awu-60 ngoR168.19, olofu bezinkwa bezinsuku eziwu-25 ngenyanga ababiza uR381.14, u-800g we-peanut butter R84.87, u-900g kajamu owu-R38.86, u1kg wemargarine owu-R41.70, ijusi ewu-R120. Konke lokhu kuba wu-R1 068.18.Uthe okunye ukudla okudliwa yizingane kubalwa negilosa yabantu abadala ngakho bayadinga ukuthi isibonelelo sezingane sinyuswe.IChildren’s Institute ibuye yagqugquzela ukuthi izingane kufanele zihambe inkulisa, uhulumeni aqinisekise ukuthi kunothisha abafundisekile ngokuthuthukisa ulwazi lwezingane.
UBENOMLANDO wodlame emndenini owesilisa waKwaMkhabela, eNdwedwe, okuthiwa ubulale ugogo wakhe emuva kokufudunyezelwa ukudla ngoMgqibelo.Kuthiwa umsindo usuke ngesikhathi umsolwa (29) evuka umbhejazane, ebuza umalumekazi wakhe, uNksz Zimbili Vilakazi, ukuthi umfudumezelelani ukudla kwakhe ngoba uyakwazi ukuzenzela?Ngokusho kukaNksz Thokozani Nxumalo, oyindodakazi kamufi, uNkk Nombulelo Vilakazi (70), olandwe ngudadewabo (uZimbili) emzini wakhe osendaweni, uthe udadewabo uphendule umsolwa ngokuthi uyamfudumezela ukudla ngoba bese kunqumele. Uthe umsolwa umtshele emehlweni uNksz Vilakazi (uZimbili) ukuthi uzomphahlaza ngalo ipuleti, nokuyinto okuthiwa ugcine eyenzile njengoba uNkk Nxumalo ezifice ngempela izingcucu zepuleti nophuthu kusakazeke phansi.Udalule ukuthi yiyo le ngxabano evuse umufi nomyeni wakhe uMnuz Richard Vilakazi ngenhloso yokuzolamula."Yilapho avele wavuka khona indlobane, wabangenela ngesando bobathathu,” kusho uThokozani.Uveze ukuthi umsindo ugcine uvusa umfowabo uMnuz Bongani Vilakazi, onguyise kamsolwa, endlini engaphandle, naye kanti uzodliwa yiso isando.Uqhube wathi uNksz Vilakazi (uZimbili) ukwazile ukuphunyula, wazovusa yena (uNkk Nxumalo) kwakhe."Ngithe uma ngifika ekhaya, ngafica umama nobaba belele phansi bengakhulumi, besaphefumula. Ngibafunele izingubo ngabambathisa, kwabizwa i-ambulensi,” kusho uThokozani.Uthe igcine ithatha umkhulu nomfowabo, ibaphuthumisa esibhedlela, ugogo wangabe esahamba njengoba ebesephangalele.Uthe umkhulu noyise kamsolwa, bebenezingozi ezimbi ekhanda."Umkhulu usasesibhedlela, isimo sakhe sibi kangangokuthi abakamtsheli ukuthi umkakhe ushonile ngosuku lwesigameko. Umfowethu yena, utishiwe wakhiswa ngalo usuku. Yize isimo sakhe sivele saba sibi namuhla (esho izolo) wabuye wayiswa emtholampilo,” kubeka uThokozani.Udalule ukuthi umsolwa kudala aqala ukuhlukumeza izihlobo zakhe, enza isibonelo ngokuthi bekungesikhona okokuqala elimaza umkhulu."Kukhona lapho amlimaza khona waze wayotishwa. Wake wawabulala wonke amawindi. Ngaphambi kwalokho, wake washaya unina waze wambopha,” usho kanje.Uqhube wathi ubethi uma esenza izigameko zokuhlukumeza izihlobo, unina aze athi uyazisola ukuthi wamkhiphelani ejele.Uthe basola ukusebenzisa izidakamizwa kumsolwa, abathi uvele abe yibhubesi esithubeni."Ngibuhlungu ngokuthi alimaze abazali bami kanje ajike angabi nandaba, njengoba ebesho ephindelela ukuthi akanendaba yena, awabizwe lawo maphoyisa, yena akasabi ukubuyela eWestville (ejele) ngoba kumnandi,” kusho uThokozani.IMeya kaMasipala waseNdwedwe, uMnuz Sam Mfeka ohlanganise amehlo nomndeni izolo, ithe kusinda kwehlela ngezigameko zodlame endaweni, wathi kuyabakhathaza ukwanda kwazo."Sikhathazwa nayindaba yezidakamizwa ezidla lubi entsheni, okuthi uma intsha isizidlile, yenze izinto ezihlasimulisa umzimba,” kusho uMfeka.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa aseNdwedwe abophe owesilisa oneminyaka engu-29 ngecala lokubulala, namabili okuzama ukubulala."Lokhu kwenzeke emva kwesigameko lapho umsolwa ehlasele uyise, ugogo wakhe nomkhulu wakhe ngesando. Ugogo wakhe (70) uhlonzwe njengosedlulile emhlabeni endaweni yesigameko,” kusho uNetshiunda.Uqhube wathi laba abanye ababili baphuthunyiswe esibhedlela lapho abasathola khona usizo lwezempilo, wathi umsolwa kulindeleke ukuthi avele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseNdwedwe, maduze.
ASEFISA ukuthutha endaweni ukuze aphephe amanye amalungu omphakathi ngenxa yetwetwe kufufusa impi yezigodi ezimbili KwaNongoma okukholakala ukuthi kuqalwe wukubulawa komfundi owagwazwa ngomunye ngoJulayi.USeluleko Zondi (17), wasoNyango khona KwaNongoma, kuthiwa washona emva kokugwazwa ngomunye umfundi obehlala esigodini sakwaMusi, okuthiwa wamgwaza ngaphakathi emagcekeni esikole. Kuvela ukuthi badutshulwe ngabasolwa abangaziwa abebehlome ngezibhamu, kwashona ababili uChunu Mchunu ophelele endaweni yesehlo noSandile Ngubo, yena oshone emva kokungeniswa esibhedlela. Isimo sibi kangangoba sekunamalungu omphakathi athi asesaba nokuphuma ebusuku azivalela ezindlini kanti amanye asefisa nokuthutha endaweni.
