UPHIKO lwentsha lwe-ANC, i-ANCYL eThekwini, linxuse umasipala ukuba upheze ukumosha imali, lukhala ngokuhlaliswa kwemihlangano yamakhansela e-Inkosi Albert Luthuli Convention Centre (ICC) okuthiwa kudla imali eyevile ku-R1 million ngenyanga.Lokhu bekusohlwini lwezikhalo ezidluliselwe eHhovisi leMeya yeTheku, uMnuz Cyril Xaba, emva kwemashi ebisuka e-Durban Christian Centre yaphelela e-City Hall.Intsa ye-ANC eThekwini imashele kuMasipala weTheku bekhala ngamathuba omsebenzi Isithombe: Sibonelo Ngcobo/Independent Media Kule mashi bekukhalwa ngokugqoza kokuqashwa kwentsha kulo masipala.Efunda uhlu lwezikhalo, uNksz Zama Mncube ongumgqugquzeli we-ANCYL eThekwini, uthe iningi imali ekhokhwa wumasipala ukubamba imihlangano yamakhansela-ICC, okumele ngabe kusetshenziswa i-City Hall."I-City Hall sekuyophela iminyaka ewu-10 kunengxenye elungiswayo, okungapheli ukulungiswa kwayo okwenza kubhukhwe i-ICC ukubamba imihlangano. Akuzwakali ukuthi ukulungiswa kwale ndawo sekungathatha isikhathi eside kanje, asazi noma kukhona yini ozuzayo kulokhu, kodwa uma kunjalo sizothola,” usho kanje.Uthe imali ekhokhwa e-ICC, ibingalekelela ekuqasheni inqwaba yentsha ukunciphisa ingwadla yokungasebenzi kwayo egqame kakhulu kulo masipala.Lolu phiko luthi yinqwaba yezikhala zemisebenzi, umasipala ongaqashi muntu kuzo okumele ngabe kusebenza abantu abasha, naveze ukuthi zevile ku-4 000 emikhakheni eyehlukene.Intsha ithi ifuna isabelomalo esinikwa yihhovisi layo esibhekelele izinhlelo, sibe ngu-R1 billion, njengoba ithi u-R9 million owabelwa ihhovisi labantu abasha awenele kwazise ziningi izinhlelo okumele zenziwe. Bafuna umasipala ubuyisele emsebenzini abantu abasha abebesebenza ohlelweni oluxhaswa wuMnyango wezeMisebenzi yoMphakathi olubizwa nge-Expanded Public Works Programme. Le ntsha yaphelelwa wumsebenzi ngoJulayi emva kokuthi umasipala umemezele ukuthi awunayo imali eyanele oyithola emnyangweni ukuxhasa lolu hlelo.Okunye abakhale ngakho, inkinga yamanzi ekhungethe lo masipala abafuna ilungiswe ngokushesha kuphinde kuqashwe abantu abasha ekutheni benze umsebenzi wokuhlola amamitha emizini yabantu, njengoba kunezikhalo ezithi umasipala ubiza imali ayithandayo ngokusetshenziswa kwamanzi, abekho abasebenzi abanele abahlola ukusetshenziswa kwayo. Bafuna umasipala ukuthi ulungise udaba lwamabhilidi abathi agweve nabofika.Le mashi beyihanjelwe uMengameli we-ANCYL, uMnuz Collen Malatji. Ekhuluma nabebehambele imashi, uMalatji unxuse intsha yale nhlangano ukuthi iqinisekise ukubuyela emagatsheni ayo iwavuselele njengoba imiphumela yokhetho langoMeyi lukhombisile ukuthi yehlelwe ukuthenjwa ngabantu."I-ANC ihlale ku-40% kuzwelonke. Esikhathini sokuphila kwethu, ihleli ku-14% KwaZulu-Natal. Kunzima, akusafani nayizolo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi indlela esenza ngayo izinto kumele ishintshe. Kumele sibuyele emuva silungise emagatsheni ethu, siyeke ukulwela ukuthi kukhethwa bani, ubani akakhethwa. I-MK ifikile, yathatha amavolontiya enu, yadla ukudla kwenu kwayiwa okhethweni yawina,” usho kanje.
LIZOPHAKAMISA esigungwini esiphezulu se-ANC ikomiti lezobuqotho kule nhlangano, ngezinyathelo okumele athathelwe zona uNgqongqoshe wezobuLungiswa nokuThuthukiswa koMthethosisekelo uNksz Thembi Simelane, ngezinsolo zokuthi wahlomula ebhange eselawa iVBS Mutual. Lokhu kushiwo nguNobhala jikelele we-ANC uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, otshele abezindaba ukuthi nakuba sebewutholile umbiko kuNksz Simelane, kodwa kusamele ayovela phambi kwekomiti lezobuqotho elizophakamisa esigungwini esiphezulu ngokumele kwenzeke ngaye.Usho kanje nje iyaqonga ingcindezi nokuxokozela ukuthi kumele ashenxea kulesi sikhundla kuze kuphothulwe uphenyo.Mayelana nesikhundla sakhe kuhulumeni, ulinde uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, ojutshwe nguyena kulo mnyango.UMbalula uthe bazozamukela iziphakamiso zesigungu esiphezulu."Yisona esizosho ukuthi kumele simyeke aqhubeke nempilo noma kwenziwe okuthile ngaye. Sizolandela yonke imigomo ekhona kanti ngasohlangothini lukahulumeni, umengameli ozonquma ngekusasa lakhe.”UNksz Simelane ugeqe amagula ePhalamende ngeledlule lapho ekhiphe ingonyuluka ngemali engu-R575 600, ayiboleka kuleli bhange. Uveze ukuthi le mali wayikhokha isinenzalo wathi akayibolekanga ebhange iVBS ngqo, kodwa wayiboleka enkampanini iGundo Wealth Solutions kanti wathenga ngayo indawo edayisa ikhofi eSandton.Ubalule ukuthi le nkampani yayisebenzisana nebhange iVBS njengoba uMasipala wasePolokwane ayeyimeya kuwona, wawunobudlelwano nale nkampani."Ngaboleka le mali ngoba ngangifuna ukuthi ngithole umholo uma sekuphele itoho kuhulumeni. Ngafuna iseluleko enkampanini iGundo ukuze ngifeze leli phupho, yangazisa ukuthi ingakwazi ukungisiza. Ngayikhokha le mali izikhawu ezintathu, ngayibuyisa nenzalo isingu-R800 000 ngayifaka kwi-akhawunti yeGundo, angikaze ngiboleke imali ngqo kwiVBS,” kusho uNksz Simelane.I-ActionSA ne-DA bamfuna ehlile esikhundleni uNksz Simelane.Umholi we-Action SA ePhalamende uMnuz Athol Trollip, uthe ubhalele uSomlomo wePhalamende noSihlalo wekomiti lezobuLungiswa befuna kube nophenyo oluzimele mayelana nokuthi ngeke angenele ophikweni lwezokushushisa iNPA, uma isishushisa abathinteka odabeni lweVBS, njengoba ingaphansi komnyango wakhe.Ufuna umengameli asheshe angenele amumise emsebenzini kuze kuphothulwe uphenyo.UNksz Simelane uthembise amalungu ePhalamende ukuthi ngeke angenele ekusebenzeni kweNPA kulolu daba.
I-ANC KwaZulu-Natal iphelile, kudingeka yakhiwe kabusha.Lokhu kushiwo nguSihlalo kazwelonke we-ANC, uMnuz Gwede Mantashe, othe kudingeka abunjwe kabusha amagatsha kulesi sifundazwe avithizwe wukufika kweqembu eliholwa nguMnuz Jacob Zuma, Umkhonto weSizwe.UMantashe okusho lokhu izolo ekhuluma ne-SABC ngaphandle kwendawo obekubanjelwe kuyona umhlangano wekomiti elibhekele ukusebenza kwansuku zonke eBoksburg, eGauteng, uthe i-MK iyivithizile i-ANC eKZN."Iphelile i-ANC eKZN, kudingeka yakhiwe kabusha. I-MK iqedile ngale nhlangano kulesiya sifundazwe. Abantu bacabanga ukuthi ukwakha kabusha kusho ukuhlakaza yonke into kanti akunjalo, kulula ukwakha uma kunesisekelo. Safunda isifundo ngokuhlakaza bonke ubuholi phambilini okuba nzima uma usuwakha kabusha. Yingakho kulula ukwakha nokuvuselela lapho kukhona okuthile khona kunokuqala phansi lapho kungekho lutho,” kusho uMantashe.Usho kanje sekunesikhathi ikhulunywa eyokuthi buzulelwa amanqe ubuholi bakulesi sifundazwe ngenxa yokwehlelwa ukwesekwa kwale nhlangano kuleli.UNobhala Jikelele, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, ekhuluma nabezindaba uthe bazobuyela kulesi sifundazwe ingakapheli inyanga njengoba kusona ukuzozizwela emagatsheni ngokwenzeka.Uveze ukuthi asikathathwa isinqumo ngokuthi kuzokwenzakalani ngobuholi bakulesi sifundazwe.UMbalula uthe bayazi kwenzakalani, wathi isigungu esiphezulu yisona esizokhipha umkhombandlela ngokumele kwenzeke."Sizoba nomhlangano wesigungu esiphezulu ekupheleni kwale nyanga. Abantu ababalelwa ku-600 000 bavotela i-ANC eKZN, abanye banquma ukungavoti. Ziningi izinto esingazenza eKZN kodwa asifuni kube sengathi kukhona esibabeka amabala ngokwehlwa kokwesekwa. Iqembu likaZuma lidale umonakalo. Amanye amalungu e-ANC abehobile kanti asebenza umshoshaphansi ne-MK okhethweni,” kusho uMbalula.Uthe ukuhlakaza ubuholi akusona kuphela isisombululo esikhona ngoba zikhona nezinye izindlela zokulungisa isimo ngaphandle kokuhlakaza ubuholi.Uveze ukuthi bahambele izifundazwe ezintathu okuyiKZN, Gauteng naseNorthern Cape, lapho le nhlangano yehlelwa ukwesekwa."Sizoya naseMpumalanga lapho sehlelwe khona ukwesekwa sisuka ku-70% saya ku-50%. Silungiselela ukhetho lohulumeni basekhaya osekusele cishe unyaka ngaphambi kokuthi lubanjwe,” kusho uMbalula.Uthe ukucishwa kukagesi, inkinga yamanzi, ubugebengu, ngezinye zezinto ezenze abantu bangayivotela i-ANC.
SEKUVELE ukuthi ukushoda kwemithi kashukela ikakhulukazi lowo obizwa nge-Ozempic, kuhlobene nokuthi abanye abantu bawusebenzisela ukuncipha emzimbeni.I-South African Health Products Regulatory Authority (Sahpra) ixwayise abenza lokhu ithi babeka impilo yabo engcupheni. Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi izinkampani ezikhiqiza imithi elwa ne-type 2 diabetes, ziveze ukuthi izoshoda kulo nyaka emhlabeni jikelele.UMnuz Deon Poovan obhekelele ukulawulwa kwemithi kwi-South African Health Products Regulation Authority (Sahpra), uthe ukushoda komuthi kashukela obizwa nge-Ozempic bathole ukuthi kuhlobene nokuncishiswa kwesisindo somzimba.Ekhuluma kwi-eNCA, uthe kunabantu abasebenzisa lo muthi ukuncipha ngenxa yezithako zawo ezikwazi ukulawula isisindo somzimba.Uthe kuyingozi ukusebenzisa i-Ozempic ukuncipha ngoba eNingizimu Afrika ayizange igunyazwe njengomuthi wokuncipha.Labo abasebenzisa i-Ozempic ukulwa noshukela kufanele bakhulume nodokotela babo ukuze banikezwe eminye imithi."I-Ozempic iyashoda emhlabeni jikelele. Okubi esesikutholile manje wukuthi kunabantu abayisebenzisela ukuncipha. Kuyingozi ukwenza lokhu ngoba njengenhlangano elawula ukusetshenziswa kwemithi asikaze sithi i-Ozempic ngeyokunciphisa umzimba,” kusho uPoovan.Ucele abafuna ukunciphisa umzimba ukuthi bakhulume nodokotela babo ngoba i-Ozempic ngeke ibasize kodwa babeka impilo yabo engcupheni. Uthe badinga ukukhuluma nezazi zempilo ezizobaluleka kahle."Ngisho umuntu onoshukela uyachazelwa ukuthi i-Ozempic izomsiza ngani. Ubuye akhulume nabasebenzi bezempilo okubalwa odokotela, ama-dietician nabanye ngokudla okufanele akudle. Uye achazelwe nangendlela osekufanele aphile ngayo njengoba ushukela obizwa nge-type 2 diabetes udinga umuntu adle ngendlela efanele, azivocavoce enze nokunye okuzomgcina ewumqemane.”Ubuye wakugcizelela ukuthi i-Ozempic wumuthi otholakala ngokuya kudokotela awuvele nje uwuthenge ungenayo incwadi ekugunyaza ukuba uwuthenge.
KUNXENXWA abantu ukuthi baqede indlala futhi badale amathuba omsebenzi ngokutshala amakhowe besebenzisa ubuchwepheshe baseChina obubizwa ngeJuncau Technology obenza impilo ibe lula.Lobu buchwepheshe basungulwa nguSolwazi Lin Zahanxi waseFujian Agriculture & Forestry University (FAFU) ngo-1986. Wazakhela utshani obungezinhlobo ezingu-49 bokutshala amakhowe adliwayo nasetshenziselwa ukwakha imithi.Kuthiwa lobu tshani obucishe bufane nomhlanga, buphinde busize ukuvikela inhlabathi ingaguguleki noma ubusike budliwe yimfuyo.ENYE inhlobo yotshani i-juncao Isithombe: Fanelesibonge BenguUMnuz Hui Lin ongumqondisi wezokuqeqesha eChina National Juncao Research Center of Juncao Technology, uthe iSilo esesebuza, uGoodwill Zwelithini kaBhekuzulu, wakugqugquzela ukusetshenziswa kwe-Juncao ngesikhathi evakashele esikhungweni sabo okuyinto ayenza kwaze kwaba yikathathu."Lobu buchwepheshe benza ukuthi kuhlale kunokudla okunomsoco futhi budala amathuba omsebenzi nokwenza imali. Amazwe amaningi asathuthuka ayabunaka manje. Sikhuluma nje, bangaphezu kwabayisishiyagalolunye omengameli bamazwe asebake bavakashela isikhungo futhi sebusabalale emazweni angu-107,” kusho uLin.Uthe isikhungo sivule amagatsha emazweni angu-13 okuhlanganisa nesiseCedara College of Agriculture eduze kwaseHowick.UMnuz Lungelo Dlamini osebenza ngezesayensi eMnyangweni wezoLimo KwaZulu-Natal, uthe i-Juncao yethulwa kubo ngo-2005, futhi bayisebenzisela ama-oyster mushroom.Uthe sebeqeqeshe abalimi abangaphezu kwenkulungwane. Uqhube wathi babheke ukungagcini ngokuyisebenzisela amakhowe kodwa nangezinye izindlela ngoba isimo sezulu sasesifundazweni iFujian, eChina, sicishe sifane nesaseKZN.ITSHE eliyisikhumbuzo sokuhambela kweSilo uGoodwill Zwelithini kaBhekuzulu, esikhungweni eChina National Juncao Research Center of Juncao Technology Isithombe: Fanelesibonge BenguUgqugquzele abalimi ukuthi bakubheke ukutshala amakhowe ngoba isidingo sawo siyakhula.Uthe abafuna ukuhlomula kumele baxhumane namahhovisi omnyango asezindaweni abaseduze nazo okuyilapho kunabeluleki babo khona okuyibo abazobasiza mahhala.ULin noDlamini bebekhuluma nezitshudeni ezingu-17 zaseDurban University of Technology (DUT) ezihambele eChina amasonto amabili ngenhloso yokuyofunda.Uhambo luhlelwe yiConfusius Institute (CI) yaseDUT neFafu futhi luzosongwa ngoLwesihlanu. Bahambele izindawo ezigcina ulwazi ukufunda kabanzi ngeChina; ikakhulukazi ngeFujian nendlela yesimanje okwenziwa ngazo izinto emikhakheni okubalwa kuyo eyezolimo, imfundo neminye.Umqondisi weDUT CI, uMnuz Frank Lin Wu uthe babheke ukuthuthukisa ukuqeqeshelwa amakhono futhi ubuchwepheshe ngenye yezinto abaqala ngazo. "Sibheke ukwakha inkundla ezozuzisa umphakathi ikakhulukazi abantu abasha nezingane ngokubafundisa iMandarin (ulimi lwaseChina) ukubasiza bathole amathuba ahlunene namakhono,” kusho yena.
KUFE nodabuka kulesi sifundazwe, empini yamaphoyisa nosolwa ngokuba wubhongoza ekuqhwageni ngodli imali yomphakathi nosomabhizinisi eMthatha, esifundazweni i-Eastern Cape, obezibiza ngenkosi eyaqokwa ngabantu.UMnuz Senzo Ndlovu waseRichmond, KwaZulu -Natal, kuthiwa ungomunye wabaqaphi ababili bakaMnuz Sakhumzi Dalinzolo Mareke (42), okuthiwa bobathathu bafe ujuqu bedubulana namaphoyisa.UNdlovu kuthiwa ubesebenza njengomqaphi kaMareke ngesikhathi betholana phezulu namaphoyisa okuthiwa abelandela umkhondo ngezenzo zabahlalise lubhojozi umphakathi nosomabhizinisi kuleya ndawo agasele emzini wakhe (uMareke).Umthombo weSolezwe ongathandanga ukudalulwa obusondelene noNdlovu, uthe ubesenesikhathi esebenza njengomqaphi, ngakho abakholwa ukuthi kukhona okumhlanganisa nalobu bugebengu ngaphandle kokuthi ubesebenza."Besingazi nokuthi umuntu amgadayo usolakala ezenzweni ezinje. USenzo bekuwumuntu nje ohloniphayo, wahamba nje kuwumuntu eyosebenza kusho ukuthi uthelwe amachaphazelo,” usho kanje.Kuthintwa udadewabo kamufi uNksz Amanda Ndlovu, ukuqinisekisile ukushona komfowabo kulesi sigameko wathi bewumndeni bacela ukungaphawuli ngalolu daba kwabezindaba kuze kube uyafihlwa.Ekhuluma nabezindaba izolo e-Eastern Cape uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa kuleli, uGeneral Fannie Masemola, uthe amaphoyisa anomsebenzi wokuvikela umphakathi kanye nawo."Lezi zigameko ezihlalise kabi umphakathi, azibikwa ngokwanele emaphoyiseni. Selokhu kuvulwe inombolo yamahhala yokumpimpa ngazo eMthatha emasontweni adlule, zisengu-1 180 kuphela izingcingo ezisangenile zibika ngalobu bugebengu. Kuzona, ezingu-688 ezabafona bedlala. Angu-33 amacala abikiwe mayelana nalobu bugebengu” usho kanje.Uthe amaphoyisa asebenza ngokuzinikela ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abathintekayo bayaboshwa, kwenzeke ubulungiswa. Selokhu kuqale lezi zigameko, bevile ku-10 abasolwa ezifundazweni ezehlukene asebebulewe bedubulana namaphoyisa okukholakala ukuthi bathinteka ekufuneni ngodli imali yomphakathi.Kukholakala ukuthi omunye umsolwa uzame ukuhlasela iphoyisa lophiko i-National Intervention Unit elalikhona kudutshulwa uMareke nabaqaphi bakhe, kodwa wagcina eboshiwe.
KUHLUKENE imibono kumalungu omphakathi waseNhlonga, ku-ward 13 ngaphansi kukaMasipala waseMsinga, ngesakhiwo esiyihholo sika-R480 000, okuthiwa lakhelwa inkosazana yamanzi osebeni lomfula wumasipala, emva kwesibonakaliso somthandazi.Leli hholo kuthiwa akuvumelekile ukuthi lisetshenziswe yinoma wubani ukugwema ulaka lwenkosazana yasemanzini. Livulwa uma kukhona umthandazi kuphela ezobamba inkonzo khona. Amanye amalungu omphakathi akholwa wukuthi ukwakhiwa kwalo kwehlisa izingozi nokufa kwabantu ababefela kulesi siziba njengoba bekholwa ukuthi bekuwulaka lwayo. Abaphikisana nalokho, bagxeka umasipala ngokuchitha imali ngabakubiza ngenkoleloze yabathile ekubeni intuthuko igqoza endaweni.Elinye ilungu lomphakathi eselikhulile, lilandisa ekhasini lika-Ayanda Msweli kwi-You Tube, lithe izigameko zokufa kwabantu esizibeni okukholakala ukuthi ihlala kuso, bezibhilitile phambilini, ngaphambi kokulandwa komthandazi okwazi ukukhuluma nayo okuwuyena owaveza ukuthi ifuna ukwakhelwa."Kwathi uma abesifazane beyibona ngelinye ilanga babikela amadoda ayengayikholwa ukuthi ikhona. Amabili agijima eyobheka esizibeni, omunye wangena kuso, kwaba ukuphela kwakhe bamkhipha esethule. Kwesinye isikhathi izikebhe zabelungu uma bentweza, bezifika zicishe kulesi siziba, baze banikele ngemali emhlophe kuyima bekwazi ukudlula, okuyizimpawu zokuthi bekukhona okukhona kusona,” usho kanje.Uthe umphakathi wasukuma wathungatha umthandazi okwazi ukukhuluma nayo, okuyilapho olande khona uMnuz Felize Dladla waseGreytown, eMatimalo, okuwuyena owaveza ukuthi ithi ifuna ukwakhelwa indlu yayo.UMNUZ Felize Dladla okuthiwa wumthandazi okwazi ukuxoxa nenkosazana eyamyalela ukuthi yakhelwe indlu Isithombe: SUTHUNYELWEEkhuluma neSolezwe, uDladla uthe emva kokuthi umphakathi umcelile, inkosazana imtshele ukuthi ifuna umphakathi uyakhele indlu eyisitezi. Kuthiwa umphakathi uhlanganise imali, yaqala ukwakhiwa, kodwa yona (inkosazane) yayibhidliza okuvele ukuthi yayidinwe ukwakhiwa kwayo ngabantu besifazane kanti yayifunwa ukwakhelwa ngamadoda kuphela. Umphakathi kuthiwa ufake isicelo kumasipala, wagunyaza ukuthi yakhiwe.UMnuz Mletheni Ndlovu oyikhansela kule ndawo oseke waba yimeya kulo masipala, uthe nguye owafaka isicelo ngokuthunywa wumphakathi"Bengisayikhansela ngesikhathi umphakathi uphakamisa ukuthi ucela umasipala uwusize wakhele inkosazane indlu. Ngesikhathi ngifaka isicelo, umasipala uthe akusetshenziswe isabelomali sewadi ukwakha indlu ngoba awunayo imali eyanele. Sigcine sibona kungcono ukuthi sakhe esahholo ngoba eyisitezi yayizobiza kakhulu. Sisebenzise u-R480 000 wesabelomali sonyakamali ababili ukwenza lo msebenzi,” usho kanje.Uveze ukuthi inkosazana ayihlali kuleli hholo, kodwa lisetshenziswa kuphela uma kunemicimbi eqondene nayo noma kukhona abasuke befuna ukuzonikela.Imvunge kwamanye amalungu omphakathi ivukuzwe yesinye isibonakaliso sesibili somthandazi (uDladla) njengoba kuvele ukuthi ifuna umphakathi wenzele izingane zayo umemulo. Emhlanganweni obuyizolo kulo leli hholo lenkosazane, kuthiwa kuvunyelwene ngokuthi umuzi nomuzi ukhokhe u-R100 ukuze kuthengwe inkomo yokwenza lo mcimbi.Ilungu lomphakathi elikhulume neSolezwe elingelinye langahambisani nezibonakaliso zomthandazi ngenkosazana, lithe lidumele ngemali eyachithwa umasipala."Kuyadumaza ukuthi umasipala ukholelwa kokushiwo umuntu kungenabo ubufakazi. Izingane zethu ziwela kanzima uma ziya esikoleni, kodwa kunemali ekhishelwa ukwakha izinto ezingakaze zibonwe wumphakathi kodwa okuthiwa zabonwa abathile,” usho anje.Amanye amalungu omphakathi avumile ukuthi awakaze ayibone inkosazana kodwa kule ndawo akuvumelekile ukuwasha esizibeni ngoMgqibelo nokuchitha amanzi obuwasha ngawo kusona ngoba kuyayithukuthelisa.
IQEMBU Umkhonto weSizwe lithi ngeke limsuse ohola leli qembu ePhalamende uDkt John Hlophe, ekubeni yilungu lohlaka olululeka umengameli ngezobulungiswa.Okhulumela leli qembu uMnuz Nhlamulo Ndhlela, uthe bazolwa kuze kube sekugcineni nezinhlangano ezifuna kukhishwe uHlophe kwi-Judiciary Services Commission, ngoba unamava kwezobulungiswa."Ngeke sizwe ngezinye izinhlangano ukuthi ubani okumele simjube, nokungamele. Noma kuthiwa inkantolo iyasichitha siyoqhubeka nomsebenzi wethu, uHlophe akayi ndawo.” Usho lokhu nje inkantolo enkulu yaseWestern Cape ayizange isikhiphe isinqumovecaleni elifakwe yi-DA nezinhlangano ezehlukene ezifuna kuchithwe uHlophe, kwi-JSC.I-JSC iphinde iphakamise okumele babe ngamajaji nezimantshi kuleli. Amajaji abelalele leli cala, athe azokhipha isinqumo maduzane.Kuqalwe ngoLwesine ukudingidwa kwalolu daba kule nkantolo njengoba lezi zinhlangano okuyi-Freedom Under Law ne-Corruption Watch, zifuna uHlophe achithwe kwi-JSC.I-AfriForum iya eNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo ukuyophikisana nalesi sinyathelo sePhalamende sokufaka uHlophe kwi-JSC. U-Adv Thabani Masuku SC omele uHlophe, unxuse inkantolo ukuthi isichithe lesi sicelo esiphuthumayo sokuthi uHlophe angabi yingxenye yeJSC.Uthe kumele lezi zinhlangano zikhokhe nezindleko kuleli cala ngoba yizona ezihudulele uHlophe enkantolo, noma kuthiwa uyawina noma uyachithwa. "Uma kukhishwa uHlophe kwi-JSC kuyosho ukumnqinda umsebenzi wakhe wasePhalamende. I-DA isasho into eyodwa emaphepheni ayo mayelana nokungamfuni uHlophe okuyinto ehlulekile ukuyilwa ePhalamende,” kusho uMasuku.Uthe ukuze uHlophe abe yilungu le-JSC kudingeka abe yilungu lePhalamende kuphela, akukho okunye.Ummeli weMK, u-Adv Dali Mpofu, ukhale nge-DA wathi ifuna izinkantolo zinqumele iPhalamende indlela okumele lisebenze ngayo.Uthe akumele izinkantolo zisetshenziselwe ukuphendula izinqumo ezithathwe yiPhalamende."Lokhu okwenzeka la enkantolo kuyimizamo zokuphinde zingcwabe uHlophe, ngoba emnyama. UHlophe waphundlwa izimendlela zokuba yijaji, ngakho lesi sicelo salezi zinhlangano siyimizamo yokuthi aphinde acindezelwe futhi,” kusho uMpofu.Uthe i-DA kwakumele ilwe ukuphakanyiswa kukaHlophe njengelungu lePhalamende okuyinto leli qembu elingakwenzanga.Uchithe ukuthi iJSC iyona eqoka amajaji, wathi lowo msebenzi okamengameli wezwe.
INKAMPANI ephehla ugesi kuleli ithi seyonge u-R12 billion ebizothenga ngawo udizili ukube inkinga kagesi obucima umlibe ibisaqhubeka.Lezi zindaba zivezwe ngoLwesihlanu, eGoli, nguNksz Daphe Mokwena okhulumela i-Eskom, othe sekuphele izinsuku eziwu-163 ugesi wagcina ukunqamuka okuyisimo esagcina ukubonakala ngo-2018.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi kusukela ngoMashi 26, ugesi awukaze unqamuke yize ubudingeka kakhulu ebusika.Selokhu kwaqala izinkinga zikagesi, i-Eskom ibiye isebenzise udizili uma imishini ephehla ugesi ngamalahle inenkinga, lokhu bekwenzelwa ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izwe alibi mnyama bhuqe.UNksz Mokwena uveze ukuthi ngoJulayi 9, ugesi obudingeka ezweni uwu-33 385MW kodwa akuzange kube nesidingo sokuwunqamula ngenhloso yokuwonga ngenxa yokuthi imishini iwuphehla kahle.Uthe kulo nyaka imali esisebenzile ngodizili wu-R3.62 billion kusukela ngo-Ephreli 1 kuze kube wu-Septhemba 5. Ngonyaka odlule imali eyayisisebenzile ukuthenga udizili ngesikhathi esifanayo iwu-R15.74 billion.Uveze ukuthi zihamba kahle izinhlelo zokulungisa iziphehli zikahgesi futhi iziteshi zabo zikhiqiza ugesi owu-66% nangaphezulu. Phakathi kweziteshi ezenza kahle kubalwa iKusile, Grootvlei, Kendal, Lethabo neMatla.Njengamanje i-Eskom iphehla ugesi owu-30 643MW ngosuku kanti ngezikhathi zantambama abantu bavamise ukusebenzisa ugesi owu-26 345MW.I-Eskom imemezele ukuthi ayilindele ukuthi kunqamuke ugesi ehlobo okuyisikhathi esisukela ku-Septhemba kuze kube wukuphela kukaMashi wonyaka ozayo.Yize ugesi ungasanqamuki kodwa kwezinye izindawo usacima ngenxa yokuthi kufanele kuvikelwe ama-transformer ikakhulukazi ezindaweni okuxhunywe kuwo ugesi wezinyokanyoka.UNksz Mokwena ucele abantu ukuthi bagade inqgalasizinda kagesi, uma bebona okungahambi kahle bashayele i-Eskom ku-0800 112 722 noma ku-WhatsApp 081 333 3323.
SICHITHWE nezindleko isicelo esiphuthumayo samalungu eqembu Umkhonto weSizwe, axoshwe ePhalamende yileli qembu.La malungu angu-10 aya enkantolo enkulu yaseWestern Cape, efuna kumiswe ukufungiswa kwamalungu amasha ezikhundleni zawo.Abefuna kubuyekezwe nendlela axoshwe ngayo kuleli qembu njengoba athola izincwadi ezivela ePhalamende, ziwazisa ngokuthi buhoxisiwe ubulungu bawo yi-MK.Esinqumweni esikhishwe yinkantolo ngoMsombuluko, kuvele ukuthi isicelo esiphuthumayo sala malungu sichithwe nezindleko.La malungu ayekhale ngokuthi uma echithwa kuzodingeka aphume ezindlini zePhalamende lapho eqube khona.Abekhala ngokuthi awazange anikwe izizathu zokuhoxiswa kobulungu bawo.Asola umholi waleli qembu, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, ngokuba undlovukayiphikiswa ngokumane awaxoshe noma yikanjani kungazange kuhlale ngisho isigcawu sokuqondisa kwawo ubugwegwe.Phambilini, uZuma ubelokhu ekuveza ukuthi bazolokhu bebahosha labo abangafanele ukuba sePhalamende.Leli qembu lakuveza ukuthi la malungu ayazisiwe ngesikhathi sokufungiswa ukuthi asazosuswa ezikhundleni ngoba kukhona abangena ngomkhoshosho ohlwini lwabantu ababezojutshwa yileli qembu ePhalamende.Esewonke amalungu axoshwa yi-MK ePhalamende angu-18.
ISILO samaBandla uMisuZulu kaZwelithini, sithi size sisole ukuthi kukhona abalaya sona uma sibheka imbedumehlwana yobugebengu esifundazweni KwaZulu-Natal ezinsukwini zokubusa kwaso. ISilo sisho kanje enkulumweni yaso eMkhosini woMhlanga esigodlweni eMachobeni ngempelasonto lapho sivule isifuba ngevuso laso ngezehlakalo zokubulawa kwabantu, ukudlwengulwa kwabesifazane nezingane kanjalo nokuqhuma kwesibhamu umlibe esifundazweni. IMbube ithe okuyikhathaza kakhulu ngukuthi lesi sifundazwe yisona esihamba phambili ngalezi zinto.Sikhuze lesi sihlava sathi sekwanele, akwenziwe okuthile ngoba yisona abayogcina sebesikhomba ngomunwe ukuthi isimo saphuma esandleni ngesikhathi siseSihlalweni."Angibulali ubuthongo. Eyokubulawa kwabantu, ukudlwengulwa kwabesifazane nezingane, kanjalo nokuqhuma kwesibhamu esifundazweni sakithi. Angazi noma ngalezi zehlakalo kuyalwa mina yini,” kusho iSilo.IZINTOMBI ziphethe umhlanga eMachobeni UMkhosi obuseMachobeni, eNgwavuma, wandulela omkhulu ozoba ngempelasonto KwaNongoma.ISilo sithe sizohlanganisa amakhanda noNdunankulu waso uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, noNdunankulu wesifundazwe uMnuz Thami Ntuli, ngezehlakalo zobugebengu.ISILO samukela umhlanga ngempelasonto Izithombe: KZNGOV"Kumele siyixoxe le ndaba ngoba iyangikhathaza. Umkhuzi wamaPhoyisa esifundazweni, ubaba uMkhwanazi (Lt-Gen Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi), usebenza ngokuzikhandla elwa nobugebengu,” kusho iMbube.UMPHATHISWA wezeMidlalo, ubuCiko namaSiko KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Mntomuhle Khawula, uNdunankulu kaZulu uMfundisi Thulasizwe Buthelezi neMbube emkhosini womhlanga obuseMachobeni, ngempelasonto INgonyama ithe lesi sifundazwe kumele sidume ngezinto ezinhle."Kungani nje singadumi ngokuthi sihamba phambili ngezolimo? Noma ngabe siduma ngokuthi sihamba phambili kwezemfundo, hhayi ngobugebengu.” Sithe okugujwa kakhulu kulo nyaka ngukuphela kweminyaka engu-40 ukhona lo mkhosi. "Ngiyafisa ukuthi niqhubeke nibambisane nami njengoba benibambisene kahle noMdlokombane. Lo mkhosi namanje usekhona, okusho khona ukuthi izinhlanhla zilokhu zikhona,” kusho iMbube. UNtuli uthe ezinsukwini ezimbalwa uzobe eqeda izinsuku eziyikhulu esihlalweni sobuNdunankulu.Uthe bafike kuhulumeni imali ingekho, kanjalo lesi sifundazwe singaphansi kwesimo esibucayi. IZINTOMBI ziphethe umhlanga "Sifice izinga lobugebengu liphezulu okubalwa nokubulawa kwamakhosi nezingane. Anginamahloni Silo ukuthi uhulumeni wakho ubukhosi oyinhloko yabo buyingxenye yesixazululo. Ubugebengu sibufice budlangile ngaphakathi nangaphandle kukahulumeni. Sesiqalile ukubuphunga ngenhloso yokubuqeda.”Uthe baqale umkhankaso wokukhuculula abokufika kuleli abakuleli ngokungekho emthethweni oqale eThekwini.Uthe ngeke bayeke isifundazwe sibuswe yizigebengu.Uncome izintombi ebezihambele uMhlanga athe izibalo zazo zikhula minyaka yonke.ISILO MisuZulu kaZwelithini"Njengohulumeni weSilo, siyazibophezela ekutheni yonke le minyaka ezayo lo mkhosi woMhlanga sizoweseka. Namuhla uneminyaka engama-40 sizowuphakamisa ufike kweminye iminyaka engu-40.”
UNDUNANKULU waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, uthe akafuni ukuphinde ababone abokufika abakuleli ngokungemthetho emafemini aKwaSithebe, eMandeni.UNtuli usho kanje ngoLwesihlanu, kule ndawo ngesikhathi ehambele amafemu ehlukene, eyohlola izimo zokusebenza kuwona.Ekhuluma nezisebenzi ezivele zaqoqana eduze kwakhe, zimbona etheleka kungazelelwe namaphoyisa, abezoMnyango weziSebenzi, uMnyango wezaseKhaya nobuholi bendawo, uthe udaba lwabokufika abangenamaphepha abagunyaza ukuba kuleli, akafuni ukuphinde ababone kule femu abeyihambele, nakwamanye asendaweni."Ngiyezwa ukuthi nithi bazongena (emsebenzini) ebusuku (abokufika). Angithi amaphoyisa akhona? Azophinde abuye nasebusuku,” kusho uNtuli.Uthe lolu hlelo lwangoLwesihlanu, luzoqhubeka nangezinye izinsuku, ngisho engasekho yena, wathi abakwasidlodlo behambisana nobuholi bendawo bazolokhu beya njalo emafeni ukuyobheka ukuthi iyaqhubeka yini indaba yokuqasha abantu bakwamanye amazwe abakuleli ngokungemthetho.Uthe basembhidlangweni wokuhambela wonke amafemu esifundazweni ukubheka ukuthi aqashe abantu okufanele baqashwe yini.UNDUNANKULU waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, ekhuluma ngokuqashwa kwabokufika abangenazo izimvume zokuba kuleli kwenye yamafemu KwaSithebe, eMandeni Isithombe: SITHUNYELWE "Sizobheka nokuthi izimo zokusebenza zisezingeni yini. Sibheke ukuthi imithetho yamaholo iyalandelwa yini,” kusho uNtuli.Uqhube wathi uhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal noMnyango wezaseKhaya bazoqhubeka babambisane ukuthi lolu hlelo abaluqalile luqhubeke."Asifuni kube khona abantu okuzodlalwa ngabo. Sizozilandelela izimo enisebenza ngaphansi kwazo ngoba baningi abantu bakule ndawo abangaqashiwe, abafuna umsebenzi,” usho kanje.UNDUNANKULU waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, ekhuluma ngokuqashwa kwabokufika abangenazo izimvume zokuba kuleli kwenye yamafemu KwaSithebe, eMandeni Isithombe: SITHUNYELWE Wethembise ukuthi uzobuyela emumva ayohlela ithimba elizobuya lizohlala phansi (nezisebenzi), lithathe zonke izikhalo zazo ukuze abone ukuthi zixazululwa kanjani."Namuhla bengizobheka nje abokufika abangenawo amaphepha okuthiwa bagcwele la,” kusho uNtuli.Izisebenzi zizwakalise ukungeneliseki ngesikhathi uNtuli ethi kufanele zibike ukungaphatheki kahle kwazo eMnyangweni wezeziSebenzi, zathi uyagwazelwa, awuzithatheli phezulu izikhalazo zazo.
SIPHULUKUNDLELE amaphoyisa asala ebambe ophaca, isiboshwa okuthiwa sishiye imantshi nezikhonzi zenkantolo zibambe ongezansi sijomba ebhokisini labasolwa emva komyalelo wokuthi sibuyiselwe ekhulukuthu.UMnuz Ntuthuko Nxumalo (30), obevele okokuqala eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseGlencoe, ebhekene necala lokweba, kuthiwa ushiye amaphoyisa nonogada behlanza udende ngesikhathi ecela empunzini engena ehlathini, eshiya enkantolo ophaca abebacathulele. Ngesikhathi sokushicelela, Isolezwe lithole ngomthombo walo ukuthi ubesagcwelwe amathafa. Lo mthombo obukhona enkantolo ngesikhathi kwenzeka lesi sigameko, uthe imantshi beyisanda kukhipha isinqumo sokuthi abuyiselwe ngaphakathi kwazise ubevela okokuqala ngecala lokuntshontsha."Imantshi ithe iqeda nje ukumtshela ukuthi icala lakhe liyahlehla, uzogqunywa esitokisini kuze kube wuSepthemba 17, waphulukundlela wadla phansi ephuma ngomnyango wenkantolo. Bekukhona amaphoyisa amabili asenkantolo nonogada, bazama ukumbamba kodwa wajomba ucingo wangena ehlathini, kwaba ukunyamalala kwakhe,” usho kanje.Uthe umsolwa uvela nje, ubevele edonsa isigwebo esithile esilengisiwe ngawo amacala okuntshontsha angaxhumene naleli abevele ngalo enkantolo, njengoba ayetholwe enecala ezinyangeni ezimbalwa ezedlule, wagwetshwa. Kuthiwa amaphoyisa amabili azamile ukumshekelela kangangoba elinye lize ladubula ngenhloso yokumfaka amanzi emadolweni, kodwa kwanhlanga zimuka nomoya, waqhubeka nokubaleka.Kushaye isikhathi sokushicilela, okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uColonel Robert Netshiunda engakayiphenduli imibuzo athunyelwe yona ukuqinisekisa lesi sigameko.
UVUTHA engabaselwe owesilisa waKwaMaphumulo osola uMfundisi akhonza naye ngokubaleka nomkakhe.UMnuz Sfiso Gumbi (44) usola uMfu Edward Khumalo (47) webandla iGod’s Christian ngokuthi ubaleke nomkakhe, uNkk Nomusa Gumbi (37). Leli bandla linesizinda KwaMaphumulo.Uma elandisa uGumbi, uthi umkakhe ubeye eGoli, kukhona umhlangano webandla abekuwona njengoba enesikhundla ebandleni.Uthi kumxakile ukubuya kwabanye ebebeseGoli kodwa lutho umkakhe."Ngibe sengimshayela ucingo ngimbuza umkami ukuthi kanti kwenzakalani? Umane wangiphendula ngokuthi angikhulume noMfundisi. Ngimane ngaxakeka ukuthi uchaza ukuthini," echaza.Kodwa uthi umshayelile ucingo uMfundisi wambuza ukuthi kungani umkakhe engakabuyi.Uthi impendulo kaMfundisi imshiye ebhocobele."Umane waqala ngokuxolisa, wase engehla ngaphezulu engitshela ukuthi uyathandana nomkami. Wathi uyaxolisa ngokungizwisa ubuhlungu kodwa impela sebeyathandana," kusho yena.Uthi eseshayela umkakhe ucingo okwesibili akabange esalubamba nhlobo.Kuvela ukuthi uMfundisi washonelwa ngumkakhe ngo-2015 engozini yemoto.Isolezwe Ngempelasonto lishayele ucingo uNkk Gumbi, wathi akaqondi ukuthi kwenzakalani kodwa uzizwa enomuzwa wothando olujulile lukaMfundisi, wathi kodwa akathandi ukukhuluma lolu daba nabantu angabazi. Uthe yena noMfundisi bahlela ukubuyela eThekwini, kuxoxwe noMnuz Gumbi ukuze kutholakale isixazululo salolu daba.Eshayelwa ucingo uMfundisi, uthe izindaba zakhe azidingi ukunekelwa izwe.Ilungu lebandla elicele ukuba kugodlwe igama lalo lithe bakhathazekile kakhulu njengoba sekuphele amasonto amabili uMfundisi engalubhadi enkonzweni.Lithe kuduma amakhanda kubona njengoba bengaqondi ukuthi ngempela kwenzekani."Sizwa kuthiwa uMfundisi wethu ubaleke nomfazi womuntu. Asazi ngoba nathi sididekile. Uma simshayela ucingo uMfundisi akalubambi. Asazi ukuthi ngempela kuqhubekani, '’ lisho kanje ilungu likhulumela phansi.Lithe amalungu ebandla asabisa ngokuliduba ibandla uma kuya ngokuthi lolu daba luyiqiniso.
BAKHATHAZEKILE abazali babafundi basesikoleni i-Ekwazini High, eMlaza, ngenxa yamabhoklolo ahlukumeza abanye abafundi.Esigamekweni sakamuva esigcine sidlule nomphefumulo womunye wabafundi u-Awande Mdabe (20) obenza u-matric, kusolakala ukuthi uklinywe womunye wamabhoklolo ngothayi endlini yangasese khona esikoleni ngesonto eledlule.UNksz Slindile Mdabe ongumamncane ka-Awande ekhuluma neSolezwe, uthe baphatheke kabi ngalesi senzo."Ngikhala ngobudedengu bothisha ngoba abayihambisanga ingane esibhedlela futhi abawashayelanga amaphoyisa. Njengabazali baze basazisa ngo-2 ntambama kodwa ingane ibe ilimale ekuseni. Izimoto zothisha bezikhona, okwenze ngazibuza ukuthi yini ndaba bengayihambisanga ingane?” kusho uNksz Mdabe.Uthe okumphatha kabuhlungu kunakho konke ukuthi kuthiwa lo mfundi oklinye umufi akukona okokuqala ekwenza lokho."Ngibabuzile ukuthi yini ndaba besamgcinile lo mfundi, bathi uMnyango wezeMfundo awuvumi ukuthi umfundi axoshwe esikoleni. Umphakathi nawo ubukhalaza ngoba ziningi izigameko zenzeka njengoba kwesinye isehlakalo abafundi bagwazana,” usho kanje.Uthe mhlawumbe ezinye zezizathu ezenze ukuthi umufi abulawe yingoba amazinyo angaphambili ubengenawo njengoba ashayiswa yimoto, manje izingane bezimgcona ngakho lokho. Uthe nasekhaya umufi wabika ukuthi kukhona umfundi omhlukumezayo esikoleni, kodwa banganaka.Oyilungu lesigungu esangamele isikole, uNkk Hayzel Joyisa, ekhuluma neSolezwe, uthe abafundi bathukile."Abafundi abathusiwe yisigameko lesi esenzekile, kodwa bathuswe yiqulu labantu ebelimemeza esangweni lesikole, lithi lifuna uthishomkhulu futhi lisabisa ngokushisa isikole. Belithi uthishomkhulu ubengayihambisi ngani ingane esibhedlela? Akekho owayebona ukuthi umfana ulimele kakhulu ngoba wayelokhu ekhuluma ethi kubuhlungu ikhanda,” kusho uNkk Joyisa.Uthe njengabazali baphatheke kabi. "Siphoxekile yilesi senzo ngoba asikwazi ngisho nokulala. Uthishomkhulu namalungu ekomiti bahambile baya emndenini kamufi beyobhonga emswaneni nomndeni womfana owenze lesi sigameko nawo uhambile wayoxolisa,” usho kanje Uqhube wathi izingane ziyaseshwa esangweni lesikole uma zifika ekuseni kubhekwa izikhali noma ezinye izinto ezingalungile besizwa yiforamu namanye amalungu esigungu esangamele isikole.Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo, KwaZulu-Natal, uSihle Mlotshwa, uthe balinde umbiko ophelele ovela emahhovisi esifunda mayelana nalolu daba.Uqhube wathi ukushaya kuyicala lobugebengu, ezinkantolo isiqhwaga singathweswa icala."Isikole kufanele sisebenzise umyalelo wekhodi yaso yokuziphatha. Akulungile ukuthi umfundi akakwazi ukuxoshwa futhi asinawo umthetho othi othisha bangakwazi ukuyisa abafundi esibhedlela,” ubeke kanje.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, ukuqinisekisile ukuboshwa komsolwa."Amaphoyisa aseMlaza, abophe umsolwa oneminyaka engu-21 ubudala kulandela isigameko sokushona komfundi oneminyka engu-20 esikoleni esigcemeni sakwa-G eMlaza, ngoLwesihlanu olwedlule. Umsolwa uvele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMlaza ngoMsombuluko, Septhemba 2, 2024. Imibiko iveza ukuthi umsolwa waklinya futhi washaya isisulu ngemuva kwengxabano,” kusho uCol Netshiunda.
KUZOKONGEZWA elinye icala lokudlwengula abe ngu-19 kowesilisa osolwa ngokunukubeza abesifazane elokishni eMlaza, eThekwini.UKhethani Khuboni (31) uvele okwesibili eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMlaza. Bekulindeleke ukuthi afake isicelo sebheyili kodwa kwahlehliselwa uSepthemba 19.Isolezwe lihoshe ukuthi uKhuboni uzophinde athweswe amacala amabili okuphanga amaselula abagilwa okusolakala ukuthi wakwenza eseqede ukubadlwengula.Izolo, enkantolo uKhuboni ulumane indlebe nommeli weLegal Aid obe esetshela inkantolo abebekhuluma ngakho.UKhuboni ukhale ngokuthi kukhona umuntu osebenzisa umakhalekhukhwini wakhe njengoba yena egqunywe ezitokisini.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi ngesikhathi eboshwa entathakusa ngoLwesbili lwangesonto eledlule, amaphoyisa ashaqa neselula yakhe.Leyo selula isiyizibithi, kusolakala ukuthi iyingxenye yophenyo lwamaphoyisa.UKhuboni ufake isicelo sokuthi alethele inkantolo ubufakazi akholelwa wukuthi bungase bumkhiphe phambili kodwa inkantolo ithe iyosilalela isicelo sakhe uma esefaka isicelo sebheyili emasontweni amabili ezayo.Lo wesilisa ubekade egqoke izimpahla ezifanayo neyayikade ezigqoke ngesonto eledlule ivela enkantolo.Umsolwa ubebukeka ezikhululekele ngesikhathi efaswe umlenze owodwa wakwesokunxele ngozankosi wahlanganiswa nowesokudla ungomunye umsolwa obeze kwelinye icala kule nkantolo.Okuqaphelekile ukuthi ubekade engekho enkantolo owesifazane okuthiwa uthandana noKhuboni owayekhona ngesonto eledlule.Lo wesifazane kusolakala ukuthi wayengazi ukuthi uKhuboni umshiya endlini ayogila imigilingwane abuye ahlale naye kube ngathi akwenzekanga lutho.Lamuzwa Isolezwe ethi ufuna ukubuyela emakhaya ngoba ayikho into asazoyihlalela endlini esehostela okwaboshelwa khona uKhuboni. Phambilini, kuvele ukuthi uKhuboni unezingane ezimbili futhi ushadelwe, inkosikazi yakhe isemakhaya eXobho.UMbuso uthi icala lokuqala lenzeka ngoDisemba 11, 2021. Usola uKhuboni ngokudlwengula abesifazane ababili ngosuku olulodwa ngoDisemba ngonyaka odlule.UKhuboni usolwa ngokudlwengula abesifazane abathathu ngenyanga edlule kanti kuthiwa wadlwengula oyedwa ngenyanga efanayo ngonyaka odlule.
IZIHLATHI zivakashela izindlebe kubasebenzi bomasipala emuva kokusayinwa kwesivumelwano esizobanyusela amaholo ngo-6%.Lesi sivumelwano seminyaka emihlanu kulindeleke ukuthi silethe uzinzo komasipala abawu-257 abangaphansi kwe-South African Local Government Association (Salga).UNobhala Jikelele we-South African Municipal Workers Union (Samwu), uMnuz Dumisane Magagula, uthe lesi sivumelwano sizokhuphula amaholo abasebenzi abawu-300 000 abaqashwe komasipala."Emuva kwezingxoxo ebezinzima sikwazile ukutholela abasebenzi u-6%. Lokhu kusho ukuthi imali izonyuka ngo-4.5% kusukela ngoJulayi 1 walo nyaka bese kunezezelwa u-1.5% ngoMashi wonyaka ozayo. Yisivumelwano seminyaka emihlanu esizoqinisekisa ukuthi umthwalo uyehla emahlombe abasebenzi njengoba impilo ibiza.”Uveze ukuthi abasebenzi abahola u-R22 000 nangaphansi, abangenaso isibonelelo sezindlu bazothola u-R2 000 ozokhokhwa kunyaka wokuqala wesivumelwano.Uthe bazoqhubeka benze uphenyo ukuthi abasebenzi abangasitholi isibonelelo sezindlu bangalekelelwa kanjani. Lolu phenyo luzophothulwa ngoMashi wonyaka ozayo."Isivumelwano seminyaka emihlanu sizoqinisekisa ukuthi kunozinzo komasipala ngoba abasebenzi ngeke baphoqeleke ukuthi bayokhuluma indaba yamaholo ngenxa yezivumelwano zeminyaka embalwa. Kuzosiza omasipala ukuba bathumele izidingo kubantu,” kusho uMagagula.ISalga ikuqinisekisile ukuthi amaholo anyuswe ngo-6% ezingxoxweni ebezenganyelwe yiSouth African Local Government Bargaining Council.Kulezi zingxoxo abasebenzi bebemelwe yiSamwu ne-Independent Municipal and Allied Trade Union (Imatu).Izingxoxo ziqale ngoJulayi 15.I-Imatu nayo ithe isivumelwano sizoletha uzinzo komasipala kanti yize isivumelwano sisayinwe ngoLwesihlanu kodwa amaholo azonyuka kusukela ngoJulayi nonyaka.
UPHUME esibhedlela waqonda esitokisini owesilisa odle ushevu nengane yakhe egcine ishonile.Lokhu kwenzeka ngo-Agasti 3, 2024, endaweni yaseKanana, ngaseKlerksdorp, eNorth West.Kubikwa ukuthi lo mlisa waba nengxabano nentombi yakhe engumama wezingane zakhe wafuna ngodli izingane zakhe ngayizolo.Yize umama wezingane waqale wanqaba nazo, wagcina esevuma, wayalela umalume wezingane ukuthi ahambe nazo."Uyise wezingane wamukela izingane watshela umalume wazo ukuthi akahambe, umalume uhambe neyodwa ingane eneminyaka emine zasala ezimbili,” kusho okhulumela amaphoyisa aseNorth West.Lo mlisa akapholisanga maseko, washayela ucingo unina wezingane emtshela izinhlelo zakhe zokuphuza ushevu nalezi zingane. Kwathi kusenjalo lo wesifazane wathola ucingo oluvela kugogo wezingane emtshela ukuthi basendleleni eya esibhedlela ngenxa yomonakalo odalwe uyise wezingane.Kuvela ukuthi ingane eneminyaka esisishiyagalombili yasinda ngoba yanqaba ukuphuza ushevu, kanti le encane yona yayisesimweni esibucayi kakhulu yagcina ishonela esibhedlela. Umsolwa naye wasinda wakhululwa esibhedlela ngoLwesine, ngoSepthemba 4, kanti kuzokuba wusuku lokuboshwa kwakhe ngecala lokubulala.
UTHEMBISE ukungenela alungise isimo aphinde aqede nenkohlakalo ohlelweni lokuphakelwa kwabafundi ezikoleni zaKwaZulu-Natal uNgqongqoshe weMfundo eyisiSekelo uNksz Siviwe Gwarube.UNksz Gwarube uthe ukhathazekile ngezinkinga ezibhekene nalolu hlelo eKZN njengoba kunezinkinga angenela kuzona, ngokungakhokhelwa ngesikhathi kwabahambisa ukudla ezikoleni.Uthe yingakho eze wamisa nse nokukhishwa kwethenda kaR9.8 billion, yokuphakela izikole zakuleli ngoba efuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abafundi abalambi, nokuthi ukudla kuzofika nsuku zonke ezikoleni."Ngizimisele ukuyisiphula nezimpande inkohlakalo ohlelweni lokuphakelwa kwabafundi ezikoleni zethu. Kumele kuhlomule umphakathi kulolu hlelo kungazuzi umuntu oyedwa,” kusho uNksz Gwarube.Uthe uma esethathe isinqumo uyomemezela indlela okuzosetshenzwa ngayo ngaphansi kwalolu hlelo.Sinconyiwe isinyathelo sokumisa lithenda njengoba bekusolwa ukuthi kungenzeka kube nenkohlakalo.EKZN uhlelo lokunika umuntu oyedwa ozophakela abafundi lwaba nezinkinga kwaze kwabuyelwa ohlelweni oludala lokuhambisa ukudla kosonkontileka abahlukene.UNksz Gwarube ubuye wathembisa ukuthi ngoMashi ngonyaka ozayo bafuna ukube sebeqede nya ngamathoyilethi omgodi ezikoleni zakuleli."Zingu-259 izikole ezinamathoyilethi emigodi kuleli. Sihlela ukuthi siqede ngawo uma kuphela unyaka wezimali ophela ngoMashi 2025.” Amalungu ePhalamende afune ukwazi ukuthi uzoqinisekisa kanjani ukuthi lokhu kuyenzeka.Uwaphendule ngokuthi eminyakeni edlule zingaphezu kuka-4 000 izikole ebezinamathoyilethi omgodi kanti manje sekusele ezimbalwa.UNksz Gwarube uchithe indaba yokuthi umnyango wehlisa isibalo sothisha eWestern Cape.Uthe kunenkinga yemali kuleli wathi basazama ukuxoxisana noMgcinimafa ngalolu daba."Uma sivala noma sihlanganisa izikole sixoxa nomphakathi. Asimane sisivale noma yikanjani njengoba nalapho ngakhulela khona kunezikole eziningi ezavalwa,” kusho uNksz Gwarube.

Uthe kumqoka kakhulu nokuthi uma kukhulekwa, ingashiywa ngaphandle indaba yemindeni ukuze imishado izoma phakade ingazamaziseki kalula. Ubalule nokuthi kuba nzima ukukhulisa izingane uma umndeni vele usuqhekekile.U-Archbishop Dlamini uthe kuleli bandla bayakholelwa kakhulu ophikweni lomama ngoba lunamandla okwenza izinto zenzeke lisebenzisa amandla omkhuleko.

Ngicabanga ukuthi bekufanele ngabe kade ashenxa emsebenzini wakhe ngoba wehlulekile,” kusho uMthalane.Khonamanjalo: Inyunyana iFedusa esitatimendeni sayo sithe, kade babexa nomkhandlu wase-DUT, kodwa ubaziba."Abaphathi base-DUT bavamise ukudelela izinqumo ze-CCMA ezivuna abasebenzi, badonsele amacala ezinkantolo eziphakeme. Banyathela phansi amalungelo abasebenzi, bashintsha izimo zokusebenza ngaphandle kokuxoxa ngokuhlanganyela."Usiko lokusatshiswa selixoshe odokotela nosolwazi abahlonishwa kakhulu e-DUT, kanti abasele nabo babamba bayayeka. LILOLIWE izembe kumalungu e-EFF ePhalamende, aweziShayamthetho namakhansela aqhamuka ezindaweni lapho iqembu lathola khona amavoti angaphansi kuka-100.I-EFF isibhalele amalungu ayo aqhamuka ezindaweni lapho iqembu lahluleka ukuthola amavoti angu-100, iwayalela ukuba achaze ukuthi kungani kufanele angadilizwa ezikhundleni. Ngo-2019 sathola amavoti angaphezu kuka-360 000. Uyichaza kanjani lena yokuthi kulo nyaka sithole ngaphansi kuka-100 000. Kukhona abantu okufanele bathathelwe izinyathelo.”Umthombo uthe okumangazayo ukuthi i-EFF inobuholi bamagatsha cishe kuzo zonke izingxenye zeKwaZulu-Natal kodwa kukhona izindawo lapho ihluleka khona ukuthola amavoti angu-100."Igatsha le-EFF lakhiwa amalungu angu-100. BABHEKE ukuthi uMkhosi woMhlanga wakulo nyaka uhanjelwe isibalo sabantu esiphezulu kwesake sabonwa kulo mkhosi waminyaka yonke.UMnyango wezoBuciko namaSiko KwaZulu-Natal, uthe ulindele amatshitshi angaphezu kuka-40 000 ukuba abe ingxenye yomkhosi wakulo nyaka.Ngokwezibalo zomnyango, isibalo sijwayele ukuba u-35 000.Umkhosi wakulo nyaka uyingqophamlando njengoba kuzobungazwa iminyaka engu-40 kwavuselelwa lolu siko.UMkhosi woMhlanga wavuselelwa iNdlovukazi uShiyiwe Mantfombi Dlamini Zulu ngo-1984.Umlando uveza ukuthi umkhosi wangalowo nyaka wawuhanjelwe amatshitshi angu-500.UMkhosi woMhlanga wakulo nyaka uzoqala esigodlweni eMachobeni, eNgwavuma.Lo mkhosi uzokuba izinsuku ezimbili, uLwesihlanu noMgqibelo, kulindeleke ukuthi uhanjelwe amatshitshi angu-5 000.Ngesonto elizayo kuzoba nomkhosi omkhulu esigodlweni eNyokeni, kwaNongoma.Umkhosi uzothatha izinsuku ezintathu, uzoqala ngoLwesihlanu, futhi kulindeleke ukuthi uhanjelwe amatshitshi angu-40 000.Okhulumela umnyango, uMnuz Ntando Mnyandu, uthe konke sekumi ngomumo."Indlunkulu kaZulu ngokubambisana nohulumeni wesifundazwe, omasipala kanye nezinye izinhlaka sebekulungele ukwamukela amatshitshi aqhamuka kuzo zonke izifunda ezingu-11 zaKwaZulu-Natal, aqhamuka ezifundazweni ezingomakhelwane iMpumalanga neGauteng, kanye naqhamuka eSwatini.”UMnyandu uthe balindele ubukhazikhazi emkhosini wakulo nyaka."Kukhulu ukuzigqaja eMkhosini woMhlanga. Izintombi zizikhethela zona ukuzigcina nokuzithiba ocansini. Kulo mkhosi, izintombi ezisuke zihlobe ngemibala ehlukene ekhombisa ukuba msulwa kwazo, ziyaye zihambe ngamaqoqo. Zisuke zicula amahubo ngesikhathi zihambisa umhlanga eSilweni uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini. "Lo mzuzu ukhombisa ukunqoba kwazo zonke izintombi ezilingweni ezibhekana nazo. ISilo uGoodwill Zwelithini kaBhekuzulu sasisebenzisa uMkhosi woMhlanga ukugqugquzela amatshitshi ukuba aziphathe kahle. Ngokubambisana neNdlovukazi uMantfombi kaSobhuza, basungula inkundla yokukhuthaza izintombi ukuba ziziphathe kahle.”UMnyandu uthe ngenxa yokubaluleka komkhosi wakulo nyaka babe nemicimbi yokulungiselela izintombi eziya emhlangeni ebikuzo zonke izifunda."Kube injabulo yodwa ngesikhathi kunemicimbi ebinesiqubulo esithi #SiyayaEmhlangeni.”UMnyandu uthe emkhosini wakulo nyaka bazophinde bahlomise amatshitshi ngamakhono, baphinde bawaluleke ngemikhakha angayifundela."Inhloso yalokhu ukuba izintombi zikwazi ukubhekana nezimo zempilo.”
IGCAGCELE esokeni emindenini yabagilwa nakumalungu omphakathi ayesekayo, iNkantolo yeMantshi yaseVerulam yenqaba ukuthi akhishwe ngebheyili umfundisi webandla labasindisiwe osolwa ngamacala okunukubeza ngokocansi abafana abancane.UMnuz Mkhanyisi Mshalala (57), ubevele kule nkantolo izolo, lapho obekulindeleke ukuthi kukhishwe isinqumo esicelweni sakhe sokuthi adedelwe ngebheyili. Ubhekene namacala amane okunukubeza ngokocansi abafana abaneminyaka engu-12 kuya phansi eWaterloo. Kuthiwa ubewumqeqeshi weqembu lebhola lezinyawo aphinde afundise izifundo zeBhayibheli futhi ewumfundisi ebandleni labasindisiwe elikhona endaweni. Isinqumo sokunqatshelwa ibheyili semukelwe ngentokozo yimindeni yabagilwa namalungu omphakathi abenkanise ngaphandle kwenkantolo ukufaka ingcindezi ekutheni angayinuki.Uyise womunye wabagilwa (igama lakhe eligodliwe ukuvikela isithunzi sendodana yakhe), uthe okumdumaza kakhulu ngomsolwa, ukuthi ubemthemba kakhulu, kanti yena uthi lala lulaza."Ngijabule kakhulu ngesinqumo senkantolo. Ngiyafisa ukuthi uma esegwetshwa athole isigwebo esizomenza ahlale isikhathi eside ngaphakathi. Ingane beyicela kimina ukuyodlala ngiyivumela ngangoba noma ingazobuya bengingenankinga nokuthi ilala endlini kamqeqeshi ngoba yilapho abebehlanganyela khona ngebhola noma ngezinto ezithinta isonto kwazise ubebuye abewumfundisi wabo. "Ngiqale ukubona uma ingane ichama igazi ingafuni ukusho ukuthi kwenzenjani, ngaze ngayithembisa induku, kwayilapho igonyuluka khona ngokunukubezwa umsolwa,” usho kanje.Umsolwa kuthiwa abagilwa ubebaphuzisa unemenayidi okukholakala ukuthi ubesuke esewuthake nesidakamizwa esithile, ebese uyabadlwengula, emva kwalokho ebasabise ngokubenzakalisa uma beke bayizeka emakhaya imikhuba yakhe.UMnuz Khumbulani Zuma oyisishoshovu somphakathi, uveze ukuthi umsolwa uwavumile amacala athweswe wona. "Umphakathi ubuphume ngobuningi uzokweseka imindeni yabagilwa, ufake nengcindezi enkantolo ekutheni umsolwa engayitholi ibheyili. Isinqumo senkantolo siyasenelisa. Ngesikhathi sibhikisha ngaphandle, bakhona abazali abathathu baseMhlasini, abaqinisekise ukuthi izingane zabo nazo ziphumele obala zagonyuluka ngokuhlukunyezwa umsolwa. Basuke enkantolo banikela esiteshini samaphoyisa ukuyovula amacala,” usho kanje.Inkantolo ilihlehlisele u-Okthoba, 17 icala, njengoba kusaphenywa. Kulindeleke ukuthi sande isibalo samacala afanayo athweswa umsolwa uma esevela ngalolu suku.Eboshwa ngenyanga edlule, kudingeke angeniswe esibhedlela ukuyokwelashwa kwazise umphakathi wawuqale wamtitinya kanzima ngaphambi kokuthi umdlulisele emaphoyiseni.
ABEZWA lutho abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ngemali yabo esemabhodweni empesheni njengoba abantu sebeqalile ukufaka izicelo zokukhipha o-R30 000 babo.UNksz Michelle Acton oyi-Retirement Reform Executive (Isikhulu esikhulu) e-Old Mutual, uthe ngoLwesibili bangaphezu kuka-93 000 abantu abangene ku-WhatsApp wale nkampani bebuza ngendaba yokukhipha u-R30 000 wabo osebhodweni lempesheni elibizwa nge-savings pot.Uthe selokhu kuqale uhlelo lwe-two pot retirement system bathole izingcingo ezingaphezulu kuka-1000 kodwa konke kuhamba kahle."Amakhasimende ethu afuna ukukhipha imali ayasizakala. Ziningi izingcingo esesizitholile, bayangena ku-WhatsApp nakwezinye izindlela zokuxhumana abantu. Okwamanje izinhlelo zethu zisahamba kahle.”UKhomishana we-South African Revenue Service, uMnuz Edward Kieswetter, uthe ngoMsombuluko baphasise izicelo zokukhipha imali eziwu-2 759, kwathi ngoLwesibili bathola eziwu-2 424. Lokhu uthe kusho ukuthi abantu bazothola imali ewu-R103 million bese kungena intela ewu-R6.7 million.KwaSanlam bathe ngoSepthemba 1, abantu bese beqalile ukufaka izicelo zokukhipha imali ebhodwe lempesheni.Baveze ukuthi konke kuhamba kahle base becela abantu ukuthi bangajahi ukukhipha imali ngaphandle uma kunezizathu ezibaphoqa ukuthi bayikhiphe.Bathe amakhasimende abo azokwaziswa ngazo zonke izigaba zokukhipha imali ngoba le ye-two pot izothatha isikhathi esijana kunesijwayelekile.IGovernment Employees Pension Fund (GEPF) yazise abantu ukuthi bathole uhlelo olusha lwe-app ye-GEPF etholakala ku-Android naku-Huawei.Abasebenzisa i-IOS bazokwazi ukuyithola ngoSepthemba 23 le app yokuzisiza.Ithe uma sekuqinisekiswe yonke imininingwane yomuntu kuzothatha izinsuku eziwu-60 ukuba imali ingene kwi-akhawunti yomuntu.IMomentum igqugquzele abantu ukuthi basebenzise i-app ukufaka izicelo zokukhipha imali, yathi izinkumbi ezithutheleke emahhovisi ayo.
UPHIKO oluphenya amacala abucayi i-Special Investigations Unit, seluphothule uphenyo lwezicelo zenhlawulo ezingu-108, ezifakwe eMnyangweni wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal ezizodla imali eyevile ku-R2.4 billion.Lokhu kuvezwe yiNhloko yalolu phiko u-Advocate Andy Mothibi ngesikhathi ethulela ikomiti elibhekele ukusebenza kwemali yomphakathi, i-Standing Committee on Public Accounts (Scopa) ePhalamende, igxathu asebelihambile ukuphenya ngezicelo ezibopha umnyango okukholakala ukuthi ezinye zazo zenziwa ngabameli abaqhuba inkohlakalo ezifundazweni ezehlukene.KwaZulu-Natal nje kuphela, uMothibi uthe lolu phiko luthole izicelo ezingu-2 440 ezifakwe eMnyangweni wezeMpilo kulesi sifundazwe zemali eyevile ku- R29.1 billion, kanti kuzona sekuphothulwe uphenyo kweziwu-108."Kwezingu 107 osekuqediwe ngophenyo lwazo, eziwu-76 kuzona kutholwe ukuthi okufakwe ngabo izicelo sebashona, okwenze ukuthi imali engu- R1 715, 500, 250,00 isuswe emalini yenkokhelo. Kudluliselwe ophikweni lwezokushushiswa komphakathi (NPA) amacala abandakanya abameli nabanye abasolwa abatholwe namaphepha okushicilelwe kuwo imininingwane yeziguli, antshontshiwe,” usho kanje.Uthe ngophenyo sekugwenywe ukulahleka kwesamba esevile ku- R2.4 billion kulesi sifundazwe, selokhu kuqale uphenyo, kanti bonke abathinteka kulo bugebengu kubalwa abameli nabasebenzi bezempilo, bazoshushiswa.Lolu phiko luthi izicelo eziningi ezihlawulisa umnyango, zigxile ebudedengwini obenzeka ngesikhathi kubelethiswa, okuholela ekukhubazekeni kwezingane. UMothibi uthe ezinye izicelo zifakwe ngeziguli zingenalo ulwazi ngazo, kanti kwesinye isikhathi abameli abebezenza osonhlalakahle bebevakashela abantu asebekhulile abahlala nezingane ezashiywa ngabazali, babhalise imali yesibonelelo kanti babasayinisa amaphepha okufaka izicelo.Inkampani yabameli i-Nonxuba Attorneys ezinze eGoli, okuthiwa seyivele ithweswe amacala ngokusemthethweni, ifake ezicelo ezingu-44 zalolu hlobo eMnyangweni wezeMpilo e-Eastern Cape, okuyimali engu- R497 million obekumele ikhokhwe umnyango kulesiya sifundazwe.UMothibi uthe phakathi kuka-2010 no-2016, izicelo ezifakwe eNkantolo eNkulu yaseMthatha nje kuphela zinyuke zafinyelela ku-529 zisuka ku-46.Uthe ubufakazi buveza ukuthi kunokusebenzisana phakathi kwabameli, abahlengikazi nodokotela ukuqhuba le nkohlakalo.Umthetho ogunyaza ukuphenywa kwenkohlakalo eyenziwa izikhulu eminyangweni kahulumeni usayinwe uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ngo-2022

OWAYENGUMSAKAZI woKhozi FM, uNgizwe Mchunu, usevaliwe ekusebenziseni amabhanoyi angaphansi kwenkampani iFlySafair, emuva kokuphothulwa kophenyo obelwenziwa yizikhulu zale nkampani. Ngokusho kwemithombo, iziphathimandla zale nkampani zithathe isinqumo sokumisa lo msakazi emabhanoyini ayo emuva kokubonakala kwi-video ephazamisa ukusebenza kwabasebenzi nabagibeli ngeziqubulo namahubo.Emasontweni adlule , kusabalale i-video ebikhombisa uNgizwe nabehamba nabo bekhuza izaga futhi besho namahubo besebhanoyini esikhumulweni samabhanoyi saseThekwini, i-King Shaka International Airport. Ngesonto eledlule oyisikhulu sezokuxhumana kwa-FlySafair, uKirby Gordon, wakuqinisekisa ukuthi bayibonile i-video ebiveza abasebenzi bale nkampani behlangabezana nezimbila zithutha ziholwa ngemhlophe phambili ebhanoyini i-FA196, ngesikhathi kuneqeqebana ebeliphazamisa abagibeli. Uthe iqeqebana liphinde laphula imithetho yokuphepha, okubalwa nokwehluleka ukuhlonipha izimpawu zokugqokwa kwebhande lokuphepha."Abophiko lwezokuphepha njengamanje baphothula ukubuyekeza ngesehlakalo. Izinyathelo ezifanele zizothathwa ngokwenqubomgomo yethu, okubalwa nokuvala ngokuzayo abantu ababandakanyekayo emabhanoyini akwa-FlySAfair,” kuphetha uGordon. Esebuzwa kuleli sonto uGordon ukuthi bahambe bagcinaphi nophenyo lwabo, uqale wathi akubuzwe uNgizwe. Exinwa ngemibuzo ugcine esethi uyenqaba ukuphawula kabanzi ngalolu daba ngoba sebeluphothulile ngokulandela inqubomgomo yabo."Ngokwenqubomgomo yenkampani, asiphawuli ngodaba oluthinta ikhasimende elilodwa. Ngakho kufanele uthole imininingwane kuMnuz Mchunu. Okwethu ukugxila ekungadaluleni izimfihlo esinazo namakhasimende ethu. Siyakubonga ukuqonda kwakho futhi sizibophezele ekugcineni izinga lokunakekela nokuvikela amakhasimende ethu liphezulu.”Ethintwa uNgizwe, esikhundleni sokuphendula, uvele wabhoka ngolaka maqede waqhulula intatheli ngenhlamba ngaphambi kokuvala ucingo. Umhleli walolu hambo lwabebebuya kwiBhinca Day eNyuvesi yase-Cape Peninsula, uSthembiso "Navigator” Gcwensa, wadlulisa ukuphoxeka okukhulu ngalesi sigameko esibandakanya izihambeli zakhe futhi wasigxeka kakhulu."Ngesikhathi sesibuyela eKZN, abathize bahlulekile ukulandela imithetho yebhanoyi le-FlySafair. Thina njengenhlangano sidlulisa ukuxolisa kubo bonke abahlukumezeka, ikakhulukazi abenkampani i-FlySafair namakhasimende ayo. Siyaxolisa emphakathini wonkana futhi siyaqinisekisa ukuthi sizothatha izinyathelo ezinqala ukuze ukuziphatha ngale ndlela kungaphinde kwenzeke,” kusho uNavigator. Ngesonto eledlule, uNgizwe uthe abantu okufanele baxolise ngabanikazi be-FlySafair ngoba bona njengemabhinca babekhuleka kwiLembe ngoba indiza yayisimile. "Nalesi siphukuphuku esinguNavigator sasingekho endizeni. Uyazifaka ezintweni ayengekho kuzo. Uxoliselani? Uxolisela ukuthandaza?” kubhoka uNgizwe ozishaya isifuba ngokuba wumengameli wamabhinca owagcotshwa yiSilo SamaBandla. Akukhona okokuqala uNgizwe exabana nabantu esikhumulweni sendiza. Wake wamangalela abaphathi balesi sikhumulo efuna ukunxeshezelwa ngo-R10 million emuva kokubasola ngokulahla phansi ihawu lakhe ngoba belisola ngokuba namatele. Ngebhadi wakhala ngaphansi okwentshebe yaKwaMashu.

Ngabe ufuna ikusasa eliqhakazile? Woza e-Durban University of Technology (DUT), isikhungo esaziwa emhlabeni jikelele ngemfundo esezingeni eliphezulu, ukuqeqesha kwezobuchwepheshe, ucwaningo, ezamabhizinisi nokwenza izinto ngendlela ehlukile enobuhlakani.Kwafuna ukufunda enyuvesi yekhethelo ngo-2025, iDUT iyona ehamba phambili. IDUT yisikhungo semfundo ephakeme esiKwaZulu-Natal, esinamakhephasi emfundo ayisikhombisa aseThekwini naseMgungundlovu. IDUT yasungulwa ngo-2002 emuva kokuhlanganiswa kwe-ML Sultan ne-Technikon Natal, le nyuvesi inezigaba zemfundo ezahlukene okubalwa eze-Accounting and Informatics, Applied Sciences, anagement Sciences, Engineering and the Built Environment, Health Sciences, neze-Arts and Design. Kunezinhlaka zocwaningo eziwu-20 okugxilwa kuzona, ngalolu cwaningo iDUT izibophezele ekuthuthukiseni ubuchwepheshe besimanje ibuye ixazulule izingqinamba ezibhekene nomhlaba. Impumelelo ye-DUT ayithinti kuphela ezemfundo kodwa kuthuthukiswa izitshudeni ngayo yonke indlela, lapha kubalwa nakwezamabhizinisi.Uphiko lwe-Management Sciences lunesikole samabhizinisi esibizwa nge-DUT Business School,okuyisona esigxile ezifundweni zamabhizinisi ezihlomisa izitshudeni ngamakhono ebhizinisi aletha uguquko lwezomnotho oluhle emphakathini. Lezi zifundo zigunyazwe yi-Council for Higher Education (CHE). Lesi sikhungo esibuye sibe yilungu le-South African Business School Association (SABSA), sithembisa izifundo ezihlukile zebhizinisi, ezikhiqiza abaholi abazokwazi ukuxazulula izinkinga ezenzeka emhlabeni.Emithanjeni ye-DUT kuhamba phambili uhlelo lwayo olushintsha ezemfundo olubizwa nge-ENVISION2030, olwasungulwa ngo-2020. Lolu hlelo lugxile kwizisekelo zokwenza izinto ngokuthembeka, ukungafihli lutho, inhlonipho, ukuziphendulela, ukungenzeleli, ukuzinikela, ukusebenza ngokuzikhandla, ukusebenza ngendlela eyamukelekile, nokuba nozwelo. Konke lokhu kuyisisekelo salesi sikhungo. Ngaphezu kwalokho uhlelo lwe-ENVISION2030 luyisitatimende sokuzibophezela ukuthi iDUT iyohlezi inakekela umphakathi, iza namasu amasha okwenza izinto, ithuthukisa osomabhizinisi futhi ihambisana nalokho okwenzeka emhlabeni jikelele. Lesi sitatimende sisho ukuthi iDUT izohamba phambili ekuthuthukiseni izwe nomhlaba. Iyakholelwa ekwakheni ingqalasizinda ehamba phambili kwezemfundo nakuyo yonke imikhakha esebenza kuyona. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uhlelo lwe-ENVISION2030 lunenjongo yokuthuthukisa impilo yabantu ngayo yonke indlela.Isiqubulo senyuvesi esithi– "CREATIVE. DISTINCTIVE. IMPACTFUL.” –sithembisa izitshudeni imfundo nentuthuko kuyo yonke impilo yazo. Labo abafuna ulwazi, abomele ukuqeqeshwa kwezobuchwepheshe namabhizinisi bazothola usizo eDUT. Akusona isikhungo semfundo ephakeme kuphela kodwa yisikhungo somphakathi esenza izinto ngendlela ehlukile kwezobuchwepheshe, nezamabhizinisi. Phezu kwakho konke lokhu sithuthukisa izitshudeni ukuze zithi uma ziphuma zibe namagalelo abonakalayo emhlabeni.Kulabo abanobizo lwamabhizinisi, iDUT inesikhungo esibizwa nge-innobiz DUT Centre for Entrepreneurship and Innovation. Lesi sikhungo siqeqesha izitshudeni ngolwazi lomsebenzi, zifunde kabanzi ngemikhakha yamabhizinisi ukuze zithi uma ziphuma zikwazi ukuzivulela amabhizinisi azo, azoxazulula izinkinga zomphakathi. Yenza iDUT inyuvesi yakho ekhethekile ukuze uqale imfundo ehlukile, ezokuhlomisa ngolwazi oludingayo, ukwazi ukuba neqhaza elibalulekile emhlabeni. Yiba namaphupho amakhulu, khetha iDUT njengekhaya lakho lezemfundo. Sezivuliwe izikhala zezifundo ze-undergraduate ne-postgraduate,kulabo abafuna ukufunda izifundo ezihlukene ezizobasiza ukuphumelela.Ngolwazi oluphelele ngezifundo zaseDUT, okudingekayo uma uzobhalisa nokufakwa kwezicelo ungavakashela u-www.dut.ac.za (https://www.dut.ac.za/)DUT ENVISION2030… CREATIVE. DISTINCTIVE. IMPACTFUL.

"Nginxusa abantu ukuthi uma kukhona abangazwani ngakho, bakulungise ngendlela engenalo udlame, hhayi ukubulalana nokulimaza abantu abangenacala,”’ kusho uThwala.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe abasolwa ababili abaneminyaka ewu-27 no-37 ababoshelwe lesi sehlo bazovela namhlanje enkantolo yeMantshi yaseNyoni, eMandeni.
SEKUHLOLWE kwaphinde kwagonywa abafundi abevile esigidini kuleli ngaphansi komkhankaso woMnyango weMfundo eyisiSekelo noMnyango wezeMpilo. Abafundi okubalwa nabafunda ezikoleni zabaphila nokukhubazeka, bahlolwe izifo ezehlukene baphinde bagonyelwa izifo ezifana ne-Human papillomaviru, eyaziwa nge-HPV, okuyisifo esithathelana ngokocansi esidala umdlavuza womlomo wesibeletho.Lokhu kuvele ngesikhathi le minyango ivele ngaphambi kwekomiti lasePhalamende.UMqondisi obhekele imfundo yabaphila nokukhubazeka, uMnuz Jabulani Ngcobo, utshele amalungu ePhalamende ukuthi lo mkhankaso uthela izithelo njengoba sanda isibalo sabafundi abahlolwa izifo ezehlukene, baphinde bagonywe ukuze bavikeleke.Uveze ukuthi angaphezu kuka-4 million amantombazane asegonyelwe iHPV."Asibashiyi ngaphandle abafundi abaphila nokukhubazeka uma kwenziwa le mikhankaso ezikoleni. Kusuka ngo-2015 sekuqeqeshwe othisha abevile ku-178 000, ukuthi balandele imigomo ethinta ezempilo ezikoleni. Kubalulekile ukuthi sisheshe sinqande izifo ikakhulu kubafundi bamantombazane,” kusho uNgcobo.UDkt Lesley Bamford woMnyango wezeMpilo, uthe bangaphezu kuka-7 million abafundi asebethole usizo lokukhishwa izikelemu ezikoleni ezingu-Quintile 1 kuya ku-3.Uthe babalelwa ku-1.6 million abafundi abaneminyaka engu-6 kuya ku-12, asebethole imigomo yezifo ezehlukene okubalwa i-tetanus ne-diphtheria."Abafundi abevile ku-258 000 basizwe ezinkingeni ezithinta amehlo, abangu-59 451 bathole usizo oluthinta ukuzwa kwathi abangu-685 000, basizwa ezinkingeni ezithinta inhlanzeko yamazinyo. Abanye basizwe ngokuthi babone ongoti abazobasiza ukuze bakwazi ukukhuluma.”UMqondisi jikelele eMnyangweni weMfundo eyisiSekelo, uMnuz Mathanzima Mweli, uthe zonke izikole abazakhayo bayaqikelela ukuthi zinezinsiza ezizokwenza kube lula kwabaphila nokukhubazeka.Uthe kuyadingeka kube nokubambisana emikhakheni ehlukene.Amalungu ePhalamende aveze ukuthi akumele bazibone beshaywe indiva abafundi abaphila nokukhubazeka kunakwe abafunda ezikoleni ezijwayelekile.Okunye okuvelile ngukuthi kumele kuqiniswe ezobuchwepheshe ezikoleni zabaphila nokukhubazeka.
KUSOLWA izimpunyela ngokusebenzisa intsha ekwenzeni ubugebengu obufana nokuqoqa ngodli imali yokuvikela ezinhlakeni zomphakathi nokudayisa izidakamizwa.Lokhu kushiwo nguKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, eSouth Beach eThekwini kulandela ukufa kwabasolwa abayisithupha kade bedubulana namaphoyisa.Abafi, okuvela ukuthi basebancane ngeminyaka, badutshulelwe eflethini eliyindawo yokuvakasha njengoba kuvela ukuthi bebebhukhelwe kulo ngowesilisa othile ngoMgqibelo.Laba basolwa ngokudubula babulale abesilisa abane abasebancane eTshelimnyama, eMarriannhill, ngeSonto.Kuleso sigameko kuvela ukuthi abasolwa bafica abafi bezihlalele emgwaqweni bephuza, babayalela ukuthi balale phansi ngezisu maqede babadubula emakhanda.Kuthiwa abane bafela khona lapho, kwathi owesihlanu waphuthunyiswa esibhedlela esesimeni esibucayi.Abafi ababulawe ngeSonto kuthiwa bebedayisa izidakamizwa ngakwaGaqanga esitolo ngaseTshelimnyama Primary.Abasolwa (ababulawe izolo) baphinde basolwe ngokudubula babulale abesilisa abathathu eMinitown, eHammarsdale, ngoLwesihlanu.Kuleso sigameko kuthiwa baficana nabafi esitolo somuntu wokufika kuzoqoqwa imali yokuvikela. Kuthiwa baqale bahilizisana ngaphambi kokuthi bakhiphelane izibhamu badubulane.UMkhwanazi uthe bengamaphoyisa bakhathazekile ngentsha esencane ezibandakanya nobugebengu."Uma ubuka iminyaka yabo, ikhomba ukuthi kufanele ingabe bafunda u-matric noma basenyuvesi kodwa benza ubugebengu,” kusho uMkhwanazi.Uthe phakathi kobugebengu le ntsha eba mandla kubo obokudayisa izidakamizwa nobokuqoqa imali yokuvikela ikakhulukazi ezitolo zabokufika.Ugcizelele kwelokuthi basebenzela abantu abathile abanemali."Njengalaba nje esibathole kuleli flethi elibizayo. Ngeke uvele ubhukhe kulona ungenamali, kusobala basebenzela umuntu onemali,” kusho uMkhwanazi.Uthe lona osolwa ngokuba nemali obebhukhele abafi, basezithendeni zakhe.Uthe le nkinga idinga zonke izinhlaka zomphakathi ukuba zibambisane ziyidudule impi yobugebengu."Ngeke inqotshwe yithi sodwa singamaphoyisa, izinkantolo namajele. Lokhu okwenzekayo kukhomba ukuthi inkulu inkinga emphakathini nasemakhaya lapho le ntsha ikhuliswa khona” kusho uMkhwanazi othe uma kuqhubeka kanje ikusasa alikho.Uthe ukuhlala kwabantu abasha bengenzi lutho, behamba bezulazula ezitaladini, bazithola sebeqashwa abathile ukuthi babenzele ubugebengu bese uma amaphoyisa ethi ayababopha, badubule kuqala bese beyafa uma amaphoyisa esebuyisela ngenhlamvu.
AMAQEMBU epolitiki ePhalamende akhala ngokungabibikho kohlelo olucacile lokulwa nabaqola ngodli amalungu omphakathi nosomabhizinisi bathathe kubo imali abayibiza ngeyokubavikela (edume nge-protection fee), okuyisihlava esibukeka sisabalala nezwe lonke.UNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, ubethulela amalungu ePhalamende likazwelonke e-Cape Town, phakathi kokunye - izinhlelo umnyango wakhe onazo ukulwa nalobu bugebengu obuhlalise kabi umphakathi.UMchunu uveze ukuthi sekuqalwe uhlelo lokusebenzisana olubizwa nge-Operational Plan olufaka phakathi zonke izinhlaka ezilwa nobugebengu okubalwa kuzona amaphoyisa, izinkampani zonogada ezizimele nabamakomiti abhekelele ubugebengu emphakathini okuhloswe ngalo ukulwa nobugebengu ezifundazweni nakomasipala abehlukene."Ukusayinwa kwesivumelwano salolu hlelo sekwenziwe esifundazweni i-Western Cape. Maduze luzokwethulwa edolobheni i-Nelson Mandela Bay esifundazweni i-Eastern Cape njengoba sekuvunyelwene ngalo. Ngesonto elizayo lethulwa eGauteng bese kuthi KwaZulu-Natal lethulwe ngomhla ka-19 no-20 kule nyanga,” kusho uMchunu.Uthe amaphoyisa ayabhekana nalezi zigameko, kodwa izigebengu zikhombisa ukuphikelela. Uqinisekise ukuthi nakuba kunjalo kuyogcina wona. Ubalule isigameko sokuboshwa kwabathathu eGauteng, abaqhuba lobu bugebengu, kanti bathathu esifundazweni iMpumalanga okuthiwa balandelwa ngamaphoyisa. Abane bafe bedubulana namaphoyisa eCape Town, kwalimala abane, kanti ababibili basagcwele amathafa. Uveze ukuthi umphakathi uyabika ngezigameko kodwa akwenele. Uthe kunesidingo sokuthuthukiswa kwezibunhloli ukubhekana nalesi sihlava. Ukhale ngohlelo lokukhululwa kweziboshwa ngoshwele, waveza ukuthi bazolubheka noMnyango wezoBulungiswa, njengoba ethi ziningi iziboshwa ezikhululwa ngalo, ngaphambi kwesikhathi okunomthelela ezingeni lobugebengu obubatshazwayo.UDkt Quinton Ndlozi we-EFF ukhale ngokungabibikho kweqhinga elicacile lokuvika lobu bugebengu."Abantu bafuna ukuzwa ukuthi yiliphi iqhinga uhulmeni azolenza ukulwa namaqembu ezigelekeqe athatha ngodli o-30% kosomabhizinisi abanikezwe imisebenzi kahulumeni. Lokho kwenza uhulumeni angakwazi ukusebenza emazingeni aphansi. Izigameko ziyabikwa emaphoyiseni, kuphela azishaya sabantu abangazi ukuthi lobu bugebengu buyenzeka. Umphakathi uyabazi abantu abawuhlalise lubhojozi,” kusho uNdlozi.UMnuz Vuyo Zungula we-ATM, uthe kumele imikhankaso yokukhuculula ngobugebengu efana nobonakale wenziwa ePhoyinti eThekwini, ngesonto eledlule, yenziwe nakwamanye amadolobha."Kumele kukhishwe amaphoyisa akhohlakele. Umnyango kumele utshale amaphoyisa ophiko lwamabherethi (Tactical Response Team) emigwaqweni ethile ukulwa nobugebengu. Kumele akhulule amaphoyisa azivikele, uma ebhekene nezigebengu, angavikeli izigebengu ukwedlula wona,” usho kanje.UMnuz Nsikayezwe Cebekhulu we-IFP, uthe lobu bugebengu obudlangile bucacisa ukuthi azikho izinhloli ezanele, okwenza elakuleli kube yikamachanca.UMnuz David Sikhosana we-MK, uthe uphiko oluphenya ngokuziphatha kwamaphoyisa i-Independent Police Investigative Directorate, kumele luqinise isandla ekuphenyeni amaphoyisa njengoba kunezinkomba zokuthi kukhona amaphoyisa asebenzisana nabaqhuba lobu bugebengu.
Izitshudeni zaseDurban Uneversity of Technology (DUT) ezenza izifundo zeMandarin (Ulimu lwaseChina) zizoba nethuba lokuvakashela izindawo ezahlukene esifundazweni iFujian, eChina, ngenhloso yokuqonda kabanzi ngosikompilo lwakhona namathuba emikhakheni eyahlukene.Lezi zitshudeni ezingu-17 zifulathele eNingizimu Afrika ngoMsombuluko ekuseni zaze zafika edolobheni iFuzhou, ngoLwesibili ngo-5 ntambama, ngokwesikhathi saseChina (iChina ingaphambili ngamahora ayisithupha neNingizimu Afrika).Uhambo, i-2024 FAFU-DUT Confucius Institute Summer Camp of "Experiencing Charming Fujian" luhlelwe yiConfusius Institute yaseDUT neFujian Agriculture and Forestry University (Fafu) futhi luzodonsa amasonto amabili.UDKT Eddie Fu oyi-Director ye-Global Engagement Fujian Agriculture and Forestry University Isithombe: Fanelesibonge BenguIConfucius Institute (CI) yaseDUT igqugquzela ukusebenzisana emikhakheni ehlukene phakathi kwe-DUT namanyuvesi aseChina.UDkt Eddie Fu oyi-Director ye-Global Engagement eFafu, uthe uyajabula ukwamukela izitshudeni zase-DUT ikakhulukazi ngoba usebenze khona iminyaka emine njengesikhulu se-CI yakhona.Uthe kuningi akukhumbula ngeTheku ngoba bagqugquzele ukuthi abantu baxhumane, ikakhulukazi abasha baseChina naseThekwini."Yize nizohlala izinsukuwana kodwa siyathemba iFuzhou izoba yikhaya lenu lesibili. Nizovakashela izindawo ezahlukene esifundazweni nibe nezingqungquthela nabanye abafundi bakwezinye izikhungo esifundazweni. Nizohambela izindawo ezinomlando. IFujian iyafana neKwaZulu-Natal eNingizimu Afrika ngoba sinemilando eyahlukene namasiko amangalisayo nezizwe ezahlukene njengaKwaZulu-Natal,” kuchaza uFu.IZITSHUDENI zaseDUT zifika eFuzhou lapho zizochitha khona izinsuku ezingu-10 zifunda ngezinto ezahlukene ngeChina Isithombe: Fanelesibonge BenguUthe uyathemba ukuthi bazokhuluma kakhulu iMandarin babone nokundlondlobala kweFujian, futhi ngomuso bazobuya bezofunda noma bezosebenza kulesi sifundazwe.Lolu hambo luqondane nokuvakasha kukaMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa eChina, ofike ngoMsombuluko, njengoba kunengqungquthela iChina-Africa Cooperation Summit (FOCAC) esongwa ngoLwesine. NgoLwesithathu uzokwethula inkulumo engqungqutheleni i-South Africa-China Business Forum."Omengameli bamazwe omabili (Ramaphosa nowaseChina) babe nomhlangano obe yimpumelelo wokugqugquzela ukusebenzisana. Ngiyathemba njengabantu abasha nizobambisana nathi sigqugquzele ubungani kula mazwe womabili,” kusho uFu.Inhloko ye-DUT CI, uFrank Lin WU, ithe lolu wuhlelo abalwenza minyaka yonke kusuka ngo-2015, ngaphandle kweminyaka lapho kuhlasele khona iCovid-19.I-CI yase-DUT isungulwe ngoMashi, ngesikhathi uMengameli waseChina, uXi Jinping, evakashele owayengumengameli waseNingizimu Afrika uJacob Zuma. Yaqala ukusebenza ngo-2014 futhi ise-ML Sultan.Izitshudeni ezihambile bezibukeka zijabule zithatha nezithombe yize nokukhathala bese kubhalwe ebusweni kwabanye. Ngemuva kwendiza yamahora alinganiselwa ku-12 esuka eGoli iya eShenzhen, zingene ebhasini imizuzu engu-40 zibheke esiteshini sesitimela samahora amane esibheke eFuzhou. Zamukelwe yithimba laseFafu, nasehhotela zamukelwa ngezinye izitshudeni zaseFafu nazo ezikhombise injabulo.
INYUNYANA yothisha i-National Teachers Union, isola uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal ngokuxhamazela, ukhangisa inqwaba yezikhala zothisha eziku-Post Level One, (PL1) kungalandelwanga imigudu. Kulindeleke ukuthi ukwamukelwa kwezicelo zomsebenzi kuvalwe ngoLwesihlanu.Kusukela umnyango umemezele izikhala ezingu- 747 emasontweni amabili adlule, othisha abangaqashiwe bamatasa behla benyuka befaka izicelo zomsebenzi njengoba kuwuhlelo lokuqala lwalo lo mnyango lokukhangisa izikhala ngendlela evulelekile evumela wonke umuntu ohlangabezana nokudingekayo ukuthi acele umsebenzi.Yize kunjalo, amathe angase abuyele kwasifuba kwabanye asebechithe imali yabo belungiselela ukufaka izicelo, njengoba ziqina izinsolo eziveza ukuthi kunenqwaba yezikhala ezizohoxiswa okukholakala ukuthi akuhanjiswanga ngendlela kwazise ezinye zazo zikhangiswe sekuvele kunabantu abaqashiwe kuzona.UMengameli weNatu kuMnuz Sibusiso Malinga engxoxweni neSolezwe, ukhale ngokuxhamazela komnyango njengoba eveze ukuthi maningi amaphutha ohlwini olukhishiwe."Umnyango bekumele ulinde, ulandele kahle yonke imigudu ngaphambi kokuthi uphanyeke lo luhlu lubonwe abantu bonke, kube kunamaphutha. Isenzo sawo siwukukhohlisa umphakathi futhi ngiyakholwa ukuthi siqhutshwa izinhloso zepolitiki. Ngaphambi kokukhishwa kwezikhala, bekumele kuqale kuthintwe abahloli nothishomkhulu ngendlela efanele baqinisekise ukuthi izikhala zikhona kulezo zikole ngaphambi kokukhishwa kwesikhangiso. Othisha abangaqashiwe, sebevele bachithe imali befaka izicelo nasezikoleni lapho kuvele kungeke kusathathwa muntu khona ngoba izicelo zivaliwe,” usho kanje.Ukusho lokhu nje, kunohlu lwezikhala ezingu-33, okwabelwana ngalo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana okuthiwa zihoxisiwe. UMalinga uthe bayazi ukuthi kukhona izikhala ezikhangiswe kungafanele, wathi umnyango uhlangane nezinyunyana zothisha ukubhunga lolu daba khona izolo, kanti kulindeleke ukuthi umemezele okufinyelelwe kukhona kulo mhlangano.Omunye wothisha abangasebenzi okhulume neSolezwe, uthe emva kokuphuma kwezikhangiso, ufake izicelo ezindaweni ezintathu ezama inhlanhla."Amathemba ami asethanda ukufiphala emva kokuhosha umoya wokuthi ezinye izikhala kungenzeka zihoxiswe. Bengiboleka imali yokugibela ngiye edolobheni eGreytown ukuze ngingene kwi- internet cafe ngoba ngasekhaya sihlushwa yi-network. Kumele ngibuye ngibe nemali yokugaya ama-CV ami, ngakho ngingadumala kakhulu uma kungathiwa lapho ngifake khona izicelo, bekuyizikhala ezivaliwe,” kusho yena.UMnuz Mfanelo Mncube wenhlangano yothisha abangaqashiwe, i- KwaZulu-Natal United Unemployed Educators, uthe emva kokubhalela ihhovisi loMphathiswa woMnyango uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka ngesonto eledlule bekhala ngento efanayo, bathole impendulo ethi ukukhangiswa kwezikhala kuzobuyekezwa.Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal uMnuz Muzi Mahlambi, uthe yihhovisi lomnyango eligunyaza ukukhishwa kwezikhala ngokuxhumana nezinyunyana, ngakho noma yiluphi uguquko olungenziwa ngalezi zikhala, luzoqhamuka kuleli hhovisi.
I-ANC Youth League (ANCYL) iphonsele i-SACP inselelo yokuba ingenele ukhetho, iyeke ukucasha nge-ANC.UMengameli we-ANCYL, uMnuz Collen Malatji, uthe uma i-SACP izibona ukuthi ingakwazi ukunqoba ukhetho, ayilungenele bese iyeka ukugxeka isinqumo se-ANC sokusungula uhulumeni wokubambisana.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba izolo, lapho ebekhuluma khona ngezinhlelo zokugubha iminyaka engu-80 kwasungulwa i-ANCYL.Abaholi be-SACP nabe-ANC ababoni ngaso linye ngodaba lokufakwa kwe-DA ne-FF Plus kuhulumeni wokubambisana.I-SACP ikhala ngokuthi la maqembu amabili anemithetho ecindezela abahlwempu nabasebenzi.Selokhu kwathi nhlo i-SACP ayingaze ingalungenela ukhetho, iyaye ikhankasele i-ANC.UMalatji uthe uma kuwukuthi i-SACP imile ekutheni i-ANC yenza iphutha ngokufaka la maqembu kuhulumeni wokubambisana, ayingenele ukhetho khona singezokuba khona isidingo sokuthi i-ANC ibambisane ne-DA ne-FF Plus."Uma nje sesikhuluma iqiniso, ukuphela kweqembu esingathanda ukubambisana nalo i-SACP. Sesisebenzisane nalo kusukela ngo-1994. Linemigomo efanayo neyethu. Alikho elinye iqembu elinemigomo efana ne-ANC, ngisho i-EFF ne-MK abanayo imigomo efana neye-SACP. Kahle kahle wonke la manye amaqembu ayazifanela nje, afuna ukukhipha i-ANC emandleni."Uma kuwukuthi abe-SACP bazibona ukuthi banawo amandla okwakha izinhlaka ezingabasiza ukuthi bakwazi ukunqoba ukhetho, abangenele ukhetho oluzayo. Uma kuwukuthi abawufuni uhulumeni wokubambisana, abangenele ukhetho, bayeke ukucasha ngaphansi kweziketi ze-ANC.”UMalatji uthe uma kuwukuthi i-SACP ayijabule ngohulumeni okhona, kufanele abaholi bayo baphume baphele kuwona."Okusikhathazayo njenge-ANCYL ukuthi abaholi be-SACP, lena egxeka uhulumeni wokubambisana, bangongqongqoshe kuhulumeni wokubambisana. Usihlalo we-SACP (uDkt Blade Nzimande) unguNgqongqoshe wezeSayensi nezoBuchwepheshe. "Amanye amalungu esigungu esiphezulu kwi-SACP nawo angongqongqoshe. Lokhu kusho ukuthi i-SACP nayo iyingxenye yohulumeni wokubambisana. Lo msindo abawubangayo awunasidingo, bafuna ukubukwa.”UMalatji uthe i-ANC yaba nezingxoxo ne-SACP ngaphambi kokuthi isungule uhulumeni wokubambisana njengedlelandawonye.UMalatji uthe bazokuba nezingxoxo ne-SACP lapho bezozama khona ukuqeda ukungaboni ngaso linye.
