BANUKANA bodwa othisha baMsizeni Combined eTugela Ferry, eMsinga, izigebengu zintshontsha u-R42 000 westokofela abebesidlala namakhompyutha esikoleni. Kuthiwa izigebengu zibophe unogada wesikole izandla nezinyawo ngezintambo zezicathulo, zamvalela kwelinye igumbi.Lesi sigameko esenzeke ngesonto eledlule, kuthiwa izigebengu ezine ebezihlome ngemimese nesibhamu zigasele kulesi sikole esiseMsinga ebusuku, zabamba unogada zamvalela kweliye igumbi emva kokumshaya nokumbopha.Kuthiwa zithathe amakhompyutha awu-12 nama-laptop amane okuyimpahla yesikole. Kuvela ukuthi zidlulele endaweni obekugcinwe kuyo imali yothisha ewu-R42 000 yesitokofela abebesidlala, bebolekisana ngayo.Umthombo osondelene nalesi sikole ongathandanga ukudalulwa, uthe kunezinsolo zokuthi kukhona uthisha obajikele wathumela izigebengu ukuthi zigile lo mhlola."Angiboni ukuthi izigebengu zingene esikoleni ngoba zifuna amakhompyutha, kodwa kuyacaca ukuthi bezizolanda imali. Beyihlala esikoleni, betshelekisa ngayo, kodwa kuthe sebeyiqoqile ngesonto eledlule besazoyihambisa ebhange, cishe ngenxa yokuthi bekuphakathi nezinsuku kusetshenzwa, kwaphoqa ukuthi isale ikhiyelwe egunjini okuhlangana kulo othisha nakho ke sekungena abantu sebeyishaqa,” usho kanje.UNksz Nelisiwe Thusini owusihlalo wesigungu esengamele isikole, uthe ukuntshontshwa kwempahla yesikole, kubaphazamisile kakhulu abafundi nothisha."Umsebenzi wabafundi omningi ugcinwe kwamanye amakhompyutha antshontshiwe. Kusale amathathu kuphela, nakhona kusho ukuthi imoto ebihamba izigebengu beyisigcwele. Sihlanganile nabazali nothisha ukudingida lolu daba, siphakamisa ukuthi okungenani kulekelelwane kuthengwe ikhompyutha eyodwa ezolekelela abafundi. Abazali abayizwanga kahle leyo, ngakho ke sizohlanganisa nothisha sibone ukuthi senzenjani,” kusho uNksz Thusini.Elandisa ngabakutshelwe ngunogada wesikole, uthe kwakungo-1 ezintatha, ngesikhathi ebona abesilisa abane becusha esibhobeni, othangweni lwesikole. Ukuphazima kweso, unogada uthe basondela kuyena bamkhomba ngesibhamu bemsabisa nangokumgwaza. Uthe emva kokumbopha nokumshaya, sebehambile, unogada wazama ukumemeza kodwa kwangekho omzwayo wagcina ekwazile ukuvula isicabha ngesilevu. Wahamba egxuma waze wafika emzini osondelene nesikole elimele ekhanda.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa aseMsinga aphenya icala lokugqekeza.
BABHEKE lukhulu koyinhloko yamajaji, uMandisa Maya, othathe izintambo ngokusemthethweni ngeSonto.IJaji Maya, oyinhloko yamajaji yesifazane yokuqala kuleli, uthathe ngokusemthethweni emva kokushiya kobeyinhloko yamajaji, uRaymond Zondo, othathe umhlalaphansi ekupheleni kwenyanga eyedlule.Amaqembu ezepolitiki nezinhlaka zezobulungiswa bathe balindele lukhulu kuJaji Maya.Inhlangano eqapha ukusebenza kwamajaji, iJudges Matter, ithe ziningi izinselelo ezisabhekene nezobulungiswa.UMnuz Mbekezeli Benjamin weJudges Matter, uthe inkinga enkulu imayelana nokuphathwa kwezinkantolo.UBenjamin uthe uZondo uzamile ukuyilungisa le nkinga kule minyaka emibili ephethe."Kodwa ke usazisile ukuthi ugcine engakwazanga ukuyilungisa, wayesazama ukubonana nomengameli. Manje uMaya kufanele aqhubeke nalolu daba. Sizimisele ukusebenzisana naye sizophinde siqaphe ukusebenza kwakhe.”UBenjamin uthe nakuba ezobulungiswa zibhekene nezinselelo eziningi uyakuncoma ukuzimela kwazo.Inhlangano ehola uhulumeni wokubambisana, i-ANC, ithe ukuthatha izintambo kweJaji Maya kufakazela ukuthi ukusebenza ngokuzikhandla kuzala impumelelo.Okhulumela i-ANC, uMnuz Zuko Godlimpi, uthe uMaya uyisibonelo esihle ezweni."Uzinikele emsebenzini wakhe. Uzokuba owesifazane wokuqala ukungena kulesi sikhundla. Lokhu kufeza izifiso ze-ANC zokuba kube nezinguquko, abesifazane baqokelwe ezikhundleni zokuphatha kuzo zonke izinhlaka zomphakathi. Simfisela inhlanhla njengoba ethatha lolu hambo. Siyazibophezela ekumesekeni ngayo yonke indlela.”I-ActionSA ithe ukuthatha kukaMaya kuyinto enkulu emlandweni wakuleli.Umholi we-ActionSA ePhalamende, uMnuz Athol Trollip, uthe ukuthatha kukaMaya kufanele kuze nezinguquko ezinqala kwezobulungiswa."Kufanele sifunde kulokhu esidlule kukhona, bese sithuthukisa ukusebenza kwezobulungiswa.”Bobabili uGodlimpi noTrollip baphinde bancoma iqhaza likaZondo abathe uyibambe ishisa.Bathe uZondo wakwazi ukwenza umsebenzi wakhe ngokungesabi yize kwakukhona ababemchapha ngazo zonke izinhlamba.UMaya waqokwa uMengameli, uCyril Ramaphosa, ngoJulayi.Ubeyiphini lenhloko yamajaji, nokuyisikhundla aqokelwa kuso ngo-2022.Ngaphambi kwalokho ubengumengameli weNkantolo yezokuDluliswa kwamaCala kuleli, nokuyisikhundla aqokelwa kuso ngo-2017.
ISIPHENDUKE inkomo yomqhoyiso eyokuxoshwa kwemeya yaKwaDukuza, uNksz Lindile Nhaca, izinhlaka ze-ANC azivumelani ngalolu daba, naye uNksz Nhaca akavumi ukwehla esikhundleni.UNksz Nhaca useludlulisele kunobhala jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, udaba lokuxoshwa kwakhe, ukhala ngokuthi uboshelwa amanqina enyathi.Izinhlaka ze-ANC esifundeni iGeneral Gizenga Mpanza, i-ANC Women’s League (ANCWL) neYouth League (ANCYL), seziphumele obala zaphikisa isinqumo sokuxoshwa kukaNksz Nhaca.Isinqumo sokuxoshwa kukaNksz Nhaca, esiyingxenye yezinguquko ezizokwenziwa ebuholini bomkhandlu, simenyezelwe unobhala we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Bheki Mtolo, ngoLwesihlanu.UMtolo watshela abezindaba ukuthi umhlangano wesigungu esiphezulu kwi-ANC uthathe isinqumo sokwenza izinguquko ebuholini bomkhandlu ukuze kube nozinzo.UMtolo wenza le simemezelo nje ngoJulayi kwaputshuka inkulumo yakhe lapho ayetshela amakhansela e-ANC kulo mkhandlu ukuthi uNksz Nhaca uzokhonjwa indlela.Ngesikhathi ekhuluma emhlanganweni namakhansela, uMtolo wathi esikhaleni sikaNksz Nhaca bazofaka uMnuz Njabulo Cele, oyikhansela le-ANC emkhandlwini.Encwadini ayibhalele uMbalula, uNksz Nhaca ukhale ngokuthi akazange anikezwe ithuba lokuziphendulela ezinsolweni abekwa zona."Ziningi izinsolo ezenziwe uMtolo ngami engibala kuzo nalezo azenza ngesikhathi ehlangene namakhansela e-ANC KwaDukuza. Ngikugwemile ukuthi ngiyomphendula esidlangaleni. Sekuyacaca manje ukuthi ngiboshelwa amanqina enyathi.”UNksz Nhaca uthe umhlangano wesigungu esiphezulu esifundeni iGeneral Gizenga Mpanza wasichitha isiphakamiso sokuthi axoshwe.UMasipala waKwaDukuza iwona onesabelomali esiningi komasipala abangaphansi kukaMasipala wesiFunda Ilembe njengoba isabelomali sakulo nyaka singu-R2.7 billion.I-ANCWL ne-ANCWL esifundeni iGeneral Gizenga babe nesithangami nabezindaba ngokuhlanganyela, lapho begxeke khona imizamo yokuxosha uNksz Nhaca.Usihlalo we-ANCWL esifundeni, uNkk Malindi Zondi, uthe ukwenza izinguquko kuMasipala waKwaDukuza kungaphazamisa i-ANC kubo bonke omasipala abasesifundeni Ilembe.UNkk Zondi uthe umkhandlu usebenza kahle ebuholini bukaNksz Nhaca.Usole uMtolo ngokubukela phansi ubuholi besifazane.Umdidiyeli we-ANCYL esifundeni, uMnuz Ndabenhle Mzoneli, uthe abafuna ukuxosha uNksz Nhaca kufanele babize umhlangano wesigungu esiphezulu esifundeni, kuxoxwe lolu daba."Umthetho we-ANC usho njalo. Asikho isinqumo esike sathathwa ubuholi be-ANC esifundeni obuthi akuxoshwe imeya. Imeya isebenza kahle, ngakho asikho isidingo sokuthi ixoshwe.”
KUZOBIZWA ofakazi abangu-13 ecaleni lowesilisa waseFolweni obhekene necala lokudlwengula nokusoconga okuthiwa wakwenza kowesifazane ngesikhathi somvalelandlini.UMnuz Samkelo Victus Dube (29) usolwa ngokudlwengula abulale uNksz Sibahle Faith Biyela (17), ngokumgwaza esiphongweni ngesikrudrayva, esigamekweni okuthiwa senzeka ngo-Okthoba 5, 2020.UDube kuthiwa wayevakashelwe nguNksz Biyela endlini yakhe eseFolweni kade embizile ukuthi bazohlala ndawonye baphuze utshwala.Umufi kuthiwa wafika nomngani wakhe, uNksz Thandiwe Princess Shange.UDube ubevele izolo eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini, nokuyilapho uMshushisi, uSenior State Advocate Khatija Essack eveze ukuthi kuzobizwa ofakazi abangu-13 kuleli cala elizoqala ukuqulwa namhlanje.Phakathi kofakazi abazobizwa uMshushisi, uthe kubalwa iphoyisa elafika endaweni yesigameko, udokotela wasemakhazeni asePark Rynie nomngani kamufi, uNksz Shange.Sebeqedile ukuphuza, kuthiwa uDube wacela uNksz Biyela ukuthi baye ocansini, okuyinto umufi okuthiwa wayenqaba ethi akalali nendoda angathandani nayo.Kuthiwa baphuza kwaze kwaba yiphakathi kwamabili.Enkantolo, kuvele ukuthi lokhu kwamnenga uDube wase edonsela ngenkani egumbini lakhe uNksz Biyela wamdlwengula. Ngemuva kwalokho wamgwaza washonela khona lapho.Ngemuva kwalokho waphuma wahubha uNksz Shange naye wamgwaza kodwa wasinda wacela empunzini. UNksz Shange kuthiwa wakubona konke okwakwenzeka egumbini likaDube.UDube kuthiwa wagcwala amathafa kodwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi wagcina esekhalelwa ngamasongo kaSingonyela.Uke wasifaka isicelo sebheyili kodwa inkantolo yamchitha. Kuvele nokuthi uDube babengamathe nolimi nomufi kodwa wayengakaze amshele.
KUDONSWE ngendlebe izintombi ngokubaluleka kokuzigcina zizitombi nokuthi zigxile emfundweni.Lokhu kuvele ngesikhathi kunomcimbi wokulungiselela ukuya eMkhosini woMhlanga obukwaHlabisa ngeSonto.Induna yezintombi okunguNksz Andile Zuma uthe kubalulekile ukuthi amatshitshi aziqhenye ngobuntombi bawo agxile emfundweni ukuze abenekusasa eliqhakazile.IZINTOMBI nto ebezilulekwa ngkuziphatha nokugxila emfundweni emcimbini owandulela uMkhosi Womhlanga obukwaHlabisa Isithombe: SITHUNYELWE"Isikole sibaluleke kakhulu. KUGQUGQUZELWE ababhalisele i-Unemployment Insurance Fund (UIF) ukuba baye emahhovisi omnyango wezabasebenzi ukuze basizakale.Lokhu kuza emuva kokumiswa kwezinsiza ze-UIF ukuba zitholakale kumakhompyutha (online) nakumaselula njengoba inkantolo inqume ukuthi akumiswe inkampani ebhekelele lezi zinsiza.UMnyango wezabaSebenzi wathula uhlelo lokuthola izinsiza ze-UIF online nakumaselula ukuze unciphise olayini abade emahhovisi awo. Abantu abafaka izicelo ze-UIF yilabo abasuke bephelelwe wumsebenzi, abakhulelwe nabanye abasuke begunyazwa wumthetho ngenxa yezimo ababhekene nazo.UNgqongqoshe wezemiSebenzi, uNkk Nomakhosazana Meth, uthe njengoba inkantolo imise le nkampani kusho ukuthi okwamanje izinsiza ze-UIF ngeke zithokakale online, ngeke zenzeke nakumaselula."Sicela abantu baye emahhovisi oMnyango wezemiSebenzi ukuze bathole izinsiza ze-UIF. Sizolula nesikhathi sokusebenza ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bayasizakala. Siyazi vele ukuthi ukungatholakali kwezinsiza online kuzoholela ekutheni kugcwale abantu emahhovisi,” kusho uNkk Meth.Uxolisile kubantu ngokuphazamiseka okudalwa wukungatholakali kwezinsiza ze-UIF online, esho ukuthi bekufanele balandele isinqumo senkantolo.Uthembise ukuthi uzosebenzisana nezinhlaka ezifanele ukuze enze isiqiniseko sokuthi isimo esinjengalesi asiphindi sibe khona."Sicela abantu basibekezelele ngesikhathi sisalungisa lolu daba lokutholakala kwezinsiza ze-UIF online. Sizobazisa abantu ukuthi kwenzekani ngesikhathi esifanele, uma sezibuya izinsiza. Siyaxolisa ngokuphazamiseka okube khona,” kusho uNkk Meth.

Into emcasulile wukuthi bengivalelisa komunye wabangani bethu, sishayana ngesinqanda sasemoyeni kanti uzocikeka," kusho umgilwa.Uthe akazange anake ukuthi ulwandle selugcwele kumsakazi ngesikhathi bephuma kule ndawo bebheke emotweni, kwaze kwaba wukuthi sebephakathi emotweni yaqala ingxabano."Ubethukuthele egane unwabu, engisola ngokushendeza naloya mngani, ethi besingeke sivalelisane ngale ndlela uma kungenzeki lutho phakathi kwethu. Indaba yonakale esefonela lo mngani ethi angikhulume naye ngenkani ukuze abone ukuthi akwenzeki lutho phakathi kwethu. Nginqabile, ngavala ucingo kanti sengizithintele,"Lo mlisa uthe lo msakazi umgqeme ngebhodlela lotshwala ebusweni, maqede wagibela kuye ngezibhakela ethukuthele. Uthe kulamule abantu abebedlula ngendlela, behamba ngemoto iPolo, abafike babuza ukuthi kwenzenjani kwayima esuka kuyena.Lo mgilwa uthe waphuma emotweni, waqopha ivideo (Isolezwe elinayo nezithombe) ukuze abe nobufakazi. Kule-video kubonakala owesilisa ehleli phezu komsakazi, umsakazi ekhala ethi kungcono ambulale.Lo umlisa obemcindezela uzwakala ethi qhubekani nokulwa kwenu. Umsakazi ubize lo mlisa abexabana naye ngegama emnxusa ukuthi angene emotweni ukuze amhambise esibhedlela, kodwa wenqaba lo mlisa, wathi akasahambi naye. Kwenye-ivideo lo msakazi, obezwakala njengomuntu oweqiwe amambawu, unxuse asolwa ngokumshaya ethi akayeke ukuqopha i-video. Umsakazi kubikwa ukuthi ujahe lo mlisa abehamba naye, efuna ukumphuca iselula ukuze asuse i-video, washiya imoto iduma, babuya abafana be-Polo, bashaya bachitha nemoto yomsakazi.Ethintwa umsakazi ucingo lwakhe beluvaliwe kanti nomlayezo athunyelelwe wona akazange awuphendule.Kwenzeka lokhu-nje uKhozi FM lunomkhankaso wokulwa neGBV nodlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane nezingane unyaka wonke.UNksz Mmoni Seapolelo Okhulumela iSABC uthe usalinde umbiko ehhovisi laseKZN ngalolu daba.

Ingakho singeke sivume ukuzwa ngabo.”Enye ingozi yemoto edlule nemiphefumulo yabathathu yenzeke KwaDukuza.

IZODLIWA yizembe imeya, uNksz Lindile Nhaca, njengoba ubuholi be-ANC KwaZulu-Natal sebuqale izinhlelo zokwenza izinguquko ebuholini obuphezulu bomkhandlu.Isinqumo sokwenza izinguquko ebuholini bomkhandlu sithathwe emhlanganweni wesigungu esiphezulu kwi-ANC KwaZulu-Natal.Unobhala we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Bheki Mtolo, uthe izinguquko zizothinta ubuholi obuphezulu bomkhandlu obaziwa nge-troika. I-troika kuba imeya, iphini lemeya nosomlomo.Usomlomo womkhandlu uNkk Dolly Govender, kanti iphini lemeya lona alikaze likhethwe kusukela kwashona uMnuz Thulani "Mbazo” Ntuli, ngonyaka owedlule.Imihlangano yokuzama ukukhetha ozongena esikhundleni sephini lemeya yabhuntsha ngenxa yokungavumelani kwamakhansela e-ANC.Isigungu esiphezulu kwi-ANC KwaZulu-Natal sithatha lesi sinqumo nje uNksz Nhaca ubevele esehleli ngesinqe esisodwa.Ngenyanga eyedlule kwaputshuka inkulumo kaMtolo, lapho ayethi khona kufanele uNksz Nhaca asuswe esikhundleni bese kufakwa elinye ikhansela le-ANC, uMnuz Njabulo Cele.Izolo uMtolo akazange afune ukudalula amagama abazokhishwa nabazongena ezikhundleni.UMtolo uthe bakhethe ukwenza izinguquko ngoba befuna ukubuyisa uzinzo kulo mkhandlu."Kubalulekile kakhulu ukuthi njengoba sibheke okhethweni lohulumeni basekhaya lwango-2026, siqinisekise ukuthi kunozinzo kuyo yonke imikhandlu ephethwe i-ANC. Sizokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi sibuyisa isithunzi se-ANC, siphinde sihambise izidingo.”UMtolo uthe bazophinde benze izinguquko nasemakomitini omkhandlu."Uhlelo lokwenza izinguquko kuMasipala waKwaDukuza sizolwenza ngokuvumelana nehhovisi likanobhala jikelele (uMnuz Fikile Mbalula). Uma sesivumelene nehhovisi likanobhala jikelele, sizobe sesiqhubeka nezinguquko ngokubambisana nobuholi be-ANC esifundeni iGeneral Gizenga Mpanza. Ubuholi besifunda buzokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi akubi khona zihibe ngesikhathi kwenziwa izinguquko.”UMtolo uveze ukuthi i-ANC izophuma umkhankaso wokufuna amaqembu ezobambisana nawo komasipala baKwaZulu-Natal okungekho qembu elaphumelela ngamalengiso.I-ANC ibikade ibambisene ne-EFF komasipala abaningi baKwaZulu-Natal.Umshado we-ANC ne-EFF usuchithekile komasipala baKwaZulu-Natal abaningi, futhi i-ANC isinabangani abasha KwaZulu-Natal, i-IFP, DA, neNFP, ababusa nabo ngokubambisana isifundazwe.UMtolo uthe bazimisele ngokubambisana namanye amaqembu komasipala ukuze kuzokuba nozinzo.Loku bambisana kwabo sekuqalile ukubonakala kuMasipala waseThekwini, lapho ikhansela le-IFP, uMnuz Mdu Nkosi, eqokelwe kwesikasihlalo wekomiti elibhekelele amanzi nogesi.I-ANC isaxoxa neDA kulo mkhandlu, uma izingxoxo ziphumelela, iDA izothola ikomiti elibhekelele ukuhlaliswa kwabantu.UMtolo uthe kuphelile obekubahlanganise ne-EFF."Kunzima ukusebenza nala bantu ngoba balala bephenduka. Ngeke ubathembe, bafana nesimo sezulu.”

UMBALA kapende womuzi wakho wangaphandle, owangaphakathi nefenisha ephakathi kumele kuhambisane nezidingo zakho, awumane ufake noma ikuphi.Lokhu kushiwo uNkk Thandeka Malinga weDefyn Dezign, ongomunye wezikhulumi ezizobe zicobelela izihambeli zomcimbi wabesifazane ohlelwe Isolezwe, iNtandokazi Womens Club ozoba ngo-Okthoba. Udokotela uma esemsebenzini uhlala ebhekene neziguli ezigulayo, ikhaya lakhe kumele libe nemibala emhlophe ezokwenza ukuthi kwehle umoya. KUVELA ukuthi ushadelwe futhi unezingane ezimbili azishiye nenkosikazi yakhe emakhaya eXobho, owesilisa othweswe uxhaxha lwamacala okudlwengula abantu besifazane ehostela eGlebelands eMlaza.UMnuz Khethani Khuboni (31) uvele okokuqala eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMlaza ngoLwesine kanti ubonakale efake indandatho emunweni.Ubhekene namacala angu-18 okudlwengula abantu besifazane abehlukene esebenzisa indlela efanayo.UMNUZ Khethani Khuboni osolwa ngokudlwengula abesifazane abangu-18 eMlaza Isithombe: SIBONELO NGCOBO/INDEPENDENT MEDIAUMbuso ungase wengeze amanye amacala okungawokuthumba nawokuphanga uma esecela ibheyili ngenyanga ezayo.Umsolwa uboshwe ngesikabhadakazi ngoLwesibili endlini amaphoyisa athe ubebhace kuyona ehostela eGlebelands, eMlaza.Kuthiwa uKhuboni ubefunwa amaphoyisa kodwa isehlakalo sokudlwengula, okuthiwa senzeke ngempelasonto, yisona esiholele ekuboshweni kwakhe.Umshushisi uMnuz Khulekani Mzotho usho zisuka wathi uMbuso uzosiphikisa isicelo sebheyili sikaKhuboni.Uthe lokhu bakwenza ngenhloso yokuphephisa abagilwa abamangalele uKhuboni"Iningi labagilwa, bonke okungabantu besifazane, liyamazi umsolwa. Kukholakala ukuthi umsolwa ubekade esebenzisa izindlela eziningi ezihlukene eyenga ngazo abagilwa bese eyabadlwengula,” kusho uMzotho.Emuva kokuthi imantshi ifundele uKhuboni uhla lwamacala asolwa ngawo nokuthi wawenza nini, le ndoda ibe isidlana indlebe nommeli wayo wamahhala.Ummeli utshele inkantolo ukuthi uyalelwe uKhuboni ukuthi ufuna ukucela ibheyili.Isolezwe lihoshe ngomthombo walo ukuthi uKhuboni akasebenzi, uhlala ehostela futhi ushadelwe unezingane ezzimbili eXobho. Ehostela kuthiwa ubehlala nentombi Isolezwe elithole ukuthi ikhulelwe. Kuthiwa ubefike ayenge abesifazane bese eyabadlwengula abaphange amaselula abo.Enkantolo kuvele ukuthi icala lokuqala lenzeka ngoDisemba 11, 2021. Usolwa ngokudlwengula abesifazane ababili ngosuku olulodwa ngoDisemba ngonyaka odlule. UKhuboni usolwa ngokudlwengula abesifazane abathathu kule nyanga kanti kuthiwa wadlwengula oyedwa ngenyanga efanayo ngonyaka odlule.Beyibukeka izikhululekele le ndoda ebifaswe ngozankosi ngesikhathi iqhutshwa amaphoyisa iphuma nangesikhathi ibuyiselwa esitokisini. Ngisho eseshuthwa ubengazifihli ubuso kodwa ezifakele isigqoko asikhumule esengaphakathi enkantolo. Ngaphakathi enkantolo bekukhona owesifazane abonakale ekhuluma naye esephuma enkantolo baze bahambisana baze bakhuzwa amaphoyisa ukwathiwa owesifazane akabuyele eceleni.Owesifazane ubebonakala ekhathazekile, yize bekungacaci ukuthi ubefunani kumsolwa kodwa kubonakale sengathi bebengavumelani enkulumeni yabo. Isolezwe lithole ngomthombo walo ukuthi abanye abagilwa ubebaheha ezinkundleni zokuxhumana. Ngaphambi kokuthi aboshwe kuthiwa utholwe neselula yowesifazane amaphoyisa aveze ukuthi ubemdlwengule ngeSonto ebusuku. Umbiko wamaphoyisa uveze ukuthi owesifazane uqale ukuxhumana naye kwi-internet base bexoxa bavumelana ngokuthi bazohlangana. Sebehlangana baya enkundleni esehostela eGlebe lapho umsolwa kuthiwa waba nodlame wadlwengula owesifazane. Emuva kwesigameko umsolwa wathatha iselula kamgilwa wamnika i-sim card yakhe. Icala lihlehliselwe uSepthemba 5 nonyaka ukuze acele ibheyili.

Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) certificates are a fundamental technology for securing online communications. SSL certificates are small data files that digitally bind a cryptographic key to an organization’s details.When installed on a web server, they activate the padlock and the HTTPS protocol, ensuring secure connections between a web server and a browser.In simpler terms, SSL certificates encrypt data transmitted between users and websites, protecting sensitive information from being intercepted by malicious actors.Why SSL Certificates are Essential for South African WebsitesImproving SecurityThe primary reason every website in South Africa needs an SSL certificate is security. In an era where cybercrime is on the rise, protecting users' data is paramount.SSL certificates encrypt information such as personal details, credit card numbers, and login credentials, making it difficult for cybercriminals to access or tamper with the data.This level of security is essential for e-commerce websites, banking portals, and any platform where users share sensitive information.Building Trust and CredibilityWeb users are becoming increasingly aware of online security. When they visit a website, they often look for the padlock symbol in the address bar, indicating that the connection is secure.Websites with an SSL certificate display this symbol, along with "HTTPS" in the URL, which helps in building trust and credibility with visitors.In contrast, sites without SSL certificates are marked as "Not Secure" by browsers, deterring potential customers and reducing traffic. For South African businesses, establishing trust is essential for retaining customers and attracting new ones, making SSL certificates a vital component.Improving Search Engine RankingsGoogle and other search engines prioritize user safety, and as part of this commitment, they favour HTTPS websites in their search algorithms. Websites with SSL certificates are more likely to rank higher in search engine results, leading to increased visibility and traffic.For businesses in South Africa looking to improve their online presence and attract more customers, having an SSL certificate can provide a competitive edge in search engine optimization (SEO).Complying with Data Protection RegulationsSouth Africa has implemented the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA), which regulates how organizations collect, store, and manage personal information. SSL certificates help websitescomply with these regulations by ensuring that data is encrypted during transmission, protecting it from unauthorized access.Non-compliance with POPIA can result in hefty fines and legal repercussions, making SSL certificates not just a security measure but also a legal requirement for businesses operating in South Africa.Types of SSL CertificatesDomain Validated (DV) CertificatesDV certificates are the most basic type of SSL certificate, offering encryption and a basic level of validation. They are quick to issue and are ideal for small businesses and personal websites.Organization Validated (OV) CertificatesOV certificates provide a higher level of validation compared to DV certificates. They require more thorough vetting of the organization’s identity and are suitable for websites where visitors need assurance about the legitimacy of the business.Extended Validation (EV) CertificatesEV certificates offer the highest level of validation and security. They involve a rigorous vetting process and provide a green address bar in browsers, indicating the highest level of trust. These certificates are ideal for e-commerce sites and organizations handling sensitive transactions.ConclusionSSL certificates are indispensable for websites in South Africa. As cyber threats continue to evolve, having an SSL certificate is no longer optional but a necessity for any website that values the safety and trust of its users. Investing in the right type of SSL certificate can significantly benefit businesses by protecting data, building credibility, and driving traffic to their sites.
INKANTOLO yeMantshi yasePitoli igwebe umlisa odabuka eMalawi uMlotha Nelson Usale (59) ophinde abe ngumfundisi weGods Chapel Church iminyaka engu-10 ebhadla ejele ngamacala okweba ingqalasizinda ebalulekile neminyaka engu-8 ngamacala amathathu okukhwabanisa.Kusukela ngo-2021 kuya kuMeyi 2022, u-Usale ubehola iqembu lemigulukudu elintshontsha amabhethri ezinkampanini ezahlukene ze-network yakwaVodacom ne-MTN ezweni lonke, eshintsha indlela yokuphatha amabhethri kubakhiqizi abahlukene, aphinde apende amabhokisi ebhethri ezama ukufihla imvelaphi yangempela yamabhethri ukwenza kubukeke sengathi amabhethri elanga athengiswayo.Ngemuva kwalokho, lawa mabhethri ubewadayisela abathengi ngokufaka izikhangiso ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ngaphansi kwebhizinisi elibizwa nge-SOLAR MART ne-SUN SHOP.Uma ikhasimende selithengi lawa mabhethri ubeletha ngokusebenzisa izimoto ezikhokhelwa ngebanga. Kungalula ukuwalawula uma uhulumeni esebenzisana nathi.”Ukugcizelele ukuthi bona abaziphazamisi izinhlelo zokwakha ngakho akufanele bahlanganiswe ne-construction mafia.Uthe amaphoyisa kufanele abophe abaphula umthetho. UBEPHILA impilo yobukhazikhazi, ezikhangisa ngokuhweba ngeForex omunye wabasolwa ababhekene necala lokubulala ngesihluku abesifazane ababili eKenville ngempelasonto.Izidumbu zabangani, oNksz Anele Mbokazi noNksz Zizipho Gabisa zitholwe zidindilizile kule ndawo. Uma ngithi ngilandele, uzofana nami, ngisuke ngikhuluma ngento enje,” esho eveza imfumbamfumba yemali engamaphepha ekhalibhothini. Kukhona lapho eveza khona izinhlobonhlobo zezimoto zakhe zenani eliphezulu. Uphinde avele esezindaweni zomntakabani. Kuleli cala uboshwe nomngani wakhe, uMnuz Sandile Chili, ongumsolwa wesibili. Bobabili bebelokhu beqalaza emumva, bebuka ukuthi obani abeze enkantolo.Isolezwe liqaphele ukuthi bekukhona imindeni yabasolwa kuphela, ingekho eyabagilwa.Ithintwa imindeni yabagilwa ithe iphansi phezulu namalungiselelo emingcwabo.Ngosuku lwesigameko, abasolwa kuthiwa bahamba bayolanda abafi emakubo eRiverview Park, eVerulam kwayiwa ebumnandini.Kuvela ukuthi abasolwa babashela abafi ngenhloso yokuthi kugcine kuyiwe ocansini, nokwathi uma kungasenzeki lokho, abasolwa babathatha abafi bayobadubulela eKenville.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi abagilwa nabasolwa bazane emasontweni amabili edlule, kuhlanganwa ememulweni othize.UNksz Mbokazi kuthiwa ubengumhlengikazi esibhedlela iGeneral Gizenga Mpanza Memorial (Stanger Hospital) kuthi uNksz Gabisa abe yi-pharmacist esibhedlela esizimele eMhlanga. UGQUGQUZELE abesifazane ukuthi basukume bazethembe ngoba banamandla uPastor Lungi M obesiyikhulumi esiqavile emcimbini wokubungaza abesifazane obuku-ward-4 eThalaneni, eNkandla, ngoMsombuluko.Bekuphume nesinedolo kulo mcimbi obekunandisa kuwo umculi wowokholo uFikile Mlomo futhi uhanjelwe inkosi yesizwe sakwaKhanyile, uNdlunkulu uSnqobile Khanyile. Obekuseqhulwini kulo mcimbi obuhlelwe uMasipala waseNkandla bekuwukuqhakambisa ukubaluleka komuntu wesifazane njengoba isiqubulo somcimbi besithi; Zethembe Ungowesifazane Onamandla."Uma ungumuntu wesifazane kumele wazi ukuthi uwubani, ngoba uma ungazazi wena, uzovumela abantu bakuchaze ukuthi ungubani. Inkinga uma abantu bekuchaza ukuthi ungubani, lokho akulona iqiniso ngoba awudalwanga yibona. Uma uzotshelwa umphakathi, uzothola izinto ezingelona iqiniso ngawe futhi uma uzotshelwa umndeni oganele kuwo, bazokuqamba igama elithi ungumakoti, bese beyakuchazela ngoba wena awuzazi ukuthi kusho ukuthini ukuthi ungumakoti,” kusho uLungi M.Uthe umuntu wesifazane ungumkhiqizo owadalwa uNkulunkulu."Umuntu wesifazane kunencwadi ebizwa ngeBhayibheli ewumqondo kaNkulunkulu, owamdalayo. UNkulunkulu wasinika amandla ukuze izinto ezenziwa owesifazane zilunge. Yingakho uma izinkinga zikuhlasele, uzibone uvuka, uvuswa amandla kaNkulunkulu avalelwe kumuntu wesifazane,” usho kanje.Iphini leMeya yaseNkanda, uNkk Nonhlanhla Nzuza, likhuluma nabezindaba, lithe obengekho kulo mcimbi uphuthelwe."Sidle ngokwendlebe nangokomoya okwenza ukuthi sakheke ngoba sinezinto eziningi esizithwele emahlombe singabantu besifazane."Imizi kumele yakhiwe, izingane zikhuliswe ngendlela noma ngabe kunzima kangakanani ngoba sitholile ukuthi umuntu wesifazane uphiwe amandla okuthi noma izinto zilukhuni kodwa abhekane nazo. Lo mcimbi wembule okunye kwabebezitshela ukuthi size emcimbini nje kodwa kuvele kwashintsha kwaba yinkonzo emnandi ngoba thina singomama abakholwayo,” usho kanje.Khonamanjalo uNksz Buyenzeni Sikhakhane oyisakhamuzi ebesihambele umcimbi uthe bayabonga ngokwenzekile kodwa bacela umasipala ubakhele ihholo lomphakathi eMbizo, eKukhanyeni. "Sihlangana phansi kwesihlahla futhi sicela nomasipala usisize ngokuqeqesha intsha ngamakhono endaweni,” kusho uNksz Sikhakhane.
YIZE obeyisikhulu soMnyango wezoLimo eCedara ehambe emhlabeni engakutholanga ukuhlonishwa ngeziqu zobudokotela kodwa imibhalo yakhe inothise imisebenzi eminingi yezobuciko. SIKHULU isililo ngokudlula emhlabeni kwemenenja kaMasipala waseDumbe, uMnuz John Khumalo.UKhumalo ushone engozini yemoto eyenzeke phakathi kwedolobha iDumbe neVryheid, ngoLwesithathu, ekuseni.Imininingwane yengozi edlule nomphefumulo kaKhumalo ayicacile kahle.Izithombe ezisabalale ezinkundleni zokuxhumana zikhombise imoto kaKhumalo nenye ukuthi zitholane mahlanze.Zombili izimoto bezishayiseke kakhulu ngaphambili, enye yazo ibilele ngohlangothi.UKhumalo uchazwe njengesikhulu ebesizinikele emsebenzini waso futhi sikwazi ukusebenza nawo wonke amaqembu ezepolitiki.UKhumalo usebenze kulo mkhandlu kuphethe i-IFP, nangesikhathi kuphethe i-ANC, njengoba manje sekuphethe iNFP.USotswebhu we-NFP esifundeni iZululand, uMnuz Siphamandla Ntombela, uthe bagqemeke engeqiwa ntwala ngokushona kukaKhumalo."Ibuhlungu indaba kaMntungwa, umuntu obezinikele ekusebenzeleni umphakathi, ubenothando nentobeko. Ziningi izindawo uKhumalo asebenze kuzo. Umsebenzi ubewenza ngokwethembeka.”UNtombela uthe uKhumalo ubesebenza nabo bonke abaholi bamaqembu ehlukene."UMntungwa usebenzile ebuholini be-IFP, obe-ANC nobe-NFP. Ubekwazi ukuhlukanisa ipolitiki yobuqembu nomsebenzi kahulumeni. Zimbalwa izimenenja zomasipala ezisebenze ngaphansi kwamaqembu ahlukene. Uyingxenye yabambalwa abasebenze ngokwethembeka emaqenjini ehlukene. UNtombela uthe ngeke bawakhohlwe amagalelo kaKhumalo."Sifisa ukukhalela umkakhe, izingane zakwabo, izingane zakhe, umndeni kanye noMkhandlu waseDumbe. Sisadumele namanje ngalezi zindaba esivuke ngazo.”UKhumalo uyindodana yengwevu ye-IFP engasekho, uMnuz Zakhele 'MZ’ Khumalo, owayengunobhala wezokuphatha kwi-IFP futhi esondelene kakhulu nomsunguli wale nhlangano, inkosi Mangosuthu Buthelezi.Imizamo yokuthola iMeya kaMasipala waseDumbe, uMnuz Sibusiso Mkhabela, ayizange iphumelele njengoba ucingo lwakhe belukhala lungabanjwa futhi engazange ayiphendule imiyalezo ayithunyelwe.Kanjalo nemizamo yokuthola umndeni ayizange iphumelele.
UKUSHAYELE ihlombe ukufakwa kwemibhoshongo yamaselula eyisishiyagalombili eMkhanyakude umphakathi wakule ndawo.Inkampani yamaselula, iMTN imemezele ukuthi isiqedile ukufaka imibhoshongo ezindaweni ezehlukene ezakhele uMkhanyakude, okukhona kuzo neManguzi, okudlula kuyo izimoto ezebiwe ziyiswa eMozambique.Osethimbeni elilwa nobugebengu bokweqiswa kwezimoto emngceleni, uMnuz Joseph Ngubane, uthe iMTN ibasisizile ngokufaka imibhoshongo."I-network eManguzi iyinkinga. Ihlupha impela nje, wagudluka kancane edolobheni, ayisekho. Lokhu kuzosilekelela kakhulu,” kusho uNgubane.Uqhube wathi kona ubugebengu bokweqiswa kwezimoto emngceleni abusebubi njengakuqala."Kusukela kwalethwa ithimba lamaphoyisa azobhekana ngqo nalobu bugebengu, sibona kukhona umehluko omkhulu,” kusho uNgubane.Enza isibonelo uthe, emasontweni amabili edlule kubanjwe izimoto ezimbili ngaseHluhluwe."Zombili zibanjwe ziyokweqiswa umngcele,” kusho uNgubane.Uthe ithimba lamaphoyisa, lisekhona namanje futhi liyasebenza impela.Oyisikhulu esiphezulu eMTN KwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Busi Dlamini uthe ngokufaka le ngqalasizinda benzela ukuthi kube lula ukuxhumana kubantu bendawo, kuphinde kube lula ukuthi izinhlaka ezehlukene zilwe nobugebengu bokweqiswa kwezimoto emngceleni."Isifunda saseMkhanyakude siyaziwa ngobugebengu bokweqiswa kwezimoto emngceleni. Enye yezingqinamba zezinhlaka ezilwa nalobu bugebengu bekuba i-network, ebiyenza kube nzima ukuthi kulwiwe kalula nobugebengu,” kusho uNkk Dlamini.Uthe ukufakwa kwemibhoshongo kuzokwenza ukuthi kuxhumaneke kalula, abezinkampani zama-tracker abheka ukuhamba kwezimoto basebenze kalula kanjalo nokubikwa kobugebengu kufinyelele ngesikhathi esifanele ezinhlakeni.Ubugebengu bokwebiwa kwezimoto buke badla lubi eManguzi. Kuke kwaba nemibiko yokuthi abahamba ngezimoto ezingamaveni amakhulu kule ndawo, bebengenelwa emakhaya, baphucwe izimoto zabo. Kulezo zigameko, abagilwa bekuke kwenzeke ukuthi bathathwe bayolahlwa emahlathini akude.Isigamekoi esadonsa amehlo abaningi, kwaba esokudutshulwa kukaMnuz Judah Mthethwa, owayesekhaleni lokulwa nalobu bugebengu. UMthethwa wangenelwa ekhaya lakhe wadutshulwa. Nokho bagwetshwa ngasekuqaleni kwalo nyaka abalahlwa yicala lokumbulala.
AKEKHO ozolahlekelwa wumsebenzi njengoba sekuhlanganiswe izikhungo ezine zikahulumeni zaba yizikhungo ezimbili.UMphathiswa wezokuThuthukiswa koMnotho, ezokuVakasha neMvelo KwaZulu-Natal, uMfu Musa Zondi, wethule ngokusemthethweni i-KZN Economic Regulatory Authority (KZNERA) esungulwe emuva kokuhlanganiswa kwe-KZN Liqour Authority ne-KZN Gaming and Betting Board.Ubuye wathula ngokusemthethweni iKwaZulu-Natal Tourism and Film Authority (KZNTAFA) esungulwe emuva kokuhlanganiswa kwe-Tourism KwaZulu-Natal ne-KZN Film Commission.Uthe indlela abalwenze ngayo uhlelo lokuhlanganisa lezi zikhungo akekho ozolahlekelwa wumsebenzi ngoba abantu bafakwe ezikhaleni ezihambisana namakhono abo."Ukuhlanganiswa kwalezi zikhungo kusho ukuthi sizokonga izigidi zamaRandi emaholweni futhi senze umsebenzi ngokushesha. Lezi yizikhungo ezibalulekile ekudaleni amathuba omsebenzi nasekuthuthukiseni umnotho waKwaZulu-Natal. Okuhle wukuthi akekho olahlekelwe wumsebenzi njengoba senza lolu hlelo olwaqala ngo-2015,” kusho uZondi.Uthe kuthathe isikhathi eside ukuhlanganisa lezi zikhungo ngenxa yokuthi abantu bebenexhala lokuthi kungalahleka umsebenzi.Ukhumbuze abaqokiwe ukuphatha lezi zikhungo ukuba bayizisebenzi zomphakathi ngakho kufanele balethe impilo engcono kubantu.Ubalule ukuthi kwesinye isikhathi abantu abasebenzayo baye bangaboni ukuthi kukhona abantu abampofu abadinga usizo, wathi akufanele abanotho bakhohlwe wusizi lwabampofu.UNkk Mbali Myeni ongusihlalo we-KZNERA, uthe ngesikhathi kuqala uhlelo lokuhlanganiswa kwezikhungo zikahulumeni kwakukhona abathukile ngoba bengazi ukuthi bazothinteka kanjani kodwa manje bayabona ukuthi lesi sinyathelo siyawenza umqondo.Uthe ngeke bakhiphe amalayisensi kuphela kodwa bazoqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinhlanga zakuleli ziyangena kule mikhakha abayibhekelele.UMnuz Paulos Ngcobo oyilungu lebhodi le-KZNTAFA, uthe bafuna iKwaZulu-Natal ihehe izivakashi nabazokwenza amafilimu e-Afrika. Lo msebenzi uthe uzokwenzeka kahle njengoba sekuhlanganiswe ezokuvakasha namafilimu.Okwamanje lezi zikhungo zinezikhulu eziphezulu ezisabambile eseKZNTAFA nguMnuz Sibusiso Gumbi kanti eseKZNERA nguNksz Portia Baloyi.IKwaZulu-Natal Growth Fund isibizwa ngeKZN Growth Fund Agency, usihlalo webhodi layo nguDkt Cassius Lubisi, isikhulu esisabambile nguNksz Tshidi Ikaneng.IMoses Kotane Research Institute iyona esizogxila ocwaningweni lwezomnotho, usihlalo weBhodi nguMnuz Thinta Cibane, isikhulu esiphezulu ngu-Dkt Thandeka Ellenson, esisabambile ngu-Adv Thembelihle Mapipa.
KUVELE amagama ezikhulu ezisolwa ngenkohlakalo kufungiswa amalungu amasha e-MK ePhalamende.Phakathi kwamalungu e-MK amasha afungisiwe kukhona igama laloyo owayeyisikhulu esiphezulu e-Eskom, uMnuz Brian Molefe, elaloyo owayeyisikhulu esiphezulu ePrasa, uMnuz Lucky Montana, nelaloyo owayeyisikhulu esiphezulu eTransnet, uMnuz Siyabonga Gama.Laba bobathathu bafungiswe uSomlomo, uNkk Thoko Didiza, izolo.Bonke laba baholi bashiya ezikhundleni zabo belandelwa yifu elimnyama.Amagama abo avela kakhulu ngesikhathi kuqhubeka iKhomishini eyayiphenya izinsolo zokuLawulwa koMbuso yiDlanzana.Okhulumela i-MK, uMnuz Nhlamulo Ndhlela, uncome amagalelo alaba baholi ngesikhathi besaphethe la mabhizinisi kahulumeni.Abanye abaholi be-MK abafungiswe izolo, uMnuz Gezani Kobane, owaziwa ngelikaPapa Penny, okhulumela inhlangano kaZuma engenzi nzuzo, uMnuz Mzwanele Manyi, uMnuz Thulani Gamede, uMnuz Thembinkosi Mjadu, noNksz Nompumelelo Gasa.UNdhlela unxuse zonke izikhulu zikahulumeni ezinamava nezincithabuchopho ukuba zijoyine i-MK."Sisembhidlangweni wokulungiselela ukhetho lohulumeni basekhaya lwango-2026 nokhetho lukazwelonke lwango-2029. Sifuna lusifice sikulungele ukuphatha.”I-MK ifungisa labaholi nje, kusenombango ngokuxoshwa kwamalungu ale nhlangano angu-18.La malungu afaka icala enkantolo ephonsela inselelo ukuxoshwa kwawo.Kunesivimbelo esinqanda i-MK ukuthi ifake abantu ezikhaleni zalaba baholi kuze kube kuphuma isinqumo mayelana nokuxoshwa kwabo.Laba baholi be-MK bafungiswe namalungu e-EFF, oMnuz Sinawo Tambo no-Nazier Paulsen.UTambo no-Paulsen bangena ezikhaleni ezivuleke emva kokuqembuka kukaManyi noFloyd Shivambu, abajoyine i-MK ngeledlule.UNkk Didiza wamukele amalungu amasha, wawayalela ukuba asebenze ngokuzikhandla.
Bavele ngoLwesithathu enkantolo yeMantshi KwaDukuza abasolwa abathathu ababoshelwa ukuphatha izibhamu nezinhlamvu okungekho emthethweni.Kubikwa ukuthi amaphoyisa abelandela umkhondo wowesilisa okuthiwa uphethe izibhamu ezingekho emthethweni ngoLwesibili. Umkhondo wamaphoyisa uwaholele eNhlangwini, KwaDukuza, lapho umsolwa (24) etholwe nezibhamu ezimbili nezinhlamvu eziyisithupha."Umsolwa ubehleli namanye amabhungu amabili aneminyaka engu-20 no-21 nawo aboshiwe ngoba ephethe izinhlamvu ezingu-65 zezibhamu ezahlukene.Isibhamu esisodwa esithathwe kumsolwa wokuqala sisuswe izinombolo zaso. Amaphoyisa azozihlola izibhamu ukuqinisekisa ukuthi azikaze zisebenze kobunye ubugebengu.
UZINIKELE emaphoyiseni usomabhizinisi waseNanda obhekene necala lokudlwengula akhulelise intombazane engumakhelwane wakhe eneminyaka engu-13.Lo somabhizinisi oneminyaka engu-59, inkantolo ekhiphe umyalelo wokuthi igama lakhe ligodlwe ubevele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseNtuzuma ngaleli cala.Kuvele khona enkantolo ukuthi uzinikele yena emaphoyiseni ngesonto eledlule.Kuthiwa unamabhizinisi ahlukene eThekwini nakwezinye izindawo ezingaphandle kweTheku. Kubatshazwa isithabathaba somuzi wakhe okhona eNanda. Akuvelanga ukuthi unamabhizinisi anjani.Kuhlaluka ukuthi uzinikele emaphoyiseni ngemuva kokuba unina kamgilwa emvulele icala esethole ukuthi kwenzekeni. Kuvela ukuthi le ngane bese kuphele isikhathi eside elala nayo.Kuvele ukuthi unina wengane uze wathola ngalokhu ngoba ingane seyikhulelwe kwaba yima eyibuza ukuthi kwenzekani.Usomabhizinisi kuthiwa ubenobudlelwane obuhle nomndeni kamgilwa.UMshushisi elingatholakalanga igama lakhe unxuse inkantolo ukuba iqinisekise ukuthi uthola ubulungiswa umndeni kamgilwa.Isolezwe litholile ukuthi amalungu omphakathi waseNanda ahlela ukumxosha endaweni usomabhizinisi. Akhala ngesenzo sakhe esinobulwane."Kungekudala uzozwa kuthiwa usexoshiwe eNanda ngoba umphakathi ucasukile kakhulu. Ukholwa ukuthi ngeke ukwazi ukuthi ungahlala ndawonye nowesilisa onesibindi sokwenza into efana nalena,'' kuchaza ilungu lomphakathi.Liqhuba lithe umphakathi ukholwa ukuthi aziphephile izingane ezincane zamantombazane uma ezoqhubeka nokuhlala kule ndawo owesilisa uma kuya ngokuthi inkantolo izogcina imnikeza ibheyili.Lithe ngesonto elizayo bazobhikisha ngaphandle kwenkantolo bafake ingcindezi yokuthi usomabhizinisi angayitholi ibheyili.Liveze nokuthi kukhona uqhekeko phakathi kwalo somabhizinisi nomkakhe okhala ngokuthi umthunaze isithunzi sakhe wasiqeda.Elinye ilungu lomphakathi lithe bebemethemba usomabhizinisi bengazi ukuthi ngelinye ilanga kungathiwa ubhekene necala elibucayi ngalolu hlobo.Icala lakhe lihlehliselwe isonto elizayo ukuze acele ibheyili.
KUZOSHINTSHA ukwenza komasipala abashaya udaka kuleli njengoba kuzobunjwa ithimba longqongqoshe abahlukene, abazobhekana ngqo nokulungisa isimo kulabo masipala.Leli thimba lizobhekana nokuguqula izinto kulabo masipala abangenzi kahle abahlale bethola imibiko engemihle yokusebenza kwemali.Lokhu kuvezwe nguNgqongqoshe wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu, uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa, othe leli komiti lizongena ligamanxe kulabo masipala, libheke amava ezikhulu ezijutshwe khona. UHlabisa uthe iKhabhinethi inqume ukuthi kumele kubunjwe leli thimba elizoletha uhlaka lokusebenza ezinsukwini ezingu-21 ezizayo."Uhulumeni wobumbano ubeke eqhulwini eyokulungisa uhulumeni wasekhaya. Ithimba longqongqoshe lizibekele isikhathi sokuthi lilungise isimo, kwezinye izindawo izinyanga ezintathu, kweminye eziyisithupha kuya kwezingu-12,” kusho uHlabisa.Uthe sekusele izinyanga ezingu-26 ngaphambi kokhetho lohulumeni basekhaya, wathi yingakho besebenza ngamandla ukulungisa isimo kulabo masipala.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi uMcwaningi maBhuku Jikelele evele ngaphambi kwekomiti lalo mnyango ePhalamende izolo, lapho bekuthulwa umbiko wokusebenza kwemali komasipala.Iminyango athe iyingxenye yekomiti kubalwa owezokuBusa ngokuBambisana, owezokuHlaliswa kwaBantu, owezaManzi nokuHanjiswa kweNdle, uMnyango kaMgcinimafa, owezokuThutha kanjalo nokaGesi naMandla.UHlabisa uthe uzolinika leli komiti umbiko uma usulungile. Ukhale ngomasipala abangu-10 okubheda uhlelo kubona.UMcwaningi maBhuku Jikelele, uNksz Tsakani Maluleke, uveze ukuthi omasipala abangu-34 kwabangu-257, abathole umbiko omuhle wokusebenza kwemali.UMasipala waseKapa yiwona kuphela umasipala kwabakhulu kuleli abaziwa ngamametro, othole umbiko omuhle wezezimali.KwaZulu-Natal, uMasipala uMhlathuze ungomunye womasipala abathole umbiko omuhle wokusebenza kwezezimali.UNksz Maluleke ukhale ngokuthi omasipala abaningi bathole imibiko esuke inezinto okudingeka zilungiswe."Omasipala abangu-110, bathole umbiko wokusebenza kwezezimali omuhle kodwa kunezinto okudingeka zilungiswe. Omasipala abangu-14 bathole umbiko omubi wokusebenza kanti kudingeka batakulwe kulesi simo.” Ukhale ngokuthi phezu kokuba omasipala abangama-metro benazo zonke izinsiza kodwa ukhathazekile ngokuthi abenzi kahle."Omasipala okubalwa oweTheku, owaseGoli, owase-Ekurhuleni ne-Nelson Mandela Bay, bathole imibiko edinga ukuthi kulungiswe okuthile,” kusho uNksz Maluleke.Ubuye waveza ukuthi kunokuthi isimo sibe ngcono komasipala abathola imibiko emihle siya ngokuba sibi kakhulu.UNksz Hlengiwe Mkhaliphi we-EFF, ukhale ngokuthi isimo siba sibi kunokuthi sibe ngcono komasipala ngokusebenza kwemali.UHlabisa uthe amaqembu ezepolitiki kumele akwazi ukungenelela abuze izimeya ngezikwenzayo emikhandlwini engahambisi ngisho imibiko yokusebenza kwemali.
UFUNA izimpendulo esikoleni umndeni womfundi ka-matric eMpumelelo High, isidumbu sakhe esitholwe sidindilize eceleni komgwaqo eLoskop, eMtshezi, okuthiwa uxoshwe wuthisha emva kokubhadanywa ezivalele nomfundi wesifazane kwelinye igumbi esikoleni, kuqhubeka ikhempu yabafundi baleli banga ngoMgqibelo ebusuku.ULuthando Gama (17) waseLoskop, kuthiwa akabange esafinyelela kubo emva kokuthi ekhonjwe indlela ngomunye wothisha ngesikhathi u-matric ukhempile, kufundwa ngesikhathi esengeziwe, okukholakala ukuthi ushayiswe yimoto.UMnuz Mncedisi Mazibuko onguyisemkhulu kaLuthando, uthe batshelwe abafunda naye ukuthi emva kokubonwa wuthisha evalelene nomfundi wesifazane kwelinye igumbi kuqhubeka ukufunda ebusuku, omunye wothisha ezwa lokho, uthukuthelile wamxosha ethi akabuyele ekhaya."Ngokuzwa kwethu bekungabo-10 ebusuku ngesikhathi exoshwa. Izingane zithi emva kokuthi ebonwe evalelene nomfundi, ubuyele ekilasini, kodwa uthisha umtshele ukuthi ngenxa yesenzo sakhe, akafuni nokumbona, akabuyele ekhaya. Kuthiwa umqhubile waze wayomdlulisa esangweni likanogada enza isiqiniseko sokuthi uyamxosha,” usho kanje.Uthe ngeSonto ekuseni, bengezelele lutho, babone kungena emagcekeni iveni yamaphoyisa, ebazisa ngokutholwa kwesidumbu sikaLuthando, isidumbu sakhe okuthiwa bese sivele sifakwe emakhazeni ngayizolo emva kwesikhashana kwehle umshophi.UMazibuko uthe kuze kwashona ilanga ngeSonto, lutho uthisha ukufika ukuzobika ukuthi kwenzekeni ekubeni isikole siyibanga elingamakhilomitha amathathu nje vo, ukusuka kubo kamufi.Uthe ufike ngoMsombuluko ehambisana nothishomkhulu, wachaza into umndeni ongayiqondi. UMazibuko uveze ukuthi uphikile ukuthi umxoshile umfundi, wathi uthe umlindise egunjini okuhlanganela kulo othisha. Uzihlangule ngokuthi ubesayolanda owesifazane abhadanywe naye ukuze bachaze ukuthi bavalelanelani ngesikhathi sokufunda. Uthisha uthi wabuya engasekho esephumile. Kuthiwa uthisha uthe emva kokumbheka, engamtholi, uqhubekile nokufundisa okuthe emva kwesikhashana bathola ucingo olubazisa ngomfundi ogqoke umfaniswano wesikole sabo oshayiswe yimoto. UMazibuko uthe uthisha uveze ukuthi uzamile ukuyobikela umndeni ngawo uMgqibelo ngosekwehlile kodwa wafika isango livaliwe, wanquma ukubuyela emuva.Umndeni kamufi ukholwa ukuthi uthisha ubengamjezisa ngenye indlela umfundi kunokuthi afake impilo yakhe engcupheni ngoba akukho okuvelayo ukuthi laba bafundi bebelele kodwa babhadanywe nje kuphela omunye uthisha bezivalele kuleliya gumbi, wabikela lo obaxoshileKuthiwa unina kamufi, ungeniswe emtholampilo emva kokuzwa lezi zindaba okukholakala ukuthi kungenxa yokuphatheka kabi.Ngawo uMsombuluko, kuthiwa abafundi kulesi sikole bavuke indlobana kwaphazamiseka izinhlelo zokufunda, bekhala ngesenzo salo thisha sokuxosha umfundi ebusuku.Kushaye isikhathi sokushicilela okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, engayiphendulile imibuzo athunyelelwe yona.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa esiteshini Amangwe, aphenya icala lokubulala ngokungenhloso, emva kokuthi kutholwe isidumbu sowesilisa ona-17, okusolakala ukuthi ushayiswe yimoto.
UMPHAKATHI waseMzinyathi, eNanda, ufuna kuvalwe thaqa ukusebenzisa impophoma kwabelaphi bendabuko, kulandela ukwanda kwezigameko zobugebengu obushaqisayo.Izakhamuzi zakule ndawo zizwakalise ukukhathazeka kwazo emhlanganweni womphakathi ngeSonto, kulandela isigameko sakamumva lapho okutholwe khona isidumbu somuntu ongaziwa egwaziwe.Umufi kuthiwa ubonwe umthandazi obezokwenza izinto zakhe empophomeni ngoLwesine, wahlaba umkhosi emphakathini.Kuthiwa umphakathi uthutheleke khona, wambona umufi entanta emanzini, kwabizwa amaphoyisa, aze amkhipha ngoLwesihlanu emini.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi yize kungacaci ukuthi umufi ubulawe nini kodwa kuthiwa ezinsukwini ezimbalwa ngaphambi kokutholwa kwakhe, kwezwakala umuntu ekhala ecela usizo ebusuku khona empophomeni.Unobhala wohlaka olulwa nobugebengu endaweni, uMnuz Ndumiso Mzobe, uthe akusona esokuqala isigameko esishaqisayo senzeka empophomeni."Emasontweni amabili edlule, umphakathi usize owesifazane obeshaywe kanzima yizigebengu, othe sezimkhiphise u-R20 000 kuwi-app yasebhange kumakhalekhukhwini,” kusho uMzobe.Uqhube wathi ngenyanga edlule kutholwe amathambo omuntu egaxele ematsheni empophoma."Ziningi nje izigameko. Kwezinye kuye kuphucwe bona abelaphi bendabuko nalabo abasuke behamba nabo izimoto, amaselula nemali,” kusho yena.Uthe izigilamkhuba akuzona ezendawo, kodwa zingabantu abangaziwa ababona ithuba lokwenza ubugebengu kubantu abasuke bezokwenza izinto zokwelapha nokwelashwa.Ukhale ngokuthi ubugebengu sebukapakela nasemizini eyakhele impophoma."Uma bebuye belambatha empophomeni, badubela kithina esakhele impophoma, basingenele ezindlini, bathathe noma yini abayifunayo."Yikho sifinyelele ekutheni sivumelane ngokuthi akuvalwe ukusebenza kwempophoma ngoba ubugebengu buya ngokuya buba bubi kakhulu,” kubeka uMzobe.Induna, uThathokwakhe Gumede, ikuqinisekisile ukuthi sibi kakhulu isimo empophomeni."Abantu bahlaselwa yizigebengu ezingaziwa emakhaya, empophomeni kutholwa abantu sebefile, kungaziwa babulawe nini. Lo wakamumva nje njengoba etholwe ngoLwesine, asazi wayebulawe nini. Phambilini, kutholwe amathambo omuntu, naye okungacaci wabulawa nini,” kusho uGumede.UMengameli wenhlangano yabelaphi bendabuko, iSouth Africa's Traditional Healers Association KwaZulu Natal, uMnuz Sazi Mhlongo naye ushaye amakhala ngokuhanjiswa kwabantu ezimpophomeni, wathi kungaba umbono omuhle ukuvalwa kwazo.Uthe izinyanga ezilapha abantu ngendlela yasemandulo, azikaze ziyalelwe ukuthi ziyise abantu ezimpophomeni."Ukwelapha kwezikhathi zamanje sekwangenwa ngisho nayizigebengu, ubona sekwande abantu abayisa abantu ezimpophomeni. Lokhu kubeka sona isiguli nayo inyanga engozini yokugetshengwa. Kwabona bangajikelana bodwa, bagebengane,” kusho uMhlongo.Uphinde wenza isibonelo ngalabo abehlelwa umshophi wokuminziswa yizinyoka zezimpophoma neziziba, athe ukube akuyiwa kule zizindawo, ngabe awuze ungehla umshophi wokugwiliza namanzi,” kusho uMhlongo.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uColonel Robert Netshiunda uthe amaphoyisa aseNanda aphenya idokodo lokufa komuntu emva kokutholwa kwesidumbu somuntu esesonakele empophomeni yaseNanda ngoLwesihlanu. Uthe izimo ezimayelana nalesi sehlakalo zisaphenywa.
UKUTHANDANA nabantu abadala kwezitshudeni kwandisa izigameko zokuhlukunyezwa.Lokhu kushiwo u-registrar (isikhulu) wesikhungo sezemfundo i-Durban University of Technology (DUT), uDkt Maditsane Nkonoane, ngesikhathi ekhuluma nezitshudeni zakule nyuvesi ngesikhathi kunemashi yezitshudeni ekhuza ukuhlukunyezwa ngokobulili, i-Gender Based Violence (GBV), i-Silent March, ebiyizolo.IZITSHUDENI zase-DUT zethamele izikhulumi ebezikhuluma etendeni ngemuva kwemashi i-Silent March, exwayisa ngokuhlukunyezwa ngokobulili ISITHOMBE: SIBONELO NGCOBO/ INDEPENDENT MEDIA ISEKELA Ngqongoshe woMnyango weMfundo ePhakeme, uMnuz Buti Manamela, likhuluma nezitshudeni zase-Durban University of Technology (DUT) emashini, i-Silent March ISITHOMBE : SIBONELO NGCOBO / INDEPENDENT MEDIA ISIKHULU sase-DUT, uDkt Maditsane Nkonoane, sikhuluma emashini nezitshudeni ngesikhathi kunemashi yezitshudeni zakule nyuvesi ekhuza ukuhlukunyezwa ngokobulili ISITHOMBE: SIBONELO NGCOBO/ INDEPENDENT MEDIA "Siyinyuvesi umsebenzi wethu ukuthi uma sinemukela nizofunda nibuyele ekhaya senineziqu zenu, hhayi ukuthi nibuyele emakhaya niyizidumbu. Umkhuba wokuthandana namadoda amadala o-sugar daddy nomama abadala o-sugar mama, abazi ukuthi uma bethandana nezitshudeni banelungelo lokuzilawula. Uma ukulobo budlelwano phuma! Phuma ngoba kulobo budlelwano usengcupheni yohlukumezeka," kuxwayisa uNkonoane.UNksz Silindile Mabonga osesigungwini sabafundi i-SRC, uthe le mashi osekuneminyaka eyishumi yenziwa ngabafundi bakulesi sikhungo iyisikhumbuzo salaba abavalwa imilomo ngokuthi bangakhulumi ngokuhlukunyezwa kwabo."Iyisikhumbuzo sokuthi kumele siqwashe, sikhande indawo ephephile elungele ukuthi sikwazi ukuphilisana sonke, sesekane nokuthi sizame senze isiqiniseko sokuthi abenzi bokubi babhekana nengalo yomthetho.UNkk Thembalethu Fihlela wophiko lwezomthetho e-DUT, uthe kumele kuphele ukuthi uma kuthiwa kunomfundi odlwenguliwe kubuzwe ukuthi ubekuphi, egqokeni."Ukuthi umuntu ubegqokeni akusho ukuthi sekumele adlwengulwe," kusho uNkk Fihlela.IPhini likaNgqongqoshe weMfundo ePhakeme, uMnuz Bhuti Manamela, lithe kunezinto amadoda okumele azazi njengokuthi umzimba wabantu besifazane akuwona owawo."Akukhathalekile ukuthi uwena omondlayo, uma ethi cha kusho ukuthi cha! Akukhathalekile ukuthi cha uwusho ngezwi eliphansi noma uke wavuma wabuye washintsha. Amadoda awawazi ucha," kusho uManamela.Uthe uzwile ukuthi selokhu kwaqalwa le mashi baningi ababika ngokuhlukunyezwa."Kuhle lokho kodwa sifuna kufike esigabeni lapho kuzothiwa azisekho izigameko zokuhlukunyezwa," kusho uManamela.UMnuz Sandiseni Madela ongowesilisa othandana nabobulili obufanayo, uthe abathandana nabobulili obufanayo basahamba beqalaza uma besezindaweni abahlala kuzo noma besemphakathini."Kunenkolelo yokuthi awukwazi ukushintsha indlela odalwe ngayo uma ungowesilisa noma ungowesifazane. Bakholwa ukuthi siyazenzisa ngakho sidinga ukuthi silungiswe ngokuthi sidlwengulwe noma sishaywe," kusho uMadela.
UMCULI wowokholo uFikile Mlomo ubonge uNkulunkulu ngokumnika elinye ithuba njengoba ebonakale okokuqala enandisa emcimbini wokugubha inyanga yabesifazane obuseThalaneni eNkandla.Lo mculi owaziwa ngamacwecwe okukhona kuwo elithi Noma Kunje, Ngiyabonga Mama namanye, ubenandisa okokuqala phambi kwezinkumbi zabantu emva kokuthi ezinyangeni ezintathu ezedlule axinwa wukugula okwaholela ekutheni afe esingezansi, esehamba ngesihlalo. Kwaba kubi ngendlela yokuthi ozakwabo baze bamenzela ikhonsathi yokuqoqa imali ukuze ayohlinzwa esibhedlela iNkosi Albert Luthuli eThekwini.Ekhuluma neSolezwe, uthe ubonga abantu bakuleli ngokumnika uthando ebhekene nokufa. "Abantu basangithanda futhi badinga okunye okuningi kimina. Bangitshengisile lokho ngesikhathi ngigula, bengithumelela imiyalezo befika nasesibhedlela bezongibheka,” usho kanje.Uthe ukugula obekumxinile akumenzanga walahlekelwa ithemba."Besingekho isidingo sokuthi ngitatazele. UNkulunkulu ungidlulise ezintweni eziningi futhi obekungiphethe bengikuthatha njengomkhuhlane odlulayo yize bekukubi ngempela,” usho kanje.Uphinde waqinisa idolo ababhekene noma abadlula ezimweni ezehlukene empilweni ukuthi bangatatazeli, behlise umoya ngoba okusuke kwenzeka kusuke kungesikhona ukuthi kuzobabulala. Uthe ulindele ukuthi aqashwe kakhulu ukuze aqhubeke nokushumayeza abantu ngephimbo lakhe. " Maduze ngizokhipha i-albhamu ezoba ngehlukile ngoba kuyona ngizobe ngilandisa ngohambo lwami noNkulunkulu engidlulisa esigodini sethunzi lokufa,” kusho lo mculi oseke washiyelana inkundla nezingwazi emculweni wokholo.Khonamanjalo, elandisa ngohambo lwakhe kulo mcimbi uFikile, uphinde wadalula ukuthi usinde kukubi ecishe enukubezwa ngokocansi ngempelasonto edlule."Abangaziyo bazobona ukuthi ubuso bami budumbile, anginawo ngisho umakhalekhukhwini ngoba kukhona owesilisa engingamazi obezama ukungidlwengula. Ngize ngamncenga engidonsela ehlathini, ngimbuza ukuthi ngimenzeni ngoba angimazi naye akangazi, yini angathathi lokhu akufunayo bese eshiya umphefumulo wami, kodwa uthe ufuna ukungidlwengula anginqume,” ubeke kanje.Uthe munye umkhuleko awukhulekayo emhlabeni nathe ucela uNkulunklulu amsize axolele abantu besilisa. " Silimele sibaningi singabesifazane ngenxa nje yomuntu wesilisa.”
OWAYENGUNGQONGQOSHE wezoLimo, uNkk Thoko Didiza, usola ungqongqoshe walo mnyango, uMnuz John Steenhuisen, ngokufuna ukubukwa ngodaba lwezinsolo zenkohlakalo kaR500 million.UNkk Didiza uthe uSteenhuisen ukhombise ukuba isakabuli ngokugijima aye kwabezindaba eyothi ufice inkohlakalo yezigidi zamaRandi emnyangweni.Okukhalisa uNkk Didiza ukuthi uSteenhuisen akazange azibalule izinyathelo ezathathwa umnyango ukuphenya lolu daba.Ngempelasonto uSteenhuisen utshele abezindaba ukuthi uR500 million owanikezwa inkampani eyenza imigomo yezilwane, Onderstepoort Biological Products (OBP) akwaziwa ukuthi washonaphi.USteenhuien unezinyanga ezimbili ephethe lo mnyango, imali akhuluma ngayo yakhishwa ngesikhathi kusaphethe uNkk Didiza.Esitatimendeni, uNkk Didiza, osenguSomlomo wePhalamende, uthe ziningi izinyathelo ezathathwa umnyango ngesikhathi kusaphethe yena."Kwenziwa uphenyo olugcwele, emva kwalokho udaba lwabe seludluliselwa ophikweni oluphenya amacala enkohlakalo, iSpecial Investigating Unit. Imininingwane emayelana nalolu daba iyatholakala embikweni wokusebenza kwemali we-OBP.”UNkk Didiza uthe akulungile ukuthi uSteenhuisen akhulume kakhulu ngalolu daba ekubeni kunophenyo olungakaphothulwa."USteenhuisen kufanele aqaphele uma ekhuluma ngoba izinto azishoyo zingagcina zimosha okuningi. Akufanele akhulume ageqe amagula, enze sengathi azikho izinyathelo ezithathiwe ngalolu daba ekubeni kunophenyo oluqhubekayo.”UNkk Didiza uthe usembhalele uSteenhuisen emazisa ngezinyathelo ezathathwa umnyango kanye nekomiti lasePhalamende elibheke ukusebenza komnyango.Uthe ngesikhathi edlulisela izintambo zokuphatha umnyango kuSteenhuisen, wachaza kabanzi ngokusebenza komnyango.UNkk Didiza uthe namanje usazivulile izandla kuSteenhuisen uma kukhona okunye afuna ukukwazi ngalolu daba."Kusobala ukuthi incazelo ebanzi engamnikeza yona ngokusebenza komnyango nezinkampani ezingaphansi kwawo, ayanele. Ingakho ngithi ngizimisele ukwelekelela uSteenhuisen ngezinto ezithinta ukuphathwa komnyango.”Imali uSteenhuisen uthe yayikhishelwe ukwakha kabusha isikhungo esikhiqiza imigomo.Uthe udaba uselubikile kumqondisi jikelele womnyango, wathi ufuna ukuthi kuthathwe izinyathelo."Umcwaningi mabhuku ukhale ngezinto eziningi ezithinta ukusebenza kwemali. Ngizobheka izinto umcwaningi mabhuku akhale ngazo, bese senza isiqiniseko sokuthi izinto ezifana nalezi azenzeki,” kusho yena.
INKANTOLO yeMantshi yaseVerulam ikuhlehlisile ukugwetshwa kwamadoda amane alahlwe icala lokuthumba nokubulala u-Andile 'Bobo’ Mbuthu (16).Bekulindeleke ukuthi ngoLwesibili iMantshi Sanele Hlatshwayo agwebe o-Andile Nhleko, Mncedisi Mzobe, Lindani Ndlovu noMalusi Mthembu abalahlwe ngamacala ngenyanga edlule.Kodwa akwenzekanga njengoba uHlatshwayo kuvele ukuthi akekho kule nkantolo kodwa umatasa nelinye icala ayijaji elibambile kulona eliqhubeka eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini.Ukuwiswa kwesigwebo kube sekubekelwa u-Okthoba 2 nonyaka.Abasizi bakaHlatshwayo, abafikisane nentatheli enkantolo, bekubukeka sengathi kabanalo ulwazi ngokuhlehliswa kwecala.Baze babekwa esithombeni umshushisi wecala uMnuz Ntuthuko Mngadi base bebona abeze ngayo.Amalungu omndeni kaBobo nawebandla okukhonza kulona unina awalubhadanga enkantolo.Umalume kaBobo, uMnuz Bongani Mthembu, uthe bese bazisiwe ukuthi ngeke sikhishwe isigwebo izolo, kuhlehliselwe olunye usuku.Ubezwakala ocingweni ukuthi ukhululekile. Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi kwaqale kwaba nokuhlehla okwaba khona ekukhishweni kwesinqumo, okwawunenga umndeni ukhala ngokuthi awaziswanga.Ngosuku okuyokhishwa ngalo isigwebo inkantolo iyokwamukela imibiko yosonhlalakahle ngempilo yala madoda nangomndeni kamufi.Kuyophinde kube nesigcawu sobengummangalelwa owaphenduka ufakazi woMbuso lapho ezobe ezicelela khona intethelelo nokuthi abeke izizathu zokuthi yini kungamele ashushiswe.UHlatshwayo wakhala kakhulu ngalo fakazi owayewumngani kaBobo, ebuza uMbuso ukuthi kungani enziwe ufakazi?UBobo washaywa wafa yilama doda ngo-Ephreli 20, 2020. Isidumbu sashiswa izinsalela zahlakazwa ngepiki zagxishwa ezikhwameni nezitini zayolahlwa emfuleni. Wayesolwa ngokweba utshwala eMagagula Lounge, eHambanathi oThongathi.Le ndawo yobumnandi eyangqongqiswa umphakathi kwakungekamzala kaBobo, uMnuz Mlungisi Thabethe owadutshulwa wafa ngoMashi 2021 esigamekweni amaphoyisa athi sasingahlobene nokufa kukaBobo.

Izikhukhula zengeze ezinkingeni ebesinazo kodwa inkinga yakamuva idalwa ilolu lwelwesi. Umasipala uzothumela amaloli amanzi engeziwe ezindaweni ezithintekile,” kusho uXaba.
UKUFAKWA kwamakhamera anele, ukulawula izikhathi zokusebenza kwamabhizinisi amancane nokuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abahlala emabhilidini aseThekwini bakuwo ngokusemthethweni, kungalekelela ekwehliseni izigameko zobugebengu ezibatshazwayo ePhoyinti, edume ngokuhlala abantu bokufika.Lokhu kuvele enkulumweni kaKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba kuqhubeka umkhankaso wamaphoyisa neminyango kahulumeni wokukhuculula emabhilidini. Kulo mkhankaso amaphoyisa abehambisana noMnyango wezaseKhaya nowezoBulungiswa. INQWABA yabantu bokufika abanganazimvume zokuba kuleli ababoshwe emkhankasweni wokukhuculula emabhilidini asePhoyinti Isithombe: DOCTOR NGCOBO/Independent NewspapersKuthe ngoLwesibili bagasela kungazelelwe emabhilidini ayisithupha asePhoyinti, kwaboshwa abangu-123 bokufika abahlala kuwo benganazimvume zokubakuleli.Kuvundulululwe izidakamizwa nemali engumbombayi engamadola aseMelika, elinginiswa no- R4,1 million wemali yakuleli.UMkhwanazi uthe umasipala kumele uqinise kakhulu kweminye imithetho, njengokubeka isikhathi esiqondile sokuvalwa kwamabhizinisi njengoba ethe kukhona asebenze ubusuku bonke kungekho sizathu esiqinile sokwenze njalo. Ubale kuwo izindawo zokucwala izinwele nezitolo zokudla ezincane, athe izigilamkhuba zicasha ngakho uma ziphusha umshikashika wazo esithe."Inkinga yethu enkulu njengamaphoyisa, kunamabhilidi anganakiwe othola ukuthi abanikazi bawashiya phansi, athathwa ngokungekho emthethweni ngabathile. Bahlukaniselana ngawo baqashise, ngakho kukhona abahlala khona abakhokhiswa imali yokuqasha ngendlela engaqondile,” usho kanjeUNDUNANKULU uMnuz Thami Ntuli, uKhomishana wamaphoyisa eKZN, uLt General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi neMeya yaseThekwini uMnuz Cyril Xaba, ngesikhathi kugasela amaphoyisa emabhilidini aseThekwini Isithombe: Sithunyelwe Uthe ukwengeza amakhamera ukuqinisekisa ukuthi yonke into eyenziwa edolobheni iyaqopheka, kungenza kube lula ukulwa nobugebengu.Uthe abanye kutholakala ukuthi endaweni okurenta kuyo abantu enemibhede emibili, kuhlala abangu-20. Abantu bayashintshana, abanye balala ebusuku abanye balale emini, okwenza naphakathi kwamabili uthole kunabantu abehla benyuka emgwaqweni ungazi ukuthi benzani, okuphazamisa kakhulu izivakashi.Emabhilidini okugaselwe kuwo kutholwe ukuthi elinye yibhilidi likamasipala kanti kunothile okhokhisa i-renti kulo ngokungemthetho, othathwe amaphoyisa wayophoswa imibuzo. Kulo mkhankaso kuphinde kwavundululwa izinhlamvu ezingu-117 zezibhamu ezehlukene, kanti kunqanyulwe ukuphakelwa kwamanzi nogesi emabhilidini amabili okukholakala ukuthi kungenwe kuwo ngokungemthetho.Yize kunezinsolo ezibeka kabi amaphoyisa esiteshini samaphoyisa esisePhoyinti zokusebenzisana nezigebengu, kodwa uMkhwanazi ugcizelele ukuthi amaphoyisa asebenza ngokuzikhandla ukulwa nabo nakuba ekhona amazambane abolile. Uveze ukuthi yinqwaba yamaphoyisa kulesi siteshi aseboshiwe ngenxa yalezi zinsolo.UNdunankulu wesifundazwe, uMnuz Thami Ntuli neMeya kuMasipala weTheku uMnuz Cyril Xaba, bebengabanye abebehola lo mkhankaso.UNtuli uthe imikhankaso enjengalena izoqhubeka, kanti akuwona nje kuphela amabhillidi okungenwe kuwo ngokungemthetho aseThekwini okugaselwa kuwo, kodwa nakwezinye izindawo.

SIBEKELWE imibandela eqinile isikhungo i-Educor, nguNgqongqoshe weMfundo ePhakeme uDkt Nobuhle Nkabane, obuyisele okwesikhashana ukubhaliswa kwaso ngaphansi komnyango wakhe njengoba sase sikhishiwe. Lesi sikhungo esinamakolishi amane akhishwa ngaphansi kwabhalisiwe owayenguNgqongqoshe walo mnyango uDkt Blade Nzimande, ngenxa yokungayilandeli imibandela ebekelwe izikhungo zemfundo.Amakolishi athintekayo kulokhu yi-Damelin, City Campus, Icesa City Campus ne-Lyceum College.UDkt Nkabane uthe uzobuyisela okwesikhashana ukubhaliswa kwe-Educor, uma izohlangabezana nayo yonke imigomo nemibandela yeCouncil on Higher Education (CHE), ngaphambi kokuqala uhlelo lokufunda nokufundisa.Uthe okunye ngukuthi kumele isikhungo silethe umbiko wokusebenza kwaso njalo ngenyanga emnyangweni."Kumele izinhlelo zokufunda nokufundisa zibe sezingeni. Kumele kulethwe umbiko zinyanga zonke obandakanya izitatimende zokusebenza kwemali, izibalo zezitshudeni ezibhalisile kanjalo nezinye izimfanelo.” Uthe njalo ngekota kumele isikhungo silethe umbiko oveza ukuthi kunozinzo ngasemalini."Kumele kube nokuvuleleka ngasemabhukwini athinta imali. UMASIPALA wasebaQulusini ufuna kuqiniswe imithetho elawula ukusebenza kwezikhungo ezithenga izinsimbi namakhebula kagesi antshontshwe kamasipala.IMeya yalo masipala, uMnuz Sifiso Mkhwanazi ibibize isithangami sabezindaba izolo, izokwethula umbiko mayelana nokwebiwa kwamakhebula kagesi ezindaweni ezingaphansi kwalo masispala. Ukhale ngokuthi lokhu kugcina kuholele ekutheni umphakathi umashele umkhandlu uma ungenawo ugesi, wathi lezi zikhungo zibuye zithenge amakhebula kamasipala antshotshiwe ekubeni kwaziwa ukuthi ayimpahla kamasipala.Uthe izinga lokwebiwa kwamakhebula kagesi kule ndawo kuphezulu kakhulu kangangoba umkhandlu usuze wathatha isinqumo sokuthi uqoke abaphenyi abazimele ngo-2022."Okusiphethe kabi kakhulu ukuthi kubantu abasolwa ngalobu bugebengu kubalwa nomunye wabasebenzi bethu njengoba ngoLwesine kutholakele ikhebula elingamamitha angu-300 emzini kasomabhizinisi wendawo ohlonishwayo. Lo somabhizinisi uthe lilethwe umsebenzi wethu. "Kuyasikhathaza lokhu, ngaphezu kwalokho sikhathazwa indlela amaphoyisa ahudula ngayo izinyawo ngamacala athinta ukwebiwa kwamakhebula. Akulona udaba oluncane lolu. "Ukwebiwa kwamakhebula, ukuphazanyiswa kokusebenza kwama-transformer (imishini ephehla ugesi) nengqalasizinda kagesi, kusibuyisela emuva. Sizithola sisebenzisa imali sithenga izinto ebese zithengiwe," kusho uMkhwanazi.Uthe awu-30 amacala avuliwe okwebiwa kwamakhebula kodwa mahlanu asesesigabeni sokuthi kunabantu ababoshiwe abavela enkantolo ngawo.Uqhube wathi usebhalele abaholi bamaphoyisa ebaQulusini, ekhalaza ngokuthi amaphoyisa ahudula izinyawo ngala macala, kwesinye isikhathi aba nokwenzelela kubantu abathintekayo. "Kulaba bakamuva, kuvela ukuthi amaphoyisa abathathile kodwa abazange bavele enkantolo ngoba baboshwe badedelwa, bangabekwa amacala. Kubo kubalwa nomnikazi womuzi ikhebula elitholakale kwakhe,” kuchaza imeya. UMkhwanazi uqhube wathi kuzolandelwa imithetho yabasebenzi yokuqondiswa ubugwegwe kumsebenzi othintekayo, wathi lolo hlelo lwenziwa yimenenja kamasipala.
USUBHALELE uNgqongqoshe wezeziMali noMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa uhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal ofuna kulungiswe indaba yelayisensi yebhange Ithala.Lezi zindaba zivezwe wuMphathiswa wezokuThuthukiswa koMnotho, ezokuVakasha neMvelo, uMfu Musa Zondi, esithangamini sabezindaba ebesiseLangeni Hotel, eThekwini."Ithala liyinsika yokuthuthukiswa komnotho KwaZulu-Natal, emuva kwesimemezelo se-Financial Conduct Authority (FSCA) sokumisa ilayisensi yebhange Ithala, uNdunankulu uMnuz Thami Ntuli nohulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal, uthathe isinqumo sokubhalela uNgqongqoshe wezeziMali, uMnuz Enoch Godongwana noMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, ukuba babheke lolu daba. "Sifuna kuqinisekiswe ukuthi inkinga enjengalena ayiphindi ibe khona. Kufanele kushintshe nomthetho osucindezela Ithala ngoba kade lisebenza ngaphandle kwezihibe phambilini,” kusho uZondi.Uveze ukuthi emuva kokuvela kwezindaba zokumiswa kwelayisensi yeThala uthole inqwaba yezingcingo kogogo nabanye abantu abalondoloza imali yabo kuleli bhange."Abezindaba banyuse ushukela wogogo ngendlela abalubike ngayo lolu daba. Ngiyaqonda ukuthi abanye bebefuna ukudayisa amaphepha kodwa kufanele nisebenzisane nathi nibike ngendlela ehlelekile, ningabhali okudukisa umphakathi. Silapha nje ngenxa yenu ngoba nilayithe umentshisi. Ithala alikho sephutheni kodwa wuhulumeni oshintshe imithetho.”Uthe ezinye izinkinga zaseThala azithinti imali kuphela kodwa zithinta nepolitiki."Wuhulumeni kazwelonke oshintsha imithetho ethinta izikhungo ezifana neThala ngakho uyena ozoza nesixazululo. UNdunankulu usukumele phezulu ukuthola isixazululo. Ithala lisasebenza ngisho uhulumeni waseGauteng uthatha izifundo eThala.” Ubalule ukuthi Ithala belilokhu lisebenza kahle kodwa kwashintsha imithetho njengoba ingavuselelwanga i-exemption ebilivumela ukuba lisebenze njengamanye amabhange anemishwalense neminye imikhiqizo.Isikhulu esiphezulu sebhange Ithala, uDkt Thulani Vilakazi sithe ziyalungiswa izikhalo ze-FSCA ngakho abantu mabakhululeke.Uveze ukuthi i-FSCA ikhiphe Ithala ezikhungweni zemali ebezingadingi ukuletha umbiko we-Financial Soundness okuyinto eyenziwa izikhungo eziqoqa imali yemishwalense nokunye.Ubalule ukuthi Ithala belingangeni kulolu hlu ngoba beluqhuba umsebenzi walo ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka iminyaka engaphezulu kuka-20."Izikhalo ze-FSCA besizilungisa vele. Kuyimanje sithathile uhlu lwebhizinisi oluthinta umshwalense silufake ngaphansi kwe-Ithala Development and Finance Corporation (IDFC) kuze kube sithola isixazululo salolu daba. Abathola amathenda kuhulumeni nabo basazoyithola imali e-IDFC, umehluko wukuthi ngeke sisakwazi ukubavulela ama-akhawunti ebhange Ithala.”Ubalule ukuthi isinqumo se-FSCA asisho ukuthi ibhange Ithala linenkinga yemali ngoba namanje linombiko ongenawo ugcobho womcwaningi mabhuku.Uveze ukuthi umehluko wukuthi phambilini kunemithetho elandelwa ngamabhange amakhulu ebingalithinti ibhange Ithala njengoba lona lingafani namanye amabhange."Ithala liyibhange elihlukile, lidinga ukuthi kushintshe umthetho ozokwazi ukubhekana nesimo salo. Alifani namanye amabhange, alilona ibhange elikhulu, alilona ibhange eliwumfelandawonye kodwa liyibhange elikwazi ukusiza wonke umuntu. Izinkinga ezibalulwe yi-FSCA kudala siqalile ukuzilungisa.”Ukhale ngokuthi bazoshayeka beyibhange njengoba bengakwazi ukuvula ama-akhawunti amasha noma bamukele amakhasimende amanye njengoba besalungisa izinkinga ze-FSCA.Uphethe ngokuthi kunomehluko phakathi kwe-IDFC okuyiyona ebolekisa ngemali futhi ephethe ibhange Ithala. Ubalule ukuthi okwenzeka ebhange Ithala akunamthelela kwi-IDFC.

KUHLEHLISELWE isonto elizayo yiNkantolo yeMantshi yaseVerulam, ukulalelwa kwesicelo sebheyili ecaleni elibhekene nomfundisi webandla labasindisiwe, osolwa ngokunukubeza ngokocansi izingane zabafana.UMnuz Mkhanyisi Mshalala (57) okuthiwa ubenezinyanga eziyisithupha ehlala eWaterloo, okuthiwa ubencikiswe yisihlobo sakhe, ubevele kule nkantolo izolo. Inkantolo ilihlehlisele u-Septhemba 5 leli cala, kusaqhubeka uphenyo.UMnuz Khumbulani Zuma oyisisishoshovu somphakathi nomgqugquzeli we-MK ku- ward 106, obengomunye wabebehola umbhikisho ngaphandle kwenkantolo ngesikhathi kuvele umsolwa, uthe abazali bezingane balutheka njengoba ngesikhathi efika wangenisa ngesonto nangebhola okwenza bamethemba."Ukufika kwakhe uzenze umuntu oyikholwa nofundisa ngeBhayibheli. Uphinde waziveza njengomuntu onolwazi nogqozi ekuqeqesheni abafana abancane ebholeni lezinyawo. Ngenxa yokuthi indawo ikhungethwe ubugebengu nokusetshenziswa kwezidakamizwa, abazali babone kuyithuba lokugcina izingane zabo zimatasa futhi zenza into eqondindile, kanti uthi lala lulaza,” kusho uZuma.UMnuz Xolani Ngcobo oyilungu lesigungu esilwa nobugebengu eWaterloo, uthe ukuya kwabantu enkantolo, bekuhloswe ngakho ukweseka imindeni yabagilwa ukuze umsolwa engadedelwa."Ngenxa yesimo semindeni yabagilwa somnotho neminyaka yabo, sibone kukuhle ukuthi sibe ngasohlangothini lwabo sibeseke kulesi sikhathi esinzima ababhekene naso. Ukwesaba kwethu kusekutheni asazi ukuthi zingaki izingane azigilile ezingakaphumeli obala ngoba sithole ukuthi ezindaweni aseke ahlala kuzo okuyi-Parkgate naseMhlasini, ubewumuntu ogila le mikhuba,” kusho uNgcobo.Ngesikhathi eboshwa, uMshalala usindiswe ukufika konogada bakwa-Reaction Unit of South Africa olakeni lwamalungu omphakathi abesho ukumudla amfele. Uvela nje, uqeda kululama njengoba ubengeniswe esibhedlela emva kwalokhu kutitinyeka ngamalungu omphakathi, kanti ubephansi kweso lwamaphoyisa.
