Sizohlala nomqashi ngasekuqaleni kwenyanga ezayo ukuze sizwe izincomo zale khomishini. Emva kwalokho sizodlulela eNkantolo yezabaSebenzi ukuze inqume ngalolu daba,” usho kanje.Uthe yize lolu hlelo kungolwesikhashana ngenhloso yokuthi kusinwe kudedelwane kodwa kunabasebenzi asebedonse iminyaka eminingi besebenza, osekwenze bangena shi ezikweletini kwazise bese bezitshelile ukuthi ngeke izinkontileka zabo zisamiswa.Ezinkundleni zokuxhumana kuzungeza izwi eliqoshiwe okukholakala ukuthi ngelikaNobhala we-ANC esifundeni ITheku, uMnuz Musa Nciki, okuthiwa liqoshwe ngesikhathi ekhuluma nezithameli ePlayhouse ngeSonto, ngesikhathi kuhambele ikomiti elibhekelele ukusebenza kwale nhlangano kuzwelonke.Kule nkulumo, uNciki usola laba basebenzi ngakubize ngokubumba inyunyana yabo i-Matusa, ngenhloso yokuthi ibalwele ukuze baqashwe ngokugcwele wumasipala. Uphinde aveze ukuthi emaqoqweni abo ku-WhatsApp lapho babelana khona ngezindaba, ngaphambi kokhetho babegqugquzelana ukuthi bengayivoteli le nhlangano, wanxusa iMeya entsha uMnuz Cyril Xaba ukuthi angagedluki kokwaqalwa nguMnuz Mxolisi Kaunda obeyimeya phambili ekutheni lolu hlelo luqalwe phansi.UMaxhegu uthe inkulumo kaNciki inobudedengu njengoba inyunyana ingabunjwanga abasebenzi balolu hlelo, seyineminyaka eminingi ikhona futhi ivule izandla kuwona wonke umsebenzi nabangekho ngaphansi kwe-EPWP. Uthe bezikhona izinkulumo ezingehli kahle kubasebenzi njengoba iningi labo lisolwa ngokuthi lavotela i-MK ngokhetho olwedlule okukholakala ukuthi kungenye yezimbangela zokuxoshwa kwabo.
UNGQONGQOSHE wezoLimo nokuThuthukiswa kweziNdawo zaseMakhaya kwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Thembeni Madlopha-Mthethwa, uhlabe ikhwelo kwabesifazane basemakhaya ukuba babuyele emasimini bavuse ezolimo ukuze bafukule umnotho wesifundazwe.UMadlopha-Mthethwa ubekhuluma emcimbini wokugubha inyanga yabesifazane obuseNqulwana , ku-ward 14 kwaHlabisa ngoMgqibelo.ABESIFAZANE bakwaHlabisa ngesikhathi besemcimbini wokugubha inyanga yabesifazane obuseNqulwana kwaHlabisa Isithombe: SITHUNYELWEUthe ezolimo ziwumgogodla womnotho, akumele abesifazane basonge izandla futhi uMnyango wakhe uzobaxhasa ukuze bakwazi ukuqinisa kulo mkhakha osanenqwaba yabesilisa abamhlophe."SinguMnyango sizimisele ukuba sinixhase siphinde senze isiqiniseko ukuthi njengabantu besifazane nidlala indima ebalulekile emnothweni wesifundazwe nasekudaleni amathuba omsebenzi," kusho okaMadlopha-Mthethwa.Ukusho lokhu nje ezindaweni eziningi zasemakhaya abesifazane bayazilimela ukuze badle nemindeni yabo njengoba bekhala ngokuthi awekho amathuba abavulelwa wona okudayisa imikhiqizo yabo emakethe.UNkk Babongile Mdletshe (54) uthe bayakujabulela ukuthi ekugcineni uHulumeni usesibonile isidingo sokubafukula emsebenzini abebazi ukuthi bawenza nje ukuze kulalwe kudliwe emakhaya."Empeleni besingazi ukuthi uma sizilimela izitshalo zethu lokho sekungasenza osomabhizinisi. Besazi ukuthi silima ngoba kumele emakhaya ethu kuhlale kunokudla singathengi konke ezitolo. Nokho uNgqongqoshe usivula amehlo okuba sihlangane singabesimame sikhande umnotho ngalezi zivande zethu esizilimayo," kusho uNkk Mdletshe.Udaba lokuba abesifazane bangene kwezolimo ngokwebhizinisi luseqhulwini kule nyanga yabesifazane.Muva nje uNdlunkulu wokuqala weSilo samabandla uZwelithini kaBhekuzulu, uNdlunkulu uSibongile maDlamini wakwaKhethomthandayo, ucele abesifazane eMkhosini weSivivane ukuba bayeke ukudayisa imihlaba yabo emakhaya kodwa abayilime benze ibhizinisi ngayo eliyohlomulisa isizukulwane esizayo emindenini yabo.IMeya waseBig Five Hlabisa, uMnuz Comfort Khumalo, ithe banezinhlelo ezizosiza abesifazane ukuba bakwazi ukulima.
UMHOLI we-EFF, uMnuz Julius Malema, usechithe isiphakamiso somholi weqembu Umkhonto weSizwe, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, sokuthi kumele amaqembu amancane ahlangane ngaphansi kwe-MK, ukufukula abamnyama.UMalema uthe kumele la maqembu ahlangane ngaphansi kweqembu eliholwa yintsha, ngoba umuntu omdala akukho asangakwenzela intsha. "Kubalulekile ukuthi amaqembu amnyama ahlangane, afukule abantu abamnyama. Kodwa kumele akwenze lokhu ngaphansi kweqembu eliholwa yintsha ngoba abantu abadala abanawo umbono ngokumele kwenzeke ngomuso. Asikwazi ukuholwa abantu abadala abavuka nsuku zonke babe nombono omusha befuna ukuzithola la bemi khona. Iqembu elingakwenza ngempumelelo lokhu yi-EFF,” kusho uMalema.Ukusho lokhu izolo, ekhuluma emngcwabeni kamama kasihlalo waleli qembu KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Mongezi Twala, oSizweni.UMalema uphefumule kanje emva kokuba uZuma enxenxe amaqembu amancane amnyama ngeledlule ukuthi kumele abubambane."Amaqembu abamnyama kumele ahlangane ukuze kukhululwe abantu abamnyama. I-MK yisona sisombululo ezweni yingakho kumele sihlangane singamaqembu amnyama sisebenze ukufukula abantu bakithi,” kusho uZuma.UMalema utshele abebehambele lo mngcwabo ukuthi bankanise kulesi sifundazwe ukuzothola umnyombo wokwehlelwa wukwesekwa okhethweni lwangoMeyi nonyaka.Ufanise ukufika kwe-MK nesikhonyane esifike sabhincisela nxanye amaqembu ahlukene ikakhulu kulesi sifundazwe."Sila ukuzothola ukuthi uZuma wenzeni ukuthola amavoti ethu. Sishaqekile ngokulahlekelwa wukwesekwa okhethweni, i-MK ifike yaba iTsunami. Usishaqisile umntomdala waseNkandla,” kusho uMalema.Ugxeke uhulumeni wokubambisana kwamaqembu wathi ngelinye ilanga siyovuka izwe lihambile."Lo hulumeni akuwona owokubambisana, owe-DA ne-ANC. Ngelinye ilanga siyovuka ingasekho iKZN, ngoba amaBhunu awabufuni ubuholi bomdabu,” kusho uMalema.Unxuse abefundisi ukuthi bakhululeke i-EFF."Izivuvaba zakamuva kwi-EFF azinganithusi kakhulu. Wonke amaqembu ayavivinywa,” kusho uMalema.Usho kanje kulandela ukulaxazwa kwe-EFF ngobeyiphini likamengameli uMnuz Floyd Shivambu, osenguMgqugquzeli kaZwelonke kwiMK.Namhlanje leli qembu lizohlanganisa umbiko wezinto ezivele emhlanganweni namagatsha ahlukene esifundazweni ngokwenzeke okhethweni.Lizobe selikhipha umkhombandlela ngokuzokwenzeka kodwa phambilini uMalema wakuveza ukuthi akekho owayazi ukuthi i-MK izocoboshisa kwasani okhethweni njengoba esiShayamthetho sesifundazwe leli qembu lilahlekelwe yizihlalo eziyisithupha, lisalelwe ezimbili vo. UNobhala Jikelele, uMnuz Marshall Dlamini, uveze ukuthi lilahlekelwe amavoti acela ku-300 000.
NGOSUKU obekumele luphenduke injabulo emndenini waseNhlangwini, eHlokozi, kudutshulwe kwabulawa abakhongi abayizelamani besakhuleka esangweni bezoshiya nezinkomo zemali. Izelamani, oMnuz Thandokuhle Dlamini (38) noMnuz Mzwandile Dlamini (45) besesigodini saKwaMayibuye, khona eHlokozi, ziphelele emagcekeni asekhweni esehlakalweni esishaqise nomphakathi. Kulesi sigameko, kuthiwa abasolwa baphinde bakhala bemuka no-R50 000 abafi ebebezolobola ngawo.Ngokusho komthombo, abafi bebethunywe umfowabo, uMnuz Bongani Dlamini (41) emzini wakwaHlongwa ukuyocela isihlobo esihle baphinde bashiye nezinkomo zemali.Umthombo uthe abafi baphume ekhaya ngabo-7 ekuseni, kwangaphela ngisho nehora, kwangena ucingo oluthi sebedutshuliwe."Uma sifika endaweni yesigameko sithole ukuthi abasolwa behle ezimotweni ezimbili ezingama-Polo abengenazinombolo. Baqale baphoqa abakwaHlongwa ebebekikiza emnyango ukuthi babuyele endlini. Base bezodubula abafi,” kusho umthombo.Uqhube wathi baqale ngoMzwandile, bamshaya ngenhlamvu eyodwa, wawa, baqhubekela kuThandokuhle, abambulale ngentululwane yezinhlamvu.Uthe baphinde babuyela kuMzwandile, bamdubula kabili, maqede bathatha imali base bengena ezimotweni zabo, bashaya bachitha.Umthombo uthe uThandokuhle bese kunesikhashana esekubhaceni kulandela izinsongo zokuthi uzosocongwa okusolwa ukuthi ziyamene nezindaba zamathenda."Usanda kuthola ithenda lokwakha umgwaqo endaweni. Kuthe kungakapheli nasikhathi esingakanani eqalile umsebenzi, kwadutshulwa owesilisa abesebenzisana naye eduze. Kwavela ukuthi abasolwa bathi wuye ozolandela,” kusho umthombo.Umthombo uveze ukuthi izimoto zike zabonakala zimile isikhathi eside ngasendaweni yesigameko ngoLwesihlanu."Sisola ukuthi bebehlola isimo, nanokuthi izigodi zisondelene kakhulu, ngakho indaba yamalobolo kungenzeka ukuthi basheshe bayithola, base besebenzisa ithuba,” kusho umthombo.Umthombo uthe awukholwa ukuthi isigameko simayelana netulo lokuphazamisa izinhlelo zokushada kwezithandani.Uthe izithandani ezehlelwe umshophi ngosuku lwazo akuvumi nokuthi zikhulume kulandela isigameko.Owesifazane kuvela ukuthi uphatheke kabi ngokonakala kosuku lwakhe ngomshophi onyantisa igazi.Owesilisa yena kuthiwa uphatheke kabi ngokubulawa kwabafowabo ngesihluku bethunywe wuye. Uyazibuza uyaziphendula.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa ase-Highflats avule amacala amabili okubulala kulandela isigameko sokudutshulwa kwababili eHlokozi, ngoMgqibelo. "Ulwazi olutholwe amaphoyisa luthi abafi bebethunywe ukuyolobola. Bathe besamile esangweni, belinde imvume yokungena, bahlaselwa abasolwa abayisithupha ebebehlome ngezibhamu, behamba ngama-Polo amabili eli-dark grey neli-navy blue,” kusho uNetshiunda. Uthe abasolwa bavulele ngenhlamvu bebhekise kubagilwa, bebabulala ujuqu. "Babuye babaphuca nemali ebebezolobola ngayo ngaphambi kokuthi babaleke,” kusho uNetshiunda. Uthe uphenyo lwamaphoyisa luveza ukuthi oyedwa wabafi ubefunelwa icala lokubulala okuthiwa walenza ngoJulayi nonyaka.
BASOLA ukushaywa ngendlebe etsheni wuMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal othisha abangaqashiwe, emva kokuthi umemezele inqwaba yezikhala zothisha ezisesigabeni u-Post Level One (PL1), ezikhangiswe esidlangalaleni okokuqala, osekuvele ukuthi ezinye zazo kudala zavalwa.Umnyango wenze isimemezelo sezikhala ezingu-747 ezikhangiswe ngokuvulelekile, osekuvumeleke noma wubani onalokho okudingekayo afake ngqo isicelo somsebenzi emnyangweni obekungenzeki phambilini. Emva kwesimemezelo kube negidigidi kubantu abaningi nasezinkundleni zokuxhumana, kunconywa isinqumo njengesiphusile esizosiza ukulwa nezinsolo zokuqashana ngokwenzelela ebezikhona.Nakuba kunjalo, inhlangano yothisha abangaqashiwe kulesi sifundazwe, i-KwaZulu-Natal United Unemployed Educators, isola isenzo somnyango njengemizamo yokuthalalisa ukugwema ingcindezi ekubhekenani nezikhalo zamalungu ayo, kufakwa kulolu uhlu ezinye izikhala esezivaliwe.UMnuz Mfanelo Mncube wale nhlangano engxoxweni neSolezwe, uthe sebethole imibiko kumalungu wabo ngezikole ezingasenazo izikhala kodwa ezifakiwe kulolu hlu."Ngesikhathi kumenyezelwa lezi zikhalo, besinakho ukunganeliseki ngokuthi azenele zincane kodwa sibonga lokho. Emva kwemibiko ngezinsolo zokuthi kunezikhala ezigcwalisiwe kodwa ezisohlwini, sibonile ukuthi umnyango usaqhubeka nokudlala ngemizwa yethu," usho kanje.Uthe banxuse amalungu abo ukuthi uma ehambele izikole asondelene nazo ezimenyezelwe njengezinezikhala zomsebenzi, aqinisekise kuthishomkhulu ukuthi zikhona ngempela yini ngaphambi kokufaka izicelo.Isolezwe lizibonele incwadi eputshikile eqinisekisa ukuqokwa komunye wothisha esikoleni esiseMlaza i-Velabahleke Secondary, ofundisa i-Accounting ne-Economics eyayimyalela ukuthi aqale ukusebenza ngoJulayi 25, kulo nyaka. Yize kunjalo, lesi sikhala sikhona ohlwini lwezikhala ezikhangiswe wumnyango okuqinisa izinsolo zale nhlangano. Esinye isikole esivela kulolu hlu, iMayiyana High ngaphansi kukaMasipala uMzumbe okukleliswe kulo izikhala ezimbili zothisha abazofundisa u-grade 10 kuya kuya ku-grade 12 i-Maths Literacy ne-Mathametical Literacy, okuvele ukuthi lesi sikole sekunesikhathi savalwa ngenxa yesibalo esiphansi sabafundi, sahlanganiswa nesikole iNdlelenhle Secondary esisondelene naso. UMncube uthe bazobhalela uHlomuka bemazise ngalezi zinsolo, kanti basaqhubeka nokuqoqa ubufakazi ukuze bebe nohlu oluphelele lezikole okuthiwe zinezikhala zingekho.Ukhale ngokubiza kokulungiselela ukufaka isicelo somsebenzi, okwenza kungahlali kahle ukunxenxa abantu ukuthi bafake izicelo ezikhaleni ezivele zivaliwe. Nakuba kunjalo, uthe bakumisile ukuqhinqa emahhovisi omnyango eMgungundlovu kothisa abangaqashiwe abangamalungu ale nhlangano, njengoba sebabayalele ukuthi basebenzise leso sikhathi ukufaka izicelo zomsebenzi ezikhaleni ezimenyezelwe wumnyango. Kumenyezelwa lezi zikhala, uHlomuka ugqugquzele othisha abangasebenzi ukuthi bafake izicelo.
UKUHLASELWA nokubulawa kwamaphoyisa kuleli okwenziwa yimigulukudu, kuwukubukela phansi amandla oMbuso.Lokhu kushiwo oyinhloko yophiko loKlebe, Lieutenant General Godfrey Lebeya esithangamini nabezindaba ePitoli, ngeSonto, obekuhloswe ngaso ukucacisela umphakathi ngosekwenziwe yilolu phiko ekoteni ephelile yonyaka wezimali u-2024/2025.ULebeya uthe ngekota yokuqala kuphela yalo nyakazimali, angu-21 amaphoyisa asebulewe kanti iningi lawo abulawe engekho emsebenzini njengoba engu-16, abe mahlanu abulawe esebenza."Bangu-18 abasolwa asebeboshiwe ngamacala okubulawa kwamaphoyisa, kubona abayisishiyagalolunye bahlanganiswa namacala akamuva okubulwa kwamaphoyisa angu-21, bese kuthi enye ingxenye ihlanganiswa namacala afanayo enzeke ngaphambi kwekota yokuqala yalo nyakazimali,” kusho uLebeya.Enaba ngamacala asephothuliwe alolu hlobo, uLebeya uveze ukuthi oboshelwe ukubulala iphoyisa lakuMasipala weTheku uConstable Nkosinathi Ndlovu (57) ngoJuni 2022, okwenzeka ehostela eliseMlaza iGlebbelands, okunguSibusiso Sosibo (27), udonsa isigwebo seminyaka ewu-50 emva kokuphenya kwalolu phiko okuholele ekutheni elahlwe ngamacala.Uphinde wakhala ngezigameko sokuqhunyiswa nokubanjwa kwezimoto ezithwala imali okudla lubi, wathi lubeka engcupheni impilo yabantu.Uthe awu-55 amacala adluliselwe kulolu phiko, kanti bangu-34 asebeboshiwe, abangu-28 kubo baboshelwe amacala enzeke ekoteni yokuqala kuhlanganiswa nalabo abafa bedubulana namaphoya. Uthe sekugwetshwe abangu-19, iminyaka ewu-288 uma behlanhaniswa bonke.Awu-18 461 amacala abephenywa yilolu phiko ngekota yokuqala yonyaka u-2024/2025, zibe wu-752 712 izimangalo ezishicilelwe, okudla imali eyevile ku- R 1 billion.Lolu phiko luphinde lwavalela inqwaba yabasolwa emacaleni abucayi okubalwa kuwo inkohlakalo, ukuhwebelana ngemali ngendlela engekho emthethweni, ukubulawa kwamaphoyisa, abavukuza ezimayini ngokungekho emthethweni namanye.ULebeya uthe yinqwaba yezidakamizwa eziqoqwe yilolu phiko kule ngekota edlule engabiza imali eyivile ku-32 million kanti bangu-64 ababoshelwe lolu hlobo lobugebengu. Bangu-25 asebegwetshiwe kanti abangu-15 baphume ngenhlawulo. Kuhlakazwe izindawo ezintathu okuthiwa beyizidleke ezikhiqizwa izidakamizwa ngokungekho emthethweni eGauteng, kwaboshwa abangu-12, kwashaqwa izidakamizwa ezingabiza imali eyevile ku-R16 million.
UKHUNGATHEKILE umndeni wowesilisa waseNquthu, owadutshulwa wabulawa, uthola ikhadi lesimemo somshado wakhe livela kowesifazane ashona ejola naye.Umufi owayesembonini yametekisi, uMnuz Hezekia Naledi Masiteng, wahlaselwa ngamadoda angaziwa amdubula esendleleni ebheke emzini wakhe khona eNquthu.Isigameko kuthiwa senzeka ngoJuni 5, 2020. Ngesikhathi ebulawa wayethandana nentombi yakhe, uNksz Nompumelelo Ntuli odume ngelikaYayo.Lo wesifazane kuvela ukuthi uthumelele ikhadi lesimemo somshado kumalungu kamufi.IKHADI lesimemo somshado kamufi nentombiIsolezwe Ngempelasonto lisibonile isimemo somshado okuthiwa uzokuba ngoSepthemba 29. Uzosuka kubo kowesifazane eNkandla, uphelele kubo kukamufi eNquthu.UNKSZ Nompumelelo Ntuli ohlela umshado nesoka lakhe elingasekho emhlabeni elife ngokudutshulwaUmndeni kamufi usola lo wesifazane ngokuhlekisa ngendodana yawo."Sididekile ukuthi le ntombazane iwuhlela kanjani umcimbi nomufi ingazange isitshele thina. Ize ibe nesibindi esingaka sokusithumelela nekhadi lesimemo somshado pho,'' kubabaza owomndeni.Umndeni uthi uxakwa nawukuthi lo mshado uzophelela kanjani emagcekeni kamufi ngaphandle kwemvume yawo?INCWADI yokufa eveza ukuthi umufi ubengashadile ngesikhathi ebulawaKwenzeka le mpicabadala nje, kunecala lombango wamafa eliqhubekayo enkantolo phakathi kwentombi nomndeni kamufi.Intombi kuvela ukuthi inezingane ezintathu nomufi. Isolwa nangokushaqa amatekisi awu-13 kamufi okumanje imali ayisebenzayo kuthiwa iya entombini. Kuthiwa umufi wayengalobolile.Omunye womndeni kamufi uthe bayazi ukuthi umshado intombi iwenza ngoba nakhu sekumele ivuselele izincwadi zemvume yamatekisi njengoba seziphelelwe yisikhathi."Umthetho wasematekisini uthi izincwadi zezimvume zamatekisi kumele zivuselwe owomndeni kamufi noma ke kube umkakhe. Manje le ntombazane seyifuna ukuba nencwadi yomshado ukuze izoqhubeka nokuba nelungelo lamatekisi,'' kuchaza owomndeni.Kuthiwa umndeni ohlangothini lwentombi yiwona omagange nezinhlelo zomshado ngoba ubona ubungozi bokuthi kungenzeka amatekisi agcine esema ukusebenza uma owesifazane engayitholi ngokushesha incwadi yomshado.Ithintwa intombi, ivuthe ingabaselwe isola umndeni kamufi ngokuphapha, uyisa udaba kwabezindaba.UNksz Nompumelelo Ntuli ukuqinisekise ngomlomo wakhe ukuthi impela kuyiqiniso ukuthi uyashada nomufi futhi izimemo seziphumile, wathi ukushada ngale ndlela akuqali ngaye."Wena angithi unguMzulu? Le nto ngokwesintu ike yenziwe, nami ngiyenza ngaphansi kwemibandela wesintu. Kodwa ngeke ngisuke ngitshele wena ukuthi kungani ngenza lo mshado,'' usho kanje ebhoka ngolaka.Ube esecela intatheli ukuthi eminye imininingwane iyifune kulabo ethole kubona udaba, wathi nentatheli ivumelekile ukuba ingafika izodla ngosuku olukhulu lomshado.Isazi somthetho, u-Advocate Mpumelelo Zikalala, sithe angeke abe nayo incwadi yomshado ngoba ukuze ibe khona ngokomthetho kumele kube ukuthi abantu ababili basadla anhlamvana, bavumile baqinisekisa ukuthi bayashada.Isazi samasiko, uSolwazi Gugu Mazibuko waseNyuvesi yaseJohannesburg sithe lo wesifazane wenza umuga.Uthe lolu hlobo lomshado ngokwesintu lwenziwa uma isoka elishone selilobolile futhi selikhehlile, sekusele ukuthi kuphume udwendwe nje kuphela.Kulolu daba uthe uyakweshwama lokhu okuzobe kwenziwa yilo wesifazane ngoba ubeyintombi nje kuphela engalotsholiwe futhi engazange ikhehlwe.

ISILO uMisuzulu kaZwelithini sesizwakalise ukukhathazeka ngokuhoxiswa kwelayisensi yebhange Ithala njengoba sithi lokhu kuzoba nomthelela omubi kubantu abathembele kuleli bhange ukuqhuba amabhizinisi abo.Siyalele uNdunankulu kaZulu, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, ukuba athinte uMphathiswa wezeziMali noNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal ukuze beze nezinhlelo ezizoqinisekisa ukuthi ilayisensi yaseThala iyabuya.Sibalule ukuthi Ithala libalulekile kubantu baKwaZulu-Natal, osomabhizinisi basemakhaya nabaselokishini abazothikamezeka uma lingasavumelekile ukusebenza ngendlela ejwayelekile.Sithe Ithala yibhange elasungulwa nguNdunankulu kaZulu ongasekho, uMntwana uMangosuthi Buthelezi, ukuze lisize izizukulwane zaKwaZulu-Natal.UMnuz Wonder Jaca onguNobhala Jikelele we-Black Business Federation, uthe kuyabakhathaza ukuhoxiswa kwelayisensi yaseThala ngoba liyisikhungo esisiza abantu abamnyama ngaphandle kwemicikilisho eminingi."Siqale ukukhathazeka ngesikhathi iSouth African Reserve Bank (Sarb) iqoka umlawuli ukuba asebenzisane neThala. Siye sakhala nangesikhathi i-Absa ingayivuseleli inkontileka yokusebenzisana neThala. Kuyasikhathaza kakhulu ukuthi manje iFSCA isihoxise ilayisensi yeThala kangangokuthi alivumelekile ukuthatha amakhasimende amasha,” kusho uJaca.Uthe sekuphele iminyaka Ithala lizama ukuthola ilayisensi yamabhange kodwa aliphumeleli."Sicela uhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal, ikakhulukazi uNdunankulu uMnuz Thami Ntuli noMphathiswa wezokuThuthukiswa koMnotho, ezokuVakasha neMvelo, uMfundisi Musa Zondi, bangenelele. Sibonile eGauteng uMphathiswa wezeziMali ehlenga iDrip okuyinkampani kasomabhizinisi omnyama. Sicela naKwaZulu-Natal uhulumeni abhalele iSarb nezinye izikhungo ezilawula ukusebenza kwebhange Ithala ukuze linikwe ilayisensi yalo.”Uthe osomabhizinisi abamnyama basizwa yiThala uma bethole umsebenzi njengoba libaboleka imali yokuqala umsebenzi."Uma osomabhizinisi sebethole imali baye bagqugquzelwe ukuthi bavule nama-akhawunti ebhange Ithala. Ngisho ozakwethu laba abaphakela izikole baye baboleke kulo imali. Uma lingasakwazi ukuvula ama-akhawunti amasha kusho ukuthi baningi abazothikamezeka. Siyacela uhulumeni enze isiqiniseko sokuthi ilayisensi iyabuya.”Isikhulu esiphezulu sebhange Ithala, uDkt Thulani Vilakazi, sithi phansi amaphaphu kubantu ngokuhoxiswa kwelayisensi yi-FSCA ngoba lisazoqhubeka nokusebenza."Ithala lisavuliwe futhi liyaqhubeka nokusiza amakhasimende alo. Sifisa ukuqinisekisa abantu ukuthi imali yabo iphephile futhi asikho isidingo sokuthi bazoyikhipha.”Uthe ilayisensi ihoxiswe ngoba iFSCA inganeme ngokulandelwa kwemigimo ethile ethinta imali (financial soundness reguirements)."Abathola amathenda basazoqhubeka nokusizwa Ithala Development Finance Corporation, okuyinkampani ezimele. Amakhasimende ebhange Ithala azoqhubeka nokusebenzisa ama-akhawunti awo, azoqhubeka nokukhokha ngamakhadi ezitolo nokukhipha imali ezitolo nakuma-ATMs. Ababoleke imali eThala bazoqhubeka nokuyikhokha. Imishwalense yamakhasimende ngeke iphazamiseke, konke kuzoqhubeka kahle.”Uthe iyodwa kuphela into abangavumelekile ukuyenza ngokomyalelo we-FSCA, wukuvula ama-akhawunti amasha.Ubalule ukuthi imigomo ethinta imali (financial soundness requirements) ebekwe kwisigaba 194 somthetho wezikhungo ezisebenza ngemali awulithinti Ithala njengoba lingabhalisile njengebhange ngaphansi kwesigaba 1 se-Banks Act.Uthe isinqumo se-FSCA sokuhoxisa ilayisensi yokuhlinzeka ngemali siza emuva kokuthi Ithala lingasathathwa njengesikhungo esisebenza ngendlela ehlukile kwamanye amabhange yize kunomlawuli oqinisekisayo ukuthi imali yabantu iphephile kuze kutholakale isisombululo sezihibe ezibhekene neThala.
INKAMPANI ephehla ugesi kuleli i-Eskom ithi zihamba kahle izinhlelo zokushintsha izinto kule nkampani njengoba sekuphele izinsuku eziwu-150 ugesi ungacimi ezweni.Iveze ukuthi namuhla izoba nesithangami sabezindaba ukuchaza kabanzi ngezinhlelo zayo zokuqinisekisa ukuthi lesi simo siyaqhubeka.Ukungacimi kukagesi kusho ukuthi isiyonge u-R10.60 billion kudizili njengoba ingakhanyisi imishini esetshenziswa ezimweni eziphuthumayo.Ithe iziteshi ezenza kahle yiKusile, Kendal, Majuba neLethabo kanti ezinye nazo zihlale zinogesi owu-70%.Ugesi ongekho njengamanje uphakathi kuka-9 800MW no-10 482MW.Ugesi okhona uwu-31 963MW kanti odingwa ngabantu uwu-26 420MW.Abophiko lwezokuxhumana e-Eskom bathe ngesikhathi ithimba lale nkampani lenza izinhlelo zasebusika lalilindele ukuthi okungenani ugesi uzocinywa ngokwesigaba sesibili. Lalizitshela ukuthi kuzoba nogesi owu-15 500MW kusukela ngo-Ephreli 26 kuze kuphele ubusika kodwa izinhlelo zokulungisa ingqalasizinda ziye zashintsha isimo.Bathe namuhla i-Eskom izokhipha izinhlelo zasehlobo zikagesi ezizoqala kuSepthemba 1 kuze kube wuMashi 31 wonyaka ozayo.Yize ugesi ungacimi ngokohlelo lokunqamula ugesi kodwa uyacinywa ukuvikela ingqalasizinda okungama-transformer (imishini yokuphehla ugesi). Ugesi ucima lapho bebaningi abantu abadinga ugesi njengoba ingqalasizinda yakhelwe ukuhlinzeka isibalo esithile ngogesi. Lolu hlelo lubizwa nge-load reduction.Kugqugquzelwe abantu ukuba babike abaxhuma ugesi wezinyokanyoka ukuze kuvikelwe ama-transformer. UBUHLAKANI namava kaMgqugquzeli kaZwelonke weqembu Umkhonto weSizwe, uMnuz Floyd Shivambu, azokwazi ukumsiza ekuphembeni amagatsha kuleli qembu, akhe imigomo aphinde abumbe izinhlaka ezifana nophiko lwentsha nolwabesifazane.Lokhu kushiwo abahlaziyi bezepolitiki abathe mkhulu umthwalo obekwe emahlombe kaShivambu kanti abangabazi ukuthi lo msebenzi uzowenza ngempumelelo. Bakusho lokhu nje, kulandela ukutuswa kwesenzo somholi we-MK, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, sokujuba uShivambu kulesi sikhundla njengoba leli qembu lisabumba amagatsha kanjalo nemigomo.UZuma umncomile uShivambu osule kwi-EFF njengephini likamengameli, ngobuhlakani bakhe wathi wambona esasophikweni lwentsha lwe-ANCYL ukuthi akayimpumputhi ipolitiki.Umhlaziyi wezepolitiki, uMnuz Zakhele Ndlovu waseNyuvesi yaKwaZulu-Natal, uhambe emagameni abancoma isinyathelo se-MK sokujuba uShivambu kulesi sikhundla.Uthe uzokwazi ukubumba amagatsha, akhe imigomo, abhekele labo abajutshwe kumakhokhasi ePhalamende naseziShayamthetho, aphinde enze nokunye."Unamava nobuhlakani njengoba nakwi-EFF nguyena muntu obethathwa njengomunye onobuhlakani. Angingabazi ukuthi lo msebenzi anikwe wona uzowenza ngempumelelo.”UNdlovu uthe kodwa akaboni ezokwazi ukubumba izinhlaka ezixovayo ngaphakathi ngoba nguZuma ongenza lokho."Asazi futhi noma uzokwazi yini ukukhulisa iqembu ezifundazweni elingatholanga khona amavoti amaningi. Kunabakholelwa ukuthi i-MK ivotelwe abantu abakhuluma isiZulu, ngakho angazi noma uzokwazi yini ukulikhulisa ezifundazweni ezifana neNorth West, Limpopo nase-Western Cape,” kusho uNdlovu. Omunye umhlaziyi ofundisa enyuvesi yakuleli i-Unisa uNkk Sanet Madonsela, uncome umnyakazo we-MK ukujubela uShivambu kulesi sikhundla.Uthe bekulokhu kukhulunywa ngokungahleleki kwezinto kwi-MK njengoba namagatsha ebengekho."Uzokwazi ukukhanda amagatsha anike ne-MK umkhombandlela. Ngakho umnyakazo omuhle ngoba uzogxila nasezintweni ezithinta ucwaningo kuleli qembu.”Uthe abanye bebecabanga ukuthi ukuthatha lesi sikhundla kufana nokwehlelwa amandla njengoba kwi-EFF nguyena obelandela umholi wayo ngokuba sesikhundleni esiphezulu.UNobhala Jikelele we-MK, uDkt Sifiso Maseko, uveze ukuthi umsebenzi kamgqugquzeli kazwelonke wukuhlela, athuthukise izinhlaka zeqembu, akhe imiqulu nemigomo, acije ngezepolitiki, enze ucwaningo, aqaphe ukusebenza kwemigomo.Okunye ngukuqapha ukusebenza kwalabo abakumakhokhasi ahlukene aphinde abe sethimbeni leKhomishini yezoKhetho.UShivambu uthe noma noma bangamsusa kulesi sikhundla kodwa uzoqhubeka nokuba yilungu."Uma ngisuswa ekubeni yilungu leqembu, ngizoqhubeka nokuba ivolontiya. Ngizofaka izingqwembe noma kuthiwa ubuholi buyangichitha. Angizele izikhundla kwi-MK kodwa ukuzosebenzela abantu.”
UGWETSHWE kanzima owesilisa waseZakheni owaboshiswa ngumama wakhe ngemuva kokuba agonyuluka kuye ngokubulala umuntu ababemgebenga nabangani bakhe.INkantolo yesiFunda eZakheni igwebe uSaneliso Tshabalala (23) noLungani Ngwenya (19) udilikajele neminyaka engu-25 umuntu ngamunye ngamacala okubulala, ukugqekeza ngenhloso yokubamba inkunzi nokubamba inkunzi kusetshenziswa isihluku kanye nokuthumba abakwenza ngoMashi 2023. Ummangali uSiyabonga Makhaza nomufi uSithembe Mabizela babehlala emqashweni eZakheni, eMnambithi. Ekuseni ngoMashi 7, 2023, bavuswa wumsindo wokuphuka kwengilazi. Babona amadoda amane endlini yabo. Amadoda abashaya athatha nezimpahla zawo. Emva kwalokho uMakhaza noMabizela bathathwa bayiswa ebhulohweni eliseduze batshelwa ukuthi beqe.Baphinde bashaywa lapho benqaba. UTshabalala wathi abagxume ngoba esaba ukuthi bazokwazi ukubakhomba uma kuvulwa icala. Yize uMakhaza agwazwa wakwazi ukubaleka kodwa uMabizela akakwazanga ukuphunyuka.UMakhaza waya emizini eminingi eseduzane ukuze athole usizo wagcina efike esiteshini samaphoyisa. Ngesikhathi amaphoyisa eya endaweni yesehlo, athola isidumbu sikaMabizela. UTshabalala waboshwa sekuphele isonto ngemuva kokuvuma icala kunina, wabe esemnikela emaphoyiseni. UNgwenya waboshwa ngemuva kwalokho.Ekwenzeni lesi sigwebo sibe nzima, uMshushisi uCwayita Ngcongo wethule isitatimende esibhalwe ugogo kaMabizela. Esitatimendeni sakhe, uthe uMabizela wayeyithemba lomndeni lempilo engcono. Washiya ikhaya wayohlala eZakheni ukuze ezokwazi ukufunda njengoba wayesenza unyaka wokugcina ezifundweni zakhe.
UKHOMISHANA wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutanent General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, uthi evile ku-50 amaphoyisa asemisiwe, aphenywa ngamacala abandakanya ukwephula umthetho kusuka ngo-Ephreli kulo nyaka kuze kube yimanje.UMkhwanazi ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ephendula imibuzo ohlelweni obeluyisipesheli lwe-Newzroom Afrika kudingidwa izinkinga ngamaphoyisa eKZN.Lokhu kulandela izigameko ezimbalwa ezibikwayo zokungasebenzi kwamanye amaphoyisa ngendlela nokubandakanyeka ezenzweni zobugebengu."Uma kunezigameko lapho kutholakala khona ukuthi amaphoyisa ephule umthetho ngandlela thile, kuyabhekwana nakho. Ngingakusho ngingangabazi ukuthi kulo nyaka nje kuphela, kusuka ngo-Ephreli, sekumiswe amaphoyisa evile ku-50, iningi lawo lisahamba amacala ngaphakathi ngezinto asolelwa ukuthi azenzile eziphambene nomthetho,” usho kanje.Ukusho lokhu nje, kuthe ngesonto eledlule inhlangano i-Amnesty International yadedela umbiko wocwaningo lwayo oluthathe izinyanga eziwu-18 ngokubulawa kwabaholi nezishoshovu zenhlangano Abahlali Basemijondolo. Lolu cwaningo luveza ukuthi amaphoyisa awawasukumeli amacala okubulawa kwalaba ngendlela efanele, bekhala kakhulu ngesiteshi samaphoyisa esise-Cato Crest, ngokubukela phansi abahlala kulezi zindawo abasuke bezobika noma belandelela emacaleni abikiwe.UMkhwanazi uthe nakuba engenayo imininingwane ngamacala le nhlangano ekhuluma ngawo kulolu cwaningo, kodwa unxusa ukuthi uma umuntu ezovula icala esola ukuthi iphoyisa alibenzi ubulungiswa noma ekholelwa ukuthi liyabandakanyeka ebugebengwini obuthile, lowo muntu wamukelekile ukuzama olunye osizo njengokubika lelo phoyisa ophikweni olubhekelele ukuphenya ngamacala awo, i-Independent Investigating Directorate (IPID) ukuze luphenye.Ukhwele wadilika kulabo abagxeka amaphoyisa ngokusebenzisa inganono uma edubulana nezigebengu, isikhathi esiningi okuvame ukuthi kufe abasolwa. Uthe umsebenzi wamaphoyisa awulula njengokukhuluma kwalabo abasuke behlaziya abakubukela kude, abangakaze babe sesigamekweni lapho izigebengu zitholene phezulu nawo.Uthe maningi amaphoyisa agcina ebulewe kulesi sigameko zokutholana phezulu nezigebengu. Lesi sifundazwe sibala nezinye ezinezinga eliphezulu lokubulawa kwabantu, njengoba izibalo zobugebengu ziveza ukuthi bangu-18 abantu ababulawayo kusona ngosuku.
INHLANGANO elwela ukuthi abantu badle ukudla okunomsoco, iHealthy Living Alliance (Heala), isembhidlangweni wokunxenxa uhulumeni ukuba aphoqe izinkampani zokudla ukuthi zibhale emakhathonini nasemathinini ukuthi ukudla kuthakwe ngani.Lapha kukhulunywa ngabakhiqiza iziphuzo, ukudla okusemathinini, okusezitsheni zoplastiki njengamayogathi nokusemakhathonini.UNksz Zukiswa Zimela obhekelele ezokuxhumana kwi-Heala, uthe banemikhankaso emibili eseqhulwini njengamanje. Owokuqala; owokuqinisekisa ukuthi amalebuli okudla anezithako zakho abhalwa ngaphambili, ngamagama agqamile futhi kusheshe kucaciswe ukuthi lokho kudla kunoshukela, usawoti namafutha angakanani.Owesibili; umkhankaso owokuthi intela kashukela isetshenziselwe ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bakuleli banokudla okwanele ikakhulukazi izingane ezivela emindenini ehlwempu.Lokhu uthe kungenziwa ngokuthi kwengezwe isibonelelo sabangasebenzi noma kwakhiwe izindawo ezilonda ukudla okuzodliwa wumphakathi (food bank).Uthe amalebuli okudla avamise ukuba ngemuva lapho uzotshelwa ngokuthi lokho kudla kuthakwe ngani, ngabe kunempilo nokunye okuningi.Ubalule ukuthi amalebuli okudla ayadida ngoba abhalwe ngamagama esiNgisi angakhulunywa njalo.Lokhu uthi kwenza abantu bathenge noma yikuphi ukudla abasuke bezitshela ukuthi kunempilo kanti kunoshukela, usawoti, amafutha nokunye okungenampilo okusuke kucashile.Uveze ukuthi ukudla kakhulu ushukela, usawoti namafutha kubanga isifo sikashukela (i-type 2 diabetes), isifo somfutho wegazi (high blood), esenhliziyo kanjalo nesohlangothi."Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bafundiswe ngendlela yokudla kahle, ukuze bakwazi ukubona ukudla okunomsoco nokungenawo. Into esiyifaka emlonyeni inomthelela empilweni yethu ngoba kukhona asebeguliswa wuhlobo lokudla abakudlayo. Sidinga uhulumeni enze amalebuli okudla abe ngaphambili,” kusho uNksz Zimela.Uveze ukuthi amanye amazwe afuna ukuba nezakhamuzi eziphile kahle aseqalile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amalebuli aba ngaphambili ekudleni. Kulawo mazwe kubalwa iBrazil, Mexico neChile.Ubuye wakhala ngokuthi eNingizimu Afrika abantu bakhuluphele ngokweqile njengoba ucwaningo luveza ukuthi abayisithupha kwabesifazane abawu-10 bakhuluphele ngokweqile kanti u-13% wezingane ukhuluphele kakhulu.Uthe izifo azigcini kwabesifazane nezingane ngoba olunye ucwaningo luveza ukuthi umuntu oyedwa kwabahlanu eNingizimu Afrika, unesifo somfutho wegazi, esenhliziyo noma usengcupheni yokuqalwa yilezi zifo.Konke lokhu uthe kufakazela ukuthi abantu kufanele badle ukudla okunomsoco, ngisho ezitolo kube sobala ukuthi yini abayithengayo.
BANIKWE izinsuku eziwu-30 abaphathi bekhaya labadaba iKwaMashu Christian Care Society ukuba balungise isimo salo, kungenjalo lizovalwa.Kuleli sonto, uMphathiswa wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi, uNksz Mbali Shinga, unikele kuleli khaya kungazelele muntu emuva kokuzwa ukuthi uMasipala weTheku usulivalele amanzi ngenxa yokuthi likweleta ngaphezu kuka-R2 million."Leli khaya lisebenza ngokuzimela kodwa lokho akusho ukuthi sizosonga izandla uma izinto zingahambi kahle. Uma bengasilungisi sizobhalela uMnyango wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi kuzwelonke ukuba ulivale. Ngeke sivume abantu abadala bahlale ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima,” kusho uNksz Shinga.Uthembise ukuthi uzosiqapha ngeso lokhozi isimo saleli khaya ngoba ufuna abantu abadalala baphile kamnandi, hhayi ukuthi baphatheke kabi.Ngaphandle kokuvalwa kwamanzi, uNksz Shinga uveze ukuthi iKwaMashu Christian Care Society inezinkinga zokuphathwa njengoba amalungu ebhodi engaboni ngasolinye okuze kwaholela ekutheni ibhange ligodle kwi-akhawunti imali yaleli khaya.UNksz Shinga ujube ithimba eliyisipesheli elizosebenzisana nabaphethe ikhaya ukuze likwazi ukuthola imali yalo, likhokhele izikweletu, likhuluma noMasipala weTheku ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amanzi ayabuya.Uphethe ngokuthi uzosiqapha ngeso lokhozi isimo, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi isimo siyalunga ukuze abadala bahlale ekhaya elifudumele.
BANGASE babe senkingeni abagcotshwa baseBuhleni okuthiwa baxakazise uMfundisi waseGinyezinye becasulwa wukuthi ugqoke umjiva enkonzweni yomngcwabo wakubo ebiphethwe yibona.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi uMfundisi Joseph Mhlongo waseGinyezinye nophinde akhulumele lolu hlangothi, kuze kwaphoqa ukuthi angayi ngisho emathuneni kungcwatshwa udadewabo nomfowabo, exakaziswa abagcotshwa baseBuhleni eMphushini, eFolweni, emasontweni amabili edlule. IGinyezinye iholwa yinkosi Sizwe Shembe, uMudliwamafa.Kuthiwa uMfundisi Mhlongo ubesemngcwabeni womndeni, kushone udadewabo nomfowabo ngesikhathi ehlelwa yilo mshophi."Ubaba omncane oshonelwe ukhonza eBuhleni mina ngikhonza eGinyezinye. Bengiyongcwaba izingane zakhe ezishone ngokulandelana. Kuqale kwashona intombazane ebigula ngoLwesibili, kwalandela umfana obesengozini yemoto ngoLwesine. "Ngifike khona ngigqoke umnazaretha kodwa ngangahlala nabagcotshwa, ngahlala nomndeni ngoba bengazi ukuthi inkonzo iphethwe abaseBuhleni. Kuze kumina omunye wabagcotshwa engitshela ukuthi sengathi kuzoba nenkinga ukuthi ngigqoke umjiva uma kukhona bona. Ngibabuzile ukuthi inkinga ikuphi ngoba ngeke ngikwazi ngisho ukuphatha inkonzo ngoba ngiyilungu lomndeni oshonelwe,” kusho uMfundisi Mhlongo.Uthe emva kwalokho, lo mgcotshwa uphindele emuva wayokhuluma nabanye abagcotshwa baseBuhleni. Uveze ukuthi babheke kuyena bamkhombisa ngezandla ukuthi akunankinga. Yize kunjalo uthe ubebona ukuthi banenkinga ngaye. "Ngosuku lokungcwaba ngixakaziswe yelinye ilungu laseBuhleni elingeyena ngisho umgcotshwa, lingibamba ngomjiva lizama ukungikhumulisa wona phambi kwabantu. Kuvele kwacaca ukuthi nabagcotshwa bayazi ngale nto eyenziwa yilo mfana njengoba bevele bazibukela nje, bangakhuza. Kuze kwasuka abafowethu abangewona amaNazaretha bafuna ukulwa kwasuka umsindo khona emngcwabeni. Kuze kwaphoqeleka ukuthi ngingayi ngisho emathuneni ngasala ekhaya ngoba impi ibingafuni ukunqamuka njengoba bese nginqabile ukukhumula umjiva,” usho kanje.Uthe okubuhlungu kakhulu ukuthi akakwazanga ngisho ukubeka itshe kufihlwa izingane zakwabo ngenxa yabantu abangenzisanga okwamakholwa. Uthe okumphatha kabuhlungu kakhulu ukuthi uyazi ukuthi iNkosi Mduduzi Shembe (uNyazilwezulu) kaluhambisani nale nto eyenziwe abagcotshwa balo. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi enkonzweni yokuqala konyaka lukuvezile ukuthi amaNazaretha awahloniphe imindeni uma ishonelwe.Okhulumela uNyazilwezulu, uMnuz Thokozani Mncwabe, uthe sebezwile ngalesi sigameko."Sizobikelwa iNkosi uNyazilwezulu. UBaba uNyazi alukuvumi lokhu abakwenzile, kumele kube nezinyathelo ezithathwayo ukunqanda izimo ezinje nangomuso. Wonke umuntu wamukelekile ukuthi angahlangana nezihlobo zakhe ngaphandle kokuphazanyiswa ngoba esohlangothini oluthize lwamaNazaretha. "Mina nje nginazo izihlobo eKuphakameni naseThembezinhle futhi ngiyahlangana nazo njengomndeni wami, angiphazanyiswa wumuntu yize ngaziwa ukuthi ngihamba nobaba uNyazilwezulu. Okunye abantu kumele bazi ukuthi ukuba nezinhliziyo ezimbi kwabantu baseBuhleni akuwona umthetho webandla kodwa basuke befike nazo bangaphenduki noma sebebhabhadisiwe. Ukuba nezinhliziyo ezimbi lokhu abakwenzile,” kusho uMncwabe.Uthe umfundisi abamxakazisile uhlonipheke kabi futhi unomlando omude kabi nenkolo yamaNazaretha. Uthe kubo kaMfundisi Mhlongo yilapho okwakufikela khona uMqaliwendlela kanjalo neNkosi iLanga belifikela kubo kusanda kuqala inkolo yobuNazaretha.

UNIKWE umsebenzi wokubumba izinhlaka zeqembu Umkhonto weSizwe (MK), ukusungulwa kophiko lwentsha nolwabesifazane, ukwakha imigomo yeqembu aphinde aqaphe ukusebenza kwabajutshelwe ePhalamende naseziShayamthetho obeyiphini likamengameli kwi-EFF uMnuz Floyd Shivambu.UShivambu umenyezelwe njengoMgqugquzeli kaZwelonke kwi-MK esithangamini sabezindaba ebesihanjelwe wuMengameli waleli qembu, uMnuz Jacob Zuma.Kulesi sithangami ebesiseSandton, eGauteng, kumenyezelwe abaholi abaphezulu baleli qembu abayisishiyagalombili.UShivambu oshiye kwi-EFF muva nje, bekubhekwe ngabomvu isikhundla abezonikwa sona kwi-MK njengoba eshiye iqembu alisungula noMnuz Julius Malema.UMalema ukhale ngokushiywa nguShivambu wamfanisa nomuntu ojikele umzabalazo.UShivambu uthe akazange ajikele umzabalazo kodwa usemkhankasweni wokwakha iqembu elizofukula abamnyama."Ngeke sixolise ngomsebenzi esiwenzayo ngoba yinto esibizelwe kuyona. BASABALWA nabanye abasebenzi abaxhashazwayo abasebenzi basezindlini njengoba ucwaningo lwakamuva lweSweepSouth luveza ukuthi abaholelwa ngokohlelo lwe-National Minimum Wage (NMW).ISweepSouth yinhlangano efunela abasebenzi basezindlini umsebenzi.Ngokwe-NMW umsebenzi kufanele ahole uR27.58 ngehora okusho ukuthi ngosuku kufanele athole uR220.64.Ucwaningo lwenziwe kubasebenzi basezindlini abawu-5 600 okugcwele kubo abesifazane abaneminyaka ewu-26 kuya kwewu-41.Kuvele ukuthi abaqashe abasebenzi basezindlini abakwazi ukuholela abantu iNMW ngenxa yezindleko zokuphila, bakhale ngokuthi nabo amaholo abo aphelela kugesi, ekuthengeni igilosa nasemalini kaphethroli neyezinye izidingo zempilo.Kuvele ukuthi abasebenzi basezindlini baholelwa uR2 659 uma besebenze inyanga yonke ezifundazweni eziningi kanti kukhona nabasaholelwa imali engaphansi kwalena.Kuthiwa izifundazwe eziholela kangcono yi-Gauteng neWestern Cape njengoba khona umsebenzi wesifazane wasendlini ohola kancane ethola uR3 349 ngenyanga, bese kuthi owesilisa ovamise ukusebenza engadini athole uR3 059 ngenyanga.Abasebenzi basendlini abahola kangconywana bathola uR3 792 ngenyanga bese kuthi abayitoho bathole uR3 250 ngenyanga.Kuvela ukuthi abokufika bagcwele kulo mkhakha njengoba u-59% okukhulunywe nawo udabuka eZimbabwe, u-37% ngowakuleli bese u-3% kube ngowaseMalawi.Kuthiwe u-83% wabasebenzi basezindlini yiwona kuphela osebenzayo emindenini yawo, unabantu abane abathembele kuwo.UNkk Pinky Mashiane ongumengameli wenyunyana i-United Domestic Workers of South Africa, uthe akubamangazi ukuthi abasebenzi basezindlini baholelwa kancane badlulwa ngisho ngabasemapulazini."Basaxhashazwa abasebenzi basezindlini, sidinga ukuthi uhulumeni athumele abahloli emizini ehlukene ukuze bayoqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi baholelwa malini. Kubuhlungu ngoba manje sesixhashazwa ngabantu bakithi okuyibona abaholela imali encane kakhulu,” kusho uNkk Mashiane.Uthe bazoqhubeka nokugqugquzela abasebenzi ukuthi bangene enyunyaneni ukuze bathole ubulungiswa. Ubalule ukuthi abanye abaqashi abayifaki nemali ye-Unemployment insurance fund (uif) okuba yinkinga uma abasebenzi sebexoshiwe.Uveze ukuthi abasebenzi banikwa uhlu lomsebenzi okufanele bawenze kodwa uyanda njalo ngenyanga kodwa iholo limi ndawonye.Njengamanje abasebenzi abaqashelwe ukuhlanza indlu kuphela kufanele okungenani bathole uR3 349, abasebenza engadini bathole uR3 128, abagada izingane bathola uR3 464, abagada abadala bahola uR3 324 bese abaqashelwe ukupheka bathole uR3 463.UNkk Lourandi Kriel oyisikhulu esiphezulu seSweepSouth, uthe ucwaningo lwabo kufanele luvuse wonke umuntu waseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi abe nozwelo, aholele umsebenzi wasendlini imali efanele.Naye uthe uhulumeni kufanele athumele abahloli futhi ajezise abangaholeli imali enqunyiwe.Abaqashi abakhulume neSolezwe bathe nabo abakwazi ukuholela abasebenzi basezindlini imali enqunyiwe ngenxa yokuthi igilosa isibiza uR5 252.15, ugesi uyabiza kanti nemali mboleko inyuka umlibe.UNkk Nqobile Mahlangu (40) ozinze eGoli, uthe ubenomsebenzi oqashelwe ukuhlanza ikhaya abemholela ngokohlelo lwe-NMW iminyaka eyisishiyagalombili bahlukana uma esefuna ukuzosebenzela eThekwini.Uthe ubewenza kahle umsebenzi kanti emuva kokuthi elahlekelwa wuye uye wathola abantu abangazimiseli ngomsebenzi abebefuna ukuholelwa ngokwe-NMW kodwa bengawenzi kahle umsebenzi. Uveze ukuthi abanye bebengathandi nokutshelwa ukuthi bawenze kanjani umsebenzi. Ubalule ukuthi ukubiza kwempilo kwenza abanye abaqashi bangakwazi ukuholela ngokohlelo lwe-NMW kodwa baye baxoxisane nalabo abadinga umsebenzi ukuthi mhlawumbe bano-R2 500 bese bezwana. Njengamanje uthe unomsebenzi ofika ngempelasonto ngenxa yokuthi akamtholi umsebenzi oziphatha kahle enze okulindeleke kuye.
SESIPHELILE isikhathi sokuthi umuntu wesifazane ukhuliselwa ukuthi agane nakho okugcina kumdalela izinkinga zokuthi kunabantu abacabanga ukuthi ukulobola kusho ukuthenga.Lokhu kushiwo iPhini likaNgqongqoshe wezokuThutha, uMnuz Mkhuleko Hlengwa ngesikhathi ekhuluma emhlanganweni wokubonisana nokubheka indima eklanywe umunxa wamabhanoyi ekuqinisekiseni ukulingana ngokobulili emisebenzini ekhona kulo mkhakha, iNational Aviation Gender Summit, ebiseThekwini.Uthe lo mhlangano uyingxenye yokuqhubeka nomkhankaso wokulinganisa abesifazane nabesilisa kulo mkhakha owaqala ngo-2018, ngesikhathi lolu phiko luqala ukuba nesigcawu esinjengalesi."Kulo mhlangano sizobheka ukuthi iziphi ezinye izindlela esingazenza ukuze siqhubeke nomgqigqo omuhle. NgokweWorld Economic Forum kungathatha iminyaka engu-102 ukuthi sikwazi ukuvala igebe elikhona phakathi kwabantu besifazane nabesilisa. Yize kunocwaningo olunjalo thina sibheka ukuthi yini esingayenza ezokwenza ukuthi sisheshe sifinyelele lapho kumele sifike khona. Siyabonga ukuthi kulolu phiko kuningi osekwenziwe njengoba sibona abantu besifazane bebaningi ezikhundleni zokuphatha, ukuze kuphume lokhu kucabanga ukuthi kunemisebenzi ethile abesifazane abangayenza. Ezinye zezindlela zokucabanga ziholela ekutheni abantu besifazane bagcine sebehlukumezeka ngenxa yelobolo," kusho uHlengwa.IPHINI likaNqongqoshe wezokuThutha, uMnuz Mkhuleko Hlengwa oyisikhulumi emhlanganweni wokucobelelana ngolwazi obheka ukulingana ngokobulili emkhakheni wamabhanoyi obuyizolo, eThekwini Isithombe: SIBONELO NGCOBOUNkk Poppy Khoza owumqondisi wesikhungo esilawula amabhanoyi, iCivil Aviation Authority, uthe sekusele iminyaka eyisithupha ngaphambi kokuthi kufike u2030 lesi sikhungo esizibekele ukuthi ngawo abesifazane abasezikhundleni babe sebelingana nabesilisa kube u50/50."Senza kahle uma ubheka ukuthi lesi sikhungo sineminyaka engu-28 kuphela. Uma sikwaze ukushintsha izinto ngale minyaka, iminyaka engu-102 iyofika kade salungisa," kusho uNkk Khoza.Uthe abesifazane abanamalayisensi okushayela amabhanoyi bangu-1 590 kwabesilisa abangu-11 000. U-45% wabesifazane abasezikhundleni zokuphatha, ophikweni olubhekele ukugcinwa komthetho uthe bangu-37.1% , abaphethe ebhodini lokuphatha kulesi sikhungo bangu-52%.Uthe ngokubona kwakhe enye inselelo ekhona ukuthi umuntu uma ecabanga wona ucabanga ukushayela ibhanoyi kanti ziningi izinto ezikhona ezingahambisana nomkhakha awufundele okungadingeka ukuthi ashintshe kancane abhekele wona." Uma uwummeli uyakwazi ukwengeza ngezifundo ezithile ukuze ubhekele amabhanoyi kanjalo neminye imikhakha. Okudingeka ukuthi abantu besifazane bakwenze ukufunda izifundo ezilingana nephakethe labo. Ngiye ngithi uma ukwazi ukukhokha imali yokugibela ungakwazi ukufundela ikhono elithile elingakungenisa kulo mkhakha,” kusho uNkk Khoza.
INHLANGANO elawula izinkampani ezisebenza ngemali kuleli, i-Financial Sector Conduct Authority (FSCA) imemezele ukuthi ihoxise ilayisensi yokusebenza yebhange Ithala.Ithe ilayisensi ihoxiswe ngokomthetho i-Financial Advisory and Intermediary Services Act (FAIS Act), 37 ka 2002.Esitatimendeni esithunyelwe kwiSolezwe izolo, i-FSCA ithe ilayisensi ihoxiswe ngoJulayi 26 ka-2024, kanti namanje isahoxisiwe. Ithala lizobuyiselwa ilayisensi yalo uma selilungise okukhalwa ngakho.Isizathu sokuhoxiswa kwelayisensi wukuthi Ithala alikho sesimweni esihle kwezezimali ukuze kuvikelwe amakhasimende alo."Ukuhoxiswa kwelayisensi kusho ukuthi Ithala alivumelekile ukuqala umsebenzi omusha othinta imali ngaphansi kwe-FAIS Act. Kufanele lichazele amakhasimende alo ngokwenzekayo ngoba livumelekile ukusiza amakhasimende alo ebelisebenza nawo ngaphambi kokuhoxiswa kwelayisensi,” kuchaza iFSCA esitatimendeni.Iveze ukuthi Ithala lizamile ukufaka isicelo sokuphikisa isinqumo seFSCA kwi-Financial Services Tribunal kodwa yachithwa, icala belilalelwe ngo-Agasti 22, 2024.I-FSCA iveze ukuthi Ithala belilokhu libekwe iso ngabasebenzi bayo (FSCA) kanti bathole ukuthi kalikho sesimweni esihle sezezimali ngokwesigaba 46 (1) sokusebenza ngemali kanjalo nangokwesigaba 48 (1) salo mthetho.Ithe kubalulekile ukuthi izikhungo ezisebenza ngemali zilandele umthetho wokusebenza ngemali FAIS Act, okuyiwona ovikela amakhasimende alezi zikhungo.Ibalule ukuthi kubalulekile ukuthi ibhange lime kahle esimweni sezezimali (solvency), lifeze lokho elalisungulelwe kona ukuze kusizakale amakhasimende alo nezinye izinhlaka.Isikhulu esiphezulu sebhange Ithala, uDkt Thulani Vilakazi sithe abantu kumele bazi ukuthi Ithala livuliwe ukubhekelela amakhasimende alo njengoba lisalungisa okushiwo yiFSCA.Uthe kuyiqiniso ukuthi ilayisensi ihoxisiwe kodwa lokhu ngeke kuphazamise imishwalense yamakhasimende abo nemihlomulo ayitholayo, abantu bangaqhubeka nokufaka izicelo zokunxeshezelwa bazosizakala."Uhulumeni wasungula Ithala ukusiza abantu baKwaZulu-Natal ngezimali ikakhulukazi labo abasezindaweni eziswele emakhaya. Ithala liyawenza umsebenzi walo, liyiguqulile impilo yabantu. Ukulandela imithetho yokusebenza ngezimali kulisebenzele Ithala njengoba lithole umbiko ongenagcobho woMncwaningi Mabhuku kunyaka wezimali ka-2023/24. Ayikho imali emoshiwe noma esebenze kungafanele. Selisebenze kahle, linozinzo iminyaka engaphezu kuka-20 .” kusho uVilakazi.
SIKHIHLA esikaNandi isaguga (78) saseLovu, eThekwini esiqolwe isamba semali owesilisa waseMgababa, esidayisela indlu yomxhaso okungesiyo eyakhe.UNkk Cecilia Mswazi (78) otshele Isolezwe ukuthi usephenduke undingasithebeni, uthe bekunguMeyi nyakenye ngesikhathi ethenga umuzi kuMnuz Daluxolo Sifumba ngoR160 000.Elandisa ngesigameko, uthe wayefuna ukuthola umuzi omusha emva kokudayisa omdala ayesehlale kuwo iminyaka.Uthe wezwa ngowesilisa wendawo ukuthi uSifumba udayisa umuzi wakhe osendaweni, wamnika inombolo yocingo ukuba amshayele."Sengimshayela ucingo ngathola ngempela ukuthi uyawudayisa umuzi. Wajaha ukuthi sikhokhelane, wathi nokho itayitela akakalitholi,” kusho uNkk Mswazi.Uthe uSifumba wathi uma selibuya itayitela, liyoshintshwa libize uNkk Mswazi.Uthe baya ebhange, bayofakelana imali isuswa ebhange likaNkk Mswazi, iya kwelikaSifumba."Ngahamba ngayongena kahle endlini kodwa kwathi uma kuphela isonto omakhelwane bangitshela ukuthi ngizophuma kabuhlungu kuwo, sengikhishwa abanikazi bangempela,” kusho uNkk MswaziUthe wathi uma ebuyela kuSifumba, wangundaza, maqede waqala waziba izingcingo zakhe.Uthe kuthathe isikhathi ezama ukuthi uSifumba ambuyisele imali yakhe, kwaze kwafika ekutheni ayomvulela icala ezinsukwini ezimbalwa ezedlule."Ungenze isilo sengubo engiqola imali yami yokugcina. Ngesikhathi ngithenga indlu, nganginethemba lokuthi ngizoba nekhaya elikahle kanti angibuzanga elangeni,” kusho uNkk Mswazi.Uthe akufunayo kuSifumba, imali yakhe.Ethintwa uSifumba uthe uNkk Mswazi ukhuluma iphutha, yena wamtshela ukuthi indlu ayikabi netayitela emdayisela wathi akunankinga."Emva kwezinyanga ezintathu ehlala kuyo wathi iyavuza akasayifuni, ngamtshela ukuthi imali uyoyithola uma sengithole itayitela,” kusho uSifumba.Uthe kumanje kuhlala indodana kaNkk Mswazi kule ndlu. Uvumile ukuthi indlu kwakuzoba eyomuntu othile kodwa wagcina enikwa enye indlu eCornubia. Uthe akulona iqiniso ukuthi uziba izingcingo. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi amaphoyisa aseManzimtoti aphenya icala lokukhwabanisa kulandela isigameko lapho isaguga siqolwe isamba semali.
OKHULE kanzima ukhumbule izintandane, abafelokazi nabampofu amahhashi akhe ewina emincintiswaneni yamahhashi ehlukene.UMnuz Nyanga Ndlangamandla ongumlimi nekhansela eDumbe, uthe amahhashi akhe amane abengenele imijaho yamahhashi kuyo okungowaseNkandla, owaseDundee nowaseKing Cetshwayo awine uR250 000 kulo nyaka. Lama hhhashi okunguShenge athi uliqambe esusela esibongweni sikaMntwana waKwaPhindangene ngoba lithembekile njengaye, akwenzeki lingawini, uBaselona, uMthwal'zethule no-Asenali.Uthe uqale ukungenela imijaho yamahhashi eyesekwa omasipala ngo-2008, ngaphambi kwalokho ubengenela imijaho yasemakhaya ebihlelwa abafuyi bamahhashia, obekuwinwa kuyo izingubo zokulala."Ngikhule kanzima ngikhuliswa usingamama. Ngiyazi ukuthi kunjani ukulala ungadlile, ukugqoka ihembe elilodwa amasonto amabili lingawashwa uya esikoleni. Lokho kuhlupheka mina kungenze ngazibamba zaqina, ngangayeki ukufunda. Ngifuna lolo gqozi ukulunika izingane ezikhuliswa ngabafelokazi neziyizintandane ukuze zazi ukuthi noma ukhule kanzima uyakwazi ukutabalasa uze uzimele nawe udonse abanye," kusho yena.UMNUZ Nyanga Ndlangamandla waseDumbe ephakamise enye yezindondo azithole ngokuwina kwamahhashi akhe emijahweni Isithombe: SITHUNYELWEUthe unemindeni emithathu kuyo okukhona ephethwe ngabafelokazi nephethwe izingane ayondlayo nyanga zonke. Kuyo kunezingane eziyisikhombisa ezifundayo azithengela umfaniswano nesinkwa zonke izinsuku."EDumbe miningi imindeni eswele, indlala ibhokile ngithe uma ngithola le mali ngase ngicabanga kuthi angibuyisele emphakathini. Abantu badle basuthe, ngingadli ngedwa," kusho uNdlangamandla.Uthe ufisa ukuthi uhulumeni umsize umnike indawo yokulima angatshala kuyo ummbila ozogaywa ube impuphu ezonikezwa imizi eswele njalo ngenyanga. Uthe amahhashi omjaho kuyabiza ukuwanakekela akufani namahhashi ajwayelekile okulanda izinkomo."Ngiwumfuyi ngiyakwazi ukunakekela imfuyo, kimi akuwona umthwalo ukuba nehhashi. Into eke ingithwalise kanzima ukuthi wona adinga ukunakekelwa ngokwehlukile ngoba awomjaho," kuchaza uNdlangamandla.
AMALUNGU ePhalamende ahoxiswe yiqembu uMkhonto weSizwe (MK), aseveze ukuthi asamhlonipha futhi asamthanda umholi waleli qembu, uMnuz Jacob Zuma. La malungu angu-10 aye enkantolo enkulu eWestern Cape efuna kumiswe ukufungiswa kwamalungu amasha ezikhundleni zawo, aveze ukuthi kunedlanzana elixovayo kuleli qembu elidinga ukususwa.Angu-18 amalungu ahoxiswe yi-MK ePhalamende ngoJulayi.Esithangamini sabezindaba izolo, okhulumele la malungu uMnuz Thami Khuzwayo owayehola uphiko lwezitshudeni kuleli qembu, uthe abalwi noZuma ngokuya enkantolo."Asilwi nomengameli uZuma ngoba siyamthanda futhi asilwi neqembu. Sajoyina leli qembu ngoba simthanda uZuma neqembu. Kodwa kunabantu okumele basuswe okuyibona abaxova iqembu,” kusho uKhuzwayo.Uthe baye enkantolo ngoba befuna ubulungiswa."Sethemba ukuthi uZuma uzoyixazulula le nkinga. Kunzima ukufinyelela kuyena uma ufuna ukumbona ngoba siyavinjwa. Ezinye izinto ezenzekayo akazazi,” kusho yena. IPhini likaMengameli we-MK ophinde ahole leli qembu ePhalamende, uDkt John Hlophe, lithe bazoyekela izinkantolo ukuthi zinqume ngalolu daba. "Njengoba lolu daba selusezithebeni zenkantolo siyajabula ngoba nosuku seluseduzane lokuthi lulalelwe. Sizolinda yona inqume. Asiphawuli ngezinto ezingaphambi kwezinkantolo ngoba siyawuhlonipha umthetho,” kusho uHlophe.Icala lizolalelwa ngoSepthemba 3.UKhuzwayo usole uSotswebhu waleli qembu ePhalamende, uMnuz Sihle Ngubane, indodakazi yomholi we-MK uMnuz Jacob Zuma, uDuduzile Zuma-Sambudla, umkhulumeli weqembu uMnuz Nhlamulo Ndhlela nabanye ngokuxova iqembu."Sizolwa kuze kube sekugcineni. Asiyanga kwi-MK ngenxa yezikhundla kodwa silwa ngoba nabanye kuyobenza okusenzile. Uma singalwi kuyophela nge-MK. Siyalithanda iqembu, salijoyina ngenxa kaZuma owayehlushwa yi-ANC. Ngeke sililaxaze manje, okunalokho sifuna kukhishwe abaxovayo.”Ufunge wagomela ukuthi bazobuyela ePhalamende ngoba bebengafudumezeli muntu izihlalo zabo. Ukwamukele ukufika kukaMnuz Floyd Shivambu, obeyiphini likamengameli le-EFF, kuleli qembu. UKhuzwayo ukhale ngokuthi abazi noma baqhubeke basebenze noma bahlale emakhaya njengoba behoxisiwe.Ubuye wagxeka uNkk Zuma-Sambudla ngokubasola ukuthi baxhasiwe njengoba beye enkantolo."Asisebenzisani noKhumalo (Jabulani, owaxoshwa owabhalisa iqembu). Asikaze simeseke uKhumalo, saseka uZuma. Sisizwa abameli ngaleli cala ngoba bebona ukuthi kudlalwa ngathi. Siholelwe imali yezinsuku ezinhlanu ekubeni sasebenza inyanga yonke,” kusho uKhuzwayo.Uthe bayazi ngeke kube mnandi kodwa bona abayi ndawo kwi-MK.
KUBATSHAZWA ubulwane kowesilisa nendodana baseMwolokohlo, eNdwedwe, kulandela ukutholakala kwesidumbu sesihlobo sesonakele ethoyilethi lomgodi emzini wabo.Umufi, uMnuz Nkosinathi Vilakazi (25) obedukile, wagcinwa umndeni wakhe ngoJulayi 21, eya esitolo.Kutholwa isidumbu sikamufi emva kwenyanga aduka nje, kuvela ukuthi ukhona umoya obuvunguza wokuthi umuntu owagcina ukubonwa elandela umufi, yindodana yakulo muzi atholwe kuwo.UMPHAKATHI waseMwolokohlo, eNdwedwe, umi izixongololo eduze nendawo yesigameko lapho obekumbiwa khona isidumbu sowesilisa owabulawa waphoswa ethoyilethi Isithombe: SIBONELO NGCOBO/INDEPENDENT MEDIAKuvela ukuthi amalungu omphakathi adlulisela lolu lwazi emaphoyiseni emva komhlangano womphakathi.Kulo mhlangano okuthiwa kwakukhona amalungu omphakathi, ubuholi bendawo namaphoyisa, kwakudingidwa izigameko zokubulawa kwabantu endaweni okuthiwa zidlangile.Owomndeni, uMnuz Mzikayifani Vilakazi, uthe kubahlukumeze kakhulu emoyeni okwenziwe ngabasolwa njengoba bebebathatha njengezihlobo."Kulo muzi sikhulele khona, kwagana umalumekazi wethu. Ayikho into esiphathe kabuhlungu njengokuthola ukuthi ingane yethu ibulawe khona,” kusho uVilakazi.Nokho ubonge ukusebenzisana phakathi kwamalungu omphakathi, amaphoyisa nobuholi bendawo ekutheni kugcine kutholwe ithambo likamufi.Uthe bazoshiya konke ezandleni zamaphoyisa ukuthi enze umsebenzi wawo.AMAPHOYISA endaweni yesigameko njengoba bekuyokhishwa isidumbu ethoyilethi lesihlobo Isithombe: SIBONELO NGCOBO/ INDEPENDENT MEDIAEndaweni yesigameko izinhlaka zamaphoyisa ziqale zasusa amatshe kasimende njengoba kuvele ukuthi abasolwa basiphosa emgodini wethoyilethi elidala elingasasebenzi isidumbu.Kuthiwa baphinde badiliza udonga lwalo, bezama ukuthi kunganakeki.IZINHLAKA zamaphoyisa endaweni yesigameko njengoba bekuyokhishwa isidumbu ethoyilethi lesihlobo Isithombe: SIBONELO NGCOBO/ INDEPENDENT MEDIANokho kuthangi, ngesikhathi umndeni uya khona, emva kokuthi oyedwa wabasolwa eculile, ufice kubhuza izimpukane, kunephunga elingabekezeleleki.Kuvele nokuthi abantu ebebedlula njengoba indawo yesigameko iseduze nomgwaqo oya emtholampilo wendawo, bebebona abasolwa bediliza ithoyilethi, bebeka amatshe kasemende, benganaki bezitshela ukuthi bazilungisela umuzi wabo.Ngesikhathi imoto yamaphoyisa isihamba nabasolwa emva kokukhomba indawo yesigameko, umphakathi ushiye ongalazi, udinwa abakwenzile.Ikhansela lendawo, uMnuz Mdu Cele, lithe isigameko siwethuse kakhulu umphakathi, wathi senzeka nje, vele abantu banovalo lokuhamba nasemgwaqweni ngenxa yokukwanda kwezigameko zokubulawa nokugetshengwa kwabantu."Njengoba sebeboshiwe, sikhuthaza amalungu omphakathi ukuthi angathuli nokuwehlele kodwa akhulume,” kusho uCele.Okhulumela amaphoyisa eKZN uColonel Robert Netshuinda uqinisekisile ukuthi kuboshwe ubaba oneminyaka engu-48 nendodana eneminyaka engu-25 emuva kokumbiwa kwesidumbu emgodini wethoyilethi kule ndawo. Uthe abasolwa bazovela enkantolo yeMantshi eNdwedwe ngoMsombuluko. Uthe umsolwa oneminyaka engu-25 uqale waboshelwa icala lesibhamu esingekho emthethweni. Kuthe uma kwenziwa uphenyo kwatholakala ukuthi ungumuntu wokugcina ukubona umufi obembiwa. Laba basolwa uveze ukuthi bathinteka kwamanye amacala amabili okubulala, elenzeke ngoMeyi nonyaka lapho unogada wabulawa kwatholwa isidumbu sakhe silahlwe emgwaqweni siboshwe ngentambo. Esinye isigameko esangoJanuwari 2021, lapho kwabulawa khona indoda eyatholwa igwaziwe isidumbu sayo salahlwa emgwaqweni ebangani elingelide ukusuka emzini wabasolwa. UNetshuinda uthe kusaqhubeka uphenyo ngokuthinteka kwabasolwa esigamekweni sokubulawa kwabasolwa ecaleni lokubulawa kowesifazane okhulelwe eMlaza.
UMNYANGO wezemfundo KwaZulu-Natal, usuluqale ngokusemthethweni uhlelo lokukhangiswa kwezikhala zothisha eziku- Post Leve One (PL1), oluvumela bonke abanezicucu ezifanele bafake izicelo ngokuvulelekile.Lolu hlelo belulindwe ngamehlo abomvu ngothisha abangaqashiwe nabaqashwe ngokwetoho, emva kokuthi lwamenyezelwa nguMphathiswa walo mnyango esifundazweni uMnuz Sipho Hlomuko ethatha izintambo, kulandela izikhalo zenkohlakalo nokuqasha ngikwenzelela okukholakala ukuthi bekwenziwa yiziphathimandla ezikoleni nasemahhovisi omnyango emazingeni aphansi ngesikhathi kuqhubeka uhlelo lwaphambilini obeluphoqa umuntu ukuthi ashiye imininingwane yakhe kwi-database yomnyango, athembele ekutheni igama lakhe lizotonyulwa uma kuvela isikhala. Ngalolu hlelo, abafaka izicelo sebezokwazi ukubona izikhala ezikhona zomsebenzi, njengoba zikhangiswa isidana zifakwe kwi- website yomnyango ethi, www.kzneducation.gov.za. UHlomuka ugqugquzele bonke abafuna ukufaka izicelo zomsebenzi ukuthi bengaliyeki leli thuba. Izikhala zomsebenzi zikleliswe ezikoleni ezikomasipala abehlukene esifundazweni.
INKANTOLO eNkulu yaseThekwini ikubekele uNovemba ukulalelwa kwecala elithweswe umengameli wezimantshi KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Eric Nzimande.UNzimande, osekuphele iminyaka emihlanu amiswa esikhundleni sakhe, usanda kuvela kule nkantolo.UMENGAMELI wezimantshi KwaZulu-Natal, omisiwe, uMnuz Eric Nzimande Isithombe: SIGCINIWE Icala lihlehlisiwe ukuze kulalelwe izindlalelo zokuqala kokuqulwa kwecala. UNzimande ubhekene namacala amahlanu okuphula umthetho iPrevention and Combating of Corrupt Activities (PRECCA) Act.Usolwa wuphiko lwezokushushisa iNational Prosecuting Authority(NPA) ukuthi wamukela imali 'eyintshontsho’ engu-R230 000.Kwenzeka lokhu nje uNzimande uvele ugqigqa esigcawini esimqondisa ubugwegwe esiqale ngoJanuwari nonyaka.Isigcawu sisenkantolo edingida amacala athinta imindeni, ePhoyinti eThekwini.Sisahlabe ikhefu kanti kulindeleke ukuthi siqhubeke nomsebenzi waso wokubiza ofakazi esontweni lokuqala ku-Okthoba nonyaka.Ummeli kaNzimande, uMnuz Ravindra Maniklal, uthe inkantolo ilinde kuqale kuphothulwe isigcawu bese iqhubeka nokulalela icala eliphambi kwayo.UNzimande uyawaphika wonke amacala awu-162 athweswe wona abandakanya inkohlakalo alalelwe yilesi sigcawu.Okunye umqashi asola ngakho uNzimande ukuthi wayegembula ngesikhathi somsebenzi, enukubeza ngokocansi futhi egwazisa.UNzimande usolwa ngokuthi wayekade egwazisa abantu ababezobamba izikhundla zokuba yizimantshi. Kusolakala ukuthi lokhu wakwenza phakathi kweminyaka u-Ephreli 2012 no-Okthoba 2015.Kuthiwa nguyena owayeluleka ungqongqoshe wezobulungiswa ngaleso sikhathi, ukuthi wobani okwakumele bavale izikhala zokuba izimantshi.Okunye uNzimande asolwa ngakho ukuthumela uzakwabo wesifazane isithombe esasiveza ubuntu bakhe. Owesifazane kuthiwa wagcina elubike kwiKhomishini yeziMantshi lolu daba okuyiyona eshushisa uNzimande esigcawini.
I-IFP imise ilungu lePhalamende elisolwa ngokuhlukumeza unkosikazi walo.UMnuz Sanele Zondo, ongusihlalo we-IFP Youth Brigade, umiswe kuzo zonke izikhundla aziphethe.Umiswe emva kokuthi unkosikazi wakhe, uNkk Simenyiwe MaDlomo Zondo, emsole ngokumhlukumeza.UNkk Zondo wenze le zinsolo ngesikhathi ekhuluma bukhoma enkundleni yezokuxhumana i-Instagram.UNkk Zondo wenze inkulumo emva kokuthi sekuphele izinsuku ezinhlanu kubikwe ukuthi unyamalele.Ekhuluma ngoLwesithathu, uNkk Zondo usole umyeni wakhe ngokumshaya, nangokungamnaki.Okhulumela i-IFP, uMnuz Mkhuleko Hlengwa, uthe banqume ukunikeza uZondo ikhefu elikhethekile ngenxa yobucayi bezinsolo ezenziwe uNkk Zondo."Lokhu kuzomnika ithuba lokuthi ayolungisa izinkinga zasekhaya.”UHlengwa uthe bazibonile izinsolo ezenziwe uNkk Zondo, wathi bafuna ukuthi ziphenywe izinhlaka zomthetho."I-IFP ihlezi izibophezela ekuthuthukisweni kwabesifazane. Lokhu kubonakala emithethweni nasezithembisweni zokhetho esizenzayo. Sihlezi sizibophezele emkhankasweni wokulwa nokuhlukumeza ngokobulili. Lolu daba siyalusukumela, sithanda ukuqinisekisa umphakathi ukuthi sizobhekana nalo ngokushesha, futhi sizoluphatha ngobunono.”UHlengwa uthe zonke izindaba ezithinta i-IFP Youth Brigade zizosingathwa ihhovisi likanobhala jikelele walolu phiko, uMnuz Mlungisi Mabaso, kuze kuphele ikhefu elinikezwe uZondo."Uma kukhona okusha ngalolu daba sizophinde senze esinye isimemezelo.”UHlengwa uthe bajabule ngokuthi uNkk Zondo utholakale ephila.UNkk Zondo wayekade egcine ukubonakala ngesonto eledlule njengoba eqhamuke esevumbuka ezinkundleni zokuxhumana.Ukhale ngokuthi uZondo wamthembisa ukumakhela umuzi emuva kokushada kodwa wagcina ehlala endlini karawondi kubo ayifanise nehhoko. Ukhale ngokuthi emuva kokubuya kwenkosikazi kaZondo endala, uZondo ubesehlala elala endlini yayo futhi engakudli ukudla amphakela kona. Ubuye waveza nezinsolo zokushaywa nguZondo athe wagijima kuqala waya esiteshini samaphoyisa eyovula icala kodwa bagcina bengawavulanga ngoba kwavunyelwana ngokuthi bayokhuluma njengomndeni. UZondo uyaziphika izinsolo abekwa zona njengoba ethi uyena ohlukunyezwa unkosikazi.UZondo uthe ngelinye ilanga umkakhe wake wamshaya waze wopha, waze waveza nesithombe lapho ayephuma khona igazi ngasehlweni.Uthe wazama ukuyovula icala emaphoyiseni kodwa wagcina engalivulanga emva kokungenela kwemindeni.UZondo ugcagcelwe ngoMashi kulo nyaka.UNkk Zondo ukholwa ukuthi umyeni wakhe umhlukumeza ngoba nakhu efuna ukuthatha unkosikazi wesithathu.Kepha uZondo uthe izinkinga zabo zaqala emva kokuthi eveze ukuthi ufuna ukulanda ingane yakhe ayithola ngaphandle komshado.Uthe unkosikazi wakhe waqala ukumshintshela emva kwalokho.
