KUPHOQELEKE ukuthi lihlehliselwe inyanga ezayo icala lobekade eyiphoyisa oboshelwe icala lokushaya abulale unina KwaDabeka, eClermont, imantshi ingabonwa nangalukhalo enkantolo.Imantshi u-Bilkish Asmal ayifikanga eNkantolo yesiFunda, ecaleni elithweswe uMnuz Lungisani Xaba (48).Ngesonto eledlule, imantshi yalihlehlisela usuku lwayizolo icala ukuze kwenziwe izindlalelo zokuqala kokuqulwa kwalo emuva kweminyaka emibili lisenkantolo linganyakazi.Kube sekubekelwa uSepthemba 11 nonyaka, ukwenziwa kwalolu hlelo. Kwenzeka lokhu emasontweni edlule, imantshi ibisanda kukhala ngokubambezeleka kwecala ithi kuqhamuka ohlangothini lukaXaba.Yathi kusukela ngoNovemba 11, 2022, lifika enkantolo yalo, akunamnyakazo ngakho kumele kube khona okwenzakalayo.Izolo, abomndeni kaXaba baphume edangele enkantolo kwazise baze bathola ngephoyisa elisebenza enkantolo ukuthi selihlehlisiwe icala.Lokhu kubangelwe ukuthi wona abekade ehlezi ngaphandle kwenkantolo okuvamise ukulalelwa khona leli cala elishintshelwe kwenye izolo.Yize kunjalo bathe bazolokhu begqigqa enkantolo ngoba ekugcineni bafuna ukwazi iqiniso lokuthi uXaba 'wambulalelani unina’, uNkk Greta Xaba (81).Kusolakala ukuthi ummangalelwa washaya unina, owayehamba ngesihlalo esinamasondo ngenxa yokukhubazeka, ngepulangwe elalinezipikili ngoLwesihlanu ngoMeyi 6, 2022.Waboshwa ngakusasa wabekwa icala lokushaya ngenhloso yokulimaza elashintshwa laba ngelokubulala umufi eshona esibhedlela ngoMeyi 8, 2022.UXaba usenqatshelwe ibheyili amahlandla amabili futhi useshintshe abameli izikhawu eziningi.Kamuva usanda kubhokela izintatheli wazikhomba, ebuza kummeli wakhe ukuthi zivumelekile yini ukuba senkantolo zibike ngecala athweswe lona?
UMHOLI weMK uMnuz Jacob Zuma usehlise amaphaphu kulabo abajahe ukuthi leli qembu lihlalise izingqungquthela njengoba ethi abajahile ukuzibiza. UZuma uthe esinye sezizathu zokuthi bangazihlalisi izingqungquthela yingoba abantu bakhipha imali bathenge amalungu."Abantu bathenga amalungu ukuthi abavotele. Sithe lokhu asifuni ukuthi kwenzeke kwiMK. Sifuna ukwakha uzinzo eqenjini lihlonishwe uwonke wonke ngaphambi kokubiza izingqungquthela. Sifuna iqembu limele abantu, yingakho singajahile ukuhlalisa izingqungquthela,” kusho uZuma.Ukusho lokhu izolo esithangamini nabezindaba eSandton lapho bekuthulwa khona ubuholi obuphezulu baleli qembu.UZuma uphefumule kanje kulandela ikhwelo elihlatshwe yizinhlaka ezehlukene ngaphakathi eqenjini ezifuna kuhlaliswe izingqungquthela.Lezi zinhlaka zikhala ngokuthi ukungabikhona kwezinhlaka ezikhethwe engqungqutheleni kwenza lungabikhona uzinzo njengoba neqembu lipheka lithulule abaholi abahlukene okubalwa obengunobhala jikelele uMnuz Arthur Zwane.UZuma ephendula umbuzo wokupheka kuthululwe abaholi, uveze ukuthi yingoba ababafuni abantu abenza izinto ezingalungile eqenjini."Ngithi angiwuphendule lo mbuzo wabantu ababuza ngokuphekwa kuthululwe abaholi. Ezinyangeni ezimbalwa kusungulwe iqembu sekube nonobhala jikelele abayisihlanu. Sasivele sishilo ukuthi akekho umuntu ozokwenza into engalungile bese simyeka. Sisazoqhubeka sibaxoshe abenza okungalungile. Ngiyazi bathi singamaqaba sixosha abantu,” kusho uZuma.UZuma uveze umbono wokuthi kumele ahlangane abe yimbumba amaqembu amancane ukuze kukhululwe abamnyama."Amaqembu abamnyama kumele ahlangane ukuze kukhululwe abantu abamnyama. IMK yisona sisombululo ezweni yingakho kumele sihlangane singamaqembu amnyama sisebenze ukufukula abantu bakithi,” kusho uZuma.Kulesi sithangami kumenyezelwe ubuholi obuphezulu obuholwa nguZuma njengomengameli, Dkt John Hlophe iphini likaZuma, Dkt Sifiso Maseko unobhala jikelele, iphini lakhe nguNksz Nombuso Mkhize, usihlalo kazwelonke uMnuz Nathi Nhleko, iphini lakhe nguMnuz Wilson Sibiloane, umgqugquzeli kazwelonke uMnuz Floyd Shivambu othezwe kwi-EFF lapho ebeyiphini likamengameli kuthi uMgcinimafa kube uMnuz Menzi Magubane. UMaseko uthe ihhovisi lakhe yilona elizobe limatasa wathi bafuna ukwehlisa umthwalo obhekene noZuma.Ukhale ngokuthi uZuma uhlangana nenqwaba yabantu kuze kuse emnyango.Uchithe eyokuthi kukhona abavinjwayo uma befuna ukubona uZuma eNkandla."Umengameli umatasa, ungafika emini uze umbone ebusuku, ngendlela amatasa ngayo. Akekho ovinjwayo ukuthi ambone. Umuntu oshaya amaphiko eqenjini ngumengameli,” kusho uMaseko.Uthe baxhumane nezinhlaka ezehlukene eqenjini mayelana nobuholi obuphezulu.Ukhale ngamaqembu amaningi amancane wathi kunesidingo sokuthi ahlangane, asebenzisane."Ngeke babekezelwe abantu abazodala uqhekeko eqenjini. Ubuholi obukhona kumele buhlonishwe. Zonke izinqumo zeqembu zizokhishwa yihhovisi likanobhala jikelele.”Uthe bayaqhubeka nokujuba abantu abanamava ePhalamende naseziShayamthetho zezifundazwe."Abantu esibajubayo banolwazi namava emikhakheni ehlukene okubalwa nakuhulumeni. Sifuna abantu abakhaliphile ePhalamende. Abahola iqembu ngeke bajutshelwe ePhalamende naseziShayamthetho.” Uveze ukuthi bazoqhubeka basebenzisane namanye amaqembu ePhalamende naseziShayamthetho.UMaseko uchithe eyokuthi leli qembu liyistokfela sikaZuma."Angiyena owakwaZuma, nabanye abaningi ababona abakwaZuma. Yinto engekho ukuthi iqembu elakwaZuma.”
KULINDELEKE ukuthi wehle umthwalo emahlombe abantu bakuleli njengoba amandla emali eseku 4.6% esuka ku-5.1% ngoJuni.Lezi zibalo zikhishwe yi-StatsSA izolo. Iveze ukuthi amandla emali antengiswa wukubiza kukagesi, uphethroli nokudla.Isazi somnotho esizimele, uSolwazi Bonke Dumisa, sithe ukudlondlobala kwamandla emali afike ku-4.6% kusho ukuthi iBhange loMbuso, i-South African Reserve Bank (Sarb), lizoyehlisa imalimboleko.Uthe isizathu salokhu wukuthi amandla emali asondele kwisilinganiso semali esifunwa yi-Sarb njengoba ifuna abe phakathi kuka-3% no-6%."Njengoba amandla emali eseku-4.6% azokwenza kube lula ukuthi iBhange loMbuso liqale ukwehlisa imalimboleko ngenyanga ezayo (Septhemba). Kungakuhle ukuthi imalimboleko yehle ngoba vele amandla emali antengiswa wukunyuka kukaphethroli, ugesi, izinsiza zikamasipala nokunye okungelona iphutha labantu,” kusho uDumisa.Ezibalweni ze-StatsSA kuvele ukuthi yehlile nentengo yokudla neziphuzo ezingenabo utshwala njengoba intengo yalezi zinto isuke ku-4.6% ngoJuni yaya ku-4.5% ngoJulayi.Isazi somnotho sase-FNB, uNksz Koketso Mano, sithe emhlabeni jikelele amandla emali asenozinzo olubonakalayo nakwintengo ka-oyela futhi neRandi alisehlelwa ngamandla.Naye uthe balindele ukuthi i-Sarb yehlise imalimboleko okuzokwehlisa imali ekhokhwa yilabo abakhokhela imizi, izimoto nenye imali abayibolekile.UMnuz Morne Malan we-Free Market Foundation (FMF), uthe kufanele uhulumeni alubhekisise udaba lokunyuka kukaphethroli, ugesi, ukudla okuba nomthelela omubi emandleni emali.Uthe yize bejabula ukuthi amandla emali akhombisa ukudlondlobala kodwa abazi ukuthi azoqhubeka yini ngale ndlela ngenxa yezinto ezenzeka ezimakethe zomhlaba.Ubalule ukuthi amandla emali awantengiswa yizinto ezenzeka eNingizimu Afrika kuphela kodwa ukunyuka kukawoyela ongahluziwe kuba nomthelela kuwona.
SITHOLWE sesonakele, silahlwe exhaphozini elisosebeni lwedamu i-Henley, eMgungundlovu, isidumbu somfundi wase-Snathing Junior Primary, obesekuphele amasonto kubikwe ngokunyamalala kwakhe.U-Asenathi Ngcobo (9), obefunda u-Grade 4 kulesi sikole, kuthiwa ugcine ukubonwa ngoJulayi 29, ephuma esikoleni njengoba isidumbu sakhe sitholwe silaxazwe kwenye i-ward eyibanga ukusuka lapho ebehlala khona, sisagqokiswe umfaniswano wesikole ngoMsombuluko ntambama.Ngokulandisa kwekhansela lasendaweni okutholwe kuso isidumbu salo mfundi, uMnuz Mlungisi Zondi, lithe sitholwe obezilusela izinkomo. Uhlabe umkhosi kwase kubikelwa amaphoyisa ngokushesha nokuyilapho kutholakale khona ukuthi ingane okungasiyona eyasendaweni kodwa ngeyakwenye i-ward okukholakala ukuthi izigilamkhuba zayibulala maqede isidumbu sayo zazosilahla ngasedamini.Kuthintwa unina kamgilwa uNksz Nondumiso Ngcobo, uthe ukuyigcina kwakhe indodakazi yakhe, babephuma edolobheni wayehlisa etekisini ababeligele ngenhloso yokuthi idlulele lapho ebihlala khona njengoba ubengahlali nayo, ihlala emzini othile eyacelelwa kuwo ukuze iqhubeke nesikole, okuvele ukuthi ayibange isafika.UNksz Ngcobo uthe okwamanje akukavumi aphawule ngalolu daba wacela ukuthi intatheli ibuye imthinte.Ikhansela lase-Snathing, uMnuz Sanele Zuma, ebelihambisana nothisha abebefundisa umgilwa ukuyobhonga emswaneni, lithe lesi sigameko siwethusile kakhulu umphakathi."Akusikhona okokuqala kuduka ingane itholwe isibulewe njengoba kuke kwenzeka eminyakeni emihlanu edlule. Umphakathi wethuke kakhulu ikakhulu njengoba kuthe kulo leli sonto, omunye umfundi obephuma esikoleni esinde ngokulambisa kwabebembhudubeza bemfaka emotweni ngenkani okukholakala ukuthi bebemntshontsha, kwasiza ukuqhamuka kukamakhelwane,” usho kanje.Uthe bathole ukuthi umndeni wakwaNgcobo unesikhashana uthuthile endaweni emva kokuthi kubekhona abawuhlaselile kwakhona amalungu alimalayo. Uthe kuphoqe ukuthi ingane icelelwe komunye umuzi wakamakhelwane ukuze isale iqedele ukufunda kulo nyaka, njengoba seyehlelwa yilo mshophi. Kunemidlinzo yokuthi kungenzeka abebehlasela umndeni banesandla ekubulaweni kukamgilwa.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa asePlessislaer avule idokodo lophenyo ngokufa komuntu, kanti okwamanje imbangela yalesi sigameko ayikaziwa.
ZIYIFANISA nesigodi sethunzi lokufa indawo eyisiganga ebhulohweni eliphakathi kwaseMachobeni naseMolweni izakhamuzi kulandela ukuthowa kwezidumbu zabesilisa ababili abangaziwa ngoLwesithathu.Izidumbu zabafi, ebeziboshwe izandla ngemuva, kuthiwa zibonwe ngumuntu obezidlulela, wahlaba umkhosi emaphoyiseni nasemphakathini.Umthombo weSolezwe, ocele ukungadalulwa, uthe kubukeka sengathi babulawelwe endaweni yesigameko ngokudutshulwa njengoba igazi beligobhoza lapho ziwele khona izidumbu."Mhlawumbe yisigameko seshumi manje lesi, kutholwa abantu ababulewe esikhathini esingangonyaka,” kubabaza umthombo.Uthe ngeledlule kutholwe isidumbu sowesilisa obephoswe phansi ebhulohweni."Ukutakulwa kwakhe kwakunzima ngenxa yokuphoswa phansi ebhulohweni. Ayikho inhlobo yephoyisa engafikanga kuzanywa ukuthi atakulwe,” kusho umthombo.Ngaphambi kwalokho kwatholwa umuntu eshisiwe."Uhulumeni ake asilekelele ngendaba yobugebengu babantu ababulawayo kule ndawo,” kusho umthombo.Induna yendawo, uMnuz Zaba Muthwa, ikuqinisekisile ukuthi le ndawo ihlaselwe yizehlo ezihlasimulisa umzimba ngenxa yokuthi iyisigange futhi akuvamisile ukuthi abantu behle benyuke kuyo.Uvumile ukuthi sekuyinto ejwayelekile ukuthi kutholwe izidumbu zabantu ababulewe ngesihluku."Sikholelwa ekutheni bababulalela kwezinye izindawo bese bezobalahla lapha endaweni yethu ngoba kuye kuthi uma kulandelelwa kuvele ukuthi abantu basezindaweni eziqhele kakhulu nathi,” kusho uMuthwa.Uthe le nkinga ibakhathaza kakhulu ngoba ingcolisa indawo yabo futhi itshala ukwesaba ebantwini.Uveze ukuthi ngenxa yokwanda kwalezi zigameko baze basungula iforamu eqapha ubugebengu endaweni nyakenye, wathi ukhathazeke ngokuthi yize kunjalo izigameko azinciphi."Sesifisa nokuthi kulethwe isiteshi samaphoyisa esingumahamba nendlwana kwenzele ukuthi zizothuka izigebengu,” kusho uMuthwa.NgoFebhuwari nonyaka Isolezwe libike ngowesifazane, uPatricia Jeza (48), nendodakazi yakhe, uQueen Jeza (22), baseChesterville abatholwa belahliwe endaweni efanayo.Emva kokuhlonzwa ukuthi bangobani, kwaboshwa inyanga, uMnuz Abraham Mhlaba, owayengumfundisi webandla lamaJericho eNanda ngokubulawa kwabo.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa aseNanda aphenya amacala amabili okubulala kulandela isigameko sokudutshulwa kubulawe abesilisa ababili eMachobeni izolo. "Abagilwa batholwe benenqwaba yamanxeba okudutshulwa," kusho uNetshiunda.
UBALISA ngeminjunju ayizwayo owesifazane waseMadundube, eMbumbulu ngokubulawa komyeni wakhe obeyiphoyisa eselathatha umhlalaphansi.UNkk Zilungile Makhanya ubalisa ngokudutshulwa kukaMnuz Joachim Makhekhe Makhanya (65) okuthiwa uhlaselwe esemzini wakhe eMbumbulu.UNkk Makhanya uthe umufi ubeqeda kugeza ngesikhathi kuthushuka indoda engazange ibuze lutho yamane yamdubula wawela khona lapho.Uthe indlela ebimdubula ngayo bekubonakala ukuthi yenza isiqiniseko sokuthi akasindi. "Ngikutshela ukuthi le ndoda imdubule wawa phansi. Isidumbu sakhe sagingqika saze sayofika ekugcineni kwegceke. Ushonele khona lapho,’’ kuchaza yena.Uthe indawo yokugezela ingaphandle komuzi. Uthe bebekade begeza bobabili ngesikhathi edutshulwa.Noma iyinye indoda ebonakale idubula amahlandla amaningi ibhekise kumufi, kodwa uthe kukhona abanye besilisa ababili ebebekhona."Owomndeni uthe uwabonile amanye amadoda amabili egcekeni abekade ehambisana nalo odubulile,’’ usho kanje.Uthe okumhlukumezile ukuthi lesi sehlakalo senzeke phambi kwakhe."Ingihlukumezile kakhulu le nto indlela eyenzeke ngayo,’’ usho kanje kuzwakala ukuthi ukhathazekile emoyeni.Uthe iminjunju yokubulawa komyeni wakhe phambi kwakhe isekude ukuphela.Kuthiwa umufi uzamile ukubaleka kodwa wagcina ewa phansi. Kuvela ukuthi udubuleke esifubeni, esiswini nasengalweni yangakwesokudla, ethangeni kwesokudla, umlenze wangakwesobunxele kuthiwa uphukile futhi ubumbobombobo yizinhlamvu.Egcekeni kuthiwa kutholakale amagobolondo ezinhlamvu amahlanu.Ukhala ngokuthi kuduma ikhanda kuyena njengoba engazi ukuthi siyini isizathu sokubulawa komyeni wakhe."Akukho nje nokuncane esingathi siyakusola ngabe siqamba amanga aluhlaza,’’ usho kanje.Uchaze umufi njengowesilisa obengenazo izitha kodwa engumuntu obechitha isikhathi esiningi ngokuzivocavoca.Uveze ukuthi umufi wathatha umhlalaphansi emaphoyiseni ngo-2016.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa aseMbumbulu aphenya icala lokubulala kulandela isigameko sokubulawa kowesilisa.
INHLOKO yamajaji esibeka phansi imijiva yezobulungiswa, uRaymond Zondo, iveze imfihlo yamajaji nezimantshi uma kuziwa ezinqwumeni nasezigwebeni ezikhishwa yizinkantolo.Udalule ukuthi ezinye zezigwebo azikhiphayo - kwesinye isikhathi - asuke yena mathupha engahambisani nazo. Uthe kodwa baphoqwa nguMthethosisekelo okuyiwo obekwe phambili ukuthi bakhiphe lezi zinqumo nezigwebo. "Amajaji nezimantshi ngeke aphumele obala aveze ukuthi isigwebo noma isinqumo esithile asuke esikhiphile, awahambisani naso. Esikwenzayo sisuke sibuswa nguMthethosisekelo wezwe okumele siwulandele," kusho uZondo.INHLOKO yamajaji esithatha umhlalaphansi, uRaymond Zondo, inconywe ngeqhaza layo kulo mkhakha Isithombe: RSAJudiciaryUkusho lokhu izolo, ethula inkulumo yokuvalelisa eNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo, njengoba ethatha umhlalaphansi ekupheleni kwenyanga.UZondo onconywe nxa zonke ngamava akhe okusebenzela ezobulungiswa, wavuma ukuthi uzakhele inqwaba yezitha ngalesi sikhathi.Uthe amajaji nezimantshi akumele afune ukuduma noma anconywe ngabezindaba ngoba umsebenzi wawo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umthetho ubekwa phambili.Unxuse ozakwabo ukuthi babeke phambili uMthethosisekelo wezwe."Yinto eningangihlonipha ngayo njengoba sengibeka phansi izintambo ukubeka phambili umthetho wezwe. Ngifisa ukuthi singaphinde sibuye isihlava sokulawulwa kombuso yidlanzana,” kusho uZondo. Othatha izintambo kuZondo, iJaji uMandisa Maya, likhale ngokuthi kuzovuleka igebe ngokuhamba kukaZondo.Lithe baneminjunju ngokuhamba kukaZondo lathi basebenze kahle naye."Ngesikhathi sakho ufukule inqwaba yabantu besifazane kwezobulungiswa, bakhethelwa ezikhundleni eziphezulu. Wenze nezinhlelo zokweseka amajaji nabameli besifazane.”Uthe bezomkhumbula ngemisebenzi yakhe emihle njengoba eyibekile induku ebandla. USomlomo wePhalamende, uNkk Thoko Didiza, uthe bayaziqhenya ngomsebenzi omuhle owenziwe nguZondo.Uthe wenze umsebenzi omuhle muva nje ngesikhathi kuvulwa iPhalamende, kufungiswa amalungu amasha kanjalo nangesikhathi kukhethwa umengameli wezwe.UNkk Didiza uthe akusoka lingenasici njengoba kukhona ezinye zezinqumo zikaZondo ababeshaya amakhala ngazo. UZondo uthe bonke omengameli bezwe ngaphansi kwentando yeningi bamqokela ezikhundleni ezehlukene kubalwa noMnuz Jacob Zuma.
IGWETSHWE odilikajele abahlanu neminyaka engu-30 ngaphezulu yiNkantolo yesifunda yaseNquthu, inyanga mbumbulu ezishaya samphrofethi, elahlwe ngoxhaxha lwamacala okudlwengula.Kuthe ngoLwesithathu, inkantolo yagweba kanzima uMthokozisi Cyril Mdlalose (37) ngamacala amathathu okudlwengula abesifazane abasebancane abaneminyaka ephakathi kuka-15 no- 18, emva kokuthi ayebaholela ophathe, ezenza umphrofethi okhathalele ukubelapha.NgoFebhuwari 2022, uMdlalose kuthiwa waholele ophathe umgilwa oneminyaka ewu-15, emva kokuthi ekhohlise unina (kamgilwa) ngesibonakaliso esithile, okuthe uma umgilwa efika endlini yakhe wamyalela ukuthi akahlubule, ngaphambi kokuthi amdlwengule ephindelela. Ngo-Agasti ngawo unyaka ofanayo, uMdlalose kuthiwa wasebenzisa amaqhinga afanayo ukulutha unina kamgilwa oneminyaka ewu-18. Kuthiwa wathatha umgilwa wahamba naye waya emfuleni ngenhloso yokuyomhlambulula. Kufikwa emfuleni kuthiwa wamyalela ukuthi akangene emanzini ahlambe. Ngesikhathi umgilwa eqeda ukugeza, kuthiwa uMdlalose wayesevele elendlalile ithawula, wamyalela ukuthi ahlale kulo, wamgcoba umuthi wakhe ekhanda nasezindlebeni. Emva kwalokho kuthiwa umgilwa wahanjelwa umqondo wangabona lutho okwenzekayo, kwathi uma ephaphama wayesesele yedwa uMdlalose engasabonwa.Kuvele ukuthi le mikhuba uyiqale ngo-2020, okuyilapho edlwengule khona umgilwa ono-18 emva kokuthi emhlolelile wathi uyathakathwa kangangokuba izinsuku zakhe ephila emhlabeni ziyancipha. Wayalela umgilwa ukuthi afike emzini wakhe osendaweni okuthiwa kuseMadresini, khona ezokwazi ukumsusa isinyama ahamba naso. Esefikile umgilwa, kuthiwa wamyalela ukuthi akalale abheke phezulu, wamgcoba ngomuthi ngaphambi kokuthi amdlwengule. Kuthiwa wayalela umgilwa ukuthi angayixoxeli muntu indaba, kwathi emva kwezinsuku ezingu-11 waphinde wamdlwengula.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe emva kokuvulwa kwamacala, umphenyi wahlanganisa ubufakazi obuholele ekuboshweni kukaMdlalose.UKhomishana wamaPhoyisa esifundazweni uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi ukushayele ihlombe ukugwetshwa komdlwenguli."Lesi sigwebo sifke ngesikhathi esihle kuyinyanga yokuhlonipha iqhaza labesifazane. Izigwebo ezinjengalezi ziyawakhuthaza amaphoyisa ekutheni aphenye ngokungakhathali emacaleni afuze lawa, enolwazi lokuthi izinkantolo zizokwenza isiqiniseko sokususa izigilamkhuba emphakathini,” kusho uMkhwanazi.UMdlalose ngeke esavunyelwa ukuphatha isibhamu, igama lakhe lizokleliswa ohlwini lwabantu abalahlwe ngamacala ocansi, abayingozi.
KUZOQOPHEKA umlando eMkhosini woMhlanga wakulo nyaka ozokuba ngenyanga ezayo.Kulo nyaka kuzobe kuhlangana iminyaka engu-40 kwavuselelwa kabusha lo mkhosi ohanjelwa izintombi eziqhamuka ezindaweni ezehlukene okubalwa nezingaphandle kwesifundazwe iKwaZulu-Natal.UMkhosi woMhlanga wavuselelwa kabusha ngo-1984, uvuselelwa iNdlovukazi uShiyiwe Manftombi Dlamini Zulu, ozala iSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi emkhosini wakulo nyaka kuzogqanyiswa kakhulu ibanga eselihanjwe yilo mkhosi.Umthombo osondelene namalungiselelo omkhosi, uthe kuyinto enkulu ukuthi umkhosi uzohlanganisa iminyaka ewu-40 wavuselelwa."UMkhosi woMhlanga ungeminye yemikhosi egqamile lapha KwaZulu. Isasasa lilokhu likhule njalo, kwahlula nangesikhathi umkhosi uphazanyiswa iCorona. Nombango wesihlalo sobukhosi awuzange uwuphazamise umkhosi. Ingakho ke kuzogqanyiswa ukufinyelela komkhosi kule ngqophamlando."UMkhosi woMhlanga ubambe elikhulu iqhaza ekwakheni intsha. Ukhuthaza izintombi ukuba zizithibe, zingajahi izinto ezingalungile. Ingakho kwathathwa isinqumo sokuthi uvuselelwe kabusha ngoba kwakubonakala ukuthi intsha ibhekene nezinkinga eziningi.”Umthombo uthe ngeke bakukhohlwe okwenziwa iNdlovukazi uShiyiwe ivuselela umkhosi ngesikhathi kubusa iSilo uGoodwill Zwelithini kaBhekuzulu."Ngiyacabanga ukuthi akuzange kube lula ukuvuselela umkhosi okwasekuphele isikhathi eside ungasenziwa. Ngibona ukuthi into eyalekelela indlovukazi ukuthi vele nakwaNgwane (eSwatini, lapho izalwa khona) uyenziwa uMkhosi woMhlanga.”Njengenhlalayenza, uMkhosi woMhlanga uzoqala esigodlweni eMachobeni, eNgwavuma, ngoSepthemba 7.NgoSepthemba 14 kuyobe sekulandela umkhosi omkhulu ozokuba sesigodlweni eNyokeni, kwaNongoma.Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kokhulumela iSilo, uMntwana uSimphiwe Zulu, ayizange iphumelele njengoba ucingo lwakhe belukhala lungabanjwa.Amalungiselelo omkhosi aseqalile, izinhlaka ezehlukene seziqalile ukukhangisa umcimbi ezinkundleni zokuxhumana.Omasipala abaningi sebeqalile ukwenza imicimbi yokuthi ndlelanhle ezintombini ezizoya emhlangeni.
INHLANZI ishelwe amanzi kuboshwa abasolwa ngokuhlalisa lubhojozi umphakathi waKwaMashu bese bebhaca ehostela lakuleya ndawo.Amaphoyisa abophe abasolwa abathathu ngoMsombuluko, abavele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseNtuzuma ngoLwesithathu icala lahlehliswa.OMnuz Dumisani Mlambo (26), Sifundo Hlophe (24) noMnuz Mlondolozi Malinga (43) babhekene necala lokuzama ukubulala, ukuduna imoto nawokutholakala nezibhamu nezinhlamvu okungekho emthethweni.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi laba baboshwe yithimba lamaphoyisa laKwaMashu elibikelwe ngobugebengu obebukade benzeka emgwaqweni uDumisani Makhaye.Kuvela ukuthi abasolwa babone amaphoyisa behla emotweni abebehamba ngayo badla phansi.I-VW Polo emhlophe eshaqwe amaphoyisa okusolakala ukuthi beyiduniwe yatholwa eSiyanda, KwaMashu Isithombe: SithunyelweAmaphoyisa kuthiwa ahubhe ngezinyawo abasolwa, omunye wabo wadubula ebhekise kuwona kodwa wabanjwa.Kubikwa ukuthi utholwe nesibhamu i-9mm ecishwe izinombolo nezinhlamvu. La maphoyisa kubikwa ukuthi aqhubekile nokuthungatha abasolwa, omunye waboshwa ngasemgwaqweni eSiyanda nesibhamu esingekho emthethweni.Kuthiwa uphenyo lwamaphoyisa luwaholele emzini oseSiyanda lapho kuboshwe khona umsolwa wesithathu otholakale nemoto iVW Polo emhlophe obekukade kubikwe ukuthi idunwe eNtuzuma ngawo uMsombuluko.Kulindeleke ukuthi uMlambo abuyele enkantolo ngo-Agasti 29, uMalinga benoHlophe bavele ngosuku olulandelayo.Kwenzeka lokhu nje abanye ababili abasolwa ngokugcweleza kule ndawo basanda kudutshulwa babulawa. Owokuqala ushone emuva kwesigameko sokudunwa kweloli lezinkukhu elafakwa ehostela kwaphenduka idili likamkhipheni.Owesibili udutshulwe washona esigcemeni kwa-H ngesonto eledlule. Umphakathi wasehostela KwaMashu ubukade usuhlalele ovalweni ngenxa yaleli qembu eligcwelezayo.Abantu baphinde banengwa yivideo ebikhombisa laba bantu beqhumisa izibhamu emini kabha ehostela.
KUMISWE ukufungiswa kwamalungu amasha eqembu Umkhonto weSizwe ePhalamende kuze kuxazululwe eyecala elifakwe abebengamalungu aleli qembu, abahoxiswa ezikhundleni zabo.Amalungu ayishumi kwangu-18 ahoxiswa yiMK ePhalamende, aye enkantolo enkulu yaseWestern Cape, efuna kumiswe ukufungiswa kwala malungu kuphinde kuchithwe ukuhoxiswa kobulungu bawo. Inkantolo ilihlehlisele inyanga ezayo icala ukuze inike ithuba izinhlaka ezehlukene okubalwa uSomlomo wePhalamende neMK ithuba lokufaka amaphepha kule nkantolo.Okhulumela iPhalamende uMnuz Moloto Mothapo, uthe akukho lungu leMK elizofungiswa kuze kuxazululwe lolu daba enkantolo.Ekhuluma nabezindaba ngaphandle kwenkantolo izolo ummeli wala malungu, weWendy Cele and Associates, uthe icala lihlehlele uSepthemba 3, 2024.Uthe bafake isicelo esiphuthumayo sokuthi akungafungiswa amalungu amasha ezikhundleni zamalungu ahoxiswa yiqembu."Amalungu akhala ngokuthi awazazi izizathu zokuhoxiswa kobulungu eqenjini okwenze ahoxiswa njengamalungu ePhalamende. Afuna kungafungiswa amalungu amasha ezikhundleni zawo. Amalungu angakhishwa ezindaweni ahlala kuzona ePhalamende,” kusho ummeli.Uveze ukuthi amanye alawa malungu ashiya emisebenzini ayeyenza ayomela leli qembu ePhalamende.Kwenzeka lokhu nje ibhekwe ngabomvu inkulumo yomholi waleli qembu, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, obize isithangami lapho ezokhuluma khona nesizwe eGoli namhlanje.Angu-18 amalungu iMK eyahoxisa ubulungu bawo ikhala ngokuthi abanye babo bangena ngomkhoshosho ohlwini lwabantu ababezojutshwa yileli qembu.Okhulumela iqembu uMnuz Nhlamulo Ndhlela, uxwayise abaye enkantolo wathi sebezixoshile.Ekhuluma neDaily News enguzakwabo weSolezwe, uthe amalungu angayilandeli imigomo yeqembu azokhonjwa indlela.Uthe abaye enkantolo baya bazi ukuthi basemseni weqembu."Angiqondi kungani besiyisa enkantolo ngoba baya bazi ukuthi bazosuswa ezikhundleni zabo. Abaya ezinkantolo kumele bazi ukuthi sizobhekana nabo kanzima. Sebefana nabantu abazixoshe bona ngokuya enkantolo,” kusho uNdhlela. Amalungu okulindeleke ukuthi afungiswe kubalwa obeyiphini likamengameli kwi-EFF uMnuz Floyd Shivambu, umculi uPenny Penny, kanjalo nabanye okubalwa uMnuz Brian Molefe, Lucky Montana nabanye.
UBHOBOKE ngokuhlukumezeka nokuncishwa ucansi kwakhe emendweni unkosikazi welungu lePhalamende obekuthiwa udukile.UNkk Simenyiwe MaDlomo Zondo, ogane ilungu le-IFP, uMnuz Sanele Zondo, ugeqe amagula kwi-Instagram ngezinkinga abhekene nazo emshadweni wakhe athi ubesenezinyanga ezine kuphela ekuwo. UNkk Zondo wenze izinsolo zokuthi umyeni wakhe uyamshaya, akamnaki, nokuthi ufuna ukuthatha unkosikazi wesithathu okuthiwa uzomlobola ngenyanga ezayo njengoba sekuphume nosuku lomcimbi.UNkk Zondo wenza le nkulumo nje, izolo bese kuphele izinsuku ezinhlanu kubikwe ukuthi udukile. UZondo nabakwaDlomo bathi bagcina ukuxhumana naye ngoLwesihlanu.Izolo, uNkk Zondo uveze ukuthi izinto ziqale ukuba muncu kubuya unkosikazi omdala owayesehambile.Uthe ngesikhathi egana umyeni wakhe wamtshembisa izulu nomhlaba kodwa esefika emzini izinto zashintsha.Uthi ubemhlukumeza, wathi wake wamshaya waze wabulala ngisho iselula yakhe."Umbhede ebengilala kuwo ubufile phakathi nendawo, mina ngigana wayethe ekhaya uzongakhela indlu kodwa ngafika ngangena endlini karondo engiyifanisa nehhoko lezinkukhu. Ucingo bengingenalo, ngathi ngimcela ukuthi angithengele wathi uzokwenza lokho. Kukhona isikhathi la abengasanginiki khona ngisho imali yokuthenga ukudla. Lo muntu wangiyekisa ukudayisa kanjalo nokufuna umsebenzi,” kubeka uNkk Zondo.Uthe esigamekweni angeke asikhohlwe ila aya khona ngenkani endlini uZondo alala khona yedwa ngoba sekukudala alugcina ucansi."Ngashada naye mina ngiyintombi nto. Ngafike ngangena engubeni wangangenza lutho kodwa ngaba nethemba lokuthi ekuseni kukhona okuzokwenzeka. Kwathi ngezithuba zehora lisihlanu kwakhala ucingo lwakhe nokwathi eqeda kuluphendula wathi angiphume endlini yakhe. Ngazama ukuziba nokuyilapho angishaya khona waze wangikhipha ngomnyango. Ngamtshela ukuthi ngiya emaphoyiseni, uZondo wagijima kuqala waya emaphoyiseni, wawatshela ukuthi ngimshayile,” kuchaza yena.UNkk Zondo uthe icala lagcina lingavulwanga njengoba udaba baluxoxa lwaphela. Muva nje, uthi uNkk Zondo uthe uhamba ezwa ngabantu ukuthi umyeni wakhe umhlukumeza kanjena nje ingoba efuna ukuthatha unkosikazi wesithathu."Nginezinyanga ezine ngishadile. Ngicela ukubuza ukuthi wake welanywa yini umuntu onezinyanga ezine eshadile?”Ngale kokuba yilungu lePhalamende, uZondo uphinde abe usihlalo wophiko lwentsha kwi-IFP, i-IFP Youth Brigade.UNkk Zondo uthe umyeni wakhe akafanelwe ukuphatha isikhundla esingaka."Uma mina ngizokuba nendoda ewumholi eyazi ukuthi umfazi uyashaywa, nithi akathini entsheni? Ayihole athini? Intsha le esikhuluma ngayo, ikusasa lesizwe? Abantu abasha ibona abazokuba abaholi bakusasa. Uma nithi abantu abasha abaholwe umuntu owazi ukuthi umfazi uyahlukunyezwa, uyashawa, akondliwa, nithi akathini entsheni?”UNkk Zondo uveze ukuthi umyeni wakhe ubenqaba ukumondla, emnqabela ukuthi asebenze, nokuthi wehluleka ukufeza isethembiso sokumakhela umuzi.Ubaba kaNkk Zondo, uMnuz Nkosinathi Dlomo, unqabile ukuphawula ngalolu daba, wathi ufuna ukuthi kube nomhlangano wemindeni.UZondo yena uthe uzobiza isithangami nabezindaba, lapho athe khona uzophawula khona ngalolu daba.
USESIMENI esibucayi umshayeli wemoto ediliva impahla kulandela ukuhlaselwa izigebengu zifuna ukuduna iveni yenkampani.Lokhu kwenzeke kuN2 ngaseMandeni ngoLwesine ekuseni. Ngokombiko ovela endaweni yesehlo, iveni edilivayo kuthe iphuma kwi-toll gate yavinjwa yimoto encane inamadoda amane phakathi."Kuthiwa amadoda amane avulele ngenhlamvu ebhekise kumshayeli weveni, ngenhlanhla imoto yonogada eqapha iveni ibiseduze yaphendula ngenhlamvu ibhekise kubasolwa,” kusho uSamantha okhulumela abe-IPSS Medical Rescue and IPSS Security Services.Abasolwa baphunyuke babaleka bengaphethe lutho. Umshayeli weveni odubuleke kabi uthole usizo lokuqala endaweni yesehlo waphuthunyiswa esibhedlela ngendiza enophephela emhlane.
UKHATHAZEKILE ngokuphepha kwakhe owesifazane waKwaPata, eMgungundlovu, kulandela isigameko sokudlwengulwa okusolwa kuso iphoyisa ngaphakathi esiteshini samaphoyisa ngesikhathi eyofuna usizo.Ngokusho kukanina kamgilwa (25), isigameko senzeke esiteshini samaphoyisa i-Pietermaritzburg SAPS ngo-Agasti 15.Uthe umgilwa wayeyokwenza incwadi efungelwe, ayezoyisebenzisa ukufaka isicelo somsebenzi ndawana thize.Umsolwa ogcine eboshwa ngamaphoyisa ngo-Agasti 16, uvelile eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMgungundlovu, ngoMsombuluko, wadedelwa ngebheyili ka-R5 000.Unina kamgilwa uthe lokhu akwehlanga kahle kumgilwa njengoba ebevele enovalo kulandela isigameko."Emva kwesigameko, indodakazi yami ivela yama ukuya lapho eyenza khona i-internship yayo ngenxa yokwesaba. Ithi izizwa ingaphephile,” kusho unina kamgilwa.Uqhube wathi, okwenze isimo saba sibi kakhulu, ukukhishwa kukamsolwa ngebheyili."Kumsabise kakhulu ukudedelwa kwakhe ngebheyili, ubona ukuthi angamlandela nokumlandela, bese eyamenzakalisa,” kusho unina kamgilwa.Elandisa ngokwenzeka ngosuku lwesigameko, uthe umgilwa wayemi kulayini elinde ukusizwa ngesikhathi umsolwa emtomula kulayini, ethi akeze uzomsiza ehhovisi lakhe."Wathi uma esengaphakathi ehhovisi lakhe, wamenzisa incwadi efungelwe. Uthe esuka wakhipha isibhamu enqulwini, ethi siyamsinda,” kusho unina kamgilwa.Uqhube wathi, ngokuphazima kweso, umgilwa uthe esuka wayebona umsolwa ekhiya isicabha, waqala wamdlwengula, emsabisa ngesibhamu ayesesisusile enqulwini.Udalule ukuthi emva kwesigameko, ngenxa yovalo, umgilwa waphuma wahamba esiteshini engabikile ngosekumehlele.Uthe washayela omunye umngani wakhe emtshela ngosekumehlele, nowamluleka ngokuthi akangabe esapholisa maseko, akaye kwadokotela, ayohlolwa bese eyovula icala kwesinye isiteshi. Iphoyisa laboshwa ngakusasa.Okhulumela uphiko oluphenya ubugebengu obenziwa ngamaphoyisa, i-Independent Police Investigative Directorate (IPID), uMnuz Phaladi Shuping, usiqinisekisile isigameko.Uthe i-IPID iqale ukusebenza udaba emva kokudluliselwa idokoko ebelivulwe esiteshini samaphoyisa i-Mountain Rise."Umsolwa uvelile enkantolo ngoMsombuluko, ebhekene necala lokudlwengula, icala lahlehliselwa u-Okthoba 11 nonyaka, ukuze kuqhutshekwe nophenyo,” kusho uShuping.Ungoti kwezokululekwa ngokwengqondo, uDkt Manqoba Myeni, uthe abasolwa abenza okubi kwabanye njengakho ukudlwengula, bavame ukuthi baqale bamhlaziye masinyane umgilwa."Ngeso elisheshayo, basuke befuna ukubheka ukuthi uma benza isehlakalo mangakanani amathuba okuthi basenze ngempumelelo,” kusho uDkt Myeni.Uqhube wathi izigameko ezifuze lesi ziyenzeka ezindaweni ezehlukene, nakhona emaphoyiseni."Ezindaweni lapho okuhlangana khona abantu, bezofuna usizo, kukhona yonke inhlobo yomuntu okufaka phakathi nezigebengu. Umuntu angaba yiphoyisa kodwa aqhubeke enze izinto eziphambene nomthetho,” kusho yena.Uthe kuba nzima kumgilwa ukusheshe abone ukuthi umuntu ofuna ukumnika usizo, eceleni, unezinye izinhloso."Mhlawumbe kubagilwa kungafanele baqale bazibuze imibuzo ngesikhathi etonyulwa eningini ukuthi ayonikwa usizo ngokukhethekile, azibuze ukuthi kungani etomula mina ngedwa, abantu bebaningi kangaka,” kusho uDkt Myeni.
LIZOVELA enkantolo ngecala lokuzama ukubulala isoka 'elingqongqise’ intombi yalo okubonwa ngokusa kuyona esibhedlela.Kuvela ukuthi omakhelwane bacishe intombi (22) ebiivutha ubuhanguhangu isoka (34) selidle phansi.Isehlakalo senzeke ngesikabhadakazi ngoLwesibili eCarolina, eMpumalanga. Isoka lithungathwe amaphoyisa laboshwa emva kwamahora ambalwa lenze lokhu.Kubikwa ukuthi umgilwa usindiswe ukumemeza ehlaba umkhosi ecela usizo komakhelwane eshiswa.Amaphoyisa athe kuthe uma omakhelwane bephuthuma beyobheka ukuthi kwenzekani babona umsolwa ebhunyela umgilwa ngokuthile obekusesigubhini esingu-2 litre wase eyabaleka.Ibamba loMkhuzi wamaPhoyisa eMpumalanga, uMajor General (Dkt) Zeph Mkhwanazi lisigxekile isehlakalo esenzeke ngenyanga yokubungaza abantu besifazane."Sithikamezekile izigameko zalolu hlobo eziwudlame olubhekiswe kubantu besifazane esikhathini lapho sibabungaza ngenyanga yabo u-Agasti. Simfiselela ukwelulama okusheshayo umgilwa,” kusho uMkhwanazi.Umsolwa kulindeleke ukuthi avele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseCarolina namuhla.
SIZOLALELWA ngoMsombuluko eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMbumbulu, isicelo sebheyili sekhehla, okuthiwa libanjwe oqotsheni ngunogada wesikole livalele izelamani zamantombazane ezincane, okuthiwa lizibhudubeze zidlula ngakwakhe ziya esikoleni.UMnuz Philo Walton Mbambo (64) wase-Adams Mission, eThekwini, okuvele ukuthi uyinhlalisuthi kwelinye lamabandla, uvele kule nkantolo ngoMsombuluko, emva kokuthi eboshwe ngesonto eledlule ngecala lokunukubeza ngokocansi abagilwa abaneminyaka ephakathi kuka-12 no-14. Kuthiwa abagilwa bafunda kwesinye sezikole ezikhona endaweni, ubebavimba uma bedlula ngakwakhe beya esikoleni.Bese kungokwesibili umsolwa evela kule nkantolo, kanti inqume ukulihlehlisela uMsombuluko icala abhenekene nalo ngenxa yokuthi amaphoyisa asazoyoqinisekisa ikheli lakhe.Unina wabagilwa elandiswa Isolezwe ngokwenzeka, uthe umsolwa usebenzise ukuthi wakhe eduze kwendlela lapho edlulela esikoleni."Bengingakaze ngimbone, ngiqale ukuzwa nje sengibizwa esikoleni sezingane, kuthiwa angiphuthume. Angihlali nezingane ngibamba amatoho, zihlala noninakhulu. Ngesikhathi kufika isigijimi sithi ngifunwa esikoleni, ngenhlanhla ngangingasebenzi ngalolo suku, ngisekhaya,” usho kanje.Uthe elandiswa, umsolwa ubonwe wumakhelwane oqaphele ukuthi uvalele izingane zamantombazane njengoba bese kunesikhathi zingenile endlini.Kuthiwa umakhelwane kamsolwa uphuthume esikoleni wayobika, nebala unogada wesikole uzithele kumsolwa ebophe umgilwa izandla nezinyawo, okuvele ukuthi ubeseqedile ukunukubeza omncane esehlela ukudlulela komunye.Uthe izingane ziveze ukuthi ubengaqali, bese kungokwesithathu, omncane selokhu emqale ngonyaka odlule kanti omdala ubesemnukubeza okwesibili. Kuthiwa ubethi abasome, abangcolise emathangeni, kwesinye isikhathi ebaphoqe bavume ashutheke isitho sakhe sangasese endaweni yokuzikhulula. Kuthiwa abagilwa ubeqale abaphoqe ukuthi babuke i-video yocansi ngaphambi kokuthi agile umkhubaUnina wabagilwa uthe emva kokuthi umsolwa ebanjiwe ngesikhathi engakaboshwa, ufikile kubo kwabagilwa okuvela ukuthi akekho umuntu wesilisa ohlala khona, wathi abangayilaleli into eshiwo esikoleni. Kuthiwa uthe bavele othisha bayamzonda kodwa bamphebeza ngoba nodokotela wayeseqinisekisile ukuthi izingane zinukubeziwe.
Afunga ayagomela ukuthi azobuyela ePhalamende, amalungu eqembu Umkhonto weSizwe, okwahoxiswa ubulungu bawo yileli qembu.La malungu angu-10 ayise leli qembu enkantolo, athe awafudumezeli muntu izihlalo zawo asazobuyela yingakho enqume nokuya enkantolo enkulu yaseWestern Cape, ngoba efuna ubulungiswa.Angu-18 amalungu aleli qembu okwahoxiswa ubulungu bawo yiMK ngoJulayi.UMnuz Thami Khuzwayo, owayehola uphiko lwezitshudeni lweMK, okhulumele amalungu aye enkantolo esithangamini sabezindaba izolo, uthe abayi ndawo bona eqenjini futhi basazobuyela ePhalamende."Siyakwamukela ukufika kwabantu abafana noMnuz Floyd Shivambu, obeyiphini likamengameli le-EFF. Kodwa akekho ozothatha izihlalo zethu. Siye enkantolo ngoba sifuna kuxazululeke lolu daba.”Uveze ukuthi kunabantu okubalwa uSotswebhu waleli qembu ePhalamende uMnuz Sihle Ngubane, indodakazi yomholi weMK uMnuz Jacob Zuma, uDuduzile, umkhulumeli weqembu uMnuz Nhlamulo Ndhlela nabanye abaxova iqembu."Sizolwa kuze kube sekugcineni. Asiyanga kwiMK ngenxa yezikhundla kodwa silwa ngoba nabanye kuyobenza okusenzile. Uma singalwi kuyophela ngeMK. Siyalithanda iqembu, salijoyina ngenxa kaZuma owayehlushwa yi-ANC. Ngeke sililaxaze manje, okunalokho sifuna kukhishwe abaxovayo.”IPhalamende limise ukufungiswa kwamalungu amasha eMK kuze kuxazululwe lolu daba enkantolo.Icala kulindeleke ukuthi libuyele ngoSepthemba 3, 2024 kanti la malungu angu-10 afuna kubuyekezwe nendaba yokuhoxiswa kwawo.

AFUNA ukuxegiselwa umbandela webheyili othi angalubhadi eHillcrest lapho kuhlala khona ummangali ongusomabhizinisi, uMnuz Thabiso Ngcobo, amaphoyisa alishumi ayamaniswa nokuzama ukumbulala.Wonke la maphoyisa angaphandle ngebheyili ka-R5000 enemibandela.Kulokhu bonke bebezifihlile. Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi phambilini kwaba nemibuzo ngokuzifihla kwephoyisa elidume ngokuqotha izigebengu ngenhlamvu nalo elingumsolwa kuleli cala, uPedro Rodiguez (44).Amaphoyisa abekwe icala lokuzama ukubulala. Kuthiwa adubula imoto kaNgcobo esigamekweni okuthiwa senzeka emgwaqweni uM13 ngasePinetown.Izolo eNkantolo yeMantshi yasePinetwown, ummeli wamaphoyisa, uHenry Van Breda utshele iMantshi, uWendalynn Robinson ukuthi abasolwa bacela ukuxegiselwa omunye wemibandela yebheyili."Umbandela wokuthi amaphoyisa angalubhadi eHillcrest ngoba kungalapho kuhlala khona ummangali awumubi futhi bazimisele ukuwuhlonipha. Kodwa inkinga ngombandela ukuthi uphazamisa ukusebenza kwamaphoyisa,'' kusho uVan Breda.Uqhube wathi njengoba amaphoyisa esaqhubeka nokwenza umsebenzi wawo umbandela wokuthi kube khona indawo angakwazi ukufinyelala kuyona ukhinyabeza ukusebenza kwawo."Bangichazelile ukuthi abasazi ukuthi benzenjani uma kuvela izimo eziphuthumayo ezibaphoqa ukuba bayosebenza kule ndawo. Ngiyanxusa ukuthi lo mbandela uhoxiswe ukuze basebenze ngokukhululeka,'' kunxusa uVan Breda.Uthembise ukuthi eminye imibandela amaphoyisa azimisele ukuyigcina njengoba injalo.IMantshi ithe ngeke iwuhoxise lowo mbandela ngoba uyingxenye enkulu yemibandela yebheyili. Yathi ayiboni kungumqondo ophusile ukuhoxiswa kwawo."Kungakuhle uma ningase nikhulume nabaqashi benu nibazise ngesinqumo senkantolo esihambisana nombandela webheyili yenu. Uma nenza kanjalo ngikholwa ukuthi akukho okuzoniphazamisa ekusebenzeni kwenu,'' kusho iMantshi.Icala lihlehliselwe uNovemba 15 njengoba kuvela ukuthi kunolunye uphenyo olusaqhutshwa.
SISHAYELWE ihlombe isinqumo sikaNgqongqoshe weMfundo eyisiSekelo, uNksz Siviwe Gwarube oyilungu le-DA, sokumisa ukukhishwa kwethenda ka-R9.8 billion, enkampanini eyodwa ebizophakela izikole kuleli.Le thenda kuthiwa imiswe emva kokuba kukhona abahlabe umkhosi besola inkohlakalo njengoba yakhishwa engakabikhona ungqongqoshe kulo mnyango. Kucacile ukuthi ezinye izifundazwe ziyehluleka ukulawula ngendlela lolu hlelo ngakho kumele zisike iphethini kulezo ezenza kahle.” Okhulumela inhlangano ephakela izikole KwaZulu-Natal, i-NSNP Service Providers Association, uMnuz Thabang Mncwabe, usincomile isinyathelo sikaNksz Gwarube. Uthe bayakuchitha ukuthi uhlelo lunikwe inkampani eyodwa ezophakela izwe lonke."Inhloso yalolu hlelo wukufukula abesifazane, abalimi nezinhlaka ezehlukene okubalwa nentsha. Sikhathazekile ngoba uhlelo olufuze lolu lwaba nezingqinamba esifundazweni umnyango wagcina ukhokhe imali enkulu.”Uthe bayakhathazeka uma umsebenzi omkhulu njengalo unikwa umuntu oyedwa.Lolu hlelo luhlomulisa abafundi abevile ku-9.6 million nsuku zonke.Esifundazweni inkampani eyodwa eyayithole lo msebenzi wokusabalalisa ukudla ezikoleni zesifundazwe, yabhekana nezingqinamba kwadingeka ukuthi umnyango ubuyele ohlelweni oludala lokuthi osonkontileka bazihambisele ukudla ngqo ezikoleni.Izinkinga zazifaka ukungafiki ngesikhathi kokudla ezikoleni eziningi.
UNIKWE ikhefu uFata wamaKhatholika eLamontville osolwa ngokuba yi-blesser lomfundi oneminyaka engu-17 okhonza ebandleni lakhe.Ngokuthola kwaleli phephandaba, uFata ubengekho enkonzweni ngeSonto esisuka kulo, ebanjelwe ngomunye owenze imisa kulandela ukuthi umndeni womfundi ongamalungu aleli bandla, uthole ukuthi bayathandana wase umceba kuMbhishobhi.Umndeni wengane, efunda izifundo uma kungamaSonto kulo leli pherishi, uthe ubambe izinkulumo phakathi kukaFata nalo mfundi obekucaca ukuthi bayathandana futhi sebeke baya nasocansini, naye uFata wavuma.Unina womfundi uthe ingane yakhe ibisihlale inemali, isigqoka izingubo ezithengwa esitolo soku-oda nge-internet iShein okuthi uma ibuzwa ukuthi izithenge ngani, ingasho. Kugcine kuvela ukuthi i-blesser wuFata."Ngike ngamshaya ngoba ubesenomkhuba wokunyamalala amahora ngingazi ukuthi uyephi kwaze kwaba ngilunywa indlebe yisihlobo ngokuthi sesike sambona izikhawu eziningana egibela emotweni kaFata."Sinodadewethu sibe sesilandelela sifuna ukuthola iqiniso ngoba yena ubephika uma simbuza. Size savula iselula yakhe sabona izinto ezishaqisayo abazikhulumayo ezigcinwe kuma-archives," kusho unina.Uthe bewumndeni baziyele ngqo kuFata bayombuza ngalokhu, wavuma wathi "ulingekile”. Kuthiwa uvumile nokuthi sebeke baya ocansini, wathembisa nokuhlawula uma umndeni ungayamukela inhlawulo.Ngokwenqubo yamaKhatholika abefundisi bathathwa njengezindela, kabazibandakanyi nocansi futhi abaganwa."Asikwazi ukuthatha inhlawulo sengathi yinto eyemukelekile lena. Izingane sizidedela ukuthi ziye esontweni ngoba sazi ukuthi kukhona ubaba."Uma sekuzophenduka yena enze into enje siyaphoxeka futhi sifuna anqunywe ebufundisini, anikezwe umsebenzi ozokwenza ukuthi angahlangani nezinye izingane bese enza okufanayo," kusho unina wengane.UMbhishobhi Elias Zondi, owumsizi kaMbhishobhi Mandla Mjwara ehhovisi lesiFundabhishobhi samaKhatholika saseThekwini, uthe lolu daba lubikiwe ehhovisi kuye nakuMbhishobhi (omkhulu). Basezinhlelweni zokuthi bathole umphenyi ozimele ozocubungula ukuthi likhona yini icala elingaphenywa. Kusenziwa lokho babone ukuthi uFata othintekayo anikwe ikhefu."Umndeni siwazisile ngokuthi inqubo ithini uma kunezinsolo ngoFata."Uma umphenyi webandla etholile ukuthi kunecala okumele liphenywe, uzomiswa uFata bese kwaziswa amakholwa. Ngalolu hlelo asiqondile ukulunyathela udaba. Yinqubo esiyilandelayo kuwo wonke amacala," kusho uZondi.Leli phephandaba lizamile ukuxhumana noFata othintekayo ocingweni lwakhe, kepha belungangeni futhi lungayemukeli imiyalezo.

INHLANGANO elwela amalungelo abantu eSwatini, iSwaziland Solidarity Network, igxeka umshado olungiselelwayo weNgonyama uMswati wesithathu nendodakazi yowayengumengameli, uJacob Zuma, uNomcebo (21).ISwaziland Solidarity Network ichaze lo mshado njengechilo, yakhala ngokunyathelwa kwamalungelo kaNomcebo.Okhulumela inhlangano, uMnuz Lucky Lukhele, uthe alukho uthando kulo mshado, wathi kusetshenziswa uNomcebo ukuqinisa ubudlelwano beNgonyama noZuma. UNomcebo uzokuba unkosikazi kaMswati ka-16.Ingonyama yathumela abakhongi ngenyanga eyedlule, kuthiwa yalobola ngezinkomo ezingu-100, nemali enguR2 million.ESINYE sezithombe esigcwele ezinkundleni zokuxhumana njengoba anabanye abantu bephawula ngomshado wendodakazi kaJacob Zuma nendodakazi yakhe eneminyaka ewu-21, uNomceboUNomcebo uvele useqalile ukubonakala emicimbini yaseSwatini ehanjelwa abasendlunkulu.Kuthiwa kulindeleke ukuthi ziwushaye emva koMkhosi woMhlanga.ULukhele unxuse zonke izinhlangano ezilwela amalungelo abesifazane ezwenikazi i-Afrika jikelele ukuba zigxeke isenzo seNgonyama noZuma."Sekukaningi la madoda ebukela phansi amalungelo abantu besifazane. Sekukaningi enza izinto eziphambene namasiko ethu thina ma-Afrika ukuze azuze kwezepolitiki nangemali. "Sifuna ukuthi athathelwe izinyathelo ngokushesha. La madoda awagcinanga nje ngokusebenzisa budedengu amasiko ethu, kepha aphinde ehlisa isithunzi sabantu besifazane.”AbakwaDlamini nabakwaZuma banomlando wokuganiselana.Ngesikhathi uZuma eseyiphini likamengameli, walobola udadewabo weNgonyama, uMntwana uSebentile Dlamini, ngezinkomo ezingu-50.Abanye abakwaZuma abaganwe ebukhosini baseSwatini kubalwa indodana kaZuma, uMnuz Mxolisi Zuma, nosomabhizinisi uMnuz Khulubuse Zuma.ULukhele uthe kukhona okushaya amanzi ngokuganiselana kwale mindeni."Sekusele kancane ukuthi iganiselane abantu abayizihlobo. IFinancial Intelligence Centre kufanele iphenye ukushintshisana ngomcebo kwale mindeni yomibili.”UNomcebo uke wabonakala eseduze neNgonyama, evunule ngebhayi leMK, okuyiqembu likaZuma.ULukhele uthe lokhu kwabamangaza ngoba amaqembu ezepolitiki avalwe imilomo eSwatini."Abaholi bamaqembu ezepolitiki eSwatini bayahlukunyezwa. Kuyamangaza ukuthi uNomcebo uyakwazi nje ukuvele azifakele ibhayi leqembu likayise phambi kweNgonyama. Le senzo sikhombisa ngokusobala ukuthi abukho ubulungiswa lapha eSwatini.”Okhulumela Ingonyama, uMnuz Percy Simelane, akathandanga ukuphawula kakhulu ngalolu daba ngoba 'luthinta impilo yeNgonyama’ yasesithe.USimelane uthe nakuba iSwaziland Solidarity Foundation inelungelo lokuzwakalisa imibono yayo, kodwa ayinalo ilungelo lokugxambukela empilweni yabantu yasesithe.

Akekho umuntu okufanele enze into efana nale bese eyekwa nje, yingakho amaphoyisa ephansi phezulu emfuna, sizombamba futhi,” kusho uMchunu.Unxuse abenzi bobubi ukuthi uma bekwazi okubafanele, bavele bazinikele emaphoyiseni, wanxusa nomphakathi ukuthi uma kukhona okwaziyo ngabo, usheshe ubikele amaphoyisa.

BAYATHUTHUMELA abantu base-Nairobi, eKenya, kweqa ejele iziboshwa ezingu-13 okukhona kuzo nomalugaju osenqume wabulala inqwaba yabantu besifazane.Ngokombiko wamaphoyisa aseKenya, laba beqe esitokisini samaphoyisa eNairobi.Ngokusho kwamaphoyisa, uCollins Khalusha oneminyaka engu-33 ubudala okuthiwa uzivumele yena amacala okunquma abulale abesifazane abangu-42, uphakathi kwabantu abangu-13 abeqe esitokisini samaphoyisa eNairobi.UKhalusha uchazwe ngamaphoyisa "njengomuntu onobulwane nongaphilile kahle ekhanda ngesikhathi eboshwa ngoJulayi, ngemuva kokutholwa kwezidumbu endaweni eyaziwayo enhlokodolobha yaseKenya.Amaphoyisa athe ngoLwesibili, iphoyisa eliphethe nomphathi wenkantini esiteshini samaphoyisa iGigiri, babone ukuthi abasolwa bebengekho ngesikhathi beyobanika isidlo sasekuseni ngo-5 ekuseni.Kuthiwa uKhalusha nezinye iziboshwa ezidabuka e-Eritrea futhi eziboshelwe izinsolo zokuba eKenya ngokungemthetho, basika izintambo ezitokisini zabo base beqa udonga.UMohamed Amin oyinhloko yophiko oluphenya ngamacala obugebengu, utshele i-Associated Press ukuthi kuyishwa ukweqa kwalaba basolwa. "Lona bekungumsolwa onobungozi kakhulu obhekene namacala abucayi. Siyasiphenya lesi sigameko futhi sizothatha izinyathelo ezifanele,” kusho u-Amin.Ngokusho kwamaphoyisa, uKhalusha uzivumele yena amacala okubulala abesifazane abangu-42 eminyakeni emibili edlule, waphonsa izidumbu zabo enkwalini okumanje isisetshenziswa njengendawo yokulahla udoti. ISIMO besimuncu esiteshini samaphoyisa KwaMashu, izolo, kulandela ukuthi amaphoyisa amabili akulesi siteshi abanjwe enza ubugebengu njengoba elilodwa lidutshulwe labulawa, elinye lakhalelwa ngamasongo kaSgonyela.La maphoyisa kusolakala ukuthi abeyingxeye yezigebengu eziyisishiyagalolunye ezisolwa ukuthi zibambe inkunzi esitolo e-Richmond Farm, okuthe uma sezikakwe amaphoyisa eLindelani, eNtuzuma, ngeSonto, zadubula amaphoyisa aphindisela kwashona ezintathu. Esisodwa bekuyiphoyisa lakuso lesi siteshi.NgoMsombuluko, elinye iphoyisa lakulesi siteshi elikwazile ukubaleka ngesikhathi kudutshulwana yize bese lidubuleke engalweni, likhalelwe amasongo kaSgonyela likwesinye sezibhedlela enyakatho yeTheku lelashwa inxeba lokudutshulwa. Umthombo waleli phephandaba okuso lesi siteshi, uthe isimo besimuncu kungasebenzeki ngenxa yalezi zindaba."Siphoxeke kakhulu ngesikuzwile ukuthi ozakwethu ebese sinesikhathi sinabo sithole ukuthi bebeyingxenye yethimba lezigebengu,” kusho lo mthombo.Uthe abanye ozakwabo bebengakholwa becabanga ukuthi kunephutha kuze kube bakhonjiswa izithombe. Iphoyisa eliboshwe esibhedlela liwu-constable, kanti elishonile liwusayitsheni. Okhulumela amaphoyisa kulesi sifundazwe, uLt Col Colonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe iphoyisa eliboshiwe u-constable oneminyaka engu-38, kanti elishonile belingakadalulwa igama lalo kodwa ozakwabo balichaze njengosayitsheni obeseneminyaka eyevile ku-20 eyiphoyisa. "Umsolwa oboshwe esibhedlela kulindeleke ukuthi avele enkantolo maduze nje," kusho uNetshiunda.UNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu obehambele eMlaza lapho kudutshulwe khona abantu abayisithupha bashona, ngoMsombuluko, ephawula ngalesi sigameko, uthe baphoxekile ngokuthi kubasolwa bekunamaphoyisa."Siyawanxusa amaphoyisa ukuthi noma ngabe abhekene nasiphi isimo angangeni ebugebengwini. Kuyasikhathaza futhi kwenza nokuthi sibheke izinhlelo zethu zokuqasha amaphoyisa ukuthi amaphoyisa kube yiwo enza ubugebengu. La maphoyisa ebusuku ngoMgqibelo abesemsebenzini. Aphuma ekuseni ayozibandabakanya nobugebengu. Amaphoyisa amaningi asebenza kahle kodwa lesi sigameko sisiphoxile," kusho uMchunu.UKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLt General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, uthe abasolwa bangamaphoyisa baphume emsebenzini bayokwenza ubugebengu besagqoke umfaniswano wamaphoyisa. Kusolwa ukuthi abasolwa bebeyisishiyagalolunye ngesikhathi beficwa ngamaphoyisa komunye wemizi eLindelani. Ngokuthola kwaleli phephandaba, iphoyisa elisale enkundleni lingelokuzalwa eMabheleni, kuthiwa like lasebenza esiteshini samaphoysisa eNtuzuma kodwa belisesiteshini saKwaMashu. Ozakwabo bathi belingakukhonzile ukukhuluma kakhulu.Eliboshiwe, ozakwabo balichaza njengomuntu ozikhululekele, naye osenesikhashana ekhona embuthweni wamaphoyisa. Isolezwe lithole ukuthi uhlala eNtuzuma eduze kwalapho amaphoyisa eqale khona ngesikhathi efuna umkhondo wabasolwa. Kuchaphazeleka lawa maphoyisa nje esigamekweni sobugebengu, sikhulu isililo ngobugebengu obudla lubi emgwaqweni uDumisani Makhaye ongakwaMashu nasehostela lakule ndawo. Kuke kwavela ne-video ekhombisa abafana abasebancane bephethe futhi beqhumisa izibhamu emini kwabha ehostela. Amaphoyisa akhulume neSolezwe angagunyaziwe ukukhuluma nabezindaba, akhale ngobugebengu obusehostela abathi budla lubi ngale ndlela yokuthi budinga izinsiza eziningi nokuncipha kwesibalo samaphoyisa nakho kunomthelela. Khonamanjalo, izolo ntambama amaphoyisa adubule abulala abasolwa ababili okuthiwa bebefunwa eStanger. Ngesikhathi sokushicilela abesamatasa endaweni yesigameko.

UNOBHALA Jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, ubona kungeke kwenze mehluko ukuhlakaza ubuholi be-ANC KwaZulu-Natal nobezifunda.UMbalula uthe into ezobasiza ukuthi bathole ukuthi yini eyenza ukuthi bengenzi kahle eKZN ngesikhathi kunokhetho lwangoMeyi.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba, eThekwini, izolo, lapho kuqhubeka khona umhlangano wekomiti elibhekelele ukusebenza kwansuku zonke kwi-ANC.UMbalula usho kanjena nje, kukhona amalungu eqembu agxeka ubuholi baKwaZulu-Natal ngokwahluleka ukukhankasela ukhetho olwedlule.Isolezwe lizwe ukuthi abanye abaholi bamagatsha batshele uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, ukuthi bafuna kuhlakazwe ubuholi besifundazwe.URamaphosa ube nomhlangano nabaholi bamagatsha esifundeni iMoses Mabhida, ngoSonto.Umholi wegatsha obehambele umhlangano, uthe bafuna ukuthi ubuholi besifundazwe nobesifunda buhlakazwe."Silwile kakhulu emhlanganweni. Asisabafuni laba bantu. Sihlezi sihlulwa ezinkethweni zokuchibiyela bekhona, abasisizi ngalutho uma kukhankaswa. Ngingakubeka kucace ukuthi bayahamba,” usho kanje.UMbalula yena ubehlangene namagatsha e-ANC eThekwini, ngalo iSonto.Utshele abezindaba ukuthi akekho owenze isiphakamiso sokuthi kuhlakazwe ubuholi besifundazwe noma obezifunda.UMbalula uthe abajahile ukuhlakaza ubuholi."Mhlawumbe bakhona abakujahile lokho, kodwa thina asizile lapha ukuzohlakaza ubuholi. Thina into esiyijahile ukuthola ukuthi iziphi izinto ezaholela ekutheni sihlulwe okhethweni. Ayikho into ongayakha ngokuhlakaza ubuholi. Ziningi izinto esingazenza ukwakha kabusha i-ANC KwaZulu-Natal. Into ebalulekile ukuthi sazi ukuthi kungani abantu bengasivotelanga, nokuthi kungani abantu bengaphumanga ngobuningi.”UMbalula uthe kubashayile kakhulu KwaZulu-Natal ukuvela kweqembu eliholwa owayengumengameli, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, i-MK."IKwaZulu-Natal iyona eyaba nesibalo esiphezulu sabantu abaphuma bayovota. Ngicabanga ukuthi u-58.2% wabantu abavota lapha KwaZulu-Natal. Kodwa iqiniso ukuthi labo bantu bavotela uZuma. Kufanele sikubuke ukuthi kusho ukuthini lokho.”UMbalula uthe bazimisele ukwakha kabusha izinhlaka zeqembu, wathi bazokhetha ubuholi besikhashana emagatsheni asale engenabuholi ngenxa yokuhlubuka kwabantu okwenzeke ngaphambi kokhetho.Ikomiti elibhekelele ukusebenza kwansuku zonke kwi-ANC luphothule uhambo lwalo laKwaZulu-Natal izolo, lapho lihlangane khona nobuholi besifundazwe.

Kuvamisile vele ukuthi uma kuduke umuntu oshadile, kusolwe lona omunye osele."Ingakho sengithandazela ukuthi uMaDlomo atholakale, khona kuzophela konke lokhu kukhuluma okukhona. Uma engabuya mhlawumbe angacacisa ngalezi zinto ezikhulunywayo. Ingakho ngithandazela ukuthi atholakale ephila.”Uyise kamakoti, uMnuz Nkosinathi Dlomo, uthe indodakazi yakhe yagcina ukumthumela umyalezo ngeWhatsApp, ngaphambi kwehora lesibili, ngalo uLwesihlanu."Emva kwalokho wabe eselahleka emoyeni. Sasithi noma sithi siyafona, ucingo lwakhe lukhale lungabanjwa. Ngeshwa ucingo walushiya khona kwaZondo, baze baluthola ngesinye isikhathi.”UDlomo uthe ubunzima ababhekene nabo abuchazeki."Kubuhlungu ngoba umntwana wethu lona, asimazi noma usaphila yini. Asazi ukuthi kwenzekani ngaye. Siphatheke kabi kakhulu. Sinethemba lokuthi uzotholakala maduze.”Kuze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, engakayiphenduli imibuzo athunyelwe yona.
IZINYUNYANA zabasebenzi bezempilo zithi uMnyango wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal unomthelela ezigamekweni zonesi abashaywa iziguli besemsebenzini.Esigamekweni sakamuva esenzeke ngoMgqibelo, isiguli okusolwa ukuthi besingayidli kahle imishanguzo yaso yokulawula isifo sengqondo, sishaye abahlengikazi ababili emtholampilo oseMpangeni.UMphathiswa wezeMpilo uNksz Nomagugu Simelane, uthe ngokuzwa kwakhe kuthe kusenomhlangano abaphathi besakhuluma nomhlengikazi wokuqala ngesigameko sokushaywa yisiguli, saphinde salwa nomunye umhlengikazi oqashwe inhlangano esiza umphakathi osebenza kuwo umtholampilo. Kwagcina sekubizwa amaphoyisa nophiko olubhekele iziguli ezinezifo zengqondo zasesibhedlela iNgwelezane. Usihlalo wenyunyana yabahlengikazi, iDENOSA KwaZulu-Natal , uMnuz Sibonelo Cele, uthe ukushoda kwabahlengikazi ezibhedlela nokungabikhona kwamawodi abhekele iziguli eziphazamisekile ngokwengqondo kuzo zonke izibhedlela ekubeni sikhula isibalo seziguli ezihlaselwa izifo zengqondo kudala ukuthi inkinga ingapheli. "Isiguli esiphazamiseke ngokwengqondo sidinga ukuthi umhlengikazi angawasusi amehlo kuso. Uma umhlengikazi eke wawasusa amehlo wasiza ezinye iziguli siyadinwa. Imithetho okumele ilandelwe ngaphambi kokuthi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi isiguli siphazamisekile nayo yengeza ingcindezi. Ngesikhathi kusalindwe isiqinisekiso kuyenzeka isiguli senze umonakalo. Ukushoda kwabahlengikazi kwenza ukuthi umhlengikazi angakwazi ukubheka leso isiguli esisodwa," kusho uCele.UMnuz Mlungisi Ndlovu oyimenenja yenyunyana yabasebenzi bezempilo iPSA KwaZulu-Natal, uthe ezokuphepha ezikhungweni zezempilo azikho ezingeni elifanele."Onogada kwesinye isikhathi basuke bengekho eduze ukuze baqaphe ukuphepha kwabasebenzi nezinye iziguli ngoba isiguli singalimaza noma ngubani. Emasontweni ambalwa khona esibhedlela eNgwelezane udokotela ugwazwe isiguli esemsebenzini, manje isiguli sesishaya onesi ababili. Lesi simo sidinga ukuqashelwa kakhulu. Uma sesenzekile isigameko umnyango kudingeka ukuthi ubeseke abasebenzi ngokuthi uvakashele kuleso sikhungo ukuze kwehle uvalo. Uphinde unikeze umhlengikazi othinthekayo usizo lokwelulekwa ngokwenqondo. Uma elimele kubhekwe nokuthi uyawuthola umhlomulo wokuthi ulimale esemsebenzini," kusho uNdlovu.UMphathiswa, uNksz Simelane, uthe umnyango uyaluphenya lolu daba kodwa isiguli asiboshwanga, sigodukiswe nowomndeni.
SISHUBILE isimo phakathi kwenkosi yaseMgababa, eSouth Coast uPhathisizwe Philbert Luthuli nesizwe sakhe, esimsola ngokuqasha izingane zayo ezikhundleni zomkhandlu wayo.Isolezwe Ngempelasonto lithole ukuthi impi ephakathi kwenkosi nesizwe isikwelinye izinga njengoba kuthiwa ngisho nesigungu sayo asihambisani nesenzo senkosi."Isimangazile inkosi uLuthuli eqasha izingane zakhe ukuthi zisebenze emkhandlwini wakhe. "Ithe uma isimemezela ukuthi kuqashwe omunye, kwavunyelwana ukuthi kumele kube wumsebenzi okhangiswayo ukuze abantu bendawo bafake izicelo zomsebenzi. Baningi abantu abafake izicelo ukuthi banikwe umsebenzi. Kuyilungelo lami ukuthi ngingamqasha umabhalane. Njengoba ungazimisele ukuveza amagama abantu abakutshele lolu daba ngeke ngikwazi ukuphawula ngalo. Okunye okumele ukwazi ukuthi lolu daba akulona olwamaphephandaba, kungcono ungalubhali. Kufana nokuthi olomndeni njengoba luthinta isizwe nami. Udaba lomndeni ke kusuke kungelempepho akulona olokubhalwa emaphepheni. Laba abaluyise emaphepheni bafuna ukungihlambalaza nje,” kusho inkosi uLuthuli.ULuthuli akaqali ukuba sematheni ngezinto ezithinta yena endaweni yakhe. Ngo-2018 kwake kwavela isikhalo somphakathi wakhe uthi uhlala ebonakala ezindaweni zobumnandi ephuza eshaya namavosho. Umphakathi waphinde wasola inkosi ngokuthi idla imali yokudayisa izindawo endaweni yayo bese iyozitika ngeziphuzo. Kuyona le ndawo inkosi uLuthuli yake yaxabana nosomabhizinisi, uMnuz Edward Mpeko owayenendawo yokulala khona, waxoshwa yinkosi ngokungemthetho. Leli cala lagcina liphelele eNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu lapho kwaphuma phambili uMpeko kwathiwa akakhokhelwe nezindleko zecala.
KUSEMNYAMA ngokwakhiwa kwezindlu zesiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal eMgungundlovu, njengoba amaqembu abusa isifundazwe ngokubambisana ehlukene phakathi.Nakuba emaqenjini abusa ngokubambisana kukhona afuna ukuthi kuqhubeke ukwakhiwa kwezindlu zesiShayamthetho ezizokuba namahhovisi kahulumeni, amanye amaqembu afuna ukuthi isiShayamthetho sibuyele oLundi.USomlomo, uNksz Nontembeko Boyce, uthe lolu daba uselushiyele emaqenjini abusa ngokubambisana ukuba aluxoxe.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ethula isabelomali sesiShayamthetho ngoLwesihlanu.UNksz Boyce ubephendula inkulumo kaSotswebhu we-DA, uDkt Imran Keeka, ocele ukuthi kuvuselelwe izingxoxo zokwakhiwa kwesiShayamthetho.Udaba lokwakhiwa kwezindlu zesiShayamthetho eMgungundlovu, ludala, laqalwa ukukhulunywa ngesikhathi kusuka isiShayamthetho oLundi, ngo-2004.Nakuba kade lwaqala ukukhulunywa lolu daba, akukho mnyakazo otheni owenziwe.Umnyakazo oqaphelekile wenziwa owayengundunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Nomusa Dube-Ncube, owamemezela ukuthi kuzoqala ukwakhiwa kwezindlu zesiShayamthetho ezizobiza u-R6 billion.Lokhu wakwenza ngesikhathi ethula inkulumo yakhe ngesimo sesifundazwe yokugcina, ngasekuqaleni konyaka.Ukungabuyeli kwe-ANC emandleni kushiye ungabazane ngokwakhiwa kwezindlu zesiShayamthetho njengoba isibambisene namaqembu afuna ukuthi isiShayamthetho sibuyele oLundi.I-IFP ne-NFP bafuna ukuthi isiShayamthetho sibuyele oLundi.Nakho ukubuyela kwesiShayamthetho oLundi kubukeka kungelula. Muva nje uNdunankulu Thami Ntuli, uthe lolu daba lusadinga ukuxoxwa.Lokhu wakusho ngesikhathi eyokwethula iKhabhinethi yakhe eSilweni.UKeeka uthe unethemba lokuthi uMnyango kaMgcinimafa kuzwelonke nasesifundazweni, noMnyango wezeMisebenzi yoMphakathi neNgqalasizinda esifundazweni, izoqala kabusha izingxoxo zokwakhiwa kwezindlu zesiShayamthetho, eMgungundlovu.Uthe uhambo lwakamumva lwamalungu esiShayamthetho lwaseScotland, lukhombise ngokusobala ukuthi kufuneka kwakhiwe isiShayamthetho.UNksz Boyce uthe uyazi ukuthi kunokungavumelani ngalolu daba, wabalula kakhulu ingwevu ye-IFP, uMnuz Blessed Gwala, athe iyazi ukuthi abavumelani nayo ngalolu daba.UNksz Boyce uthe amaqembu abusa ngokubambisana kufanele baluxoxe udaba. "Ekugcineni kufanele sivumelane. Yingakho ngithi ngizoyishiyela kubaholi bamaqembu abusa ngokubambisana ukuba axoxe.”

USHIYE esezihlelele ukuthi zikwazi ukuzimela izingane zakhe uZanele Mbokazi Nkambule ongcwatshelwe emathuneni aseMariannhill, eThekwini, ngoMgqibelo.UZanele (52) obengumsunguli wama-Crown Gospel Music Awards ushone ngoMsombuluko owedlule ngemuva kokuhlaselwa yisifo somdlavuza wamaphaphu.Uhlonishwe ngomngcwabo osesigabeni sesibili ezingeni lesifundazwe.Enkonzweni yomngcwabo wakhe ezinye zezikhulumi bezihamba emazwini okuthi zifunde lukhulu kuye.Indodakazi yakhe uNonjabulo Mdluli, ithe ngesikhathi kushona unina omzalayo, owayelamana noZanele, uQondi, bakhuliswa nguZanele.UNonjabulo uchaze umama uZanele njengomuntu owayesebenza ngokuzikhandla, wathi ngesikhathi esegula "wayesho izinto obonayo ukuthi uthini kodwa futhi ungafuni ukubona”.Uthe wayesho ukuthi uyagula futhi ekhala ngezinhlungu.UMYENI kaZanele Mbokazi Nkambule, uMbhishobhi Mpendulo Nkambule noNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uThami Ntuli Isithombe: Sibonelo Ngcobo "Umama wayengakhali kodwa yilapho engabona khona ukuthi uyagula. Impilo yakhe yonke wayengahlukani ne-laptop yakhe. Ezinyangeni ezintathu ezedlule wathi uyayivula i-laptop ethi uyasebenza wayivala wathi akuvumi. Kwakungokokuqala selokhu ngamazi engakwazi ukusebenza. Kwakumcasula kakhulu ukuthi akakwazi ukusebenza,” kusho uNonjabulo.Uthe wabiza umhlangano womndeni wathi unemali futhi ucela bonke beze namacebo amabhizinisi.Uthe wawacubungula enza nezincomo zokuthi yiliphi alibona lizosebenza.
