Igama likaZanele lizohlale likhona ingunaphakade.”UNonjabulo ubemi esiteji nomfowabo uLindo nezingane zikaZanele ezimbili uYolanda Myeza noMawande.Umzukulu wakhe uMazwi obehamba nabanye abazukulu u-Andiswa noNolifa, uthe uZanele ubaphe impilo efiswa ngabaningi.Umyeni kaZanele uMbhishobhi Mpendulo Nkambule encwadini afundelwe yona, uthe ubusisiwe ngokuthola uthando lwangempela ngoba uZanele ubemthanda.Enkonzweni bekunezikhulu zikahulumeni, osaziwayo, nabanye.Uhlelo beluphethwe ngobunono wuThokozani MaMkhize Ndlovu noSiya Mhlongo.Kubaculi abebenandisa kubalwa kubo uSbu Noah, Dumi Mkokstad, Benjamin Dube, Solly Mahlangu noRebecca Malope.UNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uThami Ntuli, ubonge uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ngokuvumela ukuthi uZanele ahlonishwe ngomngcwabo kahulumeni.Uthe yize engasekho kodwa umbono wakhe wokuthuthukisa abantu abasha nezobuciko kuzoqhubeka.UZanele ubeyingane yokugcina kaMichael noMargaret Mbokazi abangasekho.Waqopha umlando ngokuba ngowesifazane wokuqala ukusakaza ohlelweni lwantambama kuKhozi FM okuwumsakazo ashone esebuyele kuwo.Uke wethula izinhlelo zethelevishini futhi wabhala izincwadi.Ushiye emhlabeni umyeni wakhe, izingane nodadewabo uKitty Zulu.
KULEZI zinsuku abantu bahamba ngolayini baqonde emabhodweni abo amabili lapho bethi bayonyula khona imali yabo yempesheni.UMnuz Bheki Mkhize oyisazi sezezimali e-FNB, uthe uhulumeni uze nohlelo lwe-two pot system ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu banemali eyanele uma sebethathe umhlalaphansi.Uthe ucwaningo abalwenzile bebuza abantu ukuthi bawulungele yini umhlalaphansi, luthole ukuthi u-50% wabo awulondolozi imali eyanele.Kuvele ukuthi abantu uma beshintsha imisebenzi bathatha imali yabo yempesheni bayibhubhudle bese kuthi uma kufika isikhathi somhlalaphansi bangabi nemali eyanele yokuphila.Labo bantu bagcina sebebhalisela ukuhola impesheni kahulumeni etholwa yizaguga ezingakaze zisebenze nebezingayitholi impesheni emsebenzi wazo.Ubalule ukuthi uhlelo lwe-two pot retirement system luzoqinisekisa ukuthi kunengxenye ebekelwe umuntu ukuze aphile impilo entofontofo uma esethatha umhlalaphansi.UMnuz Roy Evans we-Compass Consulting, eluleka abantu ngezezimali zomhlalaphansi nokulondoloza, uthe i-two pot retirement system wuhlelo oluzophoqa abantu ukuthi balondolozele umhlalaphansi.Uthe kusukela ngoSepthemba 1, imali elondolozwa ngabantu ukuze ibasize uma sebethathe umhlalaphansi isizohlukaniswa kabili.Enye izoya esikhwameni esibizwa nge-savings pot, bese enye ifakwe esikhwameni esibizwa nge-retirement pot.Imali yabo esikhona njengamanje esikhwameni somhlalaphansi izohlala esikhwameni esibizwa nge-vested pot.Kuzothi ngoSepthemba 1, kuthathwe u-R30 000 kwi-vested pot ufakwe kwi-savings pot."Abantu bazokwazi ukukhipha imali esukela ku-R2 000 kuya ku-R30 000 kanye ngonyaka kwi-savings pot. Lo R30 000 uzonyulwa kanye kwi-vested pot ngeke uphinde unyulwe. Uzobe usuba nenzalo, wandiswe nayimali umuntu azobe eyifaka nyangazonke,” kusho u-Evans.Uthe noma ngabe unezigidi esikhwameni sakho sempesheni kodwa imali ozoqala ngayo kwi-savings pot wu-R30 000.Wenze isibonelo sokuthi uma njalo ngenyanga ufaka u-R3 000 esikhwameni sakho sempesheni, kuzothi ngoSepthemba 1 leyo mali icazwe kabili. U-R700 uzongena kwi-savings pot bese u-R2 100 ungena kwi-retirement pot. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma ungayikhiphanga imali ngoSepthemba, kuzothi uma kuqala u-Okthoba ube usuno-R30 700.Uhlelo lwe-two pot retirement system alubathinti abantu okushaye uMashi 1, 2021 sebeneminyaka ewu-55 noma ngaphezulu kodwa-ke banelungelo lokukhetha ukungena ngaphansi kwalolu hlelo uma beluthanda. U-Evans ubaxwayise ngokuthi kufanele bacabangisise ukuthi bayathanda yini ukungena kulo ngoba uma sebengenile ngeke bakwazi ukuphuma.U-Evans ukhumbuze abantu ukuthi u-R30 000 okhishwa kwi-savings pot uzoba nezindleko zentela nezesikhwama sempesheni."Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu babheke nesikhwama sabo ukuthi i-South African Revenue Service (SARS) izothatha malini nokuthi izindleko zesikhwama zizoba malini. Ngeke umuntu athole u-R30 000 unjengoba unjalo. Isikhwama sizothatha izindleko zaso bese no-SARS ethatha intela yakhe, kuzoya ngokuthi umuntu ukusiphi isigaba sentela. Omunye kungathathwa uR8 000 okusho ukuthi u-R30 000 uzofika kuye usuwu-R22 000,” kuchaza u-Evans.Udonse ngendlebe abantu ukuthi bangayikhiphi imali yabo yempesheni ngaphandle uma bebhekene nezimo ezinzima. Ubalule ukuthi imali yempesheni izobe izala, ngakho uma ihleli kulezi zikhwama kusho ukuthi umuntu uzothatha umhlalaphansi enemali enhle kodwa uma eyikhipha ngeke abe nemali ezomjabulisa.Uma kwenzeka umuntu exoshwa, edilizwa emsebenzi noma ephelelwa wumsebenzi ngenxa yezizathu ezithile, uzokwazi ukuthola isamba sakhe semali esikwi-vested pot.Uzokwazi nokuthola imali ekwi-savings pot kodwa ngeke akwazi ukuthatha imali ekwi-retirement pot njengoba yona izomlinda ukuthi aze afike eminyakeni yomhlalaphansi.Kuyothi uma esethathe umhlalaphansi ayithole kanye ngenyanga njengoba uhulumeni engafuni ukuba nabantu akade benezikhwama zempesheni kodwa abagcina sebehola impesheni yakhe.Uma kwenzeka umuntu eshona labo abondliwa wuyena bazothola yonke imali yakhe ekuwo wonke amabhodwe, ngeke kuthiwe ubengakafiki eminyakeni yomhlalaphansi.
NKOSIKHONA CELEUMELAPHI wendabuko wakwaMhlabuyalingana, ukhuthaza abesifazane ukuba bakukhuthalele ukuzihlanza ngemuva kwezinto ezifana nokuphuphunyelwa yisisu noma ukukhipha isisu uqobo.UMnuz Mvelase wasePhelandaba, kwaMhlabuyalingana odume ngelikaShumi Lamakati, uthi baningi abesifazane ababhinjelwa yizinto ngenxa yokuhamba nesinyama esihambisana nokungazihlanzi.UMvelase uthi njengoba kuyinyanga yabesifazane ukhethe ukuqhakambisa lezi zihloko ezinkulumweni zakhe azenza emisakazweni yomphakathi nakweminye imithombo efuze amakhasi akhe ezokuxhumana."Noma ungaphuzuzela kanjani kodwa uma uke wakhipha isisu noma waphuphunyelwa, awukwazi ukushiya kulenga nje, kumele kube khona okwenzayo ukuze uzihlanze,” egcizelela uMvelase.Lo melaphi osezakhele udumo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana uthi kunezinto okuthi uma abesifazane bezizibile zigcine seziphenduka ithunzi elimnyama kubona.Uthe abanye abantu besifazane baba namahloni ukuhambela abelaphi bendabuko, kanti akumele kube njalo."Ayikho into umuntu wesifazane okumele azenyeze ngayo uma esukumela izinkinga zakhe. Wonke umuntu ophilayo ngaphansi komthunzi welanga kumele azisukumele izinkinga zakhe,'' usho kanje.Uveze ukuthi bayadinga nokuhlanjululwa nalabo besifazane abashonelwa ngabayeni babo. Kodwa uthe lokho kumele kube umsebenzi owenziwa ngumelaphi owuqonda kahle umsebenzi wakhe.Uveze nokuthi bakhona nabanye besifazane abangayitholi imisebenzi ngenxa yezinkinga zesinyama nemisamo yabo. Uthe akumele imbokodo yazi ukuthi ukuya kubalaphi akuchazi ukuthi kukhona okubi abasuke sebekwenza kodwa ukusukumela impilo engcono futhi engenazo izihibe.Uthe abesifazane abazithola benezinkinga ezahlukene uyabakhuthaza ukuthi bangasondela kuyena abaxazululele.UMvelase ujwayele ukuzwakala emsakazweni Igagai FM, ekhuluma ngezinto ezahlukene ezithinta indlela yokwelapha ngesintu nendlela yokusebenzisa amakhambi esintu ngendlela efanele.
UMENGAMELI we-ANC, uCyril Ramaphosa, usakubabaza namanje ukugqemeka kwe-ANC udume lwengozi KwaZulu-Natal, ngesikhathi kunokhetho lwangoMeyi nonyana.URamaphosa ukufanise nokuhlangabezana nezimbila zithutha okwehlela i-ANC KwaZulu-Natal.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi eseMgungundlovu, lapho ebezohlangana khona nezinhlaka zeqembu.URamaphosa uqale wahlangana nobuholi be-ANC esifundeni iMoses Mabhida, wahlangana nabaholi be-ANC abajutshwe komasipala, wabe esegcina ngokuhlangana nabaholi abaqhamuka emagatsheni.Kule mihlangano bekubukwa imiphumela yokhetho.I-ANC ayizange yenze kahle KwaZulu-Natal njengoba yasuka ekubeni yiqembu eliphethe ngokuzimela, yaba iqembu lesithathu ngobukhulu.URamaphosa uthe imiphumela yokhetho olwedlule ibadumazile."Amavoti esiwatholile ehle kakhulu, ikakhulukazi lapha KwaZulu-Natal.”Abaholi be-ANC kuzwelonke bebephume kuzo zonke izinkalo zesifundazwe, behambe bekhuluma namalungu enhlangano.USihlalo we-ANC, uMnuz Gwede Mantashe, ubesesifundeni iJosiah Gumede, iPhini likaNobhala, uNkk Nomvula Mokonyane, belisesifundeni iMusa Dladla, uMgcinimafa Jikelele, uDkt Gwen Ramokgopa, yena ubesesifundeni i-General Gizenga Mpanza.URamaphosa uthe inhloso yale mihlangano ukuqinisa izinhlaka zeqembu."Sifuna ukuzinikeza kahle isikhathi, sibuke ukuthi ikuphi esingazange sikwenze kahle ngesikhathi kunokhetho. Lena iyona ndlela esizokwazi ukuqinisa ngayo amagatsha e-ANC futhi ezokwenza ukuthi sikwazi ukwakha kabusha i-ANC.”Okhulumela i-ANC, uMnuz Zuko Godlimpi, uphinde waphebeza amahlebezi okuthi kunezinhlelo zokuhlakaza ubuholi be-ANC KwaZulu-Natal.UGodlimpi uthe isigungu esiphezulu kwi-ANC asikaze sithathe isinqumo sokuthi kuhlakazwe ubuholi be-ANC KwaZulu-Natal.Amahlebezi okuhlakazwa kobuholi besifundazwe awaqali manje, ngesikhathi kubhekwe okhethweni kwakunamahlebezi okuthi ubuholi buzohlakazwa.Aphinde aqala phansi amahlebezi emva kokumenyezelwa kwemiphumela yokhetho."Njengoba silapha sizolalela abaholi bamagatsha. Asikwazi nje ukuvele sivuke ekuseni, bese sithi sihlakaza ubuholi besifundazwe. Sekungaba ke abaholi bamagatsha abangakhuluma leyo nto uma kuwukuthi iyona nto abayibona ifanelwe ukwenzeka.”UGodlimpi uthe basazohambela nezinye izifundazwe, abezokugcina lapha KwaZulu-Natal.Namhlanje ubuholi be-ANC kuzwelonke buzokuba nomhlangano nesigungu esiphezulu saKwaZulu-Natal.USihlalo we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Siboniso Duma, uthe uhambo lobuholi lubalulekile ikakhulukazi njengoba sekusondele ukhetho lohulumeni basekhaya oluzokuba ngo-2026.
UMBUSO uchaze uMphrofethi Paseka "Mboro” Motsoeneng njengomuntu oyingozi, ongumkhohlisi futhi ongakufanele ukudedelwa ngebheyiili ngoba lokho kuzobeka impilo yofakazi neyezingane engcupheni.UMbuso usho kanje eNkantolo yeMantshi yase-Palm Ridge, ngoMsombuluko, uphikisa isicelo sebheyili esifakwe uMboro nababili aboshwe nabo.Kungene osukwini lesibili ukulalelwa kwalesicelo sebheyili, lapho uMbuso uthe uMboro unike inkantolo ikheli elingekho, akwaziwa uhlala kuphi nezimpahla anazo."Uqambe amanga wathi akabazi ofakazi edukisa inkantolo. Uyabazi ofakazi ababili ugogo wezingane no-anti wazo. Kunencwadi yenkantolo yesikhashana eshoyo ukuthi izingane kumele zihlale koninalume kuze kuphothulwe umdonswano okhona kodwa bona baya esikoleni bayozithumba bephula umthetho wenkantolo,” kusho umshushisi.UMbuso uthe uMboro uma ededelwa angalibalekela icala ngoba akaziwa uhlala kuphi, unikezele ikheli elingekho.Bathi ayikho impahla anayo eyaziwayo futhi ukudedelwa kwakhe kungaphazamisa inhlalo enhle yomphakathi.Ukulalelwa kwesicelo sebheyili kuzoqhubeka emuva kwekhefu lamadina.UMboro ubelokhe ekhuleke njalo ngesikhathi kuqhubeka ukulalelwa kwesicelo sakhe sebheyili. Ubebuye ahlahle amehlo akhombise ukumangala uma kukhona okushiwo uMbuso ngaye.Uboshwe nendodana yakhe nomqaphi emuva kwesigameko lapho baya esikoleni basabisa othisha ngocelemba nangesibhamu. UMboro nonogada wakhe wancishwe ibheyili, bazogqunywa esitokisini kuze kube yinyanga kaMfumfu lapho kuzoqulwa khona leli cala.
KUSHONE abasolwa ngobugebengu abathathu kubo okukhona nephoyisa ngesikhathi betholele phezulu namaphoyisa eNtuzuma, eThekwini, ngeSonto.Ngokuthola kwaleli phephandaba, abasolwa kuthiwa babambe inkunzi isitolo e-Richmond ekuseni izolo. Amaphoyisa athola umkhondo wokuthi bacashe eNtuzuma, okuthe uma efika lapho kade becashe khona bavulela ngenhlanvu bebhekise emaphoyiseni, nawo aphendula ngayo. Baphume bebaleka beqa uthango lomuzi ebebehleli kuwo amaphoyisa abajaha. Ababili basala lapho, abayisikhombisa babaleka. Ngemuva kwesikhashana, kubikwe ukuthi amaphoyisa abalandelile abafica komunye umuzi ebese becashe kuwo badubula amaphoyisa aphindisela kwafa umsolwa oyiphoyisa. UKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLt General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, uthe kulaba basolwa ababili abadutshulelwe emzini wokuqala eduze koyedwa kutholakale ivesti evikela inhlamvu nekepisi lamaphoyisa nesibhamu sephoyisa ebelihambisana nezigebengu elishonile, okutholakele ukuthi lisebenza esiteshini samaphoyisa KwaMashu.INQWABA yezimoto zamaphoyisa ebezikake umuzi wokuqala oseNtuzuma, okuthiwa izigebengu ezintathu ezidutshulwe zafa ngesikhathi zitholene phezulu namaphoyisa bezicashe kuwo ISITHOMBE: PHILI MJOLI "Ngaphakathi endlini kutholakale izingubo zamaphoyisa ezehlukene esicabanga ukuthi iphoyisa yilo ebelisiza izigebengu ngazo. Imoto yaleli phoyisa okungeyona eyomsebenzi nayo itholakele kulo muzi," kuchaza uMkhwanazi.Umuzi wokuqala abasolwa ngobugebengu abaficwe kuwo kuthiwa owomsolwa oboshelwe amacala ehlukene obugebengu, ongaphandle ngebheyili okusolakala ukuthi naye ubeyingxenye yabasolwa ababalekile.Amaphoyisa aveze ukuthi sebebonke abasolwa bebeyisishiyagalolunye.Ngaphandle komuzi bekugcwele umphakathi obubuka, obuthi awubonanga lutho futhi awuzwanga lutho uma ubuzwa ngamaphoyisa nezintatheli ngokwenzekile, yize amaphoyisa ethi ububukele abasolwa bebaleka.Omunye womakhelwane obengekho ngesikhathi kudubulana amaphoyisa nabasolwa, uze wazincama wabuza kuwo amaphoyisa, omakhelwane bakhe bonke bethi abazi ukuthi kungani kuhenqiwe kungasavumelekile ukuthi adlule aye emzini wakhe.UMkhwanazi uthe abasolwa ababili abakazi ukuthi bangobani nokuthi akhona yini amanye amacala abayamaniswa nawo. Uthe emakhukhwini abasolwa bekukhona amavawusha ama-airtime nawokugembula okusolwa ukuthi bawathathe esitolo abasibambe inkunzi."Uzakwethu ubesebenza ebusuku, esikhundleni sokuthi ekuseni aye ekhaya ayolala, uhambe wayokwenza ubugebengu. Ngiphoxeke kakhulu ngalesi senzo kodwa angimzweli ngokuthi ugcine eseshona ngale ndlela. Kuyishwa ukuthi maningi amaphoyisa athinteka ezenzweni zobugebengu. Umphakathi kuba lula ukuthi uvule uma kufika iphoyisa lifake umfaniswano. Uma nawo esebandakanyeka ezenzweni ezinje kuzokwenza umphakathi ungabe usazi ukuthi uthembele kubani," kusho uMkhwanazi.
OWESILISA usabuzwa namanje ubuhlungu bokubulawelwa udadewabo okwenzeka ngoJulayi 2018, eneminyaka engu-18, mhlazane bengenelwa kubo yizigebengu zibaphanga KwaSithebe, eSundumbili.Lokhu kuvele esitatimendeni esifundelwe iNkantolo yesiFunda yaseShowe ephethe ngokuthi igwebe uSiphiwe Kweyama (28) udilikajele ngecala lokubulala neminyaka nengu-15 ngokuphanga kusetshenziswa udlame.Inkantolo ithole uKweyama njengomuntu ongasakufanele ukuphatha isibhamu impilo yakhe yonke.UKweyama nayekade egebenga nabo, omunye wabo owathelwa othulini ngenhlamvu amaphoyisa egoloza ukuboshwa, bagqekeza kubo kwabagilwa.Ngokusho kophiko lwezokushushisa i-National Prosecuting Authority (NPA) KwaZulu-Natal kwashona intombazane eyayineminyaka engu-18.Okhulumela i-NPA, uNkk Natasha Ramkisson-Kara, uthe ngobusuku bangoJulayi 13, izelamani zazikubo ngesikhathi zithelekelwa uKweyama nayekade ehamba nabo.Kuthiwa baphanga iselula yowesilisa bemkhombe ngesibhamu."Bamqhuba umgilwa bamyisa endlini kanina ekhona egcekeni. Bazenza amaphoyisa bangena ngaphakathi, bavulela isibhaxu kubantu ababesendlini bebafuna imali,” kusho uNkk Ramkisson-Kara.Kuvela ukuthi kwakumnyama endlini ababekuyona abahlaseli sebewucimile ugesi abagilwa bekhihla esikaNandi.Kuvela ukuthi uKweyama wayemi phandle, elokhe eyalela ozakwabo ababesendlini ukuthi abenze isiqiniseko sokuthi abagilwa abawubangi umsindo owawuzovusa omakhelwane.I-NPA ithe ngalesi sikhathi, umufi walizwa izwi likaKweyama wase eyasho ukuthi uyalazi futhi kabawona amaphoyisa."Ngaphambi kokwenzeka kwesigameko, uKweyama wake wazama ukushela umufi. Omunye wababekade behamba noKweyama wabe esedubula umufi amahlandla amathathu maqede badla phansi,” kuchaza i-NPA.UKweyama waboshwa emuva kwesonto neselula kamufi. Kuvela ukuthi enye yamadoda ayekade ehamba nawo kwenzeka isigameko yashona idubulalana namaphoyisa ayezama ukuyibopha.Emaphepheni asenkantolo umgilwa, uthe yashintsha unomphela impilo yakhe kusukela kwenzeka isehlo."Mina nomndeni wami sizizwa singasaphephile ekhaya. Isabuya le nto emqondweni wami ngibe namaphupho amabi. Umama wayekhungatheke kakhulu ngokushona kukadadewethu, wagcina edlulile emhlabeni,” kusho umgilwa.I-NPA ikwamukele ukushushiswa ngempumelelo kukaKweyama, yathi isigwebo iyathemba sizosiza ukunqanda abanye abebekade besahlela ukugila imigilingwane.
UMNDENI wowesifazane oshayiswe imoto washona ufuna lijeze iphoyisa elimshayise, labaleka ngoLwesihlanu ePhoenix, eThekwini.UNksz Phumla "Thini” Mtshali (28) ushonele emgwaqweni uPhoenix Highway lapho kwenzeke khona isigameko.Udadewabo, uNksz Phili Mtshali, uthe isigameko senzeke phakathi kuka-1 no-2 entathakusa ngoLwesihlanu.Uthe ngesikhathi udadewabo ehlelwa yingozi ubehamba nesoka lakhe, elithumele umyalezo ngomakhelwane abadlule ngemoto endaweni yesigameko esephangalele.UNksz Mtshali uthe abakutholile ukuthi udadewabo ushayiswe yiphoyisa ebelihamba ngemoto labe selibaleka."Libonile ukuthi limshayise kabi, labona kungcono ukuthi libaleke. Sithole ukuthi kuthe uma lifika ndawana thize, labona ukuthi inombolo yemoto yangaphambili, iwile endaweni yesigameko ngesikhathi lishayisa udadewethu. Lithumele omunye umuntu ukuthi ayoyicosha,” kusho uNksz Mtshali.Nokho uthe, lokhu kwenzeke emva kwendaba njengoba bese kufike inkampani yonogada, yathatha izithombe zayo."Sithe sizwa, kwakuthiwa imoto seliyibike njengeyebiwe emzini walo esiteshini samaphoyisa ePhoenix. Sizwa kuthiwa libike ngoLwesihlanu ngabo-10 ekuseni, emva kokwebiwa kwayo ngoLwesine ebusuku ngabo-11,” kusho uNksz Mtshali.Uthe okwenza basole ukuthi ukubikwa kwayo njengeyebiwe kuyindlela yokugwema icala ukuthi kungani kuthathe isikhathi eside kangaka ukuthi liyibike njengelahlekile."Libalekeleni endaweni yesigameko, laphinde lathumela umuntu ukuthi azolanda i-number plate yemoto ebiwile? Izigebengu bezingeke zizikhathaze ngalokho, uma ibiyebiwe ngempela,” kubuza uNksz Mtshali.Uphinde wathi baxakwa ukuthi uma kungukuthi beyebiwe ngempela imoto, yini ebisayifuna endaweni yasePhoenix emva kwamahora amathathu yebiwe njengoba udadewabo imshayise phakathi kuka-1 no-2 entathakusa.Uphinde waveza nokuthi kuthe uma bebuza ngephoyisa kwathiwa livamile ukushayela libukhile.Ukhale ngokuthi umufi ushiye izingane ezimbili ezisencane njengoba enye ineminyaka emithathu, enye ineyisishiyagalolunye.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa asePhoenix avule icala lokubulala ngokungenhloso ukuze liphenywe."Lokhu kuza emva kwesigameko lapho obehamba ngezinyawo eshayiswe yimoto yamaphoyisa engaphansi kophiko lwezokuphepha lwasendlunkulu. Kuthiwa umshayeli wehlulekile ukuma, emgwaqweni uPhoenix Highway ngoLwesihlanu, umgilwa wafela endaweni yesigameko,” kusho uNetshiunda.Uqhube wathi imoto eyenze ingozi itholwe isilahliwe esimobeni.Uthe imoto efanayo ibikwe njengentshontshiwe lapho ebikhona ngoLwesine ebusuku. Wathi icala lokwebiwa kwayo liyaphenywa."Uphenyo lokuthi ubani obeyishayela ngesikhathi yenza ingozi luyaqhubeka,” kusho uNetshiunda.
'AKUSIBO bonke abantu abathanda ukufunda izincwadi, kanti futhi nezinto eziningi ziyashintsha ngakho kusemqoka ukuhambisana nesikhathi ukuze ubuciko bukusebenzele.’Isho kanjalo imbongi, uMbali Malimela, ekhuluma emcimbini wokucobelela ababhali besifazane ngolwazi lokuchuma kwezokubhala, iYoung Writers Women Symposium, eWushwini Pan African Centre, KwaNgcolosi, ngoLwesihlanu emini.Kulo mcimbi obuwenziwe okwesibili nonyaka, bekuhlangene amaciko asebasha esifazane ukucotshelelwa ngolwazi lokusiza achume ebucikweni obehlukene okuhambisaa nokubhala.UMbali owaziwa ngokubhala, akhiphe izinkondlo zesiZulu, ezenza kahle kakhulu online, ubecebisa izihambeli ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe besimanje ukusabalalisa umsebenzi wazo.Uthe nababhali asebeshicilele izincwadi zabo kungabasiza ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe besimanje ukusabalalisa umsebenzi wabo wobuciko ebantwini abaningi."Into enhle ngezitolo zobuchwepheshe wukuthi zenza kube lula ukufinyelelelisa umsebenzi wakho ezindaweni ezahlukene, umhlaba wonke jikelele, futhi kungakusiza nawe osuvele unezincwadi, uzenze zibe nama-audio, ukusiza ukwandisa amakhasimende abantu abangathandi ukufunda, kodwa abangakujabulela ukulalela umsebenzi wakho,” usho kanje.Omunye wababhali nongumshicileli wezincwadi, uZikhona Myaka, yena ucebise izihambeli ngokumele zikwenze nokumele zikugweme uma zizoshicilela izincwadi, ikakhulu uma zisaqala. Uxwayise ababhali abasafufusa ukuqaphela ukuthi baqoka yiphi inkampani ukushicilela umsebenzi wabo, ukusiza ukugwema ukuthi kube lula ukwebiwa komsebenzi wabo ngosomathuba."Yenza ucwaningo ngenkampani ozoshicilela kuyona, ubheke ukuthi isebenza ngayiphi imibandela nokuthi iyahambisana yini nawe ngaphambi kokwenza isivumelwano. Kuyasiza nokuthi uqhathanise ukusebenza kwezinkampani namanini omsebenzi, ukuze uqoke ehambisana nawe. Okumqoka wukukhuthalela ukufunda ukuze uzochuma ngokubhala, usho kanje.Kuwo futhi lo mcimbi, kwethulwe incwadi ka-Amanda Khomo, esihloko sithi Hurt: Losing A Loved One. UFUNA uzimpendulo nobulungiswa umndeni wowesilisa waseMangethe, eMandeni, ogwini olusenyakatho yaKwaZulu-Natal, odutshulwe wumlisa owaziwayo endaweni, wafela egcekeni kubo ngoLwesine ekuseni.Ilungu lomndeni kamufi, uFanele Mpanza (22), obaziwa ngoKela, elingathandanga ukudalulwa ngoba lisabela ukuphepha kwalo nomndeni walo, lithe lishaqeke kwaphela nasozwaneni ngenkathi lizwa lezi zindaba lisemsebenzini eThekwini.Lilandisa Isolezwe ngokwenzekile, lithe umufi obebamba amatoho ezinkampanini zokupheka KwaDukuza, ubevakashile ekhaya ngenkathi kwenzeka lesi sigameko."Umzali womshana wami ubesendlini ekuseni ngesikhathi ezwa impikiswano yamazwi egcekeni, waphuthuma khona ukuyozwa ukuthi ingane yakhe ixabana nobani. Kuthe ephuma phandle wazithela kumshana wami exhakathiswe ingalo yilo mlisa owaziwayo endaweni, obephethe isibhamu, kukhona abaphikisana ngakho, okungazwakalanga kahle ukuthi bebethini. "Kuthe uma umzali ebuza ukuthi kwenzenjani, umshana wami waphunyula kulo mlisa wabaleka eshona ezansi komuzi, wavele wamdubula kwesingezansi nangenhla ngemuva, waphelela khona lapho egcekeni kubuka umzali wakhe,” kusho owomndeni.Eqhuba, uthe kuthiwa kuthe bembuza ukuthi uyidubulelani ingane, wankwankwaza qede wasuka lapho washaya wachitha, eshiya umfana esethule egcekeni kwabo."Kuyasikhathaza ukuthi kungani engakaboshwa namanje ngoba wumuntu owaziwayo endaweni futhi phezu kwakho konke lokho sifuna asichazele ukuthi uze ubulala ingane kamfowethu ngesihluku esingaka nje bekwenzenjani. Yingane lena, uma ngabe beyonile bekumele asichazele kahle ukuthi yoneni, uma kuyinto esengalungiseka sizame ukuyilungisa kahle,’’ usho kanje.Uthe kumanje banovalo ngoba abaqondi ukuthi isenzo salo mlisa ngebesiqondene nomufi kuphela yini noma usazobuya futhi azoqotha wonke umndeni ukucisha ubufakazi."Njengoba ngikhuluma nawe nje angizange ngibuthi quthu ubuthongo ngenxa yokwesaba futhi okunye okubuhlungu wukuthi umshana wami ushiye izingane ezintathu emhlabeni, ezisencane nezisamdinga ukuzikhulisa,” kubalisa owomndeni.POLICE COMMENT HERE

NKOSIKHONA CELEIPHOYISA lasoSizweni Police Station, eNewcastle, ngokubambisana nohlaka olulwa nobugebengu kule ndawo, seliqale umkhankaso wokuxwayisa abelaphi bendabuko ngobungozi bokusebenzisana nezinswelaboya.UWarrant Officer Sipho Mlungisi Zondi, okumsukumise phansi wukwanda kwezigameko zezigebengu okuthi uma zibanjwa zikade zigila imikhuba yobugebengu, zitholwe nemithi ezisuke ziyilande kubelaphi bendabuko.Ubale namabhande eziwabophela ezingalweni, ezikholwa wukuthi ayazivikela uma sezigila imikhuba. uZondi uthi lokhu kuveza ngokusobala ukuthi kungakanani ukusebenzisana phakathi kwabelaphi bendabuko nezinswelaboya okuyinto athi isiqala ukubakhathaza kakhulu.''Sesitholile ukuthi izigebengu eziningi zihamba kakhulu kubelaphi bendabuko uma kukhona ezizokwenza okungukuganga. Sikholwa ukuthi uma abelaphi bendabuko benganciphisa ukuzilekelela izinswelaboya, kungancipha nobugebengu kule ndawo,'' usho kanje uwarrant.Uthe lo mkhankaso uwuqala ngokubiza ukhukhulelangoqo womhlangano abize kuwo nabelaphi bendabuko. Lo mhlangano uzoba ngo-Agasti 30, ehholo lomphakathi eNewcastle. Uthe inhloso ukubaqwashisa ngokuthi uma benza lokhu, okanye uma isigebengu siyibalile inyanga, nayo iba mdibi munye nalobo bugebengu obusuke benziwe.Ngaphandle kokuba yiphoyisa, uZondi uyisishoshovu esilwa nobugebengu kule ndawo. Ugcizelele ukuthi igxathu lokuqala lokunqanda lesi simo ukuxoxisana nabelaphi bendabuko."Kulo mhlangano sizobaqwashisa abelaphi bendabuko ngobungozi bokusebenzisana kakhulu nezinswelaboya. Siyethemba ukuthi lo mhlangano uzoletha ushintsho olukhulu mayelana nobugebengu kule ndawo esikuyona,’’ usho kanje.Uthe bayafisa nokuthi izinhlangano eziphethe abelaphi bendabuko nazo zisondele ukuze kuzotholakala ikhambi kule ngwadla abazithola bebhekene nayo kule ndawo.Uthe kuningi okunye okuhlabahlosile abazobhunga ngakho kulo mhlangano.Isolezwe Ngempelasonto kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi ngaphambilini lake labika kabanzi ngezigameko zokwanda kobugebengu kule ndawo.Laveza ukuthi sekunamaqembu ehlukene ezinswelaboya ahlalise lubhojozi umphakathi wakule ndawo.

UNGQONGQOSHE kagesi ezweni uMnuz uKgosientsho Ramokgopa, umemezele ukuhoxiswa kwenqubo efakwe emqulwini kahulumeni, igazethi yesigaba 34 eyavula ithuba lokukhiqizwa kukagesi wenuzi kuleli."Ngiyayihoxisa igazethi ukuze ngivumele umphakathi ithuba lokuthi ubambe iqhaza,” kusho uRamokgopa.Lolu hlelo luyingxenye yezinhlelo zokukhiqizwa kukagesi wezwe ngesikhathi esizayo uhulumeni asebenzela phezu kwazo ngaphansi kohlelo lwezinsiza oludidiyelwe -2019, i-Intergrated Resource Plan 2019. Ngokwalolu hlelo, u-2500MW womthamo kagesi ozophehlwa kusetshenziswa inuzi.Echaza ngohlelo uRamokgopa, uthe badinga ukubeka lolu hlelo ekutheni umphakathi ubambe iqhaza ukuze konke okwenziwayo kube sobala.URamokgopa uthe iNational Energy Regulator of South Africa (Nersa), yehlulekile ukwenza izingxoxo eziphelele mayelana nokuqalwa kanye nezindlela zokwenziwa kohlelo lukagesi, okuholele ekutheni kube nezinselelo zezomthetho. Kukhona abathile abakhala ngokungalandelwa kahle kwezinhlelo zokuqala uhlelo."Abebefake izikhalo bebethi uMnyango usubuya nombiko wokuthi uzohlangabezana kanjani nemibandela esikhundleni sokuthi iNersa ilungise eyakwenza yokuthi izihlelele yodwa. Bathi yayinesibopho sokudalula konke ngalolu hlelo ngombiko enawo ngesimo esingenzeka nesingeke senzeke uma kwenziwa lolu hlelo. "Ngithe kwabakhalazayo, sinomthwalo wokuqinisekisa ukuthi uhlelo esilwenzayo umphakathi uyakwazi ukuluhlaziya, ugxeke ngokwakha kuhlanganisana nakho ukubheka isimo esingenaso isiqiniseko saso (suspensive condition)," kusho uRamokgopa.Uqhube wathi uyavumelana nokushiwo abakhalazo ngokuthi iNersa bekumele ifake uhlelo enkundleni ezovumela ukuthi umphakathi ubambe iqhaza."Esingakufuni ukwakha phezu kwezinsolo zokuthi umnyango nohulumeni kukhona abakufihlela umphakathi. Ukuhoxiswa kwegazethi kuwukuqinisekisa ukuthi uhlelo luhlanzekile futhi lusobala. Yebo, ikhona inhlawulo oyikhokhayo ngenxa ngokubambezeleka kohlelo kodwa siyajabula ukulibazisa ukuze sivumele umphakathi ukuthi ube nezwi. Uhlelo luzolibaziseka ngezinyanga eziphakathi kwezintathu kuya kweziyisithupha," kusho uRamakgopa.
IZELAMANI zakwaNdimande ezithinteka ekubulaweni komrepha, uKiernan 'AKA’ Forbes, nomngani wakhe, uTebello 'Tibz’ Motsoane, kulindeleke ukuba zibuyiselwe eNingizimu Afrika kungekudala.Lokhu kwenzeke emuva kokwenqaba amahlandla amaningi kwalezi zelamani, oMnuz Malusi noSiyabonga, ukubuyiselwa kuleli, besuswa eSwatini. INkantolo yeMantshi yaKwaManzini, eSwatini, ngoLwesihlanu isamukele isicelo sokubuyisela laba basolwa kuleli. Okwamanje akukacaci ukuthi bazobuya nini.USiyabonga noMalusi bazojoyina oMnuz Thabani Mkhwanazi, uLindani Ndimande, uSiyanda Myeza, uMziwethemba Gwabeni noLindokuhle Ndimande uma sebebuyela eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini. Laba basolwa bayathinteka nasekubulaweni kukaMntimande Kunene, uNhlanhla Ngcobo noZamokuhle Mkhwanazi, okuyizigameko ezenzeka eManzimtoti naseBerea, eThekwini.Khonamanjalo, laba abanye abasolwa basagqunywe esitokisini saseNingizimu Afrika emuva kokunqatshelwa ibheyili.U-AKA noTibz badutshulwa babulawa bephuma eWish Restaurant kuFlorida Road, eThekwini.
UBOSHWE enkantolo ngesikhathi ezovela ngelinye icala uBonginkosi Khanyile (34) wabekwa icala lokuphula umthetho ovimba ukuhlangana kwabantu ngaphandle kwemvume nelokubopha itulo lokugovuza umphakathi ukuba uvuke udlambedlu.OKlebe okuyibo ababophe uKhanyile bathe ukuboshwa kukaKhanyile kusukela enkulumeni ayenze ngoMashi nonyaka eGoli.Kuthiwa inkulumo kaKhanyile yayiphambene nomthetho iRiotous Assemblies Act.Uboshwa nje uKhanyile uvele ungaphandle ngebheyili ka-R5 000 ngecala elithinta izibhelu zomtapo zangoJulayi 2021 abelivelele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini ngoLwesihlanu.Okhulumela oKlebe kuzwelonke, uColonel Katlego Mogale, uthe inkulumo kaKhanyile yayihlose ukugovuza umphakathi ukuthi ubhikishe futhi ube nodlame uma iqembu lakhe lezepolitiki lingekho ohlwini layezovotelwa."Lenkulumo yayinencazelo ethi izakhamuzi kumele zihlangane bese ziyatapa njengoba kwenzeka ngoJulayi 2021. Icala livulwe esiteshini samaphoyisa saseBrixton,” kusho uCol Mogale.Uthe uKhanyile uphinde wadedelwa ngebheyili uzobuyela enkantolo ngoSepthemba 23 nonyaka ngawo wonke amacala athweswe wona.Kuthiwa uKhanyile wathi ngeke lube khona ukhetho eNingizimu Afrika uma kususwa iqembu lakhe uMkhonto weSizwe Party nomholi walo uMnuz Jacob Zuma.
ABE-EFF abaziwa ngokweseka umholi weMK, uJacob Zuma, baphika ukuthi bazolandela obeyiphini likamengameli we-EFF, uMnuz Floyd Shivambu, osejoyine iMK.Amalungu ePhalamende, uMnuz Carl Niehuas no-Advocate Busisiwe Mkhwebane, bachithe amahlebezi okuthi bazolaxaza i-EFF.UNiehaus waziwa ngokuba phambili ekwesekeni uZuma, u-Advocate Mkhwebane uthathwa njengomuntu ozwelana noZuma.Amahlebezi okuthi bazojoyina iMK aqale ukubhebhetheka ngoLwesine ngesikhathi kuvela izindaba zokuthi uShivambu uyashiya kwi-EFF.Umholi we-EFF, uMnuz Julius Malema, ukushilo ukuthi bakulindele ukuthi kukhona abathembekile kuShivambu abazohamba naye. Nokho uNiehaus no-Advocate Mkhwebane bathe bazoqhubeka bayibambe kwi-EFF.UNiehaus uthe akakuphuphi ngisho elele ebusuku ukushiya i-EFF.Advocate Busisiwe Mkhwebane Isithombe: Jeffrey Abrahams"Ngizoqhubeka nokuba ilungu le-EFF elethembekile. Namanje ngisasho ukuthi i-EFF iyona kuphela elwela izinguquko kwezomthetho. Ngakho ngizoqhubeka nokusebenzela iqembu ngokwethembeka.”UNiehaus uthe ngempelasonto uzokube ekhankasela i-EFF eGoli, lapho kuzokuba nokhetho lokuchibiyela.UNiehaus ugxeke nesenzo sokhulumela inhlangano kaZuma engenzi nzuzo, iJacob G Zuma Foundation, uMnuz Mzwanele Manyi, oshiye kwi-EFF, noShivambu, wajoyina iMK.UNiehaus uthe uManyi bekungafanele ashiye i-EFF kabuhlungu kanje."I-EFF yakuthatha ngesikhathi ubhekene nezinkinga empilweni yakho, yakufukamela. Iyona ndlela obabonga ngayo le?”U-Advocate Mkhwebane uthe ngeke ayishiye i-EFF, wayibiza ngekhaya lakhe. "Angisoze ngiphoxe amalungu e-EFF.”UMnuz Carl Nihaus nomholi we-EFF uMnuz Julius Malema Isithombe: XUdaba lokushiya kukaShivambu kwi-EFF luyaqhubeka nokuba segudwini, abaningi babona isigameko sizohlukanisa phakathi i-EFF.Nokho inhlangano yabafundi edlelana ne-EFF, i-EFF Students Command, inxuse amalungu enhlangano ukuba ehlise amaphaphu.Unobhala wenhlangano, uMnuz Khanya Bungane, unxuse amalungu eqembu ukuba angavumi ukuphazanyiswa ilesehlo."Njengoba sibheke okhethweni lobuholi basezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme, sinxusa ukuthi kube nobumbano. Abafundi ayikho enye inhlangano abayaziyo ngaphandle kwe-EFF. Lesi yisikhathi sokuthi sikhankase, akusona isikhathi sokuthi silahle ithemba.”UBungane uthe bayakholelwa ebuholini bukaMalema."Kufanele ngazo zonke izikhathi sihlale sigade labo abafuna ukudala uqhekeko. Kufanele siyivikele ngakho konke esinakho i-EFF.”
KUWUJABULISILE umndeni wowesifazane owagwazwa wabulawa enxanxatheleni yezitolo i-Gateway umsolwa elaxaza ukufaka isicelo sebheyili.Umsolwa uMnuz Siphamandla Khumalo (34) obevele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini, izolo, ubhekene necala okugwaza abulale unina wezingane zakhe uNksz Nomfundo Msibi (30) ngo-Agasti 4.Ngesikhathi evela ngo-Agasti 6, wayekade etshele ummeli wakhe, uMnuz Ntando Cele, ukuthi uzofaka isicelo sebheyili ngoLwesine.Nokho ushaye ungqimphothwe esethi ibheyili akasayifuni.Umfowabo kamufi, uMnuz Halalisani Mbatha, uthe kubajabulise kakhulu bewumndeni okwenziwe umsolwa."Sisola ukuthi ubebona vele ukuthi ngeke ayinuke ibheyili uma kubhekwa isihluku asenzile ngesikhathi ebulala udadewethu,” kusho uMbatha.Ubuye wathi babona nokuthi ubuyile umqondo kuyena ukuthi wenza into embi kunina wezingane zakhe."Ubone kahle ukuthi awukho umphakathi azokwazi ukuhlala kuwo emva kokwenza isigameko esinyantisa igazi,” kusho uMbatha.Imantshi uMnuz Ashwin Singh ilihlehlisele u-Okthoba 1, nonyaka, icala ukuze kuqhubeke uphenyo. Uthe ngalelo langa, uyobe esesho ukuthi lizoqhubeka eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini noma ledluliselwa eNkantolo yesiFunda.Kuthiwa umufi wayesemalile umsolwa kodwa engafuni nokuyizwa leyo.Kuvela ukuthi umufi ubeseshintshe izindawo zokuhlala izikhawu ezintathu, ezama ukubalekela umsolwa.Ngosuku olwandulela olwesigameko kuthiwa umsolwa wavusa indaba ye-lay-by ayeyithume umufi ezinyangeni ezintathu ezedlule.Kuthiwa wathi ucela ayomkhiphela yona ngoba uyayidinga.Kubikwa ukuthi umufi wayengazizwa kahle ngalokhu kodwa waya ngenkolelo yokuthi, uma eseyikhiphile, umsolwa uzoyeka ukumlandela.Kuthiwa umufi wacela ukuthi umsolwa athumele umuntu, angazizeli yena, kwathi yena (umufi) wacela ukuphelezelwa umngani, ezizwa engaphephile.Kuvela ukuthi umufi wathi uma efika e-Gateway wathola ukuthi umsolwa uze nomfowabo, waqala ukumhilizisa eseyikhiphile e-lay-by, esethi uyogibela erenki yamatekisi, wagwaza wafela endaweni yesigameko.Enkantolo umsolwa uvele edlubhe ijakhethi empunga, elokhu ebeke isandla esibhandishiwe ebusweni. Kuthiwa walimala ngesikhathi eboshwa. Ibikhona yomibili imindeni enkantolo, okamufi nokamsolwa.Umufi nomsolwa bebenezingane ezimbili, eyashona ineminyaka eyisikhombisa, nephilayo eneminyaka eyisihlanu.
UMISE ummeli wakhe ekhala ngokuthi umba eqolo owesilisa ongumsolwa wesibili ecaleni lokubulawa kwabantu abangu-15.UMnuz Thalente Mkhize (33) utokile eWestville nomngani wakhe okuthiwa babeqotha naye abantu, uMnuz Sibonelo "Madanone" Shangase (33).NgoLwesine eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini uMkhize uveze ukuthi useyamkhulula ummeli wakhe, u-Advocate Nkatha abemkhokhela ngoba akasenayo imali yokumkhokhela.Inkantolo igunyaze ukuthi atholelwe ummeli wamahhala.Laba ababili basolwa ngokubulala abantu ezindaweni ezehlukene ngezikhathi ezehlukene eminyakeni eyedlule.Phakathi kwezigameko abasolwa ngokuba ongqondongqondo kuzona kubalwa nesokubulawa kwabantu abayisithupha esenzeka eMawoti, eNanda ngo-2002.Kuleso sigameko kwadutshulwa kwabulawa oMnuz Wandile Fanaphi (17), Qaphelani Mkhovu (20), Mlondi Getane (22), Mlondi Kunene (25), Phillip Hansa (25) noLindo Sphambo (22).UFanaphi noMkhovu kuvele ukuthi babefunda u-matric ngesikhathi bedutshulwa. Lezi zinkabi ziphinde zisolwe nangokuthi yizona ezabulala usomabhizinisi wase-Overport, uMnuz Zeyn Moideeb, owadutshulwa emgwaqweni, uBrickfield ngo-2022.Basolwa nangokuthi baphinde badubula babulala umakhelwane walo somabhizinisi, uShaheed Moodel.Ngo-2021 kuthiwa bathumba, uMnuz Phakamani Cwele bamsusa eNanda bayombulalela KwaDabeka.Basolwa nangokuthi yibona ababulala uMnuz Nhlanhla Goge, eNanda, ngo-Agasti 7, 2021.Kuthiwa yibona futhi ababa ngongqondongqondo ekubulaweni kukaMnuz Njabulo Bongani Shongwe noMnuz Zolani Goodman Mbuthuma okuthiwa kwenzeka eNanda, ngoSepthemba 2, 2021.Kuvela nokuthi kunesinye isigameko lapho babamba khona inkunzi kuhlonyiwe eThekwini bantshontsha imali engu-R144 000.Bakhalelwa ngamasongo kaSigonyela ngo-2022 ngesikhathi bebanjwa ngamaphoyisa bedlula eMarriannhill Toll Plaza.Kuvela ukuthi bazama nokubulala owesilisa wakwaSibisi ohlala eNtuzuma.Icala lihlehliselwe u-Agast 29 ukuze uMkhize athole omunye ummeli.
LIQINISE isikimu salo ePhalamende iqembu Umkhonto weSizwe, ngokuhlabana ngofishi omkhulu osuka kwi-EFF uMnuz Floyd Shivambu, obeyiphini likamengameli kuleli qembu.Kunezinkulumo zokuthi maningi namanye amalungu e-EFF angase ahambe noShivambu njengoba noMnuz Mzwanele Manyi, okhulumela iJacob Zuma Foundation, elandele uShivambu wajoyina i-MK.I-MK iqinisa iskimu sayo nje kunezikhala ezingu-18 ezivulekile emva kokuhoxisa amalungu ayo ePhalamende.Umhlaziyi wezepolitiki, uMnuz Zakhele Ndlovu ozinze eNyuvesi yaKwaZulu-Natal, nomkhulumeli we-MK uMnuz Nhlamulo Ndhlela, bathe uShivambu uza namava ezepolitiki nobuhlakani obuzokhulisa leli qembu.UNdlovu uthe i-EFF igqemeke udume ngokushiywa nguShivambu, ongomunye wabasunguli beqembu eminyakeni engu-11 edlule, wathi umholi we-EFF, uMnuz Julius Malema, kumele azinuke amakhwapha ngokuhamba kukaShivambu, kanjalo nabanye abasazohamba."UShivambu ubonile ukuthi alikho ikusasa kwi-EFF ehlelwe wukwesekwa yadlulwa yi-MK esanda kusungulwa ngokwamavoti nangokwesekwa. Bekungekho ukukhula kuyena ngoba i-EFF istokfela sikaMalema ngakho ubengeke abe ngumengameli. Uyigqeme ingozi i-EFF ngokuyishiya kanti izuze kakhulu i-MK ngokuyoqinisa isikimu sayo ikakhulu ePhalamende.”UNdlovu uthe akangabazi ukuthi namanye amalungu okubalwa uMnuz Carl Niehaus, owaziwayo ngokweseka uZuma angashiya noma yinini."Noma i-EFF izobakhona kodwa ngeke isakhula. UMalema uluhlaza, akakwazi ukusebenza nabantu. Ushiywe umngani omkhulu wakhe abengazitsheli ukuthi angahamba. Akungimangazanga ukuhamba kwakhe kodwa ngoba kumele ngabe lesi sinqumo kade asithatha,” kusho uNdlovu.Omunye umhlaziyi uMnuz Nkosikhulule Nyembezi ekhuluma neSABC, uthe ukushiya kukaShivambu nabanye kusho ukukhula kwentando yeningi kuleli.Uthe uShivambu kunamathuba okukhulisa iqembu i-MK alifake nakwezinye izifundazwe."Yisikhathi esinzima lesi obekumele amaqembu angavumi ukulahlekelwa amalungu. Kakade usayosebenza ngaphansi kohlaka lwamaqembu aphikisayo ePhalamende ngakho kufana nokuthi basayokwenza into eyodwa ne-EFF.” UNdhlela uthe bayabamukela oShivambu noManyi, wathi bazoqinisa leli qembu empini yokukhulula abantu kuleli."Bafike ngesikhathi esihle eqenjini lapho siqinisa khona umshikashika wamaqembu aphikisayo. Bazojutshwa ngokwamava abo kanti sibafisela okuhle kodwa ekulweleni abahlwempu,” kusho uNdhlela.Uthe okwamanje basangamalungu wathi ubuholi abukanqumi ukuthi bazojutshwaphi.UShivambu uthe asikho isikhundla asanikwe sona, wathi uzosebenza ukunika umkhombandlela kwi-MK."Asikho isethembiso enginikwe sona yi-MK sokuthi izonginika isikhundla noma ingijube ePhalamende. Isinqumo engisithathile sithinta mina ngqo, sizoqhuba umshikashika wamaqembu aphikisayo ePhalamende.”
UMYENI kaZanele Mbokazi-Nkambule, uMbhishobhi Mpendulo Nkambule, ukhuze abasabalalisa ukuthi umkakhe uthakathwe emsakazweni Ukhozi FM okuholele ekutheni ashone.Lokhu ukusho enkonzweni yesikhumbuzo kaZanele ebisetendeni le-GNF Ministries eDurban Station, ngoLwesine."Abantu abayiyeke le nto yokuthi uZanele uthakathwe emsakazweni Ukhozi FM lapho abesakaza khona. Ubephathene kahle nabo bonke abakulo msakazo kodwa uhlaselwe wumdlavuza okuyiwona othathe impilo yakhe. Nokubuyela emsakazweni Ukhozi FM ubengayiswa wukuthi ufuna imali kodwa ubekuthanda ukuba phambi kombhobho. Iphupho lakhe lokuthi abuyele emsakazweni, ngiyabonga ukuthi uhambe selifezekile. Ngiphinde ngibonge uSbongi (uSbongi Ngcobo ongumphathi woKhozi FM) ukuthi enze leli phupho lifezeke,” kusho uNkambule.Kuvuke umunyu wakhihla isililo uNkambule uma ecabanga ukuphilisana kamanndi noZanele nezingane zakhe athe azikaze zikhombise ukungamhloniphi nangelilodwa ilanga.UDADEWABO kaZanele Mbokazi-Nkambule, uKitty Mbokazi-Zulu othe imphethe kabi indaba yokuthi kukhona omunye womndeni wakhe ohambe emhlabeni ngenxa yomdlavuza Isithombe: SIBONELO NGCOBO"Ngo-2021, ngishonelwe yinqwaba yamalungu omndeni wami ngenxa ye-Covid-19. Kwashona umama, omalume nabafowethu ngesikhathi esifishane. UZanele ube iyona yonke into kumina njengoba ephenduke umama, umngani, udadewethu njengoba kunguyena ebengimkhalela kunzima. Namhlanje ngizwa ubuhlungu obukhulu ukuthi sengishiywe uyena. Bengithi angizokhuluma kodwa ngikhumbula amagama awasho kimina engitshela ukuthi ngizokhuluma futhi ngicule enkonzweni yomngcwabo wakhe,” kusho uNkambule kwehla izinyembezi.Udadewabo kaZanele, uKitty Mbokazi-Zulu, uthe ngesikhathi kushona umama wabo ohambe ngomdlavuza eminyakeni edlule, wakhuleka ukuthi kungaphinde kushone muntu kubo ngale ndlela."Kubuhlungu ukuthi uZanele naye usehambe ngendlela efanayo. Yinto ebengihlala ngiyikhulekela ukuthi ingaphinde yenzeke ekhaya kodwa nakhu sekusiphindile futhi. Ngidiniwe kabi yile nto. Ngicela ngisho nozosiduduza angalokothi esivulela izwi elithi 'Inkosi idinga ithole layo.’ Hawu ingaze izolidinga kuthina sivele sesibancane kanje bebe bebaningi abaseyinqwaba emakubo. Noma kunjalo kodwa siyabonga indlela eniseseke ngayo. Kusuka udadewethu eqalwe wukugula, abantu bebengena bephuma bezosibheka. Ngisho eseshonile udadewethu abantu balokhu bekhombise uthando njalo. Siyabonga kakhulu ngenisenzele kona,” kusho uKitty.USGWILI Zuma noBabo Ngcobo ababonakale benandisa ndawonye ngesikhathi kunenkonzo yesikhumbuzo somngcwabo kaZanele Mbokazi-Nkambule Isithombe: SIBONELO NGCOBOUthe uyabonga nangendlela abebethandana ngayo nombhishobhi njengoba bebambisane kwaze kwaba sekugcineni."Ngikhumbula uZanele ezokwethula umbhishobhi kumina. Ngashaywa wuvalo ngibona lolu ngqwazi lwensizwa. Ngaze ngathi ninezibindi weZanele. Iphinde le ndoda ibe umbhishobi futhi,” usho kanje.Indodakazi kaZanele, uYolanda ibonge ukwesekwa komndeni kusuka unina eqalwa wukugula ezinyangeni ezintathu ezedlule kuze kube yimanje."Umama ubenesibindi enza izinto zenzeke. Nami nginaso isibindi sikama. Ngizoqhubeka lapho egcine khona. Noma kungeke kufike ezingeni lakhe. Silimele kakhulu ngokuhamba kwakhe ngoba impilo yethu ngeke isefana nesikhathi esekhona kodwa impilo izoqhubeka,” kusho uYolanda.Enye indodakazi kaZanele, uNonjabulo ithe bayajabula ukuthi banoyise onguMbhishobhi Nkambule kanti nodadewabo kanina uKitty usekhona.Kule nkonzo bekugcwele kunyinyitheka kuphume nesinedolo. Abaculi bowokholo baphinde babhonga emsaneni ngokuthi banikele ngenkomo bephelezela uZanele ngayo.Kule nkonzo bekugcwele inqwaba yosaziwayo nabaculi abaduduze ngomculo. Phakathi kwabo singabala o-Ayanda Ntanzi, Dumi Mkokstad, Jumbo, Andile kaMajola, Tira, Ga Ndlela, Thobekile, Sipho Makhabane, Ihhashelimhlophe nonkosikazi walo u-Ebony, Noma Ngoma, usomabhizinisi uThemba Njilo, ababhishobhi nabafundisi bamabandla ehlukene, Lindelani Mkhize, Dudu "Lady D” Khoza, Sbongi Ngcobo woKhozi FM, Zimdollar Biyela, Timothy Myeni, Zulu Pavarotti, nabanye abaningi.Inkonzo yomngcwabo kaZanele izoba se-ICC eThekwini ngoMgqibelo bese efihlwa emathuneni eMarianhill, ePinetown.
INHLANSI yethemba njengoba abamelene nokuqokwa kweSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini, befakwa ethimbeni elijutshwe ukuba lixazulule imibango yobukhosi.Ungoti wezamasiko oseNyuvesi yaKwaZulu-Natal, uthe ukufakwa kwabaphikisa ukuqokwa kweSilo ethimbeni kunikeza ithemba lokuthi uzoxazululeka umbango wesihlalo sobukhosi bukaZulu osudonse iminyaka emithathu.Ithimba elijutshwe ukuba lixazulule imibango yobukhosi limenyenzelwe nguMphathiswa wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, ngoLwesine.Kuleli thimba kukhona abaseNdlunkulu, uMntwana uMathubesizwe ozohola ithimba, uMntwana uMbonisi, uMntwana uMxolisi, uMntwana uVulindlela, noMntwana uLindi.Bonke laba baNtwana bayaphikisana nokuqokwa kweSilo uMisuzulu njengoba abanye baseka uMntwana uSimakade Jackson kaZwelithini, abanye baseka uMntwana uBuzabazi Mbuzeli kaZwelithini.Abanye abasethimbeni uMntwana uThuthukani kaMcwayizeni, iNyosi uBuzetsheni Mdletshe, uMfundisi Hamilton Mbatha noMfundisi Daniel Mthembu.UButhelezi uthe ukuqokwa kwethimba kuzobuyisa uzinzo ezizweni zamakhosi ezigubuzelwe imibango."Isilo esidala uMdlokombane saqala uhlelo lokuthi iNdlunkulu kaZulu ibambe iqhaza lokuxazulula nokudala ukubuyisana lapho kuqubuka khona imibango. Ngethula ithimba labaNtwana baseNdlunkulu abasebenze isikhathi eside noMdlokombane benza lo msebenzi. Ukuzinikela kwabo kuwona kuzoba nomthelela omuhle wokuthula nozinzo ezizweni zamakhosi."Ukwethulwa kwaleli thimba labantwana elihlanganisa nezingwevu ezisebenze neSilo esidala ezindabeni ezithinta ubukhosi, kuzoqinisa kusimamise isakhiwo sobukhosi Kwazulu Natal.”Isimemezelo sishiye imibuzo eminingi, nokho abezindaba abazange banikezwe ithuba lokubuza.USolwazi uNgubane, uthe ukuqokwa kwabantwana abaphikisa ukuqokwa kweSilo kungase kube ikhambi elingaqeda umbango wesihlalo sobukhosi bukaZulu."Ngibona kube ubuchule obukhulu ukuqokwa kwabo, siyethemba ukuthi sekuyisona isixazululo lesi.”UNgubane uthe ukuxazululwa kombango wesihlalo sobukhosi bukaZulu kunganciphisa imibango yobukhosi ekhona esifundazweni."Uma kungalunga phezulu, kuzolunga nakwezinye izindawo. Sihlezi sifisa ukuthi izinkinga zasendlunkulu zilungiswe khona endlunkulu ngoba abaNtwana baseNdlunkulu ibona abazi amasiko. Ezinkantolo abameli babuka imithetho kuphela, abawazi amasiko.”Umbango wesihlalo sobukhosi bukaZulu useNkantolo yokuDluliswa kwamaCala.INkantolo eNkulu ePitoli yachitha isinqumo sikaMengameli uCyril Ramaphosa, sokuvuma ukuqokwa kweSilo, ivuna izicelo ezazifakwe ngabeseka uMntwana uSimakade nabeseka uMntwana uBuzabazi.URamaphosa wabe eseludlulisela phambili udaba.
INDODA eboshewe icala lokubulala 'owashela’ intombi yayo ehostela KwaMashu, inikwe ithuba lokuya esibhedlela iyofuna isiqiniseko sokuthi yalashwa khona mhlazane iphukile.UMnuz Sbongiseni Njabulo Khoza uzoziyela mathupha esibhedlela i-Victoria Mnxenge, ebiyaziwa ngeKing Edward VIII, ayofuna amaphepha okulashwa kwakhe.Uyaphika ukuthi nguye owadubula wabulala uMnuz Sizwe Petros Zungu (40) ngoNovemba 2021, ehostela laKwaMashu.UKhoza watshela iNkantolo yesiFunda yaseNtuzuma efakaza ukuthi wayegodle ukhonkolo ngengalo ephukile, wayengawubamba kanjani umkhono wekati athathe impilo kaZungu?Waphinde wathi ngesikhathi sesigameko wayekade esentombini eMlaza.Imantshi uRavi Pillayi, ngoLwesithathu, ikhiphe umyalelo wokuthi umphenyi wecala ayofaka isicelo sokukhipha uKhanyile ejele laseWestville bese eya naye esibhedlela.Kuvele nokuthi uKhoza usemelwe ummeli omusha yize icala selifike ngasemaphethweni. Lo mmeli ucele ukunikwa isikhathi afunde imininingwane yecala. Sekusele kufakaze udokotela owelapha uKhanyile ephukile obizwe imantshi.UKhoza wayekade efake isicelo sokuthola imininingwane ukuze aqinise ubufakazi bakhe bokuthi akazani nokubulawa kukamufi.UMbuso uyavuma ukuthi uKhoza waphuka futhi walashwa kodwa akwenzekanga ngesikhathi sokubulawa kukamufi. Usola uKhoza ngokuqondanisa izigameko ngenhloso yokuzihlangula.Umfowabo kamufi owabona ebulawa, uMnuz Zubise Zungu, wathi nguKhoza owadubula futhi ngamampunge ukuthi wayephukile efake ukhonkolo.Wachaza umufi njengemvu, eyayinothando lwabantu idabuka KwaMaphumulo, kodwa ehlala ehostela ukuze asondelane nomsebenzi wokuba unogada.Wasola ukuthi umufi wabulawela ukuthi washela owesifazane oyintombi kaKhoza amchaza ngomgulukudu owayesatshwa ehostela negenge yakhe.
INHLANGANO ebhekele abathengi eNingizimu Afrika, iNational Consumer Commission idonse ngendlebe abantu ukuthi babuyisele ezitolo impahla okusuke kuthiwe ayiphephile ngoba ukuqhubeka bayisebenzise kubeka impilo yabo engcupheni.I-NCC iveze ukuthi kusukela ngo-Ephreli 1 kuze kube wuJuni 30 kulo nyaka iwu-20 impahla okucelwe ukuthi abantu bayibuyisele emuva.Kuleyo mpahla kukhona i-peanut butter, shampoo, battery, izinkomishi, amasobho, amaplaki kagesi, i-punching bag esetshenziswa ngamabhokisa, izinsimbi zezimoto okubalwa ezeMercedes Benz, Chery, Ford, Citroen neJeep nokunye."Sithole ukuthi akusibona bonke abantu ababuyisa impahla esisuke sicele ukuthi ibuyiselwe ezitolo. Abanye bayaqhubeka bahlale nayo noma bayisebenzise. Kuyingozi ukwenza lokhu ngoba abakhiqiza lezi zimpahla basuke bethole ukuthi kunobungozi obuthile kuzona. Siye sicacise nasezitatimendeni zethu ukuthi oqhubeka nokusebenzisa leyo mpahla usuke ebeka impilo yakhe engcupheni kokunye angafa nokufa,” kusho iNCC esitatimendeni.Ibalule ukuthi uma kuthiwa abantu ababuyisele into edliwayo emuva kusuke kucacile ukuthi ayisafanele ukudliwa, ngakho ukungayibuyiseli emuva kubeka impilo yoyidlayo engcupheni. Ithe kanjalo nasezimotweni uma kuthiwa azibuyiselwe emagaraji ngoba kunezinsimbi ezingenzi okufanele akufanele kuzitshwe lokhu. Ithe akukho okulahlekela umthengi ngokubuyisela impahla esitolo ngoba usuke ezobuyiselwa imali yakhe bese kuqinisekiswa ukuthi izinkampani zikhiqiza impahla ephephile.I-NCC ithembise ukuthi izokuqapha ngeso lokhozi ukukhiqizwa kwempahla ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi abantu bakuleli basebenzisa imikhiqizo ephephile.
KUTHUNGATHWA amalungu amasha ebhodi lesikhwama sezitshudeni, i-National Students’ Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS), anamava emikhakheni ehlukene aphinde abe neziqu ze-Masters.Lokhu kuvele emqulwini kahulumeni i-Government Gazette, okhishwe nguNgqongqoshe weMfundo ePhakeme, uDkt Nobuhle Nkabane, onxuse umphakathi ukuthi uphakamise amagama abantu abazoba amalungu aleli bhodi.Kulo mqulu kudingeka amalungu angu-18 azohlala kulona iminyaka emine.Inhlangano yezitshudeni i-EFFSC, ifuna abazoba amalungu aleli bhodi baphendule imibuzo esidlangalaleni.Le nhlangano ithe ifuna lonke uhlelo lwenziwe esidlangalaleni ngoba ifuna kunqandwe inkohlakalo."Sifuna abafuna ukuba amalungu basivezele ukuthi bahlela ukuyivikela kanjani imali kahulumeni. Phambilini, ongqongqoshe balo mnyango bebeqoka abantu emakhoneni, abanye abangenawo amava. Yingakho lesi sikhwama sihaqwe yinkohlakalo engaka ingoba bekufakwa obhululu,” kusho i-EFFSC. Ibhodi lalesi sikhwama lahlakazwa ngowayengungqongqoshe womnyango uDkt Blade Nzimande, waqoka umlawuli uMnuz Freeman Nomvalo owehliselwe isikhathi azosihlala kulesi sikhwama njengoba ezogcina ngoDisemba, nonyaka.Kumanje uNomvalo umatasa uhambela izifundazwe ezehlukene lapho ehlanganisa amehlo nabahlinzeka ngezindawo zokuhlala ezikhungweni zemfundo, ethola izinselelo ababhekene nazo.Izinhlangano zezitshudeni ziveze ukuthi azifuni kube nezinxushunxushu uma sekumele kufakwe izicelo zangonyaka ozayo.Zifuna kungabi nokuphazamiseka uma sekuqokwa ibhodi elisha.Emqulwini okhishwe nguDkt Nkabane, amagama abazophakanyiswa kumele afike kuyena ngoSepthemba 3, ngenyanga ezayo.Kumalungu angu-18 ebhodi, angu-13 aqokwa ngungqongqoshe kanti afaka nosihlalo webhodi, amanye aqokwa yibhodi.Kudingeka abe namava emkhakheni wezezimali, owezomthetho, owezesayensi, owezokuphatha, owezobunjiniyela kanjalo nowemfundo ephakeme. Lesi sikhwama sixhasa siphinde siboleke izitshudeni imali yokufunda ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme.Umsebenzi walesi sikhwama ukululeka ungqongqoshe ngezithinta ukuxhaswa kwezitshudeni siphinde senze eminye imisebenzi esiyalelwe yona nguDkt Nkabane.Abaphakamisa amagama abantu kumele bashutheke ne-CV yalabo ababaphakamisayo, nencwadi yabo bevuma ukuphakanyiselwa ebhodini.Bangathumela ku:The Director General: Higher Education and Training, bayibhekise ku: Ms. K Matjane.Bangayiposela ku:Private Bag X 174, Pretoria, 0001.Bangathumela ne-email ku: [email protected]
Iyaqaqamba inhliziyo yomholi we-EFF uMnuz Julius Malema, ngokulaxazwa yiphini likamengameli waleli qembu uMnuz Floyd Shivambu, ojoyine iqembu eliholwa owayengumengameli wezwe uMnuz Jacob Zuma. UMalema ufanise ubuhlungu abuzwile ngokusula kukaShivambu nangesikhathi ezwa ngokudlula emhlabeni kukanina.UShivambu uthumele incwadi yokusula kanti uMalema uthe babe nengxoxo ende naye."Iminjunju engiyizwayo ifana nangesikhathi ngizwa izindaba zokushona kukamama. UFloyd ubengeyena nje umlingani kwezepolitiki kodwa ungumfowethu. Uzohlale engumfowethu futhi naye ngimtshelile ukuthi ukushiya kwi-EFF kufana nokuthi uzishiya yena ngoba ungumsunguli waleli qembu,” kusho uMalema esithangamini nabezindaba izolo lapho obumbona ukuthi udumele ngalesi sigameko.Uveze ukuthi uyazi ukuthi kukhona abanye abazwelana noShivambu, abasazohamba."Kunabanye engibaziyo ukuthi vele bebebhobhe kwi-EFF nakwiMK. Kodwa bengingalindele ukuthi ngingashiywa nguFloyd. Umgomo we-EFF uthi osehambile akaphinde abuyele kwi-EFF kodwa kuFloyd ngiyawushintsha lo mthetho noma yinini wamukelekile uma esefuna ukubuya.” Uthe akananxa neMK ngokuhlwitha uShivambu wathi ngeke bamvimbe umuntu onqume ukuthatha enye indlela.UMalema uchithe nokuthi uShivambu ushiya ngoba bengazwani noma ebefuna ukumphonsela inselelo njengoba kuzoba nengqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi ngasekupheleni konyaka."Belungekho ungabazane ngesikhundla sikaShivambu, nokuthi kukhona abebesisikaza ngejozi. Bakhona engizwe ukuthi bazophonselwa inselelo njengonobhala jikelele uDlamini. Esephini likamengameli angizwanga ukuthi kukhona osisikaza ngejozi kanjalo nokuthi uShivambu ubezongiphonsela inselelo,” kuqhuba uMalema.Uthe ngeke life leli qembu ngokuhamba kukaShivambu."Kuvuleka isahluko esisha futhi siyavivinywa. Amalungu awame isibindi iqembu aliyi ndawo. Noma singahamba kodwa lona lizohlale likhona.”UMalema uthe uyoze afe eyilungu le-EFF."Ibhokisi lami liyobe ligoqwe ngemibala ye-EFF. Angisoze ngajikela abantu abama nami, abanye baze baxoshwa, balahlekelwa yimizi nemisebenzi ngesikhathi bengiseka ngixoshwe kwi-ANC, ngayovula i-EFF.”Uthe ngeke basivale isikhundla sikaShivambu ngoba kubhekwe engqungqutheleni."Uma sifaka umuntu esikhundleni sephini likamengameli kuzosidalela inkinga. Uma engasakhethwa engqungqutheleni kuzoba nesixakaxaka ngoba uzobe ezibona ekhethwa,” kusho uMalema.Encwadini yokusula uShivambu uthe unqume ukungabuvuseleli ubulungu bakhe wathi uyashiya eqenjini futhi uyahoxa kuzona zonke izikhundla nokujutshwa ePhalamende. Uthe akathandi ukukhuluma kakhulu ngeqhaza lakhe kwiMK wathi uyokhuluma ngesikhathi esifanele. Ukuchithile ukuthi ubevakashele eNkandla muva nje eyobonana noZuma.
UMNYANGO wezeMpilo uthi abantu abangatatazeli ngokuthi inhlangano yezempilo emhlabeni, iWorld Health Organisation (WHO) nenhlangano ebhekele izifo e-Afrika, i-Africa Centres for Disease Control (CDC) imemezele iMpox njengesimo esiphuthumayo e-Afrika.UMqondisi-jikelele we-Africa CDC uDkt Jean Kaseya ememezela isimo esiphuthumayo ngeMpox kuleli sonto, uthe kunesidingo esiphuthumayo sokuthi umphakathi womhlaba wonke uthathe izinyathelo ezinqala ukuze kuqedwe lesi sifo. Wathi okungenani angu-13 amazwe ase-Afrika abike ukubheduka kwezifo kulo nyaka.Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMpiloi, uMnuz Foster Mohale, uthe okwamanje asikabi khona isidingo sokuthi umphakathi wakuleli uphakamise amaphaphu ngalolu daba.Uthe iNingizimu Afrika inemithamo eyanele yemithi yokwelapha lesi sifo. Wathi umnyango uthole enye inqwaba ye-Tecovirimat, eyaziwa nangokuthi i-TPOXX, enikelwe yi-WHO, njengengxenye yokwesekwa okuqhubekayo emizameni yokusiza iNingizimu Afrika ukuthi ilawule lesi sifo. "Ukuvikela kungcono kunokwelapha, ngakho abantu akumele bagxile ekusebenziseni izindlela zokuzivikela zokuhlanzeka nokusheshe basukume uma bebona izimpawu noma beke basondelana nabanaleli gciwane," kusho uMohale.INingizimu Afrika isiqinisekise izigameko zabahaqwe ileli gciwane ezingu-24 ezaseGauteng , ezingu-11 ezakwa-KwaZulu-Natal nesisodwa saseWestern Cape. Bathathu abashonile ngenxa yalesi sifo.
KUTHIWA ubesebenzisa iNcwadi eNgcwele ukuxhopha izingane uMfundisi webandla elise-Waterloo, ngase-Verulam, otitinywe kanzima ngabantu emva kokuvela kokuthi ubuye anukubeze ngokocansi abafanyana angumqeqeshi wabo ebholeni.Lo msolwa oneminyaka engu-57, kuthiwa ungeniswe esibhedlela kukubi lapho eluswe khona amaphoyisa. Kuthiwa ithumba ngemikhuba asolelwa kuyo liqhunjuswe omunye wabafana oqunge isibindi wabikela unina ngamanyala enziwa kubo. Kuthe ngoLwesibili ntambama, umphakathi wendawo wamthelekela, usho ukumudla luhlaza. Nakuba usindile yingoba kufike onogada benkampani i-Reaction Unit of South Africa (Rusa).UMnuz Xolani Ngcobo, onguSihlalo wekomiti elibhekelele ukulwa nobugebengu endaweni, uthe omunye wabafana abebeqeqeshwa wumsolwa ubikele unina ngobekwenzeka. Uthe umsolwa ubehlala yedwa ngakho izingane bezimvakashela, ewumuntu ozifundisa ngeBhayibheli nangebhola obekwenza abazali banganaki."Sitshelwe ukuthi uyabaqeqesha ebholeni njengoba eneqembu labafana abancane abaneminyaka engaphansi kuka-10. Abagilwa abane abaphumele obala ngaleso senzo baveze ukuthi uqala ebabhixe ngo-Vaselina ngemuva ngaphambi kokubanukubeza alale nabo. Baveza ukuthi kwesinye isikhathi uyabaphoqa ukuthi bamphulule umphambili, kanti izingane bezisaba ukusho ngoba ubesonga ngokuzenzakalisa,” usho kanje.Umsolwa kuthiwa uqashwe kuMasipala weTheku, kanti lokhu kokufundisa ngeBhayibheli nokuqeqesha ubekwenza ngesikhathi sakhe.UMnuz Prem Balram we-Rusa, uthe ngesikhathi befika umsolwa ubesehlutshulwe konke abekugqokile, esenqunu, abantu besafuna ukuqhubeka nokumshaya."Sithole ukuthi umsolwa lokhu ubesekwenze isikhathi esingangonyaka. Kuthiwa ubeziqhuba izingane ziyiqembu noma ahehe eyodwa, azifakele izidakamizwa bese egila le mikhuba. Kusolwa ukuthi umsolwa phambilini ubeseke waboshelwa icala elifanayo lokudlwengula umfana omncane alenze eMhlasini, kodwa lokhu akukaqinisekiswa,” usho kanje.UNksz S’bo Ngcobo wenhlangano ebhekelele izingane engenzinzuzo, uThingo Crisis, uthe isikhathi esiningi izingane zinukubezwa ngabantu abasuke bethenjiwe."Kubalulekile ukuthi singabazali siqaphele kakhulu izingane zethu, sizinike isikhathi sokukhuluma nazo sizilalele. Noma ngabe ingane yenza ezemidlalo, kubalulekile ukuthi umzali abe nobudlelwano nomqeqeshi, azi futhi ukuthi ingane yakhe idlala kuphi, nini. Kumele ahambe ayoyibuka uma kunemidlalo ukuze uma kukhona okungahambi kahle kuzoba lula ukuthi asheshe asole,” usho kanje.Uthe abazali kumele baqinisekise ukuthi izingane ezidlule kulesi simo ziyakuthola ukwelulekwa ngokomqondo ukuze zingabinakho ukuzenyeza nolaka esikhathini esizayo.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe kuboshwe umsolwa ona-57 ngamacala okudlwengulwa kwabafana abane."Amacala okudlwengula avulwe esiteshini samaphoyisa e-Verulam. Imibiko iveza ukuthi umsolwa ushaywe ngamalungu omphakathi kanti ungaphansi kweso lamaphoyisa esibhedlela,” usho kanje.
BASOLA ukuthi ubulawe ukushumpulwa umphambili owesilisa waKwaDumisa eMzinto, isidumbu sakhe esitholakale emzini abewugada, ngoMsombuluko.UMnuz Mduduzi Mkhize (42) kuthiwa utholwe umfowabo ephaseji lendlu, izinyawo zakhe zingaphakathi egunjini lokugeza, sekuphele izinsuku ezintathu engabonakali.Ekhuluma neSolezwe izolo umfowabo, uMnuz Nkanyiso Ngongoma. uthe umuzi okubulawelwe kuwo umufi owezihlobo ezizinze eThekwini ngokomsebenzi, ezazicele ukuthi azigadele wona.Uthe belungapheli usuku engezanga kubo ezobabona noma ezobheka okuya ngasethunjini."Utholwe yimi emva kokuqaphela ukuthi sekuphele izinsuku ezintathu engezi ukuzosibheka ekhaya sinesalukazi sethu njengenjwayelo. Ngithe uma ngifika khona, ngaqaphela ukuthi umsakazo nethelevishini bekukhalela phezulu. Ngimumemezile, lutho ukusabela,” kulandisa uNgongoma.Uqhube wathi uze waphusha umnyango, wabona ukhiye obujikijelwe kude, wawuqhweba ngenduku, ukuze akwazi ukuvula, angene."Ngiqaphele ukuthi umsakazo nethelevishini bekukhushulwe i-volume yaze yafika ekugcineni,” kulandisa uNgongoma.Uqhube wathi ngaphambi kokuba azithele phezu kwesidumbu sikamfowabo, uqale wakhangwa ngamabhodlela otshwala, amanye esele nobuwuhhafu.UNgongoma uthe ngesikhathi eqhubeka ngephaseji, uzithele kumfowabo elinyaziwe."Ibisekhona impintshisi egcwele igazi, engikholwa ukuthi yiyo esetshenzisiwe ngesikhathi ebulawa. Umphambili wakhe ubungekho, bahambe nawo,” kusho uNgongoma.Uthe okunye akuqaphele iphuphusi elingatheni ekhanda likamufi, athe akakholwa ukuthi libe nomthelela ekufeni kwakhe.Uthe abanalo ulwazi lokuthi ubulawe nini phakathi kwalezi zinsuku angezanga ngazo ekhaya baze banquma ukuyombheka.Uthe okunye okubadidayo ukuthi yisiphi lesi sitha abesenaso, esikhethe ukumbulala ngesihluku esingaka njengoba bemazi njengomuntu ongesona isixhwanguxhwangu."Akasiye nomuntu okhonze abantu noma abangani. Ubezikhonzele ukuchitha isikhathi nathi siwumndeni, engesilo novanzi. Manje siyadideka ukuthi ubani lo omenzakalise ngesihluku esinje, edinwa yini?,” kusho uNgongoma.Ikhansela lendawo, uMnuz Mandlenkosi Phungula, lithe umphakathi usovalweni njengoba sikhona esinye isigameko esicishe sifane nalesi esenzeke emasontweni amathathu edlule."Nakuso kwangenelwa umuntu endlini, wabulawa, wakopolotwa amehlo. Nakuso kwaficwa umsakazo ukhalela phezulu, kusho ukuthi lo muntu usuke engafuni kuzwakale abagilwa bekhala. Umphakathi ukhathazwa ukuthi awazi noma indawo isinomalugaju yini,” kusho uPhungula.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa aseSawoti aphenya icala lokubulala kulandela isigameko sokusokutholwa kowesilisa ebulewe ngoMsombuluko."Isidumbu sikamgilwa sitholwe phansi egumbini lokugeza,” kusho Netshiunda.
LIPHIKA lilala ngomhlane ikhansela le-IFP kuMasipala waseNdumeni elisamisiwe, okuthiwa kuphinde kwatholwa imoto yalo nezinkomo okukholakala ukuthi ezokwebiwa, e-Utrecht ngesonto eledlule.Kuphinde kwaqubuka umsindo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ngesikhathi kunofaka umbhalo othi kuphinde kwatholwa imoto kaMnuz Dumisani Xaba ophinde abewusihlalo we-IFP nomfundisi ebandleni laseChibini, okuvele ukuthi iphinde yatholakala nemfuyo kwebiwa.Ozibiza ngoSizwe Mjibhozi obhale ekhasini elithi IFP IN DIVERSITY 2024/2026/2029, ubhale kanje: "Lisaqhubeka ikhansela laseNdumeni nokungcolisa isithunzi seqembu… Kulokhu ubethumele, kwabanjwa imoto yalo nezinkomo zokwebiwa kwabanjwa nemigulukudu.”UXaba ezihlangula, uthe imoto useyidayisile."Imoto ngiyidayise ngoLwesibili olwedlule. Ngebhadi besingakaqedi ukukhokhelana nobeyithengile ngakho isabiza lapha ekhaya. Ngiqale ukubona udaba ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ngeSonto. Amaphoyisa abekade engithinte ngoLwesihlanu ngalolu daba, ngawazisa ukuthi angisahlanganise lutho nemoto,” usho kanje.Uthe yize kunjalo, yena nomthengi bebengakakhokhelani imali ephelele okuchaza ukuthi imoto isasegameni lakhe, futhi uyena okudingeka ayoyikhipha emaphoyiseni ngoba isabiza yena. Uthe usenqume ukuthi ayigcine uma eseyikhiphile, okungenani abuyisele abemdayisele imali yakhe ngoba ukutholwa kwayo nemfuyo yokwebiwa kungcolisa igama lakhe. UXaba uthe uxhumanile namdayiselile, kodwa naye waziqhathulula ngelokuthi imoto ibihamba umfana wakhe ngoba yena wayithenga nje kodwa akakwazi ukushayela. Kuthiwa kuboshwe abasolwa ababili ngaleli cala..NgoMeyi ubesematheni ngesikhathi imoto abehamba ngayo okuyile esiphinde yaboshwa, ibhadanywa amaphoyisa ilayishe izinkomo ezine zokwebiwa emgwaqweni obheke eDundee, okuvele ukuthi zazintshontshwe eDannhauser.Nakuba Isolezwe belibike ukuthi uXaba naboshwe naye bangaphandle ngebheyili ka- R1 000 futhi kulindeleke ukuthi baphinde bavele ngo-Agasti 28. Kodwa ngesikhathi ethintwa, uveze ukuthi icala abebekwe lona lihoxisiwe emva kokuthi ngoJulayi 18 kuvele umuntu owayeqashe imoto yakhe, okugcine sekuboshwa yena.Ucele ukungaphawuli agxile kulolo daba njengoba ethe usalinde ukuhlangana neqembu bese emva kwalokho ekwazi ukweneka isayidi lakhe kwabezindaba njengoba ekholwa ukuthi igama lakhe lahudulelwa phansi kakhulu.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uColonel Robert Netshiunda uthe kuboshwe abasolwa abathathu abaneminyaka ephakathi kuka-34 no- 45 ngamacala okutholwa nemfuyo eyebiwe, kanti bavele eNkantolo yeMaantshi yase-Utrecht ngoMsombuluko.
AMAPHOYISA aphenya icala lokubulala emuva kwesigameko lapho kudutshulwe ngoyaba lwezinhlamvu kwabulawa owesifazane esigcemeni ka-D, KwaMashu.Kubikwa ukuthi uNksz Nomonde Mkhonza (55) udutshulwe amadoda amabili ngoLwesibili ntambama.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe umufi ubekade enamanxeba amaningi okudutshulwa ekhanda.Uqhube wathi umufi uhlonzwe njengomuntu oshonele endaweni yesigameko.Kwenzeka lokhu nje, elakuleli libungaza inyanga ka-Agasti ethathwa ngokuthi ngeyabantu besifazane kuqhakambiswa amalungelo namagalelo abo.Isolezwe lihoshe ngomthombo walo ukuthi umufi ubesanda kuphuma esangweni wahlaselwa."Uthe uyaphuma nje esangweni emgwaqweni uNtuzuma, wahlaselwa amadoda amabili akade ehlome ngezibhamu amdubula amahlandla amaningi washonela khona lapho,” kusho umthombo.
LIBHEKWE isambane iphoyisa elilahlwe icala lokubulala unkosikazi walo njengoba ummeli walo evumelana noMbuso kwelokuthi kufanele lithole isigwebo esiqinile.Ummeli kaMthokozisi Nene, u-Advocate Shane Matthews, utshele inkantolo ukuthi uNene ufanelwe isigwebo esingaphezu kweseminyaka engu-15 okuyisigwebo esincane kunazo zonke esinganikwa umuntu olahlwe icala lokubulala.UNene ulahlwe icala lokudubula abulale unkosikazi wakhe, uNkk Thobeka Nene, owabulawa ngo-2022 emzini wabo oseNtshanga.INkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu inikeze UMatthews ithuba lokuba ashwelezele uNene ukuba anganikwa isigwebo esiqinile.UMatthews uvele wenza okungajwayelekile, watshela inkantolo ukuthi uNene ufanelwe isigwebo esiqinile."Libi icala olenzile, ufanelwe ukudonsa isikhathi eside, mhlawumbe nodilikajele ukufanele.”Okushiwo UMatthews kuhambisana nokushiwo uMbuso, ocele ukuthi uNene anikwe isigwebo esiqinile.UMatthews uthe nakuba engamele uMbuso kuleli cala, uyakuqonda ukuthi icala elenziwe uNene likhulu kakhulu."Ngike ngezwa uMbuso ubalula ukuthi isigwebo esincane esinikwa umuntu olahlwe icala lokubulala kuba iminyaka engu-15. Umuntu owenze icala elifana naleli ufanele ukuthola isigwebo seminyaka engaphezu kuka-15. Lapha enkantolo sizwe ubufakazi bokuthi umufi wazikhalela, ecela ukuba angabulawa. Sizwile ukuthi wahudulwa phansi.”UMatthews uthe uNene usamile kwelokuthi umsulwa."Ngimcelile ukuthi akazochaza ukuthi kwenzekani ngempela ngosuku lwesigameko, kodwa walokhu emile kwelokuthi umsulwa.”UMbuso ufunde isitatimende sikanina kamufi, uNkk Thandekile Msomi, nesikadadewabo kamufi, uNksz Halala Msomi.Bobabili bacele ukuthi uNene anikezwe isigwebo esiqinile.Bathe bayasaba ukuthi angase abenzakalise uma engasheshe adedelwe.UNkk Msomi uthe kubahlukumezile emiqondweni ukubulawa kwendodakazi yakhe."Izingane ziyasaba noma uzithuma kwenye indlu. Ebusuku sisheshe sivale iminyango ngoba siyasaba. Mina senginenkinga yokuvele ngiwe esithubeni, ngidla imishanguzo ngenxa yokuthi nginenkinga yenhliziyo, ngihlushwa nawushukela.”UNkk Msomi uthe amantombazane amabili azalwa indodakazi yakhe noNene, awenzi kahle esikoleni, wathi useze wabizwa watshelwa ukuthi kufanele abonane nodokotela wengqondo.Enye indodakazi yayineminyaka engu-12 ngesikhathi kubulawa unina, enye yayineminyaka eyisithupha.UNkk Msomi uthe kwaphoqeleka ukuthi abazukulu bakhe bakhishwe esikoleni esizimele ababefunda kuso ngoba wayengasekho umuntu ozobakhokhela.UNene ubefake ikhanda phansi ngesikhathi kuqhubeka icala.Bekulokhu kuzwakala amagama ayiziswana evela kumalungu omphakathi abegcwele enkantolo.UNene uzogwetshwa ngoSepthemba 30.Abebezolalela icala bathe baphoxekile ukuthi uNene akazange agwetshwe izolo, bathi bebejahe ukuzwa ukuthi uzothola isigwebo esingakanani.
KUBUYE ithemba kubekwa usuku okuzoqulwa ngalo icala kunina wengane eyabulawa ngokuklinywa ngentambo yesikhindi eyayisigqokile kwaboshwa uyise wayo.UNksz Nonhlanhla Sibisi, obegajwe injabulo, uthe useyabona ukuthi iyasebenza ingalo yomthetho emuva konyaka nezinyanga eziyisikhombisa kwabulawa uSfundo Sibisi (8).Izolo, iNkantolo yesiFunda yasePinetown ibeke uNovemba 27, ukuthi kuzoqala ngawo kuqulwe icala lokubulala elithweswe uMnuz Siyabonga Innocent Shezi (30).Ngenyanga eyedlule, uShezi wenqatshelwe ibheyili yinkantolo efanayo."Ngizizwa ngikhululekile emoyeni nokuthi ingalo yomthetho imande isebenza ngempela. Amanga okushiwo ummeli kamsolwa uma ethi ingane yaziwela ngesiphongo, ngoba ubufakazi bentambo bukhona,” kusho uNksz Sibisi.Uqhube wathi uma kuwukuthi ingane yawa ngesiphongo, imiphi imizamo ayenza uShezi njengoyise wayo, ukuyihlenga?Ubuze nokuthi uShezi wayekade eyaphi nomufi ehlathini?"Ingoba wayazi ukuthi wayefuna ukwenza into yakhe ayiqede engabonwa muntu. Ingane yayiphuke nomlenze. Ingane yashaywa uyena (uShezi) futhi ngezwa ngothile amxoxela athi kuyena ngesikhathi esebona ukuthi izwela ubuhlungu, wavele wayiphumuza ngokuthi ayiklinye (yashona),” kuchaza uNksz Sibisi.Isidumbu sikamufi satholakala ehlathini eNtshongweni.Ummeli kaShezi uthe ingane yawa yashaywa itshe esiphongweni yashona.Umshushisi, uMnuz Rowen Souls, uthe uzobiza ofakazi abahlanu boMbuso uma sekuqulwa icala.USfundo ushone ngoJanuwari nyakenye. Kwaboshwa uyise ogqunywe ejele laseWestville kusukela ngaleso sikhathi.Phambilini, uNksz Sibisi wathi uShezi wabulala ingane ngoba evova yena kwazise ucu lwalungasahlangani.Khonamanjalo: Kuhlehliselwe uLwesithathu ngesonto elizayo ukwenziwa kwezindlalelo zokuqala kokuqulwa kwecala lokubulala elithweswe uConstable Lungisani Xaba (48).UXaba ubekade evele kule nkantolo izolo ngecala lokubulala unina owayephila nokukhubazeka, uNkk Greta Xaba (81) KwaDabeka, eClermont, ngoMeyi 2022.UMbuso usola ukuthi wamshaya ngeplangwe elalinezipikili waze washona ngosuku lomama lwangalowo nyaka.
ZIYABHIMBA izinto kuSomlomo kuMasipala Abaqulusi, osebhalelwe yiqembu lakhe i-IFP lifuna izincazelo ngenkulumo ayethule kungcwatshwa isishoshovu somphakathi esiyilungu le-EFF kulo masipala.Incwadi eputshukile Isolezwe eliyibonile iqondiswe kuNksz Nonkululeko Ndlela owuSomlomo nekhansela laleli qembu ibhalwe ngoMgqibelo. Le ncwadi imnikeza umnqamulajuqu wezinsuku eziyisikhombisa ukuthi aphendule ngenkulumo ayethule emngcwabeni kaMnuz Simangaliso Zwane, odutshulwe ebangeni elingatheni ukusuka kubo ngabasolwa abangaziwa ngenyanga edlule.Ekhuluma kulo mngcwabo, uNksz Ndlela okukholakala ukuthi kumdonsele amanzi ngomsele, uncome isibindi sikamufi owameseka esedayiswe abakwabo (IFP)."Ngiyamkhumbula, sebengidayisile abakwethu. Amaqembu ezepolitiki anamhlanje ayadayisana, nani niyadayisana, akekho ongcono. Kwakumele ngikhethwe ngibe wusihlalo womama eZululand. Abantu bafaka imisila ngaphansi bonke. Kwaqhamuka amadoda angabafazi athwala amaduku, akhuluma izindaba zabafazi…” washo kanje.Encwadini ebhalwe wunobhala we-IFP ehhovisini layo elikulo masipala, uMnuz Sifiso Danisa, leli qembu lithi inkulumo kaNksz Ndlela ayethula kulo mngcwabo, ifaka iqembu ehlazweni.Bafuna acacise ukuthi inkulumo ayeyethula kulo mngcwabo, wayeyethula njengosomlomo na? Bafuna aveze ukuthi wubani omyalele ukuthi akhulume emngcwabeni egameni leqembu nokuthi umngcwabo wayewuhambele njengomholi weqembu le-IFP okukanye wayezihambele nje.Le ncwadi iveza ukuthi lolu daba lizodluliselwa esigungwini sobuholi obuphezulu be-IFP.Kuthintwa uDanisa (unobhala), ukuqinisekisile ukuthi incwadi nguyena oyibhalile."Beyiqondiswe kusomlomo ngakho anginalo ulwazi lokuthi iputshuke kanjani. Esikudingayo nje ukuthi asicacisele, akuliwa naye. Ngokwehhovisi engikulo, kumele sazi uma umholi ezokhuluma emcimbini othile egameni leqembu. Kodwa ke angifuni kuphawula ngalokhu kakhulu kwazise incwadi seyivele iputshukile nokuyinto engadala umonakalo uma ngingaphawula ngigxile ngayo ngoba kwakungayona incwadi evulelekile,” usho kanje.Ngaphambi kokuthi uZwane adutshulwe, wayekhala ngayekubiza ngenkohlakalo edla lubi kulo masipala. Phakathi kokunye akubhala ekhasini lakhe kwi-Facebook ngaphambi kokuthi abulawe, wayekhala ngokudutshulwa kwesishoshovu okuthiwa besilwela amalungelo abasebenzi kulo masipala uMnuz Sandile Ntshali. Kuthiwa uNtshali wasinda edutshulwa, walimala kabi okuthiwa bakhona ababoshiwe. UZwane wayesola ukuthi uNtshali wayekade elalelwe unyendle ngezinye izikhulu kulo masipala ezamthengela izinkabi. Wayegqugquzela umphakathi ukuthi uphume ngobuningi uyokweseka uNtshali enkantolo ngesikhathi kuvela abasolwa ngokumdubula. Kuthiwa ngesikhathi uZwane edutshulwa, ngayizolo wayekade ehambele leli cala, egqugquzele namanye amalungu omphakathi ayeyingxenye yalo.
UMPHAKATHI waseThornwood, eMariannhill lapho kukhulele khona uZanele Mbokazi-Nkambule, uthi ufe olwembiza ngokushona kwalo msakazi woKhozi FM ophinde abe ngumsunguli wama-SABC Crown Gospel Awards.Yize ebengasahlali endaweni, kuthiwa ubengapheli khona futhi ewusizo emphakathini. Omakhelwane bakhe kule ndawo bathi yize sebezwile ngezindaba zokudlula kwakhe emhlabeni kodwa akekho okholwayo ukuthi akasekho ngempela.UMNUZ Francis Bafana Nkosi othi ubesefana nowomndeni kaZanele Mbokazi-Nkambule njengoba ethi akukho abengamsizi ngakho Isithombe: THOKOZANI NDLOVUUmakhelwane wakhe obesondelene naye kakhulu, uNksz Madlala, uthe balimele kakhulu ngokushona kwakhe."Endaweni ubesiza wonke umuntu. Besazi ukuthi uma uyokhala kuyena ngeke uphume ungalutholanga usizo. Noma ebengahlali la kodwa ubefika njalo. Uma esefikile ubumuzwa ngokuhlabelela izingoma zokholo abingelele bonke omakhelwane. Ubengenendaba ukuthi akakwazi, uma ungowasendaweni udinga usizo ubekunika. Sike saxakwa yisiphepho nezikhukhula la endaweni kuwona lo nyaka, uZanele ufike wanikela ngomatilasi, obhulankethi nokudla emphakathini. "Uma eza ekhaya ubemiswa abantu esaqhamuka phezulu esitobhini ngemoto yakhe bembingelela axoxe nabo aze afike kudala ekhaya ngendlela abeba nesineke ngayo nabantu. Ngisho kunemicimbi emphakathini, awukho umuzi abengezi kuwona elethe isipheko. Bekuhlula ngisho ematasa engezophumelela kodwa ubenza isiqiniseko ukuthi uyasithola isipheko,” kusho uNksz Madlala.Uthe okubajabulisa kakhulu ukuthi uzongcwatshelwa eMariannhill, wathi nasenkonzweni yomngcwabo bazophuma ngobuningi ukuyofihla uZanele. Uthe bebenovalo bezitshela ukuthi ukuthi njengoba eshadile mhlawumbe umyeni wakhe uzomyisa eSwatini, kodwa bayabonga ukuthi amngcwabele la, ukuze bathole ithuba lokuyovalelisa okokugcina kuyena.UMnuz Francis Bafana Nkosi, uthe yena ubesefana nowomndeni kaZanele."Kuningi angisize ngakho uZanele. Njengoba ngingasebenzi nje bengihlala ngiqashwa uyena. Ngike ngahlala iminyaka emibili emzini wakhe e-La Mercy. Ngaya khona engiqashile ukuthi ngiyopenda amahhovisi akhe ngagcina sengihlala khona. Nangesikhathi ethenga umuzi okokuqala ngase-Pavillion wathatha mina nabanye abafowabo ukuthi siyohlala khona ngoba wayekhala ngokuthi uyasaba ukuhlala yedwa khona,” kusho uNkosi.UMnuz Themba Bindela obaziwa njengoninalume kaZanele, uthe uZanele ubengafani namuntu endaweni."Ubenza izimanga nento engajwayelekile. Bekuthi uma kunomcimbi wakhe ongekho la endaweni afisa ukuthi sibe yingxenye yawo, avele asiqashele amatekisi ukuthi asiyise kuwona. Ubengaziphakamisile njengoba ubeshiya ngisho imoto yakhe agibele nathi ematekisini uma siya emcimbini. Obekumangaza besiza sizozijabulela kodwa sothi sesibuya asixhawule ngemali,” kusho uBindela.UZanele ubengowokugcina ezinganeni zakwabo bebahlanu. Omdala kwabo uFelo Mbokazi, alanywe wuQondi, uMdu, uKhethi bese kuba uyena uZanele. Abafowabo abasekho bonke emhlabeni nodadewabo uQondi. Bese kusele yena noKhethi okunguyena osaphila ezinganeni zakwabo.Kuthiwa izingane zabafowabo nabazukulu ubehlala nazo emzini wakhe e-La Mercy kanti ekhaya eThornwood, kusele indodana kamfowabo uCharles Mbokazi abebefikela kuyona bonke uma beze ekhaya.
UBALISA ngobunzima obhekene nabo umndeni wakwaNyathi, eSonyongwane, eMzimkhulu ngemuva kokushona kukababa wekhaya ngesikhathi ebona isidumbu sendodana ebizongcwatshwa. Ubaba wekhaya, uMnuz Bhekithemba Nyathi (64) kuthiwa uvele wawa washona ngoMgqibelo ntambama ngesikhathi kufika isidumbu sendodana yakhe, uMnuz Swelihle Nyathi (27).Kuvela ukuthi indodana yakhe beyisebenzela eFree State ingunogada kwenye inkampani.Kuthiwa ixabane nomngani wayo ogcine ngokuyigwaza yashona. Akucaci ukuthi ingxabano ibimayelana nani.Kuvela ukuthi ubaba ubelokhu ebalise njalo ngokufa kwendodana yakhe ekhala ngokuthi uzoba yini ngozinyobulala wakhe. Kuthiwa ubebalisa ngokuthi indodana yakhe ishone isanda kulobola.Ilungu lomndeni elikhulume neSolezwe, uNkk Nomaswazi Khumalo (uMaNyathi) ongudadewabo omncane kababa wekhaya, uthe bayakweshwama okubehlele."Besisazikhotha amanxeba ngodaba lokufa kwendodana yethu kanti asazi ukuthi kuzolandela uyise. Izinhliziyo zethu ziyathatha ziyabeka futhi ziyabhibha zinjalo nje,’’ usho kanje.Uthe ibethusile kakhulu indlela uyise kamufi ahayize ngayo kungena isidumbu endlini. "Ubungaze ufunge ukuthi kukhala umuntu wesifazane. Besingazi ukuthi usekhala okokugcina,'' kusho uNkk Khumalo.Uthe kuthe eqeda ukuhayiza washayeka phansi akuphelanga mizuzu emingaki wathula. Uthe kumane kwahlwa emini kubona."Indlela okwenzeke ngayo isethusile sonke njengomndeni. Siyazibuza siyaziphendula ukuthi ngempela sivelelwa yini,'' usho kanje.Uthe uqhubekile umngcwabo wendodana ngeSonto. "Njengamanje senza amanye amalungiselelo omunye futhi umngcwabo. Angikaze ngiyibone mina into enjengalena,’’ usho kanje.Uthe okunye abakusolayo ngokuwa kukababa uma ebona kungena ibhokisi lendodana yakhe ukuthi kungenzeka umane wacabanga ngomkakhe okungakapheli ngisho izinyanga ezimbili ebandakanyeke engozini yemoto washona.
UMPHAKATHI wasehostela laKwaMashu ukhala ngobugebengu obuhambisana nokubulawa kwabantu okuthiwa kwenziwa abafana abancane abasatshwayo.Umhlali ocele kugodlwe igama lakhe obona engaphephile, uthe la bafana basiqhumisa umlibe isibhamu kubuka wonke umuntu. "Abafana abasebancane abenza le nto. Sidinga ezokuphepha ziqine, kufakwe amaphoyisa. Izibhamu ziningi ehostela. Kunzima nokukhuluma ngale nto emphakathini ngoba kukhona abantu abagade la bafana ababatshela ukuthi ubani uthini, kubani ngabo,” kusho umhlali.Omunye umhlali, uthe ubugebengu budlangile ehostela awukwazi ukuhamba ukhululeke ebusuku."Ukuhamba nje uphumele phandle, ngisho ubheka umngani noma isihlobo uthuka izanya ngoba usuke uzokhuthuzwa noma uthathelwe izinto oziphethe ulinyazwe,” kusho umhlali.Uthe yizingane ezincane ezihluphayo eziphuma ehostela ziyokwenza ubugebengu.Ulandise wathi emasontweni amabili edlule zidune iloli yotshwala zeza nayo ehostela kwaba umazitapele.Ngesonto eledlule kube esifanayo kudunwa iloli yenyama. Emuva kwalokho uthe akulalwanga izibhamu zaqhuma kwaze kwasa emuva kokuthi kudutshulwe kwafa omunye walaba bafana."Le zingane zinezibhamu. Asihleli kahle ehostela. Ukuba kuya ngami bekuzoba nomahamba nendlwana wesiteshi samaphoyisa ehostela. Uma kuqhuma isibhamu asizwe eseduzane amaphoyisa,” kusho umhlali.Ikhansela lendawo, uMnuz Mzwethu Gwala, lithe inkulu inkinga ekhungethe ihostela futhi wamtshela umphathi wesiteshi samaphoyisa endawo ngokumele kwenziwe yena wenza okwakhe.UGwala uthe watshela umasteshi ukuthi akalande amaphoyisa kazwelonke azotshalwa ehostela ukuze akhuculule izibhamu athe zigcwele."Isixazululo engasinikezwa wumphakathi ukuthi kwenziwe njengasehostela iGlebelands (eMlaza), kulandwe amaphoyisa kazwelonke ngoba awendawo kawanele futhi awanazo izinsiza kusebenza ezanele,” kusho uGwala.UGwala usole umphathi siteshi wathi wakuhlaba inhlali amtshela khona ayekuthunywe umphakathi.Uqhube wathi kunalokho wabiza amakhosi ukuba azokhuluma nabantu kwalandwa nebandla elafika lashiya umkhuleko.UGwala uqhube wathi nsuku zonke kuqhuma isibhamu ehostela KwaMashu, kunezingane ezifunda ezikoleni zamabanga aphansi ezijomba igazi."Kufa abantu abathathu kuya phezulu njalo ngesonto ehostela. La bantu babulawa ngokudutshulwa okukhomba inkinga yezibhamu ehostela,” kusho uGwala.Kwesikabhadakazi ngoLwesine kubikwa ukuthi kudutshulwe kwabulawa ibhungu nomalume walo.Ngeledlule amaphoyisa athe zikhona izinhlelo anazo zokulwa nobugebengu obuhlalise lubhojozi umphakathi emgwaqweni uDumisani Makhaye.Anxenxe abantu ukuthi babike ngobugebengu obenzeka ehostela futhi balekelele amaphoyisa ngemininingwane engaholela ekutheni kunqandwe izigelekeqe.Abe esekhuthaza abantu ukuthi bapheze ukuhamba kulo mgwaqo ngabodwana ebusuku okuyisikhathi okubikwa ukuthi lisuke libhubha ubugebengu.
