Kuthiwa wahlaselwa ngabesilisa abangazange babuze lutho ngesikhathi evula isango.Waphuthunyiswa esibhedlela eSiphingo Medical Towers okuyilapho okwafike kwamenela khona.Ngemuva kwalokho, kwaboshwa inkabi uSipho Ntombela eyayikade isekubhaceni. Le nkabi yagcina seyigeqa amagula enkantolo, yaveza ukuthi yayithunywe nguNkk Faith Ntombela ogane umufi.Wakhalelwa ngamasongo kaSigonyela uNkk Ntombela, kusuka lapho ugqigqa enkantolo.Icala labe selidluliselwa eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini. Emasontweni amabili edlule, enkantolo kwavela ukuthi uNkk Ntombela uyalivuma icala bobabili nenkabi esatshwayo KwaZulu Natal, uKhulani Cele, nayo okwavela ukuthi iyabandakanyeka etulweni lokubulawa kukamufi.UKhumalo naye owaboshwa eyamaniswa naleli cala kwavela ukuthi wayesebenzisana noNkk Ntombela kukhandwa itulo lokubulala umufi.Kuvela ukuthi kumethusile uKhumalo ukuvuma kwalaba icala futhi akazi ukuthi kumele enze njani.Ngaphambilini, inkantolo ike yakhipha isexwayiso esishubile isibhekise ngqo kuKhumalo sokuthi makahlukane nokulokhu enza imizamo yokuxhumana nenkabi engaphakathi ngaleli cala, uSipho Ntombela.Namhlanje, kulindeleke ukuthi kucace ukuthi njengoba laba ababili sebelivuma icala yena uKhumalo uzokwenzanjani.UKhumalo ungaphandle ngebheyili ayithola nyakenye, ngoDisemba, ngesikhathi leli cala lisaqhubeka eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMlaza.Ngaphambilini kwavela ukuthi isibhamu esabulala umufi satholakala sigqitshiwe egcekeni likaKhumalo KwaMaphumulo.
UNUKWA ngokungayibheki imfuyo owesilisa ogcine eshonela esibhedlela, kulandela ukudutshulwa ethi usiza owesifazane otholwe edutshuliwe emotweni eshiywe kanjalo egcekeni lakwakhe eHlane Location, ngoMgqibelo.Kuthiwa lona wesilisa, uMnuz Ntandoyenkosi Langa (53), uhlonzwe njengoseshonile ngesikhathi efika esibhedlela ngosuku lwesigameko.Kulesi sigameko kushone abantu ababili njengoba Isolezwe lithole ukuthi indodana kaLanga angayizali, uMnuz Philasande Chiya (32) yona ishonele endaweni yesigameko.Umthombo ocele ukungadalulwa, uthe uLanga nomnikazi wemoto, oqede ukuyipaka endaweni yesigameko, wacela empunzini, bahlanganiswa yikho ukweba imfuyo.Uthe bayakholwa ukuthi umnikazi wemoto nowesifazane abehamba naye bebehlaselwa ndawana thize, bakhetha ukubalekela kwaLanga."Akavelanga wabalekela emzini angawazi, ubalekele kwamngani wakhe (uLanga) avame ukuhlala naye futhi abanukwa naye ekwebiweni kwemfuyo,” kusho umthombo.Uthe basola ukuthi abahlaseli bebengabasukeli ebebesemotweni kanjalo noLanga, wathi abasola ukuthi ufele into angayazi, wuye uChiya."Naye unkosikazi kaLanga ubazi ngokwenziwa umyeni wakhe ngoba indodana yakhe (uChiya) kuthiwa iye yamtshela unina ukuthi akakhuze usingababa wayo ayeke ukweba imfuyo,” kusho umthombo.Uqhube wathi uChiya waze wengeza nangokuthi unina akawuhlakaze umhlangano wobungani obusuvuthiwe phakathi kukaLanga nomnikazi wemoto.Uthe imfuyo ebiyebiwa, ibihlinzelwa khona endaweni, bese idayiswa."Bekuye kutholakale izinhloko zezinkomo, zisele kanjalo esigangeni, uzwakale umoya wokuthi zihlinzwe yibo, bayozidayisa,” usho kanje.Uphinde umthombo wathi uLanga nomnikazi wemoto bebebuye badobe amalungu omphakathi ukuthi abajoyine ekwebeni imfuyo."Omunye wabo, naye udutshulwe wabulawa ezinyangeni ezine ezedlule, ejahwa ngabantu abangaziwa,” kubeka umthombo.Udalule nokuthi kwayena umnikazi wemoto usesinde kathathu edutshulwa."Abasukelwanga. Ngisho naye lo wesifazane, sisola ukuthi usebenzisana nabo,” Ngesikhathi kwenzeka isigameko, kuthiwa imoto yabonwa uChiya esesitolo sendawo ipaka kubo ebusuku. Kuthiwa washayela ucingo unina emtshela ukuthi akaphume abheke ukuthi kwenzekani. Kuvela ukuthi wathi uma ebheka, wazithela kowesifazane odutshuliwe. Kuthiwa wabiza abantu okukhona kubo nomyeni wakhe nayo indodana eyayisesitolo ukuthi bazosiza nokuyilapho okufike khona abalisa abathathu bavulela ngenhlamvu.Owomndeni, uNksz Bongi Chiya, ethintwa, uthe usazobuza enkosikazini kamufi ukuthi iyathanda yini ukuthi kukhulunywe nabezindaba, wathembisa ukuthi uzobuya entathelini nempendulo.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa ase-Creighton aphenya amacala amabili okubulala nelilodwa lokuzama ukubulala kulandela isigameko sokudutshulwa kubulawe abesilisa ababili eHlane Location."Owesilisa oyedwa uhlonzwe njengoseshonile endaweni yesigameko, abanye bephuthunyiswa esibhedlela ukuyokwelashwa. Owesilisa wesibili, uhlonzwe njengoseshonile naye ngesikhathi efika esibhedlela,” kusho uNetshiunda.

USteyn ugcizelele ngelithi bafonelana.Ngesikhathi kuqala inkantolo uMokgoatlheng ukhiphe isexwayiso esishubile ethi yize noma kusuke kuliwa nokuthi kutholwe iqiniso ngesigameko kodwa akufanele kungabe kusahlonishwana noma kwehliswe isithunzi somuntu.Ubesho ngesigameko sangoLwesibili lapho uMnisi noSteyn beshukane khona kwakuncane indawo, uSteyn wagcina ecela indlela, ethi obesekwenzeka akukhona abekubuyiselwe enkantolo.
KUSOLWA ukuthi bekufunwa owesilisa ofike ngemoto enowesifazane odubulekile eHlane eCentocow, ngokudutshulwa kubulawe abesilisa bendawo bezama ukusiza ngoMgqibelo ebusuku.Endaweni yesigameko kuthiwa kushone uMnuz Philasande Chiya, okuthiwa ubezama ukuhlenga owesifazane obedutshuliwe. NgoMsombuluko kushone owesibili uMnuz Ntandoyenkosi Langa, obephuthunyiswe nabanye ababili esibhedlela, okukhona kubo nowesifazane obeficwe emotweni. Ngokusho komthombo olwazi ukusuka nokuhlala udaba, umufi ushayele unina ucingo ebusuku ngosuku lwesigameko."Umtshele ukuthi ubona kukhona imoto emi ngaphandle egcekeni lakubo, wayalela unina ukuthi aphume ayobheka. Ngaleso sikhathi yena ubesesitolo sendawo,” kusho umthombo.Uqhube wathi, unina kamufi uphume wayoyibheka imoto, wafica kunowesifazane obehleli esihlalweni esiseceleni kwesomshayeli, edutshuliwe."Ubuyisele ucingo endodaneni eyibiza ukuthi ize izomlekelela ngoba emotweni efice owesifazane odutshuliwe, odinga usizo,” kusho umthombo.Uqhube wathi lona wesilisa uze egijima ezosiza, benonina kwase kufika abanye abathathu bendawo."Bebesamsiza lona wesifazane, bembizela nabosizo oluphuthumayo ngesikhathi kufika enye imoto, ebinamadoda amathathu, afike avulela ngenhlamvu kulaba ebebethi bayasiza,” kuqhuba umthombo.Uthe yilapho okugcine kushona khona uChiya, kwathi abanye abathathu baphuthunyiswa esibhedlela.Udalule nokuthi basola ukuthi umuntu obefunwa uthuli owesilisa obeshayela imoto, okuthiwa ucele empunzini emva kokupaka imoto endaweni yesigameko, eshiya owesifazane olimele kuyo.Uphinde wathi bathole ukuthi imoto ibisuka ePlangweni, okuyindawo ekhona eCentocow.Ikhansela lendawo, uMnuz Nhlanhla Dlamini eqinisekisa isigameko, uthe umphakathi usashaqekile nokho wathi abethukile kangako njengoba besola ukuthi abahlaseli bebehlose abebesemotweni. "Nokho izigameko zokudutshulwa kwabantu ewadini seziqala ukusikhathaza, ngoba sezivamile. Ngeledlule emhlangalweni we-war room kuze kwaphakanyiswa indaba yokuthi kusungulwe iCPF," kusho uDlamini. Uveze ukuthi akukaziwa ukuthi umshayeli uphelelephi kanti imoto igcine ithathwe ngamaphoyisa. Imizamo yokuthola umndeni kamufi ayiphumelelanga. Owesifazane otholwe emotweni kuthiwa uphuthunyiswe esibhedlela elimele. Amaphoyisa athunyelelwe imibuzo ngalolu daba kodwa kuze kwashaya isikhathi sokuchicilela engakaphenduli.
UMBIKO wodokotela ovela esibhedlela saseMgungundlovu sabanokukhubazeka ngokwengqondo, i-Fort Napier, uveza ukuthi isebenza kahle ingqondo kaMnuz Thabo Ntokozo Nzimande (31) obhekene necala lokushumpula ngocelemba ikhanda likaninakhulu wase eyaligenda njengebhola.UNzimande utokile eWestville njengoba esolwa ngokubulala uninakhulu, uNkk Betreace de Lange (80) esigamekweni esenzeka ePinetown ngoJuni 7, nonyaka.UNzimande ubekade evele kwithelevishini yasenkantolo kusetshenziswa ubuchwepheshe besimanje yena eseWestville. Icala belikade liqhubeka eNkantolo yeMantshi yasePinetown.Ngaphambilini, icala belihlehlisiwe ukuze inkantolo igcine ithole ukuhlinzekwa ngombiko ogcwele ovele e-Fort Napier.UDkt Shain noDkt Lugongolo kuvele ukuthi yibona ebebehlola ingqondo uNzimande.Izolo, umshushisi uNksz Nomcebo Xulu uveze ukuthi sewubuyile umbiko omayelana nokuhlolwa kwengqondo kaNzimande.Umbiko kuthiwa uveza ukuthi uNzimande uphila saka ekhanda futhi azikho izimpawu ezikhombisa ukuthi kukhona okumphazamisayo. Ugcizelela nokuthi uNzimande angakwazi ukumelana necala.Kuze kufinyelelwe kulesi sigaba sokuthi ahlolwe ingqondo nje uNzimande, yingoba ngaphambilini watshela inkantolo ukuthi akasakhumbuli ukuthi kwenzakalani ngosuku lwesigameko.Nombiko wokuqala kadokotela wase-RK Khan eChartswoth, uveze ukuthi uNzimande akakulungele ukuthi angabhekana necala ngokwesimo sakhe somqondo.Uveze nokuthi uNzimande une-bipolar (isifo sengqondo esenza ukushintshashintsha kwemizwa nendlela abhekana ngayo nempilo) futhi nesigameko akasasikhumbuli.UNzimande utshele imantshi uWendolyine Robinson ukuthi akakhumbuli lutho.Waveza nokuthi usumhlamukile umndeni wakoninalume abekade ehlala nawo egcekeni ngaphambilini.URobinson uthe ukuphuma kwalo mbiko kunikeza umhlahlandlela ogcwele wenqubekela phambili kuleli cala. "Yilo mbiko obubalulekile kakhulu kuleli cala. Kusuka manje sesizoqhubeka senze konke okumele sikwenze kuze kufinyelele esiphethweni secala,’’ usho kanje.Icala lihlehliselwe uSepthemba 10, njengoba kukhona uphenyo okuthiwa lusazoqhubeka mayelana necala.
UKUNGAHOSHELANI kwabomndeni wakwaKhumalo eMsinga, KwaMajozi, esigodini iMazabeko, yikho okusolwa ukuthi kuholele ekuphumeni kwesidumbu, kudutshulwa kufa omunye wabo, kubuka abantu emshadweni emzini wakwaMabaso, endaweni. "Bengingekho kulowo mshado kodwa ngibikelwe ukuthi kube nokuhilizisana phakathi kukaThubelihle nomunye umfana obehamba nabafowabo ababili bozalo. Kuthe engazelele umfana wami, eme kwenye yezimoto ebezisemshadweni, bamdubula esiphundu, edutshulwa womunye wabafowabo kubuka wonke umuntu. Basuke lapho bakhala amaphepha, bemshiya efile. Kumanje bagcwele izinkalo, akwaziwa ukuthi babaleke, bashona kuphi,” kulandisa uKhumalo.Eqhuba, uthe usola ukuthi ukwenzeka kwesigameko bekuvele kuyitulo ebeliboshelwe umufi njengoba bekunezingxabano zomndeni, waveza nokuthi abanye bomndeni bebesola umufi ngokuba yimpimpi yamaphoyisa."Bekusanda kugasela amaphoyisa emzini wabafowabo esibasola ngesigameko, ashaqa izibhamu zabo kubona, ababopha. Ngiyazi futhi ukuthi bekusolwa ukuthi wuyena owabampimpa emaphoyiseni. Bamdubula nje, bebesanda kuphuma ejele ngamacala okutholakala nezibhamu ezingekho emthethweni. Ngisola ukuthi le ndaba isukele lapho,” usho kanje.Uthe kuyamkhathaza ukungahoshelani kwabomndeni wakhe awuchaze ngokuthi wumndeni omkhulu onamalungu amaningi, ngokwehlukana kwezindlu nokuzaleka kwabo."Ukungezwani komndeni wami kuqale ngenkathi kubulawa omunye wabafowethu eGoli, ngoMashi, nonyaka. Uthe yize kunjalo kodwa ukholwa wukuthi kunabathile abajabule ngokumehlele.Kuthintwa okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uConstable Thenjiswa Ngcobo, uthe amaphoyisa aseNhlanhleni, aphenya icala lokubulala mayelana nesigameko sokudutshulwa, kwafa umlisa oneminyaka ewu-25 eMazabeko, eMsinga, ngoMgqibelo.

UMPHAKATHI wasoGunjini, eNdwedwe, uthandazele ibhuloho osekuphele iminyaka lingapheli, ufisa umsebenzi wokulakha usheshe njengoba sekuzoqala imvula yasehlobo.Ibhuloho elibizwa nge-P713 lisoGunjini, eNdwedwe, kanti uma seliqediwe lizohlanganisa umgwaqo osuka esiteshini samaphoyisa eNdwedwe udlule esibhedlela oSindisweni, uze uyongena eVerulam.Ngempelasonto, kube nenkonzo yokukhulekela asebashona ngenxa yezingozi nezimpi ezenzeka eduze kwaleli bhuloho. Siyafisa ukuthi umsebenzi wokulakha usheshe njengoba kusazoza nemvula,” kuchaza uNgcobo.Uthe bahlela enye inkonzo ezohlanganisa nemindeni yabashonelwa nezihlobo, abafisa ukuthi uMnyango wezokuThutha nezinye izinhlaka, zibe yingxenye yayo.
UNGQONGQOSHE kaGesi, uDkt Kgosientsho Ramokgopa, uthi omasipala bakweleta i-Eskom u-R78 billion.URamokgopa uveze lezi zindaba izolo esithangamini sabezindaba ngezinhlelo zokuphehla ugesi."Omasipala bakweleta i-Eskom uR78 billion, bona bakweletwa uR349 billion ngamabhizinisi, iminyango kahulumeni nezakhamuzi ezingawukhokheli ugesi. Sizosebenzisana neSouth African Local Government Association (Salga) ukuqinisekisa ukuthi omasipala bayalekelelwa ukukhokha izikweletu zabo. Kunohlelo lokubasiza olwenziwa wuMnyango weziMali kuzwelonke kodwa sifuna omasipala abazongena kulo bahlonyiswe ngamakhono azobasiza ukuthi bangaphinde bazithole kulesi simo,” kusho uRamokgopa.Uthe u-78% womasipala abangaphansi kohlelo lokuhlela kabusha isikweletu sabo sikagesi abayikhokhi imali okufanele bayikhokhe nyanga zonke. URamokgopa uthe kuzothathwa omasipala ababili abakweleta kakhulu kuzo zonke izifundazwe ukuze baqale uhlelo oluvivinywayo lokubasiza. Bazosebenzisana noNgqongqoshe wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana nezoMdabu, uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa, nezinkampani ezizimele ezizobalekelela.Ukhale ngokuthi uma isimo sokukweletwa kwe-Eskom womasipala singanqandwa manje, kuyoshaya u-2050 sebeyikweleta u-R3.1 trillion.Ube eseveza ukuthi izinhlelo zokulwa nenkinga yokucima kukagesi zihamba kahle njengoba sekuphele izinyanga ezine ugesi ungacimi."Zihamba kahle kakhulu izinhlelo zokuphehla ugesi. Isimo sishintshile eKusile, Majuba naseMatla njengoba lezi ziteshi ziphehla ugesi owanele. Ezinye iziteshi zikagesi ezingasafelwa yimishini njalo yiTutuka, Kendal neKrile. I-Eskom ibithe akufanele ugesi ongekho udlule ku-14 000MW kodwa manje lesi sibalo simi ku-10 508MW. Okuyisimo esihle kakhulu,” kusho uRamokgopa.Yize izinhlelo zokuphehla ugesi zihamba kahle kodwa uRamokgopa uthe lokhu akusho ukuthi seludlulile uhlelo lokucima ugesi ngoba zisekhona izingqinamba.Ubuye waveza ukuthi bazoqinisekisa ukuthi intengo kagesi ayinyuki ngendlela exakile njengoba izinhlelo zokuphehla ugesi sezingconywana kunesimo ezazikuso ngonyaka odlule.Uthembise ababhekene nohlelo lokucinywa kukagesi ukuze kuvikelwe ingqalasizinda, olubizwa nge-load reduction, ukuthi uyalusukumela udaba lwabo.Ubuye wakhala ngokuthi emizini ewu-10 million okufanele ukuthi ithole ugesi wamahhala, iwu-2 million kuphela ehlomulayo.Uthe bazosebenzisana nomasipala ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kuhlomula abantu abaningi futhi basizwe nangama-solar okuziphehlela ugesi welanga. INHLANGANO eyengamele ezempilo emhlabeni jikelele, iWorld Health Organization (WHO), izwakalise ukukhathazeka ngokwenyuka kwesibalo sabaphethwe yi-monkey pox e-Afrika.UMqondisi we-WHO, uDkt Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus ubize umhlangano ophuthumayo ngoba efuna ukwazi ukuthi kufanele yini ukuthi imonkey pox ithathwe njengesifo esihlasele emhlabeni jikelele (international emergency).Uveze ukuthi okumenze wabiza umhlangano wukuthi selokhu imonkey pox yaqubuka eDemocratic Republic of Congo (DRC) ngoSepthemba, ilokhu ivela nakwamanye amazwe alapha e-Afrika. Ngaphambi kokuba ibikwe eDRC ibihlasele emazweni ase-Europe."Umhlangano uzohlala maduzane futhi uzobe usihlanganisa nongoti abazimele bezempilo emhlabeni jikelele. Sifuna ukwazi ukuthi ngabe imonkey pox sesingayithatha njengesifo esihlasele emhlabeni jikelele yini,” kusho uDkt Tedros.Umthetho uthi nguTedros kuphela njengomqondisi we-WHO okwazi ukusho ukuthi isifo sesihlasele emhlabeni jikelele ukuze kulandelwe imithetho ebekwe yile nhlangano yokulwa naleso sifo. UTedros uveze ukuthi kulo nyaka bawu-14 000 abantu abaphethwe yiMpox eDRC kanti bawu-511 esibabulele.Uthe okumkhathazayo wukuthi ngoJulayi kubikwe ukuthi bangaphezu kuka-50 abantu abaphethwe yi-monkey pox eDRC. Kubuye kwabikwa ukuthi bakhona nabanye eBurundi, Kenya, Rwanda, Uganda naseNingizimu Afrika.UMnuz Foster Mohale woMnyango wezeMpilo kuleli, uthe bawu-24 abantu abaphethwe yi-monkey pox eNingizimu Afrika. Abawu-12 base-Gauteng kuthi abawu-11 babe KwaZulu-Natal, oyedwa useWestern Cape.Khonamanjalo iWHO izwakalisa ukukhathazeka ngokwenyuka kwezibalo zabaneCovid-19.UDkt Maria van Kerkhove ongungoti wezifo ezithelelanayo kwi-WHO uthe emazweni awu-84 emhlabeni bathole ukuthi siyanyuka isibalo sabaneCovid emasontweni edlule.Uthe abatholwa benalesi sifo bawu-10% kodwa kuyahluka ngokwamazwekazi (contintents) njengoba e-Europe abatholwa beneCovid-19 bewu-20%.USihlalo we-South African Medical Association, uDkt Mvuyisi Mzukwa, uthe asikho isidingo sokuthi abantu bakuleli basabe."Bancane kakhulu abantu bakuleli abane-Covid-19 ngoba okwamanje basaphethwe wumkhuhlane ojwayelekile,” kusho uDkt Mzukwa.IWHO igqugquzele abanamasosha omzimba antengayo nabasengcupheni yokungenwa kalula yizifo ukuba bagomele iCovid-19.
BATHWALE izandla emakhanda, babalisa abebejutshwe yiqembu i-MK ePhalamende, okumanje banikwe izincwadi ezibaxoshayo ngemuva kwenyanga eyodwa befudukele eKapa.Amalungu angamanye awu-18 i-MK eqinisekise ukuthi iwasusile ePhalamende, athi ebese efudukile benzela ukusondezela umsebenzi omusha. Abanye bese beyekise amakhosikazi imisebenzi, bayekisa izingane ezikoleni nabo besula emisebenzini abebeyenza njengoba bebazi ukuthi bayogxila eKapa, ePhalamende.Bakhala ngabathile kuleli qembu abaxovayo, ababakhiphe ngoba befuna ukufaka izintombi zabo, izihlobo kanjalo nabangani babo. Ayisalanga ngaphandle nendodakazi yomholi waleli qembu uMnuz Jacob Zuma, uNksz Duduzile Zuma-Sambudla, abayikhomba ngenjumbane ukuthi ibhokile ekubulaleni leli qembu abalithandayo.UMHOLI we-MK uMnuz Jacob Zuma Isithombe: XAbanye bebengothisha, abefundisi, ababesebenza eminyangweni kahulumeni ehlukene kanti abanye abaholi bomdabu.Okubakhalisa kakhulu ngukuthi bese bethenge izimoto, bathuthela eKapa nemindeni yabo, okuyizingane kanjalo naphathina babo ababayekise nemisebenzi yabo ukuze bayoqala kabusha impilo eKapa lodumo. Leli qembu limemezele ukuthi lihoxise amalungu angu-18 ePhalamende. La malungu lithe angu-12 awo ayevele azi ukuthi azodeda inkundla emuva kokufungiswa kodwa akhetha ukuqhubeka. Ayisithupha ayengekho ngesikhathi kufungiswa ngenxa yokungaphatheki kahle nangezinye izizathu.Omunye wabaxoshiwe osuka KwaZulu-Natal okhulume neSolezwe wacela ukungavezwa, uthe ibuhlungu into ebehlele wathi akayifiseli ngisho isitha sakhe.Uveze ukuthi izindaba zokuxoshwa kwabo zibafikele besemaqeleni lapho bejutshwe khona ezifundazweni ezehlukene."Siqale ukubona ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ukuthi sixoshiwe. Incwadi ifike ngo-Agasti 7, isuka ePhalamende iveza ukuthi iqembu lithi selihoxise ubulungu bethu. Asikaze sizwe lutho evela eqenjini mayelana nalokhu kuhoxiswa kobulungu. Sithuke soma nesixoshwe nabo ngoba besimatasa sijutshwe kwezinye izifundazwe, senza umsebenzi weqembu.” Ukhale ngokuthi usule lapho ebesebenza khona ngoba eseyosebenza ngokugcwele eKapa."Amanga ukuthi kukhona umuntu owavuma ukufungiswa ebe azi ukuthi uzokhishwa emuva kwenyanga. Abaxova iqembu bafuna ukufaka izintombi zabo, abangani, imindeni yabo kanjalo nezihlobo zabo. Okubuhlungu ngukuthi bayalixova iqembu. Sikhulu isililo, yimbi le nto eyenziwe kubantu nguMkhonto,” kubalisa oxoshiwe.Omunye wabaxoshiwe naye ongeke avezwe, ukhale ngokuthi indodakazi kaZuma iyona eshaya amaphiko."Iyona efaka abangani bayo ezikhundleni ezishiywe yithina. UZuma zinhlanu izikhundla abefuna ukufaka abantu azogadla ngabo abafana noBrian Molefe, Papa Penny, Lucky Montana nabanye. Siwusebenzele uMkhonto kusuka nyakenye wabunjwa. Besikhankasa ngemali yethu, sehla senyuka kuyona yonke imikhankaso kodwa manje sesikhishwa okwezinja.” Uveze ukuthi ngoLwesihlanu abaxhumanisi nabagqugquzeli be-MK eKZN bayile kuZuma eNkandla, lapho behlale khona kwaze kwahlwa, bemkhalela ngezinto eziningi ezingahambi kahle eqenjini."Wabikelwa ngezinkinga zokungabi khona kwezinhlaka ezikhethwe ngokusemthethweni ezenza kube nabazenzela umathanda eqenjini. Ubikelwe nangendodakazi yakhe ebulala iqembu. Sekucacile ukuthi uma ngase iNkosi imkhumbule, i-MK kuyophela ngayo iyofana ne-NFP ne-Cope. Abantu bayayithanda i-MK kodwa uma izinto zenzeka kanje, bazoyiduba.” Abaxoshiwe bathe bazolinda iPhalamende lize libaxoshe."Okwamanje sisathole izincwadi zasePhalamende, elithe asixazulule le nkinga eqenjini noma siye enkantolo. Asikafiki odabeni lokuya enkantolo ngoba sisafuna ukubonana nobaba (Zuma), simbikele. Uma uzama ukuya eNkandla uyavalelwa ngaphandle, kungasa ungangenanga wabonana nomengameli. Asifuni ukuxova iqembu ngoba siyalithanda futhi asingenanga ngopotsho noma ngomkhoshosho ngoba amagama ethu afakwa ohlwini ngendlela eqondile.” Okhulumela i-MK, uMnuz Nhlamulo Ndhlela, esitatimendini uthe lizoqhubeka lusefe ulwandle kwabangena ngomkhoshosho ohlwini lwasePhalamende futhi abahlonizi ngokubakhomba indlela.
UCWANINGO lwenkampani ebolekisa ngemali, iWonga, luveza ukuthi abantu baseNingizimu Afrika sebenciphise imali yokuthenga igilosa ukuze bakwazi ukukhokhela i-medical aid, umshwalense nezokuphepha emizini yabo njengoba izinga lempilo liqombola.Ucwaningo lwenziwe kubantu abawu-4 500 abaneminyaka engaphezu kuka-18.Kuvele ukuthi bayahluleka ukukhokhela ama-credit card nezinye izikweletu. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abakwazi ukonga imali nokongela umhlalaphansi.UMnuz James Williams oyinhloko yezokukhangisa eWonga, uthe inhloso yocwaningo lwabo wukuthola ukuthi abantu baphila kanjani njengoba impilo ibiza."Njengoba impilo ibiza, abantu abasenayo imali yokwenza izidingo zabo. Bayaphoqeleka ukuthi babophe izifociya,” kusho uWilliams.Abantu okukhulunywe nabo kulolu cwaningo u-41% wabantu bahola phakathi kuka-R10 000 no-R25 000 ngenyanga.Kuthiwa bathwele kanzima njengoba besebenzisa u-80% womholo wabo ukukhokhela imizi noma irenti kanti abahola kangconywana basebenzisa u-24% womholo wabo ukwenza lezi zinto.Kuvela ukuthi abahola uR2 500 bona bachitha imali yabo ekuthengeni ukudla nasekuqinisekiseni ukuthi banendawo yokuhlala.Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika abaningi bafuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi banophahla, bayadla, baphile kahle futhi baya ezikoleni ezikahle.Imali eningi iya ekukhokheleni izindlu (24%), i-medical aid (13%), ukudla/igilosa (11%) nasemalini yesikole (10%).UWilliams uthe bancane kakhulu abantu abakwazi ukuya ezibhedlela ezizimele ngoba abaningi kabanayo imali.Kubantu okwenziwe kubona ucwaningo wu-16% kuphela othe ukwazi ukukhokhela i-medical aid futhi bayakhala ngokuthi iyabiza.Okukhathazayo wukuthi abantu bakhale ngokuthi amabhondi nerenti adla imali yabo eningi.UWilliams uthe labo abakhokhela ama-credit cards nezinye izikweletu bathole ukuthi inzalo inyuke ngo-51%, ikakhulukazi kulabo abahola uR2 500."Lokhu kusho ukuthi abantu bacwile ezikweletini futhi bayaphoqeleka ukuboleka imali komashonisa nabanye ababolekisi ngemali abangabhalisiwe ngokusemthethweni,” kuchaza uWilliams.U-84% wabaphendulile uthe imali eningi uyichitha ekuthengeni ukudla, u-54% uthe uyichitha ukukhokhela ugesi kanti uphethroli uthatha u-33% wamaholo."Ukuntenga kwamandla emali kunomthelela omubi njengoba kwenza ukudla kubize, uphethroli onyuka umlibe nogesi obizayo nawo wenza impilo ibize,”kusho uWilliams.Kwabaphendulile ocwaningweni bathe abasathengi izimpahla ezibizayo, abasakwazi ukuzikhipha nokuzijabulisa okuyisibalo esiwu-32%.Bathe baphoqelekile ukunciphisa igilosa abayithenga nyanga zonke nokubopha izifociya.Kuvele ukuthi u-60% wabaphendulile unezingane ezineminyaka engaphansi kuka-21, okufanele bazondle ngo-R971 ngenyanga bengakabali imali yesikole.UWilliams uthe u-10% wabantu abaphendule imibuzo bayaphoqeleka ukuboleka imali ukuze baphile njengoba izindleko zidlula amaholo.Bathe basebenzisa u-90% noma umholo wabo wonke ukuze baphile.U-55% wabantu abaphendulile uthe awukwazi ukonga ikakhulukazi labo abahola kancane.U-59% wabaphendulile uthe awukwazi ukonga imali yomhlalaphansi njengoba abanye bonga u-R1 206 abahola kangcono.Okuthusayo wukuthi abaneminyaka ewu-56 kuya ku-64 abanayo imali abayibekele umhlalaphansi.
ZIHAMBA kahle izinhlelo zokuguqula isimo enkampanini ephehla ugesi kuleli, i-Eskom njengoba imemezele ukuthi isiyonge u-R9.59 billion kwizindleko zikadizili kulo nyaka.UNksz Daphne Mokwena okhulumela i-Eskom uthe bazongile izindleko kudizili njengoba kulo nyaka besasebenzise oka-R3.48 billion kanti ngonyaka odlule ngesikhathi esifanayo base besebenzise oka-R13.07 billion."Zihamba kahle izinhlelo zokuqinisekisa ukuthi i-Eskom isebenza kahle njengoba sikwazile ukonga imali ebesiyisebenzisa kudizili ngo-R9.59 billion,” kusho uNksz Mokwena.I-Eskom ibisebenzisa udizili omningi uma ugesi ucime kungalindelwe ngenxa yokufa kwemishini.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi sekuphele izinsuku eziwu-135 ugesi ungacimi eNingizimu Afrika.Ezindaweni lapho ucima khona kungenxa yohlelo olubizwa nge-load reduction, lapho i-Eskom iphoqeleka ukuthi icime ugesi ukuze ivikele ingqalasizinda.Ngokusho kukaNksz Mokwena, i-load reduction yenzeka kakhulu ezindaweni okuxhunywe kuzo ugesi wezinyokanyoka, ezinemiqasho nezinye esezidinga ugesi omningi kunalowo ingqalasizinda eyayakhelwe ukusabalalisa.Uthe uma ungacimi ugesi ingqalasizinda - okungama-transformer nokunye - ingasha bese kuthatha izinyanga eziningi ukuba ilungiswe. Ngakho ukugwema leso simo baye bacime ugesi ngezikhathi ezithile.

SIBUYELE ekhaya singenamyocu isitshudeni saseBerea Tech obekubikwe ngeledlule ukuthi sekuphele izinsuku sinyamalale endaweni yobumnandi iLondon On 75, Kwa-L KwaMashu.U-Amile Khambule waseMbumbulu kuthiwa ubuyele kubo ngoLwesithathu ntambama.Wayekade ehambe kubo ngo-Agasti 3, ethi uya ebanganini bakhe eVerulam.Ugogo wakhe, uNkk Patience Khambule ekhuluma neSolezwe izolo ukuqinisekisile ukubuya kuka-Amile, wathi umfice ezihlalele ekhaya ebusuku ngoLwesithathu ebuya emsebenzini. UNkk Khambule ubezwakala ukuthi sisamdinile isenzo somzukulu wakhe sokuhamba izinsuku ekhaya engabuyi."Ngithe uma ngimfica ngambuza ukuthi uvelaphi, wathi ubesazihlalele ebumnandini. Ingidinile le ngane. Namanje ayikho into etheni esengiyikhulumile nayo. Akuvumi nje ngikhulume naye,” kusho uNkk Khambule.Uthe akwenza emva kokubuya kwakhe, wamthatha wamyisa esiteshini samaphoyisa eMbumbulu ukuze ayotshela amaphoyisa ukuthi usebuyile kwamathanda nhliziyo.Uthe wabikela amaphoyisa ngokunyamalala kuka-Amile ngoba ekhathazekile, kwazise izigameko zokunyamalala kwabesifazane ziyathusa kulezi zinsuku."Ngangizothini ukungawabikeli amaphoyisa, umuntu engabuyi ngosuku ayethe uzobuya ngalo? Nokho ungifundise isifundo sokuthi uma ephinda elahleka, ngingabe ngisazihlupha,” kusho uNkk Khambule obabaze ukuthi akazi ukuthi umuntu onjani ohlala ebumnandini izinsuku ngezinsuku engagoduki.Ethintwa u-Amile uphendule ngelithi yena ubengalahlekile, wathi iselula yakhe ebilahlekile.Ebuzwa ukuthi iselula yatholwa kumngani nje, owathi umnike yona ngo-Agasti 3, maqede wanyamalala, akabange esezwakala ukuthi uphendula uthini, kuhixiza i-network.Wethembisile ukuthi uzoyiphendula imibuzo Isolezwe elizoyithumela ku-WhatsApp, nokugcine kungenzekanga njengoba ewuzibile umyalezo awuthunyelwe.Isolezwe lalaziswe umnikazi weLondon, uMnuz Xolani Mabanga ngoLwesine ekuseni ukuthi u-Amile ubuyele ekhaya ephephile. Ethintwa izolo uthe okubajabulisayo bona ukuthi u-Amile ubuyele ekhaya ephephile ikakhulukazi njengoba imibiko ebisabalele ibithi uduke endaweni yabo yobumnandi.Uthe imibiko yokunyamalala kwabantu endaweni yobumnandi ibuye ihluphe ngoba uthola ukuthi umuntu usuke engadukile, kodwa ezihlalele, engafuni ukugoduka.
IDUTSHULWE yafela endaweni yesigameko indoda okuthiwa ihlwithe isibhamu sephoyisa ngaphakathi esiteshini, yadubula ibhekise emaphoyiseni kwalimala amathathu.Isigameko esithuse abaningi senzeke ngaphakathi esiteshini samaphoyisa esiseRichmond, ngoMgqibelo.Umsolwa, Isolezwe elithole ngomthombo walo ukuthi ngowase-Harding, kuthiwa ufike kulesi siteshi ezenza umuntu ozovula icala. Ngesikhathi iphoyisa lesifazane lisazama ukumsiza, kuthiwa ugxavune isibhamu salo ebesilenga enqulwini, wadubula ebhekise emaphoyiseni abekhona kwalimala amathathu. Kuthiwa amaphoyisa angenelelile aphendula ngenhlamvu wadubuleka wafela endaweni yesigameko.Umthombo weSolezwe osondelene namaphoyisa aseRichmond, uthe; "Kusolwa ukuthi ubeseke waya esiteshini esise-Harding, wayobika ukuthi kukhona abamlandelayo abafuna ukumbulala, wanxusa amaphoyisa ukuthi amsize ayomcashisa okungenani eXobho, okuyinto okwagcina kungavunyelwene ngayo.” Uthe ukholwa ukuthi kungenzeka ukuthi umsolwa ubezama ukuzibulala ngalesi senzo sakhe kwazise ukugasela esiteshini samaphoyisa ahlwithe isibhamu salo udubule kungenasizathu, kuyizinkomba zokuzimbela igodi kalula.UNksz Kamogelo Mgotsi okhulumela ihhovisi likaNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa kuleli, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, uthe uMchunu ukushayele ihlombe ukungenelela ngokushesha kwamaphoyisa okuholele ekudutshulweni komsolwa.Kwenzeka lokhu nje, kuthe ngalo isonto eledlule ithimba lamaphoyisa esifundeni Umzinyathi, adubula abulala umsolwa okuthiwa udubule wabhekisa ngakuwo ngesikhathi embhadama ephethe isibhamu esingekho emthethweni, erenke eMsinga.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, Colonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe kulimale iphoyisa elilodwa kulesi sigameko."Amaphoyisa abeqeda kubopha umsolwa obefunwa uthuli ngamacala amathathu okubulala enzeke eQulu, eNquthu, obanjwe eMsinga. Ngesikhathi esendleleni ebuyayo, azithele phezu komsolwa obephethe isibhamu erenke okuthe uma esondela ngakuyo wasikhipha wadubula ebhekise ngakuwo, kwadubuleka iphoyisa elilodwa lalimala. Amaphoyisa aphendule ngendlela efanayo wafela endaweni yesigameko,” kusho uNetshiunda.Uthe umsolwa oboshiwe utholwe nesibhamu esikhulu, kanti odutshulwe ngamaphoyisa, utholwe nesibhamu esincane sohlobo lwe-38 special revolver.
UMA uzwa kuthiwa kunowesifazane obulewe yisoka noma ngumyeni, kwabaningi akuseyona into engajwayelekile kwazise ayipheli inyanga kungabanga khona imibiko efuze le. Yize iminingi imibiko yabesifazane ababulawa ngabasuke beshade nabo kodwa muva nje miningi kakhulu eyalabo ababulawa amasoka abasuke benezingane nawo noma abakipite nawo. Bonke basuke begajwe yisikhwele. Kusuke kube nezinsolo zokuthi owesifazane usuke eseqomile noma nje indoda isuke seyaliwa. Lobu bushimane abenziwa ngamadoda aseqinile ngokweminyaka kodwa kubhoke amabhobhodleyana kulo mkhuba onyanyisayo.Isigameko sakamuva nje sokubulawa kowesifazane enxanxatheleni yezitolo eGetaway, yisoka okuvela ukuthi belingafuni ukwaliwa, ngesinye sezibonelo zalezi zindaba ezishiya ezincane izingane zingenabazali kwazise labo yise abasuke bebulele onina bajwayele ukubanjwa baboshwe bagwetshwe.Esinye isigameko ngesowesifazane waseNanda oneminyaka ewu-21, owabulawa yisoka nalo eliselincane lidinwa wukuthi uhambe wangabuya emkipitweni wabo. Uma sekuphenyisiswa kwatholakala ukuthi empeleni lo wesifazane ubebalekele kwadadewabo ngoba esekhathele yisibhaxu salo myeni mbumbulu akipite naye. UKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, ukhale kakhulu ngezigameko zokubulawa kwabesifazane ngamasoka abo kulesi sifundazwe. Uze wakubeka obala nokuthi empeleni nje amadoda aKwaZulu-Natal yiwona enza ukuthi kube khona ubugebengu obuhambisana nokubulawa kwabantu jikelele.Muva nje iNkantolo yeMantshi ePinetown isanda kugixabeza ngeminyaka engu-15 u-Africa Mdabe (31) ngokulahlwa yicala lokubulala intombi yakhe, uThandeka Thwala (26).UMdabe waqongqotha umufi ngegalofu ekhanda washona ngemuva kwezinsuku esibhedlela. Isigameko senzeka ngoNovemba 8, 2019. Isigameko senzeka eQabavu, eNsuze, ngonyaka odlule kodwa uNtombela waze wakhombisa amaphoyisa la agqiba khona umufi sekudlule unyaka.UNONTOBEKO Mkhwanazi owabulawa yisoka lakheNgoNovember 17 ngonyaka owedlule iNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini yagweba udilikajele uSfiso Professor Ndlovu (50) ngecala lokubulala ayethandana naye, uKhulukazi Ndlovu.UNdlovu wayenengwa ukuthi lo wesifazane usethandana nomunye ayesebenza naye. UNdlovu kuthiwa wamthumba umufi wase emshisa nemoto. Naye wayegajwe yisikhwele.UHLOMISILE Mbatha owabulawa yisokala lakhe lase lilahla isidumbu ehlathiniEzinyangeni ezedlule sibe yindaba egudwini isehlakalo sephoyisa ebelisebenzela uMasipala weTheku, uConstable Sizwe Ngema (osezikhindini), ayebonakala kwividiyo ebulala intombi yakhe, uBianca Khuzwayo.Muva nje uMnuz Zimisele Dlulisa (29), ongumpheki, ukhalelwe ngamasongo kaSigonyela esolwa ngokubulala intombi yakhe, uMbali Mokokone (29). INkantolo yeMantshi yaseNtuzuma isanda kumnqabela ibheyili.UMBALI Mokokone owabulawa yisoka lakhe ngokumphihliza ngesitini laphinde lamgwazaUMbhishobhi Thabani Khumalo, wenhlangano yamadoda iSukuma Ndoda Sakhe, ukholwa wukuthi konke lokhu kudalwa yidimoni lolaka emadodeni. Ukhomba ukungafundiseki ngempilo njengento eyinkinga edlulele eyenza nabesifazane bagcine beyizisulu ngale ndlela.Ugxeke nomkhuba wokukipita odla lubi kulezi zinsuku, wathi kwenza amanye amadoda acabange ukuthi ngoba nakhu owesifazane usehlala naye, usefana nonkosikazi."Akugcini lapho, kunanamadoda athi uma esenengane noma enezingane nowesifazane acabange ukuthi sebefana nonkosikazi nendoda. Uma kuke kwathi nkente umuntu abone kufanele ajezise owesifazane ngokumbulala noma ngokumshaya kanzima. Uthe maningi amadoda agcine esebulala amakhosikazi enengwa ukuthi asezibona engelutho emizini yayo ngoba kusebenza amakhosikazi wona engasasebenzi. Ukhulume nangodaba lokuthi amadoda kumele adodiswe, ahambele uchungechunge lwezigcawu zokubhungwa kwezinselelo abhekana nazo."Uma amadoda ehamba lezi zigcawu azokwazi ukuthi umama wengane akuchazi ukuthi usengowakho,’’ usho kanje.UMnuz Sakhile Ngubane, oyiLife Coach, uthi amadoda amaningi adiniwe, anentukuthelo esuka kude."Ngiyazi ukuthi le yinto ehlale ikhulunywa kodwa ngiyayisho, lento yokuthi indoda yikhali iyazona izinto. Lokho kungakhali kwenza kugqibelane intukuthelo eyona izinto. Nokukwazi nje ukuthi uma owesifazane esethe ucu alusalingani, amadoda amaningi anokuzibuka wona acabange ukuthi lokho kusuke kuwaphuca ubudoda bawo. Kumele sifunde ukuthi uma umuntu esethi kuphelile, akuphele. Akukho akukweleta khona. Wayethe uyakuthanda manje akasakuthandi. Angithi thina siyabashiya abesifazane siqonywe ngabanye. Basale bekhala kodwa kudlule,” egcizelela. Ungoti oweluleka ngezomphefumulo, uDkt Cynthia Hafejee, weluleka abesifazane ukuthi bangalubekezeleli ulaka emadodeni."Uma nixabene nesoka lakho, likushaye ngempama noma likwethuke lisho ukukuqeda, musa ukube usahlala kulobo budlelwane. Yizinkomba zokukhulu okuzayo lezo,” usho kanje.Uthe abesifazane okumanje babulawe amasoka, konke kusuke kuqale ekuthukweni nasekushayweni."Kuwumkhuba ongalungile ukuxolela isoka eselike lakushaya....ngisho ngabe likusikaze ngetshe. Lelo litshe ngelinye ilanga liyosuka esandleni lize ngqo ekhanda lakho kuphele ngawe”.
KULINDELEKE ukuthi avele eNkantolo yeMantshi eBloemfontein, uNksz Moroadi Cholota owayengumsizi kaMnuz Ace Magashule ngesikhathi esangundunankulu wase-Free State.UNksz Cholota ufike kuleli ngoLwesine emva kokuboshwa ngohlelo lokulanda abasuke bekwamanye amazwe ukuthi bezobhekana namacala abethweswe wona njengoba kuthiwa ubese United States lapho ebefunda khona. Ngo-2022, uphiko lwezokuShushiswa koMphakathi, i- National Prosecuting Authority yafaka amaphepha kuleliya lizwe ukuthi kubuyiswe lo msolwa ngalolu hlelo emva kokuthi igama lakhe lathinteka enkohlakalweni ka-R255 million kulesiya sifundazwe efaka phakathi negama likaMagashule ogqigqa inkantolo ngecala elifanayo. NgoJuni iNkantolo yesiFunda yaseMaryland kuleliya lizwe, iwamukele amaphepha alolu phiko, athi kunobufakazi obanele. UColonel Nkwalase okhulumela uphiko loKlebe, uthe bangu-18 abasolwa abesebethweswe amacala okubalwa kubo nezinkampani ezinkulu ezinhlanu.
UFUNA ubulungiswa umndeni wowesilisa waseNtinyane, eMbumbulu okwatholakala isidumbu sakhe sinqunywe ikhanda futhi sishisiwe endlini yakhe ngemuva kwengxabano aba nayo nentombi yakhe ethinta abantwana.UMnuz Scelo Dodo Mkhize (42) wabulawa ngoJuni 2022. Kuvela ukuthi isidumbu sakhe satholakala ngemuva kwenyanga.Kuthiwa wayekade ebe nokuhilizisana nayethandana naye kubangwa ukuthi umufi wayefuna ukwenza ulibofuzo lwezingane zakhe ezimbili ayekholwa ngukuthi akusizona ezakhe.Kuthiwa lokhu kwayinenga kakhulu intombi yakhe yakhala ngokuthi isenzo sikamufi simenza abukeke kabi kumalungu omndeni nasemphakathini.Kuvela ukuthi kungakapheli izinyanga ezine kwabe sekutholakala isidumbu sakhe sinqunywe ikhanda futhi sesibolile endlini.Umfowabo kamufi, uMnuz Patrick Mkhize uthe bakhathazekile ngokuthi kuze kube yimanje akekho osaboshiwe mayelana nalesi sehlakalo.Uthe bakholwa wukuthi ukhona ungqondongqondo wetulo lokusocongwa kukamfowabo.Ukhale ngendlela okucwebe ngayo iziziba mayelana nalolu daba, wathi ayibanikezi nje nhlobo ukuthula.Uthe kodwa ngeke baze bathule bagoqe izandla, bazoqhubeka nokufaka ingcindezi emaphoyiseni ukuze kutholakale umnyombo wokusocongwa kukamufi."Sekuqala ukusikhathaza kakhulu manje ukubona kuthuleke kangaka ngendaba yokubulawa kukamfowethu. Asisazi ukuthi senze njani uma kuthuleke kangaka,'' usho kanje.Ngaphambilini amaphoyisa akuqinisekisa ukubulawa kukamufi. Aveza ukuthi kusaqhubeka uphenyo olunzulu ngokubulawa kwakhe.
ZISAZOQHUBEKA izinselelo ezibhekene noMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, zokungavalwa ngesikhathi kwezikhala zothisha, ukungaqashwa konogada, ukungaqashwa kwabahlanza izikole, ukushoda kwezinsiza-kufundisa okubalwa nezincwadi nokungakhokhelwa kwamanzi nogesi ngenxa yokunganeli kwesabelomali nakulo nyaka.Lezi zinkinga zeminyaka ezixake lo Mnyango, zizoqhubeka kunyaka wezimali u-2024/2025 nakuba isabelomali singu-R62.989 billion.Izinyunyana zothisha esifundazweni zihlala zikhala ngokungafakwa ngesikhathi kwemali yezikole, ukungavalwa kwezikhala zothisha abathatha ikhefu, ukushoda kwezinsiza-kufundisa, ukungakhokhelwa ngesikhathi kosonkontileka, nokufeyila ukukhokhela ugesi namanzi ngesikhathi, nangezinye izinkinga ezibhekene noMnyango.Zithi othishanhloko kuze kudingeke ukuthi basebenzise imali yabo ukutakula izikole.Umphathi wezezimali eMnyangweni, uMnuz Lalisingh Rambaran, uthe isimo sisenzima njengoba kusenohlelo lokuthi ingxenye ethile yemali, bengayitholi yonke kuMgcinimafa.Uveze ukuthi ingxenye enkulu yesabelomali iya emaholweni abasebenzi."U-R51 billion uya emaholweni wabasebenzi bese kuthi enye imali iye ezikoleni. Kudingeka sifake izicelo kuMgcinimafa uma kudingeka sivale izikhala ezibalulekile emnyangweni,” usho kanje emhlanganweni wekomiti lezemfundo esiShayamthetho ebelizophasisa lesi sabelomali.Uveze nokuthi kumiswe nezinhlelo ezintsha zokulungiswa kwezikole, ngaphandle kwalezo ezikhahlanyezwe yizimvula nesichotho.Lokhu kusho ukuthi izikole ezidinga ukulungiswa zizothi ukuma kancane ngenxa yezinselelo.Kulo mhlangano, uMphathiswa woMnyango uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka, unxuse ukuthi leli komiti lisebenzisane nelezezimali ukuthi kuyiwe kuMgcinimafa, kuyonxuswa ukuthi achathazele lo Mnyango imali.UHlomuka ubuye waveza eyobugebengu obenzeka ezikoleni kanjalo nezehlakalo zokuhlaselwa kothisha, balinyazelwe emagcekeni ezikole, wathi kudinga ukubambisana kwezinhlaka ezehlukene.Uthe onogada abakhona ezikoleni baqashwe ngumnyango abaqashiwe yizinkampani ezizimele njengoba kunamalungu esiShayamthetho abethi kumele onogada baqashwe ngumnyango.UNksz Hlengiwe Mavimbela we-ANC, uvumelene nombono wokuthi basebenzisane nekomiti lezezimali ukuze kuyiwe kuMgcinimafa kuyonxenxwa ukuthi achathazele lo mnyango imali.Ukhale ngesimo esingesihle sokuthi kuzogqoza ukuhlinzekwa kwamathuluzi okusebenza ezikoleni ekubeni kubhekwe imiphumela ka-matric ekupheleni konyaka.UMnuz Siphiwe Moyo weqembu i-MK, ukhale ngokushoda konogada ezikoleni zesifundazwe nabafundi abangakuqondi abakufundayo uma beqhathaniswa namanye amazwe. I-MK ne-EFF abasesekanga isabelomali, kwathi amanye amaqembu okuyi-ANC, IFP ne-DA baseseka.
LUSAZOQHUBEKA nokusefa ulwandle eqenjini Umkhonto weSizwe, njengoba leli qembu liveze ukuthi lisazogawula izembe kwizithunywa ezangena ngomkhoshosho ohlwini lwabajutshwe ePhalamende.Lokhu kuvezwe ngumkhulumeli waleli qembu uMnuz Nhlamulo Ndhlela, kulandela ukuhoxiswa kwamalungu aleli qembu angu-18 ePhalamende, aphucwe ubulungu yileli qembu.Sekuya ngokwamagama enkehli njengoba umholi waleli qembu uMnuz Jacob Zuma, ubelishumayela elokuthi basazolushintsha uhlu lwabantu abajutshwe ePhalamende.Njalo bekuthi uma ekhankasa akuveze ukuthi kukhona abangena ngomkhoshosho kanti bazokhishwa ohlwini.UNdhlela uthe amalungu ahoxiswe ePhalamende, awaxoshiwe eqenjini."Basangamalungu e-MK ngoba wonke umuntu ojutshiwe uyivolontiya. Abaxoshiwe eqenjini kodwa bahoxiswe ePhalamende. Bangu-18 abakhishwe ohlwini, abangu-12 bafungiswa bazi ukuthi bazokhishwa ohlwini. Abayisithupha abazange bafungiswe ngenxa yezizathu ezehlukene okubalwa ukugula nezinye kanti bonke bahoxisiwe. Sisazoqhubeka sibakhiphe abangene ngomkhoshosho ohlwini,” kusho uNdhlela.Uthe ohlwini, abantu babefaka izihlobo, abangani kanjalo nomakhelwane babo."Besilokhu sisho ukuthi sifuna zonke izinhlaka zomphakathi zimeleleke ePhalamende. Yilokho esizoqhubeka sikwenze. Iningi labahoxisiwe alizange lifike ePhalamende ngelanga elibalulekile, okwakumele kuvotwe ngalo.”Uthe abanye abaholi abavela ohlwini lwabantu abazojutshwa, ababevele beshilo ukuthi bazomela leli qembu ePhalamende basaya."Sinabaholi abafana noMnuz Brian Molefe, Siyabonga Gama, Lucky Montana nabanye. Balinde iPhalamende ukuthi libazise ukuthi bazofungiswa nini. Silandele zonke izinhlelo zangaphakathi eqenjini ukuhoxisa nokujuba amalungu amasha e-MK ePhalamende. Abahoxisiwe baziswa ngalesi sinqumo.”Uveze ukuthi kunozinzo eqenjini, akukho ukuntenga kobuholi."Vele uma usaphemba iqembu kuba nezinkinga kodwa ayikho inhlekelele eqenjini. Uzinzo lukhona kwi-MK njengoba ubuholi obukhona ngobesikhashana.”Okhulumela iPhalamende, uMnuz Moloto Mothapo, uvumile ukuthi uSomlomo wePhalamende, wayithola incwadi evela kwi-MK, yokuhoxisa amalungu ePhalamende.Uthe ngokoMthethosisekelo, ilungu lePhalamende lihoxiswa uma iqembu elilimele lihoxisa ubulungu lalelo lungu."USomlomo umatasa ubhekisisa izincwadi azitholile ukuze athathe isinqumo ngazo. Isinqumo uzosimemezela maduzane,” kusho uMothapo. Leli qembu lisanda kuhoxisa esikhundleni obengunobhala jikelele walo, uMnuz Arthur Zwane.UZwane uhoxiswa nje wake wakhonjwa indlela ngaphambilini kwabuye kwaba nengwiji wabuya.
UMASIPALA i-Alfred Duma eMnambithi, izolo uqale umkhankaso wokugqugquzela abafundi abasezindaweni ezisemkhaya ukuthi bathande umkhakha wezesayensi ngokwethula iNational Science week, emcimbini obuseDriefontein kuWard 19.IMeya kaMasipala uMnuz Zama Sibisi, ithe ukushoda kolwazi nezobuchwepheshe balezi zifundo ezikoleni ezisemakhaya, kwenza abantu abasha basezindaweni ezisemakhaya basalele emuva kulo mkhakha oyikusasa emhlabeni wonke. USibisi uthi njengomasipala bafuna ukuklama indima ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi babuyisa uthando lwesayensi kubafundi basemakhaya.ABANYE babafundi baseMnambithi abakhuthazwe ngezifundo zesayensi"Inkinga enkulu esibhekene nayo ezindaweni ezisemakhaya ukuthi sincane kakhulu isibalo sabantu abasha abenza izifundo zesayensi. Sifuna ukuthi kushintshe manje lokho kuvuleke ikhasi elisha,'' usho kanje uSibisi.Uthe okudala ukuthi akuqaphele ukuthi bayidlanzana abafundi abenza lezi zifundo, ukuthi phambilini uke wawusebenzela uMnyango wezeMfundo.Uthe umasipala ufuna ukusebenza kanzima ngenhloso yokuguqula lesi simo. Uthe ukholwa ukuthi nakanjani lokhu kuzokwenzeka.Uzibophezele ekutheni abafundi bezikole ezahlukene zaseMnambithi, abayophuma phambili kwisayensi bayogixatshezwa ngemifundaze nendathane yeminye imiklomelo.UMasipala kuleli sonto lesayensi, uzohambela izikole zakule ndawo uhambisana nabezikhungo zemfundo ephakeme, okubalwa iDurban University of Technology nezinye, befundisa kabanzi ngalezi zifundo. Bekhuluma ngemikhakha yesayensi ehlukene abantu abangangena kuyona."Sihlose ukuthi sakhe abantu abasha abakubeka phambili ukufunda. Sifuna kodwa ukuthi kube ngabantu abasha abangesabi ukwenza izifundo zeScience,'' usho kanje.Uveze ukuthi bawu-200 abafundi bakule ndawo abahlomule ngemali yokubhalisela ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme.Ngonyaka ozayo ufisa ukuthi isibalo sinyuke sifinyelele kwabangu-300. Lokhu uthe bazohlezi bekwenza ngoba bayibeke eqhulwini imfundo kulo mkhandlu.UDkt Myalo Sabela obevela eDurban University of Technology (DUT) ukushayele elikhulu ihlombe ukutshalwa kothando lwesayensi kubafundi.Uthe akangabazi nakancane ukuthi lokhu okuhlwanyelwa umasipala waseMnambithi, kuzohluma ngokuhamba kwesikhathi."Ngeke nizisole ngokukhuthaza abafundi ukuba benze izifundo zesayensi,'' usho kanje uDkt Sabela.Umfundi u-Andile Hadebe wesikole sakule ndawo Ingula High ubonge umasipala ngokukhuthaza abafundi basemakhaya ngezifundo zesayensi.
ABESIFAZANE ebebehambele umcimbi we-High Tea ebihlelwe ngusomabhizinisi uNkk Nqobile Mthembu, bagonyuluke ngezimo abadlule kuzona empilweni.Umcimbi ubuhanjelwe abesifazane basemazingeni ahlukene, begqoke beconsa. Ubusendaweni eyibhizinisi elidayisa ukudla okuphekiwe okusezingeni elicokeme iMadam & Sir esemgwaqweni uFlorida, eThekwini.Bonke abebekhuluma kulo mcimbi bebesho ngazwi linye ukuthi izinselelo ezibhekana nabesifazane ziyafana kungakhathaleki ukuthi uyiliphi ibala. Babale izinkinga zasemindenini ezicindezela abesifazane. UNksz Nomxolisi Gumede owaziwa ngezinkulumo ezakhayo, oke azwakale nasemsakazweni iGagasi FM, uthuse abaningi ekhuluma ngezinkinga ahlangabezana nazo emndenini wakhe, okubalwa kukho ukuzitshwa wuyise. Wafana nomuntu ongenababa yize ekhona. Uthe kodwa ukholwa wukuthi lokho kwamqinisa kakhulu kunakuqala kwamenza walangazelela ukuzimela nokuphumelela empilweni yakhe.Uphosele inselelo abesifazane ebebeyingxenye yomcimbi ukuthi baqine noma behlangabezana naziphi izimo.ABESIFAZANE ebebehambele umcimbi we-High Tea. Kusukela kwesokunxele nguNksz Nomxolisi Gumede, uNkk Nqobile Mthembu, uNkk Mbali Maduna, uNksz Bhela Sibiya noNksz Zama Makhaza Isithombe: NKOSIKHONA CELEAbanye bebeveza izinkinga ababhekene nazo emishadweni yabo njengoba kuvele nabathi bayadivosa, bakhathele ukumelana nobunzima. UNksz Bhela Sibiya ongomunye wabebehambele lo mcimbi, uthe abesifazane uma beshada basuke bengazitsheli ukuthi ngelinye ilanga bangazithola sebedivosa, kodwa kuyenzeka futhi kunzima. Uthe naye njengamanje uyadivosa. Ubeseshade iminyaka engu-8.Ekhuluma ngenhloso yalo mcimbi, uNkk Mthembu uthe bekungukuhlanganisa abesifazane ndawonye bacobelelane ngolwazi lwezinto ezehlukene futhi babuye bakhulisane bebodwa.Uthe okunye kwakho abesifazane abahlose ukubakhuthaza ngakho wukungena emabhizinisini.Uthe ukholwa wukuthi iNingizimu Afrika ingaba yindawo engcono kakhulu uma benganda abesifazane abangena kwezamabhizinisi. "Abesifazane banothando futhi banozwelo. Ngakho baningi abangasizakala uma benganda abesifazane abangene kwezamabhizinisi,’’ usho kanje.Abesifazane ebebekhona lapha bebehlobe bebahle bonke befake imihelane. Bebegqoke izingubo ezahlukene ezinemibala egqamile.
UMFUNDISI osemncane uthi ukholwa ukuthi kumqoka ukuchelelwa kwemishado yabantu abamnyama ukuqinisekisa ukuthi noma izamaziseka kodwa akuqhumi izehlukaniso.UMfu Thembinkosi Congolo (37) ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi kunesigcawu sabantu abashadile ebesihlelwe yisikhungo sakhe, iMukashi Marriage Officers.Besikade sisesakhiweni seGrace Life Church ebiseReunion, eSiphingo, muva nje.UCongolo uthi uyakholelwa emishadweni ngakho kumele ibandla likaNkulunkulu nalo libhukule liqinisekise ukuthi iyama."Kumqoka ukuthi izigcawu zalolu hlobo zibe khona. Ngikholwa ukuthi zinendima enkulu eziyidlalayo kubantu bakithi abasemishadweni,'' usho kanje.Uveze ukuthi lesi bekungesisona esokugcina isigcawu kodwa ziyeza ezinye ezizoba wuchungechunge kusona sonke isifundazwe iKwaZulu Natal."Sifuna ukufinyelela kusona sonke isifundazwe. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi sihlela nokuthi sifinyelele nakwezinye izifundazwe,'' usho kanjena.Lo mbhidlango ubambisene kuwona no-Advocate Jodwane Nyameko ongummeli. Uthe ukholwa ukuthi abantu abashadile bayadinga ukuthola ukuboniswa okuvela kubameli.Isikhulumi sosuku bekunguMphostoli Musa Khwela weJesus Restoration owenabe kabanzi ngokubaluleka kokuba abashadile bazane kangcono futhi babekezelelane.Uthe emshadweni akuhlezi kumnandi, wathi kodwa okumqoka yizindlela ezinobuhlakani okumele zisetshenziswe ngabasemshadweni ukuxazulula izinkinga zabo ngokuthula."Yonke imishado iyahlaselwa yizinkinga kodwa okuyikhona okumqoka kakhulu wukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinkinga zisonjululwa kanjani,'' usho kanje.Uthe emandulo sasiphansi kakhulu isibalo sabahlukanisayo, wathi lokhu kwakubangelwa ukuthi kwakubanjiswana kukhona konke ababekwenza.Ukhuthaze nokuthi abashadile bazifundise ukukhuluma kabanzi ngezezimali.
UBONGA ukwesekwa yibandla umculi wokholo osanda kukhipha i-albhamu, uNdumiso Mzobe. Uthe ngale albhamu uhlose ukukhuthaza ngayo ukuzethemba ebantwini.Lo mculi, okhonza ebandleni labasindisiwe i-Ebenezer Christian Family Church, uthi kumqoka ukuthola ukwesekwa ngamalungu ebandla uma ungumculi wokholo.Usanda kukhipha i-albhamu esihloko sithi God is Able. Ngale albhamu uthi uhlose ukukhuthaza abazalwane ukuthi bangaliphosi ithawula kungakhathaleki ukuthi bazithola bebhekene naziphi izimo."Ngifuna ukuthi le albhamu ibuyise ukuzethemba ebantwini. Ngifuna bazi ukuthi asikho nesisodwa isimo esingabanqoba uma nje uNkulunkulu engakubo,'' echaza.Uveze ukuthi le albhamu iyatholakala ezitolo ezahlukene ezikhona eNingizimu Afrika. Uthe kulokoza inhlansi yethemba ngokuthi izowenza umehluko omkhulu kubona bonke abantu abazoyithenga.Ukhulume nangokubaluleka kokuba abaculi bokholo bawazi umnyango wesonto. Ugcizelele ukuthi ubudlelwane bomculi wokholo noNkulunkulu bumqoka kakhulu.Uthe akumele abaculi bakhombe indlela maqede bajike. "Mina ngikholwa ukuthi uma ungumculi wokholo kumele uye nakanjani enkonzweni. Lokho kuyakwakha njengomculi,'' usho kanje.Ubalule ukuthi kumele kube seqhulwini ngaso sonke isikhathi kubaculi bokholo ukubaluleka kwendlela yokuziphatha.Uthe eminyakeni ezayo ufuna ukuzibona ebalwa nabanye babaculi asebedlondlobele kakhulu ngokomculo.Uveze nokuthi uyafisa kakhulu ukuthi acule nabanye babaculi asebemnkantshubovu kulo mkhakha womculo wokholo
UPHINDE wahlangabezana nenye ingqinamba yezomthetho loyo owayengumengameli, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, emzamweni wakhe wokuzishushisela mathupha uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa.INkantolo yokuDluliswa kwamaCala ichithe omunye umzamo kaZuma wokuphonsela inselelo isinqumo seNkantolo eNkulu eGoli, esachitha icala lapho ezishushisela khona uRamaphosa.Ummeli kaZuma, u-Advocate Dali Mpofu, uveze ukuthi iNkantolo yokuDluliswa kwamaCala iphinde yabachitha.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi kuhleli icala eNkantolo eNkulu eGoli.INkantolo eNkulu eGoli yalichitha icala elifakwe uZuma, ikhala ngokuthi isitifiketi esasisetshenziswa uZuma sasinengenalo igama likaRamaphosa.Amajaji ayelalele icala athola ukuthi uZuma wehluleka ukukhokha ngesikhathi imali yesibambiso aphinde anquma ukuthi izinsolo zikaZuma zazingeke ziholele ekutheni uRamaphosa agwetshwe.UZuma wabe esenikela eNkantolo yokuDluliswa kwamaCala, yamchitha, njengoba isiphinde yamchitha futhi.UMpofu utshele inkantolo ukuthi njengoba iNkantolo yokuDluliswa kwamaCala isiphinde yabachitha, sebezonikela eNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo.Ukuqhubeka kwecala ebeliseNkantolo eNkulu eGoli izolo, kuzoncika esinqumweni seNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo.UMpofu ucele ukuthi icala ebelilalelwe izolo lihlehliselwe uFebhuwari 6."Sekuyinto eyejwayelekile ukuthi sicele ukuthi icala lihlehliswe ngoba sisuke sisalinde izinqumo ezithile. Sinethemba lokuthi kuyothi kushaya uFebhuwari, iNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo, iyokube isisikhiphile isinqumo sayo.”UZuma ushushisa uRamaphosa njengengxenye yecala lapho eyezishushisela khona umshushisi omkhulu ecaleni lakhe lenkohlakalo nokukhwabanisa, u-Advocate Billy Downer nentatheli yeziko lezindaba elibika ngesiNgisi.UZuma usola uRamaphosa ngokungathathi zinyathelo ngesikhathi embikela ngokwephula umthetho kukaDowner abemshushisela izinsolo zokuputshuzela intatheli ulwazi oluyimfihlo ngempilo yakhe.Nalo icala lapho uZuma eshushisa uDowner nentatheli, lachithwa yiNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu.UZuma ubezifikele amathupha enkantolo izolo.Akazange akhulume namalungu e-MK abezomeseka enkantolo.Nangeledlule, uZuma akazange akhulume namalungu e-MK ayezothamela icala lombango wophawu elafakwa i-ANC eNkantolo eNkulu eThekwini.Okhulumela inhlangano kaZuma engenzi nzuzo, iJacob G Zuma Foundation, uMnuz Mzwanele Manyi, uthe uZuma uzimisele ngokushushisa uRamaphosa.Ugxeke isinqumo sikaRamaphosa sokuphonsela inselelo ukushushiswa kwakhe, wathi sibambezela ukuqulwa kwecala.
UZOCHITHA isonto egqunywe ezitokisini uMphrofethi Paseka 'Mboro’ Motsoeneng obhekene noxhaxha lwamacala angu-12 okukhona kuwona nelokushaya, elokusabisa nokuthumba.Uvele eNkantolo yeMantshi yasePalm Ridge izolo nomqaphi wakhe uMnuz Vincent Baloyi nendodana yakhe uMnuz Revival Motsoeneng.Icala lihlehliselwe u-Agasti 16 ukuze kuqhubeke uphenyo futhi abasolwa bacele ibheyili.Bekunamaqembu amabili ngaphandle kwenkantolo okungelamakholwa abezokweseka abasolwa, abecula ethandaza nangezilimi efuna bakhululwe.Bekukhona nelinye lamalungu omphakathi ebelicula amaculo omzabalazo lizophikisana nokuthi badedelwe.Ukuboshwa kwabo kusuka esigamekweni esibonakale kwi-video lapho uMboro egasele nobhushu esikoleni iMatshediso Primary, eKatlehong ngoMsombuluko wasabisa othisha nabafundi.Bashaye bachitha nabafundi ababili okuthiwa ngabamshana kaMboro. Ingxabano kuthiwa iphakathi kwemindeni emibili ezala lezi zingane engaboni ngasolinye mayelana nokukhuliswa kwazo.INational Prosecuting Authority ithi unogada kaMboro uthweswe namacala okungelokuphatha isibhamu esingekho emthethweni, esingavumelekile, elokukhomba umuntu ngaso nokusiqhumisa. Laba abathathu bathweswe namacala okusabisa.INPA ithe uphenyo lwayo luyaqhubeka futhi kungenzeka yengeze amanye amacala.Khonamanjalo kuvela ukuthi ugogo nomalume balezi ngane bavelile nabo kule nkantolo ngecala lokushaya okuthiwa balivulelwa uMboro.Inkantolo ibadedele ngebheyili kaR1 000 umuntu emunye. Icala labo eliqulwa ngokwehlukana nelikaMboro libe selihlehliselwa uSepthemba 10.Kuvela ukuthi amaphoyisa aphenya necala lokushisa emuva kokuthi umphakathi ungqongqise isonto likaMboro ngoLwesibili.
UMENGAMELI Cyril Ramaphosa uyalele amadoda ukuba avale oziphu njengoba ucwaningo lwakamuva luveza ukuthi u-600 000 wawo usuke wahlukumeza umuntu wesifazane.URamaphosa ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi kugujwa usuku lwabesifazane emcimbini kahulumeni obuseNorthern Cape izolo."Ucwaningo lwakamuva luveza ukuthi u-7% wabesifazane, okuwu-1.5 million, usuke washaywa noma wadlwengulwa ngabesilisa. U-13% uveze ukuthi izithandwa zabo ziyabahlukumeza ngokomnotho kanti u-4% wamadoda, okuwu-600 000, uvumile ukuthi usuke washaya noma wahlukumeza abesifazane,” kusho uRamaphosa.Uthe amadoda kufanele ashintshe indlela aziphethe ngayo, azibophezele ukuvikela abesifazane."Madoda, kufanele nivale oziphu benu. Nizibophezele ukuthi ngeke nibahlukumeze noma yingaluphi uhlobo abesifazane. Nami ngiyazibophezela ukuthi ngizoqinisekisa ukuthi umthetho wokubavikela, ukubanikeza isithunzi sabo nokubavulela amathuba omnotho uyasebenza,” kusho uRamaphosa.Ukhale ngokuthi ubuso bobuphofu busewumuntu wesifazane omnyama yize sekukhona ushintsho oluncane abalwenzile bewuhulumeni.Uthe abesifazane bahlakaniphile ukudlula abesilisa ngoba nasezikoleni amantombazane yiwo aphasa kahle futhi yiwona agcwele ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme."Awuphele umkhuba omubi wokuholela amadoda kangcono ezinkampanini ezizimele. Abesifazane kufanele bahole umholo olingana nowamadoda ngomsebenzi ofanayo abawenzayo,” kusho uRamaphosa.Uthe ufuna nemisebenzi kahulumeni iye ezinkampanini zabesifazane ngoba abesifazane bathenga ukudla, banakekele nemindeni yabo. Ubalule ukuthi abafani namadoda okuthi uma ethola imali athenge izimoto, ahlale ematshwaleni noma enze ezinye izinto ezingawakhi umphakathi.Ubuye wakhumbuza abantu baseNorthern Cape ukuthi lolu suku lwasunguleka kanjani njengoba ngo-1956 abesifazane baqunga isibindi bamashela ezindlini zoMbuso ePitoli befuna inkululeko.Uthembise ukuthi bazoqinisekisa ukuthi abesifazane babuyelwa yisithunzi, bahlala ezindlini ezisesimeni esikahle, banamanzi, ugesi nemisebenzi ebuyisa isithunzi.Uthe akukuhle ukuthi bawubuso benhlupheko, baphila ngezibonelelo zikahulumeni.Ubalule ukuthi bazoqinisekisa ukuthi abesifazane bathola umhlaba othi bona nasezindaweni zasemakhaya ukuze babe ngabalimi noma bazenzele izimboni ezizolekelela ukuthi banganciki kumuntu.
UBHEKENE nomqansa uNgqongqoshe weMfundo eyisiSekelo uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, ofuna uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, abambe amatomu ngokusayina uMthethosivivinywa wezikole i-Basic Laws Amendment Bill (BELA), okunomsindo ngawo. UNksz Gwarube ufuna kwenziwe izichibiyelo kulo Mthethosivivinywa njengoba amaqembu afana ne-DA ekhala ngokuthi uphuca amandla izigungu ezilawula izikole odabeni oluthinta ulimi okumele lufundwe kuleso sikole, ukuba yimpoqo kukaGrade R ezikoleni nokunye. USihlalo wekomiti elibhekele izinguquko kwezomnotho kwi-ANC, uNksz Mmamoloko Kubayi, utshele abezindaba abebehambele iLekgotla ukuthi kudingeka uNksz Gwarube eze kwiKhabhinethi, afune ukwesekwa ukuze kwenziwe izichibiyelo.Uthe uMthethosivivinywa akuwona okangqongqoshe othile kodwa wagunyazwa yiKhabhinethi."UMthethosivivinywa ukuRamaphosa, usawucubungula ngaphambi kokuwusayina. Ofuna kwenziwe izichibiyelo kumele aye kwiKhabhinethi, ayinxenxe ukuthi imeseke ngaphambi kokuba kwenzeke lokho. Okwamanje akekho oseke weza kwiKhabhinethi mayelana nezinguquko kuMthethosivivinywa,” kusho uNksz Kubayi.Okhulumela uRamaphosa, uMnuz Vincent Magwenya, ekhuluma ngezinhlelo zikamengameli izolo ezindlini zoMbuso ePitoli, uthe uMthethosivivinywa ukumengameli.Uthe umatasa nawo esebenzisana nabeluleki bezomthetho."Akekho oseke weza kumengameli wathi akamise ukusayina uMthethosivivinywa ukuze ube ngumthetho. Kumele anikwe isikhathi ukuze awucubungulisise,” kusho uMagwenya.Uthe bayazi ngemvunge ekhona ngoMthethosivivinywa."Umengameli uzokhipha umhlahlandlela ngokuzokwenzeka uma esephothule konke okuthinta uMthethosivivinywa. Ingcabha ikumengameli ukuthi awubuyisele emuva ePhalamende ukuze kwenziwe izichibiyelo uma ebona kunesidingo,” kusho uMagwenya izolo. UNkk Helen Zille, onguSihlalo we-DA, usabise ngokuthi bangaya nasenkantolo uma ugcina usayiniwe uMthethosivivinywa.Uhlale ekugcizelela ukuthi abahambisani nokuthi uMthethosivivinywa uphuca amandla izigungu zezikole.Ngakolunye uhlangothi izinyunyana zothisha ikakhulu iSadtu, ziyalele uRamaphosa ukuthi ayeke ukubamba ayeke kodwa asayine.Inyunyana yakhala ngokuthi uRamaphosa ujwayele ukuhudula izinyawo uma kumele asayine imithetho ephathelene nezemfundo.ISadtu isanda kukhala ngokuthi sekuphele iminyaka engu-10, kukutakutwa indaba yoMthethosivivinywa.
UKUHOXA kukaChidimma Adetshina emncintiswaneni wonobuhle uMiss South Africa, sekusele izinsuku ezimbili ngaphambi kosuku lokuklomelisa onqobile, kufane noju kwizakhamuzi zakuleli zwe ebezingayizwa indaba yakhe.UChidimma (23), kuthe ngoLwesine wakhipha isitatimende, ememezela ukuthi usenqume ukuhoxa emncintiswaneni, okuzomenyezelwa onqobile kuwona namhlanje ebusuku, eSunBet Arena, ePitoli. Bese kuyisikhathi kunempikiswano ngokungenela kwale ntokazi kulo mncintiswano, kukhona abakhala ngokuthi akufanele ngabe iwungenele ngoba uyise owaseNigeria, kuthi unina udabuka eMozambique, yize bekwaziwa kuthi izalelwe eGoli, futhi yakhulela eSoweto, okwenza ibe nobuzwe baseNingizimu Afrika. USthembiso Mngoma ubhale ekhasini lakhe lakwiFacebook wathi: "Ukube abantu abakhulumanga ngabe ayivelanga le nto eyenziwa eminyakeni ewu-23 edlule. Cabanga nje ukuthi kunomuntu okunzima ukuthi athole umazisi, kanti uvinjwa yizigebengu ezingena kuleli zwe ngokungemthetho.’”UKwena Molweka uthe: "Akekho umuntu ongangenza ngikholwe wukuthi uChidimma uwumgilwa kukho konke lokhu. Umgilwa kulesi simo wumuntu wakuleli zwe owaphucwa ubuzwe bakhe eminyakeni ewu-23 edlule, futhi lowo muntu kumele atholakale, anxeshezelwe ngakho konke lokho.”NgoLwesithathu ebusuku, uMnyango wezaseKhaya, ukhiphe isitatimende uveza ukuthi ukuphenywa kwawo ngoChidimma, kuveze ukuthi unina wasebenzisa umazisi womunye umuntu wesifazane ukumbhalisa njengesakhamuzi sakuleli zwe.UMnyango uveze nokuthi uyaqhubeka uyaphenya futhi uzobathathela izinyathelo bonke abathinteka kugcobho lwakho konke okwenzeke ngokungemthetho ngodaba lukaChidimma."’Ukuba kulo mncintiswano bekumnandi kodwa emva kokubheka izinto eziningi, sengithathe isinqumo esinzima sokuhoxa kuwona, ukusiza ukuzivikela nomndeni wami,”’ kusho uChidima ekhasini le-Instagram.Akuphelanga sikhathi esingakanani, nenhlangano iMiss South Africa, yakhipha isitatimende ifisela uChidimma inhlanhla kukho konke ahlela ukukwenza ngempilo yakhe."Inhloso yethu wukuqhakambisa izinhlanga ezahlukene futhi sibeke eqhulwini ubuntu, kanjalo nje sizibophezele ukubamba iqhaza ukwenza abantu besifazane base-Afrika, nasemhlabeni jikelele bazithembe ngobubona,”’ kusho iMiss SA.Ukuphuma kukaChidimma, kusho ukuthi namhlanje kuzoqhudelana izintokazi eziyishumi kuMiss SA, obuya ihlandla lesi-66 nonyaka, okungoNompumelelo Maduna, Kirsten Khan, Layla Zoubair, Ontshiametse Tlhopane, Palesa Lombard,Taahira Katz, Kebalepile Ramafoko waseMpumalanga, Mia Le Roux waseFree State, Onalenna Constantin waseNorth West, noLebohang Khoza othwele amathemba eKwaZulu-Natal.

UCWANINGO lwePietermaritzburg Economic Justice & Dignity Group, luveza ukuthi isibiza u-R5 252.15 igilosa yomndeni isuka ku-R5 252.77 ngoJuni.Kule nyanga kuye kwanyuka isitambu, amaqanda, ugreen pepper, impuphu, irayisi, izibindi zenkukhu, i-cremora, ama-aphula, ipeanut butter nesinkwa.Ukudla okwehlile wutamatisi, ukherothi, i-butternut, ispinashi, amawolintshi, u-anyanisi, u-curry powder, isobho, itiye, izingingila zenkukhu, i-wors, usu, iklabishi, upholoni nojamu.UMnuz Mervyn Abrahams we-Pietermaritzburg Economic Justice & Dignity Group, uthe igilosa isabiza ngoba ukudla okuyizidingo okuthengwa nyangazonke okubalwa impuphu nokunye kusabiza.Uveze ukuthi ukudla kwengane okunomsoco kubiza uR935.71 kodwa isibonelelo sezingane siwu-R530."Ukudla kuyabiza, abesifazane okuyibona abenza igilosa bathwele kanzima ngoba igilosa yomndeni ibiza ukwedlula amaholo abasebenzi (iNational Minimum Wage) ewu-R5 074.72 ngenyanga njengoba igilosa iwu-R5 252.15. Abangasebenzi bathwele kanzima kakhulu ngoba nesibonelelo sezingane asaneli igilosa enomsocoyezingane,” kusho u-Abrahams.Ukhale ngokuthi ukunyuka kukagesi nakho kwandisa umthwalo emahlombe abantu njengoba unyuke ngo-12.72%.Ubalule ukuthi imizi eminingi isebenzisa ugesi owu-350kWh ngenyanga okusho ukuthi ithenga ikhadi likaR900 kuya ku-R1 200 ngenyanga.Wenze isibonelo sokuthi eMgungundlovu umndeni osebenzisa ugesi owu-350kWh unyuke ngo-R136.05 usuka ku-R906.92 waya ku-R1 042.97.Uthe abantu bathwele kanzima, abakwazi ukumelana nezindleko zikagesi, ezegilosa, ezokugibela nezokubiza kwempilo.
LISHENXISIWE icala lokudlwengula inkosazana ebelethweswe isethenjwa somholi wamaNazaretha, iNkosi Mduduzi Shembe uNyazilwezulu, ngenxa yokushoda kobufakazi obanele bokusishushisa.UMnuz Xolani "Maliyavuza” Zungu owaboshwa ngecala lokudlwengula inkosazana ukhishwe phambili yinkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini, izolo. Ubethweswe icala lokudlwengula inkosazana okuvele kamuva ukuthi bekuyintombi yakhe.UMNUZ Xolani 'Maliyavuza’ Shembe nommeli wakhe, uMnuz Ayanda Khanyile emva kokuhoxa kwecala lokudlwengula ebelithweswe ummangalelwa Isithombe: SITHUNYELWEUmmeli kaZungu, uMnuz Ayanda Khanyile we-Ayanda Khanyile Attorneys, uthe ukuhoxa kwecala kufakazela khona ukuthi uZungu ubeboshelwa amanqina enyathi ngalo."Leli cala belivele lingekho kwasekuqaleni. Umshushisi ufike enkantolo wakhuluma into engabambeki, washo nokuthi ingxoxo obekumele ibekhona phakathi komphenyi wecala nommangali ayibange isabakhona. Ngolwazi lwami nobufakazi enginabo, ingxoxo ibekhona kodwa usaba ukuthi ummangali akasambophi uZungu ngoba nasekuqaleni wayevele esetshenziswa ukuthi amvulele leli cala. Njengamanje sithatha isinqumo sokubopha uMbuso ngokudicilela phansi isithunzi sikaZungu,” kusho ummeli uKhanyile.Njengoba uZungu ebehamba leli cala bekunemiyalezo athe yayithunyelwe uyena ummangali, kuyena eveza ukuthi kukhona ababemsebenzisa ukuthi amvulele icala ngoba befuna ukumgudluza eduze koNyazilwezulu. Kukhona nalapho lo wesifazane ayesecela khona uZungu ukuthi babaleke naye ngoba akasafuni nokuhlala ekhaya ngoba nomndeni wakhe uhambisana nabathi akaboshwe. Yonke le miyalezo ebinikwe umshushisi kwakuvele ukuthi isayohlolwa ubuqiniso bayo kuphinde kuxoxwe nommangali. Bekuvele kuhlelwe usuku lwayizolo ukuthi icala libuyele enkantolo sekuxoxiwe naye ummangali kwase kuvela ukuthi akuxoxiwe naye, kwahoxa icala.UZungu oseke wasinda edutshulwa okusolakala ukuthi lesi sigameko seyamene naleli cala lokudlwengula abethweswe lona, uthe ubonga amandla oNyazilwezulu ngokuphela kwecala."Ngijabule kakhulu ngokwenzekile ngoba belivele lingekho leli cala. Ngiyabonga ngamandla kababa uNyazilwezulu ukungiphephisa,” kusho uZungu.UZungu ungomunye wezethenjwa zoNyazilwezulu owaziwa ngokuhamba phambi kwezimoto zalo mholi uma kunemihlangano emikhulu yamaNazaretha. Kuthiwa uyena oqinisekisa nokuphepha kwalo mholi uma kunabantu abaningi lapho ekhona. Kuthiwa ubeboshelwe itulo ngenxa yezinsolo zokuthi uyena obevimbe ukuthi kuqhubeke umsebenzi wokwakhiwa kwamadokodo eBuhleni. Lokhu kwenzeka emva kokuba umholi uNyazilwezulu emise ukwakhiwa kwawo emva koxhaso lukaMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa luka-R18 million wokwakha amadokodo.Kuvela ukuthi kunezethenjwa zoNyazilwezulu ezisebenzisana nezikhulu zepolitiki ukuze zihlomule kulo R18 million, nezagcina zisola yena uZungu ukuthi uvimbile.UZungu usalokhu emile ekutheni yena akangene ezintweni ezithinta amathenda futhi wayengeke avimbe ukwakhiwa kwamadokodo aseBuhleni.Ngesikhathi esinda esigamekweni sokudutshulwa bekuputshuke izwi lowesifazane ezihlangula ukuba yingxenye yokubulawa kukaZungu, ayethi kuhlelwa ngabathile ebandleni lamaNazaretha. Kuthiwa kwakunqunywe ukuthi ungafiki uJulayi 12, engabulewe ngoba kwakuyiwona azovela ngawo enkantolo. Kuthiwa okwakwenza kuthiwe akasheshe asocongwe lungakafiki usuku lwecala yingoba bese kuzwakele ukuthi ummangali akazimisele ukuqhubeka nokumbophisa njengoba kwakuhleliwe.
KUKHALWA ngemali echithwa nguhulumeni okhokhela abasebenzi abamisiwe asebehlale emakhaya iminyaka. Lokhu kuvezwe nguSihlalo wePublic Service Commission, uDkt Somadoda Fikeni, okhale ngokuthi nohulumeni akasazi isibalo salaba basebenzi abamiselwe amacala ahlukene.UFikeni uthe ezikhaleni zabamisiwe kunamabamba kwawona akhokhelwa imali ngokubamba kulezi zikhundla. Uthe izibalo zabasebenzi abahleli emakhaya behola zihlawumbiselwa ku-300 kuya phezulu."Abanye babethi basuka ku-300 kuya ku-1 000 kodwa asinaso isiqinisekiso ngoba asinazo izibalo eziphathekayo. Ibalelwa kuR240 million imali esetshenziswa uhulumeni ukukhokhela la basebenzi. Kuyawuqeda umdlandla kubasebenzi abafaka uphethroli baye emsebenzini nsuku zonke ekubeni kunozakwabo abazihlalele emakhaya abaqhubeka nokuhola.”Uthe kwabamisiwe kukhona asebeqhuba izifundo zabo, abanye bavula amabhizinisi kanti abanye baya kwamanye amazwe bazitamuzele le mali kahulumeni. Ukusho lokhu emhlanganweni ohlanganisa osihlalo bePublic Service Commission, esifundeni iSADC obuseKapa. UNgqongqoshe weziSebenzi zikaHulumeni nokuPhatha, Inkosi Mzamo Buthelezi, uthe kuqalwe uphenyo ukuze bathole isibalo sabahola besemakhaya.UButhelezi uthe abanazo izibalo eziqondile zabahola besemakhaya. UFikeni uthe wayephakamise ukuthi kube nosuku okuzoza ngalo bonke abamisiwe emisebenzini yabo."Sasithe akube nguNovemba nyakenye ukuze babalwe ukuthi bangaki. Namanje ngisamile ekutheni uma silubeka lolu suku singakwazi ukuba nesibalo esiqondile sabahola behleli emakhaya. Uma sifuna ukuba nohulumeni osebenza ngendlela, kumele siqale sazi ukuthi zithini izibalo zabasebenzi abahola bengenzanga lutho.”Uthe bayajabula ukuthi uButhelezi uveze ukuthi uzobeseka njengoba befuna iPSC izimele.Uveze ukuthi bafuna iPSC ifane nezinye izinhlaka ezifana nehhovisi loMvikeli woMphakathi nezinye ukuze ithathele abasebenzi izinyathelo ezinqala.Ubalule ukuthi inhloso yalo mhlangano ngukuthekela ulwazi kwamanye amazwe akwiSADC ngezithinta abasebenzi bakahulumeni."Sifuna abantu bathole izidingo okuyinto abahlale bekhala ngayo kuhulumeni. Yingakho kumele siqinisekise ukuthi abasebenzi bakahulumeni basekhaleni lentuthuko,” kusho uFikeni.
KUKHALWA ngabokufika abaphendule inhlekisa inhlokodolobha yaKwaZulu-Natal, uMgungundlovu, ngokwakha imijondolo phakathi edolobheni.Imijondolo ekhalisayo yakhiwe engxenyeni yedolobha ebizwa ngeSomalia, ephakathi kwimigwaqo uWest noPietermaritz Street.Le ngxenye yedolobha igcwele kakhulu izitolo zabokufika.Izindlu eziningi sezinwetshiwe, umasipala ukhala ngokuthi akuzange kulandelwe imithetho ngesikhathi zinwetshwa.IMeya yoMasipala waseMsunduzi, uMnuz Mzimkhulu Thebolla, uthe le ndawo isiphenduke yaba ikwampunz’ edla emini.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi benomkhankaso wokuyobheka ukuthi imithetho yomkhandlu iyalandelwa yini.UThebolla uthe abafike bakuthola kule ndawo kubashaqisile."Bengihlezi ngizwa kuthiwa kukhona indawo okuthiwa kukwaMachanca, bengingakaze ngiyibone. Sithole imijondolo la. Le mijondolo idlula lena ekoGomora, nakwezinye izindawo, itholakala edolobheni. Lapha abantu bazakhele nje angazi ukuthi bakha kuphi. Abantu kufanele bazi ukuthi kunemithetho lana.”UThebolla ufunge ngokuthi bazothathelwa izinyathelo osomabhizinisi abaphambana nomthetho."Njengoba silapha asizile nje ukuzokhuluma, sizobuya sesihamba nazo zonke izinhlaka zomthetho. Sifuna ukwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi akekho umuntu ozokhala ngokuthi kunyathelwa amalungelo akhe. Sifuna ukwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi umthetho uyalandelwa eMsunduzi. "Sifuna ukwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi imithetho yomkhandlu iyalandelwa. Sibonile ukuthi enye yezindawo lapho edolobheni ezinenkinga yokulandelwa kwemithetho. Abantu bazenzela umathanda, imithetho ayilandelwa nhlobo.”UThebolla uthe zikhona izinyathelo abavele sebezithathele osomabhizinisi abaphula imithetho."Akusikhona okokuqala sifika lapha. Sekunesikhathi siqhuba umkhankaso wokuhlola ukuthi imithetho iyalandelwa yini. Akhona amabhizinisi esesiwavalile ngoba sithole ukuthi enza okuphambene nomthetho. Njengoba besilapha besisaqhubeka kulokho.”Le ndawo ihlezi igcwele izimoto eceleni komgwaqo. UThebolla uthe bazoqala uhlelo lokuthi izimoto ezima kule ngxenye yedolobha ziyakhokha."Nakuba lungakabi bikho uhlelo lokukhokhela ukupaka lapha eMsunduzi, kodwa sizokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi izimoto ezima lapha ziyakhokha. Sizoqala nje silungise izindawo zokuma izimoto.”UThebolla uthe basazogasela nakwezinye izingxenye zedolobha.Uthe bafuna ukuthi amabhizinisi abuyele ebantwini abamnyama."Kunezinto nje ongalindele ukuthi zenziwe abanye abantu, ezingenziwa ugogo Dlamini. Sifuna ukuthi umnotho ubuyele ebantwini.”
SEBEPHENDUKE ondingasithebeni abahlali basebhilidini uStrathdon elisekhoneni lomgwaqo uPark no-Maud Mfusi enkabeni yeTheku njengoba bekhishiwe kuleli bhilidi.Izimpahla zabo okubalwa kuzo imibhede, amafriji, amathelevishini nokunye, kusaphazwe emgwaqweni ngoba kuthiwa abanazo izincwadi eziyisivumelwano sokuqashisa futhi bahleli ngokungemthetho.Omunye wabahlali ongathandanga ukudalulwa ngoba ebona engaphephile, utshele Isolezwe ukuthi abantu abakhishwayo abahlala kuleli bhilidi ngokungemthetho."Into ebuhlungu ukuthi kukhishwa nabantu abanezivumelwano zokuqasha. Kuthiwa abakhiphe zona lezi zincwadi ezingekho kubona ezikumuntu owadayisa ibhilidi. Uma sizama ukubafonela, laba esenza nabo isivumelwano sokuqashisa bona basikhomba kwabathenga ibhilidi,” kusho lo mhlali.Uthe leli bhilidi beselifana nezindlu zomxhaso kubo."Kunabantu abese behlale iminyaka engu-27 kuleli bhilidi. Asinayo nendawo esizoya kuyo njengoba sesilahlwe ngaphandle nje. Akekho umuntu osichazelayo ngalokhu okwenzekayo. Abantu abadayisa ibhilidi asibatholi ezingcingweni, kanti laba abasikhiphayo bathi ibhilidi balithenga endalini,” usho kanje.Uqhube wathi imali yerenti bebeyikhokha njalo ngenyanga, kushintshe njengoba sekufike abaphathi abasha bebhilidi."Besesingazi ukuthi imali yerenti sizoyikhokha kubani. Sathunyelelwa izincwadi sitshelwa ukuthi kumele siyikhokhe kubaphathi abasha okungabaphathi esingenaso isivumelwano nabo. Sizamile nokuthola ummeli osithembise ukuthi lolu daba uzolufaka enkantolo, asingayikhokhi irenti okwamanje size sibathole laba esilwa nabo.”Uthe ngeke aqinisekise ukuthi imali yerenti bekuyimalini, kodwa abantu abebefaneleka ukuthi bahlale bekungabantu abahola imali elinganiselwa ku-R3 500 kuya phezulu, ebese bekhokha imali yerenti engu-R1 500 noma u-R1 800 kushiyana ngesivumelwano obanaso.Amanye amabhilidi okukhishwe kuwo abahleli ngokungemthetho yiCarlen Cort, Tarbora neWeltevrede.Ayiphumelelanga imizamo yokuthola abanikazi bamabhilidi ukuze baphawule. Nakhu okumele ukuqaphele uma urenta noma uthenga ibhilidi:Kumele wazi umnikazi walelo bhilidi futhi kumele ube nesivumelwano sokuqashisa.Kumele ukhokhe irenti ngesikhathi ukuze ugweme ukuxoshwa. NGOLWESIBILI silale ngezindaba ezibuhlungu zokudlula emhlabeni koqweqwe lomlingisi, uConnie Temweka Gabisile Chiume, oshonele esibhedlela iGarden City, eGoli, lapho umndeni dalule ukuthi ushone ngenxa yokugula okumxine isikhashana. Lolu qweqwe lomlingisi luzalelwe eWelkom, eFree State, ngoJuni 5, 1952. Lugqame kwezokulingisa ngendawo kaStella Moloi olwaluyilingisa emdlalweni owawukhonjiswa kwi-SABC 1, i-Zone 14, ngo-2007 kuya ku-2015, selujoyina i-Rhythm City, lapho lufike khona kwezwakala ngendawo kaMamokete Khuse.UConnie (72) ngaphambi kokungena ekulingiseni, akuqale ngasekupheleni kwama-70’s, wenze izifundo zobuthishela, waziphothula ngo-1976. Ufundise iminyaka emibalwa, wase eshiya phansi, eseyozinza phesheya kwezilwandle, e-Greece. Ungenise kwezokulingisa ngendawo kaThembi emdlalweni osihloko sithi Inkom’ Edla Yodwa ngo-1989 nakwifilimu ethi Warriors from Hell ngo-1990.Uwole inqwaba yezindondo ngegalelo lakhe ekulingiseni, kubalwa eye-Best Actress in a Drama Series neye-Best Supporting Actress kuma-South African Film and Television Awards. Ngo-2018 uqophe umlando elingisa kwifilimu yaphesheya kwezilwandle eyaba nedumela umhlaba wonke, i-Black Panther, wenza esifanayo nango-2020, kweyesihlabani somculi waphesheya kwezilwandle, u-Beyonce, ethi Black Is King.Ngawo futhi u-2020 kuya ku-2023, uphinde wenza ezibukwayo kwithelevishini, elingisa indawo kaMam’ Sonto Molefe emdlalweni wakuMzansi Magic osuwaphela, i-Gomora. Eminye imidlalo yethelevishini namafilimu alingise kukho yi-I Dreamed of Africa, In My Country, Blessers, What Did You Dream?, Seriously Single, Sgudi Snaysi, Yizo Yizo, The Line, A Woman of Color, Mazinyo Dot Q ne-Thula's Vine. Ushiye emhlabeni izingane ezintathu, nabazukulu abathathu, kanti futhi kuvele nokuthi ubewumngani omkhulu wenye inkakha yezokulingisa, uThembi Nyandeni, aqale ukulingisa naye ngabo-70’s. Kuvele ukuthi uyise udabuka eMalawi, unina owaseKZN. Okhulumela umndeni wakhe, uPercy Vilakazi, ubonge ukwesekwa abakuthola ebantwini selokhu edlulile emhlabeni, wase edalula ukuthi okuningi kuzocaca kusasa ngemininingwane yokufihlwa kwakhe, aqinisekise ukuthi kuzokwenzelwa eGoli.
ZIYANDA izinkinga kumholi weNFP, uMnuz Ivan Barnes, okufakwe icala lokuthi axoshwe ebukhanseleni.Owakhishwa esikhundleni ngesikhathi kufakwa uBarnes ebukhanseleni kuMasipala wesifunda iZululand, uMnuz Sibusiso Nkosi, ufake icala eNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu.UNkosi ufuna ukuthi inkantolo ichithe ukuxoshwa kwakhe, iphinde ichithe nokuqokwa kukaBarnes kwesobukhansela.UNkosi waxoshwa kwiNFP esolwa ngokuthi usefudukele kwelinye iqembu elingazange lishiwo.Emaphepheni asenkantolo, uNkosi uthe kungamanga aluhlaza ukuthi usefudukele kwelinye iqembu.UNkosi uthe akuzange kulandelwe imigomo ngesikhathi exoshwa, wakhala ngokuthi akazange anikwe ithuba lokuthi aziphendulele."Isinqumo sokungixosha kuthiwa sathathwa emhlanganweni wesigungu esiphezulu. Iqiniso ukuthi isigungu esiphezulu asinawo amandla okuxosha umuntu. Akukho okubhalwe phansi okukhombisa ukuthi obani ababekhona kulo mhlangano okuthiwa wathatha isinqumo sokungixosha."Umthetho weqembu unikeza ilungelo umuntu ukuthi abizelwe esigcawini sokuqondiswa ubugwegwe uma kunezinsolo abhekene nazo. Umuntu uxoshwa emva kokunikezwa ithuba lokuthi aphonsele inselelo isinqumo sokumxosha. Mina angizange nginikwe ithuba lokuthi ngiziphendulele.”UNkosi uthe uxoshelwa ukuthi ubonwa njengomuntu ongameseki uBarnes."UBarnes uphezu komkhankaso wokuxosha bonke labo akholwa ukuthi abahambisani naye. Akusimina owokuqala ukuba athole incwadi emxoshayo, baningi abanye abaholi abathole izincwadi zokubaxosha.”Kuleli cala, uNkosi umangalele noMphathiswa wokuBusa ngokuBambisna neziNdaba zoMdabu, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, uMasipala wesifunda iZululand, nenhlangano eyengamele ukhetho, i-Independent Electoral Commission.UNkosi ufuna kuchithwe isinqumo sikaButhelezi sokwamukela incwadi yokumxosha.Ufuna ukuthi icala lokuxoshwa kwakhe lilalelwe ngo-Okthoba 2.Ayizange iphumelele imizamo yokuthola uBarnes ukuze aphawule njengoba ucingo lwakhe beluthi lumatasa.UNkosi akasiyena umholi wokuqala ukufaka uBarnes enkantolo.Ngenyanga eyedlule abaholi beqembu abangu-12 abaqavile okukhona kubo iphini lemeya kuMasipala waseThekwini, uNksz Zandile Myeni, nemeya kaMasipala waKwaNongoma, uMnuz Mshangane Ndabandaba, bamangalela uBarnes emva kokuthi ebathumelele izincwadi ezibasabisa ngokubaqondisa ubugwegwe.INkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu yakhipha isivimbelo sesikhashana esinqanda uBarnes ukuthi amise la baholi.INFP ibhekene nezinkinga zangaphakathi njengoba kukhona icala eliphonsela imiphumela yengqungquthela okwakhethwa kuyo uBarnes.UBarnes wakhethwa engqungqutheleni eyayingonyaka odlule kodwa akasahoshelani nabanye abaholi aqokwa kanye nabo okubalwa kubo unobhala jikelele, uMnuz Teddy Thwala, naye uBarnes ambhalela incwadi yokumumisa.

AWUSABUTHI quthu ubuthongo umndeni wowesifazane waseMbumbulu, onyamalele okuthiwa ugcine ukubonwa endaweni yobumnandi i-London, Kwa-L, KwaMashu, lapho bekunentundabebhekene yephathi ngoMgqibelo.UNksz Amile Khambule kuthiwa uhambe kubo ngawo uMgqibelo, engumuntu oya ebanganini bakhe ayesebenza nabo eVerulam.Ngokusho kukagogo kaNksz Khambule, uNkk Patience Khambule, ehamba wathi uzobuya ngeSonto, nokugcine kungenzekanga.Uthe baqale ukukhathazeka ntambama ngeSonto bebona engaqhamuki, nasocingweni engatholakali."Sivuke ngoMsombuluko, saphinde samzama kodwa lutho ukumthola,” kusho uNkk Khambule, othe bagcine beya emaphoyiseni ngoLwesibili, ukuyobika umuntu odukile.Uthe baphinde baluzama ucingo lwakhe, lwabanjwa umfana waseWoodlands othe ungumngani kaNksz Khambule."Usitshele ukuthi u-Amile wamgcina ngoMgqibelo, eLondon. Uthe yilapho amnika khona iselula yakhe ukuthi amphathele yona, wagcina egoduka nayo, esemcinga engasamtholi,” kusho uNkk Khambule.Uthe okwenza bashawe uvalo ngokunyamalala kwakhe ukuthi wahamba engaphethe ngisho nezingubo zokushintsha, okukhombisa ukuthi wayengumuntu ozobuya ngakusasa.Uphinde wathi okunye okwenza basole ukuthi kukhona okungenzeka ukuthi kumehlele, ukuthi ungumuntu ozihloniphayo izinsuku zesikole njengoba enza unyaka wokuqala e-Berea Tech."Yena uvamile ukuzihambela nabangani bakhe ngezimpelasonto kodwa uyaqinisekisa ukuthi ngeSonto uyabuya ngoba usuke azi ukuthi ngoMsombuluko kumele aye esikoleni,” kusho yena.Isolezwe libuye lathola nezikhalo ngeLondon, izakhamizi eziyakhele, zithi ziyafa umsindo futhi kuphazamiseka nokuhamba kwezimoto emigwaqweni eyakhele.Kuthintwa umnikazi weLondon, uMnuz Xolani Mabanga, uthe uNksz Khambule ungomunye wabesifazane abathathu okusabalale ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ukuthi badukile.Nokho uthe kuthe sekulandelelwa kahle, kwatholakala ukuthi usekhona kule ndawo yobumnandi nabangani.Ugcine ethi uzokwenza imizamo yokuthi aye endaweni yobumnandi, amthathe uNksz Khambule amgodukise ngenkani.Ephendula ngomsindo nokuphazamiseka kokuhamba kwezimoto, uthe ngaphambi komcimbi, ubize umhlangano nezakhamuzi ezakhele indawo, ebika ukuthi kuzoba nomcimbi onesasasa, wabuza ukuthi zikhona yini izikhalazo ezikhona, umphakathi wathi cha."Kunokuthi bakhalaze, bathe bacela ukuthi bavunyelwe ukuthi bazidayisele ngaphandle kwendawo, bazenzele imadlana, savumelana.
