Sidlule nomphefumulo kaMnuz Zibonele Mkhize (60) oyinhloko yomuzi, uLisakhanya Mthethwa (4) owumzukulu noNksz Nomalanga Mchunu okuthiwa ubengumsebenzi kuleli khaya.Kuthiwa abanye emndenini balimale okungatheni, kanti owesifazane ongumnikazi womuzi yena usesimeni esibucayi esibhedlela emva kokuthi elimale kulesi sigameko.Ikhansela kule ndawo, uMnuz Fisokwakhe Dlamini, liuthe nakuba isizathu sokusha kwendlu enkulu okuvela ukuthi beyilala amalungu omndeni abalelwa kwayisishiyagalolunyeni ingakaziwa, kodwa kusolwa ukuthi kubangelwe ukucinywa kukagesi."Kunohlelo lokucinywa kukagesi amahora athile komasipala. Sikholwa ukuthi kungenzeka ukuthi kukhona obekhanyise ikhandlela wakhohlwa, asazi. Akekho futhi osinika izimpendulo ngoba abantu abadala abebekhona yibona abashonile kanti osindile usesibhedlela, bonke laba abanye izingane okungekho okutheni ezikukhumbulayo,” usho kanje.Uthe okwehlele umndeni kubashaqise kakhulu, kangangoba umfana osethe ukukhula okuwuyena owazama ukuhlenga unina nowazibonela uyise nabanye ababili bengqongqa, kuyakhombisa ukuthi uhlukumezeke kakhulu emqondweni ngenxa yalesi simo.Owomndeni, uNksz Silindile Mkhize, uqinisekise ukuthi uyise ubefihlwa khona izolo, kanti uLisakhanya ufihlwe ngeSonto bese kuthi uNksz Mchunu yena batshelwe ukuthi uzofihlwa namhlanje."Izikhulu zikaMasipala oLundi zifikile ukuzobhonga emswaneni. Lukhona usizo esilutholile kumasipala, osihlangabeze ngalo,”usho kanje.IMeya kulo masipala uMnuz Wilson Ntshangase, idlulisele amazwi enduduzo emndenini ngesikhathi iwuhambele ngoMsombuluko.
UZOFAKA isimangalo eNkosini umndeni wakwaPhiri, KwaCele, eMandawe ojikiswe kule ndawo sewufikile nesidumbu kukhalwa ngokuthi awukwazi ukungcwaba endaweni ongasahlali kuyona.Lo mndeni ubusuka eGolokodo, eFolweni, lapho osuzinze khona.Ngokuthola kweSolezwe lo mndeni uhlangabezane nezimbila zithutha ziholwa emhlophe phambili ngesikhathi umphakathi ubaxosha sebefikile nesidumbu.Kuvela ukuthi bebefike nesidumbu sikaMnuz Sandile Phiri (30) oshone ngeledlule ngemuva kokugula. Uze wangcwaba ngakusasa endaweni abathe abathandi ukuyidalula.Owomndeni okhulume neSolezwe ocele ukuba ligodlwe igama lakhe uthe umndeni unenxiwa eMandawe.Uthe lolu daba bahlela ukuyolibika enkosini. '’’Sizoluyisa enkosini lolu daba ngoba lusiphethe kabi,’ kusho owomndeni.Uthe sekuphele isikhathi eside benaleli nxiwa, uthe inkinga yonakale ngokuthi kudlule amhlabeni umalume wakhona okunguyena obehlala khona kwasala kungenamuntu.Uthe kodwa kuyinto eyaziwayo ukuthi inxiwa ngelakwaPhiri. Uma elandisa uthe kushone umufi bangabuza lutho bahamba bayomba ithuna ngayizolo ukuze angcwatshwe ngakusasa."Lokhu besikwenza ngoba siyazi ukuthi yinxiwa lakwaPhiri. Besingazi ukuthi kanti kukhona abantu abaxakwa ukuthi asisahlali khona futhi lokho bakubona kuyisono,'' usho kanje.Uthe okubashiye bedidekile ukuthi kungani bengazange babamise ngayizolo ngesikhathi bemba umgodi kodwa babalinda bafika nesidumbu ngakusasa."Ukuba kukhona abebefuna ukuthi bakusho ngabe kube ngcono kakhulu ukuba bakusho ngayizolo ngesikhathi bebona kusambiwa umgodi. Manje kusixakile ukuthi basilinde size sifike nesidumbu,'' usho kanjena.Uthe kube yisigameko esibe buhlungu kakhulu saphinde sanezela usizi phezu kolunye emndenini."Bengiqala ngqa empilweni yami ukubona abantu bephindiswa emuva nesidumbu. Indlela okwenzeke ngayo ibithusa kakhulu. Indlela abantu bakuleya ndawo ebebengafuni ngayo ukuthi kungcwatshwe ibishiya imibuzo,'' usho kanje.Ithintwa iNkosi yakule ndawo, uMnuz Cele (elingatholakalanga igama lakhe), uthe umthetho wendawo, uthi umuntu ongcwaba khona ohlala khona ngokugcwele.Uthe kodwa alukho udaba olufuze lolu oolufinyelele ezindlebeni zakhe. ''Ngizozama ukuxhumana nezinduna ngithole ukuthi kwenzekeni,'' usho kanje.Ngokujwayelekile uthe izinkinga zalolu hlobo kuye kubhungwe ngazo emihlanganweni yangoLwesine.Uthe mhlawumbe nalolu daba luzofinyelala kubona bese lubhungwa emhlanganweni.
UBECELE umufi ukuthi azomkhiphela i-lay-by ababeyenze bobabili, umsolwa okuthiwa ugcine egwaza ebulala owesifazane enxanxatheleni yezitolo eGateway, eMhlanga, ngeSonto.Lokhu kuvezwe owomndeni, uMnuz Halalisani Mbatha, engxoxweni neSolezwe, izolo, kulandela ukuvela kukamsolwa eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini.Izithombe zokubulawa kukaNksz Nomfundo Msibi (30) zisabalale ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ngosuku lwesigameko, abantu bebabaza isihluku sikamsolwa, uMnuz Siphamandla Khumalo (34), ebhokoda ngommese umufi kubuka wonke umuntu.Elandisa, uMbatha uthe umufi bese kunesikhashana ebuqedile ubudlelwano bakhe noKhumalo, anezingane ezimbili naye.Uveze ukuthi uKhumalo ubengafuni nokuyizwa leyo, njengoba ebehlale eshayela ucingo umufi kodwa azizibe izingcingo zakhe.Uthe ngoMgqibelo, umsolwa uvele waba yiphela endlebeni kumufi nakuye uMbatha, ethi ufuna kuyokhishwa i-lay-by yakhe yejakhethi eGateway.UMSOLWA uMnuz Siphamandla Khumalo ngesikhathi evela eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini, ngecala lokubulala unina wezingane zakhe enxanxatheleni yezitolo iGateway Isithombe: Sibonelo Ngcobo"Wayenike uNomfundo imali ezinyangeni ezintathu ezedlule ukuthi ayomenzela yona ngomazisi wakhe. Kuthe esebona eziba izingcingo zakhe, wagcina eseshayela mina ucingo, ethi ufuna ayomkhiphela,” kusho uMbatha.Uthe umufi ubemanqikanqika ukuya, ethi akazizwa kahle ngalolu hambo.Uthe wuye (uMbatha) omncengile ukuthi ahambe ayoyikhipha, khona kuzobonakala ukuthi uma ephinda eshaya uzobe esefunani.UMSOLWA uMnuz Siphamandla Khumalo ngesikhathi evela eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini, ngecala lokubulala unina wezingane zakhe enxanxatheleni yezitolo i-Gateway Isithombe: Sibonelo Ngcobo"Ungicele ukuthi ngikhulume naye, ngimtshele ukuthi okungenani akathumele umfowabo, angazizeli yena. Uthembisile ukuthi uzokwenza njalo kodwa bagcine befika bobabili,” kubeka uMbatha.Uqhube wathi uyalele umufi ukuthi angahambi yedwa, aphelezelwe wumngani, ukuze amvikele."Sizwa kuthiwa ingxabano iqale khona ngaphandle kwesitolo isikhishiwe ijakhethi, umsolwa ebuza ukuthi kungani uNomfundo eziba izingcingo zakhe?” usho kanje.Uthe bona bezwe sebeshayelwa wuye umngani obehamba nomufi edinda esikaNandi ethi: "Nangu emgwaza, ephindelela.”Uthe babuze ukuthi ukhuluma ngani, wabatshela ukuthi umsolwa ubulala umufi.Uthe phambilini, ubudlelwano babo bebubuhle kodwa mumva nje bese bunodlame, umsolwa esehlale eshaya umufi, waze wathatha isinqumo sokumala.Uthe bakholelwa ukuthi ubekuhlelile ukumbulala njengoba ubemphathele ummese amgwaze ngawo.Uveze ukuthi ingane yabo endala, yashona eminyakeni edlule ineminyaka eyisikhombisa, kanti ephilayo ineminyaka emihlanu.Kuthiwa umufi obeseqashe kwa-Q eMlaza, ubeseshintshe amahlandla amabili imiqasho abehlala kuyo ebalekela yena umsolwa. Umufi owaseHlophenkulu, kanti umsolwa owaKwaMinyamanzi KwaNongoma, kanti babehlala ndawonye ubudlelwano busahamba kahle. Umsolwa ubesebenza ezinkontilekeni, umufi ebamba amatoho. Enkantolo, umsolwa ungene esagqoke isikibha esinamachaphazelo egazi, okukholakala ukuthi wayesigqoke ngesikhathi ehlasela umufi.Imantshi, uMnuz Ashwin Singh, ilihlehlisele uLwesine oluzayo, icala ukuze umsolwa afake isicelo sebheyili. UMbuso uveze ukuthi uzosiphikisa isicelo sebheyili, ngokusabela ukuphepha kofakazi nobucayi becala.Emva kwesigameko, amaphoyisa abopha umsolwa nomfowabo, Isolezwe elinalo igama lakhe, kodwa ugcine engavelanga enkantolo izolo, njengoba kuvele ukuthi igama lakhe libuye lahoxiswa ecaleni.
UMNYANGO waManzi nokuThuthwa kweNdle kuzwelonke, uzodlulisela kwikhabhinethi umthetho ochitshiyelwe okholwa ukuthi uzolekelela ekutheni kuhlinzekelwe ngendlela efanele umphakathi ngamanzi. Bakholwa wukuthi i-Water Services Amendment Bill, izoqinisekisa ukuthi izinkampani ezinikezwe umsebenzi wokuhlinzeka umphakathi ngamanzi, zinezimvume.Lokhu kudalulwe nguNgqongqoshe womnyango uNksz Pemmy Majodina esithangamini nabezindaba ebesisePitoli izolo, okuthiwa bekuhloswe ngaso ukwenekela umphakathi ngamaqhinga umnyanoo onawo ukulwa nengwadla yokushoda kwamanzi kuleli.UNksz Majodina uthe umnyango wakhe usebenza ngokubambisana nowezokuBusa ngokuBambisa neziNdaba zoMdabu kuzwelonke kanye nowezeziMali ukuthi bathole isisombululo sokushoda kwamanzi okubukeka kukhahlameza omasipala abaningi."Izinga lokuphakela amanzi komasipala nokuthuthwa kwendle liyaqhubeka nokwehla. Sizokwethula lo mthetho ochitshiyelwe kozakwethu kwikhabhinethi ngaphambi kokuthi udluliselwe ephalamende. Uzophoqa ukuthi izinkampani eziphakela umphakathi ngamanzi zibe nezimvume zokusebenza kulula. Kuzonika abasemandleni ilungelo lokuthi babhekisise ukuthi izinkampani ezinikezwa umsebenzi wokuhlinzeka ngamanzi, zinamava adingekayo ahlangabezana nokwenza lo msebenzi,” usho kanje.Uthe ngaphambi kokuthi banikezwe umsebenzi, kuzobhekwa ukuthi banazo yini izimvume ezibavumela ukusebenza.Ukuvaleka kwamanzi, ikakhulu komasipala abakhulu kubalwa nowaseThekwini, kushiye inqwaba yamalungu omphakathi ekhathazekile ngoba kwezinye izindawo amanzi aphuma ngezikhathi ezithile kuphela, kanti kwezinye awasaziwa.UNksz Majodina uthe umnyango wakhe usebenzisana nezinkampani ezizimele neminye iminyango kahulumeni ukuqinisekisa ukushintshwa kamapayipi amadala, avuzayo komasipala abakhulu ngoba ukuchitheka kwamanzi ngalolu hlobo yikhona okuyimbangela yokulahleka kwamanzi amaningi nokuyinto elimaza umnotho.Mayelana nokuthuthwa kwendle, uthe umnyango wakhe usebenza kanzima ukususa uhlelo olubizwa nge-bucket system (ukuthutha indle ngebhakede), elenziwa kwezinye izifundazwe. Uthe umnyango usebenze nabacwaningi ukuthola izindlela ezilula nezinesithunzi zokuthuthwa kwendle okuwuhlelo oluzoqinisekisa ukuthi azikho izitamkoko ezivuzayo futhi lukwazi ukonga amanzi.
UNGQONGQOSHE wezamaPhoyisa, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, uxwayise ngokuthi zizoqhubeka nokuhlangana nezimbila zithutha izigebengu ezizama ukudubula amaphoyisa uma efuna ukuzibopha.UMchunu uthe amaphoyisa azoqhubeka nokuzivikela ezigebengwini ezinqaba ukuboshwa.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba abalikanise emhlanganweni wesigungu esiphezulu kwi-ANC, i-lekgotla, eBoksburg.UMchunu uvikele amaphoyisa asolwa ngokuqinisa isandla uma ebhekene nezigebengu, wathi ngeke asonge izandla uma ezithola ebhekene nezigelekeqe eziwadubulayo."Ngifisa ukukhipha isexwayiso ebantwini noma emaqenjini emigulukudu, ukuthi uma ukhomba amaphoyisa ngesibhamu, uwadubule, ungacabangi ukuthi amaphoyisa azokubuka. Amaphoyisa kufanele azivikele.”Amaphoyisa agxekile ikakhulukazi KwaZulu-Natal emva kokwanda kwezigameko zabasolwa abashona kuthiwa bebedubulana namaphoyisa.Bangu-32 abasolwa ababulewe amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal kulezi zinyanga ezimbili ezedlule.UMchunu uthe awukho umyalelo wokuthi amaphoyisa kufanele aqothe izigebengu, wathi ayikho into asuke ezoyenza uma edutshulwa izigebengu."Amaphoyisa nawo angabantu, awaqhumanga etsheni, angobaba nomama ezinganeni zawo, angabayeni namakhosikazi, anezihlobo zawo eziwathandayo. Ngakho-ke kufanele azivikele. Awakwazi ukuvele azinikelele ezigebengwini.”UMchunu uthe amaphoyisa kufanele azivikele ngazo zonke izindlela, wathi ayadingeka empini yokulwa nobugebengu."Amaphoyisa kufanele azivikele ukuze ezokwazi ukuqhubeka nokuvikela imiphakathi kusasa. Amaphoyisa kufanele aziphephise ukuze ezokwazi ukusivikela. Siyawagqugquzela amaphoyisa ukuthi aqhubeke nokuzivikela, futhi siyayeseka imizamo yawo yokulwa nobugebengu.”UMchunu uthe amaphoyisa aya ezigamekweni azi kahle kamhlophe ukuthi abhekene nezigebengu eziyingozi, wathi ezinye zazo zisuke ziwafungele amaphoyisa."Amaphoyisa asuke ephethe ulwazi oluphelele ngendawo asuke eya kuwo futhi asuke ebazi kahle kamhlophe abantu asuke ebafuna ukuthi bayingozi. Kunesigameko nje esenzeka KwaDlangezwa, lapho khona amaphoyisa aya azi ukuthi kukhona izigebengu eziyingozi emzini othile."Vele amaphoyisa asuke azi ukuthi izigebengu angeke ziwenzele itiye uma efika. Izigebengu uma zifaka izinhlamvu, zisuke zisho kahle ukuthi zifuna ukudubula amaphoyisa. Ziyazi ukuthi abantu abazilwisi, abantu benza konke okushiwo yizigebengu uma bekhonjwe ngezibhamu. Lezo zinhlamvu zisuke zizodubula amaphoyisa.”UMchunu uthe i-ANC izimisele nokulwa nobelelesi obudla lubi.

EZOMHLABA: Kubikwa ukuthi ubesekhathele ukucefezelwa ngokuganwa owesilisa obulale umakhelwane wakhe obehlezi ebuza ukuthi uganwa nini njengoba esena-45 kodwa lutho umalokazana.Ngokwemibiko yabezindaba e-Indonasia, lesi sehlo senzeke ngomhla ka-29 Julayi nonyaka eeTapanili eNorth Sumatra lapho umsolwa uParlindungan Siregar, 45, ehlasele umakhelwane wakhe u-Asgim Irianto, 60, emqqema ngepulangwe ekhanda.Ukhomishana wamaphoyisa uMaria Marpaung uthi umgilwa waphuma wabaleka ngemuva kokuhlaselwa uSiregar kodwa wawa, umsolwa waqhubeka nokumshaya kwaze kwangenelela abanye omakhelwane balamula."Umgilwa waphuthunyiswa esibhedlela esiseduze nokuyilapho ashonela khona. Umsolwa ulivumile icala ngesikhathi eboshwa ngemuva kwesigameko,” kusho uMarpaung.
UKUNCELISA ingane ibele uma ungumama osemncane akukwenzi ungabi sezintweni.Lokhu kushiwo uMphathiswa wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal, uNksz Nomagugu Simelane ngesikhathi ekhuthaza omama abasebancane ukuthi bancelise izingane zabo ibele. Lona ngumyalelo ohambisana nesonto lokugqugquzela omama ukuthi bancelise izingane ibele emhlabeni, iWorld Breastfeeding Week, eqale ngoLwesine ngeledlule ephela ngoLwesithathu."Nginxusa omama abancane ukuba bangaphuci izingane zabo inzuzo enkulu yobisi lwebele ngenxa yokwesaba ukuthi bangase babonakale sengathi abekho ezintweni noma badla ngoludala," kusho uMphathiswa.Uqhube wathi izingane ezincela ibele kuphela izinyangeni eziyisithupha zokuqala (ngaphandle kokunikezwa amanzi, ubisi oluyimpuphu, olunye ubisi noma ukudla) zithola inzuzo eningi yezempilo ngoba ziba namasosha omzimba aqinile, zinamathuba amancane okuthi zihlaselwe izifo okubalwa kuzo isifo sokungaphefumuli kahle, ukutheleleka ngesifo sofuba / i-pneumonia, isifo sohudo, isifuba somoya, ukukhuluphala ngokweqile, noma isifo sikashukela utype1."Ubisi lwebele luqukethe yonke imisoco edingwa ngumntwana. Uma izingane zincela ibele kuphela amasosha azo omzimba ayaqina aphebeze izifo uma ziqhathaniswa nezingane ezincela ibhodlela noma olunye ubisi," kusho uMphathiswa.Uphinde wanxusa omama abancelisa ibele, abanobisi oluningi ukuthi banikele ngalo ukuze basize izingane ezisengozini ezizalwe ngaphambi kwesikhathi nezigulayo kanye nomama abangakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngobisi olwanele lwezingane zabo ezilaliswe esibhedlela."Izibhedlela zethu eziningi zine-Human Milk Bank, ehlola, iqoqe, icubungule bese isabalalisa ubisi lwebele. Sicela abancelisayo ukuthi bakucabange ukunikela ngobisi lwebele, ukuze basize izingane ezingalutholi ubisi konina. Ngale ndlela bangasiza abampofu, futhi babanikeze isipho esiyigugu sempilo enhle, isipho sokuphila.” kusho uMphathiswa Omama abangakwazi ukunikela ngobisi lwabo kwiMilk Bank, abangabhemi, abangaphuzi, abangasebenzisi izidakamizwa, abaphila kahle, abazimisele ukuhlolelwa iHIV, isifo sofuba, iHepatitis B, ugcusula nezinye izifo. Izibhedlela ezinama-Milk Bank iPrince Mshiyeni Memorial, Addington, Grey’s, Victoria Mxenge (King Edward VIII), RK Khan, Ladysmith, Newcastle, Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central, Harry Gwala Regional, Port Shepstone, Queen Nandi Memorial, Murchison, General Justice Gizenga Memorial, Mahatma Gandhi Memorial neChrist the King. Ezibhedlela iDr Pixley ka-Isaka Seme Memorial, Charles Johnson Memorial, Manguzi, Showe, neVryheid asakhiwa.
ISANTACO KwaZulu-Natal ikhuthaze osomatekisi ukuthi basebenzise izinhlaka nemigudu yangaphakathi embonini yamatekisi ukuxazulula izinkinga kungaze kukapakele emiphakathini.Lokhu kuza emuva kwemibhikisho ebinodlame ezingxenyeni ezehlukene esifundazweni.UMphathi weHhovisi leSantaco eKZN, uMnuz Sfiso Shangase, uthe osomatekisi kumele bakhanyiselwe ukuthi imboni isebenza kanjani"Uma ningaboni ngaso linye akumele uyogovuza umphakathi ningene emgwaqweni ekubeni wazi kahle ukuthi kusetshenzwa kanjani. Uma kunenselelo, asisombulule izinto ngemigudu okuyiyona yona esikwazi ukuphila ngayo kwezokuthutha,” kusho uShangase.Usho kanjena nje ibibambene ngezihluthu embonini yamatekisi phakathi kososeshini bamatekisi oLundi nasoPhongolo.UShangase uthe abathole ukuthi kususe udweshu wukuthi bekukhona osomatekisi abebefuna ukusebenzela ngasemakubo ngaphandle kokulandela imigudu efanele. Uthe embonini akusetshenzwa kanjalo kunemithetho eyilawulayo okumele ilandelwe."Kukhona abebefaka amatekisi abo ngenkani bethi akukwazi ukuthi ngasemakubo kusebenze abantu bakwezinye izindawo. Bese kuba nososeshini ababili abebefuna ukusebenza ngenkani,” kusho uShangase.UShangase uthe umuntu ofuna ukufaka itekisi kusoseshini kumele aqale abheke ukuthi sikhona yini isikhala bese efaka isicelo.Uqhube wathi uma kuvuleka izikhala uyafakwa lowo asebenze.Imibhikisho yangenyanga edlule iphoqe iSantaco ukuthi ithathe isinqumo sokuthi ngoSepthemba ihambele zonke izifunda zamatekisi eKZN, ikhulume nabemboni yamatekisi emazingeni aphansi kososeshini.Isola ukuthi izinqumo ezithathwa abaholi ezingeni lesifundazwe azifiki kososeshini okungenye yezinto ezidala udungunyane.UMnyango wezokuThutha eKZN uthe uzosiqapha ngeso lokhozi isimo kuleya ndawo usebenzisana neSantaco.Umnyango uthe umdonsiswano obusudonse iminyaka emibili ugcine sewuba umbhikisho womphakathi kwavalwa imigwaqo eMayiwane, oLundi ngenyanga edlule.
UMPHATHISWA woMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana KwaZulu-Natal, ukhathazekile ngokwehluleka kobuholi bukaMasipala uMdoni ukulungisa izinkinga.UMphathiswa womnyango uMfundisi Thulasizwe Buthelezi, uhambele umasipala okhungethwe yizinkinga eseziholele ekutheni kube nemibhikisho ehlukene ngaphansi kwawo. Sekuphele amasonto amathathu amahhovisi kamasipala evaliwe ngenxa yemibhikisho yomphakathi neyabasebenzi bekhala ngenkohlakalo nezidingo zomphakathi ezingafiki kuwo."Umkhandlu wehluleke ukulandela izincomo njengokuyalela komthetho uSection 106, mayelana nombiko wophenyo olwenziwa umnyango ngo-2018, ngenkohlakalo kulo masipala. Ukungalandelwa kwalezo zincomo kuveza lo masipala njengongenandaba nenkohlakalo. Siyafisa ukubona umkhandlu ukusukumela ukuxazulula izinkinga umphakathi okhala ngazo. Ukusebenza ngokuvulelekile, ukubuyisela isimo sokuhanjiswa kwezidingo zomphakathi ngendlela kubalulekile," kusho uButhelezi.Uqhube wathi ikomiti lesigungu sokuphathwa kukamasipala kumele libambe iqhaza elibonakalayo ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi izinkinga zilungiswa ngokushesha nangempumelelo.UButhelezi uthe uzobhalela usomlomo kamasipala incwadi ezobe imnxusa ukuthi akangenelele, alungise izinkinga umphakathi okhala ngazo.
OKHULUMELA i-ANC, uMnuz Zuko Godlimpi, uthe uma abaholi bengashintshi ukwenza kuzophela nge-ANC esiphathe iNingizimu Africa iminyaka ewu-30.UGodlimpi uthe ukwehluleka kwe-ANC ukunqoba ngamalengiso okhethweni lwangoMeyi, kuyizinkomba zokuthi abantu bayidinelwe inhlangano.Uthe uma abaholi bengazisukumeli ngokushesha izinkinga ezikhungethe abantu bakuleli, i-ANC ngeke iphinde iphathe ngokuzimela.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba abakanise lapho kubanjelwe khona umhlangano wesigungu esiphezulu, i-lekgotla eBoksburg.UGodlimpi uthe i-ANC kufanele ibhukule, wathi uma ihluleka ukwenza lokho izozithola isenkingeni enkulu ukunalena ebhekene nayo manje."Asisekho isikhathi sokusinisa amahleza kwi-ANC. Sonke siyakubona lokho. Abantu bakhombisa ukuthi bazosikhipha ngomnyango uma siqhubeka kanje. Umyalezo owathunyelwa abantu ngesikhathi kunokhetho, ucacile. Abantu bathi yebo bayakuqonda ukuthi i-ANC inemigomo emihle. Into abantu abakhala ngayo ukuthi i-ANC iyadembesela, ayiyilandeli imigomo yayo emihle. "Uma ukhuluma nabantu uyabona ukuthi bayayazi imigomo ye-ANC, into nje abakhala ngayo ukuthi imigomo ayilandelwa. Manje ke kubalulekile ukuthi silungise isimo ngokushesha. Uma sehluleka ukulungisa isimo, sizolahlekelwa amandla.”Uthe enye yezinkinga ezikhona kwi-ANC ukungathathelwa izinyathelo kwabantu abenza okuphambene nomthetho."Into ehlezi ishiwo abantu lapha ngaphandle ukuthi i-ANC ihlezi ikwazi ukubona ukuthi inkinga ikuphi, kodwa iyehluleka ukuthatha izinyathelo. Sonke siyavuma ukuthi manje uma kukhona abaphambana nomthetho noma abahlulwa ukwenza umsebenzi, kuzofanele bathathelwe izinyathelo. Asikwazi ukuthula sibuke umsebenzi ungenziwe. Silahlekelwe amandla ngenxa yokungazisukumeli izinkinga.”UGodlimpi uveze ukungena kwe-ANC ngaphansi kohulumeni wokubambisana angeke kuyishintshe imithetho kahulumeni evele ikhona."Yonke imithetho kahulumeni ekhona njengamanje izoqhubeka nokusebenza. Imithetho okufanele yesekwe amaqembu esibambisene nawo ileyo ezoshaywa manje njengoba sekuphethe uhulumeni wokubambisana.”UGodlimpi uthe banethemba lokuthi wonke amadlelandawonye e-ANC azogcina eweseka uhulumeni wokubambisana.I-SACP isikusho kaningi ukuthi ayihambisani nokufakwa kwe-DA kuhulumeni wokubambisana.UGodlimpi uthe angeke bayivimbe i-SACP ekutheni igxeke lokho engahambisani nakho.I-lekgotla izophothulwa namhlanje.Izolo, kube namakhomishini abexoxa ngezihloko ezahlukene.
LUYINDABA egudwini kumalungu omphakathi eSakabuthu, eBulwer udaba lomfundi wentombazane waseNdabakazibuzwa High School okuthiwa ulwe nomunye kwagcina kuphuma isidumbu. Ngokuthola kweSolezwe, umufi uSnqobile Ngubane (16) obefunda uGrade 10 kulesi sikole uhilizisane nomunye umfundi afunda naye ekilasini bagcina sebebambana ngesidlozana.Isigameko kuthiwa senzeke ngoLwesihlanu phambi kwabanye abafundi nothisha.Kuthiwa ngesikhathi belwa umufi bamngqubuze kaningana kabuhlungu etsheni ngekhanda wopha kakhulu, waphuthunyiswa esibhedlela kwafike kwamenela.Usihlalo wesigungu esilawula isikole, uMnuz Ngubane (ongathandanga negama lakhe) usiqinisekisile lesi sigameko.Uthe bayakweshwama okwenzekile kulesi sikole. "Kuyaqala nje ngqa ukuthi kube nesigameko esifuze lesi emlandweni walesi sikole. Namanje sisathukile siyazibuza ukuthi ngempela kwenzekeni,'' usho kanje.Ugcizelele ukuthi abatholanga ukuthi ubuyini umnyombo wempi yabafundi ababili. Uthe bakhathazekile kakhulu ngokuthi kugcine kuphuma isidumbu egameni lokuthi kube nempi emagcekeni esikole.Omunye umzali ocele ukuba kugodlwe igama lakhe, uthe okubakhathaza kakhulu ukuthi uma bebabuza abanye abafundi ukuthi bekubangwani bathi kabazi."Sifuna ukuthola ukuthi abafundi bebebangani kodwa sihlulekile,'' usho kanje.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi abomndeni kamsolwa bahambile bayocela uxolo emndenini kamufi.Umthombo uveza ukuthi kube khona ukuxoxisana phakathi kwezinhlangothi zombili kwavunyelwana ngokuthi le bekuyimpi yezingane akumele igcine seyidala udungunyane phakathi kwale mindeni."Imindeni yomibili igcine ivumelana ngokuthi asikho isidingo sengxabano ngenxa yalesi simo,’’ usho kanje.Isolezwe lithole nokuthi lesi sigameko simhlukumezile kakhulu unina kamufi, kangangoba kuvela ukuthi akekho esimweni esikahle ngokomqondo.Isolezwe lizamile ukuxhumana naye kodwa belungangeni ucingo lwakhe. Umfundi osolwa ngokulimaza kabi omunye kuthiwa ukubo akazange alubhade esikoleni izolo.Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu Natal, uMnuz Muzi Mahlambi, uthe siyabethusa lesi sehlakalo.Ukhale kakhulu ngesihluku esesikhonjiswa ngabafundi kwabanye muva nje.Uthe sekuqala ukuba yinsakavukela manje ukuthi abafundi babulalane emagcekeni esikole.Uveze ukuthi ngalo isonto eledlule kube khona umfundi wasesikoleni saKwaNongoma ogwaze wabulala omunye emagcekeni esikole."UMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal uyazwelana kakhulu namalungu omndeni kamufi. Kuyacaca ukuthi inkulu inkinga ekhona ezikoleni zethu,’’ usho kanje.Umufi kuthiwa uzongcwatshwa kule mpelasonto.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda usiqinisekisile isigameko.Uthe amaphoyisa aseBulwer aphenya icala lokufa komfundi wentombazane oneminyaka engu-16."Umfundi kuvela ukuthi ushone ngemuva kokuba elimale kabi ekhanda kade exabane nozakwabo esikoleni. Isidumbu sizohlolwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi yini ngempela imbangela yokufa,'' usho kanje.
OJOYINE iqembu i-MK Party, uMnuz Canaan Mdletshe, uyifanise nentaba engcwele indawo yaseNkandla lapho kwakhe khona uMengameli waleli qembu. UMdletshe ukusho lokhu ngemuva kokwemukelwa "ngezandla ezimhlophe” umholi waleli qembu, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, emcimbini owenzeke khona Kwadakw’udunuse ngempelasonto. UMdletshe phambilini wayenguNobhala Jikelele we-NFP ngaphambi kokuthi uhlangothi lwakhe lwehluwe emdonsiswaneni owawusenkantolo. Uvumbuka kwi-MK nje usanda kushiya i-NFP ethi unengwa yisinqumo sayo sokubambisana ne-DA namanye amaqembu KwaZulu-Natal."INkandla isifana nentaba engcwele. Wonke umuntu ozizwa sengathi ucindezelekile, uya khona eNkandla eyokhuleka. Nami ngizizwa ngisekhaya lapha,” usho kanje uMdletshe.Elanidisa Isolezwe ngesinqumo sakhe, uMdletshe uthe umbono womsunguli we-NFP, uNkk Zanele KaMagwaza-Msibi, nawo umholele kwi-MK.Uthe ngesikhathi uKaMagwaza-Msibi, esungula i-NFP ngo-2011, wayefuna ukwakha iqembu lezepolitiki elizokuba yikhaya labantu abahluphekile nabanganakiwe."Uma uzobheka i-MK, uzobona ukuthi nayo inombono ofanayo nalona njengoba ibeka phambili abantu. Kucacele noma ubani ukuthi i-MK iyona eyithemba labantu. Noma ungabuza noma yimuphi umuntu waKwaZulu-Natal noma eNingizimu Afrika, bazokutshela ukuthi wonke amathemba abo akuZuma, bazokutshela ukuthi angeke kuhlale kunje.”Nakuba uMdletshe ethe akuzange kube yisinqumo esilula ukuthi ashiye i-NFP ngenxa yomlando anawo enhlanganweni, uthe kube lula ukuthi ajoyine i-MK ayifanise nompheme wokuphephela.Izembe lihlezi liloliwe kwi-MK njengoba sebebaningi abaholi asebexoshiwe okubalwa kubo nowabhalisa le nhlangano ngokusemthethweni, uMnuz Jabulani Khumalo. Kamuva nje izembe lidle isethenjwa ebesinguNobhala Jikelele uMnuz Arthur Zwane.Kepha uMdletshe uthe yena angeke ahlale ngesinqe esisodwa, wathi indlela ethulwe ngayo itshengise ukuthi wamukelekile eqenjini.UMdletshe wethulwe ngendlela engejwayelekile njengoba ethulwe nguZuma phambi kwabalandeli be-MK Party. Akubona bonke abaholi abafike kanje kuleli qembu.Injabulo ibibhalwe emehlweni kuZuma ngesikhathi ethula uMdletshe."Ingithobisile kakhulu indlela engethulwe ngayo. Ukuba le nto ibiyenzeka ngo-12 ebusuku, bengizokuthi mhlawumbe ngiyaphupha. Inhlokomo ebe khona ikhombise ukuthi ngamukelwa ngisho nangamadlozi e-MK. Ngizohlala ngokukhululeka, angizukulokhu ngiqalaza ngoba ngiyazi ukuthi ngamukelekile.”UMdletshe uthe akazange ahehwe ngesikhundla ukuba ajoyine i-MK."Nami futhi asikho isikhundla engike ngahlebeza ukuthi ngiyasifuna. Ngiyakuqonda ukuthi ukuze iqembu liqine emazingeni aphansi, kufanele kube nabantu abakhona. Kodwa-ke uma kukhona lapho iqembu elifuna ukungithuma khona, angeke nginqabe.”
LIDLULISELWE eNkantolo eNkulu yasePort Shepstone icala lomfundi osolwa ngokuba umalugaju obevele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMzumbe.Le nkantolo inqume ukuthi umsolwa ona-17 waseMthwalume avele enkantolo engenhla kusasa.Ubhekene necala lokuzama ukubulala, ukushaya ngenhloso yokwenza ucansi nokuthumba umfundi oneminyaka eyisithupha okuthiwa wamcathamela ephuma esikoleni wamhudulela esikhotheni wazama ukumdlwengula. Kukholakala ukuthi wamgqema ngetshe ekhanda wamshiya ecabanga ukuthi ufile.Umsolwa, okuvela ukuthi ubefunda u-grade 9 kwesinye sezikole ezikule ndawo ngesikhathi eboshwa, zimkhalele ngenyanga edlule emva kokuthathwa amalungu omphakathi amnikela emaphoyiseni.Kuthiwa uphinde wavuma icala lokubulala uSinethemba Ngcece (8) waseMakhoso khona eMthwalume, naye okukholakala ukuthi walandelwa ngendlela efanayo njengoba isidumbu sakhe kuthiwa satholwa abafana ababebhukuda silahlwe osebeni lomfula, sihlinziwe futhi sesiqala ukonala. USinethemba wayesenamasonto amathathu enyamelele.Emasontweni adlule inkantolo iphinde yengeza icala lokubulawa kukamgilwa kulawa abhekene nawo umsolwa. Ngesikhathi evela bekuvunyelwe kuphela ilungu lomndeni wakhe, okuthiwa yingoba usemncane ngokweminyaka, usengaphansi kwesandla sabazali. Okhulumela inhlangano elwa nokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane endaweni, i-Women of Mthwalume, uNkk Bongekile Sithole, uthe imindeni yabagilwa ibiziwe yaziswa ngesinqumo senkantolo. Bakholwa ukuthi njengoba selidluliselwe eNkantolo eNkulu, sebezovunyelwa ukwethamela icala.
UNDUNANKULU waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, uphosele abomthetho esifundazweni inselelo yokubhekana ngqo nabantu bokufika abahweba ngendlela engekho emthethweni, ukuzama ukunqoba ukwanda kwezenzo zobugebengu obudlangile.UNtuli ubeyisikhulumi sosuku engqunqutheleni ebiyenzelwe ukubhunga ngamasu angasetshenziswa ukulwa nobugebengu, iKZN Social Crime Prevention Summit ebise-Olive Convention Centre, eThekwini ngoLwesihlanu."Kumele kuphenywe izitolo zabokufika ikakhulu lezo ezenza ubugebengu nakulezo zindawo eziyisizinda sokuqhuba umkhuba omubi wokushushumbisa izidakakamizwa,” usho kanje.Uthe okunye okuzosiza ukulwa nobugebengu eKZN wukuthi kuqiniswe uhlelo lwezivimbamgwaqo emigwaqweni eyahlukene yesifundazwe, ukusiza ukubheka izigebengu ezishushumisa izidakamizwa nezihwebelana ngezikhali ngokungekho emthethweni. Uthe: "Akumele umuntu asuke eThekwini aze ayongena eJozini, engakaze amiswe nakanye emgwaqweni ngoba yilokho okudala ukuthi izigebengu zicanaze, zizibona zikhululekile”’UNdunankulu udalule nokuthi yena nethimba asebenzisana nalo bazohambela zonke izifunda zaseKZN, kanjalo nezindawo eziyizizinda zobugebengu ukushumayela ivangeli lokulwa nobugebengu, futhi bazimisele ukusebenzisana nomphakathi."Akumele sizibe ukuthi iKZN ingesinye sezifundazwe ezenza kwande ubugebengu ezweni. Ngeke siwushaye indiva umthelela omubi walokho njengoba kumanje sekuvele kunosomabhizinisi nabatshalimali abashiyayo esifundazweni sethu ngenxa yobugebengu. Lokho okuzodala ukuthi kulahleke amathuba emisebenzi, kuphinde kubhebhetheke ubugebengu,” usho kanje.UNtuli ugcizelele nokuthi kukho konke okwenziwayo, kumele kubekwe abesifazane nezingane phambili, ikakhulu njengoba sekuqale inyanga yokuqhakambisa imbokodo ezweni."Kuyadumaza ukubona kuqhubeka izigameko zokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane njengoba sizwile ngokwenzeke kuthisha wesifazane odutshulwe, wafa phambi kwezingane azifundisayo kwesinye sezikole zaseThekwini. Yizo zonke izinto okumele silwe nokuzinqoba lezo. Asikwazi ukuhlala singenzi lutho kube konakala kangaka emphakathini wethu,” kusho undunankulu.Ushayele ihlombe umsebenzi owenziwa ngamaphoyisa wokubopha izigebengu, wathi: "Awaqhubeke ayibambe kanjalo futhi angathandeli izandla uma izigebengu zingafuni ukuthobela umthetho. Iphoyisa ngeke lithandele izandla uma isigebengu sihlulwa wukuthobela umthetho. "’Nomphakathi awubambisane nathi kukho konke lokhu ngoba iqiniso wukuthi izigebengu zinathi emphakathini. Asingathuli sibe sibona konokala phambi kwethu,” kusho uNtuli.

UKUKHULA kowesifazane emndenini owenza izinto ngendlela yesimanje, futhi ongagxili kwezesintu kungenza kube nzima uma eganela emndenini oqhakambisa indlela nemikhuba yokwenza kwesintu.Wukuqonda nokuqaphela lokho okwenze umbhali wezincwadi, uNelly Page Magwaza wabhala incwadi esihloko sithi Can We Get Married? ukukhuthaza futhi acebise imbokodo ukuthi ingavumi ukwenza izinto eziyicindezelayo ngoba ijabulisa abasemzini.Lo mbhali wodumo lwencwadi yakhe yokuqala yango-2021, ethi The Beloved MaShenge, useqede konke ngalena yesine ezoqala ukutholakala ezitolo ezahlukene zezincwadi ngesonto elizayo.IKHAVA yencwadi entsha kaNelly Page Magwaza Isithombe: SITHUNYELWEElandisa Isolezwe Ngempelasonto ngale ncwadi, uNelly uthe ixoxa indaba yomfana okhulele emakhaya, ozalelwe esithenjini. Lowo mfana uhlangana nentombazane ekhulele emndenini ocebile, futhi onganaki kangako okwesintu, bathandane, ayicele umshado."Ingqikithi nesifundo sendaba kuba lapho lo mfana eseyisa intombi yakhe kubo, bangayithandi abakubo ngoba becasulwa wukuthi ayikhulanga njengabo."Yilapho okuzogqama khona isifundo sokuthi abesifazane akumele bavumele abanye abantu ukuthi babenzise izinto abangahambisani nazo ngoba nakhu beganile,” kusho uNelly.Lo mbhali odabuka eMandeni, nonabalandeli abangaphezu kwa-200 000 kwiFacebook, uthe okunye okuhle nokuzojabulisa abantu ngale ncwadi wukuthi ibhalwe ngendlela efundeka kalula nexutshwe namahlaya."Lokho ngikwenze ngoba ngifuna kube lula kumfundi ukuyiqonda futhi ayilandele kahle, ikakhulu ngoba mina ngithwale kanzima ngiyibhala ngoba bengibheke nezimo zempilo, ngibala nokhwantalala obekwenza ngingakwazi ukuyiqeda ngokushesha, njengoba kungithathe iminyaka emibili ukuyiqeda,” usho kanje.UNelly (28) uneziqu zePsychology aziphothule e-Unisa ngo-2022, kanti manje wenza unyaka wokuqala we-Information Technology, kuyo le nyuvesi.Uthe nakuba umshado kungesiyo into ayigijimisayo nengabusi umqondo wakhe okwamanje, uyowamukela uma impilo imubeka kuleso sigaba. Ukhuthaze amantombazane asemancane ukuthi akuthande ukufunda izincwadi futhi ayikhuthalele imfundo. Uthe into okumele ibe seqhulwini entombazaneni ekhulayo wukuzithuthukisa nokuthatha isikhathi iziqonda uqobo ngaphambi kokuba ingene kwezinye izigaba zempilo njengokugana.I-Can We Get Married? inamakhasi awu-315, kanti yelama incwadi yakhe yesibili neyesithathu, ezisihloko sithi Sabatha: The Begetter yango-2021 neDear Khethelo ephume ngo-2022.
BASASHAQEKILE namanje abazibonele owesilisa egwaza ebulala okusolwa ukuthi uyintombi yakhe ngeSonto, enxanxatheleni yezitolo iGateway, eMhlanga, eThekwini.Kulesi sigameko kushone owesifazane oneminyaka engu-30, kwaboshwa abesilisa ababili, okuthiwa kubona kukhona isoka likamufi.Ozibonele senzeka isigameko, wacela ukungadalulwa, uthe kusuke ingxabano phakathi kukamsolwa nomufi ngesikhathi behambisana bebheke erenki yamatekisi."Kubonakele ukuthi kukhona abaphikisana ngakho, yize singeke sazi ukuthi bebephikisana ngani. Sithe sibona lona wesilisa, wabe edonsa ummese egwaza umufi, kwatshaza igazi ngaso leso sikhathi,” kusho umthombo.Uqhube wachaza ukuthi umufi uvele waphelela lapho kanti ubegwazwe endaweni embi. Uthe bekukhona abantu nezingane ezincane eduze kwendawo yesigameko nokwenze ukuthi kuthuke wonke umuntu."Namanje asiyikholwa leya nto,” kusho umthombo.Uthe umsolwa usheshe waboshwa ngoba isehlo senzeke enxanxatheleni yezitolo lapho kunenqwaba yononogada.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi umsolwa ubehamba nomngani wakhe.IMenenja yezokukhangisa enxanxatheleni yezitolo uNkk Ayesha Sewbaran, isiqinisekisile isigameko yathi senzeke eduze kwerenki yamatekisi emini ngeSonto.Wathi inxanxathela yezitolo ikubeka phambili ukuphepha kwabathengi yikho udaba selwedluliselwe emaphoyiseni ukuthi aluphenye."Abenzi bobubi baboshiwe ngamaphoyisa, ngebhadi umgilwa ushonile. IGateway ithumela amazwi enduduzo emndenini kamgilwa nabangani,” kusho uNkk Sewbaran.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa aseDurban North, abophe abesilisa ababili oneminyaka engu-37, nengu-44 ngecala lokubulala owesifazane oneminyaka engu-30."Umufi ugwazwe waze wafa ngeSonto eMhlanga. Bobabili abasolwa bazovela eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini,” kusho uNetshiunda.Uqhube wathi imibiko ithe umgilwa nabasolwa babenengxabano, oyedwa wabasolwa wakhipha ummese wagwaza, wabulala umufi."Bazamile ukubaleka kodwa amaphoyisa ababopha,” kusho uNetshiunda.
KUSOLWA iqembu lemigulukudu elihlalise lubhojozi umphakathi waKwaMashu, elingena izikole liphange othisha futhi ligebenge abasebenzisa umgwaqo uDumisani Makhaye.Lokhu kuvezwe umthombo weSolezwe osezinhlakeni zezokuphepha ocele igama lawo ligodlwe.Uveze ukuthi laba besilisa bafike benze ukuganga bese beyabaleka bayocasha ehostela laKwaMashu.Esehlakalweni sakamuva kuthiwa bajamelane namaphoyisa amabili angabaseshi akade ezolanda iselula ebikadwe ikhuthuzwe umuntu ebizisho ukuthi isehostela."Iqulu lezigebengu, ebelihlome ngezibhamu, livele lawagolozela amaphoyisa okudingeke ukuthi ahlabe umkhosi abize amanye kwayimande zidla phansi. Sezibhubhisile, zibamba nabantu emgwaqweni uDumisani Makhaye,” kubeka umthombo.Uqhube wathi izigebengu zisanda kungena esikoleni eMukelani Primary, zaphanga othisha amaselula nemali.Kuthiwa azigcinanga lapho, ziphinde zasebenzisa amaselula othisha zazithumelela imali ngohlelo lwe-app. Kulowo mnyama kuthiwa othisha bebekhonjwe ngezibhamu.Isolezwe selibike kaningi ngobugebengu okuthiwa bugubuzele ihostela laKwaMashu nokubulawa kwabantu. Uma kukhona abakusolayo bashayele ucingo amaphoyisa noma bazame izindlela zokuthi baphephe. Bangazami ukuphindisela ezigebengwini,” kusho uNetshiunda.Mayelana nemibiko ethi abantu ababodwa abenza lobu bugebengu elokishini laKwaMashu, uNetshiunda uthe uma kwenzeka ubugebengu amaphoyisa ashona khona bese eyacubungula enze uphenyo kubhekwe nembangela.Uthe ihostela laKwaMashu bese lithule isikhathi eside ngoba basebenzisana nabantu abahlala ngaphakathi kulona."Uma kunezigilamkhuba kunoma iliphi ihostela, eziphuma zenze ubugebengu ngaphandle, abantu abanikeze amaphoyisa lolo lwazi khona ezoya eyozibopha,” kusho uNetshiunda.

IMANTSHI ikhale ngendlela enesihluku okubulawe ngayo intombazane eneminyaka engu-14 ngesikhathi inqabela ibheyili unina ongumsolwa ecaleni lokubulala.Kuthiwa isidumbu sikamufi uLuvuyo Tafadzwe Bera besikade sinamanxeba amathathu okushaywa ngento ethile esiphundu futhi sinezibazi zokuklinywa.Kube sekuboshwa uNksz Ncamisile Evarista Hlophe (43) obehlala naye emzini okwa-D, KwaMashu.Umsolwa wenqatsheliwe ibheyili yiNkantolo yeMantshi yaseNtuzuma, ngoLwesihlanu, phambi komakhelwane abebethamele icala.IMantshi N Madlala ithe nakuba umufi esekobandayo kodwa uyabudinga ubulungiswa, umndeni wakhe ufuna izimpendulo ngakho ngumsolwa kuphela ongakwazi ukuphendula ukuthi kwenzakalani ngosuku lwesigameko."Leli yicala elingajwayelekile. Ulindele ukuthi umzali kube nguye onikeza ingane uthando. Ingane ibizokhula ilime indima ethile emphakathini kodwa yabulawa ngesihluku esikhulu,” kusho uMadlala.Uthe ngokunqaba kwakhe ibheyili akasho ukuthi umsolwa unecala noma umsulwa kodwa yinkantolo eyolalela icala lakhe eyokwahlulela uma seliphothuliwe.Umsolwa ubefake isicelo sebheyili wathi ufuna ukuyongcwaba umufi. Uveze nokuthi unebhizinisi lokupheka elimile ngoba esezikhindini. Kodwa akayihlinzekanga inkantolo amaphepha alo nokuthi lenza malini.UMbuso uthe unezitatimende zomakhelwane abezwa umsindo wengxabano phakathi kukamsolwa nomufi. Sekuthulekile, kuthiwa umsolwa waphumela ngaphandle wacela usizo lokutholelwa i-ambulensi komakhelwane.Abanye balabo makhelwane abangathandanga ukudalulwa amagama, bathe abamazi umsolwa enjena, bebemazi ngomuntu olungile ngakho kumele akhulume iqiniso ukuthi kwenzakalani.Kuthiwa ngoJulayi 22, umsolwa utshele amaphoyisa ukuthi umufi waphuza amaphilisi ekhanda wawa phansi esuka embhedeni ayekade elele kuwona.Kodwa emuva kokuhlolwa kwesidumbu kube sekuvulwa icala lokubulala sekutholakele ukuthi umufi akazishonelanga.Kuboshwe uNksz Hlophe obenguye kuphela obehlala nomufi, wathweswa icala lokubulala.UNksz Hlophe obegundile ekhanda efake nezibuko, akazange akhale, athukuthele noma akhombise ukudangala encishwa ibheyili.Icala libe selihlehliselwa ngasekupheleni kukaSepthemba, ukuze kuqhutshekwe nophenyo.
Kukhale izembe ebuholini be-ANC Youth League (ANCYL) ezifundazweni nasezifundeni obusolwa ngokwehluleka ukuhlela izingqungquthela zokukhetha ubuholi.Ikomiti elibhekele ukusebenza kwansuku zonke kwi-ANCYL lihlakaze ubuholi bezifundazwe nobezifunda, kwase kuqokwa ubuholi besikhashana.Ubuholi obuhlakaziwe bebuvele bungobesikhashana, babukade buqokelwe ukuba buhlele izingqungquthela zokukhetha ubuholi.Nokho izifundazwe nezifunda eziningi zihlulekile ukuhlela izingqungquthela zokukhetha ubuholi.Umhlangano wekomiti elibhekele ukusebenza kwansuku zonke kwi-ANCYL ubungesonto eledlule, unqume ukuthi zihlakazwe izinhlaka zesikhashana.Uhlu olukhishwe i-ANCYL luveza ukuthi iningi labaholi abebephethe phambilini abazange balibone elidlalayo ngesikhathi kuqokwa ubuholi obusha.Phezu kwezinguquko eziningi ezenziwe, obengumdidiyeli we-ANCYL KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Mqondisi Duma, usindile ezembeni.UNksz Lulame Mabude, uqokelwe kwesomgqugquzeli we-ANCYL esifundazweni.I-ANCYL KwaZulu-Natal isidonse ngobuholi besikhashana kusukela ngo-2021 emva kokuhlakazwa kobuholi bangaleso sikhathi obabuholwa uMnuz Kwazi Mshengu, owayengusihlalo, noMnuz Thanduxolo Sabelo, owayengunobhala.Amathimba e-ANCYL abehola esifundazweni phambilini ehluleka encama ukuhlela izingqungquthela, ezinye izingqungquthela zabhuntsha ngemizuzu yokugcina.Unobhala jikelele we-ANCYL , uMnuz Mntuwoxolo Ngudle, utshele ubuholi obusha ukuthi buhlalelwe umsebenzi wokuhlela ingqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi.Esitatimendeni, uNgudle uthe zonke izingqungquthela zokukhetha ubuholi kufanele zibanjwe ngaphambi kokuphela kukaFebhuwari."Nibhekene nomsebenzi wokulungiselela imihlangano yamagatsha lapho kuzophakanyiswa khona amagama abantu abazongenela imibango yezikhundla ezingqungqutheleni enizozihlela. Kufanele nenze isiqiniseko sokuthi yonke imigomo iyalandelwa, niphinde nenze isiqiniseko sokuthi kuphendulwa zonke izikhalo ezingase ziqhamuke ngesikhathi kuqhubeka amalungiselelo okuhlela izingqungquthela.”UNgudle uxwayise abaqokiwe ngokuthi bazokhishwa uma benza okuphambana nomthetho."Labo okuzotholakala ukuthi baphambana nalo mbhidlango wokwakha kabusha izinhlaka ze-ANCYL, bazokhishwa. Ikomiti elibhekele ukusebenza kwansuku zonke linikeze ihhovisi likanobhala jikelele amandla okukhipha abaphambana nomthetho ngaphandle kokuthi kuze kuthiwe abavele phambi kwekomiti eliqondisa ubugwegwe.”Esifundeni iTheku, umdidiyeli kuzoba uNksz Zama Mncube, umgqugquzeli kube uMnuz Ntokozo Ngcobo.Esifundeni iMoses Mabhida umdidiyeli kuzoba uMnuz Mthokozisi Ngidi, umgqugquzeli kube uMnuz Lungisani Mthalane.
Baphenduke ondinga sithebeni abomndeni obuqashise osolwa ngokubulala ingane (7), ngesikhathi beshiselwa umuzi eDumisani Makhaye, eMpangeni, ngoLwesine.Owomndeni, uNksz Samke Khumalo, udalule ukuthi emva kwalesi sehlo, baphoqelekile ukuthi bayokhosela kwezinye izindawo eziphephile.Echaza ngesigameko, uthe senzeke bengekho ekhaya."Bengisemaphoyiseni, ngashayelwa ucingo ngomunye umngani wami ethi ekhaya kuyasha,” kusho uNksz Khumalo.Uveze ukuthi umuzi wakubo uke wagadwa ngamaphoyisa usuku lonke emva kokutholakala kwesidumbu sikamufi, umphakathi ufuna ukuwucekela phansi."Babewujikijela ngamatshe, bezama ukuphihliza amawindi,” kusho uNksz Khumalo.Uthe kwangenelela amaphoyisa, ebakhuza ukuthi umnikazi womuzi akanacala futhi konke akuyekelwe ezandleni zawo."Sibona ukuthi anele ahamba, baqala phansi,” kusho uNksz Khumalo.Usole owesifazane ambize ngegama ethi wuye ophehle udweshu ezinkundleni zokuxhumana.Uthe lona wesifazane ubesabalalisa ulwazi olungelona, ethi ingane iqotshiwe yenziwa izicucu, nokuyinto athi igovuze umphakathi, baqala phansi badinwa.Uveze ukuthi umsolwa owayengasolisi, wayedabukisa njengawo wonke umuntu ngesikhathi kucingwa ingane.Uthe kwaze kwaba yintambama lapho amthumelela khona umyalezo, oyindida, naphuza ukuwubona ngenxa yokucisha kweselula, iphelelwe yi-battery.Uthe bekusaphele izinyanga ezintathu lona wesilisa eyisiqashi kubo, nokho wathi ubevame ukuchitha isikhathi esiningi emzini wentombi yakhe eyinesi.Uthe bekungakaze kube khona okusolisayo ngaye njengoba ebekhonze ngisho ezakubo (kaSamke) izingane ezineminyaka emine (eyintombazane) neyishumi (engumfana).Umthombo weSolezwe uveze ukuthi umphakathi ushise umuzi emva kokuzibuza imibuzo engaphenduleki ngesigameko."Kuningi umphakathi ozibuza khona. Isibonelo nje, ukuthi umastende waze nini ukuthi kunesidumbu sengane emzini wakhe?” kusho umthombo.Uthe umastende wathi ingane yaphuma yahamba emva kokuyithuma amaphilisi ezinhlungu."Umbuzo uthi, uma iphume yahamba, uyithole kanjani pho umfana ohlala ngasesangweni? Kunokushayisana kwezikhathi kusuka ngesikhathi umfana azicebe ngaso u-06.50pm ntambama kuze kuba umama (umastende) ubikela amaphoyisa ngoba esewabona,” kusho umthombo.Okhulumela umndeni kamufi, uMnuz Sandile Mhlongo, uthe akukho angakuphawula ngokushiswa komuzi ngaphandle kokuthi ababandakanyeki, isigameko senzeke bebematasa namalungiselelo omngcwabo.Umufi uZanokuhle Khumalo (7) ungcwatshwe ngeSonto. Waduka ngoMsombuluko, evakashele kwamastende. Isidumbu sakhe esasixhishwe kuplasitiki satholwa ngaphansi kombhede endlini yesiqashi, esagcina siboshwa, sesibalekile.
Usuthembele emaphoyiseni umndeni waKwaXimba, eCato Ridge, kulandela ukubulawa kwelungu lawo ngoLwesine, libulawelwa ophaqa bomngani.UMnuz Siboniso Hlophe (23) kuthiwa udutshulwe umsolwa owaziwayo, ekubo kamngani wakhe endaweni. Kulesi sigameko kuphinde kwalinyazwa abesilisa ababili abangabangani bakamufi. Kuthiwa kumanje kusekubi kubona njengoba besegumbini labagula kakhulu esibhedlela.Kuthiwa abomndeni baphuthume endaweni yesigameko emva kokuzwa kuqhuma isibhamu. Bathe uma befika khona bathola ukuthi abangani badutshuliwe."Sithe uma singena ngaphakathi, sathola ukuthi ababili balimele, oyedwa ubesakwazi ukuchaza ukuthi kwenzekeni kodwa uSiboniso ubesethule,” kusho uNksz Nomfundo Ndawonde okhulumela umndeni.Udalule ukuthi bathole ukuthi ingxabano yophaqa ibisinesikhashana yaqala. Uthe umsolwa wabaqhwaga kumngani kamufi emasontweni ambalwa edlule."Ngosuku lwesigameko, bahlangane naye ebagqokile, babafuna. Ugcine ngokubanika, wathi uma esekude, wamemeza wathi uzobuya nezinja zakhe,” kubeka uNksz Ndawonde.Uthe nangempela, umsolwa ubuyile esehamba nabangani bakhe, bafike badubula umufi nabangani bakhe. Abangani balimalile base bephuthunyiswa esibhedlela.Uthe umufi ubedutshulwe kwesingenhla nokwenza babone ukuthi umsolwa ubehlose ukumbulala.Uthe umfowabo omdala ongomunye wabagilwa, ubatshele ukuthi bebehleli endlini enkulu ngesikhathi bezwa kuqhuma isibhamu endlini engaphandle ebihleli abangani."Uthe bathe uma bephuma beyobheka babona izithunzi zabesilisa ziphuma zigijima, bazilandela, bezitshela ukuthi abangani bagijimisa izigebengu,” kusho yena.Uqhube wathi abasolwa baphele emehlweni, maqede abafowabo boyedwa wabagilwa babuyela ekhaya ukuyobheka ukuthi kwenzakaleni ngoba sekucaca ukuthi akubona abangani laba ababalandelayo.Uthe yilapho ke abazithele khona phezu komshophi wokuthi kanti abagilwa badutshuliwe endaweni yesigameko.Uthe ngokwazi kwabo abasolwa bebengakaboshwa, basagcwele amathafa.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa aseMsunduzi aphenya icala lokubulala namabili okuzama ukubulala., emuva kokubulawa koyewa kulinyazwe ababili KwaXimba ngoLwesine. Uthe ngokombiko abawutholile, laba abathathu bebehleli endlini ngesikhathi kutheleka abalisa ababili bavulela ngenhlamvu bebhekise kubona."Umgilwa oyedwa ushonele endaweni yesigameko, ababili baphuthunyiswa esibhedlela benamanxeba okudutshulwa,” kusho uNetshiunda.Uthe abasolwa abakaziwa okwamanje nembangela yokubulala ayikahlonzwa.
YIZE kube nesasasa kukhethwa izintombi nto ebandleni lamaNazaretha kuphela umhlangano kaJulayi, kuthiwa isibalo somama bezingane abakhethiwe sibe ngaphezulu kwesezintombi.Isolezwe Ngempelasonto, lithole ngomthombo walo ongaphakathi ukuthi bezenzeka esihlahleni kukhethwa omama bezingane abaziwa ngokuthi yizintombi zentethelelo.Ngokujwayelekile omama bezingane kuthiwa yibona abasuke beheha inhlalisuthi ukuthi ibakhethe kanti eSipholi, kusuke kuyinhlalisuthi esuke idla ngamabala."Njengoba isibalo sezintombi ezikhethiwe silinganiselwa ku-5 000, esezintombi zentethelelo cishe sibe ngaphezulu kwalesi. Inkinga ukuthi isihlahla akuyona into egunyaziwe kumaNazaretha njengoba lungakaze lube khona uhlelo lokukhethwa kwasebenezingane,” kusho umthombo.Okhulumela umholi wamaNazaretha inkosi Mduduzi Shembe uNyazilwezulu, uMnuz Thokozani Mncwabe, uthe noma ibekhona eyesihlahla kodwa akekho obenake okwenzeka khona kakhulu.IZINTOMBI nto okusuke kukhethwa kuzona uma inhlalisuthi ifuna ukuthatha amakhosikazi ebandleni lamaNazaretha Isithombe: SIGCINIWE"Njengoba kuyinto engamukelekile akekho okunakayo okwenzeka khona. Ngalokho asisho ukuthi akumele zikhethwe esezinezingane kodwa akulona uhlelo oluhambisana nenqubo yebandla. Ngenxa yokuthi sekuyinto eyenzekayo, sinxusa ukuthi nazo izintombi zentethelelo ziziphathe kahle. Uma izimisele ngokuyokhethwa ayihlale ilindile nayo ingayi esihlahleni inomuntu okhona empilweni yayo ngoba lokho kuzoqhatha inhlalisuthi. Awukwazi ukulinda usuku lokukhethwa ube ubambise ngomuntu. Uma kungukuthi ufuna ukukhethwa kumele ube wumuntu ongenaye umuntu,” kweluleka uMncwabe.Uthe umholi wamaNazaretha osewakhothama, inkosi Amos Kula Shembe Inyangayezulu, nguyena owetha asebenezingane bengagcagcile ukuthi bayizintombi zentethelelo. Uthe, wathi njengoba zithethelelwe kumele ziziphathe kahle zingakulibali ukuthi zisengamaNazaretha futhi zisenalo ilungelo lokuthi zingagana.Echaza ngezintombi nto ezikhethethiwe, ngokwenqubo yebandla lamaNazaretha akumele okhethe intombi kuphele iminyaka emibili engayilobolile."Empeleni usuke unonyaka owodwa obekelwe wona bese unikwa owesibili ukuthi wenze izinto ngendlela. Uma wehluleka kumenyezelwa ebandleni ukuthi sewehlulekile. Akufihlwa ubizwa ngegama lakho ukuthi wehlulekile okusho ukuthi intombi isingaphindela eSipholi iyokhethwa kabusha. Nayo intombi inalo ilungelo lokuthi iyokumangalela esontweni ukuthi sekuphele iminyaka emibili ungayilobolile. Umuntu okuze kucishe kube ngcono kuyena osuke ematasa elobola kungukuthi iyaphela iminyaka emibili engakaphothuli. Loyo uyazwelwa ngoba kusuke kubonakala ukuthi uzimisele inkinga iwona amandla kodwa ongaqalile nhlobo uyavezwa esontweni. Kumele uye kokhetha usuyibekile imali yokuthi uqale izingxoxo zamalobolo ngoba akuvumelekile ukuthi kuphele izinyanga ezintathu ungavelile emndenini wentombi uma usuyikhethile esontweni,” usho kanje.
Imibhikisho eyahlukene isiholele ekutheni uMasipala waseMdoni umise ukuhlinzeka izidingo ezifana nokuqoqwa kukadoti nokuvula izikhungo ezihlola abafundela ukushayela.UMdoni usubhekane nemibhikisho eyahlukene emasontweni amathathu edlule ephazamise ukusebenza komkhandlu.Emibhikishweni esibe khona kukhona owomphakathi okhala ngenkohlakalo nowabasebenzi.Ngeledlule, bekunomunye umbhikisho womphakathi lapho ababhikishi benxuse ukuthi uMengameli uCyril Ramaphosa, ajube uphiko oluphenya inkohlakalo, iSpecial Investigating Unit, ukuba izophenya umkhandlu.Ngaphambi kwalo mbhikisho, bekukhona owabasebenzi abakhala ngezinsiza zokusebenza. Namhlanje, kulindeleke ukuthi kube nomunye umbhikisho womphakathi emahhovisi omkhandlu.Ngenyanga eyedlule, umkhandlu wakhipha isaziso somphakathi lapho owawuxwayisa khona ukuthi udoti angeke uqoqwe nokuthi kuzovalwa izikhungo ezihlola abafundela ukushayela ngenxa yemibhikisho.Khona lapho, kuphinde kube nodaba lokumiswa kwenkotileka eyakha umgwaqo eDududu, umphakathi usola amakhansela ngokuqasha abasondelene nawo.Sekuphele amasonto amathathu, umphakathi wakule ndawo uvale amasango kasonkontileka ufuna ukuthi kuphume abasebenzi othi sebephelelwe izinkontileka zezinyanga ezintathu abazisayina. Sekumele kuqashwe abanye abasohlwini lwabadinga umsebenzi emawadini amabili umgwaqo owakhiwa kuwo.Ngakolunye uhlangothi, amakhansela athi asezamile ukuhlangabezana nomphakathi ngokuthi kubekhona abantu abasha abaqashwayo, ngaphezu kwalaba abakhona ngoba usonkontileka uthi usabadinga kodwa umphakathi ushaya phansi ngonyawo ufuna kuphume laba abebesebenza.Omunye wamalungu omphakathi ocele ukungavezwa igama lakhe ngoba ethi wesabela ezokuphepha, uthe ngesikhathi kuqalwa iphrojekthi ngoFebhruwari, kwakuvunyelelwe ukuthi abaqashiwe bazosebenza izinyanga ezintathu badedele abanye, manje akusenzeki .Ngaphezu kwalokho, akusalandelwa amagama asohliwni labantulayo emawadini, sekubonakala nabantu abebengemuva ohlwini sebesebenza nokungebona abasemawadini athintekayo."Imihlangano esisabe nayo amakhansela awafuni ukulandela uhlelo, kunalokho athi azokwengeza abanye abasebenzi okuzokwenza ukuthi kungathathwa isibalo esiningi salaba abebengakahlomuli. Amakhansela afuna ukugcina abantu bawo. Ngeke sikuvume lokho uma sekuphele izinanga ezintathu umuntu akaphume kungene omunye," kusho yena.USomlomo ophinda abe yikhansela lakwa-ward 3, kuMasipala waseMdoni, uMnuz Mthandeni Mbutho, uthe uyazi ngezinsolo zokuthi baqashe abantu babo. "Into esibhekene nayo la ukuthi imiphumela yokhetho esiphuma kulo iveze ukuthi iqembu elithile ilona elithandwa ngabantu, manje lelo leqembu selifuna ukuphatha ekubeni ukhetho esiphuma kulo bekungelona olwamakhansela. Lenza noma yini ukuze kube sengathi ilona eliphethe. Lizibiza ngomphakathi, uma ningavumelani nokushiwo yilo lenza kungasebenzeki,” kusho uMbutho. Uthe izinkontileka zabasebenzi ziyizinyanga ezintathu kodwa zibhalwe ukuthi usonkontileka uma esamdinga umsebenzi uzoqhubeka." Lo 'mphakathi’ omise inkontileka kuthe uma ufika nesikhalo usonkontileka wathi uma kuqalwa phansi kuzoba izindleko ezengeziwe, kungcono engeze ngesibalo esithile sabasebenzi ngoba kudingeka umfaniswano, ukuthi baqeqeshwe nerekhodi lezempilo. Okuxakayo ukuthi lo mphakathi awufuni kuzwa lutho, ufuna kwenziwe okufunwa yiwo. Awufuni kuthatha mbono wamuntu, uncamela ukuthi umgwaqo ume noma ungayiswa kwenye indawo awunandaba. Asikwazi ukumisa abantu emsebenzini sebetshelwe ukuthi bayaqhubeka, nabo bazoteleka," kusho yena Uqhube wathi kuMasipala uMndoni akusebenzeki ngenxa yabantu abathile abagovuza umphakathi kumiswe amaphojekthi. Amahhovisi kamasipala avaliwe, abasebenzi basesitelekeni. UMphathiswa woMnyango wokuBusa ngokuBambisana nobuHoli boMdabu, uMfundisi Thulasizwe Buthelezi, uzohlangana nabasebenzi bakwamasipala abatelekile ngoMsombuluko.
KUZOPHENYWA ngebhilidi lamaphoyisa elathengwa ngo-R695 million eseliphenduke umhume wabaphangi emva kokuchithwa kukaR250 million kuzanywa ukulilungisa.UNgqongqoshe woMnyango wezeMisebenzi yoMphakathi, uMnuz Dean Macpherson, usejube uphenyo ngebhilidi lamaphoyisa iTelkom Towers, esePitoli.Leli bhilidi lathengwa ngo-2016. Ngo-2017 kwavalwa izingxenye eziningi zesakhiwo emva kokuthi kutholakale ukuthi akuphephile. Kwabe sekuqala imizamo yokulungisa ibhilidi. Muva nje uMnyango weziSebenzi usanda kuyalela ukuthi livalwe ibhilidi ngenxa yokuthi aliphephile. Ngesikhathi uMacpherson eyohlola ibhilidi, utshelwe ukuthi seliphenduke umhume wabaphangi.Uphinde watshelwa ukuthi izigebengu zintshontshe impahla ebikuleli bhilidi, enye yacekelwa phansi.UMacpherson uthe akwamukelekile ukuthi ibhilidi elathengwa ngemali eshisiwe liphenduke umhume wabaphangi ngale ndlela."Uhulumeni uyivumela kanjani into enje ukuba yenzeke? Kuyamangaza ukuthi kule minyaka eyisishiyagalombili leli bhilidi belingasetshenziswa ngokugcwele, laze laphenduka umhume wabaphangi.”UMacpherson uthe ufuna kuphenywe ukuthi sasikhona yini isidingo sokuthi uhulumeni athenge leli bhilidi kwasekuqaleni."Ngifuna ukwazi ukuthi yini eyadala ukuthi umnyango uthenge leli bhilidi, nokuthi ayikho yini enye indlela umnyango owawungenza ngayo. Asikwazi ukulahlekelwa izigidi zamaRandi sizama ukulungisa ibhilidi ngenxa nje yokwehluleka kwezikhulu zomnyango ukuhlela.”Uphenyo luzokwenziwa yinkampani ezimele, luzophothulwa ezinyangeni ezimbili.Uphenyo luzobheka ukuthi ayikho yini indlela yokuthi izinkampani ezathola amathenda okulungisa ibhilidi zihlanziswe imali ezayithola."Kuzophenywa ukuthi yiluphi uhlelo olwalandelwayo ngesikhathi kuqokwa izinkampani ezanikwa umsebenzi wokulungisa ibhilidi, kuphenywe nokuthi lezi nkampani zaziwulungele yini umsebenzi. Uphenyo luzositshela ukuthi ayikho yini indlela yokuthi izinkampani ezahluleka ukwenza umsebenzi ziphoqwe ukuthi zibuyise imali.”UMacpherson uthe uphenyo luzophinde lubatshele nokuthi azikho yini izinyathelo okufanele zithathelwe izikhulu zomnyango ezibandakanyeka ekuthengweni kwebhilidi."Sifuna ukuthi uphenyo lusitshele ukuthi yini okufanele yenziwe ngaleli bhilidi njengoba isimo sesinje.”UMacpherson uthe umnyango kufanele wenze isiqiniseko sokuthi imali yomphakathi ayimoshwa."Kufanele senze isiqiniseko sokuthi zonke izakhiwo ezithengwe ngezimali zomphakathi ziyasetshenziswa, siphinde senze isiqiniseko sokuthi siyazivikela, zingaphenduki imihume yabaphangi. Isimo sezimali sibi, ngakho asikwazi ukumosha izigidi zamaRandi ezintweni ebesingakwazi ukuzigwema.”

UKUGCONWA ngokungabi nawo umfaniswano wesikole esafunda kwenze uMnuz Celukwakha Chonco wase-Davenport, eThekwini, osedume ngeleNkosi Yabafundi, ukuthi aqale umkhankaso wokunikelela kubafundi abangathathi entweni.UChonco (25) osebenza njengomluleki wezezimali, uthe ukuba nesandla esiphayo kugqugquzelwa yindlela akhula ngayo eyenze waqala inhlangano engenzi nzuzo ebizwa ngeNkosi Yabafundi Organization esiza abafundi ngemifaniswano yesikole.Ekhuluma neSolezwe, uthe ukugconwa kwengane esikoleni ngokungabi nawo umfaniswano kumphatha kabi."Ukukhonjwa kwengane igconwe ngokuthi inamasokisi adabukile, lokho kukodwa kwenza ukuthi ungabe usakuthanda ukuya esikoleni,” kusho uChonco.Uthe lokhu akwenzayo kusuka ngaphakathi enhliziyweni njengoba engakabi nabo abazomsiza.Uthe ngesikhathi efunda, abazali bakhe babengakwazi ukumthengela umfaniswano wesikole, ehlale egqoka awuphiwe ngabanye abantu. UMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa uthi ukwehluleka kwe-ANC ukunqoba ukhetho ngamalengiso akusho ukuphela kwale nhlangano ebisiphathe ngokuzimela iminyaka engu-30. URamaphosa uthe ukungenzi kahle okhethweni lwangoMeyi kuzobagqugquzela ukuthi babuye ngamandla okhethweni olulandelayo.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ethula inkulumo yokuvula umhlangano wesigungu esiphezulu, i-lekgotla, eqale ngeSonto.I-lekgotla ibanjwe emva komhlangano wezinsuku ezintathu wesigungu esiphezulu obubhunga ngemiphumela yokhetho.Bekungokokuqala emlandweni i-ANC yehluleka ukunqoba ukhetho ngamalengiso ngesikhathi kunokhetho olwedlule.I-ANC yaphinde yahluleka ukunqoba ngamalengiso ezifundazweni ezintathu ebiziphethe, iKwaZulu-Natal, Gauteng neNorthern Cape.Kukhona abasabela ukuthi i-ANC ngeke iphinde ibuyele emandleni kulezi zifundazwe ngoba iyehluleka ukubuya ngamandla ezinkethweni.Le nhlangano isihluleke yancama ukubuyisa isifundazwe esayiphunyuka ngo-2009, iWestern Cape, kanye nokubuyisa omasipala abakhulu abayiphunyuka okhethweni lwango-2016 okukhona kubo iJohannesburg neTshwane.Kodwa uRamaphosa uthe imiphumela yokhetho angeke ibadikibalise, wathi bazolwela ukwenza kangcono ezinkethweni ezilandelayo."Sizithola sisesimweni esinzima. Asikaze sibhekane nesimo esinjena emlandweni wethu weminyaka engu-112. Nokho ke ukuhlulwa kwethu okhethweni akusho ukuthi sekuphelile ngathi. "Siyinhlangano ekade yayinethwa yizimvula. Sakwazi ukudlula kuzo zonke lezi ziphepho esesike sabhekana nazo phambilini. Nakulokhu sizokwazi ukudlula kukho. Kufanele siqhamuke namaqhinga esizowasebenzisa ukuze sikwazi ukubuya ngamandla.”URamaphosa uthe asikho isikhathi sokuthi abaholi be-ANC belokhu bebalisa ngemiphumela yokhetho, wathi abavuke bazithathe.Unxuse abaholi ukuthi bagxile ekulungiseni izinkinga ezidale ukuthi abantu bangayivoteli ngobuningi i-ANC.Uthe bazongenelela komasipala abakhulu abakhungethwe yizinkinga njengoba bekholelwa ekutheni ukwehluleka kwalabo masipala abakhulu ukuhambisa izidingo yikho okwenze ukuthi abantu bangayivoteli i-ANC.Uthe kuzokuba nezinguquko ebuholini bale mikhandlu.URamaphosa uthe bazoqhamuka nezinhlelo zokusombulula izinkinga ezibhekene nentsha."Kucacile okhethweni ukuthi intsha ayijabule neze. Kufanele siqhamuke nezinhlelo zokufukula intsha.”URamaphosa uthe bazothathelwa izinyathelo abaholi be-ANC abahluleka ukwenza umsebenzi."Siphelile isikhathi sokudlala manje, ngeke sibabekezelele abantu abahlulwa umsebenzi.”Imiphumela yokhetho yashiya i-ANC iphoqelekile ukuthi isebenzisane namanye amaqembu okukhona kuwo iDA neFF Plus, okungamaqembu anemigomo ephikisana neye-ANC.Lokhu sekwenze ukuthi kube bamadlelandawonye e-ANC agxeka ukusebenzisana kwayo nala maqembu.URamaphosa uvumile ukuthi bazithola bengaphansi kwesimo esinzima njengoba kufanele basebenzisane namaqembu aphikisana nemigomo yabo.Kepha uthe akukho okunye okungcono abebengakwenza ngaphandle kokusungula uhulumeni wokubambisana.Uthe wonke amalungu esigungu esiphezulu avumelana ngokuthi kwakufanele i-ANC isungule uhulumeni wokubambisana.
UYAVEVA umgcotshwa webandla lamaNazaretha eBuhleni othi uyabulwe ngomjiva, kwagqashuka nomqhele ekhishwa ngesidlozana ethempelini, esolwa ngokuzibeka kwesobufundisi ngesikhathi kuvalwa umhlangano kaJulayi.Umgcotshwa uMnuz Mandlakayise Mthethwa ozinze ethempelini eMaqhaweni, e-Uganda, eMlaza, uthe usesaba ngisho ukuya enkonzweni ngokwenziwe kuyena ngabefundisi eBuhleni.Uthe kulesi sigameko kulahleke ngisho nemali yakhe engu-R10 000 abezoyothenga ngayo izimbuzi, waze wavula icala emaphoyiseni.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda ukuqinisekisile ukuthi kunecala elivulwe wuMthethwa eNanda."Kulesi sigameko ummangali uthe walahlekelwa yisigqoko sakhe, wumjiva wesonto nemali. Amaphoyisa ayaphenya,” kusho uNetshiunda.Echaza uMthethwa uthe: "Mina ngingumfundisi owaphakanyiselwa kulesi sikhundla wuBaba uNyazilwezulu. BengiwuMshumayeli futhi amagalelo ami ayaziwa njengoba kukhona amathempeli amathathu eMlaza asungulwe ngenxa yami. Uma sekufika isikhathi sokuthi ngiphakanyiselwe kwesobufundisi, kukhona abangathandanga. "Bekungekhona okokuqala bengiphatha kanje abagcotshwa. Lesi sigameko senzekile siseTafelkop ngoMashi kulo nyaka. Bafike bangigxavuna kanje futhi baze bangiphuca kwawona umjiva wami. Namanje bangigxavule kabuhlungu bangiphuca umjiva wami kwaze kwagqashuka nomqhele. Kulokhu angikwazanga ngisho ukuthatha izimpahla ebengiziphethe, zisale khona ethempelini eBuhleni ngikhishwa kabuhlungu. Kulahleke nemali engu-R10 000 ebengiyikhiphele ukuthi ngizoyothenga ngayo izimbuzi,” kusho uMthethwa.Uthe ngesikhathi ephucwa umjiva okokuqala eTafelkop, akazange afune ukuphumela obala ngalolu daba ngoba wayezitshela ukuthi luzogcina lulungisekile. Uthe manje uyabona ukuthi akusizi ukuthi athule ngoba uyabona ukuthi bazoze bamlimaze laba bagcotshwa.Ngesikhathi ekhishwa ngesidlozana eBuhleni, uthe uzamile ukubatshela abagcotshwa abebemkhipha ukuthi abaye kumholi uNyazilwezulu ngoba uyazi ngaye ukuthi usengumfundisi kodwa banqaba, bengafuni ukumlalela."Angazi noma babefuna ngibagwazele yini laba bagcotshwa ukuze bangibeke esikhundleni sokuba ngumfundisi. Bengingeke ngikwenze lokho ngoba igama lami laphakanyiswa wuBaba uNyazilwezulu. Into abangenze yona isangithusile futhi bangihlazile, bengikhipha kabuhlungu kanje phambi kukankosikazi wami nezingane,” kusho uMthethwa.Okhulumela umholi wamaNazaretha, inkosi Mduduzi Shembe uNyazilwezulu, uMnuz Thokozani Mncwabe uthe uyalwazi udaba lukaMthethwa."Kuyiqiniso ukuthi unguMshumayeli uMthethwa kodwa okokugcotshwa kwabefundisi, ibandla alingeni kukhona. Isikhathi esiningi bagcotshwa wubaba uNyazilwezulu uma kuqala unyaka sisentabeni engcwele. Thina njengamalungu ebandla sibona ngaye umgcotshwa sesibuyile entabeni esevathe isevatho sabefundisi. Okunye asingeni kukhona ngoba kuningi okwenzekayo uma begcotshwa esingeke sakudalula ngoba kuyizimfihlo zebandla. Ukugcina kwami ukukhuluma noMthethwa kungesikhathi ephucwe umjiva siseTafelkop. Kulapho ngaphakamisa khona ukuthi udaba lwakhe lulungiswe ngokukholwa,” kusho uMncwabe.

Kumanje izingane nothisha bahleli emakhaya, akucaci ukuthi kuzobuyelwa nini,” kusho umthombo.Kuthintwa uSihlalo wesiSungu elisawula isiKole iTshana High, igama lakhe elingatholakalanga, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi sekuphele isonto kungafundwa."Bekukhona isimo somphakathi obufuna izimfuno zawo kwagcina sekuphazamiseke izikole. Wathi bayakhala abalimi babo abaseLevubu, Marble Hall, Arabie, Vivo naseBela-Bela bathi izitshalo zahlaselwa yisithwathwa zase ziyamosheka."Ucwaningo lwethu luveza ukuthi kuzoshoda amazambane ngoba yiwona ashayeke kakhulu, namanye amaveji athintekile okubalwa utamatisi. Abalimi babuye bakhala ngokuthi kumosheke nengqalasizinda yamanzi. Abalimi bamazambane bashayekile nangokudlule ngenxa yesimo sezulu,” kuchaza uVan de Graaf.Ucele izikhungo ezibolekisa ngemali ukuthi zingabahluphi abalimi ngoba basazoyidinga imali yokutshala kabusha.Ucele nongqongqoshe wezoLimo ukuthi angenelele ngoba uma isimo sezulu siphazamisa abalimi kusho ukuthi kuzophazamiseka ukuba khona kokudla ezweni. Ubalule ukuthi izambane liphekwa yiwo wonke umuntu kusukela kompofu kuya kocebile ngakho ukungabikhona kwamazambane enele kuzozwela.IPotatoes South Africa, idalule ukuthi intengo yamazambane ingase inyuke ngenxa yokuncishiswa kwesikalo samanzi okufanele sisetshenziswe ngabalimi.Ithe abalimi bamazambane badinga amanzi ngakho ukuncishiswa kwesikalo samanzi kuzoba nomthelela omubi ekulinyweni kwawo.

Kufanele sizibuze ukuthi ngabe yini lena eyenza ukuthi abantu abahlala ehostela iDenver, bevotele iMK. Baliyeka leli qembu abebehlezi belivotela, okungeyona i-ANC. LUNIKWE amandla uphiko oluphenya amacala enziwa amaphoyisa kanjalo namaphoyisa kamasipala kuleli i-Independent Police Investigative Directorate (IPID), kulandela ukusayinwa komthetho nguMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa.URamaphosa usayine umthetho i-Independent Police Investigative Directorate Amendment Act, ezonika i-IPID amandla okuphenya amacala enziwa amaphoyisa namaphoyisa kamasipala uma esemsebenzinini noma engekho.Phambilini lolu phiko belunamandla okuphenya kuphela amacala enziwe amaphoyisa uma esemsebenzini. Amacala azophenywa yilolu phiko asuke ebucayi okubalwa awokudlwengula, awokubulala namanye.Okhulumela uRamaphosa uMnuz Vincent Magwenya, uthe lo mthetho usayinwe emuva kokubuyekezwa komthetho wango-2011 walolu phiko.Uthe ngokwalo mthetho lolu phiko kumele lusebenze ngokuzimela futhi lungakhethi mabala."Kumele lungakhethi mabala, lusebenze ngaphandle kokwesaba nokwenzelela. Lolu phiko luzophenya wonke amacala enziwe amaphoyisa namaphoyisa kamasipala noma kuthiwa bebesemsebenzini noma bengekho. Luzophenya namacala okudlwengula enziwa amaphoyisa namaphoyisa kamasipala.”Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi lolu phiko lumandla ekuphenyeni amacala athinta amaphoyisa asuke edubule kwaze kwagcina kushona izigebengu. Ngokwalo mthetho osayiniwe uNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa akasazokwazi ukuthatha izinyathelo zokuqondisa ubugwegwe isikhulu se-IPID, ngaphandle kokungenela kwePhalamende.Okunye ngukuthi sekumele kuhlolisiswe kabanzi ngaphambi kokuqashwa kwesikhulu salolu phiko.UMnuz Stephens Ramafoko, obhekele ezomthetho kwi-IPID, ekhuluma nesiteshi somsakazo iSAfm, uthe okusha ngukuthi lolu phiko selunikwe amandla athe xaxa okuphenya amacala enziwa amaphoyisa nakamasipala."Phambilini besingakwazi ukuphenya amacala enziwa amaphoyisa nakamasipala uma engasebenzi. Kodwa manje sesizokwazi ukuphenya amacala noma kuthiwa abengasebenzi.” UMagwenya uthe uhlaka iCivilian Secretariat, lweluleka ungqongqoshe wamaphoyisa ngemigomo nangocwaningoUthe luqapha nokusebenza kwamaphoyisa luphinde luxhumane nezinhlaka ezehlukene ezingekho emnyangweni ngezinhlelo zokulwa nobugebengu.
UKHOMISHANA wamaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLt General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi ukhombe umunwe abantu besilisa bendlu emnyama ukuthi yibona abayimbangela enkulu yokwanda kwezigameko zobugebengu kulesi sifundazwe.UMkhwanazi usho lokhu ekhuluma kwiKZN Social Crime Prevention Summit, ingqungquthela yokulwa nobugebengu, ebise-Olive Convention Centre, eThekwini izolo.Kule ngqungquthela, uKhomishana uveze ukuthi ekucwaningeni kwabo ngobugebengu obuhlukene obenzeka esifundazweni, babophe abantu besilisa abamnyama abawu-60 000, kwathi kwabesifazane kwaboshwa abawu-11 728."Ngiyaxolisa ukubeka lokhu ngale ndlela kodwa lezi zibalo zikubeka ngokusobala ukuthi abantu besilisa bendlu emnyama bayimbangela yokudlonga kobugebengu eKZN,” usho kanje.Eqhuba uMkhwanazi, uveze ukuthi okunye okubakhathazayo wukuthi iTheku noMgungundlovu yizona zifunda ezenza ubugebengu bube phezulu kakhulu esifundazweni.Uthe iTheku lino-42.1% kuthi uMgungundlovu ube no-11% wezenzo zobugebengu. "Uma singanqoba ubugebengu kulezi zifunda isimo singaba ngcono kakhulu esifundazweni sethu.”’"Kuyasikhathaza nokuthi intsha yesifundazwe ingene shi ebugebengwini obehlukene. Ukucwaninga kwethu kusivezele ukuthi intsha eneminyaka ephakathi kuka-16 no-25 iyona ebandakanyeka kakhulu ezenzweni zobugebengu. Yinto esikhathaza kakhulu ngoba labo bantu baseminyakeni okumele ngabe bayafunda noma bayasebenza kuyona,” kusho yena.UMkhwanazi uthe ezinhlotsheni eziwu-17 zobugebengu ezibikiwe, okuhamba phambili ngezokweba nezokushaya, njengoba ezibalweni zangonyaka odlule, bathola ukuthi awu-96 000, ku-256 527 wamacala obugebengu abikiwe. "Uma kungehla izenzo zalawo macala kungaba ngcono kakhulu. Okunye okudale lokho wukwanda kwesibalo sabantu abahlala emigwaqeni, okwenza kwande izenzo zobugebengu ngoba ukuphila kwabantu ngendlela engacacile kwenza benze noma yini ukuziphilisa, bese bephula nomthetho," kusho uMkhwanazi.Uthe abantu abayekile ukubulalana njengoba kulo nyaka nje kuphela sekubikwe amacala okubulala awu-6 343, okwenza iKZN ibe yisifundazwe esihamba phambili ezweni ngokufa kwabantu."Ukubopha abantu abenza ubugebengu akusizi ukulungisa izinto. Asithole umnyombo wazo zonke lezi zinkinga esibhekene naso.”’UMkhwanazi uveze nokuthi ukuswela ingqalasizinda, yindlala yamathuba omsebenzi, yimibhikisho eyenziwa ngabantu ngezizathu ezahlukene nodlame ematekisini ngezinye zezinkinga ezidinga ukulungiswa ukuze kuliwe nobugebengu.
IQEMBU uMkhonto weSizwe (MKP) selisole i-ANC ngokuyichithela isikhathi ngokubuyela enkantolo ifuna ukuthi ivunyelwe ukudlulisa isinqumo sokuchithwa kwayo embangweni wegama nophawu olusetshenziswa yi-MK.UNobhala Jikelele we-MK, uMnuz Arthur Zwane, uthe i-ANC ayizange ifike ngisho enkantolo enkulu ukuzolwa udaba.UZwane usho lokhu izolo, ekhuluma namalungu eqembu ngaphandle kweNkantolo eNkulu eThekwini, kulandela ukugodlwa kwesinqumo. Abengekho amalungu nabaholi be-ANC enkantolo, ithumele abameli bayo. ABESEKA iqembu i-MK abebengaphandle eNkantolo eNkulu eThekwini, njengoba bekunecala lombango wegama nophawu Isithombe: Khaya Ngwenya / Independent MediaIJaji uMahendra Chetty lithe lizokhipha isinqumo kulolu daba emuva kokuzwa amaphuzu abevela kubameli be-ANC nabe-MK.I-ANC ibuyele enkantolo ifuna ukuvunyelwa ukuthi isidlulise isinqumo sokuchithwa kwayo yinkantolo ngo-Ephreli nonyaka, eyavuna i-MK odabeni lophawu negama njengoba uKhongolose uthi ngelawo.UZwane ukhwele wadilika kuhulumeni wokubambisana kwamaqembu ahlukene wathi ngowabadayisi."Ayikho into okuthiwa uhulumeni wobumbano kodwa abadayisi. I-ANC ingabadayisi isebenzisana nabamhlophe, akuwona uhulumeni wobumbano.”Uthe uphawu negama abalisebenzisayo elabo, wathi bazoliwina futhi icala."Besisodwa nje enkantolo, bengekho. Basaba ngisho ukuza entweni yabo.”Umholi we-MK, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, ufikile enkantolo ezolalela ukuqhubeka kwecala, kwathi uma seliguqa waphuma wahamba. Akazange aye ngisho ukuyokhuluma nabalandeli abebengaphandle kwenkantolo.Ubehamba nendodakazi yakhe uDuduzile, kanti bekulindeleke ukuthi uzophefumula ngokuxoshwa kwakhe i-ANC ngokuhola i-MK nokwehlisa ukwesekwa kukaKhongolose okhethweni.Ummeli we-MK, u-Advocate Dali Mpofu, uthe icala le-ANC ngeke lithele zithelo.Uthe umonakalo wenzeka okhethweni ngakho akukho okuzoshintsha.Ummeli we-ANC, u-Advocate Gavin Marriott, uthe kusazoba nezinye izinketho ngakho ukusetshenziswa kwegama yiMK kuzoba nomthelela.I-ANC ithi enye inkantolo ingafinyelela esinqumeni esehlukile kunesenkantolo enkulu yingakho ifuna udaba ludluliselwe eNkantolo okuDluliswa kuyo amaCala.
UBEMAGANGE efika ekhaya ngoMsombuluko owesifazane waseDumisani Makhaye, eMpangeni, obebuya koteta, ethi uzokhombisa umufi ingane yakwabo ezelwe.Nokho injabulo yakhe iphenduke eyesikhashana, ethola ukuthi indodakazi yakhe, uZanokuhle Khumalo (7) unyamalele.Isidumbu sikaZanokuhle sigcine sitholwa sishuthekwe ngo-plasitiki ngaphansi kombhede wesiqashi endaweni ngoLwesibili, kanti kusolwa ukuthi uklinyiwe.UMUFI uZanokuhle KhumaloElandisa ngesigameko umakhelwane, uMnuz Sandile Mhlongo, olusukumele phezulu udaba, uthe ufike kubo ngoMsombuluko, ingundabamlonyeni eyokunyamalala kukamufi.Uveze ukuthi unina kamufi, uNksz Nondumiso Khumalo, uthe efika ebuya esibhedlela wabe ebuza ukuthi uphi uZanokuhle, ufuna ukumkhombisa ingane yakwabo."Kuqale kwathiwa uhambe wayodlala nokuthe uma esebhekwa, kwavela ukuthi umasitende kamsolwa, uke wamthuma amaphilisi ezinhlungu esitolo,” kusho uMhlongo.Uqhube wathi kugcine kubikelwa amaphoyisa, wabe esabalalisa ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ukuthi bacela ukufuniswa umufi.Uthe ngoLwesibili, behlangene ngalo udaba eduze kwesitolo, iChakalaka, kuqhamuke umasitende kamsolwa ethwele izandla ekhanda ethi: "Waze wangigila umfana, uthi ubulale ingane wayifaka ngaphansi kombhede.”Uthe banikele khona endlini, nebala bayithola ingane ngaphansi kombhede.Uqhube wathi bahlome ngemibuzo owesifazane owafika ngaye endaweni lona wesilisa, obayalele lapho kuhlala khona intombi yakhe (umsolwa)."Sithe uma sifika kuyo, yathi akekho kuyona kodwa uke wayitshela ukuthi wenze into engadala ukuthi alahlekelwe yimpilo yakhe. Ugcine esiyalela umngani asondelene naye kakhulu, sanikela kuye,” kusho uMhlongo.Uqhube wathi umngani ubatshele ukuthi umgcine ethi use-B&B eseHillview.Uthe bathe uma befika khona, izisebenzi zakhona zathi wenze okungajwayelekile, ebhalisela ukuhlala isikhashana kodwa wabuye wahamba."Ngisole ukuthi kukhona okushaya amanzi ngalokhu, ngabampintshela ekutheni basikhombise igumbi abelibhalisile. Silithole likhiyiwe, sangqongqoza, wangavula. Kuthe uma umngani wakhe embiza ngegama, wasabela masinyane. Sibe sesingena ngendlovu iyangena, samxhakathisa, samyisa emaphoyiseni,” kusho uMhlongo."Unina wengane namanje akakholwa ukuthi ingane yakhe ibulelwe. Nomphakathi ushaqekile futhi udiniwe. Sithe uma simbuza umsolwa ukuthi uyibulaleleni ingane, wathi ingoba inqabile ukulala naye.”Uthe bathole ukuthi ungowaseMacekane.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa aseMpangeni abophe owesilisa (33) ngecala lokuthumba nelokubulala."Uboshwe emuva kokutholwa kwesidumbu sengane (7) ngaphansi kombhede kamsolwa owaziwayo ngoLwesibili, eDumisani Makhaye,” kusho uNetshiunda.Uqhube wathi umsolwa bekulindeleke ukuthi avele eNkantolo yeMantshi eNgwelezane ngoLwesine.
KUPHUPHUMA injabulo nothando luvutha bhe kumlandeli wezemidlalo wokuqina kuleli, uMama Joy Chauke. Le ntokazi ilokhu izinameke njalo izithombe inesoka layo eyalithola eFrance esilethe igama likaPapa Joy.Naye uPapa Joy kucacile ukuthi uzitholele umakoti ngempela kule ntokazi njengoba eseyethule nasemndenini wakhe. Ezithombeni azinamekile kuvela nalapho uMama Joy esekhishini nomamezala wakhe.Uveze ukuthi uninazala umamukele ngenhle indandatho yegolide, okusho ukuthi "uyamamukela njengomakoti kaPapa Joy".ISANDLA sikaMama Joy esinobufakazi bokuthi usethembisene umshado nesoka lakhe laseFrance, uPapa Joy Isithombe: X/JOYCHAUKE5 Useqede nokuqagela kubantu abebezibuza beziphendula ukuthi uhanjiswe wubani ukuya eFrance, njengoba kunemidlalo yama-Olympic."Zonke izindleko zokuya eParis zikhokhelwe wuPapa Joy... uthando luyavutha bhe,” kusho uMama Joy kweminye yemibhalo ayinameke kwi-X.Ekuqaleni kwaleli sonto, uMama Joy ufake izithombe ekhasini lakhe khona kwi-X, zihambisana nombhalo obuthi "ngisendleleni ngiya eFrance”.Abanye abantu bebezibuza ukuthi ngabe wubani okhokhele izindleko zohambo lwakhe, ikakhulu ngoba kuyaziwa ukuthi uNgqongqoshe omusha wezeMidlalo kuleli, uGayton McKenzie usanda kuvala ukukhokhela izindleko zabalandeli bezemidlalo abahambela imidlalo esuke idlalelwa kwamanye amazwe, ekhala ngokuthi kumoshwa imali engabe isiza kwezinye izinto.Kweminye yemibhalo yakhe, uMama Joy uthe: "Ngiyabonga kakhulu ngothando lwakho Papa Joy. Emva kokuba sematheni eNingizimu Afrika, bengiludinga lolu hambo lokuya eFrance.”UMAMA Joy nomamezala wakhe Isithombe: X/JOYCHAUKE5 Uthe njengamanje uwumlandeli oqavile kaPapa Joy olokhu embusisa njalo ngezidlo ezimnandi, emtetemukisa nasezindaweni ezinezinto ezikhala kahle.Kwesinye sezithombe kuvela isipho asithengelwe yisoka lakhe, futhi ufake kaningi izithombe lapho eshuthe khona nalo behambela izindawo ezehlukene kwelinye lamadolobha aseFrance, iLille.Ufake nama-vidieo enomamezala wakhe kubonakala ukuthi kujatshulwe. Nendandatho athe wamukelwe ngayo emzini, uyivezile kwezinye zezithombe. Ukugcizelele nokuthi indandatho isho ukuthi kuzokikizwa maduze eFrance naseNingizimu Afrika.
IGCAGCELE esokeni kosomabhizinisi abancane baKwaZulu-Natal abazohlomula ngoxhaso lwemali yokuthuthukisa amabhizinisi oluvela ebhange Ithala nakwiSourceFin.Izolo isikhulu esiphezulu se-Ithala Development Finance Corporation (IDFC), uNksz Pearl Bengu, sithe iSourceFin ibeke uR150 million wokuthuthukisa osomabhizinisi abancane abasemikhakheni ehlukene.Uthe le mali izotholakala ngokushesha futhi osomabhizinisi sebengaqala ukufaka izicelo."Ithala liyathanda ukuthuthukisa osomabhizinisi abancane ngoba yibona abadala amathuba omsebenzi amaningi. Kuzoxhaswa osomabhizinisi abathole umsebenzi kuhulumeni kodwa abangenayo imali yokuqala umsebenzi, abanamabhizinisi emalokishini, emakhaya nakwezinye izindawo. Inhloso yethu wukufukula umnotho waKwaZulu-Natal ukuze wonke umuntu asebenze,” kuchaza uNksz Bengu.Uthe Ithala lingamavulandlela ekufukuleni osomabhizinisi basemakhaya nasemalokishini njengoba kuyilona elibaxhasa ngaphandle kokubafuna imicikilisho."Sifuna osomabhizinisi bakhule bangahlali bengosomabhizinisi abancane. Ukusebenzisana kwethu neSourceFin kuzosisiza ukwenza lokho. Okuhle wukuthi sizobe sicathula nabo, ngeke sibanike imali noma izinsiza kusebenza kuphela kodwa bazofundiswa nangokuphatha kahle imali, ukuhlela umsebenzi nangemithetho ethile ethinta osomabhizinisi,” kusho uNksz Bengu.UMnuz Joshua Kadish oyisikhulu esiphezulu seSourceFin, uthe bayajabula ukusebenzisana neThala ngoba lihamba phambili ekuthuthukiseni abantu baKwaZulu-Natal.Uthembise osomabhizinisi ukuthi ngeke balinde isikhathi eside uma sebefake isicelo sokuxhaswa njengoba kusetshenziswa ubuchwepheshe besimanje."Siyazi ukuthi kunzima ukuthola imali emabhange amakhulu yingakho sisebenzisana neThala okuyilona elenza umsebenzi omuhle wokulekelela osomabhizinisi abancane. Sizobanika imali yokwenza umsebenzi, sibafundise ukuyiphatha sibanike nohlelo lokuqeqeshwa ngomakadebona kwezamabhizinisi. Okuhle wukuthi sinezinkampani esisebenzisana nazo ezenza imikhiqizo ehlukene okuzosiza osomabhizinisi,” kusho uKadish.Wenze isibonelo sokuthi usomabhizinisi olungisa ingqalasizinda uyakwazi ukuxhunyaniswa nendawo azothenga kuyona engambi eqolo. Lokho kusiza yena ukuthi onge izindleko.Uthe osonkontileka bavumelekile ukuthenga ezinkampanini abazaziyo kodwa kulolu hlelo kuzoqale kubhekwe ukuthi kwezinye izindawo leyo mpahla ibiza malini.

SEKUPHINDE kwaqubuka enye impi yamazwi kubaholi bamaqembu akuhulumeni wokubambisana, unobhala jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, nosihlalo woMkhandlu weDA, uNkk Helen Zille.UMbalula useveze ukuthi uNkk Zille abamncengile ukuthi ahlale kuhulumeni wokubambisana, wathi angaphuma uma engasathandi ukuhlala.UMbalula ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ebuzwa ngenkulumo kaNkk Zille esabalale ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, lapho uNkk Zille ezwakala ethi awukho uhulumeni wokubambisana eNingizimu Afrika, wathi izwe liphethwe i-ANC neDA.UHELEN Zille Isithombe: SIGCINIWEKwi-video esabalale ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, uNkk Zille uzwakala ethi i-DA ne-ANC bavumelana ngokuthi babuse ngokubambisana.Uthe uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, uyena-ke owabe eseshintsha ethi kuzoba nohulumeni wokubambisana ngoba efuna ukuthi amalungu e-ANC asheshe amukele ukubambisana kwala maqembu.Kule nkulumo uNkk Zille uphinde azwakale ethi inhloso yabo ukuthi i-ANC igcine iphumile emandleni.UMbalula uthe bona bazi ukuthi izwe liphethwe uhulumeni wokubambisana.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba ngaphambi kokuqala komhlangano wesigungu esiphezulu wezinsuku eziyisithupha.
