UMASIPALA wasoThukela unxusa umphakathi owakhele lo masipala ukuthi ubilise amanzi ozowaphuza emva kokutholakala kwegciwane i-E. coli esikhungweni esiphehla amanzi.Umphakathi othintekayo owaseColenso, Winterton naseBergvilleUMnuz Siyabonga Masoka oyimenenja yezinhlelo ezenziwa umasipala, uthe umasipala uhlole ukuphepha kwamanzi esikhungweni sawo emva kokutholakala kwenqwaba yezinhlanzi ezifile emseleni wamanzi eBergville. Uthe ukuhlolwa kwamanzi ngoMsombuluko kuveze ukuthi kunezinsalela ze-E. coli esikhungweni esihlanza amanzi esiseColenso naseBergville.Ethintwa izolo mayelana nokuthi ngabe umasipala awukakwenzi yini okunye ukuhlolwa, uthe: "Isixwayiso sokuthi umphakathi ubilise amanzi ozowaphuza sizoqhubeka kuze kube umasipala wenelisekile ngokuhlanzeka kwamanzi okungabeka impilo yezakhamizi engcupheni. Ngizokuthinta uma sengithole okusha,"Ucashunwe kweminye imithombo yezindaba ethi kumisiwe ukuphakelwa kwamanzi esuka ezikhungweni zokuhlanza ezithintekile eya emachibini aseZwelisha, eLangkloof naseBergville.Lo masipala ungowesibili obike ngamanzi angahlanzekile ngenxa yegciwane i-E. coli emasontweni amathathu.Ekuqaleni kwenyanga edlule isikhungo esihlola ukuphepha kwamanzi i-Institute for Water and Wastewater Technology (IWWT), esiseDurban University of Technology (DUT) sakhomba amabhishi angu-11 aseThekwini njengangahlanzekile ngoba kwatholakala izinsalela ze-E. coli ngesikhathi ehlolwa.Usolwazi Faizal Bux, we-IWWT, wathi lesi sikhungo njalo uma kungamaholidi sihlola ukuphepha kwamanzi ukuze siqinisekise ukuphepha komphakathi owasebenzisayo.Wathi okukhathazayo ukuthi imiphumela yokuhlolwa kwamanzi atholakala emlonyeni womfula uMgeni isihlale iveza ukuthi amanzi akhona ane-E. coli.
UNGQONGQOSHE woMnyango wabesiFazane, iNtsha, iziNgane nabaKhubazekile uxwayisa abesifazane abasebenzayo ngamadoda angamaqola ashaya sengathi eze ngothando kanti azobaqola. UNkk Sindisiwe Chikunga, uthe muva nje sekunamadoda athandana nabesifazane abasebenzayo njenhloso yokubalutha ukuze basule emisebenzini yabo ukuze bathole mali yempesheni bese eyabaqola." Lona umkhuba omusha osudlangile, abantu besifazane abaqaphele ngoba lawo madoda abesha amashushu ngothando ayanyamalala ngemuva kokuthi esethathe imali yabo kuthiwa kuyoqalwa ibhizinisi," kusho uChikunga. UNkk Chikunga ubesho lokhu ngesikhathi ethula ngokusemthethweni izinhlelo zenyanga yabantu besifazane, ePitoli, izolo.Uthe ziningi izinto eziwushintsho esezenziwe uhulumeni eminyakeni engu-30 ezibhekela abesifazane."Abesifazane ePhalamende ngo-1994 babengu-28%, ngo-2019 isibalo bese senyukele ku-45%. Emanyuvesi abesifazane abathole iziqu ibona abaningi. Izibalo zika-2017 zikhomba ukuthi bangu-61% abathole iziqu emanyuvesi, abesilisa bangu-38% Isibalo sabesifazane abasezikhundleni zokuphatha kuhulumeni nasezinkampanini ezizimele sisuke ku-20% ngo-2001 saya ku-36% ngo-2021," kusho yena.Uqhube wathi ngo-1994 amajaji ayekhona ayengu-165 kuwo angu-160 kungamadoda angabelungu, amadoda amathathu kungabantu abamnyanga nabesifazane ababili abangabelungu."Ngo-2023 izibalo zikhomba ukuthi eNingizimu Afrika bekunamajaji angu-253 kuwo angu-113 ngabesifazane, u32% wawo ngabesifazane abamnyama. Siqala le nyanga nje umengameli usanda kuqoka umengameli wamajaji wokuqala ongumuntu wesifazane, uJustice Mandisa Maya," kusho uNk Chikunga.Uthe ezinhlelweni ezihlelwe umnyango ezizokwenziwa kule nyanga kubalwa umbungazo kazwelonke ozoba sePuffader, eNamaqualand, eNorthern Cape, kuwo uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa uzokwethula inkulumo yakhe. KwaZulu-Natal kuzoba nemashi yamadoda alwa nodlame lobulili ezobe iholwa yiSilo uMisuzulu kanye nePhini likamengameli uMnuz Paul Mashatile.
I-IFP yenze umzekeliso ngokushweba kwe-MK iKwaZulu-Natal nesimo sezintombi ezinhlanu kulezo ezilishumi okukhulunywa ngazo eBhayibhelini, ezozela zalala zashweba ekutholeni umyeni.Iqembu eliholwa uhulumeni wobumbano ophethe iKwaZulu-Natal, i-IFP, lithe ukungaphathi kwe-MK esifundazweni kuyafana nokwenzeka ezintombini ezaphuthwa umendo ngenxa yokuthi azizange ziwaphathe amafutha okukhanyisa izibani zazo.I-MK iyona eyathola izihlalo eziningi esiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal, njengoba inezihlalo ezingu-37 kwezingu-80, kepha isifundazwe siphethwe ngokubambisana yi-IFP, ANC, DA ne-NFP, abanezihlalo ezingu-41 uma behlanganisiwe.Ngesikhathi kunenkulumo mpikiswano esiShayamthetho, izolo, amalungu e-MK, akhale ngokuncishwa ithuba lokuphatha iKwaZulu-Natal yize kuyiyo eyathola amavoti amaningi esifundazweni.Inkulumo mpikiswano ibibizelwe ukuzoxoxa ngenkulumo eyethulwe uNdunankulu, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, ngoLwesithathu.Ohola i-MK esiShayamthetho, uMnuz Mervyn Dirks, uthe uNtuli akafanelwe ukuphatha isifundazwe, wathi uzosuka maduzane."Abantu baKwaZulu-Natal bavotela i-MK ngobuningi. Ngokuhlakanipha ke kwenu namaqembu enibambisene nawo, naphuca i-MK ithuba lokuthi iphathe isifundazwe. Angeke sibenzele phansi abantu baKwaZulu-Natal abavotela i-MK, sizoqhubeka silwe. Ukungaphathi kwethu kuyinto yesikhashana.”La mazwi ananelwe elinye ilungu le-MK, uMnuz Sithembiso Magubane, okhale ngokuthi alikho iqembu elasondela kwi-MK ngamavoti KwaZulu-Natal.I-MK yathola amavoti angaphezu kuka-1,6 million KwaZulu-Natal, iqembu eliyilandelayo, i-IFP yathola amavoti angaphezu kuka-600 000.Ilungu le-IFP, uMnuz Mntomuhle Khawula, lithe abe-MK kufanele bazinuke amakhwapha ngokungaphathi kwabo iKwaZulu-Natal.UKhawula uthe njengoba lingekho iqembu elanqoba ngamalengiso KwaZulu-Natal, wonke amaqembu kwakufanele angene ezingxoxweni zokubusa ngokubambisana."Izandla zazivuliwe kuwo wonke amaqembu ukuba axoxe kodwa kwaba khona akhetha ukungaxoxi ngoba nakhu ayekholelwa ukuthi wona alunqobile ukhetho. NaseBhayibhelini kukhulunywa ngezintombi ezilishumi. Kuyashiwo ukuthi zozela zalala ngesikhathi zisalinde umyeni. Kuyashiwo ukuthi lezo eziyizihlakaniphi zaphatha amafutha okukhanyisa izibani awenele, lezo eziyiziwula aziwaphatha amafutha.”Elinye ilungu le-IFP, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, lithe ukwakhiwa kohulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal kwakungeke kuvinjwe yiqembu elinezihlalo ezingu-37."Abantu be-MK kufanele bafundiswe ipolitiki.”UNtuli uthe angeke kuyisize ngalutho i-MK ukubalisa, wathi kufanele ingakhohlwa ukuthi ayizange inqobe ngamalengiso."Ukuze uphathe isifundazwe kufanele uthole ngaphezu kuka-50% wamavoti. Alikho iqembu elathola ngaphezu kuka-50% wamavoti lapha KwaZulu-Natal. Amaqembu aphethe athola u-55% wamavoti uma ehlanganisiwe. Ingakho ephethe."Ukubalisa angeke kubasize ngalutho abantu baKwaZulu-Natal. Manje sekufanele ukuthi wonke amaqembu asebenzisane ukuze kufezwe izidingo zabantu.”
SIDALE uqhekeko kumalungu enhlangano yothisha abangaqashiwe, i-KZN United Unemployed Educators, isenzo soMnyango wezeMfundo esifundazweni sokuqasha ngasese abanye babaholi bayo okuthiwa bathole izincwadi ezibakhomba ezikoleni ezithile, ngesonto eledlule.Abanye bakholwa ukuthi lokhu kuphambene nesimemezelo esenziwe nguMphathiswa eMnyangweni, uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka, ngokushintshwa kohlelo lokuqasha othisha. Isimemezelo besithi zonke izikhala zikhangiswe ngendlela esobala evumela noma wubani afake isicelo, okuhlukile kobekwenzeka phambili njengoba bekudingeka kutonyulwe kuphela amagama aku-database yomnyango. Umnyango ubuveze ukuthi lokhu ukwenza ngenhloso yokulwa nenkohlakalo ekuqashweni kothisha njengoba bekunezikhalo eziningi ngohlelo oludala, namalungu ale nhlangano abelugxeka kakhulu. Lungesinye sezikhalo esenze aqoka ukuyoqhinqa emahhovisi omnyango, eMgungundlovu kusuka ngenyanga edlule.Nakuba kunjalo, Isolezwe lithole ukuthi iningi labebesekhaleni lempi kule nhlangano, yibona abathole izincwadi zokuqashwa ezibakhomba ezikoleni ezehlukene, ngaphandle kwesikhangiso esifakiwe.UMnuz Mfanelo Mncube ongomunye wabaholi bale nhlangano, uthe abanye ozakwabo abamukele lezi zincwadi, bebethenjwe kakhulu ngamalungu."Sonke lesi sikhathi besilwela ukuthi kuphele inkohlakalo ekuqashweni kothisha. Kuyadumaza ukuthi ozakwethu ebisilwa nabo, bona futhi baqashwa ngendlela efanayo. Siyabahalalisela ngomsebenzi kodwa okwenzekile kushiya imibuzo kumalungu ukuthi akusiyona yini imizamo yokusivala imilomo? Kungabe izikhala zisazoqhubeka zikhangiswe na njengoba silindele ukuthi umnyango wenze njalo kusukela ngoLwesine (namuhla)?” usho kanje.Uthe okubuhlungu ukuthi abathole izincwadi zokuqashwa abahlale beqhinqe eMgungundlovu, kanti basekwa ngeminikelo yenqwaba yamalungu asuke engakwazi ukuphumelela ngenxa yezizathu ezehlukene eziphoqayo, enikela ngemali ukuthi bakwazi ukudla nokukhokhela nendlu yesonto abalala kuyo.Omunye wamalungu ongathandanga ukudalulwa, uthe bebekhokha imali esuka ku- R20 umuntu eyedwa ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ababamele eMgungundlovu abahlupheki, kanti emva kokuvela kwalezi zindaba, abanye sebenqume ukungayifaki imali ngoba bakholelwa ukuthi sebedayisiwe.UMnuz Ndumiso Mngwengwe owuSihlalo wale nhlangano, uqinisekise ukuthi ungomunye wabamukele incwadi yokuqashwa kwakhe."Ebesikulwela sesikutholile. Besifuna ukuthi izikhala zikhangiswe ngendlela esobala okuyinto ezokwenziwa kusuka ngoLwesine. Uhlelo lokukhangisa luqala ngoLwesine, ngakho thina sisaqashwe ngohlelo lakudala lokufakwa kwemininingwane kwi-database,” usho kanje.Ukuphikile ukuthi ukuqashwa kwabo yimizamo yokuvalwa imilomo, wathi basazoqhubeka noma sebeqashiwe ukulwela ukuthi iningi lothisha abahleli emakhaya baqasheke. Uthe okwenzekile, yikhona kanye abavumelene ngakho nomnyango ikakhulukazi bona abebeqhinqe eMgungundlovu, bedele amakhaza ukulwela amalungelo othisha abahleli emakhaya.Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Muzi Mahlambi, ethunyelelwa imibuzo ngalolu daba, uthe sekukaningi bezwa ngezinsolo zokuqashwa kothisha, kodwa uma sekumele kutholakale ubufakazi akwenzeki. Nakuba kunjalo, uMngwengwe ekhuluma neSolezwe uzivumele yena ukuthi ubengowokugcina ukwamukela incwadi yokuqashwa kwakhe, waveza ukuthi akusibona kuphela abaholi benhlangano abaqashiwe, kodwa kukhona nabanye bakwezinye izindawo.
UKHALA ngokungasukunyelwa kwenkinga yokudlebekela kwezigebengu usomabhizinisi waseMgungundlovu, obhekene nenkinga yokugqekezelwa izikhawu eziningi, kucekelwe phansi impahla nengqalasizinda yokusebenza ebhizinisini lakhe.UMnuz Bongani Zuma wase-Unit 2, eMbali, uthi ibhizinisi lakhe liqashisa ngezindawo zokusebenzela kwabenza amabhizinisi ehlukene okubalwa ukucwala ikhanda, awabathungayo nabadayisa ukudla nemikhiqizo eyahlukene.Nokho ukuthula akakutholi ngenxa yokwanda kwezigameko zokucekelwa phansi kwempahla yamakhasimende akhe, okuba nomthelela omubi njengoba kuwaxosha, abone kungaphephile ezigebengwini."Lezi zigameko ziqale ukwenzeka ngabo-2022, lapho ebesifika khona ekuseni kugqekeziwe futhi kucekelwe phansi impahla yamakhasimende ami. Sekwaba yinsakavukela njengoba kungapheli isikhathi esingakanani, kuphinde kwenzeke. "Kwala ngisho ngibika kaningi emaphoyiseni, akukho mehluko futhi akukho muntu oboshwayo. Inkinga yami wukuthi anginawo amandla okuqasha abaqaphi ebhizinisini, yingakho kubiyiwe kodwa izigebengu ziyangena, zimoshe konke,” kulanda uZuma.Uthe le ndawo ayivula ngo-2013, inezakhiwo eziwu-9 eziwusizo kakhulu emphakathini ngoba zenza kube lula kosomabhizinisi asabafufusa abaqashe kuyena ukusebenzela futhi iwukuphela kwendlela aziphilisa ngayo nezingane zakhe eziyisithupha.Uthe kuyamkhathaza kakhulu konke lokhu, ikakhulu ngoba ubona kungekho okwenziwa wumthetho ukunqanda inkinga abhekene nayo, wathi kugcine ukugqekezwa ngoMeyi nonyaka ebhizinisini.Kuthintwa okhulumela amaphoyisa esifundazweni, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uqinisesike ukuthi amaphoyisa ayazi ngezinye zezigameko ezibikwa wuZuma. "Amacala obugebengu obuhleliwe bokweba impahla nokukhomba ngesibhamu abikwa esiteshini samaphoyisa ePlessislaer ukuthi kuphenywe ngezigameko ezenzeka ngoMashi 27 wango-2022 nangoFebhuwari 17 wango-2024, nokho akukaze kuboshwe muntu ngazo,” kusho uNetshiunda.
BAKHALA ngesikhwama sempesheni esingayikhokhi imali yabo onogada abathola uma sebexoshiwe ukuthi imali yempesheni ibingangeni kwiPrivate Security Sector Provident Fund (PSSPF).Onogada abakhulume neSolezwe kodwa bacela ukuthi angadalulwa amagama abo ngoba bafesa kwezinye izinkampani, bathe iPSSPF ayibasizi ngoba nayo ivele ibatshele ukuthi izinkampani bezingayifaki imali yempesheni esikhwameni yize ibidonswa nyanga zonke emholweni wabo.UMnuz Bheki Dzanibe, onguNobhala weDudula Movement KwaZulu-Natal, uthe kukhona onogada abakhale kubona ngendaba yokungayitholi imali yempesheni."Akuyona kuphela imali yempesheni ebanjelwa onogada bese ingafakwa esikhwameni sempesheni kodwa sithole ukuthi babanjelwa ne-UIF kodwa nayo ayidluliselwa eMnyangweni wezemiSebenzi. Siyalulwa lolu daba sesize sathola nommeli ozolusingatha ngoba akekho ofuna ukusiza onogada,” kusho uDzanibe.Uthe bafuna uNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, akhiphe umyalelo wokuthi kuqashwe ngokugcwele onogada abaqaphe izikhungo zikahulumeni kanjalo nalabo abasebenza ukuzihlanza."Sifisa kuqale uNtuli aqashe onogada nabahlanza izikhungo zikahulumeni ngokuphelele KwaZulu-Natal, ngoba ukusebenzela izinkampani ezithola amathenda kufana nokubaxhaphaza. Abasebenzi abayitholi imihlomulo efanele njengeyempesheni neminye ezoletha isithunzi empilweni yabo. Bahlale beyitoho impilo yabo yonke ngoba abanye sithole ukuthi sebesebenze iminyaka ewu-11 kodwa abanampesheni, abana-UIF yize idonswa emholweni yabo nyanga zonke,” kusho uDzanibe.Uthe bafuna uhulumeni kazwelonke nawo uqashe abantu ngokugcwele uyeke uhlelo lwamathenda axhaphaza onogada nabahlanza izikhungo zawo.NgoJulayi 16, Isolezwe liyithintile iPSSPF kwangena umlayezo wekhompyutha othe omunye wabasebenzi uzophendula i-email emuva kwezinsuku ezimbili kodwa kuze kube manje akekho ophendulile.UNksz Muvhango Lukhaimane oxazulula izinkinga zezimpesheni, uthe izikhalo azitholayo nge-PSSPF zisuke zidalwe wukuthi abasebenzi abayitholanga imali yabo ngoba kuthiwa abaqashi babo bebengayifaki imali kulesi sikhwama.Uthe kodwa naso asikhokhi ngesikhathi ngakho uthola bebaningi onogada abalinde imali yabo yempesheni."Esikhathini esiningi ngiye ngithole ukuthi abanikazi bezinkampani zonogada abayidluliseli imali esikhwameni esifanele kodwa naso lesi sikhwama sinephutha ngoba asilandeleli. Anginawo amandla okubopha isikhwama esithintekayo kodwa ezimeni eziphoqayo ngiye ngiyalele osuke efake isikhalo ukuthi aye enkantolo ukuze akhokhelwe imali yakhe,” kuchaza uNksz Lukhaimane.
Kufe abasolwa ngokuduna imoto abathathu, kwalimala iphoyisa elilodwa ngesikhathi kudutshulwana eMlaza, eThekwini, ngoLwesihlanu ekuseni.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe abasolwa bebeqeda ukuduna owesifazane imoto kwaR ngesikhathi amaphoyisa ebajaha."Kujahwane ngezimoto ngesivinini nokuthe kufikwa kwaT, abasolwa badubula bebhekise emaphoyiseni nawo ase ezivikela ngokudubula. Kufe abasolwa abathathu. Iphoyisa lidubuleke engalweni kanti lisesimeni esigculisayo,” kusho uNetshiunda.Uthe abasolwa batholakale nezibhamu ezintathu nemoto abebesolwa ngokuyiduna.Owesifazane oduniwe akalimalanga.
IYAQONGA ingcindezi ebhekene noMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa yokuthi ajube uphiko oluphenya amacala athinta inkohlakalo, iSpecial Investigating Unit (SIU), ukuthi iphenye inkohlakalo kwi-National Skills Fund.Lesi sikhwama esingaphansi koMnyango weMfundo ePhakeme, sakhelwe ukuphucula amakhono nokuxhasa izinhlelo ezehlukene.I-DA, Fedusa nophiko lwentsha lwe-EFF bakhala ngenkohlakalo edla lubi kulesi sikhwama.Muva nje kuvele umbiko wokuthi kunemali ebalelwa ku-R123 million, eyakhwatshaniswa esikhwameni.UNkk Desiree van der Walt, iphini lomkhulumeli we-DA kwezemfundo ephakeme, unxuse uRamaphosa ukuthi ajube i-SIU ukuthi iphenye ngenkohlakalo kulesi sikhwama.Uthe le mali engu-R123 million eyadliwa, kusolwa ukuthi yathenga izimoto zikanokusho nepulazi.Uveze ukuthi le mali yayihlelelwe izinhlelo zokufuya onogwaja, kuqeqeshwe imiphakathi ngalokhu kufuya baphinde bayiswe kwamanye amazwe."Sifuna i-SIU iphenye. Abathola lolu xhaso kuthiwa basebenzisa kuphela u-R1.6 million ohlelweni lokufuya. Sethemba ukuthi ungqongqoshe omusha emnyangweni uzobeka phambili izitshudeni ezidonsa kanzima, akhuculule inkohlakalo.” IFedusa igxeke inkohlakalo kulesi sikhwama yathi le mali bekufanele yenze izinhlelo zokuqeda indlala.Inxuse abezomthetho ukuthi babophe abakhwabanise imali yomphakathi."Siyayigxeka eyokuthi imali ebihlele ukuphucula umphakathi igcine isiyenza okunye. Akubuyiswe le mali elahlekile ukuze ifakwe kwezinye izinhlelo.” I-EFFSC ithe ukwebiwa kwale mali kuphuca intsha ithuba lokuthola amakhono.Ithe kufanele kuboshwe abathintekayo, kuliwe nenkohlakalo ebuyisela izwe emuva."Ngeke siphumule kuze kubanjwe abenzi bobubi. Kumele benziwe isibonelo labo okuyotholakala ukuthi babe neqhaza kule nkohlakalo.” OwayenguNgqongqoshe womnyango, uDkt Blade Nzimande, wakuveza ePhalamende ukuthi kunophenyo ababelwenza mayelana nokungacaci ukuthi washonaphi u-R5 billion kulesi sikhwama.Wajuba ithimba elaliphenya ngalokhu kunyamalala kwale mali eminyakeni emibili yezimali.Okhulumela uNzimande, uMnuz Veli Mbhele, ucashunwe kwiNewzroom Afrika, ethi ezinye zezinto seziphenywa abezomthetho ngakho akakwazi ukukhuluma ngazo.Uthe uNzimande usaya komunye umnyango wathi unethemba ukuthi uMnyango weMfundo ephakeme uzophawula maduzane ngalolu daba.
BEKUYINJABULO ngesikhathi isikole samabanga aphansi iMthethweni Primary, eMlaza, sivakashelwe inkampani i-Sporting Chance ibambisene nenkampani i-Walt Disney Afrika kuyoqwashiswa abafundi ngokuhlala bezivocavoca, izolo.Ukuhambela izikole kuwuhlelo olubizwa nge-Happy Healthy Play nalapho behlose ukunika amandla izikole ezintula izinsiza ukuze zifundise nangokubaluleka kokuzivocavoca ezikoleni.Ezinye izinto izingane eziqwashiswe ngazo ukufundiswa ukudla ukudla okunomsoco futhi okuzozinika amandla kanye nokuzivocavoca ngezindlela ezihlukahlukene ongakwenza uzihlalele ekhaya.Imenenja yakwa-Sporting Chance, uMnuz Bradlyn Stuurman, ikhuluma neSolezwe, ithe lolu hlelo baluqala ngo-2016."Inhloso yethu ukuqhakambisa ukubaluleka kokuzivocavoca nokuthi izingane ziphile kahle. Isizathu sokuthi sivakashele ezikoleni ezingenazo izinsiza ezifanele yingoba ezinye zazo azinazo izinhlaka ezikahle zokuthi izingane zizivocavoce,” kusho uStuurman.Uthe kumqoka ukuthi izingane zifundiswe zisezincane ngokuzivocavoca futhi kubekhona ozoziqeqesha ezikoleni."Izingane kumele ziphile impilo ekahle. Sisazama ukuthola abaqeqeshi emphakathini abazokwazi ukuziqeqesha ukuze siqhubeke nohlelo lwethu. Omunye umgomo esinawo wukuthi uma sesibatholile abaqeqeshi, sibahlomise ngolwazi. Siphinde sipende indawo esiyibiza nge-happy play ground ngaphakathi ezikoleni esizivakashelayo ukuze kuxhumane nohlelo lwezemfundo abalufundayo kwaGrade 3 okubalwa kulo ukuzivocavoca, ngezindlela ezehlukene,” usho kanje.Uthisha, uNksz Zama Cuambe, ofundisa uGrade 3 eMthethweni, uthe okwenziwe yi-Disney World kubasize kakhulu."Sisizakele ngoba abantwana bazokhula bazi ukuthi yikuphi ukudla okumele bakudle okuzobasiza ekukhuleni kwabo nokumele bakugweme ukuze bangangenwa yizifo,” kusho uNksz Cuambe.Uthe njengothisha bakuthokozelile okulethelwe abafundi ngoba kuyisifundo esihle. Uthe njengoba befundisa izingane bazoqikelela ukuthi ziyazivocavoca ngoba zingabantu abafunda ngokubuka. Uqhube wathi nezithombe abazitholile zibahlomise ngolwazi okuzosiza izingane ukuze zibone ukuthi uma zidla ukudla okuthile imizimba yazo izobukeka kanjani.
LIVELE lakhiphela ulaka lalo ezintathelini iphoyisa eliboshelwe icala lokubulala unina, libuza ukuthi zifunani enkantolo nokuthi zivumelekile yini ukucoshela okuqhubeka ecaleni?UConstable Lungisani Xaba (48) ubekade evele eNkantolo yesiFunda yasePinetown, izolo.Ungenisane nezintatheli nentombi yakhe enkantolo yena esuka ezitokisini. Ube esenza izimpawu okomuntu obuza ugwayi entombini. Emuva kwalokho, ube esephakamisa isandla edonsa amehlo emantshi, wacela ukudlana indlebe nommeli wakhe ongowomdabu waseNdiya, kwasondela notolika ezobalekelela batholane ngenkulumo.Kulowo mzuzu, uXaba uphendule ikhanda, wabuka ngenhla kwehlombe lakhe lakwesokunxele wakhomba ngesandla izintatheli.Uphimise amagama athi: "Bafunani laba lana? Ngicela ukubuza ukuthi zivumelekile yini izintatheli ukuthi zithamele leli cala enkantolo?”UXaba obekubonakala ukuthi udiniwe, uthe udaba lwakhe lugcwele yonke indawo, kufundwa ngalo nasejele laseWestville agqunywe kulona.Izintatheli bezikade zihleli emabhentshini angemuva kwakhe eduze kwebhokisi okuhlala kulona abammangalelwa. Intombi yakhe beyihleli ngemuva kwezintatheli.Enkantolo kuvele ukuthi uXaba ubonane nodokotela ngoLwesithathu owedlule, omxilongile wase ethola ukuthi akakulungele ukuqula icala ngenxa yokugula anakho.Udokotela uphinde wabhala, enza isincomo sokuthi yize emhlolile kodwa uphakamisa ukuthi ayohlolwa kabanzi wudokotela wengqondo.Umshushisi, uMnuz S Govender, ube esetshela inkantolo ukuthi bafuna umbono kadokotela wesibili ngakho kuzomele kuqalwe uhlelo lokuthi uXaba atholelwe umbhede esibhedlela iFort Napier, eMgungundlovu, lapho ezoxilongelwa khona.Kodwa kugcine kungenzekanga lokho ngoba ummeli kaXaba uvele watshela imantshi ukuthi usekhulumile nommangalelwa ngakho bahlabela phambili necala.Ummeli ukushaye indiva ukukhononda kukaXaba akwenzile mayelana nezintatheli ekhuluma nemantshi u-B Asmal.Nebala imantshi ibe isibeka usuku lwango-Agasti 14 nonyaka, ukuze kuqalwe izindlalelo zokuqala kokuqulwa kwecala.Lapha uMbuso nommeli kulindeleke bakhulume ngobufakazi obamukelwayo, obungaphikiswa kubekwe nosuku okuzoqala ngalo icala.Imantshi ikhale ngokudleka kwesikhathi lingaquliwe icala, yathi kusukela ngoNovemba 2022, efika enkantolo uXaba, akunyakazeki.Ikhombe ngasohlangothi lukaXaba, yathi ukubambezeleka okuningi kuqhamuka ngakulona.Abekade engekho enkantolo amalungu omndeni kaXaba ahlale efuna ukuthi kuqale icala khona ezothola umnyombo wesehlakalo sokushona kukamama wabo.UXaba usolwa ngokushaya ngepulangwe abulale unina, uNkk Greta Xaba (81), owayephila nokukhubazeka.Isigameko senzeka emzini kamufi KwaDabeka, ngoMeyi 6, 2022, waboshwa ngakusasa uXaba.
IPHINI likaNgqongqoshe weMfundo ePhakeme uMnuz Buti Manamela, lithe asikho isidingo sokuthi kwenziwe ushintsho ezinhlelweni zomnyango ngoba ezikhona ziyasebenza. UManamela uthe izinhlelo zenza kube nozinzo futhi zihambisana nokubalulwa umqulu wokuthuthukisa izwe, iNational Development Plan.Uthe noma izwe selibuswa nguhulumeni ohlanganisa amaqembu ahlukene anemibono yawo ngezemfundo kodwa kubalulekile ukuthi lo mkhakha unganyakaziswa. "Ibambe ngakho ngezinhlelo ezikhona, asikho isidingo sokuthi siyishintshe, senze kungabi nozinzo. Siyazi izinto okumele sizenze ukuphucula lo mkhakha,” kusho uManamela.Ukusho lokhu ngenkathi ekhuluma engqungqutheleni esongwa namhlanje eLimpopo, yenhlangano yothishanhloko bamakolishi amakhono iSouth African Public Colleges Organisation (SAPCO).Usho lokhu nje izinhlangano ezimele imikhandlu yezitshudeni iSAUS neSasco, zahlaba ikhwelo lokuthi kungenziwa izinguquko ezinqala ikakhulu esikhwameni esixhasa ngemali yokufunda ezikhungweni iNSFAS. Lezi zinhlangano zazinongabazane zingazi ukuthi yikuphi okuzokwenzeka kulesi sikhwama njengoba abaholi bamaqembu ahlukene, bebefuna kwenzeke izinguquko kusona.Bebefuna isikhwama sibuyele kwesasikwenza phambilini okokuthi sigxile ekubolekeni imali yokufunda izitshudeni.I-DA yayihamba phambili ithi kumele kwenziwe izinguquko esikhwameni.UManamela uthe kubalulekile ukuthi amakolishi asebenzisane nezinkampani ezehlukene ukuze kube nezinguquko ohlelweni lokufunda."Uma sisebenzisana nezinkampani kuzoba lula ukwazi ukuthi zifunani. Ngaleyo ndlela sizokwazi ukufundisa lokhu okudingwa abaqashi.” Uthe ukuze lo mkhakha ukhule kumele izitshudeni zibambe iqhaza."Izitshudeni kumele ziveze imibono yazo ngokuthi zifuna kwenziweni kulo mkhakha. Ngaphandle kwazo asikwazi uwukukhulisa.”
Uzoshaya indesheni emantshini acele ibheyili owesifazane oboshelwe icala lokubulala indodakazi yakhe eyayinodume lwengozi yokushaywa ngento ethile esiphundu.Kubikwa ukuthi isigameko senzeka KwaMashu, kwa-D ngoMsombuluko ekuseni ngesonto eledlule.Umsolwa uNksz Ncomisile Evarista Hlophe (43) uboshwe ngoLwesine lwesonto eledlule, wavela okokuqala eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseNtuzuma ngoMsombuluko.Namuhla ngoLwesihlanu kulindeleke ukuthi afake isicelo sebheyili ngecala lokubulala uLuvuyo Tafadzwe Bera (14).Umsolwa kuthiwa watshela amaphoyisa ukuthi ingane yakhe iphuze amaphilisi ekhanda, kanti izowela phansi isuka embhedeni eyayikade ilele kuwona, kwaba ukuthula kwayo.Nebala amaphoyisa kuthiwa afika asithatha isidumbu kwase kuvulwa idokodo ngokufa komuntu esiteshini samaphoyisa saKwaMashu.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe lishintshiwe icala laba ngelokubulala emuva kokuhlolwa kwesidumbu."Umufi ubenenxeba elivulekile esiphundu kanti waqinisekiswa njengomuntu oshonele endaweni yesehlakalo. Umbiko kadokotela wokuhlolwa kwesidumbu uveze ukuthi wabulawa futhi washaywa ngento ethile,” kusho uNetshiunda.Uthe unina kamufi uboshiwe wabekwa icala lokubulala.Ngokuthola ngomthombo weSolezwe, kwakunamachaphazelo egazi lapho abosizo oluphuthumayo abafica khona isidumbu endlini.Kuvela nokuthi umufi nonina bebekade behlala bobabili kulo muzi osemgwaqweni uSangwana nokumenze waba ngumsolwa.Kuthiwa umbiko kadokotela uveze nokuthi umufi ubekade enomaka okomuntu oklinyiwe.

Uma ungasinelwe uyinsizwa ziningi izinto ezikudlulayo, ngisho kugcotshwa abashumayeli nabefundisi awunikwa lelo thuba. Noma ungaganile akulula ukuthola ithuba lokuthi ube ngumholi ebandleni. Yingakho amaNazaretha ewubona ubalulekile umshado,” kusho uMncwabe.Ecacisa ngohlelo lomshado nokukhethwa kwezintombi okuyinto ebiyenzeka ngempelasonto, uMncwabe uthe awukho umshado obusiswa kuleli sonto kungalotsholiwe, futhi esigcawini semishado kuya izintombi nto eziqala ngokuthi ziyohlolwa ubuntombi bese zibonakala ngechashaza elimhlophe esiphongweni ukuqinisekisa ubuntombi bazo.UMHOLI wamaNazaretha inkosi Mduduzi Shembe uNyazilwezulu okhiphe inqwaba yemishado ngempelasonto Isithombe: FACEBOOK"Njengoba bekushadwa ngeSonto, zonke izintombi bese zihloliwe zanikwa inansuka (indwangu eluhlaza ezimboza ngayo ikhanda). Inansuka itholakala esontweni kuphela futhi inikwa umuntu oseyintombi nto ozoshada. Izintombi ezisuke zizoshada uzibona ngayo. Noma ngabe sekushadiwe ngokohlelo lwenkonzo kusuke kumele ukuthi zingapheli izinyanga eziyisithupha ungalukhiphanga udwendwe. AWAGAYELWE mphako amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal kulezi zinsuku, uma ebhekene nabasolwa ngezenzo zobugebengu nokuhlalisa lubhojozi umphakathi, njengoba eseqothe inqwaba esikhathini esingaphansi kwezinyanga ezimbili.Esigamekweni sakamuva, esenzeke eCato Crest eMayville, ngoLwesibili ebusuku, amaphoyisa edubule abahlanu okuthiwa bebefunwa uthuli ngamacala okubamba inkunzi amabhizinisi omphakathi namathathu okubulala.Isigameko siholele ekutheni babe ngu-32 abasolwa ababulewe ngamaphoyisa ezinyangeni ezimbili (Juni noJulayi), okuvele ukuthi bonke baqale badubule kuqala babhekise kuwo, bese ephendula ngendlela efanayo. Kuzona zonke izigameko ezenzekile, alikho iphoyisa elibulaliwe okuyinto eshayelwa ihlombe umkhuzi wawo esifundazweni uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi. ULt Gen Mkhwanazi usenconywe ngabaningi ngokuqothwa kwezigebengu okuthiwa zihlasela amaphoyisa uma ezama ukuzibopha.Nakuba kunjalo, isishoshovu esilwela amalungelo abantu, uNksz Mary de Haas, uthe ukuqothwa kwabasolwa ngobugebengu ngale ndlela akunabo ubulungiswa futhi kuveza amaphoyisa njengabantu abazithathela umthetho ngezandla."Kumele sikhathazeke kakhulu ngalokhu kudutshulwa kwabasolwa okwenzeka izikhathi zilandelana. Kunezigameko okuqondakalayo ukuthi kungani amaphoyisa edubule abasolwa. Kuyaqondakala uma edubula abebebamba imoto yemali, lapho ke akungabazeki ukuthi basuke behlome beyizingovolo, ingekho enye indlela amaphoyisa angabhekana nabo ngayo,” usho kanjeUthe sekukaningi kunemibiko eveza ukuthi amaphoyisa adubula abasolwa ngoba impilo yawo isuke isengozini kodwa isikhathi esiningi kusuke kungasilona iqiniso. Uthe kwesinye isikhathi kuyaye kube nobufakazi bophenyo obuvezayo ukuthi umuntu osuke ebulewe usuke engesiyona ingozi emaphoyiseni. Uveze ukuthi akukhona konke okushiwo ngamaphoyisa ngalezi zigameko okuyiqiniso njengoba kwesinye isikhathi engakwenza ukugqiba inkohlakalo yawo. Uphinde wakuveza ukuthi isikhathi esiningi ababulawa ngamaphoyisa basuke bebandakanyeka ekudayiseni izidakamizwa futhi amanye awo enesandla, ngakho ukudutshulwa kwabo kusuke nje kuwukususa ubufakazi obuthile. UDe Haas uthe okunye uma amaphoyisa edubula abantu abaningi kangaka, kukhombisa ukuthi kukhona okungahambi kahle kwezobunhloli emaphoyiseni ikakhulu ukubhekana nokusabalala kwezibhamu esifundazweni. Ukhale ngokungakhokhelwa ngendlela nokubulawa kwezimpimpi zamaphoyisa akholwa ukuthi - kwesinye isikhathi - ulwazi lusuke luputshuzwe yiwo uqobo.Yize uNksz de Haas ebalule ukuthi amaphoyisa nawo kumele abhekisiswe ekwenzeni kwawo kodwa zikhona izigameko lapho amaphoyisa ehlaselwa khona. Ezigamekweni zakamuva esenzeke ngoJuni 6 nonyaka, lapho iphoyisa eliwu-captain elisebenzela esiteshini esikwaMashu elisinde ngokulambisa emvuleni yezinhlamvu lizithela kwabebebamba imoto ethwala imali emgwaqweni u-N2, ekuseni libheke emsebenzini.Kwesinye isigameko esenzeke ngesonto eledlule ePhoenix, iphoyisa lidutshulwe lalimala ngesikhathi iqeqebana labasolwa ebelihlomile libamba inkunzi isitolo esidayia ubucwebe kule ndawo.Okhulumela uphiko oluphenya ngamacala athinta amaphoyisa, i-Independent Police Investigating Directorate (IPID), uMnuz Phaladi Shuping, uthe kukhona lapho uphiko lwabo luthole ukuthi amaphoyisa asebenzise umthetho ukudubula izigebengu kanti kukhona nalapho okuvela ukuthi awephulile."Lapho ephula khona umthetho, kubhalwa umbiko oyayela ukuthi athathelwe izinyathelo, bese amadokodo edluliselwa ophikweni lwezokushushisa uma kubonakala ukuthi kubekhona izenzo zobugebengu,” usho kanje.Okhulumela amaphoyisa uColonel Robert Netshiunda ekhuluma ezikweni labezindaba i-Newzroom Afrika, ebuzwa mayelana nokudubula kwamaphoyisa, uthe awavele avuke ekuseni eyodubula abantu kodwa asuke eqondene ngqo nabasolwa emva kokuthola umkhondo ngabo."Siyabalandela abasolwa ngenhloso yokubabopha. Ngokuthola ukuthi bakephi kulandela uphenyo, esikhundleni sokuthi bathobele umthetho bazama inhlanhla ngokudubula amaphoyisa. Uma bedubula, amaphoyisa kumele azivikele, kungenjalo yiwona angazithola esefile,” usho kanje.Uthe abasolwa abadutshulwe eCato Crest batholwe nesibhamu esikhulu, nezintathu ezincane nezidakamizwa.Ezinye izigameko amaphoyisa aqothe kuzo abasolwa okuthiwa abedubula ebhekise kuwo; NgoJulayi 26, adubule abasolwa ababili eNanda, okukholakala ukuthi abeqembu lezigebengu i-West elihlalise lubhojozi umphakathiNgosuku olufanayo, abasolwa abathathu badutshulwe KwaDlangezwa, babefunwa ngamacala okubamba inkunzi nokubulalaNgoJulayi 25, kudutshulwe indoda esolwa ngokuqhumisa umshini wemali eSikhaleni NgoJulayi, 25, adubule abasolwa abathathu eNanda, abebefunwa ngawokubulala okukhona kuwo olokubulala iphoyisa nokubamba inkunziNgoJulayi, 21, adubule umsolwa owayeyisosha eMgungundlovu, eMbali, obefunwa ngamacala ahlukene kubalwa nelokubulala iphoyisaNgoJulayi, 17, adubule abasolwa abane e-Overport abebesolwa ngobunkabiNgoJulayi,14 adubule umsolwa ona-26, eNanda, eLusaka, obefunwa ngamacala amathathu okubulalaNgoJulayi 7, kudutshulwe ababili eChartsworth ngokuntshontshwa kwamakhebula esakhiweni sikahulumeni.NgoJuni 5, munye umsolwa odutshulwe eMbumbulu, obefunwa ngamacala okuduna izimoto nokubamba inkunziNgoJuni 10, adubule abasolwa abane eHarding, okuthiwa bebezama ukubamba inkunzi usomabhizinisi obephuma ebhangeNgoJuni 4, adubule ababili ePhoenix abasolwa ngokubamba inkunzi izimoto ezithwala imalingoJuni 3, kudutshulwe umsolwa oyedwa obefunwa ngamacala okubulala ababili abasekomitini elilwa nobugebengu eNanda.

NAKUBA iqembu elikhulu esiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal, i-MK lithi uNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, uthinte izihloko ezimqoka ngesikhathi ethula umhlahlandlela kahulumeni wesifundazwe kodwa lithe alinalo ithemba lokuthi uzozifeza izethembiso azenze.Bakusho lokhu ngesikhathi bephawula emva kwenkulu eyethulwe nguNtuli esiShayamthetho, eMphithi.Inkulumo kaNtuli ibigxile ekuthuthukiseni umnotho, ukulwa nendlala, ubugebengu, nenkohlakalo, nokuthuthukisa ezemfundo nezempilo.Inkulumo inconywe ngamaqembu abusa ngokubambisana ne-IFP kuhulumeni wesifundazwe; okuyi-ANC, DA ne-NFP.La maqembu athe izinhlelo ezimenyezelwe nguNtuli zizothuthukisa isifundazwe.Kepha abe-MK bathe bazokholwa uma sebebona uNtuli esenza lokho akuthembisile.I-MK iyona enezihlalo eziningi esiShayamthetho.Umdidiyeli we-MK KwaZulu-Natal, uDkt Kwazi Mbanjwa, uthe uhulumeni uhlezi wenza izethembiso ezigcina zingafezwanga."Siyazi ukuthi uNtuli uyaqala ukuphatha uhulumeni wesifundazwe. Abantu abasebenzi, badinga imisebenzi, ubugebengu buphezulu. Kuningi akushilo okwenza umqondo. Inkinga yethu ukuthi izikhathi eziningi kuba nezethembiso kodwa akukho okuphumelelayo.”UMbanjwa uthe njengeqembu eliphikisayo bazolandelela ukuthi izithembiso ziyafezwa.UMphathiswa wezokuThutha nokuHlaliswa kwaBantu ophinde abe uSihlalo we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Siboniso Duma, uthe inkulumo kaNtuli iyahambisana naleyo eyethulwa uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, ngesikhathi evula iPhalamende."URamaphosa wakhuluma ngendaba yokuthuthukiswa komnotho. UNtuli naye ukhulume ngokuthuthukiswa kwechweba laseRichard’s Bay, waphinde wakhuluma ngendaba yokulwa nobegebengu.”UDuma uthe vele igeja selisensimini kubaphathiswa baKwaZulu-Natal."Sivele sesiqalile siyasebenza. Thina nje sesikwazile ukuvakashela abashelwa izindlu ngesikhathi kunomlilo wequbula.”UMphathiswa wezeziMali ophinde abe umholi weDA KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Francios Rodgers, uthe okubajabulisile ukuthi uNtuli ugcizelele eyokuthi ukusetshenziswa kwemali yomphakathi kuzoqashwa ngelokhozi."Mahle impela amaqhinga athulwe undunankulu, kodwa ke okubalulekile ukuthi kufezwe izinto azethembisile. Sizolwela ukuthi ziyafezwa zonke.”UMphathiswa wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi ophinde abe usihlalo we-NFP KwaZulu-Natal, uNksz Mbali Shinga, uthe beyikhabhinethi lesifundazwe bazokuba 'omabizw’ asabele’."Usikhuthaze kakhulu thina malungu ekhabhinethi lakhe ukuthi ulindele uhulumeni ozogijima, ozosheshe ufinyelele, kufezwe izidingo zabantu. Siyakuthatha ke lokho, sizogijima nakho.”Namuhlanje kuzokuba nenkulumompikiswano esiShayamthetho lapho khona amaqembu ezobhunga ngenkulumo kaNtuli.
UNDUNANKULU waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, uthembise ukuthi umnotho waKwaZulu-Natal uzovuka ngaphansi kukahulumeni omusha ophethe isifundazwe.UNtuli ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ethula umhlahlandlela kahulumeni omusha, esiShayamthetho eMgungundlovu, izolo. Uthe uhulumeni wokubambisana ukubeke emahlombe awo ukwakha kabusha umnotho esifundazweni okhinyabezwe wukubheduka kobhubhane iCorona, izibhelu zikaJulayi 2021, nezikhukhula.UNtuli uthe uhulumeni wokubambisana owakhiwe i-IFP, ANC, DA ne-NFP, uhlalelwe umsebenzi ophuthumayo wokuthuthukisa umnotho."Emhlanganweni wekhabhinethi, i-lekgotla, savumelana ngokuthi kufanele sikhombe indlela siphinde sididiyele ukwakhiwa kabusha komnotho wesifundazwe.”UNtuli uthe umnotho waKwaZulu-Natal ukhula kancane uma uqhathaniswa nokukhula kwesibalo sabantu, wathi lesi simo sishaya kakhulu intsha nezingane.Uthe ezinsukwini ezingu-100 ezizayo bazogxila ekuthuthukiseni umnotho, okubalwa umnotho wasemalokishini nowasemakhaya."Umnotho wasemalokishini nowasemakhaya ubalulekile. Angeke kulunge ukuthi abantu basemalokishini nabasemakhaya baphucwe amathuba omnotho. Ezolimo zizobamba iqhaza elibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni umnotho wasezindaweni zasemakhaya. Sizokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi ubukhosi bubamba iqhaza elibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni umnotho wasezindaweni zasemakhaya.”UNtuli uthe bazoyifakela izibuko indaba yezitolo eziphethwe abokufika abangenazo izimvume zokuba kuleli."Siyakuqaphela belu ukuthi abanye babo abanezimvume zokuba kuleli abayilandeli imithetho yezempilo neyezokuphepha elawula ukugcinwa kwempahla. Abanye babo badayisa ukudla okubolile. Ezinyangeni ezintathu ezizayo sizokwenza izinhlelo zokuqinisekisa ukuthi imithetho iyalandelwa.”UNtuli uthe ngaphansi kukahulumeni omusha inkohlakalo angeke ibekezelelwe."Ngithi angikucacise ukuthi uhulumeni angeke uyibekezelele inkohlakalo, sizokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi bathathelwa izinyathelo labo abephula imithetho. Sifuna ukuthi yonke iminyango kahulumeni ilwele ukuthola imibiko yomcwaningi mabhuku engenalo ichashaza. Lena akuyona into ekufanele siyibange.”UNtuli umemezele inombolo yamahhala yokumpimpa abenza inkohlakalo ethi 080 122 9040, ne-email ethi [email protected]."Ngifisa ukuthi izakhamuzi zingathuli uma zibona inkohlakalo, nginxusa ukuthi ziyibike.”UNtuli uthe bazokulwa nobelelesi obudlangile esifundazweni athe buphazamisa ukukhula komnotho nozinzo.Uthe maduze kuzokuba nezimbizo zokubhunga ngobugebengu kuzo zonke izifunda.Uthe bazolwa nodlame lwezobulili athe ludla lubi eNanda, Mlaza naseMpangeni.UNtuli uthe osomabhizinisi abaphazamisa izinhlelo zentuthuko bazoyikhotha imbenge yomile.UNtuli uthembise ukwenza ngcono ezemfundo, ezempilo nokusiza abakhahlamezwa izikhukhula.Uphinde wamemezela ukuthi uhulumeni uzovula umfuziselo weSilo saKwaDukuza osesikhumulweni sezindiza iKing Shaka International Airport.Lo mcimbi kade wawumenyezelwa kodwa ubuye uhlehliswe.Inkulumo kaNtuli ibihanjelwe yiSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini, uNdlunkulu Nomzamo Myeni, abaNtwana basendlunkulu, inkosikazi kaNtuli uSindiswa MaSibisi Ntuli, nezikhulu zikahulumeni.
SIBUYELE kwesijwayelekile isimo engojeni yezinkulungwane zabantu bakuleli iDragon City eGoli kulandela imizamo yamaphoyisa yokukhuculula kule ndawo ngoLwesithathu.Ithimba lamaphoyisa lisebenza ngokubambisana nabaseshi bophiko lweCommerce Crime, Gauteng Crime Prevention Wardens, neBrand Protectors, lukhiphe incwadi egunyaza ukuseshwa nokushaqa okuhlosiwe eDragon City ngokuhambisana nemigomo yoMthetho wezMpahla zoMgunyathi.Ngokusho kwamaphoyisa, lena ngenye yezindlela abazama ngazo ukulwa nokuhwebelana ngezimpahla zomgunyathi nezingekho emthethweni eGauteng. "Ube yimpumelelo umsebenzi wethu njengoba kushaqwe izimpahla zomgunyathi ezingu-5,800 zenani lika-R2.4 mil. Kwaboshwa umsolwa obandakanyeka kulesi senzo esingekho emthethweni kanti uzobhekana necala eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseGoli.”
USUZOLUTHOLA eduzane usizo lwezempilo umphakathi waseMbumbulu namaphethelo emuva kokunikelelwa kukaMasipala weTheku ngomtholampilo ongumahamba nendlwana.Izolo iMeya yeTheku, uMnuz Cyril Xaba, yamukele umacekecele weveni enobuchwepheshe besimanje umasipala oxhaswe ngayo abakwaToyota.INGAPHAKATHI lomtholampilo ozosiza abantu baseMbumbulu onikelwe abakwaToyita Isithombe: Sithunyelwe Umkhandlu uthi abantu baseMdumezulu naseMadundube bebethwala isiphambano uma izulu liyidliva kungafinyeleleki emtholampilo.Kuthiwa lokhu bekudalwa yimigwaqo emibi eyibhuqu okungahambeki nhlobo kuyona uma izulu lina.UXaba ubonge wanconcoza kwaToyota wathi lo mtholampilo uzoba isixazululo ezinkingeni lapho umnyango wabo wezempilo uhluleka khona ukuhlinzeka abantu usizo ngenxa yobude bendlela."Siyajabula siwumasipala ukuthi abakwaToyota bathathe isinqumo sokuthi basihlinzeke ngomtholampilo ongumahamba nendlwana ozosiza abantu baseMbumbulu. Siyophumelela siyisizwe uma kukhona ukusebenzisana nabomkhakha wamabhizinisi,” kusho uXaba.Umengameli ophinde abe isikhulu esiphezulu kwaToyota South Africa Motors, uMnuz Andrew Kirby, uthe bajabulile ngoba kubathathe iminyaka bakhela umasipala iveni yezempilo.UKirby uthe bakhe umahamba nendlwana ukuze kube lula ukuba ufinyelele ezindaweni lapho usizo lwempilo lungafiki khona kalula."Kuyasijabulisa ukusebenza ngokuhlanganyela noMnyango wezeMpilo nomasipala. Sekunezinyanga siyihlola, siqinisekisa ukuthi imelana nanoma isiphi isimo,” kuchaza uKirby.Umtholampilo ongumahamba nendlwana kuthiwa wakhiwe waba sezingeni eliphezulu futhi uyakwazi ukumelana nanoma isiphi isimo somgwaqo nezulu.Kuvela ukuthi unethangi lamanzi eziguli, iWiFi, ama-solar panels, umbhede, i-microwave, ifriji namawindi.
BASATHUTHUMELA othisha nabafundi baseMukelani Primary, KwaMashu, kulandela ukungena kwezigebengu - ebezihlome ziyizingovolo ngezibhamu - zaphuca othisha imali namaselula.Lesi sigameko senzeke ngoLwesibili ntambama, kanti izolo abafundi abaningi nabanye othisha abalubhadanga esikoleni ngenxa yovalo.Kwenzeka lesi sigameko nje, bekusabatshazwa isigameko sangoMsombuluko ekuseni, sokubulawa kukathisha wasePhikiswayo Primary eLindelani, odutshulwe wabulawa ngamadoda amabili okuthiwa angene ngaphakathi esikoleni ngesikhathi kuphithizela kungena abafundi, amdubula washonela emagcekeni esikole. Ngokuthola kweSolezwe, esigamekweni sangoLwesibili unogada wesikole ukhonjwe ngesibhamu esebude buduze nesango lesikole abelikhiyile esawelisa abafundi bamabanga aphansi ebese bephumile ngoba baphuma kuqala esikoleni.Elandisa Isolezwe, usihlalo wesigungu sabazali esikoleni, uNksz Zama Sokhulu, uthe unogada uvule isango esekhonjwe ngesibhamu, sekuthathwe neselula yakhe.Uthe izigebengu eziyisithupha zimqhube zaze zamngenisa egumbini elihlala othisha. Kulo bekunothisha oyedwa nabafundi abebefundisa amagama, eSpelling Bee. Lo thisha nalaba bafundi balaliswe phansi ngezibhamu, uthisha waphoqwa ukuthi akhiphe iselula yakhe. "Izigebengu bezilinda kube nomfundi othunywe kuleli gumbi bese zimkhomba ngesibhamu, zithi akayobiza uthisha wakhe, ucelwa ngothisha abasehhovisi. Uma efika akhonjwe ngesibhamu aphucwe iselula noma kuthiwe akayivule kubhekwe ama-App anawo ukuze kusetshenziswe wona ukukhipha imali. Omunye wothisha ukhiphe uR3 000 obukhona kwi-App, omunye kuthathwe ikhadi lasebhange nenombolo eyimfihlo. Abebengenawo ama-App bashayiwe, omunye wathathelwa ijakhethi,” kuchaza uNksz Sokhulu.Uqhube wathi kulamule umfundi okuthe uma ethunywa ukuthi ayobiza uthisha wakhe, waphuma wamemeza, ekhala. Kuphume abafundi ebebesemakilasini nothisha, izigebengu zabaleka.Izigebengu kuthiwa zithathe nokhiye wemoto yomunye uthisha kodwa zagcina zingakwazanga ukuhamba nayo. Izolo, uthe abafundi abafike esikoleni bangu-40 kwabangu-585 abafunda khona. "Izingane zethu zithukile, eyami ithe isiyesaba ukuya esikoleni ngoba izigebengu zingena nasezikoleni zikhombe othisha nezingane ngezibhamu. Othisha abanye bakhona kodwa nabo bayesaba. Umnyango ubungakasho ukuthi kumele kwenziwenjani. Ngokwethu besifisa ukuthi kufike abeluleka ngezengqondo bakhulume nabafundi nothisha, ukufunda kuze kuqale ngesonto elizayo,” kusho yenaUthe ekuseni kubakhona amaphoyisa kaMasipala weTheku awelisa abafundi, emini awabe esabuya, abafundi baweliswa ngunogada. UMphathiswa wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka, uthe ukhathazekile futhi udabukile ngalesi senzo, wathi ukuphepha nokuvikeleka kothisha nabafundi kubalulekile kakhulu. "Umnyango uzibophezele ngokuhlinzeka ngosizo oludingekayo kothisha nabafundi abahlukumezekile. Sizokwenza okusemandleni ukuqinisa ezokuphepha eMukelani Primary nakwezinye izikole esifundazweni ukuze sigweme izehlakalo ezinjengalesi. Sinxusa abangaba nolwazi ukuthi basondele ukuze kuboshwe izigilamkhuba,” kusho uHlomuka. Esitatimendeni umnyango uthe: "Sinabo onogada kwezinye izikole esifundazweni, kodwa lokho sekubonakele ukuthi akusona isixazululo ngoba kwezinye izikhathi bayahlaselwa baphinde babulawe yizigebengu,” Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa aKwaMashu avule icala lokubamba inkunzi kuhlonyiwe."Izigebengu eziyisithupha ebezihlomile kuthiwa zingene esikoleni ngoLwesibili, zaphuca othisha amaselula, imali nezimpahla zokugqoka,” kusho uCol Netshiunda.
OWESILISA waseNtshongweni, obhekene necala nokubulala indodana yakhe, kuvele ukuthi wayiklinya ngentambo yesikhindi ngoba ethi ulaya unina. Lokhu kuvezwe ngumphenyi wecala, uSergeant Vincent Zondi, obethula ubufakazi, eNkantolo yesiFunda yasePinetown.Bekuvele uMnuz Suyabonga Shezi (32) obhekene necala lokubulala indodana yakhe, uSifundo Sibisi (8), esigamekweni esenzeka ngoJanuwari 13, 2023.UShezi kuthiwa waya emqashweni owawuhlala indodana yakhe nonina wayo, wayicela ukuthi iye ezihlotsheni zakhe ngoba bayikhumbule.Kuvela ukuthi akayiyisanga ezihlotsheni kodwa wayithatha waya nayo ehlathini wayibulala.UZondi uveze ukuthi ingane yabulawa ngokuklinywa ngentambo yesikhindi eyayikade isifakile, yase imbozwa ngejakhethi emnyama okwavela ukuthi ngekayise.UShezi eseyibulele indodana yakhe, kuthiwa washayela unina ucingo emazisa ngokuthi useyibulele, wase emtshela nokuthi isidumbu uzositholaphi."Ngesikhathi siyithungatha ehlathini, uShezi wayedane eshaya ucingo eyalela unina kamufi ukuthi isidumbu uzosithola kuphi,’’ kuchaza umphenyi.Isidumbu satholwa yisihlobo sikaShezi esasikhona ngesikhathi kuthungathwa.Ngemuva kwalokho, uthi amaphoyisa aya KwaNdengezi lapho uShezi ayehlala khona."Asizange simfice kodwa waqala phansi washayela ucingo unina kamufi emtshela ukuthi angeke abuye uma kusakhona amaphoyisa egecekeni. Sangena emotweni senza sengathi siyahamba, nangempela weza uShezi. Yilapho esambamba khona,'' elandisa.Uveze ukuthi - esitatimendeni - uShezi wagonyuluka washo ukuthi uyibulele indodana ecikwa ukuthi unina useyajola.Umshushisi, uRowen Souls, uveze ukuthi banobufakazi bokuthi uShezi wagonyuluka kubantu abehlukene."Wagonyuluka ephoyiseni, kunina wengane, kugogo wakhe, kudadewabo kanina kamufi nasemndenini wakho,'' kusho umshushisi ebhekise kuShezi.Eziphendulela uShezi uthe: "Angizele lokho ongitshela khona. Ngizele ukuthi inkantolo ingitshele ukuthi iyaningikeza ibheyili noma cha.''Isinqumo sokuthi uyayithola yini ibheyili uShezi, imantshi ithe izosikhipha kuleli sonto.
UBEYISIBANI sabanye akhahlamezeka nabo owesilisa wasoThongathi ongumsubathi, owaqhubeka nokuyogijima iComrades Marathon waze wayiqeda yize ayelahlekelwe yikho konke ayenakho ngesishingishane.UMnuz Phumlani Anold Ntuli nabanye abayisishiyagalolunye ngoLwesibili, banikelelwe ngamasheke kaR8 000 umuntu ngamunye yinkampani ekhiqiza izinkwa, iBB Bakeries, ukuthi bavuse amakhaya abo.UNtuli waphikelela nokuyogijima lo mjaho okokuqala ngqa ngoJuni 8, emva kokudilikelwa yindlu yakhe ngoJuni 3.ABENKAMPANI ekhiqiza izinkwa iBB Bakeries nabahlomule ngamasheke okuthenga izimpahla zokwakha Isithombe: ZIMBILI VILAKAZIABENKAMPANI ekhiqiza izinkwa iBB Bakeries noMnuz Phumulani Anold Ntuli (ogqoke isigqoko esibomvu) bezonikela ngamasheke okuthenga izimpahla zokwakha Isithombe: ZIMBILI VILAKAZIUmnikelo bawuthole emva kokuthi omunye wabasebenzi baseBB Bakeries, owagijima noNtuli wathola ngesimo esamehlela ngaphambi komjaho.Ekhuluma neSolezwe, uNtuli uthe wayengazi ukuthi ukuqhubeka kwakhe nokuyogijima umjaho yize sekuphika isimo kuzozala ukuthi azitholele usizo nabanye."Okwangenza ngaqhubeka nokuyogijima ukuthi yize ngangilahlekelwe yikho konke enganginakho kodwa ngangisaphila. Angibonanga kufanele ukuthi ngivumele inkinga eyayingehlele inginqande,” kusho uNtuli.Uthe wayethi uma enyuka amagquma azibuze ukuthi ingabe uma esebuya, uzolalaphi ngoba indlu yayingekho."Ngangingazi ukuthi ukuqhubeka kwami nokugijima kuzoholela ekutheni babone ukuzimisela kwami, bese bengilethela lolu xhaso,” kusho uNtuli.Uthe usizo lukhulu kuye nabanye ngoba iningi liziphilisa ngamatoho, bebengeke babenawo amandla okuvusa izindlu zabo.Oyi-Regional Community Development Specialist eBB Bakeries, uMnuz Samukelo Nkosi, uthe okwenze basondela nosizo ukuthi izandla ziyagezana.Uthe inkampani imile ngenxa yokwesekwa umphakathi othenga umkhiqizo wabo ngakho kuba wumbono omuhle ukuthi uma nabo sebebhekene nenkinga, inkampani isondele kubo nosizo."Emva kokuthinteka komunye wabasebenzi bethu yisimo sikazakwabo agijima naye, wasibikela siyinkampani ngesimo, sibe sesisondela nosizo. Umthetho wenkampani uthi asikwazi ukutomula umuntu oyedwa sisize yena, sigcine sesithola nabanye abayisishiyagalolunye, ukuthi banikelelwe kanye naye umfo kaNtuli,” kusho uNkosi.Uthe udaba lokuzinikela kukaNtuli lubafikisele ngezinyembezi, becabanga ukuthi uqhubekile nokuphokophelela waqeda umjaho yize ehlelwe umshophi.
INKULUMO yeSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini iwashiye ekhuluma ngezwi elilodwa amaqembu abangayo esiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal.Amaqembu ameleleke esiShayamthetho ancome inkulumo yeSilo, athi ithinte amaphuzu asemqoka.INdlulamithi yamakhosi yethule inkulumo yokuvula isiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal izolo, lapho ikhulume khona ngobugebengu, inhlupheko, ezokuvakasha nokunye.UNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, ongusihlalo we-IFP esifundazweni, uMnuz Thami Ntuli uthe bazohlale bezihlonipha iziyalo zoNgangazwe lakhe."Bayede, kuyasithokozisa ukuthi ngaso sonke isikhathi uma kuvulwa isiShayamthetho iSilo sibeka eceleni esisuke sikwenza, size sizokhuluma nathi. ISilo siwuphawu lokuthula noxolo. Yingakho kusijabulisa ukuba iSilo sibe phakathi kwethu. Njengamalungu esiShayamthetho sizimisele ukulandela iziyalo zoNgangazwe.”UNtuli uthe nabo iyabakhathaza eyobugebengu obudlangile, okungelinye lamaphuzu iSilo esigxile kakhulu kuwo ngesikhathi sethula inkulumo."Sixoxile kakhulu ngale ndaba ngesikhathi kunomhlangano weKhabhinethi, iLekgotla. Sizosebenzisana namaphoyisa ukuqhamuka namasu okubhekana nale nkinga. Njengoba sizokuba nengqungquthela yokubhunga ngobugebengu, sizoxoxa ngokuvikelwa koNdabezitha namakhansela.”UMphathiswa wezokuThutha, ongusihlalo we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Siboniso Duma, uthe nakuba inkulumo yeSilo ibe mfishane, ikwazile ukuthinta zonke izihloko ezisemqoka."Kusijabulisile ukuthi iSilo sithinte konke okubalulekile. Manje kufanele abantu baKwaZulu-Natal babumbane ukuze kuzofezeka izifiso zeSilo.”UMphathiswa wezeZimali, ongumholi we-DA KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Francois Rodgers, uthe kubajabulisile ukuzwa iSilo sikhuluma ngezokuvakasha."Ngicabanga ukuthi sithe ukulala kancane lapha KwaZulu-Natal uma kuziwa kwezokuvakasha. Kufanele engabe sisebenzisa ukuba nomlando ocebile njengesifundazwe ukuheha abavakashi. Lena yinto engizoyigqugquzela emihlanganweni yeKhabhinethi ukuba siyenze.”Okhulumela i-MK esiShayamthetho, uMnuz Emacous Mbatha, uthe njengeqembu elihlonipha ubukhosi, bazosebenzisana neNdlulamithi ukuxazulula izinkinga ezibhekene nesifundazwe."Izinto ezibalulwe oNgangazwe lakhe zidinga ukuthi wonke amaqembu asebenze ndawonye. Kuyajabulisa ukuthi kulo hulumeni omusha uqhubeke umkhuba wokuthi iSilo sinikwe ithuba lokuthi sikhulume nathi. Njenge-MK siyabuhlonipha ubukhosi, yingakho lapha esiShayamthetho siholwa yinkosi (Phathisizwe) Chiliza.”Namhlanje uNtuli uzokwethula umhlahlandlela wesifundazwe, khona esiShayamthetho sesifundazwe.
LIZOQALA ukuqulwa ngoFebhuwari 10 wonyaka ozayo, icala lokweqa ejele kwesiboshwa, uThabo Bester.Lokhu kuvezwe yiJaji uCagney Musi, eNkantolo eNkulu yaseFree State.Bekuvele kulindeleke ukuthi uMusi amemezele ukuthi kuzoqala nini ukuqulwa kwecala likaBester nabanye, njengoba bonke abameli kanjalo noMbuso beveze ukuthi sebekulungele ukuqulwa kwalo.Ngesikhathi kuqhubeka ukuhlala kwenkantolo, ummeli kaBester uke wazama ukuveza ukuthi uBester kungenzeka angakulungeli ngokomqondo ukuqulwa kwecala ngenxa yendlela aphethwe ngayo ejele, iKgosi Mampuru.Ummeli udalule ukuthi unikwa ihora elilodwa kuphela lokuthi azivocavoce, nokho uMusi akakugqizanga qakala lokhu, wathi uma ummeli kaBester esewalungise kahle amaphepha esikhalo sekhasimende lakhe, ngeke ananaze ukudlulisela udaba lwakhe kwelinye ijaji ukuze lilulalele.Leli cala laba wundabuzekwayo ngoMeyi 2022, ngesikhathi kuvela ukuthi uBester owayedonsa isigwebo sakhe ngamacala okubulala nawokudlwengula, weqa ejele.Lezi zindaba zavela sekuphele unyaka eqa.Bayisishiyagalolunye ababoshwa ngalokhu, okukhona kubo nowayeyintombi yakhe, ababanjwa naye eTanzania uDkt Nandipha Magudumana.I-ANC nomhlangano wokubhunga ngokhetho nentuthukoIBIZE umhlangano ozodonsa izinsuku eziyisithupha i-ANC ukuzobhunga ngokubhacaza kwayo okhethweni obelungoMeyi nonyaka.IBIZE umhlangano ozodonsa izinsuku eziyisithupha i-ANC ukuzobhunga ngokubhacaza kwayo okhethweni obelungoMeyi nonyaka.Isitatimende sikaKhongolose siveze ukuthi umhlangano uqala namhlanje eBirchwood Hotel, eBoksburg.Kuqala umhlangano wesigungu esiphezulu se-ANC namhlanje kuze kube nguMgqibelo. Kusuka ngeSonto kuze kube nguLwesibili, kuzohlala umhlangano ohlanganisa bonke abaholi bakwezinye izifundazwe, kubalwa ongqongqoshe, abaphathiswa beminyango, ondunankulu, izimeya, amaphini ongqongqoshe kanjalo nabanye abaholi.Kulo mhlangano bazobe becaciselwa kabanzi ngezinhlelo ze-ANC okumele bazilandele ezisuselwa emqulwini wezokhetho. "Inhloso ngukuthi kufuqwe izinhlelo zokuqeda indlala, ukukhulisa umnotho, ukwakha amathuba emisebenzi, ukwehlisa izinga lokuphila eliphezulu kanjalo nokubhekana nezinye izingqinamba ezibhekene nomphakathi,” kusho isitatimende.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi i-ANC yehlelwa wukwesekwa yaze yadinga ukuthi ibambisane namanye amaqembu ngenxa yokwehlelwa wukwesekwa okhethweni.Kuhlukene imibono ngabase-Israel kuma-Olympic KUSHAYISANA imibono ngokuya kwabadlali base-Israel kuma-Olympic aseParis, njengoba leliya lizwe liqhubeka nokudedela amabhomu eGaza.IPhini likaNgqongqoshe wezeMidlalo, ubuCiko namaSiko, uNksz Peace Mabe noNobhala jikelele we-ANC uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, bathe i-Israel akufanele ivunyelwe ukuya kuma-Olympic njengoba isaqhubeka nokubulala abantu basePalestine, eGaza.Babalule ukuthi neRussia ayikwazi ukuya kuleya midlalo ngoba isolwa ngokuba nodlame.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi abadlali baseRussia kabavumelekile ukuya kuma-Olympic ngenxa yempi eqhubeka phakathi kwezwe labo ne-Ukraine kanjalo nezinsolo zokuthi abadlali babegqugquzelwa ukuba basebenzise izikhuthazi ezingavumelekile.ISouth African Zionist Federation (SAZF), ithe uMabe noMbalula kufanele bahlukane ne-Israel ngoba inelungelo lokuya kuma-Olympic njengawo wonke amazwe.Kolunye uhlangothi. i-Palestine Solidarity Alliance Youth League in South Africa, ithe i-Israel enobandlululo akufanele ibe semidlalweni yama-Olympic.Ikhale ngokuthi ukuba khona kwayo kugqugquzela ukucindezelwa kwabantu.
UBONGE imantshi wathi ihlenge impilo yakhe ngokuthi imncishe ibheyili owayeyisoka lakhe oboshelwe icala lokubulala indodana yabo eyayineminyaka eyisishiyagalombili.UNksz Nonhlanhla Sibisi ongunina kamufi, uSifundo Sibisi (8), uphawule kanje emuva kokuthi iMantshi L Gurie imnqabele ibheyili uMnuz Siyabonga Innocent Shezi (30).UShezi uthweswe icala lokubulala uSifundo ngokumshaya nokumklinya ngentambo yesikhindi ayesigqokile ngoJanuwari 13 nyakenye ethi uqhuqha unina."Ngijabulile noma kungekhona ukuthi icala seliphelile kodwa ukuthi impilo yamo iyisindisile inkantolo. Inkantolo ibonile ukuthi uyingozi uma ephumela ngaphandle uzosibulala,” kusho uNksz Sibisi emamatheka.Ube esethi unethemba lokuthi icala lizoqulwa liphele ngesikhathi esifushane ngoba bonke ubufakazi bukhona bese uShezi edilikelwa ijele alapheke emoyeni.UMbuso uthe uNonhlanhla ubesohlwini lwabantu abebezobulawa uShezi njengoba bese eqalile ngoSifundo.Abanye okuvele ukuthi amagama abo asohlwini lwabazoyiswa kwagoqanyawo, abangofakazi boMbuso, ngunina kaShezi, ugogo wakhe nodadewabo.Imantshi ithe uShezi akanayo indawo eqondile ahlala kuyona, uzolibalekela icala futhi uyingozi kofakazi ashaye inkantolo ngemfe iphindiwe wathi akabazi."Ubhekene necala elibucayi lokubulawa komuntu okuyingane yakho ngakho uzolibalekela uma udedelwa ngebheyili ngoba uyazi ukuthi lihamba nesigwebo sokuthi udilikelwe ijele uma likulahla. Akusona isizathu esinqala futhi esehlukile ukuthi ufuna ibheyili ukuze unakekele umama wakho futhi uqhubeke nebhizinisi lokudayisa amagwinya noswidi,” kusho imantshi.Icala libe selihlehliselwa u-Agasti 14 nokuyilapho inkantolo izobeka khona usuku eliyoqulwa ngalo.UShezi uyaliphika icala wathi izizathu uzozisho mhlazane seliqulwa okwamanje ufuna ibheyili aqhubeke nempilo.Akakhombisanga zimpawu zokudinwa noma zokudibikibala ngesikhathi imantshi ithi akabuyele ezitokisini inkululeko uyoyithola limthetha icala.
ISILO uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini sisebenzise inkulumo yaso yokuvula isiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal ukukhumbuza izinhlaka zikahulumeni ukuthi yiso esibusa lapha kwelikaMthaniya.ISilo sinxuse izinhlaka zikahulumeni ukuba zinikeze ubukhosi inhlonipho obuyifanele.Lokhu kwenzeke ngesikhathi iNdlulamithi ikhuluma emcimbini wokuvula isiShayamthetho eMgungundlovu izolo.ISilo sithe asiyona inkosi yesizwe esisodwa, sathi siphethe iKwaZulu-Natal yonke."Ngiyafisa ukucacisa okuthile nokumqoka. Ngokukhonjwa ngumunwe womlando ngiyazi ukuthi ngiyinkosana kaZulu. Lokhu angikungabazi futhi ngiyakuqonda ukuthi kusho ukuthini. Okunye engikwaziyo wukuthi ngokwemithetho yale ndlu, ngiyinkosi yesifundazwe. "Lokhu ngithi angikuveze ngoba sikhona isilingo sokuthi isihlalo lesi engiyinhloko yaso sibukwe njengento nje yemikhosi futhi yesizwe esisodwa. Ngiyanigqugquzela ukuba ubukhosi nibunike indawo yabo obuyifanele. Kanjalo nakubo ubukhosi ngithi abungazexwayi izinguquko okungenzeka ukuthi ziza nesikhathi esikuso.”IMbube ithe nakuba lilikhulu igxathu eselihanjwe wuhulumeni ekuthuthukiseni abantu kule minyaka engu-30 kuphethe uhulumeni wentando yabantu, kuningi okusafanele kwenziwe.Sikhale ngokuthi miningi imindeni ebhuqabhuqwa yindlala, sakhala nangobelelesi obudlangile KwaZulu-Natal."Ngeke sincome sithi konke kuhamba kahle uma kusekhona abantu abacabanga ukuthi ukuxazulula ukungaboni ngaso linye emaqenjini abo nasemiphakathini yabo kumele kwenziwe ngezibhamu. Njengoba ngimi lapha namuhla isibalo esikhulu samakhosi, izinduna nabantu bakababa sisenhlabathini ngenxa yezibhamu. Ngenxa yezibhamu imindeni eminingi ibhekene nobubha futhi isele nezintandane, eminye ilahlekelwe ngabantu abebeyondla.”IMbube ikhale ngokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane."Njengenhloko yobukhosi lokhu kuyangikhathaza futhi nani kufanele kunikhathaze. Abesifazane kuleli zwe nabo bayizakhamizi. Kumele bavikeleke, kumele bazizwe beyingxenye yezwe elinakekelayo nelivikelayo.”ISilo sincome imizamo yamaphoyisa aKwaZulu-Natal yokulwa nobugebengu, saphinde sashayela ihlombe izinhlelo zikaNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, zokuba nengqungquthela yokubhunga ngobugebengu.ISilo sinxuse zonke izinhlaka zomphakathi ukuba zibe yingxenye yengqungquthela ehlelwayo.IKwaZulu-Natal iphethwe ngokubambisana amaqembu ahlukene.ISilo sinxuse wonke amaqembu anezihlalo KwaZulu-Natal ukuba abambisane, sakhumbuza amalungu esiShayamthetho ukuthi awazimele wona, kodwa amele abantu."Njengoba sakhele lesi sifundazwe saKwaZulu-Natal singumndeni, singumndeni omibalabala. Ukuba mibalabala kwethu akulona iphutha, kunalokho kusinika ithuba lokwazana, ukufundisana nokwamukelana. Njengezakhamizi zaKwaZulu-Natal kasidlule ekubekezelaneni kepha samukelane, samukelane ekutheni sehlukile nje kepha singumndeni. Njengosesihlalweni nenkosi yenu ngimi ngomumo ukunilekelela kulolu hambo nezinye izinkambo ezihlose ukuthuthukisa abantu baKwaZulu.”ISILO uMisuzulu kaZwelithini uvule iSishayamthetho sesifundazwe izolo Isithombe: Gcina Ndwalane / Ihhovisi likaNdunankulu KwaZulu-Natal Umcimbi wayizolo ubungewona ubukhazikhazi njengokuvamile.Bekungokwesibili iSilo sivula isiShayamthetho kulo nyaka njengoba senza ngasekuqaleni konyaka.Namhlanje uNtuli uzokwethula umhlahlandlela kahulumeni wesifundazwe, khona esiShayamthetho.
INHLOKO yoMnyango weMfundo eyiSisekelo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Nkosinathi Ngcobo, isinxuse umphakathi ukuba ubambe iqhaza ulwe nenkinga yodlame ezikoleni nasemphakathini.Lokho kuza emva kwesigameko sangoMsombuluko ekuseni, lapho kudutshulwe kwafa uNksz Duduzile Khumalo, obefundisa uGrade R ePhikiswayo Primary, eNtuzuma, eThekwini.Isigameko senzeke emagcekeni esikoleni, lapho kugasele khona abalisa ababili abangaziwa, bazenza abazali bezingane ezifunda kulesi sikole, bavulela ngenhlamvu kuNksz Khumalo (46), kubuka izingane zesikole, waphelela khona lapho.UNgcobo uvakashele isikole izolo, lapho efike wadlulisa khona amazwi enduduzo kothisha, wase ephonsa inselelo yokuthi umphakathi kube khona okwenzayo ukulwa nodlame emphakathini, oselukapakela nasezikoleni."SiwuMnyango wezeMfundo sinazo izinhlelo zokuqinisekisa ukuphepha kwezikole, okuwukuqinisekisa ukuthi izikole zibiyeliwe, futhi sihlale sisebenzisana namaphoyisa ukulwa nobugebengu."Nokho asikwazi ukwenza konke ngokwethu, sidinga umphakathi usilekelele ngoba izikole zethu zisemphakathini, ngakho sicela wonke umuntu abambe iqhaza ukubhekana nezinkinga ezinje esibhekene nazo,”’ kusho yena.Eqhuba, uthe bayazi ukuthi kunabazibuza ukuthi kungani onogada abagada ezikoleni bengabaningi, futhi bengahlomi ngezikhali zokuzivikela ebunzimeni obufuze lesi sigameko."Inkinga edala lokho wukuthi asinawo umklamo wemali eyanele ukuqasha abantu abaningi, nokuthi asikwazi ukuvumela ukuthi onogada bezikole bahlome ngezikhali eziyingozi ngoba lokho kungabeka impilo yabafundi engcupheni, futhi kungaholela nasekutheni bangakhululeki emagcekeni ezikole,” usho kanje.Isolezwe lifika kulesi sikole, bekuyisikhathi sekhefu. Izingane bezizidlalela nje ebaleni phandle, ungaphika ukuthi kunesigameko esinjena esisanda kwenzeka emagcekeni esikole.Nokho sekuqale isithangami, ebesithanyelwe nawothisha bakulesi sikole, bebonakala ebusweni bengashongo lutho ukuthi baphatheke kabi ngokubehlele.Kuphethwe isithangami, kwaqhubeka nohlelo obese luvele luqalile, nobeluzothatha usuku lonke, nokweluleka abafundi nothisha, ukubasiza ukubhekana nokuvelile nabakubonile. Uthishanhloko wakulesi sikole, uMnuz Mthokozisi Mchunu, ubonge ozakwabo ngokuqina nokubhekana nalesi simo esinzima, wanxusa ukuthi baqhubeke nokuzikhandla basize izingane abazifundisayo zibe nekusasa eliqhakazile.
SIMUNCU isimo kumalungu omphakathi waseMfube Village ngaphandle kwaseMiddelburg eMpumalanga ngokushona abafundi engozini yebhasi nesitimela ngoLwesithathu ntambama.Imibiko evela endaweni yesigameko ikhomba abafundi abahlanu besikole iMoreig Primary School abashone kule ngozi yebhasi nesitimela kanti baningi abanye abalimele.Abezimo eziphuthumayo basendaweni yesehlo njengoba kusatakulwa abafundi abasavalelekile.
UBEHLALE ekhala, efuna ukubuyiselwa indodakazi (3) yakhe umfundi ka-matric otholwe ebulewe eSiqungeni, eMthwalume, ngeSonto.Isidumbu sikaMandisa Cele (21) obefunda eSinokubonga Junior Secondary sitholwe simbozwe ngengubo phezu kombede egumbini lakhe lokulala.Ikhanda lakhe kuthiwa belibokozela, aphinde abe nezibazi ebusweni nasemzimbeni.Kusolwa uyise wengane ngesigameko, okumanje kuthiwa akasabonwa nangokhalo. Ubabomncane kamufi, uMnuz Mzwandile Dlungelwa, uthe umsolwa ubemhlukumeza umufi, ehlala ngokumshaya."Bebevame ukuxabana, uMandisa efuna abakubo kamsolwa babuyise ingane yakhe, abamphuca yona ngenkani,” kusho uDlungelwa.Uthe uMandisa ubebabikela uma eshaywe umsolwa, bathi uma benikela khona, bamfice esekhale amaphepha. Udalule ukuthi esigamekweni esandulela lesi, umsolwa wabulala wonke amawindi endlu kaMandisa, ayishiyelwa wunina ongasekho. "Ngathi ngiyafika, ngathola esebalekile,” kusho uDlungelwa.Elandisa ngesigameko, uthe babizwe womakhelwane. "Sifike sekugcwele umphakathi, kukhona nomndeni kamsolwa. Sithole ukuthi yiwo umndeni kamsolwa nomakhelwane ababone kuqala ukuthi uMandisa ubulewe,” kusho uDlungelwa.Uthe bezwe kuthiwa umndeni kamsolwa ubone engabuyi ngoMgqibelo, wanikela kwamakhelwane wendawo yesigameko ngeSonto, uyocela ukuphelezelwa uyombheka.Kuthiwa bafike bathuma umakhelwane ukuthi akangene ngaphakathi, abheke, waphuma ethwele izandla ekhanda ethi usezithele phezu kwesidumbu."Sisola ukuthi kukhona abakwaziyo. Yini le ebese beyazi eyenze ukuthi bafune ukuphelezelwa uma beye endaweni yesigameko?” kubuza uDlungelwa.Uphinde wathi basola ukuthi umndeni kamsolwa uyazi ukuthi ukephi njengoba engabonwa nangokhalo nje."Ngisho sesifikile endaweni yesigameko siwumndeni, bavele bazimela esixukwini somphakathi, belokhu belalela ukuthi sikhuluma sithini,” usho kanje uDlungelwa othe lokhu kubadine kakhulu.Uveze ukuthi igazi likaMandisa beliqala endleleni yakwamsolwa, ligudle liye ethangini lamanzi eliseduze kwendlu, ngaphambi kokuba liyongena egumbini lokulala endlini.Uthe basola ukuthi umhlasele ngesikhali esithile endleleni, wawa, maqede wamhudula, ezama ukumgeza igazi ethangini, ngaphambi kokuqhubeka amhudulele endlini, la agcine eficwa khona.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, ukuqinisekisile ukuvulwa kwecala lokubulala emaphoyiseni aseHibberdene.Isolezwe like labika ngesigameko esifuze lesi ngo-Ephreli nonyaka, umfundi ka-matric eSiphapheme High, uZanele Khathi (18) owashaywa waklinywa yisoka KwaDumisa, eMzinto. Kule sigameko kwasolwa iskhwele kumsolwa.
KUPHAZAMISEKE ukuhamba kwezimoto, abantu bangakwazi ukufinyelela ezindaweni abasebenzela kuzo nasezikoleni, ngenxa yokuvalwa kwemigwaqo engenela edolobheni, ePort Shepsone, nasezindaweni ezisondelene nalo, okukholakala ukuthi kwenziwe ngosomatekisi abakhala ngokushaqwa kwezimoto zabo ngamaphoyisa afuna izimvume.Lesi siteleka singenele osukwini lwesibili izolo njengoba siqale ngoMsombuluko. Abebevale umgwaqo kuthiwa bebededela kuphela abama-ambulensi nabezimoto zezimo eziphuthumayo, kanti iningi labafundi, othisha, abasebenzi namalungu omphakathi basale dengwane.Iningi labantu abathinte Isolezwe abangathandanga ukudalulwa lithe lisondelene nabemboni yamatekisi, liveze ukuthi ukushuba kakhulu kwesimo izolo, kubhebhethikiswe ukungafiki koMphathiswa woMnyango wezokuThutha nokuHlaliswa KwaBantu uMnuz Siboniso Duma, obekulindeleke ukuthi ahlangane nosomatekisi enkundleni yezemidlalo eMarburg ngoMsombuluko, kodwa okuthiwa ugcine engafikanga."Kubukeka sengathi uDuma akayisukumelanga le nto isaqala njengoba isisiphazamisa sonke. NgoMsombuluko bekungcono ngoba izimoto ezincane bezingavinjwa bekungamatekisi namabhasi kuphela angahambi, kodwa namhlanje (izolo) kuvinjwa yonke into ngaphandle kwabama- ambulensi. Nami bekumele ngivuke ngiye emsebenzini, kodwa ngigcine sengizilalela ngoba akukho engizokwenza akuphumi lutho nje.”USihlalo wenhlangano yosomatekisi i-South African National Taxi Council esifundeni Ugu, uMnuz Lethu Maphumulo, uthe abakhala ngakho ukushaqwa kwezimoto zabo ngamaphoyisa kaShanela ngenxa yezimvume."Iphutha lingakubo, abasiniki izimvume zethu. Izimoto zethu ziboshiwe, sigcina sesingena ezikweletini ngoba siyazikhokhela. Kwesinye isikhathi zigcina sezidliwa lapho sizithenga khona, kungcole izithupha zethu ngoba kuthiwa siboshelwa izimvume. Sifuna umnyango udedele izimoto zethu ukuze sisebenzea,” usho kanje.Uxolisile kubagibeli abazithola sebengondingasithebeni, wathi abaqondile ukubahlukumeza kodwa bazama ukulwela amalungelo abo ukuze bamelane nempilo.Ngesikhathi sokushicilela, umnyango ukhiphe isitatimende sokuthi uzohlangana nobuholi beSantaco esifundeni Ugu, khona izolo ntambama.
BAHLAFUNA bejeqeza abantu baseCato Crest ngenxa yokwanda kobugebengu obuhambisana nezibhamu. Lokhu kuhlale obala ngoLwesibili ebusuku amaphoyisa etholana phezulu nabasolwa kweminye yemizi ekule ndawo.Okhulumela amaphoyisa, uRobert Netshiunda, uthe akulona iqiniso ukuthi amaphoyisa aqinisa kakhulu isandla kwabasolwa ngobugebengu njengoba kuyisehlo sesine lesi emasontweni amabili sokubulawa kwabantu okuthiwa bebefunelwa amacala abucayi.NgoLwesibili olwedlule, abasolwa abathathu abebefunelwa inqwaba yamacala okubulala okuhlanganisa noSergeant Yekani Siboniso Thabete, badutshulwe babulawa eCongo, eNanda. USergeant Thabete, obeyilungu leKwaMashu Tracking Team, wahlaselwa waphucwa izikhali wadutshulwa wabulawa ngesibhamu somsebenzi.NgoLwesine, umsolwa oyedwa okuthiwa ubeyingxenye yabagebenge i-ATM wadutshulwa wabulawa amaphoyisa abemjaha eMandlankala, eSikhaleni. Ekuseni ngovivi (ngoLwesihlanu olwedlule), abanye abasolwa abathathu basala enkundleni bedubulana namaphoyisa balimala kabi emzini oKwaDlangezwa eMpangeni. Kusolwa ukuthi nabo babeyingxenye yesigameko sokuqhunyiswa kwe-ATM okwenzeke ngoLwesine.Kube esifanayo eNanda abasolwa ababili bezithela olakeni lwamaphoyisa. Laba ababili abebengamalungu eqembu elidume kabi iWest Gang bebevaleleke ekhoneni emzini ose-Angola e-Mawoti eNanda bedudulana namaphoyisa ngenhlamvu. Kuthiwa bebefunelwa amacala okungenani amane okubulala.Esigamekweni sangoLwesibili esenzeke emgwaqweni uStandard eCato Crest, amaphoyisa agadle kubasolwa abahlanu. Ngokwesitatimende samaphoyisa, laba bebefunelwa uxhaxha lwamacala okubulala, ukuduna izimoto kanjalo nokugebenga amabhizinisi.Ngesikhathi kuhlolwa indawo, amaphoyisa athole izibhamu ama-AK47, ama-handgun amathathu nezidakamizwa.UMnuz Tshepo Shezi utshele abeNewzroom Afrika ukuthi bazwile kuduma izulu lezandla ebusuku bathuka kakhulu ngoba nabo banezingane futhi bebengazi ukuthi njengoba kudutshulwa kuhlaselwa bani futhi isizathu sithini."Sivuke ekuseni sathi asizozibonela ukuthi kwenzenjani nokuthi ngobani abebehlaselwa yingakho size lapha ngoba sinabantwana sinezihlobo. Ubugebengu obukhona lapha buningi kakhulu futhi ngeke sakwazi ukulwa nabo sibuqede bonke ngoba kokunye asazi busukaphi,” kusho yena.

KUHLALE kuthiwa omama yibona abazifelayo ngetiye kuze kuthiwe uma bengalitholanga bakhala ngekhanda. Ucwaningo lwakamuva olwenziwe ngabakwaRooibos luveza ukuthi empeleni amadoda ayazifela ngetiye.Njengoba siphila esikhathini esimatasatasa kuthiwa kunamadoda aqala usuku lwawo ngetiye ukuze ehlise ukhwantalala. UDkt Gerald Maarman, ongusosayensi obehola ucwaningo olwaziwa ngeMen’s Drinking Habits Survey, uthe lolu cwaningo luveza ukuthi u-69% wamadoda uphuza amanzi uma nokhwantalala, u-16% uphuza ikhofi kanti u-11% uphuza itiye iRooibos. Luqhuba luthi uma eseqede ukusebenza u-32% wawo uphuza iRooibos, u-19% ubhiya, u-12% ikhofi, u-11% uphuza ugologo kanti u-10% uphuza iwayini.Amadoda kulolu cwaningo abike ukuthi iRooibos awayiphuzeli ubumnandi kodwa asuke enzela ukuthi imizimba yawo ikwazi ukubhekana nemisebenzi eyenzayo ngosuku olulandelayo ngoba inezithako ezilwa nezifo egazini.UDkt Maarman uthe yize amadoda amaningi ethi aphuza iRooibos, u-67% walawo azivocavocayo aphuza amanzi ukuze umzimba wawo ube namanzi enele, iRooibos iyisiphuzo sesibili asikhethayo. Ezindaweni zomphakathi, uthe iRooibos nobhiya yizona ziphuzo ezihamba phambili njengoba u-47% wadoda uphuza zona, zilandelwe yitiye elimnyama, ama-cooler namacider."I-Rooibos ihamba phambili esigabeni seziphuzo ezishisayo. Abesilisa abangaphezu kuka-42% baphuza okungenani inkomishi eyodwa ye-Rooibos nsuku zonke, u-22% wawo uyiphuza kabili noma kathathu ngesonto bese kuthi u-17% uyiphuze njalo ngemva kwesonto,"UMaarman uthe lolu cwaningo lugunyazwe yiSouth African Rooibos Council (SARC) ukuze ibone ukuthi ngabe izinkolelo zabantu ngokuphuzwa kwetiye ziyizo yini.

YIZE sesingcono kakhulu isimo sokuphehlwa kukagesi eNingizimu Afrika njengoba sekuphele izinsuku eziwu-124 ugesi unganqamuki kodwa ezinye izindawo zizocinyelwa ugesi ukuze kuvikelwe ingqalasizinda.Usho kanje uNgqongqoshe wezikaGesi, uDkt Kgosientsho Ramokgopa, izolo, ngesikhathi echaza ngesimo sikagesi ezweni.URamokgopa uthe ukunganqamuki umlibe kukagesi kwenziwa wuMnuz Bheki Nxumalo nethimba lakhe labaphathi beziteshi, eliqinisekisa ukuthi imishini isebenza kahle."Isimo sokunganqamuki kukagesi isikhathi eside kanjena sagcina ukusibona eminyakeni eyisithupha edlule, kwakuwuJulayi ka-2018. Izinhlelo zokushintsha isimo zihamba kahle kakhulu kodwa zisekhona izingqinamba,” kusho uRamokgopa.Uveze ukuthi bayonga nasezindlekweni zikadizili ngoba kusasebenze okaR3 billion kulo nyaka ekubeni ngonyaka odlule kwase kusebenze okaR9 billion ngesikhathi esifanayo.Uthe lokhu kuzosiza ekwehliseni izindleko zikagesi ngoba indlela onyuka ngayo ilawulwa nayizindleko zokuwuphehla.Ubuye wachaza ukuthi yize uhlelo lokucima ugesi lumile kodwa kunezindawo ezicishelwayo amahora ambalwa ukuze kuvikelwe ingqalasizinda."Uhlelo lwe-load reduction okuwukucinywa kukagesi ukuze kuphole imishini ewusabalalisayo, luyaqhubeka. Nakulokhu iSilo sivula isiShayamthetho namhlanje, bese kusasa uNdunankulu, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, athule umkhombandlela wezinto uhulumeni wesifundazwe ozogxila kuzona kule minyaka emihlanu ezayo, ngaphansi kukahulumeni wokubambisana kwamaqembu ahlukene.Okhulumela isiShayamthetho, uNksz Nomusa Phungula, uthe njalo uma kuwunyaka okubanjwe ngawo ukhetho lukazwelonke nolwezifundazwe, isiShayamthetho sivulwa kabili.Uthe umcimbi wokuvulwa kwesiShayamthetho okwesibili, ubanjelwa ezindlini zaso eMgungundlovu.Usho lokhu nje, ngoFebhuwari nonyaka, iMbube yathula inkulumo yokuvulwa kwesiShayamthetho. Kuzoba nesidlo emva kokuvulwa kwesiShayamthetho,” kusho uNksz Phungula.Kuke kwakhalwa ngokuthi kungcono umcimbi wokuvulwa kwesiShayamthetho uhlanganiswe nowokuthulwa kwenkulumo kandunankulu ukuze kongiwe imali.Kulo nyaka okukhalise kakhulu ngokuthi iMbube yathula inkulumo engazange ithathe ngisho ihora, kwabe sekuhlakazekwa sekuyodliwa.Ngakusasa kwaphinde kwaba nomcimbi wenkulumo kandunankulu, nakhona kwaphinde kwayodliwa emva kwayo.Ababekhala babethi le mali ingasetshenziselwa ukuthuthukisa umphakathi wesifundazwe.NgoLwesine kuzoba nenkulumo mpikiswano esiShayamthetho ngenkulumo kaNtuli.
UNOBHALA Jikelele weSouth African Federation of Trade Unions (Saftu), uMnuz Zwelinzima Vavi, uthe abaholi bezinyunyana abayeke ukuba wohlohlesabo kodwa kumele balwele amalungelo abasebenzi.UVavi ubekhuluma engqungqutheleni ye-General Industries Workers Union of South Africa (Giwusa), ebise-Germiston, eGauteng, ngempelasonto."Izinyunyana ziphelelwe ngamandla ngenxa yethu baholi bazo. Sidlala ipolitiki yesisu, sivune abantu esihlomula kubo yize bengabenzeli lutho abasebenzi. Sekuyisikhathi sokuthi sakhe kabusha izinyunyana, siyeke nokuqembukelana ngoba uthola ukuthi enyunyaneni eyodwa sekunezinhlangothi ezimbili. Omunye udonsa abhekise le, nomunye aye le. Ayibasebenzeli leyo nto abasebenzi,” kusho uVavi.Uthe kuyimanje kuneqeqebana eselifuna ukuqala izinyunyana ezintsha emuva kokuhluleka ukusiza abasebenzi ezinselelweni ababhekene nazo."Akufanele sincenge abaholi abangafuni ukusebenzela abasebenzi. Izinyunyana ngezabasebenzi, kufanele zibalekelele ukuba nempilo engcono. Njengoba anda amaqembu epolitiki nezinyunyana ziyanda kwazise kunabaholi asebefuna ukuhlohla izisu zabo. Bafuna ukuvula izinyunyana ezidlelana namaqembu athile ngoba banezinhloso zabo, hhayi ukuthi bafuna ukuqhuba umzabalazo wabasebenzi,” kuchaza uVavi.Uthe inkulumo yakhe akufanele isetshenziswe ngabaholi abafuna ukuqhoqhobala izikhundla ezinyunyaneni kodwa bengabasebenzeli abasebenzi."Kuyimanje izinga lempilo liyabiza, imalimboleko iphezulu, amaholo awanyuki ngendlela efanele. Izinyunyana kufanele ukuthi zilwe nale nkinga. Akufanele zilume ziphephetha ngoba zincenge izikhundla kuhulumeni, kufanele zigxeke futhi zize nesisombululo,” kusho yena.Uthe njengoba sekunohulumeni wokubambisana kwamaqembu, izinyunyana kufanele zilwe kakhulu kunakuqala ngoba kulo hulumeni kugcwele ongxiwa abacindezela abasebenzi.

Yingakho sithi awusayinwe ngoba akuwona umthetho we-ANC, noma we-DA kodwa owabantu bakuleli. Nangesikhathi umengameli kumele asayine umthetho wokuthi abafundi basezikoleni zabaphila nokukhubazeka bathole izinsiza zokubasiza uma befunda, kwathatha isikhathi eside ukusayina umthetho owawuzokwenza lokhu kusheshe kwenzeke. Sifuna into ethinta imfundo ayisukumele ngokushesha.” Uthe abasabi ukumasha ukuze bamtshengise ukuthi kumele abeke imfundo phambili.

UFUNA ubulungiswa umlisa waseNtabamhlophe, e-Estcourt, uMnuz Sizwe Vilakazi, emuva kokukhonjwa indlela emsebenzini abewenza ngoba exoxe "imikhuba" nentombazane yomdabu waseNdiya eneminyaka ewu-14.UVilakazi (35) uthe uqale ngokumiswa ngaphambi kokuxoshwa enkampanini ezinze ePinetown kodwa ediliva amanzi emiphakathini yaseVerulam nasePhoenix, iCrosmoor (XM Group). Eluchaza ukusuka nokuhlala udaba uVilakazi, uthe wayejutshwe yinkampani ukuba ayohambisa amanzi emphakathini waseVerulam, eThekwini ngoJulayi 17.Uthe wathi esalinde ukuba umphakathi uze namabhakede uzokhongozela amanzi, kwaqhamuka intombazane engumNdiya yamnikeza incwadi efundeka kanje: "Igama lami nguKa futhi ngikukhonzile kakhulu. Uthe wagcina elubambile kanti ushayelwa yile ntokazi ngocingo lukayise nolukagogo wayo.
