Le ntombazane ebingelela kuqala kuVilakazi ngokuthi "Hi Baby" bese yena ephendula ngokuthi "Hi Babe, how are you love..." Le ntombazane ibuye imtshele ukuthi imkhumbule, bese uVilakazi aphendule ngokuthi ayenze imizamo yokuba babonane bese yona imbuza ukuthi ufuna ukulala nayo yini, athi yena ufuna bazipholele nje. UVilakazi uthe ngoLwesine wabe esethola ucingo oluthi akaphuthume ehhovisi emuva kokuba ilungu le-ward committee lazise inkampani ukuba engabe esajutshwa eVerulam ngoba ufuna ukulala nengane encane.Uthe okwalandela lapho kwaba wukumiswa kwakhe ngoba kuthiwa ubexoxa imikhuba nentombazane eneminyaka ewu-14.Isolezwe Ngempelasonto lizibonile lezi zincwadi, eyokummisa neyokumxosha.Isikhulu seCrossmoor Transport (XM Group), uPauline Naidoo, uvumile ukuthi lesi sehlakalo senzekile."Okokuqala, ubudlelwano umshayeli akhuluma ngabo obengane eneminyaka ewu-14, umntwana ... ngeke sisanaba kakhulu. Izingxoxo ezakhe nomntwana," kuphetha uNaidoo.UVilakazi uthe ubengazi ukuthi intombazane ineminyaka engu-14 ngoba inethambo futhi yena akayishelanga kodwa iyona eyamshela. Uthe akaneme ngokuxoshwa kwakhe ngoba abenzanga lutho nale ntombazane ngoba bagcina ngokuxoxa futhi ngeke ayikhomba. Uthe kungcono ukuba uvulelwe icala ngoba yena uzibona emsulwa.Unxuse nanoma wubani ongamsiza kulolu daba ngoba usawudinga umsebenzi wakhe.SIDE BARUNGOTI wezithinta abasebenzi ozimle, uMnuz Nzulu Dlamini, weluleke uVilakazi ngokuthi udaba lwakhe aludlulisele enkantolo yezabasebenzi. Uthe ukuba khona kwemiyalezo nokuthi akuzange kuvele zisuka ukuthi intombazane akhulume nayo ezothando yingakanani, kungaluqinisa udaba lwakhe.Uxwayise abesilisa nokho ukuthi uma besemsebenzini, ikakhulukazi abahamba ngezimoto ezibhalwe amagama ezinkampani, kubalulekile ukuthi baziphathe kahle. Uma kuyiwa ngasezintweni ezithinta uthando, uthe kubalulekile nokuthi bayibhekisise indaba yeminyaka noma ubudala babesifazane abakhuluma nabo ezothando. " Ngiyacabanga nje ukuthi ukube le ndaba kaVilakazi nale ntombazanyana iqhubekile, ubengaze azihlanganise nayo ngokocansi engayazi iminyaka yayo. Lokho bekuyomenza umdlwenguli obengabhadla ejele iminyaka ngeminyaka,” echaza. Uthe ucansi nentombazane eneminyaka engaphansi kuka-16, yicala elibovu eNingizimu Afrika.Uthe noma engeke akusho kugcwale umlomo ukuthi inkampani iphambukile ngokwesinqumo sokumxosha, kodwa uma indaba isiqhamuka ezikhulwini zenkampani isithi: ' umshayeli wenu ubekhuluma amanyala nengane eneminyaka ewu-14’, kulula ukugcoba ngodaka leyo nkampani uthi inabashayeli abakhohlakele abashela izingane ezincane. Lokho uthe kungafinyelela esinqumeni sokuthi ngempela umsebenzi ufake inkampani ehlazweni.
KUBUYISE ithemba ukusayinwa komthetho ngokuguquguquka kwesimo sezulu, i-Climate Change Bill, esayinwe nguMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa.Ngalo mthetho uhulumeni uhlose ukuzibophezela ekuqhamukeni namaqhinga azonciphisa umonakalo odalwa isimo sezulu esingesihle, ngenxa yokuguquguquka kwesimo sezulu.Phakathi kokunye okulindeleke kuhulumeni ukuthi aqinisekise ukuthi elakuleli lenza okulindeleke kulo, kwinhlanganisela yamazwe azibophezele ekuqhamukeni namasu azolwisana nalesi sihlava. Echaza kafushane okhulumela ihhovisi likaRamaphosa, uMnuz Vincent Magwenya, uthe phakathi kokuhloswe ngalo mthetho, ngukuthi elakuleli liqinisekise ukuthi muncane umoya eliwungcolisayo."Ngokuqhubeka kwesikhathi kufanele elakuleli linciphise inani lama-greenhouse gases eliwakhiqizayo, afinyelele esikalweni esivumelekile ngale kokuthi kulahleke amathuba emisebenzi. Kumele kwakhiwe amanye amathuba omsebenzi azobe eqhakambisa ukubaluleka kokusetshenziswa kwezinye izinto ezingawungcolisi umoya,” kusho uMagwenya.Lo mthetho uhlose ukuthi uqinise amatomu okusebenzisana phakathi kwenzinhlaka ezehlukene nokubekwa kwemigomo ecacile elakuleli likwazi ukuhlangabezana nezivumelwano, zeNationally Determined Contribution (NDC) engaphansi kwesivumelwano saseParis.OTHONGATHI kwasala umonakalo onje, kuhlasele isishingishane Isithombe: SIGCINWE Lesi sivumelwano sasayinwa amazwe angu-196 engqungqutheleni i-UN Climate Change Conference (COP21), eyayiseParis ngo-2015.Amazwe azibophezela ukuthi azoqhamuka nezindlela ezintsha zokunciphisa ukukhiqiza umoya ongcolile, aqhamuke nezindlela ezintsha ezizokhuthaza umoya ohlanzekile.Kucacele noma ngubani ukuthi iyadingeka imizamo enjengale kulandela iziwombe zomonakalo odalwa yisimo sezulu esingesihle esilokhu sibonakala siziphinda minyaka yonke.Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele kushintshe ukwenza kubantu, izimboni zemikhiqizo kanjalo nezinhlaka ezehlukene zikahulumeni.IZIKHUKHULA ezahlasela idolobha eMnambithi kwangahambeka, amanzi egcwele yonke indawo Isithombe: SIGCINIWEUma ubuka iziwombe zesimo sezulu esingesihle ezilokhu zihlasela isifundazwe iKwaZulu-Natal kukhomba ngokusobala ukuthi izinto ziya ngokuya ziba zimbi.Ngo-Ephreli 2022 lesi sifundazwe sahlaselwa yizikhukhula ezadlula nemiphefumulo yabantu abalinganiselwa ku-450. ITheku lashayeka kakhulu.Balinganiselwa ku-48 abagcina bengatholwanga.Ezibalweni ezashicilelwa uhulumeni ezingeni likazwelonke, abalelwa ku-4 000 amakhaya acekeleka phansi, kwathi angaphezu kuka-8 000 akhahlamezeka kancane. Lokhu kwashiya abantu abalinganiselwa ku-40 000 bengenazo izindawo zokufihla ikhanda.Zingaphezu kuka-600 izikole ezacekeleka phansi, okwaholela ekutheni abafundi abangaphezu kuka-270 000 bathikamezeke.Izikhungo zezempilo ezathinteka zibalelwa ku-66.NgoDisemba 2023, zaphinda zagasela futhi izikhukhula, kwathinteka uMnambithi noMgungundlovu. Ngokwezibalo ezashicilelwa uMnyango wokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu, kuleso siwombe kwafa abantu abangu-40.Le mvula yabuye yaholela ekutheni kulimale abantu abangu-74.Kwakhahlamezeka amakhaya angu-800, kuwona kwakukhona angu-247 okwaphela nya ngawo, kwasala abantu abangu-47 bengenandawo yokuhlala, kwathinteka abalinganiselwa ku-4 000.Ngasekuqaleni kukaJuni nonyaka, kufe abayishumi kuhlasela isishingishane oThongathi. Isishingishane sashiya inqwaba ingenamakhaya. Ngokusho kowayeyiMeya yeTheku uMnuz Mxolisi Kaunda, umonakalo owadalwa yisishingishane ulingangiselwa kuR481.7 million.Kuzo zonke lezi ziwombe, nengqalasizinda efana nemigwaqo, amabhuloho akusali , nakho kucekeleka phansi.Emasontweni edlule, umlilo wequbula eShowe naseMgungundlovu udlule nabantu abangu-15.EMgungundlovu, bayisikhombisa abacisha umlilo abafe bezama ukubhula umlilo eBoston. Kule sigameko, kwasha amadlelo angama-hektha angaphezu kuka-2 000, kwasha imfuyo engu-48.Ngaphambi kwalokho, lo mnyango wabika ngokufa kwabayisikhombisa kulandela ukuqubuka komlilo wequbula ezindaweni ezehlukene okukhona kuzo iKing Cetshwayo, Ilembe, Zululand noThukela.Abalimi balahlekelwa yimfuyo engu-1 600, isha emlilweni, kwathi ama-hektha angu-14 000 ayenamadlelo angqongqa.Ucwaningo olwenziwa yizazi zesimo sezulu, lukhomba ukuthi ukuguquguquka kwesimo sezulu kudalwa yizenzo zabantu ngokushisa kwabo kuze kweqe izinto ezifana namalahle, uwoyela negesi. Ukushiswa kwalezi zinto kuholela ekutheni kwakheke ukushisa okungabekezeleleki emkhathini bese kuba nezimo zezulu ezingezinhle.OnguSolwazi kwezokuguquguquka kwesimo sezulu eLondon School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine, ophinde ahlonishwe ngokuba wuSolwazi eNyuvesi yaKwaZulu-Natal, uTafadzwa Mabhaudhi, uthe elakuleli seliphenduke inkundla yesimo sezulu esingesihle ngenxa yokuthi alizilungiseleli.Uthe okwenza kushaye kuzwele ukuthi izinga lobubha nokungalingani kwabantu liphezulu kakhulu."Ngokubambisana phakathi kwezinhlaka zonke zikahulumeni, umphakathi, izincithabuchopho, abemikhakha ezimele, sihlalelwe yijoka lokwenza okuthile ukuzama ukunciphisa umthelela odalwa isimo sezulu esingesihle,” kusho uMabhaudhi.Uthe okungasiza ukuthi izwe liqale ukuqinisa ekusebenziseni amandla avuselelekayo (renewable energy) liphinde litshale izihlahla eziningi."Umphakathi kufanele ufundiswe ngobungozi besimo sezulu esingesihle ukuze uqonde ubungozi baso. Lokhu kuzolekelela nasekuzilungiseleleni, ikakhulu kulabo abahlala ezindaweni ezakhele imifula,” kusho uMabhaudhi.Uthe kufanele uhulumeni ashintshe ukwenza, esikhundleni sokuthi aqhamuke esephendula emonakalweni odalwe yisimo sezulu esingesihle."Ngibala ingqalasizinda ekwaziyo ukumelana nesimo sesulu esingesihle,” kunezela yena.Wenze isibonelo ngohlelo lokugeleza kwamanzi emigwaqweni. Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi imibiko yangemuva kwezikhukhula zika-Ephreli 2022, yaveza ukuthi enye yezinto ezenza ukuthi iTheku kube yilo elishayeka kakhulu, ukungasebenzi kohlelo lokuhambisa amanzi emigwaqweni.UMasipala weTheku wathunyelwa imibuzo mayelana nokuthi usuhambe ibanga elingakanani ukulungisa le nkinga. Esikhundleni sokuphendula, wacela ukuthunyelwa uhlu lwemigwaqo enale nkinga.

KUKHALWA ngomengameli we-ABC, uMnuz Philani "PG” Mavundla ophinde abe yikhansela kuMasipala waseMvoti okuthiwa unqwahe nemoto yeMeya yalo masipala, uMnuz Gabriel Malembe we-IFP.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi uMavundla ubenikwe le moto ngesikhathi eyiMeya kulo masipala.IMEYA kaMasipala waseMvoti, uMnuz Gabriel Malembe we-IFP okhala ngoMavundla uthi unqwahe nemoto yalo masipala Isithombe: SIGCINIWEUmthombo waleli phephandaba uveze ukuthi uMavundla usabisa nemeya yaseMvoti uyitshela ukuthi ngeke ayinike imoto futhi yena uyinsizwa ngeke imenze lutho.Kuthintwa imeya yaseMvoti, ithe impela kuyiqiniso ukuthi uMavundla unqaba nemoto kamasipala.IMOTO yaseMvoti okuthiwa ihambe noMnuz Philani Mavundla nokuthiwa akafuni ukuyibuyisa ukuze isetshenziswe yimeya ye-IFP esisesikhundleni sokuba yimeya kulo masipala uMnuz Gabriel Malembe Isithombe: SITHUNYELWE"Ngicela ukucacisa lokhu. UMavundla wakhishwa esikhundleni ngoMeyi 21 kulo nyaka akaseyona imeya kodwa usele nesikhundla sokuba yikhansela. NgoJulayi 1 uthole incwadi yasenkantolo esho ukuthi isikhundla sakhe sokuba yimeya siphele ngoMeyi 21. Njengoba incwadi ibiqinisekisa ukuthi akaseyona imeya kumele abuyisele yonke impahla kamasipala abenikwe yona njengemeya. Manje unqwahe nemoto yaseMvoti eyiBMW X5 ebhaliswe ngokuthi Mvoti 1. Kunalokho uphambanisa izinto uthi uma ebuyisa imoto ngeke ayibuyise zingakapheli izinsuku ezingu-30. Angiqondi ukuthi ukhuluma ngaziphi izinsuku ezingu-30 ngoba yena waphuma esikhundleni ngoMeyi 21. Uma ekhuluma ngezinsuku ezingu-30 zaphela ngoJuni,” kusho uMalembe.UMalembe uthe usaxoxisana namaphoyisa ukuthi kube yiwona angenelelayo ukuxazulula lolu daba ngoba sekucacile ukuthi uMavundla akafuni ukubuyisa imoto."Uma uzokhumbula mina ngike ngaba yiMeya yaseMvoti ngaphinde ngehliswa esikhundleni emva kwesikhashana ngifungisiwe. Akuphelanga ngisho isonto uMavundla akanginikanga thuba efuna la izimoto zomkhandlu. Angizange ngiyikhulume indaba yezinsuku ezingu-30 ngazibuyisa manje yena usebamba uyayeka uma sekumele abuyise imoto yomkhandlu,” kuqhuba uMalembe.Kuthintwa uMavundla ucingo lwakhe belukhala lungabanjwa nemiyalezo abethunyelelwa yona ifkile kuyena kodwa wangayiphendula. Nangemuva kwemiyalezo uphinde wazanywa efonelwa kodwa lutho engalubambi ucingo lwakhe.KuMasipala waseMvoti kuthiwa uMavundla uhlala emihlanganweni kamasipala njengekhansela lakhona futhi uthatha izinqumo ngokubambisana namanye amakhansela. Kuleyo mihlangano kuthiwa kusuke kuhleli uMalembe njengemeya kamasipala.
OBEGCOTSHELWA kwesokuba nguMengameli omusha weZulu Congregational Church (ZCC), uMfu Sihle Zuma ufuna ukuthi ibandla lilwe nenkinga yezidakamizwa ekhungethe intsha.Umsebenzi wokugcotshwa kukaMfu Zuma bewenganyelwe nguMfu George Mnisi wesikole sokufundela ubufundisi, i-Union Bible Institute (UBI).Le ndumezulu yenkonzo ebihanjelwe ngamalungu aleli bandla ebevela ezingxenyeni ezehlukene zeKwaZulu Natal ibisesakhiweni sePresbyterian Church of Southern Africa esiseMpendle.UZuma enkulumeni yakhe uqhakambise kakhulu ukubaluleka kokuba leli bandla liklame indima enkulu ekuthuthukisweni kwentsha yalo.Uthe ukholwa ukuthi ibandla likaNkulunkulu linendima enkulu okumele liyiklame uma kukhulunywa ngentsha eacwile ezidakamizweni."Ngifuna ukuthi kube khona esikwenzayo ngenhloso yokuphucula impilo yentsha. Kodwa konke kulele ekutheni sisebenza ngokubambisana kangakanani,'' usho kanje.Uthe ingwadla yentsha ecwile ezidakamizweni akumele ibandla liyibukele kude kodwa kumele libhukule ukuze lithole isisombululo sayo.Uthe ebuholini bakhe ufuna ukubona leli bandla linentsha eaphokophelele impilo engcono futhi engeke nangephutha igcine isiphenduka imilutha yezidakamizwa.Ngale kwezidakamizwa uthe ibandla kumele kube khona elikwenzayo ukugwema ukuthi intsha ingangeni ebugebengwini"Ngiyilolu hlobo lomholi olukholelwa kakhulu entsheni. Yingakho nje ngifuna sibabeke phambili siphinde sibalekelele ngayo yonke indlela esingenza ngayo,'' usho kanjena.
LIFUNA ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantwana balo bakasontosikole bakhuliswa ngendlela efanele ibandla, uBuhle Benkanyezi Catholic Church in Zion.Lokhu kugcizelelwe kakhulu oyiNhloko yaleli bandla, uMbhishobhi Mandlenkosi Mchunu.Ubekhuluma enkonzweni ankulu kaJulayi yaleli bandla. Inkonzo ibiseSikhaleni.Uthe kumqoka ukuthi abantwana bebandla bakhuliswe kahle ngoba bayikusasa lebandla."Ngiyakholelwa kakhulu ekutheni ukuze ibandla lethu libe nekusasa eliqhakazile kumele ukuthi nakanjani likhulise kahle usontoskole walo,'' usho kanje.Uthe uma bekhuliswa ngendlela efanele lokho kuyohamba ibanga elide kakhulu bakwazi nokuhlukanisa okubi nokuhle."Kumele kube yinto esiyibeka phambili ngaso sonke isikhathi indaba yokukhuliswa kahle kukasontosikole wethu. Lokhu kulula ukuba kwenzeke uma sonke njengebandla sizimisele ngokuthi sikwenze ngokubambisana,'' usho kanje.Ukhulume nangokubaluleka kokuba abefundisi bahambe bayothekela ulwazi ezikoleni ezithuthukisa abefundisi.Uthe ukholwa ukuthi esikhathini samanje kudingeka uhlobo lwabefundisi olukwaziyo ukuzithuthukisa uma kukhulunywa ngezemfundo.Ugcizelele ukuthi ivangeli lezemfundo akumele liphelele kubefundisi kuphela, kodwa nasentsheni yebandla."Sifuna ukuthi intsha ybethu iaqhubeke nemfundo ize ifinyelele ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme. Lokho kuyokwenza ukuthi nabo bagcine benekusasa eliqhakazile,'' usho kanje.Leli bandla linamagatsha ehlukene ezingxenyeni ezehlukene zeKwaZulu Natal. Sekuphele iminyaka engu- 19 laba khona njengoba lasungulwa ngo-2005.Liphinde libe nezinhlelo ezehlukene elisuke lihlose ngazo ukuthuthukisa umphakathi elikuwona ngezindlela ezehlukene.
UBENOKHWANTALALA, ehlale ebalisa ngoyise okukholakala ukuthi wathunjwa wangaphinde wabuya ekhaya, umfundi waseKuhlekonke eMaswazini, ngaphansi kukaMasipala Umngeni, isidumbu sakhe esitholwe ngabanye abafundi silenga elawini lakhe.UMlondi Hlengwa (18) okuthiwa ubedume ngelikaMbududu, efunda uGrade 11 kulesi sikole, isidumbu sakhe sitholwe abanye abafundi abangabangani bakhe sivalelwe elawini lakhe silengiswe ngentambo ophahleni lwendlu ngezikhathi zokuphuma kwesikole.Owomndeni, uNksz Nozipho Hlengwa elandisa Isolezwe, uthe umufi ubezihlalela nabantu asebekhulile ngakho bebezitshela ukuthi uvuke waphikelela esikoleni njengezinye izingane."Baqale ukubona ngesikhathi kufika abafundi abejwayelene nabo bezombheka. Nabafundi kuthiwa bathe abazange bambone esikoleni ngalolo suku, kanti ubematasa ebabhalela imiyalezo abangayiqondi kwiFacebook. Ngesikhathi kuvulwa isicabha sendlu yakhe, bazithele esidunjini silenga okukholakala ukuthi uzibulele,” usho kanje.Uthe ubeyingane ebizithulela, ihlonipha futhi ihlakaniphile nasesikoleni ngakho okusolisayo ukuthi ubehleze ebalisa ngoyise owanyamalala ngo-2019. Uyise kuvela ukuthi washayelwa ucingo othile wathi abahlangane naye eThekwini, kukhona umsebenzi wonogada ovelayo, kwabe ukugcina kokubonwa kwakhe. Kuthiwa isigameko sokunyamalala kukayise okunenkolelo yokuthi wenzakaliswa, saphoqa ukuthi abuyele koninalume ayohlala khona. Umufi kuvela ukuthi wayekhule ekhonze kakhulu uyise, ezihlalela naye, okukholakala ukuthi yinto ebihlale imhlupha ukuhamba kwakhe ngaleya ndlela.Isolezwe liyibonile eminye imibhalo ekhasini lakhe kwiFacebook okukhona kuyo othi;"Uphi ubabawakho? Akukho lula ukuthi ngithi anginaye.”Umndeni uthi akusona isigameko sokuqala sokuthi kubekhona emndenini ohamba ngale ndlela njengoba umkhulu wakhe omncane ngasohlangothini likanina nobabomncane wakhe nabo badlula emhlabeni ngendlela efanayo.Umufi kuthiwa ubedume ngokuzigidela ingoma, kangangoba ngesikhathi ebhalela abangani bakhe afunda nabo umyalezo, kuthiwa ubacele ukuthi bafike bonke baphelele emcimbini wakhe ngoLwesihlanu kugidwe ingoma kuze kuse, okukholakala ukuthi ubeqonde umngcwabo wakhe.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa ase-Taylor’s Halt, avule idokodo lophenyo ngokufa komuntu emva kokuthi isidumbu sakhe sitholwe silengisiwe kubo ngoMsombuluko.
UMPHATHISWA wezeZimali KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Francios Rodgers, ufunge wagomela ukuthi kuzophela nya ukusaphazwa kwemali ezintweni ezingahlelelwe kuhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal.URodgers uthembise ukukuqapha ngelokhozi ukusetshenziswa kwemali kuhulumeni wesifundazwe.Ukusho lokhu emva kokwethula kabusha isabelomali sesifundazwe esingu-R150 billion, esiShayamthetho.URodgers uthe izikhathi esiphila kuzo zidinga ukuthi iminyango kahulumeni ibophe izifociya."Asikwazi ukuvele sisebenzise imali ezintweni ebesingazihlelelanga. Kufanele sikuqaphe lokhu. Kuzokuba umsebenzi wami ukuba iphoyisa elizogada ukusetshenziswa kwemali. Ngizokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi imali ayimoshwa. Kufanele sibekezele, sizophuma maduze kule simo esikuso.”URodgers uthe bafuna ukuthi zithathelwe izinyathelo izikhulu zeminyango kahulumeni eziphula imigomo."Izinto engihlale ngizisho ukuthi kufanele sakhe uhulumeni osebenza ngokuthembeka. Ukuze uhulumeni usebenze ngokuthembeka, kufanele kube nemigomo ebekiwe okufanele ilandelwe yiwo wonke umuntu. Njengoba kunemigomo elawula ukusetshenziswa kwemali kahulumeni, kufanele senze isiqiniseko sokuthi le migomo iyalandelwa."Njengohulumeni omusha, kufanele senze izinto ngendlela ehlukile. Kulo hulumeni kufanele senze isiqiniseko sokuthi imigomo iyalandelwa. Kufanele senze isiqiniseko sokuthi bathathelwa izinyathelo abamoshe imali. Akufanele sitotose abantu abaphula imithetho. Ngizokuba owokuqala ukubathathela izinyathelo abaphula umthetho.”URodgers ukhulume ngezingxoxo zokuthi ezinye izinkampani zikahulumeni ezenza inzuzo zifakwe emnyangweni wakhe.URodgers uthe ngesikhathi kunezingxoxo zokubusa ngokubambisana kwaba nesiphakamiso sokuthi izinkampani ezifana nezeMvelo KZN Wildlife, Sharks Board, Liqour Board, neGaming and Betting Board, zifakwe emnyangweni wakhe.Lezi zinkampani ziseMnyangweni wezokuThuthukiswa koMnotho nokoNgiwa kweMvelo."Lezo zingxoxo azikaphothulwa.”Ephawula ngezeMvelo KZN Wildlife, uthe le nkampani kufanele ibhukule ukuze yenze imali, ingathembeli kuhulumeni."Into engihlale ngiyisho kwabezeMvelo ukuthi kufanele bazi ukuthi yini inhloso yezeMvelo. Akuwona umsebenzi kahulumeni ukwenza amabhizinsi ezokungcebeleka. Into okufanele siyibheke kakhulu ukunakekela izilwane nezithelo ezitholakala ezindaweni eziphethwe ezeMvelo. Akhona amaqhinga okwenza imali esesiqalile ukuwabona esebenza.”
BANOKHWANTALALA abesifazane ngenxa yezikweletu nokungabibikho kwemali yokubhekela izidingo.Lezi zindaba zivezwe nguMnuz Benay Sager oyisikhulu esiphezulu seDebt Busters.USager ukhiphe ucwaningo olubizwa ngeMoney Stress Tracker, oluthole ukuthi abesifazane abasebasha banokhwantalala kakhulu ngenxa yokubiza kwempilo.Abadala kuvele ukuthi bakhathazeke kancane ngoba abanazo izikweletu eziningi futhi abayi kwabaluleka ngezikweletu."Ucwaningo lwethu belubheka abantu abawu-26 000 ababhalise kwiDebt Busters ukuthi bacwaningwe ukuthi ukhwantalala lwabo lungakanani ngenxa yezikweletu. Sithole ukuthi ukhwantalala lwezikweletu lusuke ku-78% obelukuwona ngonyaka odlule lwaya ku-75% kulo nyaka. Abantu bampintshwe wukubiza kokudla, ukunyuka kwemali mboleko nokungathunyelwa kahle kwezidingo,” kusho uSager.Ukungacimi njalo kukagesi kuye kwehlisa kancane ukhwantalala njengoba abantu bekwazi ukubuka ithelevishini, ukupheka nokwenza ezinye izinto eziphazamisekayo uma ugesi ungekho.Uma kuqhathaniswa namadoda abesifazane banokhwantalala oluwu-10% ukudlula olwamadoda, bakhathazeke ka-20% ngempilo yabo naka-30% ngempilo yemindeni yabo.Udokotela wengqondo uDkt Andrea Kellerman, uthe abesifazane yibona abakwaziyo ukusho ukuthi banokhwantalala. Uthe ukhwantalala lubahlasela kakhulu ngoba yibona okufanele beseke amalungu omndeni, baqinisekise ukuthi umndeni udlile futhi wonke umuntu uphile kahle. Abanye banokhwantalala ngoba bakhulisa izingane ngabodwana.Amadoda uthe ayakwazi ukuvalela imizwa yawo, angabhekani nezinto eziningi ngesikhathi esisodwa njengabantu besifazane."Into eyenza abesifazane babe nokhwantalala kakhulu wukuthi bangomama, yibona abasebenzayo ukuze kudliwe ekhaya. Bahlale bephatheke kabi ngenxa yomthwalo abawutshethe wezezimali nempilo,” kusho uDkt Kellerman.Uthe bakhathazekile ngoba abakwazi ukukhokha izikweletu, ayipheli inyanga besanemali ebhange, umholo uphelela kwigilosa.Ubalule ukuthi u-40% womholo ukhokhela izikweletu kanti abahola uR20 000 ngenyanga abakwazi ukuphila kahle ngenxa yezikweletu.Abaneminyaka ewu-55 bakhathazeke ngokukhokhela izikweletu nokuthi ngabe banemali eyanele yomhlalaphansi.IDebtBusters ithe abadinga usizo bangangena kwi-website yale nkampani ukuze balekelelwe ngezindlela zokuqeda izikweletu.
UHULUMENI waKwaZulu-Natal uzongenela ezinkingeni ezikhungethe omasipala bakulesi sifundazwe.Uhulumeni wesifundazwe uthathe isinqumo sokulekelela bonke omasipala.Le sinqumo sithathwe emhlanganweni wezinsuku ezimbili wekhabhinethi, ilekgotla, ophele ngoLwesithathu.Undunankulu, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, uthe bonke omasipala baKwaZulu-Natal bayalelwe ukuba balwele ukuthola imibiko yomcwaningi mabhuku engenagcobho kulo nyaka wezimali ozoqala."UMphathiswa woMnyango wokuBusa ngokuBambisana (uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi) sithe akahambe ayobheka ukuthi imaphi amaphuzu amqoka omasipala okufanele sibalekelele kuwona ukuze bathole imibiko engenawo ugcobho. Nokuthi akufanele sifike komasipala ngoba nakhu umcwaningi mabhuku esekhiphe imibiko. Kufanele imibiko yokusebenza kwemali yomasipala siyithole njalo emva kwezinyanga ezintathu.”UNtuli uthe omasipala babambe iqhaza elikhulu ekuhanjisweni kwezidingo."Sithe ngeke sikubekezelele ukuthi omasipala bangenzi kahle. Omasipala bayithemba lethu. Intuthuko eningi yenziwa omasipala.”UNtuli uthe uhulumeni wesifundazwe usuzosebenzisana nomasipala."Siqala umkhuba omusha manje wokusebenzisana nomasipala. Akufanele nje uma siyosebenza ezindaweni zomasipala, singabazisi. Omasipala abangaboni nje sesiqhamuka. Lokhu sizokwenza ngokubambisana nenhlangano yohulumeni basekhaya.”Ikhabhinethi yaKwaZulu-Natal ibunjwe amaqembu ehlukene, iqembu elathola amavoti amaningi esifundazweni iMK, lasala ngaphandle ngesikhathi kubunjwa uhulumeni, nosekwenze ukuthi kube khona abangawamukeli uhulumeni wesifundazwe.UNtuli ukuvumile ukuthi nakuba bona bebumbene njengamaqembu abusa ngokubambisana, abantu baKwaZulu-Natal basahlukene phakathi."Kufanele siqhamuke nomyalezo ozokhombisa ubumbano. Thina njengamaqembu aphethe ngokubambisana kufanele sikhombise ubumbano.”UNtuli uthe wonke amaqembu ayingxenye kahulumeni wokubambisana, i-IFP, ANC, DA, neNFP, azimisele ukubona uhulumeni wesifundazwe uphumelela."Indlela okuyiyona, kufanele umuntu we-IFP akhathazeke uma kunezinkinga kwi-ANC, nowe-ANC kufanele akhathazeke uma kunezinkinga kwi-IFP ngoba sonke sifuna ukuthi kube nozinzo kula maqembu. Uma kunozinzo kula maqembu kusho ukuthi uhulumeni wobumbano ngeke uphazamiseke.”UNtuli umemezele ukuqokwa koMphathiswa woMnyango wezokuThutha nokuHlaliswa kwaBantu, uMnuz Siboniso Duma, esikhundleni sokuxhumanisa ikhabhinethi lesifundazwe nesiShayamthetho.UDuma ubevele esiphethe le sikhundla ngesikhathi kusaphethe i-ANC."Uzokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi awungeni lapho kungafanele ungene khona, ukuze kungabikhona ukuphambana kokusebenza kuhulumeni wethu.”
UCABANGA ukulivuma icala uNkk Faith Ntombela obhekene nelokubulala umyeni wakhe owayeyiphoyisa lomkhandlu weTheku, uCaptain Zwelakhe Ntombela.Lokhu kuvezwe umshushisi, u-Advocate Kristen Shaah eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini.Ubekade etshela iJaji uBruce Bedderson ngokuhlelwa nguNkk Ntombela ongumsolwa wokuqala kuleli cala."Umsolwa wokuqala kuleli cala uhlela ukuthi alivume icala lokubulala,'' kusho umshushisi etshela ijaji.Ngaleso sikhathi, uNkk Ntombela ubebonakala ethule ebheke phansi enganyakazi. Kulokhu ubebonakala engahleki, esaba nokubheka abantu abebesenkantolo.UCAPTAIN Zwelakhe Ntombela owabulawa ngokudutshulwa Umshushisi uveze nokuthi nenkabi uCele, icabanga ukwenza okufanayo, ngaphandle kukaKhumalo ongummangalelwa wesithathu kuleli cala.Ijaji alizange limbuze uNkk Ntombela ukuthi kuyiqiniso yini lokhu okushiwo ngumshushisi wecala.Ngaphambilini, Isolezwe lake lakuveza ukuthi litholile ngemithombo yalo ukuthi ucabanga ukulivuma icala uNkk Ntombela osolwa ngokuba ungqondongqondo wetulo lokubulawa komyeni wakhe.Umufi wahlaselwa esemzini wakhe okwaS, eMlaza, ngoMeyi 3, ngonyaka owedlule.Ngesikhathi edutshulwa umufi, uNkk Ntombela wayekhona ngaphakathi endlini kodwa kuvela ukuthi akazange azihluphe ngokuyobheka emnyango.Wadutshulwa ngabantu abangaziwa wabe esephuthunyiswa esibhedlela eSiphingo Medical Towers okuyilapho okwafike kwamenela khona.Ngemuva kwalokho, amaphoyisa abopha inkabi uSipho Ntombela okwavela ukuthi iyona eyadubula.Le nkabi yageqa amagula ilandisa inkantolo ngalo lonke itulo, yaveza nokuthi yayikade ithunywe nguNkk Ntombela.Yaveza nokuthi yayikhokhelwe imali engakanani ukuze yenze lo msebenzi. Inkantolo yabe seyiyigweba iminyaka ewu-15 ibhadla ejele.Ngemuva kwalokho, noNkk Ntombela wakhalelwa ngamaSongo kaSigonyela ngaleli cala.Kwavela nokuthi uNkk Ntombela itulo wayelihlanganisa noMnuz Sithembiso Justice Khumalo onguthishanhloko esikoleni iMpumulwane Primary, KwaMaphumulo, ongaphandle ngebheyili.Kwavela negama lenkabi esatshwayo KwaZulu-Natal, uKhulani Cele, ukuthi nayo iyabandakanyeka kuleli tulo.Icala lihlehlele u-Agasti 15. UMnuz Nkosinathi Ntombela ongumfowabo kamufi, uthe bajabule ukuthi umakoti wabo useze wathambisa inhliziyo."Ukuhamba leli cala kuyasikhathaza kakhulu futhi kusivusela amanxeba. Ngakho kuyajabulisa lokhu okuvezwe ngumshushisi kokuthi ucabanga ukulivuma icala,'' usho kanjena.
ISEZITHEBENI zikahulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal eyokuxhasa abazokwembathwa iSilo uMisuzulu kaZwelithini ohambweni lwaso lwasebukhosini baseMalawi okuthiwa ludinga imali engaphezu kukaR3 million.Udaba lokuxhasa abazokwembathwa iSilo ohambweni lwangesonto elizayo luxoxwa yihhovisi likaNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal noMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana kanye neziNdaba zoMdabu esifundazweni. ISilo sizohambela umcimbi waminyaka yonke waseMalawi, iMthetho Cultural Festival, oba ngo-Agasti.ISilo kuhlelwe ukuthi sembathwe abantwana basendlunkulu, amakhosi namabutho uma sesihambele lo mcimbi ozoqala ngoLwesithathu.UNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, uthe basalubheka lolu daba."Lolu udaba lusezithebeni. Uzokhumbula ukuthi uMphathiswa wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana kanye neziNdaba zoMdabu (uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi) ubuye abe uNdunankulu kaZulu. Ngakho ke siyalubheka lolu daba. Uma ngingaphosisi sengathi uhambo luzodinga imali engaphezu kukaR3 million.”UNtuli ubekhuluma nabezindaba emva komhlangano weKhabhinethi, iLekgotla, ophele ngoLwesithathu.Kuvele sekukhona itwetwe kwabanye abantwana basendlunkulu abafisa ukuba yingxenye yohambo lwangesonto elizayo.Abanye bathe babona sengathi baningi abazophutha sebethembile.Umthombo osendlunkulu uthe bayalelwe ukuba banciphise ithimba labazokwembathwa iSilo."Sitshelwe ukuthi kufanele kuhambe abantwana abalishumi kanye nasemabuthweni futhi kufuneka abalishumi. Kusho ukuthi baningi abazosala. Lokhu kuwukubukela phansi iSilo. Ingonyama yamaZulu iphethe isizwe esikhulu kabi, kufanele uma inyathela eMalawi kubonakale.”Lo mthombo uthe awazi ukuthi imali edingekayo ingaphezu kukaR3 million, wathi bazi ukuthi kufuneka imali engu-R400 000.Ulanda lo mthombo, uthe yize iSilo sizohamba ngebhanoyi bona batshelwe ukuthi bazohamba ngebhasi."Lolo hambo mhlawumbe luzothatha izinsuku ezimbili ebhasini. Sofika sinjani eMalawi? Khona uyokube usekhona umdlandla wokuhuba uma sifika phambili? Sibona sengathi kukhona nokungacabangelani lapha.”Umcimbi uhlelwe Inkosi Ya Makhosi M’mbelwa V, wamaNgoni.AmaNgoni adubuka kwelikaMthaniya, afuduka ngesikhathi sezimpi eholwa uZwangendaba Gwaza kaZiguda Jele Gumbi.Inkosi yakhona inobudlelwano obuhle neSilo, yayikhona ngesikhathi iMbube ingena esibayeni.Isasasa likhulu eMalawi ngokunyathela kweSilo.UM’mbelwa uthe ukuhambela kweSilo eMalawi kuzoqinisa ubudlelwano bobukhosi bukaZulu nobamaNgoni.Lokhu ukusho embhalweni awufake ekhasini lakhe leFacebook."Sikulangazelele ukufika kweSilo lapha kwelakithi.

UNOBHALA Jikelele weSouth African Federation of Trade Unions (Saftu), uMnuz Zwelinzima Vavi uthe kufanele uhoxiswe umthetho omusha wezimpesheni ngoba ngeke unikeze abasebenzi imali abayidingayo.UVavi uthe ngesikhathi bephakamisa ukuthi uhulumeni avumele abasebenzi ukuthi bathole ingxenye ethile yempesheni yabo ukuze bakwazi ukuphila babengazitsheli ukuthi kuzodedelwa imali encane bese enye kuthiwe bazoyithola uma sebethathe umhlalaphansi."Njengamanje umthetho wezimpesheni onikeza abantu igunya lokuthola ingxenye ethile yemali yabo, obizwa nge-two pot retirement system awubasizi abasebenzi. Asihambisani nalo mthetho ngoba usho ukuthi umsebenzi odiliziwe, oxoshiwe noshiya emsebenzini ngeke athole imali eyanele yokuphila. Sifuna uhoxiswe bese kulethwa umthetho ozosiza abasebenzi ngemali yabo yempesheni hhayi lona obanikeza uR30 000 ongeke ubasize ngalutho,” kuchaza uVavi.Uthe uR30 000 awanele ukubhekana nobunzima obuthwelwe ngabantu bakuleli ngenxa yokubiza kwempilo, ukunyuka kwemali mboleko, izinkinga zezikweletu, ukushonelwa, ukufundisa izingane nokunye okuningi."Asihambisani nokuthi ingxenye eningi yempesheni ihlale esikhwameni esizolinda abantu ukuthi bafike eminyakeni yempesheni. Kudala abasebenzi babefuna ingxenye yempesheni yabo okungenani uhhafu hhayi le okuthiwa bazoyithola. Sasifuna abasebenzi banikwe ingxenye yempesheni yabo ukuze sigweme umkhuba wokushaya isidudla kubasebenzi bakahulumeni ikakhulukazi othisha. Ubuthola ukuthi uthisha uyasula emsebenzini ngoba empintshwe yizikweletu nezinye izinkinga zempilo. Ubethola imali yakhe yempesheni bese ebuyela emsebenzini emuva kwezinyanga ezintathu noma eziyisithupha,” kusho uVavi.Uthe uhulumeni uthathe izimfuno zabasebenzi wazenza ngendlela yakhe ukuze ajabulise ongxiwa."Uhlelo lwezimpesheni olusha oluzoqala ngoSepthemba luzocebisa ongxiwa ngoba bayayilondoloza imali yabasebenzi ezikhwameni zabo ezehlukene. Ithi uma isizala bathole imihlomulo emikhulu kuthiwe amabhonasi okwenza kahle. Abasebenzi abajuluka kanzima besebenzela le mali awukho umcebo abawutholayo futhi manje bazonswinyeka ngenxa yalo mthetho ozobanika amakinati noma ngabe bebhekene nezimo ezinzima,” kuphetha uVavi.
BAVUKWE umunyu enkantolo abesilisa bechaza ngesigameko sokubulawa komfowabo owadutshulwa ehostela laKwaMashu esolwa ngokuthi uyimpimpi yamaphoyisa.OMnuz Mike Zungu noZibuse Zungu abangabafowabo bakamufi, uMnuz Sizwe Petros Zungu (40), bebekhuluma eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseNtuzuma izolo.La madoda achaze umfowabo njengemvu, eyayinothando lwabantu idabuka KwaMaphumulo kodwa behlala ehostela ukuze asondezele nomsebenzi wokuba unogada.Basola ukuthi umfowabo wafela ukuthi washela owesifazane oyintombi kammangalelwa, uMnuz Sbongiseni Njabulo Khoza, abamchaze ngomgulukudu owayesatshwa ehostela.UZungu (Mike) uthe nakuba umufi nalo wesifazane base benikezene nezinamba zocingo kodwa wayeka ukumeshela ngesikhathi ezwa ukuthi bahlobene naye ngezibongo."Kwaba ukuqala kwezinkinga zikamfowethu owangitshela ukuthi uzwa kuthiwa kukhona umuntu osefike izikhawu emfuna kodwa engachazi. Lo muntu wayengayazi indlu naye (umufi) wagcina esefona,” kuchaza uZungu.Ulandise wathi ngosuku lwesigameko uNovemba 21, 2021, babehlezi emnyango ntambama ngabo-5 owesifazane ayemshela wafonela umufi embuza ukuthi ukuphi.Kuthiwa yayingamphethe kahle umufi indaba yokufunwa umuntu angamazi wafuna ikhulunywe iphele le nto. Kuthiwa wabiza abafowabo ababili nowesilisa ongusibonda wendawo kwayiwa endaweni okukhandwa kuyona izimoto ukuze kuxoxwe.Kuvela ukuthi uKhoza waqhamuka neviyo lamadoda behlome ngezibhamu waqonda kumufi wathi: "Ngayithola impimpi yamaphoyisa, asilali nje uwena?”Kuthiwa kwathi uma elandula umufi, amthelekela ngesibhaxu amadoda, uZungu (Mike) waphelela endaweni.Kuvela ukuthi amadoda aqhuba umufi noZungu (Zibuse) aya nabo kumama obolekisa ngemali ezalayo befuna abatsheleke uR10 000.Kubikwa ukuthi kwathi uma ingaphumeleli imizamo yokuthola imali eyayifunwa amadoda, kwayiwa endaweni ewumhosha lapho afike wadutshulelwa khona washona umufi."Ngathi uma ngibona edonsa isibhamu emshaya, ngaphunyula kumfana owayengibambile ngabaleka ngazodlula kuyena lona owayephethe isibhamu ngabaleka ngashiya ophaqa nefoni yami khona lapho,” kusho uZungu (Zibuse).Uthe wabalekela egengeni yangakubo emakhaya wayitshela ukuthi ayihlome ihlasele kodwa yamphendula ngokuthi ayizile yona ngezimpi kodwa izosebenza okuyinto eyamqeda amandla. Athutha ehostela la madoda emuva kwesigameko.Bekulindeleke ukuthi kufakaze udokotela obizwe inkantolo acacise ukuthi wamelapha nini achaze nangokulimala kwakhe. UKhoza ucele inkantolo ukuthi imnike isikhathi esingamasonto amabili ukuze intombi yakhe iye esibhedlela ilande ubufakazi bokuthi wayephukile yena ngesikhathi kwenzeka isigameko.UKhoza uthe akukwazi ukuthi wayengahlohla isibhamu, adubule abulale umuntu ekubeni wayekade enokhonkolo engalweni.Icala lihlehlele u-Agasti 14.
KUBHEKWE ukuthi i-IFP neDA banikwe isikhundla sokuhola ikomiti esaphucwa kabuhlungu i-EFF kuMasipala waseThekwini.I-IFP neDA kulindeleke ukuthi banikezwe izikhundla zokuphatha amakomiti amasha abunjwe emva kokuhlukaniswa kwekomiti ebeliphethwe i-EFF.Ikomiti elihlukaniswe phakathi elokuHlaliswa kwaBantu, manje sekuzokuba nekomiti elibhekele ezithinta Amanzi, uGesi nokuQoqwa kukaDoti, bese kuba khona elibhekele ukuHlaliswa kwaBantu, ezokuThutha nezobuNjiniyela.Isinqumo sokuhlukaniswa kwekomiti sithathwe emhlanganweni wesigungu esiphezulu obungoLwesibili, umhlangano womkhandlu iwona ozothatha isinqumo sokugcina ngokusungulwa kwamakomiti amasha.IMeya kaMasipala, uMnuz Cyril Xaba, ithe bakhethe ukuhlukanisa ikomiti phakathi ngoba bafuna ukuthi umkhandlu ubhukule ekuhambiseni izidingo kubantu.UXaba uthe ukusungulwa kwamakomiti amasha kuzokwenza ukuthi kube lula ukuqapha ukusebenza kweminyango engaphansi kwalama komiti, wathi kuzokwenza ukuthi umasipala uqoqe imali eningi.Ikomiti lokuHaliswa kwaBantu beliphethwe ikhansela le-EFF, uMnuz Themba Mvubu, owakhishwa ngasekuqaleni kwalo nyaka emva kokuchitheka komshado we-ANC ne-EFF.Umthombo onolwazzi ngodaba uthe izikhundla zokuphatha amakomiti amasha zizonikwa i-IFP ne-DA.La maqembu abengabhekani ne-ANC eThekwini, kodwa kubukeka sengathi seligaya ngomunye umhlathi manje njengoba sekunohulumeni wokubambisana KwaZulu-Natal nakuzwelonke obunjwe ilamaqembu womathathu.I-IFP neDA abazange bawungenele umbango wesikhundla sobumeya ngesikhathi kuqokwa uXaba ngasekuqaleni kwenyanga, phambilini la maqembu abeyaye ayibangise i-ANC uma kuqokwa imeya.Amakhansela e-IFP neDA kuMasipala waseThekwini akuncomile ukuhlukaniswa kwamakomiti, kepha athi awazi lutho ngendaba yezikhundla okuthiwa azonikwa zona.Ohola i-IFP kuMasipala waseThekwini, uMnuz Mdu Nkosi, uthe ikomiti lokuHlaliswa kwaBantu bekufanele lihlukaniswe, wakhala ngokuthi belinomsebenzi omningi kakhulu."Empeleni kudala la makomiti ayehlukene. Angicabangi ukuthi kukhona umuntu ongaphikisana nalesi sinqumo ngoba sibeka phambili abantu. Umuntu mhlawumbe ongaphikisa iloyo ozicabangela yena yedwa.”UNkosi uthe akazi ngendaba yokuthi bangase banikwe isikhundla, wathi izingxoxo ziphethwe ubuholi obuphezulu."Thina sizozwa ngobuholi obuphezulu bese silandela lokho abakushoyo.”Ohola iDA kuMasipala waseThekwini, uMnuz Thabani Mthethwa, uthe ukuhlukaniswa kwekomiti kuzokwenza ukuthi kube lula ukuthi balandelele ukusebenza kweminyango engaphansi kwekomiti.UMthethwa uthe azikho izingxoxo zokuthi banikwe isikhundla."Ingakho bengakhethwanga osihlalo bamakomiti ngoba azikho izingxoxo.”
IBHEKENE nengwadla imiphakathi eyakhele iTheku namaphethelo ngenxa yokungabibikho kwamanzi nokungathunyelwa kwamaloli awathwalayo. Isolezwe lithole ukuthi kusukela ngo-2022, imiphakathi eyahlukene eThekwini ikhala ngenkinga yamanzi ikakhulukazi leyo esenyakatho yeTheku. Abantu bakhala ngokuthi uMasipala weTheku awuzikhiphi izaziso zokuthi azophela nezizathu zokuphela kwawo, bavele babone ngawo engasaphumi kompompi babo. Uma beshayela ucingo kwamasipala izingcingo azibanjwa, u-WhatsApp awuphendulwa, ngisho ezinkundleni zokuxhumana umasipala awuchazi. Uma amanzi engekho abantu bathi abakwazi ukuphuza amanzi ahlanzekile, abakwazi ukugeza, ukusebenzisa izindlu zangasese, ukupheka, ukuwasha nokunye okuningi.UNksz Bayo Smamane waku-ward-56, eNewtown A, eNanda, uthe sebehlale isikhathi eside bengenawo amanzi."Emuva kwezikhukhula zika-2022, amanzi awaphindanga aphuma kompompi. Izindlu zangasese asikwazi ukuzisebenzisa, asikwazi ukupheka, ukuwasha nokuphuza amanzi ahlanzekile. Sisizwa ukujaha amaloli amanzi afika uma ethanda,” kusho uNksz Smamane.Uthe akekho umuntu obachazelayo ukuthi kwenzekani ngenkinga ababhekene nayo.Uthe isimo siya ngokushuba ngoba namaloli athwala amanzi awasafiki endaweni."Okubuhlungu ukuthi nesikole iPhumuzuzulu Primary sibhekene nenkinga efanayo, izingane zize zikhishwe kungakashayi isikhathi sokuphuma. Abadla imishanguzo abakwazi ukuyiphuza,” ubeke kanje.ENanda namaphethelo umphakathi uze wabhikisha kuleli sonto, ufuna amanzi. Ikhansela lendawo, uMnuz Syabonga Ntombela, lithe ukuhamba kwamanzi kubangelwa ukulimala kwengqalasizinda eyaguguleka ngesikhathi sezikhukhula.Khonamanjalo: KwaSanti, Klaarwater, Savannah Park naseShallcross, amanzi ahamba phakathi neviki abuye ngempelasonto."Amanzi asehamba ngoLwesine aze abuye ngeSonto. Uma engaphelanga ngalezi zinsuku, siye sibone ngawo ephela ngo-7 ebusuku aze abuye ngo-8 ekuseni. Sesiyazi ukuthi ayavalwa ebusuku kodwa uma sibuza kuMasipala weTheku kuthiwa asuke engavaliwe kodwa izinqolobane eziwagcinayo zisuke zisagcwaliswa. Okubuhlungu wukuthi umasipala usazithumela izincwadi ezifuna abantu bakhokhele amanzi,” kusho isakhamuzi.EDassenhoek naseThornwood nakwezinye izindawo zaseMariannhill, nakhona kukhalwa esifanayo njengoba amanzi ephela noma kunini, asikho isimemezelo esikhishwayo kodwa abantu babona ngawo esephelile.KwaMashu sekuphele izinyanga ezintathu amanzi ephuma ngezinsuku ezithile. ENtuzuma aphuma izinsuku ezintathu ngesonto. Kulezo zinsuku kuba amahora ambalwa, ebusuku nangezimpelasonto awaphumi. UNkk Gugu Sisilana okhulumela uMasipala weTheku, uthe kuyiqiniso ukuthi iNanda Newtown ngenye yezindawo eziphazamisekile njengoba kusalungiswa isikhungo samanzi iNtuzuma 2 Pumpstation."Akusilo iqiniso ukuthi sekuphele iminyaka emibili abantu bengenawo amanzi kodwa amanzi ayafika abuye aphele. Ziningi izinhlelo ezenziwa wumasipala zokusiza abantu okubalwa ukufakwa kwamathangi ezindaweni ezingenamanzi. Uyaqhubeka umsebenzi wokuthuthukisa ingqalasizinda eNtuzuma 2 Pumpstation. Kulindeleke ukuthi uphele ngo-2025,” kuchaza uNkk Sisilana.Uveze ukuthi ukuncishiswa kwamanzi kwenzelwa ukuthi kugcwale izinqolobane zamanzi, ukuze wonke umuntu athole amanzi ngokulinganayo.INtuzuma Pumpstation 2 iphakela izikhungo zamanzi ezihlukene okubalwa iNtuzuma Reservoirs 3, 4, 5, ne 7.Izindawo ezithintekayo yiNanda namaphethelo, iNtuzuma namaphethelo neRichmond Farm.Ubuye wafaka isitatimende seMeya yeTheku, uMnuz Cyril Xaba, lapho ithembise abantu baseThekwini ukuthi iyalusukumela udaba lwamanzi futhi isixazululo sizotholakala maduze.Ithe uyaqhubeka umsebenzi wokuthuthukiswa kwengqalasizinda yamanzi enyakatho yeTheku, eningizimu nasentshonalanga yeTheku.
KUQUBUKE imvunge ngesenzo soMnyango weMfundo ePhakeme, sokubuyisela emuva uR580 million kuMgcinimafa ngoba ungasebenzanga. Imvunge iqutshulwa wukuthi iningi likholwa wukuthi le mali ngabe yenze izinto eziningi okuhlale kukhalwa ngazo ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme, okungamanyuvesi namakolishi amakhono ama-TVET.Okukhalisa kakhulu izinhlangano zezitshudeni wukuthi imali ibingasetshenziselwa ukwesula izikweletu zezitshudeni, ukuxhasa izitshudeni ezidonsa kanzima nokwenza ezinye izinto ezibalulekile. Umfelandawonye wezinyunyana zabasebenzi iSouth African Federation of Trade Unions (SAFTU), udumele ngesenzo somnyango uthi le mali ibingasiza enkingeni yengqalasizinda ezikhungweni zemfundo.I-Saftu ithe imali ibingasiza izitshudeni ezingu-476 ezincishwe uxhaso kulo nyaka wezimali yisikhwama iNSFAS."Minyaka yonke kuhlale kunesililo, izitshudeni zikhala ngoxhaso ekubeni umnyango ubuyisela emuva imali. Le mali ibingenza izinto eziningi okubalwa nokuphucula ingqalasizinda ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme, ukuthenga izinsiza kufundisa ezifana namakhompyutha angasebenzi ezikhungweni,” kusho iSaftu.Umengameli weSasco uMnuz Vezinhlanhla Simelane, ugxeke umnyango ngokubuyisela emuva imali engabe isize izitshudeni.Uthe kunezitshudeni ezingaxhasiwe yiNSFAS ezisalinde isinqumo salesi sikhwama ngokuthi ziyaluthola uxhaso."Kuhlale kuthiwa imali ayenele yokuxhasa izitshudeni kodwa kubuyiselwa emuva imali. Inkulu kakhulu le mali ukuthi ingabuyiselwa emuva imali engaka,” kusho uSimelane.Ugxeke obengungqongqoshe womnyango uDkt Blade Nzimande, ngokubuyiselwa emuva kwemali."Sethemba ukuthi ubuholi obukhona buzoyibhekisisa le nkinga. Kumele le mali ibuyiselwe emnyangweni ukuze izosiza izitshudeni ezidonsa kanzima.” Ibamba likanobhala jikelele wenhlangano i-The Economic Freedom Fighters Students’ Command (EFFSC) uMnuz Khanya Bungane, ligxeke umnyango ngalesi senzo lathi imali kumele ibuyiswe ukuzokweseka izitshudeni ezidonsa kanzima.UBungane uthe uhulumeni we-ANC uhlulekile ukuthuthukisa abantu abasha nezwe ngoba akukwazi ukuthi imali engaka ingabuyiselwa emuva."Izitshudeni zishoda ngendawo yokuhlala ezikhungweni zemfundo. Izinsiza ziyashoda, liphezulu izinga labalaxaza izifundo bengaqedanga. Sidumele ngokuthi kunemali engaka ebuyiselwa emuva phezu kwezingqinamba ezingaka emfundweni ephakeme.”UMnuz Lucian Kearns, ibamba lomphathi wezimali emnyangweni, uthe le mali ebuyiselwe emuva eyeminyaka emibili yezimali.Uveze ukuthi ingu-R462 million imali eyabuyela emuva okwakungeyonyaka wezimali u-2022/2023, noR117 million wangonyaka wezimali u-2023/2024, kanti uma isihlanganisiwe ibalelwa kuR580 million. "Le mali kwakumele isebenze ukuvala izikhala ezikhona ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme. Imali ethinta ezinye izidingo ezibalulekile njengokuxhaswa kwezitshudeni yasebenza cishe yonke,” kuchaza uKearns ekhuluma nesiteshi sethelevishini i-ENCA, izolo ekuseni.Uthe uma befake isicelo sokwabelwa imali basuke behlele ukuyisebenzisa yonke kodwa kuke kubekhona izingqinamba ezenza ukuthi izifiso zingafezeki.
ABEKOMITI elilwa nobugebengu eNanda nasezindaweni ezakhelene nayo, bathi akuwenzi umehluko ukuqothwa kwabasolwa ngobugebengu kule ndawo. Ngaphambi kokuthi iphoyisa libulawe, kwathathwa isibhamu salo somsebenzi,” kusho uNetshiunda.
UKUNGABIBIKHO kwedokodo kuphoqe ukuthi iNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMlaza ilihlehlise icala lokubulawa kowesilisa wakwa-B, eMlaza, owaqhululwa ngezinhlamvu ehamba ngesihlalo esinamasondo.Umufi uMnuz Simanga Khumalo (29) wadutshulwa ngamadoda angaziwa ekuqaleni konyaka, esigamekweni esenzeka kwa-Q, emini kwabha kubuka wonke umuntu.Ngemuva kwalesi sigameko kunabesilisa ababili abakhalelwa ngamasongo kaSigonyela, beyamaniswa naleli cala.Ababoshwa ngoMnuz Siyabonga Ngubane (36) noSithembiso Khomo (23), okuyimanje bavalelwe futhi bagqigqa eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMlaza emuva kokunqatshelwa ibheyili.Babhekene namacala amane. UGOBE uphondo wasula ePhalamende owayenguNgqongqoshe wezeMidlalo, ubuCiko nezokuNgcebeleka kuleli uMnuz Zizi Kodwa.UKodwa usula emva kokuba ezinye izinhlangano bezikuchitha ukuba khona kwakhe ePhalamende njengelungu lekomiti leMfundo eyisiSekelo.Usula nje ungaphandle ngebheyili kaR30 000 ngamacala enkohlakalo. Unobhala jikelele we-ANC uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, wamukele incwadi yokusula kukaKodwa.Ibamba lomkhulumeli we-ANC uMnuz Zuko Godlimpi, lithe uKodwa uthumele le ncwadi ngoLwesithathu, waveza ukuthi usula ngokushesha.UGodlimpi uthe i-ANC ikwamukele ukusula kukaKodwa wathi bamfisela okuhle kodwa. UKodwa nosomabhizinisi uMnuz Jehan Mackay, babuyela enkantolo ngenyanga ezayo ngalawa macala.UMackay usolwa ngokugwazela uKodwa ngo-R1.68 million ngesikhathi esawumkhulumeli we-ANC, ukuze amcubuzele amagabadi kwithenda yezobuchwepheshe ayefake isicelo kuyona.Kuthiwa le mali yakhokhela indawo yomntakabani ayevakashele kuyona eKapa phakathi kuka-2015 no-2016. Babuyela enkantolo ngo-Agasti 21. Ngisho neCosatu ike yakhala ngokujutshwa kukaKodwa ePhalamende, yathi lokhu kubuyisela emuva imizamo yokuzakha kabusha kwale nhlangano.
I-INTERPOL idlulisele emaphoyiseni imishini esho ngaleso sikhathi uma umuntu ekuleli ngokungemthetho noma uma uhamba ngemoto eyebiwe.Le mishini inikwe amaphoyisa uNobhala-jikelele we-Interpol, uDkt Jurgen Stock osohambeni lwezinsuku ezimbili eNingizimu Afrika.Imishini yamukelwe uMkhuzi wamaPhoyisa, uGeneral Fannie Masemola.Okhulumela amaphoyisa kuzwelonke, uBrigadier Athlenda Mathe, uthe imishini izolekelela ngokuthi ube impumelelo umsebenzi wamaphoyisa wokulwa nobugebengu."Uzositshela ngaleso sikhathi uma umuntu engene eNingizimu Afrika ngendlela engekho emthethweni futhi uma imoto iduniwe noma yebiwe,” kusho uBrig Mathe.Umbutho wamaphoyisa kuleli uyingxenye yamazwe omhlaba ayilungu lale nhlangano.Khonamanjalo, athelekile eParis, eFrance amaphoysa angu-15 asophikweni iPublic Order Policing (POP) azoba ingxenye yazobe eqaphe emidlalweni yama-olympic evulwa ngokusemthethweni ngoLwesihlanu.
UKUQHUBEKA komsebenzi wokuthuthukiswa kwemigwaqo emikhulu KwaZulu-Natal kuzoholela ekuvalweni kwesikhashana kukathelawayeka uN2 eNseleni kusukela ngoMsombuluko ozayo.Lo mgwaqo uzovalwa ebhulohweni iNseleni River Bridge (B2020) njengoba kuqhubeka umsebenzi wokulungisa ingqalasizinda lapha kuleya ndawo. Abashayeli abajwayele ukusebenzisa lo mgwaqo bayazi ukuthi sekunesikhathi kunosebenzi oqhubekayo kuleya ndawo. USerisha Sukraj oyi-Eastern Region Project Manager eSanral uthe ukuvalwa kwalo mgwaqo kubalulekile ukuze uqhubeke kahle umsebenzi wokuphakamisa ibhuloho kule ndawo."Njengoba kuqala uhlelo lokuphakamisa ibhuloho, kubalulekile ukuvala ingxenye yomgwaqo ukuze kulawulwe isimo,” kusho yena.Izinsuku nezikhathi okuzovalwa ngazo:Julayi 29, 2024 uma ubheke eningizimu kusukela ngo-9 ekuseni kuya ku-2 ntambamaJulayi 30, 2024 uma ubheke enyakatho kusukela ngo-9 ekuseni kuya ku-2 ntambamaJulayi 31, 2024 uma ubheke eningizimu kusukela ngo-9 ekuseni kuya ku-2 ntambamaAgasti 1, 2024 uma ubheke eningizimu kusukela ngo-9 ekuseni kuya ku-2 ntambamaKunxuswa abashayeli ukuba bahlele kahle uhambo lwabo bazibekele nesikhathi esanele sokubhekana nokubambezelela, ikakhulukazi uma bebheke ezindaweni ezifana nasezikhumulweni sezindiza lapho kusetshenzwa khona ngesikhathi."Sinxusa abasebenzisi bomgwaqo ukuba baqaphelisise izimpawu zomgwaqo behlise nesivinini uma sebesondela kule ndawo okusetshenzelwa kuyo,” kuqhubeka uSerisha Sukraj.

Uthe incwadi yezikhalo yamukelwe uMnuz Njabulo Zungu oyisikhulu kulo masipala wathembisa ukuthi bazoba nomhlangano ngoLwesihlanu nabamele abasebenzi ukubhunga ngalolu daba.Abasebenzi balolu hlelo bathola isibonelelo esiphakathi kuka-R3000 no-R 4000 ngenyanga
UPHIKO lwentsha lweqembu Umkhonto weSizwe (MKPYL), lusole umona ezinhlanganweni ezigijimele ezinkantolo zifuna ukuchitha umholi waleli qembu ePhalamende uDkt John Hlophe, ekubeni yilungu leJudicial Services Commission (JSC). Le khomishini iluleka umengameli wezwe ngezinto ezithinta amajaji.Lokhu kulandela ukuya enkantolo kwezinhlangano i-AfriForum ne-DA, zifuna uHlophe akhishwe kwiJSC.NeFreedom Under Law ithe izothatha izinyathelo zomthetho ngalolu daba.UMnuz Nkateko Mkhabela wezokuxhumana kwiMKPYL, uthe iPhalamende lalandela yonke imigomo ngesikhathi liphakamisela uHlophe kwiJSC.Uthe lezi zinhlangano zifuna ukwenza iMK intenge njengeqembu eliphikisayo ePhalamende."Lezi zinhlangano bezingafuni uHlophe akhethelwe kulesi sikhundla ngoba ziyawazi amava akhe. Azibhekele ukusebenza kwansuku zonke kweJSC, ngakho azikwazi ukukhulumela ikhomishini.” I-AfriForum ifake amaphepha enkantolo yoMthethosisekelo ifuna kususwe uHlophe.Isikhulu esiphezulu se-AfriForum uMnuz Kallie Kriel, sithe akukwazi ukuthi umuntu owaphucwa isikhundla sokuba yijaji angakhethelwa esikhundleni esifuze lesi.UKriel uthe bazolwa kuze kufike enkantolo yokugcina ngoba bafuna singehli isithunzi seJSC. "Ukuthi uHlophe abe yingxenye yeJSC kubeka engcupheni isithunzi sale khomishini. Kubeka engcupheni nomthetho wakuleli yingakho siyilwa indaba yokufakwa kwakhe.”UNkk Helen Zille uSihlalo weFederal kwi-DA, uthe bafake amaphepha enkantolo enkulu yaseWestern Cape, ngoba befuna kuchithwe uHlophe kwiJSC. Uthe noma bekwamukela ukuthi kuyilungelo lamaqembu ukuphakamisa amalungu awo kwiJSC, kodwa abamfuni uHlophe kule khomishini."Akaziphathanga ngendlela elindelekile kumuntu oyijaji. Sifake isicelo esiphuthumayo sokuthi avinjwe ukuthi angene kwiJSC. Okwesibili ngukuthi sifuna kubuyekezwe isinqumo sePhalamende sokumqokela kwiJSC.” Uthe ukuqokwa kukaHlophe kubukela phansi umthetho.Amanye amalungu ePhalamende ayingxenye yeJSC kubalwa kuwona nomholi we-EFF uMnuz Julius Malema. Kulindeleke ukuthi umhlangano weJSC uhlale ngo-Okthoba, lapho le khomishini izophakamisa kumengameli wamajaji okumele avale izikhala ezivulekile ezinkantolo ezehlukene.
BAHLONGOZA ukufaka isikhalazo esisemthethweni kumaphoyisa ahlanganisa ubufakazi bokusebenza kwamaselula abameli babamangalelwa ecaleni lokubulawa kowayengunozinti we-Orlando Pirates neBafana Bafana uSenzo Meyiwa.Lokhu kuvezwe ummeli kammangalelwa wesithathu, uMthobisi Ncube, u-Advocate Charles Mnisi izolo ngesikhathi ephosa ngemibuzo ufakazi woMbuso oyisikhulu sakwaVodacom, uNksz Pinky Vythilingam.Lesi sexwayiso size ngesikhathi uMnisi ephikisana ngamazwi noNksz Vythilingam.Umsindo ususwe wubufakazi benombolo okuthiwa yayisetshenziswa uKelly Khumalo naleyo eyayisetshenziswa ummangalelwa wesihlanu, uFisokuhle Ntuli.UMnisi ubalule ukuthi ngesikhathi behlaziya ulwazi oluyamaniswa nalezi zinombolo olukwifomethi ye-Excel kuveza ukuthi lezi zinombolo zashayelana izingcingo ngaphambi kokubulawa kukaMeyiwa kanjalo nangemumva kokubulawa kwakhe.Kugcine kuvela ukuthi ulwazi uMnisi afunda kulo kulwifomethi ye-Excel ekubeni ufakazi yena ethi alulethe phambi kwenkantolo lukwifomethi ye-PDF nokwenza angakwazi ukuphendula lutho ngalolu olushiwo uMnisi ngoba akalwazi.Ukuxhumana phakathi kukaKelly noKhumalo kwaqala ukuvela ebufakazini bukaColonel Lambert Steyn, onguchwepheshe wezamaselula emaphoyiseni nyakenye. UNksz Vithilingam uthe yena kolwabo ulwazi akukho lapho okuvela khona lobu bufakazi uMnisi abushoyo. Ubuze ufakazi ukuthi uma sekukhulunywa iqiniso, ngokolwazi lwamaselula, ike yenzeke yini into efana nale."Akuze kungenzeka ukuthi kubekhona ukusebenza kwezingcingo okungaveli kwi-system yethu,” kuphendula ufakazi.Uthe uzokusho angahlonizi ukuthi lolu lwazi alutomulile lunenhlese yokukhwabanisa ngoba alufani nolwazi olwahlanganiswa wufakazi okubeke kwacaca ukuthi ulwazi lwamaselula baluqapha ngeso lokhozi enkampanini yabo."Noma ukukhwabanisa kwenziwa, angazi kodwa kulezi zinsuku esiphila kuzo, kungenzeka noma yini. Okwesibili, inhloso yalolu lwazi (olungaqondakali), ukukhanda icala elingekho ngommangalelwa wesihlanu, kube sengathi kwakukhona ukuxhumana phakathi kwakhe nenombolo okuthiwa eKelly Khumalo,” kusho uMnisi.Uqhube wathi lokhu kuwumzamo nje woMbuso ukuthi uKelly Khumalo waba nokuxhumana nommangalelwa."Okokugcina, siyalelwe (abamangalelwa) ukuthi sifake isikhalazo esisemthethweni ngalabo abahlanganisa lolu lwazi,” kusho uMnisi.Uthe leso sikhalazo sizobe simayelana nokukhwabanisa nokuzama ukunqinda amandla ingalo yomthetho ngoba lolu lwazi ludukisa inkantolo.Icala liyaqhubeka namuhla.
UFUNA izimpendulo umndeni wekhehla laseMadamini, eJozini, okuthiwa lishone lase lingcwatshwa yintombi umndeni ungazi.Kuthiwa uMnuz Bhekabakubo Dludla (69) ubanjwe ukugula washona. Ube esengcwatshwa yintombi yakhe yakhona eJozini, uNksz Zamile Mhlongo (30), ingawazisanga umndeni kamufi.Isolezwe likhulume nendodakazi endala kamufi, uNksz Bongekile Dludla, ebivutha ingabaselwe.Ithe kuyilumbo okwenziwe yintombi kayise, yathi bona ngeke baze bavume ukuthi balawulwe yintombi ngomzimba kayise. Ithe bafuna simbiwe isidumbu sikayise sizongcwatshwa emzini wakhe.Indodakazi kamufi ithe bazolulwela lolu daba kuze kube yisekugcineni. "Iyachwensa le ntombazane. Angazi ngempela ukuthi icabanga ukuthi iyini. Isithathaphi nje isibindi sokuthi ingenza lo mhlola ngaphandle kokuthi isazise?'' isho kanje kuzwakala ukuthi iyathuthumela.Ivumile ukuthi bebazi ngomjolo kayise nentombi, yaveza nokuthi uyise wayekade esebenza kahle kodwa manje ubengasasebenzi. Yalile ukudalula ukuthi uyise wayesebenza kuphi, yathi intombi kuzomele ibachazele ukuthi ngempela ibingenelwe yini? "Intombi yake yangishayela ucingo ingazisa ukuthi ubaba usezohlala nayo. Yangitshela ukuthi ubaba uthe kuyona siyamhlukumeza selokhu kwashona umama lapha ekhaya. Nalapho futhi asazi ukuthi ubaba besimhlukumeza ngani futhi kanjani,'' kusho indodakazi.Ithe bazovula icala futhi ngeke kuze kugcine yona intombi. Ithe intombi kumele ibachazele ukuthi imali kababa wabo ayeyibekile ishonephi?"'Kuningi kabi lo wesifazane okuzomele asichazele khona. Angeke phela sidlale intombazane ifuna ukucanasa phezu kwamakhanda ethu.'' Ngesikhathi uNksz Mhlongo ethintwa uqale ngokuthuka ukuthi lolu daba selufinyelele kwiSolezwe. "Hawu sebegijime batshela Isolezwe!'' usho kanje.Uvumile ukuthi ubesothandweni oluvuthayo noDludla. Wamchaza njengowesilisa obesekhulile kodwa obenothando lweqiniso.Uthe akazimisele ngokuthi aphenduke inkukhu nempaka nezingane zikamufi, wathi umufi uxinwe yisifuba kwase kuyamenela njalo.Ebuzwa ukuthi umngcwabe kuphi uDludla, uphendule ngokukhululeka, wathi kubo. Uveze ukuthi bese kuphele iminyaka emithathu egcwele ehlezi ndawonye nomufi."Kumele bazi ukuthi mina anginacala. UDludla uyena owangeshela ehlangana nami futhi uyena owathi uzizwa enokuthula okukhulu uma ekanye nami lapha ekhaya,'' usho kanjena.Uthe uma befuna ukumba isidumbu akanankinga kodwa bayobe benza okuphambene nesifiso sikamufi "owacela" ukufihlwa nguyena.Uthe akakwazi emzini kaDludla kodwa wathi uyazi ukuthi yikhona eJozini.Isazi samasiko, uSolwazi Phila Mthethwa, sisihlabe sasihlikiza isenzo sentombi. UMthethwa uthe kunemikhuba eyenziwayo uma kungcwatshwa ubaba wekhaya, kuwona okufaka phakathi ukubika ukuthi umzimba sewufikile emagcekeni.Ubuze ukuthi leyo mikhuba pho intombi iyenze kanjani? Uthe intombi kumele isukume ilungise lo monakalo ngoba uma kungenjalo lesi simo singahamba sigcine siba yifindo empilweni yayo esikhathini esizayo."Ngokwesiko nje, yichilo leli elenziwe yilo wesifazane,’’ usho kanje. Uthe futhi ngemuva kwezinyanga ezithile umufi wenzelwa umsebenzi wokumbuyisa, wathi pho umndeni kamufi uzowenza kanjani isidumbu sikwelinye igceke lomuzi ongaziwa? Isolezwe ngaphambilini like labika ngesehlakalo esifuze lesi lapho khona intombi yaseMzimkhulu yangcwaba indoda ngaphandle kokwazisa umndeni wayo.
UNDUNANKULU waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, unxuse amalungu ekhabhinethi lakhe ukuba akhohlwe izimpi ezingathi shu.UNtuli unxuse abaphathiswa baKwaZulu-Natal ukuba bakhombise ubumbano, baphinde bagxile ekuhambiseni izidingo.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ethula inkulumo yakuvula umhlangano wekhabhinethi, obizwa ngelekgotla.Ikhabhinethi yaKwaZulu-Natal ixube abaphathiswa abaqhamuka emaqenjini ahlukene, i-IFP, ANC, DA neNFP.UNtuli uthe abantu baKwaZulu-Natal balindele ukuthi uhulumeni wokubambisana usebenze ngaphandle kwezihibe."Asikho isikhathi sokudlala. Asikho isikhathi sezimpi ezingathi shu. Abantu baKwaZulu-Natal bathembele kuthina, asingabaphoxi.”Lo hulumeni ongakaqedi izinyanga ezimbili usunguliwe, usuke wabhekana nezivunguvungu.Kuke kwajikijelana ngamazwi uNobhala we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Bheki Mtolo noMphathiswa woMnyango wokuBusa ngokuBambisana oyilungu le-IFP, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi.UMtolo wayesola uButhelezi ngokuzenzela umathanda komasipala, emsola ngokushintsha abalawuli ngaphandle kokulandela imigomo.UMtolo ube nomhlangano noNtuli izolo, naphambi kokuqala kwelekgotla.Wale waphetha ukuphawula emva komhlangano wabo, wathi bebezikhulumela ezomndeni.UNtuli uthe abaphathiswa kufanele bangakhohlwa ukuthi bahlanganiswe into eyodwa, athe ukuhambisa izidingo kubantu."Lona uhulumeni wamaqembu ahlukene ahlanganiswe injongo eyodwa, ukwakha iKwaZulu-Natal elungele wonke umuntu, enamathuba ekusasa elisha. Kulo mhlangano kufanele sivumelane ngezinhlelo zokuhambisa izidingo kubantu."Ngesikhathi ngigcotshwa, ngathembisa ukuthi sizosebenzela abantu baKwaZulu-Natal. Manje sekuyisikhathi sokuthi sikhombise ukuthi sizimisele kangakanani ukusebenza ngokubambisana. Ukuzimisela kwethu kuzokhombisa ukuthi sizinikele kangakanani ngokusebenzela abantu.”UNtuli uthe babeke eqhulwini ukukhulisa umnotho nokudala amathuba emisebenzi.Uthe umnotho waKwaZulu-Natal ukhahlamezeke kakhulu ngesikhathi kuhlasela icorona, ngesikhathi kunezibhelu zokuzitapela nangezikhathi ezehlukene okuhlasele ngazo izikhukhula.UNtuli uthe bazimisele ukulwa nobugebengu obudlangile esifundazweni."IKwaZulu-Natal seyaziwa njengesizinda sezinkabi. Kwaziwa ukuthi abantu babulawelwa ubala lapha. Lokhu ngeke kusiqede amandla, sizoqhubeka nokulwa nobugebengu. Iqhinga esifuna ukulisebenzisa ilelo lokuqala ngokulwa nobugebengu obuncane. Okwenza sifune ukusebenzisa leli qhinga ukuthi uma sibayeka abenza amacala amancane, lokho kugqugquzela abantu ukuthi benze amacala amakhulu ngoba babona sengathi umthetho awuqinile.”Umhlangano welekgotla uzophela namhlanje.
INKOSIKAZI yenduna edonsa udilikajele, ngokubulala usihlalo wegatsha le-ANC, izihlangulile ekutheni iyona eyagwazela amaphoyisa imali enguR120 000 ukuze asule icala elagcina ligojele umyeni wakhe.UNkk Sibongile Ndlovu ubephicwa ngemibuzo wuqweqwe lomshushisi, u-Advocate Lawrence Gcaba, eNkantolo yeMantshi yasePinetown izolo.Ungummangalelwa wesibili ecaleni lokuphazamisa ukusebenza kwengalo yomthetho nelenkohlakalo yokufumbathiswa kwamaphoyisa amabili angabamangalelwa, uLieutenant Colonel Khephu Ndlovu noKapteni Bonginkosi Dlamini woKlebe.UMbuso uthi la maphoyisa afumbathiswa uR120 000 owawukhishwe ebhange wuNkk Ndlovu ngomyalelo womyeni wakhe, uFelokwakhe Ndlovu, owayesatokile ngaleso sikhathi ukuze kulahleke ubufakazi ecaleni lokubulawa kukaThulani Nxumalo owayengusihlalo we-ANC KwaNdengezi.UFelokwakhe ugwetshwe udilikajele ngoMeyi nonyaka ecaleni lokubulala uNxumalo ayeyisihlobo sakhe. Kusolakala ukuthi uR120 000 wamukelwa amaphoyisa endaweni epaka izimoto ezize esiteshini samaphoyisa, iDurban Central. UDlamini nalaba abashadile bancishwa ibheyili. Bavele enkantolo nendodana yabo, uMnuz Lindokuhle Ndlovu, noKhephu abangaphandle ngebheyili.UGcaba utshele uNkk Ndlovu ukuthi wakhipha uR120 000 kwi-akhawunti yasebhange yomyeni wakhe kunguLwesine ayezowunika uNdlovu noDlamini eyalelwe ngumyeni wakhe esejele."Imali ngayikhipha ngoba ngifuna ukwenza izidingo zasekhaya. Kwakungeyona eyokugwaza ukuze kusulwe icala. Ngaya kuNdlovu ukuze angicebise ngoba ngangifuna ukuthenga itekisi, iQuantum, sase sixoxa nangomcimbi womembeso owazuzoba sekhweni lakhe,” kuchaza uNkk Ndlovu obezihlangula aze abize uGcaba ngobaba.UGcaba ukuphikisile lokhu, wathi uNkk Ndlovu waya emhlanganweni wokuhanjiswa kwemali emaphoyiseni ekhashwa ngabesilisa ababili ababize ngomkhulu noMpofu okwakuyizethenjwa zalo mndeni ezazizoqinisekisa ukuthi uhlelo luba yimpumelelo.Bekukhona izihlobo zabamangalelwa enkantolo. UFelokwakhe uyisihlobo segazi nephoyisa uNdlovu. Kusolwa ukuthi UDlamini, owayephenya icala lokufa kukaNxumalo, wagcina esusiwe kulona.UNkk Ndlovu uthe akasiboni isidingo sokuqambela inkantolo amanga esehlale isikhathi eside kangaka ejele.ULindokuhle, ongumshana kaKhephu, kuleli cala ungena ngokuthi uMbuso uyasola ukuthi nguyena owafihla isibhamu okwabulawa ngaso uNxumalo.IMantshi uMuntukayise Khumalo ilihlehlisele uSepthemba 26 icala ukuze kuqhutshekwe nokuqulwa kwalo.
USEHAMBA ethuka izanya ngenxa yezinsolo ezibhekiswe kuyena unina wowesifazane owadutshulwa wabulawa kwaboshwa umyeni wakhe oyisosha.UNkk Gwen Msane ongunina kaNkk Tania Msane-Zungu, uthe njengoba sekusondela ukuqala kokuqulwa kwecala usebekwa amabala, yonke into embi ibhekiswe kuyena.Ukhale ngomndeni wesosha lombutho wezokuvikela kuleli elingummangalelwa, uMnuz Lwanda Zungu, athe umsola ngezinto eziningi."Amakhadi asebhange nezimpahla zikammangalelwa ezathathwa kuthiwa zikumina,” kubalisa uNkk Msane.Ubekade evevezela, amehlo ebomvu ebambe izinyembezi, eqalaza nasemaceleni ngesikhathi enekela intatheli usizi kwakhe.Uthe lezi zinto asolwa ngazo okubalwa namakhadi asebhange, kwathathwa odadewabo bakaZungu kodwa manje sekukhonjwa kuyena."Kwayena ubaba wabantwana (uZungu) ubengabhekani nomndeni wakhe kodwa ngoba esenze le nto (esolwa ngokubulala), usehlangene nawo, balwa nami,” kuchaza uNkk Msane.Uthe uma eza enkantolo bakhona abamkhaphayo kodwa akasuki nabo eMlaza, lapho ehlala khona.UNkk Msane uthe udinga ukuvikelwa, kube khona umuntu omlandayo eMlaza, ambuyisele khona emuva kwecala ngoba uyasaba.Lo wesifazane uze wacela iphoyisa elingumphenyi wecala ukuba aphume nalo enkantolo, egajwe uvalo.UZungu usolwa ngokubulala umkakhe ngokumdubula amahlandla ayisithupha emqaleni nasesifubeni ngoJanuwari, nonyaka.UMbuso usola ukuthi wakwenza lokhu phambi kwezingane zakhe benoNkk Msane, maqede wabaleka. Wanyamalala emuva kwesigameko, kwadlula izinsukwana wazinikela emaphoyiseni eqhutshwa ummeli wakhe.Inkantolo yasichitha isicelo sakhe sebheyili.NgoLwesibili, ubekade evele phambi kweNkantolo yeMantshi yasePinetown okuyiyona ezolalela icala lakhe.Icala libuyela kule enkantolo ngoSepthemba 3, ukuze kwenziwe izethulo zokuqala zokuqulwa kwecala.Laba abashadene banezingane ezimbili ndawonye. Phambilini, uNkk Msane wathi uZungu wayeyihlukumeza indodakazi yakhe kwaze kwaba ugcina eyibulele.Ngakolunye uhlangothi, abakubo kaZungu basola umufi ngokuphinga nomuntu wesilisa obesondelene kakhulu nalo mndeni, nokuyinto abathi yanenga kakhulu ummangalelwa.Njengenjwayelo uZungu, oqatha ngomzimba, ungene enkantolo eshesha. Ubegqoke isikibha esimhlobhe nebhulukwe elikuhlaza namateku.Ungena enkantolo ame phuhle adedele izingalo. Akatolikelwa kwazise usuke ekuzwa njengoba kunjalo okusuke kukhulunywa ngesiNgisi enkantolo.

I-NFP iphethe ngokubambisana ne-ANC kulo mkhandlu.Izinkinga zangaphakathi kwi-NFP azizintsha.Ubuholi obudlule beNFP bahlakazwa yisinqumo senkantolo nokwalandelwa umbango omude owaholela ekutheni iqembu lingakwazi ukungenela izinketho.

Kusolwa ukuthi lo wesilisa osejele nguyena ungqondongqondo wetulo lokusocongwa kukamufi njengoba esolwa ngokuthumela ababulali esezikhindini.Kuthiwa wayenengwa ukuthi umufi akalaleli, akafuni ukusula icala.Ilungu lomndeni elikhulume neSolezwe lacela ukungadalulwa ngenxa yokwesaba, liveze ukuthi bahlaliswe lubhujozi ngabathile ababafuna behambile kuleli lokishi."Angeke thina size sithuthe lapha eMlaza ngoba sizwa ngabantu. Into esiyifunayo nje ukuthola iqiniso nobulungiswa mayelana nokubulawa kwelungu lethu lomndeni,'' lisho kanje.Liqhuba, lithe njengomndeni sebeshaya amakhala ngokuthi amaphoyisa ayoke abasize ngelinye ilanga."Phela ngaphambi kokuba uSimanga abulawe wayeseqalile ethola izinsongo zokuthi kumele asule icala uma engafuni ukubulawa. Sawabikela amaphoyisa ngalokhu kodwa waze wabulawa uSimanga, akukho ake azama ukusisiza ngakho,'' kusho ilungu lomndeni.Icala liyabuyela eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMlaza namhlanje.
Imqoka impilo yomntwana ezinsukwini ezingu-1000 ezelwe. Lesi kuba yisikhathi sokusimama komzimba, nokuswabuluka engqondweni nasemoyeni komntwana. Futhi lesi kuba yisikhathi sokwakheka kwesisekelo sempilo yengomuso enganeni.Uhlelo olwaziwa nge-1000 Hospital Programme - oluqhamuka nabakwa-Huggies bembambisene noMnyango wezeMpilo luhlomisa omama abazobeletha ngolwazi namathuluzi amqoka ukunakekela impilo yabo neyabantwana abazelwe. Lo mkhankaso uzophinde uvule amathuba omsebenzi kulabo abafisa ukwenza umsebenzi wezempilo emphakathini.Selokhu lwaqala lolu hlelo ngo-2013, lwaziwa nge-Huggies Health Workers noma iHuggies Moms, sekuqeqeshwe abesifazane bathunyelwa ezibhedlela ezingu-113 eNingizimu Afrika. Iningi lalezi zibhedlela zisezindaweni ezishoda ngezidingo-ngqangi njengakoSoweto eGauteng, eMlaza KwaZulu-Natal naseKhayelitsha eWestern Cape.Esinye sezizathu zokuqalwa kohlelo olunjengalolu kwaba ukucaca kwesidingo sokufundisa abantu ngobumqoka benhlanzeko, impilo yengane nokondleka kwayo. Lezi zinto zineqhaza elikhulu ekukhuleni kahle komntwana osanda kuzalwa nempilo kamama wayo. ENingizimu Afrika ukusondeza lokhu kwesekwa kubalulekile emkhankasweni wokuqinisekisa impilo enhle, ikakhulu ngesikhathi owesifazane esakhulelwe ukuze umntwana afike ephile kahle.Echaza ngalokhu, ngaphambi kosuku i-Baby #BumpDay olungomhla ka-24 Julayi, uCamilla Mgiba oyi-Junior Brand Manager kwa-Huggies, uthe lolu suku luveza ithuba lokuqwashisa ngesidingo sokunakekelwa okulinganayo komama abalindele ukuteta."Uhlelo lwe-1000 Day Hospital Programme seluzakhele igama ngokuba yinqola ethwele ulwazi nezimfundiso ezifanele. Ithimba lethu iHuggies Moms lisebenzisana nodokotela nabahlengikazi amitholampilo nasezibhedlela abazinze kuzo. Sebeyingxenye emqoka yomsebenzi wabezempilo. Ngomsebenzi wabo, besiza omama abalindele ukubeletha, bayakwazi ukusondeza ulwazi oludingekayo olungalekelela labo mama endleleni yabo nangesikhathi esibucayi ngemuva kokubeletha. Singasho nje ukuthi kuze kube manje ithimba le-Huggies Moms selisebenze ama-shift angu-230 lisiza amakhulu omama ekuzinakekeleni bona nabantwana abasanda kuzalwa," kusho uMgiba.Ithimba le-Huggies Moms lisiza kakhulu ngokubonisa abakhulelwe ngokuzinakekela nokuhlelela abantwana besesesiswini baze bafike emhlabeni. Baphinde basize abezempilo ngokulungiselela umama ngolwazi lokuzinakekela sebesemakhaya, bebanika amacebo okubalwa kuwo ukuvama ukugona umntwana enamathele esikhumbeni sakho, ukushintsha amanabukeni, ukuncelisa ibele nokuhlela isimo umntwana osanda kuzalwa azokhula kahle kuso.Kumanje ithimba le-Huggies Moms lihambela izibhedlela zomphakathi namaklinikhi usuku nosuku behambisa izifundo nosizo oludingekayo. Bayakwazi nokuhlela ukuxoxa nomama ngabanye ukuze bezwe kabanzi ngabakudingayo. Kule mikhankaso basebenzisa nemifanekiso ukuze imilayezo yabo ifinyelele ngendlela ezwakalayo.Ngaphandle kokufundisa, ithimba le-Huggies Moms liphinde linikwe umsebenzi wokusabalalisa namasampula emikhiqizo njengamanabukeni nama-wipes okwesula umntwana osanda kuzalwa."Izinsuku ezifana ne-#BumpDay zibekelwe imigubho kwa-Huggies - zisinika ithuba lokubheka indlela esesiyihambile namagalelo enziwe yimikhankaso efana ne-1000 Day Programme. Kuyasithokozisa ukubona umehluko owenziwe yilolu hlelo kubantu besifazane nasemiphakathini. Sizolokhu ziyilandela imiphumela emihle yalolu hlelo olumqoka kangaka," kwengeza uMgiba.

Ezikhathini eziningi okusilimazayo, uthola ukuthi umuntu owagcina ebhaliswe ukuthi uhlala kuleyo ndlu kade ahamba futhi wahamba engashintshwanga. Kuthi loyo ongena esikhaleni sakhe, kugcine kungaveli ukuthi ungubani ngoba usuke engabhalisiwe. UKhumalo uphethe ngelokuthi kumele kube nokuthula kubahlali basehostela futhi kumele abantu izindlu bazithole ngendlela okuyiyo. Uthe lokho okwenzakala manje akusikho ukuthula futhi akumele lushawe indiva udlame nokwebiwa kwezindlu.Ikhansela lendawo uMnuz Khulekani Mbhele, aliliphendulanga ucingo ngesikhathi lifonelwa ngalolu daba.

Ishayiwe ekhanda nasemzimbeni, ngokusho kukayise kodwa yena uthi ubengekho eseGoli isele nosingamama wayo,” kusho unina kamufi.Ethintwa ocingweni lo wesifazane, ukhale ngokuba matasa wacela ukuba intatheli ibuye imfonele kodwa akabange esaluphendula ucingo.Ethintwa uyise wengane, uvumile ukuthi usigcabile isidumbu sendodana yakhe."Ngiyazi ukuthi ngenze iphutha elikhulu ngokusigcaba isidumbu sengane yami. Kodwa nami bengithi ngenza izaba nje njengoba ngiwumuntu wamakhambi,” usho kanje.Uthe kuduma ikhanda ngoba akakaze ashonelwe yingane ngaphambilini."Ngididekile, angazi nokuthi ngithini futhi ngenze njani uma izinto zinjena. Eyi impela kunzima,” usho kanje sakubalisa.Le nyanga ithe ibuzile emndenini ukuthi kwenzakaleni enganeni njengoba inemivimbo. Bayiphendula ngokuthi nabo badidekile ukuthi ngeyani ngoba akekho oke wayishaya.Kuvela ukuthi uPhilasande wayekade ehlala kubo kanina kwathi ngasekupheleni kukaDisemba nyakenye uyise wayihlawula ingane. Ngemuva kwalokho wase ethembisa ukuthi uzoyikhokhela ngokugcwele ebese ihlala naye ngokuphelele eMadadeni. UPhilasande ubenza uGrade R khona eNewcastle.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa aseMadadeni aphenya icala lokubulala emuva kwesigameko lapho ingane eneminyaka emihlanu kusolakala ukuthi ishaywe yaze yashona ngeSonto.UNetshiunda uthe amaphyisa ayaphenya mayelana nalesi sigameko engeza ngokuthi umufi ubekade enemihuzuko nezibazi emzimbeni wakhe.
UMENGAMELI uCyril Ramaphosa ukhale ngokudlebeleka komholi we-EFF, uMnuz Julius Malema, uma kunezinkulumompikiswano ePhalamende.URamaphosa ukhale ngokuthi uMalema uvele ahlasele isiqu somuntu uma kukhulunywa ePhalamende, ayeke ukukhuluma ngezinto ezithinta abantu okusuke kuxoxwa ngazo.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma ePhalamende, lapho ebephendula izinto ezashiwo amaqembu ezepolitiki ngesikhathi kunenkulumompikiswano, ngoLwesihlanu.Ngesikhathi uMalema ekhuluma kwinkulumompikiswano, wagxeka isinqumo se-ANC sokubambisana ne-DA.UMalema wasola uRamaphosa ngokuthengisa ngabantu abamnyama, wathi vele nangesikhathi sobandlululo wayesolwa ngokuba impimpi.Eziphendulela, uRamaphosa uthe uMalema usadinga ukufundiswa ipolitiki."Uchithe isikhathi esiningi lapha uhlasela mina siqu sami, esikhundleni sokukhuluma ngezinto ezizoyisa izwe phambili. Mina nawe kusafanele sihlale phansi sikhulume ngepolitiki. Kusafanele ke ngikufundise ipolitiki. Ngibona sengathi ipolitiki iyakudida. "Kufanele uma usukuma lapha, ukhulume izinto ezizoyisa abantu phambili. Nginesiqiniseko sokuthi emva kokuhlala nawe phansi, uyobuya ipolitiki usuyiqonda kangcono. Uyothi uma usuthola ithuba lokukhuluma lapha, bese ukhuluma into ephilayo.”URamaphosa uthe izinto eziningi uMalema akhuluma ngazo ezazenzeka ngesikhathi kuliwa nobandlululo, uyaziphambanisa, wamyalela ukuba abuze kubaholi be-ANC abadala uma kukhona izinto ezazenzeka ngesikhathi kuliwa nobandlululo afuna ukuzazi."Into engizibuza yona ukuthi wena wawukuphi ngesikhathi kwenzeka lezi zinto okhuluma ngazo?”URamaphosa uthe bekungekhona okokuqala uMalema emhlasela ePhalamende, wathi ngomunye unyaka uMalema wathuka ubaba wakhe khona ePhalamende."Uyazi mina ukuthi ngakhuluma nogogo wakho. Mina angisoze ngama la, ngathuka ugogo wakho ngoba ngiyamhlonipha, futhi nawe ngiyakuhlonipha. Le nto ngiyisho ngoba ngifuna wazi ukuthi kufanele sihloniphane.”URamaphosa uncome ukubambisana kwamaqembu aphethe uhulumeni wobumbano ngesikhathi kunenkulumompikiswano."Amaqembu abusa ngokubambisana akhombisa ukuthi azimisele kangakanani ukubona uhulumeni uya phambili. Amaqembu akhombisa ukuthi azimisele ukubeka eceleni ukungaboni ngaso linye, abeke phambili izidingo zezwe. Akukho okuzovimba uhulumeni wokubambisana. Lo hulumeni uzophumelela noma kukhona abasishwabulelayo.”URamaphosa uthe amaqembu abusa ngokubambisana azoxoxa ngemithetho angavumelani ngayo.Kule mithetho kukhona umshwalense wezempilo nemthetho wezeMfundo."Sizokwazi ukuthola isisombululo kulokho esingavumelani ngakho. Uhulumeni uzosebenza kahle.”
