BALENGELA eweni lokuba bahlakazwe omasipala abangasebenzi kuqalwe phansi kuvotwe ukuze kukhethwe ubuholi obusha.UMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu uthe ngeke abantu balinde ukhetho lwamakhansela ngo-2026 ekubeni izinto zibheda manje.Lo mnyango, oholwa nguMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa, uthe uwutholile umbiko ebuholini bawo obudala mayelana nesimo somasipala ezweni.UHlabisa uthe uhulumeni wasekhaya (umasipala) ubalulekile ngoba yiwona ohlinzeka abantu ngezidingongqangi futhi uthuthukise imiphakathi.Uthe bawu-257 sebebonke omasipala eNingizimu Afrika futhi kulindeleke bayisebenzise ekwenzeni izidingo zomphakathi imali abasuke behlinzekwe yona."Kunomasipala isimo sabo esingagculisi. Sizoqala sikhulumisane nabo sibezwe ukuthi yiluphi usizo abaludingayo. Uma sebekushilo abakufunayo sizobe sesibanika khona bese sibabekela isikhathi sokuguqula isimo,” kusho uHlabisa.Uthe uma umnyango usukwenze konke kodwa ingabikhona inqubekela phambili, yilapho bezothatha khona izinyathelo ezinqala."Awukwazi ukugcina abantu iminyaka emihlanu kumasipala ongasebenzi. Kumele kunikezwe abantu ithuba lokuthi bakhethe kabusha abaholi njengoba bekhombisile ngoMeyi 29 ukuthi bayalishintsha ivoti labo uma ingekho inqubekela phambili,” kusho uHlabisa.UHlabisa ugcizelele ukuthi asikho isidingo sokuba umuntu agcinwe esikhundleni asiphethe ekubeni engawenzi umsebenzi asuke ebekelwe wona. Uqhube wathi bazophinde baxhumane nezinyunyana zabasebenzi komasipala balubeke ezithebeni lolu daba.Akazange awadalule amagama alabo masipala abangasebenzi, wathi usafuna ukuqale akhulumisane nabo.Kwenzeka lokhu nje ngeledlule uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, evula iPhalamende, uthe uhulumeni kazwelonke kumele ulekelele omasipala. Ubalule noMasipala waseThekwini athe kumele kusetshenzwe ubuyiselwe esimeni esihle owawukusona kudala.Lo masipala usanda kukhomba indlela obeyimeya yawo, uMnuz Mxolisi Kaunda, isikhala savalwa nguMnuz Cyril Xaba.Njengamanje kunezinhlelo zikahulumeni wesifundazwe nokazwelonke zokuwukulekelela ukuze ukwazi ukusebenza ngendlela efanele.
SESENYUKELE kwabayisikhombisa isibalo sabadlule emhlabeni belekelela ukucima umlilo wamadlelo, okwenzeke eMpophomeni kuMasipala Umngeni, emasontweni amabili adlule.UMnuz Vusi Dlamini ongomunye wabebelimele kanzima ngesikhathi bezama ukubhula umlilo, kuthiwa udlule emhlabenii ngoLwesihlanu emva kokuthi esehlale isikhathi esingangesonto egunjini labalimele kakhulu, eshe kanzima.Ilungu lomphakathi elicele ukuthi igama lalo ligodlwe, lithe izindaba zokudlula emhlabeni kukaDlamini zifinyelele kubona besemngcwabeni kazakwabo naye oshone kule ngozi."Ubewuntu olungile, ezithulela futhi ethanda umndeni wakhe. Ubesesebenzele inkampani kasonkontileka iFarmusa iminyaka eminingi ngokumazi kwami, kanti ngendlela ayelimele ngayo ngokuzwa kwethu, bekukubi kakhulu,” usho kanje.Ukudlula emhlabeni kukaDlamini kwenze safinyelela kwabawu-15 isibalo sabafe ezigamekweni zomlilo obonakale kulesi sifundazwe emasontweni adlule, kubalwa noNksz Nomthandazo Dawodi (30) obezithwele, oshone kungqongqa inqwaba yemijondolo eKenville, eThekwini emasontweni amabili adlule.Kuthiwa abayisithupha abashone becima umlilo abasebenzela usonkontileka elekelela inkampani i-Sappi ngomsebenzi wamahlathi, iFarmusa Agric and Forestry, okungoNksz Ntombikhona Nxele, Nonsikelelo Zuma, Khethiwe Ngcobo, Ntombifuthi Ngcobo, Mabongi Shishane noMnuz Vusi Radula bafihlwe ngempelasonto, kanti uDlamini angase afihlwe kuleli sonto.Imizamo yokuthola abomndeni wakhe ayiphumelelanga njengoba izingcingo ezedluliselwe entathelini bezivaliwe kwaze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela.I-Farmusa kuthiwa idlulisele emindenini yabalahlekelwe usizo ngokubambisana nenkampani yakwa-Sappi, umasipala neminyango kahulumeni.Ngesikhathi evakashele kule ndawo ngesonto eledlule, uNgqongqoshe wokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa, uthe kusanemininingwane esalinde ukuhlanganiswa nombiko mayelana nezigameko zomlilo wequbula ohlasele izingxenye zesifundazwe, okuzoba wumkhombandlela ekutheni umengameli uyasimemezela yini njengenhlekelele lesi simo esehlele umphakathi ezindaweni ezithintekile. Kuthiwa ulinganiselwa ku-R90 million umonakalo odalwe yilesi simo.
IPHINI likaNobhala Jikelele we-ANC, uNkk Nomvula Mokonyane, lichithe amahlebezi okuthi ubuholi benhlangano KwaZulu-Natal bulengelwa izembe.UNkk Mokonyane uthe azikho izingxoxo zokuthi kuhlakazwe ubuholi be-ANC eKZN.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ehambele umhlangano wesigungu esiphezulu esifundazweni ngempelasonto.I-ANC ayizange yenze kahle KwaZulu-Natal okhethweni lwangoMeyi njengoba yaphunyukwa isifundazwe, manje isiyiqembu lesithathu ngobukhulu.UNkk Mokonyane uthe ukungenzi kahle kwe-ANC KwaZulu-Natal akusho ukuthi kufanele kuhlakazwe ubuholi."Kungaba iphutha ukuthi emva kokhetho bese sigijimela ukuhlakaza ubuholi. Kufanele ubuke ukuthi unani, ubheke izindlela zokwenza ngcono lokho onakho. Kufanele uqhamuke namasu okubuyisa lokho okukulahlekele. "Kufanele uqhamuke namasu okugqugquzela uphinde uthuthukise labo abakhona ukuze bezokwenza ngcono ngokuzayo. Indaba yokuthi ubuholi buzohlakazwa amahemuhemu nje futhi ngingakutshela ukuthi ngaphakathi kwi-ANC azikho izingxoxo ezinjalo.”Uhambo lukaNkk Mokonyane laKwaZulu-Natal luqale ngoMgqibelo, lapho ehlangane khona nobuholi besifunda iTheku.Nabo ubuholi besifunda bubhekene nezembe njengoba ikomiti elibhekelele ukusebenza kwansuku zonke kwi-ANC KwaZulu-Natal lenza isiphakamiso sokuthi buhlakazwe.Isigungu esiphezulu kwi-ANC KwaZulu-Natal isona esizothatha isinqumo sokugcina ngalolu daba.Echaza ngenjongo yohambo lwakhe, uNkk Mokonyane, uthe bahamba behlaziya imiphumela yokhetho."Sihamba sibheka ukuthi izinhlakaza zeqembu zalukhankasela kanjani ukhetho. Sihamba sibheka ukuthi umyalezo we-ANC wafinyelela kanjani kubantu. Sifuna ukuqhamuka nezindlela zokuya phambili njengoba sisembhidlangweni wokwakha i-ANC kabusha.”Ukuqhamuka kweqembu eliholwa owayengumengameli, uJacob Zuma, iMK, kwayilimaza i-ANC KwaZulu-Natal.I-MK iyona eyathola amavoti amaningi kulesi sifundazwe.UNkk Mokonyane uthe amalungu e-ANC kufanele angaqheli kubantu uma efuna ukubuyisa amavoti awalahlekele okhethweni olwedlule."Kufanele singaqheli kubantu. Izinhlaka zeqembu kufanele zihlezi zisemphakathini. Kufanele le nto yokusondela emiphakathini singagcini nje ngokuyenza uma sekusondele ukhetho kodwa kufanele sihlezi siyenza. Kufanele sisebenze nezinhlaka ezahlukene emiphakathini. Kufanele onke amalungu e-ANC afundiswe ngepolitiki.”I-ANC izokuba nomhlangano wesigungu esiphezulu ozodonsa izinsuku eziyisithupha. Izinsuku ezintathu zibekelwe ukuxoxa ngemiphumela yokhetho.
KUTHELE izithelo ezinhle ukubambisana kwezinhlaka ezahlukene zezomthetho i-Asset Forfeiture Unit (AFU), uphiko lukazwelonke lwezokushushisa kanjalo nophiko oluphenya amacala ayisipesheli noKlebe kushaqwa imphahla yezigidi ezingu-R52.6 million ezikhulwini ezingu-22 zoMnyango wezemiSebenzi yoMphakathi eMpumalanga, nakumabhizinisi aphakela lo mnyango ngemisebenzi.Ukushaqwa kwale mpahla kuhambisana nomthetho wesiGaba 26 womthetho Wokuvimbela Ubugebengu Obuhleliwe, 121 ka-1998. Lokhu kumayelana nophenyo lweSIU ngezinkontileka zama-PPE ngesikhathi sokubheduke iCovid-19. Kubikwa ukuthi izikhulu zalo mnyango zakhipha amathenda ezigidi ukuze kutholakale amaPPE kodwa izinkampani ezanikezwa umsebenzi kazizange ziwenze, zakhetha ukukhokhela lezi zikhulu nemindeni yazo ngezindlela ezahlukene.Abasolwa abathintekayo abasebenzela lo mnyango nguMacDonald Sigudla, Dorries Mbatha, Bandile Ngcobo, Godisamang Molotsane, Kobus Mkhabela noSipho Monareng. Izinkampani nabanikazi bazo iMaganeleni Trading and Projects (Pty) Ltd, Anthony Maganeleng Mashigo, Gladness Gugu Bulunga, Thandolwam Transport and Projects (Pty) Ltd, Mbombela Integrated Waste Management Services (Pty) Ltd, Orapaleng Molotsane, Tsidi Susan Sedibe, Superia Services Trading CC, Whisky Delisa Khumalo, Makulaspan Construction (Pty) Ltd, Thabang Lebo Andiswa Dibakoane, Ntando Ms Trading (Pty) Ltd, Bongani Edward Lukhele, Ligabho Le'Africa Properties (Pty) Ltd, Oratile Molotsane no-Ezrom MolotsaneUphenyo lumbule ingubo ngobugebengu obuhlukene benkohlakalo, ukukhwabanisa, ukweba nokushushumbiswa kwemali okwenziwe yibo bonke laba basolwa. KUSHAQWE impahla yezigidi yezikhulu zoMnyango wezemiSebenzi yoMphakathi nezinkampani eziphakela lo mnyango ngemisebenzi njengoba kuqhubeka amacala enkohlakalo, ukweba nokushushumbisa kwemali eNkantolo eNkulu yaseMbombela isithombe: sithunyelweNgokuhambisana noMthetho wama-Special Investigating Unit ne-Special Tribunals Act 74 ka-1996 (uMthetho we-SIU), i-SIU idlulisele ubufakazi bobugebengu ku-NPA nakoKlebe ukuze kuqhutshekwe nophenyo, okuholele ekuboshweni kwezikhulu zomnyango nabahlinzeka ngemisebenzi.Imvume yokushaqwa kwempahla ikhishwe iNkantolo eNkulu yaseMpumalanga ezinze eMbombela, egunyaze ukushaqwa kwempahla ezindaweni ezingu-34 ezifundazweni iMpumalanga, North West, Western Cape naseGauteng.KUSHAQWE impahla yezigidi yezikhulu zoMnyango wezemiSebenzi yoMphakathi nezinkampani eziphakela lo mnyango ngemisebenzi njengoba kuqhubeka amacala enkohlakalo, ukweba nokushushumbisa kwemali eNkantolo eNkulu yaseMbombela isithombe: sithunyelweKule mpahla kukhona izakhiwo ezingu-2, izimoto ezingu-31, nesikebhe, impahla yaphakathi endlini, ubucwebe, izikhali, izihlamvu nemali. Kusukela ngoJulayi 23, abasolwa bavinjelwe ukusebenzisa amabhange abo, ukuthola imiholo, ukubhanga ngobuchwepheshe besimanje.
Induna yamabutho esondelene neSilo uMisuzulu kaZwelithini inxusa amabhungu asakhula ukuba avikele izaguga kubadlwenguli.UMnuz Muzi Nyandeni onguNobhala weziNduna zamabutho esifundeni iZululand, uthe kuwumsebenzi wamabutho ukuvikela izaguga nabesifazane.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma emcimbini wokudodisa amabhungu asakhula obuKwaNongoma, ngempelasonto.Lo mcimbi, oyingxenye yokugubha inyanga yamadoda, ubuhanjelwe abantu abangaphezu kuka-500.UNyandeni uthe izinsizwa akufanele zivumele abadlwenguli ukuthi bachanase ezweni lamakhosi."Kufanele nazi ukuthi lokhu angeke kwenzeke esigodini sakithi sikhona, sizosivikela isigodi sakithi. Asikuncomi ke ukuthi nihlale nihlale nixakazisa imikhonto, singakutholi ukuphumula. Kodwa esikushoyo ukuthi kuwumsebenzi wenu ukuvikela wonke umuntu esigodini sangakini."Akekho ugogo okuzothiwa udlwenguliwe esigodini nikhona. Ayikho ingane yentombazane okuzothiwa idlwenguliwe esigodini nikhona. Umsebenzi wenu ukuvikela isigodi sangakini njengoba kuwumsebenzi wezinsizwa zonke ukuvikela isifunda senkosi ezikhonze, noma oyise nonina abakhonze ngaphansi kwayo."UNyandeni uthe izinsizwa kufanele zilwe nabo bonke ubugebengu ezigodini ezihlala kuzo."Akufanele kube nomkhulu okuzothiwa ungenelwe abantu, bamphuca imali yempesheni."Omunye wabahleli bomcimbi, uNksz Mningi Zuma, uthe babona imicimbi yokudodisa amabhungu yenza umehluko.Le micimbi yaqalwa emva kwezigameko zokudlwengulwa kwezintombi zomhlanga.Inhlangano engenzi nzuzo, i-Ubuhle leZolo Lethu Youth Development, iba nemicimbi yanyanga zonke, bese kuba nomcimbi omkhulu wonyaka.Le micimbi yaqala ngonyaka owedlule, owokuqala wawusenqabeni yeNgonyama, KwaCeza."Yehlile imibiko yokudlwengulwa kwezingane ebesiyithola ngaphambilini. Le mibiko besiyithola cishe nyanga zonke.”UMntwana uBhekizizwe Zeblon Zulu ufundise abebehambele umcimbi amahubo nezaga.Kuphinde kwaba nezikhulumi ebeziqhamuka eMnyangweni wezeMfundo eziqhakambise imfundo.Amabhungu angene kulo mcimbi ngoLwesihlanu ebusuku, aphuma ngoMgqibelo ekuseni. Abe eseba nemashi edolobheni KwaNongoma.
Imindeni ikhala ngokudembesela kwamaphoyisa uma ebikelwa ngokuduka kwamantombazane asemancane.Lokhu kushiwo imindeni yamantombazane amabili aduke ezehlakalweni ezehlukene eThekwini, ngeledlule. UNOKUBONGA Ndimande (19) ohlala eGreenwood Park, oduke ngoMsombuluko odlule, kade eye kogilosa edolobheni eThekwini, ongakatholakali ISITHOMBE: SITHUNYELWE Umndeni kaNqobile Hlophe (13) ofunda uGrade 8 ePinetown Girls, oduke ephuma esikoleni ngoLwesihlanu, watholakala ngoMgqibelo eseshonile nokaNksz Nokubonga Ndimande (19) ohlala eGreenwood Park, oduke ngoMsombuluko odlule, ehambe ekhaya eya edolobheni eThekwini, osafunwa, ithi ukudembesela kwamaphoyisa kunikeza izigebengu ithuba lokwenza kahle ubugebengu. UMnuz Mbuso Dladla umalume kaNokubonga Ndimande, uthe amaphoyisa athe amantombazane amancane ngokujwayelekile asuke engadukile, asuke ezihlalele namasoka.UDladla uthe njengoba u Nokubonga wabikwa ngoLwesithathu, ukuthi udukile kodwa akekho umphenyi ophenya ngokulahleka kwakhe anikezwe yena esiteshini, iGreenwood Park. Amaphoyisa ngoLwesihlanu athe azoqala aphenye ngoba elokhu ebuya. " Angiwasoli amaphoyisa ngokucabanga kanjalo ngoba umshana wami naye bekwenzeka ahambe angabuyi aze abuye ngakusasa. Kulokhu sekuphele isonto nokuyinto angakaze ayenze," kusho uDladla.UMnuz Khetho Hlophe umalume kaNqobile, uthe bewumndeni bathe noma bezwa lokho abakutshelwa amaphoyisa, baphuma bazifunela ingane yabo."Ngisizwe ukuthi ngibuye ngibambe itoho ezimotweni ezikhokhelwa ngebanga ezilihambile. Ngifake isithombe ezinkundleni zezokuxhumana. Lolo lwazi luholele ekutheni sishayelwe ngumuntu othe uke wabona intombazane efake umfaniswano ofana nowakhe igijima ngasemgwaqweni ongenela emathuneni e-Ashley ntambama ngoLwesihlanu. Sifike kuleyo ndawo entathakusa ngoMgqibelo sathola isikhwama sakhe. Sase sishayela amaphoyisa asitshela ukuthi kunengane yesikole eshayiswe izimoto ngayizolo. Saya emakhazeni sathola ukuthi uyena," kusho yena.Uthe umufi ubelimele kakhulu. Umzimba udlavazekile kubonakala ukuthi ushayiswe yizimoto eziningi. Uthe amaphoyisa athe imoto yokuqala emshayisile ayimanga, kwalandela nezinye. Uqhube wathi umthetho wamahora angu-24 oshiwo ngamaphoyisa nezigebengu ziyawazi, okwenza ukuthi ziqhubeke kahle nobugebengu bazo, zazi ukuthi azikafunwa.Uthe basola ukuthi umshana wakhe uphunyulile kwabebemthumbile noma bese befikile lapho kade beya khona, kanti uzokwazi ukubaleka.UColonel Robert Netshiunda, okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uthe kuzo zombili izigameko zokulahleka kwabesifazane akukaboshwa muntu, wathi ngeke bazi noma ziyenyuka yini izigameko zokulahleka kwabo esifundazweni, njengoba lokhu kuvezwa izibalo ezikhishwa njalo ezinyangeni ezintathu. UNksz Nokwanda Gambushe weSonke Gender Justice, KwaZulu-Natal, uthe zibukeka zanda izigameko zokuthunjwa kwabantu besifazane, abanye babo batholwa bebulelwe."Cishe zonke izinsuku kuWhatsApp sibikelwa ngezingane zamantombazane adukile kwesinye isikhathi abanukubeziwe. Abanye ababe besatholakala," kusho uNksz Gambushe.Izibalo ze-Statistics SA ezikhishwe ngoMashi kulo nyaka, ziveza ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika ilele isikhombisa ngokuba nabantu abaningi abathunjiwe emhlabeni.Ngokwalezi zibalo bangaphezu kuka-16 000 abantu abathunjwayo kuleli njalo ngonyaka, kubo u-85% ngabesifazane nezingane.Ngokusho kukaNkk Bianca Van Aswegen we-Missing Children SA kwi-website yale nhlangano, uthi zingu-77% izingane ezitholakalayo uma zilahlekile, u-23% awutholakali, wathi ulwazi abaluthola emaphoyiseni luveza ukuthi njalo emizuzwini emihlanu kulahleka ingane kuleli.
UNobhala we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Bheki Mtolo, uzithintele ulaka lwenyunyana iNehawu esola amalungu ale nhlangano angahambisani nohulumeni wokubambisana ngokungafuni ukusebenza.INehawu isiyalele uMtolo ukuba axolise kumalungu ayo kungakapheli izinsuku ezimbili.Unobhala weNehawu KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Ayanda Zulu, uthe ngeke bamvumele uMtolo ukuthi akhulume emihlanganweni yeNehawu uma ehluleka ukuxolisa.UMtolo uzithintele ikhekhe leziqandu, ngesikhathi ekhwela edilika kumalungu eNehawu aphikisaba nohulumeni wokubambisana.UMtolo uthe isizathu esenza ukuthi amalungu eNehawu angafuni ukuthi i-ANC ibambisane neDA kuhulumeni wokubambisana wukuthi afuna ukuqhubeka nokuzenzela umathanda emsebenzini.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma emcimbini obungoMgqibelo abewenzele izaguga eKokstad.INehawu ingelinye lamadlelandawonye e-ANC angayizwa eyokufakwa kweDA kuhulumeni wokubambisana.Le nyunyana ibinomhlangano eGoli ngeledlule, lapho izikhulumi ezehlukene zigxeke ukufakwa kweDA kuhulumeni wokubambisana.UMtolo uthe amalungu eNehawu akhala ngokufakwa kweDA ngoba afuna ukuqhubeka nokuhudula izinyawo emsebenzini."Into ezondelwa i-ANC ukuthi kuqhubeke ukuthi kube nabasebenzi bakahulumeni ababheke izidingo zabo, abangazikhathalele izidingo zabantu. Bacabanga ukuthi kuzophela lokhu kukhohlakala kwabo uma kuphethe uhulumeni wokubambisana.”UMtolo uthe amalungu eNahawu agcwele eminyangweni kahulumeni ehlulekayo ukusiza abantu.Uthe amalungu eNahawu agcwele eMnyangweni wezaseKhaya, owezeMpilo nakowezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi."Uma ufika eMnyangweni wezaseKhaya uthi uzofuna isitifiketi sokushona, ufike unganakwa, okwazi ukuthi umuntu weNehawu lona ongakunaki. Uma ufika kwaSassa bafike baziqhenye ngawe, okwazi ukuthi abantu beNehawu labo. Uma nicasulwe ukuthi i-ambulance ayifikanga ngesikhathi, nazi ukuthi umuntu weNehawu lona ongazange asheshe.”UMtolo uthe abantu kufanele babaqaphele labo abathi abawufuni uhulumeni wokubambisana."Kufanele nimbheke kahle ukuthi lowo muntu akusiye yini lona owenze ukuthi kuhlehle umngcwabo ngenxa yokuthi unqabile ukukwenzela isitifiketi sokushona.”UZulu uthe kubashaqisile ukuzwa uMtolo ehlasela amalungu eNehawu.Uthe amalungu eNahawu asebenza ngokuzikhandla, wathi ngesikhathi kuhlasele i-corona amalungu enyunyana abeka impilo yawo engcupheni."I-ANC kufanele iyicubungule kahle le nto eshiwo uMtolo. Ngabe uchaze ukuthi uhulumeni wokubambisana uzokwenza kangcono kunalokhu okwenziwe i-ANC kule minyaka engu-30 eyedlule?”UZulu uthe uMtolo kufanele azinuke amakhwapha ngokuhlulwa kwe-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, wathi i-ANC isazophinde idinge amalungu eNehawu uma isikhankasela ukhetho lohulumeni basekhaya oluzayo.UZulu unxuse ubuholi be-ANC KwaZulu-Natal ukuba bukhuze uMtolo.
Umhlaziyi wezepolitiki uthe maningi amathuba okuthi uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, akhishwe singakapheli isikhathi sakhe njengoba kwenzeka kwababengaphambi kwakhe.Uvele usuqalile umjaho wezikhundla kwi-ANC, le nhlangano izoba nengqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi ngo-2027.Umhlaziyi wezepolitiki oseNyuvesi yaKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Siyabonga Ntombela, uthe maningi amathuba okuthi uRamaphosa kuthiwe akashenxe kwesokuba umengameli wezwe emva kwengqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi be-ANC.URamaphosa ube nomlando omubi njengoba ebe umengameli wokuqala kwi-ANC ukuba ahluleke ukunqoba ukhetho ngamalengiso.I-ANC isiphethe ngokubambisana namanye amaqembu.UNtombela uthe uma i-ANC ingakhetha abaholi abangahambisani nohulumeni wokubambisana lokho kungabeka engcupheni amathuba kaRamaphosa okuqeda ihlandla lesibili."Uma nje kungakhethwa umuntu onjengoPanyaza Lesufi (usihlalo we-ANC eGauteng), kungasho ukuthi i-ANC izophuma kuhulumeni wokubambisana. ULesufi usekhombisile ukuthi akahambisani nohulumeni wokubambisana. Akazange ayifake iDA kwikhabhinethi yaseGauteng."Ngike ngamuzwa ethi uRamaphosa akasayine iBela Bill (umthetho wezemfundo obangwayo). Ubuholi obusha be-ANC bungazibuza ukuthi sikhona yini isidingo sokuthi uRamaphosa aqhubeke njengoba inhlangano ihluliwe okhethweni. Kukhona abangathi inqubekela phambili abayiboni selokhu angena ngo-2018.”Akekho umengameli we-ANC osaphathe izwe kuze kuphele amahlandla amabili.Owayengumengameli wokuqala wombuso wentando yabantu, uNelson Mandela, wathi khumu emva kokuphatha ihlandla elilodwa.Owalandela emva kwakhe, uMnuz Thabo Mbeki, wehliswa esikhundleni kusele izinyanga aqede ihlandla lesibili.UJacob Zuma wehliswa esikhundleni kusasele unyaka kuphele ihlandla lesibili.Bobabili uZuma noMbeki behliswa ezikhundleni emva kwezingqungquthela zokukhetha ubuholi be-ANC.UNtombela uthe kungenzeka ukuthi ubuholi obusha be-ANC bukhethe ukumdedela uRamaphosa aqedele ihlandla lesibili."Lokho bazobe bekwenzela ukuthi kube lula ukudlulisela izintambo kozongena. Uma i-ANC ikhetha umuntu ohambisana nohulumeni wokubambisana, bazomyeka uRamaphosa aqhubeke."Unobhala jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, ukhuze amalungu enhlangano aseqale umbango wezikhundla.UMbalula uthe amalungu e-ANC kufanele agxile ekulungiseni izinkinga eziholele ekutheni le nhlangano ihluleke ukuwina ukhetho ngamalengiso.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba, ngoMgqibelo."Ngingakusho ukuthi kukhona abantu asebeqalile ukukhuluma indaba yezikhundla. Abantu abafundi emaphutheni abo. Njengamanje sithole u-40% wamavoti okhethweni."Esikhundleni sokuthi abantu baqhamuke namaqhinga okubuyisela i-ANC endaweni yayo, abantu bakhuluma indaba yezikhundla. Abantu abakhohlwe indaba yezikhundla, ngeke isisize ngalutho."UMbalula uthe bazokhuluma kabanzi ngemiphumela yokhetho emhlanganweni wesigungu esiphezulu olandelayo.Umhlangano wesigungu esiphezulu olandelayo uzoba izinsuku eziyisithupha, izinsuku ezintathu zibekelwe ukuxoxa ngemiphumela yokhetho.
ISilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini sizogcoba iNkosi yaseMbongobongweni, uMzamo Buthelezi, ngoLwesihlanu.Umcimbi wokugcoba uButhelezi uzokuba seMbongombongweni.UMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal, oholwa uNdunankulu kaZulu, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, ukhiphe isimemo somcimbi.UMnyango uchaze umcimbi wangoLwesihlanu njengengqophamlando.UButhelezi uwuNgqongqoshe woMnyango weziSebenzi zikaHulumeni nokuPhatha, uphinde abe iPhini likaMengameli we-IFP.Ubaba omncane wenkosi, uBukhos'abuhawukelwa Buthelezi, uthe sebelala bengalele, njengoba kulungiselelwa usuku olukhulu."Lolu usuku oluyingqophamlando esizweni sakwaButhelezi. Kuzokwenzeka into engakaze yenzeke. Sibona sengathi kujabula ngisho imvelo. Ngingasho ukuthi amalungiselelo ahamba kahle ngakuthina.'UBukhos'abuhawukelwa uthe balindele ukuthi umcimbi uhanjelwe abantu abaqhamuka ezindaweni ezahlukene."Uma uzokhumbula kahle isizwe sakwaButhelezi sahlakazeka ngesikhathi sezimpi. Kukhona abasoPhongolo, abaseJozini, abaseMtuba nabaseDumbe. Ibo bonke labo bantu esibalindele ukuthi befike."UBukhos'abuhawukelwa uthe umcimbi wokugcotshwa kwenkosi kufanele engabe kade wenzeka kusaphethe iSilo uGoodwill Zwelithini kaBhekuzulu."Inkosi kade yahlonzwa, saze sageziswa izandla iSilo uMdlokombane. Ziningi izinto eziphazamisile njengakho ukuvela kobhubhane iCorona, umcimbi walokhu uhlehla. Siyathokoza ukuthi ekugcineni umcimbi uzogcina wenzekile."UBukhos'abuhawukelwa uthe kubajabulisile ukuqokwa kwenkosi kwiKhabhinethi likaMengameli, uCyril Ramaphosa."Lena into enkulu lapha esizweni sakithi ikakhulukazi ngoba inkosi yethu icoshe leli thuba, ikakhulukazi ngoba inkosi yethu iselula, ineminyaka engu-47."Njengoba umsebenzi wokuba ungqongqoshe udinga isikhathi esiningi, uBukhos'abuhawukelwa uthe uButhelezi ubengakacacisi ukuthi uzoqoka umuntu ozombambela ubukhosi noma uzozibambela.Umsunguli we-IFP, iNkosi Mangosuthu Buthelezi, wayebanjelwe ubukhosi ngenxa yokuba matasa ngezinto zepolitiki."Inkosi iyona ezonquma, kusekusha ukuba sengingaphawula ngalokho."Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kokhulumela iHhovisi leSilo, uMntwana uSimphiwe Zulu, ayizange iphumelele njengoba ucingo lwakhe belukhala lungabanjwa.UButhelezi waqokelwa kwesiPhini likaMengameli we-IFP ngo-2012.Kwakungokokuqala ukuba kube nalesi sikhundla kwi-IFP.Uke waba ilungu lesiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal, waba imeya yomasipala wesifunda iZululand, ngaphambi kokuthi abe ilungu lePhalamende. UButhelezi uchazwa njengenothando lokongiwa kwemvelo nokuthuthukiswa kwamabhizinisi amancane.
Usenze isibophezelo sokuthi bazosebenza ngokuzikhandla ngenhloso yokuthola ongqondongqondo betulo lokubanjwa kwenkunzi kwezimoto ezithwala imali, uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uGeneral uLieutenant Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi.Ubekade ebize isithangami sabezindaba ngoLwesihlanu, eThekwini, ukuzoveza kabanzi ngesimo samacala ehlukene nangesimo sezokuphepha esifundazweni.UMkhwanazi ukhuluma kanjena nje, seziphenduke insakavukela muva nje izigameko zokubanjwa kwenkunzi izimoto zemali.Uveze ukuthi kusuka ngo-Ephreli nonyaka kuze kube manje zingu-17 izigameko zokubanjwa kwezimoto ezithwala imali. Amaphoyisa akwaze ukuvimba ezinye izigameko ezinhlanu ezigcine. Uthe kuboshwe abasolwa abahlanu, abathathu kubo asebelahlwe ngamacala. Kudutshulwe kwabulawa abasolwa abangu-10 balezi zigameko ngesikhathi bedubulana namaphoyisa. Esigamekweni sakamuva kubikwa ukuthi kubanjwe imoto yemali KwaMadundube, KwaMaphumulo. Kulesi sigameko kuthiwa abasolwa babaleke nemali.Ziningi ezinye izigameko ezifuze lezi okuke kwabikwa ngazo ngaphambilini.Emgwaqweni uN2 ngaKwaMashu, abasolwa abane ababehamba ngezimoto ezahlukene bavulela ngenhlamvu bebhekise emotweni ethwala imali bagcina bebaleke nesamba semali engadalulwanga.Isigameko esifanayo senzekile naseKranskop emasontweni edlule, kwafa ujuqu abasolwa ababili ngesikhathi abasolwa ababandakanyekayo sebetholana phezulu namaphoyisa ePhoenix ngesikhathi bebaleka.Ngenyanga eyedlule, amaphoyisa adubule abasolwa abane ebebefunwa ngamacala okubamba inkunzi izimoto ezithwala imali eCamperdown. Abasolwa kuthiwa badubula kuqala amaphoyisa nawo aphendula ngenganono.EMnambithi, eMlazi naseThekwini kuke kwabikwa ngezigameko ezifanayo nakhona."Izigameko zokubanjwa kwenkunzi izimoto ezithwala imali ngezinye zezinto amaphoyisa azimisele ukuzinqoba,'' usho kanje.Phezu kwazo zonke lezi zigameko uMkhwanazi uthembise ukuthi bazokwenza konke okusemandleni ukuthola umnyombo wezigameko nanokuthi obani abangongqondongqondo bazo.Uthe uphenyo ngezigameko zabangakabanjwa abathinteka kulezi zigameko luyaqhubeka.Uthe okubuhlungu ukuthi namaphoyisa agcina esedubula ebese kuba khona abashonayo. "Amaphoyisa umsebenzi wawo ukubopha abasolwa ebese beyashushiswa uma betholakala benecala. Kodwa kwesinye isikhathi kuyawaphoqa ukuba nawo adubule,’’ echaza.
NKOSIKHONA CELEUMasipala waseNkosi Mtubatuba usuqale uhlelo lokuthi iziphathimandla zawo zihambele kuzo zonke izindawo okwenziwa kuzo imisebenzi kamasipala ngenhloso yokuqinisekisa ukuthi konke kuhamba kahle nomsebenzi uqedwa ngesikhathi.Lokhu kuvezwe yiMeya yawo, uMnuz Mxolisi Mthethwa ngesikhathi eqala umkhankaso wokuhambela izinhlelo ezehlukene zomphakathi owakhele lo masipala.UMthethwa uthe ukuze intuthuko isheshe ifike emphakathini, babone kubalulekile ukuthi basukume bangahlali emahhovisi, baye ngqo lapho kusetshenzwa khona. Ukholwa wukuthi lokhu kuzosiza nasekutheni kungabi nezinhlelo ezidonsa isikhathi eside ezingapheli.Ubehambisana neMenenja yakulo masipala, uMnuz Thamsanqa Xulu bahlola nokwakhiwa kwenkundla yezemidlalo eNkombose. Le nkundla izodla uR13 million."Sifuna ukuthi uma kunenkinga engaholela ekutheni umsebenzi uhambe ngonyawo lonwabu, sisheshe sazi. Ukuziyela mathupha kuyasiza ngoba sifike sithole umbiko ogcwele nathi sizobonele ngawethu, singatshelwa nje sihlezi emahhovisi,” kugcizelela imeya.Ithe kubajabulisile ukuthi ukwakhiwa kwale nkundla kuhamba kahle futhi kubukeka yonke into izophothulwa ngesikhathi esibekiwe.Ngaphandle kwalokhu, uMthethwa uthe uzibonele yena ukuthi ngempela amalungu omphakathi awatholile amathuba omsebenzi njengoba eyingxenye yokwakhiwa kwale nkundla.UNksz Nokukhanya Msane ongomunye wamalungu omphakathi othole umsebenzi ngokwakhiwa kwale nkundla uthe: "Izinhlelo zalolu hlobo zibuyisa ithemba emphakathini wakithi ngoba zifika namathuba emisebenzi,'' usho kanje.Imeya ithe kulokoza inhlansi yethemba ngokuthi le nkundla uma seyiphothuliwe izolekelela abantu abasha bangabi wuvanzi futhi bagweme nokungena ebugebengwini."Sinxusa umphakathi ukuthi usebenzisane nathi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amaphrojekthi esiwenzayo ayashesha ukuphothulwa. Lokho umphakathi ungakwenza ngokuthi uwavikele aze aphothulwe,'' kuchaza uMthethwa.Kuphinde kwahanjelwa nesakhiwo esizolekelela ukufukula ezokuvakasha kule ndawo, iTourism Centre.Lesi sakhiwo uma sesiphothuliwe kuthiwa ngaphakathi sizoba nendawo yokudayisa nendawo yokudla esezingeni eliphezulu. Bahambele naseZamimpilo Craft Market lapho okwaqubuka khona umlilo kwathi ababesebenza khona basala dengwane. Isinqumo sokubuyisa bonke abebexoshiwe ebandleni lamaNazaretha somholi, inkosi uMduduzi Shembe uNyazilwezulu, siletha ithemba ngozinzo kuleli bandla.Lokhu kwenzeka ngemva kokuthi uNyazilwezulu lumemezele eBuhleni, njengoba kunomhlangano kaJulayi ukuthi kube yiphutha ukuthi kuxoshwe abantu ebandleni, abanye okungaqulwanga ngisho amacala abo.Luveze ukuthi ukuxoshwa kwabantu ebandleni lamaNazaretha kufana nokubabulala ngoba kukhona abazalelwa kuleli bandla abangazicabangi bekwenye inkolo ngaphandle kweyobuNazaretha.ITHEMBA uNyzilwezulu lubyiswa abaxoshwa ebandleni Isithombe: Bongani MbathaPhakathi kwabantu abaxoshwa ebandleni kubalwa abefundisi okusanda kumenyezelwa ukuthi sebebuyiselwe futhi bayaqhubeka nemisebenzi yabo. Abanye yinhlalisuthi okusanda kumenyezelwa ukuthi ixoshiwe emva kophenyo okuthiwa kuvele ukuthi bekunamatulo amabi ebeliwabhekise kumholi uNyazilwezulu.Ngasekuqaleni koyaka kwaba nabafundisi ababuyiselwe ebandleni kade bexoshiwe, bafike abangamukelwa kahle ngoba kukhona abebengazimisele ngokubahlonipha njengabefundisi.ITHEMBA uNyazilwezulu lubuyisa abaxoshwa ebandleni Isithombe: Bongani MbathaKuwona lo nyaka kwavela nezindaba zokuthi inkosi yamaQadi, uMqoqi Ngcobo ike yathwala kanzima ibandla liye emhlanganweni eGoli. Kuthiwa yavinjwa ngabathile yaphuma ngesamagundane kukubi kwaze kwabakhona abashawayo.Kuzona zonke lezi zigameko nezinye ezenzeke phambilini, uNyazilwezulu belungakaze luzwakale luphawula ngazo.ITHEMBA uNyzilwezulu lubuyisa abaxoshwa ebandleni Isithombe: DOCTOR NGCOBO Ukuzwakala kwayo ikhuluma ngalezi zinto kubuyise ithemba kumaNazaretha njengoba iningi likholwa wukuthi udaba lulunga uma sekukhulume umholi.Isolezwe Ngempelasonto linenkulumo okuthiwa ibikhulunywa nguNyazilwezulu eBuhleni muva nje, lukhala ngokungazwani kwenhlalisuthi nokuyikho okuholela ekutheni kuxoshwe abantu ebandleni."Inkinga yenu anizwani lapha ebandleni. Umuntu uthi esathi ukhuza lokhu kuvumbuke okunye. Eqinisweni inhlalisuthi ayinalo ilungelo lokuxosha abefundisi. Uma kunenkinga ekhona kumele kuhlalwe phansi ilungiswe. Noma ngabe umuntu wonile akumele ukuthi avele axoshwe ebandleni lingaqulwanga icala lakhe. Noma ngabe liquliwe kodwa akumele abantu baxoshwe kalula kanjalo ebandleni. Kunabantu abazalwa bengamaNazaretha abangayazi enye inkolo, okusuke kungukubabulala uma ubaxosha ebandleni. Njengoba kungumhlangano kaJulayi, akekho umuntu oyiNazaretha ofisa ukuba sekhaya kodwa bonke bafisa ukuba yingxenye yalo mhlangano kaJulayi. Uma umxoshe ebandleni kusuke kufana nokuthi umbulele ngoba isuke ingekho enye into ayaziyo ngaphandle kobuNazaretha. Akazi nokuthi uzophila ngani ngaphandle kwenkolo yobuNazaretha,” inkulumo okuthiwa eyoNyazi.Kuyona lunxuse amakhosi nabafundisi ukuthi babambisane nalo ukwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi wonke umuntu obexoshiwe ubuyela ebandleni.Kuthiwa bonke abebexoshiwe ebandleni sebeqalile ukubonakala ebandleni. Okhulumela uNyazilwezulu, uMnuz Thokozani Mncwabe uthe ngeke ayiphinde inkulumo yenkosi uNyazilwezulu, ngoba kusuke sekukhulume owokugcina uma kukhulume lona."Osekumele sikwenze ukuthi siyoshweleza enkosini uNyazilwezulu nasemakhosini nakubefundisi. Siwathukile amakhosi nabefundisi neNkosi uNyazilwezulu ngendlela esiziphethe ngayo esontweni. Noma ngabe awubanga yingxenye yomhlangano okwathathwa kuwona isinqumo sokuthi kuxoshwe abantu kodwa uma uyiNazaretha nawe unesono. "Uma kumele kushwelezwe kusuke kudingeka wonke amaNazaretha abe yingxenye yokushweleza. Lokho kungumthetho wamaNazaretha okudingeka waziwe nangabantu abasanda kubhajadiswa ukuba ngamaNazaretha. Izinkinga ziqale ngokuthi kuthukwe amakhosi kukhulunywa izinto ezingenabufakazi kuthiwa akhombe inkosi ngezibhamu. Lelo chilo kumele ligezwe kuxoliswe nakubefundisi nasenkosini uNyazilwezulu,” kusho uMncwabe.Uthe nokungezwani kwenhlalisuthi akakholwa ukuthi yingoba ingezwani ngempela kodwa ukushayisana kwemibono okugcina sekuholele ekutheni kuxoshwe abantu esontweni.Uveze ukuthi lesi sinyathelo senkosi uNyazilwezulu singesibalulekile kakhulu futhi nesizokwenza kube nozinzo ebandleni. Uqhube wathi uma sekushweleziwe unxusa amaNazaretha ukuthi abuye ahlale phansi abe nokuthula akhonze uNkulunkulu, azoyibona imiphumela yokudumisa uShembe.Ibandla lamaNazaretha linamalungu alinganiselwa ku-7 million emhlabeni. Iningi lawo likwaZulu-Natal lapho kuzinze ikomkhulu lawo, ekuPhakameni.Isigodlo okuyisona esithathwa njengesikhulu njengamanje iseBuhleni, okuyindawo yebandla eyakhiwa ngumholi wesithathu wamaNazaretha inkosi u-Amos Kula Shembe Inyangayezulu. Inyangayezulu inguyise wenkosi uMbusi Vimbeni Shembe uThingolwenkosazana, oluzala inkosi ebusayo kumanje uMduduzi Shembe uNyazilwezulu.

AMAQEMBU abusa ngokubambisana athi azowapheka ngebhodwe elincane aze athi 'tshiyo tshiyo sengivuthiwe' amaqembu aphikisana nohulumeni wokubambisana oqale ngemuva kokhetho lukaMeyi 29 nonyaka.Amaqembu abusa ngokubambisana athe awakhohlwe amaqembu afungela uhulumeni wokubambisana ngokuthi ngeke uhlale isikhathi eside.Akusho lokhu ngesikhathi kunenkulumompikiswano ePhalamende, lapho bekuphikiswana ngenkulumo kaMengameli wezwe uCyril Ramaphosa.Amaqembu abusa ngokubambisana okubalwa i-ANC, DA, IFP nePA, athe azokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi uhulumeni wokubambisana awushabalali.Umholi weDA, uMnuz John Steenhuisen, uthe ngeke balunge abasongela uhulumeni wokubambisana. Uthe labo abagxeka uhulumeni wokubambisana yilabo abangafuni ukuthi izwe liye phambili."Sekunesikhathi eside sivumela abantu ukuba bacekele phansi izwe ukuze kuzuze bona, baphazamise ukukhula komnotho. Laba abafuna ukucekela phansi izwe ngeke balunge uma sihlangene.”USteenhuisen uthe ukubambisana kwabo akusho ukuthi bazohlala bevumelana ngaso sonke isikhathi.Umholi wePA, uMnuz Gayton Mckenzie, uthe bazosala bodwa labo abafungela uhulumeni wokubambisana."Isitimela siyahamba, asimile. Asibayeke laba basale kanje. Into eyenza ukuthi belokhu besisola ngokuthi sidayise ngabantu yingoba bona bagibele isitimela okungesona. Bengingabe ngidayise ngabantu ababengikhankasela ukube angizange ngingene kuhulumeni wokubambisana.”Umholi we-IFP, uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa, uthe bazimisele ukuletha uzinzo kuhulumeni wokubambisana."Abantu ngesikhathi bevota bathi bafuna ukuthi amaqembu abambisane. Kufanele senze isiqiniseko sokuthi uhulumeni wokubambisana uyasebenza.”UHlabisa uthe uhulumeni wokubambisana uzoshintsha izimpilo zabantu.Usotswebhu we-ANC ePhalamende, uMnuz Mdumiseni Ntuli, uthe bazimisele ngokusebenzisana nawo wonke amaqembu anezihlalo ePhalamende.Umholi weMK ePhalamende, uDkt John Hlophe, uthe uhulumeni wokubambisana wakhiwe abantu abathanda izikhundla. Uthe ukuba lamaqembu aphethe ngokubambisana awazithandi izikhundla abezoyidedela iMK, iphathe KwaZulu-Natal."Angithi kuthiwa i-ANC iyona okufanele ihole uhulumeni kazwelonke ngoba iyona eyathola amavoti amaningi, pho kungani iMK ingayekwanga iphathe KwaZulu-Natal? IMK iyona eyawina KwaZulu-Natal.”UHlophe uthe iDA iyona eshaya amaphiko kuhulumeni wokubambisana. Uthe abaguquki ekufuneni ukuthi kuthathwe umhlaba ngaphandle kwesinxephezelo.Umholi we-EFF, uMnuz Julius Malema, uthe kubajabulisile ukubona i-ANC ihluleka ukunqoba ukhetho ngamalengiso.UMalema usole uRamaphosa ngokuphinda izinto azisho enkulumweni ayethula ngoFebhuwari."Ulenza kanjani lelo phutha? Le nkulumo iyona eyenza ukuthi nilahlekelwe okhethweni. Kusho ukuthi awufundanga lutho.”URamaphosa uzophendula ngoMsombuluko.
Umhlaziyi wezepolitiki uthi kusekuncane lokhu kuxabana kwamaqembu abusa ngokubambisana KwaZulu-Natal kududulana owe-ANC nowe-IFP.UMnuz Zakhele Ndlovu waseNyuvesi yaKwaZulu-Natal, uthe asazoxabana kakhulu amaqembu aphethe ngokubambisana esifundazweni.Ubekusho lokhu emva kokujikijelana ngamazwi kukaNobhala we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Bheki Mtolo, noMphathiswa wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu oyilungu le-IFP, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi.Ingxabano yabo iqalwe nguMtolo, osole uButhelezi ngokuzenzela umathanda komasipala.Esitatimendeni, uMtolo uthe uButhelezi uhamba eshintsha abalawuli nezimenenja zomasipala ngaphandle kokulandela imigomo.Abalawuli abashintshiwe kusukela kungene uButhelezi bakoMasipala Inkosi Mtubatuba, uMkhanyakude nasoThukela.UMtolo uthe ukuziphatha kukaButhelezi kubeka engcupheni ukusebenza kukahulumeni wokubambisana."Angeke sivume ukuthi uButhelezi azenzele umathanda. Selokhu akhethwa, uzibona emkhulu ukunohulumeni wokubambisana. Ngifuna ukumkhumbuza ukuthi alikho iqembu elanqoba ngamalengiso KwaZulu-Natal. Wonke amaqembu kufanele asebenze ngokubambisana.”Nokho uButhelezi uthe angeke ezwe ngoMtolo."UMtolo kufanele akhumbule ukuthi i-ANC yaphuma emandleni ngoMeyi 29. Akangadidwa ukuthi kunohulumeni wokubambisana bese ezitshela ukuthi kusaphethe i-ANC. Ziphelile izinsuku lapho uMtolo ezotshela khona umphathiswa nezikhulu zomnyango ukuthi akwenziweni. Mina ngakhethwa undunankulu.”UButhelezi uthe kunenkohlakalo eningi ebiyenzeka emnyangweni ngaphambi kokuthi afike, wathi bazoqala uphenyo athe lungase luholele ekutheni kube khona ababoshwayo.Akukapheli ngisho izinyanga ezimbili uhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal wokubambisana waqokwa njengoba sekuqala uqhekeko.I-IFP ne-ANC iwona maqembu amakhulu kuhulumeni wokubambisana, iwona aphethe izikhundla eziningi.UNdlovu uthe akuthusi ukudonsisana kukaMtolo noButhelezi."Iqiniso ukuthi la maqembu awazange azikhethele ukusebenzisana, aphoqwa imiphumela yokhetho. La maqembu azosebenzisa izikhundla abelwa zona ukukhankasela ukhetho lohulumeni basekhaya oluzayo."UButhelezi uzofuna ukusebenzisa umnyango awunikiwe ukuveza inkohlakalo komasipala. Uzofuna ukuveza i-ANC njengeqembu elikhohlakele. Uzofuna ukuthi i-IFP ibonakale njengeqembu elisebenzayo.”UNdlovu uthe kuningi okusazoqhatha amaqembu, kodwa wathi akaboni umshado wawo uzoshabalala."Basazoqhubeka nokumbulana izinqe kodwa bazohlala ndawonye ngoba bayazi ukuthi kungonakala okuningi uma bangahlukana. Ukuhlukana kwabo KwaZulu-Natal kungachaphazela uhulumeni kazwelonke njengoba nakhona bebambisene. Ngakho ke ngicabanga ukuthi abaholi bakazwelonke angeke bayivume leyo nto.”
UMFELANDAWONYE wezinyunyana, iSouth African Federation of Trade Unions (Saftu), ithi iBhange loMbuso kufanele liyehlise manje imalimboleko ngoba abasebenzi abasakwazi ukukhokhela izidingo zabo.UMnuz Trevor Shaku okhulumela iSaftu, usho lokhu ngoLwesine emuva kokuthi umphathi weSouth African Reserve Bank (Sarb), uMnuz Lesetja Kganyago eyigcine ku-8.25% imali mboleko.Okusho ukuthi inzalo ekhokhwa ngabantu uma beboleke imali emabhange izohlala ku-11.75%.UKganyago uthe okwamanje imalimboleko isazohlala kulesi sigaba ekuso ngenxa yokuthi amandla emali asahleli ku-5.2%. ISarb ifuna abe ku-4.5% ngaphambi kokwehlisa imalimboleko."Amalungu amane ekomiti avotele ukuthi imalimboleko ihlale ku-8.25% kodwa amabili aphakamise ukuthi yehle. Sizobheka okwenzeka emandleni emali, emnothweni nakwamanye amazwe ngaphambi kokuthi sinyakazise imalimboleko. Kuhle ukuthi ugesi awusacimi njalo kodwa umnotho siwubona ukhula ngo-0.6% ngekota yesibili yalo nyaka,” kusho uKgangayo.UShaku uthe sekuyisikhathi sokuthi iSarb yehlise imalimboleko ngoba abasebenzi bakhokha inzalo eningi ezikweletini zabo. Uthe umuntu onomuzi obiza uR1.3 million usekhokha inzalo ewu-R4.247 manje ngenxa yemalimboleko engehli."UKganyago uhlale ethi usiza abantu ngokungehlisi imalimboleko kodwa iqiniso wukuthi usiza abacebile ngoba yibona abakwazi ukonga njengoba isimo sinjena. Abasebenzi abakwazi ukonga, sebephila ngezikweletu ukuze bakwazi ukudla nokwenza ezinye izidingo,” kusho uShaku.UMnuz Mervyn Abrahams wePietermaritzburg Economic Justice & Dignity Group, uthe iBhange loMbuso alibacabangeli abampofu nabasebenzi ngoba ukuntenga kwamandla emali akusilo iphutha labo kodwa kungenxa yezimo abangakwazi ukuzilawula.Uthe abampofu nabasebenzi bathwele kanzima ngoba kubiza yonke into eNingizimu Afrika.Uphethe ngokuthi bazoqhubeka nokubhalela izinhlaka ezifanele bacele ukuthi kwehliswe imali mboleko.Izazi zomnotho oSolwazi Bonke Dumisa noMnuz Siphamandla Mkhwanazi wakwaFNB, zithe akukho okuzimangazayo ngesinqumo sikaKganyago ngoba vele iSarb ayinyakazi uma amandla emali engekho esilinganisweni sayo sika-3% no-6%.
UNobhala Jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, ubona ukudideka kumholi we-MK Party, uJacob Zuma.UMbalula uthe uZuma akazi nokuthi kufanele ezisebenzise kanjani izihlalo ezitholwe yiMK okhethweni lwangoMeyi.Ukusho lokhu ngoMgqibelo ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba, lapho ebezophawula khona ngenkulumo yokuvula iPhalamende eyethulwe uMengameli uCyril Ramaphosa.UMbalula uthe okukhombisa ukuthi uZuma udidekile ngempela ukuthi uvele waqoka owachithwa ekubeni yijaji, uDkt John Hlophe, ukuba ahole iMK ePhalamende."Lokhu kukhombisa ngokusobala ukuthi uZuma akabahloniphi abantu abavotayo. Kubo bonke abantu abengabaqoka uvele wakhetha uHlophe. Awucabange nje.”UMbalula uthe uHlophe ugcwele intukuthelo."Ingakho nangesikhathi ethola ithuba lokukhuluma ePhalamende evele wangakhuluma ngenkulumo kaRamaphosa. Uvele wazikhulumela into ethandwa uyena.”UZuma ubekhona ePhalamende ngesikhathi kunenkulumompikiswano ngoLwesihlanu.Ngesikhathi kuqhubeka inkulumo mpikiswano amalungu eMK abelokhu ekhalaza ngokuthi abebephethe umhlangano abafuni ukumemezela ukuthi uZuma ukhona ePhalamende.UMbalula uthe nakho lokhu kuyizinkomba zokuthi nawo amalungu eMK azididekele.
Amaqembu angeyona ingxenye kahulumeni wobumbano, asebekele umshado wamaqembu abambisene kulo hulumeni isikhathi esingangonyaka noma emibili ngaphambi kokugqabuka kwegoda.La maqembu okuyiMK, EFF, ATM, NCC ne-UAT, aveze ukuthi uma kuke kwakhishwa uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, ezintanjeni zokuhola i-ANC, umshado uyophela.NgoLwesine, esithangamini sabezindaba ePhalamende abaholi balawa maqembu bathule ikhokhasi njengoba bezobe bephikisa ePhalamende.Umholi weMK ePhalamende, uDkt John Hlophe, uveze ukuthi akaboni umshado we-ANC, DA, IFP, PA namanye amaqembu kuzophela ihlandla lalo hulumeni usekhona.Uthe ziningi kakhulu izinto ahluke ngazo uma kuziwa emigomeni."Kungaba umlingo uma kungase kuphele iminyaka emibili usekhona lo mshado kuhulumeni. Yinto ezophela njengomlilo wamaphepha.” Nomholi we-EFF, uMnuz Julius Malema, uphefumule okufananyo noHlophe, wathi ingase ongapheli iminyaka emibili usekhona lo mshado we-ANC."I-DA yathi izosebenzisana ne-ANC ngenxa kaRamaphosa. Nakanjani uRamaphosa uzophuma engqungqutheleni ye-ANC ngenxa yokuthi le nhlangano ayiyivumi eyehlandla lesithathu.”Kulindeleke ukuthi ihlale eminyakeni emibili ezayo ingqungquthela ye-ANC kuzwelonke okuyokhethwa ubuholi obusha kuyona.Kuningi ukukhuluma kuleli ngeyalo mshado nokuthi ngabe uzohlala isikhathi esingakanani. UMalema noHlophe babize abaholi be-UDM ne-PAC ngabadayisi abathanda izikhundla kuhulumeni ngokuba yingxenye yomshado.UHlophe uthe njengoba bebethula le khokhasi banezihlalo ezingu-102 abazolwa ngazo ukuphucula impilo yabantu.Uveze ukuthi bazofaka iziphakamiso ePhalamende zokuthi kuqashwe ngokugcwele abasebenzi abafana nonogada, ukusulwa kwezikweletu zezitshudeni, ukunikezwa kwezingane zamantombazane amaqakelo amahhala kanjalo nokuvusa indaba yokuthi kukhishwe ngevoti lokungamthembi uRamaphosa ngodaba lwasepulazini lwakhe iPhala Phala, lapho kwatholakala khona imali ithukusiwe."Sifuna ivuswe eyokuthathwa komhlaba ngaphandle kwesinxephezelo, ukufakwa ngaphansi kukahulumeni kweBhange loMbuso, ukuchithwa kwayo yonke imithetho yobandlululo nezinye izinto ezithinta umphakathi. Sinethemba ukuthi sizokutholwa ukwesekwa emkhankasweni esizoyenza njengekhokhasi yamaqembu ahlukene.”Odabeni lokuvumbuka kabusha kwezithinta indaba yokudliwa kwemali ebhange iVBS okufaka nabaholi be-EFF, uMalema uthe wudaba oludala lolu nesahluko salo sesavalwa."Abasisabisa ngokuthi bazosibopha ngokuvusa indaba yeVBS, abakwenze, asibasabi. Akukho okusha okuthinta le ndaba. Ukuthula kwethu akusho ukuthi ingoba singazi ukuthi sizophendula sithini, ingoba sikhathele ukuphendula into engathi shu. Akekho ozosisabisa ngokuthi asivale umlomo ngokuthi avuse indaba yeVBS,” kusho uMalema.
OBENGUMMANGALELWA usukume waphaphatheka, engakholwa ngesikhathi inkantolo imkhipha phambili ecaleni eselidonse iminyaka emine lokuthumba nelokubulala ngesihluku u-Andile "Bobo” Mbuthu (16).UMnuz Siyanda Msweli kuthiwe akagoduke ngoba buntekenteke ubufakazi obebumyamanisa namacala.Usukume waphaphatheka wayoma emnyango nakhona esamangele eme yedwa walinda kwaze kwaphothulwa icala.Ozakwabo o-Andile Nhleko, Mncedisi Mzobe, Lindani Ndlovu noMalusi Mthembu libagojele, balale bebaliwe.Bancishwe nokuthi yelulwe ibheyili yabo, bayalelwa ukuthi babuye eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseVerulam, ngo-Agasti 27.Ngalolu suku kuyokwamukelwa imibiko yosonhlalakahle ngempilo yalawa madoda nomndeni kamufi.Kuyophinde kube nesigcawu sobengummangalelwa owaphenduka ufakazi woMbuso lapho ezobe ezicelela intethelelo nokuthi kungani kungamele yena ashushiswe.Imantshi uSanele Hlatshwayo ithe lawa madoda enza isihluku futhi uma ewadedela ngebheyili angase abaleke unomphela.UBobo washaywa yilawa madoda wafa ngo-Ephreli 20, 2020, esolwa ngokuthi weba utshwala endaweni yobumnandi eMagagula Lounge eHambanathi, oThongathi. Le ndawo yangqongqiswa ngomlilo wumphakathi uveva intukuthelo.Ujabule unina kaBobo, uNksz Gugulethu Mbuthu, elahlwa ngecala lawa madoda.Yena nomndeni wakhe nabebandla abebezomeseka baphume enkantolo bacula bebonga uMdali.UNksz Mbuthu uthe yize ingeke isavuka indodana yakhe kodwa uyabonga ngokuthi ligcine libagojele abamangalelwa."Ngase ngithembele kuyona ukuthi izoqeda u-matric ingondle kwazise ngangiwa ngivuka nayo kodwa babona kungcono bayithathe impilo yayo,” kusho UNks Mbuthu.Lo mndeni ufuna badilikelwe yijele ababulali bakaBobo.UBobo washaywa usuku lonke wafa, isidumbu sakhe kwayiwa naso eBhamshela lapho sabaselwa nezinkuni emphongolweni ubusuku bonke.Ngakusasa ekuseni izinsalela zaso zahlakazwa ngepiki zafakwa ezikhwameni nezitini ukuze zizike zaphonswa edamini.Zatholakala emuva kwezinsukwana kwenziwa ulibofizo nonina, imiphumela yaqinisekisa ukuthi kwakungezikaBobo. Umnikazi weMagagula Lounge naye owayeboshiwe kuleli cala wadutshulwa wabulawa kwesinye isigameko engaphandle ngebheyili ngecala likaBobo.
Kusinde ngokulambisa umshayeli weVW Polo odutshulwe ngoyaba lwezinhlamvu eVerulam, eThekwini, ngoLwesihlanu ntambama.Lesi sigameko kuthiwa senzeke emgwaqweni uWick Street.NgokweReaction Unit South Africa (Rusa), le nkampani ithole inqwaba yezingcingo kosomabhizinisi nabahamba ngezinyawo bekhala ngokuduma kwezulu lezandla."Onogada bathunyelwe ngabo-6.14 ntambama nokuthe uma befika bathola indoda ihleli esihlalweni somshayeli kwiVW Polo e-silver. Ubetshulwe amahlandla amaningi kwesingenhla emzimbeni nasekubusweni. Unogada udubuleke ethangeni yinhlamvu ebindiza emoyeni,” kusho iRusa esitatimendeni.Isitatimende sithe abezimo eziphuthumayo bakwaRusa nakwaKZN VIP basize laba ababili ngaphambi kokubaphuthumisa esibhedlela.Sithe kutholakale inqwaba yamagobolondo esibhamu i-9mm nawesibhamu esikhulu endaweni yesigameko. Bekukhona neVW Polo emhlophe ebishiywe ngaphambi kwemoto yowesilisa olimale kanzima. Iwindi lePolo emhlophe nalo belidubulekile."Akukaqinisekiswa ukuthi imoto ishiywe ngabasolwa yini. Imbangela yokuhlasela ayikaziwa.”
Ibekwe eqhulwini eyokuqeda inkemane, ukwakha amathuba emisebenzi, ukufukula umnotho nokwakha uzinzo kuhulumeni nakomasipala.Lokhu kuvezwe nguMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ngoLwesine ePhalamende ngesikhathi enekela isizwe umkhombandlela wezinto ezizokwenziwa nguhulumeni wobumbano, kule minyaka emihlanu ezayo.Nakuba ezinye zezinto eseke wazisho phambilini kodwa uveze ukuthi kulokhu kuzobekwa umnqamulajuqu wokuthi zenzeka ngokushesha ngoba abantu bakhathele ukulinda. "Abantu bafuna imisebenzi, ukwenza lokho kumele sikhulise umnotho. Umnotho sizowukhulisa ngokuthi silungise omasipala bethu. Ziqalile izinhlelo zokubalungisa ikakhulu labo abakhulu abangamaMetro, njengaseThekwini lapho sijube khona ithimba elilungisa izinto. Sifuna iTheku libuyelwe isithunzi elalinaso ngoba akumele idolobha elikhulu kangaka libe esimeni elikuso manje,” kusho uRamaphosa.Uthe komasipala kumele kufakwe abantu abazi umsebenzi, kulungiswe ingqalasizinda nezinkinga ezithinta amanzi nokuthuthwa kwendle.Uveze ukuthi bazogxila nasekubhekeni ukudla okungeke kusafakwa intela ukuze baqede indlala."Indaba yokubiza kukaphethroli yinto esizoyibheka ukuze abantu bangashayeki kakhulu ephaketheni. Sizoxoxa njengohulumeni wobumbano sibheke ukuthi ikuphi ukudla okumele kungafakwa intela ukuze kwehle inkinga yobubha.” Ubalule nendaba yemisebenzi wathi bafuna abatshali bezimali bafake imali futhi benza nemizamo yokuthi behlise imali ekhokhelwa isikweletu sezwe."Sakhe amathuba emisebenzi eyevile ku-2 million, ohlelweni lukamengameli lokuzama ukulwa nalesi sihlava. Izikole ezingu-25 000 zihlomule ngabasizi bothisha. Uma sibambisene sizosiqeda isihlava sokungasebenzi,” kusho uRamaphosa.Ubalule nokuthi bazobiza umhlangano ozohlanganisa zonke izinhlaka, nabantu bakuleli kubhungwe ngezinto ezithinta izwe.URamaphosa wehlise amaphaphu kwabacabanga ukuthi kuzogqabuka igoda phakathi kwamaqembu abambisene kuhulumeni."Singamaqembu angu-10 kuhulumeni wokubambisana. Kumnandi ukuxoxa nabaholi bala maqembu. Awuyi ndawo lo hulumeni. Sinezinto esingaboni ngaso linye kuzona, kodwa kweziningi zazo sibona ngeso elilodwa. Kudingeka ukuthi sisebenzisane,” kusho uRamaphosa.Uthe basazohlangana neKhabhinethi bakhe izinhlelo ezizohambisana nesabelomali sezwe."Sizoqhubeka sivikele abasebenzi, senze izimo zokusebenza zibe sesimeni. Sizoqhubeka nezinhlelo zokuvikela imigomo ethinta ukuthuthukiswa kosomabhizinisi abamnyama. Sizobaseka osomabhizinisi abancane ukuze bakhe amathuba emisebenzi.” Uthe bayaqhubeka neyomshwalense wezempilo iNational Health Insurance, bakhe amagumbi okufundela ezikoleni, baqeqeshe abahlengikazi, baqinise emkhakheni we-ECD kwezemfundo, baphinde balungise inkinga yamanzi."Sifuna izwe likwazi ukuzikhiqizela izinto. Asifuni ukuthi kube nezinto ezizoyiswa kwamanye amazwe zibuye sezibiza kakhulu uma sezibuya kula mazwe.”Uthe bafuna sigcine sesiholwa unomphela isibonelelo sabangatohozi.Uveze ukuthi ufuna izwe liphenduke inkundla yokwakha kudume imishini kuphuculwe ingqalasizinda emikhakheni ehlukene okubalwa ezolimo neminye.
INHLANGANO egqugquzela ukuba kuthengwe imikhiqizo eyenziwe kuleli iProudlySA, idonse ngendlebe amalungu ePhalamende ukuba agqoke umswenko owenziwe ekhaya.IProudlySA ibinenkundla yokucobelela ngolwazi ePhalamende. Nakukhaphethi obomvu amalungu ePhalamende abekhuluma nomethuli wezinhlelo uThami Dish amchazele ukuthi agqokiswe wobani.AbeProudlySA bathe kubalulekile ukuthi wonke umuntu agqoke impahla eyenziwe kuleli ukuze kuzodaleka amathuba omsebenzi. Amalungu ePhalamende esilisa ebegqoke imibala ezothile kanti awesifazane ebegqame ngemibala ehlukene.UNgqongqoshe wamaBhizinisi Amancane, uNkk Stella Ndabeni-Abrahams, uthe kubalulekile ukuthenga yonke imikhiqizo eyenziwe kuleli nokuseka amabhizinisi amancane.Ubalule ukuthi amabhizinisi amancane adala amathuba omsebenzi amaningi ezweni.UMUZ Mzwandile Masina we-ANC nenkosikazi yakhe uNkk Sinazo Masina obegqoke igubo enombala wegolide Isithombe: ANC Parliament USOTSWEBHU we-ANC ePhalamende uMnuz Mdumiseni Ntuli ubeziphihle ngesudi enombala ozothile Isithombe: ANC Parliament UNKSZ Nonceba Mhlauli oyiPhini likaNgqongqoshe ehhovisi likaMengameli ubehlobe ngengqubo eluhlaza, inamalivilivi amahle Isithombe: ANC Parliament IPHINI likaNgqongqoshe wezaseKhaya uMnuz Njabulo Nzuza belizicuphe ngesudi empunga nezicathulo ezisesitayeleni Isithombe: GCISUNGQONGQOSHE wezeMisebenzi uNkk Nomakhosazana Meth ubedle ingubo enemibala egqamile Isithombe: GCISIPHINI likaNgqongqoshe wemiSebenzi kaHulumeni neNgqalasizinda uMnuz Sihle Zikalala ugqanyiswe yinkosikazi yakhe uNkk Neli Zikala obemeshe kahle ngombala obomvu Isithombe: GCISUSOMLOMO wePhalamende, uNkk Thoko Didiza uthathwe lapha eqeda kwemukela iNhloko yamaJaji kuleli uJaji Raymond Zondo nowakhwakhe Isithombe: GCISUNKK Pemmy Majodina osenguNgqongqoshe waManzi neNhlanzeko ubegcwele amahlaya njengenjwayelo, lapha uthathwe emodelela izithatheli eziqhenya ngobuhle bombhaco wakhe Isithombe: Henk Kruger/Independent Media UDKT Gwen Ramokgopa ubemoyizela kanjena ehamba kukhaphethi obomvu Isithombe:Henk Kruger/Independent Newspapers ICIKO lakuleli elidume umhlaba wonke nemidwebo yalo yesiNdebele, uNkk Esther Mahlangu beliyisimenywa esikhethekile sikaMengameli, belihamba nabomndeni walo Isithombe:Henk Kruger/Independent Newspapers ILUNGU lePhalamende le-ANC uMnuz Malusi Gigaba belimeshise kahle isudi yalo nezicathulo ezibrown Isithombe: ANC Parliament
Osomabhizinisi abahlukene baKwaZulu-Natal bathole ithuba nokukhangisa ngemikhiqizo yamabhizinisi abo ezihambelini zomcimbi wokuvulwa kwengqungquthela yezokuhwebelana, i-reSURGEnce Conference, e-ICC, eThekwini, ngoLwesine.Kule ngqungquthela, ezoze iphethwe ngeSonto, nezoba nezigcawu ezahlukene zokucobelana ngolwazi lokuchuma kwezamabhizinisi. Kunosomabhizinisi abawu-120 abazokhangisa ngamabhizinisi abo. UNkk Agnes Mhlongo weSwitched on Trade CC, yaKwaNyuswa, uthe ukuba kulo mcimbi kusho lukhulu kuyena futhi wethemba ukuthi kuzoba nomehluko obonakalayo ebhizinisini lakhe lezimpahla zokugqoka azithunga ngesandla, aliqala ngo-2005."Ngizele ukuzokhangisa ngebhizinisi lami ezithamelini zamazwe omhlaba ngoba ngiyazi ukuthi ziyithanda kabi imikhiqizo ehlukile nemihle njengeyami. Ngifuna nokwakha ubudlelwano obuzoba wusizo ebhizinisini lami ngesikhathi esizayo,” kusho uNkk Mhlongo.UMnuz Sifiso Ngcobo naye ongomunye wosomabhizinisi ababezokhangisa emcimbini, uthe ithuba elinjengaleli liwusizo kakhulu kosomabhizinisi abanjengabo abangakachumi.Lo somabhizinisi owumdwebi nosebenzisa upende ukwenza izithombe zemidwebo uqhube wathi wethemba ukuthi le ngqungquthela izoba nomehluko omkhulu ebhizinisini lakhe ikakhulu ngoba bayindlala abamnyama abenza lo msebenzi."Into engiyibheke kakhulu ngokuza lana wukwakha ubudlelwano obuzongisiza ngokungivulelela amanye amathuba ngomuso, nokuthi ngikwazi ukuthola eminye imicimbi efuze lona yokusabalalisa umkhiqizo engiwenzayo,” kusho yena.Le ngqungquthela izoqhubeka futhi namhlanje ngemibukiso yosomabhizinisi futhi kube nezingxoxo zokucobelana ngolwazi lokuhwebelana nokusebenzisana kwiziphathimandla zamazwe ehlukene omhlaba okubalwa nezaseMelika.NgoMgqibelo kuzovakashelwa izindawo zokuvakasha ezahlukene zaseThekwini, kube nomcimbi womculo wokholo kusihlwa, bese kuvalwa ngemvuselelo ngeSonto emini.
Abantu nezinkampani ezehlukene bagubhe usuku lokuzalwa kowayengumengameli waseNingizimu Afrika wokuqala wentando yabantu ongasekho uNelson Mandela ngokwelula isandla emiphakathini.Ithimba leSolezwe lihambisana nenkampani ebhaka izinkwa iBB Bakeries, lihambele ehholo KwaNdengezi livakashele inhlangano yabantu asebesempeshenini iKwaNdengezi Senior Citizens liphethe izinkwa, amalayisi nezingubo zokulala zakwa-Aranda Blankets.Ngaphambi kokuya KwaNdengezi, ithimba leSolezwe nabaxhasi balo bavakashele ekhaya labadala nabaphila nokukhubazeka iSakhisizwe Old Age Home, eNewtown A, eNanda, nezipho.Nezinye izinkampani nohulumeni benze okufanayo.ABANTU abadala baKwaNdengezi abangamalungu eKwaNdengezi Senior Citizens Isithombe: FANELESIBONGE BENGUUMNUZ Zwelakhe weSolezwe noMnuz Samukelo Nkosi benikezela ngezingubo zokulala. Usuyesaba umphakathi emva kokuba umfundi wokuqala kuleli kutholakale ukuthi uhaqwe iMpox.Umfundi waseHammanskraal eGauteng ungowokuqala ukuhaqwa ilesi sifo. Isifo besidlange kwabesilisa abanemiyaka ephakathi kuka-17 kuya ku-43.Ekuseni ngoLwesine iningi labantu lizwakalise ukuba novalo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ngokusabalala kwaleli gciwane..UDumisani Mazibuko kuFacebook, uphawule wathi: "Siyabhebhetheka manje lesi sifo” UMthobisi Myende uthe: " Hhayi bo awucishwe lo mlilo"UThobe Thobe uthe: " Shwele Nkosi ngenelela unqande lesi sifo kodwa soneni kangaka.Kuke kwaba nokudideka mayelana neqiniso ngemiphumela yalo mfundi ofunda uGrade 1 esikoleni i-Iketleng Primary, eHammanskraal. Ekuseni uMnyango wezeMfundo eGauteng ukhiphe isitatimende uthi umfundi uhaqwe iMpox. Akuphelanga sikhathi esingakanani wakhipha esinye wathi isitatimende sikhishwe ngaphambi kokuthi isikhungo esibhekele izifo ezithathelanayo, iNational Institute for Communicable Diseases (NICD) siqinisekise imiphumela yakhe.UMnuz Steve Mabona okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo, uthe abazali bomfundi bazise isikole ngemiphumela yomfundi ngoLwesibili, bathi umfundi uke wavakashela izihlobo ebezinezimpawu zeMpox eNorthern Cape ngempelasonto edlule. Ngemuva kwezinsukwana naye ube nezimpawu wahlolwa kwaqinisekiswa ukuthi uhaqekile. Kuleso sitatimende uthe uMnyango wezeMfundo ngeke usakhuluma ngalolu daba kuzokhuluma owezeMpilo. Ntambana, uMphathiswa wezeMfundo eGauteng, uMnuz Matome Chiloane, uqinisekise ukuhaqeka komfundi. Ucele abazali bezingane ezike zasondelana naye ukuthi baxhumane nesikole ukuze zihlolwe ukuthi azithelelekanga yini."Ithimba le-Integrated School Health Programme (ISHP) lizovakashela esikoleni ukuze lifundise ngalesi sifo nangokuhlolwa kwaso. Siyaqonda ukuthi lokhu kungase kudale ukukhathazeka kubazali kodwa siyabaqinisekisa ukuthi lesi simo sisisingethe ngokucophelela okukhulu.” kusho uChiloane.
UCWANINGO lwakamuva lwaseFNB luveza ukuthi u-50% wabantu bakuleli awukulungele ukuthatha umhlalaphansi njengoba ungalondolozi imali eyanele yomhlalaphansi.UMnuz Samukelo Zwane, oyiNhloko yeFNB Wealth and Investments, uveze ukuthi u-60% wemali eyenziwa ngabasebenzi bakuleli abahola kancane iphelela ekuthengeni ukudla, ukugibela nokurenta. Enye ingxenye ikhokhela izikweletu bese besala no-2% abawulondolozela umhlalaphansi.Uveze ukuthi abahola kangcono nabacebile bonga u-12% abawufaka ezikhwameni zomhlalaphansi."Ukubiza kwezinga lempilo, ukunyuka kwemali-mboleko nokungabi nolwazi olwanele ngezindaba zomhlalaphansi kwenza abantu abahola kancane bangasheshi ukulondoloza imali yomhlalaphansi. Abaningi bathi bazosizwa yizingane zabo noma bazohola impesheni kahulumeni uma sebegugile,” kuchaza uZwane.Uthe kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baqale ukulondolozela umhlalaphansi uma beqala ukusebenza noma bangafaka uR300 esikhwameni somhlalaphansi esifanele ngoba yisona esiba nenzalo enhle.Ubalule ukuthi yize abacebile nabahola kangcono kubukeka sengathi babeka imali eningi yomhlalaphansi kodwa ukuze umuntu ahlale ngokunethezeka ekugugeni kwakhe, kufanele alondoloze u-15% womholo wakhe nyanga zonke.Ubuye waveza ukuthi abacebile nabahola kahle abahlali phansi dekle uma sebethathe umhlalaphansi kodwa bayasebenza noma bavule amabhizinisi kodwa abahola kancane bavamise ukuhlala phansi dekle ngenxa yokungabi namanye amakhono.Yize kubukeka sengathi isimo sibi, uZwane uthe ucwaningo lwabo luveza ukuthi abantu abaqala ukusebenza manje sebeqalile ukulondolozela umhlalaphansi.UMnuz Siphamandla Mkhwanazi, oyisazi somnotho sakwaFNB, uthe balindele ukuthi imali-mboleko yehle ngoNovemba ngenxa yokuqina kwerandi.Uveze ukuthi ukuqina kwerandi kunomthelela omuhle ngoba kuzokwehlisa intengo kaphethroli neyegilosa njengoba ukudla kuthuthwa ngamaloli.UMnuz Bheki Mkhize, oyisikhulu seFNB Wealth and Investments, uthe sebezoletha usizo lokwelulekwa ngezimali kuwo wonke umuntu obeka imali eFNB ngoba abafuni ulwazi lwezimali kube ngolwabacebile kuphela.Ugqugquzele abantu ukuthi bangajahi ukukhipha imali yempesheni njengoba kunohlelo oluzoqala ngoSepthemba (two pot system) olubavumela ukukhipha ingxenye ethile.Uthe le mali ekhishwayo yenzelwa izimo eziphuthumayo njengeCovid-19 nokunye okungagwemeki.
UQOME ukuzibhixa ngothuvi kunokubingelela iMantshi owesilisa osolwa ngokubulala uyise. Ngokwemibiko yamaphoyiseni, ibhungu elineminyaka engu-24 laxabana noyise ngeSonto ekhaya kubo kwaMhlushwa, eMpumalanga. Ngemuva kwengxabano uyise wahamba waya esontweni engazi ukuthi uzobuya indodana yakhe imlalele unyendle."Ngesikhathi ubaba wekhaya ebuya esontweni, indodana yakhe yamhlasela yambokoda ngommese iphindelela,” kusho uCaptain Magonseni Nkosi.Kuthiwa umgilwa oneminyaka engu-64 wazama ukubaleka kodwa wawa. Kwasiza omakhelwane ababona igazi bahlaba umkhosi kwafika abezimo eziphuthumayo kodwa ngeshwa akasindanga.Umsolwa waboshwa wabekwa icala lokubulala.Kuthe ngoMsombuluko sekumele ahanjiswe enkantolo, amaphoyisa abhekana nenkinga efica lo mlisa ezibhixe ngothuvi bakhe.Kuphoqe ukuthi lo msolwa ogama lakhe nguTsepo Dlamini avele ngoLwesibili enkantolo yeMantshi eNkomazi, ukubhekana necala lokubulala.
SISANKENENEZA ezindlebeni zakhe isililo sozakwabo becela usizo, kumsebenzi osale nezibazi zokusha kodwa wakwazi ukuphulukundlela kungqongqa abayisithupha abebezama ukucima umlilo wamadlelo obusha ubuhanguhangu, eMpophomeni kuMasipala waseMngeni, ngeSonto.UNgqongoshe woMnyango wokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu kuleli uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa noNdunankulu wesifundazwe uMnuz Thami Ntuli behola ithimba longqongqoshe nabaholi abebeyobhonga emswaneni emindenini elahlekelwe amalungu ayesiza ukubhula umlilo eMpophomeni Isithombe: Sithunyelwe Umgilwa igama lakhe eligodliwe ngenhloso yokumvikela, uthe akubone kwenzeka kuyisithombe azophila naso impilo yakhe yonke njengoba kusenzima ukwamukela indlela abone ozakwabo beyiyo ngemizuzwana nje kade bephila kungekho ocabanga ukuthi kunento ebuhlungu ezobehlela.Ngesikhathi Isolezwe livakashele kubo kamgilwa, limfice elele ngenxa yezinhlungu ebhandishe isitho nasemathangeni womabili, engakwazi nokuhamba kahle, esebenzisa induku.UMUFI uNksz Mabongi Sishane"Sithole umbiko obuthi kuyasha. Ngesikhathi sizama ukucima, kuqapheleke ukuthi amalangabi omlilo angaphezu kwamandla, induna ebisigadile yasiyalela ukuthi siqhele bese sizame ukuqhamukela ngakolunye uhlangathi. Kodwa ngokushesha, umoya uvunguze wabheka ngalapho bese singakhona usunamandla kakhulu,” usho kanje.Uthe ubephambili asebenza nabo bengemuva kwakhe, ngesikhathi ephenduka ubengasaboni muntu kodwa ezwa ngesililo, wazama ukubaleka kodwa amalangabi esevele emhangulile njengoba izinto abezigqokile kudingeke azikhumule sezivutha."Ngesikhathi ngibaleka, bekunzima ngoba sibeletha isigubhu emhlane esinamalitha awu-20 amanzi, okwenza kubenzima ukugijima naso. Ngicabanga ukuthi abaningi bahlulwe ukugijima naso ngoba indawo beyenyukela siphefumula intuthu,” kuqhuba yena.Uthe bebeqeqeshwe izinsuku ezintathu kuphela kanti ezimbili kuzona besekilasini befundiswa ngomlilo. Uthe baqashwe yinkampani i-Formusa kasonkontileka osebenza ngaphansi kwenkampani, i-Sappi yaveza ukuthi alukho usizo asalutholile ngisho lokwelulekwa ngokomqondo. Uthe emva kokuqeqeshwa, azikho izitifiketi abanikwe zona.Uveze ukuthi ubesanamasonto yena nabanye asebenza nabo beqashiwe, kanti umqashi ubebabambela kuphela imali ye-Unemployment Insurence Fund.Kulesi sigameko kudlule emhlabeni abesifazane abahlanu nowesilisa oyedwa, kanti omunye wesilisa kuthiwa isimo sakhe sibi esibhedlela.Kwabadlule emhlabeni kulesi sigameko kukhona; uNksz Ntombifuthi Ngcobo, Nksz Ntombikhona Nxele, Mnuz Vusi Radula, Nksz Nonsikelelo Zuma, Nksz Khethiwe Ngcobo noNksz Mabongi Sishane.UNksz Amanda Sishane ongudadewabo kaMabongi, uthe bewumndeni bafe olwembiza ngokulahlekelwa udadewabo kule nhlekelele."Bekuwuyena kuphela osebenzayo futhi esondla ekhaya. Sekusele mina, izingane zakhe ezintathu neyami nomama lapha ekhaya. Bekungunyaka wakhe ka-12 esebenza e-Formusa kanti ubengasisona isicimamlilo kodwa bebecelwa nje ukuthi benze lo msebenzi uma sekufike ubusika beqeqeshwe izinsukwana, uma kuqala ihlobo baphindele emsebenzini wabo wokutshala amahlathi,” usho kanje.Kuthintwa osebenza ophikweni lwezicishamlilo eThekwini osemnkantshubomvu kulo msebenzi ocele ukungadalulwa, uveze ukuthi ukuqeqeshelwa lo msebenzi kuthatha izinyanga ezine zonke futhi ngaphambi kokuqasha kuningi okubhekwayo kumuntu kubalwa nesimo sakhe sempilo.UMnuz Alson Ngesi okhulumela iFormusa, uthe abasebenzi babenikezwe ukuqeqeshwa okwanele, kodwa wavala ucingo ngesikhathi ecelwa ukuthi aqinisekise ukuthi baqeqeshwa izinsuku ezintathu kuphela.UNgqongqoshe woMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa noNdunankulu esifundazweni uMnuz Thami Ntuli nabanye abaphathiswa beminyango, bahambele imindeni ukuyobhonga emsanweni. UHlabisa uthe ngokombiko, umonakalo odalwe imililo ehlasele lesi sifundazwe ulinganiselwa ku-R90 million.
UTHWESWE amacala ngokusemthethweni uBafana Mahungela osolwa ngokubulala uthisha waseGoli uKirsten Kluyts. Lo msolwa ubhekene namacala amahlanu, okukhona kuwona ukuthumba, ukuphanga esebenzisa isihluku, ukubulala, ukuhlukumeza ngokocansi kanye nokuphazamisa ukusebenza kwengalo yomthetho.Umufi wayeyingxenye yomqhudelwano wokugijima i-MyRun, eGeorge Lea Park, ekupheleni kuka-Okthoba, isidumbu sakhe satholwa onqenqemeni lwepaki. Uthi uma kubhekwa ubunzima bokusebenza kohlelo, mancane amathuba okuthi ukulalelwa kwezethulo ngaphambi kokuqulwa kwecala kuqhubeke ngokuthanda koMbuso. AZOVINJWA yimigomo amalungu ahlele ukuphazamisa uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, ePhalamende uma esethula inkulumo yokuhlahla indlela ezolandelwa nguhulumeni wobumbano eminyakeni emihlanu ezayo eKapa, namhlanje ebusuku.URamaphosa uzovula iPhalamende ngokuthula inkulumo ezobanjelwa eCity Hall, lapho kumenywe khona izicukuthwane ezifaka nababengomengameli bezwe.USomlomo wePhalamende, uNkk Thoko Didiza, ekhuluma izolo esithangamini sabezindaba ngamalungiselelo alo mcimbi, uveze ukuthi kunemigomo elawula ukuhlala kwezindlu zombili zePhalamende, evimbela ukuphazanyiswa kukamengameli wezwe."Kunemigomo emisha ezolandelwa yePhalamende enqinda labo abafuna ukuphazamisa inkulumo kamengameli ukuthi bangakwenzi lokhu. Le migomo iyacacisa ukuthi umcimbi wakusasa (namhlanje), owokuvulwa kwePhalamende kuphela, hhayi okunye. Le migomo ibekelwe ukuthi kube nesizotha ngoba inkulumo kuzobe kungeyokuhlahla indlela ngezinto ezizokwenziwa nguhulumeni omusha,” kusho uNkk Didiza.Uthe akazi noma likhona yini iqembu elizoduba ukuvulwa kwePhalamende.Iqembu iMK yaduba ukuhlala kwePhalamende lapho kwakhethwa khona usomlomo, iphini likasomlomo kanjalo nomengameli wezwe.Kubhekiwe ukuthi ngabe kuzoya ngokwamagama enkehli kwi-EFF, eyathembisa ukuthi ngeke isamphazamisa uRamaphosa uma ethula inkulumo ebhekise esizweni.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi leli qembu belimisa kabi uRamaphosa uma ethula le nkulumo lize ligcine selikhishwa ngesankahlu ePhalamende. UNobhala wePhalamende, uMnuz Xolile George, uveze ukuthi lo mcimbi uhlelelwe phakathi kukaR6 million kuya kuR14 million.Uveze ukuthi abazi imalini ezogcina isebenzile esabelweni abasibekile.Ubalule nokuthi sekuphothuliwe ukwakhiwa kwamahhovisi angu-155, kwangu-203 asha ngesikhathi kusha iPhalamende."Sishoda ngamahhovisi angu-54 ukuze kube namahhovisi enele. Sithemba ukuthi umsebenzi wokuphothula ukwakhiwa kwePhalamende kabusha, kuzophela ngo-Ephreli 2026,” kusho uGeorge.USihlalo weNdlu yoMkhandlu weziFundazwe, uNkk Refilwe Mtsweni-Tsipane, uthe bameme ababengomengameli okubalwa noMnuz Jacob Zuma, ababengoSomlomo bePhalamende okubalwa uNksz Baleka Mbete noNkk Nosiviwe Mapisa-Nqakula, ohamba amacala enkohlakalo enkantolo.UNkk Didiza uthe abakazi ukuthi ubani ozofika nongeke aphumelele kwabamenyiwe okwamanje."Sizokwazi kusasa ntambama uma sekuvalwe uhlelo lokulandwa kwezinto zokungena ukuthi obani abazofika. Okwamanje ngeke sikwazi ukusho ukuthi ubani uyeza noma akezi,” kusho uNkk Didiza.Uthe ingqephu izobe idla umunyu kwizimenywa wathi nomkhosi wezokuvikela uzoviliyela kuye ngokuthi sinjani isimo sezulu.
KUBHIMBE uhlelo kwabesilisa abayisihlanu okukholakala ukuthi bebeyobulala usomabhizinisi nonogada bakhe, ngenkathi bezithela olakeni lwamaphoyisa, badudubulana ngenhlamvu kwasala abane enkundleni, oyedwa walimala, esigamekweni esenzeke emgwaqeni uMoses Kotane, eSydenham, eThekwini ngoLwesithathu emini. Kuthiwa amaphoyisa abevele elandela umkhondo wabasolwa ngenxa yamacala abucayi okubalwa kuwo awokubulala nawokubamba inkunzi. Emuva kokuthola ukuthi kukhona abaphezu kwakho amaphoyisa ahlale ezithendeni zabo. Abasolwa kuthiwa babe wukubona amaphoyisa bavele bavulela ngenhlamvu babhekisa emaphoyiseni abezama ukubamisa. Kube sekudubuleka abanye bashonela emotweni, kwalimala oyedwa okuthiwa uzame ukubaleka. Ngesikhathi Isolezwe lifika endaweni yesigameko, umsolwa osindile ubehleli phansi ebhandishe emlenzeni egadwe ngamaphoyisa. Ubebonakala elokhu eqalaza. Ubegqoke isikibha esimpunga nesikhindi esimnyama namateku. Amaphoyisa abala ukhasha uma kusondelwa kuye. Bese kugcwele abantu, kuvalwe nomgwaqo, bebodwa abebebabaza okwenzekile, abanye bekhomba ngalapho obekukhona imoto ebinabasolwa ababulewe. Imoto yabo encane yohlobo lwe-KIA, ibifahlake yaphela iwindi langemuva, kubonakala sengathi izinhlamvu eziningi zamaphoyisa beziqhamuka ngemuva.Oyedwa wabasolwa, obesesihlalweni somshayeli, ubelengela ngaphandle ngekhanda, enoxhaxha lwamanxeba okudutshulwa entanyeni, negazi ligcwele entanyeni. Imoto ibime eceleni komgwaqo ishayise udonga lomuzi.Omunye umsolwa ubelele esihlalweni esingaphambili eceleni komshayeli, nangemuva kukhona ababili. Kuvela ukuthi laba bebeyizinkabi ebezibhilitile ekubulaleni osomabhizinisi emkhakheni wezokwakha nabantu abasemkhakheni wokuqapha. Okhulumela amaphoyisa esifundazweni, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uqinisekise ukuthi bese kuyisikhathi eside amaphoyisa ebafunela amacala okubulala nokubamba inkunzi."Kuthe amaphoyisa ezwa ngabo izolo aphuthuma ukubavimba, abelamela kule ndawo. Kuthe ezama ukubamisa, bala ukulalela umthetho. Badubule kuqala bebhekise emaphoyiseni. Amaphoyisa aphendule ngenhlamvu kwadubuleka abane bafa, oyedwa walimala,” usho kanje.UMSOLWA oyedwa kwabayisihlanu osinde bedudulana namaphoyisa ngenhlamvu eSydenham, eThekwini Isithombe: DOCTOR NGCOBO/INDEPENDENT NEWSPAPERS"Lo msolwa ozame ukubaleka utholwe nesibhamu esincane. Emotweni kutholakale izibhamu esilobe singakatholi ukuthi bezingaki. Kuvele ukuthi esinye sezibhamu abebesisebenzisa bekungesamaphoyisa,” kusho uNetshiunda.
KUHLEHLE isigcawu sokuqondisa ubugwegwe owayengumengameli, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, kubangwa eyokuthi ubefuna ukuzifikela mathupha.UZuma akazange aye esigcawini abebizelwe kuso ebesibanjwe ngezobuchwepheshe, izolo.Kunalokho uZuma uthumele owayeyilungu lesigungu esiphezulu kwi-ANC, uMnuz Tony Yengeni, ukuba eyomumela.Okhulumela iMK, uMnuz Nhlamulo Ndhlela, uthe uYengeni ufike wakubeka kwacaca ukuthi uZuma ufuna ukuthi azifikele bukhoma esigcawini, singabanjwa kusetshenziswa ezobuchwepheshe."Emva kwempikiswano ende, ikomiti eliqondisa ubugwegwe linqume ukuthi isigcawu sizobanjwa kusetshenziswa ezobuchwepheshe kodwa ke sabe sesiyahlehla. Kuphakanyiswe ukuthi sibe ngoJulayi 23.I-ANC icele ukungajahwa ngesikhathi iqala ukushushisa owayengumengameli, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, osehola iMK.Le nhlangano inxuse ukunikwa ithuba lokuthi ishushise uZuma ngasese, yaveza ukuthi isinqumo esizothathwa yikomiti eliqondisa ubugwegwe angeke simenyezelwe ngokushesha.Okhulumela i-ANC, uMnuz Zuko Godlimpi, uthe isigcawu siqhubekile ngendlela obekuhlelwe ngayo, kusetshenziswa ezobuchwepheshe.UGodlimpi uthe abezindaba abavumelekile ezigcawini ze-ANC zokuqondisa ubugwegwe."Kunenqwaba yemibuzo esiyitholayo eqhamuka kwabezindaba ngalolu daba. Isinqumo sizomenyezelwa uma ikomiti selilalele laphinde lahlaziya zonke izethulo. Angeke ngikwazi ukusho ukuthi isinqumo sizophuma emva kwesikhathi esingakanani ngoba konke lokho kuncike ekutheni ikomiti lizothola izethulo ezingakanani.”UNobhala-Jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, ubezokwethula ubufakazi kulesi sigcawu.UMbalula usekusho kaningi ukuthi isinqumo sikaZuma sokweseka iMK senze ukuthi i-ANC ihluleke ukunqoba ukhetho ngamalengiso.Okokuqala emlandweni, i-ANC yathola ngaphansi kuka-50% wamavoti okhethweni, yalahlekelwa iKwaZulu-Natal, yaphinde yahluleka ukuwina ngamalengiso ezifundazweni, iGauteng neNorthern Cape.Ngakolunye uhlangothi iMK yona yafika kwezwakala njengoba yalala isithathu.Ekhuluma engqungqutheleni ebihlelwe yinyunyana yabasebenzi, iNehawu, uMbalula uthe amavoti angaphezu kuka-2 million atholwe iMK okhethweni abezotholwa i-ANC."Abantu bethu bakhethe ukuvotela iMK, lokho kufanele sikuvume.”UZuma usolwa ngokuphula imigomo ye-ANC njengoba amemezela ukuthi uzokhankasela iqembu ebelincintisana nayo okhethweni, waphinde wanxenxa nabantu ukuthi bangayivoteli i-ANC.UZuma kwakufanele ashushiswe ngaphambi kokhetho kodwa isigcawu sabuye sahlehliswa ngenxa yokusabela udlame.Izolo bekunengcosana yamalungu eMK abecula bude buduze namahhovisi e-ANC.
UNGQONGQOSHE wokuHlunyeleliswa kweziMilo ukhale ngokuthi kuzobambezela ukuthengwa komshini omisa i-signal yamaselula aphathwa iziboshwa ukuncishiswa kwesabelomali somnyango wakhe.UDkt Pieter Groenewald usho kanje emuva kokwethulwa kwesabelomali sikaR87.1 million. Le mali yehle ngoR2.5 billion.Ekhuluma nabeziko lezindaba iNewzroom Afrika, uGroenewald udalule ukuthi kungase kunqindeke nokuqashwa kwabasebenzi abasha abagada iziboshwa.Ukuncishiswa kwesabelomali uthe kuzobambezela ukuthengwa komshini omisa i-signal yamaselula asetshenziswa yiziboshwa kuzobambezela ukuthengwa kwawo."Sidinga nomshini osezingeni eliphezulu lobuchwepheshe besimanje ozokwenza sinqamule i-signal yamaselula aphathwa yiziboshwa. Asikwazi ukuwuthenga manje kodwa wudaba engizolubika kubaphathi bami,” kusho uGroenewald.Elakuleli lineziboshwa ezingu-156 600 uGroenewald athe kuwumsebenzi ukugadwa kwazo ngakho badinga kwengezwe abasebenzi.Ufuna kuqhanyukwe nezisombululo ekutheni kuzokwenziwa njani ngeziboshwa eziboshelwe amacala amancane, ezinye zazo ezivalelwe ngoba zihluleka wukukhokha ibheyili kaR100.Uthe kudla umnyango awengamele uR400 ukunakekela isiboshwa esisodwa ngosuku ejele."Zibalelwa ku-60 000 lezi ziboshwa. Ukunciphisa le sibalo kungasiza ekongeni imali nokugcwala okusemajele,” kusho uGroenewald.Ngo-2019 ngesikhathi ekhankasela ukhetho uGroenewald wathi kumele kubuyiswe isigwebo sentambo sinikezwe abasuke belahlwa amacala okubulala. Wathi kumele kuqikelelwe ukuthi abanikwa isigwebo sentambo yibo kanye abenze amacala abasuke belahlwe ngawo.Kodwa useshaya ungqimphothwe uthi kwakuwumbono weqembu iFreedom Front Plus angumengameli walo.Ube esebeka ukuthi wonke umuntu unelungelo lokuphila."Abantu abaqala le nto yesigwebo sentambo nokuyinto engahlangene nomnyango wami futhi engahambisani noMthethosisekelo wezwe. UChapter 2 ucacisa ngamalungelo abantu, ukuthi wonke umuntu unelungelo lokuphila,” kusho uGroenewald engeza ngokuthi akakwazi ukubuyisa isigwebo sentambo.
BAZOSHUSHISWA abelaphi abazovuma ukubhalela noma ngubani incwadi yokuthi angayi emsebenzini.Lokhu kushiwo uNkk Gugulethu Mchunu, owusihlalo obhekelele inyakatho yeTheku enhlanganweni yabelaphi, i-Ethekwini Traditional Health Practitioners, ngesikhathi eyala abelaphi bendabuko. Lokhu kumayelana nokuthi uhulumeni ufuna babhalise emkhandlwini wezinyanga ukuze bakwazi ukukhipha izincwadi zokuqinisekisa ukuthi iziguli zabo bezigula."Njengamanje uhulumeni ufuna sibhalise. Belaphi leli akulona ithuba lokuthi abelaphi banikeze abantu izincwadi zezinyanga ezintathu kuya phezulu, okugcina kufake abasebenzi ezinkingeni. Awukwazi ukunikeza umuntu obezihlalele ekhaya ezidlela utshwala incwadi yokuthi ubegula. "Kumele siqaphele ngoba lokho kuzokwenza ukuthi siboshwe ngoba nodokotela akakwazi ukubhalela isiguli incwadi engasibonanga. Lokhu kwenzelwa ukuthi sihleleke, saziwe ukuthi singobani nokuthi silandele imigomo ezobe ihambisana nokuthi ubhalisile," echaza.Uqhube wathi omunye wemigomo ohambisana nokubhalisa ngaphansi komkhandlu wokwelapha ngokwendabuko ukuthi ube nenhlangano obhalise kuyo okuyiyo eyaziyo ukuthi imithetho yokuba umelaphi uyilandele yonke yini.UNkk Mchunu ubesho lokhu esigcawini sokucobelelana ngolwazi sezinsuku ezimbili sabelaphi bendabuko ebesihlelwe yiNyuvesi yaKwaZulu-Natal, esiseNanda, esiqale izolo, esizophela namhlanje.Kulesi sigcawu uSolwazi Nombulelo Magula, wophiko olufundisa odokotela ngokwelashwa kwezifo, uthe ngesikhathi sobhubhane lweCovid-19, bafunde ukuthi abantu abanezifo ezingamahlalakhona yibona abagula kakhulu, abanye bashona. Ngenxa yalokho, babone ukuthi kumele umphakathi wonke usebenzisane ukuze kulawulwe izifo ezingamahlalakhona."Esikwaziyo ukuthi u-70% weziguli uqala ngokuya kumelaphi ngaphambi kokuthi uye ezikhungweni sezempilo. Ingakho kubalulekile ukuthi sisebenzisane sonke. Sifisa ukuthi abelaphi bakwazi ukuhlola izifo ezifana nomfutho wegazi, ukusebenza kwezinso nesifo sikashukela okuyizona zifo ezidlange kakhulu eThekwini, ukuze sikwazi ukulwa nazo zingakagxili kakhulu. Sigweme nokushayisana kokwelashwa kwesintu nokwasentshonalanga," kucacisa uSolwazi Magula.UMnuz Enerst Gwala ongumelaphi, uthe inkinga ekhona ukuthi imitholampilo ayibahloniphi abelaphi."Kungenzeka yini ukuthi umtholampilo udlulisele isiguli kimi noma usibuyisele kimi. Cha ngeke kwenzeke ngoba konke okwethu kungcolile. Uma singasebenzisana ngokweqiniso singakwazi ukuhambisana nesifiso senhlangano yempilo yokuthi sehlise izifo ngo-2030. Ezinye izifo ezingamahlalakhona siyakwazi ukuzelapha," kusho yena.
KUGQUGQUZELWA abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuba balungise imininingwane yabo njengoba selivuliwe iwindi lokuqoqa intela yalo nyaka.UKhomishana weSouth African Revenue Service (Sars), uMnuz Edward Kieswetter, uthe basebenzisa izindlela ezihlukene ukuqoqa intela okubalwa ukuvakashela emagatsheni abo, ukufaka imininingwane online nangokulungiselela abantu imininingwane yabo yentela bengenzanga lutho. Sizoqinisekisa ukuthi siyabasiza ngokushesha emagatsheni ethu, siyabagqugquzela ukuthi bafake imininingwane online ngezinhlelo zethu zobuchwepheshe ezihlukene. Siyayenza i-automatic assessment kodwa abanye abantu kufanele bazifakele bona imininingwane yabo,” kusho uKieswetter.Uthe ngonyaka odlule bakwazile ukugwema ukuthi uR100 billion uqolwe ngabantu akade bezobuyelwa yimali ngendlela engafanele.Kusukela ngoMsombuluko bangaphezu kuka-191 000 abantu abafake imininingwane yabo yentela, abawu-183 000 bazifake ngamakhompyutha kanti abawu-7 700 bebesebenzisa iMobiApp.Uveze ukuthi baphendule izinkulumo eziwu-16 million online, wathi abantu kufanele bangene kwiwebsite yakwaSars ukuze basizakale.Ngaphambi kokuya egatsheni lakwaSars, uKieswetter uthe abantu abavakashele ikhasi elithi www.secure.sarsefiling.co.za badownloade i-app yakwaSars ku-Google Play noma Apple Stores.
