USALE egade abafundi ngesikhathi othisha beduba ukufundisa, uthishanhloko wasesikoleni Umbambangwe High KwaFelekisi, eManzimtoti, abamsola ngokuhlukumeza nokuqhuba intwala ngewisa.Othisha okuvele ukuthi bevile kwabangu-20, bavuke bayoqhinqa emahhovisi omhloli kwiSekethi eMbumbulu, befuna umnyango ungenelele ngabakubize ngokuphathwa ngesandla sensimbi nokuhlukunyezwa. Uthisha ongagunyaziwe ukukhuluma nabezindaba, uthe ithumba liqhumbuzwe ukuvulelwa icala kukazakwabo othandana nabobulili obufana nobakhe ngaphakathi emnyangweni. Icala avulelwe lona elokukopelisa abafundi bakaGrade 12 iGeography ngesikhathi kubhalwa izivivinyo zikaJuni nonyaka, ngaphambi kokuvalwa kwezikole."Sekunesikhathi emsebenzisa kabuhlungu, emnyanyela indlela ayiyo, kanti ubevele enyamanambana kuthishomkhulu selokhu afika ngo-2019. Esanda kuqashwa besehhovisi, uthishomkhulu waphimisa amagama abuhlungu, wathi uzothatha amadoda abantu esikoleni ngoba uyisitabane,” usho kanje.Uthe isenzo sokuhlukumeza othisha yinto uthishomkhulu ayiqala efika ngo-2016, ebadelela engabazi nokuthi bayini.Uthe kamuva nje, ngaphambi kokuvalwa kwezikole, usole othisha ngokumthakatha emva kokuthi ethe uthole inkalankala ifile emnyango wehhovisi lakhe, wathi lokhu kuholele ekutheni anqume ukulawula abangena ehhovisi lakhe elibuye libe nezinsiza ezibalulekile zesikole. Uthisha ukhale ngokuthi lesi senzo sikathishanhloko siphazamise ukufunda kwezingane ezenza uGrade 12 ngamaholidi asebusika ngenxa yokuthi othisha bebengakwazi ukusebenzisa umshini wokufothokhopha.Kuthintwa uthisha okuthiwa uvulelwe icala okuvumile ukuthi uthandana nobulili obufana nobakhe, unqabile ukuphawula ngalolu daba athe imigomo ayimvumeli kodwa wakuqinisekisa ukuthi likhona icala elifakwe emnyangweni nguthishanhloko oluthinta abafundi.Umthombo weSolezwe uqinisekise ukuthi othisha bahlangane nabaholi bezinyunyana egatsheni nomnyango ngenhloso yokuveza indlela abaphethwe ngayo. Uthe umhloli ubekhona kulo mhlangano wathembisa ukulidlulisela emahhovisi omnyango ezingeni lesifundazwe lolu daba. Umthombo uthe bazamile ukukhuluma nothishanhloko kodwa akekho okwazi ukumsola ingcaca kubona ngoba uma uphikisa akushoyo uyakunombola bese ekuhlukumeza emsebenzini. Uthe uma umnyango ungangeneleli, bazoqhubeka othisha nokungalubhadi esikoleni, bavukele ukuyoqhinqa emahhovisi.Kuthintwa uMnuz Sibongiseni Xulu (uthishanhloko), ukhombise ukushaqeka ngalolu daba, wakhala ngokuthi umthetho womnyango awumvumeli ukuthi aphawule kwabezindaba."Ukube bekuthiwa mina njengendoda nje yakwaXulu angiziphendulele bengizophawula, manje ngoba nginguthishomkhulu angikwazi ukuphawula, umgomo womnyango awungivumeli,” usho kanje.Kushaye isikhathi sokushicilela uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal ungakaphenduli ngalolu daba.UMbatha (esingenalo igama lakhe) ongusihlalo wesigungu esengamele isikole unqabile ukuphawula ngalolu daba wanxusa intatheli ukuthi ifike emhlanganweni ongoLwesithathu.
KUBATSHAZWA isihluku nesibindi sezigebengu ezigile amaphoyisa zingazimbozile ngisho ubuso, ngesikhathi ziwahlasela, zawalalisa phansi, zawaphuca izibhamu eMbizana, e-Eastern Cape, ngeSonto ebusuku.Lesi sigameko sishiye abantu bebambe ongezansi izigebengu ebezingagayelwe mphako, zilinda amaphoyisa zase ziyagadla kwasala elilodwa enkundleni nayisikhombisa elimele kanzima.Ngokuthola kweSolezwe, lawa maphoyisa ahlaselwe kusetshenziswa izinhlokohlela zezibhamu, ama-AK47. Kuthiwa amaphoyisa asesiteshini eMbizana aye eZizityaneni ebizelwe endaweni yesigameko obekubulewe kuso umuntu ngeSonto ebusuku. Ezintatha ngoMsombuluko, amaveni amathathu esebuyela esiteshini esisedolobheni, ahlaselwe. Iveni yokuqala kuthiwa ibidlula egaraji ngesikhathi kuzwakala ukuqhuma kwesibhamu kubhekiswe kuyo ngabasolwa abangaziwa. Umshayeli ukwazile ukudlubulundela wadlula kule ndawo edubulekile waze wayoma esiteshini samaphoyisa eMbizana. Ababili abebekule veni babike ngalokhu kuvukelwa ngabantu esiteshini. Iveni yesibili ebilandela, kuthe isidlula ngakule ndawo nayo yadutshulwa, umshayeli wahluleka ukuyilawula, yaze yayoshayisa isigxobo sikagesi. Izigilamkhuba kuthiwa zibe seziya kule moto zaphoqa amaphoyisa amane abephakathi ukuthi aphume, ziwakhombe ngezibhamu. Ziphuce amaphoyisa izibhamu zathatha, iR5 eyodwa nama-9mm amane. Zithathe amaphoyisa zayongena nawo egaraji, zawaphoqa ukuthi alale phansi, zawabopha, lapho ebese ziveze zilalise khona abasebenzi basegaraji abebegadwe ngezibhamu. Kuthiwa izigebengu zibe sezilinda amanye amaphoyisa, kuthe kuqhamuka imoto yesithathu yamaphoyisa, zavulela ngenhlamvu kwadubuleka iphoyisa elilodwa lashona, imoto yashayisa isigxobo sikagesi. Izigebengu kuthiwa ziye kule moto zathatha isibhamu sephoyisa abelingumgibeli, umufi obeshayela ubengasiphethe isibhamu. Kuthiwa ziye egaraji zazama ukuqhumisa umshini wemali kodwa zehluleka, zagcina zibaleke nezibhamu zamaphoyisa.Okhulumela amaphoyisa e-Eastern Cape, uLieutenant Colonel Siphokazi Mawisa, uthe amaphoyisa aphenya icala lokubulala, awokuzama ukubulala nawokubamba inkunzi. Amacala aphenywa ngoKlebe. Abasolwa ababalelwa kwabangu-20 basagcwele amathafa. Kwenzeka lokhu nje, ngeviki eledlule kusinde ngokulambisa amaphoyisa amabili eMbumbulu, adunwe imoto athathelwa izibhamu ngabasolwa ababehamba ngemoto iVW Polo. Imoto yamaphoyisa itholwe ilele ngokhakhayi budebuduze nalapho ithathwe khona. UDkt Johan Burger ongungcweti wezobugebengu ozimele, uthe kuyakhathaza ukwanda kwezigameko zokuhlaselwa kwamaphoyisa futhi kukhombisa ukuthi izigebengu aziwesabi nhlobo."Indlela okwenzeka ngayo lezi zigameko, lapho esize sibone izigebengu zigebenga amaphoyisa zingazifihlile nokuzifihla, kukubeka ngokusobala ukuthi aziwesabi amaphoyisa. Kumele uhulumeni neziphathimandla bayisukumele le nkinga, kwenziwe isibonelo ngabathinteka kulezi zigameko,” usho kanje.Uthe kumele kuphenywe kuze kuboshwe abathintekayo, kungathalaliswa nje kugcine kungaziwa ukuthi uphenyo luhambe lwafika kuphi. Okhumela iSouth African Policing Union, uMnuz Lesiba Thobakgale, uzigxeke kakhulu izenzo zokugetshengwa kwamaphoyisa."Zonke lezi zigameko zikhombisa ngokusobala ukuthi amaphoyisa awahlonishwa nhlobo futhi okwenziwa kuwona kungukwedelela umthetho ngakho sinxusa ukuthi kuphuthume uphenyo ukuze kuboshwe abenzi bokubi,” usho kanje.
IKHALE kakhulu ngesihlava sokubulawa kwabesifazane imantshi ethe sesiphenduke insakavukela ngesikhathi igweba udilikajele owesilisa waseLindelani owasoconga intombi yakhe.UMxolisi Mvula (32) kuthiwa wangqubuza odongeni intombi yakhe, uNksz Phindile Mkhize (21) amahlandla ayisikhombisa waze washona.Isigameko senzeka ngoDisemba 2, 2022 eLindelani, uMvula ecikwa ukuthi umufi wayekade engalalanga kuyena ngayizolo njengoba babekipitile.Ngemuva kokuba esemngqubuze odongeni, kuthiwa waqhubeka wamgxoba umufi eselele phansi waze wakhihliza amagwebu.Ngemuva kwalokho kuthiwa uMvula wabaleka kodwa amaphoyisa agcina embambile.Wafaka isicelo sebheyili kodwa inkantolo yamnqabela ikhala ngokuthi izizathu zokuyicela azibekile azenele ukuthi angayithola.Izolo iNkantolo yeMantshi yaseNtuzuma imgwebe udilikajele ngecala lokubulala ngenhloso.IMantshi uMohamed Motala ikhale ngesihlava sokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane yathi kumele sinqandwe. Ithe lesi sihlava siyethusa indlela esesisabalele ngakhona ezweni lonke.Ithe ukuze sizonqandwa kumele abantu abenza isenzo esifana nesikaMvula bagixabezwe ngezigwebo zodilikajele ukuze nabanye bezofunda."Isigwebo sikadilikajele yisona esikufanele ngenxa yonya olukhombisile ubulala umufi. Uma zizoqina izigwebo zabahlukumeza abesifazane nakanjani sizokwehla isibalo sokuhlukunyezwa kwabo,'' usho kanje.Iqhuba, ikhale ngokuthi uMvula kusukela ekuqaleni ubengakaze akhombise ukuzisola ngakwenze kumufi."Umsebenzi wenkantolo wukufaka imfundiso kulabo abasuke bonile ngethemba lokuthi bayofunda emaphutheni abo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Ngeshwa akukho esingabe sisakwenza kulabo abasuke sebebulewe,'' isho kanje.Ngemuva kwesigwebo, uMvula obegqoke ijakhethi emnyama obebonakala ebheke phansi, usukumile waqalaza emuva ebantwini abebekhona wase eyehla. Akukho akushilo kubona.Abomndeni kamufi bambukile babonakala sebekhala beduduzana.UMshushisi uKaystree Ramshamujh ufunde incwadi ebhalwe ngunina kamufi, uNkk Vuyile Mkhize echazela inkantolo ngokuthi kwamlimaza kanjani ukubulawa kwendodakazi yakhe.Kuyona uveze ukuthi usephila ngokuphathwa yikhanda elingapheli futhi elingasalapheki ngenxa yokuthi ucabanga njalo selokhu kwabulawa uPhindile.Uthe wayazi ukuthi kuyogcina kuphume isidumbu kulobu budlelwano bendodakazi yakhe noMvula.Uthe yingakho aze ambiza uMvula wamtshela ukuthi ukugwema lokho mabahlukane nendodakazi yakhe kodwa washaya phansi ngonyawo uMvula.Kuyona uveze ukuthi umufi uyena obeyithemba lempilo engcono njengoba wayesemusha, bekholwa ukuthi uzoba nekusasa eliqhakazile. Uthe manje sekungumsebenzi wakhe ukukhulisa ingane kamufi ayishiya ineminyaka emithathu.

KUKHALWA ngogesi omba eqolo eNingizimu Afrika njengoba ucwaningo luveza ukuthi u-57.9% womholo wabantu bakuleli uphelela emalini yokuthenga ugesi neyokugibela.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi ngo-R200 abantu sebethola ugesi wekhadi owu-59.3 units kanti phambilini ububa wu-80 units.Ngo-R500 sebethola ama-unit awu-149.5, phambilini bebethola awu-168.4.Lezi yizibalo zikagesi othengwa ngabantu baKwaZulu-Natal, eGauteng abantu bakhona babhekene nenye inkinga njengoba emalini abathenga ngayo ugesi kudonswa uR200 okuthiwa wokukhokhela ukulungiswa kwengqalasizinda.UMnuz Mervyn Abrahams wenhlangano eyenza ucwaningo ngokubiza kokudla nesimo senhlalo, iPietermaritzburg Economic Justice & Dignity Group, uthe ucwaningo lwabo luthole ukuthi u-57.9% wamaholo uqedwa wugesi nemali yokugibela.Uthe ugesi uyabiza kakhulu kufanele uhulumeni eze nezindlela zokuwehlisa."Ngaphambi kokuthi iNational Energy Regulator of South Africa (Nersa) inyuse intengo kagesi sathumela izethulo zokuthi akufanele unyuswe kakhulu. Inkinga abantu abazihambeli izithangami zeNersa ukuze babeke imibono yabo ngokubiza kukagesi. Kwabanye omasipala unyuke ngo-13%, kwabanye unyuke ngo-16%. Yisimo esithwalisa kanzima abantu ngoba kusho ukuthi u-57.9% womholo wabo ukhokhela ugesi bese enye ingxenye bayisebenzisele ukugibela uma beya emsebenzini,” kuchaza u-Abrahams.Uthe bazoqhubeka nokukhala ezinhlakeni ezifanele kodwa wagqugquzela abantu ukuthi ngonyaka ozayo bahambele izithangami zeNersa futhi bayibhale phansi imibono yabo yokuthi kungani ugesi kungafanele unyuke ngamalengiso.Ubuye waveza ukuthi i-Eskom iwunyusa kakhulu ugesi ngoba ifuna ukuqoqa imali eyayilahlekela kodwa okubuhlungu le mali isikhokhwa ngabantu abampofu."Abantu abacebile banama-solar nezinye izindlela zokuphehla ugesi. Okusho ukuthi eminyakeni ezayo kuzosala abampofu abancike kugesi wase-Eskom. Kufanele uhulumeni eze nezindlela zokuxhasa ugesi ophakelwa abantu emizini yabo ngoba njengamanje ubiza kakhulu,” usho kanje.Uthe abantu abakwazi ngisho ukuthengela imindeni yabo ukudla okunomsoco ngenxa yokubiza kukagesi, imali mboleko enyuka njalo nokubiza kwezinga lempilo.Ubuye waphakamisa ukuthi bafuna iNational Minimum Wage (NMW) inyuke ibe wuR40 ngehora njengoba iwuR27.58 okwamanje.Uveze ukuthi ukubiza kwempilo kwenza abasebenzi baboleke imali noma behola ngenxa yokuthi abakwazi ukuthenga ukudla, ukukhokha ugesi nokwenza ezinye izidingo zempilo."I-NMW kufanele inyuke ukuze abasebenzi bakwazi ukuphila impilo engcono. Iholo lomuntu oyedwa londla abantu abane kuya phezulu. Umholo wabo njengamanje awubaniki isikhala sokonga nesokuphila impilo engcono. Bayaphoqeleka ukuyoboleka ukuze badle ngenxa yokuthi uhhafu womholo uphelela emalini yokugibela nasekuthengeni ugesi,” kusho u-Abrahams.
UTHOLWE enecala lokubulala ngenhloso owesilisa waseNtuzuma, owangqubuza intombi ayekipite nayo ngekhanda odongeni kasikhombisa yaze yafa eyisola ngokuthi isiqomile. UMxolisi Mvula (30) wabulala uNksz Phindile Mkhize(21) ngoDisemba 2 2022, kulandela ukuthi engalalanga endlini ababekipite kuyona eLindelani.Kuleso sigameko kuvela ukuthi uMvula, owucecevana ngokomzimba, wayedinwe egane unwabu esho nokusho ukuthi ukungalali endlini kowayeyintombi yakhe kwakusho ukuthi usenelinye isoka alale kulo. UMUFI uNksz Phindile Mkhize, owangqutshuzwa odongweni yisoka lakhe waze washona Isithombe : SITHUNYELWEUmufi kuthiwa washonela endaweni yesigameko. Ngemuva kwalokho ummangalelwa wathi nyawo zami ngibelethe kodwa wagcina ekhalelwe ngamasongo kaSigonyela.NgoMsombuluko, uMvula okhanyayo ngokwebala, ubebukeka sengathi akazi nokuthi lidumephi. INkantolo yeMantshi yaseNtuzuma, ikhiphe isinqumo yamlahla ngecala lokubulala ngenhloso.IMantshi uMohamed Montala, ikhale ngesihluku esikhonjiswe ngummangalelwa kumufi.Imantshi isebenzise ubufakazi obethulwa nguDkt Naidoo onguchwepheshe osenolwazi olunzulu lokuhlolwa kwezidumbu.Lo chwepheshe wenekela inkantolo ngendlela alimala ngayo ekhanda umufi. Waveza ukuthi igazi elilinganiselwa ku-100 mm lachithekela ebuchosheni."Indlela igazi elachitheka ngayo ebuchosheni uchwepheshe ohlola izidumbu waveza ukuthi kwakubangelwa yisankahlu ummangalelwa ayesisebenzisa ngesikhathi engqubuza umufi odongweni ephindelela,'' kusho iMantshi.Iqhuba ithe kuvela ukuthi ummangalelwa wamngqubuza umufi izikhawu eziyisikhombisa okuwubufakazi bokuthi wayehlosile ukumbulala."Ukube wawungahlosile ukumbulala umufi wawungeke umngqubuze odongweni izikhawu eziningi kangaka. Yingakho namhlanje ngikuthola unecala lokubulala ngenhloso,'' isho kanje imantshi ibhekise kummangalelwa.IMantshi isebenzise ubufakazi obethulwa ngufakazi owayekhona ngesikhathi sesigameko, uNksz Sithembile Mkhize.Ithe ubufakazi obethulwa yilo fakazi buyabambeka futhi abuzange bushiye inkantolo nongabazane ngokwenzeka ngosuku lwesigameko.Kuvele nokuthi kunofakazi abapendele inkantolo isithombe sokuthi umufi wayesebudlelwaneni bothando obabuhlukumeza.Kubikwa ukuthi ngesikhathi engalalanga nesoka lakhe wayekade elale nodadewawo, wavuka ekuseni wamncenga ukuba amphelezele ukuze ayolanda izimpahla zakhe kubo kwesoka."Lokhu kokuthi umufi wayezolanda izimpahla zakhe kubo kukammangalelwa kuveza ngokusobala ukuthi wayesezinhlelweni zokuphuma kulolu thando,'' kuqhuba iMantshi.UMshushisi u-Advocate Kaystree Ramsamujh, uchaze ummangalelwa njengomqambi manga wakhala ngobufakazi obushayisanayo abethulela inkantolo.Uthe ukholwa ukuthi konke ummangalelwa wayevele ekuhlosile. Ukhale ngokuthi ummangalelwa waqamba amanga wathi umufi washayeka ngephutha odongeni kade bebanga iselula ekubeni umufi wayengenayo (iselula) ngesikhathi sesigameko.Kuvele nokuthi ngo-Okthoba 2022, ummangalelwa wake washaya walimaza umufi waze wavuvukala umlomo.Unina kamufi uNkk Vuyile Mkhize ubonge ukuthi ummangalelwa ulahlwe yicala."Ngiyabonga ukuthi ekugcineni ubulungiswa bubonakala benzeka ngokubulawa komtanami. Manje sengifisa ukuthi athole isigwebo esimfanele,'' usho kanje uNkk Mkhize.Omunye obesenkantolo, uNkk Thokozani Khumalo, uSihlalo wenhlangano uBambiswano, ebhekekelele ukuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane eLindelani, uthe bajabule ngokuthi inkantolo imthole enecala ummangalelwa.Namhlanje inkantolo izokhipha isigwebo sikammangalelwa.

Kulesi sithangami, uMchunu ubehambisana namaphini akhe amabili, uMnuz Cassel Mathale noNksz Polly Boshielo noKhomishana kazwelonke uGeneral Fannie Masemola.
KUHLWE emini kowesilisa obebhekene necala lokusoconga umshayeli kaBolt ngo-2021 ngesikhathi iNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini imgixabeza ngesigwebo sikadilakajele.Kuvela ukuthi uLuyanda Makhanya (17) wabulala uSiboniso Shangase (23) ngoFebhuwari 2021.Kuthiwa wamyenga ngokuthi enze isicelo sokuzolandwa emgwaqeni uMointy Naicker eThekwini ukuze ezomyisa eQueensburgh.Esefikile umufi, kuthiwa uMakhanya nomngani wakhe, u-Ayanda, bamjikela endleleni bambulala maqede bathatha isidumbu bayosilahla ehlathini eMlaza.Kuthiwa bambopha izandla nezinyawo base beyamklinya.Ngemuva kwalokho kuthiwa imoto kamufi yohlobo lweToyota Etios babeyishayela njalo uma bebuya esikoleni.Bakhalelwa ngamaSongo kaSigonyela njengoba amaphoyisa ababhadama beshayela imoto kamufi ngemuva kwalokho base bewakhombisa lapho belahle khona isidumbu.Isidumbu satholwa ngamaphoyisa sesibolile, sinephunga futhi sihanjwa yizimpethu. Ngaphambilini ethula ubufakazi, uConstable Patrick Xaba watshela inkantolo ukuthi ubuso bukamufi babugcwele izimpethu.IJaji uWilliam Nicholson limthole enecala uMakhanya, kwathi umngani wakhe lamkhipha phambili njengoba bungekho ubufakazi bokuthi kukhona akwenza ngesikhathi kubulawa umufi.UMakhanya limgojele ngokuthi kwasetshenziswa iselula yakhe ukuthumela isicelo sokulandwa.Izolo ijaji limgixabeze ngodilikajele uMakhanya ngecala lokusoconga umufi, lathi wayengungqondongqondo etulweni lokubulala umufi.Liphinde lamgweba iminyaka emihlanu ngkuthumba nengu-15 ngelokubamba inkunzi."Ngenhloso yokwehlisa isibalo samacala alolu hlobo, kumqoka ukuthi sikugwebe ukuze nabanye bezobona ukuthi bayagwetshwa abenza njengawe,'' usho kanje.UMnuz Bonga Zondi, ongumalume kamufi, ukushayele ihlombe ukugwetshwa kukaMakhanya.Uthe kubathoba izinhliziyo yize umshana wakhe engeke esabuya.Uthe bekungaba ngcono ukuba bobabili abathintekayo bagcine begwetshiwe. "Akusenani ngoba ukhona oyedwa ogwetshiwe ngokubulawa kukamshana wami,'' usho kanjena.UMshushisi, u-Advocate Thabani Buthelezi, ubenxuse inkantolo ukuba imgwebe ummangalelwa ngoba ukhombise unya ebulala umufi.
ZINIKWE uhlu lwezinto okufanele zizenze izikhulu zoMnyango weMfundo, okufaka indaba yokuqedwa kwezindlu zangasese eziyimigodi, kanjalo nokuthola ukuthi badukuza kuziphi izinkalo abafundi abaphothula u-matric kodwa bangaya ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme. Lo myalelo ukhishwe yikomiti lalo ePhalamende njengoba namhlanje uNgqongqoshe woMnyango uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, ethula isabelomali salo nyaka wezimali.Eyezindlu zangasese zomgodi ibihlale iqhatha obengungqongqoshe walo mnyango, uNkk Angie Motshekga, nezinhlangano ezehlukene zomphakathi okubalwa namaqembu aphikisayo ezepolitiki, okubalwa ne-DA uNksz Gwarube ayilungu layo.Usihlalo wekomiti uNksz Joy Maimela, uthe bafuna kuphele lo nyaka wezimali, umnyango usuqedile ngenkinga yezindlu zangasese zomgodi."Sinike umnyango kuze kuphele lo nyaka wezimali ukuthi uqede ngale nkinga yezindlu zomgodi ezikoleni. Sifuna nombiko ogcwele ezinsukwini ezingu-60, mayelana nezinto ezithinta ukuphuculwa kwengqalasizinda ezikoleni. Sifuna ukwazi ukuthi zingaki izikole ezizokwakhiwa ezifundazweni ezehlukene.” Uthe bafuna kubuyekezwe nendaba yesilabhasi endala eyenziwa abafundi abenza uN1 kuya kuN3."Sifuna abafundi abaphothula u-matric kodwa abangayanga ezikhungweni bahlinzekwe ngezinhlelo zokuthi bazanyelwe izikhala ezikhungweni zemfundo ezehlukene kuleli. Umnyango kufanele uxhumane noweMfundo ePhakeme ukuze kuvaleke igebe elikhona nokuthi laba bafundi bazithole sebebhuquza emakhaya.” UNksz Maimela ukhale ngabafundi abangamahlongandlebe."Siyalele umnyango ukuthi ukhulume nabazali balaba bafundi abangezwa. Sikhathazekile ngokuphepha kothisha ezikoleni zethu.” Uveze nokuthi kumele umnyango uqikelele ukuthi izinsiza kufundisa zifika ngesikhathi ezikoleni.Mayelana nezinkinga ezibhekene nomkhandlu olawula othisha kuleli iSACE, uthe kumele usheshise ukukhipha izitifiketi zokubhaliswa kothisha abasha endimeni."Kumele labo thisha bahlonyiswe ngezinto ezenzeka emkhakheni wezemfundo. Kunokusilela emuva odabeni lokubhaliswa kothisha okugcina kuthatha isikhathi eside okudinga ukulungiswa ngokushesha.” Uthe umkhandlu oqinisekisa izingabunjalo lika-matric, Umalusi, kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi ugunyaza amaphepha abhalwayo aleli banga angenawo amaphutha."Kumele Umalusi usheshise nendaba yokukhipha izitifiketi zika-matric. Kumele wakhe nezinhlelo zokusiza intsha engatohozi ngamakhono angasiza ekutheni ithole imisebenzi.”
UBEWUMLUTHA wezidakamizwa umfundi waseBongucele High, eMthwalume, osolwa ngokuba umalugaju ocathamela izingane ezifunda ezikoleni zamabanga aphansi azenzakalise, obevele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMzumbe, ngoLwesihlanu.Lokhu kwenzeke emva kwesigameko esishaqise abaningi sokuhudulelwa esikhotheni komfundi oneminyaka eyisithupha obephuma esikoleni ahlutshulwe izimpahla okukholakala ukuthi kwenziwe yilo msolwa oneminyaka ewu-17 ofunda u-Grade 9. Ubhekene namacala; elokudlwengu nelokuzama ukubulala njengoba kuvela ukuthi kulesi sigameko esenzeke ngesonto eledlule, kuthiwa uzame ukudlwengula umgilwa ngaphambi kokumshaya ngetshe ekhanda wamshiya edindilizile ezitshela ukuthi ufile. Kuthiwa emva kokuboshwa uvumile ukuthi uyena owenze lesi sihluku waphinde wavuma nokuthi wuye owabulala uSinethemba Ngcece (8) owayenza u-Grade 3 esikoleni samabanga aphansi eMakhoso, nyakenye. Isidumbu sakhe satholwa silaxazwe ngasemfuleni sesonakele okwasekuphele amasonto enyamelele selokhu wayegcine ukubonwa ephuma esikoleni.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi umsolwa uvele uwuhlupho esikoleni afunda kuso, kuthiwa uzitika ngezidakamizwa nangesikhathi sesikole.Omunye wothisha ofundisa esikoleni afunda kuso ongagunyaziwe ukukhuluma nabezindaba, uthe umsolwa ubemisiwe esikoleni ngaphami kokuvalwa kwezikole kwathiwa akabuye nomzali njengoba ubebanjwe namaphilisi ohlobo oluthile ayizidakamizwa esikoleni."Uwuhlupho kakhulu. Kuthiwe akabuye nomzali ngokuvulwa kwezikole ngenxa yezenzo zakhe kodwa wakhetha ukufika nomuntu othile okungesiye umzali wakhe. Kuthiwe uzobuyela esikoleni mhla wafika nomzali wakhe. Yize ubengakaze akhombise ulaka kwabanye abafundi kodwa ukusebenzisa izidakamizwa esikoleni, sekuyinto yakhe, ” usho kanje. Uthe nasekilasini kufundwa, ubevele enze akuthandayo uma kuthi akasukume ame ngezinyawo noma aphume ngaphandle uthisha efundisa okukanye akhulume amagama ayiziswana, enze njalo.Uqinisekise ukuthi nabazali bakhe sebeke babizelwa esikoleni babikelwa imikhuba yakhe.Uthishomkhulu wesikole okufunda kuso umsolwa, uMnuz Vuyani Nguse, uthe akukho okuhlanganisa isikole nezenzo umsolwa asolelwa kuso."Okusiphatha kabi nje ukuthi lokhu kulimaza igama lesikole ngoba kuzovela ukuthi umfundi wethu lo osolelwa ezenzweni eziyisihluku kangaka. Kodwa ngiyafisa ukuqinisekisa umphakathi ukuthi izingane ezifunda kulesi sikole ziyahlonipha ngendlela eyisimannga njengoba kuyisiko lethu futhi kuyafundwa akukhona kwampunzi edla emini. Nokho siyazwelana kakhulu nemindeni ethintekile nomndeni nje wakhe umsolwa ngoba akekho obekulindele lokhu uma sibuka iminyaka yakhe,” usho kanje.Ubabekazi kamsolwa ocele ukungadalulwa, uthe bewumndeni kubashaqisile ukuthola ukuthi unukeka ezenzweni ezimbi kanje."Uwumuntu ohloniphayo lapha ekhaya, ngisho omakhewane bebemazi kanjalo. Besingakulindele ukuthi athinteke ezenzweni ezinjengalezi, kodwa ngicela ukungaphawuli kakhulu kwazise sisazohlangana siwumndeni ngoba uyingane yasekhabonina. Lapha nje ubezohlala kubo kayise esondelela isikole, kumele sihlale nabo siludingide lolu daba,” usho kanje.
SESIFINYELELE kwabayisikhombisa isibalo sabafe ngenxa yemililo yequbula esha ubuhanguhangu komasipala abahlukene KwaZulu-Natal, osekuphoqe uhulumeni ukuthi ame ngezinyawo ukuhlinzeka ngosizo kwabakhahlamezekile.Kwabadlule emhlabeni ngenxa yale nhlekelele eqale ukubonakala ngesonto eledlule ebangelwa imimoya enamandla ehlasele ezingxenyeni zesifundazwe, kubalwa uSandiso Wudla (2) noMnuz Ncane Nyandeni (68) basoLundi, uMnuz Muntukabongwa Gazu noNksz Bongiwe Luthuli (67) kuMasipala uMlalazi, uNkk Jadi Ngcobo (86) kuMasipala uMaphumulo, uSinakho Madlala (9) kuMasipala Inkosi Langalibalele noMnuz Sithaba Mpofu (29) wakuMasipala iRay Nkonyeni.UMphathiswa woMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu esifundazweni, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi obehambele oLundi ukuyohlangana nabakhahlanyezwe yilesi simo, usole amasela emfuyo ngokusha kwale mililo edlangile.Uthi izinduna kumele zisebenzisane nomphakathi ukuthi kwenziwe uphenyo lwala bantu abashisa umlilo."Umlilo awuvelanga wazisukela kodwa ushiswe umuntu. Kumele kuphenywe kabanzi. Amasela emfuyo yiwo asusa le mililo ukuze ebe kahle imfuyo. Izinduna azisebenzisane nomphakathi kubanjwe laba bantu,” usho kanje. Uthe usebhalele ungqongqoshe walo mnyango kuzwelonke ekutheni kube nemali ezolekelela ukuze izigameko ezifuze lezi zingashiyi abantu bedengwane."Nginxuse ukuthi u-R100 000 ufakwe kwi-ward ukuze kube lula ukulekelela. KUDONSWE abantu ngendlebe ukuthi bangalinge bathumele imininingwane yabo yasebhange neminye imininingwane eyimfihlo kumaqola azenza sengathi aqoqa intela.Njengoba kuqala isikhathi sokuqoqwa kwentela kubantu, iSouth African Revenue Service (Sars) ikhumbuze abantu ukuthi ayikaze ifune imininingwane yabo yasebhange kwi-email, SMS noma ePosini ngakho uma bethola lesi sicelo kumele bazi ukuthi asiveli kule nhlangano.UMnuz Manie van Schalkwyk oyisikhulu esiphezulu senhlangano elwa nokuqolwa kwabantu, iSouthern African Fraud Prevention Service (SAFPS), uthe njengoba sekuqoqwa intela namasela amatasa afuna intuba yokuqola abantu.Uthe babone ukuthi njalo uma kuqoqwa intela kunezigebengu ezithumelela abantu imilayezo yokuthi seziphothuliwe izinhlelo zabo zentela. Kuye kuthiwe kunemali okufanele ibuyele kubona noma okufanele bayikhokhe.Emuva kwalokho, kuthiwa baye bacele abantu ukuthi bathumele imininingwane yabo yasebhange noma bathunyelelwe ama-link kuma-website angekho semthethweni, lapho kuthiwa mabafake imininingwane yasebhange ukuze bakhokhelwe imali eza ngakubona."Amaqola aze athumele ubufakazi bokuthi imali isifakiwe kwi-akhawunti yomkhokhi wentela kanti lutho. Abantu kufanele baqaphele ngoba amaqola amatasa,” kusho uVan Schalkwyk.Uthe abantu bangayikhiphi imininingwane yabo eyimfihlo noma ngabe amaqola esethi uma bengakhokhi inhlawulo bazojeziswa noma bavalelwe ejele.Ugqugquzele abantu ukuthi bathinte iSars uma bethola imininingwane abangenayo isiqiniseko sayo.Ubalule ukuthi iSars inayo imininingwane yomuntu okhokha intela ngakho uma kufanele abuyelwe yimali izofakwa kwi-akhawunti yakhe ngaphandle kokuthi afake imininingwane yakhe.Uthe abantu kufanele bahlale beqaphile ngoba izigebengu zisebenzisa izindlela ezihlukene ukubaqola.Uphethe ngokuthi kufanele zibikwe emaphoyiseni izigameko zokuqolwa ngoba bathole ukuthi abantu abavamisile ukuzibika.
BEKUKHONA okumtshelayo owesifazane obesekubalwa izinsuku atete, odlule emhlabeni kungqongqa umjondolo abevaleleke kuwo kokheleka neminingi okushiye abaningi abahlala emijondolo eseKenville, eThekwini, besele dengwane, esigamekweni esenzeke ngoMgqibelo ebusuku.Ngesikhathi Isolezwe lifika kuleya ndawo, bekuwunyu nosizi lodwa kumalungu omphakathi amanye abebonakala encike ngengcosana yezimpahla ezisinde kusha. Buqamama, ezansi le, amaphoyisa abematasa nezinsalela zesidumbu sikaNksz Nomthandazo Dawodi (30) nombungu wakhe, okuthiwa ubesengateta noma yinini njengoba bese zevile kweziyisishiyagalombili izinyanga ezithwele.Umngani kamufi uNksz Nonhlanhla Mgwaba imijondolo yabo ebeyincikene, uthe bekungathi kukhona obekumtshela indlela abeyiyo ngaphambi kwalesi sigameko."Okusixakayo ukuthi sipheka endlini yami, kweyakhe uyalala kuphela bekungekho sitofu kodwa umlilo uqale khona. Ngendlela abeyiyo bekungathi uyabikelwa, akazange adle ngisho ukudla, kanti ubethule engaswabulukile njengasemihleni. Ushayela ucingo wonke umuntu wakubo, kuthe kanti sijwayele ukuphuza ukulala, kodwa wathi ucela ukuyophumula ukhathele,” usho kanje.Uthe uzwe ngomsindo abantu beshaya isicabha ukuthi kusha umjondolo wakhe, bazama ukumsiza njengoba ubevaleleke ngaphakathi endlini evalwa ngamaketango, kwasho ukuthi sekuhambe isikhathi, amalangabi asekhotha isibhakabhaka futhi sekokheleke neminye imijondolo."Kwamina ngiphume nengikugqokile kuphela. Kushe konke enginakho; omazisi, izincwadi zezingane zesikole, ukudla, ngisele nginje. Nginezingane ezimbili ezifunda uGrade 10 esikoleni eSea Cow Lake Secondary neyodwa efunda uGrade 4, angazi ngizothathani ngihlanganise nani,” kubalisa yena.Isoka likamufi uMnuz Thulani Mhlongo elidabuka eShowe elithe besebeneminyaka emithathu bethandana futhi bebesebenza ndawonye, lisola ukuthi kukhona okushaya amanzi ngokufa ngesihluku kothandiweyo wakhe."Ugesi ubungakaze uhambe futhi izintambo zikagesi bezingekho esimweni sokuthi sezingasha kuqaleke umlilo, futhi ubewudonsela ukukhanyisa njengoba ubengaphekeli endlini yakhe. Kuyamangaza ukuthi kungani isicabha singavulekanga ngoba bekuyisicabha esidala noma ubani obengasikhahlela sivuleke. Lokhu kwenza ngisole ukuthi kukhona oqale umlilo,” kusho isoka.UMhlongo egcina ukubonana naye emini ngosuku okwenzeke ngalo isigameko, ubewumuntu obengeneme kangangoba wambuza ukuthi kukhona yini okungamphethe kahle kodwa umufi wathi akafuni ukuqhatha abantu. Umtshele ukuthi kunofike kuyena abamjwayele, wathi akathandaze okuyinto esamdida namanje ukuthi ubesho ukuthini njengoba kwehle lesi sehlo. Uthe odokotela bebeqinisekise ukuthi bazothola ingane yomfana.UNksz Ntombozuko Daniso osekomitini lomphakathi uthe yevile ku-270 imijondolo eshile, kanti zingu-89 izingane ezisale zingenamakhaya. Bangu-342 abantu abadala."Okwamanje ngoba kusekusha besingakatshelwa ukuthi sizosizakala kanjani kwazise kusabalwa. Kodwa indlela okwenzeke ngayo, kusihlukumezile kakhulu kangangoba abanye abasele nabakugqokile kuphela,” kusho uNksz Daniso.Kushaye isikhathi sokushicilela amaphoyisa engakayiphenduli imibuzo athunyelelwe yona.
Abezimo eziphuthumayo bafike endaweni yesigameko bathola iveni elilayisha izingane zesikole liginqikile kwaSithebe, eMandeni.Le ngozi yenzeke ngoMsombuluko ekuseni lapho okulilame khona abafundi abangu-15 belimele ngezindlela ezahlukene.Abe-IPSS Medical Rescue bafike bahlola isimo sezingane, abaningi bebenemihuzuko emincane. "Abafundi baphuthunyiswe emtholampilo waseSundumbili. Ngesikhathi kufikwa emtholampilo kutholakale ukuthi abafundi abathathu bahanjiswe emtholampilo ozimele.”Kusenjalo, kushintshe isimo somfundi oyedwa kwaphoqa ukuthi athole usizo lokuqala olukhethekile ngaphambi kokuthi abe-IPSS Medical Rescue bamphuthumise kwenye indawo athole usizo.
ASHESHE akhalelwa amasongo kaSigonyela amadoda amane asolwa ngokuqhumisa imishini yemali eKatlehong naseThokoza.Ithimba labaseshi elisuka ezinhlakeni ezahlukene zezomthetho lisebenze ngokuzikhandla kula masonto amabili adlule lithungatha abasolwa ngokuqhumisa imishini yemali.Uphenyo lubonise inqubekela phambili ngesikhathi kuboshwa abasolwa ababili ngoLwesine, kwathi owesithathu owadubuleka wakwazi ukubaleka. OKUFANELE ingane yakho ebusika: Uchungechunge lwe-Just For Baby Skincare.Ubusika buletha ukuphola nobuhle besizini kodwa bubeka budala izinselelo esikhumbeni esithambile somntana wakho. Umoya obandayo, umswakama ophansi, nokufudumala kwangaphakathi kungasusa umswakama wemvelo, kushiye isikhumba somile, sizwele futhi sisengcupheni yokulimala kalula. Kulobu busika, qinisekisa ukuthi isikhumba sengane yakho sihlala sithambile, sinamanzi futhi sinempilo ngobubanzi ngochungechunge lwe-Just For Baby Skincare. Ifakwe izithako ezipholile nezicebe ngama-antioxidant eRooibos, imikhiqizo yethu inikeza inhlanganisela ephelele yokunakekelwa okumnene nokuvikela okusebenzayo.I-Petroleum Jelly: Umvikeli oguquguqukayo I-Just For Baby Petroleum Jelly yethu, etholakala kuzo zombili izinketho ezinephunga elimnandi nezingenalo iphunga, kufanele ube nayo ebusika. Lo mkhiqizo usebenza ngezindlela eziningi, njengesithiyo esivala umswakama, ugcina isikhumba somntwana wakho sivikelekile ezintweni ezinokhahlo. Umkhiqizo ongenaphunga ufanelekile ezinganeni ezinesikhumba esinokuzwela, ukuqinisekisa ukuvikelwa ngaphandle kwengozi yokuqubuka. Kulabo abajabulela iphunga elimnene, elimnandi, inketho yephunga inikeza ukuvikelwa okufanayo okuhambisana namakha amnandi.Amafutha okugcoba alungele ukuvimbela kanye nokupholisa amaqhubu enziwa yinabukeni, ukuvikela izindebe eziqhekekile, nokuvikeleka okwengeziwe kulezo zihlathi zasebusika ethambile. Ukungaguquguquki kwawo kuqinisekisa ukumata kwesikhumba okuhlala isikhathi eside, okwenza kube yisisekelo esimisweni sokunakekela isikhumba sasebusika somntwana wakho.I-Baby Oil: Ukunakekela okukhethekile kwesikhumba esinozwelaI-Just For Baby Baby Oil, ethakwe kahle ngeRooibos, igcina isikhumba simatile futhi kuqinisekisa ukuthi sihlala sithambile futhi sibushelelezi. Le fomula engasindi, futhi ayikwenzi uxhwathe amafutha kakhulu nokwenza ilungele ukusetshenziswa nsuku zonke, isiza ukuvimbela isikhumba esomile, esiklazukile esivame ukuhambisana nezinyanga ezibandayo.Ukubhucunga ingane yakho Ngamafutha Ezingane akugcini nje ngokuthuthukisa ukuthamba kwesikhumba kodwa futhi kuthuthukisa ukuphumula nokusondelana kwenu. Amakha amnandi e-Rooibos anikeza umuzwa opholile, okwenza ukubhucungwa ngaphambi kokulala kube isiko elisiza ingane yakho ukuthi ihlise umoya futhi ilale kangcono. Amafutha ethu ezingane asiza ukondla isikhumba esinozwelo, anikeze umgoqo ovikelayo kwisomiso sasebusika.I-Aqueous Cream: Isigcobo sansukuzonkeI-Just For Baby Aqueous Cream yethu, etholakala ngezinhlobonhlobo ezinamakha amnandi nezingafakwanga amakha, iyingxenye ebalulekile yanoma yiluphi uhlobo lokunakekelwa kwesikhumba ebusika. Lesi sigcobo esinokhilimu, singena kalula esikhunjeni sifanelwe wukusetshenziswa nsuku zonke, siqinisekisa ukuthi isikhumba somntwana wakho sihlala simatile futhi sinethezekile usuku lonke.Isigcobo esingenawo amakha sifanele izingane ezinesikhumba esizwelayo, sithambisa kalula ngaphandle kwamakha angeziwe. Kubazali abakhetha isigcobo esinamakha ashayela phansi, ukhilimu omatisa kamnandi onephunga elimnandi futhi sithakwe kahle nge-Rooibos.Lesi sigcobo sisetshenziswa emzimbeni wonke, okwenza kube yisixazululo esiguquguqukayo sokugcina isikhumba somntwana wakho sithambile futhi sibushelelezi. Sigcobe ngemva kokugeza ukuze uvale umswakamo noma uwusebenzise usuku lonke ukuze ulungise noma yimaphi amabala omile avela ngenxa yezimo ezinzima zasebusika.Amandla eRooibosOkwenza uchungechunge lwe-Just For Baby luhluke wukusetshenziswa kweRooibos. I-Rooibos iyisithako semvelo esiza ukupholisa nokuvikela isikhumba esithambile sisenza sibe isengezo esifanelekile ohlelweni lokunakekela isikhumba sengane yakho ebusika.Sesiphetha njengoba kuqala ubusika, beka phambili ukunakekelwa kwesikhumba sengane yakho ngochungechunge lwe-Just For Baby. Imikhiqizo yethu, ehlanganiswe nezithako zekhethelo nezivikelayo ze-Rooibos, yenzelwe ukugcina isikhumba sengane yakho sithambile, simatile, futhi sinempilo isizini yonke. Kusukela ekuvikelweni okushintshashintshayo kwe-petroleum jelly yethu kuya ekufakweni okujulile kwe-baby oil yethu nokudla kwansuku zonke kwe-Aqueous Cream, umkhiqizo ngamunye uklanywe ngokucophelela ukuze uhlangabezane nezidingo eziyingqayizivele zesikhumba esithambile somntana wakho.Yenza ubusika kube yisizini yokunethezeka nokunakekela nge-Just For Baby futhi uqinisekise ukuthi ingane yakho ijabulela isizini ngesikhumba esivikeleke kahle, esondlekile, nesithambile kahle.Landela i-Just For Baby: https://www.facebook.com/justforbabysouthafrica
UHOLE amaphoyisa nabekomiti elibhekele ubugebengu emphakathini ukuyokhomba ezinye izindawo aseke wagila kuzo umkhuba, umfundi (17) osolwa ngokuba umalugaju esigodini okuthiwa iseMakhoso, eMthwalume.Kuthiwa umsolwa uvume eyokucathamela izingane ezifunda ezikoleni zamabanga aphansi azidlwengule bese eyazibulala. Kulezi gameko kukhona nesengane eneminyaka eyisishiyagalombili, isidumbu sayo esatholwa silaxazwe ngasemfuleni sesonakele.Lo msolwa ofunda u-Grade 9 esikoleni esisendaweni, ubevele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMzumbe izolo, kulandela isigameko esenzeke ngoLwesithathu okuyisona esimdonsele amanzi ngomsele.Esigamekweni sangoLwesithathu, usolwa ngokuhlasela umfundi owenza u-Grade 1, ephuma esikoleni samabanga aphansi esikhona endaweni. Kusolwa ukuthi umhudulele esikhotheni wamhlubula umfaniswano wesikole abewugqokile nezimpahla zangaphansi wazama ukumdlwengula, ngaphambi kokuthi amgqeme ngetshe ekhanda amklinye, wamshiya ecabanga ukuthi ufile. Inkantolo ilihlehlisele uMsombuluko icala, njengoba kuthiwa emva kokuthi evelile, uhole amaphoyisa eyowakhombisa lapho kwabulawelwa khona uSinethemba Ngcece (8) owayefunda u-Grade 3 eMakhoso Primary. Isidumbu sikaSinethemba satholwa ngoSepthemba nyakenye ngabafana abebebhukuda, silahlwe emhlangeni ngasosebeni lomfula. Kwase kuphele amasonto amathathu edukile, kanti naye wayegcine ukubonakala ephuma esikoleni.Kuthiwa eboshwa umsolwa, emva kwesigameko esenzeke ngoLwesithathu sokuhlaselwa komfundi, uzivumele yena kumalungu omphakathi alandele umkhondo kungakapheli sikhathi kuhlatshwe umkhosi. Amalungu omphakathi ambhadame ezihlalele kubo.Uyise womgilwa elandisa Isolezwe Ngempelasonto, uthe indodakazi yakhe ihlwithwe wumsolwa sekubalwa amagxathu ingene ekhaya njengoba ubeyilandela eduze, udadewabo akazange abone lutho."Umhudulele endaweni eyisikhotha wamenzakalisa. Ingane iphaphame emva kwesikhashana umsolwa esehambile, yangena kwamakhelwane yopha kanzima ekhanda ingakwazi nokuphefumula. Ibihlubule njengoba umsolwa ehambe nezingubo zayo. Bayiphelezelile bangena nayo ekhaya okuyilapho okuhlatshwe khona umkhosi kuthungathwa umsolwa. Ngibonga iNkosi nabakithi ukuthi ingane yami isindile,” kusho yena.Ukuqinisekisile ukuthi indodakazi yakhe iyelulama, wathi izoludinga usizo lokwelulekwa ngengqondo njengoba namanje isathuka izanya.UNkk Bongekile Sithole oyiPhini likaSihlalo wenhlangano engenzi nzuzo, i-Women of Mthwalume obehola umphakathi kulandelwa umkhondo womsolwa uthe: "Siphatheke kabi singamalungu omphakathi ngezehlo okubonakala zilokhu zanda. Sisukumile namalungu esigungu abhekelele ukuphepha emphakathini salandela umkhondo. Sitholile ukuthi umsolwa ufunda esikoleni samabanga aphakeme esikhona endaweni nokuthi ubemisiwe esikoleni. "Amacala abekwe wona awokuzama ukubulala nokudlwengula kodwa sitholile ukuthi uvumile emaphoyiseni icala lokubulawa kukaSinethemba, wathi uzokuya kokhombisa amaphoyisa lapho agila khona lo mkhuba,” usho kanje.Amalungu omphakathi abegcwele ngaphandle kwenkantolo ngesikhathi evela, abengavunyelwe ukungena ngaphakathi.UMphathiswa woMnyango wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi KwaZulu-Natal uNksz Mbali Shinga usigxekile lesi senzo, waqinisekisa ukuthi umgilwa nomndeni bazohlinzekwa ngosizo lokwelulekwa ngokwengqondo.

Ngokusho kukayise omncane kamufi, uMnuz Sthembiso Latha, umsolwa uqhutshwe ngamaphoyisa wayowakhombisa lapho abulalele khona indodana yomfowabo.ULatha uthe umufi uhlaselwe ngezithuba zabo-5 kuya ku-6 ntambama ngeSonto. KUSHAQISILE ukubulawa ngesihluku kukaMnuz Nkanyiso Mhlongo-Latha endaweni yaseXobho Isithombe: SITHUNYELWE"Sengathi ubekomunye umuzi wakwaZuma obekunetiyana khona lapha endaweni yangakithi eSpringvale. Usuke khona ngabo-4 ntambama ewumuntu ozowela emfuleni aye entombini yakhe. Akabange esawela-ke lapho ezansi.” Uthe ube esehlaselwa wumuntu thizeni. "Akwazeki noma lo muntu uqhamuke ngemuva noma baficane lapho kodwa mina ngimfice enezingozi ngemuva. Emklabhile, wamgenca. Wamnquma intamo, wabe esemhlahlela nasesifubeni. Uthulele lapho.” ULatha uthe yena umfice ngezintathakusa ngabo-2 ngoMsombuluko eseshonile.Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kwamaphoyisa aKwaZulu-Natal ayiphumelelanga kwaze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela.
UBEHAMBA ngevesi lokuhlonipha oyinkakha kwezokulingisa uLeleti Khumalo eluleka amaciko abethweswa iziqu emcimbini obubanjelwe eDurban North, eThekwini izolo.ULeleti ukhulume kanje ngesikhathi ethula inkulumo yakhe yokwethula i-Simon "Mabhunu” Sabela Industry Lecture ebihlelwe yiKwaZulu-Natal Tourism and Film Authority.Abafundi abebethweswa iziqu bebeqhamuka esikhungweni esiseMzimkhulu kuMasipala iHarry Gwala nesiseMbazwana, eMkhanyakude.Ezifundweni ebekade bezenza kubalwa izifundo zika-NQF Level 4 no-NQF Level 5 zokubhalwa kwamafilimu nemidlalo yethelevishini, ezokudidiyela nezokuthwebula kusetshenziswa ubuchwepheshe be-drone.Ethula inkulumo yakhe udalule ukubaluleka kokuhlonipha kumkhakha wezokulingisa."Ukuze lo mkhakha ukuhloniphe, kumele uqale wena uwuhloniphe uphinde uzihloniphe wena. Ngeshwa lo mkhakha wezokulingisa usifuna sibahle futhi sakheke kahle kodwa manje izinto ziya ngokushintsha, yingakho ngigcizelela ukuthi kubalulekile ukuthi uzinakekele,” kusho uNksz Khumalo.Uthe ziningi izinselelo umkhakha wezokulingisa oza nazo futhi kumele wazi ukuthi yini ekusebenzelayo njengomlingisi."Abanye bagcina sebezinikela ezidakamizweni. Awukwazi ukuthi ube umlingisi owenza yonke into. Ngokukwazi ukwenza lokho, uzokwazi ukuthi yimuphi umsebenzi okufanele,” usho kanje.Eqhuba uthe kubalulekile kulo mkhakha ukuthi uzwane uphinde wazi abantu futhi uqikelele ukuthi njalo ulola ikhono lakho."Ngeke uphumelele kulolu hambo uma uhamba wedwa. Kumele usebenzise ukuzwana kwakho nabantu ngoba ngeke uphile wedwa. Lo mkhakha unonya kakhulu, abanye bazokudonsela phansi ngoba bebona ikhono lakho onalo elimangalisayo.”"Ungakhululeki kakhulu ngoba ikhono kudingeka ulilole nsuku zonke. Uma usingethwe abantu asebemnkantshubomvu ungasabi ukubabuza ukuthi lokhu kwenziwa kanjani,” ubeke kanje.UMnuz Sbonelo Cele waseLovu KwaZulu-Natal, ongomunye wabathweswe iziqu kwezokuthwebula kusetshenziswa ubuchwepheshe be-drone, ekhuluma neSolezwe, uthe ukwenza lezi zifundo kumba eqolo."Ngiwumuntu ozisebenzayo njengoba ngithwebula izithombe ukuze ngiziphilise. Ngibonge kakhulu ku-KZN Tourism and Film Authority njengoba bekwazile ukungikhokhela uR30 000 izifundo. Ziningi izinselelo ebengibhekene nazo ngesikhathi ngenza lezi zifundo ngoba kumele ufike isonto lonke, okwenze ukuthi ngize ngiyiqede ngawo lo nyaka ngoFebhuwari,” kusho uCele.Uthe ngokomsebenzi awenzayo ukuthola ilayisensi yokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe be-drone kuzomsiza kakhulu."Kuneminye imisebenzi ongakwazi ukuthi ufake izicelo kuyo uma ungenayo ilayisensi. Esikhathini samanje kusebenza izinto zobuchwepheshe, ngakho-ke ukundizisa i-drone kunciphise izindleko zokuqashwa kwendiza enophephela emhlane ohambisana nomthwebuli futhi kulula ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe uma usukwazi njengoba izinto zihlala zishintsha njalo,” usho kanje.USphamandla Mdluli waseMbazwana obenza izifundo zika-NQF Level 5 zokubhalwa kwamafilimu nemidlalo yethelevishini nokudidiyela, uthe ufunde okuningi ngokudidiyela."Ngifunde ukuthi kusukela ngaphambi kokuthi udidiyele, noma usudidiyelile yini okumele uyiqonde futhi uyenze uma usebenza nabantu. Mina bengibhekene nokuhlela isikhathi esiningi, ngafunda nokuthi uqala kuphi uma uhlela,” kusho uMdluli.Uthe kunamafilimu amancane abekade bewenza ngesikhathi besafunda abehlelwa wuye. Uthe ufunde ukuthi kulo mkhakha awusebenzi wedwa kodwa usebenza nabantu abanemiqondo ehlukahlukene.
KUBIKWA ukuthi bathathu abezicishamlilo abashonile ngesikhathi belwa nokuqeda umlilo wequbula ku-R617 ngaseBoston.Kuthiwa lo mlilo uqale epulazini iStirling Farm, wabhebhetheka ngokushesha ngenxa yesimo sezulu esingesihle.Umphathi omkhulu weMidlands EMS, uMark Winterboer, uqinisekise kwabezindaba isibalo sabathathu abashonile wathi owesine uphuthunyiswe esibhedlela esesimweni esibucayi kakhulu.Kuthiwa abashonile ngabesifazane abathathu abasebenzela inkampani. Umphathiswa wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, udlulise amazwi enduduzo ngabezicishamlilo abashonile."Sibuhlungu ngokulahlekelwa abasebenzi abanesibindi abebelwela ukuvikela abanye abantu ukuba bangangeni engozini.”UButhelezi usho lokhu ngesikhathi esoLundi, lapho abehlola khona isimo kulandela umonakalo odalwe wumlilo wequbula. Lapha kushe umhlaba olinganiselwa ku-3 000 hectares ovame kakhulu ukudla imfuyo. Lo mphathiswa ufike ephethe amabhele ukulekelela abanemfuyo engasenakho ukudla, waveza nokuthi uhulumeni usebenza ngokuzikhandla ukusiza labo abasale dengwane.
KUYALELWE uMnyango wezeMpilo kuleli ukuthi ugxile ekulapheni abantu abahaqwe yizifo zengqondo (mental health). Kusolaka sengathi isifo siyathinteka njengoba kwanda amacala athinta udlame lokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane.Lo myalelo ukhishwe amalungu ePhalamende izolo ngesikhathi uNgqongqoshe womnyango uDkt Aaron Motsoaledi, ethula isabelomali sikaR62.2 billion, sonyaka wezimali u-2024/2025.Amalungu ePhalamende akhale ngezinto eziningi ezingalungile kwezempilo. Akhale ngezinkinga ezithinta iziguli ezihlala isikhathi eside ezibhedlela zingalutholi usizo lokuhlinzwa nezinye izinto ngenxa yokushoda kwezinsiza.UMnuz Nhlanhla Gcwabaza weqembu iMK, ukhale ngokuhamba kancane kwezinto ezibhedlela zikahulumeni. Uthe namanje izibhedlela azinalo uhlelo lwezobuchwepheshe olunemininingwane yeziguli."Isiguli siya esibhedlela sokuqala, sithathwe igazi, sidluliselwe kwesinye isibhedlela siphinde sithathwe kabusha igazi. Lapho umuntu ugulela ukufa kodwa kudingeka alinde into angayazi. Iziguli zihlala isikhathi eside zingalutholi usizo ezibhedlela, abanye bafika ezintatha baze bagoduke bengambonanga nodokotela. IPhalamende ilona elibulala abantu ngoba kumele ngabe yilona elishaya imithetho evikela iziguli,” kusho uGcwabaza.UDkt Sophie Thembekwayo we-EFF, uthe kumele izibhedlela zivulwe amahora angu-24 ukuze kusizakale iziguli. Uthe ziningi izinto ezonakele kwezempilo ekubeni inkulu imali ehlinzekwa umnyango.UMnuz Makashule Gana weRise Mzansi, uthe kumele kuqashwe odokotela, abahlengikazi kulungiswe isimo ezibhedlela nasemitholampilo.Ukhale ngokwehla kwesibalo sabantu abadla imishanguzo yokuthithibalisa igciwane iHIV.Usihlalo wekomiti lezeMpilo uDkt Sibongiseni Dhlomo we-ANC, ukhale ngemali ekhokhwa ngumnyango ekhokhela labo abasuke befuna ukunxeshezelwa ngenxa yobudedengu bezibhedlela.Uthe ukube kunohlelo lwezobuchwepheshe olunolwazi lweziguli, ngabe abammeli abathathi amashansi ngamacala athinta ubudedengu ngoba umnyango usuke ungenayo imiqingo nolwazi oluthinta leso siguli."Ayisukunyelwe indaba yezifo zengqondo ngoba andile namacala athinta udlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane nezingane, okungenza ukuthi umthelela isifo sengqondo. Kunesifundazwe esikhokhe uR900 million, sikhokhela amacala athinta ubudedengu bezibhedlela ngenxa yokuthi ulwazi lweziguli alukho kwezobuchwepheshe,” kusho uDhlomo.UMotsoaledi uthe bayazazi zonke izinselelo ezibhekene nomnyango wathi bayazilungisa.Uveze ukuthi bahlabela phambili nomshwalense wezempilo, iNHI."Lo mshwalense uzosiza abantu abantulayo kuleli. Ngonyaka uhulumeni uchitha uR100 billion, ukhokhela abanama-medical aid. Le mali kumele ngabe ifakwa kwezempilo ukuze kuzuze wonke umuntu.”Uthe abasebenzi bakahulumeni, amalungu ePhalamende namajaji, baxhaswa nguhulumeni ngoR70 billion ngonyaka kuma-medical aid.Ubalule ukuthi abanye abasebenzi abanama-medical aid, noma kungathiwa basebenza kumuphi umkhakha baxhaswa nguhulumeni ngoR30 billion."Lo R30 billion usuke ubuyiselwa labo abakhokhela ama-medical aid yisikhwama esiqoqa intela iSARS. Yingakho sithi sihlabela phambili neNHI,”kusonga uDkt Motsoaledi.Esabelweni somnyango kuvele ukuthi uR56 billion, uyiswa ezifundazweni.
IMIFELANDAWONYE yezinyunyana ithi uhulumeni kufanele aqinise isitilobho ezinkampanini ezizimele ukuba zize noguquko njengoba ucwaningo lwakamuva luveza ukuthi izikhundla eziphezulu zisaphethwe ngamadoda abelungu.Kulolu cwaningo olwenziwe wuMnyango wezemiSebenzi, kuvela ukuthi u-61% wezikhundla eziphezulu uphethwe ngabelungu, u-11.6% wazo uphethwe ngamaNdiya, AmaKhaladi aphethe, u-6.1% bese abaMnyama baphathe u-17.2%.Kuthiwa abamnyama baphethe u-17.2% wezikhundla eziphezulu yize u-80% wabasebenzi abaqashwe emazingeni aphansi umnyama.Kuvela ukuthi ezinkampanini ezizimele ezikhundleni zokuphatha amadoda amhlophe aphethe u-48% wazo, kulandele abesifazane abamhlophe ngo-13% kugcine amadoda amnyama ngo-10%.Kubuye kwavela ukuthi izinkampani ezizimele yizona eziqashe kakhulu abantu bokufika.UMnuz Trevor Shaku obhekelele ezokuxhumana, kwiSouth African Federation of Trade Unions (Saftu), uthe kuyishwa ukuthi abantu abamnyama nabesifazane yibona abaningi futhi abenza umsebenzi onzima kodwa bayingcosana ezikhundleni zokuphatha."Uhulumeni kufanele azithathele izinyathelo izinkampani ezizimele ezingazimisele ukuletha uguquko ezikhundleni zokuphatha. Uguquko siyalubona kuhulumeni kodwa asiluboni ezinkampanini ezizimele. Kufanele zihlawuliswe izinkampani ezingazimisele ukunika ababencishwe amathuba ithuba lokuphatha,” kusho uShaku.Uthe bazolwa nalezi zinkinga zokungabikho koguquko futhi bafuna ne-National Minimum wage inyuke ibe wuR72 ngehora ukuze umsebenzi ohola kancane athole uR12 000 ngenyanga.UMnuz Matthew Parks weCosatu uthe kuyaphoxa ukuthi emuva kweminyaka ewu-30 izwe libuswa ngentando yabantu kusenezinkampani ezingafuni ukuthi ebuholini bazo kube nazo zonke izinhlanga zakuleli.Uthe izinkampani ezingenalo uguquko kufanele zibe namahloni bese zijeziswa ngendlela efanele."Kuyaphoxa ukuthi amadoda abelungu asahleli ezikhundleni eziphezulu yize enza isibalo esiwu-4% sabantu bakuleli. Uguquko lukhona kuhulumeni kodwa ezinkampanini ezizimele asiluboni. Siyazi nasePhalamende ukuthi iDA, Action SA ne-FF+ ngamaqembu angahambisani nokuthi ababencishwe amathuba banikwe izikhundla zokuphatha. Sibona amadoda abelungu esaphethe emkhakheni wezezimali, emabhange, kwimishwalense, ezimayini nakwezokuvakasha,” kusho uParks.Uphethe ngokuthi uma uhulumeni ezimisele ngokuletha uguquko akufanele ukuthi agcine ngokwenza ucwaningo kodwa kufanele ajezise izinkampani ezingawulandeli umthetho.
USEMBHIDLANGWENI wokufukula osomabhizinisi abancane uMasipala waseMnambithi, i-Alfred Duma.Lokhu kuvezwe yiMeya yakule ndawo, uKhansela Zama Sibisi ngesikhathi enikezela ngezinsiza ezahlukene kosomabhizinisi abasafufusa. Balinganiselwa ku-100 sebe bonke osomabhizinisi ebehlukene abathole usizo oluvela kulo masipala.Osomabhzinisi ebebelekelelwa basemikhakheni ehlukene, okungabalimi, abathungayo, abadayisa ukudla emgwaqweni nabanye."Siyakholelwa kakhulu ekutheni kumele kube khona okuthile esikwenzela osomabhizinisi bakithi ikakhulu abasafufusa. Sifisa ukubabona bedlondlobala,'' usho kanje uNksz Sibisi.Abadayisa ukudla banikezwe amabhodwe nezitofu zokupheka. Abathungayo bahlomula ngemishini yokuthunga yeqophelo eliphezulu.Abadayisa emgwaqweni banikelelwe ngezindlu abazozisebenzisa ukuze benganethwa yimvula noma bashiswe yilanga.Imeya ithe akumele banyundelwe osomabhizinisi abancane ngoba baklama indima enkulu ekufukulweni komnotho wedolobha.UNksz Sibisi uveze ukuthi bazimisele ngokwenza konke okusemandleni ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bayathuthukiswa osomabhizinisi abancane.''Sifuna ukubona osomabhizinisi bethu abancane bethuthuka kuze kufinyelele kwisigaba sokuthi nabo bagcine sebeqashe abanye abantu,'' usho kanje.Uveze ukuthi basebenzise imali eningi ukufezekisa lolu hlelo ngoba bekholelwa kosomabhizinisi abancane.UNksz Nomalanga Ngubane onebhizinisi lokuthunga onikezwe imishini embili uthe bajabule kakhulu ngokuhlomula ngosizo kumasipala."Ngijabule kakhulu ukuthi lokhu ababekade besithembise khona ekuqaleni basigcinile ngampela isethembiso sabo,'' usho kanje.UMnuz Msawakhe Zindela onikelelwe indlu azosebenzela kuyona edolobheni uthe kungathi uyaphupha ulele kusazothiwa akaphaphame."Namanje angikakholwa ukuthi lento yenzekile ngampela,'' usho kanje.UNksz Sibisi uthe lusatshalaliswe ezingxenyeni ezahlukene zaseMnambithi."Lolu hlelo luhanjiswa kuwona wonke ama-ward ethu akhona lapha eMnambithi,'' usho kanje.Uveze ukuthi kunezinhlelo ezinye abanazo ezimayelana nokuhanjiswa kwentuthuko kubantu bakule ndawo ezifaka phakathi ukuvulwa kwamahholo amasha ezindaweni ezahlukene.
KUGQAME inkinga yokushoda kwamanzi ezindaweni ezehlukene zakuleli, imiphakathi ephuza amanzi nemfuyo kanjalo nokuhluleka kukahulumeni ukuxazulula lezi zinselelo.Lokhu kuvele ngesikhathi kwethulwa isabelomali sikaR134 billion soMnyango wezaManzi nokuHanjiswa kweNdle ePhalamende.Amalungu ePhalamende akhale ngokuthi izinkinga zamanzi azibhekene kuphela nabantu abahlala emakhaya kodwa nasemadolobheni.UNksz Nobuntu Webster weBosa ukhale ngokuthi imiphakathi ithwele kanzima ngenxa yamanzi.Uveze ukuthi ngisho emalokishini asemadolobheni iyinkinga eyamanzi."EThekwini kunenkinga yamanzi ekubeni yidolobha elikhulu. Angiyiphathi ke eyezinye izindawo lapho imiphakathi kudingeka ikhe amanzi emifuleni nasezizibeni ezinezilwane. Iyakhathaza eyokuthi noma kunale nkinga kodwa umnyango ubuyisela emuva imali. Nyakenye kubuyiselwe emuva uR44 million kuMgcinimafa, le mali ngabe isiza umphakathi.”UMnuz Makashule Gana weRise Mzansi uthe bazimisele ukweseka umnyango kodwa uma uzohlinzeka abantu ngamanzi.Ukhale esifanayo ngezindawo eziningi kuleli ezingenawo amanzi."Abantu kumele bathole amanzi ahlanzekile. Nathi lapha ePhalamende uma sithi amanzi ethu ahlanzekile, kumele ngabe asiphuzi amanzi athengwe ezitolo kodwa siphuze aphuma empompini. Asiphuze amanzi aphuzwa yiwo wonke umuntu.” UMnuz Thembinkosi Mjadu weMK uthe abaseseki lesi sabelomali ngoba abantu abaningi abanawo amanzi.Ubale izindawo ezehlukene ikakhulu KwaZulu-Natal athe zakhele amadamu amakhulu kodwa azinawo nhlobo amanzi."Abantu abanawo amanzi. Kudingeka kusheshiswe ukuhlinzekwa kwabantu ngamanzi.” UNgqongqoshe walo mnyango, uNksz Pemmy Majodina, uneke eyezinhlelo ezehlukene zokulwa nenkinga yamanzi.Uthe kunezinhlelo zokulungisa amadamu ezindaweni ezehlukene eKZN, ezizoletha amanzi."Kunamadamu afana neHazelmere azokwandisa indaba yamanzi eThekwini nakwezinye izindawo. Kunamanye azokwandisa amanzi eMkhomazi, Bulwer, enyakatho yeKZN, Port Shepstone nakwezinye izindawo.” Uvumile ukuthi iTheku libhekene nenkinga yamanzi, wakhala ngokuthi amanzi amaningi ayamosheka kuleli."Siyizwe elisebenzisa kakhulu amanzi. Amanye amanzi ayamosheka agcina engafinyelelanga emphakathini. Lokhu kudalwa ukuvuza kwawo kanjalo nengqalasizinda esindala,” usho kanje.Ukhale nangemvula ehambisana nezikhukhula athe ilimaza ingqalasizinda."Siyayithanda imvula kodwa uma isihamba nezikhukhula ilimaza ingqalasizinda. Imvula yenza ukuthi amadamu angashodi ngamanzi. Ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu kuyasilimaza ngoba izikhukhula zango-2022, 2023 nezamanje eKapa, zilimaza le ngqalasizinda yamanzi kanjalo neyokuthuthwa kwendle,” kusho uNksz Majodina.UMnuz David Mahlobo, iPhini likaNgqongqoshe walo mnyango, lithe ngeke kubekhona ukushoda kwamanzi kuleli.Uthe kunemali evile kuR40 billion ukusiza omasipala ababhekene nenkinga yamanzi.

Wahamba amanye amaqembu eseke azama ukumkhipha ngevoti kodwa ahluleka.UKaunda wazishaya isifuba ngokuthi ushiye umbiko omuhle wokusebenza kwezimali. msebenzi esaboshiwe.UNksz Lukhaimane, oyiPension Funds Adjudicator, uthe kubalulekile ukuthi izikhwama zempesheni zikhokhe imali kubantu abafanele ukugwema ukuqolwa yizigebengu.Uyalele iMunicipal Gratuity Fund ukuba inikeze lo msebenzi, owayeqashwe yinkampani ebhekelele ezemfucuza kuMasipala waseGoli, iPikitUp, uR800 000 nenzalo yakhona eyanikwa umuntu ongafanele.Lo msebenzi, okungacaci ukuthi wayeboshelweni, wafaka icala ehhovisi likaNksz Lukhaimane ekhala ngokuthi emuva kokuboshwa ngo-2016 wathola ukuthi imali yakhe yempesheni ewu-R810 413.07 yakhokhelwa umuntu ongafanele ngoSepthemba ka-2018.Uthe wayesejele ngesikhathi imali ikhishwa futhi uma esephumile uthole ukuthi kunesitatimende somkokotelo okwathiwa uvuma kuso ukuthi imali uyayifuna, kwathunyelwa namafomu anamaphutha kwathiwa yiwona ayegunyaza isikhwama ukuba sikhiphe imali.Uthe isitatimende esifungelwe sasingenaso nesigxivizo futhi singasayiniwe, okubeka obala ukuthi sasiwumkokotelo.UNksz Lukhaimane uthe lesi sikhwama sakhokha imali yize kwakucaca ukuthi kunenkohlakalo eqhubekayo.Ubalule ukuthi ngoFebhuwari ka-2016 ngesikhathi isikhwama sicela ikhophi kamazisi womsebenzi egxiviziwe, umqashi wathi ngeke akwazi ukuyikhipha ngenxa yokuthi usejele.Uthe ngisho ngoJuni 22 ka-2018 isikhwama sempesheni saqinisekisa ukuthi usesejele kodwa saqhubeka nokukhuluma nesigebengu esasizenza lo msebenzi nge-email.Umsebenzi uthe isikhwama sempesheni sakhokha sibe sazi kahle ukuthi usejele, akakwazi ukuxhumana nabantu nge-email.Isikhwama sithe sona sathola isaziso sakuqinisekisa ukuthi i-akhawunti okufakwa kuyo imali ngeyomsebenzi sase sidedela imali ngoSepthemba ka-2018.Siveze ukuthi sithole ngoJanuwari ka-2019 sesitshelwa yiBidvest Bank ukuthi i-akhawunti okwafakwa kuyo imali ngeyamaqola antshontsha imininingwane yabantu ukuze akhwabanise imali yabo.Sithe savula necala emaphoyiseni emuva kwalesi sigameko.UNksz Lukhaimane uthe isikhwama saba budedengu ngokuthi sikhokhe imali ekubeni sitsheliwe ukuthi umuntu usejele."Kuyacaca ukuthi isikhwama sasitsheliwe ukuthi umsebenzi usejele. Asizange siyikhiphe imali ngo-2016 njengoba umqashi wayeshilo ukuthi umnikazi wemali usejele. Kuyamangaza ukuthi asizange siyobheka ukuthi kwenzekani njengoba esefuna imali. Kuyaziwa ukuthi umuntu osejele akakwazi ukuxhumana kalula nabantu abangaphandle ngakho kuyamangaza ukuthi isikhwama sempesheni sakhokha imali singazange siqinisekise ukuthi umuntu okhokhelwayo usephumile yini ejele,” kusho uNksz Lukhaimane.Uthe ukube lesi sikhwama besingekho budedengu ngemali yabantu, bekufanele sazi ukuthi ejele awukhulumi nesiboshwa bengazi ojele futhi abantu ababoshiwe abakwazi ukuvula ama-akhawunti asebhange.Ubalule ukuthi izikhwama zempesheni zinesibophezelo sokuphatha kahle imali yabantu, singayiniki amaqola ngakho-ke kufanele sikhokhele lo msebenzi imali yakhe nenzalo yayo.
OWESILISA obesolwa ngokuba ungqondongqondo wokusocongwa kukamshayeli wezimoto ezikhokhelwa ngokwamabanga eziwahambayo ulahlwe yicala.Umufi uMnuz Siboniso Shangase kuvela ukuthi ngoFebhuwari 2021, wathola isicelo sokuba ahambise owesilisa emsusa emgwaqweni uMointy Nacker amyise eQueensburgh.Owesilisa owayenze lesi sicelo nguLuyanda Makhanya, kuvela ukuthi wayehambisana nomngani wakhe u-Ayanda.Kuvela ukuthi umufi wabathatha wabayisa lapho ababethe bafuna ukuya khona. Kuthiwa bamjikela endleleni bamphuca imoto.Ngemuva kwalokho bamklinya, bambopha nezinyawo base bethatha isidumbu sakhe basifaka ngemuva emotweni.Ngemuva kwalokho, kuthiwa basithatha basiphosa ehlathini laseMlaza. Bathatha imoto kamufi yohlobo lweToyota Etios, babeyishayela njalo uma bephuma esikoleni.Bakhalelwa ngamasongo kaSigonyela behamba ngayo imoto, base bewakhombisa amaphoyisa ukuthi isidumbu sikuphi.Ngaphambilini, inkantolo ilalele ubufakazi obehlukene obebuthulwa ngabantu ebehlukene. Omunye wabo kwakunguConstable Patrick Xaba owayekhona ngesikhathi kuthathwa isidumbu sikamufi eMlaza.Walandisa inkantolo ngesimo sesidumbu, eveza ukuthi sase sonakele kangakanani. Wadalula nokuthi iphunga laso lalivimbanisile ngenxa yokuthi kwase kuphele isikhathi eside sisehlathini.Waveza nokuthi kwakungelula ukubona ukuthi ngesikabani isidumbu kodwa wathi ilungu lomndeni lalingabona uma lizazi izingubo zikamufi.Ubuso bukamufi kuthiwa kwakungeselula ukububona ngenxa yokuthi base budliwe yizibungu.UMshushisi u-Advocate Thabani Buthelezi wanxusa inkantolo ukuba yenze okufanelekile, ekhala ngonya olwakhonjiswa ngesikhathi kusocongwa umufi.IJaji uWilliem Nicholson limlahle ngecala uLuyanda njengoba kunguyena owenza isicelo sokubiza umshayeli we-Bolt.Ungoti wenkampani iBolt South Africa, uMnuz Benjamin Meyer, wageqa amagula echazela inkantolo ngobufakazi abanabo obuqoshiwe ngosuku lwesigameko.Wavezela inkantolo ukuthi ngokujwayelekile uma umshayeli ethola isicelo sokulanda umgibeli kuyavela kubona, wathi uma esemthathile kuyavela kubona futhi uma esekhokheliwe kuyavela ngoba umshayeli kunebhathini alicifizayo lokukhombisa ukuthi usemtholile umgibeli futhi usemkhokhelile.Uthe kodwa ngosuku lokusocongwa kukamufi akazange alicifize ibhathini eliveza ukuthi usefikile lapho ayoshiya khona umgibeli. Lokhu wathi kwakungabangelwa ukuthi wayesevele eseshonile.Uthe umufi akalicifizanga nebhathini lokuthi ukhokheliwe, nalapho wathi yingoba akazange akhokhelwe.Namhlanje uyagwetshwa.

IBINQUNYELWE ujuqu wokuthi lingashayi elanamhlanje isaphila inhlalisuthi eyisethenjwa somholi wamaNazaretha, Inkosi Mduduzi Shembe (uNyazilwezulu), elalelwe unyendle yathelwa ngoyaba lwezinhlamvu kodwa yaphuma ingenamyocu KwaMashu ngoLwesine.UMnuz Xolani "Maliyavuza” Zungu uhlaselwa nje ubekade ebuya kogubha usuku lwakhe lokuzalwa. Ngaphambi kwalokhu kuhlaselwa ubethole umyalezo oputshukile wagcina ufike kuyena, kukhona oveza ukuthi akumele kushaye uLwesihlanu (namhlanje) esaphila. Isolezwe linawo lo myalezo oyiphimbo lowesifazane. Uthe ubesathi uzoyobika emaphoyiseni.ISALE nezimbobo zenhlamvu imoto kaMnuz Xolani 'Maliyavuza’ Zungu othe udutshulwe abantu abangaziwa ephuma kogubha usuku lokuzalwa Isithombe: SITHUNYELWEElandisa ngokusinda kwakhe, uZungu uthe: "Bengihamba ngemoto nginganakile ebusuku ngibuya kogubha usuku lokuzalwa nabasebenzi bami eThekwini ngesikhathi kuqhamuka imoto evele yama phambi kwami ngangakwazi ukudlula. Ngisamangazwe yilokho, kuphume umfana omfishane nesibhamu esincane waqhulula ngenhlamvu ebhekise kimi ngisemotweni. Usuke ezitshela ukuthi useqedile ngami wabuyela emotweni bashaya bachitha. Ngamandla kaNkulunkulu woNyazilwezulu angitholanga ngisho umyocu kodwa imoto isale imbobombobo. Ngisuke lapho ngaya esiteshini samaphoyisa ukuyovula icala ngosekungehlele. Kulapho ngifike ngabona khona sesibala izimbobo zezinhlamvu ukuthi ngidutshulwe ngezinhlamvu ezingu-8,” kusho uZungu othe imoto isasele khona esiteshini samaphoyisa KwaMashu.UZungu ungenye yezinhlalisuthi eziyizethenjwa zoNyazilwezulu nehlala iseceleni kwalo mholi ngaso sonke isikhathi uma ehamba. Abaningi bamazi ngokuhlala egibele isithuthuthu esihamba phambi kwezimoto zoNyazi ukuphendla indlela uma kunemihlangano yamaNazaretha.Isolezwe like labhala ngaye emva kokwethweswa icala lokudlwengula, elibuyela eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini namuhla. Lo wesifazane ozwakala emyalezweni uyaziqhathulula, uthi akazimisele ukuba yingxenye yokuthi kusocongwe le nhlalisuthi njengoba kunetulo elinjalo.Uzwakala ebiza igama lenye inhlalisuthi, nayo eyisethenjwa soNyazi, ukuthi iyona epheka itulo lokuthi kubulawe uZungu. Uveza ukuthi yena akazimisele ukuthi abe yingxenye yaleli tulo. Uthi yena usafuna ukuphila kahle akhulise nezingane zakhe, angabi yingxenye yokubulawa kwabantu. Uqhuba athi abafuna ukubulala uZungu abaziqhubekele bodwa bangamfaki yena. Inhlalisuthi ayibala kule nkulumo ingenye yezisanda kuxoshwa ebandleni lamaNazaretha ngezinsolo zamatulo amabi okuthiwa iwaphekela uNyazi. Leli phephandaba izolo libike ngokujamelana kwenhlalisuthi okuthiwa isize yaba ngamaqembu amabili khona eBuhleni.Imizamo yeSolezwe yokuthola ukuphawula kwamaphoyisa ayiphumelelanga izolo kwaze kwashaya isikhathhi sokushicilela.
AYIPHUMELELANGA imizamo ye-EFF neMK ePhalamende yokuthi kuhlehliswe inkulumo yokuvulwa kwePhalamende nguMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ngesonto elizayo.La maqembu abefuna inkulumo ihlehliswe ngenxa yokuthi sincane isikhathi esinikwe amakomiti ukuthi aphasise isabelomali seminyango, okumele kuphothulwe kule nyanga.Okukhalisa i-EFF neMK wukuthi, uRamaphosa wenze kwaba nalesi simo sokusheshisa izinto ngenxa yokuthi waphuza ukukhetha iKhabhinethi entsha ngenxa yokuthi kwakusaqhubeka izingxoxo zamaqembu zokubumba uhulumeni.Emhlanganweni wekomiti lemigomo lasePhalamende izolo, uDkt Mbuyiseni Ndlozi we-EFF, ukhononde ngokuthi amalungu ePhalamende anikwe isikhathi esincane sokuthi afundisise imiqingo ethinta isabelomali.Uveze ukuthi emihlanganweni yamakomiti bekudingeka kukhethwe osihlalo kuphinde, kubhungwe ngeyesabelomali."Yingakho sithi akuhlehliswe ukuvulwa kwePhalamende ngenxa yokuthi nguyena uRamaphosa ophuze ukuqoka iKhabhinethi. Ngemuva kwalokho kudingeke ukuthi kwakhiwe amakomiti asePhalamende, azobhekela iminyango. Ayihlehliselwe u-Agasti eyenkulumo yokuvulwa kwePhalamende ukuze sibe nesikhathi esenele.”UMnuz Mnqobi Msezane weMK, ukhale esifanayo ngokuthi sincane isikhathi esinikwe amalungu ukuthi afunde imiqingo ethinta isabelomali ukuze siphasiswe.Uthe le miqingo ifika ngayizolo ebusuku, ekuseni ngosuku olulandelayo kumele kubhungwe ngayo."Sincane isikhathi esinikwe amalungu amakomitini ukuthi acubungulisise. Amalungu cishe wonke amaqembu akhala esifanayo, yingakho sithi akuhlehliswe imihlangano.”URamaphosa uzothula inkulumo yokuvula iPhalamende lehlandla lesikhombisa likahulumeni, ngoJulayi 18. NgoJulayi 19, kuzoba nenkulumo mpikiswano ngenkulumo kaRamaphosa. NgoJulayi 22, uRamaphosa uzophendula obekushiwo amalungu ePhalamende.UNksz Veronica Mente we-EFF, uthe ukushoda kwezindawo zemihlangano zibhebhethekise isimo njengoba amanye amakomiti kudingeke asheshe aphume lapho abehlangene khona ngenxa adedele elinye ikomiti.Uthe njengoba behlangana njalo beyikomiti lasePhalamende yingoba basuke bezoxoxa ngezingqinamba ezikhona futhi nohlelo lwasePhalamende lungabuyekezwa uma kunezikhalo ngalo. Amakomiti azokwazi ukuhlala kumele aqhubeke, kuthi lawo anezinselelo kuhlehliswe imihlangano.”Uthe njengoba emaningi amaqembu ayingxenye yePhalamende babona ukuthi kungcono kwandiswe izinsuku ukuze athole ithuba lokuphawula enkulumeni kaRamaphosa.Usotswebhu we-ANC uMnuz Mdumiseni Ntuli, unxuse ukuthi kungashintshwa uhlelo lokuvulwa kwePhalamende ngoba kubalulekile ukuvulwa kwale ndlu kuleli hlandla.
KUPHAZAMISEKE ukufunda esikoleni iNkoningi Primary, eNtambanana, abafundi bezithela phezu kwesidumbu sikathishomkhulu silenga ngentambo kwelinye lamakilasi, emagcekeni esikole ngoLwesine ekuseni, okukholakala ukuthi uzibulele.UMnuz Welcome Mathenjwa (43) okuthiwa bekungakapheli nezinyanga eziyisithupha ethathe isikhundla sokuba wuthimkhulu kulesi sikole, kukholakala ukuthi uzilengise ngoLwesithathu ebusuku, njengoba isidumbu sakhe kuthiwa sibonwe abafundi ekuseni, silenga ekilasini obekungafundeli muntu kulo elisondelene nekhishi lapho bephakelwa khona.Umthombo weSolezwe ocele ukungadalulwa, ongomunye wabazali bezingane ezifunda kulesi sikole, uthe umufi ngosuku olwandulela okutholakale ngalo isidumbu sakhe, uvalelise othisha ngokubosela inyama, kungekho okusolisayo."Kuthiwa ubize othisha wabosela inyama kwamnandi nje ngaphakathi esikoleni kungekho okusolisayo.
