BAZOTHOLA umthobanhliziyo kaR20 000 umuntu ngamunye abasebenzi bakwaFord abebetelekela amabhonasi akhethekile.Lezi zindaba zivezwe uNobhala Jikelele we-National Union of Metalworkers of South Africa (Numsa), uMnuz Irvin Jim.Abasebenzi bakwaFord baqale isiteleka ngoJulayi 4 bafuna ukuthi uma inkampani yenze inzuzo nabo bahleshulelwe kuleyo mali njengoba kwenzeka ezikhulwini. Bathe ngeke kwenzeke inzuzo uma bengasebenzi ngokuzikhandla.Bathe abahambisani nokuthi izikhulu zidle zodwa ekubeni nabo besebenza kanzima.UJim uthe yize iFord yayithole incwadi evimbela abasebenzi ukuba bateleke, iningi labo lathi alibuyeli emsebenzini izikhalo zabo zingaphenduliwe."Besilokhu sixoxa nabakwa-Ford Motor Company of Southern Africa sizama ukuxazulula lolu daba, baphuma nesisombululo sokuthi bazokhokhela abasebenzi uR20 000 umuntu ngamunye ukuze babuyele emsebenzini. Lokhu akusho ukuthi sebezimisele ukucazela abasebenzi inzuzo, kodwa yindlela yabo yokuxoxisana nathi ngendlela efanele,” kusho uJim.Uthe abasebenzi babuyele emsebenzini ngokugcwele ngoLwesihlanu."Yize iFord ithi lokhu akusho ukuthi isicazela abasebenzi inzuzo yayo, kodwa sikholwa wukuthi lesi sinyathelo sibalulekile ekukhumbuzeni izinkampani ukuba zidle nabasebenzi. Lesi simo sizosiza ekunciphiseni igebe elikhulu phakathi kwabacebile nabampofu,” kusho uJim.IFord Motor Company of Southern Africa ithe isiteleka esiqale ngoJulayi 4 sesixazululiwe ngaphandle kwezihibe."Bonke abasebenzi akade betelekile bazobuyela emsebenzi ngoLwesihlanu (12 Julayi) ukuze kuqhubeke ukukhiqizwa kweFord Ranger efemini yethu eseSilverton,” kusho iFord esitatimendeni.
UMPHATHISWA woMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal, uMfundisi Thulasizwe Buthelezi, uthi kumele uhulumeni enyuse imali esinikezwa omasipala, ngenxa yezinhlekelele ezibangelwa ukuguquguquka kwesimo sezulu, esivamise ukushiye amalungu omphakathi esele dengwane.UButhelezi ukusho lokhu njengoba kusabatshazwa umonakalo odalwe umlilo wequbula obukhashwa yisishingishane somoya onamandla oshiye kukhalwa kwabanye omasipala abekhele lesi sifundazwe, kungqongqa imizi yabantu, imfuyo nempahla ebalulekile."Selokhu siwuqalile lo nyaka, inyanga nenyanga kuba nenhlekelele kanti omasipala abanayo imali eyanele yokubhekana nalezi zinto ngoba uma inhlekelele yenzeka, abantu babika ekhanseleni noma kwimeya kamasipala. Njengomphathiswa womnyango, lokhu ngizokubheka sibone ukuthi omasipala singabalekelela kanjani ekutheni isabelomali senyuswe ukuze bekwazi ukubhekana ngqo nalesi simo,” kusho uButhelezi.Uthe abantu sebekhuzwe kakhulu ekutheni uma beqala umlilo kwesinye isikhathi ngenhloso yokubabela ikhaya, kumele bawugade umlilo ukuthi ungeqi. UButhelezi noMphathisa woMnyango wezokuThutha nokuHlaliswa KwaBantu esifundazweni, uMnuz Siboniso Duma, kuzothi namhlanje bayobhonga emswaneni emzini wakwaGazu eZinyosi ku-ward 1, ngaphansi kukaMasipala Umlalazi. Kudlule emhlabeni khona ilungu lomndeni, uMnuz Mntukabongwa Gazu (67) okuthiwa ushe wangqongqa nendlu abekuyo ngesikhathi umlilo ushisa izindlu ezintathu kulo muzi ngeSonto ebusuku, kanti elinye ilungu lalo mndeni lingeniswe esibhedlela lilimele kabi.UDuma uthe umnyango wakhe unezinhlelo zokuthi umndeni wakwaGazu wakhelwe indlu yesikhashana ukuze ukwazi ukugoba amadlangala kuyo, uzile ngesikhathi kuqhubeka izinhlelo zokufihlwa kukaGazu."Ithimba lokuphiko lokuHlaliswa KwaBantu eliholwa yinhloko yomnyango, uMnuz Mdu Zungu, liyaqhubeka nomsebenzi wokwakha indlu yesikhashana ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umndeni uzilela ngesizotha othandiweyo wawo. Ukuhlonzwa kwemindeni ethintekile kwehla inhlekelele kuyaqhubeka, ngoba asifuni kube khona abakhahlamezwe yilesi simo abashiyeka ngaphandle,” kusho uDuma.Izindawo ezithinteke ngenxa yale nhlekelele ngezakhele oMasipala Umlalazi, Inkandla, Umvoti nowaKwaNongoma.
MANCANE amathuba okuthi izinkawu ezijwayelekile, ezihlale zibonakala emakhaya kuleli, zisabalalise upokisi wezinkawu, iMpox.Lokhu kushiwo ongoti bezempilo baseNyuvesi yaKwaZulu-Natal ngesikhathi kunesigcawu sokucobelelana ngolwazi mayelana neMpox. UDkt Richard Lessens uthe igciwane, imonkeypox, isezinkawini zase-Afrika emaphakathi nezwe, eligcine selitheleleka nakubantu lisuka ezilwaneni. "Baningi abantu abakhathazeke ngokuthi eThekwini kunezinkawu eziningi, bacabanga ukuthi zingalisabalalisa leli gciwane kanti akunjalo. Izinkawu ezinaleli gciwane ezamaphakathi ne-Afrika futhi kunohlobo oluthile lwegciwane olusabalalayo. Njengamanje eDRC kunohlobo olusha, iClade IIb, olusabalala kakhulu yingakho bebaningi abantu abatheleleka ngalesi sifo kuleliya lizwe. Emazweni analeli gciwane lasuka ezinkawini, njengamanje lithelelana ngokuthintana kwabantu nakuleli kunjalo," kusho yena.Uqhube wathi nakuba kukuningi abangakakwazi ngalesi sifo kodwa bayacabanga ukuthi ukubheduka kwaso kudalwe ukuthi ukugomela iSmallpox kuleli kwavalwa eminyakeni engu-40 eyedlule."IMpox iyigciwane elisemndenini owodwa nowe-Smallpox. Umgomo ovikela iSmallpox uyayivikela iMpox. Esingakakuqondi kahle okwamanje ukuthi kungani iziguli ezineHIV ezine-Cd4 Count engaphansi kuka-350 zigule kangaka," kuchaza uDkt Lessens.USolwazi Nokukhanya Msomi, owungoti wezifo ezidalwa amagciwane, uthe okwamanje isikhungo esihlola uketshezi esibhekelele ukuhlola lesi sifo sisakwazi ukumelana nomthamo okhona woketshezi okumele luhlolwe. USolwazi Yunus Moosa uthe okwamanje zonke iziguli ezingu-20, ezike zahaqwa yileli gciwane kuleli zilaliswe esibhedlela, zigula kakhulu."Esikwaziyo ukuthi okwamanje zonke iziguli ezihaqekile ngabesilisa abaya ocansini nabanye, iMpox ziyithole ngokusondelana nabanayo. Ngalokho angichazi ukuthi lesi sifo sithelelana ngocansi. Uketshezi oluphuma ezilondeni yilona olusuke lunegciwane. Ludlulela komunye ngokuthi uketshezi lungene esikhunjeni esilimele okungaba esisikekile, esishile noma esinomhuzuko,” kusho uSolwazi Moosa.
SIVUNDULULWE abahlala emgwaqweni sinezibazi zokushiswa, sesonakele, isidumbu sengane engaziwa okukholakala ukuthi ineminyaka eyisikhombisa, esitholwe epaki iLotus eSiphingo, ngoMsombuluko.UNksz Dawn Gounden we-Renegades Search and Rescue unxuse ukufuniswa umndeni kamgilwa isidumbu sakhe okuthiwa bese sesonakele okukholakala ukuthi bese kunesikhathi eside senzakaliswa, sagqitshwa ethuneni elingashoni kakhulu, esibonwe ngabahlala emgwaqweni."Bathinte amaphoyisa nabeRenagades and Rescue, kanti isidumbu besisemweni esibi kakhulu, sesingasabonakali kahle obekukhombisa ukuthi bese kunesikhathi sagqitshwa futhi sinezibazi zokusha. Sinxusa usizo emphakathini ukuthi usilekelele ekutholeni ulwazi olungaholela ekutholakaleni komndeni,” kusho uNksz Gounden.Kwenzeka lokhu nje, umndeni waseMalukazi uphansi phezulu uthungatha indodakazi yawo uZekhethelo Luphalule (6) osekuyophela inyanga anyamalala njengoba egcine ukubonwa ngoJuni 20, 2024.UNksz Gounden uqinisekise ukuthi umndeni kaZekhethelo ufikile ukuzobheka isidumbu esitholiwe kodwa kwatholakala ukuthi akuyena. Uthe kungenzeka ukuthi isidumbu esitholiwe akusona esasendaweni kodwa ingane ibulawe kwenye indawo yayisizolahlwa eSiphingo. Ugqugquzele abantu ukuthi baqinisekise ukubika emaphoyiseni uma kunomuntu onyamelele, ukuze besizakale, bekwazi ukufuniswa abathandiweyo babo.Isihlava sokubulawa kwezingane kumbe sokuduka kwezingane zitholwe sezibulewe kubukeka sidla lubi kulesi sifundazwe. Kuthe ngesonto eledlule kwatholwa isidumbu sikaSifundo Mkhize (7) waseZinketheni, eMgungundlovu, sivalelwe endlini kamakhelwane siboshwe izandla nezinyawo sinenxeba esiphangeni. Kulesi sigameko kukholakala ukuthi senziwe umakhelwane obefuna ngodli umsebenzi kuyise kamufi, okuholele ekutheni amalungu omphakathi athukutheliswe yilesi senzo amhlasele umsolwa ambulale.ULisulenkosi Lamula (2) waseMakhazane, oLundi, isidumbu sakhe sitholwe emasontweni amabili edlule ethoyilethi lomgodi emva kosuku edukile ngesikhathi bekunomcimbi ezihlobeni zomndeni. Umndeni usola isandla semfene ngokufa kwakhe.Mayelana nesidumbu esingaziwa esitholwe eSiphingo ngoMsombuluko, okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant Colonel Thenjiswa Ngcobo, uthe amaphoyisa aseSiphingo aphenya icala lokubulala."Imibiko iveza ukuthi isidumbu sengane engaziwa sitholwe sesonakele ehlathini kubonakala sengathi sasiqale sashiswa,” usho kanje.
ISINGENE kwelinye igiya ingxabano esuswe ukuxoshwa kwabathile abebesondele enkosini yamaNazaretha uNyazilwezulu yohlangothi lwaseBuhleni. Isolezwe lihabule ukuthi ngemuva kokugudluzwa kwamalungu abenukwa ngokwakha itulo elibi elibhekiswe ekuphazamiseni ubuholi boNyazi kudaleke uqhekeko phakathi kwenhlalisuthi eyizethenjwa okumanje isize yaziqamba amaqembu. Kuthiwa kula maqembu kukhona elizibiza ngoBumbano Cop 17 kuthi elinye libizwe ngaBathandi beQiniso. Lesi simo sesidale uvalo ngokuthi kungaba khona uthuthuva olunganqandeki uma singalungiseki. Umthombo ongaphakathi ebandleni uthe iNhlalisuthi yaziwa ngokukhuluma ngazwi linye okwenza le ngxabano esanda kuqubyuka ishayise ngovalo."Ayikaze yenzeke le nto ukuthi kuxabane inhlalisuthi yodwa esontweni. Indaba isuswe ukuthi kususwe inhlalisuthi ebisondele eduze koNyazilwezulu yayalelwa ukuthi ingaphinde ingene esontweni futhi ingalubhadi kuwona wonke amathempeli ebandla ngaphansi koNyazilwezulu,” kusho umthombo. "Okwenzekayo manje nokufakela abantu uvalo ukuthi iNhlalisuthi ememezele ukuthi kusuke le ebiseduze koNyazilwezulu, iyona esibonakala isondele kulona igade uNyazi. Le exoshiwe okuthiwa akulindelekile ukuthi ibonakale ebandleni ifika ngenkani futhi iyabonakala ukuthi ifuna ukuba seduze koNyazi. "Lokhu kwenza kungabi nakho ukuthula njengoba sekuke kwaba nanesimemezelo esisabalale nge-voice note (izwi eliqoshiwe) kuthiwa iNhlalisuthi akumele ithathe izinqumo esontweni. Sekuphinde kwagqama nendaba yala maqembu eNhlalisuthi esihlukene phakathi ebandleni,” kusho umthombo.Leli phephandaba lishayele ucingo enye yezinhlalisuthi okukholakala ukuthi yiyo eyenza isimemezelo sokumisa le esolwa ngokuba namatulo amabi abhekiswe kuNyazilwezulu, ethe ngeke ikwazi ukuphawula. Ithe umuntu ovumeleke ukuphawula ngezindaba zesonto uMnuz Thokozani Mncwabe kuphela.Ethintwa uMncwabe, uthe uyayazi yonke le nhlalisuthi ngokuzihlukanisa kwayo ngamaqembu."Ngokwazi kwami bonke laba bantu bathanda inkosi uNyazilwezulu. Angiboni ukuthi abasazwani ngalolo hlobo kodwa engikubonayo kube wukuphambana kwemibono nje kubona. Ngokuvunyelwa yinkosi uNyazilwezulu ngizokwazi ukuhlala nabo phansi kodwa nabo kumele bakhombise ukuthi bazimisele ukuthi lolu daba luxazululeke. Ngisho inkosi iNyangayezulu yathi uma kukhona lapho singaboni khona ngaso linye kumele sihlale phansi silulungise lolo daba,” kusho uMncwabe.Uthe phambilini kwakunabaholi bezinsizwa ababebheka yonke into ethinta izinsizwa obekungabikwa kubona ukuba basekhona. Uthe njengoba bengasekho manje sekungaba yibona abangangenelela ukulungisa isimo.
SIYINDABA egudwini kumalungu omphakathi waseMtshebheni, eNanda, isigameko sokubulawa kowesifazane oyedwa kwase kudutshulwa namalungu akhe omndeni.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi uNksz Zandile Ndlovu (38) udutshulwe ngoyaba lwezinhlamvu ngesikhathi emzini wakhe kugasela amadoda amahlanu abehlome eyizingovolo.Amdubula nje ubengena esangweni esedubule alimaza indondana yakhe nelinye ilungu lomndeni. Kuthiwa abahlaseli bangene badubula laba ababili, okuthe uma kungena lo wesifazane esangweni, kwazwakala omunye wabo ethi "Majita, nangu umuntu ebesimzele”, kwase kukhala inganono wasala edindilizile njengoba efele khona lapho. Kuvela ukuthi la madoda afike apaka imoto kude nasegcekeni lakwaNdlovu ase asondela ngezinyawo.Umthombo uthi acuthe esangweni okuthe uma kuthushuka indodana yakhona ayidubula yalimala kabi onyaweni.Angene ngaphakathi adubula umkhulu wakhona esiswini ophuthunyiswe esibhedlela. Kuthiwa amadoda aphume abaleka kwathi esengenhla abonakala engena emotweni emnyama abekade eyipake kude maqede akhala amaphepha."Sididekile sonke lapha emphakathini, asazi ukuthi ingampela ubulaweleni lo wesifazane. Okusixakayo ukuthi besingakaze sizwe ukuthi kukhona umuntu axabene naye kumbe ke umuntu angazwani naye,'' kuchaza umthombo.Omunye umthombo osondelene nomufi kodwa ocele ukuba ligodlwe igama lawo, uthe badukuza ebumnyameni mayelana nokuthi kungani kuhlaleselwe lo mndeni."Kuyaxaka ngampela ukuthi kungamane kuhlaselwe umndeni esingawazeli lutho kodwa umane uhleselwe ngale ndlela. Kubi ngampela lokhu esikubone kwenzeka kuleli khaya,'' usho kanje.Umufi kuvela ukuthi akukho lapho abesebenza khona.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi eminyakeni emine eyadlula umfowabo kamufi owayenesitolo sokudayisa utshwala, naye wahlaselwa ngamadoda amane ambulala ngokumdubula.Kuze kube yimanje kuthiwa abekho abantu abake baboshwa mayelana naleso sigameko.Kuvela ukuthi amalungu omndeni wakwaNdlovu athuka izanya njengoba esezizwa engasaphephile.Indodana kamufi, uMnuz Simli Ndlovu, ithe bakhungathekile ngesehlakalo ngoba abekho abantu ebebazi ukuthi bayabalandela emndenini wabo.UNdlovu uveze ukuthi lesi sigameko sibalimazile njengoba sebesele bodwa beyizingane kulo muzi. "Nami bangidubulile onyaweni, kodwa bona bebefuna umama,'' usho kanjena.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu Natal, uConstable Thenjiswa Ngcobo, uthe belingakabibikho icala lalolu hlobo elivuliwe kubona kodwa basazolibheka.
IKAPAKELE nasePhalamende eyokusebenzisana kwamaqembu ahlukene kuhulumeni wobumbano njengoba osihlalo bamakomiti bepikwe kulawa maqembu futhi bakhethwa ngaphandle kokuphikiswa. Abanye ababengamaphini ongqongqoshe, bakhethelwe ekubeni osihlalo bamakomiti ePhalamende.Ukwehla kokwesekwa kwe-ANC okhethweni obelungoMeyi nonyaka, kwenze abanye abaholi bangakhethelwa ezikhundleni zongqongqoshe namaphini oNgqongqoshe ngenxa yokuthi uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, bekumele apike abaholi bamanye amaqembu kwiKhabhinethi yakhe.Umholi weRise Mzansi, uMnuz Songezo Zibi, ukhethwe ngo-elethu esikhundleni sikasihlalo wekomiti elibhekele ukusebenza kwemali yomphakathi iScopa.Leli komiti yilona elihlola kabanzi ukusebenza kwemali kahulumeni eminyangweni ehlukene.UZibi oke waba ngumhleli wephephandaba, wesekwe yi-ANC kanjalo ne-DA kwesikasihlalo weScopa.Iqembu lakhe liveze ukuthi iScopa isinomholi omusha."Uzosebenzisana nabantu bakuleli ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imali yomphakathi isetshenziswa ngendlela. Uzovikela imali yomphakathi ngaphandle kokwesaba nokwenzelela,” kusho iRise Mzansi.UDkt Sibogiseni Dhlomo obeyiphini likangqongqoshe wezeMpilo ukhethelwe kwesokuba ngusihlalo wekomiti lezeMpilo ePhalamende.Owayeyinhloko yezokuxhumana kwi-ANC, uNksz Khusela Diko, uqokelwe kwesikasihlalo ekomitini lezokuXhumana nobuChwepheshe.Owayengungqongqoshe wezokuThutha, uMnuz Joseph Maswanganyi, uqokelwe kwesikasihlalo wekomiti lezeziMali.Abaholi okubalwa uMnuz Supra Obakeng Mahumapelo, uqokelwe kwesikasihlalo wekomiti lezobuDlelwano bamaZwe oMhlaba nokuBambisana.Umholi weBosa, uMnuz Mmusi Maimane, uqokelwe kwesikasihlalo weStanding Committee on Appropriations.Oke waba yimeya yaseKurhuleni, uMnuz Mzwandile Masina, uqokelwe kwesikasihlalo wekomiti lezoHwebo, iziMboni nokuNcintisana.Owayengumxhumanisi wethimba lesikhashana le-ANC Youth League, uNksz Joy Maimela, uqokelwe kwesikasihlalo wekomiti leMfundo eyisiSekelo. Owayengungqongqoshe wezemiDlalo, ubuCiko namaSiko uMnuz Zizi Kodwa, uyilungu lekomiti leMfundo ePhakeme.UKodwa wazihoxela kulesi sikhundla njengoba ebhekene necala lenkohlakalo.
UKULAHLEKA kwezibhamu zamaphoyisa minyaka yonke sekuqubule isiphakamiso sokuthi zifakwe ubuchwepheshe obuthile, obuzokwenza ukuthi zisheshe zitholakale.Lesi siphakamiso senziwe yilungu le-EFF ePhalamende uDkt Mbuyiseni Ndlozi, belikhononda ngokwanda kokulahleka kwezibhamu zamaphoyisa. UNdlozi uphakamise ukuthi amaphoyisa ayibheke eyokuthi afake izibhamu zawo ubuchwepheshe beGPS, obuzokwenza ukuthi zisheshe zitholakale.UNdlozi ukhale ngokuthi amaphoyisa alahlekelwa yizibhamu emsebenzini abudedengu. Kuphinde kwaba nesiphakamiso sokuthi namaphoyisa uqobo kumele afakwe okuthile okuzohlonza lapho ekhona zikhathi zonke."Njengoba izimoto zamaphoyisa zifakwe okuthile okwenza zisheshe zitholakale uma zilahlekile, kumele ibhekwe eyokuthi namathuluzi okusebenza okuyizibhamu zifakwe lobu buchwepheshe. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi zisheshe zitholakale uma zilahlekile. Ziningi kakhulu izibhamu ezisabalele emphakathini okugilwa ngazo ubugebengu,” kusho uDkt Ndlozi.Ukusho lokhu izolo ngesikhathi ubuholi bamaphoyisa obuhlanganisa uKhomishana uGeneral Fannie Masemola, noNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, buhambele umhlangano wekomiti lasePhalamende lamaphoyisa ukuyokhuluma ngesabelomali sonyaka.Emhlangannweni kuvele ukuthi njalo ngonyaka zibalelwa ngaphezu kuka-700 izibhamu zamaphoyisa ezilahlekayo.UMasemola uvumile ukuthi izimoto zamaphoyisa zinabo ubuchwepheshe bokwenza ukuthi zitholakale uma zilahlekile."Indaba yokufaka lo buchwepheshe ezibhamini, yinto esizoyibheka. Ngonyaka kuhlaleka izibhamu ezingaphezulu kuka-700 zamaphoyisa. Sikwazi ukuthola izibhamu ezevile ku-22 000 ebezilahlekile ezihlanganisa nezamaphoyisa, nezabantu jikelele. Nendaba yokuthi sifake okuthile emaphoyiseni ukuze sazi ngaso sonke isikhathi ukuthi akuphi, yinto esizoke siyibheke,” kusho uMasemola. Emhlanganweni kuvele ukuthi nonyaka isabelomali somnyango sizofinyelela ku-R113 billion.Okunye okuvelile wukuthi ukugada ukhetho lohulumeni basekhaya nolukazwelonke obelungoMeyi nonyaka, beluhlinzekelwe uR290 million. Izinhlelo zokulwa nobugebengu zihlinzekelwe ngoR38 billion, ukuqapha imingcele kubekelwe uR2.5 billion, izinhlaka ezehlukene emaphoyiseni okubalwa iSpecial Task Force zibekelwe uR82 million, iNational Intervention Units ithole uR804 million, kwathi iTactical Response Teams yathola uR590 million kanti iPublic Order Policing ihlinzekwe ngoR4 billion.UMchunu uthe kubalulekile ukuthi kubanjiswane ukuze kuphume uhlelo oluhlanganisa uwonke wonke lokulwa nobugebengu."Mkhulu umsebenzi esibhekene nawo wokulwa nobugebengu. Uma singahlangene sizobe sihlulekile ukwenza okubhekiwe emphakathini. Abantu yibona okumele basho uma sisebenzile, bakubona ngamehlo ngoba ubugebengu busithinta sonke,” kusho uMchunu.
KULOKOZA inhlansi kubantu abaningi ngokuvulwa kabusha kwedokodo elimayelana nokuthi wafa kanjani loyo owabe engumengameli we-African National Congress (ANC), uChief Albert Luthuli.Lokhu kushiwo ngusihlalo weChief Albert Luthuli Museum uDkt Mxolisi Mchunu obekhuluma izolo, eGroutville, ngesikhathi kwethulwa ngokusemthethweni iLuthuli Peace Walk.ILuthuli Peace Walk izokuba ngomhlaka-20 Julayi khona eGroutville.UMchunu uthe uMnyango wezoBulungiswa kuzwelonke yiwona obanikeze isiqiniseko mayelana nodaba lwedokodo."Kuhle ukuthi idokodo lizovulwa kabusha ukuze sithole iqiniso ngokufa kukaLuthuli," usho kanje.Uveze ukuthi lolu daba kuyimanje lusezandleni zoKlebe.ULuthuli owaba ngowokuqala ukuhlonishwa ngeNobel Peace Prize kuthiwa wafa ngokushayiswa yisitimela eseThembeni.Mayelana nomjaho, uthe uzothuthukisa umnotho iphinde ukhuthaze ezemidlalo kubantu bakule ndawo. Lokho uthe kuhle ngoba uLuthuli wayezifela ngezemidlalo.Ilungu lomndeni, uNkk Velile Luthuli, lithe kuyabajabulisa ukukhunjulwa kukaLuthuli ngale ndlela.Naye uthe kuhle ukuthi idokodo lizovulwa kabusha. Uthe njengomndeni bafuna ukuthola ukuthi wafa kanjani uLuthuli.IMeya yesiFunda iLembe, uMnuz Thobani Shandu, ithe kuhle ukuthi leli qhawe likhunjulwe ngale ndlela.Obhekelele ezokukhangisa kwiLuthuli Museum, uNksz Valencia Mthembu, uthe bayethemba ukuthi konke kuzohamba kahle ngosuku lomjaho.Umsunguli walo mjaho, uMnuz Zakhele Gumede, ushayelwe uhlombe ngokuqhamuka nombono ohlukile wokukhunjulwa kukaLuthuli.

INKAMPANI ephehla ugesi kuleli i-Eskom isiqale uhlelo lokucisha ugesi ngenhloso yokuhlenga ingqalasizinda yayo esengcupheni yokusha.INKAMPANI ephehla ugesi kuleli i-Eskom isiqale uhlelo lokucisha ugesi ngenhloso yokuhlenga ingqalasizinda yayo esengcupheni yokusha.UNkk Daphne Mokoena obhekelele ezokuxhumana e-Eskom, uthe ukucisha ugesi isikhashana akufani nohlelo lokunqanyulwa kukagesi ngenhloso yokuwonga okuyinto esime izinsuku ezingaphezu kuka-105.Uthe sebeqale uhlelo abalubiza ngokuthi yi-"Save Your Transformers. Save Lives” olugqugquzela abantu ukuthi bonge ugesi, bawuthenge ezindaweni ezisemthethweni, bangaxhumi nowezinyokanyoka.Uveze ukuthi i-Eskom iyaphoqeleka ukuthi inciphise ugesi amahora ambalwa ngenxa yokuthi ingqalasizinda yawo okungama-transformer iyasindwa ngenxa yokwebiwa kukagesi.Uthe u-94% wama-transformer asindwayo okusho ukuthi awu-2 111 ezweni jikelele. Atholakala eLimpopo, KwaZulu-Natal, Gauteng, Western Cape, Eastern Cape, North West naseMpumalanga."Ama-transformer agcina esesindwa ngenxa yokuxhunywa kukagesi wezinyokanyoka, ukwebiwa kukagesi, ukuthengwa kukagesi kubantu abangavunyelwe nokuxhunywa kwezigubhu ezingekho semthethweni. Kufanele siwucime ugesi ukuze sivikele ingqalasizinda yethu ngoba uma i-transformer isha lokhu kuchaza ukuthi indawo ingasala ingenagesi izinyanga eziyisithupha,” kuchaza uNksz Mokoena.Uthe ukucishwa kukagesi nokunqamuka kwawo akufani ngoba ukucima ugesi ukuze kuvikelwe ama-transformer akusho ukuthi ugesi usuke usaphehlwa kodwa usuke ukhona."Uma sicima ugesi sisuke sivikela ukuthi ama-transformer angashi nempilo yabantu. Uma sinqamula ugesi usuke ungekho mningi ophehliwe ngakho siye siwunqamuke ukugwema ukuthi izwe libe mnyama bhuqe. Lo ocinywayo manje wenzela ukuvikela ukusha kwengqalasizinda kagesi,” usho kanje.Lapho bezocisha khona ugesi, uNkk Mokoena, uthe omasipala bazobazisa abantu ukuthi kuzocishwa nini.Ucele abantu ukuthi bonge ugesi, babike izigameko zobugebengu okubalwa labo abaxhume ugesi wezinyokanyoka, abeba ingqalasizinda kagesi ku-0800 112 722.Usihlalo wePietermaritzburg and Midlands Chamber of Business, uthe ukucima kukagesi kubi ebhizinisini futhi eMgungudlovu ugesi ucima njalo.Uthe osomabhizinisi abancane bayaphazamiseka ngoba abanayo imali yokuthenga ama-generator, labo abakwazi ukuthenga ama-generator inzuzo abayiboni ngenxa yokuthi imali iphelela kudizili.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi eMgungundlovu namaphethelo ugesi uye ucime ngabo-5 ekuseni ubuye ngo-9 ekuseni noma ucime ngo-5 ntambama bese ubuya ngo-9 ebusuku.Njalo ngosuku ugesi uhamba amahora amane ngenxa yohlelo lokuvikela ingqalasizinda.

ISIFO sohlangothi yisona esibe yimbangela yokudlula emhlabeni kwenkosi yomculo wesikhalanga, uDkt Thulani Manana (56).Lokhu kudalulwe yindodana yakhe, uMnuz Trevor Manana, ngesikhathi ikhuluma neSolezwe ngezindaba zokudlula emhlabeni kwale ngwazi eyenze umculo weZayoni wachuma.UManana uveze ukuthi uyise ubekade eseMtubatuba eye komunye umngcwabo, kwathi ngemuva kwezinsuku ezimbili engakaphindeli ekhaya e-Ermelo, eMpumalanga, wadluliselwa esibhedlela saseNgwelezane.UMUFI, uMfu Thulani Manana"Kusiphathe kabi kakhulu ukushiywa ngubaba emhlabeni. Uhlaselwe yisifo sohlangothi wase eyasishiya,'' esho.Uthe bagqemeke udume lwengozi ngokulahleka kukayise. Umncomile ngendima ayiklamile ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi uyachuma umculo weZayoni.Uthe kuyise bekuhlale njalo kuseqhulwini ukubaluleka kokufukulwa komculo weZayoni.Uchaze uyise njengendoda ebikholelwa kakhulu emkhulekweni. "Ubaba ubewazisa kakhulu umkhuleko. Ubekholwa ukuthi uma nje esethandazile konke kusuke sekuqondile,'' usho kanje.Ubekhuluma neSolezwe enza amalungiselelo okuthi kuthathwe isidumbu sibuyiselwe e-Ermelo okuyilapho azofihlelwa khona.Umethulele isigqoko ngokuthatha umculo waseZayoni awusabalalisele eSwatini naseBotswana.UMfu Thulani Gwala ongusihlalo wenhlangano yamaZayoni, iHlangana Zayoni uthe uwile umuthi omkhulu.Uncome iqhaza likaManana ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi uyathuthukiswa umculo weZayoni kuzona zonke izifundazwe.Ukuvelela kukaManana emculweni kumenze wagcina esezuza izindondo ezahlukene eminxenei eyahlukene. Wathola nendondo kumaSama Awards.Uke wahlabana ngendondo yeBest AmaZion Music kumaCrown Gospel.Kumncintiswano iMpumalanga Awards wazuza izindondo kwiBest siKhalanga, Best African Mucic nakwiBest Composer.Waqala ukuduma kakhulu nge-album yakhe eyayisihloko sithi Imali yomntwana.'Wayekade eyenze ngokubambisana noMbhishobhi Sipho Mnyembe ongasekho emhlabeni.Belidume kakhulu iqembu lakhe Abanikazi Bomkhalanga. UMfu Bheki Dlamini obeyilungu leqembu uthe bafe olwembiza ngokudlula emhlabeni kukaManana.Umchaze njengomuntu obenokuthula, ewazisa umculo weZayoni. UManana wake wakhipha i-album esihloko sithi Udlalelani ngom’Zayoni ezama ukukhuza abadicilela phansi isithunzi saleli bandla.UMfu Vusi Gama ongomunye wezingwazi zomculo waseZayoni naye uthumele amazwi enduduzo ngokudlula emhlabeni kukaManana. Uthe kulotshiwe emlandweni ukuthi umufi waba ngowokuqala ukuqopha i-album egcwele yomculo wesikhalanga.Uthe kuningi okuhle okungafundwa ngabantu mayelana nendlela uManana abewuthanda ngayo umsebenzi wakhe wokucula.Phakathi kwabaculi aseke acula nabo uManana kubalwa uThokozani Langa, uBonakele noLundi naye ongasekho emhlabeni.UManana ubephinde abe nguMfundisi ebandleni lamaZayoni, iPhillip Apostolic Catholic Church yaseThembisa. Ikhwaya yeZayoni yaseTshwane University of Technology (TUT) ubeyicija ngomculo.Ushiye emhlabeni abantwana bakhe abayisikhombisa. Umndeni uthe usazolumemezela usuku lokufihlwa kwakhe.

UPHUNYUKE bemchitha ekubeni yilungu lekhomishini eluleka uhulumeni ngezinto ezithinta amajaji, ohola iqembu Umkhonto weSizwe ePhalamende, uDkt John Hlophe.UHlophe ungene ngodli kule khomishini nakuba ebechithwa amanye amaqembu ePhalamende abengayizwa eyokuphakanyiswa kwegama lakhe ekubeni yilungu le-Judicial Service Commission (JSC). Igama likaHlophe owayengumengameli wamajaji eWestern Cape, beliphakanyiswe namanye amagama amalungu ePhalamende, ukuthi abe yingxenye yeJSC, ephenya izikhalazo ezibhekiswe emajajini. Akubanga namsindo ngokuphakanyiswa kwamagama amalungu ahlukene ukuthi abe yingxenye yeJSC, okubalwa elomholi we-EFF uMnuz Julius Malema, elikaNksz Fasiha Hassan we-ANC, Advocate Glynnis Breytenbach we-DA, Mnuz Athol Trollip we-ActionSA noMnuz Molapi Lekganyane we-ANC. USotswebhu we-ANC, uMnuz Mdumiseni Ntuli, nguyena ophakamise amagama alawa malungu.USomlomo wePhalamende, uNkk Thoko Didiza, ubuze ukuthi kukhona yini abaphikisana nalesi siphakamiso, kwaphakama uSotswebhu we-DA uMnuz George Michalakis, wathi bachitha igama likaHlophe. Kushintshane abaholi bamaqembu ahlukene baphefumula ngalesi siphakamiso sokufaka igama likaHlophe.I-DA, Freedom Front Plus ne-ACDP yiwona maqembu achithe igama likaHlophe, kwathi amanye amaqembu ameseka. UMnuz Sihle Ngubane weMK, uthe uMthethosisekelo wezwe, awuwavimbi amalungu ePhalamende ukuthi abe yingxenye yeJSC.Uthe uHlophe unawo amava okuba yingxenye yeJSC ngoba uthunywe abavotele iMK.UMnuz Floyd Shivambu iPhini likaMengameli le-EFF, uthe selimlinde ngabomvu uHlophe kwiJSC."Sifuna ukuzwa amangwevu akho kwiJSC ngakho asinankinga nokuphakanyiswa kwegama lakho. Kunamalungu e-DA, angongqongqoshe angafundile. Amanye awo awanasicucu kodwa angongqongqoshe. Asinankinga nalokhu ngoba avumelekile ukuthi akhethelwe ezikhundleni eziphezulu,” kusho uShivambu.Umholi we-UDM, uGeneral Bantu Holomisa, uthe abantu abavotele iMK bamjube noma ikuphi uHlophe ngakho angaya noma ikuphi lapho ethunywa khona yiqembu lakhe."Asinankinga noHlophe, unamava ngakho akangene.”Amanye amaqembu akhale ngokuthi uHlophe akumele abe kwiJSC ngoba waphucwa igunya lokuba yijaji emva kokuzama ukuhlohla amanye amajaji aseNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo ukuthi aseke owayengumengameli wezwe, uMnuz Jacob Zuma (osengumholi weMK) emacaleni enkohlakalo abhekene nawo. Akhale ngokuthi ukufakwa kukaHlophe kungaphazamisa umsebenzi weJSC. Noma kunjalo kodwa uNkk Didiza uthe igama likaHlophe lizoba yingxenye yabantu abazoba kwiJSC ngoba usekwe yiningi. Kunezinhlangano zomphakathi ebezingahambisani nokufakwa kukaHlophe kwiJSC.

AMAQEMBU ezepolitiki aphikisayo kuMasipala waseThekwini, asola i-ANC ngokuhlinzela ezibini amakhulu abasebenzi abaqashwe ngaphansi kohlelo i- Expanded Public Works Programe (EPWP). Sekubikwe ukuthi bazohola okokugcina ngokuphela kwale nyanga ngoba kuthiwa kuvunyelwane ngokuthi zingavuselwa izinkontileka zabo, umasipala ubalisa ngezindleko.Encwadini eputshukile, ebibhalelwe iziphathimandla zangaphakathi kumasipala ezibhekelele lolu hlelo, kuvela ukuthi emhlanganweni obungenyanga edlule, kwadingidwa ukuthi uhlelo oluphethwe wuMnyango wezeMisebenzi yoMphakathi ludla R297 million ngonyaka kumasipala. Kuthiwa isibonelelo salo mnyango esinekezwa umasipala sincishiswe safinyelela kuR18.7 million, okusho ukuthi umasipala kumele ubeke eceleni uR278.3 million wokuhlangabeza izindleko. Kule ncwadi kubhalwe ukuthi imenenja kamasipala nesikhulu esiphezulu esibhekelele ukusebenza kwezimali kuwona baveze ukuthi ayikho imali okuholele ekutheni kunqunywe ukuthi ngo-Julayi, 25 nonyaka bonke abasebenzi abangaphansi kwalolu hlelo bazohola okokugcina.I-ActionSA ne-EFF, bathi lokhu kuzoshiya inqwaba yabantu ingenawo umsebenzi nedolobha iTheku nezindawo ezakhelene nalo zisesimeni esingesihle ngoba umasipala awunabo abasebenzi abenele ukubhekana nemisebenzi okubalwa kuyo ukugcina idolobha lihlanzekile.UMnuz Themba Mvubu we-EFF, uthe lokhu kuyaziveza ukuthi uhlelo lolu lwalubanjwe ngamabomu yi-ANC ngenhloso yokunxenxa amavoti, emva kwalokho uhulumeni wobumbano okhona usuqalile ukukhombisa ukuthi awunendaba nabantu."Lena yimali yesibonelelo eqhamuka ehhovisi likamgcinimafa kazwelonke kuhulumeni omkhulu. Kuza kanjani ukuthi kwandiswe isibalo songqongqoshe kwikhabhinethi okuzodla ama-billion, bese kuqedwa imisebenzi ebantwini abayidinga ngempela ukuxosha ikati eziko? Esikhathini esinzima kakhulu kubantu bakithi abayizinkulungwane, ababhubhiswa yinkemane ukuze kudle iziqumama ziqhubeke nokuphila ntofontofo ngoba nakhu ukhetho seludlulile sebeqalile bayaziveza ukuthi bangobani,” kusho uMvubu.UMnuz Zwakele Mncwango we-ActionSA, uthe uhlelo lwavuselwa ngoDisemba nyakenye umasipala usukuvezile ukuthi awunayo imali okwathi uma bebuzwa ngokuthi pho bazoluqhuba kanjani, bangena ezintangeni."Kuyacaca ukuthi kugenjulwa ngempilo yabantu abathembele kulolu hlelo ukondla imindeni. Konke abakwenza belivuselela babenzela ukunxenxa amavoti ebantwini manje ukhetho seludlulile. Wumsebenzi kamasipala ukugcina idolobha lihlanzekile kodwa ngendlela owenza ngayo kungathi wenzela laba basebenzi umusa nje ekubeni kufanele vele uqashe isibalo esanele ukwenza lo msebenzi,”usho kanje.Uthe emhlanganweni wamakhansela olandelayo, bazophakamisa ukuthi kungaqhubeki ukumiswa kwabasebenzi futhi ngaphambi kokuthi bamiswe, ababizwe bonke ndawana thile babalwe. Wathi lokhu kuzoveza obala ukuthi isibalo sabasebenzi sincane kakhulu kunalesi esibhalwe phansi njengoba ekholelwa ukuthi yinqwaba yezipoki eziholelwa kulolu hlelo okugcina sekulimaza abantu abawudinga ngempela umsebenzi. Imizamo yokuthola izinyunyana zabasebenzi kulo masipala ayiphumelelanga. Kuze kwashaya nesikhathi sokushicilela kungatholakalanga nokuphawula kukaMasipala weTheku.
UNGQONGQOSHE kaGesi nezaMandla, uDkt Kgosientsho Ramokgopa, uthi inkukhu inqunywe umlomo kulabo abebethi ugesi awucishwa ngenxa yokuthi sekusondele ukhetho.URamakgopa uthe ukuqhubeka kokungacishwa kukagesi noma ukhetho seludlulile kukhombisa ngokusobala ukuthi babesenga ezimithiyo labo ababethi kuzobuya ukucishwa kukagesi emva kokhetho lwangoMeyi.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba ngoMsombuluko.Sekuphele izinsuku ezingaphezu kuka-100 ugesi ungacishwa.Kwagcina ngo-2020 ukuba ugesi ungacishwa izinsuku eziningi kangaka zilandelana.Ukucishwa kukagesi kwagcina ngoMashi, kusele isikhathi esingaphansi kwezinyanga ezimbili kubanjwe ukhetho lwangoMeyi.URamokgopa uthe ukungacishwa kukagesi isikhathi eside kanje kukhombisa ngokusobala ukuthi uhulumeni uzoyinqoba inkinga kagesi."Ngaphambi kokhetho bekukuningi ukukhuluma. Kukhona ababethi ugesi awucishwa ngoba kuza ukhetho. Ngesikhathi umengameli esungula uMnyango kaGesi, wasinikeza izinto ezimbili afuna sizenze."Eyokuqala wathi ufuna ukuthi ugesi ungacishwa kakhulu. Lokho ngicabanga ukuthi sesikwazile ukukwenza. Okwesibili wathi ufuna ukuthi siyiqede nya eyokucishwa kukagesi. Ngokwami ngibona siza kahle okwamanje.”URamokgopa uthe bayaqhubeka nokwandisa umthamo kagesi.Ukhale ngomasipala athe ukwehluleka kwabo kwenza ukuthi ucishwe ugesi kwezinye izindawo yize izwe linogesi owanele."Ngenxa yokuthi sinogesi owanele njengamanje, kunenkinga entsha esiyiqaphelile. Kunabantu othola ukuthi bahlala isikhathi eside bengenawo ugesi, kwesinye isikhathi kuba izinsuku ugesi ungekho. Lokhu kungenxa yokwehluleka komasipala ukunakekela ingqalasizinda. Kugcina sekufuneka ukuthi kucishwe ugesi ngenxa yokuthi ingqalasizinda endala iyehluleka ukumelana nomthamo omningi kagesi. Ezinye izinkinga ukungaphathwa ngendlela kwezimali komasipala, nokungabikhona kwabantu abazi umsebenzi.”Uthe le nkinga uzoyikhuluma noNgqongqoshe wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana kanye neziNdaba zoMdabu, uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa.URamokgopa uthe nakuba kukuningi osekwenziwe, ayikapheli inkinga yokushoda kukagesi."Asikaphumi enkingeni. Kuzothatha isikhathi eside ukuthi siyinqobe le mpi.”URamokgopa uthe ngale kwenkinga yokushoda kukagesi, kubuye kube nenkinga yokuthi abantu abaningi abawukhokheli.URamokgopa ukhale ngokumba eqolo kukagesi, wathi kwenza ukuthi abantu abaningi bangakwazi ukuwukhokhela."Uma ingabhekisiswa indaba yokunyuka kukagesi, sizokuba nenkinga ezweni. Abantu abaningi abakwazi ukuthenga ugesi ngenxa yesimo somnotho. Abantu kufanele bakhethe phakathi kokuthenga isinkwa nokuthenga ugesi. Ekugcineni abantu bakhetha ukuthenga isinkwa. Osomabhizinisi nabo banenkinga yokuthi abakwazi ukuqhuba amabhizinisi abo ngenxa yokubiza kukagesi.”
UPHIKO lwezamanzi eDurban University of Technology (DUT), i-Institute for Water and Wastewater Technology (IWWT) luthi awangcolile ayaxathuka amabhishi aseThekwini. Bakhiphe nesexwayiso ngobungozi bokusebenzisa la mabhishi awu-14 aseThekwini namaphethelo.Ngokusho komqondisi we-IWWT uSolwazi Faizal Bux, ukuhlolwa kwabo kubavezele ukuthi awu-14 amabhishi anamagciwane ayingozi amsuka wawo yindle.Uthe kulawo mabhishi bathole ukuthi awu-11 awo okukhona kuwo iBallito Tidal Pool, Westbrook Beach, Umdloti Beach, Glenashely Beach, Virginia Beach, Umgeni River, Umgeni River mouth, Laguna Beach, Country Club Beach, Bay of Plenty, ne-Addington Beach anesilinganiso esiphezulu segciwne elibizwa nge-Escherichia coli (E.coli).UBux uveze ukuthi yiBronze Beach noMhlanga Lighthouse kuphela amabhishi anesilinganiso esamukelekile se-E.coli, bese kuba yi-uShaka Beach enesilinganiso saleli gciwane."Uma uqhathanisa namanye amabhishi aseThekwini, yi-uShaka Beach kuphela ekhombise ukuba nesilinganiso esiphansi se-E.coli. Kulawa amanye amabhishi awu-11 kuvele ukuthi isimo sawo siyakhathaza kakhulu, futhi ososayensi be-IWWT beluleke abantu ukuba bangawasebenzisi ukuzijabulisa kuwona kuze kube wukuthi kwehla leli gciwane kuwona,” kusho uBux. Uqhube wathi umlando ukhombisa ukuthi Umgeni River uhlale unesilinganiso esiphezulu saleli gciwane, okuwubungozi okukhulu. Uthe uphiko lwabo lwezamanzi luhlale luhlola ukuba sezingeni elifanele kwamanzi njalo ngamaholidi ukusiza ukubhekelela ukuphepha komphakathi. Kuthintwa okhulumela uMasipala weTheku, uNkk Gugu Sisilana, ucele ukuthi bathunyelelwe imibuzo nge-email, bese benikwa okungenani amahora awu-24 ukuphendula.
AMAQEMBU abambisene ne-ANC kuhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal nokazwelonke, i-IFP neDA, awazazi noma azokweseka i-ANC noma azongenela umbango wesikhundla sobumeya kumasipala waseThekwini, uma sekukhethwa imeya entsha.Abaholi be-IFP nabeDA eThekwini, bathe basalinde izwi eliqhamuka ebuholini obuphezulu uma bebuzwa ukuthi bazokweseka bani ngoLwesithathu.Imeya yeTheku izoqokwa emhlanganweni womkhandlu oyisipesheli ozokuba ngoLwesithathu eNkosi Albert Luthuli Convention Centre, eThekwini.Maningi amathuba okuthi i-ANC isicoshe phansi isikhundla ngoba akukho okubambekayo okukhombisa ukuthi amaqembu aphikisayo azozama ukuyihlanganyela.Kubhekwe ukuthi i-ANC iphakamise igama lowayenguMphathiswa wezoLimo, uMnuz Cyril Xaba.I-ANC ayinazo izihlalo ezanele zokuthi ibuse ngokuzimela eThekwini, yasindiswa amaqembu amancane ngesikhathi amaqembu aphikisayo amakhulu iDA, EFF ne-IFP bezama ukuyiqumba phansi mhla kukhethwa imeya emva kokhetho lohulumeni basekhaya lwango-2021. Akubukeki i-IFP neDA bezoyiphonsela inselelo kulokhu.Yize amaqembu engenaso isivumelwano sokusebenzisana komasipala, anesivumelwano sokusebenzisana kuzwelonke naKwaZulu-Natal.Ohola i-IFP kumasipala waseThekwini, uMnuz Mdu Nkosi, uthe bebengakanqumi ukuthi bazokwenza njani emhlanganweni wakusasa."Njengamanje alikho iqembu elisakhulume nathi kulawa amakhulu anezihlalo esigungwini esiphezulu. Sisalinde abaholi ukuthi basitshele ukuthi kufanele senzenjani. Sizokuba nenguyazana ngaphambi komhlangano, kulapho ke esizovumelana khona ngokuthi emhlanganweni sizofika senze njani."UNkosi uthe ukusebenzisana kwe-IFP ne-ANC esifundazweni nakuzwelonke akusho ukuthi sebezobambisana nakumasipala."Kodwa ngiyazi ukuthi abaholi bethu bayaxoxa ngalokhu, ngakho sizolinda bona."Ohola iDA kumasipala waseThekwini, uMnuz Thabani Mthethwa, uthe bazokuba nenguyazana namhlanje."Asikho isinqumo esesisithathile, silinde abaholi ukuthi basibonise."Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kukasihlalo we-EFF eThekwini, uMnuz Themba Mvubu, ayizange iphumelele.I-EFF ibikade isebenzisana ne-ANC eThekwini, kodwa umshado wabo waphela kabuhlungu njengoba i-ANC yakhipha uMvubu kwesokuba usihlalo wekomiti lezokuhlaliswa kwabantu.ITheku lisale lingenayo imeya emva kokususwa kukaMnuz Mxolisi Kaunda, osejutshwe eMkhandlwini weziFundazwe.Imeya kwakufanele ikhethwe emhlanganweni womkhandlu owawungenyanga eyedlule kepha akwangenzeka.
KUPHAKAME imimoya, kwashoda ozogadla kuqala phakathi kukammeli nomshushisi phambi kwejaji ebeliqeda kugweba udilikajele unesi owathenga izinkabi ezabulala umyeni wakhe owunjiniyela.IJaji elibambile, uSolwazi Bonke Dumisa, ligwebe uNksz Nompumelelo Goncalves (31) eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini, ngoLwesibili.UNksz Goncalves nomfowabo uNkosinathi Zungu (40) bagwetshwe iminyaka engu-10 ngecala lokuthumba, engu-20 ngecala lokuphanga kusetshenziswa udlame nodilikajele ngokubulala okuhleliwe.Lo wesifazane ubhanselwe ngeminyaka eyisishiyagalombili ngamacala amabili okuphazamisa ukusebenza kwengalo yomthetho.Wabika amacala angekho emaphoyiseni okungelokuduka komuntu nelokwebiwa kweveni kamufi uMnuz Nkosi Timmy Langa owayengunjiniyela kwaTransnet.Wathunjwa kwakhe ePinetown, ngoSepthemba 29, 2020, waklinywa ebulawa emahlathini asoZwathini, eNdwedwe ngalobo busuku. Ummeli kaNksz Goncalves, u-Advocate Mandla Luthuli, usukume waphonsela inselelo izigwebo ezinikwe lo wesifazane wathi ziqine kakhulu ekubeni usemncane, uyaqala ukwenza icala. Uthe kunobufakazi inkantolo engabamukelanga.Wenze nezinsolo zokuthi abagwetshiwe babona sengathi inkantolo ithathe kakhulu uhlangothi loMbuso, icindezela bona.Kusukume umshushisi, u-Advocate Krishen Shah, wakuchitha lokhu wabeka amaphuzu avumelana nokushiwo ijaji.Kulowo mnyama, uLuthuli usukumile ephikisa obekushiwo uShah, bobabili bemi ngezinyawo.Bajikijelane ngamazwi baze bakhombana. Ungenelele uDumisa wabakhuza, wathi abehlise umoya, kwahlatshwa ikhefu.Ubuye ekhefini uDumisa wasichitha isicelo ebesifakwe uLuthuli sokuba kubuyekezwe izigwebo.
UNESI, owathenga izinkabi ezabulala umyeni wakhe owunjiniyela, uvumbuke nesicelo sentethelelo ekugcineni lapho sekubhekwe ukuthi kukhishwe isinqumo secala. UNompumelelo Goncalves (31), obheke necala lokuhlela nokubulala umyeni wakhe, uxolisile emndenini kamufi, wathi wayengaqondile ukumbulala.Ummangalelwa ukusho lokhu encwadini efundwe eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini ngoMsombuluko ngummeli wakhe, u-Advocate Mandla Luthuli.NgoLwesibili UNksz Goncalves nomfowabo uNkosinathi Zungu (40) bagwetshwe iminyaka engu-10 ngecala lokuthumba, engu-20 ngecala lokuphanga kusetshenziswa udlame nodilikajele ngokubulala okuhleliwe.Lo wesifazane ubhanselwe ngeminyaka eyisishiyagalombii ngamacala amabili okuphazamisa ukusebenza kwengalo yomthetho.Wabika amacala angekho emaphoyiseni okungelokuduka komuntu nelokwebiwa kweveni kamufi uMnuz Nkosi Timmy Langa owayengunjiniyela kwaTransnet.Encwadini yakhe uveze ukuthi wayehlukunyezwa wumufi, uMnuz Nkosi Timmy Langa owayengumyeni wakhe. Uthi wayephela yisibhaxu.ULuthuli ubekade emcelela eJajini, uSolwazi Bonke Dumisa, ukuthi limthambisele isigwebo."Ngiyacela ukuthi ungixolisele emndenini wakwaLanga. Ungitshelele bona ukuthi ngiyaxolisa kakhulu ukuthi balahlekelwa ubhuti wabo. Kwakungeyona inhloso yami ukuthi kube khona umuntu obulawayo. Ngiyavuma engakwenza kwaba kubi futhi kwakungekho emthethweni,” kusho uLuthuli efunda incwadi uGoncalves abezicelela ngayo intethelelo.Lo mmeli uthe uGoncalves uhlalile ejele wadlinza, ezisesha emhlanganweni ayewubambe yedwa, nokuyilapho ebone khona ukuthi akwenza kwaba yiphutha, kwakungamele akwenze.Kuvele ukuthi uGoncalves akagcini ngokuba umhlengikazi, uphinde abe nesikole esiqeqesha abahlengikazi eMgungundlovu.Ungumaqhuzu ngeziqu ze-honours zobuhlengikazi, uyinsika yekhaya futhi unengane eneminyaka eyisishiyagalombili ehlala nogogo wayo eMtubatuba.Uzincengelile kuDumisa wathi uyacela ukuthi achezuke esigwebeni sikadilikajele esibekelwe icala lokubulala okuhleliwe, okungenani amnikeze iminyaka engu-18 ejele.Umcele nokuthi amgwebe iminyaka eyishumi ngecala lokuphanga kusetshenziswa udlame, eyisishiyagalombili ngokuthumba nemihlanu icala ngalinye kwamabili ngokuphazamisa ukusebenza kwengalo yomthetho.UGoncalves waboshwa nomfowabo, uNkosinathi Zungu (40), ayekade emqashile ukuba kusocongwe umyeni wakhe.Ummeli kaZungu, uMnuz Jabulile Malinga, uthe ummangalelwa unabantwana abathathu futhi usetoke iminyaka emithathu. Umcelele ukuba athanjiselwe isigwebo ngoba wavuma ukuthi kukhona lapho abamba khona iqhaza kuthunjwa nangesikhathi kuphangwa umufi.Ukuhlabe wakuhlikiza konke lokhu umshushisi, u-Advocate Krishen Shah, wathi bayazenzisa abamangalelwa ngoba inhlanzi isishelwe amanzi.UShah uthe uxolo balufuna ngoba sebelahlwe ngamacala, sebefuna ukuthanjiselwa izigwebo nokudatshukelwa."Ungqondongqondo ongummangalelwa wesibili (uGoncalves) wayengakumisa konke okwenzeka ukube wayenonembeza kodwa waba mdibi munye. Wamosha ikusasa likamfowabo nelikaMthimkhulu (ayebaqashile ukubulala uLanga). Kwakumele ngesikhathi ethula ubufakazi atshele inkantolo iqiniso lonke neqhaza alibamba futhi axolise ngomlomo wakhe kubantu bakwaLanga enkantolo,” kusho uShah.Inkabi, uJames Mashudu Mthimkhulu, yalivuma icala yathi yiyona noZungu ababulala umufi, yagwetshwa iminyaka engu-20..

IZAZI zezilimi zihlanganyele ndawonye kwi-International Conference of the African Languages Association of Southern Africa (ALASA), ehlelwe ngokubambisana phakathi kwePan South African Language Board (PanSALB), neNyuvesi iKwaZulu-Natal (UKZN).USihlalo wengqungquthela obuye abe yisifundiswa e-UKZN uDkt Sanele Nsele, uthi umbuthano ubophele izazi zezilimi ezehlukene eziphuma ezikhungweni ezahlukene. Wathi inhloso wukubhunga ngekusasa lezilimi zesintu nokuthi kucutshungulwe ngamathuba akhona ezinhlakeni ezahlukene okubalwa kwezemfundo, kwezamabhizinisi nakwezobuchwepheshe besimanje.IZAZI zezilimi zihlangane ndawonye eThekwini ukucubungula amasu okuthuthukisa izilimi zesintu nokukhuthaza ukufundisa ngoliminingi ukukhuthaza abafundi ukuba bazigqaje ngolimi lwebele isithombe: Nonkululeko NhlapoUDkt Nsele uthi bahlose ukukhuthaza nokuthuthukisa izilimi zesintu nokugqugquzela ukusetshenziswa kwazo ezinhlakeni ezahlukene kanye nokusetshenziswa kwazo lapho kuthuthukiswa ezobuchwepheshe.Izazi ezihlangene zidingida izihloko ezithinta ukuhumusha nokutolika, ukusetshenziswa kukaliminingi ezikoleni ngenhloso yokukhuthaza abafundi ukuba bakuthakasele ukuthola ulwazi ngolimi lwebele kanjalo nokuthuthukisa ubuchwepheshe obusebenzisa ulimi lwesintu.Ingqungquthela iqale ngoLwesibili izogoqwa ngoLwesihlanu.

KUMJABULISILE ukuboshwa kukamakhelwane wakhe obengaphandle ngoshwele onikwa iziboshwa uyise wentombazane eyadlwengulwa yabulawa ngoMeyi nonyaka kubo eMlaza.UMnuz Mondli Ngcobo onguyise kaWandile Ngcobo (17), ubonge amaphoyisa ngomsebenzi wawo wathi umsolwa umuntu obehlala emzini ohlukaniswe wumgwaqo nowakhe.Isidumbu sikaWandile, owayefunda uGrade 11 eDurban Girls Secondary, satholakala sinamanxena okugwazwa emzimbeni, siboshwe izandla savalwa umlomo nge-pentihose ngoLwesibili ngoMeyi 28 nonyaka.Kwebiwa iTV ne-remote, idecoder neselula kamufi okusolakala ukuthi waqale wadlwengulwa.Omunye wabakhalelwe ngamasongo kaSigonyela ecaleni lokubulawa kwentombazane yaseMlaza eyayineminyaka ewu-17, uWandile Aphiwe Ngcobo Isithombe: SAPSUmsolwa oneminyaka ewu-39 uboshwe ngeSonto ekuseni esekubhaceni KwaShembe, eClermont.Kuqale kwaboshwa indoda ena-25 eMalukazi ngoMgqibelo okuthiwa itholwe nefoni kamufi."Kungijabulisile ukuboshwa kwabasolwa ngoba le nto ibiyindida. Kwaqale kwasolwa umfana wami kodwa kwashintsha lokho. Kuyacaca ukuthi umsolwa wangigada ngahamba waseyongena ingane seyisele yodwa. Ngibonga amaphoyisa, asebenzile,” kusho uNgcobo.UNgcobo uthe umsolwa uphuma esigwebeni seminyaka engu-15. Ugcine ukubonakala endaweni ngosuku lwesigameko sekusele iziqashi kubo. Uthe akazi wayekade edonsa isigwebo saliphi icala umsolwa nokuthi hloboluni lempilo ayiphilayo.UNgcobo uthe amaphoyisa aphenye naye uqobo, kwadingeka alethe ubufakazi obushoyo ukuthi wayengekho kwakhe ngesikhathi kwehla isigameko.Ube esekhala ngamakhaza kahulumeni asePark Rynie ayegcine isidumbu sikaWandile asole ukuthi ayengasebenzi amafriji akhona."Ingane yami yafa kabili. Isidumbu sayo sasonakele sihanjwa izibungu amehlo eseshone phakathi. Asilethwanga nasemlindelweni ngendlela esase sonakele ngayo. Ngisifakile isimangalo ngahlinzeka nangobufakazi kubaphathi balendawo,” kubalisa uNgcobo.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, Brigadier Jay Naicker kulindeleke ukuthi abasolwa bavele enkantolo yeMantshi eMlaza. Umsolwa wesibili yena uthe uzovela kule nkantolo ngoLwesibili. UNaicker uthe abaphenyi basebenze ubusuku nemini beqoqa ubufakazi."Uphenyo luholele ekuboshweni komsola ona-26 otholakale nefoni kamufi ngoMgqibelo eMalukazi. Kuphinde kwaboshwa umsolwa ona-39 ngesikabhadakazi ngeSonto KwaShembe, eClermont. Ubekwe icala lokudlwengula nelokubulala. Lo msolwa ubengaphandle ngoshwele onikezwa iziboshwa,” kusho uNaicker.
AMALUNGU eMK athi uzikhiphile kuwo umdidiyeli wamabutho akwaMandlakazi, uMnuz Nkosikhona 'Phakel 'umthakathi’ Ndabandaba, amsola ngokugxibha umholi wawo, uJacob Zuma.Amalungu eMK axwayise uNdabandaba ngokuthi udumo lwakhe luzoshabalala ngokushesha uma ezifaka kwipolitiki, ameluleka ngokuthi agxile ekushayeni induku.UNdabandaba uzithintele ulaka lwabeMK emva kokufaka inkulumo ethathwe ngokuthi ugxeka uZuma kuyo.Kule nkulumo ayifake ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, uNdabandaba ukhale ngobaba angazange ambize ngegama, athe wayedlala ngeSilo esesabuza, uGoodwill Zwelithini kaBhekuzulu.Inkulumo kaNdabandaba ibihambisana nesithombe esinomsunguli weMK, uMnuz Jabulani Khumalo, noZuma, uZuma ukekeleziwe kelesi thombe.UNdabandaba ubhale ukuthi lo baba amshoyo akakaze abenzele lutho abantu baKwaZulu-Natal, wathi akakaze abuthande ubukhosi bukaZulu."Uxhaphaze uMdlokombane kwaze kwaba sekugcineni,bnamanje ufukuzela nalamakhosazana angaphethe muntu sibe sazi kahle ukuthi ulikhomanisi, wabulala abantu bakwaZulu ezama ukuzikhombisa eMaXhoseni ukuthi unamandla. Ngenxa yakhe kunemindeni eyafelwa abantu abantu (395) ngezibhelu evulele amasela ukuthi ayotapa amabhenke, nina nathatha ama stay soft anizange nibone ukuthi kwakuqondwa amabhenke ukuze ezokwazi ukuvula iqembu.”Le nkulumo idine amalungu eMK atshele uNdabandaba ukuthi aphume ezintweni ezithinta ipolitiki.Abaningi bakhombise ukubungabaza ubunsizwa bukaNdabandaba, bamtshela ukuthi uyinsizwa ngakubo.UNdabandaba uqale ukudonsa amehlo ngesikhathi exabana nowayengumsakazi woKhozi FM, uNgizwe Mchunu, ngesikhathi kunenkonzo yokutshala undunankulu kaZulu ongumsunguli we-IFP, inkosi Mangosuthu Buthelezi.UNdabandaba wazwakala etshela uMchunu ukuthi akamnqeni, wathi engamshaya ebelethe umuntu emhlane.Ethintwa yiSolezwe, uNdabandaba uthe akazange alibize igama likaZuma enkulumweni yakhe.UNdabandaba uthe inkulumo yakhe ibiqonde ukukhuthaza abantu ukuthi bangawashiyi amaqembu abo."Abantu abafunde ukwethembeka emaqenjini abo. Akungabe kusafike iqembu elisha, wena usuyagxuma. Uma kukhona into umuntu afuna ukuyilungisa akayilungise khona engaphakathi eqenjini lakhe, kube ithina esibonayo ukuthi badlala ngaye eqenjini lakhe.”UNdabandaba uthe akanendaba nabantu abamthukayo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, wathi iningi labo bazifihlile."Labantu abasongayo ngingathi nje mina ngiyobona ngabo.”Okhulumela iMK KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Ndaba Gcwabaza, uthe kubadumazile ukuthi umuntu onesikhundla esiphezulu kangaka akhulume budedengu ngale ndlela."Ukhombisa ukuthi ukhokhelwe abantu abamhlophe ukuba akhulume kabi ngeMK noZuma. Lento ayishilo ayehli kahle kuthina.”UGcwabaza uthe inkulumo kaNdabandaba ikhombisa ukungabahloniphi abantu abadinwa ukugwetshwa kukaZuma ngaphandle kokuthi ayeziphendulela enkantolo.
I-ATM iyaqhubeka nemizamo yokuchitha umbiko woMvikeli woMphakathi okhipha phambili uMengameli, uCyril Ramaphosa, ngodaba lokuntshontshwa kwezindodla zamadola aseMelika epulazini lakhe iPhala Phala.I-ATM ifake amaphepha okuphendula esicelweni sayo esifake eNkantolo eNkulu ePitoli, lapho ifuna ukuthi kuchithwe umbiko ka-Advocate Kholeka Gcaleka.URamaphosa wayesolwa ngokungawabikeli amaphoyisa ngokuntshontshwa kwemali engu- $580 000 (R10 million) eyantshontshwa ngo-2020.Umbiko ka-Advocate Gcaleka wathola ukuthi uRamaphosa akukho okuphambene nomthetho akwenzayo.Kepha i-ATM ayizange iwemukele lo mbiko, yakhala ngokuthi uRamaphosa kufanele achaze ngale mali.Yabe isifaka icala, ikhala ngokuthi u-Advocate Gcaleka akazange akhulume nabo bonke abantu abathintekayo.Emaphepheni asenkantolo, umholi we-ATM, uMnuz Vuyo Zungula, wathi u-Advocate Gcaleka kwakufanele akhulume nowayeyimenenja epulazini likaRamaphosa, uMnuz Simphiwe Ndlovu, okuthiwa uyena owafihla lemali empahleni yasendlini.UNdlovu kuthiwa wanqaba ukukhuluma no-Advocate Gcaleka, uZungula wathi kwakufanelwe aphoqwe ukuthi aphendule imibuzo.UMHOLI weqembu i-ATM, uMnuz Vuyo ZungulaUZungula wathi u-Advocate Gcaleka kwakufanele aphinde akhulume nowayesebenza endlini, Nksz Froliana Joseph, okuthiwa uyena owahlebela izigebengu ezashaqa lemali.UNksz Joseph nomfowabo, uMnuz Ndilishano David Joseph, baboshelwe leli cala. Okhulumela i-ATM, uMnuz Zama Ntshona, uthe banethemba lokuthi inkantolo izovumelana nabo kulesicelo sabo.UNtshona uthe bafuna ukuthi u-Advocate Gcaleka aqale phansi umbiko wakhe."Sifuna enze uphenyo lwakhe ngendlela, asinikeze umbiko oqondile.”UNtshona uthe u-Advocate Gcaleka wavikela uRamaphosa ngoba nakhu encenge umsebenzi.Ngesikhathi enza umbiko, u-Advocate Gcaleka wayebambile esikhundleni sakhe.Kwenzeka lokhu nje iNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo isanda kwemukela icala elifakwe i-EFF, ephonsela inselelo isinqumo sePhalamende sokuchithwa umbiko wethimba elaliphenya ngalolu daba.Umbiko wethimba elaliholwa owayeyinhloko yamaJaji, uSandile Ngcobo, wathola ukuthi kukhona uRamaphosa okufanele akuphendule.Nokho iningi lamalungu ePhalamede lavotela ukuthi umbiko uchithwe, nokwakhalisa amaqembu aphikisayo.I-ATM iyona eyayikade ifake isikhalazo ePhalamende esaholela ekutheni kusungulwe ithimba.
BAYOKHOHLWA befile abazibonele owesilisa enquma umakhelwane wakhe uqhoqhoqho ejoyintini kubuka abantu endaweni yokucima ukoma eMevamhlophe, eMpangeni, ngempelasonto.Kulesi sigameko esishaqise umphakathi, kwazise senzeke emini ka bha, kunqunywe uMnuz Thabani Ncanana (21) okuthiwa uke wahilizisana nalo wesilisa emasontweni edlule, khona endaweni yokucima ukoma.Kuthiwa umufi ufele endaweni yesigameko.Ngokusho kukamalume kamufi, uMnuz Sifiso Mathe, umufi ubeziyele eSiphethwini, okuyindawo yokucima ukoma endaweni.Kuthiwa phambilini laba ababili bathi uma bexabana, umsolwa wasabisa umufi ngokuthi uzomgwaza, okuthe uma sebeficana kule ndawo umufi wabuza ukuthi wayesho ukuthini uma ethi uzomgwaza. Kuthiwa ingxabano isuke lapho ke, umsolwa wakhipha uhalakasha lommese wamnquma uqhoqhoqho ethi ' uyamkhombisa ukuthi wayechaza ukuthini’.UMUFI uMnuz Thabani Ncanana Isithombe: SITHUNYELWEUMathe uthe abebekhona kule ndawo babatshele ukuthi umsolwa ubalekile. UMathe uthe umsolwa usuke kule ndawo waya kwenye ebude buduze wayoziphuzela kuyona kwangathi akonakele lutho. Uthe ubhadanywe yibo namaphoyisa ezidansela futhi ezicima ngotshwala. "Uthe uma ebona amaphoyisa wabaleka wangena ethoyilethi. Eseficwa khona, uma ebuzwa ukuthi wenzeni, wathi yena akenzanga lutho," kusho uMathe.Uqhube wathi uthe uma ebuzwa ngesigameko, wathi yena akukhumbulayo ukuthi baxabene nomufi kuphela.Kuvela nokuthi ummese omkhulu anqume ngawo umufi uwufake esikhwameni wawunika isihlobo esiyingane wathi asiyowufihla."Sithe uma sifika kubo namaphoyisa, usucingwe nasehlathini ummese ungatholakali, unina wambuza ukuthi yini le abeyinika ingane ekuseni, ethi iyoyifihla," usho kanje.Uqhube wathi isikhwama abefake kuso ummese sigcine sitholwa emva kwendlu lapho ebesithukuswe khona yingane."Ubusenalo igazi. Ngathi uma ngimbuza ukuthi umbulaleleni ubafo, wathi ubengazi ukuthi owakithi. Ngaxakeka ke ngoba phela umuntu noma ngabe owaphi, akufanele abulawe," kusho uMathe.Uthe abamdingi ngaphandle umsolwa njengoba engumuntu owaziwa ngokuba yisigelekeqe endaweni.Uveze ukuthi wenza leli cala nje, ungaphandle ngebheyili ngelinye icala asaqhubeka nokulihamba enkantolo."Udaba silubizele amaphoyisa ukuze umthetho udlale indima yawo ngoba asifuni ukuzithathela umthetho ngezandla. Lo muntu asimdingi ngaphandle, asifuni aphume ngisho nangebheyili," kusho uMathe.
KUVALWE amaculo nemidanso engesiyona eyamaNazaretha ebese kudla lubi ngaphansi komholi webandla lakwaShembe, inkosi uMduduzi uNyazilwezulu Shembe.Lesi simemezelo senziwe yinhlalisuthi yoNyazilwezulu eBuhleni ekhale ngokuthi iningi lamaculo abese esetshenziswa ngabaningi kuleli bandla abehamisana nomoya ongcolile okungesiwona okaShembe.Lesi simemezelo esiqoshwe ngeselula kukhuluma inhlalisuthi yoNyazi senziwe eBuhleni muva nje.Kusona kuthiwa: "Amaculo okungesiwo ebandla, nemidanso eyenziwa ebandleni kuvaliwe. Akusavumeleke noyedwa oyophinde abonakale noma azwakale ecula iculo okungesilona elebandla. Ofuna ukucula akasebenzise izihlabelelo zebandla enze ngendlela okwenziwa ngayo ebandleni lamaNazaretha oNyazilwezulu. La maculo nemidanso awahambisani nomoya ongcwele woNyazilwezulu kodwa anomoya ongcolile kaSathane. Oyotholakala ecula noma enza le midanso uzothathelwa izinyathelo ezinqala ngaleso senzo,” lisho kanje.Udaba yokucula amaculo okungesiwo awakaShembe kuleli bandla bese ludla lubi. Bekuze kube khona nama-video abegcwala ezinkundleni zokuxhumana lapho bekuvela khona abanye babashumayeli beshaya ivosho esontweni kuchwaze. Kuthiwa bese kuwumkhuba owandile nokungaziwa ukuthi uqale kanjani njengoba abantu bese bezenzela umathanda ebandleni.Obekuthusa kakhulu ukuthi abagcotshwa bebebonakala beshaya ivosho begqoke imijiva yebandla baphinde bacule namaculo okungewona awamaNazaretha, nobekushiya abanye bedidekile ukuthi kuseyibandla likaShembe yini leli okwenziwa kulona kanje.Okhulumela uNyazilwezulu, uMnuz Thokozani Mncwabe uthe bajabule kabi ngokuvalwa kwale mikhuba ebiyenzeka esontweni."Bonke laba abebegila le mikhuba bebeyiqala uma sebefuna ukuqola abantu imali. Bebecula lezi zingoma abebehlose ngazo ukufuna imali emakholweni. Esikuqaphelile ukuthi ngaphezu kokuthi bebefuna imali, bebengcolisa negama loNyazilwezulu ngoba lo mkhuba bawuqale sekunguye osesihlalweni. Abakaze bayenze lento kubaholi abedlule. Bese kuyinto esiyandile okungaziwa nokuthi izonqadwa kanjani. Uma sebefuna imali bese beze babe nezindlela zabo zokuyifuna njengoba bese kunamatemu abawasebenzisayo bethi 'Akushaywe uthando’. Ubuwazi ke ukuthi uma sekushiwo njalo sekufuneka imali bese ziyaqala lezi zingoma kuqhume nevosho khona esontweni. Sinezihlabelelo zamaNazaretha ezingu-242 abantu abangazisebenzisa noma bejabule bazicule uma bese sontweni,” kusho uMncwabe.Njengoba amaNazaretha esemhlanganweni kaJulayi, uMncwabe uthe bazilile, abazithinti izinto eziningi njengokudla isinkwa nenyama yenkukhu. "Kuzoqala imigidi yezintombi nto ezohlukana izigaba eziyisikhombisa njengoba sezihambise izintingo eNtanda, zaphinde zahlolwa ubuntombi. Emva komgidi wezintombi kuzoqala owenhlalisuthi obizwa ngenjobo, kube yizikotshi bese kuza umbhabhadiso, kuphume imishado nokukhethwa kwezintombi nto Esipholi (Ebhentshini),” usho kanje.Kuthiwa ukuzila inyama yenkukhu kungenxa yokuthi yenza abantu bafudunyalelwe yigazi bese befuna ukuya ocansini kanti nalo luziliwe njengoba kunomhlangano kaJulayi.Kuthiwa noma ngabe awuyile emhlanganweni kaJulayi, uma uyiNazaretha kuyaphoqa ukuthi uzile konke okuzilwayo lapho ukhona.
INHLANGANO eyengamele ukhetho, i-Independent Electoral Commission (IEC), ifuna lingahoxiswa icala elifakwe i-MK, efuna kuqalwe phansi ukhetho.I-IEC ifuna ukuthi iNkantolo yezoKhetho ichithe imizamo yeMK yokuhoxisa icala njengoba ifuna ukuthi leli cala lilalelwe ngokushesha.I-IEC ithe i-MK yenza izinsolo ezibucayi mayelana nokusingathwa kokhetho lwangoMeyi, yathi kubalulekile ukuthi lolu daba lulalelwe ukuze kuzozwakala iqiniso.Ngeledlule i-MK iveze ukuthi iyalihoxisa icala, yathi izobuye ilifake kabusha.Kepha i-IEC ithe i-MK ayizange ilandele imigudu elandelwayo uma uhoxisa icala.Encwadini yabameli, i-IEC ithe i-MK bekufanele ithole imvume yokuhoxisa icala enkantolo ehlalele udaba.Ithe lokhu kungenxa yokuthi icala selihambe izigaba ezahlukene njengoba kukhona imiyalelo esike yakhishwa inkantolo.I-MK yenza izinsolo zokuthi kwakhwabaniswa amavoti ngesikhathi kunokhetho, yathi kunamavoti angu-9 million angazange abalwe.Ummeli we-IEC, uMnuz Moeti Kanyane, uthe bafuna ukuthi icala lilalelwe."Kusemqoka ukuthi leli cala lilalelwe izwe libuka, inkantolo bese ithatha isinqumo. Okungenani kufanele sazi ukuthi lezi zinsolo ezibucayi kangaka zinaso yini isisekelo.”UKanyane uthe bafuna nokuthi inkantolo isho ukuthi ubani okufanele akhokhele izindleko zabameli uma kuhoxiswa icala."I-MK ayizange izibophezele ukuthi izozikhokhela izindleko zabameli. Lapha kumoshwe imali yomphakathi kulungiselwa icala, kanti bazolihoxisa. Kufanele inkantolo ibayalele ukuthi abakhokhe.”Ngesikhathi i-MK ihoxisa icala, yathi izobuye ilifake kabusha.Okhulumela -iMK, uMnuz Nhlamulo Ndhlela, uthe bahoxise icala ngenxa yokuthi sebethole ubufakazi obusha.Wathi bahoxise icala ukuze bezofaka ubufakazi obusha esicelweni abazosifaka kabusha.I-MK yafaka icala ngenyanga eyedlule, emva kokuthi ihlulekile ukuvimba ukumenyezelwa kwemiphumela yokhetho.I-IEC neDA bayasiphikisa isicelo se-MK, bakhala ngokuthi asinabufakazi.Yize i-MK yahlula wonke amaqembu abengenele ukhetho okokuqala, yaphinde yahlula namaqembu amadala afana ne-IFP ne-EFF, ubuholi be-MK abunelisekile ngale miphumela njengoba bekholelwa ekutheni balunqoba ukhetho.Le nhlangano ilale isithathu kuzwelonke, yahamba phambili ngamavoti KwaZulu-Natal.
INKANTOLO yesiFunda yaseNtuzuma igwebe udilikajele owesilisa obedlwengula ephindelela unina omzalayo okhubazeke ngomqondo KwaMashu.Ngokobufakazi obethulwe enkantolo, lo wesilisa oneminyaka engu-31 obehlala nonina, waqala ukumnukubeza ngokocansi kusukela ngo-2020. Kuvela ukuthi kusukela lapho, lokhu bese kuyinsakavukela njengoba kuthiwa ubesemdlwengula cishe nsuku zonke.Okhulumela uphiko lwezokushushisa KwaZulu-Natal, iNational Prosecuting Authority (NPA), uNkk Natasha Ramkisson-Kara uthe umgilwa waqale wabikela omakhelwane ngayekade ekwenziwa yindodana yakhe kodwa bangamnaka.Kuthiwa indaba yaze yabhadlazwa udadewabo kamgilwa emaphoyiseni emuva kokuthi exoxelwe ngokukade kwenzeka. "Udadewabo wayevakashile ephuma kwesinye isifundazwe waxoxelwa wumgilwa ukuthi unukubezwa yindodana yakhe. Emuva kwalokho udadewabo kamgilwa walubika emaphoyiseni udaba, zamkhalela umsolwa,” kusho uNkk Ramkisson-Kara.Inkantolo ifundelwe isitatimende esichaza ngobunzima umgilwa abhekane nabo emuva kokudlwengulwa.Kusona uveza ukuthi okwamehlela kuzomkhinyabeza impilo yakhe yonke."Uchaza nokuthi kwaphoqeleka ukuthi athuthe lapho ayekade ehlala khona ngenxa yento ayenziwa indodana yakhe engakhombisanga ukuzisola,” kusho iNPA.Inkantolo yahlulele nangokuthi igama lale wesilisa lifakwe ohlwini lwabantu asebeke balahlwa amacala athinta ucansi.INPA yamukele ukushushiswa ngempumelelo kwalo wesilisa incoma umsebenzi wabashushisi namaphoyisa. Ithe kuwumsebenzi wayo ukuvikela abantu abangakwazi ukuzivikela emphakathini.Khonamanjalo, le nkantolo igwebe udilikajele indoda ena-58 eyayingumqeqeshi wesibhakela ngokudlwengula intombazane ena-13.Ibhanselwe nangeminyaka eyisikhombisa ngokufundisa umgilwa izinto eziphathelene nocansi.Kuthiwa umgilwa wayeqeqeshelwa isibhakela umgilwa. Kuthiwa wayeqala ngokumanga bese eyamqabula uma embingelela."Wagcina esedlwengula umgilwa isikhathi esingaphezu konyaka. Umgilwa wangatshela muntu okwakumehlela kodwa ekubhala phansi ebhukwini. Langa limbe unina kamgilwa walibona ibhuku wambuza ngokwakubhalwe kulona,” kusho iNPA.Kuthiwa unina wengane wabuza umsolwa ngokwakubhaliwe kodwa waphika kunalokho waya ekhaya likamgilwa wafuna ukukhokha isinxephezelo okuyinkomo.Kuvela ukuthi umalume nonina wengane bakunqaba lokhu bavele babikela amaphoyisa, wagcina eboshwa umsolwa.
BATUSA ubuhlakani bukaMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, bokuvala imilomo yabaholi bamaqembu ahlukene, nokubabekela ugibe lokuthi bazikhunge bona eminyangweni ehlukene abajube kuyona.Sisesikhulu isikhalo ngesibalo seKhabhinethi entsha, edidiyele amaqembu angu-11 akuhulumeni wobumbano njengoba inamalungu angu-75. Ongqongqoshe bangu-32 kuthi amaphini ongqongqoshe abengu-43.Abavoti yibona abakhonjwa ngenjumbane ngokuthi ukube bavotele iqembu elilodwa eliphethe uhulumeni, ngabe sincishisiwe isibalo seKhabhinethi ngoba izodla ngaphezu kukaR1 billion ngonyaka. Ngeke bakhale kumuntu uma sebengenzi mehluko ngoba abazokwazi ukwenza noma yikanjani eminyangweni abayiphethe,” kusho uNdlovu.UNdlovu uthe ongqongqoshe bamaqembu ahlukene akaboni kukhona imigomo yamaqembu abo, abazoyiphusha kuhulumeni wobumbano."Imigomo ezolandelwa izohlanganisa uhulumeni wobumbano, hhayi iqembu elilodwa. Ngakho akukho okuzobe kuphuma emaqenjini esingakubona kuphuma eminyangweni ephethwe abanye ongqongqoshe okungebona abe-ANC,” kuqhuba uNdlovu.UNgqongqoshe ehhovisi likamengameli uNksz Khumbudzo Ntshavheni, useyalele ozakwabo kwiKhabhinethi ukuthi babambe amatomu, bangaphefumuli ngezinto abazozenza eminyangweni yabo ngoba umkhombandlela ozolandelwa uzokhishwa nguRamaphosa.Le migomo izokhishwa ngelizayo emhlanganweni weKhabhinethi Lekgotla, ohlanganisa bonke ongqongqoshe, amaphini abo nabaqondisi jikelele.Emuva komhlangano uRamaphosa uzokwenekela izwe ngomkhombandlela ozolandelwa nguhulumeni kule minyaka emihlanu ezayo uma sekuvulwa ngokusemthethweni iPhalamende.Kuzocashunwa imigomo yamaqembu ahlukene ayingxenye yohulumeni wobumbano, ezoyisa izwe phambili futhi ehambisana nemigomo yokuthuthukisa izwe, iNational Development Plan (NDP). "Alikho iqembu okuzothi uma sekuphasiswe le migomo bese kuba elayo. Kuzoba ekahulumeni, ihlanganise wonke amaqembu angu-11 ayingxenye kahulumeni. Lokhu kusho ukuthi akekho ungqongqoshe ozophusha imigomo yeqembu lakhe kodwa imigomo ezophushwa ngekahulumeni,” kuchaza uNksz Ntshavheni.Uveze ukuthi amaqembu ayingxenye kahulumeni wobumbano, uma esevumelene ngemigomo ngeke esakwazi ukuyigxeka."Amaqembu aphikisayo yiMK ne-EFF kanjalo namanye angekho kuhulumeni wobumbano. Amaqembu akuhulumeni wobumbano, yiwona aphethe uhulumeni.”Mayelana nabakhala ngokwanda kwesibalo seKhabhinethi ekubeni bekunezinhlelo zokuyinciphisa, uNksz Ntshavheni, uthe abavoti yibona abadale lesi simo."Ukube abavoti bavotela iqembu elilodwa ukuba libuse uhulumeni, ngabe ayibanga khona le nkinga. URamaphosa wayehlele ukunciphisa isibalo seKhabhinethi kodwa ngenxa yokuthi iqembu lakhe alitholanga amavoti enele okuthi akwazi ukwenza lokhu, leli phupho alizange lifezeke.” Kukhona nalabo abangaboni lo hulumeni wobumbano kuphela ihlandla lawo ngo-2029, usabumbene. UNobhala jikelele we-ANC uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, uthe abanankinga nabazophuma kulo hulumeni."Silindele ukuthi kukhona abazophuma kodwa kukhona abazongena babe yingxenye kahulumeni omusha. Abahambe abahambayo, sizosala siyincenga,” kugcizelela uMbalula.
KUYE ngamagama enkehli amaphoyisa ebopha abashayeli abaphule imithetho yomgwaqo namanye amacala.Abekade exwayisile amaphoyisa ngaphambi kwempelasonto yobumnandi eThekwini ukuthi zizolala zibaliwe izaphulamthetho emigwaqeni.Okhulumela amaphoyisa kaMasipala weTheku, uColonel Boysie Zungu, uthe kuboshwe abashayeli abangu-23 ngempelasonto.UZungu uthe amaphoyisa abekade enesivimbamgwaqo eCato Ridge lapho ebophe khona abantu abayisikhombisa abebeshayela bebukhile."Abanye ababili baboshelwe ukutholakala nezibhamu ezingekho emthethweni,” kusho uZungu.Uqhube wathi ziwu-602 izigameko ezibikelwe amaphoyisa akwazile ukuthi abhekane nazo.Amaphoyisa abikelwe nangezehlo zasemigwaqeni ezingu-128.UZungu uthe amaphoyisa akwazile ukuthola imoto eyodwa ebikade ibikwe ukuthi yebiwe."Kuphinde kwabhekwana namacala angu-116 okuphulwa kwemithetho kamasipala,” kuchaza uZungu.Khonamanjalo, uZungu uthe abakwasidlodlo babophe abashayeli abangu-14 abebephuzile eHillcrest.Lokhu kwenzeke ngesikhathi kunesivimbamgwaoeqo kuleya ndawo.Kulaba ababoshiwe kukhona nomshayeli oyedwa wesifazane.Ngasekupheleni kwesonto elidlule, amaphoyisa akhiphe isixwayiso ethi bazoboshwa abantu abazoshayela bebukhile.Akhuthaze abashayeli bezimoto nabathandi bobumnandi ukuba bahloniphe imithetho yemigwaqo futhi bangashayeli bephuzile.Aveyeveze nokuthi kuzobe kuphithizela iphoyisa eThekwini futhi kube khona azobe etshalelwe ukuthi alawule ukuhamba kwezimoto ezize emjahweni wamahhashi eGreyville.Bekuphithizela iphoyisa emigwaqweni yaseThekwini, ezindaweni zobumnandi nasemabhishi ngempelasonto. Kwezinye izindawo abekade ehamba ngezinyawo eqaphe ubugebengu ikakhulukazi enkabeni yeTheku naseGreyville.
Amaphoyisa aKwaZulu-Natal abophe abasolwa abayisikhombisa eKombe, phakathi kweNkandla naseMsinga, ngezinsolo zokutholakala nezibhamu okukhona kuzo ama-AK47 nezinhlamvu okungekho emthwethweni ngoMsombuluko ekuseni.La madoda, aneminyaka ephakathi kuka-27 no-75, aboshwe ngemuva kokuthi amaphoyisa elunywe indlebe ngawo.Amaphoyisa athe kungenzeka ukuthi kunomuntu osindile obezobulawa yila madoda njengoba eboshiwe nje."Abayisithupha baboshwe ngemuva kokutholakala ne-AK47, i-308 yokuzingela nezibhamu ezincane ezintathu zonke ebezinezinhlamvu,” kusho amaphoyisa esitatimendeni.Athe umkhankaso wawo udlulele kwenye indawo lapho kuboshwe khona umsolwa oyedwa otholakale nezibhamu ezingekho emthethweni."Ngesikhathi efika kule ndawo owesilisa oyedwa uboshwe ngemuva kokutholakala ne-AK47 ne-.38 special revolver nezinhlamvu. Bonke abasolwa bagcinwe esiteshini saseMuden futhi bazovela eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseGreytown maduze,” kusho amaphoyisa.

KULINDELEKE ukuthi inkantolo ikhiphe isigwebo ecaleni likanesi owaqasha izinkabi ezabulala umyeni wakhe owayewunjiniyela.Ibamba lejaji, uSolwazi Bonke Dumisa, kulindeleke ukuthi liwise isigwebo eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini.Luwubekele uMsombuluko noLwesibili umsebenzi wokufundwa kwesigwebo ngenxa yobufakazi obuningi elethulelwa bona.Phambilini uDumisa walahla ngecala lokuthumba, elokubulala ngokweba imoto uNompumelelo Goncalves.Lo wesifazane walahlwa ngamacala benomfowabo uNkosinathi Zungu.UZungu, nayekade eqashwe nabo, babulala uMnuz Nkosi Timmy Langa, owayewunjiniyela kaTransnet.Bamthumba emzini wakhe ePinetown ngobusuku bangoSepthemba 29, 2020 bayombulalela emahlathini oZwathini, eNdwedwe.Bazihlangula kwaze kwaba uDumisa ubalahla ngalawa macala ngo-Ephreli nonyaka.UNksz Zodwa Langa ongudadewabo kamufi, ufuna inkantolo ukuthi igixabeze ababulali ngodilikajele.UNksz Langa uthe uyobe ubathobe amanxeba uDumisa uma ebanikeza izigwebo ezizobahlalisa ejele isikhathi eside laba ababili."Silindele ukuthi ijaji libanikeze udilikajele ababulala, ikakhulukazi uMpume (Goncalves). Lokho kuzosisiza ukuthi sikwazi ukuphola nasemoyeni ngoba abakwenza kwasizwisa ubuhlungu,” kusho uNksz Langa.Phambilini ehlulela uDumisa watusa ubuchwepheshe besimanje wathi uMbuso ukwazile ukwethula ubufakazi obuqanda ikhanda uvezela inkantolo ukuthi yilaba ababulala uLanga.Umshushisi u-Advocate Krishen Shah wayesebenzisa ubufakazi bezingcingo eziqoshiwe, obe-tracker yezimoto, obasemabhange, obemibhoshongo okudonsa khona amafoni wabiza nochwepheshe bamafoni.Inkabi uJames Makhudu Mthimkhulu, engomunye yabantu abaqashwa uGoncalves yathenjiswa uR15 000, yalivuma icala yagwetshwa iminyaka engu-20 ejele.UMthimkhulu waphenduka ufakazi woMbuso wazininda kanye nalaba abazogwetshwa.Watshela inkantolo ukuthi uyena noZungu abaklinya ngentambo ye-ayina uLanga washona. Wathi abakwenza bebulala babeqashwe uGoncalves.
INKOSIKAZI yenkakha kaphrojusa owayebuye abe ngumculi uRobbie Malinga, ongasekho emhlabeni, isithathe isinqumo sokuthi ifake enkantolo iTS Records ifuna inkontileka eyasayinwa wumyeni wayo ephakathi kwakhe nale nkampani.U-Ann Malinga ongunkosikazi kaRobbie uthe kuyaphoqa ukuthi afake iTS Records enkantolo emva kokufaka incwadi yabameli, ebhalela inkampani efuna inkontileka kaRobbie kodwa iTS Records yangampendula. Isolezwe Ngempelasonto linayo ikhophi yencwadi yabameli baka-Ann Malinga ayibhalele iTS Records, ne-Universal Music efuna inkontileka yokusebenzisana kwezinkampani nomyeni wakhe, ukuze abone ukuthi kumele ahlomule kanjani kumaroyalty omyeni wakhe. Ann Malinga Isithombe: InstagramIncwadi ibhalwe ngabameli baka-Ann, iMdakane Attorneys Inc, lapho becela ukuthi banikwe wonke amaphepha asayinwa nguRobbie enkotileka yokusebenzisana nalezi zinkampani. Uthe okwenza agcine engazi ukuthi kumele ahlomule kanjani ngamaroyalty omyeni wakhe okumele awathole yingoba nenkontileka akanayo."Ngiyibhalelile iTS Records ne-Universal Music ukuthi banginike lamaphepha enkontileka. I-Universal isingiphendulile icacisa ngedaba yamaphepha engiwadingayo nokuyinto engikhululile kodwa iTS ivele yakhetha ukungaphenduli. Isenzo sayo siyaphoqa ukuthi sibafake enkantolo ngoba kuyacaca ukuthi abazimisele ukuthi sisebenzisane kahle njengoba beziba ngisho nencwadi yabameli. Ngesikhathi bebhalelwa bebekelwe isikhathi ukuthi babe sebephendulile kodwa kuze kube yimanje abakasho lutho,” kusho u-Ann.Kwimpendulo yakwa-Universal Music leli phephandaba elinayo ikhophi yayo, le nkampani iyaziqhelelanisa namaphepha asayinwa phakathi kukaRobbie nayo kodwa iwakhomba khona eTS Records. Empendulweni yayo i-Universal Music iyakuveza ukuthi, impela iyazi ukuthi ikhona inkontileka eyasayinwa abaculi abangaphansi kweTS Records ebisebenzisana nayo kodwa bona babenenkontileka neTS Records, engathinti abasayine ngaphansi kwayo. Bathe inkontileka yokusebenzisana neTS Records yasayinwa yi-EMI ngaphambi kokuba ithengwe yi-Universal Music. Bathi le nkontileka yayithinta ukusebenzisana phakathi kwabo ne-TS Records kuphela ingathinti abantu abangaphansi kweTS Records. Yathi uma kukhona abafuna ukukwazi abaxhumane nayo iTS Records.Imizamo yokuxhumana nommeli weTS Records, uDumisani Motsamai ayiphumelelanga ngoba nomyalezo athunyelelwe wona akawuphendulanga.U-Ann uthe akusekho okunye sebezohlangana khona enkantolo ngoba kuyacaca abazimisele ukubambisana nabo.Ukuxabana phakathi kuka-Ann Malinga, neTS Records kaTK Nciza kuqale eminyakeni edlule ngesikhathi sekumele u-Ann athole imali yamaroyalty kaRobbie kodwa wakhala ngokuthi akayitholile. Uthe ubevamise ukuyithola kodwa kumxakile uma esebona engasayitholi kunalokho watshelwa ngemali eyisamba anikwa yona iTS Records watshelwa ukuthi ukhisimuzi wezingane.
UKHALA uyazithulisa umculi owazakhela udumo emsakazweni ngowesifazane athi ubaleke nengane yakhe futhi akasafuni ayibone. Lo mculi, odumile eThekwini nophinde abe ngumphathi wezinhlelo emicimbini eyehlukene, uthe unendodana eneminyaka eyisithupha nalo wesifazane waseMlaza. Inkinga uthe akasakwazi ukuyibona emva kokuthi lo wesifazane ethole isoka elisha asehlala nalo nendodana yabo.Uveze ukuthi okubuhlungu uyayondla indodana yakhe futhi usayihlawula waze wengeza nangenkomo ngaphezulu ngoba efuna ukuba nobudlelwano nayo."Ayikho into engiphethe kabuhlungu njengale eyenziwa wu...(egagula igama lakhe). Akukho engingakwenzeli yona indodana yethu kodwa ukwazi ukuyithatha abaleke nayo. Sithole le ngane naye sisafunda, ngingakabi nayo imali, kodwa bengimnika imali uma kwenzekile ngaba nayo. Nabazali bakhe u....(esho unina wendodana yakhe) abanankinga nami njengoba bebekwazi ukuthi uma ngifuna ukubona ingane yami bayikhiphe ngiyibone njengoba ibihlala nabo. Udaba lwethu sengize ngaluyisa enkantolo njengoba ngidinga ukuthi ngikwazi ukubonana nengane yami emva kokuthi efike kubo u...(esho unina) wayithatha wahamba nayo ngaphandle kokuvumelana nabazali bakhe,” kusho lo mculi.Uthe ngoJulayi 18 baya enkantolo njengoba efuna ukuthi anikwe ithuba lokuthi abe sempilweni yendodana yakhe."Mina engikukhalelayo ukuthi sihlale sazana nendodana yami. Ngalokho angisho ukuthi ngifuna sibuyelane. Ukuba sempilweni yendodana yami akusho ukuthi ngizoyithatha ngizohlala nayo kodwa ngifuna ukwenza isiqiniseko ukuthi ngezimpelasonto ngihlala nginayo ukuze sihlale sixhumene. Yena uthi iyoze iqale ukuhlangana nami isineminyaka engu-11 engingazi ukuthi kusho ukuthini. Okubuhlungu kakhulu ukuthi indodana yami angiyazi noma isafunda yini njengoba zonke izikole aveza ukuthi ifunda kuzona sengiyile kuzona kuvela ukuthi ayikaze ifunde khona,”usho kanje.Imizamo yokuxhumana nonina wendodana yalo mculi ayiphumelelanga njengoba engekho emndenini wakhe onezinamba zocingo lwakhe njengoba kuthiwa usexabane ngisho nomndeni wakhe.Udadewabo walo wesifazane uthe kumanje unina wengane yalo mculi usenze izincwadi zesivimbelo emaphoyiseni ukuthi unina noyise abamzalayo bangaphinde baxhumane naye njengoba ebasola ngokuzwelana noyise wengane yakhe."Akekho ekhaya osevumeleke ukuthi axhumane naye. Nathi asimazi ukuthi uhlala kuphi nengane. Usashintsha ngisho nezingcingo zakhe. Indoda ahlala nayo sezwa kuthiwa inguphrojusa wakhe womculo njengoba naye engumculi. Umndeni wami uhlukumezeke kabi ngesenzo sikadadewethu njengoba engasafuni ukuxhumana namuntu ekhaya. Uyise wengane wenze konke kahle ekhaya futhi ingane uyikhokhele ngokugcwele. Inkinga nguyena udadewethu. Asazi uthando olunjani lolu alutholile olwenza aze adikile ngisho nomndeni wakhe ngenxa yendoda, aphinde angafuni ingane ixhumane noyise,” kusho udadewabo walo wesifazane.
LINGASE liphele isonto elizayo isiqokiwe imeya yomasipala waseThekwini njengoba i-ANC KwaZulu-Natal ithi uzobizwa "maduze” umhlangano wokuqoka ozongena kule sikhundla esivuleke emva kokususwa kukaMnuz Mxolisi Kaunda.Kulindeleke ukuthi kube nezingxoxo zokugcina kule mpelasonto.Uma amaqembu evumelana, kulindeleke ukuthi kubizwe umhlangano womkhandlu oyisipesheli ngesonto elizayo, ozokhetha imeya.ITheku lisale lingenayo imeya ngenyanga eyedlule emva kokususwa kukaKaunda, osejutshwe eMkhandlwini weziFundazwe.Ukuqokwa kwemeya entsha kwabhuntsha emhlanganweni womkhandlu owawungenyanga eyedlule.Yize uSomlomo womkhandlu, uMnuz Thabani Nyawose, athi ukukhethwa kwemeya kwabhuntshiswa wukungabi bikho kwenhlangano eyengamele ukhetho, i-Electoral Commission of South Africa (IEC), imithombo yaveza ukuthi ukungavumelani kwamakhansela e-ANC ngozongena esikhundleni yikhona okwenza ukuthi imeya igcine ingakhethwanga.Igama elihamba phambili elaloyo owayephathiswe uMnyango wezoLimo, uMnuz Cyril Xaba.Umthombo uthe uma izingxoxo zingahamba kahle, umhlangano wokukhetha imeya uzokuba ngesonto elizayo."Kubukeka sengathi kukhona ukuvumelana, sekushoda ukuthi kuqinisekiswe yonke into. Izingxoxo zokugcina zizokuba kuyo le mpelasonto. Lokho kusho ukuthi uma kuvunyelwene ngayo yonke into, umhlangano womkhandlu uzokuba ngesonto elizayo. Ngeke kulindwe umhlangano womkhandlu owejwayelekile ngoba usekude (umhlangano womkhandlu owajwayelekile uba sekupheleni kwenyanga). Umasipala omkhulu kangaka ngeke uhlale isikhathi eside kangaka ungenayo imeya.”Okhulumela i-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Mafika Mndebele, uvumile ukuthi umhlangano wokuqoka imeya uzobizwa maduze kodwa wanqaba ukusho usuku."Thina lapha kwi-ANC asisebenzi kanjalo. Thina sifike senze izinhlelo zethu zangaphakathi kwi-ANC, bese siyekela abaholi esibajube kuhulumeni ukuba baqhubeke nomsebenzi. Yingakho kungeke kube yithina esimemezela umhlangano womkhandlu waseThekwini, sishiyela ebuholini bomkhandlu ukuthi kube ibona obumemezela umhlangano. Engikwaziyo nje ukuthi umhlangano uzobizwa maduze.”UMndebele uthe ngokwabo sebekulungele ukuhlala komhlangano."Sesiphothule yonke into, sesilinde ukuthi kubizwe umhlangano.”Ngakolunye uhlangothi, uNyawose utshele iphephandaba elinguzakwano weSolezwe, iThe Mercury, ukuthi bebengakanqumi ukuthi umhlangano uzokuba nini."Asikho isimemezelo somhlangano esesiphumile. Sizokwenza isimemezelo uma sesinqumile ukuthi umhlangano uzokuba nini.”I-ANC ayinazo izihlalo ezanele ukuthi ibuse ngokuzimela eThekwini, ibambisane namaqembu amancane.Akucaci noma isizosebenzisana yini ne-IFP neDA kumasipala njengoba la maqembu esebambisene kuzwelonke nasesifundazweni.
I-MK ithi izobuye ilifake kabusha icala eliphikisa imiphumela yokhetho elihoxise ngoLwesithathu.Ithe ukuhoxisa kwayo icala akufanele kuthathwe ngokuthi ayinabo ubufakazi bokuthi ukhetho lwangoMeyi lwalungakhululekile.Le nhlangano ihoxise icala ebilifake eNkantolo yezoKhetho, lapho ibifuna khona ukuthi kuqalwe phansi ukhetho.I-MK ayiyemukeli imiphumela yokhetho njengoba ithi kunezigidi zamavoti ayo angazange abalwe.Okhulumela i-MK, uMnuz Nhlamulo Ndhlela, uthe bakhethe ukuhoxisa icala emva kokuthola ubufakazi obusha bokukhwatshwaniswa kwamavoti."Abameli bethu basiluleke ngokuthi kunemidanti okufanele ilandelwe ukuze sikwazi ukwethula lobu bufakazi obusha enkantolo. Abameli baseluleke ngokuthi kufanele sifake isicelo esisha ukuze sizokwazi ukwethula ubufakazi."Ngifuna ukukugcizelela ukuthi ukuhoxisa kwethu icala akusho ukuthi asinabo ubufakazi balezi zinsolo esizenzile. Sizofaka isicelo esisha maduze ukuze kuzophenywa izinsolo.”UNdhlela uthe ubufakazi obusha bufakazela lokhu abebelokhu bekusho kokuthi ukhetho lwalungakhululekile."Ochwepheshe esixoxa nabo bayaqhubeka nokuthola ubufakazi obusha bokukhwashwaniswa kwamavoti. Ingakho sikhethe ukufaka isicelo esisha ngoba besingafuni ukuthi ubufakazi obusha buchithwe.”I-MK ingelinye lamaqembu afika kwezwakala okhethweni lwangoMeyi njengoba yalala isithathu kuzwelonke, yathola izihlalo ezingu-58 ePhalamende.KwaZulu-Natal iyona i-MK eyahamba phambili ngezihlalo ezingu-37, nokho ayisiphethe isifundazwe njengoba izihlalo zayo zingenele ukuthi ibuse ngokuzimela.Yize i-MK yahlula wonke amaqembu abengenele ukhetho okokuqala, yaphinde yahlula namaqembu amadala afana ne-IFP ne-EFF, ubuholi be-MK abunelisekile ngale miphumela njengoba bekholelwa ekutheni balunqoba ukhetho.Emva kokhetho i-MK yafaka isikhalo, ifuna kumiswe ukukhishwa kwemiphumela yokhetho.UNdhlela uthe namanje kusabadida ukuthi yini eyenza ukuthi inhlangano eyengamele ukhetho, i-Electoral Commission of South Africa (IEC), iphuthumise ukumenyezelwa kwemiphumela yokhetho."Ukukhipha kwabo imiphumela ngokushesha kwaphula amalungelo abantu ababevotile okhethweni.”Njengengxenye yokukhombisa ukungayemukeli imiphumela yokhetho, amalungu e-MK awazange aye ePhalamende ngesikhathi kufungiswa amanye amalungu ePhalamende.Nokho agcine eyile ukuyofungiswa ngesonto eledlule.I-IEC neDA bayasiphikisa isicelo se-MK, bakhala ngokuthi i-MK ayinabo ubufakazi bezinsolo zokuthi kwakhwatshwaniswa amavoti.
