Unxuse ukuba abazobhadanywa benza ubugebengu bangabekwa izandla kodwa balethwe kuye.UNYAZI LWEZULU"Ngoba ngiyazi niyashaya kodwa akufanele nishaye ngale ndlela enenza ngayo. Umuntu engabe esazi ukuthi abaleke ashone kuphi. Athi uya nga la, kuthiwe vala. Athi uyakha ngujubane, abe la amaNazaretha. Nangaphambili kube sengathi athi yima wena, uyaphi la kuthina.”UNyazi luthe abangashaywa abantu ngoba uzothi uyamlokotha kanti ubesesalelwe imizuzu emibili ephila."Uthi uyamshaya bese ethula. Usuyabuya uza kimi uzofuna uVaselina wokuvusa umuntu, ebulawe nguwena. Ngakho ngiyanicela bantwana bakaNkulunkulu, kade sawulinda lo Mhlangano. Sewuze wafika."UNyazi lubuye lwacela abanikazi bezitolo ukuba bazivale izitolo ngesikhathi kusontwa.Lubuye lwadonsa ngendlebe abantu abaxabene ukuba bangezi nengxabano yangasemakubo bezodunga ngayo uMhlangano.Lo mholi ubuye wadonsa ngendlebe amakhosazane ukuba angabonakali egcaluza kodwa uhlale eSipholi. "Akufunakali-ke inkosazane egcaluza umuzi wonke sengathi idiliva iposi. Kufanele abantu bahlale eSipholi. Kunesikhathi-ke okufanele inkosazane isazi ukuthi ngaseKamu ayisafuneki ngaso."UNyazi luthe isikhathi okungasafuneki ngaso amakhosazane u-7 ntambama. Luthe intombi ayihambi nomfana uma sekungene isikhathi somhlangano, "ngisho noma owakini ngoba akanayo i-number plate ethi owakini."Lubuye lwanxusa amakhosazane kuMdedele ukuba aziphathe kahle."Okufanele nikwazi makhosazane ukuthi nina ningabanikazi balo mhlangano. Kufanele niwuphathe kahle, ungoniwa yinina. Ngibabekile abashumayeli. Abashayi bayabhaxabula. Angazi-ke. Ngithe benganishayi kakhulu. Kodwa nifuna ukushaywa khona. Ophuma esiporweni kufanele asithole isijeziso. Noma ningashaywa yinhlalisuthi yabashumayeli, kuyofanele baniyise kubaphathi benu. Angazi-ke ngoba abaphathi bayayidedela impama. Ziyovuthwa izihlathi," kuphetha uNyazi.Njengoba kuyinkonzo kaJulayi, kuningi okwenzeka kuyona. Kumanje amaNazaretha azile izinto eziningi njengoba kuwuJulayi. Awayi ocansini kanjalo nokunembiliso awakudli kuze kuphele uJulayi. Kunemigido eyahlukene okungeyomama, eyezintombi neyenhlalisuthi. Nezintombi ziyisa nezintingo eNtanda eNanda lapho zisuke zilindwe khona wuNyazilwezulu. Uma sekuvalwa umhlangano ngasekupheleni kwenyanga kulapho kuzobe sekuyiwa khona ebhentshini lapho inhlalisuthi izobe ikhetha izintombi ngenhloso yokuganwa. Kuzophinde kuphume nemishado esuke ibusiswa khona enkonzweni ngokohlelo lwamaNazaretha.

BABONGWE besadla anhlamvana abesifazane abayisithupha bebandla lamaRoma Akhatholika ababe khona ngesikhathi kusungulwa umhlangano wamadodakazi ka-Anna Ocwebileyo iDaughters of St Anne Sodality, kwisiFundabhishobhi saseThekwini.Lokhu kwenzeke ngesikhathi leli bandla linendumezulu yenkonzo yokubungaza ukuphela kweminyaka engu-20 kwasungulwa lo mhlangano kwisiFundabhishobhi saseThekwini esenganyelwe ngu-Archbishop Mandla Mjwara.Inkonzo ibikade iqhubeka eNtshongweni futhi ihanjelwe nanguyena uqobo u-Archbishop. Abesifazane ababongiwe ngokuyibamba ishisa kusukela umhlangano usungulwa ngoNksz Thokozani Myeza, uNksz Stinky Dube, Nksz Busi Mbokazi, Nksz Khanyisile Jali, Nksz Lindiwe Mokoena noNksz Nonkululeko Hlengwa."Sithanda ukunibonga kakhulu ngokuthembeka kulo mhlangano kusukela uqala kuze kube yimanje. Kusho lukhulu ukuthi namanje nisakhona nisayibambile. Siyabonga kakhulu ngokuzinikela kwenu kulo mhlangano,'' kusho uMjwara ebhekise kubona.Banikezwe izitifiketi bebongwa ngendima abayiklamile kulo mhlangano. Bagixatshezwe nangezipho ezinhlobonhlobo. Nabo bazwakalise okukhulu ukujabula ngokuthi babongwe besadla anhlamvana.Lona ngumhlangano wabesifazane bebandla eliKhatholika abangashadile. Lo mcimbi ubuzinyaziswe ukuphuma ngobuningi kwabazalwane abaningi baleli bandla ebebevela ezingxenyeni ezahlukene zesiFundazwe seKwaZulu Natal.UMengameli walo mhlangano, uNksz Nontobeko Dlamini naye ubabongelile laba besifazane ngebanga elide asebelihambile kusukela ubunjwa lo mhlangano.Uthe bakhombisile ukuthi bazimisele kangakanani ngokuwusebenzela ngokuzikhandla nangokwethembeka umhlangano abawujoyina.
UNGQONGQOSHE weMfundo eyisiSekelo, uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, uchitha eyokuzodlala ipolitiki emnyangweni nokuzolwa nenyunyana yothisha iSadtu.UNksz Gwarube uzibophezele ekutheni uzohlangana nezinhlaka ezehlukene ngoba zibaluleke kakhulu noma kungathiwa kuhlukenwe ngemibono. Izinto azibeke eqhulwini lwazozenza, ukuqeda ngezindlu zangasese zomgodi ezikoleni, ukuphucula izinga lokufunda kubafundi abangakuqondi abakufundayo ukuphucula ingqalasizinda nokulwa nesihlava sokuhlukunyezwa kwabafundi."Angizile ukuzolwa izimpi zepolitiki noma ukuzofaka imigomo ye-DA kwezemfundo. Ngizosebenzisana nezinhlaka ezehlukene kwemfundo ngoba ngeke ngiwenze ngingedwa lo msebenzi.” Ukusho lokhu ekhuluma nesiteshi sethelevishini iNewzroom Afrika.Usho kanje iSadtu yaphumela obala yachitha ukuqokwa kwakhe ikhala ngokuthi iqembu lakhe aliyifuni le nyunyana ngoba libona isitha nokuthi konke okungalungile kwezemfundo, kwenziwa yile nyunyana.Le nyunyana isole ne-DA ngokuchitha umthetho wezikole obuchitshiyelwa olinde ukusayinwa nguMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa iBela Bill, onika amandla izinhloko zeminyango yezemfundo ezifundazweni ukuthi zinqume uma izikole sezigcwele kanjalo namanye amandla.UNksz Gwarube (34) uthe kummangazile ukuthi kube nomuzwa onje kule nyunyana esanda kuqokwa."Odabeni oluthinta iBela Bill, ngizoxoxa noMengameli ngezinye izigatshana engingeneme ngazo. UMengameli unawo amandla okuwuphindisela ePhalamende lo mthetho, ukuze ulungiswe ngaphambi kokuba awusayine. Angicabangi ukuthi wonke lo mthetho kumele uchithwe kodwa izigatshana ezimbalwa ezidinga ukulungiswa,” kusho uNksz Gwarube.Uthe okwakhe yena ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abafundi abangu-14 million, ababhekele bayafunda."Okwami nje ukuqinisekisa ukuthi angibenzeli phansi abafundi. Okunye nokunye ngizokubona uma kuhamba isikhathi. Ngizoyiveza eminye imibono yami, ngeke ngidlale ngizosebenza.” Uthe uzimisele nokuvakashela ezifundazweni ayohlangana nabaphathiswa beminyango, namathimba abo."Yinto engiyijahe kabi ukuhambela zonke izifundazwe ngihlangane nezikhulu zomnyango ngizwe ngezinto ezimbi, nezinhle ezidinga ukulungiswa. Ngizothola nalapho kuhamba kahle khona, ukuze siqinise kakhulu khona." Uthe uzoxhumana nanongoti kwezemfundo ukuze bamluleke ngezinye zezinto ezidinga ukulungiswa.Uncome obenguNgqongqoshe walo mnyango uNkk Angie Motshekga, wathi usenamava kulo mkhakha ahlale kuwo iminyaka engu-15. Uveze nokuthi uzosebenzisana nozakwabo osemnyangweni wezemiSebenzi yoMphakathi neNgqalasizinda uMnuz Dean MacPherson, okwi-DA mayelana nezithinta ingqalasinda ezikoleni.
ITSHE lizogaya ngomunye umhlathi ezikhungweni zoMnyango wezaseKhaya kufika ungqongqoshe omusha othi kumele iphele indaba yolayini abade nokuthi njalo kuthiwe imishini ayisebenzi.UDkt Leon Schreiber, ophuma kwiDemocratic Alliance, usho kanje eqeda kufungiswa ukuba wungqongqoshe walo mnyango eCape Town.Uthe abantu bakuleli abehlise amaphaphu mayelana nomazisi oyibhukwana eliluhlaza ngoba awukazoqedwa. Usho lokhu nje ngeledlule kusabalale imibiko ebithi sekuyaphela ngalolu hlobo lukamazisi njengoba lo Mnyango usufuna ukuthi bonke abantu babe nomazisi oyikhadi. "Yize kunjalo kodwa siyabakhuthaza abantu ukuthi bathole omazisi abangamakhadi (smart IDs) okungewona umqansa ukuwuthola,” kusho uSchreiber.Ube esethi igeja ensimini, ufuna ukubona kuphuculwa indlela amahhovisi alo mnyango enza ngayo umsebenzi.Ufuna kuqedwe olayini abade ababonakala ezikhungweni zalo mnyango. Ufuna nokuthi abantu balujwayele uhlelo lokufaka izicelo usebenzisa ikhompyutha."Kuzomele iphele le nto yokuthi imishini ayisebenzi (i-offline). Mina njengongqongqoshe ngifuna ukuthi isebenze (imishini). Kumanje sixoxisana nezinye izinhlaka ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi imishini yethu ihlale isebenza ngaso sonke isikhathi,” kusho uSchreiber.Uyichithile imibiko esanda kusabalala ngaye ukuthi ungowaseZimbabwe.Uthe yena akaze awubeke umcondo wakhe eZimbabwe, uzalelwe eNingizimu Afrika wakhulela khona.Uveze nokuthi uyafisa ukuvakasha kulelizwe elingumakhelwane namanye emhlabeni angakaze aye kuwona."Izindaba ezingelona iqiniso ukuthi mina ngingowaseZimbabwe. Ngisho ikhomishana yokhetho i-IEC ayikuvumeli ukuthi ube yilungu lePhalamende uma ungeyena owaseNingizimu Afrika,” kuchaza ungqongqoshe.Uchaze ubumqoka bomnyango aphathiswe wona empilweni yomuntu wathi iwona oqinisekisayo ukuthi uyisakhamuzi.Uqhube wathi umuntu uyaxhumana nalo mnyango cishe impilo yakhe yonke kusukela ezalwa enzelwa isitifiketi noma esedlulile emhlabeni enzelwe esokufa.

OWAYEYIMEYA kaMasipala waseThekwini, uNkk Zandile Gumede, uphika imibiko yokuthi udlelwe impahla ebiza izigidi zamaRandi.UNkk Gumede uthe ungamanga aluhlaza umbiko oshicilelwe ezikweni lezindaba elibika ngesingisi othi uphiko oludla impahla, i-Assets Forfeiture Unit, lushaqe izimoto nomuzi wakhe kanokusho.Ukusho lokhu esitatimendeni esikhishwe yinhlangano yakhe engenzi nzuzo, iMama Zandile Gumede Foundation.Umbiko uthe i-Assets Forfeiture Unit ishaqe impahla kaNkk Gumede yesamba sikaR25 million.Lo mbiko uthe ukushaqwa kwale mpahla kumayelana necala lenkohlakalo yezigidi zamaRandi yethenda yokuqoqa udoti eThekwini.UNkk Gumede, owusihlalo we-ANC kwisifunda iTheku, ungomunye wabantu ababhekene naleli cala.Okhulumela uNkk Gumede, uMnuz Siphelele Jiyana, uthe i-Assets Forfeiture Unit yagasela kanye emzini wakhe, yaphuma ilambatha."Wonke umuntu uyazi ukuthi bagasela ngo-2019, ngo-Okthoba 10. BAYALELWE ukuthi babambe amatomu oNgqongqoshe asebephefumula ngezinto abazozenza eminyangweni abeyengamele ezweni njengoba umkhombandlela ozolandelwa uzokhishwa nguMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa.Lo myalelo ukhishwe nguNgqongqoshe ehhovisi likaMengameli uNksz Khumbudzo Ntshavheni ngoLwesine, ekhuluma esithangamini nabezindaba eKapa.Ongqongqoshe abahlukene bamatasa baphawula ngezinto abazozenza kuhulumeni wehlandla lesikhombisa, kulandela ukufungiswa kuleli sonto.UNksz Ntshavheni uthe imigomo emisha ezolandelwa nguhulumeni, izobhungwa ngelizayo emhlanganweni weKhabhinethi Lekgotla."Lo mhlangano uhlelelwe uJulayi 11 noJulayi 12. Kuwona kuzobhungwa ngemigomo ezolandelwa kubhekwa umqulu wokuthuthukisa izwe i-National Development Plan. Abaqondisi jikelele beminyango babuka yonke imigomo yamaqembu ayingxenye yohulumeni wokuphatha ngokubambisana, bese becaphuna imigomo engasetshenziswa ukuthuthukisa izwe. Izobe isihlanganiswa kwenziwe imigomo eyodwa okuyiyo izwe elizogxila kuyona kule minyaka emihlanu ezayo.”Uthe uRamaphosa uzobe esethula isihlanganisiwe ePhalamende ngoJulayi 18, isiwumkhombandlela wezwe."Alikho iqembu okuzothi uma sekuphasiswe le migomo bese kuba elayo. Kuzobe sekuba yimigomo kahulumeni, isihlanganisa wonke amaqembu angu-11 ayingxenye kahulumeni.”Ugcizelele ukuthi akekho ungqongqoshe ozophusha imigomo yeqembu lakhe, kodwa imigomo ezophushwa ngekahulumeni okuzobe kuvunyelwene ngayo emhlanganweni weKhabhinethi lekgotla.Uveze ukuthi emaqenjini angu-11 ayingxenye kahulumeni, alikho elizobe seliyigxeka."Amaqembu aphikisayo yi-MK ne-EFF kanjalo namanye angekho kuhulumeni wobumbano. Amaqembu akuhulumeni wobumbano, yiwona aphethe uhulumeni. Imigomo kuzobe kungeyona eye-ANC, DA noma i-UDM, kodwa ekahulumeni.”Uveze ukuthi ongqongqoshe bazobe sebelandela le migomo emisha kahulumeni."Okwamanje awukho umgomo okhona ezweni, ngoba eyehlandla likahulumeni wesithupha iphele ngesikhathi kufungiswa uRamaphosa. Ngalesi sikhathi ongqongqoshe bamatasa nomsebenzi wokuxhumana nabaqondisi beminyango, ukuthola ngezinto ebezenzeka emnyangweni, nokuthi imiphi imigomo okumele ifakwe ukuze iminyango iyilandele,” kugcizelela uNksz Ntshavheni.Mayelana nabakhala ngokwanda kwesibalo seKhabhinethi ekubeni bekunezinhlelo zokuyinciphisa, uNksz Ntshavheni, uthe abavoti yibona abadale lesi simo."Ukube abavoti bavotela iqembu elilodwa ukubusa uhulumeni, ngabe ayibanga khona le nkinga. URamaphosa wayehlele ukunciphisa isibalo seKhabhinethi kodwa ngenxa yokuthi iqembu lakhe alitholanga amavoti enele okuthi akwazi ukwenza lokhu, leli phupho alizange lifezeke.” Uthe basazoqhubeka nezinhlelo zokuthi kube nengxoxo ngekusasa lezwe ezohlanganisa izinhlaka ezehlukene zomphakathi.Ugcizelele ukuthi njengoba sebekhethelwe kwiKhabhinethi, bazosebenzela izwe hhayi amaqembu."Njengoba sifungile nje, asisebenzeli amaqembu ethu kodwa sesisebenzela izwe. Konke esikwenzayo sibeka phambili izwe, hhayi amaqembu ethu asijubile.”
NKOSIKHONA CELEZIGCWALE udaka izinyawo zikamfundisi webandla laseZayoni, uMusa wokuKhanya, ngemuva kokuba esakaze umkakhe ngempama phambi kwesigungu sebandla.Ngokuthola kweSolezwe, uMfundisi Zethembe Mcambi uwaklaze umkakhe ngempama, uNkk Nomalungelo Mcambi ngemuva kokuba babe nokungaboni ngasolinye ngodaba lokusetshenziswa kwemali ebandleni.Umthombo obukhona ngesikhathi sesigameko uveza ukuthi isehlakalo senzeke emagcekeni ebandla kunomhlangano waminyaka yonke, lapho okusuke kudingidwa ukungena nokuphuma kwemali yebandla.Uthi umfundisi ubephakamisa okuthile mayelana nendlela okumele kusetshenziswe ngakhona imali yebandla esuke inikelelwe ukuthi kulekelelwe ngayo izingane ezingenabo abazali ebandleni.Kuthiwa umkakhe ubenombono owehlukile kobe kushiwo ngumholi webandla, ongumyeni wakhe."Angifuni ukuveza ukuthi ubaba ubefuna imali isetshenziswe kanjani kodwa umama uphakamise okuhlukile kobe kushiwo ngumyeni wakhe,'' usho kanje umthombo.Elandisa uthi umfundisi ubuze umkakhe ukuthi kungani emhlambalaza emphikisa phambi kwabazalwane ekubeni engumuntu wesifazane yena eyindoda."Uqede ukubuza loyo mbuzo wabe esemsakaza ngempama izikhawu ezimbili. Kusize ukuthi abemaningi amadoda abekhona kulo mhlangano ase eyasukuma amkhuza embamba,'' usho kanje.Uthi ukube akakhuzwanga ngabe kukhulu akwenzile kumkakhe, umfundisi ngendlela abese eyiyona ebusweni."Sonke simane saxakeka nje ukuthi ngempela kwenzakalani. Ubese egqunqile emnyama namehlo akhe esebomvu tebhu ukudinwa,'' usho kanje.Isolezwe likhulume nomfundisi mayelana nalokhu, ezwakala ekhulumela phansi. Uvumile ukuthi uxoshiwe ebandleni."Ngiyalivuma icala lami impela ngonile. Angazi ukuthi bengingenelwe yini kangaka. Kodwa ngiyacela ndodana ningalubhali lolu daba,'' usho kanje.Uveze ukuthi uzamile ukuxolisa kumkakhe kodwa kwanhlanga zimuka nomoya njengoba engekho nasekhaya emukile waya kubo eMnambithi."Ngikhuluma nawe nje akekho ekhaya, ngizwile ukuthi ukubo. Nami angikho ekhaya ngizihlalele kwenye indawo ngesaba nokubabuka abantwana bami ngoba bangicasukele nabo, abafuni nakukhuluma nami,'' echaza uMcambi.Ethintwa umama uthe sebeshade iminyaka engu-12 nomyeni wakhe futhi ubengakaze ambeke isandla. Wathi lokhu akwenzile kummangazile.Uthe kodwa uzobuyela ekhaya baxoxisane ukuthi nje usafuna ukuhlehla kancane nasezintweni ezithinta ibandla.Inhloko yebandla ezweni lonke, uMbhishobhi Nhlanhla Ntombela inqabile ukuphawula kumayelana nokudicilelwa phansi kwebandla alisebenzela kanzima kangaka. " Mfana wami angifuni nanokuthi kulokhu kuthiwa ngiphawulile. Ngilisebenzele kabi leli bandla eselehliswa isithunzi ngalolu hlobo...angiphawuli lutho,” usho kanje.Ukuqinisekisile kodwa ukuthi uMcambi uxoshiwe.
NGEKE babuyele emsebenzini bengawatholanga amabhonasi abo abasebenzi benkampani ekhiqiza izimoto iFord Motor Company South Africa.NgoLwesine laba basebenzi abakwiNational Union of Metalworkers of South Africa (Numsa) baqale isiteleka sabo esisemthethweni besola umqashi wabo ngokuba yigovu elidla lodwa.Isiteleka siqale ngo-9 ekuseni ngaphandle kwamasango akwaFord, aseSilverton, ePitoli.UMengameli weNumsa obebhikisha namalungu ale nyunyana, uMnuz Andrew Chirwa, uthe izikhulu zakwaFord azifuni ukudla nabasebenzi kodwa zijabulela ukubaxhaphaza.Uveze ukuthi sekuphele iminyaka emibili bexoxisana neFord ukuthi uma yenze inzuzo icazele abasebenzi. Kungahlomuli izikhulu zodwa ngoba yizona ezithola amabhonasi ezizumbulu."Izikhulu zakwaFord azizwa, azifuni ukusilalela uma sizicela ukuthi zicazele abasebenzi inzuzo eyenziwa yinkampani. Le nkampani selokhu yenza inzuzo ngisho ngo-2021 ibiyenza kahle akukho okushintshile namanje izinto zihamba kahle kodwa ayifuni ukunika abasebenzi amabhonasi,” kusho uChirwa.Uthe abasebenzi bazoteleka kuze kube umqashi uhlala phansi nenyunyana yabo ayitshele ukuthi uzoqala nini ukubacazela inzuzo.Uthe inkampani ngabe ayenzi kahle ukube abasebenzi abazikhandli ngakho nabo bayadinga ukubongwa ngokusebenza kanzima njengoba kubongwa izikhulu.UMengameli weNumsa uMnuz Andrew Chirwa uthi iFord ayifuni ukudla nabasebenzi, izikhulu ziyitamuza zodwa inzuzo yenkampani Isithombe:Numsa"IFord ikhiqiza izimoto eziwu-720 ngosuku. Ikwazile ukutshala imali yokuthuthukisa ingqalasizinda kodwa iyahluleka wukubonga abasebenzi ngokuzikhandla kwabo,” kusho uChirwa.IFord ithe isiteleka sizoba nomthelela omubi emnothweni wezwe njengoba itshale imali eningi ukuthuthukisa ingqalasizinda nabasebenzi bayo. Iveze ukuthi lesi siteleka sizokwakha isithombe esibi ngokuqhuba ibhizinisi eNingizimu Afrika."Uma senza izinqumo zokuqhuba ibhizinisi nokutshala imali, sibheka ukuthi lapho sisebenza khona yindawo ekahle yokwenza ibhizinisi nokuthi umsebenzi awuphazamiseki,” kusho iFord esitatimendeni.Ithe iyathemba ukuthi bonke abasebenzi bazobuyela emsebenzini maduze, yacela abangatelekile ukuthi bahlale emakhaya kuze kuphele isiteleka.
INHLANGANO elwela amalungelo abampofu, iDudula Movement, ikhala ngokuvalwa kwabadayisa amashibusi noswidi ezitimeleni zaKwaZulu-Natal.UNobhala weDudula Movement esifundazweni, uMnuz Bhekie Dzanibe, utshele Isolezwe ukuthi iPassenger Rail Agency South Africa (Prasa) yethule izitimela ezintsha yase ivala ukuthi kudayiswe kulezi zitimela.UDzanibe uveze ukuthi phambilini abadayisi bebethwala amashibusi, oswidi, amagwinya neziphuzo ukuze badayisele abagibeli bezitimela KwaZulu-Natal."IPrasa yethule izitimela ezintsha, ezinhle futhi esizijabulelayo. Okubuhlungu wukuthi kulezi zitimela abantu bakithi abazizamela ukuphila ngokudayisa ezitimeleni abasavumelekile ukwenza lo msebenzi. Siyazi ukuthi isimo sibi eNingizimu Afrika, imisebenzi ayikho ngakho abantu baziphilisa ngokudayisa,” kuchaza uDzanibe.Uthe abadayisi bayaboshwa uma betholwe beqhuba umsebenzi wabo wonogada bakwaPrasa ezitimeleni.Uveze ukuthi nabagibeli abasavumelekile ukudla nokuphuza amanzi ezitimeleni, nabo bayajeziswa uma benza lokhu."Sibabhalelile kwaPrasa KwaZulu-Natal sacela ukuthi basichazele isizathu sokuvala abadayisi, abazange basiphendule. Abasho nokuthi yimuphi umthetho abawulandelayo njengoba bephuca abantu bakithi isinkwa,” kusho uDzanibe.Yize ethe abantu bayaboshwa kodwa ebuzwa ukuthi bayiswa ejele noma bayahlawuliswa, uthe akekho umdayisi oseke wavalelwa ejele noma wahlawuliswa kodwa baye bavalelwe ezindlini zangasese amahora ambalwa bese bexwayiswa ukuthi bangaphinde badayise.UMnuz Zama Nomnganga, obhekelele ezokuxhumana kwaPrasa KwaZulu-Natal, uthe umthetho awubavumeli abadayisi ezitimeleni ezintsha. Uthembise ukuthi uzothumela impendulo ayeyibhalele iDudula Movement kodwa kuze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela engayithumelanga incwadi.
INJABULO kubantu bakwaDakadaka, KwaQwabe, eMthandeni iqembu leMK Party liletha usizo kulabo abakhahlanyezwa isishingishane esahlasela ngenyanga edlule sashiya kukhalwa ezindaweni ezahlukene KwaZulu-Natal.Leli qembu linezinyanga ezimbalwa lasungulwa kodwa lingelinye lamaqembu asukumela phezulu uma kunesimo esiphuthumayo emphakathini.Yize lingangenanga kuhulumeni wokubambisana ukuqinisekisa ukuthi yilona eliholayo esifundazweni, liyaqhubeka nokuxhumana nemiphakathi liphose esivivaneni.Angu-130 amakhaya akule ndawo alimala ngesikhathi kuhlasela isishingishane esahamba saze sayophelela eBallito sinqamula oThongathi lapho okwadaleka khona umonakalo omkhulu.Abantu bakule ndawo yaseMthandeni, KwaMaphumulo abasalanga ngaphandle kwabatholelwe usizo yiqembu leMK ngesikhathi lizama imizamo yokuphosa esivivaneni.Leli qembu lahambela imizi ekhahlamezekile libheka ukuthi abantu bangasizakala kanjani ngaphambi kokuba bafake izicelo kubaxhasi abahlukene ngosizo oludingekayo.Nebala u-Ismael Mohamed nozakwabo enkampanini iPak Plastic esoThongathi basabelile basamukela isicelo kumalungu ale nhlangano ngesikhathi ecelela izakhamizi umphakathi.UMuzi Qwabe ongomunye wabaholi beMK kule ndawo, ubonge kakhulu uxhaso abaluthole kule nkampani nathe bayakujabulela ukuthi kukhona umehluko abeza nawo emphakathini wakubo.Ezintweni okunikelelewe ngazo umphakathi kukhona imibhedi kanye namaphasela okudla.

UMBUSO umkhiphe phambili umrepha nongumethuli wezinhlelo zethelevishini, uJub Jub, emacaleni obegebengu abebekwe wona obekubalwa kuwo izinsolo zokudlwengula, ukuzama ukubulala nokushaya kanzima ngoLwesine.Encwadini ethunyelelwe abameli bakaJub Jub, ogama lakhe lokuzalwa wuMolemo Maarohanye, ngoJune 20, oyibamba likasekela mqondisi womshushisi eGoli, uTebogo Maodi, uthe emva kokucubungula imininingwane yecala abanayo, kanjalo nombiko womshushisi, babone kufanele ahoxiswe wonke lavmacala abebekwe wona ngoba akukho okufakazela ukuthi kumele uJub Jub ashushiselwe wona."Ngakho-ke izethulo zenu ziphumelele futhi necala selihoxisiwe,” kusho uMaodi ngezimfishane. UPhindi Mjonondwana wophiko lwezokushushisa iNational Prosecuting Authority, uyiqinisekisile le ncwadi, wathi emva kokucubungula idokodo lecala, umbiko womshushisi nezethulo ezivela ehhovisi lomshushisi omkhulu, babone kunganele ukwenza kufanele ukuthi ummangalelwa ashushiswe.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi kuze kufikwa lapha nje, uJub Jub wavulelwa icala ngowayeyintombi yakhe, u-Amanda Du Point, ongumethuli wezinhlelo zethelevishini nomlingisi, embeka icala lokuthi wamhlukumeza ngokocansi, icala lavulwa esiteshini samaphoyisa iBrixton, eGoli ngo-2022.Ngaphambi kokuvula icala, u-Amanda waqala ngokuqopha i-video wayifaka ekhasini lakhe lika-Instagram, lapho ayesola khona uJub Jub ukuthi wamdlwengula.Lokho kwenzeka emva kokuthi uJub Jub ayemenywe ohlelweni lukaMacG lakwiYouTube, iPodcast and Chill, lapho akhuluma khona izinto ezilumelayo ngo-Amanda.Abewu-14 uma esewonke amacala abekwe uJub Jub, kanti wonke ahoxisiwe okwenza losaziwayo wodumo lwengoma ethi Ngikhokhele abe ngokhululekile manje.Esitatimendeni asithumele abezindaba khona izolo, uJub Jub ubonge ithimba labameli bakhe ngokumsiza atholwe engenacala kuwo wonke amacala abebekwe wona.Uthe ukutholwa engenacala kwenza akhululeke futhi kwehlise umthwalo empilweni yakhe, ngakho uyabonga kubo bonke abame nayo kuzo zonke lezi zimo abebhekene nazo.
EHLILE amaphaphu kwabasebenzela inkampani yensimbi i-ArcelorMittal South Africa, emuva kokuzwa ukuthi ngeke isawavala amagatsha okubalwa eliseNewcastle, KwaZulu-Natal, noluseVereeniging, eGauteng.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi ngonyaka odlule i-ArcelorMittal yayithe izovala uphiko olukhiqiza insimbi esetshenziswa ezimayini, ekwakhiweni kwamabhuloho, emizileni yezitimela nakwenye intuthuko edinga insimbi eqinile.Lolu hlelo beluzoholela ekutheni kudilizwe abasebenzi abangu-3 500INational Union of Metalworkers of South Africa (Numsa), ithe ehlile amaphaphu kubasebenzi abakade bezophelelwa wumsebenzi ukube uhlelo lokudiliza beluqhubeka.Ithe kudingeka uhulumeni athathe indawo yakhe alungise izikhalo zenkampani ukuze izohlala ivuliwe ngoba akufanele kube nemisebenzi ephelayo.Isikhulu esiphezulu sase-ArcelorMittal South Africa, uMnuz Kobus Verster, sithe okwenze ukuthi bangavali wukuthi bazimisele ngokunikeza ithuba izinhlelo zabo zokushintsha isimo ebhizinisi lensimbi."Sizoqhubeka sisebenzisane namakhasimende ethu nezinye izinhlaka ezithintekayo ukuze sazi ukuthi ifemu yethu yensimbi isebenza kahle e-Afrika eseNingizimu,” kusho uVerster.Phambilini wathi akusikona ukuthi bafuna ukuphathwa ngendlela ehlukile kunaleyo okuphethwe ngayo ezinye izinkampani kodwa bafuna uhulumeni alungise izikhalo zemboni yensimbi ngoba bekungena insimbi yaphesheya eshibhile.Wathi izinkinga zikagesi, ukuphazamiseka kwamaguzu nokuma kwezinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kwengqalasizinda zibashayile.UVerster uthe njengamanje kulokoza inhlansi yethemba ukuthi zizojika izinto emnothweni waseNingizimu Afrika, bese kudingeka insimbi eyakhiwe kuleli ezinhlelweni zengqalasizinda.

Ibingekho enye indlela ngaphandle kokuthi kube nesibalo salabo ngqongqoshe namaphini abo ngenxa yokuthi kunohulumeni wobumbano.” UNksz Pemmy Majodina, uNgqongqoshe wezaManzi nokuHanjiswa kweNdle, uthe eyamanzi iyinselelo ezweni kanjalo nasesifundeni i-Afrika.Uthe kubalulekile ukugcina amanzi ngoba ayashoda."Amanzi ayimpilo ngakho sizosebenzisana neminye iminyango. Asifuni ukubona amanzi evuza ngoba ayashoda kakhulu ezweni.” Uthe usethole izikhalazo ezevile ku-3 000 ngezinkinga zamanzi kuleli.UDkt Pieter Groenewald, uNgqongqoshe wezokuHlunyeleliswa kweziMilo, uthe uzolwa nenkohlakalo ezikhungweni okugcinwe kuzona iziboshwa futhi ezigcwele zinyinyitheka.Uthe uzobheka isabelomali sokuthi lezi zinkinga kungabhekwana kanjani nazo."Kubalulekile ukuthi amajele ethu azikhiqizele ukudla okuzodliwa khona. Okubalulekile wukuthi kumele kongiwe imali yabakhokhi bentela.” Mayelana nezinto ake azisho phambilini njengokweseka isigwebo sentambo, uthe uMthethosisekelo awuvumi ukuthi kube nalesi sigwebo."Kakade sizoba nawo umbono kwiKhabhinethi ukuthi into ethile singayilungisa kanjani njengoba singamaqembu ahlukene. Okubalulekile ukubeka abantu bakuleli phambili.” UNgqongqoshe kaGesi, uDkt Kgosientsho Ramokgopa, uthe nakuba ingaphelile inkinga yokucishwa kukagesi kuleli kodwa likhulu ibanga eselihanjiwe ukubhekana nale nkinga."Abantu balindele ukuthi ugesi ungapheli. Yinkinga esilwa nayo. Ugesi usuyabiza, abantu abakwazi ukuwukhokhela. Kudingeka kube nezindlela zokubhekana nale nkinga yokunyuka kwawo.”

UZAME kaningi ukulugwema uhambo lokuyothatha ikhasimende Kwa-E eNtuzuma umshayeli wezimoto ezikhokhelwa ngebanga ezilihambile waseLindelani otholwe eshiswe nemoto ngoLwesibili ekuseni.UMnuz Lungisani Cele (28) ongowokudabuka ePort Shepstone, utholwe eshiswe nemoto yekhe iTotoya Corolla Cross ngoLwesibili emva kokuthi ephume eyothatha ikhasimende ngoMsombuluko ebusuku. I-app abesebenza ngayo yi-Bolt.Umzala wakhe, uMnuz Mhlengi Xaba, naye ohlala emqashweni oseduze nokamufi eLindelani, uthe usinqabe kaningi isicelo ebesiya ngala agcine ebulawelwa khona."Uqale wasinqaba kaningi, ethi akafuni ukuya kuso. Lo obesifaka isicelo, ubelokhu eqhubeke njalo nokusifaka. Uthe esuka wabe esamukela,” kusho uXaba.Uqhube wathi ngesikhathi esamukela, uthe kubona usivuma ngoba siseduze. Elilinganisa ibanga uXaba, liphakathi kwamakhilomitha amabili kuya kwamathathu ukusuka emqashweni wabo.Uthe baqale ukuqaphela ukuthi kukhona okushaya amanzi ekuseni ngoLwesibili ngesikhathi sekufona izisebenzi avame ukuziyisa emsebenzini ngo-6, zithi akazilandile."Sithe uma sibheka, sabona imoto yakhe ingekho, saqala sadideka. Sithathe inye iselula yakhe, nayo enemininingwane yakhe yokungena kwi-app ka-Bolt, sangena kwi-app sabona ukuthi ugcine ngalo lolu hambo kwaseNtuzuma obeluthathe ngabo-08:30 ebusuku ngoMsombuluko,” kusho uXaba.Uqhube wathi balandele izinkomba zohambo, ezibathathe zababeka endaweni yesigameko."Sizithele phezu kwamaphoyisa nongoti abahlola izindawo zezigameko, behlola indawo yesigameko. Bekukhona imoto yakhe, ishile, sathola ukuthi naye ushele phakathi,” kulandisa uXaba.Uqhube wathi umufi ubelaliswe ezihlalweni zangemumva nokubenza basole ukuthi uqale wabulawa ngaphambi kokuthi ashiswe nemoto.Uthe banezinsolo eziqinile zokuthi umuntu obefake isicelo sokuthi a zomthatha uyathinteka ekwenzakalisweni kukamufi.Uthe omakhelwane ababize amaphoyisa endaweni yesigameko emva kokubona ukuthi kanti umlilo ebebezitshela ukuthi usha kude bekusha imoto.Uthe umufi ubengesiye umuntu ojwayele ukwamukela izicelo zasemalokishini ebusuku, uma kwenzekile wasebenza ebusuku, ubesuke amukele izicelo zasesilungwini. Uveze nokuthi ubesenezinyanga ezintathu kuphela ezisebenza kulo msebenzi."Siyabufuna ubulungiswa ngokubulawa kwakhe. Inombolo ebifake isicelo sohambo, siyifonele kodwa sathola ukuthi ivaliwe,” kusho uXaba othe badidekile ukuthi ubulawelweni nemoto yakhe yashiselwani ngoba ubengesiye umuntu ogolozayo uma elwiswa.Uthe lokhu ukusho ekhumbula isigameko sanyakenye lapho wake waphucwa imoto, yabuye yatholwa KwaMashu."Wayengakawuqali lomsebenzi. Kwakuyizigebengu nje ezamphuca imoto, akudingekanga ukuthi zise zenze okuningi ukuze azinike,” kusho uXaba.Umufi ubenengane eneminyaka emithathu.
BASOLA ukuthi ubemyenga unina wezingane zakhe uma ethi akazogubha usuku lwakhe lokuzalwa emqashweni wakhe oseLusaka, eMawoti, eNanda, ngoMgqibelo, owesilisa ongumpheki okuthiwa ugcine embulala ngeSonto.UNksz Mbali Makokone (29) wakhona endaweni kuthiwa utholwe efile ngaphakathi emqashweni kamsolwa anezingane ezimibili naye, eneminyaka emibili neyisithupha.Kuthiwa ngesikhathi kufika amaphoyisa, umsolwa uficwe ezidlela inyama eduze kwesidumbu esazidlubhe ziphelele izingubo ezinegazi abezigqoke ngesikhathi ebulala umufi.Uthe ngesikhathi eseboshwa, utshele amaphoyisa ukuthi awamnike isikhathi agqoke izingubo ezifudumalayo ngoba kuyabanda esitokisini.Kuthiwa endaweni yesigameko bekukhona isitini esigcwele igazi, umufi enenxeba lokugwazwa emqaleni, nezibazi zokuklinywa.Isihlobo sikamufi esicele ukungadalulwa silandisa ngesigameko sithe, baqale baxakwa ukufika kwezingane zikamufi kubo ekuseni, zihamba zibambene ngezandla."Sithe uma sizibuza ukuthi kwenzenjani zafika zodwa, endala yathi uyise uzinike u-R10 wathi azihambe ziyothenga esitolo bese ziza ekhaya. Ibe isisho nokuthi uyise ubemshaya unina,” kusho isihlobo.Siqhube sathi abazange banake ukuthi konakele njengoba bese kujwayelekile ukuthi umsolwa amshaye umufi.Uthe bathuke sekungena ucingo lwesihlobo sithi asihambe siyobheka ukuthi konke kuhamba kahle yini kumufi emqashweni kamsolwa ngoba uqeda kuthola ucingo lwakhe, ethi awuze umndeni wakhe uzomthatha."Umama uhambe waya khona, wafica umshophi. Nathi size kamumva safica kugcwele abantu egcekeni, abanye bezobuka, abanye bebevele bekhona njengoba uMbali ebegubha usuku lwakhe lokuzalwa,” kusho isihlobo.Uthe abakutholile ukuthi kugujwe umsolwa engekho, eye emsebenzini.Uqhube wathi ubuye ezintatha, wafika abantu begcwele igceke kuphuzwa, wakhombisa ukunengeka yize engashongo lutho."Sizwa kuthiwa ekuseni umsolwa nomufi baphelezele omunye umngani kamufi esegoduka. Kuthiwa akuphelanga sikhathi esingakanani sebebuyile, waqala wamshaya endlini,” kusho isihlobo.Uthe okubaphathe kabi ukuthi umufi ubulawe kukhona abantu egcekeni kanjalo nomakhelwane abaseduze, okukhona kubo ngisho nabesilisa kodwa bonke abakwazanga ukusiza.Uthe umufi ubulawa nje ubenezinsuku ezintathu ebuye ekhaya emva kokuxoshwa umsolwa abehlala nye emqashweni."Kuthe uma sekusondela usuku lwakhe lokuzalwa, wamncenga ukuthi eze emqashweni wakhe. Sesibona sengathi ubevele ehlele ukumbulala ngoba umbiza nje ubazi ukuthi baxabene, wajika wahamba wayosebenza, wambulala emva kwamahora ambalwa ebuye emsebenzini,” kusho isihlobo.Uthe bafuna ubulungiswa ngobulwane abenzile.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Nata,l uConstable Thenjiswa Ngcobo, uthe amaphoyisa abophe owesilisa oneminyaka engu-38 emva kokuthi owesifazane oneminyaka engu-29 etholwe efile ngeSonto eLusaka."Umufi ubenezibazi eziningi zokulimala emzimbeni. Umsolwa bekulindeleke ukuthi avele eNkantolo yaseNtuzuma ngoLwesibili. Imbangela yokubulala ayikaziwa,” kusho uConst Ngcobo.
BAHLUKENE phakathi abaholi beNFP ngezinsongo zokuhoxa kuhulumeni wokubambisana ophethe KwaZulu-Natal.Unobhala jikelele wale nhlangano ewumbeki wenkosi esifundazweni, uMnuz Teddy Thwala, uthe angeke baphume kuhulumeni wokubambisana ne-IFP, ANC neDA.Lokhu kuphikisana nezinsongo ezenziwe umengameli weqembu, uMnuz Ivan Barnes, ngeledlule lapho esabise khona ngokuhosha imfe uma benganikezwa isikhundla sobumeya kumasipala wesifunda iZululand.UBarnes wayesigaqele lesi sikhundla kodwa sagcina sithathwe ikhansela le-IFP, uMnuz Michael "Mkhonyovu’’ Khumalo.Emva komhlangano owakhetha uKhumalo, uBarnes wasabisa ngokuhoxa kuhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal.Kepha uThwala uthe angeke baphume kuhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal njengoba ekhala ngokuthi isivumelwano sokubambisana kuhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal asibafaki omasipala.Njengengxenye yesivumelwano sokusebenzisana, iNFP yanikwa uMnyango wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi, ophethwe uNksz Mbali Shinga."Abantu kufanele bakuqonde ukuthi kunomehluko phakathi kukahulumeni kazwelonke, owesifundazwe nohulumeni wasekhaya. Izimo azifani kuhulumeni wesifundazwe nakomasipala. Ngesikhathi sivuma ukusebenzisana kuhulumeni wesifundazwe, asizange siyikhulume indaba yakomasipala. Angicabangi ukuthi ngesikhathi amaqembu evumelana ngokusebenzisana esifundazweni ayevuma ukuphisana ngomasipala.”UThwala uthe uNksz Shinga uzosiphatha lesi sikhundla kuze kufike ukhetho olulandelayo."Sizoqhubeka nokumeseka, akekho ozomkhipha. Uzophatha kuze kuphele iminyaka emihlanu. Abantu kufanele bakuqonde ukuthi into ebalulekile lapha ukufeza izifiso zabantu baKwaZulu-Natal. Abantu akufanele bafune ukusebenzisa uShinga ukulwa izimpi zabo zokufuna izikhundla.”UThwala uthe iNFP angeke izuze lutho ngokuhoxa kuhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal.I-NFP inesihlalo esisodwa esiShayamthetho, ukuhoxa kwayo kungashiya i-IFP, ANC neDA benezihlalo ezingu-40 uma behlanganisiwe.I-MK inezihlalo ezingu-37, bese kuthi i-EFF ibe nezimbili."Lokho ke kungadala ungqingetshe ngoba izihlalo ziyokube sezilingana. Lokho kungakhinyabeza ukusebenza kukahulumeni wesifundazwe nokungaholela ekutheni mhlawumbe kugcine kuqalwa phansi ukhetho. Leyo nto ngeke ibasize ngalutho abantu baKwaZulu-Natal kodwa izobambezela ukulethwa kwezidingo.”UThwala uthe udaba lokuphathwa komasipala waseZululand lunzima ngoba kunezimpi zangaphakathi kwiNFP.Kunamakhansela eqembu amabili eNFP, uNksz Khanyi Jiyane, noMnuz Sibusiso Nkosi, aphonsela inselelo ukuxoshwa kwawo.UThwala uthe njengoba kusenamacala asezinkantolo kunzima ukuthi bangaxoxa eyokuthi kufanele banikezwe umasipala."Njengamanje kusaxabene ubendle, kufanele silinde la macala asezinkantolo kuqala.”
UMCULI kamaskandi, uKhuzani "Indlamlenze" Mpungose, usolwa ngokuphuca isinkwa abantu akade besebenza esibhedlela saseThekwini, iKing Dinuzulu.Laba basebenzi bathi sebesebenze iminyaka eyisikhombisa kuya kweyishumi kulesi sibhedlela ngaphansi kwenkampani iTower City Cleaning Services. SELIPHENYWA ngamaphoyisa udaba lokuphahlaka kwebhanoyi likaR5 eliwe nezizumbulu zabantu abakhele iVerulam, enyakatho yeTheku.UConstable Thenjiswa wamaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uthe amaphoyisa aseVerulam aphenya icala lokukhwabanisa emuva kokuthi abantu akade betshale imali enkampanini ebizwa ngokuthi yiLeftover Currency bebikele amaphoyisa ukuthi abasayitholi lapho ibisebenzela khona futhi nabanikazi bayo sebenyamelele.Izindaba zokuphahlaka kweLeftover Currency zisabalale ngoMsombuluko ntambama emuva kokuthi abantu akade befake imali yabo khona bevimbezele emahhovisi ale nkampani kwaze kwafika amaphoyisa.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi abantu bebefaka uR5 onobuso bukamengameli wokuqala wentando yabantu, uNelson Mandela, bese befaka noR1 300 ngaphezulu obekuthiwa owokulekelela ukusebenza kwehhovisi. Bebethenjiswa inzalo kaR33 800 emuva kwezinsuku eziwu-32.Inzalo ibiya ngokuthi ufake hlobo luni lukaR5 njengoba bekufuneka owokugubha iminyaka ewu-90 kuphila uMandela nabanye baleyo minyaka.NgoLwesithathu abantu bebesaqhubeka nokuthutheleka kuleli hhovisi elisenkabeni yeVerulam njengoba benethemba lokuthi lisazovulwa.Abanye bathi sengathi basephusheni elibi abasovuswa kulona njengoba bebelindele izizumbulu zikaR700 000, R1million nezinye izimali.Okwamanje akekho oseboshiwe ngalesi sigameko njengoba amaphoyisa esaphenya ngaleli bhanoyi ebeliphethwe ngowesilisa ozibiza ngoBrian Mkhize nozakwabo obebizwa ngoDlamini.UNksz Ntombikhona Dlamini waKwaSimamane, eNdwedwe, uthe baqale ukuzwa ngeLeftover Currency ngo-Agasti wonyaka odlule ngesikhathi benikwa amaphepha achaza ngale nkampani uma beyothenga eVerulam.Uthe baye batshala imali kule nkampani ngoba bebona sengathi isemthethweni njengoba bekulenga isitifiketi esitholakala ezinkampanini zangempela esinombhalo weSouth African Revenue Service (Sars).
Uthembise ukujulukisa aphinde azincishe umoya izigebengu uNgqongqoshe omusha wamaPhoyisa, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu.UMchunu ulimise ngesihloko elokuthi ngeke baziwotawote izigebengu ezicabanga ukuthi ikwampunzi edla emini njengoba bezobhekana nazo besebenzisa indlakadla.Kulindeleke ukuthi namhlanje ahlangane nezikhulu zamaphoyisa ukuze aqale umsebenzi ngokushesha njengoba ebeke eqhulwini izinto ezine azogxila kuzona zisuka amadaka. Ufuna ukulwa nesihlava sokwanda kwamacala okubulala, awokudlwengula, ukwebiwa kwezimoto nokugqekezwa kwemizi.Lezi zinto zimenza angabuthi quthu ubuthongo."Ngiyazi abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ababulali ubuthongo ngenxa yokwanda kwamacala okubulala, awokudlwengula, ukwebiwa kwezimoto kanjalo nokugqekezwa kwemizi. Noma ngingakawutholi umbiko ngebanga elihanjiwe emaphoyiseni okulwa nalawa macala kodwa ngiyazi ukuthi yizona zinto ezenza abantu bangakhululeki.” UMchunu uveze ukuthi akekho ongakhululeka uma la macala eqhubeka nokwanda."Abantu kumele bazizwe bephephile ezweni labo. Uma lezi zinto singazilungisi, sizobe sibenzele phansi abantu.” Uphefumule kanje izolo ngesikhathi ekhuluma neziteshi zethelevishini zabezindaba ngesikhathi kufungiswa ongqongqoshe namaphini abo eKapa.UMchunu uveze ukuthi uzoqhubeka lapho kushiye khona obephethe izintambo eMnyangweni wamaPhoyisa uMnuz Bheki Cele."Sengiwulungele lo msebenzi. Ngeke siwotawote ubugebengu, sizolwa ngqo nabo,” kusho uMchunu.Uveze ukuthi uzokwazi ukuphefumula kabanzi nangezinye izinhlelo uma esezinzile kulo mnyango.Indaba yobugebengu ngezinye zezinto ezenza abantu bakuleli bahlale benexhala.KwaZulu-Natal kuba nezehlakalo zokubulawa kwenqwaba yabantu ngesikhathi esisodwa.UCele ubewatshela amaphoyisa ukuthi angananazi futhi angafi ephethe izibhamu uma ebhekene nezigebengu evikela abantu bakuleli.UMchunu uthe bazolakha uhlelo abazosebenza ngalo lokulwa nobugebengu.Uveze nokuthi engakawuqali ngisho lo msebenzi wakhe ubese ethole umbiko ngesinye isehlakalo esithinta ukudlwengula esenzekile."Kudinga isandla esiqinile ukulwa nobugebengu. Amaphoyisa azolwa ukuze abantu bakhululeke ezweni labo,” kusho uMchunu.
UNOBHALA jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, uthi uhulumeni wokubambisana ophethe kuzwelonke uzoqhubeka nokusebenza noma kungakhona amaqembu aphumayo.UMbalula uthe bakulindele ukuthi kube khona amaqembu aphumayo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi kodwa wathi lokho ngeke kuguqise uhulumeni wokubambisana.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma kwisithangami nabezindaba, ngoLwesithathu. Uhulumeni wokubambisana wakhiwe ngamaqembu awu-10 athola u-70% wamavoti okhethweni.Phakathi kwamaqembu ayingxenye yokubambisana kukhona iDA, IFP, PA namanye.Kuvele sekukhona ukungaboni ngasolinye emaqenjini abambisene ngoba i-ANC neDA bethibelene ngodaba lokuphathwa kwesifundazwe, iGauteng.EGauteng alikho iqembu elathola amavoti anele ukuthi libuse ngokuzimela.UNDUNANKULU waseGauteng, uMnuz Panyaza Lesufi, obekulindeleke ukuthi amemezele ikhabhinethi lakhe, izolo Isithombe: FACEBOOKI-ANC, DA namanye amaqembu ayingxenye yohulumeni wokubambisana anezihlalo ezanele ukuthi aphathe iGauteng, kodwa amaqembu ayehluleka ukuvumelana ngokwabiwa kwezikhundla.Umdonsiswano usuholele ekutheni kube nokwesaba ukuthi ukwehluleka kwamaqembu ukuvumelana eGauteng, kungaphazamisa ukusebenza kwawo kuhulumeni kazwelonke.Kepha uMbalula uthe uhulumeni wokubambisana uzoqhubeka nokuphatha noma kungakhona abashiyayo.Ubeke kanje uMbalula: "Uhulumeni wokubambisana uzohlezi ukhona. Vele kuzokuba khona amaqembu azobuye aphume ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uma ebona mhlawumbe ukuthi uhulumeni wokubambisana awuwasebenzeli. Ngesikhathi kukhona amaqembu aphumayo kukhona lawo azophinde angene. Ngakho-ke abantu kufanele babeke phansi amaphaphu.”UMbalula uveze ukuthi basazimisele ngokusebenzisana neDA eGauteng kodwa wathi abavumelani nalokhu okufunwa yiDA. UMbalula uqhube wathi iDA ishintshe isivumelwano abebe naso.Uthe iDA yayikade ifune izikhundla ezintathu kuhulumeni waseGauteng, kodwa yabuye yashintsha yathi ifuna ezine."Ngeke sikwazi ukuhlangabezana nalezi zimfuno zabo. Into okufanele bayazi ukuthi asikhulumi nabo kuphela lapha eGauteng, kukhona amanye amaqembu esixoxa nawo.”Ukumenyezelwa kwekhabhinethi laseGauteng, sekuze kwahlehliswa kwabili ngenxa yokungavumelani kwalamaqembu.NgoLwesithathu uNdunankulu, uMnuz Panyaza Lesufi, umemezele ikhabhinethi lakhe. ULesufi ubethe uzolimemezela ikhabhinethi lakhe noma ngabe iDA ayivumi ukusebenzisana nabo."Ngeke ngize ngikuhlehlise kulokhu ukumenyezelwa kwekhabhinethi,” kusho uLesufi obekhuluma esithangamini nabezindaba.Ebuzwa ukuthi bazosebenzisana namaphi amaqembu, uLesufi uthe bazosebenzisana nawo wonke amaqembu anezihlalo esiShayamthetho sesifundazwe. Amaqembu anezihlalo eGauteng kukhona iMK, ne-EFF abengeyona ingxenye yohulumeni wokubambisana.ULesufi ukuphikile ukuthi benza okuphambene nokuvunyelwene ngakho kuzwelonke.IDA ithe isazimisele ngokusebenzisana ne-ANC uma ingavumelana nemibandela yayo.Usihlalo woMkhandlu weDA, uNkk Hellen Zille, uthe uma i-ANC ibashiya ngaphandle eGauteng, bazokwamukela ukuba yiqembu eliphikisayo.UNkk Zille uthe uma beshiywa ngaphandle eGauteng, ngeke bahoxe kuzwelonke naKwaZulu-Natal, lapho bebambisene khona ne-ANC namanye amaqembu.

IDURBAN Chamber of Commerce and Industry ithi iyasamukela isinqumo sokufakwa ngaphansi kwesigaba 139 lapho kulethwe ongoti ukuze balekelele lo masipala ukuthumela izidingo.UMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana nezoMdabu uthumele uDkt Mike Sutcliffe noDkt Casius Lubisi ukuba bazotakula iTheku ngaphansi kwesigaba 139 ngoJuni.Esitatimendeni iDurban Chamber ithe uMasipala weTheku uyaludinga usizo ngoba kuningi osudlule kukho okubalwa iCovid-19, izibhelu zikaJulayi 2021, izikhukhula zango-2022 nezinye izigameko ezenza kungathunyelwa kahle izidingo kubantu abakhele lo masipala.Iveze ukuthi amanye amabhizinisi aphoqeleke ukuvala ngenxa yokungabibikho kwamanzi, ugesi, izinkinga zokuphepha, ukungathuthwa kukadoti nezinye izingqinamba.Phezu kwalezi zingqinamba iDurban Chamber, ithe osomabhizinisi bebekhokhiswa intela wumasipala unganakile ukuthi izinto azihambi kahle.Ibuye yakhala nangokungcola kwamanzi asolwandle obekuhlalahlale abe negciwane le-e-coli ngenxa yokungenwa ngamanzi anendle, lokhu bekuxosha amakhasimende nezivakashi emabhizinisi agudle ulwandle."Njengenhlangano emele osomabhizinisi siyasamukela isinqumo sokulethwa kongoti abazosiza iTheku ukuze likwazi ukuthumela izidingo kubantu. Kule mali kukhona neyabasebenzi abazobe besemahhovisi ongqongqoshe namaphini abo.”Okhulumela i-EFF uNksz Leigh-Ann Mathys, ugxeke iKhabhinethi wathi bekwabelwana ngezikhundla emaqenjini ahlukene ayingxenye kahulumeni wobumbano.Uthe: "Lezi zikhundla zinikwe abelungu abazoqhuba imigomo esekwa ongxiwa, kusetshenziswa abantu abamnyama okuyibo abaningi. Siyayichitha eyeKhabhinethi egcwele ababandlululi.” Usihlalo we-DA Federal Council uNkk Helen Zille, uthe ubengenalo ulwazi ukuthi sizonyuswa isibalo seKhabhinethi. Uthe uzwe ngayo ngesikhathi uRamaphosa eseyimemezela."Besingazi ukuthi iKhabhinethi izonyuswa kangaka ukuze i-ANC izuze kakhulu kunalokho obekumele ikuthole. Besazi ngezikhundla ebezizotholwa yi-DA kuphela. Besazi futhi ngokuhlukaniswa kweminye iminyango. Ukunyuswa kwesibalo seKhabhinethi akuhlangene ne-DA.” Uthe bebefuna iKhabhinethi encane wathi ukube bekulandelwe imigomo yokuthi kwabiwe ngokuthi amaqembu athola izihlalo ezingaki, ngabe ayibanga nkulu iKhabhinethi.UMnuz Wayne Duvenage isikhulu esiphezulu senhlangano i-OUTA, uzwakalise ukukhathazeka ngokwanda kweKhabhinethi.Uthe emnyangweni wezokuMbiwa Phansi bekumele lo mnyango ophethwe nguMnuz Gwede Mantashe, ufakwe ngaphansi komnyango kaGesi."Le bekuyindlela yokuhlomulisa amalungu e-ANC. Bekungamele kugcinwe umuntu ofana noDkt Blade Nzimande, osesemnyangweni wezeSayensi ngoba lo mnyango bekungamele futhi uhlukaniswe nomnyango weMfundo ePhakeme nokuQeqesha.”Ukhale ngokuthi uNzimande bekumele asuswe ngoba ushiye emoshe isikhwama iNSFAS.ICosatu ikhale esifanayo ngesibalo esikhulu seKhabhinethi.UMnuz Matthew Parks weCosatu, uthe badumele ngokwandiswa kwesibalo samaphini ongqongqoshe."Siyayamukela iKhabhinethi kodwa siyakhala ngesibalo samaphini ongqongqoshe. Sizosebenzisana neKhabhinethi ukuphucula impilo yabantu.” ISACP ikhale ngokwanda kweKhabhinethi yathi lokhu kusho khona ukuthi i-ANC ilahlekelwa amandla.Umhlaziyi wezepolitiki uDkt Levy Ndou, uthe uRamaphosa ubengaphansi kwengcindezi yokuthi anyuse isibalo seKhabhinethi ukuze kumeleleke uwonke wonke emaqenjini akuhulumeni."Iyakhathaza eyokwanda kwesibalo seKhabhinethi. Kodwa ibingekho into abengayenza ngoba izikhundla zibalulekile kwipolitiki. Isizathu esenza amaqembu angenele ukhetho ingenxa yezikhundla.”Amanye amaqembu akuhulumeni ne-ANC ayamukele iKhabhinethi.Akuqali ukuthi kube neminyango enamaphini amabili ongqongqoshe. Ngisho eminyangweni kahulumeni wezifundazwe esuke ihlanganise iminyango emibili, kujwayelekile ukuthi kube nezinhloko zomnyango ezimbili.UNdou uthe amaphini ongqongqoshe enza imisebenzi ehlukene eminyangweni esuke ihlanganisiwe.Iminyango okubalwa owezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu, owezokuVikela ofaka namaMilitary Veterans, owezokuQasha nowezabaSebenzi, owezamaHlathi, ukuDoba nezeMvelo anamaphini amabili ongqongqoshe."Yinto ejwayelekile akukho okusha ekutheni kube namaphini amabili emnyangweni owodwa,” kusho uNdou.
UVULE icala lokwehliswa isithunzi unobhala jikelele weNFP, uMnuz Teddy Thwala, obizwe ngembongolo washwabulelwa ngokufa.UThwala ubizwe ngembongolo yilungu leNFP okuthiwa lisebenza komunye womasipala abangaphansi kwesifunda, iZuland.Enkulumweni eqoshiwe, kuzwakala ilungu leNFP lithi ngabe kungcono ukuba uThwala wafa.Ingxabano iqale ngemva kokuthi iNFP iphunyukwe yisikhundla sobumeya kumasipala wesifunda, iZululand.I-NFP ibifuna ukuthi uMengameli wayo uMnuz Ivan Barnes, agaxwe amaketango obumeya kulo mkhandlu.Kuphenduke amatafula ngesonto eledlule, kwaqokwa uMnuz Michael 'Mkhonyovu’ Khumalo, oyikhansela le-IFP, ukuba athathe isikhundla esivuleke emva kokwesula kukaMfundisi Thulasizwe Buthelezi, osephathiswe uMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu.Ingwijikhwebu yokungaqokwa kukaBarnes yenze ukuthi amalungu eNFP ajikelane wodwa, amanye, okubalwa kuwo uThwala, asolwa ngokusebenzisana ne-IFP.Enkulumweni eqoshiwe, kuzwakala umholi weNFP ekhwela edilika kuThwala, emsola ngokusebenzisana ne-IFP."Sawubona Teddy, wena lamanyala owenzayo okuxova iqembu lethu, wena uyiNkatha kodwa uxova iqembu lethu. Siyawazi amanyala owenzayo. Ngeke uze ulunge mfana wami. Sobona ukuthi ubani ozogcina phakathi kwami nawe. Uyimbongolo kabi wena. Awuzwa nasemadlebeni, uyimbongolo nje. Akekho usopolitiki ongezwa nasemadlebeni njengawe.”Inkulumo iphetha ngokuthi lomholi weNFP aveze ukuthi uThwala bamthakatha kancane kwi-UDM, aze athi ufisa engabe usafa."Bakuloya kancane, uyimbongolo wena. Ukube kwa-UDM bakuloya wafa, ngabe kungcono.”UThwala uthe izinkulumo eziqoshiwe uzithunyelelwe ngoWhatsapp, wathi umsolwa uyamazi. Uthe okuqukethwe yizinkulumo kumenze wasabela impilo yakhe."Angikwazi ukungathuki uma ngithola izinsongo ezinje ikakhulukazi uma uzobheka ukuthi isimo sishube kanjani lapha esifundazweni. Kunesisho esithi isishiphi sikhonga ukunya.”UThwala uthe ufuna ukuthi umsolwa alethe ubufakazi bezinto amsola ngazo. Uthe usazothathela amanye amalungu eNFP izinyathelo."Kunemibhalo nezinkulumo eziqoshiwe ezisabalele ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, lapho ngithukwa ngamalungu eqembu. Konke lokho ngizokunikeza amaphoyisa.”Okhulumela amaphoyisa, uConstable Thenjiswa Ngcobo, uthe amaphoyisa aphenya icala lokwehlisa isithunzi.
IJUTSHELWE ukuyomela iqembu, Umkhonto weSizwe, ePhalamende lase-Afrika, iPan African Parliament, indodakazi yomholi waleli qembu, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, uNkk Duduzile Zuma-Sambudla. Leli Phalamende liyingxenye ye-African Union kanti lakhelwa ukuthi abantu basezwenikazi, i-Afrika, babe nezwi ezintweni ezithinta ezomnotho e-Afrika. USotswebhu we-ANC ePhalamende, uMnuz Mdumiseni Ntuli, usukume izolo ngesikhathi lihleli waphakamisa amagama amalungu azojutshelwa ezinhlakeni ezehlukene.Kulo mhlangano bekumele kukhethwe namalungu amaqembu azojutshwa kwiKhomishini yeziMantshi ne-Judicial Services Commission (JSC). UNtuli uphakamise amagama amalungu aya kwi-Pan African Parliament okungoMnuz Vuyani Pambo we-EFF, nguyena uNtuli ozomela i-ANC, uMergan Chetty we-DA kanjalo noNkk Sambudla-Zuma weMK.USomlomo, uNkk Thoko Didiza, ubuze ukuthi kukhona yini abaphikisa lawa magama, kwangavela muntu.Uthe lokhu kusho ukuthi ayaphasiswa. UNtuli uphinde waphakamisa amagama amalungu azoba yingxenye yeKhomishini yeziMantshi kuleli, okungoNksz Faith Muthambi we-ANC, uMnuz Adrian Roos we-DA, uMnuz Sbonelo Nomvalo weMK kanjalo noNksz Omphile Maotwe we-EFF.Aphasiswe ngo-elethu amagama alawa malungu.UNtuli uphakame wahoxisa isiphakamiso abesenzile sokuthi abaholi okubalwa kubo oMnuz Soviet Lekganyane we-ANC, uDkt John Hlophe umholi weMK ePhalamende, u-Advocate Glynnis Breytenbach we-DA, uMnuz Julius Malema we-EFF noMnuz Athol Trollip we-ActionSA, babe sekomitini iJSC.Umsebenzi weJSC wukuphonsa imibuzo amajaji asuke ezojutshelwa ezinkantolo eziphezulu okubalwa neyoMthethosisekelo.UNtuli uthe uhoxise lesi siphakamiso ngoba kusazoxoxwa kabanzi namaqembu ahlukene ePhalamende.UNkk Didiza ukwamukele okuphakanyiswe nguNtuli nakuba amalungu eMK abengeneme ngokuthi awathintwanga ngaphandle kokuhlehliswa kokujutshelwa kwalawa malungu kuleli komiti.Kwenzeka lokhu nje namhlanje kulindeleke ukuthi kufungiswe iKhabhinethi entsha emenyezelwe nguMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ngeSonto ebusuku.Izofungiswa eCape Town International Convention Centre, eKapa yinhloko yamajaji uRaymond Zondo.
BAKHALA bayazithulisa abantu akade betshale imali ebhanoyini elibizwa nge-LeftoverCurrency ebelizinze eVerulam, KwaZulu-Natal.Leli bhanoyi liphahlazeke ngoMsombuluko lapho abantu abaningi bebelindele ukuthi bazokhokhelwa o-R700 000, R1 million nezinye izishaqane.NgoMsombuluko kusabalale ama-video nezithombe zenqwaba yabantu benkanise ngaphandle kwebhilidi obekukhona kulo amahhovisi ale nkampani okuthiwa bafike kuwo sekulenga ingidi. Iningi labebenkanisile belithi lizohola ngoba phela usuku lokuqala enyangeni lungolunye lwezinsuku okuholwa ngazo kodwa bagoduke belambatha njengoba bese kukhala ibhungezi, kungasekho muntu. Isolezwe lithole ukuthi iLeftoverCurrency ibiphethwe ngowesilisa obezibiza ngelikaBrian Mkhize nozakwabo obebizwa ngoDlamini.UNksz Ntombikhona Dlamini waKwaSimamane, eNdwedwe, uthe baqale ukuzwa ngeLeftoverCurrency ngo-Agasti wonyaka odlule ngesikhathi benikwa amaphepha achaza ngale nkampani uma beyothenga eVerulam."Sibe sesihambela izinkundla zokucobelelana ngolwazi sabona nesitifiketi esibhalwe ukuthi bayayikhokha intela eLeftoverCurrency sase sijoyina. Abantu bakhona bebebukeka bethembekile, behlanzekile futhi bekhuluma kahle. Ubufaka uR5 ohambisana no-R1300 bese uthola uR3200. Bekufanele ube nekhanda likaMandela uR5. Owokugubha iminyaka ewu-90, uR5 ubuthi uma uwufakile uthole uR33 800 emuva kwezinsuku eziwu-32,” kuchaza uNksz Dlamini.Uthe okokugcina ubetshale oR5 abawu-20 kanti ubezothola uR700 000 kwazise baningi nabantu akade ebatshela ngale nkampani."Sithe uma sesiyolanda imali yethu ngoMsombuluko safica amahhovisi evaliwe, uMkhize noDlamini bengasabonwa nangokhalo. Silindile ngoba phela imali besivamise ukuyithola kodwa kulokhu asizange siyithole. Amaphoyisa afikile athi kufanele ababili kithina bayovula icala bese silifaka kwigroup kawhatsapp ukuze kuthi uma kunokwenzekayo ecaleni sikwazi ukusizakala,” kusho uNksz Dlamini.Uthe ukhathazekile ngokungayitholi imali kule nkampani ngoba ubebona eyithola le abeyitshale kancane.Uveze ukuthi uMkhize wathi udabuka eNewcastle futhi le nkampani ibisebenza online naseMpumalanga ngaphambi kokuza KwaZulu-Natal.Omunye obedlala leli bhanoyi, ongathandanga ukudalulwa, uthe okwabenza bangena kalula wukuthi ngo-Ephreli kulo nyaka kunabantu abaklonyeliswe ngamathelevishini, amabhodwe esintu, amafriji nokunye ababeqale kulo ngonyaka odlule.Isolezwe liyibhekile iLeftoverCurrency langayithola ohlwini lwezinkampani ezigunyazwe ukusebenza ngemali yiFinancial Sector Conduct Authority (Fsca).IFSCA ithe ngaphambi kokutshala imali abayisebenze kanzima abantu, kufanele babheke ukuthi leyo nkampani igunyaziwe yini ukwenza lo msebenzi.Lokhu bangakwenza ngokungena kwiwebsite yeFSCA ethi www.fsca.co.za noma bashayele u-0800 110 443.IBhange loMmbuso, iSouth African Reserve Bank, lihlale likugcizelela ukuthi imali ayishintshi intengo yayo, uR5 uhlale uwuR5 noma ngabe unekhanda likaMandela noma elezilwane zasendle.UConstable Thenjiswa Ngcobo wamaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal ugcine engayiphendulanga imibuzo athunyelwe yona ngalolu daba. Basale bemi kanje abantu akade belindele izizumbulu kwibhanoyi likaR5 elindize ngoMsombuluko eVerulam Isithombe:sithunyelwe
INYUNYANA yamaphoyisa, iSouth African Policing Union (Sapu), idonse ngendlebe uNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa omusha, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, ukuthi angalinge aphume emzileni wakhe wokuba ngungqongqoshe.ISapu ikusho lokhu izolo ngesikhathi yamukela uMchunu kulesi sikhundla emva kokuqokwa kuso nguMengameli wezwe, uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa, ngeSonto.Oyibamba lokhulumela iSapu kuzwelonke, uMnuz Jabu Mabena, uthe kuzofanele uMchunu angagxambukeli emsebenzini wamaphoyisa njengoba ukusebenza kwawo kungesiwo umsebenzi wakhe."Ukusebenza kwamaphoyisa kubhekene nokhomishana wawo kuzwelonke. Asimfuni uNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa ozoziphathisa okukakhomishana wawo,” kusho uMabena.Nokho uveze ukuthi bayabethemba ubuholi bukaMchunu njengoba beke basebenzisana kahle naye ngesikhathi esengungqongqoshe woMnyango weziSebenzi zikaHulumeni nokuPhatha.UMchunu waphatha lo mnyango phakathi kuka-2019 no-2021."Indlela ayewuphethe ngayo lo mnyango, ebonisana nezinhlaka ezifanele, yadlala enkulu indima ekuxazululweni kwezithinta izisebenzi zikahulumeni. Sasithi uma sidingida izingqinamba naye kwiPublic Service Co-ordinating Bargaining Council (PSCBC), wayekhombisa ukuthi uyindoda ongayethemba,” kuchaza uMabena.Isikhundla esithathwa nguMchunu besiphethwe nguMnuz Bheki Cele kusuka ngo-2018.UMabena uphinde wathi bayakwemukela ukuqokwa kukaDkt Pieter Groenewald njengoNgqongqoshe wezobuLungiswa nokuHlunyeleliswa kweziMilo.Uthe uDkt Groenewald akamusha kangako emkhakheni wezokuphepha njengoba eke waba yingxenye yekomiti lamaphoyisa ePhalamende."Sifuna ukumnika ithuba ukuthi azibonakalise amava akhe eMnyangweni wezobuLungiswa nokuHlunyeleliswa kweziMilo. Ziningi izingqinamba kulo mnyango. Inkinga yokugcwala ngokweqile kwamajele akuyona yodwa into esifuna ayisebenze ngokushesha, siphinde sibe nenkinga yokushoda kwezisebenzi kulo mnyango,” kusho yena.Uthe isibalo seziboshwa ezibhekwa wujele ngamunye eNingizimu Afrika siyazedlula izibalo ezibekiwe ngokusemthethweni nokwenza kube nzima ukuthi ojele benze umsebenzi wabo ngendlela.Lo mnyango othathwa nguDkt Groenewald ubuphethwe nguMnuz Ronald Lamola iminyaka eyisihlanu kusuka ngo-2019.Okhulumela inyunyana yamaphoyisa, iPopru, uMnuz Richard Mamabolo, ekhuluma neNewzroom Afrika, uthe bona abasinaki kakhulu isiqu somuntu."Esikhathazeke ngakho thina ukuthi iSAPS izokushintsha kanjani ukwenza kubhekwe phambili ngoba ibe nezingqinamba eziningi," kusho uMamabolo.Uthe okunye okubakhathazayo ukuthi amaphoyisa awakaze abe nokhomishana wawo kuzwelonke osiqedayo isikhathi asuke esibekelwe ukuthi asihlale ehhovisi. "Leyo nto ibanga ukuthi lungabi khona uzinzo kwezokuphatha. Ukuqokwa kwakhe (uMchunu) kufike ngesikhathi amaphoyisa ebhekene nesihlava sokubulawa kwawo, ukungabibikho kwezinsizakusebenza kanjalo nobuhixihixi ekukhushulweni kwamaphoyisa ezikhundleni,” kusho yena.Uthe uthola iphoyisa lihlala esikhundleni esisodwa kuze kuphele iminyaka eyishumi."Konke lokhu sifuna kulungiswe, okufaka phakathi nokubuyekezwa kwendaba yemali yezokuphepha kwamaphoyisa, okulokhu kudonsa ngonyawo lonwabu kusuka ngo-2003," kusho uMamabolo.
KUHLUKENE imibono ezinyunyaneni zothisha kuleli ngokuqokwa kukaNgqongqoshe omusha weMfundo eyisiSekelo, uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, njengoba zithi zizomqapha ngelokhozi ngendlela azosebenza ngayo.ISadtu iyakuchitha ukuqokwa kwakhe, ithi unomlando wokungazifuni izinyunyana njengoba ehlale ezigxeka, ikakhulu kwezemfundo.INatu ngakolunye uhlangothi ithe izomlinda imbone ukuthi uzosebenza kanjani ngaphambi kokubanga umsindo uma esephambuka.UNobhala-jikelele weSadtu, uMnuz Mugwena Maluleke, umchithile uNksz Gwarube wathi iqembu alimele alinendaba nezikhalazo zothisha abamnyama.UMaluleke uthe bayazi ukuthi uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa unelungelo lokuqoka noma ngubani ambona efanele ukuphatha umnyango othile."I-DA ibichitha umthetho wezikole, iBela, oqhakambisa indaba yolimi okumele lusebenze ezikoleni kanjalo namandla anikwa inhloko yoMnyango wezeMfundo. Aseneme ngokuthi umnyango unikwe umuntu we-DA noma kuthiwa umnyama. ”Uthe ngisho emqulwini wokukhankasela ukhetho we-DA, yakubeka kwacaca ukuthi iSadtu inamandla ngakho kumele kubhekwane nayo."Noma kungumengameli onamandla kodwa akukho okuvimba i-DA ukuthi yenze ekuthandayo ngomnyango ewuphethe. Siyinyunyana enkulu kwezemfundo ngakho uphoqelekile ukuthi asebenzisane nathi,” kusho uMaluleke.Umengameli weNatu, uMnuz Sibusiso Malinga, uthe bayamamukela uNksz Gwarube, wathi bona basebenza nanoma ngubani.Uthe njengoba bengacheme naqembu lezepolitiki, abanankinga nabaphathiswa beminyango noma kuthiwa baqhamuka kuliphi iqembu.Uveze ukuthi vele nasezifundazweni abaphathiswa bavela emaqenjini ahlukene."Sizomlinda aqale asebenze sibone ukuthi uzozisukumela izinkinga ezikhona kwezemfundo bese sibanga umsindo uma engasazenzi. Asikwazi ukumchitha singakezwa nokuthi uhleleni ngomnyango.”Uthe ziningi izinselelo ezisabhekene noMnyango wezeMfundo."Kunenkinga yengqalasizinda ezikoleni, inkohlakalo ekukhishweni kwamathenda, ubugebengu ezikoleni, ukunqanyulwa kwesabelomali seminyango kanjalo nezinkinga ohlelweni lokudla. Sifuna aqashe othisha ababhuquza emakhaya, avale nezikhala ezikoleni.”Uthe kumele aqede nokuqashwa kwabathile ezikhundleni eziphezulu ngoba bedlelana neqembu elithile.INaptosa ithe kube nozinzo ngesikhathi kusaphethe obengungqongqoshe, uNkk Angie Motshekga.Ithe bazomeseka uNksz Gwarube futhi bazosebenzisana naye ezinkingeni ezibhekene nomnyango.UNksz Gwarube (34) uneziqu zeBA kwi-Law, Politics nePhilosophy azithola enyuvesi iRhodes.
UKWANDA kwezigameko zobugebengu kuyamkhathaza uNdunankulu omusha waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, kangangoba unqume ukufaka uMnyango wokuPhepha koMphakathi ngaphansi kwehhovisi lakhe.UNtuli ozichaza njengomholi ozibambelayo, hhayi othumelayo, uthi inkinga yobugebengu idinga wonke umuntu wakuleli eze nesisombululo."Ngithathe isinqumo sokuthi uMnyango wezokuPhepha koMphakathi ube ngaphansi kwami ngoba ngesikhathi ngisahola iSouth African Local Government Association (Salga) bengikhathazeka uma ngibona kwanda ukubulawa kwabaholi bomdabu, ukubulawa kwabantu abaningi nobunye ubugebengu. Ngifuna ukusebenzisana nezinhlaka ezihlukene nomphakathi wonkana ngoba inkinga yobugebengu isithinta sonke futhi kufanele sisebenzisane ukuze siyixazulule,” kusho uNtuli.Wenze isibonelo sokuthi uma emphakathini kukhona umuntu onesibhamu esingekho semthethweni ahlale esiqhumisa njalo kufanele abikwe emaphoyiseni ngoba uma engabikwa leso sibhamu siyobulala elinye ilungu lomphakathi.Uthe kubalulekile kuyena ukuthi iKwaZulu-Natal ibe yisifundazwe esiphephile ukuze abantu bahlale kahle, kuhehwe abatshalimali abazokwazi ukudala amathuba omsebenzi nokufukula umnotho.Wehlise amaphaphu kubantu baKwaZulu-Natal abanovalo lokuthi uhulumeni wokubambisana ungase ungasebenzi ngenxa yokuthi kuzwelonke kuthatha isikhathi eside ukufinyelela esivumelwaneni sikahulumeni wokusebenzisana."Ngenhlanhla akusikona okokuqala iKwaZulu-Natal ibuswa wuhulumeni wokubambisana ngoba nakuqala i-IFP yayiphethe uhulumeni kodwa kukhona abaphathiswa be-ANC okubalwa uDkt Zweli Mkhize noSbu Ndebele. Besinaso isisekelo sokuthi kufanele siziqhube kanjani izingxoxo futhi ubungekho umdonsiswano ngezikhundla. Ngisho amaqembu ayefika ezoxoxa ne-IFP ayekubeka kucace ukuthi afuna ihole uhulumeni. Kuningi esesikulungisile futhi ngeke uphazamiseke uhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal,” kusho uNtuli.Uveze ukuthi izingxoxo kuhulumeni wokubambisana zizolokhu ziqhubeka.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi bekukhona abaphathiswa abangazwani ngaphambi kokubunjwa kwalo hulumeni kodwa uNtuli uthe sekuxazululiwe ukungaboni ngasolinye phakathi kwalabo baphathiswa.Uveze ukuthi sekunokubambisana okuhle phakathi kukaMphathiswa wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana nezoMdabu uMfundisi Thulasizwe Buthelezi noMphathiswa wezokuThutha nokuHlaliswa KwaBantu, uMnuz Siboniso Duma owaphuca uButhelezi obuye abe nguNdunankulu kaZulu umbobho emcimbini okwakukhona kuwo Isilo.Uthe selihoxisiwe necala ebelifakwe wuButhelezi emuva kwezinkulumo ezingezinhle ezenziwa wuMphathiswa wezeMpilo, uNksz Nomagugu Simelane, owayesola uButhelezi ngokuqasha abesifazane ngesinene. UNtuli uthe kuheleza umoya wobumbano nokusebenzela abantu baKwaZulu-Natal.Uthe uyajabula uma kusizakala abantu ngoba inhloso yakhe wukufukula izinga lempilo yabantu baKwaZulu-Natal, kuvuselelwe izimboni koSithebe, Madadeni nakwezinye izindawo ukuze kuzothuthuka umnotho, kuqashwe abantu abangasebenzi ikakhulukazi abasha.Uthe ezinye izinto ezizobekwa phambili ezemfundo, ezempilo kanye nokuthuthukiswa komphakathi. Kusolakala ukuthi kube nesandla semfene kugwazwa, kubulawa umfundisi emvuselelweni yebandla, iFountation of Life Global Church, ebikwaDendethu, eMandeni, enyakatho yaKwaZulu-Natal, esigamekweni esenzeke ngoMgqibelo ebusuku.Umholi webandla, uMfundisi Sifiso Mazibuko, uthe kubashaqise kakhulu ukubulawa kukazakwabo ngesihluku esinje futhi basola ukuthi lesi senzo sinogcobho ngenxa yendlela esenzeke ngayo. Umufi, uMfu Mduduzi Mcineka (49), kuthiwa ubesenonyaka agcotshelwa ubufundisi kuleli bandla kanti ubesebenza kwenye yamafemu enza imibhede KwaSithebe, khona eMandeni. Elandisa Isolezwe ngokwenzekile, uMazibuko uthe ibandla lakhe belikade lenze imvuselelo phakathi noJuni, kwathi ngokubona ukuthi abantu bayithakasele base benquma ukuyenza futhi ngoLwezihlanu nangeMigqibelo ezindaweni ezahluke endaweni. "Nangalowo Mgqibelo besiyenzile imvuselelo, sibeke itende kwaDendethu ukuzokhulekela inhlalakahle yomphakathi, sinxuse uNkulunkulu ukulwisana nobugebengu nezinye izimo ezikhathaza umphakathi wasendaweni,” usho kanje.Eqhuba, uthe ngenkathi kwenzeka isigameko yena ubengakafiki etendeni kodwa utshelwe ukuthi imvuselelo ibisiqalile, kunomama obefunda iBhayibheli epulpiti, sekuzovulwa inkonzo."Kuthiwa kuqale kwaqhuma izibhamu bude buduze netende obekuhlanganyelwe kulona kepha akwanganakeka kangako, abazalwane baqhubeka nokukhonza. Kuthe kusenjalo kwangena abalisa abathathu abangaziwa kodwa kwangasolwa lutho ngabo ngoba vele abantu bebeqhubeka betheleka ngobuningi babo njengenjwayelo etendeni."Kusuke omunye walaba balisa wayohlwitha iselula yalo mama obesepulpiti, efunda iBhayibheli kuyona, wazama ukubaleka nayo. Umufi usukumile ezama ukuyosiza lo mama obephucwa iselula, kwaba nesibhudubhudu kwase kusuka omunye walaba balisa abangaziwa wagwaza umufi esiswini. Umphefumulo uphumele endleleni ephuthunyiswa emtholampilo lapho udokotela esazise ukuthi ummese ushaye nenhliziyo wopha kakhulu, washona,” kulandisa uMazibuko.Uthe okwenza bashaye amakhala ngalokhu wukuthi ngaphambi kwesigameko kunamalungu afike enkonzweni ukuzolanda izihlobo zawo inkonzo ingakapheli. Lokho okwenza basole ukuthi kungenzeka kukhona abebazi ukuthi kunento enje ezokwenzeka. "Sifisa ukuthi amaphoyisa alandelele ngalesi sigameko ngoba indlela esenzeke ngaso yenza sishaye amakhala futhi sekuqala ukusikhathaza lokhu ngoba sekungokwesine manje kufa umfundisi endaweni ngendlela enesihluku kanje,” kusho yena.Kuthintwa udadewabo kamufi, uNksz Hloniphile Mcineka, naye ukhale ngokuthi ibadidile indlela umfowabo ashone ngayo futhi yenza basole ukuthi kunogcobho oluthile kuyona.Uthe yena ubengekho enkonzweni ngosuku lwesigameko, ufonelwe sekuvele sekonakele. Uthe ngokwazi kwakhe umufi ubengenazo izitha futhi ewumuntu okholwayo nokhonze umndeni wakhe, akamazeli lutho olubi. "Kuyasixaka ukuthi kungani umenzi wokubi egwaze yena kuphela ekubeni bekunabantu abaningi kangaka enkonzweni yingakho ngisola ukuthi kungenzeka ukuthi yitulo ebeliqondene naye ngqo. Sifisa ukuthi ukuphenya kwamaphoyisa kusiphendulele imibuzo esinayo ngokufa kukamfowethu,” kusho udadewabo kamufi.Udadewabo kamufi uveze nokuthi yena nomfowabo badabuka eMthunzini kodwa sebehlala eMandeni manje ngenxa yomsebenzi.Uthe ingane yakwabo ibiqashe KwaMasomonco, khona eMandeni, kodwa isiqalile ukwakha umuzi wayo osuzophela. Umufi ushiye emhlabeni unina, unkosikazi nezingane ezimbili.Okhulumela amaphoyisa esifundazweni, uConstable Thenjiswa Ngcobo, uthe amaphoyisa asesiteshini eSundumbili aphenya icala lokubulala mayelana nesigameko sokufa kwendoda eneminyaka ewu-49."Kusolakala ukuthi lona wesilisa ugwazwe ngabasolwa abathathu abangaziwa ngoMgqibelo eMandeni, endaweni yakwaDendethu. Umgilwa uphuthunyiswe esibhedlela washonela khona ngenxa yamanxeba amabi okugwazwa,” kusho uConstable Ngcobo.
Bavukele ehhovisi lezibonelelo zikahulumeni iSouth African Social Security Agency (SASSA) ngoMsombuluko eDurban Station, eThekwini, benengwa ukungayitholi imali yabo.Abantu bebeqhethe ngaphandle kwamahhovisi bezofuna izimpendulo ngoba sekuphele izinyanga belinde ukuthola imilayezo ebatshela ukuthi imali isingenile kodwa lutho.Iningi labo likhala ngokuthi kuthiwa aliye emagatsheni ahlukene kodwa alilitholi usizo.Ekhuluma neSolezwe, uMnuz Lindokuhle Mbhele, ohlala KwaMakhutha, uthe sekungokwesithathu ehambela emahhovisini akwa-SASSA kodwa usizo engalutholi."Uma ngibashayela ucingo bangikhomba emagatsheni njengoba ngaya egatsheni eliseMbumbulu, bafike bangichitha, ngagcina ngingasizakalanga,” kusho uMbhele.Uthe u-R350 uyamsiza ezintweni eziningi njengoba engasebenzi."Ngale mali ngiyakwazi ukuzithengela izinto zokugcoba ngiphinde ngikwazi nokukhokha imali yerenti ngoba ngihlala emjondolo. Buchitheke bugayiwe ibandla lixosha izethenjwa zomholi wamaNazaretha, Inkosi Mduduzi Shembe, uNyazilwezulu okuthiwa bezinamatulo ebeziwabophile ukuholela Ophathe umholi.Isolezwe lithole lezi zindaba ngomthombo ongashayi eceleni nozazi zonke ezebandla, kuthiwa kunesimemezelo esenziwe ngoMgqibelo, eBuhleni kuxoshwa izethenjwa ebese zifana nensila yoNyazilwezulu. Leli phephandaba linalo izwi eliqoshiwe lapho bekwenziwa khona lesi simemezelo futhi kukhona nekhophi yencwadi ebhalwe yiNhlalisuthi, iveza ukuthi sekunesikhathi yenza uphenyo ngabadla uNyazi izithende bengaphakathi ebandleni.Abaxoshiwe, abangeke adalulwe amagama abo ngenxa yokuthi abatholakalanga ukuze baziphendulele, kuthiwa bahlonzwe njengabayingozi kakhulu ngamatulo okuthiwa bebewakhele lo mholi.Omunye wabaxoshiwe kuthiwa uyathinteka ematulweni amabi okungcolisa igama loNyazilwezulu, ukudayisa umuzi waseBuhleni nasezinhlambeni ezihlambalaza uNyazi. Omunye kuthiwa uthinteka kuwona la matulo futhi kuthiwa yena ubedelela inkosi uNyazi. Owesithathu oxoshiwe kuthiwa kutholwe ukuthi ubesebenzisana nezitha zoNyazilwezulu ukuze kufezeke izinhloso zazo ukungcolisa uNyazi.Imibandela yokuxoshwa kwabo kuthiwe bangaphinde babonakale bebeka imicondo yabo kuwona wonke amathempeli angaphansi kwebandla lamaNazaretha, oNyazilwezulu kuze kuphele iminyaka eyishumi. Noma ngabe kuthiwa isiphelile le minyaka kuthiwa ngeke bavele bavunyelwe ukungena ebandleni kodwa kuyoqalwa ezingxoxweni, uma ibandla lingagculiseki ngesimo sabo ngaleso sikhathi ngeke bavunyelwe ukubuyela kulona.Kuphinde kwakhishwa nomyalezo oshubile wokuthi kungabi khona noyedwa kumaNazaretha ozozama ukubancengela noma ukukhuluma udaba lwabo ukuthi babuyiselwe ebandleni."Oyokwenza kanjalo uzomiswa iminyaka eyisikhombisa ebandleni. Uma kunezizathu ezibalulekile ayozethula ukuthi angamiswa, kuzomele azi ukuthi ngeke aphinde aqokelwe kunoma yisiphi isikhundla ebandleni. Ngokunjalo nomnikelo wesihle oya esiqwini (uNyazi) ngeke aphinde avunyelwe ukuthi awukhiphe,” kusho inkulumo eqoshiwe. Umthombo wephephandaba uveze ukuthi bobathathu abaxoshiwe bebeseduze kakhulu koNyazilwezulu kangangoba ayikho into ebifika kulona ingadlulanga kubona."Amacala ka (emgagula ngegama) mabi kakhulu ngoba yena usebenzisana nezikhulu zepolitiki ukudicilela phansi isithunzi soNyazilwezulu. Inkinga ingethenda ka-R18 million okungumnikelo kaMongameli Cyril Ramaphosa wokwakha amadokodo eBuhleni, eyamiswa wuNyazi, abezibheke kuyona. Phezu kwamanye amatulo abathinteka kuwona uNzimande ungomunye wabathele uNyazi ngehlazo lokuthi lushiywe yibhanoyi luya eCape Town muva nje. U..(emgagula ngegama) yena kuthiwa ubesebenzisana nabaseThembezinhle ukuketula uNyazi,” kusho umthombo.Okhulumela uNyazilwezulu, uMnuz Thokozani Mncwabe uthe kufakazeleka isiphrofetho somholi wesibili wamaNazaretha inkosi Johannes Galile Shembe Ilanga, asisho ngeNhlalisuthi njengoba kuyiyona ethathe lesi sinqumo. "Inkosi iLanga yathi uma kukhona okungahambi kahle akobuzwa Inhlalisuthi ngebandla. Ngalokho yayisho khona ukuthi inhlalisuthi ingabaqaphi bebandla. Isinqumo esithathile sikholwa ukuthi ilwenzisile uphenyo ngaphambi kokuba isithathe,” kusho uMncwabe.

Uthe abazali bakhe bebethembele kuNkulunkulu, wakhulela enkonzweni noMntwana waKwaPhindangene owayemkhuthaza ukuthi abambelele okholweni emtshela ukuthi impilo idinga umkhuleko nokukholwa ukuze umuntu anqobe.Okumjabulisayo empilweni ukusiza abantu nokubona besizakala, kanti kumphatha kabi ukungakwazi ukusiza. UMA engasebenzi uNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli uzibhekela okufanele akwenze egcekeni adlale nezingane, anakekela nezinja zakhe Isithombe: FANELESIBONGE BENGUMayelana nezinkulumo zokugconwa akuthola ezinkundleni zokuxhumana njengoba abanye bembiza ngoNdunankulu womgunyathi noma uNdunankulu ka-18%, uthe akayinaki into engakhi."Uma uwumuntu awuwasusi amehlo akho ohambweni lwakho. Uqonda ngqo kulokho osophe ukukufeza. Uma uzingela usubona inyamazane, awuyeki ukuyishaya ngoba sekuvuka ingwenya esizibeni. Akusibo bonke abantu abazokushayela ihlombe ngempumelelo yakho, abanye bazokugxeka ngoba bebefisa kube yibona bodwa abaphumelelayo,” kusho uNtuli.Kodwa noma kunjalo, uMphemba uyatholakala emakhasini ezokuxhumana okubalwa i-Facebook, instagram, Tiktok nakwi Twitter.
IZIMO zempilo zenza kungabi yiwo wonke umuntu okhuliswa wumzali noma ngabazali bakhe bobabili.Zehlukene izizathu eziholela kulokho. Kungaba wukuthi omunye wabazali noma bobabli abasekho emhlabeni, noma bangabi seduzane nomntwana ngenxa yezizathu ezahlukene, okungaba wukusebenzela kude nasekhaya noma ukwehlukana kwabazali.Umeluleki wezengqondo ozinze eManzimtoti, eNingizimu yeTheku, uNkk Tholinhlanhla Dlamini-Ngcoya, uthe ukukhula komntwana kungekho umzali noma abazali bobabli kuyingozi ngoba kungaholela ekutheni eqe izigaba zokuba wumntwana."Lokho kwenzeka ngokuthi umntwana kugcine sekuphoqa ingqondo yakhe ukujwayela ukuba mdala ebe esasemncane, futhi kwenza angakwazi ukujabulela isigaba sokuba wumntwana njengabanye abantwana. Inkinga ukuthi usuke ebhekene nezimo ezidinga enze izinto okumele ngabe zenziwa wumzali wakhe ukube ubekhona,” kusho uNkk Dlamini-Ngcoya.Eqhuba, uthe okungcono ngobunzima baleyo mpilo wukuthi kungenza umntwana asheshe ajwayele ukubhekana nezimo ezinzima zempilo, loko kumsiza ukusheshe aqine ukhakhayi."Yize kunjalo kusemqoka ukuthi abantwana abaphila impilo enjalo balekelelwe ngabantu abadala abangakwazi ukuxhumana nabo, bancele kubona ulwazi lwezinto obekumele ngabe bazifundiswe ngabazali babo ukubasiza baqhubeke nempilo,” usho kanje.UMELULEKI wezengqondo uMnuz Siyabonga Ntshangase Isithombe: SITHUNYELWEUMnuz Siyabonga Ntshangase, umeluleki wezengqondo ozinze ePitoli, eGauteng, yena uthe umzali wumuntu obaluleke kakhulu empilweni yengane kusukela izalwa kuze kube isisesigabeni sokukwazi ukuzimela empilweni."Umzali uneqhaza elikhulu okumele alibambe ukubhekela ukuthi ingane yakhe ikhula kanjani. Nguye okumele ayifundise indlela yokuphila nokumelana nezimo ezahlukene zempilo, yingakho kuba nzima kakhulu uma kwenzeka engabi bikho empilweni yomntwana ngenxa yezizathu ezahlukene,” kusho yena. Uthe nakuba kuzohlale kubuhlungu kodwa kuba ngconywana uma abazali beshiya umntwana emhlabeni esekhulile futhi esekwazi ukuzimela, kunokuthi bahambe noma bangabi bikho empilweni yomntwana esasemncane ngoba lokho kwandisa izinto ezingathikameza ukukhula kwakhe."Okunye kwalokho wukuthi kuba lula ukuthi ingane ibe ngumgilwa wabantu abahlukumeza umphakathi ngoba engekho omuntu obhekelele ukuphepha nenhlalakahle yayo, futhi kungenza nokuthi umntwana angakwazi ukuchuma emakhonweni ezinto aphiwe kuzona ngenxa yokungabi bikho komuntu omesekayo nomgqugquzelayo,” usho kanje.UNtshangase ucebise ngokuthi amalungu omndeni abantwana abangasenabazali kumele balekelele ukubakhulisa, nokuthi labo bantwana bangesabi ukucela usizo ezinhlakeni zohulumeni okungaba ezenhlalakahle ukuze basizakale kokubakhathazayo.
IHLABELA phambili i-ANC nokuqondisa ubugwegwe umholi weqembu Umkhonto weSizwe uJacob Zuma.Inhlangano ithumele uMsholozi incwadi imazisa ukuthi isigcawu sokumqondisa ubugwegwe sizohlala ngoJulayi 17, 2024.Lesi sigcawu sahlehliswa ngenxa yokuthi bekusaqhubeka imikhankaso yokhetho.Unobhala jikelele we-ANC uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, wakuveza ukuthi ngeke bamyeke uZuma bazomqondisa ubugwegwe ngokukhankasela elinye iqembu, agcine esengumholi walo ngoba uphule imigomo yenhlangano. UZuma wamemezela ukuthi uzovotela iMK ngoDisemba nyakenye. Ugcine esengumholi weqembu ngokusemthethweni.Incwadi ethunyelwe uZuma esabalele ezinkundleni zokuxhumana eze yafakwa ngisho yindodakazi yakhe enkundleni i-X, iveza ukuthi isigcawu sokumqondisa ubugwegwe sizokwenziwa ngohlelo lwezobuchwepheshe besimanje.IMK idlise i-ANC namanye amaqembu ngamapayipi okhethweni lwangoMeyi. KwaZulu-Natal leli qembu licoboshise i-ANC layikhipha emandleni lithola izihlalo ezingu-37.EPhalamende linezihlalo ezingu-58, kanti lizibona yiqembu eliphikisayo.Ibamba lomkhulumeli we-ANC uMnuz Zuko Godlimpi, lithe ukuqondiswa ubugwegwe kukaZuma kuzokwenziwa ngohlelo lwezobuchwepheshe.Uthe lokhu kusuke kuyisivumelwano phakathi kwabantu ababhekele uhlelo lokuqondisa ubugwegwe nalowo osuke ezovela ngaphambi kwesigcawu.UZuma ubengahlonizi ukuveza ukuthi ufuna ukulungisa i-ANC ngokuthi ayibuyise ngoba uyithatha njengelahlekile. Uchitha nobuholi bukamengameli wayo uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa.Leli qembu belichitha ngisho eyokuxoxa ekahulumeni wobumbano ne-ANC uma engakhishwa uRamaphosa emandleni.Ngakolunye uhlangothi i-ANC ibala ukhasha ingafuni ukuchitha uRamaphosa ngoba ibilibeka ngembaba elokuthi labo abafuna lo mholi ehambile, abakhohlwe ngeke kwenzeke.UMbalula wathi bafuna ukulandela yonke imigomo yenhlangano ngaphambi kokuthatha izinyathelo ngoZuma.
UMMELI uNksz Kaylen Moodley wenkampani yabameli iMooney Ford Attorneys udonse ngendlebe abaqashi ukuthi babe nobufakazi obuphathekayo ngaphambi kokuxosha abasebenzi.Usho lokhu emuva kokuthi iNkantolo okuDluliswa kuyo amacala iyalele isitolo iWoolworths ukuba sibuyisele emsebenzini umsebenzi owayexoshwe ngoba esolwa ngokuthenga incwadi yokugula kudokotela.Ngokombiko wePretoria News, lo msebenzi wathumela incwadi kadokotela ngesikhathi ayelovile emsebenzini. Abaphathi bakhe eWoolworths basola ukuthi uyithengile emuva kokuthola ukuthi yayisayinwe ngumuntu ababesola ukuthi uyinesi.Lo msebenzi wachaza ukuthi udokotela unezindawo ezimbili zokusebenza yingakho enye incwadi isayinwe wumuntu ohlukile kodwa abaqashi abazange balalele.Kuthiwa bathumela ithimba lapho kusebenzela khona lo dokotela elathola ukuthi abantu babeshesha ukuphuma sebephethe izincwadi zokugula.Wabe esexoshwa emuva kokuthi ithimba lithumele umbiko wokuthi lo dokotela ukokotela izincwadi.Ijaji leNkantolo okuDluliswa kuyo amacala lithe iWoolworths kufanele ibuyisele lo msebenzi eyamxosha ngo-2018 emsebenzini.Lathi abukho ubufakazi bokuthi udokotela udayisa izincwadi ngaphandle kwenzwabethi eyatholwa yilesi sitolo.UNksz Moodley ubhale kwi-website yeMooney Ford Attorneys emuva kwalesi sinqumo wathi abaqashi kufanele babe nobufakazi obuphathekayo, hhayi inzwabethi ngaphambi kokushushisa nokuxosha abasebenzi.Uthe uma umqashi esola ukuthi umsebenzi uthumele incwadi yokugula ewumkokotelo kufanele aqoqe ubufakazi kudokotela othintekayo, ambuze ukuthi isiguli sifikile yini kuye?Uthe leli cala lingubufakazi bokuthi ukukhuluma iqiniso kuyakhulula ngoba umsebenzi othintekayo wayemazisa njalo umqashi uma egula futhi eze nencwadi kadokotela.Uphethe ngokuthi wumqashi okufanele abe nobufakazi obuphathekayo bokuthi umuntu akaguli ngempela futhi uma esola udokotela ngokudayisa izincwadi nalapho abe nobufakazi obuphathekayo, hhayi inzwabethi.
Izinhlangano ezilwela ukuthi kube nesibonelelo sabangasebenzi kuleli sezizwakalise ukukhathazeka ngohlelo lokuqinisekisa imininingwane yabahola uR370 obuwu-R350 wabangasebenzi njengoba zithi abanye ukuthi kunamaqola azama ukuhlomula kule mali ngakho ukugwema lokhu iSassa icela abahola isibonelelo sabangasebenzi ukuba baqinisekise imininingwane yabo.Abahola isibonelelo sabangasebenzi baye babheke ubuso bomuntu oholayo ukuze ibone ukuthi uye ngempela.UNkk Elizabeth Raiter we#Paythegrants okungenye yezinhlangano ezikwi-UBIC, uthe baningi abangeke bayihole imali yabo kaJuni ngenxa yokuthi lolu hlelo lumenyezelwe sekuhambe isikhathi futhi abaningi abanawo amaselula.Uthe yize bekuqonda ukuthi iSassa kufanele ilwe nenkohlakalo kodwa abahambisani nokuthi kukhishwe inyumbazana abantu abahola isibonelelo sabangasebenzi.Ukhale ngokuthi njengoba imisebenzi ingekho abantu abaningi sebeziphilisa ngale mali ngakho ukuphazamiseka kwezinhlelo zokuyihola kunomthelela omubi empilweni yabo.Uphethe
