UKWANDA kwesibalo samaqembu asePhalamende sekuqubule isikhalo ngokushoda kwezindawo zokubambela imihlangano emaqenjini ezepolitiki.Sinyuke sisuka ku-14 isibalo samaqembu abesePhalamende ehlandleni eledlule safinyelela ku-18 ngemuva kokhetho obelungoMeyi nonyaka.Lokhu kwenze kwanyuswa nesibalo samalungu azoba sekomitini ePhalamende. Emhlanganweni wekomiti elakha uhlelo lwePhalamende eliholwa nguSomlomo uNkk Thoko Didiza muva nje, amaqembu afune incazelo egcwele ngokuthi lukuphi uhlelo lokulungiswa kabusha kwePhalamende, njengoba ishoda indawo yokubambela imihlangano yamakhokhasi yamaqembu. Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi ingxenye yePhalamende yashiswa ngoJanuwari 2022, kanti seluqalile uhlelo lokubhidliza ingxenye eyacekeleka phansi ukuze yakhiwe kabusha. UNksz Pemmy Majodina we-ANC, ukhale ngokushoda kwezindawo zokubambela imihlangano yekhokhasi ye-ANC.Uthe sekuphele iminyaka bekhokhela izindawo zokubamba le mihlangano njengoba indawo abebebambela kuyo imihlangano ePhalamende yasha."Kumele ibhekelwe indaba yezindawo zokuhlanganyela kwamakhokhasi ngoba izindawo ziyashoda. Kumele sithole ukuthi selukuphi uhlelo lokulungiswa kwePhalamende.”UNksz Hlengiwe Mkhaliphi we-EFF, uthe kade babenxusa ukuthi banikwe uhlelo olugcwele lwePhalamende ngezindawo zokubambela imihlangano.Uthe amanye amakomiti abebambela imihlangano emahhotela okudla iPhalamende enye imali."Siyaludinga ulwazi olugcwele mayelana neyezindawo zokubambela imihlangano njengoba iPhalamende lasha.” UMnuz Cedrick Frolick oke waba ngusihlalo ePhalamende, uthe nakwamanye amaPhalamende uma kushoda indawo amalungu ayama."Akuyona into engajwayelekile ukuthi uma indawo incane uthole amanye amalungu emile. Kwamanye amaPhalamende emhlabeni ufica amalungu eme ngemuva. Isisombululo okwamanje njengoba sisenale nkinga ngukuthi uma kuzoba nemihlangano kunikezwe amaqembu isibalo samalungu okumele azothamela lowo mhlangano. Uma abanye befika kugcwele sebeyoma. Amanye amaqembu amancane ngeke abe nesibalo esanele samalungu azothamela yonke imihlangano,” kusho uFrolick.UNkk Didiza, uthe udaba lwezindawo zokubambela imihlangano luyaphuthuma."Kuyadingeka ukuthi sithole umbiko ngokushesha ngokuthi selukuphi uhlelo lokulungiswa kwePhalamende.” IPhalamende kulindeleke ukuthi liphothulwe ukulungiswa ngo-2026.Kwenzeka lokhu nje sizonyuka isibalo samalungu azoba semakomitini sifinyelele ku-15 ekubeni ePhalamende eledlule amalungu abengu-11.Lokhu kwenziwe ukwanda kwesibalo samaqembu.I-ANC iyona ezoba namalungu amaningi ekomiti njengoba ezoba mahlanu, ilandelwe yi-DA ngamathathu, Umkhonto weSizwe azoba mabili bese kuthi i-EFF ibe nelilodwa. Amanye amaqembu amancane azonquma ukuthi azohlukaniselana kanjani izihlalo ezine ezisele ekomitini.Amaqembu amancane okudingeka anqume ukuthi azosebenzisana kanjani yi-IFP, Patriotic Alliance, ActionSA, Freedom Front Plus, Azanian Christian Democratic Party, UDM, Rise Mzansi, Build One SA, Al Jama-ah, African Transformation Movement, National Coloured Congress, PAC ne-United Africans Transformation.
IGODUKE isithwele izinsiza zokuthuthukisa amabhizini ayo intsha ewu-150 engaphansi kukaMasipala uMhlathuze ngesikhathi kunomcimbi wokuzidlulisela kwababefake izicelo eNgwelezane, eMpangeni. Bekungokwesibili kunomcimbi walolu hlobo njengoba owokuqala ube khona nyakenye. UNksz Bongiwe Mthembu, waseNseleni onebhizinisi lokukhulisa amatshwele, uhlomule nge-incubator okungumshini omumatha amatshwele angu-1000 ukuze amaqanda achanyiselwa yizinkukhu agcineke efudumele."Ngithokoze kakhulu ukuthi ibhizinisi lami lizokwazi ukuthi lenze umkhiqizo omningi, abantu ngeke besalinda isikhathi eside njengoba ukuchamisela amatshwele kuthatha izinsuku ezingu-21. Ukuba ne-incubator efaka amaqanda amaningi kuzokwenza ukuthi umkhiqizo wami uhambe," kusho uNksz Mthembu.Uthe ukuba ne-incubator encane kumlahlekisele ngamakhasimende."Amakhasimende abegcine esethenge kwezinye izitolo engasathengi kimi. Okunye wukuthi amaqanda ayabiza futhi awatholakali kalula, bengize ngiwathenge eGoli," usho kanje.UMnuz Langelihle Shabalala waseSikhaleni onebhizinisi eliwasha amateku, iKick Slack yena uhlomule ngetende, itafula kanye nensipho yokuwasha amateku."Itende lizosisiza kakhulu ngoba sisebenza endaweni evulekile, ngakho sinokuphazamiswa imvula uma ina, singakwazi ukusebenza nokwenza ukuthi ibhizinisi lethu lingayingenisi imali," kusho uShabalala.Uqhube wathi njengoba kuyinyanga u-Juni ibhizinisi lenza kahle kakhulu."Njengoba kungamaholidi kuyenzeka siwashe amateku angu-20 futhi sisebenza kakhulu uma kunemicimbi ngoba baba baningi abantu abafuna ukuwashelwa amateku ngokushesha. Amateku ajwayelekile siwabiza uR60, amhlophe siwawashe ngo-R70, ebese ama-suede kuba ngu-R100 ngoba kudingeka okokufutha ukwenzela ukuthi singalimoshi iteku," usho kanje.UMnuz Ayanda Mpanza ohlomule ngomshini wokuthunga, uthe lokhu kuzomkhuthaza kakhulu, wanxusa ukuthi intsha ingakubukeli phansi ukuthunga."Umshini ekade ngiwusebenzisa ubusebenza ebese uyakhathala njengoba ububizwa nge-domestic, kodwa manje ngoba ngithole umshini we-industrial, ngizosebenza kakhulu. Kuyinto enhle ukuthunga futhi kunayo inzuzo ngoba akekho umuntu ongakudingi ukugqoka," kusho uMpanza.
IHHOVISI likaNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, selizwakalise ukukhathazeka kwalo futhi lagxeka abantu abakhangisa ngemisebenzi engekho besebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumana nezinye izindlela zokusabalisa ulwazi. Esitatimendeni esithunyelelwe abezindaba namhlanje, lithe ezinye zalezi zikhangiso, ezingaselona iqiniso, zakhangiswa wuhulumeni wesifundazwe ngo-Agasti nyakenye ngaphansi kohlelo, iSthesha Waya-Waya."Izikhangiso zaleyo misebenzi nohlelo lokuqashwa kuzona sekwavalwa futhi azikaze zikhangiswe kabusha. Zonke izikhala zemisebenzi kuhulumeni wesifundazwe zikhangiswa ekhasini le-website likahulumeni noma kuma-website eminyango,” kusho isitatimende.Lesi sitatimende sigcizelele ukuthi lezi zikhala zemisebenzi ezikhangiswa ezinkundleni zokuxhumana azigunyaziwe wuhulumeni wesifundazwe kodwa zingezabantu abahlose ukulutha abantu baseNingizimu Afrika abadinga imisebenzi nabafuna ukushiya emikhakheni ethile, bangene kweminye.Sinxusa izakhamuzi ukuthi ziqaphele ukungaluthwa ngabantu uma zifaka izicelo zemisebenzi."Seluleka ukuthi abantu bayeke ukulutha abanye ngemisebenzi engekho nokuthi noma yisiphi isikhala somsebenzi esikhishwa wuhulumeni sizokhangiswa emaphephandabeni athembekile nakwisizindalwazi sohulumeni wesifundazwe ku-www.kznonline.gov.za/kznjobs,” kusho ihhovisi likaNdunankulu.Lithe lizibophezele ukwethembeka nokusingatha uhlelo lokuqasha ngendlela ecacile futhi engenagcobho, lakhuthaza abantu ukuqala baqinisekise ukuthi isikhala somsebenzi ababona sikhangisiwe sisemthethweni yini, babike kubona uma kukhona okusolisayo abakubonayo kusona. "Sihlose ukuvikela izakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika, siqinisekise nokuthi wonke amathuba avelayo anikezelwa ngendlela efanele nenobulungiswa,” kuphetha ihhovisi likaNdunankulu.
Ukhalaezimathonsi uyise womfanyana (11) wase-Adams Mission, engeke silidalule igama lakhe nelikayise, othi indodana yakhe isezinhlungwini emva kokucwecwa wudokotela isikhumba somphambili kwasala ijwabu ekubeni ubethi uyayisoka.Elandisa ngokubehlele uyise womfanyana, uthe waze ngesikhungo sokusoka i-Unjani Clinic ngokusibona kuTikTok, lapho besikhangisa khona ngokuthi sisoka izingane zabafana. "Ngibone ukuthi lesi sikhungo esizimele ngesangala ngihlala ngakhona e-Adams Mission, ngase ngiyasethemba, ngayisa umfana wami kusona. Bengifuna ukuthi kusokwe indodana yami futhi bekungenye yezindlela zokuseseka ngoba esasendaweni, kanti ngizilandela izinkinga,” kusho uyise.Uthe indodana yakhe isokwe kulesi sikhungo ngoMsombuluko, wangoJuni 17, wathi babone isibuyela kusona ngesonto eledlule, isiqaqwa amabhandishi ukuthi ayisokekanga nhlobo, kunalokho kucwecwe isikhumba phakathi nomphambili, ijwabu lisenjengoba belinjalo. Leli phephandaba lisibonile isithombe esikhombisa ubuntu balo mfana ngendlela alinyazwe ngayo. Kucwecwe isikhumba kwajikelezwa umphambili wakhe ijwabu lisele liyazilengela."Ngithe uma ngibuza ukuthi kungani ingane yami ilimele kanjena, bacasha ngokuthi mhlawumbe yalala kabi ebusuku, yazicindezela, yazithunuka - besho into engekho ngoba kuyacaca ukuthi umsebenzi obekumele bawenze ubehlulile. Sizamile ukubonisana nabo ukuthi simisa kanjani ukulungisa le nkinga, kepha bangakhombisa nhlobo ukuzwelana nathi.”"Sikhathazeke kakhulu ngalesi simo, size sabona kukuhle ukuhambisa ingane esibhedlela eKingsway izolo (esho ngoLwesine), okuyilapho ikhona namanje, ukubheka ukuthi ngeke yini ilapheke."Kuyasikhathaza ukuthi asazi umonakalo ongaphakathi ungakanani, futhi sesaba nokuthi kungenzeka ukuthi ubuntu bayo bungasebenzi ngendlela efanele uma isikhulile uma kuwukuthi ilimale kabi,” kusho kanje.Kuthintwa uMnuz Nhlanhla Mbatha osebenza kulesi sikhungo, uthe bayalwazi lolu daba futhi bamchazela uyise womfana ukuthi basola ukuthi ingane yakhe yazilimaza ngokuzenwaya esilondeni singakapholi kahle. Uthe kungenzeka ukuthi yikhona okudale ukuthi ingasokeki ngendlela efanele, futhi ilimale ngale ndlela."Simcelile nokuthi alethe umntwana wakhe kithina izolo (esho ngoLwesine), kepha wala waphetha, wasitshela ukuthi lolu daba uzolwengamela ngendlela yakhe, njengoba sekwenzeka manje sithintwa ngabezindaba. Simtshelile futhi ukuthi uma ebona ukuthi kukhona esingakwenzanga kahle akasivulele icala ukuze udaba lusingathwe ngokomthetho,” kulanda uMbatha.Uqhube wathi bona sebeneminyaka engaphezu kwemihlanu benza lo msebenzi bezimele, futhi kuyaqala ukuthi kube nesimo esinjena."Nawe bhuti wami ungazifikela esikhungweni sethu uzibonele umsebenzi wethu ukuthi siwenza kanjani,” esho entathelini. Kuthintwa okhulumela uMnyango wezeMpilo esifundazweni, uMnuz Agiza Hlongwane, ucele ukuthi banikwe ithuba lokulandela lolu daba ukuze bathole ukuthi konakale kuphi.
SEKUQUBUKE imvunge kumaNazaretha ngaphansi kobuholi benkosi uMduduzi Shembe uNyazilwezulu ngemali yensipho yokugeza ihlazo lokuthi lo mholi ushiywe yibhanoyi eye enkonzweni eCape Town ngeledlule.Kuthiwa amaNazaretha asenqunyelwe ujuqu ngabagcotshwa abathile okuthiwa bafuna le mali iqale ukukhokhwa njengoba kuqala umhlangano kaJulayi.Okunye okuthiwa kukhalisa amaNazaretha ukuthi sekuphakanyiswe nokuthi kuqoqwe imali yokuthengela uNyazilwezulu ibhanoyi elizohamba ngalo uma liya kwezinye izindawo ezingaphandle kwesifundazwe.Umthombo waleli phephandaba, ongashayi eceleni, uthe le mali kuthiwa idingeka ngoMsombuluko njengoba kuzoqala inkonzo kaJulayi."Inkinga esiyibonayo la ukuthi kunabagcotshwa abafuna ukuqola amaNazaretha egameni loNyazilwezulu. Bamemezele ukuthi bayile kumholi uNyazilwezulu beyovuma ihlazo elenzekile ukuthi inkosi igcine ingabanga yingxenye yenkonzo ebiseCape Town njengoba yafika isikhathele. Emva kwalokho bamemezele ukuthi wonke umuntu oyiNazaretha eNingizimu Afrika anikele ukuze kuhanjiswe imali yensipho ukugeza ihlazo lokuthi amaNazaretha aye eCape Town eshiya umholi ngemuva. Inkinga esinayo ukuthi abantu abadala lokho yibona abaholi abaphazamisa inkosi uNyazilwezulu ngokulokhu bethi basayobheka indawo inkosi ezohlala kuyona ebhanoyini laze lahamba ibhanoyi ingangenile, manje sekuthiwa asiyogeza ihlazo,” kusho umthombo.Uqhuba uthe emva kokushiywa yibhanoyi koNyazilwezulu kuphoqeleke ukuthi luhanjiswe ngemoto luya eCape Town. Lokho kudale ukuthi lufike sekwedlule isikhathi futhi lukhathele kwaphoqeleka ukuthi lungabe lusayibamba inkonzo yangeSabatha eledlule eCape Town.Leli phephandaba linawo umyalezo odluliswe ngabanye babagcotshwa kumaNazaretha obhalwe kanje: Sanibonani zihlobo zami ezinhle eNkosini. Ngiyathemba uThixo usasigcinile sonke. Ngiyazi siyazi isimo esisehlele eZweni lakithi eNingizimu, uThixo ehambe uhambo lwaseKapa, kwagcina kwenzeke ihlazo elingenziwanga umuntu wakithi eNingizimu kodwa inkinga ukuthi uThixo wayekithi eNingizimu, leli hlazo lasithela sonke. Izolo kuyiwe phambi kweZulu ozihlalo bonke bakithi kanye noMfundisi Mvubu neNkosi yakwaBhala. Bekuyofunwa insipho yokugeza lesi simo njengoba lo monakalo wagcina wenze uThixo wangaba senkonzweni ngosuku lweSabatha. Ngithi anginazise ukuba kuyolungiswa leso simo kuthiwe asiyazise yonke iNingizimu uma kukhona abafisa ukuba bangasali ukususa lel icala bangavela.Siyabonga.Emva kwalesi sicelo kuthiwa sekuphume nomyalelo wokuthi abesilisa baqale ukuhlanganisa imali engu-R1000 abesilisa kube u-R500 kwabesifazane ukuze kuthengelwe uNyazilwezulu ibhanoyi. Kuthiwe le mali kumele iqale ukukhokhwa ngoMsombuluko ngoJulayi 1.Okhulumela umholi uNyazilwezulu, uMnuz Thokozani Mncwabe, uthe inkosi uNyazilwezulu ihlakaniphe kabi ukuthi ingashiywa yibhanoyi."Abantu ngeke bakuqonde ukusebenza kukaShembe. Akukhona ngoba ashiywa yibhanoyi kodwa kukhona ayesafuna ukukulungisa okuthinta uShembe, imiphumela yakho ezobonakala kungekudala. UShembe uMpicabadala, udida izazi. Bazitshela ukuhji washiywa yibhanoyi ababoni kukhona ayesakulungisa,” kusho uMncwabe.Ngodaba lokuthenga insipho yokugeza ihlazo, uthe kuke kwenzeke insipho ithengwe uma kungukuthi kunesigameko esenzekile okumele sigezwe kodwa ngeke angene kakhulu kulona. Uqhube wathi nalaba abathi kumele kuthengele uNyazi ibhanoyi uyabancoma kakhulu, wumqondo omuhle lowo kodwa ikomidi lebandla belingakahlali phansi ukudingida lolo daba. Uveze ukuthi nemali okuthiwa izokhishwa uyibona inkulu kakhulu, wathi ngomnikelo ka-R20 nje umuntu emunye lingaphuma ibhanoyi ngenxa yobuningi bamaNazaretha.Amalungu ebandla lamaNazaretha alinganiselwa ku-7 million.
INHLOKO yoKlebe kuzwelonke, uLt. Gen Godfrey Lebeya, ithi sebebophe abantu abawu-33 abathinteka ekudliweni kukaR2 billion webhange i-VBS Mutual Bank elawa nemali yabantu.NgoLwesihlanu uLebeya uthe sekusele kancane babophe abawu-43 abasele njengoba sebeqoqe izitatimende eziwu-2 900 ophenyweni lwabo oluqhubekayo.I-VBS Mutual Bank yawa ngo-2019 emuva kokubhubhudlwa kwemali.Kwakukhona omasipala abawu-14 ababelondoloze kuyo imali nabantu abangaphezu kuka-20 000.ULebeya uthe bazolandelwa bonke abadla imali yaseVBS ngoba oKlebe abamile ukusebenza.Ukuwa kweVBS kwenza ukuthi ibhange lombuso, iSouth African Reserve Bank, lisungule umshwalense ozovikela abantu uma kuwa amabhange.Lo mshwalense obizwa nge-Corporation for Deposit Insurance (Codi) olunxephezela abantu ngemali efinyelela kuR100 000.Khonamanjalo uLebeya uthe luyaqhubeka nodaba lokubopha abathinteka ekudliweni kukaR200 billion eSteinhoff.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi owayeyisikhulu esiphezulu uMnuz Markus Jooste, wazibulala emuva kokuboshwa.Kubuye kwaboshwa owayephethe imali kule nkampani uMnuz Benjamin La Grange ozinikele koKlebe wadedelwa ngebheyili kaR150.000. Uzobuyela enkantolo ngo-Okthoba 4.ICosatu ithe iyajabula ngokuboshwa kwezikhulu zaseSteinhoff ngoba kukhona noMnuz Stehan Grobler owayebhekelele ezomthetho kule nkampani.Ithe kufanele baboshwe bonke abathinteka enkohlakalweni yaseSteinhoff ngoba abasebenzi balahlekelwa wuR4.3 billion.Icele iFinancial Sector Conduct Authority ukuthi iqhubeke nokulanda uR475 million owawuhlawuliswe uJooste nezinye izimali ayezithukusile.
INHLANGANO yosomabhizinisi, i-Black Business Federation ikhala ngomdonsiswano phakathi kwe-ANC ne-DA okubambezela ukumenyezelwa kweKhabhinethi, ekholwa ukuthi kungalimaza kakhulu osomabhizinisi ikakhulu abancane njengoba iRandi liya ngokuya lintengantenga.UNobhala-jikelele we-BBF uMnuz Wonder Jaca ekhuluma neSolezwe, uthe ukungamenyezelwa kweKhabhinethi wuMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, akugcini nje kuphela ngokufaka ingcindezi kosomabhizinisi ikakhulu abansundu abadonsa kanzima, kodwa kushaya nomnotho njengoba kungabalekisa abatshalizimali okufakazelwa ukuphelelwa amandla kwe-Randi uma liqhathaniswa nomnotho wakwamanye amazwe."Nakuba elakuleli sekuphele iminyaka ewu-30 lathola inkululeko, kodwa osomabhizinisi abansundu basadonsa kanzima ngakho lokhu kubambezeleka nomdonsiswano, kudala ukuthi isimo sibe sibi kakhulu kubona ngoba kuphazamiseka notshalozimali,” kusho uJacaUkusho lokhu nje izingxoxo zokuqokwa kweKhabhinethi kuzwelonke ziyaqhubeka phakathi kwe-DA ne-ANC osekuphele amasonto amabili abantu bakuleli belindele ukumenyezelwa kwalo.Le nhlangano ithe ikuqonda kahle ukuthi udaba lokwandiswa kwamathuba omsebenzi akuncikile kuphela ekutheni avulwe uhulumeni, kodwa kufanele aqinisekise uzinzo oluzokwenza osomabhizinisi bakhule ngaleyo ndlela kuvuleke amathuba okuqashwa kwabantu. Uthe ukuputshuka kwezincwadi ze-DA ngekufunayo ngesikhathi kuqhubeka izingxoxo, yikhona okwenza abatshalimali babe manqika okungaba nomthelela ongemuhle kosomabhizinisi abancane, wanxusa uRamaphosa ukuthi amemezele ikhabhinethi ukugwema ukuthi isimo singadlebeleki.Ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngenxa yalo mdonsiswano, i-BBF inxuse uRamaphosa ukuthi eminyangweni emibili okungowoHwebo, ukuNcintisana neziMboni noMnyango obhekele amabhizinisi amancane, kuqokwe ongqongqoshe abansundu abakuqonda kangcono ukuhlupheka kwabantu abansundu.
SELOKHU kubheduke upokisi wezinkawu, iMpox ebuye yaziwe nge-Monkeypox edlange kakhulu kwabesilisa abathandana nobulili obufanayo, kunombuzo wokuthi ngabe yisifo socansi yini.Uma kuyisifo socansi kungani abezempilo bengaphumeli obala bathi yisifo socansi? Kunalokho balokhu bemile ekutheni noma ngubani angasithola uma esondelene nomuntu onaso.Ungoti wezifo ezithathelanayo eNyuvesi yaKwaZulu-Natal, uDkt Richard Lessells, uthe lesi sifo akusona esocansi kodwa indlela esitholakala ngayo yenza sibukeke sengathi esocansi. Emasontweni ayisithupha edlule sibhedukile sidlange kwabesilisa abathandana nabanye besilisa. Yize sivela ngalolu hlobo kodwa akusona isifo socansi. UDkt Lessells uthe lesi sifo sidala, wathi isigameko sokuqala seMpox ehaqe abantu sabikwa ngeminyaka yama -70s, eCentral Africa.Uthe kukholakala ukuthi lesi sifo okwakungesezilwane sadluliselwa kubantu yizilwane ezincelisayo ezincane (small mammals) namagundane. Ngemuva kwakho sase siphenduka siba yigciwane elisuka komunye umuntu liye komunye uma bethintene. UDkt Lessells uthe ukuqubuka kwalesi sifo manje emhlabeni-jikelele naseNingizimu Afrika, okuqale ngo-2022, kudaleke ngokuthi onaleli gciwane athelele omunye, asisasuki ezilwaneni."I-Mpox ne-Smallpox, isifo ebese siphelile ngenxa yokuthi abantu abaningi bayagoma. Yize i-Mpox ne-Smallpox zinezimpawu ezibonakala zifana kodwa zidalwa izinhlobo ezehlukene zamagciwane," kusho uLessells.Onalesi sifo uthe uba namabhamuza anamanzi noma izilonda."Uketshezi okungaba amanzi aphuma ezilondeni noma okusamafinyila uma kuhlangana ngesikhathi kuthintana isikhumba igciwane lidlulela kanjalo komunye," kusho uLessells.UDkt Nevashan Govender wesikhungo esibhekelele izifo ezithathelanayo kuleli, iNational Institute for Communicable Diseases (NICD), uthe uma leli gciwane selingenile esigulini liyaziphindaphinda bese lidlulela ezindlaleni ezisentanyeni.Uqhube wathi eNingizimu Afrika, ukusuleleka kwenzeka ngemva kokuthintana kwesikhumba, ikakhulukazi ngokuhlangana ngokocansi. Kuneminye imizila engase ibe khona yokudlulisela leli gciwane kodwa yona akucatshangwa ukuthi igciwane lidlulele ngazo kulokhu kuqubuka kwakamuva."Ubufakazi besayensi buveza ukuthi abantu abanezifo ezingamahlalakhona basengcupheni yokuthi bagule kakhulu uma kwenzeka behaqwa yileli gciwane. Akubona abaneHIV engalawulwa kahle kuphela," kusho uGovender.Uthe izimpawu zeMpox zihlanganisa izilonda ezinkulu bezisabalele emlonyeni, emehlweni nasezithweni zangasese, izifo ezibangelwa amagciwane ziba sesikhumbeni, egazini nasemaphashini.Umsunguli wephephandaba elibhala ezempilo, iBhekisisa Health Journalism, uNkk Mia Malan, ucashunwe kweminye imithombo yezindaba ethi iMpox ayitholakali emoyeni."Leli gciwane ulithola kumabhamuza asesikhumbeni somuntu. Lawo mabhamuza anoketshezi. Lawo manzi anegciwane. Ngakho-ke, ukuze uthole i-Mpox, udinga ukuthintana nalawo mabhamuza," kusho uNkk Malan. "ENingizimu Afrika, iSmallpox ibigonyelwa kwaze kwaba u-1980. Uma uneminyaka engu-45 kuya phezulu maningi amathuba okuthi ungawugomela upokisi. Lowo mgomo ukuvikela ngo-85%, mancane amathuba okuthi uhaqwe iMpox," kucacisa uNkk Malan.UMnyango wezeMpilo uthe abahaqekile amadoda aneminyaka ephakathi kuka-23 no-43.Isikhungo esibhekelele imingcele kuleli, iBorder Management Authority (BMA), sesiqale uhlelo lokuthi kuqashwe ukusabalala kwaleli gciwane ngokuthi kuhlolwe izinga lokushisa emzimbeni kubo bonke abangena kuleli. Lolu hlelo luqale kuleli sonto.Umnyango uthenge umshanguzo iTecovirimat, owaziwa nangokuthi i-TPOXX noma i-ST-246 engatholakali kuleli ukuze isetshenziswe ezigulini ezibambeke kakhulu. Kunokukhathazeka ukuthi imishanguzo ethengiwe ayenele kodwa okhulumela uMnyango wezeMpilo kuleli, uMnuz Foster Mohale uthe: "U-1% wabantu abahaqekayo ngesonto abadinga ukwelashwa ngalo mshanguzo masonto onke, umnyango usazoyithenga eminye imithi.”
UVELE wadumala unina webhungu elabulawa ngesihluku, lisolwa ngokuntshontsha utshwala, ethola esefikile enkantolo ukuthi kwahlehliselwa olunye usuku ukukhishwa kwesinqumo secala.Unina kamufi, umndeni wakhe namakholwa bebemagange ngesikhathi befika eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseVerulam izolo kodwa baphuma sebephatheke kabi.Bekulindeleke ukuthi iMantshi Sanele Hlatshwayo yehlulele ecaleni lokubulawa kowayengumfundi ka-matric, u-Andile 'Bobo’ Mbuthu (16), okwenzeka ngo-Ephreli 2020.Abamangalelwa abahlanu bebengabonwa nangokhalo enkantolo nokuthe uma intatheli ifonela ummeli wabo, imbuza ukuthi kungani kucwebile enkantolo, wathi kwahlehliselwa uJulayi ukukhishwa kwesinqumo.Umshushisi wecala ubengekho enkantolo kodwa uzakwabo oficiwe uqoqele ndawonye abebeze kuleli cala waxolisa ngokuthi abaziswanga ukuthi imantshi yathi izobe ingekho enkantolo osukwini lwayizolo.Lo mshushisi uthe phambilini kwahlanganwa kwathathwa isinqumo sokuthi imantshi yehlulele ngoJulayi 18.Ngaphandle kwenkantolo umalume kaBobo, uMnuz Bongani Mthembu, uthe baphatheke kabuhlungu bewumndeni.UMthembu uthe yibona obekumele baziswe kuqala ukuthi icala lihlehlile kodwa bathola sebefika enkantolo okuyinto athe iwubudedengu."Bakhombise ukuseya ekubeni salinyalelwa. Kuvusa isilonda ukuza kwethu enkantolo. Kumanje sihamba nonina womntwana (Bobo), uphatheke kabi ukuthi ngosuku okumele ngabe ujabula ngalo, uthola ingcindezelo,” kusho uMthembu ethi bathatheke kancane.Abomndeni kaBobo namalungu ebandla babuthelane ndawonye ngaphambi kwesango lenkantolo kubonakala ukuthi abayikholwa into ebehlele.Umholi webandla labo, uMnuz Cebolenkosi Mngomezulu, uhambe emazwini kaMthembu wathi badumele ngakuchaze ngobudedengu benkantolo."Sekuphele iminyaka emine siyihamba le ndlela. Asijabule neze indlela okwenzeke ngayo izinto. LIVULWA ngosuku okwazalwa ngalo owayenguMengameli wokuqala wombuso wentando yeningi eNingizimu Afrika, uMnuz Nelson Mandela, iPhalamende ngenyanga ezayo.UMengameli wezwe uCyril Ramaphosa uzothula inkulumo yokuvula iPhalamende lehlandla lesikhombisa ngoJulayi 18, 2024.Uzonaba ngezinhlelo zikahulumeni omusha wehlandla lesikhombisa ngemuva kokhetho lukazwelonke nolwezifundazwe obelubanjwe ngenyanga edlule.Leli hlandla likahulumeni lizohlala iminyaka emihlanu ngaphambi kokuba kukhethwe obunye ubuholi.Kulo nyaka kwenzeka okuhlukile njengoba kuzoqale kuvulwe iziShayamthetho bese kuvulwa iPhalamende ngenxa yokhetho.Okhulumela ihhovisi likaMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, uMnuz Vincent Magwenya, uthe lo mholi usebhalele uSomlomo wePhalamende, emnxusa ukuthi abize umhlangano wokuhlala kwePhalamende, kuhlanganise neNdlu yoMkhandlu weziFundazwe.Uthe uzothula inkulumo yokuvula iPhalamende. "Ukuvulwa kwePhalamende kuhambisana nomgubho wosuku lukaMandela, okuwusuku olwabekwa yi-United Nations. Ngalolu suku umphakathi usuke unxuswa ukuthi wenze umehluko ulandela ezinyathelweni zale ngqalabutho.”Okhulumela iPhalamende uMnuz Moloto Mothapo, uthe uSomlomo uNkk Thoko Didiza noSihlalo weNdlu yoMkhandlu weziFundazwe uNkk Refilwe Mtsweni-Tsipane, bayitholile incwadi kamengameli enxusa ukuthi babize umhlangano wokuhlala kwePhalamende.Uthe lo mhlangano ubizwa kulandelwa isigatshana u-84 ngaphansi koMthethosisikelo wezwe."Ayaqhubeka amalungiselelo alolu suku olubalulekile. Kubalulekile ukucacisela umphakathi ukuthi ukuvulwa kwePhalamende emuva kokhetho kuhlukile kunomcimbi wenkulumo kamengameli asuke eyibhekise esizweni, okwenzeka njalo ngoFebhuwari minyaka yonke,” kusho uMothapo.Uthe ukuvulwa kwePhalamende ilapho umengameli ezobe eveza umkhombandlela wezinto ezisuke zizokwenzeka eminyakeni emihlanu yombuso wakhe. "Inkulumo ebhekiswe esizweni usuke ebalula izinto ezizokwenzeka kulowo nyaka kuphela. Ubika nangesimo sezwe, yingakho kunomehluko,” kusho uMothapo.Kwenzeka lokhu nje kulindeleke ukuthi kushaye lolu suku umengameli ebe eseyimemezelile iKhabhinethi yakhe.Okwamanje ziyaqhubeka izingxoxo namaqembu ahlukene mayelana nokubumba uhulumeni.Umcimbi wokuvulwa kwePhalamende uhambisana nengqephu emalungwini ePhalamende. Kanjalo noma kwethulwa inkulumo kamengameli ayibhekise esizweni njalo ngoFebhuwari amalungu asuke egqoke econsa, kukhona nezimenywa ezehlukene okubalwa nababengomengameli bezwe kanjalo nabantu abenza umehluko ezweni.

Kungiphatha kabi ukuthi sekuhambe isikhathi esingaka, kodwa akukho engikuzwayo ngecala, ekubeni ngashayelwa ubala futhi ngalimala kabi nasendukwini,” kubalisa uKhuzwayo.Kuthintwa imenenja yesitolo, uKhuzwayo athi wayesebenza kusona, ithe ayazi lutho ngalolu daba, futhi ayikaze izwe lutho ngesigameko esinjalo, yase ivala ucingo. BAWOTHA ubomvu abaphakela izikole KwaZulu-Natal, abakhala ngokulinda umnyama ongenafu ezikhulwini zoMnyango wezeMfundo esifundazweni, ezingabuyi nezimpendulo ezikhalazweni zabo. Uma kwenziwa isitshulu, awuwakhokheli amafutha no-curry powder wokunandisa. Kanjalo no-anyanisi awukhokhelwa.”Uthe endabeni yegesi, umnyango ukhokha imali encane kakhulu kunale owawuyikhokhela inkampani eyahluleka ukwenza lo msebenzi yagcina iphuciwe."Le nkampani eyayinikwe lo msebenzi yayizokhokhelwa uR2 100 ngegesi engu-48kg. Imali ayinyuki ihambisane nesimo somnotho samanje. Osonkontileka bayaveva manje ngoba bakhathele ukuxhasa uhulumeni,” kusho uShange.Uthe sebecabanga nokungakuhambisi ukudla abangakhokhelwa imali yakho."Okwamanje asikafiki ekutheni sidube ukuhambisa ukudla esingakhokhelwa khona, sihambise lokhu okumele sikuhambise. Uma umnyango uqhubeka usiziba, ngoLwesibili sizohlangana sikhiphe umkhombandlela.”Uthe kubalulekile ukuthi izikhalazo ezikhona zilungiswe ngaphambi kokuvulwa kwezikole."Asifuni ukuthi kushaye isikhathi sokuvulwa kwezikole kusanalezi zikhalazo. Sifuna kuthi kuvulwa kube sekuxazululeke yonke into ngoba sizimisele ukwenza umsebenzi ngendlela.” Okhulumela umnyango, uMnuz Muzi Mahlambi, akazange ayiphendule imibuzo athunyelelwe yona.Akuqali ukuthi kube nomsindo ngalolu hlelo oluhlinzekwa ngezigidigidi zamaRandi nguhulumeni.Phambilini, abafundi babhuqwa yindlala ngenxa yezinkinga ezazilukhungethe.
UPHIKO oluthuthukisa intsha likaMasipala uMzinyathi lubambisene neMoses Kotane Research Institute neMantec Foundation lucije intsha ewu-100 eyakhele lo masipala ngolwazi logesi osebenza ngelanga nobuchwepheshe bokuwenza. Ngenkathi icijwa intsha ithole ithuba lokufunda ngobuchwepheshe bezamandla, ukuthi kwenziwa kanjani namasu ezixazululo zokwenza ubuchwepheshe busebenze.UMthokozisi Silango waseGlencore ongomunye wabahlomule kulolu hlelo, uthe abakufunde kuzoba wusizo kakhulu ukuxazulula izinkinga ezibhekene nomphakathi."Sithemba ukuthi esikufunde kuzosisisza siqhamuke namasu okuxazulula inkinga kagesi ezweni futhi sikwazi nokuqala amabhizinisi ukukwazi ukuzimela,” kusho uSilango.USamkelo Mdunge waseNdumeni, naye ohlomulile uthe: "Okungihlabe umxhwele kakhulu wukuthi bazokwazi ukusilekelela uma siqala izinkampani zethu futhi basisize nokuzichumisa, ithuba elingandile emphakathini engikuwona.”Isikhulu esiphezulu soMzinyathi Development Agency, uMnuz Senzo Ntombela, sithe ngesikhathi bezwa ngale ngqayizivele yethuba, banquma ukulibamba ngezandla zombili ngoba bayazi ukuthi ezamandla zisayinselelo enkulu ebhekene nezwe."Lolu hlelo luyisize kakhulu intsha ukuguqula inkinga yezamandla ibe yithuba lezomnotho, okuzosiza isifunda sethu, kube kusiza futhi ngokwakha amathuba omsebenzi adingeka kakhulu."Le ntsha esicijiwe izosizwa esibambisene nabo kulolu hlelo ukuqala amabhizinisi ayo ezamandla futhi izobhekwa ngeso elibukhali ngabazi kabanzi ngale mboni isikhathi esithile kuze kube wukuthi amabhizinisi abo esekwazi ukuzimela ngokwawo,” kusho uNtombela.Uthe ubafisela okuhle njengoba sebengena kwezamabhizinisi, nokuthi unethemba lokuthi lolu hlelo luzovuna izithelo."Sinethemba elikhulu lokuthi lokhu akuzukuphelela lapha manje njengoba sikhuthaza nabanye abantu abasha ukulandela ezinyathelweni zalaba,’’ usho kanje.INTSHA yaseMzinyathi ihlonyiswe ngolwazi lwezamandla Isithombe: SITHUNYELWEINTSHA yaseMzinyathi ihlonyiswe ngolwazi lwezamandla Isithombe: SITHUNYELWE
BADIDEKILE kuboshwa oshelwe wumuzi esayoncenga inkosikazi akade exabane naye yagoduka, ukuba ibuye ekhaya eNtaphuka, eNdwedwe.Omakhelwane bendoda (54) eboshwe emuva kokushelwa wumuzi, bathi kuyadida ukuboshwa kwayo emuva kokwehlelwa wumshophi wokushelwa yisithabathaba somuzi.Kuthiwa umuzi wayo ushe ebusuku bangoMsombuluko emuva kokuthi ishiye ikhandlela likhanya yayoncenga unkosikazi ohambe waya kubo emuva kwengxabano.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi kuye kwaba nokuhilizisana ngamazwi phakathi kwendoda nenkosikazi yayo ngesikhathi indoda ivakashelwe ngumngani obephethe utshwala ngenhloso yokuthi babuphuzele emzini wale ndoda.Kuthiwa inkosikazi iye yacela ukuthi utshwala buyophuzelwa kubo kwendoda, hhayi emzini wabo njengoba ingumuntu osontayo.Indoda inqabile yahlala kwayo nomngani baphuza utshwala yagcina ihilizisana nomkayo.Kuthiwa ibe isimphelezela umngani sebeqedile ukuphuza yathi uma ibuya ingxabano yaqhubekela phambili.UMnuz Zibonele Ngcobo wenhlangano esiza umphakathi iNdwedwe Development Commitee, uthe bathole ukuthi emuva kwengxabano unkosikazi uye washiya umuzi wakhe wabuyela kubo, okungekho kude kakhulu nomuzi wayo.Indoda kuthe sekwehle ulaka yamlandela, yashiya ikhandlela likhanya njengoba bese kumnyama ngenhloso yokuyoncenga umkayo ukuba abuye."Ibuye umuzi ususha kungasekho ukuthi ingangena egumbini obekushiywe kulo ikhandlela izame ukucisha. Ngiyile nami ngiyohlola isimo ngathola ukuthi kusele urawondi kuphela isithabathaba somuzi sishile. Ngesikhathi ngiya khona ngifice kunenkonzo nomama womuzi angikwazanga ukukhuluma naye ngoba ubelethelwe umkhuleko kulo rawondi osele," kuchaza uNgcobo.Uthe baxakekile uma sekuboshwa umnumzane wekhaya ngoba abazi nokuthi icala livulwe nini nokuthi livulwe wubani.Ucele usizo kumasipala nakubo bonke abantu baKwaZulu-Natal ukuze kusize umndeni oshelwe. Uveze ukuthi usele nokugqokile, kushe omazisi nezincwadi zendodana yakhona efunda u-matric.UConstable Thenjiswa Ngcobo wamaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uthe amaphoyisa aseNdwedwe aphenya icala lokucekela phansi umuzi emuva kwesigameko lapho kusolakala ukuthi indoda (54) ishise umuzi wayo eNtaphuka ngoJuni 24.Kulindeleke ukuba ivele enkantolo yeMantshi yaseNdwedwe namuhla (kusasa).
UMENGAMELI Cyril Ramaphosa ubhalele umholi we-DA uMnuz John Steenhuisen, incwadi eshubile mayelana nezikhundla zongqongqoshe ezifunwa yi-DA.URamaphosa encwadini esabalele ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, utshele uSteenhuisen ukuthi udumele ngendlela leli qembu elenza ngayo izinto njengoba kuqhubeka izingxoxo zokwakha uhulumeni wobumbano.Ukusho lokhu kulandela izincwadi ezilokhu ziputshuke njalo ze-DA iveza izikhundla ezifunayo kuhulumeni.Encwadini kaRamaposa yangoLwesibili, utshele uSteenhuisen ukuthi uyaqhubeka nezingxoxo zokubumba lo hulumeni namanye amaqembu asayine isivumelwano sokusebenzisana.Uthe udaba lokubumba uhulumeni luseqhulwini njengoba efuna ukuluphothula kuleli sonto."Ngizimisele ukuphothula izingxoxo nokubonisana ngeyokwakha lo hulumeni kuleli sonto. Ngisavulelekile ukuthi ngibe nengxoxo nawe,” kusho uRamaphosa kuSteenhuisen.Ngale mpelasonto i-ANC izohlangana nezinhlaka zayo okubalwa namadlelandawonye ukuzozazisa ngebanga eselihanjiwe kulezi zingxoxo.Ngemuva kwale mihlangano kulindeleke ukuthi amemezele iKhabhinethi entsha njengoba abantu bakuleli belinde ngabomvu lesi simemezelo.Iyaqonga ingcindezi yokuthi uRamaphosa amemezele le Khabhinethi njengoba bengekho ongqongqoshe namaphini abo, kuwuyena ophethe izintambo.Encwadini kaSteenhuisen kuRamaphosa ngoMsombuluko, iveza ukuthi uphakamise ukwabela leli qembu ongqongqoshe eminyangweni okubalwa oweMfundo eyisiSekelo, owezaseKhaya, owezemiSebenzi yoMphakathi neNgqalasizinda, owezokuXhumana, owezamaHlathi, ukuDoba nezeMvelo kanjalo nowezoHwebo nokuNcintisana.Uveze nokuthi uzokwabela leli qembu izikhundla zamaphini ongqongqoshe eMnyangweni weziMali, owezaMandla noGesi nowamaBhizinisi amancane.USteenhuisen uphakamise ukuthi kwengezwe izikhundla ezimbili zongqongqoshe kuphinde kwengezwe ezamaphini ongqongqoshe. Lokhu kusho ukuthi i-DA ifuna izikhundla zongqongqoshe abayisishiyagalombili, besuka kwabayisithupha.
USIHLALO we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Siboniso Duma, uthe uhulumeni wobumbano ophethe iKwaZulu-Natal angeke uzanyazanyiswe noma kungafika izivunguvungu ezinkulu.UDuma uthe ukubambisana kwamaqembu ayingxenye yohulumeni wokubambisana kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi uhulumeni wesifundazwe usebenze ngendlela.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi enengxoxo ekhethekile neSolezwe.I-ANC, IFP, DA neNFP yibona abaphethe ngokubambisana uhulumeni wesifundazwe.I-MK okuyiyo eyahamba phambili ngokwamavoti KwaZulu-Natal, iyaqhubeka ngokusonga ngokuthi uhulumeni wesifundazwe ngeke uhlale isikhathi eside.I-MK ayinazo izihlalo ezanele ukuthi ibuse ngokuzimela.UDuma uthe uhulumeni wokubambisana ophethe iKwaZulu-Natal awuyi ndawo."Abantu ababeke phansi amaphaphu, uhulumeni wokubambisana uzosebenza lapha KwaZulu-Natal.”UDuma uthe umnyango awukavalwa kulabo abasala ngaphandle ngesikhathi kwakhiwa uhulumeni wobumbano, wase exwayisa ngokuthi bazothathelwa izinyathelo zomthetho labo abazokwenza izinto eziphambene nomthetho."Leli lizwe lafelwa. Isikhathi segazi safika sedlula. Manje sekuyisikhathi samaphoyisa nomthetho. Yonke into eyenzeka lapha kufanele iqale ezingxoxweni, iphethwe khona ezingxoxweni. Ngiyacabanga nje ukuthi abantu basahlushwa ulaka nelukuluku, basazohamba babone ukuthi sinezinhloso ezinhle. Bazohamba babone ukuthi sizosebenzela abantu bakithi.”Amaqembu ayingxenye yokubusa iKwaZulu-Natal akwazi ukusheshe avumelane ngokwabiwa kwezikhundla kwikhabhinethi lesifundazwe.Kuze kube manje kuzwelonke naseGauteng akukavunyelwana ngokwabiwa kwezikhundla.UDuma ubalule izizathu ezintathu athe zenze kube lula ukuthi basheshe bavumelane KwaZulu-Natal.Esokuqala, uDuma uthe iKwaZulu-Natal yagubuzelwa kakhulu udlame lwezepolitiki, wathi abantu abafuni ukubuyela kuleso sikhathi.Esesibili; uthe iKwaZulu-Natal ivele inomlando wokubusa ngokubambisana kuhulumeni wesifundazwe nakomasipala.Esesithathu; uDuma uthe abantu baKwaZulu-Natal bayakwazi ukuthobela umthetho ngoba iningi labo liqhamuka ezindaweni zamakhosi."Abantu baKwaZulu-Natal bayakwazi ukuthobela umthetho obekiwe. Uzokhumbula ukuthi emakhaya uma insizwa ishaye enye ikhanda, kuyaye kufanele ukuthi iyigeze ikhanda, bese kuqhubeka kahle umcimbi. Le indlela esidalwe ngayo.”UDuma uthe izingxoxo zabo esifundazweni beziholwa yizingwevu okungoMnuz Sbu Ndebele, Mike Mabuyakhulu noNkk Weziwe Thusi."Lesi sikhathi sifana no-1994 kuthina lapho uhulumeni kaMadiba (uMnuz Nelson Mandela) wawuhlanganise amaqembu amaningi. Okubalulekile manje ukuthi sisebenzele abantu. Isisu asikwazi ukubona ukuthi lona uyi-ANC, i-IFP, DA, noma iMK.”UDuma uthe uyabethemba abaholi bakazwelonke ukuthi bazogcina bevumelene."Udaba lukazwelonke lubucayi ngoba kunokwehlukana kwemigomo yamaqembu. Amanye amaqembu akholelwa ekutheni izwe kufanele lisebenzele ongxiwa, bese bethatha inzuzo bondle ngayo izingane zabo. Thina njenge-ANC sikholelwa ekutheni izwe kufanele lisebenzele abantu."Ngisho ebandleni imibono ihlezi ishayisana. Ngiyabethemba abantu abangu-400 (amalungu ePhalamende) ukuthi bazokwazi ukubeka eceleni indaba yokulangazelela izikhundla. Kunengcithabuchopho esixwayisa ngokuthi isikhundla siyize leze, ithi into ebalulekile abantu.”
KUBE isiphithiphithi abantu bebaleka, kuqhuma isibhamu emini kabha, erenki yaseThuthwini, eseduze nezitolo eMthwalume izolo, esigamekweni esidlule nemiphefumulo yabane okuthiwa kukhona kubo nosomatekisi odumile waseHlokozi.Lesi sigameko esishiye amalungu omphakathi azibonele senzeka ethuthumela ngenxa yokwethuka, kukholakala ukuthi abathathu abebeqaphe usomatekisi (igama lakhe eligodliwe kuze kwaziswe umndeni) bashonele endaweni yesigameko kwathi yena wadlula emhlabeni emva kwesikhashana engeniswe emtholampilo.Ilungu lomphakathi elizibonele ngamehlo kwehla lo mshophi, lithe imoto ebihamba usomatekisi nokukholakala ukuthi bebemgadile ihlaselwe abathile abebehamba ngezimoto ezimbili abavele bakhipha izinhlokohlela zezibhamu ngamawindi badubula bebhekise ngakuyo, yasala imbobombobo."Kuvele kwaqhamuka imoto eyiveni, abebephakathi bakhipha izinhlokohlela zezibhamu ngamawindi kwasho inhlamvu. Bengisathi ngingena esitolo kwa-Boxer, angibange ngisaqhubeka. Ngivele ngajika ngabaleka ngingazi kwenzekani, ngala ebengibalekela ngakhona kuvele kwaqhamuka imoto ethwala imali, ngavele ngangabe ngisazi ngishonephi ngoba bese ngizitshela ukuthi kubanjwa yona inkunzi,” kusho ilungu lomphakathi.Liveze ukuthi akabange esakuthenga abekusukele ekhala ngoba bese kugxabha isisu ngenxa yokuduma kwezulu lezandla. Kwi-video eqoshwe kwenzeka lesi sigameko kubonakala abantu besaphazeka bebaleka, oyiqophayo elokhu ebabaze njalo isihluku.Ngokuthola kweSolezwe ngomthombo walo, usomatekisi ngesikhathi ehlaselwa ubephuma eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMzumbe lapho kukhona icala alihambayo. Kuvela ukuthi ungumfowabo kasomatekisi waseHlokozi owayesatshwa, owashona eminyakeni edlule emva kokudutshulwa amaphoyisa, ayekade emfuna uthuli.Ngesikhathi sokuloba, amaphoyisa abesaqinisekisa ukuthi bathathu abadlulile, kodwa umthombo weSolezwe uveze ukuthi owesine ushonele emtholampilo.Oyimenenja yenhlangano yamatekisi, i-South African National Taxi Association KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Sifiso Shangase, ngesikhathi sokuloba uthe bebengakatholi mbiko ngalolu daba.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uBrigadier Jay Naicker, uthe amaphoyisa aseHibberdene aphenya amacala okubulala."Kukholakala ukuthi umshayeli nabagibeli bebephuma enkantolo ekhona endaweni besathi bangena emgwaqweni omkhulu ngesikhathi bevalelwa ekhoneni ngabebehamba ngezimoto ezimbili abavele bavulela ngenhlamvu. Kukholakala ukuthi abasolwa baphinde bathatha izibhamu zabagilwa ngaphambi kokuthi bashaye bachithe endaweni yesigameko,” kusho uNaicker.Uthe imbangela yalokhu kuhlasela ayikaziwa okwamanje, amaphoyisa ayaphenya.Kule ndawo okwenzeke kuyo lesi sigameko kuyaphithizela njengoba kunerenki yamatekisi, kunezitolo eduze nezinye izakhiwo zikahulumeni zokusiza umphakathi. Ngenxa yokuphithizela imoto edlula ngakhona ayikwazi ukuhamba ngejubane eliphezulu.
ITHEMBISE ukubeka eqhulwini ukuhlinzekwa kwabantu ngamanzi, imeya entsha kuMasipala i-Zululand okuthiwa ikhethwe ngo-elethu, emhlanganweni womkhandlu wamakhansela.Kuphele ukuqagela ngozongena njengoba, uMnuz Michael "Mkhonyovu" Khumalo we-IFP, egcine engene kulesi sikhundla, esivuleke kushiya uMfundisi Thulasizwe Buthelezi osekunguMphathiswa woMnyango wezokuBusa ngokubambisana nobuHoli boMdabu esifundazweni. Phambilini, kuke kwaba namahlezi abeveza ukuthi umholi we-NFP, uMnuz Ivan Barnes, uyena othishiwe ekubeni yimeya kulo masipalaEsitatimendeni esithunyelelwe abezindaba wumasipala, uKhumalo uthembise ukusebenza ngokuzikhandla nokuthembeka kulesi sikhundla."Ngifisa ukudlulisa ukubonga kwami emkhandlwini wamakhansela ngokungethemba. Ngethembisa ukuhola ngokuthembeka nokuthi kube nokusebenzisana kwawo wonke amaqembu ezepolitiki angaphansi kwalo masipala,” usho kanje.Lo masipala omkhulu, unomasipala abahlanu ngaphansi kwawo okuwuMasipala Ulundi, Nongoma, Phongolo, iDumbe nowaBaqulusi. Iningi lezindawo ezakhele labo masipala zinenkinga yokushoda kwamanzi.UKhumalo useke waba usomlomo kuMasipala Abaqulusi, ngaphambi kokuthi ahoxiswe kulesiya sikhundla ngo-2022, emva kokuthi kuthiwa wakhuluma budedengu ngesikhathi ehambele umngcwabo kazakwabo owayeyikhansela kulo masipala. Inkulumo eyamdonsela amanzi ngomsele, ayenza kulo mngcwabo eyokuthi kumele kuphenywe isikhala kuqashwe ingane yekhansela, uma kungukuthi azikho izikhalo kuxoshwe umuntu we-ANC, kodwa wabuye waxolisa.
UMBUSO ukhathazwa ukushintshashintsha abameli othi kwenziwa abanye abamangalelwa ecaleni elithinta izibhelu zomtapo, idokodo lalo elingamakhasi angu-17 000.Ubufakazi bedokodo buqukethwe kwi-USB. Amakhasi alo angu-10 000, anobufakazi obuyizingxoxo okuthiwa zaziphakathi kwabamangalelwa kuWhatsapp.Ngokwaleli dokodo, uMbuso uklelise ofakazi abangaphezu kuka-100 kodwa abangu-20 abazobizwa bazokwethula ubufakazi enkantolo.Kwabazofakaza kubalwa ochwepheshe bezinkundla zokuxhumana nabanye abazi kabanzi ngobuxhakaxhaka besimanje.Uqweqwe lomshushisi, u-Advocate Mahen Naidu, luthe ezingxoxweni eziwubufakazi ezisedokodweni kunezinkulumo eziqoshiwe (voicenotes) nezibhalwe phansi, amavideo nezithombe okuthiwa kwakuxhumana ngakho abamangalelwa abangu-64.Laba bamangalelwa, abaqhamuka ezifundazweni ezehlukene, bavele eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini izolo phambi kweJaji uJacqueline Henriques.Abamangalelwa bathweswe icala lokubopha itulo lokususa udlambedlu emphakathini, ukugqugquzela udlame emphakathini, ubuphekula, ukuvukela uMbuso nokubopha itulo lokuzama ukubulala.Enkantolo kuvele ukuthi obengummangalelwa ka-14, uNksz Ntombizonke Zanele Msalela, ushone ngasekuqaleni kwalo nyaka.UNaidu uthe okudala ixhala manje yingqinamba yokuthi abamangalelwa bayapheka bathulula abameli."Sebeshintshe kaningi abameli, usuka kulona angene kulona bese omusha edinga isikhathi ukuze alungiselele icala,” kusho uNaidu.Uthe ngenyanga edlule zichithiwe izicelo zabanye abamangalelwa zabameli bamahhala.UNaidu uthe batshelwa abamangalelwa ukuthi bazozimela ngokwabo uma behluleka ukuzitholela okhokhelwayo.Icala lihlehliselwe uJulayi 26 nonyaka ukuze kwenziwe izindlalelo zokuqala kokuqulwa kwecala.Omunye wabamele ummangalelwa ukhale ejajini ngokubambezeleka okwenzekayo ecaleni. Uthe lokhu kubambezeleka kweminyaka kuphula amalungelo kammangalelwa. Uthe uzoxhumana nommangalelwa bese ethatha isinqumo sokuthi uyasifaka yini isicelo ejajini sokuba icala lakhe liqulwe lodwa eceleni.
IZINKOMBA ziveza ukuthi izikhungo ezingonyamakayipheli, njengoshisanyama nasemadeleni, yizo okuphelela kuzo imfuyo esuke yebiwe.Lokhu kuvezwe abenhlangano yabalimi i-African Farmers’ Association of South Africa (Afasa) KwaZulu-Natal, nenhlangano elwa nokuntshontshwa kwemfuyo iNkanyamba Forum, engxoxweni neSolezwe.Isigameko sakamuva esenzeke ngeSonto sokuboshwa kwekhansela le-IFP kuMasipala waseNdumeni, uMnuz Dumisani Xaba nabehamba naye uMnuz Kwazi Zulu, kushiye amalungu omphakathi ebambe ongezansi.Kuthiwa babanjwe belayishe izinkomo ezine emotweni edonsa inqola emgwaqweni u-R33 phakathi kweDundee neKranskop UMnuz Mbongeni Sikhakhane owusihlalo we-Afasa KwaZulu-Natal, uthe bakhathazekile ngokwanda kwezigameko zokuntshontshwa kwemfuyo kulesi sifundazwe. Uthe kunobufakazi bokuthi amasela ayisebenza masisha, adayise impahla isiyinyama ezindaweni ezingoshisanyama nasemadeleni."Imvamisa imfuyo esuke yebiwe, amasela ayihlinzela emahlathini kutholakale ngesikhumba nomswani, okukhombisa ukuthi isuke izolayishwa iyiswe endaweni ethile edayisela abantu inyama okungaba yikoshisanyama nakwezinye izindawo ezidayisayo. Lokhu kuyabalimaza abalimi ikakhulu abansundu ngoba sikholelwa ukuthi imfuyo iyibhange lethu thina bantu abansundu,” usho kanje.UMnuz Tallman Zuma, ongumsunguli wenhlangano elwa nokuntshontshwa kwemfuyo emphakathini iNkanyamba Forum, uthe isikhathi esiningi uma belandela umkhondo ngokulahleka kwemfuyo kuyabonisa izinsalela zayo zivamise ukutholakala ebangeni elingaqhelile kakhulu nalapho yebiwe khona."Ezigamekweni eziningi, imfuyo siyifica ihlinziwe. Kwesinye isikhathi uyaye ubone umuntu odayisa inyama emholweni wezalukazi, ubone ukuthi isavuza igazi okukhombisa ukuthi ibisanda kuhlatshwa,” usho kanje.Uthe kwesinye isikhathi ezindaweni ezishisa inyama, inyama uyithola inotshani nenhlabathi nokuyizinkomba zokuthi isuke ihlinzwe kuphuthunywa.Umnikazi wendawo yobumnandi eChesterville eThekwini, i-Mashamplane’s Shisanyama, ukugxekile ukuthengwa kwenyama yokwebiwa okunezinsolo zokuthi kwenziwa abanye abasebhizinisini elifanayo, wathi kuwudlisa amakhasimende into engekho ezingeni."Ngenza isiqiniseko sokuthi inyama engiyidayisayo ngiyithenga ezindaweni ezivumelekile ukudayisa inyama ukuhlangabenzana namazinga ezokuphepha ezempilo. Uma udayisela umuntu ukudla into oyithenge emaseleni, uma isigulisa abantu sekutholakala ukuthi inobuthi, uzokwazi kanjani ukuthola loyo muntu okudayiselile? "Ebhizinisini lami abezempilo bayafika izikhathi nezikhathi ukuzohlola, namaphoyisa ayafika ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ibhizinisi lisaqhutshwa ngendlela ephephile. Uma kukhona ozakwethu abathenga ngalolu hlobo, abakuyeke lokhu, kuyasilimaza sonke kwehlise isithunzi semboni esikuyo,” usho kanje.UMnuz Mike Ngwenya ongumqondisi kwa-Cattle Watch, okuyinhlangano yamaqhinga okunqanda ukwebiwa kwemfuyo, uthe zikhona izindlela zobuchwepheshe abazisebenzisayo kwezinye izifundazwe ukunqanda ukwebiwa kwemfuyo."Kunama-tracker afakwa emfuyweni okwenza kube lula ukuyibona ukuthi ikuphi ngoba ixhunyaniswa nomakhalekhukhwini womlimi. Lolu hlobo ludinga ingqalasizinda, ekhona kwezinye izifundazwe kodwa KwaZulu-Natal ayikho ngoba uhulumeni akafuni ukuhlangabezana nabalimi ngoba lolu hlelo lumba eqolo. Kwezinye izifundazwe iminyango yezolimo iyasebenzisana nabalimi ngakho silufakile khona, okubi ngoba siqhamuka kulesi sifundazwe kodwa asikwazi ukusiza khona,” kusho uNgwenya.Phakathi kuka-Okthoba noDisemba nyakenye, awu-7 290 amacala okwebiwa kwemfuyo abikwe emaphoyiseni KwaZulu-Natal.
LIZOHLAWULISWA uR1 193 iqembu lezepolitiki uma lisuselwa uqwembe lokhetho olulodwa kweziphanyekwe ezigxotsheni kusuka ngoMsombuluko (Julayi 1).Lesi saziso sikhishwe uMasipala weTheku esitatimendeni osithumele abezindaba izolo.Lo mkhandlu uthe ukhetho lwangoMeyi 29 lufike lwadlula, wakhuthaza amaqembu ezepolitiki ukuthi asuse izingqwembe ungaze uzisuse ngokwawo.Ibamba lemenenja ebhekele ezokukhangisa, uMnuz Sagren Naicker, lithe umgomo wabo uthi zonke izingqwembu kumele zisuswe zingakapheli izinsuku ezingu-30 kudlule ukhetho.Uthe lesi sinqumo esathathwa emhlanganweni wamakhansela ngoDisemba nyakenye."Uma amaqembu ezepolitiki ehluleka ukususa lezingqwembe ngokwawo, esikhathini abekelwe sona, umasipala uzozisusa ngokwawo bese uhlawulisa lelo qembu ubheka isibalo sezingqwembe ozisusile,” kuchaza uNaicker.Uthe lomgomo ufaka phakathi nalawo maqembu ayekade egunyazwe ukukhangisa kothalawayeka nasemabhishi ngokhetho.Uqhube wathi umasipala wenza isiqiniseko sokuthi ilandelwa njengoba injalo imithetho yedolobha futhi akukho namunye onegunya lokukhangisa ngaphandle kokuthi anikezwe imvume.Imenenja kaMasipala weTheku, uMnuz Musa Mbhele, ihambe emazwini kaNaicker, yathi ukhetho ludlulile ngakho azisuswe izingqwembe."Ukususwa kwazo kuzosisa ukugcina umasipala uhlanzekile ngoba ezinye izingqwembe zipheshulwe umoya ezinye zilenga ngendlela enobungozi,” kusho uMbhele.

SIYANDA isibalo sabagxeka ukufungiswa kobengungqongqoshe wezeMidlalo, amaCiko namaSiko, uMnuz Zizi Kodwa, njengelungu lePhalamende nakuba esabhekene namacala enkohlakalo.UKodwa wasule njengongqongqoshe walo mnyango kulandela ukuvela enkantolo ngezinsolo zokuthi wamukela uR1.7 million wentshontsho.UMnuz Wayne Duvenage wenhlangano i-Organisation Undoing Tax Abuse (OUTA), uthe lesi sinyathelo se-ANC sokuvumela uKodwa ukuthi afunge njengelungu lePhalamende, sizoba nomthelela ongemuhlelo empini yokulwa nenkohlakalo.Uthe lokhu kuzodlulisa umyalezo ozodida abantu ngokuthi ngabe le nhlangano izibophezele ekulweni nenkohlakalo."I-ANC ihlale ithi izakha kabusha kodwa yenza okuhlukile kunalokho. Abantu bazodideka ngokuthi ngabe i-ANC izinikele empini yokulwa nenkohlakalo noma isuke izikhulumela nje,” kusho uDuvenage. Umfelandawonye wezinyunyana zabasebenzi iCosatu, isigxekile lesi sinyathelo, yathi uKodwa kumele ahoxe.UMnuz Matthew Parks weCosatu uthe kubamangazile ukufungiswa kukaKodwa ekubeni i-ANC inomgomo wokuthi amalungu abhekene namacala enkohlakalo kumele ahoxe emisebenzini yenhlangano.Uthe lesi sinyathelo sizodida abantu ngoba i-ANC isho okunye iphinde yenze okunye.Uveze ukuthi akuwakhi umqondo ukuthi wasula esikhundleni, gwiqiqi useyabuya uyafungiswa."Abantu bazolahlekelwa yithemba ngemizamo ye-ANC yokulwa nenkohlakalo. Akukuhle ukuthi sibe namalungu ePhalamende azophuma engena ezinkantolo,” kusho uParks. I-ActionSA nayo isigxekile lesi senzo yathi ngoba ubhekene namacala abucayi.Umholi wenguyazane yaleli qembu ePhalamende, uMnuz Athol Trollip, uthe uKodwa ubhekene nezinsolo ezithinta uR1.7 million, wentshontsho ngakho bekungamele afungiswe.Uthe akuwakhi umqondo ukuthi kungaba nelungu lePhalamende elakha imithetho yezwe ekubeni ligqigqa ezinkantolo."Sinxusa i-ANC ukuthi imsuse njengelungu layo ePhalamende ukuze abe nesikhathi esenele sokuhamba icala abhekene nalo. Asifuni abantu bakuleli ukuthi bakhokhele izindleko zecala likaKodwa.” Ekhuluma nabezindaba ngemuva kokufungiswa, uKodwa uthe akubuzwe i-ANC mayelana nokufungiswa kwakhe.Uthe eyecala uzobhekana nalo enkantolo wathi umsulwa.
IMK ithi kusazophenduka amatafula KwaZulu-Natal, kukhishwe emandleni amaqembu ayikhipha inyumbazana ngesikhathi kuqokwa uhulumeni wobumbano KwaZulu-Natal.IMK ithe uhulumeni wobumbano owakhiwe i-IFP, ANC, DA neNFP, ngeke uhlale isikhathi eside.Lokhu bakusho ngesikhathi benemashi yokukhala ngemiphumela yokhetho abebeyibhekise eNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu.Kule mashi iMK ibikhala ngemiphumela yokhetho.Osethimbeni lesikhashana elihola iMK esifundeni iMoses Mabhida, uMnuz Mzwandile Goge, uthe abantu baKwaZulu-Natal bavotela iMK ukuba iphathe isifundazwe.UGoge uthe izofezeka maduze intando yabantu baKwaZulu-Natal yokuthi kuphathe iMK."Le sitokfela sesikhashana esiphethe lapha sizophela maduze. Ngicela nikhumbuze abantu abadala ukuthi bona bavotela iMK. Nibatshele ukuthi asimile, siyalwa.”Umgqugquzeli weMK esifundeni iMoses Mabhida, uMnuz Reggie Ngcobo, uthe abafuni nokuyizwa ekahulumeni wobumbano ohlanganisa iDA."Ngeke sivume ukuphathwa uZille (usihlalo woMkhandlu weDA). Ngeke sivume ukuphathwa uSteenhuisen (umholi weDA).”UNgcobo uthe basamile ekutheni kukhona amavoti eMK angazange abalwe.Usho kanjana nje kunesikhulu senhlangano eyengamele ukhetho, i-Independent Electoral Commission (IEC), ebesivele eNkantolo yeMantshi eMgungundlovu, khona izolo.Le sikhulu saboshwa emva kokutholwa sihambisa amaphepha okuvota singagadiwe amaphoyisa.Izolo inkantolo izwe izethulo zabameli bommangalelwa nabe-IEC abathe icala kufanele liyolalelwa eNkantolo yezoKhetho, abeMK bona bafuna ukuthi liqhubeke khona eNkantolo yeMantshi.Inkantolo izonquma namhlanje ukuthi icala lizoqhubeka eNkantolo yeMantshi noma lizodluliselwa eNkantolo yezoKhetho.UNgcobo uthe ukuboshwa kwale sikhulu kufakazela lokhu abakushoyo ukuthi ukhetho lwalungakhululekile."Kwasimangaza ukuzwa i-IEC ithi ukhetho belukhululekile ekubeni kunamacala asezinkantolo. Kazi bathini ngalesi sigebengu ebesivela lapha namhlanje.”UNgcobo uthe bafuna ukuthi umengameli wamaJaji KwaZulu-Natal, uThoba Portia Poyo-Dlwathi, achithwe ekubeni ijaji."Kwakufanele alinde kuze kuphele amacala. Manje yena wavele wajaha ukuthi kukhethwe.”UNgcobo uthe uPoyo-Dlwathi kwakungafanele ahlalise umhlangano wokukhetha undunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal ekubeni kusenecala elisenkantolo.Uthe nenhloko yamaJaji, uRaymond Zondo, kwakungafanele ahlalise umhlangano wokuqoka umengameli.IMK ihambise uhlu lwezikhalo ethe ifuna lubhekwe iphini lenhloko yamaJaji, uMandisa Maya. "Asimthembi uZondo, ingakho sifuna ukuthi kube iJaji Maya eliphenyayo.”
INZIMA impilo kubantu abasha abangasebenzi njengoba izibalo zabangasebenzi zilokhu zikhula unyaka nonyaka.IStatsSA iveze ukuthi kuphele imisebenzi ewu-67 000 noma ewu-0.6% kusukela ngoDisemba wonyaka odlule kuze kube wuMashi walo nyaka. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abangasatohozi sebewu-10 664 000.Imisebenzi iphele emkhakheni wezohwebo lapho kuphele ewu-57 000, kwezemiphakathi ewu-18 000, ezamabhizinisi ewu-4 000 nezezimayini ewu-3000.Isolezwe likhulume nentokazi yaseMlaza (28) eyaphothula iziqu ze-BA Industrial Sociology eNyuvesi yaseZululand ngo-2019, eveze ukuthi selokhu yaqeda ukufunda ayiwutholi umsebenzi yize iwufuna.Iveze ukuthi inzima impilo yokungasebenzi uma uwumuntu omusha ngoba kufanele ucele imali ye-data lokungena kuma-website ahlukene okubheka umsebenzi, ucele imali yokwenza amakhophi lapho kuposwa khona kanjalo nemali yokugibela uma usubizelwe ukuyokwenza inhlolokhono.Le ntokazi engathandanga ukudalulwa igama ngoba inqena amehlo abantu, ithe ayiwutholi noR350 wabangasebenzi kodwa iye izame amatoho ezindaweni ezihlukene."Siyazi ukuthi uhulumeni ugxile emkhakheni wesayensi kodwa zikhona nezinye izifundo ezingagxilile kwisayensi lapho abantu bedinga khona imisebenzi. Kungakuhle ukuthi angayikhohlwa naleyo mikhakha adale amathuba omsebenzi. Ngiyazifaka izicelo zomsebenzi ezinhlelweni ezibhekelele abantu abasha abangasebenzi kodwa angikaze ngibe nenhlanhla yokutohoza kuzo,” kusho le ntokazi.IStatsSA sithe abantu abaqashiwe sehle ngo-29 000 noma u-0.3% sisuka ku-9 513 000 ngoDisemba wonyaka odlule saya ku-9 484 000 ngoMashi walo nyaka.Isazi somnotho sakwaFNB, uNksz Koketso Mano, sithe kuyakhathaza ukuthi sebevile ku-10.6 million abantu abangasebenzi kuleli.Unxuse uhulumeni ukuthi udaba lokudalwa kwemisebenzi lube seqhulwini lwezinhlelo zakhe ngoba abantu abangasebenzi baphelelwa yithemba.Uveze ukuthi izinga lokuphila eNingizimu Afrika liyabiza ngisho abantu abasebenzayo abakwazi ukumelana nezindleko zempilo.
LUTHOLAKALE selushonile usana obelusanda kuzalwa lusongwe ngoplastiki kadoti eTea Estate, eNanda, KwaZulu-Natal, izolo.Ngokwesitatimende sonogada be-Reaction Unit South Afrika (RUSA), bathole ucingo oluphuthumayo obeluqhamuka komakhelwane abakhelene nendawo izolo ekuseni.Baphuthume endaweni ababizelwe kuyo behamba nabezimo eziphuthumayo abafike bathola ingane yentombazane ingaphefumuli isongwe ngoplastiki kadoti eduze komgwaqo, bayihlola kwatholakala ukuthi isishonile.Kuthiwa amadoda amathathu okuyiwo athole ingane abalekile ngaphambi kokuthi kufike abantu.Okhulumela iReaction Unit South Afrika, uMnuz Prem Balram, uthe ngesikhathi befika endaweni yesehlo batshelwe amalungu omphakathi ukuthi abesilisa abathathu abebehamba nezinja zokuzingela bebebheka emgqomeni kadoti nalapho bevule khona umgqomo bathola ingane ilahliwe, base bethinta abantu bendawo abashayele ucingo onogada. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, Constable Thenjiswa Ngcobo, uthe amaphoyisa ayaphenya."Amaphoyisa ase-Verulam aphenya icala lokufihla ukubeletha kulandela isigameko lapho ingane ebisanda kuzalwa itholakale ishonile ngoJuni 25. Isidumbu sengane sitholwe sigoqwe ngoplastiki,” kusho uConst Ngcobo.
NJENGOBA kungathu kusalindwe umnyama ongenafu ngesimemezelo seKhabhinethi entsha kaMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, omkhulumelayo uMnuz Vincent Magwenya uveze ukuthi alikho iqembu lezepolitiki elizoshintsha imigomo ekhona ezweni.UMagwenya uthe amaqembu ayingxenye kahulumeni wobumbano, awakhohlwe uma ecabanga ukuthi abekhankasa ngakho kuzoba yingxenye yemigomo kahulumeni ozobunjwa. Uthe izwe libuswa ngokwentando yeningi, ngakho ongqongqoshe abazokhethwa abavela kwamanye amaqembu bazoqhubeka balandele imigomo ekhona kahulumeni."Ongqongqoshe abasha ngeke bafake imigomo yamaqembu abo kuhulumeni. Imigomo ezolandelwa ekahulumeni ehambisana noMthethosisekelo wezwe,” kusho uMagwenya ekhuluma nesiteshi sethelevishini iNewzroom Afrika.Usho lokhu nje, ziyaqhubeka izingxoxo phakathi kukaRamaphosa namanye amaqembu mayelana nokubunjwa kwalo hulumeni njengoba lingekho iqembu elawina ngamalengiso okhethweni.UMagwenya uthe uRamaphosa ekugcineni nguyena ozoba nezwi lokugcina ngalabo azobakhetha kwiKhabhinethi."Umengameli uhlangana nawo wonke amaqembu, kungaba elikhulu noma elincane. Uzolalela zonke iziphakamiso, bese enza isinqumo. Ngeke akwazi ukufeza zonke iziphakamiso ezizovela. Kukhona abangeke baname ngezinqumo azozithatha ngeKhabhinethi ngoba ekugcineni nguyena onamandla okunquma ukuthi obani azobakhetha,” kusho uMagwenya.Uveze ukuthi alikho iqembu elinamandla noma okuyilona elingungqo-shishilizi kuhulumeni wobumbano.Usho lokhu nje, kulandela ukuvela kwencwadi ye-DA eveze uhlu lwezikhundla ezifunayo kuhulumeni wobumbano.Kulezi zikhundla kubalwa nesephini likamengameli wezwe, noma iminyango ethathwa njengebalulekile.UMagwenya uthe amaqembu ahlukene abekhankasa ayazi ukuthi ezinye zezinto ngeke zibe semigomemi kahulumeni.URamaphosa usanda kukhuza amaqembu ngokufuna izikhundla kuhulumeni wobumbano.UMagwenya uthe abantu balindile bafuna imisebenzi, kukhuliswe umnotho kanjalo nezinye izimfuno."Okubalulekile ngukuthi kumele kusetshenzelwe abantu, hhayi okunye. Abantu bafuna uhulumeni ozobasenzela ngokushesha.”Uveze ukuthi nakuba iKhabhinethi ingekho, uhulumeni uyaqhubeka nokusebenza."Uyaluthola usizo eminyangweni kahulumeni nakuba iKhabhinethi ingekho. Umengameli nguyena owengamele izintambo kuhulumeni kuze kuqokwe iKhabhinethi entsha. Ngemuva kokuqokwa kweKhabhinethi kuzoba nomhlangano weLekgotla, lapho kuzohlahlwa khona indlela kalo hulumeni.”I-ANC iveze ukuthi ihlangane nobuholi boMdabu ngoMsombuluko, bavuma ukusebenzisana nohulumeni wobumbano.
'ASIYILE ePhalamende ukuyosinisa amahleza, asibona futhi ondlavini, siye ngenhlonipho.’Lokhu kushiwo ngumholi weqembu uMkhonto weSizwe ePhalamende, uDkt John Hlophe, othe noma bezohlonipha ozakwabo kodwa ngeke bakuvumele ukuchukuluzwa. UHlophe owayengumengameli wamajaji eWestern Cape, uthe bayawazi umthetho futhi bazosebenza ngawo ukuze ushintshwe."Size la ukuzosebenza, hhayi ukuzosinisa amahleza. Sizokwenza konke silandela umthetho wezwe nakuba sifuna kushintshwe izinto ezithinta wona umthetho. Asizile ukuzodlala ipolitiki eshibhile. Njengomuntu owazi umthetho, siyawazi amalungelo ethu njengabantu abadala,” kusho uHlophe kulandela ukufungiswa kwamalungu aleli qembu angu-58 ePhalamende, eKapa izolo.UHlophe owayengekho ohlwini lokuqala lwabantu abajutshwe yileli qembu ePhalamende, uveze ukuthi owayengumengameli wezwe ne-ANC uJacob Zuma, nguyena ongumengameli weMK."Sifuna ukuqeda ngemithetho esilawulayo njengoba sifuna ukulawulwa owase-Afrika. Sifuna umhlaba ubuyele ngaphansi kwamakhosi. ENgilandi, umhlaba ungaphansi kweNgonyama yakhona kodwa akukho okonakele emnothweni wakhona,” kusho uHlophe ekhuluma nabezindaba.Ubalule ukuthi bazoba yiqembu eliphikisayo besebenzisana namanye amaqembu amancane."I-DA isikuhulumeni ngakho ayiselona iqembu eliphikisayo. Sifuna kucacele noma ngubani ukuthi ngeke siwuyeke umshikashika wasenkantolo wokuphikisana nemiphumela yokhetho njengoba sesifungisiwe.”Ohlwini lweMK labafungisiwe kukhona abebevele bebhekiwe nabasha.Kwabebevele bebhekiwe kubalwa indodakazi kaZuma, uDuduzile, okhulumela leli qembu uMnuz Nhlamulo Ndhlela, uMnuz Des van Rooyen owaduma ngokuqhoqhobala izinsukwana isikhundla sikangqongqoshe wezizeziMali kuleli, noMnuz Sipho Mbatha owayekwi-EFF.Abanye abafungisiwe kubalwa uMnuz Andile Mngxitama umengameli weqembu iBlack First Land First, owayeyilungu lePhalamende emele i-EFF, uMnuz David Skosana, umyeni ka-Advocate Busi Mkhwebane, owayenguMvikeli woMphakathi kanti manje uyilungu lePhalamende emele i-EFF. Omunye ofungisiwe ngobengungqongqoshe wezeMidlalo, ezobuCiko namaSiko, uMnuz Zizi Kodwa, owasula esikhundleni ngoba ebhekene necala lenkohlakalo.Ekhuluma nesiteshi sethelevishini izolo, uKodwa uthe bekumele afunge ngeledlule kodwa wabambeka."Ngiyilungu le-ANC njengoba ngiwunombolo 25 ohlwini lwabamele le nhlangano ePhalamende. Yingakho ngizile ngazofunga,” kusho uKodwa ngamafuphi.La malungu afungiswa nje, kulindeleke ukuthi uqale umsebenzi wePhalamende njengoba namhlanje kuqala imihlangano ehlukene.Izoshintsha impilo kumalungu amasha ePhalamende njengoba amanye awo abetohoza kanti amanye abengatohozi.La malungu asezolala noR1.274 million ngonyaka, kuthi umholi weqembu eliphikisayo ahole uR1.792 million ngonyaka.Azothola neminye imihlomulo njengoba ezohlala ezindlini ezikhokhelwa abakhokhi bentela eKapa. Lezi zindlu zinefenisha kanti amanzi nogesi kumahhala kuzona.La malungu azotetemuka ngamabhanoyi mahhala nezingane zawo.Azokwazi ukugibela amabhanoyi izikhawu ezingu-88 bhusende aphinde abe nezinkontileka zocingo.Izingane zawo ezineminyaka engaphansi kwemibili zizondiza mahhala izikhawu ezingu-60, kuthi ezineminyaka emibili kuya kwengu-18 zingandiza kawu-12. Awakhokheli ukupaka ezikhumulweni zezindiza, izingane zawo zihanjiswa bhusende zisuka lapho ehlala khona eKapa ziya ezikoleni.
ASIKEZUKUBUYELA oLundi isiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal okwamanje. UNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, uthe udaba lokususwa kwesiShayamthetho eMgungundlovu, lusazoqale luxoxwe amaqembu aphethe ngokubambisana uhulumeni wesifundazwe.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba emva kokwethula ikhabhinethi lakhe eSilweni uMisuzulu kaZwelithini, oLundi, izolo.IsiShayamthetho sathutha oLundi ngesikhathi i-IFP iphuma emandleni KwaZulu-Natal.Kuyiwe okhethweni amaqembu ehlukene phakathi ngokubuyela kwesiShayamthetho oLundi.Amanye amaqembu okukhona kuwo i-IFP, abekhala ngokuthi uhulumeni umosha imali enkulu eqasha izakhiwo eMgungundlovu ekubeni kukhona isakhiwo esingasebenzi oLundi.Amanye amaqembu okukhona kuwo i-ANC abengafuni nokuyizwa eyokuthutha kwesiShayamthetho, ekhala ngokuthi kunezinhlelo zezigidi zamaRandi zokwakha isakhiwo sawo khona eMgungundlovu.Manje la maqembu asebusa ngokubambisana, kuzofanele axoxe ngalolu daba."Ngiyazi ukuthi sekuzokuba nemibuzo yokuthi ngabe ukuza kwethu lapha kusho ukuthi isiShayamthetho siyabuya. Angikusho ukuthi ukuza kwethu lapha akuhlangene nokubuya kwesiShayamthetho. Njengoba sasishilo nasekuqaleni, lolu daba kufanele luxoxwe. Akufanele silushalazele.”UNtuli uthe kubajabulisile ukuba esiShayamthetho esakhiwa umsunguli we-IFP, iNkosi Mangosuthu Buthelezi."UButhelezi wayengundunankulu kaZulu. Uyena owayehola uhulumeni waKwaZulu, wayehlala kulesi sihlalo engihlezi kuso namhlanje. Ukuza kwethu lapha kusho khona ukuthi asiwabukeli phansi amagalelo alabo abaphatha ngaphambi kwethu.”UNtuli uthe iSilo sibayalele ukuba babumbane.Uhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal uphethwe ngokubambisana amaqembu amane, i-IFP, ANC, DA neNFP."Umyalezo weSilo ushumayele ukuthula nobumbano. Umyalezo weSilo ukhuthaze ukuba sisebenze ngobuqotho. Ngingasho ukuthi iSilo sisamukele kahle."Bekubalulekile kithina ukuba sizozethula ngoba siyazi ukuthi lapha KwaZulu-Natal kubusa iSilo. Lapha besizokwethula izinhlelo zethu zokuthuthukisa abantu baKwaZulu-Natal."UNtuli uthe bazoxhumana nezinye izinhlaka zomphakathi."Lesi bekuyisiqalo nje, sisazoxhumana namakhosi, nezinhlangano ezilwela amalungelo abantu. Siyazi ukuthi kufanele sisebenzisane nezinye izinhlaka ukuze sizokwazi ukuthuthukisa iKwaZulu-Natal.”UNtuli uthe uhulumeni omusha usuqalile ukusebenza, wathi bazokuba nomhlangano wokuqala wekhabhinethi namhlanje."Ngiyawethemba la madoda nabesifazane engibaqokile. Abazange baze bapholise amaseko, baqala umsebenzi emva kokuthi ngibaqokile. Abazange basho ukuthi balinde mina ukuthi ngibatshele ukuthi yini okufanele bayenze.”
EZWENI lapho izinga lokungasebenzi kwentsha liphakathi kwamanani aphezulu kakhulu emhlabeni, osomabhizinisi abathathu abasebasha baguqula imiphakathi yabo futhi benza umehluko.Labosomabhizinisi abathathu bonke bayavumelana ngokuthi amabhizinisi adinga okungaphezu nje kwemali ukuze athuthuke; adinga isiqondiso, ukuqeqeshwa, kanye nomphakathi okholelwa emandleni abo.UFundisiwe Mbele, u-Achuma Somkhence, noSilindokuhle Mbatha abagcini nje ngokwakha amabhizinisi abo kodwa baphinde bahlahla indlela yekusasa eliqhakazile neliqinile njengabaqashi bakusasa.Uhambo lukaMbele kwezamabhizinisi lwazalwa ngenxa yesidingo lapho elahlekelwa umsebenzi ngesikhathi kubhebhetheka igciwane iKhorona (COVID-19).UMbele wasebenzisa amakhono akhe okwenza izinwele aba ibhizinisi eliphumelelayo.Waqale iDurban Kids’ Salon, isaluni engumahamba nendlwana eletha isitayela sezinwele ngqo emakhaya ezingane eThekwini namaphethelo.Umgomo wakhe ucacile: ukukhuthaza ukunakekelwa kwezinwele zemvelo nokunciphisa ukusetshenziswa kwamakhemikhali anokhahlo.Isevisi yesaluni yakhe ayigcini nje ngokusindisa isikhathi sabazali kodwa futhi inikeza ulwazi oluzolile ezinganeni.Uthi: "Ngangifuna ukwakha indawo lapho izingane zizizwa ziduduzekile futhi zinakekelwe.UMbele uncoma inqubekelaphambili yakhe ngokwesekwa akuthola ku-FNB Youth Start-up Accelerator emnikeze ukuqeqeshwa okubalulekile ekuphathweni kwezimali, ubuholi kanye nokumaketha.Izinhlelo ezifana nalezi zibalulekile kosomabhizinisi abasebasha, azinikezi nje uxhaso lwezimali kodwa nokuqeqeshwa okudingekayo ukuze kusimame futhi kuthuthukiswe ibhizinisi.Ngokwemibiko yakamuva, ama-70-80% amabhizinisi amancane ayahluleka phakathi neminyaka emihlanu yokuqala.Leli zinga eliphezulu lokuhluleka ligqame kakhulu phakathi kosomabhizinisi abasha ngenxa yezihibe zezimali, ukuqeqeshwa, namathuba ezimakethe (GEM Global Entrepreneurship Monitor) .UMbele unalesi seluleko kosomabhizinisi abasafufusa: "Uma kukhona kungasebenzi, zama okunye. Yiba umngane ngokuzithiba, ukungaguquguquki nokusebenza kanzima.”Achuma SomkhenceU-Achuma Somkhence, wasungula ibhizinisi lakhe, iSamgn Smoothies ukuze anikeze izakhamuzi zaseMlazi, eThekwini ezinye izindlela ezinempilo esikhundleni sokudla okusheshayo.USomkhence watshala imali yakhe abeyilondolozile kuma-blender nezinye izinto zokusebenza ekuqaleni kuka-2020, emva kwezinyanga ezimbili ibhizinisi lakhe labhekana nenqinamba ngesikhathi izwe lonke liba nama lockdown ngenxa yeKhovidi.Naphezu kwalezi zingqinamba, ukuzimisela kwakhe akuzange kuntengantenge.Usebenzise ukukhangisa kwamagama kanye nemicimbi ye-pop-up ukukhulisa ibhizinisi lakhe lapho isivuma imithetho yelockdown."Zonke izingqinamba ohlangabezana nazo, nozinqobayo zikwenza ukhule, ufunde futhi ngengomuntu,” usho kanje.USomkhence uthe ukuba nomeluleki yinto edingwa yibo bonke abanikazi bamabhizinisi; umuntu ohamba eduze kwabo, umuntu ongabakhomba endleleni efanele."Ngaphezu kwalokho, uma uqala ibhizinisi, akekho okufundisa ngezezimali. Ngifunde ukuthi ngingabiza kanjani imikhiqizo yami nokuphatha ukungena kwami ​​kwemali ngesisheshisi sentsha esine-FNB ne-Fetola. Kwakuyinguquko kimi futhi yangifundisa ukuphatha imali yami kangcono. Kungenze ngaba usomabhizinisi ongcono. Manje sengingakwazi ukugxila kwezinye izinto zebhizinisi lami.”Uthando lukaSilindokuhle Mbatha lokusimama kwemvelo luholele ekutheni asungule i-Bantu Solutions, inkampani elawula udoti wokudla eNewcastle.Esebenzisa indlela yeBokashi, uMbatha, 29, uguqula imfucumfucu yokudla ibe umquba obalulekile, okunqanda ukuthi kugcine sekugcwele izindawo zokulahla imfucuza."Umsebenzi wami wokuqala wawu sembonini yokugaywa kabusha kwatoti, ngaba nokuqonda kokubaluleka kokugaya udoti okwazi ukuthi uphinde uwusebenzise kabusha (recycling). Ngaba nentshisekelo yokwenza okuthile okunomthelela ofanayo. Ngakho ngaqala ibhizinisi lami,” kusho yena.UMbatha ubhekana nezingqinamba nsuku zonke njengoba ibhizinisi likhula, kuya kuba nzima ukuqoqa udoti wokudla usebenzisa izithuthi zomphakathi noma izimoto eziqashiwe. Unethemba lokuthi ngelinye ilanga uzothenga eyakhe imoto.Umbele naye ubalule ukuthi ezokuthutha nazo ziyakhathaza.Ngokuvamile kufanele aye kumakhasimende ngemva kwamahora futhi asebenzise amatekisi noma ashayele i-Uber. Lokhu kudla inzuzo yakhe futhi uyavuma ukuthi impilo izoba lula ngeveni lakhe."Uma ngizizwa ngicindezelekile ngikhuluma nomeluleki wami kwezamabhizinisi ongisizayo ukuhlela uhlelo lwami kanye nezithunywa. Ukuzethemba kwami ​​sekukhule kakhulu, sengiyakwazi ukwethula izethulo kanye nenethiwekhi kalula,” kusho uMbatha.Uthi uma uzimisele ngokuqala elakho ibhizinisi, qonda ukuthi ayikho into eyimpumelelo eyenzeka ngobusuku obubodwa kumele uqinise umsebenzi wakho ukuze uthole izithelo ezinhle."Uhambo lwezamabhizinisi luwumjaho wemarathoni, hhayi owokugijima. Gxila embonweni wakho, futhi izokuyisa ezikhathini ezinzima,” kusho uMbatha

Abanye abamangalelwa abezanga enkantolo ngezizathu ezehlukene.Enkantolo kuvele ukuthi omunye ummangalelwa uyoteta, kwathi omunye wabika ukuthi uvaleleke esiminyaminyeni sezimoto ekuseni nokuthe uma elandelelwa ngocingo wangabe esatholakala.Bakwabahlanu ijaji eligunyaze ukuthi baboshwe uma bengalubhadi enkantolo ngokuzayo.Abanye babamangalelwa bebegqoke izimpahla zeqembu lezepolitiki, uMkhonto weSizwe enkantolo. Ngaphakathi enkantolo bahlala bagcwala wonke amabhentshi.Izibhelu zaqala KwaZulu-Natal zenabela ezingxenyeni zaseGauteng. Zadlula nemiphefumulo yabantu abangu-350.
KUSHONE isiguli sesibili esihaqwe upokisi wezinkawu KwaZulu-Natal.UMnyango wezeMpilo kuleli, izolo, uthe owesilisa wesibili oshonile ngowesilisa oneminyaka engu-40 waseMnambithi, kanti ushonele ekhaya. Kuhlonzwe eseshonile ukuthi ubehaqekile ngoba ubengazange aye esikhungweni sezempilo.Isibalo sabantu abahaqwe ileli gciwane kuleli sesenyukele kubantu abangu-16, kubo bathathu abantu abashonile. Kwabashonile ababili abaKwaZulu-Natal, oyedwa owaseTembisa.Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMpilo, uMnuz Foster Mohale, uthe imiphumela yokuhlolwa kwalo wesilisa kuqinisekiswe ngeSonto.Uthe lo wesilisa ubenezimpawu ze-mpox okuwutwayi emzimbeni wonke. Izigameko ezimbili ezihlonzwe kamuva ziqinisekiswe eGauteng, isigameko sokuqala indoda eneminyaka engu-43 neneminyaka engu-29."Bobabili abahlonzwe kamuva abanawo umlando wokuphumela emazweni angaphandle kwaleli," kusho uMohale.Kwabangu-16 abahaqwe ileli gciwane, abayisishiyagalombili abaKwaZulu-Natal, abayisikhombisa baseGauteng, noyedwa owaseWestern Cape.
UVALO kubagibeli bamabhasi akwaMetro kubulawa omunye wabo egibela ibhasi elilibangise eSandton lisuka eFleurhof.Kuthiwa owesifazane oneminyaka elinganiselwa kweyo-o40 ubudala osebenza ebhange uhlaselwe umsolwa esitobhini ajwayele ukubibela kuso eFleurhof ngoLwesithathu ekuseni.UMnuz Kenny Kunene oyiphini likamengameli wePatriotic Alliance nekhansela kumasipala waseGoli uthi ngempela njengoba befike endaweni yesigameko bazizwele ngokwabo okwenzekile.Uthi lowesifazane uhlaselwe engena ebhasini kanti umsolwa usebngaphakathi wavulela ngesibhamu. Ukusoka akukhona okwabafana kuphela, amadoda amadala okuyiwona aseya ocansini asengasoka. Lokhu kushiwo uMnuz Phakamani Ndlovu wePhakamani Empowerment egqugquzela ukuthi abesilisa basoke. Uthe abafana abancane abaneminyaka engaphansi kuka-15 kuhle ukuthi basoke kodwa iqiniso ukuthi bona basuke bengakaqali ukuya ocansini. "Abesilisa esibadinga kakhulu abeneminyaka ephakathi kuka-15 kuya ku-29, okuyibona abasuke sebeqale ukuya ocansini, abasengcupheni yokuthola izifo zocansi kuzo okubalwa neHIV," kusho uNdlovu.Uthe abantu abakule minyaka bavamise ukuba nezaba zokuthi kungani bangayi kosoka. "Izaba ababa nazo ukuthi bayasebenza ngeke bakwazi ukulova emsebenzini, abanye bayafunda ngeke bakwazi ukulova esikoleni, kanti abanye babona sengathi amasonto ayisithupha okuyisikhathi esilindwayo ngaphambi kokuthi uye ocansini uma kade usokile side ngokungabekezeleki,” kusho uNdlovu. UDkt Khumbulani Moyo weRigth to Care, uthe ucwaningo olwenziwe yiHuman Sciences Research Council, i-Sixth SA National HIV Prevalence, Incidence, and Behavior Survey, olushicilelwe ngo-2022, luveze ukuthi ukuthi cishe u-50% wabesilisa baseNingizimu Afrika abaneminyaka engu-15 kuya ku-24, abasokwe ezikhungweni zezempilo."Sinxusa amadoda amadala ukuthi asoke. Ungasoka noma uneminyaka emingaki, ungabi sengcupheni okutheleleka nge-HIV," kusho uDkt Moyo.Lezi zinhlangano zithe okunye okuyinkolelo ukuthi ukusoka kwenziwa ebusika. UNdlovu uthe isilonda sipholiswa indlela umuntu asinakekela ngayo, akuhlangene nokuthi isiphi isikhathi sonyaka."Ukusoka kwenziwa nganoma iyisiphi isikhathi sonyaka bese uyasinakelela sizophola ngesikhathi esilinganayo nalesi esiphola ngaso nasebusika. Into eyenza ukuthi sikugqugquzele ukuthi abesilisa baye kosoka ngalesi sikhathi ukuthi abafundi basuke bevalile okubanikeza ithuba elihle lokuthi bayosoka," kusho yena.Uthe abanye abantu bathoba isilonda ngamanzi anosawoti, bagcobe uvaselina okuyikhona okubhibhisa isilonda.Uthe kule nyanga bakhuthaza kakhulu ukuthi kuphume abesilisa abaneminyaka ephakathi kuka-15 kuya-29.UDkt Moyo uthe: "Ubusika buyisikhathi esinabantu abaningi abasoka ngaso eNingizimu Afrika, amathimba ethu eGauteng, Free State, Eastern Cape, Western Cape, Limpopo, Mpumalanga, North West naKwaZulu-Natal asuke emi ngomumo ukuze asoke abesilisa mahhala."
UMENGAMELI, uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa, okungakacaci namanje ukuthi uzolimemezela nini iKhabhinethi, ukhuza umbango wezikhundla kumaqembu ayingxenye yohulumeni wokubambisana.Kukholaka ukuthi umbango wezikhundla yiwo omise ukumenyezelwa kweKhabhinethi.Uhulumeni wokubambisa wakhiwe amaqembu ayishumi.URamaphosa uthe amaqembu akufanele ajoyine uhulumeni wokubambisana ngoba nakhu ejahe izikhundla.Ukusho lokhu encwadini yakhe ayibhekise kubantu bakuleli."Akufanele sivumele umbango wezikhundla ukuba ubeke engcupheni ukusebenza kuhulumeni wokubambisana. Akufanele sibeke phambili umbango wezikhundla, kufanele sibeke phambili izidingo zabantu."URamaphosa uthe abantu bakuleli babheke lukhulu kuhulumeni wokubambisana."Abantu bakubeka kwacaca ngesikhathi bevota ukuthi bafuna sibeke eceleni ukwehlukana kwethu, sisebenze ndawonye. Ngoba maningi amaqembu avumelana ngokuthi kube nohulumeni wokubambisana, ngiyathemba ukuthi sizokwazi ukubeka eceleni ukwehlukana."URamaphosa ofungiswe ngeledlule, bekulindelwe ukuthi iKhabhinethi yakhe ayimemezele ngempelasonto.Umholi wePatriotic Alliance (PA), uMnuz Gayton Mckenzie, uphumele obala waveza ukuthi izingxoxo zibanjezelwe umbango wezikhundla.I-PA ingelinye lamaqembu ayingxenye yohulumeni wokubambisana.Le nhlangano yakubeka kwacaca ukuthi ifuna ukunikwa uMnyango wezaseKhaya nowamaPhoyisa.UMckenzie ubhale kwi-X, ukuthi basaqhubeka nokuphikisana ngokwabiwa kwezikhundla."Akufanele siqambe amanga, sonke njengoba singene kuhulumeni wokubambisana sifuna izikhundla. Alikho iqembu lezepolitiki elingazifuni izikhundla."USotswebhu weDA ePhalamende oyingxenye yezingxoxo, uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, uthe izingxoxo zokubusa ngokubambisana azilula, wacela abantu ukuthi babekezele."Ngonyaka owedlule, ePhalamende ngenze isiphakamiso sokuthi kululwe isikhathi esibekiwe sokuthi kuqokwe abaholi emva kokhetho, sibe izinsuku ezingu-30 esikhundleni sezinsuku ezingu-14. Lokhu ngangikwenza ngoba ngiyazi ukuthi izingxoxo zokubusa ngokubambisana azilula.”Umhlaziyi wezepolitiki, uMnuz Sandile Swana, uthe i-ANC neDA bahlulekile ukulungiselela kusenesikhathi izingxoxo zokubusa ngokubambisana.Ekhuluma nabeNewsroom Afrika, uSwana uthe la maqembu kufanele engabe kade aqala ukuzilungiselela ngoba kuyiwe okhethweni kubonakala ukuthi i-ANC angeke inqobe ngamalengiso. "Ngasekuqaleni konyaka bese kubona nengane encane ukuthi i-ANC izothola ngaphansi kuka-50%. I-ANC neDA bebekubona lokhu kodwa abazange bazilungiselele. Ingakho ke sekuthatha isikhathi eside.”Imibiko iveza ukuthi i-DA ifuna ukunikwa izikhundla eziyishumi kwiKhabhinethi kaRamaphosa.USwana uthe i-DA ayinalo ilungelo lokufuna inqwaba engaka yezikhundla.

okungaxoxwanga, kusukela kokwango-1994 kuze kube okwamanje mayelana nokwakha isisekelo sokusebenzisana.”UButhelezi wenqabile ukuphawula ngalolu daba, wathi intatheli ayinalo ilungelo lokumbuza ukuthi abazwana nokuthula, siyathokoza nxa abaholi sebehlalile phansi, babonisana. Kodwa ke ukuxoxa kwabo lapha ezingeni likahulumeni akusho ukuthi udaba seluphelile."Isihlalo satheleka ngehlazo ngaleliya langa, angeke sikubalekele lokho. Udaba kufanele luzophelela phambi kweSilo.”Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kukasihlalo wendlu yobuholi bomdabu KwaZulu-Natal, iNkosi Sifiso Shinga, ayizange iphumelele.Bekungekhona okokuqala uButhelezi ebonakala encokola noDuma.Ngeledlule, laba baholi babonakala bexoxa ngesikhathi kumenyezelwa ikhabhinethi yaKwaZulu-Natal.UButhelezi noDuma kulindeleke ukuthi babe khona uma uNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, eyokwethula ikhabhinethi lakhe eSilweni.UNtuli uzokwethula ikhabhinethi eSilweni, oNdini, namhlanje.
Belike lanukeka emikhubeni yokwebiwa kwemfuyo endaweni ikhansela le-IFP kuMasipala iNdumeni ngaphambi kokuthi lizithele kunoxhaka wamaphoyisa alibophe nezinkomo okusolwa ukuthi bezintshontshiwe. UMnuz Dumisani Xaba (52) waKwaSithole eDundee, uzobuyela ngesonto elizayo eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseDannhauser, naboshwe nabo ababanjwe ngamaphoyisa belayishe emotweni izinkomo zokwebiwa okukholakala ukuthi bezintshontshwe epulazini lomlimi ngeSonto.UXaba, oyikhansela le-IFP elihlala kulo mkhandlu ongaphansi koweSifunda Umzinyathi, noMnuz Kwazi Zungu bebevele enkantolo kanti bathweswe icala lokweba imfuyo. Imoto kaXaba, ebihudula inqola ebinezinkomo ezine, kuthiwa imiswe amaphoyisa emgwaqeni u-R33 phakathi kweDundee neKranskop ngeSonto ebusuku. Kuthe uma befakwa izinkwesheni ngokuthi baphumaphi futhi balibangisaphi bakhombisa ukunkwankwaza, zabe seziyabakhalela.Inkantolo ilihlehlisele uLwebili leli cala, lapho kulindeleke ukuthi bafake isicelo sebheyili. Kuthiwa ngesikhathi beboshwa, amaphoyisa acele ukunikezwa incwadi egunyaza ukulayishwa kwemfuyo kodwa bakhipha ebinemininingwane engacacile, okwenze amaphoyisa asola ukuthi kukhona okushaya amanzi.UXaba, okuvele ukuthi ubuye abe wuMfundisi ebandleni laseChibini, kuthiwa uphinde abe nguSihlalo we-IFP eNdumeni.USihlalo wenguyazana ye-IFP kulo masipala, uMnuz Xolani Msezane, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi bazwile ngokuboshwa kukaXaba."Siyakholelwa ekutheni umuntu umsulwa kuze kube inkantolo imthola enecala. Emva kokusabalala kwesithombe esinemoto edonsa inqola enezinkomo okuthiwa abanikazi baboshwe ngamaphoyisa, siyifanisile nekakhansela wethu, kwaphoqa ukuthi ngithinte uSomlomo sanikela esiteshini samaphoyisa eDundee, nebala sifike kunguye uXaba oboshiwe. "Udaba siludlulisele ebuholini obungenhla okuyibona obuzonquma. I-IFP imile emgomweni wawo yokungahambisani nanoma yiluphi uhlobo lobugebengu, ngakho sidedela umthetho ukuthi uphenye,” kusho uMsezane.Umthombo weSolezwe, okhona kule ndawo ongathandanga ukudalulwa, uveze ukuthi bezikhona izigameko zokuntshontshelana imfuyo endaweni, kanti leli khansela belinukeka kodwa liziphungele ngokuthi liyazondwa nokuthi yizimpi nje zomndeni."Esigamekweni nje sakamuva esenzeke ngoMeyi, kudutshulwe indodana yalo ikhansela okukholakala ukuthi kwakubangwa izinkomo zokwebiwa. Kwaphela izinsuku ezimbili, kwadutshulwa okukholakala ukuthi uyena owadayisa indodana yekhansela okusolwa ukuthi yisenzo sokuziphindiselela,” kusho umthombo.Kubuzwa uMsezane ngalolu daba, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi sikhona isigameko esinjalo esenzeka endaweni. Uveze ukuthi amahlebezi abehlanganisa ukufa kwendodana yekhansela nawokuziphindiselela, abe nomthelela ongemuhle ngisho nangesikhathi sekuvotwa njengoba bekukhona abebelibeka ngembaba bethi ngeke bayivotele i-IFP. Bethi ngeke bayivotele ngoba kubulawa abantu akholwa ukuthi kungenye yezimbangela zokuthi yehlelwe kakhulu ukwesekwa okhethweni kulesiya sigceme. Uthe uboshwa nje uXaba bekuwusuku abebize ngalo inguyazana ye-IFP ukuzobhunga ngemiphumela etholwe iqembu kule ndawo nendlela eya phambili, nakho-ke sekungasenzeki. Okhulumela amaphoyisa esifundeni Umzinyathi, uConstable Siyabonga Nkwanyana, uthe abasolwa babhekene namacala okuntshontshwa kwemfuyo.

Ngemuva kwalokho uSelani wathatha isando washaya a u-Avile ekhanda ephindelela waze wafa wase emngcwaba phezu kwezidumbu zalaba abanye ababili egcekeni. Ngo-Agasti 2020 uSelani wathatha indodana yakhe encane (14) wayiyisa enyangeni ngoba yayingaphilile. Ngesikhathi bekhona umfana watshela umelaphi ngezigameko zokubulala. Ngesikhathi umholi efika indodana yagonyuluka ngodaba kumholi owabe esebiza amaphoyisa."USelani nendodana baboshwa sebebuyela ekhaya.
