Ufuna ubulungiswa umndeni wakwaKhwela eNtambanana, eMpangeni, kulandela ukudutshulwa kubulawe ilungu lomndeni walo ngamadoda angaziwa agalela emzini wabo ebusuku ezibiza ngamaphoyisa.Isolezwe Ngempelasonto lixoxa nowomndeni, ongathandangwa ukudalulwa igama lakhe, uthe lesi sigameko senzeke ngentathakusa yangoMgqibelo odlule lapho okwathi abomndeni walo belele kwenye yezindlu ezisegcekeni, bavuswa wukungqongqoza ngesankahlu kwamadoda emnyango. Uthe la madoda angaziwa ukuthi angobani, nababekhona abanganakanga ukuthi ayemangaki ngoba kwakusebusuku kakhulu futhi kumnyama, afike angqongqoza emnyango wendlu kamfowabo azibiza ngamaphoyisa.Uthe umka mfowabo nezingane baqale baziba isikhashana, bedidwa yisankahlu sokungqongqoza emnyango okwathi ngokuzwa ukuthi abangqongqozayayo abazimisele ukuyeka futhi sebeshaya kabana nasemafasiteleni, bagcina bevulile."Kuthe sebevulile, laba balisa bangena ngaphakathi bashaya ingane yomfowethu nomkakhe base bebathatha baya nabo kwenye indlu bafike babafaka kuyona. Kuthe noma sebelapho baqhubeka nokubashaya ngesihluku namanye amalungu omndeni ayekuyona base bebahudulela emnyango,” kusho ilungu lomndeni.Liqhuba lithe ngokuzwa umsindo, inhloko yekhaya, uMnuz Phumlani Khwela, yaphumela emnyango ukuyokhuza umhlola kanti ayibuzanga elangeni - yazithela kwizimbila zithutha, ziholwa ngemhlophe phambili."Laba balisa bamkhombe ngesibhamu bathi akalale phansi. Kwathi esalele phansi kanjalo bavulela ngenhlamvu wadubuleka ekhanda, waphelela khona lapho kubuka wonke umuntu maqede bashaya bachitha bemshiya esefile,” usho kanje.Umufi Khwela (66) ufihlwe izolo kanti ushiye emhlabeni izingane eziyisithupha nabazukulu abayisishiyagalolunye.Liqhuba ilungu lomndeni, lithe okwenza bakhathazeke kakhulu ngalesi simo wukuthi isigameko esinjena asiqali ukwenzeka emndenini njengoba nango-2010 kwadutshulwa kwafa umzala walo ebulawa ngamaphoyisa mhla kubhoke izigameko zodlame endaweni. Lithi nalapho kwagcina bungenziwanga ubulungiswa."Kuyasikhathaza ukuthi siqothelwa amalungu omndeni ngabantu abazibiza ngamaphoyisa okufanele ngabe yibona abasivikelayo siwumphakathi. Kuyasikhathaza kakhulu lokhu futhi kumanje sizizwa singaphephile ngoba asazi ukuthi kuzokwenzekani olunye olubi kusukela manje,” kusho ilungu lomndeni.Kuthintwa okhulumela amaphoyisa esifundazweni, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa aseNtambanana aphenya icala lokubulala kulandela isigameko sokubulawa komlisa oneminyaka ewu-66 endaweni ebizwa ngokuthi kuseMthombeni."Imibiko esayithola ithi umsolwa wafika emzini kamgilwa wangqongqoza emnyango. Kwathi umgilwa evula umnyango, umsolwa wavulela ngenhlamvu amahlandla amaningi kuyena,” kusho uNetshiunda.
Lizoqala namhlanje, ngoLwesibili ukuqulwa eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini icala labesilisa abathathu baseThekwini, abasolwa ngokugasela kwiBnB eseGlenwood, babulala umnikizi wayo ngo-August 10, nyakenye.Laba besilisa abangoBernand Langa (31), Mdumiseni Ntuli (27) noManelisi Mtshali (29) bebevele kule nkantolo ngoMsombuluko.Kuvela ukuthi bahlasela uNksz Jackie Nedham bafika endaweni yakhe bangqongqoza bazenza abantu abazofuna indawo yokulala.Kuthiwa kwathi sebengaphakathi baqale ngokumshaya ngaphambi kokuba bambulale ngokumklinya ngaphambi kokumnquma imilenze, bamshiya kanjalo.Ngemuva kwalokho, kuthiwa bakhala bemuka nesamba semali esikhulu esingazange sidalulwe. USOLA isandla semfene umndeni womfanyana waseMkhazana, oLundi, onyamalale ngoLwesihlanu, kwagcina kutholwa isidumbu sakhe ethoyilethi lomgodi ngeSonto.Kuthiwa isidumbu sikaLisulenkosi Lamola (2) sitholwe yisihlobo ethoyilethi elingasasebenzi sekuphele izinsuku ezimbili ecingwa kulona (ithoyilethi) kanjalo nakwamanye omakhelwane.Elandisa ngesigameko umamkhulu wakhe, uNksz Nontobeko Lamula, uthe behlelwa umshophi nje, bekunomcimbi wokukhumbula umkhulu wakuleli khaya obuwenziwe ngoMgqibelo."ULisulenkosi ulahleka nje ubefike nonina ngoLwesihlanu, besuka kwesinye isigodi esiseduze, behambele umcimbi obuyizolo (esho ngoMgqibelo),” kusho uNksz Lamula.Uqhube wathi unina kamufi ubefike naye (umufi) ngabo-3 ntambama, waba matasa nomsebenzi wasekhaya, ngesikhathi uLisulenkosi ezidlalela ngaphandle.Uthe basola ukuthi umufi ulandele esinye isihlobo ebesiye komunye umuzi endaweni ukuyolanda okuthile.UMPHAKATHI uthutheleke endaweni yesigameko lapho okutholwe khona isidumbu sikaLisulenkosi "Asazi ukuthi kwenzekeni ngoba kuphele imizuzwana, unina waqaphela ukuthi akamboni, waphuma wambheka egcekeni, kwacaca ukuthi akekho,” kusho yena.Uqhube wathi bazitshele ukuthi isihlobo sizobuya naye kodwa sabuya sizihambela sodwa."Ilapho ke okuqalwe khona kwabhekwa kabanzi, sekucaca ukuthi ingane ilahlekile,” usho kanje.Uveze ukuthi ngesikhathi becinga, bebegxila kuwo amathoyilethi omgodi belekelelwa wumphakathi.Uthe emva kokubuya inqina kamabuyaze, babikele amaphoyisa.Uveze ukuthi ngoMgqibelo ngesikhathi beqhubeka nokucinga ukhona umuntu wendawo obatshele ukuthi uke wambona kancane uLisulenkosi ethi pheshe ngakwakhe, kodwa wangamnaka."Siyakholwa ukuthi ubebona yena ngempela ngoba uze washo nokuthi ubegqokeni. Okusixakayo ukuthi uma ebesehambe ibanga elingako, ubengeke esakwazi ukuzibuyela, ikakhulukazi ngoba leyo ndlela idlula ngasemhosheni,” kubeka uNksz Lamula.Uthe okubashiya nemibuzo ukuthi leli thoyilethi atholwe kulo umufi ilo leli ebebeqale kulo ukucinga, bangamthola.Echaza ngokutholakala kwakhe izolo, uthe isohlobo ebesithi siya ethoyilethi, esiqaphele ukuthi kukhona okusolisayo emgodini."Sibize umndeni ukuthi uzosibukisa, wazithela kuyo ingane ilele ibheke phezulu, isishonile,” kusho uNksz Lamula.Ubalule ukuthi indlela okwakheke ngayo indawo yokuhlala ethoyilethi, yikho okwenza bashaye amakhala."ULisulenkosi uyingane enomzimba, ubengeke aphoseke kuleya ndawo yokuhlala ethoyilethi ngoba incane. Ngokwethu, uphoswe umuntu,” kusho yena.Ikhansela lendawo, uMnuz Mpolompolo Khanyile, lithe umphakathi otheleke endaweni yesigameko izolo, usashaqekile."Sesiyekele konke ezandleni zamaphoyisa. Uphenyo lwawo kanjalo nokuhlolwa kwesidumbu okufanele kusiphendulele imibuzo yokuthi ishone ngokuphoseka ethoyilethi noma ibulewe yase iphoswa” kusho uKhanyile.USotswebhu weNFP eZululand, uMnuz Siphamandla Ntombela, uthe akwenziwe uphenyo olunzulu ukuze umndeni uthobeke amanxeba."Ukuze kwazeke ukuthi iphosekile noma iphosiwe. Sinxusa nomasipala ukuthi ulekelele ukuvala imigodi yamathoyilethi amadala ukugwema izigameko ezifana nalezi,” kusho uNtombela. UMHOLI wamaNazaretha eThembezinhle, Inkosi uPhinda Shembe - Ukukhanyakwelanga, usethathe isinqumo sokulidlulisela eNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo icala lokukhipha eBuhleni umholi wamaNazaretha, Inkosi Mduduzi Shembe - Unyazilwezulu.Lokhu kuza emuva kokuthi ngoLwesithathu iNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini iphinde yachitha isicelo sakhe sokugudluza Unyazilwezulu eBuhleni. Thina besifake isicelo sokuthi inkantolo ilugudluze esihlalweni eBuhleni ukuze kungene Ukukhanyakwelanga okunguyena mholi ofanele nowavunwa yinkantolo. Asazi ukuthi kungani ijaji liqala phansi ligxila odabeni esesadlula kulona futhi laphothulwa,” kusho uSibisi.Uthe sebexoxile nabameli babo ukuthi ngesonto elizayo bafaka amaphepha eNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo."Siyabona abanye bayajabula njengoba sichithwa yinkantolo ihlandla lesibili esicelweni esisodwa kodwa thina asithukile nakancane. Okunye kwakho nje ukuthi izintombi nto zizobe zihambise izintingo kuNyazilwezulu eNtanda, eMzinyathi. I-IFP ikhuza ukudonsisana phakathi kwamaqembu amakhulu ayingxenye yohulumeni wokubambisana osanda kwakhiwa.I-IFP ifuna ukuhlalisa phansi abaholi be-ANC nabeDA ukuze kuxazululwe izinkinga ezifufusayo kuhulumeni wobumbano owakhiwe amaqembu ayisikhombisa.I-ANC neDA bathola izihlalo eziningi okhethweni, njengoba i-ANC izihola phambili, ilandelwe iDA.Abaholi be-ANC nabeDA abavumelani ngokujoyina kwePA, iDA ikhala ngokuthi i-ANC ayizange ibonisane nabo ngaphambi kokuthi ivumele iPA ukuba ijoyine.Ngakolunye uhlangothi i-ANC ithi iDA ayinawo amandla okuvimba amanye amaqembu afuna ukujoyina uhulumeni wokubambisana. I-DA nePA bayinkukhu nempaka, iPA ibikhankasa ngokuthi ifuna ukugudluza iDA eWestern Cape.Okhulumela i-IFP, uMnuz Mkhuleko Hlengwa, uthe bafuna ukuthi kuqedwe ngokushesha ukungaboni ngaso linye."Umengameli we-IFP, uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa, usejuba ithimba ebelisimele ezingxoxweni zokubambisana, eliholwa iphini likamengameli inkosi Mzamo Buthelezi, ukuba lixoxe nabaholi bamaqembu. Sibona kunesidingo sokuthi kube nomhlangano, ukuze sixazulule izinkinga. Njengoba siyingxenye yohulumeni wobumbano, sizibophezele ekwenzeni isiqiniseko sokuthi sixazulula zonke izinkinga ukuze sizokwazi ukuyisa phambili izwe lethu,” kuchaza uHlengwa.Ukudonsisana phakathi kwabaholi be-ANC neDA sekwenze ukuthi kube khona ababona sengathi uhulumeni wobumbano uzohlakazeka.Kepha uHlengwa uthe lesi yisiwombe nje esidlulayo."Lezi ezinye nje zezinkinga eziyaye zibe khona uma ingane iqale ukukhasa. Uhulumeni wokusebenzisana wakhiwe amaqembu amaningi. Into ebalulekile ukuthi kuhlalwe phansi kuxoxwe uma kunokwahlukana kwemibono. Kufanele ekugcineni sikwazi ukukhuluma ngezwi elilodwa.”UHlengwa uthe bayazi ukuthi kule minyaka emihlanu abazobusa kuyo ngokubambisana kuzokuba nezinkinga ezinkulu ezizoqhamuka."Into nje ezobaluleka ukuthi sihlale sibonisana, sivumelana ngalokho okuzoyisa izwe phambili.”Amanye amaqembu ayingxenye yohulumeni wokubambisana iGood, nePAC. Izolo, lamaqembu ajoyinwe yiFF Plus.Umholi weFF Plus, uDkt Pieter Groenewald, uthe bajoyine uhulumeni wobumbano ngoba banesifiso sokwakha kabusha iNingizimu Afrika."Inkulumo eyethulwe umengameli (uCyril Ramaphosa) ngesikhathi egcotshwa ihambe emazwini esiwasho ngesikhathi sikhankasela ukhetho. Njengeqembu sizibophezele ekuletheni uzinzo ezweni.”

Kuyasijabulisa ukuthi uHlophe abe ingxenye yeMK. Sizimisele ukuhlanganisa bonke abafuna ukubona abantu abamnyama beya phambili."UNdhlela uthe uHlophe uzoqapha ngeso lokhozi ukusebenza kukahulumeni wobumbano oholwa i-ANC, DA namanye amaqembu amancane.UHlophe kulindeleke ukuthi afunge namanye amalungu eMK. Wonke amalungu eMK awazange aye ukuyofungiswa mhla kwakufungiswa amalungu ePhalamende.Lokhu ayekwenza ngoba ekhala ngemiphumela yokhetho, aze azama nokumisa umcimbi wokufungiswa kwamalungu ePhalamende, kepha inkantolo yabachitha.Emuva kokufungiswa kwamanye amalungu ePhalamende, iMK yamemezela ukuthi amalungu ayo azokuya kofungiswa. Akukacaci ukuthi azofungiswa nini amalungu eMK. IMK yathola izihlalo ezingu-58 ePhalamende.Ohlwini lwamalungu eMK aya ePhalamende kukhona indodakazi kaZuma, uNkk Duduzile Zuma-Sambudla, owayenguNgqongqoshe ngesikhathi kusaphethe uZuma, uMnuz Des van Rooyen, ikhansela lakumasipala waseThekwini, uMnuz Visvi Reddy, nobengunobhala jikelele weMK, uMnuz Sihle Ngubane.Uhlu lokuqala lwamalungu eMK aya ePhalamende lwalukade luholwa nguZuma, kepha wakhishwa emva kokuthi inkantolo inqume ukuthi akakulungele ukuba ilungu lePhalamende ngoba wagetshwa isikhathi esingaphezu konyaka ebhadla ejele.Igama likaZuma lalilandelwa elaloyo owabhalisa ngokusemthethweni iMK, uMnuz Jabulani Khumalo.UKhumalo ngeke afungiswe namanye amalungu eMK ngoba waxoshwa enhlanganweni. UKhumalo uzame wehluleka ukuphonsela inselelo ukuxoshwa kwakhe.

BASOBISHINI othisha besifazane ababili basesikoleni saseNanda, iMatabetulu Primary, ngenxa yezinsolo zokufihla udaba lokudlwengulwa komfundi wesifazane kaGrade 4 wakulesi sikole. Isolezwe lithole ngomthombo walo ongaphakathi kulesi sikole ukuthi uNkk Nonhlanhla Gumede noNksz Gugu Hlanguza bakhalelwe ngamasongo kaSigonyela emuva kokutholakala ukuthi bathula nodaba olungaka. Umthombo uhlebele leli phephandaba ukuthi umfundi (13), eligodliwe igama lakhe ukuvikela isithunzi sakhe, wabikela labo thisha ukuthi wadlwengulwa ngumlisa oyisihlobo sakhe futhi ogada kulesi sikole. Kuthiwa labo thisha kabazange basibika lesi sigameko kwiziphathimandla zesikole nasemaphoyiseni. Baqoma ukufela ngaphakathi okwebutho likaZulu. Okhulumela amaphoyisa aKwaZulu-Natal, uConstable Thenjiswa Ngcobo, ukuqinisekisile ukushaqwa ngamaphoyisa asesiteshini saseMtshebheni kukaNkk Gumede noNksz Hlanguza ngoLwesihlanu olwedlule."Amaphoyisa aseNanda abophe abesifazane ababili ngokwehluleka ukubika ngesehlakalo sokudlwengulwa kwengane. Kusolwa ukuthi intombazane eneminyaka ewu-13 yabikela othisha ukuthi inukubezwe wuninalume wayo kodwa othisha bangalubika lolu daba emaphoyiseni. Idokodo libe seludluliselwa ophikweni lwamaphoyisa aseNanda olulwa nodlame lomndeni, ukuvikelwa kwezingane nezigameko zokudlwengula ukuze luqhubeke nophenyo. Laba bantu besifazane baboshwe ngoJuni 14, 2024."UConstable Ngcobo uthe othisha bavele phambi kweNkantolo yeMantshi yaseNtuzuma ngoLwesithathu. "Icala lihlehliselwe u-Agasti 2, kulo nyaka," kuphetha uConstable Ngcobo.Ethintwa okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo kulesi sifundazwe, uMnuz Sihle Mlotshwa, uthe bayaleshwama lolu daba. Yize kunjalo kodwa uthe sebeyalele umqondisi wezeMfundo esiFundeni sasePinetown ukuba abaphenyele kabanzi. "Siphatheke kabi futhi kusidinile ukuzwa izindaba ezibuhlungu kangaka. Sinethemba lokuthi umthetho uzodlala indima yawo,” kuphetha uMlotshwa.Isolezwe libuye lahabula ukuthi nomalume wengane naye ukhalelwe ngozankosi kanye nabo othisha.
SIYANDA isibalo seziguli ezinezimpawu zomkhuhlane ezihlwahlwa njengezine-Pnuemonia eNingizimu AfrikaIsikhungo esibhekelele izifo ezithathelanayo, iNational Institute for Communicable Disease (NICD) embikweni waso wakamuva mayelana nokusabalala komkhuhlane, sithe uhlelo olubheka iPnuemonia kuleli, iPnuemonia Serveillance Programme, luveza ukuthi kusukela ngoMeyi 26, uhlobo lomkhuhlane oluhlasele kakhulu abantu oludala iPnuemonia, i-influenza A ebuye yaziwe nge-H1N1. Abesikhungo bathi le influenza isihaqe abantu abangu-90 kwabangu-116 abanalesi sifo esidalwe ngamanye amagciwane. Bathi kulandela i-influenza B/Victoria ngezigameko ezingu-23 eziholele ekutheni iziguli zihlaselwe yiPneumonia.Isikhungo sithi iziguli eziningi zihlaselwe zineSwine Flu zijwayele ukuba nezimpawu zomkhuhlane ezijwayelekile, okuhlanganisa umkhuhlane, ubuhlungu bomzimba, ukugodola, ukukhathala, umphimbo obuhlungu nekhanda elibuhlungu. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ezihaqwe yigciwane iRespiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) - enezimpawu ezicishe zifane nezeCovid-19 - ziba nenkinga yomgudu wokuphefumula, okuholela ekutheni zicinane esifubeni, kube nzima ukuthi ziphefumule kahle kwesinye isikhathi kube nomsindo esifubeni noma zikhwehlele kakhulu. I-NICD ithe iqhathanisa izibalo zabantu abalaliswa ezibhedlela nabaya ezibhedlela belashwe babuyele emakhaya, benezinkinga zokuphefumula. Izinga liyalingana nelanyakenye, ngokwezibalo abazithole ezibhedlela ezizimele nakodokotela. "Odokotela siyanxusa ukuthi uma iziguli zifika ziphethwe umkhuhlane zingakwazi ukuphefumula kahle bazihlolisise ukuthi zingenwe iliphi igciwane ngoba ukumkhuhlane obukeka ungenawo amandla ungaholela ekutheni umuntu agule kakhulu noma ashone, ikakhulukazi kubantu abasengcupheni," kusho iNICD esitatimendeni.Iqhube yathi abantu ethe basengcupheni ngabesifazane abakhulelwe abanesikhathi esingaphansi kwamasonto ayisithupha, abanezifo ezingamahlalakhona kuzo okubalwa iHIV, isifo sikashukela, izifo zamaphaphu, isifo sofuba, izifo zezinso, izifo zenhliziyo, abakhuluphele ngokweqile, abantu abadala abaneminyaka engaphezulu kuka-65 nezingane ezineminyaka engaphansi kwemibili.I-NICD ithe nakuba isizini yomkhuhlane isinesikhashana iqalile kusabalulekile ukuthi abantu bawugomele umkhuhlane ukuze bagweme ukugula kakhulu.
I-UNITED National Transport Union (Untu) isola inkampani yakuleli yezitimela, iPassenger Rail Agency South Africa (Prasa), ngokuzama ukudiliza abasebenzi isinyenyela. Lokhu kulandela ukuthi amalungu e-Untu ebikele inyunyana yawo ukuthi iPrasa inezithangami eziphoqa abasebenzi ukuba bavolontiyele ukushiya umsebenzi.I-Untu iveze ukuthi amalungu ayo, ayitshele ukuthi izikhulu zakwaPrasa zihambela izifundazwe ezehlukene bese zithi asebekhulile kufanele bathathe umhlalaphans kanti nalabo abaneminyaka eminingana besebenza kule nkampani kufanele bavolontiyele ukushiya.Esitatimendeni sabezindaba, iPhini likaNobhala we-Untu, uMnuz Dan Khumalo lithe bakhathazekile ngesinyathelo sePrasa ngoba akekho umsebenzi abafuna adilizwe kodwa bafuna izinkampani zikahulumeni zidale amathuba omsebenzi."Sikhathazekile ukuthi iPrasa ihlela ukudiliza abasebenzi isinyenyela njengoba ibabizela emakhoneni ingasitsheli thina esibamele. Sagcina izikhulu zisitshela ukuthi kwehlile ukusetshenziswa kwezitimela njengoba kudala abantu bebehamba ka-600 million ngezitimela kodwa manje sebehamba ka-15 million ngonyaka,” kuchaza uKhumalo.Uthe iPrasa yabatshela ukuthi izodinga uR7 billion kule minyaka ezayo ukubhekela izindleko zokusebenza kodwa ayizange ibalule ukuthi izodiliza abasebenzi."Sizocela umhlangano ophuthumayo nezikhulu zasePrasa ngoba asifuni abasebenzi badilizwe. Sifuna izinkampani zikahulumeni zidale umsebenzi. Asithandi nokuthi izinkampani zingawulandeli umthetho ngoba ukubeka kucace ukuthi yini okufanele yenziwe uma kuzodilizwa abasebenzi,” kuchaza uKhumalo.Imizamo yokuthola iPrasa ukuze iphawule ayiphumelelanga njengoba bengayiphendulanga i-email abathunyelelwe yona.
AMEHLO asethe njo kuMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, obhekwe ukuthi amemezele iKhabhinethi entsha, okulindeleke ukuthi ihlanganise amaqembu ahlukene.Le Khabhinethi kulindeleke ukuthi ayimemezele noma yinini njengoba ematasa exoxa nezinhlaka ezehlukene okubalwa namaqembu akuhulumeni wobumbano, amadlelandawonye ne-ANC mayelana nazobajuba kuhulumeni. Kuhlukene imibono ngale Khabhinethi njengoba kukhona abafuna kuncishiswe isibalo sayo, kuqedwe ngamaPhini oNgqongqoshe, abanye bafuna kwandiswe isibalo sabesifazane, kanti abanye bafuna kufakwe abantu abanamava. Kukhona nabayichithayo eyalo hulumeni njengoba abanye abaholi bamaqembu beqagela nokuthi ngeke kushaye ngisho uDisemba walo nyaka, usekhona lo mshado.Njengoba lingekho iqembu eladla umhlanganiso okhethweni, kwaphoqa i-ANC ukuthi inxenxe amanye amaqembu ukuthi kwakhiwe lo hulumeni wobumbano. Okwamanje amaqembu akha uhulumeni yiDA, IFP, Patriotic Alliance, ANC neGood. Amanye amaqembu aveze ukuthi asayicubungula eyokuba yingxenye kahulumeni angasayina noma yinini kuwona.Ngesikhathi efungiswa eziNdlini zoMbuso ePitoli kuleli sonto, uRamaphosa, uveze ukuthi usemi ngomumo ukusebenza nalo hulumeni.Uveze ukuthi bahlela ukwakha amathuba emisebenzi kulo hulumeni, balungise zonke izinkinga zezwe, wathembisa ukuthi uzosebenzisana nawo wonke amaqembu kulo hulumeni.Ubuyise ithemba kubantu, wathi kumele bawuthembe lo hulumeni ozinhloso zawo ukuthuthukisa izwe."Kulabo abaphakathi kuhulumeni wobumbano, abagangayo sizobakhipha. Akudlalwa la kuyasetshenzwa,” kusho uRamaphosa.USotswebhu we-ANC ePhalamende, uMnuz Mdumiseni Ntuli, ekhuluma nesiteshi sethelevishini iNewzroom Afrika izolo, uthe uRamaphosa uyazi ngezinselelo ezibhekene nezwe ngakho maduzane uzomemezela iKhabhinethi.UNtuli uthe uRamaphosa nguyena ozoba namandla okuqoka iKhabhinethi."Angakhetha noma amalungu amangaki eqenjini elithile, noma angakhethi muntu ngoba umgomo wohulumeni wobumbano ngukuthi nguyena onamandla okuqoka iKhabhinethi yakhe,” kusho uNtuli.Uthe akukho lapho kubhalwe khona ukuthi kumele akhethe amalungu amangaki emaqenjini asemshadweni.UNtuli ubuye wacacisa ukuthi i-ANC iyona ehola uhulumeni wobumbano."I-ANC iyona ehola lo hulumeni wobumbano njengoba kuyiyona eyanxenxa amanye amaqembu ukuthi abe yingxenye kahulumeni wobumbano. Akuyona i-DA eshaya amaphiko kuhulumeni wobumbano. Noma ingaphuma esivumelwaneni, ngeke uwe bhu uhulumeni,” kusho uNtuli.Ukusho lokhu kulandela isikhalazo se-DA sokuthi bekumele kuqale kukhulunywe nayo, ivume ngaphambi kokuba kwamukelwe i-PA kulo mshado.Uthe abadingi ukuthi baqale bakhulume neqembu elithile, bathole imvume yalo ngaphambi kokwamukela elinye iqembu kulo mshado.

Wathi kuleyo mali kukhona uR21 billion ongena ezimakethe zamaveji ezinkulu, noR32 billion ongena ezitolo zokudla ezinkulu.Udalule nokuthi izitolo ezinkulu ziyasebenzisana ekutheni zilawule intengo yamaveji nezithelo. Yikho okwenza kungabikhona ukuncintisana okuhle.URatshisisu uqhube wathi nezinkampani ezikhiqiza imbewu nezikhiqiza umanyolo nezinye izinsiza zolimo kufanele zehlise intengo yemikhiqizo ngoba ukubiza kwayo kukhiphela abalimi abancane ngaphandle.Ukhale ngokuthi umanyolo namanye amakhemikhali asetshenziswa kwezolimi alandwa phesheya. Uthe izitolo ezinkulu ziyasebenzisana ukulawula intengo yegilosa futhi azikho izitolo ezincane ezingena ezinxanxatheleni zezitolo ukuze kuzoba nokuncintisana okuhle.Uphakamise ukuthi izitolo kufanele zivulele abalimi abancane imakethe futhi zilungise nemithetho ebakhiphela ngaphandle abalimi abancane. I-SOUTH African National Taxi Council (Santaco) ikushayele ihlombe ukuphasiswa komthetho wezokuthutha, iNational Land Transportation Act ochitshiyelwe kabusha.UNkk Mmatshikhidi Rebecca Phala okhulumela iSantaco kuzwelonke, uthe umthetho uzoqinisekisa ukuthi abanikazi bezimoto ezikhokhelwa ngebanga ezilihambile bafaka izicelo zokusebenza njengawo wonke umuntu osebenza kwezokuthutha.Yize bejabula kodwa uNkk Phala uthe basamangele ukuthi kungani kuthathe isikhathi eside kangaka ukuthi uchitshiyelwe umthetho."Sekuphele iminyaka ewu-13 imboni yamatekisi ikhala ngokusebenza kwezimoto ezikhokhelwa ngebanga ezilihambile ezitholakala kuma-app. Lezi zimoto bezidla umsebenzi kodwa zingenazo izimvume zokusebenza. Izimoto bezisebenza emizileni yamatekisi anezimvume zibe zingenazo izimvumo, bekunobugebengu obuphazamisa abagibeli,” kuchaza uNkk Phala.Uthe ukufika kwezimoto ezikhokhelwa ngebanga ezilihambile ezitholakala kuma-app kudle inzuzo yabamatekisi kwavala nenqwaba yezinkampani zama-meter taxi."Kusiphatha kabi ukuthi uhulumeni uthathe isikhathi eside ukuvikela abantu baseNingizimu Afrika, ezinkampanini zangaphandle ebezisebenza ngaphandle kwezimvume. Siyathemba ukuthi uhulumeni uzosebenzisana nemboni yezokuthutha asize nezinkampani zakuleli ezithuthukisa ama-app ezokuthutha,” kusho uNkk Phala.Ngaphansi kwalo mthetho kulindeleke ukuthi abasebenza ngaphandle kwezimvume bahlawuliswe uR100 000.Ubuye unikeze izinhlaka zezokuthutha ezifundazweni amandla okuphuca nokumisa imvume yokusebenza yomuntu ongawulandeli umthetho. ISantaco ithe izokuqapha ngeso lokhozi ukusetshenziswa komthetho ngoba ifuna kuphephe abagibeli. Kube nokuncintisana okuhle kwabasebenza embonini yezokuthutha.
OWADUMA ngokuhaya izinkondlo ezigxeka uhulumeni wangesikhathi sobandlululo, uMzwakhe Mbuli, uphumele obala wagxeka ukusebenzisana kwe-ANC ne-DA ukubumba uhulumeni wobumbano.Ukungabikhona kweqembu elinqoba ukhetho ngoqekelele kuzwelonke, okungokokuqala emlandweni selokhu kwangenwa kuhulumeni wentando yeningi, kuholele ekutheni i-ANC ethole izihlalo eziningi ephalamende likazwelonke imemezele uhulumeni obunjwe ngamaqembu ahlukene, i-Government of National Unity, okusagqame kuwo i-ANC ne-DA.Engxoxweni neSolezwe, uMbuli uthe okwenziwe yi-ANC, ukuqoka ukusebenzisana ne-DA ishiya ngaphandle amaqembu avotelwe yiningi labantu abansundu, kuwukubukela phansi amaqhawe afela ukuthi kukhululwe leli zwe."Ngizokhuluma ngokungesabi ngoba vele nangesikhathi sobandlululo kunzima kodwa ngakhuluma ngigxeka uhulumeni wangaleso sikhathi. Okwenziwa yi-ANC, ukubumba uhulumeni ne-DA, wukwenza abantu iziwula. Uma i-ANC isiwuhulumeni ne-DA, isazoyikhuluma kanjani indaba yokubuyiswa komhlaba nomnotho ebantwini? Kungabe lokhu kusho ukuguquko kwezimiso zayo ezafelwa amaqhawe omzabalazo efela lomhlaba ezandleni ze-DA iseyi-National Party, okuyimanje umhlaba nomnotho usasezandleni zabamhlophe?" kubuza uMbuli.Kuqubuke umsindo enkundleni yezokuxhumana i-X emva kokusabalala kwezwi lakhe eliqoshiwe ehaya inkondlo egxeka lolu bumbano, abanye bethi akusilo izwi lakhe. UMbuli ukuqinisekisile ukuthi nguye kanye kanti inkondlo yakhe enesihloko esithi: I wish the dead could rise, ubalula kuyo amaqhawe amaningi athi afela ize njengoba konke ayekulwela kubukeka kucwila kuhulumeni we-ANC nowobumbano okuthiwa amaqembu avumelane ngawo emva kwemiphumela yokhetho lwangenyanga edlule.
KUSOLWA ukudembesela komphenyi 'ngokuduka' komunye wofakazi owukhiye ecaleni lokungqongqiswa kwabathathu okwenzeka ngoJanuwari 25, 2022, eNkanini, eCato Manor.Ngalobo busuku kwabulawa abesilisa abathathu okungoMnuz Phumlani Tshekele, Numkile Mfenqe noRefilwe Mokoena.Kuvela ukuthi babesolwa umphakathi ngokuwuhlalisa lubhojozi bedlwengula bedayisa izindlu zabantu ngo dli.Ngosuku lwesigameko kuvela ukuthi amalungu omphakathi abahlasela besendlini abathatha ayobokhela ngomillo bephakathi emotweni.Kwabe sekuboshwa abasolwa abayisithupha oMnuz Mmiseli Khondlo (41) odume ngelikaJomo, Vusimuzi Mazula ( 46), Thandekile Penelope Sithuntsa (37), Siphenathi Zoko (28) Mfanafuthi Muzi Masikane (37) noScelo Thusi (39).NgoLwesithathu eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini bekufakaza umphenyi elingeke lidalulwe igama lakhe ngenxa yezizathu ezithile.Ngesikhathi ephekwa ngemibuzo, ummeli wabasolwa uvumile ukuthi akamazi ukuthi washonaphi uMnuz Mlambo ongomunye wofakazi ochazwa yinkantolo njengobalulekile kuleli cala.Kuvela ukuthi uMlambo wayekhona ngesikhathi sesigamemko futhi kuningi akubona.Kodwa kuthiwa walimisa ngesihloko kwabasondelene nabo ukuthi akazimisele ngokuthi abe ngufakazi kuleli cala ngoba lokho kungabeka umndeni wakhe engcupheni.Kodwa isitatimende esifungelwe wasenza.Umphenyi uveze ukuthi lo fakazi wake wamthinta ngocingo emazisa ukuthi akasekho eNkanini useseGoli."Wangitshela ukuthi ukhethe ukuthi alishiye iTheku ngoba akazimisele ngokuthi abe ngufakazi kuleli cala. Wangitshela ukuthi useGoli kodwa wanqaba ukungitshela ukuthi kuphi nalo,'' usho kanje.Ummeli wabasolwa usole umphenyi ngokudembesela ukuthola ukuthi ukuphi nendawo ufakazi.Uziphendulele umphenyi wathi kunzima kakhulu ukuthi angagcwala lonke iGoli ekubeni lilikhulu kangaka ebheka umuntu oyedwa."Akulula njengoba ucabanga ukufuna umuntu ongamazi nokuthi ukuziphi izinkalo,'' uphendule kanjena.Uthe ikhona imizamo ayenza kodwa yabhuntsha. Uthe baze bacela nokuthi kungenele nophiko lweCrime Intelligence kodwa kwanhlanga zimuka nomoya.Umphenyi unxuse inkantolo ukuba isebenzise isitatimende esenziwa ufakazi ngaphambi kokuba agcwale izinkalo.IJaji uChetts lizwakalise ukukhathazeka kwalo ngokuduka kwalo fakazi lakubeka ngembaba ukuthi bekudingeka afike ezobethula ubufakazi ngento ayibona ngosuku lwesigameko..
Umndeni wamalungu amahlanu kasomatekisi ahlaselwe aqothwa evela emcimbini eZakheni, ngoMsombuluko, usuqinisekise ukuthi inhloko yomuzi yalo mndeni isesibhedlela emva kokudubuleka kulesi sigameko.Umthombo weSolezwe ubuveze ukuthi umgilwa ongusomatekisi ungomunye wamalungu omndeni ashonele endaweni yesigameko, kodwa uMnuz Skobho Thusi uveze ukuthi umfowabo usesibhedlela.Uqinisekise ukuthi abadlule emhlabeni kulesi sigameko yinkosikazi kamgilwa, uNkk Thulile Thusi obenguthisha KwaNgcende Primary nezingane zakhe ezintathu okukhona kuyo eyenza u-Grade 11 esikoleni iLimehill High."Kushone nezihlobo ezimbili zasemndenini wakithi oseNquthu. Okwamanje sisematasa ngodaba oluthinta amakhaza, ngicela ubuye ungithinte,” kusho uThusi.IKhansela uMnuz Mzuzwana Magasela elihambele umndeni ngenhloso yokuyobhonga emswaneni, lithe bewumasipala bazohlangana nomndeni namhlanje ukubheka ukuthi bangalekelela kuphi."Namhlanje (esho izolo), bengiye emndenini njengomngani nokuthi izingane ezimbili ezishone kulesi sigameko bengizifundisa esikoleni njengoba ngiwuthisha. Sizoya emndenini sesihambisana neMeya uMnuz Zama Sibi ukuyobhonga emswaneni, sibone ukuthi umndeni ungalekelelwa kuphi,” usho kanje.Kulimale abantu abahlanu kulesi sigameko, kanti okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uqinisekisile ukuthi abayisithupha abashonile ngabesifazane. Uthe amaphoyisa aphansi phezulu afuna abasolwa.UMphathiswa woMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka, udlulise amazwi enduduzo emndenini. Uthe banethemba lokuthi amaphoyisa azokwazi ukulandela umkhondo wababulali.
Kuzophoqeleka ukuthi amaqembu ajube abanye abaholi ezikhundleni zobumeya ezivuleke emuva kokushiya kwabanye ngesikhathi kubekwa uhulumeni omusha.Izwe libuya okhethweni lukazwelonke oludale ushintsho olukhulu ezweni. Kulezi zinsuku kumatasa kubekwa uhulumeni ozobusa iminyaka emihlanu.UMasipala waseZululand ophethwe yi-IFP, usale ungenayo imeya emuva kokwenyuka kukaMfundisi Thulasizwe Buthelezi waya kuhulumeni wesifundazwe. UButhelezi ubuyela njengokugiya eSishayamthetho ngoba wayekhona phambilini.UButhelezi obuye abe wuNdunankulu kaZulu, uqokelwe kwesoMphathiswa wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu. UButhelezi umenyezelwe wuNdunankulu omusha uMnuz Thami Ntuli, ngoLwesibili.UNtuli onguNdunankulu omusha umemezele abaphathiswa bakhe eqeda ukufungiswa eMgungundlovu ngoLwesibili emcimbini obukade ubhekwe ngabomvu.UNtuli naye ubeyimeya yaseKing Cetshwayo njengoba esekhuphukele ekuphatheni uhulumeni wesifundazwe. Nakhona eKing Cetshwayo eseRichards Bay, kuzophoqa ukuthi kuvalwe isikhala sakhe sobumeya.Okhulumela i-IFP uMnuz Mkhuleko Hlengwa, uthe bayazi ukuthi kunezikhala ezivulekile futhi akonakele lutho. Uthe akukho ukuphazamiseka kokusebenza okuzoba khona ngokwenyuka kwezimeya."Amaphini ezimeya azobamba ezikhundleni kuze kube kuqokwa izimeya zomasipala. Kunzima okwamanje ukusho ukuthi yinto yanini,’’ kusho uHlengwa.Ngaphandle kwezimeya ze-IFP kuphinde kwavuleka isikhala semeya yeTheku ngesikhathi kwesula uMnuz Mxolisi Kaunda yena osejutshwe ePhalamende.UKaunda wesule kungasazelele muntu emuva kokuthi kade kwasa evika izagila ngapha nangapha bezama ukumketula. UKaunda ehamba wathi i-ANC izowusingatha umsebenzi wokuqokwa kwemeya entsha maduze.Igama likaMnuz Cyril Xaba lilokhu livela njengokunguyena osikazwayo esikhundleni semeya yeTheku. UXaba akasabuyeli ePhalamende emuva kokhetho. UXaba uthathwa njengonesipiliyoni kakhulu ekusebenzeleni uhulumeni emazingeni ehlukene.
UMENGAMELI Cyril Ramaphosa usekhiphe isexwayiso esishubile kosopolitiki nalabo abazama ukudala uqhekeko nodungunyane ezweni ukuthi izophunza imizamo yabo. URamaphosa ophefumule kanje ngoLwesithathu ngesikhathi egcotshwa eziNdlini zoMbuso ePitoli, uthe akuphele ukujikijelana ngamazwi kosopolitiki nokungabaza imiphumela yokhetho ngoba abantu bakhulumile.Uphinde waxwayisa nalabo abazama ukuthi abantu bajikelane bodwa ukuthi nabo ngeke baphumelele. Uveze ukuthi izwe libumbene futhi ungumengameli kawonke wonke."Kumele siyichithe yonke imizamo yabahlela ukusikhipha endleleni esihlele ukuyihamba ngokuthi bafake ungabazane noma bafune sijikelane sodwa. Abafuna ukuma endleleni yethu ngokuthi bafake uqhekeko bagxeke nemiphumela yokhetho ngeke baphumelele,” kusho uRamaphosa.Noma engazange abadalule laba abazama ukudala uqhekeko nokungabaza imiphumela yokhetho kodwa kucacele noma ngubani ukuthi ubekhuluma ngeqembu uMkhonto weSizwe eliholwa owayengumengameli wezwe ne-ANC, uJacob Zuma.I-MK ingabaza imiphumela yokhetho kanti yaduba nokuya ePhalamende ngesikhathi kukhethwa uMengameli noSomlomo wePhalamende.Leli qembu lidube nokuhambela umcimbi wokugcotshwa kukaRamaphosa ihlandla lesibili. Liye naseNkantolo yezoKhetho lichitha imiphumela yokhetho.URamaphosa uthe abantu bakuleli bayakwazi abakufunayo."Ngiwumengameli wawonke wonke, hhayi idlanzana. Abantu bakhulumile, sibazwile, senza lokhu abakufunayo. Alikho iqembu eliwine ngamalengiso okhethweni, yingakho abavoti bethe asisebenzisane ukubumba uhulumeni,” usho kanje.Uveze ukuthi babumbe uhulumeni ohlanganisa amaqembu ahlukene."Sizoba nokhukhulelangoqo womhlangano ozohlanganisa zonke izinhlaka zomphakathi, amaqembu ahlukene ezepolitiki, abezenkolo ukuhlahla indlela ngekusasa lezwe. Kumele sisebenzisane ukulungisa izinselelo ezibhekene nezwe.” Uveze ukuthi bazosebenza nawo wonke amaqembu, ngeke bakhethe iphela emasini."Izandla zivuliwe zokuthi sisebenze nawo wonke umuntu. Siyabanxenxa nabangakasondeli ukuthi beze ukuze sisebenzisane ukuyisa izwe phambili,” kusho yena.Ubalule ukuthi abantu bakhathele yinkohlakalo, izinga eliphezulu lobugebengu, ukulawulwa koMbuso yidlanzana, ukwebiwa kwemali yomphakathi kanti bazibekile izinto abafuna ukuthi zilungiswe ngokushesha ezweni. "Akubekwe abantu bakuleli phambili. Akukhuliswe umnotho, kwakhiwe amathuba emisebenzi, abantu baphephe siphinde sisebenzele abantu. Mina ngizimisele ukusebenzela umphakathi.” Uthe abantu bakuleli bayemukele imiphumela yokhetho. URamaphosa ufungiswe yinhloko yamaJaji kuleli, iJaji uRaymond Zondo, phambi kwezinkumbi zezicukuthwane, kuhlanganisa nomengameli bakwamanye amazwe.

Sekuqubuke izinkinga emaqenjini ayingxenye kahulumeni wokubambisana kubangwa ukujoyina kwePA.I-DA isibhalele i-ANC ifuna ukwazi ukuthi iPA ivunyelwe kanjani ukuthi ijoyine uhulumeni wobumbano kungakhulunyiwe namanye amaqembu.Amaqembu asabela kuqala ikhwelo likahulumeni wobumbano owamenyezelwa i-ANC, iDA, IFP neGood.Ukujoyina kweDA ne-IFP uhulumeni wobumbano kwenza ukuthi kube lula ukuba uMengameli, uCyril Ramaphosa, abuyele esikhundleni ngesikhathi kunomhlangano wokukhetha umengameli.Ngesikhathi i-ANC ikhipha isimemo sikahulumeni wobumbano, yakubeka ngokusobala ukuthi izandla ziyohlezi zivuliwe kwamanye amaqembu afuna ukujoyina.Muva nje kuvele izindaba zokujoyina kwePA ebeke umbandela wokuthi ifuna ukunikezwa uMnyango wezaseKhaya noma uMnyango wezamaPhoyisa uma ijoyina.Usihlalo woMkhandlu weDA, uNkk Hellen Zille, uthe bafuna ukwazi ukuthi iPA ivunyelwe kanjani ukuthi ijoyine uhulumeni wobumbano kungakhulunyiwe nabo.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabakwaSABC."Isigaba 17 sesivumelwano sikahulumeni wobumbano sikubeka ngokusobala ukuthi nakuba umengameli enegunya lokuqoka ongqongqoshe, kufanele abonisane nabaholi bamaqembu ayingxenye kahulumeni wokubambisana."I-ANC kufanele yazi ukuthi ayikwazi ukuzithathela izinqumo, kufanele baxoxe nathi. Kufanele bengakhohlwa ukuthi abazange balunqobe ukhetho. I-ANC ayikwazi ukuvele nje izifakele noma ubani.”USotswebhu we-ANC ePhalamende, uMnuz Mdumiseni Ntuli, uthe izingxoxo ngohulumeni wobumbano azikaphothulwa, wathi lokho kusho ukuthi wonke amaqembu afuna ukujoyina asavumelekile."Asikwazi ukuvala umnyango ekubeni singakaqedi ukuqoka abazongena ezikhundleni ePhalamende.”USotswebhu weDA ePhalamende, uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, uthe impikiswano ngokujoyina kwePA ayisho ukuthi uzohlakazeka uhulumeni wobumbano."Singene kuhulumeni wobumbano sazi ukuthi ngeke sihlezi sivumelana ngakho konke.”IDA nePA abanabo ubudlelwano obuhle, ngesikhathi kukhankaselwa ukhetho iPA yayifuna ukuthi iDA ithole ngaphansi kuka-50% eWestern Cape.Unobhala wePA, uNksz Chinelle Stevens, uthe ngeke bavume ukuphathwa uNkk Zille."UNkk Zille kufanele azi ukuthi incwadi yokujoyina uhulumeni wobumbano sayisayina ngosuku olulodwa nabo, ngakho ke sasingekho isidingo sokuthi i-ANC ixoxe nabo. I-ANC ayikwazi ukutshelwa iDA ukuthi kufanele imeme maphi amaqembu kuhulumeni wokubambisana. Uma i-ANC ingavuma ukulawulwa iDA, lokho kungakha isithombe sokuthi uNkk Zille ubabambe lapho bebancane ngakhona.”Khonamanjalo, ayanda amaqembu ajoyina uhulumeni wobumbano.IPAC iyiqembu lakamumva elimemezele ukuthi lizokuba ingxenye kahulumeni wobumbano.Lokhu ikusho esitatimendeni esikhishwe emva komhlangano wesigungu esiphezulu.Unobhala jikelele wePAC, uMnuz Apa Pooe, uthe banqume ukujoyina uhulumeni wobumbano ukuze benze isiqiniseko sokuthi uhulumeni usebenza ngendlela.
I-IFP iyona ehlomule kakhulu ezinkethweni zokuchibiyela ebezithe chithi saka KwaZulu-Natal.Le nhlangano inqobe kumawadi ayisikhombisa abenezinketho zokuchibiyela ngoLwesithathu.I-IFP inqobe amawadi amathathu ebikade ingawaphethe eMzumbe, wonke la mawadi abekade ephethwe i-ANC ngaphambi kokhetho lokuchibiyela.I-IFP iphinde yanqoba iwadi ebikade iphethwe i-ANC kuMasipala waseMthonjaneni, yase ithatha nelikade liphethwe i-ABC kuMasipala waseMvoti.Kwenzeka lokhu nje, i-IFP isanda kuthola isikhundla sikandunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, yaphinde yathola nabaphathiswa abane kwikhabhinethi lesifundazwe.IPhini likaSihlalo we-IFP KwaZulu-Natal, iNkosi Ntandoyenkosi Shabalala, lithe imiphumela ikhombisa ukuthi abantu bakulesi sifundazwe bayahambisana nesinqumo se-IFP sokujoyina uhulumeni wobumbano.Amanye amaqembu ahlomulile okhethweni lokuchibiyela yiDA neMK.I-DA iwine iwadi ebeliphethwe yi-ANC eNewcastle, iMK nayo yawina iwadi ebeliphethwe i-ANC eMzumbe.I-ANC ikwaze ukugcina amawadi amathathu okhethweni lwangoLwesithathu.

I-MK ifuna kuchithwe ukuqokwa kukaNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli.Le nhlangano ifake amaphepha eNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu lapho ifuna khona ukuthi kuchithwe umhlangano okwaqokwa kuwo uNtuli.Kulo mhlangano owawungoLwesihlanu, kwaphinde kwaqokwa uSomlomo wesiShayamthetho sesifundazwe, uNksz Nontembeko Boyce, nePhini likaSomlomo, uNksz Mmabatho Tembe.IMK ikhala ngokuthi akuzange kulandelwe imigomo ngesikhathi kuhleli lo mhlangano.Ngesikhathi kuqhubeka umhlangano, abeMK baba nezikhalo eziningi okukhona kuzo ukuthi kukhona abantu abakhombisa abanye ukuthi bavote kanjani ngesikhathi kuvotwa ngokuyimfihlo.Baphinde bakhala nokungavunyelwa ukuyogada ngesikhathi kubalwa amavoti.Umgqugquzeli weMK KwaZulu-Natal, uDkt Kwazi Mbanjwa, uthe ibashiya nemibuzo eminingi eyokungavunyelwa kwesicelo sabo sokuba bayobuka ngesikhathi kubalwa amavoti."Yini kanti lena eyayenziwa ngesikhathi kubalwa amavoti ababengafuni ukuthi siyibone?"UMbanjwa uthe abakwamukeli ukuqokwa kukaNtuli neKhabhinethi alimemezele izolo.UMbanjwa uthe konke lokhu okumenyezelwe uNtuli kusazoshintsha uma sekuphume isinqumo ecaleni abalifakile.UMbanjwa uthe iMK okufanele iphathe uhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal ngoba iyona eyathola amavoti amaningi.IMK yayivota ne-EFF ngesikhathi kukhethwa undunankulu.Amalungu eMK abebhocobele ngesikhathi kuqhubeka umcimbi.Usihlalo we-EFF KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Mongezi Thwala, akazange abonakale emcimbini wayizolo.Amaqembu ayingxenye kahulumeni wokubambisana akwamukele ukuqokwa kweKhabhinethi elisha, athi awathuswa icala elifakwe iMK.USotswebhu we-IFP, uMnuz Blessed Gwala, uthe abaholi beMK bakhombisa ukungazimiseli ngomsebenzi."Asinaso isikhathi sokudlala thina. IMK ifike yathi ifuna ukuvotelwa, yajika lapho yathi ayisayi ePhalamende. Bathi noma befika lapha esiShayamthetho bafike bazibangela umsindo."UGwala uthe banelisekile ngabaholi abaqhamuka kwamanye amaqembu abaqokelwe ezikhundleni.UGwala ukushayele ihlombe ukufakwa koMnyango wezokuPhepha koMphakathi ngaphansi kwehhovisi likandunankulu."Udaba lokulwa nobugebengu lubalulekile, ludinga iso elibukhali. Iso likandunankulu Ilona elizokwazi ukubheka kahle lolu daba."Okhulumela i-IFP KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Mafika Mndebele, uthe akakungabazi ukuthi lizochithwa icala elifakwe iMK."Kahle hle iyihlaya le nto abayenzayo."UMndebele uthe bazibophezele ekusebenzisaneni kahle namaqembu ayingxenye kahulumeni wokubambisana.Uthe bafuna ukubona kuphuthunyiswa ukuhanjiswa kwezidingo ebantwini.Usihlalo weDA KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Dean Macpherson, uthe ukuqokwa kweKhabhinethi kukhombisa ngokusobala ukuthi uhulumeni wokubambisana ungakwazi ukusebenza."Siyisibonelo esihle lapha KwaZulu-Natal, sithemba ukuthi abaholi bakazwelonke nabo bazobukela kithi, benze into efanayo. Siyaziqhenya ngokuthi kube khona abaholi beDA abaqokiwe. Abaholi bethu abaqokiwe banesipiliyoni esiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal."UMacpherson uthe okubajubulisa kakhulu ukuthi bayishiye ngaphandle iMK ne-EFF ngesikhathi kwakhiwa uhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal.
Uhlanganise abantu abaqhamuka ezinhlakeni ezahlukene umcimbi wokugcotshwa kukaNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, obuseMgungundlovu, ngoLwesibili.ONkk Nonto Magwaza noNobuhle Mashaba Izicukuthwane eziqhamuka ezinhlakeni eyahlukene nabantu abajwayelekile beziphume ngobuningi bazo ukuzozibonela lo mcimbi ochazwe njengengqophamlando.Kuqale kwanesibhocobhoco ngaphambi komcimbi, izicukuthwane zibukeka zikhungathekile ngenxa yokungaqali ngesikhathi kwawo.Umcimbi uqale sekudlule isikhathi esingaphezu kwehora kwebesishiwo, ayikho incazelo enikeziwe.UMNTWANA uNkinobho Zulu noSandile Khomo Zonke izicukuthwane zike zakhishelwa ngaphandle, kwathiwa abezokuphepha basabheka ukuthi azikho yini iziqhumane etendeni.UNtuli ufike ehamba nomndeni wakhe, okukhona kuwo unkosikazi wakhe, uNkk Sindiswa MaSibisi Ntuli, ofike wahlala phambili.Kwizicukuthwane ebezihambele umcimbi bekukhona abaseNdlunkulu, phakathi kwabo bekukhona owayekhulumela iSilo, uMntwana uThulani kaGqikazi, kube khona noMntwana uNkinobho Zulu, ongomunye wababhekelele ukusebenza kwansuku zonke kwebutho likaZulu.O-NKSZ Siphume Sangweni, Nondumiso Chili noPhumla Ndlovu Umcimbi ubuhanjelwe amakhosi okukhona kuwo usihlalo wendlu yobuholi bomdabu KwaZulu-Natal, inkosi Sifiso Shinga, amakhosi aseKing Cetshwayo aphambili ekwesekeni iSilo uMisuzulu kaZwelithini, uThembinkosi Xulu noZenzo Zungu.Umndeni womsunguli we-IFP, inkosi Mangosuthu Buthelezi, nawo ubuphume ngezinkani uholwa iNkosi uNtuthukoyezwe Zuzifa Buthelezi.Umcimbi ubuhanjelwe owayengundunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Willies Mchunu nabaholi bezepolitiki abahlukene. Bekukhona izifundiswa, abaholi bamabandla, nosomabhizinisi.Abantu abajwayelekile nabo bathe angeke basale ngaphandle, bafika bezozibonela umcimbi ngaphandle kwenkundla.Amalungu e-IFP abecula, ekhuza iziqubulo esangweni obekungena kulo izicukuthwane. Athe ukujabulele ukuphinde abe nondunankulu KwaZulu-Natal.O-NKSZ Makhosi Butheleze no-Andile Mkhize Izithombe: Sibonelo Ngcobo/Independent Newspapers I-IFP yagcina ukuba nondunankulu KwaZulu-Natal ngaphambi kokhetho lwango-2004.Bekuyinjabulo yodwa phakathi kwabe IFP nabe-ANC ngesikhathi kuqhubeka umcimbi.Kubonakale usihlalo we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Siboniso Duma, encokola noNdunankulu kaZulu, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, owumholi we-IFP.UDuma noButhelezi baba nesiwombe esibi emcimbini wokukhumbula iSilo uDinuzulu kaCetshwayo, lapho khona uDuma aphuca uButhelezi umbhobho.
Kuhluka imibiko yodokotela ecaleni lababulawa bangqongiswa kwabathathu, ngoJanuwari 25, 2022, eNkanini, eCato Manor.Ngosuku lwesigameko kwasocongwa abesilisa abathathu okungoMnuz Phumlani Tshekele, Numkile Mfenqe noRefilwe Mokoena.Kuvela ukuthi babekade besolwa umphakathi ngokuwuhlalisa lubhojozi, bedlwengula bedayisa izindlu zabantu ngodli.Kuvela ukuthi amalungu omphakathi abahlasela besendlini abathatha ayobokhela ngomillo bephakathi emotweni.Kwabe sekuboshwa abasolwa oMnuz Mmiseli Khondlo (41) odume ngelikaJomo, Vusimuzi Mazula ( 46), Thandekile Penelope Sithuntsa (37), Siphenathi Zoko (28) Mfanafuthi Muzi Masikane (37) noScelo Thusi (39).NgoLwesibili, eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini, bekukade kufakaza uDkt Tsikwe Lesego owayehlola izidumbu. Uveze ukuthi esidunjini sokuqala asihlola wathola ukuthi umufi washa wangqongqa, wathola nokuthi intuthu yiyona eyaba yimbangela yokuthi agcine edlulile emhlabeni.Uthe wathola ukuthi entanyeni kamufi kwakubhajwe izinhlayiya okungaqondakali ukuthi ngezani.Ngakolunye uhlangothi, uDkt Naidoo naye owayehlola izidumbu zabafi uyakuphikisa lokhu, uthe kwakungezona izinhlayiya kodwa kwakuyigazi elase lomele ngaphakathi esidunjini sokuqala.Kuningi okunye okusembikweni wokuhlolwa kwezidumbu kaDkt Naidoo okuphikisana nombiko kaDkt Lesego."Kusho ukuthi naye yindlela ahlola wathola ngayo ukuthi leliya yigazi. Mina kodwa ngokwami ukuhlola ngathola ukuthi leziya kwakuyizinhlayiya ezithile,'' usho kanje.Ngokombiko kaDkt Naidoo, kubuye kuvele ukuthi ingxenye yephaphu kulesi sidumbu sokuqala sase sibovu okwakuwumphumela wokuthi isidumbu sakhe sasha sangqongqa.Nalokhu futhi uDkt Lesego uthi yena akazange akubone. UDkt Lesego uveze nokuthi yena wasihlola isisu sesidumbu sokuqala, kodwa uthi njengoba embikweni kaDkt Naidoo kungaveli lutho olumayelana nesisu, lokho kuveza ukuthi akazange asihlole isisu sesidumbu sokuqala.Ngokombiko kaNaidoo izidumbu zazimnyama, kodwa uLesego uthi kunjalo kodwa, hhayi kuzona zonke izingxenye zomzimba."Phela isidumbu sibamnyama sonke uma kuya ngokuthi sonke sishe yonke indawo,'' echaza.UMshushisi, uCalvin Sing ubesabe emphicaphice njalo ngemibuzo uDkt Lesego.IJaji uChetts belibonakala linokudideka uma lizwa okushiwo uDkt Lesego ekuqhathanisa nombiko kaNaidoo.
KUBOSHWE owokufika eziNdlini zoMbuso ePitoli wabekwa icala lokukhwabanisa nelokuba kuleli ngokungemthetho.Kuthiwa umsolwa ugqunywe ezitokisini emuva kokuthi eboshwe ngoMsombuluko.Kubikwa ukuthi amaphoyisa athole ukuthi umsolwa uzame ukusebenzisa umazisi womuntu osewashona ukuze anikezwe imvume yokuthamela umcimbi wokugcotshwa kukamengameli.Okhulumela amaphoyisa kuzwelonke, uBrigadier Athlenda Mathe, uthe akuwathathanga isikhathi esingakanani amaphoyisa athola ukuthi umsolwa "uthatha amashansi.”Ïsigameko senzeke ngoMsombuluko lapho bekulandwa khona izimvume zokuthamela lo mcimbi. Ube esekhalelwa amasongo kaSigonyela, kulindeleke avele enkantolo maduze,” kusho uSam.
Iseqhulwini eyokuhlonishwa koMthethosisekelo wezwe, eyokungacwasi ngokwebala nangokobulili, eyokugqugquzelwa koxolo nokubuyisana kanjalo neyozinzo kuhulumeni wasekhaya ezisekelweni ezilawula uhulumeni wobumbano, ohlanganisa amaqembu amahlanu kuleli. Ngaphansi kwalezi zisekelo, uMengameli wezwe uCyril Ramaphosa nguyena onamandla okuqoka iKhabhinethi yakhe. Uthe basebenza namaqembu ahlonipha uMthethosisekelo wezwe, angacwasi ngokobulili nangokobuhlanga kanjalo neminye imigomo ethuthukisa izwe.Amaqembu abambisene kuhulumeni anezihlalo ezingu-273 ePhalamende. Lokhu kusho ukuthi ano-68%.UMbalula uthe baphoqwe ngabavoti ukuthi basebenzisane namanye amaqembu njengoba lingekho iqembu elawina ngamalengiso okhethweni lukazwelonke nolwezifundazwe."Akuyona inkinga edalwe yi-ANC, kodwa abavoti abathi kumele sibambisane. Abantu abathi abafuni kube nohulumeni ophethwe yiqembu elilodwa, yingakho sinalo hulumeni,” kusho uMbalula.Njengoba abantu bengayi nxanye bengemanzi, baningi abangeneme ngalesi sivumelwano sikahulumeni wobumbano. Ngaphakathi kwi-ANC kukhona abangeneme kanjalo nakwamanye amaqembu. Nezinyunyana zabasebenzi azeneme ngalesi sinyathelo.Abanye bakhala ngokuthi imigomo ye-DA neye-ANC iyashayisana, ikakhulu ezintweni ezithinta ezemfundo, umhlaba nokuvikelwa kwamalungelo abasebenzi.Abanye bebefuna ukuthi kubambisane amaqembu 'abamnyama’ ne-ANC, okubalwa Umkhonto weSizwe, oholwa owayengumengameli wezwe uJacob Zuma, i-EFF, IFP namanye.I-ANC ike yakubalula ukuthi ayikwazanga ukusebenzisana ne-MK ngoba eminye yemibandela yayo bekuwukuchitha uMengameli Ramaphosa. UMbalula ukubalulile ukuthi ukusebenzisana kwabo namaqembu anemibono ehluke kakhulu kunekaKhongolose, akusho lutho ngoba ngeke baguquke babe yilawo maqembu."Ngeke sishintshe imigomo yethu ifane neye-DA, ngeke futhi isigwinye. Ne-DA ngeke ishintshe imigomo yayo ilandele eye-ANC njengoba sibambisene. Sibambisene ukuze siyise izwe phambili,” kusho uMbalula.Okunye okuseqhulwini emigomeni ngukuthi uma kukhona ukungavumelani kwamaqembu, kumele kusetshenziswe ezinye izindlela zokuzama isixazululo uma kunongqingetshe.Umhlaziyi wezepolitiki uSolwazi Ntsikelelo Breakfast, uthe okuhle manje ngukuthi sekunemigomo amaqembu asesebenzela phezu kwayo.Ekhuluma nesiteshi sethelevishini iNewzroom Afrika, uBreakfast uthe le migomo izokwazi ukunqanda abazonhlanhlatha."Kunento amaqembu azobe esebenzela phezu kwayo kunokuthi nje wonke umuntu adonse abheke le, nomunye abheke kwenye indawo.”

IPHINI likaMengameli wezwe, uMnuz Paul Mashatile, lithembise ukuthi sizoqhubeka nokufukula izitshudeni ezintulayo isikhwama esixhasa ngemali yokufunda ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme, iNational Students’ Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS).UMashatile uveze ukuthi ngeke siguqulwe lesi sikhwama senziwe enye into njengoba inhlangano emele imikhandlu yezitshudeni emanyuvesi, iSouth African Union of Students’ (SAUS), yanxusa uhulumeni othathe izintambo ukuthi ungasiguquli lesi sikhwama sigcine sesibolekisa ngemali yokufunda njengoba manje sikwenza kokubili - sibolekisa ngemali siphinde sihlinzeke ngemifundaze kwabantulayo. "Uhulumeni uyazazi izinselelo ezibhekene neNSFAS, ezenze izitshudeni eziningi zasala dengwane. Siyazilungisa lezi zinkinga ngoba lesi sikhwama sizoqhubeka nokufukula izitshudeni ezintulayo,” kusho uMashatile.Uphefumule kanje ngesikhathi kugujwa usuku lwentsha ePolokwane, eLimpopo, ngempelasonto.UMashatile usho lokhu nje kulandela ukukhathazeka ngohulumeni wobumbano ohlanganisa amaqembu ahlukene okuyi-ANC, DA, IFP, Patriotic Alliance neGood.Ukukhathazeka kwezitshudeni kuqubuke emva kokuba iDA ingelinye lamaqembu afuna siguqulwe lesi sikhwama sibolekise ngemali kunokukhipha imifundaze.ISAUS yaveza ukukhathazeka ngokuthi akumele sithintwe lesi sikhwama noma kuthiwa kungena ungqongqoshe welinye iqembu eMnyangweni weMfundo ePhakeme nokuQeqesha. UMashatile uphinde waveza ukuthi uhulumeni wobumbano uzogxila ezintweni ezithinta intsha kanjalo nokwakha amathuba emisebenzi."Siwuhulumeni sifuna ukubona abantu abasha bengena bethi shi kwezithinta umnotho. Sifuna banqume ngempilo yabo njengoba ungeke ukhule umnotho ngaphandle kokuqasha intsha.” Ubalule ukuthi ngaphansi kukamengameli omusha, uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa, izinselelo ezibhekene nentsha zizoqhubeka zibe seqhulwini lwezinto uhulumeni azozisukumela."Kule minyaka emihlanu ezayo uhulumeni uzogxila ekuhlinzekeni intsha ngamakhono. Zizoqhubeka izinhlelo zokwakha amathuba emisebenzi,” usho kanje. UMashatile udalule ukuthi ngeke izwe liye phambili ngaphandle kwentsha yakuleli okuyiyona eningi. Intsha ihlala ikhalaza ngokunqaba kwamathuba emisebenzi okuyisihlava esibhekene nelakuleli.NgokweStatistics SA, izinga lokungasebenzi kuleli limi ku-32.9% kanti elokungasebenzi kwentsha kuleli liphezulu kakhulu njengoba lingu-59.7%.
KULINDELEKE kukhethe ukhethu phakathi kweqembu uMkhonto Wesizwe ne-ANC okhethweni lokuchibiyela, emawadini angaphansi kukaMasipala uMzumbe, namhlanje ngoLwesithathu.Angu-12 amawadi anganamakhansela komasipala abahlukene KwaZulu-Natal, okuzobe kuvotwa kuwo owaseNewcastle, Umvoti nowaseMzumbe. Amehlo azobe ethe njo kowaMzumbe okunamawadi ayisithupha asale emva kokwesula ezikhundleni kwamakhansela ayisithupha e-ANC, abemiswe ngonyaka odlule. Abesolwa nokuvota namaqembu aphikisayo ukugudluza iMeya uMnuz Bongani Nyuswa owabuyela esikhundleni emva kokuthi inkantolo ikumisile ukukhishwa kwakhe.Lawa makhansela okunguMnuz Sibonelo Maphumulo owayewusomlomo kumasipala namakhansela emawadini ahlukene kulo masipala okunguMnuz Thulo Mkhungo, Mnuz Sibonakaliso Hadebe, Mnuz Bheki Ngema, Mnuz Mhlengi Luthuli, Mnuz Thuthukani Jeza, noMnuz Ayanda Duma okuthiwa bajoyine i-MK emva kokwesula kwabo, kanti bangenele ukhetho sebemele leli qembu.Unobhala we-ANC esifundeni iTolomane, uMnyayiza uMnuz Xolani Luthuli, uthe bakulungele ukuvikelwa ukulahleka kwalawa mawadi."Siyethemba ukuthi abantu bazosivotela. Siwenze wonke amalungiselelo alolu khetho lokuchibiyela,” usho kanje.UMnuz Vincent Mdunge okhulumela i-MK esifundazweni, uthe ukwesula kwamakhansela e-ANC ajoyine i-MK, kuyizinkomba zokuthi leli qembu liyakhula."Lolu khetho sizolunqoba vele. Miningi imikhandlu esesithole imibiko yokwesula kwamakhansela, edinwe yisinqumo se-ANC, kungeyona kuphela kuphela njengoba amalungu amanye amaqembu nawo awenelisekile ngokwenziwe amaqembu ngalo hulumeni osanda kubekwa,” kusho uMdunge.Lo masipala ophethwe yi-ANC unezihlalo eziwu-39, kanti i-ANC emva kokhetho lohulumeni basemakhaya ngo-2021, yathola izihlalo ezingu-21, i-IFP ezingu-14, ezimbili ze-EFF, bese kuthi iqembu i-APEMO ne-ATM banesihlalo ngasinye.Ngaphandle kwalolu khetho, u-ward 14 ngaphansi kukaMasipala i-Ray Nkonyeni ngaphansi kwaso lesi sifunda se-ANC, nayo isale ingenakhansela emva kokusula kukaMnuz Sabelo Malunga okukholakala ukuthi ujoyine i-MK. ULuthuli uthe basalindele ukuthi ikhomishini yokhetho i-IEC ikhiphe usuku lokhetho.
UZOGCOTSHWA bese enekela izwe umkhombandlela ngezinhlelo zikahulumeni wobumbano, uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, emcimbini okuzobe kusindwe ngobethole, ozoba sezindlini zoMbuso e-Union Building, ePitoli, namhlanje.URamaphosa uzogcotshwa yinhloko yamajaji, iJaji uRaymond Zondo, kulo mcimbi okulindeleke ukuthi uhanjelwe omengameli bamanye amazwe ase-Afrika, amalungu ePhalamende, abaholi bamaqembu ezepolitiki, izicukuthwane ezehlukene, abantu bakuleli kanjalo nondunankulu bezifundazwe.Abezokuphepha bami ngomumo ukubhekana nosikhwili phambana nobhoko, abazophula umthetho.UYAQHUBEKA umsebenzi wokuhlelela umcimbi wokugcoba uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ezindlini zoMbuso kusasa Isithombe:X/PresidencyUtshwala, izidakamizwa, izikhali eziyingozi, amabhodlela nama-kani akuvumelekile lapho kuzobe kubanjelwe khona umcimbi.Imigwaqo eseduzane nezindlu zoMbuso, izobe ivaliwe kungangeneki ngezimoto.Abantu abazothamela lo mcimbi bazobe behlinzekwe ngezokuthutha.UNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa, uMnuz Bheki Cele, uthe bahlale beyilungele imicimbi efuze le ukugada abaphula umthetho.AMASOSHA abeviliyela elungiselela umcimbi wokugcoba uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ezindlini zoMbuso kusasa Isithombe:X/PresidencyUCele obekhuluma esithangamini soNgqongqoshe bezokuphepha ezweni muva nje, uveze ukuthi akukho okuzokwenzeka uma sekugcotshwa umengameli ngoba naphambilini ziningi izinto obekusatshiswa ngazo ukuthi zizokwenzeka, kodwa ezigcine ngokungenzeki.Ubale eyangesikhathi kuzoba nokhetho, wathi kukhona ababethi kuzoba nodlame, nangesikhathi kumele kukhishwe imiphumela yokhetho, okwagcina ngokuthi kungenzeki lutho."Nangesikhathi kumele kuhlale iPhalamende okokuqala likhethe umengameli kanjalo nosomlomo, kwakunengebhe yokuthi kukhona okungase kwenzeke. Namanje akukho okuzokwenzeka, siyizingovolo siqaphe kwasani,” usho kanje uCele.Inkulumo kaRamaphosa ibhekwe ngabomvu njengoba kukhona uhulumeni ohlanganisa amaqembu ahlukene.Okwamanje mahlanu amaqembu ayingxenye kahulumeni, aholwa yi-ANC, kube ne-DA, IFP, Patriotic Alliance neGood.Izingxoxo zisaqhubeka namanye amaqembu mayelana nokwengeza amanye amaqembu kulo hulumeni.Ngemuva kokugcotshwa kukaRamaphosa, kulindeleke ukuthi amemezele iKhabhinethi yakhe ezobe ihlanganisa amaqembu ahlukene.Kule Khabhinethi kuthiwa iPhini likaRamaphosa uMnuz Paul Mashatile, maningi amathuba okuthi likhuze ibuya kulesi sikhundla.Amanye amaqembu wona kuthiwa azothola izikhundla zongqongqoshe namaphini oNgqongqoshe kanjalo nokwengamela amakomiti ahlukene ePhalamende.Minyaka yonke uma kuzomenyezelwa iKhabhinethi entsha, kuhlale kuhlatshwa ikhwelo lokuthi sehliswe isibalo songqongqoshe beKhabhinethi ngoba baningi kakhulu.Phambilini, i-DA ibihlale ikhala ngokuthi kuncishiswe isibalo seKhabhinethi ngoba kwengezwa izindleko ezingenasidingo. Nakulokhu ezinye izinhlangano ezehlukene okubalwa ne-ActionSA, ahlabe ikhwelo lokuthi kwehliswe isibalo seKhabhinethi.UNobhala Jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, utshele abezindaba ukuthi uRamaphosa uzokhetha iKhabhinethi yakhe ezobe ihlanganisa namalungu akwamanye amaqembu.UMbalula uveze ukuthi uma seziphothuliwe izingxoxo uRamaphosa uyomemezela iKhabhinethi yakhe.Uveze ukuthi izinto eziseqhulwini kuhulumeni yindaba yokuphucula umnotho, ukwakha amathuba emisebenzi, ukuvikela amalungelo abasebenzi, ukuvikela amalungelo abesifazane, ukuphucula ezemfundo, ukulwa nobugebengu nenkohlakalo kanjalo nendaba yokuvikela imigomo ethinta ubudlelwano namanye amazwe.URamaphosa uzohlonishwa ngumbutho wezokuvikela okubalwa ukuqhunyiswa kwezibhamu, ukuviliyela kwezindiza emoyeni.Kuzonandisa amaciko ahlukene okubalwa uSjava, Vicky Sampson, Makhadzi nabanye.
Kubukeka sengathi obengundunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Nomusa Dube-Ncube, uphuthwe wukuthamela ukufungiswa kothatha izintambo kuye uMnuz Thami Ntuli, eMgungundlovu, ngoLwesibili ngoba engekho ezweni.UDube-Ncube waqopha umlando eqokwa njengondunankulu wokuqala wesifazane ngo-2022, engena esikhaleni esashiywa nguSihle Zikalala.Indodakazi yakhe, uZama Dube, ifake ekhasini layo le-Instagram ngoMsombuluko ukuthi ibithweswa iziqu zobudokotela.Umbhalo kaZama Dube ekhasini lakhe le-InstagramIthe onina bayo ababili bahambe amahora angu-28 ukuzoyibona kwenzeka into eyaphrofethwa ngugogo wayo ongasekho eNyuvesi yaseCalifornia Los Angeles. Ezithombeni kubonakala uDube-Ncube futhi kune-video ethula nenkulumo.UZama uke waba ngumsakazi eziteshini zaseGoli okubalwa kuzo iYFM ne-702 ngaphambi kokuyoqhuba izifundo zakhe phesheya,Uthweswe iziqu zeDoctor of Philosophy: Film, Television and Digital Media.UZama ubonge bonke abamesekile wathi kuzothatha isikhathi ukukholwa.
IQEMBU uMkhonto weSizwe (MK), lithi lisayimunyunga indaba yokuthi lizowathaka kanjani amalungu ePhalamende, ukuze ibe nenqanawe yekhokhasi.I-MK isabukisisa eyohlu ngemuva kokugoba kophondo yazidela amathambo yathi amalungu ayo azoya ePhalamende, ayofungiswa maduze. I-MK ibifunga igomela ithi ayiyemukeli imiphumela yokhetho.Leli qembu belibize isithangami sabezindaba lapho belichaza khona ngezinhlelo zalo njengoba ukhetho seludlulile futhi sekubekwa uhulumeni omusha. Okhulumela iMK, uMnuz Nhlamulo Ndhlela, uthe lusadingidwa udaba lokuthi izomiswa kanjani ikhokhasi yabo. Uhlu lweMK lubukeka lugqishe ngamagama angaziwa kangako kwipolitiki.UNdhlela, obembiwa ukuthi akhulume, uthe bazomemezela konke ngesikhathi esifanele."Sishilo nje ukuthi siyaya ePhalamende, sinikeni ithuba silungise kahle sizomemezela. Sisayixoxa indaba yokuthi uhlu lwethu luzoma kanjani. Nizobona ngathi sesiyofunga ePhalamende bese nibona yonke into,’’ kuchiliza uNdlhela.Akafunanga ukuphuma nosuku abazoya ngalo ePhalamende.Uhlu lweMK seluke lwashintsha ngenxa yokuphuma kwabantu ababili, okunguMengameli wayo uJacob Zuma ,nowabhalisa iqembu uMnuz Jabulani Khumalo.UZuma wachithwa yinkantolo yathi ngeke akwazi ukuba yilungu lePhalamende ngoba walahlwa ngecala wagwetshwa, wayohlala ejele. UKhumalo uchithwe yiMK emuva kokuthi imxoshile yamkhipha ohlwini lwayo.UNdhlela udalule ukuthi bazoxoxa nangokuthi ngubani ozohola ikhokhasi yeqembu ePhalamende ukuze lifike kuzwakale. I-MK inezihlalo ezingu-58 ePhalamende ezithole iqala nokungenela ukhetho. Ithole izihlalo ezingu-37 eSishayamethetho KwaZulu-Natal, kanti amalungu ayo asefungisiwe.Nakuba i-MK iya ePhalamende kodwa isakhala ngemiphumela yokhetho futhi ithi izoqhubeka isebenzise izindlela zezomthetho ukuze ithole ubulungiswa.I-MK isiwafakile amaphepha eNkantolo yezoKhetho imangalela i-IEC, iyisola ngokungahambisi izinto kahle. Ummeli we-MK u-Advocate Dali Mpofu, uthe kungenzeka baye nasezinkantolo ezingaphandle kwezwe.Kwenzeka konke lokhu nje iPhalamende selihlalile ngaphandle kweMK lakhetha uSomlomo, iPhini likaSomlomo, noMengameli.
Izihlathi zizovakashela izindlebe kubashayeli bezimoto njengoba izibalo zeCentral Energy Fund (CEF) zamaphakathi nenyanga ziveza ukuthi intengo kaphethroli izokwehla ngoJulayi.Ngokwezibalo zeCEF kulindeleke ukuthi intengo yelitha likaphethroli i-ULP95 lehle ngoR1.10 bese ele-ULP93 yehle ngoR1.15. Intengo yamalitha kadilizili izokwehla ngo-55 cents bese elikapharafini yehle ngo-45 cents.Inhlangano eyenza ucwaningo ngezezimoto, i-Automobile Association (AA) ithe lezi zibalo zisengashintsha njengoba inyanga ingakapheli."Okwamanje ngeke sikuqinisekise ukuthi ilitha likaphethroli lizokwehla ngamalini ngoba izibalo zisengashintsha njengoba inyanga ingakapheli. Esingakuqinisekisa wukuthi ucwaningo lukhombisa ukuthi uphethroli uzokwehla ngoJulayi. Ucwaningo lwethu luveza ukuthi intengo ka-oyela iyehla emhlabeni jikelele kanti sibuye sibheke neRandi ukuthi lihweba ngamalini uma liqhathaniswa ne-Dollar laseMelika ngoba u-oyela ongahluziwe ulandwa ngaphandle,” kuchaza abe-AA esitatimendeni.Bathe uma iDollar laseMelika lehlelwe ngamandla lokho kusho ukuthi u-oyela ongahluziwe uzothengwa ngemali encane bese kuba nomthelela omuhle uma nowoyela ushibhile ngoba kuzuza abathengi bakaphethroli njengoba ugcina sewehla."Uma isimo singashintshi abashayeli bezimoto bazozuza ngoba ukwehla kukaphethroli kuzonciphisa umthwalo emahlombe abo. Phela impahla eningi ithwalwa ngamaloli ngakho uma kunoshintsho kwintengo kadizili nophethroli lokho kwehlisa izindleko kubantu bakuleli,” kusho abe-AA.Uhulumeni uyimemezela ngesonto lokuqala intengo kaphethroli bese abantu bebona ushintsho eziteshini zikaphethroli ngoJulayi 3.
AMAPHOYISA aKwaZulu-Natal asezinike amahora angu-72 ukuthungatha abasolwa ngokuqotha abantu abayisithupha kwalimala abane Entshele, Ezakheni, eMnambithi, ngoMsombuluko ebusuku.Ngokwesitatimende samaphoyisa, abantu abangu-12 bebehamba ngeveni emgwaqweni uHelpmekaar, ngesikhathi kuqhamuka enye imoto abebekuyo bavulela ngenhlamvu bebhekise kubo.Abesifazane abayisithupha; oneminyaka ewu-37, ababili abana-17, ona-15, oneminyaka emihlanu nonemibili baphelele endaweni yesigameko.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe abesilisa ababili nabesifazane abathathu baphuthunyiswe esibhedlela ngemuva kokulimala. Owesifazane oneminyaka ewu-21 uphunyuke engenamyocu.Uthe imbangela yalokhu ayikaziwa, wanxusa abanolwazi ngabasolwa ukuthi babikele amaphoyisa aseduze noma bashayele u-08600 10111.
KUKHALWA ngokubhenywa mawala kwesidakamizwa iwunga okuthiwa kudla lubi ehostela KwaMashu, okuholela ezigamekweni ezishaqisayo zobugebengu nokubulawa kwabantu, osekuhlalise lubhojozi amalungu omphakathi kule ndawo. Ngokusho komthombo weSolezwe osondelene nesiteshi samaphoyisa KwaMashu, bayisithupha abantu abatholwe bebulewe ezinsukwini ezehlukene. Ukweqiwa kwezidumbu ngabantu abasuke beya noma bebuya ematohweni ekuseni nantambama kuleli hostela, kuthiwa sekuyinsakavukela kumalungu omphakathi ahlala ehostela okusolwa kakhulu izenzo zobugebengu ezibhebhethikiswa ukusetshenziswa kwalesi sidakamizwa nezinye okuthiwa zithengiswa ubuthaphuthaphu kuleli hostela.UMnuz Sandile Gwala oyikhansela kule ndawo engxoxweni neSolezwe, uthe isonto nesonto, kutholakala okungenani abantu abathathu kuya phezulu abasuke bebulewe akholwa ukuthi yizenzo zobugebengu ngenxa yezidakamizwa ezidlangile."Ukubulawa kwabantu kuleli hostela yinto nje ejwayelekile eyenzeka masonto onke, ukuthi inyathelwa ngezinyawo ngoba abantu abadayisa izidakamizwa bayasatshwa futhi basebenzisana nezikhulu zamaphoyisa ezisatshwayo esifundazweni. Phambilini, ngesikhathi kunomhlangano wokuzama ukuthola isixazululo, ngikuvezile ukuthi sicela okungenani kungenele amaphoyisa kazwelonke ukulwa nalesi sihlava, kodwa sengathi umbono wami awamukelekanga,” usho kanjeUthe kunalokho kwavela umbono wokuthi akuqale kuhlangane amakhosi, njengoba abantu abahlala ehostela iningi labo livela ezindaweni zamakhosi ezehlukene. Uthe akulula ukuhlanganisa amakhosi, ngeke abamelele bonke abantu kwazise bavela ezindaweni eziningi ezehlukene.Ngonyaka odlule ngo-Agasti, umholi wamaNazaretha aseBuhleni uvakashele kuleli hostela ngenhloso yokuhambisa umkhuleko wokulwa nesihlava sokubulawa kwabantu. UGwala uthe nakuba ukuhlanganiswa kwamakhosi nomkhuleko woNyazi engakufeli ngamathe, kodwa ukholwa ukuthi kumele kuqale kungenele amaphoyisa ajutshwe esuka ezingeni likazwelonke ukubamba izephulamthetho bese kugcinwa ngomkhuleko ukuqinisekisa ukuthi isihlava asibuye siqale phansi njengoba kwenzeka.UMnuz Mthembeni Thusi wenhlangano Ubumbano Lwamahostela, uthe izigameko zokubulawa kwabantu nobugebengu emahostela, zidalwa ukuntuleka kwamathuba omsebenzi."Siyathemba ukuthi uhulumeni ongenile uzokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi okungenani kule minyaka emihlanu uyalehlisa izinga labantu abangasebenzi. Lokhu kungaletha isixazululo, ngoba ukufa kwabantu kuyinto esikhathazayo sonke, ebuhlungu kakhulu,” kusho uThusi.Kwesinye sezigameko zakamuva zokubulawa kwabantu kule ndawo esenzeke ngesonto eledlule, kutholwe izidumbu zabesilisa ezimbili zidindilizile ngasenkundleni yezemidlalo, Isulabasha kuyo le ndawo. UGwala (ikhansela) uthe waziswe ukuthi bebekade bevakashele abathile ababaziyo abahlala ehostela, kanti uthole ukuthi omunye wabo udabuka eMbumbulu.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa KwaMashu aphenya amacala okubulala, emva kokutholakala kgwezidumbu ezimbili zabesilisa zinamanxeba okudutshulwa emgwaqweni uDumisani Makhaye.
Kuqopheke umlando ngesikhathi uNdunankulu omusha waKwaZulu-Natal, uThami Ntuli, ememezela ungqongqoshe wokuqala owaziwa ngokuthandana nobulili obufana nobakhe.UNtuli umemezele ilungu leDA, uMartin Meyer njengoNgqongqoshe weMisebenzi yoMphakathi neNgqalasizinda.Ukuqokwa kwakhe kwenzeke ngenyanga okuqwashiswa ngayo ngazo zonke ezithinta abathandana nobulili obufana nobabo uJuni nebizwa ngePride Month.UNGQONGQOSHE omusha weMisebenzi yoMphakathi uMartin Meyer nePhini likaSomlomo waKwaZulu-Natal uMmabatho Tembe Isithombe: DAUMeyer, oke waba yikhansela eThekwini, uyaziwa nangokuba yisishoshovu samalungelo abathandana nobulili obufana nobabo.Owayengumholi wentsha yeDA, uMbali Ntuli ubhale ekhasini lakhe leTwitter ukuthi ucabanga ukuthi uMeyer ungqongqoshe wokuqala othandana nobulili obufana nobakhe eKZN."Ube yiqhawe elihle lamalungelo eLGBTI esifundazweni futhi ngiyathemba ukuthi noma ngabe ubani othandana nabantu banoma ngabe yibuphi ubulili obekhathazekile ukuthi banendawo yini kwezombusazwe ezweni uyabona ukuthi banayo," kubhala uNtuli.Uthe ukumemeleka kubalulekile kubantu abebeshiywe ngaphandle futhi becindezelekile ikakhulukazi kulo mkhakha nakulesi sifundazwe.
Inkantolo yeMantshi yasePinetown ibeke usuku okulindeleke ukuthi kuqalwe ngalo kuqulwe icala lokubulala elithweswe isosha lomMbutho wezempi kuleli elisolwa ngokubulala umkalo.IMantshi uWendolyn Robinson ibeke uJulayi 23 nonyaka, eNkantolo yesiFunda yasePinetown ukuba kulalelwe icala elithweswe uMnuz Lwanda Zungu.Usolwa ngokudubula abulale inkosikazi yakhe, uNkk Tania Msani-Zungu ngoJanuwari 3 nonyaka kubuka izingane zabo.UMbuso uthe ihhovisi lomqondisi wophiko lwezokushushisa lithathe isinqumo sokuthi lingayi enkantolo enkulu leli cala kodwa lilalelwe kweyasePinetwon.Umshushisi uNksz Nomcebo Xulu akazishongo izizathu eziholele kulesi sinqumo sabaphathi bakhe kodwa uthe uMbuso usubuqoqile ubufakazi ngecala, umi ngomumo.Njengenjwayelo uZungu, oqatha ngomzimba, ungene enkantolo eshesha egqoke isikibha esinemikhono emide esinemibhalo, ibhulukwe eliluhlaza namateku.Bathe bebeka isinqe emabhentshini abantu abebezothamela icala, wabe eseyophuma ngomnyango uZungu ebuyela ezitokisini icala selihlehlisiwe.Laba bantu, iningi ebelikade lizokweseka umndeni kamufi, baze basizwa utolika obe esebakhanyisela ngobekushiwo imantshi kwazise akuthathanga sikhathi esingakanani icala lahlehliswa.
UNGQONGQOSHE wezaMahlathi, ukuDoba nezeMvelo, uNkk Barbara Creecy, uxwayise ngobungozi izwe elingazithola libhekene nabo uma ungasetshenziswa ngokucophelela umhlaba.Ukusho lokhu izolo njengoba umhlaba jikelele ubukade ubungaza uJuni 17 njengosuku olwaziwa ngokuthi iDrought and Desertification Day.Isiqubulo sakulo nyaka besithi: "United for Land: Our Legacy. Our Future.”Lapha bekuqhakanjiswa ukubuyisela umhlaba esimeni sawo, kuncishiswe ukusetshenziswa kwawo ngendlela engenza ungabe usaba nempilo futhi kuliwe nesomiso.UNkk Creecy uxwayise ngokuthi indlela okusingethwe ngayo umhlaba wezwe ibeka engcupheni ezempilo nokukhiqiza."Ukwanda kwesibalo sabantu, okuhambisana nokukhiqiza nokusetshenziswa komhlaba okungajwayelekile, kufaka ingcindezi ekukhiqizweni kwamagugu ambiwa phansi. Lokhu kwenza umhlaba usetshenzwe ngendlela engajwayelekile,” kusho uNkk Creecy.Uqhube wathi isimo somhlaba wezwe sithinta wonke umuntu ngakho ukunakekelwa kwawo kumele kube wumsebenzi wawo wonke umuntu.Ukhuthaze abantu nabamahlelo ehlukene ezweni ukuthi beseke imizamo nezinhlelo okuhloswe ngazo ukuvikela nokubuyisela umhlaba esimweni sawo."Inhlalonhle nempilo yomphakathi, ikakhulukazi emakhaya, kuncike kakhulu ekusetshenzweni komhlaba. Umhlabathi ubalulekile ukuthi kukhiqizwe ukudla, kukhiqizwe ugesi, amanzi okuyizinto ezibalulekile ekuphileni kwabantu. Ngakho ukusebenzisa budlabha umhlaba kuphazamisa indlela yokuphila,” kusho ungqongqoshe.Uveze ukuthi uma babantu besebenzisa umhlaba ngendlela eyamukelekile, lokho kuzobenza bakwazi ukubhekana nesimo sokuguquka kwesimo sezulu ikakhulukazi ezindaweni okubhoke khona isomiso.Ubalule nokuthi umhlaba ubalulekile ekukhulisweni komnotho ngezolimo, amahlathi namagugu ambiwayo ukuze kukhiqizwe ukudla nezinye izimpahla."Ngakho kubalulekile ukongiwa komhlaba futhi kulandelwe imigomo eyiyo yezolimo,” kusho ungqongqoshe.
UNdunankulu omusha waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, umemezele ikhabhinethi yakhe entsha ngoLwesibili ekuseni.UNtuli, obeyiMeya kaMasipala iKing Cetshwayo, umemezele ikhabhinethi ngemuva kokufungiswa yiJaji uThoba Poyo-Dlwathi, ezinkundleni zemidlalo iWoodburn, eMgungundlovu.Kwikhabhinethi yakhe ufake nabavela kwamanye amaqembu njengoba isifundazwe sibuswa wuhulumeni wokubambisana ngemuva kokuthi kungabanga khona qembu elinqobe uqekelele.Amaqembu i-IFP, DA neNFP asayine isivumelwano sokusebenzisana.UNtuli ubabe kanje ongqongqoshe:UMnyango wezokuThuthukiswa koMnotho - Mfundisi Musa ZondiUMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana kanye neziNdaba zoMdabu - Mfundisi Thulasizwe ButheleziUMnyango weMisebenzi yoMphakathi - Mnuz Martin MeyerUMnyango wezeZimali - Mnuz Francois RodgersUMnyango wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi - Nksz Mbali ShingaUMnyango wezokuThutha - Mnuz Siboniso DumaUMnyango wezeMfundo - Mnuz Sipho HlomukaUMnyango wezoLimo - Nkk Thembeni Madlopha-MthethwaUMnyango wezeMpilo - Nksz Nomagugu SimelaneUMnyango wezemiDlalo, ubuCiko namaSiko - Mnuz Mntomuhle Khawula
Ihhovisi likaNdunankulu waseKZN lithi nakanjani liyoshona elanamuhla esegcotshiwe ngokuphelele ozohola uhulumeni wesifundazwe.Okhulumela uhulumeni wesifundazwe, uMnuz Bongi Gwala, uthe konke sekumi ngomumo, sebephothule wonke amalungiselelo. UGwala ubekhuluma ephuma emhlanganweni nabezokuphepha. Kulindelekele ukuthi uMnuz Thami Ntuli agcotshwe njengoNdunankulu wesifundazwe emcimbini ozoba senkundleni iWoodburn, eMgungundlovu."Konke sekumi ngomumo sikhona nje la endaweni yomcimbi ingqalasizinda ikhona, abezokuphepha bakhona nabobonke abasebenzi bakahulumeni benza umsebenzi wabo ngendlela,’’ kusho uGwala.UNtuli ungena ezinyathelweni zikaNkk Nomusa Dube-Ncube obe nguNdunankulu wokuqala wesifazane ukuphatha isifundazwe iKZN. UGwala uthe kulindeleke ukuthi uNdunankulu afungiswe, uma eqeda sekuyoba kuyena ukuthi wenzanjani maqondana nokuqokwa kwabaphathiswa esifundazweni.UGwala uthe uhulumeni umeme izicukuthwane ezehlukene ezizothamela lo mcimbi futhi noNdunankulu uyazimemela ngokwakhe ngoba kusuke kuwusuku lwakhe.UNtuli onguSihlalo we-IFP eKZN ukhethelwe kwesikaNdunankulu ngoLwesihlanu emcimbini weSishayamthetho ebesihlala okokuqala emuva kokhetho.UNtuli udabuka eVumanhlamvu, eNkandla, kanti uke waba yimeya yakhona. Ukhethwa nje, kade eseyimeya kaMasipala wesiFunda iKing Cetshwayo eRichards Bay.UNtuli uqokwe yi-IFP ngaphambi kokhetho yathi wuyena ezogadla ngaye kwesikaNdunankulu wesifundazwe. I-IFP ingene kuhulumeni wobumbano ne-ANC,DA neNFP.I-IFP ingene ngezihlalo ezingu-15 yalandelwa yi-ANC ngezingu-14 kulandele i-DA ngezihlao ezingu-11. I-NFP yona ithole isihlalo esisodwa okuyisona esinqume ngohulumeni wesifundazwe.I-MK ne-EFF bazithole besele ngaphandle ngesikhathi kubunjwa uhulumeni wesifundazwe. I-MK yiyona enezihlalo eziningi ezingu-37 bese i-EFF iba nezimbili.I-ANC ebiphethe uhulumeni yehluleke yancama wukubuyela emandleni esifundazweni njengoba ilahlekelwe amavoti amaningi okhethweni obelushubile.

SABELO NSELEKUCACELE noma wubani eSishayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal ngoLwesihlanu ukuthi zibe nzulu izingxoxo nokuvumelana kube okusezingeni eliphezulu phakathi kwamaqembu abeyinkukhu nempaka ngesikhathi kuqhubeka imikhankaso yokhetho.I–ANC, DA ne-IFP bebeyimbumba. Bekuthi uma bephakamisa igama lozokhethwa, owe-ANC aphakanyiswe oweDA, oweDA aphakanyiswe owe-IFP okuyinto ebicacisa ukuthi kuxoxwe ngempela kwavunyelwana ngobekumele kwenzeke izolo kukhethwa usomlomo, iphini lakhe nondunankulu wakulesi sifundazwe okugcine kube wuMnuz Thami Ntuli. I-MK izithole isikhishwa inyumbazane njengoba la maqembu amathathu evote ngokubambisana ekhetha kulezi zikhundla ezintathu. Abaholi be-IFP, ANC, DA, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, uNksz Nontembeko Boyce, noNksz Mmabatho Tembe baqokelwe ezikhundleni ebezibangwa, bahlula amalungu eMK abengenele umjaho wezikhundla.IMK iyona eyathola amavoti amaningi KwaZulu-Natal, yathola izihlalo ezingu-37 kwezingu-80.I-EFF kuphela enezihlalo ezimbili, evote neMK.Imbumba ye-IFP, ANC, DA neNFP inezihlalo ezingu-41.Le mbumba ikhombise ubumbano ngesikhathi kukhethwa yize ibikade ihlakanhlaka ngesikhathi kukhankaselwa ukhetho.Ngesikhathi kukhankaselwa ukhetho, kwaba neziwombe eziningi lapho amalungu alezi zinhlangano ayejikijelana khona ngamazwi ayiziswana.Abanye babefungile ukuthi ngeke basebenzisane nangeshobolo ngesikhathi besakhankasela ukhetho.NgoLwesihlanu abaholi bala maqembu bebebonakala bexoxa, benza amancoko kuqhuma uhleko.Ubumbano lugqame kakhulu ngesikhathi kuphakanyiswa amagama abazongenela umbango wezikhundla.Igama likaNtuli, oqokelwe kwesikandunankulu, liphakanyiswe yilungu le-ANC, uNksz Nomagugu Simelane.Igama likaNksz Boyce, oqokelwe kwesikasomlomo, liphakanyiswe yilungu le-IFP, uMnuz Mntomuhle Khawula.ElikaNksz Tembe, oqokelwe kwesephini likasomlomo, liphakamiswe yilungu le-ANC, uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka.AbeMK bebengazibekile phansi njengoba bephakamise amagama kuzo zonke izikhundla ebezibangwa.Onke amalungu ayo, Inkosi Phathisizwe Chiliza, uMnuz Mervyn Dirks, noNksz Ishan Barciela, akhale ngaphansi.INhloko yamaJaji KwaZulu-Natal, uJaji Thoba Portia Poyo-Dlwati, ebelihlalise umhlangano, lithwale kanzima njengoba amalungu eMK nawe-EFF ebelokhu ekhalaza ngohlelo obelulandelwa ngesikhathi kuvotwa.Bekuvotwa ngokuyimfihlo.Amalungu eMK nawe-EFF akhale ngokuthi kukhona abebeveza ukuthi bavote kanjani. Bathe ukhetho belungakhululekile, bafuna ukuthi kuqalwe phansi ukuvotwa.Bakhalaza nangabezindaba abebeqopha, nokuphethe ngokuthi bayalelwe ukuba bayeke ukuqopha.Kuke kwaba nezikhawu lapho bekubukeka sengathi amalungu eMK nawe-EFF afuna ukuwunyomfa umhlangano.IJaji Poyo-Dlwati lize lakhumbuza la malungu ukuthi linamandla okukhipha abahluphayo.Ngaphandle kwesiShayamthetho amalungu eMK nawe-IFP abekikilizana ngezingoma.Ekhuluma okokuqala njengoNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uNtuli ubonge ukubambisana okube khona emaqenjini kodwa wathi okwamanje akafuni ukugeqa amagula ngakuphethe esandleni.
ABEMBONI yezinkukhu bafuna kuphasiswe umgomo womkhuhlane wezinkukhu njengoba bethi lesi sifo sithula kancane sibuye sivumbuke.UDkt Abongile Balarane we-SA Poultry Association, uthe sekuphele izinyanga belindele ukuthi obeNgqongqoshe wezoLimo, uNkk Thoko Didiza, uzophasisa umgomo womkhuhlane wezinkukhu.Ekhuluma kwi-East Coast Radio, uDkt Balarane, uthe ukuphasiswa komgomo womkhuhlane wezinkukhu uzosiza abazifuyile ukuthi bakwazi ukuza nezinhlelo zokugwema lesi sifo.Uveze ukuthi bafuna kube nohlelo olungambi eqolo lokuvikela izinkukhu emkhuhlaneni olungeke ludle imali yabalimi abancane."NgoNovemba wonyaka odlule, uhulumeni washicilela imithetho okufanele ilandelwe uma kugonywa izinkukhu. Kwatholakala ukuthi le mithetho inzima ngeke bakwazi ukuyilandela kahle abalimi. Sicela imithetho elula ezophephisa izinkukhu kodwa kube lula nakubalimi ukuthi bayilandele,” kusho uBalarane.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi isifo sezinkukhu saqubuka ngonyaka odlule, kwanyuka amaqanda nenyama yenkukhu.Inyunyana yabasebenza ngokudla, iFood and Allied Workers Union (Fawu), igqugquzele uhulumeni ukuthi asheshise ngalo mgomo ukuze kuzovikelwa imboni yakuleli.Iveze ukuthi uma lungacacile uhlelo lokugoma izinkukhu zakuleli kuba nzima ukuthi inyama yazo idayiswe kwamanye amazwe lokhu kuholela ekutheni kwande amaphisisi avela kwamanye amazwe azogcina eqeda imisebenzi embonini yenkukhu.
INHLANGANO esiza abalimele ezingozini zomgwaqo isiveze ukuthi abantu abasha abaningi babulawa yizingozi zomgwaqo.Isikhulu esiphezulu seRoad Accident Fund (RAF) uMnuz Collins Letsoalo, sithe ucwaningo lwabo luveza ukuthi uma usuku lwabantu abasha, iYouth Day lungempelasonto, ezingozini eziwu-74 ezenzeka ngalolo suku kufa abantu abasha kuzo.ULetsoalo uthe ngo-2020 kuya ku-2022 bawu-13 963 abantu abasha abashona ezingozini zomgwaqo eziwu-34 964 ezenzeka ngaleso sikhathi.Uthe iningi labantu abasha abashona ezingozini zomgwaqo basuke behamba ngezinyawo njengoba isibalo sabo simi ku-38% bese kuthi abasuke begibele izimoto babe wu-35%.Ubalule ukuthi abantu abasha abayilandeli imithetho yomgwaqo okubalwa ukubopha ibhande uma besemotweni, ukugqoka izimpahla ezikhanyayo uma behamba ngezinyawo nokuhamba ezindaweni ezifanele ukuze bagweme izimoto."Njengoba inyanga yabantu abasha isebusika, ubusuku bude kanti abantu abasha bayazula. Kuba yinkinga ngoba sibona abaningi babo beba sezingozini zomgwaqo ngenxa yokuthi bahamba kakhulu ngalesi sikhathi. Siyabacela ukuthi baqaphele uma behamba ngezinyawo, balandele imithetho yomgwaqo futhi bafase amabhande uma begibele izimoto,” kusho uLetsoalo.Udonse ngendlebe bonke abasebenzisa umgwaqo ukuthi balandele imithetho ukuze kunciphe izingozi zomgwaqo."Kuzo zonke izingozi ezenzeka emigwaqweni yakuleli u-40% wazo ubulala abantu abasha. Ngithanda ukubakhumbuza ukuthi baphephe emgwaqweni ikakhulukazi njengoba kuyimpelasonto enkulu. Ngicela bagweme izingozi zomgwaqo bakhumbule ukuthi kufanele baphile ngomuso, basenamaphupho okufanele bawafeze,” kusho uLetsoalo.Uthe bonke abantu bakuleli kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi imigwaqo iphephile, ikakhulukazi ngezimpelasonto, bangashayeli bephuzile, bahloniphane nasemgwaqweni.Uphethe ngokuthi uma kwenzeka beba sezingozini zomgwaqo bashayele iRAF ku-087 820 1111 ngoMsombuluko kuya kuLwesihlanu noma bangene ku-www.raf.co.za ukuthola usizo olufanele.
USUKU lobaba wusuku olukhethekile lapho kuqhakanjiswa ubuhle babo emhlabeni wonke. Lapha kusuke kuyithuba elihle lokukhombisa uthando wonke umuntu owubaba empilweni yakho, kungakhathalekile ukuthi uyakuzala noma cha, umalume, umkhulu noma ubaba ongumakhelwane odlale iqhaza elibalulekile empilweni yakho.Lolu suku lugujwa ngezinyanga ezihlukene emazweni ahlukene ngokuhambisana nezinkolo namasiko ahlukene. Njengosuku lomama, lolu suku luthakaselwa kakhulu emindenini ngezipho, ukudla okumnandi nokujabula ndawonye.Yize kuthiwa isipho siphuma enhliziyweni kodwa obaba bathi sebekhathele yizipho zemihla ngemihla (amasokisi, uthayi, izinkomishi namakhadi).Abezitolo zezipho bakhuthaza kakhulu ukuthi kwenziwe ibhokisi elinezinto ezahlukene ukuze bajabule obaba.UNosipho Khuzwayo, weKasi Foodz and Events, uthi awudingi ukuba nemali eningi kodwa udinga ukuhlakanipha nobuciko. "Thatha ibhokisi lakho elihle lezicathulo ufake isithombe esenziwe kahle, inkomishi, amasokisi, uswidi wohlobo lwe-menthol, iwashi nesikhwama semali.” Uthi kuya ngamandla akho ukuthi ungafaka izinto ezingakhi ebhokisini ukuze libukeke lilihle.Uthi esikhathini samanje abantu bathanda izinto ezibhekiswe ngqo kubona. Lokhu kusho ukuthi ungathenga isikhwama semali namasokisi, uye lapho abhalwa khona ubhale igama likababa nomyalezo wakho.Uma unemali, ungenza isithombe esikhulu esibhalwe isibongo nezithakazelo zakini, esizokhangiswa ekhaya ukuthi wonke umuntu ofikayo asibone.IZIMBALI kuthiwa zinhle uma zihlotshiswe ngento yokuthenga isithombe: FACEBOOKUMbongeni Mayisela (35), onamadodana amathathu, uthi akukho akulindele ngalolu suku ngoba uma kungewona amasokisi yinkomishi. Uthi kungaba kuhle ukuthola noma yibhodlela lesiphuzo esishisayo asithandayo noma ijezi leqembu lebhola alithandayo, i-Man City.URev. Chris Mathebula ungomunye wobaba abanikele enkundleni uX eyala abantu ngezinhlobo zezipho abangazithokozela bengobaba: iwashi, amaselula ahamba phambili, amateki noma imali."Sicela nime kancane ngothayi, ama-gown okulala namasendela,” kubhala yena.
ISIFUNDAZWE iLimpopo singene emlandweni wokuba nondunankulu wokuqala wesifazane, uDkt Phophi Ramathuba, okhethwe ngoLwesihlanu esiShayamthetho.IziShayamthetho zihlale okokuqala izolo lapho bekukhethwa khona osomlomo, amaphini abo nondunankulu bezifundazwe. Izifundazwe zihlale ngesikhathi esifanayo nePhalamende, nalo ebelihlala okokuqala.ILimpopo ibuyele ezandleni ze-ANC ebivele iyiphethe phambilini. Bekuqala eLimpopo ukuthi kukhethwe undunankulu wesifazane njengoba lesi sikhundla besihlala siqhoqhobalwa amadoda.USOMLOMO wePhalamende omusha, uNkk Thoko Didiza, okhethwe emhlanganweni wokuqala wePhalamende Isithombe: THE PRESIDENCYUDkt Ramathuba ubenguMphathiswa wezeMpilo esifundazweni kuhulumeni okade uphelelwa yisikhathi kanti ungena esikhundleni ebesiphethwe wuMnuz Stanley Mathabatha.UNkk MaQueen Joyce Letshoha-Mathae ukhethelwe kwesikaNdunankulu waseFree State.
