Nakhona eMpumalanga kubuyele yona i-ANC.E-Eastern Cape kubuyiselwe uMnuz u-Oscar Mabuyane naye ojutshwe yiyona i-ANC ebuyise isifundazwe. E-Western Cape kubuyele uMnuz Alan Winde obevele eqhoqhobele lesi sikhundla yena ojutshwe yi-DA ephethe isifundazwe.UMnuz uPanyaza Lesufi ubuyiselwe kwesikaNdunankulu waseGauteng yona ezophathwa ngokubambisana namanye amaqembu nebikade iphethwe yi-ANC ngaphambi kokhetho. UDkt uZamani Saul ubuyele kwesikaNdunankulu waseNorthern Cape.E-North West kukhethwe uMnuz uLazarus Mokgosi ongena esikhundleni sikaMnuz Bushy Maape ongabuyelanga. INorth West nayo ibuyela ezandleni ze-ANC ebikade iyiphethe ngaphambi kokhetho.Omunye owesifazane othole isikhundla esiqavile nguNkk Thoko Didiza okhethelwe kwesikaSomlomo wePhalamende. UNkk Didiza udabuka KwaZulu-Natal kanti uke waba ungqongqoshe wezoLimo, ukuBuyiswa koMhlaba nokuThuthukiswa kwezindawo zasemaKhaya.KwaZulu-Natal kukhethwe uNksz Nontembeko Boyce kwesikaSomlomo weSishayamthetho nokuyisikhundla abevele esiphethe ngaphambi kokhetho. UNksz Boyce udabuka eFlagstaaf, e-Eastern Cape, kodwa usezinze eKZN. UNksz Mmabatho Tembe weDA ukhethelwe kwesePhini likaSomlomo. UNksz Tembe udabuka eMgungundlovu, KwaZulu-Natal.
SEZIFAKWE ngokusemthethweni ohlelweni lokufundisa izifundo zobuchwepheshe bamakhompyutha iCoding neRobotics.Lezi zifundo zifakwe ngokusemthethweni emqulwini kahulumeni iGovernement Gazette, muva nje.Zizofundiswa kusuka kaGrade R kuya kuaGrade 9 kanti seziyingxenye yeCurriculum Assessment Policy Statements (CAPS), okuwuhlelo okufundwa ngalo ezikoleni zakuleli.UMnyango weMfundo eyisiSekelo waqala ukuhlola ukufundwa kwalezi zifundo kwaGrade R kuya kwaGrade 3, ngo-2021 ezikoleni ezingaphezu kuka-2 000.UNgqongqoshe walo mnyango uNkk Angie Motshekga, wathi bafuna abafundi bakuleli bafunde izinto ezihambisana nesikhathi wathi yingakho befaka izifundo ezintsha.Wathi lezi zifundo zibandakanya ukwakha izinto ezifana namarobhothi, nokufunda ngezinto ezithinta amakhompyutha.KwaGrade R kuya kwaGrade 3, lezi zifundo zizokwenziwa neMaths, kuthi kwaGrade 4 kuya ku-9, zenziwe neMaths, Natural Sciences neTechnology.Emazingeni aphansi kwaGrade R kuya ku-3, abafundi bazofundiswa ngezinto ezisetshenziswayo uma kwakhiwa amarobhothi.Kwezithinta amakhompyutha bazofundiswa ukuhlwaya ulwazi kwi-internet. KwaGrade 4 kuya ku-6, bazofundiswa ukusebenzisa i-internet, izinto ezithinta ukuntshontsha ulwazi lomunye ulwenze olwakho.KwaGrade7 kuya kuGrade 9, abafundi bazofundiswa amakhono okwakha ama-website nokunye. UNkk Motshekga waveza ukuthi baqeqeshe abaluleka ngalezi zifundo bahlinzeka ngezinsiza zokufunda nokufundisa kulezi zifundo.Okhulumela umnyango uMnuz Elijah Mhlanga, uveze ukuthi baqale nezinye izifundo ezintsha ezifana neMarine Sciences, Technical Science, Technical Mathematics nezinye.Uthe baziqala ngoba zidingwa ngumnotho wakuleli."Ukushintsha kwezinto kwenza ukuthi senzise izifundo ezintsha ezikoleni ukuze zihambisane nesikhathi. Siqala nezinye ezithinta amabhizinisi nezinye ezikoleni zamabanga aphezulu,” kusho uMhlanga.
USIBANGE nomholi we-EFF isikhundla sokuba wumengameli wezwe kulokhu uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa ogcine ephinda ekhethwa waba ngumengameli wezwe ihlandla lesibili. IPhalamende lihlale umhlangano wokuqala eKapa lakhetha uNkk Thoko Didiza kwesikaSomlomo. UNkk Didiza wehlule uNksz Veronica Mente onguSihlalo we-EFF kuzwelonke nobephakanyiselwe kwesikasomlomo. Amalungu akhethe uDkt Annelie Lotriet we-DA kwesePhini likaSomlomo eginqa uMnuz Vuyolwethu Zungula we-ATM naye obephakanyisiwe.IPhalamende ebelihlala lingelesikhombisa kusukela ngo-1994 ngesikhathi izwe liphuma kuhulumeni wobandlululo kungenwa kowentando yeningi.Ukuhlala kwePhalamende kuqale kwenganyelwa yiNhloko yamaJaji kuleli iJaji uRaymond Zondo yase iphosa izintambo kuSomlomo uNkk Didiza. UMengameli ukhethwe selishonile ilanga ebusuku ngenxa yokuhamba kancane kohlelo.Ukukhethwa kukahulumeni omusha kuwumphumela wohulumeni wobumbano lweANC, DA ne-IFP.I-ANC ebiphethe izwe iminyaka engu-30 ingene ehlazweni ihluleka wukubuyela emandleni nokuphoqe ukuthi ihambe ifongqa isigqoko ixoxa namaqembu.Kuthe kusahleli umhlangano wePhalamende kusakhethwa, i-MK yathumela isimemo sabezindaba ibika ukuthi uMnuz Jacob Zuma uzokhuluma ngeSonto njengoba ebize abezindaba.Isimemo siveza inkulumo kaZuma njengezobe iqavile ibhekene ngqo nesizwe sezwe nepolitiki."UMengameli uZuma uzokhuluma nabezindaba kwingqophamlando yenkulumo maqondana nesimo sepolitiki esiqhubekayo. IPhalamende liqhubekile nomsebezi walo ngaphandle kwamalungu ePhalamende eMK adube umhlangano ngoba ethi awayemukeli imiphumela yokhetho lukazwelonke. Uzokhuluma ngezinto eziningi nezithinta ikusasa lezwe,’’ kusho isitatimende esikhishwe wuMnuz Nhlamulo Ndhlela, okhulumela iMK.UNdhlela uthe inkulumo kaZuma izoba ngeSonto eGoli endaweni engakadalulwa ngehora lesibili ntambama nokuyilapho azokhuluma khona konke.UZuma ubiza imbizo nje wachithwa yinkantolo ohlwini lwamalungu ePhalamende ngenxa yokuthi wake walahlwa ngecala wagwetshwa.I-MK ibingabonwa nhlobo ePhalamende kodwa esifundazweni KwaZulu-Natal amalungu ayo afungiswe ngempumelelo. I-MK inezihlalo ezingu-58 ePhalamende bese iba nezingu-37 esiShayamthetho saseKZN.Kulindeleke ukuthi uMengameli agcotshwe emcimbini ozoba ngoLwesithathu lwesonto elizayo ePitoli. Emuva komcimbi amehlo ayobe esethi njo kumengameli ukuthi amemezele amalungu ekhabhinethi azosebenza nawo kuhulumeni omusha.Nakuba i-ANC ingenile kuhulumeni wobumbano namanye amaqembu kodwa sikhona isikhalo kwezinye izakhamkhanya ezisola i-ANC ngokushintsha imibala.Amaqembu angafakwanga kuhulumeni wobumbano abelokhu ekhale njalo futhi abeziphakamisela amanye amagama aphikisa lawo aphakanysiwe yilawo ayingxenye kahulumeni wobumbano.

Lapha kutholakale amabhethri awu-40 ezinkampani zamaselula ezintathu okusolakala ukuthi ebiwe, angabiza uR1 million,” kusho uNetshiunda.Abasolwa abavela ezweni elingumakhelwane, abaneminyaka ephakathi kuka-35 no-49, kulindeleke bavele enkantolo maduze.Abane bazovela eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMthunzini, abanye kweyaseChatsworth.

Ngiyethemba uyakuqonda lokho."Umthombo osondelene nalolu daba uveza ukuthi uKhumalo uvakashele inkabi esivele isejele uMzo Ntombela okunguyena owadubula.Kuthiwa uzame ukumnxenxa ukuba angabethuli ubufakazi kuleli cala okanye angaliphathi igama lakhe uma esebethula.Umthombo uthe kukhona uKhumalo akuthembise inkabi uma izolandela umyalelo wakhe.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi le nkabi yagonyuluka yaveza konke okwenzeka ngokusocongwa kukamufi maqede inkantolo yayigweba.Yadalula ukuthi ibikade isebenzisana noNkk Ntombela nabanye. Yaveza nokuthi yanunuselwa ngesamba semali enkulu eyahluleka ukusenqaba.UMshushisi uKrishen Shaah ukuvezile eNkantolo izolo ukuthi batholile ukuthi uKhumalo uke wenza imizamo enjalo.Ummeli kaKhumalo u-Advocate Mdu Mvune uphikile ukuthi lokhu kuke kwenzeka phambilini.Icala lihlehlele uJulayi 25 ukuze uCele athole ummeli.
NGESONTO kuphela iminyaka ewu-48 intsha yaseNingizimu Afrika eyayiphila ngo-1976, yabhikisha ilwa nohulumeni wobandlululo, ilwela ukufuna ukufunda ngolimi lwayo ezikoleni, hhayi ukufunda zonke izifundo ngesiBhunu, isenzo esasiphoqwa wuhulumeni wengcindezelo, izwe lingakakhululeki. Ngalelo langa, abafundi bezikole ezehlukene zaseSoweto abalinganiselwa ku-10 000 babegcwele imigwaqo, bebhikisha. Lokho kwaholela ekutheni kufe abantu abangaphezu kuka-500, kubalwa noHector Pieterson, owayeneminyaka ewu-12 ngaleso sikhathi. Kwalimala abantu abangaphezu kuka-2 000.Isolezwe lixoxe nentsha ephila manje uNksz uZoleka Dlamini waseHighflats, uMnuz Sibusiso Cele waseNdwedwe noNksz Nothando Ndlovu waseThekwini, ukuzwa ukuthi lolu suku lusho ukuthini kubona nokuthi yikuphi okungabagculisi ngalo manje.UNKSZ Zoleka Dlamini Isithombe: SITHUNYELWEUNksz Dlamini (21) uthe ukubaluleka kwalolu suku kuya ngokuya kuyehla ngenxa yokuthi intsha yamanje ayisenandaba nomlando nokubaluleka kwawo, ngenxa yezizathu ezehlukene."Lolu suku seluyiholidi nje elifana namanye ngenxa yokuthi intsha seyiphelelwe yithemba lempilo engcono. Iningi lethu lifundile kodwa imisebenzi ayitholakali, yingakho abaningi sebelushaya indiva. Kumele kwenziwe izinhlelo zokuluvuselela, kufundiswe abeza ngemuva kwethu ngokubaluleka kwalo, futhi kukhuthazwe ubumqoka bokuzimela nokuqala amabhizinisi entsheni,” kusho uNksz Dlamini.UMNUZ Sibusiso Cele Isithombe: SITHUNYELWEUCele (35) uthe nakuba lolu suku lusesemqoka ngenxa yomlando walo, kepha azikapheli izinto ezikhathaza intsha, umehluko wukuthi intsha yamanje isibhekene nezinkinga ezehlukene kunezentsha eyayiphila ngo-1976."Thina sasilwela izinto engingabala kuzo inkululeko yezomnotho, wukuzimela nokuba ngabaholi bakusasa. Lokho kubonakele nangesikhathi kuvotwa ukuthi intsha seyikhathele yizethembiso ezingafezwa, ifuna izinhlelo zezinto ezibambekayo zokuthi kuzoyiwa kanjani phambili,” usho kanje.UNKSZ Nothando Ndlovu Isithombe: SITHUNYELWEUNksz Ndlovu (29) ugxeke intsha yamanje, ekhala ngokuthi izinto ezenziwa ngabanye babo zikhombisa ukungazi ukuthi sisuka kuphi njengoba izwe selilana elikhona manje."Intsha yamanje yazisa kakhulu amalungelo nokwenza igcine ingasazinaki ezinye izinto ezimqoka, futhi igcina yenza izinto ezingalungile bese icasha ngokuthi ikhululekile. Nokho isekhona intsha ekuqondayo ukuthi asifikanga kalula lapho esikhona manje. Kumele siyintsha siyeke ukukhululeka kakhulu, sivuke sizithintithe sisebenzele ukwenza izinto ezibonakalayo,” kusho uNksz Ndlovu.
OBEYIMEYA yeTheku, uMnuz uMxolisi Kaunda, uthi akaxoshwanga esikhundleni ngoba eyisehluleki kodwa i-ANC ibone kufanele ayoyisebenzela kwenye indawo.UKaunda, obekhuluma esithangamini sabezindaba izolo, uphawule kabanzi ngokuxoshwa kwakhe esikhundleni wakhonjwa ePhalamende eCape Town.UMkhandlu weTheku usezandleni ze-ANC ewuphethe ngokubambisana neNFP emuva kokuthi engabanga khona onqoba ingcaca okhethweni. Kusabalele amahlebezi okuthi kungase kujutshwe uMnuz uCyril Xaba, obeyilungu lePhalamende, azovala isikhala sikaKaunda.Ukuchithwa kukaKaunda kumenyezelwe ngoLwesithathu ntambama futhi kuvela nje kumatasa ezweni kuzanywa ukubumba uhulumeni.UKaunda ubebukeka engadangele, eshaya amancoko ebhuqa nangakho ukukhishwa kwakhe esikhundleni. Uthe yena wenze konke okusemandleni ukuthi iTheku libe yindawo engcono kakhulu. Uthe ngesikhathi etshelwa ngokukhishwa kwakhe, ayiphathwanga eyokwehluleka le eshiwo ngabantu."Uma ujutshwa kwi-ANC awubuzi ukuthi kungani bekhethe wena, ngokunjalo noma usukhishwa ukhonjwa kwenye indawo ngeke ubuze. Yisinqumo engisemukele kahle njengoba ngihlala ngenza nakwezinye. Ngeke ngibaphendule abathi ngiyisehluleki kodwa umsebenzi wami uzozikhulumela,’’ kusho uKaunda.Uthe uyakholelwa ekutheni i-ANC isebenzise ubuhlakani bayo ngendlela efanele ngesikhathi yenza isinqumo. Uthe ukholwa wukuthi imbone njengomuntu ofanele ukuyolekelela esikhundleni ajutshwe kusona.Uthe ukungcola kweTheku lokhu okukhalwa ngakho kungcono kakhulu manje. Uthe balenyusile izinga lokuhlanza idolobha baze bafinyelela nasezindaweni ezisemakhaya.Uthe uyawazi amahemuhemu abhokile, athi angase ashiye kwi-ANC aye kwenye indawo. Uthe amampunge akhulunywa ngabantu abangazi ukuthi bathini.Uthe wazijoyinela yena i-ANC ngokuthanda kwakhe, uyayiqonda kahle ukuthi isebenza kanjani. Uthe bekunozinzo eThekwini ngesikhathi sakhe, akufani nabanye omasipala okuhlala kuketulwa izimeya kufakwe ezinye inyanga nenyanga.Uthe uzishaya isifuba ngokuthi umasipala uphethwe kahle futhi basebenze kakhulu belwa nenkohlakalo ebidla lubi emkhandlwini.Ubuye wathi usebenze kakhulu elungisa udaba lokushoda kwamanzi eThekwini. Kulindeleke ukuthi i-ANC ikhombe imeya entsha ezovala isikhala sikaKaunda.
OBEYIMEYA yaseZululand uMfundisi uThulasizwe Buthelezi, uthe uhamba nenhliziyo emhlophe ngoba uwenzile umsebenzi abejutshelwe wona wokuhambisa amanzi ebantwini.UButhelezi obuye abe wuNdunankulu kaZulu, wesulile esikhundleni sobumeya njengoba ephikelele esiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal. Uhleli endaweni yesishiyagalolunye ohlwini lwamalungu e-IFP esiShayamthetho.Kulindeleke ukuthi i-IFP iqoke imeya entsha ezovala isikhala sikaButhelezi ngoba iyona ephethe ngokubambisana namanye amaqembu kulo mkhandlu.I-IFP KwaZulu-Natal ize mawala okhethweni yathola izihlalo ezingu-15 esiShayamthetho okuyizona ebikhulumela phezu kwazo ezingxoxweni.UButhelezi exoxa neSolezwe, uthe uzishaya isifuba ngakwenzele abantu baseZululand njengoba eseshiya nje." Ngifike eZululand ngoNovemba 2017 manje ngiwushiya umkhandlu usesimeni esihle ngokwezimali futhi uMcwaningi mabhuku uthe awukho ugcobho. Kunemisebenzi yokufakwa kwamanzi eminingi esiyenzile siqinisekisa ukuthi ayafika ebantwini,’’ kusho uButhelezi.Uthe imisebenzi ibonakale ngesikhathi sokhetho i-IFP yanqoba cishe wonke ama-ward KwaNongoma kwacaca ukuthi banelisekile.Uthe kunemizi eminingi ebingenawo amanzi ikakhulukazi ohlangothini lwaKwaNongoma kodwa aseyaphuma manje." Imizi engu-36 000 ibingawatholi amanzi kodwa siwafakile, banawo manje. Ngishiya umasipala onozinzo futhi ngibonga amakhansela, abasebenzi namakhosi ngokusebenza ngokubambisana,’’ kusho uButhelezi.Uthe unethemba lokuthi bazoqhubeka nokuhlonipha imeya ezovala isikhala sakhe ukuze umsebenzi uqhubeke kahle. Maqondana nokuya esiShayamthetho uthe inkonyane izobe ingethuki isisinga.UButhelezi uthe iqembu lamjuba esiShayamthetho sesifundazwe ngo-2006 wasebenza khona iminyaka emihlanu. Uthe wayegxile ekomitini lehhovisi likandunankulu nezindaba zasendlunkulu. Uthe wafunda okuningi ngokusebenza kukahulumeni nobukhosi.Uthe namanje uzosebenzisa leso sipiliyoni sakhe ukuqhuba umsebenzi ofunwa yi-IFP.
INhloko yamaJaji kuleli iJaji uRaymond Zondo, ichibiyele imithetho yokuhlala kwePhalamende okubhekwe ngabomvu namuhla ngoLwesihlanu lapho okuzokhethwa khona uMengameli.Umthetho omusha uthi uma ilungu lifisa ukubuza ngendlela okuqhutshwa ngayo umhlangano kufanele liphakamise umbuzo lisekelwa elinye elivela kwenye inhlangano.Ngaphezu kwalokho indlela elidingidwa ngayo iphuzu izobe ilawulwa ukugwema ukuphazamiseka komhlangano.Ekuqaleni ilungu belinelungelo lokuphakamisa isandla libuze ngaphandle kokudinga ukwesekelwa.Usihlalo womhlangano unikwe ilungelo lokuthi uma ilungu lingayihloniphi imithetho likhishwe phandle khonamanjalo.Ekuqaleni ilungu belinxuswa ukuthi lihoxise amazwi ahlabayo ngaphambi lokuthi likhishwe kodwa manje kuthiwa lingakhishwa khonamanjalo.
IMK ithi izoqhubeka nokuduba umhlangano wePhalamende elikhulu eCape Town kodwa amalungu ayo aseKZN azofungiswa eSishayamthetho namuhla.I-ANC iphunyukwe amandla okubusa yodwa okokuqala emuva kweminyaka engu-30 nokuphoqe ukuthi ihambe iphaphatha ixoxa namanye amaqembu.IMK ichithwe yiNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo izama ukumisa ukuhlala kwePhalamende elizohlala namuhla lifungise amalungu, kukhethwe usomlomo nomengameli.IMK ikhala ngokuthi kukhona okungahambanga kahle okhethweni obelubanjwe ngenyanga edlule futhi isola ukuthi amavoti ayo awabalwanga kahle.IMK igile izimanga okhethweni ingena okokuqala emuva kokuthi imenyezelwe ngoDisemba nyakenye. IMK imenyezelwe ngowayengumengameli, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, ekhala ngokuthi akeneme nge-ANC ngaphansi kukaMengameli wayo, uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa.Okhulumela iMK, uMnuz uNhlamulo Ndhlela, uchaze ngezinhlelo zabo zanamuhla njengoba kuwusuku olukhulu olubhekwe ngabomvu."Amalungu ethu aseKZN azoya eSishayamthetho kodwa ngeke siye ePhalamande ngoba namanje sisamile ekutheni imiphumela asiyemukeli. IPhalamende liyindawo ekahle yokuzwakalisa izikhalo zethu,’’ kusho uNdhlela.Ngokwesitatimende esikhishwe iMK seliyozilahla kunina, amalungu abo azoya kofungiswa eziShayamenthetho enezihlalo kuzo. Uthe basazobuka ezinye izindlela zomthetho zokuqhubeka nokukhononda ngemiphumela yokhetho abangeneme ngayo.IMK ePhalamende inezihlalo ezingu-58 kanti eKZN inezihlalo ezingu-37. KwaZulu-Natal kulindeleke ukuthi kukhethwe uhulumeni wobumbano namuhla. I-IFP ihlangene ne-ANC ne-DA ne-NFP benza izihlalo ezingu-41 okungabenza bathathe umbuso.Uma kuba kanjalo kuyobe kuchaza ukuthi iMK ne-EFF bazoba yizibukeli bebe ngamaqembu aphikisayo. Kuleso sivumelwano kulindeleke ukuthi uSihlalo we-IFP KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, aphakanyiselwe kwesikandunankulu.Kulindeleke ukuthi abanye bamanye amaqembu banikwe izikhundla ezehlukene ngokuhambisana nesivumelwano sobudlelwano. IMK ike yazama ukuxoxa neNFP enesihlalo esisodwa esizonquma ngohulumeni kodwa kwacaca ukuthi abavumelani. I-IFP yona imemezele ukuthi ike yathola isimemo somhlangano kwiMK kodwa yagcina ingafikanga.I-ANC yona imemezele ukuthi ingena kuhulumeni wobumbano ne-DA, IFP namanye amaqembu asazovela.Uma iPhalamende likhethe ngempumelelo, kuzolandela ukugcotshwa kukamengameli bese eqoka ikhabhinethi yakhe azosebenza nayo.Ngenxa yesivumelwano sohulumeni wobumbano, kulindeleke ukuthi kuvele ongqongqoshe bamaqembu ahlukene uma sekuqokwa ikhabhinethi.
IJAJI alimzwelanga ngisho esekhala mi izinyembezi, ecela ukuthanjiselwa isigwebo, owesilisa owabulala abantu eMlaza ogixabezwe ngodilikajele abathathu neminyaka engu-85 ngaphezuluIJaji Bruce Bedderson leNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini ligwebe uBongumusa Sphesihle Radebe (25) wakwa-B eMlaza.URadebe ubekade ethweswe amacala angu-13, kuwona kwahoxiswa amabili okungelokuzama ukubulala nokuphanga kuhlonyiwe kushoda ofakazi okuthiwa abezanga enkantolo ukuzofakaza.Yize kunjalo umshushisi, u-Advocate Bongumusa Mbokazi, ukwazile ukwethula ubufakazi obuholele ekutheni uBedderson alahle uRadebe ngamacala angu-11, okungamathathu okubulala agwetshwe kuwona udilikajele lilinye, awokuphanga kuhlonyiwe amabili wagwetshwa iminyaka engu-15 lilinye.Ugixabezwe ngeminyaka engu-15 icala ngalinye kwamathathu okuzama ukubulala, izinyanga ezingu-12 ngokutholakala nemoto eyebiwe neminyaka engu-10 ngokutholakala nesibhamu nezinhlamvu okungekho emthethweni.UBedderson uphuce uRadebe ilungelo lokuphinde aphathe isibhamu empilweni yakhe.Ngaphambi kokuthi ijaji ligwebe uRadebe, ummeli wakhe umcelele ukuthi agibele ebhokisini lofakazi azinxusele ukuba athanjiselwe isigwebo agcine esitholile.URadebe ukhihle isililo, wacela uxolo emindenini yabagilwa ebisenkantolo wathi sekusemahlombe ayo ukuthi iqede noma iqhubezele phambili okwenzeka ngoba yena akasenawo amandla useboshiwe.Le ndoda ithe ayizalwanga ingumbulali futhi yayingathunywe muntu kodwa okwayehlela idutshulwa ize ibuya emashidini amhlophe esibhedlela eMshiyeni, eMlaza, kwayishiya ilimele emzimbeni nasemphefumulweni.Ivumile ukuthi yayidayisa izidakamizwa nokuthi ababulawa babekhula ndawonye futhi bengabangani kodwa baqembukelana bagcina bedubulana.Esegwetshiwe uRadebe, eseshona phansi ezitokisini, uklunyuluze ngeso izihlobo zabagilwa waphakamisa izandla wamisa o-7 wathi: "Umphefumulo usahlangene nenyama, umqondo usasebenza.”Ababulawa ngokudutshulwa ngoLoyiso Shabalala ngoDisemba 2020, Sthembiso Njapha ngoMeyi 2021 noMthobisi Shibase ngoJuni 2023. Le ndoda ize yaboshwa ngoFebhuwari nyakenye.Emaphepheni asenkantolo unina kaShabalala, uNksz Tholakele Shabalala, uthe uRadebe wabulala indodana yakhe sekusele izinsuku ezintathu kube uKhisimusi, wayiphanga iselula yayo.Kuthiwa uRadebe wabe esephanyeka ezinkundleni zokuxhumana isithombe sikamufi."Wasifonela wasitshela ukuthi yisipho sikaKhisimusi asisijabulele (esho ukubulala umufi). Waphinde wasabisa ngokuthi usezoqotha wonke umndeni, sagcina sibalekela komakhelwane sayocasha khona,” kusho uNksz Shabalala.URadebe uthe akabazi bakuziphi izinkalo abangani bakhe ababili okuthiwa wayegila nabo le migilingwane.
KUSEKUNINGI okusamele kwenziwe ukuze kuliwe nesihlava sokubulawa kwabesifazane nezingane kuleli.Lokhu kushiwo yinhlangano elwa nalesi sihlava, iMbizo, ebiseDurban Girls Secondary, eThekwini, enkonzweni ebiyenzelwe ukukhumbula uWandile Ngcobo (17), owanukubezwa maqede wabulawa yizigebengu ezangena kubo zizokweba, zamfica esekhaya, engayanga esikoleni emasontweni amabili edlule. UWandile ubefunda uGrade 11 kuso lesi sikole. Isitatimende esithunyelwe ile nhlangano sithe kubuhlungu ukuthi intombazane esencane kangaka iphume umphefumulo ngenxa yomuntu wesilisa, yize kunezinhlelo ezingaka zokulwa nalesi sihlava ezweni. OMUNYE wabafundi baseDurban Girls Secondary ngesikhathi benemashi enokuthula ngaphandle kwesikole ekuseni izolo. Isithombe: SITHUNYELWE UMnuz Sanele Ndlovu wale nhlangano esitatimendeni, uthe: "Asizukuphumula abenzi bobubi bengakaboshwa. Akusibo wonke amadoda afana nezigebengu ezibulele uWandile. Akhona amadoda aqotho."Omunye wabangani bakamufi uNomcebo Mthembu, uthe uWandile nakuba ebengeyena umuntu obekhuluma avuleleke ngempilo yakhe, kodwa ubezigqaja ngenkolo yakhe. "Ngendlela abengavulelekile ngayo sisanda kuzwa ukuthi ushiywe unina ngasekupheleni konyaka odlule. Kithina bangani bakhe ubefana nodadewethu, hhayi umngani nje kuphela. Kubuhlungu ukuthi namhlanje sikhuluma nganye esengomunye wabasesibalweni sabantu ababulawe ngamadoda," kusho uNomcebo ekhala.INGXENYE yabafundi baseDurban Girl’s Secondary bephethe amabhelunde okuvalelisa kuzakwabo, uWandile Ngcobo (17) okusolwa ukuthi ubulawe izigebengu ebezizokweba, zamfica esekhaya Isithombe: SIBONELO NGCOBO UYISE kaWandile , uMnuz Mondli Ngcobo nendodakazi yakhe uSiphosethu bephethe isithombe sikaWandile ongenelwe ngabantu okusolwa ukuthi babezokweba, bamfica esekhaya, bamnukubeza, bamgwaza washona Isithombe: SIBONELO NGCOBOUNkk Pamela David ongomunye wothisha, uthe sekuphele iminyaka eyevile kwengu-30 ewuthisha kodwa kungokokuqala ebhekana nesimo esinjena sokuthi umfundi abulawe ngesihluku esinje."Abafundi bonke bethukile ngalesi sehlakalo. Sizomeseka udadewabo, uSiphosethu naye ofunda kulesi sikole," kusho uNkk David.Uthishanhloko wakulesi sikole uMnuz Sunil Balgobind, uthe ngendlela isimo ebesisibi ngayo, kudingeke ukuthi acele ongoti abeluleka ngokomphefumulo ukuzokweluleka abafundi.Uyise kaWandile, uMnuz Mondli Ngcobo, ubonge isikole ngokwenza le nkonzo."Ngiyethemba ukuthi iqiniso lizovela maduze lokuthi ngubani lona owenze isihluku esinje endodakazini yami. Ngeshwa angikwazi ukukhuluma okuningi manje ngoba udaba lusingethwe ngamaphoyisa,” kusho uNgcobo.
USASHAQEKILE namanje umphakathi wakwa-J eMbali, eMgungundlovu, ngemva kwesigameko lapho iphoyisa kuthiwa lidubule izithandani zashona, lase lizidubula nalo lafa ngoMsombuluko.Ngokusho komthombo ocele ukuthi ungadalulwa kulesi sigameko, kushone uNksz Musawenkosi Masinga, kwalimala isoka lakhe igama lalo elingatholakalanga, kwashona umsolwa uConstable Mququ obesebenza (naye igama lakhe elingatholakalanga) esiteshini samaphoyisa, iPlessislaer.Umthombo uthi uConstable Mququ, okuthiwa ubesehlukene noNksz Masinga, uthekele endaweni yesigameko ehlome ngesibhamu."Ufice owesilisa endlini kaNksz Masinga. Waqala wavulela ngenhlamvu kowesilisa. Udlulele phambili kuNksz Masinga okuthiwa ubegeza endlini encane wamdubula, wathi uma eqeda wazidubula naye,” kusho umthombo.Uqhube wathi owesilisa obeficwe endlini uzamile ukubaleka ngemva kokudutshulwa kodwa wawela ngaphandle komnyango. Wathi uNksz Masinga utholakale enqunu endlini encane futhi opha ekhanda, eseshonile."Umsolwa naye utholwe esethule egumbini lokuphumula (lounge). Naye ubopha ekhanda, ephethe isibhamu ngesandla,” kusho umthombo.Uqhube wathi bekukhona incwadi yenkantolo evimbela umsolwa ukuthi asondele eduze kukaNksz Masinga, kodwa kuthiwa ubengayigqizi qakala kwaholela ekutheni aboshwe.Omunye umthombo uthe, omakhelwane babize amaphoyisa emva kokuthi bezwe kuqhuba isibhamu emzini okwenzeke kuwo isigameko."Bathe uma bephuma bebheka, baqaphela ukuthi kukhona owesilisa obelele phansi ngaphandle komnyango. Baqaphele ukuthi akekho umuntu ophume wabaleka, base bethinta amaphoyisa,” kusho umthombo.Uqhube wathi, athe efika amaphoyisa, agqekeza isango ngoba belivaliwe, angena abona wonke umonakalo.Udalule ukuthi umufi wesifazane ubenguthisha kanti bekungumuzi wakhe lona abulawelwe kuwo kanti umsolwa ubeqashile endaweni.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda uthe amaphoyisa asePlessilaer, aphenya amacala amabili okubulala nelilodwa lokufa komuntu kulandela isigameko sokutholakala kwabathathu benamanxeba okudutshulwa ngoMsombuluko e-Unit J eMbali."Kusolwa ukuthi owesilisa udubule owayeyintombi yakhe, isoka lakhe (lo wesifazane), wabe esephendula isibhamu ezidubula naye. Isoka lowayeyintombi liphuthunyiswe esibhedlela kodwa lashona ngesikhathi lifika khona,” kuchaza uNetshiunda.Uqhube wathi imbangela yokubulala ayikaziwa kodwa kusolwa udlame lwasekhaya.
ABASE-ESKOM basola ubugebengu kugqabuka ilangabi esiteshini sikagesi eZola eSoweto ngoLwesithathu.Ukusha kwalesi siteshi kuphazamise izakhamuzi eziningi eDobsonville, eMndeni, Jabulani, Moletsane, Mofolo North, Naledi, Tladi, Zola naseZondi eziphakelwa yilesi siteshi ugesi.I-Eskom iphuthumise ama-Technician ukuphenya ngalesi sehlo nokuhlola umonakalo nokuthi kuzothatha isikhathi esingakanani ukuphothula umsebenzi wokulungisa le nkinga.Uphenyo lokuqala lwe-Eskom ngokusho kuka-Innocentia Zabala okhulumela le nkampani, luveza ukuthi ukusha kudalwe yinkinga yobugebengu. Uthe kusolwa izinswelaboya ebezizama ukweba i-transformer kwase kusha enye. Uthe lokhu kubonakale ngokungabibikho kwamafutha e-transformer nabakholwa wukuthi ebiwe."Abasebenzi bethu bamatasa nomsebenzi wokuzama ukulungisa isimo ukuze kusizakale izakhamuzi ngogesi. Izindawo ezifana naseMndeni, Moletsane, neDobsonville endala zisanenkinga," kusho yena.Uqhubeke wathi okwamanje kabakwazi ukusho ukuthi uzobuya nini ugesi kulezi zindawo kodwa basebenza ngokuzikhandla ukulungisa inkinga. Uthe kukhona onogada abaqaphe isimo kulesi siteshi kwazise siyintandokazi yemigulukudu.
KUSHESHE kwaguqa ukuqulwa kwecala lokubulawa kowayengunozinti weBafana Bafana ne-Orlando Pirates, uSenzo Meyiwa, ummangalelwa wokuqala ekhala ngokuxinwa yisisu.OMuzikawukhulelwa Sibiya, Bongani Sandiso Ntanzi, Mthobisi Prince Mncube, Mthokoziseni Maphisa noFisokuhle Nkani Ntuli baphambi kweNkantolo eNkulu yasePitoli ngokufa kukaMeyiwa.Icala liguqe isikhulu enkampanini yamaselula iVodacom, uNksz Pinky Vythilingam, sisaqhubeka nokwethula ubufakazi baso obumayelana nokusetshenziswa kwamaselula abathinteka kuleli cala.UNksz Vythilingam ubethula ubufakazi bakhe eholwa uMshushisi woMbuso u-Advocate Ronnie Sibanda.USibiya uphakamise isandla ecela ukulumana indlebe nommeli wakhe, u-Adv Thulani Mngomezulu.UMngomezulu ubuye kuSibiya watshela inkantolo ukuthi ummangalelwa wokuqala uthi akazizwa kahle, ukhishwe yisisu ekuseni."Manje senze njani?” kubuza ijaji elengamele ukuqulwa kwecala, uRatha Mokgoatlheng."Ummangalelwa wokuqala uzwakalise ukuthi ucela liguqe icala, lihlehliselwe usuku lwakusasa,” kuphendula uMngomezulu.UMokgoatlheng obezwakana engagculisekile, ubuzisise ukuthi simqale nini isisu uSibiya, uMngomezulu waphendula ngelithi: "Ekuseni namuhla (esho izolo)”.UMokgoatlheng wexwayise ngokuthi uzoyidinga incwadi kadokotela ozomhlola uSibiya aphinde amnike nemithi, ozokwenaba ngokuthi uguliswa yini.Icala liyabuyela enkantolo namuhla.
PHEZU kokuqengqeleza phambili kwe-MK Party ngamavoti okhethweni lwesifundazwe, iqembu Inkatha Freedom Party (IFP) yilo eseliziveze njengababeki benkosi kuhulumeni wesifundazwe. Lokhu kuhlaluke ngesikhathi uMengameli we-IFP, uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa, ememezela ukuthi banesivumelwano sokusebenzisana ne-ANC, DA ne-NFP KwaZulu-Natal. Ngokusho kukaHlabisa, la maqembu aphinde asho ngazwi linye ngegama longaba undunankulu. Lowo uSihlalo we-IFP KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli.Lesi sivumelwano sishiya ngaphandle iqembu okuyilona elihamba phambili ngokwezihlalo esiShayamthetho, i-MK, okuthiwa ayizange ifike emhlanganweni eyayiwucele ne-IFP ngoMsombuluko.Umhlangano weSishayamthetho nozobumba uhulumeni wesifundazwe uhlelelwe ukuba kusasa.Esithangamini nabezindaba, uHlabisa uveze ukuthi KwaZulu-Natal baphothula izingxoxo zokubusa ngokubambisana ne-ANC, DA, ne-NFP. La maqembu uma ehlanganisiwe anezihlalo ezingu-41 kwezingu-80 esiShayamthetho.UHlabisa uthe wonke amaqembu abaxoxa nawo alemukele igama likaNtuli ukuba athathe njengondunankulu.UHlabisa uthe izingxoxo zisaqhubeka, wathi kodwa sebevumelene ukuthi ubani ozokuba uSomlomo nozokuba yiPhini likaSomlomo."Sisazokuba nezinye izingxoxo. Siyazi ukuthi isikhathi asisekho njengoba sibekelwe umnqamulajuqu wangoLwesihlanu.”UHlabisa uthe bazi ukuthi i-NFP izosebenzisana nabo.Izolo kusabalale izithombe zikamengameli we-NFP, uMnuz Ivan Barnes, enomhlangano nomholi we-MK, uJacob Zuma.Lokhu kwenze kwaba namahlebezi okuthi i-NFP izosebenza ne-MK.UHlabisa uthe kade benomhlangano izolo ekuseni noBarnes, wathi bazophinde babe nomunye umhlangano khona izolo ebusuku."Angiyiboni into embi uma uBarnes eyohlangana noZuma. Nathi njenge-IFP asinankinga nokuhlangana ne-MK yize umhlangano wethu wabhuntsha. Iqiniso ukuthi ukuze sikwazi ukuyisa izwe phambili, kufanele sixoxe.”Uma i-NFP ingashaya ungqimphothwe ihlangane ne-MK, esebenzisana ne-EFF, kungasho ukuthi zombili izinhlangothi zizokuba nezihlalo ezilingayo.UHlabisa uthe abakawuvalile umnyango kwi-MK athe yabalindisa umlibe."Ithimba lethu ebelisingethe izingxoxo lalinda amahora amabili endaweni yomhlangano. Latshelwa ukuthi abaholi be-MK kukhona lapho bebambezeleke khona. Ithimba lethu lagcina lihlakazeka, lashiya uHlengwa (uMnuz Mkhuleko), nomyalelo wokuthi akofona uma kwenzeka befika abe-MK. UHlengwa wahlala amanye amahora amabili, lutho ukufika kwabaholi be-MK. Sekuphinde kwaneminye imizamo yokuthi kube nomhlangano. Asinankinga nokuhlangana nabo.”UHlabisa uveze ukuthi kuzwelonke bazokuba yingxenye kahulumeni wobumbano ohlongozwa yi-ANC.UHlabisa uthe bakhethe ukuba yingxenye yohulumeni wobumbano ngenxa yokuthi alikho iqembu elinezihlalo ezanele ukuthi libuse ngokuzimela."Into esenza ukuthi sivume ukuba yingxenye kahulumeni wokubambisana ukuthi siyafuna ukubona izwe lakithi liya phambili. Sibakhathalele abantu bakithi, sifuna ukubona izwe liya phambili.”UHlabisa ukuchithile ukuthi uthenjiswe ukunikwa isikhundla sePhini likaMengameli wesibili."UMthethosisekelo awuvumi ukuthi kube namaphini kamengameli amabili. Ngakho-ke laba abathi ngizokuba iphini likamengameli wesibili bakhuluma into engekho.”UHlabisa uthe beyi-IFP banesipiliyoni sokuphatha ezigabeni ezahlukene zikahulumeni."Kuzwelonke sasiyingxenye yohulumeni wokubambisana owawuphethe emva kokhetho lwango-1994. Sake saphatha KwaZulu-Natal, siphethe komasipala.”UHlabisa uthe ukuba yingxenye yohulumeni wokubambisana akusho ukuthi bazolahlekelwa ukuzimela."Sizoqhubeka nokuzimela. Manje isikhathi sokusebenzela izwe.”UHlabisa ukhale ngabantu abangayivotelanga i-IFP athe bafuna ukubakhethela ukuthi basebenze namaphi amaqembu."Angeke sivume abantu abangazange bayivotele i-IFP ukuba basilawule. Awukwazi ukufike ungasivoteli bese ufuna ukusikhethela ukuthi senzeni.”
IQEMBU uMkhonto Wesizwe (MK) lithi ligabe ngamanyundululu obufakazi obuqanda ikhanda bokukokotelwa kwemiphumela yokhetho. IMK ithi izimisele ngokuweneka ngesikhathi esifanele.I-MK isho lokhu emaphepheni ewafake enkantolo icela kumiswe ukuhlala kwePhalamende, elizofungisa amalungu amasha likhethe nomengameli. Kulindeleke ukuthi iPhalamende lihlale ngoLwesihlanu, kufungiswe amalungu amasha.Isolezwe liwabonile amaphepha aqondiswe eNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo lapho iMK icela ukuthi udaba lulalelwe ngokuphuthuma. AbeMK bathi bafisa udaba lulalelwe ungakashayi uLwesihlanu kaJuni 14, okuzohlala ngawo iPhalamende.Incwadi efungelwe ibhalwe nguNobhala-Jikelele weMK obambile, uMnuz Sihle Ngubane.Amaphepha aveza ukuthi kunenkindlane yobufakazi ummangali agadla ngabo athi buzovela ngesikhathi esifanele." Ummangali unezindodla zobufakazi obunye asaqhubeka nokubuqoqa, obuveza ukukokotelwa kwemiphumela kodwa asikabibikho isidingo sokubuveza okwamanje,’’ ngokombhalo wamaphepha.IMK emaphepheni ayo imangalela iNhloko yamaJaji kuleli iJaji Raymond Zondo, okunguyena ozosingatha umcimbi ngoLwesihlanu.Kuvela igama likaMnuz Xolile George, onguNobhala wePhalamende. I-IEC ingeyesithathu kwabamangalelwe ngodaba. Owesine wumengameli wezwe kodwa akagagulwanga ngegama.Kummangalelwe namaqembu anamalungu ePhalamende okulindeleke ukuthi afungiswe bese endaweni yesihlanu kube amaqembu angenamalungu ePhalamende.IMK phakathi kwezinto ezibalayo ithi ifuna imiphumela yokhetho ichithwe ngoba kuningi okungahambanga kahle. Ithi yakhala nangobuxhakaxhaka besimanje obaba nenkinga sekungena imiphumela.IMK ize ithi okunye okuxakayo wukuthi ngesikhathi iveza izikhalo zayo benamanye amaqembu ababutholanga ubulungiswa. Ithe abezindaba babuza ukuthi i-IEC ijaheni kodwa yathi inexhala ngodaba lwezimakethe.IMK iphinde ithinte udaba lwezihlalo ePhalamende okuyilona olubangwa kakhulu. IMK ithi umthetho uthi iPhalamende kufanele libe namalungu aqala kwangu-350 kuya phezulu. Bathe uma isibalo singaphansi kwalokho kuyobe kusho ukuhlala okungekho emthethweni.IMK ithi ifuna kuchithwe imiphumela yokhetho bese kubizwa olunye kabusha ezinsukwini ezingu-90. IMK inxusa inkantolo ukuthi ivune yona kwelokuthi i-IEC yagagamela ngokuthi imemezele imiphumela.Kwenzeka konke lokhu nje, iMK ithi ayilubhadi ePhalamende uma sekufungiswa amalungu ngoLwesihlanu. IMK inezihlalo ezingu-58 ePhalamende ezithole emuva kokhetho.IPhalamende limemezele ukuthi lihoxise amabhanoyi nezindawo zokulala nokunye abebekuhlelele amalungu eMK abezobe eyofungiswa.Amehlo azobe ethe njo ePhalamende njengoba kulindwe ukubona ukuthi uhulumeni uzokwakhiwa kanjani emuva kwezingxoxo zamaqembu.
USASHAQEKILE umndeni wowesilisa oboshelwe icala lokubulala uninakhulu, maqede washumpula ikhanda waligenda njengebhola endlini.UMnuz Thabo Ntokozo Nzimande (31) uthweswe icala lokubulala uNkk Beatrice de Lange oneminyaka engu-80, ngoLwesihlanu.UNzimande uvele eNkantolo yeMantshi yasePinetown ngoMsombuluko ngecala lokubulala okuhleliwe. Icala lihlehlele uJuni 27 ukuze umsolwa aphinde ahlolwe wudokotela isimo sakhe sengqondo.Amaphepha oMbuso, ombiko kadokotela wengqondo ohlole uNzimande ngoMsombuluko ngaphambi kokuthi avele enkantolo, aveza ukuthi umsolwa unesifo esiphazamisa indlela yokusebenza komqondo, i-bipolar.Kula maphepha, udokotela uthi uNzimande akakulungele ukubhekana naleli cala ngenxa yesimo sakhe sengqondo."Akakwazi ukunikeza incazelo ukuthi yini eyenzeka, akasikhumbuli nhlobo isigameko. Unomlando wokusebenzisa izidakamizwa. Ubesebenzisa imishanguzo yokuthithibalisa isifo anaso. Usengeniswe kathathu esikhungweni esisiza abanenkinga yezidakamizwa,” kusho udokotela embikweni.Umthombo osondelene nalolu daba uthe uNzimande utholakale egenda ikhanda lesidumbu sikamufi wase ekhalelwa amasongo kaSigonyela.Isihlobo sikamufi, ebesizwakala ocingweni ukuthi sikhungathekile, sithe bewumndeni kabathandi ukuphawula ngomshophi obehlele.Sivumile ukuthi senzekile isigameko, sathi umsolwa ubengazikhombisi izimpawu zokuba wumuntu onobungozi ngaphambi kokuthi kwenzeke le nkilayitheka.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa abizelwa emzini osePinetown afica owesilisa owayegqoke izimpahla ezigcwele igazi."Isidumbu sikamufi, esasingenalo ikhanda, satholakala egunjini lokulala. Ikhanda latholwa egunjini lokuphumula,” kusho uNetshiunda.Uqhube wathi amaphoyisa abe esethola ukuthi umsolwa ushumpule ikhanda likaninakhulu ngocelemba.Okhulumela uMnyango wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Mhlaba Memela, uthe sibaphathe kabi lesi sigameko sokubulawa kwesaguga.UMemela udlulise amazwi enduduzo emndenini ngokushona kwesalukazi."Umphakathi kumele uzithathele phezulu izifo eziphathelene nengqondo futhi kuliwe nesihlava sokusetshenziswa budedengu kwezidakamizwa ezibukeka ziqeda intsha,” kusho uMemela.
INKANTOLO eNkulu yaseThekwini igwebe owesilisa odilikajele abathathu neminyaka engu-85 ngoxhaxha lwamacala okukhona kuwo nawokubulala eMlaza.UBongumusa Sphesihle Radebe (25), wasesigcemeni kwa-B eMlaza, ugwetshwe ngoLwesithathu emini.Uwaphike kwaze kwaba sekugcineni amacala nokuthe uma esemgojele wacela uxolo emindenini yabagilwa.Ugixabezwe udilikajele icala ngalinye lokubulala uLoyiso Shabalala, Sthembiso Njapha noMthobisi Shibase.Abafi babulawa ngokudutshulwa ngoDisemba 2020, Meyi 2021 nangoJuni 2023.Ijaji liphinde lagweba uRadebe iminyaka engu-15 icala ngalinye kwamathathu okuzama ukubulala, neminye engu-15 icala ngalinye kwamabili okuphanga kuhlonyiwe.Inkantolo igwebe uRadebe iminyaka engu-10 ngokutholakala nesibhamu nezinhlamvu okungekho emthethweni nezinyanga ezingu-12 ngokutholakala nemoto okwakukholakala ukuthi uyebile.Enkantolo kuvele ukuthi lokhu kubulala kwakuthinta amaqembu amabili ezigelekeqe ayeqembukelene eselwa futhi kunombango ofaka phakathi izidakamizwa.
INHLANGANO iCouncil for the Advancement of South African Constitution (CASAC), isichithe eyokufakwa kwenhloko yamajaji uRaymond Zondo, ezingxoxweni zamaqembu ezepolitiki ngokubunjwa kukahulumeni wobumbano kuleli.Le nhlangano ithe uZondo akumele abe yingxenye yalo mhlangano noma kube nguye ozohlanganisa la maqembu, ngenxa yokuthi kumele angachemi, futhi angahlangani nezinto ezithinta ipolitiki ngoba wengamele umthetho.Ikusho lokhu kulandela ukuthi amaqembu ayisithupha, i-ACDP, ATM, BOSA, PAC, UDM ne-UAT ebhalele uZondo, emnxenxa ukuthi abe yingxenye yalezi zingxoxo ngokuthi aqoke ijaji eselathatha umhlalaphansi ukwengamela lezi zingxoxo.Awaneme ngokuthi i-ANC iyona ephakamise ukuthi kuxoxwe ngokuthi kube nohulumeni wobumbano emva kokuba lingekho iqembu elidle umhlanganiso okhethweni elingakwazi ukubumba uhulumeni lilodwa.Unobhala weCASAC uMnuz Lawson Naidoo, uthe akumele inhloko yamajaji izibandakanye nezepolitiki.Uthe kanjalo nejaji eselathatha umhlalaphansi akumele lifakwe ukwengamela lezi zingxoxo ngoba ngomuso kungabakhona abakhalayo."Isivuthiwe intando yabantu kuleli ngakho amaqembu angakwazi ukuzibambela izingxoxo ngawodwana, kungafakwa amajaji. Uhulumeni wobumbano wango-1994, wawulawulwa nguMthethosisekelo, yonke into eyayenzeka yayibhalwe phansi kubalwa nokuthi izihlalo zizokwabiwa kanjani. Namanje ngicabanga ukuthi umlando usengaziphinda, ngokuthi kusikwe iphethini kulokhu okwenzeka ngo-1994,” kusho uNaidoo.Uthe uma kwakhiwa lo hulumeni amaqembu kumele abeke eceleni ukungazwani, kodwa acabangele umphakathi.Ubalule ukuthi ezifundazweni elingekho iqembu elidle umhlanganiso kuzona, kudingeka iphathwe ngobunono ekahulumeni wobumbano noma uhulumeni wokubambisana ukuze izidingo ziqhubeke nokufinyelela emphakathini.UZondo akakawaphenduli la maqembu amnxenxe ukuthi angenelele.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi uZondo nguyena ozobamba izintambo ePhalamende uma sekufungiswa amalungu amasha, kukhethwa usomlomo nephini likasomlomo wePhalamende, kanjalo nokukhethwa kukamengameli omusha ezweni.
UTHOLWE necala lokuzama ukubulala nokudlwengula owayeyisosha, ongamtshelanga ayethandana naye ukuthi uphila negciwane lengculazi agcina emthelela ngalo.ULeon Santos Conga utholwe necala yiMantshi uFikiswa Ntlati enkantolo yasePitoli ngoLwesibili.Umgilwa, u-Antoinette Ndishishi, obemelwe wuphiko lwezokushushisa lwe-AfriForum wabika lolu daba kulo ngo-2018.I-AfriForum yaphoqa iSouth African National Defence Force (SANDF) ukuthi ikhiphe umlando wezempilo kaConga owaveza ukuthi wayazi ngokuthi unegciwane kusuka ngo-2007.Ithe ukunqaba kweSANDF ukuthi ikhiphe umlando kaConga kwenza ukuthi uphiko lwezokushushisa umphakathi, iNational Prosecuting Authority (NPA), iluhoxise kabili udaba enkantolo.Umgilwa u-Antoinette Ndishishi Isithombe: SithunyelweEsitatimendeni, i-AfriForum ithe imantshi ithole uConga enecala lokudlwengula ngoba uNdishishi wavuma ukuthi baye ocansini ngoba azi ukuthi akanalo igciwane. Ithe inkantolo ibamukele ubufakazi bukaNdishishi bokuthi ukuba uConga wasidalula isimo sakhe, wayengeke avume ukuthi balale njengoba lezi zithandani zakhuluma ngalolu daba kodwa uConga wayigodla imininingwane.UConga kuthiwa utholwe necala lokuzama ukubulala ngoba wathelela uNdishishi ngegciwane azi ukuthi unalo futhi wangamtshela.UNdishishi ubonge i-AfriForum, wathi ngaphambi kwayo ubesekwa wunina kuphela."Ngizwa ngathi ngithole ubulungiswa ngoba utholwe enamacala kuwona womabili, okungelokuzama ukubulala nokudlwengula. Uma ngikhuluma iqiniso, ngikhalile ngesikhathi ngizwa imantshi imthola necala. Ngikhale ngoba sengilwe iminyaka eyisikhombisa ngakho bengijabule. Kungaba kuhle ukuthi nabanye besifazane bavele bazibike izigameko ezinje ngoba eNingizimu Afrika baningi abatheleleka ngeHIV."Icala lihlehliselwe u-Agasti 7.

IMK yamemezela ukuthi iyamxosha uKhumalo nabanye abaholi besolwa ngokungethembeki.UKhumalo ususwe nasohlwini lweMK ePhalamende nokuwudaba asaluphosela inselelo enkantolo. Kulindeleke ukuthi iPhalamende lifungise amalungu ngoLwesihlanu emcimbini uKhumalo abezimisele ngokuwuhambela.
BABONGE uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi emva kokuhlanganisa izikhulu zamatekisi KwaZulu-Natal emhlanganweni obubanjelwe eDurban Central Police Station, eThekwini.Lo mhlangano bekungokwesibili uhlala njengoba owokuqala wawubanjelwe eMayville ngenyanga edlule.Lokhu kulandela ukuvala umgwaqo kosomatekisi bamabanga amade asePort Shepstone kanye naseThekwini.Osomatekisi bavala imigwaqo emikhulu okubalwa kuyo uthelawayeka uN2 ePort Shepstone no-N3 eThekwini bephazamisa ukuhamba kwezimoto bekhala ngokugqoza kokukhishwa kwezimvume zokusebenza ngaboMnyango wezokuThutha kulesi sifundazwe.Okhulumela inhlangano yamabanga amade ePort Shepstone, uMnuz Lizwi Maphumulo ekhuluma neSolezwe, uthe abenelisekile ngokuhlalukile kuwo lo mhlangano."Sizothatha ezinye izinyathelo njengoba sifike nommeli, sizoxoxa naye akwazi ukusilekelela ukuthi sigcine sikutholile esikufunayo,” kusho uMaphumulo.Uthe zikhona ezinye izindlela abazozizama ukulwa nale nkinga yezimvume ababhekene nayo embonini yamatekisi."Impela sizozama ukuya enkantolo futhi njengoba size safika lana sibonga igalelo likaMkhwanazi ngoba uyena osilekelele kakhulu. Njengoba samisa isiteleka, sasihlonipha yena. Ukube sasingamhloniphi sasizophinde sibuyele emgwaqeni,” usho kanje.Okunye okuhlalukile kuwo lo mhlangano yilapho ummeli obemele uMnyango wezokuThutha KwaZulu-Natal, u-Adv Nxumalo efunde umthetho, isigaba 50 se-National Land Transport Act esithinta ukugunyazwa kwezimoto ezithutha umphakathi, isigaba 87 esikhuluma ngokuboshwa kwezimoto kanye nesigaba 90 esikhuluma ngamacala nangenhlawulo uma izimoto seziboshiwe."Lo mthetho uthi akekho umuntu okwazi ukuthi asebenzise isithuthi somphakathi ngaphandle kokuthi abe nemvume emgunyazayo futhi imvume iyona enikeza isithuthi igunya lokusebenzisa uhlobo oluthize lwesithuthi,” kusho u-Adv Nxumalo.Uthe uma umuntu ezothutha umphakathi futhi ezohlomula kulokho, imvume iyadingeka."Uma umuntu ezothutha abantu, ikakhulukazi ngokwenkokhelo yamabhizinisi, kufanele abe nemvume yokukwenza lokho.”Obemele osomatekisi u-Adv Sinclair uyaphikisana nalokhu okushiwo umthetho esigabeni 87 mayelana nokuboshwa kwezimoto."Uma uwufunda lo mthetho, kunegama elithi 'kungenzeka’, okungezinye zezinto eziletha izinkinga engicabanga ukuthi osomatekisi bahlangabezana nazo ngoba osomatekisi bayazifaka izicelo zezimvume kodwa lezo mvume aziphumi ngaleso sikhathi ekumele ziphume ngaso,” usho kanje.UNkk Nokulunga Hlophe ubacaciselile osomatekisi ngemigudu elandelwayo uma befaka izicelo zezimvume. Uthe uma bezifakile izicelo, zithatha izinsuku ezingu-60 ukuthi ziphume, uma kuyizicelo zezimvume zezimoto ezihamba amabanga amade umthetho esigabeni 65 uthe akumele bakhiphe izimvume umasipala ungavumile.
UMASIPALA waseThekwini, uwanqumele ugwayi katiki amaqembu ezepolitiki wathi zingapheli izinsuku ezingu-30 emuva kokhetho, engazisusile izingqwembe zokhetho ezigxotsheni.Umkhandlu uqhuba uthi uma kuneqembu noma umuntu ohlulekayo ukususa izingqwembe, umasipala uzozisusa ngokwawo bese lowo othintekayo ekhokha izindleko zomsebenzi wokususelwa zona.Lokhu kudalulwe ngoLwesibili ngokhulumela uMasipala weTheku, uNkk Gugu Sisilana ephendula imibuzo yephephandaba.Umhlangano wamakhansela eTheku owawungoNovemba nyakenye, waphasisa imibandela ephathelene nokhetho obelungoMeyi 29.Eminye yayo ithi inhlangano noma umuntu ongenele ukhetho kumele akhokhe idiphozithi kaR200, ebuyiswayo, ukuze aphanyeke izingqwembe ewadini eyodwa.Abangenela ukhetho bakalelwa ukuthi zingeqi ku-800 izingqwembe zeqembu noma ezokungenela ukhetho kwiwadi ngayinye."Emuva kokhetho, idiphozithi ekhokhiwe izogcinwa esikhwameni izinyanga ezintathu, kukhokhelwe ngayo izindleko zomsebenzi wokususwa kwezingqwembe,” kuchaza umasipala.Uma iqembu noma ongenele ukhetho ehluleka ukususa izingqwembe ngokwakhe, uyobe esekhokhiswa zonke izindleko zomsebenzi wokususelwa uqwembe ngalunye oluphanyekwe esigxotsheni.Eminye yemibandela ebibekiwe ukuthi iqembu noma ongenele ukhetho bangaphanyeki izingqwembe ezimbili esigxotsheni esisodwa.Alikho iqembu lepolitiki noma ongenele ukhetho ngokuzimela obekade evumelekeke ukuthi akhangise kuthelawayeka uN2, N3, eNkosi Albert Luthuli International Convention Centre (ICC), nasolwandle (Marine Parade/Snell Parade).Bekungavumelekile ukuphanyeka izingqwembe zokhetho emabhulohweni, ezindongeni nasezihlahleni.
ABAMANGALELWA ecaleni lokufa kukaSenzo Meyiwa bathi bazoyeka ukuya enkantolo ngoba abakwazi ukugeza ejele ngoba bageziswa ngamanzi abandayo njengoba kubanda nje.UMeyiwa owayengunozinti we-Orlando Pirates neBafana Bafana, wadutshulwa wabulawa ekubo kwentombi yakhe uKelly Khumalo eVosloorus, eGauteng ngo-2014.Kusafakaza uNksz Pinky Vythilingham osebenzela iVodacom nowethula ubufakazi bokuxhumana ngamaselula abamangalelwa.U-Advocate Charles Mnisi wethule isikhalo sekhasimende lakhe eliwummangalelwa wesithathu uMnuz Mthobisi Mncube. UMnisi uthe kunenkinga yamanzi ashisayo angaphumi ejele eKgosi Mampuru II nokuthwalisa kanzima ikhasimende lakhe."Akakwazi ukugeza ekuseni ngoba uhlala egumbini elinamanzi abandayo selokhu kuqale ubusika. Akaze ageze kusukela ngoLwesine ngoba kumakhaza kakhulu,’’ kusho uMnisi.Ubalule namanye amaphuzu athe uMncube ukhala ngawo, afisa alungiswe."Selokhu avalelwa egumbini lakhe yedwa lapha eC-Max akakwazi nokushayela umndeni ucingo, akunathelevishini, akaxoxi namuntu. Izikhulu zejele zithi ugcinwe kanjalo ngenxa yokuthi uwummangalelwa kuleli cala,’’ kusho uMnisi.Uthe ikhasimende lakhe selihlale egunjini lalo lodwa iminyaka emine nokuyinto ebukeka iwukujezisa ngaphandle kokutholwa enecala.Uveze nokuthi ikhasimende lakhe linendawo elalimala kuyona kudala esebuhlungu namanje futhi lidinga usizo lwezempilo. Uthe ikhasimende lakhe lisola ukuthi ukugeza ngamanzi abandayo kuvusa izinhlungu lapha lalimala khona.UMnisi uthe ucela kubizwe isikhulu sejele sizochazela inkantolo ngoba uke wakhuluma naso kodwa asisazibambi izingcingo zakhe.Kuthe kusabhekwe lokho kwasukuma u-Advocate Zandile Mshololo omele ummangalelwa wesihlanu uMnuz Fisokuhle Ntuli, naye ekhala esifanayo."Ikhasimende lami uNtuli lihlala ejele elifanayo, nalo likhala ngawo amanzi abandayo futhi lingase lingezi enkantolo ngoba alikwazi ukugeza,’’ kusho u-Advocate Mshololo.UMshushisi woMbuso u-Advocate George Baloyi uthe bayaqala ukuzwa ngalesi sikhalo kodwa bazojuba ithimba labaphenyi becala balulungise lolu daba.IJaji Ratha Mokgotlheng liyalele uBaloyi ukuthi aqinisekise ukuthi lolu daba luyalungiswa.
IFUNA izimpendulo ngamathuna ayo ambiwe ingatshelwe lutho imindeni engaphezu kweyishumi eNgwadini eMzinto njengoba kuqhubeka uhlelo lokwakhiwa kwedamu kule ndawo.Ngokusho kukaNksz Nomathemba Madlala, ongomunye wabantu okumbiwe amathuna akubo, bekuyinyanga edlule ngesikhathi bethola ngalo monakalo.Uthe awakubo amathuna athintekile ayisishiyagalombili."Sathola izingcingo kwabanye abantu bendawo, besazisa ukuthi ambiwe amathuna asekhaya kanjalo nawakweminye imizi eseyaba ngamanxiwa kule ndawo,” kusho uNksz Madlala.Uthe emva kwesehlakalo, kube khona imihlangano ababe nayo naboMngeni-uThukela Water kodwa zangaphuma izimpendulo zokuthi umonakalo wenzeke kanjani.Uthe eminyakeni emibili edlule, ngesikhathi kuvela izindaba zokuthi kuzokwakhiwa idamu, zabizwa zonke izakhamuzi zendawo zatshelwa ngokuthuthukiswa kwendawo ngokuthi kwakhiwe idamu.Uthe ngaleso sikhathi batshelwa ukuthi abantu abasahlala endaweni bazothuthwa bayokwakhelwa kwenye indawo nokuyinto eyenzeka.Uqhube wathi kwaphinde wathiwa kuzoqinisekiswa ukuthi amathuna akule ndawo awathintwa."Baze bafaka ucingo babiya indawo enamathuna, bethi benzela ukuthi bayibone kahle indawo okungafanele bayithinte. Simangele uma sesithola ukuthi balususile ucingo, baqhubeka nomsebenzi wokumba lapho ababethe ngeke bambe khona,” kusho uNksz Madlala.Uthe okwenzekile kuyabakhathaza njengoba bengabantu abasazisayo isintu.Uthe okokuqala, basafuna izimpendulo zokuthi ubani ogunyaze ukuthi kumbiwe amathuna bona bengatshelwe lutho."Asazi nokuthi amathambo abathandiweyo bethu bawambe bayowalahlaphi. Lokho kwenza singahlali kahle ngoba asazi ukuthi kuzoba nomthelela ongakanani empilweni yethu,” kusho uNksz Madlala.Uqhube wathi bayakholelwa ekutheni kufanele benze imisebenzi ethile ukushweleza ngokuthintwa kwamathuna."AboMngeni kufanele basinxephezele ngomonakalo odalekile ukuze sizokwazi ukwenza imisebenzi yokushweleza ngokuthikanyezwa kwamathuna,” kusho uNksz Madlala.Induna yendawo, uMnuz Kwenzakwenkosi Bele, ivumile ukuthi udaba iyalwazi, yathi luyalungiswa ezingeni lobukhosi bendawo."Kunemihlangano elokhu ihlala kusukela kwaqala ukubonakala ukuthi kwenzeke umonakalo. Kule mihlangano basuke bekhona nabo aboMngeni. Sinethemba lokuthi isiphetho esifanele sizoba khona, bawulungise umonakalo abawenzile, wokuthinta amangcwaba abantu,” kusho uBele.Abophiko lwezokuchumana kuMngeni-Uthukela Water bakuqinisekisile ukuthi bayitholile imibuzo ngalolu daba kodwa baveza ukuthi basalinde umbiko ngokwenzeka kule ndawo. Kuvela lesi sikhalo nje, ngenyanga edlule uhulumeni ubuhlangene nabantu baseMaqadini, eNanda kuyokwenziwa umcimbi wokushweleza emuva kokuthi kwasuswa abantu, kule ndawo ngesikhathi kwakhiwa iNanda Dam, kwasala amathuna abantu okukholakala ukuthi kwakhiwa phezu kwawo idamu.
UKUGUQUGUQUKA kobufakazi obethulwe ngomunye wofakazi ngesigameko sokubulawa ngokungqongqiswa kwabathathu, eNkanini, eCato Manor kugcine kuphoqa iJaji kuleli cala ukuba lizifikele mathupha endaweni yesigameko.IJaji uMahandra Chetty kuvele ukuthi lihambile nethimba lalo beyobona lapho okwenzeka khona isigameko.Kuvela ukuthi ngoJanuwari 25, 2022 kwagasela abantu abayisithupha endlini lapho okwakuhlala khona abesilisa abathathu ababesolwa ngokuhlalisa lubhojozi umphakathi.Kuthiwa bakhishwa endlini bafakwa emotweni bangqongqiswa bephila. Kulesi sigameko kwabulawa oMnuz Phumlani Tshekele, Numkile Mfenqe noRefilwe Mokoena.Babesolwa ngezigameko zokudlwengula nokudayisa izindlu zabantu ngodli.Ngemuva kwesigameko kwaboshwa oMnuz Bangomniseli Khondlo (41) odume ngelikaJomo, Vusimuzi Mazula (46), Thandekile Penelope Sithuntasa (37), Siphenathi Zoko (28), Mfanafuthi Muzi Masikane ( 37) noScelo Thusi (39).Selokhu kuqaliwe ukuqulwa kwecala kunofakazi ozichaza njengowayekhona ngosuku lwesigameko. Igama lakhe ligodliwe ngenxa yezizathu zokuphepha.Kodwa okuqaphelekile enkantolo ukuthi ukhuluma aphinde aziphikise. Kokunye athi wabona aphinde ashaye ungqimphothwe athi okunye akakubonanga.Yikho lokhu okugcine kuphoqa iJaji ukuba lizifikele mathupha endaweni yesigameko."Bekumqoka ukuba ngihambe ngifike endaweni yesigameko ngoba bekukuningi ukudideka uma ufakazi efakaza," lisho kanje.Phakathi kwezinye zezizathu okuvela ukuthi zigcine zidala ukuthi iJaji liye endaweni yesigameko ukuthi ufakazi uthi wakubona konke okwakwenzeka ngosuku lwesigameko ekubeni wayebuqamama.Kuvela ukuthi ngesikhathi sesigameko ufakazi wabaleka wangena ehlathini, waqhela ngebanga endlini lapho okwathathwa khona ababulawa.IJaji liye endaweni yesigameko lifuna ukuzibonela mathupha ukuthi kule ndawo ufakazi athi wayekuyona kwakungenzeka yini ukuthi abone konke okwakwenzeka.Belifuna nokubona ukuthi ikude kangakanani inkundla yezemidlalo ufakazi athi wadlula kuyona ngesikhathi ebaleka.Yize selibuya khona endaweni yesigameko kodwa ufakazi ubesaqhubeka nokulidida iJaji. Icala liyaqhubeka.
UMNYANGO wezokuThutha uthi sekuseduze ufike umshini ozoshicilela ngokushesha amalayisensi okushayela.Lo mshini ozolandwa e-Europe kulindeleke ukuthi ushicilele amalayisensi kungakadluli izinsuku ezinhlanu.Bekufanele ufike ngoMeyi kodwa awufikanga ngenxa yokuthi kusalandelwa izinhlelo zikahulumeni zokuthenga impahla.UMnuz Collen Msibi okhulumela uMnyango wezokuThutha, uthe bekufanele kulandelwe izinhlelo zokuthenga impahla kodwa wona umshini ozoshicilela amalayisensi ngokushesha uyeza."Sicela abantu basibekezelele ngoba simatasa nezinhlelo ezilandelwa uma kuthengwa impahla. Sizodedela ikomiti elibhekele amabhidi okuthengwa kwempahla ukuba lenze umsebenzi walo,” kusho uMsibi.Uthe okwamanje akekho umuntu oselinde isikhathi eside engayitholi ilayisensi kodwa kuzothengwa umshini omusha ngoba omdala usufa njalo.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi ngesikhathi seCovid-19 kwaphazamiseka ukushicilelwa kwamalayisensi emuva kokufa komshini wokuwashicilela.Kwavela ukuthi umshini wawuthengwe eGermany ngo-1998, uma ufile kuyama ukushicilelwa kwamalayisensi kwazise izipele zokuwulungisa zilandwa eGermany.UMnuz Fikile Mbalula owayenguNgqongqoshe wezokuThutha waveza ukuthi izinsimbi zokuwulungisa azikho kuleli futhi naseGermany abasalusebenzisi lolu hlobo lomshini ukushicilela amalayisensi.Yikhona lokhu okwenza ukuthi uhulumeni anqume ukuthenga umshini omusha wokushicilela amalayisensi okuthiwa azohluka kakhulu kulawa akhona njengamanje ngoba azobe esenobuchwepheshe obuthe xaxa.Kulindeleke ukuthi amalayisensi amasha abe yikhadi elicishe lifane nelomazisi omusha. Kuthiwa nawo azoba nemininingwane yomuntu akwazi nokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe be-biometric.
IZAZI zomthetho zithi uMkhonto weSizwe (MK) awunathuba lokuphumelela ngisho ungaya enkantolo ngenhloso yokuvimba ukuthi kufungiswe amalungu njengoba kunezikhalo ngemiphumela yokhetho.Iqembu elisha i-MK ifuna buchitheke bugayiwe njengoba izama ukumisa izinhlelo zokuhlala komhlangano wokuqala wePhalamende. I-MK isabisa nangokuya enkantolo iyovimba ukuhlala kwePhalamende ukuze kulungiswe isikhalo sayo ngemiphumela yokhetho.Zinkani zababili njengoba iPhalamende likubeke kwacaca ukuthi liyaqhubeka nezinhlelo zalo noma ngabe abe-MK abezi. Kulindeleke ukuthi iPhalamende lihlale okokuqala lifungise amalungu, kukhethwe uSomlomo bese kuvotelwa noMengameli ngoLwesihlanu.Umsindo ususwa wukuthi i-MK ayeneme ngemiphumela yokhetho obelungenyanga edlule nalapho iwole khona inqwaba yezihlalo. I-MK ithi akulungiswe isikhalo sayo ngaphambi kokuhlala kwePhalamende.OWAYENGUMENGAMELI uJacob Zuma osewumholi weMK akayizwa eyokuthi kuhlale iPhalamende ekubeni izikhalo zabo zingakalungiswa Isithombe : FACEBOOK/UMKHONTO WESIZWE PARTYUngoti wezomthetho uSolwazi Pierre de Vos ekhuluma neNewzroom Afrika, uthe iPhalamende livunwa wumthetho ukuthi liqhubeke nomsebenzi."Mancane amathuba okuthi inkantolo imise ukuhlala kwePhalamende, njengamanje amalungu akhethiwe angu-400 futhi abhaliwe ohlwini. Bangamalungu ePhalamende kumanje umehluko wukuthi abakwazi ukuqala ukusebenza bengafungile,’’ kusho uDe Vos.Uthe umthetho uthi uma kukhona amalungu angafikanga kuyaqhubeka ukuhlala kodwa umuntu uma ephuthwe yimihlangano engu-15 ilandelana engabiki kufanele athathelwe izinyathelo achithwe.Omunye ungoti wezomthetho uMnuz Mpumelelo Zikalala weZikalala Attorneys, uthe umhlangano wePhalamende uzobe usemthethweni. UZikalala uthe kuyaqala ukwenzeka lokhu kodwa akuyona ingqinamba yinto ecacile nje."Uhlu lwamalungu ePhalamende lukhona aselinde ukufunga bese eyasebenza. Mancane amathuba okuphumelela enkantolo uma uzama ukuvimba ukuhlala kwePhalamende,’’ kusho uZikalala.Uthe okokuqala uma i-MK iya enkantolo kuyofanele kube wudaba oluphuthumayo."Uma udaba luphuthuma kufanele kube wukuthi kunamalungelo azophazamiseka, kunomonakalo omkhulu oyobe ungeke usalungiseka bese kuba wukuthi alukho olunye uhlaka olungalungisa udaba,’’ kusho uZikalala.Uthe uma ubheka amaphuzu amathathu angenhla kuzoba nzima ukuthi udaba lwamukeleke. Uthe iMK bekufanele ifake udaba eNkantolo yezoKhetho ngaphambi kokuya eNkantolo yezoMthethosisekelo.UNobhala wePhalamende, uMnuz Masibulele Xaso, naye obekhuluma kwithelevishini, uthe amalungu ePhalamende asekhethiwe futhi azofungiswa ngoLwesihlanu."Konke kumi ngomumo umhlangano uzohlala kufungiswe amalungu ePhalamende noma ngabe kukhona amanye aqoke ukungezi. Uhlu lukhona lunikwe inhloko yamajaji yona yalunika iPhalamende,’’ kusho uXaso.
