IMANGOSUTHU University of Technology (MUT), isixwayise abafaka izicelo zokuthola izikhala zokufunda kule nyuvesi, ukuthi baqaphele amaqola azama ukubagebenga imali ngethemba lokuthi bazobatholela izikhala zokufunda. Umyalezo othunyelwe ekhasini lenyuvesi uveza ukuthi abenza lo mkhuba, baheha abafaka izicelo ukuthi bakhokhe imali ukuze bathole izikhala zokufunda besebenzisa izindlela ezehlukene okubalwa ne-E Wallet, Money Send nokukhokha ezitolo uSpar noShoprite. Kuthiwa abenza lokhu basebenzisa inkundla yezokuxhumana i-WhatsApp. Inyuvesi ithe ayizisebenzisi zonke lezi zinhlelo uma kukhokhwa kulesi sikhungo."Abenza lo mkhonyovu abasebenzeli inyuvesi ngoba ayizisebenzisi lezi zinhlelo uma kukhokhelwa izikhala zokufunda. Izikhala zitholakala ngokuthi ufake isicelo kwi-Central Applications Office (CAO), usebenzisa imiphumela yakwaGrade 12. Sifuna ukuxwayisa abazokhokha besebenzisa lezi zinhlelo ukuthi ngeke bazithole izikhala ngoba imali isuke ingayi enyuvesi,” kushoisixwayiso.Sibuye sabalula ukuthi isikhungo asixhumani nabafake izicelo kusetshenziswa inkundla i-WhatsApp."Sixhumana nabafake izicelo sisebenzisa inombolo yocingo umuntu asuke efake ngayo isicelo kwi-CAO. Imali yaseMUT ikhokhwa ebhange i-Absa kuphela.” Kuxwayiswe nangokuthi abafaka izikhala bangakhokheli muntu imali noma kuthiwa isitshudeni noma umsebenzi wakule nyuvesi ukuze bathole izikhala zokufunda."Sinxusa abaziyo ngalabo abafuna imali kulabo abafuna izikhala zokufunda enyuvesi ukuthi babampimpe. Bangabika ku:0800 228 999 ngoba akuvumelekile ukugwazelwa kwezikhala zokufunda kulesi sikhungo,” kusho umyalezo.
AMAPHOYISA athungatha abasolwa abasinde ngokulambisa ngesikhathi eqotha abane okuthiwa bebehamba nabo okukholakala ukuthi badubule babhekisa ngasemaphoyiseni abezama ukubabopha, bebamba inkunzi usomabhizinisi ephuma ebhange, eHarding, ngoMsombuluko ekuseni.Kuthiwa abasolwa bahlale ezithendeni usomabhizinisi obengene enxanxatheleni yezitolo kule ndawo wakhipha isamba semali esingadalulwanga. Kusolakala ukuthi bebezama ukumbamba inkunzi ngesikhathi behlangabezana namaphoyisa. Kunokuthi bathobele ukuboshwa, bavulela ngenhlamvu bebhekise kuwona nawo aphendula ngendlela efanayo, kwafa abane.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe ithimba lamaphoyisa oluhlanganisa awophiko loKlebe, olwe- K9 namanye eHarding, lithole umbiko wezobunhloli ngokubanjwa kwenkunzi obekungase kwenzeke."Ngesikhathi amaphoyisa esondela kubasolwa, banqabile ukulandela umyalelo wawo badubula babhekisa ngakuwona. Amaphoyisa aphendule ngendlela efanayo, kwafa abane. Amaphoyisa asezithendeni zabanye abasolwa ababaleke ngababili endaweni yesehlakalo,” usho kanje.Uthe imali ebithathiwe nesibhamu kutholwe kubasolwa abadutshuliwe. Unxuse noma ngubani ongaba nolwazi olungasiza amaphoyisa ekubanjweni kwabasolwa abasagcwele amathafa ukuthi babike esiteshini samaphoyisa esiseduze noma bafonele ku-08600 10 111.Kwenzeka lokhu nje amaphoyisa asanda kuthela othulini abasolwa ababili, kwathi owesithathu wangeniswa esibhedlela elimele, abadutshulwe ngasePhoenix abebelandelwa ngamaphoyisa ngecala lokubanjwa kwemoto ethwala imali emgwaqeni u-R74 ngaseKranskop ngesonto eledlule. Ngenyanga edlule aqothe abayisithupha nabo okuthiwa bebedubulana nawo, abebefunwa ngamacala okubamba inkunzi imoto yemali, okwenzeke ezigamekweni ezehlukene eCamperdown naseKlaarwater.
ULAXAZE ukufaka isicelo sebheyili, ngenxa yolaka lwamalungu omphakathi, umakhenikha okuthiwa ungowokufika oboshelwe ukubulala ngesihluku umfelokazi nendodana yakhe okuvela ukuthi ubegoloza ukubabuyisela imali okwakuthengwe ngayo imoto eminyakeni edlule egcine ingafinyelelanga kubona, eDundee kuMasipala waseNdumeni, ngesonto eledlule.Umsolwa okuvele ukuthi ungowokudabuka ezweni elingaphandle, Isolezwe elithole ukuthi ubizwa ngo-Ali, kuthiwa uboshwe ngesonto eledlule emva kokubulawa ngesihluku kukaNkk Ntombifuthi Buthelezi nendodana yakhe uMnuz Mncedisi Buthelezi (20), izidumbu zabo ezatholwa zinamanxeba okudutshulwa, zigxivizwe emakhanda ngezinsimbi ezingamathuluzi okukhishwa ngawo izinjini zezimoto, zidindilize endaweni yokulungisa izimoto umsolwa asebenzela kuyo esedolobheni, eDundee. Indodakazi kaNkk Buthelezi kuthiwa yona isasesibhedlela emva kokuthi yakwazi ukuphunyuka ibaleke nenxeba lokudutshulwa, ngesikhathi umsolwa ehlasela unina nomfowabo. Umsolwa obevele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseDundee okuthiwa beyigcwele phama amalungu omphakathi abebhikisha nangaphandle, uncamele ukungasifaki isicelo isebheyili, okuholele ekutheni imantshi inqume ukulihlehlisela uJulayi 15 kulo nyaka icala.Umakhelwane osondelene nomndeni wakwaButhelezi ongathandanga ukudalulwa, elandisa Isolezwe ngokwenzekile, uthe uNkk Buthelezi ubezihlalela nje nomndeni wakhe abewa evuka nawo njengoba ubesebenza umsebenzi ongatheni."Ngikholwa ukuthi ngesikhathi kudlula emhlabeni ubaba wekhaya owayesebenza kwamasipala oshone eminyakeni edlule, enye imali umndeni wanquma ukuthenga ngayo imoto ku-Ali (umsolwa), kodwa wagcina engayidluliselanga kuwona ebika imbiba nebuzi ekubeni imali wayeseyithathile. Ngenxa yokuhamba kwesikhathi, ngesonto eledlule umndeni umfonelile usufuna ukuthi abuyise imali okungcono, nokuyilapho ebabizele lapho ehlala khona e-Forestdale, uma befika wabanxusa ukuthi bahambe naye baye lapho esebenzela khona endaweni yakhe esedolobheni,” usho kanje.Uthe ngokulandisa kwelungu lomndeni elisinde kubulawa abakwabo, umsolwa uxabane noNkk Buthelezi kubangwa ukuthi ubesegoloza ukukhokha imali, wadonsa isibhamu wamdubula. Uthe ngesikhathi indodana kamufi ibona kudutshulwa unina, izame ukusondela, umsolwa wadubula ebhekise ngakuyo ngaphambi kokuthi adubule nendodakazi kamufi ekwazile ukubaleka nenxeba ibhace ndawana thile emva kokuthi isibhamu somsolwa siphelelwe izinhlamvu. Kuthiwa umsolwa ugxivize ikhanda likaNkk Buthelezi ngokusansimbi, ephindelela emva kokuthi eqedele ngesando esendodana yakhe kubuka ilungu lomndeni ebelibhacile.Ikhansela kule ndawo, uMnuz Andile Nsibande, uthe lesi sigameko sishiye amalungu omphakathi eshaqekile."Yisihluku esikhulu esingagcina sisusa uthuthuva emphakathini. Lokhu kungadweba isithombe esibi ngabantu bokufika okungadala udweshu kodwa ngoba uboshiwe siyethemba ukuthi ubulungiswa buzokwenzeka,” usho kanje.Uqinisekise ukuthi abagilwa bangcwatshwe ngempelasonto. Imizamo yokuthola okhulumela umndeni ayiphumelelanga njengoba izinombolo zocingo zingatholakalanga kwaze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela.
IQEMBU lezepolitiki i-IFP, KwaZulu-Natal selinxuse uhulumeni ukuthi amemezele uThongathi, eThekwini, olukhahlanyezwe yisishingishane njengendawo yenhlekelele.Isishingishane esinamandla esihlasele esifundazweni ngesonto eledlule, sishaye kwazwela oThongathi kwacekeleka phansi imizi elinganiselwa ku-2 000, kwathi abantu ababalelwa ku-8 000 basala dengwane.UMnuz Les Govender, oyilungu le- IFP esiShayamthetho, usenxuse uMphathiswa eMnyangweni wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana KwaZulu-Natal uNkk Bongiwe Sithole-Moloi noNdunankulu kulesi sifundazwe uNkk Nomusa Dube-Ncube ukuthi bamemezele indawo yasoThongathi njengeyehlelwe yinhlekelele. Bangu-12 abantu okuthiwa badlule emhlabeni."Emva kokuhambela ezinye izindawo ezikhona oThongathi okuyiSandfields, Faibreeze, Magwaveni, Newtown, Sea Tides, Greylands nakwezinye, kubonakele ukuthi zikhahlamezekile, ngakho sikholelwa ukuthi uhulumeni kumele anikeze okokufihla amakhanda ngokushesha emphakathini osale ungenamakhaya. Le nhlekelele eyenzeke oThongathi iveze ubuthaka ngasekulungiseleleni ukubhekena nezimo ezifuze lezi nokuhlela nje ngokubekwa kwezakhiwo,” usho kanje.Uthe kufanele kube namaqhinga okungenelela ezimeni ezinjengalezi, kungaba athinta imvelo noma noma ingqalasizinda ukuqinisekisa ukuphendula ngokushesha uma kwehla umshophi nokugwema ukubambezeleka. Le nhlekelele idale ukuphazamiseka kokuhanjiswa kwamanzi nokuphakelwa kukagesi kodwa iMeya kuMasipala weTheku, uMnuz Molisi Kaunda ebihambele khona ngoLwesihlanu, iqinisekise ukuthi abasebenzi baphansi phezulu ukubuyisela isimo kwesejwayelekile.Okhulumela uphiko lwezibonelelo zikahulumeni, i-South African Social Security Agency KwaZulu-Natal, uNksz Sandy Godlwana, uthe u-R4 968 700 yimali esetshenziswe wuphiko ukwelekelela abehlelwe yinhlekelele oThongathi."Abasebenzi bamatasa ukuqinisekisa ukuhlinzeka ngokudla okuphekiwe nsuku zonke, kubagilwa abangu-2001, ukuhlinzeka ngezingubo zokulala, izimpahla zezingane, omatrasi nokunye okubalulekile, ” kusho uNksz Godlwana.
BAHLALELE ovalweni osomabhizinisi abangabanikazi bezindawo zokucima ukoma emva kokusocongwa kwabanye babo kulandelana. Lokhu kuza emva kokudutshulwa kubulawe uMnuz Zola Kweyama wakwa-A eMlaza. Kuvela ukuthi udutshulwe ekuseni ngabesilisa abathathu abafike bazenza abantu abazothenga utshwala. "Sididekile ukuthi kungani ebulewe ngesihluku esingaka uKweyama ngoba ubengumuntu wabantu,” kusho umthombo.UKweyama udutshulwe ngoyaba lwezinhlamvu waphelela endaweni yesigameko. Udutshulwa nje kusasa kuzobe kungcwatshwa umelaphi wendabuko, uMnuz Nhlanhla Cele, uSbushebushe, naye obenendawo yokucima ukoma encikene nekaKweyama.Naye uCele wadutshulwa ngeledlule esendaweni yakhe yokucima ukoma, iYellow Lounge, ngamadoda angaziwa. Badutshulwa nje emasontweni edlule kwadutshulwa umnikazi wendawo yokucima ukoma ese-Reunion, engekho kude naseMlaza.Khona eMlaza kwa-E kunowesilisa obenendawo yokucima ukoma naye okuthiwa ubulawe ngendlela efanayo.Ezinyangeni ezedlule kusocongwe induna yaseMbumbulu, nayo ebinendawo yokucima ukoma khona eMbumbulu.Nayo yadutshulwa ngoyaba lwezinhlamvu ngamadoda angaziwa ngesikhathi esevala endaweni yakhe.EMgungundlovu, ekuqaleni kwalo nyaka, kwabulawa owesifazane obenendawo yokucima ukoma ngokudutshulwa.Lokhu sekudale itwetwe kubanikazi bezindawo zokucima ukoma.USihlalo weSisonke Liquor Traders KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Brush Mncadi, uthe bakhathazekile ngokwanda kwezigameko zokusocongwa kwabo."Sihlalele ovalweni ngoba asazi sixabene nobani. Akekho futhi umuntu oseke weza kithina ezobeka isikhalo sakhe ngathi. Lokho kusishiya ebumnyameni ukuthi kwenzekani njengoba sibulawa. "Kumanje sesicabanga nokuthi sithole onogada abazosiqapha kodwa nakhona sinenkinga yokuthi asinayo imali eyanele ukuthi singabakhokhela,” kusho uMncadi.UMncadi uqhube wathi abasaqondi noma abahlaseli babo kunomyalezo abaqonde ukuwudlulisa yini ukuze uma sebekhuluma kuzwakale.Uqhube wathi into ebaphatha kabi ukuthi lezi zigameko ziphazamisa osomabhizinisi abamnyama.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uCol Robert Netshiunda, uthe esigamekweni sayizolo kuphenywa icala lokubulawa kowesilisa oneminyaka engu-57 obengumnikazi wendawo yokucima ukoma. "Kule ndawo yokucima ukoma kungene owesilisa ephethe isibhamu esikhulu wadubula ebhekise kumnikazi wendawo obemi ngemuva kwetafula lokudayisa. Emva kwemizuzwana kuphinde kwangena omunye wesilisa ephethe isibhamu esincane waqhubeka wadubula umnikazi wendawo yokucima ukoma esemdubulela eduze. Baqede lapho baphuma babaleka, kumanje basathungathwa abenze lokhu,” kusho uCol Netshiunda.
UMLAWULI wesikhashana wesikhwama esixhasa izitshudeni ngemali yokufunda neyokuhlala ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme, iNational Student Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS), usehlabe ikhwelo komastende abaqashise izitshudeni ukuthi bangazixoshi lezo ezisakweleta imali ngoba bayalusebenza udaba lwazo. UMnuz Freeman Nomvalo, usebathembise ukuthi izikhalazo zabo bahlela ukuzixazulula ungakashayi uJuni 18, 2024. Uthe selokhu eqale umsebenzi kulesi sikhwama abanye babantu ahlangana nabo ababalulekile kubona omastende ngoba bahlalisa izitshudeni zabo. "Ezinye zezikhalazo zabo yindaba yokuthi abakhokhelwa. Sibafakelile omastende imali yabo ngenyanga edlule kanti sizophinde sibakhokhele enye ingxenye yemali maphakathi noJuni. Yingakho ngibanxusa ukuthi labo abangakhokhelwe ukuthi bangazixoshi izitshudeni ezikweletayo. Siyaqinisekisa ukuthi bonke omastende siyabakhokhela ngoba asifuni kube nalabo abangayitholi imali yabo.” Uthe isasebenza ne-email abangathumela kuyona baveze izikhao zabo."Bangathumela ku: [email protected]. Sicela kuthumele labo abakhalaza ngokungakhokhelwa.” Uphinde wanxusa nezitshudeni ezifunda emakolishi amakhono amaTVET ezingenawo ama-akhawunti asemabhange ukuthi ziwavule ukuze kungabambezeleki ukukhokhelwa kwemihlomulo yazo.Uthe imininingwane yasebhange kumele kube eyesitshudeni ukuze kufane yonke into uma sekuqhathaniswa ulwazi lwasemabhange. Uphinde waxwayisa umphakathi kanjalo nalabo abagxeka umsebenzi osuwenziwe ukulungisa izinto kulesi sikhwama okwenzeka ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, ukuthi bapheze ukwenza lokhu.Uveze ukuthi abanezikhalazo bangakwazi ukuxhumana naye ngqo."Sivuleleke kunoma ngubani ukuthi axhumane nathi uma enezikhalazo. Inhloso yethu sonke ukulungisa izinto ukuze izitshudeni zithole izimfanelo zazo.”
UMNYANGO wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uthi uyalusukumela udaba lwezikole ezicekeleke phansi, kugasela isiphepho kulesi sifundazwe ngesonto eledlule. Isiphepho sishiye amanye amalungu omphakathi esele dengwane kuphephuka imizi nezinye izikhungo zikahulumeni.Sishaye kwazwela kakhulu oThongathi njengoba iminingi imizi ecekeleke phansi kwakhona nabadlula emhlabeni.Okhulumela umnyango uMnuz Muzi Mahlambi, uthe bathole umbiko wezikole ezingu-20 ezicekeleke phansi ngenxa yalesi simo, kanti isikole esisoThongathi, i-Seatides Combined kuthiwa yisona esithinteke kakhulu kwezisabikwe ukuthi zicekeleke phansi ngesikhathi kwehla lo mshophi."Siwumnyango sinqume ukususa izingane ezifunda kusuka ku-Grade 10 kuya ku-Grade 12 kulesi sikole, siziyise esikoleni i- Anton Lembede ukuze zikwazi ukuqhubeka nokubhala izivivinyo zazo,” usho kanje.Uthe umnyango uzodlulisela amagumbi esikhashana angomahamba nendlwana ezikoleni ezithintekile, kanti uveze ukuthi ngokwemibiko abasayitholile okwamanje, angu-56 amagumbi angomahamba nendlwana adingekayo.UMahlambi uqinisekise ukuthi umnyango uyaqhubeka nokubheka isimo, uxhumana namahhovisi awo ezingeni lezifunda ukuqoqa ulwazi ngomonakalo odwalwe yilesi siphepho.Bevile ku-8 000 abasale dengwane endaweni yasoThongathi, kanti kuthiwa ilinganiselwa ku-2 000 imizi ecekeleke phansi.Ngesikhathi iMeya yeTheku uMnuz Mxolisi Kaunda ehlangene nalo mphakathi ngoLwesihlanu ukudlulisela ezinye izinsiza kubagilwa balesi siphepho, uqinisekise ukuthi uMnyango wezokuHlaliswa kwaBantu uzokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi abadlule emhlabeni ngenxa yale nhlekelele, bangcwatshwa ngesizotha."Emva kokubheka isimo sikwazile ukususa imindeni ekhahlamezekile sayifaka ezindaweni eziphephile ezisafihle khona amakhanda, ngakho namhlanje siqinisekisa ukuthi sibahambisela izinto eziyizidingongqangi,” usho kanje.Uthe le nhlekelele iphazamise ugesi namanzi endaweni kodwa umasipala wenza isiqiniseko sokubuyisela isimo kwesejwayelekile.Lo masipala ngokubambisana noMnyango wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi esifundazweni, udlulisele izingubo zokwembatha ezingu- 1 700 neziponji abangu-1 300 kubagilwa.
ULOKHU ekhale njalo ngobungozi bendodakazi owesilisa waseChatsworth eThekwini okumanje umatasa nokunakekela izilonda zokusha emva kokuthi imbhunyele ngamanzi abilayo ngeledlule.UMnuz Sithembiso Ngidi (42) uthe ugcine eyivulela icala indodakazi yakhe (20) yize ifunda u-matric, yase ikhalelwa amasongo kaSigonyela. Uthe isigameko abengasilindele futhi esimshiye ethuthumela senzeke ngoMsombuluko.UMGILWA uMnuz Sithembiso Ngidi othi ushiswe yindodakazi Isithombe: SITHUNYELWE Elandisa ngesehlakalo, uthe simehlele ngesikhathi ebuyile lapho esebenza khona ezochitha isikhathi nomndeni njengoba esebenzela kude, ebuya njalo uma kuphele inyanga."Siqhathwe ukuthi ngimbuze ukuthi kungani engayenzi imisebenzi yakhe yasekhaya njengentombazane. Ngibuza lokhu nje, umama (73) ubeqeda kukhala ngokuthi usuku lonke akakaze adle namaphilisi akawaphuzile,” kusho uNgidi.Uthe wayeyicele kahle indodakazi ukuthi yenze imisebenzi yasendlini njengokupheka, ukuhlanza indlu nezitsha, bese isondezela unina (ongugogo kumsolwa) amanzi okuthi aphuze amaphilisi.Uveze ukuthi unina akakwazi ukuzenzela izinto kulandela ukuphuka onyaweni eshayiswa yimoto, waphinde wehlelwa omunye umshophi, wokuwa waphuka ingalo emasontweni ambalwa edlule."Umntanami ngangimtshelile ukuthi njengoba umama enenkinga yokuba nonyawo olulodwa nengalo eyodwa, ngithembe yena ukuthi abe yiso amnakekele,” kusho uNgidi.Ngosuku lwesigameko, uthe emva kokuyithethisa indodakazi, iphume iyishodi, ibheke kwamakhelwane kanti iyobilisa amanzi."Sisale sazibukela ithelevishini nomunye umngani wami. Ngizwe ngigodola, ngangena ekamelweni ngiyolanda ingubo yokulala ukuze ngimbathe. Ngithe ngibuya nayo, ngisathi ngisazisonga, ngezwa ngomngani wami ethi 'Sthe bhasobha’. Ngithe ngisathi ngiyaqalaza ukuthi yini le athi angiyibhasobhe, asho amanzi abilayo ebusweni,” kusho uNgidi.Udalule ukuthi ubezitshela ukuthi uzoyiyeka indodakazi yakhe ngemenze khona kodwa ubuye washintsha umqondo esezwa izinkulumo zayo ezithusayo."Ngithole ngomakhelwane ukuthi uyakhuluma, uthi ngoba amanzi awangibulali, usezongitholela abantu abazongibulala,” usho kanje.Uqhube wathi: "Le ngane icwile otshwaleni. Iyingozi. Ayihloniphi muntu.”Uthe akafuni nokuthi ithole ibheyili, ngoba usebonile ukuthi iyingozi, ingambulala nokumbulala.
USABISA ngokumisa ukusebenza ezimayini uMengameli we-Association of Mineworkers Union (Amcu), uMnuz Joseph Mathunjwa, uma zingaxazululwa izinkinga zabasebenzi abafuna amasheya eKroondal, eNorth West.UMathunjwa uthe udaba lwamasheya lwaqala ukuxoxwa ngo-2020 iSibanye-Stillwater ilokhu ibathembisa ukuthi izobuyela kubona kodwa alukalungi namanje."Sizobhalela i-Commission for Conciliation, Mediation and Arbitration (CCMA) ukuyazisa ukuthi asisitholi isisombululo odabeni lwamasheya olwalungaphothuliwe emuva kwezivumelwano zamaholo ezidlule. Sizolulwa lolu daba futhi sicela uNeal Froneman alulungise ngoba uma engakwenzi lokho uzoyikhotha imbenge yomile. Kwezinye izimayini zakhe uFroneman, siyathembisa ukuthi uma engalulungisi udaba zonke ngeke zisebenze,” kusho uMathunjwa.Usole uFroneman, oyisikhulu esiphezulu eSibanye-Stillwater, ngokungawahloniphi amalungelo abasebenzi.Izolo kube nomhlangano obuhlanganisa amalungu eNational Union of Mineworkers (Num) nawe-Amcu ezinkundleni zemidlalo iWaterval, eKroondal, eNorth West.Kulo mhlangano uMengameli weNum, uMnuz Daniel Daniel Balepile, uthe namhlanje bazohlangana nomqashi ukuze kuguqulwe isinqumo sokubaxosha.Uthe udaba lwamasheya luzolungiswa ngoba bazobambisana ne-Amcu ukuze abasebenzi bathole okungokwabo.Ngeledlule abasebenzi abangaphezu kuka-200 bachitha amahora awu-48 emgodini waseKroondal, bekhala ngokuthi abayitholanga imali yamasheya etholwe abanye ozakwabo kwezinye izimayini zakwaSibanye.Nokho bagcina bephumile emgodini emuva kokuncengwa yizinyunyana zabo.NgoLwesihlanu, uMnuz James Wellsted obhekelele ezokuxhumana eSibanye-Stillwater, uthe bazikhiphile izincwadi eziwu-213 ezazisa abasebenzi ngokuxoshwa kwabo, ezinye bezibaxwayisa ngokuthi bangaphinde bazithole esimweni esinjengalesi.Uthe udaba lwamasheya aseKroondal lwaxoxwa kabanzi nezinyunyana ngonyaka odlule kwashiwo ukuthi umqashi usazobona ukuthi bazofakwa kanjani ohlelweni lwamasheya oluqhubeka eRustenburg.Uveze ukuthi bebezobona uma kuphela lo nyaka ukuthi benzenjani ngalolu daba futhi izinyunyana ziyakwazi konke lokhu."Kubukeka sengathi kwaba khona ukungaqondi kahle kubasebenzi njengoba kukhona akade belindele okuthile. Izikhalo zabo bekufanele baziphakamise ngendlela efanele ngaphakathi emayini noma bazise izinyunyana zabo. Asihambisani nokuthi bazivalele emgodini ngoba lokhu kubeka engcupheni impilo yabasebenzi. Kufaka engozini umsebenzi wonkana okubeka engcupheni nezinye izinhlaka,” kuchaza uWellsted.
I-DA eThekwini isiveze ukuthi ukungabikho kwemali kadizili wamaloli athwala amanzi yikho okwenza ukuthi angafinyeleli kuzo zonke izindawo ezisuke ziphelelwe yiwo.Ngokusho kukaMnuz Chris van den Berg oyikhansela le-DA ku-ward 63 eThekwini, ngesikhathi engekho amanzi eMalvern, Northdene, Burlington, Chatsworth, KwaSanti, Klaarwater nezinye izindawo, uye wabuza ukuthi kungani kungathunyelwa amaloli, wabe esetshelwa ukuthi apakile ngoba awuthengiwe udizili.Amanzi aphele ngoLwesine ntambama ezindaweni ezihlukene emuva kwezinkinga zikagesi nokufa kwe-motor esiza amaphampu amanzi."Amaloli athwala amanzi ebengenawo udizili yingakho abantu beye balinda isikhathi eside ukuze bathole amanzi. Ngithole ukuthi le nkinga isilungisiwe kwase kuthunyelwa amaloli ngoMgqibelo emini. Kuyishwa ukuthi izinkinga zamanzi ziyaqhubeka eThekwini yize umasipala wawuthembise ukuthi iyalungiswa ingqalasizinda,” kusho uVan den Berg.Uthe bazoqhubeka beyi-DA nokuluphakamisa udaba lokulungiswa kwengqalasizinda yamanzi ngoba yindala kakhulu.Uveze ukuthi umasipala wawuthe uzofaka imali eyengeziwe uma abantu bekhokhela amanzi ukuze izoqoqwa bese kulungiswa ingqalasizinda kodwa abazi ukuthi ishonephi leyo mali."Umsebenzi wokuqinisekisa ukuthi amanzi ayaphuma kompompi baseThekwini unzima ngoba amapayipi aqhuma njalo. Lolu daba saluphakamisa kudala futhi besazi ukuthi ayalungiswa kodwa kubukeka sengathi kufanele sisiqaphe ngeso lokhozi isimo sokulungiswa kwawo ngoba aqhuma njalo,” kusho uVan den Berg.UNkk Gugu Sisilana okhulumela uMasipala weTheku, uthe akusilo iqiniso ukuthi ubungekho udizili noma umasipala uphelelwe yimali yokuthenga udizili."Okwenzekile wukuthi kuye kwabambezela ukudilivwa kukadizili emuva kokwehla kwawo ngoLwesithathu. Lokhu kudalwa wukuthi izinkampani zikadizili aziwuthenganga ngesikhathi ngoba zifuna ukuwuthenga uma sewehlile. Yikona okubambezele ukuthunyelwa kukadizili ezindaweni zethu. Amaloli athwala amanzi abe eselinda kolayini abade ngaphambi kokuthi agcwalise udizili, yikona lokhu okuye kwawabambezela,” kuchaza uNkk Sisilana.Uthe amadepho kamasipala aqale ukuthola udizili ngoLwesihlanu ntambama kwayima kugcwaliswa amaloli athwala amanzi.Ukugcizelele ukuthi umasipala awunayo inkinga kadizili kodwa ukufuneka kwawo nxazonke ngenxa yokwehla kwentengo yawo yikona okubambezele amaloli amanzi.
UDIDEKILE umndeni waseMzikhulu njengoba uthi uxakwa wukuphuma kwezidumbu ngambili kuwona.Umndeni wakwaGabela uthi sekuze kwaba amahlandla amathathu manje kuvela umshophi walolu hlobo.Ilungu lomndeni eliyindodana endala, uMnuz Nzuzo Gabela uchazele iSolezwe Ngempelasonto ngakho konke okuqhubeka kulo mndeni.Uveze ukuthi ngo-2007 inhloko yekhaya, uMnuz Thathezakho Gabela wagingqika nemoto washona ekanye nendodakazi yakhe.Lesi sehlakalo uthi senzeka kuN2 engwaqweni obheke KwaDukuza ngosuku olwalandulela uKhisimuzi.Uthe lesi sehlakalo sabashiya bekhungathekile.Uthe kwabaphinda lokho ngo-2010 ngesikhathi kuhlasela izigilamkhuba kubo zadubula zabulala indodana yakhona, uMnuz Sanele Gabela nengane yakhe yomfana eyayineminyaka engu-16 ngaleso sikhathi.Uthe baqala banyusa izinhlonze basola ukuthi kukhona okushaya amanzi. Base beqala ukusukuma behamba abantu ababonayo.Ngonyaka owedlule ngoDisemba uthe ilungu labo lomndeni lakhala ngekhanda lashona. Kwathi ngemuva kwezinsuku ezimbili umfana wakhona wagwazwa ngabafana ababezama ukumbamba inkunzi eThekwini."Asisazi manje ukuthi siyithini lento. Kuyasicacela nje ukuthi inkulu into engahambi kahle uma kunje," usho kanje.Uthi sebezame konke ukubhula lo mlilo kodwa kunhlanga zimuka nomoya.Uthe akukho nokuncane nje ukungabaza mayelana nokuthi kukhona okudinga ukulungiswa emsamo."Eyi, futhi inkulu inkinga ekhona lapha ekhaya," usho kanje.Uthe ziningi kakhulu izinyanga asebezihambile kodwa kunhlanga zimuka nomoya."Sesihlalele ovalweni lokuthi uma kungukuthi lona umkhokha, awuvaleke phela ngoba kuyacaca ukuthi uzosishaya usibhuqe," usho kanje.UMnuz Bongani Gumede ongumelaphi wendabuko wakhona eMzimkhulu uthe kukhona okudinga ukulungiswa kulo mndeni.Uthe uma bengenankinga bangasondela kuyena, kukhona angabalekelela ngakho. Uthe lo mndeni kubonakala sengathi ubhekene nomkhokha.
ITHOLWE ishonile indodana yeMeya kuMasipala Umvoti ewumholi weqembu lezepolitiki i-Abantu Batho Congress, ebesekuphele isonto kubikwe ngokunyamalala kwayo.UMnuz Nkosinathi Mavundla (30), oyindodana kaMnuz Philani Mavundla ongusomabhizinisi nomholi we-ABC, kuthiwa isidumbu sakhe sitholwe ngoMgqibelo.Ngokwesitatimende esithunyelelwe abezindaba, umndeni uveze ukuthi umufi wayegcine ukubonakala ngoJuni 1.Esitatimendeni, umndeni uveze ukuthi wayegcine ukubonwa ekubo kwaMavundla, kanti awandanga ekutheni isidumbu sakhe sitholwe kuphi, sikusiphi isimo.Isolezwe lithinta okhulumela umndeni, uMnuz Sandile Mavundla, uqinisekise ukutholwa kwesidumbu somfowabo kodwa waveza ukuthi okwamanje umndeni usematasa ngezinhlelo zokumfihla ngakho kuzoxhunywana nabezindaba ngalolu daba ngokuhamba kwesikhathi.Ecashunwa ekhuluma nephephandaba eliwuzakwabo weSolezwe, i-Sunday Tribune, uyise kamufi, uMavundla uthe okwamanje umndeni usasemanzini wanxusa ukuthi kukhulunywe noSandile, oveze ukuthi ngenxa yomyalelo wamaphoyisa anxuse ukuthi ulwazi umndeni wabelane nawo, akazokwazi ukuveza ukuthi isidumbu somfowabo sitholwe kuphi.Kuthiwa umufi ubenezingane ezimbili nengoduso yakhe, kanti umndeni uzoyidlulisa imininingwane ngohlelo lokungcwatshwa kwakhe uma seluphothuliwe.Kushaye isikhathi sokushicilela amaphoyisa engakayiphenduli imibuzo abethunyelelwe yona ngalolu daba.
I-DA ithe ngeke ikwazi ukungena esixaxeni samaqembu uma kukhona i-MK, EFF nePatriotic Alliance, kungamane kuyekwe. Lo mbandela uvezwe wuMnuz Werner Horn ekhuluma ne-SAfm.Amaqembu amatasa nomshikashika wokuxoxisana ukuze kubunjwe uhulumeni wobumbano emuva kokuthi lingabanga khona iqembu elinqobe ngengcaca.I-ANC iphunyukwe yizintambo zombuso yathola u-40%, nokuyiphoqa ukuthi ihambe iphaphatha emaqenjini ixoxa nawo ukuze kungenwe kuhulumeni.UWerner uthe isigungu sabo esiphezulu sithathe isinqumo ngamaqembu okungase kusetshenzwe nawo."NgoMsombuluko isigungu esiphezulu sizonquma ngendlela eya phambili. Noma ngabe aneqhaza elincane kanjani la maqembu amathathu, ngeke sikwazi impela, sekuyoba nzima kithi,’’ kusho uWerner engacucuzi.Kwenzeka lokhu nje uMengameli we-ANC uCyril Ramaphosa, ngoLwesine ebusuku umemezele ukuthi isigungu sabo esiphezulu sivumelane ngohulumeni wobumbano.UWerner uthe kuyabakhathaza ukuthi uRamaphosa akachazanga kahle ngemicikilishi yohulumeni wobumbano akhuluma ngawo. IMK nePatriotic Alliance bangene okokuqala ePhalamende futhi bafike kwezwakala bathola izihlalo.I-ANC ithe yona izimisele ngokuxoxa nawo wonke amaqembu izwe iziphakamiso zawo ngohulumeni.
INHLANGANO iHola Bona Rennaisance Foundation (HBRF), ithi kufanele ichithwe imiphumela yokhetho ngoba kuningi okungahambanga kahle.Izwe belibambe ukhetho lukazwelonke ukuze kuqokwe uhulumeni ozobusa iminyaka emihlanu ezayo, namanje indaba yokhetho isewundabamlonyeni.I-HBRF imangalele i-IEC eNkantolo yezoKhetho, ikhala ngokuthi ayikwazanga ukubhekana nezikhalo zamaqembu anganelisekile ngokhetho.Amaphepha abonwe yiSolezwe ngeMpelasonto abeka amaphuzu enhlangano ethi yiwona amqoka okufanele abhekwe uma sekuqulwa icala. Iveza ukuthi amaqembu amaningi okubalwa iMK afaka izikhalo ngokhetho.Iveza nokuthi i-IEC ayikwazanga ukuphendula ngendlela egculisayo. Babuye bakhale ngokuthi abayithembi ukuthi iqotho kangakanani iimiphumela eyayivezwa ebhodini le-IEC.Inhlangano yokhetho i-IEC imemezele imiphumela yokhetho ngeSonto yathi belungolukhululekile nolungenazihibe. IMK namanye amaqembu bakhala ngokuthi abanelisekile ngokuningi abakholwa wukuthi akuhambanga kahle.Amaqembu ayephakamisa nokuthi kubalwe kabusha abanye bethi akuqalwe phansi kuvotwe. Nakuba kunjalo kodwa ziyaqhubeka izinhlelo zokuhlalisa iPhalamende lapho okuzokhethwa khona umengameli wezwe.Seluhanjisiwe uhlu lwamalungu ePhalamende olwemukelwe yiNhloko yamaJaji kuleli iJaji uRaymond Zondom okusho ukuthi izinhlelo ziyaqhubeka.
UMKHANDLU wamabandla, iSouth African Council of Churches (SACC) ugqugquzele abantu bakuleli ukuthi baqine emkhulekweni njengoba kwanda izinhlekelele zemvelo.UMengameli we-SACC, u-Archbishop Thabo Makgoba, uthe babeke usuku lwanamhlanje njengosuku lapho isizwe sonke kufanele sikhulekele izingqinamba ezibhekene neNingizimu Afrika.Uthe kuzokhulekelwa abapheshukelwe yizindlu nabashonile ngenxa yesimo sezulu esibi KwaZulu-Natal, Eastern Cape naseWestern Cape.Kuzokhulekelwa nokuthi abaholi bepolitiki babe nobuhlakani njengoba kudingidwa izindlela zokubusa izwe emuva kwemiphumela yokhetho ephoqa amaqembu epolitiki ukuba asebenzisane.Kuzobuye kukhulekelwe nokuthula ezweni uMakgoba athe kufanele kukhulekelwe emhlabeni jikelele."Njengesizwe esisodwa siza phambi kukaNkulunkulu ngomthandazo. Umkhuleko wethu uzozwakala kuNkulunkulu woxolo, uthando nobulungiswa. Sigqugquzela bonke abantu ukuba bathandaze,” kusho uMakgoba.Uthe osopolitiki uma bexoxa kufanele bakhumbule izidingo zabantu bakuleli, balwe nobuphofu, inkohlakalo, udlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane, ubugebengu, balungise nemfundo yakuleli.Udlulise amazwi enduduzo kwabashonelwe yizihlobo zabo ngenxa yesimo sezulu esibi KwaZulu-Natal nase-Eastern Cape.Ucele abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi baqhubeke nokunikelela abakhahlanyezwe yisimo sezulu wabonga nalabo asebenikelile.
UTHUKUTHELE uyaveva owesilisa wakwaNongoma, uMntwana Bongani Zulu (57), othi uxoshwe yinduna yakhe emsebenzini imsola ngokuthi uthakathe uzakwabo, washona.UZulu ubengomunye wabasebenzi abaphusha izinqola ezithuthela abantu impahla uma beqeda ukuthenga eSpar, KwaNongoma.Uthe ubesebenzela iSpar, waxoshwa yinduna yakhona ngemva kokumsola ngokuthakatha uzakwabo ophathwe yizinyawo washona.UZulu usevule icala lokwehliswa isithunzi ngokusolwa ngokuthakatha yinduna yakhe ayibize ngoMsimango, athe ize yamxosha nasemsebenzini imnuka ngokuthakatha.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda ukuqinisekisile ukuthi uZulu uvule icala ngemuva kokusolwa ngokubulala umuntu ngomuthi. Uthe amaphoyisa aKwaNongoma, ayaphenya ngalokhu. UZulu uchaze uMsimango wathi uyinduna yaseSpar, aphinde abe yinduna yenkosi endaweni. Uveze ukuthi isono sakhe kube wukungaphumeleli ukuya emngcwabeni kazakwabo ophathwe yizinyawo wagcina eshonile.Ngaphambi kosuku lomngcwabo uthe kwaba nomhlangano lapho kwaqoqwa khona umnikelo wo-R50."Kwabe sekuthiwa abaphakamise izandla abangazophumelela ukuya emngcwabeni. Mina ngibe ngomunye wabantu abaphakamisa isandla, ngathi ngeke ngiphumelele ukuya emngcwabeni ngoba ngiyagula, ngizobe ngichathile," kusho uZulu.Inkinga uthe iqale esebuyela emsebenzini emva komngcwabo emasontweni amabili edlule."UMsimango uvele wangibuza ukuthi kungani ngingayanga emngcwabeni kazakwethu. Ngimtshelile ukuthi ngasho nje ukuthi kungani ngingeke ngiye. Uvele wathi angihambe emsebenzini ngoba ngiyathinteka ekufeni kukamufi," usho kanje uZulu.Uthe simphathe kabi isenzo sikaMsimango, wathi ufuna achazele izwe ukuthi uzwe ngobani ukuthi uyena othakathe umufi washona. Uthe okunye wukuthi umufi ubeyisoka lendodakazi kaMsimango, manje akazi noma ubhodlela kuyena ngoba ephethwe kabuhlungu wukushona kwesoka lendodakazi yakhe yini. Uthe okuzomjabulisa ukuthi uMsimango ageze igama lakhe ngemva kokumhlambalaza phambi kwabanye ozakwabo ngokumbheca ngobende ekubeni inyama engayithanga mbibi.Kuthintwa uMsimango, akafunanga ukuphendula ngesinqumo sakhe sokuxosha uZulu emsebenzini. Kunalokho, uthe akekho umuntu ongamazi uZulu ukuthi ungumuntu onjani endaweni. Uqhube wathi ngisho kungabuzwa abanye abasebenzi bangamchaza ukuthi ungumuntu onjani. Uphethe ngokuthi bese beke balukhuluma udaba naye efike emsebenzini, waze waxolisa uZulu kodwa uyaxakeka ukuthi kungani esemvulele necala. Uthe uma enenkinga akazikhulumele nabaphathi besitolo yena akasangeni kulolu daba, akuselona olwakhe.
UMPHATHISWA wezokuphepha komphakathi nokusebenza kwamaphoyisa eWestern Cape, uReagen Allen, unxuse amaphoyisa ukuthi enze konke okusemandleni ukuqinisekisa ukubanjwa kwabasolwa abavulele ngenhlamvu endaweni yokuphuca kwafa izingane ezintathu.Lokhu kwenzeke elokishini laseKhayelitsha, eKapa, ngoMgqibelo ntambama ngezithuba zika-4 lapho oshayasibhamu abangaziwa befike kule ndawo bavulela ngenhlamvu.Okhulumela amaphoyisa kulesi sifundazwe uColonel Andrè Traut uthe leli cala lidluliselwe ophikweni oluphenya amacala abucayi nanodlame esifundazweni."Abaseshi ophikweni lwamacala abucayi odlame aphenya ngesigameko sokubulawa kwabantu abathathu nokulimala kwabanye endaweni yokuphuca ngoMgqibelo ntambama. Kubikwa ukuthi kufike amadoda angaziwa kule ndawo avulela ngenhlanvu ebhekise kwabebekhona,” kusho yena. Owesilisa oneminyaka engu-30 u nezingane ezimbili ezineminyaka engu-11, 12 bafe ujuqu kwathi enye ingane eneminyaka emihlanu yashonela esibhedlela. Zintathu ezinye izingane eziphuthunyiswe esibhedlela ngenxa yokudubuleka.
UNOBHALA -JIKELELE obambile kweloMkhonto Wesizwe, uMnuz Sihle Ngubane, uthi babhalele iPhalamende belazisa ukuthi uMnuz Jabulani Khumalo, waxoshwa akufanele abe sohlwini lwabo.Kumanje iMK inezihlalo eziwu-58 ePhalamende, ezithole emuva kokugila izimanga okhethweni lukazwelonke ngenyanga edlule.UKhumalo owabhalisa iqembu, nguyena ophezulu ohlwini lwamalungu eMK aya ePhalamende, emuva kokuthi kukhishwe igama likaJacob Zuma. Igama likaZuma likhishwe emuva kwesinqumo senkantolo eyathi akufanele aye ePhalamende.UKhumalo ubelele isibili ngaphambi kokuthi igama likaZuma lihoshwe ohlwini. UNgubane uthe ngeke bakwazi ukumelwa nguKhumalo ngoba waxoshwa eqenjini."Yinto ejwayelekile nje, amaqembu ayalwenza ushintsho ohlwini uma esexoshiwe umuntu. Sibhalele iPhalamende silicela ukuthi uKhumalo akhishwe sabanika nencwadi yokuxoshwa kwakhe bayalusebenza udaba manje,’’ kuchaza uNgubane.Ethithwa uKhumalo ngalokhu uthe nguyena umholi weMK ePhalameende noma ngabe kukhona abangakuthandi lokho."Ngiphakathi impela, yimina umholi weMK ePhalamende, uNgubane ukhuluma into angayazi nje. Kusho ukuthi abafundile ngoba imithetho yePhalamende iqondile. Nani anobathumelela umthetho bawufunde kahle,’’ kuphendula uKhumalo.UNgubane ubuziwe ukuthi bazoya yini ePhalamende ngoba benesikhalo ngemiphumela yokhetho, wanqaba ukuphendula. Uthe ucela ukuphawula ngodaba lukaKhumalo bese kuphelela lapho hhayi okunye.Phambilini abe-IEC bakucacisile ukuthi amaqembu awakwazi ukuchibiyela uhlu lwawo kuze kube kuhlala iPhalamende okokuqala.Kwenzeka konke lokhu nje uKhumalo ulufake enkantolo udaba lokuxoshwa kwakhe kwiMK. Udaba lwangena enkantolo kwalalelwa izethulo sase siyagodlwa isinqumo.
ABAKWASIDLODLO bathungatha umkhondo wabasolwa ngecala lokubulala owesifazane, base becwiya izitho zomzimba eNorthdale, eMgungundlovu.Kuthiwa kutholakale isidumbu sowesifazane ehlubulwe isikhumba ebusweni, wakopilitwa amehlo, wasikwa ikhala nezindlebe.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda uziqinisekisile izindaba, wathi kunophenyo oluqhubekayo ngesehlo."Amaphoyisa aseMountain Rise, aphenya icala lokubulala ngemva kwesigameko sokutholakala kwesidumbu sowesifazane oneminyaka engu-27 eNorthdale, ngoLwesine. Kukholakala ukuthi lo wesifazane ubelinyaziwe ebusweni,” kusho uColonel Netshiunda.I-Independent Online ike yabika ukuthi izingane ezilinganiselwa eminyakeni eyisishiyagalombili neshumi ebezidlala esitaladini, zizithele phezu kwesidumbu sowesifazane. Emva kokuthi zizithele kulesi sidumbu, abaqaphe ukuthula kule ndawo baphuthume khona bayobheka.Abaqaphe ukuthula endaweni iMi7, baphawulile ngesidumbu sowesifazane otholakale eNorthdale: "Uma ubheka indlela alinyazwe ngayo lo wesifazane kukhona ukuthi ube yisisulu ecaleni elibi. Kodwa ukuhlolwa kwesidumbu sakhe yikhona okuzocacisa ngokwenzekile kulo wesifazane,” kusho iMi7Amaphoyisa unxusa noma ngubani ongaba nolwazi, ukuze kugcine kubanjwe abenzi bobubi ukuthi afonele amaphoyisa aseMountain Rise kule nombolo ethi: 033 387 9600.
UPHIKO lwezokuShushisa kuleli lufuna icala lenkohlakalo elibhekene nobenguSomlomo wePhalamende, uNkk Nosiviwe Mapisa-Nqakula, lidluliselwe eNkantolo eNkulu yasePitoli lapho lizoqulwa khona.INkantolo yeMantshi ePitoli, ilihlehlisele inyanga ezayo leli cala ukuze kutholakale usuku azovela ngalo enkantolo enkulu.Okhulumela lolu phiko, uMnuz Henry Mamothame, uthe icala likaNkk Mapisa-Nqakula lihlehliselwe uJulayi 9.Uthe okwamanje uNkk Mapisa-Nqakula nguyena kuphela osabhekene nezinsolo zenkohlakalo.Uthe egcina ukuvela ngo-Ephreli, uMbuso wawuthe uma esebuya kule nkantolo uzovela nabanye."Ubufakazi obukhona abenele ukuthi singabeka amacala umsolwa wesibili. Sinobufakazi obuqanda ikhanda bokushushisa uNkk Mapisa-Nqakula,” kusho uMamothame. Uthe bafuna icala lidluliselwe enkantolo enkulu yasePitoli ngenxa yobucayi balo.Inkantolo ilulele uNkk Mapisa-Nqakula ibheyili yakhe kaR50 000.Ngokwemibandela yebheyili yakhe akavumelekile ukuthi axhumane nofakazi bombuso, nokuthi ahambise i-passport yakhe kubaphenyi.Ubhekene necala lokuthola intshontsho komunye wosomabhizinisi owayethole ithenda emnyangweni wezokuVikela ngesikhathi esaphethe lo mnyango.Libalelwa ku-R4.5 million intshontsho lezipho nezinye izinto azithola okuhlanganisa nemali enguR2.1 million.Umshushisi u-Advocate Bheki Manyathi, uthe banqume ukungambeki amacala obengumsolwa wesibili ngoba ubufakazi bethu bebunganele.Uthe bafuna leli cala lilalelwe enkantolo enkulu."UNkk Mapisa-Nqakula uselibone lonke idokodo kanti sivumelene nethimba labameli bakhe ukuthi icala liye enkantolo enkulu. Zonke ezinye izicelo zizokwenzeka kule nkantolo,” kusho uManyathi.UNkk Mapisa-Nqakula ubhekene namacala angu-12 athinta inkohlakalo kanjalo nokushushumbisa imali.
NKOSIKHONA CELEWELULEKWE kabanzi umfundisi webandla labasindisiwe, i-Acts of Obedience Ministries (AOM), ngesikhathi ebopha ifindo likasofasilahlane.UMfundisi Bhuti Mbuthumo ubebopha ifindo lomshado noNksz Nonhlanhla Maphumulo, kanti umshado ubuhlelelwe esizindeni sebandla esiseNew Germany.Umholi webandla uMfundisi Thandie Ngonelo, ubeluleke ngesineke bobabili kepha waqondisa kakhulu encekwini yeNkosi, eyihlomisa ngeziyalo ezinqala engazisebenzisa emshadweni.Eqhulwini uyale uMbuthumo ngokuthi kumele azi ukuthi emshadweni kuyaxolwa. "Ngifuna ukukuxoxela mina ukuthi njengoba ushada nalo wesifazane zikhona izinto ezizobonakala zivuka maphakathi nendlela. Kodwa kumele wazi ukuthi kuyaxolwa emshadweni,'' usho kanje uMfu Ngonela.Waqhubeka wamyala ngokuthi enze isiqiniseko sokuthi uyazidongcula izinto ezibonakala zingaba yisithiyo emshadweni wabo. "Uyabona mfundisi uma kukhona into ema endleleni yomshado wenu kodwa ubona ukuthi unamandla okuthi uyigudluze, ubomane wenze kanjalo,'' kweluleka uMfu Ngonela.Inkulumo kaMfu Ngonela, yokugudluza into ethikameza umshado uyiyamanise nesibonelo sowesifazane owayeshadile kodwa ethanda kakhulu ithelevishini aze akhohlwe ukuthi unomyeni.Uqhube walandisa wathi ngelinye ilanga unkosikazi wafika umyeni wakhe eseyikhiphile endlin ithelevishini.UMfu Ngonelo uthinte nendaba yokubekezelelana emshadweni, wathi kuwumgogodla omkhulu ogcina umshado uphila isikhathi eside kakhulu.UMbuthumo uthembise ukuthi uzomthanda futhi amnakekele umkakhe impilo yakhe yonke. Uthe kuningi kakhulu okuhle akuthandayo ngomkakhe."Ngiyakuthembisa mkami ukuthi ngizokuthanda, ngikunakekele kuze kube sihlukaniswa ukufa,'' usho kanje uMbuthumo, emfaka indandatho unkosikazi wakhe, maqede kwaqhuma umkikizo.Akasalanga ngaphandle unkosikazi, naye wenze isethembiso esifanayo kumyeni wakhe.
OMUNYE wabefundisi osemnkantshubovu evangelini welinye lamabandla amadala, i-African Gospel Church (AGC) usezwakalise isifiso sakhe esijulile sokuqeda amaqembuqembu kuleli bandla.UMbhishobhi Petros Zimu ungomunye wezingwevu ezindala zaleli bandla.UZimu ukhuluma kanjena nje yingoba uhlangothi lwakhe luzokuba nengqungquthela enkulu ezokube iseFascadale Mission, ePort Shepstone.Uveze ukuthi le ngqungquthela izoqala noJulayi 21 ize isongwe ngomhlaka-24.Uthe kuningi kakhulu okuzobhungwa ngakho kuyona wathi okunye kwakho kuzophinde kube ukubaluleka kokuba kwenziwe okuthile ukuze leli bandla libuyisane."Iqiniso ukuthi kumqoka ngempela manje ukubona leli bandla libuyisana. Ngikholwa ukuthi nakanjani lokho kungenzeka,'' usho kanje.Leli bandla lihlukene ngokwamaqembu amane abizwa ngamagama abaholi bawo.Kukhona iZimu Group, iGigaba Group, iMbili Group neShezi Group."Ukukhuluma iqiniso nje, mina njengoMbhishobhi uZimu ngikhathazekile kakhulu ngale nhlukano. Ngifisa ukubona wonke lawa maqembu ebuyisana,'' usho kanje.Uthe ukholwa ukuthi kuningi okuhle okungavela uma leli bandla lingaqala phansi libumbane libe yimbumba.Ebuzwa uZimu ukuthi kanti konakalaphi kuze kube nenhlukano, uthe naye akukho angakukhomba ukuthi kwaba wumnyombo wale ngwadla ibandla elizithola libhekene nayo manje.Uthe kodwa ukholwa ukuthi kusengahlalwa phansi kulungiswe izinkinga maqede kube nenqubekela phambili.Abaholi abazobe beshiyelana inkundla ngezintshumayelo kubalwa kubo uMfu Ndaba, Mfu Mkhwanazi, Mfu F Mzimela, Mfu B Shangase, Mfu Zuma, Mfu Mthiyane naye uMbhishobhi Zimu.
AKHALA ngokuhlawuliswa izizumbulu ngumlimi omhlophe amadoda aseMbonjane, eMophela emuva kokuthi izinkomo zawo zingene epulazini lakhe.Ngokusho kukaMnuz Mntonjani Robert Luthuli (74) izinkomo zabo bezijwayele ukuyodla epulazini zingaboshwa kodwa kuthe uma selithengwa ngomunye umlimi baqala baba nezinkinga zokuthi ziyaboshwa uma zingena epulazini."Okusiphethe kabi wukuthi umlimi akabiyile lapho kungena khona izinkomo. Alikho nebhodi elixwayisa ngokuthi akayidingi impahla ukuba ingene kuleya ngxenye yepulazi. Ngosuku ufuna uR50 uma inkomo yakho eyibophile. Mina ngiboshelwe izinkomo ezintathu. Anginayo imali yokuzikhipha njengoba ngiphila ngokuhola impesheni,” kusho uLuthuli.Uthe bayafisa ukuthi kungenele uMnyango wezoLimo ngoba izinkomo zabo phambilini bezidla lapho seziboshwa khona manje.Omunye umnumzane okhiphe izinkomo zakhe ezintathu ngoR2 000, uthe bayafisa ukuthi kungenelele aboMnyango wezoLimo ngoba izinkomo zabo bezidla zikhululeke phambilini kodwa seziyaboshwa njengoba ipulazi selithengwe wumlimi omusha.Uthe okwamanje bebengakalubiki enkosini lolu daba bebesazizamela bodwana eceleni ukuluxazulula.UMnuz Reggie Ngcobo obhekele ezokuxhumana eMnyangweni wezoLimo nokuThuthukiswa kwezindawo zasemakhaya kuzwelonke, uthe abalimi ababoshelwe izinkomo kufanele babanike igama lepulazi ukuze bathumele uphiko lwabo lwezomthetho ukuba lulungise lolu daba.UMnuz Bruce Mattison ongumnikazi wephawundi eligcina imfuyo esuke iboshiwe, uthe abalimi ababoshelwe imfuyo bangeza ephawundini lakhe bazolanda imfuyo.Uveze ukuthi ngokomthetho i-Animal Identification Act ka-2002 yonke imfuyo kufanele ibe nophawu oluhlukile okuyilona umnikazi wayo abona ngalo ukuthi ngeyakhe."Imfuyo esuke iboshiwe ilethwa ephawundini lami eliseHowick bese idedelwa uma umnikazi eseyikhombile. Angeza yedwa noma ahambe namaphoyisa emfuyo ukuze athole izinkomo zakhe,” kusho uMattison.Ukugcizelele ukubaluleka kokumakwa kwemfuyo ukuze kusheshe kucace ukuthi ngekabani.Imizamo yokuthola umlimi ukuze aphawule ayiphumelelanga njengoba Isolezwe lingayitholanga inombolo yakhe yocingo.
KUPHOQE ukuthi lihlehle icala lokungqongqiswa ngomlilo kwabathathu okwenzeka eNkanini, eCato Manor, ngoJanuwari 25, 2023 ngesikhathi ummangalelwa wokugcina ekhala ngesibhobo ebesisho ukumjuqa eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini.Bayisithupha abasolwa kuleli cala, ngoMnuz Mniseli "Jomo" Khondlo (41), Vusimuzi Mazula (46), Thandekile Penelope Sithuntsa (37), Siphenathi Zoko (28), Mfanafuthi Muzi Masikane (37) noScelo Thusi (39) okunguyena oxinwe wukugula kuqhubeka icala.Laba basolwa ngokuthi baba ngongqondongqondo ekutheni bokhele ngomlilo abesilisa abathathu, oMnuz Phumlani Tshekee, Numkile Mfenqe noRefilwe Mokoena.Laba ababulawa kuvela ukuthi babewuhlalise lubhojozi umphakathi ngezigameko ezahlukene. Phakathi kwezigameko ababesolwa ngazo ukudlwengula abesifazane, ukubamba inkunzi nokudayisa ngodli izindlu zabantu bakule ndawo.Izolo ngesikhathi kuqhubeka icala, umsolwa wesithupha ubebonakala ebamba isisu ezibhongqa. Ugcine ebonakala esephakamisa isandla.Kusondele ummeli eduze kwakhe okunguyena ogcine esetshela iJaji, uMahendra Chetty, ukuthi ummangalelwa ubambekile akazizwa kahle.Ijaji libe selicela ukuthi icala lihlabe ikhefu isikhashana ukuze athole ukunakekeleka akudingayo umsolwa.Selibuya ekhefini ufakazi, ongeke lidalulwe igama lakhe, uqhubekile nokuthula ubufakazi ethatha inkantolo ngamehlo engqondo ngokwenzeka ngosuku lwesigameko.Kuthe esalandisa ijaji laphinda lakuqaphele ukuthi umsolwa wesithupha usabhekene nenkinga yokugula."Ngenxa yokuthi omunye wabasolwa ubonakala engaphilile nhlobo. Leli cala kungcono lihlehle ukuze liqhubeke kusasa ngesikhathi esifanayo kuyona le nkantolo,'' usho kanje.Ekuseni ufakazi utshele inkantolo ukuthi abasolwa abane kulaba abayisithupha wababona behlome beyizingovolo ngesikhathi kusuka udweshu lokubulawa ngesihluku kwalaba abathathu.Uthe ummangalelwa wesihlanu nowesithupha, obegula, bona akazange aqaphele ukuthi babehlome ngani esandleni.Uthe abamangalelwa ubakhumbula kahle befika endlini ababekuyona bathatha laba abathathu bayobokhela ngomlilo emotweni.Ngosuku lwesigameko kuvela ukuthi umphakathi wawuhlome uyizingovolo uphethe ocelemba, izando nezinye izikhali wahlasela kubo kaPhumlani lapho ayehlezi khona nabangani bakhe.Kuvela ukuthi babathatha babayisa emotweni babaphoqa ukuba bangene kuyona ngaphakathi base befaka uphethroli base bayabashisa.
INHLOKO yamaJaji kuleli uRaymond Zondo, ithe kuzoqhubeka ukufungiswa kwamalungu ePhalamende noma kuthiwa kunamalungu adube umhlangano. UZondo uthe kulo mhlangano wokuqala wePhalamende okumele uhlale ezinsukwini ezingu-14 kwamenyezelwa imiphumela yokhetho, kuzokhethwa uSomlomo nomengameli wezwe. Uthe umhlangano uyoqhubeka uma sivuma isibalo samalungu angekho ngenxa yezizathu ezithile. "Uma nje isibalo samalungu ePhalamende senele, siyoqhubeka nomsebenzi wokufungisa amalungu ePhalamende. Umsebenzi obaluleke kakhulu ezweni ngoba kukhethwa usomlomo wePhalamende, umengameli wezwe, kanjalo nosihlalo woMkhandlu weziFundazwe,” kusho uZondo.Ukusho lokhu eKapa ekhuluma nezintatheli kulandela ukuthola uhlu kwiKhomishini yezoKhetho lwamalungu amasha ePhalamende naweziShayamthetho azofungiswa maduzane.Uveze lokhu nje iqembu eliholwa owayengumengameli wezwe uJacob Zuma, Umkhonto weSizwe, lisabise ukuthi lingase lidube lo mhlangano wokuqala wePhalamende lapho kuvotelwa khona lezi zikhundla, ngenxa yokuthi aleneme ngendlela ikhomishini yezokhetho ebhekelele ngayo izikhalo zamaqembu.Ongoti kwezoMthethosisekelo bathe ukuduba kweMK ukuthamela lo mhlangano ngeke kumise ukuhlala kwePhalamende ngoba likhona noma lingekho leli qembu isibalo samalungu adingekayo ukuze kuqhubeke umhlangano sizohlangana."Umsebenzi obalulekile lo ozokwenziwa amajaji. Ikhona imigomo esishicilelwe okumele ilandelwe uma sekufungiswa la malungu. Kuzobe kuvuleka isahluko esisha ezweni,” kusho uZondo. Usihlalo wekhomishini yezokhetho, uMnuz Mosotho Moepya, uthe siyaqhubeka nokwanda isibalo samalungu ePhalamende naweziShayamthetho angabesifazane.Uthe u-43.5% wamalungu ePhalamende akhethiwe, abesifazane, abesilisa benza u-56.5%.Uveze ukuthi iningi lamalungu akhethiwe aphakathi kweminyaka u-40 kuya ku-59.Abaneminyaka engu-20 kuya ku-29 angu-12, aphakathi kuka-30 weminyaka no-39 abengu-67.Aneminyaka engu-40 kuya ku-49 angu-110, aneminyaka ephakathi kuka-50 kuya ku-59 abengu-110. Aneminyaka engu-60 kuya ku-69 angu-90, kuthi aneminyaka engu-70 angu-11. "Umsebenzi wekhomishini ukuqinisekisa ukuthi sibamba ukhetho, kukhethwe abantu abazohola izwe. Siwenza lo msebenzi ngaphandle kokuchema nokwenzelela. Uhlu esiludluliselayo liveza umbono wabantu bakuleli,” kusho uMoepya.UZondo uthe njengoba sebethole uhlu sebeyazi ukuthi obani abantu abajutshiwe."Mkhulu umsebenzi ebese siwenzile ukulungiselela amalungu amasha. Okunye kwakho ukwenza imigomo ezolandelwa kanjalo nokuqoka abazongimela ezifundazweni uma sekufungiswa amalungu eziShayamthetho,” kusho uZondo.Uthe konke abakwenzayo balandela uMthethosisekelo wezwe.

ABAMELI bagqugquzele abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi bangawuzibi umkhakha wensangu njengoba ibalulekile ekuvikeleni imvelo.Baveze ukuthi njengoba insangu (hemp) yafakwa ngaphansi kwezitshalo ezibalulekile ekuvikeleni imvelo ngo-1976, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bayitshale ngokusemthethweni.UMnuz Sentebale Makara, ongummeli eCliffe Dekker Hofmeyr (CDH), uthe eNingizimu Afrika insangu kwaphasa ukuthi isingasetshenziswa emizini yabantu futhi itshalwe ngoFebhuwari walo nyaka.Uthe insangu ibalulekile ngoba iyakwazi ukugcina umoya ongcolile ibuye ivikele ukuguguleka kwenhlabathi kanti ayidingi ukunakekelwa ngamakhemikhali abulala izinambuzane njengezinye izitshalo.Udonse abantu ngendlebe ukuthi bafundisise kabanzi ngalesi sitshalo ngoba ngaphandle kokubangenisela imali, siyakwazi nokuvikela izinhlekelele zemvelo okubalwa kuzo izikhukhula njengoba sikwazi ukuvimbela ukuguguleka kwenhlabathi.UNkk Tessa Brewis, naye ongummeli eCDH osohlakeni lwezomthetho olubheka ezezimali, uthe miningi imithetho ephasiswayo emhlabeni jikelele mayelana nensangu ngakho kufanele abantu bafunde kabanzi ngayo ukuze bakwazi ukuyitshala.Ubalule ukuthi insangu iyasiza ekudambiseni izinhlungu njengoba isisetshenziswa emithini ehlukene.Kwesinye isikhathi iba ngamafutha okurabha kanjalo namaphilisi asiza abagula ngezifo ezihlukene.Uveze ukuthi ingasetshenziswa ekukhiqizeni indwangu, isetshenziswe ekudleni njengoba izinhlamvu zayo zinama-vitamin ne-Omega 3.Iyasiza nasekwakheni izindlu nasekwakhiweni kwamaphepha.
INGCABHA isisemphakathini ukuthi uphawule ngoMthethosivivinywa ozolawula ohulumeni bokubambisana kuleli.Ngalo mthethosivivinywa i-Local Government: Municipal Structures Amendment Bill, kuhloswe ukwakha imigomo ezolawula labo hulumeni ukuze kungandi izinkinga zokuphatha ezikhona ikakhulu emkhandlwini ephethwe ngokubambisana amaqembu ahlukene.UNgqongqoshe wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu kuleli uNkk Thembi Nkadimeng, uthe uyakwamukela ukukhishelwa umphakathi ukuze uphawule ngoMthethosivivinywa.Awukho umthetho ofuze lo kuleli ekubeni kubukeka uhulumeni kazwelonke uzophathwa ngokuhlanganyela ngenxa yokuthi alikho iqembu elidle umhlanganiso okhethweni lwangeledlule."Lo Mthethosivivinywa uza ngesikhathi lapho kudingeka kube nemigomo ezolawula ohulumeni bokubambisana. Uza ngesikhathi omasipala abangu-81 bephethwe ngokuhlanganyela emuva kokhetho lohulumeni basekhaya lwango-2021,” kusho uNkk Nkadimeng.Ukwanda kwale mikhandlu okungekho iqembu eliwine ngamalengiso, kwenza kube nesidingo sokuthi indaba yezinselelo ezibhekene nale mikhandlu okubalwa nendaba yokuhanjiswa kwezidingo kanjalo nokungabikhona kozinzo."Ukuchitshiyelwa kwalo Mthethosivivinywa kuzophoqa amaqembu ukuthi angene esivumelwaneni esibhaliwe esizokwenza ukuthi asebenzisane lapho kungekho khona iqembu elidle umhlanganiso elingakwazi ukubumba uhulumeni ngalodwana. Sikholwa ngukuthi lo Mthethosivivinywa uzokwazi ukulungisa nendaba yokuthi amaqembu amancane afune izinto ezinkulu ekubeni ethole amavoti amancane.” Uveze ukuthi kulabo hulumeni bokubambisana kubangwa nezikhundla igcina isishaywa indiva eyokuhanjiswa kwezidingo emphakathini."Kuba nombango emihlanganweni kuliwe, imihlangano igcine ingasahlalanga ngenxa yokuthi izibalo zisuke zingenele. Isabelomali sigcina singaphasiswanga okuphazamisa ukuhanjiswa kwezidingo.” Ugqugquzele zonke izinhlaka ukuthi zibambe iqhaza zibeke umbono wazo ngalo Mthethosivivinywa.Okuqukethwe yilo Mthethosivivinywa ngukuthi imeya, iphini lemeya, usomlomo womkhandlu kanjalo namalungu esigungu esiphezulu angasuswa ngevoti uma sekuphele iminyaka emibili akhethwa. Kodwa lezi zikhulu bangasuswa noma yinini uma kungukuthi zihlulwa ukwenza umsebenzi wazo noma zephule umthetho.Abafuna ukuphawula bangabhalela umnyango ungakashayi uJulayi 5, 2024. BALULINDELE ngamehlo abomvu usuku lwangeSonto abesifazane abazogijima kwiComrades Marathon yanonyaka, ezosuka eThekwini iphele eMgungundlovu.UMabongi Zikalala (50) wakwaNdengezi, ogijimela iHollywood Athletic Club, utshele Isolezwe ukuthi kuzobe kuyiComrades yakhe ye-11. Usegabe ngenombolo eluhlaza enikezwa asebegijime imijaho ewu-10UMabongi, onguthisha esikoleni iZwelinjani Secondary eZwelibomvu, uthi waqala ukugijima iComrades Marathon ngo-2008, emuva kwalokho wajoveka futhi juthi akasayiboni impilo yakhe ngaphandle kwalo mjaho.Uthe ukugijima koweComrades akumdingi umuntu onyanyalatayo, kumele azimisele, ajime ngendlela efanele futhi azibophezele kwezokusubatha. Ubalule ukuthi kubalulekile ukudla izinto ezinomsoco owakha umzimba.Ugqugquzele abesifazane ukuthi bagijime, wathi ukube kuya ngaye ngabe abesifazane badlala lonke uhlobo lwemidlalo olukhona ngoba kuyasiza ukugcina ingqondo iphile kahle.UMabongi uthi waqoka iHollywood Athletic Club ngoba ubulungu bayo abumbi eqolo futhi babuye bagqugquzelwe ngemiklomelo ehlukene uma bephothule iComrades.UMABONGI Zikalala (50) uzobe egijima koweComrades Marathon ka-11 kulo nyaka kanti uthi ukugijima kuyasiza kakhulu Isithombe:sithunyelweOmunye wesifazane ongenele iComrades, nguMiliswa Zenzele (41) wasePort Edward, othi waqala ukugijima ngo-2015, enzela ukuchitha isizungu.Ngaleso sikhathi wayegijima imijaho emincane yo-5km, kuya ko-10km. Kuthe ngo-2016 waqala wagijima imijaho yamabanga amade ngoba umdlalo ususegazini kuye."Ngangizitshela ukuthi ngizongenela iComrades Marathon yokuqala ngo-2020 kodwa ngagcina ngingayingenanga ngenxa yeCovid-19. Ngenza umjaho wabo o-virtual, kuzobe kungeyokuqala lena. Ngijabule ukuthi ngizobe ngijima, ngike ngawugijima umzila esizohamba ngawo ngabona ukuthi ngikulungele ukugijima ngeSonto,” kuchaza uMiliswa.UMasibulele Mkhundlu (31), odume ngelika-Fit Masi The Runner ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, uthe uzobe egijima iComrades Marathon yesithathu futhi uselinde ukuthi kube yiSonto, ngendlela ajabule ngayo.UMASIBULELE Mkhundlu (31) uthi ukugijima kuyabasiza abesifazane bahlale bephilile emzimbeni nasengqondweni. Uthi usekulungele ukugijima kwiComrades ngeSonto Isithombe: SITHUNYELWELe ntokazi yaseNgqeleni, e-Eastern Cape, iqale ukugijima ngo-2018 ngamabanga amafushane yase ikhula yenza amabanga amade okubalwa o-45km kuya ko-70kms.Uthe wagijima iComrades Marathon yokuqala ngo-2022 wenza isikhathi esiwu-11:29, emuva kwalokho wenza eyesibili ngoba egqugquzelwa wukuthi uthola izindondo amabili. Kulo nyaka uzobe eqala ukugijima koweComrades Marathon esuka eThekwini, iye eMgungundlovu ebizwa nge-Up Run.Uthe abangani bakhe bathi yima bezombiza ngomgijimi weComrades Marathon ngoba uzobe esezazi izingqinamba zokunyuka izintaba ebheke eMgungundlovu.UMasibulele waziwa nangokuba yinxusa leComrades Marathon ngoba usebenzisana nayo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana.Uthi selokhu aqala ukugijima isifiso sakhe kwakuwukungenela iComrades Marathon eyodwa kodwa akasakwazi ukuyeka. Ukhuthaze abafisa ukuyingenela ukuthi bajime, badle kahle ngoba akuwona umjaho ongawungenela ungajimanga kahle futhi ungadli ngendlela efanele.
KUPHELE amahlathi kubasolwa abayisikhombisa kwabayisishiyagalolunye bevinjezelwa oKlebe bengazelele.Lokhu kwenzeke ngoLwesine nangoLwesihlanu ezifundazweni ezine okuyiLimpopo, Gauteng, Eastern Cape ne Free State lapho oKlebe becaphune abesifazane abane nabesilisa abathathu. Kubikwa ukuthi laba basolwa bebesebenzela iSouth African Revenue Services (SARS) abanye babo sebelohonjwe indlela.Laba babhekene namacala okukhwabanisa, ukushushumbisa imali nokuphula umthetho wokuphathwa kwentala nokunguMthetho 28 ka-2011, ukwephulwa koMthetho wentela yeMpahla kanye neMpahla Ethengiswayo nokungumthetho 91 ka-1964, kanye nokwephulwa koMthetho Wokuvinjelwa Kobugebengu Obuhleliwe we-121 ka-1998. Kuseduze ukuba kuboshwe abasolwa ababili abafunwa uthuli.Omunye wabasolwa okhalelwe amasongo kaSigonyele ngamacala okukhwabanisa isithombe; SAPSKuthiwa laba basebenzi bebesebenzela eFicksburg Bridge, Maseru Bridge naseVanrooyenshek Bridge lapho bahla ubugebengu bokuthengiselana okungu-333 okufika ku-R653 500 455-28. Konke ukuthengiselana okuhlonziwe bekuyimpahla/impahla (indwangu) engenisiwe ngemali yebhondi (Ukususwa Ngebhondi) isuka esikhumulweni sokungeniswaa kwempahla emtateni waseThekwini ezothunyelwa ngaphandle emngceleni waseFree State (ngebhuloho laseMaseru).Omunye wabasolwa okhalelwe amasongo kaSigonyele ngamacala okukhwabanisa isithombe; SAPSISARS iqinisekisile ukuthi abasebenzi bayo abahlanu babhekene nenqubo yokuqondiswa ubugwegwe emsebenzini futhi balahlwa amacala baxoshwa emsebenzini.Abanye abasebenzi ababili basulile emsebenzini bangakaqondiswa ubugwegwe.Omunye umsebenzi naye oqondiswe ubugwegwe uthole incwadi yokugcine yesexwayiso, kanti ababili abangakaboshwa bona basabhekene nale nqubo kamqashi wabo.OKlebe, basebenzisane nophiko oluphenya ngenkohlakalo kwa-SARS, bethula icala eliqinile kuNational Prosecuting Authority (NPA). I-NPA ikwamukele ukuboshwa kwabasolwa futhi ibona kuboshwa kwalaba kuzothumela umyalezo ocacile kwabanye abenzi benkohlakalo namacala ahlobene nokukhwabanisa.Laba basolwa bazobingelela iMantshi yaseLadybrand ngoMsombuluko mhla ka10 Juni 2024.
UMENGAMELI weNFP, uMnuz Ivan Barnes, ufuna kubasebenzele ukuba ababeki benkosi KwaZulu-Natal.UBarnes ufuna isihlalo abasithole esiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal sibasize bakhulise iqembu.Yize iNFP ithole isihlalo esisodwa KwaZulu-Natal, ibonwa njengababeki benkosi njengoba lingekho iqembu elinqobe ukhetho ngamalengiso.INFP imataniswa nesivumelwano sokusebenzisana okuthiwa sixoxwa i-IFP, ANC, neDA, abanezihlalo ezingu-40.Ukuze la maqembu aphathe adinga isihlalo esisodwa.Uma isivumelwano siphumelela, kuthiwa iNFP izonikezwa isikhundla kwikhabhinethi lesifundazwe.UBarnes uthe isivumelwano abazongena kuso ufuna sibasize ukuba bakhe kabusha leli qembu elikhombisa ukwehlelwa ukwesekwa."Njengeqembu sizobheka izindlela esingasebenzisa kahle ngazo isihlalo esisitholile. Kubalulekile ukuthi isihlalo sisisebenzele ukuze sibuye ngamandla okhethweni lohulumeni basekhaya lwango-2026.”UBarnes ukuqinisekisile ukuthi kukhona amaqembu asebathintile, efuna ukuthi basebenzisane."Ngingakuqinisekisa ukuthi i-ANC ne-IFP sebesithintile, sesilinde ukuba sihlangane nabo. Engingakusho ke ukuthi iDA ayikakhulumi nathi. Esikulindile ukuthi zonke izinhlangano ezifuna ukuphatha zihlangane, zikhulume ngezwi elilodwa. Sifuna ukuba kube nesivumelwano esizosiza abantu.”Kucishe kwavalwa ngehlahla kwiNFP kulolu khetho njengoba ingatholanga lutho ePhalamende, ibikade inezihlalo ezimbili.Naso isihlalo abasithole KwaZulu-Natal basithole ngengcacamezela njengoba bethole amavoti angu-16 991.Isihlalo esiShayamthetho besingamavoti angaphezu kuka-40 000, iNFP ibhekelelwe njengeqembu elincane elithole amavoti angconywana kunamanye.UBarnes ukhale kakhulu ngezinkinga zangaphakathi, wathi izona ezenze ukuthi bangenzi kahle okhethweni."Imiphumela yokhetho ngeke siyihlukanise nezinto ebezenzeka ngaphakathi kwiNFP. Yebo abantu abathembekile kwiNFP bavotile kodwa kunamalungu eNFP anganelisekile angazange avote. Izinkinga zangaphakathi kwiNFP zenze ukuthi abantu abaningi bagcine bengasayithembi iNFP.”UBarnes uthe izinkinga eziningi sebezilungisile, wathi sekusele kancane bakhulume ngezwi elilodwa."Lokhu kusho ukuthi sizoya okhethweni olulandelayo singasabhekene nezinkinga. Lokho kusinika amathuba okuthi senze kahle.”Izinkinga zeNFP zindala, zaqala ngesikhathi kunengqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi eyayingo-2019.Ubuholi obakhethwa kule ngqungquthela bahlakazwa isinqumo senkantolo.Ngonyaka odlule i-NFP yaba nengqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi, nokho kukhona abaphikisana nobuholi obakhethwa.
NJENGOBA amaqembu ezepolitiki ematasa nezinguyaza ngokubumba uhulumeni wokubambisana kuleli, abamabhizisini nosomnotho bafuna kube nozinzo kungashintshwa kakhulu imigomo elawula izwe. Abamabhizinisi bathe akumele kubaleke abatshalimali njengoba abavoti bephoqe ukuthi amaqembu asebenzisane ezweni lonke ngenxa yokuthi alikho iqembu elidle umhlanganiso elizokwazi ukubumba uhulumeni ngalodwana.Umengameli weBusiness Unity South Africa, uMnuz Mxolisi Mgojo, uthe kumele uhulumeni ozobunjwa alandele imigomo yoMthethosisekelo.Uthe kumele uhulumeni alungise izikhalazo zomphakathi. "Silindele uhulumeni ukuthi aseke imigomo eyeseka ukuhweba kwezimakethe ngokukhululeka, umkhakha ozimele ube neqhaza olibambayo. Kumele kubhekwane nenkinga yokungasebenzi kwabantu, izinselelo ezibhekene nomphakathi, kwakhiwe ngokuthi kube namakhono azokhulisa umnotho.” Uthe kumele kuliwe nenkohlakalalo, abantu bakwazi ukuthola izidingo abazifunayo. Ubalule ukuthi kumele amaqembu abambisane akwazi ukuhlukanisa izwe kanjalo neqembu.Isikhulu esiphezulu somkhandlu wosomabhizinisi abamnyama, iBlack Business Council, uMnuz Kganki Matabane, sithe kudingeka kubekwe izwe phambili kunamaqembu ezepolitiki.UMatabane uthe akumele kushitshwe imigomo okulawulwa ngayo izwe."Kumele izwe liqhubeke nentando yeningi okumanje kubuswa ngayo, abaholi baxoxisane baphinde bavumelane kuphinde kube nozinzo. Lokhu kuzodonsa abatshalimali bangabaleki uma bebona ukuthi sekushintshe izinto.” Abanye osomnotho baveze ukuthi basibheke ngabomvu isinqumo samaqembu azosebenzisa ukubumba uhulumeni.Lokhu kulandela ukuthi i-ANC ikwazi ukudla umhlanganiso ezifundazweni ezinhlanu, kuzwelonke idinga amanye amaqembu ukuze yakhe uhulumeni.Abatshalimali kwabona basibheke ngabomvu isinqumo sokuthi imaphi amaqembu azobambisana ukwakha uhulumeni kuleli. IRandi beliqinile njengoba bekuvotwa kuleli.Abanye bakhuluma eyokubambisana phakathi kwe-DA ne-ANC ukuthi kungadala uzinzo kuleli.UNobhala Jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, uthe baxoxa nawo wonke amaqembu, abakhethi phela emasini ngokubumba uhulumeni.
UBHONGOZA weWest, okuyiqembu lemigulukudu elisolwa ngokudubula libulale ababili ebebesohlakeni olulwa nobugebengu eNewtown C eNanda, usalokhu efika ngaphandle komuzi woyedwa wabafi.Lokhu kuvezwe ngelinye ilungu lomndeni wakwaMbambo, elicele ukungadalulwa ngenxa yokuzibona lingaphephile, izolo ngesikhathi bevakashelwe nguNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Nomusa Dube-Ncube.UNkk Dube-Ncube ubehambele imindeni emithathu yalabo abadutshulwe babulawa besekhaleni lokulwa nobugebengu eNanda naseVerulam.Esigamekweni esenzeke ngeSonto kudutshulwe kwabulawa u-Avela Nomphahla (30) ezilolonga nabanye enkundleni yemidlalo.Esigamekweni sesibili (naso esenzeke ngeSonto) kungenelwe uMzwandile Mbambo (60) emzini wakhe wadutshulwa ngabasolwa phambi kwabazukulu nonkosikazi.Kwesinye esenzeke ngoMsombuluko eWaterloo, eVerulam, kudutshulwe kwabulawa uMajola weCommunity Policing Forum (CPF) igama lakhe elingatholakalanga.Kuthiwa uhlaselwe ngababulali esematasa ephelezela amalungu omphakathi eyogibela eya emsebenzini ezama ukuthi aphephe."Uyafika zonke izinsuku u... (Egagula ubhongoza ngegama), afike ame la ngenhla komuzi. Ufika ngezimoto ezehlukene. Lokhu ukwenza zonke izinsuku selokhu kwabulawa umufi (uMbambo)," kusho ilungu lomndeni.Umsunguli weThekwini Neighbourhood Watch, uMnuz Andile Jali, uthe bazisiwe ngalokhu.Uqhube wathi indlela abahlaselwa ngayo yimigulukudu idweba isithombe sokuthi abaphephile kangakanani bengamalungu ezinhlangano ezilwa nobugebengu."Phela thina siyisithiyo esibavimba ukuthi bangakwazi ukufinyelela kubantu ukuze babagcweleze," kusho uJali.Ukhale ngokuthi indawo yonke ye-INK (Inanda, Ntuzuma neKwaMashu) ibhekene nobugebengu obuseqophelweni eliphezulu.Uthe sekunesikhathi bexhumana nezinhlaka ezehlukene zikahulumeni okukhona kuzo yena undunankulu, uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka, ukhomishana wamaphoyisa esifundazweni noMnuz Bheki Cele."Njengoba eza lana nje uzwelana nathi ngoba wonke umuntu ogadayo akavikelekile. Siyabonga ukuthi azifikele mathupha azozibonela ubungozi bale ndawo. Siyajabula uma undunankulu eveza ukuthi kukhona ithimba lamaphoyisa elitshaliwe kule ndawo ukuba ligade ubusuku nemini," kusho uJali.Uthe bakuyekele kuwona amaphoyisa ukuthi ayababopha noma ayababulala njengoba nabo bebulala ozakwabo abaqaphe nabo ubugebengu.Uthe kubajabulisile ukubulawa komunye wabasolwa ngoMsombuluko ngoba lokho kusho ukuphunguka ngasohlangothini lwezigebengu ezizenzela umathanda emphakathini.UNkk Dube-Ncube uthe kubuhlungu ukuhlaselwa kwamalungu ezinhlaka ezilwa nobugebengu, ebulawa yizigebengu."Sizoqhubeka nokuletha izinsiza okufanele zibe khona. Yikho sibanike izimoto, amaselula, nezimpahla zokugqoka," kusho uNkk Dube.Uqhube wathi basazonikwa noqeqesho lokuthi bagcine bekwazi ukubhekana ngqo nezigebengu uma ziphethe izibhamu.Ukhale ngokwakheka kwelokishi iNewtown, wathi kufanele kube khona izindlu ezibhidlizwayo ukuze kwakheke kahle imigwaqo khona namaphoyisa ezokwazi ukuthi afinyelele kalula uma ebizelwa esigamekweni.Uthe basezingxoxweni nemiphakathi efana nale ukuthi mhlawumbe sekuyisikhathi sokuthi kudilizwe eminye yemijondolo ukuze kwakhiwe imigwaqo ukuze usizo lufike kalula.
INKUNZI eluvava kwezokuphathwa kweminyango kahulumeni, uDkt Kwazi Mbanjwa, iwumholi omusha weMK KwaZulu-Natal emuva kokudilizwa kophethe lesi sikhundla.IMK isematheni kulezi zinsuku emuva kokugila izimanga okhethweni iqala nje nokungena futhi inezinyanga ezimbalwa imenyezelwe.IMK yamenyezelwa ngowayengumengameli, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, ngoDisemba nyakenye, wathi uyayishiya i-ANC ngeke asayivotela. Emuva kwalokho kudilike umthangala abantu bejoyina ubuthaphuthaphu kuleli qembu elisha.UMbanjwa waduma kakhulu engumqondisi-jikelele kuhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal kudala. Uke waba wumeluleki kaZuma kudala.IMK imthumelele incwadi imazisa ukuthi nguyena osezophatha isikhundla somdidiyeli wesikhashana eKZN. Encwadini uMbanjwa uncengwa ukuthi asiphathe ngobunono isikhundla."Uyanxuswa ukuthi usebenzise amandla onikwe wona ngokunakekela, ungawasebenzisi budedengu. Ubeke phambili ukukhulisa iqembu lilungele ukhetho lohulumeni basekhaya ngo-2026,’’ kusho incwadi Isolezwe eliyibonile.UMbanjwa uqokwa nje bekusanda kudilizwa uMnuz Simphiwe Mpungose obesahlale isikhashana esikhundleni. Ngaphambi kukaMpungose kwakudilizwe uMnuz Nhlanhla Ngidi.UNgidi naye uwugalagala kwezokuphathwa kukahulumeni futhi wadilizwa isigubhukane, wangachazelwa ukuthi kwenzenjani. Ukuqokwa kukaMbanjwa kulesi sikhundla abanye bakuhumusha ngokuthi iMK ilungiselela ukuthatha uhulumeni.Kusaqhubeka izingxoxo zokubusa ngokubambisana emuva kokuthi engekho onqobe ngengcaca eKZN. I-MK inezihlalo ezingu-37 KwaZulu-Natal ezithole emuva kokhetho futhi ihleli esicongweni.Endaweni yesibili kuhleli i-IFP ngezihlalo ezingu-15, ilandelwe yi-ANC ngezingu-14. Endaweni yesine kukhona i-DA ngezihlalo ezingu-11, ilandelwe yi-EFF ngezihlalo ezimbili.I-NFP ilele emsileni ngesihlalo esisodwa kodwa naso esingenamehluko uma sekuxoxwa. Kulindeleke ukuthi ubunjwe maduze uhulumeni uma sekukhona amaqembu avumelanayo.
AMANAZARETHA athi kufakazeleka isiphrofetho somsunguli webandla lakwaShembe, iNkosi Isaya Shembe, Umqaliwendlela ngokuqamba iLindamakhosi okuyithempeli lebandla elikwaNongoma njengoba kuzobhajadiswa iSilo uMisuzulu kaZwelithini ngeSonto kwaNongoma.ISilo sizobhajadiswa wuMholi wamaNazaretha, inkosi uMduduzi Shembe uNyazilwezulu.Okhulumela uNyazilwezulu, uMnuz Thokozani Mncwabe, uthe kuzoqopheka umlando kudumale izitha kubhajadiswa iSilo wuNyazi.Uthe kumanje kuqhubeka umhlangano wamaNazaretha oseLindamakhosi kwaNongoma, kodwa iSilo sizobhajadiselwa kwaKhangelamankengane okungaqhelelene naseLindamakhosi."UMqaliwendlela wathi kuseLindamakhosi. ISilo uMisuzulu kaZwelithini kuzoba iSilo sokuqala ukubhajadiswa sithatha inkolo yobuNazaretha. Sijabule kakhulu ngokuzokwenzeka futhi kuzoba ngumlando enkolweni yobuNazaretha kubhajadiswa iSilo. Izilo zaphambilini bezingayixwayi inkolo yobuNazaretha kodwa asikho sake sabhajadiswa saba yiNazaretha," kusho uMncwabe.Ngomcimbi wokubhajadiswa kweSilo uthe konke bazokuzwa ngoNyazilwezulu, akwaziyo ukuthiumbhabhadiso uzoba semini kwaKhangelamankengane. Ubudlelwano bamaNazaretha ngaphansi koNyazilwezulu buhlala bubuhle. NeSilo esesibuzile uZwelithini kaBhekuzulu ubehlala evakashelana noNyazilwezulu. Uma kunemigidi eNdlunkulu kuqala kunyathele amaNazaretha eholwa wuNyazilwezulu ukubusisa umcimbi ungakaqali. Noma amaNazaretha enyuka intaba eNgcwele uma kuqala unyaka iSilo siba yingxenye yalolu hambo olungcwele lokunyuka intaba.
ISIFO sofuba ngeke siphele uma kusanenqwaba yabantu abadla ukudla okungenamsoco kuleli.Lokhu kushiwo uSolwazi Willem Hanekom wesikhungo esenza ucwaningo i-Africa Health Research Institute (AHRI), ngesikhathi ongoti asebenesikhathi eside becwaninga ngaleli gciwane beshiyelana inkundla engqungqutheleni edingida ngalesi sifo, i-8th SA TB Conference eqhubekayo eThekwini.UHanekom uthe asekubonile ngalesi sifo ukuthi uma abantu bedla ukudla okunempilo kuyenzeka noma benalo igciwane laso lingafiki esigabeni lapho lizobagulisa khona."Inkinga esibhekene nayo ukuthi kuleli kuneqwaba yabantu ababhuqwabhuqwa indlala abajabulela ukuthi badlile, okuseyiphupho kubo ukuthi ukudla abakudlayo kube okuqukethe imisoco edingwa umzimba ukuze amasosha abo aqine. Lokhu kusitshela ukuthi imithi iyodwa ngeke isilaphe isiqede lesi sifo. Siyoze silekelelwe ukuthi kube nomgomo wokuvikela lesi sifo." Uthe okunye nje okungakaqondakali ngalesi sifo yize sekuneminyaka eminingi sikhona ukuthi sithelelana kanjani.Uthe phambilini bekuthiwa uma onaso ekhwehlela kuqhasha amathe, oseduze kwakhe uba sengozini yokusithola. Kunolunye ucwaningo oluveza ukuthi uketshezi oluningi luphuma emakhaleni ngesikhathi onaleli gciwane ephefumula noma ekhwehlela."Ucwaningo lwakamuva luveza ukuthi bangaphezu kuka-58% abantu abanesifo seTB abangenazo izimpawu. Okungenzeka ukuthi iyona imbangela yokuthi lesi sifo silokhu siqhubekile nokuba ngesihamba phambili esibulala abantu kuleli yize kunezinto ezinhle kangaka esizenzayo zokulwa naso. Umbuzo ukuthi sizobathola kanjani abantu abanalesi sifo uma bengenazo izimpawu," kusho uHanekom.UDkt Refiloe Malatji oqale ukusebenza ezinhlelweni zoMnyango wezeMpilo zokwelapha iTB kuleli ngo-1994, nomsunguli wenhlangano, i-AQUATIY Innovations, uvumelane noHanekom, wathi kusadingeka kutshalwe imali emkhakheni wokuqeda ububha ngoba lesi sifo simandla kakhulu ebantwini abanobubha."Kumele kulungiswe indaba yokushoda kwezindlu, indlela okusetshenzwa ngayo ngoba nayo inomthelela ekusabalaleni kwalesi sifo. Ngasohlangothini lwezempilo akukho okusivimbayo ukuthi uma umuntu ekhwehlela simnike imishanguzo ngaphambi kokuthi kubuye imiphumela. Njengamanje uma sisola ukuthi umuntu uneTB simnika amabhodlela sithi akayokwehlela. Abuyele ekhaya egula enjalo. Sivinjwa yini ukuthi simnike imishanguzo, sisalindile? Ngesikhathi ebuyela ekhaya uthelela abangaki,," kubuza uDkt Malatji.
UFUNA ibheyili ukuze akwazi ukuyodayisa amaswidi, amagwinya namashibusi owesilisa othweswe icala lokubulala indodana yakhe.UMnuz Siyabonga Innocent Shezi (30) ufake ubeke lamaphuzu enxenxa imantshi ukuthi imnikeze ibheyili.Usolwa ngokushaya aklinye indodana yakhe uSifundo Sibisi owayenenminyaka eyisishiyagalombili.Ubuzwe ummeli wakhe kungani iMantshi L Gorie kumele imnikeze ibheyili wathi ufuna ukuyovusa ibhizinisi lakhe."Ngifuna ukuthi ngiqhubeke namabhizinisi ami amancane. Ngingumakhi, ngiyabhaka futhi nginebhizinisi lokudayisa oswidi, ukudla okungamagwinya, amashibusi engikudayisa ezikoleni nasemphakathini, " kuchaza uShezi.Waboshwa ngoJanuwari 13, 2023 wathweswa icala lokubulala okuhleliwe.Isidumbu sikamufi satholakala ehlathini eNtshongweni eThekwini sinamanxeba okushaywa ngokuklinya.Uvele wayihleka usuku yonke into ebikade ichazwa uShezi ethula ubufakazi unina kaSifundo, uNksz Nonhlanhla Shezi obesenkantolo.Usole uShezi ngokusenga ezimithiyo wathi ubengayenzi yonke lento athi uyayenza, udukisa inkantolo.Icala lihlehliselwe uJuni 13 nonyaka khona uMbuso uzoyofuna iminingwane ngezinto ezishiwo uShezi ngesikhathi ethula ubufakazi ecela ibheyili.UShezi ubeqale wadonswa ngendlebe yimantshi ethe akamusa ukudlala uma eza enkantolo.Ubekade ekhuluma kancane, ebuka phansi unomphela abuye acimeze, wathi kwenziwa ukukhathala anakho.Ubebuye ajeqeze unina kaSifundo nakade ehlezi nabo abebekade bezomeseka enkantolo.
