INHLANGANO ebhekelele abathengi, iNational Consumer Commission (NCC) icela abantu ukuthi babuyisele ezitolo ishampoo yeDark and Lovely etholakala kuma-relaxer akhona ahlukene.Le shampoo ewu-50ml itholakala kwiDark and Lovely Moisture Plus Kit eyi-regular neyi-super nakwiDark and Lovely Anti Breakage Kit.INCC icela abantu ukuthi babuyisele ezitolo imikhiqizo ene-shampoo yakwaDark and Lovely esesithombeni Isithombe:NCCINCC ithe abantu abathenge le shampoo kufanele bayibuyisele ezitolo ukuze bathole imali yabo abathenge ngayo.IPhini likaKhomishana weNCC uNksz Thezi Mabuza uthe inkampani ekhiqiza iDark and Lovely, iLoreal ibatshele ukuthi ithole igciwane kule shampoo ngesikhathi iyihlola ngakho kufanele ibuyiselwe emuva."Siyakuqonda ukuthi le shampoo isetshenziswa kanye kodwa siyacela ukuthi abantu baseNingizimu Afrika abayithengile imikhiqizo enayo bayibuyisele emuva. Abakhiqizi bale shampoo bathe ukusebenziswa kwayo kungaholela ekutheni ogeze izinwele zakhe ngayo abe nenkinga yesikhumba ekhanda ikakhulukazi labo abanezifo ezihlazela amasosha omzimba,” kusho uNksz Mabuza.Uthe le shampoo yayikhiqizwe ngo-Ephreli wonyaka odlule, idayiswa eZambia, Zimbabwe, Namibia, Kenya, Ghana, Botswana, Eswatini, Lesotho, Morocco, Nigeria nakuleli.Uphethe ngokuthi umthetho ovikela abathengi iConsumer Protection Act, uphoqa abakhiqiza ukuthi baqinisekise ukuthi imikhiqizo yabo iphephile.Ucele izinkampani ukuthi zinisekise ukuthi abathengi baphephile ngaso sonke isikhathi futhi uzoluqapha ngeso lokhozi uhlelo lokubuyiselwa kwama shampoo ezitolo.
INKANTOLO ibeke usuku ezolalela ngalo ubufakazi obuzokwethulwa iphoyisa elithweswe icala lokudubula ngoyaba lezinhlamvu libulale okuthiwa wayekade encike emotweni yalo.Kubekelwe uJuni 25 nonyaka ukuze uSergeant Sibonelo Christopher Shabangu abeke uhlangothi lwakhe ngokwenzeka.UShabangu ubekade evele eNkantolo yeMantshi yasePinetown ngoLwesithathu emini.Ungaphandle ngebheyili kaR5 000.Ummeli kaShabangu, uMnuz Andile Dakela phambilini watshela inkantolo ukuthi ummangalelwa wadubula ezivikela ngoba ebona ukuthi impilo yakhe isengcupheni.UDakela wathi uShabangu wayekade exabana nomufi, uMnuz Qaphela Mdima, ayekade emyalele ukuthi asuke emotweni yakhe anganciki.Isigameko senzeka ngaphandle kwendawo yobumnandi iCasa Blanca Lifestyle, eMolweni, eThekwini.Enkantolo bekade kukhona abantu baseMolweni abangaphuthi uma kuqulwa icala.UMdima wahlonzwa njengoseshonile emuva kokuthi ephuthunyiswe emtholampilo waKwaDabeka elimele kanzima.UMbuso usonge uhlelo lwawo lokubizwa ofakazi.
ZIQALE phansi izigameko zokubanjwa inkunzi kwezimoto ezithwala imali, KwaZulu-Natal, njengoba sekwenzeke ezintathu esikhathini esingaphansi kwenyanga.Esigamekweni sakamuva esenzeke emgwaqweni u-N2 ngaKwaMashu izolo ekuseni, kuthiwa abasolwa abebehamba ngezimoto ezehlukene bavulele ngenhlamvu bebhekise emotweni ethwala imali bagcina bebaleka nesamba semali engadalulwanga.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe ngesikhathi abasolwa bedubula bebhekise ngasemotweni ethwala imali, badubule nemoto ebihamba iphoyisa engamakiwe ebelidlula liya emsebenzini. Uthe iphoyisa lidubule labhekisa ngakubasolwa, lasiza ekuvimbeni nabanye abashayeli bezimoto abebesebenzisa umzila ofanayo, abebengazithola bengabagilwa bentululwane yezinhlamvu ebezindiza emoyeni zivela ohlangothini lwabasolwa."Izigebengu zikwazile ukuqhumisa imoto ethwala imali zabaleka nesamba semali engadalulwanga. Onogada abebegade imoto yemali baphume bengenamyocu, nakuba izigebengu zibaphuce izibhamu zabo. Kunxuswa noma ngubani ongaba nolwazi olungasiza amaphoyisa ukuze abambe abasolwa aludlulisele esiteshini samaphoyisa esiseduze, noma ashayele enombolweni ethi; 08 600 10111,” kusho uNetshiunda.Kwenzeka lokhu nje, amaphoyisa abesanda kuthela othulini abasolwa ababili, abadutshulwe bafa, kwathi oyedwa zamkhalela enenxeba lokudutshulwa. Laba basolwa kuthiwa bebelandelwa ngecala lokubanjwa kwenkunzi imoto ethwala imali okuthiwa kwenzeke emgwaqweni u-R74 ngaseKranskop, ngoMsombuluko.UNetshiunda uthe ngesikhathi amaphoyisa elandela umkhondo, alandele imoto ebihamba abasolwa egcine ishayisa ipali eliseceleni komgwaqo ePhoenix, emva kokuthi abasolwa bebonile ukuthi kubashele, kuthiwa baphume badubula bebhekise ngasemaphoyiseni, amaphoyisa aphendula kwashona ababili, kwathi oyedwa watholwa ebhace kwesinye isakhiwo enenxeba lokudutshulwa, kanti ungeniswe esibhedlela ngaphansi kweso lamaphoyisa.Ngenyanga edlule, amaphoyisa adubule abasolwa abane abebefunwa ngamacala okubamba inkunzi izimoto ezithwala imali, babulawe e-Camperdown. Kukholakala ukuthi abasolwa badubula kuqala bebhekise emaphoyiseni, aphendula ngendlela efanayo.
I-ACTIONSA ikhale ngobuxoki kozakwabo abayingxenye yesivumelwano sokukhipha i-ANC emandleni ngesikhathi imemezela ukuhoxa kwayo kulesi vumelwano esasayinwa ngonyaka owedlule.Umholi we-ActionSA, uMnuz Herman Mashaba, uthe banqume ukuphuma esivumelwaneni ngenxa yokuthi amaqembu abebekhankasa nawo ngokuthi bafuna ukukhipha i-ANC emandleni asecula elinye iculo.UMashaba uthe amanye ala maqembu asexoxa ne-ANC, ngenhloso yokufinyelela esivumelwaneni sokusebenzisana.I-ANC yehlulekile ukuthola izihlalo ezanele ukuthi ibuse ngokuzimela, njengamanje ixoxa namanye amaqembu ngenhloso yokuthola isivumelwano sokusebenzisana.Amaqembu ayingxenye yesivumelwano sokukhipha i-ANC emandleni ahlulekile ukuthola izihlalo ezanele ukuthi akhiphe i-ANC emandleni.UMashaba uthe emva kokumenyezelwa kwemiphumela yokhetho, ozakwabo abebeyingxenye yesivumelwano bavele bagijimela ukuyoxoxa ne-ANC, nathe kuphambene nemigomo abazibekela yona ngesikhathi besayina isivumelwano."Samangala ngesikhathi sibona amaqembu esinesivumelwano nawo esexoxa ne-ANC. Ngalesi senzo baphula isethembiso abasenza kubantu bakuleli ngesikhathi sikhankasela ukhetho. Ingakho thina sikhethe ukuhoxa."Asikwazi ukubavimba uma befuna ukuyoxoxa ne-ANC, kuyilungelo labo. Kodwa ke lento abayenzayo iphambene nalokhu esavumelana ngakho. Ingakho sithe asikwenze kube semthethweni ukuhoxa kwethu. Ngeke silokhu sitetema, abaqhubeke nabakwenzayo. Ingakho sihlehla, khona bezokwazi ukuxoxa nanoma iliphi iqembu abafuna ukuxoxa nalo.”UMashaba uthe abafune lutho oluzobahlanganisa ne-ANC."Sizimisele ngokuba yiqembu eliphikisayo kunokuba sisebenzisane ne-ANC.”I-ActionSA ithole izihlalo eziyisithupha ePhalamende.UMashaba nosihlalo kazwelonke we-ActionSA, uMnuz Michael Beaumont, abazokuya ePhalamende.UMashaba uthe bathathe isinqumo sokuthi bangayi ePhalamende ukuze bagxile ekukhuliseni iqembu."Ukhetho lohulumeni basekhaya lwango-2026 seluseduze. Sifisa ukuthi ukhetho lufike silulungele. Siyazi ukuthi ukhetho lohulumeni basekhaya ngeke lube lula. Yingakho sikhethe ukuthi sisheshe siqale ukulungiselela ukhetho. "Ukuba yilungu lePhalamende kudinga isikhathi esiningi. Ugcina usuphoqeleka ukuba ukhethe phakathi kokuhambela umhlangano wasePhalamende nowomphakathi. Mina ngikhetha ukuhambela umhlangano womphakathi. Yingakho ngikhethe ukungayi ePhalamende.” Ithimba le-ActionSA ePhalamende lizoholwa owayeyimeya yoMasipala waseNelson Mandela Bay, uMnuz Athol Trollip.Kuleli thimba kukhona nekhansela laseThekwini, uMnuz Alan Beesley.UMashaba uthe uyalethemba ithimba abalithumele ePhalamende.
AMALUNGU esigungu esiphezulu kwi-ANC angene emhlanganweni wokuyoxoxa eyokubusa ngokubambisana engaphansi kwengcindezi yokuba adlalele kude neDA.Ngaphambi komhlangano wayizolo, kwande amadlelandawonye namalungu e-ANC athi awafuni nokuyizwa eyokubambisana kwe-ANC neDA.Idlelandawonye le-ANC, iSACP, libe nesithangami lapho liveze khona ukuthi alihambisani nokubambisana kwe-ANC neDA.Idlanzana lamalungu e-ANC eliphikisana nokubambisana neDA belibhikisha ngaphandle kwendawo obekubanjelwe kuwo umhlangano.Yize kukhona ongoti ababona umshado we-ANC neDA ungabuyisa ithemba kubatshalizimali, kukhona amalungu e-ANC angafuni nokuyizwa eyalo mshado.Omunye walabo abebebhikisha, uNksz Thuthukile Zuma, oyindodakazi yomholi weMK, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, uthe iDA ihlale iphikisana nemithetho ethuthukisa abantu abamnyama."Sikholelwa ukuthi asikho isidingo sokuthi i-ANC ibambisane neqembu elaziwayo ukuthi alifuni ukubona abantu abamnyama beya phambili. I-DA ihlezi iphikisana nayo yonke imithetho eshaya uhulumeni we-ANC. Kuyimanje bayaphikisana nomshwalense wezempilo. Uma ufunda kahle umqulu wabo wezethembiso zokhetho uzobona ukuthi bayaphikisana nemithetho ethuthukisa abantu abamnyama. "Singalifaka kanjani kuhulumeni wokubambisana iqembu eliyisitha sokuthuthukiswa komuntu omnyama. Uze ubabone ukuthi abalikhathalele kanjani izwe, bakwazi ukushisa ifulegi lakuleli. Siyathemba ukuthi abaholi bethu ngeke basebenzisane neDA.”ISACP ibe nesithangami nabezindaba ngoLwesithathu ebusuku, lapho ithe ayihambisani nokubambisana kwe-ANC neDA.Unobhala weSACP, uMnuz Solly Mapaila, uthe abasebenzi nabahlwempu bazohlupheka uma kungaphatha iDA.UMapaila uphinde waveza ukuthi abafuni ukuthi i-ANC ibambisane neMK.ICosatu namanye amalungu esigungu esiphezulu kwi-ANC abevele esephumele obala ngaphambi komhlangano wayizolo, aveza ukuthi awayizwa eyokubambisana neDA.Unobhala jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, uthe besingekho isidingo sombhikisho."Asikanqumi ukuthi sizobambisana naliphi iqembu. Kuyishwa ukuthi bese kuba khona umbhikisho. Isikhathi esikuso sidinga ukuthi sibeke phansi amaphaphu. Njengoba siya emhlanganweni asicabangi ngokufana.”Uthe okwamanje bazama ukuxoxa nawo wonke amaqembu ezepolitiki.UMbalula uchaze ubunzima ababhekene nabo ekuxhumaneni neMK."Asikayitholi impendulo eqondile. Kunzima ukuxhumana neMK ngoba bavele bakutshele ukuthi balinde ubaba (uZuma). Yonke into yenziwa ubaba lapha.”
IJAJI Ratha Mokgoatlheng elihlalele icala lokufa kukaSenzo Meyiwa lithi abameli babambezela icala bashaya izaququ ngongoti wabo ohlola izibhamu abathi bazomletha.UMeyiwa wadutshulwa wabulawa ekaKelly Khumalo, eVosloorus, eGauteng ngo-2014. UMbuso wethula ubufakazi ozimisele ukugojela ngabo abalisa abahlanu okholwa wukuthi babulala uMeyiwa.UMbuso sewambiza ungoti ohlola izibhamu owathi isibhamu esatholwa siyahambisana negobolondo lenhlamvu elatholwa endaweni yesigameko. Isibhamu esahlolwa satholwa kummangalelwa wesithathu uMthobisi Mncube.Abameli babamangalelwa babuphosela inselelo lobo bufakazi bathi bazoletha owabo ungoti ahlole isibhamu. IJaji libuze ku-Advocate Charles Mnisi ukuthi kumiphi ngongoti wabo ozohlola isibhamu.UMnisi uthe basalinde iLegal Aid SA ukuthi ibazise ukuthi isihambe yafikaphi ngokuqoka ungoti wezibhamu. IJaji likhuze lababaza lathi sekudleke isikhathi eside." Umthetho uthi kufanele nithole ithuba elanele lokwenza umsebenzi wenu kodwa sekungaphezulu manje. UMbuso wethula ubufakazi bawo ngo-Agasti ngonyaka odlule, sekuphele izinyanga eziyishiyagalolunye,’’ kusho iJaji.IJaji lithe leli cala liwundendende alipheli kanti nabaphathi balo bayakhononda ngalo. IJaji lize lancokola ngokuthi liyoze lificwe wukufa lingaqedile ngecala.Kuvele omunye ummeli uMnuz Sipho Ramosepele wathi abeLegal Aid SA bake bambhalela bemazisa ukuthi sebemtholile ungoti wabanika nezindleko zakhe. URamosepele uthe abakwazi kodwa ukubonana nongoti okwamanje.IJaji libuze kuMshushisi woMbuso u-Advocate George Baloyi ukuthi bangaki ofakazi abasele abazobizwa wuMbuso. UBaloyi uthe uMbuso uya ngasemaphethelweni okusonga ubufakazi bawo.Uthe bebezimsele ukusonga ngasekupheleni kwenyanga kodwa ukubambezeleka okukhona kuzophoqa ukuthi kwelulwe isikhathi. izolo icala lisheshe laguqa ngesikhathi isikhulu saseVodacom ebesethula ubufakazi bamaselula sixinwa wukugula.Izwi lesikhulu beliya ngokuya lishabalala ngenxa yomkhuhlane kwavunyelwana ngokuthi aliguqe icala ufakazi anikwe ithuba lokululama. IJaji nakuba belingeneme kodwa ligcine livumile ukuthi icala lihlehlele uLwesibili.

INDODAKAZI yezishoshovu zomzabalazo uNksz Lindiwe Sisulu, ithi liyashona ilanga inkomo ifasiwe, i-ANC yehlulwa wukukhanda isixaxa namaqembu abantu abamnyama kubunjwe uhulumeni.UNksz Sisulu ozalwa uMnuz Walter Sisulu noNkk Albertina Sisulu, usematheni ngokuphumela obala ngalolu daba. Indaba enkulu iqale emuva kokuthi i-ANC yehluleke wukunqoba ukhetho ngengcaca.Kunamahlebezi athi i-ANC ingase ikhande isixaxa ne-DA elele isibili ngo-21.81% ilandela i-ANC yona ethole u-40%. I-ANC inezihlalo ezingu-159 ekubeni i-DA inezihlalo ezingu-87 okungathi uma behlangana benze izihlalo ezingu-246.ILUNGU lesigungu esiphezulu se-ANC uNksz Lindiwe Sisulu aleneme ngamahlebezi okuthi i-ANC ingase ihlangane ne-DA kubunjwe uhulumeni Isithombe : FACEBOOK/LINDIWE SISULUI-ANC igadle zephuka okhethweni obelunzima kakhulu ngesonto eledlule yahluleka nokuyiphoqa ukuthi ihambe iphaphatha emaqenjini. Kulezi zinsuku izingxoxo zishisa phansi kuzanywa ukuthola isixaxa esizongena kuhulumeni siphathe izwe.Amaqembu anezinsuku ezingu-14 emuva kokumenyezelwa kwemiphumela yokhetho ukuthi aphume negama kubunjwe uhulumeni. I-ANC isematasa nemihlangano yokuxoxa namaqembu ibingakamemezeli ezokwenza.UNksz Sisulu uthe kungaba yihlazo ukuthi i-ANC iyeke amaqembu abantu abamnyama emaningi kangaka bese ihlangana ne-DA."Sikhetha i-DA ngoba kwenzenjani nje ngoba sehlukene kakhulu ngemigomo nemibono nabo. Sinabantu esibethembise ukubamela sibenzele konke kodwa i-DA akuyona indlela esingayisebenzisa. Siyiyekeleni i-IFP noma i-MK namanye amaqembu?,,’’ kusho uNksz Sisulu.Uthe umphakathi uyijezise izikhathi eziningi ngevoti ngenxa yokwehluleka kwayo wukufeza izethembiso kodwa yona ifuna ukubagila kakhulu abantu.UNksz Sisulu uthe ekuqaleni iNational Party yazicelela yona ukuhoxa esixaxeni sayo ne-ANC ngoba kucaca ukuthi banezinhloso ezehlukene kakhulu.Kwamanye amaqembu abamnyama akhona kuvela i-MK elele isithathu ngo-14.58% okuyinika izihlalo ezingu-58, ilandelewe yi-EFF ngezihlalo ezingu-39. I-IFP isendaweni yesihlanu ngezihlalo ezingu-17.UNksz Sisulu ubuziwe kwithelevishini ukuthi uvumbukaphi ngoba akaze abonakale ekhankasela i-ANC, wavuka ngolaka wathi akazele ukuzophendula lokho. Uthe ubengeke azishuthe izithombe ekhankasa.
IQEMBU eliholwa owayengumengameli, uJacob Zuma, iMK, lichayise i-ANC ebizama ukulinxenxa ukuba libe ingxenye yezingxoxo zokubusa ngokubambisana.Okhulumela i-ANC, uNkk Mahlengi Bhengu-Motsiri, uveze ukuthi iMK izibe izicelo zabaholi be-ANC zokuba kuhlanganwe.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba, izolo, lapho ebekhuluma khona ngokuxoxwe emhlanganweni wekomiti elibhekele ukusebenza kwansuku zonke kwi-ANC obubhunga eyokubusa ngokubambisana.I-ANC isembhidlangweni wokuthola amaqembu ezobusa ngokubambisana nawo njengoba ingazange iwine ngamalengiso ngesikhathi kunokhetho ngeledlule.IMK ilele isithathu ngokwezibalo zamavoti.Abaholi beMK sebekusho kaningi ukuthi ngeke baxoxe ne-ANC uma isaphethwe uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa.UNkk Bhengu-Motsiri uthe ubuholi obuphezulu kwi-ANC buzamile ukuxhumana neMK kodwa zangabuya izimpendulo."Kube nemizamo eminingi yokuxhumana neMK kodwa ke asikayitholi impendulo. Umnyango uzohlezi uvuliwe kuwo wonke amaqembu afuna ukuyisa izwe phambili. Thina siyi-ANC sizimisele ukuxoxa nawo wonke amaqembu ezepolitiki. Yebo singaba nemibono ehlukene kodwa sinethemba lokuthi singakwazi ukusebenzisana sonke. Thina sibeke phambili izwe.”UNkk Bhengu-Motsiri uthe sebeziqalile izingxoxo namanye amaqembu athole izihlalo eziningi ePhalamende, iDA, EFF, IFP, NFP nePA.Uuthe banethemba lokuthi izingxoxo nala maqembu zizohamba kahle."Okusinikeza ithemba ukuthi lamaqembu avumile ukuhlangana nathi sixoxe. Lokhu kukutshela ukuthi nabo bafuna ukubona lolu daba luxazululeka. Kodwa ke konke kuzoncika ezingxoxweni. Thina esikufunayo ukuthi kube nohulumeni ozohlanganisa onke amaqembu"Kuzobe kungekhona okokuqala siba nohulumeni ohlanganisa amaqembu. Ngisho nasezikhathini lapho esasiwine khona ngamalengiso, sasike siwafake amaqembu amancane. Ude Lille (uNkk Patricia) weGood, uyingxenye kahulumeni. UHlengwa (uMnuz Mkhuleko) we-IFP uwusihlalo weScopa (Standing Committee on Public Accounts).” UNkk Bhengu-Motsiri uthe kujwayelekile ukuthi kube netwetwe uma kunezingxoxo zokubusa ngokubambisana, wathi bazokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi izingxoxo ziphothulwa ngokushesha.Namhlanje kuzoba nomhlangano wesigungu esiphezulu kwi-ANC ozothatha isinqumo sokuthi imaphi amaqembu abazosebenzisana nawo.UNkk Bhengu-Motsiri uthe kuneziphakamiso ezintathu okuzoxoxwa ngazo, nokho angafuni ukuzidalula.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi isiphakamiso sokuqala esokuthi i-ANC ibambisane namaqembu athole izihlalo, ezinye iziphakamiso zithinta ukusebenzisana ne-DA ne-IFP ngezindlela ezehlukene.
BESE kunesikhashana esongelwa ngokubulawa oyilungu eliqavile loMkhonto weSizwe Party (MK) odutshulwe wabulawa eCato Crest, eMayville, eThekwini.UMnuz Mxolisi Zungu (32) kuthiwa uhlaselwe umsolwa obehamba yedwa ngezinyawo ngesikhathi yena (umufi) nowakwakhe behamba ngezinyawo bengazelele bebuya ukuyohambisa ingane (3) yabo enkulisa yendawo.Isolezwe lithole ngelinye ilungu leMK kule ndawo elicele ukungadalulwa ukuthi umufi uke wabatshela ukuthi kukhona abamsongela ngokumyisa kwagoqanyawo.Leli lungu liqhubeke ladalula ukuthi nangenyanga edlule, ngesikhathi kungqongqiswa nendlu elinye ilungu leqembu, umufi wakuveza ukuthi naye impilo yakhe isengcupheni."Ngesikhathi sisendaweni yesigameko lapho okwakubulewe khona uMorgan, uMxo wayeqhaqhazela, esho ukuthi naye unovalo lokuthi angahle alandele,” kusho ilungu.UMnuz Morgan Mbili (45) washona ngo-Ephreli 30 emva kokusha nomjondolo kule ndawo. Abaningi okubandakanya nabeqembu, basola unyawo lwemfene ngendlela ashona ngayo.AMALUNGU omphakathi namaphoyisa endaweni yesigameko eCato Crest lapho okudutshulwe kwabulawa khona ilungu leMKP uMnuz Mxolisi Zungu Isithombe: Tumi Pakkies/ Independent NewspapersOmunye osebuholini beMK kule ndawo, naye ocele ukungavezwa uthe, umufi ubengumdidiyeli wokhetho eqenjini kule ndawo. Uthe bakholwa ukuthi amavoti evile ku-5 000 atholwe yiqembu kule ndawo, atholwe ngenxa yezithukuthuku zakhe."Kusithusile ukubulawa kwakhe ngoba lesi sigameko selama esenzeke ngenyanga edlule lapho kushiswe khona elinye ilungu lethu nendlu. Manje uma sekwenzeka lesi sigameko, sesiqala ukuyibuka ngamanye amehlo le nto. Umufi ubeyimenenja yokhetho kule ndawo. Nalezi zibalo esizitholile, kungenxa yakhe,” kusho ilungu.UMUFI, uMnuz Mxolisi Zungu obeyilungu leMKP elele endaweni yesigameko eCato Crest lapho edutshulwe wabulawa khona umsolwa obemlandela Isithombe: Tumi Pakkies/ INDEPENDENT NEWSPAPERSIlungu lomndeni, elicele ukufihlwa ngoba libona lingaphephile njengoba umsolwa esacanasa, lithe umufi udutshulwe ngezinhlamvu eziyisihlanu, kwathathwa nesibhamu sakhe. Liqhube lathi umsolwa uvele wachusha phakathi kwemijondolo, waphela emehlweni emva kokugila le mikhuba.Lidalule ukuthi ubebuye enze umsebenzi wokuba umqaphi uma ebiziwe nokwenza badideke ukuthi ubulawelwani."Asazi ukuthi isigameko sokubulawa kwakhe singasiyamanisa nakuphi phakathi komsebenzi wakhe kanjalo nezepolitiki. Yena ubeyilo ilungu leMK eliqavile,” kusho ilungu lomndeni.Liqhube lathi bona bewumndeni ubengakaze abavezele ukuthi uyasongelwa.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa aseCato Manor aphenya icala lokubulala nelokubamba inkunzi emva kokudutshulwa kowesilisa eCato Crest izolo ekuseni."Umgilwa ubehamba nomkakhe kuNew Road, beqeda kushiya ingane yabo enkulisa ngesikhathi umsolwa obehamba ngezinyawo emdubula ngemumva. Ushonele endaweni yesigameko. Umsolwa uthathe isibhamu sikamgilwa ngaphambi kokubaleka endaweni yesigameko,” kusho uNetshiunda, othe imbangela yokubulala ayikaziwa.
YENZA umahluko imishanguzo emisha eyelapha isifo sofuba esingazweli emakhambini, iDrug-resistant-TB.Imishanguzo eyinhlanganisela yamakhambi iBedaqualline, iPretomanid, iLinezolid eyaziwa ngeBPaL, yelapha iziguli ezinaleli gciwane izinyanga eziyisithupha esikhundleni sezinyanga ezingu-18. Iqale ukusetshenziswa kuleli ngoSepthemba nyakenye, ongoti bathi alukho uhlelo olwake lwasebenza njengayo.USolwazi Norbert Ndjeka, umqondisi wezihlelo zokwelapha iTB kuleli, usho lokhu izolo, engqungqutheleni yesifo sofuba yakuleli, i8th SA TB Conference, eThekwini.Uthe njengamanje zingu-2000 iziguli ezidla imishanguzo, kuzo kusashone ezimbili kuphela."Asinazo iziguli ezingasabuyeli ezikhungweni zezempilo ngoba uhlelo lwenziwe ngendlela yokuthi iziguli nabasebenzi bezempil, basebenzisane. Uma isiguli sinenkinga sazisa umsebenzi wezempilo inkinga isheshe isonjululwe. Ngemuva kwezinyanga eziyisithupha odla imishanguzo usuke eselapheke ngokuphelele. Imali yokukwelapha isiguli yehlile uma siqhathanisa nohlelo lwezinyanga ezingu-18 zaphambilini ngoba kule mishanguzo kukhishwe izinhlobo ezine zamaphilisi ebezisetshenziswa, kwehla nesikhathi sokwelashwa," kuchaza uNdjeka.Ukusetshenziswa kwamakhambi kuyingxenye yokuhambisana nemigomo yakamuva ebekwe yinhlangano yezeMpilo eMhlabeni, iWorld Health Organisation (WHO).UDkt Karen Dupreez weNyuvesi iStellenbosch, uthe kungekudala bazokhipha imigomo emisha yokwelapha isifo sofuba ezinganeni, ebafaneni nasemantombazaneni asengena ebuntombini nabesifazane abakhulelwe, iNational Child, Adolescence, Martenal TB Working guidelines.Uthe imigomo emisha bayisungule ukuze balwe nokufa kwezingane kanye nabantu abasha bebulawa yilesi sifo."Zingu-27 000 izingane ezibulawa yiTB kuleli ngonyaka ngokombiko iGlobal TB Report ka-2022, ekhishwe nyakenye, okuyisibalo esikhulu kakhulu," kuchaza uDkt Du Preez.Uthe kunzima ukuhlonza iTB ezinganeni. Okunye okwenza ukuthi isibalo silokhu siphezulu ukuthi kuthathe isikhathi eside ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika, iqale ukulandela imigomo yeWHO. Wengeze ngokuthi ukwelashwa kweTB kuqalwa noma bungekho ubufakazi obubambekayo uma nje kusoleka ukuthi inayo. Wathi imigomo yakhishwa ngo-2015, kepha iNingizimu Afrika iqale nyakenye ukusebenzisa uhlelo.UDkt Enesto Jarmillo we-WHO, uthe uhlelo lokwelapha iTB kumele luhambisane nokuhlolwa kwesifo sikashukela, izifo ezidalwa wukubhema, iHIV nezinye izifo ezihamba phambili ngokubulala abantu, ukuze isiguli singathi sesiphothule ukwelashelwa esinye isifo.
KUSOLAKALA ukuthi isikweletu semali yokushonisa sibe yimbangela yokudutshulwa, kufe iphoyisa elisebenzela eNsuze, eNdwedwe ngoLwesibili ebusuku, libulawa wuzakwalo. Kuthiwa ubesehlulwa wukukhokha imali abelikweleta yona.Umthombo weSolezwe ongathandanga ukudalulwa uveze ukuthi umufi (47) ubewumashonisa, eboleke umsolwa (47) imali abesehluleka ukuyikhokha, kanti ngoLwesibili ebusuku umthelekele emsebenzini wamdubula, washaya wachitha, emshiya efile. "Baxabane bebanga ukuthi umufi ubefuna imali yakhe ebisinkulu, ayiboleka umsolwa. Bebesebenza ndawonye, kanti umsolwa ubengasebenzi ngosuku lwesigameko, wafika emsebenzini, wavulela ngenhlamvu kumufi, waphelela khona lapho,” kusho umthombo. Okhulumela amaphoyisa esifundazweni uColonel Robert Netshiunda uqinisekise ukuthi umufi obewusayitsheni, ubesemsebenzini njengenjwayelo ngenkathi kwenzeka isigameko. Uthe umphathi wesiteshi ubeqaphe isimo egcekeni njengenjwayelo ngenkathi kwenzeka isigameko, wezwa kuqhuma isibhamu, okuthe ephuthuma ngaphakathi, wazithela kumufi.Umsolwa kuvela ukuthi uvuke izolo waya emsebenzini. Kusolwa ukuthi ubezitshela ukuthi akabonwanga muntu ngesikhathi esebaleka emuva kokudubula uzakwabo. Libe selimshonela esefike emsebenzini ngoba kulapho ekhalelwe ngamasongo kaSigonyela. UKhomishana wamaPhoyisa esifundazweni uLt General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, uthe amaphoyisa kumele azwane ngaso sonke isikhathi, agcine ubudlelwano babo bubuhle futhi avikelane."Abaphathi kumele baqaphe isimo zikhathi zonke futhi basondelane nabasebenzi ukusiza ukusheshe babone uma kunokungaboni ngaso linye. Umsebenzi wobuphoyisa uyafukuzisa futhi amaphoyisa abaluleke kakhulu, ngakho kumele abhekelelwe njalo."Lesi sigameko esenzeke esiteshini samaphoyisa sibi futhi yize umsolwa ezothathelwa izinyathelo zomthetho ngaso, kumele kwenziwe imizamo yokuphenya ngembangela yokufa komuntu endaweni okufanele ngabe amaphoyisa aphephile kuyona,” kusho uMkhwanazi.UMkhwanazi ukhuthaze amaphoyisa ukusebenzisa izikhungo zangaphakathi eziteshini zamaphoyisa zokwelulekwa ukusiza ukuzigcina esesimweni esihle somqondo ukuze kugwemeke ukusebenzisa udlame ukuxazulula izinkinga.UNobhala Jikelele wenyunyana ebhekele amalungelo amaphoyisa namajele iPolice and Prisons Civil Rights Union (Popcru) uNksz Nthabeleng Molefe, uthe uzwelana kakhulu nomndeni wephoyisa elibulewe, wase ethembisa ukuthi bazobhunga nobuholi babo ukusiza ukugwema izigameko ezifuze lesi."Yize singakezwa ngembangela yalesi sigameko kodwa siyazi ukuthi amaphoyisa asebenza ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima nezingenza kube nesimo esinjena, yingakho sihlale siwaluleka ukuvuleleka ngezimo abhekana nazo ukuze zilungiswe ngendlela efanele. Siyasigxeka kakhulu isenzo esinje futhi sizwelana nomndeni wephoyisa elibulewe,” kusho uNksz Molefe.Ebuzwa ngezokuphepha emaphoyiseni, uthe kunzima ukuvimbela umsebenzi ukuza emsebenzini uma engasebenzi ngoba kungenzeka avike ngokuthi kunomsebenzi angawuqedanga, okumele awenze, wase ecebisa ukuthi kwandiswe amaphoyisa eziteshini ezishoda ngawo ukuze kuhlale kunabantu abanele ukumelana nokuqapha izimo ezahlukene ezindaweni zokusebenza.

UBONGE ithuba lokusebenzela abantu bakuleli uMnuz uZizi Kodwa esula esikhundleni sobungqongqoshe emuva kokusobozelwa woKlebe wavela enkantolo ngecala lenkohlakalo.UKodwa, obengungqongqoshe wezemiDlalo, ubuCiko namaSiko, udedelwe ngebheyili kaR30 000 benoMnuz Jehan Mackay aboshwe naye. Bebevele eNkantolo yamaCala eMali ePalm Ridge izolo.UMackay wayeyisikhulu senkampani, i-EOH, ngesikhathi okuthiwa kwenzeka ngaso inkohlakalo phakathi kwakhe noKodwa.UKodwa ufike enkantolo engaxwayile ehamba noMackay abehleli naye ebhokisini labamangalelwa. Ubonge umengameli nabantu bakuleli ngokumnika ithuba lokusebenzela uhulumeni.UMackay, ongummangalelwa wokuqala, usolwa ngokucubuza amagabade kuKodwa ngemali engaphezu kukaR1 million ekhonga amathenda.UMbuso uthi uMackay wayetetemukisa uKodwa, emlalisa ezindaweni ezibizayo eshunqisela izinyosi ukuze atape amakhekhe emalini kahulumeni.KWESOKUNXELE wuMnuz Jehan Mackay noMnuz Zizi kodwa ngesikhathi bevele eNkantolo yezeMali ePalm Ridge izolo Isithombe : SITHATHELWE KWIVIDEOUMbuso uthi uKodwa wakwenza lokhu ngesikhathi esakhulumela i-ANC. UKodwa noMackay baboshwe kusukela ebufakazini obethulwa kwikhomishini eyayiphenya inkohlakalo.Kwikhomishini kwavela ukuthi uKodwa wemukela imali kaMackay wathenga unyanyavu lwemoto. UKodwa wayivuma imali phambi kwekhomishini, wathi wayexakekile wacela umngani ukuthi amhawukele.UMbuso uthe uphenyo seluphothuliwe futhi abameli bazonikwa uhlu lofakazi ukuze abamangalelwa bengaxhumani nabo baphazamise uphenyo.UMbuso awukuphikisanga ukudedelwa ngebheyili kwabamangalelwa, wathi akukho okukhomba ukuthi bangase babalekele icala. Bathe abamangalelwa ababona abantu abayingozi emphakathini.Bayalelwe ukuthi banike umseshi izincwadi zabo zokuhambela amanye amazwe. Ummeli kaKodwa, uMnuz Zola Majavu, uthe ikhasimende lakhe liyaliphika icala futhi bayazibuza ukuthi umuntu okhulumela i-ANC uhlangana kanjani namathenda.Icala likaKodwa lihlehlele uJulayi 23 ukuze kunikwe abameli ithuba lokuxoxa kabanzi nabamangalelwa, bathathe imiyalelo yabo.UKodwa uboshwa nje ulandela obengusomlomo wePhalamende, uNkk Nosiviwe Mapisa-Nqakula, naye osenkingeni yecala lenkohlakalo. Umthetho we-ANC uthi bonke ababhekene namacala kufanele bashenxe ezikhundleni abajutshwe kuzona.
YIZE iKwaZulu-Natal iliqale kabi leli sonto njengoba kuvuke isiphepho esiphephule imizi nezimoto kwaze kwashona nabantu, kodwa isazi sezulu sithi kulindeleke ukuthi liphenye izulu kusukela namuhla kuze kube wuLwesine.Ngokusho kukaMnuz Sihle Dlamini oyisazi sezulu se-SA Weather Service, isiphepho esiphephule imizi nezimoto zabantu ngeke sibuye kuleli sonto.UDlamini uthe ngokocwaningo lwabo babona izulu lizoba lihle kusukela namhlanje kuze kube wuLwesine.Imvula bayilindele ngoLwesihlanu nakhona amathuba ayo awu-30% ezindaweni ezigudle ulwandle okubalwa iMargate, iTheku, iRichards Bay naseMbazwana.Uthe le mvula izoqhubeka kuze kube yiSonto lapho izobe isina eRichards Bay, River View naseMbazwana.Phambilini uSolwazi Tafadwanashe Mabhaudhi oyisazi sokuguquka kwesimo sezulu, eNyuvesi yaKwaZulu-Natal, wathi kufanele kwakhiwe izindlu ezimelana nesimo sezulu elibi njengoba siguquka ngendlela ecekela impahla kulimale nabantu.Wathi kuyisinyathelo esihle ukusungulwa kwesikhwama sokuguquka kwesimo sezulu esibizwa nge-Climate Fund."Isikhwama sokuguquka kwesimo sezulu akufanele nje sigxile ezinhlekeleleni zemvelo kuphela kodwa kufanele sisetshenziselwe ukwakha ingqalasizinda ezomelana nesimo sezulu esishintsha njalo. Kufanele seseke izinhlelo zokuphehla ugesi ngendlela engayilimazi imvelo,” kusho uMabhaudhi.Okwamanje bezingakacaci izinhlelo zesikhwama sokuguquka kwesimo sezulu.
Kutheleke KwaZulu-Natal amaphoyisa engeziwe ukuzoqapha isimo njengoba kusaqhubeka izinguyazana zamaqembu zokwakha uhulumeni wokubambisana.La maphoyisa ajutshwe nguKhomishana wamaphoyisa uGeneral Fannie Masemola, kanti azosebenzisana namasosha uma kunesidingo.UMasemola ujube amaphoyisa angu-300 ophiko oluqapha izibhelu emphakathini ukuzoqapha isimo. Leli yithimba lesithathu ukujutshwa eKZN.UMasemola waqala wajuba amaphoyisa angu-200 ekuqaleni kwenyanga edlule, waphinde wajuba amanye angu-300 ngesikhathi sokhetho njengoba esejube ithimba langu-300 manje.Ezingxenyeni ezehlukene eThekwini okubalwa Kwa-D KwaMashu, kubonakale amasosha abehlome ephelele abeqaphe isimo. E-Avoca nasemgwaqweni uMngeni eThekwini, amaphoyisa abevala kwasani, esesha izimoto, amatekisi kanjalo namaloli.Amanye amaphoyisa abekanise nasemigwaqweni engenela ezimbonini zaseMariannhill nasePinetown, lapho kwatatshwa khona inyama notshwala ngezikhathi zezibhelu ngo-2021, esesha izimoto. Ezinye izimoto zamaphoyisa bezishaye ujenga zilibhekise ngaseChatsworth.UMasemola uthe bajube la maphoyisa emuva kokuthola umbiko wethimba lezobunhloli. "Sengeze amaphoyisa emuva kombiko wezobunhloli wokuthi kukhona okuhlelwayo noma ngingeke ngisho ukuthi yini. Lo mbiko uveza ukuthi alukabikhona uzinzo, yingakho sithumele amaphoyisa ophiko oluqapha izibhelu,” kusho uMasemola.Uthe banolwazi ngazo zonke izinto ezihlelwayo eKZN, wathi yingakho befuna ukuzinqanda."Siyazi ukuthi abantu benzani nokuthi bahlelani yingakho siqinise ezokuphepha eKZN. Amaphoyisa azozinza eKZN kuze kube siyaqinisekisa ukuthi kuphephile,” kusho uMasemola.Uthe uzothumela amanye amaphoyisa uma kunesidingo."Ukhetho lube nokuthula kanjalo nozinzo. Abantu bavote ngokukhululeka futhi ngaphandle kokusatshiswa. Siyabonga emphakathini ngokuziphatha kahle ngalesi sikhathi,” kuqhuba uMasemola.Omunye usihlalo womkhandlu obhekele ukuphepha ezweni iNational Joint Operational and Intelligence Structure (NATJOINTS), uLieutenant General Tebello Mosikili, uthe amasosha ami ngomumo ukulekelela uma kunesidingo.Uthe anendima ayidlalayo amasosha njengoba eyingxenye yomkhandlu. Uveze ukuthi amaphoyisa awajutshiwe kuphela eKZN kodwa nakwezinye izifundazwe. "Sithola ulwazi lwezobunhloli bese silandela lowo mbiko ngoba asifuni ukuthi kusiphinde okwasenza phambilini, kwaqubuka udlame singalindele. Kulokhu lonke ulwazi esilutholayo siyaluhlelela ngendlela ngoba asifuni ukuzithola sibamba siyeka. Yingakho sijube amaphoyisa eKZN ukuze aqhubeke nokuqapha isimo.” Ukhomishana wamaphoyisa uLieutenant-General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, uxwayise osikhwili phambana nobhoko esifundazweni wathi babhiyoze bazibheke ngoba amaphoyisa azobe eqaphe isimo.Uthe amaphoyisa azolokhu esiqaphile isimo kuze kubunjwe uhulumeni.
AMAPHOYISA afuna uthuli abesilisa abane abasolwa ngokuvulela ngenhlamvu emndenini waKwaMagwaza eMalangeni, eMzinto, ngeSonto kwashona abathathu.Kulesi sigameko kuthiwa kulimale abanye ababili.Ngokusho kokhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, umndeni ohlaselwe ngowabesifazane bodwa abaneminyaka ephakathi kuka-11 no-61.Uthe abagilwa bahlaselwe behleli endlini ewurawondi sebelungiselela ukuyolala ngesikhathi abasolwa bevula ngesankahlu isicabha."Isicabha sivulwe oyedwa wabo obegqoke isigqoko esimfihla ubuso, kwathi omunye naye obezifihle ubuso ngesigqoko, wakhomba abesifazane abefuna badutshulwe bafe,” kuchaza uNetshiunda.Uqhube wathi kutholwe abesifazane abaneminyaka engu-28, 37 nonengu-61 benamanxeba ayinqwaba okudutshulwa."Bahlonzwe njengabashonele endaweni yesigameko. Abagilwa abasindile, oneminyaka engu-11 nonengu-60, bebedubuleke ezingalweni nasezithweni,” kulandisa uNetshiunda.Uthe abasolwa abakaziwa okwamanje nembangela yokubulala ima isazohlonzwa ngamaphoyisa.Uqhube wathi nokho kunezinsolo ezivezwa wuphenyo lwamaphoyisa zokuthi kungenzeka ukuthi ukuhlaselwa kwabagilwa kuyamene nokuthi oyedwa wabo ubesezinhlelweni zokudivosa."Ubelwela ukuthola ingxenye yempesheni yomyeni wakhe,” kusho uNetshiunda.Uphethe ngelithi amaphoyisa anxusa noma ngubani ongaba nolwazi olungawalekelela ophenyweni lwawo ukuthi athinte amaphoyisa aseduze noma ashayele inombolo yawo yamahhala ethi 08600 10111. Ikhansela lendawo, uMnuz Sithembiso Mthwane, lithe lizwile ngesigameko kodwa belingakayi ukuyohlanganisa amehlo nomndeni.Uthe isigameko siwushaqisile umphakathi ngoba yize ubugebengu bukhona endaweni kodwa obokuhlaselwa kwabantu emzini wabo bebungakaze benzeke."Sishaqekile nje futhi sizibuza imibuzo eminingi ngoba nalo mndeni ohlaselwe akukho okutheni esiwazela khona, ukuthi sekungenzeka isigameko sokuthi uhlaselelwe ekhaya bese ubulawa ngesihluku esingaka,” kusho uMthwane.Imizamo yokuthola umndeni ayiphumelelanga.
BAZOLIBUKA kuthelevishini iPhalamende abanye abaholi abebenezihlalo kodwa bangakwazi ukubuyela.Bekushunqa uthuli ezweni kuvotwa okhethweni olube yingqophamlando lapho bezidlana imilala. Inhlangano ebusayo izithole ilahlekelwa yizihlalo ezingu-71 ePhalamende yangakwazi ukubuyela emandleni ngengcaca.Kunamaqembu angene okokuqala ePhalamende ayekade elibuka kuthelevishini ekuqaleni manje sekuzobukwa bona. UMkhonto weSizwe (MK) ungene okukuqala ePhalamende ngezihlalo ezingu-58 nokube yingqophamlando kwezepolitiki yezwe.Kwabazongena okokuqala kukhona nePatriotic Alliance (PA), engene ngezihlalo ezingu-9. Kukhona i-ActionSA ekwazile ukungena ngezihlalo eziyisithupha nayo izobe iqala ukubonakala ePhalamende.KULINDELEKE ukuthi angene ePhalamende nethimba lakhe umholi we-ActionSA uMnuz Herman Mashaba Isithombe : FACEBOOK/HERMAN MASHABAKuvela negama le-Build One South Africa (BOSA) engene ngezihlalo ezimbili ePhalamende.Kuvela negama le-National Coloured Congress (NCC) nayo engene ngezihlalo ezimbili ePhalamende. Neqembu elisha iRise Mzansi likwazile ukungena ngezihlalo ezimbili ePhalamende.Kukhona ne-United Africans Transfomation (UAT) engenile ngesihlalo esisodwa. Kukhona amaqembu abeyingxenye yePhalamende eledlule kodwa angakwazanga ukuthola amavoti enele ukuze abuye.Kwabangabuyanga kuvela igama leNFP ehluleke yancama ukuthola amavoti enele, ekuqaleni ibinezihlalo ezimbili. Kuphinde kuvele iCOPE nayo ekhale ngaphansi kade inezihlalo ezimbili ePhalamende.Kuphume i-African Independent Congress (AIC) ebikade inezihlalo ezimbili njengoba ingasekho. Nakuba abanye bengenile abanye baphuma kwabasele kukhona abehlelwe yisibalo sezihlalo zakhula kwabanye.I-EFF ibuye ngezihlalo ezingu-39 isuka ezihlalweni ezingu-44 nokusho ukuthi ilahlekelwe yizihlalo ezinhlanu. IFreedom Front Plus (FF Plus) ibuye ngezihlalo eziyisithupha isuka ezihlaweni eziwu-10 nokusho ukuthi yehle ngezihlalo ezine.I-ACDP ingene ngezihlalo ezintathu isuka kwezine eyayinazo ekuqaleni. I-Good Party ibuye ngesihlalo esisodwa isuka kwezimbili eyayinazo ekuqaleni.I-DA ibuye ngezihlalo ezingu-87 nokusho ukwenyuka isuka kwezingu-84 eyayinazo ekuqaleni. I-IFP ingene ngezihlalo ezingu-17 nokukhomba ukwenyuka isuka kwezingu-14.I-UDM ibuye ngezihlalo ezintathu yakhula ikade inezimbili.
UMSUNGULI weMK olwa nokuxoshwa kwakhe kule nhlangano, uMnuz Jabulani Khumalo, uvunwa umthetho ukuba amele le nhlangano emhlanganweni wasePhalamende ozoqoka umengameli nosomlomo.Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi amaqembu awakwazi ukushintsha uhlu lwamagama awathumela enhlanganweni eyengamele ukhetho, i-Independent Electoral Commission (IEC).Igama likaKhumalo lilandela elomholi wale nhlangano okwanqunywa ukuthi akakulungele ukuba yilungu lePhalamende, uMnuz Jacob Zuma.UKhumalo waxoshwa kwiMK ngenyanga eyedlule, ngoMsombuluko bekulalelwe icala lapho khona ephonsela inselelo ukuxoshwa kwakhe.Ukuxoshwa kukaKhumalo kudale imibuzo yokuthi ngabe uzokwazi yini ukuqhubeka ayomela iMK emhlanganweni wasePhalamende.Okhulumela i-IEC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thabani Ngwira, uthe umthetho awuvumi ukuthi amaqembu enze izinguquko manje ohlwini lwamalungu azowamela."Bangakwazi kuphela ukushintsha uhlu emva komhlangano wokuqala wasePhalamende. Njengamanje amaqembu awakwazi ukushintsha.”UNgwira uthe noma benganqaba ukufungiswa labo abavela ohlwini, amaqembu angeke akwazi ukufaka abanye abantu.IMK inezihlalo ezingu-58 ePhalamende.UKhumalo akusiye yedwa ovela ohlwini lweMK lwasePhalamende osexoshiwe eqenjini.Ophezulu ohlwini lwayo lwasesiShayamthetho, uMnuz Nhlanhla Ngidi, wadilizwa ekubeni umdidiyeli weMK KwaZulu-Natal.Ngesikhathi edilizwa iqembu lathi ukuxoshwa kwakhe kungase kudale izinguquko ohlwini lwasesiShayamthetho.IMK inezihlalo ezingu-37 esiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal.Imizamo yokuthola uKhumalo nokhulumela iMK, uMnuz Nhlamulo Ndhlela, ayizange iphumelele njengoba izingcingo zabo bezikhala zingabanjwa.IMK isike yakusho ngaphambilini ukuthi uhlu lwayo lwasePhalamende lusazoshintsha.Ngeledlule uNobhala-Jikelele weMK, uMnuz Sihle Ngubane, wathi asikho isiqiniseko sokuthi bonke laba bantu abasohlwini bazokuya ePhalamende.Ekhuluma esikhungweni semiphumela, uNgubane wathi basengashintsha ngisho ukukleliswa kwamalungu avela ohlwini lweMK.Elinye iqembu eliveze ukuthi lisazokwenza izinguquko ohlwini lwayo yi-EFF.I-EFF yehlile okhethweni olwedlule, yathola izihlalo ezingu-39, isuka kwezingu-44.Umholi we-EFF, uMnuz Julius Malema, uthe angeke baye ePhalamende labo abangazange bakhombise ukuzimisela ngesikhathi kukhankaselwa ukhetho."Abakhohlwe labo abebelibele ukujuxuza ngesikhathi sikhankasela ukhetho. Abantu babelibele ukuhamba izindawo zobumnandi ngesikhathi sikhankasela ukhetho. Sizokwenza izinguquko ohlwini lwasePhalamende nolwaseziShayamthetho. Kukhona esizobatshela ukuthi bangayi ukuyofungiswa ePhalamende.”
ISIKHULU enkampanini yamaselula iVodacom, uNksz Pinky Vythilingam, esiwufakazi ecaleni lokufa kukaSenzo Meyiwa, sithi ukhona owayesebenzisa iselula kamufi esebulewe.UMeyiwa, owayengunozinti we-Orlando Pirates neBafana Bafana, wadutshulwa wabulawa ekubo kwentombi yakhe, uKelly Khumalo, eVosloorus, eGauteng, ngo-2014.Bahlanu abalisa abashushiswayo uMbuso okholwa wukuthi bathengwa bamkakisa okwenyamazane uMeyiwa bamjuqa. Icala lisesigabeni lapho uMbuso weneka khona ubufakazi ozimisele ukugojela ngabo abamangalelwa.UMshushisi woMbuso, u-Advocate Ronnie Sibanda, nguyena obeqhuba ufakazi ngemibuzo ngesikhathi kufikwa odabeni lweselula kaMeyiwa.UNksz Vythilingham uthe ubufakazi buveza ukuthi kunomuntu owenza ikhadi elisha leselula kaMeyiwa ngo-Okthoba 27 okuwusuku olulandela abulawa ngalo. Uthe kodwa akazi ukuthi wubani lowo muntu."Lokhu kwenziwa esitolo esiseBenmore Gardens, ikhadi elisha lase lifakwa kwenye iselula, iNokia 3330 Classic. Kwashaywa izingcingo ezingu-63 ezaba yimpumelelo kusebenza lelo khadi,’’ kusho uNksz Vythilingham.Uthe ukuze umuntu akwazi ukwenza lolu shintsho kudingeka aphathe umazisi bese eveza ubufakazi bokuthi ikhadi leselula elakhe. Uthe kuphinde kudingeke nephepha lobufakazi bekheli ahlala kulona lowo muntu.UNksz Vythilingham uphinde waveza indaba kaKelly athe waxhumana nommangalelwa wesihlanu, uMnuz Fisokuhle Ntuli, ngaphambi kokubulawa kukaMeyiwa. Uthe ucingo lokuqala lwaba ngo-Agasti 2, 2014.Uthe olwesibili lwaba ngo-Okthoba 15, 2014 nokwaba yizinsuku ngaphambi kokujuqwa kukaMeyiwa. Ngesikhathi uNksz Vythilingham efakaza, kuvele ukuthi unomkhuhlane othanda ukumxina.Uthe esaqhubeka nokufakaza kwacaca ukuthi uxineka kakhulu kwavunyelwana ngokuthi icala liguqe. Kulindeleke ukuthi icala libuyele namuhla enkantolo.
BAZOHLANGANA nemamba iphuza umhluzi abantu abasabisa ngodlame nezenzo zokuphulwa komthetho uma sekukhishwe imiphumela yokhetho.Lesi sixwayiso esishubile sikhishwe wuhlaka longqongqoshe beminyango ebhekele ezokuphepha kuleli, iNational Joint Operational and Intelligence Structure (Natjoints) esithangamini sabezindaba.INatjoints ithi yenelisekile ngokugcinwa kokuthula nokuphepha okubonakale ngokhetho, nakuba kukhona ababoshiwe.Labo ngqongqoshe baphendule imibuzo yezintatheli mayelana nenkulumo yowayengumengameli wezwe ne-ANC, uJacob Zuma.UZuma, ubulungu bakhe obumisiwe kwi-ANC futhi osengumholi weqembu uMkhonto weSizwe Party, uthe ayikho imiphumela yokhetho ezomenyezelwa yi-IEC (izolo) ingakabaphenduli izikhalazo zabo.Uthe kumele i-IEC iqale ibenelise ukuthi ikubhekile abebekade bekhala ngakho"Ayikho imiphumela ezomenyezelwa. Uma kwenzeka, kuyosho ukuthi siyachukuluzwa ngoba siyayazi into esikhuluma ngayo, asiqageli. Kungani bejaha ukubala? Ngiyathemba obhekele lokhu uyangizwa, ningayiqali inkinga uma ingekho,” kusho uZuma.UNgqongqoshe wezokuVikela noMakadebona bezeMpi, uNkk Thandi Modise, uthe amasosha afika emva kwendaba ngomtapo ngoJulayi 2021, nokuyinto eyabavula amehlo engasoze iphinde yenzeke.Ufungile wathi bami ngomumo bazofika ngesikhathi uma bedingeka."Akukho namunye ozobekezelelwa uma ephazamisa amalungelo ezinye izakhamizi. Nakuba abantu benelungelo lokukhuluma bezwakalisa izimvo zabo, kodwa lelo lungelo linomkhawulo,” uNksz Thandi Modise enxenxa abantu bathobele umthetho.Uthe bazongenelela uma leli lungelo lokukhuluma libeka engcupheni impilo yomuntu nempahla.UNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa, uMnuz Bheki Cele ushayelele isipikili, wathi akukhathaleki ukuthi uwubani kodwa uzojeza kanzima lowo ozoke aphule umthetho.Ukhumbuze abantu wathi kumanje bagqigqa inkantolo abammangalelwa abevile ku-60 abathweswe amacala okuvukela uMbuso nokuphehla izibhelu zangoJulayi 2021.UKhomishana wamaPhoyisa, uGeneral Fannie Masemola, uthe kuboshwe abantu abangu-90 ngesikhathi sokuvota, kwavulwa amacala angu-130.UNgqongqoshe eHhovisi likaMengameli, uNksz Khumbudzo Ntshavheni, uthe abaholi bezepolitii basayina umgomo wokuziphatha ngesikhathi sokhetho okumele awulandele. Uthe ukuphulwa kwawo kusho ukuphulwa komthetho okuhambisana nokubhekana nengalo yomthetho.
KUJUTSHWE ithimba elikhethekile emaphoyiseni aseGauteng ukuba aphenye futhi abophe abasolwa abayisithupha ababulale amantombazane amabili emijondolo yaseSoshanguve ngeSonto.Kuthiwa laba basolwa baqale ejoyintili iChanging Spot emijondolo yaseSoshanguve ngeSonto ebusuku adubula abantu abebekhona. Kufe ababili (owesilisa nowesifazane) kwalimala kabi abanye abane. Abasolwa basuke kule ndawo banikela komunye umjondolo okule ndawo. Kulo mjondolo bafike badubula babulala izelamani ezingamantombazane amabili uMpfumo (4) noTinyiko (7) ngaphambi kokuba bawushise ziphakathi izingane.Okhulumela amaphoyisa eGauteng uLt-Col Mavela Masondo uthi uphenyo lokuqala luveza ukuthi abasolwa bebefuna uyise wezingane emzini wakhe ngesikhathi kubulawa lawa mantombazane.
USIZI luzwa olunye emindenini ehlukene yasoThongathi ekhahlanyezwe yimvula eshiye kukhalwa kule ndawo.Uma ungena ezingxenyeni ezehlukene zakule ndawo ukhangwa yizihlahla eziwiswe umoya zivimbe imigwaqo, izindlu ezidilikile nezimoto ezipheshulwe umoya.Abantu ubafica behlezi ngaphandle kwezindlu bengamaqoqo kubonakala nje ukuthi badidekile futhi basakhuluma ngalo mshophi obehlele.Emndenini wakwaMngadi usizi lumi ngenhla njengoba kubhidlike umuzi wabo waphela maqede kwalimala izingane zamantombazane ezimbili ezingamawele.UNkk Berlina Mngadi ubebalisa ngabazukulu bakhe ebebenonyaka nezinyanga eziyisithupha bezelwe. "Hheyi futhi Nkosi yami abazukulu bami bebancane kangaka,'' kubalisa yena.UNKK Berlina Mngadi echaza ukuthi alimale kanjani amawele angabazukulu bakheUveze ukuthi isiqandisi siwele phezu kwabazukulu belele. Elilodwa iwele lishonele khona lapho elinye laphuthunyiswa esibhedlela isimo sisibi kakhulu. "Kwayena lo omunye ubesaphila kodwa bese ebanda. Kodwa konke sikuyekela kuNkulunkulu owazi konke,'' usho kanjena.UMnuz Zakhele Chili uveze ukuthi nasemndenini wakhe usizi luzwa olunye njengoba kudilike umuzi wakhe kwase kulimala kabi indodana yakhe ayiphuthumise esibhedlela ilimele kabi ekhanda."Kubi ngibalisa ngosizi lokuwa komuzi wami. Kodwa nantu olunye usizi lokulimala kabi kwendodana yami,'' usho kanje.UNKK Nkosingiphile Khanyile eveza umonakalo odalwe yimvula emzini wakhe : Isithombe : SIBONELO NGCOBOUNkk Nkosingiphile Khanyile uthe kumnyama amehlo kuyena akazi nokuthi uzothathani ahlanganise nani uma izinto zimapeketwane ngalolu hlobo.Uveze ukuthi imvula ibhidlize umuzi wakhe oyisitezi ayeewuthenge ngo-R730 000 ngo-2007.Emndenini wakwaMthembu nakhona bakhala ezimathonsi njengoba bebalisa ngokuthi imvula iwubhidlize yawuqeda umuzi wabo ebebengakaqedi ukuwakha.UNkk Noncedo Hlamaphi uthe ukudilika komuzi kubashiye bedidekile njengoba kube manzi nezincwadi zendodakazi efunda u-matric.Ukhale ngokuthi ukonakala kwempahla yasendlini kunezele phezu kosizi lokudilika komuzi.UNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Nomusa Dube Ncube, uthe senyukile isibalo sabantu abadlule emhlabeni ngenxa yemvula kule ndawo.Uthe abayisikhombisa abakhona oThongathi abanye abaseNquthu, eShowe naKwaHlabisa.Uthe kunabantu abangu-55 abalimalile base bephuthunyiswa ezibhedlela wathi kukhona abazobalekelela ngakho labo abangazi ukuthi bazohlala kuphi ngemva kwemvula.Le mvula kuvela ukuthi ikhahlameze lezi zifunda, iLembe, uMzinyathi, King Cetshwayo, Amajuba naseMkhanyakude.Izinhlangano ezigxile ekulekeleleni umphakathi iRed Cross, Gift of the Givers nazo zimatasa ezindaweni ezikhahlamezekile.
NJENGOBA ziqhubeka izinguyazana zamaqembu ezepolitiki ngohulumeni wokubambisana ngenxa yokuthi alikho iqembu elidle umhlanganiso okhethweni, elingakwazi ukumisa uhulumeni ngalodwana, iKhabhinethi kaMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa izoqhubeka nokuphatha izwe kuze kufungiswe umengameli omusha.Le khabhinethi igunyazwe yisigaba sika-94 soMthethosisekelo esibalula ukuthi umengameli, iphini lakhe, ongqongqoshe namaphini ongqongqoshe baqhubeke nomsebenzi wabo kuze kube kufungiswa umengameli omusha ozobe esekhetha amafolosi akhe.Okhulumela iPhalamende uMnuz Moloto Mothapo, ukuqinisekisile lokhu wathi seziqalile izinhlelo zokuthi kulungiselelwe uhulumeni wehlandla lesikhombisa ozongena ezintanjeni selokhu kwatholakala intando yeningi.Uthe emazweni abusa ngentando yeningi iPhalamende lidlala indima ebalulekile yokushaya imithetho ezokwenza uhulumeni aphendule. Uveze ukuthi iPhalamende libunjwa amalungu angekho ngaphansi kuka-350 kuya kwawu-400.Kunezihlalo ezingu-400 ePhalamende, ezingu-200 ezomkhandlu weziFundazwe kuthi ezingu-200 ezeNational Assembly."Uma sekumenyezelwe imiphumela yokhetho ezweni, kumele kuhlale iPhalamende ezinsukwini ezingu-14. Uhlu lwabaya ePhalamende lunikwa inhloko yamaJaji kuleli okuyiyona ebiza umhlangano wokuqala wokuhlalisa iPhalamende. Kulo mhlangano kufungiswa wonke amalungu amasha, bese kuphakanyiswa igama lomuntu ozoba ngusomlomo wePhalamende.”Uthe kuzobe sekuvotelwa igama likasomlomo, uma kungukuthi baningi abantu okuphakanyiswe amagama abo. "Uma esekhethiwe usomlomo, uzobe esengamela uhlelo lokukhethwa kwephini likasomlomo. Uhlelo lokukhetha umengameli lwenzeka ekugcineni emva kokuba sekukhethwe iphini likasomlomo. Lenganyelwa inhloko yamajaji. Kuphakanyiswa igama lozoba ngumengameli, uma emaningi amagama aphakanyisiwe, kuvotwe ngokuyimfihlo bese okhethiwe kwesikamengameli esula ekubeni yilungu lePhalamende. UMothapo uqhube wachaza ukuthi ezinsukwini ezinhlanu ekhethiwe umengameli kumele kubanjwe umcimbi wokumfungisa."Lo mcimbi wenganyelwa yinhloko yamajaji. Umengameli okhona nethimba lakhe yilapho ke bezobe sebededa khona inkundla uma sekufungiswe umengameli omusha.”Uthe lokhu kwenziwa ukuze ezindlini zombuso kungahlali bungekho ubuholi obuphethe izwe. Ubalule ukuthi uma umengameli esengene ehhovisi, ube esekhetha iKhabhinethi yakhe."Esebenzisana noSomlomo wePhalamende kanjalo noSihlalo weNdlu yoMkhandlu weziFundazwe, kube sekunqunywa usuku lokuvulwa kwePhalamende. Ukuvulwa kwePhalamende kuhambisana nenkulumo ebhekiswe esizweni.” Uthe kube sekucijwa amalungu amasha ngemigomo yePhalamende nangezinto azobe ezenza kule minyaka emihlanu.Uveze nokuthi maduzane bazokhipha uhlelo olugcwele oluzolandelwa ekubunjweni koMkhandlu weziFundazwe.

Siyasigxeka lesi senzo esiwukungahloniphi indawo yabantu abalele.”
UNUNUSELWA ngesikhundla sikandunkulu wesifundazwe uSihlalo we-IFP KwaZulu-Natal uMnuz Thami Ntuli, okuthiwa ucingo lwakhe lukhala umlibe eshelwa ngamaqembu.UNtuli obefakwe kwesombango kandunankulu kuthiwa ufunwa yiMK, yi-ANC ne-DA abafuna ukungena naye embusweni wesifundazwe. Endaweni yesine kuhleli i-DA ngezihlalo ezingu-11.USIHLAO we-IFP KwaZulu-Natal uMnuz Thami Ntuli, uthi uzobeka indlebe ezwe ukuthi iqembu lithini ngezingxoxo eziqhubekayo zokubunjwa kukahulumeni wesifundazwe Isithombe : FACEBOOK/THAMI NTULII-EFF inezihlalo ezimbili bese kuvala i-NFP ngesihlalo esisodwa kodwa esingenza umehluko omkhulu. Isolezwe lithole ngezingede zalo ukuthi amaqembu ashela uNtuli kwesikandunankulu.Ebuzwa uNtuli ngalokhu uthe kuyiqiniso ukuthi amaqembu ayamthinta kodwa akukho azokwenzeka ngoba izingxoxo ziphethwe yiqembu kuzwelonke."Ucingo lukhala manje namanje kube kungena olunye bayangithinta kodwa ngibedlulisela kubaholi kuzwelonke lapho okuphethwe khona izingxoxo. Mina ngiqhubeka nomsebenzi lapha eKing Cetshwayo,’’ kusho uNtuli.UNtuli wale waphetha ukudalula amagama amaqembu amthintile wathi ngeke akwazi okwamanje. Uthe akazi ukuthi izingxoxo zizophetha kanjani kodwa iqembu lizomemezela uma kukhona izivumelwano.Okokuqala okusabalele wukuthi i-ANC ingase ingene iphathe ne-DA ne-IFP bese befaka neNFP. Uma wonke la maqembu ehlangene enza izihlalo ezingu-41 nokungenza kube lula ukuthatha umbuso wesifundazwe.Izihlalo eSishayamthetho zingu-80, okusho ukuthi ophethe izintambo kufanele abe nezihlalo ezingu-41 kuya phezulu. Uma ehlangana amaqembu abalwe ngenhla kuyobe kusho ukuthi iMK ne-EFF bazoba amaqembu aphikisayo.Uma i-IFP ikhetha ukungena neMK kuyobe kusho ukuthi izihlalo zabo uma zihlangene zingu-52 nokuyokwenza badlule ngehubo beyothatha izintambo zombuso kuhulumeni wesifundazwe.Lokhu kuyobe kusho ukuthi i-ANC, DA, EFF neNFP bazoba amaqembu aphikisayo esifundazweni. I-ANC ebiphethe isifundazwe ilahlelwe yizihlalo ezingu-30 eyayizithole okhethweni lwango-2019, lapho yayithola u54%.

BAPHAKIWE abakhongi bamaqembu ezepolitiki abayowamela ezingxoxweni zokubumba uhulumeni wokubambisana ngoba kalikho iqembu elinqobe ngengcaca.Izwe libuya okhethweni lulazwelonke olunzima lapho bezidlana imilalala kubangwa amavoti. UPHIKISA eyokuchithwa kobuholi be-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uNobhala Jikelele wale nhlangano, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, ngokubhacaza okhethweni lukazwelonke nolwezifundazwe njengoba le nhlangano yehlelwe wukwesekwa italajwa yiqembu eliholwa ngowayengumengameli wezwe uJacob Zuma, Umkhonto weSizwe.UMbalula uthe nakuba kukhona abakhuluma eyokuthi kumele buhlakazwe lobu buholi kodwa ngeke kwenzeke lokhu.Uthe akumele kugxekwe ubuholi bakulesi sifundazwe kuphela ngale miphumela.Kumele sonke isigungu esiphezulu se-ANC sizigxeke ngemiphumela yokhetho lwaseKZN. Besazi ukuthi uZuma uzothola ukwesekwa eKZN kodwa hhayi ngale ndlela," kusho uMbalula ekhuluma nabezindaba, izolo.Uthe yingakho bathumela inqwaba yabaholi abebegiya bephindelela kulesi sifundazwe ngoba bebefuna ukuwina amavoti."Besibheke kakhulu i-IFP KwaZulu-Natal. Asigxeki muntu ngale miphumela ngoba siwenzile amaphutha eKZN.” Uthe kuyiwe okhethweni abantu bengenawo amanzi emalokishini amakhulu okubalwa uMlaza."Senze amaphutha amaningi kuhulumeni. Siye okhethweni kukhalwa eKZN ngendaba yamanzi. Bekunenkinga kagesi. Ngakho siye okhethweni ziningi izinkinga umphakathi obukhala ngazo,” kusho uMbalula.Akuqali ukuthi kukhulunywe indaba yokuthi kuhlakazwe ubuholi be-ANC eKZN.Lobu buholi buholwa nguMnuz Sboniso Duma, noNobhala uMnuz Bheki Mtolo.UMbalula uthe lesi sifundazwe singesinye esinesibalo esikhulu sabantu abavotayo.Uthe bakhethe ukuvotela uZuma kulolu khetho, wathi abazokwenza ukuxoxa ukuthi isimo basilungisa kanjani."Sizobheka ukuthi sisilungisa kanjani isimo saseKZN, ngoba siyayivuma induku sibhaxabuliwe. Ukube iMK ayifikanga ngabe senze kahle kakhulu eKZN.”
NKOSIKHONA CELEOWESILISA waseJozini uthi kuduma ikhanda, akazi nokuthi kumele enze njani ngemuva kokuthola izindaba zokuthi ingoduso yakhe ayilobole ekuqaleni konyaka, ibizolotsholwa omunye umbhemu emasontweni ambalwa edlule.UMnuz Simon Makhathini (46) uthi okumdidayo ukuthi izinto bezihamba kahle phakathi kwakhe nengoduso yakhe, bayafonelana nsuku zonke njengoba yena esebenza eMpumalanga. Usola ingoduso yakhe, uNksz Fikile Mjwara (34) ngokuba yinyoka."Ngenhlanhla kunomakhelwane engimaziyo eMpangeni, ongihlebelile ukuthi ingoduso yami ibizolotsholwa. Angikholwanga kodwa ngethukile uma sengiziseshela ngithola ukuthi ngempela ngiyisilima,” kusho uMakhathini othi wazishaya zonke izinkomo ezazibizwe ekhweni lakhe.Uthi yena ubesaqhubeka nokubeka imali yomgcagco nawo abehlele ukuthi ube maduze nje kodwa manje kuduma ikhanda.Uthe baneminyaka eyisithupha bethandana nalo wesifazane." Uma ngibuza ingoduso yami ngalo mhlola, iphike yalala ngomhlane kodwa kuthe uma isibona ukuthi ngiyazi ngempela, yathi lesi yisinqumo esithathwe abazali bayo, uma ngifuna izincazelo angithinte bona,” kusho uMakhathini."Ngimbuzile ukuthi emdala kangaka angavumela kanjani abazali bakhe bamfake entweni angahambisani nayo, uma ethi akahambisani nayo. Uhlulekile ukungiphendula." UMakhathini uthe uma ebuza mayelana nowesilisa obezomlobola, ingoduso yakhe nakhona ivele yathi akabuze kuyise nonina. Uthi umshayele ucingo umkhwe wakhe embuza ngale mbedumehlwane, wavele wamphendula ngokuthi indodakazi yakhe seyithole indoda ekholwayo yena bazombuyisela izinkomo zakhe.ISolezwe Ngempelasonto lixhumanile nengoduso yavuma ukuthi iyamazi uMakhathini. Yathi ayithandi ukuphendula imibuzo eminingi yase inikeza intatheli izinombolo zikayise.Ethintwa uyise uthe izindaba zakwakhe azifuni abantu bakwaCele. Wathi futhi azifuni Isolezwe wase egcizelela nokuthi indodakazi yakhe inelungelo lokuthi ilandele inhliziyo yayo. Uthe akathandi ukukhuluma kade ngalolu daba ngoba luthinta imindeni eminingi.ISolezwe Ngempelasonto lizamile ukuthola imininingwane yowesilisa okuthiwa ulobole okwesibili kodwa ligcine lingazitholanga.
NKOSIKHONA CELEWENZE isibophezelo sokuthi bazophathwa kahle abazalwane abasha abajoyina ibandla aliholayo, uMbhishobhi Phumlani Dlamini, Isibusiso Ibandla leNkosi Baptist Church in Zion of Southern Africa.Lesi sibophezelo uDlamini usenze kwindumezulu yenkonzo yokwamukelwa kwamalungu amasha. Inkonzo ibisehholo lomphakathi eMaromeni, eNewcatsle.Leli bandla belikade lijoyinwa nguMbhishobhi VJ Shongwe namanye amalungu afike nawo. Lena bekuyinkonzo enkulu ebiyenzelwe ukuba bamukelwe kahle futhi nabo bazizwe bamukelekile.Ekhuluma ebhekise kubona uDlamini uthe : "Siyabonga kakhulu ngokuthi nibone kungcono ukuba leli kube yilona bandla enilijoyinayo. Akusikhona ukuthi singcono kodwa kuyacaca ukuthi niholwe umoya kaNkulunkulu uqobo. Okwethu nje ukuqinisekisa ukuthi asenzi ukuba nizisole ngokujoyina leli bandla.''UDlamini uthe kumhlabe umxhwele ukubona ibandla aliholayo lijoyinwa ngamalungu amasha eholwa ngumholi osenokhakhayi oluqinile njengoMbhishobhi Shongwe.Uthe kulokoza inhlansi yethemba ngokukhula kwaleli bandla njengoba ethi bafuna ukulibona liba namalungu amaningi futhi lisabalala nasezweni lonke.Konke lokhu uthe kungaba lula ukuba kwenzeke inqobo nje uma kwanda ukusebenzisana nokubambisana okuhle phakathi kobuholi bebandla.UMbhishobhi Shongwe uthe kuningi okuhle okudale ukuthi abone kungcono ukuba ajoyine Isibusiso Ibandla LeNkosi.Uncome ubuholi bebandla wathi bubonakala buyazi kahle into obuyenzayo nobuphokophelele kuyona. Wathi yingakho ke nje engazange ananaze ukuthi naye abe yingxenye yalo.Kule nkonzo bekukade kukhona noMfu Thulani Manana uqweqwe lomculi waseZayoni osenamava nosezakhele udumo.Le nkonzo ibihanjelwe ngabazalwane baKwaNongoma, Swatini, oPhongolo naseGoli. Bekukhona nebandla iTwelve Apostolic Church ngaphansi kukaMbhishobhikazi Zungu.
IQEMBU eliholwa ngowayengumengameli uJacob Zuma, uMkhonto weSizwe Party, lidube umcimbi wokukhishwa kwemiphumela yokhetho emuva kokuthi lehlulekile ukunqanda ukukhishwa kwale miphumela. Abamele leli qembu bebengabonwa eMidrand, eGauteng nase-ICC eThekwini lapho bekukhishwa khona imiphumela yokhetho lwalo nyaka, abebefuna ukuthi kumiswe ukukhishwa kwayo kuze kulungiswe izikhalo ebezikhona.I-MK namanye amaqembu, i-ACC, ACP, ACT, ACDP, SUN, COPE, UDM, XILUVA, AADP, PA, CIASA, PMC, AHC, AMC, ARA, UAT, AM4C, APC, AL-JAMAH, SARA, UIM, SARKO, ATM ne-OHM, athumelele le khomishini incwadi yabameli ebiyalela ukuthi lo mcimbi obungeSonto ebusuku esikhungweni samavoti eMidrand, ungaqhubeki kuze kulungiswe izikhalazo.Encwadini yabameli iBoruchowitz ethunyelelwe ikhomishini, iveze ukuthi lezi zinkinga zingaba nomthelela emiphumeleni yokhetho.Ithe lezi zinkinga ziphuce ilungelo lalawa maqembu okhetho olukhululekile. "Yingakho sithi akumiswe ukudedelwa kwemiphumela yokhetho kuze kuphothulwe zonke izikhalazo zamaqembu. Uma kungukuthi ikhomishini ayiphenduli, esibamele bazoqhubeka nezinhlelo zomthetho,” kusho le ncwadi. Ekhuluma neSolezwe ngeSonto ebusuku, okhulumela i-MK, uMnuz Nhlamulo Ndhlela, uthe bebengeke bakwazi ukuyoba yingxenye yento engekho emthethweni. "Bekuwumhlangano ongekho emthethweni. Ziningi izikhalo esifakiwe ngalolu khetho kodwa i-IEC izositshela ngomzuzu wokugcina ukuthi zichithiwe. Sizobheka ukuthi yiziphi izinyathelo zomthetho esizozithatha ngalokhu.”Ekhuluma nabezindaba ngoMgqibelo ebusuku, uZuma uthe akumele imenyezelwe le miphumela yokhetho ngenxa yezikhalazo zamaqembu.Uthe kumele zilungiswe zonke lezi zikhalazo, wathi ngeke kufe muntu uma ingakhishwa."Akekho ozofa uma le miphumela ingamenyezelwa njengoba bekuhleliwe. Abangacasuli abantu, yingakho sithi akubhekisiswe zonke izikhalazo ngaphambi kokukhishwa kwemiphumela,” kusho uZuma.Usihlalo wekhomishini uMnuz Mosotho Moepya, uthe lolu khetho belunzima kakhulu. Uthe baningi abebencintisana kulona, wathi bagxekwe nxa zonke ngezinkinga ebezikhona."Sime kunzima ukuze siqhubeke nomsebenzi wesizwe wokhetho. Nanoma yikuphi emhlabeni uma ukhetho seluphothulwa, isimo siyashuba. Siyabonga kulabo abebesikhulekela, besithumelele imiyalezo yokuthi siqine nakuba besigxekwa,” kusho uMoepya. Uthe bebethole izikhalazo ezingu-579 zalabo abebekhalaza ngezinto eziningi ezithinta ukhetho. Uke wakuveza ukuthi umthetho ubalula ukuthi imiphumela yokhetho kumele idedelwe ezinsukwini eziyisikhombisa emva kokubanjwa kokhetho.Uveze ukuthi imiphumela ezokhishwa izoba semthethweni uma isifakwe ngaphansi komqulu kahulumeni, iGovernment Gazette. Ekhuluma emcimbini wokumemezela imiphumela umengameli uCyril Ramaphosa unxuse ukuthi kuhlonishwe isinqumo sabavoti abanqume ukuthi kungabikhona iqembu elidla umhlanganiso kuzwelonke. Uthe imiphumela yokhetho iveza imibono yabantu."Abantu bakuleli balindele ukuthi abaholi bamaqembu basebenzisane. Bafuna ukuthi kubekwe eceleni ukungaboni ngaso linye, kodwa kusetshenzelwe isizwe. Bafuna ukuthi kuphuculwe izwe, yilokho okuvezwe abantu bakuleli.” Uthe kumele kulungiswe izinkinga ngokuthula, kulandelwe umthetho wezwe."Kuyohlale kukhona ukungaboni ngaso linye, kanjalo nezinkinga ziyohlale zikhona kodwa abantu bafuna sisebenzisane. Iqembu ngalinye lijutshwe ngabantu ukuthi lenze lokho ebelikuthembisile.” Uthe amaqembu uma eseya ePhalamende kumele azi ukuthi izihlalo akuwona ezawo.Ubonge abantu bakuleli ngokuqinisa intando yeningi."Kumele sibeke abantu bakuleli phambili. Yisikhathi lapho sithandaza khona ukuthi uNkulunkulu asivikele.”Imiphumela yokhetho iveze ukuthi i-ANC ithole izihlalo ezingu-159 ePhalamende.Amanye amaqembu athole kanje:DA-87, MK-58, EFF-39, IFP-17, PA-9, Freedom Front Plus-6, ActionSA-6, ACDP-3, UDM-3, ATM-2, Al Jama-2, Bosa-2, NCC-2, Rise Mzansi-2, Good-1, PAC-1, UAT-1.Kulolu khetho sehlile isibalo sabantu abaphumile bayovota njengoba bebengu-58.61%. Angu-16 million amavoti angenile kanti angu-212 518 acekeleke phansi.Ngo-2019, bangu-66.99% abantu abaphuma bayovota kanti amavoti acekeleke phansi ayengu-235 472. Bangu-17 million abantu abavota ngo-2019.
UKHALE ngesihluku okubulawe ngaso indodana yakhe edutshulwe yashona nezihlobo zayo ezimbili ngesikhathi besendleleni bebuya ukuyovota eSihlabeni, eMuden.UMnuz Mdumiseni Mzila, onguyise kamufi, uMnuz Menzi Mzila, usola ukuthi siwubugebengu isenzo sokubulawa kwendodana yakhe.UMzila uthe ukusocongwa kwendodana yakhe entathakusa ngoLwesine akuhlangene nhlobo nokuvota."Bese bebuya ukuyovota, beziyela ekhaya badlula komunye umuzi bethi bayothenga i-artime kanti bazodutshulwa. Kuyakhombisa ukuthi abantu ababadubulile bebebalalele unyendle,” kusho uMzila ngosizi.Lo wesilisa uthe abanye ababulewe kulesi sigameko wumshana wakhe uMnuz Foni Dladla noMnuz Fundo Mdletshe ongumzukulu wakhe.Ukubulawa kwabafi uthe kubashiye bedumele bewumndeni, wakhala nangendlela eyisihluku abasocongwe ngayo.Kuthiwa ababulewe bekungabesilisa abathathu behamba ngemoto namantombazane amathathu.Enye yalawa mantombazane kuthiwa ilimalile ngesikhathi behlaselwa, amabili aphuma engenamyocu.Amaphoyisa athe uphenyo lwawo luveza ukuthi imoto obekuhanjwa ngayo yayikade ibikwe njengeyebiwe eGoli."Ayikho into esike sayizwa njengabazali babo ukuthi bayenzile. Besingakwazi ukuthi imoto abebehamba ngayo yebiwe, siqale ukukuzwa ngamaphoyisa lokho. Sifuna uhulumeni aqinise umthetho, amaphoyisa abathungathe ababophe ababulali,” kusho uMzila.Uchaze ababulewe wathi ngokwazi kwakhe bebeyizingane eziziphethe kahle, bebengakaze bathole izikhalazo ngabo ezivela emphakathini.UMzila uthe ababulewe bebengasebenzi kodwa uzobakhumbula njalo uma ebona izingane ezilingana nabo.Okhulumela amaphoyisa esifundazweni, uColonel Robert Netshiunda uthe ababulewe baneminyaka engu-22, 24 nengu-25.
