INKANTOLO yeMantshi yaseThekwini ilihlehlisele uJulayi 12 icala lokudlwengula elithweswe isethenjwa soNyazilwezulu.UXolani "Maliyavuza” Zungu ubevele kule nkantolo ngoLwesine njengoba engaphandle ngebheyili ecaleni lokudlwengula athweswe lona.Usolwa ngokudlwengula owesifazane ongelinye lamalungu ebandla lamaNazaretha.Ummeli kaZungu, uMnuz Ayanda Khanyile we-Ayanda Khanyile Attorneys, uthe bona sebemi ngomumo ngaleli cala kodwa babanjezelwe wuMbuso ngenxa yobufakazi obungenele okudingeka buzokwethulwa enkantolo."Esikutholile ukuthi owesifazane okuthiwa wadlwengulwa wuZungu akakaxoxi nomphenyi wecala. Ngelanga obekuhlelwe ukuthi bayokhuluma ngalo wafike wakhala wangakhuluma. Okunye wukuthi kunemiyalezo abeyithumelela uZungu okungakaqinisekiswa ukuthi iphuma kuyena ngempela yini. Thina sesimnikile yona umphenyi wecala, besilindele ukuthi sizofika enkantolo eseyidlulisele kuMshushisi kodwa sathola ukuthi akukenzeki lokho. Ngeke ngikwazi ukudalula ukuthi le miyalezo ithini ngoba lokho kungalimaza icala,” kusho ummeli.Kuthintwa uZungu, uthe ngeke akwazi ukuphawula lutho ngecala ngoba lisesenkantolo.Elinye ilungu lomndeni kaZungu ebelisenkantolo nelingathandanga ukudalulwa, lithe bona banolwazi lokuthi leli cala alikho kodwa kukhona abalibhebhezelayo ngoba belwa noZungu."Inkinga ukuthi uMaliyavuza usondelene kakhulu noNyazilwezulu. Kukhona abanenkinga yokuthi uyalivikela kwezinye izinto. Owesifazane lo okuthiwa umdlwengulile, yintombi yakhe akade athandana nayo futhi bebehlala bevakashelana. Inkinga idalwe yile thenda ka-R18 million eyakhishwa wuMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa yokwakha amadokodo eBuhleni. Kukhona izethenjwa ezilwa nawo wonke umuntu osondele noNyazi ngoba zifuna iwele ezandleni zazo. Zisebenzisana nezikhulu zepolitiki ezicasulwe wukuthi uNyazilwezulu lukumisile ukwakhiwa kwamadokodo obekuzozihlomulisa ngokudla le mali,” kusho umthombo.Kuthintwa uZungu ngendaba yethenda ka-R18 million yokwakha amadokodo eBuhleni, uthe yena akahlomuli lutho kumathenda kahulumeni futhi namabhizinisi awenzayo awahlangene namathenda.
INGONYAMA yaMabandla wonke uMisuzulu kaZwelithini, iyalele zonke izinduna emahostela ukuthi zibike uma kunemizamo yokudala uthuthuva emphakathini, lwenziwa abangayamukeli imiphumela yokhetho.Isilo siyishayele ihlombe inhlangano eyengamele ukhetho i-Independent Electoral Commission (IEC), ngokuqinisekisa nokuhlela ukhetho olukhululekile futhi olunemiphumela eyiqiniso."Isilo sincoma wonke amaqembu ezepolitiki ngendlela aziphathe ngayo enokuthula ngesikhathi kunkankaswa nangosuku lokuvota,” kusho uNdunankulu kaZulu, uMfundisi Thulasizwe Buthelezi esitatimendeni.Isilo sinxuse abezomthetho ukuthi babhekane nabazama ukudala uthuthuva ngemuva kokhetho.Sithe siyathemba ukuthi bonke abaholi bamaqembu bazozibophezela ekuhlonipheni imiphumela yokhetho futhi babambe iqhaza ekugqugquzeleni ukuthula nozinzo.Imiphumela imenyezelwe eMidrand, ngeSonto ebusuku naphezu kwezikhalo zamaqembu.I-MK namanye amaqembu angu-26 esewonke athumele i-IEC incwadi yabameli ebiyalela ukuthi ungaqhubeki umcimbi wokumenyezelwa kwemiphumela kuze kulungiswe izikhalazo.
IHHOVISI likaMgcinimafa selichithe ukuthi izinkinga ezibhekane neKhomishini yezoKhetho kuleli, ngesikhathi kuvotwa zidalwe wukungaxhaswa ngokwanele ngemali.Leli hhovisi lithi ikhomishini ibixhaswe ngemali eyenele ukuze ibambe ukhetho nonyaka lukazwelonke nolwezifundazwe.Lokhu likusho kulandela izikhalazo ngokungahambi kahle kwezinto okhethweni ebezivela ezinhlakeni ezehlukene.Kukhalwe ngokuthi ikhomishini ibingaluhlelelanga ngendlela ukhetho ngoba imishini yokubheka abazovota ibingasebenzi okwenze kwaba nolayini abade ezikhungweni zokuvota. Kwezinye izindawo kukhalwe ngokujikiswa kwabavoti.Isitatimende esikhishwe yihhovisi likaMgcinimafa siveze, ukuthi ngesikhathi lilungiselela isabelomali sezwe, laxhumana nekhomishini mayelana nezidingo zokhetho."Saxhumana nekhomishini yavuma ukuthi isabelomali esizoyabela yona, sizokwazi ukuhlangabezana nezidingo. Savumelana nekhomishini ukuthi ngeke sibe khona isidingo sokuthi yengezelwe imali ngoba yathi bekukhona uR1.5 billion, eyayinawo emgodleni.”Isitatimende sithe onyakeni wezimali u-2024/2025 ikhomishini yahlinzekwa ngoR2.232 billion. Siveze ukuthi uR322 million wale mali wanikwa ikhomishini ngo-Ephreli kulo nyaka."NgoMeyi ikhomishini inikwe uR1 billion. Kunemali enguR350 million okwakungeyokuhlinzeka ngezokuphepha ngesikhathi sokhetho.” Abaholi bamaqembu ahlukene bakhalile ngezinkinga ezikhungathe ikhomishini ngalesi sikhathi.UMnuz Granville Abrahams, imenenja ebhekele ukusebenza kwekhomishini, utshele abezindaba ukuthi imali abayabelwa yona yenza izinto ezifanele. Uthe baqasha inqwaba yabasebenzi abebesiza ngezinto zokhetho.Uveze ukuthi kwagaywa namaphepha okuvota acela ku-90 million ngoba kulolu khetho bekukhona iphepha lesithathu lokuvota elinabangenele ukhetho ngokuzimela."Emalini esabelwe yona siyisebenzise ezinhlelweni zokhetho. Siqashe inqwaba yabasebenzi ngalesi sikhathi sagaya nenqwaba yamaphepha okuvota ukuze angashodi uma sekuvotwa,” kusho u-Abrahams.Akazange adalule ukuthi imali ababelwa yona ibiyanele noma ibingenele."Senze obekumele sikwenze kulokhu ebesabelwe khona ukuze ukhetho kube ngolukhululekile nolunokuthula.”
KUHLEHLELE ukuphela kwenyanga ukugwetshwa kukaNobhala-Jikelele we-EFF uMnuz Marshall Dlamini, olahlwe yicala lokushaya ngesihluku.UDlamini ubevele eNkantolo yesifunda eCape Town lapho obekulindeleke khona ukuthi kukhulunywe eyesigwebo. UDlamini ngo-Ephreli walahlwa yicala lokushaya iphoyisa ngesihluku kwafahlaka izibuko ebusweni balo.UDlamini washaya u-Warrant Officer Johan Carstens ngesikhathi kunomcimbi wenkulumo kamengameli ayeyibhekise ezweni ngo-2019. UDlamini uzithethelela ngokuthi babelunywe indlebe ngecebo lokuhlasela umholi wakhe uMnuz Julius Malema.Wathi yena njengomuntu obuye abe yinhloko yezokuphepha eqenjini, kwakufanele enze imizamo yokuphebeza uCarstens.Okhulumela abezokuShushisa (NPA) eWestern Cape, uMnuz Eric Ntabazalila uqinisekisile ukuthi udaba lungenile kodwa isigwebo asikhishwanga.Uthe udaba luhlehlele uJuni 28 lapho okuzoqhubeka khona uhlelo lokukhishwa kwesigwebo sikaDlamini. Ngesikhathi evelile ngoLwesihlanu kuqalwe imicikilisho yokwendlalela isigwebo.Kulalelwe umbiko kangoti obeluleka inkantolo ngelokuthi uDlamini ungumuntu onjani nongafanelwa hlobo luni lwesigwebo.UDlamini akuyena yedwa kwi-EFF ohamba icala njengoba noMalema ebhekene necala lokuqhumisa isibhamu ngesikhathi kunomcimbi eMdantsane, e-Eastern Cape ngo-2018. Kwelinye icala uDkt Mbuyiseni Ndlozi noMalema baphuma phambili besolwa ngokushaya iphoyisa emngcwabeni kaNkk Winnie Madikizela-Mandela.
INGASE iqale ingqayingqayi yezikhundla zikahulumeni eqenjini, iMK, eligila izimanga okhethweni ikakhulukazi KwaZulu-Natal lapho ishiye khona kukhalwa emaqenjini.Umbuzo osezindebeni zabaningi njengamanje owokuthi ngabe yibaphi abaholi abazobonakala bevumbuka bephatha iminyango kahulumeni kulesi sifundazwe KwaZulu-Natal uma leli qembu lithatha izintambo.Amagama abaholi abaziwayo abafana nowake waba yisikhulu esiphezulu eMnyangweni wezokuThutha KwaZulu-Natal, uDkt Kwazi Mbanjwa nowake waba nangumeluleki kaZuma, nowake waba wuNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa kuleli, uMnuz Nkosinathi Nhleko, ngamanye amagama alokhu eqhamuka.Njengamanje iMK ayinalo uhlaka njengoba ingakaze ibe nengqungquthela yokukhetha abaholi. Nemigomo yayo ayiqondwa kwazise ayikaze futhi yaba nengqungquthela yemigomo.Akwaziwa futhi ukuthi igadla ngobani nasezikhundleni zondunankulu njengoba nakhona eKZN kungaziwa ukuthi izogadla ngobani. Leli qembu liye okhethweni linezinyanga cishe eziyisithupha likhona nokuchaza ukuthi lisha ceke.Lisebenza kakhulu ngezinhlaka zesikhashana nakhona bekuphekwa kuthululwa. Inqwaba idilizwa ezitezi zezikhundla ebinikezwe zona.Kuzwelonke isebenza ngesigungu esiphezulu sesikhashana esinabaholi cishe abangu-25 abathatha izinqumo.Okhulumela iMK, uMnuz Nhlamulo Ndhlela, uthe nakuba bengakahlali phansi bakhulume ngezikhundla zikahulumeni kodwa abanalo uvalo."Hhawu senikhuluma ngezikhundla njalo? Thina sisabhekene nomsebenzi wokuthola amavoti. IKZN siqedile ngayo, siyithathile futhi sinabo abantu abafanelwe wumsebenzi esizobajuba, nizobona nje,’’ kusho uNdhlela.UNdhlela uthe akuyona kuphela iKZN lapho ababheke khona kodwa nakuzwelonke basazowenza umonakalo uma sekuqedwe kahle ukubalwa kwamavoti.Uthe abaholi abaqavile bakhona noma ngabe kuthiwa izinhlaka ezisemthethweni azikakhiwa. Uhulumeni wesifundazwe eKZN uma ubunjwa kuba nabaphathiswa abawu-11.Ngaphandle kwabaphathiswa, kube sekuqokwa usomlomo weSishayamthetho sesifundazwe okunguyena okhethwa kuqala ukuze kuhlale indlu. Usomlomo uba nephini lakhe elimlekelelayo ukuze ukusebenza kweSishayamthetho kuhambe kahle.ISishayamthetho sesifundazwe sinezihlalo ezingu-80 ezisuke zizovalwa amalungu avela emaqenjini. Kulindeleke ukuthi uma kwedlula ukhetho bese kuqala ukujuba abantu ezikhundleni, kufungiswe undunankulu bese eqoka abaphathiswa.Kwenzeka konke lokhu nje iMK yadiliza obeyibamba lomdidiyeli wayo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Nhlanhla Ngidi, owugalagala kwezokuphatha uhulumeni.
KUBOSHWE amadoda amabili akade engaphandle ngoshwele onikezwa iziboshwa njengoba ayekade etholwe enecala lokubulala isaguga oThongathi, eThekwini.Abasolwa kulindeleke ukuthi bavele enkantolo namuhla ngamacala amahlanu ababekwe wona.Kubikwa ukuthi ngoLwesithathu, amaphoyisa abizelwe emzini osepulazini iWaterfall ebekade ugqekeziwe kwebiwa. Umnikazi wawo oneminyaka engu-69 nemoto yakhe bengabonwa nangalukhalo.Kuthiwa amaphoyisa esevula idokodo ngokulahleka komuntu kanye namacala okungelokugqekeza nelokweba.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe ngoMgqibelo, uphenyo lwamaphoyisa aseMhlali luholele ekuboshweni kukamsolwa esitolo esidayisa ukudla."Utholwe nesibhamu nezinhlamvu okungokwendoda ebikwe ukuthi ilahlekile. Uphenyo luholele ekuboshweni kukamsolwa wesibili otholwe nemoto nezimpahla okusolakala ukuthi zebiwe ngesikhathi kugqekezwa,” kusho uNetshiunda.Kuvela ukuthi uphenyo olunzulu lwamaphoyisa luwaholele epulazini lamoba eWaterfall, lapho kutholakale khona isidumbu sesaguga obekubikwe ukuthi silahlekile.Isidumbu besikade sisongwe ngoplastiki abamnyama saboshwa ngezintambo salahlwa ekujuleni kwesimoba.UNetshiunda uthe abasolwa babe sebebekwa amacala, okungelokubulala, elokugqekeza nokweba, elokuphatha isibhamu nezinhlamvu ngokungemthetho okusolakala ukuthi kwebiwe kulo muzi."Uphenyo kwesikhashana wamaphoyisa luvundulule ukuthi abasolwa bebekade bengaphandle ngoshwele onikezwa iziboshwa,” kusho uNetshiunda.Ngokusho kwenkampani yonogada iReaction Unit South Africa (Rusa) esitatimendeni, umufi ubekade enamasonto amabili agcina ukubonakala ephila.Okhulumela iRusa, uMnuz Prem Balram, uthe babikelwe ngamalungu omndeni kamufi ukuthi bagcina ukumbona ephila ngesikhathi beze kwakhe emgubheni wosuku lwakhe lokuzalwa.
ZIHLABANA amalunda ngoMsombuluko eNkantolo yezoKhetho, phakathi komholi weMK uMnuz Jacob Zuma, noMnuz Jabulani Khumalo ababanga ubuholi beqembu. INkantolo yezoKhetho ezinze eBloemfontein, eFree State, isebenza izindaba eziphathelene nokhetho kuphela.UKhumalo owabhalisa iqembu, ufake udaba enkantolo ecela ukuthi kuchithwe uZuma kubuyiselwe yena njengomholi.UZuma umemezele iMK ngoDisemba nyakenye wathi uzoyikhankasela futhi ayivotele. Wathi akasayingeni eye-ANC. Kuhambe kwavela ukuthi uZuma usebhaliswe njengomholi kwi-IEC, kwaphuma uKhumalo.UZuma uhambe waze wafakwa waba wubuso beqembu emaphepheni okuvota okungenwe ngawo okhethweni. Kuhambe kwavela ukuthi uKhumalo uxoshiwe eqenjini kodwa yena ekuphikisa lokho.UKhumalo wayibhalela i-IEC eyicela ukuthi isuse uZuma njengomholi ifake yena kodwa yamchitha. I-IEC yathi ime ngencwadi kaKhumalo owayibhalela eyicela ukuthi ifake uZuma njengomholi.I-IEC yathi umuntu ezomlalela nguZuma ngoba nguyena umholi weMK futhi ayingene embangwnei wezikhundla ngaphakathi.UKhumalo ubelele isibili ohlwini lweMK lwabaya ePhalamende, elandela ngemuva kuZuma obephezulu eqhulwini. UZuma uchithwe yinkantolo ohlwini lwasePhalamende nokusho ukuthi izikhala ezivulekile esakhe nesikaKhumalo.UKhumalo ofake isimangalo enkantolo umile ekutheni nguyena umholi osemthethweni weMK. UKhumalo ukuqinisekisile ukuthi udaba lwakhe luzongela eNkantolo ngoMsombuluko lapho oluzolalelwa khona.Kulindeleke ukuthi abameli bakaKhumalo benze izethulo phambi kwamajaji bawachazele ukuthi kungani efuna ukubiyiselwa eqenjini njengomholi.IMK selokhu imenyezelwe ibigqigqa ezinkantolo ivika izagila ezivela kwi-ANC. I-ANC yamangalela iMK iyisola ngokweba igama layo kodwa yafika yanqoba iMK enkantolo.Kuphinde kwavela elinye icala elangena eNkantolo eNkulu eThekwini, kubangwa uphawu lweMK nakhona futhi i-ANC yakhala ngaphansi.Kwenzeka konke lokhu nje iMK igila izimanga okhethweni oluqhubekayo njengoba kusabalwa amavoti.
INHLOKO yamajaji, iJaji uRaymond Zondo, lizothamela umcimbi wokumenyezelwa kwemiphumela yokhetho lapho lizokwamukela khona uhla lwamalungu azofungiswa njengamalungu ePhalamende likazwelonke.Ihhovisi likaZondo liqinisekise lokhu esitatimendeni esishicilelwe enkundleni yezokuxhumana i-X.I-IEC kulindeleke ukuthi imemezele imiphumela yokhetho ngo-6 ntambama ngeSonto, eMidrand.IHhovisi likaMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa likuqinisekisile ngoMgqibelo, ukuthi uzowuthamela umcimbi.Imiphumela imenyezelwa nje, kunamaqembu angaphezu kuka-20, okubalwa kuwo noMkhonto Wesizwe, angeneme ngendlela ukhetho oluhambe ngayo nokubalwa kwemiphumela.Umholi woMkhonto Wesizwe, uJacob Zuma, esithangamini nabezindaba, uthe imiphumela akumele imenyezelwe izikhalo zabo zingalaleliwe.Ngokomthetho, iPhalamende akumele libe namalungu angaphansi kuka-350 nangaphezu kuka-400.Amalungu ePhalamende aqokelwa isikhathi esiyiminyaka emihlanu.Okhulumela iPhalamende, uMoloto Mothapo, uthe uma iPhalamende lihlakazwa, umengameli wezwe kumele abize ukhetho zingakapheli izinsuku ezingu-90."Yize isikhathi saleli siphele ngoMeyi 21, liqhubekile nokusebenza kwaze kwaba yingaphambi kosuku lokhetho okube yiphakathi kwamabili ngoMeyi 28,” kusho uMothapo.Ngemuva kokumenyezelwa kwemiphumela yiokhetho, i-IEC idlulisa uhla lwamalungu kwinhloko yamajaji eyidlulisela ePhalamende.Uthe iPhalamende kumele lihlale zingakapheli izinsuku ezingu-14 kumenyezelwe imiphumela yokhetho futhi lolo suku luzokhethwa wuZondo.Uqhube wathi ngaphambi kokuthi amalungu eqale ukusebenza kumele afungiswe yinhloko yamajaji."Ngemuva kokufungiswa kwamalungu, inhloko yamajaji ibhekelela ukuqokwa kukasomlomo wePhalamende yena okumele abhekelele ukuqokwa kwephini likasomlomo. Umengameli wezwe ngowokugcina ukuqokwa ngoba indlu kumele ihlangane kuqala ngaphambi kokusebenzisa amandla ayo ukukhetha umengameli.”
KUVULWE amacala angu-130 ngezinsuku ezintathu zokuvota lapho kuboshwe khona abantu abangu-90 babekwa amacala ehlukene.Lokhu kudalulwe uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa, uGeneral Fannie Masemola esithangamini nabezindaba sophiko lwezokuphepha iNational Joint Operational and Intelligence Structure (NatJoints) ngeSonto ntambamaUMasemola uthe izigameko eziningi zibikwe e-Eastern Cape, KwaZulu-Natal naseMpumalanga.Uqhube wathi linye icala lokubulala elibikwe eWartburg, eKZN."Ngosuku lokuqala lokuvota okuyisipesheli kubikwe amacala angu-26 kwaboshwa abantu abangu-24. Ngolwesibili kubikwe amacala angu-17, kwaboshwa abayisishiyagalolunye,” kusho uMasemola.Uqhube wathi ngosuku lokuvota, ngoLwesithathu kubikwe amacala angu-37, kwavalelwa abantu abangu-57.UMasimola uthe iningi lababoshiwe lidedelwe ngebheyili kodwa abangu-22 basagcinwe ezitokisini.Lolu phiko luthe lwanelisekile ngezokuphepha nokugcinwa komthetho ngesikhathi sokhetho.
UNobhala Jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, uthe awakhohlwe amaqembu afuna ukuthi kuhoxiswe uMengameli we-ANC uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa njengomengameli ukuze asebenzisane nale nhlangano kuhulumeni wokubambisana. UMbalula uthe uzwile ukuthi kunamaqembu asabise ngokuthi ngeke axoxe ne-ANC uma kungukuthi ayimhoxisi uRamaphosa."Abazofika nalesi siphakamiso abahambe bashone ngoba ngeke siyingene eyabo. Siyazi amaqembu azofuna izinto ezithile ukuze asebenzisane nathi, kodwa ekaRamaphosa ngeke siyenze, akayi ndawo,” kusho uMbalula ekhuluma nabezindaba esikhungweni semiphumela yokhetho eMidrand.UMbalula uthe sebeqalile ukubamba izinguyazana ngohulumeni wokubambisana."Sixoxa nanoma iliphi iqembu. Sixoxa nawo wonke umuntu ngoba ukhetho aluzange luhlonze ozophatha uhulumeni ngayedwana. I-ANC ne-DA amanzi namafutha kodwa sizoxoxa nawo wonke umuntu. Sizoxoxa naneqembu i-Freedom Front Plus,” kusho uMbalula.Usho lokhu nje, iqembu uMkhonto weSizwe eliholwa owayengumengameli we-ANC wezwe uJacob Zuma, lithe lizoxoxa ne-ANC uma isusa uRamaphosa.UMbalula uthe abazange bamthathe kancane uZuma ngoba bebazi ukuthi uyesekwa KwaZulu-Natal, eGauteng naseMpumalanga.I-MK ithole ukwesekwa okukhulu eKZN yadlula i-ANC, kanti ilandelwa yi-IFP.UMbalula uthe bazoxoxa naneMK, wathi kodwa banazo ezinye izinto abangazenza."Singaba iqembu eliphikisayo ngokusemthethweni, noma sibambisane namanye amaqembu. Asibhekile kuphela ukuthi sibe kuhulumeni.” Uthe ngoMsombuluko, kuzohlangana abaholi abaphezulu benhlangano babhunge ngomkhombandlela."Kuzobuye kuhlangane nekomiti elibhekele ukusebenza kwansuku zonke kwenhlangano. NgoLwesibili, kuzohlala umhlangano wesigungu esiphezulu okuyiso esizonquma ngokumele kwenzeke. Sizobuyela kwabezindaba sizobatshela ukuthi sihamba nobani kulezi zinguyazana ngohulumeni wokubambisana,” kusho uMbalula.
Amaphoyisa athungatha uthuli abasolwa ngokudubula 'usomabhizinisi odumile nomqaphi wakhe’ ebusuku ngoLwesihlanu, eMogaung.Okhulumela amaphoyisa aseLimpopo uBrigadier uHlulani Mashaba, uthe lo somabhizinisi (57) odumile angamdalulanga nomqaphi wakhe (33) badutshulwe ngabo-7.45 ebusuku.Ngokwemibiko, abagilwa bebeshayela emgwaqweni u-R574 bebheke ngaseMonsterlus ngesikhathi befika kwisicimpisajubane ngaseMogaung. Abasolwa abebehamba ngeMercedes-Benz eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka kuthiwa badubule kaningi bebhekise kubo."Usomabhizinisi udubuleke engalweni kanti umqaphi wakhe uphumile emotweni wadubula kaningi ebhekise ngakubasolwa. Udubuleke kaningi ngesikhathi enza lokho,” kusho uMashaba.Uthe abasolwa babaleke ngale kokuthatha lutho kubagilwa. Abasolwa baphuthunyiswe esibhedlela.UMashaba uthe amaphoyisa aphenya amacala amabili okuzama ukubulala.Anxuse onolwazi ngabasolwa ukuthi ashayele umphenyi uSergeant Madimetja Manganye ku-060 624 3383 noma athine isiteshi samaphoyisa okanye ku-08600 10111
IQEMBU lepolitiki uMkhonto Wesizwe Party (MKP) lowayenguMengameli wezwe, uMnuz Jacob Zuma lithi alizimisele ngokwenza ubudlelwano ne-ANC eholwa wuMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa emva kokhetho.Liveze ukuthi lizimisele ukusebenzisana namaqembu azovumelana nokuthi uMengameli Zuma anikwe ushwele kamongameli.Okhulumela iMKP, uNhlamulo Ndhlela usho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba kwi-IEC’s National Results Operations Centre eMidrand.Uthe wonke amaqembu azimisele ukukhuluma nabo kumele azimisele ngokuthi kushintshwe umthethosisekelo. Kwezinye izinto azibalile ukuthi kushintshwe nomthetho i-Irrigation Act ephoqa uhulumeni ukuthi uthenge amanzi emadamini aphethwe abantu abazimele."Sifuna ukuthi kube nobumbano futhi asikungabazi ukuthi lokhu kuzokwenzeka. Sizozofinyelela kulokho asidlali. Le iyona ndlela esizoyisebenzisa ukuthi siye esivumelwaneni sokusebenzisana namanye amaqembu. Sizobheka ukuthi amaqembu ayayifuna inqubekela phambili futhi sizosebenzisana nahambisana nalo mbono wethu. Lokho ikona okuzocacisa ukuthi siyasebenzisana noma cha,” kusho uNdhlela.Uthe bafuna ukuthi amaqembu azimisele ukusebenzisana nabo avumelana nalo mthetho wokunika uZuma ushwele ukuze akwazi ukubuyela ephalamende.UNdhlela uthe ukusho lokhu njengoba kubukeka izinto zibavuna ukuthi bangaba yiqembu eliphikisayo ngokusemthethweni."Ithina esizosho ukuthi ubani okumele abe ngumengameli futhi bese simbekela umgomo wokuthi anike uZuma ushwele. Sizombuyisela uZuma ukuba ngumengameli ngisho ngabe asikawushintshi lo mthetho ,futhi lokho sizokwenza kalula. Yize kuke kwaba nezinsolo zokuthi alikho iqembu lepolitiki elizowina ngamalengiso kwaZulu-Natal, kodwa uNdhlela uthe bebezibekele ukuthi bazowina ngo-60% kulesi sifundazwe.
Inhlangano eyengamele ukhetho i-IEC ithi ithole izikhalo ezingu-579 kusuka kuqale ukhetho.USihlalo we-IEC uMnuz Mosotho Moepya uthe noma ubani unelungelo lokufaka izikhalo kusuka kumalungu omphakathi, amaqembu ezepolitiki noma abangenele ngokuzimela.Uthe izikhalo zithinta abazifake kungakaqedwa ukubala, ezabathi batshelwe ngabanye ukuthi bavotele othile kodwa esikhungweni abaliboni ivoti libaliwe, isikhalo sabathi amavoti abo awaveli esiteshini abavote kuso, ababuza ngokuthi zabiwa kanjani izihlalo ePhalamende nezikhalo zokuziphatha noma ukuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi be-IEC.Uveze ukuthi banewindi lokulungisa amaphutha nokwenza imiphumela evelayo ibonakale ihlehla iphinde iye phambili."Kunezikhawu ezingu-24 lapho ikhomishane iyalele ukuthi kuphinde kubalwe.” Kusho uMoepya.Uthe zingu-20 eGauteng izindawo okubalwe kabusha kuzo, ezintathu eNorth West neyodwa eLimpopo.Uthe ngeSonto bazobe bekulungele ukumemezela imiphumela yokhetho kusasa.UMthethosisekelo uthi i-IEC inezinsuku eziyisikhombisa ukumemezela imiphumela ngemuva kokhetho kodwa u Moepya uthe kumele bamemezele ngesikhathi abaqeda ngaso.Umholi woMkhonto Wesizwe uMnuz Jacob Zuma, uthe i-IEC ingajahi ukumemezela imiphumela yokhetho zingalaleliwe izikhalo zayo namanye amaqembu.UZuma uthe abafuni ukucasulwa ngokuthi kujahwe ukubala le miphumela ekubeni kunezikhalazo."Kujahwephi? Ikhomishini imele thina ngakho kumele isilinde uma sinezikhalazo. Asidlali, sifuna kubhekisiswe zonke izikhalazo kungaphuthunywa kukhishwe imiphumela," kusho uZuma.Phezu kokusho kanje kodwa iKhomishini ithe iyaqhubeka nokudedela imiphumela yokhetho ngeSonto ntambama.
Umholi woMkhonto Wesizwe uJacob Zuma uthi akukho miphumela yokhetho ezomenyezelwa kusasa ngeSonto besenezikhalo ezingaphenduliwe.UZuma ukusho lokhu esithangamini nabezindaba esikhungweni semiphumela se-IEC eMidrand, eGoli, ngoMgqibelo ebusuku.Uthe abafuni ukujahwa kodwa bafuna ukunikwa ithuba ukuze bafake izikhalo zabo. Iqembu lakhe namanye amaqembu angaphezu kuka-20 bakhala ngendlela izinto ezenzeke ngayo ngesikhathi kuqhubeka ukhetho nangesikhathi kubalwa."Sizodinga isikhathi. Akukho muntu ozothi nansi imiphumela. Uma lokho kwenzeka abantu bazobe besichukuluza ngoba siyazi sikhuluma ngani, asiqageli. Nginethemba lokuthi okunguyena obhekelele lokhu ulalele. Ungayiqali inkinga uma ingekho. Nika amaqembu ezepolitiki ithuba lokubeka udaba lwawo,” kusho uZuma.Uthe inhlangano ebhekelele ukhetho uma bekhuluma ngokuthi kunezinkinga okumele zibhekwe ibanika imizuzu emincane."Angazi yinkululeko enjani leyo. Siphushwa sengathi siyiziboshwa umuntu okuphoqa ukuthi ungene esitokisini akhiye.”Uthe akekho umuntu okumele abaphoqe ukuthi nayi imiphumela yiza ingashayi emhloleni. Uthe kumele i-IEC ibagculise ukuthi izinto zenzeke ngendlela efanele."Akujahwe lutho, ngeke kufe muntu uma imiphumela ingakhishwa kusasa. Kujahweni? Sesibekezele kakhulu izinto zenzeka. Ngisho abantu benza ubugebengu ababoshwa.Akukho muntu ozomemezela kusasa ngaphandle uma bebengasebenzi nathi. Asikwazi ukuba nondlovukayiphikiswa.”Khonamanjalo uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa sekuqinisekisiwe ukuthi uzokwethula inkulumo emcimbini wokumenyezelwa kwemiphumela ngeSonto.
Iqembu Umkhonto Wesizwe lithi lingase lifune ukuthi kuqalwe phansi ukuvota ngenxa yezinto ezahlukene elingeneme ngazo.Okhulumela iqembu uMnuz Nhlamulo Ndhlela, uthe banobufakazi obuqanda ikhanda obuthinta ukungasebenzi ngendlela kwenhlangano eyengamele ukhetho i-IEC. Uthe obunye buthinta i-ANC athe isebenzise izinto zikahulumeni ukufeza izinhloso zayo.Uthe banobufakazi ababuthumele kwi-IEC obuhlanganisa obuqoshiwe lapho abantu bebekhuluma ngokuthi bawaxosha kanjani amalungu abo abegade ukuthi ukhetho luqhubeka ngendlela yini.UNdhlela ubekhuluma esithangamini nabezindaba esikhungweni sikazwelonke semiphumela se-IEC eMidrand ngoMgqibelo ebusuku. Bekukhona nomholi weqembu uJacob Zuma ofike okokuqala kulesi sikhungo.Uveze ukuthi ngesikhathi kunobuhixihixi ngoLwesihlanu ekuseni lapho imiphumela ibingaveli khona kungenxa yokuthi bekunenkampani yezobuchwepheshe yaseKapa ebikhwabanisa izinto."Sikhulume nabameli bethu futhi izeluleko esizitholile kubo bathe kumele, futhi sizokwenza. Sicabanga ukuthi kuvotwe kabusha. Ukufuna kuqalwe phansi kuvotwe ngenye yezinto esizicabangayo. Yisinqumo esizokhuluma ngaso,” kusho uNdhlela.Uthe okunye bafuna kusungulwe ikhomishana ezophenya kabanzi ngokwenzekile okhethweni.
Umholi we-IFP uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa, uthi akuzange kubalimaze ukufika kweqembu Umkhonto weSizwe ngoba banyuse ukwesekwa baze badlula ne-ANC KwaZulu-Natal.UHlabisa obekhuluma nezintatheli esikhungweni semiphumela seKhomishini yezoKhetho eMidrand, uthe bathole konke abebezibekele khona njengeqembu.Uthe baneme ngoba i-ANC yehlelwe wukwesekwa kulolu khetho."Akusithintanga ukufika kweMK ngoba sikhulise ukwesekwa sadlula emavotini esawathola ngo-2019. Amanye amaqembu ashayekile. Siyiqembu elinyukelwe wukwesekwa, sizoya eziShayamthetho zezifundazwe sesithole izihlalo ezithe xaxa,” kusho uHlabisa. Uveze ukuthi ubuholi besigungu esiphezulu seqembu buzohlangana ukuze kuphume nomhlahlandlela ngokuzokwenzeka."Asijahile ukuthi singene kuhulumeni wokubambisana nanoma ngubani. Sizoxoxa ngesizokwenza bese siphuma nomkhombandlela,” kusho uHlabisa.Uthe kuzoba nomhlangano wesixaxa samaqembu abexoxa eyokusebenzisana ngaphambi kokhetho. Ubalule nokuthi bayayamukela imiphumela yokhetho ngoba abantu baphumile ukuyovotela ukususa i-ANC emandleni."Silinde ihlandla elisha likahulumeni. Abavoti bakhulumile ukuthi bafuna kube nohulumeni wokubambisana, kuphelile ukuthi kube neqembu elilodwa eliphethe. Ayikho into ezomane iphasiswe manje ngenxa yokuthi kuphethe iqembu elilodwa.” Uthe manje sekuzodingeka kutholakale umbono wamanye amaqembu ngaphambi kokuba kuphasiswe into ethile.Uveze ukuthi nesixaxa samaqembu seneme ngokuthi i-ANC ithole ngaphansi kuka-50%, okhethweni.
UYAYIVUMA induku yoMkhonto weSizwe (MK) uNobhala we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, othe balithathe kancane leli qembu bebona ukuthi alinabo abaholi nemigomo elakhelwe phezu kwayo.UMnuz Bheki Mtolo ukusho lokhu engxoxweni abenayo neziko lezindaba i-eNCA ngoMgqibelo emini.Ubalule nokuthi abantu bebengenelisekile ngokulethelwa izidingongqangi emiphakathini ikakhulukazi eThekwini lapho abantu bekhala ngesomiso samanzi, imigwaqo nokunye.UMtolo uthe kuyilandele izinkumbi zabalandeli iMK ukukhankasa ifolosa ngowayengumengameli wezwe ne-ANC,, uJacob Zuma."Yizinto eziphathelene nokulethwa kwezidingo emphakathini okwenze abantu baya eqenjini elisha okuyiMK. Basebenzise umakadebona we-ANC ukuze balande abavoti,” kusho uMtolo.Ukhale nangokuthi kukhona amalungu e-ANC emagatsheni asebenze engaphakathi kulenhlangano esiza iMK ukuze inqobe ukhetho, wabalula izigameko ezimbili sakuMasipala iRay Nkonyeni naseMhlathuze.UMtolo uthe yinto esazolandelelwa ngaphakathi enhlanganweni yabo.Imibiko engakaqinisekiwa ikhomishini yokhetho i-IEC, ikhomba ukuthi alikho iqembu elinqobe ukhetho elizokwazi ukubusa iKZN lodwa.Nakuba kunjalo iMK iwole amavoti abalelwa ku-45%, yalandela i-IFP ngawu-18%, i-ANC yalala isithathu ngawu-17%.Ebuzwa uMtolo ukuthi bazosebenzisana neMK ukwakha uhulumeni wobumbano, uthe i-ANC izosebenzisna neqembu elikhathalele abantu besifundazwe.Ngakolunye uhlangothi iMK ibekele i-ANC umbandela othi kumele isuse umholi wayo, uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa uma ifuna basebenzisane."Kumele kube uhulumeni onozinzo ozokwazi ukuhlala isikhathi esiyiminyaka emihlanu. Abantu esizokwakha nabo uhulumeni kumele kube ngabathenjwa nangabatshali zimali. Abantu abazobhekana ngqo nabatapayo, abenza ubugebengu nodlame nabavala imigwaqo,” kusho uMtolo.
USIHLALO weDA KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Dean Macpherson, ujabulela ukuthi iMK ayizange ithole izihlalo ezanele ukuthi ibuse ngokuzimela KwaZulu-Natal.UMacpherson uthe bazokwenza ngakho konke okusemandleni abo ukuthi iMK ayisiphathi isifundazwe.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba esikhungweni sokubala amavoti esiseThekwini.IMK iyona ezihola phambili KwaZulu-Natal ngamavoti angaphezu kuka-44%, iDA yona ilele isine.UMacpherson uthe bamelene nokuthi kuphathe iMK KwaZulu-Natal."Emkhankasweni wethu besithi 'takula iKZN'. Besisuke sisho ukuthi iKZN ayitakulwe ezintweni ezifana neMK. Sijabule ukuthi abakwazanga ukuthola isibalo esingaphezu kuka-50%."UMacpherson uthe amaqembu aphikisayo kufanele abambisane ukuze iMK ingezukuphatha.UMacpherson uthe angeke bayemukele imiphumela yokhetho uma izikhalazo zayo zingaxazululwa ngokushesha.UMacpherson, uthe kunezikhalazo ezingu-34 abazifakile ezingakaxazululwa.Imiphumela yokhetho izomenyezelwa kusasa, ntambama.Izolo, iDA ibhalele inhlangano eyengamele, i-Independent Electoral Commission (IEC), beyitshela ukuthi bafuna izikhalazo zabo zixazululwe ngaphambi kokuthi kumenyezelwe imiphumela.I-DA iphinde yafaka isikhalazo ngokwesigaba somthetho u-55, esiphoqa ukuthi kuqokwe ukhomishana ozophenya izikhalazo zabo.UMacpherson uthe izikhalazo zabo zingenza umehluko omkhulu uma zingaxazululwa."Kunezindawo lapho othola khona ukuthi kunaphepha okuvota esifundazweni angu-2 000, bese kuthi akazwelonke abe u-4 000. Kunzima ukukholwa ukuthi into enje yenzeke kanjani."Okubi ukuthi asizitholi izimpendulo eziqondile uma sibuza imibuzo. Uma uhlanganisa lezibalo uyabona ukuthi kungashintsha izinto eziningi. Kungashintsha ukwabiwa kwezihlalo esiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal."
USihlalo weKhomishini yezoKhetho uMnuz Mosotho Moepya, useqinisekise abantu bakuleli ukuthi bazobhekisisa konke okuyizikhalazo ngaphambi kokudedela imiphumela yokhetho.Uthe ngeke bajahe ukudedela le miphumela ngoba bafuna abantu baqhubeke nokubethemba."Sizoqhubeka nokuqinisekisa ukuthi sibheka yonke into ngokucophelela. Zonke izikhalazo ezingenile sizozibhekisisa ngokuvuleleka,” kusho uMoepya esithangamini sabezindaba.Usho lokhu nje cishe wonke amaqembu ezepolitiki akhala ngokwenzelwa phansi yikhomishini.La maqembu akhala nangezinye izinto ezithinta nokuthi kukhona ukushintshwa kwemiphumela okwenzekile.Amanye afuna kuphinde kuqalwe phansi ukubalwa kwamavoti ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi angu-ngqo.Lokhu kwenzeka nje alikho iqembu eliwine ukhetho ngamalegiso kuzwelonke.I-ANC kuzodingeka ukuthi isebenzisane namanye amaqembu ukuze ibumbe uhulumeni."Uhlelo lokubala imiphumela emhlabeni jikelele luhlale lidinga ukwenziwa ngobunono. Lwenziwe ngendlela yokuthi luhambisane nezinguquko ezibekhona ngesikhathi kuchitshiyelwa umthetho kuleli.” Uthe lolu hlelo lwahlolwa yiKhomishini ngaphambi kokulusebenzisa.Usho lokhu nje ngoLwesihlanu kube nobuhixihixi kwacisha izibani ebhodini le miphumela.Kukhona abebesola ukuthi ikhomishini izama ukukokotela imiphumela.Izikhulu zekhomishini zithe alukho ulwazi olulahlekile ngenxa yalobu buhixihixi.
NJENGOBA umphakathi namaqembu ezepolitiki eyilinde ngabomvu imiphumela yokhetho lukazwelonke nolwezifundazwe, uhulumeni uthi phansi amaphaphu.Okhulumela uhulumeni uNksz Nomonde Mnukwa, uthe njengoba lusaqhubeka uhlelo lokuqinisekisa imiphumela yokhetho, abantu ababeke umoya phansi.Uthe uhlelo luthatha isikhathi ngoba kudingeka kwenziwe izinto eziningi okubalwa ukwaba izihlalo zasePhalamende, kanjalo naseziShayamthetho zezifundazwe.Uchaze kanje uNksz Mnukwa:"IKhomishini yezoKhetho ivulelekile ohlelweni lokuqinisekisa imiphumela ukuze ukhetho kube ngolukhululekile. Le miphumela kudingeka icwaningwe yizinkampani zabacwaningi eziqokwe ukwenza lo msebenzi.” Uqhube wathi amaqembu ezepolitiki ayakwazi ukuzicwaningela imiphumela wathi ngokomthetho imiphumela kumele imenyezelwe ezinsukwini eziyisikhombisa ngemuva kokhetho."Izinsuku eziyisikhombisa ziphela ngoJuni 5, 2024. IKhomishini iyona kuphela enelungelo lokumemezela imiphumela yokhetho. Asikho esinye isikhungo noma abahlaziyi kanjalo namaqembu abanelungelo elisemthethweni lokumemezela imiphumela yokhetho.” Uxwayise amaqembu ukuthi angasheshi amemezele imiphumela. Uthe uma seyimenyezeliwe imiphumela, uhlu lwabazomela amaqembu ePhalamende luzonikezwa umengameli wamajaji.Uzobe eseludlulisela kunobhala wePhalamende."La malungu kudingeka afungiswe, bese kuphakanyiswa igama lomuntu ozoba ngumengameli, ozovotelwa amalungu. Uhlelo lokuvotelwa kukamengameli lusingathwa nguJaji Raymond Zondo.” Uhulumeni usho lokhu nje kulindeleke ukuthi ikhomishini idedele imiphumela yokhetho kusasa. Kuthiwa imiphumela yesikhashana ize ifakwe emqulwini kahulumeni iGovernment Gazette.Umcimbi wokumemezela imiphumela yokhetho KwaZulu-Natal, use-Inkosi Albert Luthuli International Convention Centre eThekwini, kanti uqala ngo-4 ntambama.Okazwelonke useMidrand, kanti wona uqala ngo-6 ntambama.Lolu khetho belubhekwe ngabomvu kanti belufaniswa nolokuqala olwabanjwa ngaphansi kwentando yeningi ngo-1994.
Umholi we-EFF uMnuz Julius Malema uthe bangasebenzisana ne-ANC kuhulumeni wokubambisana ngoba le nhlangano ngeke isakhula ngokwezibaloUMalema uthe uKhongolose uzoqhubeka nokwehla njengoba njalo uma kunokhetho le nhlangano yehlelwa wukweseka."I-ANC esingasebenzisana nayo kuhulumeni wokubambisana ngoba njengoba yehlelwa wukwesekwa, ngeke abaholi bayo bazikhukhumeze. Iqembu esizosebenza nalo sifuna libuyise umhlaba, kuvulwe imitholampilo ubusuku nemini kuphinde kuhlinzekwe ngamaqakelo mahhala,” kusho uMalema ekhuluma nabezindaba ekomkhulu lemiphumela yezokhetho eMidrand ngoMgqibelo.Uthe bayajabula ukuthi i-ANC ichuthwe amaphiko wathi ngisho ezinkundleni zokuxhumana abaholi bayo bathule du.Uveze ukuthi sebebonile ukuthi abantu abebebaseka KwaZulu-Natal, bekungabantu bomholi weqembu Umkhonto weSizwe, uMnuz Jacob Zuma."Siyajabula ngoba sesiyazi ukuthi sesekwa ngobani eKZN. Bekungebona abantu bethu laba abebeseseka kodwa abantu abaduba i-ANC emuva kokususa uZuma. Kwakumele sibone ngesikhathi kuboshwa uZuma izibhelu ezasuka eKZN ukuthi lo muntu kukhona abamesekayo,” kusho uMalema.Uthe bazimisele ukusebenza neMK nasezifundazweni.Uchithe ukuthi i-EFF iyashabalala njengoba ilokhu yehlelwa wukwesekwa."Ayifi i-EFF, ukuvumbuka kweMK ikhona okusiphuce amavoti. Iqembu elilahlekelwe kakhulu kulolu khetho yi-ANC, i-EFF iwinile. Siyakwamukela ukushawa.” Uveze ukuthi bayayamukela imiphumela yokhetho."Asinamengameli kumanje okhona ezweni. Kwalo okhona manje akanaso isiqinisekiso ukuthi uzoba ngumengameli. Ngeke sifonele muntu thina, abasifunayo bazosishayela bona ucingo ukuze sixoxe.”UMalema uthe izembe lizogawula kulabo abavilaphile bangasebenza ngesikhathi sokhetho."Sizolishintsha uhlu lwabaya ePhalamende nabaya eziShayamthetho ngoba kukhona abangenzanga lutho. Bazozihoxela bona ngoba ongasebenzanga akayi ePhalamende.”
OKHULUMELA i-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Mafika Mndebele, uveze ukuthi ngeke babambisane neqembu eliholwa owayengumengameli wezwe ne-ANC uMnuz Jacob Zuma, UMkhonto weSizwe. UMndebele uthe nakuba bevule izandla kuwo wonke amaqembu athole izihlalo kodwa ngeke bakwazi ukubambisana neMK.IMK iyona ethole amavoti amaningi KwaZulu-Natal kodwa kubukeka ingeke ithole izihlalo ezanele ukuthi ibuse ngokuzimela.UMndebele uthe isithiyo esibavimba ukuthi basebenzisane neMK ukuthi abaholi beMK abawuhloniphi uMthethosisekelo."Kungafanele benze izinto ngenye indlela abeMK uma befuna ukusebenzisana nathi."Ukusho lokho ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba esikhungweni sokubala amavoti esiseThekwini.UMndebele uthe ukuhlulwa kwabo KwaZulu-Natal akusho ukuthi abantu bakulesifundazwe abasayithandi i-ANC.Njengoba sekubalwe u-99,66% wamavoti KwaZulu-Natal, i-ANC ilele isithathu ngamavoti awu-595 349.Phezulu kuqhwakele iMK, enamavoti awu-1 587 856, kulandele i-IFP ngamavoti awu-631 036.UMndebele uthe abantu baKwaZulu-Natal bakhethe ukujezisa i-ANC."Abantu basayithanda i-ANC kodwa bayicasukele. Bacasulwa ukungagcinwa kwezethembiso. Abantu bacasulwa ukungahanjiswa kwezidingo. Siye okhethweni abantu bakoMlaza, lapho i-ANC ivotelwa khona kakhulu, bengenawo amanzi."
UKHOMISHANA wamaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, ukhalima abantu abazobhiyozela imiphumela yokhetho, bese bekwenza ngendlela engekho emthethweni.UMkhwanazi uthe abazoba osikhwili phambana nobhoko, abazobhiyoza kuze kweqe, bazoyikhotha imbenge yomile.Uyalele abaholi bamaqembu ezepolitiki ukuthi baxwayise amalungu abo ukuthi abhiyoze kepha aqaphele.Umkhwanazi ubeke kanje:"Sixwayisa labo abazobhiyoza ukuthi bakwenze lokhu belandela umthetho. Uma bebhiyoza bephula umthetho, amaphoyisa ngeke ananaze ukubabopha. Amaphoyisa azobe eyiqaphe ngelokhozi imibhiyozo.”Wathi nalabo abazophuza bese beshaya abanye, bazobhekana nabo."Njengoba kuqala impelasonto kukhona abazophuza bese bebhiyozela kwabanye. Kwabona siyabaxwayisa ukuthi bapheze ukwenza lokhu ngoba uma beke baphambana nomthetho, sizobe sikhona ukubabopha,” kusho uMkhwanazi.Ukusho lokhu ngoLwesihlanu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba esikhungweni semiphumela yezokhetho yeKhomishini yezoKhetho eThekwini.UMkhwanazi uncome amaphoyisa ngomsebenzi omuhle awenzile ngalesi sikhathi sokhetho, wathi ibalelwa ngaphezu kuka-900 imibhikisho yomphakathi yokukhala ngezidingo kusuka ekuqaleni konyaka."Abalelwa ku-60 amacala athinta ukhetho, ahlanganisa ukuphazamisa abasebenzi bokhetho, ukucekela phansi impahla yokuvota, ukushaya, ukuqhumisa isibhamu namanye. Bathathu abantu ababoshelwa lawa macala abangakadedelwa,” kubeka uMkhwanazi.Uthe emacaleni okubulala abikiwe eMpumalanga, Wartburg naseMuden ngaseGreytown, bathole ukuthi abengahlangene nokhetho."Kunamaphoyisa amabili ayekiswe umsebenzi wokugada ukhetho emuva kwe-vidiyo esabalale ezinkundleni zokuxhumana egqoke umfaniswano wamaqembu. Umsebenzi wethu akuwona owokuba osopolitiki kodwa ukugada ukhetho,” kusho uMkhwanazi.Khonamanjalo isikhulu esiphezulu seKhomishini yoKhetho, uMnuz Sy Mamabolo, sikuchithile ukuthi ubuhixihixi obudaleke izolo kucisha ibhodi lemiphumela ezikhungweni okukhishwa kuzona imiphumela, buzoba nomthelela emiphumeleni.Uthe alukho ulwazi olwebiwe kulobu buhixihixi."Alukho ulwazi olwebiwe ngenxa yalobu buhixihixi. Ulwazi lonke luphelele kube nje nokuphazamiseka kodwa yonke into ihamba kahle.” Kanti isikhulu sekhomishini KwaZulu-Natal uNkk Ntombifuthi Masinga, sihambe emazwini kaMamabolo, sathi alukho ulwazi olulahlekile ngenxa yobuhixihixi.Uveze ukuthi zintathu izikhalazo ngokhetho abazitholile wathi ezimbili zazo zichithiwe. "Esisodwa simatasa naso. Sizothi sikhipha imiphumela ngeSonto (kusasa) sibe sesixazulule yonke into. Imiphumela yaseThekwini, izogcina ukungena ngenxa yokuthi inezikhungo eziningi zokuvota,” kuchaz uNkk Masinga.Uveze ukuthi iTheku linezikhungo ezibalelwa ku-800, ekubeni izikhungo zokuvota zibalelwa ku-4 900.
KUXWAYISWE abaholi bamaqembu ezepolitiki namalungu ukuthi bangakhulumi amagama anohlevane noma izinto ezizojivaza isithunzi sokhetho njengoba ingakakhishwa ngokusemthethweni imiphumela yokhetho.Lesi sexwayiso sikhishwe nguSihlalo weKhomishini yezoKhetho uMnuz Mosotho Moepya, othe umgomo wokuziphatha owasayinwa amaqembu usamile njengoba imiphumela ingakashicilelwa.Usho lokhu nje abaholi abehlukene bakhwela bayadilika, abanye bakhuluma amagama anohlevane njengokuthi kwezinye izifundazwe abavoti bavote belandela uhlanga oluthile.Amehlo abamaqembu ezepolitiki nezintatheli alokhu ethe njo emabhodini emiphumela esikhungweni semiphumela ye-IEC eMidrand Isithombe: GCIS USihlalo we-ANC uMnuz Gwede Mantashe noSihlalo woMkhandlu we-DA uNkk Helen Zille, bathe abavoti baKwaZulu-Natal, bavotele iqembu elisha uMkhonto weSizwe, eliholwa ngowayengumengameli uMnuz Jacob Zuma owayengumengameli wezwe, ngokobuhlanga ngoba engumZulu."Sixwayisa abaholi nabeseka amaqembu ukuthi bacwecwe ulimi uma bekhuluma ngoba imigomo yokuziphatha ethinta ukhetho isamile. Abamaqembu bayazi ukuthi uma kuphulwa le migomo yiziphi izinyathelo abangathathelwa zona emthethweni ngakho sinxusa ukuthi bakuqaphele abakushoyo kuze kukhishwe imiphumela.” Uthe bayakwamukela ukugxekwa ngezikhalo zomphakathi ezithinta ukhetho.Amaqembu ehlukene akhale ngokuhamba kancane kohlelo lokuvota kwezinye izikhungo ezize zavalwa entathakusa izolo, ukungasebenzi kwemishini yokubheka amagama abavoti, ukungavunyelwa kwabanye abavoti ebebengabhalisile ezikhungweni abebefuna ukuvota kuzona nezinye izinkinga.UMnuz Sy Mamabolo, isikhulu sekhomishini, uthe abasebenzi abebesiza okhethweni baqeqeshwe izinsuku ezine.Uthe bakha uhlelo lokuqasha laba basebenzi besebenzisana namaqembu amelelekile emkhandlwini ofaka ikhomishini namaqembu."Kwaqashwa intsha eningi ebingasebenzi, engenaso nesipiliyoni. Ukuphatha ukhetho kudinga ukuthi ube nolwazi.”Uthe ezikhungweni okubalwa iCity Hall, eThekwini enabantu abaningi abavota kuyona baphuzile ukubala amavoti ngenxa yokuthi kuvotwe ngisho sesishayile isikhathi sokuvala.Ubalule nokuthi izolo ngabo-3 ntambama kunezikhungo ebezisabala amavoti. "Siqashe abacwaninga imiphumela abazoqinisekisa ukuthi yonke imiphumela iyiyona. Uma sekuphothulwe konke kuzobe sekwabiwa izihlalo zasePhalamende kanjalo naseziShayamthetho, kunikwe inhloko yamajaji uhlu lwabantu abazojutshwa.” Uthe umthetho ubagunyaza ukuthi bamemezele imiphumela ezinsukwini eziyisikhombisa wathi bazimisele ukungaphambani nalokhu okubekwe emthethweni.UMamabolo uthe umthetho uvumela ukuthi umuntu avote lapho ehlala khona kuphela wathi abajikisiwe yingoba bebengaveli ohlwini lokuvota.Abanezikhalo ezithinta ukubalwa kwamavoti noma ezinye ezithinta izinto ezenzeke ezikhungweni zokuvota, banikwe kuze kube yinamhlanje ngo-9 ebusuku ukubika ku:[email protected].
BAFE ujuqu abantu abathathu abadutshulwe eSihlabeni, eMuden bebuya ukuyovota entathakusa ngoLwesine.Kubikwa ukuthi abagilwa abaneminyaka ephakathi kuka-22 no-25, baqhululwe ngenhlamvu ngesikhathi behamba ngemoto okubikwe ukuthi yebiwa eGoli.Imibiko yamaphoyisa ithi amadoda amathathu abehamba nabesifazane abathathu aqede ukuvota kwase kuyiwa emzini onesitolo esiseduze nesikhungo sokuvota.Kuthiwa bavukelwe abantu abangaziwa okusolakala ukuthi bebekade bebalalele unyendle, babadubula.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe kulimale owesifazane oyedwa waphuthunyiswa esibhedlela.Udalule ukuthi abanye besifazane ababili baphume kulesi sehlakalo bengenamyocu.Kwesinye isehlakalo esiseceleni, amaphoyisa aseWartburg maphakathi nesifundazwe aphenya icala lokubulala nelokuzama ukubulala emuva kokubulawa kowesilisa.Umufi obeneminyaka engu-40 kusolakala ukuthi udutshulwe wafa ngesikhathi esemotweni bude buduze nesikhungo obekuvotelwa kusona esikoleni KwaSwayimana High, ngoLwesithathu ebusuku.UNetshiunda uthe kubikwa ukuthi umufi ubehlezi emotweni nowesilisa ngesikhathi imoto iPolo emhlophe ipaka phambi kweyabo."Kusolakala ukuthi kuphume indoda ebiphethe isibhamu esikhulu yadubula ibhekise kubagilwa. Kuphangalale umuntu oyedwa, ohlonzwe njengoshonele endaweni yesigameko. Omunye uphume engenamyocu,” kusho uNetshiunda.Uqhube wathi akwaziwa ukuthi bangobani abasolwa nembangela yalokhu kubulala.Unxuse noma ubani ongaba nolwazi lokuthi bangatholakala kuphi abasolwa athinte amaphoyisa aseduzane noma athinte abeCrime Stop enombolweni yocingo ethi: 08600 10111.
UYAQHUBEKA ugingqigonqo wezikhundla kumasipala okungekho kuwo iqembu elathola izihlalo ezanele ukuba libuse ngokuzimela, uMvoti.INkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu ichithe umhlangano okwakhishwa kuwo iMeya, uMnuz Philani Mavundla, noSomlomo, uMnuz Mfundo Masondo.UMavundla noMasondo, abangamakhansela e-ABC, bakhishwa ngevoti lokungabethembi ubuholi babo emhlanganweni womkhandlu owawungeledlule.NgoLwesibili, inkantolo ikhiphe isinqumo sesikhashana esivimba ukukhishwa kukaMavundla noMasondo.Abafuna ukukhipha uMavundla noMasondo ezikhundleni bayalelwe ukuba bafake amaphepha asenkantolo ngaphambi kuka-Agasti 6, baveze ukuthi kungani uMavundla noMasondo kufanele bakhishwe ezikhundleni?UMavundla bakhishwa ezikhundleni emhlangaweni owawubizwe wuMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal.Amakhansela ayebhalele uMphathiswa woMnyango, uNkk Bongi Sithole-Moloi, emcela ukuba abize umhlangano, ekhala ngokuthi uMasondo akafuni ukubiza umhlangano.Isiphakamiso sokuthi kukhishwe uMavundla noMasondo sesekwa amakhansela e-IFP nawe-ANC.Kwabe sekuqokwa ikhansela le-IFP, uMnuz Zamani Malembe, kwesobumeya, uNkk Ntombi Ngubane, we-ANC, yena waqokelwa kwesikasomlomo.UMalembe wabuye wasula esikhundleni emva komyalelo wobuholi be-IFP.Amakhansela e-ABC awudikila umhlangano, aveza ukuthi anesivimbelo sasenkantolo evimba ukuhlala komhlangano.UMasondo uthe babevele beshilo ukuthi kwakungekho emthethweni ukukhishwa kwabo."Umhlangano esakhishwa kuwo wawufana nomhlangano waphansi kwesihlahla, basebenzisa ubunsizwa, benza ngomqondo waserenki. Bakwenza lokhu bephikisana nezinkantolo.”UMasondo uthe ukukhishwa kwabo ngokungekho emthethweni kushayisa amakhala.Uthe ziningi izinqumo ezithathiwe, nezinto ezenzekile kulezi nsukwana bekhishiwe ezikhundleni.UMasondo uthe ngosuku olulandela abakhishwa ngalo kwahlala umhlangano womkhandlu owabuyisela emsebenzini imenenja kamasipala esamisiwe, uNksz Noxolo Ndaba."Ayikho enye into eyakhulunywa kuloyo mhlangano, kwakhulunywa lena yokubiyiswa kwemenenja kamasipala esamisiwe kuphela. Imenenja kamasipala ibhekene nezinsolo ezibucayi. Bekufanele ukuthi balinde uhlelo lwayo lokuqondiswa ubugwegwe luze luphele. Uma ibingenacala ibizotholakala imsulwa.”UMasondo uthe kwaba nemizamo yokuxosha abanye abasebenzi, kwaphinde kwagqekezwa nasehhovisi lakhe."Kwagqekezwa kwabili ehhovisi lami. Kusho ukuthi kukhona imikhoshosho ababefuna ukuyenza.”UMasondo uthe angeke bavume ukuthi umasipala uphenduke isidleko senkohlakalo.Alikho iqembu elathola izihlalo ezanele ukuthi libuse ngokuzimela umasipala waseMvoti.I-IFP inezihlalo ezingu-10, i-ANC ineziyisishagalolunye, i-ABC yona ineziyisikhombisa.

Kusale enkundleni isosha elilodwa lombutho wakuleli, iSouth African Defence Force (SANDF), kwalimala amanye angu-13 ngesikhathi etholana phezulu namavukelambuso, iM23, eSake, eDemocratic Republic of Congo, ngoLwesine.I-SANDF, esitatimendeni esikhishwe ngoLwesihlanu, ithe wonke amasosha alimele ayalulama esibhedlela, iGoma.Ithe kulimale izimoto zawo ezimbili kulesi sigameko."Uma yonke imininingwane mayelana namalungu ethu isiqinisekisiwe sizophinde sikhiphe eminye imininingwane futhi umndeni woshonile uzokwaziswa,” kusho iSANDF.Amasosha akuleli ajutshwe eDRC njengengxenye yeSouthern African Development Community Mission in the Democratic Republic of Congo (SAMIDRC) ukuyosiza uhulumeni wakuleliya lizwe ukudala ukuthula nozinzo.Ngelesihlanu isosha kakuleli ukufa kuleliya lizwe kusuka kuqale unyaka. Iqembu iMK lidlebeleka okomlilo wamadlelo njengoba kungena imiphumela yokhetho KwaZulu- Natal. I-MK imenyezelwe ngowayengumengameli uJacob Zuma ngoDisemba nyakenye, wathi uzoyikhankasela ayivotele futhi akasayingeni eye-ANC. UZuma akasulanga kwi-ANC, namanje ubulungu bakhe busekhona njengoba ebuye abe yilungu leMK.Kusho ukuthi iMK ingenele ukhetho inezinyanga cishe eziyisithupha imenyezelwe ngokusemthethweni kubantu bakuleli. Emuva kwesimemezelo sikaZuma ngoDisemba, kwadilika umthangala abantu bethutheleka kuleli qembu.Kushaye u-5 ntambama ngoLwesihlanu iMK isithole amavoti angaphezu kwangu-800 000 esifundazweni ilandelwa yi-IFP enangu-340 069, endaweni yesithathu bekukhona i-ANC ebingaphezu kuka-337 000 ngamavoti. I-DA ibisendaweni yesine izama ukusondela emavotini angu-260 000.Imiphumela yamavoti ebisingenile KwaZulu-Natal ngemuva kuka-5 ntambama ngoLwesihlanuUmhlaziyi wezepolitiki uMnuz Zakhele Ndlovu ofundisa ipolitiki e-UKZN, uthe iMK iphundle i-ANC ne-IFP ngenxa yezizathu ezimbili."Indaba yokuba wumZulu ineqhaza elikhulu ngoba uZuma njengamanje wuyena mholi waKwaZulu omdala nohlonishwayo emuva kokuhamba kukaMntwana waKwaPhindangene. Abantu abebecikwe yi-ANC bebezoya kwi-IFP ukube kayivelanga iMK,’’ kusho uNdlovu.Uthe nangaphandle kokuba wumZulu, uZuma ungumuntu onogazi kubantu nonesisoka nobugagu bokukhuluma izinto ezigovuza abantu."Indaba yokudatshukelwa aziveze njengomuntu ohlukunyezwayo iyamsebenzela ngoba abantu bathi uZuma waya ekudingisweni waboshwa kodwa namanje usahlushwa. Uma umlalela kahle uyigagu, uyakwazi ukukhuluma nabantu,’’ kusho uNdlovu.UNdlovu uthe nayo iMK yazi kahle ukuthi ibingeke ibe yilutho ngaphandle kukaZuma.Omunye umhlaziyi uMnuz Thobani Zikalala, uthe lokhu kudlondlobala kweMK kuwubufakazi bokuthi iyasebenza indaba yomuntu siqu sakhe kwipolitiki."Abantu bakuleli bavota ngokuthi umuntu uwubani futhi bayamthanda yini, bese kuxubana nezimo ababhekene nazo ngaleso sikhathi. I-ANC ishaya eceleni njengoba ilokhu ibelesela indaba yobuhlanga,’’ kusho uZikalala.Uthe i-ANC ibukeka igcizelela indaba yokuvota ngobuhlanga uma kukhulunywa ngabantu baseKZN kodwa kwezinye izindawo ayisho kanjalo.UZikalala uthe bakhona abantu abanamakhono nesipiliyoni kwiMK abangase bajutshwe ezikhundleni zikahulumeni uma begcina bethatha izintambo.Kwenzeka konke lokhu nje, umkhankaso we-IFP KwaZulu-Natal ububukeka unamandla uholwa wuSihlalo wayo uMnuz Thami Ntuli ogaqele esikandunankulu.

UMPHATHI webhange lombuso, iSouth African Reserve Bank (Sarb), uMnuz Lesetja Kganyago, uthi ngeke ishintshe maduze imali mboleko, isazohlala ku-8.25%.UKganyago usho lokhu ngoLwesine ngesikhathi ememezela ukuthi amalungu athatha izinqumo ngemali mboleko avumelene wonke ukuthi ayingashintshi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi inzalo ekhokhwa ngababoleka imali emabhange izohlala ku-11.75%.Uthe okwamanje ikomiti elinquma ngemali mboleko eSarb lizobheka okwenzekayo ngaphambi kokuthatha isinqumo esihlukile. Uveze ukuthi imali mboleko ingase yehle ngonyaka ozayo.Uncome ukuthi ugesi usudonse isikhathi eside unganqamuki, wathi kulokoza inhlansi yethemba ngokukhula komnotho waseNingizimu Afrika.USolwazi Bonke Dumisa, ongumhlaziyi womnotho ozimele, uthe bekulindelekile ukuthi iSarb igcine imali mboleko ku-8.25% ngenxa yokuthi ifuna amandla emali abe phakathi kuka-3% kuya ku-6%.Uthe ngeke yehle uma amandla emali eseko-5.2%.Isazi somnotho saseFNB, uNkk Mamello Matikinca-Ngwenya, naso sithe akumangazi ukuthi imali mboleko ayishintshanga ngoba ucwaningo lwabo lukhombisa ukuthi ingase yehle ekoteni yesibili yalo nyaka.UMnuz Mervyn Abrahams, wenhlangano eyenza ucwaningo ngokubiza kokudla nesimo senhlalo, iPietermaritzburg Economic Justice & Dignity Group, ucele uKganyago ukuthi ehlise imali mboleko ngoba iyabashaya abantu abampofu.Uthe yize bekuqonda ukuthi inyuselwa ukuthi abantu bangazenzi izikweletu kodwa vele abampofu abasazenzi ngoba badonsa kanzima kunalokho basala bengenamali ngenxa yenzalo abayikhokha ezikweletini zabo.Lesi sinqumo uthe sivuna abacebile ngoba akuzweli kangako kubona.

ISIKHULU se-IEC KwaZulu- Natal uNkk Ntombifuthi Masinga, sithi kushone abantu ababili abebesuka ezikhungweni zokuvota.UNkk Masinga ubekhuluma esithangamini sabezindaba esikhungweni semiphumela e-ICC, eThekwini. Uthe bawachazelile amaphoyisa ukuthi umsebenzi wabo ubesebenza kepha wasolwa abathile ngokukhwabanisa.UNkk Masinga uthe udaba lusaphenywa ngamaphoyisa kanti ibhokisi lokuvota lithathiwe. Uthe ngaphandle kwalokho ukuvota kuhambe kahle nokubala kusaqhubeka.
I-SOUTH African Social Security Agency (Sassa) ixwayisa abantu ukuthi bangayinaki inkulumo engelona iqiniso ezungeza ezinkundleni zokuxhumana emayelana nokuholwa kwezimpesheni.Esitatimendeni esithumele abezindaba, iSassa ithe izwe lisesikhathini sokhetho ngakho kunabantu abazama ngakho konke okusemandleni abo ukutshala ingebhe kubantu abahola izibonelelo zikahulumeni.Kule nkulumo eqoshiwe kuthiwa kuzwakala izwi lowesilisa okhuluma isiXhosa, ethi uhlelo lokuholela izimpesheni lakwaSassa lugqekeziwe.Iqhubeka ithi ngenxa yalokhu, abantu ngeke bayithole impesheni yabo njengenhlalayenza ngoba iSassa isaba abakhwabanisi.Kuthiwa le ndoda isho nokuthi imali yesibonelelo ngeke ifakwe kuma-akhawunti asemabhange abahola izimpesheni kuze kulungiswe uhlelo lokuholwa kwezimpesheni emuva kwamasonto amabili.Kuyona le nkulumo eqoshiwe kwaziswa abantu ukuthi imali yesibonelelo bazoyithola emahhovisi akwaSassa eduze kwalapho behlala khona futhi kumele baphathe omazisi babo.Le ndoda kuthiwa ihubhuza amanga, ithi isabalalisa le nkululumo ngoba iyazi kunabantu abangenayo imisakazo noma uWhatsApp.AbakwaSassa bathi ngamampunge ashiwo kule nkulumo futhi abantu abangangenwa amanzi emadolweni."Sinxusa abantu ukuthi bangakunaki okuqukethwe yile nkulumo kodwa balandele okubhalwe ezinkundleni zokuxhumana zakwaSassa eziqukethe imininingwane yangempela mayelana nezinsuku okuholwa ngazo izimpesheni zinyanga zonke,” kusho uSassa.ISassa ithi akukhona okokuqala ibhekana nenkinga efuze lena kwazise isike yaphebeza amahemuhemu ayethi kuzonqanyulwa ukuholwa kwezibonelelo."ISassa ifuna ukuqinisekisa umphakathi ukuthi ngeke kube nokuphazamiseka ekuholweni kwezimpesheni. Luhamba kahle uhlelo lwethu lokuholela abantu izibonelelo futhi ngeke luphazanyiswe lutho. Abantu bazoyithola ngesikhathi imali yabo,” kucacisa iSassa esitatimendeni.
AMAPHOYISA kuMasipala weTheku akhiphe isixwayiso ngokuvalwa komgwaqo amasonto ambalwa kuleli dolobha. Ngokwesitatimende esikhishwe amaphoyisa, kuzovalwa umgwaqo uBrooke Street oxhuma kuM4 ngaseningizimu uze uyongena kuDr Pixley KaSeme Street. Lo mgwaqo uzovalwa okwesikhashana kusukela ngoMeyi 3, (ngoLwesihlanu) kuze kube nguJuni 21, 2024.Lo mgwaqo uzovalwa ukuze kuqhubeke kahle ukubhidlizwa kwebhilidi iChina Emporium.Kunxuswa abashayeli ukuba bagweme ukuhambela kule ndawo, basebenzise le migwaqo:Ukungena kwesokunxele ku-Anton Lembede Street, ujikele kwesokudla kuWarwick Avenue ubuye kwesokudla ukuthola uPixley Ka Seme Street.Ukungena kuMargaret Mncadi Avenue (Victoria Embankment) Ukungena kuChe Guevara Road (Moore Road)Kukhuthazwa abashayei ukuba bacophelele futhi bahlele kahle izindlela zabo ukuze bangaphazamiseki.Amaphoyisa omgwaqo azobe ekhona ukuqapha isimo.
LUQALILE uhlelo lokunqanyulwa kwezinkontileka zezinkampani ebezinikezwe umsebenzi yisikhwama esibhekelele uxhaso lwezitshudeni, i-National Students Financial Scheme, wokuhlinzeka ngemali okukholakala ukuthi aziwenzanga ngendlela umsebenzi.Ngenyanga edlule uNgqongqoshe weMfundo ePhakeme nobuChwepheshe, uDkt Blade Nzimande, umemezele ukuhlakazwa kwebhodi elengamele lesi sikhwama, safakwa ngaphansi kweso lomlawuli emva kokuthi kube nezikhalo eziningi ezivele ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme nakwabamele izitshudeni ngokungahambi ngendlela kohlelo lokudluliselwa kwemali.Kuqokwe uMnuz Freeman Nomvalo njengomlawuli kulesi sikhwama, okuwumsebenzi azowenza izinyanga eziwu-12, okuyisikhathi esingavuselelwa uma kusenesidingo.Ekhuluma esithangamini nabezindaba ebesisePitoli ngoMsombuluko, okokuqala selokhu ephethe lesi sikhundla, uNomvalo uthe lesi sikhwama sithathe amagxathu abalulekile ukulandela izincomo zombiko wenkampani yabameli, iWerkmen Attorneys, owawucubungula iminxa isikhwama okumele sikhuphule amasokisi kuyo ekuphathweni kwaso."Phakathi kwezinto ezavela kulo mbiko, okuthiwa azihanjiswanga ngendlela, wukuqokwa kwezinkampani isikhwama esasizokhokha kuzo zona ziyidlulisele kwizitshudeni ezifake izicelo zoxhaso, okuyi-Ezaga Holidings, iCoinvest Africa, iNorraco Corporation neTenet Technologies. Ngiyajabula ukumemezela ukuthi ukunqanyulwa kwezinkontileka zalezi zinkampani sekuqalile namaphepha adingekayo asefakiwe enkantolo. Ukunqamula izinkontileka, iNsfas isebenzisane nabophiko oluphenya amacala abucayi, iSpecial Investigation Unit. Lapho kudingeka khona, sizovula amacala obugebengu,” usho kanjeUthe ukuqinisekisa ukuthi uhlelo lokukhokhelwa kwezitshudeni emanyuvesi aluphazamiseki, lesi sikhwama sinxuse wona amanyuvesi uqobo ukuthi alekelele kulolu hlelo lokuhlinzekwa kwezitshudeni ngezimfanelo kuze kube sekupheleni kukaJulayi kulo nyaka.Unxuse zonke izitshudeni, ezifake imininingwane yasebhange engaqondile ezithole umyalezo ozazisa ngalokho, ukuthi ziphinde zifake kabusha imininingwane yazo elungisiwe.Mayelana nezindawo ezihlala izitshudeni, uNomvalo unxuse bonke abanikazi bezindawo ezizimele abangakhokhelwe ukuthi babhalele lesi sikhwama kwi-email ethi [email protected] babike izikhalo zabo. Uthembise ukuthi ababhale manje bazokhokhelwa ngasekupheleni kwale nyanga kanti abasalile bazokhokhelwa maphakathi nenyanga ezayo.Uveze ukuthi izitshudeni ezifunda emakolishi, ezibhekelelwe ngaphansi kwalesi sikhwama, imali yazo iqale ukukhokhwa ngenyanga edlule, wanxusa lezo ezingakawafaki ama-akhawunti azo asemabhange ukuthi ziwafake ukuze zikhokhelwe. Uthe zingu-211 591 izitshudeni zasemakolishi eseziyitholile imali yazo kanti ezingu- 7 160 azikakayitholi ngenxa yezingqinamba ezehlukene kubalwa nalezo ezithinta imininingwane yasemabhange.
USIHLALO we-ANC ukhale ngepolitiki yobuhlanga asola ukuthi idlalwa uMkhonto weSizwe (MK) ukuwola amavoti KwaZulu-Natal.UMnuz Gwede Mantashe uphawule kanje eMidrand, eGoli ngoLwesine emini eqeda kutheleka esikhungweni semiphumela yokhetho.Ubekade ebuzwe intatheli yeziko lezindaba kwa-eNCA mayelana nemiphumela yokhetho yesikhashana ekhomba ukwehla kukaKhongolose eKZN kwadlondlobala i-MK eqengqeleza phambili."Uma umonakalo omkhulu uKwaZulu-Natal lokho kusho into ehlukile. Ukhomba ipolitiki yobuhlanga yamaZulu okungamele sizikhathaze ngayo. Lolu wuhlobo lwepolitiki olusibuyisela emuva futhi oselaphelelwa isikhathi,” kusho uMantashe.UManatashe uthe okwenzeka eKZN akumkhathazi uma kuwukuthi kunjengoba echaza.Nosihlalo we-Federal Council kwiDA, uNkk Helen Zille uhambe emazwini kaMantashe esola iMK ngepolitiki ehambisana nobuhlanga.Udalule ukuthi isizwe samaZulu singesikhulu futhi esinamandla wathi imiphumela yokhetho ikhombisa ukudlondlobala kweMK eKZN, eMpumalanga nasezingxenyeni zaseGauteng.Ukhale ngobubi balolu hlobo wepolitiki wathi abantu ababe besayibheka imigomo nezisekelo okwakhelwe kuzona iqembu bagxila ekutheni iqembu liphethwe umuntu wohlanga olufana nolwakhe.IMK ithi ibheke phambili ukulungisa umonakalo osuwenzekile kulelizwe nesikhathi esimoshekile. Ithi okunye ehlose ukukwenza, ukutholela abantu imisebenzi ukuze babuyelwe isithunzi nobuntu babo.Leli qembu lithi liphokophelele ukufukula osomabhizinisi abasathuthuka.
BAFUNA kubiywe ihostela ukuze kuphele ubugebengu abantu abebevota esikhungweni saKwaMashu ehostela njengoba bethi kulula ukuthi kungene noma wubani azolahla izidumbu.UMnuz Mhlonipheni Celemba Sibiya (39) owuSihlalo wesigceme esibizwa ngokuthi kuseMalondolo, ehostela KwaMashu, uthe baphume ngobuningi babo ukuyovota ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ihostela liyabiywa ukuze kunciphe ubugebengu."Sizovota ngoba sifuna kuphele imijondolo kwakhiwe izindlu ezizobuyisa isithunzi sabantu. Sifuna ihostela libiywe ngoba sesiye sifice izidumbu zilahliwe lapha kodwa okungesizo ezabantu abahlala lapha ehostela. Kusuka abantu kwezinye izindawo bazolahla izidumbu lapha. Amaphoyisa agcina esesola thina ngokuba yizigebengu,” kusho uSibiya.Uthe bayajabula ukuthi wonke umuntu ukhululekile ukuvota futhi namaphoyisa asiqaphe ngeso lokhozi isimo.UNksz Siphokazi Mtekwana (33) waseBhambayi eNanda, uthe uvuke ekuseni wayovota eNanda Comprehensive Secondary ngoba bafuna amanzi."Sidinga amanzi, asinawo kuyimanje sesiphila ngokuthwala izigubhu siyowalanda elolini eliwalethayo. Sizovota ukuze uhulumeni alungise ingqalasizinda yamanzi, sithole amanzi ahlanzekile. Siyayidinga nemisebenzi ngoba sihleli emakhaya asiqashiwe,” kusho uNksz Mtekwana.UNkk Lucy Mhlongo (72) ovote Ohlange, eNanda, uthe ufuna ivoti lakhe lisize uhulumeni ukuthi adale amathuba omsebenzi ngoba izingane zihleli emakhaya namajazi emfundo.Unxuse abaholi be-ANC athe uyilungu layo ukuba baqinisekise ukuthi akuqashwa ngokwenzelela kodwa kunikwa yonke intsha amathuba.UMnuz Sifiso Sithole obedlubhe ezeMK, uthe akangabazi ukuthi izoletha ushintsho ilwe nobugebengu obudla lubi eNanda.Okuphawulekayo wukuthi amalungu amaningi e-IFP abevota egqoke izikibha ezinemibala yeqembu lawo, kulandele awe-MK, awe-EFF nedlanzana le-ANC KwaMashu naseNanda.
KUBE yithuba eliyingqayizivele kwabadayisa ukudla nokokuphuza, kuvotwa eCato Crest eMayville, njengoba abantu bebemi kolayini abade belinde ukuvota.Nakuba kuthe kuphakama ilanga olayini sebekapakele ngaphandle ezikhungweni ezimbili okuvotelwa kuzo, esiseWiggins naseCato Crest, abantu babekezelele ilanga ebeliphumile, kodwa beyigcagcele esokeni kwabadayisa ukudla ngaphandle, kulezi zikhungo.UNksz Nosihle Mlotshwa obehla enyuka kolayini edayisa amajusi esikhungweni esingasemtapeni wolwazi eCato Crest, , exoxa neSolezwe, uthe lolu wusuku olumatasa njengoba akudayisayo kuthengwa ubuthaphuthaphu."Engifisa nje ukukubona ngevoti ukuthi kuthathe uhulumeni ozosinakekela singabadayisi basemgwaqweni. Sakhelwe amatafula anezindawo zokukhosela uma lina noma kushisa ngoba nathi siyalekelela emnothweni wezwe," usho kanje.Emigwaqweni egudla lezi zikhungo zokuvota, bekumiswe amatende amaqembu ezepolitiki ehlukene abesondelene kodwa kungekho ukungcofana ngaphandle nje kokuthi imisakazo beyiqhuma phezulu, umuntu edansela ingoma yeqembu alizwa ngaphakathi.Ukuvota akuqalanga ngesikhathi esibekiwe ezikhungweni eziningi esifundazweni kubalwa nalesi esiseCato Crest.Ilungu lesigungu esiphezulu kwi- ANC uDkt Sibongiseni Dhlomo, ojutshwe yinhlangano ukubheka ukuqhubeka kokhetho ezikhungweni zokuvota eziku-ward 101, eThekwini, uthe ukuqala emva kwesikhathi akuphazamisanga kangako uhlelo lokuvota."Ukuvota kuqale emuva kancane kwesikhathi esibekiwe ngenxa yokuthi bekunenkinga kweminye imishini yakwa- IEC, kodwa kuqhubeke kahle. Siyakuqaphela ukuthi mabili amaqembu akhombisa ukuba nesasasa okuyi- ANC ne-MK eyingane yethu okukhombisayo ukuthi ngaphambi kokuxebuka kwe- MK, besizidlela amahlanga, namanje noma isikhona, sizonqoba kule ward," usho kanje.
OMAKHELWANE bomholi weMK, uJacob Zuma, bathe ngeke bamlahle lo mholi njengoba bebethi bavotele iMK ngesikhathi kuvotwa.Abantu abavote esikhungweni okuvote kuso uZuma, esisesikoleni iNtolwane Primary, bathe ngeke bamlahle uZuma, sebehamba neMK.Kusukume nesinedolo ngesikhathi kufika uZuma esikhungweni sokuvota.Kuqhume umkikizo namakhwelo, kwama yonke into njengoba wonke umuntu ebefuna ukuzibonela uZuma.BEKUPHUME nesinedolo abantu baseNkandla beyovota okhethweni lukazwelonke nezifundazwe izolo eNtolwane Primary Isithombe: Doctor Ngcobo/Independent NewspapersUZuma akazange athathe isikhathi eside evota.Ubelokhu encokola nabavotisayo ngesikhathi kubhekwa igama lakhe ohlwini lwabazovota.Ngesikhathi enikwa amaphepha okuvota ufune ukwazi ukuthi iqembu 'lakubo' likhona yini ohlwini lwamaqembu azovotelwa.KUQHUME umkikizo kufika umholi weMK uJacob Zuma eyovota esikoleni eNtolwane Primary, KwaNxamalala eNkandla izolo Isithombe: Doctor Ngcobo/Independent NewspapersUkhombise ukujabula ngesikhathi ebona iqembu abelifuna, wabe esethi sekuphelele konke.Emva kwalokho usuke wayovota, wabe esephuma eyobingelela amalungu eMK abehlezi etendeni, ebelingaphandle kwesikhungo.Kuleli tende bekuqhuma ingoma evala izindlebe.UZuma ubonge abantu abebemjabulela, wazwakalisa ithemba lokuthi bazolunqoba ukhetho.Ube esehamba emva kwalokho.Abantu abebejabulela uZuma bathe sebehamba neMK.Bathe bayakholelwa ebuholini bukaZuma, bathi sebelahle ithemba kwi-ANC.Abanye babo bathe bafuna ukujezisa uMengameli, Cyril Ramaphosa, abamsola ngokubahlukumeza ngesikhathi kubhoke ubhubhane iCorona.UMnuz Funukwazi Ndlovu, uthe uyamethemba uZuma."Sihamba naye, ngoba igalelo lakhe silibonile ngesikhathi esaphethe. Abantu abaningi baphumelele ngesikhathi kusaphethe yena. Baningi abantu abaphumelela lapha endaweni ngesikhathi kusaphethe yena. Wayewusizo kakhulu. Wayengakhethi bala, wayengabuzi ukuthi uqhamuka kuyiphi inhlangano. Wayekusiza noma ingani uma usufikile kwakhe.”UNdlovu uthe ufisa ukuthi uZuma athuthukise indawo yangakubo uma enqoba ukhetho."Ngifuna ukuthi kungabi khona izinto esizokhala ngazo. Sisakhala kakhulu ngamathuba emisebenzi. Izingane zifundile, zagogoda, kodwa aziyitholi imisebenzi. Nathi esinamakhono, ayikho indlela esixhaseka ngayo ukuze sithuthukise amakhono ethu.”UNdlovu uthe isasasa elikhona ngeMK ilona elimsukumise phansi."Bengithi angizukuvota, kodwa ke ngokubuka isasasa, ngithe angiye kovota.”UNkk Dalekile Biyela uthe ufuna ukuthi uZuma aphinde aphathe."Sihamba nomuntu walapha endaweni ngoba siyamazi, sakhula naye. Uyazazi izidingo zethu. Ngeke asilahle.”Uthe ufisa ukuthi uhulumeni ubakhele izindlu."Sihlala ezindlini zodaka. Akulungile ukuthi silale phandle. Akufuneki ukuthi sifele ezindlini zodaka.”UNksz Biyela uthe ukhetho alukaze lumphuthe selokhu abantu abamnyama bavunyelwa ukuvota."Selokhu saqala ukuvota kusavotelwa uMandela. Namanje asisaboni nakahle, kodwa ngiyavota ngoba ngiyaye ngithande ukuthi uvo lwami luzwakale.”UNksz Nokwanda Ntombela uthe akajabule ngohulumeni ophethe."Sahlukumezeka kakhulu ngesikhathi seCorona. Kwakushaywa imithetho esicindezelayo. Baningi abantu abalahlekelwa imisebenzi, kwavalwa amafemu. Kuyimanje asisebenzi.”UNksz Ntombela uthe kuningi okwenziwa uZuma esaphethe."Asikaze sihlupheke kanje ngesikhathi kusaphethe uZuma. Abantu babesebenza, futhi ziningi izinhlelo zentuthuko ezazilethwa uhulumeni.”
AMEHLO athe njo emiphumeleni yokhetho lwezifundazwe nolukazwelonke elindwe ngabomvu engena ilekanyana njengoba kuqhubeka umshikashika wokubalwa kwamavoti.Le miphumela kulindeleke ukuthi kushone ilanga ngeSonto sekwaziwa ukuthi iliphi iqembu noma inhlangano edle umhlanganiso kulolu khetho obelunesasa kubantu bakuleli.UMENGAMELI Cyril Ramaphosa obephelezelwa owakwakhe uDkt Tshepo Motsepe bavote esikhungweni iHitekani Primary, eChiawelo, eSoweto Isithombe:Jairus Mmutle/GCIS Lolu khetho luqale ngebatha kwezinye izindawo njengoba kube nezinkinga zokuphuza ukuvula kwezinye izikhungo zokuvota ngenxa yemibhikisho yomphakathi.Ngaphandle kokuphuza ukuvula kwezikhungo kuze kwavalwa kwezinye kusenamahele kalayini kukhalwa ngemishini yokubheka ababhalisile ebinobuhixihixi.Abantu abaningi kubalwa nabaholi bamaqembu ezepolitiki bakhale ngokuthi inkinga edale olayini abade, ukungasebenzi kwemishini nokudinge ukuthi kusetshenziswe uhlelo lokubheka ephepheni abavoti. Kwezinye izikhungo kubambezeleke ukufika kwezinsiza zokuvota ngenxa yokuthi abengekho amaphoyisa abezophelezela abasebenzi bekhomishini yezokhetho ukuzihambisa.UMHOLI we-DA uMnuz John Steenhuisen ushaye u-X wakhe esikhungweni iNorthwood High eThekwini Isithombe:DA/XNgaphandle kwalezi zinkinga azikho izehlakalo ezimise noma eziphazamise ukhetho njengoba lapho obekunezinkinga khona, amaphoyisa engenelele axazulula isimo. UMHOLI we-IFP uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa ovote eMthekelezi Primary, KwaHlabisa Isithombe:FACEBOOKKubikwe ukuthi zibalelwa ku-20 izikhungo zaKwaZulu-Natal, ezivule sesidlulile isikhathi.Lokhu kuvezwe nguMnuz Masego Sheburi, iphini lesikhulu esiphezulu seKhomishini yezoKhetho, ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba ngokuthi luqale kanjani usuku lokuvota.UMHOLI we-EFF uMnuz Julius Malema ovote ngemuva kokuma kulayini amahora amane eSeshego Isithombe:XUSheburi uthe e-Eastern Cape, zinhlanu izikhungo zokuvota eziphuzile ukuvulwa ngenxa yemibhikisho yomphakathi."EThekwini zingu-20 izikhungo eziphuzile ukuvulwa ngenxa yemibhikisho yomphakathi. Kube nokubambezeleka kwezinye izikhungo ngenxa yokuthi amaphoyisa abengekho ukuphelezela abasebenzi bekhomishini ukuhambisa izinsiza zokuvota.”Ubale izindawo ezehlukene okubalwa eThekwini, uThukela, Mtubatuba, Ugu, uMzumbe naseBuhlebezwe lapho bekulindeke ukuthi amaphoyisa aphelezele abasebenzi.USheburi uvumile ukuthi le mishini ibe nezinkinga kwezinye izikhungo okubambezele uhlelo kwaba nolayini abade. Nesikhulu esiphezulu seKhomishini uMnuz Sy Mamabolo, ekhuluma nabezindaba ekomkhulu lemiphumela izolo ebusuku, uthe bayixazululile inkinga yolayini abade ezikhungweni zokuvota."Imishini ayisona isidingo esidingwa ngumthetho ezikhungweni zokuvota, into edingekayo wumqulu wokuvota. Yingakho silande abasebenzi abebezobala ukuthi bazofaka isandla enkingeni yolayini abade, sayalela ukuthi kusetshenziswe umqulu wokuvota ukubheka amagama abavoti.”USheburi uveze ukuthi kube nesasasa kulolu khetho njengoba ngabo-11 ebusuku abantu abaningi bese bevotile."Kube nesasasa kakhulu uma kuqhathaniswa nezikhathi ezidlule zokhetho. Baningi abantu abaphumile bayovota noma okwamanje singeke siveze ukuthi bangakanani. Kwenzeke lokhu ebesikulindele njengoba bengu-27.79 million abantu ababhalisela ukuvota.”Ubalule ukuthi abanye abakwazanga ukuvota lapho bengahlali khona ngenxa yokuthi kwashintshwa umthetho ophoqa ukuthi uvote kuphela lapho uhlala khona.UMamabolo uthe bebengeke balule izinsuku zokuvota ngoba ayikho indawo engagcina izigidi zamaphepha asesebenzile kuvotwa.Usihlalo wekhomishini uMnuz Mosotho Moepya, ukhale ngabanye babaholi bamaqembu abaphazamise ukhetho.Umengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, uncome umsebenzi weKhomishini wathi akubanga nokuphazamiseka okukhulu kulolu khetho.Ugxeke abavimbe abanye ukuyovota wathi noma kunezikhalo akumele kuvinjwe abantu ukuyovota.Usho lokhu emuva kokuvota esikoleni iHitekani Primary, eChiawelo, eSoweto.Ubalule ukuthi uyazi abezomthetho bazoqapha isimo kuze kumenyezelwe imiphumela.Uveze ukuthi unethemba lokuthi abantu bazophinde bayinike elinye ithuba i-ANC.Umholi we-EFF uMnuz Julius Malema, ovote nowakwakhe uNkk Mantoa Malema eSeshego, ume kulayini amahora amane ngaphambi kokuvota.Uthe ubone kunesidingo sokuthi angajombi abanye abavoti kodwa abambe ulayini, ezwe lokhu abahlale bekuzwa abanye."Uhlelo lokuvota luhambe kancane ngenxa yemishini ebingasebenzi. Ngeke sigxeke iKhomishini ngoba ayihlinzeki nge-network, kodwa uhulumeni okumele uhlinzeke nge-network. Ayikho into ehlale i-100% empilweni ngakho asikhali.”
LIGUQE kungasekuhle icala lokufa kukaSenzo Meyiwa ngesikhathi iJaji uRatha Mokgoatleng lithuthana nommeli u-Advocate uThulani Mngomezulu obelisola ngobuqili. UMeyiwa owayengunozinti we-Orlando Pirates neBafana Bafana, wadutshulwa wabulawa ekubo kwentombi yakhe uKelly Khumalo eVosloorus, eGauteng, ngo-2014. Bahlanu abalisa abashushiswayo okuthiwa banikwa itoho lokujuqa uMeyiwa.Icala lisesigabeni lapho uMbuso ubiza khona ofakazi bawo bese bephekwa ngemibuzo abameli babamangalelwa uma beqeda. UMngomezulu ubepheka ngemibuzo ufakazi oyiphoyisa uConstable uJabulani Buthelezi ngesikhathi kusuka ingxabano.Bekubangwa indaba yokuthi mangaki amaselula atholakala kummangalelwa wokuqala uMuzikawukhulewa Sibiya ngesikhathi eboshwa. UMngomezulu uze wathi uzofaka isikhalo ngejaji athe alihambisi kahle izinto uma lisingethe udaba. Uthe uselinake izikhawu linakho ukuvuna uMbuso."Impela Nkosi yeNkanto ngisho njalo futhi ngimile emazwini ami. Kumanje ngilungisa isicelo ngaphansi komthetho u-317,’’ kusho uMngomezulu ebhoka.UMngomezulu uthe ijaji liyathanda ukugxambukela futhi lihlangene noMbuso benza ubuqili. Kusuke isidumo esinamathambo emuva kwalokho, ijaji kwathi alimqede."Ungisola ngobuqili manje, ngihlangene kanjani noMbuso mina? Ungasebenzisi amagama ongeke uwamele, ungalokothi ngoba nginelungelo lokukumangalela. Kungenzeka awuqondi kahle umthetho. Ungehlisa isithunzi ungibeka izinsolo,’’ kusho ijaji.Emuva kwalokho, kube sengathi kuyedlulwa odabeni kwayiwa ekhefini lesidlo sasemini nokuthe uma kubuywa ijaji laqala phansi labhoka liqhuba lolu daba, ijaji lakhipha izichazamazwi ezintathu kwafunwa incazelo yegama elisetshenziswe wummeli.Ijaji lifunde izincazelo ebeziveza ukuthi leli gama lichaza ukuhlangana ngobuqili. Ijaji laqhubeka labhoka lisho nokuthi selibikele abaphathi balo.UMngomezulu ugcine esexolisa ethi uyawahoxisa amazwi akhe kodwa kwabonakala ukuthi ijaji belisadiniwe ngesikhathi kuguqa icala. Kuvunyelwane ngokuthi icala liguqele uMsombuluko. UMbuso uthe namuhla yiholidi kanti kusasa nangoLwesihlanu abekho ofakazi abazofika.

ULAXAZE isikhundla oyisihlobo sowayengumengameli, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, ngemva kokusolwa ngokushendeza neMK ekubeni eyikhansela le-ANC.UMnuz Malunga Sabelo, usulile ekubeni yikhansela kuMasipala iRay Nkonyeni, ngemva kwamahlebezi okuthi uhamba imihlangano yeMK.Kuthiwa bese kunesikhathi eside uSabelo ehlezi ngesinqe esisodwa esikhundleni sakhe. Kuthiwa okumqhathe kakhulu nobuholi be-ANC, ukuvakashelwa kwakhe nguZuma, okwenzeke ngasekuqaleni kwenyanga.Ekhuluma neSolezwe, uSabelo uthe usule ngemva kokuqonga kwezinkulumo ezithi uzoxoshwa.USabelo uphawule kanje:"Ngaqale ngezwa izindaba zokuthi kunobuholi obebuhlangane bodwa, bukhuluma indaba yokuthi ngizoxoshwa ngoba ngizalana, noma ngihlobene noZuma. Ithe uma indaba isiningi kakhulu, ngabe sengizama ukubikela abanye abaholi. Ngangikhala ngokuthi akungakhulunywa ngegama lami ngingekho, angibizwe nami ngizoziphendulela. Nokho abazange bangibize. Nami ngigcine sengizibona ngingaphephile.”USabelo bahlobene kabili noZuma, ngezibongo uMavundla noMzobe. Ukuphikile ukuthi uhamba imihlangano yeMK, wathi ukuvakasha kukaZuma emzini wakhe kwakungahlangene nepolitiki.Echaza ngokuvakashelwa nguZuma uthe:"Ubevakashe elandela indaba yobuhlobo. Kwakuyinto yomndeni. Wafika emzini wami, sabe sesidlulela enkosini yakwaMavundla, lapho kusuka khona ubuhlobo bethu.”USabelo uthe ngeke avume ukuthi kube nabantu abazomkhethela ukuthi axhumane naziphi izihlobo zakhe."Ngeke ngivume ukushayelwa umthetho yibona. Akufanele basole mina, ngoba nami angizikhethelanga ukuhlobana noZuma. Kufanele basole uNkulunkulu ngoba uyena okhethayo ukuthi ngubani uzohlobana nobani.”USabelo uthe ubevele engahleli kahle ebukhanseleni. "Ngike ngazama ukwesula esikhundleni ingakabi khona iMK ngenxa yokuthi kwakukhona izinto engangikhala ngazo. Ubuholi besifunda bathi angingasuli, bathi bazozilungisa izinto engangikhala ngazo. Abazange bazilungise lezo zinto.”USabelo uthe ngeke ashiye kwi-ANC.Unobhala we-ANC esifundeni iTolomane Mnyayiza, uMnuz Xolani Luthuli, uthe uSabelo usule ngemva kokubanjwa esemhlanganweni weMK."Ubevele azi ukuthi uzoxoshwa ngoba bese kunezithombe zakhe esemihlanganweni yeMK. Abantu bebelokhu besho ukuthi lo muntu usebenzela iMK. Usemane uyayisho nje leyo buhlobo noZuma kodwa iqiniso lithi uke wazama ukwesula ngaphambilini.”Ukwesula kukaSabelo kusho ukuthi kuzokuba nokhetho lokuchibiyela kuWard 14. I-ANC ijwayele ukungenzi kahle okhethweni lokuchibiyela KwaZulu-Natal.ULuthuli uthe balulindele ukhetho lokuchibiyela.

BAKHALELWE amasongo kaSigonyela abantu abathathu okusolwa ukuthi basabise owesifazane bemphoqa ukuthi avotele liphi iqembu lezepolitiki.Abasolwa abaneminyaka ephakathi kuka-48 no-55 kulindeleke ukuthi bavele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseRitavi ngoLwesine.Amaphoyisa athi ngoLwesibili babikelwe owesifazane okuthiwa ufike esikhungweni sokuvota esikoleni iXibukulwana Secondary, eRunnymede, eyovota.Kusolakala ukuthi kuqhamuke abesifazane ababili nowesilisa abambuze ukuthi uzovotela yiphi inhlangano yepolitiki.Kubikwa ukuthi lo wesifazane ube esebatshela ukuthi ivoti lomuntu liyimfihlo.Kusolwa ukuthi laba abathathu bavele bamsabisa bamyalela ukuthi avotele liphi iqembu ngoba uma engakwenzi lokho, uzobe ebeka impilo yakhe engcupheni.Okhulumela amaphoyisa eLimpopo, uBrigadier Hlumani Mashaba, uthe umgilwa ube esebika udaba lwakhe kubasebenzi bekhomishini yokhetho i-IEC, ababe sebebikela amaphoyisa.UMkhuzi wamaPhoyisa eLimpopo, uLieutenant General Thembi Hadebe, uthe ukuboshwa kwalaba abathathu kungeminye yemizamo yabo yokulwa nodlame nokuqinisa ezokuphepha ngalesi sikhathi sokhetho.
KUVUNGUZA umoya wokuthula nozwano phakathi kwabantu baseMzumbe, abavota ezikhungweni ezehlukene endaweni.Zivulwe ngesikhathi esifanele izikhungo zokuvota endaweni kanti akubikwanga zihibe. Phakathi kwabantu abebezovota bekuxubene abadala nabancane. Bebehleli izixukwana ngaphandle kwezikhungo abanye bebambe imigqa belinde ukungena ngaphakathi ukuze bavote.Kuzo zonke izikhungo bekubonakala amaphoyisa ahlomile eqaphe isimo futhi ehla enyuka ngaphandle nangaphakathi ezikhungweni. Yize bekunabantu bamaqembu ahlukene kodwa bebehleli ngokuzwana bedansa bexoxa.Amanye amalungu omphakathi athe avuke ngovivi ezilungiselela ukuvota, abelubheke ngabomvu usuku lokuvota. Bathe banezikhalo ngentuthuko ikakhulu amanzi namathuba emisebenzi. Kukhona abakhononde ngokuthi amanzi aphuma kanye emuva kwesikhathi eside futhi namaloli athwala amanzi awafiki.Abanye bathe bahleli nezingane ezifundile emakhaya kodwa aziqashiwe. Bathe kukhona abake bakubona phambilini okuyizindlu nogesi kodwa kusashoda.Kulindeleke ukuthi ukuvota ezikhungweni kuqhubeke kuze kushaye u-9 ebusuku uma sekuvalwa izikhungo.
UMENGAMELI Cyril Ramaphosa usenxuse abantu ukuthi bangavinjwa uma befuna ukuyosebenzisa ilungelo labo lokuvota noma kunezikhalazo emphakathini.URamaphosa okhulume kanje emuva kokuvota esikoleni iHitekani Primary, eChiawelo, eSoweto, uthe uthemba ukuthi abezomthetho bazoqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bayakwazi ukuvota.
