Ngethemba ukuthi konke kuzohamba kahle ezweni lonke njengoba kuqhubeka ukuvota kuze kuvalwe izikhungo," kusho uRamaphosa obehamba nowakwakhe uDkt Tshepo Motsepe.UMENGAMELI Cyril Ramaphosa obehambisana nowakwakhe uDkt Tshepo Motsepe esikhungweni sokuvota iHitekani Primary, eChiawelo, eSoweto Isithombe:GCIS Uveze ukuthi unethemba lokuthi abantu bazophinde bayinike elinye ithuba i-ANC.Usho lokhu nje kwezinye izindawo okubalwa nase-Eastern Cape kunemibhikisho eqhubekayo abantu abangeneme ngokugqoza kwezidingo.Abanye babaholi bamaqembu ahlukene ezepolitiki bahlabe ikhwelo elifanayo lokuthi abantu abaphume bayovota. UMnuz Masego Sheburi, iphini lesikhulu esiphezulu seKhomishini yezoKhetho, utshele isiteshi sethelevishini ukuthi iningi labavoti liphuma ekuseni ukuyovota.Uthe ngokwemibiko abayitholile zimbalwa izehlakalo zokuphazamiseka kokuvota abebesabikelwa ngazo.Uhlabe ikhwelo kubantu ukuthi baphume bayovota njengoba izikhungo zivalwa ngo-9 ebusuku.Okunye okubaluliwe ngukuthi uma wenze iphutha ngesikhathi uvota, uyakwazi ukucela elinye iphepha lokuvota uphinde uvote.Kuchithwe njengamampunge ukuthi abesifazane abapende izinzipho abavunyelwe ukuvota njengoba kuxikizwa isithupha sabo ngo-inki.Laba okuzoshaya u-9 ebusuku besami kolayini ezikhungweni zokuvota bazovunyelwa ukuthi bavote baze baphele bonke kulayini.
SELUZE lwafika usuku lwesinqumo lapho abantu bethola khona ithuba lokukhetha uhulumeni ozobabusa eminyakeni emihlanu ezayo. Ukhetho lwalo nyaka belulindwe ngabomvu futhi luthathwa njengoluzokwehluka kakhulu.Bangu-27 million abantu bakuleli ababhalisele ukuvota kanti lesi sibalo sinyukile sisuka ku-26 million wango-2019. Angu-70 amaqembu angenele ukhetho kanti bangu-11 abangenele ukhetho ngokuzimela.Kulindeleke ukuthi abantu bakuleli baphume ngobuningi babo beyovota ezikhungweni okulindeleke ukuthi zivulwe ngo-7 ekuseni zivalwe ngo-9 ebusuku. Usuku lokuvota lumenyezelwe njengeholidi ukuze abantu bathole ithuba elanele lokuyovota.Isikhulu se-IEC kuzwelonke uMnuz Masego Sheburi, sithe kuqale kahle ukuvotisa labo abebefake izicelo zokuvota ngokukhethekile. Abavota ngokukhethekile baqale ngoMsombuluko kwaqhubeka nayizolo.USheburi uthe zincane kakhulu izinkinga ezibikiwe futhi bakwazile ukuzisukumela bazilungisa ngokushesha."Kuqale kahle kakhulu ukuvota, besinezikhungo ezingu-666 ebezingenabo abavota ngokukhethekile. Ezinye izikhungo bezivotisa abantu ngokukhethekile. Sike saba nezinkinga eMthatha nasePort St Johns kodwa sengeza abasebenzi kwalunga,’’ kusho uSheburi.Uthe kunabantu abakhononde ngokuthi abakwazanga ukuvota ngokukhethekile ngenxa ygezizathu ezehlukene kodwa bakwazile ukusiza izolo. Uthe kukhona abasebenzi babo abahambele ubala emakhaya bengasabafici ababhalisele ukuvota ngokukhethekile.Uthe sekuwumsebenzi wabo labo bavoti ukuziyela ezikhungweni bayovota nawowonke umuntu ngeke bachithwe. Uthinte nodaba lwabakhubazekile abangaboni wathi banalo uhlelo lokubasiza.Uthe nalabo abanenkinga yedumbe ezandleni bazothola usizo bakwazi ukuvota ngendlela enesithunzi nokuhlonipha ilungelo labo. Abe-Commission for Gender Equality bathe bazobe bekhona ezikhungweni beqaphile ukuthi amalungelo abantu athinta ubulili ayahlonishwa yini kungabibikho abacwaswayo.Bathe bafuna ukubona kubekwa eqhulwini abakhulelwe, abadala, abakhubazekile nabaphethe izingane ezincane kakhulu.Kulindeleke ukuthi umuntu oyovota aphathe umazisi wakhe oyikhadi noma omdala oyibhukwana onamagabelo. Okunye okugcizelelwayo wukuthi umuntu uzovunyelwa ukuvota esikhungweni ayebhalise kusona.Umuntu ozokwazi ukuvota kwesinye isikhungo angabhalisanga kusona yilowo owayesifakile isicelo salokho kusenesikhathi. Umuntu uma evota uzonikwa amaphepha amathathu okuvota okulindeleke ukuthi avote kuwowonke ngalinye.Abe-IEC bazokhipha imiphumela yokhetho ngokusemthethweni ngeSonto kodwa ngaphambi kwalokho izobe ibonakala esikhungweni semiphumela, ilokhu ingena.Kulindeleke ukuthi izingqapheli zokhetho nezithunywe amaqembu ziluqaphe ngeso lokhozi ukhetho.

UTHOKOZANI NDLOVU uxoxe nale ntokazi ukuthola ukuthi iphatheka kanjani ngoshintsho empilweni yayo nangomuzwa wayo ngokhetho lwalo nyaka.THOKOZANI NDLOVU (TN): Ngabe likhona iqembu lepolitiki ogcine uthathe isinqumo sokuthi uzolivotela, kungani ukhethe lona?THEMBEKA DLIWAKO (TD):Yebo likhona iqembu engizolivotela. Noma ngingeke ngilidalule kodwa izithembiso zalo zikhombise ukugxila kakhulu ekunakekeleni thina njengabafundi njengoba ziziningi izinkinga esibhekene nazo nokuvula amathuba omsebenzi. TN: Kukhona ongakuphawula ngemikhankaso eqhubekayo yamaqembu epolitiki?TD: Engikuqaphelile ukuthi inselelo ibe nkulu kakhulu emaqenjini epolitiki njengoba wonke ekhombise ukuzimisela efuna ukunqoba ukhetho.TN:Uveze ukuthi iqembu ozolivotela liqhakambise ukuthi lizoninakekela njengabafundi, kukhona ongakuveza obona ukuthi aninakekelwe kukho njengabafundi?TD: Ngikhuluma nawe nje kuvele kwavaleka imali yethu yeNSFAS sangakwazi nokuthenga ukudla esikoleni. Okubuhlungu akukho esitshelwa khona ngokuthi kwenzekeni.TN:Usuhambe izindawo eziningi ngenxa yamaqembu epolitiki, ngabe amaqembu abezikhokhela izindleko zakho zokuya kwimihlahlandlela yokhetho?TD:Ngiqale ngeza ngamabhasi amahhala abesuke ehlelwe ukuthi athuthe abantu ebayisa kwimihlahlandlela, kodwa muva kushintshile lokho. Amaqembu abengiyisa emicimbini yawo ngokukhethekile engigibelisa ngisho nebhanoyi okuyinto engiqale ukuyigibela ngawo, ngiphinde ngibhukhelwe nendawo yokulala, kanti nasemicimbini bengiba yingxenye yezicukuthwane. Akugcinanga lapho njengoba kugcine sekuba nemali engiholelwa yona ngokuza emicimbini yawo.TN:Ezintweni ezithenjiswe amaqembu yikuphi okukuchaze kakhulu kuwona ethula imihlahlandlela yokhetho?TD: Iningi lawo belikhuluma into ecishe ifane kodwa obekugqama ukuthi wonke athembisa amathuba omsebenzi ukunyusa imali yezibonelelo nohlelo lwabafundi baka-matric abazoqeqeshwa ukuze baqasheke.TN:Uzovotela kuphi?TD: Ngizovotela eMnambithi lapho ngibhalise khona.TN: Njengoba usudumile unjani umuzwa wakho ngodumo?TD: Ngizizwa ngijabule kakhulu kodwa ekuqaleni benginokwesaba ngoba ngiqale ngahlekwa. Okunye ukuthi sekunzima ukuphila impilo ngokukhululeka ngenxa yokwaziwa. Yonke indawo lapho ngiqhamuka khona abantu bayangijabulela bafune nokushutha nami ngigcine ngingakwazanga ukwenza engisuke ngifuna ukukwenza.TN:Njengoba kudlula ukhetho zithini izinhlelo ngempilo yakho?TD:Ukuzibandakanya namaqembu epolitiki kuveze okunye ngempilo yami ngathola ukuthi nginekhono lokuphatha uhlelo emicimbini. Emva kokhetho ngizogxila ekuphatheini izinhlelo emicimbini. Kumanje ukhona umcimbi kamaskandi ozoba ngoJuni 16 engizobe ngiphethe kuwona.TN: Uhambile kakhulu namaqembu epolitiki, uyazibona ungusopolitiki ngelinye ilanga?TD:Noma ikanjani futhi ngingakujabulela ukuba wusopolitiki ngelinye ilanga, futhi yinto engiyifuna kakhulu.TN: Izikibha zamaqembu ehlukene obuzigqoka emicimbini ehlukene uzozigcina noma uzozishisa?TD: Ngeke ngizishise ngizozigcina. Zizohlala ziyisikhumbuzo ngomlando wami nepolitiki. Ngisho sengimdala ngiyafisa ukuzikhombisa abantwana bami babone ukuthi ngaduma ngenxa yazo. Okunye ukuthi impahla ayishiswa.TN: Uzobe uqala ukuvota? Ungathini kubantu abathi ngeke bavote?TD: Yebo ngizobe ngiqala. Kubantu ngithi abaphume bayovotela amaqembu abawathandayo. Ukungavoti kwabo kuzobe kusho ukuthi abalufuni ushintsho, kuzokwenzeka izinto abangazithandi bangabi nendawo abazokhala kuyona.Yize elifihlile iqembu azolivotela uThembeka kodwa emva kwayo yonke imihlahlandlela ugcine esebonakala eziyamanisa kakhulu ne-Action SA. Nogaqele esikaNdunankulu wakwaZulu-Natal kwi-Action SA, uZwakele Mncwango uyabonakala esebenzisana noNomaRally ezintweni eziningi zaleli qembu.
SIKHULU isililo ngokubulawa kwenyanga yaseMlaza, uMnuz Nhlanhla "Sibushebushe" Cele, obese esinde izikhawu bemhlasela.UCele wazakhela udumo olukhulu ngembiza esiza amadoda ekamelweni, iSibushebushe.Ukuduma kwale mbiza kaCele yikhona okwadala ukuthi naye agcine esebizwa ngoSibushebushe.Udutshulwe izinhlamvu eziyisithupha ekhanda esendaweni yakhe yokudayisa utshwala iYellow Lounge, eMlaza.Kuvela ukuthi wehle emotweni kwase kuqhamuka amadoda amathathu avulela ngenhlamvu ebhekise kuyena, amdubula ekhanda nasesifubeni.Abahlaseli kuvela ukuthi bathathe nemali yakhe ebilinganiselwa ku-R40 000.Uphuthunyiswe esibhedlela eMshiyeni nokuyilapho ashonele khona.Ngonyaka owedlule, bamhlasela bamdubula ngentululwane yezinhlamvu kodwa wasinda, wayolala esibhedlela.Kuvela ukuthi nakulo nyaka bazamile ukumdubula nakhona baphinde behluleka.Izolo, amalungu ebandla abekade elihola, iDwala Lokuphila, abeseqalile ukuthutheleka kubo kwa-A, eMlaza, ezobhonga emswaneni.Okuqaphelekile ukuthi sikhulu isililo kumalungu alo ngokubulawa kukaCele.Abelimisa ngesihloko elokuthi afe olwembiza achaza uCele njengomholi obeqotho ebandleni eqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinto zihamba kahle. Ibandla abelihola linamagatsha kusona sonke isifundazwe.Umfowabo kamufi, uMnuz Thembile Cele, uthe badunguza ebumnyameni ngokuthi ngabe obani abambulele. Uthe bagqemeke engeqiwa ntwala.Uthe bakhathazekile ngokuthi ubani lo obelandela umfowabo kangaka.UCele ubedume kakhulu ngeziphrofetho zakhe ebezishaya emhlolweni. Abantu abaningi bebejwayele ukufika kwakhe bezokwenza imhlahlo njengoba ebedume ngokungashayi eceleni, egagula abantu ngamagama.Eminyakeni eyedlule, kwavela udaba lomunye umndeni ayekade ecuphe kuwona ithuna kwasa ngakusasa kubanjwe umkhunkuli.Ngaphandle kwendawo iYellow Lounge, ubephinde abe nezindlu zokuqashisa. Kuwona wonke amabhizinisi akhe balinganiselwa ku-100 abasebenzi abebaqashile. Ubenesithabathaba somuzi esikwa-Q, eMlaza.Ubengakufihli ukuthi uzifela kangakanani ngeqembu i-Inkatha Freedom Party (IFP).Waduma kakhulu nangesikhathi enze umngcwabo wenkawu yakhe, u-2 Pool ayekade eduma ngokuhlezi ehamba nayo.Njalo ngoDisemba ubethengela imindeni engu-100 igilosa yokudla. Wayevamise ukuzwakala kakhulu oKhozini nasemsakazweni Izwi LoMzansi.Ubenenqwaba yezimoto abebuye ezisebenzisele ukuhambisa amalungu ebandla lakhe.Kune-prank call ayenziwa nguKini Shandu lapho okwakuzwakala khona uCele emsabisa ngokuthi uzomthumelela ngezulu.Kwake kwabhalwa nodaba ngowesilisa waseThekwini okuthiwa wayekhala ezimathonsi ngokuthi wathenga umvusankunzi iSibushebushe kuCele, induku yakhe yama unomphele. Kuthiwa lo wesilisa wayeseze washiywa wunkosikazi wakhe ngoba wayekhala ngomyeni wakhe owayesefuna ucansi zonke izinsuku nenduku ingawi.Kwesinye isigameko, uCele wake wathukana nomkhwekazi wakhe bebanga ukuthi umkhwekazi umphuce indodakazi yakhe. Kuthiwa umkhwekazi wafika emzini kaCele wathatha indodakazi yakhe nomzukulu wabaleka nabo uCele engekho.Ushona nje, bekunecala abelihamba ebophe yena umkhwekazi wakhe efuna inhlawulo ka-R600 000. Kulelo cala waxosha ummeli wakhe isigubhukane ekhala ngokuthi wenza kancane.Endaweni yakhe iYellow Lounge wake wasungula umcimbi wabesifazane abebedansela amakhasimende akhe benqunu njalo uma kunguLwesihlanu ebusuku. Kwakufika ngisho nabefundisi bephulula izinqe zamantombzane. Kwakuba uyena uCele owayebuye apotshozele abantu ukuthi abamaphi amabandla labo bafundisi.Amaphoyisa abengakayiphenduli imibuzo athunyelelwe yona ngalolu daba.
KUMISWE amaphoyisa amabili abeyingxenye yezoqapha ukhetho, njengoba ezobhekana nokuqondiswa ubugwegwe ngenxa yokuziphatha kwawo.UMkhuzi wamaPhoyisa kwaZulu-Natal uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi ukhiphe umyalelo wokuthi kuthathelwe amaphoyisa amabili izinyathelo, ngokubonakala ephula umthetho wamaphoyisa ngendlela aziphathe ngayo nokwehlisa isithunzi samaphoyisa.Amaphoyisa asolwayo kuthiwa abonakale kwi-video egqoke umfaniswano wamaphoyisa, ehamba ngemoto yamaphoyisa yaseSundumbili, ethatha uzakwabo obengekho emsebenzini esikhungweni sokuvota egqoke nomfaniswano weqembu lepolitiki.Lokho kuholele ekutheni uMkhwanazi ayalele ukuthi lamaphoyisa asuswe ngokushesha ohlwini lwamaphoyisa aqaphe ukhetho. Uthe amaphoyisa kumele aziphathise okwamaphoyisa ngaso sonke isikhathi ahloniphe nesifungo angaphansi kwaso njengombutho wamaphoyisa aseNingizimu Afrika. "Sengikusho izikhathi eziningana lapha kwaZulu-Natal ukuthi amaphoyisa awaziphathise okwamaphoyisa ayekele ipolitiki kosopolitiki. Ngihlala ngikusho futhi ukuthi amaphoyisa angakhankaseli amaqembu epolitiki. Okwenziwe yila maphoyisa akwamukelekile futhi ukuziphatha kwawo kuwukubukela phansi umsebenzi osuwenziwe wokuqinisekisa ukuthi sibe nokhetho olukhululekile noluphephile. Uthe lamaphoyisa azoquliswa ngaphakathi emaphoyiseni ngokuziphatha kwawo,” kusho uLieutenant General Mkhwanazi.Amaphoyisa anxuswa ukuthi aphathe wonke amaqembu epolitiki ngokufana nangenhlonipho. Kuthiwa amaqembu awabike konke akubona kungahambi kahle emaphoyiseni futhi akekho ongaphezu komthetho. Amaphoyisa aphambana nomthetho kuthiwa kuthiwa azobhekana nemiphumela yomsebenzi wawo.
UCWANINGO lwakamuva lweStatsSA luveza ukuthi u-50% wabantu bakuleli uthembele ezibonelelweni zikahulumeni ukuze uphile.Kuvela ukuthi imizi ethembele ezibonelelweni zikahulumeni isuke ku-12.8% ngo-2002 yaya ku-39.4% ngo-2023.Umuzi nomuzi onomuntu oyedwa othola isibonelelo isibalo sakhona sisuke ku-30.8% ngo-2002 saya ku-50% ngo-2023.Isibalo sinyuswe kakhulu yisibonelelo sikaR350 wabangasebenzi.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi uhulumeni uveze ukuthi bawu-18 million abantu bakuleli abathola izibonelelo zikahulumeni.Umphathi weStatsSA, uMnuz Risenga Maluleke, uthe bawu-9.8 million abantu bakuleli abane-medical aid, iningi labo ngabamhlophe njengoba benza u-71.7% wabantu bakuleli abane-medical aid.Uveze ukuthi abaningi abahola izibonelelo zikahulumeni bagcwele e-Eastern Cape, kulandele iLimpopo nezinye izifundazwe.Yize isibalo sabathola ugesi sinyuke saya ku-89.8% ngo-2023 kodwa kuvela ukuthi ikota yabantu bakuleli isabasa phansi ukuze ipheke, abanye basebenzisa igesi nopharafini.UMnuz Mervyn Abrahams, wenhlangano eyenza ucwaningo ngokubiza kokudla nesimo senhlalo, iPietermaritzburg Economic Justice and Dignity Group, uthe kuyiqiniso ukuthi abantu abaningi bathembele ezibonelelweni zikahulumeni kodwa kufanele zithi ukunyuka.Uthe abantu badinga isibonelelo esizobasiza ukuthi beze nezindlela zabo zokuphila.Uveze ukuthi kunocwaningo akade belwenza lapho bebenika intsha efunde kumaTVET College izibonelelo kanti le ntsha ikwazile ukuyofuna imisebenzi, enye yavula amabhizinisi amancane kanti enye isebenzise le mali ukulima amaveji ewadayisela umphakathi.Ubalule ukuthi izibonelelo ziphelela ekudleni futhi nazo azanele ukuthengela abantu ukudla okunomsoco.Ugqugquzele uhulumeni ukuba eze nesibonelelo esizolekelela abantu ukuthi bakwazi ukuziphilisa.
ISHINTSHE umshovo i-EFF ijuba uNobhala-Jikelele wayo, uMnuz uMarshall Dlamini, embangweni wesikhundla sikandunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal.Seluvele luqalile ukhetho zidlana imilala kuyavotwa njengoba kuqalwe ngabavota ngokukhethekile izolo, nanamuhla beqhubeka. Kulindeleke ukuthi kusasa kuqale ukuvota uwonkewonke.Isifundazwe i-KZN ibukeka iyintombi efunwa yizo zonke izinsizwa kwezepolitiki ngoba imikhankaso yamaqembu iqine kakhulu khona.I-EFF imemezele ukuthi uDlamini uzongenela umbango wesikandunankulu njengoba zidlana imilala okhethweni. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma ingase isithole isikhundla nguyena oyongena kusona ahole uhulumeni.Akuvamile kwezepolitiki ukuthi unobhala-jikelele ohlala ehhovisi elikhulu abuye ayobanga izikhundla ezingeni elingaphansi. Okunye okuqaphelekayo wukuthi i-EFF imeqile uSihlalo wayo waseKZN, uMnuz uMongezi Twala, yalanda uDlamini phezulu. Okwesithathu wukuthi i-EFF ithathe isikhathi eside kakhulu ukumemezela egadla ngaye kwesombango kandunankulu ekubeni amanye amaqembu kade abamemezela. Igama likaDlamini lize lavezwa wumholi weqembu, uMnuz uJulius Malema, emcimbini wabo womkhankaso wokugcina eLimpopo.UMalema uthe uma bethatha uhulumeni, bazojuba abantu abafundile abanesipiliyoni nabanamakhono afanele noma ngabe abawona amalungu e-EFF.UDlamini udabuka eMzimkhulu khona kulesi sifundazwe. Kuvalwa ihlandla likahulumeni nje ubeyilungu lePhalamende, emele lona iqembu lakhe.Ubuye aziwe njengosomabhizinisi kanti ubesanda kuthweswa iziqu ze-Bachelor of Arts in International Relations azithole e-Unisa nyakenye. UDlamini uphakanyiswa nje ngo-Ephreli nonyaka ulahlwe yicala lokushaya iphoyisa ngesihluku ePhalamende kanti kulindeleke ukuthi agwetshwe ngoMeyi 31.UDlamini uzanywe kaningi ocingweni wangatholakala njengoba belukhala lungabanjwa. Kuzanywe nomkhulumeli weqembu, uMnuz Sinawo Tambo, naye ongatholakalanga.
KUKHUTHAZWE amaphoyisa ukuthi asiqinile isandla uma ebhekene nos’khwiliphambana nobhoko abahlela ukunyomfa ukhetho.Lokhu kushiwo uNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa kuleli, uMnuz Bheki Cele.Ukhulume kanje emuva kwezehlekalalo lapho abemboni yamatekisi eThekwini, ePort Shepstone naseMthatha bevale thaqa imiwaqo emikhulu nesibhedlela ngenxa yezikhalazo abebekade benazo.Ezinye zazo ukushaqwa kwamatekisi abo abathi kwenziwa amaphoyisa omgwaqo ngoba kuthiwa awanazo izimvume zokusebenza.UCele uxwayise abantu abaphula umthetho wathi bazojeza."Zonke izinhlaka eziqapha ukuthula namaphoyisa kumele basiqinise isandla kubantu abasebenzisa indlela efana nalena (yokuvalwa kwemigwaqo nezikhungo). Umsebenzi wamaphoyisa ukuqinisekisa ukuthi uyagcinwa umthetho, akuxoxiswana,” kusho uCele.Uqhube wathi awufike uqale ngokuthi uvale isiteshi sokuvota, isikole noma isibhedlela bese uthi ufuna kuxoxwe.Ugqugquzele amaphoyisa wathi awaqale aqinisekise ukuthi uyagcinwa umthetho ngaphambi kokuthi axoxisane nabantu abagila lemigilingwane.Idolobha laseMthatha belivalwe thaqa embhikishweni okusolakala ukuthi bewuholwa abemboni yamatekisi.UCele uthe iminyango yabo ivuliwe bewuhlumeni ekutheni kuxoxwe ngezingqinamba zabamatekisi. Uphinde wathi ngeke baxoxisane nabo bephethe izibhamu ngezandle njengoba kwenzekile ePort Shepstone."Sinxusa abemboni yamatekisi ukuthi uma benezinkinga, abazikhuulume nathi. Kodwa uma beya emgwaqweni, bephaka impi beyibhekise emphakathini, uMbuso kuzomele ubhekane kanzima nabenza lokho,” kusho uCele.Uthe kukhona asebeboshelwe lezi zigameko abanye balimala njengoba kukhona nabebekade befuna ukuvala isikhumulo sezindiza saseMthatha.

UZOVELA maduze enkantolo owesilisa wokufika oboshelwe icala lokuzenza udokotela eSydenham, eThekwini ngempelasonto.Lokhu kushiwo okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uColonel Robert Netshiunda.Ubeqinisekisa isigameko sokuboshwa kowesilisa oneminyaka engu-43 ngoLwesihlanu, eSydenham emva kokubhadanywa esebenza ekubeni ewudokotela mbumbulu. "Ubesebenza ngaphandle kwamaphepha obudokotela. Amaphoyisa ambophe emva kokulunywa indlebe ngokuba khona kodokotela abasolisayo esikhungweni sezempilo esisemgwaqweni uRandless kule ndawo. Umsolwa uficiwe, waboshwa, uzovela enkantolo maduze,” kusho uNetshiunda. Umthombo osemaphoyiseni utshele Isolezwe ukuthi udokotela mbumbulu ubhadanywe exilonga ingane eneminyaka emine endaweni yakhe yokusebenzela ngosuku aboshwe ngalo. Uqhube wathi owesilisa okuthiwa ungowokufika kuleli uboshwe amaphoyisa ophiko oluhlukahlukene okukhona kulo neSydenham Trio Task Team.Umthombo uthe owesilisa uboshwe emva kokuthi amaphoyisa ngokubambisana nenhlangano yabasebenzi bezempilo, iHealth Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA), enohlu lwabo bonke odokotela kuleli elunywe indlebe ngemikhuba egilwa ilona wesilisa.Uthe kuthiwa ubekwe icala lokuzenza udokotela osemthethweni ekubeni engenazo iziqu zobudokotela."Amaphoyisa eSydenham Trio Task Team athole umkhondo ngeHPCSA ngodokotela mbumbulu okuthiwa usebenza ngezikhathi zasebusuku ekhemisi laseSydenham,” kusho umthombo.Uveze ukuthi banikele khona nezikhulu zeHPCSA, bazithela phezu kwakhe exilonga ingane (4) ebilethwe abazali bayo."Amaphoyisa aqonde kuyena, ambuza ngezincwadi zomsebenzi wakhe, wahluleka wancama ukuziveza, maqede wakha phansi, ebalekela ukuboshwa,” kusho umthombo.Uthe ugcine eboshwa, wayiswa esiteshini samaphoyisa eSydenham ukuze kuqhutshekwe nophenyo.Umthombo uveze ukuthi kuthathwe zonke izinto zakhe zokusebenza okukhona kuzo iStethoscope, isigxivizo sikadokotela, imiqingo yezempilo namanye amafayela nemoto iToyota Fortuner ecishwe izinombolo zayo (Vin number)."Konke okuthathiwe kuzosetshenziswa uma sekuqhutshekwa nophenyo,” kusho umthombo.
I-TRANSNET isayine isivumelwano sika-R1.3 billion nenkampani iMnambithi Terminals ukuba yakhe isikhungo sokubeka impahla ewuketshekezi, eMaydon Wharf, eThekwini.Lesi sikhungo kulindeleke ukuthi sisize ichweba laseThekwini ukuba libe nezindawo ezihlukile zokugcina impahla ewuketsheze futhi nomsebenzi usheshe.Njengamanje iTransnet imatasa nezinhlelo zokunyusa impahla engena emachwebeni ayo njengoba ifuna ukubuyela esicongweni samachweba enza kahle emhlabeni jikelele.Ukusayinwa kwesivumelwano kusho ukuphothulwa kwesigaba 79 esakhishwa wuNgqongqoshe wezokuThutha, uNkk Sindisiwe Chikunga, sokuba kunikezwe iMnambithi Terminals igunya lokuphatha impahla ewuketshezi esizeni esiwuMaydon Wharf 6, iminyaka ewu-20.Okujabulise abantu wukuthi uMnambithi Bulk Terminals ngeyabantu abamnyama bakuleli njengoba bethephe u-100% wayo. Lokhu iTransnet ithe kukhombisa ngokusobala ukuthi izimisele ukuletha uguquko lwezomnotho echwebeni laseThekwini.Ithe iNingizimu Afrika izokwazi ukulanda impahla ewuketshezi nokuyithumela kwamanye amazwe kusetshenziswa iMnambithi Terminal.I-terminal yaseMnambithi izokwazi ukuba nomzila wamaguzu ezitimela obhekelele yona nendawo yokungenisa amaloli. Lokhu kuzoqinisekisa ukuthi akukho okuzobambezela umsebenzi wale nkampani.Kulindeleke ukuthi intuthuko yeMnambithi Terminal idale amathuba omsebenzi awu-40 kuya ku-100 bese kuba awu-400 ayimixhantela azovela ezinkampanini ezizosebenzisana nale nkampani.Isigaba sokuqala sale ntuthuko sizoqala ngokuthi kudilizwe ingqalasizinda ekhona njengamanje ukuze kwakhiwe isisekelo esisha, kufakwe amathangi, amapayipi amakhulu okuthwala impahla ewuketshezi kanjalo nezindawo zokupaka imikhumbi esuke ilethe impahla.Esigabeni sesibili nesokugcina kuzobe sekufakwa amanye amathangi nenye ingqalasizinda."ITransnet National Port Authority (TNPA) izimisele ukuletha uguquko kwezomnotho nokuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abantu bakuleli abasali ngaphandle. Siyajabula kakhulu ukwamukela iMnambithi Terminals futhi siyathemba ukuthi lesi sivumelwano sizothuthukisa umnotho wezwe njengoba kubhalwe kwisigaba 79 se-National Ports Act ka-2005,” kusho isikhulu esiphezulu saseTransnet, u-Adv Michelle Phillips.

Iyona nto engifuna ukuyibona ngaleli voti kodwa nje awukho okwamanje umehluko engisawubonile. ZIWU-107 izikhungo ezigcine zingavulwanga izikhungo ezigcine zingavulwanga eMthatha, e-Eastern Cape ngenxa yodlame oluqhubeka esifundeni i-OR Tambo.Lokhu kuza emuva kokuthi abanikazi bamatekisi bevale imigwaqo bekhala ngokuthi izimfuno zabo aziphendulwanga.Lezi zindaba zivezwe yiPhini likaKhomishana yokhetho i-Independent Electoral Commission (IEC), uMnuz Masego Sheburi.Uthe zikhona nezinye izikhungo lapho ukhetho luqale khona sekudlule isikhathi ngenxa yokuthi bekulindwe izimvilophu.Uveze ukuthi bazokwenza konke okusemandleni ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu baqhuba ilungelo labo lokuvota ngokusebenzisana nezinhlaka zokuphepha.Uveze ukuthi bawu-1.6 million abantu ababhalisele ukuvota okuyisipesheli.Kulabo bantu abawu-1 million bazovotela ezikhungweni, kuthi abawu-600 000 bavakashelwe emakhaya.Uveze ukuthi izolo ngabo-2 ntambama besekuvote abantu abawu-230 000 ezikhungweni kanti bebengakababali abavotiswe emakhaya.USheburi uthe yize zibe khona lezi zinkinga kodwa zincane kakhulu uma ubheka ukuthi izikhungo zokuvota zingaphezu kuka-22 000. Uthe izinhlaka zezokuphepha ziyalusebenza udaba lwaseMthatha, kanti bazokwazi ukwenza isimemezelo ngesikhathi esizayo ukuthi kuzokwenzekani kulesiya sifunda, kodwa bona njengenhlangano yokhetho bazokwenza konke okusemandleni ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abathintekayo abalahlekelwa yilungelo labo lokuvota. Amavoti ayisipesheli azobalwa kanye nawawo wonke umuntu uma sekuqedwe ukuvota.Uthe abasebenzi base-IEC bazovakashela nasemajele ukuyovotisa iziboshwa.Uxwayise abantu ukuthi baqaphele imininingwane engesiyo ebhebhethekiswa ezinkundleni zokuxhumana.Uthe amavoti azobalwa ezikhungweni zokhetho bese edluliselwa esikhungweni esikhulu sokubala amavoti.Ugqugquzele ababhalisele ukuvota okuyisipesheli ukuba bavote ngoba ithuba lizovalwa namhlanje.Bangavota nakusasa ezikhungweni ababhalise kuzo uma kwenzekile ukuthi bahlulekile wukuvota ngezinsuku ezibekelwe amavoti ayisipesheli.USheburi uthembise ukuthi ukuvota namuhla kuzoba ngcono kakhulu ngoba izinkinga abahlangabezane nazo ngosuku lokuqala lokuvota ngokuyisipesheli bazobe sebezilungisile. Khonamanjalo, uKhomishana wamaphoyisa kuzwelonke uGeneral Fannie Masemola ekhuluma eHarrismith lapho bekunomviliyelo wamaphoyisa ajutshwe ukuyolekela ezifundazweni okubalwa kuzo iKZN ne-Eastern Cape, uthe umyalelo awunike amaphoyisa ukuthi enze isiqiniseko sokuthi abantu bakuleli bakhululekile ukuthi bavote. Uthe ubaluleke ukuba banqande ubugebengu benze isiqiniseko sokuthi kunozinzo.
KULALE isidumbu sesibili, kudutshulwa kubulawa owesilisa waseNquthu, obehambele umngcwabo womunye wesilisa KwaJikaza, oLundi, ngoMgqibelo.Ngokuthola kweSolezwe, lona wesilisa, okungaveli ukuthi ungubani, kuthiwa udutshulwe yinhlamvu ebindiza emoyeni ngesikhathi kuqhunyiswa izibhamu kulo mngcwabo.Kuvela ukuthi bekungcwatshwa uMnuz Sabelo Mazibuko (47) okuthiwa ushone ngokudutshulwa ngoMeyi 19, ehostela iNguni, eGoli.Umfowabo kamufi, uMnuz Celi Mazibuko, uthe yize engazi kahle ukuthi ubani odubulile nanokuthi ithini imininingwane yalo odutshuliwe, kodwa lesi sigameko esibashiye beshaqekile, senzeke phambi kwabo."Isigameko senzeke ngesikhathi sesiphuma nebhokisi ekhaya emva kwenkonzo yomngcwabo, siya emathuneni ngaphandle komuzi. Mina nabanye besibambe ibhokisi ngesikhathi sizwa kuqhuma isibhamu,” kusho uMazibuko.Uqhube wathi ngokwejwayelekile, uma kuqhuma isibhamu abantu baye bethuke, abanye babheke phansi, nabo benze okufanayo."Sithe siphakamisa amehlo, bese kukhona owesilisa obese elele phansi, edubulekile,” kusho uMazibuko.Uthe lona wesilisa akukho okutheni abakutholile ngaye ngaphandle kokuthi ungowokudabuka eNquthu. Uthe nomndeni wakhe ubungakaxhumani nabo, nabo bebengakayenzi imizamo yokuwucinga.Uqhube wathi yize beqhubeke nokuya emathuneni bengumndeni, kodwa bathole ukuthi lona wesilisa uphuthunyiswe esibhedlela Obonjeni ngabanye ebebehambele umngcwabo kamfowabo."Sizwa kuthiwa ufike washonela khona esibhedlela,” usho kanje.Akakwazanga ukucacisa eyalabo ebebeqhumisa izibhamu njengoba ethe, bezwe kuthiwa ebebedubula ngabangani bakamfowabo."Sithole ukuthi bemphelezela ngendlela ahambe ngayo, njengoba naye ehambe ngaso isibhamu,” kubeka uMazibuko.Ebuzwa ukuthi ubephila mpiloni umufi eGoli, uthe ngokwazi kwakhe, ubengasebenzi kodwa ezihlalele nje ehostela.Uthe kwebebehambele umngcwabo, bebekhona ebebevela eGoli, kuphinde kube khona abendawo, wathi ngenxa yokuba matasa ngezinhlelo zomngcwabo, abazange banake ukuthi abadubulayo bebengobani nokuthi bebengabendawo noma abaseGoli.Imithombo yeSolezwe ithe umufi ubeyinkabi, kanti odutshulwe emngcwabeni wakhe, kusolwa ukuthi uye owadayisa umufi ngesikhathi edutshulwa eGoli. Nokho uMazibuko akakwazanga ukuqinisekisa lezi zinsolo.Kushaye isikhathi sokushicilela amaphoyisa engakayiphenduli imibuzo athunyelelwe yona.
KUKHUTHAZWA abantu abasha ukuba babe nentshisekelo yokuvakashela izigcinamagugu ukuze bafunde kabanzi ngomlando onothile wezwe.Lokhu kugqugquzelwe nguNgqongqoshe wezeMidlalo, ezobuCiko namaSiko KwaZulu Natal, uDkt Ntuthuko Mahlaba.UDkt Mahlaba ukusho ngesikhathi kuvulwa ngokusemthethweni isigcinamagugu saKwaDukuza, enyakatho neKwaZulu Natal."Siyakholelwa kakhulu ekubalulekeni kwezigcinamagugu KwaZulu Natal. Yingakho nje sikukhuthaza kakhulu ukuthi zakhiwe zibe ningi,'' usho kanje uDkt Mahlaba, uNgqongqoshe wezeMidlalo, ezobuCiko namaSiko KwaZulu Natal.UMahlaba udalule ukuthi ukwakhiwa kwesikhungo samagugu kudle imali elinganiselwa ku-R27 million. Uqhube wathi kubajabulisile kakhulu ukuphothulwa kwesigcinamagugu.Ungqongqoshe uchaze izigcinamagugu njengezikhungo ezilonda futhi zinakekele amagugu esizwe nomlando ojulile wezwe. Uthe bafisa ukubona sanda isibalo sabantu abasha basendaweni ababayingxenye yokuvakashela isigcinamagugu."Akukho nokuncane ukungabaza ukuthi kuningi kakhulu abangakuzuza uma bezijwayeza ukusisebenzisa ngendlela efanele,'' kusho uMahlaba.UNgqongqoshe ubuye wahalalisela izikole zaKwaDukuza namaphethelo, wathi zizozuza lukhulu ngokusebenzisa isigcinamagugu. Ugcizelele ukuthi kungaba yinto enhle uma zinganda izigcinamagugu ezingxenyeni ezahlukene KwaZulu Natal.Uthe lokhu kumele kube yinto ebonakala iba seqhulwini komasipala abehlukene baKwaZulu Natal.IMeya yaKwaDukuza, uNkk Lindiwe Nhaca, ikushayele ihlombe ukuphothulwa kwesigcinamagugu kule ndawo. UNkk Nhaca nxuse abantu abasha bakule ndawo ukuba bazijwayeze ukusisebenzisa ngendlela efanele ukuze bahlomule ngolwazi olunzulu mayelana nomlando wezwe.UNkk Nhaca uthe kusemqoka futhi ukuthi abantu abadala nabo kumqoka bazijwayeze ukusebenzisa isigcinamagugu."Kuningi kakhulu abazokufunda abantu abasha bethu abazokuthola uma bengena ngaphakathi kusona,'' usho kanje.
UHLAKA olushaya imithetho ethinta izikweletu, iNational Credit Regulator (NCR), ludonse ngendlebe ababolekisa ngemali ukuthi bangalokothi bathathele abantu omazisi babo namakhadi okukhipha imali ebhange.I-NCR ikhiphe lo myalelo emuva kokuthola izikhalo kubantu baseMbombela, eMpumalanga, akade bekhala ngokubanjelwa omazisi babo ngomashonisa.Iye yajuba Oklebe ukuba bayophenya ngalolu daba, bagasele emizini yomashonisa lapho bethole khona omazisi namakhadi okuhola isibonelelo sikahulumeni.I-NCR ithe kuyicala ukubamba umazisi, ikhadi lasebhange nelesibonelelo sikahulumeni. Owenza lokhu angavalelwa ejele isikhathi esingangonyaka noma ahlawuliswe imali. Isigwebo siya ngobunzima becala.Ithe abantu baye bayibikela ngokubanjelwa omazisi njengoba sekusondele ukhetho ngoba bekusho ukuthi bebengeke bakwazi ukuvota.Iveze ukuthi ihambisane noKlebe ngoba ayikwazi ukubopha.Esitatimendeni sabezindaba uCaptain Lucy Sekgotodi woKlebe eMpumalanga, uveze ukuthi kuboshwe abantu abayisithupha abaneminyaka ephakathi kuka-23 no-54 ababhekene necala lokuphula umthetho wezikweletu iNational Credit Act.Uveze ukuthi bebehambisana neNCR ngesikhathi bebopha laba bantu emuva kokuthi umphakathi ubalume ngendlebe ngokuthi laba banamabhizinisi okubolekisa ngemali angekho semthethweni."OKlebe bathole ukuthi laba ababolekisa ngemali bebebamba amakhadi asebhange, amakhadi okuhola isibonelelo sikahulumeni nomazisi. Bebegcina lezi zinto ngakubona ukuqinisekisa ukuthi labo ababoleke imali bayayikhokha imali abayibolekile nenzalo yakhona ephezulu,” kusho uCapt Sekgotodi.Uthe umphathi woKlebe eMpumalanga, uMajor General Nicholas Gerber, ukushayele ihlombe ukuboshwa kwalaba bantu abayisithupha.UGerber ucele umphakathi ukuthi uyeke ukuboleka imali komashonisa ngoba abanawo unembeza futhi baxhaphaza abampofu.I-NCR itholakala ngokushayela u-0860 627 627/011 554 2700 nangokuthumela i-email [email protected]

UJoe wayengathuli, wayekhuluma njalo nje. Wayengasweli into azoyikhuluma (esho sakuncokola). Njengoba nazi-ke nani ukuthi ngesikhathi sethu yayingekho imali. Ngakho-ke kwesinye isikhathi sasike singaholi.Ngoba-ke mina nganginguthisha, uJoel wayethi ngoba wena unguthisha uyahola noma ungangahola (eqenjini) akunandaba, yithina abantu okumele sihole,” kusho uKhumalo.Phakathi kwezinkakha zebhola ebezizimazise inkonzo yesikhumbuzo, kubalwa uMafa "Ace” Nduli, Ronald "Cutter” Langa, Vuma Mfeka, Patson "Sparks” Banda, Siyabonga "Bhele” Nomvethe, ukubala ezimbalwa.

UHLUSHWA wumcabango wokuthi ngeke esaqasheka emkhakheni awufundele kanzima ngenxa yeminyaka yakhe, ophothule iziqu zakhe emva kokuthi wayeqale wasebenza enkampanini ehlanza esibhedlela iminyaka eyisikhombisa.UNksz Zanele Mathenjwa (37) ongowokudabuka eGroutville, KwaDukuza, wethweswe iziqu i-Degree in Environmental Science yi-University of South Africa ngesonto eledlule. Yize ukusebenza kanzima kukaNksz Mathenjwa nesifiso sokuguqula isimo sakubo nokuthweswa lezi ziqu kulethe inhlansana yethemba, kodwa uthe injabulo anayo ibuye ibe nebohlololo uma ecabanga imigomo yezinkampani eziningi kuleli neminyango kahulumeni enikeza ithuba abantu abaneminyaka engaphansi kuka-35 ama-internship okuyiwo akuvulela iminyango namava adingekayo emkhakheni osuke ulangazelele ukuqashwa kuwo."Ngijabule kakhulu, yikhona ukuthi angazi ngizoqashwa kuphi njengoba sengineminyaka ewu-37 nje, yilokho okungikhathazayo. Yingakho ngaqoka ukwenza lezi ziqu, engizenze iminyaka emine kusuka ngo-2020,” usho kanje.UNksz Mathenjwa uthe waqeda u-matric ngo-2008 esikoleni samabanga aphezulu eGroutville. Kuthe ngo-2012 wathola umsebenzi wokuhlanza enkampanini ehlanza esibhedlela i-Alberlito esiseBallito. Ngo-2017, kwavalwa inkampani ayesebenza kuyo, wabe esefikelwa wumcabango wokubuyela esikoleni ayolungisa u-matric wakhe njengoba wayengaphasanga kahle. Ngaleso sikhathi wayeneminyaka engu-30, kanti kwadingeka ukuthi aqale ku-grade 11 esikoleni amukelwa kusona iBhekikusasa High eMpangeni. Ngo-2019, waphasa u-matric wakhe ngo-B, wathola isikhala sokufunda e-Unisa ngo-2020, kusuka lapho akabange esabheka emuva.Uthe beziningi izinselelo abhekana nazo ngesikhathi efunda kule nyuvesi kwazise ubengafundi ngokugcwele kanti ubesevele esebenza njengomsebenzi ojwayelekile nje kwenye yezimboni khona KwaDukuza nokuyilapho asasebenza khona namanje."Bengibuya emsebenzini ngikhathele, kwesinye isikhathi kade ngingena ebusuku ngizela, kodwa kuphoqa ukuthi ngenze umsebenzi wesikole. Bekunzima kangangoba ngo-2022 kukhona isifundo engisifeyilile kwaphoqa ukuthi ngisiphinde nyakenye ukuze ngithweswe iziqu zami,” usho kanje.Uthe isifiso sakhe ukuthola umsebenzi awufundele ukuze athole amava adingekayo.
KUNGASE kuphazamiseke ukukhokhwa kwesondlo sezingane uma kuphela inyanga njengoba uMnyango wezoBulungiswa uveze ukuthi izigebengu zizame ukweba imali zisebenzisa i-internet.Esitatimendeni sabezindaba, uMnyango wezoBulungiswa uveze ukuthi izigebengu zingene ohlelweni lokukhokhwa kwemali yesondlo zashintsha imininingwane yabantu okufanele bathole isondlo zafaka eyazo.Lokhu kuholele ekutheni umnyango ulumise uhlelo lokukhokhwa kwezibonelelo olujwayelekile ukuze kuliwe nalobu bugebengu.Uthe usubikele izinhlaka zomthetho okuyizona eziphenyayo ngalolu daba.Okwamanje abahola izibonelelo zikahulumeni bacelwe ukuba baye ezinkantolo ukuze bakwazi ukuthola imali yabo.Esitatimendeni, uNksz Kgalalelo Masibi uthe imali izotholakala kuzo zonke izinkantolo zakuleli ukuze abahola isondlo bengeke bahlupheke.Ubuye wakuveza ukuthi bayaxoxisana nezinye izinhlaka okubalwa kuzo namabhange ukuze kungagcwali imali eningi ezinkantolo.Ezinkundleni zokuxhumana abesifazane abathola isondlo sezingane bathe ubuhixihixi buqale ngoMeyi 15 kanti abanalo ithemba lokuthi uma kuphela inyanga wonke umuntu uzoyithola imali.Omunye ocele ukungadalulwa, ngoba esabela ukuthi ngeke ayithole imali uma eseya enkantolo, uthe akusikona okokuqala izigebengu zizama ukweba imali ngakho umnyango kufanele ube nezinhlelo ezifana nezamabhange zokuvikela imininingwane yabathola isondlo sezingane.Ucele ukuthi imali ifakwe kuma-akhawunti abantu asebhange, ingavayi ohlelweni lwekhompyutha lomnyango ngoba izigebengu zihlasela lona njalo.
SIYINDABA egudwini kumalungu omphakathi wase-17 eMlaza isehlakalo sokutholakala kwesidumbu somuntu sikhishwe ikhanda emathuneni akule ndawo.Kuvela ukuthi ngoLwesine amaphoyisa anikele kule ndawo ngemuva kokuba elunywe indlebe ngokuthi kukhona isidumbu esimbiwe sasuswa ikhanda kwahanjwa nalo.Kuvela ukuthi amaphoyisa efika endaweni yesigameko, afice ibhokisi lingaphandle komgodi.Kuthiwa bekugcwele igazi endaweni yesigameko phansi njengoba kubonakale sengathi ikhanda lijuqulwe khona emathuneni. Isidumbu besingaphandle kwebhokisi.Umthombo okhulume neSolezwe Ngempelasonto ukhona endaweni yesigameko, uthe lokhu abakubonayo akujwayelekile nhlobo."Njengoba ngikhuluma nawe nje bhuti, ngikhona lapha. Nali ibhokisi phambi kwami, isidumbu sijuqulwe ikhanda. Ikhanda akwaziwa ukuthi lithathwe lase liyiswa kuphi,'' usho kanje.Isidumbu kuvela ukuthi ngesomuntu wesilisa futhi singcwatshwe ngoMeyi 12 kuwona lo nyaka.Kuvele ukuthi lesi sidumbu ngesomuntu obephila nokukhubazeka njengoba impilo yakhe yonke ubengaboni emehlweni. Kuvela ukuthi bakhona nabanye abangaboni emehlweni emndenini wakubo, okuthiwa babehlala kwa-U, eMlaza kodwa base befudukela, eKapa.Umphakathi osondelene nalawa mathuna okhulume neSolezwe Ngempelasonto uzwakalise ukukhathazeka okukhulu ngalokhu okwenzekile.Amalungu omphakathi acele ukuba kugodlwe amagama awo, athe ayathuthumela uma ecabanga ngalento eyenzekile.Abuze ukuthi aphephe kangakanani amathuna ezihlobo zawo uma kuzoba nabantu abangena kalula nje emathuneni, bambe igodi bese benukubeza isidumbu.Ngaphambilini kuke kwaba namahemuhemu okuthi isidumbu sisuswe nezingalo, okugcine kutholakale ukuthi akunjalo."Imbi kakhulu lento esiyibone yenzeka kulawa mathuna. Uma ingasukunyelwa kuyacaca phela ukuthi kusazombiwa ezinye izidumbu kule ndawo,'' kukhalaza ilungu lomphakathi.Elinye ilungu lomphakathi likhale ngokuthi umndeni uzwiswa ubuhlungu besibili njengoba isidumbu sesiqale phansi sayiswa emakhazeni.Bakhale kakhulu nangokuthi sekumele kube khona abantu abawaqaphayo amathuna ukuze kugwemeke izehlakalo zalolu hlobo.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, ecashunwa yi-IOL, uthe amaphoyisa abizelwe endaweni yesehlakalo azithela phezu kwethuna elimbiwe. Uthe athole nokuthi ikhanda belinqunyiwe."Kuvulwe icala lokumbiwa kwethuna ngokungemthetho nokunukubezwa kwesidumbu,” kusho uNetshiunda.

KUVELA ukuthi nabefundisi bamabandla abasindisiwe bambodelana KwaMhlabuyalingana, ePhelandaba kumelaphi wendabuko ongakufihli ukuthi "uyathwalisana''.Lo melaphi wendabuko, osephenduke undabuzekwayo nasezinkundleni zokuxhumana, uthe kucacile ukuthi abantu bakuleli abasakwenqeni ukuthwala. Usizi nobubha yikona okwenza bakhethe lo mkhuba.UMnuz Mvelase, odume ngelikaShumi lamakati, uthe abefundisi bamabandla abasindisiwe batheleka bethelekile kuyena. Iningi lisuke lifuna ukuthi kuchume amabandla alo nabazalwane banganqeni ukunikela izimali ezishisiwe ebandleni ukuze kusimame nomfundisi.''Ngeke ngibe namahloni ngalo msebenzi ngoba yinto eyenziwayo. Ngiwenza impela nje, ngithwalisa nabo impela abefundisi abasindisiwe, ngeke ngibacwase. Namanje nje lapha izolo kade kukhona abavela eGoli naseMpumalanga ekade ngibathwalisa,'' usho kanje.Uphikile ukuthi ukuthwala kuyingozi njengoba abanye abelaphi bendabuko beyaye baxwayise. Uthe kuya ngokuthi uthwala ngayiphi indlela nokuthi uthwaliswa wubani."Ngeke ngibadalule abefundisi esengibasizile kodwa yinqwaba la KwaZulu-Natal. Abazalwane babo baze babathengele nezimoto imbala. Abantu bangakhuluma nje abafuna ukukusho kodwa okusalayo lento iyenzeka futhi yenziwa abantu bakuwo wonke amazinga empilo muva nje,” egcizelela.Uthe alikho icala ekuthwaleni, ngoba umuntu usuke ehlose ukuqinisekisa ukuthi leyo nto aziphilisa ngayo iyakhula.Uthe izithwalo zakhe azinabo ubungozi ngoba zisuke zingahlanganisi ukuthi akubulawe abantu noma kuchithwe igazi.ISolezwe Ngempelasonto likhulume nabefundisi ababili abacele ukuba kugodlwe amagama abo.Owokuqala ulimise ngesihloko elokuthi selokhu ahlangana noMvelase izinto uzibona zikhanya ebandleni, nomnikelo abazalwane bawukhipha ngenye indlela.Uthe naye kukhona omunye uMfundisi owamcebisa ukuthi kumele aye kuphi uma efuna ukubona izinto zakhe zikhanya ebandleni, athole nomnikelo obonakalayo.Owesibili uthe akathandi ukuthi kwaziwe ukuthi ibandla lakhe likhuliswa yini kodwa uvumile ukuthi kunento ayithola eyisithwalo okuyiyona edala ukuthi izinto zenzeke.Bonke laba befundisi bathi abayithi vu emindenini yabo eyokuthi bathwele, baye bababaze ubukhulu bukaNkulunkulu uma izinto sezenzeka.
ISIKHULU se-IEC KwaZulu- Natal, uNkk Nombifuthi Masinga, sithi akufanele lidale ukudideka iphepha lesithathu lokuvota.Izwe limatasa lilungiselela ukhetho lukazwelonke oluzoqala namuhla ngalabo ababhalisele ukuvota ngokukhethekile. Uhlelo lwabavota ngokukhethekile luzoqhubeka nakusasa.NgoLwesithathu kuyobe sekuwusuku lokuvota lwawonke umuntu, kanti izikhungo zizovulwa ngo-7 ekuseni zivalwe ngo-9 ebusuku.I-IEC isivele isethulile isikhungo semiphumela yokhetho KwaZu-Natal okuzoba yi-ICC, eThekwini.Abe-IEC bathe konke kumi ngomumo, balindele ukhetho olungenazihibe.UNkk Masinga uxoxe neSolezwe ecacisa ukuthi umuntu uma evota angaxwayi uma enikwa amaphepha amathathu. Phambilini, okhethweni lukazwelonke umuntu ubethola amaphepha amabili avotele iPhalamende likazwelonke bese evotela isifundazwe.Kuzobe kuqala ukuthi umuntu anikwe amaphepha amathathu okulindeleke ukuthi avote kuwowonke.UNkk Masinga uthe ngeke liphazamise ngalutho iphepha lesithathu, indaba yalo icace bha.''INkantolo yoMthethosisekelo yanquma ukuthi kufakwe nabangenela ukhetho ngokuzimela. Iphepha lesithathu lenzelwe ukufaka labo abangenele ngokuzimela. Umuntu uma evota ukhetha kuwona womathathu amaphepha," usho kanjena.Amaphepha womathathu ahlukaniseka kalula ngokwemibala yawo ecacile. Iphepha lokuqala eliluhlaza njengesibhakabhaka elokuvotela uzwelonke futhi linamaqembu kuphela.Elesibili elinombala osawolintshi libizwa ngokuthi elesifunda nelizobe lixube amaqembu nabangenele ukhetho ngokuzimela.Elesithathu li-pink lona elesifundazwe lizobe lixube amaqembu nabangele ukhetho ngokuzimela.UNkk Masinga uthe balwenzile uhlelo lokusabalalisa ulwazi ngephepha lesithathu nasemisakazweni bayachaza kakhulu ngalo.Abe-IEC bathe abantu uma befika ezikhungweni bazolekelelwa abasebenzi abaqeqeshiwe abanesineke abazobachazela konke.Olunye udaba aluvezile wukweluswa kwamaphepha okuvota uma abantu sebevotile. Uthe kunohlelo lwezobuchwepheshe abalusebenzisa ukuwaqapha amaphepha ukuthi asekuphi ngesikhathi ethuthwa.Kulindeke ukuthi uma sekuqedwe konke bese i-IEC imemezela imiphumela ngokusemthethweni ngoJuni 2.

UHusna Docrat ofunda u-Grade 11 eSt Dominics eNewcastle, wathola indondo yegolide ngocwaningo lwakhe oluthinta uhlobo lweplasitiki esetshenziselwa ukufaka izimpahla, engahlala isikhathi esevile eminyakeni ewu-20, engasiza ukugwema ukunukubezeka kwemvelo ngenxa yokungcola.Kulo mqhudelwano okusuke kubhekene abafundi nezitshudeni zezikhungo zemfundo ephakeme ezivela emazweni omhlaba, kubukiswa ngezinto ezehlukene eziqhamuka nentsha ezingaletha isixazululo ezinkingeni ezehlukene emhlabeni jikelele.USiqiniseko bekunguyena kuphela kubafundi abathathu abaqokwe emncintiswaneni i-Eskom Expo for Young Scientists kuleli, ovela esikoleni esisemakhaya. Ekhuluma neSolezwe uthe ubengakulindele ukuphuma isibili."Ngijabule kakhulu ngengikuzuzile. Besiqhudelana nabebevela emazweni ahlonishwayo okukhona kuwo i-France, USA, UK namanye. Iningi labebekulo mkhakha engiqhathwe kuwo, yizitshudeni ezivela ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme kuyimina nje obevela esikoleni samabanga aphezulu. Ngibonga kakhulu kubazali bami, othisha bami nakubantu abenze iphupho lami laba yimpumelelo,” usho kanje.Isifiso sakhe esikhulu ukuthola umfundaze, njengoba efuna ukufundela ukuba yi-Megatronic Electrical Engineer.USiqiniseko uthe imoto yakhe uyiqale esafunda esikoleni samabanga aphansi eJozini okuthe ngo-2021 waqala ukuthuthukisa umsebenzi wakhe. Iyazishayela yona, ihamba ngogesi ibe nomazibuthe ezinhlangothini zonke abavimbela ukuthi ingashayisi ezinye emgwaqweni, okuyinto uSiqiniseko athi inganqanda izingozi. Embukisweni wezinsuku ezintathu walo mqhudelwano phakathi kukaMeyi 2 no 5, amajaji kuthiwa abenikeza nongenelile ithuba lokuba achaze kabanzi ngomsebenzi wakhe.UMnuz Parthy Chetty owuMqondisi kwi-Eskom Expo ecashunwa kwi-website yoMnyango weMfundo eyisiSekelo, ubongele abafundi abahlabene,"Kuyajabulisa ukubona abafundi bakuleli beqhudelana nabanye basemazweni omhlaba. Laba bafundi baqhamuka ezindaweni ezehlukene kuleli ngakho kuyathembisa ukubona izinhloso zethu nge-Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics and Innovation (STEMI), kuyaqala kuthela izithelo,”usho kanje.
ABENZA ucwaningo ngokubiza kokudla bathi awukho umehluko ozokwenziwa wukudlondlobala kwamandla emali kubantu bakuleli.NgoLwesithathu, iStatsSA sikhiphe izibalo eziveze ukuthi amandla emali asuke ku-5.3% ngoMashi aya ku-5.2% ngo-Ephreli.UMnuz Meryvn Abrahams obhekelele ukusebenza kwe-Pietermaritzburg Economic Justice & Dignity Group, eyenza ucwaningo ngentengo yokudla, uthe okwamanje akukho okuzojabulisa abantu ngoba amaveji nokunye ukudla kusaqhubeka nokumba eqolo."Siyakwamukela ukuthi amandla emali athe ukudlondlobala kodwa lokhu ngeke kwehlise umthwalo emahlombe abantu bakuleli abathwele kanzima ngenxa yokubiza kwempilo. Amaveji asetshenziswa njalo okubalwa amazambane, u-anyanisi, u-pepper nokunye kusabiza. Igilosa yomndeni ibiza uR5 336.31. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abantu bathwele kanzima kanti njengoba amaveji esabiza, awukho umehluko ozokwenzeka ngezibalo zakamuva zamandla emali,” kusho u-Abrahams.Uthe mhlawumbe umehluko uzobakhona uma sekuvunwe amaveji atshalwe manje ebusika.Ugqugquzele abaqashi ukuba banyuse amaholo abasebenzi ukuze bakwazi ukuba nemali eyanele yokuthenga ukudla."Uhulumeni naye kufanele anyuse izibonelelo ukuze abantu bakuleli bezokwazi ukuthola ukudla okunomsoco. Okwamanje kuyabiza ukuphila eNingizimu Afrika,” kusho u-Abrahams.USolwazi Bonke Dumisa, oyisazi somnotho esizimele, uthe izibalo zakamuva zamandla emali zisho ukuthi abantu bakuleli akufanele balindele ukuthi kwehle imali-mboleko.Uthe ibhange lombuso iSouth African Reserve Bank (Sarb), lifuna amandla emali abe phakathi kuka-3% no-6%."Angiyiboni iSarb yehlisa imali-mboleko kulo nyaka ngoba ukuze inyakaze kuyodingeka ukuthi amandla emali abe ku-4.5%. Abantu abaqhubeke nokubopha izifociya ngoba iqiniso lithi okwamanje ngeke yehle imali mboleko,” kusho uDumisa.UNksz Koketso Mano oyisazi somnotho eFNB, uthe abalindele ukuthi amandla emali adlondlobale kakhulu ngoMeyi, kodwa balindele ukuthi uphethroli uqhubeke nokwehla uma udlame lwaseMiddle East luba ngcono.Naye uthe imali-mboleko abalindele ukuthi yehle okwamanje mhlawumbe ingaze yehle makuphela unyaka.
ITHOBEKE amanxeba inkosikazi kasomatekisi waseBhukhanana, eMpangeni, owabulawelwa uR6 000, begwetshwa odilikajele neminye iminyaka ngaphezulu, abesilisa ababili abalahlwe ngecala lokubulala umyeni wakhe.UMnuz Thulani Nsele wadutshulwa wabulawa emakethe yakule ndawo ngoMeyi 24, 2021, eneminyaka engu-47.INkantolo yeMantshi yaseMthunzini ilahle ngecala usomatekisi waseBhukhanana uNkunzebomvu Biyela nenkabi yakhe yaKwaDukuza, uTsepo Pakkies.Ngecala lokubulala bagwetshwe odilikajele, ngelokuzama ukubulala banikwa iminyaka emihlanu, ngelesibhamu esingekho emthethweni bagixabezwa ngeyishumi, baphinde bathasiselwa ngemibili ngokutholwa nezinhlamvu.Ephawula ngesigwebo umkamufi, uNksz Nompumelelo Ndlovu, uthe nakuba isigwebo singeke sisambuyisa umyeni wakhe kodwa ujabule. Wabalula ukuthi kuningi adlule kukho ngesenzo sababulali."Sinezingane siphoqeleke ukuthi sishiye ikhaya lethu, siye ekubhaceni ngenxa yezinsongo ebesizithola. Bengishayelwa ucingo izinombolo ezifihliwe, zingitshele ukuthi angihambe ngiyosula icala, kungenjalo nami ngizobulawa,” kusho uNksz Ndlovu.Uqhuba wathi ubevele abatshele kwezikabhoqo ukuthi akukho cala azolisula ngoba icala eloMbuso akulona elakhe.Uveze nokuthi ukubulawa komyeni wakhe kwashiya omkhulu umonakalo ezinganeni zakhe, athe zonhlanu zisasesikoleni."Ngaphandle kokulimala komqondo ngoba bezisondelene kakhulu noyise, kwaphoqa ukuthi ngizikhiphe ezikoleni ezizimele, ziyofunda kwezikahulumeni ngoba imali ibingasangeni kahle ngamatekisi asishiya nawo,” kusho uNksz Ndlovu.Uthe umufi wayenamatekisi ayisishiyagalombili ePitoli, bese eba mathathu eMpangeni, wathi uphoqeleke ukuthi awathuthe awaseMpangeni awayise ePitoli ngoba kungasebenzeki."Nakhona kuyafiliza, kuyasho ukuthi sekushintshe isandla, akusefani nangesikhathi kusekhona yena,” kusho uNksz Ndlovu.Elandisa ngokubulawa komyeni wakhe, uthe into ayibanga noBiyela ukufikiswa kwezingane sekwedlule isikhathi esikoleni.Uthe izingane zendawo zazithuthwa imoto kaBiyela, bathola izikhalazo esikoleni, othisha bethi zihlale zifika sekwedlule isikhathi."Umyeni wami wakhuluma kaningi noBiyela ezwakalisa ukungenami ngoba imoto yakhe ibizithatha ngo-5 ekuseni izingane emakhaya, sixakeke uma sezifika sekwedlule isikhathi esikoleni,” kuchaza uNksz Ndlovu.Uqhube wathi umufi wavele wazikhipha ezakhe izingane emotweni kaBiyela, waqala ngokuzihambisa yena esikoleni, ngaphambi okuba azitholele enye imoto eyayiya ngakhona ezikoleni zezingane."Abazali bavele bazikhipha nezabo, bazifaka kule moto etholwe umyeni wami. Kwaphuma izingane ezingu-12 emotweni kaNkunzi, wadinwa wafa, ethi umyeni wami umphuce umsebenzi,” kusho yena.Uthe baqala lapho bathola izinsongo, uBiyela eshayela ucingo umufi emtshela kwezikabhoqo ukuthi izinsuku zakhe sezibaliwe. UNksz Ndlovu uthe naye wayemsongela, ethi akusensuku zatshwala amgqokise inzilo."Ingane ngayinye yayikhokha uR500 ngenyanga. Okusho ukuthi uNkunzi wabulala umyeni wami embulalela uR6 000,” kubalisa uNksz Ndlovu.UBiyela noPakkies baboshwa ngalo usuku lwesigameko njengoba icala balenzela budebuduze nesiteshi samaphoyisa, avele abajaha esizwa nawumphathi. Ngenxa yengcindezi, bayigingqa imoto ababebaleka ngayo, uBiyela waphuma wabaleka eshiya ngemumva umazisi, amakhadi asebhange, ilayisense neselula. Amaphoyisa ngaphakathi emotweni afica uPakkies, nomunye wesilisa owaphenduka ufakazi woMbuso.UNksz Ndlovu ubonge umphakathi ngokumeseka kusuka liqala icala, waphinde wancoma abaseshi ngokugojela ababulali.
KUSUKE umsindo ecaleni lokubulawa kukaSenzo Meyiwa kuphikiswana ukuthi kuyiqiniso yini ukuthi uKelly Khumalo waveza izinombolo zeselula ezimbili emaphoyiseni wazigodla ezinye.UMeyiwa owayeyisilomo sikanozinti we-Orlando Pirates neBafana Bafana, wadutshulwa wabulawa ekaKelly eVosloorus, eGauteng ngo-2014. Kushushiswa abalisa abahlanu okuthiwa banikwa itoho lokujuqa uMeyiwa.Izolo bekuphekwa ngemibuzo ungoti wamaselula wasemaphoyiseni uLieutenant Colonel Gideon Gouws emuva kokuqeda ukwethula ubufakazi.Icala lisesigabeni lapho uMbuso weneka khona ubufakazi bamaselula uzama ukuveza ukuxhumana kwabamangalelwa nokwazana kwabo.U-Advocate Thulani Mngomezulu omele ummangalelwa wesithathu, uMthobisi Mncube uvukuze udaba lwamaselula nezinombolo zikaKelly. UMngomezulu ubezama ukuveza ukuthi uMncube akaze axhumane noKelly bexoxa ngokujuqa uMeyiwa. UMngomezulu uthe unencwadi kaKelly efungelwe lapho edalula khona izinombolo zakhe ezimbili.UMngomezulu uthe kulezi zinombolo akuveli ukuthi uKelly waxhumana noMncube. UMngomezulu unqandwe yiJaji uRatha Mokgoatlheng elithe kuke kwavela ukuthi uKelly wayenezinombolo noma amaselula amaningi ngaphezu kwayisithupha.IJaji licele uMshushisi woMbuso u-Advocate George Baloyi ukuthi alekelele kulokhu. UBaloyi uhambisane nejaji wathi ziningi izinombolo zikaKelly ezatholwa amaphoyisa kunalezo aziveza yena." Nkosi yenkantolo ufakazi owungoti wamaselula uColonel Lambertus Steyn wathi uKelly wayenezinombolo eziyisishiyagalombili,’’ kusho uBaloyi.Udaba lwamaselula kaKelly luke lwavela phambilini ngesikhathi kuthiwa wayexhumana nabamangalelwa. Ngesikhathi abameli bepheka ufakazi ngemibuzo kuke kwasuka isidumo kusolwa iJaji ngokuxhamazela nokuba nethika.UMngomezulu usole iJaji ngokuba nethika lingamniki ithuba elanele lokwendlala udaba." Inkosi yenkantolo ibuye igagamele ingabi nakho ukubekezela,’’ kusho uMngomezulu. IJaji langazibeka phansi nalo lathi hhayi ngoba lihluthuka kodwa likhuluma iqiniso.UMnuz Sipho Ramosepele ubuye wakhala ngento efanayo ethi ijaji alibaphathi kahle bengabameli libuye lingababekezeleli kahle. Icala liyaqhubeka namuhla kulindeleke ukuthi uMbuso ubize omunye ufakazi.
KUPHAZAMISEKE izinhlelo zokugubha usuku lokuzalwa komgilwa (18) ngoMgqibelo 'edlwengulwa’ umastende okuqashe kuye umndeni wakhe e-Extension 3, eChesterville.Lesi sigameko kuthiwa senzeke kwi-B&B yakhe lona wesilisa okuthiwa uphinde abe yinesi esibhedlela esizimele, iLife Westville, aphinde abe sekomitini le-ward elithenjwayo.Unina kamgilwa elandisa ngesigameko, uthe senzeka nje, bebehlele ukuthi bazomkhipha, ayojabulela usuku lwakhe lokuzalwa uma bebuya emsebenzini.Uthe umgilwa ubhozonyelwe umastende ngesikhathi ethunywe esinye isiqashi kwesinye esihlala emiqashweni yakhe lona wesilisa, encikene neB&B khona e-Extension 3."Luvele lonakala usuku lwakhe sekuvela lo mshophi, kwathina singabazali bakhe sadunyelwa amakhanda, kwaphela nokuthi besimhlelele okuhle," kusho unina. Eqhubeka nokulandisa uthe: "Ingane ibonwe esinye isiqashi esihlala naso, ikhala. Sayibuza ukuthi ikhalelani, yangafuna ukusho, kwaze kwaba ukuthi igonyuluka sekubuya uyise emsebenzini,” kusho unina kamgilwa.Uqhube wathi bathole ukuthi bekungesikho okokuqala eyigila."Bese kungokwesibili. Ubethi uma eyidlwengula, ayisabise ngokuthi uzoyibulala bese eyoyiphosa kude lapho engeke iphinde itholwe khona muntu,” kusho unina kamgilwa.Uqhube wathi, esigamekweni sakamumva, umastende uze wengeza ngelithi usazoyiphinda futhi.Uthe baphoqelekile ukuthi bathuthe kulo mqasho ngeSonto, emva kwesigameko."Ngeke ngikukhohlwe akwenze kithina. Uziphathise okwesilwane ekubeni besimethemba,” kusho unina kamgilwa, oveze ukuthi ngesikhathi ethola ucingo olumazisa ngesigameko, wake wahlala phansi, waphinde wasukuma ngenxa yokungakukholwa ayekutshelwa.Uyise kamgilwa uthe okubahlukumeza kunakho konke ukuthi lona wesilisa ubefike aqoqe irenti ngapha ezenza usomabhizinisi othembekile bese eyodlwengula indodakazi yabo ngale.Udalule ukuthi bese kuzophela unyaka wesibili beqashe emqashweni walona wesilisa kanti ngesikhathi sebehamba, ufune ngodli R900 ngaphambi kokuba baphume.Ukhale ngokusatshiswa abakubo kamsolwa nabanye abantu abangaziwa, abafika bukhoma bezobatshela ukuthi abasule icala."Izolo nje (esho ngoLwesibili) ukhona ofike kulo mqasho omusha esesikuwo, ngoba usendaweni, wafike wayibamba ngesidlozana, ethi ayiyosula icala. Uphinde wathi uzolokhu ebuya kuze kwenziwe le nto ayishoyo,” kusho uyise kamgilwa.Uthe umgilwa ufunda uGrade 11 kodwa usamile esikoleni kulandela isigameko njengoba engekho esimweni esikahle ngokomqondo.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa ophiko oluphenya amacala oDlame lwaseMndenini, ukuVikelwa kweZingane nawoCansi eBrighton Beach lubophe owesilisa (30) emva kokudlwengulwa kwentombazane ngoMgqibelo. "Umsolwa uvele enkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini ngoLwesibili," kusho uNetshiunda.

UQALE kabusha umdonsiswano ngendaba yomhlaba ongaphansi kwamakhosi KwaZulu-Natal, onganyelwe isikhwama Ingonyama Trust njengoba iSilo izolo senekele izwe ngezinkinga zaso nebhodi eliphethe.Uqhekeko phakathi kweSilo uMisuzulu kaZwelithini nohulumeni luhlale obala emhlanganweni wamakhosi obusoLundi.Kulo mhlangano iSilo sikhale ngokukhishwa inyumbazane yibhodi leNgonyama Trust. Ibhodi laqokwa uNgqongqoshe wezoLimo, uNkk Thoko Didiza, ngonyaka odlule.ISilo yiso esinguSihlalo weNgonyama Trust, nokuyisikhundla esisithathe kulo nyaka emva kokususwa kwenkosi uThanduyise kaMpiyezintombi Mzimela.ISilo sithe amalungu ebhodi awafuni ukusamukela njengoSihlalo walo."Ngicela ukusho ukuthi asizwani kuleli bhodi. Abafuni ukungamukela, bafuna ukungixosha. Angazi ukuthi bazongixosha kanjani ngoba phela yimina ophethe Ingonyama Trust, kuza amakhosi emva kwami. Basayina izinto ezingekho emthethweni. Angithi phela bayazi ukuthi ngimatasa ngeminye imisebenzi yesizwe.”ISilo sithe ngeke sivume ukuthi Ingonyama Trust iphele, saphinde sakhononda ngokungabi bikho kukaNkk Didiza emhlanganweni wayizolo.Okhulumela uNkk Didiza, uMnuz Reggie Ngcobo, uthe uNkk Didiza akazange amenywe kulo mhlangano."Siyakweshwama lokhu okushiwo uNgangezwe. Asizange sisithole isimemo. Indaba yalo mhlangano besiyizwela emoyeni. Siyibonile nje incwadi indiza emoyeni, kumenywa amakhosi.”Akuqali manje ukubhekana ngeziqu zamehlo kukaZulu nohulumeni ngodaba lweNgonyama Trust.Udaba lombango weNgonyama Trust luqale ukususa udweshu ngesikhathi ithimba elaliholwa owayengumengameli, uMnuz uKgalema Montlanthe, liphakamisa ukuthi Ingonyama Trust ihlakazwe.Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni iSilo uGoodwill Zwelithini kaBhekuzulu sibize imbizo kaZulu eyayisoLundi lapho kwahuba khona isimo kunukwa inhangano ebusayo i-ANC ngokuthi izama ukuphuca amakhosi umhlaba.ISilo sithe umbango wesihlalo sobukhosi bukaZulu udala ukuthi abangayifuni Ingonyama Trust bathole ithuba lokuyiqeda.ISilo sibalule amacala afakwa uMntwana uMbonisi kaBhekuzulu, esithe amanye sengathi 'uvele aphuphe ebusuku bese evuka ekuseni eyowafaka'.Sithe sona asinendaba nemihlomulo esiyithola kuhulumeni, sathi singaphila ngaphandle kwayo.ISilo siphinde sasebenzisa ithuba izolo ukwethula ngokusemthethweni uNdlunkulu waso omusha, (Nomzamo) uKaMyeni.UNdunankulu kaZulu, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, uthe amalungu ebhodi eNgonyama Trust nabasebenzi benza sengathi Ingonyama Trust eka-Nkk Didiza."Ngesikhathi iSilo sihlela lo mhlangano, isikhulu esiphezulu kwiNgonyama Trust, sibuze ukuthi ngabe uNkk Didiza uwugunyazile yini umhlangano.”Omele iSilo endlini yobuholi bomdabu, uMntwana uSimphiwe Zulu, ubuze ukuthi kungani Ingonyama Trust iphethwe ehhovisi likaNkk Didiza."Kungani ingaphethwe lapha KwaZulu-Natal? Laba bantu abayiphethe ePitoli abanandaba nayo, bafuna ibhidlike. Ukuba iphethwe lapha KwaZulu-Natal ngabe iphethwe abantu abayikhathalelayo.”Inkosi Russell Nsikayezwe Cebekhulu ikhale ngokuthi amalungu ekomiti lasePhalamende elibhekelele ezomhlaba awayifuni Ingonyama Trust.Uthe uZulu kufanele uhlanganise imali, ukuze uyokulwa udaba lweNgonyama Trust enkantolo.Usihlalo wendlu yobuholi bomdabu KwaZulu-Natal, iNkosi Sifiso Shinga, namakhosi asesigungwini sale ndlu, bebengekho emhlanganweni.Ngaphambi komhlangano uShinga ubebhale incwadi, ephakamisa ukuthi iSilo sihlehlise umhlangano.Iphini likaNdunankulu kaZulu, iNkosi Phathisizwe Chiliza, lithe ngesikhathi lisengusihlalo wendlu, abakaze baphikisane nokusuke kushiwo iSilo.Uthe babeshiya konke ababekwenza uma sekukhulume iSilo.

Sesisaba noma kuthiwa izingane ziya esikoleni, sishaywa uvalo ngoba asazi ukuthi kuzokwenzekani kuzo.”UNksz Qhubo Ngema, onebhizinisi lokuwasha amateki, ukhale ngamathuba emisebenzi noxhaso kosomabhizinisi abasafufusa.
LIHLEHLISELWE inyanga ezayo yiNkantolo yeMantshi yaseHarding, icala lowokufika kuleli okuthiwa ngesonto eledlule, uvukwe yisikhwele wagenca ngocelemba isoka lobeyintombi yakhe. Umgilwa kuthiwa ulimale kanzima esandleni.Lo msolwa ona-27 (esingenalo igama lakhe) okuthiwa ungowokudabuka eSomalia, ubevele enkantolo ngoMsombuluko, ngecala lokushaya ngenhloso yokulimaza uMnuz Xolani Mbuthuma (35) okuthiwa usebenza njengonogada ezitolo eHarding. Kusolakala ukuthi uhlaselwe emva kokubonwa wumsolwa emi nentombi okuthiwa ibithandana nomsolwa kodwa isimalile.Lesi sigameko kuthiwa siholele ekutheni umphakathi nabomndeni kamgilwa bavuke umbhejazane, baphoqe ukuthi kuvalwe izitolo zabokufika baseSomalia edolobheni eHarding, kuze kube abafowabo bakamsolwa bamhambisa emaphoyiseni njengoba bekukholakala ukuthi bebemfihlile. USALE elimele kanje uMnuz Xolani Mbuthuma Isithombe: SITHUNYELWEUmfowabo kaMbuthuma, uMnuz Tony Mbuthuma, uthe emva kokuthi abanikazi bamabhizinisi baseSomalia bevakashele umndeni ukuzoxolisa ngesenzo sabo beqinisekisa ukuthi umsolwa sebemhambise emaphoyiseni, bakhokhiswe inhlawulo ethile ngokulimala kukamsolwa, kwathelelwana amanzi."Noma kuvunyelwane ngokuthi icala lizosulwa emva kokuthi abafowabo bakamsolwa bekhokhe inhlawulo ethile, kodwa umsolwa usatoke ngaphakathi njengoba inkantolo inqume ukulihlehlisela uJuni 5, icala. Umhlangano siwuhlale namhlanje (esho izolo), kanti umsolwa ubesevele esevelile enkantolo, kwathathwa lesi sinqumo. Sekuyothi ke uma esevela, umgilwa aye enkantolo aveze ukuthi sekuxoxiwe,” usho kanje.Elandisa ngokulimala kukamfowabo okuthwa ugenceke kanzima esandleni ezama ukuvika, uthe ngoLwesine esephuma emsebenzini ushayelwe ucingo yintombi yakhe yeza ngasesangweni lalapho asebenzela khona. Ngesikhathi besazimele, kuthiwa kuqhamuke umsolwa wabuza intombi ukuthi bayini nalo muntu emi naye. Uthi imchazelile ukuthi bayathandana njengoba yena (umsolwa) isamala. Kuthiwa umsolwa uphuthume esitolo sakhe wabuya esebelethe ucelamba emhlane, ngesikhathi umgilwa enganakile elibele ukukhuluma nentombi yakhe. UMbuthuma uthe abantu abebekhona bazamile ukuxwayisa umgilwa ukuthi akabaleke, kwasho ukuthi bese kusemuva kwesikhathi, umsolwa eseseduze kakhulu, kwaphoqa ukuthi avike ngezandla okulapho alimale khona.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uConstable Thenjiswa Ngcobo, uthe kuboshwe owesilisa oneminyaka engu-27 ngecala lokushaya ngenhloso yokulimaza. Uzobuyela enkantolo ngenyanga ezayo.
LIZOGAYA ngomunye umhlathi kubafundi abenza uGrade 4 ezikoleni ngonyaka ozayo njengoba sebezofunda ezinye izifundo ngolimi lwebele. Izifundo, iMaths neNatural Science zizoqala ukufundwa ngolimi lwebele ukuze kunciphe isihlava sabafundi abafeyilayo ngenxa yokuthi basuke sebefundiswa ngesiNgisi.Lokhu kuvezwe nguNgqonqoshe weMfundo eyisiSekelo, uNkk Angie Motshekga, izolo ekhuluma engqungqutheleni ebheka ukufunda ngezilimi zesintu kuhlanganisa nesiNgisi eBlomfontein.UNkk Motshekga uthe ucwaningo luveza ukuthi abafundi bayafeyila uma sebekwaGrade 4 ngenxa yokuthi basuke sebeshintshe ulimi lokufunda sebefundiswa ngesilungu.Uveze ukuthi kusuka kwaGrade R kuya kwaGrade 3, abafundi bafundiswa ngolimi lwebele bese kushintsha izinto uma sebefka kwaGrade 4, lapho sekudingeka bafundiswe ngesilungu."Ucwaningo luveza ukuthi abafundi abafundiswa ngezilimi abazincela ebeleni, benza kahle kakhulu. Uma uqhathanisa izibalo zocwaningo uthola ukuthi abafundiswa ngolimi lwabo okuyisiNgisi kanjalo nesiBhunu benza kahle kunalabo abasuke bekhuluma lezi zilimi njengezengeziwe. Umfundi ongaluncelanga ebeleni lolu limi, uqale atolikele olimini lwebele, ngaphambi kokuba aphendule umbuzo,” kusho uNkk Motshekga. Uveze ukuthi abafundi baze baqale ukwenza kahle uma sebekwaGrade 9."Lokhu kuveza ukuthi basuke sebeqala ukusibamba isilungu yingakho benza kahle uma sebekuleli banga. Kusuka kwaGrade 4 kuya kwamanye amabanga kusuke kumbulwa kwembeswa kulabo abangaluncelanga ebeleni ulimi abafunda ngalo.” Uthe baluqala kancane kancane lolu hlelo ngoba abafuni ukuxina abafundi."Kukhona abathi sifuna ukubabuyisela eGibhithe ngokuthi sibafundise ngezilimi zabo. Kwamanye amazwe abafundi bakhona benza kahle kakhulu ngoba basuke befunda ngezilimi zabo.” UDkt Mark Chetty, obhekele izivivinyo emnyangweni kazwelonke, uveze ukuthi yingakho nocwaningo lubalula ukuthi abafundi bakwaGrade 4 abakuqondi abafundayo.Uthe bazoqala ngezifundo ezimbalwa kwaGrade 4 bese benabela kwamanye amabanga eminyakeni elandelayo."Ngo-2026 sinabela kwaGrade 5, size sifinyelele kwaGrade 7. U-80% wezinto ezizofundwa kwaGrade 4 ngonyaka ozayo, zizofundwa ngolimi lwebele bese u-20% ufundwe ngesiNgisi. KwaGrade 7 kuzolingana, njengoba u-50% kuzoba ngolimi lwebele bese kuthi omunye kube isiNgisi,” kusho uChetty. Uveze ukuthi abafundi bazokwazi ukuphendula ngalezi zilimi zombili, okungaba isiZulu nesilungu.UNkk Motshekga uthe baqale bavivinya lolu hlelo e-Eastern Cape, iminyaka eyishumi wathi lube yimpumelelo."Kuzobe kungokokuqala ukuthi eminyakeni engu-30 izwe lakhululeka, sibhalise siphinde sicwaninge ukuthi abafundi baphasa kanjani uma bebhala ngolimi lwabo iMaths nezinye izifundo.”Uchithe ukuthi bafuna ukuqeda ngesiBhunu njengoba kukhona abafafaza la mampunge wathi zonke izilimi zesintu ziyalingana emnyangweni.
KUVALIWE ukuthuthwa kwemfuyo eMpangeni, oLundi naseVryheid, kuhlasela amatele kulezi zindawo.Lesi sifo sike sahlasela ezindaweni eziningi kulesi sifundazwe nyakenye njengoba sesibuyile futhi.UMnyango wezoLimo KwaZulu-Natal, uthe zimbili izigameko zalesi sifo eziqinisekisiwe; esaseMpangeni nesaseVryheid, esesithathu sasoLundi sisaphenywa.UMphathiswa walo mnyango, uMnuz Super Zuma, uthe ukuhamba kwemfuyo isuka kwezinye izindawo iya kwezinye yikho okuyimbangela yokuthi kubuye lesi sifo eKZN ngoba imfuyo enalesi sifo ihlangana nengenaso bese iyayithelela."Kuzo zombili izindawo ezinobungozi obukhulu neyodwa enobungozi obuncane, sekubanjwe imihlangano nobuholi bendabuko, izinhlangano zemfuyo, abalimi, abahweba ngemfuyo kubo bobathathu omasipala," kusho uZuma.Uthe kusukela kubikwe isigameko sokuqala, umnyango uqinise izinhlelo zokugoma, waqala ukusebenza ngokuqapha okuqhubekayo ngempilo yezinkomo.Uqhube wathi uyethemba ukuthi ososeshini bezifundazwe namakomiti azokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi bonke abafuyi abangamalungu nabangewona amalungu bayayigoma imfuyo yabo ukuze kunqandwe ukusabalala kwalesi sifo.
ZENZE okungajwayelekile izinswelaboya okuthiwa zigqekeze indlu yebandla lamaRoma aKhatholika e-Oakford, eVerulam, maqede zaphuza iwayini zashiya kumapeketwane ngaphakathi.Kuvela ukuthi ziqale zaphula umnyango zase zingena ngaphakathi. Ilungu likhale ngokuthi maningi amagatsha angaphansi kwale pherishi angeke asakhonza ngenxa nje yalesi simo.Amakholwa alawo magatsha okuthiwa mane, azosala dengwane ngenxa yalesi simo esibehle ngaphezulu.Leli lungu lebandla lidalule ukuthi bese kungokwesibili izinswelaboya zihlasela kule ndlu yesonto. Akukapheli nesikhathi esingakanani njengoba bake baligqekeza, basusa nothayela waphezulu,'' lisho kanje.Ilungu lisole amaphoyisa lathi ayadembesela, akukho okungakho ababalekelela ngakho, lathi ukuba ayangenelela ngabe abazitholi bebhekene nengwadla engaka yokugqekezwa kwendlu yesonto.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZululu Natal, uConstable Thenjiswa Ngcobo, usiqinisekisile isigameko.Uthe amaphoyisa aseVerulam aphenya isigameko sokugqekezwa kwendlu yesonto. Uthe kusolakala ukuthi kunabantu abathile abagqekeze indlu yesonto, bangena ngaphakathi."Kukhona nezinto okuvela ukuthi bazintshontshile sebengene ngaphakathi,'' usho kanje.Kwenzeka lesi sigameko nje, Isolezwe emasontweni amabili edlule, libike ngokubanjwa inkunzi kwabafundi nabazali besinye sezikole ezakhelene naleli sonto. Abafundi baseSacred Heart Secondary nabanye abazali babanjwa inkunzi yizigebengu okuthiwa zafike zaqhumisa izibhamu kusanda kuphuma isikole. Abafundi kuthiwa basala bethuthumela emuva kwesigameko. Kule ndawo kukhona nesikole samabanga aphansi.
Lithathe elinye igxathu udaba lweholidi lwaseDubai olwathathwa wuNobhala Jikelele we-ANC uMnuz Fikile Mbalula nomndeni wakhe ngo-2016 njengoba uphiko lwezokushushisa oluzimele lwe-AfriForum lukholwa wukuthi kukhona okumele aphendule ngakho.I-AfriForum imemezele ngoLwesithathu ekuseni ukuthi isithole idokodo emaphoyiseni ngemuva kokufaka isicelo kulandelwa umthetho iPromotion of Access to Information Act (PAIA).Ngonyaka odlule uphiko lwezokushushiswa komphakathi iNational Prosecuting Authority (NPA) yathi ngeke ize imshushise uMbalula ngezinsolo zokushushumbisa imali.Umbiko woMvikeli woMphakathi wango-2019 wathi iNPA kumele ibheke izinsolo zokuthi inkampani iSedgars Sports yakhokha izindleko zeholidi likaMbalula ngoDisemba ka-2016 ngesikhathi esanguNgqongqoshe wezemiDlalo, ubuCiko namaSiko kuzwelonke.I-AfroForum ithe ngemuva kokuthola idokodo ikholwa wukuthi uMbalula kumele aphendule."Ngemuva kokuhlaziya ubufakazi, kucace bha ukuthi isinqumo sokungamshushisi uMbalula sasingenasisekelo. Ubufakazi bukhomba ukuthi kukhona ukuvumelana okungekho emthethweni okwakukhona phakathi kofakazi namaphoyisa; ukuhluleka ukuthatha izitatimende kofakazi ababalulekile; ukuhluleka ukuqoqa amabhuku nemininingwane ebalulekile kanjalo nokungasebenzisani kahle kwamaphoyisa nabashushisi," kusho uBarry Bateman, okhulumela i-AfriForum.Uthe ubufakazi bukhomba ukuthi baningi abakhokhela izindleko zempilo yakhe ewubukhazikhazi."Kubukeka sengathi uMbalula ubefikelwa ngamaphoyisa neNPA. Lokhu sekuqinise umkhankaso wophiko ukuthi wenze isiqiniseko sokuthi uMbalula uyavela enkantolo."
IPHINI leNhloko yamaJaji kuleli, iJaji Mandisa Maya, eliphakanyiselwe kwesenhloko yamajaji, lithi lisungule umgomo wokuvikela ozakwabo ezenzweni zocansi.IJaji Maya lidalule lokhu izolo, ngesikhathi kunenhlolokhono lapho beliphekwa ngemibuzo yiJudicial Service Commission (JSC), ebiholwa yiNhloko yamaJaji kuleli, iJaji Raymond Zondo.IJaji uMaya liphakanyiswe nguMengameli uCyril Ramaphosa, wathi yilona alibona lifanelwe wukuvala isikhala sikaZondo, oseyodla endala. Kuvele ukuthi iJaji uMaya liqhamuke nombono wokuthi kube nomgomo wokubhekana nenkinga yezenzo zokunukubezwa kozakwabo emsebenzini."Lowo msebenzi uyaqhubeka futhi ususemaphethelweni, sawubhala umbiko wokuqala waya kubaphathi bawubuyisa bathi asilungise okuthile. Sisanda kulungisa nje sawuhambisa umbiko siyethemba uzophumelela kulokhu,’’ kusho iJaji uMaya.UZondo uvumele phezulu wathi ikomiti impela uyalazi liholwa yiJaji uMaya futhi kwaba wumbono walo. IJaji uMaya lithe kufanele kubhekisiswe indaba yezimo zokusebenza namaholo ozakwabo."Izimo zokusebenza kufanele zibe zinhle ukuze sihehe abantu abasezingeni eliphezulu. Ngiyazi nje ukuthi izimantshi zike zasabisa ngokuya esitelekeni nongqongqoshe uyakwazi lokho,’’ kuchaza iJaji uMaya.Ungene odabeni lokunakekelwa kwezempilo nokuqinisekisa ukuthi baphile kahle ngoba babhekene nomsebenzi obucayi nobalulekile.Uthe uzimisele ngokusukumela udaba lwezokuphepha ezinkantolo wathi kunezigameko zokuhlaselwa kozakwabo lapho okusuke kufanele baphephe khona. Uthe uMengameli wamaJaji eGauteng, iJaji Dunstan Mlambo, uke waba ngumgilwa wobugebengu enkantolo.IJaji uMaya lithinte nodaba lokuvikelwa kwesithunzi sezobulungiswa lathi uhlaka lwezokuxhumana kufanele likhuphule amasokisi lufundise abantu ngokusebenza kwamajaji.Uthe umphakathi uke ukhale ngezinto ezilula nje okufanele ngabe uyafundiswa ngazo njengokuboshwa komuntu adedelwe ngebheyili. Uthe ukungabi nolwazi kwabantu kwenza baphelelwa ukwethemba umkhakha wezobulungiswa.Ijaji lithe enye inkinga enkulu wukuthi kunabantu abanegama emphakathini abahlalele ukugxeka ezobulungiswa esidlangaleni nje, bebe bengazifundanga izinqumo zamajaji.

Labo abathi bafuna ukuba ondunankulu, bazogcina ngokuba ondunankulu emizini yabo. Amaphupho nje lawa esizowaqeda ngesonto elizayo. Angeke babe ondunankulu sisekhona.”UDlamini uthe i-ANC izophuma emandleni, wanxusa abaseNanda ukuba baye elibeni likamengameli wokuqala we-ANC, uJohn Dube, bayombikela ukuthi i-ANC iyaphuma emandleni ngesonto elizayo.
UNGOTI wamaselula uLieutenant Colonel Gideon Gouws ecaleni lokufa kukaSenzo Meyiwa, uveze ubufakazi obulahla ummangalelwa wesibili uBongani Ntanzi.UMeyiwa owayeyisilomo se-Orlando Pirates neBafana Bafana, wadutshulwa wabulawa ekubo kaKelly Khumalo eVosloorus, eGauteng ngo-2014.Bahlanu abalisa abashushiswayo, icala lisesigabeni lapho uMbuso wethula khona ubufakazi ozimisele ukugojela ngabo abamangalelwa. Kufundwa ubufakazi bamaselula obuveza ukuxhumana kwabo ngaphambi nangemuva kwesigameko.UGouws weneke ubufakazi bokuthi iselula kaNtanzi yayidonsa eduze kwesiteshi samaphoyisa eVillieria, ePitoli lapho ayetoke khona. Phambilini uNtanzi waphika ukuthi watholwa neselula esesitokisini.UGouws uthe iselula yasebenza ngesikhathi idonsa ngasesitokisini okwakuvalelwe kusona uNtanzi. Kuvela ukuthi kunezithombe zephephandaba elalishicilele udaba lwecala lokufa kukaMeyiwa ezabukwa kwiselula eyatholwa kuNtanzi.UBUFAKAZI bamaselula buveza okwehlukile kunalokhu okwashiwo wummangalelwa wesibili uBongani Ntanzi owaphika ukuthi watholwa neselula esitokisini Isithombe : OUPA MOKOENA/INDEPENDENT MEDIA" Izithombe zavulwa zahlelwa kabusha ngo-9 ebusuku, kunesithombe sephephandaba esikhuluma ngaleli cala esavulwa sahlelwa kabusha sekwedlule umzuzu kushaye u-9 ebusuku,’’ kusho uGouws.Phambilini iphoyisa uSergeant Vusumuzi Mogane wethula ubufakazi bokuthi wathola uNtanzi ephethe iselula esitokisini emuva kokulunywa indlebe ngayo.Ummeli kaNtanzi u-Advocate Thulani Mngomezulu wathi ikhasimende lakhe liyakuphika ukuthi latholwa neselula. UMngomezulu wathi iselula kaNtanzi yayikade ithathwe amaphoyisa ngesikhathi eboshwa.Kuvela ukuthi uNtanzi watholwa neselula ngoFebhuwari 2021 esitokisini eyishutheke ezingutsheni zakhe zokulala. Kuvela ukuthi ngaphambi kwalokho iselula yayikade idonsa eQueenswood, ePitoli nokuyindawo esondelene nesiteshi samaphoyisa ayevalelwe kusona uNtanzi.Abamangalelwa bebebukeka bebulandela ngokuzimisela ubufakazi bephethe nebhuku bebhala belalele ngokucophelela. Bebebuye bahlanganise amakhanda sengathi babhunga okuthile sabantu abqhathanisa lokhu okwethulwayo. Kuthe kusaqhubeka lobu bufakazi kwasukuma abameli besola uMbuso ngokuxova ubufakazi. Kuphikiswane ngalokho kwase kuvela ukuthi sekuvele kushaye isikhathi sokuguqa kwecala. UMbuso uthembise ukulungisa lokhu abebekhala ngakho abameli.Kulindeleke ukuthi kuqhutshekwe namuhla kulalelwe ubufakazi bukangoti wamaselula.
ITHOBEKE amanxeba imindeni engaphezu kuka-500 eyayakhele indawo okwakhiwa kuyo idamu laseNanda, kufika uNgqongqoshe waManzi neNhlanzeko, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, izolo, ezokwenza umsebenzi wokugezwa kwayo nokukhunjulwa kwabathandiweyo bayo ababengcwatshwe kule ndawo.UMchunu ubezofeza isicelo le mindeni obese kuhambe iminyaka yasicela kuhulumeni.Usihlalo wale mindeni okuthiwa yasuswa ngendluzula, uMnuz Scara Gcabashe, uthe kube yinto enhle okwenziwe wuhulumeni ekugcineni."Abathandiweyo bethu bambiwa ngo-1988, sangabazi ukuthi bahamba bayongcwatshwaphi,” kusho uGcabashe.Uthe le nto ibibahlupha kakhulu njengoba bengabantu bakholelwayo esintwini."Sibatshele ngo-2017 ukuthi siyawudinga lo mcimbi wokugezwa ngoba besibona sengathi abakutholi ukuphumula abathandiweyo bethu,” kusho yena.Uqhube wathi bonke abathandiweyo babo ababazi ukuthi amaBhunu athi uma ehamba kule ndawo, abangcwabaphi."Uhulumeni wobandlululo wazenzela okuthandwa yiwo. Ngokwemiqingo, bathi bangcwatshwa emathuneni ahlukene eThekwini. Asinaso isiqiniseko salokho,” kubeka uGcabashe.Uveze ukuthi kukhona abanye abangambiwanga, abangaphansi kwamanzi namanje.Uthe ngaphansi kwesizwe samaQadi, ingu-317 imindeni eyasuswa, kuthi esizweni saseMaphephetheni ibe ngu-271. Uthe yonke yalayishwa emalolini ngendluzula.Uthe abanaso isibalo esiqondile semindeni engaphansi kwesizwe sakwaNgcolosi eyasuswa."Yona ayizange ilayishwe ngisho emalolini, yabhunyelwa ngamanzi, abantu baphuma nalokho ababekugqokile kuphela,” kukhumbula uGcabashe.Uphethe ngelithi bagculisekile ngokwenzeke izolo, wathi bayakholwa ukuthi imiphefumulo yabathandiweyo babo izokuthola ukuphumula.UMchunu uthe idamu lakhiwa ngo-1989, ngenhloso yokuthi kuqedwe isomiso samanzi emphakathini, kulekelelwe ukusebenza kwezimboni bese kuthuthukiswa ezokuvakasha ngobuhle balo."Kodwa ngaphansi kwalo kunendaba ebuhlungu, engaxoxwa, yabantu abanikela ngokukhulu, baphinde baphenduka ondingasithebeni,” kusho uMchunu.Uqhube wathi kwathikanyezwa amathuna abathandiweyo bemindeni eyayihlala kule ndawo. "Namuhla (esho izolo) sizovuma ukuthi okwenzeka la, akubanga nabo ubulungiswa, siyaxolisa ukuthi sithathe isikhathi eside kangaka ukufezekisa umcimbi ofana nalo,” kusho uMchunu.Uthe bami nabo bonke labo amazwi abo agcina eya ngokusha ngenxa yobude besikhathi, wathi bayabuqonda ubuhlungu balabo abanabathandiweyo babo abagcina bevaleleka emanzini."Ukukhala kwabo buthule, buyozwiwa ngisho nayizizukulwana,” kusho uMchunu.Uqhube wathi umcimbi wayizolo uwuphawu lokuthi bayazibophezela ezintweni ezingamasiko ezibachazayo njengabantu abamnyama.Kulo mcimbi kwembulwe itshe lesikhumbuzo elichaza ngokwenzeka athe liwuphawu lwethemba.
KUZOTSHALWA amaphoyisa engeziwe ezikhungweni zokuvota ezisezindaweni osekuke kwabikwa izigameko zokungabekezelelani kwezepolitiki KwaZulu-Natal, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amalungu omphakathi avota ngenkululeko nangaphandle kokwesaba.Lokhu kuvele enkulumweni kaMphathiswa wezokuThutha ukuPhepha nokuXhumana koMphakathi kulesi sifundazwe, uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka esithangamini nabezindaba eThekwini, okuthiwa bekuhloswe ngaso ukunekela umphakathi ngamalungiselelo amaphoyisa esifundazwe ukuqinisekisa ukuthula okhethweni likazwelonke nezifundazwe, ngesonto elizayo.KwaNongoma ngenye yezindawo okuthiwa zizoqiniswa ngokwengeziwe ezokuphepha, njengoba inomlando ongemuhle wokubulawa kosopolitiki.UHlomuka uthe evile ku-17 000 amaphoyisa nabanye bezinhlaka zezokuphepha, abazobe betshalwe kuzona zonke izikhungo zokuvotisa esifundazweni."Zonke izikhungo okuzovotelwa kuzo sezibhekisisiwe nangendlela okumele ezokuphepha zimiswe ngakhona kuleso naleso sikhungo. Njengoba ukuvota ngokukhethekile kuzoqala ngoMeyi 27 no-28, sesikulungele. Uhlelo lwethu ukuthi siqinisekise ukuthi zonke izikhungo zivikelwe nabasebenzi bekhomishini yezokhetho i-Independent Electoral Commission," usho kanje.Uthe angu-1 008 amavolontiya azolekelela ukulwa nobugebengu ajutshwe wuphiko lomnyango aphathiswe wona.Uthe kunamathimba alwa nobugebengu azohlala evivele ukuthi uma kunesigijimi esixwayisa ngokwenzeka endaweni ethile, anikele khona ngokushesha. UHlomuka uphinde waveza ukuthi kuzoba nezinkantolo eziyisipesheli ezizohlalela amacala aphuthumayo enenzeka ngesikhathi kuqhubeka ukhetho ukuqinisekisa ukuthi axazululwa ngokushesha.Uthe kunekomiti elihlanganisa wonke amaqembu ezepolitiki ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kuyabhekwana nezimo ezingaphazamisa uzinzo esifundazweni, kanti liyahlangana njalo ukubhekana nalezi zimo.Zingu-4 974 izikhungo zokuvotisa esifundazweni. Nakuba lesi sifundazwe sivakashelwa kakhulu amaqembu ezepolitiki ehlukene ukunxenxa amavoti, uHlomuka uthe kunenhlansi yokubekezelelana kwezepolitiki kwazise kuze kube manje njengoba zingeziningi izigameko ezibikiwe zodlame. Uxwayise abasabalalisa izinto ezingamanga ezingaphehla udllame ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ukuthi bangase bathathelwe izinyathelo.Uqinisekise ukuthi imigwaqo eya ezikhungweni zokuvotisa isesimweni esigculisayo, wathi amathimba ezinhlekelele azobe emi ngomumo ukubhekana nazo zonke izimo zezulu.UHlomuka ubehambisana noKhomishana wamaPhoyisa esifundazweni, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, amncome ngokulwa nobugebengu esifundazweni.
AMAPHOYISA axwayisa abantu abasabalalisa izinto ezingamampunge ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, befaka itwetwe kubahlali, ukuthi bazowukhomba umuzi onotshwala.Lesi sixwayiso esishubile silandela ukusabalala kwenkulumo eqoshiwe ethi kunabantu 'abangamaqabane’ abangu-11 abadutshulwe KwaXimba, KwaZulu-Natal.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe ngamampunge okuqukethwe kule nkulumo futhi bazobhekana nengalo yomthetho abagila le migilingwane.Uqhube wathi kule nkulumo eqoshiwe kuhubhuzwa amanga kuthiwa kunemoto ehamba abantu asebedubule emizini emine KwaXimba."Amaphoyisa ayasigxeka lesi senzo futhi singakuqinisekisa ukuthi yinto engekho okukhulunywa ngayo. Sikhuza umphakathi ukuthi uhlukane nokwenza izitatimende ezingamampunge ezingase zisuse uthuthuva noma zifake abantu ingebhe,” kusho uNetshiunda.Uveze nokuthi asikho isigameko salolu hlobo noma esithinta ipolitiki esibikiwe ukuthi senzeke KwaXimba namaphethelo.Ukhuze abenza lo mkhuba wathi abawuyeke ngoba ungase uqubule udlame emphakathini kungenjalo bazobhekana nengalo yomthetho.Ukhuthaze abantu ukuba bazibike ngokushesha emaphoyiseni izigameko zodlame noma ezokusongelwa, kuhlanganisa nalezo ezithinta ipolitiki."Amaphoyisa ami ngomumo futhi anezinhlelo zokuqapha izakhamuzi futhi agcine ukuthula kusukela manje kuze kudlule ukhetho,” kusho uNetshiunda.Kwesinye isigameko, amaphoyisa akhuze nabasabalalisa inkulomo eqoshiwe ethi kuneziboshwa ezingu-31 ezeqe elolini ebizihambisa enkantolo zisuka ejele iNew Prison.Amaphoyisa athe le nkulumo eqoshiwe indala, ikhuluma ngesigameko esenzeka ngo-2021.Ngokusatshalaliswa kwale nkulumo kabusha kuhloswe ukufaka abantu ingebhe futhi kuphazanyiswe nomsebenzi wamaphoyisa esikhathini esimqoka kangaka,” kuchaza amaphoyisa.

akuqali ukuthi uNkk Sithole-Moloi abuze ngalolu daba.Uthe wakuphendula konke ayekubuzile, wathi namanje uzophinde aphendule kulokho akwazi ukukuphendula."Ngoba bathi bazoqala uphenyo ngokwesigaba u-106 somthetho wokuphathwa komasipala, ezinye izimpendulo bazozithola kahle uma sebeqale uphenyo. Lapho bazobe sebekwazi ukukhuluma nayo yonke iminyango yomkhandlu, bathole izimpendulo ezigcwele.”Khonamanjalo uNksz Ndlela neMeya kaMasipala, uMnuz Sifiso Mkhwanazi, bathole izincwadi ezibabizela enkantolo ukuba bazokwethula ubufakazi ecaleni elithinta inkohlakalo emkhandlwini.Icala lithinta udaba lwesikhulu esavele saqashwa ngokugcwele isikhala somsebenzi singakhangiswanga.UNksz Ndlela noMkhwanazi babizelwe eNkantolo yeMantshi eVryheid, ngoJuni 4.UNksz Ndlela uthe uzoya kokwethula ubufakazi njengokubizwa kwakhe yinkantolo.
