Ngemuva kokuphekwa ngemibuzo kwabasolwa, kucacile ukuthi imfuyo akuyona eyabo.”Umnikazi walezi zimbuzi uzifikele mathupha kule ndawo wakhomba imfuyo yakhe athe ngempela yebiwe. Abasolwa baboshwe ngaleso sikhathi babekwa icala lokweba imfuyo.

I-ACTIONSA KwaZulu-Natal ikhathazwa isimo samabhilidi asenkabeni yeTheku anganakwe muntu, asesetshenziswa abokufika kuleli.Lokhu kuvezwe umholi waleli qembu kulesi sifundazwe, uMnuz Zwakele Mncwango, ngesikhathi ehambele amabhilidi ngoLwesihlanu.UMncwango uthe inhloso yokuhambela amabhilidi bekungukuthi bayohlola isimo nokwenzekayo ngaphakathi kuwo.Uthe kuyakhathaza ukuthi bathole ukuthi iningi lamabhilidi lisesimweni esingagculisi, wathi banezinsolo ezinkulu zokuthi kwenziwa izinto ezingalungile kuwo."Amaningi awo aqhwagwe ngabokufika kuleli. Size sathola nokuthi omunye usomabhizinisi onesitolo kwelinye lamabhilidi, uvale isitolo sakhe ngaphambi kokufika kwethu, okudweba isithombe esicacile sokuthi kula mabhilidi kuqhutshwa imishikashika engalungile,” kusho uMncwango.Uthe okukhathazayo ukuthi amabhilidi anganakiwe awagcini nje ngokuba yizindawo zokuhlala ngokungemthetho kodwa ayinkundla lapho kwenziwa khona izinto ezingalungile."Lokho kubeka engcupheni ezokuphepha zomphakathi,” usho kanje.UMHOLI we-ActionSA ongowesithathu ukusuka ngakwesokudla, uMnuz Zwakele Mncwango, ngesikhathi behambele amabhilidi alaxaziwe eThekwini Isithombe: SITHUNYELWE Wenze iziphakamiso zokungenziwa ukuze amabhilidi asetshenziswe kangcono umphakathi."Eyokuqala into engenziwa ukuthi alungiswe kahle, aphendulwe izindawo zokuhlala ezingambi eqolo njengoba sazi ukuthi iseyinkinga indaba yezindawo zokuhlala eThekwini. Ukuphendula la mabhilidi abe yizindawo zokuhlala ezishibhile, kuzonika usizo lwendawo yokuhlala edingekayo kubantu abadonsa kanzima, kuphinde kuqinisekise ukuthi bahlala endaweni ephephile nehloniphekile,” kusho yena.Uthe okunye okungenziwa ukuthi zilungiswe bese ziphendulwa izindawo zokusebenza kosomabhizinisi abancane."Zingaphendulwa ama-hub aseqophelweni eliphezulu, asize osomabhizinisi abasafufusa ukuthi baqhube amabhizinisi abo ezindaweni ezikahle. Lokho kungalekelela ekutheni kufukuleke umnotho, kwakhe namathuba omsebenzi,” kusho yena.Uthe bayakholwa ukuthi uma kungalungiswa isimo samabhilidi, idolobha lungathuthuka kakhulu bese lokho kuphucula impilo yezakhamuzi zeTheku nezokuphepha.
UPHIKO loKlebe lusebenze ngokuzikhandla ngoMsombuluko, lulandela umkhondo wabasolwa kwelokubulawa kukaDitebogo Phalane.Ngokombiko otholwe yithimba eliphenya icala, umkhondo abawutholile ubaholele eSoshanguve, nase-Atteridgeville. Lapha ithimba libambe abasolwa ababili abaneminyaka engu-29, no-30 ubudala. Kuthiwa batholakale nezibhamu ezimbili okusolakala ukuthi esisodwa sasetshenziswa ngenkathi kubulawa uDitebogo, obeneminyaka emihlanu ubudala.Lezi zibhamu zizohlohlwa ngochwepheshe ukuze kucace uma zike zasetshenziswa kwamanye amacala. Uphenyo lokuqala mayelana nabasolwa luveza ukuthi omunye wabo ungaphandle ngebheyili yamacala okuduna, ukuzama ukubulala nokutholakala nesibhamu esingekho emthethweni. NgoLwesithathu, kulindeleke ukuba babingelele iMantshi ePitoli.
AKUHAMBANGA kahle kowayengumengameli uJacob Zuma ekhala ngaphansi emzamweni wakhe wokuphikelela ukungena ePhalamende. IJaji uLeona Theron leNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo likhiphe isinqumo esilahla uZuma.UZuma ngoDisemba wonyaka odlule, umemezele ukuthi usehamba neqembu elisha i-MK, akasayingeni eye-ANC. Izwe kumanje lilungiselela ukhetho lukazwelonke oluzoba ngoMeyi 29.I-MK ibilibeka ngembaba elokuthi ifuna ukubuyisela uZuma esikhundleni sikamengameli, ake asiphatha amahlandla amabili.INkantolo yoMthethosisekelo yiyona eyayilahle uZuma ngecala lokwedelela inkantolo ngo-2021, yamgweba izinyanga eziwu-15 wangena ejele eMtshezi.Ngokwesigaba 47 (1) (e) soMthethosisekelo, wonke umuntu uvumelekile ukungena ohlwini lwabazoya ePhalamende ngaphandle komuntu ogwetshwe izinyanga ezingaphezulu kwezingu-12 ngaphandle kokunikwa ithuba lokukhokha inhlawulo.I-IEC yamemezela ukuthi uZuma akufanele abe sohlwini lwasePhalamende ngoba walahlwa ngecala. Abe-MK basedlulisela eNkantolo yezoKhetho bafika balunqoba udaba.I-IEC yalwedlulisa udaba yalusa eNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo njengoba befike balunqoba.Umbango ubumaqondana nokuthi uZuma kufanele yini aye ePhalamende njengoba walahlwa ngecala lokwedelela inkantolo. IJaji uTheron lithe uZuma walahlwa ngecala futhi lokho kumile, akujiki. Lathi ukuthi akasiqedanda isigwebo ngenxa yokuthi washeshe wakhishwa nanokuthi wanikwa ushwele kamengameli, akusho lutho ngoba isigaba somthetho sikhuluma ngesigwebo kungakhathalekile ukuthi ugwetshwele icala lobugebengu noma lokwephuma umthetho. Inkantolo ithe uZuma angakwazi ukungena ohlwini lokuya ePhalamende emuva kweminyaka emihlanu kuphele isigwebo sakhe njengoba kusho umthetho. Ijaji lithe kungumsebenzi we-IEC ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu ababa sohlwini lwasePhalamende bathembekile, lathi kungumsebenzi wenkantolo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umthetho uyalandelwa njengoba unjalo. Ungoti wezomthetho, uMnuz Mpumelelo Zikalala, uthe isinqumo senkantolo sisho ukuthi kuphelile ngalolu daba. UZikalala uthe uZuma akanalo ithuba lokwedlulisa icala ngoba isinqumo siphume enkantolo enkulu kunazozonke kuleli.I-IEC ikhiphe isitatimende ithi iyasemukela isinqumo senkantolo, isizokwazi ukubhekana namalungiselelo okhetho ngaphanddle kokuphazamiseka. I-IEC ithe akufanele kube nokudideka ngalolu daba."Ukugwema ukudideka kuhle sicacise ukuthi isinqumo ngeke siphazamise iphepha lokuvota. UZuma uzoba wubuso beqembu lakhe kodwa igama lakhe lizokhishwa ohlwini lwabaya ePhalamende.UZuma nakuba engabonakalanga enkantolo kukhishwa isinqumo kodwa uNobhala-Jikelele we-MK, uMnuz Sihle Ngubane, ubekhona. Ubehamba namanye amalungu e-MK nokuthe uma kuphuma isinqumo babonakala bedangele.Kwenzeka konke lokhu nje, i-MK isanda kuxosha uMnuz Jabulani Khumalo owabhalisa iqembu. UKhumalo ulufake enkantolo udaba lombango weqembu, ufuna kukhishwe uZuma kufakwe yena.UKhumalo umile ekutheni nguyena umholi nomsunguli weqembu osemthethweni futhi uzolwa kuze kube sekugcineni.
NKOSIKHONA CELEOMUNYE wabefundisi asebenokhakhayi oluqinile, odume nangezintshumayelo ezinohlonze nasemisakazweni, uthi akuphele ukucwasana kwamabandla ikakhulukazi phakathi kwamabandla abasindisiwe naweZayoni. UMfu MS Mpungose weBandla iHis Own Bible Church International, wodumo lwezintshumayelo ezisuke zibeka into njengoba injalo futhi onganqeni ukuqinisa ulimi, uthi sesifikile isikhathi sokusebenzisana nokuhambelana phakathi kwabasindisiwe nabaseZayoni ukuze kuphele lobu butha okungazeki nokuthi bakheka kanjani.Ugcizelela ukuthi munye uNkulunkulu okhonzwayo kuwona wonke amabandla.Lokhu ukusho njengoba ezoba yingxenye yendumezulu yenkonzo yebandla laseZayoni Isibusiso Ibandla leNkosi Baptist Church in Zion of Southern Africa, eliholwa nguMbhishobhi Phumlani Dlamini.Le nkonzo izokuba ngoMeyi 25, ehholo lomphakathi iMarromen, eNewcatsle. UMBHISHOBHI Phumlani DlaminiUveze ukuthi phambilini uke wakhonza ebandleni laseZayoni futhi konke wayekubona kukuhle nje."Makuphele ukubakhona kwemingcele ephakathi kwabasindisiwe nebandla laseZayoni. Uzwe nezintshumayelo zabanye zigudla abanye kabi."Into emqoka ukuthi kukhonzwa uNkulunkulu kulelo bandla. Inqobo nje uma engathukwa uNkulunkulu kulelo bandla, konke kuhle ngalo,'' usho kanje.Uthe empeleni ibandla likaNkulunkulu ngobubanzi balo lingabonakala likhula kakhulu uma lingagwema ukupiklelana nokubukelana phansi.Ugcizelele ukuthi yena uNkulunkulu umkhonza noma yikuphi lapho ebona khona ukuthi ukhona futhi ukhonzwa ngeqiniso.UMbhishobhi Dlamini uhambe emazwini kaMpungose wathi yize beyibandla leZayoni, bakhethe ukumsondeza eduze ngoba ungomunye wabaholi abanohlonze olukhulu.Uthe kumqoka ukuthi wonke amabandla asebenzisane ngaso sonke isikhathi, kungabibikho ukuklwebhana okungenasidingo.
ISILO uMisuzulu kaZwelithini sizobikela amakhosi "ngokudayiswa” kwaso yibhodi lesikhwama esigade umhlaba kaZulu, Ingonyama Trust.IMbube ibize umhlangano wamakhosi ophuthumayo ozoxoxa ngeNgonyama Trust.Ibhodi elisha leNgonyama Trust lisanda kwenza isibophezelo sokuthi ngeke liphinde likhokhele izindleko zabameli beSilo uma kunamacala athinta umbango wesihlalo sobukhosi bukaZulu.Lesi bophezelo senziwe eNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu ngeledlule, ngesikhathi kulalelwe icala elifakwe uMntwana uMbonisi kaBhekuzulu, ofuna ukuthi Ingonyama Trust nohulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal bangazikhokheli izindleko zabameli beSilo.Isibophezelo seNgonyama Trust sanenga uNdunankulu kaZulu, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, owaze wasola ibhodi leNgonyama Trust "ngokunikela ngeSilo ezitheni”.Umhlangano wamakhosi uzoba sesiShayamthetho esidala, oNdini, ngoLwesine.UButhelezi uthe umhlangano wangoLwesine ubizwe ngesikhathi esinzima, wathi kunemizamo yokuqeda ngeNgonyama Trust."Kunemizamo yokuphuca amakhosi umhlaba ongaphansi kweTrust, okuwumhlaba amakhosi awugadele uZulu.”UButhelezi usanda kusola uNgqongqoshe wezoLimo nokuThuthukiswa kweziNdawo zaseMakhaya, uNkk Thoko Didiza, ngokuphuca amakhosi ilungelo lokusayina izimvume zokusebenzisa umhlaba.Lezinsolo wazenza emhlanganweni we-IFP namakhosi, owawungeledlule.UButhelezi wathi lezi mvume sezizosayinwa uNkk Didiza."Amakhosi ayazi ukuthi ukusayina amaPTO (permission to occupy) amandla amakhosi, emhlabeni wamakhosi. I-ANC isijikile esithembisweni eyasenza kuMntwana wakwaPhindangene (uMangosuthu Buthelezi) sokuthi umhlaba ongaphansi kweNgonyama Trust ngeke iwuthinte.”UNkk Didiza uziphikile lezi nsolo, wasola uButhelezi ngokudukisa abantu.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nesiteshi sethelevishini esikhokhelwayo.UNkk Didiza uthe isinqumo sokuphuca amakhosi amandla sathathwa yibhodi elaliphethe Ingonyama Trust ngo-2016.Uthe isinqumo sebhodi saphonselwa inselelo izakhamizi zilekelelwa inhlangano iCouncil for the Advancement of the SA Constitution (Casac)."Nebala inkantolo yachitha isinqumo sebhodi. Usihlalo webhodi wangaleso sikhathi wanquma ukudlulisela phambili isinqumo. Njengamanje kunecala elingakaphothulwa eNkantolo yokuDluliswa kwamaCala. Thina silinde isinqumo senkantolo. Ngakho ke akusilo iqiniso lokhu okushiwo uButhelezi. Sithanda ukumxusa ukuthi uma kukhona izinto afuna ukuzidlulisa, alandele imigudu efanele.”UButhelezi uthe emhlanganweni wangoLwesine bazophinde bakhulume ngombuthano obizwa ngeSibaya.Lo mbuthano kaZulu wonkana uzokuba sesigodlweni kwaKhangelamankengane.
BANGU-45 abantu ababoshelwe amacala athinta ukhetho selokhu kuqale isizini yokhetho kuleli.Lokhu kushiwo uLt General Tebello Mosikili, ongomunye wosihlalo bohlaka lombutho wezokuvikela oludidiyelwe, iNational Joint Operations and Intelligence Structure, oluholwa umbutho wamaphoyisa akuleli, iSouth African Police Service (SAPS) ngeSonto, ngesikhathi kunesithangami sabezindaba lapho lolu hlaka belukhuluma khona nabezindaba ngokuzilungiselela kwalo ukubhekana nokhetho lukazwelonke olungoLwesithathu oluzayo.ULt Gen Mosikili, uthe nakuba engeke asho ukuthi mangaki amaphoyisa ahlelelwe ukubhekana nomsebenzi wokugada ukhetho, kodwa angakusho ukuthi bakuhlelele konke okungahle kwenzeke ngamaphoyisa enele nokuthi uma kuba nesidingo amasosha angenelele.Uthe selokhu iqalile isizini yokhetho kuvulwe amacala angu-50, kuwo kwaboshwa abangu-45. Amacala ababhekene nawo awokudala udlame emphakathini, ukulimaza impahla, ukwephula umthetho wokhetho, i-Electoral Act, nokususa izingqwembe zokukhankasa zelinye iqembu. Ababoshiwe abaseGauteng, Limpopo, Mpumalanga naseNorth West."Sesilwenzile uphenyo olubheka ukuthi iziphi iziteshi zokhetho okungenzeka zibe nodlame ngokubheka izindawo ezike zaba nodlame phambilini, isimo esiqhubekayo kulezo zindawo nokunye. Angeke ngizisho ukuthi iziphi lezo ziteshi nokuthi zikuziphi izifundazwe ngoba sihlelele ukubhekana nazo zonke izimo ezingavela kuzo zonke izifundazwe, kuhlanganisa nezinhlekelele zemvelo nezingadalwa ngabantu," kusho uLt Gen Mosikili.Uthe uhlelo lwabo luhlanganisa amasosha, abasebenzi boMnyango wezaseKhaya, amaphoyisa, ezinye izinhlaka zezokuvikela, ezokutakula nezinye."Eziteshini kuzobe kunamaphoyisa azobe esizana nabekhomishini yokhetho, i-Independent Electoral Commission (IEC), ukuze kukhishwe abazofika nezikhali, abazodala udlame, abazokhankasa ngendlela engavumelekile khona eziteshini nokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi asebexoshiwe ngeke besangena eziteshini futhi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, sizobe sibheke abantu abasabalalisa izinto ezisusa udlame ezinkundleni zezokuxhumana. Sizoqapha abe-IEC uma sebehambisa amabhokisi amavoti ezikhungweni, siphinde sibagade uma sebebala. Ngemuva kokhetho, sizoqapha izixuku zabantu abazobe bejabulela ukhetho sibheke ukuthi lokhu akwenziwa ngendlela enodlame," kusho uMosikili.UGeneral Nhlanhla Sizani wombutho wamasosha kuleli, iSouth African National Defence Force, uthe iNiningizimu Afrika ayikho empini ngakho ngeke asho ukuthi mangaki amasosha ajutshelwe ukulekelela ngesikhathi sokhetho." Sizolekelela lapho esizobe sidingeka khona,” kusho uGen Sizani.
UNGQONGQOSHE woMnyango wemiSebenzi yoMphakathi neNgqalasizinda, uMnuz Sihle Zikalala, uthe ukwanda kwezigameko zokufa kwezisebenzi emkhakheni wezokwakha kuphoqa ukuthi babuyekeze imigomo yezokuphepha ezindaweni zokwakha.UZikalala ukusho lokhu esitatimendeni esikhishwe umnyango wakhe izolo, emuva kwesigameko sokushona kwabane kulimale oyedwa, abawelwe udonga abebelakha eBallito, ngoMgqibelo. "Asilona izwe elingenamthetho. INingizimu Afrika inayo imigomo ebekiwe uma kuziwa embonini yezokwakha. Ukwanda kwezigameko zalolu hlobo ngesikhashana nje, kudala ukuthi sikhathazeke,” kusho uZikalala.Uthe okubi ukuthi basazikhotha amanxeba ngesehlakalo saseGeorge, eWestern Cape, kulandela ukudilika kwesakhiwo phezu kwabasebenzi, kwafa abangu-33.Uqhube wathi bathe besababaza lokho, kwenzeka esinye isigameko eNgcobo, e-Eastern Cape, lapho okufe khona abayisithupha."Kuzodingeka uphenyo olunzulu kuzo zonke lezi zigameko, ukuze kutholakale umnyombo wokuthi zibangelwe yini nokuthi kungani le mboni isibhekana nokwanda kwalezi zigameko?” kusho kanje.Kuvele ukuthi abashonile bebedabuka e-Eastern Cape.Lokhu kuvezwe yikhansela lendawo, uNkk Tammy Colley, ngesikhathi ekhuluma neSolezwe izolo.UNkk Colley uthe ukhulume kafishane nabasondelene noyedwa obembozekile."Ngesikhathi befika endaweni yesigameko, bebekhala bengalawuleki. Sithole ukuthi bonke abathintekayo bebengabokudabuka e-Eastern Cape, kodwa baqashe kulesi sifundazwe ukusondezela umsebenzi,” kubeka uNkk Colley.Uqhube wathi isigameko senzeke ngabo-9 ekuseni, banikela khona."Sithole abezimo eziphuthumayo ezehlukene sebevele befikile. Indawo lapho okwenzeke khona isigameko bekuyikhaya lomuntu,” kusho uNkk Colley, oqhube wathi ubengekho umnikazi wendawo ngesikhathi kutakulwa abambozekile.INDAWO yesigameko lapho okushone khona izisebenzi ezine ebezakha Isithombe: DOCTOR NGCOBO/ INDEPENDENT MEDIASouth Uthe babonga umphakathi ngokusheshe ubike ukuthi sekwenzeke isigameko nokuthi usondele masinyane emva kwesigameko.Uthe babuye babawusizo nasethimbeni ebelitakula beliboleka izinsiza ezifana nama-generator, ukudla neziphuzo.UNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Nomusa Dube-Ncube edlulisa amazwi enduduzo emindenini yabasholelwe, uthe kuyakhathaza ukwenzeka kwesinye isigameko embonini yezokwakha."Kuyadabukisa futhi kubuhlungu ukudlulisa amazwi enduduzo emindenini, abangani nozakwabo babane abalahlekelwe yimpilo yabo. Lesi sehlo silethe losizi emphakathini, sikhala nalabo abalahlekelwe,” kusho uNkk Dube-Ncube.Uthe ngesikhathi belinde umphumela wophenyo lwamaphoyisa ngokuholele kule nhlekelele, bazoqhubeka nokunika imindeni ethintekayo ukwesekwa nalolonke usizo eludingayo.Uthe bafisela nophuthunyiswe esibhedlela ukululama okusheshayo, wathi babonga nokusebenza ngokuzikhandla kwamathimba abesebenzi ukutakula abagilwa.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa avule amadokodo okufa kwabantu amane emva kokuthi udonga luwele kubasebenzi abahlanu, kwashona abane."Amaphoyisa aseqale nophenyo ngembangela yokuwa kodonga oluwele phezu kwabasebenzi endaweni yokwakha esemgwaqweni uZen Drive eBallito, ngoMgqibelo,” kusho uNetshiunda.Uthe olwazi abasenalo okwamanje bengamaphoyisa bezingu-14 izisebenzi ebezikule ndawo yokwakha ngesikhathi udonga luwela kwabayisihlanu, lubagqiba."Amathimba abebheka emaphoyiseni esebenzisana nezinye izinhlaka ezizimele, akwazile ukukhipha bobahlanu ebebegqibekile kodwa abane babo bese beshonile,” kusho uNetshiunda.Uqhube wathi oyedwa utholwe esaphila yize ebesehlale amahora ayisithupha ngaphansi kodonga oluwile."Amadokodo okufa kwabantu avuliwe ukuthi aphenywe, imbangela eholele ekutheni kuwe udonga nayo izoba yingxenye yophenyo,” kusho uNetshiunda.UMnuz Stoney Buthelezi wenkampani i-Thelbridge Enterprise (PTY) Ltd, uthe ezigamekweni ezifana nalezi kunzima ukusho ukuthi yini imbangela yazo ngoba kwesinye isikhathi basuke beyilandele yonke imigudu efunekayo osonkontileka kodwa ziqhubeke zenzeke izingozi."Indaba yokwakha ibucayi. Uthola ukuthi umakhi ulithathile isampula lomhlabathi layohlolwa ngaphambi kokuthi kuqale umsebenzi, imiphumela ibuye ithi ungaqhubeka umsebenzi wokwakha, kodwa ngokuqhubeka kwesikhathi kwenzeke ingozi," kusho uButhelezi.Uqhube wathi kunzima ukuqagula ukuthi yini ebingenziwanga kahle kulesi sigameko.
UTHEMBISE impilo engcono kwabamnyama, owayengumengameli uJacob Zuma, ngesikhathi ethula umqulu wezethembiso zokhetho weMK.UZuma uthe inhlupheko izophela kwabamnyama uma iMK inqoba ukhetho oluzayo.Umqulu wezethembiso wethulwe enkundleni yezemidlalo i-Orlando Stadium, eGoli, ngoMgqibelo.Emuva kokwethula lo mqulu, izolo inkantolo yoMthethosisekelo imemezele ukuthi sizophuma namuhla ngo-10 izinqumo secala elifakwe yinhlangano eyengamela ukhetho kuleli, i-IEC sokucela incazelo ngesinqumo sokuthi kugcinwe igama likaZuma ohlwini lwabazoya ePhalamende emva kokhetho. Uma singasukumi sizimele, akekho ozosimela.”UZuma uthe ufisa ukuthi izwe liphathwe amakhosi.Uthe ufuna ukuthi izingane zifunde mahhala, kuphele indlala, kube nokuthula noxolo.UZuma uthe inhlupheko ebhekene nabantu abamnyama iphinde idalwe nawukuvela kwamaqembu amancane.UZuma uthe abaholi bamaqembu amancane abanandaba nezidingo zabantu, wathi basuke bezifunela izikhundla ePhalamende."Mina nginenkinga yokuthi amaqembu maningi kakhulu. Iwona adala ukuthi sihlupheke. La maqembu athola imali kubelungu. Kuwona ukuya ePhalamende bakuthatha njengomsebenzi."Kulaba abaningi enibavotelayo, abanandaba nani, bazifunela umsebenzi. Noma sebesePhalamende abakhulumi ngenhlupheko yenu. Bafike bakhohlwe uma sebethole izikhundla.”UZuma uxwayise abaholi beMK ngokubanga izikhundla.Uthe bazoxoshwa abalwela izikhundla."Angikufuni ukuvungama. Umuntu athi ngifuna ukuya ePhalamende. Njengoba sibaningi kangaka ngeke sonke siye ePhalamende. Angifuni kube nabantu abazokhalela ukuthi bakhishiwe ohlwini lwabaya ePhalamende. Leli qembu silakhele indlu emnyama. Wena uzokhalela ukuthi ukhishwe ohlwini. Kanti wena ubulwela ukuba sohlwini?"Asingabangi ubala size siphathelane izibhamu. Uma nje sike sabathola laba abahamba bekhalela izikhundla, ngeke siphinde sibanike izikhundla. Labo abazoba amalungu esigungu esiphezulu kwiMK kufanele bazi ukuthi ngeke baqokwe njengongqongqshe. Phela into eyenza ukuthi kube nenkohlakalo yile nto yokuthi abantu bahlafune ngapha nangapha.”Abalandeli beMK bebephume ngezinkani kulo mcimbi.Abaholi bakhale ngokuthi kube nemizamo yokuphazamisa umcimbi.Lokhu kufakazwe nawuZuma, othe uzwe kuthiwa amabutho abeze emcimbini avinjiwe."Ngiyajabula ukubona izinsizwa zimi lapha ngoba ngike ngaphatheka kabi emini uma ngizwa kuthiwa ziyavinjwa.”Nasezinkundleni zokuxhumana kukhona abebekhala ngokuthi sebeme baze bavuvukala izinyawo amabhasi awafiki kuthiwa abashayeli bawo bayavinjwa.
LILOLIWE izembe kwiMeya kaMasipala waseMvoti, uMnuz Philani Mavundla, njengoba uMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal, usubize umhlangano ozolalela isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bakhe.Umhlangano uzokuba ngoLwesibili, uzophinde ulalele isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaSomlomo womkhandlu, uMnuz Mfundo Masondo.Lo mhlangano kwakuhlelwe ukuthi ube ngoLwesihlanu kodwa wabuye wahlehliswa.Isolezwe libone incwadi yephini lomqondisi jikelele obhekelele ezohulumeni basekhaya, uMnuz Madoda Khathide, eyazisa amakhansela omkhandlu ngomhlangano ozobanjelwa ehholo ledolobha, eMdlovane.UKhathide ubize umhlangano wakusasa emva kokuthi amakhansela omkhandlu ebhalele uMphathiswa uNkk Bongi Sithole-Moloi, ekhala ngokuthi uMasondo uyenqaba ukuhlalisa umhlangano.Imihlangano yokukhipha ubuholi bemikhandlu ehlaliswa umnyango ijwayele ukuba nezigameko zodlame.Kule ncwadi, uKhathide uveze ukuthi ezokuphepha zizokube ziqinile emhlanganweni."Izikhali azivumelekile emhlanganweni. Kodwa ke ngoLwesibili kuthiwa umhlangano uzohlala. Siwulindile ke lowo mhlangano. Esikuqaphelayo ukuthi i-ANC isebenzisana ne-IFP. Akukho lapho besebenzisana khona. Sijahile ke ukuwubona umshado wabo ukuthi uzohamba kanjani.”UMavundla uthe uzondelwa ukuthi ufuna iKwaZulu-Natal ithole uzimele geqe.I-IFP inezihlalo ezingu-10, i-ANC ineziyisishiyagalolunye, i-ABC yona ineziyisikhombisa.Akucaci ukuthi I-IFP ne-ANC bazokwabelana kanjani izikhundla uma isiphakamiso sabo siphumelela.Umthombo osondelene nodaba uthe isiphakamiso esikhona esokuthi elinye iqembu lithathe isikhundla sobumeya, bese kuthi elinye lithole esephini lemeya nesikasomlomo.Njengamanje i-ANC iphethe isikhundla sephini lemeya, esiphethwe uNkk Ntombi Ngubane.
NKOSIKHONA CELEAVUTHA engabaselwe amalungu eBandla laseZayoni, eNseleni, uKukhanya Kwezwe athi awafuni ukuphinde ambone umholi walo, amsola ngokuthi ubanjwe oqotsheni ezitika ngocansi endlini yesonto.UMbhishobhi Zwelibanzi Mtimande (59) oshadelwe, usolwa ngamalungu aleli bandla ngokuthi ngesonto eledlule ubhadanywe amalunga amane aleli bandla, ezitika ngocansi nowesifazane ohlala eduze kwesakhiwo sebandla.Lamalunga amane kuthiwa abezokwenza umsebenzi wokuhlanza indlu yesonto njengenjwayelo, azithela phezu kukamholi walo ezitika ngocansi nowesifazane okuthiwa uwumakhelwane wendlu yebandla. "Uvele wathi thina siyaphi ngalesiya sikhathi esontweni ngoba kunezikhathi ezibekiwe zokuthi sizohlanza indlu yesonto,” kusho omunye wabazibonele ngawakhe.Kuvela ukuthi uMtimande uyindoda ehlonishwayo ebandleni nasendaweni uqobo. Omunye kulaba abazibonele uthe uMtimande uzamile ukubavala umlomo ngemali kodwa banqaba. "Nabo labo abathi bangibambile bayazi ukuthi owesifazane ubeguqile mina ngimile ngikhuleka. Kodwa uma sebekhetha ukuthi bangibukanise nomhlaba ngokungiqambela amanga kulungile. Owami uNkulunkulu uyashesha ukuphendula,'' usho kanje.Kuvela ukuthi ngaphakathi ebandleni sekuqubuke omkhulu umsindo njengoba kukhona abathi akaxolelwe uMtimande ngakwenzile. Abanye kuthiwa bashaya phansi ngonyawo bathi inkomo ingazala umuntu.UMfu Ntokozo Makhathini ongunobhala webandla ukhombise ukungathandi ukuphawula ngalolu daba ngesikhathi ethintwa. Engangiboshelwe kona ukutholakala nezibhamu okwabe sekwenziwa uphenyo ukuthi kungani zikumina."Nakhona kugcine kutholakele ukuthi kwakuyizibhamu zomsebenzi, akukho okwakushayisa amakhala ngazo. Kumanje lelo cala seliphelile futhi ngitholakale ngimsulwa kulona,”’ kusho uNdlovu.Ngokuboshwa kukaNtuli uthe akukho okuningi azokuphawula ngoba udaba lukubameli.Uveze ukuthi noma kunjalo akanankinga noNtuli futhi bayabingelelana ngisho behlangana kumasipala njengoba besaqhubeka nokusebenza njengamakhansela e-IFP.Uthe naye usaqhuba umsebenzi wakhe njengekhansela leWard yakhe futhi usenguyena uSihlalo we-IFP wesiFunda uMzinyathi. UMagubane owadutshulwa naye wayeyikhansela le-IFP eMsinga.
SEKUVELE izindaba ezishaqisayo ngetulo okuthiwa liphekwa ngabathile eBandleni lamaNazaretha, ukuketula umholi uMduduzi Shembe uNyazilwezulu bese kufakwa uMnuz Mpume Shembe esikhundleni salo sokuhola ibandla. Yize umbango ogqamile uphakathi koNyazilwezulu nomholi uPhinda Shembe Ukukhanyakwelanga, kodwa kulokhu kuthiwa itulo liphekwa ngabathile abayizethenjwa zalo uNyazi.Isolezwe Ngempelasonto, lithole ngomthombo walo ongashayi eceleni ukuthi kunomshoshaphansi wokungcolisa igama loNyazilwezulu lokulenza libukeke licheme namaqembu athile epolitiki, okuzoba yisona sizathu sokuthi lugudluzwe ngaphakathi esikhundleni kukhalwa ngalokho.UMpume okulungiselwa ukuthi athathe isikhundla soNyazilwezulu, kuthiwa uzalwa ngomunye wabafowabo bomholi wamaNazaretha wesibili, iNkosi Jerome Galile Shembe Ilanga. Kuthiwa uyise kaMpume akakaze abe ngumholi wamaNazaretha kodwa kuthiwa uyena ongabangcono ngoba esondelene nezikhulu ezithile zebandla nezepolitiki."Uma uzokhumbula kahle kuke kwagqanyiswa izindaba zokuthi uNyazilwezulu lunxenxa amaNazaretha ukuthi anike i-ANC ithuba lesibili ukuthi iphinde ihole izwe."Lokho kwakungaphumi kulona ngokuthanda kwalo, kodwa kukhona isigungu esihlonishwayo esisondele kulona esisuke silweluka ngokumele lukusho kumaNazaretha."Okudala lokho wukuthi kwasona leso sigungu sisebenza nabathile kwipolitiki. Siyazi ukuthi uma lusho kanjalo kuzongcola igama lalo bese luvela lungeyena umholi ofanele ngoba kuyaziwa ukuthi uShembe akazingeni ezepolitiki."Lokho kuzokwenza ukuthi kube lula uma sona isigungu sesiphakamisa ukuthi alugudluke esikhundleni ngoba uzihlanganisa nepolitiki,” kusho umthombo.Kuthiwa le mpi isuswe wukuthi uNyazilwezulu lumise ithenda ka-R18 million yokwakha amadokodo eBuhleni, okuwuxhaso olwakhishwa wuMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa."Kuzona izethenjwa zebandla kukhona ababezohlomula ngale thenda, njengoba besebenzisana nezikhulu ezithile kuhulumeni, bacasuka uma isimiswa. Yingakho sebenza yonke into ezoholela uNyazilwezulu ophathe."Lezi zethenjwa zilwa nawo wonke umuntu ozama ukuluvikela uNyazilwezulu. Ngikhuluma nawe nje zikwazile ukuqhelisa Inkosi yamaQadi uMqoqi kulona obengavumeli noma yini."Kukhona nesinye sezethenjwa esiluvikelayo uNyazilwezulu esesithweswe icala lokudlwengula njengoba sihamba inkantolo kumanje,” kusho omunye umthombo.Uqhuba uthe njengamanje kuneminye imizamo yokuthi uNyazilwezulu luvezwe njengomuntu ovukela uMbuso."Lezi zethenjwa zeluleke uNyazilwezulu ukuthi lukhiphe umhlangano oya eSwazini njengoba kunguMeyi. Ngokujwayelekile umholi webandla akahambi yedwa uma ehambisa umkhuleko kodwa uphelezelwa ngamaNazaretha."Ukukhipha umhlangano uye eSwazini kuzokwenza amaNazaretha azoluphelezela luya eSwazini angasitholi isikhathi sokuyovota ngoMeyi 29 bese kuthiwa luvukele uMbuso ngokuyisa abantu ngaphandle kuvotwa ezweni labo,” usho kanje.Okhulumela uNyazilwezulu, uMnuz Thokozani Mncwabe ukuqinisekisile ukuthi kunomhlangano wamaNazaretha ozophuma ngoMeyi 25 ukuyokhuleka eSwazini."Asinalwazi ukuthi uzobuya nini kodwa kuba wumholi onquma isikhathi sokuwubuyisa. Kungenzeka kubuywe lungakafiki ukhetho kodwa asinasiqiniseko."Ngetulo okhuluma ngalo, lokugudluza uBaba uNyazilwezulu, anginalwazi ngalo kodwa igama likaMpume Shembe ngike ngizwe kukhulunywa ngalo ukuthi ungomunye womndeni wakwaShembe, angikaze ngizwe kuthintwa ezokuhola ibandla ngaye. Ngebhadi angikaze ngihlangane naye futhi anginamlando ogcwele ngaye,” kusho uMncwabe.
UNDUNANKULU kaZulu, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, usifanise nokunikela ngeSilo ezitheni isinqumo sebhodi leNgonyama Trust, sokungaphinde sikhokhele abameli beMbube uma kunamacala athinta umbango wesihlalo sobukhosi bukaZulu.Isibophezelo sokuthi Ingonyama Trust angeke iphinde ikhokhele abameli beSilo uMisuzulu kaZwelithini senziwe eNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu, ngoLwesihlanu.Inkantolo ibilalele icala elifakwe uMntwana uMbonisi kaBhekuzulu, ofuna ukuthi Ingonyama Trust nohulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal bengazikhokheli izindleko zabameli beSilo uma kunamacala athinta umbango wesihlalo sobukhosi bukaZulu.UButhelezi uthe isibophezelo sabameli beNgonyama Trust sikhombisa ukuthi ibhodi elisha alinendaba neSilo.Ukusho ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabaNtwana baseNdlunkulu abezokweseka iSilo. "Banikela ngeSilo ezitheni ekubeni yona le Ngonyama Trust kungeyeSilo.” kusho uButhelezi.Uthe bafuna ukubikela amakhosi ngale nkinga, uphinde wakhala nangokuthi iminyango kahulumeni ebimangalelwe neSilo kuleli cala, ikhombise ukusilahla iSilo."Kusobala ukuthi sebesikhaphele iSilo. Kufanele siwabikele amakhosi ngale ngozi elengele uZulu,” esho.Ummeli weNgonyama Trust, u-Advocate Alastair Dickson, uthe angeke baphinde bakhokhele abameli beSilo.Inkantolo izwe ukuthi Ingonyama Trust ikhokha isikweletu sezigidi zamarandi sabameli abadala beSilo, iStrauss Daly.AbeStrauss Daly babemele iSilo emacaleni ayethethwa eMgungundlovu, isikweletu sabo singabalelwa kuR8 million.UDickson uthe isivumelwano sokuthi Ingonyama Trust ikhokhe lesi sikweletu senziwa yibhodi elidala elaliholwa iJaji uJerome Ngwenya."Lena inkinga esayifica uma siqokwa. Senza isibophezelo sokuthi angeke siphinde sikhokhele izindleko zabameli,” kusho uDickson.Uqhubeke ngokuthi asikho isidingo sokuthi Inkantolo ikhiphe isivimbelo sokuthi bakhokhele abameli beSilo ngoba benze isibophezelo sokuthi angeke baphinde benze into efana nale."Uma umuntu evuma iphutha lakhe, ethi bengidakiwe, angeke ngiphinde, asikho isidingo sokuthi umjezise ngoba uyalivuma iphutha lakhe. Nathi siyasho ukuthi angeke siphinde,” kugcizelela uDickson.Ummeli kaNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Nomusa Dube-Ncube, u-Advocate Muhammad Suleman, uthe uhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal kufanele ulekelele iSilo.USuleman uthe umthetho olawula isikhwama esibhekelele izidingo zeNdlunkulu, iRoyal Household Trust, ubanikeza igunya lokuthi balekelele iSilo ngezidingo zaso.Ummeli weSilo, u-Advocate Jonny Klopper, uthe uMntwana uMbonisi akanalo igunya lokufaka icala."Ulifaka icala njengobani. Lapha emaphepheni asenkantolo uthi ufaka lesicelo egameni labaNtwana baseNdlunkulu."Uma kunjalo kufanele engabe kwaba nomhlangano womndeni, waqokwa njengomuntu ozomela umndeni,” kusho u-Advocate Klopper.Isinqumo sigodliwe.
UMNYANGO wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal ukwamukele ukukhonjwa indlela kukathisha waseGroutville Secondary, KwaDukuza emuva kokulahlwa yicala lokufuna izithombe zezitho zangasese zomfundi nokumthumelela umphambili wakhe. UMnuz Musa E Mnkwanyana (39) uxoshwe ekufundiseni wuMkhandlu woThisha eNingizimu Afrika (SACE). Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Muzi Mahlambi, uthe bahlale bebakhuza othisha ukuba bahlukane nemikhuba engasile kubafundi. Isolezwe Ngempelasonto lithole ukuthi uMnkwanyana walahlwa yicala wumkhandlu wezabasebenzi abasemkhakheni wezemfundo (ELRC) ngoMeyi 8. UMnkwanyana ubemangalelwe kulo mkhandlu wumqashi wakhe, okunguMnyango wezeMfundo eKZN. Leli cala lalihlelelwe ukunkankanywa ngo-Okthoba 19, ngo-2023, Febhuwari 26, 2023 nangoMashi 26 kulo nyaka. Ngokusho kwesinqumo somkhandlu (ELRC), leli cala lenzeka ngo-2022 ngesikhathi uMnkwanyana efuna izithombe zezitho zangasese zomfundi ayemfundisa isiNgisi kuGrade 11 (ongagagulwangwa ngenxa yokuthi usemncane) futhi wabuye wamkhombisa umphambili wakhe. Yize uMnkwanyana abephika elala ngomhlane ukuthi wawenza lamanyala kodwa kwakhona ubufakazi obulethwayo futhi kwafakaza ngisho noyise womfundi. Siqhuba isinqumo sithe ngesikhathi kuqhubeka uphenyo, uMnkwanyana wabhala isitatimende ezivumela ukuthi ulenzile ichilo enganeni."Ngakhuluma nengane ngendlela engafanele umsebenzi engiwenzayo futhi ngayicela ukuba ingithumelele izithombe ezigcolile."Ngenxa yamahloni ngazicisha izithombe efonini yami. Abazali beza esikoleni futhi angikuphikanga ababekusho ngalolu daba," kusho uthisha. Eqhuba uMnkwanyana wathi uyazisola futhi uyaxolisa ngesenzo sakhe, uqhubeke kanje:."Ngakhuluma nobaba futhi ngaxolisa kakhulu. Ngiyafunga ukuthi angikaze ngiyithinte ingane. Ngiyasemukela isono engasenza enganeni nasemndenini. "Ngingenza nanoma yini ukulungisa isiphambeko sami nokulekelela ingane nomndeni ekubhekaneni nalesi simo. Ngiyaxolisa kakhulu futhi ngiyafisa ukunikezwa ithuba lokulungisa iziphambeko zami."Umfundi wathi waqala ukuxhumana noMnkwanyana ngoWhatsApp ngaphandle kwesikole isikhashana kwaze kwaba lolu daba lwaziwa ngu-anti wakhe. Uvumile umfundi ukuthi wamtshela uMnkwanyana ukuthi uyamthanda ngaphambi kokuba baqale ukukhuluma ngemikhuba yocansi. Uthe uthisha wamcela izitho zangasese, naye wamthumelela futhi wazijabulela uthisha. Eqhuba uthe naye wamcela uthisha izithombe ezingcolile kodwa uthisha wenqaba, wathi ufuna azibonele ngqo umphambili wakhe.Umehluleli omkhulu eMkhwandlwini wezeMfundo veKZN, uRaj Shanker, ubuchithile ubufakazi bukaMnkwanyana wabe esemlahla ngecala nokuthi axoshwe ngokushesha wuMnyango wezeMfundo ngoba akakufanele ukusebenza nezingane ngokomthetho wesigaba 120 weChildren's Act. Ubuye wathi kuzokwaziswa noMqondisi-Jikelele ukuba afake igama likaMnkwanyana kwawabantu abakhohlakele..
UKWANDA kwezehlakalo zodlame olubhekiswe kothisha ngabafundi ezikoleni zakuleli, sekwenze bakhala ngokuthi abanazo ezinye izindlela zokuqondisa abafundi selokhu kwavalwa induku.Izinyunyana zothisha zikhala ngokucindezelwa kwamalungu azo njengoba nomthetho uvikela abafundi.Uma uthisha eke waqondisa umfundi, emntshontsha ngenduku uma ebhadanywe oqotsheni, ubhekana necala elimkhomba emnyango, axoshwe angakwazi nokuthi aphinde afundise kuleli.UNOBHALA jikelele weSadtu uMnuz Mugwena MalulekeKodwa uma umfundi etitinye uthisha, uma isigungu sesikole simthole enecala, umiswa izinsuku ezimbalwa bese ebuyiselwa esikoleni.NoMnyango weMfundo eyisiSekelo, ukhale ngokuthi uma umfundi exoshwa esikoleni asuke enze icala kusona, kudingeka uphinde umfunele isikole ngoba akumele kube nomfundi ozobhuquza ekhaya angafundi.Ukusabalala kwe-video yesehlakalo esenzeke eGlenvista High eGauteng, muva nje, lapho kungongaphansi nongaphezulu phakathi kukathisha nomunye wabafundi, kwenze izinyunyana zathi kumele kwenziwe okuthile ngoba othisha abaphephile. Uthisha kule video ubonakala ezama ukubhula lo mfundi ngesihlalo, emuva kokuvuka othulini.UNobhala jikelele weSadtu, uMnuz Mugwena Maluleke, ukhale ngokuthi isiyinsakavukela ezikoleni eyodlame olubhekiswe kothisha ngabafundi .Uthe izikole kumele zibe yizindawo ezingenalo udlame wathi nosizo olunikezwa ezikoleni okuqubuke kuzo udlame, kumele lungachemi nabafundi kuphela."Okubuhlungu ngukuthi iSace igweba kanzima othisha, abafundi bona bayayekwa. Umnyango kumele wenze isimo sokusebenza kothisha sibe sihle futhi ubhekane nabafundi abangalawuleki.”UMENGAMELI weNatu uMnuz Sibusiso MalingaUMengameli weNatu, uMnuz Sibusiso Malinga, uthe selokhu kwavalwa induku ezikoleni, akukho uMnyango wezeMfundo owabahlinzeka ngakho ukuthi bakusebenzise ukuqondisa abafundi."Ibuhlungu impilo kathisha kulezi zinsuku ngoba uma eshaye umfundi uyaxoshwa, ayikhulunywa eyakhe. Akekho ovikela uthisha ngoba nomnyango umlahla ngecala, aze aboshwe kwesinye isikhathi. Umfundi osuke eshaye uthisha uyabuyela esikoleni, emuva kokumiswa isikhashana.”Uthe nomkhandlu olawula othisha iSouth African Council for Educators (Sace), ucheme nabafundi."Ithina esikhokhela iSace kodwa kwayona ayisivikeli, ichema nabafundi. Ngiyazi kunzima kodwa ngiyanxusa kozakwethu ukuthi uma bebona ukuthi umoya uyaphakama, baphumele emnyango babuye selehlile igwebu. Ukucabanga kothisha kumele kube ngaphezu kwalokho komfundi, bangasheshi ukuhluthuka.”Ubalule nokuthi ezikhathini eziningi uma umfundi onile, umjezisa ngokuthi umhlalise uma sekuphume isikole."Inkinga enkulu ngukuthi uma umhlalisa ngemuva kwesikole kudingeka wena umgade. Uma egibela izimoto zomalume, kumele wena uqinisekise ukuthi leyo moto ayimshiyi ngoba ngeke umhlalise uphinde umlaxaze ungazi ukuthi uhambe ngani. Ujika wena ke usufana nobophekile, ngoba kumele umhambise ekhaya uma imoto isihambile ngoba ngeke umshiye kanjalo esikoleni. Kugcina sekufana nokuthi uzigwebe wena ngokumqondisa,” kusho uMalinga.Okhulumela umnyango, uMnuz Elijah Mhlanga, uthe uMthethosisekelo wezwe ubalula ukuthi kuyilungelo lomfundi ukufunda.ABANYE babafundi ababebhaxabulwe ngenduku ezikoleni zakuleli baba nezibazi ezithweni nakuba yavalwa Isithombe:ZANELE ZULUUthe bazama ukushintsha indlela abafundi abacabanga ngayo emakilasini ukuze baxazulule izinkinga abanazo ngokuthula."Kudingeka sisebenzisane siyizinhlaka ezehlukene kusuka emaphoyiseni, umphakathi, abazali kanjalo nabafundi. Induku yavalwa ngakho umuntu oyisebenzisayo ubhekana necala,” kusho uMhlanga.Ukhale ngabanye abazali athe baphikela izingane zabo uma zenze amacala ezikoleni."Umthetho uthi umfundi umiswa izinsuku ezingu-14, emva kwalokho uyabuyela esikoleni. Uma umxosha esikoleni, kungumsebenzi womnyango ukumfunela esinye isikole. Nakhona kuleso sikole bafike bamchithe ngoba kuthiwa uxoshwe la ebefunda khona ngoba eyihlongandlebe.”UMnuz Matakanye Matakanya, wenhlagano iNational Association of School Governing Bodies (NASGB), uthe othisha bayazi ukuthi akumele bashaye abafundi ngoba kuyicala.Uthe kumele iqiniswe imigomo ezikoleni kulabo bafundi abashaya othisha. "Akumele ngabe sibona izehlakalo lapho abafundi beshaya khona othisha. Kodwa induku yavalwa ngakho othisha bayazi ukuthi akumele bayisebenzise.” I-Sace embikweni wayo waminyaka yonke ihlale ibika ukwanda kwamacala othisha abasashaya abafundi ekubeni induku yavalwa ngeminyaka yo-1990.Isikhulu esiphezulu se seSace uNksz Ella Mokgalane, sithe minyaka yonke ayanda amacala enduku ezikoleni.Uthe ezinkundleni zokubonisana ababa nazo nezinyunyana zothisha, bahlale bexwayisa ngalesi sihlava senduku ngoba othisha bayaxoshwa."Uma umfundi ekukhahlela unguthisha, wena awukwazi ukumphindisela. Umele umzali esikoleni ngakho okubalulekile ngukuthi uphume kulelo kilasi, ungazange uphindisele,” kusho uNksz Mokgalane.NoMthethosivivinywa iBasic Educations Laws Amendment Bill (Bela) ephasiswe wuMkhandlu weziFundazwe ePhalamende, ukubeka kucace ukuthi induku isavaliwe ngakho kuyicala kulabo abasaqhubeka nokuyisebenzisa.
ZIPHEFUMULE ngezinkinga ezikhungethe uhlelo olusavivinywa lwezindawo zokuhlala ezingaphansi kwesikhwama esixhasa izitshudeni ngemali yokufunda ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme, iNational Student Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS), izinhlaka ezihlanganisa izitshudeni nabaphathi bezikhungo.Lo mhlangano obungoLwesine ePitoli, bekuhloswe ngawo ukuthola isisombululo enkingeni ebhekene nezikhungo, izitshudeni nezinye izinhlaka kulolu hlelo lwalesi sikhwama ngezindawo zokuhlala ezikhungweni.Umlawuli wesikhashana weNSFAS, uMnuz Mr Freeman Nomvalo, uthe babize lo mhlangano ngenxa yezikhalazo sezitshudeni ezithinta ukuphepha lapho zihlala khona nezingqinamba omastende abahlangabezana nazo.Uthe omastende bakhale ngokungakhokhelwa kanjalo nokuphuza ukukhokhelwa."Sivumelene ngokuthi kusungulwe ithimba eliyisipesheli elizobhekana nazo zonke izingqinamba ezithinta izindawo zokuhlala. Nginethemba lokuthi kuzobanjiswana ukuze kuxazululeke lezi zinkinga ngokushesha,” kusho uNomvalo.Izinhlaka abehlangene nazo zifaka uMnyango weMfundo ePhakeme nokuQeqesha, inhlangano yabaphathi bamanyuvesi i-Universities South Africa (USAF), eyabaphathi bamakolishi amakhono amaTVET i-South African Public Colleges Organisation (SAPCO).Abanye yilabo abamele imikhandlu yezitshudeni emanyuvesi i-South Africa Union of Students (SAUS), emele izitshudeni emakolishi i-South African Technical Vocational Education and Training Student Association (SATVETSA), eyabahlinzeka ngezindawo zokuhlala ne-Development Bank of Southern Africa (DBSA).UNomvalo uthe ziningi nezinye izinto abavumelene ngazo kulo mhlangano. Zikhala mihla izitshudeni ezikhokhelwa yilesi sikhwama ngalolu hlelo lwezindawo zokuhlala njengoba zigcina sezilala endle ngenxa yokungakhokhi kwalesi sikhwama.ISAUS isikhale kakhulu ngalolu hlelo yathi lwenza kube nzima satshe ukuthi izitshudeni zigxile ezifundweni ngoba zijikijelwa emnyango omastende ngoba lesi sikhwama singakhokhile.Enye yezinto uNgqongqoshe weMfundo ePhakeme uDkt Blade Nzimande, ayalela uNomvalo ukuthi ayilungise indaba yezindawo zokuhlala izitshudeni.UNzimande wathi izitshudeni akumele zize zikhathazeke ngokuthi akukhokhiwe, kodwa zigxile ezifundweni zazo.
OMELE i-EFF embangweni wesikhundla sikandunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Mongezi Twala, ukhale ngokushaywa indiva kwabantu abahlala emijondolo nasemapulazini esifundazweni, wathi basathwele kanzima njengoba bengahleli kahle. Uthe abalimi basabahlukumeza kakhulu abantu abahlala emapulazini ezindaweni ezehlukene esifundazweni."Ezindaweni ezifana nakoFilidi, Madlangeni nezinye, basahlukunyezwa kakhulu abantu abahlala emapulazini. Njenge-EFF esifundazweni nakuleli, uma sithatha amandla sizokwazi ukulwa nalesi sihlava ngoba amaBhunu abacindezele,” kusho uTwala. Uveze ukuthi kusanabagilwa bezikhukhula ezahlasela esifundazweni, namanje abasahlala emaflethini."Kumele kubuyiswe isithunzi somuntu omnyama, abantu bahlale ezindlini ezibafanele. Uhulumeni akabasizi ngalutho, impilo yabo ayithuthuki.” Ubalule ukuthi iminyango kahulumeni okungowezeMfundo nowezeMpilo, iwe bhu esifundazweni, ayisebenzi.OMELE i-EFF kwesikandunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Mongezi Twala, nezinhlelo zokufukula abahlwempu Isithombe: MHLENGI SHANGASE"Abantu abalutholi usizo ezikhungweni zezempilo, ekubeni kunabahlengikazi abahleli emakhaya abangasebenzi. Esibhedlela eMadadeni imibhede ayisekho, ziningi nezinye izikhungo ezingasebenzi kwezinye izindawo. Imitholampilo ayivulwe ubusuku nemini ngoba abantu badinga usizo, ngaso sonke isikhathi.” Kwezemfundo, uthe othishanhloko kudingeka basebenzise imali yabo ukuze kuqhubeke ukufunda nokufundisa.UTwala uphefumule kanje ngesikhathi enengxoxo ekhethekile neSolezwe, lapho ebekhuluma khona ngomkhankaso wokuhola isifundazwe.Okhethweni lwango-2019, leli qembu lathola amavoti acela ku-350 000 esifundazweni, lathola izihlalo eziyisishiyagalombili esiShayamthetho eMgungundlovu.Lilele endaweni yesine ngobukhulu kulesi sifundazwe kanti kulolu khetho lihlose ukuthola amavoti ayisigidi."Sihlose ukuthola isigidi samavoti, siphathe uhulumeni ngokuphelele. Siphume imikhankaso senza nezinhlelo zokudla umhlanganiso kulolu khetho.” Ubalule ukuthi bayiqembu labantu abasha ngakho bagxile kubona ngethemba lokuthi babavotele. "Siphuma singena ezindaweni ezihlala izitshudeni namafulethi ukuze sithole amavoti. Akulalwa, sisebenza ubusuku nemini ngoba sifuna ukuwina ngamalengiso lolu khetho. Sike sahlala sacubungula ukuthi kungani sesekwe abantu abasha ezikhungweni zemfundo siwine imikhandlu kulezi zikhungo kodwa bangavoti ngobuningi babo. Sithole ukuthi abanye abanendaba nokuvota. Sibeke phambili uhlaka lwabantu abasha okuyilo olusebenza ngamandla nangokuzikhandla ukuze siwine ukhetho olwaziwa ngeMlungisi Madonsela Battalion. UMadonsela wayeyisitshudeni eDUT, esashona kubhikishwa kule nyuvesi. Sinamashoshozela angu-1 000 okungenani isikhungo ngasinye ukuze kugqugquzelwe intsha ukuthi ivote.” Uthe ukuba ngusihlalo weqembu elesekwa yintsha njenge-EFF, akuyona into elula ngoba kudingeka bagxishe imfundiso kubantu abangakaze bavote, abanye basuke bengakaze babe ngisho ngamalungu amanye amaqembu ezombusazwe.UTwala (38) uphinde waxwayisa amalungu abo ukuthi angacekeli phansi impahla ezikhungweni zemfundo noma emiphakathini uma kukhona angeneme ngakho."Siyiqembu elilandela imithetho yezwe, ngakho asihambisani nokucekelwa kwempahla ozobuye uyidinge ngomuso. Kodwa ke nasezikhungweni eziningi zemfundo ephakeme, kuyaqapheleka ukuthi abaphathi abayifuni imikhandlu yezitshudeni ye-EFF ngoba uthola ukuthi uma kutelekwa, kuboshwa amalungu ethu. Uma uya ezinkantolo uthola kuwuphiko lwethu oluboshiwe, ekubeni nezinye izinhlangano beziteleka. Lokhu kukushiya nemibuzo eminingi ngoba kukhona namalungu ethu anikwe izincwadi zokuthi angasondeli ezikhungweni.” Mayelana nokufika kweqembu elisha Umkhonto weSizwe esifundazweni elizongenela ukhetho okokuqala eliholwa ngowayengumengameli we-ANC nezwe uJacob Zuma, uthe okwamanje alikho ilungu noma umholi we-EFF osejoyine iMK. "Abantu engicabanga ukuthi abasabuthi quthu ubuthongo uKhongolose njengoba kunamakhansela eMzumbe ajoyina iMK. Akusithusi ukubakhona kweMK, ngicabanga ukuthi izoshaya kakhulu i-ANC, thina sesekwa kakhulu yintsha, engadidiseki kalula.”UTwala wasoSizweni eNewcastle, akalona ivukana kwezepolitiki njengoba eyingxenye yabantu abasungula i-EFF esifundazweni.Uthe balikhulisa lasabalala kusona sonke isifundazwe njengoba laqala ezifundeni ezine kuphela kodwa manje sebemeleleke kuyona yonke iKZN."Ngiqale ukusebenza eduzane nomphakathi ezinhlakeni ezehlukene okubalwa kwimiphilandawonye nako-Love Life. Umndeni wami wawuvele ukhona emzabalazweni, nomkhulu wayeyingxenye yekhomishini yamaqiniso nokubuyisana.”
UHULUMENI waKwaZulu-Natal usamukele futhi wasishayela ihlombe isigwebo esiyingqophamlando seminyaka engu-23 esinikezwe umshayeli weloli elabulala abantu abangu-20 oPhongolo ngoSepthemba 2022.INkantolo eNkulu yasoPhongolo igwebe uSibusiso Siyaya (30) ngoLwesine.Ubekade ethweswe amacala angu-22 okukhona nawokubulala angu-20 engozi eyenzeka kuthelawayeka uN2 eGodlwayo, oPhongolo.Kwelokushayela budedengu, ugwetshwe iminyaka emithathu, elokuhluleka ukusiza abagilwa nokubika ingozi wagwetshwa eyisithupha. Uzozidonsa umkanye lezigwebo.USiyaya uphinde wagwetshwa iminyaka engu-14 ngamacala okubulala abekade ethweswe wona futhi akakulungele ukuba nezincwadi zokushayela, aphucwe zona. Inkantolo ithe ingu-20 iminyaka azoyibhadla ejeleOkhulumela uMnyango wezokuThutha KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Kwanele Ncalane uthe ukugwetshwa kukaSiyaya ngale ndlela kuyigxathu elikhulu kwezobulungiswa."Kuzohamba ibanga elide ekuhlwayeleni imbewu entsha kubashayeli ukuthi bafunde ukuthi ubumqoka bokugcinwa kwemithetho yemigwaqo bungakanani.”Ukugwetshwa kukaSiyaya kuzokwenza nemindeni iphole amanxeba,” kusho uNcalane.UNcalane uthe nabanye abashayeli kuhlanganisa nabamaloli kumele bafunde isifundo kule ngozi."(Isinqumo sizosiza) nokubuyekeza imithetho yemigwaqo ezweni ukuze iqine kakhulu kunakuqala."Abashayeli mabaqonde ukuthi ubudedengu babo bungaholela ekutheni kuvaleke imizi eminingi,” kusho uNcalane.Uphiko lezokushushisa iNational Prosecuting Authority KwaZulu-Natal isamukelile isinqumo senkantolo esiyingqophamlando.UMbuso obuholwa uMshushisi u-Advocate Krishen Shah ubize ofakazi abawu-12 okukhona nochwepheshe nobamakhamera ayeselolini.Abashona babe neminyaka ephakathi kwemihlanu kuya kwengu-28 iningi labo kungabafundi. Emuva kwengozi uSiyaya wadla phansi kodwa wagcina eboshiwe ngosuku lwesigameko uSepthemba 16.
SICHITHIWE isicelo sezintatheli ezicele kumiswe ukuqulwa kwecala lokufa kukaSenzo Meyiwa ngesikhathi sokhetho ngoba zizobe zingekho enkantolo.Kulindeleke ukuthi izwe liye okhethweni lukazwelonke olubhekwe ngabomvu ngoMeyi 29. Isicelo sabezindaba sivezwe wuMshushisi woMbuso u-Advocate George Baloyi ngesikhathi kuguqiswa icala ngoLwesihlanu. Icala lisheshe laguqa ngesikhathi sekhefu lesidlo sasemini ukuze kunikwe abameli noMbuso ithuba lokubhunga okuthile.UMeyiwa wadutshulwa wabulawa ekubo kwentombi yakhe uKelly Khumalo, eVosloorus eGauteng ngo-2014.UMshushisi uBaloyi ethula udaba ucele ukubonana neJaji uRatha Mokgoatlheng ngasese. babhunge ngodaba lwabezindaba.IJaji lithe uBaloyi akayibeke ebandla indaba, izwakale ukuthi bathini abezindaba.UBaloyi uthe abezindaba bazobe bematasa nokhetho kodwa abafuni ukwedlulwa yicala, bebecela ukulindwa baze babuye."Nkosi yenkantolo abezindaba bebecela ukuthi icala liguqe ngesikhathi sokhetho ngoba zonke izinsiza zabo zizobhekana nokhetho. Bebecela ukuthi kubuywe sekwedlule ukhetho,’’kusho uBaloyi.IJaji libuze ukuthi ithini indlu ngalesi sicelo, kwaqhasha ummeli u-Advocate Zandile Mshololo wathi ngeke kwenzeke kanjalo yena uyasiphikisa isicelo.U-Advocate Thulani Mngomezulu weseke u-Advocate Mshololo wathi naye uyasiphikisa isicelo.Omunye ummeli u-Advocate Charles Mnisi uthe abezindaba bekufanele bafake isicelo esibhalwe phansi esisemthethweni, hhayi ukuphathisa umyalezo kumshushisi.IJaji lizwakale lingahambisani nesicelo libuza abameli ukuthi yake yabonakala yini into enjalo phambilini.UBaloyi uthe ukholwa wukuthi lokhu kudalwa yindlela umphakathi omagange ngayo ngaleli cala.Udaba lumunyungwe kwaphunywa nesinqumo sokuthi siyachithwa isicelo ngeke balindwe abezindaba.Bekungaqali ukuthi kube nodaba lwabezindaba, phambilini uZandie Khumalo wayecele ukuthi bangabucosheli ubufakazi bakhe. Isicelo sikaZandie sachithwa, abezindaba baqhubeka nomsebenzi wabo.Ngesikhathi icala liguqa bekulalelwe ubufakazi bukangoti wamaselula uLieutenant Colonel Gideon Gouws othi abamangalelwa babexhumana ngamaselula.Kulindeleke ukuthi icala libuyele enkantolo ngoMsombuluko, kuqhubeke ubufakazi bamaselula.
INGENISE uR500 million emnothweni weTheku i-Africa’s Travel Indaba ebiseNkosi Albert Luthuli International Convention Centre (ICC), eThekwini.Lezi zindaba zivezwe yiPhini leNhloko yophiko lwezokuvakasha kuMasipala weTheku, uNkk Winile Mntungwa esithangamini sokuvalwa kwengqungquthela, izolo."I-Africa’s Travel Indaba ihambe kahle kakhulu eThekwini ngoba abayihambele bafake imali engaphezu kuka-R500 million emnothweni weTheku. Le mali ingene ngokuthengwa kwempahla, ukuhlala kwabantu emahhotela, ukubhukhwa kwezimoto ezisetshenziswa yizivakashi, ukudla ezindaweni zokudlela nokunye okuningi,” kuchaza uNkk Mntungwa.Uthe aseqalile amalungiselelo okuqinisekisa ukuthi i-Africa’s Travel Indaba ihlala eThekwini njengoba bekhipha unyawo njalo uma kunalo mbukiso ngokuthi baphathe kahle izivakashi.Uveze ukuthi nezokuphepha sezihlala ziqinile eThekwini hhayi ukuthi amaphoyisa atshalwa ngoba kune-Africa’s Travel Indaba kodwa ahlale esiqaphile isimo sezokuphepha.Ubalule ukuthi kunomkhankaso wokuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bayahlomula kwezokuvakasha njengoba bekukhona osomabhizinisi abancane abaxhaswe yiDurban Tourism ukuba bazikhangise kulo mbukiso.Isikhulu esibhekele ukusebenza kwe-Tourism KwaZulu-Natal, uNksz Phindile Makwakwa, sithe uma abantu becabanga i-Africa’s Travel Indaba, bacabanga iTheku neKwaZulu-Natal ngakho asikho isidingo sokuyihambisa kwenye indawo.Uthe kunezinhlelo abazenzayo zokuqinisekisa ukuthi lo mbukiso uhlala kulesi sifundazwe yize bazi ukuthi nabanye bazowubhidela.Isikhulu esiphezulu se-SA Tourism uNksz Nombulelo Guliwe, sithe i-Africa’s Travel Indaba ihambe kahle kakhulu ngoba zingaphezu kuka-1 200 izinkampani ebezizokhangisa ngemikhiqizo yazo.Uveze ukuthi osomabhizinisi benze imihlangano engaphezu kuka-24 000 futhi bayajabula ukuthi namazwe ase-Afrika ayanda kulo mbukiso.UMnuz John Oritho obhekele ukusebenza kwe-ICC, uthe isimo sesingcono kakhulu kulokho esasiyikho emuva kokuhlasela kweCovid-19."Silindele ukuthi imicimbi eza lapha ikhule ngoba kuyimanje isikhulu esiphezulu sase-ICC siphesheya siyohlwaya eminye imicimbi esingayiletha lapha. Ukuza kwe-Travel Indaba kuyasisiza ngoba kuvulela abafundi bezokuvakasha eDurban University of Technology (DUT) amathuba okuthola isipiliyoni somsebenzi. Sibuye sithathe abapheki bakuzo zonke izikole zalapha eThekwini ukuze bazophekela izivakashi zamazwe omhlaba. Bonke abasebenzayo bathola izitifiketi ezishoyo ukuthi bebesebenza kwi-Travel Indaba ezibasiza ukuthola umsebenzi noma ukuzisebenza,” kusho u-Oritho.Uthe bayakuqonda ukubaluleka kwezokuphepha kwezokuvakasha ngoba izivakashi zifuna ukuzizwa ziphephile ngaso sonke isikhathi.Uthembise abantu ukuthi ezokuphepha zizohlala ziqinile eThekwini ngoba umasipala ubambisene kahle nosomabhizinisi nezinye izinhlaka zomphakathi.

Bese kuneminyaka behlukumeza umphakathi, bengenziwa lutho ngoba bayasatshwa. Kuthe uma kuzwakala izindaba zokudutshulwa kwabo, kwajabula wonke umuntu,” kusho umthombo.Uqhube wathi nokho umphakathi usakhathazekile ngomunye olamana noyedwa wababulewe ngoba yena usindile."Sisola ukuthi ubengekho ngesikhathi kugasela amaphoyisa, kwabulawa laba abafile, wasinda kanjalo. Sikhathazekile ngoba uye obengubhongoza eqenjini ebelihlukumeza umphakathi ngobugebengu,” kusho umthombo.Uthe oyedwa wabafi ungowokudabuka eGumbatana eHighflats, kanti wafika nomfowabo (osindile) bezohlala noyise owayenesipaza ehostela."Uyise wadutshulwa wabulawa eminyakeni edlule, zaqala lapho ke ukuba yizigebengu lezi zingane,” kusho umthombo.Ikhansela lendawo, uMnuz Sibusiso Khwela likuqinisekisile lokhu lathi phakathi kobugebengu obebenziwa abafi, ukubamba inkunzi, ukudayisa izidakamizwa nokubulala."Bebenza yonke inhlobo yobugebengu obuyingozi,” kusho uKhwela.Uqhube wathi bayintsha, ekhule ihlala kuleli hostela, bebefunda esikoleni iPhakathi Secondary."Bagcina bexoshwa kulesi sikole ngoba babengalawuleki, bengaziphathisi okwezingane, bedayisa nezidakamizwa,” kusho uKhwela.Esigamekweni saseCamperdown, induna yesigodi, uMnuz Amos Shange, ithe bakhathazekile ngokwanda kobugebengu obudalwa ukwanda kwamakotishi endaweni."Sinenkinga yokuthi kufika abantu bacele ukubekwa endaweni, uma sebebekiwe, bakhe amakotishi, baqashise ngawo,” kusho uShange.Uthe nakuba bekhona abantu abawasebenzisela ukusondezela umsebenzi amakotishi kodwa bayawuzwa umoya wokuthi amanye afuye izigebengu ezisuke zifuna izindawo zokucasha.UKhomishana wamaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi ekhuluma nabe-eNCA, uthe bese kuphele izinyanga befuna abasolwa ababulawe eCamperdown.Uthe baqale ngasekupheleni konyaka odlule ukubalandela, kanti bebefunelwa ukubamba inkunzi izimoto zemali eKing Cetshwayo naseHarry Gwala."Bayiqembu elilodwa. Lisebenza nabanye abakwesinye isifundazwe esingumakhelwane. Babamba inkunzi kulezi zifunda ezimbili bese behamba beqasha amakotishi okucasha,” kusho uMkhwanazi.Uqhube wathi babheka izindawo lapho abangeke belokhu befunwa imininingwane eminingi uma bezoqasha indawo yokuhlala isikhashana."Ngisho nomasitende wale ndawo ababulawe kuyo, akabazisisi kahle,” kusho uMkhwanazi.Esigamekweni saseKlaarwater kuthiwa abasolwa bebelandelwa amaphoyisa ophiko lweNIU. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uBrigadier Jay Naicker, uthe ezigamekweni ezimbili ezehlukene amaphoyisa athole izibhamu ezinhlanu ezingekho emthethweni.Uthe esigamekweni esenzeke eCamperdown, amaphoyisa adubule abulala abane, athola izibhamu ezintathu kubo.Wathi esigamekweni saseKlaarwater, zimbili izibhamu ezitholwe kubasolwa ababili abadutshulwe amaphoyisa.Uthe kuzo zombili izigameko, abasolwa abadubule kuqala bebhekise emaphoyiseni, abuyisela ngayo inhlamvu, basala enkundleni.

Labuye lathi wahamba nendoda. Laphinde lathi wahamba nabesilisa ababili. Wathi baze bamkhuza ukuthi akangashayi umuntu wesifazane kanje,” kusho uVilakazi.Uthe uNdlovu waphinde wabatshela ukuthi lezi zithandani zahamba zaya emqashweni wowesilisa, zibashiya endaweni yokucima ukoma."Wathi kwathi uma sebefika emqashweni ngoba naye uhlala emqashweni ofanayo, bathola ukuthi usephinde waqala phansi wamshaya udadewethu ngoba baqhamukela kuye ekhala,” kusho uVilakazi.Uthe uNdlovu uthi akasakhumbuli ke emva kwalokho ukuthi kwenzekani njengoba naye wahamba wayozilalela.Udalule ukuthi bathola ngowesilisa ongumnikazi wendawo yokucima ukoma ukuthi uNksz Vilakazi wafika kuye ebusuku ezocela usizo lokuthi kufonelwe amaphoyisa ngoba isoka lakhe liyamshaya."Sixakwa ukuthi owesilisa uthi akawafonelanga amaphoyisa ekubeni kwakucacile ukuthi udadewethu usenkingeni. Sisola ukuthi naye unalo ulwazi lokuthi isoka lamenzani udadewethu ngoba uma kukhulunywa nabo, inkulumo yabo icishe ifane ungafunga ukuthi bayavikelana,” usho kanje.Uthe okwenza balahle ithemba lokuthi uzotholakala esaphila ukuthi wayeshawa owesilisa owake walahlwa amacala okubulala ababili abashisa nendlu KwaHhaza eminyakeni eminingi eyedlule.Uthe okunye okwenza balahle ithemba ukuthi ucingo lukadadewabo selokhu lwavaleka lokho, kanti nomholo wakhe wangenyanga edlule awukaze uthintwe."UThabisile uwuhlobo lomuntu othandayo ukuphila kamnandi, ukuthi imali yakhe ingangasetshenziswa kusinika isithombe esingesihle sokuthi kungenzeka ukuthi akasekho,” usho kanje.Uthe bafuna usizo kunoma ubani ongaba nolwazi olungaholela ekutheni atholakale, njengoba sebeye ezibhedlela nasemakhazeni ehlukene kodwa babuya belambatha.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uConstable Thenjiswa Ngcobo, uthe kuvulwe idokodo lokulahleka komuntu esiteshini samaphoyisa eMariannhill.
KUSHODA kwabasebenzi ezikhungweni ezamukela izingcingo uma abantu beshayela inombolo u- 10111eziteshini zamaphoyisa, kuchazwe njengengwadla umphakathi obhekana nayo uma kumele ubike noma umpimpe abathile ngamacala asuke enzeka njengoba izingcingo kugcina sekuthatha isikhathi eside ukuthi ziphendulwe.Ephendula umbuzo we-DA ePhalamende ngesonto eledlule mayelana nezikhala zomsebenzi ezingavaliwe kulezi zikhungo, uNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa uMnuz Bheki Cele, uthe u-41,31% wabasebenzi abakhona ezikhungweni abenza lo msebenzi, okuchaza ukuthi izikhala ezingu- 58,69% zasala zingavaliwe.Esitatimendeni esithunyelwe yi-DA, leli qembu lithe isibalo esikhulu ngalolu hlobo sezikhala ezingavaliwe, sikhombisa ukuhluleka kukaCele."Lezi zibalo zikhombisa ukuthi ungqongqoshe akawugqizi qakala umsebenzi wakhe wokuqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi benele kulesi sikhungo esiwuhlaka olubalulekile emphakathini kwazise yilona olwamukela izingcingo uma abagilwa befuna usizo ngokushesha,” kubhalwe kanje,Kuvele ukuthi zingu- 2.34 million izingcingo ezingene kulezi zikhungo zangamukelwa ezinye zavalwa ngaphambi kokuthi oshaya ucingo adlulise umbiko, okwenzeke ngonyakamali owedlule u-2022/2023. Lokhu kwenza kube u-61,59% kuphela wezingcingo ezamukelwe kulezi zikhungo kuzwelonke, ngonyakamali ofanayo.Echaza ngalokhu, uCele uthe lesi sibalo sisuselwe ezintweni ezimbalwa okungaba ukufoneleka kwale nombolo ngephutha, ukufona udlulise umbiko ongekho okhohlisayo nokunye, noma kunjalo i-DA ikhale ngokuthi lesi yisibalo esiphezulu.UNobhala-jikelele womfelandawonye wezinyunyana, iSouth African Federation of Trade Union uMnuz Zwelinzima Vavi, uthe siyakhathaza isibalo sezikhala zomsebenzi kulesi sikhungo ezingavaliwe."Kumele sikuqonde ukuthi abantu abafoneli kulezi zikhungo ngoba befuna ukudlala nje, kodwa kungenxa yokuthi basuke besesimeni esidinga ezokuphepha ngokushesha noma behlaselwe yizigebengu. Uma kubhekwa imininingwane emenyezelwe uCele, kuyakhombisa ukuthi asikho isikhungo salolu hlobo esisebenza ngokugcwele,” usho kanje.Izifundazwe i-KwaZulu-Natal, i-Free State, i-Mpumalanga ne-Eastern Cape kuthiwa zinesibalo esingu- 60% sabangaqashiwe kulesi sikhungo. Izikhungo ezise-Queensburg e-Eastern Cape neziseSecunda eMpumalanga zinabasebenzi abangu- 8,2 % no- 14,2% ngokwahlukana.

Abalisa abahlanu ababhekene necala, kusolwa ukuthi bamkakisa okwenyamazane uMeyiwa bethengiwe.UMbuso uthi abamangalelwa bayazana bakuhlela bonke ukufa kukaMeyiwa behlangene ehostela. UMbuso uthi abanye bama ngaphandle, abanye bangena ngaphakathi mhla kuyojuqwa uMeyiwa.Ummeli uNxumalo ubepheka ngemibuzo ungoti wamaselula uLieutenant Colonel Gideon Gouws oveze ukuxhumana kwabamangalelwa. UGouws uthe uNtuli waxhumana nabobonke abamangalelwa.UMaphisa uvume nokwazana nommangalelwa wesithathu uMncube athi wumngani wakhe omkhulu. UMaphisa uthe kodwa wayengamazi ummangalewa wokuqala uBongani Ntanzi, waqala ukumbona enkantolo eBoksburg.Ummangalelwa wesithathu uMthobisi Mncube, uthe ubengabazi abamangalelwa owokuqala nowesibili, waqala ukubabona eNkantolo yeMantshi eBoksburg, ngo-2020.Kuqaphelekile ukuthi abamangalelwa bakubheke ngabomvu lobu bufakazi bamaselula ngoba bebelalele bethe njo amehlo. Abanye bebephethe amabhuku namapeni bebhala. Babuye baxoxe banikine amakhanda, bahleke.Ungoti wamaselula uGouws, uthe akakwazi ukuzwa ukuthi abamangalelwa babexoxa bethini ezingcingweni kodwa ukwazi ukubona ukuthi baxhumana isikhathi esingakanani.Phambilini,. ungoti wamaselula wadalula ukuthi uKelly Khumalo wake waxhumana nommangalelwa wesihlanu uFisokuhle Ntuli kodwa kwangavela ukuthi babexoxa bethini.Kulindeleke ukuthi icala liqhubeke namuhla lapho ummeli u-Advocate Zandile Mshololo azopheka khona uGouws ngemibuzo.IJaji uRatha Mokgoatlheng liyalele ojele ukuthi basheshe babalethe abamangalelwa bengalokhu bebika izaba bekhomba isiminyaminya emgwaqweni.
UYIDONSE ngendlebe intsha wathi ayingakhethi imisebenzi uSive Mbizo (29) odume njengobaba wemikhoma ngenxa yokuthi ushaya uphondo olutshela izivakashi ukuthi imikhoma ingakuphi emabhishi aseHermanus, eWestern Cape.Le nsizwa eneziqu zeTourism Management, ithe yayizitshela ukuthi izohlala ehhovisi ngesikhathi iyofuna umsebenzi kodwa yatshelwa ukuthi kunesikhala somuntu ozobiza imikhoma."Emuva kokuphothula iziqu zami zeTourism Management ngangizitshela ukuthi ngizosebenza ehhovisi ngibe wumuntu obhekele ezokuvakasha kodwa kwathi uma ngitshelwa ukuthi kunomsebenzi womuntu ozofutha uphondo uma ebona imikhoma, ngawuthatha. Sengidume kakhulu ngalo msebenzi futhi angisagcini nje ngokuhamba olwandle ngazise abantu ngemikhoma kodwa sengiyiTourism Information Officer, okusho ukuthi yimina engitshela izivakashi ngezinto ezingazenza uma zivakashele eHermanus,” kusho uSive.Uthe intsha kufanele ithathe amathuba ewatholayo noma ngabe akuphi."Intsha ayiwathathe amathuba ewatholayo ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezokuvakasha ngoba maningi amathuba okukhula. Isibonelo nje mina angisagcini ngokutshela abantu ukuthi imikhoma ingakuphi kodwa sengikwazi ukubatshela nangezindawo abangazivakashela nangokunye okuphathelene nezokuvakasha eHermanus. Ngiye ngaqeqeshwa ukuze ngazi ngakho konke okudingwa yizivakashi uma ziya emalokishini. Umkhakha wezokuvakasha ubalulekile ngoba uyakwazi ukudala amathuba omsebenzi,” kusho uSive.Ugqugquzele intsha wathi ayingasongi izandla ngisho noma ngabe isafuna umsebenzi kodwa izame ukuvula amabhizinisi ezokuvakasha."Izivakashi azisagcini emadolobheni kuphela kodwa zifuna ukuya elokishini ziyodla nathi inyama yenhloko, zibonane nabahlala emijondolo ngoba zifuna okuhlukile. Njengamanje ayikho imisebenzi ezimbonini kodwa emkhakheni wezokuvakasha amathuba omsebenzi ayohlale ekhona, okuhle wukuthi noma ngubani uneqhaza angalibamba, akukhathalekile ukuthi ungakanani noma ukuyiphi indawo,” kusho uSive.

Waphuma emotweni wabaleka ebheke kubo kodwa umfundisi wamlandela wangena egunjini lokulala likanina kamgilwa, wase eyamdlwengula,” kusho uSerg Rani.Kusolakala ukuthi emuva kwale sigameko, umfundisi watshela umgilwa ukuthi angatsheli muntu ngokwenzekile. Nina nibanga ithambo elingenanyama, niyayiyeka inyama."Osekomitini lomphakathi, uMnuz Mnelisi Shange, ukuphikile ukuthi bahudulela phansi igama likaNgubane.Uthe babiza umhlangano wangoMgqibelo ngoba bekhathazekile ngokumiswa kokwakhiwa komgwaqo.UMnuz Salanjalo Mncwabe, uthe kwakungafanele uNgubane amise ukwakhiwa komgwaqo engakhulumile nesizwe asibusayo."Inkosi iyinkosi ngesizwe sayo. Inkwali yahlala emgwaqweni, kwaze kwadaleka ingozi."

Abe-IEC abayiphendulanga incwadi nokulandelwe wukuthi uKhumalo alufake enkantolo udaba.UKa-Sibotho uthe sebeyohlangana enkantolo lapho beyochaza kahle konke."Sibathumelele incwadi bangayiphendula, manje udaba sizolufaka eNkantolo yezoKhetho kube iyona enqumayo. BASWELE amaphiko okundiza osomabhizinisi baKwaZulu-Natal abathole izitifiketi eziklelisa izindawo zabo ngenkanyezi eyodwa.UNkk Bronwen Auret oyi-chief quality assurance officer kwiSouth African Tourism, uthe baqale uhlelo lokuqeqesha osomabhizinisi abanezindawo zokuhlala abantu emakhaya nasemalokishini ngo-Okthoba 2021, e-Eastern Cape kwathi sebebona ukuthi luyasebenza baludlulisela KwaZulu-Natal ngoNovemba 2022 lwaphela ngoNovemba 2023."Inhloso yalolu hlelo wukuqinisekisa ukuthi akekho osala ngemuva kwezokuvakasha, bonke abantu bayangena kulo mkhakha kusukela kwabasemalokishini nabasezindaweni zasemakhaya. KwaZulu-Natal siqeqeshe osomabhizinisi abawu-210 kodwa bawu-150 abathole izitifiketi ezinenkanyezi eyodwa. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma izivakashi zifuna izindawo zokuhlala ezithembekile zizobona zona kuqala,” kusho uNkk Auret.Uthe emabhizinisini ase-Eastern Cape abawasizile, bathole ukuthi asethola izivakashi unyaka wonke okusho ukuthi nabantu bahlale besebenza.UNkk Lungile Hlabisa weMbopha Guest House esoLundi, uthe sisho lukhulu isitifiketi ngoba manje abantu bazokwazi ukuthi yize besendaweni esemakhaya kodwa izinga labo liphezulu futhi bathembekile.Uthe ukuba sohlelweni lokuqeqeshelwa inkanyezi kwenza abantu basheshe bazi ngabo.UMnuz Luyanda Khoza weVikama Guest House esoLundi , uthe ukuba nenkanyenzi kuyawenza umehluko ngoba ngisho uhulumeni uyabaletha abantu abazohlala endaweni yabo.UNksz Busi Mhlongo wendawo yokuhlala izivakashi ekwaP nakwaN KwaMashu, Umusa Guest House, uthe bayajabula ukuthi izindawo zabo zombili sezinesitifiketi senkanyezi eyodwa.Uthe ibhizinisi lihamba kahle ngoba ukuqeqeshelwa inkanyezi kubavulela amathuba okuthenjwa yibo bonke abasemkhakheni wokuvakasha.Ubalule ukuthi izindawo zabo zisetshenziswa ngisho nayizinhlelo zethelevishini eziqoshwa KwaMashu okubalwa Uzalo, Imbewu neminye imidlalo.Uveze ukuthi sebedale amathuba omsebenzi awu-15 kanti bazimisele ukudala eminye njengoba benethemba lokuthi zizokwanda izivakashi ezibahambelayo
UMNDENI wendoda yaseMpangeni, okuthiwa ingcwatshwe yintombi umkayo engazi, ususabise ngokuthi lolu daba uzoluyisa enkantolo ngesonto elizayo.Kuvela ukuthi umufi uMnuz Bhekithemba Thusi (62) ungcwatshwe eSonyongwane, eMzimkhulu, kubo kwentombi, uNksz Sindisiwe Ngcongo (36).Kuthiwa umufi ubesebenzela eGoli kodwa esejwayele ukubuya ayohlala nentombi eMzimkhulu. Ekhaya kuthiwa imali ubeyithumela.Kuvela ukuthi umufi nentombi bese bethandane isikhathi eside, kodwa bengenayo ingane.UNkk Nozuzile Thusi (58) obegane umufi, uthe angeke athule kugxotshwa ilungelo lakhe.Utshele Isolezwe ukuthi sekunesikhathi eside azi ngomjolo womyeni wakhe nentombi.Uveze ukuthi kunesikhathi lapho umufi acela khona ukuthi abe nesithembu, kodwa yena washaya phansi ngonyawo.Uthe unezingane ezimbili zabafana nomufi. Eyokuqala ineminyaka engu-28, eyesibli ineminyaka engu-24."Iyangicasula le nto eyenziwe yile ntombazane. Ukuthi bengazi ngobudlelwano bayo nomyeni wami, akuchazi ukuthi yenze le nto embi kangaka,'' echaza.Uthe ushayelwe ucingo intombi ngeSonto, imazisa ukuthi umyeni uxinwe wukugula washona base bemfihla khona eMzimkhulu. Uthe ngoMsombuluko unikele eMzimkhulu.Uthe ubengakwazi nalapho okuhlala khona intombi kodwa uguduze waze wafika esizwa ngowesilisa obesebenza nomyeni obekwazi."Ngithe uma ngingena egcekeni ngakhangwa yintombi ifake izingubo ezimnyama. Ngayibuza ukuthi imzilela kanjani umuntu engamganile?” echaza.Uthi intombi ivele yanxapha yase ithi akamlandele amkhombise ithuna okufihlwe khona umyeni wakhe."Ngizwe zehla izinyembezi ngabona ukuthi impela ngiyalingwa. Ngivele ngalibuka ngase ngiyahamba. Ngiwakhuzile amadodana ami esesho ukumqeda lo wesifazane,'' echaza.Indodana endala, uMnuz Scebi Thusi, ithe angeke bande ngalolu daba, kuyolamula inkantolo.Ithintwa intombi, ithe yona inelungelo eligcwele lokufihla umufi. "Bese ngihlale nale ndoda iminyaka eyisikhombisa. Yiyona futhi okuthe uma seyigula yangicela ukuba ngiyingcwabe lapha ekhaya,'' isho kanje yavala ucingo.Khonamanjalo: Umndeni wakwaZungu eMahlabathini, oLundi, ukhala esifanayo, ngomasihlalisane okuthiwa ungcwabe owesilisa eFree State, ngoMgqibelo, engagunyaziwe.UNkk Simangele Zungu (62) ukhala ngesihluku asenziwe owesifazane athe umyeni wakhe, uMnuz James Zungu (64), ubesenezingane ezimbili naye nazo asanda kuthola ngazo.Uthe bekungakapholi maseko bethole ngezingane ngesikhathi eyodwa yazo ibabikela ngo-Ephreli 30, ukuthi uyise uyagula, akasakwazi nokukhuluma."Sithe sisamangazwe yilokho, sithi sizokwenza izaba zokuya khona, yaphinde yathi useshonile ezintatha zangoMeyi 1."Izingane zami ezintathu zinikele khona ngenhloso yokuthi zibuye nesidumbu sakhe kodwa zahlangabezana nezingqinamba, bengafuni ukudedela isidumbu," kusho uNkk Zungu.Uthi baqale babeka izaba zokuthi kukhokhwe uR11 000 emakhazeni ayesefakwe kuwo uZungu, nokuthe izingane zikaNkk Zungu sezilungiselela ukuwukhokha, zahlaselwa yiqulu elalihamba nomasihlalisane kamyeni wakhe, lizovimba."Kulona kwakukhona nababephethe izibhamu, izingane zami zaphuma ngesamagundane," echaza.Uthe ufisa ukuthola usizo lwabameli abangammela enkantolo enkulu, alwe olokungcwatshwa kukamyeni, eFree State."Ngize ngaya eMnyangweni wezaseKhaya ngiyobhekisisa ukuthi ngabe kuthiwa wafaka isehlukaniso yini umyeni wami."Ngafica ukuthi ngisewuye unkosikazi wakhe futhi yimi ngedwa obhalwe phansi ngokusemthethweni," usho kanje. Uveze ukuthi umyeni wakhe ubesabuya ekhaya njengenjwayelo uma kungamaholidi futhi bekuthi uma kunemicimbi yesizulu okufanele igcinwe ekhaya, abekhona, bekhuluma nasocingweni.UNksz Slindile Melanu obengumasihlalisane ucele ukuthi athunyelelwe umyalezo ocingweni angazange awuphendule. Nocingo ubengasalupheduli.Ummeli uMpumelelo Zikalala uthe intombi kayivumelekile ukungcwaba umuntu engashadile naye, wathi isixazululo salokhu kuba incwadi yefa eshiywa ngumufi.Uthe umufi uma ekubhalile ukuthi ufisa ukufihlwa yintombi, lokho kungenzeka.Udalule ukuthi kulandelwa lokho okuyizifiso zikamufi, kodwa kulolu daba umama oshadile kulula ukuthi udaba aluyise enkantolo alunqobe.Uthe kodwa inkantolo imvamisa ithatha isikhathi eside ngaphambi kokuba ikhiphe isinqumo ngodaba olufuze lolu.
KUDUTSHULWE kwabulawa umsolwa obengaphandle ngebheyili yamacala angu-29 okweba nokuduna izimoto.Ithimba elihlanganisa amaphoyisa ezinhlaka ezahlukene nenkampani yonogada ezimele bebelandela abasolwa ecaleni lokuthunjwa kukasomabhizini waseBenoni, uMnuz Shamshudeen Faki.Lo somabhizinisi oneminyaka engu-68 ubudala, wathunjwa esendaweni yebhizinisi lakhe ngoMgqibelo ngoMeyi 11. Abasolwa baxhumana nomndeni wakhe befuna izigidi zamaRandi ukuze adedelwe.Ngokombiko wamaphoyisa, umgilwa wafa esasezandleni zabathumbi bakhe kanti isidumbu sakhe size satholakala ngoMsombuluko, silaxazwe eDalpark.KUDUTSHULWE kwabulawa umsolwa obengaphandle ngebheyili yamacala angu-29 okweba nokuduna izimoto. isithombe: SAPS"Isidumbu sikamgilwa owathunjwa ngoMgqibelo sitholwe amalungu eCPF eDalpark, ngoMsombuluko, okuyiwona ashayele amaphoyisa,” kusho amaphoyisa ngesitatimende.Ithimba ebelihlanganiselwe ukuphenya icala lokuthumba lilandele umkhondo wolwazi ngabasolwa lwabaholela kuN12 phakathi kweKliprivier nejika lomgwaqo uXavier eGoli, lapho kube nokungqubuzana nabasolwa abebehamba ngengqovungqovu yeveni ngoLwesibili ebusuku.Umsolwa obehamba ngale moto udutshulwe wabulawa ngamaphoyisa. Ngesikhathi kuseshwa imoto abehamba ngayo kutholakale izincwadi zikaMnuz Faki, amalambu aluhlaza, izinombolo zezimoto ezazisetshenziswa kuthunjwa umufi, izibhamu ezimbili okuyi-pistol nevolovolo.Uphenyo lokuqala luveze ukuthi lo msolwa obulewe unamacala angu-29 okweba nokuduna izimoto futhi ubefunwa ngamaphoyisa kulandela ukunyamalala ngemuva kokudedelwa ngebheyili.Amaphoyisa aveze ukuthi ayaqhubeka nokuthungatha abanye abasolwa abebesebenza nalo obulewe.
UZOBHALISA kwiNHI emtholampilo, kudokotela noma esibhedlela esinenkontileka ne-NHI uma uqala ukuya khona, ngemuva kwalokho ngeke kudingeke ukuthi ubhalise, uma uya kunoma yimuphi omunye umtholampilo, udokotela noma esibhedlela ngoba amarekhodi akho azobe esetholakala kubo bonke abahlinzeka ngezempilo abanenkontileka. Ngabe abantu bazokwazi ukusebenzisa izinsiza abazithandayo?Yebo. Abantu bazokwazi ukuthola odokotela abanenkontileka ye-NHI, emitholampilo noma izibhedlela eziseduze nabo, kungakhathaleki ukuthi ezikahulumeni noma ezizimele.Yiziphi izinsiza ezizohlinzekwa ngaphansi kwe-NHI?I-NHI izokhava inzuzo yosizo lwezempilo oluphelele ezikhungweni zezempilo ezinenkontileka ye-NHI zikahulumeni nezizimele.Ama-Medical Aid ngeke avumeleke ukuthi akhave inzuzo ekhavwe iNHI uma isiqalile ukusebenza kodwa izibhedlela ezizimele zizoqhubeka zibe khona.Uma zisize iziguli zizokhokhelwa iNHI njengoba kwenza ama-mediacal aid njengamanje. Ayisezukubakhona imali okumele ikhokhwe isiguli eceleni ebizwa ngama-levy nama co-payments.
INKANTOLO eNkulu yasoPhongolo ilahle ngamacala okubulala angu-20 umshayeli weloli eladala isibhicongo libulala abafundi nothisha ngo-2022.USibusiso Siyaya (28) uphinde walahlwa ngamanye amacala amabili okungelokushayela budedengu nelokuhluleka ukulandela imigomo eyenziwa umshayeli osuke ebandakanyeke engozini.Ulahlwe ngala macala ngoLwesibili kanti kulindeleke ukuthi iJaji Garth Davis limgwebe namuhla uSiyaya.UMbuso ubumelwe uqweqwe loMshushisi, u-Advocate Krishen Shah. USiyaya ubemelwe ugalalagala lommeli wakwaLegal Aid eNkantolo eNkulu obuye abe yibamba lejaji, uMnuz Pregasen Marimuthu.Icala liqale ukuqulwa ngo-Ephreli 15 nonyaka, kwaphothulwa ngesonto eledlule ukwenziwa kwezethulo uShah benoMarimuthu benxenxa ijaji ukuba libavune.Umqulu oqukethe uhlu lwamacala athweswe uSiyaya uveza ukuthi wayeqashwe uMnuz Perry Masinga enkampanini iiBaoBao Projects.Wayekade esebenzela inkampani ethutha ilahle isuka esifundazweni iMpumalanga ilisa echwebeni laseRichards Bay.Okhulumela uMnyango wezokuThutha KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Kwanele Ncalane, uthe bayakwamukela ukulahlwa ngecala kukaSiyaya."Besihlale sisho ukuthi sikholwa wukuthi imbangela yale ngozi kwaba ubudedengu bomuntu, okuwumshayeli weloli. Besilibheke ngeso lokhozi leli cala. Sinethemba lokuthi lizoba yisifundo nakwabanye abashayeli bamaloli,” kusho uNcalane.Uqhube wathi banethemba lokuthi isigwebo esizokhishwa yinkantolo sizothumela umyalezo oshubile nakwabanye abashayeli bamaloli abanomqondo ofanayo nokaSiyaya emigwaqweni.Uveze nokuthi umnyango ukholelwa ukuthi isigwebo esizonikezwa uSiyaya sizoyithoba amanxeba imindeni yabashonelwa.NgoSepthemba 16, 2022, uSiyaya wasika izimoto eziningi ngeloli kuyizimoto ayekade ephambana nazo ezazimvika.Kuthiwa wayeqhubeka elibelesela iloli kwaze kwaba lishayisana mahlanze neveni eyayilayishe abafundi ababebuya esikoleni. Kwashona abafundi abangu-18, uthisha nomshayeli weveni owayeneminyaka engu-19.
