KUYAQHUBEKA ukuhlonzwa kwezidumbu kulandela ukuwa kwebhilidi elingamafulethi ayizitezi ezinhlanu ngoMsobuluko odlule.Ukuwa kwaleli bhilidi elisemgwaqweni u75 Victoria, eGeorge kwathusa abaningi ezweni lonke kanti umsebenzi wokutakula abangakatholakali usaqhubeka yize sekuphele amahora angaphezu kuka-211 kwenzeka isehlo.Umbiko wakamuva oqinisekiswe wumasipala waseGeorge uthi babengu-81 abasebenzi abebekhona ngosuku lwesehlo, bangu-62 abatholakele, bangu-12 abasesibhedlela, bangu-33 abashonile kanti bangu-19 abangakatholakali.Kwabashonile, bangu-27 abesilisa kanti abesifazane bayisithupha.Umasipala waseGeorge uveza ukuthi uyaqhubeka umsebenzi wokuhlonza abalimele nabashonile kanti bangu-47 abagilwa asebaxhunyaniswe nemindeni yabo.Umsebenzi wokuhlonzwa kwezidumbu owenziwa amaphoyisa ngokubambisana nabezempilo esifundazweni iWestern Cape uthela izithelo ezinhle njengoba sekuhlonzwe izidumbu ezingu-18. Kulezi zidumbu ezihlonziwee zingu-14 ngezabesilisa kanti ezine ezabantu besifazane. Kubo bonke abashonile asebahlonziwe, bayisikhombisa abakuleli, kanti abakwamanye amazwe bami kanje:- Zimbabwe: 3- Lesotho: 1- Malawi: 5- Mozambique: 2Umasipala waseGeorge uyaqhubeka nesicelo emindenini elahlekelwe yizihlobo zayo ukuba ixhumane namaphoyisa ukuze kuzosizakala nalabo abangakahlonzwa.
SEBEBHEKE uMengameli uCyril Ramaphosa, asayine umthetho womshwalense wezempilo okhalisa abaningi, iNational Health Insurance (NHI) bese bemfaka enkantolo.Kunezinhlangano eseziphumele obala zathi zizokuphonsela inselelo enkantolo ukusayinwa kwalo mthetho.Umthetho uzosayinwa namhlanje, e-Union Buildings. Phakathi kwabaphikisa ukusayinwa komthetho kukhona izinhlangano zodokotela, ezamabhizinisi, izinyunyana nezepolitiki. Inhloso yomshwalense ukuthi zonke izakhamuzi zithole izinsiza zezempilo ezisezingeni eliphezulu, ukuxilongwa okuyikho nokwelashwa mahhala.Abaphikisana nawo bakhala ngokuthi umthetho uphambene nomthethosisekelo, bakhala nangokuthi imibono yezinhlaka ezithintekayo yashaywa indiva ngesikhathi kunezigcawu zasephalamende.Umholi weDA, uMnuz John Steenhuisen uthe abameli babo sebelinde ukuthi uRamaphosa asayine, bese befaka icala enkantolo."Kade saqala ukulungiselela lo mzuzu. Abameli bethu sabatshela konke ezinyangeni ezimbalwa ezedlule. Bazofaka icala ngokushesha uma nje uRamaphosa eke wawusayina umthetho,” kusho uMnuz Steehuisen.Uthe isimemezelo sikaRamaphosa sesidale itwetwe kubantu abangazi ukuthi kuzokwenzakalani kuma-medical aid abo.Uthe uRamaphosa uzama ukuthola amavoti njengoba ukhetho selusemome, usebonile ukuthi bazohlulwa okhethweni, yingakho esegijima esayina lo mthetho.Ilungu le-ActionSA, uDkt Kgosi Letlape lithe ukusayinwa komthetho kuzokwenza ukuthi kubhubhudlwe imali njengoba kwenzeka ngesikhathi kubheduka ubhubhane i-corona."Nakuba kunezinhloso ezinhle zokwenza abantu bathole ezempilo ezilinganayo, inkinga ukuthi indlela oyiyo lo mthetho, uzokwenza ukuthi kube nenkohlakalo esayibona ngesikhathi se-corona."Iminyango kahulumeni isikhombise kaningi ukuthi iyehluleka ukuphatha ngendlela imali,” kusho uDkt LetlapeIsikhulu esiphezulu kwiBusa, uMnuz Cas Coovadia sithe umthetho awuhambisani nomthethosisekelo, sathi bazothatha izinyathelo zomthetho uma ugcina usayinwa.Uthe umthetho uzokhinyabeza ezempilo nomnotho. Ngokomthethosivivinyo ozosayinwa ube ngumthetho namhlanje, kudingeka imali ephakathi kuka-R200 -R700 billion ngonyaka.Inyunyana yabasebenzi, iPublic Service Association ithe akucaci kahle ukuthi imali yeNHI izovela kuphi ngaphandle kokuthi abasebenzi bazokhokha intela nokuyinto ezobathwalisa kanzima.Inhlangano emele abasebenzi bezempilo abangu-25 000, iSA Health Professionals Collaboration (SAHPC), ithe iziphakamiso abazenza kusukela ngo-2011, zishaywe indiva.Okhulumela iSAHPC uDkt Simon Strachan uthe bebefuna ukuthi uRamaphosa awuphindisele emuva umthetho, uyoxoxwa kabusha ephalamende."Okwethu ukukhathazeka wukuthi sifisa iNHI ithuthukise uhlelo oluvele lukhona, ingalushonisi phansi,”kusho uDkt Strachan.
UMENGAMELI Cyril Ramaphosa ukhale ngobunzima nezinkinga abhekane nazo ehlandleni lakhe lokuqala lokuphatha izwe.URamaphosa uthe uchithe isikhathi esiningi elungisa izinkinga kule minyaka emihlanu yokuqala ephethe izwe.Lokhu ukusho ngesikhathi ekhuluma nosomabhizinisi, eGoli.URamaphosa uthe ezinye zezinkinga ezehle ngesikhathi kuphethe yena azikaze zibonwe kule lizwe."Kule minyaka emihlanu sithwale kanzima, silungisa izinkinga esizificile nezinkinga ezisehlele. Sichithe isikhathi esiningi silungisa, sakha kabusha.”URamaphosa ubale izibhelu zokuzitapela zango-2021, izikhukhula, nokulawulwa koMbuso yidlanzana njengezinye zezinselelo abhekane nazo.URamaphosa uthe izibhelu ezaziKwaZulu-Natal nasezingxenyeni zaseGauteng zakhinyabeza umnotho.Kwashona abantu abangu-354 kulezo zibhelu ezaqubuka emva kokuboshwa kowayengumengameli, uJacob Zuma, owaboshelwa icala lokudelela umyalelo weNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo.URamaphosa uthe izibhelu zaveza ngokusobala ubuthaka bezinhlaka zokuvikela kuleli."Kwacaca ukuthi izinhlaka zokuphepha nezinhloli zibuthaka, nokwenza ukuthi umonakalo ube mkhulu.”URamaphosa uthe kubathathe isikhathi eside ukuthi balungise umonakalo owadalwa izibhelu.Uthe kuthe besaxakwe umthelela wezibhelu, kwahlasela izikhukhula, ezaba mandla kakhulu, eThekwini.Kwashona abantu abangu-495 KwaZulu-Natal ngesikhathi kuhlasela izikhukhula."Ukuhlasela kwezikhukhula kwacekela phansi ingqalasizinda emqoka, nokwaphazamisa ukuhanjiswa kwezidingo.”URamaphosa uthe ngesikhathi engena ehhovisi ubhekane nomthwalo wokuqeda ukulawulwa koMbuso yidlanzana."Sithe uma sifika sakwazi ukuyiqeda nya le nto yokulawulwa koMbuso yidlanzana. Bonke labo ababebambe iqhaza ekulawulweni koMbuso yidlanzana, sebabaleka bazephula. Siyazi ke kodwa ukuthi bakhona ababesebenzisana nabo abasasele.”URamaphosa uthe kuningi abakwenzayo ukulwa nenkohlakalo, athe kukona kukhona nokunikezwa kwezinhlangano eziphenyayo amandla athe xaxa, nokusungula ezinye izinhlaka ezilwa nenkohlakalo.URamaphosa uthe inkohlakalo ayiqali manje njengoba sekuphethe i-ANC."Uhulumeni wobandlululo nawo wawukhohlakele. Into eyayikhona ukuthi abezindaba babengabiki ngokukhululeka ngesikhathi kusaphethe uhulumeni wobandlululo. Ingakho wawungeke uzwe kukhulunywa ngenkohlakalo."Uma abantu bekhuluma ngenkohlakalo, bakhuluma sengathi inkohlakalo lena inkinga ekhungethe uhulumeni kuphela. Iqiniso ukuthi inkohlakalo idla lubi nasezinkampanini ezizimele.”
UHULUMENI ugunyaze ukuba kuphenywe kabusha ngembangela yokukhothama kweNkosi u-Albert Luthuli eyayingumengameli we-ANC nokusocongwa kukaMnuz Griffiths Mxenge owayeyisishoshovu sikaKhongolose.Kuzophenywa nangembangela yokubulawa kowayengumholi womphakathi uMnuz Booi Mantyi.Lokhu kugunyazwe uNgqongqoshe wezobuLungiswa nokuHlunyeleliswa kweziMilo uMnuz Ronald Lamola.ULamola ubethole isicelo esivela ophikweni lezokushushisa, iNational Prosecuting Authority (NPA).ULuthuli, owahlabana ngendondo iNobel Peace Prize, wadlula emhlabeni ngoJulayi 21, 1967. Ngokwemibiko eqoshwe phansi, imbangela yokukhothama kwakhe kwaba wukushayiswa isitimela ngasesiteshini iGledhow.Okhulumela lomnyango uMnuz Chrispin Phiri, esitatimendeni uthe ngo-1967 uhulumeni wobandlululo wenza uphenyo eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseStanger eyathola ukuthi uLuthuli wafahlaka ugebhezi nobuchopho.UPhiri uthe inkantolo ngaleso sikhathi yathi abukho ubufakazi obabukhomba ukuthi kube nonyawo lwemfene ekukhothameni kukaLuthuli."Kube nombiko owethulelwe iNPA oveze ukuthi uphenyo lwango-1967, lwashiya ngaphandle ubufakazi obubalulekile."Lobufakazi bezobuchwepheshe buveza ukuthi iNkosi Luthuli yayingeke ishayiswe isitimela siyibulale,” kusho uPhiri.Uthe kungenxa yalobu bufakazi nobethulelwa kwiKhomishini yamaQiniso obenze uLamola wemukela isicelo seNPA, wavuma nokuthi kuphenywe kabusha.Kulindeleke ukuthi uLamola acele uMengameli wamaJaji KwaZulu-Natal ukuba avule uphenyo ngokukhothama kukaLuthuli.Isidumbu sikaMxenge, satholakala enkundleni yezemidlalo eMlaza ngoNovemba 20,1981sinamanxeba angu-45.Kuvela ukuthi uphenyo lwango-1983, lukahulumeni wobandlululo ngembangela yokufa kwakhe, lwahluleka ukuthola ababulali bakaMxenge.Kuthiwa uMantyi wabulawa emuva kwengxabano namaphoyisa ngesikhathi sobandlululo ngo-1985 eNorthern Cape.Uphenyo lwango-1985 olwenziwa e-De Aar ngembangela yokufa kukaMantyi, lwaveza ukuthi akukho muntu okumele abekwe icala ngokufa kwakhe.UPhiri uthe ubufakazi obusha bukhomba ukuthi kunomuntu owazibonela ngamehlo isigameko ongazange afakaze ekuqaleni.
ZIZOQALA ukufundwa ngonyaka ozayo emazingeni aphansi ezikoleni zakuleli izifundo ezintsha ezizogxila kwezesayensi nobuchwepheshe, iCoding and Robotics.Lezi zifundo zigunyazwe ukuthi zifundwe wumkhandlu oqinisekisa izingabunjalo lemiphumela, Umalusi.Lokhu kuvezwe nguNgqongqoshe weMfundo eyisiSekelo uNkk Angie Motshekga, ekhuluma engqungqutheleni yabeluleka ngalezi zifundo eBirchwood Hotel & OR Tambo Conference Centre, eGoli.Uthe balubuyekezile uhlelo lokufunda nokufundiswa kwalezi zifundo abebesaluvivinya bathola nezincomo emphakathini kanjalo nakuMalusi."Lezi zifundo zizofundwa kusuka kwaGrade R kuya kwaGrade 9. Uhlelo luzoqala ngonyaka ozayo, kodwa emazingeni aphansi okwamanje, luzobe selwenabela nakwamanye amabanga.”Uthe luzogxila ezintweni zesayensi nokuxazululwa kwezinkinga ezikhona kulo mkhakha wesayensi."Abafundi bazokwazi ukwenza izinto ezintsha, bazofunda bebe benza kanti bazobe besebenzisa nezinto ezithinta amakhomyputha,” kusho uNkk Motshekga.Uthe bazokwakha izinto besebenzisana namarobhothi, emikhakheni ehlukene ethinta ezobunjiniyela. "Lezi zifundo zizolungiselela abafundi abazokwenza imikhakha ehlukene ethinta amakhompyutha, izibalo, ezobunjiniyela, ezobuchwepheshe neminye. Zizoqinisa ukufundwa kwezinye izifundo ezivele zikhona ezifana neCreative Arts, nezinye ezithinta impilo jikelele.” Uthe kubalulekile ukuthi abafundi babe nolwazi ngezinto ezithinta ubuchwepheshe ikakhulu ngalesi sikhathi njengoba abantu abaningi sebephila ngobuchwepheshe. Ubalule nebanga elihanjiwe emkhakheni wemfundo eyisisekelo eminyakeni engu-30 edlule.Uveze ukuthi kube nezinguquko ezinqala selokhu kwatholakala inkululeko."Sivule iminyango kwezemfundo njengoba phambilini imfundo yayihlukaniswe ngokobuhlanga. Manje kuyimpoqo ukuthi abafundi abaneminyaka engu-7, kuya ku-15 babe sezikoleni.”Ubalule nokuthi kunezinhlelo ezihlomulisa abafundi abahlwempu njengohlelo lokudla ezikoleni."Lolu hlelo luphakela abafundi abangu-9.6 million ngosuku ezikoleni ezingu-21 274. Bangu-61 314 abaphakela abafundi abathola itoho bakwazi ukondla imindeni yabo. Uhlelo lokudla lwenza abafundi bangalovi ezikoleni futhi bathola ukudla okunazo zonke izakhamzimba.” Uveze ukuthi basebenza ngamandla ukuqala uhlelo lokuthi kube nesidlo sasekuseni nsuku zonke ezikoleni.Ubalule nohlelo lwezikole kuzona okungakhokhwa nhlobo imali yokufunda."Sinyukile isibalo sezikole okungakhokhwa nhlobo kuzona njengoba zingu-80% kuleli. Lokhu kwenza ukuthi nabahlwempu bakwazi ukuthola imfundo.” Ukhale ngezinselelo ezisekhona kwezemfundo ukungaphephi ezikoleni, izidakamizwa kanjalo nodlame ezikoleni.Ubalule ukuthi sebefake ugesi ezikoleni eziningi selokhu izwe lakhululeka.Uthe njengoba kuzoba nokhetho kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bavote.
UKUQINISEKISA ukuthi izivakashi ziphephile, uhulumeni utshale uR174.5 million ukuvikela izindawo ezihanjelwa kakhulu yizivakashi, waqasha nabaqaphi abawu-2 300.Lezi zindaba zivezwe wuNgqongqoshe wezokuVakasha, uNkk Patricia de Lille ngesikhathi evula ngokusemthethweni umbukiso wezokuvakasha, i-Africa’s Travel Indaba oseNkosi Albert Luthuli Internatonal Convention Centre (ICC), eThekwini.UNkk de Lille uthe basebenzisana nezinhlaka ezehlukene kusukela kuhulumeni kazwelonke, amaphoyisa kahulumeni nawomasipala ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izivakashi ziphephile.Uthe amaphoyisa atshalwe ngobuningi bawo e-ICC nakwezinye izindawo ezihanjelwa yizivakashi.Amazwi akhe ananelwe wuSomlomo weTheku, uMnuz Thabani Nyawose oveze ukuthi umasipala uwatshale kuwo wonke amakhona aleli dolobha amaphoyisa kanti ngisho emalokishini azobe ebonakala.Ngaphandle kwamaphoyisa ahamba ngezinyawo, uNyawose uthe basebenzisa ubuchwepheshe besimanje ukuqapha ubugebengu."Sitshale uR8.1 million sithenga imishini yobuchwepheshe esisiza ukuqapha ubugebengu. Lokhu sikwenzela ukuvikela izakhamuzi zeTheku nezivakashi ezisiza ukufukula umnotho nokudala amathuba omsebenzi. I-Africa’s Travel Indaba ngomunye wemibukiso ekhombisa ukuthi iTheku likulungele ukuhweba namanye amazwe nokwamukela izivakashi. Ezokuphepha siziqaphe ngeso lokhozi. Njalo ngonyaka siyawandisa amaphoyisa kamasipala ngokuqasha awu-400,” kusho uNyawose.UNkk de Lille uthe umkhakha wezokuvakasha ubalulekile ngoba ngonyaka odlule ungenise uR458.9 billion emnothweni.Uthe kuyamjabulisa ukubona abantu bakuleli bevakasha wabagqugquzela ukuthi nakulo nyaka benze njalo njengoba kuzoba nezipesheli ngaphansi komkhankaso we-Shot Left ezizoqala ngoSepthemba 2 ziphele ngoSepthemba 8.Uveze ukuthi i-Africa’s Travel Indaba iyakhula njengoba inamazwe awu-26 ase-Afrika okukhona kuwo namabili amasha okuyi-Burkina Faso ne-Eritrea aqalayo ukuza kulo mbukiso.UNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Nomusa Dube-Ncube, uthe i-Africa’s Travel Indaba ibalulekile ngoba yenzeka ngoMeyi okuyinyanga ye-Afrika kanti indikimba yalo nyaka ethi, Unlimited Afrika, yinhle kakhulu.Uthe bayajabula ngokuthi umkhakha wezokuvakasha ususesimeni esingcono kakhulu kunaleso owawukusona ngesikhathi seCovid-19.
KUSUKE inkombankombane phakathi kweMeya kuMasipala Umzinyathi, uMnuz Petros Ngubane, nosomabhizinisi waseMsinga osolwa ngokuvalela umphakathi amanzi ekhala ngokungakhokhelwa, okuthiwa sekuyophela inyanga engabonwa endaweni.Abantu kule ndawo kuthiwa sebethembele emanzini abagcina ngokuwakhongozela emvuleni, kulabo abangenawo amandla okuwathenga ezitolo. Kule ndawo kunesibhedlela i-Church of Scotland naso okuthiwa sikhahlamezekile njengoba amanzi engekho. Isolezwe lithinta uNgubane, uvumile ukuthi amanzi awekho endaweni, wathi bathole ukuthi avalwe usonkontileka wenkampani i-FDM Construction enikezwe umsebenzi wokuhambisela umphakathi amanzi ngamaloli, uMnuz Simanga Mabaso, emva kokuthi ekhale ngokungakhokhelwa emva kokuthi emisiwe."Ngiye kule ndawo ngesonto eledlule emva kokuthola izikhalo ngokungaphumi kwamanzi. Sithole ukuthi esinye isiphehlimanzi sethu sivalwe nguMabaso okuthiwa uxoshe onogada bakamasipala wafaka abakhe, wavala ngokwakhe kule ndawo yokusebenzela. Ngithe abamvulele icala ngalesi senzo, ngenxa yokuthi bengingaphandle kwesifundazwe, ngizozwa ngoLwesibili ukuthi kuqhubekani ngalolu daba,” usho kanje.Ebuzwa ngemali ekweletwa lo somabhizinisi, unqabile ukuphawula wathi udaba lokumiswa kwakhe nenkontileka ethinta ukukhokhelana, kusingethwe yihhovisi leMenenja kuMasipala, yena akangene. Uthe ubuye wavula ngoMsombuluko odlule emva kokuvumelana ngokuthi uzokhokhelwa lingakapheli leli sonto. Yize esho kanje uMabaso nanamuhla amanzi awekho. Ngokusho kwakhe lokhu sekudalwa ukuthi eminye imishini kulesi siphehlimanzi ifile kwazise umasipala ukweleta omunye usonkontileka imali yokulungisa lemishini."Okokuqala; angikuveze ukuthi angixoshwanga wumasipala kodwa ngixoshwa uNgubane. Ungixoshe emva komcimbi weqembu i-MK (Party) esengiyilungu layo, obesezinkundleni zezemidlalo (eMphelankani), ngoMashi 20, okuthe emva kwawo ngaziswa ukuthi amaloli ami awasadingeki. Ngilindile-ke ukuthi ngokuphela kukaMashi njengoba sengixoshiwe ngizokhokhelwa imali engikweletwa yona, kodwa lutho. Kwaphela u-Ephreli ngangakhokhelwa ngagcina ngibona ukuthi indlela engingakwazi ukubhikisha ngayo ukuze ngithole okungokwami ukuvala isiphehlimanzi kodwa sengisivulile kodwa amanzi awaphumi ngoba sifile,” usho kanje.UMabaso uthe uvala nje isiphehlimanzi bese kuvele kunesikhathi eside singasebenzi ngenxa yokufa kwaso, kanti naye inkinga yamanzi yinto emlimaze kakhulu njengoba enamabhizinisi ehlukene kuleya ndawo. Uveze ukuthi Umsinga wonke amanzi awekho kubalwa nasezikhungweni zikahulumeni ezisiza umphakathi, wathi kunamahlebezi okuthi ngoLwesine kungase kube nokhukhulengoqo wesiteleka lapho abantu bezobhikishela amanzi osekunesikhathi eside bawagcina.Okhulumela uMnyango wezoBusa ngokuBambisana uMnuz Siboniso Mngadi, uthe umsebenzi wamanzi unikezwe umasipala omkhulu okuyiwona onelungelo lokuxazulula izinkinga zamanzi."Umasipala nosomabhizinisi kumele bahlale phansi baxoxe ukuthi lolu daba baluxazulula kanjani kungaze kugcine sekuhlukumezeka abantu abangenacala abasuke belindele ukuhlinzekwa ngezidingo,” kusho uMngadi

ABESIKHUNGO sabakhubazekile iNduduzweni Centre for Disabled esiseMhlabeni, eMlaza, bathi kubuye inhlansi yethemba izolo bevakashelwa wuSihlalo we-IFP kwaZulu-Natal ogaqele esokuba nguNdunankulu walesi sifundazwe, uMnuz Thami Ntuli.Umphathi wesikhungo, uMnuz Themba Shiba, uthe akukho abangakwenzile ukuthola usizo kuhulumeni ukuze basizwe njengoba bentula yonke into esikhungweni.Isikhungo uthe sigcine abantu abangu-40 abakhubazeke ngezindlela ezehlukene. UNGQONGQOSHE kaGesi uDkt Kgosientsho Ramokgopa usechithe ukuthi bamise izinhlelo zokucisha ugesi ngenhloso yokuwonga ngenxa yokuthi kunokhetho lukazwelonke ngasekupheleni kwenyanga.URamokgopa uthe alukho uhlelo olufuze lolu abalwenzayo lokumisa ukucishwa kukagesi ukuze i-ANC inganyundelwa ngalokhu ngako ngamaqembu aphikisayo njengoba kuzoba nokhetho ngoMeyi 29. Uthe mkhulu umsebenzi owenziwe yi-Eskom ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ugesi awucishwa."Baningi engihlangana nabo bangibuze ukuthi ngabe kuzobuya yini ukucishwa kukagesi. Abanye bathi simise ukucinywa kwawo ngenxa yokhetho."Ugesi awucinywa ngenxa yemizamo yabasebenzi abazikhandlayo kanjalo nokubakhona kwawo okwamanje esingathi wenele ukuthi ungacishwa ngenhloso yokuwonga,” kusho uDkt Ramokgopa. Ukusho lokhu izolo ekhuluma esithangamini sabezindaba lapho kade azisa khona izwe ngezinhlelo zokuqeda ngale nkinga kagesi ebesisesikhungweni esiphehla amandla iKusile, eMpumalanga.Ukhuluma kanje sekuphele izinsuku ezingu-47 ugesi ungacishwa kuleli.Njengoba sekusele amasonto kuvotwe, amaqembu ahlukene nezinhlangano zomphakathi zikhala ngokuthi kuzothi kungavotwa nje, kubuye ukucishwa kukagesi.UNobhala - Jikelele we-ANC uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, ekhankasa KwaZulu-Natal ngempelasonto uthe bazoyiqeda le nkinga, bazosebenza kanzima ukuqinisekisa ukuthi iyaphela nya."Ngiyazi abanye abaholi bamaqembu aphikisayo bebefuna ukukhankasa ngale nkinga yokucinywa kukagesi. Bashaye eceleni-ke ngoba silwa nayo futhi sizoyinqoba siwuhulumeni kaKhongolose,” kusho uMbalula.URamokgopa uthe uhulumeni akayifuni into yokucinywa kukagesi ngakho ngeke athi akumiswe ukucinywa kwawo ngenxa yokuthi kuzoba nokhetho bese iphinde iyabuya le nkinga ngemuva kwalo.Uthe ngokwezinhlelo ze-Eskom njengoba kungena ubusika, uma kukhona izinkinga ezibakhona kudingeke ukuthi kucinywe ugesi, kungenzeka ngokwesigaba sesibili."Uma kungukuthi isimo sibi kakhulu ugesi ungacishwa ngokwesigaba sesihlanu. Kodwa kusetshenzwa ngamandla ukuthi lokhu kungenzeki ngoba kunohlelo lokubheka isimo samanje ebusika nesimo sasehlobo,” esho. Uveze ukuthi kwehlisiwe ukusetshenziswa kukadizili ukuze kutholakale ugesi.Ugxeke ababeyizikhulu ze-Eskom, abaqhubeka nokugxeka bethi ugesi awucinywa ngenxa yokuthi kusetshenziswa udizili."Abanye bahlulwa umsebenzi bayobhala izincwadi ngenkinga kagesi. Thina esikwenzayo wukuqinisekisa ukuthi ugesi ukhona, ngeke sigijime sibhale izincwadi, siyeke umsebenzi esiqokelwe ukuthi siwenze ngogesi, ” kusho ungqongqoshe. Usho lokhu nje owayeyisikhulu esiphezulu se-Eskom, uMnuz André de Ruyter, wathi i-Eskom isebenzisa kakhulu udizili ukuze ugesi ungacishwa njengoba kuzoba nokhetho. I-Africa’s Travel Indaba isiphenduke umbukiso ohlonishwa kakhulu kwezokungcebeleka kanye nezokuvakasha okhombisa inhlobonhlobo ebanzi kakhulu yemikhiqizo yezokuvakasha yase-Afrika ehamba phambili kanye nolwazi emhlabeni.Sinesiqiniseko sokuthi iKwaZulu-Natal izophinde ibeke unyawo lwayo phambili futhi isingathe enye i-Africa’s Tourism Indaba encomekayo.Sinezindaba eziningi ezithokozisayo esingabelana ngazo nabalingani bethu bohwebo bamazwe ngamazwe abazohambela i-Africa's Travel Indaba yalo nyaka.Kusuka kwesokunxele: Sibonelo Nzimande (onguMqondisi omkhulu yezokuvakasha eMnyangweni wezokuThuthukiswa koMnotho, ezokuVakasha nezeMvelo, KwaZulu-Natal); uDiana Hoorzuk (ilunga leBhodi yeTourism KZN), uFarhana Abdool Kadar (i-Chief Financial Officer seTourism KZN) noSthembiso Madlala (uSihlalo weBhodi yeTourism KZN) Sinxusa zonke izithunywa ukuba zivakashele isitendi seTourism KwaZulu-Natal kuDEC1.G37Njengohulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal, sifuna izithunywa zamazwe ngamazwe zibuyele emakhaya zazi ukuthi isifundazwe sethu sizishaya isifuba ngensada yemikhiqizo nemisebenzi yezokuvakasha. Isifundazwe sethu esihle kakhulu, siyindawo ephephile enokuhlangenwe nakho okuhlukahlukene kwezokuvakasha ongakwenza, ukuthengise uphinde ukupakishele amaklayenti akho uma ubuyela ekhaya.Uma sewufikile KwaZulu-Natal, siyethemba ukuthi uzozinika isikhathi sokuzibonela imikhiqizo yethu yezokuvakasha, izindawo zokudlela, ukudla, impilo yasebusuku, isimo sezulu esimnandi, abantu abanomoya wokungenisa izihambi kanye nomlando onothile kanye namasiko.

IZIHLATHI zivakashela izindlebe kubasebenzi bomkhakha wensimbi emuva kokuthi izinyunyana zabo zisayine isivumelwano sokuthi amaholo abo anyuswe ngo-7% kusukela ngoJulayi.UNobhala Jikelele weNational Union of Metalworkers of South Africa (Numsa), uMnuz Irvin Jim umemezele ukuthi basayine isivumelwano seminyaka emithathu nabaqashi ngoMsombuluko.Uthe amaholo azonyuka ngo-7% ngonyaka wokuqala bese ngonyaka wesibili nowesithathu anyuke ngo-6%.Uveze ukuthi babuye bakwazi nokuphakamisa udaba lokuthi abasebenzi baxhaswe uma beuthenga izindlu."Kuzobhekwa ukuthi imali ezosiza abasebenzi ukuthenga izindlu izotholakala kanjani bese siyaziswa kungakapheli izinyanga ezintathu.Siyajabula ukuthi sivumelane nabaqashi ngoba siye sabacela ukuthi beze nemali engcono. Sitholele abasebenzi isivumelwano esingaphezu kwamandla emali njengoba eku-5.3% thina sathola u-7%,” kusho uJim.Izinyunyana ezisayine isivumelwano yi-UASA eyayibizwa nge-United Association of South Africa, Numsa, South African Equity Workers Association (Saewa) neMetal and Electrical Workers’ Union of South Africa (Mewusa). INational Union of Mineworkers ithe isazokhuluma namalungu ayo.Inyunyana ezigqaja ngokumela abasebenzi abanamakhono (ama-artisan nonjiniyela), iSolidarity, ithe ayihambisani nalesi sivumelwano ngoba amalungu ayo azonyuselwa amaholo ngo-6% bese kufana nokuthi anyuswe ngo-2% uma sekudonswe imali edonswa nyangazonke.
UMA ufuna ukuthola ukwesekwa ngamavoti okhethweni lukazwelonke ngoMeyi 29, kumele umkhankaso wakho uwubhekise kwabesifazane kanjalo nentsha.Abesifazane bangu-15 million emqulwini wokuvota kuthi intsha eneminyaka engu-18 kuya ku-39 ingu-11.7 million.Umkhankaso wakho kumele ugxile ezifundazweni ezinkulu ngabavoti, iGauteng, ilandelwe yiKwaZulu-Natal kuthi endaweni yesithathu kube yi-Eastern Cape. Lezi zibalo zivezwe yikhomishini yezokhetho, i-Independent Electoral Commission (IEC), eveze ukuthi bangu-27.79 million abantu ababhalisele ukuvota.UMnuz Sy Mamabolo, isikhulu esiphezulu sekhomishini, uveze ukuthi abesifazane yibona abaningi ohlwini lokuvota uma uqhathanisa nabesilisa.Uthe abesilisa benza u-45% ohlwini lokuvota okusho ukuthi bangu-12 million.Uveze ukuthi ngenxa yomthetho ovikela ulwazi, iProtection of Personal Information (POPI) Act, kucishwe ingxenye yezinombolo zomazisi."Umqulu wezokhetho ukhulile uma uqhathanisa nokhetho lwango-1999, owawunabavoti abangu-18.17 million, kwathi ngo-2014 waba nabavoti abangu-25.39 million. Ngo-2019 wenyuke waya ku-26.74 kanti kulolu khetho bangu-27.79 million.” Uthe amazwe anabantu abaningi abahlala kwamanye amazwe kubalwa iLondon ngabangu-19 525, The Hague (5 574), Canberra (2 609), Dubai (2 574), Dublin (2 342), Wellington (1 668), Abu Dhabi (1 416), New York (1 379), Washington (1 228) neBerlin (1 188).IGauteng inabantu abangu-6.5 million ababhalisele ukuvota, iKZN bangu-5.7 million, kuthi e-EC bangu-3.4 million.UMasipala waseGoli yiwona onabantu abaningi ababhalisele ukuvota ngo-2.3 million. Kulandela uMasipala waseKapa ngo-2.1 million, endaweni yesithathu kulele uMasipala weTheku ngabangu-1.9 million. Kuke kwakhalwa ngokugqoza kwentsha ebhalisele ukuvota kuleli.Amaqembu ezombusazwe aze aphuma umkhankaso ne-IEC, kunxenxwa intsha ukuthi ibhalise.NgoLwesihlanu umnqamulajuqu wokuthi labo abazobe bengekho ezindaweni abajwayele ukuvotela kuzona, bazise ikhomishini. Kulolu khetho ngeke ukwazi ukuvota endaweni ongahlali kuyona ngaphandle kokwazisa ikhomishini njengoba phambilini ubungaya noma yikusiphi isikhungo sokuvota ufike uvote. Kuzobe kungokokuqala ukuthi abangenela ukhetho ngokuzimela babe yingxenye yalolu khetho lukazwelonke.
"BANGALALA bevale iso elilodwa abacebile uma igebe phakathi kwabampofu nabacebile lingavalwa.” Lesi yisexwayiso esikhiswe yiPhini likaNgqongqoshe wezokuVakasha, uMnuz Fish Mahlalela.Izolo, uMahlalela evula isithangami sokucobelelana ngolwazi namathuba embonini yezokuvakasha, kwi-Africa’s Travel Indaba, uthe likhulu kakhulu igebe phakathi kwabampofu nabacebile eNingizimu Afrika."Kufanele singalizibi igebe eliphakathi kwabampofu nabacebile ngoba lilokhu likhula. Uma singalivali igebe lokungalingani phakathi kwabaswele nabacebile, abacebile ngeke balale ngoba bazogqekezelwa abampofu, abazobe bezofuna ukudla,” kusho uMahlalela.Uthe bewuhulumeni badinga ukusebenzisana nezinhlaka ezihlukene emphakathini ukuze kuvulelwe abampofu amathuba emkhakheni wezokuvakasha.Ugxeke abavalela abanye ngaphandle, wathi umkhakha wezokuvakasha kuleli akusiwona owabebala elithile kuphela kodwa ngowabo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika.Inkakha yomlingisi wakuleli, uJerry Mofokeng wa Makhetha, igqugquzele abantu ukuthi babe yibona, bangasilahli isintu ngoba izivakashi zifuna ukubona lokho.UJerry nguye obe yisikhulumi sokuqala embukisweni wezokuvakasha, i-Africa’s Travel Indaba, eqhubeka eNkosi Albert Luthuli International Convention Centre.Uthe izivakashi zifuna ukuzwa izindaba zabantu bakuleli, zifuna ukuzwa imfudumalo yabo nobuntu.Lo mlingisi uqale ngokuxoxa inganekwane wabe esethula inkondlo ebincoma ubuhle beNingizimu Afrika, amaqhawe ase-Afrika nazo zonke izigameko esezehlele leli zwekazi.Izolo, bekunezithangami zokucobelelana ngolwazi ezihlukene lapho osomabhizinisi abancane beveze ukuthi badinga ukufakwa ezinhlelweni zokuthuthukisa umnotho.UJerry Pooe ongumsunguli we-Wushwini Pan African Art Centre, eKwaNgcolosi, uthe bafuna ukuhlomula bewosomabhizinisi abancane emicimbini emikhulu eyenzeka enkabeni yeTheku.Uveze ukuthi yibona abasondele kakhulu kubantu futhi abakwazi ukudala amathuba omsebenzi amaningi.Amazwi akhe ananelwe nguNkk Dumile Cele, othe amabhizinisi amancane yiwona akwazi ukudala amathuba omsebenzi amaningi ngakho kufanele asekwe.UMnuz Thato Mothopeng onguMqondisi weSouth African Township and Village Tourism (SATO VITO), uthe izivakashi azisagcini ngokuhambela emadolobheni noma eziqiwini kodwa sezifuna ukuya ebantwini."Izivakashi sezifuna ukuyobona abantu ukuthi baphila kanjani. Zifuna ukuyohlala emakhaya abantu, azisathandi kakhulu ukuhlala emahhotela noma eziqiwini zifuna ukuxoxa nabantu,” kusho uMothopeng.UJerry uthe kuyiqiniso lokhu ngoba izivakashi ezivela eRussia, ziye zicele ukuyobonana nemindeni yaKwaNgcolosi, zicele nokuyobona izangoma."Ezokuvakasha ziyakwazi ukushintsha impilo yabantu ngoba zifuna ukubahambela lapho behlala khona. KUGQAME isifundazwe i-KwaZulu-Natal kuklonyeliswa izikole, emqhudelwaneni wazo kazwelonke, i-Road Accident Fund ngokubambisana nenhlangano engenzi nzuzo i-Safer South Foundation. Umqhudelwano uqale nyakenye, abafundi bezikole zamabanga aphakeme bebenxuswe ukuthi babhale indatshana ezoveza izisombululo ekutheni zingagwemeka kanjani izingozi emgwaqeni.Abamabanga aphansi bona benze imidwebo ethile ezofundisa futhi ikhombise okungaba yizisombululo ekugwemeni lesi sihlavaUNkk Riah Phiyega we-Safer South Africa Foundation, enikezwe umsebenzi wokugqugquzela izikole ukungenela lo mqhudelwano kulezi zifundazwe, unxuse izihambeli ukuthi zibambe iqhaza ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi isihlava sezingozi emgwaqweni siyagwemeka."Uhlelo lweqhinga lokuthuthukisa elakuleli esigabeni sikazwelonke lwango- 2010, lugcizelela ukuthi ngonyaka u-2030 zibe sezehle okungenani ngo-50% izingozi ezenzeka emgwaqweni."Ngakho-ke uma kufundiswa izingane ukuthi ziqhamuke nesisombululo, yinto enhle leyo,” usho kanje.IPhini likaNgqongqoshe wezokuThutha kuleli uMnuz Lisa Mangcu obehambele lo mcimbi, uphonsele inselelo uMnyango wezeMfundo kuleli ukuthi kube nesifundo esifundisa ngokuphepha emgwaqweni."Izingozi zomgwaqo isikhathi esiningi zidlula nemiphefumulo yabantu abasha abayikusasa. Kuyaphoqa ukuthi sibe nesifundo ngokuphepha emgwaqweni ukuvikela ikusasa lakuleli."Sincoma abakwa-Road Accident Fund ne-Safer South Africa Foundation ngokuqhamuka nalolu hlelo olufundisayo ezikoleni. Intsha yango-1970, yasukuma yalwela amalungelo."Ngakho-ke nentsha yanamhlanje nayo mayithi sekwanele ngezingozi emgwaqweni, iveze izisombululo,” kusho uMangcu.Izikole ezine kulesi sifundazwe eziklonyelisiwe, esabakhubazekile iDas Special School, elale isithathu kumunxa wezikole zabaphila nokukhubazeka, saklonyeliswa ngo- R15 000. Ubengakaze asitshele ukuthi kunezitha ezimfunayo,'' usho kanje.Uveze ukuthi lesi simo siyihlukumezile kakhulu ingoduso kamfowabo, uNksz Fikelephi Dlamini.ISolezwe Ngempelasonto lithunyelelwe ama-video lapho khona umufi ebonakala khona ebhikla ingoma, kukhala amakhwela, kuqhuma nemikikizo, izinsizwa ziyivuma.Kuvela ukuthi izinsizwa zendawo ziyathuthumela ngendlela okusocongwe ngayo umufi.Elinye ilungu lomphakathi libabaze ukulunga kukamufi nokuba nogazi kwakhe emphakathini.Lilimise ngesihloko elokuthi abazi ukuthi yini le engaka ebingaze idale ukuthi insizwa ethandwa kangaka emphakathini isocongwe ngalolu hlobo.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uConstable Thenjiswa Ngcobo usiqinisekisile lesi sigameko.Uthe amaphoyisa aKwaNdengezi amatasa afuna umkhondo wabantu okungenzeka ukuba bayathinteka ekusocongweni kukamufi."Kusolakala ukuthi umufi ubekade esekhaya ngesikhathi ehlaselwa ngabantu abangaziwa. Kuthiwa bafike bamdubula bambulala,'' usho kanje.
KUGQUGQUZELWE abasebenzi bophiko lwezibonelelo zikahulumeni, i-South African Social Security Agency (Sassa) ukuthi bavezele ulwazi amalungu omphakathi asuke ehambele amahhovisi alolu phiko, ukuze afundiseke ngezindlela zokusebenza kwalo nendlela yokuziphatha.Emcimbini wokuvulwa ngokusemthethweni kwamahhovisi alolu phiko eBridge City KwaMashu ngoLwesihlanu, uNgqongqoshe wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi uNkk Lindiwe Zulu uthe umphakathi kumele uqonde ngokusebenza kwabasebenzi, uphinde ufundiswe nangendlela yokuhleleka ukugwema izinkinga empilweni."Uma abantu besemahhovisi belindile, akube nento ebafundisayo ukuthi yikuphi okulindeleke kubona. Amalungu omphakathi achitha isikhathi esevile emizuzwini engu-30 elindile, ngaleso sikhathi kuningi angabe asekufundile okuwumphako wendlela."Umyalezo ogqugquzela amantombazane asemancane ukuthi azivikele ekutholeni izingane eminyakeni yawo."Olunye lolwazi olungagcizelelwa kwabasuke behambele amahhovisi, ngolokugwema ukwanda kwabathola izingane besebancane, okwenza umsebenzi wakwa-Sassa ube nzima,” usho kanje. Uthe awafundiswe nangokubaluleka kokugxila kakhulu ezikoleni, waveza ukuthi amahhovisi alolu phiko, ayinkundla evakashelwa ngabantu abaningi nsuku zonke ngakho kumele abasebenzi basebenzise lelo thuba ukudlulisa ulwazi olubalulekile.Ukulungiswa kwamahhovisi akule nxanxathela yezitolo, kulandela ukucekeleka kwawo phansi ngesikhathi engqongqa kunezibhelu ngo-2021. Lesi sigameko saphoqa ukuthi athuthelwe ehholo lomphakathi Kwa-L khona KwaMashu okwesikhashana ngo-2022.Ukulungiswa kwawo bekuqhubeka kanti aqale ukusebenza ngoSepthemba ngonyaka odlule.UNksz Thamo Mzobe oyi-Regional Executive Manager unxuse abasebenzi ukuthi bathembeke emsebenzini wabo ukuze kungagcini sekugxekwa uhulumeni ngenxa yokuziphatha kwabo.Uhambo lukaNgqongoshe, uNkk Zulu eThekwini luqale ngoLwesithathu olwedlule ngesikhathi evakashele esikoleni i-Cwebezela Primary eMlaza lapho enikele khona ngemifaniswano.NgoLwesine udlulele emahhovisi alolu phiko eMnini ukuzohlola ukusebenza kwawo ngaphambi kokudlulela eBridge City ngoLwesihlanu.
ZIMISWE zaphinde zayalelwa ukuthi zingasondeli emagcekeni enyuvesi iMangosuthu University of Technology (MUT), izikhulu ezimbili kulesi sikhungo kuze kuphothulwe uphenyo. Lokhu kumenyezelwe ngumlawuli wesikhashana walesi sikhungo uSolwazi Lourens van Staden, othumele incwadi kwizitshudeni nakubasebenzi balesi sikhungo.Kule ncwadi ekwi-website yalesi sikhungo nasezinkundleni zokuxhumana, iveza ukuthi kumiswe ibamba lomphathi wale nyuvesi nebamba lemenenja ehhovisi lomphathi wenyuvesi.Uthe laba bamiswe kuze kuphothulwe uphenyo."Isinqumo sokumisa laba silandela izinsolo ezisanda kuvela ezingalimaza isithunzi senyuvesi. Kubalulekile ukuthi lezi zinsolo ziphenywe ukuze sivikelwe isithunzi sesikhungo kuphinde kube nokuvuleleka kohlelo lokuthi abantu baziphendulele.”Lezi zikhulu ziyalelwe ukuthi zingathinti lutho oluthinta umsebenzi wazo. Azivunyelwe ukuthi zisondele emagcekeni alesi sikhungo noma baxhumane nabasebenzi nezitshudeni."Abavumelekile nokuthi baxhumane nezinhlaka ezehlukene kulesi sikhungo ngezinto ezithinta inyuvesi,” kusho uVan Staden.Uthe lesi sinqumo sithathwe ukuze kungabikhona abazokhala ngokuchema ngohlelo lokuphenya.Udalule ukuthi bangakwazi ukuxhumana nalezi zinhlaka uma begunyazwe nguVan Staden, noma nanoma ngubani amjubile."Ukumiswa kwabo akusho ukuthi banecala kodwa wuhlelo lokuqinisekisa ukuthi uphenyo luqhubeka ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka."Ngifuna ukuqinisekisa zonke izinhlaka zasenyuvesi ukuthi sizimisele ukubeka phambili isithunzi senyuvesi,” esho. Unxuse ukuthi kubanjiswane ngalesi sikhathi kusaqhubeka uphenyo. Umemezele ukuthi uSolwazi Nokuthula Sibiya, uzoba yibamba lomphathi walesi sikhungo.Uthe usewuqalile umsebenzi wakhe kanti uzobamba kuze kwenziwe isimemezelo."Unamava ezintweni ezithinta imfundo ephakeme kanjalo nezokuphatha. Ngiyamethemba ukuthi uzokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngobuholi obusezingeni ngalesi sikhathi,” kugcizelela uVan Staden. Unxuse zonke izinhlaka ukuthi zimeseke ngalesi sikhathi ukuze kuqhubeke kube nozinzo kule nyuvesi.Iyinsakavukela eyezinkinga kule nyuvesi njengoba uNgqongqoshe weMfundo ePhakeme uDkt Blade Nzimande, ehlale ekhala ngokuthi njalo kudingeka ayifake ngaphansi kwesandla somlawuli.UNzimande wathi ukhathazekile ngokuthi sekube namahlandla amaningi le nyuvesi eyifaka ngaphansi komlawuli ukuze kulungiswe izinkinga ezisuke zibhekene nokuphathwa kwayo kanjalo nezinye.URegistrar eMUT uDkt Phumzile Masala, uthe ngeke baphawule ngalo myalezo ngoba bekuyinto yangaphakathi ebithunyelwe izitshudeni nabasebenzi.Uthe bazokwazisa abezindaba ngesikhathi esifanele.
KUGUNYAZWE ukuboshwa kwababili bandawonye, yiNkantolo eNkulu yaseMgungundlovu okuthiwa banyamalala kuqhubeka ukuqulwa kwecala lokubulawa kwabathathu.Lokhu kwenzeke ngoLwesihlanu ngenkathi kugwetshwa umfowabo obesele odilikajele abathathu neminyaka engu-30, ngaphezulu emacaleni okukholakala ukuthi bawenza ndawonye nababalekile.Lawa macala kuthiwa enzeke eMid- Illovo ngo-2021, kuxabene imindeni emibili, okwafa abangu-10 kwakhona nabalimalayo. UZwelakhe Nene (43) ugwetshwe yile nkantolo udilikajele icala ngalinye, kwamathathu okubulala neminyaka ewu-10 icala ngalinye kwawokuzama okubulala.Abafowabo oMnuz Mhlonishwa Nene noMvikelwa Nene kuthiwa basagcwele amathafa njengoba bebengasalubhadi enkantolo kuqhubeka ukuqulwa kwecala osekugunyazwe ukuboshwa kwabo.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe emva kokukhululwa kwabo ngebheyili yinkantolo, kube nelungu lomunye wemindeni exabene eladutshulwa labulawa emasangweni esikole lapho laliwunogada khona, okwenzeka ngoSepthemba, 2021."Baphinde badubula babhekisa etekisini elaligcwele abagibeli, esigamekweni okwafa kuso ababili, kwalimala abevile kwababili. "Abaphenyi bakwazi ukulandela umkhondo, owaholela ekutheni lesi sigameko sihlanganiswe nalaba, kanti uMvikelwa noMhlonishwa banquma ukungabuyeli enkantolo ngesikhathi kuqhubeka ukuqulwa kwecala, okuholele ekutheni kukhishwe incwadi egunyaza ukuboshwa kwabo,” usho kanje.Kuvele ukuthi laba baboshwe ngoJuni emva kokuthi itekisi eyayilayishe amadoda ayisishiyagalolunye yavinjwa ngamaphoyisa kwatholakala izibhamu nezinhlamvu.Abayisithupha ababesetekisini iNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini yabakhulula emva kokuthi bungabanga bikho ubufakazi obubahlanganisa necala.Okwavela enkantolo ngomlomo kaMnuz Mxolisi Nxasana owayemele omunye wabathathu abathwesa amacala ngesikhathi kulalelwe isicelo sebheyili, laba babephuthuma emhlanganweni wokukhethwa kobuholi begatsha le-ANC khona eMid-Illovo ngesikhathi bevinjwa amaphoyisa.Waveza ukuthi omunye wababesetekisini wayezokhethwa kulo mhlangano, wasola ukuthi kwakuyimizamo yabathile ukubathumelela ngamaphoyisa ngenhloso yokuqinisekisa ukuthi abafiki emhlanganweni.
USAKHUNGATHEKILE umndeni kamabhalane wasesikoleni iMbazwana Primary eHangaz eMbazwana otholakale ezihilele ngoMgqibelo.UMnuz Musawenkosi Sunshine Zikhali (57) kuthiwa utholwe esethule kuveranda wasekhishini emzini wakhe.Ngokusho kwelungu lomndeni elibuye libe sekomitini lezokuphepha emphakathini uMnuz Vuyani Zikhali, umufi uphume engumuntu oyochitha amanzi endlini encane, kodwa watholwa eseshonile ngabo-6 ekuseni.Uthe uphume egumbini lakhe nonkosikazi lokulala ewumuntu oyochitha amanzi endlini encane ngaphandle ngabo-6 ekuseni, wangabe esabuya."Utholwe esethule, ezilengisile, kwase kwaziswa amanye amalungu omndeni ngomshophi,” kusho uZikhali.Udalule ukuthi umshophi wenzeka nje bekukhona ukhanjana obelwenziwe njengoba umufi ebevakashelwe abashana bakhe abahlala ezindaweni ezikude."Bekubuswa, kodwa kungesikho ukuthi bekunomsebenzi obukhona. Alukho unyawo lwemfene olusolwayo nembangela eholele ekwenzekeni kwalesi sigameko, esisazophenywa ngamaphoyisa,” kusho uNetshiunda.

Ngakho ke omama kufanele basheshe ukuqala ukuhola. Izibonelelo zikahulumeni azilingani nemali edingwa umuntu ukuze angabulawa indlala. Intela efakwa ezintweni ezifana namafutha namaqanda, yenza ukuthi abantu abahlwempu bangakwazi ukuthenga ukudla. Kanjalo nabantu abafuna imisebenzi kufanele bathole uxhaso.”UPappas uphinde abeke phambili ukudalwa kwamathuba emisebenzi, ukuthuthukiswa komnotho, ukulwa nobugebengu, nokuhanjiswa kwezidingo.UPappas uthe akakhulumi inganekwane uma ethi uzotakula iKwaZulu-Natal.UPappas uthe abangakholwa ukuthi uzokwazi ukushintsha isimo sesifundazwe, ababuke umsebenzi omuhle awenzile ngesikhathi eqokwa njengemeya yoMasipala waseMngeni.UPappas waqokwa kwesobumeya ngo-2021.Uthe wafika isimo sisibi emkhandlwini, wathi basishintshile isimo ngokushesha."Emkhandlwini wethu, isimo sezimali besingahambi kahle. Kule minyaka emibili nengxenye, silungise isimo sezimali. Sesithole imibiko kamcwaningi mabhuku engenagcobho kulandelana. Lokhu kusho ukuthi siyakwazi ukuphatha imali yomkhandlu."Ukuhanjiswa kwezidingo nakho sekubuyele esimweni. Phela singakhohlwa ukuthi inhloso ngukuthi abantu kufanele bathole izidingo ekugcineni. Ngicabanga ukuthi sekuyinto eyejwayelekile ukubuka omasipala behlulwa ukuhambisa izidingo kubantu. Thina lapha eMngeni siyakhombisa ukuthi omasipala kufanele bahambise izidingo kubantu.”UPappas uthe ukuphatha kahle kwabo uMasipala waseMngeni kwenza ukuthi umkhankaso wabo waKwaZulu-Natal ube lula."Kuqala bekuba nzima uma sikhankasa lapha KwaZulu-Natal ngoba abantu uma besibuza ukuthi siyakwazi yini ukuphatha, ibingekho indawo eseduze esiyiphethe ebesibakhombisa ngayo ukuthi siyakwazi ukuphatha. Besilokhu sibatshela ngezindawo ezikude esiziphethe, sithi ababuke kuzona. "Manje sesivele sibatshele ukuthi ababuke eMngeni. Lena yindawo eseduze nabo, abangakwazi ukuziyela, beyoyibona. Enye into ebisilimaza ukuthi besikhankasa kakhulu eCape Town naseGoli. Manje sesiyazi ukuthi kufanele sikhankase nasezindaweni zasemakhaya.”UPappas uthe umkhankaso wabo uphinde ulekelelwe ukwehluleka kobuholi obuphethe iKwaZulu-Natal."Ukwehluleka kwabo kwenza ukuthi abantu babone ukuthi sekufanele bashintshe ivoti labo. Phela abantu baKwaZulu-Natal abasabi ukushintsha ivoti. Bake bakwenza lokhu ngaphambilini, bakhipha i-IFP. Namanje abantu bazophinde bakwenze lokho. Lapha KwaZulu-Natal sidinga abaholi abaqotho.” UPappas uthe iDA ikhombisa ukukhula KwaZulu-Natal."Siyiqembu elikhula ukhetho nokhetho lapha KwaZulu-Natal. Nathi sibalwa kanye namanye amaqembu amakhulu lapha KwaZulu-Natal. Buka nje ngoMgqibelo sizokuba nomcimbi omkhulu eThekwini, eCurries Fountein, lapho silindele khona abantu abangu-10 000. Yebo asikafiki ezingeni lokugcwalisa iMabhida kodwa nayo le nkundla esizoyisebenzisa inomlando onothile emzabalazweni wamalungelo abantu.”UPappas uthe umbango ushisa phansi KwaZulu-Natal."Maningi amaqembu aqhamukile lapha KwaZulu-Natal. Angiboni kuneqembu elizothola u-50%. I-MK ibikade ize kabi kodwa manje sebeyaxabana kakhulu. Ngibona kuzokuba iyona i-MK, ithina, i-IFP ne-ANC, mhlawumbe ne-EFF, abazothola amavoti amaningi.”

AYAKHALA amaqembu ezepolitiki ngokuphasiswa komthetho othinta ukuxhaswa kwamaqembu njengoba ethi uzohlomulisa i-ANC ne-DA kuphela ngasezimalini.La maqembu aveze ukuthi lo mthetho iPolitical Party Funding Act, osayinwe nguMengameli uCyril Ramaphosa kuleli sonto, uhlose ukutakula i-ANC ebhekene nezinkinga zemali.USotswebhu we-IFP uMnuz Narend Singh, uthe bahlanganyele namanye amaqembu ukuphikisa ukuphasiwa kwalo mthetho ngoba bazihambisa izethulo ngezinto ababekhala ngazo kuRamaphosa, kodwa wazishaya indiva.Uthe bahlose ukuthi noma sekuhlala iPhalamende elisha lesikhombisa ngemuva kokhetho, bazoqhubeka bawuphikise."Singamaqembu angu-10 akhala ngendaba yalo mthetho ngoba uphasiswe sisalinde izimpendulo kuRamaphosa ngezethulo zethu. Uzohlomulisa kuphela amaqembu amakhulu okuyiwo azothola imali enkulu, amancane wona azothola imfalakahlana,” kusho uSingh.Uveze ukuthi i-ANC izothola imali ezobe ithathwe kwamanye amaqembu amancane.Kulo mthetho uRamaphosa unegunya lokubeka isikalo semali amaqembu anganikelelwa ngaso emva kokubonisana nePhalamende.Okwamanje amaqembu kumele adalule abaxhasi bawo uma esenikelelwe ngoR100 000 kuya phezulu. Ngonyaka iqembu lezepolitiki linganikelelwa ngumuntu oyedwa ngesamba sika-R15 million kuya ngaphansi ngonyaka.UMnuz Adrian Roos we-DA, uthe bayawuchitha lo mthetho ngoba i-ANC ihlose ukuzizuzisa yona ngawo.Uthe noma bezothola imali ethe xaxa kunamanye amaqembu belandela i-ANC, kodwa bayawuchitha."Kumele amaqembu amancane abhekelelwe kangcono kungazuzi kuphela amaqembu amakhulu. UMnuz Lawson Naidoo weCouncil for the Advancement of the South African Constitution, uthe kuyashaqisa ukuthi uRamaphosa usayine lo mthetho ekubeni kukhona izikhalazo ezikhona ezivela emaqenjini ahlukene.Uthe akuzange kube nezigcawu zokuthi umphakathi uphawule ngesikhathi lo mthetho useMkhandlwini weziFundazwe ePhalamende.Okunye okuqukethwe yilo mthetho ngukuthi ufaka isigxivizo sokuthi kugunyazwe abangenela ukhetho ngokuzimela ukuthi babe yingxenye yokhetho lwezifundazwe nolukazwelonke olungoMeyi 29, 2024.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi phambilini abangenela ukhetho ngokuzimela bebengenela olohulumeni basekhaya kuphela.mKulolu khetho bangu-11 abazongenela ukhetho ngokuzimela.
ZIKHALA ngokucindezelwa kothisha izinyunyana njengoba zithi umthetho uvikela uphinde uvune abafundi abatitinya othisha okuthi uma sebezivikela bakhonjwe indlela. Lezi zinyunyana zithi kugcina sekuba umfundi ophenduka umgilwa ekubeni engumphehli wodweshu.Lokhu kulandela ukusabalala kwe-video yesehlakalo esenzeke eGlenvista High eGauteng, muva nje lapho, kungongaphansi nongaphezulu phakathi kukathisha nomunye wabafundi. Kuvela nomunye umfundi ezama ukugqema uthisha ngesihlalo.Uthisha kule video ubonakala ezama ukubhula lo mfundi ngesihlalo, emuva kokuvuka othulini.UMengameli weNatu, uMnuz Sibusiso Malinga, uthe selokhu kwavalwa induku ezikoleni, akukho uMnyango wezeMfundo owabahlinzeka ngakho ukuthi bakusebenzise ukuqondisa abafundi.Uveze ukuthi okwenziwa abafundi yinto eyenzeka nasemphakathini ngoba kwayona iyabahlasela othisha kubalwa nezigebengu. "Ibuhlungu impilo kathisha kulezi zinsuku ngoba uma eshaye umfundi uyaxoshwa, ayikhulunywa eyakhe. Akekho ovikela uthisha ngoba nomnyango umlahla ngecala, aze aboshwe kwesinye isikhathi. Umfundi osuke eshaye uthisha uyabuyela esikoleni, emuva kokumiswa isikhashana.” Uthe nomkhandlu olawula othisha iSouth African Council for Educators (SACE), ucheme nabafundi."Ithina esikhokhela iSACE kodwa kwayona ayisivikeli, ichema nabafundi. Ngiyazi kunzima kodwa ngiyanxusa kozakwethu ukuthi uma bebona ukuthi umoya uyaphakama, abaphumele emnyango babuye selehlile igwebu. Ukucabanga kothisha kumele kube ngaphezu kwalokho komfundi, bangasheshi ukuhluthuka.” UNobhala Jikelele weSadtu, uMnuz Mugwena Maluleke, ukhale ngokuthi isiyinsakavukela eyodlame ezikoleni.Uthe izikole kumele kube yizindawo ezingenalo udlame wathi nosizo olunikezwa ezikoleni okuqubuke kuzo udlame, kumele lungachemi nabafundi kuphela. Ukhale ngokuthi umthetho uvuna abafundi kodwa bese uqina ngasohlangothini lothisha."Okubuhlungu ngukuthi iSACE igweba kanzima othisha, abafundi bona bayayekwa. Umnyango kumele wenze isimo sibe sihle sokusebenza kothisha futhi ubhekane nabafundi abangalawuleki.”Ukugxekile ukuhlaselwa kothisha wathi lokhu kuzothena amandla labo abasafuna ukufundela lo mkhakha. Okhulumela umnyango, uMnuz Elijah Mhlanga, ucashunwe ethi uMthethosisekelo wezwe ubalula ukuthi kuyilungelo lomfundi ukufunda.Ukhale ngokuthi abanye abazali bayazivuna izingane zabo ngokuthi baziphikele uma kungukuthi kukhona izinto ezisolwa ngazo ezikoleni."Abazali yibona abagijima baphikele izingane zabo. Umthetho uthi umfundi umiswa izinsuku ezingu-14, emva kwalokho uyabuyela esikoleni. Uma umxosha esikoleni, kungumsebenzi womnyango ukumfunela esinye isikole. Nakhona kuleso sikole bafike bamchithe ngoba kuthiwa uxoshwe la ebefunda khona ngoba eyihlongandlebe.”

SEKULINDWE isinqumo semantshi ecaleni eselidonse iminyaka emine lokubulawa ngesihluku kowayengumfundi ka-matric u-Andile 'Bobo’ Mbuthu (16).Izolo uMbuso nommeli wabasolwa benze izethulo zokugcina, benxenxa iMantshi uSanele Hlatshwayo ukuba ibavune.Isigwebo sizowiswa ngasekupheleni kukaJuni ngenxa yokuthi iNkantolo yeMantshi yaseVerulam, elalele icala, inohlu lwamacala amaningi okumele iwalalele.UMbuso unxenxe uHlatshwayo ukuthi ulahle abamangalelwa abahlanu ngecala lokuthumba nelokubulala uBobo.Bancike kakhulu ebufakazini obethulwa owayengumsolwa futhi engumngani kaBobo owaphenduka ufakazi woMbuso ezininda nabamangalelwa.Umshushisi uthe okwenziwa abamangalelwa kuBobo babekuhlelile futhi benomqondo bezama ukuziveza kumphathi wabo owayebelwe utshwala..Ngakolunye uhlangothi ummeli wabamangalelwa uMnuz Chris Gounden, uthe uMbuso uhlulekile ukuvezela inkantolo ubufakazi bokuthi wayekade ethunjiwe uBobo nokuthi kwakuhleliwe ukubulawa kwakhe.Unxenxe imantshi ukuthi ingabalahli ngamacala abathweswe wona okungenani ayibathole benecala lokushaya.UBobo washaywa wafa ngo-Ephreli 2020 esolwa ngokweba utshwala endaweni yobumnandi okwakungekamzala wakhe uMnuz Mlungisi Thabethe, eMagagula Lounge, eHambanathi oThongathi.UGounden uthe uThabethe uyena owayalela abamangalelwa ukuthi bashaye uBobo ephethe isibhamu ngesandla ebatshela ukuthi uma bengamshayi yena uzoshaya bona.UMbuso ukuchithile lokhu ubuza ukuthi kungani abamangalelwa babekade besebenzela umuntu abamsabayo futhi oyingozi emphakathini njengoba sebesho manje enkantolo?Ubuze nokuthi kungani bengayanga emaphoyiseni emumva kwesigameko beyobika ukuthi kwenzekeni uma kungeve kuyinhloso yabo ababekade bekwenza?.UThabethe wadutshulwa wafa ngo-2021 esigamekweni esingahlobene nokufa kukaBobo. AKHALA ngokunganakwa amanesi angaqashiwe osekuphele isonto eqhinqe ngaphandle kwebhilidi loMnyango wezeMpilo iNatalia, eMgungundlovu.Ngokuthola kweSolezwe, amanesi alinganiselwa ku-150, asuka ezindaweni ezehlukene KwaZulu-Natal ankanise kule ndawo.Lilandisa ngodaba elinye lawo, uNksz Slindile Ndlovu, lithe baneminyaka engaphezu kweyishumi bathola iziqu kodwa lutho umsebenzi."Mina nje, ngigogoda ngo-2013, ngaqala ngafaka izicelo zomsebenzi njalo uma kuphume izikhangisi kodwa namanje angikaze ngiqashwe,” kusho uNksz Ndlovu.Uqhube wathi abanye ozakwabo, abaqhinqe nabo, bagogoda ngo-2007.Udalule ukuthi iningi labo njengoba lihleli ngaphandle kwebhilidi lowezempilo, lalikhona kulabo ababelinganiselwa ku-8000 abavele bagcwalisa inkundla yezemidlalo, behambise izicelo zabo esibhedlela iNkosi Albert Luthuli, eThekwini ngo-2018.AMANESI angaqashiwe eqhinqe ngaphandle kwebhilidi loMnyango wezeMpilo eMgungundlovu Isithombe: SITHNYELWENgaleso sikhathi umnyango wawukhangise izikhala ezingu-100 kuphela.Uphinde wathi babekhona futhi kulabo ababeyofaka izicelo eminyakeni edlule, kuzovulwa isibhedlela iDkt Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial, KwaMashu.Wenze izinsolo zokuthi ziyadayiswa izikhala."Sine-group kaWhatsapp yamanesi angaqashiwe lapho esixoxa khona ngodaba lwethu. Sesize sajwayelana, sibaningi. Kukhona abaveze ukuthi sebeqashiwe kodwa bagwaza ngemali enguR35 000 ukuze baqashwe,” kusho uNksz Ndlovu.Uthe babatshela ukuthi izikhulu ezigwazelwa ngale mali zikhona ngaphakathi kuleli bhilidi abaqhinqe ngaphandle kwalo."Asinawo uR35 000 wokugwaza kodwa umsebenzi siyawudinga, sicela ukuqashwa,” usho kanje.Uthe ngoMsombuluko kukhona isikhulu esiphume ngaphakathi sabatshela ukuthi asikho isabelomali sokuthi baqashwe.Wathi banombuzo wokuthi sisuke sesivelaphi esokuqasha abagwazayo.Uthe bazoqhubeka nokuqhinqa ngaphandle kwaleli bhilidi kuze kuba bachazelwa into ezwakalayo maqondana nokungaqashwa kwabo.Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Ntokozo Maphisa, uthe "Umnyango ufisa ukukubalula ukuthi zikhona izikhangiso zabahlengikazi nabahlengi ezikhishiwe, bayanxuswa labo abenesifiso sokufaka izicelo zokuqashwa ukuba babheke kwi-website yomnyango.Uqhube wathi odabeni lwezinsolo zokugwazisa, umnyango unxusa ukuba labo abanobufakazi balokhu ukuba bavule amacala emaphoyiseni bese beletha ubufakazi ukuze umnyango uphenye.
KUZOVALWA imigwaqo eseduze kweNkosi Albert Luthuli International Convention Centre (ICC) njengoba kuza umbukiso omkhulukazi wezokuvakasha, i-Africa’s Travel Indaba.UMasipala weTheku uthe umgwaqo uWalnut uzobe uvalwe thaqa njengoba kuza umbukiso kanti izimoto ezisuka kuBram Fischer naku-Dr AB Xuma ngeke zikwazi ukuhamba kulo mgwaqo.Imigwaqo iqale ukuvalwa ngoMsombuluko 6 Meyi kuya kuMeyi 20.Eminye imigwaqo ezophazamiseka uStalwart Simelane, Samora Machel, Or Tambo Parade, Boscombe Terrace noPlayfair.Umasipala ucele abashayeli bezimoto ukuthi basebenzise eminye imigwaqo ngalesi sikhathi.I-Africa’s Travel Indaba izohanjelwa ngabantu abangaphezu kuka-9 000 kusukela ngoMeyi 13 kuya kuMeyi 16.Kuzobe kukhona osomabhizinisi abancane abawu-120 abazozikhangisa nabanye abavela emazweni awu-26 ase-Afrika.UColonel Boysie Zungu okhulumela amaphoyisa kaMasipala weTheku uthe ukuvalwa kwemigwaqo kuzoqinisekisa ukuthi i-Africa’s Travel Indaba ihamba kahle."Kuzobe kutshalwe amaphoyisa kamasipala kuwo wonke amakhona eTheku. Isimo sizobe sisiqaphe ngeso lokhozi ngoba Indaba ihanjelwa ngabantu abavela emazweni ahlukene. Kuzobe kukhona izikhulu zohulumeni, abathengi bamazwe, izinhatheli nezinye izivakashi,” kusho uZungu.IMeya yeTheku, uMnuz Mxolisi Kaunda, ithembise ukuthi konke kuzohamba kahle ngoba iTheku linomlando wokuba nemicimbi esezingeni lomhlaba.Ugqugquzele abantu baseThekwini nabasembonini yezokuvakasha ukuba bamukele izivakashi ngezandla ezifudumele.
ABASOLWA ababili abanukeka ekufeni komrepha u-AKA, ababhajwe eSwatini bafuna idokodo lecala ukuze bathathe isinqumo ngesicelo sokubuyiselwa kwabo kuleli. Iphephandaba laseSwatini iTimes of Swaziland libike kabanzi ngalolu daba.U-Kiernan 'AKA’ Forbes, wadutshulwa wabulawa nomngani wakhe uTebello "Tibz” Motsoane, eThekwini nyankenye. Bobabili bathelekelwa amadoda abavithiza ngenhlamvu baphelela khona lapho bephuma endaweni yokudlela i-Wish on Florida esiyavalwa.Ummeli wababhajwe eSwatini, uMnuz Sivesonke Ngwenya nguye oveze ukuthi amakhasimede akhe afuna ukubona idokodo lecala ngaphambi kokuthi baphendule.Ababhajwe eSwatini wuMnuz Siyabonga Gezani Ndimande obuye abizwe ngoNxele noMnuz Malusi Dave Ndimande okuthiwa abandawonye. Bayisikhombisa sebebonke abasolwa abakhonjwa wuMbuso ukuthi bamkakisa okwenyamazane bamjuqa umrepha.Ngokuvamile amaphoyisa awalidedeli idikodo lecala ngaphambi kwesigaba lapho sekulungiselelwa ukuqulwa kwecala sebehlangene nabameli.Izinsizwa zakwaNdimande sezivele izikhawu eNkantolo yeMantshi kwaManzini kulandela ukuboshwa kwazo eZone 4 eMbabane, eSwatini.Abalisa abahlanu bahamba icala kuleli kanti laba ababili bakwaNdimande baseSwatini kuzanywa ukuthi babuyiswe. Sesathunyelwa isicelo sokuthi babuyiswe, kodwa kuthe sekufanele baphendule base befuna idokodo lecala.Kuvela ukuthi bathe abakwazi ukuphendula isicelo sokubuyiswa kwabo bengakaboni ukuthi amaphoyisa agugusheka nani edokodweni lawo okubayamanisa necala. Babeka nokuthi azikho izikhali ezatholwa kubona ezibayamanisa nokufa kuka-AKA.Ummeli uNgwenya uthe amakhasimede abo ezwa kuthiwa abekwe uxhaxha lwamacala yingakho efuna idokodo lecala." Njengoba sisho sicela imininingwane ethe thuthu ngoba kuthiwa kunamacala okubulala, awokuzama ukubulala, ukutholakala nesibhamu ekubeni singatholwanga ngesikhathi beboshwa eSwatini,’’ kusho uNgwenya.Kwenzeka konke lokhu nje abalisa bakwaNdimande kulindeleke ukuthi babuyele eNkantolo yeMantshi kwaManzini ngoMeyi 14 kuzoqhutshekwa nodaba lwabo.Ababoshelwe kuleli kulindeleke ukuthi babuyele eNkantolo yeMantshi eThekwini ngoMeyi 15 lapho kuzophuma khona isinqumo ngesicelo sabo sebheyili.
IQEMBU elisha uMkhonto weSizwe (MK) lithi lichithwe ezinkundleni zemidlalo ezehlukene ngaphambi kokuthola i-Orlando, eSoweto lapho lizokwethula khona izethembiso zayo zokhetho.I-MK izimisele ukugadla kuzwakale okhethweni lukazwelonke oluzoba ngoMeyi 29 lapho kulindeleke ukuthi zidlane kulo imilala.Okhulumela i-MK uMnuz Nhlamulo Ndlhela, uthe basesigabeni sokuqedela amalungiselelo omcimbi wabo wokwethula izethembiso okulindeleke ukuthi ube ngoMeyi 18.I-MK yethulwe owayengumengameli uJacob Zuma ngoDisemba nyakenye, wathi uzovotela yona akasayingeni eyokweseka i-ANC. UZuma wathi akenelisekile ngobuholi bukaMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa.KULINDELEKE ukuthi abalandeli beMK baphume ngobuningi ngelanga lomcimbi wokwethula izethembiso zokhetho Isithombe : FACEBOOK/MK PARTYKumanje i-MK kuphuzwa ngayo itiye iba sezindabeni mihla namalanga ngezizathu ezehlukene. Amaqembu amaningi asezethulile izethembiso zokhetho kubantu futhi sekusele amasonto ambalwa kuvotwe.UNdhlela ubale izindawo ezimbili abachithwe kuzona kwaba nezinye angabange esafuna ukuzisho athe bebezama kuzona." Inkundla yokuqala ebesiyifuna kakhulu yi-FNB kodwa kwavela ukuthi izobe isetshenziswa. Sizamile ukuthola iMoses Mabhida nakhona satshelwa ukuthi izobe isebenza. Sizame kaningi nakwezinye izindawo saze sathola i-Orlando,’’ kusho uNdhlela.Uthe akuwona umcimbi wokwethula izethembiso kodwa wumhlangano wezwi labantu nokuyilona okufanele ligqame kakhulu ukwedlula osopolitiki. UNdlhela uthe uZuma uzokwethula umyalezo wosuku kulo mcimbi.Uthe ubuholi bumatasa nje buqedela zonke izinhlelo zalo mcimbi okulindeleke ukuthi ube yingqophamlando. Udaba lokungatholakali kwezindawo belulokhu luvela emaqenjini ekhala ngokuthi kuba nzima.I-FP isanda kukhala ngento efanayo izama ukuthola inkundla ngaseMzimkhulu kodwa kwathiwa ngeke ikwazi. Akhona namanye amaqembu ake akhala ngokuthi izinkundla azitholakali.Ngaphandle kodaba lomcimbi wokwethula izethembiso, kulindeleke ukuthi udaba lweMK ne-IEC lungene eNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo namuhla.I-IEC yanquma ukuthi uZuma akafanelwe wukuba sohlwini lwabaya ePhalamende ngoba waboshwa wagwetshwa. I-MK yaluyisa enkantolo udaba yafika yalunqoba. I-IEC yalwedlulisa udaba yalufaka eNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo.
I-ACTIONSA KwaZulu-Natal ihlongoza ukufaka enkantolo uMasipala weTheku nowoGu ngenkinga yamanzi.Lokhu kuvezwe umholi waleli qembu, uMnuz Zwakele Mncwango izolo kwabezindaba emva kokuhambela iziphehlimanzi ngoLwesibili nangoLwesithathu behlola isimo samanzi.Uthe lokhu bakususele embikweni owenziwe inhlangano elwela amalungelo abantu, iHuman Rights Commission kulandela ukuthola izikhalazo eziningi emphakathini.Udalule ukuthi abemukelekanga kuMasipala woGu njengoba bevinjwe ngezinhlokohlela zezibhamu.UMncwango ophinde agaqele esobuNdunankulu njengoba kuyiwa okhethweni, uthe bazoya enkantolo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi uyabahlinzeka abantu ngamanzi njengoba kuyilungelo labo elikumthethosisekelo."Sizoqale sifune incwadi ephoqa laba omasipala ukuthi basivulele amathangi agcina amanzi neziphehlimanzi ukuze sihambise onjiniyela bethu ukuyobheka ukuthi yiziphi izinkinga ezikhona,” kusho uMncwango.Uqhube wathi onjiniyela bazophinde bahlole nengqalasizinda bese beyasho ukuthi kungaba yimalini ukuthi kulungiswe umonakalo."Uma sesiqede lokho, sizobe sesiya enkantolo nombiko ogcwele ozosho ukuthi nazi izinkinga ezikhona, zingalungiswa kanjani ukuze inkantolo iphoqe (omasipala) ukuthi abantu bahlinzekwe ngamanzi,” kusho uMncwango.Ukhale ngokulahleka kwamanzi angu-58% eThekwini, wathi lokhu kusho ukuthi iningi imali ekhishwa umasipala ukhokhela amanzi agcina engafikanga kubantu.Uthe amanzi alahlekayo uma sekubhekwa ezezimali, kuye kuvele ukuthi adla imali engu-R2 billion ngonyaka.Okunye akhale ngakho ukuhudulwa kwezinyawo ukulungiswa kwezinkinga zamanzi ezindaweni ezihlala abantu bebala elimnyama."Kugcina sekuyinto ejwayelekile kubantu abahlwempu kodwa uma eMhlanga kuhambe amanzi izinsuku ezimbili, kusukuma ngisho imeya (uMnuz Mxolisi Kaunda) ayochaza ukuthi kwenzekeni,” kusho yena.Uthe sekuphele amasonto amabili eMlaza kwa-Q bengenamanzi."Inhlekelele yamanzi eThekwini yenziwe ngamabomu ukuze kukhishwe amathenda, bese kudliwa imali,” kusho uMncwango.Uthe abakubonayo wubugebengu babantu abasebenzisa amanzi ukuzicebisa."Umngeni Water uyawaletha amanzi kodwa agcine engafinyelelanga kubantu. Kunobugebengu babantu asebehlangene ukwenza imali ngokusungula inhlekelele yamanzi. Bacekela phansi ingqalasizinda ukuze kuzothunyelwa amaloli emphakathini,” kusho uMncwango.Uqhube wathi abanye babulala ingqalasizinda ukuze bezobizwa ukuthi bazoyilungisa, wathi le nkinga ingalungiswa ngokuqedwa kwamathenda.Uphinde wathi enye inkinga idalwa wukuthi ubuholi bukaMasipala waseThekwini bunenkinga yokungazimiseli ngokuxazulula inkinga yamanzi.Wenze isibonelo ngezigcinimanzi zaseNanda, Ntuzuma nasePhoenix, wathi imiphakathi eyakhelene nazo sekuneminyaka ingenamanzi.
USIZI ingane igubha iminyaka emibili yokuzalwa izolo ngaphandle kwabazali bayo ababulawe ngesihluku ngesikhathi bedutshulwa owayebasola ngokumkweleta uR300.UNksz Phindile Nkomo (28) noMnuz Ntobeko Mhlungu (29), okungabazali bengane esihlala nogogo wayo, badutshulwe bashona ngenyanga edlule emqwashweni eNazaretha, ePinetown.Kusolakala ukuthi uNkomo wayekade ekweleta uMnuz Phiwinhlanhla Nzama (45) ongumshayeli weloli ethutha izinkwa. Kuthiwa wayemkweleta u-R300Kubikwa ukuthi uNksz Nkomo wadutshulwa esendlini encelisa ingane yakhe.Isidumbu sikaMhlungu satholakala emva kwendlu, sinamanxeba amabili okudutshulwa esifubeni nasesiphongweni. Lezi zigameko zenzeke ngo-Ephreli 14 ebusuku.Uphenyo luholele ekuboshweni kukaKhuzwayo, wabekwa amacala amabili okubulala. Ungaphandle ngebheyili kaR5 000 ayinikezwe iNkantolo yeMantshi yasePinetown yize uMbuso wawukade uyiphikisile.Le ndoda yaboshwa ngo-Ephreli 17, isibhamu sayo esisemthethweni satholakala sesigqitshwe esibayeni sezimbuzi kubo eKranskop.Unina kamufi, uNkk Duduzile Khuboni, ukhombise ukumangala, wathi kunzima emhlabeni. Asazi ukuthi kuhamba kanjani uma iqiniso lingekho kanje. Ungaze ubulale umuntu umbulalele uR300?” kubalisa unina kamufi.Uqhube wathi umzukulu wakhe, osebhekwe uyena, ubekade ehlanganisa iminyaka emibili izolo kodwa akasenabo abazali."Iyakhula ingane, ike yasihlupha unina esanda kushona ngoba ibingahlukani naye isancela ibele. Ibikhala ihlupha kodwa kuthe esengcwatshiwe yaba sesimeni esikahle. Kubuhlungu khona ngoba ayisenabo abazali futhi angiboni ukuthi ngiyoke ngikhohlwe umntwana wami,” kusho uNkk Khuboni.Uchaze indodakazi yakhe wathi akayazeli ukuntshontsha kodwa ubeyazela ukuthanda utshwala okuyinto obungeke uyithinte kuyona.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uConstable Thenjiswa Ngcobo, uthe umsolwa uzophinde avele enkantolo ngoJuni 14, kusaqhutshekwa nophenyo.
