PHEZU kokugxekwa nxa zonke kwesikhangiso sethelevishini sokukhankasela ukhetho se-DA, esiveza ifulegi lakuleli lingqongqa, kodwa leli qembu lithe ngeke lisihoxise.Umholi waleli qembu uMnuz John Steenhuisen uthe ngeke basihoxise futhi bangaya ngisho enkantolo bayosivikela.Uveze ukuthi lesi sikhangiso sikhombisa izwe elishayo, wathi inhloso yaso ngukuthi abantu babone ukuthi uma beqhubeka nokuvotela isixaxa samaqembu esihlanganise i-ANC, EFF noMkhonto weSizwe Party ikuphi okuzokwenzeka ezweni.Ngisho noMengameli uCyril Ramaphosa ukubize njengesenzo sokuvukela umbuso lesi sikhangiso.UNgqongqoshe wezemiDlalo, ubuCiko namaSiko uMnuz Zizi Kodwa, uthe bacubungula indaba yokuthi bayihlasela ngezinhlaka zomthetho eyalesi sikhangiso.Uveze ukuthi kumele kube nomgomo ozobekwa yiKhomishini yezoKhetho, mayelana nokuthi amaqembu angavezi izinto ezifana nokuthi kushiswe ifulegi lezwe nezinye izinto eziyifagugu zezwe."Kumele kushaywe umthetho wokuthi izinto ezifana nefulegi nezinye ezithinta izwe, zingashiswa noma zicekelwe phansi."Lokhu asikwenzi ngoba kuwukhetho kuphela kodwa kumele kwenziwe ukuze nangomuso isehlakalo esifuze lesi singaphinde senzeke. Abameli bakahulumeni yinto abayifakela izibuko eyokushiswa kwefulegi,”kusho uKodwa.URamaphosa uthe ifulegi wuphawu oluhlanganisa abantu."Ifulegi lezwe akulona eleqembu lezepolitiki elithile. Wuphawu oluhlanganisa abantu. Baningi abantu abafa, befela leli fulegi. Yinto okumele ihlonishwe ngoba wuphawu olubumba isizwe,” kusho uRamaphosa. UKodwa uthe ngisho kwamanye amazwe amaciko azigqaja ngalo."Uma sekuphephezela ifulegi emva kokwenza kahle kwamaciko ethu kwamanye amazwe siba nokuzigqaja ngempumelelo yethu. Yingakho kumele lihlonishwe ifulegi, kungabikhona nje ozovele alishise,” kuqhuba uKodwa.Uthe ngeke isebenze imizamo yokuhlukanisa isizwe. Abaholi bamanye amaqembu okubalwa i-ActionSA uMnuz Herman Mashaba, ukugxekile ukushiswa kwefulegi wathi kufana nokuvukela umbuso.Nophiko lwentsha lwe-ANC, uVukayibambe lukhwele lwadilika kwi-DA, lwathi leli qembu lizama ukuzuza amavoti ngalesi sikhangiso.Nasezinkundleni zokuxhumana iyindaba egudwini eyokushiswa kwefulegi njengoba begxeka leli qembu ngalesi sikhangiso.
IPHINDELA enkantolo imenenja kaMasipala waseMsunduzi, uMnuz Lulamile Mapholoba, ephinde yamiswa emsebenzini kungakapholi maseko inkantolo ichithe ukumiswa kwayo kokuqala.UMapholoba uthe useyalele abameli bakhe ukuthi bafake isicelo esiphuthumayo eNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu, baphonsele inselelo ukumiswa kwakhe kwakamumva.UMapholoba wamiswa emsebenzini ngoFebhuwari, esolwa ngokungaziphathi kahle.NgoMsombuluko, iNkantolo yezabaSebenzi inqume ukuthi kwakungekho emthethweni ukumiswa kukaMapholoba.NgoLwesithathu nangoLwesibili uMapholoba uzamile ukuphindela emsebenzini, kodwa wafike watshelwa ukuthi akavumelekile ukubuyela emsebenzini ngoba usamisiwe.Izindaba zokumiswa kukaMapholoba okwesibili ziqinisekiswe imeya uMnuz Mzimkhulu Thebolla, obekhuluma esithangamini nabezindaba, izolo.UThebolla uthe uMapholoba uthunyelwe incwadi emazisa ngokumiswa kwakhe.Inkantolo yachitha ukumiswa kukaMapholoba ngelithi kwakungafanele ukwenza kwakhe izethulo kuhlalelwe uThebolla, yathi kwakufanele kuhlalelwe umhlangano wawo wonke amakhansela.UThebolla uthe leli phutha balilungisa emhlanganweni womkhandlu owawungeledlule, nokuyilapho bathatha khona isinqumo sokumisa uMapholoba okwesibili.UThebolla uthe uMapholoba uzobhekana nohlelo lokuqondiswa ubugwegwe."Sesiluphothulile uphenyo, sathola ukuthi uMapholoba kukhona imithetho ayephula. Manje uzobhekana nokuqondiswa ubugwegwe. Uzomiswa emsebenzini kuze kube kuphothulwa uhlelo lokuqondiswa kwakhe ubugwegwe.”UThebolla uthe abalindele ukuthi uMapholoba afike emsebenzini njengoba emisiwe."Angifuni ke ukusho ukuthi kwenzekani kubantu abafika endaweni abangamukelekile kuyo.”UMapholoba utshele Isolezwe ukuthi ufuna ukumangalela uThebolla, amsola ngokungawuhloniphi umyalelo wenkantolo."Ihlazo leli elenziwa imeya yaseMsunduzi, ayiwuhloniphi umthetho. Ithimba labameli bami libheke eNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu liyomangalela imeya ngokuthi idelela umyalelo wenkantolo. Ngifuna nokuthi inkantolo iwuthathe njengongekho emthethweni umhlangano okwathathwa kuwo isinqumo sokungimisa okwesibili.”UMapholoba uthe incwadi yesibili yokumumisa emsebenzini ithi isinqumo sokumumisa sathathwa ngoMeyi 2, wathi kodwa incwadi uze wayithola ngoLwesibili, emva kokuphuma kwesinqumo esithi kwakungekho emthethweni ukumiswa kwakhe."Angazi ukuthi umgxabhiso wani lo abawenzayo. Bakhombisa ukungawuhloniphi umthetho. Mhlawumbe kwenza ukuthi akusibona abakhokhela izindleko zamacala. Ngiyazi ukuthi ekugcineni ngizonqoba. Nasekuqaleni bahlekisa ngami uma ngibatshela ukuthi ayikho emthethweni le nto abayenzayo.”UMapholoba ukuqinisekisile ukuthi uzamile ukubuyela emsebenzini izolo nangoLwesibili, wathi ufike watshelwa ukuthi akavumelekile ukuba semsebenzini ngoba usamisiwe.UMnuz Sabelo Hlela uyena ozoqhubeka nokubamba esikhundleni semenenja kamasipala.
ABEQEMBU uMkhonto weSizwe (MK) bakhala ngenkohlakalo nokugqoza kwezidingo kumasipala oyinhlokodolobha yesifundazwe iKwaZulu-Natal, uMsunduzi.Izinkumbi zamalungu eMK zibe nombhikisho emahhovisi omkhandlu asedolobheni uMgungundlovu, izolo, lapho bekhale khona ngokungahanjiswa kwezidingo.Amalungu eMK athe inkohlakalo iyona eyenza ukuthi umasipala wehluleke ukuhambisa izidingo.Umdidiyeli weMK eMsunduzi, uMnuz Majay Hadebe, uthe umasipala uyahluleka ukuhambisa izidingo ezifana namanzi nogesi."Ugesi uyacishwa njalo phakathi kuka-5 no-9 ntambama. Bathi abantu abasuke besuka emsebenzini abapheke ngani? Amanzi ayahlupha ezindaweni eziningi futhi awahlanzekile.”UHadebe uthe idolobha seliphenduke isizinda semigulukudu namaphara ngenxa yokungaqiniswa kwemithetho yomkhandlu."Izigebengu ziyacanasa. Abokufika nabo bayazenzela nje.”UHadebe uthe umasipala awunalo uhlelo oluthembekile lokubheka ukuthi abantu bawusebenzisa kangakanani ugesi namanzi."Kunabantu okuthiwa bakweleta imali eshisiwe kodwa uma usuthi uyalandelela uyathola ukuthi bayasukelwa. Sifuna ukuthi zicishwe zonke izikweletu ezindala.”UHadebe uthe bafuna nokuthi umasipala uqashe ngokugcwele bonke labo abaqashwe ngaphansi kohlelo lwemisebenzi yomphakathi.Umasipala unikezwe izinsuku eziyisikhombisa ukuba uphendule.Uhlu lwezikhalazo lwamukelwe ngobambe njengemenenja, uMnuz Sabelo Hlela.IMeya kaMasipala waseMsunduzi, uMnuz Mzimkhulu Thebolla, ikhale ngobuxoki kwabeMK.UThebolla obekhuluma ngaphambi kombhikisho, uthe izinkinga eziningi ezikhungethe umasipala zaqala ngesikhathi kusaphethe abantu asebengamalungu eMK.Uthe umkhandlu waze wafakwa ngaphansi kweso lomlawuli kusaphethe abantu asebengamalungu eMK."Kusobala ukuthi laba bantu babengayenzi into ababeyithunywe i-ANC, babezenzela okwabo. Vele eMgungundlovu kwakugcwele izingede zohulumeni wobandlululo. Manje sekuyavela ukuthi abantu bayiliphi.”Baningi ababengamakhansela eMsunduzi asebefudukele kwiMK.Phakathi kwabo kukhona owayephini lemeya, uMnuz Thobani Zuma, kube uMnuz Mtuza Mkhize noMsizi Ngcobo, nabo ababengamakhansela e-ANC.Umgqugquzeli weMK eMsunduzi, uMnuz Thabo Mbambo, uthe angeke baphawule ngokuthi yini eyayenziwa yilaba baholi ngesikhathi besaphethe eMsunduzi."I-MK inhlangano entsha. Simukela wonke umuntu. Asibheki ukuthi uphumaphi. Sonke sivula ikhasi elisha.”UThebolla uthe iMK ayizange ibazise ngemashi yayizolo."Sizwile nje kuthiwa bathi bazokhipha amasela, bathi bazokulwa nenkohlakalo. Abantu beMK abangakhohlisani. Ukhetho oluzokuba ngoMeyi 29, akusilo olomasipala. Bona uma benezikhalazo kufanele balandele imigudu efanele ukuze izikhalazo zabo zizosukunyelwa.”
KUHLOMULE amaNazaretha ngezigubhu ezishaywa uma kugidwa ngesikhathi kunomkhuleko obekuhloswe ngawo ukunqanda izinkinga ezahlukene ezihlasele umphakathi.Umkhuleko obusesizweni sakwaMdletshe, ubuholwa wuMasipala iHlabisa iBig 5 Hlabisa ngaphansi kweMeya, uMnuz Comfort Khumalo.UKhumalo unoxhaxha lwemikhuleko aluhlele ukuthi lujikeleze ngaphansi kukamasipala awuholayo ngenhloso yokuthandazela ukuthula nezinkinga ezihlasele umphakathi.Imeya ikhiphe umnikelo wezigubhu zokusina zamaNazaretha emapthempelini amane aku-Ward 8, nethe akugcinile ngawo njengoba namanye esazohlomula ngazo.Umshumayeli Shayimbizo Ntshangase waseThempelini lamaNazaretha iMpilenhle, uthe bajabule kakhulu uma umkhandlu ubakhumbula bengamaNazaretha uma kunentuthuko yomphakathi.Ngaphambi kokuba iMeya uKhumalo ithule inkulumo kulo mkhuleko, iqale yakhalisa isizwe saseMdletsheni ngokukhothama kwenkosi yakulesi sizwe, iNkosi uBonga Mdletshe esanda kutshalwa."INkosi uMdletshe ibineqhaza elikhulu esizweni nasemphakathi waseMdletsheni. Ngicela ukuthi uma sekukhulekwa, ungasali ngaphandle nomndeni weNkosi ngokugubuzelwa yifu elimnyama. Kuningi engifisa ukuthi uma sekukhulekwa kungasali ngaphandle. Okunye kwakho ukushelwa yimizi kwabantu njengoba kuvele kuqubuke umlilo ongaziwa ukuthi uqhamukaphi. Sicela ukuthi kukhulekelwe leli dimoni ngoba sikholwa ukuthi umkhuleko ongalinqanda,” kusho iMeya uKhumalo.Unobhala wekomidi labafundisi, uMfu Vusumuzi Mbatha, uthe bazokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi basebenzisana nomasipala ngaso sonke isikhathi ukuqhuba imikhuleko.Umlilo okuthiwa uvele uqubuke esithubeni ushise imizi yabantu, ubuhlasele indawo yaseMdletsheni manje kuthiwa uhlasele kwaMnqobokazi kwaHlabisa.
BAKHOMBA ngenjumbane inyosi yesilo, uMnuz Buzetsheni Mdletshe, kugengcwa owesilisa kuphinde kusatshiswa inqwaba ngenganono ngasekupheleni kuka-Ephreli eGazini, KwaCeza.Esigamekweni esenzeke ezinkambini zezinkomo zaseGazini, kugengcwe uMntwana Bhobho Zulu.Kuthiwa uze waya esibhedlela ukuyothola usizo lwezempilo esandleni esagengceka ephephisa ikhanda kucelemba owawuzosho phezulu."Udokotela wathi kuthinteke nomthambo. Angazi noma isandla sizophinde sikwazi yini ukusebenza,” kusho uZulu.Elandisa Isolezwe olwazi ukusuka nokuhlala udaba, uMntwana uNgcebo Zulu, uthe izinto zaqala ukonakala ngesikhathi kusungulwa umkhandlu okuthiwa Usuthu/Egazini Tribal Authority.Uthe kwaqala sengathi umyalelo ophuma esilweni esesakhothama futhi kuzosizakala abantu."Uthe usuqala usebenza umkhandlu kwashintsha izinto, kwadliwa umhlaba wabantu baseGazini,” kusho uZulu.Uqhube wathi indawo edliwayo yinkambi okudla kuyo izinkomo zabantu baseGazini.Uthe bavele babone sekubekwe umuntu maqede ibiyelwe indawo edliwe. Uthe yonke imizi ebekiwe eyakwaMdletshe futhi eyabantu abasondelene nenyosi."Bebelokhu beyinciphisa inkambi ngokuthi bahlehlise ucingo,” kuqhuba uZulu.Udalule ukuthi kwaphinde kwabekwa izinduna eziyisithupha ezigodini ezivele zinezinduna, isigodi ngasinye saba nezinduna ezimbili, eyomkhandlu wakwaNdebele neyasoSuthu.Uthe bayisukumele lento bezama imizamo yokubika esilweni kodwa kube nhlanga zimuka nomoya."Kwaze kwathintwa uMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu,” kusho yena.Uthe okwavela emva kokuthinta kwabo umnyango, isigcizelelo sokuthi umkhandlu osemthethweni ngoholwa inkosi yakwaNdebele, kwanqanyulwa nemiholo yezinduna eziyisithupha zasoSuthu athi zabekwa nguMdletshe phezu kwezakwaNdebele."Esigamekweni sakamuva amalungu omphakathi wakwaNdebele adinwe agana unwabu ayodiliza izigxobo nocingo olususwe endaweni yalo lunciphisa inkambi. Yilapho-ke okuqhamuke khona ebebehlome ngezibhamu badubula,” kusho uZulu.Uqhube wathi iningi labaleka kwathi umgilwa owagengcwa wabuza ukuthi benzani belimaza abantu.Uthe abaphendulanga kodwa wahlaselwa ababili, omunye esho ukumqeda ngocelemba, omunye eshaya ngesando."Sinovalo lokuthi kuzogcina kufa abantu ngale nto,” kusho uZulu.INkosi yakwaNdebele, uMnuz Sibusiso Ndebele, iluqinisekisile udaba, yathi lonke udweshu olukhona luphehlwa nguMdletshe."Ngokusho kwakhe, indawo iphethwe emikhandlwini emibili. Yilokho-ke okudala udweshu. Okubi ukuthi usebenzisa ukuba seduze nesilo nokuthenjwa yiso ukwenza noma yini,” kusho uNdebele.Uqhube wathi ufisa kungenelele izinhlaka ezifanele ukuze kuxazululeke udaba."Ngifisa nokuthi ake athathwe ahlaliswe phansi, achaze ukuthi lokhu akwenzayo ukwenzelani,” kusho Ndebele.Ethintwa uMdletshe, uthe ucela ukungaphawuli lutho ngoba akazi ukuthi ungena kanjani ekulinyazweni kwabantu. "Ngangingekho nokubakhona ngesikhathi okwenzeka ngaso isigameko. Engikwaziyo ukuthi leyo ndawo inomuzi kamfowethu,” kusho uMdletshe.Uthe akazi ukuthi kuqondwe ukuthini uma kuthiwa uhamba phambili ekudliweni komhlaba."Ayikho into engizoyiphawula, kwabona labo bantu angibazi, abakaze bakhulume nami," kusho uMdletshe.Okhulumela uMnyango wokuBusa ngokuBambisana nezindaba zoMdabu, uMnuz Siboniso Mngadi, uthe bayalwazi udaba. "Sesibe nemihlangano eminingi nenkosi nenyosi uMdletshe nabantwana basendlunkulu ukuzama ukulungisa udaba. Kule mihlangano kucaca ukuthi umkhandlu wasoSuthu nowakwaNdebele yimikhandlu emibili ehlukene futhi imingcele yalezi zizwe yehlukene, ayigibelene ndawo,” kusho uMngadi.Uqhube wathi akulindelekile ukuthi umkhandlu wasoSuthu kuthiwe ubeka izinduna noma usika iziza kwaNdebele, KwaCeza. "Kucacile futhi ukuthi ukubekwa kwenyosi KwaCeza kwakuwukuthi ibheke umgede osuthathwa njengesigodlo, hhayi ukuthi iyinduna yesigodi noma iso lesilo ezizweni esiphethwe yinkosi yakwaNdebele,” kusho uMngadi. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uConstable Thenjiswa Ngcobo, uthe amaphoyisa aKwaCeza abophe abesilisa ababili abaneminyaka engu-23 no-55 ngecala lokuhlasela ngenhloso yokulimaza."Abasolwa bavele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMahlabathini ngo-Ephreli 30, icala lahlehliselwa uMay 6.”
UZONGCWABA amathambo umndeni wowesifazane owabulawa umyeni wakhe, wamgqiba emgodini oseceleni kwethoyilethi, emzini wabo ngo-2020.UNkk Nontobeko 'MaDlomo" Ntombela (31) waseQabavu, eNsuze kusolakala ukuthi waxabana nomyeni wakhe uMnuz Khetha Ntombela (36).Ngemuva kwengxabano kuthiwa owesilisa wamshaya ngesando ekhanda, wase emumbela umgodi egcekeni, wamgqiba.Kuthiwa umsolwa akazange athi vu kumalungu omndeni kamufi ukuthi kwenzekeni kuyena, kodwa wayemlandula ethi akamazi ukuthi washonaphi.Kuthiwa wabikela umndeni kamufi namaphoyisa ngokunyamalala kwakhe.NgoNovemba nyakenye, owesilisa wakhombisa amaphoyisa lapho agqiba khona umkakhe. Ngemuva kwalokho wakhalelwa ngamasongo kaSigonyela.Ngaphambi kokuba abakhombise waqale ngokubantuntisa ebakhombisa izindawo ezehlukene.Kune-video Isolezwe elinayo lapho owesilisa echaza khona ukuthi kungani ambulala umufi. Kuyona uzwakala ekhala ngokuthi umkakhe wayesemshiyile esebuyele kubo.UMnuz Bhekokwakhe Dhlomo ongumfowabo omdala kamufi ukuqinisekisile ukuthi umufi uzofihlwa ngeSonto kubo KwaMaphumulo.Uthe imiphumela yolibofuzo isiphumile yingakho sebethathe isinqumo sokuthi bamfihle. Imiphumela uthe ikhomba ukuthi nguyena ngempela udadewabo owambiwa."Kuzoba umngcwabo nje ophelele. Sizofaka amathambo ebhokisini. Kuzoba nenkonzo ngaphambi kokuba afihlwe,'' usho kanje.Ugcizelele ukuthi lokhu kubathoba amanxeba, njengomndeni njengoba sebazi ukuthi ithambo labo likuphi."Khona kuhle ukuthi sesiyazi ukuthi ilungu lethu lashona. Obekukubi kakhulu ukuthi aduke njengoba sonke lesi sikhathi besingazi ukuthi kwenzekani ngaye,'' usho kanje.Okhulumela amaphoyisa uColonel Robert Netshiunda wakuqinisekisa ukumbiwa kwamathambo omuntu eNsuze.Umsolwa kuyimanje ugqigqa enkantolo ngecala lokubulala.
KUQHUME isililo enkantolo ngesikhathi ijaji ligweba uscabha wetekisi udilikajele neminyaka engu-38 ngaphezulu ngecala lokubulala owayengumshayeli wemoto ekhokhelwa ngebanga elihambile eMbilo, eThekwini.IJaji KQ Hadebe, eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini ligwebe uSambulo Mngomezulu (38) udilikajele ngecala lokubulala uMnuz Griffits Mndeni Gumede (37).Uphinde wagwetshwa eminye engu-18 ngecala lokuduna iVW Polo empunga kusetshenziswa indlakadla, engu-15 ngokutholakala nesibhamu nemihlanu ngokutholwa nezinhlamvu.UMngomezulu uphucwe ilungelo lokuthi aphinde aphathe isibhamu esisemthethweni ngezandla zakhe.Umshushisi u-Advocate Gugu Xulu watshela inkantolo ukuthi ababulali bakaGumede bazenza abantu abaqasha imoto kanti bafuna ukumgebenga.Sasingakathathwa nasendaweni yesigameko isidumbu sikaGumede nemoto yakhe isanda kubizwa emoyeni, waboshwa eseKwaMashu, uMngomezulu.Wayekade engaphandle ngoshwele onikezwa iziboshwa uMngomezulu eboshwa.Wayedonsa isigwebo seminyaka engu-23 ngoxhaxha lamacala okukhona kuwona awokugqekeza, ukubamba inkunzi kuhlonyiwe, ukutholakala nesibhamu nezinhlamvu okungekho emthethweni.NgoLwesihlanu, olwedlule uMngomezulu uxolisile emndenini kaGumede usenkantolo okuthe emuva kwesigwebo, umndeni walunqaba uxolo lwakhe.Eseshona emgodini ebuyela ezitokisini uMngomezulu, uvele washwiba izandla samuntu ophebeza obekukade kushiwo umndeni kamufi abebemvalelisa bekhihla isililo.Ngaphambi kwalokho ijaji lithe uMngomezulu ungumuntu ongeke aphinde ahlumeleliseke isimilo ngoba ekukhuleni kwakhe ubengena ephuma ejele ngamacala afana nagwetshelwe wona izolo.Likhale nangesihlava sokubulawa kwabenza umsebenzi ofana nokamufi lathi kuwumsebenzi wenkantolo ukubagixabeza ngezigwebo eziqinile abagila le migilingwane.."Ibhizinisi ayekulona umufi libuyisa ithemba kubantu ukuthi bazosizakala esikhathini lapho imisebenzi ingekho khona. Nsuku zonke bayabulawa abakuleli bhizinisi baphucwe izimoto zabo,” kusho ijaji.Ijaji lithe wayezenzisa uMngomezulu ecela uxolo efuna ukudatshukelwa ekubeni waqale wabambezela ukuqala nokuphothulwa kwecala ebashonisa le nale. "Waxolisa ngoba wenzela wena kungeve kusuka ngaphakathi kuwena. Sikuphi isidingo sokubulala umuntu owayengalwi futhi engahlomile? Isenzo sakho sasiwubuqaba. Umufi ubengumuntu omncane, ethembekile futhi enakekela abantwana bakhe nomndeni. Ngenxa yesenzo sakho esimbi kwashabalala lokho. Amanxeba ayesendaweni ebucayi, nanenza isiqiniseko sokuthi akasindi,” kusho ijaji.Umufi washiya emhlabeni umndeni, izingane ezimbili nenye unina ayeyikhulelwea. Ngokwezitatimende ezifundwe enkantolo, izingane ziqhatha usizi, ziswele futhi zintula imali.Unina wengane kamufi yena, uthe washayeka phansi wavuka esibhedlela ezwa ukuthi ushonile uGumede. Uthe uGumede wayebondla, usephila ngokukhangezwa izimpahla zengane eyake yaphila ngamanzi abhoyiliwe isonto lonke iswele ubisi.Ilungu lomndeni kaGumede, elicele kugodlwe igama lalo, lithe nakuba bejabule ngesigwebo esinikezwe uMngomezulu, esibathoba amanxeba, kodwa basenemibuzo engakaphenduleki ukuthi wayebulawelani futhi baphi abanye ababulali bakhe?
UMKHAKHA wezolimo waseNingizimu Afrika kumele uhlale uwuqaphile umkhuhlane wezinyoni, iH5N1 osukapakele ezinkomeni zobisi, e-United States (US) ngoba usabalaliswa yizinyoni ezihamba amazwe amaningi. Igciwane lomkhuhlane iH5N1 neH7N6 ilona elihlasele izinkukhu kuleli nyakenye, okuholele ekutheni kubulawe inqwaba yazo kodwa bewungakaze usabalalele kolunye uhlobo lwemfuyo kuleli. Yize kunjalo, abezempilo nosomnotho bathi wonke amazwe kumele aqaphe ngoba kusangenzeka nakwamanye amazwe leli gciwane litholakale nakolunye uhlobo lwemfuyo okungezona izinkukhu nezinyoni. Kungokokuqala ukuthi leli gciwane liphathe izinkomo nabantu. UMnuz Wandile Sihlobo owusomnotho kwi-Agricultural Business Chamber of SA, uthe okwamanje lo mkhuhlane kusabikwe ukuthi usabalalele ezinkomeni e-US kodwa iNingizimu Afrika kumele ihlale iqaphile ngoba ukulawula kwezifo zezilwane kuleli kuya ngokuya kuba ntekenteke. USihlobo uqhube wathi ukuqubuka kwezifo zezilwane ezifana nesifo samatele, i-swine fever, kungubufakazi bokuthi kunobuthakathaka endleleni izwe elilawula ngayo izifo, ukudla okudliwa izilwane nemigomo elawula ukuphathwa kokudla kuleli.Uthe ukubheduka kwezifo kunciphisa inzuzo kubalimi kuphinde kuphazamise nokuthunyelwa kokudla kwamanye amazwe.Kusolwa ukuthi leli gciwane liqale ngoMashi, ukusabalala e-US lagcina selihlasela izinkomo nabasebenza emapulazini kuleliya lizwe. Akacaci kahle ukuthi zingaki izinkomo zobisi ezinaleli gciwane kanjalo nabasebenza emapulazini, isikhungo esibhekelele izifo, iFood and Drug Administration (FDA), sisaphenya. Inhloko yophiko olubhekelele umkhuhlane, enhlanganweni yezempilo emhlabeni, World Health Organisation (WHO), uDkt Wenqing Zhang, uthe maningi amathuba okuthi lo mkhuhlane usabalalele ezilwaneni obungakaze uziphathe nakwamanye amazwe ngoba usatshalaliswa izinyoni ezizulazula emhlabeni wonke."Lo mkhuhlane ophatha izinyoni, ubujwayele ukuthi usabalalele ezinkukhwini nasemakatini asendle, manje sesithole ukuthi kuyenzeka ungene nasemfuyweni eyizinkomo, yize kungavamile. Amathuba okuthi abantu bawuthole lo mkhuhlane mancane kakhulu kodwa sinxusa ukuthi abantu base-US baphuze ubisi oluke laphekwa kubulawa amagciwane, kuphela okwamanje," kusho uZhang.
UTHELA izithelo ezifundazweni ezehlukene kuleli, umkhankaso wamaphoyisa okuhloswe ngawo ukukhuculula ubugebengu owaziwa nge-Operation Shanela.Lokhu kuvezwe okhomishana bamaphoyisa ezifundazweni esithangamini nabezindaba ebesisePitoli, izolo, obekuhloswe ngaso ukunekela izwe imiphumela yalo mkhankaso esikhathini esiwunyaka kusuka kuMeyi, wanyakenye.Lesi sithangami besizimaziswe wuKhomishana wamaPhoyisa kuzwelonke, uGeneral Fannie Masemola, uNgqongqoshe wezamaPhoyisa, uMnuz Bheki Cele nePhini lakhe uMnuz Cassel Mathale nokhomishana bezifundazwe obekukhona phakathi wabo noLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, obambe lesi sikhundla KwaZulu-Natal nezikhulu eMnyangweni wamaPhoyisa.Bangu-616 423 abasolwa ababoshelwe amacala ehlukene kuzwelonke selokhu kuqale lo mkhankaso, kwavundululwa izibhamu ezingu-22 525.Evula lesi sithangami, uCele uthe nakuba amaphoyisa esekhaleni lalo mkhankaso kodwa ukusebenzisana neminye imikhakha abalule kuyo i-South African National Defence Force, amaphoyisa akomasipala, uMnyango wezaseKhaya, uphiko oluqoqa intela kuleli i-South African Revenue Services, neminye iminyango kahulumeni yikhona okukwenze waqhutshwa ngempumelelo."Kulo mhlangano sihlose ukukhombisa izwe ukuthi kusukela kuqale lo mkhankaso ngonyaka odlule, amaphoyisa asalokhu ezinikele emsebenzini wokulwa nobugebengu. Iqhaza elibanjwe wumphakathi ukulwa nobugebengu liyakhula,” usho kanje.UMkhwanazi uncome umsebenzi wamaphoyisa kulesi sifundazwe ngokuzinikela ekuvikeleni umphakathi, eqinisekisa ukuthi emigwaqweni okuhamba kuyo kungaba abasuke beya emisebenzini, nezingane eziya ezikoleni, baphephile."Kube nempumelelo kakhulu ukusebenza kwamaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, ikakhulu uma ubheka izigameko ezenzekile kubalwa kuzo ezokudutshulwa kwabantu behleli ndawonye noma izigameko lapho uthola khona ukuthi sekunomgilwa obulewe. Baningi asebeboshiwe ezigamekweni ezifuze lezi. Ukwenza isibonelo esigamekweni esenzeka ePlessislaer (eMgungundlovu) lapho kwabulawa khona abawu-10 bendawonye, nesaseMlaza lapho kwabulawa abayisithupha,” kusho uMkhwanazi.UKhomishana wamaPhoyisa eGauteng, uLieutenant General Tommy Mthombeni, uqinisekise ukuthi ngempelasonto edlule nje kuphela, bangu- 940 ababoshwe kulesi sifundazwe, wancoma ukusebenza kwamaphoyisa. Bangu-51 557 kuzwelonke ababoshelwe ukutholakala nezidakamizwa kulo mkhankaso, okuyisibalo esiphezulu kunawo wonke amacala asohlwini lababoshiwe ngesikhathi sawo umkhankaso.

Ngesikhathi uGovender echaza kafishane okuqukethwe umbiko, kukhona abavele banxapha.Phambilini, lo mndeni ubulokhu usho ukuthi ngokwawo awuqondi ukuthi kungani uNgema engavele avume icala, agwetshwe.Ubukusho lokhu ngenxa ye-video eyasabalala ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ekhombisa uConst Khuzwayo emzuzwini wakhe wokugcina, ephuma igazi ngamakhala nangomlomo.Le video kuthiwa yafakwa wuNgema ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, waphinde wayithumela kwabasondelene nomufi, ebatshela ukuthi usembulele.

IQEMBU uMkhonto weSizwe (MK), ligabe ngezincwadi zikaMnuz Jabulani Khumalo azibhala ngo-Ephreli edlulisela amandla kowayengumengameli uJacob Zuma neye-IEC ecacisa ngobuholi.UZuma ngoDisemba nyakenye wamemezela ukuthi uzokweseka iMK okhethweni oluzoba ngasekupheleni kwenyanga lapho okulindeleke ukuthi zidlane khona imilala.UKhumalo owabhalisa iqembu nosexoshiwe eqenjini, ubhalele i-IEC eyicela ukuba ihoxise uZuma njengomholi weqembu. UMasipala weTheku ubambisene ne-Innovate Durban baqhamuke nohlelo oluzosiza abesifazane abanamabhizinisi eThekwini namaphethelo.Lolu hlelo olubizwa ngeSHEshisa lwenzelwe ukusiza futhi lufundise abesifazane abasaqala nalaba asebenawo amabhizinisi ukuthi bakwazi ukusebenzisa ezobuchwepheshe, bathole ulwazi ngawo baphinde babe nesibindi sokwakha ubuhlobo uma kuziwa kwezamabhizinisi.Ukwamukelwa kwezicelo zokubhalisela ukuba yingxenye yabesifazane abazofunda ngaphansi kwalolu hlelo kuzovalwa ngoMeyi-19, 2024 futhi lolu hlelo luzofundwa izinyanga eziyisithupha.Ukufunda kuzoqala ngoJuni 1, 2024 lapho osomabhizinisi bezofunda ekilasini baphinde basebenzise usizo lwe-inthanethi.Phakathi kwezinto abazozifunda kubalwa ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuzinaka, ukusebenzisana nabantu nokusebenzisa ezobuchwepheshe.Ukuqeqeshwa ngezamabhizinisi kuzobandakanya ukuphathwa kwezezimali, ukudayisa, ezokuxhumana, izindlela zokwenza ibhizinisi, umnyango wezabasebenzi nokuhambisana nesikhathi kwezamabhizinisi.Ukuze ube yingxenye yohlelo lweSHEshisa kuzobhekwa ukuthi ngabe ibhizinisi lakho liyahambisana yini nemibandela ebekiwe.Le mibandela ithi ibhizinisi kumele libe nonyaka owodwa kuya kwemihlanu lasungulwa, kumele libe nezobuchwepheshe, lingenise imali engango-R100 000 000, kube elilapha KwaZulu-Natal futhi likwazi ukuba yingxenye yezinhlelo ezizobe zihleliwe eThekwini. Induna yakulesi sigodi icele umphakathi, ikakhulukazi izinsizwa, ukuthi zibe yiso nomvikeli walesi sakhiwo esikade saba isidingo.Kuphinde kwanenhlokomo nasemphakathini waseCool Air ku-Ward 7 ngesikhathi wemukela ngokusemthethweni isikhungo samakhono, iCool Air Skills Centre, okuyisakhiwo esidle umhlanganiso kwisifundazwe sase KZN ngokuba isakhiwo esiseqopheleni eliphezulu. Lesi sakhiwo sizoqeqesha amakhono ahlukahlukene, okubandakanya ulwazi lwama-computer.Ubuholi bukhulume nezindimbane zamalunga omphakathi obuyingxenye yokuvulwa kwalesi sakhiwo.
ONGOTI bezomthetho babona umqansa ongakhwelwa mbongolo emajajini ngodaba lowayengumengameli uJacob Zuma owacele ukuthi ashenxe uma sekulalewa udaba lwakhe ne-IEC.Kulindeleke ukuthi iNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo ngoLwesihlanu, ilalele udaba lombango phakathi kukaZuma ne-IEC. Abe-IEC banquma ukuthi uZuma aphume ohlwini lwabaya ePhalamende ngoba walahlwa ngecala wagwetshwa.I-IEC ikhuluma ngecala lokwedelela umyalelo wenkantolo elagweba uZuma izinyanga ezingu-15 ejele ngo-2021, lapho okwasuka khona izibhelu. Lelo cala yilona elibangwa kakhulu njengoba sekufanele aye ePhalamende, i-IEC ithi umthetho awuvumi.UZuma walufaka enkantolo udaba wafika walunqoba kodwa abe-IEC balwedlulisela eNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo bengenelisekile. Kuthe kusalindwe ukuthi lungene, uZuma wathushuka nesicelo esingajwayelekile.OWAYENGUMENGAMELI wezwe, uJacob Zuma, ufuna amajaji ayisithupha ashenxe ebhentshini uma sekulalelwa udaba lwakhe ne-IEC Isithombe: FACEBOOK/UMKHONTO WESIZWE PARTYUZuma ucele ukuthi amajaji ayisithupha athatha isinqumo sokumlahla ngecala amgweba ngo-2021, awangalulaleli udaba lwe-IEC. UZuma ukhala ngokuthi lawo majaji angase angabi nobulungiswa kulolu daba.UZuma ugagule amaJaji uMbuyiseli Madlanga, Steven Majiedt, uNonkosi Mhlanthla, uLeona Theron noZukisa Tshiqi. INhloko yamaJaji uRaymond Zondo ingelesithupha kwabacelwa ukuba bashenxe.Ungoti wezomthetho, uMnuz Mpumelelo Zikalala wenkampani yabameli iZikalala Attorneys, uthe zihlala ziba khona izicelo kodwa lesi sehlule kakhulu."Izicelo zokuthi amajaji ashenxe sizejwayele kodwa hhayi amaningi kangaka, akuvamile lokhu. Kwalona uhlaka lwezomthetho kuleli indlela oluhlelwe ngayo alukaze lucabange ukuthi kuyofika isicelo salolu hlobo, sekuzosiza ukuthi babhekane naso,’’ kusho uZikalala.Ibhentshi linamjaji angu-11 esewonke njengoba uZuma efuna kuhoxe ayisithupha nje. UZikalala uthe kungathathwa amajaji ezinkantolo ezinkulu noma eNkantolo okuDluliswa kuyo amaCala azohlalela udaba. Uthe kodwa kuyofanele kube amajaji angakaze alulalele udaba lukaZuma phambilini.Omunye ungoti wezomthetho u-Advocate Michael Osborne obekhuluma neSABC, uthe yinkiyankiya yodaba le kaZuma."Wudaba oluyimpicabadala lolu ngoba okokuqala kufanele asebenze kanzima uZuma ukuveza ukuchema kwamajaji. Okwesibili kodwa wukuthi udaba lwe-IEC oluzongena enkantolo luxhumene nesigwebo sakhe esakhishwa yiyo inkantolo ezolalela udaba,’’ kusho u-Osborne.Uthe iphuzu likaZuma elizwakalayo wukuthi ngeke inkantolo ikhiphe isinqumo bese ngelinye ilanga icelwa ukuba isicubungule isihlaziye ukuze inqume ngaso futhi.U-Osborne uthe uma kwenzeka amajaji eshenxa kuyofanele iphini lenhloko yamajaji liqoke amajaji azobamba alalele udaba.
INKANTOLO iyilahle ngecala indoda eyabulala ingoduso yayo ngoba yayiyikhuza ukuthi ingakhwelezeli indodakazi yayo engayizali eyayikade iyisola ngokuthi ijola nomshayeli wetekisi.IJaji elibambile, uKevin Gounden weNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini, lilahle ngecala le ndoda eneminyaka engu-38. Isigwebo sizokhishwa ngesonto elizayo.Phambilini le ndoda yavuma ukuthi yadlwengula indodakazi yayo engayizali eyayina-18 neyizalayo eyayina-14 KwaNyusa, eThekwini entathakusa ngoMeyi 11, 2022.Unina wamadodakazi washaywa yile ndoda wafa, isidumbu sakhe saphonswa esiweni sisongwe ngengubo sambozwa ngamahlamvu.Le ndoda yaboshwa ngo-Agasti 3, 2022 eLovu ibhace kwagogo wayo igqoke ingubo yabesifazane e-navy newigi izifihla ngoba yayikade yazi ukuthi ifunwa amaphoyisa."Umufi wawusumthathisa okomuntu osesithenjini nengane yakhe owawusuyithatha njengentombi yakho uyidlwengula. Usumbulele umufi watshela amadodakazi akhe ukuthi anakekelane, abambane ngoba wena ngeke usabakhona isikhathi eside,” kusho ijaji lahlulela.Lithe lanelisekile ngobufakazi boMbuso, obethulelwe inkantolo ofakazi abebekade beluswa umshushisi u-Advocate Thabani Buthelezi.Ijaji lithe ubufakazi bukhiphe isithombe esisodwa esiphelele sokuthi yile ndoda eyabulala futhi ikuhlelile.Bebekhona abagilwa ngesikhathi ijaji likhipha isinqumo enkantolo.Kube nesikhathi lapho bevukwa khona umunyu, omunye wabo waphumela ngaphandle, omunye wasala ekhala enkantolo ngesikhathi kufundwa izitatimende zabo zokuthi kubashiye benjani okwenziwa uyise kubona.Nayo le ndoda ibimi ngezinyawo ebhokisini labasolwa ichiphiza izinyembezi igebise ikhanda unomphela.Ezitatimendeni ezinikezwe inkantolo, zabo bobabili abagilwa, bathe ngeke bamxolele uyise futhi sebephenduke inhlekisa emphakathini behlelwa ukuzethemba baqalwa ukhwantalala. Omunye wabo usole unina ngokuyiletha empilweni yakhe le ndoda ayichaze ngomhlukumezi.Enye yalezi zingane ithe le ndoda iyiphuce ubuntombi bayo, yaphelelwa ukuthemba umuntu, futhi ayisakwazi ukuya eMkhosini woMhlanga okuyinto ebikade iphila ngayo.Ngakolunye uhlangothi, uNkk Zeera Fareed, ongummeli wale ndoda uyicelele ukuba ithanjiselwe isigwebo ngoba iyazisola, iyaxolisa ezinganeni zayo ngeyakwenza futhi isiphila ngemishanguzo ethithibalisa ukhwantalala eyiqale ngoSepthemba 2023, ejele laseWestville. Ucele inkantolo ikubeke emqondweni uma seyigweba ukuthi le ndoda seyinonyaka nezinyanga eziyisishiyagalombili igqunywe ejele.Ummeli uthe ngaphambi kokuthi iboshwe yayingunogada esibhedlela sikahulumeni eHowick kuyiyona kuphela ebheke ikhaya ngeholo likaR5 000. Uqhube wathi inabantwana abayisithupha omdala una-17 futhi ayikaze yalahlwa icala phambilini.Kodwa uButhelezi uthe ifanelwe isigwebo esingudilikajele ngokudlwengula nokubulala umuntu okwakumele ngabe iyamvikela."Sekuthenjwe izinkantolo ukuba zikhiphe izigwebo eziqinile ezizothumela umyalezo emphakathini nakwabanye abantu abasacabanga ukwenza izigameko ezinyantisa igazi njengalezi. Le ndoda ayiwavumanga amacala ngoba kusuka ngaphakathi kuyona kodwa yabona ukuthi uMbuso unobufakazi obuqanda ikhanda obuzoyigojela,” kusho uButhelezi.
KUSOLWA ukuphuma kwesondo elolini laphaphalaza laqonda etekisini njengembangela yengozi eshiye abagibeli betekisi belimele kabi kuN2 ngaseBallito.Ngokubika kwabezimo eziphuthumayo abakhulume nofakazi ozibonele kwenzeka le ngozi, kuthiwa yisondo leloli eliphaphalaze lashayisa itekisi okuholele engozini."Obonile kwenzeka ingozi uthi kuphume isondo nerim elolini ebihamba ibheke ngaseningizimu, eliphaphalaze lawelela emzileni wezimoto ezibheke enyakatho, lashayisa itekisi ngaphambi kokushayisa imoto yesibili.”Babili abagibeli betekisi abalimale kabi okudingeke ukuba bathole usizo lokuqala olukhethekile ngaphambi kokuphuthunyiswa esibhedlela. Abanye abagibeli abayishumi bathole imihuzuko.Ngenhlanhla abebesemotweni yesibili abalimalanga.
IKHALE ngokumosheka kwesikhathi senkantolo nangezindleko engena kuzona imantshi ngesikhathi kuhlehla icala likathisha obhekene namacala ayisithupha okudlwengula abafundi abathathu ephindelela.Uthisha oneminyaka engu-56 owayefundisa esikoleni saseClermont, ubevele eNkantolo yeMantshi yasePinetown. Icala lakhe belizoqulwa isonto lonke.Kodwa akubange kusaqala ukuqulwa kwecala njengoba ukugula kommeli kamsolwa, u-Advocate Andile Thusi, kuphoqe ukuba lihlehliselwe inyanga ezayo. Ummeli uMendlula ufikile enkantolo watshela iMantshi uSimphiwe Hlophe ukuthi uthunywe ngu-Adv Thusi ukuthi azokwazisa inkantolo ukuthi uyagula angeke aze akwazi ukuqhubeka necala kuleli sonto.Imantshi ikwamukelile lokhu kodwa yakhala ngokumosheka kwesikhathi senkantolo nangezindleko inkantolo engena kuzona ngenxa yokuhlehla kwalo."Angeke ilunge phela le nto uma izohamba kanjena. Phela kunemali ekhokhelwa ofakazi bakuleli cala. Namhlanje nampa bafikile kodwa icala aliqhubeki, kuzomele bakhokhelwe imali yokuphinda emuva,'' isho kanje.Ithe ohlwini lwamacala aqhubekayo kuleli sonto kule nkantolo belibekwe eqhulwini leli, kodwa sekufanele kube nokuguquka kwaloluhlu ngenxa yokuthi sekunecala elihlehliswayo.Umsolwa obekhona enkantolo, kuvela ukuthi waboshwa emagcekeni esikole ngo-2022.Usolwa ngokudlwengula abafundi bamantombazane abathathu. Kuthiwa eyedwa umfundi wamdlwengula amahlandla amabili.Ecaleni lokuqala kuvela ukuthi umsolwa wadlwengula umfundi oneminyaka engu-17 ngoMashi 16, 2021. Kuthiwa lo mfundi waphinde wamphinda futhi ngalo usuku olufanayo.NgoJanuwari 19, 2022,, kuthiwa wadlwengula umfundi oneminyaka engu-17. Naye usolwa ngokuthi wamgila amahlandla amabili.Ngo-2021, uthisha usolwa ngokuthi wakhumula isikhindi sakhe sangaphansi ekhombisa umfundi oneminyaka engu-17 isitho sakhe sangasese ngaphakathi emagcekeni esikole.Ngalo lolu suku usolwa ngokuthi wanukubeza ngokocansi omunye umfundi oneminyaka engu-16.Kuvela ukuthi abafundi wayebadlwengulela ngaphakathi emagcekeni esikole.Umsolwa ungaphandle ngebheyili ka-R5 000 ayithola ngoMeyi ngonyaka owedlule.Umzali womunye umfundi okuthiwa wadlwengulwa yilo thisha ukhale ngokubambezeleka kwecala..
Inhlangano eyengamele ukhetho kuleli, i-Independent Electoral Commission (IEC) iyazihlangula embangweni wobuholi beqembu uMkhonto Wesizwe (MK) kulandela incwadi ebhalelwe yona wuMnuz Jabulani Khumalo ecela ukuthi kuhoxiswe owayengumengameli uJacob Zuma njengomholi.NgoLwesibili ekuseni Isolezwe libike ukuthi uKhumalo, owabhalisa iMK, ubhalele i-IEC eyicela ukuthi ihoxise uZuma njengobuso beqembu.Incwadi uyibhale ngemuva kokuxoshwa kwakhe kuleli qembu ekupheleni kwenyanga edlule. Abe-IEC bakubeke kwacaca esitatimendeni abasikhiphile ukuthi bona babambe elentulo ukuthi uZuma wumholi weqembu okunye abahlangene nakho.Kwenzeka lokhu nje, ngoLwesihlanu eNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo kuzolalelwa udaba lombango phakathi kwe-IEC noZuma ngokungena kwakhe ohlwini lwabamele iqembu ePhalamende.I-IEC yathi ngeke akwazi ukungena ngenxa yokuthi wagwetshwa izinyanga ezingu-15 ejele kodwa inkantolo yasiguqula leso sinqumo.
ALIKAHLOLWA namanje ingqondo iphoyisa likaMasipala weTheku elibhekene necala lokubulala intombi yalo ebinguzakwabo emsebenzini.Lokhu kuvele izolo ngesikhathi uConstable Sizwe Ngema (27) evela eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini.Usolwa ngecala lokugwaza abulale uConstable Bianca Khuzwayo (23) eflethini lakhe elisenkabeni yeTheku ekupheleni kukaMashi. Uphinde asolwe nangecala lokweba iselula kamufi.Ngesikhathi evela ngesonto eledlule enkantolo, uMbuso waphakamisa ukuba lihlehliselwe izolo icala ukuze ayohlolwa ingqondo.Bekulindeleke ukuthi kumenyezelwe imiphumela yokuhlolwa kwakhe ingqondo izolo kodwa uMshushisi, uMnuz Calvin Govender waveza ukuthi akakahlolwa."UMbuso unesicelo sokuthi lihlehliselwe ikusasa (esho namuhla) icala ngoba umsolwa akakahlolwa ingqondo. Lokhu kwenzeke ngenxa yokuthi udokotela obekelwe ukuthi enze lo msebenzi ubebambeke kwelinye icala athula kulo ubufakazi lonke leli sonto eledlule,” kusho uGovender.UMSOLWA uConstable Sizwe Ngema obevele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini izolo Isithombe: ZIMBILI VILAKAZIUqhube wathi ngokwezinhlelo, bekulindeleke ukuthi udokotela amhlole izolo ntambama ngo-2 bese ephothula umbiko wakhe khona izolo.Ubuye wathi umsolwa uzogcinwa esitokisini sasesiteshini samaphoyisa iDurban Central ukuze kusondezelwe udokotela ozomhlola.Ummeli kamsolwa, u-Advocate Ravi Reddy uqinisekise ukuthi uyakwazi konke okushiwo uGovender.Ube esebuza inkantolo ukuthi ngeke yini kwenzeke ukuthi umsolwa asale esecela ibheyili emva kokufundwa kombiko kadokotela.IMantshi, uMnuz Scelo Zuma, ithe kuzobonakala namuhla ukuthi lokho kungenzeka yini, ngokubuka uhlu lwamacala azongena.Umsolwa ubedlubhe ijakhethi ebomvu, ekhophoza, esonge izandla zakhe zingaphambili.Umndeni kamufi, ubugcwele ngezinkani enkantolo. Ngaphambi kokuqala kwecala, umamkhulu kamufi, uNksz Mpume Khuzwayo, wehlulekile ukubamba izinyembezi, waphuma wayokhala ngaphandle kwenkantolo.Kuthe inkantolo isilihlelisile icala, aphuma amalungu omndeni ayomthulisa.Emva kokubulawa kukamufi ngoMashi 31, umsolwa kuthiwa wafaka i-video ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ekhombisa umufi eshona.Kule video, kwakubonakala umufi ephuma igazi ngomlomo nangamakhala, esifubeni kwakugcwele igazi, kwakusabhajwe ummese okusolwa ukuthi wamgwaza ngawo.Le video kuthiwa umsolwa akagcinanga ngokuyinameka ezinkundleni zokuxhumana kuphela, kodwa wabuye wayithumela kwabanye abasondelene nomufi, okukhona kubo nomngani.
UKUDLIWA komhlaba kubeka engcupheni uhlelo lokwakhiwa kwesikhumulo sezindiza sikaR14 billion okuhlongozwa ukuthi sakhiwe endaweni engaphansi koMasipala waseMkhambathini.Abatshali bezimali abavela eGermany bamanqika ukuqala ukwakha isikhumulo sezindiza esizodala izinkulungwane zamathuba emisebenzi ngenxa yokuthi kukhona abakha imizi endaweni ehlonziwe.Lokhu kuvezwe iMeya uNhlakanipho Ntombela, obekhuluma esidlweni sakusihlwa ebesihlelwe ubuholi be-ANC kwisifunda iMoses Mabhida.Umhlaba odliwayo usendaweni enothile, eLynnfield, phakathi kweCamperdown, noMgungundlovu.UNtombela uthe umhlaba ohlonziwe ukuthi kwakhiwe kuwo isikhumulo sezindiza wabuyiselwa emphakathini."Mabili ama-Trust ayenikezwe umhlaba. Ama-Trust ke avamisile ukuba nezinkinga. Abantu bayaye bangaboni ngendlela eyodwa. Abanye bayaye bafune ukuqhubeka nokutshala, kube khona abafuna ukuwudayisa umhlaba. Manje kukhona abantu abasika izindawo, ababeka abantu.”UNtombela uthe isikhondlakhondla senkampani yaseGermany esifuna ukwakha isikhumulo sezindiza ngabe sesiqalile ukwakha ukube abekho abantu abadla umhlaba."Nakuthina kunzima ukungenelela ngoba umhlaba okukhulunywa ngawo uphethwe abantu abazimele. Siyazama ukuxoxisana nabo abanikazi bomhlaba. Into esiyihlongozayo ukuthi basidayisele wona umhlaba.”UNtombela uthe ukwakhiwa kwesikhumulo sezindiza kuzodala amathuba emisebenzi angu-5 000.UMkhambathini ukhula ngamandla, izimboni eziningi sezithuthele ezindaweni ezingaphansi kwalo mkhandlu.Izimboni zihehwa ukuthi lo mkhandlu useduze nothelawayeka uN3, uphinde ube phakathi kwamadolobha amakhulu iTheku noMgungundlovu.UNtombela uthe bafuna ukuthi uMkhambathi ufane nedolobha lomntakabani eliseGoli, iSandton."Sikhula ngamandla. UMengameli (uCyril Ramaphosa) wakhuluma ngamadolobha esimanje ngesikhathi ethula inkulumo yakhe ngesimo sezwe. Thina sikulungele ukuba yidolobha lesimanje. Ziningi izinkampani eziza lapha.”UNtombela uthe ukukhula kwabo kuphinde kwasizwa nawukuthi banikezwe ezinye izindawo ebezingaphansi kweTheku ngesikhathi kuklanywa kabusha imingcele."Lezi izindawo eziseCato Ridge. Kunezinkampani eziningi lapho. Siphinde sanikwa iMophela. Lokhu kusho ukuthi sesizophatha amathuna. Kuzokube kungokokuqala siphatha amathuna. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi umkhandlu uyakhula.”UNtombela uthe okubuye kuvimbe abatshali bezimali eMkhambathini ukuthi abanawo amapayipi athwala amanzi angcolile."Lento iyihlazo. Sisebenzisa amathoyilethi emigodi. Abanye abatshali bezimali bafike babe manqika uma bebona lokhu. Le nto iyasibambezela. Njengobuholi asisongile izandla, siyazama ukulungisa le nkinga.”
BAPHENDUKA inkomo edla yodwa abafelokazi abasebancane ngemuva kokushona kwabayeni, okudalwa izizathu eziningi okubalwa ukuthi kuye kusolwe bona ngokushona kwabayeni, ukusaba ukuthi bangase basolwe ngokuthi sebengenwe ngabafowabo bomyeni uma beqhubeka nokusondela kubo. Laba bafelokazi abazibiza ngeYoung Widows Talk, bebehlangene eThekwini ngoMgqibelo, bedingida ngezinto ezithinta abafelokazi abashiywe amadoda besebancane, okuhlanganisa ukuthi umphakathi usuke ulindele ukuthi baziphathe kanjani, ukuthi uzikhulisa kanjani izingane usuwedwa, ukuthi usamukela kanjani isimo sakho esisha nodaba olunzima lokuthi ungaqoma nini nokuthi ngabe yinto okumele uyenze yini leyo nemiphumela yayo.UNkk Mamatu Joyisa onezinyanga eziyisithupha eshonelwe umyeni wakhe, okunguyena obehlele lesi sigcawu, uthe: "Indaba iqala nje ngokuthi abafelokazi bahlale besolwa ngokubulala amadoda. Kwabanye, leyo nkulumo iqala umyeni esagula. Uma engagulanga kuba nzima kakhulu. Kungcwatshwa nje, umakoti usuke engasabhekani nabasemzini. UNKK Mamatu Joyisa ongumsunguli weYoung Widows Talk ISITHOMBE: SITHUNYELWE BAKE bakhohlwa kancane izinkinga zabo abafelokazi bajabulela ukushutha ngaphambi kokuthi kuqale isigcawu sabo sokucobelelana ngolwazi iYoung Widows Talk, ebesiseThekwini ISITHOMBE: SITHUNYELWE Uthe kusuke kumele uqaphele indlela okhuluma ngayo nabafowabo bomyeni wakho, ungasondeli kakhulu kubo noma ngabe bewujwayele ukucela usizo kubo umyeni wakho esakhona ngoba kuzokudalela amazinyo abushelelezi kumakhosikazi abo. UNkk Baby Mkhabela owashonelwa umyeni ngo-1995 eneminyaka engaphansi kuka-30, uthi kwesinye isikhathi umfelokazi uze akhumule inzilo engakaze abe naso isikhathi sokukhala nesokuzila, exabana nabasemzini kubangwa ifa. "Lesi sigcawu sizosisiza ekutheni sikhulume ngokukhululeka ngoba sonke siyefana. Abanakwenu, abangani bakho, abazalwane basuke bekhona bekweseka kodwa iqiniso ukuthi bona basuke bengashonelwe amadoda, kukhona abasuke bengakuqondi. Kunzima ukukhuluma uvuleleke ngakho. Esigcawini esinjengalesi uma ngithi nginesizungu, ngikhuluma nomuntu owaziyo ukuthi ngikhuluma ngani. Ongeke angibuke ngeso lokuthi ngihlulwa inyama ngoba uyazi ukuthi kunjani ukuthenga ithuluzi locansi kwesinye isikhathi kungayilethi injabulo ephelele ngoba ngisuke nginesikhala sokuthi udinga ukuxoxa nomuntu okuyinto esuke ingeke isenzeka ngoba lowo muntu akasiye umyeni wakho, awukwazi ukumxoxela ngezinye izingqinamba zesimo obhekene naso," kusho uNkk Mkhabela.UNkk Phili Mfeka oneminyaka emithathu eshonelwe umyeni, uthe kuyenzeka impi nabasemzini iholele ekutheni umfelokazi ashiye konke akusebenzele nomyeni wakhe, aqale phansi athenge umuzi ukuze abe nokuthula, okuba nomthelela omubi uma enezingane.
UBUHOLI be-ANC kwisifunda iMoses Mabhida buthi ukuphikisana kwabo nesiphakamiso sokuthi isiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal sibuyele oLundi, kubanikeza ufuqufuqu lokuthi bakhankasele ukuthi i-ANC inqobe ukhetho KwaZulu-Natal.Ubuholi bakulesi sifunda esihlanganisa izindawo eziseMgungundlovu, buthe buzokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi i-ANC inqoba ngamalengiso KwaZulu-Natal ukuze uMgungundlovu uzoqhubeka nokuba yinhlokodolobha.Lokhu bakusho ngesikhathi bunesidlo sakusihlwa nabezindaba ngoLwesihlanu.Uhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal unezinhlelo zokwakha isiShayamthetho esisha esizohlanganisa namahhovisi eminyango kahulumeni, khona eMgungundlovu.Amaqembu aphikisayo, okubalwa kuwo i-IFP, NFP ne-ActionSA afuna ukuthi isiShayamthetho siphindele oLundi.Usihlalo we-ANC kwisifunda iMoses Mabhida, uMnuz Mzi Thebolla, uthe ukuthutha kwesiShayamthetho kungaphazamisa ukuhanjiswa kwezidingo."Uyacabanga isiphithiphithi esingasuka, kuthuthwa emahhovisi kuyiwa oLundi? Kungama ukuhanjiswa kwezidingo, abantu bematasa nokuthutha. Kuke kwanesikhathi lapho kwakukhona amahhovisi eminyango kahulumeni ayesoLundi nawayeseMgungundlovu. Lokhu kwakudla kakhulu imali. Asifuni ukubuyela lapho."Sizokulwela ukuthi uMgungundlovu uqhubeke nokuba inhloko dolobha. Kufanele abantu baseMgungundlovu, nabantu baKwaZulu-Natal bakulwele ukuthi uMgungundlovu uqhubeke nokuba yinhlokodolobha.”UThebolla uthe umkhankaso wabo wokhetho uhamba kahle, wathi akubathusi ukuvela kweqembu elalikhankaselwa owayengumengameli, uJacob Zuma, iMK.I-MK isijoyinwe amalungu aqavile asuka kwi-ANC, EFF ne-DA eMgungundlovu okukhona kuwo owayephini leMeya kuMasipala waseMsunduzi, uMnuz Thobani Zuma, nababengamakhansela kulo mkhandlu, uMnuz Mtuza Mkhize, Msizi Ngcobo, Sibongiseni Majola, Khumbulani Nene, noSibongiseni Majola.UThebolla uthe abantu baseMgungundlovu angeke bevume ukudukiswa uZuma."Abantu baseMgungundlovu bachayisa uSifiso Nkabinde (owasuka kwi-ANC waya kwi-UDM). Abantu baseMgungundlovu bazomchayisa uZuma nayo yonke le nto ayenzayo. Abantu akusikhona ukuthi babethanda yena siqu sakhe, kodwa babethanda i-ANC. Le nto ifana nembongolo eyayigitshelwe uJesu. Abantu babengathandi imbongolo, kodwa babethanda lomuntu owayeyigibele.”I-ANC eMoses Mabhida izokhetha ubuholi obusha ngoDisemba.Iphini likasihlalo we-ANC kulesi sifunda, uMnuz Nhlakanipho Ntombela, lithe bakwazile ukubuyisa uzinzo."IMoses Mabhida ibisidume ngokubulawa kosopolitiki neziteleka. Ngesikhathi singena sanikezwa umsebenzi wokuthi sibuyise uzinzo. Bancane kakhulu abantu ababulewe ngesikhathi kuphethe thina futhi neziteleka zibe ncane kakhulu. Uma kunozinzo kwi-ANC, omasipala esibaphethe bayakwazi ukusebenza ngendlela.”
UFUNA angayitholi ibheyili umsolwa, umndeni womfundi waKwaDumisa eMzinto okuthiwa umbulale ngasekupheleni kwenyanga edlule.Isidumbu sikaZinhle Khathi (18) obefunda u-matric eSiphapheme High satholwa egumbini ayelala kulo ngo-Ephreli 25 ugogo (78) wakhe.Kusolwa ukuthi umsolwa, onguyise wengane kamufi enonyaka nezinyanga eziyisithupha, wamshaya ngesikhali esithile maqede wadla phansi.Umamncane kamufi, uNksz Thando Khathi, uthe kubathobe amanxeba ukuboshwa komsolwa."Sijabule ngokuthi uboshiwe. Yize kungeke kusambuyisa uZinhle kodwa kuhle avalelwe ejele ngakwenzile (umsolwa),” kusho uNksz Khathi.Uqhube wathi balindele ukuthi umthetho uqhubeke usebenze, angayitholi ibheyili bese egwetshwa kanzima.Umufi ubengcwatshwa izolo.UMphathiswa wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi KwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Nonhlanhla Khoza, ukushayele ihlombe ukusebenza ngokuzikhandla kwamaphoyisa ebopha umsolwa ngokushesha.Uthe ukubulawa kukaZinhle kushiye abaningi nezinhliziyo ezibuhlungu."Umndeni wakhe ubusalindele lukhulu kuye kodwa impilo yakhe yanqanyulwa umuntu onenhliziyo embi. Sizwa kuthiwa ngayizolo, ngaphambi kokuba ambulale, wayekade emshaye ngendlela yokuthi akakwazanga nokuya esikoleni,” kusho uNkk Khoza.Uthe kuyawathoba amanxeba ukuboshwa komsolwa"Yize noma singeke sisawubuyisa mphefumulo kaZinhle kodwa kuyasijabulisa ukuthi umuntu osolwa ngokwenza isigameko esinesihluku uboshiwe. Njengoba bonke ubufakazi bukhomba yena, siyethemba ukuthi umthetho uzosebenza, athole isijeziso esimfanele,” kusho uNkk Khoza.Uphinde wanxusa umphakathi ukuthi wehlise amaphaphu, ungazijeziseli umsolwa kodwa uyeke umthetho usebenze njengoba usuqalile ngokubopha umsolwa."Kufanele siyeke amaphoyisa aqhubeke nomsebenzi wawo ngaphandle kokuphazanyiswa. Ukuboshwa komsolwa ngokushesha kusho ukuthi asebenza ngokuzikhandla ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ubulungiswa buyenzeka,” usho kanje.Uthe osonhlalakahle basazoqhubeka nokunikezela usizo lokwelulekwa ngokomqondo emndenini kamufi kanjalo nakubafundi besikole abefunda kuso.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa aseSawoti abophe owesilisa oneminyaka engu-24 ngoLwesithathu."Umsolwa onguyise wengane kamufi uyamaniswa necala lokubulala umfundi oneminyaka engu-18 owatholwa efile ngaphakathi endlini yakubo KwaDumisa ngo-Ephreli 25,” kusho uNetshiunda.Uqhube wathi kuthe sekubuya imiphumela yokuhlolwa kwesidumbu, yaveza ukuthi ufe ngenxa yokushawa kanzima, kwase kuvulwa idokodo lecala lokufa komuntu.Uthe umsolwa ubanjwe eReservoir Hills, wavela enkantolo ngoLwesihlanu
UMHLAZIYI wezepolitiki uthe ukuhlehliswa kwesigcawu sokuqondisa ubugwegwe kowayengumengameli, uJacob Zuma, kukhombisa ukuthi ubuholi be-ANC buyesaba ukuthathela uZuma izinyathelo.Umhlaziyi waseNyuvesi yaKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Zakhele Ndlovu, uthe kufanele engabe kade i-ANC yamxosha uZuma ngoba vele usekhankasela iqembu elincintisana nayo okhethweni, iMK.Lokhu ukusho emva kokuthi i-ANC iqinisekise ukuhlehliswa kwesigcawu sokuqondisa uZuma ubugwegwe."Bayazi ukuthi kunabantu abangaphakathi kwi-ANC abamthandayo uZuma futhi uZuma ulandelwa izinkumbi zabantu, ikakhulukazi abangamaZulu. Ingakho abaholi be-ANC bevele bangenwa amanzi emadolweni, bahlehlisa isigcawu.”Isigcawu sokuqondisa uZuma ubugwegwe bekufanele sibe kusasa, ekomkhulu le-ANC, iLuthuli House.I-ANC ikhombe izinsolo zokuthi kungase kube nodlame, yase ihlehlisa isigcawu. Amalungu eMK abethe azohlangana eLuthuli House, ezokweseka uZuma.UNdlovu uthe enye into eyenza ukuthi kube nzima kwi-ANC ukuba ixoshe uZuma manje ukuthi iyazi ukuthi kusangenzeka ukuthi ibuye imdinge emva kokhetho."Kunezinkomba zokuthi i-ANC angeke ilunqobe ngamalengiso ukhetho oluzayo, ikakhulukazi lapha KwaZulu-Natal. Kungenzeka ukuthi bazophinde bamdinge uZuma emva kokhetho.”UZuma ubhekene namacala amabili, elokukhankasela iqembu elincintisana ne-ANC, nokuba ilungu leqembu elincintisana ne-ANC. Wamiswa kwi-ANC emva kokuthi ememezele ukuthi uzokhankasela iMK.UNobhala Jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, usivikele isinqumo sokuhlehlisa isigcawu sokuqondisa uZuma ubugwegwe."Asifuni ukuphinde sibone le nto esayibona mhla i-DA inemashi lapha eLuthuli House. Udlame aluzange lube lukhulu ngelanga le-DA kodwa kulokhu sibona sengathi udlame beluzokuba lukhulu. Sihlehlise isigcawu ngoba nakhu singafuni ukuthi kube nodlame.”UMbalula uthe uZuma uyaqhubeka nokukhombisa ukuthi akaselona ilungu le-ANC."Akakhombisi ukuzisola, ukhombisa ukuthi uzimisele ngokushiya i-ANC.”I-MK ikugxekile ukuhlehliswa kwesigcwawu.Okhulumela iMK, uMnuz Nhlamulo Ndhlela, uthe alukaze lube khona udlame lapho amalungu eMK esuke ezokweseka khona uZuma.Uthe izinsolo zodlame ezenziwa i-ANC zisho ukuthi yiyo i-ANC enochuku."Kusho ukuthi amalungu e-ANC iwona abezovele abhozomele abantu abamsulwa. Vele amalungu e-ANC kade aqala esisongela, aze asihlasela ngesikhathi kunokhetho lokuchibiyela ebaQulusi. Le nto ikutshela ukuthi amalungu e-ANC ayimdlwembe.”UNdhlela uthe uZuma ubesewaqalile amalungiselelo okuyovela phambi kwesigcawu sokuqondiswa ubugwegwe.
UNOBHALA Jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, ukuphikile ukuthi itwetwe lokuthi bangase bephunyukwe yiKwaZulu-Natal okhethweni oluzayo yilo elenze ukuthi bathumele abaholi bakazwelonke ukuba bezokhankasa kulesi sifundazwe esibangwayo.Amalungu esigungu esiphezulu kwi-ANC aholwa uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, azokuba nemikhankaso ezindaweni ezahlukene KwaZulu-Natal njengoba ukhetho selusondele. Imikhankaso izodonsa isonto lonke.Izinkampani ezicwaningayo nabahlaziyi bezepolitiki babona i-ANC ingeke ilunqobe ukhetho KwaZulu-Natal ikakhulu njengoba iqembu elikhankaselwa owayengumengameli, uJacob Zuma, iMK, likhombisa ukudlondlobala.UMbalula uthe abanalo itwetwe lokuthi bazolahlekelwa yiKwaZulu-Natal, wathi ukuthunyelwa kwabaholi akusho ukuthi bayatatazela."Asikho engcupheni yokulahlekelwa iKwaZulu-Natal. Inkinga ngeKwaZulu-Natal ukuthi inabantu abaningi kakhulu. Ngakho ke udinga abantu abaningi ukuthi beyokhankasa khona ukuze umyalezo we-ANC uzofinyelela kubo bonke abantu."Kukhona abathi umbango ushisa phansi KwaZulu-Natal. Abanye bathi njengoba sekukhona iMK, sisengcupheni yokulahlekelwa isifundazwe. Mina engingakusho ukuthi umkhankaso wethu uhamba kahle. Amalungu e-ANC siwacelile ukuthi angavumi ukuchukuluzwa.”UMbalula uthe abaholi bakazwelonke bazokuya eGauteng uma sebeqede KwaZulu-Natal.Lezi zifundazwe izona ezinesibalo esiphezulu sabantu ababhalisele ukuvota.Abaholi be-ANC bafike KwaZulu-Natal ngeSonto, lapho bebenomhlangano okukhulume kuwo uRamaphosa.Lowo mhlangano ubuhanjelwe nangabaholi bamadlelandawonye.Ubuholi be-ANC kwisifunda iTheku buthe ukuhambela kwabaholi bakazwelonke kuzolekelela umkhankaso wokunqoba iKZN.Okhulumela i-ANC kwisifunda iTheku, uMnuz Mlondi Mkhize, unxuse abantu ukuba babe yingxenye yemikhankaso ezokuba iqhutshwa amalungu esigungu esiphezulu."Sinxusa abantu baseThekwini ukuba basebenzise leli thuba ukuyozwakalisa izinkinga zabo kubuholi bukazwelonke. Abaholi abathunyelwe lapha kukhona abaholi bakahulumeni kazwelonke, abesifundazwe nabaholi bomasipala. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abantu bazothola ithuba eliyingqayizivele lokuba bazwakalise izinkinga zabo.”UMkhize uthe uhambo lwabaholi bakazwelonke lufike kahle njengoba ukhetho seluseMome."Emikhankasweni emikhulu yokungena umuzi ngomuzi nemihlangano yomphakathi esibe nayo, abantu bawamukele kahle umyalezo we-ANC. Lokhu kwenza sibe nokuzethemba, kwenza singakungabazi ukuthi i-ANC izolunqoba ukhetho."Umkhankaso wethu wokhetho uzothola amandla ngalokhu kuhambela kwamalungu esigungu esiphezulu. Abaholi bakazwelonke bazokwamukelwa amalungu amagatsha akulungele ukukhankasela ukhetho.”
IZINSOLO ezihlasimulisa umzimba okuvela kuzo ukuthi umakoti ushayise ephindelela umyeni wakhe ngemoto waze waqhuma ikhanda, zishiye umphakathi waseHammarsdale ubambe ongezansi. Wangagcina lapho, wazinkinka ngotshwala kwafika abakubo kamufi engazazi negama ngenxa yokudakwa, sekwenze umndeni kamufi wacela amaphoyisa ukuthi ambophe.UMnuz Nhlanhla Gabela (51) obeshade noNkk Khulile Gabela, kuthiwa ushonele endaweni yesehlakalo kuleli sonto. Kunomakhelwane abaningi abathi bazibonele ngawabo kwenzeka le nsambatheka.Ilungu lokuqala lomphakathi liveze ukuthi kube nengxabano phakathi kwalaba ababili besemotweni kamufi. Ngemuva kwengxabano kuthiwa kubonakale umufi ephuma ngesankahlu emotweni samuntu ophushwayo."Sithe sisababaza lokho imoto yeza kuyena yamshayisa iphindelela. Ikhanda lopha kabuhlungu. Yaqhubeka yamgaya ikhanda kwaze kwaba uyathula khona lapho,'' lisho kanje leli lungu lomphakathi.Elinye lithe liyokuxoxela amagwababa echobana elikubone kwenzeka phambi kwalo."Angiyazi mina le nto, angikaze ngibone umuntu wesifazane ebulala indoda yakhe ngesihluku esingaka. Khona ke kuthiwa baxabane usengaze amgaye ngemoto pho,'' libuza sakumangala.Owesifazane naye othe ubekhona ngesikhathi sesigameko uthe akusuki emqondweni wakhe akubone kwenziwa kumufi.Usole owesifazane ngokuba nonya ekhala ngokuthi le nto uyenze phambi kwezingane zikamufi ebezibuza ukuthi ubulawelani uyise.Udadewabo kamufi, uNksz Amanda Magwaza uthe bafuna ukuthi amaphoyisa aphenye umakoti ngokufa komfowabo.Uthe utsheliwe ukuthi ubulawe kanjani umfowabo. Wathi ubaxoxele izinto ezingefani ngesikhathi ebalandisa ngokushona komfowabo."Esithinta okokuqala uthe umfowethu ube sengozini yemoto washayiswa kabuhlungu yiloli. Okwesibili wathi umfowethu ushayiswe yimoto engaziwa maqede yabaleka,'' usho kanje.Uthe kusobala ukuthi umakoti usenga ezimithiyo. "Ngesikhathi sifika lapho behlala khona simfice ephuzile engazazi nokuthi ungubani futhi kungabonakali nokuthi kunesigameko esibuhlungu esenzekile,'' echaza.ISolezwe Ngempelasoto lithole ukuthi umakoti kwenzeka lesi sigameko nje uvele unyamanambana kubo kamkhwenyana, usolwa ngokuhlukumeza umufi.Kuvela ukuthi umakoti ubengasebenzi, wayeka umsebenzi wokushayela amatekisi.Kodwa kuthiwa yize bebehlala ndawonye bese bephenduke inkukhu nempaka njengoba indoda bekuyicika ukuthi yiyona ephekela umkayo.Amalungu omphakathi akhala ngokuthi namanje akakaboshwa umakoti.Ethintwa umakoti uthe umatasa kukhona abantu ahlezi nabo akhuluma nabo udaba olumqoka akakwazi ukuphendula imibuzo yentatheli.Eshayelwa ucingo okwesibili walile ukuphawula ngabamsola ngokubulala umyeni wakhe. "Ngeke ngikwazi ukuphendula umbuzo wakho,'' eshaya ngezinqamulelayo.Ezinkundleni zokuxhumana beyikhulunywa kakhulu le ndaba amalungu omphakathi ekhomba umakoti ngenjumbane.Laba ababili kuthiwa banezingane ezimbili kuthiwa bese siside isikhathi beshadile.

Kusolwa ukuthi uzibulale ngokudla ushevu,” kusho isitatimende.NgoLwesihlanu, ngoMeyi 3 kuthiwa kunomunye umfundi ongumfana obenza uGrade 11 naye odle ushevu oshonele esibhedlela.NgeSonto, ngoMeyi 5 kuthiwa kunobenza uGrade 12 okusolwa ukuthi udle ushevu ekhaya washonela endleleni ebheke esibhedlela.Umnyango uthe usuthumele ongoti abazokweluleka abafundi esikoleni nezihlobo.UChiloane uthe kubuhlungu ukubona kushona abantu abasebancane.

Impilo yashintsha ekhaya ngoba sasesibheke yena. Abantu abangafuni ukuyovota benza iphutha abazosisola ngalo impilo yabo yonke," kusho uNksz Shabalala.
I-NFP inikezwe izinsuku ezimbili ukuba iqhamuke nohlelo lokukhokha isikweletu sezigidi zamaRandi yi-Ezulweni Investment, isabisa ngokuthatha izinyathelo ezingaholela ekutheni leli qembu lingakwazi ukungenela ukhetho oluzayo uma lihluleka ukuqhamuka nohlelo lokuyikhokhela kulo mnqamulajuqu ewubekile.Lezi zinsongo ziqukethwe encwadini yabameli ethunyelwe uMengameli weNFP, uMnuz Ivan Barnes.Encwadini yabameli, i-Ezulweni Investment isabisa ngokuthi izoqhubeka necala lokuthi iNFP ihlakazwe uma ihluleka ukuqhamuka nohlelo lokuyikhokhela.Ngokwamaphepha afakwe eNkantolo eNkulu eGoli, isikweletu seNFP sesikhule safika kuR25 million, njengoba yayiboleke uR13 million kwi-Ezulweni Investment ngo-2013.Le mali yasetshenziselwa ukukhankasela ukhetho lwango-2014. Kusukela lapho i-Ezulweni Investment ibilokhu izama ukuthola imali yayo.I-Ezulweni Investment ithe amakhansela eNFP azibophezela ukuthi azosikhokha isikweletu emhlanganweni owawuseThekwini ngonyaka owedlule."Nawe (Barnes) wawukhona emhlanganweni lapho amakhansela azibophezela khona ukuthi azoqhamuka nohlelo lokusikhokha sonke isikweletu. Nakuba amakhansela enza lesi sibophezelo, isikweletu asikaze sikhokhwe.”I-Ezulweni Investment ike yaba sematheni ngesikhathi ilwa ne-ANC, kubangwa isikweletu sikaR100 million.Icala lahamba laze lafika eNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo, kwawina i-Ezulweni Investment. I-ANC yagcina isikhokhile isikweletu.Abe-Ezulweni bathe bazonikela enkantolo uma bengayitholi impendulo."Sizoqhubeka necala lapho sifuna ukuthi kuhlakazwe iNFP. Nani ke niyazi ukuthi umphumela wokuhlakazwa kweNFP kuzokusho ukuthi angeke nikwazi ukungenela ukhetho oluzayo.”UBarnes ukuqinisekisile ukuthi bayitholile incwadi yabameli be-Ezulweni Investment, wathi bazophendula."Into nje esifuna ukuyibona ubufakazi balesikweletu. Sifuna ubufakazi bokuthi iNFP yazithola ngempela yini izimpahla okuthiwa iyazikweleta, nokuthi zamukelwa abantu abasemthethweni. Angeke sivele sithi sizokhokhela noma isiphi isikweletu ngenxa yokuthi kukhona abantu abasisabisa ngokuthi sizohlakazwa.”UBarnes uthe abanalo itwetwe lokuthi lesi sikweletu singase sibavimbe ukuthi bangenele ukhetho."Ukuhlakaza iqembu akusiyo nje into elula ongavuka uyenze ekuseni. Lolu kuba uhlelo oluthatha isikhathi eside. Abantu abafuna ukuvotela iNFP kufanele bazi ukuthi sizokube sikhona okhethweni.”UBarnes usole amalungu eNFP anganeme nasashiya iqembu, ngokuhambe ebhebhezela inkulumo yokuthi iqembu lizohlakazwa.
INKANTOLO eNkulu yaseThekwini izonquma ngekusasa lowesilisa othweswe amacala ayisikhombisa okukhona kuwona awokudlwengula izingane zakhe ezimbili nokubulala unina wazo.IJaji elibambile uKevin Gounden kulindeleke ukuthi lahlulele emacaleni uMbuso owathwese ummangalelwa.Bekulindeleke ukuthi uGounden asikhiphe ngesonto eledlule isinqumo kodwa wase ekuhlehlisa uMsombuluko ekhala ngokuthi akakulungeli ukwahlulela.Ummangalelwa uthweswe amacala amane okudlwengula, elokubulala, elokuzama ukubulala nelokushaya. Ugcinwe ezitokisini njengoba anqatshelwa ibheyili.Ababeyizinqandamathe kuthiwa baqala ukuhlala ndawonye eMlaza ngo-2009, bafudukela KwaNyuswa ngo-2016. Laba ababili bebenezingane ezintathu.Kuvela ukuthi phakathi konyaka u-2014 no-2016, ngesikhathi umndeni usahlala eMlaza, ummangalelwa wayejwayele ukuya kwenye yezingane zakhe eyintombazane ngesikhathi igeza.Usolwa ngokufike akhuhle umphambili wakhe esithweni sayo sangasese ayesithinta nangeminwe yakhe.Kubikwa ukuthi umufi (unina wezingane) wayesuke engekho ekhaya ngalezo zinsuku.Nangesikhathi sebehlala KwaNyuswa, kusolakala ukuthi wayesenza isikhathi sokuthi abe yedwa nengane (umgilwa) aqhubeke nemigilingwane yakhe."Baya ngokuba muncu ubudlelwano phakathi kwalezi zithandani ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, okwakudalwa indlela ummangalelwa ayesesondelene kakhulu ngayo nomgilwa. Ummangalelwa usolwa ngokuthi wayesemshaya futhi emthuka umufi,” kusho uMbuso.UMbuso, oholwa u-Advocate Thabani Buthelezi, usola ummangalelwa ukuthi ngoMeyi 10, 2022, ukuthi waqhasabula ngezimpama umgilwa emsola ngokubuya emuva kwesikhathi emsebenzini emsola ngokuthi kade esesokeni.Phakathi kwamabili ngoMeyi 11, 2022, kusolakala ukuthi ummangalelwa wayenga umufi ngokuthi ambizele ehlathini elingaphandle komuzi wabo, lapho afike amshaya khona ngokuthile amahlandla amaningi wagcina eshona."Emuva kwalokho, wabaleka endaweni yesigameko, wabizela ngaphandle enye yamadodakazi akhe waya nayo ehlathini lapho afike wayidlwengula khona. Emuva kwalokho wayishaya, wakhipha ummese wazama ukuyigwazwa kodwa wehluleka. Indodakazi yaphunyuka yase ibalekela endlini,” kuchaza uMbuso.Kuthiwa isidumbu sikamufi sacingwa satholakala ehlathini, lapho ummangalelwa wayengasabonwa nangalukhalo. Kubikwa ukuthi ummangalelwa wagcina etholakele wabe esekhalelwa amasongo kaSigonyela.
INGCABHA isisele noMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ukuthi asayine uMthethosivivinywa, iBasic Laws Amendment Bill (BELA), ube ngumthetho njengoba wesekwe izifundazwe eziyisishiyagalombili eNdlini yoMkhandlu weziFundazwe ePhalamende, ngoLwesine.Isifundazwe iWestern Cape yisona kuphela esingawesekanga uMthethosivivinywa.Usihlalo wekomiti lezeMfundo, ubuChwepheshe, ezemiDlalo, ubuCiko namaSiko, uMnuz Mamagase Elleck Nchabeleng, ubuze abebemele izifundazwe ukuthi bayaweseka noma bayawuchitha lo Mthethosivivinywa.Abebemele lezi zifundazwe basho ngamunye ukuthi bayalelwe ukuthi baweseke uMthethosivivinywa ngaphandle kowaseWestern Cape, oveze umyalelo wokuthi kumele uchithwe.UNchabeleng uthe ngenxa yokuthi ezifundazweni eziyisishiyagalolunye kuleli sinye esiwuchithile, kusho ukuthi uyasekwa ngoba zonke ezinye ziwesekile."Siyabonga ngomsebenzi owenziwe kulo Mthethosivivinywa obalulekile. Ninqume ukuthi wesekwe uMthethosivivinywa siyayazi imibono yamanye amaqembu ngawo, futhi siyayihlonipha.” Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi lo Mthethosivivinywa waphasiswa yiNational Assembly, wase udlulela kulo Mkhandlu weziFundazwe ukuze kulungiswe ezinye zezinto okwakukhalwe ngazo, ngaphambi kokuba uye kumengameli ukuze awusayine.Akuwona umthetho omusha njengoba uchibiyela umthetho wezikole ovele ukhona.Okuseqhulwini kuwona indaba yokuthi uGrade R abe yimpoqo kuleli, ukuvala unomphela ukusetshenziswa kwenduku, ukunikwa amandla inhloko yomnyango ukuthi inqume uma isikole sesigcwele nezilimi okumele zisebenze zokufunda ezikoleni.Okunye wukuthi kumele kubekwe imigomo ohlelweni lokufundela kwabafundi emakhaya.Okunye ngukuthi labo abazovimbela abafundi ukuthi baye ezikoleni kumele bagwetshwe yinkantolo.Amaqembu ahlukene okubalwa i-DA nezinhlangano zepolitiki okubalwa i-Freedom Front Plus, ziyawuchitha uMthethosivivinywa.Okukhalwa ngakho kakhulu ukuthi kumele kube abasekomitini lesikole abazonquma uma sesigcwele, izwi lokugcina kungabi elenhloko yomnyango.Lezi zinhlangano zikhala nangokuthi uhulumeni akanayo imali yokulungisa izinkinga ezibhekene nezemfundo ngakho ukuphoqa ukuthi uGrade R ube yimpoqo, kuzokwengeza omunye umthwalo.Selokhu yaqala eyokuchibiyela kwalo Mthethosivivinywa kukhulu ukuphikisana nawo njengoba ezinye izinhlangano zisabise ngokuthi zizoya nasenkantolo ngoba azihambisani nawo.Abawesekayo bona bathi liphume nobovu ngoba kukhona abazama ukuvimba ezinye izinhlanga ukuthi zifunde ezikoleni zabo ngokuthi kufundwe ngolimi oluthile nokuthi kuthiwe isikole sesigcwele ekubeni singagcwele.
ABAHOLI be-EFF babhukuliswa wucwaningo oluthi umkhankaso wabo waKwaZulu-Natal uphazanyiswa ukuvela kweqembu elikhankaselwa owayengumengameli uJacob Zuma, iMK.Umholi we-EFF, uMnuz Julius Malema uthe bazokwenza konke okusemandleni abo ukunqanda okushiwo ucwaningo lwe-Ipsos, oluthi kuzokwehla ukwesekwa kwabo KwaZulu-Natal.Ucwaningo lwe-Ipsos luxwayise ngokuthi ukwehla kwesibalo samavoti esizotholwa i-EFF, KwaZulu-Natal kuzokwehliswa isibalo samavoti esizotholwa yi-MK kuzwelonke.Ukuvela kweMK kushintshe izinto KwaZulu-Natal. Ucwaningo lwe-Ipsos luthole ukuthi kunamalungu e-EFF asehamba neMK.NgoFebhuwari ucwaningo lwe-Ipsos lwalukade luthe i-EFF izothola u-19%, kodwa olwakamuva luthi izothola u-11.5%.Ucwaningo luthi iMK yona izothola u-8%. Lokhu kwenziwe kwenziwe kubantu abangaphezulu kuka-2 500 abahanjelwe emakhaya abo.I-Ipsos ithe yenze ucwaningo phakathi kuka-Mashi no-Ephreli, kuzo zonke izifundazwe zakuleli.Isifundazwe iKwaZulu-Natal singesesibili ngokwesibalo sabantu ababhalisele ukuvota ekupheleni kwenyanga esiwu-20% siqhamuka kusona.UMalema uthe bazokuba senkingeni enkulu uma bengase bangenzi kahle KwaZulu-Natal.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba emva komcimbi we-EFF wokubungaza usuku lwabasebenzi, obuseGauteng."Ucwaningo lwe-Ipsos lukhombisa ukuthi siyakhula kuzo zonke izifundazwe. Ucwaningo luthi sizothwala kanzima KwaZulu-Natal."Ukungenzi kahle KwaZulu-Natal kungaholela ekutheni ukukhula kwethu kwezinye izindawo kugcine kungasasisizi ngalutho,” kusho uMalema.I-EFF ibilokhu ikhombisa ukukhula KwaZulu-Natal ezinkethweni ezedlule.Okhethweni lwango-2019, i-EFF yathola izihlalo eziyisishagalombili esiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal, isuka kwezimbili okhethweni lwango-2014.UMalema uthe bazokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi bayaqhubeka nokukhula kulesifundazwe esibangwayo.I-EFF isanda kujuba uNobhala Jikelele wayo, uMnuz Marshall Dlamini ukuzokhanaksa KwaZulu-Natal."Ngicabanga ukuthi nibonile ukuthi ikuphi esikwenzile KwaZulu-Natal. UDlamini uzohlala khona kuze kudlule ukhetho. Sinethemba lokuthi sizokwazi ukwenza kahle KwaZulu-Natal,” esho.UMalema uvumile ukuthi akuzukuba lula ukukhankasa KwaZulu-Natal."Thina siyinhlangano entsha. Kusukela emandulo, zimbili izinhlangano ezinamandla KwaZulu-Natal, i-ANC ne-IFP. ”Angeke kube lula ukuthi inhlangano entsha ivele ingene nje kalula KwaZulu-Natal. Kuyangijabulisa ukuthi thina sikhombisa ukukhula KwaZulu-Natal yize siyinhlangano entsha,” esonga.
