Kuthiwa ubegobe amadlangala emzini thizeni ongasahlali muntu, eduze kwemizi yomntakabani.Kuthiwa laba abanemizi kule ndawo basolile ukuthi kukhona okushaya amanzi ngomuntu ohleli nosana emzini ongahlali muntu bawuhlaba bawulawula.Unina wosana olwebiwe uthe lo mzanyana wamthola ngesihlobo sakhe esasihlala naye emqashweni. Uthe ngendlela umzanyana abezwana ngayo nengane bamangele uma esekhala emuka nayo.Ngesikhathi eboshwa ngoLwesine umzanyana, kuthiwa uvele njengomuntu ongathi uyadideka emqondweni ethi usana luwumzukulu wakhe.Kulindeleke ukuthi umzanyana avele enkantolo ngoMsombuluko lapho okuzocaca khona ngendaba yekheli.
KUSAZOBA nzima kubathandi bakashokoledi njengoba intengo yawo ilokhu ikhuphuke njalo kusukela ekuqaleni konyaka.Ongoti bezomnotho bathi kulindeleke ukuthi ushokoledi ulokhu ukhuphuka ngenxa yokuthi amazwe akhiqiza u-cocoa ase-Afrika awakwazanga ukukhiqiza u-cocoa oyisibalo esijwayelekile ngenxa yokushintshashintsha kwesimo sezulu.Ngokolwazi olubhalwe kweminye imithombo yezindaba, ushokoledi ongu-80g, ngoFebhruwari ububiza uR22.48 manje usukhuphuke ngo-4.3%. Ngenyanga ezayo kulindeleke ukuthi uphinde wenyuke ngo-17% okuzokwenza ukuthi ushokoledi omncane, i-chocolate bar ibize uR14 kuya phezulu.Ngokolwazi olukhona, kube nomoya omkhulu eWest Afrika odale umonakalo emasimini ka-cocoa okuholele ukuthi u-cocoa ozovunwa ube ngomncane kakhulu oseke wavunwa eminyakeni engu-14 eyedlule.Ngenxa yalokhu, inkampani enkulukazi yaseNingizimu Afrika ekhiqiza ushokoledi, iMondelēz South Africa, engabakhiqizi bakashokoledi iCadbury, ithe ihlela ukusebenzisa ukwenyuswa kwamanani ukuze ibhekane nokushoda kuka-cocoa ongase kube nomthelela omubi enzunzweni engeniswa ile nkampani.Isikhulu esiphezulu enkampanini ekhiqiza ushokoledi, iHershey-EO uMichele Buck, uthe: "Uma kubhekwa amanani ka-cocoa sizosebenzisa wonke amathuluzi ebhokisini lethu lamathuluzi, okuhlanganisa namanani, ukuze singalahlekelwa".Abakhiqizi be-Lindt & Sprungli bathe bazama ukubhekana nezindleko ezikhuphukayo zika-cocoa ngesu lokuthenga ngendlela ezobavumela ukuthi babe no-cocoa omningi kunojwayelekile."Izindleko ezisele zidluliselwe ngokunyuka kwentengo, nentengo ephezulu ka-cocoa kuyisizathu esikhulu salokho," kusho okhulumela lo Mnyango.Lokhu kwenyuka kuka-cocoa kuthinta ababhaki bamakhekhe nezinye izidlo ezenziwa ngo-cocoa.
UNDUNANKULU waKwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Nomusa Dube-Ncube, unengwa wukwanda kwezigameko zokudlwengulwa kwezalukazi ezindaweni ezingaphansi kukaMasipala waseMshwathi. UNkk Dube-Ncube udalule lokhu ngoLwesihlanu ngesikhathi kunembizo yokulwa nobugebengu ezinkundleni zemidlalo eNdlebezembuzi, kwaSwayimani.UNdunankulu uthe baze badlulela esiteshini samaphoyisa esisebenzela indawo ukuyokhuluma namaphoyisa ngale nkinga. Unxuse umphakathi ukuba ubambisane namaphoyisa ekulweni nesihlava.Ngo-2012 ucwaningo olwenziwa wuMnyango wokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi eKZN, lwaveza ukuthi indawo yakwaSwayimane, ihamba phambili ngezigameko zokudliwa kwezidakamizwa, utshwala nokudlwengulwa kwezalukazi. Unkosikazi walowo owayenguMengameli wezwe, uNkk Thobeka Madiba-Zuma, ehambisana nosonhlalakahle baze bathula umkhankaso wokulwa nokuhlukunyezwa kwabantu abadala emuva kokudlwengulwa kwezalukazi ezineminyaka ewu-84 nesino-94. Ngo-2015 owayenguNgqongqoshe woMnyango wokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi kuzwelonke, uNkk Bathabile Dlamini, wethula ikhaya labantu abadala esigodini saseGujini.UNkk Dube-Ncube ubuye wanikela ngezindlu ebantwini abebehlala emapulazini futhi wathembisa ukutakula imindeni eyasala dengwane emuva kokuhlasela kwezikhukhula kule ndawo.Undunankulu unxuse osomabhizinisi abasafufusa ukuba bayeke ukurentisa ngezitolo zabo ebantwini bangaphandle, kunalokho abaxhumane nehhovisi lakhe ukuze bathole uxhaso. Ugqugquzela abafundi abaneziqu ukuba bazifukule ngolwazi ukuze bakwazi ukuqasheka ngoba kungenzeka ukuthi iziqu aziwalungele amathuba emisebenzi ekhona.Imeya yaseMshwathi uMnuz Mandla Zondi, ikhale ngokwanda kwezigameko zokubulawa kosomatekisi KwaSwayimani. Uthe esikhathini esifushane kule ndawo sekubulawe osomatekisi ababalelwa kwabangu-15. Wathi basezinhlelweni zokuvuselela isiteshi samaphoyisa esingumahambanendlwana esikule ndawo. Eqhuba echaza uZondi, uthe isiteshi sasivalwe ngenxa yokungabikhona kukagesi namanzi. IMeya yoMkhandlu waseMgungundlovu ithembise ukusukumela inkinga yamanzi nekagesi. Uhlelo lomcimbi beluphethwe nguNgqongqoshe wezoLimo eKZN, uMnuz Super Zuma.
I-ANC ithi usomabhizinisi uMnuz uTokyo Sexwale uphakathi kwezingwevu ezilandiwe ukuze zilekelele emkhankasweni wayo. I-ANC imatasa nomkhankaso wokhetho ngenhloso yokubuyela emandleni iphathe izwe.Izwe limatasa lilungiselela ukhetho lukazwelonke oluzoba ngoMeyi 29 nonyaka kanti lubhekwe ngabomvu.USihlalo we-ANC eGauteng, uMnuz Panyaza Lesufi, uthe balande uSexwale ngoba ungomunye wabaholi abamethembayo ukuthi angaba nesandla emkhankasweni.USexwale ubewumholi oqavile kwi-ANC kanti yake yamjuba esikhundleni sokuba wundunankulu waseGauteng.ULesufi uthe umkhankaso wabo uhlelwe kahle futhi uzoba nezigaba ezehlukene ezizobe ziphethwe abaholi bayo abehlukene abahlonishwayo.I-ANC ilanda uSexwale nje, kusanda kubonakala owayengumengameli uThabo Mbeki eyikhankasela emuva kwesikhathi eside.Kuthe kusabukwa uMbeki, kwavela ukuthi noMnuz Kgalema Motlanthe uzoba yingxenye yomkhankaso we-ANC. USexwale kulindeleke ukuthi abonakale ezingxenyeni eziseGauteng lapho ezobe enxenxa khona abavoti ukuthi babuyisele uKhongolose.ULesufi uthe abantu abaningi bazomangala uma sekuphuma imiphumela yokhetho. I-ANC izithola ingaphansi kwengcindezi yamaqembu aphikisayo ayimise kabi, kubalwa neqembu iMK Party eholwa owayengumengameli uJacob Zuma.
UNGQONGQOSHE wamaPhoyisa kuleli, uMnuz Bheki Cele uthi ukwakhiwa kwesiteshi samaphoyisa eManguzi, kuzolekelela ekulweni nokweqiswa kwezimoto umngceleni okudla lubi.UCele uvule ngokusemthethweni isiteshi samaphoyisa esakhiwe kabusha sanwetshwa saba ngcono kunakuqala. Kuvulwa isiteshi nje, isifunda uMkhanyakude, sixakwe wubugebengu bokushushumbiswa kwezimoto emngceleni.Kunezigebengu ezeba izimoto kuleli bese ziziwelisa ziye emazweni angomakhelwane anjengeMozambique. Kusolakala ukuthi kuneqeqebana elibamba inkunzi lithathe izimoto ezinkulu zidayiswe eMozambique.Kugcine kutshalwa ithimba elikhethekile ukuthi liyozinza kule ndawo libhekane nalobu bugebengu.UCele kuleli sonto ubenomkhankaso wokuvula iziteshi zamaphoyisa ezintsha esifundazweni.Ungqongqoshe uvule ngokusemthethweni isiteshi samaphoyisa kwaDabhazi, KwaNongoma. Uphinde wavula isiteshi samaphoyisa eMelmoth, kulo leli sonto elifanayo, esinye eGamalakhe, ePort Shepstone. NeDonybroook ayisalanga ngaphandle. Ukuvulwa kweziteshi kuchazwe njengomzamo wokubhekana nenkinga yobugebengu edla lubi ezweni.Ngaphandle kokuvulwa kweziteshi, uCele uke wazinza esifundazweni KwaZulu-Natal, ehamba ngohlelo lwezimbizo zokulwa nobugebengu ezindaweni ezehlukene.Ubugebengu budla lubi KwaZulu- Natal, kanti amaphoyisa ayavutha abathela othulini abasolwa okuthiwa basuke bewadubula uma eyobabopha.
NKOSIKHONA CELEUMBHISHOBHI uthi uzimisele ngokuthi kube khona akwenzayo ngenhloso yokwehlisa isibalo sabantu abangasebenzi eNingizimu Afrika yonkana.UMbhishobhi Graham Sabela weBandla, iThe Church of Jesus Christ of Latter Day Saints uthi ufuna inkampani yakhe iG Force Employment Solutions iklame indima enkulu ekuqedeni ukwesweleka kwamathuba omsebenzi.USabela usho lokhu ngemuva kokuba le nkampani iqashe abantu abangu-100 muva nje.Uthi lonke udumo uluyisa kuNkulunkulu ngoba konke kwenzeka kahle uma uNkulunkulu ekhona."Ngiyambonga kakhulu uNkulunkulu uma kukhona abantu abazokwazi ukondla imindeni yabo manje. Lokhu kusho lukhulu kimina,'' usho kanje.Uthi ufuna ukuthi uNkulunkulu amsebenzise ekulweni nokugqoza kwamathuba omsebenzi ezweni lonke.Uqhubeke ngokuthi kuyajabulisa ukuthi abantu abathole amathuba omsebenzi kubona bevela ezifundazweni ezahlukene zaseNingizimu Afrika.Uveze ukuthi ugxile kakhulu kubantu abasha abaneziqu ezahlukene. Uthi kuye kuba buhlungu kakhulu ukubona abantu abasha beswele imisebenzi ekubeni beneziqu abazithola enyuvesi."Sifuna ukulekelela kakhulu labo bantu abasha abaneziqu abazithole ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme,'' usho kanje.Le nkampani uveze ukuthi isungulwe ngo-2018 kodwa yaze yaqala ukusebenza kahle ngonyaka olandelayo u-2019.Ukhulume nangohlelo abanalo lokulekelela abantu abasha ngezincwadi zokushayela.Uthe ukholwa wukuthi miningi iminyango evulekayo kumuntu omusha osuke esethole izincwadi zokushayela.Uphethe ngokuthi yingakho bethathe isinqumo sokuthi kube khona abakwenzayo kokulekelela intsha ngezincwadi zokushayela.
UMSHUSHISI ecaleni lokufa komrepha u-AKA, u-Advocate Lawrence Gcaba uthe ummangalelwa wesine uMnuz Muziwethemba Gwabeni, ugweve neselula efunwa amaphoyisa.UGcaba usho lokhu ngesikhathi kuqhubeka isicelo sebheyili sabamangalelwa abahlanu eNkantolo yeMantshi eThekwini ngoLwesihlanu. Zisongiwe izethulo zesicelo sebheyili, sekulindwe isinqumo.UKiernan Forbes "AKA”, wadutshulwa wabulawa nomngani wakhe uTebello "Tibz” Motsoane eThekwini nyakenye. U-AKA nomngani wakhe bathelekelwa amadoda abavithiza ngenhlamvu baphelela khona lapho.Amaphoyisa akhomba abalisa abayisikhombisa ukuthi yibona ababemlandela okwenyamazane u-AKA bamjuqa bahlukaniselana imali. Abamangalelwa ababili babhajwe eSwatini lapho ababoshelwa khona kanti kusenziwa imizamo yokubabuyisa.UMbuso waveza uGwabeni njengongqondongqondo kuleli cala okuthiwa wakhokhela abamangalelwa sebeqedile ukubulala umrepha.UMbuso uyasiphikisa isicelo sebheyili sabamangalelwa ufuna bahlale ejele kuze kuphothulwe icala. UGcaba ukhulume indaba yeselula ezama ukuveza ukuthi uGwabeni angaluphazamisa uphenyo uma engathola ibheyili."Kwacelwa abameli bakhe ukuthi basize kulethwe iselula le amaphoyisa angayitholanga efika emzini wakhe. Ummangalelwa uthi iselula yebiwa amaphoyisa futhi icala liphenywa yi-IPID kodwa ohlwini lwezinto ezibhaliwe ezebiwa ayibalwanga iselula,’’ kusho uGcaba.Uqhubekile uGcaba wathi bafaka isicelo sokuthola amarekhodi ayo le selula bathola okushaqisayo."Sathola ukuthi iselula iyasebenza namanje futhi idonsa embhoshongweni edonsa kuwona uma ummangalelwa esemzini wakhe. Umbuzo uthi iphi iselula? Akukhona yini ukuphazamisa uphenyo lokho, ” kubuza uGcaba.IMantshi uMnuz Vincent Hlatshwayo ibuzisisile ngodaba lweselula, uGcaba wagcizelela yashona phansi ngepeni yabhala okuthile ebhukwini layo.UMbuso kuleli cala ubukeka ugabe kakhulu ngobufakazi bezobuchwepheshe bamaselula obuninda abamangalelwa ngokuthi babekuphi, nemali abafakelana yona.Ngaphandle kodaba lweselula, okunye okuvelile wudaba lwabamangalelwa abaseSwatini. Ummeli wabamangalelwa u-Advocate Cyril Mlotshwa ukhale ngokuthi udaba lokubuyiswa kwabo lungase lubambezele."Udaba lokuthi kulindwe abamangalelwa abaseSwatini luthinta amalungelo abamangalelwa okuthi icala labo liqulwe ngokushesha liphothulwe. Isicelo sokubuyisa abantu kwelinye izwe siwumdanti odlula ezandleni zabantu abaningi,’’ kusho uMlotshwa.Kulindeleke ukuthi inkantolo ikhiphe isinqumo sebheyili yabamangalelwa ngoMeyi 15.
AMAQEMBU aphikisayo akhala ngokuthi ukunyuswa kwemali kagesi namanzi wuMasipala waseThekwini kuzoshaya kuzwele kulabo abakhokhela lezi zidingo.Amaqembu aphikisayo athe ukunyuswa kakhulu kwale mali kuzokwenza ukuthi babe baningi abantu abazohluleka ukukhokhela lezi zidingo zomkhandlu.Lokhu bakusho emva kokwethulwa kwesabelomali somkhandlu, esithulwe iMeya uMxolisi Kaunda, ngoLwesihlanu.Ugesi uzonyuka ngo-12.7%, amanzi wona azokwenyuka ngo-12.9%.UKaunda uthe ngokomthetho kwakukade kuhlongozwe ukuthi ugesi unyuke ngo-14%, amanzi wona kwakuhlongozwe ukuthi anyuke ngo-14.9%."Njengohulumeni olalelayo, sinqume ukunciphisa imali kagesi namanzi emva kokuthola izikhalazo zomphakathi. Imali okuzonyuka ngayo ugesi isiyefana nalena i-Eskom eyikhuphule ngayo. Imali esinyusa ngayo amanzi yona siyinciphise ngo-2%.”Amaqembu aphikisayo athe inkulu kakhulu le mali okukhushulwe ngayo.Ikhansela leDA, uMnuz Thabani Mthethwa, uthe bekufanele inganyuswa imali yokukhokhelwa kwezidingo."Into eyinkinga kakhulu ukuthi umasipala uyehluleka ukuhambisa izidingo. Wonke umuntu ohlala eThekwini uyazi ukuthi umasipala uyehluleka ukuhambisa izidingo. Akuwenzi umqondo ukuthi thina sihlale lana sikhulume indaba yokukhuphula imali yezidingo ekubeni umasipala wehluleka ukuhambisa izidingo.”Ikhansela le-ActionSA, uMnuz Zwakele Mncwango, uthe kubukeka sengathi umasipala ujezisa kakhulu labo abakhokhela izidingo."Abantu abakhokhela izidingo ibona abazoshayeka kakhulu. Lemali okuzonyuswa ngayo imali yezidingo inkulu kakhulu. Lento izokwenza ukuthi kuvalwe amabhizinisi, nokuzokwenza ukuthi abantu abaningi balahlekelwe imisebenzi. Okuyolandela lapho ukuthi abantu abaningi bangabi nayo imali yokukhokhela izidingo.”Amakhansela e-ANC, EFF namanye amaqembu amancane avota ne-ANC, akuvikele ukunyuswa kwemali yezidingo.La makhansela athe umasipala kufanele uqoqe imali ukuze uzokwazi ukuqhubeka nokuhambisa izidingo.Isabelomali somkhandlu singu-R67 billion.Imali eningi yabelwe ukulungisa ingqalasizinda yamanzi nekagesi.Imali ebekelwe ukulungisa ingqalasizinda kagesi uR21.5 billion, eyamanzi yona uR11.6 billion.UKaunda uthe lesabelomali sibhekelele kakhulu abahlwempu."Njengoba kuphela iminyaka engu-30 sathola inkululeko, sifuna ukushintsha izimpilo zabantu. Omasipala ibona abahambisa izidingo eziningi kubantu.”
OMELE i-IFP kwesikaNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli uthi ukungenisa kwe-IFP ezindaweni ebikade ingemandla kuzona, kumnikeza ithemba lokuthi bazokwazi ukudla umhlanganiso KwaZulu-Natal okhethweni lwangoMeyi 29.UNtuli uthe kusukela eqale umkhankaso wakhe, i-IFP ikhombisa ukukhula ezindaweni ezisesifundeni Ugu naseHarry Gwala.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi enengxoxo ekhethekile ne-Isolezwe.Yize i-IFP iphethe iningi lomasipala baKwaZulu-Natal, ayikho imikhandlu ephethwe yilenhlangano oGwini naseHarry Gwala.UNtuli uthe abantu basoGwini naseHarry Gwala bakhombise ukuyamukela i-IFP."Abantu abafike emicimbini yethu bakhombise ukuseseka. Ukufika kwabantu akusho lutho, okubalulekile ukuthi bakweseke."Ngakho-ke sibona umkhankaso wethu uhamba kahle. Alikho iqembu elinomkhankaso ofana nowethu. Muva nje besinemikhankaso ezindaweni eziyisithupha ezahlukene ngempelasonto eyodwa,”kusho uNtuli.Uthe baningi abantu abanezikhundla ezihlonishwayo emiphakathini abajoyina i-IFP. Basanda kujoyinwa ikhansela le-EFF eKokstad, nomholi wegatsha le-ANC eMkhanyakude.Udalule ukuthi sekukhona abazama ukuvimba umkhankaso wakhe."Kunezindawo lapho esivinjwayo kuzo uma sithi siyokhankasa. EKokstad banqaba ukusinikeza indawo naseMzimkhulu futhi banqaba.”Uthe bafuna ukuhlonipha umsunguli we-IFP, Inkosi Mangosuthu Buthelezi ngokuthi banqobe ukhetho oluzayo.UNtuli wethule umqulu wakhe wezethembiso oLundi, lapho kwatshalwa khona uButhelezi."Indawo yasoLundi ifana nomsamu kuthina ngoba kulapho kulele khona uMntwana. ULundi luyinhliziyo kithi, sakha ngisho iPhalamende laphana."Likhona nanamhlanje leloPhalamende. Saya oLundi ngoba nakhu sihlonipha uShenge. Sasiyokusho ukuthi Shenge, sizokube sivotela wena. Sasiyocela amandla edlozini,” kuqhuba uMphemba.I-IFP yayikade iphethe iKwaZulu-Natal kwaze kwaba u-2004.UNtuli uthe impilo yayingcono kakhulu KwaZulu-Natal ngesikhathi kusaphethe i-IFP, bafuna ukubuyisela isifundazwe kulento esasiyona ngaphambi kokuthi bakhishwe emandleni."Uma ubuka ubugebengu nokungasebenzi kwabantu kwakungengaka ngesikhathi kuphethe thina. Isimo sezikole njengamanje sibi kakhulu. Sakha amagumbi okufundela angaphezu kuka-6 000. Uhulumeni okhona njengamanje usuvale izikole ezingaphezu kuka-800."Yonke lento sasiyenza ngesabelomali esincane. Abantu babephuma ezikoleni behlome ngamakhono, bakwazi ukuziphilisa. Abantu babephuma esikoleni benethemba lokuthi bazothola imisebenzi,” esho.UNtuli uthe uma benqoba ukhetho bazobuyisela amandla omnotho ebantwini bakulesifundazwe.Abantu bangaphandle abakuleli ngokungemthetho uthe yibona abadala njengoba sekugcwele bona yonke indawo.Ufakazise lokhu ngokuthi uma uya lapho kugundwa khona, ezitolo ezisemalokishini, ufika kugcwele bona. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abantu balapha abasenawo amathuba emisebenzi.Akambuluzanga ngabazokwenza uma bengena njengoba bezoshaya umthetho wokuthi uma ufuna ukuba nebhizinisi, kufanele ube nemvume.Uthe bazokuba nomkhankaso wokubheka bonke labo abakuleli ngokungemthetho. Bazothatha wonke amabhizinisi amancane bawabuyisele kubantu bakuleli. Abantu bakuleli uthe bazobaqeqesha, baphinde babaxhase ngabakudingayo. Uthe liqiniso limile, ukuthi abantu abaningi babulawa yindlala nje ngenxa yokuthi amandla omnotho aphethwe abantu abakuleli ngokungemthetho.Okunye abazokwenza uma bethatha, bazohlinzeka amakhosi ngabaqaphi."Lokhu asifuni ukukungabaza, amakhosi abambe iqhaza elikhulu emiphakathini. Umsebenzi omkhulu wawo wukuxazulula imibango." Uma kunomsindo ongadala impi yezigodi, amakhosi yiwona axazululayo. Yingakho sizolungisa izinkantolo zamakhosi, siwakhele nezindlu ngoba akukuhle ukuthi ahlale emizini engekho esimweni,” kuphetha uGodide.
BUKHATHAZEKILE ubuholi bamaphoyisa kaMasipala weTheku ngezigameko ezinesihluku ezenziwa ngamaphoyisa awo.Lokhu kuvezwe ngokhulumela amaphoyisa kaMasipala weTheku ngoLwesibili, uMnuz Boysie Zungu.UZungu uthe ayikho into ebakhathaza njengokuthi balahlekelwe ngamaphoyisa omkhandlu wabo ngendlela enesihluku.Ubekhuluma ngezigameko ezimbili ezenzeke esikhathini ezingaphansi kwenyanga kusuka ekupheleni kwaMashi.Esigamekweni sakamumva, esenzeke phakathi nenyanga, uConstable Mlu Ndaba (45) udubule wabulala inkosikazi yakhe, wazingqokloza naye.Isigameko esashiya abaningi bemangele, kwazise kuthiwa bebeyizithandani ezizithulelayo, senzeke emzini wabo oseLovu.Ngaphambi kwalesi sigameko, uConstable Sizwe Ngema (27), usolwa ngokubhokoda ngommese intombi yakhe nayo eyiphoyisa uConstable Bianca Khuzwayo washona.Isigameko senzeke eflethini likaNgema elisenkabeni yeTheku ngoMashi 31.Kusolwa ukuthi emva kokumgwaza ephindelela uNgema, uConst Khuzwayo, waqopha iv-ideo esephuma umphefumulo wayinameka ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, waphinde wayithumela nakubantu abasondelene nomufi.UNgema uhamba inkantolo ngaleli cala.UZungu udalule ukuthi emuva kwalezi zigameko bavumelene ngokuthi basungule izinhlelo ezehlukene ezizolekelela amalungu abo."Phakathi kwazo kukhona uhlelo lokubizwa kwesithangami samaphoyisa angamadoda lapho kuzobizwa khona ongcweti abehlukene ukuzoweluleka,” kusho uZungu.Uthe kongcweti kuzoba khona odokotela, odokotela bengqondo nabeluleki bezezimali.Uveze ukuthi ngeke kugcine lapho kodwa kuzophinde kube khona nabaholi bezenkolo nabelaphi bendabuko."Nabo bazonikwa ithuba lokuthi bakhulume namaphoyisa ethu esilisa. Siphinde sibe sezinhlelweni zokusungula indawo lapho ababhekene nokhwantalala nezimo ezinzima zempilo abazothola khona usizo,” usho kanje.Uveze ukuthi belukhona uhlelo lwe-KWAYS lapho zonke izisebenzi zikamasipala zithola khona usizo lokwelulekwa ngokomqondo uma kwenzeka ziludinga.Uthe abakwazi ukuba nesiqiniseko sokuthi yini engaba yimbangela yokuthi amaphoyisa abe nesihluku, wathi kungaba odokotela bengqondo abangakwazi ukusho ukuthi umsuka wodlame kumuntu obulala ngesihluku usukaphi ngoba baqeqeshelwe lokho.Walile ukuphawula ukuthi zikhona yini izinyathelo asebenzithathele uNgema, wathi lokho kuphakathi kwakhe nomqashi, ngeke bakuxoxe nabezindaba. Okhulumela inyunyana yabasebenzi iSouth African Municipal Workers Union kulo masipala, uMnuz Xolani Dube, uthe babuye babe nawo umcabango wokuthi izigameko zalolu hlobo zidalwa ukuthi amaphoyisa abuye ahambele izindawo zezigameko ezihlasimulisa umzimba kubalwa izingozi zomgwaqo.Wathi benze isiphakamiso sokuthi ibuyekezwe indaba yokuthi amaphoyisa afakwe mdibi munye nabanye kwi-KWAYS."Ngendlela esibona ngayo, amaphoyisa kufanele abe nolwawo wodwa uhlelo lokwelulekwa ngokomqondo, angaxutshaniswa nowonkewonke ngoba okwawo kuhlukile,” kusho uDube.
UJABULILE, wathi ubulungiswa uyabuthola kancane unina wowesifazane obekade eyinkosikazi yesosha odutshulwe washona ngoJanuwari 3, nonyaka, umsolwa enqatshelwa ibheyili.INkantolo yeMantshi yasePinetown incishe ibheyili uMnuz Lwanda Zungu, osolwa ngokubulala inkosikazi yakhe uNkk, Tania Msane-Zungu (36).UZungu unqatshelwe ibheyili yimantshi Gwendolyn Robinson ethe azikho izizathu ezinqala futhi ezingejwayelekile azibekile esicelweni sakhe sebheyili.Icala libe selihlehliselwa uJuni 18, nonyaka, ukuze uMbuso uphothule uphenyo lwawo.UNkk Gwena Msane, unina kaNkk Msane-Zungu (36), uthe: "Yize sijabulile kodwa ukwesaba ebekade sinakho akuphelile ngoba noma ngabe yini ayicabangayo (uZungu) ngeke ayenze ngezandla zakhe, uzothumela. Besingafuni ukuthi ayithole ibheyili.” Uchaze ngesimo sabantwana bababafana balaba ababeganene, wathi bayamkhumbula unina wabo ngoba iminyaka yonke bebekade bephila naye.Uqhube wathi laba bafana abakaze baphile noyise obekade esebenza kude ezintabeni embuthweni wezempi waseNingizimu Afrika."Bayamdinga umuntu ozoba nabo, bakhungathekile kakhulu, angifuni ukuqamba amanga kubi nje. Oyedwa esikoleni uyazama omunye akakhoni ukulandelela okwenzakalayo,” kuchaza uNkk Msane.Imantshi ithe ngokubona kwayo, uZungu ubekade efuna ibheyili ukuze anakekele abantwana bakhe, aqhube imfundo yakhe futhi ubekhombisa ukukhathazeka ngesimo somqondo sentombazane yakhe.Iqhube yathi uZungu wabuzwa uMbuso ngeqhaza alibamba ekwenzekeni kwesigameko kodwa akusho wathi konke kuyohlaluka uma sekuqulwa icala."Okwami akukhona ukwahluleka ukuthi unecala noma cha kodwa ukubheka izizathu ezinqala nezehlukile esicelweni sakhe sebheyili. UZungu waphika isidana ukuthi wambulala umkakhe. Inkantolo bekumele ikuqhathanise akushilo nokushiwo uMbuso,” kusho imantshi.Imantshi ithe vele uZungu akasasebenzi futhi abukho ubufakazi abethulele inkantolo uma ethi uzoqala ibhizinisi.Ithe isizathu esikhulu soMbuso, sokuthi uZungu anqatshelwe ibheyili, kumayelana nokuphepha kofakazi nokuthi uyabasabisa.Enkantolo bekukhona amalungu ayo yomibili imindeni eganiselene engasabhekani.Lokhu kuyaye kugqame nangokuhlala kwawo ngokwehlukana emabhentshini asenkantolo.UZungu ubebukeka ezikhululekele njengenjwayelo futhi akakhombisanga kujabha encishwa ibheyili.
UMHLAZIYI wezepolitiki waseNyuvesi yaKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Siyabonga Ntombela, uthe kubalulekile ukuthi i-ANC ishushise uMnuz Jacob Zuma ngaphambi kokhetho.Uphawule kanje emuva kokuthi i-ANC ibizele owayengumengameli, uJacob Zuma, osekhankasela iMK, esigcawini sokuqondisa ubugwegwe.Ngokwamaphepha okumbiza kulesi sigcawu, uZuma uzoqondiswa ubugwegwe ngoLwesibili ekomkhulu le-ANC, iLuthuli House.UZuma ubhekene namacala amabili okuphula imigomo ye-ANC.Icala lokuqala elokugqugquzela abantu ukuthi bavotele iqembu elizokube lincintisana ne-ANC okhethweni.Ngonyaka owedlule, uZuma wagqugquzela abantu ukuthi bakhiphe i-ANC emandleni, wabacela ukuthi bavotele iMK.Icala lesibili elokuba yilungu leqembu elincintisana ne-ANC.UZuma uvela ohlwini lwamalungu eMK aphakanyiselwe ePhalamende."I-ANC kufanele iye okhethweni yazi ukuthi uZuma umi ngakuphi. Uma uya empini udinga ukuya namasosha owethembayo. I-ANC ibingeke ithi izoyeka ukushushisa uZuma ngenxa yokuthi sekusondele ukhetho. Abakwazi ukumisa izinhlelo zabo ngenxa yokuthi kuza ukhetho," kusho uNtombela.Uthe kubalulekile ukuthi i-ANC izwe uhlangothi lukaZuma."Angicabangi ukuthi lento ayenzayo uyenziswa ukuthi ufuna ukubuyela ePhalamende. Ngisola sengathi emva kokhetho uzophakamisa omunye umuntu ukuthi ayohola iMK ePhalamende. Kufanele bezwe ukuthi ngempela yini lena ayifunayo."UNtombela uthe amalungu eMK azosebenzisa lesi sigcawu ukuqhuba umkhankaso wabo"Bazokuthi uZuma uyacindezelwa. Bazokuthi ukhishwa ezinkantolo, manje useyashushiswa. Bazoveza uZuma njengomuntu osukelwayo."Okhulumela iMK, uMnuz Nhlamulo Ndhlela, uthe bazomphelezela uZuma uma eseyovela phambi kwesigcawu sokuqondisa ubugwegwe."Sizophuma ngobuningi bethu. I-ANC asiyethembi nakancane. Kunabaholi be-ANC abasongela uZuma, emva kwalokho wavelelwa ingozi yemoto. "UNdhlela uthe umthethosisekelo uyamvumela uZuma ukuthi abe yilungu le-ANC aphinde akhankasele iMK.Okhulumela i-ANC, uNkk Mahlengi Bhengu-Motsiri, uthe isinqumo sokubizela uZuma esigcawini sokuqondisa ubugwegwe sikhombisa ukuthi i-ANC izimisele ukubhekana nabaphula umthetho.UNkk Bhengu-Motsiri uthe uZuma uzothola ithuba lokuziphendulela.UZuma uxwayiswe ngokuthi isigcawu sokuqondisa ubugwegwe sizoqhubeka noma engekho.
ZIMKHALELE owesifazane owumzanyana osolwa ngokweba usana olunezinyanga eziyisikhombisa, abelugada washaya wachitha nalo nezimpahla zalo konke nesitifiketi salo sokuzalwa.Umthombo olwazi kahle udaba, uthe umzanyana uqoqe izingubo samuntu oyowasha kanti usehamba nosana ngaphandle kwemvume yomndeni.Usana lwebiwe ngoLwesibili lwatholakala ngoLwesine, oThongathi, kwaboshwa umzanyana ngecala lokuthumba.Unina wosana ubememezele kuFacebook enameke nezithombe ecela ukufuniswa lo wesifazane owebe usana.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi ilungu lomndeni ebelikhona libone kuthe nya, laqalaza laze lakhathala kanti useshaye wachitha nosana umzanyana.UNksz Zibuyile Gumede uthe umhlolo awugilwe wumzanyana, impela uyowukhohlwa efile.Uthe lo mzanyana wayemthole ngesihlobo sakhe ababehlala naso emqashweni wasemcela ukuthi amgadele ingane.Uqhubeke wathi umzanyana washeshe wafika ukuze abone kahle ekhaya, ajwayele ngaphambi kokuqala ngokusemthethweni emsebenzini."Bebezwana kahle kakhulu nengane yami konke kuhamba kahle."Usisi wami kodwa uke wangitshela ukuthi lo muntu ogada ingane wamxoxela ukuthi ufunwa ngesibhamu wumyeni abeshade naye, badivosa."Kwaba yinto ekhathazayo kumuntu ogada ingane uma kuzwakala esho kanjalo,’’ kusho uNksz Gumede.Uthe njengoba kade enyamalele nosana nje ubengenayo ngisho iselula futhi abazi okutheni ngaye, wazi ukuthi owaseNtaphuka, eNdwedwe.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uConstable Thenjiswa Ngcobo, uthe amaphoyisa abophe owesifazane ngalolu daba. "Amaphoyisa aseMhlali abophe owesifazane ngecala lokweba usana, uboshelwe oThongathi."Idokodo ladluliselwa emaphoyiseni aKwaDukuza abhekene namacala odlame lwemindeni, ukuvikelwa kwezingane nawocansi. Umsolwa uzovela enkantolo maduze,’’ kusho uConstable Ngcobo.Umthombo obukhona kutholwa ingane kumzanyana, uthe batholwe emzini thizeni ongahlali muntu oThongathi. Ngesikhathi kufika amaphoyisa kuthiwa umzanyana uzenze umuntu ophanjanelwa yikhanda ekhuluma izinto ezingahlangani."Uvele wathi wumzukulu wakhe le ngane futhi ubaleke nayo ngoba bebehlela ukumbulalala yena nayo. Le ndawo ahleli kuyona wumuzi nje ongahlali muntu. ”Ubanjwe ngokuthi acele ukubeka amanzi komakhelwane, base beyasola,’’ kusho umthombo.Unina wengane ubonge kakhulu kubo bonke abalekelele ekutheni kutholwe usana lwakhe, wathi basaphikelele esibhedlela ukuze luxilongwe ukuthi luphile kahle yini.
UMASIPALA wasoLundi usukulungele ukuthi leli dolobha libuye libe inhloko dolobha yaKwaZulu-Natal.Lokhu kushiwo iMeya kaMasispala wasoLundi uMnuz Wilson Ntshangase ngesikhathi kunesidlo sasekuseni nosomabhizinisi bendawo, amakhosi nabatshali zimali abafisa ukuzozitshala ebesihlelwe uMasipala wesiFunda iZululand, ngoLwesibili.IMeya yaseZululand uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi onethemba lokuthi uhulumeni ozongena uzolwa nabazenza osomabhizinisi abadla imisebenzi ngenkani esifundazweni Isithombe: Sithunyelwe UNtshangase uthe ukulethwa kwezidingo kuleli dolobha kusesimweni esiyiso, ezepolitiki zizinzile kanti nezitolo ezinkulu ebezike zahamba kuleli, sezibuyile."Sasivele sikulungele ukuba inhloko dolobha nangesikhathi uhulumeni uthutha isishayamthetho ngo-2004."Edolobheni nasemalokishini imigwaqo yethu isesimweni esihle, akukho nowodwa onezimbobo,” kusho uNtshangase.IMeya kaMasipala iZululand, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, uthe ingqalasizinda ezindazweni zasemakhaya ayikho esimweni.Umasipala wakhe uyazama ngemali encane osuke uyitholile ukulungisa ingqalasizinda njengoba besanda kwakha inkundla yezemidlalo, eziHlabeni, oLundi. Uthe inkinga ekhona ukuthi ugesi uyahlupha ngoba ubuye ucishe ngenhloso yokuwonga kodwa banalo uhlelo lokuyilungisa le nkinga ngoba kunenkampani ezokhiqiza ugesi welanga khona oLundi. "Ngo-2004 ngesikhathi uhulumeni uthutha oLundi kwakunenkolelo yokuthi izitolo ezinkulu zizohamba. "Ezinye zazo zahamba kodwa manje sezibuyile ngoba ziyakholelwa ekutheni umnotho waleli dolobha uyakhula,” kusho uButhelezi.Uthe unethemba lokuthi uhulumeni omusha ozongena ngemuva kokhetho uzoqinisa imithetho, kuphele laba bantu abazenza osomabhizinisi abayiziqhwaga abadla imisebenzi ngenkani esifundazweni. USihlalo weMikhandlu yoMasipala, uSouth African Local Government Association (SALGA), obuye abe iMeya yaseKing Cetshwayo, uMnuz Thami Ntuli uthe uhulumeni wasekhaya, unethuba lokulungisa isimo ukuze sihehe abatshalizimali abazokhuphula umnotho.
OWAYENGUMENGAMELI wezwe uMnuz Jacob Zuma, neqembu Umkhonto Wesizwe (MK) bafake isicelo eNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo. Bacela ukuthi amajaji ayekhona ngesikhathi kuthathwa isinqumo sokuthi aboshwe ngokwedelela umyalelo wenkantolo, ashenxe uma sekulalelwa isicelo senhlangano yokhetho i-IEC ngesonto elizayo. UZuma wagwetshwa izinyanga ezingu-15 waboshelwa ejele lase-Estcourt ngo-2021.I-IEC, yanquma ukuthi uZuma akafanelwe wukungena ohlwini lwasePhalamende ngoba walahlwa ngecala, wagwetshwa. UMkhonto weSizwe walufaka enkantolo udaba wanqoba kodwa i-IEC yalwedlulisa ithi ayinelisekile ngesinqumo.INkantolo yoMthethosisekelo kulindeleke ukuthi ilalele isicelo se-IEC ngoMeyi 10.I-SABC ibike ukuthi uZuma emaphepheni uthe ukuze inkantolo ihlale, kumele kuba nokungenani namajaji ayisishiyagalombili. UTHOLWE eshonile esitokisini, esiteshini samaphoyisa eBhekithemba, eMlaza obesolwa ngokubulala ngesihluku unina wengane yakhe enezinyanga eziyisikhombisa, oboshwe ngesonto eledlule okukholakala ukuthi uzilengisile.Isidumbu sikaMnuz Sboniso Chamane (27) waseMlaza Kwa-H, sitholwe ngoMgqibelo emva kosuku zimkhalele, ubefunwa amaphoyisa ngecala lokubulala uNksz Simangele Dlamini (23) obeyisinqandamathe sakhe okuthiwa bese simala, esigamekweni esenzeke emasontweni amabili edlule.UMNUZ Sboniso ChamaneKwi- akhawunti ku-Facebook okukholakala ukuthi eyakhe enegama lika-Sboniso Sbo, bese enamathelise umbhalo esola abamgxeka ngokubulala umufi ngokuthanda ukungena izinto ekubeni bengazi ukuthi kuqalephi, esonga ngokuzibulala.Kubhalwe kanje:"Ingane besihlala nayo sithandana kamnandi inkinga besihlushwa umndeni wakhe uthanda ukungena izindaba zethu. Bamfide wafideka naye, bengimthanda futhi namanje ngisamthanda ukuthi nje kwenzeka ngendlela engingayiqondi ngiyazisola manje. Ngizozibulala maduze nami ngimlandele bese ninameka kule nkundla, lindani-ke nizozwa khona nizojabula.” kubhalwe kanje Ngokusho komthombo weSolezwe, umsolwa uboshwe ebhace ekhabonina KwaMaphumulo.Unina kaSimangele, uNksz Duduzile Dlamini elandisa, uthe umsolwa nomgilwa bebehlala ndawonye kubo kamsolwa, okuthe uma indodakazi yakhe inquma ukubuyela ekhaya, isoka layo lagana unwabu."Ungifake ezindlekweni engingazi ukuthi ngiyophuma kanjani kuzona. Ngengane yami iyinhle kanje. Kuyimanje isesemakhazeni kufanele ngabe ingcwatshwe ngesonto eledlule, kodwa aginayo nemali yokungcwaba Ngethembele emalini efakwa esosweni ukuqongelela izindleko. Okungizwisa ubuhlungu kakhulu yingane ayishiyile ngoba ibisancela kunina, ngizoyithathaphi kwamali yobisi?” ebalisa.Uthe umsolwa ubengaqali ukushaya indodakazi yakhe njengoba phambilini ike yangeniswa egunjini labagula kakhulu esibhedlela ilimele emva kokushaywa wuyena kanzima, kodwa kwathiwa imindeni ayixoxe okwagcina kungenzekanga. Uthe usola ukuthi umsolwa ubeyidlisile indodakazi yakhe ngoba beyingezwa mshini ngaye okuthe uma eyibuyisela ekhaya eyiphalazisa kwasa inkungu yamala, ibulawa nje bese kuphele amasonto amathathu yabuyela ekhaya,Ikhansela lendawo uMnuz Mhlengi Shinga oveze ukuthi uyihambele yomibili imindeni eyobhonga emswanini, ukhale ngokwanda kwezigameko zokubulawa kwabesifazane bebulwa yizinqandamathe zabo. "Okunye esibona ukuthi kuyimbangela yalezi zigameko, ukusetshenziswa kakhulu kotshwala. Lesi sigameko silamana eduze nesinye esifanayo esenzeke khona endaweni okutholakale ukuthi owesilisa wayephuze utshwala bezandla ngesikhathi enza isigameko. Sifisa uNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa uMnuz Bheki Cele aqinise umkhankaso wokuvalwa kwezindawo ezidayisa utshwala ngokungekho emthethweni,” kusho uShinga.Imizamo yokuthola inombolo yelungu lomndeni kaChamane ayiphumelelanga kwaze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela. Okhuluma amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa aseBhekithemba avule idokodo lophenyo, emva lokuthi umsolwa obeboshelwe icala lokubulala etholwe eshonile esitokisini. Uthe imbangela yokufa kwakhe ayikaziwa okwamanje.

UMENGAMELI we-ANC Youth League (ANCYL), uMnuz Collen Malatji uthi into eyenza i-ANC ithwale kanzima esifundazweni iKwaZulu-Natal wukuthi abantu bakhona bavota ngokobuhlanga.UMalatji uthe ukuvota kwabantu baKwaZulu-Natal ngokobuhlanga kwenza ukuthi i-ANC yenze kahle kulesifundazwe ngesikhathi isaholwa owayenguMengameli, uJacob Zuma ongowaKwaZulu-Natal.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma kwisithangami nabezindaba.Uthe wumkhuba omdala lona wokuvota ngokobuhlanga KwaZulu-Natal."Lomkhuba wawuvele ukhona nangaphambi kokhetho lwango-1994. Uma ubuka indlela abavota ngayo abantu baKwaZulu-Natal, uzokuqaphela ukuthi kwenyuka ukwesekwa kwe-ANC ngesikhathi iholwa ilona waseNkandla, kwase kuyehla ngesikhathi sekuphethe uMengameli uRamaphosa (Cyril). Lena indlela abantu baKwaZulu-Natal abavota ngayo.”"Ingcabha isele kubaholi ukuba bafundise abantu baKwaZulu-Natal ngepolitiki."Kufanele batshelwe ukuthi lapha asakhi amaqoqo ezinhlanga ezithile, kodwa sakha izwe. Sifuna izwe elihlanganisa bonke abantu,” kusho uMalatji.Ngonyaka owedlule i-ANC yajuba abaholi bayo abaqavile baKwaZulu-Natal, okukhona kubo uDkt Zweli Mkhize, Dkt Nkosazana Dlamini Zuma, oMnuz Sihle Zikalala, Senzo Mchunu noMike Mabuyakhulu ukuba bazoqinisa umkhankaso wokhetho.UMalatji uthe banethemba lokuthi bazokwazi ukunqoba iKwaZulu-Natal."Sisanda kujuba izingwevu eziqhamuka KwaZulu-Natal ukuba ziyokhankasa. Umkhankaso wethu uhamba kahle kakhulu, kufanele sisebenze kanzima kule ndawo. "Silahlekelwe inqwaba yomasipala KwaZulu-Natal ngesikhathi kunokhetho lohulumeni basekhaya olwedlule. "Nathi kufanele sizinuke amakhwapha ngokulahlekelwa eminye yalemikhandlu. Abanye abantu esabajuba kulemikhandlu babelele emisebenzini, babengazihambisi izidingo kubantu."Abantu ngeke baqhubeke nokuvotela abantu abangabasizi ngalutho. I-ANC kufanele ijube abantu abazimisele ngokwenza umsebenzi,” esho.Uthe bazoqhubeka nokulwela abantu abasha kanti ukunqumela kwabo ongqongqoshe abahlukene ugwayi katiki, sekuqalile ukwenza umehluko.Ubalule kakhulu uNgqongqoshe wezabaSebenzi, uMnuz Thulasi Nxesi noweMfundo ePhakeme, uDkt Blade Nzimande.Uthe selokhu banqumela uNxesi ugwayi katiki, umnyango usuqalile ukudala amathuba emisebenzi.Uveze nokuthi kusizile nokuhlangabezana kukaNzimande nezimfuno zabo zokuhlakazwa kwebhodi lesikhwama esixhasa abafundi ngemali ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme, iNsfas.Uphethe ngokuthi kuyabajabulisa nokuthi sekuyophela inyanga ugesi ungacishwa.
BAGCIZELELE izizathu ezehlukene zokuthi kungani kufanele badedelwe ngebheyili abasolwa ecaleni lokubulawa komculi uKiernan 'AKA’ Forbes nomngani wakhe uTebello 'Tibz’ Mosoane.Abasolwa abahlanu, oMnuz Lindokuhle Thabani Mkhwanazi, Lindani Zenzele Ndimande, Siyanda Eddie Myeza, Mziwethemba Harvey Gwabeni noLindokuhle "Lindo” Ndimande bebevele ngoLwesinne eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini.Abameli babo bebenza izethulo zokugcina njengoba kuqhubeka ukulalelwa kwesicelo sebheyili.Ummeli womsolwa wesibili, uNdimande, u-Adv Walmaras, uthe akufanele ukuthi kubekwe isizathu sokuthi umsolwa angeqa aye kwelinye izwe, bube bungekho ubufakazi obusekela lokho."Ibheyili akufanele inqatshwe ngoba nakhu amaphoyisa athi kunobungozi. Iphoxekile iCosatu kuphunza imizamo yokuhlenga imisebenzi engu-4 889 yabasebenzi beSouth African Post Office (Sapo), abadiliziwe emuva kokuthi isicelo soxhaso lwe-Temporary Employment Relief Scheme (TERS) singaphumelelanga.Ababhekelele ukuhlenga iposi bebefake isicelo kwi-UIF ukuthi ikhokhele abasebenzi amaholo izinyanga eziwu-12 ngesikhathi beseza nezinhlelo zokuletha uzinzo eposini. Lesi sicelo besibhekwa ngaphansi kweCCMA okuyiyona ebhekelele izinhlelo zokudilizwa kwabasebenzi.Kuleli sonto kuvele izindaba zokuthi isicelo asiphumelelanga ngoba ababhekelele ukuhlenga iposi abanazo izinhlelo ezicacile zokungenisa imali nokugcina abasebenzi beqashiwe.ICommission for Conciliation, Mediation and Arbitration (CCMA) iye yasichitha lesi sicelo ikhala ngokuthi ngeke imise ukudilizwa kwabasebenzi ngoba izinhlelo bezithi basazodilizwa emuva kwezinyanga eziwu-12 kade beholelwa yiTERS.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi ngesonto eledlule Isolezwe belibike ukuthi kuzohoxiswa izinyanga eziwu-12 ukudilizwa kwabasebenzi njengoba bekufakwe isicelo seTERS, kodwa manje ababhekelele ukuhlenga iposi bathe bazodilizwa abasebenzi.UMnuz Anoosh Rooplal obhekelele izinhlelo zokuhlengwa kweposi, uthe baphatheke kabi ngokungaphumeleli kwesicelo sabo."Ngesikhathi sifaka isicelo sasho ukuthi ukudilizwa kuzomiswa isikhashana njengoba sasifake isicelo seTERS."Njengoba singaphumelelanga abasebenzi abawu-4 889 bazodilizwa. Sizamile ukuhlenga imisebenzi kodwa asiphumelelanga."Siyazi lesi sinqumo sizoba nomthelela omubi kubasebenzi abathintekayo nemindeni yabo, siyaxolisa ngalokhu,” kusho uRooplal.Izindaba zokudilizwa kwabasebenzi baseposini ziqale ukuvuthwa ngonyaka odlule ngesikhathi ababhekelele izinhlelo zokulihlenga bethi ukunciphisa abasebenzi kuzolisiza ukonga imali.UMnuz Matthew Parks ongumkhulumeli weCosatu osabambile, uthe sibaphoxile isinqumo seCCMA sokuchitha isicelo seTERS."Asikwazi ukulahlekelwa yimisebenzi njengamanje. Sizokhuluma noNgqongqoshe wezemiSebenzi nowezokuXhumana ngalolu daba,” kusho uParks.Iposi linezikweletu ezingaphezu kuka-R3 billion okubalwa nemali yokurentela amaposi ahlukene.Amaningi asevaliwe kanti imiphakathi yasemakhaya iyakhala ngokuvalwa kwamaposi. Emakhaya abantu basasebenzisa amaposi ukuhola izibonelelo, ukulondoloza imali, ukulanda imishanguzo nezinye izinsiza.
SEBENGAPHEZU kwesigidi abantu ababhalisele ukuvota okuyisipesheli, okhethweni lwezifundazwe nolukazwelonke ngoMeyi 29.Laba babhalisele ukusheshe bavote ngoMeyi 27 noMeyi 28 2024, ngoba bazobe besebenza ngosuku lokhetho.Abanye bazovakashelwa emakhaya yizisebenzi zeKhomishini yezoKhetho, ngoba begula noma bekhulelwe.IKhomishini ihlabe ikhwelo kwabasafisa ukubhalisela ukuvota ngokuyisipesheli ukuthi basenalo ithuba njengoba kuvalwa namhlanje.Abazofaka izicelo emahhovisi ekhomishini banethuba kuze kube u-5 ntambama, labo abazosebenzisa ubuchwepheshe bazokwazi ukubhalisa kuze kube u-12 ebusuku."Ikhomishini ifuna ukukucacisa ukuthi akuyi ngeminyaka ukuze ukwazi ukubhalisela ukuvota ngokuyisipesheli. Noma ngubani angafaka isicelo sokuthi avote ngokuyisipesheli,” kusho ikhomishini.Iveze ukuthi bangu-396 531 abazovotiswa emakhaya ngalezi zinsuku kanti abangu-686 458 bazovota ezikhungweni. Isifundazwe i-Eastern Cape yisona esinesibalo esiphezulu sabazovotiswa njengoba bengu-105 631, kulandele iKwaZulu-Natal ngabangu-65 600. Siphinde sathatha isinqumo sokuthuthukisa osomabhizinisi abancane ngokubanika ama-Voucher okuthi bakwazi ukuqhubeka namabhizinisi abo,” usho kanje.Kosomabhizinisi abancane uMasipala ukhiphe iVoucher ka-R300 umuntu emunye, kwahlomula osomabhizinisi abangu-1 500. ISilo uMisuzulu kaZwelithini sizothumela abakhongi ukuba bayosicelela ubuhlobo obuhle ebukhosini bakwaMyeni, eJozini.Ithimba labakhongi beSilo lizokuya komemeza kwaMyeni, ngeSonto.ISilo sizothatha imbali yakwaMyeni, uNomzamo Myeni, ukuba ibe undlunkulu.Izindaba zokuthunyelwa kwabakhongi zimenyezelwe undunankulu kaZulu, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, emhlanganweni obusesigodlweni kwaKhangelamankengane ngoLwesibili ntambama.Kulo mhlangano bekukhona amakhosi nabantwana baseNdlunkulu nabanye osopolitiki naso iSilo.ISilo sicele indlunkulu ukuba isiphelezele uma abakhongi seboyosicelela ubuhlobo obuhle."Nina beSilo iNgonyama ithi anginazise ukuthi isithole imbali ngapha ebukhosini bakwaMyeni. Ngakho ibithi anginicele baNtwana ukuba niyiphelezele iyolobola le mbali esiyitholile yakwaMyeni,” kusho uButhelezi. Ithimba labakhongi beSilo kulindeleke ukuthi liholwe abantwana basendlunkulu abadala, kulindeleke namabutho.Ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, akukho okutheni okubhalwe uNksz Myeni emakhasini akhe.Amakhasi kaNksz Myeni amathathu akwiFacebook agcwele izithombe ezindala, esokugcina esango-2021.Uzichaza njengomsebenzi wasebhange, aphinde aveze ukuthi wafunda eMfolozi Tvet College.Umthombo wasendlunkulu uthe sekuneminyaka iSilo sithandana noNksz Myeni."Ngiqale ukwazi ngothando lwabo cishe esikhathini esiyiminyaka emibili eyedlule uma ngingaphosisi. Into yabo ibifihliwe, ababaningi endlunkulu abebazi ngayo.”Umthombo uthe iSilo siqale ukuthandana noNksz Myeni ngesikhathi esasebenzela elinye lamabhange egatsheni eliseJozini."Ugcine esesebenza ehhovisi leSilo, angazi kahle ukuthi ubenzani.”ISilo sinondlunkulu ababili, uNtokozo Mayisela noNozizwe Mulela waseSwatini.ISilo nondlunkulu uMayisela babhala ngo-2021, emva kokutshalwa kwendlovukazi ezala iSilo, uShiyiwe Mantfombi Dlamini Zulu.Ngawo u-2021 iSilo sabe sesithumela abakhongi kwaMayisela, eNewcastle.Kuthiwa iSilo salobola ngezinkomo zoboya eziyisishiyagalombili no-R50 000. Sabe sesihambisa umembeso ngo-2022.Yize iSilo nondlunkulu uMayisela babhala ngo-2021, kwase kuneminyaka bethandana.Bahlangana ngo-2009, emshadweni kaMntwana uBukhosibemvelo, ongudadewabo weSilo. Banabantwana ababili, uLwandle noMandulo.Ngo-2022 iMbube yalobola undlunkulu uMulela.Kuthiwa iSilo nondlunkulu uMulela basuka kude, njengoba kuthiwa baqala ukuthandana ngesikhathi iSilo sisafunda eSwatini.Ngonyaka owedlule kuvele imibiko yokuthi iSilo nondlunkulu uMulela abasaboni ngaso linye.Ngesikhathi kunalamahlebezi, iSilo sasimeqa undlunkulu uMulela uma sibingelela abahambele imicimbi yasendlunkulu.Mumva nje undlunkulu uMulela akasabonakali emcimbini yasendlunkulu.

BABHEKENE nengwadla abanye othisha abafundisa uGrade R KwaZulu-Natal, abathe ngqu emabhange bafica itshe lome inhlama, imali ingabonwa.Labo thisha bekumele bahole ngoLwesibili kodwa bafike imali ingekho kuma-akhawunti abo.UMengameli weNatu uMnuz Sibusiso Malinga, ugxeke umnyango wathi awubacabangeli labo thisha.Uthe bathathwa kancane ngoba beyingcosana ngoba ngeke laba abanye kuthiwe abakhokhelwe."Amanyala lawa enziwa ngumnyango ngoba labo thisha babalulekile ngoba yibona abafundisa isisekelo semfundo. "Banezikweletu okumele bazikhokhe, kuvele kuyaziwa ukuthi njalo ngenyanga kumele bahole ngakho kuyaxaka uma bengasaholi,”kusho uMalinga.Uthe umnyango uhlela ukuthi uGrade R ube yimpoqo kodwa izinsiza azikho.Uqhubeke ngokuthi baqalelani ngokufanele bagcine ngakho, kumele ngabe kunazo zonke izinsiza ngaphambi kokuba kuthiwe uGrade R uyimpoqo. Bazokhokha ngani uma usuyimpoqo? ebuza. "Ngaphambi kokuba ube yimpoqo zonke izidingo zakhona okubalwa nokuholela othisha kumele zibekhona,” kusho uMalinga.UDkt Imran Keeka okhulumela i-DA kwezemfundo esiShayamthetho, ukhale ngokuthi umnyango ufuna ukwenza uGrade R ube yimpoqo ekubeni imali ingekho.Ekhuluma ngesikhathi kudingidwa eyoMthethosivivinywa wezikole iBasic Laws Amendment Bill esiShayamthetho, uthe akazi kwamali ukuthi izovelaphi njengoba uGrade R befuna ube yimpoqo ekubeni umnyango wesifundazwe uhlale unezinkinga zesabelomali. Umnyango wezemfundo esifundazweni uthembise ukuthi bazokhokhelwa kusasa abangaholanga.Esitatimendeni somnyango, uveze ukuthi labo thisha baqashwa isikhathi esiwunyaka, okuyinto eyenzeka ngisho ezingeni likazwelonke."Izinkontileka zabo zivuselelwa njalo ngonyaka, uma kuqala unyaka wezimali ngo-Ephreli. Nakulo nyaka kwenzeke okufanayo, kwalungiswa neyamaholo abo ango-Ephreli 30, 2024."Iningi labo bakhokhelwe ekupheleni kwenyanga edlule, kodwa abanye bangakhokhelwa."Imbangela yokungaholelwa kwabanye kube wukulethwa kwezinto ezingaphelele, okwenzeke ngesikhathi befakwa ohlelweni lokukhokhelwa kwi-Persal, ngo-Ephreli 15, 2024."Imali yabo isifakiwe, bazoyithola ngoMeyi 3, 2024, umnyangon uzokhokha kabili ngohlelo lwePersal,” kusho isitatimende.Lesi sitatimende siveze ukuthi umnyango ukwazi ukukhokha kabili ngenyanga ngohlelo lwe-Persal.Umnyango uxolisile kulabo abangayitholanga imali kodwa wathi nakanjani bazoyithola kusasa.

BAMISIWE abasebenzi bakaMasipala waseNewcastle, okuthiwa batholwa bedla amambawu bukhoma emini kwabha ngesikhathi somsebenzi, baze bashuthwa ngabantu.UMasipala waseNewcastle usezandleni ze-IFP, eyawephuca i-ANC emuva kokhetho lohulumeni basekhaya ngo-2021.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi abasebenzi bakamasipala abahlanu bebenomkhuba wokuhlala epaki thizeni bashaye ezibandayo kubuka amalungu omphakathi. Kuthiwa bakwenza lokhu befake ngisho izimpahla ezibakhombayo ukuthi basebenzela umkhandlu, kodwa bengazi nanyaka.Leli phephandaba linaso isithombe esiveza laba bebeke okubonakala njengobhiya phambi kwabo.Babonakala bezipholele kukhona abesilisa nabesifazane behleli etafuleni ngokukhulu ukukhululeka.Kuthiwa kunomuntu thizeni owashutha laba ekhuza umhlolo wokuthi abasebenzi bomkhandlu badla utshwala ngesikhathi somsebenzi.Isithombe sihambe saze safika ezikhulwini zomkhandlu nazo ezikhuze zababaza.Lesi sithombe besisabalele nasezinkundleni zokuxhumana, kukhuzwa umhlolo wabasebenzi abangenandaba.IMenenja kaMasipala uMnuz Zamani Mcineka, ikuqinisekisile lokhu yathi kunophenyo oluqhubekayo kodwa ayivumelekile ukwanda kakhulu okwamanje."Sibacele ukuthi balinde ngasekhaya ngoba sisaqhuba uphenyo olunzulu, emuva kwalokho bazovela esithangamini esifanele."Angikwazi ukukhuluma ngalolu daba okwamanje ngoba lusaphenywa, kufanele silusingathe ngobulungiswa,’’ kusho uMcineka.Ngaphandle kokuphawula kwemenenja, bekukhishwe isitatimende ngalolu daba umasipala ukhala ngalesi senzo.Umasipala uveza ukuthi lesi senzo sijivaza igama lawo futhi siwufaka ehlazweni kubantu abawakhele.Uthe uma kukhona abanolwazi oluthe thuthu ngalezi zigameko bangesabi ukuwulekelela ngemininingwane ukuze kuthathwe izinyathelo ezifanele.Kwesinye isigameko phambilini Isolezwe labika ngabasebenzi bakaMasipala uMsunduzi, eMgungundlovu abatholwa becambalele emathuneni ngesikhathi somsebenzi.Labo basebenzi bathathelwa izinyathelo bagcina besayine izexwayiso, bangaxoshwa.
INHLANGANO yezokusakaza kuleli, iSouth African Broadcasting Corporation (SABC), ithi ayinabo ubufakazi bokuthi iHhovisi likaMengameli liphuma iqhubu nenhloko yezindaba kuyo, uMnuz Moshoeshoe Monare, ukuthi liyohlolwa.Lokhu kuza ngemuva kwemibiko yeCity Press yokuthi uMonare kumele ayohlolwa yiState Security Agency (SSA). Kulolu hlelo kusukwe kubhekisiswa yonke imininingwane ethinta umuntu nokuthi uhulumeni engamthemba yini ngemininingwane ebucayi.Izinhlangano ezifana neSouth African National Editors’ Forum (Sanef), Media Monitoring Africa, SOS Support Public Broadcastiong Coalistion (SOS), neCampaign For Freedom of Expression (CEF) zikhiphe isitatimende kanye kanye zikugxeka ukuhlolwa kukaMonare.Okhumela uMengameli uCyril Ramaphosa, uMnuz Vincent Magwenya, ukuchithile ukuthi kuphunywa iqhubu noMonare ngoba sekubhekwe okhethweni lukazwelonke ngoMeyi 29.I-SABC esitatimendeni ngoLwesibili emini, ithe zonke izikhulu zayo ziyahlolwa. Ithe ngesikhathi uMonare eqashwa ngo-2022, iSABC yenze isicelo eSSA ukuthi ahlolwe.Lokhu kuwumbandela wokuqashwa futhi zonke izikhulu zithola isitifiketi uma sezihloliwe."Ukucacisa, yinto ejwayelekile eSABC ukuthi izikhulu zihlolwe, akukho okubi okuhlosiwe ngalokho. Isikhulu esisha uNomsa Chabeli, naso siyahlolwa njengokombandela wenkontileka yaso. I-SABC ayihlangani nokuhlelwa ukuthi ukuhlolwa kuzokwenziwa nini.”Ithe uMonare akaluphothulanga uhlelo lokuhlolwa njengokusho kwenkontileka yakhe futhi wavuma ukuthi uzohlolwa ngesikhathi esayina inkontileka yakhe.
KUSHESHE kwamshela owesilisa ohlangane namaphoyisa esolwa ngokubulala usomatekisi ePitoli.NgoLwesibili ebusuku, kuhlaselwe usihlalo kasoseshini wamatekisi ahamba ngebanga enkabeni yedolobha iTshwane. Kubikwa ukuthi umsolwa uvulele ngenhlamvu ebhekise kumgilwa wamshiya edindilizele ngaphambi kokubaleka ngezinyawo."Amaphoyisa ophiko oluqapha ubugebengu ezitimeleni ezwe kuqhuma isibhamu anikela ngalapho, abona owesilisa ebaleka ephethe isibhamu,” kusho amaphoyisa ngesitatimende.Amaphoyisa azamile ukummisa lo mlisa kodwa wadubula ebhekise ngakuwo, nawo aphindisela ngenhlamvu. "Umsolwa udubulekile emlenzeni nokuyinto emenze waphelelwa amandla wokubaleka waboshwa khona lapho.”Uphenyo lokuqala luveze ukuthi lo mlisa ungowaseNanda, KwaZulu-Natal. Ugaxwe ozankosi wabekwa icala lokubulala nokuphatha isibhamu esingekho emthethweni. Uhanjiswe esibhedlela. Kulindeleke ukuthi avele eNkantolo yeMantshi ePitoli, uma ededelwa.Amaphoyisa athi uphenyo luyaqhubeka ukuze kucace ukuthi awekho amanye amacala umsolwa anawo athinta imboni yamatekisi.
LUZOGUJWA ngokukhankasela ukuthi i-ANC idle umhlanganiso okhethweni lukazwelonke lwangenyanga ezayo, usuku lwabasebenzi.Lolu suku olugujwa ezweni lonke kuleli, irali enkulu yomfelandawonye wezinyunyana zabasebenzi iCosatu uzobe useKapa.Kulo mgubho osenkundleni yemidlalo i-Athlone Stadium, eKapa, kulindeleke ukuthi kukhulume kuyona umengameli walo mfelandawonye uNksz Zingiswa Losi, uMengameli we-ANC nezwe uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa noNobhala Jikelele weSACP uMnuz Solly Mapaila.KwaZulu-Natal umugubho walolu suku weCosatu uzoba senkundleni yemidlalo iCurrie’s Fountain eThekwini.Kuzokhuluma kuwona uNobhala -Jikelele weCosatu uMnuz Solly Phetoe nePhini lokuqala likaNobhala wamaKhomanisi uMnuz Madala Masuku.ICosatu ayihlonizi ngokuthi yeseka i-ANC ukuthi ibuyele emandleni njengoba kuzovotwa ngoMeyi 29. UNksz Losi uhlale ekugqugquzela ukuthi kuvotelwe i-ANC nakuba zikhona izinselelo ezweni.Lo mfelandawonye uzivezile izizathu ezenza ukuthi weseke i-ANC okhethweni.Uveze ukuthi izinto zijikile kuleli njengoba kuboshwa ngisho umuntu owayenguMengameli weZwe uJacob Zuma nobenguSomlomo wePhalamende uNkk Nosiviwe Mapisa-Nqakula.ICosatu ibale izinto eziningi ezenziwe yile nhlangano selokhu yathatha izintambo zombuso ngo-1994.Ezinye zazo imfundo yamahhala, izingane ezihola isibonelelo, isibonelelo sabangasebenzi, amalungelo abasebenzi athinta ukuteleka nokuba ngamalungu ezinyunyana, izinkundla zokuxoxa ngamaholo abasebenzi nezinye."Sesiyakwazi manje ukuthi uma umuntu egula ahlabe ikhefu lokugula. Uma eyobeletha akhokhelwe imali yakhe noma elimele."Kunezinguquko ezithinta imali yezimpesheni abasebenzi abazokwazi ukuthola ingxenye yayo besaphila, okungezinye zezinto ezenziwe nguMbuso we-ANC,” kusho iCosatu.Ithe ziningi izinselelo ezisekhona ezweni kodwa igqugquzela abantu bakuleli nabasebenzi ukuthi bavotele i-ANC. UKhongolose ubhekene nomqansa kulolu khetho njengoba emaningi amaqembu afuna ukuwuketula emandleni.Okunye ngukuthi kulo nyaka kugujwa iminyaka engu-30 le nhlangano yathatha amandla.Yilokhu okudala ukwehlukana kwemibono, abanye bathi sebekhathele yi-ANC ayiphume ngoba yehlulekile, abanye bathi ayiqhubeke ihole izwe.
ISouth African Federation of Trade Unions (Saftu) ifuna bajeziswe kanzima abaqashi ababambela abasebenzi imali yempesheni kodwa bagcine bengayidluliselanga ezikhwameni ezifanele.ISaftu isho lokhu emuva kokuthi umxazululi wezinkinga zempesheni, uNksz Muvhango Lukhaimane eveze ukuthi abasebenzi bakuleli bakweletwa uR7 billion yizikhwama zempesheni.IFinancial Sector Conduct Authority (Fsca), ishicilele uhlu lwezinkampani eziwu-4 200 ezibambela abasebenzi imali yempesheni, kodwa zingayifaki esikhwameni esifanele.Iningi lalezi zinkampani ngeziqashe onogada kanti ulwazi lutholakala ku-www.fsca.co.zaUNksz Lukhaimane uthe uma izinkampani zingayifaki imali esikhwameni sempesheni kufanele zithathelwe izinyathelo.Ubalule ukuthi izinkampani ezingakhokhi imali yempesheni zikweleta phakathi kwezinyanga ezinhlanu kuya ezinyangeni eziwu-252 okusho ukuthi iminyaka ewu-21."Izikhalo ezingaphezu kuka-80% engizitholayo ngezabasebenzi abakweletwa imali yabo yempesheni. "Bathola lokhu uma sebethathe umhlalaphansi noma sebexoshiwe, sebeyofaka isicelo semali yabo."Kufanele abahleli emabhodini ezikhwama ezahlukene zempesheni bathathe izinyathelo uma umqashi engayikhokhi imali yabasebenzi yempesheni yize ebadonsela,” kuchaza uNksz Lukhaimane.Uthe ngokomthetho wePension Funds Act, kufanele inkampani engayikhokhanga izinyanga ezintathu impesheni, ivulelwe icala.Uveze ukuthi abangayikhokhi imali yempesheni esikhwameni esifanele bebe beyidonsa emaholweni abantu, bangahlawuliswa uR10 million noma iminyaka ewu-10 bebhadla ejele.UNobhala Jikelele weSaftu, uMnuz Zwelinzima Vavi uthe imali yempesheni idonswa eholweni lomsebenzi nyangazonke bese enye ingxenye ikhokhwa wumqashi.Uthe le mali kufanele iye esikhwameni sempesheni esifanele ukuze uma umsebenzi esethatha umhlalaphansi, akwazi ukuphila impilo engcono."Sibonga iFCSA ngokushicilela uhlu lwabaqashi abaxhaphaza abasebenzi ngokubabambela imali yempesheni bese bengayifaki esikhwameni esifanele."Kufanele manje uhulumeni aqinisekise ukuthi abanikazi balezi zinkampani bajeziswa kanzima."Abakhokhiswe imali abayikweleta abasebenzi nenzalo yayo noma kulandelwe lokhu okushiwo wumthetho wezimpesheni. Lo mthetho ukubeka kucace ukuthi kufanele bahlawuliswe uR10 million noma bavalelwe ejele iminyaka ewu-10,” kusho uVavi.Uthe abasebenzi basebenza kanzima ukuze kuthi uma sebethathe umhlalaphansi bangabi wumthwalo kuhulumeni, kodwa bakwazi ukuphila impilo engcono nemindeni yabo."Imali yempesheni ibalulekile kubasebenzi ngoba iyabasiza ukuba baphile impilo abayijwayele, banganciki ezibonelelweni zikahulumeni. Bayakwazi nokuqhuba izingane esikoleni nokuthuthukisa impilo yabo."Abasuke bexoshiwe noma bephelelwe wumsebenzi kungakafiki umhlalaphansi, le mali iyabasiza ukuthi babe nemali yezidingo zabo ngesikhathi besafuna omunye umsebenzi. "Abanye bathenga imizi noma izimoto. Uma bengasayitholi kubadalela ukhwantalala nezinye izinkinga zempilo,” kuqhuba uVavi.Uphethe ngokuthi abaqashi abaphula umthetho wezimpesheni kufanele bajeziswe kanzima.UNkk Lukhaimane ugqugquzele abasebenzi ukuba babheke njalo uma kuphela inyanga ukuthi izinkampani abazisebenzelayo ziyayidlulisela yini imali ezikhwameni zempesheni.Uma bethola ukuthi aziyifaki esikhwameni ucele ukuthi bathinte ihhovisi lakhe ku-www.pfa.org.za. INHLANGANO esiza abanezifo zengqondo, iSouth African Depression and Anxiety Group (Sadag), isigqugquzele abantu bakuleli ukuba behlise otshwaleni.Iveze ukuthi abanye bancamela ukuphuza utshwala kunokuthenga ukudla okunomsoco. Icele abantu ukuba basheshe bafune usizo uma becabanga ukuthi banenkinga yophuzo oludakayo.Udokotela wengqondo waseCape Town, uDkt Timmy Joji ubenesithangami sokucobelelana ngolwazi nabeSadag exwayisa ngobungozi bophuzo oludakayo."Uma unomuntu onenkinga yotshwala kubalulekile ukuthi ube nozwelo ngoba loyo muntu uzama ukubhekana nesimo esithile ngokusebenzisa utshwala."Abantu abanenkinga yotshwala abaziboni. Abanye abafuni nokusizwa. Kubalulekile ukukhuluma nabo ngendlela ekahle, ungabahluleli,” kusho uDkt Joji.Ucele abanenkinga yophuzo oludakayo ukuthi bangabi namahloni futhi bangazehluleli, kodwa bathinte iSadag ngoba ikhona ukubasiza.Uthe bangakhuluma nomeluleki ku-whatsapp ngokushayela u-087 163 2025.Bangashayela u-0800 12 13 14 lapho bezokhuluma nomeluleki osiza abanenkinga yotshwala. Bangathumela futhi isms ku-32312 ukuze balekelelwe. Usizo lumahhala kanti lutholakala nsukuzonke.UJoji uthe kukhona nezinhlangano ezisiza abanenkinga yophuzo njenge-Alcoholics Anonymous (AA) eba nemihlangano kuzo zonke izifundazwe zakuleli. Abafisa ukuthi ibasize i-AA, bangangena kwi-website yale nhlangano ethi www.aasouthafrica.org.za ukuthola umhlangano oseduze nabo.Nazi izimpawu okufanele zisukunyelwe:Ukuhlale ufuna utshwala ukuze uzizwe ngendlela ethile.-Ukungazizwa kahle uma ungaphuzanga utshwala. Kungenzeka uqhaqhazele, ujuluke, ucanuzelwe yinhliziyo, ungahlaliseki kahle, usheshe ucikeke noma uzizwe ukhathazekile.-Ukungenzi lokho okulindeleke kuwena, isibonelo ungayi emsebenzini, esikoleni noma ungafuni ukuba nomndeni wakho ngenxa yotshwala. Kungenzeka ehle amamaki akho esikoleni uma uwumfundi, ulove esikoleni noma uxabane nabantu obathandayo.-Ukushintsha kwendlela oziphatha ngayo, abanye bashintsha esikhaleni babe nolaka ngenxa yokuphuza kakhulu noma ukungabutholi utshwala.-Ukungamukeli ukuthi unenkinga yotshwala, uma abanye bekhuluma nawe. Lokhu kwandisa izinkinga zakho.
ISOSHA elibhekene necala lokubulala umkalo ekuqaleni konyaka lizokwazi ngoLwesine ukuthi liyayithola yini ibheyili noma cha.UMnuz Lwanda Mxolisi Zungu obeyisosha loMbutho wezempi wakuleli iSouth African National Defence Force (SANDF), usolwa ngokudubula abulale umkakhe, uNkk Tania Zungu (36).Isehlakalo kuthiwa senzeka emzini wabo osePinetown. Izolo bekulindeleke ukuthi iMantshi, uWendalynn Robinson akhiphe isinqumo ngebheyili kodwa washaya ungqimphothwe.Uthe kunezinto okumele aqale azibhekisise, isinqumo sesizophuma ngoLwesine."Angeke kulunge ukuthi ngikhiphe isinqumo namhlanje. Kunezinto okumele ngiqale ngizibhekisise kuqala mayelana naleli cala," echaza.Ngaphambi kwalokho umbuso ushayele isipikili sokugcina uveza amaphuzu oweseka ngawo ukuthi kungani kumele isosha lingayitholi ibheyili.UMshushisi u-Enud Franko zithe zisuka nje wasola umsolwa ngokusebenzisa ingane yakhe eneminyaka engu-14 ukuzivikela."Bekungafanele umsolwa avunyelwe ukuthi ingane yakhe ayenzise isitatimende sokuthi imvikele. Le ngane ithe iyamdinga uyise kumele ayithole ibheyili," usho kanje.Umshushisi ubuye wakhala ngokuthi isosha akumele lidedelwe ngoba lingaletha ukwesaba kwabomndeni kamufi.Umsolwa ubefake ishethi elimhlophe efake nothayi oluhlaza.
IQEMBU uMkhonto weSizwe (MK), lithi asikho isidingo sokuthi owayengumengameli uMnuz Jacob Zuma, ahlangane noMnuz Jabulani Khumalo oxoshiwe ngoba wachazelwa konke ngesinqumo seqembu.I-MK imenyezelwe nguZuma ngoDisemba nyakenye, wathi ngeke esayivotela i-ANC kodwa usehamba neqembu elisha okhethweni oluzayo. Izwe liya okhethweni lukazwelonke ngoMeyi 29, nonyaka.UKhumalo owabhalisa iMK, kwi-IEC uxoshiwe njengelungu futhi lokhu kumenyezelwe ngesitatimende esisabalele kwabezindaba. UKhumalo ucashunwe ekhuluma ne-eNCA, ethi akayazi eyokuxoshwa futhi usazohlangana noZuma ezwe kahle.UKhumalo uchithwa nje, ubelele isibili ohlwini lweqembu lwabaya ePhalamende futhi ubenesikhundla esiphezulu ebizwa ngoKhomanda.Okhulumela iMK uMnuz Nhlamulo Ndlhela, uthe akukho mhlangano ozoba khona phakathi kukaKhumalo neqembu."Akukho mhlangano ozoba khona ngicela kucace nje lokho. UKhumalo wayesemhlanganweni onabaholi cishe abangu-25, bamchazela konke wanikezwa incwadi, washiya umhlangano. Asikhathazekile ngalutho azokukhuluma ngoba akukho okubi ebesikwenza futhi iqembu libhaliswe ngoZuma manje,’’ kusho uNdlhela.Ebuzwa ngezizathu zokuchitwa kukaKhumalo, uthe abakwazi ukuzidalula manje kodwa zizovela ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. I-MK esitatimendeni sokuxoshwa kukaKhumalo icacise ukuthi wayecelwe nguZuma ukuba abhalise iqembu kwi-IEC.Kuhambe, kwahamba kwaba noshintsho kwakhishwa uKhumalo kwafakwa isithombe sikaZuma, ukuze kukhangiswe ngaye.Kwenzeka lokhu nje, kunombhalo ongaphansi kwegama likaDuduzile Zuma-Sambudla oyindodakazi kaZuma, oveze ukuthi akukho mhlangano.Lo mbhalo okukholakala ukuthi okaDuduzile, uveze ukuthi emabhukwini kaZuma awukho umhlangano awuhlele noKhumalo.Ngaphambi kwalokho kuke kwaba nomunye umbhalo othi bekungeke kulunge ukuthi izinkunzi ezimbili zikhonye esibayeni esisodwa.UKhumalo uzanywe kaningi ocingweni lwakhe belungabanjwa futhi nomyalezo athunyelwe wona akawuphendulanga.Kuxoshwa uKhumalo nje, iMK iphuma ingena ezinkantolo futhi kubukeka kusayihambela kahle. Kulindeleke ukuthi ngoMeyi 10, iNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo ilalele icala phakathi kwaleli qembu ne-IEC.I-IEC yamemezela ukuthi uZuma akafanelwe wukuba sohlwini lwabaya ePhalamende ngoba wake wagwetshwa, waya ejele.
UNQUME ukuqhubeka nokubhadla esitokisini, umsolwa kwelokubulawa kwendodakazi eneminyaka emibili angayizali, isidumbu sayo esitholwe simbozwe ngobhavu egcekeni kubo, esigamekweni esishaqise amalungu omphakathi esenzeke eSiqungeni, eMthwalume ngesonto eledlule.UMnuz Siyabonga Ndlovu (34) ubevele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMzumbe izolo ngecala lokubulawa kuka-Ayabonga (2).Kukholakala ukuthi iqulu lamalungu omphakathi ebelibhikisha lisho ukuyibamba ngezandla iveni yamaphoyisa ebifika naye ngesikhathi ezovela, okungenye yezinto ezimenze wamanqika ukufaka isicelo sebheyili.Inkantolo inqume ukulihlehlisela uMeyi 17 leli cala. Okhulumela inhlangano elwa nokuhlukunyezwa kwezingane nabesifazane endaweni, i-Women of Mthwalume uNkk Bongekile Sithole obengomunye wabebehola umbhikisho uthe ukungadedelwa kukamsolwa ngebheyili yinto abebevele befuna ukuthi yenzeke.Uthe yingakho bebephume ngezinkani ukuzokweseka umndeni nokufaka ingcindezi ukuthi engayinikwa."Sigculisekile ngokuthi angadedelwa ngebheyili noma enqume ukungasifaki isicelo."Lokhu ngeke kwenze umphakathi ungabe usaphuma ngobuningi ukuzobhikisha ngaphandle kwenkantolo uma evela ngoba esikufunayo ukuthi athole isigwebo esimfanele,” usho kanjeUthe bazokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi amalungu omphakathi abamaningi enkantolo uma kuzovela umsolwa ukufaka ingcindezi ukuze anikezwe udilikajele.Bakholwa wukuthi ukuphuma ngobuningi komphakathi yikona okumenze wanquma ukungaqhubeki nesicelo sebheyili esaba ulaka lwawo Uthe abakufunayo ukuthi leli cala lidluliselwe enkantolo enkulu ukuze asheshe athole okumfanele ngoba vele icala wazivumela yena ngaphambi kokuboshwa ukuthi ulenzile.UNdlovu okukholakala ukuthi wayegajwe yisikhwele emva kokwaliwa wunina wengane, kuthiwa ngosuku lwesigameko wathatha ingane kuninomncane eyayihleli naye wathi ifunwa wunina oyizalayo bahleli naye kwaba wukunyamalala kwakhe. Kuthiwa ufonele unina ka-Ayabonga emazisa ukuthi ingane useyibulele wayilahla ehlathini okuthe uma kuyobhekwa khona, kusolwa ukuthi ukhokhobe nesidumbu sengane wayosilaxaza egcekeni kwabo wasimboza ngobhavu.
AMANYE amalungu, omphakathi waku-ward 1 kuMasipala waseMshwathi, abuyele emakhaya esehleka wodwa emuva okwamukela amatayitela ezindlu zawo.Kulo mcimbi, obubanjelwe ehholo laseThokozani, kunamalungu awu-128 anikezwe amatayitela.UNgqongqoshe woMnyango wokuHlaliswa kwaBantu nemiSebenzi yoMphakathi, uMnuz Sipho "KK" Nkosi, uthe zingu-800 izindlu ezakhelwe abahlali bakulesi sigceme. Yize kunjalo kodwa uNkosi uthe amanye amatayitela asalungiswa."Ngizonikeza amatayitela asho izinto ezintathu. Eyokuqala ithi lendlu oyakhelwe wuhulumeni, wangafaka ngisho isenti elimnyama, isingeyakho nezizukulwane zakho. Eyesibili ithi-ke nalo mhlaba lapho lendlu eyakhiwe kuyo, akekho oyokukhipha kuwona." UNkosi uthe okwesithathu laba abafuna ukuba ngosomabhizinisi "uma unetayitela ufuna ukuboleka usizo noma ngabe yiluphi, uyakwazi ukusebenzisa lelo tayitela lakho njengesibambiso." Nakuba uNkosi ekhulume kanje kodwa uthe akakugqugquzeli ukuba abantu babambise ngamatayitela "ngoba uma ungasabakhokheli labo bantu, banelungelo lokuyidla indlu yakho. Cabanga-ke izindlu ezinhle kanje."UNGQONGQOSHE uMnuz Sipho "KK” Nkosi eshayela uMnuz Bogani Msweli izandla ngokuhlabana ngetayitela Isithombe:SITHUNYELWEUNkosi uthe umuntu uzothola indlu yamahhala, umhlaba wamahhala netayitela lamahhala.Uthe uhulumeni ukhokhela ummeli uR25 000 ngetayitela ngalinye."Zibalele ukuthi uhulumeni ukhokhe ama-million amangaki ngezizindlu ezingu-128."Esephetha uNkosi uthe benza konke okusemandleni ukuthi abangakawatholi amatayitela, bayashesha ukuwathola "ngoba sifuna wonke umuntu abe netayitela."
SEKUZOPHELA ukuba umphakathi waseMpolweni uhambe amabanga amade uma befuna ukwelashwa njengoba sebakhelwa umtholampilo wabo osezingeni elicokeme. UNgqongqoshe woMnyango wezeMpilo, eKZN, uNkk Nomagugu Simelane, umemezele lokhu ngesikhathi kuzokwethulwa umakhi ehholo lomphakathi waseMpolweni. UNkk Simelane uthe lomtholampilo uzodla isamba sikaR70 million.IMEYA yaseMshwathi, uCllr Mandla Zondi neNkosi yaseMathulini, uMhlabunzima "Zondamasiniya” Mthuli, bebeyingxenye yezicukuthwane Isithombe:SITHUNYELWE"Ngonyaka owedlule sathi kulo nyaka sizokwakha imitholampilo engu-11. Omunye wale mithompilo ka-11 yilo esiwakha namhlanje eMpolweni. Sathatha isinqumo sokuthi ngeke siphendule isoyi kuphela. Sizohlaba ifosholo maqede ojutshulwe ukwakha, aqale namhlanje ukwakha." UNkk Simelane kulo mtholampilo kuzoqashwa abantu ebebengasebenzi abaphakathi kuka-20 no-25 futhi uzosetshenziswa ngamalungu omphakathi abalelwa ku-50 000, okubalwa nabahlala ku-ward 1 no-ward 12."Ngiyafisa ukuthi njengoba lomtholampilo uzokwakhiwa, ngiyacela niwuvikele."UKHANSELA waku-ward 10 kuMasipala waseMshwathi, uNksz Hlengiwe Ngubane neMeya yaseMgungundlovu,uMnuz Mzi Zuma, behambele umcimbi wokwethulwa kukasonkontilaki womtholampilo Isithombe:SITHUNYELWEUNgqongqoshe uthe phakathi kwezinto ezizotholakala kulo mtholampilo kubalwa igumbi lokweluleka ngokwengqondo, amahhovisi, igumbi eligcina imishanguzo, i-dispensary, izindawo zokulala abahlengikazi ne-generator ezolekelela kakhulu uma sekubuye i-loadshedding."Uthe lo mtholampilo uzosebenza zonke izinsuku, kusukela ngoMsombuluko kuze kushaye omunye. "Siyafisa usebenze amahora awu-24 kodwa awukwazi ngoba asikwazi ukuba nemali yokuqasha abantu abazosebenza lamahora." Uthe uma kukhona umuntu olimalayo ngezithuba zabo-6.30 ebusuku, abantu bengaya emtholampilo ngoba kuzobe kunomhlengikazi ozobe elala ekhaya eliseduze ngoba elindele ukunikezela ngosizo oluphuthumayo.Imeya yakuMasipala waseMshwathi, uMnuz Mandla Zondi, ikushayele elikhulu ihlombe lokhu kwakhiwa komtholampilo. Uthe abantu bakule ndawo bebehlukumezeka kakhulu ngoba bekufanele bahambe amabanga amade. Lo mcimbi bewuhanjelwe yiNkosi yaseMathulini, oZwathini, uMhlabunzima "Zondamasiniya" Mthuli.
UMNYANGO wezeMpilo kuleli uxwayisa umphakathi ngokusabalala kweqoqo lamagciwane omkhuhlane ahlasela umgudu wokuphefumula iRespiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV), asabalele ezweni lonke njengoba kuyisikhathi somkhuhlane.Umnyango uthe iRSV phakathi kwezinye zezimpawu zayo ohaqekile wehlelwa i-oxygen ehamba egazini lakhe okuholela ekutheni izicubu zakhe zingayitholi ngokwanele, bese ecobeka ekhathala.Kwesinye isikhathi kusuke kuhambisana nokuvaleka kwamakhala, ukucinana kwesifuba, ukuthimula, ukukhwehlela noma ubuhlungu bomphimbo.UMnuz Foster Mohale, uthe uNgqongqoshe walo Mnyango uDkt Joe Phaahla ukukhuthaza abantu bagomele umkhuhlane ukuze bawugweme.Uthe lo mkhuhlane ube nzima kubona ikakhulukazi abantu abadala, izingane nabanezifo ezingamahlalakhona ezithinta amaphaphu."Isikhungo esibhekele izifo ezithathelanayo iNational Institute for Communicable Diseases (NICD), sinohlelo lokuqapha ukusabalala kwamagciwane okuphefumula ezweni lonke."Yazise umnyango ukuthi manje sekuyisikhathi se-RSV engadidaniswa ne-Covid-19 noma i-SARS-CoV- 2 ngenxa yezimpawu ezivamile. "Igciwane le-RSV lidala ukugula ikakhulukazi ezinganeni ezincane nezinkinga zokuphefumula kubantu abadala. Isizini yomkhuhlane ngokuvamile ilandela i-RSV njengoba sesiqala ukubona ukwanda kwezifo."Yize izifo eziningi ezibangelwa umkhuhlane - amagciwane e-RSV ne-SARS-CoV-2 ngokuvamile adala ukugula okunqobekayo. "Kuyenzeka lamagciwane adale ukugula okuholela ekutheni umuntu afe ikakhulukazi labo abasengcupheni," kusho uMohale.Iphini likaNgqongqoshe walo Mnyango uDkt Sibongiseni Dhlomo, uthe amagciwane abizwa ngeRSV ahlasela abantu njalo ngesikhathi esithile sonyaka.Uthe njengamanje amagciwane eRSV asabalele kakhulu. Kulula ukuthi aphambaniseke neCovid-19 ngoba izimpawu zakhona ziyefana. "ICovid-19 nayo isekhona. Njengezwe asizange sikwazi ukugoma abantu abangu-90% ukuze kuvikelwe ukusabalala kwayo. Abagoma abanye abazange besajova ngemijovo yokwengeza amandla."Abantu abadala, abanezifo ezithinta amaphaphu nabake bahlinzwa ubende, abangayidli ngendlela imithi yabo yokuthithibalisa iHIV banamathuba amaningi okuhaqeka noma begomile," kusho uDhlomo.Indlela yokugwema ukusabalala komkhuhlane ukuvala umlomo uma ukhwehlela noma uthimula.Ukuhlala ekhaya uma ugula, ungayi kwabanye abantu ngoba ungabathelela.Gwema ukusebenzisa izitsha ebezisetshenziswa yilowo onomkhuhlane zingageziwe nokuqabulana.
ISIKHWAMA esixhasa ngemali yokufunda ezikhungweni zemfundo, iNational Students’ Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS), siyalele izitshudeni zasemakolishi amakhono ukuthi zivule ama-akhawunti asebhange ukuze zithole imihlomulo yazo.Lesi sikhwana sithe lezi zitshudeni zingavula ama-akhawunti kunoma iliphi ibhange.Umlawuli wesikhashana weNSFAS, uMnuz Freeman Nomvalo, ngeledlule, uhlangane nenhlangano yezitshudeni zasemakolishi ama-TVET, ngenxa yokwanda kwezehlakalo zokungenami ngokungakhokhwa kwemihlomulo."Umhlangano ubumayelana nokubambezeleka ekukhokhweni kwemihlomulo nokunyamalala kwemali kuma-akhawunti ezitshudeni. Kulo mhlangano izitshudeni zikhale ngohlelo lokusatshalaliswa kwemihlomulo,” kusho iNSFAS.Lesi sikhwama sithe sesiqhamuke nohlelo oluzobhekana nalezi zinkinga kulabo abazothola imihlomulo yabo ekupheleni kwenyanga ezayo."I-NSFAS ihlela ukuthumela ngqo imali kuma-akhawunti ezitshudeni. Yingakho kubalulekile ukuthi izitshudeni zibe nama-akhawunti anoma iliphi ibhange.” Lesi sikhwama sithe sizoxhumana nabathola uxhaso sibanxenxe ukuthi balethe ulwazi lwabo ukuze imali ingene ngqo kubona."Siyazi ngokubambezeleka ekutheni izitshudeni zithole imihlomulo yazo kule nyanga. Sijube ithimba lezikhulu zalesi sikhwama ezikhungweni ezehlukene ukuze ziyoxazulula lezi zinkinga.” Lokhu kwenzelwa ukuthi kuqala uhlelo olusha lokufakwa ngqo kwemali kuma-akhawunti ezitshudeni zibe sezixazululekile izinkinga ezivele zikhona. Abalesi sikhwama baveze ukuthi bayazilungisa nezinkinga ezibhekene nezitshudeni zasemanyuvesi."Okwamanje uhlelo lokukhokhela ngqo izitshudeni kuma-akhawunti azo lokuqala kwezasemakolishi kuphela. Izitshudeni zasemanyuvesi zizoqhubeka nokuthola imihlomulo yazo ezikhungweni, kuze kube uJulayi nonyaka.” I-NSFAS ithe izobeka izitshudeni phambili uma isinquma ngabazothola uxhaso.Kwenzeka lokhu nje, kwezinye izikhungo ziyaqonga izinkinga zezitshudeni ezikhala ngokucotha kohlelo lokukhokhwa kwemihlomuloKwezinye izikhungo kuqubuke imibhikisho yezitshudeni ezikhala esifanayo.Ezinye zazo zikhala ngokuthi zikhishwa omastende eziqashe kubona ngenxa yokungakhokhi kwalesi sikhwama.Uphenyo lwenkampani yabameli eyayijutshwe yiNSFAS lwaphakamisa ukuthi kuchithwe izinkampani ezine ebezikhokha imihlomulo yezitshudeni.UNgqongqoshe weMfundo ePhakeme, uDkt Blade Nzimande, ujube uNomvalo ukuthi alungise izinto kulesi sikhwama, ikakhulu uhlelo lokukhokhwa kwemihlomulo izitshudeni ezikhala ngalo.Wamyalela ukuthi abike njalo kuyena ngokwenzekayo kulesi sikhwama.
UMA kukhulunywa ngembiza ewumvusankunzi kwabaningi besilisa, ababuzi lutho, bakhala khona. Abanye esikhundleni zokuphuza isivalo, bagcina bephuza ibhodlela lonke okuyinto ebabeka engcupheni yezinkinga eziningi emzimbeni wabo.Yingakho ungoti wemithi yesintu, Mnuz Mfanafuthi Msomi esekhethe ukuvula ikhemisi okuhloswe ngalo ukufundisa kabanzi ngezikalo zemithi yesintu nezimbiza ezithandwa kakhulu ngabantu.UMNUZ Mfanafuthi Msomi ozovula ikhemisi lesintu elehlukile eThekwini" Into engiyaye ngiyisho wukuthi imithi yasentshonalanga ayingcono ngalutho kunale yesintu, umehluko nje wukuthi bona bayacwaninga bese beqhamuka nezikali ezibhalwe phansi zemithi yabo. Lokho kube sekwenza engathi bona bangcono,”kusho uMsomi.Uthe lunzulu ulwazi nakubelaphi bendabuko mayelana nezikalo zemithi, kuphela wukuthi abantu abafundiswa ngazo. UMsomi uvula leli khemisi ngoMgqibelo enkabeli yeTheku. Uthe lizoba elehlukile abantu abake balibona ngoba lizoba nendawo okufundwa kuyona kabanzi ngezikalo zemithi yesintu.Ubalule nale mithi eyaziwayo ukuthi inomsebenzi othile njengekhambi lesisu, abantu abaningi okuthi uma belidlula endleleni balibalule ukuthi eliqeda isisu. Umehluko wukuthi basuke bengazi ukuthi liphekwa bese likalwa kanjani. Uthe kule khemisi yakhe uzobe efundisa kabanzi nangalokhu." Ngifuna sibuye isithunzi semithi yesintu, nokufaka isifundo nje sokuthi umuthi wesintu awulona ihlazo noma awusho ukuthi awuphucuzekile,” egcizelela. UMsombi uwuthisha oqeqeshiwe ofundisa eThulubheke eMthwalume.Uthe okunye akuthokozelayo ngaleli khemisi lesintu, wukuthi lizovula namathuba omsebenzi njengoba beyishumi abantu abazobe besebenza kulo.UMsomi obuye aziwe ngelikaMkhulu Hlombe, uthe leli khemisi lizoba senkabeni yeTheku ku-114 Joe Slovo.''Kuyangijabulisa kakhulu ukuthi kuzodaleka amathuba omsebenzi uma kuvulwa leli khemisi. Siyazi sonke ukuthi amathuba omsebenzi abaluleke kangakanani ikakhulukazi kulesi sikhathi samanje,'' usho kanje.Okunye okwehlukile athi kuzokwenzeka kuleli khemisi, wukuthi imithi ngeke ifike isisemabhodleleni kodwa izothakwa khona kule ndawo. Njengoba elindele ukuthi leli khemisi lihanjelwe yizinkumbi zabantu, uthe ukhethe nokuthi zonke izinsuku kuleli khemisi kuphekelwe amakhasimende ukuze bathi besalindile bathole okuya ngasethunjini."Lokhu sizobe sikwenza ngamabomu ngoba abantu behlukene. Kukhona abanye abafika bezothenga amakhambi azodinga ukuthi balinde, uthole ukuthi akukho lutho naseziswini ngenxa yezinkinga esizaziyo,"echaza. UMsomi ngokudabuka ungowasePort Shepstone, eningizimu uyesifundazweNgaphandle kwaleli khemisi unawo amanye ezingxenyeni ezahlukene zeKwaZulu-Natal kodwa leli kuzoba kungelokuqala elizoba nalezi zinhlelo.Uthe kungekudala naseGoli, naseFree State uzobe esenawo amakhemisi nakhona uthe ufuna kudaleke amathuba omsebenzi ngawo.Phezu kwakho konke, abantu babe nolwazi olunzulu ngokusebenza kwemithi yesintu.
