ISIKHUNGO semfundo ePhakeme, iDurban University of Technology (DUT), sikhombisile ukuthi kungani saziwa njengesikhungo sobuchwepheshe njengoba sethule isikebhe sokuqala esihamba ngogesi welanga e-Afrika yonkana.Lesi sikebhe esibizwa ngeSiyahamba Solar Boat sizongenela umncintiswano omkhulukazi wezikebhe ozoba se-Europe ngoJulayi, obizwa ngeMonaco Energy Boat Challenge (MEBC).NgoLwesihlanu, izikhulu zaseDUT zisebenzisana ne-Energy and Water Sector Education Training Authority (EWSETA), zethule ngokusemthethweni iSiyahamba Solar Boat ePoint Yatch Club, eThekwini.Kuvele ukuthi isikebhe saseDUT sakhethwa ukuba singenele iMEBC kwimingenelo ewu-120 eyayifakiwe. Sizoncintisana nezinye izikebhe eziwu-15 ezivela emazweni ahlukene.Isikebhe sakhiwe yizitshudeni nabasebenzi beDUT Energy Technology Station eyaziwa ngokuthi yiKZN Industrial Energy Efficient Training Resource Centre (IEETR).UMqondisi wezokuXhumana eDUT, uMnuz Alan Khan uthe iDUT yiyona yodwa inyuvesi eya kwiMEBC, e-Afrika yonkana.Uthe iSiyahamba bayiqambe kanjena ngoba behlonipha uKaputeni wamaBhokobhoko uSiya Kolisi emuva kokuwina indebe yomhlaba yebhola lombhoxo ngo-2019.Umsebenzi wokwakha iSiyahamba waqala ngo-2018.USolwazi Fulufhelo Nemavhola oyiPhini likaVice Chancellor weResearch, Innovation and Engagement eDUT, uchaze iSiyahamba njengophawu oluhle olukhombisa imisebenzi eyenziwa yile nyuvesi."ISiyamba iwubufakazi bokuthi iDUT ikhiqiza izitshudeni ezishintsha impilo yabantu. Asiqhubeke nokuza nemikhiqizo emisha ezoletha ushintsho,” kusho uNemavhola.USolwazi Ian Lazarus ohola ithimba leSiyahamba uthe bahlale beza nemikhiqizo ezoshintsha impilo yabantu eDUT kanti kade baziqala izinhlelo zokuya eMonaco.Uveze ukuthi umshayeli wesikebhe uMnuz Steve Ellis unolwazi olunzulu ngokusebenza kwezikebhe ngakho akangabazi ukuthi uzonqoba kwiMEBC."ISiyahamba yisikebhe esisizwa wugesi welanga ukuhamba. Lokhu kuzosisiza ukudlulisa umyalezo wokuthi akuvikelwe ulwandle nemvelo ngokusebenzisa obunye ubuchwepheshe. "Izosisiza njengoba simatasa nokuletha ezokuthutha ezingambi eqolo futhi ezivikela imvelo. Kuzosisiza ukukhombisa abasemkhakheni wezikebhe ukuthi uyakwazi ukusebenzisa izindlela ezingayilimazi imvelo ukusebenzisa umkhumbi,” kusho uLazarus.UNksz Candice Moodley we-EWSETA uthe ngeke bayeke ukweseka izinhlelo ezizoguqula impilo yabantu ngokuletha ubuchwepheshe obungayilimazi imvelo.Udalule ukuthi izinhlelo zabo zike zaphazamiseka ngesikhathi seCovid-19 kodwa babuye baqhubeka emuva kwayo.
INHLANGANO esiza abanenkinga yokugembula kuleli, iGamblers Anonymous SA, ithi ukugembula kuyinkinga ezweni jikelele ngenxa yokuthi abantu basuke becabanga ukuthi kuzobalethela imali esheshayo.Ukwesweleka kwemisebenzi nokubiza kwempilo kuthiwa yikona okuholela iningi ekugembuleni njengoba lisuke lizama imali yokuphila.Isolezwe libhalele le nhlangano emuva kokuthi abafundi baleli phephandaba besilisa beveze ukuthi amakhosikazi abo agembula kumaselula.Omunye umfundi uveze ukuthi akasayiniki imali inkosikazi yakhe, ngisho nekhadi lokuhola isibonelelo sezingane seliphathwa wuyena ngoba ithenga amavawusha okugembula."Unkosikazi wami ubewumuntu olithandayo ikhaya, okwaziyo ukwenza igilosa esilonda inyanga yonke. "Ubekwazi nokuthengela izingane izimpahla zokugqoka ngesibonelelo sazo sikahulumeni. Muva nje uthenga amavawusha okugembula, ahlale kwiselula yakhe ilanga lonke njengoba engasebenzi."Uma ngibuza ukuthi kungani ukudla kuphela inyanga isephansi, uvele akhale ngokuthi igilosa iyabiza,” kuchaza indoda.Ithe iye yenza uphenyo lwayo njengoba inqume ukuzenzela igilosa ngemali ebiyinika umkayo, yathola ukuthi yize ukudla kubiza kodwa imali isakwazi ukwenza igilosa ehlala inyanga yonke.Emuva kokuphucwa imali yegilosa kuthiwa lo wesifazane ebesebenzisa imali yesibonelelo sikahulumeni ukuthenga amavawusha okugembula."Ngiye ngamhlalisa phansi ngambuza ukuthi imali uyenzani? Ungitshele ukuthi uthenga amavawusha kaR50 okugembula kwiselula yakhe. Ungibonisile imidlalo ekhona, eminye eyezinombolo ezihamba ngokushesha njengalezi zemishini yase-casino kanti kunebhanoyi elindizayo okuthiwa lenza imali. Okunye kunamagqamuza alokhu enza imali uma umuntu ewashaya ngephethini ethize. Yena ubengaboni ukuthi lento iyamlimaza ngoba uhlezi esethembeni lokuthi uzowina izigidi zamaradi kodwa lokhu akwenzeki,” kusho indoda.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi abesifazane bagembula kumaselula kakhulu, kanti amadoda avamise ukuhambela izindawo zokubheja ezahlukene futhi sekukhona izinkundla zokucijana ngokugembula ezikhokhelwayo ku-whatsapp nakwezinye izinkundla zokuxhumana.Indlela ukugembula okuyinkinga ngakhona imantshi yenkantolo yaseGqeberha isanda kugweba umgcini mabhuku iminyaka ewu-18 ebhadla ejele emuva kokuthi egembule uR14 million wenkampani abeyisebenzela.Akukona nje ukugembula kumaselula nasezindaweni zokubheja okuheha abantu, kodwa nasezinxanxatheleni zezitolo sekukhona indawo yokugembula ebizwa ngeBingo ekhonzwe kakhulu ngabadala.Kuthiwa bashaya sengathi bayokwenza igilosa kanti sebeyogembula kwiBingo.IGamblers Anonymous SA, ithe abantu balahlekelwa yimali kakhulu ekugembuleni ngenxa yokuthi uma sebebhejile badliwa, babuye bafake enye imali ngethemba lokubuyisa leyo abadliwe yona.Iveze ukuthi izikhangiso zokugembula emazikweni ahlukene ezindaba okubalwa imisakazo, ithelevishini, amaphephandaba, amabillboards nasezinkundleni zokuxhumana, yizona eziheha abantu ukuba bagembule.Igqugquzele abanenkinga yokugembula noma abanabantu abagembulayo emindenini yabo ukushesha bathinte iGamblers Anonymous SA."Sinemihlangano ezindaweni ezahlukene. Siyakwazi nokweluleka abadinga ukuyeka ukugembula. ”angaluthola usizo nakwiNational Responsible Gambling, sibagqugquzela ukuthi bavale ama-akhawunti abo okubheja, banikeze nabantu ababathembayo izimali zabo, ukuze bangalingeki baze bagcine sebegembula,” kusho iGamblers Anonymous SA.Abafuna usizo bangavakashela iwebsite yegamblers anonymous ethi https://gamblersanonymous.org.za/Bathe usizo luyatholakala kuzo zonke izifundazwe zakuleli kanti imihlangano iyenziwa ngisho nange-zoom. Usizo olunikwa abantu lumahhala, ayikho imali abakhokhiswa yona.
UNEMIBUZO umndeni wowesilisa waseChesterville, eThekwini, okuthiwa wabulawa yisihlobo sikammangali ngaphakathi esiteshini samaphoyisa oThongathi, maphakathi nenyanga.Kuthiwa umufi, uMnuz Thabiso Shangase (29), wabhudukezwa yilona owesilisa, okuthiwa wayekhaphe udadewabo owayegqekezelwe eze esiteshini samaphoyisa.Ngokusho kukagogo kamufi, uNksz Jabu Mthembu, ngo-Ephreli 15, bathola ucingo lokuthi umufi useshaqwe ngamaphoyisa asoThongathi, esePhoenix.Uthe umufi uboshwa nje, uyamaniswa necala lokugqekeza okuthiwa lenziwa abesilisa ayebagibeze emotweni ayehamba ngayo ekhokhelwa ngebanga elihambile."Sinikele khona esiteshini samaphoyisa, simphathele izingubo zokugqoka nokudla kodwa sahlala kwaze kwaba yileyo ndaba, singavunyelwa ukuba simbone,” kusho uNksz Mthembu.Uqhube wathi kukhona iphoyisa elabatshela ukuthi usaphume namanye amaphoysa, lathi uma kwenzeke njalo kusuke kuphakathi kokuthi uyoshawa noma uyokhomba indawo yesigameko.Uveze ukuthi kwabuye kwaba khona elinye abalijwayele, elabahlebela ukuthi amampunge ukuthi usaphumile, ukhona ngaphakathi esitokisini, limbonile, laze lakhuluma naye ngakho abaqhubeke balinde."Laze lasitshela ukuthi ekuxoxeni kwalo naye, washo ukuthi uthe kwaleli cala aboshelwe lona akalenzanga, kodwa lenziwa yilaba abagibeza emotweni, wathi omunye wabo uyamazi. Lathi lamtshela ukuthi kuzofanele akhulume lonke iqiniso ngaphandle kokwesaba,” kusho uNksz Mthembu.Uqhube wathi bagcina begoduka ngabo-6.30 sekuhwalele bengambonanga, kwathi ngabo-9 ebusuku baphinde bathola olunye ucingo lubabizela esiteshini futhi."Sathi uma sifika, kwathiwa asiphuthume esibhedlela Osindisweni siyombheka ngoba ulimele. Sathi uma sifika esibhedlela, udokotela wasitshela ukuthi ufike esibhedlela ngabo-7.30 ebusuku eseshonile,” kulandisa uNksz Mthembu.Uthe bathi uma bebabuza ukuthi kwenzakaleni, amaphoyisa abatshela ukuthi kwangena umfowabo kammangali, wamshaya."Thina sixakwa ukuthi sanqatshelwa ukuthi simbone uThabiso, kodwa umhlaseli yena wavunyelwa ukungena. Sifisa ukwazi ukuthi kwenzeka kanjani lokho? Sifuna nokwazi ukuthi wazi kanjani ukuthi ukusiphi isitokisi?” usho kanje.Uphinde wathi kuyabakhathaza ukuthi isiphi isikhathi ahlaselwa ngaso njengoba bona bahamba ngabo-6.30 sekuhwalele esiteshini kanti udokotela wasoSindisweni uveze eyokuthi wafika ngo-7.30 eseshonile.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa asoThongathi aphenya icala lokubulala emva kokuthi umsolwa owayeboshwe ngecala lokugqekeza washawa ngaphakathi esiteshini samaphoyisa."Umsolwa wakhishwa esitokisini umphenyi wecala ngenhloso yokwenza uphenyo. Ummangali naye wayeyalelwe ukuthi eze esiteshini samaphoyisa ukuzobhalisa isitatimende,” kusho uNetshiunda.Uqhube wathi ngesikhathi bengaphakathi ehhovisi, umfowabo kammangali wabhozomela umsolwa, owavele wawa waquleka."Kwabizwa abezimo eziphuthumayo, wanikwa usizo oluphuthumayo endaweni yesigameko ngaphambi kokuba aphuthunyiswe esibhedlela lapho afike washonela khona,” kulandisa uNetshiunda.Uvese ukuthi umbulali waboshwa, wabekwa icala lokubulala, wathi uzophinde avele enkantolo ngoJuni 24.
USOLA isikhwele kumsolwa, umndeni womfundi ka-matric obulawe uyise wengane yakhe KwaDumisa, eMzinto.Isidumbu sikaZanele Khathi (18) obefunda eSiphapheme High sitholwe egumbini abelala kulo ngoLwesine emini. Kusolwa ukuthi umsolwa umbulale ngokumshaya aphinde amklinye ngoLwesithathu ebusuku.Ngokusho kukamalume wakhe, uMnuz Petros Khathi, umufi ubenengane enonyaka nezinyanga eziyisithupha nomsolwa.Uthe ubehlala nogogo (78) ongasaboni kahle emehlweni nophinde angezwa kahle nasezindlebeni ngenxa yokuguga."Uye ugogo oqaphele ngoLwesine ngabo-10 ekuseni ukuthi umufi akazange amuzwe elungiselela ukuya esikoleni. Uhambe wayobheka lapho elala khona, wazithela phezu kwakhe esethule,” kusho uKhathi.Uveze ukuthi umufi ubengasafuni ukuthandana nomsolwa ngenxa yesikhwele nokuhlukumeza."Umbulala nje, ubesanda kumtshela ukuthi abahlukane, wathi okungenani bazoqhubeka uma eseqede u-matric wakhe ngoba ubudlelwano buyamthikameza esikoleni,” kusho uKhathi.Uthi bakholwa ukuthi udinwe yilokho wambulala.Udalule ukuthi nyakenye, ngesikhathi umufi ezama ukubuqeda ubudlelwano bakhe nomsolwa, wamkhiphela ummese, ethi uzomgwaza ambulale."Wakwenza lokhu phambi kwabantu, waze wathi omunye umama wendawo, uma esemgwazile yena uzowutshela umndeni wakhe ukuthi umbonile embulala,” kusho uKhathi.Uthi unina kamsolwa uveze ukuthi uyasola ukuthi indodana yakhe isenzile isehlo, njengoba ngoLwesine ekuseni, imcele imali yathi ifuna ukuthengela umufi okudliwayo ngoba akaphilile."Wathi uthe uzothenga isinkwa, upholoni ne-drink. Lezi zinto zificwe endaweni yesigameko ngosuku okutholwe ngalo isidumbu. Sisola ukuthi wayezitshela ukuthi usazophaphama umufi,” usho kanje.Uthe okubuhlungu ukuthi umsolwa wenza lomuga nje, umndeni awunayo ngisho imali noma umasingcwabisane wokungcwaba umufi.Uthe yize eshone ngeledlule, izinhlelo zomngcwabo azikaqali ngoba abazi bazothathani bahlanganise nani.Uveze nokuthi bahleli ngokwesaba njengoba umsolwa esagcwele amathafa.UMphathiswa wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi KwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Nonhlanhla Khoza, uzwakalise ukudabuka nokudinwa kulandela isigameko.Uthe ukuqhubeka kokubikwa kwezigameko zokuhlukunyezwa kwabantu besifazane esifundazweni kuyifu elimnyama emiphakathini eyehlukene."Sikhathazekile ngabenza isihluku, abazibona benelungelo lokuphatha abantu besifazane, betshala ukwesaba nokuhlukumeza. Yize umnyango nezinye izinhlaka zenza konke okusemandleni ukulwa nesihlava, imizamo yethu iwela ezindlebeni ezingezwa,” kusho uNkk Khoza.Unxuse umphakathi ukuthi usukume ulwe nezigameko zokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa aKwaSawoti avule idokodo lokufa komuntu ukuba liphenywe emva kokutholakala kwesidumbu sowesifazane sinamachaphazelo egazi."Izinsolo zithi kungenzeka ukuthi wawa wazilimaza kodwa kuzolindwa imiphumela yokuhlolwa kwesidumbu ukuze kucace ukuthi ubulawe yini,” kusho uNetshiunda.
KUZOSHUBA kwabangena ngenkani ezindlini zomxhaso ezisuke zakhiwe wuhulumeni njengoba uNgqongqoshe wezokuHlaliswa kwaBantu kuzwelonke, uNksz Mmamoloko Kubayi, ethi bazothathelwa izinyathelo zomthetho abadla izindlu zomxhaso."Sithatha izinyathelo ezinqala kulabo abaphula umthetho ngokuthi bangene ezindlini ezisuke zakhelwe abanye abantu. Sithole ukuthi abanikazi bezindlu ezakhiwe wuhulumeni bahlala kabuhlungu noma izindlu zabo seziqediwe. Siyacela abadla izindlu ukuthi basiphumele kuzona ngoba sizosebenzisa umthetho ukuqondisa isimo,” kusho uNksz Kubayi.Uthe bazosiqinisa isandla nakosonkontileka abangaziqedi ngesikhathi izindlu zomxhaso ngoba behlose ukudla imali kahulumeni."Uhulumeni uselahlekelwe yizigidi ngenxa yosonkontileka abangawuqedi ngesikhathi umsebenzi. Sisuke sihlele ukusebenzisa izigidi ezithile ukwakhela abantu izindlu. Uma umsebenzi usudlula leyo mali esisuke siyibekile kusidalela izinkinga ngoba abantu basuke bezilindile izindlu. Siyabacela osonkontileka ukuba baqede umsebenzi ngesikhathi esibekiwe nalabo abasuke besebenza ngaphansi kwabo njengosonkontileka abancane, sicela benze umsebenzi. Kufanele nginikeze abantu bakithi izindlu eziphelile,” kusho uNksz Kubayi.Uchaze osonkontileka abangawuqedi umsebenzi njengabantu abaphazamisa izinhlelo zikahulumeni zokunika abantu izindlu.Uthe abangawuqedi umsebenzi bazothathelwa izinyathelo, ngeke balokhu benikwa imali yokuthi baqedele ngoba leyo mali ngeyabakhokhi bentela abasuke befuna ukusiza uhulumeni ekuthuthukiseni izwe.Ugqugquzele abantu ukuba babheke izinhlelo zoMnyango wezokuHlaliswa kwaBantu zokuhlinzeka wonke umuntu ngezindlu njengoba uhulumeni ungagcini ngokukhipha izindlu zomxhaso kodwa kukhona uhlelo olokuxhasa abafuna ukuthenga umhlaba wokwakha.Uthe kukhona nohlelo lwabahola kancane abasizwa ukuthi bathole amabhondi nezinye eziqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abantu bakuleli bathola izindlu ezibuyisa isithunzi sabo.
BAZOYIKHOTHA imbenge yomile abasabisa ngodlame, abavala imigwaqo, abacekela phansi ingqalasizinda, abasabalalisa izinto ezigqugquzela udlambedlu ezinkundleni zokuxhumana nolwazi olungelona ngokhetho lukazwelonke olungenyanga ezayo.Lesi sexwayiso sikhishwe yithimba longqongqoshe ababhekelele ukuphepha njengoba ngoMeyi 29, kuzovotwa okhethweni lukazwelonke nolwezifundazwe.UNgqongqoshe wezokuVikela uNksz Thandi Modise, uxwayise ngokuthi bazoboshwa abazophazamisa ukhetho nabazophambana nomthetho ngokucindezela ilungelo labantu bakuleli.Uveze ukuthi abantu banelungelo lokukhululeka, ukuphepha nokuthi amalungelo abo angacindezelwa."Abazophambana nemigomo ebekiwe ngalesi sikhathi bangazithola sebegwetshwa iminyaka engu-30 bebhadla ejele. Sinxusa umphakathi ukuthi ungalusabalalisi ulwazi ongenabo ubuqiniso ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ngoba bazoba senkingeni. "Nalabo abahlose ukudida abavoti bazoba senkingeni,” kusho uNksz Modise esithangamini sabezindaba ePitoli, izolo. Uthe amaphoyisa azobafuna aze abathole labo abacabanga ukuthi bazosabalalisa izinto becasha ngezinkundla zokuxhumana.Unxuse nabaholi bamaqembu ngokuqaphela abakushoyo, bangakhulumi izinto ezizokwenza kube nabaphula umthetho.Umphakathi unelungelo lokuthi ubhikishe kodwa lokho kumele ukwenze ngokuthula, kungacindezelwa ilungelo labanye..Uveze ukuthi uhlaka iNATJOINTS, lizobhekana ngqo nanoma yiluphi udlame olungase luqubuke. "Umphakathi awubike noma yimaphi amacala athinta ukhetho noma udlame eziteshini zamaphoyisa noma emahhovisi ekhomishini yezoKhetho,” esho. ABAHLAZIYI bezombusazwe sebexwayise ngokuthi kungaba nomthelela ukuxoshwa komunye wabaholi ababhalisa iqembu Umkhonto weSizwe kwikhomishini yezokhetho kuleli uma kungukuthi kukhona abazozwelana naye ngalesi sinqumo sokumkhomba indlela. Laba bahlaziyi bathi leli qembu lidinga wonke umuntu ukuthi abe yingxenye yalo ikakhulu njengoba lizobe liqala ukungenela ukhetho.Bakusho lokhu kulandela ukuxoshwa kukaKhumalo namanye amalungu amane, kungakapheli sikhathi esingakanani kwehliswe esikhundleni obezomela leli qembu kwesikandunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Nhlanhla Ngidi.UKhumalo ulele endaweni yesibili ohlwini lwabantu leli qembu elibajuba ePhalamende emva kokhetho.Isitatimende esikhishwe okhulumela iqembu, uMnuz Nhlamulo Ndhlela, siveze ukuthi uKhumalo nabanye abaholi okungoMnuz Ray Khumalo, Bheki Manzini, noNksz Lebo Moepeng noRochelle Davidson, sebekhonjwe indlela."Emhlanganweni wabaholi bakazwelonke kuthathwe isinqumo sokuthi bakhonjwe indlela laba baholi. Lesi sinqumo sithathwe ngenxa yokuthi kunemizamo yalabo abafuna ukuthi lungabikhona uzinzo eqenjini kanti sithathwe ukuvikela bonke labo abafuna kube nezinguquko kuleli.” UNdhlela unxuse amalungu ukuthi athembe abaholi abamatasa nomsebenzi weqembu. Umhlaziyi uDkt Levy Ndou uthe kumele likhathazeke leli qembu ngokulahlekelwa abantu ngalesi sikhathi sokhetho.Uthe kuseva ukuthi leli qembu lingaxosha abantu ngoba libadinga kakhulu ukuze lenze umehluko okhethweni."Kolunye uhlangothi, ngeke futhi kube kuhle ukuthi njengoba iqembu kumele libe nemigomo okumele liyilandele, bese kubakhona abazokwenza umathanda. Kumele ilandelwe imigomo ebekiwe emaqenjini kungabonakali ukuthi kukhona ukukhetha iphela emasini,” kusho uNdou. Omunye umhlaziyi uSolwazi Bheki Mngomezulu, uthe bangabakhona abazozwelana noKhumalo njengoba engumuntu owabhalisa iqembu.Uthe lokhu kungadala izinxushunxushu eqenjini wathi kodwa uma abantu bezochazelwa izizathu bazoqonda okwenzekayo."Akumele kube nokukhetha iphela emasini, uma kukhona abanye abaholi abazosolwa ngokufanayo nabo kumele bakhonjwe indlela. Uma kunokungathembani eqenjini ngeke futhi ukwazi ukugcina abantu abanjalo ngoba kumele kube nemigomo ezolandelwa enhlanganweni,” kusho uMngomezulu.Ayiphumelelanga imizamo yokuxhumana noKhumalo, izolo njengoba ucingo lwakhe belukhala lungamukeli nemiyalezo.UKhumalo ubhalise leli qembu ngoSepthemba nyakenye, ngoDisemba owayengumengameli wezwe uJacob Zuma, wamemezela ukuthi uzolikhankasela.Muva nje, kuvele ukuthi uKhumalo wayethunywe nguZuma ukuthi abhalise leli qembu.Zimbuza izintatheli uKhumalo muva nje ngoqhekeko ngaphakathi eqenjini ngesikhathi kukhishwa isinqumo enkantolo yaseThekwini esachitha i-ANC mayelana nombango we-logo yaleli qembu, wathi izinkulumo ziyohlezi zikhona wathi abantu bafuna ukubona iqembu lihluleka.Waveza ukuthi izinkinga bayazilungisa.UZuma uhlezi ekuveza lapho ekhuluma khona namalungu eMK, ukuthi bazobasusa labo abagangayo eqenjini.Wathi nalabo abagaqele izikhundla ngeke balibone elidlalayo ngoba akuyona indawo yokudlalela kwiMK.Wabalula nokuthi okwamanje akekho umholi okhethiwe kodwa kusawubuholi besikhashana obubambile.Muva nje, nekhomishini yezokhetho isanda kuveza ukuthi yathola incwadi evela kwiMK, eyayiveza ukuthi sebushintshiwe ubuholi kwiMK, uZuma osehola leli qembu.
KUPHELE amahlathi oshayasibhamu bevinjezelwa amaphoyisa kuN3 phakathi kweVilliers neHeidelburg ngeSonto ebusuku.Laba baziwa njengemigulukudu esebenzisa amalambu amaphoyisa aluhlaza ukuqhuba ubugebengu bokuduna nokugebenga abantu. Laba bebelandelwa amaphoyisa ezinhlaka ezahlukene okubalwa kuzo iSAPS National Head Office Counter Intelligence, Secunda Crime Intelligence, Gauteng Tactical Response Team, Gauteng Anti-Gang Unit, DPC Tracking Team, Johannesburg K9, CAP Specialised Operations, Tracker Connect, ICB Insurance Crime Bureau, MZ Werke Security, Telesure Insurance Investigation kusukela eGrootvlei eMpumalanga. Imoto ebihamba abasolwa ngesikhathi bevinjezelwa ngamaphoyisa Isithombe:SAPSKuthiwa amaphoyisa aqale ukusola ngesikhathi ebona le moto ebihamba ngamalambu aluhlaza, aqala ukuyijaha.Bathe sebebona abasolwa ukuthi balandelwa ngamaphoyisa banyusa isivinini bazama ukubaleka bangena eZonkizizwe, Ekurhuleni. Ngokubika kwamaphoyisa, abasolwa bathe bebaleka babe bevulela ngenhlamvu bebhekise kuwo, nawo aphendula ngayo.Bathathu abasolwa abafe ujuqu endaweni yesigameko, kwasinda oyedwa okwazile ukubaleka ngezinyawo.Amaphoyisa athole izibhamu ezimbili ezingetho emthethweni nezinhlamvu kanjalo namalambu aluhlaza emotweni yabasolwa.Imoto yabasolwa okuyiToyota Hilux inikelwe kwabeVehicle Crime Investigation Unit ukuze kuqhubeke uphenyo ngayo.
UNDUNANKULU waKwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Nomusa Dube-Ncube ukhuthaze izakhamizi ukuthi zingavumi kube nabantu abasebenzisa ugesi wezinyokanyoka ukuze zigweme ukuthi ucishwe.Ukhulume kanje eseNtshanga, eThekwini ngoLwesibili ebusuku ehlangene nomphakathi.Ubekade ebungaza nawo ukuthi sekuyakhanya emuva kwesikhathi esiwunyaka nezinyanga ezine lendawo ingenawo ugesi.Kuthiwa lokhu kubangelwe wukuqhuma kwesiphehlamandla sikagesi ngenxa yabantu ababekade bezixhumele ugesi ngendlela engekho emthethweni. Kuvela ukuthi i-Eskom, okuyiyona ephakela ugesi lendawo, iyalele umuzi ngamunye ukuthi ukhokhe uR3 000 ukuze kulungiswe isiphehlimandla sikagesi ebesicekeleke phansi."Umphakathi akufanele wenze izinto ezingekho emthethweni. Kukhona abantu abawukhokhelayo ugesi bese kuba khona labo abawuntshontshayo."Ukukhokhiswa kwabo, (okwenziwe yi-Eskom), sekuzodala ukuthi wonke umuntu azibophezele, angavumi kube nabantu abawuntshontshayo ngoba naye yimali yakhe lena ayikhokhile, kuthengwa itransformer,” kusho uNkk Dube-Ncube.Uxwayise wathi umphakathi uzoba nenkinga uma ungayinakekeli ingqalasizinda yawo.Uveze ukuthi i-Eskom inomgomo wokuthi uma kusha i-transformer yenza uphenyo ithole ukuthi bangaki abantu abasebenzisa ugesi.Kuthiwa emuva kwalokho ibe isilungiswa kodwa uma iphinda isha, kumele umphakathi ukhokhe."Siwuhulumeni kube nomnikelo esiwenzayo ukuhlangabezana nomphakathi (waseNtshanga) ngoba sebekhombisile ukuthi bazimisele ukukhokhela ugesi futhi angabi khona owebayo."I-Eskom ibatshelile ukuthi uma iphinda isha i-transformer, abayisebenzisayo bazokhokha ngokuphindwe kabili imali yokuyilungisa,”kusho uNdunankulu.USomlomo kaMasipala waseThekwini, uMnuz Thabani Nyawose uthe indawo yaseNtshanga ingezinye ezihlinzekwa ugesi i-Eskom ngakho kuba lukhuni ukuthi umkhandlu ungenelele uma kunezinkinga zawo.UNyawose uthe ukujabulele ukungenelela kukaNdunankulu noNgqongqoshe kaGesi (Dkt Kgosientsho Ramokgopa) enkingeni ebikhungethe lomphakathi.Uveze ukuthi ziningi ezinye izindawo ezinenkinga efuze eyaseNtshanga okubalwa kuzona eNtshongweni, eMgababa, eMagabheni, eLovu nezinye ezihlinzekwa ugesi i-Eskom."I-Eskom ikhala ngokuthi abantu bayawuntshontsha ugesi, abawukhokheli. Siwumasipala siqale umkhankaso wokufundisa abantu ngobubi bokungawukhokheli ugesi.”Sinomsebenzi omkhulu wokufundisa abantu ngokubaluleka kokukhokhelwa kwezidingongqangi zikahulumeni,” kusho uNyawose.Uthe banethemba lokuthi nakulezi ndawo ezingenawo ugesi undunankulu uzobasiza ekutheni ubuye ngokushesha.
EZINKUNDLENI zokuxhumana sekuyinsakavukela ukuthi uzwe abantu bentela ngesihloko esimayelana nokuthwala. Ukuthwala kuchazwa abelaphi bendabuko njengemigilingwane eyenziwa kumuntu ukuze agwilike ngokushesha, imali ibuzwe kuye. Kodwa umelaphi wendabuko osezakhele udumo ngolwazi olumayelana nale migilingwane, uMnuz Sabelo Khumalo odume ngelikaSikhiye Sasejele odabuka eMalahleni eMpumalanga, uxwayisa abantu ngalo mkhuba.Uthe yize ububha bubhokile futhi abantu ngisho abasebancane belubalubela ukugwilika nempilo ewubukhazikhazi kodwa ukuthwala akuyona impendulo.Uthe lo wumkhuba oyingozi nobucayi ngendlela emangalisayo. Uthe okubuhlungu wukuthi othwalayo usuke ebeka umndeni wakhe engozini enkulu kwazise ukuthwala kona izinto eziningi emndenini yize othwele esuke esegwilikile."Inkinga ekhona kulezi zinsuku wukuthi abantu bangena kulo mkhuba bevale amehlo, amehlo abo ethe njo ekugwilikeni,” usho kanje.Uthe sekufike isikhathi sokuthi njengabelaphi bendabuko babe nezinkundla abazoxwayisa kuzo ngale migilingwane ebhubhisa imindeni yabantu abamnyama iyiqede nya.Ukhale nangalabo abathwalisayo ukuthi abachazi ngobubi balo mkhuba kulabo abasuke bezothwala noma befuna ukuthwala. Ulimise ngesihloko elokuthi umndeni uba sengozini enkulu, okubalwa kuyo nokufa uqobo. Unxuse abantu ukuba bangangeni kulolu gibe."Okunye abantu abangakwazi wukuthi izinto ezisetshenziswa uma abantu benza lo mkhuba wokuthwala, azihambisani nhlobo nedlozi,” echaza. Uthe kwalabo abasuke bethwalisa, abanandaba nokuthi bachazele kahle labo abasuke sebekhethe ukwenza lokhu."Uma ungachazelwa kahle ukuthi ukuthwala kuhanjiswa kanjani, kunamiphi imiphumela emndenini nasezinganeni zakho, ngingabeka imali phansi, ngeke uqhubeke nakho ikakhulu uma uwumuntu owuthandayo umndeni wakho.”Yize engathandanga ukuchaza ukuthi uma kuthwalwa kusuke kuzokwenzekani emindenini kodwa uthe imigilingwane ehambisana nalo mkhuba isuke ifuna igazi okungaba ngisho elomuntu.Uthe okuyinkinga ukuthi uma leso sithwalo singayitholi lento esiyifunayo, sishaya umntwana noma umzali wakho.UKhumalo uthe ubona kumqoka ukuba abantu baxwayiswe kahle ngengozi yesithwalo ukuze bengagagameli bacabangele kusona ngoba bebona bebhuqwa wububha nesifiso sokufuna ukugwilika ngokushesha.Lo melaphi ujwayele ukuzwakala emsakazweni Ukhozi, ezinkundleni zokuxhumana nasemakhasini akhe, ufundisa kabanzi abantu ngemikhuba ehambisana nokwelapha ngokwesintu okukhona kuyo udaba lokuthwetshulwa nokunye.
UMKHUZI wamaPhoyisa kuleli uGeneral Fannie Masemola, uhlabe ikhwelo emaphoyiseni ukuthi abhalisele ukuvota ngokuyisipesheli njengoba ngosuku lokhetho ezobe ejutshwe ezindaweni ezehlukene.UMasemola uthe njengoba ngokhetho lukazwelonke ngoMeyi 29, ezobe esebenzela ezindaweni ezehlukene, kubalulekile ukuthi azifake lezi zicelo zokuvota ngokuyisipesheli kwiKhomishini yezoKhetho ngoba azobe engekho ezindaweni ahlala kuzona.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi kulolu khetho umuntu akakwazi ukuvota lapho engahlali khona njengoba kubalula umthetho.Ukuze ukwazi ukusheshe uvote kumele ufake isicelo kwi-IEC sokuthi usheshe uvote lapho uhlala khona ngoMeyi 27 noMeyi 28. "Kubalulekile ukuthi nisebenzise ilungelo lenu lokuthi nisheshe nibhalisele ukuvota ngokuyisipesheli. Uma ungakasifaki isicelo, yisikhathi esikahle ukuthi usifake ukuze ukwazi ukuvota,” kusho uMasemola.Uyalele oKhomanda ukuthi baluleke abasebenzi ababaphethe uma kunemihlangano ukuthi babhalisele ukuvota.Ukufaka isicelo sokuvota ngokuyisipesheli kwi-IEC kuvala ngoMeyi 3. Khonamanjalo uMkhuzi wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uLieutenant-General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, uveze ukuthi kuzotshalwa amaphoyisa angu-17 000 ngesikhathi sokhetho esifundazweni.UMkhwanazi uthe awekho amaphoyisa azohlaba ikhefu ngesikhathi sokhetho.Uthe ukutshalwa kwalawa maphoyisa kuzodla uR40 million.Ukhale ngokuthi kunezikhungo zokuvota abazobe beziqaphe ngelokhozi ukuze kungabi nobugebengu.Wabalula nokuthi kumele ngabe bagxila ekuphenyeni amacala abaxakile obugebengu okubalwa ukudlwengula, ukubulala namanye kodwa kudingeka bagade ukhetho. Kwenzeka lokhu nje, kusasa uMkhandlu woNgqongqoshe bezokuPhepha kuleli, bazophefumula ngamalungiselelo alolu khetho.Abazobe behola lesi sithangami kubalwa uNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa uMnuz Bheki Cele, owezokuVikela uNkk Thandi Modise kanjalo nowezaseKhaya uDkt Aaron Motsoaledi.
KUME nse ukufunda esikoleni Incinjane Secondary, ePieters, eMnambithi. Lokhu kwenzeke ngemva kokuthi abazali nabafundi bebhikishili besola uthisha ofundisa izibalo ngokuthi udakwa kuze kuphazamiseke umsebenzi.Isolezwe Ngempelasonto lithole ngomthombo walo ukuthi bekunganyakazi lutho esikoleni abazali nabafundi bethi isibami emphinjeni indaba kathisha futhi akathathelwa izinyathelo. Kuthiwa okubi kakhulu wukuthi ufundisa izibalo kumatric nokuyinto ebucayi kanti ubuye afundise neNatural Science.Kuthiwa uthisha uyabudlonya utshwala akabudlalisi futhi kwesinye isikhathi uze ahambe efunwa nguthishanhloko emashibhini uma engasafiki esikoleni.ABAFUNDI bebemi izixukwana ngaphandle kwesikole bebhikishela uthisha okuthiwa uyeqisa ezinkambeni aze akhohlwe wukufundisa Isithombe : SITHUNYELWEUSihlalo wesigungu esephethe isikole uMnuz Sibongiseni Madlala, uthe impela babhekene nengwadla futhi bafuna isukunyelwe ngokushesha." Uma kuholiwe nje kuyaziwa ukuthi akabe eseza emsebenzini isonto lonke, kuthiwa uhamba ephuza nasemajoyintini endawo. Uma kufanele kuphume imiphumela yezingane, ayiphumi ngoba izifundo zakhe azimakiwe ngakho amamaki awekho,’’ kuchaza uMadlala.UMadlala uthe abantu bendawo baze bamncishe utshwala bethi akahambe aye emsebenzini kodwa abufune ezingojeni aze abuthole bese ehlala khona lize lishone.Uthe kuyabakhathaza lokhu ngoba sekuze kwehlisa izinga lokuphasa isikole besiphasa ngo95% sehlile safika ko63% kanti izibalo zizodwa nje imiphumela yazo iwu-33%. Uthe uphenyo lukhomba ukuthi uselove izinsuku ezingu-222 selokhu afika ngo-2018 kulesi sikole.Kuthiwa akukho okungazanywanga ngoba uke watholelwa usizo wayiswa esikhungweni sabasiza abaxakwe yinkinga yezidakamizwa. Kuthiwa waya kabili washiya phansi, bezwa kuthiwa ubuyele emashibhini aphuza kuwona.Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz uMuzi Mahlambi uthe wudaba olukhathaza kakhulu olufuna ukusukunyelwa ngokushesha nangokukucophelela lolu."Ihhovisi lesifunda luzolusebenza udaba sizame ukuthi simsize lo msebenzi wethu. Siwumnyango onakekekelayo yingakho sizoqala ngokumfunela usizo. Uma kuya ngokuthi izinkinga ziyadlondlobala siyobe sesidlulela ekuqondiseni ubugwegwe,’’ kusho uMahlambi.Leli phephandaba lithole ukuthi ngesikhathi kunombhikisho izikhulu zomnyango esifundeni zifikile zathembisa ukuthi kuzolethwa abanye othisha ababili. Kuvele ukuthi lo thisha onenkinga usethunyelwe ukuyothola usizo.Imizamo yokumthola uthisha ayiphumelelanga izinombolo zakhe bezingasebenzi. Kuthiwa uyawalahla amaselula uhlala engatholakali ocingweni.
KUTHUKUTHELE iJaji uRatha Makgoatlheng, elengamele ukuqulwa kwecala lokufa kukaSenzo Meyiwa ngesikhathi kuvela ukuthi omunye wabameli akafikanga ngenxa yokugula.UMeyiwa owayeyisilomo sikanozinti we-Orlando Pirates neBafana Bafana, wadutshulwa wabulawa ekubo kwentombi yakhe uKelly Khumalo eVosloorus, eGauteng ngo-2014.Icala lisesigabeni lapho uMbuso uqhubeka nokweneka ubufakazi onabo. NgoLwesihlanu bekufundwa ubufakazi bamabhange abamangalelwa.Kuthe kuqala icala ngoLwesihlanu kwavela ukuthi u-Advocate Thulani Mngomezulu akekho ubike ukugula. UMngomezulu ungummeli wommangalelwa wokuqala uMuzikawukhulelwa Sibiya.Ijaji uRatha Mokgoatlheng Isithombe: Oupa Mokoena / African News Agency (ANA)Umbiko kaMngomezulu wethulwe wu-Advovate Zandile Mshololo ethi wuyena ozombambela kodwa ngeke akwazi ukupheka ufakazi ngemibuzo kuzolindwa uMngomezulu. IJaji licikwe wukuthi uMngomezulu akabikanga kulona ngokugula kwakhe kodwa ubikele u-Advocate Mshololo."Buka nje uyakwazi ukushayela uzakwabo ucingo kodwa akakwazi ukushayela ijaji. Ubhalele umabhalane wami kodwa akangibhaleli mina. Uma umuntu ebikela ijaji kufanele lithole ithuba lokumbuza imibuzo ukuthi akezi ngani kodwa yena ubhale incwadi,’’ kusho ijaji.Kuvele ukuthi abehhovisi likaMngomezulu babhalele umabhalane wejaji bebika lolu daba kodwa ijaji lathi akwenele lokho.Ijaji lithe yingakho lize lathetha, likhala ngokuthi abanye abameli abawahloniphi amajaji."Manje usesitshela ukuthi uyoze apheke ufakazi ngemibuzo uma esebuyile ekubeni wazi kahle ukuthi imigomo ithi kufanele kuqale ummeli kamsolwa wokuqala,’’ kubhoka ijaji. Lithethe laze labuza ukuthi ithini imithetho yokusebenza.Ijaji lithe kwalona qobo lwalo liyabika kubaphathi balo uma libambezelekile lingeke lifike ngesikhathi futhi libika ngendlela efanele.Kwenzeka lokhu nje ijaji belisanda kutholana phezulu noMngomezulu kubangwa yona indaba yokugula. UMngomezulu wayecele ukuthi icala liguqe ekhala ngeso lakhe kodwa ijaji lanqaba lathi lizomnika umuthi weso.Ngaphambi kwalokho ijaji lake lakhononda ngabameli abamnyama libasola ngobuhlathi kodwa lagcina lixolisa ngoba inhlangano yabo yayivutha. Kulindeleke ukuthi icala liqhubeke ngoMsombuluko.

Ngesikhathi bengena emotweni, kuphume omunye wesilisa naye owuhlanga lwabo, wavulela ngenhlamvu ebhekise kubona,” kusho amaphoyisa ngesitatimende.Kushone owesimame oyedwa, abanye baphuthunyiswa esibhedlela besesimeni esibucayi.Amaphoyisa asendaweni yesigameko njengoba uphenyo luqhubeka ukuze kutholakale imbangela yokuhlaselwa kwalaba kanye nomsolwa okukholakala ukuthi ubalekile.

BABHODLA umlilo abantu abazivocavoca eVirgin Active, eMoses Mabhida, eThekwini, kulandela ukubonakala kwendle endaweni yokubhukuda.Ngokuthola kweSolezwe, umuntu obone lesi simanga, umuntu ozivocavoca kule ndawo, abaphethe bethule bengayithi vu.NgeSonto eledlule, amanye amalungu athathe isinqumo sokuthumela abameli bawo ukuthi bathumele incwadi ephuthumayo kubaphathi bendawo yokuzivocavoca.Kule ncwadi, Isolezwe eliyibonile ikhophi yayo, amalungu abuza iziphathimandla ukuthi ukube ilungu elithile belingathwebulanga izithombe, lazifaka kwi-Whatsapp Group yasejimini, bekuzokwaziwa nini ukuthi kunalesi simo endaweni yokubhukuda?"Ngokubuka ubuningi bendle, singasho singananazi ukuthi amanzi angcolile. Nakanjani, lesi sigameko sizoba nomthelela wezempilo ongemuhle kumuntu ozithole ebhukuda kula manzi,” kusho incwadi.Iqhube yathi, kungani amalungu engaziswanga ukuze ezoyigwema indawo yokubhukuda isikhashana.INDLE phakathi endaweni yokubhukuda eVirgin Active eMoses Mabhida Ibuye yathi njengamalungu endawo yokuzivocavoca, bazokwazi ngani ukuthi ngokuzayo, into efana nale ngeke iphinde ifihlwe njengoba kwenzekile kulokhu?"Abantu bazophathwa yizifo zamehlo, izindlebe, amakhala, umphimbo, ukuphefumula nokukhishwa yizisu, bengazi ukuthi imbangela kube ukusebenzisa indawo yokubhukuda enendle,” kusho incwadi.Oyinhloko yophiko olubhekelela amakhasimende, uNksz Jacqui Walter, uthe iVirgin Active ihlale iqinisekisa ukuthi ezempilo nezokuphepha ziseqopheleni eliphezulu."Imenenja ebisebenza iyilandele imigudu efanele ngeSonto ebusuku. Sesiphenyile sathola ukuthi ilungu elithintekayo linokugula okuthile kanti izinyathelo ezifanele ukulungisa lolu daba sezithathiwe,” kusho uWalter. Uthe ngaphezu kwalokho, kukhona umyalezo othunyelwe kuwo wonke amalungu ngeWhatsapp group ngo-5:30 ngoMsombuluko ekuseni.Uphinde wathi babuye bathumela amaSMS, abesho ukuthi indawo yokubhukuda ivaliwe futhi isazohlolwa iphinde ikhucululwe ngaphambi kokuthi ivulwe. "Uma kwenzekile kwakhona ukungcoliswa kwendawo yokubhukuda ngendle, siye sisheshe siyivale, siyisuse indle, sihlole amazinga e-chlorine ne-pH kuyima siyivula uma konke sekubuyele esimweni esifanele,” usho kanje.
USEPHUMELE obala wazwakalisa isifiso sakhe sokubona ibandla aliholayo libuyela esimweni elaliyiso ngaphambilini, uMfu Bonginkosi Ngcobo oyiNhloko yeBandla, iGadner Mvuyane African Congregational Church of Southern Africa.UNgcobo ophinde abe ngusomabhizinisi uqale ukuhola leli bandla njengoMengameli walo ngo-2018.Ugonyuluke ngesifiso sakhe sokubona leli bandla libuyela esimweni. Uthe kwaba yishwa elikhulu ukuthi esanda kungena ekuholeni leli bandla kwavumbuka ukhuvethe lweCovid 19.Ulimise ngesihloko elokuthi labashiya nezibazi. Uthe kuyimanje kuningi okungahambi kahle ebandleni kusukela ngaleso sikhathi."Iqiniso elimsulwa ukuthi iCovid -19 yasishiya nezibazi ezinkulu. Kuyimanje sisalwa nazo lezo zibazi,'' usho kanje.Uveze ukuthi ukhuvethe lwadala umoya wobuvila kubazalwane, lwaphinda lwaqeda imisebenzi kwabanye.Uthe kodwa ukufadabala nokudlondlobala kwaleli bandla kuncike kakhulu kubaholi balo abathathu.Labo baholi ubagagule ngamagama wathi nguMfu B.W. Ngcobo, uMfu B.H. Msibi noMfu M.A. Hlatshwayo.Lawa madoda uthe anobuhlakani obanele bokuqinisekisa ukuthi leli bandla alifadabali, kodwa liyakhula."Nami ngiyazibala kulawo madoda okumele enze isiqiniseko sokuthi leli bandla liyama noma ngabe sekunzima kangakanani."Uma limile kuyodunyiswa uNkulunkulu ngesikwenzile, kodwa uma lifadabala kuyoba kubi. Kuyobe kwenzeka ezandleni zethu,'' usho kanje.Ukhulume nangezinhlelo ezihlabahlosile leli bandla eliye libe nazo. Ezinye zazo ukulekelelwa kwamalungu omphakathi aswele.Ukhulume nangohlelo abanalo lokukhuthaza ezemfundo kubantu abasha bebandla. "Sikholwa ukuthi ezemfundo ziwumgogodla omkhulu kubona bonke abantu abasha bethu,'' usho kanje.
BADINGA ukunikezwa uthando abantwana bamantombazane abatholele abantwana emakhaya kunokuthi bahlulelwe ngamaphutha abawenze ngaphambilini.Lona bekuwumongo wenkulumo kaMfu Thandi Ngonelo we-Acts of Obedience Ministries ngesikhathi ekhuluma engqungqutheleni iLadies Tea yamashumi amabili nesithupha.Le ngqungquthela ibibanjelwe esakhiweni sebandla lakhe esiku-37 Qashana Khuzwayo (Shepstone Road), eNew Germany.Le ngqungquthela ihlanganisa abesifazane abehlukene abavela ezifundazweni zakuleli, okuxoxwa kuyo ngezingqinamba abesifazane abazithoa bebhekana nazo empilweni.Inhloso yayo wukucija abesifazane nokubakhuthaza ukuthi bangaliphosi ithawula kunoma yini abahlangabezana nayo ebudeni bendlela.Kube kuningi kakhulu uMfu Ngonelo akhulume ngakho kabanzi enkulumweni yakhe.Eqhulwini uNgonelo ukhulume ngephutha athe lenziwa ngabazali lokwahlulela izingane zabo zamantombazane ezitholela abantwana ekhaya.Ugcizelele ukuthi leli yiphutha okumele abazali bangabe besalenza."Awukho umgqomo wokulahla umuntu. Masizithande singazehluleli izingane zethu zamantombazane ezitholele abantwana emakhaya,'' usho kanje.Uthe ukuze abesifazane babe nekusasa eliqhakazile, kungakuhle ukuthi basheshe bathole injongo yabo yokuphila bese beba nentshisekelo yokufinyelela kulokho abakudingayo.Abazali uthe kumele bakhumbule nokuthi ziningi izilingo esezikhona manje ezingagcina zikhinyabeza amantombazane amancane.Noma esho kanje kodwa uthe ngale nkulumo yakhe akahlosile khona ukubavuna."Empeleni akekho umuntu wesifazane okumele atholele umntwana ekhaya okanye esemncane."Kumele owesifazane osemncane umqondo wakhe ugxile ekuqhakaziseni ikusasa lakhe ngezindlela eziningi, njengokufunda nokuzithuthukisa, esho.UNgonelo waziwa kakhulu ngenhlangano yakhe ebizwa ngokuthi yiPalm Tree nayo ejwayele ukuhlela izingqungquthela zabesifazane.Ibandla aliholayo uNgonelo laziwa kakhulu ngokunakekela umphakathi elikuwona ngezindlela ezahlukene.Isikhulumi sosuku bekunguDkt Pinky Ngcakani-Ncula umongo wenkulumo yakhe ubumayelana nokubaluleka kokuzethemba kubantu besifazane.

Wayedlisa ngengoma eyayisihloko sithi Imali yomntwana.Waqopha umlando ngokuthi abe ngumculi wokuqala ngqa wesifazane waseZayoni ukucula ngayedwana kulolu hlobo lomculo.
ISOSHA laqhulula umkalo ngezinhlamvu eziyisithupha; okwaba eyodwa ekhanda, ezine entanyeni neyodwa esifubeni kanti lalimi phezu kombhede okwakulele kuwona umufi, lakwenza phambi kwezingane zalo nomkhwekwazi walo emzini wabo ePinetown, eThekwini, ngoJanuwari 3.Lokhu kuqukethwe esitatimendeni esifungelwe somphenyi wecala uSergeant Sugar Sosibo esethulelwe enkantolo.Isosha lombutho wezempi (reservist), uMnuz Lwanda Zungu (37), ugqigqa iNkantolo yeMantshi yasePinetown, ucela ibheyili ecaleni athweswe lona lokubulala ngokuyinhloso umkakhe, uNkk Tania Msane-Zungu (36).UZungu usolwa ngokuthi watshela enye yezingane zakhe, ngesikhathi zigijimela ekameleni labo (benomufi) nogogo wazo bezwa umufi ekhala efuna usizo, ukuthi ayikhululeke wase eyadubula."Waqeda ukudubula umufi amahlandla ayisithupha, wabaleka esegcwele igazi. Endleleni wasabisa umakhelwane wakhe owayezobheka ukuthi kwenzakalani, wathi uzomdubula waqede wamqhulula ngamatshe,” kuchaza uSosibo.Incwadi kaSosibo ifundwe ngumshushisi uMnuz Ehud-Jadon Francke echazela imantshi uWendalynn Robinson.UZungu wazinikela emaphoyiseni ngoJanuwari 5, emuva kokushayelwa ucingo nguBrigadier Cele ngoba wayengaziwa ukuthi ukuziphi izinkalo.Kubikwa nokuthi umufi waxoxela umama umfundisi, uNkk Londi Ndimande, ngoFebhuwari 14, 2022, ukuthi wabikela uyise mhlazane eshaywa uZungu.Kuthiwa ubaba kamufi wameluleka wathi akahlukane noZungu ngoba kuyacaca ukuthi uzombulala. Kubikwa ukuthi umufi watshela uyise ukuthi usemxolele uZungu."Ubaba kamufi wathi uyasihlonipha isinqumo asesithathile kodwa uma kwenzeka ebulawa uZungu ngeke alubhade yena lapho,” kufunda umshushisi.NgoNovemba nyakenye, kuthiwa umufi wacela usizo lwezomthetho kummeli u-Advocate Bongumusa Sishanga ngemigudu angayilandela ukuze athole incwadi yenkantolo ezovimba uZungu ukuthi asondele eduze kwakhe. Kuthiwa umufi wathi uZungu ungumuntu onodlame futhi usabela impilo yakhe neyomndeni wakhe nokuthi usefuna incwadi yesehlukaniso somshado.UMbuso uthi akanganikezwa ibheyili uZungu ngoba akanalo ikheli eliqondile lalapho ehlala khona, akanayo impahla ebiza yena, unencwadi yokuhambela amanye amazwe, ubeqashwe umbutho wezempi kuleli kodwa eyi-reservist."Uma ededelwa ngebheyili kuyafana ngoba umbutho wezempi ngeke umbizele emsebenzini, okuyinto oyishilo. UZungu uyabazi ofakazi, wabulala umkakhe, yini engamvimba ukuthi ababulale nabo? Angalibalekela icala,” kusho uFrancke.Ummeli kaZungu, u-Advocate Muzi Mzelemi, uthe singamampunge isithombe esizanywa ukudwetshwa uMbuso ngomsolwa. Uthe akukho namunye umuntu owaziyo ukuthi kwakwenzekani kuleya ndlu ngosuku lwesigameko. Ucele imantshi imnikeze ibheyili uZungu, aphume ayosebenza ondle izingane zakhe.Udalule nokuthi anganikwa nombandela wokubosholewa endlini aphume uma eyosebenza kuphela izingane zakhe zingaphili impilo yokukhangeza ekubeni ekhona edla anhlamvana.Imantshi kulindeleke isikhiphe ngoMsombuluko isinqumo ngebheyili.
INKANTOLO yoMthethosisekelo yamukele isicelo soMkhonto weSizwe (MK), sokwelulelwa isikhathi sokufaka amaphepha ecala lombango wokungena kukaMnuz Jacob Zuma, ePhalamende.NgoDisemba nyakenye, uZuma umemezele ukuthi weseka iqembu elisha Umkhonto weSizwe, akasayingeni indaba ye-ANC. KUHLATSHWE ikhwelo emaqenjini angenele ukhetho lukazwelonke ukuthi ahloniphe isibopho asenzile sokuthi ukhetho luzoba nokuthula futhi luzobe lukhululekile.Lokhu kuvele esitatimendeni somhlangano oyisipesheli weKhabhinethi, njengoba ngenyanga ezayo kunokhetho lukazwelonke nolwezifundazwe ngoMeyi 29. Okhulumela uhulumeni uNksz Nomonde Mnukwa, uthe konke sekumi ngomumo ngalolu khetho njengoba neKhomishini yezoKhetho ibisayinisa abaholi bamaqembu izibopho zokuthi ukhetho luzoba nokuthula nokukhululekile.Uthe lesi sibopho kumele sihlonishwe njengoba sibeka imigomo okumele ilandelwe."IKhabhinethi inxusa abantu ukuthi baphume bayovota, nokuthi kuzoba nokuthula ngesikhathi sokhetho. Njengoba izwe ligubha iminyaka engu-30 lakhululeka, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baphume bayovota bakhumbule ukhetho lokuqala lwango-1994.” Khonamanjalo, i-IEC ithe isiwuqalile umsebenzi wokugaya amaphepha okuvota njengoba bengu-27.7 million abantu ababhalisele ukuvota.Lesi yisibalo esikhulu sabantu abake babhalisa kuleli selokhu kwaqala ngo-1999, ukusebenzisa umqulu wokuvota. Ikhomishini idalule embikweni wasePhalamende ukuthi inike amaqembu amelwe kule ndlu uR342 million onyakeni wezimali u-2022/2023.Iveze ukuthi amaqembu amane awazange anikwe ingxenye yemali yawo ngoba awazange ahambisane nemigomo edingwa ngumthetho olawula ukuxhaswa kwamaqembu, iPolitical Party Funding Act. La maqembu yi-African Independent Congress, Cope, NFP nePan Africanist Congress of Azania.Umgomo wePolitical Party Funding Act, udinga ukuthi amaqembu adalule abawaxhasa ngemali uma sebenikele ngemali esuka kuR100 000 kuya phezulu. Le mali kumele ayidalule ezinsukwini ezingu-30, enikelelwe. I-IEC ibe isishicilela uhlu lwamaqembu anikelelwe kanjalo nabaxhasi.Ikhomishini iveze ukuthi angu-537 amaqembu abhalisiwe kuleli. Angu-322 kuwo abhalise kuzwelonke kuthi angu-214, abhalise ezifundazweni.Angu-167 kwangu-537 amelwe ePhalamende naseziShayamthetho. Kuphinde kwavela ukuthi i-ANC iyona ethole imali eningi evela kwikhomishini njengoba ithole uR148 milllion. I-DA yona ithole uR62.7 million, kulandele i-EFF ngoR40.9 million, namanye amaqembu.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi bangu-14 889 abazobanga izihlalo okhethweni ekubeni izihlalo zingu-887, ezihlanganisa ezingu-400 ePhalamende, kuthi ezinye ezaseziShayamthetho zezifundazwe.Ikhomishini ivule iwindi lalabo abazobe besebenza noma bengekho lapho bevotela khona ngosuku lokhetho ukuthi bafake izicelo zokuvota ngokuyisipesheli.Leli windi livalwa ngoMeyi 3. Kulolu khetho ngeke uvunyelwe ukuvota lapho ungahlali khona.Ukuvota ngokuyisipesheli kuqala ngoMeyi 27 noMeyi 28.

Imvamisa abantu abafika bezofuna usizo, basuke sebenenkinga yemali, omunye esecwile ezikweletini ngendlela emangalisayo, njengoba uma sesikungene kahle egazini ungasibhema noma ikathathu ngosuku,” usho kanje.Uthe abazisebenzisayo akulula ukuthi babonakale njengoba iningi lapho lingabantu ababukeka bephumelele, abagqoka kahle futhi abahloniphekile ngenxa yemisebenzi abayenzayo noma iqhaza abanalo emphakathini. Uveze ukuthi osomabhizinisi abadlondlobele nabo bagcina bedla lesi sidakamizwa esishaya kuzwele ephaketheni."Okunye ngaso ukuthi sinomona, asisebenziseki nolunye uhlobo lwesidakamizwa. Umuntu ungamfica ephethe ikani likabhiya endaweni yobumnandi kuze kuse engaliqedile ngoba usuke ebheme sona. Uma sibuza ababhema intashi ukuthi yimuphi umuzwa abasuke abanawo uma sebeyisebenzisile, baveza ukuthi ibanika umdlandla kanti bazizwa behlala benomuzwa wenjabulo ephuphumayo nje emva kokubhema,” kusho uMsomiUthe imvamisa abantu abasisebenzisayo baneminyaka esuka ku-19 kuyaphezulu. Uthe abanye asebengenwe kahle yilesi sidakamizwa abafika kuyena baveza ukuthi sebesebenzise imali mhlawumbe abebeyilondolozele izinhlelo ezithile zokuthuthukisa imindeni, noma sebedayise impahla ebalulekile kubalwa imizi nezimoto ngenxa yokungena shi ezindlekweni. Izingane ezishiyelwe amafa ngabazali imvamisa zigcina imali ziyibhubhudle ngaso.Uveze ukuthi sehluke kakhulu kulezi ezinye, ngakho umzali akulula ukuthi asheshe aqaphele ukuthi ingane iyasisebenzisa ngoba asikhahlazani emzimbeni futhi osesebenzisayo umuntu obukeka ehlanzekile, futhi nabantu asuke ehamba nabo benza abone ingane yakhe iphephile futhi inekusasa eliqhakazile ngendlela ababukeka ngayo, kwesinye isikhathi abahlonipheka ngayo emphakathini. Kwezinye izidakamizwa okubalwa kuzo iwunga notshwala imvamisa kuba wukududana kwabangani kodwa kulolu hlobo kuthiwa umuntu uyazikhethela yena ngoba ebona uhlobo lwabantu abasuke besisebenzisa ezibuka yena kubona.Nakhu ongakuqaphela uma umuntu esebenzisa iCocaine.Uvamise ukucinanaUbukeka ejabule ngokweqile ebhemile noma abhocobale uma engabhemileAkasebenzisi ezinye izidakamizwa, uma kwenzeka akagxili kuzo

SEBUTHATHE elinye igxathu ubugebengu baKwaBester, eNanda njengoba kubikwa ukuthi izigelekeqe sezibamba abantu inkunzi ematekisini.Kubikwa ukuthi nasematekisini ahambela eMlaza emzileni wakwaM&R, kukhalwa esifanayo.Ngokuthola kweSolezwe ziyisithupha izigameko KwaBester lapho abasolwa bezenza khona abagibeli ngenhloso yokubamba inkunzi.Ngokusho kwelinye lamalungu aqapha ubugebengu kule ndawo, uMnuz Mfaniseni Mthethwa, lolu hlobo lobugebengu luqale emasontweni amathathu edlule."Singakuqinisekisa impela ukuthi kuyiqiniso lokho. Siqale ukubikelwa ngakho emasontweni amathathu edlule."Kuvela ukuthi izigilamkhuba zihamba ngazimbili, zima esitobhini, zimise itekisi sabantu abafuna ukugibela,” kusho uMthethwa.Uqhube wathi, umshayeli wetekisi uvele ame ngenkulu inkululeko, ezitshela ukuthi ngabantu abafuna ukugibela."Bathi uma bevula isicabha babeke unyawo lokuqala etekisini, kube sengathi bayagibela, ngokuphazima kweso bese bekhipha izibhamu, batshele wonke umuntu osuke engaphakathi ukuthi akalethe iselula yakhe nesikhwama,” kulandisa uMthethwa.Uthi baphinde baphendule umbhobho wesibhamu, ubheke ngakumshayeli, bamfune yonke imali aseyisebenzile.Ubuye waveza ukuthi lezi zigelekeqe azigcini lapho, uma zibone izingubo ezizithandayo zigqokwe ngabagibeli, ziyabakhumulisa zizithathe. Lo mkhuba, uthe wenzeka kusuka KwaBester erenki, uze uyoshaya eDube Village eNanda.Ukhale ngobugebengu obuphezulu, wathi isimo asisalawuleki.Echaza ngokwamenza wajoyina izinhlaka ezilwa nobugebengu nyakenye, uthe kwaba yisigameko sokudlwengulwa kowesifazane wendawo, ngamalungu egenge angu-12.Kwenye i-voice note ethunyelelwe Isolezwe, omunye wabashayeli uveze ukuthi sebeyisithupha abashayeli asebebanjwe inkunzi ematekisini abahamba ngawo."Bafika noplastic, bathathe yonke into. Mina nje laphaya eZintombini angisagibezi muntu ongimisayo. Laba bafana sebesihlukumeze kakhulu, baphatha izibhamu,” kusho umshayeli.Uthe omunye uzakwabo ubanike uR300, omunye wabasolwa wafaka izinhlamvu esibhamini, watshela umshayeli ukuthi uma eqeda ukuzifaka bazozithulula kuyena zonke."Bathe imali agoloza nayo akuyona eyakhe ngoba itekisi akuyona eyakhe, ngeke kube ukuthi ngo-4.30 ntambama usasebenze uR300 kuphela, wavele wabanika yonke umshayeli," kusho umshayeli.Uthe naKwaBester erenki ngezikhathi zasekuseni, bahlale bedlula abesifazane bekhala ubumayemaye, bephucwa izikhwama."Kwenye itekisi bathe uma sebeqede ukubabamba inkunzi bababuza ukuthi bayayazi yini iWest, baphendula ngokuthi cha, bathi iWest yibona, banamalungu angu-200, ngeke benziwe lutho,” kusho umshayeli.Umsunguli weNtuzuma Neighbourhood Watch, esisabalale nakwamanye amalokishi eTheku afana noMlaza, KwaMashu neNanda, uMnuz Andile Jali uthe isimo sakuleya ndawo sesidinga iNatonal Intervetion Unit (NIU).Udalule ukuthi sekukhona imindeni esithuthile endaweni, ixoshwa yigenge yeWest ne-East."Bafuna ukuthi kube khona izindlu ezingahlali muntu ukuze bezothi uma beqeda ukucanasa, bahlale kuzo. ”Leya ndawo ayisalawuleki. Namalungu ethu asenomuzwa wokuthi impilo yawo isengcupheni njengoba eqapha ubugebengu engenazikhali. Lama genge afuna ukuyiphatha indawo,” kusho uJali.Okhulumela iSouth African National Taxi Association (SANTACO) KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Sfiso Shangase uthe lobu bugebengu buyisihlava abasigxekayo."Sibuhlungu ngoba kuhlukumezeka abagibeli ezimotweni zethu. Siphinde siphathwe kabi wukuthi nathi siyalahlekelwa uma kuphucwa nabashayeli imali abasuke beyisebenzile,” kusho uShangase.Uqhube wathi lukhona uhlelo abaphezu kwalo lokuzama ukuqinisekisa ukuphepha kwabagibeli kulezi zigilamkhuba kodwa wathi akafuni ukudalula yonke into."Zingaze zithole ngezinhlelo esinazo zokulwisana nobugebengu bazo,” kusho yena.Uphinde wathi bagqugquzela osomatekisi ukuthi bafake amakhamera ematekisini abo ngoba nawo ayasiza ngobufakazi obuqandula ikhanda.Ihhovisi lezokuxhumana emaphoyiseni aKwaZulu-Natal, lithe lidinga imininingwane egcwele ngezigameko ukuze likwazi ukubheka ukuthi akhona yini amacala avuliwe ngalokhu.

KUPHELILE ukuvalelwa ngaphandle kwabalimi abancane bakamoba KwaZulu-Natal njengoba ngoLwesine benikwe umqulu obangenisa embonini kashukela. UNgqongqoshe wezoLimo nokuThuthukiswa kweziNdawo zaseMakhaya, uNkk Thoko Didiza nowezoHwebo, iziMboni nokuNcintisana uMnuz Ebrahim Patel bafake iSouth African Farmers Development Association (Safda) ngaphansi kwemboni kashukela.Kuyaqala ngqa ukuthi usoseshini wabalimi abamnyama abancane uhlale nososeshini abakhulu embonini kashukela eneminyaka ewu-180.INJABULO ibibhalwe ebusweni kuSihlalo weSafda, uDkt Siyabonga Madlala ngesikhathi enikwa igazethi ebamukela ngokusemthethweni embonini kashukela wuNgqongqoshe wezoHwebo, iziMboni nokuNcintisana uMnuz Ebrahim Patel Isithombe:DTILokhu kusho ukuthi iSafda isizohlala etafuleni elilodwa neSouth African Sugar Association nezinye izinhlangano ezisembonini kashukela.UDkt Siyabonga Madlala onguSihlalo weSafda, uthe kuqopheke umlando njengoba sebezohlala nezinye izinhlangano zemboni kashukela."Kudala besingamukelekile lapha KwaShukela besithathwa njengabashokobezi. "Lolu suku lwanamhlanje luzosiza abalimi abancane bakamoba nezizukulwane ezizayo ngoba kusho ukuthi izwi lethu selizozwakala ngokwenzeka embonini esisebenza kuyo,” kusho uDkt Madlala.Ubalule ukuthi kubathathe iminyaka eyisishiyagalolunye ukuba bafike kulesi sigaba ngoba baqale bavalelwa ngaphandle, kodwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi bebehlala isikhashana bese ubulungu babo buphelelwa yisikhathi."Namuhla ugogo waseMakhathini nomunye olima umoba uzoba nezwi embonini kamoba. Siyabonga kakhulu kongqongqoshe bethu ngokusisukumela singabalimi abancane."Sizoqhubeka nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa abalimi esizenzayo namanje ngoba sifuna le mboni iqhubeke nokukhula,” kusho uMadlala.UNkk Didiza uthe kuningi okuzayo embonini kamoba ngoba abafuni nje igcine ngokukhiqiza ushukela kodwa bafuna yenze nophethroli ozosetshenziswa ngamabhanoyi.Bafuna amakhasi omoba asetshenziselwe ukwenza ugesi nokunye okuningi. UPatel uthe beza nohlelo lokufukula imboni olubizwa ngeSugar Industry Masterplan, babefuna ukuthi imboni ibe nazo zonke izinhlaka zakuleli."Selokhu saba nohlelo lweSugar Industry Masterplan sesikwazile ukunyusa umkhiqizo kashukela ngo-23%. Sikwazile ukusayina izivumelwano nabasebenzisa ushukela ukuba bathenge owakuleli kanti sinentela ekhokhwa ushukela wangaphandle ukuvikela imboni yethu.Isibonelo uma kade sikhiqiza amasaka amane kashukela kudala, sesikhiqa amahlanu manje. Uma besithenga amasaka amathathu phesheya manje sesithenga amabili,” kusho uPatel.Uthe kusukela ngo-2019 kuze kube manje bebesebenzela ukuletha uzinzo embonini kashukela.Kuzothi esigabeni sesibili basebenzele ukuyikhulisa kakhulu lemboni njengoba sebebheka nezinye izinto abangazenza ngomoba.U-Adv Fay Mukaddam onguSihlalo weSouth African Sugar Association (Sasa), uthe bayalwemukela uguquko olukhona embonini kashukela.Uthe bayajabula ukuthi iSafda isiyilungu eligcwele elizothola yonke imihlomulo etholwa ngabanye ososeshini bemboni.
BAKHALA ngobunzima oMasipala baKwaZulu-Natal abathi bakweletwa yiminyango kahulumeni u-R3 billion. Usihlalo wenhlangano yomasipala, iSA Local Government (Salga) KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli uthe omasipala nabo sebephoqeleka ukutsheleka imali abazoyisebenzisa ngesikhathi besalinde ukuthi iminyango kahulumeni ibakhokhele.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba ngezinkinga ezikhungethe omasipala, izolo eThekwini.UNtuli uthe kungokokuqala emlandweni ukuthi isikweletu seminyango kahulumeni sifike kuR3 billion.Iminyango ekweleta kakhulu owezeMpilo, owezeMfundo nowezeMisebenzi yoMphakathi.Isikweletu esikhulu esamanzi, kube esama-rates nesikagesi.Uthe sekuyinto eyejwayelekile ukuthi omasipala bazithole bephoqeleka ukudala izikweletu ngenxa yokwanda komkhuba wokungakhokhi ngesikhathi kweminyango kahulumeni."Indlela omasipala abenza ngayo isabelomali sabo, basenza bebala nemali abasuke bezoyiqoqa. "Uma iminyango kahulumeni namabhizinisi behluleka ukukhokha ngesikhathi, kuphoqa omasipala ukuthi bayodala izikweletu ukuze kungaphazamiseki izinhlelo zentuthuko abasuke bezihlelile.”"Ukunyuswa kwemali ekhokhwa uma uboleka imali ifike ngesikhathi esinzima komasipala. Imali inyuswe ngesikhathi kunesidingo esikhulu komasipala ukuthi batsheleke imali ngenxa yokungakhokhi kweminyango kahulumeni."Kuyasikhathaza ukuthi ayikaze yehliswe namanje imali ekhokhwa uma uboleka. Lesimo siphazamisa ukusebenza komasipala,” kusho uNtuli.Uqhubeke ngokuthi imali enkulu ekhokhwa uma kubolekwa, yenza kube nzima komasipala ukuyibuyusela.Isikhulu esiphezulu kwiSalga KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Sabelo Gwala uthe sikhula ngamandla isikweletu seminyango kahulumeni."Ngonyaka owedlule isikweletu besingu-R2,5 billion, manje esingaphezu kuka-R3 billion. Kuke kwakhona isikhathi lapho khona isikweletu besiphansi, singuR500 million.”"Uma omasipala bethi babasela izikweletu, bayaye batshelwe ukuthi imali inikezwe imikhandlu yabazali (ezikoleni)."Uma bethi bakhuluma nemikhandlu yabazali, imikhandlu yabazali, ibatshele ukuthi ayikayitholi imali. Yingakho- ke kwesinye isikhathi kuyaye kuze kuphoqe ukuthi omasipala bavale amanzi,” kuqhuba uGwala.Uthe bayayeseka imikhandlu evala amanzi eminyangweni kahulumeni ekweletayo."Ayikho enye indlela omasipala abangenza ngayo ukuze bakwazi ukuqoqa izikweletu zabo,” ephetha.

Amaqembu amaningi asongela i-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, awayiniki lutho okhethweni.Izwe kumanje lilungiselela ukhetho lukazwelonke oluzoba ngoMeyi 29 nonyaka, kanti izingqapheli nabahlaziyi bathi i-ANC ingase ilahlekelwe amavoti iphume emandleni.UDuma onguMphathiswa wezokuThuthukiswa koMnotho nezokuVakasha esifundazweni, ube nengxoxo ekhethekile neSolezwe, echaza ngomkhankaso wokubuyisela i-ANC emandleni.USIHLALO we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Siboniso Duma, onethemba lokuthi abantu bazovikela izwe ngokuvotela i-ANC Isithombe: FACEBOOK/SIBONISO DUMAUDuma okhethelwe kwesikaSihlalo kaKhongolose ngoJulayi 2022, ubehleli enethezekile kusofa ekhuluma ngokukhulu ukuzethemba echaza ngokuvuleleka. Uthe akusabethusi ukuthi abantu bathi i-ANC izokwehlulwa."Akukho soka ladla kahle imbangi ikhala vele, uma uphethe uzolandelwa. I-DA kumanje ikhanda imibiko yocwaningo engekho emthethweni. Nangesikhathi uMengameli uMbeki (Thabo) ezonqoba egwaza ibhece, kwakuthiwa i-ANC izophuma emandleni. Asikhathazekile neze, kunalokho sibona i-ANC ikhula kakhulu,’’ kusho uDuma.I-ANC ngo-2019, yanqoba isifundazwe ngo-55.47% isuka ku-65.0%, yalandelwa yi-IFP eyakhombisa ukukhula yathola u-16.34 yaphikisa ngokusemthethweni. I-DA eyathola u-13.91% ngo-2019, yehla endaweni yesibili yokuba yiqembu eliphikisayo, yalala isithathu. Uthe izimbangi zabo zithembisa abantu izulu nomhlaba zithi zizobakhela izindlu kodwa zingakaze zakhe ngisho umjondolo. Uthe uyakuqonda ukuthi isifundazwe iKZN siyinyama ngezizathu ezehlukene.Uthe esokuqala; wukuthi inabantu abaningi futhi bangu-4.6 million ababhalisele ukuvota okhethweni oluzayo. Uthe futhi iKZN iyisifundazwe esicebile ngokomnotho yingakho kunesasasa kakhulu, iconselwa amathe.Uthe okubanika ithemba kakhulu wukuthi uMengameli uCyril Ramaphosa uke wakhankasa esifundazweni wemukelwa kahle, abantu bejabula. Uthe bakhona nabanye abaholi abasazofika bahlale cishe izinsuku eziyisikhombisa besebenza isifundazwe.Uthe bagabe ngomqulu wezethembiso zokhetho owethulwe yi-ANC, wathi yiwona okhombisa ukuthi basazimisele ngokusebenzela abantu bakuleli.I-ANC ibeke amaphuzu ayisithupha aphambili okuwudaba lwamathuba emisebenzi, inkinga yokwenyuka kwezindleko zokuphila, wukugxila kakhulu kubantu nezidingo zabo, wukuvikela intando yeningi nokugxilisa inkululeko bese kuba wukwakha i-Afrika nomhlaba ongcono.UDuma uthe nakuba bengene ihlandla likahulumeni wesifundazwe seliphakathi kodwa bakwazile ukuhlela kabusha uhulumeni basebenza kahle. Ukhale ngezinselelo ezifana nezikhukhula ezishaye kwezwela kodwa wathi bahlabela phambili."Kuningi esikwenzile phezu kokuthi kube khona izikhukhula, kwagadla iCovid-19 nezibhelu zangoJulayi 2021. Uma ubheka izethembiso zethu zokhetho, phezulu eqhulwini, amathuba omsebenzi. Uhulumeni siwuthumile yingakho ubona izinhlelo ezifana noSthesha Waya Waya,’’ kusho uDuma.Uthe bakhele phezu kwesisekelo esihle esiqalwe wondunankulu baphambilini abenze umsebenzi omuhle esifundazweni. UDuma uthe kufanele abantu bakuqonde ukuthi ezinye izinselelo zidalwa wukungahambi kahle kwesimo somnotho emhlabeni wonke.Uthe i-ANC ithathwe izwe livele linezinkinga zeminyaka kodwa yazama konke okusemandleni ukusebenzela abantu bakuleli. Uthe namanje banalo ithemba lokuthi abantu bazobumbana bavikele izwe labo kuqhutshekwe nombono kaMnuz Nelson Mandela.
UNGQONGQOSHE wezeMpilo kuleli uDkt Joe Phaahla uthe zingu-2000 izidumbu eziduve emakhazeni kahulumeni ezingaziwa ukuthi ezobani. UPhaahla usho lokhu ephendula imibuzo yamalungu e-DA ePhalamende.Uthe zisemakhazeni ehlukene ezweni lonke futhi zihlala zihanjiswa cishe zonke izinsuku zigcine zibe ningi.Izidumbu okukhulunywa ngazo kusuke kuyilezo ezitholwe zilahliwe noma zidindilizile kungaziwa ukuthi kwenzekeni. Kuvele ukuthi inkinga idalwa wukuthi abantu abafiki ukuzocinga izidumbu zihlonzwe bese beyozingcwaba, zigcina zibhadla isikhathi eside.Uthe isifundazwe iKwaZulu-Natal ihamba phambili ngezidumbu ezingu-1 336 ezingaziwa, ilandelwe yiLimpopo ngezingu-283, iNorth West ilele isithathu ngezingu-266. IMpumalanga yona inezidumbu ezingu-82 okuyisibalo esilinganayo nesaseFree State, kugcine iNorthern Cape ngezingu-51.Akazikhiphanga izibalo ngezinye izifundazwe. UPhaahla uthe umgomo wabo wokusebenza uthi kufanele isidumbu uma sifika sibekwe eshalofini lamakhaza izinsuku eziyisikhombisa, emuva kwalokho bese kwenziwa uhlelo lokusingcwaba.Uthe uma singcwatshwa ngokohlelo lukahulumeni, kushuthwa isithombe kuthathwe amaloba eminwe namasampula olibofuzo. Kukhalwe nangesikhala sokubeka izidumbu uma zilokhu zinqwabelana emakhazeni kahulumeni.
ANGAPHEZU kwenkulungwane amaphoyisa asuka ezifundeni ezahlukene zaKwaZulu-Natal abeyingxenye yomjaho obubanjelwe ebhishi laseBlue Lagoon, eThekwini ngoLwesihlanu.Lo mjaho waminyaka yonke webanga elingu-12.5 km uhlelwa yihhovisi likakhomishana wamaphoyisa esifundzweni usuneminyaka emithathu wasungulwa. Inhloso yawo ukuhlola ezempilo nokuzivocavoca.Ngokwesitatimende samaphoyisa, lo mjaho wasungulwa ngumkhuzi wamaphoyisa ngo-2022 kanti kulo nyaka, kubonakale isibalo esiphezulu sababambe iqhaza abasuka ezinhlakeni ezahlukene zezomthetho njengamaphoyisa kahulumeni, amaphoyisa omgwaqo, ojele kanjalo namaphoyisa angaphansi kophiko lweRoad Traffic Inspectorate."Amaphoyisa ajoyine lo mjaho ngenhloso yokuzigcina enempilo. Abawinile bathole imhlomelo kaR5000.”Umqhudelwano ubumkhulu kakhulu kwabesilisa kwazise owokuqala uConstable Thamsanqa Mbanjwa nowesilibili uThemba Dlamini oyiProvisioning Administration Clerk bebeshiyana ngemizuzwana.
