Umanqoba wangonyaka odlule uSergeant Petrus Ndlela wasesiteshini sasePlessislaer uthathe indawo yesithathu ngesikhathi esingu-42.47.Abanqobile Constable Future Jona, Sgt Petrus Ndlela, Constable Fanta Ngema, PAC Themba Dlamini, Constable Thabisile Thobeka Phungula noConstable Thamsanqa Mbanjwa isithombe: sithunyelwe/SAPSKwabesifazane uConstable Thabisile Thobeka Phungula osebenzela esiteshini saseDundee ubuyise isithunzi kwazise nguyena wokuqala ukudla umhlanganiso kusungulwa lo mjaho ngo-2022, walala isibili ngonyaka odlule. UConstable Phungula ushaye isikhathi esingu-55.04 uhlule uzakwabo uConstable Fanta Ngema osebenzela uphilo lwePOP eMpangeni njengoba emshiye ngemizuzwana engu-41. UConstable Future Jona fongaphansi kophiko lwePOP eThekwini uthathe indawo yesithathu ngesikhathi esingu-57.42.
IDINGA ithimba longqongqoshe beminyango ehlukene inkinga yokuduva kwezidumbu ezingenabanikazi emakhazeni kahulumeni kuleli. Lokhu kushiwo nguDkt Sibongiseni Dhlomo, iphini likaNgqongqoshe wezeMpilo kuleli ngesikhathi ekhuluma nesiteshi sethelevishini izolo. UDkt Dhlomo ubekhuluma ngemuva kokukhishwa kombiko othi zibalelwa ku-2 000 izidumbu eziduve emakhazeni kahulumeni kuleli, ezingenabanikazi.Isibalo sidalulwe nguNgqongqoshe wezeMpilo ezweni uDkt Joe Phaahla, obephendula umbuzo welungu leDA, ePhalamende uNksz Madeleine Hicklin.UPhaahla uveze ukuthi isifundazwe iKwaZulu-Natal, yisona esinesibalo esiphezulu sezidumbu eziduve emakhazeni njengoba zingu-1 336, kulandele iLimpopo ngezingu-283, neNorth West ngezingu-266. Ungqongqoshe uveze nokuthi eMpumalanga zingu-82 izidumbu ezingenabanikazi, eFree State zingu-82, kuthi eNorthern Cape zingu-51.Azikho izidumbu ezidalulilwe eGauteng, Eastern Cape, naseWestern Cape.UDhlomo uthe inkinga isidinga ukuthi kungenelele ithimba longqongqoshe abehlukene okubalwa owamaPhoyisa, owezaseKhaya, owezeMpilo, owezokuBusa nokuBambisana nowezobuLungiswa. "Ngikhulumile noPhaahla ukuthi mhlawumbe kumele sicele kumengameli ukuthi sisebenzisane nalabo ngqongqoshe kule nkinga. Isidinga uwonke wonke ngoba ukuze singcwabe izidumbu ezingenamuntu sidinga umhlaba kumasipala,” kuchaza uDkt Dhlomo.UDhlomo uqhube wathi izidumbu eziningi zakulesi sifundazwe zisuke zingezabantu abagwaziwe, nabadutshuliwe."Ezinye izidumbu eKZN zisuke zingezabantu abazikhungile kanjalo nabasuke belimele ezingozini. Siyazigcina izidumbu ngethemba lokuthi imindeni izofika izofuna izidumbu emakhazeni. Uma kudlula izinsuku ezingaphezu kuka-30, sibe sesihlela ukuzingcwaba siwuhulumeni, ngokwethu sisigcina izinsuku ezingu-30 isidumbu,” kuchaza uDhlomo.Uthe bengumnyango abakwazi ukubika izidumbu eziduvile ezingenabantu ngoba ezinye izinqumo zidinga eminye iminyango.UDkt Dhlomo uchaze kanje:"Okunye okumele sikubheke noNnqongqoshe wezobuLungiswa ngukuthi mhlawumbe isidumbu esesihlale isikhathi eside emakhazeni silothiswe. Manje lesi sinqumo asikwazi ukusithatha singumnyango wezeMpilo wodwa, sidinga usizo lweminye iminyango.” Uthe bayalugcina ulwazi olufana nesithombe, amasampula egazi namanyela ezandla ukuze ngomuso uma kufika izihlobo bakwazi ukuhlola ulibofuzo.Unxuse imindeni esuke ilahlekelwe yizihlobo ukuthi iye emakhazeni kahulumeni iyothungatha khona izidumbu ezisuke zingaziwa.UDkt Dhlomo uveze ukuthi akukuhle ngasohlangothini lwezempilo ukugcina isidumbu emakhazeni iminyaka eminingi."Sinxusa abasebenzi bethu ukuthi baqhubeke nje bazigcine lezi zidumbu noma sazi ukuthi akukuhle ngakwezempilo. Ezinye izidumbu kuphela iminyaka ziduvile emakhazeni.”
KUNUKWA ikhansela ngowesilisa obesekuyophela inyanga yesithathu enyamalele, isidumbu okukholakala ukuthi ngesakhe esitholwe sesonakele silaxazwe emafusini agudle ujantshi phakathi kwamafemu, KwaSithebe eMandeni ngeledlule.UMnuz Siyabonga Makhoba (40) kuthiwa ubegcine ukubonwa ngoFebhuwari 7 kulo nyaka evakashele abangani bakhe.Isidumbu okukholakala ukuthi ngesakhe, kuthiwa sitholwe sisagqokiswe izimpahla ezifanayo nayenyamalale ezigqokile, sesingasabonakali kahle.Umndeni kaMakhoba usola ikhansela lenye yama-ward KwaSithebe, njengoba ngesikhathi edukile, bekunamahlebezi okumsongela.Lamahebezi alandele emva kokungavumelani ngemali ikhansela okwakumele liyikhokhele umufi ukuze acishe icala lokushaya, ukuzama ukubulala nokuthumba ayelithwese lona.Kusolakala ukuthi ikhansela lenza lokhu limsola ngokweba uthayela walo.Umfowabo kamufi uMnuz Mthoko Makhoba, elandisa Isolezwe uthe ngoNovemba nyakenye umsolwa nabangani bakhe bathumba umufi.Kuthiwa bamhudula ngemoto bembophe izandla nezinyawo bamshaya bemsola ngokuthi untshontshe uthayela, okuthe ngokuhamba kwesikhathi kwavela ukuthi awuthathwanga uyena."Emva kwalokho sihlanganile, kuvulwe icala emaphoyiseni aseSundumbili, nokuthe ngoJanuwari 14, ikhansela lahlangana nomndeni lifisa ukuthi kucishwe icala. "Umfowethu ufune u-R50 000 ngokulimala kwakhe, ikhansela lathi lingamkhokhela u-R25 000 kwagcina kungabonwanga ngaso linye, kwaba ukuthi umufi uyaqhubeka necala,” usho kanje.Uthe bezwe ngabathile ukuthi ikhansela lisonga ngokuthi ngeke liqedelwe umsebenzi yi "phara” lona.Kusaphele amasonto amathathu emva komhlangano, umufi wanyamalala njengoba isidumbu okusoleka ukuthi ngesakhe sitholwe ngeledlule.UMakhoba uphinde wagxeka umphenyi wecala ebelithweswe ikhansela ngokuhudula izinyawo ekuqoqeni ubufakazi njengoba ifomu lokulimala i- J88, (Isolezwe elilibonile) likhombisa ukuthi umufi wayelimele kabi ngesikhathi evulela umsolwa icala.Uveze ukuthi batshelwe ukuthi icala elithweswe ikhansela lihoxisiwe ngenxa yokushoda kobufakazi, kanti lolu lwazi lufinyelele emndenini umufi esanyamalele isidumbu singakatholwa.Yize umndeni uthumelele intatheli yonke imininingwane ngokubikwa kwecala elithweswe ikhansela lokushaya, ukuthumba nokuzama ukubulala umufi, okubalwa nenombolo yecala elivulwe esiteshini samaphoyisa eSundumbili, amaphoyisa aqinisekise ukutholwa kwezinsalela zesidumbu somuntu.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uConstable Thenjiswa Ngcobo, uthe amaphoyisa aseNyoni avule idokodo lophenyo ngokufa komuntu.
AMAQEMBU ezepolitiki adudulana ngezifuba kulezi zinsuku ekhankasela ukhetho, ethula nezethembiso kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu akwenzeki nje emadolobheni nasemalokishini kuphela kodwa ngisho ezindaweni zasemakhaya lapho izakhamizi zisadonsa kanzima uma kukhulunywa ngentuthuko.Kuyaphithizelwa kwethulwa izinhlelo zentuthuko kuvulwa nenqgalasizinda ebeyakhiwa.Leli phephandaba livakashele izakhamizi zasemakhaya eNkandla ukuthola ukuthi sezikulungele yini ukuvota, ngabe isekhona inhlansi yethemba ngohulumeni kuleli njengoba kugujwa iminyaka engu-30 kwabusa uhulumeni wentando yabantu.UMnuz Muzikayifani Majola waseMahlayizini, uveze ukuthi ukhathazwa iminyaka ebekelwe ukuqasha abantu eNingizimu Afrika.Lokhu ukubona kushaya kuzwele kakhulu kubazali ngoba bahleli nezingane ezinezidingo. Uphinde waveza nokuthi kwanda ubugebengu ngenxa yokweswela kwabantu.UMnuz Muzikayifani Majola"Ngabuya emsebenzini ngo-2002 ngaqala ibhizinisi lokuxova izitina kodwa uxhaso lokukhulisa ibhizinisi angilutholi. "Into ebalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni andise amathuba omsebenzi ukuze nentsha izosebenza ikwazi ukuzimela."Nomthetho udinga ukuqiniswa ukuze kungabi nentsha egcaluza emadolobheni ngoba igcina isiphenduke amaphara," kusho uMajola.UNksz Mpho Dubazane waseMatshenezimpisi, oziphilisa ngokucwala amakhanda, uthe uqale leli bhizinisi ngenxa yokugqoza kwamathuba omsebenzi, wakhetha ukugxila ekhonweni analo. Yize kunjalo kodwa uNksz Dubazane uveze ukuthi inkinga kagesi yenza impilo ibenzima endaweni yangakubo.UNksz Mpho Dubazane "Ugesi namanzi kuyasihlupha kodwa sekungcono amanzi asekhona. Into esifisa ilungiswe manje ugesi ukuze kusebenzeke kahle."Ngiyafisa nokuthola indawo yami ngingasebenzeli etendeni ngoba umasipala usengixhasile ngezinto zebhizinisi."Ngizoya kovota ngoba isidingo sakho ngiyasibona futhi sengisithathile nesinqumo ngeqembu engizolivotela," kusho uNksz Dubazane.UMnuz Taelo Tsotetsi waseMadiyane ukhala ngogesi ekubeni izindawo eziningi zasemakhaya seziphucuzekile. Uveze ukuthi imidanti ka-Eskom yenza kubenzima ezindaweni zasemakhaya bese zisalela emuva ngentuthuko.UMnuz Taelo Tsotetsi"Zikhona izinguquko esizibonayo kodwa okuningi sisele kukhona. Ugesi ngenye yezinto esingenayo, ekhaya kusukela ngo-2013 sizama, asinawo kuze kube yimanje. "Uhulumeni kumele abambisane namakhansela nezinduna zisondelane nomphakathi ngoba yibona bantu abazi izidingo zawo."Kukhona nabantu abadala abahleli ezindlini eziwayo ngenxa yokuswela," kusho uTsotesti.UMnuz Vusimuzi Majola waseMabengela, uthe lesi yisikhathi sokuthi umphakathi uhlangane ubhukule uyovota ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kungena uhulumeni omusha okhathalele izidingo zabo.Indawo yangakubo uthe yeswele kakhulu uma eyiqhathanisa nezinye zasemakhaya ezihlinzekwa ngentuthuko."Kusenzima kakhulu ngogesi, uhulumeni akasisizi, sigqigqa njalo kwa-Eskom kodwa asisizakali. Kuyiwa okhethweni siyovota, sikhipha uhulumeni ongasisizi ngalutho."Ziningi izidingo zomphakathi esingenzelwa zona ngoba kubambeke kuhulumeni omkhulu, kuze kusize umasipala ngoxhaso senze amabhizinisi," kusho uMajola.
OSOMABHIZINISI baseHluhluwe bakhala ngokukhetha iphela emasini kukahulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika, okhombisa ukukholelwa kwabaqhamuka emazweni angaphandle, abathi babamise kabi kwezamabhizinisi.Lokhu kuvele emcimbini wokwethulwa kwentuthuko kwaMduku kumasipala iBig 5 Hlabisa muva nje. Bathe sekuyisikhathi sokuthi uhulumeni ubuyekeze umthetho ovumela ukudayisa udede kwabokufika ukuze kuqedwe izingqinamba ababhekene nazo.UNksz Nompilo Vilane, uthe kuyabalimaza kakhulu ukukugcwala kwezitolo zabantu abaqhamuka kumazwe angaphandle njengoba idolobha labo lincane."Asibe sisayibona nhlobo into esiyisebenzayo uma kuzogcwala abantu bokufika abagcina besiphuca iqatha emlonyeni ngenxa yamanani aphansi abadayisa ngawo impahla yabo. Singajabula uma uhulumeni engangenelela kule nkinga ukuze siyibone into esiyenzayo,” usho kanje.Imeya uMnuz Comfort Khumalo, ithe ukulawuleka kwalesi simo kuzolekelela kakhulu ekulweni nobubha kubantu bakuleli abaswele imisebenzi."Siqala ukuba nenkinga uma abantu bamazwe angaphandle kuyibo abanakwa ngaphezu kwabantu bakuleli abantula imisebenzi. Kunemisebenzi engadingi ukuthi uze ube yingcithabuchopho kodwa edinga ukuthi abantu babe nolwazana nje oluncane oludingeka kulowo mkhakha abasuke bekuwo. Ngakho- ke asikwazi ukuba nesibalo esiphezulu soweta babantu bamazwe angaphandle ezindaweni zokudla zakuleli ekubeni sinentsha yakuleli eswele imisebenzi,” kusho uKhumalo .Eqhuba uthe kweminye imisebenzi edinga ulwazi olunzulu kwamukelekile ukuthi kulandwe abantu abangaphandle.Omunye usomabhizinisi, uNksz Lizzy Ndlovu wakwaMduku osekuphele iminyaka emithathu edayisa ukudla, uthe enye inkinga ababhekene nayo ukuvaleleka ngaphandle ohlelweni lokuthola izindawo zokudayisa ezinikwa abokufika."Amathuba omsebenzi awekho, phezu kwaleyo nkinga kube yithi esizizamelayo ngokuvula amabhizinisi esihlukumezeka ngodaba lwabokufika abagweva nezindawo. Yibo ababekwa phambili ekubeni iningi lethu lingenazo izindawo zokudayisa ezikhishwa uhulumeni,” kusho yena.Eqhuba unxenxe uhulumeni ukuthi ushintshe imithetho yawo ezokwenza balekeleleke nabo njengosomabhizinisi abazimisele ngokuvula amathuba omsebenzi.
UZISHAYA isifuba uMengameli wezwe, uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa, ngokuthi uzokhuza ibuya kuhulumeni, uma sekuqala ihlandla elisha emva kokhetho. URamaphosa uthe kuningi okwenziwe kuleli eminyakeni engu-30 edlule, ekubeni kube nezinselelo eziningi okubalwa kuzo ubhubhane iCovid-19, izikhukhula, izehlakalo zokwanda kobugebengu nezinye.Umengameli wezwe uthe kukho konke lokho, izwe aliguqanga ngamadolo."Zizosukuma kakhulu izinto kuhulumeni ozongena ngemva kokhetho. Ngizobe ngiyingxenye kahulumeni olandelayo,” kusho uRamaphosa.URamaphosa ukusho lokhu ngoLwesibili, evula ingqungquthela ezobheka iqhaza lezinkampani ezihlomulisa abasebenzi ngamasheya, eSandton. Ukhuluma kanje nje uRamaphosa, ubhekene nenselelo ephuma emaqenjini amaningi ahlose ukukhipha i-ANC emandleni. Amaqembu afuna kwehle ukwesekwa kukaKhongolose nokuthi uhulumeni uphathwe ngokubambisana phakathi kwezinhlangano zepolitiki ezehlukene kunokuthi kuphathe iqembu elilodwa. URamaphosa uveze ukuthi ukunika abasebenzi amasheya kwenza ukuthi basebenze ngokuzikhandla ngoba basuke bengabanikazi baleyo nkampani."Kwakha umdlandla futhi kuba nobudlelwano obuhle ngoba abasebenzi basuke bezazi ukuthi bayingxenye yenkampani. Uma bengabanikazi bayaziqonda izingqinamba ezibhekene nezinkampani ukuze bazikhulise,” kubeka uRamaphosa.Umengameli uqube wathi abasebenzi beza namasu okukhulisa ibhizinisi."Kumele sincome ukuthi noma sisincane isibalo sabasebenzi abanamasheya ezinkampanini abasebenza kuzona kodwa ikhona inhlansi yethemba. Banguhhafu wesigidi kuleli abasebenzi abanamasheya lapho besebenza khona. Lokhu kusho ukuthi umsebenzi oyedwa kwabangu-20 emkhakheni ozimele, unamasheya enkampanini ayisebenzelayo,” kusho uRamaphosa. Wengeze ngokubalula izikhathi lapho ayehola khona abasebenzi ababeyinkukhu nempaka nomqashi."Kwakuthi uma sizohlangana nabaqashi singasebenzi, bangafuni ngisho ukuphuza itiye, bathi ngeke baliphuze itiye lezitha. Abasebenzi babebuka abaqashi njengezitha zabo. Kodwa kwakuthi uma isidonsa imihlangano, bagcine abasebenzi beliphuzile itiye labaqashi nama-semishi ayesuke ethengiwe,” kusho uRamaphosa.Uqhube wathi nangesikhathi engumholi wenye yezinkampani, abasebenzi bamcela ukuthi abanikeze iqatha lokuthi babe namasheya ukuze basebenze ngokuzikhandla."Bathi uma bengathola nje okuncane, bangangena noma yikuphi lapho kungangeneki khona. Lokhu kukhomba ngokusobala ukuthi bazinikela kakhulu uma bazi ukuthi nabo kukhona abazokuzuza.” URamaphosa uncome osomabhizinisi abancane abaphethe amabhizinisi ukuthi badela konke ukuze amabhizinisi abo athuthuke. Umengameli usonge ngokuthi uhulumeni wentando yabantu usebenze ngamandla ukuphucula umnotho ngoba phambilini abamnyama babevalelwe ngaphandle ngenxa yemithetho yobandlululo.
BADIDEKILE abazali bezingane ezifunda eSizakahle High, eMnambithi, okuvele ukuthi sekuphele izinsuku othisha bengangeni emakilasini ukufundisa.Abazali kulesi sikole abavuke banikela esikoleni izolo, ngenhloso yokuzwa ngokuqhubekayo emva kokuthi izingane zabo kuthiwa bezilokhu zifika zibika ukuthi azifundi. Kuthiwa asicaci isizathu kahle ukuthi kungani benquma ukungangeni emakilasini, bafundise.Umzali oyilungu lesigungu esengamele isikole ocele ukungadululwa, uthe akukho okuqondile ukukhulunywayo okwenza ukuthi othisha bangafundisi."Sifikile esikoleni, othisha abafunanga ukukhuluma nathi. Emhlanganweni wesigungu esilawula isikole esibenawo ngoMsombuluko, uthishomkhulu uveze ukuthi othisha bathi abafundisi ngoba kufe imishini yokufothokhopha, okuyinto engingaboni ukuthi iyiqiniso ngoba ezinye izinsiza kufundisa njengoshoki nokunye kukhona,” usho kanje.Uthe emva komhlangano ongabanga yimpumelelo njengoba abazali bengahlangananga nomhloli njengoba bekulindelekile, banqume ukuthi ngeke bazidedele izingane zabo ziye esikoleni kuze kube uMnyango wezeMfundo esiFundazweni uyangenelela ukuxazulula le nkinga.Omnye umzali, uthe lesi sinqumo basithathiswe wukuthi ziningi izindleko abangena kuzona ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abafundi baya esikoleni njengoba abanye begibela.Uthe ukubahambisela ukuthi bayohlala bengafundiswa kungaba ukuchitha imali kungenasidingo."Sikhathazekile ngekusasa lezingane zethu, kodwa akukho mina engingakwenza kuphela ukuthi ngingabavumeli baye esikoleni ukugwema izinto eziningi ngoba izingane uma zingafundi, ziyohlala esikoleni usuku lonke, zingagcina sezenza izinto ezingafanele,” kusho umzali.Okhulumela umnyango uMnuz Muzi Mahlambi, uqinisekisile ukuthi bawutholile umbiko ngalolu daba basawubheka.Kuze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela engakabuyeli entathelini ukucacisa ngokuphazamisa ukufunda kulesi sikole.
USATHUKILE namanje owesilisa waKwaNxamalala, eNkandla uma ecabanga ngobuqhawe abenze ngoLwesihlanu olwedlule, etetisa owesifazane amawele kulandela ukungalutholi usizo emtholampilo wendawo.Lesi sehlo senzeke esangweni lasemtholampilo KwaNxamalala, emva kokuthi abahlengikazi bale baphetha ukusiza lona wesifazane obesikwa.Elandisa ngesigameko uMnuz Simphiwe Ndlovu (38), ongunogada, uthe ubethi uziyela esitolo ukuyothenga i-airtime namakhandlela ngesikhathi ekhangwa umsindo wowesifazane obekhala ubumayemaye, ecela usizo."Ngendlela abekhala ngayo, ibingekho indlela yokuthi ngingaqinisa ikhanda, ngiqhubeke nohambo lwami,” kusho uNdlovu.Uthe ngesikhathi esondela emotweni eyiveni, uthole owesifazane nomshayeli, kwamcacela ukuthi kubi.Uveze ukuthi ugijime waya konogada bomtholampilo, wabacela ukuthi bayovusa abahlengikazi ngoba kunesimo esiphuthumayo.Uthe babuyise impendulo ethi 'abasebenzi ebusuku bona’.Uqhube wathi umpongoloze kwaduma izihosha, ecela usizo komakhelwane. Abanye ubethi mayebatshela ukuthi abasondele kuzosizwa owesifazane osikwayo, bathwale izandla ekhanda, bathi bayesaba ngeke bakwazi.Uthe kuthe uma ebona ukuthi kuyonakala evenini, wasizana nomshayeli ukuthi kundlalwe ublankethi ngemuva evenini, yabe iza ingane yokuqala."Sikhongozele ngezandla sinomshayeli, senzela ukuthi ingane ingashayeki phansi, ihuzuke."Besithi sesiqedile kodwa owesifazane wathi kuseza enye ingane. Nayo siphinde sayikhongozela,” kusho uNdlovu.Uthe ngesikhathi eqeda ukuteta owesifazane, uqale phansi wayofuna usizo emakotishini aseduze, nokuyilapho okuphume khona owesifazane.Nalona ophumile naye ubekhulelwe, walekelela ngokuthi ashayele imoto iye komunye umtholampilo njengoba umshayeli bese zingcolile izandla zakhe engeke akwazi ukushayela.Uthe yena akabange esahamba nabo, wagoduka waya ekhaya.Echaza ngesizathu esenza ukuthi afake isandla ekuteteni kowesifazane, uthe akasilona uhlobo lomuntu oluvele lufulathele uma kufuneka usizo.Nokho uveze ukuthi nakuba enezingane ezintathu, ubengakaze atetise. "Ngiye ngiqikelele ukuthi ngiqaphela izinsuku zakhe (unina wezingane) zokuya emtholampilo, ngimeseke kulokho."Noma sekusondela isikhathi sokuteta, ngiye ngiqinisekise ukuthi okuningi kumi ngomumo ukuze uma eqala esikwa, ngimphuthumise esibhedlela,” usho kanje.Usigxekile isenzo sabahlengikazi baKwaNxamalala, ethi indlela abaziphathe ngayo ayamukelekile."Ubengafa nokufa lona wesifazane ngenxa yesenzo sabo. Ekumsizeni kwami, ngibhekise kimi ukuthi ngingenzenjani uma isinqandamathe sami noma udadewethu ehlelwa yinto efana nale. "Kubuhlungu ukukhala komuntu enganakwa,” kusho uNdlovu.Uthe akakaze axhumane nowesifazane ukuzwa ukuthi kwahamba kanjani esefike emtholampilo omnike usizo. Kuvela ukuthi lo mtholampilo uvalwa ngehora lesine ntambama, kanti amanye amanesi ahlala ngaphakathi. Isolezwe lizamile ukuthola owesifazane kodwa ucingo lwakhe beluvaliwe, olukayise wamawele lungenile, washiya angalazi, ebuza ukuthi intatheli iyithathephi inombolo yakhe.Akagcinanga lapho, uphinde wathi konke kuhamba kahle, akukho akubona kungahambi kahle ngokuthi amawele atetelwe esangweni lomtholampilo.
ABAKHAHLANYEZWA yizikhukhula zango-2022, abasahlala ezakhiweni zesikhashana, bathi sebelilahlile ithemba kwi-ANC.Banxuse amaqembu angenele ukhetho KwaZulu-Natal ukuba abakhiphe ezindaweni zesikhashana abahleli kuzo.Lokhu bakusho ngesikhathi kunenkulumo-mpikiswano yamaqembu angenele ukhetho KwaZulu-Natal ebihlelwe iziko lezindaba elinguzakwabo weSolezwe, i-IOL.Owakhahlamezwa yizikhukhula, uNksz Sibongile Mkhize, utshele abebehambele inkulumo-mpikiswano ebiseMhlanga, ukuthi sebekhathele ukuhlala ezindaweni zesikhashana."Njengamanje kwelulwa inkontileka yakule ndawo esihlaliswe kuyona. Kwenzekani ngemali eyakhishwayo ukuba silekelelwe? Ngiyabonga nge-ANC. Ngizalelwe kuyo, ubaba anginaye ngenxa yayo kodwa ayikho ingqubekela phambili."Kuyimanje sihlala ndawonye ezindlini. Akekho umuntu ongavuma ukuthi ahlale endlini nomuntu angamazi. Kuyimanje kuyaliwa, abantu bayafa. Sicela ukuthi kuthi kuphela izinyanga eyisithupha sibe sesiphumile lapha. Ayisancengani ngempela manje!”Okhulumela i-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Mafika Mndebele, uthe iningi labantu abakhahlanyezwa yizikhukhula selahlelelwa izindlu."Cishe u-70% wabo usakhelwa izindlu.”UMndebele uthe inkinga enkulu ukuthola umhlaba okuzokwakhelwa kuwo abantu.Omele i-IFP KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, unxuse abakhahlanyezwa yizikhukhula ukuba bakhombise intukuthelo yabo okhethweni oluzayo."Ukulinda izinyanga eziyisithupha angeke kunisize ngalutho. Ninethuba lokuba nizwakalise uvo lwenu ezinsukwini ezizayo. Lisebenziseni ngobuhlakani leli thuba.”Omele i-DA embangweni wesikhundla sikandunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Chris Pappas, uthe uzokuba nomhlangano nabakhahlanyezwa izikhukhula."Akusithina esiphethe lapha eThekwini kodwa njengeqembu eliphikisayo umsebenzi wethu ukuthi sibange umsindo, ukuze labo abaphethe bezokwenza umsebenzi wabo.”Ilungu le-EFF, uMnuz Magasela Mzobe, lithe kufanele kupheze ukwehliswa ngemilenze kwemali ekhishelwa ukusiza abasuke bekhahlanyezwe izikhukhula."Uhulumeni kufanele uthathe umhlaba ngaphandle kwesinxephezelo ukuze singeke sibe nenkinga yokuswelakala komhlaba wokwakhela abantu. Lokhu kukhona emqulwini wethu wezethembiso zokhetho.”Omele iRise Mzansi embangweni wesikhundla sikandunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Nonkululeko Hlongwane-Mhlongo, uthe bayavinjwa uma bethi bafuna ukulekelela abakhahlamezwe izikhukhula. "Uma sifika emahholo sitshelwa ukuthi kunezingane ezingadlile, kunomamama abangenazingubo zokulala, sijikiswa emasangweni nosizo. Amakhansela angafuni ukusiza imiphakathi ayasijikisa thina esifika nosizo.”
IKHALA ngamaphoyisa abulale abantu okungesibo abebafuna, imindeni yabesilisa ababili baseMatshana Reserve, eMpangeni, abadutshulwe ngoMsombuluko.UMnuz Khanyisani Mdladla (30) noMnuz Andile Ngubane (29) kuthiwa baficwe amaphoyisa ophiko lwe-National Intervention Unit (NIU) bedlula ngasesitolo sangakubo, bebuya emsebenzini.Unina kaMdladla, uNkk Sbongile Mdladla, uthe babizelwe endaweni yesigameko ngamanye amalungu omphakathi, bafike bazithele phezu kwenqwaba yamaphoyisa abehlome eyizingovolo futhi enolaka oluxaka uSathane."Sithe noma sithi sifuna ukusondela emotweni ebebedutshulelwe kuyo, ala ukhasha amaphoyisa abegqoke izigqoko ezifihla ubuso,” kusho yena.Uthe banqatshelwe ngisho ukuyobuka abafi baze bathathwa imoto elanda izidumbu.UMUFI uMnuz Andile Ngubane "Siye sesiyocosha ubuchopho obebusale endaweni yesigameko. Ngesikhathi sibucosha, asihleka amaphoyisa,” kuchaza uNkk Mdladla.Uthe banesiqiniseko sokuthi babulawelwe into abangayazi abafi."Lezi zingane bezihlonipha wonke umuntu emphakathini. Abantu ebebethunywa nanoma ubani, bengakhalazi. Bebezisebenzela endaweni elungisa izimoto iPower Star. Sekuphele iminyaka emine besebenza khona,” kulandisa yena.Uthe kulo msebenzi bebesebenza izinsuku eziyisithupha ngesonto, behamba ekuseni, babuye ebusuku sebezolala.Wengeze ngelithi amaphoyisa awathathile amaselula abafi, wathi kuhle ethathiwe ukuze kuvezwe ukuthi benzeni."Siyabufuna ubulungiswa ngokubulawa kwabo. Amaphoyisa kufanele asichazele kabanzi ukuthi yimaphi lawo macala abawenzile njengoba singaze siwabone efika ezobafuna ukukhombisa ukuthi bawuhlupho,” usho kanje.UNksz Nokululeko Mthethwa, ongudadewabo kaNgubane, uthe imoto ebebehamba ngayo wayithenga kumqashi wabo.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe abasolwa ababili ebebefunelwa amacala amabili okubulala, babulawe emva kokudubulana namaphoyisa eMatshana Reserve eMpangeni ngoMsombuluko."Amaphoyisa amise imoto ebihamba abasolwa, abasolwa bawushaye indiva umyalelo wamaphoyisa, baqala badubula bebhekise emaphoyiseni, nawo abuyisela ngenhlamvu,” kusho uNetshiunda.Uthe emva kokudubulana, abasolwa ababili bashonile. Amaphoyisa asafuna abanye abasolwa abadubule amaphoyisa, abakwazile ukubalekelaUmndeni uyiphikisile eyokuthi abafi badubule amaphoyisa, wathi bobabili, abakaze babe nezibhamu.Uphinde waphika eyabanye abasolwa ebebehamba nabafi, wathi bebezihambela bobabili emotweni njengenjwayelo, bezibuyela emsebenzini.
KUHLWE emini owesilisa egwetshwa odilikajele ababili yinkantolo eNkulu yasePitoli ngamacala okubulala.USibusiso Mtshali (29) waseVosloorus owaziwa ngokuba yinkabi ugwetshwe odilikajele ababili ngamacala amabili okubulala okuhleliwe.Ugixabezwe ngeminyaka engu-15 ngamacala amathathu okuzama ukubulala, eyisithupha yokutholakala nesibhamu neminye emithathu yokutholakala nezinhlamvu.Kuthiwa ngomhlaka19 Meyi 2019, uMnuz Convency Lawrence Twala owayengusomatekisi wayesemzini wakhe eZithobeni, eBronkhorstspruit, nabangani bakhe abane ngesikhathi kugasela uMtshali ehamba nabanye abantu ababili, bavulela ngenhlamvu.UTwala wafa ujuqu kwathi umngani wakhe uKagiso Zachariah Rampou wafela esibhedlela. Abangani babo ababili balimala kodwa basinda.Uphenyo lwamaphoyisa lwawaholela enkantolo yeMantshi eVanderbijlpark ngomhlaka 24 Mashi 2022 evele ngelinye icala lokubulala.Ngokombiko wophiko lwezokushushisa, uMtshali wagqunywa esitokisini kusukela ebanjwa enkantolo yemantshi ngemuva kokunqatshelwa ibheyili. Waqale wawaphika amacala ayebekwe wona, kodwa ngemuva kokulahlwa ngawo, wanxusa inkantolo ukuthi ibe nozwelo kuyena ngesigwebo ezosikhipha icabangele iminyaka yakhe.Umshushisi obephethe icala u-Advocate Sipho Lalane ukhale ngokuthi uMtshali akazange abonise ukuzisola ngezenzo zakhe.Wayenesikhathi esiningi sokushintsha umqondo esuka eGoli eyokwenza amacala eBronkhortspruit.Wahamba waze wafika emzini kamufi embulalela ekhaya lakhe.
UNDUNANKULU waKwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Nomusa Dube-Ncube, uthe isivumelwano ebebenaso noqweqwe lwenyosi yeSilo edilizwe isigubhukane, uMnuz Buzetsheni Mdletshe, besiphambene nomthetho.UNkk Dube-Ncube uthe banqume ukunqamula inkontileka ebebenayo nenkampani kaMdletshe, iMavukefile, emva kokuthi umcwaningi mabhuku omkhulu ekhonondile ngayo.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba ngesikhathi enemibuzo yokulwisana nobugebengu, eNchanga, ngoLwesithathu.UMdletshe waziswe ngeledlule ukuthi inkontileka yakhe izonqanyulwa ekupheleni kwenyanga.Encwadini ebhekiswe kuMdletshe, uhulumeni ukhale ngezimali.UMdletshe waqala ukuba yinyosi ngesikhathi kubusa iSilo uGoodwill Zwelithini kaBhekuzulu, ngo-1977.Ngo-2020 wathatha umhlalaphansi, kepha wabuye wabuya eseyitoho, esebenzisa inkampani yakhe iMavukefile.UMdletshe uyinyosi, aphinde abe umeluleki wezamasiko weSilo uMisuzulu kaZwelithini.UNkk Dube-Ncube uthe uMdletshe usazoqhubeka nokuhasha iSilo uma edingeka, kodwa wathi ngeke esayenza eminye imisebenzi abeyenza."Ngesikhathi kubusa iSilo esabuzayo, uMdletshe wayenza izinto ezahlukene. Kwesinye isikhathi wayeba umeluleki wezamasiko, kwesinye asebenze ukuphelezela abaya emadlinzeni amakhosi, kokunye asebenze njengosomlando."Umcwaningi mabhuku wathi kuphambene nomthetho ukuthi kube khona umuntu ozoba nezinkontileka ezahlukene nohulumeni ekubeni esathatha umhlalaphansi kuhulumeni. Manje uMdletshe usezobizwa uma edingeka ukuthi ayohasha iSilo.”UNkk Dube-Ncube uthe uMdletshe usezobambisana nezinye izinyosi eziqashwe uhulumeni."Akusikhona ukuthi uMdletshe akasezukusebenza. Usazoqhubeka asebenzisane nezinye izinyosi eziqashwe uhulumeni. Uma sizokhuluma iqiniso, vele uhlelo olwalukhona olokuthi uMdletshe acije ezinye izinyosi ngoba yena usathatha umhlalaphansi.”Udaba lokunqanyulwa kwenkontileka kaMdletshe lususe umsindo, iSilo sakhipha isitatimende, lapho besikhala ngokwedelelwa wuhulumeni wesifundazwe.Esitatimendeni esikhishwe uNdunankulu kaZulu, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, iSilo sikufanise nokufakwa kukaZulu umunwe esweni ukudelelwa kwaso wuhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal.Kepha uNkk Dube-Ncube ukhale ngokugxambukela kukaButhelezi ezindabeni ezithinta ukuphathwa kukahulumeni."Bazokhumbula abezindaba ukuthi saba nobudlelwano obuhle nondunankulu weSilo owakhothama, iNkosi yakwaButhelezi (Mangosuthu). Wayewazi umsebenzi kahulumeni ukuthi uhamba ugcinephi, futhi wayewazi umsebenzi kaNdunankulu kaZulu ukuthi uhamba ugcinephi."Lo msebenzi wokwengamela umnyango weSilo ngokukahulumeni, uphethwe yihhovisi likaNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal. Akufanele kube nezitatimende eziqhamuka kuNdunankulu kaZulu ezigxambukela emsebenzini kahulumeni. Uma uNdunankulu kaZulu kunezinto angaziqondi kahle, kufanele afonele uNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal.”

ZIKHALE ngezinkinga ezehlukene iziboshwa zesifazane ejele laseWestville, izolo, ngesikhathi kuhambele uMphathiswa wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi KwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Nonhlanhla Khoza.UNkk Khoza ubehlele ukuyohlanganyela neziboshwa zesifazane ezalahlwa amacala okubulala abesilisa ezazithandana nabo.UMPHATHISWA wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi KwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Nonhlanhla Khoza, ekhuluma neziboshwa zesifazane ejele laseWestville Isithombe: ZIMBILI VILAKAZIUPhumelele Zulu weseMelmoth, ukhale ngeminye yemithetho elawula ukuphathwa kweziboshwa kubalwa nezesifazane."Aseneme ngezigwebo. Nami bengiqhubeka nokuqhubeza izifundo zami kodwa kuthe ngo-2019, sekufanele ngiyogqoka ijazi lami le-Honours, kwathiwa ngiyingozi, angikwazi ukuya,” kusho uNkk Mthethwa.Ubuze umbuzo wokuthi ngesikhathi efundisa ezinye iziboshwa usuke engesiyo ingozi?"Lokhu esakwenzayo kwakungafanele, kodwa uma usungaphakathi, isibuyile nengqondo, uthi uyazakha kabusha kodwa ugcine ufana nomuntu ongakaze enze lutho,” kusho uNkk Mthethwa.UNomshado Mdluli waseNorth West ukhale ngokungabibikho kwezingcingo ezenele ezisebenzayo ngaphakathi ejele."Ukusuka eNorth West uza la, kuthatha amahora angu-12. Kunzima ukuthi umndeni wami ungazongibona lana. Ukuba nocingo olulodwa kuphela olusebenzayo kuyasikhathaza ngoba sethembele ezingcingweni ukuthi sixhumane nemindeni yethu nezingane zethu,” kusho uMdluli.Umphathi wamajele KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Mnikelwa Nxele, uthe ezinye zezinto eziphakanyiswe yiziboshwa njengenkinga yocingo bazozisukumela bona.UMphathiswa wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi KwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Khoza, uthe ngokuhambela kwabo isikhungo, bazonika ithemba lokuthi ngale kobumnyama kukhona ukukhanya."Sike sifice umntwana ona-14 esibhedlela (ezobeletha), uma umbuza ukuthi okabani umntwana, kuvele kwehle izinyembezi. Uthole udaba lokuthi umntwana okababa omzalayo, okamalume, okamakhelwane, abantu abaseduze. Uma ufika kuleso simo esinjalo uwumama, kufanele wenzenjani? Uhleke? Ngeke. Yingakho sithi siyaziqonda izimo ezinibeke lana,” kusho uNkk Khoza.Wathembise ukuthi izikhalazo eziphakanyisiwe bazozisukumela.

IPHINI leNhloko yamaJaji kuleli iJaji Mandisa Maya, linike uMkhonto weSizwe (MK), umnqamulajuqu wanamuhla ukufaka amaphepha uma bephikisa, i-IEC esicelweni sayo sokudlulisa isinqumo senkantolo ngodaba lokufakwa ephepheni lokuvota igama lowayengumengameli, uJacob Zuma.Izwe lilungiselela ukhetho lukazwelonke oluzoba ngoMeyi 29, lapho okulindeleke ukuthi zidlane imilala uma amaqembu esebanga amavoti.Wongaphansi nongaphezulu phakathi kwe-IEC neMK abafakana ezinkantolo.AbeMK bamile ekutheni iyoze iyochithana ngoba yona ayijiki iya okhethweni futhi izimisele ngokunqoba, iphathe izwe.UZuma ngoDisemba nyakenye umemezele iqembu elisha iMK wathi usehamba nalo, uzolikhankasela futhi aleseke okhethweni.I-IEC yasefa uZuma yamkhipha ohlwini ithi walahlwa yicala wagwetshwa kanti umthetho uthi akufanele umuntu onjalo aye ePhalamende. UZuma neMK balwedlulisela eNkantolo yezoKhetho udaba, bafike balunqoba.I-IEC ngokungeneliseki kwayo ngesinqumo senkantolo yamemezela ukuthi iyalwedlulisa udaba luya eNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo.I-MK ilokhu iwanqobe njalo amacala ebifakelwe wona ezinkantolo zakuleli.Icala lokuqala yilapho i-ANC ebiphosela khona inselelo isinqumo sokubhalisa nokwemukela iMK njengeqembu.I-IEC yagunyaza ukubhaliswa kweMK yahamba yayosimela isinqumo sayo enkantolo, i-ANC yakhala ngaphansi.Kuphinde kwaba necala elifakwe yiyona futhi i-ANC, eNkantolo eNkulu eThekwini kubangwa uphawu loMkhonto weSizwe.I-ANC iphinde yakhala ngaphansi kulolu daba yehlulwa futhi yamemezela ukuthi izosedlulisa lesi sinqumo ngoba ayeneme ngaso.Olunye udaba yilolu lokungena kukaZuma ohlwini lwabaya ePhalamende.Kwenzeka konke lokhu nje, i-IEC isivele iwagayile amaphepha okuvota futhi ubuso bukaZuma buyavela njengokunguyena ongumholi weqembu iMK.
UMMELI ecaleni lokubulawa kukaSenzo Meyiwa u-Advocate Thulani Mngomezulu, uthe uzizwa engaphephile emuva kokugasela kwamadoda amabili kwakhe ezintatha zangoLwesithathu.UMngomezulu omele ummangalelwa wokuqala uMuzikawukhulelwa Sibiya, ubike lolu daba enkantolo ngesikhathi kuqhubeka icala.UMeyiwa owayeyisilomo se-Orlando Pirates neBafana Bafana, wadutshulwa wabulawa ekubo kwentombi yakhe uKelly Khumalo, eVosloorus, eGauteng ngo-2014.UMngomezulu owajoyina icala seliphakathi, ubikele iJaji uRatha Mokgoatlheng ngamadoda asolisayo afike kwakhe.Uthe unezinsolo zokuthi kuhlobene nokusebenza kwakhe kuleli cala.UMngomeezulu uqale wacela inguyazana neJaji, uMshushisi nabanye abameli bayoxoxa esithe.Babuya lapho laqhubeka icala kodwa lithe selisongwa base belikhumbuza iJaji.IJaji libe selendlala udaba esidlangaleni njengokucela kukaMngomezulu."Ngithole umbiko othusayo kuMngomezulu engibikela ngesigameko asola ukuthi sihlobene naleli cala.Ubike ngamadoda amabili afike emzini wakhe egcaluza ngendlela esolisayo ezintatha.Ngenhlanhla izinja zibhoke kakhulu, zawaphazamisa la madoda abezama ukungena,’’ kusho iJaji.IJaji lithi uMngomezulu akaneme neze ngoba usola ukuthi la madoda abezomenzakalisa futhi uzizwa engaphephile emuva kwesigameko."UMngomezulu uthi uyasola ukuthi laba balisa bebeze kabi kuyena befuna ukumenza okubi noma bambulale ngoba phela yizigameko ezenzekayo eNingizimu Afrika lezi,’’ kusho iJaji.IJaji lithe uMngomezulu unelungelo lokuthi avikeleke ngoba ungumsebenzi wenkantolo futhi kungaba kuhle uma udaba engalubika amaphoyiseni.Libe selinquma ukulweneka esidlangaleni udaba ukuze kwaziwe ukuthi uMngomezulu uyaphazamiseka emsebenzini.IJaji libuze uMngomezulu ukuthi wenelisekile yini ngendlela eleneke ngayo udaba. UMngomezulu uthe kukhona afisa ukukwengeza ngesinye isigameko esithinta igama lakhe."Nakuba ngingeke ngikuhlanganise lokhu nalolu daba kodwa ngizokusho."Nkosi yenkantolo iKaya FM ixoxe noChicco Twala ngobufakazi bukaSifiso Meyiwa, ethi angiwazi umsebenzi wami, akazi ukuthi ngimfakelani kuleli cala,’’ kusho uMngomezulu ngokukhathazeka.UMngomezulu ubesanda kuveza ukuthi isitatimende sikaMeyiwa (uSifiso), siveza ukuthi uSihlalo we-Orlando Pirates nePSL, uMnuz Irvin Khoza wathi umufi akabulawanga yizigebengu.UMngomezulu uthe uzobiza uChicco, uKelly noKhoza bazofakaza ngabakwaziyo kuleli cala. Abameli baqedile ukupheka ngemibuzo ufakazi owumphenyi uSergeant Batho Mogola. Icala liyaqhubeka namuhla, uMbuso uzokhomba indlela.
BASASHAQEKILE namanje ngesigameko sokumbiwa kwesidumbu sengane enezinyanga ezinhlanu eMpongompongweni, ngaseNtshawini, KwaDukuza, ngoMgqibelo, okuthiwa igqitshwe abazali bayo ngeledlule.Kulesi sigameko kuboshwe uyise kamufi, uSmangaliso Kwanele Nqoko ngoMsombuluko, obanjwe esegcwele amathafa.Kuthintwa ikhansela lendawo, uMnuz Nkululeko Qwabe mayelana nesigameko, lithe lithole ukuthi ingane yagqitshwa yizithandani ebusuku ngoMgqibelo owedlule, emva kokubona ukuthi isishonile.INDAWO yesigameko lapho okutholwe khona ingane igqitshiwe Isithombe: SITHUNYELWEUQwabe uthe ngokuzwa kwakhe, izithandani zazikade zihambe ziyophuza endaweni yokucima ukoma endaweni nayo ingane.Kuthiwa, sezibuya owesifazane wazumeka walala, wavuswa owesilisa ephethe ingane ngesandla, ethi isishonile akazi kwenzekeni."Kuthiwa bavumelana ngokuthi kungcono bavele bayoyigqiba ngasemfuleni osendaweni. Bazama kodwa behluleka ngoba babengenawo amathuluzi okumba,” kusho uQwabe.Uthe bagcine becela usizo komunye wabangani ukuthi abambise egcekeni kubo kowesilisa (uyise wengane) owamdonsa ngendlebe umngani ukuthi aze angayithi vu."Kuthiwa emva kokuba sebeyigqibile, waphinde wasabisa yena unina wengane ukuthi angatsheli muntu,” kusho yena.Uthe ngokuqhubeka kwezinsuku, izihlobo zabo zibabuzile ukuthi iphi ingane, baqamba amanga bathi bayivakashise kwezinye izihlobo.UMUFI uSmangaliso Kwanele Nqoko"Unina wengane ubeyikhomba ezihlotsheni zikayise, uyise eyikhomba ezihlotsheni zikanina,” usho kanje.Udalule ukuthi ngoMgqibelo owedlule, isihlobo sipotshozelwe umuntu othile ukuthi abalulandele udaba "lokuvakashiswa” kwengane ngoba kukhona okushaya amanzi."Lesi sihlobo sivele sanikela kubo kayise wengane namaphoyisa. Wavele wabaleka uyise wengane, kwacaca lapho ukuthi kukhona okungahambi kahle,” usho kanje.Uqhube wathi unina wengane uhlaliswe phansi wabuzwa ukuthi iphi ingane, wagonyuluka ngokuthi bayigqibile, washo nokuthi yena uvuke isishonile, wancengwa uyise wayo ukuthi bayigqibe.Uveze ukuthi ngesikhathi sesimbiwa isidumbu sengane, siphume sisongwe ngengubo, kanti besicindezelwe ngezingodo."Kuphinde kwavela nokuthi besiphuma igazi ngomlomo, nokuqinisa izinsolo zokuthi mhlawumbe yalinyazwa okuthile yashona,” kusho uQwabe.Ubuye wathi emva kokuboshwa ngoMsombuluko, uyise wengane ukhombe unina wayo, ethi wuye owayicindezela ngebele eyincelisa. Uthe unina wayo yena ukhomba uyise wayo ngelithi umvuse eyiphethe ngezandla isishonile.Uthe siwushaqise wonke umphakathi isigameko."Sibonga ukuthi aboshwe uyise wayo, sifisa kuqhubeke uphenyo, aboshwe nonina uma etholwa enecala,” kusho uQwabe.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uConstable Thenjiswa Ngcobo, uthe amaphoyisa aKwaDukuza abophe umsolwa (29) kulandela isigameko. Uthe umsolwa uzovela namuhla eNkantolo yeMantshi yaKwaDukuza.Umamkhulu kamufi, uNksz Nomzamo Nqoko okunguye owathola ucingo esihlotsheni simtshela ukuthi akaphenyisise "ngokuvakasha” kwengane, uthe abakufunayo ukubuya kwemiphumela yokuhlolwa kwesidumbu."Ukuze uma enecala, kwenziwe ubulungiswa. Ngibufuna impela ubulungiswa ngengane yami. Unina namanje usathuka izanya, sibi impela isimo kuyena,” kusho uNksz Nqoko.
IFUNA kube khona okwenziwayo ngamaphoyisa angamazambane abolile asebenzisana nemigilulukudu, i-Democratic Allience (DA).Lokhu ikusho izolo ngesikhathi ihambele esiteshini samaphoyisa saseVerulam, okuke kwaba nemibiko yokuthi amaphoyisa akhona ayehluleka ukwenza umsebenzi.Kusabalale imibiko ebisola amaphoyisa akulesi siteshi ngokuba mdibimunye nemigulukudu.UMnuz Chris Pappas oyiMeya yaseMgeni, okhethelwe kwesobundunankulu kwi-DA, uthe bakhathazekile kakhulu ngemibiko engemihle ngalesi siteshi.Uthe kumele asuswe amaphoyisa angamazambane abolile asebenzisana nemigulukudu."Kusiphathe kabi ukuzwa ngezindaba zokuthi kukhona amaphoyisa akulesi siteshi asebenzisana nezigebengu," usho kanje.Ulimise ngesihloko elokuthi eVerulam, Mashu neNanda, babhekene nengwadla yokwanda kobugebengu.Eqhuba uphosele inselelo uNgqongqoshe wezamaPhoyisa, uMnuz Bheki Cele, ukuba kube khona akwenzayo ngalesi simo.Uthe akukho okuzolunga uma amaphoyisa sekuyiwona ezwa ngezinswelaboya.UMnuz Ian Cameron oyisishoshovu esilwa nobugebengu, uthe kubi ukuthi mihla namalanga kukhulunywa ngenkinga yobugebengu KwaZulu-Natal.Usole uhulumeni ophethe ngokungabi nazo izimpendulo ngenkinga yobugebengu obugubazele iKwaZulu-Natal nezinye izifundazwe.Uthembise ukuthi bona bazimisele ngokuthi benze konke okusemandleni abo ngenhloso yokuqinisekisa ukuthi kuyaphela ukucanasa kwezigebengu eVerulam.Uphawule nangodaba lowesilisa okuthiwa uyacanasa eVerulam ngoba uzwana namaphoyisa."Kumeke kube khona okwenziwayo mayelana nalo wesilisa okuthiwa wenza umathanda ngoba nakhu asebenzisana namaphoyisa," echaza.Umphakathi wakule ndawo ukhale ngokungalutholi usizo emaphoyiseni njalo uma kunezigameko zobugebengu.
IPHINI likaNgqongqoshe wezokuVakasha, uMnuz Fish Mahlalela lithe ubalulekile umbukiso omkhulukazi wezokuvakasha kuleli i-Africa’s Travel Indaba njengoba ungenisa uR408.6 million emnothweni wezwe.UMahlalela uthe konke kumi ngomumo nge-Africa’s Travel Indaba yalo nyaka ezoba ngoMeyi 13 kuya ku-16, eNkosi Albert Luthuli International Convention Centre, eThekwini.Uthe ucwaningo lwabo luveze ukuthi ngonyaka odlule i-Africa’s Travel Indaba yadala amathuba omsebenzi awu-2 295, yangenisa uR75 million wentela eye kuhulumeni.Uthe kulo nyaka bazoletha osomabhizinisi abasafufusa abawu-120 bewuMnyango wezokuVakasha kazwelonke, ukuze bakwazi ukuzikhangisa."Sifuna ukushintsha umkhakha wezokuvakasha ukuze ube nabo bonke abantu bakuleli. Siyazi ukuthi kugcwele abasebenzi besifazane kulo mkhakha kodwa asibaboni ezikhundleni zokuphatha. Sifuna ukukushintsha lokhu ukuze sibabone yonke indawo,” kusho uMahlalela.Uthe umkhakha wezokuvakasha uyakwazi ukudala amathuba omsebenzi amaningi ngakho uma wona usebenza kahle, umnotho uzokhula nabantu baqashwe.USihlalo wekomiti lezokuThuthukiswa koMnotho kuMasipala weTheku, uMnuz Thembo Ntuli, uthe i-Africa’s Travel Indaba iza namathuba omsebenzi awu-796 eThekwini. Balindele ukuthi ingenise uR439 million emnothweni waleli dolobha.Uveze ukuthi amahhotela asebhukhwe ngaphezu kuka-85% njengoba kuza i-Africa’s Travel Indaba futhi akangabazi ukuthi azogcwala.UMphathiswa wezokuThuthukiswa koMnotho, ezokuVakasha neMvelo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Siboniso Duma, uthe bazoletha osomabhizinisi abasafufusa abawu-15 abazokhangisa imikhiqizo yabo kwi-Africa’s Travel Indaba ukuze bakwazi ukukhula.Uthe lo mbukiso ubalulekile ngoba ufukula umnotho wesifundazwe iKwaZulu-Natal kwazise abawuhambelayo baphenduka amanxusa alelizwe.UMphathiswa wezokuThuthukiswa koMnotho, ezokuVakasha neMvelo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Siboniso Duma esithangamini sokwethulwa kombukiso wezokuvakasha i-Africa’s Travel Indaba, eBat Centre, eThekwini Isithombe: Doctor Ngcobo
ISILO uMisuzulu kaZwelithini sizwakalise ukungenami ngesinqumo sikahulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal sokuhoxisa isivumelwano nenyosi engumeluleki eNdlunkulu ngaphandle kokuxhumana naso. Esitatimendeni esithunyelwe ihhovisi likaNdunankulu kaZulu izolo, iNdlulamithi ithe uhulumeni wesifundazwe kawusazi nokuthi siyini iSilo. Lokhu kulandela ukunqanyulwa isigubhukane kwenkontileka yoqweqwe lwenyosi, uMnuz Buzetsheni Mdletshe. ISilo sixwayise uhulumeni ngokungahloniphi umndeni waseNdlunkulu kanye neSilo sathi kufana nokufaka uZulu umunwe esweni. Ngokwesitatimende, uMdletshe usazoqhubeka nokuhasha iNgonyama. ISilo sesiyalele uNdunankulu kaZulu, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, ukuthi enze isiqiniseko sokuthi uMdletshe uyaqhubeka nokwenza umsebenzi wakhe waseNdlunkulu yize esediliziwe wuhulumeni wesifundazwe.UMdletshe usebenza njengenyosi, aphinde abe ngumeluleki weMbube kwezamasiko. Ubeholelwa uhulumeni wesiifundazwe. UMdletshe uneminyaka esondela ku-50 ehasha amakhosi aKwaZulu njengoba waqala ngesikhathi kubusa iSilo uGoodwill Zwelithini kaBhekuzulu.NgoMsombuluko ihhovisi likaNdunankulu wesifundazwe sibhale incwadi ebhekiswe kuMdletshe ukuthi inkontileka yakhe izonqanyulwa ekupheleni kwale nyanga. "UMdletshe ubambe iqhaza elibalulekile emikhosini yaseNdlunkulu. Uyena ovula imikhosi engcwele, umkhosi wokugezwa owenziwa ngaphambi kokuthi inkosi entsha ingene eSihlalweni nomkhosi wokweshwama,” kusho uNdunankulu weSilo.Ngokuthola kweSolezwe, uMdletshe uthintwe isigijimi sehhovisi likaNdunankulu ngoLwesihlanu wabe esesihlangabeza emgwaqweni ngenxa yobubi bendlela ebheke ekhaya. Kuthiwa isigijimi sifike samnika incwadi yokunqanyulwa kwenkontileka ngaphandle kokuchaza okuningi, sase siyahamba. Abaningi bakholelwa ukuthi uMdletshe wazidalela amazinyo abushelelezi ngokunqaba ukulandela umyalelo kaMphathiswa wezokuThuthukiswa koMnotho KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Siboniso Duma ngesikhathi kunombango wombhobho emcimbini wokukhumbula iSilo uDinuzulu kaCetshwayo kwaCeza.Ngesikhathi uDuma eyabula umbhobho kusakhuluma uButhelezi, wayalela uMdletshe ukuba asukumise iSilo, kepha uMdletshe walandula, wathi inqubo iyamphikisa ukuthi angasukumisa iSilo ekubeni ekhona uNdunankulu kaZulu.Abeluleki beSilo, uSolwazi Jabulani Maphalala noMnuz Philani Mavundla bazwakalise ukukhathazeka ngokunqanyulwa kwesivumelwano sokusebenza sikaMdletshe. Esitatimendeni, bathe lokhu kushiya imibuzo ukuthi kungani kunqanyulwa izinto ezibalulekile kodwa kuyekwa imicimbi kahulumeni ewubukhazikhazi, okusetshenziswa kuyo imali ngezinto ezingathi shu kubalwa ubumnandi. Bathe kunzima ukungayamanisi lokhu nokunqaba kukaMdletshe ukwenza ayekuyalelwa wuDuma emcimbini wakwaCeza. Kuthintwa okhulumela ihhovisi likaNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Bongi Gwala, izolo uthembise ukuthi bazokhipha isitatimende kepha kuze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela bengakasikhiphi isitatimende.UMdletshe uthe inkontileka yakhe bekufanele iphele ngo-2025.Ngokwencwadi evela kuhulumeni ehhovisi likaNdunankulu, inkontileka izonqanyulwa ngo-Ephreli 30 futhi isizathu kuthiwa wukushoda kwemali.UMdletshe ubesewuholela ngenkampani yakhe umsebenzi awuqhuba eNdlunkulu, esesebenza njengetoho, okuwuhlelo olwenziwa ngemuva kokuthatha kwakhe umhlalaphansi ngesikhathi kusabusa uMdlokombane.UMdlokombane wacela ukuthi uMdletshe aqhubeke njengetoho, ekhala ngokuthi usamdinga eduze kwakhe. Nangesikhathi kungena iNdlulamithi, nayo yanxusa ukuthi uMdletshe aqhubeke nokusebenza ngale ndlela.
Uma wena noma othile omaziyo uphila ne-HIV futhi uthatha ama-ARV nsuku zonke, ungazuza Akubonakali = Akudluliseki (U=U). Lokhu kusho ukuthi izinga le-HIV emzimbeni wakho lizoba iphansi kangangokuthi ngeke ibe yingozi kuwe futhi ngeke ukwazi ukuyidlulisela kwabanye. Njenganoma yisiphi esinye isifo esingalapheki, ngisho noma kutholakala ukuthi une-HIV, ungaphila isikhathi eside, impilo enempilo ngokuthatha imithi yakho nsuku zonke, njengoba kuyaliwe. Ngokuthatha ama-ARV akho nsuku zonkekanye nokuzuza ukucindezelwa komthamo wegciwane egazini (Akubonakali), ungakwazi:- Phila impilo ende nenempilo- Yiba nomzimba onamandla wokulwa nokugula- Bheka futhi uzizwe umnandi- Vakashela umtholampilo izikhathi ezimbalwa lapho uzinzile ekwelashweni- Qoqa imithi yakho ezindaweni ezikahle zokuthatha ngaphandle kokuya emtholampilo- Ungadluliseli i-HIV kwabanyeUmsebenzi wezempilo uzokunikeza ukuhlolwa kwenani legciwane egazini ukuze athole ukuthi ngabe uyi-U=U. Uma ufinyelela ku-U=U, kufanele uqhubeke uthatha ama-ARV akho nsuku zonke ukuze uhlale Ungabonakali = Ayidluliseleki.Ngenxa yokuthi usenayo i-HIV+, kufanele uqhubeke nokusebenzisa ikhondomu ukuvimbela ezinye izifo ezithathelwana ngocansi kanyeukukhulelwa okungahleliwe. Kungenzeka ukuthi ulahlekelwe yi-U=U uma uyeka ukuphuza ama-ARV akho noma ungawaphuzinjengoba kushiwo.I-U=U ayikona nje ukucindezela igciwane; kumayelana nokujabulela impilo kakhulu nokukhathazeka kancane ngakhoI-HIV ikubambezele. Ngokwelashwa nokunakekelwa okufanele, abantu abaphila ne-HIV bangahola begcweleiphila ngesikhathi inikela ekuqedeni ukusabalala kwe-HIV.Ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi: https://www.uequalsu.co.zaFacebook: https://www.facebook.com/UequalsUzaInstagram: https://www.instagram.com/uequalsu_zaYouTube: http://www.youtube.com/@UequalsU_za

KUSOLWA isikhwele sokungafuni ukwaliwa kowesilisa obengusingababa oboshelwe icala lokubulala ingane yentombazane eneminyaka emibili, isidumbu sayo wasilahla egcekeni kubo kwayo.Isigameko sokubulawa kuka-Ayabonga Mthethwa senzeke eSiqungeni, eMthwalume ngoMgqibelo ebusuku.Umsolwa okuthiwa ungumakhelwane kamufi, uboshwe ngeSonto ekuseni wathweswa icala lokubulala.Ngokusho kukanina omncane ka-Ayabonga, uNksz Anele Mthethwa, umsolwa ufike kuyena ngosuku lwesigameko wathi uzothatha ingane uthunywe wunina wayo bahlezi naye kwamakhelwane.Uthe unina wengane ubekade engekho ekhaya ngaleso sikhathi esezindaweni zobumnandi.Lona wesifazane uqhube wathi uvumile ukuthi umsolwa ahambe nengane engazi ukuthi uyamkhohlisa akathunywanga unina wayo obesebumnandini."Ngibe sengifonelwa unina wengane engibuza ukuthi ingane ikuphi? Umthetho uzothatha indawo yawo athole isigwebo esimfanele,” kusho uNksz Sibisi.Ube eseyala abantu besifazane wathi abaqhele ebudlelwaneni bezothando obungebuhle futhi abahlukunyezwayo kubona.Uthe alikho ithuna lomuntu ongajoli kodwa maningi awabantu ababulawe emjolweni.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uColonel Robert Netshiunda uthe kuboshwe owesilisa oneminyaka engu-34.Ubekwe icala lokuthumba nelokubulala futhi uzovela eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMzumbe maduze.UNetshiunda uthe kusolakala ukuthi ngoMgqibelo umsolwa nonina wengane babe nengxabano elandelwe wukuthi athumbe ingane kwaphetha ngokuthi ayibulalele kubo.
IKHUZA umuga i-Azapo ngokungagadwa kwethuna lesishoshovu somzabalazo uSteve Biko. Lokhu kwenzeka ngemuva kokucekelwa phansi kwethuna likaBiko, lapho kubhonculwe izinsimbi eziwumfanekiso wezandla eziboshiwe.Ithuna lesishoshovu liseSteve Biko Garden of Remembrance eGinsberg, eQonce, e-Eastern Cape. Abe-Azapo bathi babikelwe ukuthi kubonakale sezingasekho izinsimbi zethusi eziwumfanekiso wezandla zomuntu oboshiwe."Simangazwa wukuthi uMasipala iBuffalo City Metro awunakekeli, uhlinzeke ngezokuphepha endaweni ebaluleke kangaka. Ithuna likaBiko nendlu yakhe kwemukelwa nenjengendawo yamagugu ngaphansi kwe-South African Heritage Recources Agency,’’ kusho i-Azapo.Kuthiwa abenhlangano iSteve Biko Foundation, yibona ababikele umndeni kaBiko ngokucekelwa phansi kwetshe lethuna, okuthiwa akwaziwa ukuthi kwenziwe ngubani futhi akunamkhondo.UBiko owayengumholi weBlack Consiousness Movement (BCM), edabuka eKing Williamstown, wafela esitokisini ngo-1977, ePitoli. Ukufa kwakhe kuthiwa kwaba wumphumela wokushawa kanzima ngamaphoyisa ngenxa yezenzo zakhe zokulwela inkululeko.ITSHE lethuna likaSteve Biko ngaphambi kokuthi licekelwe phansi, kubhonculwe izinsimbi ezingumfanekiso wezandla eiboshiwe Isithombe : SITHUNYELWEAbe-Azapo bathe kuyichilo okwenzekile futhi kukhombisa ukuthi uhulumeni awunandaba neqhaza likaBiko emzabalazweni wenkululeko yezwe. I-Azapo ithe kungakuhle uma umasipala engase uyibiyele le ndawo bese eyihlinzeka ngezokuphepha ukuze kungaphinde kwenze lokhu.Bacele amaphoyisa ukuthi asheshise aphenye kabanzi ukuze abambe labo noma lowo owenze lo mhlolo, wacekela phansi ithuna likaBiko.Ngo-2022, kwabikwa ngokucekelwa phansi kwetshe lethuna lesinye isishoshovu somzabalazo uMnuz Chris Hani. Itshe lethuna likaHani lacekelwa phansi ngezinsuku okwadedelwa ngazo umbulali wakhe, uJanusz Walus.Ngo-2019 kwabikwa ngokucekelwa phansi kwethuna lesishoshovu uMnuz Moses Mabhida eliseMbali, eMgungundlovu. Nakhona umndeni wawukhala ngokunganakekelwa kwethuna likaMabhida.
UNGQONGQOSHE kaGesi, uDkt Kgosientsho Ramokgopa, uthi ukungacishwa kukagesi izinsuku zilandelana kumbule izinqe amaqembu ezepolitiki abesesizakele, esebenzisa lenkinga ukukhankasela ukhetho.URamokgopa uthe lamaqembu awasazi ukuthi akhankase ngokuthini njengoba sekuphele izinsuku eziningi ugesi ungacishwa.Uthe lamaqembu asekhethe ukuqamba amanga, athi ugesi awucishwa ngenxa yokuthi sekusondele ukhetho.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba izolo lapho ebephawula ngezithinta ugesi.Ekuqaleni kwalonyaka nangonyaka owedlule izwe beliphuma lingena ngaphansi kwezigaba ezahlukene zokucishwa kukagesi.Muva nje isathule inkinga yokucishwa kukagesi njengoba sekuphele izinsuku ezingu-26 ungacishwa.Ukungacishwa kukagesi izinsuku eziningi zilandelana kwagcina ukwenzeka ngo-Ephreli 2022, lapho ungazange ucishwe izinsuku ezingu-28 zilandelana.Lesi simo sesiholele ekutheni inkukhu iwusole umgqakazo emaqenjini aphikisayo, asola ukuthi ugesi awucishwa ngenxa yokuthi sekusondele ukhetho.Abaholi bamaqembu aphikisayo abakhombise ukushaya amakhala, umholi we-IFP uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa, uNobhala Jikelele we-EFF uMnuz Marshall Dlamini, nomholi weDA uMnuz John Steenhuisen.UHlabisa ucele abantu ukuthi bangayivoteli i-ANC okhethweni oluzayo noma ngabe ugesi uyaqhubeka nokungacishwa.Lokhu ukusho ngesikhathi ekhuluma emcimbini we-IFP obuKwaNongoma ngeSonto.UDlamini yena uthi ugesi uzoqhubeka nokucishwa emva kokhetho.Lokhu ukusho ngesikhathi ehola umbhikisho ngaphandle kwamahhovisi kaMasipala waseMsunduzi ngoLwesihlanu.Esitatatimendeni, uSteenhuisen uthe i-ANC ifaka ingcindezi yokuthi ungacishwa ugesi.Kepha uRamokgopa uthe ukungacishwa kukagesi akuhlangene nokhetho lwangoMeyi 29.URamokgopa uthe kukhona amaqembu ezepolitiki abese sizakele ngenkinga yokucishwa kukagesi."Bebesebenzisa lenkinga ukukhankasela ukhetho. Ngoba-ke manje ugesi awusacishwa, abasenaso isikhali sokukhankasela ukhetho."Yingakho sebehambe bekhuluma izinto ezingekho. Kukhona nje engikubone kubhalwe ngomunye wabo, ngihluleka ngisho nawukukuchaza,” kusho uRamokgopa.Uqhubeke ngokuthi ukungacishwa kukagesi izinsuku zilandelana kukhombisa ukuthi imizamo yabo yokulwa nalenkinga isiqalile ukuthela izithelo ezinhle."Kade sawuqala lombhidlango. Sibhekane nobunzima endleleni nokuyinto engayisho ngesikhathi kumnyama kakhulu, ukuthi kukhona esizokuvuna ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Sesiqalile-ke ukuvuna,” esho.URamokgopa uthe sebeyayinqoba inkinga yokucishwa kukagesi, yize ingakapheli kodwa usukhona umehluko.Uphethe ngokuthi usemncane umehluko kodwa okubaqinisa idolo wukuthi uyabonakala.
UBANJWE ugesi washona umsebenzi ngesikhathi ezama ukutakula uzakwabo obesenkingeni efana neyakhe.Kuthiwa uMnuz Sithembiso Nkomanisi (20) uficwe wukufa ngesikhathi yena nabanye asebenza nabo belungiselela ukuqala umsebenzi.Kuvela ukuthi bebezolungisa isiphehlimandla sikagesi iNkobongo Substation, eShakaskraal, KwaDukuza ngoMsombuluko.Okhulumela uMasipala waKwaDukuza uMnuz Sphesihle Ngobese, ulandise ngokuthi umufi ubengumsebenzi wenkampani ezimele eyaziwa ngokuthi Ijuba Investments ebijutshwe wumasipala ukwenza umsebenzi wokulungisa isiphehlimandla sikagesi."Kusolakala ukuthi uNkomanisi ubanjwe ugesi ngesikhathi ezama ukuhlenga uzakwabo okunguyena oqale wabanjwa ugesi,” kusho uNgobese.Kubikwa ukuthi umsebenzi wokulungisa okuthile kulesiphehlimandla sikagesi bewuzokwenza kunqamuke ukuphakelwa kukagesi emiphakathini eminingi eyakhele uWard 7, 8, 12, 20, 23 no-28.UNgobese ube esedlulisa amazwi enduduzo emndenini kamufi, enkampanini abeyisebenzela, ophikweni lukagesi nakubantu abebemazi.Ube esefisela ukwelulama okuphuthumayo kuNgema okuthiwa uyelashwa esibhedlela.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uConstable Thenjiswa Ngcobo, uthe amaphoyisa aseMhlali avule idokodo lapho ephenya khona imbangela yokushona komuntu.Uthe kusolakala ukuthi uNkomanisi nozakwabo bebekade benza umsebenzi wokushintshwa kwamakhebuli kanti uzobanjwa ugesi.Uthe ushonele esibhedlela efika.
UHLULEKE ukuzibamba wavele wakhihla isililo enkantolo, umkamfundisi ngesikhathi ebona umyeni wakhe emi phambi kwemantshi ngamacala abhekene nawo okudlwengula izingane ezincane.UMfu Mandla Mahlaba (49), izolo, uvele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseNtuzuma, ngamacala okudlwengulwa izingane zamantombazane ezineminyaka engu-13.Umkakhe ocele ukuba lingadalulwa igama lakhe, ukhulume neSolezwe ngendlela azizwa ngayo.Uthe okwenziwe ngumyeni wakhe uyokuxoxela amagwababa echobana. Uthe kumzwise ubuhlungu obukhulu ukuthi uMahlaba akhulelise ingane yakhe yentombazane eneminyaka engu-19 ngoba azi ukuthi akayizali.Uveze ukuthi ubenganalo ulwazi ngomjolo obuphakathi komntanakhe nomyeni wakhe. "Bengingazi mina ukuthi bobabili bayathandana,'' usho kanje.Uthe akukho azokubuza umntanakhe ngoba okwamanje akakulungele ukuthi kungaba khona ingxoxo emayelana nalolu daba phakathi kwabo bobabili."Angeke ngize ngiluxoxe okwamanje nomntanani lolu daba. Ngiyehluleka,'' usho kanje.IMantshi uMisri ithe okwamanje kukhona izinto ezincane inkantolo esafuna ukuzibhekisisa ngakho kuhle ukuthi isicelo sakhe sebheyili asenze ngokuzayo uma esevele enkantolo.Icala lihlehliselwe u-Epreli 30, nonyaka.UMahlaba ubefake ijakhethi emhlophe elokhu ebheke phansi njalo. Kuthe uma esehla esephindela phansi ekhulukuthu wabonakala ewabuka amalungu ebandla lakhe abejabulela ukuthi usazoqhubeka nokubhadla ejele.Ngaphandle kwenkantolo umphakathi ububhikisha uphethe izingqwembe ebezinemibhalo eyehlukene.Eminye yazo ibibhalwe ukuthi anganikwa ibheyili. Eminye ibithi abazalwane sebezoke baphumule ukudla amasi nesiklabhu masonto onke. Lokhu kusukela ekutheni uMahlaba ubebadlisa lezi zinto ethi uyabasiza, uqaqa izinkinga zabo.Amalungu ebandla akhale ngempatho yoMfundisi bethi ibibaxaka. Omunye waleli bandla, uthe bekubamangaza ukuthi uMahlaba kungani asondelane kakhulu nezingane zamantombazane ezincane."Kusho ukuthi ubazi ukuthi uhloseni ngazo,’’ lisho kanje ilungu. Lithe aphume nobomvu njengoba ekhalelwe ngamasongo kaSigonyela.Elinye lithe bafisa abolele ejele uMahlaba, lamchaza njengempisi embethe isikhumba semvu.Omunye umzali kamgilwa, ocele ukuba igama lakhe lingadalulwa uveze ukuthi ingane yakhe eneminyaka engu-13, ikhulelwe ingane yoMfundisi."Iyangicika le nto eyenziwe yilo Mfundisi enganeni yami. Ngikhuluma nawe nje ihlukumezekile kakhulu. UMENGAMELI we-ANC, uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa ubize ngezimaku amalungu eMK azame ukufaka unyawo lwedada emkhankasweni wakhe wokhetho.URamaphosa uwatshele ezinhlamvini zamehlo amalungu eMK azame ukumphazamisa ukuthi ayizimaku ezikhonkotha ubala.Lokhu kwenzeke ngesikhathi uRamaphosa ekhankasa enxanxatheleni yezitolo iHammarsdale Junction, ngeSonto.Kuthe uRamaphosa esakhuluma namalungu e-ANC, kwaqhamuka iqeqebana labantu abebefake izikibha ze-MK, bacula izingoma ezibhinqa uRamaphosa ne-ANC.URamaphosa ube esefanisa amalungu eMK nezinja ezikhonkotha ubala."Abanye bafana nama-blackie. Niyayazi inja encane ehlezi ikhonkotha, ingazi ukuthi ikhonkothani? Nampa abanye bayakhonkotha (esho ekhomba amalungu eMK). Bonke nje bayizinja ezikhonkotha ubala."Ube esekhuza isiqubulo esithi niyabesaba na, washo ekhomba amalungu eMK.Amalungu eMK anqabile ukukhuluma nabezindaba. Kume yonke into ngesikhathi uRamaphosa efika enxanxatheleni yezitolo.Kube ububhudubhudu abantu befuna ukuzibonela uRamaphosa, namalungu e-ANC abengazibekile phansi, ecula izingoma ezeseka uRamaphosa.Iningi labasebenzi basezitolo livele lashiya imisebenzi, layodushana nabebefuna ukubona uRamaphosa.URamaphosa uzulazule kancane enxanxatheleni yezitolo, ehamba ebingelela abantu, wabe esekhuluma namalungu e-ANC avele athi mbo ngesikhathi efika.Utshele amalungu e-ANC ukuthi inhlangano yabo izomangaza abaningi okhethweni oluzayo."I-ANC inkunzi ezokhonya lapha. Laba abazitshela ukuthi i-ANC isiyehlile, bazomangala."Bazobona ukuthi yibona asebehlile. Yithi esizonqoba lapha KwaZulu-Natal futhi yithi esizonqoba eNingizimu Afrika yonke," esho.URamaphosa uqale umkhankaso wakhe wayizolo KwaNgcolosi, lapho ebe nomhlangano womphakathi.Kulomhlangano uRamaphosa ubabize ngezimpumputhe labo abathi i-ANC ayizange yenze lutho kuleminyaka engu-30 eyedlule."Bakhona abahamba bethi abayiboni into eyenziwe i-ANC. Sithi kulabantu bayizimpumputhe, ababoni futhi abezwa. Kuleminyaka engu-30 ziningi izinto ezenziwe i-ANC,"kusho uRamaphosa.Uchithe labo abathi ugesi awucishwa ngenxa yokuthi kuza ukhetho.Uthe i-ANC ingalunqoba ukhetho noma ngabe kunenkinga yokucishwa kukagesi."Ukunqoba kwethu ukhetho akuncikile ekutheni ugesi awucishwa. Ukhetho sizoluwina noma ngabe ugesi uyacishwa ngoba abantu bayayithemba i-ANC."Ugesi awucishwa ngoba siyayilungisa inkinga kagesi. Nalapha eThekwini siyayilungisa. Wonke ama-transformer ashile, sifaka amasha," eqhuba.Utshele abantu ukuthi bangavumi ukukhohliswa ngamaqembu amancane enza izethembiso angeke azigcine."Abakaze benze lutho kodwa bahamba bethi, 'nywe nywe nywe', bathi bazodala amathuba emisebenzi. Thina sithi votelani abantu abazi ukwenza umsebenzi," kugcizelela uRamaphosa.Uphothule umkhankaso wakhe wayizolo KwaMashu kanti owaKwaZulu-Natal uwuqale eNanda ngoLwesihlanu.NgoMgqibelo ukhankase KwaXimba, ezindaweni eziseduze nePinetown naKwaDukuza.Namhlanje kulindeleke aqhubeke nomkhankaso wakhe KwaZulu-Natal.Umbango wokuhola lesifundazwe ushisa phansi njengoba kukhona ababona i-ANC izophuma emandleni.

Ayihlomeli impi, kodwa ihlomela ukhetho. Isikhali sethu esinaso manje ukhetho,” esho.Uphinde wasebenzisa inkulumo yakhe ukuxwayisa abaholi beqembu abenza okuthandwa yibo.Selokhu kwasungulwa i-MK, baningi abaholi asebedliwe yizembe. Mumva le nhlangano ikhombe indlela obeyididiyela KwaZulu-Natal uMnuz Nhlanhla Ngidi.UZuma uthe bazovuna abakutshalile abazophambana nomthetho."Abafuna ukuganga eqenjini abakuyeke lokho, abazi ukuthi siyobaphupha ngisho ebusuku silele,” kuxwayisa uMsholozi.

ZININGI izinto eziholela ekutheni abantu bathunjwe ngenhloso yokuthi imindeni yabo ikhokhe imali.Lokhu kushiwo yisikhulu esiphezulu senkampani iMaksure Risk Solutions, uMnuz Knight Mawere ngesikhathi ephawula ngokwenyuka kwezibalo zabantu abathunjwayo kuleli.Ngokwezibalo zakamuva ezikhishwe iStatistics SA, bangu-15 000 abantu abathunjwayo kuleli ngonyaka. Iningi labo kuba ngabesifazane nezingane.UMawere uthe ziningi izizathu ezenza ukuthi abantu bathunjwe, okungaba wukuthi usebenza kweyiphi inkampani, indawo ahlala kuyo, indlela umuzi wakhe owakhiwe ngayo (uma unezinto eziningi zezokuphepha ngokwezigebengu kungasho ukuthi udla izambane likapondo).Okunye kungaba wuhlobo lwemoto ohamba ngayo, isikole okufunda kuso izingane. Lezi zinto uthe zinomthelela wokuthi uthunjwe noma elinye ilungu lomndeni wakho.UMnuz Chad Thomas we-IRS Forenzic Investigations, uthe iNingizimu Afrika ihamba phambili ngezigameko zokuthunjwa e-Afrika yonke.Uthe ngokujwayelekile abathumbi baqale baphenye kabanzi, abavele bathumbe noma ngubani, wathi kodwa sezikhona izimfunda-makhwela ezikopela okwenziwa yilaba abasebenzisa izinga eliphezulu lokuphenya okuhambisana nokuhlela okunobuchule.Uveze ukuthi ziyehluka izizathu zokuthi abantu bathunjwe, kuvame ukuthi kube ngesokuthi bashushumbiswe kwamanye amazwe, esokuthi abathumbi bathole imali, esokuthi babulawe noma abathumbi babenze izigqila zocansi nokunye."Azikho izibalo eziyizo ezisikhombisa ukuthi izizathu zokuthunjwa kusuke kuyini. Ngicabanga ukuthi isizathu sokunyuka kwezibalo zokuthunjwa kuleli yingoba izigebengu ziyabona ukuthi ngakulolu hlangothi izinhlelo zokulwa nalobu bugebengu, aziqinile kahle."Amaphoyisa aqala ukuphenya ngokulahleka komuntu omdala ngemuva kwamahora angu-48. Engingeluleka ngakho abantu ukuthi basebenzise ama-App akumaselula, akhombisa ukuthi ukuphi."Sekuyisikhathi sokuthi iselula ibe wusizo hhayi ithuluzi lokugcina izimfihlo, ukuze uma kwenzeka wehlelwa yilesi sehlo kube lula ukuthi usizakale kusalindwe isikhathi samaphoyisa," kusho uThomas.Ngokombiko we-Stats SA, iGauteng neKwaZulu-Natal ihamba phambili ngamacala okuthunjwa kwabantu abikiwe.EGauteng kubikwe amacala angu-7 818, KwaZulu-Natal angu-3 081 ngonyaka wezimali ka-2022/2023.UNgqongqoshe woMnyango obhekelele abesiFazane, iziNgane nabaKhubazekile uDkt Nkosazana Dlamini-Zuma, uthe abantu besifazane nezingane yibona abavame ukugilwa.Unxuse amaphoyisa ukuthi enze umsebenzi wawo wokuvikela ukuze kwehle lezi zibalo.

UQHUBEKE sesimuncu isimo umshado wesintu KwaNgcolosi, eNdwedwe ngeSonto kulandela ukubulawa kwabane abadutshulwe ezintatha.Abashonile oMnuz Bhekisisa Gcabashe okuthiwa ushonele emtholamphilo, oMnuz Msawenkosi Gcabashe, Moses Saziso Gcabashe noVeli Gcabashe obeyinduna yezinsizwa.Kuthiwa kuphinde kwalimala abanye ababili, okuvela ukuthi baphuthunyiswe esibhedlela ukuyothola usizo lwezempilo.Umshado bekungokaNksz Phumzile Gcabashe waKwaNgoza noMnuz Msizi Shangase waKwaNgcolosi.Ngokusho kwesihlobo, uMnuz Khethonjani Gcabashe, bonke abagilwa abangasohlangothini lwakwamakoti.Elandisa ngesigameko, uthe kungene umuntu wafaka inhlamvu ezinsizweni zangakubo kamakoti ebezilele endlini ebezihlaliswe kuyo kubo komkhwenyana."Zizamile izinsizwa ebezingaphakathi ukumbamba, kwavele kwaqhamuka omunye emnyango, naye wavulela ngenhlamvu kuzona,” kusho uGcabashe.Uqhube wathi alukho nolunci olushiwo ngabahlaseli ngesikhathi bedubula."Bebedubula nje kuphela. Kushone abathathu enkundleni, oyedwa washonela emtholampilo eNdwedwe,” kulandisa uGcabashe, oveze ukuthi uMsawenkosi noSaziso bayizelamani.Uveze ukuthi abahlaselwe bebelale endaweni yesigameko kulandela umshado omhlophe obusehholo lomphakathi endaweni.Uthe yize besadidekile kodwa abakholwa ukuthi impi ibibhekiswe kwabebeshada njengoba kungahlaselwanga bona ngqo, kuhlaselwe abantu abasondelene nabo."Asazi noma yimpi esisuke nayo emuva esigodini esisuka kuso. Sididekile ngoba ayikho impi yezigodi esiyaziyo,” kusho yena.Uthe njengoba isintu sithi umshado awuhlehli, uqhubekile yize bekungasemnandi."Ngikhuluma nawe nje, umakoti uyembesa esibayeni, kodwa sibi isimo, kumuncu kuwo wonke umuntu,” kusho uGcabashe.IMeya yaseNdwedwe uMnuz Sam Mfeka uthe sibaphathe kabi lesi sigameko.Uthe okubakhathazayo ukuthi zibukeka zanda izigameko zalolu hlobo."Kuke kwaba khona isigameko okwabulawa kuso amantombazane amathathu ehlaselwa adutshulwa, nawo ahlaselelwa ekhaya. Sikhona esinye isigameko sababulawa bezihlalele esitolo. Asisihle isimo,” kusho uMfeka.Uthe umphakathi usathukile njengoba bekuqhubeka umshado wesintu esibayeni kwamkhwenyana, abantu babonakala ebusweni ukuthi abahlalisekile kahle."Abaningi bami izixongololo, bafisa sengathi kungasheshiswa okwenziwayo, kuhlakazekwe ngoba bazizwa bengaphephile,” kusho uMfeka.Uveze nokuthi nasemgwaqweni obheke kwamkhwenyana, abantu bahambe bema beyixoxa le ndaba.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa aseNdwedwe asephume umkhankaso athungatha abasolwa ababili abadubule babulala amadoda amane omndeni owodwa izolo."Ulwazi olusezandleni zamaphoyisa okwamanje luthi, bekuhlangene amadoda ngesikhathi kugasela abasolwa, bevulela ngenhlamvu. Abathathu bashonele endaweni yesigameko, amadoda amahlanu aphuthunyiswe emtholampilo wendawo, lapho okufike kwashona khona umgilwa wesine,” kusho uNetshiunda.

UKUHLAKAZWA kwebhodi leNSFAS ebelehlulwa wumsebenzi, akufanele kube yinto eyenzeka yedlule kanjalo nje. Kufanele uhulumeni azibuze imibuzo ngokusebenza kwamabhodi ezinkampani zakhe.UDkt Blade Nzimande, uNgqongqoshe weMfundo ePhakeme, usanda kumemezela ukuthi uhlakaze ibhodi leNSFAS, ekhala ngokuthi lehlulwe wumsebenzi. I-NSFAS ingaphansi kweso lomnyango kaNzimande futhi kulindelekile ukuthi anyakaze uma esola ukuthi akuhambi kahle.Amalungu ebhodi axoshwa nje, obengusihlalo uMnuz Ernest Khosa ubesevele esulile esikhundleni sakhe. Wesula nje, uke waba sematheni ngezinsolo ezinzima. Ngaphambi kwalokho obeyisikhulu esiphezulu uMnuz Andile Nongogo, waxoshwa emuva kokusolwa ngokungahambisi kahle.Kwayena uNzimande lona ohlakaze ibhodi, uke wasoleka ngenkohlakalo kukhalwa ngokuthi kukhona imali abebuye ayiphambukise. UNzimande uyaziphika zonke izinsolo uthi futhi akayi ndawo, ngeke esule esikhundleni ngenxa yomsindo.Izinhlaka ezehlukene zimncomile uNzimande ngalokhu zithi udodile ngoba uzwe isikhalo sezitshudeni ezithwele kanzima ngenxa yeNSFAS. Izinhlangano zezitshudeni azikufihlanga ukuthi liphume nobovu futhi izitshudeni zitshakudulisa okwamathole ebona onina njengoba kuhlakazwe ibhodi leNSFAS.UNzimande uwachithe wonke amalungu ebhodi wase efaka iNSFAS ngaphansi komlawuli, lokhu kuchaza ukuthi isimo sibi impela.Into okufanele icutshungulwe kabanzi wukuthi kudalwa yini ukuthi amabhodi ezinkampani zombuso abenezinkinga? Akuqali ngeNSFAS ukuba nezinkinga kodwa zibhokile izinsolo ngezinkampani zombuso futhi yinto endala.Inkampani yezindiza kuleli iSAA, ibe sematheni isikhathi eside ibhedelwa yizinto, namanje isimo asikabi sihle nakhona kukhalwa ngebhodi. Udaba lwebhodi leSAA lwakhulunywa kakhulu ngesikhathi kuhlezi ikhomishini eyayiphenya ukulawulwa kombuso yidlanzana.INKAMPANI yezitimela iPrasa, ayisali ngaphandle uma kukhulunywa ngamabhodi asolwa ngokungasebenzi kahle Isithombe : DAVID RITCHIE/INDEPENDENT MEDIAIPrasa ingenye yezinkampani kahulumeni eke yaba nezinkinga ezifanayo kukhalwa ngebhodi layo. Nayo iPrasa yavela phambi kwekhomishini lapho yayiphenywa futhi kusolwa ibhodi ngokungahambisi kahle izinto.IDenel ibibhekene nenkinga efanayo nakhona kukhalwa ngamalungu ebhodi, kuthiwa ayebuye angahambisi izinto ngendlela.IPosi libhekene nezinkinga zezimali nakhona bekukhonjwa ibhodi lakhona ngokuthi alizihambisi kahle izinto.I-Eskom ihlaselwe yizinkinga namanje futhi udaba lwebhodi layo lukhulunywe kakhulu nayo le nkampani yakhonjwa kakhulu ngesikhathi kuhleli ikhomishini eyayiphenya ngokulawulwa kombuso yidlanzana.NaseTransnet wutwayi olufanayo nakhona, balwenwaya luvumbuke kanti kunenkombankombane nakhona kukhalwa ngebhodi. Zonke lezi zinkampani zisolwa ngokuba yizizinda zenkohlakalo yamathenda nokuyinto ebuyela kukho ukungasebenzi kahle kwamabhodi.Izinkampani zikahulumeni zihlala zitakulwa ngokunikezwa imali njalo nje uma sezicwile ezikweletwini futhi zingasakwazi ukusebenza kahle. Kwesinye isikhathi kuze kudilizwe nabasebenzi.Aqokwa kanjani amabhodi ezinkampani zombuso ?Izinkampani zombuso zingaphansi kweminyango kahulumeni eyelusa ukusebenza kwazo. Ungqongqoshe unamandla okuqoka, nokudiliza ibhodi futhi lokhu ukudingida nekhabhinethi kube yiyona ephasisayo.Kuyaziwa kodwa ukuthi inhlangano ebusayo ivamile ukuba nezwi ekuqokweni kwabantu ngoba yazivumela yona ukuthi iyawubeka umbono, iphakamise namagama abantu ebathembayo.Ibhodi uma seliqokiwe liba nomsebenzi wokwelusa ukusebenza kwenkampani liqashe isikhulu esiphezulu kube yisona esiphatha ukusebenza kwansuku zonke. Kuvamile ukuthi uma kunezinkinga kube wukuthi indaba inebhodi nesikhulu esiphezulu, abasuke behlulekile.I-DA ithi iyezwa ngesinqumo sokuhlakaza ibhodi kodwa ayigculisekile futhi ibona ukuthi uNzimande kufanele alandele ibhodi naye asule ngoba wehlulwe wumsebenzi.UNGQONGQOSHE weMfundo ePhakeme uDkt uBlade Nzimande ohlakaze ibhodi leNSFAS ekhala ngokuthi lehlulwe wumsebenzi walo Isithombe : SIGCINIWE"Yonke le nyakanyaka idala olukhulu ungabazane ngokuphathwa kwezindaba zokuxhaswa kwezitshudeni ngemali. Ziningi izitshudeni ezisale dengwane zilambile. Bekungakuhle naye uNzimande abalandele bonke asule esikhundleni,’’ kusho iDA.I-ActionSA ikhala esifanayo neDA ithi, akuhambe uNzimande ngoba empeleni nguyena owehlulwa wumsebenzi."Ukwesula kwebhodi akuchazi ukuthi seliphunyilile ekutheni liphendule ngezenzo zalo ngoba udaba lusaphenywa amaphoyisa. Siyanxusa nokuthi uNgqongqoshe uNzimande ahoxe esikhundleni,’’ kusho i-ActionSA.I-SACP ebuye ibe yikhaya likaNzimande, ithe iyasemukela isinqumo sakhe sokuhlakaza ibhodi leNSFAS futhi ikubona njengesinyathelo esimqoka ekusombululeni izinkinga zezitshudeni.Kufanele uhulumeni azinuke amakhwapha ngendlela okuqokwa ngayo amabhodi, nohlobo lwabantu abaqokwayo kanjalo nendlela abasebenza ngayo. Kufanele kubhekwe nokuthi yikuphi okungase kwenziwe ukuthuthukisa ukusebenza kwamabhodi.
INHLANGANO, Abahlali baseMjondolo, imemezele ukuthi ithathe isinqumo sokuthi iliboleke i-EFF ivoti layo njengoba kubhekwe okhethweni ngoMeyi 29.Isimemezelo senziwe uMengameli wale nhlangano yabantu abahlala emijondolo, uMnuz S’bu Zikode, ngeSonto.Ubekade esenkundleni yezemidlalo eNkanini, eMayville, eThekwini, abantu bephume ngothi lwabo embuthanweni wabo waminyaka yonke owaziwa ngokuthi i-UnFreedom Day.AMALUNGU enhlangano, Abahlali baseMjondolo, embuthanweni wabo i-UnFreedom Day eMayville, eThekwini, lapho bethathe isinqumo sokweseka i-EFF okhethweni Isithombe: Facebook"Siyiboleka ivoti i-EFF. Abantu okumele bakwazi ukuthi asiyiyona i-EFF futhi asiyijoyini. Uma kudlula ukhetho sobona ukuthi i-EFF ibeka luphi uhlelo lokuhlangabezana nezimfuno zabahlali,” kusho uZikode.Uthe i-EFF izibophezelile odabeni lokubuyiswa komhlaba, kwezomnotho nakwezithinta izwe iPalestine.Uqhube wathi i-EFF iphinde yazibophezela ekuhlangabezaneni nezimfuno zabahlali ezingu-20.UZikode udalule ukuthi ukuvotela kwabo i-EFF akusho ukuthi sebeyiyona nokuthi bazovumelana nayo kuyo yonke into eyishoyo."Sizoqhubeka nokuthi sibe inhlangano yabantu abahlala emijondolo ezimele yize sizoyeseka ngevoti i-EFF njengoba kubhekwe okhethweni. Umbandela wokubaboleka ivoti ingoba bakwazile ukuphendula kahle bazibophezela,” kusho uZikode.Uthe emhlanganweni wabo bonke abangamalungu abahlali odlule, beyikade ibiziwe namanye amaqembu ezepolitiki lapho abahlali babekade bebeka khona abakufunayo.Uqhube wathi i-EFF ikhombisile ukuvuthwa nokuba nomlando obambekayo."Namhlanje (esho izolo) besikade sizomemezela nje kodwa isinqumo sathathwa kwiGeneral Assemble yaBahlali eyayingo-Ephreli 7. Isinqumo silandela nochungechunge lwemihlangano ebikade iba semiphakathini yabahlali, akusona nje isinqumo esivele sathathwa abaholi,” kusho uZikode.Uveze ukuthi emuva kwaleyo mihlangano abaholi baBahlali babamba imihlangano ngoMashi 22 kuya kuMashi 24, kudingidwa okwakushiwo abantu.Engxoxweni abe nayo neSolezwe maphakathi nesonto eledlule, uZikode uthe sekuyisikhathi sokuthi i-ANC iphunyuzwe ngoba ihlulekile ukubatakula ebubheni abacwile kubona abahlali.Waveza nokuthi Abahlali sebeyayisaba i-ANC esiphathe izintambo zombuso iminyaka engu-30.
BAZIZWA belahliwe abantu abahlala kolindela ababizwa ngokuthi isemathinini eWelbedacht, eChatsworth njengoba bethi babekwa khona ngo-2008, kuthiwa bazohlala izinyanga ezintathu kuphela.Abantu abahlala kule ndawo basuswa emijondolo yakwa-D nakwa-M eMlaza, eyaseSydenham naseClaire Estate ngenxa yezikhukhula.Abanye bathi basuswa ngoba kuthiwa umhlaba abahlala kuwona awukufanele ukuba kwakhiwe izindlu kuwo.Njengoba elakuleli libungaza iminyaka engu-30 yokubusa ngentando yabantu emuva kokhetho lokuqala lwentando yabantu ngo-Ephreli 27, 1994, laba bantu asebehlale kolindela bacela izindlu ezinesithunzi ababethenjiswe zona. Bakhala ngezinyoka namanzi angena kolindela asebehlaliswe kubo iminyaka ewu-15 kuthiwa abalinde izindlu zomxhaso zikahulumeni. Kuhanjwa kule ndlela yezinyawo njengoba kungangeni nemoto kulabo lindela baseWelbedacht Isithombe:Boniswa Mohale UNkk Sizani Patience Ngcuka (49), utshele Isolezwe ukuthi wasuswa emijondolo yakwa-D, eMlaza emuva kwezikhukhula, ezabagugulela izakhiwo zabo."Sasuswa eMlaza iMeya yeTheku kusewu-Obed Mlaba. Saqale saqutshiswa ehholo ngaphambi kokuthi silethwe lapha. Kwathiwa sizolinda izindlu zethu ezizobe sezilungile emuva kwezinyanga ezintathu."Namanje sisalindile selokhu safika, mhlawumbe kusahambe abantu abawu-20 okwathiwa bayohlala ezitezi ezikhona lapha eChatsworth,” kuchaza uNkk Ngcuka.Uthe impilo inzima ngoba ungowesifazane ongenamyeni kodwa osesele nezingane eziyisithupha nabazukulu abasafunda emazingeni aphansi."Sihleli ekamelweni elilodwa sonke, ngaze ngaphoqeleka ukuthi ngilidabule phakathi ukuze umfana abe nesayidi lakhe."Kunzima ngisho ukugeza uma usesikhathini, izindlu nazo ziyanetha, singenelwa yizinyoka namanzi. Sibona sengathi sasizolahlwa lapha ngoba akekho osisizayo,” kusho uNkk Ngcuka.UNkk Nomusa Gumede (49) naye owasuka eMlaza ngo-Okthoba 2008, uthe kunzima kakhulu ngoba bangenelwa yizinyoka nezingulube zehlathi."Simpintshene nezingane zethu nabazukulu kulabo lindela. Akukho nje ukuthi uyakwazi ukugeza kahle. ”Ngisho kwenziwa inkonzo yasekamelweni kamakhelwane uyezwa ube uhleli nezingane endlini yakho. "Siyacela uhulumeni asizwele manje, asiphe izindlu ayesithembise zona,” kusho uNkk Gumede.Uthe kudala babesikelwa utshani, kugencwe nezihlahla kodwa manje sebeyazibhushela njengoba kungekho muntu osondela kubona.UMnuz Sifiso Ngidi (33) naye usho okufanayo nokushiwo womakhelwane bakhe, wathi sekwanele manje, uyacela uhulumeni abanike izindlu ayebathembise zona.Ubalule ukuthi indawo ababekwe kuyo igcwala kakhulu amanzi uma lina, kuze kuvuleke imihosha.UNkk Nomusa Gumede ucele uhulumeni ukuba ababonelele ngezindlu asebezilinde iminyaka ewu-15 emathinini aseWelbedacht Isithombe:Boniswa MohaleUNkk Thembekile Maphumulo (39), onengane ekhubazekile, uthe impilo inzima ngoba ingane yakhe ayikwazi ukuhamba kahle."Sicela uhulumeni asinike izindlu ayesithembise zona ngoba kunzima ngisho ukuhambisa ingane endlini yangasese. "Isindala manje ayifuni ngiyikhumule esidlangalaleni, kodwa ngiyaphoqeleka ukukwenza lokhu ngoba asinayo indlu yangasese endlini."Kufanele ngiyikhumule ngaphambi kokuthi ingene endlini yangasese yamadoda,” kusho uNkk Maphumulo.Ubalule ukuthi akukwazi nokuthi ingane ibe nesihlalo samasondo ngoba indawo imazombezombe ayikulungele ukuhamba ngesihlalo esinamasondo noma kungene imoto. Uyaphoqeleka ukuthi ayibelethe ingane.Bathi izindlu yizona ezingabuyisa isithunzi sabo.
AKUBONA bonke ubugebengu obungaqedwa ngokubopha, obunye kudinga ukuthi kubhekwe umsuka wabo okungaba izifo zengqondo nokunye.Lokhu kushiwo uNgqongqoshe wezamaPhoyisa, uGeneral Bheki Cele, ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabazalwane esontweni, iKwaMashu Christian Church, ngeSonto.Uthe lokhu ukushiso ukuthi umnyango wakhe nyakenye ngoMeyi, usungule umkhankaso owaziwa ngokuthi i-Operation Shanela oqapha ubugebengu obenzeka ngoLwesine ntambama kuya ngoMsombuluko ekuseni."Kusukela ngalesi sikhathi kuboshwe abantu abangu-550 000. Ngikhuluma ngamacala amakhulu afana nokubulala, ukubamba inkunzi kuhlonyiwe, ukudlwengula, ukubamba izimoto zemali," kusho yena.Uthe ngekota eyodwa okungu-Okthoba kuya kuDisemba, izibalo zobugebengu zikhomba ukuthi kudlwengulwe abantu besifazane abangu-4 990. Iningi labo lidlwengulwa ngabantu ababaziyo kubo okukhona nezelamani."Asikwazi ukuthi singathi ukudlwengula udadewenu kungasonjululwa ngejele. Kumele sikubheke nokuthi kunezifo zengqondo ezihlasele abantu bakithi. Iningi lazo ziqale ngesikhathi kuhlasela iCovid-19. Kuningi obekungelona isiko-mpilo yethu okwenzekile. Singabantu abamnyama sazi ukuthi owakithi oshonile kumele simphelezele. Sime eduze kwebhokisi sikhale, sivalelise. Ngesikhathi seCovid-19 bekwenzeka kungavumeleki ukuthi nisondele eduze kwesidumbu somuntu wakini ngoba kwesatshelwa ukusabalala kwegciwane. "Leyo nto idale ukuphazamiseka okukhulu emindenini. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abanye baphelelwe imisebenzi, zonke lezi zinto ziyayiphazamisa ingqondo. Siyafisa ukuthi abelapha izifo zengqondo basondele ngoba uma kungenjalo kusho ukuthi kuzogcwala amajele," kusho uCele.Uqhube wathi ilokishi laKwaMashu liyisidleke sezigebengu."Isidleke saKwaMashu ihostela, empeleni wonke amahostela anobugebengu kodwa elaKwaMashu ledlulele. IKwaZulu-Natal yonke inezigebengu eziningi. Uma kuboshwe izinkabi noma kuyiphi ingxenye yezwe ezinye zazo kuyavela ukuthi zidabuka kulesi sifundazwe,” kubeka uCele.

ULongwe wafika edakiwe ephethe ivolovolo waxabana noZandi wadubula kwalimala uMeyiwa, wazidubula naye uLongwe emlenzeni,’’ kusho uMngomezulu.Uthe kwabe sekuthungwa intimbothi yamanga ukuze kuvikelwe abathile ngokufa kukaMeyiwa." Ubufakazi besibhamu obalethwa yiphoyisa buyingxenye yamanga akhandiwe ukuvikela umuntu othile. Yonke lento ikhandiwe futhi umuntu owabulala uMeyiwa akekho lapha enkantolo,’’ kusho uMngomezulu.Icala liyaqhubeka.

Nathi singakwazi ukukwenza lokhu. Yingakho nokufunda kubalulekile uma uwumelaphi wendabuko,” usho kanje.UMsomi ungowokuzalwa ePort Shepstone, unguthisha eThulubheke Primary School, eMthwalume. Yingakho nje nami kungisebenzela kakhulu kulo msebenzi engiwenzayo,'' echaza.Wenze isibonelo ngokuthi uma ungumelaphi wendabuko kwesinye isikhathi kuba nemithi okumele isikalo singeqi kwesithile, kungenjalo isiguli singafa nokufa.Uthi kulezo zimo kuba lula ukuthi umelaphi wendabuko asebenze ngoba uyile esikoleni.
