NKOSIKHONA CELEUVUMA eyokukhulelisa indodakazi yomkakhe, uMfundisi webandla laseZayoni osesolwe nangokukhulelisa amanye amavolontiya abalelwa eshumini ebandleni lakhe.UMfu Mandla Mahlaba ongumholi weBandla, iNew Jerusalem eliseNtuzuma, uthi kuyiqiniso ukuthi impela uyikhulelisile indodakazi yomkakhe angayizali eneminyaka engu-19.Ube esethi uzimisele kodwa ngokuhlalisa phansi unkosikazi wakhe nendodakazi ngoba 'ubathanda bobabili’.UMahlaba ubephendula iSolezwe Ngempelasonto ngemuva kokuqubuka kwezinsolo zokuthi usebhubhisile ebandleni, wakhulelisa inqwaba yamavolontiya."Vele ngiyikhulelisile indodakazi, lokho angeke ngize ngiwaqambe amanga ngithi angikwazi noma ngithi akwenzekanga. Angizimisele ngokuchazela wena ukuthi kwenzeke kanjani,'' usho kanje.Ugcizelele ngokuthi lolu wudaba lwasesithe okungamele akhulume ngalo esidlangalaleni, bazolubhunga njengomndeni. Ngaphandle kwalokhu, kunemithombo engaphakathi ebandleni ethi lo mfundisi muva nje wenza imigilingwane abangayiqondi.Njalo ngeSonto kuthiwa uvele ahlabe isiklabhu athi asidliwe ngabazalwane. Kuthiwa usuke ethi abasishebe namasi. "Lokho okhuluma ngakho ngisuke ngikwenza ngoba ngizama ukusiza bona. Angeke ngichaze ukuthi ngisuke ngibasiza kanjani,'' echaza.Uphike walala ngomhlane wathi akathwele. "Umuntu othwele akasweli njengami. Phela mina ngizixakekele,'' usho kanje.Mayelana nokuthi kunezinsolo zokuthi ubalekile, akaziwa ukuthi ukuziphi izinkalo, ukuphikile konke lokhu. "Mina ngikhona ngizihlalele lapha kwami, ongifunayo akeze," esho. Ikhansela lakule ndawo uNkk Mafi Zondi uthe bazwile ngezinto okuthiwa zenziwa uMfundisi endaweni. Lithe lizohlangana nabazali ukuze kuzotholakala isixazululo sodaba. Imizabo yokuthola unkosikazi kamfundisi ayiphumelelanga ngoba ucingo lwakhe ubengalluphenduli.
KULINDELEKE ukuthi iNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini, ihlukanise inhloko nesixhanti ikhiphe isinqumo ngombango wophawu lweqembu uMkhonto weSizwe. Icala lombango wophawu belusenkantolo ngoMashi, kwenziwa izethulo sase sigodlwa isinqumo.I-ANC imangalele iMK izigaba ezehlukene iyisola ngokweba igama nophawu lwayo yenza ngalo iqembu ezongenela ngalo ukhetho. Izwe libheke okhethweni lukazwelonke oluzoba ngoMeyi 29, nonyaka nolubhekwe ngabomvu.IMK yiqembu elisha elethulwe nguZuma ngoDisemba, wonyaka odlule. UZuma ememezela leli qembu wathi ngeke esayivotela i-ANC kodwa usehamba noMkhonto weSizwe, azowukhankasela. Kulezi zinsuku uZuma uphansi phezulu ukhankasela iqembu elisha.I-ANC ibifake udaba eNkantolo yezoKhetho ikhononda ngesinqumo se-IEC sokubhalisa iMK njengeqembu elizongenela ukhetho. Ikhale ngaphansi i-ANC, kulelo cala inkantolo yavuna iMK.I-IEC yamemezela ukuthi uZuma ngeke akwazi ukuba sohlwini lwabazoya ePhalamende, ngenxa yokuthi walahlwa yicala lobugebengu, wagwetshwa. I-MK iye enkantolo yafika yalunqoba udaba kodwa abe-IEC, bathe balufaka eNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo.Phezu kwalawo macala kukhona eliseThekwini, lapho i-ANC imangalele iMK ngophawu lwayo nokuyilona okuzophuma isinqumo ngalo ngoMsombuluko.UMkhonto weSizwe kwakuwuphiko lwe-ANC lwezempi olwasungulwa ngoDisemba 1961, ngenholso yokubhekana nohulumeni wobandlululo. Lo mbutho wezempi wahlakazwa ngoDisemba 1993, ngesikhathi izwe selizongena embusweni wentando yeningi.Abe-MK bakhiphe isaziso sokuthi bazobe bephume ngobuningi babo beyothamela isinqumo senkantolo. Abalandeli beMK bavame ukuphuma ngobuningi beyokweseka iqembu labo enkantolo noZuma uba khona.

SEKUQALIWE ukuqondiswa ubugwegwe kwezitshudeni zaseNyuvesi i-Unisa, ezibhekene nezinsolo zokukopela nokubhala into efanayo ngesikhathi sezivivinyo zanyakenye. Le nyuvesi iveze ukuthi iphenya amacala evile ku-1400 okukopela ngesikhathi kubhalwa izivivinyo kusetshenziswa uhlelo lwezobuchwepheshe.USolwazi Ramagoai Magano, iphini lomphathi wale nyuvesi obhekele ukuthuthukiswa kwesikhungo, uveze ukuthi seziqalile izigcawu zokuqondisa ubugwegwe kulabo abakopela.Uthe ezinye zezitshudeni zinikwe izexwayiso ngoba bezenze amacala angatheni ngesikhathi zibhala."Ngalezi zigcawu zobugwegwe sihlose ukuphothula amacala abalelwa ku-1 456 athinta ukukopela."Siqale ngenyanga edlule ngoMashi 25 lanti ngesonto sbheka amacala angu-75,” kusho uMagano esithangamini sabezindaba kuleli sonto.Akuqali ukuthi kubikwe izinsolo zokukopela kwezitshudeni uma kubhalwa izivivinyo kule nyuvesi.Izitshudeni sezike zakhala nge-Invigilator App esetshenziswayo uma kubhalwa izivivinyo. UMagano uthe amacala amaningi athinta izitshudeni ezenza i-Postgraduate. Uphinde weluleka izitshudeni ezihamba isigcawu sobugwegwe ukuthi zibhalise ukuze zingazitholi sezibambezeleka uma uphenyo luzikhipha phambili."Asinazo izinhlelo zokubuyela ohlelweni lwakudala siyinyuvesi lokuthi kubhalwe izivivinyo ezindaweni ezazibhalelwa kuzona. Simile ohlelweni lwezobuchwepheshe esilusebenzisayo,” kusho uMagano. Phambilini umkhandlu wezitshudeni wawukhale ngezinkinga ohlelweni lokubhalwa kwezivivinyo okwakuvezwa yizitshudeni.Umengameli womkhandlu wezitshudeni e-Unisa uMnuz Nkosinathi Mabilane, phambilini wathi kusukela ngesikhathi sobhubhane iCovid-19, inyuvesi yanquma ukuthi kubhalwe ngohlelo lwezobuchwepheshe kusetshenziswa i-App.Wakhala ngokuthi le-App okuthiwa icosha yonke into engumsindo uma ubhala, inazo izinselelo njengoba izitshudeni zazikhala ngokuthi uma kucishwa ugesi nezinye izinto kuba nokubambezeleka ukwenza izinto.UMabilane wathi zingaphezu kuka-5 000 izitshudeni ezabanjwa ukuthi zakopela izivivinyo zangonyaka odlule, ezinye zathanjiselwa isigwebo ngoba zaziqala ukubhala.Uthe kwasala ezinye ezibalelwa ngaphansi kuka-2 000, ezase zibanjwa okwesibili zikopela ezizoshushiswa.Unobhala jikelele womkhandlu wezitshudeni kule nyuvesi uMnuz Aphiwe Dlamini, unxuse isikhungo ukuthi sisheshise isigcawu sobugwegwe ukuze izitshudeni zazi ngekusasa lazo."Sicela ukuthi okungenani lezi zigcawu kushaye uJuni seziphothuliwe ukuze izitshudeni zazi ukuthi kumele zenzenjani. Kukhona izindawo lapho kusadingeka kulungiswe khona izinto enyuvesi,” kusho uDlamini. UMagano uthe asisikhulu isibalo sabakopelile wathi nangesikhathi kusabhalelwa ezindaweni ezahlukene ayebikwa amacala okukopela kanjalo nalabo ababhale into efanayo.
UMHOLI we-EFF, uMnuz Julius Malema, uthi amaqembu aphikisayo kofanele akhohlwe ukuthi ayoke akhiphe i-ANC emandleni uma ehlulwe ukuguqisa le nhlangano ebusayo okhethweni oluzayo.UMalema uthe ukhetho lwangenyanga ezayo luyithuba lokugcina emaqenjini aphikisayo ukukhipha i-ANC emandleni.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi enengxoxo nabezindaba, lapho ebekhuluma khona ngezithinta ukhetho.I-ANC izokuya okhethweni lwangoMeyi 29 kunemibiko eminingi yezinhlangano ezenza ucwaningo ethi izohlulwa okhethweni.UMalema uthe ukhetho oluzayo luzofika ngesikhathi esibi kwi-ANC."I-ANC ayikho esimweni esihle, izinto ziyababhedela. Uma bephunyule kulokhu, angeke siphinde sibabambe. Leli yithuba elihle lokuthi sikhiphe i-ANC emandleni."Ngo-1994 sasizitshela ukuthi senza into elungile ngesikhathi sivotela i-ANC. Lolu khetho lusinikeza ithuba lokulungisa amaphutha ethu, ” kusho uMalema.Uthe ukungenzi kahle kwe-ANC okhethweni kungaholela ekutheni le nhlangano ixoshe uMengameli uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa."Into nje engatakula uRamaphosa ukuthi bathole isibalo samavoti esifanayo nalesi abasithola ngokhetho olwedlule, noma bathole amavoti angcono."Uma bengase bethole amavoti amancane, abantu be-ANC bazofuna ukuthi inhlangano iholwe omunye umuntu."I-ANC ihlose ukuthola amavoti angu-11 million noma ngaphezulu okhethweni oluzayo. Uma beke bathola amavoti angaphansi kuka-11 million, uRamaphosa uzokuba senkingeni."Kwi-ANC bazoqala bazibuze ukuthi kungani kuzofanele aqhubeke nokuba umengameli ekubeni iqembu lingenzi kahle,”eshoUMalema uthe uRamaphosa uzokuba nezinkinga eziningi njengoba ethe nabo basambekele umkhusu.Uthe basafuna ukuthi uRamaphosa aphendule ngokugqekezwa kwepulazi lakhe iPhala phala."Lolu daba lusazoqhubeka nokuba iphela endlebeni kuRamaphosa. "Phela kunecala elavulwa lapha. Silinde nje ukuthi banqabe ukumshushisa, sobe sesizishushisela yena. Angeke siphumule lolu daba lungakaxazululeki,” kuqhuba uMalema.Uqhubeke ngokuthi bavule izandla kuwo wonke amaqembu ezepolitiki afuna ukubambisana nabo emva kokhetho.Ubeke kanje:"Kunamaqembu anemigomo ecishe ifane neyethu, i-ATM, Azapo, MK ne-ANC. Empeleni sake saba nesivumelwano ne-ANC sokuthi sizothatha umhlaba ngaphandle kwesinxephezelo, kodwa babuye bangenwa amanzi emadolweni.”Uphinde wagxeka isinqumo senhlangano eyengamele ukhetho, i-Independent Electoral Commission (IEC), sokuphonsela inselelo isinqumo esivumela owayengumengameli uJacob Zuma sokuthi angenele ukhetho.UMalema uthe i-IEC ikhombisa ukuba nenkinga noZuma."Empeleni lento ye-IEC inikeza uZuma ithuba lokuqhuba umkhankaso wakhe. Ngaphandle kwezinkantolo kugcwala abantu beMK, uZuma afike akhankase,” kuphetha uMalema.
UMENGAMELI we-ANC, uCyril Ramaphosa, uxwayise izakhamizi zaseThekwini ukuba zingavumi ukukhohliswa amaqembu ezepolitiki enza izethembiso angeke azifeze.URamaphosa uthe njengoba kubhekwe okhethweni lwangenyanga ezayo, amaqembu amaningi enza izethembiso angeke azigcine.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi eqhuba umkhankaso wakhe wokhetho, eThekwini.Umkhankaso kaRamaphosa waseThekwini uqale ngoLwesihlanu, eNanda.NgoMgqibelo uRamaphosa uhlanagne nenkosi yakwaMlaba, kwaXimba, wahlangana nabamabandla, waphinde wakhankasa nasezindaweni ezingasePinetwon, kwaMaMdekazi naseMarianhill.Utshele abaholi bamabandla ukuthi amaqembu amaningi akhankasela ukhetho athembisa nezinto angazi ukuthi azozenza kanjani uma enqoba ukhetho."Manje kunamaqembu amaningi ahamba ethembisa abantu ukuthi azobakhela izindlu. Labantu abakaze bakhe ngisho indlu eyodwa. Uma befika kunina benithembisa izindlu, anobabuza ukuthi bake bazakhaphi izindlu.”URamaphosa uthe i-ANC kuphela engakwazi ukufeza izethembiso ezenza ebantwini bakuleli.Uthe lokhu sebekwenze kusukela ngo-1994, ngesikhathi benqoba ukhetho okokuqala.URamaphosa unxuse abantu ukuba baphinde banikeze i-ANC ithuba okhethweni oluzayo."Yebo sibe nawo amaphutha, kodwa sikwazile ukufeza okuningi esasikuthembisile. Asiphumeni sonke ngomhlaka 29 siyovotela i-ANC.”
UMHOLI weRise Mzansi, uMnuz Songezo Zibi, ukhala ngezaguga ezingamalungu ePhalamende ezishaya imithetho ethi abantu abaneminyaka engaphezu kuka-35 abangabekwa phambili uma kunamathuba emisebenzi.UZibi uthe esikhundleni sokuthi kuncishwe abantu abaneminyaka engaphezu kuka-35 amathuba emisebenzi, kufanele engabe kushanelwa zonke izaguga ePhalamende.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi iRise Mzansi KwaZulu-Natal yethula umqulu wezethembiso zokhetho, eThekwini, ngoLwesine.UZibi uthe siphelile isikhathi sezaguga ePhalamende naseziShayamthetho.Uthe iqembu lakhe ligadla ngabantu abasha njengoba kuyiwa okhethweni.Wenze isibonelo ngomele iRise Mzansi embangweni wesikhundla sikaNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Nonkululeko Hlongwane-Mhlongo, oneminyaka engaphansi kwengu-40."Akafani nalaba baholi abadala abanitshela ukuthi senibadala uma nineminyaka engu-35, kodwa bona baneminyaka engaphezu kuka-70, basengamalungu ePhalamende. IKwaZulu-Natal ifanelwe ukuba nomholi osemusha, onamaqhinga okutakula isifundazwe.”UNkk Hlongwane-Mhlongo uthe uma benqoba iKwaZulu-Natal okhethweni abantu abaneminyaka engaphezu kuka-35 angeke bashiywe ngaphandle."Abantu abaneminyaka engu-35 noma kufanele banikezwe amathuba, bakwazi ukuziphilisa. Sizokuqeda ukucwaswa kwabantu abaneminyaka engu-35. Bonke abantu kufanele banikezwe amathuba afanayo, kuqashwe abantu abafanelwe umsebenzi.”UNkk Hlongwane-Mhlongo uthembise ukuthuthukisa amahostela nemijondolo uma benqoba ukhetho.Uthe abantu abahlala kulezi zindawo baphila ngaphansi kwezimo ezingezinhle."Sizosebenzisana nezinhlangano Ubunye bamaHostela, naBahlali baseMjondolo, ukuqeda izinkinga ezikhungethe izindawo eziyimijondolo koCato Manor naseChesterville. Izimo zenhlalo kulezi zindawo azizinhle. Kubhoke ubugebengu, kusocongwa abaholi bemiphakathi."Emahostela izindlu okuhlala kuzo obaba bethu nabafowethu, zihlukaniswe ngamakhethenisi. Uhulumeni utshela abantu ukuthi abazohlala nemindeni yabo ngaphansi kwalezimo lezi. Amahostela kufanele athuthukiswe ukuze abantu bezokwazi ukuhlala nemindeni yabo kuwo.”UNkk Hlongwane-Mhlongo uthe bazobuqeda nya ubugebengu obudlangile kulesi sifundazwe."Sizosusa izigebengu emiphakathini. Lokhu sizokwenza ngokubambisana nezinhlangano ezilwa nobugebengu.”UNkk Hlongwane-Mhlongo uthe bazosebenzisana nezinhlangano ezilwela amalungelo abantu, nezingenzi nzuzo.Uthe bazokwenza ngcono ezemfundo, ezempilo, baphinde babeke phambili abaphila nokukhubazeka.
UFUNA bangabi nokucwasana ezikoleni abafunda kuzo abafundi abaqhamuka emindenini ehlukene uLandi Ndlovu oseqale umkhankaso wokunikela ngomfaniswano wesikole, ezikoleni ezahlukene zaseMkhanyakude.ULandi uthi ukukhulela emakhaya kumenze wabona ukuthi kuningi okumele bakwenze beyintsha eqhamuka khona.Muva nje uhambele izikole ezahlukene okubalwa kuzo nakade ayefunda kuso iJevu Secondary noNgqongqoshe wezaManzi, ukuHlanjwa kwawo nokuHanjiswa kweNdle kuleli, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu.ULandi NdlovuUthe ukwenze lokhu ngokufuna ukubuyisa isithunzi kubafundi bangazenyezi ngezinto abazigqokile uma beya esikoleni."Ukukhulela lapha esifundazweni saseMkhanyakude kusenze sabona okuningi, kodwa manje njengoba nami senginamandla ngibone kungcono ngibuyisele emindenini okubonakalayo ukuthi ayikwazi ukwenza konke."Nginike abafundi okuzobenza bakwazi ukuziqhenya futhi bakukhuthalele ukuya esikoleni,” kusho uLandi.UMchunu uthe akwaziyo wukuthi abafundi baphasa kahle uma yonke into ihamba kahle ezimpilweni zabo.Uthe kuyamjabulisa okwenziwe uLandi njengoba eyintsha, ekhuthaza ukuthi emphakathini kube nabafundi abadinga ukuxhaswa uma kuziwa ezintweni ezibenza babe bahle phambi kwabanye.Ukhuthaze abafundi bakamatric ukuthi bazimisele ukuze nabo bezoshintsha isimo sabo sasemakhaya nesendawo abasuka kuyo.
KUNXENXWE amakhosi ukuba alekelele ngokudayisela osomabhizinisi abanezihlelo zokwakha izinxanxathela zezitolo umhlaba ukuze kulethwe umnotho ezindaweni zomphakathi.Amalungu omphakathi waseHluhluwe nakwaHlabisa asabeke ithemba lawo ezitolo ezisedolobheni kuphela. Lokhu kudalwa ukuthi yizo kuphela ezikhona kule ndawo nokuphoqa ukuthi ahambe ibanga elide uma efuna ukukuthenga.Emcimbini wokuthuthukiswa komphakathi obusezinkundleni yezemidlalo, eCwakeme, KwaHlabisa kwethulwe izinhlelo zakamumva zomkhandlu. Ngazo kuhloswe ukunqanda usizi olukhungethe amalungu omphakathi wakulezi zindawo.Phakathi kwalezo ezibalulwe kulo mcimbi kubalwa ukwakhiwa kwezinxanxathela zezitolo eHluhluwe nakaHlabisa.Ikhansela lendawo uMnuz Jeremiah Msizana obengomunye wabebehambele umcimbi, uthe umphakathi ungakuthokozelela kakhulu ukubona kusondela izinxanxathela zezitolo emakhaya ngoba kungenza isimo sempilo sibe ngcono kakhulu."Njengamanje azikho izindawo ezidayiswayo emakhaya kodwa ezisadayisiwe ngezomkhandlu. Yingakho- ke sicela kakhulu emakhosini ukuthi angenelele ezinhlelweni zokudayiswa komhlaba odingwa osomabhizinisi abanezinhlelo zokuletha intuthuko emakhaya,” kusho uMsizana.Uthe ukudayiswa kwazo kuzolekelela kakhulu ekutheni kuthuthuke umphakathi futhi kuphucuzeke nesimo sempilo emakhaya.Imeya yaseBig 5 Hlabisa, uMnuz Comfort Nkosi, uthe umkhandlu uhlose ukuqoqa uR2 million ngomhlaba ohlele ukuwudayisa."Leyo mali iyosilekelela kakhulu ukubhekana nesikweletu sama- rates esingu R32 million,” kusho uKhumalo.Amalungu omphakathi abefike ngobuningi bawo kulo mcimbi abegqoke izikibha zeqembu le- IFP ebezibukeka zizintsha.Amanye awo abegqoke amajazi abizwa ngezimpulampula ezinobuso bomholi we-IFP ongasekho uMangosuthu Buthelezi.Esangweni lale nkundla yezemidlalo ubukhangwa yitende elincane le-IFP lapho abantu bebebhalisa kulo abanye bethatha nobulungu beqembu.Ilungu lomphakathi uNksz Balungile Ngema waseCwakeme ubonge ukuzisondeza kommkhandlu kubantu. Unxenxe iziphathimandla zezokuphepha ukuthi zilusukumele phezulu udaba lokulahleka kwezingane endaweni."Okuningi kuhlukumeza thina singabesifazane futhi kubuhlungu ngoba namanje enye yezingane ayikatholakali,” kusho uNksz Ngema obekhala ngokunyamalala kwabantu endaweni ngenxa yobugebengu .
UMKHONTO weSizwe (MK) uthi kungenzeka kuqathake abanye abaningi njengoba ulwandle izolo, lukhafule ongumdidiyeli wayo wesikhashana KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Nhlanhla Ngidi. UNgidi udilizwa esikhaleni nje, kuthangi lokhu kade emele i-MK emcimbini we-IEC lapho amaqembu abeyofunga khona ngokuziphatha kahle ngesikhathi sokhetho. Umcimbi ubuseThekwini e-ICC, lapho wonke amaqembu abegqishe khona. Ukhetho oluzoba ngoMeyi 29, nonyakaUMkhonto weSizwe lona ongundabuzekwayo, wethulwa owayengumengameli uMnuz Jacob Zuma ngoDisemba nyakenye, wathi usehamba nawo. UZuma walibeka ngembaba elokuthi akasayingeni eye-ANC. UZuma kumanje uphezulu ohlwini lwabaya ePhalamende emuva kokwehliswa kukaMnuz Jabulani Khumalo owabhalisa iqembu. I-MK isasebenza ngezinhlaka zesikhashana njengoba ingakayihlalisi ingqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi bayo.UNgidi, ophezulu ohlwini lwe-MK lwabaya esiShayamthetho e-KZN, udiliziwe esikhundleni sokuba wumholi wesikhashana esifundazweni. Isolezwe liyibonile incwadi ebhalelwe uNgidi imaziswa ngokuhoxiswa kwakhe ebikhomba uMsombuluko ka-Ephreli 14.Ebuzwa ngalokhu izolo, uNgidi uthe uyitholile impela incwadi kodwa ubesamangele ngokukhishwa kwakhe isigubhukane engazi nokuthi woneni."Ngifana nawe nje nami njengoba ubuza, nami angazi kungaba kuhle nithinte lona iqembu lichaze kahle. Akukho nobekusolisa nje, kunalokho bebehlala bencoma bethi i-KZN iza kahle kakhulu iyasebenza,’’ kusho uNgidi obezwakala engenakutatazela.UNgidi ungomunye wabahlonishwayo kwezokuphatha kuhulumeni njengoba eke waba wumqondisi-Jikelele wesifundazwe i-KZN.Okhulumela uMkhonto weSizwe, uMnuz Nhlamulo Ndhlela, uthe umsebenzi wangaphakathi uyaqhubeka futhi kufanele kulindelwe noma yini."Ibambezelekile incwadi kaNgidi, bekufanele ifike ezinsukwini ezimbili ngaphambi kokuthi kuyofungwa kwi-IEC. Kunezinhlelo eziningi zokulungisa izinhlaka zeqembu futhi kungenzeka noma yini nakulo uhlu lwaseSishayamthetho,’’ kubeka uNdhlela.UNdlela akazange aphume nesizathu esiqondile sokuthi yini le eholele ekutheni kuchithwe uNgidi. Uthe basezinhlelweni zokubheka kabanzi ukusebenza kweqembu babuyekeze nezinye izinqumo zabo ngezikhundla zobuholi. UNgidi udilizwa nje, kade kusanda kuchithwa uMnuz Bonginkosi Khanyile obehola intsha kuzwelonke.UMkhonto weSizwe awufunanga nokuthi kuze kulalwe isikhundla sikaNgidi singenamuntu, wamemezela igama likaMnuz Thobani Zuma ekubeni umgqugquzeli. UZuma ubeyisethenjwa se-ANC eyake yamjuba kwesephini likameya kuMasipala uMsunduzi, eMgungundlovu. Esikhundleni ebesiphethwe uNgidi sokuba umdidiyeli kungene uMnuz Siphiwe Muziwenkosi Mpungose.
UNGQONGQOSHE weMfundo eyisiSekelo uNkk Angie Motshekga, uchithe ukuthi banomgomo wokuvimba abafundi ukuthi bangadluleli kwamanye amabanga, ukuze izikole zithole imiphumela emihle kwa-matric.Sekuke kwakhalwa ngomkhuba wezinye izikole okuthiwa zifeyilisa abafundi ikakhulu kwaGrade 11, ukuthi bangadluleli kwa-matric ukuze zithole imiphumela emihle.UNkk Motshekga ubephendula umbuzo welungu leDA ePhalamende uMnuz Baxolile Nodada. Ubuze ukuthi ngabe umnyango unawo yini umgomo ofuze lona, nokuthi umnyango uwunqanda kanjani lo mkhuba wokungadluliswa kwabafundi abangenzi kahle ukuze izikole zithole imiphumela emihle kwa-matric?Ungqongqoshe useke wakuveza ePhalamende ukuthi kunezikole ezenza lo mkhuba wokubamba abafundi ngoba zifuna ukuthola imiphumela emihle.Okunye okuhlale kukhalwa ngakho wukuthi cishe kubafundi abayisigidi nangaphezulu abasuke beqale uGrade 1, uhhafu wabo obhala u-matric, abanye basuke besale endleleni."Asinawo umgomo siwumnyango wokuthi sibambe abafundi bangayi kwamanye amabanga ukuze izikole zithole imiphumela emihle. Ocwaningweni esinalo oluthinta abafundi abashiya bengaqedanga ukufunda, kuvela ukuthi izibalo zabo ziyehla. Nangesikhathi kuhlasele ubhubhane iCovid-19, sanyuka isibalo sabafundi ababefunda nababhala u-matric kuleli,” kuphendula uNkk Motshekga. Ungqongqoshe uqhube wadalula ukuthi kunezikhala zothisha ezingu-31 462 ezingavaliwe kuleli.Ephendula umbuzo kaNodada uveze ukuthi iKwaZulu-Natal, yisona sifundazwe esinesibalo esiphezulu sezikhala zothisha ezingavaliwe ngoba zingu-7 044, kulandele i-Eastern Cape ngezingu-6 111, ne-Limpopo ngezingu-4 933."Kuyaqhubeka ukuvalwa kwezikhala ezikoleni kanti alikho ikilasi elingenaye uthisha. Uma kuvela isikhala kulandwa ozosivala, abambe size sigcwaliswe,” kuchaza uNkk Motshekga. UDkt Imran Keeka weDA esifundazweni, ukhale ngokuthi baningi othisha ababhuquza emakhaya abangaqashiwe. Uthe empendulweni abayitholile abayibuze esiShayamthetho, bathole ukuthi izikole ezingu-685 azinabo othishanhloko abaqashwe ngokugcwele."Kule mpendulo kuvele nokuthi umnyango ushoda ngamaphini othishanhloko angu-389, izinhloko zezifundo ezingu-1 215, nothisha abangu-909 abangu-post level 1. Ukungagcwaliswa kwalezi zikhala kwenza kungabi nozinzo ezikoleni zesifundazwe,” kukhononda uDkt Keeka.UDkt Keeka ukhale ngokuthi umnyango wenza izaba ngokuthi uhlale ugxeka ukunqanyulwa kwesabelomali, uthi yikhona okwenza ungakwazi ukuvala izikhala.
UPHUME enkantolo edangele, kuhlehliswa icala, owaxoshwa esikhundleni sokuba yikhansela le-ANC osolwa ngokudubula abulale uzakwabo eMayville, eThekwini.UMnuz Mzimuni "Mzi” Ngiba (46) nabanye abasolwa abane aboshwe nabo, ubekade evele eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini, ngoLwesine.Zithe zisuka amadaka, umshushisi u-Advocate Nhlanhla Shange wasukuma efaka isicelo kwiJaji uJacqueline Henriques, ukuba lihlehliswe icala.Ubeke isizathu sokuthi akekho umshushisi omkhulu okunguyena owengamele leli cala. UShange uthe isizathu sokuthi angabi khona enkantolo uzakwabo wukuthi ushonelwe isihlobo sakhe."Uyoze abe khona emsebenzini emuva kwamasonto amabili, ekuqaleni kukaMeyi, ngakho ngicela ukuthi lihlehliswe icala,” kucela uShange.Ijaji likhombise ukunengeka ukuthi icala kudingeka ukuthi lihlehliswe.Libuzile ukuthi uShange ngeke yena akwazi ukubamba izintambo aqhubeke necala?"Angifuni ukuzwakala sengathi anginalo uzwelo ngokwehlele uzakwenu kodwa kusukela ngoMashi kugcina ukuhlala leli cala, beningakazilungiseleli?” kubuza ijaji.Ijaji libe selikhipha isinqumo sokuthi icala lihlehliselwa uJuni 13, nonyaka.Likhiphe nomyalelo othi uMbuso nabamele abamangalelwa kuzomele bahlangane benze izendlalelo zokuqala kokuqulwa kwecala engakashayi uMeyi 17.Abamangalelwa okungoMnuz Nkosinathi Ngcobo, Sandile Mzizi Ngiba, Sifiso Mlondo noPhathesakhe Ngiba, bavele babhocobala, babuyiselwa ezitokisini beqhutshwa yiphoyisa indumalo ibhalwe ebusweni.Abamangalelwa bathweswe amacala amabili okubulala uMnuz Siyabonga Mkhize, owanqoba ukhetho engasekho, nelungu le-ANC uMnuz Mzukisi Nyanga.Babhekene namanye amacala amabili okuzama ukubulala abantu ababili ababesemotweni noMkhize noNyanga ngesikhathi behlaselwa emuva kokukhankasa eCato Crest, eMayville, ngo-Okthoba 2021.Kwelinye icala, iJaji uHendriques libeke izinsuku okuzoqulwa ngazo icala lokubulawa kowayefundisa eMangosuthu University of Technology (MUT).Icala kulindeleke ukuthi liqale ukulalelwa ngo-Okthoba 7 kuze kube uNovemba 1, nonyaka, eNkantolo eNkulu yaseScottburgh.Abamangalelwa okungoMnuz Siyabonga Freeman Mahaye (35), Thobani Mhlongo (23), Kwanele Makhaye (29) noSihle Mkhize (23) bathweswe icala lokuthumba, elokuphanga kusetshenziswa udlame nelokubulala okuhleliwe uMnuz Chanlall Dwarika ngoMeyi, 2023.Yagcwala izinkundla zokuxhumana i-video eyayikhombisa abamangalelwa beshaya umufi base bemfaka ngenkani emotweni yakhe iHonda SUV, bahamba naye. UDwarika watholakala eseshonile eNanda.
USOLA ukuthi isikhumba esilumayo esibukeka njengesenyoka yisona esimfakela isigcwagcwa kubaqashi owesifazane waseMtubatubaUNksz Mbali Msweli (31) othi wazalwa enesikhumba esomile, esilumayo bese siyebuza bese sidala izikwele emzimbeni sibukeke njengesenyoka, yisona esidala ukuthi angaqashwa emizini yabantu.Uthi abantu abaningi bacabanga ukuthi lesi sifo siyathathelana."Sengizame kaningi ukuthola umsebenzi, kwezinye izikhathi ngiwuthole owokusebenza endlini kodwa uma sengifika umqashi athi useshintshe umqondo."Umane athi uzobuye angibize, angabe esangibiza. Muva nje ngike ngathola ithuba lokwenza uqeqesho-msebenzi obeluzokwenza ukuthi mina nabanye ebesinabo siqashwe sibe ngonogada."Abanye babiziwe mina angibizwanga, kulokhu kuthiwa asikaveli isikhala. Yize engekho oshilo ukuthi inkinga yisikhumba sami kodwa ngiyabona ukuthi yisona ngoba abantu besaba nokusondela eduze kwami," kusho yena.Uthe esikoleni nakhona wayefunda kanzima izingane zimcwasa. Kunesikhathi lapho aze wasizwa uMnuz Lawrence Mthombeni owake waba imeya yaseMkhanyakude owayenebala elimhlophe. Wakhuluma nezingane ngesimo sesikhumba sakhe ezitshela nokuthi asithelelani.UNKSZ Mbali Msweli onesikhumba esomile esibukeka njengesonyoka osehlala ngokugquma ezama ukususa ukwebuza kwesikhumba sakhe Isithombe: SITHUYELWE "Ubaba uMthombeni wangisiza, ezinye izingane zangemukela kodwa akuzange kuphele ukuthi ziyangesaba."Abantu basemphakathini nabo banakho ukungibuka ngendlela ehlukile, yize ngikhulele kubo," kuchaza uNksz Msweli.Mayelana nokwelashwa uthe wagcina esekhathele ukuya emtholampilo ngoba ubenikwa i-Aqueous Cream abebona ingamsizi.Ngo-2018 uthe wadluliselwa esibhedlela iNgwelezane waya eKing Edward, watshelwa khona ukuthi isifo anaso aselapheki. Wanikwa into yokugcoba engamphathanga kahle nayo i-Aqueous Cream. Udokotela wakhe wamyekisa yona wamnika i-Aqueous kuphela, waze waziyekela ukuyilanda ngoba ebona ingamsizi.UDokotela wesikhumba uDkt Mamello Ntsele osebenza ezibhedlela iKing Edward naseCrompton, uthe nakuba engasihlolanga lesi siguli kodwa kubukeka sengathi sineLamellar Ichthyosis, okuyisifo esiwufuzo esidala ukuthi isikhumba some ngokwedlulele." Lesi sifo asilapheki ngoba siwufuzo kodwa ikhona imithi engamaphilisi yokusilawula enikezwa iziguli ezinisaso okumele ziyisebenzise impilo yazo yonke."Iziguli eziningi zibuye zikhathale ngoba zisuke zifuna into ezozelapha."Ngingeluleka ngokuthi lesi siguli sibuyele esibhedlela ukuze sithole usizo njengoba kusebusika nje isikhumba soma kakhulu, siyebuza nakho okubuhlungu. Le mithi engiyishoyo isiza kuleso simo," kusho uDkt Ntsele.
BAFUNA ukuthi kungenelele uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa kwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, noNgqongoshe wamaphoyisa, uMnuz Bheki Cele, odabeni lwephoyisa elikhala ngokuhlukunyezwa, baphinde bazama ukulidlwengula.Owesifazane (47), ongusayitsheni futhi ongathandanga kudalulwe igama lakhe ngoba ezibona engaphephile, wehlelwa yilo mshopi ngesikhathi esebenza echwebeni laseThekwini ngo-2022.Umthombo weSolezwe ongathandanga ukudalulwa uveze ukuthi leli phoyisa lalingena ekuseni ngalelo langa ngesikhathi umsolwa, ongumabhalane ophikweni lwabaseshi osebenzela eMaritime House, efika edle amponjwana."Wayephuzile, kwakhona ofonela uzakwabo kasayitsheni ukuthi akazomthatha ayofihlwa lapho kusebenzela khona umgilwa ukuze abaphathi bakhe (umsolwa) bengamboni, wayiswa eV.I.S echwebeni laseThekwini,” kusho umthombo.Ulandise wathi yilapho lo mlisa aqala khona ukuhlukumeza lo wesifazane, embamba futhi emshaya."Waqala wamshayisa odongeni ngesiphundu wawa phansi kwacima izibani, nalapho aqhubeka wamkhumula ijezi, wamehlisa ibhande kanye nebhulukwe. Lo wesifazane waphaphama sekukhona amaphoyisa kanye nabaqaphi abathathu kodwa abangazange bamsize ngalutho.” Uqhube wathi lo wesifazane walubika udaba kubaphathi bakhe kodwa bamshaya indiva."Bamtshela ukuthi akaluyeke udaba ngoba uxolisile umlisa. Lo wesifazane uze washintsha indawo yokusebenzela, wayosebenzela eBayhead nokuyilapho abaphathi abambona khona ukuthi unengcindezi base bambuza ukuthi kwenzekani wabe esechaza kubo, wavula icala ngoNovemba 2022. Selokhu kwenzeka lesi sigameko umgilwa uphila ngamaphilisi okhwantalala ngenxa yokuhlukumezeka."Udaba walubika nasenyunyaneni yamaphoyisa, iSouth African Police Union (Sapu), kodwa nakhona bamxosha bemtshela ukuthi kufanele engabe ushadile usemzini wakhe, engalokhu ezobika izinto ezingamanyala."Njengoba icala alifaka ngoNovemba wango-2022, uze wabizwa ngoNovemba 27, 2023 ezothula ubufakazi. Ekuthuleni kwakhe ubufakazi wezwa sekuthiwa icala liphelile, umlisa lo uliwinile. Okumangazayo ukuthi akaze abizwe ngesikhathi icala liqulwa futhi ayikho nento ebhalwe phansi eshoyo ukuthi icala selicishiwe,” kubeka lo mthombo.NgoJanuwari 2, 2024 abaphathi bacela ukuthi lo wesifazane afike nomndeni wakhe ukuze kuzoxoxwa ngalolu daba, naye umlisa axolise emndenini. Usufikile umndeni watshelwa ukuthi lo wesilisa uzoxolisa ngembuzi noma ngenkomo, baxakeka ukuthi lo mlisa lesi senzo usenziswa yini ngoba icala uliwinile.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe icala lavulwa kodwa laphinde lachithwa enkantolo."Amaphoyisa asePhoyinti alivula icala lokuzama ukunukubeza owesifazane ngokocansi kulandela ukuthi owesilisa ezame ukudlwengula owesifazane oneminyaka engu-47 kuJonhson Lane ngoMashi 1, 2022. Icala layiswa kumshushisi omkhulu, lafika lachithwa enkantolo,” kusho u-Netshiunda.UNobhala weSapu esifundazweni, uNksz Astrid Easthorpe, uthe akakwazi ukuphawula kabanzi ngalolu daba."Ngiyazi ngalo icala kodwa angivumelekile ukuthi ngiphawule ngalo. Usayitsheni wafika kimi washo ukuthi akaphathekile kahle ukuthi icala lisuliwe ngase ngicela ukuthi angilethele umbiko waso isigameko. Kodwa ulwazi oluningi anginalo ngoba anginayo ngisho nenombolo yalo icala ukuze silulandelele,” kusho u-Easthorpe.

NgoLwesibili, bathe asihambe siyotshela uNxesi ukuthi amakhompyutha a-offline ngoba yinkinga yawo wonke amahhovisi lena,” kusho omunye obeyofaka isicelo se-UIF.Abanye bathe ukube banemali ngabe baya kwamanye amahhovisi oMnyango wezabaSebenzi ngoba elasePinetown linabantu abangathandi ukulekelela abasebenzi."Siyacela uNxesi angenelele ngoba umphathi wehhovisi uvele athi amakhompyutha a-offline abe esesifulathela. Asazi ukuthi amakhompyutha asengaba offline amasonto amabili?” kubuza omunye.UKhumalo uthe akusilo iqiniso ukuthi wonke amakhompyutha abo a-offline."Uma sithole ukuthi amakhompyutha a-offline siye sithumele ithimba lethu lobuchwepheshe ukuthi liyilungise leyo nkinga. Ebuya, uhlangane nomgilwa ebuyela esitolo lapho ebephuza khona, njengoba naye kuthiwa ubeziphuzela kwenye indawo, wamfukula wehlela naye ngasemfuleni okuyilapho afike wamgwaza khona wazama nokumnquma, isidumbu sakhe wasiphonsa emfuleni,” kulandisa ikhansela.Lithe bekungakabikho okusolisayo ngokunyamalala komgilwa kwaze kwaba isidumbu sakhe sitholwa abafana, kwaqala kwasoleka ukuthi kungenzeka ukuthi uyazi ngokunyamalala kwakhe.UKhoza uthe ngokuqonda ububi besigameko, usukumele phezulu ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umsolwa uyamhambisa yena mathupha, kanti uveze ukuthi izigameko zobugebengu ziyinto esiqala ukwanda kule ndawo.Imizamo yokuthola umndeni kamgilwa ayiphumelelanga njengoba kuvele ukuthi uhlala nesalukazi esinguninakhulu kanti abakubo bakwenye indawo.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uConstable Thenjiswa Ngcobo, uthe kuboshwe owesilisa oneminyaka engu-22 ngecala lokubulala, kanti uvele enkantolo ngoLwesithathu.

INHLANGANO, Abahlali baseMjondolo, ikhulekela ukuthi i-ANC ikhishwe ngevoti okhethweni lwangoMeyi 29, yengeza ngokuthi "umbuso uyadakana.”Lokhu kuvezwe nguMnuz S’bu Zikode, ongumengameli wale nhlangano, engxoxweni abe nayo neSolezwe izolo.UZikode uthe sesiside isikhathi abantu behlupheka ngakho uyafisa ukuba kunikezwe abanye ithuba lokuphatha izwe."Lenele ithuba elinikezwe i-ANC, idinga ukuphunyuzwa ngenkulu inhlonipho. Ayikabi bikho inkululeko,” kusho uZikode.

INKANTOLO yeMantshi yaseMlaza ilihlehlisele inyanga ezayo icala labasolwa ababili kwelokubulawa kobehamba ngesihlalo esinamasongo waseMlaza, ohlaselwe wadutshulwa ekubo ngenyanga edlule.UMnuz Siyabonga Ngubane (36) noMnuz Sithembiso Khomo (23), abebevele enkantolo izolo, baboshwe ngenyanga edlule ngosuku okudutshulwe ngalo uSimanga 'Katsande’ Khumalo (29) okuthiwa ubesehamba ngesihlalo sabakhubazekile emva kokudutshulwa ngo-2021.Abasolwa bangene enkantolo befaswe ngozankosi kanti bekulindeleke ukuthi kulalelwe isicelo sabo sebheyili njengoba bese bevela okwesithathu ngaleli cala. UMMANGALELWA wokuqala ecaleni lokufa kukaSenzo Meyiwa, uMuzikawukhulelwa Sibiya, uthi amaphoyisa awamtholanga neselula ngesikhathi eboshwa.USibiya ubechitha ubufakazi bukangoti wamaselula, uLieutenant Colonel Gideon Gouws othi, wahlola amaselula abamangalelwa wathola ukuthi babexhumana. UMeyiwa wadutshulwa wabulawa ekubo kwentombi yakhe uKelly Khumalo eVosloorus, eGauteng, ngo-2014.Bahlanu abalisa abashushiswayo, uMbuso uthi yibona abathengwa base bemphumela inqina uMeyiwa bamkakisa okwenyamazane bamjuqa. Bonke abamangalelwa bayawaphika onke amacala abethweswe wona.UGouws uthe wathatha umsebenzi emuva kokuthi uLieutenant Colonel Lambertus Steyn ethathe umhlalaphansi. UGouws uthe watshelwa ukuthi uSibiya watholwa neselula ngesikhathi eboshwa nokuyiyona eyahlolwa ukuthi inabo yini ubufakazi obuhlobene necala.UFAKAZI woMbuso ecaleni lokubulawa kukaSenzo Meyiwa uthi abamangalelwa babexhumana ngamaselula bonke Isithombe: THOBILE MATHONSI/INDEPENDENT MEDIAUmmeli kaSibiya, u-Advocate Thulani Mngomezulu, uthe ayikho iselula eyatholwa ekhasimendeni lakhe. Awunabo nobufakazi bemiyalezo noma uWhatsApp, abukho ubufakazi obukhomba ukuthi waxhumana nommangalelwa wesibili,’’ kusho uMngomezulu.UGouws ubelokhu emile ekutheni imininingwane yokuboshwa kukaSibiya iveza ukuthi iphoyisa elambopha lamthola neselula eyathathwa ukuze ihlolwe.UGouws uphinde wagadla kuKelly, wathi ubufakazi bukhomba ukuthi waxhumana nommangalelwa wesihlanu uFisokuhle Ntuli. Udaba lokuxhumana kukaKelly noNtuli luke lwavela phambilini, kwashaqeka abaningi.UGouws uthe naye uthole ukuthi uNtuli waxhumana noKelly ngocingo ngo-Agasti 2, 2014, baxoxa cishe imizuzu emibili, kuyoshaya u-11 ebusuku. Uthe baphinda baxhumana futhi ngo-Okthoba, baxoxa ngocingo.Ngesikhathi kwethulwa ubufakazi, abamangalewa bebelokhu bexoxa sakuhleba babuye bahleke abanye banikine amakhanda. Bebebuye babonakale bethe njo kufakazi obekhuluma, sabantu abafuna ukuzwa kahle.UMbuso uthe kusazoza ufakazi osuka enkampanini ehlinzeka ngosizo lwamaselula ezolandisa inkantolo ngalokhu okuqukuthwe amaselula abamangalelwa.Kulindeleke ukuthi icala libuyele enkantolo namuhla abameli baqhubeke nokuphosa imibuzo ufakazi.
UFUNA livalwe isonto eliyalela abantu ukuba bayeke imishanguzo yezifo ezehlukene, umndeni waseSikhaleni, oshonelwe ngumama wekhaya obejoyine leli sonto. Umama oshonile kuthiwa wayeka imishanguzo ngemuva kwesiphrofetho esaqhamuka ebandleni sokuthi bayeke konke, baphile "ngeZwi”.Oshonelwe yinkosikazi eyeke imishanguzo yayo ye-HIV ne-TB emuva kokusonta kuleli bandla, elibizwa nge-House of Redemption, utshele Isolezwe ukuthi umkakhe, uqale ukuvakashela isonto elisha endaweni ngonyaka odlule. Uthe leli sonto likomunye umuzi khona eSikhaleni.Oshonelwe naye unguMfundisi ebandleni labasindisiwe. Uthe nalo leli elajoyinwa wumkakhe ngelabasindisiwe kodwa izimfundiso zalo zehlukile."Inkosikazi yami iqale iwumuntu ovakashayo kuleli sonto. Ibuye ihambe ithi bayokhuleka ebusuku kodwa kuthe ngokuhamba kwesikhathi yangitshela ukuthi yona isiyashiya kwelethu isiyokhonza kwelisha. Nalapho angizange ngibe nenkinga ngoba umuntu unelungelo lokukhonza lapho ethanda khona. Inkinga iqale lapho sengimbona ephela emzimbeni. Uma ngibuza ukuthi kwenzenjani angezi nempendulo eqondile,” kulandisa owesilisa.Uthe ngoNovemba nyakenye unkosikazi wakhe ubesephele kakhulu emzimbeni futhi wabona nokuthi akasayidli imishanguzo ye-HIV ne-TB ayinikezwa emtholampilo."Ngithe uma ngimbuza ukuthi kungani angayidli imishanguzo wathi esontweni lakhe kuphume isiphrofetho esithe sebezophila ngezwi, abalahle imishanguzo. Ngithe noma ngimtshela ukuthi ayikho into enjalo, wangangilalela. Ubeqhubeka eya khona esontweni,” kusho umfelwa.Uthe ngoJanuwari nonyaka uyile kuleli sonto eyobuza abaphathi balo ngendaba yesiphrofetho. Uveze ukuthi bavuma ukuthi sivelile bathi futhi simile nje kanjalo, abantu abayeke imishanguzo."Umkami uqhubekile nokusonta esakwazi ukuzihambela kanti noma esegula kakhulu ebewumuntu ongafuni ukuya emtholampilo futhi befika nabakuleli sonto lakhe bamthathe uma ngingekho. NgoMashi bamthatha esele nezingane. Ngathi uma ngibuya ngacela omunye umfowethu ukuba angiphelezele ngiyomlanda ngoba ngangimshiye esegula kakhulu. Saze sabiza amaphoyisa ukuthi asivulele ngoba babengavuli ngesikhathi kuseyithina sobabili,” kusho owesilisa.Uthe kwathi uma ecela abasesontweni ukuba bamthathe ngemoto yabo bambuyisele ekhaya ngoba yena wayehamba ngemoto yomuntu, banqaba.Uveze ukuthi amaphoyisa athi akukho angakwenza ngoba umkakhe uziyele ngokuthanda kwakhe kuleli sonto, akaphoqwanga."Umkami ugcine ebuyile ekhaya ngase ngimyisa emtholampilo. Wafika wadluliselwa esibhedlela ngoba amanesi ebona ukuthi usegula kakhulu. Ushone ngoMashi 13. Ngiphatheke kabi ngokuthi umkami ugcine eshonile ngenxa yokulalela isiphrofetho sebanald elathi akayeke imishanguzo esiza ngokuthi siphile. Ngiyafisa abezempilo nabomthetho balithathele izinyathelo leli sonto ngoba basekhona abaya kulo,” usho kanje.Ikhansela lendawo, uMnuz Vincent Sbu Dludla, lithe labikelwa ngokushona kowesifazane kodwa belingazi ukuthi ubesonta esontweni elithi abantu abayeke imishanguzo."Ngiyabanxusa abantu ukuthi bangayiyeki imishanguzo ngoba ngabe ayikhishwa emtholampilo ukube ayisizi. Ngiyacela bayidle ngendlela imishanguzo abayinikwa emtholampilo. Amasonto ayekisa abantu imishanguzo akufanele abe semphakathini,” kusho uDludla.UMbhishobhi Bhekimpi Mchunu, onguSihlalo weKwaZulu-Natal Church Leaders Council, uthe abahambisani nokuthi abantu balahle imishanguzo yabo ngoba yenzelwe ukubasiza ezifweni abanazo.Uthe yize bekholwa ukuthi uNkulunkulu uyakwazi ukunqoba zonke izifo kodwa alikho isonto elinelungelo lokukhipha umyalelo wokuthi abantu mabalahle imishanguzo."Amasonto kufanele athandazele abantu ukuze baphile. Akufanele kube yiwona abalahlisa amaphilisi abasiza ukuze baphile. Uma kwenzeke isimangaliso kufanele umuntu abonakale ephila, hhayi ukuthi kuthiwe akalahle amaphilisi,” kusho uMchunu.Umnikazi weHouse of Redemption, ochazwe njengoNkk Nkomo, utshele Isolezwe ukuthi yize beshumayela ukuthi abantu abaphile ngezwi likaNkulunkulu kodwa abakaze bathi akulahlwe amaphilisi. Uthe kuba wumuntu ozithathela isinqumo sokuthembela kuNkulunkulu angabe esawaphuza amaphilisi, hhayi ukuthi isonto elisuke lithe akawayeke.Ushaye ngezimfushane, wabe esecela ukufonelwa kusasa ukuze akhulume nabaphethe ibandla.Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Ntokozo Maphisa uthe: "Izinsolo esizizwayo siwuMnyango ziyashaqisa futhi ziyichilo. Umthethosisekelo wezwe wango-1996, uChapter 2 ukhuluma ngamalungelo abantu angu-27, abizwa ngokuthi yi'’Bill of Rights”. Omunye wale mithetho ukubeka kucace ukuthi bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika banelungelo lokuthola usizo lwezempilo. Abantu siyabanxusa ukuba bangazilaleli izinkoleloze ezidusa isizwe mayelana nokudliwa kwemishanguzo yokuthithibalisa isandulela ngculazi nengculazi uqobo, ngoba ihloliwe, futhi ukusebenza kwayo kuhle kufakazelwa yisayensi."Ukudliwa kwale mishanguzo ngendlela efanele - ngaphandle kokuphutha - kubalulekile ngoba kuqinisa amasosha omzimba, futhi kukwazi ukwenza igciwane ligcine lingasatholakali egazini. Siyacela nakubantu abadla imishanguzo yesandulela ngculazi kanye nengculazi uqobo ukuthi bakuqonde ukuthi impilo yabo incike kubo uqobo. Bangakuvumeli ukudukiswa ngabanye abantu ngezinqumo ezingabeka impilo yabo engcupheni."
KUBE yinjabulo yodwa kubadobi bezinhlanzi baseHluhluwe abahlomule ngezinsiza ngemuva kwesikhathi eside bekhala ngokushiwa ngaphandle emathubeni omnotho.Laba badobi abasebenzisa ichweba iSodwana Bay bahlomule ngezinsiza zokudoba ngaphansi kohlelo lwentuthuko edidiyelwe umasipala iBig Five Hlabisa.UMnuz Elliot Mthethwa ongomunye wabadobi uthe kuyabathokozisa ukutakulwa wumkhandlu iBig 5 Hlabisa onohlelo lokusiza osomabhizinisi abasebancane."Sekunesikhathi eside sishiywa ngaphandle ezinhlelweni zokuthuthukiswa komnotho endaweni. Ngakho- ke kuyasijabulisa ukuthi abaholi basikhumbule nathi ezinhlelweni ezifana nalezi,” kusho uMthethwa.Banikizwe izinsiza zokudoba izinhlanzi, baphinde bathenjiswa namathuba okuthi bakwazi ukudayisela izitolo zaseHluhluwe nezakwaHlabisa izinhlanzi abazidobile. Lokhu kwenziwa ngenhloso yokukwandisa amathuba omsebenzi nokugqugquzela osomabhizinisi abasebancane.Imeya yaseBig 5 Hlabisa, uMnuz Comfort Khumalo, ithe isifiso somkhandlu ukuthi kukhuliswe amabhizinisi agxile emkhakheni wokuhweba ngezinhlanzi ngenhloso yokuthuthukisa osomabhizinisi abasafufusa ukuze bakwazi ukuxosha ikati eziko.Ikhansela, uMnuz Sibusiso Simelane uthe kuyajabulisa ukuthi izikhalo zomphakathi wakule ndawo seziphendulekile njengoba bekuyisifiso sabo ukuthola usizo."Okuphinde kwasijabulisa ukuvulwa kwehholo lomphakathi. Lokho kusho ukuthi kuphelile ukubamba imihlangano ngaphansi kwezihlahla nokuyinto ebathwesa ubunzima uma isimo sezulu sisibi,” kusho uSimelane.
ABEZEMVELO KZN Wildlife sebeqale umkhankaso wokunquma izimpondo zobhejane ukubavikela kwizigebengu ezibabulalela zona.Obhejane abanqunywe izimpondo ngabaseHluhluwe iMfolozi Park (HiP) njengoba kubulawa abaningi kulesi siqiwi.Ngonyaka odlule kubulawe obhejane abawu-325 KwaZulu-Natal, abawu-307 babulawe eHiP.Obhejane bayabulawa bese kusikwa izimpondo zabo njengoba kunenkolelo emazweni aseMpumalanga ukuthi uma zigayiwe zisetshenziselwa ukwelapha umdlavuza nokwenza amadoda abukeke kahle.Isikhulu esiphezulu sezeMvelo KZN Wildlife uMnuz Sihle Mkhize uthe basebenzisana neWorld Wildlife Fund (WWF) ukunquma izimpondo zobhejane."Kubuhlungu ukuthi obhejane sibanqume izimpondo zabo kodwa lokhu sikwenzela ukuthi baphephe ekubulaweni izigebengu,” kusho uMkhize.Uthe ukunquma izimpondo zobhejane kudla imali ngoba zisuke sezidinga ukunqunywa futhi emuva kwezinyanga eziwu-18 kuya kweziwu-24.Izindleko bazokwazi ukubhekana nazo ngosizo lwe-WWF.Isikhulu se-WWF eNingizimu Afrika, uMnuz Morne du Plessis sithe akulula ukuthatha isinqumo sokusika uphondo lukabhejane kodwa yinto eyenziwa uma sekunzima kakhulu."IKwaZulu-Natal yabamba iqhaza elibalulekile ekuhlengweni kobhejane ngesikhathi sebezoshabalala emhlabeni jikelele."Namanje yenza ngazo zonke izindlela ukubavikela. Isinqumo sokusika izimpondo sithathwe ukubavikela obhejane yize kungeyona into esithanda ukuyenza,” kusho uDu Plessis.
KUSHODE ozogadla kuqala enkantolo emuva kokuklolodelana ngamazwi phakathi kwamalungu omndeni wesosha elisolwa ngokubulala nabomndeni kamufi.Isosha loMbutho wezeMpi eNingizimu Afrika uMnuz Lwanda Zungu, licele ibheyili eNkantolo yeMantshi yasePinetown.Njengenjwayelo ulandwe ezitokisini wangena enkantolo wahlala phansi ebhokisini labasolwa.Kube sekungena abantu abazothamela icala. Kubona bekuhamba phambili udadewabo kaZungu, uNksz Lwanele Zungu nabomndeni wakhe.Kube sekungena abomndeni kamufi, uNkk Tania Msane-Zungu.Omunye wabakubo kamufi bekuthi akamudle amqede uNksz Zungu, wabanjwa abebehamba naye wamkhumbuza ukuthi kusenkantolo lapha angazithola esejeziswa kanzima.Yomibili lemindeni eganiselene ibe isihlala ngokwehlukana emabhentshini enkantolo kubonakala ukuthi ithibelene.Ummeli kaZungu, u-Advocate Muzi Mzelemu ubize uNksz Zungu ezokwethula ubufakazi.UZungu uvele wagebisa ikhanda wase echiphiza izinyembezi ngesikhathi ezwa ukuthi idonsa kanzima indodakazi yakhe kusukela aboshwa ngoJanuwari.UNksz Zungu uthe uyapatanisa ukuze ilale idlile futhi ikwazi ukuya esikoleni indodakazi yesosha eneminyaka engu-13.UZungu ugqunywe ejele laseWestville lapho etoke khona ngezinsolo zokuthi wadubula amahlandla ayisithupha wabulala inkosikazi yakhe, abanezingane ezimbili nayo, uNkk Tania Msani-Zungu."U…(edalula igama lengane) akayijwayele impilo ayiphilayo manje yokuthi amukele ukuthi into ethile ayifunayo ngeke akwazi ukuyithola."Unokuzivalela yedwa endlini athi ukhumbule uyise. Ufeyilile nasesikoleni nge-term yokuqala nonyaka."Kunzima ngoba nonina wayo (ingane) engasekho emhlabeni. ULwanda ubemthanda futhi embiza ngontombikayise u(ebiza igama lengane),” kusho uNksz Zungu.Lowesifazane utshele iMantshi yeNkantolo yasePinetown, uGwendolyn Robinson ukuthi unezingane zakhe ezintathu azikhulisayo ngoR4 420 awuhola lapho esebenza khona nawo ongenele ukwenza zonke izidingo zomndeni.Uqhube wathi ubuye ahlephule emalini yesondlo sikahulumeni sabantwana bakhe ukuze enze izidingo zengane yesosha athe izindleko zayo zilinganiselwa ngaphezu kukaR3 000 ngenyanga.Ingane obekukhulunywa ngayo ekaZungu ayithola entombini, engazalwa wuNkk Msane-Zungu abanezingane ezimbili zabafana naye.Lezo izingane zabafana kuthiwa zathathwa abaKwaMsane emuva kwesigameko."Ingane yashonelwa unina wayo ngo-Ephreli ngonyaka odlule. Emuva kwalokho ihlale noLwanda noTania emzini wabo. Selokhu kwenzeka isigameko isihlala nami,” kusho uNksz Zungu.Uveze ukuthi lentombazane yesosha iqale yafeyila uGrade 7 ngoDisemba, kumanje ihamba udokotela oyeluleka ngengqondo futhi idinga imishanguzo yokuthithibalisa i-sinus ewufuzo kulomndeni.Lo wesifazane uchaze ubhuti wakhe njengomuntu onenhliziyo enhle, obewusizo kubo bonke futhi ewunakekela umndeni wakhe.Uthe bangamemukela ngaphandle kokumbeka amabala emndenini uma ngabe inkantolo imnikeza ibheyili.Umshushisi u-Ehud-Jadon Francke ube esetshela imantshi ukuthi uzogadla ngencwadi efungelwe yomphenyi wecala.Lencwadi iphonselwe inselelo uMzelemu wathi uyacindezelwa uZungu, abukho ubulungiswa kokwenziwa umbuso obavukele esiswini njengotshwala uletha lencwadi abebeqala ukuyibona izolo.Ube esefaka isicelo esiphuthumayo sokuba avunyelwe uZungu ukuba agibele ebhokisini labasolwa ukuze aziphendulele kwasolwa ngakho kulencwadi.Uthe isicelo sebheyili akumele sibe njengomdlalo we-chess lapho kugodlelwana khona ulwazi. Imantshi ithe izokwahlulela namuhla ngalokho.
BABALISE ngomonakalo odalwe yizikhukhula abadayisi baseMargate, ePort Shepstone.Lokhu bakubikele Isolezwe ngesikhathi kuhambele iMeya yaseMngeni uMnuz Chris Pappas kule ndawo eyohlola umonakalo. Bakhale ngokuthi selokhu kwenzeke umonakalo phakathi edolobheni lehlile kakhulu izinga lokuthengwa kwemikhiqizo yabo.UMnuz Bongani Khuzwayo odayisa izimpahla zokugqoka kule ndawo, uthe sibi kakhulu isimo ngemuva kwezikhukhula."Selokhu kwenzeke le nto bancane kakhulu abantu abathengayo. Lokhu kudalwa ukuthi sehlile nesibalo sabantu abahambela kuleli dolobha ngemuva kwezikhukhula," usho kanje sakubalisa.Uthe indlela idolobha labo elikhahlamezeke ngayo abazi ukuthi kuzothatha isikhathi esingakanani ukuthi isimo sibuyele kwesejwayelekile.UCHRIS Pappas ngesikhathi ehambele ePort ShepstoneUNkk Busisiwe Ngcokama odayisa izinto ezidliwayo uqale wabalisa ngokuthi igcwele amanzi indawo abadayisela kuyona.Uthe kulezi zinsuku akulula nokuthi abathengi basondele ematafuleni abo.Uchaze isimo ababhekene naso njengosizi. "Kulukhuni impela, imindeni yethu siyondla ngemali eyinzuzo esiyithola ngokudayisa lapha. Manje uma sekunje asazi ukuthi lizoya ngani ibhodwe eziko," ebalisa.Ugcizelele ukuthi ufisa ukubona uhulumeni ungenela ngokushesha ulungise konke okonakele edolobheni ukuze nabo njengabadayisi bangalimali kakhulu.Uthe okudala ukuthi kube lukhuni satshe ukuthi bebengakulungele ukubhekana nesimo salolu hlobo wathi empeleni nje sibehle ngaphezulu, uma bengadayisi impilo iyama.Ezinye izakhamuzi zibalise ngomonakalo omkhulu ezithi udalwe yizikhukhula emizini yazo.UMnuz Zwelakhe Mkhize uthe indlu yonke igcwele amanzi.Uthe kumele athenge impahla yasendlini entsha ngoba yonke ikhuntile futhi ngeke isasebenziseka.Ubalise ngokuthi akazi ukuthi impahla entsha uzoyithenga ngani ngoba uhola impesheni. UPappas uthe bazophindela emuva babhunge kabanzi ngabangalekelela ngakho emphakathini wakule ndawo.Uthe ukholwa ukuthi umphakathi udinga usizo oluphuthumayo hhayi izethembiso ezingamanga.
I-ANC KwaZulu-Natal isihleka usulu isinqumo seMeya yoMasipala wesifunda iZululand, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, sokubophisa iphini likasihlalo wayo esifundazweni, uNksz Nomagugu Simelane owagoloza ukuhoxisa izinsolo zokuthi ihlukumeza abesifazane ngokocansi.Okhulumela i-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Mafika Mndebele uthe angeke siphumelele isicelo sikaButhelezi sokuthi uNksz Simelane amhlawule ngo-R10 million."Ihlaya leli elenziwa uThulasizwe,” kusho uMndebele.Impi yezomthetho kaButhelezi noNksz Simelane ithathe elinye igxathu kuleli sonto njengoba uButhelezi efake amaphepha eNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu, efuna ukuba inkantolo iphoqe uNksz Simelane ukuba amhlawule.UButhelezi, obuye abe uNdunankulu kaZulu ukhala ngokuthi izinsolo zikaNksz Simelane, oyiphini likasihlalo we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal zimehlisa isithunzi.Emaphepheni asenkantolo, uButhelezi uthe izinsolo zikaNksz Simelane zingalimaza amathuba akhe okuthi abe yilungu lesiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal.UButhelezi uvela ohlwini lwabaholi be-IFP abazoyimela esiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal.UNksz Simelane waziqhatha noButhelezi ngokuthi amsole ngokufuna ukulala nabafazi babantu, lokhu ukusho emcimbini we-ANC owawuseVryheid.UNksz Simelane wakhalaza ngezinduna zamabutho ezagxeka isenzo sikasihlalo we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Siboniso Duma sokuphuca uButhelezi umbhobho ngesikhathi kunomcimbi wokukhumbula iSilo uDinuzulu kaCetshwayo.Enkulumweni kaNksz Simelane eyingxenye yamaphepha asenkantolo afakwe uButhelezi, ukhala ngokuthi izinduna zamabutho, azikaze ziphawule ngezinsolo zokuthi uButhelezi uhlukumeza abesifazane ngokocansi."Kusiphatha kabi singabantu besifazane ukuthi izinduna ziyakwazi ukukhala ngokuthi uThulasizwe uphucwe umbhobho, kodwa azisho lutho uma efuna amakhosikazi abantu embhedeni. "Zithuli zithini izinduna ngehlazo elifana naleli? Imeya ethi ngaphambi kokuthi ngikukhokhele umholo wakho owusebenzele, woza uzolala kwami kuqala,” kusho okaSimelane.UNksz Simelane ophinde abe uMphathiswa wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal, wayebekelwe umnqamulajuqu wangesonto eledlule ukuhoxisa izinsolo azenza ngoButhelezi.UButhelezi uziphikile izinsolo ezenziwa uNksz Simelane wathi zingcolisa igama lakhe."Izinsolo zingiveza njengomuntu osebenzisa budlabha isikhundla sami njengemeya, futhi zingiveza njengomuntu ongafanelwe ukuphatha isikhundla."Lezinsolo zibeka engcupheni amathuba okuthi ngiqokwe njengelungu lesiShayamthetho,” kusho uButhelezi. UNksz Simelane unikezwe izinsuku eziyishumi ukuba afake amaphepha aphikisa isicelo sikaButhelezi.Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kukaNksz Simelane ayizange iphumelele njengoba ucingo lwakhe belungangeni futhi akazange awuphendule umbuzo awuthunyelwe.

AHLULEKE nokuzibamba ejabulela isinqumo amalungu omndeni kanjiniyela owabulawa ngo-2020, ngesikhathi iNkantolo eNkulu eThekwini ilahla unkosikazi wakhe nosibali ngawo wonke amacala abathweswe wona.Isinqumo senkantolo esiphume izolo siphoqe kuthi uNompumelelo Goncalves owayewunesi, ashone ekhulukuthu njengoba ubengaphandle ngebheyili kusuka ngo-2020 ngecala lokubulala umyeni wakhe uMnuz Nkosi Langa owayengunjiniyela kwa-Transnet. Wamthengela izinkabi. Ubelokhu egqigqa inkantolo nomfowabo uNkosinathi Zungu yena obetokile, kanti inkabi esiphenduke uFakazi woMbuso uJames Mashudu Mthimkhulu, uvele udonsa isigwebo seminyaka ewu-20 emva kokuvuma icala.Efunda uhlu lwamacala abalahile, obambe njengeJaji, uSolwazi Bonke Dumisa, abebethamele icala iningi labo obekuyizihlobo nabazwelana nomndeni wakwaLanga, bebekhuzwa sebeshaya ihlombe bejabulela abakubize ngokwenzeka kobulungiswa.Bobabili abalahlwe amacala okukhona kuwo elokuthumba, ukubamba inkunzi, nelokubulala, bebewaphika. UNompumelelo uphinde watholwa enecala lokuzama ukuphazamisa ukusebenza kwamaphoyisa nelokuvula icala elingamanga emaphoyiseni.Udadewabo kamufi uNksz Zodwa Langa uthe lesi sinqumo sibajabulise kakhulu, yize singeke simvuse umfowabo nonina okuthiwa yena waxinwa wukugulwa washona ezinsukwini ezimbalwa kudedelwe umakoti wakwakhe ngebheyili kuleli cala."Angiboni ukuthi inkosikazi yomfowethu siyoyixolela ekhaya ngalesi senzo. Ngeke sixole. Umuntu esesimxolele uMthimkhulu (inkabi eyavuma icala), ngoba yena wakhombisa ukuzisola wakhuluma lonke iqiniso esikholwa ukuthi yilona eliholele ekutheni laba batholwe benecala,” usho kanje.Isidumbu sikaLanga owathunjwa kwakhe ngoSepthemba 2020, satholwa emva kwezinyanga ezimbili enyamalele, sesonakele silahlwe ehlathini oZwathini eNdwedwe. Ebufakazini bukaMthimkhulu, uyena noZungu abaklinya umufi ngentambo ye-ayina.Ngaphambi kokuthi ijaji likhiphe isinqumo, lifunde ubufakazi bukangoti uMnuz Peter Andries Oosterhuizen ocwaninga ngokusebeza kwe-tracker emotweni, owaqinisekisa ukubonakala kwemoto kaNompumelelo ihambela eKenville eThekwini ukuyohlangana nomfowabo ngosuku olwandulela ukubulawa komyeni wakhe, nokuhamba kwemoto yomfowabo. Ubufakazi bukangoti ngezindawo ezahanjwa yizimoto nezikhathi, ijaji lithe buyahambisana nobendlalelwe yinkantolo uMthimkhulu. Kuphindwe kwabhekwa ubufakazi bukangoti wamaselula uMnuz Thabani Golele obaveza ukudonsa kwamafoni abamangalelwa ezindaweni ezehlukene, nakhona okuhambisana nobufakazi obethuliwe. Kwavezwa nokukhishwa kwemali kamufi, eyakhishwa oThongathi naseMsinga. Ubufakazi bukaDkt Sureke Maharaj, okwathiwa wahlola uNompumelelo - inkantolo ekholwa ukuthi wazenza okhathazekile ngesikhathi umyeni wakhe engabuyi ekhaya - buveze ukuthi wayengenazo izimpawu zokukhathazeka futhi umfutho wakhe wegazi wawushaya ngendlela ejwayelekile ngaphandle kokuthi wayenamehlo abomvu.Inkantolo ilihlehlisele uMeyi 23 nonyaka icala, lapho abameli babamangalelwa noMbuso beyohlanganisa khona amakhanda ukuvumelana ngokuthile ngosuku lokwenziwa kwezethulo zokubashwelezela nokwehliswa kwesigwebo.
UMENGAMELI we-ANC, uCyril Ramaphosa uzohola amalungu esigungu esiphezulu azoqinisa umkhankaso walenhlangano esifundazweni esibangwayo, iKwaZulu-Natal.URamaphosa nabanye abaholi be-ANC kuzwelonke bazohlala isonto lonke KwaZulu-Natal lapho bezokube behamba bekhankasa ezingxenyeni ezahlukene zesifundazwe.Lezindaba zivezwe usihlalo we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Siboniso Duma, obekhuluma ngaphambi kokuqala komhlangano wokulungiselela ukhetho.Umhlangano wobuholi be-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, ubuseThekwini izolo.Umbango wokuhola iKwaZulu-Natal ushisa phansi, lesifundazwe singesesibili ngokwesibalo sabantu abaningi ababhalisele ukuvota.Ongoti babona kuzokuba wumqansa ukuthi i-ANC ikwazi ukugcina lesifundazwe okhethweni lwangenyanga ezayo.UDuma uthe njengoba ukhetho lwangoMeyi 29 selusondele, bazoqinisa umkhankaso wabo."Kuyizindaba ezinhle kuthina ukuthi umengameli nawo wonke amalungu esigungu esiphezulu, azohlala izinsuku eziyisikhombisa lapha KwaZulu-Natal."Lapha KwaZulu-Natal sinabantu abangu-5, 7 million ababhalisele ukuvota. Sibalwa nezifundazwe ezinabantu abaningi abahalisele ukuvota."Kulomhlangano wanamhlanje sizolungiselela ukufika kwamalungu esigungu esiphezulu. Njengoba sekusele izinsuku ezingu-42 kufike ukhetho, lokhu kukutshela ukuthi kufanele siqinise umkhankaso wethu,” kusho uDuma.Umhlangano wayizolo ubuhanjelwe amalungu esigungu esiphezulu kuzwelonke abeholwa wuMnuz Zizi Kodwa nabaholi abaqhamuka ezifundeni.UDuma uthe bazoxoxa kabanzi ngezindaba ezithinta ukuhanjiswa kwezidingo kubantu."Kulezinsuku ezingu-42 ezisele kufanele sibone ukuthi sikwenza kanjani lokhu okusasele. Kufanele sixoxe ukuthi abantu abangakawatholi amanzi, bazowathola kanjani."Sonke siqaphelile ukuthi sekuphele izinsuku ezingu-22 ugesi ungacishwa. Lokhu kukutshela ukuthi umehluko usukhona odabeni lukagesi,” esho.Uthe bazophinde bathole umbiko ngokusebenza komasipala basesifundazweni, wabalula umasipala omkhulu, iTheku.Udaba lwesiteleka sabasebenzi esidonse isikhathi eside saphazamisa ukuhanjiswa kwezidingo ezindaweni ezingaphansi kwalomkhandlu dolobha, luzoba seqhulwini.Lesiteleka esidonse amasonto siholela ekutheni abantu bagcine sebekhala ngokuphazamiseka kwezidingo ezifana namanzi, ugesi nokuqoqwa kukadoti.UDuma uthe bafuna ukwazi ukuthi isimo sinjani njengamanje."Esikwaziyo ukuthi isiteleka sesaphela, abasebenzi sebabuyela emsebenzini. Yingakho sithe asibize onke amalungu esigungu esiphezulu, ukuze sizothola umbiko. Sifuna ukuthi sonke sikhulume ngazwi linye, kuqhuba uDuma.Ngaphambi kokuqala komhlangano amalungu e-ANC abebukeka egcwele ukuzethemba, ecula izingoma zomzabalazo.

ZIMILE kwelithi ngeke zilubhade emakilasini izitshudeni zaseMfolozi TVET College ebezibhikisha izolo eRichards Bay zikhala ngezinkinga.Phakathi kwezikhalo zazo ziveze ukuthi kukhona eziphathelene neNational Student’s Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS), kuphinde kube khona ezithinta isikhungo ngqo.Umhleli wombhikisho, uMnuz Sanele Mvelase, echaza ngezinye zezinkinga, uthe kuze kube yimanje ezinye izitshudeni azikaze zizithole izincwadi zokufunda."Abanye sebeze baqala ukubhala izivivinyo, abanye kulindeleke ukuthi baqale maduze. Kuthiwa asizibhale kanjani izivivinyo singenazo izincwadi,” kubuza uMvelase.Uqhube wathi ezindaweni ezihlala izitshudeni ngaphakathi esikhungweni kunomgomo wokuthi izitshudeni ziyaphekelwa.Uthe ophekela izithudeni ukhala ngokuthi akakhokheliwe, izitshudeni zibhuqwa yindlala."Sonke lesi sikhathi ubezama ngendlela azama ngayo, aziphekele izitshudeni. Kamumva ukhale ngokuthi sekuphele kona lokho abekubekile, izitshudeni sezilala ngephalishi,” kusho uMvelase.IZITSHUDENI zaseMfolozi TVET College zibhikisha Isithombe: SITHUNYELWE Ukhale nangokuthi uxhaso lwemali yokukhokhela irenti kulezo zitshudeni ezihlala emiqashweni ezimele, imali yama-data, eyokudla nezinto zokugcoba ivele ibe ncane njengoba enye ithathwa ama-charges.Elandisa mayelana nezinkinga ezithinta isikhungo, uthe izitshudeni eziphila nokukhubazeka azibhekelelwe, njengoba zize zisizwe ezinye izithudeni uma zizofunda.Ubuye wathi amabhilidi awekho esimweni esifanele, wathi amanye anetha imvula kodwa kulindeleke ukuthi bafundele kuwo."Lezi zinkinga ezimayelana nesikhungo zindala, ezinye zazo, kusukela ngo-2012 zikhona, zingalungiswa,” kusho yena.Uthe bakulungele ukubuyela ekilasini, inqobo nje uma behlangatshezwa ezikhalweni zabo ikakhulukazi lezo ezithinta izincwadi nokudla.Okhulumela isikhungo uMnuz Bhekani Ndlovu, uthe bayazibophezela ekutheni ukufunda nokufundisa kuqhubeke ngendlela ejwayelekile.Uthe bayazi ukuthi imbangela enkulu eyenza izitshudeni ziteleke yizinkinga zeNSFAS."Ihhovisi leNSFAS elikhona esikhungweni sethu, lenza konke okusemandleni ukulungisa izinkinga zabafundi,” kusho uNdlovu.Uthe batholile ukuthi ezinye izinkinga zidalwe ukungakhokhelwa kwabahlinzeka ngezidingo esikhungweni, wathi lokhu kwenzeke izinyanga ezimbili kuphela."Ngokwesivumelwano osonkontileka abasisayina nesikhungo, kufanele babe nemali eyanele ukukhokhela abasebenzi babo izinyanga ezintathu ukugwema izimo ezifana nalezi. Isikhungo senza konke okusemandleni ukulungisa lolu daba,” kusho uNdlovu.
KUNGAKAPHOLI maseko kuphele isiteleka sodokotela abangaqashiwe abebeqhinqe ehhovisi likaMphathiswa wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal befuna ukuqashwa, ngoMsombuluko osokhemisi bagasele emahhovisi abaphathiswa bezempilo ezweni lonke befuna ukuqashwa.Osokhemisi bathi uMnyango wezeMpilo wagcina ngo-2015 ukulandela uhlelo oluyilo lokuqasha osokhemisi abasuke sebephothule izifundo zabo, baze baqeqeshelwa umsebenzi ezikhungweni zikahulumeni.UMnuz Sandile Nzuza ongomunye wosokhemisi abangaqashiwe, obehambise uhlu lwezikhalo ehhovisi likaMphathiswa wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal, uthe muva nje izikhala zosokhemisi ziyakhangiswa ezibhedlela bafake izicelo kungaqashwa muntu kuzo, kuthiwe izikhala ebezivulekile zimisiwe noma asisekho isidingo sazo."Ukukhangiswa komsebenzi kusuke kusho ukuthi isuke isikhona imali yokukhokhela lowo msebenzi obezoqashwa. Kwenzekani ngaleyo mali uma umnyango noma leso sikhungo sesithi umsebenzi asisekho isidingo sawo. Kuze kushiwo njalo nje kwenzekani ngezikhala ezivuleka ngokuthi kube khona osokhemisi abahambayo nabashonayo kusukela ngo-2015. Sekunesikhathi sikhuluma noMnyango wezeMpilo ngalokhu ngokubhala izincwadi singaphendulwa. Kulokhu sithathe isinqumo sokuthi sibe nemashi enokuthula ezoya kuwo wonke amahhovisi abaphathiswa bezempilo sethule uhla lwezikhalo zethu bese kuba nohla oluzoya eMnyangweni wezeMpilo kuzwelonke nakumengameli," kusho uNzuza.Phakathi kwezikhalo osokhemishi bafuna ukuthi kuqashwe osokhemisi abangu-150 esifundazweni ngasinye njalo ngonyaka. Kuphinde kwamukelwe ososayensi abaqeqeshelwa umsebenzi njalo ngonyaka."Sifuna ukuthi kuqashwe osokhemisi abasha ezikhaleni zalabo abasuke bekhushulelwe ezikhundleni ngoba lezo zikhala zisuke zivele zikhona kwibhajethi yomnyango," kusho uNzuza.Uthe bafuna ukuthi umnyango uphendule kungakapheli izinsuku eziyisikhombisa uma ungaphenduli bazothatha ezinye izinyathelo." Siyazi ukuthi kunenkinga yokushoda kwemali emnyangweni kodwa osokhemisi babalulekile ezikhungweni zezempilo uma kukalwa imisebenzi yabasebenzi bezimpilo babalwa njengabenza umsebenzi obucayi. Ngakho akukwazi ukuthi bashiywe ngaphandle bangaqashwa ngoba umnyango uthi uqasha abasebenzi abenza imisebenzi ebalulekile kuphela," kusho uNzuza..Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMpilo kuleli uMnuz Foster Mohale, uthembise ukuthi uzoyiphendula imibuzo athunyelelwe yona.
NJENGOBA ezobe emathathu amaphepha okuvota okhethweni lukazwelonke ngenyanga ezayo, ikhomishini yezokhetho isixwayise abavoti ukuthi bavote kanye ephepheni ngalinye.Ikhomishini iveze ukuthi uma uke wavota kabili noma ngaphezulu ephepheni elilodwa, lelo voti liyothathwa njengento engekho.Lokhu kuvezwe yisikhulu esiphezulu sekhomishini, uMnuz Sy Mamabolo, ekhuluma esithangamini sabezindaba ngoLwesibili, eGoli.UMamabolo uchaze kabanzi ngamaphepha amathathu okuvota kulolu khetho lwangoMeyi 29."Iphepha lokuqala lizobe liqukethe amaqembu ezepolitiki kuphela, kanti kulona kuzobe kuvotelwa izihlalo ezingu-200. Leli phepha linamaqembu evile ku-50 azobe efuna ukuvotelwa kanti laziwa ngokuthi yi-PR. Elesibili kuzovotelwa amaqembu kanjalo nabangenele ukhetho ngokuzimela. Kulona kuzobe kuvotelwa abasuka ezifundazweni abaya ePhalamende. Kwelesithathu kuzobe kuvotelwa amaqembu kanjalo nabangenela ukhetho ngokuzimela abazoya eziShayamthetho zezifundazwe. Isifundazwe ngasinye sizoba nephepha lesithathu laso elihlukile kunezinye izifundazwe.”ISIKHULU esiphezulu sezokhetho uMnuz Sy Mamabolo oxwayise abavoti ukuthi bangenzi amaphutha uma sebevota Isithombe:Mujahid SafodienUnxuse abavoti ukuthi bazinike isikhathi ngaphambi kokuba bashaye u-X ngoba uma benze iphutha bawufaka endaweni okungeyona uma sebephinde bewushaya kwenye indawo lelo phepha liyothathwa njengelicekeleke phansi, lingabalwa njengevoti elisemthethweni.Uveze ukuthi emaphepheni okuvota kuzoba negama eligcwele leqembu, isifingqo segama leqembu kanjalo nesithombe somholi weqembu.Kwabangenela ukhetho ngokuzimela kukhona igama lalowo mholi, ubuso bakhe kanjalo negama elithi INDEPENDENT.
LIDINWE lagana unwabu iJaji Ratha Mokgoatlheng, elihlalele ukuqulwa kwecala lokubulawa kukaSenzo Meyiwa, licikwa ngabameli laze laguqisa icala. Bekubangwa ukuchitshiyelwa kwencwadi efungelwe kafakazi.UMeyiwa owayeyisilomo se-Orlando Pirates neBafana Bafana, wadutshulwa wabulawa ngo-2014, ekubo kwentombi yakhe uKelly Khumalo eVosloorus, eGauteng. UMbuso uthi abamangalelwa bathengwa ukuthi bamphumele inqina okwenyamazane uMeyiwa, baqede ngaye.Icala liguqe kungasekuhle kuphambana imibono. UMbuso ubize ufakazi ongungoti wamaselula kwavela ukuthi uthathe umsebenzi obuwenziwa nguColonel Lambertus Steyn, osethathe umhlalaphansi. Umsindo usuke lapho-ke kubangwa ukuthi incwadi efungelwe bekufanele icacise kahle ngoshintsho longoti bamaselula.Abameli baveze ukungenami kwabo bethi indlela okwenzeka ngayo ayinabo ubulungiswa kubamangalelwa. Kukhononde kakhulu u-Advocate Zandile Mshololo, omele ummangalelwa wesihlanu uFisokuhle Ntuli.UMMELI u-Advocate Zandile Mshololo, utholane phezulu neJaji Ratha Mokgoatlheng, kwaze kwaguqiswa icala lokubulawa kukaSenzo Meyiwa Isithombe : OUPA MOKOENA/INDEPENDENT MEDIAUMbuso neJaji bavumelene ngokuthi kuqhutshekwe nencwadi efungelwe engalungisiwe kodwa u-Advocate Mshololo wala ukhasha, wathi ngeke."Lokhu okwenzekayo akunabo ubulungiswa ekhasimendeni lami ngoba simangele nje ukuthi incwadi ilungiswa khona lapha ebhokisini lofakazi. Asazi futhi ukuthi yini enye esazolungiswa,’’ kubhoka u-Adv Mshololo.IJaji libonakale licikeka kakhulu ngalokhu lithi akufanele ngabe kunenkinga ngoba kuyachazwa ukuthi ufakazi omusha uthathe izintambo kuSteyn othathe umhlalaphansi."Hhayi ! kuyacaca ukuthi ukuqonda izinto kahle kuhambisana nesipiliyoni inkosi impela. Kusobala ukuthi sizomosha isikhathi ngalolu daba. Kungcono siyeke, sihambe sibuye kusasa ngoba kuthiwa asenzi ubulungiswa. Ngiyaxolisa kakhulu ngalokhu,’’ kusho ijaji libonakala ukuthi licikekile futhi linikina ikhanda lize liyancinciza.U-Advocate Mshololo ubenikina ikhanda ngesikhathi iJaji likhuluma sakuthetha lihlehlisa icala. Ngaphambi kwalokho kuke kwabangwa indaba yokuqasha uchwepheshe ohlola izibhamu.Abameli babecele ukuletha ungoti wabo wezibhamu ukuthi azohlola isibhamu namagobolondo okuthiwa kwabulala uMeyiwa. Ungoti kufanele akhokhelwe abeLegal Aid kodwa lokhu akukenzeki. Libangiwe lelo phuzu kwaze kwalethwa omele abeLegal Aid, ukuthi azochaza.Kulindeleke ukuthi icala liqhubeke ngoLwesithathu lapho ungoti wamaselula ezokweneka ubufakazi bakhe.
INHLANGANO emele abaphathi bamanyuvesi i-Universities South Africa (USAf), isiyalele umlawuli wesikhashana weNational Students’ Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS), ukuthi alungise ngokushesha uhlelo lwezobuchwepheshe balesi sikhwama obenza kube nzima ukuhambisa imininingwane yezitshudeni.Le nhlangano ezibophezele ukuthi izosebenzisana nomlawuli uMnuz Freeman Nomvalo, oqale umsebenzi wakhe ngeledlule, ithe ayinankinga nokuqhubeka ukukhokha imihlomulo yezitshudeni kodwa inkinga isohlelweni lwalesi sikhwama olungabavumeli ukuthi bafake imininingwane yezitshudeni.UNomvalo unxuse ukuthi kube nokubambisana ezinhlakeni ezehlukene okubalwa i-USAF, izinhlangano zezitshudeni, abasebenzi beNSFAS, abamele amakolishi amakhono ama-TVET njengoba enikwe izinyanga ezingu-12, ukulungisa izinkinga ezihaqe isikhwama.UDkt Phethiwe Matutu, isikhulu esiphezulu se-USAf, utshele isiteshi sethelevishini, ukuthi akulungiswe ngokushesha izinkinga ezikhona kwiNSFAS.Uthe kunezitshudeni namanje okungacaci ukuthi zilutholile yini uxhaso noma cha."Labo abafake izimangalo kwiNSFAS kumele baphendulwe ukuze kwaziwe ukuthi baxhasiwe noma cha. Siyakwamukela ukuqhubeka sikhokhe imihlomulo yezitshudeni okuyinto esiyenze ngempumelelo selokhu kuqale unyaka. Okunye okwenza kube nokubambezeleka ekutheni sihambise imininingwane yezitshudeni kwiNSFAS wukuthi uhlelo lwabo lwezobuchwepheshe lunezinkinga alusivumeli ukuthi singene kulona kalula. Lokhu kwenza ukuthi izitshudeni zingakwazi ukuthola uxhaso.” Uthe uma bezama ukuthola usizo kwiNSFAS akekho obasizayo wasola inkinga yokushoda kwabasebenzi.NoNgqongqoshe weMfundo ePhakeme nokuQeqesha uDkt Blade Nzimande, ekhuluma nabezindaba ngokwenze wahlakaza ibhodi leNSFAS, uyivezile eyokuthi lesi sikhwama sibhekene nezinselelo ohlelweni lwaso lwezobuchwepheshe nokungabi nabasebenzi abenele.Usho lokhu nje iNSFAS ithe maduzane izoba nesithangami nabezindaba lapho izomemezela izinhlelo esizenzile ngabangakakhokhelwa.UDkt Matutu uthe kudingeka kube nabantu abazosiza uma kuba nezinkinga zokuchithwa wuhlelo lweNSFAS."Kumanje u-60% wezitshudeni osakhokhelwe, ezinye azikhokhelwe. Izitshudeni ziyalamba uthola ukuthi azazi nokuthi kungani zingaxhasiwe.”UNomvalo uthe akuzoba lula wathi kodwa uzokwenza konke okusemandleni ukulungisa isimo kulesi sikhwama.Ezinye izinto abekelwe nguNzimande ukuthi azenze ngukuxazulula inkinga yokungafiki ngesikhathi kwemininingwane yezitshudeni, ukukhokhelwa kwalabo abangakakhokhelwa okubalwa nezindawo zokuhlala, ukulungiselela uhlelo lokufakwa kwezicelo zangonyaka ozayo, ukushesha ukuphendula abafake izicelo zokuxhaswa, ukuqinisa imigomo yesikhwama nokulungisa ezithinta ubuchwepheshe.UNzimande uveze ukuthi ezinye zezizathu ezenze wachitha ibhodi leNSFAS wuqhekeko obelukhona emalungwini, amanye abedonsa aye kwenye indawo, wukuhluleka ukuchitha izinkampani ezathola ithenda yokusabalalisa imihlomulo yezitshudeni, wukuhluleka ukuletha umbiko waminyaka yonke ePhalamende, wukuhluleka ukulungisa indaba ye-call centre namanje engasebenzi, wukuhluleka ukuphendula ngesikhathi izikhalo zezitshudeni nezinye.
KUSALE enkundleni abasolwa abathathu ngesikhathi bedubulana namaphoyisa eBooysens eGauteng.Kusinde abasolwa abathathu kulesi sigameko esenzeke ngoLwesibili emini ngesikhathi amaphoyisa ezinhlaka ezahlukene eholwa oKlebe evimbezela abasolwa okuthiwa bayingxenye yeqembu lemigulukudu ethinteka emacaleni ahlukene okubalwa kuwo angu-30 okubulala.Kutholakale izibhamu ezimbili ezingekho emthethweni.
