UMA uzobe usebenza ngosuku lokhetho lukazwelonke uMeyi 29, 2024 noma uzobe ungekho endaweni obhalisele ukuvota kuyona, ikhomishini yezokhetho kuleli ivule ithuba lokuthi ufake isicelo sokusheshe uvote.Abagulayo abangakwazi ukuhamba, abakhulelwe kanjalo nabaphila nokukhubazeka abafisa ukuvakashelwa emakhaya nabo bazokwazi ukusheshe bavote ngokuthi bafake isicelo.Izicelo zokuthi usheshe uvote zivulwe kusuka izolo kuze kube uLwesihlanu, uMeyi 3, 2024. Isicelo singafakwa emahhovisi ekhomishini, komasipala noma kwi-website yekhomishini.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi njengoba kulolu khetho ungeke ukwazi ukuvota endaweni ongahlali kuyona, kubalulekile ukuthi usheshe ubhalisele ukuvota ngokuyisipesheli.Abanye abangakwazi ukubhalisela ukuvota okuyisipesheli kubalwa izintatheli, amaphoyisa, ojele kanjalo nanoma ibaphi abanye abasebenzi abazobe betohoza ngosuku lokhetho oluzoba yiholidi.Abagunyaziwe ukuthi bavote ngokuyisipesheli bazovotiswa ngoMeyi 27 noMeyi 28. Isikhulu sekhomishini yezokhetho KwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Ntomb’futhi Masinga, sisanda kutshela Isolezwe ukuthi abakubuzi isizathu esenza ukuthi usheshe ufune ukuvota."Asikubuzi ukuthi kungani ufuna ukushesha uvote. Siyakubhalisa nje ukuthi usheshe uvote. Nginxusa labo abazobe bazi ukuthi ngosuku lokhetho bazobe bengekho lapho behlala khona ngoba besebenza ukuthi basheshe babhalisele ukuvota,” kusho uNkk Masinga.Namhlanje ikhomishini inesithangami nabezindaba lapho izokhuluma ngezinto ezehlukene ezithinta ukhetho ezithinta nendaba yokuvulwa kwezicelo zokuthi abantu babhalisele ukuvota.Abafuna ukubhalisela ukuvota bangaya kwi-website yekhomishini ethi:www.elections.org.za.Bangathumela nomqhafazo wabo onenombolo kamazisi enombolweni ethi:32249. Umqhafazo uzobiza u-R1. Ungashayela nenombolo yekhomishini ethi:0800 11 8000, ukuze uthole ulwazi ngokufaka isicelo sokusheshe uvote. Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi lolu khetho lufike ngesikhathi lapho izwe ligubha iminyaka engu-30 lakhululeka.Izinkumbi zabantu bakuleli zavota okhethweni lokuqala lwango-1994. Khonamanjalo uMnyango wezaseKhaya ukhumbuze umphakathi ukuthi azovulwa wonke amahhovisi awo njalo ngemiGqibelo kusuka ngo-8 ekuseni kuze kube u-1 ntambama.Amahhovisi azovulwa ukuze abantu balande omazisi babo, ukufaka izicelo zomazisi abasha kanjalo nokukhishwa komazisi besikhashana. Azovulwa kuze kube uMeyi 25, 2024. Azovalwa ngo-Ephreli 27, 2024 ngoba yiholidi.
KUNGENZEKA sande isibalo sabashone kuhlasela izikhukhula ezihlasele eMargate, ePort Shepstone ngeSonto ntambama.Lokhu kudalulwe okhulumela uMasipala Ugu, uMnuz France Zama ngesikhathi ekhuluma neSolezwe mayelana nomshophi obavelele kule ndawo.Uthe okwamanje bahlanu abantu abangaqinisekisa ukuthi bashonile ngenxa yezikhukhula.Uthe kunezimoto ezivaleleke ngaphansi kwebhuloho eliya eMargate ngasemfuleni iNkangweni."Sizobheka ukuthi izimoto ezivaleleke ngaphansi kwaleliya bhuluho bezinabantu yini noma cha. Uma kwenzeka ukuthi bezinabantu kuyacaca ukuthi sizokwanda isibalo sabantu abadlule emhlabeni bakule ndawo ngenxa yezikhukhula,'' usho kanje.Ukhale kakhulu ngomonakalo athe mkhulu odalwe yilzikhukhula. Uveze ukuthi umonakalo okwamanje abakwazi ukusho ukuthi ungalinganiselwa emalini engakanani.Ukhale kakhulu nangokukhahlamezeka kwengqalasizinda. Wathi le ndawo ithandwa kakhulu yizivakashi, uthe ukukhahlamezeka kwayo ngalolu hlobo kungaphazamisa ezokuvakasha.Udalule nokuthi nezikhungo eziphehla amanzi zikhahlamezekile.Uveze ukuthi abezimo eziphuthumayo bebematasa bekuyona le ndawo.Okhulumela uMnyango wokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu, uMnuz Siboniso Mngadi, uthe bathumele ithimba lezinhlekelele ukuze liqaphe ngelokhozi okuqhubekayo ngemuva kwezikhukhula.Ngaphandle kwaseMargate izikhukhula kuvele ukuthi zidale umonakalo nakwezinye izindawo ezisogwini oluseningizimu kubalwa, uMgababa noMzinto. Amalungu omphakathi aseMzinto akhahlamezekile abalise ngokuthi izindlu zawo ziwe bhu phansi.UMnuz Zakhele Sibisi uthe akazi ukuthi uzothathani ahlanganise nani ukuze aqale phansi akhe umuzi wakhe wamagumbi amane odilike kuhlasela izikhukhula. "Inzima kakhulu le nto esehlele mina nabantwana bami. Kuyimanje nje angazi nokuthi ngizolalaphi ngoba ngiswele indawo yokulalala,'' usho kanje.Elinye ilungu lomphakathi lakhona eMzinto, uNksz Snegugu Makhanya, lithe abazi ukuthi bazolallaphi njengoba izikhukhula zicekele phansi indawo abebehlala kuyo.
ABAMANGALELWA ababili ecaleni lokubulawa kowayengunozinti uSenzo Meyiwa, bayabuchitha ubufakazi bokuthi batholwa namaselula besejele. UMeyiwa owayeyisilomo se-Orlando Pirates neBafana Bafana, wadutshulwa wabulawa ekubo kwentombi yakhe Kelly Khumalo eVosloorus, eGauteng, ngo-2014.Ufakazi woMbuso, uSergeant uVusumuzi Mogane, uthe kwatholakala iselula kummangalelwa wesihlanu uFisokuhle Ntuli owayesejele eQalakabusha, eMpangeni. UMogane usethimbeni labaphenyi abaphethe udaba lokufa kukaMeyiwa.UMogane uthe ngo-Agasti 2020, wayeseMpangeni ehamba noBrigadier Bongani Gininda ngesikhathi bethola ukuthi uNtuli uphethe iselula ejele. UMogane uthe babevele besendleleni beyophenya uNtuli ngecala likaMeyiwa kodwa wayeboshelwe elinye icala eMpangeni.ABAMANGALELWA ecaleni lokufa kukaSenzo Meyiwa okulindeleke ukuthi babuyele enkantolo namuhla kuzolalelwa ubufakazi Isithombe : THOBILE MATHONSI/INDEPENDENT MEDIA"Sathintwa wumphathi wejele eQalakabusha ethi uNtuli utholwe neselula. Saphuthuma khona lapho ejele siyothola kabanzi ngalokhu. Safika sayithola iselula kumphathi wejele sayithatha sayifaka esikhwameni sobufakazi,’’ kusho uMogane.UMogane ufakazelwe wuMnuz Sibusiso Yaka owayewumphathi wejele iQalakabusha osedla umhlalaphansi. UYaka utshele inkantolo ukuthi wathola iselula kuNtuli wase eyinika abaphenyi becala ngoba wayazi ukuthi bavele baphezu komsebenzi wokuphenya ngecala likaMeyiwa.UMogane uphinde wethula ubufakazi bokuthi ummangalelwa wesibili uMnuz Bongani Ntanzi watholwa neselula esiteshini samaphoyisa eVillieria, ePitoli. UMogane uthe walunywa indlebe ngokuthi uNtanzi uphethe iselula nangempela wafika wayithola ezingutsheni zokulala.UMogane uthe kuNtuli kwatholwa iselula iStylo kanti kuNtanzi kwatholwa iSamsung J5 ahlolwa kwatholwa ubufakazi obuhlobene necala lokufa kukaMeyiwa.UMogane uthe enye yamaselula yathunyelwa kuColonel Lambert Steyn owungoti owawacubungula. USteyn uke wafakaza phambilini, eveza ukuthi ummangalelwa wesihlanu uNtuli wake waxhumana noKelly ngaphambi kokufa kukaMeyiwa.Ummeli kaNtanzi uMnuz Sipho Ramosepele uthe ikhasimende lakhe liyayichitha indaba yokuthi latholwa neselula. Ubepheka uMogane ngemibuzo embuza ukuthi kuphi lapho abhala khona ngesikhathi ethola iselula?Ummeli kaNtuli, u-Advocate Zandile Mshololo, uthe ikhasimende lakhe lithi iselula yatholakala eduze kombhede wesinye isiboshwa ayehleli naso futhi ne-charger yatholwa ekhabetheni laso.UMshololo uchithe ubufakazi bukaYaka othe uNtuli wazikhiphela yena iselula ngaphandle kokuphika. Kulindeleke ukuthi icala libuyele enkantolo namuhla kubizwe omunye ufakazi woMbuso.
UFUNA ukusebenzisa ukuqoshwa komculo wakhe ukukhulekela ukuqedwa kwesihlava sokubulawa kwabantu nokuhlukunyezwa kwezingane nabesifazane umculi wokholo, uSibongiseni Zikhali.Lo mculi uzopha bukhoma ngo-Ephreli 19, ePlayhouse eThekwini, lokhu kuqopha ukwethe igama lePrayer Project.Uthi ukhethe ukukwetha kanje ngoba enhliziyweni yakhe uhlushwa wukwanda kwezigameko zokubulawa kwabantu eNingizimu Afrika.Ukholwa wukuthi umkhuleko unamandla anele okuguqula lesi simo esibonakala siwuhlalise lubhojozi umphakathi wakuleli."Indlela esezande ngakhona izigameko zokubulawa kwabantu kushiya imibuzo. Ngikholwa ukuthi ngaleli langa uma simbikela uNkulunkulu ngale nkinga kukhona angasenzela khona,'' usho kanje.Ukhulume nangesihlava esimbi sokuhlukunyezwa kwezingane nabantu besifazane. Uthe kuyadabukisa ukuthi kunezigameko zokuhlukunyezwa kwezingane nabantwana abancane okusabikwa ngazo namanje.Uthe yingakho efuna ukuthi ngalolu suku kukhulekwe kujulwe ekubhekaneni nale ngwadla. "Sizophinde simnxuse kakhulu uNkulunkulu esimkhonzayo angenelele kuzo zonke izinkinga esibhekene nazo zokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane ezincane,'' echaza.Uveze ukuthi ufuna ukubona umculo wakhe udlondlobala kakhulu ngaphezulu kwalokhu oyikhona njengamanje.Ubonge ukwesekwa akuthola kuMfu Melusi Dladla ongumholi weBandla, iFamily Church International akhonza kulona.Uthe kumnikeza isibindi njalo ukwazi ukuthi unohlobo lomholi olukwaziyo ukuthi lume naye njalo.Phakathi kwabaculi abazobe beyingxenye yomcimbi kubalwa uThobeka Jili, Dorcas Jeza, Mpumi Mtshweni nomsakazi woKhozi FM uPhindi P.Umcimbi uqala ngehora lesithupha ntambama, amathikithi okungena abiza u-R250.
UHLALELE ovalweni umndeni wowesilisa obewummangali ecaleni losolwa ngokuba yinkabi osaboshiwe, okuthiwa uhlaselwe wadutshulwa emva kokuthola ucingo obelumsongela.UMnuz Simanga 'Katsande’ Khumalo (29) waseMlaza kuthiwa bese ehamba ngesihlalo sabakhubazekile emva kokudutshulwa umsolwa owaziwayo endaweni ngo-2021 okuvele ukuthi uboshelwe namanye amacala. UKhumalo udutshulwe ngenyanga edlule ehlaselwa kubo eMlaza esigamekweni okuboshwe kuso abasolwa ababili. Umndeni ukholwa ukuthi bebethunywe umsolwa engaphakathi ejele, obefuna umufi asule icala lokuzama ukubulala okuthiwa wayemvulele lona.Ilungu lomndeni kaKhumalo elicele ukungadalulwa lilandisa Isolezwe, lithe selokhu kwenzeke lesi sigameko sebethuka izanya kwazise kunamahlebezi okuthi umsolwa owayethume abahlaseli."Ubewumuntu ophumelelayo. Ngo-2021, ngesikhathi ebuya emsebenzini ukhale ngokubanjwa inkunzi ngabathile, abaqale ngokumshaya ngenduku yegalofu ngaphambi kokuthi bamphuce ifoni nezinye izinto zomsebenzi. Omunye wabo wayemazi ngoba owakhona endaweni, sanikela kubo ngenhloso yokuthi kuxoxwe nonina ukuthi okungenani abuyise i-simcard ngoba yayinezinamba ezibalulekile zasemsebenzini njengoba ngaleso sikhathi (umufi) wayeyimenenja eHusser Grill,” echaza.Uthe ngesikhathi befika kubo kamsolwa eMlaza kwa-B, batshelwa ababekhona ukuthi akathintwa ngakho abahambe angaze ebafice, okuthe bengakaligwinyi waqhamuka wadubula ebhekise kuKhumalo. Uthe uKhumalo waphuthunyiswa esibhedlela i-Prince Mshiyeni Memorial, kwaba wusuku agcine ngalo ukuzihambela ngezinyawo.Uthe emva kokuvulwa kwecala lokuzama ukubulala, umsolwa ubengaboshwa okuthe ngokuhamba kwesikhathi waboshelwa namanye amacala, akholwa ukuthi kwavuka naleli lokuzama ukubulala."Ngelinye ilanga ngangena endlini umufi ekhala, wathi ufonelwe othile angamazi wamtshela ukuthi akasule icala emsabisa ngokuthi uzomenzakalisa. Amaphoyisa abefuna ukuthi azobhala kabusha isitatimende, kodwa bese engasazimisele ngokuqhubeka naleli cala futhi nathi siwumndeni simeseka kulokho. Ngizamile ukuyolesula kodwa amaphoyisa anqaba athi lizosulwa owalivulayo, ngachaza ukuthi akakwazi ukuhamba njengoba ekhubazekile, kwavunyelwana ngokuthi umseshi uzofika ekhaya azomsayinisa amaphepha okulesula, kodwa lutho ukufika kwaze kwabe uyahlaselwa uyadutshulwa emva kokusongelwa ngokubulawa,” kusho yena.Uthe bezwe kuthiwa omunye wababoshiwe uvumile ukuthi wayethunywe umsolwa okwenza umndeni uhlalele ovalweni ngoba awazi ukuthi yikuphi okuzolandela njengoba kucaca ukuthi ukwazi ukuthumela izinkabi zimsebenzele engaphakathi ejele. Usole amaphoyisa ngokuhudula izinyawo uma umufi efuna ukusula icala ngoba ebona engaphephile.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uColonel Robert Netshiunda uqinisekise ukuboshwa kwabasolwa ababili abasolwa ngokubulala uKhumalo abebevele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMlaza ngesonto eledlule kanti bazophinde bavele kusasa.
USOMABHIZINISI waseThekwini, uMnuz Moses Tembe, uthe wayemfuna ebhokisini lofakazi aziphendulele noma engumsolwa umrepha uKiernan Forbes owayedume ngelika-AKA owayekhona kushona indodakazi yakhe, u-Anele Tembe, eminyakeni emithathu edlule.U-Anele washona ngemuva kokuwa esitezi seshumi ehhotela ayelele kulo no-AKA ayethandana naye ngaleso sikhathi, naye okwathi ngonyaka odlule, wadutshulwa ephuma endaweni yokudlela emgwaqweni uFlorida eThekwini.UTembe ukhulume okokuqala ngalezi zigameko zombili nentatheli yeSABC uChriselda Lewis, engxoxweni ekhethekile ebikhonjiswa kwiSABC News (404), izolo.UMOSES Tembe nendodakazi yakhe u-Anele eyashona eKapa nokhulume okokuqala ngokushona kwayo nokusolwa ekufeni kuka-AKA ISITHOMBE: SIGCINIWELe ngxoxo iqoshwe emtapweni wolwazi owaqanjwa ngo-Anele esikoleni ayefunda kuso eThekwini.UTembe uveze ukuthi wayemthanda u-AKA futhi akanaso isizathu esasingaholela ekutheni ambulale."Engangikufuna kuye ukumbona ebhokisini enkantolo echaza ngokwenzeka ngosuku okwashona ngalo indodakazi yami. Mina nomndeni wami sihlala lapha eThekwini, isigameko senzeka eKapa. Ngaphukelwa umoya ngibuka indodakazi yami ivalwe ngopulasitiki ocwebezelayo ezindabeni ngingakwazi ukufinyelela khona ngokushesha. Udaba ngaluthola ngomfowethu owafika ezongibikela ngosuku lwangeSonto engangilungiselela ngalo ukuya enkonzweni. Ngemuva kwalokho, ngazibuza ukuthi ubenobani? Ubani owazama ukumsiza njengoba sezwa ukuthi kwaphela imizuzu engu-20 ephila, futhi wayeyedwa emgwaqweni nokwaze kwaqhamuka owesifazane wambona elimele,” kusho uTemba.Uthe ngokwakhe, uphenyo aluhambanga ngendlela afisa ngayo kuze kube manje.Uveze ukuthi uphiko lwezokushushisa, iNPA eWestern Cape luhambise kancane uphenyo lwaleli cala kuze kube manje.Ebuzwa ukuthi uzizwa kanjani ngokuchaywa kwegama lakhe ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ngokufa kuka-AKA, uTembe uveze ukuthi angeke aze aphendule abantu abazifihlayo nangabazi."Ngisho emndenini wami kukhona ababethi uKiernan kumele aboshwe ngokushona kuka-Anele kodwa kukodwa engangikusho, ukuthi kumele silinde umthetho udlale indawo yawo. Abantu abasola mina nomndeni wami ngokuba nesandla ekushoneni kuka-AKA kuyacaca abawazi umndeni wami nokuthi singabantu abanjani,” kuchaza yena.UTembe ukhuluma kanjena nje, bayisikhombisa abesilisa ababoshiwe ababhekene necala lokulawa kuka-AKA nomngani wakhe uTebello Tibz Motsoane.Ababili kubo basagcinwe ezitokisini eSwatini, lapho baboshehlwa khona, kusalindwe kulalelwe isicelo sokuthi babuyiselwe kuleli. KUNENGEKE abasolwa eNkantolo eNkulu yaseBloemfontein kuhlehla icala ngenxa yokungapheleli kwabasolwa nabanye abangenabo abameli.Kule nkantolo bekuvele owayengunobhala jikelele we-ANC uMnuz Ace Magashule nabanye asolwa nabo ngamacala enkohlakalo athinta ithenda ye-asbestos.Kufikwa enkantolo, kubikelwe ijaji ngezingqinamba ezikhona eziphoqa ukuba icala lingaqhubeki. Okhulumela uphiko lwezokushushisa eFree State uMojalefa Senokoatsane utshele abezindaba ukuthi isizathu esikhulu esenze icala lahlehla wukuboshwa kukaMoroadi Cholota owayengumsizi kaMagashule. UMoroadi, okumanje use-United States of America, uboshwe yiziphathimandla e-USA futhi kulindeleke ukuba avele enkantolo ngoMsombuluko 15 Ephreli 2024. UMbuso uveze ukuthi uzophuthuma izinhlelo zokubuyiswa kukaMoroadi kuleli kulandela ukuvela kwakhe enkantolo. Kubuye kwavela ukuthi ukuboshwa kukaMoroadi akusona sodwa isizathu sokuhlehla kwecala."Kuvele nokuthi ummangalelwa 5, okuyinkampani, ayinabo abameli kanti esinye isizathu wukuthi owayeyilungu lesigungu esiphezulu (MEC) uSarah Mlamleli, akakwazanga ukufika enkantolo ngenxa yokugula futhi kuvele ukuthi uzoze avele ngoJulayi 2024.”Phambilini uMagashule, Edwin Sodi, Blackhead Consulting kanye noThabane Zulu, bafaka isicelo sokuhlakaza leli cala ngoba bethi alikho icala ababekwe lona, nokho inkantolo yasichitha isicelo sabo. Laba nabasolwa nabo okunguNthimotse Mokhesi, Mahlomola Matlakala, Sello Radebe, Kgotso Manyeki, Sarah Mlamleli, Nozipho Molikoe, Albertus Venter, Moroadi Cholota, Margaret-Ann Deidericks, nezinye izinkampani ezintathu, 602 Consulting Solutions, Mastertrade 232 kanye no-Ori babhekene namacala okukhwabanisa, inkohlakalo, ukushushumbiswa kwemali nokwephulwa koMthetho wokuPhathwa kweMali yoMphakathi (PFMA).La macala amayelana nenkontileka ye-asbestos ka-R255 million eyakhishwa uMnyango wezokuHlaliswa kwaBantu eFree State yanikezwa inkampani iBlackhead Consulting, ukuze ihlaziye, ihlole futhi ikhiphe uphahla lwe-asbestos ezindlini ezisezindaweni zabahlwempu eFree State, cishe eminyakeni eyisithupha edlule.Icala lizobuyela enkantolo ngomhla ka14 Juni lapho kuzokwethulwa izendlalelo zokuqulwa kwecala. IHHOVISI likaMengameli lithi awehle amaphaphu asisibi isimo kuNgqongqoshe kaGesi uDkt Kgosientsho Ramakgopa owehlelwe yingozi yemoto.IHhovisi likaMengameli lithi uRamakgopa ube sengozini ephuma eNorth West eya eGauteng nabaqaphi bakhe. Isitatimende sikhomba ukuthi nakuba ithintekile imoto ebinongqongqoshe kodwa akalimalanga."Bonke abebesemotweni baphuthunyiswe esibhedlela beyoxilongwa kodwa uNgqongqoshe udedeliwe akalaliswanga esibhedlela,’’ kusho isitatimende.Bathe uNgqongqoshe usesimeni esikahle futhi ufisele bonke abathintekile ukululama ngokushesha. Izikhulu zikahulumeni ezigadwayo sezivamile ukuba sezingozini zomgwaqo. Owayeyiphini likamengameli uMnuz David Mabuza waphuma kukubi emotweni ehlelwe yingozi.Owayengumengameli uJacob Zuma usanda kuba sengozini yemoto lapho omunye umshayeli kuthiwa washayisa izimoto zakhe. Lo mshayeli waboshwa wavela enkantolo ngecala lokushayela budlabha.UDkt Ramakgopa uqokelwe esikhundleni ngoMashi ngonyaka odlule kwathiwa uzobhekana ngqo nenkinga kagesi.Kwaba nomsindo omkhulu ngokuqokwa kwakhe amaqembu aphikisayo ethi kwandiswa ongqongqoshe mahhala nje. Bekuqala emlandweni kahulumeni wakuleli ukuthi kube nongqongqoshe kagesi.Kwenzeka konke lokhu nje kusanconywa ukuthi ukucinywa kukagesi kusamile.

UKHETHO lukazwelonke olubhekwe ngabomvu luveze ukuthi abesifazane basashaywa ngesithende uma kukhulunywa ngezikhundla eziqavile zokuhola amaqembu. Amaqembu abophele isingqongqo samadoda sengathi kumbiwa ithuna.Uma uhamba emigwaqweni yakuleli kukancane ukubona ubuso bomuntu wesifazane kukhankaswa ngabo ezingqwembeni zamaqembu.Ulokhu ukhangwa ngamadoda nje, cishe kuzo zonke izingqwembe bese uzibuza ukuthi ngabe kudalwa yini lokhu.I-ANC ihlasela ngoMengameli uCyril Ramaphosa njengoba kuyiwa okhethweni olubhekwe ngamehlo abomvu Isithombe: AYANDA NDAMANE/INDEPENDENT MEDIAINingizimu Afrika ilungiselela ukhetho lukazwelonke olubhekwe ngabomvu nolubekelwe uMeyi 29 nonyaka.Bangu-27.79 million abantu ababhalisele ukuvota kuleli ngokusho kwe-IEC. Lesi sibalo sinyuke kakhulu kusukela ngo-1994 kuqalwa ukuvotela intando yeningi.Cishe uhhafu walaba bantu abesifazane abhalisele ukuvota nokusho ukuthi amavoti amaningi angase avele kubona.Lokhu kusho ukuthi banombono noma bazimisele ngokubeka umbono ngokuphathwa kwezwe. Nakuba kunjalo kodwa bashaywa ngesithende uma kuza ezikhundleni ezimqoka.UMHOLI we-EFF uMnuz Julius Malema uhola umkhankaso we-EFF wokhetho lukazwelonke oluzoba ngenyanga ezayo Isithombe: SIGCINIWEAmaqembu amaningi asephumele obala ngokuthi wobani ahlasela ngabo abahola umkhankaso wokhetho nabazovela ezithombeni zawo.Uma kubhekwa nje amaqembu abukwa njengamakhulu kuleli cishe wonke agadla ngamadoda, abesifazane ababonwa. Inhlangano ebusayo i-ANC ihlasela ngoMengameli uCyril Ramaphosa okungumholi wayo.Selokhu kwaqalwa ukuvota ngokwentando yeningi kuleli i-ANC ayikaze ibe nomengameli wesifazane ehlasela ngaye uma ingenele ukhetho. I-ANC iyaye ithi ayicwasi ngobuhlanga nangobulili nanoma yingayiphi indlela, kodwa lokhu kubuye kungabonakali ezikhundleni.I-DA ephikisa ngokusemthethweni ihlasela ngoMnuz John Steenhuisen ongumholi wayo. Kukhona i-EFF ehlasela ngoMnuz Julius Malema naye ongumholi wayo. I-IFP ifolosa ngoMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa naye ongumholi wayo.I-DA yethembe umholi wayo uMnuz John Steenhuisen ngomkhankaso wokhetho lukazwelonke olubhekwe ngamehlo abomvu Isithombe : FACEBOOK/DEMOCRATIC ALLIANCEI-ActionSA eholwa wuMnuz Herman Mashaba ifolosa ngaye emkhankasweni wayo wokhetho.Kuvumbuke iqembu elisha uMkhonto weSizwe elesekwa wuMnuz Jacob Zuma nalo elihlasela ngaye njengokunguyena muntu ohola umkhankaso wayo.Amanye amaqembu asebamemezilile abantu agadla ngabo ezikhundleni zokuba wondunankulu bezifundazwe nakhona abesifazane abandile uma bekhona bayimithonseyana.Imihlahlandlela yokhetho nje ebiyethulwa bekulalelwe amadoda odwa esho izethembiso zokhetho, ekhongela amaqembu awo kubavoti bakuleli.Amaqembu amaningi anabo abesifazane asebenesipiliyoni, abamakhono nabafundile futhi abakhaliphe ngokwanele ukuthi bawahole.Bake bazame ukuyobayoba befuna ukuba sezikhundleni kodwa kucace ukuthi amadoda ami ngenhla.Izwe libhekene nenkinga yokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane nokuyinto okuliwa nayo nxazonke. Omunye angazibuza nje ukuthi ukushaywa ngesithende kwabesifazne, akudwebi yini isithombe sokuthi amadoda yiwona ongqo shishilizi?Akudwebi yini isithombe sokuthi abesifazane bacindezelekile. Kungabe amaqembu awakunakile yini lokhu noma awanandaba nakho?Lokhu kuvame ukubonakala ngisho amaqembu enezingqungquthela zokukhetha ubuholi, abesifazane abavamile ukunikwa izikhundla eziqavile njengokuba womengameli emaqenjini.Abesifazane baze baqale ukuvela ezikhundleni zamaphini alabo abasuke bekhethelwe kweziqavile.Baze babuye bavele uma sekujutshwa amalungu ePhalamende kodwa nakhona kuye ngokuya kwaba ngcono ngoba belwa.Uma amaqembu eneqiniso kuyofanele alubhekisise lolu daba ngoba lushiya imibuzo eminingi ngawo.
BABUYELA emabhentshini aseNkantolo eNkulu ePitoli abalisa abahlanu abasolwa ngokujuqa owayengunozinti uSenzo Meyiwa. UMeyiwa owayeyisilomo se-Orlando Pirates neBafana Bafana, wadutshulwa wabulawa ekubo kwentombi yakhe uKelly Khumalo ngo2014.UMbuso uthi abalisa abahlanu yibona abamkakisa okwenyamazane uMeyiwa ngobusuku kuka-Okthoba 26, 2014 eVosloorus, eGauteng. Abamangalelwa bonke bayawaphika onke amacala ababekwe wona.Icala lisesigabeni sokuqulwa lapho uMbuso uqhubeka khona nokubiza ofakazi bawo okholwa wukuthi bazosiza ukugojela abamangalelwa.Phambilini icala laguqa ukuze kunikwe abameli ithuba lokucubungula kahle bonke ubufakazi bese belungela ukuphosa imibuzo kofakazi boMbuso.
KUZOPHELA ukulinda amalayisensi okushayela umlibe njengoba iNingizimu Afrika isizoba nomshini omusha wokuwashicilela.Lezi zindaba zimenyezelwe wuNgqongqoshe wezokuThutha uNkk Sindisiwe Chikunga kuleli sonto."Izinhlelo zokuthenga umshini omusha wokushicilela amalayisensi okushayela sezizophothulwa. Silindele ukuthi uma kuphela le nyanga ube usukhona."Uzoqale uhlolwe ukuthi usebenza kahle yini lomshini olandwe eFrance,” kuchaza uNkk Chikunga.Uthe bazobe sebeshicilela amalayisensi amasha kule nyanga njengoba bezimisele ukuthi umshini omusha uqale ushicilele amalayisensi awu-100 kwisifundazwe ngasinye.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi ukushicilelwa kwamalayisensi bekubambezeleka ngenxa yokuthi umshini wokuwashicilela ubufa njalo.Lo mshini wawuthengwe eGermany ngo-1998, ubuthi uma ufile kume ukushicilelwa kwamalayisensi, kwazise izipele zokuwulungisa bezilandwa eGermany.Ngonyaka odlule uMnyango wezokuThutha wabika ukuthi awu-350 000 amalayisensi alinde ukushicilelwa njengoba umshini ubufa njalo.UMnuz Fikile Mbalula owayenguNgqongqoshe wezokuThutha waveza ukuthi izinsimbi zokuwulungisa azikho kuleli futhi naseGermany abasalusebenzisi lolu hlobo lomshini ukushicilela amalayisensi.Yikhona lokhu okwenza ukuthi uNkk Chikunga anqume ukuthenga umshini omusha wokushicilela amalayisensi.Uveze ukuthi amalayisensi amasha azohluka kakhulu kwamadala njengoba ezokwazi ukusebenza nakwamanye amazwe.
UZIZWA ethunazekile owesifazane waseNdwedwe osola umyeni wakhe ngokuthatha imali yakhe isinyenyela maqede wayolobola omunye wesifazane.UNksz Dudu Mzulwini (40) usola uMnuz Funimali Mthokozisi Chili (54) ngokuthatha imali yakhe wayozishaya zonke kowesifazane angamazi futhi angamtshelanga lutho ngaye. Laba ababaili kuthiwa bebehlala ndawonye emzini wabo oseNdwedwe.Lo wesifazane ubenemali ayikhokhelwe abesikhwama esibhekele abalimala ezingozini zomgwaqo kuleli, iRoad Accident Fund. Walimala engozini yemoto ngo-2018.Uthe wayenqume ukuthi imali ingene kwi-akhawunti yomyeni wakhe ngoba emethemba, kodwa uthi akwenzile uyokuxoxela amagwababa echobana.Uthi ubone ngezithombe ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ukuthi uChili kade eyolobola.''Ngikhulumile naye ngamtshela ukuthi ngiyayifuna imali yami. Wavuma ukuthi ulobole ngayo. Emva kwalokho ugcine esethi uzoyihlanganisa angikhokhele yona kancane kancane,'' echaza.Uthi umtshele emehlweni ukuthi bekumele ayisebenzisele ukulobola le mali ngoba iyona ebikhona. "Uthe angingakhathazeki uzongikhokhela uR5000 nyanga zonke ize ihlangane,’’ echaza.Lo wesifazane othi usephenduke inhlekisa nakubangani balo olotsholiwe ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, uzizwa engento yalutho kodwa kumcacele ukuthi umuntu ongamboni kakhulu, wumyeni wakhe.''Angifuni ukuqamba amanga, ingihlukumezile kakhulu lento emoyeni wami. Ngiyazibuza ngiyaziphendula ukuthi ingampela le ndoda ngiyenzeni ukuthi isingaze ingizwise ubuhlungu obunjengalobu."Mina ngihlela izinto ezibalulekile ngemali ngala kanti yena ungihleka usulu,'' ebalisa.Uveze ukuthi bese beneminyaka engu-8 bendawonye noChili.Lo wesifazane uthe usekhethe ukumane amshiye uChili, amchaza njengowesilisa ongumhlukumezi ongabahloniphi abantu besifazane.Kumanje uthi usenqume ukumshiya uChili ngoba akaboni ukuthi uyoke akwazi ukuxola. Uthe wenza lokhu nje ubevele engamphethe kahle, emhlukumeza ngokumshaya.Uthe sekucacile ukuthi kanti nokumphatha kabi kangaka bese kwenziwa nawukuthi kugida uthando lwalo wesifazane enhliziyweni yakhe.Ethintwa uChili uvumile ukuthi kade eyolobola isinqandamathe sakhe, kodwa waphika ukuthi usebenzise imali yomunye unkosikazi ukuze alobole lena yesibili."Ayikho leyonto, uqamba amanga bengingeke ngiyenze into enjengaleyo,'' usho kanje.Ube esekhala ngokuthi usendaweni embi akakwazi ukukhuluma kahle wacela ukuthi intatheli ibuye imthinte ngakusasa. Emva kwalokho akabange esatholakala.ISolezwe Ngempelasonto litholile ngomthombo osondelene nalaba ababili ukuthi uChili unamanye amakhosikazi amathathu awalobola, kodwa wahlukana nawo emsola ngokuwahlukumeza.
IJAJI lincome ubuchwepheshe besimanje ngesikhathi lehlulela ecaleni elithweswe unesi osolwa ngokuthenga izinkabi ukuba zithumbe futhi zibulale umyeni wakhe ongunjiniyela.Lithe ubufakazi obuqoqwe uMbuso busebenzisa i-tracker yezimoto, izingcingo nemiyalezo eqoshiwe ukubandakanya abamangalelwa ecaleni.Ijaji elibambile uSolwazi Bonke Dumisa belikade lehlulela ecaleni lokubulawa kukaMnuz Nkosi Langa owayengunjiniyela kwaTransnet.Wathunjwa kwakhe ePinetown ngoSepthemba 29, 2020 wabulawa ngalobo busuku, isidumbu sakhe satholwa ngoNovemba waloyo nyaka sesonakele ehlathini oZwathini, eNdwedwe.Kwaboshwa unkosikazi wakhe ongunesi ogqigqa icala, uNksz Mpumelelo Goncalves, wabekwa icala lokuthumba, ukubulala okuhleliwe, ukuphanga kusetshenziswa indlakadla namabili okuphazamisa ukusebenza komthetho.Waboshwa kanye nomfowabo uMnuz Nkosinathi Zungu abagqigqa naye inkantolo.UJames Mashudu Mthimkhulu walivuma icala wagwetshwa iminyaka engu-20 waphenduka ufakazi woMbuso.USol Dumisa uze wathi uzithola elalele leli cala ngenxa yobufakazi obuningi obuqoqwe uMbuso usebenzisa ubuchwepheshe besimanje.Uze wafunda ubufakazi obethulwa uchwepheshe wakwaStandard Bank mayelana nokuthunyelwa kwemali ngendlela esheshayo."'Lo fakazi waveza izinkokhelo lapho ummangalelwa wesibili okusolakala ukuthi wayethumelela uMthimkhulu imali ngemuva kokuba esebulele umufi,’’ kuchaza uDumisa.Ugcizelele ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bezingcingo eziqoshiwe, imiqhafazo, i-tracker nobasemabhange budlale indima enkulu ekuzameni ukuthola iqiniso ngokwenzeka.Unkosikazi kuthiwa uyena osolwa ngokuba wungqondongqondo ekubopheni itulo lokubulala, elokuthumba nanokuthi uma sekudayiswa iveni likamufi kumele bakhiphe i-tracker bayilahle.Kuthiwa wayesho ukuthi uma ingase itholakale le veni kungabe kusho ukuthi kuphelile ngabo.Ebufakazini uDumisa asebuthintile kukhona nobukaMnuz Siyabonga Mbedu.UMbedu wayengumuntu wesithathu ukuba adayiselwe iveni kamufi eyayingadayiseki kanti uzoshiya umazisi wakhe phakathi. Watholwa ngamaphoyisa eMgungundlovu kuleliveni, eyayishiywe dengwane.Kubikwa ukuthi amaphoyisa awuthatha umazisi acinga ngawo uMbedu owafonelwa wabizelwa esiteshini samaphoyisa sasePinetown lapho afike waboshwa khona.Kuvela ukuthi wabe esechaza konke ayekwazi nokuthi uLanga ubulewe walahlwa ehlathini oZwathini, eNdwedwe. Amaphoyisa kuthiwa abe esethungatha futhi abopha abathintekayo. UMashudu wathi nguye noZungu abaklinya ngentambo ye-ayina uLanga wafa. Ngaphambi kokuthi abulawe uLanga kuthiwa wacela ukuba bamkhulule kodwa kwakhona abathi awusale usuqedelwa umsebenzi owase uqaliwe.Kuyaqhubeka ukwahlulela namuhla.

UNOBHALA-Jikelele we-EFF uMnuz Marshall Dlamini ulahlwe yicala lokushaya iphoyisa ngempama emcimbini wenkulumo kamengameli ebhekiswe ezweni ngo-2019. Ngeke ngisule esikhundleni sami sokuba nguNgqongqoshe weMfundo ePhakeme nokuQeqesha ngenxa yezinkinga zeNational Students’ Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS). Lokhu kushiwo nguDkt Blade Nzimande, othe lawo maqembu ezepolitiki amfuna ehambile kumele azi ukuthi akayi ndawo. UNzimande obekhuluma nabezindaba izolo, eTshwane, ngokuzokwenzeka kulandela ukuhlakazwa kwebhodi lalesi sikhwama, uthe uyazi amaqembu afana ne-DA, EFF, Umkhonto weSizwe Party namanye, amfuna ehambile."Ngibonga ukuthi angiqashiwe ibona. Ngizosulelani? Ngisule ekubeni ngikhulise imali esikhwameni iNSFAS. Badlala ipolitiki uma bethi angihambe, angikhethwanga ibona. Ngelanga okuyophatha ngayo i-DA ngiyosula. Angiyi ndawo ngoba asikho isidingo sokuthi ngisule ngenxa yokuthi i-DA namanye amaqembu athi angihambe.” Usho lokhu nje, la maqembu athi akahambe ngoba usehlulekile.UNzimande wehlise amaphaphu kulabo abacabanga ukuthi ngeke bayithole imihlomulo yabo ngoba sekuhlakazwe ibhodi.UNGQONGQOSHE weMfundo ePhakeme nokuQeqesha, uDkt Blade Nzimande, othi ngeke asule esikhundleni sakhe kulo mnyango ngoba kunekhwelo elivela emaqenjini aphikisayo Isithombe: Ntswe Mokoena/GCIS"Kukhona abangabazayo ukuthi njengoba sekuhlakazwe ibhodi, ngabe imali yabo basazoyithola yini. Ngifuna ukuqinisekisa izitshudeni nabantu bakuleli ukuthi yonke imihlomulo izokhokhwa. Nabahlinzeka ngezindawo zokuhlala bazokhokhelwa njengoba kuhleliwe. Sihlakaze ibhodi ngoba silungisa izinto, akukho okuzoshintsha, sizoqhubeka njengoba sihlelile,” kusho uNzimande.
SIYANDA isibalo sabafundi ababhala izivivinyo zika-matric besezibhedlela ngoba begula noma bekhulelwe.Lokhu kuvezwe nguNgqongqoshe weMfundo eyisiSekelo uNkk Angie Motshekga, ephendula umbuzo welungu le-DA uNksz Samantha Jane Graham, obebuze ukuthi kusuka ngo-2020, bangaki ababhale lizivivinyo besezibhedlela.Ubuze nokuthi ngabe kukhona yini umfundi oke wanqatshelwa ukubhala ngoba esesibhedlela.UNkk Motshekga uveze ukuthi ngo-2020 bangu-85 ababhala izivivinyo besezibhedlela."Ngo-2021 bangu-140, kwathi ngo-2022 baba ngu-150 kanti ngo-2023 bangu-209 ababhalele ezibhedlela. Imigomo ethinta ukubhalwa kwezivivinyo zika-matric iyavuma ukuthi umfundi abhaliswe noma egula uma engeke akwazi ukuziyela ngqo esikhungweni sokubhalela.” Uthe amantombazane akhulelwe ayabhaliselwa ezibhedlela uma engaphilile."Lo mfundi kudingeka ukuthi umzali wakhe afake isicelo enhlokweni yomnyango wezemfundo, ukuthi abhalele esibhedlela. Isicelo kumele silethwe nencwadi kadokotela eveza ukuthi umfundi angakwazi ukubhala futhi angamelana nengcindezi ehambisana nezivivinyo,” kusho uNkk Motshekga. Uthe uma inhloko yomnyango isisigunyazile lesi sicelo, kumele kube nemigomo elandelwayo."Kuzoqokwa umuntu ozomgada uma ebhala, ozoqhamuka ehhovisi lesifunda. Ihhovisi lesifunda kumele libheke isimo sesibhedlela ukuthi umfundi angakwazi ukubhala izivivinyo zakhe. Okubalulekile ngukuthi lapho ezobhalela khona kumele lelo gumbi liqhele nalapho kukhona khona ezinye iziguli, kuqiniswe nezokuphepha.” Uthe ozobe egadile kumele alandele imigomo uma ehambisa noma eselanda amaphepha okubhala.Uveze ukuthi kumele abekwe ngendlela ezohambisana nalawo asesikhungweni obekumele abhalele kusona."Asikaze sibikelwe ukuthi kukhona umfundi owagcina engabhalanga nakuba isicelo sakhe sasigunyaziwe sokubhalela esibhedlela. Uma kungukuthi sikhona isehlakalo esifuze lesi sicela ukubikelwa ngaso ukuze siphenye, bese sithatha izinyathelo ezifanele,” kusho uNkk Motshekga.Uthe uma kukhona isehlakalo esifuze lesi sizobe sifana nokungawenzi umsebenzi kwalabo abanikwe umyalelo ngumnyango.Umnyango unemigomo ekhishelwe izikole ebalula ukuthi umfundi okhulelwe akangaxoshwa.Kule migomo equkethwe emthethweni iBasic Education Laws Amendment Bill, ibalula ukuthi umfundi okhulelwe kumele asekwe ngezinto zokufunda aze abelethe.Uma esebelethile kumele abuyele esikoleni ngokushesha azoqhubeka nezifundo zakhe.Umnyango ukwenza lokhu ngoba ungafuni kube nabafundi abazogcina sebelaxaza isikole bengaqedanga.
INHLANGANO ebhekelele ukuphepha komphakathi, i-Institute for Security Studies, ithi ikhathazekile ngezigameko zokuqothwa kwabasolwa ezigamekweni ezahlukene okubukeka kudla lubi kulezi zinsuku, okushayelwa ihlombe ngabantu abaningi.Esigamekweni sakamuva esenzeke ngesonto eledlule eDesai, eMariannhill amaphoyisa aqothe abasolwa abayisishiyagalolunye abaneminyaka ephakathi kuka-18 no- 23, kanti lokhu kushiye amalungu omphakathi enconcoza njengoba kuthiwa abewuhlalise lubhojozi.UMnuz Gareth Newham oyiNhloko oPhikweni lweZobulungiswa kanye Nokunqandwa koDlame kule nhlangano ephendula imibuzo yeSolezwe, uthe nakuba amaphoyisa enelungelo lokudubula uma ebhekene nobungozi, kodwa izigameko zakamuva zokuqothwa kwabasolwa ngamaphoyisa, zishayisa amakhala."Lokhu kuveza ukuthi amaphoyisa awanabo ubuhlakani obudingekayo noma amaqhinga ahlelwe kahle okubopha abasolwa abasuke bendawonye."Uma bengabopha izigebengu, kungasiza ekubeni nolwazi ngazo nobunye ubugebengu ezibenzayo."Lokhu kungaqinisekisa ukuthi ubulungiswa buyenziwa kubagilwa, nokuthi okwawo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umthetho uyalandelwa,” usho kanje.Ephawula ngesigameko saseMariannhill, uthe ngokwezibhamu okuthiwa zatholwa endaweni yesigameko (amaphoyisa aqinisekisa ukuthi zine), kuyakhombisa ukuthi iningi labasolwa ababulewe belingahlomile. Uveze ukuthi ukudubulana phakathi kwamaphoyisa nezigebengu, kuphinde kube yingozi kakhulu kubantu abasuke bezimele nje bengahlangene nokuqhubekayo."Uma amaphoyisa engazobonakala njengabantu abamele ukulandelwa komthetho kodwa ababulali, kuzokwenza umsebenzi wawo ubeyingozi kakhulu njengoba izigebengu zizowadubula uma ziwabona noma ziwahlasele,” usho kanje.Unxuse iziphathimandla emaphoyiseni ukuthi zithathe izinyathelo ukuqonda ukuthi kungani amaphoyisa aqeqeshwe ngezinga eliphezulu kangaka engabophi uma ebhekene nezigebengu, kodwa kube nokudubulana okuholela ekufeni kwabantu abasuke bengahlomile.Emngcwabeni wephoyisa elidutshulwe lisemsebenzini uSergeant Sibongiseni Khoza obusoThongathi ngoMgqibelo, uNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa kuleli uMnuz Bheki Cele ugcizelele ukuthi amaphoyisa awadubule uma ebhekene nezigebengu ezidubula zibhekise kuwo uma enza umsebenzi wawo.Kwenzeka lokhu nje, amaphoyisa abesanda kucoboshisa abasolwa ngokuba yizinkabi, abathathu esigamekweni esenzeke eShowe ngeledlule.Kanti ngoFebhuwari, amaphoyisa adubule abasolwa abayisithupha okuthiwa badubula kuqala, esigamekweni esenzeke eNanda.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uColonel Robert Netshiunda uthe bangu- 9 522 abasolwa asebeboshwe ngamaphoyisa esifundazweni, ngamacala ahlukene kule nyanga nje kuphela. Uveze ukuthi zingu-258 izibhamu ezingekho emthethweni eziqoqiwe nezinhlamvu ezingu- 3000.

INHLANGANO yokhetho kuleli i-IEC, ithi ifuna lulalelwe yiNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo udaba lombango wokungena kukaMnuz Jacob Zuma ohlwini lwabaya ePhalamende.I-IEC ithe lolu daba ifisa lungene eNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo ngqo, lungaqali kwenye indawo futhi lube ngoluphuthumayo. Iveze ukuthi ifisa lusombululwe ngaphambi kosuku lokhetho.Izwe lilungiselela ukhetho lukahulumeni kazwelonke oluzoba ngoMeyi 29 nonyaka lapho okulindeleke ukuthi zidlane khona imilala.INkantolo yoMthethosisekelo kuleli kuba yiyona eyokugcina enquma ngezindaba ezisuke zibangwa futhi kuyona kukhona inhloko yamajaji nephini layo namanye amajaji amakhulu.I-IEC isanda kugqemeka ingozi engeqiwa ntwala, ilahlwa yinkantolo odabeni lombango wokungena kukaZuma ohlwini lwabaya ePhalamende.UZuma ngoDisemba nyakenye umemezele ukuthi usejoyine iqembu elisha uMkhonto weSizwe, walaxaza i-ANC.UMkhonto weSiwe umemezele ukuthi uhlasela ngoZuma kwesikamengameli futhi uphezulu ohlwini.I-IEC emuva kwalokho yamemezela ukuthi uZuma ngeke akwazi ukungena ohlwini ngoba uke walahlwa yicala wagwetshwa izinyanga ezingu-15 futhi wangakhokhiswa inhlawulo.UMkhonto weSizwe walufaka enkantolo udaba uphosela inselelo isinqumo se-IEC, amajaji afika alivuna iqembu.I-IEC emuva kwesinqumo ithe isalinde ukuthi amajaji akhiphe incazelo ngesinqumo sawo.I-IEC ithe inqume ukulwedlulisa udaba ngoba ilubona luphuthuma futhi uma lungase luyekwe, luzothunaza imiphumela yokhetho.AboMkhonto weSizwe bakhiphe isitatimende bethi kufanele uKhomishana we-IEC, uJanet Love esule esikhundleni ngoba ubukeka elubhedlile lolu daba lukaZuma. Bathe ngeke besamethemba ukuthi usebenza ngobuqotho.
UNGQONGQOSHE wamaPhoyisa uMnuz Bheki Cele usole isifundazwe iKwaZulu-Natal njengesikhiqiza izinkabi ezithunyelwa ezindaweni ezehlukene zibulale abantu.UCele usho lokhu ngesikhathi ehlanganyele nezinduna zamahostela ahlukene eSoweto eGoli ngoMgqibelo. Uthe lesi sifundazwe sesidume kabi, kwaziwa ukuthi kutholakala kusona izinkabi ezithengwa ngamanani ahlukene.Lo ngqongqoshe wenze isibonelo ngoFisokuhle Ntuli, insizwa yaKwaNongoma eyagwetshwa odilikajele abayisithupha neminyaka engu-39 ngaphezulu ngamacala okubulala osomatekisi namakhansela.UNtuli uyathinteka ecaleni lokubulawa kukanozinti we-Orlando Pirates uSenzo Meyiwa kanti leli cala lisaqulwa enkantolo."Kukhona abanye abaseShowe ababulala umuntu eKapa bengenayo nemoto yokubaleka bahamba bayogibela itekisi, babanjwe bebathathu besetekisini. ETembisa, kwabulawa itshitshi elingunesi, kulelo cala kuboshwe abantu abayisithupha, bonke labo bantu ngabaseMnambithi,” kusho uCele etshela izinduna.Uthe akakususeli ekhanda lokhu akushoyo kodwa kukhuluma ubufakazi bombiko wamacala nabantu ababoshwayo ngamacala enziwayo.Uthe kumphatha kabi ukwanda kwabantu ababulawa ngokuthengelwa izinkabi nokuthi kubonakala sengathi lobu bugebengu buxhaswe ngemali eshisiwe. Izinkabi ziqotha kwasani ezindaweni ezehlukene kusukela kosopolitiki, osomatekisi, abantu abathola nabafuna amathenda nemisebenzi komasipala abahlukene.
ISOUTH African Health Products Regulatory Authority (Sahpra) isihoxise umuthi wesifuba wezingane, iBenylin Paediatric Syrup, emuva kokuthola ukuthi inobuthi obuyingozi.Esitatimendeni sabezindaba, iSahpra ithe ithole umbiko kwiNigerian National Agency for Food and Drug Administration and Control (Nafdac), owaveza ukuthi iBenylin Paediatric Syrup inezinga eliphezulu le-diethylene glycol. ISahpra ithe idiethylene glycol ingadala izinhlungu esinyeni, ukuphalaza, ukukhishwa yisisu, ingenza oyiphuzile angakwazi ukuchama, aphathwe yikhanda, angathathi kahle engqondweni, konakale izinso noma ashone.Kuthiwa idiethylene glycol isetshenziswa emikhiqizweni ehlukene okubalwa i-antifreeze, brake fluid, kugwayi nakodayi.ISahpra ithe ithinte iKenvue (ebiayiwa ngeJohnson and Johnson) emuba kokuthola umbiko waseNigeria, ukuthola ukuthi kwenzekani kwase kuvunyelwana ukuthi imithi ethintekayo mayibuyiswe.Imithi yakwaBenylin ebuyiswayo ibonakala nge-batch number ewu-329304 newu 329303.ISahpra ithe le mithi itholakala kakhulu eNingizimu Afrika, Swatini, Rwanda, Kenya, Tanzania naseNigeria.IBenylin Paediatric iwumuthi wezingane onombala obomvu onukisa okwe-rasberry, usiza uma ingane inomkhuhlane, icinene noma nokunye nje okuphathelene nesifuba.ISahpra icele abantu ukuthi bangathuki ngoba lolu daba lusetshenzwa ngamandla futhi abakhiqiza le mithi banemvume yokwenza lo msebenzi.Ithe imithi ethintekayo yilena enama-batch namba abhalwe ngenhla ngakho kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi uwabhekisise kahle, ungathuki.Icele izikhungo zempilo nodokotela ukuthi bayibuyisele emuva imithi ethintekayo.Ukubuyiselwa kwalo muthi kufakwe njengo-class 1, okuyisigaba esisetshenziswa yiSahpra uma ikhathazekile ngomuthi osemakethe ongaba yingozi kubantu.ISahpra icele abaphuze le mithi base beba nezinkinga ukuthi baphuthume kodokotela nasezikhungweni zempilo. Kuthiwa kufanele babike ngokusebenzisa i-Med Safety App noma bathumele i-email ku- [email protected].
UCWANINGO lwakamuva luveza ukuthi inhlangano ekhankaselwa owayengumengameli, uJacob Zuma, iMK isemathubeni okunqoba iKwaZulu-Natal okhethweni oluzayo.Ucwaningo lweSocial Research Foundation luveza ukuthi iMK ingazidlela amahlanga kulesifundazwe esibhekwe ngabomvu uma ukhetho lwangenyanga ezayo lungabanjwa manje.Umbiko uthole ukuthi iMK angeke ithole izihlalo ezanele ukuthi ibuse ngokuzimela iKwaZulu-Natal. Ngokocwaningo, iMK izothola u-26% wamavoti.IMK ibilokhu ikhombisa ukudlondlobala KwaZulu-Natal selokhu uZuma aqala ukuyikhankasela, ibiyenza kahle ezinkethweni zokuchibiyela ezingenelile.Ucwaningo luveze ukuthi iDA izolala isibili KwaZulu-Natal, ngamavoti angu-20%.I-ANC ne-IFP balandela ngemumva ngamavoti angaphnasi kuka-20%.Umhlaziyi wezepolitiki ozimele, uMnuz Thabani Khumalo, uthe okutholwe wucwaningo, kucishe kuhambisane nesasasa elibonakala ezindaweni ezahlukene KwaZulu-Natal.UKhumalo uthe nakuba evumelana nokuthi iMK izokwenza kahle KwaZulu-Natal, ubona i-IFP kuyiyo ezowashaya emakhanda amaqembu agaqele lesi sifundazwe.I-IFP yiyona enqobe iningi lezinketho zokuchibiyela ezibe khona KwaZulu-Natal emva kokhetho lohulumeni basekhaya lwango-2021."IMK ngibona izolandela emva kwe-IFP. Bobabili I-IFP neMK yiwona maqembu engiwabona ezohlabana ngempela KwaZulu-Natal,” kuso uKhumalo.Uthe okulekelela kakhulu umkhankaso weMK KwaZulu-Natal wugazi lukaZuma.Udalule ukuthi uZuma ngesikhathi eqokwa ukuba abe ngumengameli we-ANC, isibalo sabantu abajoyina i-ANC KwaZulu-Natal sanyuka cishe ngo-50%. Uthi i-ANC yajoyinwa ngisho abantu ababengayithandi ngesikhathi isaphethwe uMandela (uDkt Nelson), umuntu owayethandwa kangaka.Labantu bangabalandeli bakaZuma bokuqina. Njengoba uZuma esehamba neMK, kusho ukuthi uzoxebula cishe u-50% wamalungu e-ANC KwaZulu-Natal.UKhumalo uthe ubona iKwaZulu-Natal izophathwa ngokubambisana i-IFP neDA emva kokhetho.Lamaqembu aphethe ngokubambisana omasipala baKwaZulu-Natal, futhi womabili ayingxenye yamaqembu anesivumelwano sokusebenzisana emva kokhetho."Lamaqembu avele ayasebenzisana, ngakho kuzokuba lula okwawo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi i-ANC ne-EFF sebezamile, behluleka ukusebenzisana,” kuqhuba uKhumalo.Ucwaningo luveze ukuthi iMK izokuba yiqembu lesithathu ngobukhulu kuzwelonke.Lolu cwaningo lwenziwe ezifundazweni ezintathu, iKwaZulu-Natal, Gauteng, naseWestern Cape.AbeSocial Research Foundation baxoxe nabantu abangaphezu kuka-1 200 kulezifundazwe ezintathu.Ucwaningo luveze ukuthi i-ANC izokwehla kuzwelonke ithole u-37%, iDA izothola u-25%, iMK ithole u-14%.I-EFF izothola u-11%, i-IFP izothola u-5%, i-ActionSA ithole u-2%.Luqhubeka luveze ukuthi iDA isazoqhubeka nokuzidlela amahlanga eWestern Cape, lwayibeka ku-58%, ilandelwa i-ANC okuthiwa izothola ngaphansi kuka-20%.AbeSocial Research Foundation bathe ucwaningo lwabo lukhombisa ukuthi kuzokuba nohulumeni wokubambisana KwaZulu-Natal naseGauteng."Kungase kudingeke ukuthi kubambisane amaqembu angaphezu kwamathathu ukubusa kulezifundazwe. "Maningi amathuba okuthi amaqembu azobusa ngokubambisana kulezifundazwe kube yiwo futhi nakuzwelonke,” kusho umbiko.
ZIKLANYWE ziklanyiwe njengoba konke sekulele kubavoti ukuthi bakhethe iqembu abalijuba ePhalamende naseziShayamthetho zezifundazwe njengoba ikhomishini yezokhetho idedele uhlu lokugcina lamaqembu nabazongenela ukhetho lukazwelonke ngenyanga ezayo.Kulolu hlu kukhona namaqembu amasha azobe eqala ukubanga amavoti okhethweni lwangoMeyi 29. Abalelwa ngaphezu kuka-36 amaqembu azobe ebanga amavoti, ingxenye eningi yawo amaqembu amasha.Amanye azobanga amavoti kuzwelonke nasezifundazweni ezimbalwa, kuthi amanye angenela ukhetho ezweni lonke.Emaqenjini amasha kukhona amagama aziwayo, kanjalo nangaziwa noma angagqamile kakhulu.Phakathi kwangagqamile kubalwa iSizwe Ummah Nation, engenela ukhetho kuzwelonke naKwaZulu-Natal.Amanye amaqembu esifundazweni nakuzwelonke azobe engenela ukhetho okokuqala kubalwa iRise Mzansi, Economic Liberators Forum South Africa, All Citizens Party, Build One South Africa, Africa Restoration Alliance, Umkhonto weSizwe, African Content Movement, African Congress for Transformation. Amanye amaqembu kubalwa iSouth African Royal Kingdoms Organization, South African Rainbow Alliance, Xiluva neCitizens.Bangu-12 abangenela ukhetho ngokuzimela, kulaba uyedwa esifundazweni iKZN.Ikhomishini iveze ukuthi kudingeka amavoti abalelwa ku-43 000 esifundazweni ukuze uthole isihlalo esiShayamthetho, kuzwelonke abalelwa ku-80 000 kuye ngokuthi singakanani isibalo sabavotile.Kulol luhlu lokugcina eqenjini iMK olikhankaselayo owayengumengameli uJacob Zuma useqhulwini labazihola phambili kwabaya ePhalamende, kuthi indodakazi yakhe uNksz Duduzile yona ingunombolo 18 ohlwini lwasePhalamende.Omunye okhona iNkosi yesizwe samaKhoi-San, uDkt Glen Taaibosch, oke wabonakala enoZuma ngesikhathi kulalelwe icala enkantolo enkulu kuleli sonto ongunombolo 41 ohlwini lwasePhalamende.UZuma useke wakucacisa ukuthi akusho ukuthi ngoba usohlwini ukuthi uzothola isikhundla.Umkhulumeli waleli qembu, uMnuz Nhlamulo Ndhlela, yena ungunombolo 25, ohlwini lweMK lwasePhalamende.UZuma ungene ngembobo yenaliti njengoba evunwe yiNkantolo yezoKhetho ukuthi abuyiselwe ohlwini emuva kokuchithwa yikhomishini kulandela isikhalazo ngokuthi akumele abe yingxenye.Kwamanye amaqembu uhlu alushintshanga.Amaqembu angabonwa ohlwini kubalwa i-All Game Changers, eholwa yindodana kaZuma uDuduzane. UZuma wayethembise ukuthi uza nezinguquko ezinqala ezweni. Leli qembu likhishwe ohlwini yikhomishini ngoba lingalandelanga imigomo ebekiwe.
INKANTOLO eNkulu yaseMgungundlovu igwebe abane abalahlwe yicala lokubulala ngesihluku isihlobo somunye wabo, okuthiwa basishaya ngesagila ngaphambi kokusiklinya saze safa, sisolwa ngokuthakatha okwenza siphumelele sodwa emndenini, esigamekweni esenzeka ngo-2021.Inkantolo igwebe uSiyabonga Shelembe (37) udilikajele ngecala lokubulala ubabekazi wakhe uNksz Tholakele Cynthia Shelembe (53) okuthiwa wayemsola ngokuphehlela amalungu omndeni amanzi amnyama, okwenza aphumelele yedwa emndenini. Ugwetshwe nozakwabo okuthiwa wabanxenxa ukuthi bamlekelele ekubalaleni umgilwa okungoThobani Mkhize (23) naye onikezwe udilikajele ngecala lokubulala, kwathi uThandolwethu Sibisi wagwetshwa iminyaka engu-25, kuSiphelele Cele (21) yaba ngu-18 ngamacala okubamba inkunzi.Emva kokuthi inkantolo ilalele izethulo zabameli babamangalelwa isehlisile lesi sigwebo, njengoba kuvele enkantolo ukuthi babebancane ngeminyaka ngesikhathi kwenzeka icala futhi baxolisa emndenini wakwaShelembe ngokuwuzwisa ubuhlungu.UShelembe noMkhize banikezwe iminyaka engu-15 bebhadla ejele kwathi uCele noSibisi bagwetshwa eminyaka engu-10 nengu-12 ngokwehlukana.Kuthiwa uCele, uSibisi noMkhize basuka eMlaza baqonda eNyangwini kuMasipala Ugu, lapho babezohlangana khona noShelembe, owabatshela ngeqhinga lakhe lokubulala ubabekazi. Wabatshela ukuthi uma sebembulele, bathathe izimoto zakhe ezimbili okuyizona ababezozikhokhela ngazo ngomsebenzi ababezowenza.Kuthiwa bamhlasela ngesagila ababesinikwe uShelembe bamklinya ngaphambi kokuthi bathathe izimoto zakhe ezimbili bahambe nazo. Eyodwa kuthiwa bayishisa kwathi enye bayidayisa bahlukaniselana imali. Kuthiwa uShelembe waboshwa ngakusasa emva kokuthi ebonwe umuntu omaziyo owambona ngesikhathi kuthathwa izimoto zikababekazi wakhe, okuwuyena owakhipha abanye ayenabo.UMshushisi u-Advocate Nkonzo Mlotshwa uhole ubufakazi bomunye ufakazi owayenalaba ngesikhathi kwenziwa icala. Kuphinde kwafundwa isitatimende sendodakazi kaShelembe eveze ukuthi unina wayeyinsika emndenini. Imizamo yokuphonsela inselelo isinqumo senkantolo ukuthi kubuyekezwe isigwebo ayiphumelelanga.Okhulumela uphiko lwezokuShushiswa koMphakathi KwaZulu-Natal uNkk Natasha Ramkisson Kara uthe bayasemukela isigwebo."Siyathemba ukuthi sizothumela umyalezo oshubile kwabanentshisekelo yokwenza ubugebengu obufanayo. Sincoma umsebenza owenziwe yilolu phiko namaphoyisa,” usho kanje.
AMADODA ayisithupha asolwa ngokubulala obengumdlali weKaizer Chiefs, uLuke Fleurs, asazogqunywa esitokisini aze afake isicelo sebheyili ngesonto elizayo. Laba basolwa bebevele okokuqala eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseRoodepoort ngoLwesihlanu. ULuke (24) ubulawe ngokudutshulwa esigamekweni sokudunwa imoto eGoli ngesonto eledlule.UMUFI uLuke Fleur emi eduze kwemoto yakhe abulawelwe yona Isithombe:XLaba basolwa ngoNdumiso Moswane, Fernando Sive, Nhlakanipo Dlamini, Franky Xaba, Maredi Mphahlele noThembinkosi Hlomikhawu futhi bavele phambi kwenkantolo bengamelwe wumuntu.Enkantolo kuvele ukuthi abasolwa babekwe icala lokubulala, elokubamba inkunzi, elokutholakala nesibhamu nezinhlamvu ezingekho emthethweni nokukhohlisa ingalo yomthetho. Abasolwa, abaneminyaka ephakathi kuka-21 no-36, bafune ukunikezwa ummeli wamahhala futhi bahlose ukufaka isicelo sebheyili.UMbuso uthe uzosiphikisa isicelo sebheyili. Umshushisi wenkantolo u-Arnold Limekhaya utshele inkantolo ukuthi ubbuso usadinga imininingwane yebheyili, ukwazi kabanzi ngabasolwa nezitatimende zomphenyi wecala. Icala lihlehliselwe umhla ka-19 Ephreli ukuze kwenziwe uphenyo olunzulu futhi kufakwe kahle isicelo sebheyili. UFUNA umthetho udlale indima yawo umndeni wowesilisa waseMphumulo Mission KwaMaphumulo kulandela ukufa kwelungu lawo esibhedlela kade lishayiwe.UMnuz Ntobeko Mkhize (35) kuthiwa ushaywe abesilisa bendawo ngoMsombuluko, bamphuthumisa esibhedlela, washonela khona ngoLwesibili.Umalume wakhe uMnuz Thobekani Mkhize, uthe bathole ukuthi umufi wayezihlalele esitolo eMagenqezeni ngesikhathi abasolwa abaziwayo bemthatha ngesidlozane, baya naye esitolo sabo."Sithole ukuthi bamthatha ngemoto yabo, bafike bamshaya amahora amane kuya kwamahlanu. Kuthe sebebona ukuthi uselimele kakhulu, bamphuthumisa esibhedlela eMphumulo,” kulandisa uMkhize.Uqhube wathi bathole ukuthi ngesikhathi befika esibhedlela babhalise amagama aphelele kamufi, kodwa bathi umuntu abangamazi, abamcoshe elele eceleni komgwaqo elimele eMbitane."Ukuze sithole ngokufakwa kwakhe esibhedlela kusize ukuthi udadewethu usebenza khona. Uthe uma ezongena emsebenzini wazithela phezu kwakhe, wathi uma ebuza ukuthi kwenzekeni, amanesi athi ulethwe abantu abathe abamazi, bamsizile nje ngoba bembona elele eceleni kwendlela elimele,’ kusho uMkhize.Uthi udadewabo ubheke ifayela lakhe abambhalise ngalo, wathola ukuthi babhale amagama akhe enjengoba enjalo."Ubuze umbuzo wokuthi uma kungabantu abangamazi bawaze kanjani pho amagama akhe ngoba yena ubesesimweni esibi, engakwazi nokukhuluma,” usho kanje.Uqube wathi ngoLwesibili ekuseni, engakashoni umufi ukwazile ukutshela ilungu lomndeni elisebenza esibhedlela ukuthi ushaywe owesilisa wasesitolo nabangani bakhe."Sithe uma sesihlanganisa inkulumo kamufi, ubufakazi bokubhaliswa kwamagama aphelele akhe esibhedlela nobokuthi wathathwa ngesidlozane abantu abaziwayo, sabona ukuthi yibo abambulele,” kusho yena.Uveze ukuthi umufi emasontweni amabili edlule uke wazama ukugqekeza esitolo sabasolwa, wabanjwa engakebi.Uthi waxolisa, umndeni wakhona wenza sengathi umxolele."Uma sekwenzeka kanje, kusobala bebengaxolile. Sibuhlungu ngokuthi bakhethe ukuthi bavele bambulale. ”Sifisa umthetho udlale indima yawo ngoba ngeke sizithathele umthetho ngezandla,” kusho uMkhize.Ubuye wakhala nangokuthi bakhelene, bayazana, okwenzekile bebengakulindele.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uColonel Robert Netshiunda uthe amaphoyisa aKwaMaphumulo aphenya idokodo lokufa komuntu.
KUGQAME eyesidingo sokwakhiwa kwesiteshi samaphoyisa noma ukusondeza esingumahamba nendlwana kwaDesai eMariannhill nasezindaweni ezakhelene nayo, embizweni kaNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa uMnuz Bheki Cele, ebisehholo KwaMamdekazi.Embizweni okuthiwa bekuhloswe ngayo ukuzwa izikhalo zabantu bakule ndawo okuthiwa ubugebengu budla lubi kuyo, okugqame kakhulu kumalungu omphakathi abesukuma ededelana ebeka imibono nezikhalo, isidingo sokusondezwa kwesiteshi samaphoyisa okuzolekelela ekutheni abantu bakwazi ukubika eduze ngobugebengu ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kuliwa nabo.UCele ubesebuya okwesibili kule ndawo emuva kwesigameko esisewundabamlonyeni sokuqothwa kwabasolwa abayisishiyagalolunye abaneminyaka ephakathi kuka-18 no 23 okuthiwa bebehlalise kabi umphakathi wakule ndawo, okwenzeke ngesonto eledlule.UNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa uMnuz Bheki Cele ehambele eMariannhill lapho bekunembizo yomphakathi ngendaba yobugebengu Isithombe Doctor Ngcobo/ INDEPENDENT MEDIAUNksz Sindi Vilakazi waseZwelibomvu ukhale ngokuqhela kwesiteshi samaphoyisa esiKwaNdengezi ababika kuso."EZwelibomvu sinobugebengu obuningi kakhulu. Izingane ziyadutshulwa mhlawumbe uthole ukuthi umuntu udutshulwa ephuma emsebenzini akwaziwa ukuthi kwenziwe ubani. Sisebenzisa isiteshi samaphoyisa KwaNdengezi oke ufice ukuthi kwesinye isikhathi akukho muntu. Siyafisa nje ukuthi okungenani kufakwe noma esiwumahamba nendlwana okuzoqinisekisa ukutholakala kwamaphoyisa ngokushesha uma edingeka,” usho kanje.Isiteshi samaphoyisa esiseMariannhill esiyisakhiwo sesikhashana, kuthiwa sisebenzela iMariannhill yonke ngaphaphandle kwakaNdengenzi naseZwelibomvu. Izindawo ezibika kuso yi-Dassenhoek, Mpola, Tshelimnyama, Uganda, KwaSanti, Nazareth, Desai neNagina. Umphakathi ufuna kufakwe iziteshi ezingomahamba nendlwana kulezi zindawo.Kukhalwe ngamaphoyisa aseMariannhill, umphakathi owasola ngokungawenzi umsebenzi, ikakhulu abaphenyi bamacala okuthiwa abawalandeleli amanye amacala abikwa kubona.Ephendula ezikhalweni zomphakathi zomphakathi uCele, uqinisekise ukuthi indawo nemali yokwakhiwa kwesiteshi obekuyizinto ebezibambile, sekukhona, sekulele eMnyangweni weMisebenzi yoMphakathi."Iziteshi zamaphoyisa zazakhiwe umphakathi usemncane, ngakho asinalo ijubane lokwakha ngokushesha kuhambisane nokwanda kwawo. Akuyona inkinga yaseMariannhill kuphela, kodwa ikhona nakwezinye izindawo. Ziningi izindawo esenizibalile enifuna kube khona iziteshi ezingomahamba nendlwana, zizofakwa kodwa akuzona zonke izindawo ezizozithola. Isiteshi samaphoyisa obekudala nisicela, bekushoda imali nendawo esizokwakhiwa kuso. Sekukhona ke konke, sekusele ke ngaseMnyangweni wezeMisebenzi yoMphakathi,” usho kanje.Ngasohlangothini lokugxekwa kwamaphoyisa ngokungasebenzi, uthe kulo nyaka nje kuphela, amaphoyisa asebophe abasolwa abangu- 993, abawu-209 kubona baboshelwe izidakamizwa, abawu-33 baboshelwe ukubulala, bawu-33 baboshelwe amacala okudlwengula. Uthe zingu-15 izigameko ezenzekile zokudubulana kwamaphoyisa nezigebengu kule ndawo, kanti bangu-35 abasolwa abafe kuzona, zibe ngu-29 izibhamu ezithathwe amaphoyisa.Ngaphambi kokuqala kwembizo, uCele obehambisana noKhomishana wamaPhoyisa esifundazweni uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, uNdunankulu uNkk Nomusa Dube-Ncube uSomlomo kuMasipala weTheku uMnuz Thabani Nyawose nezikhulu zikahulumeni, bahlangane nabagilwa bobugebengu. UNkk Agnes Nzimande uvele wakhihla isililo eneka usizi lwakhe, uthe izigebengu zadubula indodana yakhe ebibondla, zangagcina lapho zamkhipha emzini wakhe manje usehlala ezihlotsheni."Umuzi wami bawucekele phansi, ngiyafisa ukubuyela kuwo. Ngicela uhulumeni angisize ngibuyele emzini wami,” kubalisa yena.UNkk Caroline Maphumulo uveze ukuthi ubugebengu badlula nomphefumulo wendodana yakhe eyayisanda kuqeda enyuvesi, seyifuna umsebenzi esenethemba lempilo engcono.
UKHIHLE esikaNandi enkantolo owayengumdlali weBanyana Banyana efakaza ngempilo enzima aseyiphila kusukela adlwengulwa, wagwazwa, wakhuthuzwa, washiywa kuthiwa ufile.Lona wesifazane othandana nobulili obufana nobakhe futhi elingeke lidalulwe igama lakhe ngoba ungumgilwa ecaleni elithinta ucansi, uchazele inkantolo yeMantshi yaseNtuzuma ngobunzima bempilo nokushabalala kwamaphupho akhe emuva kwalesi sigameko.Udalule ukuthi useyinhlekisa emphakathini waKwaMashu ngoba okwamehlela ebusuku ngoNovemba 29, 2020 kwamshiya engenalo iso.Uthe manje usegqoka izibuko ubusuku nemini kushisa noma kubanda.IMantshi N Sipunzi, igwebe uSandile Wiseman Nikwe (34) udilikajele ngecala lokudlwengula, iminyaka engu-10 ngecala lokuzama ukubulala neminye engu-10 ngelokuphanga kuhlonyiwe.Ukhishelwe umbandela othi akasakufanele ukuphinda aphathe isibhamu empilweni yakhe."Sengiyinhlekisa emphakathini abantu bangibiza ngamagama ngento engenzekanga ngokuthanda kwami. ”Ngangidlalela iBanyana neqembu lebhola esigabeni esikhokhelwayo eThekwini, kuyimina engondla umndeni wami."Ngangibizelwe ukuyokwenza inhlolokhono kwiMamelodi Sundowns Ladies kanti ngizoba neshwa ngidlwengulwe,” kuchaza umgilwa.Uqhube wathi okwamehlela kwamshiya nesilonda angakholwa ukuthi siyoke siphole.Ngesikhathi ethula ubufakazi ubekhala, uze wakhumula izibuko wakhipha neso lokufakelwa wabuka ngqo uNikwe, wambuza ukuthi amenza khona wayekwenziswa yini nokuthi wayehloseni ngakho?Uveze ukuthi ngesikhathi emdlwengula bejijimezana, uNikwe wathi, uyaqala ukuhlangana nesif%# esilwa kanje. Wambuza ukuthi kanti bangaki abanye aseke abenza into efana nalena. Ubuze nokuthi ziphi izimpahla zakhe aziphangwa uNikwe okuyibhulukwe elimnyama, i-anda, iwashi, iselula nophaqa okungatholakalanga? UNikwe uvele wabheka phansi, wathula du."Ngangingeke ngitholakale ukuba ngangintekenteke. Wangishiya odakeni, uzitshela ukuthi ungibulele. Wangigwaza amanxeba emqaleni engase ngiphefumula ngawo,” kusho umgilwa.UNikwe waboshwa ngoDisemba 4, 2020 wanqatshelwa ibheyili njengoba esebhadle iminyaka emine ezitokisini.Uwaphike kwaze kwaba sekugcineni amacala, wathi ubhecwa ngobubende inyama engayidlanga.Usole umgilwa wathi nguyena owayezifunela ucansi abalwenza bevumelene.Ukhombe ngenjumbane umgilwa wathi nguyena owayefuna ukumgwaza wabe eseyazivikela, ulandulile ukuthi zikhona izimpahla zikamufi azithatha.UMshushisi uNksz Shenola Sewbaran obekunguye obelusa ngemibuzo umgilwa, naye ubebonakala evukwa wumunyu echiphiza ngesikhathi (umgilwa) echazela inkantolo isimo sakhe.UNksz Sewbaran ubuye waveza ukuthi ukupheka ethulula abameli uNikwe, yikhona okubambezele ukuphothulwa kwecala wahlala sonke lesi sikhathi asesihlale esitokisini. Imantshi ibuhlabe yabuhlikiza ubufakazi bukaNikwe yathi bungamampunge, kodwa yamukela obukamgilwa obufakazelwe nayimibiko yodokotela ababili.Kuthiwa umgilwa wahlangana noNikwe ebusuku ngo-11 ngesikhathi eyobheka umngani wakhe.Kuvele ukuthi uNikwe wayazi ukuthi umgilwa udlala ibhola futhi uthandana nabobulili obufana nobakhe.Kuvele ukuthi uNikwe wadonsela umgilwa emseleni, bajijimezana wagcina ewile (umgilwa) wase emgwaza ngebhodlela emqaleni nasemhlane. Kuthiwa wabe esemdlwengula, maqede wamphanga izimpahla zakhe.Umgilwa utshele inkantolo ukuthi wasindiswa ukuthi wavele wazenza ofile okuyinto eyenza uNikwe wamshiya kanjalo ezitshela ukuthi ushonile.Uchaze ukuthi watibula waphuma exhaphozini ayeshiywe kulona, waphumela emgwaqweni wabonwa ngabantu abamphuthumisa emtholampilo.Uthi yilapho kwafika khona izihlobo zakhe wazilandisa ngokumehlele wachaza nokuthi uNikwe omdlwengulile.

ABHEKENE nomqansa amaqembu angenele ukhetho lukazwelonke ngoMeyi 29, 2024 KwaZulu-Natal njengoba kudingeka ukuthi athole amavoti abalelwa ku-43 000 kuya phezulu ukuze athole izihlalo esiShayamthetho sesifundazwe.Njengoba ohlwini lokuvota bengu-5.7 million esifundazweni ababhalisele ukuvota, uma bephuma ngothi lwabo ukuyovota lokhu kuyosho ukuthi sizonyuka kakhulu isibalo samavoti azodingeka njengoba engafinyelela nangaphezu kuka-50 000.Lokhu kuvezwe yisikhulu sekhomishini yezokhetho esifundazweni i-Independent Electoral Commission uNkk Ntomb’futhi Masinga, obekhuluma emcimbini weSanef izolo eThekwini.Uthe kuzwelonke kuzoba ngumqansa kakhulu ngoba cishe kudingeka amavoti abalelwa ku-80 000 ukuze uthole isihlalo.UNkk Masinga ungathekise ngokuthi uma kuvota u-60% wababhalisile esifundazweni, kuzodingeka ukuthi umuntu athole amavoti asuka ku-43 000 kuya phezulu. Lesi sibalo sifaka ngisho noyedwa ongenele ukhetho ngokuzimela eKZN."Uma sanda isibalo sabavoti lokho kuyosho ukuthi siyanda nesibalo samavoti adingekayo ukuze uthole isihlalo. "Uma sehla isibalo sabavoti sizokwehla nesibalo samavoti adingekayo ukuze uthole isihlalo,” kusho uNkk Masinga.Ezweni lonke bangu-12 abangenela ukhetho ngokuzimela njengoba kuzobe kuqala ukuthi kulolu khetho babe yingxenye yalolu khetho.UNkk Masinga uthe abalelwa ku-33 amaqembu azongenela ukhetho esifundazweni.Uveze nokuthi uma kwenzeka kuvuleka isikhala ePhalamende likazwelonke ngeke kube nokhetho lokuchibiyela njengoba kwenzeka, kodwa kuyofakwa igama lobelandela ngamavoti.Uveze ukuthi ngesonto elizayo kuzoba nomcimbi wokusayinwa kwesibopho kwamaqembu azongenela ukhetho ukuthi azohlonipha imigomo yalo.Lo mcimbi uzoba se-Inkosi AlbertLuthuli International Convention Centre eThekwini ngo-Ephreli 17. Uveze ukuthi azikho izindawo ezingo-alubhadwa abangakwazi ukufinyelela kuzona esifundazweni."Asiboni ukuthi kungafika esimweni sokuthi endaweni ethile size sithi sizohamba namasosha ukuya khona ngoba singakwazi ukungena."Sisebenzisana namaphoyisa nophiko lwezokuphepha esifundazweni olufaka namaqembu ahlukene ezepolitiki,” esho. Uthinte nodaba okuhlale kugxekwa ngalo ikhomishini lokuqasha othisha abangamalungu eSadtu.I-EFF isanda kukhala ngokuthi ayifuni kuqashwe amalungu ale nyunyana ngoba idlelana ne-ANC. "Awukho umthetho othi umuntu okwinyunyana akaqashwa ukusebenza ngesikhathi sokuvota. "Abangavumelekile yilabo abanezikhundla kwinyunyana kanti asikwazi ukubashiya ngaphandle othisha ngoba bewuSadtu."Sinalo uhlelo namaqembu ahlukene ne-EFF eyingxenye yalo lokuthi siwanike uhlu ukuze afake isikhalazo ngabasuke beqashiwe, kuphetha uNkk Masinga.

ZIZOJIKA izinto embukisweni omkhulukazi wemfashini eNingizimu Afrika, iSA Fashion Week, njengoba kwethulwa isigaba esibizwa nge-Walk Your Worth esizohlonipha abesifazane abenza izinto zenzeke emikhakheni ehlukene.Lo mbukiso, ozoba ngo-Ephreli 19 eMall of Africa, uza emuva kwesithangami sokucobelelana ngolwazi ebesisakazwa kwi-You Tube esibizwa ngeTalk Your Worth nayo ebikhiqizwa yi-L’Oréal Paris.Le nkampani yezimonyo isanda kumemezela umlingisi wakuleli ozinze phesheya, uThuso Mbedu, njengenxusa layo laseSub-Sahara Africa.Esitatimendeni esithunyelwe kwabezindaba, iL'Oréal Paris ithe kuzobe kukhangisa osaziwayo embukisweni we-Walk Your Worth okubalwa kubo uBonang Matheba, uMiss SA uNatasha Joubert noThembi Seete.Kulo mbukiso we-Walk Your Worth iL’Oréal Paris isebenzisana nelebuli yemfashini, iBiji La Maison de Couture, okuyiyona ezobe yenze imisiko esezingeni."Sengenze into engiyithandayo iminyaka ewu-30 futhi ngiyajabula ukuthi ngizobe ngisebenzisana neL’Oréal Paris ne-SA Fashion Week kulo mbukiso we-Walk Your Worth.
