UMPHATHISWA wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal uNkk Bongi Sithole - Moloi, ukhumbuze abantu ngobungozi bomlilo njengoba kungena ubusika nje.UMphathiswa ugcizelele lokhu ngesikhathi kunenkonzo yokukhumbula abaphangalala ngenxa yezinhlekelele nokuhlonipha abasebenzi balo mkhakha abazinikela ngezikhathi ezinzima.Umkhuleko ubusenkundleni yezemidlalo iZinkwazi, eMbali eMgungundlovu.Isifundazwe silahlekelwe yimiphefumulo yabantu abangu-90 ngenxa yezinhlekelele ezindaweni ezingaphansi kwaseThekwini, uMgungundlovu, Ilembe nasoThukela.Abantu abakhahlamezeka basala bengenazo izindawo zokuhlala, bathuthelwa emahholo.Kwakhahlamezeka nengqalasizinda okubalwa kuyona imigwaqo neyokuphakela amanzi namanje kwezinye izindawo kusenzima.Umkhuleko ubuthanyelwe yizinhlaka ezahlukene zamabandla abehlangene enxusa kuMdali ukuthi zehle izinhlekelele esifundazweni.UMphathiswa uthe lo mkhuleko bahlose ngawo ukukhumbula abangasekho, baphinde baxwayise ngobungozi bomlilo.'’Yingqayizivele yethuba le yokuthi sihlangane, sithandaze ndawonye. Siyabancoma kakhulu abasebenzi bezokutakula abasebenza ngokuzikhandla ezimweni ezinzima,’’ kusho uMphathiswa.Uthe njengoba ubusika busondela nje, abezinhlekelele bazobe bemi ngomumo ukwelekelela lapho bedingeka khona.UMphathiswa uthe uyazi ukuthi ebusika kuvame ukuthi kubikwe izigameko zomlilo ngenxa yokuthi kumakhaza abantu basuke bezifudumeza.
OWAYENGUMENGAMELI wezwe ne-ANC uMnuz Jacob Zuma, uthe bamatasa bavimba amankentshane azifaka ngenkani ezikhundleni zoMkhonto weSizwe aze asebenzise nemali.UZuma usho lokhu ekhuluma ngaphandle kweNkantolo eNkulu eGoli emuva kokuhlehla kwecala lokushushisa uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ngokuzimela. UZuma ukhale ngokusebenza komthetho wakuleli wathi unamehlo uyabona ukuthi yimuphi umuntu obhekene naye.Ukhale ngokuthi uRamaphosa akaze avele enkantolo kodwa kube kunezinsolo abhekene nazo zokufihla imali endlini. UZuma uthe yena ngesikhathi eseCuba amajaji athi amfuna la aze akhipha incwadi yokuthi aboshwe ebe engakaze ebe ngisho inaliti.Udaba abeze ngalo enkantolo lulalelwe kancane lwaguqela u-Agasti nonyaka.Ekhuluma nabalandeli beMK ngaphandle kwenkantolo, uZuma uthe njengoba behosha abaholi ezikhundleni yingoba bayakhuculula balungisa isimo.Uthe kukhona ngisho abasebenzisa imali abaphatha izibhamu ngoba bebuswa wogovane babo belobizela izikhundla. Uthe bonke labo bayaziwa bazokhishwa ngoba abafanelwe wukusebenzela umbutho." Kuthiwa kukhona nabasebenzisa imali, bonke labo siyabazi baze baphathe izibhamu bayiziqhwaga. Kukhona nezicagogwana zezinhlaka manje. Yingakho sizolokhu simemezela kancane kancane ukuthi siyabakhipha abantu ngoba asidlali la,’’ kusho uZuma.Uthe kukhona abazifake bona ohlwini lwabaya ePhalamende nabo bazokhishwa badalakacwe phandle." Labo ababanga izikhundla siyabazi abafuneki lapha ngoba savumelana ngezinhlaka zesikhashana. Sathi ngeke siqale sibize ingqungquthela okwamanje ngoba kuzosibambezela ukubanga izikhundla.’’ UZuma ukhuluma kanjena nje iqembu lakhe lisanda kumemezela ukudilizwa kobehola intsha uBonginkosi Khanyile nabanye abaholi. Kusolwa ukuthi badilizelwe ukungaziphathi kahle.UZuma uthe uma bebona ukuthi umuntu uhalela isikhundla ngeke afakwe nhlobo uyosizwa ngendaba ngoba bafuna abantu bazibonakalise ngemisebenzi.Uthe uhlu lwabo lwasePhalamende lusabhekwa kabanzi lulungiswe kusefwe abanye ngoba bafuna ukufaka amakhosi nabanye bezinye izinhlaka ukuze zimeleleke.UZuma ubenanelwa amakhwelo nemikikizo ekhuluma aze akhuze izaga zakhe zokubhinqa ahleke kancane.
UMKHANDLU wase-Unisa uvumelane ngo-elethu ngokuhlonipha ingwazi yomculo engasekho uRay Chikapa Phiri ngeziqu zobudokotela. URay Phiri owayehola iqembu lomculo iStimela, ushone ngoJulayi 2017 exinwe wumdlavuza eneminyaka ewu-70 ubudala.I-Unisa imemezele ukuthi le ngwazi engasekho izoyihlonipha emcimbini wokwethwesa izitshudeni iziqu obungoLwesihlanu, ePitoli.Bathe bakhethe ukumhlonipha ngenxa yamagalelo abe nawo emphakathini elwela inhlalakahle yomphakathi ngokubeka uvo kwezepolitiki esebenzisa umculo."Wayesiqonda kabanzi isimo sangaleso sikhathi ebheka izimo zezepolitiki ezweni waze waqopha izingoma ezikhuluma ngalokho ezifana nezithi Highland Drifter ngo1974."Uphinde waqopha ethi Whispers In the Deep/Phinda Mzala futhi zombili lezi zingoma zavalwa wuhulumeni wobandlululo,’’ kusho abase-Unisa.UPhiri uke wacula nengwazi yaphesheya e-America uPaul Simon ngo-1986 behlangene neLadysmith Black Mambazo ecwecweni elithi Graceland eladuma umhlaba wonke.UPhiri uhlonishwa yi-Unisa nje uke wahlonishwa ngezindondo ezehlukene phambili. Uke wahlonishwa wuhulumeni nge-Order of Ikamanga ngo-2011. Uke wahlonishwa ngeLifetime Achievement Award ngo-2012.Umlobi uDkt Tlou Setumu uke wahlonipha uRay Phiri ngencwadi enomlando wakhe ethi Singajindi Majita...Struggle and Musical Train Journey Ray Phiri
UMNYANGO wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal, uthi kuningi okwenzayo ukuze ulwe nokuthi izinkawu zizicanasele esibhedlela iRK Khan eChartsworth.UMnuz Ntokozo Maphisa okhulumela umnyango, uthe indawo isibhedlela esikuyo iChatsworth njengazo zonke izindawo ezakhele iTheku inezinkawu eziningi, kodwa umnyango kuningi osukwenzile ukuze ulwe nokuthi izinkawu zizingenele ngokuthanda esibhedlela ikakhulukazi emawodini alele iziguli." Umnyango ufisa ukuxwayisa noma ibaphi abantu abazama ukufaka ipolitiki noma ukubhebhethekisa lolu daba, benzela ukuthi kubonakale sengathi akukho osekwenziwe ukulawula lesi simo ngempumelelo, okungelona iqiniso," kusho uMaphisa.Usho kanjena nje kuleli sonto leli phephandaba lithunyelelwe izithombe nama-video akhombisa izinkawu zidla ukudla kweziguli zingaphakathi ewodini. Iziguli zithi zingena ngamafasitela ngoba ahlale evuliwe ngenxa yokushisa.Kuthiwa zivele zingene seziyiviyo zizitapele ekudleni kweziguli, abasanda kulaliswa emawodini kuthiwa bavele babaleke noma bazimboze ngamashidi.Inhlangano esiza umphakathi ukuze ukwazi ukuxosha izinkawu iMonkey Helpline, ithe abaphathi besibhedlela abazilaleli izeluleko zayo zokuthi kuhlale kunomuntu okungaba unesi ewodini ozobe ephethe ibhodlela elinamanzi eliputshuzwayo nokuthi kutshelwe imindeni ukuthi ingaletheli iziguli ukudla okuningi okuyikho okuheha izinkawu.
BAHLELI lubhojozi abantu baKwaDlangezwa eMpangeni abathi izigebengu zizenzela umathanda, zingena ezindlini zibambe inkunzi zibuye zidlwengule. Lokhu kuvezwe yilungu lomphakathi elicele ukuthi igama lalo lingadalulwa ngokwesabela impilo yalo.Lithe izigebengu zingena ezindlini zigcweleze abantu, kokunye zibahlasele bezihambela emgwaqweni.Liveze ukuthi kubo, izigebengu zingene kabili esontweni elilodwa zadala umonakalo ogcine udlula nomphefumulo womuntu, kwaba khona nodlwengulwayo."Ngo-Ephreli 4, zingene zashaya ilungu lomndeni ngensimbi, lashona ngoLwesihlanu,” kusho ilungu.Lilandisa ngokwenzeke ngosuku lwesigameko, lithe abasolwa bakhahlele isicabha sendlu kamufi maqede zambamba zambopha ngentambo, zamvala umlomo nge-salotape."Ziqoqe yonke impahla endlini, maqede zamqhuba ukuthi aye endlini elala ugogo. Nakhona zifike zamshaya ugogo zifuna ngodli imali, zazama nokumdlwengula,” kusho ilungu.Liqhube lathi umufi uhlaselwe khona lapho, washaywa ngensimbi ekhanda, walimala.Udalule ukuthi nasendlini elala ugogo ikhona impahla ethathiwe.Uthe umufi nakuba eyisiwe emtholampilo kodwa akalaliswanga, watishwa wadedelwa."Sibona ukuthi waba mkhulu umonakalo wokushaywa ngoba uvele wathulela embhedeni lapho abethi usazohlala khona izinsukwana ngenxa yokwanda kwezigameko zobugebengu,” kusho ilungu.Eqhubeka uveze ukuthi ngoMashi 31, kudlwengulwe ilungu lomndeni elineminyaka engu-14, kwathi elinye lahlukunyezwa ngokocansi.Kulesi sigameko, kuthiwa abagilwa babelele bodwa endlini enkulu ngesikhathi amanye amalungu omndeni esilisa asekhulakhulile, elele ezindlini zawo ezingaphandle."Babona ngabantu sebegcwele indlu, bebasabisa ngommese nangesibhamu abebekuphethe, bebatshela ukuthi uma beke bathi nkente, bazobabulala,” kusho ilungu.Lithe nakulesi sigameko kuphinde kwathathwa nezinye izimpahla.Liveze ukuthi bafuna kungenelele izinhlaka ezilwa nobugebengu nenkosi yendawo, ukuze kwehle ubugebengu.Kwenzeka lokhu nje nezitshudeni zaseNyuvesi yaseZululand (Ongoye) nazo zihlaliswe lubhojozi yizigebengu ezibizwa ngamadabuka ezeba kwasani.NgoLwesihlanu kubulawe obeqapha imiqasho okuhlala kuyo izitshudeni, kwabulawa lona wesilisa, kwebiwa ama-laptop namaselula.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa aseMthunzini asebophe owesilisa (43) ngecala lokugqekeza, elokudlwengula nawokuhlukumeza ngokocansi."Uvele ngo-Ephreli 2, icala lahlehliselwa u-Ephreli 9. Idokodo lidluliselwe ophikweni oluphenya amacala odlame lwasekhaya, ukuvikeleka kwezingane namacala ocansi eMpangeni,” kusho uNetshiunda.
INATIONAL Consumer Commission (NCC), okuyinhlangano elwela amalungelo abathengi kuleli, ithi isiqale uphenyo ngenkampani ebitshalisa abantu imali ezingulubeni ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, iPiggy Farm Trading.Uphenyo luza emuva kokuthi iNCC ithole izikhalo kubantu abangasayitholi imali ababethenjiswe yona yiPiggy Farm Trading.Le nkampani ibiheha abantu ezinkundleni zokuxhumama ithi inepulazi okufuywe kulo izingulube. Abantu bebethenga ingulube eyodwa ngoR2 750 bese bethenjiswa ukuthi bazokhokhelwa uR500 njalo ngenyanga kuze kuphele unyaka. Lokhu kusho ukuthi umuntu ubezoba no-R6 000 uma sekuphela unyaka.Ingulube ubengeke ayithole ngoba ibihlala epulazini, iPiggy Farm, njengoba bekuthiwa yibona abayiphakelayo, bayigome bayenze konke okuhlangene nezolimo.INCC ithe iPiggy Farm iyibhanoyi njengoba isebenza ngendlela efanayo namanye amabhanoyi, athembisa abantu inzalo engaphezulu ngo-20% kwimali mboleko."Sicela abantu bazi ukuthi ukutshala imali ebhanoyini kuyicala, akufanele futhi bakhuthaze nabanye ukuthi bangene kulo. Ucwaningo lwethu luveza ukuthi ayanda amabhanoyi asebenzisa ezolimo ukuheha abantu. Uma umuntu ethenga imfuyo kufanele ayibone, hhayi ukuthi athenge imfuyo engabonakali,” kusho iNCC esitatimendeni.Ithe abasungula amabhanoyi bazenza sengathi baphila kahle ngoba befuna ukuheha abantu abayisebenzele kanzima imali yabo.NgoLwesithathu uphiko lwezokushushisa lumemezele ukuthi lunegunya lokuvala i-akhawunti yePiggy Farm Trading enoR4.3 million njengoba luphenya okwenzeka kule nkampani.Elinye iphephandaba elibhala online libike ukuthi iNedbank ivale i-akhawunti yePiggy Farm Trading ebinoR16 million.Esitatimendeni ebesikhishiwe yiPiggy Farm Trading, ithe iyakuqonda ukukhathazeka kwabantu futhi iyazisukumela izikhalo zabo.Isolezwe lizamile ukushayela abePiggy Farm Trading ucingo enombolweni yabo ethi 031 006 5204 kodwa belungangeni njengoba bekunomsindo ozwakala sengathi bakolunye ucingo.
ANGENE eNkantolo eNkulu eThekwini ngoLwesine amaphepha okubuyekeza isicelo sokugudluza umholi uNyazilwezulu, esihlalweni eBuhleni.Lokhu kuza emva kokuthi isicelo ebesifakwe wumholi wamaNazaretha, Ukukhanyakwelanga sichithiwe kule nkantolo.Umshumayeli Chansey Sibisi weBandla lamaNazaretha, nophinde asebenze nabameli bebandla, uthe bagcine besithathile isinqumo sokuthi bafake isicelo sokubuyekezwa kwesinqumo.Bebekalelwe yile nkantolo ukuthi kungapheli izinsuku ezingu-20 bengasifakile isicelo sokubuyekeza isinqumo uma bezimisele kanjalo.SIPHINDELA enkantolo isicelo sokuchitha uNyazilwezulu Isithombe: SIGCINIWE"Njengoba amaphepha siwafaka enkantolo ngoLwesine kuningi esikhala ngakho. Okokuqala ukuthi ijaji libuyisele icala emuva ngesikhathi likhipha isinqumo ngesicelo sethu sokuthi kugudluke uNyazi esihlalweni."Kunokuthi libheke esikucelile livele laqala phansi lakhuluma ngendaba yobuholi bebandla lamaNazaretha. Asisekho isidingo sakho ngoba zonke izinkantolo sezanquma ukuthi uNyazilwezulu aluyena umholi wamaNazaretha."Okwesibili sikhala ngokuthi lithathe isikhathi eside ukukhipha isinqumo ekubeni bekungasaqulwa cala. Okunye ukuthi uNyazilwezulu luhleli ngokungemthetho esihlalweni futhi siwushaye indiva umthetho ngoba isikhonzi senkantolo sayihambisa incwadi ngesikhathi seluchithwe yinkantolo yoMthethosisekelo,” kusho uSibisi.Uthe okwenziwe yijaji lichitha isicelo sabo kungukubukela phansi amajaji aseNingizimu Afrika angu-18 achitha uNyazilwezulu ezinkantolo ezahlukene ukuthi alusiye umholi wamaNazaretha.Uveze ukuthi konke okuthintwe yijaji ngesikhathi likhipha isinqumo ngesicelo sabo sekwanqunywa ngakho, besingasekho isidingo sokuphindela kukhona.Isicelo sabo uthe besinenombolo yecala entsha engahlangene nesinqumo sezinkantolo ezedlule, wathi alikwazi ukuthatha isinqumo libheka into esiyadlula.Isolezwe linawo amaphepha esinqumo sejaji ngokugudluzwa koNyazilwezulu esihlalweni eBuhleni. Kusona ijaji lithinta zonke izigameko zokuqulwa kwecala kusuka ngo-2011. Kukhona nalapho liveza khona ukuthi uNyazilwezulu lwakulwela kodwa ukuthi alukwazi ukususwa eBuhleni ngoba kusemzini kayisemkhulu, Inyangayezulu.Kulokho uSibisi uthe besingasekho isidingo sakho ngoba lolo hlangothi lwadingidwa enkantolo, eyaluchitha uNyazi ngoba bawaveza amaphepha aqinisekisa ukuthi umuzi waseBuhleni ubhaliswe njengendawo yesonto.
UDINGA ozomtakula ezidakamizweni uSifiso "Ndishi” Manana, ozisola ngokubulala ikusasa ngoba waziwa esaseyinjini yaseswini ezinkulisa zebhola ezehlukene. Phakathi kwezinkulisa acijwe kuzona uManana, kubalwa eyaMaZulu, eyeMaritzburg City, neyeBloemfontein Celtic.UNdishi (34), odabuka eSub 5 eClermont, kodwa oke wahlala naseMbali, usephenduke umhambuma emigwaqweni yaseThekwini.Echaza ngokuzithola eseyiphara, uNdishi uthe waxoshwa ebholeni futhi waphelelwa yindawo yokuhlala kubo emuva kokuntshontshela amalungu omndeni. Uthe ungene ezidakamizweni emuva kokujola nentokazi yekhaladi eyamqoma esedlalela iCeltic ngo-2002.Echaza ngokucwila ezidakamizweni ubeke kanje:"Lo muntu wesifazane wagcina esengicela kwi-fitness coach yesifazane yeqembu ukuba ngizomhlalisa kubo ngoba usele yedwa. Ubengithatha impelasonto yonke uma singenayo imidlalo angidlise izidakamizwa. Lokho kwakungenza ngibambeke ngize ngifike ngoLwesibili." Uthe intokazi, esiligodlile igama layo ngoba asiyitholanga ukuba iziphawulele, imfundise izidakamizwa ezinjenge-cocaine, ecstacy nenyaope.UNdishi uthe babanjwa nabanye abadlali ukuthi bazitika ngezidakamizwa."Owayengumqeqeshi wethu wangikhulumela naMaZulu ukuba ngiyodlala kuwo ngoba wayechazekile yikhono lami. Ngafika enkulisa yaMaZulu ngadlala ngaphansi komqeqeshi uJoel Faya." Uthe nakhona kwabuye kwamvuka ukuthi useyazazi izidakamizwa."Nakhona ngaqala ukuntshontsha izidakamizwa, ngagcina ngingasakwazi ukujima nokuya emdlalweni. Kunokuthi bangixoshe, ngabona kungcono ukuthi ngizihambele."Uthe kwababuhlungu kuye ukuhlukana nomdlalo webhola ngoba iyona yinto ayeyazi. Eqhuba uthe ubuyele kubo kodwa waxoshwa khona, okuyikho okumenze wagcina esegxila ezidakamizweni ngoba ubesengundingasithebeni.Uthe angakujabulela ukunikezwa ithuba lokuhambela izikole aqwashise ngobubi bezidakamizwa futhi asize nabadlali abasacathula ebholeni.UNdishi ufunde eVezamafa Primary, eZakhele Primary kwathi u-matric wawenza eLanga High, KwaDabeka kodwa wafeyila. Uthe ubuye wenza izifundo zeTourism eLangeni TVET College, ePinetown kodwa wangahlala isikhathi eside.Uqale ukugijima kwezikanobhutshuzwayo kwiSilver Spurs, Masters, Young Mates, nakwiClermont United. Uthe wajoyina iCeltic, ngemva kokubona kwelinye iphephandaba laseGoli, elibhala ngebhola ukuthi kwakunenhlolokhono. Abadlali ake agijima nabo ngoKermit Erasmus (Celtic), Sphelele Mthembu (City), Japhet Zwane (AmaZulu), Andile Jali (Celtic) noBrilliant Khuzwayo (AmaZulu). Esakhula wayefuna ukudlalela iKaizer Chiefs kodwa wagcina esehalela iMamelodi Sundowns. Phakathi kwabadlali akhule ebukela kubo, ubale uJabu Mahlangu, noScara Ngobese. Uthe abangakwazi ukumsiza bangaxhumana noMP Da Bee, weMPtv eCity Life, esemgwaqweni uJoseph Nduli, noma ku-071 281 7509.
UMKHONTO weSizwe (MK) uthi umethule umthwalo uBonginkosi Khanyile odilizwe esikhundleni sokuba wumholi wentsha yeqembu nabanye abenabo kulolu hlaka lokuhola abantu abasha. Ukudilizwa kukaKhanyile esikhundleni kumenyezelwe yiqembu lakhe izolo ekuseni ngencwadi. UKhanyile uchithwe noGazuzu Nduli obengumdidiyeli waseGauteng. Kuchithwe noThapelo Maisha obeyiphini likamengameli.Isolezwe lizibonile izincwadi ezithunyelelwe laba baholi bentsha baziswa ukuthi baxoshiwe futhi kufanele balinde iqembu ukuthi lizobajuba kuphi.UMkhonto weSizwe okuphuzwa ngawo itiye kulezi zinsuku, umenyezelwe owayengumengameli uJacob Zuma ngoDisemba nyakenye. UZuma washingila wachizela uKhongolose ethi akasahambi nawo useqome iMK azoya nayo okhethweni.OBENGUMHOLI wentsha yoMkhonto weSizwe (MK) uBonginkosi Khanyile uchithiwe esikhundleni kanye nabanye abaholi Isithombe: FACEBOOK/BONGINKOSI EDUCATION KHANYILEUKhanyile owaduma emkhankasweni i#FeesMustFall, ubeqokelwe esikhundleni ngoJanuwari nonyaka njengoba esechithwa manje.Okhulumela uMkhonto weSizwe uMnuz Nhlamulo Ndhlela, uthe banqume ukubadedela abaholi bentsha ukuze bakhankase kahle ezinhlakeni zentsha."Kufanele babhekane nomsebenzi wokukhankasa kubantu abasha ukuze beseke uMkhonto weSizwe. Bekufanele sibethule umthwalo ukuze bakhankase kahle bengaxakwe yilutho. Khumbula phela nokuthi akekho umuntu onesikhundla, noma wubani angashintshwa nanini, sonke nje sihlala silindile,’’ kusho uNdhlela.Kuthe kusabatshazwa lokho kokuchithwa kukaKhanyile nabanye, kwavela ukuthi uMinenhle Cibane obengunobhala-jikelele wesikhashana naye uchithiwe. UKhanyile wayeyilungu le-EFF elivuthayo, wasuka kuyona waya kwiPatriotic Alliance egcine imxoshile.Uthushuke eqenjini iMK lapho afike wanikwa khona isikhundla lesi asediliziwe kusona. UKhanyile ubesanda kuba sematheni ngezinto ahambe ezisho emphakathini.Kukhona lapho ashutshwa khona ekhaca abantu ngolaka ebabiza ngabadayisi. Kukhona nalapho akhuluma khona ngesankahlu ecaza izikhundla eqenjini ethi uZuma wuyena ngqo shishilizi.Kwenzeka konke lokhu nje, iMK isematheni emuva kokuthi uZuma enqobe icala abelifake enkantolo emangalele inhlangano eyengamele ukhetho i-IEC. UZuma uphume phambili kade ekhala ngesinqumo se-IEC sokumnqabela ukuthi aye ePhalamende uma bethola izihlalo.UKhanyile uzanywe kaningi ocingweni lungangeni.
UMHOLI weDA uMnuz John Steenhuisen usebenzise ukunqoba kwabo uMasipala waseMngeni ngamavoti amancane, ukukhuthaza abantu bakuleli ukuphuma ngezinkani okhethweni oluzayo.USteenhuisen uthe ukunqoba kwabo sekuvalwe amehlo uMasipala waseMngeni okhethweni lohulumeni basekhaya lwango-2021, kungubufakazi bokuthi ukungavoti komuntu oyedwa okhethweni lwangoMeyi kungashintsha izinto.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ethula isikhangiso sokuqala seDA sokhetho esizokhonjiswa kwithelevishini.Kulesikhangiso iDA iqhosha ngokufuqa intuthuko emikhandlwini eyiphethe.USteenhuisen uthe iningi lemikhandlu abayiphethe bayiwina ngamavoti amancane.I-DA yahlwitha i-ANC uMasipala waseMngeni ngamavoti angu-44, nokungumkhandlu wokuqala KwaZulu-Natal ophethwe iDA.Ngo-2006, i-DA yawina uMasipala waseCape Town ngevoti elilodwa."Yomibili lemikhandlu neminye ephethwe iDA isiphenduke yaba yisibonelo esihle. Imikhandlu ephethwe iDA yenza kahle kakhulu,” kusho uSteenhuisen.Uthe ukunqoba kwabo lemikhandlu ngamavoti amancane kumele kukhuthaze bonke abantu bakuleli ukuthi bayovota ngoMeyi 29.Nakuba iDA yaziwa ngokuphatha kahle komasipala ebusa kubona uthe abantu bayakhohlwa ukuthi baqale kanjani. Indlela ibeyinde kakhulu, baqale kancane, balokhu bekhula.Isifundo esibalulekile lapha uthe wukuthi wonke umuntu avote. Isimo ababhekene naso sibi kakhulu, akufanele kube khona umuntu ongezukuvota."Sinxusa bonke labo asebelahlekelwe ithemba ukuba bangadikibali, bahambe bayovota. Ivoti elilodwa lingawenza umehluko uma sekubalwa."Ukuvota yisona sikhali esikhulu esinaso esingasisebenzisa ukuzwakalisa uvo lwethu. Ukungavoti nokuvota kwakho kungacacisa ukuthi izwe liphathwa ngokubambisana i-ANC, MK ne-EFF noma liphathwa ngokubambisana ngamaqembu asebenzisana neDA,” esho.Esikhangisweni kuvela kakhulu izimeya zomasipala abaphethwe yileliqembu, lapho zikhuluma khona ngezikwenzile kusukela zaqokelwa ezikhundleni.USteenhuisen uthe abantu bakuleli bakhathele wukungazitholi izidingo.Unxuse abantu bakuleli ngokungapheli amandla, kuningi okufanele kubajabulise njengoba kuyiwa okhethweni, maningi amathuba okuthi i-ANC iphume emandleni.Lokhu uthi kuzonikeza ithuba amaqembu ahambisana neDA ukuba aphathe.USteenhuisen uthe isikhangiso sizoqala sikhonjiswe kwiziteshi zethelevision ezahlukene maduze. "Lokhu kuzoqinisa kakhulu umkhankaso wethu. Sizimisele ngokutakula abantu baseNingizimu Afrika kulolu sizi ababhekene nalo,” kuphetha lomholi.
UPHIKO lwezokushushisa kuleli ludide abaningi luveza ukuthi kukhona izicelo zebheyili olungeke luziphikise emacaleni athinta inkohlakalo nokukhwabanisa okwaholela ekubulaweni kwababili enyuvesi yaseFort Hare.Umbuso wamukele ukudedelwa kwabasolwa abangu-12 ngebheyili kodwa yala yaphetha ukuba kudedelwe abanye.Abasolwa bakamuva abangu-15 baboshwe ngenyanga edlule ezifundazweni ezine zakuleli. Kulaba basolwa kukhona no-Anwar Khan ongumnikazi wenkampani yonogada edume ngokugada osaziwayo futhi wayengunogada ka-Aka okungumrepha wakuleli owadutshulwa wabulawa eseThekwini ngonyaka odlule.Abasolwa abayishumi kulaba babhekene namacala okukhwabanisa nenkonhlakalo badedelwe ngebheyili engazange iphikiswe ngumbuso. U-Anna Smith, Paul Tladi, Lucrecia Davids, Mbulelo Gingcana, Nkateko Mawila, Nozuko Mabombo, Thamsanqa Sonjica, Craig Retief, Bradley Conradie noNthabiseng Makhoba bonke badedelwe ngebheyili kaR5000 umuntu ngamunye.Imigomo nemibandela yebheyili yabo ithi kumele basayine njalo ngoLwesithathu esiteshini samaphoyisa esiseduze futhi banikele emaphoyiseni izincwadi zabo zokuvakasha. Abanye abasolwa ababoshwa nabo uSarga Burger noGosain van der Haarhave bona badedelwe ngebheyili kaR50 000. Ngesitatimende esithunyelwe kwabezindaba, umbuso uveze ukuthi ngeke uziphikise izicelo zebheyili zalaba basolwa kodwa uzophikisa ezintathu, okungezikaTerrence Joubert, Anwar Khan no-Isaac Plaatjies obeyisikhulu esiphezulu kule nyuvesi. Umbosu uthe uPlaatjies uyayishalazela ibheyili kodwa ukuyilungelo lakhe ukuthi ayicele. "Kuyilungelo lakhe ukufaka isicelo sebheyili kodwa kumele kucace ukuthi umbuso uzosiphikisa. Njengamanje uKhan noJoubert bazofaka izicelo zabo ngoLwesihlanu.Kulaba basolwa abangu-15, abayisishiyagalolunye bangabasebenzi abaqashwe iyona le nyuvesi kanti laba abanye ngosomambizinisi abaphakela le nyuvesi ngemisebenzi eyahlukene.
SELIDLULISELWE eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini icala lokusocongwa kwephoyisa loMkhandlu weTheku, uCaptain Thomas Zwelakhe Ntombela.Lokhu kuvezwe uMshushisi u-Advocate Lungelo Nsibande izolo ngesikhathi abasolwa abathathu kuleli cala bevele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMlaza.Umufi wahlaselwa wadutshulwa esemzini wakhe okwa-S, eMlaza ngoMeyi 3 ngonyaka owedlule.Waphuthunyiswa esibhedlela eSiphingo Medical Towers nokuyilapho okwafike kwamenela khona.Ngemuva kwalokho kwaboshwa inkabi, uSipho Ntombela okunguyena owadubula.UNtombela kwathi esevela eNkantolo yaseThekwini wageqa amagula, watshela inkantolo ukuthi uyalivuma icala.UMUFI, uCaptain Thomas Zwelakhe Ntombela isithombe : SITHUNYELWEWadalula ukuthi wayekade ethunywe yinkosikazi kamufi, uNkk Nongcebo Faith Ntombela ukuba asoconge umyeni wakhe.Ngemuva kwezinyanga ezimbalwa, uNkk Ntombela wakhalelwa ngamasongo kaSigonyela benoMnuz Sithembiso Justice Khumalo njengoba kwavela ukuthi babesebenzisana ekuhleleni itulo lokusocongwa kukamufi.UKhumalo unguthishanhloko esikoleni saKwaMaphumulo, iMpumulwane Primary.Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi kwavela negama lenkabi eyesatshwayo KwaZulu-Natal evele igwetshiwe, uKhulani Cele ukuthi nayo ibibandakanyeka kuleli cala.Bobathathu bagqigqa inkantolo, uKhumalo ungaphandle ngebheyili, uNkk Ntombela inkantolo yamnqabela ibheyili.UMshushisi izolo utshele inkantolo ukuthi konke sekumi ngomumo ukuthi leli cala selingadluliselwa eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini ukuze liqale ukuqulwa."Namhlanje ngiyaqinisekisa ukuthi leli cala sekuphothuliwe okuningi okumayelana nalo. Ngakho-ke selingadluliselwa eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini,'' usho kanje.IMantshi uNgcobo ibe seyimemezela ukuthi leli cala lidluliselwa eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini ngoJuni 13."Nobathathu nizovela eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini ngalolu suku osekuvunyelwene ngalo,'' usho kanje.UMnuz Nkosinathi Ntombela oyiwele likamufi uthe kubajabulisile ukuthi ekugcineni leli cala selize ladluliselwa eNkantolo eNkulu."Kade siwulindile lo mzuzu wokuthi leli cala lithuthe lapha eMlaza liye eThekwini. Siyathemba ukuthi azophuma wonke amaqiniso uma seliqulwa eThekwini,'' echaza.Njengenjwayelo ngaphandle kwenkantolo amalungu omphakathi abegcwele.Abameli babasolwa bobathathu bathe bagculisekile ngokuthi leli cala selingadluliselwa eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini.
UGWETSHWE udilikajele neminyaka emihlanu ngaphezulu, owesifazane olahlwe ngecala lokubulala isoka lakhe, isidumbu salo esatholwa singqongqiswe nemoto emgwaqweni ophakathi koPhongolo noNongoma, ngo-2021.UNonjabulo Nokukhanya Nkosi (37) ugwetshwe udilikajele ngecala lokubulala owayeyisoka lakhe uMnuz Dumisani Qwabe (47) neminyaka emihlanu ngaphezulu ngelokweba, kwathi uzakwabo aboshwe naye uXolani Skhumbuzo Mtambo (38) wagwetshwa iminyaka engu-15 ngelokubulala.Inkantolo imxegisele uMtambo emva kokuthi kuthiwe bekungokokuqala elahlwa ngecala futhi wayengekho endaweni yesigameko ngesikhathi sokubulawa kukamufi.UNonjabulo noQwabe kuthiwa babeyizithandani, kodwa wagcina enqume ukumbulala. Kuthiwa wacela uMtambo ukuthi amfunele inkabi eyayizogudluza umufi kodwa iqhinga langaphumelela. Kuvele ukuthi wazitholela isibhamu nophethroli wokuzenzela umsebenzi wokubulala isoka kwathi ngo- Okthoba 2021 wahlangana noMtambo owamfundisa ukuthi sihlohlwa kanjani isibhamu futhi sisetshenziswa kanjani.Kuthiwa washayela uQwabe ucingo, kwathi makhathaleni imoto kamufi yatholwa ishisiwe emgwaqweni ophakathi koPhongolo noNongoma, kunezinsalela zesidumbu sikamufi. Kuthiwa uNonjabulo akazange alubeke emsebenzini ngosuku olulandelayo njengoba kuthiwa wayenezibazi zokusha esiqhomeni nasesandleni sangakwesobunxele.Emva kokufa kukaQwabe, amalungu omndeni wakhe athola ukuthi iselula nekhadi lasebhange kukamufi kuyasetshenziswa, nokwathi emva kophenyo lwamaphoyisa kwavela ukuthi uNonjabulo owayesebenzisa ikhadi ukukhipha imali ne-app yasebhange kaQwabe. Waboshwa kwathi uma kulandelwa umkhondo kwatholakala ukuthi ubefonelana noMtambo owaboshwa emva kwezinyanga ezintathu.Ebufakazini obunekelwe inkantolo obebuholwa ngabashushisi o-Advocate Nokulunga Ngcobo no- Alex Moolman kutholakale ukuthi uNonjabulo noMtambo babelokhu bexhumana ngezindlela ezehlukene ngemuva nangaphambi kokubulawa kukamufi, kubukwa nezingxoxo zabo ku-WhatsApp nokucwaninga amakhamera emishinini yokukhipha imali lapho ayehamba ekhipha khona imali kamufi.Isitatimende esifundelwe inkantolo sezihlobo zikaQwabe, simchaze njengomuntu owayenobuntu, osiza umphakathi. Kuthiwa wayewumuntu onomusa nonakekelayo.
UNOBHALA_Jikelele we-ANC uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, ukhwele wadilika kwiMK, wayichaza njengeqembu elisungulwe ngabantu abakhungethwe yizinkinga ngesikhathi kukhunjulwa isosha lophiko lwezempi kwi-ANC, uMkhonto weSizwe uMnuz Chris Hani.UMbalula uthe iMK, ekhankaselwa ngowayengumengameli uJacob Zuma, ngeke ilungelwe yilutho ngoba isungulwe abantu abanezinkinga bonke."Uma ubabheka laba, ungababala bonke banezinkinga. Iqembu lezepolitiki alisungulwa ngabantu abakhungethwe yizinkinga,” kusho uMbalula.UMbalula ubekhuluma emcimbini obuseThomas Nkobi Memorial Park, eGauteng. UHani wayenesikhundla esiphezulu kuMkhonto weSizwe, wasocongwa ngo-1993 ngesikhathi kulungiselelwa ukhetho lwango-1994.UMbalula uthe bamelene nokusungulwa kweMK ekhankaselwa wuZuma, wathi bona bazi uphiko lwezempi lolu olwaluholwa uHani nabanye."UHani ubezophatheka kabi ukuba usekhona uma ebona kukhona abafuna ukuphikisa umlando. Ubezophatheka kabi uma kukhona abafuna ukuphikisa ukuthi iMK yasungulwa yi-ANC. Ingakho sisenkantolo, silwa naleliqembu lezepolitiki elibizwa ngeMK."Asinankinga nomuntu uma efuna ukuziqalela iqembu lakhe lezepolitiki, esilwa nakho ukuthi kuntshontshwe igama lethu. IMK wuphiko lwe-ANC ,yingakho sizolilwela igama leMK,” kuqhuba uMbalula.Uthe akubathusi ukuqembuka kwamalungu e-ANC asejoyine iMK, wathi azobuya.Udalule ukuthi akuqali ngeMK ukuthi kusungulwe iqembu lezepolitiki. Ahlezi esungulwa ngabantu amaqembu ezepolitiki, abantu abahambe kwi-ANC bayazibuyela,Uqhubeke ngokuthi bababona sebebuyile, bangazi nokuthi babuye nini. Abanye babuya sebekhokhoba.UMbalula uthe abanalo uvalo lokuthi bazohlulwa okhethweni oluzayo, wachitha amaqembu athi afuna ukubusa ngokubambisana nabo emva kokhetho.Uthe baningi abahamba bethi bazohlulwa okhethweni. Abanye bathi bazobusa ngokubambisana futhi sebeqalile ukuzisondeza."Basibingelela ngisho ebumnyameni, singababoni. Abakhohlwe laba abacabanga ukuthi sizobusa ngokubambisana. Abachithe amanzi, akukho nkukhu ezochuthwa la.”"Asisakucabangi ukubusa ngokubambisana ngoba kunezinkinga eziningi komasipala ababusa ngalo luhlobo,” esho.Kwabanye omasipala uthe yibona abanezihlalo eziningi kodwa akubona abaphethe.Uveze ukuthi kufanele bahambe bencenga amaqembu amancane ukuba abanikeze isikhundla sobumeya, sebeguqela izihlalo ezimbili. Laba bantu uthe bakhuluma lokhu nje kubantu abanezihlalo ezingu-50.
KUYAQHUBEKA eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini ukukhishwa kwesinqumo ecaleni likanesi osolwa ngokuthenga izinkabi okuthiwa zabulala umyeni wakhe owayewunjiniyela ePinetown.Ijaji elibambile, uSolwazi Bonke Dumisa liqale ngokuthi libuyekeze okwashiwo ofakazi boMbuso abayisithupha.Uvele wakhihla isililo uNksz Zodwa Langa ongudadewabo kamufi ngesikhathi uDumisa ethinta ubufakazi abethulela inkantolo phambilini.Uze waduduzwa amalungu omndeni wakhe afike nawo enkantolo bezokwethamela icala.Bekukhona nezihlobo ebezizokweseka abamangalelwa okungoMnuz Nkosinathi Zungu nodadewabo kankosikazi kamufi, uNksz Nompumelelo Goncalves.Abamangalelwa bathweswe icala lokuthumba nelokubulala okuhleliwe uMnuz Nkosi Tommy Langa owayewunjiniyela eTransnet ngoSpthemba 2020.Kukhona nelokuphangwa kweveni kaLanga, i-Isuzu X Rider,ngendlakadla, namabili okuphazamisa ukusebenza kwengalo yomthetho.Ebufakazini uDumisa asebuthintile kukhona nobukaMnuz Siyabonga Mbedu.UMbedu wayengumuntu wesithathu ukuba adayiselwae iveni eyayingadayiseki kanti uzoshiya umazisi wakhe phakathi owatholwa amaphoyisa eMgungundlovu kule moto eyayishiywe dengwane.Kubikwa ukuthi awuthatha umazisi acinga ngawo uMbedu owafonelwa wabizelwa esiteshini samaphoyisa sasePinetown lapho afike waboshelwa khona.Kuvela ukuthi wabe esechaza konke ayekwazi ukuthi uLanga ubulewe walahlwa ehlathini aoZwathini, eNdwedwe. Amaphoyisa kuthiwa abe esethungatha futhi abopha abathintekayo.Omunye wabantu ababoshwa umngani kaZungu, uJames Mashudu Mthimkhulu. Walivuma icala wagwetshwa wase ephendula ufakazi woMbuso ezininda yena nabamangalelwa.
UNGOTI wezomthetho uthi mancane amathuba okuthi inhlangano eyengamele ukhetho, i-Independent Electoral Commission (IEC), iphikise isinqumo esivumela owayengumengameli, uJacob Zuma, ukuba angenele ukhetho.UMnuz Mpumelelo Zikala, weZikalala Attorneys, uthe kungaba lukhuni ukuthi i-IEC iludlulisele phambili lolu daba ngenxa yesikhathi."Inkinga enkulu ukuthi kune-timetable yokhetho, eshoyo ukuthi kufanele kwenzekeni, ngasiphi isikhathi. I-IEC iyona eyenza le timetable. Njengamanje i-timetable ithi i-IEC kufanele ishicilele uhlu lokugcina lwamagama abantu abazongenela ukhetho. Uma i-IEC ingathi ifuna ukusiphonsela inselelo isinqumo senkantolo lokho kungaphazamisa i-timetable.”I-IEC ithe ifuna izizathu eziholele ekutheni iNkantolo yezoKhetho ivumele uZuma ukuthi angenele ukhetho.Okhulumela i-IEC, uNksz Kate Bapela, uthe bakhuluma nabameli babo ukubheka ukuthi iziphi izinyathelo zomthetho abangazithatha.Lokhu ukusho esitatimendeni abasikhiphe emva kwesinqumo senkantolo sangoLwesibili.Inkantolo inqume ukuthi kwakungekho emthethweni ukukhishwa kwegama likaZuma ohlwini lwabantu abaya ePhalamende.Igama likaZuma lalikhishwe emva kwezikhalo zabantu abathi akavumelekile ukuba abe ilungu lePhalamende ngenxa yokuthi useke wagwetshwa izinyanga ezingu-15 ebhadla ejele.Umthetho awubavumeli abagwetshwe isikhathi esingaphezu kwezinyanga ezingu-12 ukuba baphathe izikhundla kuhulumeni.UBapela uthe basalinde ukuthi inkantolo ibanikeze izizathu zayo zokuvumela uZuma ukuba angenele ukhetho."Kubalulekile ukuthi inkantolo isinikeze izizathu zayo ukuze siqonde kahle ukuthi ifike kanjani kulesi sinqumo.”UNksz Bapela uthe bebengakanqumi ukuthi bazosiphikisa yini isinqumo senkantolo."Njengamanje sixoxa nabameli bethu. Sizonquma ukuthi sizothatha ziphi izinyathelo uma abameli sebesilulekile. Kuzoba lula ukuthi basiluleke uma sesinazo izizathu ezenze ukuthi inkantolo ithathe isinqumo esithathile. Sinethemba lokuthi inkantolo izosinika izizathu ngokushesha, ukuze nathi sizokwazi ukuthatha isinqumo ngokushesha.”Udaba lokukhishwa kwegama likaZuma ohlwini bese lususe umsindo njengoba kukhona amalungu eMK abesabisa ngokuthi kuzoba nodlame uma uZuma egcine engavunyelwanga ukuba angenele ukhetho.UZuma uphezulu ohlwini lweMK lwabaya ePhalamende.
UNDUNANKULU waseGauteng uMnuz Panyaza Lesufi uyaqhubeka nemizamo yakhe yokusiza izakhamuzi zaseGauteng ezingasebenzi.NgoLwesithathu ntambama ubenomcimbi eGrace Bible Church ePimville eSoweto lapho kuqashwe khona abasebenzi abangu-2500 ababengamasosha omzabalazo. Laba baqashelwe ukuba ngabasizi basemgwaqweni amaGauteng Traffic Wardens (GTW), njengengxenye yohlelo lokuqasha iNasi iSpani. Uhlelo lweNasi iSpani lwaqala ngonyaka odlule lapho uLesufi wathembisa ukuqeqesha izinkulungwane zabantu abazosebenza ukulekelela ezinhlakeni ezehlukene zikahulumeni, babodwa abaqeqeshelwe ukuqapha ubugebengu emphakathini, abantu bathole amathuba okufundela umsebenzi eminyangweni eyahlukene kahulumeni abanye basebenzisana namaphoyisa omgwaqo.NgoLwesine ekuseni, uhulumeni saweGauteng ukhiphe isimemezelo sokuthi zonke izakhamuzi ezingasebenzi zinganikela ezikoleni ezehlukene ngokohlu olukhishiwe lapho bezobhalisela khona amathuba omsebenzi kanjalo namathuba okuqeqeshelwa amakhono ahlukahlukene ngale mpelasontoUhlu lwezikole
ZITHWELE kanzima izingane ezimbili ezabona unina egwazwa ebulawa yisoka lakhe ngo-Okthoba ngonyaka odlule, eMorningside eThekwini.Lokhu kuvezwe nguNkk Thandi Phohlo, ongunina kamufi, uNksz Dima Phohlo (31) okusolwa ukuthi wabulawa ngesihluku yisoka lakhe, uMnuz Mhleli Ndaba (31).Lesi sehlakalao kuthiwa senzeka ngemuva kwengxabano eyayishubile phakathi kwabo.Izingane okukhulunywa ngazo kuvela ukuthi ngabafana omunye uneminyaka emithathu, omunye unemihlanu.Izolo umsolwa ubevele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini. Unina kamufi uzwakalise ukukhathazeka kwakhe ngabazukulu bakhe wathi njalo ebusuku abalali baxoxa ngabakubona ngosuku lwesigameko."Iyangikhathaza impilo esiphilwa ngabazukulu bami. Baxoxa ngakho konke abakubona ngalelo langa. Baze basitshele nokuthi isehlakalo saqala senzeka ngaphakathi endlini kwaze kwaphunyelwa ngaphandle,'' usho kanje.Uthe akagculisekile ngendlela izinto ezenzeka ngayo kuleli cala.Ukhale ngokuthi icala lihlehliswa njalo ekubeni kumhlukumeza nokuza njalo enkantolo. "Sengiqala nokulilahla manje ithemba ngokuthi bukhona ubulungiswa obuzokwenzeka kuleli cala. Lihlehliswa njalo kanti kunjalo nje angiboni kahle nokuthi kwenziwani,'' usho kanje ekhononda.Uthe akekho nje enkantolo ozihluphayo ngokuxhumana nabo ngakho konke okuqhubekayo.Umshushisi, u-Advocate Calvin Govender, utshele inkantolo ukuthi icala selisesigabeni sokuthi manje selingaqala ukuthi liqulwe.Kuthiwa umufi kwathi uma ebona ukuthi umsolwa uyamlimaza wabalekela emnyango, kodwa wamjaha waze wamfica waqhubeka nokumgwaza esesemnyango.Enkantolo kuvele ukuthi kunemifanekiso eqoshiwe eveza umsolwa ebulala umufi ngesihluku.Umsolwa ungaphandle ngebheyili ka-R20 000. Icala lihlehliselwe uMeyi 10 ukuze liqale ukuqulwa.Ibheyili yakhe inombandela wokuthi angalinge aphazamise uphenyo futhi angasondeli eduze kwabantwana bakhe.Phambilini umsolwa watshela inkantolo ukuthi lokhu wayekwenza ngoba wayehlose ukuthi azivikele kumufi.IMantshi, uXolile Manjeza, ivumile ukuthi icala lihlehle ukuze ngokuzayo liqale ukuqulwa.

Iziguli esezinesikhathi zilele kulesi sibhedlela bezithule emibhedeni yazo. Angikaze ngiyibone into enjengale. Izinkawu ziyazicanasela nje emawodini sengathi akwenzeki lutho. Ngikhathazeke ngokuthi azikho yini izifo ezingazithelela iziguli ezivele zigula njengoba zidla zichithe phezu kweziguli," kusho ongumhlobo wesinye isiguli. UNGQONGQOSHE wezokoThutha kuleli uNkk Sindisiwe Chikunga uqinisekisa ukupheliswa kohlelo lwama-e-toll, oselukhathaze abashayeli baseGauteng iminyaka eminingi. Ngokwesimemezelo sikangqongqoshe lolu hlelo luzonqanyulwa ngoLwesine phakathi kwamabili nokusho ukuthi kusukela ngoLwesihlanu, abashayeli ngeke besakhokhiswa ngokudlula eamabhulohweni ama-e-toll.Uthei lawa amabhuloho azoqhubeka nokuma njengoba azosetshenziselwa izinhlelo ezehlukene ukuqapha isimo emgwaqweni kanti namakhamera azosetshenziselwa ukuqapha ubugebengu.Abanama-akhawunti bazokwazi ukuqhubeka nokuwasebenzisela ezinye izinsiza ezihambisana nezokuthutha, njengokukhokhela izindaba zokupaka izimoto, kodwa abasanezikweletu kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi bayazikhokhela."Abashayeli basanesibophezelo sokuthi bakhokhe, lokho kuyisibopho ngokomthetho. Mayelana nokuthi sizokwenzenjani ukuqinisekisa lokho, yinto leyo esizoyilungisa njengoba isikhathi siqhubeka,” kusho uNdunankulu wesifundazwe uMnuz Panyaza Lesufi obeyingxenye yesithangami nabezindaba.Yize kuyizindaba ezimnandi lezi, kodwa uStefanie Fick okhulumela i-Organisation Undoing Tax Abuse (OUTA) uthe kabathokozile ngokwanele bengakezwa kahle ukuthi uhulumeni uzosikhokhela kanjani isikweletu sezigidi salolu hlelo."Kuhle ukwazi ukuthi abantu balwe baze baphumelela njengoba seluqedwa lolu hlelo, kodwa ungqongqoshe uhlulekile wukuchazela izakhamuzi ukuthi izokhokhwa kanjani imali elinganiselwa kuR43 billion eyisikweletu sokwakhiwa kwalo lonke lolu hlelo,” kusho yena.
UNGOTI wezomthetho uthi owayenguMengameli, uJacob Zuma, kuzofanele akhethe phakathi kokulahlekelwa yimihlomulo ayithola ngokuba ngowayengumengameli njengoba esevunyelwe ukuthi angenele ukhetho.UMnuz Mpumelelo Zikalala, weZikalala Attorneys uthe uZuma uzolahlekelwa yiyo yonke imihlomulo ayitholayo uma engavuma ukuba yilungu lePhalamende.Umhlaziyi wezepolitiki yena uthe akaboni uZuma ezovuma ukuphunyukwa yimihlomula ayithola ngokuba owayengumengameli.Izolo iNkantolo yezoKhetho ichithe isinqumo sokukhishwa kwegama likaZuma ohlwini lwabantu abaya ePhalamende nokusho ukuthi maningi amathuba okuthi abuyele njengoba igama lakhe liphezulu ohlwini lweMK.UZikalala uthe uZuma angeke akwazi ukuhlomula kabili."Kufanele akhethe okukodwa. Akakwazi ukuthola umhlomulo wokuthi abe ilungu lePhalamende, aphinde athole imihlomulo yokuba owayengumengameli. Uzolahlekelwa imihlomulo efana nokuba nabaqaphi,” kusho uZikalala.Uthe ubona sengathi isinqumo sikaMengameli, uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa sokuthambisa isigwebo sikaZuma, ikhona okumnikeze ithuba lokuthi akwazi ukungenela ukhetho.URamaphosa wathambisa isigwebo sikaZuma esadonse izinyanga ezintathu kwesezinyanga ezingu-15.Umthetho awubavumeli abagwetshwa isikhathi esingaphezu kwezinyanga ezingu-12 ukuthi baye ePhalamende."Kunomehluko la. UZuma akazange anikwe ushwele, isigwebo sakhe sehliswa. Lokhu kusho ukuthi isigwebo sakhe asibanga yilezinyanga ezingu-15 ayegwetshwe zona,” esho,Umhlaziyi wezepolitiki oseNyuvesi yaKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Zakhele Ndlovu, uthe akaboni uZuma ezovuma ukulahlekelwa imihlomulo ayitholayo."Mikhulu kakhulu imihlomulo ayitholayo, okubalwa kuyo nokuba nabaqaphi. Angiboni ukuthi uZuma engadela lemihlomulo, akhethe ukuba ilungu lePhalamende,” kusho uNdlovu.UNdlovu uthe ukuvunyelwa kukaZuma ukuba angenele ukhetho kuyizindaba ezimbi kwi-ANC.Uthe ukuvela kwegama likaZuma ohlwini lwabaya ePhalamende, kuzovusa ufuqufuqu kwabeMK.Uqhubeke ngokuthi bekungeke kube kuhle kwiMK ukuthi uZuma angabi khona okhethweni. Ngaphandle kukaZuma, ayikho iMK.UZuma kuphela owaziwayo kwiMK. Ukungabibikho kukaZuma ohlwini lwabaya ePhalamende bekuzokusho ukuthi uwumhlobiso nje. Impi enkulu lena abayinqobile.Uthi manje sebezokhankasa ngokukhululeka njengoba sebazi ukuthi umuntu abamthwele ngeqoma, uzokuba khona ohlwini. Lokhu kuzolimaza kakhulu i-ANC, kushaye ne-IFP.Iqiniso wukuthi uZuma uthandwa kakhulu lapha KwaZulu-Natal. Ngibona bengalala isibili noma isithathu lapha KwaZulu-Natal.”Okhulumela iMK, uMnuz Nhlamulo Ndhlela uthe ukuvunyelwa kukaZuma ukuba angenele ukhetho kusho ukuthi amadlozi avumile ukuthi aphinde abe umengameli."Konke esikwenzayo sikwenza ngokukamoya. Manje sekusobala ukuthi lokhu esikwenzayo kufunwa amadlozi. Akekho ke ongavimba into efunwa amadlozi,” kusho uNdhlela.Uqhubeke ngokuthi bafuna ukuthi uZuma aphinde abe umengameli."Iqiniso ukuthi akusiye uZuma othe ufuna ukuba umengameli, abantu abathe bafuna abuye. Kuningi esikufunayo kuZuma. Sifuna amanzi, ugesi nemigwaqo,” esho.Uthe ukukhishwa kukaZuma ohlwini bekushiya imibuzo engaphenduleki.Kubantu abangu-15 000 abasohlwini lwabangenele ukhetho, kube yigama likaZuma kuphela elikhishwayo. Lokhu kukwenza uzibuze ukuthi yini lena engaka efunwa kuZuma.UNdhlela uthe njengoba igama likaZuma selibuyiselwe ohlwini, sebezokwazi ukugxila emkhankasweni wabo.
AMAPHOYISA abophe abasolwa abayisithupha eSoweto namhlanje kulandela ukubulawa komdlali weKaizer Chiefs ngesikhathi edunwa imoto eGoli ngesonto eledlule. UTHEMBISE ukuthi kuzophela lo nyaka isixazululekile inkinga yokucishwa kukagesi, oyiPhini likamengameli wezwe uMnuz Paul Mashatile.UMashatile uthe akakhulunyiswa ngukuthi kuzoba nokhetho futhi akakhankasi kodwa le nkinga bazimisele ukuyiqeda ngoba ikhahlameza umphakathi.Ethula inkulumo ngesikhathi kunesifundo ngeminyaka engu-30 izwe lakhululeka eNyuvesi iJohannesburg izolo, ubalule ukuthi kuningi okwenziwe nguhulumeni kusuka ngo-1994."Ngifuna ukuniqinisekisa ukuthi kunezinhlelo esizisebenza ngokushesha zokuthi siqede ngenkinga kagesi kuleli. Ngiyazi aningikholwa, futhi nicabanga ukuthi ngiyakhankasa kodwa akunjalo. Yingakho ngithi ngeke iqedwe ngaphambi kokhetho kodwa izoqedwa ekupheleni kwalo nyaka.” Uthe uma isiqediwe le nkinga ungqongqoshe kagesi uzobe esehlelela ingomuso."Abanye bamuzwa ethi emuva kokuqeda ngale nkinga uzobe esewuphothulile umsebenzi wakhe. Ngimtshele ukuthi emuva kokuqeda ngale nkinga kumele ahlelele eminye iminyaka engu-10 ukuthi singaphinde sibe nenkinga efanayo,” kusho uMashatile.Uthe kumele kwakhiwe ezinye iziphehli zikagesi bese kusetshenziswa negesi ukuphehla ugesi.Uthe balubheke ngabomvu ukhetho lukazwelonke olungoMeyi 29."Ukhetho olubaluleke kakhulu kuleli njengoba emaningi amaqembu angenele ukhetho, kanjalo nalabo abazozimela. Ngiyayithemba i-ANC ukuthi izokwenzakahle okhethweni. Asithuki ukuthi maningi amaqembu angenele ukhetho ngenxa yokuqina kwentando yabantu kuleli."Uthe mkhulu umsebenzi owenziwe nguhulumeni emikhakheni ehlukene okubalwa ezokuthutha, ezolimo ezemfundo neminye."Kuthuthukiswe ingqalasizinda kwabekwa uR21.4 billion, wokuphucula umnotho. Sinxenxa intsha nabesifazane ukuthi babe yingxenye yezinhlelo zokuthi amabhizinisi abo ahlomule.” Uthe uhulumeni uyisukumele nenkinga yamanzi."UMengameli uqoke ithimba elizobhekana nale nkinga ngoba iyaphuthuma. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bakithi bathole ilungelo labo okungamanzi okuphuza ahlanzekile.” Khonamanjalo uNgqongqoshe ehhovisi likamengameli uNksz Khumbudzo Ntshavheni, uthe umnotho usukhule kakhulu uma uqhathaniswa nango-1994.Ekhuluma ngesikhathi kwethulwa inyanga yenkululeko neminyaka engu-30 izwe lakhululeka, uthe imali eqoqwe ngentela kuleli inyuke isuka kuR143 billion ngo-1996, yaya kuR2.1 trillion ngonyaka odlule.Ubalule nezinhlelo eziningi ezithuthukise umphakathi okubalwa ukuxhaswa kwezitshudeni ngemali yokufunda ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme iNSFAS, abafundi abadla nsuku zonke ezikoleni kanjalo nosizo lwezempilo.
LUSEYINZUKAZIKEYI olokuthola ummeli ephoyiseni likaMasipala weTheku elisolwa ngokugwaza libulale uzakwabo ebelithandana naye ngeledlule.Lokhu kuhlaluke izolo ngesikhathi livela eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini.UConstable Sizwe Ngema (27) kuthiwa wagwaza ephindelela uConstable Bianca Yolanda Khuzwayo (23) ngoMashi 31eflethini elisemgwaqweni uJoseph Nduli eThekwini.Umsolwa waqopha ivideo wayithumelela abambalwa abasondelene nomufi waphinde wayinameka ezinkundleni zokuxhumana.Ngesikhathi evela enkantolo kuqale kwavela ukuthi ukhona ummeli ozimele amtholile, okuthe sekufanele ammele, kwavela ukuthi ubuye wahoxa ngoba ubengakhokhelwe.UNgema ugcine etshela inkantolo ukuthi ubuyela esicelweni sakhe asenza ngeledlule sokufuna ummeli kahulumeni.Inkantolo enqume ukuthi lihlehliselwe u-Ephreli 15 icala, yathi uma esephinda evela enkantolo uNgema kuzobe kuzozwakala ukuthi isicelo sakhe basamukele yini abameli bakahulumeni.Ngesikhathi evela ngeledlule kwakugcine kungacacanga ukuthi usemisiwe yini emsebenzini noma cha.Kwathiwa ummeli kahulumeni angamthola uma eseyitholile incwadi emumisa emsebenzini, kwavela nokuthi uma engakayitholi, akangeni ohlwini lwabavumeleke ukuthola usizo lwabameli bakahulumeni.Ibigcwele phama inkantolo, kukhona amalungu omndeni kamufi, abenhlangano engenzinzuzo enikezela ngosizo lokwelulekwa ngengqondo iLifeLine, amalungu e-EFF nawomphakathi.Amalungu omndeni kamsolwa abengabonwa. Umsolwa ubebukeka edabukile, egqoke ijean, ishethi nejakhethi okushwabene.Ngesikhathi esehla ebuyela emgodini, uthe uyaqalaza lapho obekuhleli khona abantu abebehambele icala, wanxashelwa abantu abehlukene, abanye bembuza ukuthi usithathaphi isibindi sokulokhu eqalaza.Umndeni kamufi ubusasikhihla isililo. Kuzanywa ukukhuluma nomamncane wakhe, uNksz Nozipho Khuzwayo, izinyembezi zivele zagcwala amehlo wangakwazi nokukhipha izwi.Umamkhulu kaBianca, uNksz Mpume Khuzwayo, naye obebuye ahluleke ukuzibamba, zehle izinyembezi uthe namanje abakapholi ngento abayenziwe umsolwa.Ukhale ngokuthi nakho ukulokhu begqigqa ezinkantolo kubenza bangazizwa kahle."Kusebuhlungu, angisiboni isidingo sokuthi silokhu sehla senyuka ezinkantolo ngoba uzivezile ngokwakhe ukuthi nguye umbulali,” kusho uNksz Khuzwayo zehla izinyembezi.Uthe akaqondi ukuthi yini ezolokhu iqulwa enkantolo ngoba abukho ubufakazi obudlula obokusabalalisa ivideo."Bonke ubufakazi wazikhiphela yena. Angazi ukuthi yini ezolokhu ikhulunywa ezinkantolo,” kusho uNksz Khuzwayo.
BABOPHA uthishomkhulu, abazali bezingane ezifunda esikoleni samabanga aphansi, iQondokuhle Primary esiseMlaza okuthiwa bamvulele icala lokweba njengoba bemsola ngokubaphoqa ukuthi bakhokhe imali yesikole kungafanele.Abazali abavuke banikela esiteshini samaphoyisa eMlaza emva kokuvala thaqa isikole, bathe uthishomkhulu ubakhokhisa u-R500 ngonyaka ingane ngayinye ngezingane zabo ezifunda u-Grade R, okuthe makhathaleni bathola ukuthi lokhu akuvumelekile kwazise isikole singaphansi kwezikole zikahulumeni okungakhokhwa kuzo. Kuthiwa umsolwa imali uyithatha esandleni.Omunye wabazali okhulume neSolezwe (onxuse ukungadalulwa), uthe banohlu olunamagama abazali evile kwangu-30 okusolwa ukuthi baqolwe uthishomkhulu, kanti abanye sebevele bamvulele amacala.ABAZALI bemi ngaphandle kwesiteshi samaphoyisa eMlaza izolo, beyovulela uthishomkhulu amacala Isithombe: SITHUNYELWE"Ngesikhathi kufika umhloli simazisa ngalolu daba, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi ayikho imali okumele ngabe ikhokhwa abazali ngaphandle uma kuyisivumelwano sabo, isigungu esilawula isikole nothisha. Kodwa ngisho amalungu esigungu esilawula isikole abehambisana nathi ngoba akwaziwa nokuthi uthishomkhulu imali ayithatha kubazali uyifaka nini ebhange kwazise ikhokhwa ngesandla. Ngaphandle kwalokho, abazali baphinde baphoqwe ukuthi bakhokhe u- R50 okuthiwa owefomu uma bebhalisa izingane zabo,” usho kanje.Kwenzeka lokhu nje abafundi bakulesi sikole abasalubhadi esikoleni kusuka ngoLwesithathu olwedlule, njengoba abazali namanye amalungu omphakathi bavuka bayovala esikoleni kukhalwa ngesimo senhlanzeko nokungaphumi kwamanzi kompompi okuthiwa sekunesikhathi eside, kanti akusukunyelwa."Amathoyilethi awasebenzi, nelilodwa elisebenzayo ligcwele izimpethu. Izingane ziyaphoqeleka ukuthi zisebenzise lona noma zishone emva kwamakilasi. Ayikho into engagugile, uphahla emakilasini, amawindi abhodlokile izingane aziphephile. Sikhulumile nomhloli ngalolu daba kodwa wathi akangene kakhulu enqubeni yesikole kodwa yena akubhekayo ukuthi kuyafundwa yini kuso,” kusho omunye.Ilungu lesigungu esilawula isikole (elicele ukungadalulwa), lithe lesi sikole kusuka ku-2016 kuhlehle, besamukela abafundi abangu- 1 300, kodwa selokhu uthishomkhulu ethathe izintambo ngo-2017 emva kokushona kowayenguthishomkhulu, isibalo sabazali abahambisa izingane zabo kuso besilokhu sehla njengoba kulo nyaka zingu- 389 kuphela izingane ezifunda kuso."Abazali bagcina sebebalekisa izingane beziyisa kwezinye izikole ngenxa yokungaphathi ngendlela kukathishomkhulu. Okunye osekusikhathaza ukuthi ngenxa yokwehla kwesibalo sezingane, umnyango usuthathe othisha abahlanu wabathumela kwezinye izikole, kanti kubona ababili sebevele bahambile, abathathu sebeqedela isikhathi sabo nje bazohamba kungekudala ngoba vele sebezitholile izincwadi ezibakhomba kwezinye izikole,” usho kanje.Kuze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela okhulumela umnyango uMnuz Muzi Mahlambi engakayiphenduli imibuzo athunyelelwe yona.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uConstable Thenjiswa Ngcobo, uthe amaphoyisa aseMlaza aphenye icala lokweba."Kusolwa ukuthi owesifazane oneminyaka engu-41 ukhokhe imali yesikole komunye wesifazane, okuthe ngokuhamba kwesikhathi wathola ukuthi bekungamele akhokhe,” kusho uConstable Ngcobo.
UMNYANGO wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal umemezele ukwelulwa kwezinkontileka zababhekele ezokuphepha nenhlanzeko ezikoleni.Ngokwesitatimande somnyango, abasebenzi abasiza ezikoleni zikahulumeni, izinkontileka zabo zokusebenza zizoqhubeka kuze kube uMashi ngonyaka ozayo.UMphathiswa walo Mnyango esifundazweni uNkk Mbali Frazer, uthe lokhu kwenzelwe ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abafundi bafundela ezindaweni ezihlanzekile neziphephile ezikoleni."Ngenxa yokubaluleka komsebenzi abawenzayo, izinkontileka zababhekele ukuphepha ezikoleni nabahlanzayo zeluliwe kuze kube wuMashi 31 ngonyaka ozayo."Okukhulu ngalokhu kwelulwa kwezinkontileka wukuthi abafundi bathola imfundo esezingeni, endaweni ehlanzekile nephephile,” usho kanje.Uthe lokhu kuzophinde kusize nabasebenzayo ukuthi baqhubeke nokuxosha ikati eziko. Umnyango uphinde waveza ukuthi zonke izikole sezizitholile izinsiza kufunda ezidingekayo, ebezisilele kuzo kunyakamali u-2023/2024.Phambilini kubekhona ungabazane mayelana nokulungela komnyango ukuqala ukufunda, njengoba bekubikwa izingqinamba ekudlulisweni kwemali yama- norms and standards ezikoleni ezinikezwe igunya lokuthi zizithengele zona izinsiza kufunda. " Ukudluliswa kwale mali kuzoqinisekisa ukusebenza ngendlela ezikoleni zakulesi sifundazwe nokuthi abafundi bathola imfundo esezingeni elifanele.” kusho uNkk Frazer.
UMSOLWA wesine ecaleni lokubulawa komrepha uKiernan 'AKA’ Forbes nomngani wakhe uTebello 'Tibz’ Motsoane ubuze inkantolo izolo ukuthi kungani uMfundo Gcaba engekho ebhentshini labasolwa.UMnuz Mziwethemba Harvey Gwabeni, osolwa ngokuba ngungqondongqondo kuleli cala ubuze lombuzo ngomlomo kammeli wakhe u-Advocate Paul Jorgensen omfundele incwadi efungelwe.Incwadi efungelwe kaGwabeni ibiphendula uMbuso owenza izethulo zokuthi kungani ungafuni uGwabeni nabanye abasolwa abane kuleli cala kungafanele badedelwe ngebheyili.Igama likaGcaba, ongusomabhizinisi odumile embonini yamatekisi lavela phambilini enkantolo, kuthiwa imali okusolwa ukuthi yayiyinkokhelo yokubulawa kuka-AKA noTibz yafakwa yinkampani yakhe (uGcaba) kwi-akhawunti kaGwabeni.Efunda incwadi kaGwabeni, uJorgensen uthe umbuso nguye ungqondongqondo ekubulaweni kwalaba ababili, wathi imali engu-R800 000 yafakwa kwi-akhawunti yakhe ukuze kukhokhelwe ukubulawa kwabo."Uma umbuso ukholelwa kulokhu, mina bengilindele ukuthi umbophe uMfundo Gcaba, naye azoba umsolwa kanye nathi,” kusho uJorgensen.Uqhube wathi kuze kube yimanje umbuso awukaze uchaze ukuthi yisiphi isizathu esenza ukuthi angaboshwa."Isizathu ukuthi abukho ubufakazi obuqinile obumyamanisa naleli cala,” kusho uJorgensen.Esekulo lelo phuzu ugcizelele ngelithi ukufakelana imali eyisamba kwakuhambisana nomsebenzi wenkampani yakhe yemayini. Uqhube wathi inkantolo ayikakwazi ukuveza ukuthi yini eyayingadala ukuthi yena noGcaba bafune u-AKA noTibz befile.Wathi uyavuma ukuthi wayifakelwa vele imali kodwa kwakungeyomsebenzi, waqhuba wathi wayichaza kwasolwa nabo ngomsebenzi ababemenzele wona."Ukuthi ngayithola ngosuku okwabulawa ngalo abafi nokuthi ngabe sengifakela uLindokuhle Ndimande uR133 000 khona lapho, kwaziqondanela nje,” kusho uJorgensen.UJorgensen uphinde wafunda isitatimende esathunyelwa wumndeni wakwaGcaba kwabezindaba lapho bechaza khona ukuthi ilungu labo, uMfundo linobudlelwano bezamabhizinisi noGwabeni, obungaqalanga ngesikhathi emfakela uR800 000 kodwa budala.Ngokwesitatimende uthe umndeni wakwaGcaba waveza ukuthi awukaze uthintwe ngamaphoyisa mayelana nodaba lwale mali uMfundo ayifakela uGwabeni.Waveza ukuthi uMfundo uthi ukulungele ukuthi azocacisa ngale mali nanoma yinini uma engabizwa ngamaphoyisa. Eziphendulela kolwezimoto okuthiwa zasetshenziswa ekubulaweni kwalaba ababili, iBMW nePolo, uthe kuyiqiniso ukuthi wayezibolekile enkampanini ebolekisa izimoto. Wathi njengoba umphenyi egqamisa ukuthi zasetsheziswa ekwenzeni icala, wehluleke wancama ukuvezela umbuso ukuthi ngesikhathi kwenzeka isigameko, kwase kuphele izinyanga aboleka lezi zimoto.IMantshi uMnuz Vincent Hlatshwayo ulihlehlisele uMay 2 icala ukuthi kwenziwe izethulo zokugcina phakathi kwabashushisi bombuso nabameli babasolwa.Angu-12 amacala abhekene nabasolwa, kuwona kukhona elokwakha itulo lokubulala, elokubulala u-AKA, elokubulala uTibz, elokutholakala nesibhamu ngokungemthetho, elokutholakala nezinhlamvu bese kuba ayisihlanu okuzama ukubulala namabili okushintshisana ngemali ngokungemthetho.
KUPHOTHULWA amalungiselelo okwethula umhlahlandlela weNFP wokhetho okulindeleke ukuthi ube soLundi ngesonto elizayo. Amaqembu amatasa alungiselela ukhetho lukazwelonke oluzoba ngoMeyi 29 nonyaka lapho okuzoqophiswana khona.Amaqembu amaningi asevele ayethulile imihlahlandlela yawo yokhetho futhi abebukeka egxile kakhulu esifundazweni KwaZulu-Natal esibukeka siyinyama.INFP ehlala ihlaselwe yizinkinga zombango ifakana ezinkantolo, ithi iyaya okhethweni futhi iphezu kwemizamo yokuphundla izinkinga eziyihlasele.Isiyikhokhile imali yokungenela ukhetho efunwa yi-IEC yalandela yonke imibandela. INFP ithe yasheshe yakhokha izama ukugwema ishobolo elayehlela ngo-2016 ngesikhathi yehlulwa wukungenela ukhetho lohulumeni basekhaya.Umsunguli weNFP ongasekho uNkk Zanele kaMagwaza-Msibi udabuka oLundi nokulapho umhlahlandlela weqembu uzokwethulelwa khona.UNkk kaMagwaza-Msibi ushone ngo-2021 emuva kokugula okwase kumphathe isikhathi eside.INFP ikhiphe isimemezelo sokuthi umhlahlandlela wayo wokhetho izowethula ngoMgqibelo ngo-Ephreli 20, oLundi lapho izochazela khona izwe ngezethembiso zayo.UMengameli weNFP uMnuz Ivan Barnes uthe umcimbi wokwethula umhlahlandlela uya oLundi kodwa basazama ukuqedela izinto ezimbalwa ngamalungiselelo.INFP eyihlubuka le-IFP yasungulwa ngo-2011 emuva kokuthi uNkk kaMagwaza-Msibi ekhonjwe indlela emva kokulahlwa ngamacala angaphakathi. Wayeyisethenjwa se-IFP ephethe isikhundla esiqavile sikasihlalo kazwelonke.Le liqembu liya okhethweni nje linezihlalo ezimbili ePhalamende likazwelonke kanti lizimisele ukubuyisa abalandeli nabavoti abalihlamukile.INFP ingenisa oLundi nje, idedelana ne-IFP ekade yethula umhlahlandlela wayo wokhetho wesifundazwe.Nayo ibikwenza lokhu lapho okudabuka khona umsunguli wayo ongasekho uMntwana waKwaPhindangene uMangosuthu Buthelezi.
KUBOSHWE abantu abangu-243 KwaZulu-Natal bathweswa amacala okudlwengula ngoMashi nonyaka.La basolwa bayingxenye yabantu abangu-9 522 abakhalelwe amasongo kaSigonyela esikhathini esifanayo.Amaphoyisa athi bangu-1 380 ababoshelwe amacala athinta izidakamizwa kwathi ababoshelwe ukudayisa utshwala ngokungemthetho baba ngu-445.Lokhu kuvezwe esitatimendeni esithunyelelwe kwabezindaba okhulumela amaphoyisa eKZN, uColonel Robert Netshiunda.Esikhathini esifanayo amaphoyisa ashaqe izibhamu ezingu-258 kuhlanganisa nezinhlokohlela ezingu-17 nezinhlamvu ezingu-3 000."Abasolwa abangu-167 baboshelwe amacala okubulala, kwathi abawu-137 kwaba awokuzama ukubulala. Abasolwa bayingxenye yabangu-3 156 ababoshelwe amacala abucayi,” kusho uNetshiunda.Kuphinde kwashaqwa imimese engu-463 nocelemba ababalelwa ku-22.UNetshiunda udalule ukuthi abasolwa abangu-148 baboshelwe amacala athinta ukugqekeza imizi nezindawo zamabhizinisi, ukuphanga kusetshenziswa indlakadla nawokuduna izimoto.
INKANTOLO yezoKhetho ichithe isinqumo senhlangano eyengamele ukhetho, i-Independent Electoral Commission (IEC), sokukhipha igama lowayengumengameli, uJacob Zuma, ohlwini lwabaya ePhalamende.Igama likaZuma lakhishwa ohlwini emva kwezikhalo zabantu ababethi uZuma akakulungele ukuya ePhalamende ngenxa yokuthi useke wagwetshwa izinyanga ezingu-15 ebhadla ejele.Umthetho awuvumi ukuthi umuntu oseke wagwetshwa isikhathi esingaphezu kwezinyanga ezingu-12 aphathe isikhundla kuhulumeni.UZuma wabe esekuphonsela inselelo ukukhishwa kwegama lakhe.Icala belilalelwe ngoMsombuluko.Amajaji amahlanu abelalele icala anqume ukuthi kwakungekho emthethweni ukukhishwa kwegama likaZuma ohlwini.Amajaji awasidalulanga isizathu sokuchitha isinqumo sokukhishwa kwegama likaZuma.
UKHUTHAZA ukuthi kube nokuthula kungabibikho ukuklwebhana nokungcofana okungenasidingo emabandleni umfundisi osemncane.UMfu Siphiwo Sithathu (34) ongumholi webandla, iCCM ukuKhanya Kokuthula uthe leli bandla elineminyaka emibili lasungulwa lakhiwe phezu kwesisekelo sokuthula noxolo.Uthe ukhuthaza okufanayo nakwamanye amabandla akhona KwaZulu Natal nakwezinye izifundazwe.USithathu uthe ukholwa ukuthi kungagwemeka nokuqembukelana kwebandla likaNkulunkulu uma kungase kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kuba nokuthula kweqiniso phakathi kwamakholwa.Echaza kabanzi ngalokhu uSithathu uthe : "Ngiwumholi osemmcane impela kodwa ngiyakholelwa kakhulu ekutheni ibandla likaNkulunkulu lidinga ukuthula noxolo ngaso sonke isikhathi. Uma ukuthula kungaba kuningi ngaphakathi ebandleni likaNkulunkulu kungaba kuningi kakhulu okungagwemeka.''Ukhuthaze nabaholi bamabandla ukuba bazi kabanzi ngezimo nangenhlalo abazalwane ababaholayo abazithola bebhekana nayo mihla namalanga.Uthe kumqoka ukuba abefundisi bakhuthazwe ngokuthi bazi kabanzi ngenhlalonhle yamakholwa abawaholayo."Uyazi ukuthi ayikho into ebuhlungu njengokukhonzisa umzalwane othule kodwa ongasho ukuthi unezinkinga. Ngikholwa ukuthi ibandla likaNkulunkulu lingangenela kube khona elikwenzayo ngenhloso yokubalekelela uma kunesidingo sokuba kwenzeke kanjalo,'' usho kanje.Uthe kubalulekile nokuthi abahola amabandla bahole ngendlela yokuthi kube lula kubazalwane abanezinkinga ukuthi bakhulume nabo ukuze nabahlwempu kube nendlela yokubalekelela.Abanezinkinga emishadweni nabo balulekwe, umzalwane akangadikwadikwa yizinkinga abaholi bamabandla nabanye abazalwane bekhona. Ukholwa wukuthi ibandla likaNkulunkulu likhonela nalokho, ukusiza ababuthakathaka. Uthe eminyakeni eyishumi ezayo ukhulekela ukuthi ibandla aliholayo libonakale likhula ngamandla.Uthe kodwa ekukhuleni kwalo akafuni ukuthi kube nomsindo kodwa ufuna ukuthi ukuthula kuqhubeke kube yisisekelo sokukhula kwebandla.
OWAYENGUMENGAMELI uMnzu uJacob Zuma, okungakacaci ukuthi uzogcina evunyelwe yini ukungenela ukhetho oluzayo, uthi akukho okuzomvimba ukuthi aphinde aphathe leli zwe.UZuma uthe uma abantu bakuleli bemcela ukuthi aphinde abe umengameli, uzovumela phezulu.Lokhu ukusho ngesikhathi kulalelwe icala lapho iMK imangamele inhlangano eyengamele ukhetho, i-Independent Electoral Commission (IEC), ikhala ngokukhishwa kukaZuma ohlwini lwabaholi abaya ePhalamende.Icala belilalelwe izolo eNkantolo yezoKhetho, isinqumo sizophuma namhlanje.Igama likaZuma, elivela phezulu ohlwini lweMK, lakhishwa ngemva kwezikhalazo zabantu ababekhononda ngokuthi umthetho awumvumeli uZuma ukuthi aye ePhalamende.Umthetho awumvumeli umuntu oke wagwetshwa isikhathi esingaphezu kwezinyanga ezingu-12 ebhadla ejele ukuba angenele ukhetho.Ngo-2021 uZuma walahlwa yicala lokudelela umyalelo weNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo.UZuma utshele abebezomeseka ngaphandle kwenkantolo ukuthi i-IEC ayinawo amandla okukhipha igama lwakhe ohlwini, wathi iPhalamende kuphela elingakhipha igama lakhe."Umsebenzi we-IEC ukuthi babale amavoti, bese beyasho ukuthi ngubani owinile. Umsebenzi wabo uphela lapho.Kabayeke ukwenza umsebenzi okufanele wenziwe iPhalemende.”UZuma, owakhishwa kwesikamengameli singakapheli isikhathi sakhe, uthe awukho umthetho omvimba ukuthi aphinde abe umengameli.Uthe nakuba uMthethosisekelo uthi akekho umuntu ovumelekile ukuthi aphathe isikhathi esingaphezu kwamahlandla amabili, akekho ongama endleleni yakhe uma evotelwa ngabantu."Phela sibuswa ngentandoyeningi, akekho umuntu ongavimba intandoyeningi.”UZuma uthe isigaba soMthethosisekelo asimchaphazeli yena ngoba waphuma engakaliqedi ihlandla lesibili, futhi akamele i-ANC okhethweni oluzayo."Abantu bayakhohlwa ukuthi mina ngakhishwa lapha ngingakaqedi. Kukhona into engisafuna ukuyiqedela lapha. Akekho ozongivimba. Ngeke basithinte laba. Abasazi, basizwa ngendaba.”Ngesikhathi kuqulwa icala, i-IEC ithe iMK yayivele icuphe uchuku ngokufaka igama likaZuma ohlwini lwabaya ePhalamende.Emaphepheni asenkantolo i-IEC ithe abeMK bafaka igama likaZuma ekubeni bazi kahle kamhlophe ukuthi umthetho awumvumeli uZuma ukuba angenele ukhetho.Abe-IEC bathe kuyabakhathaza ukuthi kube namalungu eMK asabisa ngodlame uma uZuma ekhishwa ohlwini.Insongo zenziwa amalungu eMK aqavile, umholi wophiko lwentsha, uBonginkosi Khanyile, novela ohlwini lwabaya ePhalamende, uMnuz Visvin Reddy.Abe-IEC bathe izinsongo zikhombisa ukuthi abeMK bacuphe uchuku. Kepha lokhu kuchithiwe ngummeli weMK, u-Advocate Dali Mpofu, osole i-IEC ngokuzama ukungcolisa igama likaZuma neleMK.UMpofu uthe i-IEC ikhombisa ukuba nenkinga noZuma. Uthe umthetho awumvimbi uZuma ukuthi angenele ukhetho ngoba akazange adonse izinyanga ezingaphezu kwezingu-12 esejele.Isigwebo sikaZuma sahoxiswa nguMengameli wezwe uCyril Ramaphosa, esadonse izinyanga ezintathu.Ummeli we-IEC, u-Advocate Tembeka Ngcukaitobi, uthe ukuthi uZuma wadedelwa engakasiqedi isigwebo sakhe akukushintshi ukuthi wagwetshwa izinyanga ezingu-15.UNgcukaitobi uthe uRamaphosa akanawo amandla okunciphisa isigwebo sikaZuma, wathi inkantolo kuphela engakwazi ukusinciphisa.Uthe uZuma kufanele alinde iminyaka emihlanu ukuze akwazi ukungenela ukhetho.
LIGWETSHWE kanzima iphoyisa elilahlwe yicala lokudlwengula usingandodakazi walo.Leli phoyisa lase-East London livulelwe icala wumalumekazi kamgilwa ngemuva kokuthi unina wengane naye oyiphoyisa oshade nomsolwa ehlulekile ukuvulela umyeni wakhe icala yize ingane imazisile ngalokhu. Kuthiwa izigameko zokunukubeza ngokocansi zenzeka phakathi kuka-2018 no-2021 ziqala ngesikhathi umgilwa eneminyaka engu-13 ubudala.Leli cala ladluliselwa ophikweni oluphenya amacala amaphoyisa i-IPID waboshwa kanjalo uSergeant oneminyaka engu-53 ubudala. Lolu phiko luveze ukuthi umalumekazi kamgilwa uyena olandele inqubo yaleli cala, kwaze kwaba sekugcineni.Lo Sergeant ugwetshwe iminyaka engu-25 ngecala lokudlwengula neminyaka emihlanu ngamacala amabili okunukubeza ngokocansi. Lezi zigwebo uzozodonsa kanye kanye.Umkakhe ongunina wengane ugwetshwe iminyaka emihlanu ebhadla ejele noma akhokhe inhlawulo kaR5000 ngokuhluleka wukubika lawa macala esetsheliwe ngawo.
INHLANGANO yodokotela iSouth African Medical Association (SAMA), ithi iphoxekile ngendlela uMnyango wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal osingathe ngayo udaba lokuqashwa kodokotela asebephothule izifundo abangaqashiwe.Usihlalo wale nhlangano uDkt Mvuyisi Mzukwa, uthe labo dokotela abakatholelwa izikhala yize uNgqongqoshe wezeMpilo uDkt Joe Phaahla athembisa ukuthi kuzoshaya u-Ephreli 1 sebeqashiwe."Odokotela bayashoda ezikhungweni zezempilo ekubeni befunde ngemali yabakhokhi bentela. Uhulumeni lolu daba akalusingethe ngendlela. Sibhekene nabantu abangenalo iqiniso kusukela phezulu kuwo uMnyango wezeMpilo."UNgqongqoshe wayethe uzokhuluma nezifundazwe ngalolu daba kodwa kuze kube manje akucaci ukuthi bazoqashwa nini. Kusho ukuthi njengoba kuza ukhetho ongqongqoshe bakhuluma noma yini."Lento idala ukuthi kube nemibhikisho efana nalo oseMgungundlovu. Siyabeseka odokotela abaqhinqe ngaphambi kwehhovisi likaMphathiswa wezeMpilo eKZN, uNksz Nomagugu Simelane futhi sizobajoyina nathi ukuze abakulwelayo kube nesigqi," kusho uMzukwa.UDkt Busisiwe Mancotywa osekomitini elibhekelele odokotela abangaqashiwe eKZN uthe kusukela ngoFebhruwari bangu-17 odokotela baKwaZulu-Natal asebeqashiwe osekwenze ukuthi isibalo sisuke ku-187 siye ku-170."Lesi sibalo sincane kakhulu kunalokho ebesikulindele. Siyabonga kulabo abasesekayo kuhlanganisa neminikelo ngezinto eziningi esizidingayo njengoba sihleli ngaphambi kwehhovisi likaMphathiswa wezeMpilo," kusho yena.UDkt Thuba Nkabinde uthe kusukela beqhinqe kuleli hhovisi babe nemihlangano emibili nenhloko yomnyango uDkt Sandile Tshabalala, kodwa akukabikhona abavumelene ngakho."Sisazoqhubeka nokuhlala lapha kuze kube sithola esathenjiswa khona," kusho uNkabinde.Umnyango wezempilo, uthe uNdunankulu wakulesi sifundazwe uzokwenza isitatimende ngalou daba.
KUMNYAMA kubantu abalinganiselwa ku-87 abashelwe yimijondolo ebalelwa ku-52 eSiyathuthuka, eKenville, eThekwini, ngoMgqibelo.Ngokusho kosekomitini le-ward kule ndawo, uMnuz Mashinini Nkosi, akukacaci ukuthi yini ebe yimbangela yomlilo.Ekhuluma neSolezwe, uchaze ukuthi uphathiswe uphiko lwezinhlekelele kule ndawo, wathi ngesikhathi eyihambela uthole ukuthi yize kungafanga muntu, futhi engekho olimele kodwa abantu baphume nebebekugqokile kuphela.Uthe emva kokuthintwa kwekhansela lendawo kanjalo nophiko lwezinhlekelele ngaphansi kukaMasipala weTheku, abagilwa bathole usizo lwezingubo zokulala, izipontshi nokudla.Umlilo ubusha ubuhanguhangu emijondolo yaseKenville eThekwini kwasala dengwane inqwaba yabangu Isithombe: SithunyelweNokho ukhale ngokuthi bagcine belala emnyango."Sibone imvula kanjalo nokwanda kwezigameko zobugebengu, ngathinta iziphathimandla, zathembisa ukuthi kuzolethwa itende ukuthi balale kulo abantu kodwa ligcine lingafikanga,” kulandisa uNkosi.Uqhube wathi okubakhathazayo ukuthi abantu abaphephile nhlobo kule ndawo njengoba bebulawa mihla namalanga."Sinovalo lokuthi bangagetshengwa njengoba behleli emnyango,” kusho yena.Uthe kwaziswe noMnyango wezokuHlaliswa kwaBantu kuzwelonke, nathi uvame ukusiza abashelwe ngempahla yokwakha ukuze bavuse imijondolo yabo, wathi nokho bebengakezwa mpendulo kuwona kodwa badinga usizo masinyane ngoba abantu abakwazi ukuqhubeka bahlale esigangeni.Ukhale ngokuthi sekungokwesikhombisa kusha umlilo endaweni eyodwa kule mijondolo.Ebalula isintu, uthe kwasha ingane kule ndawo, yashona kanye noyise maqede imiphefumulo yabo yangalandwa.Uthe kuleso sigameko ngesikhathi isha ingane ngaphakathi emjondolo, uyise wathi uyazama ukuyikhipha, naye washa."Ingane yashonela endaweni yesigameko, kwathi yena washonela esibhedlela. Lesi sigameko senzeka eminyakeni emine edlule,” kulandisa uNkosi.Uthe basola ukungalandwa kwemiphefumulo yabo ngalo mlilo ohlasela uphindelela endaweni eyodwa.Ikhansela lendawo, uMnuz Ashok Maharajh, lithe yize lingakayihambeli indawo yesigameko, kodwa libikelwe ngaso."Ngiwuthintile ngokushesha umasipala, ngizwa ngabasekomitini ukuthi bafikile abezinhlekelele belethe olunye usizo, kwaphinde kwafika nabenhlangano engenzinzuzo iRed Cross nabo belethe usizo,” kusho uMaharajh.Uthe okumkhathazayo ukuthi bebengakalutholi usizo lwenye indawo yokuthi bafihle amakhanda."Bengingakatholi mpendulo kumasipala ngalokho,” kusho uMaharajh.Uthembisile ukuthi uzoya kobabheka abagilwa uma ephuma emhlanganweni ntambama izolo.
IYOGA iyalekelela ukwazi ukumelana nengcindezi edalwa yizinkinga eziningi ezivelayo ngesikhathi ukhula.Lokhu kushiwo uBongani Luthuli ofundisa iYoga enhlanganweni iSivananda World Peace Foundation, ngesikhathi kwethulwa ngokusemthethweni izinhlelo zokulungiselela usuku lweYoga emhlabeni, iWorld Yoga Day eba minyaka yonke ngoJuni 21, eThekwini, ngeSonto.Uthe unyaka wesishiyagalolunye enza iYoga esimsize ekutheni akwazi ukulawula ulaka nengcindezi abebhekana nayo ngenxa yezinkinga zokukhula."Sengiphakathi ngabona ukuthi kunesidingo sokuthi nami ngifundise abantu bakithi ukuthi iYoga iyisikhali esingakusiza ekutheni ubhekane nengcindezi empilweni, ikusize ekutheni umqondo wakho ukwazi ukucabanga ngendlela," kusho uLuthuli.UNKK Thobile Njapha efundiswa uBongani Luthuli ukuthi yenziwa kanjani iYoga ngesikhathi kwethulwa ngokusemthethweni izinhlelo zokulungiselela iWorld Yoga Day eba njalo ngoJuni, izolo, eThekwini ISITHOMBE: PHILI MJOLI Lezi zinhlelo zizokwenziwa esifundazweni iKwaZulu-Natal ukuze kufundiswe umphakathini ukuthi iYoga ibaluleke kanjani nokuthi yenziwa kanjani.UMnuz Ishwar Mabheka Zulu Ramlutchman wale nhlangano, uthe kulo nyaka kuzobe kuphela iminyaka eyishumi, inhlangano yezizwe, i-United Nations yabeka usuku lweyoga emhlabeni."Kulo nyaka sizogxila kakhulu ezikoleni ukuze sifundise abafundi ukuthi bangayisebenzisa kanjani iYoga ukuze bakwazi ukubhekana nezifundo zabo bangabi nengcindezi novalo. Abantu abadala nabo ngeke sibashiye ngaphandle ngoba iyabasiza kakhulu belule imisipha baphinde balwe nezifo ezingamahlalakhona. Okusempeleni iYoga ilungele wonke umuntu kodwa bakhona ewusizo kakhulu kubo njengalaba esengibabalile," kusho uRamlutchman.UNkkThobile Njapha (55) waseNanda obeqala ukujoyina iYoga izolo, uthe uphathwa yisifo samathambo, ujwayele ukusebenza engadini. Ululekwe ngabanye abantu endaweni ukuthi ajoyine iYoga ukuze abone ukuthi ngeke yini imsize."Kusenzinyana khona ngoba bengingajwayele ukwelula umzimba wami ngendlela esifundiswa yona kodwa ngiyethemba ukuthi kuzogcina kujwayeleka," kusho yena.UXolani Radebe waseNtuzuma ofundisa ukwenza iYoga, uthe abantu abamnyama bazitshela ukuthi iYoga into yamaNdiya kanti into esiza umzimba wawo wonke umuntu."Sengibhale nencwadi efundisa ngeYoga ngesiZulu ngoba nathi singabantu abamnyama siyadinga ukuthi siyiqonde kahle ukuthi iyini. Uma sengithole uxhaso ngizoyishicilela," kusho uRadebe.
ABAHOLI be-IFP bathembise ukuhamba ezinyathelweni zomsunguli weqembu ongasekho, Inkosi Mangosuthu Buthelezi, uma benqoba ukhetho KwaZulu-Natal.Abaholi be-IFP nomndeni wakwaButhelezi bazibophezele ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi izifiso zikaButhelezi ziyafezwa.Lokhu bakwenze ngesikhathi kunomcimbi wokwethula umqulu wezethembiso zokhetho obuhlelwe ubuholi be-IFP KwaZulu-Natal.Umcimbi ubusePrince Mangosuthu Buthelezi, oLundi, ngeSonto.Ogaqele isikhundla sikandunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, uthe bafuna ukuthi imizamo kaButhelezi yokuthuthukisa isifundazwe ingashabalali.Kuzobe kungokokuqala i-IFP iya okhethweni uButhelezi engasekho."Namuhla njengamalungu eNkatha nesizwe, ngaphandle koMntwana ongasekho phakathi kwethu, simelwe wukuthatha isinqumo. Lesi sinqumo akusona nje esethu kuphela kepha ngesezizukulwane ezizayo. Ukwenza, nokungenzi kwethu nonyaka lapho siya okhethweni kuyoqopha lokho esikufisayo ngesikhathi sethu kanjalo nalokho esikufisela izizukulwane ezizayo.”UNtuli wethule amaphuzu aw-15 abazowabeka eqhulwini uma benqoba ukhetho KwaZulu-Natal.Uthe bafuna ukubuyisela ezomnotho ezandleni zabantu bendawo ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi izipaza namanye amabhizinisi amancane kuphathwa abantu bakuleli.Uthe bafuna ukuvuselela kabusha ibhange iThala."UMntwana wakwaPhindangene nohulumeni owawuholwa yiNkatha wasungula ibhange labantu abampisholo iThala, ukulekelela kakhulu abantu ezindaweni zasemakhaya nasemalokishini, ukusungula amabhizinisi, okwaholela ekudalweni kwamathuba emisebenzi. "Uhulumeni lona okhona we-ANC usuhluleke wancama ukuqhuba umbono wokusungulwa kwebhange iThala. IThala lingumbono we IFP owehlukile kuyoyonke i-Ningizimu Afrika. Uhulumeni we-ANC lapha KwaZulu-Natal usubeke leli bhange engozini yokuthi livalwe, emva kweminyaka abaholi be-ANC bezicebisa bona kanye nobhululu babo. Uhulumeni we-IFP, uzokhuphula izinga laleli bhange, libe yibhange likahulumeni, elinomsebenzi omqoka wokufukula abantu bakithi emakhaya nasemalokishini.”UNtuli ukhale ngokuzithwala kwabaholi abaphethe uhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal, wathi bahluleka ukuzithoba ngisho naphambi kweSilo.Ubalule isigameko lapho uMphathiswa wezokuThuthukiswa koMnotho, uMnuz Siboniso Duma, ahlwitha undunankulu kaZulu, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, umbhobho phambi kweSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini.UNtuli uthe uDuma wakhombisa ukuzithwala."Ungqongqoshe ophucana umbhobho. Ukube ulana mhlawu,be ngabe nami usengiphucile umbhobho. Ngiyathemba namuzwa epikla phambi kweSilo, ethi uhulumeni unamandla. Uma sesingene emandleni, sizokuqeda lokhu kokuzithwala.”Inkosi uNtuthukoyezwe Zuzifa Buthelezi, uthe bazoqhubeka nokulwela izifiso zikaButhelezi."Sizolokhu sisebenza nani, sizolokhu simile lapho uMntwana asishiya khona.”Uthe abakungabazi ukuthi i-IFP izonqoba KwaZulu-Natal."Asinalo uvalo ngawe njengoba ukhethiwe. Siyazi ukuthi njengoba kuzovotwa ngomhla ka-29, uzongena.”IMeya kaMasipala wesifunda iZululand, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, ithe bazolanda amandla oLundi, okuyindawo okulele kuyo uButhelezi.
SIDIDEKILE esinye sezikhulu zikaMasipala waseJozini kwezokuXhumana esingasaholi njengoba sithi lokhu kwenzeka ngoba senqaba "ukujabulisa" uMnuz Mfananaye Mathe oyiMeya kuloMasipala.UNkk Sinenhlanhla Mthembu waseMthunzini, eMpangeni ugeqe amagula ngakubize ngokuhlukumezeka kwakhe athe bekuvela kwimeya, uMathe athi kwasuka ekutheni wathi kumele nakanjani "amjabulise''.Uthi akazange aqonde ukuthi uma ekhuluma ngokumjabulisa ukhuluma ngokocansi noma ufuna amnikeze imali.Ngokusho kwalo wesifazane, ukuhlukumezeka kulo masipala uqale ukukuthola ngesikhathi esanda kuwujoyina ngo-2021."IMeya uMathe yangitshela emehlweni ukuthi yona ufuna ukujatshuliswa yimina. Lento eqala ukuyisho ngangizitshela ukuthi uyadlala."Kodwa kuthe uma eqhubeka eyisho ngaqaphela ukuthi uyisho nje akadlali,'' kusho uNkk Mthembu.Ngokusho kwakhe uthi lo myalezo wawuthola esesibhedlela futhi egula kakhulu nokuyikhona okwenza ukuthi aphuze ukuthi awuthole."Lo myalezo ngawuthola emva kwesikhathi ngenxa yokuthi ngangigula kakhulu. Kuthe sengizama ukubuyela kuyena wathi mangingabe ngisazihlupha futhi mangimane ngicishe inombolo yakhe ocingweni lwami naye futhi uzokwenza kanjalo,''echaza.Uthi kusukela lapho impilo imane yanzima kakhulu ethola ukuhlukumezeka okungapheli emsebenzini. "Kusukela lapho bengihlukunyezwa ngize ngizibuze ukuthi ngoneni le engaka,'' ebalisa.Uthi kuthe esababaza ukuhlukunyezwa akutholayo ehhovisi lemeya wabona ephepheni sekukhangiswe ngomsebenzi wakhe ukuthi kudingeka ozowenza.''Ngempela wafika ozokwenza umsebenzi wami, mina kwathiwa mangiphume ehhovisi ngibone ukuthi ngisebenzela kuphi ngaphakathi ebhilidini likamasipala. "Kusukela lapho-ke bengisebenza ngaphandle kwehhovisi. Ngigcine sengiduba ngase ngithatha isinqumo sokuba ngimane ngisebenzele emotweni,'' usho kanje.Ukhala kakhulu ngokuthi umholo wakhe kawusangeni ekubeni esangumsebenzi kamasipala. Uthe uzamile ukuxhumana nabengamele izindaba zabasebenzi ngaphakathi kodwa kwanhlanga zimuka nomoya.Utshelwa ukuthi kunomyalelo wokuthi umholo wakhe awungaphumi, kodwa isizathu asicaci ngoba akaxoshiwe futhi akukho nkundla yokuqondiswa kwezisebenzi ayihambayo. Uthi utholile ukuthi imali yakhe ayingeni ngenxa yokuthi waxabana nemeya, kodwa wenqaba ukulandisa kabanzi ngokuthi lokho ukuzwe ngobani.Uveze ukuthi udaba useludlulisele kwaCCMA bazohlangana khona ngesonto elizayo.Leli phephandaba linawo amaphepha aqinisekisa ukuthi udaba lwalo wesifazane nemeya bazohlangana enkantolo yabasebenzi ngoLwesine. Eziphendulela uMathe uthe wayezoze acele ukujatshuliswa umsebenzi nje yingobani? Uthe yena njengomeya akanalo ilungelo lokuthi angaxhumana nomsebenzi.Wathi futhi akazi ukuthi kunomsebenzi osekuphele izinyanga imali yakhe ingangeni. "Ukube kukhona into enjengaleyo ngabe sekufinyelelile ezindlebeni zami,'' usho kanje.
BANGAPHEZU kuka-150 abasolwa abadutshulwe babulawa amaphoyisa eNingizimu Afrika kusuka ngo-Ephreli 2023.Lokhu kuvezwe esithangamini nabezindaba ePitoli ngeSonto nguNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa, uMnuz Bheki Cele.Esikhathini esifanayo, angu-109 amaphoyisa adutshulwe abulawa. UCele uthe iningi lamaphoyisa libulawe lingekho emsebenzini uma kuqhathaniswa nangu-36 asocongwe enza umsebenzi wawo.UCele uthe sekuboshwe abasolwa abangu-83 ngamacala athinta ukubulawa kwamaphoyisa."Ukufa komuntu noma ngabe ubani akumele kube yinto ejatshulelwayo. Kodwa ukujabula komphakathi emuva kokubulawa kweqembu lemigulukudu KwaZulu-Natal (eMariannhill) naseMpumalanga kukutshela into ethile,” kusho uCele.Ugcizelele ukuthi alikho iphoyisa okumele life liphethe isibhamu ngesandla.Ube esewakhuthaza ukuthi ahlale eqaphile, avikele imiphakathi nawo uqobo futhi asiqinise isandla uma elwa nobugebengu.Uphinde wakhipha izibalo ezithinta imikhankaso yamaphoyisa ekulweni nobugebengu nasekuzuzile.UCele uthe ingu-1 171 imikhankaso ehleliwe yamaphoyisa esezingeni eliphezulu ababe nayo. Kuyona kuboshwe abasolwa abangu-3 749."Lapha kubalwa abasolwa abangu-173 ababoshelwe amacala okubulala, abangu-57 ngamacala okugwazisa nokuthumba. Abawu-768 baboshelwe ukutholakala nezibhamu ezingekho emthethweni, u-488 uboshelwe ukuphanga kwathi abangu-79 baboshelwa ukubamba imoto yemali,” kusho uCele.Uqhube wathi abasolwa abangu-1 510 nabangu-214 baboshelwe amacala ezidakamizwa nathinta ukuvukuza ezimayini okungekho emthethweni.Uveze nokuthi bevile ku-500 000 abantu ababoshiwe ngamacala ehlukene kusuka ngoMeyi 2023 kwethulwa i-Operation Shanela.Uthe bashaqe impahla yenani likaR6.2 million, bahlakaza izidleke ezingu-16 okukhiqizwa kuzona izidakamizwa zenani elinguR161 million. Uveze nokuthi emikhankasweni yoKlebe kushaqwe izidakamizwa ezingabiza uR506 million kwaboshwa abasolwa abangu-148.Ngempelasonto uCele ubesoThongathi, eThekwini emngcwabeni wephoyisa uSergeant Sibongiseni Khoza (37) odutshulwe wafa esemsebenzini eSundumbili.UKhoza ushiye emhlabeni abantwana ababili, oneminyaka engu-12 nomunye oneyisithupha. UCele usongele izigebengu wathi asikho esizogila imikhuba bese siyolala endlini sibhekise amadolo phezulu.
