Kulindeleke ukuthi udaba lubuyele namuhla eNkantolo yeMantshi kwaManzini lapho okuzodingidwa khona lolu daba.Uhulumeni wakuleli wakuqinisekisa ukuthi usithumelile isicelo sokubuyiswa kwalaba balisa. Kulindeleke ukuthi uma udaba lungena ngoLwesibili abameli babo baphendule kwelokuthi bayasiphikisa yini isicelo sokubuyiswa kwabo noma cha.Izimpendulo zabo yizona ezingase zikhombe indlela ngokubuyiswa kwabo. Ngaphandle kwecala lokufa kuka-AKA, amaphoyisa athi kukhona namanye amacala abathinteka kuwona laba balisa okufanele bathweswe wona uma befika kuleli.
ELULWE ngamahora amahlanu, amahora okusebenza kwamahhovisi oMnyango wezaseKhaya ngemiGqibelo kuze kushaye usuku lokuvota. UMnyango wezaseKhaya, uthe amahhovisi awo azovulwa ngemiGqibelo kusukela ngo-8 ekuseni kuze kushaye u-1 emini okuqale ngoMgqibelo esiphuma kuwo kuze kube uMeyi 25.UMnyango wezaseKhaya esitatimendeni osithumelele abezindaba, uthe amahhovisi azobe evuliwe azokwazi ukuxazulula izinkinga zezinombolo zomazisi ezifanayo ezisetshenziswa ngabantu abangaphezulu koyedwa, kuchitshiyelwa imininingwane ethile kubo omazisi, ukulungiswa kwabo, omazisi abakhomba ukuthi abanikazi bashonile bebe bengashonanga bazolungiswa uma kunamaphepha aphelele akhomba ukuthi abanikazi bawo bayaphila, ukufakwa kwezicelo ezintsha zomazisi, nomazisi besikhashana. Iphini likaNgqongqoshe wezaseKhaya, uMnuz Njabulo Nzuza, lithe kuzobe kunamahhovisi angomahamba nendlwana ahlelelwe ukuthi ahambise omazisi ezindaweni ezikude namahhovisi."Sizosebenzisa amahhovisi amakhansela, neminye iminyango esisebenzisana nayo ukuze silethe usizo eduze kodwa umphakathi uzokwaziswa ngezinsuku esizofika ngazo ezindaweni ezihlonziwe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izakhamuzi zisengabhukha isikhathi sokuzolanda ama-Smart ID Cards kanye nezincwadi zomazisi abaluhlaza ngaphambi kokuvakashela emahhovisi ngokusebenzisa i-Branch Appointment Booking System , etholakala kwi-website yoMnyango wezaseKhaya i-www.dha.gov.za, noma bavakashele emahhovisi ngaphandle kokubhukha,” kusho uNzuza.Unxuse abafake izicelo zomazisi ikakhulukazi intsha eqalayo ukuzifaka ukuba beze emahhovisi omnyango bazolanda omazisi babo.
OKLEBE KwaZulu-Natal basindise amadoda ayisithupha abebikwe ukuthi athunjiwe, abopha abasolwa ababili ngempelasonto.Abasolwa abaneminyaka engu-33 nengu-41, kulindeleke ukuthi bavele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMgungundlovu, ngoLwesibili.Okhulumela oKlebe KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant Colonel Simphiwe Mhlongo, uthe abasolwa baboshwe ngoMgqibelo eNewlands West."Abagilwa abayisithupha bahlengwe ngempumelelo eNewlands futhi uphenyo lwethu esilwenzayo luyaqhubeka,” kusho uMhlongo.Uqhube wathi ngokolwazi abanalo bewoKlebe, ayikho imali ekhokhwe abagilwa kulabo abebekade bebathumbile ukuze bakhululwe.Kubikwa ukuthi ithimba lamaphoyisa ezinhlaka ezehlukene nonogada bakaMagma Security and Investigations bebe yingxenye yokuboshwa kwabasolwa obekwenziwa oKlebe.Kuthiwa abagilwa babekade kubikwe ukuthi bathunjiwe ngesonto eledlule, base beyogqunywa emzini thize oseNewlands West, eThekwini.Kolunye udaba, ubuholi bamaphoyisa kuzwelonke buveze ukukhathazeka kwabo ngokubize ngokwanda kwezigameko ezibikwayo zokuthunjwa kwezakhamuzi, abantu abadumile nosomabhizinisi.UNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa, uMnuz Bheki Cele, izolo esePitoli, uthe nakuba isimo sinjena kodwa uyancomeka umsebenzi owenziwa amaphoyisa asekhaleni lempi yokuhlakaza lobu bugebengu.UCele uveze ukuthi oKlebe sebebophe abasolwa abangu-62. "Kukhona abasolwa abangu-55 ababoshelwe icala lokuthumba amaChina. Abanye abasolwa abahlanu baboshelwe icala lokuthumba abantu abadabuka ezweni iMozambique,” kusho uCele.
IMGIXABEZE ngodilikajele iNkantolo yesiFunda yaseMadadeni owesilisa olahlwe elokudlwengula isaguga (73) oSizweni ngoNovemba 2017.Owesilisa, uSizwe Gift Zwane (30) uphinde wanikwa iminyaka emibili ngaphezulu ngokulahlwa yicala lokugqekeza ngenhloso yokwenza icala.Elandisa ngokwenzeka ngosuku lwesigameko, okhulumela iNational Prosecuting Authority (NPA), uNkk Natasha Ramkisson-Kara, uthe umgilwa wayesendlini yakhe ngesikhathi uZwane egqekeza."Umgilwa wambuza uZwane ukuthi ufunani, kodwa kunokuthi amphendule wavele wambhozomela, wamdlwengula,” kusho uNkk Ramkisson-Kara.Uqhube wathi umgilwa waphunyuka, wabaleka, wayobiza indodakazi yakhe."Umgilwa nendodakazi yakhe, bambona uZwane esebaleka,” kuchaza uNkk Ramkissson-Kara.Uveze ukuthi umgilwa wabe eseyiswa esiteshini samaphoyisa lapho afika khona wavula icala.Eqhuba uthe umgilwa wabe esedluliselwa esikhungweni iThuthuzela yakhona eMadadeni ukuze ayohlolwa kuqinisekiswe ukuthi udlwenguliwe yini aphinde anikwe nosizo lokwelulekwa ngokomqondo.Uthe ngesikhathi kuqulwa icala enkantolo, uMshushisi woMbuso uCindy Alberts uhole ubufakazi bakhe umgilwa, obendodakazi yakhe kanjalo nombiko owabhalwa odokotela emva kokuxilonga umgilwa."UZwane, ngomlomo wommeli wakhe wazama ukubuphikisa ubufakazi bukamgilwa, ethi amehlo kungenzeka ukuthi awabonanga kahle ngoba usegugile. Yize kunjalo umgilwa wakwazi ukwenaba ngesibazi esasibukeka njengesibazi sokusha ngemumva kwendlebe kaZwane,” kusho uNkk Ramkisson-Kara.Uthe umgilwa wacacisa enkantolo ukuthi isibazi wasibona kahle ngesikhathi uZwane emdlwengula."Inkantolo iyalele ukuthi igama lakhe lifakwe ohlwini lwabahlukumeza ngokocansi, yaphinde yanquma ukuthi akumfanele ukuba nesibhamu,” usho kanje.Uphethe ngelithi beyiNPA, bayasamukela isigwebo, wathi kuwumsebenzi wabo ukushushisa, bamele bonke abangabagilwa bobugebengu.
NKOSIKHONA CELELigubhe ukuhlanganisa iminyaka engu-66 laba khona ibandla, iHoly Sabath Church of God in Zion elaziwa kakhulu ngeleMighty Christian.Leli bandla lasungulwa ngo-1958 ngu-Archbishop Lazarus Swazi Kunene ongasekho emhlabeni.Njengamanje seliholwa nguMbhishobhi Sibongiseni Kunene oyindodana kamsunguli webandla.Linamagatsha amaningi KwaZulu-Natal nase-Eastern Cape. UMbhishobhi Kunene ophinde abe nguthishanhloko waseQiniselani Primary School eMbumbulu, uveze ukuthi leli bandla kokunye elikubeka eqhulwini wukubaluleka kwezemfundo kubantu abasha."Siyakholelwa kakhulu ekutheni njengoba ibandla lihlanganisa iminyake ngu-66 kumele indaba yezemfundo ibekwe phambili ngaso sonke isikhathi."Lokhu sikholwa ukuthi kungasilekelela kakhulu ukuze sibe nebandla elinabantu abasha abanekusasa eliqhakazile,'' usho kanje.Okunye akubalulile wukukhuliswa ngendlela efanele kukaSontosikole waleli bandla.Usebenzise amagama esiZulu athi ugotshwa usemanzi. Wathi ngalokho uzama ukuveza ukuthi kumqoka kangakanani ukuthi leli bandla lenze isiqiniseko esikhulu sokuthi libakhulisa ngendlela efanele abantwana abancane.Phakathi kokunye athe bafuna ibandla ligxile kakhulu kukhona, wukulwa nesihlava sokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane."Kumqoka ukuthi leli bandla kusuka manje kuya phambili libonakale kuba khona elikwenzayo ngenhloso yokunqanda isihlava sokuhlukunyezwa kwamantombazane nezingane,'' usho kanje.UMbhishobhi Kunene uganwe nguNkk Thabisile Kunene (uMaCele).
SEKUPHENDUKE insakavukela umchilo wesidwaba ukuthi njalo uma kuvulwa izikhungo zemfundo ephakeme, kube nemibhikisho yezitshudeni, kwesinye isikhathi ehambisana nokucekelwa phansi kwempahla kulezi zikhungo.Ngalesi sikhathi izikhungo zandisa onogada abazimele, zigqigqa ezinkantolo zithole incwadi evimbela izitshudeni ukuthi zibhikishe, ukuze zingacekeli phansi impahla.Umonakalo odalwa yilezi ziteleka ushaya ephaketheni izikhungo ngoba kusuke kuzobiza imali eshisiwe uma sekulungiswa impahla ecekelwe phansi.Okusuke kuseqhulwini lwezikhalazo zezitshudeni, phakathi kokunye kuthinta isikhwama esixhasa ngemali yokufunda iNational Students’ Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS). Noma izikhungo zingazama kanjani ukuxazulula le nkinga ngaphambi kokuba kuvulwe, kodwa umsindo uhlale uzosuka.Izitshudeni zisuke zikhala ngokuthi azilutholanga uxhaso, ezinye azikaphendulwa kwaze kwavulwa, okwenza ukuthi zingakwazi ukubhalisa. Muva nje isikhalo kube ngukuhamba kancane kohlelo lwezikhungo lokuthi zihambise uhlu lwezitshudeni ezizobhaliswa ukuze zikwazi ukuthola uxhaso.Indaba egudwini kube nawuhlelo olusha lwalesi sikhwama lokuthi luzame ukuzitholela ngqo izindawo zokuhlala izitshudeni.Obekukhalisa abaphathi balesi sikhwama ngukuthi kwesinye isikhathi kuba nenkohlakalo yokusebenzisana phakathi kwezikhungo nabahlinzeka ngezindawo zokuhlala.Kokunye izitshudeni zigcine zihlala ezindaweni ezingekho ezingeni elifanele ekubeni zikhokhelwa imali eshisiwe.Yingakho abalesi sikhwama beqale uhlelo lokuzihlola lezi zindawo bese bezigunyaza. Lokhu kususe omkhulu umsindo ngoba namanje kukhona abebekhala ngokuthi balala endle ngenxa yokuthi akukhokhiwe.Lesi sikhwama siveze ukuthi sithole izicelo ezingu-1.9 million zoxhaso kulo nyaka kanti bangu-1.2 million asebexhasiwe.Sisebenze ukuthi izitshudeni ezibalelwa ku-243 113 zichithiwe, kanti zingu-15 174 ezifuna kubuyekezwe izicelo zokuchithwa kwazo.SEKUPHENDUKE insakavukela umchilo wesidwaba ukuthi kube nemibhikisho njalo uma kuqala unyaka ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme kuleli, izitshudeni ezisuke zikhala ngesikhwama sezimali iNSFAS Isithombe:SIGCINIWE Ohlelweni olusha lwalo nyaka lokuboleka imali yokufunda olwaziwa nge-missing middle, abazali babo abahola kakhulu abangakwazi ukuthola umfundaze abangawukhokhi uma sebesebenza, kuvele ukuthi zingu-30 728 izitshudeni ezifake izicelo.Lezi zitshudeni zizoyibuyisa imali ezixhaswe ngayo uma seziphothule izifundo zazo.Izitshudeni eziningi zikhale nangohlelo lokuthi imihlomulo yazo ikhokhwe yizinkampani ezine, ezaqokwa yilesi sikhwama nyakenye.Lezi zinkampani kunezinhlelo zokuthi kunqanyulwe izinkontileka zazo njengoba uphenyo olwenziwa yinkampani yabameli lwaveza ukuthi kwaba nokungenelela ngesikhathi sezinikwa lo msebenzi. Kulokhu kusolwa isikhulu salesi sikhwama esakhonjwa indlela.Inhlangano emele imikhandlu yezitshudeni iSouth African Union of Students’ (SAUS), yathi ayifuni kube nokuphazamiseka ukukhokhwa kwale mihlomulo njengoba lezi zinkampani kulindeleke ukuthi ziqhubeke nalo msebenzi wokukhokha le mihlomulo ngo-Ephreli kulo nyaka.Okwamanje umsebenzi wokukhokhwa kwemihlomulo ubekwe emahlombe ezikhungo.Okhulumela iSAUS uMnuz Asive Dlanjwa uveze ukuthi zisekhona izinkinga ngezitshudeni ezingakazitholi izimfanelo.Uveze ukuthi basakuchitha ukukhokhwa kwemihlomulo yilezi zinkampani, wathi kodwa ngoba kunezinhlelo zokuthi zinqanyulelwe izinkontileka ngendlela esemthethweni, abafuni kube nokuphazamiseka ekutheni izitshudeni zithole izimfanelo zazo nyanga zonke. UNgqongqoshe weMfundo ePhakeme uDkt Blade Nzimande, uhlale ekucacisa ukuthi kunezinselelo kulesi sikhwama wathi kodwa mkhulu umsebenzi esiwenzayo.UDKT Blade Nzimande wathi kunezinselelo kulesi sikhwama kodwa mkhulu umsebenzi esiwenzayo Isithombe:SIGCINIWEUDkt Nzimande ephendula imibuzo ePhalamende muva nje ukuvezile ukuthi lesi sikhwama sengezelwe omunye umthwalo njengoba sesibhekele nohlelo lokuboleka izitshudeni imali yokufunda.Ubalule ukuthi enye yezinto eyenza luhambe kancane uhlelo lokukhishwa kwemali yoxhaso ngukuthi kumele kulandelwe yonke imigomo, izitshudeni zisayine imiqingo yokuzibophezela ngoba ngezinye zezinto ezisuke zidingeka ukuze umuntu athole uxhaso.Odabeni lwezindawo zokuhlala, uthe abakwazi ukumane bakhiphe imali bakhokhele izindawo abangakaze bazibone ukuthi zisezingeni elifanelekile..
SEKUQUBUKE izinsolo zokugwaziswa kwamalungu ebandla lamaNazaretha aseBuhleni uma efuna ukuyonikela kumholi webandla, inkosi Mduduzi "Unyazilwezulu” Shembe.Lokhu kuvezwe yimithombo engashayi eceleni kuleli bandla. Kuthiwa amaNazaretha angaphansi koNyazilwezulu akhala ezimathonsi njengoba engasakwazi ukufika kalula ukuyonikela kumholi ngenxa yokuthi kukhona okuthiwa bafuna intshontsho ukuze bawayise kumholi.Kuthiwa uma ufuna ukuyonikela kuNyazilwezulu, kukhona abaqondisa olayini, abangayizwa nhlobo indaba yomuntu ofuna ukuyonikela kodwa 'engaxoxanga’ nabo eceleni.Ngokwemithombo yangaphakathi kuthiwa uma ungalikhiphanga intshontsho uyizwa ngendaba eyokufika eduze koNyazilwezulu, futhi uphinda nawo emuva umnikelo wakho uma ungagwazi kubashumayeli abasuke beqondisa ulayini wokuyonikela."Bahafana kabuhlungu abananhliziyo futhi abancengi muntu. Uma ungabagwazele, uma kulayini uze uthathe isinqumo sokuduba uhambe. Ogwazile ususwa ngisho esemuva kulayini anidlule nonke angeniswe ngaphakathi ayonikela."Uma uzimisele ngempela ngokuyonikela, kuyaphoqa ukuthi uxoxe nabo labashumayeli abaqondisa ulayini eceleni, bese kubakhona obanika khona bese uyadluliswa. "Nemali okugwazwa ngayo ayincane ngoba uma ukhipha u-R50 kuvele kuthiwe unesikhathi sokudlala, kuthathwe abantu abakhiphe imali ngempela."Kukhona abagwaza kuze kufike naku-R1000 umuntu ngamunye bese beyadluliswa, baye konikela,” kusho umthombo.Kuthiwa ombona edluliswa abashumyeli abagade ulayini usuke usuwazi ukuthi useqondisile yingakho edluliswa. Uqhuba umthombo uthe sekunesikhathi yenzeka lento, amaNazaretha awazi ukuthi azobikela bani ngoba laba abasuke bethatha intshontsho bayizethenjwa zoNyazilwezulu, futhi yibona abahlala behamba nalo.Omunye umthombo uthe noma ingeyinhle lento eyenziwa yilaba abagwazisayo kodwa ubuye ubathethelele ngakolunye uhlangothi."Inkinga laba bantu abaholi. Banikwa u-R500 kuphela ngesonto ebandleni kuthiwe yimali yephalishi. ”Bangamadoda emizi yabo, akekho umuntu ongondla umndeni ngo-R500 wanele,” usho kanje.Okhulumela uNyazilwezulu, uMnuz Thokozani Mncwabe uthe useke wayizwa eyokuthethiswa kwabantu kolayini uma bezonikela."Indlela okuthiwa benza ngayo laba abaqondisa ulayini ikhomba ukuthi banezinhliziyo ezilukhuni ngezinto ezishiwo ngabantu ngabo. Okokugwazisa bengingakakuzwa kona kodwa okokuthethiswa nokukhacwa kwabantu sengikutholile, yinto esisazoyibheka."Engingaluleka ngakho ukuthi abantu kumele baqonde ukuthi ngonjani umuntu okusuke kumele ahambe nomholi ngaso sonke isikhathi."Ngokwazi kwami abantu abasuke besondele kumholi abasuke befike ngenxa yokugula, bagcine sebesebenza eduze kwakhe ngoba basuke belashwa."Uma kuyiqiniso okushiwo abantu ngalaba okuthiwa bakhaca abantu, kungenzeka ukuthi bathathe isinqumo sokuhamba nomholi bengaguli, yingakho sekungathi bayagula ngoba akukho ukugula abalashwa khona,” kusho uMncwabe.Kuthiwa kukhona nomfundisi oyibhadlazile eshumayela eBuhleni ngeledlule ukuthi abantu bayagwaziswa ukuthi bafinyelele kumholi.
NKOSIKHONA CELEIMEYA yesiFunda iLembe, uMnuz Thobani Shandu yethule ngokusemthethweni uhlelo lokulwa nokugxaza kwamanzi ezingxenyeni ezahlukene zakule ndawo.Lokhu ikwenze izolo ngesikhathi iseDarnela kuWard 2, nokuyilapho ifike yethula khona o-plumber okuyibona abazobhekelela amanzi agxazayo.Ithe sekumosheke imali elinganiselwa kwizigidi eziyikhulu ngenxa yale ngwadla. "Uma singayisukumeli le nkinga izodala ukuthi siqhubeke nokuthi silahlekelwe yimali,'' usho kanje.Uthe bazibophezele ekutheni benze konke okusemandleni ukuqinisekisa ukuthi iyaxazululwa inkinga yokugxaza kwamanzi ezindaweni ezahlukene zeLembe.Uveze ukuthi abasebenzi bakamasipala bazofundiswa nangezindlela ezahlukene ezingasetshenziselwa ukuqinisekisa ukongiwa kwamanzi.UShandu uthe kumqoka kakhulu ukuthi amanzi asetshenziswe ngobuhlakani ukuze ezokongiwa. "Amanzi ayisidingo esingatholakali kalula futhi esibizayo. Uma singawanakekeli namuhla, isizukulwane sethu esizayo siyobe singenalutho. Uma songa amanzi songa nemali,'' usho kanje.Ukhumbuze amalungu omphakathi ngokubaluleka kokongiwa kwamanzi. Uthe kuhle umphakathi uzijwayeze ukunciphisa amanzi owasebenzisa nsuku zonke. Ubaphonsele inselelo yokuthi mababhukule benze isiqiniseko sokuthi bayabika njalo uma kukhona ukugxaza kwamanzi abakubonayo, kwazise kusuke kuzodla izigidi uma kwenzeke isikhathi eside.Ikhansela lakule ndawo uMnuz Nkosinathi Ngema uthe kuyabathokozisa ukuthi iLembe liyayisukumela ingwadla yokugxaza kwamanzi kule ndawo.Amalungu omphakathi akushayele elikhulu ihlombe ukwethulwa kwalolu hlelo. Azwakalise ukukhathazeka ngendlela amanzi agxaza ngakhona kule ndawo.UMnuz Nhlanhla Buthelezi oyilungu lomphakathi uthe kuyajabulisa kakhulu ukubona umasipala ukusukumela ukugxaza kwamanzi.Uthe kwesinye isikhathi agxaza kuze kufike ekutheni umgwaqo ugcine sewumanzi okuyinto athe ibibakhathaza kakhulu."Siyethemba ukuthi njengoba sekukhona umasipala nje uzobhekana nale nkinga izoke iphele ngoba yona isikhathazile,''usho kanje.
INKANTOLO yesule izinyembezi umndeni wowesilisa owalalelwa unyendle, wagwazwa amanxeba angu-53 wafa yinkosikazi yakhe egwetshwe udilikajele.UMnuz Mark Buttle wabulawelwa eNewlands East, eThekwini, ngoFebhuwari 2018.Kwaboshwa inkosikazi kamufi, uDias Bella Dosantos (44) ogwetshwe udilikajele ngokubulala neminye emihlanu yokuphazamisa ukusebenza kwengalo yomthetho.Umakhelwane uCharmaine Khumalo (48) ugixabezwe ngeminyaka engu-18 ebhadla ejele.Inkantolo ithe iyachezuka esigwebeni sikadilikajele kuCharmaine ngoba akuyena owakha itulo lokubulala futhi wasebenzisana nanamaphoyisa eboshwa.Owayeboshwe nabo uNksz Teagan Brown owayengowesifazane othandana nabobulili obufana nobakhe, ushone ngo-Agasti 2023, ngaphambi kokuthi kuqale icala ngoNovemba.Okhulumela iNational Prosecuting Authority (NPA) KwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Natasha Ramkisson-Kara, uthe uButtle wayejoyine umshwalense okwakuzohlomula kuwona umkakhe futhi wayazi ngakho.I-NPA ithi kwaba nesikhathi lapho zishuba izinto emshadweni wabo, uDias waphuma emzini kwakhe wayohlala noTeagan abase beqomene."Laba ababili bahlela ukubulala uButtle ukuze uDias ahlomule emalini yomshwalense. Bafaka noCharmaine owayengumakhelwane ezinhlelweni zabo,” kusho iNPA.Ngelanga lesigameko kuthiwa uDias wayenga uButtle ukuba eze eNewlands East emkhohlisa ngokuthi bazophemba kabusha umshado wabo.Kuthiwa baphuza iwayini badakwa bamayoywane baze bazitika nangocansi. Kuvela ukuthi ngesikhathi uButtle esengazelele, wagwazwa amanxeba angu-53 wafa."UDias waphuma wayofuna usizo komakhelwane wathi sebedunwe imoto nomyeni wakhe. Laba besifazane baboshwa emuva kokutholakala kwemiyalezo ezingcingweni zabo lapho kwakwakhiwa khona itulo lokubulala umufi,” kusho iNPA.I-NPA izamukelile izigwebo zenkantolo futhi yancoma ukubambisana okube khona phakathi kwamaphoyisa nabashushisi okuzuze impumelelo.
NKOSIKHONA CELELIQINISA ubudlelwane elinabo namabandla ehlukene asesifundazweni saKwaZulu- Natal iqembu i-African Transformation Movements (ATM).Lokhu kudalulwe nguMphostoli Mxolisi Phakathi oyilungu eliqavile laleli qembu futhi ophinde abe yilungu lesiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal.Muva nje leli qembu kade lihambele amabandla ehlukene, okukhona nelinye lamadala aseZayoni neselihlanganise iminyaka engu-100 laba khona.Leli bandla yi-Ethiopian Holy Baptist Church in Zion (EHBCIZ) elaziwa kakhulu ngeleZikhova Ezimnqini kanti inkonzo ibiseZakheni, eMnambithi.Lihambele nebandla iThrone of Grace eliholwa nguMbhishobhi Thabani Khumalo.Lidlulele eNewcatsle enkonzweni yeRivers of Mercy Ministries (RMM) eholwa ngu-Arch Bishop TM Shongwe.Amanye amabandla ahanjelwe yileli bandla yiNkazimulo Church of Christ neBandla leNkosi uJesu Msindisi."Kuyinto emqoka kakhulu ukuthi iqembu lethu libonakale liba nobudlelwane obuhle namabandla ehlukene."Siyakholelwa kakhulu ekutheni ukuze konke iqembu kulihambele kahle, liyadinga ukuba nobudlelwane namabandla,'' usho kanje.Ugcizelele ukuthi lobu budlelwane akubona obesikhashana futhi abuncikile kuphela ngoba sekusondele isikhathi sokhetho lukazwelonke."Lobu ubudlelwane beqiniso esinabo namabandla ehlukene. Siyakuqonda kahle kamhlophe ukuthi bumqoka kangakanani ukuthi sibe yiqembu elisebenzisana eduze namabandla,'' esho.Ugcizelele kakhulu ukuthi kukhona konke abakwenzayo kuncika kakhulu eduze kwentando kaNkulunkulu ngoba kakade vele bamele lokho.Uthembise ukuthi bazoqhubeka nokusebenzisana namabandla noma ngabe seludlulile ukhetho.UMphostoli Phakathi uphinde abe yilungu lokuqina lebandla, iTwelve Apostolic Church in Christ (TACC).Leli qembu lisungulwe ngaphansi kwesisekelo senkolo yokubusa kwentando kaNkulunkulu emhlabeni nje jikelele.
AYOYIZEKELA amagwababa echobana amantombazane amabili, eneminyaka eyisikhombisa neyisishiyagalolunye. Kuthiwa athunjwe edlala kubo, ayodlwengulwa ubusuku bonke maqede ayolaxazwa ndawana thize.Amaphoyisa asesifundazweni iMpumalanga, athungatha izinswelaboya ezisolwa ngokuhlukumeza omuntuza.Okhulumela amaphoyisa aseMpumalanga, uColonel Donald Mdhluli, uthe izingane ezingenacala, zizwe ubuhlungu ezingasoze zabulibala empilweni yazo, zidlwengulwa ubusuku bonke."Lokhu kwenzeke emuva kokuba amantombazane amabili enyamalele ngoMgqibelo wangoMashi 30, ekhaya labazali bawo elisendaweni yaseVosman, eduze kwaseWitbank."Amaphoyisa athe isigameko esinyantisa igazi sithuthumelise amalungu omphakathi."Abazali baqale ukushaya amakhala ngokunyamalala kwalezi zingane emuva kokungatholakali kwazo lapho bezigcinwe zidlala khona."Babe sebazisa amaphoyisa okuyiwo avule idokodo labantu abalahlekile ukuze kuphenywe. Kube sekuphunywa inqina kuyokuthungathwa kwabagilwa kodwa kwanhlanga zimuka nomoya," kuchaza uMdhluli.Ngakusasa ngeSonto amaphoyisa asesiteshini sasePhola, abikelwe ukuthi izingane sezitholakele kodwa sekunezimpawu zokuthi zinukubeziwe ngokocansi."Ukutholakala kwezingane kube wusizo loMsamariya olungileyo, ozifice zidwanguza lapho zidalakaxwe khona ngumdlwenguli. Uzishiye dengwane ukuba zizibonele njengamachwane emuva kokuzivalela ubusuku bonke," kusho uMdhluli.Uthe uMsamariya olungileyo ufice izingane zingqangqazela emuva kwesigameko esizehlele nangamakhaza ashubisa umnkantsha ngoba bezingawahlomele amakhaza ngezingubo ebezizigqokile.Uqhube wathi amaphoyisa aphenya ngamacala odlame emndenini, ukuvikelwa kwezingane nokunukubezwa ngokocansi.Uthe anxusa noma ngubani ongaba nomkhondo wezinswelaboya ukuba afonele uSergeant Zinhle Mathenjwa ku-072 792 0691 noma afonele ku-08600 10111.
UHULUMENI uphake impi elwa nobugebengu emiphakathini ngokuthi aqinise izinsiza kusebenza ohlakeni iCommunity Policing Forum (CPF) KwaZulu-Natal.UNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal uNkk Nomusa Dube-Ncube wethule izimoto ezingu-95 ezizosetshenziswa yiCPF. Ezimotweni ezethuliwe kukhona namaVW Polo namaveni.Uhulumeni wabe uR30 million walolu hlelo waveza nokuthi ezinye izimoto ezingu-95 zi-odiwe ziyeza.Ukusho lokhu emcimbini obukade useHoy Park, eThekwini ngoLwesihlanu emini.Ubuzinyaziswe usihlalo weNdlu yobuHoli boMdabu eKZN, Inkosi uSifiso Shinga, amaphoyisa, abaholi bakahulumeni, abe-CPF namavolontiya."Izimoto zokuqala zizosatshalaliswa ezindaweni ezaziwayo ukuthi zinobugebengu obuningi. Kubekwe naseqhulwini izindawo zasemakhaya lapho kufakwe khona amakhamera namalambu amakhulu akhanyisa bha,” kusho uNdunankulu.Uqhube wathi lezi zindawo zifakelwe nama-WiFi ukwenzela ukuthi ikhamera ikwazi ukubonakala noma ngabe ukuphi namaphoyisa akwazi ukwenza umsebenzi wawo ngokuphepha.Udalule nokuthi abafuni kube nendawo lapho izigebengu ezizocasha khona.Ube esekhuthaza ukubambisana kukahulumeni nazo zonke izinhlaka ezilwa nobugebengu nabezinkampani zonogada."Njengamanje asikakwazi ukuthi siluhlele udaba lonsumbulwane (imali yokuholela abeCPF) ngenxa yokuthi sithe uma sibona isibalo sabo nezimali ezikhona, azizokwazi ukwanela,” kucacisa uNdunankulu.Nakuba bengeke bahole kodwa uNdunankulu ubaqinise idolo abeCPF wathi mkhulu umsebenzi abawenzayo. Uthe ngakho-ke kukhona okuncane abazothiphazisa ngakho ukuze bakwazi ukuqhubeka nomsebenzi abawenzayo ngesikhathi lusadingidwa udaba lokubaholela.Usihlalo weCPF KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Mabutho Mtshali uthe igcagcele esokeni, baneminyaka engu-25 benza lo msebenzi, beyingakaze yenzeke into efana nalena esifundazweni."Sikhalile ngokushoda kwezinsiza kuNdunankulu nakuMphathiswa (uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka) basilalela. ”Kusukela manje kubhekwe phambili isiphakiwe impi elwa nobugebengu. Sizosebenzisana namaphoyisa siqinisekise ukuthi isifundazwe sivikelekile,” kusho uMtshali.UHlomuka ubonge iqhaza elibanjwe i-CPF nabamahlelo ehlukene emphakathini okubalwa nezinkampani zonogada ezilwa nobugebengu.
KULUKHUNI satshe kwabakuleli abahlala emazweni akhungethwe yizimpi abafuna ukuvota okhethweni lwangenyanga ezayo.Abahlala emazweni akhungethwe izimpi kuzofanele bayovota emazweni angomakhelwane ngenxa yokuthi amanxusa akuleli asethuthile emazweni abahlala kuwo.Emazweni abhekene nale nkinga kukhona i-Israel elwa neHamas eGaza, bese kuba iRussia elwa ne-Ukraine.Abanye balabantu abazange bakwazi ukubhalisela ukuvota ngenxa yezimpi eziqhubekayo.UNgqongqoshe wezoBudlweno naMazwe oMhlaba, uDkt Naledi Pandor uthe zikhona izinhlelo zokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi bonke abafuna ukuvota bayalithola ithuba lokuvota."Zikhona izinhlelo esizenzile. Abafuna ukuvota bangaya emazweni angomakhelwane. Uma uhlala e-Israel, akhona amahhovisi enxusa eRamala. Sifuna kungabi khona umuntu ongezolithola ithuba lokuvota," kusho uNgqongqoshe Pandor.UPandor uthe bajabule ngesibalo esiphezulu sabantu abahlala emazweni angaphandle ababhalisele ukuvota."Emhlanganweni engibe nawo ne-IEC (Independent Electoral Commission), bangitshele ukuthi siphezulu kakhulu isibalo sabantu abahlala emazweni angaphandle ababhalisele ukuvota. Kungokokuqala emlandweni ukuba sibe nesibalo esiphezulu kanje," esho.Lo Ngqongqoshe ubekhuluma esithangamini nabezindaba ebesibizwe ikomiti le-ANC elibhekelele ezobudlelwano namazwe angaphandle.Leli komiti lishayele ihlombe imizamo kahulumeni wakuleli yokudala ukuthula ezwenikazi i-Afrika nasemhlabeni jikelele.UPandor uthe uhulumeni wakuleli wenza umsebenzi oncomekayo ngesikhathi umangalela i-Israel, enkantolo yamazwe omhlaba.Uthe lesinyathelo sasifanele njengoba ekhale ngokuthi i-Israel ibulala abantu abangenacala eGaza."Isinqumo esathathwa uhulumeni wakuleli sihambisana nesibophezelo esasisayina eGeneva Convention lapho sazibophezela khona ukuthi ngeke sivume ukuthi kube nezwe elizobulala abantu. Asikwazi ukusonga izandla kubulawa abantu eGaza."Asikwazi ukuthula kucindezelwa abantu eGaza. Nathi sike saphila ngaphansi kwengcindezelo, siyazi ukuthi kunzima kangakanani. Amazwe omhlaba aselekelela ngesikhathi silwa nengcindezelo. Ingakho nathi silekelela labo abacindezelekile,” kuqhuba uPandor. UPandor uthe bayazama ukuxazulula impi ephakathi kwiRussia ne-Ukraine kanti bafuna ukuhlalisa phansi abaholi balamazwe, kukhulunywe ngalempi esidonse isikhathi eside."Kuningi esesikwenzile ukuzama ukuxazulula impi. Njengamanje sisesigabeni lapho sesikulungele ukuhlanganisa zombili izinhlangothi. Sifuna ukuba nomhlangano ozohanjelwa izona zombili izinhlangothi," ephetha.
KUQINISEKISWE izitshudeni ezifunda ezikhungweni ezine ezikhishwe ohlwini lwezibhalisiwe ngaphansi koMnyango weMfundo ePhakeme nokuQeqesha ukuthi iziqu zazo zisemthethweni.Lokhu kushiwo nguDkt Blade Nzimande, ophethe lo mnyango obeqinisa idolo izitshudeni ezifunda ngaphansi kwezikhungo i-Educor.Ngeledlule uDkt Nzimande uthe ziyakhishwa ohlwini lwezikhungo ezibhalisiwe kuleli ngenxa yokwehluleka ukuhlangabezana neminye imibandela yomnyango efaka nokuletha imininingwane ethinta ukusebenza kwezimali.Isitatimende esikhishwe ngumnyango kaNzimande, siveze ukuthi iziqu zezitshudeni ezizithole kulezi zikhungom, zisemthethweni.Lezi zikhungo ezikhishwe ohlwini lwezibhalisiwe yiCity Varsity (Pty) Ltd, Damelin (Pty) Ltd, Icesa City Campus (Pty) Ltd neLyceum College (Pty) Ltd."Siyazi ngomthelela lesi sinqumo esibe nawo sokukhipha lezi zikhungo ohlwini lwezibhalisiwe ikakhulu kulezo zitshudeni ezisaphothula iziqu kuzona. Njengoba sibhekele izikhungo ezizimele nezomphakathi, kuwumsebenzi wethu ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umthetho wezwe uyalandelwa.” Lesi sitatimende sithe nalabo abasalelwe wukuqedela iziqu zabo kulezi zikhungo, iziqu zabo zisezingeni.Lezi zikhungo uthe zihlalelwe yijoka lokuqinisekisa ukuthi izitshudeni ezisasele ziphothula iziqu zazo futhi zibhaliswe izivivinyo ngesikhathi esisele.Sithe umnyango usazimisele ukufaka isandla ukuze lezi zitshudeni zingaphenduki ondingasithebeni."Uphiko olubhekele ukubhaliswa kwezikhungo ezizimele emnyangweni, lumatasa nezingcingo ezivela kwizitshudeni ezikhala ngokuthi akukho ukuxhumana okukhona okuvela ezikhungweni ezingaphansi kwe-Educor, mayelana nekusasa lazo. Sinxusa i-Educor ukuthi icacisele umphakathi ngokuzokwenzeka,” kusho isitatimende. Siveze nokuthi nakuba kunjalo kodwa sisamile isinqumo sokuthi kukhishwe lezi zikhungo ohlwini lwezibhalisiwe kuleli, kuze kube kulungiswa izinkinga ezibhekene nazo.Selokhu uNzimande ememezele ukukhishwa kwalezi zikhungo ohlwini lwezibhalisiwe kuleli, kunokukhathazeka kulabo abebefunda kuzona.Umnyango uxwayise ezinye izikhungo ezizimele ukuthi ngeke unanaze ukuzikhipha ohlwini lwezibhalisiwe uma zephula imigomo."Sifisa ukuxwayisa nalabo abahlela ukuvula izikhungo ezingombombayi ukuthi sizozivala, umthetho wezemfundo uthi kumele zonke izikhungo zbhaliswe ukuze kuvikeleke isithunzi sezemdundo. Sisebenza namaphoyisa ukuzivala uma sesizazi,” kusho isitatimende.
UNGASE uhlakazwe umkhandlu wase-Ekurhuleni, owehlulwa wukukhetha imeya entsha.UMasipala Ekurhuleni usuhlale isonto ungenayo imeya ngemva kokukhishwa kukaMnuz Sivuyile Ngodwana. Lokhu kwenzeke ngesonto eledlule ngemva kokuba kuvotelwe ukuthi ubuholi bakhe abusathembekile.Ngokomthetho olawula ukuphathwa komasipala, umkhandlu kufanele ukhethe imeya entsha zingakapheli izinsuku eziyisikhombisa kukhishwe imeya. Ziphele ngoLwesihlanu izinsuku eziyisikhombisa.Umhlangano obubizelwe ukuzokhetha imeya entsha obekuhlelwe ukuthi ube ngoLwesine, uhoxiswe ngemizuzu yokugcina.UMphathiswa wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu eGauteng, uMnuz Mzikayifani Khumalo uthe umthetho ucacile ngokufanele kwenzeke e-Ekurhuleni."Akumina oshoyo kodwa wumthetho okhulumayo. Umthetho uthi uma umkhandlu uhluleka ukukhetha ubuholi, kufanele uhlakazwe. Njengamanje sicubungula isimo, sekufanele umkhandlu ufakwe ngaphansi komthetho uSection 139."USection 139 uhlukene kabili. Ungakwazi ukuthi umkhandlu ungawuhlakazi ngokuphelele. Okunye ongakwenza wukuthi uwuhlakaze ngokuphelele. Lokho kungasho ukuthi kufanele kuqalwe phansi ukhetho, ukuze abantu baseku-Ekurhuleni, bezokwazi ukuvotela ubuholi obusha,” kuchaza uKhumalo.Uqhube wathi bakhathazekile ngokuphazamiseka kokuhanjiswa kwezidingo zabantu abangaphansi komkhandlu.UKhumalo uqhube kanje: "Imeya isebenza ngokugcwele kumasipala. Kanjalo nosihlalo bomakomiti nabo basasebenza. Ukungabi khona kobuholi kusho ukuthi abekho abantu abenza umsebenzi okufanele engabe wenziwa wubuholi.”UMasipala wase-Ekurhuleni ubuswa ngokubambisana ngamaqembu ahlukene, okuyi-ANC, EFF namanye amancane.I-EFF iyona ewungqo shishilizi kulo mkhandlu ngoba iphethe izikhundla ezibalulekile okubalwa esikasihlalo wekomiti lezimali eliphethwe nguSihlalo wenhlangano eGauteng, uMnuz Nkululeko Dunga, nesikaSomlomo esiphethwe nguNksz Nthabiseng Tshivhenga.Bumuncu ubudlelwano phakathi kwe-ANC ne-EFF kulo mkhandlu.Lokhu kwagqama kakhulu ngesikhathi kunesiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaNgodwana, oyikhansela le-AIC. Amakhansela e-ANC avele akhetha ukungavoti.I-DA eyakhishwa ekuphatheni umasipala ngonyaka owedlule, ithe isisombululo ukuthi umkhandlu uhlakazwe.Ikhansela leDA elakhishwa kwesobumeya uNksz Tania Campell, lithe basamile ekutheni bafuna ukhetho luqalwe phansi.
UMHOLI we-EFF, uMnuz Julius Malema uzimisele ngokutakula i-ANC uma ingase ingatholi amavoti anele ukuthi ibuse ngokuzimela okhethweni lwangenyanga ezayo.Nokho usizo lukaMalema luza nombandela oqinile i-ANC okofanele ihlangabezane nawo.UMalema uveze ukuthi uzofuna ukuthi i-ANC ibanikeze isikhundla esibalulekile kwikhabhinethi.Lokhu ukusho ngesikhathi enengxoxo ekhethekile nesiteshi somsakazo esizinze eGoli.Ongoti nezinhlangano ezenza ucwaningo ziveza ukuthi i-ANC ngeke ilunqobe ngamalengiso ukhetho oluzayo, izodinga ukubambisana namaqembu amancane ukuze ikwazi ukubuyela emandleni.UMalema uthe i-ANC angayibuyisela emandleni uma ingabanikeza isikhundla sikaNgqongqoshe wezeZimali."Ngizimisele ukuthatha amavoti e-EFF ngiwanikeze i-ANC uma ihlulwa ukuthola amavoti anele ukuthi ibuse ngokuzimela. Ngiyobabekela umbandela owodwa nje vo, ukuthi baqoke uMnuz Floyd Shivambu (oyiphini likamengameli kwi-EFF) esikhundleni sikaNgqongqoshe wezeZimali.”UMalema uthe uma benganikwa lesi sikhundla kuyobe basikelwe iqatha elinonile."Phela i-ANC neDA bangonontandakubukwa, abakwazi ukuhlukanisa phakathi kwesikhundla esikunikeza amandla okwenza izinto nesikwenza unontandakubukwa."Yingakho ngisho komasipala esibusa ngokubambisana kubo singasijahi isikhundla sobumeya."Thina siyaye sifike sithi asinendaba nokuthi ubani imeya, thina sifuna ukuthi amakhansela ethu abe osihlalo bamakomiti. Imeya ayenzi lutho, osihlalo bamakomiti yibona abahambisa intuthuko."Imeya iqhamuka isizosika amaribhini (mhla kwethulwa ngokusemthethweni izinhlelo zentuthuko). Iqiniso ukuthi zonke lezi zinhlelo ezisuke zethulwa imeya zisuke zenziwe osihlalo bamakomiti,” kusho uMalemaUthe uyazi ukuthi ngeke kube lula ukuthi i-ANC ibanike lesi sikhundla ngenxa yokubaluleka kwaso."Phela uma singathola lesi sikhundla ngabe ziphelile izinkinga ezibhekene nabantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Imali eningi ingaya ekwelekeleleni abahlwempu. Kungaphela ukuthi lo mnyango ubanjwe ngobhongwane izinjinga zaseStellenbosch,” kuqhuba uMalema.Uthe ngeke afune ukuba iphini likamengameli uma bebambisana ne-ANC."Angeke ngilunge lapha. Indlela engikhuthele ngayo ngingagcina sengigqama ngidlule umengameli."Ngisho unganginikeza isikhundla sokuba ungqongqoshe womnyango onganakiwe, ngingagqama ngidlule umengameli."Ngale kwalokho vele ngeke banginike lesi sikhundla ngoba bayangizonda. Abantu abangizondayo ilaba engakhula nabo,” esho.Umshado we-EFF ne-ANC komasipala bakuleli okubalwa kubo iTheku ne-Ekurhuleni, awuhambi kahle.
USONGELE izigebengu ungqongqoshe wamaphoyisa wathi akukho sigebengu esizogila imikhuba bese siyolala endlini sibhekise amadolo phezulu.UMnuz Bheki Cele uthe akukho zinyane lemvubu ladliwa zingwenya kwacweba iziziba."Asisusanga-mpi. Ngifuna ukuzithembisa izigebengu sizoyilwa (impi) futhi ngiyazibophezela kulokho,” kusho uCele.Usho kanje oThongathi, eThekwini ngoMgqibelo emngcwabeni wephoyisa elidutshulwe labulawa lisemsebenzini, uSergeant Sibongiseni Khoza.Kusolakala ukuthi uKhoza wadutshulwa ebusuku washona enza usebenzi wakhe eSundumbuli.KUBE nomunyu nosizi emngcwabeni wephoyisa elibulawele eSundumbili, uSergeant Sibongiseni Khoza Isithombe: SithunyelweUCele uzihlangulile wathi akayena umvubeli wempi kepha impi uyifice ikhona futhi akayazi isuswe ubani. ABAHOLI bamaqembu ehlukene ezepolitiki bathembise ukuthathela izinyathelo ezinqala amalungu azophambana nemigomo yekhomishini yezokhetho njengoba kuzovotwa.Laba baholi bathembise ukuthi bazohlonipha isibopho sokuthi ukhetho lube nokuthula futhi lube ngoluphephile kanti nokuthi ngeke bagqugquzele udlame. Bakusho lokhu ngoLwesine eMidrand ngesikhathi ikhomishini yezokhetho yenze umcimbi wokuthi amaqembu asayine isibophezelo sokuthi ukhetho luzoba ngolukhululekile nolunokuthula.IPhini likaNobhala jikelele wokuqala we-ANC, uNkk Nomvula Mokonyane, lithe bahlale bezibophezele ekutheni ukhetho lube nokuthula futhi lube ngolukhululekile.Uthe bazobathathela izinyathelo ezinqala labo abazogqugquzela udlame njengoba kuzovotwa."Abantu abaphume ngobuningi bayovota ngoba lolu khetho lubaluleke kakhulu. Kumele kube nokubekezelelana kungabikhona ukusabisana.” Umengameli we-IFP uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa, uzibophezele ekutheni leli qembu lizogqugqugquzela ukuthula njengoba kuzovotwa.Uthe abantu ababaseke ekutheni bashintshe uhulumeni osemandleni."Siyazibophezela ukuthi ukhetho kuzoba ngolukhululekile nokuthula.” UMnuz Jabulani Khumalo weqembu Umkhonto weSizwe, uthe umele umengameli weqembu uJacob Zuma, wathi bayazibophezela ekutheni kube nokuthula okhethweni.Uthe bazothathela izinyathelo ezinqala labo abazosabisa ngodlame nabazophambana nemigomo yekhomishini."Sizoshintsha izinto uma sesingene emandleni. Imithetho ekhona sizoyishintsha.” UMnuz Ivan Barnes we-NFP uthe sebengcwabe inqwaba yamalungu abe yabagilwa bezigameko zokubulawa ngenxa yokuthi kunamaqembu angenakho ukubekezelelana.Uthe babalelwa ku-15 abantu asebashona bebulawa."Siyazibophezela ekutheni ukhetho luzoba nokuthula, ngeke sigqugquzele udlame. Siyacela kodwa kwikhomishini ukuthi singatholi amabhokisi anamaphepha okuvota elahlwe emifuleni ukuze sithembe imiphumela yokhetho.” Umgcinimafa we-EFF uNksz Omphile Maotwe, uthembise ukuthi bazobaqondisa ubugwegwe labo abazophambana nemigomo yekhomishini wanxusa ikhomishini ukuthi iyeke ukusebenzisa othisha beSadtu uma kuvotwa.Unxuse nokuthi kungasetshenziswa amalungu eCosatu ngoba aseka i-ANC.Umholi we-DA uMnuz John Steenhuisen, uthe kulolu khetho kuyaphela ngeqembu elilodwa eliphethe amandla wathi abantu abaphume bayovota.Uthe bayazibophezela ekuhlonipheni imigomo yekhomishini nokuthi ukhetho luzoba ngolukhululekile.Ongenele ukhetho ngokuzimela uNksz Anele Mda, ugxeke ikhomishini ngokuthi besingekho isithombe sakhe.Uthe kumele baphathwe njengamanye amaqembu nakuba bengenela ngokuzimela.Useke waba yilungu le-ANC neCope kanti uthe ungenela umbango wokuya ePhalamende ngemuva kukaMeyi 29.Iqembu i-Alliance of Citizens for Change eliholwa nguMnuz Masizole Mnqasela, yilona elitonyulwe laba phezulu ephepheni lokuvota.I-AIC izoba ngaphezu kwe-ANC njengoba itonyulwe yathola amavoti amaningi njengoba kufana imibala. USihlalo we-IEC uMnuz Mosotho Moepya, unxuse amaqembu abalelwa ku-52, nabangenele ukhetho ngokuzimela abangu-12, ukuthi bahloniphe isibopho abasenzile.Unxuse nomphakathi ukuthi usebenzisane namalungu ekhomishini ezikhungweni zokuvota.
KWENZEKE okungajwayelekil, eBottlebrush, eChatsworth, eThekwini, njengoba kuthiwa ilungu lomndeni wabasolwa abebezokhalelwa ngamasongo kaSigonyela, lingqongqisa ngomlilo imoto yamaphoyisa lisekwa yiqeqebane.Kulesi sigameko kuthiwa kuphinde kwakhandwa ngamatshe enye imoto yamaphoyisa.Ngokusho komthombo, imoto ishiswe ngumfowabo wowesifazane obezoboshwa ngamaphoyisa ngoLwesine."Amaphoyisa agasele komunye wemijondolo ekule ndawo ezintatha ngenhloso yokubopha izithandani. Athe esematasa nalokho, aqaphela ukuthi sekukhona ilangabi lapho ebepake khona izimoto. Kushe eyodwa yophiko lwePublic Order Policing,” kusho umthombo.Uthe le moto ishe nazo zonke izinsizakusebenza kanjalo namaselula amaphoyisa.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa ophiko lwe-eThekwini District Task Team abephansi phezulu efunana nabasolwa ngecala lokubulala.Uthe kugcine kubonakala ukuthi kudingeka amanye amaphoyisa ukuba azolekelela nokuyilapho kubizwe khona amanye ophiko lwePublic Order Policing."Ngesikhathi amaphoyisa ematasa ejaha abasolwa ngonyawo, iqeqebana lamalungu omphakathi lishise imoto yamaphoyisa laphinde lakhanda ngamatshe enye,” kusho uNetshiunda.Ucacise ukuthi lesi senzo sokuhlaselwa kwezimoto zamaphoyisa akuzange kuwavimbe ukuthi aqhubeke nokubopha abasolwa ebebebafuna."Baboshwe bobabili, kanti batholwe nezibhamu ezimbili ne-air rifle,” kusho uNetshiunda, othe kulindeleke ukuthi bavele enkantolo maduze.UKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, usigxekile isenzo sokuhlaselwa kwezimoto zamaphoyisa.Uqhube wathi ukuphazanyiswa kwezinsizakusebenza zamaphoyisa kungukuhlasela ngqo uhulumeni.Ufunge wagomela ukuthi amaphoyisa azokwenza konke okusemandleni ukuthi abambe abenze lokhu."Amalungu omphakathi ahlale ekhala ngokuthi izinsizakusebenza zamaphoyisa azenele, nokuyinto ekhathaza wonke umuntu, bese kuba khona abantu abafana nalaba, abanezinhloso zokunqinda ukusebenza kwamaphoyisa ukuze baqhubeke nokucanasa,” kusho uMkhwanazi.Ukubeke kwacaca ukuthi ukushiswa nokukhandwa ngamatshe kwezimoto zamaphoyisa kuyicala elibomvu, wathi amaphoyisa asevele aphansi phezulu acinga abenze lesi sigameko.
AKUPHUMANGA gama emhlanganweni wamakhosi nekhabhinethi laKwaZulu-Natal obubizelwe ukuzobhunga ngombango wombhobho owasuka emcimbini wokukhumbula iSilo uDinuzulu kaCetshwayo.Umhlangano wangoLwesithathu awuzange unqume ukuthi uMphathiswa wezokuThuthukiswa koMnotho, uMnuz Siboniso Duma, uzoya nini ukuyoshweleza eSilweni uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini.Ubuholi bomdabu KwaZulu-Natal bebuhlangene nekhabhinethi lesifundazwe ngoLwesithathu lapho bekuxoxwa khona ngesenzo sikaDuma sokuphuca undunankulu kaZulu, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, umbhobho.Umhlangano obuseThekwini udonse kwaze kwaba ntambama.Usihlalo wendlu yobuholi bomdabu KwaZulu-Natal, inkosi Sifiso Shinga, uthe abazange baluphothule udaba."Yebo sihlanganile nekhabhinethi kodwa isiphetho sodaba asizange sifike kusona."Amakhosi nekhabhinethi bahlukene ngokwemibono uma kuza endleleni okufanele lusingathwe ngayo lolu daba.Amakhosi ayamgxeka uDuma, amsola ngokwehlisa uButhelezi isithunzi.Ikhabhinethi yona iyameseka uDuma, ithi wenza kahle wayabula umbhobho.Isola uButhelezi ngokufaka ipolitiki emcimbini kahulumeni.Yize kunalokhu kwehlukana kwemibono, uShinga uthe umhlangano wabo uhambe kahle."Sijabule kakhulu ngesikuxoxile. Iqiniso ukuthi sanelisekile."Amakhosi ayalela uDuma ukuthi aqale azovela phambi kwawo ngaphambi kokuthi ayoshweleza eSilweni.Amakhosi athi iwona azohambisa uDuma kwiMbube.UShinga uthe abakanqumi ukuthi bazomyisa nini uDuma eSilweni."Usuku alukaziwa, sizonazisa uma selubekiwe."
UMENGAMELI Cyril Ramaphosa usesungule ithimba eliyisipesheli, elizoxazulula izinkinga zikaMasipala weTheku nechweba laleli dolobha.Lezi zindaba uzimemezele ngoLwesine, emcimbini wokuvula ngokusemthethweni inkampani ezothutha impahla esuka ezitimeleni iye emkhunjini iNewlyn Park Terminal, eseduze kwechweba eThekwini."Ngisungule ithimba elibizwa ngeThekwini Presidential Working Group, elizobheka ukuthi uMasipala weTheku usebenza ngendlela efanele. Lizobuye liqinisekise ukuthi izinto zihamba kahle echwebeni laseThekwini. Sifuna ukubuyisela ichweba leTheku esicongweni ngoba yilona ebelihamba phambili e-Afrika. Sifuna libuyele lapho. Leli thimba kufanele lethule umbiko ngomsebenzi walo njalo emva kwamasonto amathathu,” kusho uRamaphosa.Uncome umnikazi weNewlyn Park Terminal, uMnuz Raj Balmakhun, ngokufeza isithembiso asenza ngo-2019 sokutshala uR3.4billion.Uthe baningi ababezitshela ukuthi ngeke sifezeke kodwa sifezeke phambi kwabo."Okwenzeka lapha kuwubufakazi bokuthi uma uhulumeni esebenzisana nosomabhizinisi, izinyunyana nomphakathi wonkana kuningi, okuhle okungafezeka. INewlyn idale amathuba omsebenzi awu-4 013 ngesikhathi yakhiwa nawu-1 000 njengoba seyiphelile,” kusho uRamaphosa.Ugqugquzele osomabhizinisi nabantu bonke baseNingizimu Afrika ukuba bangalilahli ithemba ngoba abaziyekelelanga yize iKwaZulu-Natal yakhinyabezwa yiCovid-19, izibhelu nezikhukhula.Usuke eNewlyn wanikela efemini yakwaTetra Pak, ePinetown, enwetshwe ngoR500 million.UNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Nomusa Dube-Ncube, uthe ukuvulwa kweNewlyn kusho ukuphela kwesiminyaminya njengoba amakhonteyna ezosuka echwebeni angene ezitimeleni.Uthe kuyimanje sesiphelile isiminyaminya samakhonteyna echwebeni ."Ichweba laseThekwini lisazoba matasa kakhulu ngoba manje kuza imishini emisha yokuqubula amakhonteyna. Impahla eningi izohamba ngezitimela ngakho osomabhizinisi bazobona ukuthi umsebenzi uyashesha echwebeni laseThekwini,” kusho uNkk Dube-Ncube.UBalmakhun uthe usazodala inqwaba yemisebenzi ngezinhlelo ezehlukene zokuthuthukisa umnotho nengqalasizinda eduze kwamachweba.Uveze ukuthi wakhulela emakethe yezithelo nemifino eThekwini, lapho umndeni wakhe wawudayisa imifino eyayithwalwa yisitimela isuka emapulazini.Uthe lokhu kwamkhombisa ukuthi ukusebenza kahle kwezitimela kubalulekile kwezomnotho.Phakathi kwezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa ingqalasizinda zeNewlyn kubalwa olwegesi oluzoletha ugesi owu-30MW Richards Bay, olokuphehla ugesi welanga kuzo zonke izikhungo zaseNewlyn.Olokuthuthukisa i-terminal ye-manganese echwebeni laseNgqura, olwe-terminal ye-iron ore eSaldanha nezinye.
UMNYANGO wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal ubukeka untula umkhombandlela noma ukucaciseleka mayelana nohlelo lokuqashwa kodokotela abaqhinqe emahhovisi oMphathiswa walo mnyango kusukela ngoLwesibili.Lokhu kushiwo imenenja yenyunyana yabasebenzi bakahulumeni, iPublic Servants Association SA (PSA) KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Mlungisi Ndlovu ejoyine labo dokotela abebekhombisa ukungenami kwabo ngokumasha phambi kwebhilidi elinehhovisi likaMphathiswa walo mnyango uNksz Nomagugu Simelane, iNatalia Building eMgungundlovu, izolo.BEBESAHLELI ngaphambi kwehhovisi likaMphathiswa wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal odokotela abaphothule izifundo zabo abangaqashiwe, izolo. Inyunyana yabasebenzi iPublic Servants Association SA ezwelana nabo izolo ibeseke ngokujoyina umbhikisho wabo obungaphambi kwaleli hhovisi Isithombe: SITHUNYELWELabo dokotela balokhu behlale ngaphambi kwaleli hhovisi ngoLwesibili bathi bazobuyela emakhaya nezincwadi zokuthi sebethathiwe njengoba kwethembisa uNgqongqoshe wezeMpilo uDkt Joe Phaahla ngoFebhuwari ukuthi kuzoqashwa odokotela abangu-800 abangaqashiwe kule nyanga. Bathi ezinye izifundazwe seziluqalile lolu hlelo kodwa kulesi sifundazwe kuthulekile."Sifuna ukuthi uMnyango wezeMpilo esifundazweni uluqale ngokushesha uhlelo lokuqasha odokotela njengoba uNgqongqoshe athembisa. Kuyasimangaza ukuthi umnyango esifundazweni uthi awunayo imali ekubeni uNgqongqoshe athi kwisabelomali salo mnyango izobakhona imali. Kubukeka sengathi umnyango untula ukucaciseleka ngokuthi odokotela abesebephothule izifundo zabo bafunani. SiyiPSA siyazwelana nabo ingakho silapha namhlanje, " kusho uNdlovu.UDkt Thuba Nkabinde, ongomunye wodokotela abangaqashiwe abalokhu behlale ngoLwesibili ehhovisi likaMphathiswa, uthe kubadumazile ukuthi uMphathiswa, utshele izintatheli ukuthi imali ayikho ekubeni lolu daba lungakadingidwa kahle."Inhloko yomnyango, uDkt Sandile Tshabalala, akukho okucacile asitshele kona. UNgqongoshe wakubeka kwacaca ukuthi sizoqashwa futhi siyakubona kwenzeka kwezinye izifundazwe ngoba sezikhona izikhangiso. Kulesi esethu kuthule manje sekuthiwa imali ayikho," kusho uNkabinde.Usihlalo we-IFP uMnuz Thami Ntuli, uthe akwamukelekile ukuthi odokotela bashaywe indiva noma sebehleli ngaphandle kwehhovisi likaMphathiswa."Lokhu kukhombisa ukungabi nanhlonipho kukahulumeni waseKZN. Kuyakhathaza kakhulu ukuthi izikhungo zezempilo nezibhedlela zikahulumeni KwaZulu-Natal zibhekene nenkinga yokushoda kodokotela kodwa uhulumeni akakuboni ukuphuthuma kodaba lokuqashwa kwalaba basebenzi abaqeqeshiwe," kusho uNtuli esitatimendeni.UMnyango wezeMpilo esifundazweni ubungakaphenduli.
UNGQONGQOSHE wamaphoyisa, uMnuz Bheki Cele, ukhale ngokuhlaliswa ngesinqe esisodwa kwabantu eDesai, eMariannhill, athe bekukade kwenziwa "izinswelaboya” ezibulewe.UCele udalule ukuthi amacala enzekile, ayamaniswa nababulewe angu-26 aqale ngo-Okthoba 2023."Amacala angu-23 bekungawokugqekezwa kwemizi kusetshenziswa indlakadla kuphethwe izibhamu kuthathwe izinto zabantu. Kukhona necala lokudlwengula nawokuzama ukubulala,” kusho uCele.UNGQONGQOSHE wamaPhoyisa, uMnuz Bheki Cele ehlola umuzi okubulawelwe kuwona abantu abayisishiyagalolunye eDesai, eMariannhill Isithombe: Doctor Ngcobo/Independent MediaMayelana nosekuhlukanise phakathi umphakathi, njengoba kukhona abakujabulele ukubulawa kwabasolwa, abanye bekhala ngesandla esiqinile abathi ngesamaphoyisa, uCele uthe abafana ababulewe bayingozi.Uqhube wathi kuyaye kuthi uma amaphoyisa eseluqoqile ulwazi, eseyobopha abasolwa, bavele badubule kuqala."Uma udedela izulu lezandla emaphoyiseni nawo kumele aphendule ngezulu lezandla. Zitholakele izibhamu ezingekho emthethweni kule ndawo, labantu bebenza ubelelesi obesabekayo,” kucaza uCele.Uphinde wavakasha emzini wowesifazane okuthiwa waphoqwa abasolwa ababulewe ukuthi abukele ngesikhathi omunye wabo edlwengula indodakazi yakhe eyayina-18 weminyaka.Kuvele nokuthi abasolwa abane kulaba ababulewe babekade bekhona kugqekezwa lo muzi futhi kudlwengulwa indodakazi yakhona.Ungqongqoshe uthe uphiko oluphenya izenzo zamaphoyisa i-Ipid iyaphenya ngokwenzekile."Ngeke sikuvume ukuthi uma amaphoyisa ezophenya amacala anjengalawa, sibuye sizoqoqa izidumbu zawo. Singamane sithethe amacala ukuthi amaphoyisa aqinise isandla kunokuthi sihambe siyowangcwaba,” kusho uCele.Ukhale ngezindawo ezisenyakatho nasentshonalanga yeTheku wathi zigubuzelwe ububengu.UCele uthe usazobuya eDesai ukuzoxoxa nomphakathi futhi uyabona ukuthi isekhona intuthu kule ndawo okuzomele amaphoyisa abuye azoyicisha.Ungqongqoshe uthe ukubulawa kwamaphoyisa angu-22 ezinyangeni ezintathu zokuphela kuka-2023, kubalwa nelalisophikweni i-NIU kukhomba ukuthi izigebengu azizimisele ukuhlehlela emuva. "Uma ufuna ubufakazi bokuthi ziyingozi kangakanani izigebengu, yilezi zidumbu zamaphoyisa esizingcwabayo. Umuntu okhala ngokuthi amaphoyisa anesandla esiqinile, okusho ukuthi uma sithamba, sizowangcwaba zonke izinsuku amaphoyisa," kusho uCele ethi amaphoyisa adutshulwa ngesikhathi evikela umphakathi nawo.
UKHALE ngabamzilise kabuhlungu eshonelwe umngani wakhe owesifazane waseNanda eThekwini obengumngani wephoyisa elibhokodwe ngommese yisoka lalo laze lafa ngeSonto.Kulesi sigameko kufe uNksz Yolanda Bianca Khuzwayo (23) waseGlenmore, kwaboshwa uMnuz Sizwe Ngema (27). Bobabili bebengamaphoyisa kaMasipala weTheku.Isigameko esishaqise abaningi, umsolwa enameka ezinkundleni zokuxhumana i-video kamufi ephuma umphefumulo, senzeke eflethini elisemgwaqweni uJoseph Nduli (Russell) enkabeni yeTheku.Emva kwalesi sigameko, kuvele izinkulumo ezehlukene, abanye bethi umsolwa ubulale umufi ngoba ethole ukuthi uhushule isisu.Abanye bebethi umsolwa uthole ukuthi ingane abeyikhulelwe umufi bekungesiyo eyakhe.Kugcine kungena igama likaNksz Anele Sandra Mkhize, ongumngani kamufi, kuthiwa uye obaqhathile, kwasolwa yena ngokubulawa komngani wakhe. Embhalweni omude awubhale ekhasini likaFacebook okukholakala ukuthi ngelikaNksz Mkhize, unameke nama-voice note amabili, eyakhe lapho abezwakalisa khona ukukhathazeka ngomufi, kuthi kwenye, kuzwakale umufi echaza ngesimo esingesihle phakathi kwakhe nomsolwa.Kwi-voice note okukholakala ukuthi ngekaNksz Mkhize, uzwakala ethi uzokhuluma iqiniso kumufi njengomngani."Mngani ukhombisa ukudideka, ukhuluma into uphinde uziphikise, lokho kuyasisabisa singabangani bakho futhi kuyasikhathaza. Uma udiniwe othandweni, ufuna ukuyihushula ingane, uma ujabulile, ufuna ukuyigcina,” kusho uNksz Mkhize.Uqhuba athi bona bagcina bengasazi ukuthi kufanele bameseke kanjani."Thatha isinqumo bese uyama kuso. Udinga ukuthi uhlale phansi, ucabangisise, bese uthatha isinqumo esisodwa, esizokweseka kuso thina,” kusho uNksz Mkhize.Uphinde athi uNksz Khuzwayo kudingeka athathe isinqumo ngokushesha ngoba isikhathi sesihambe kakhulu.Uveza ukuthi umufi ubeke washo ukuthi uzomtshela umsolwa ukuthi uyangabaza ukugcina ingane."Ngagcina ngingazi ukuthi ngijabulele ukuba u-anti noma ngikhathazeke ngokuba umngani womuntu owumbulali. Kufanele usicacisele ukuthi sizoba ngo-anti noma sizoba abangani bombulali,” kusho uNksz Mkhize.Kuwona lo mbhalo uNksz Mkhize ubuye aveze ukuthi ukwehlulelwa kwakhe abantu ezinkundleni zokuxhumana kuholele ekutheni angamukeleki emndenini kamngani wakhe.Waveza nokuthi ngenxa yabantu 'abangazi lutho’ ngeke esakwazi ukungcwaba umngani wakhe. Ukhale ngabantu abakhuluma into abangayazi.Kwi-voice note okukholakala kuthi ekamufi, kuvela ukuthi wayesehlele ukuthi kungenele umamncane wakhe engxabanweni yakhe nomsolwa, wathi mhlawumbe uma ikhulunywa kukhona umuntu omdala izoxazululeka.Imizamo yokuthola uNksz Mkhize, ayiphumelelanga.Umamncane kamufi, uNksz Nozipho Khuzwayo ucele ukungaphenduli wathi akekho esimweni sokukhuluma nabezindaba.
UYISE womunye wabayisishiyigalolunye ababulawe ngamaphoyisa eDesai, eMariannhill uthi ubehlale emkhuza umfana wakhe ukuthi makahlukane nabangani bakhe abangalungile, ashone nabo.Lona wesilisa ukhulume kanje embizweni yomphakathi noNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa uMnuz Bheki Cele kule ndawo ngoLwesine.Le ndoda enqabile negama layo kodwa yadalula elomfana wayo oshonile, ethe u-Andile Makhathini iveze ukuthi ngumuzi wakubo lapho okwenzeke khona isigameko.Izwakalisa nokukhathazeka kwayo ngokuthi amaphoyisa amane aqhulula ngenhlamvu wonke umuntu obengaphakathi endlini ekubeni bekukhona nabangenacala.Kwabangenacala uthe bekungumzala ka-Andile obekade evakashile, uLungisani Simelane waKwaMashu."Into engiphatha kabuhlungu ukuthi kuthiwa nabo bebephindisela kodwa bekungekho lutho olukhombisa ukuthi bebephindisela. Bebekhona vele abangani bakhe (u-Andile) ebebengalungile,’’ echaza.Uthe kungamampunge ukuthi ababulewe bebeyizinkabi, okumphathe kabi ukubulawa kwabo. Uqhubeke ngokuthi ngabe kungcono ukuthi bathathiwe bayoboshwa ngoba bebengalwi, kodwa bamane baqhululwa ngenhlamvu."Bengingekho ngesikhathi kwenzeka isigameko, ngishayelwe ucingo. Ngifike ekuseni ngathi ngizama ukungena ekhaya amaphoyisa angihlehlisa ngoshova, angithuka,’’ echaza.Uthe kulaba ababulewe kukhona abaziyo nabanye abengabazi. Uveze ukuthi ubemkhuza u-Andile ukuthi makahlukane nalaba bangani bakhe abangalungileYilapho-ke uCele engene khona wambuza ukuthi kanti ubazi ukuthi bayabheda abangani bakhe?Waphendula ngokuthi ubebazi abanye babo ukuthi bayabheda. Kuthe uma uCele embuza ukuthi bebebheda benzani, wabhoka ngolaka."Baba uCele angihambi nezingane mina, kodwa ngisasho namanje ukuthi bebekhona ababhedayo. Ngiyazi ukuthi bebekhona ababhedayo bebamba inkunzi,’’ kusho lendoda.Ibigcizelela ibuza ukuthi sekuwumthetho waseNingizimu Afrika yini ukuthi amaphoyisa amane adubule wonke umuntu nabamsulwa?Amaphoyisa athi afike kulendawo ngenhloso yokuzobopha abasolwa abathile kanti azongqongqoza emnyangweni okungewona.Aqhuba athi abe esedutshulwa abantu abebekade bekwenye indlu, nokuyilapho ephindisele kwaphangalala abayisishiyagalolunye.Aveze ukuthi ababili bakwazile ukubaleka, basagcwele amathafa.
AYANCIPHA amahlathi okucasha kwi-ANC elahlwe yicala lokushaya indiva umyalelo wenkantolo wokuba ihlinzeke iDA ngayo yonke imibhalo equkethe okwakuxoxwa yikomiti le-ANC elijuba abaholi ezinhlakeni zikahulumeni.I-ANC iphinde yahlangabezana nenye imbibizane kulempi yomthetho njengoba iNkantolo eNkulu eGoli iyiyalele ukuba inikeze iDA yonke imibhalo zingakapheli izinsuku ezingu-15.I-ANC yanika iDA imibhalo ngasekuqaleni konyaka emva kokuphoqwa yisinqumo seNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo.Kule mibhalo eyahlinzekwa iDA, ayefihliwe amagama abantu ababephakanyiselwa ezikhundleni, i-ANC yaphinde yakhala ngokuthi eminye imibhalo ayitholakali.I-DA yabe isinikela enkantolo isola i-ANC ngokushaya indiva umyalelo wenkantolo.Inkantolo iyalele i-ANC ukuba ihlinzeke iDA ngemibhalo yayo yonke imihlangano yekomiti elijuba abaholi ezikhundleni.Kulemibhalo kubalwa ama-email nezingxoxo ze-WhatsApp zamalungu ekomiti.Ilungu leDA, uDkt Leon Schreiber uthe i-ANC angeke ikuthole ukuphumula ingakayilethi yonke imibhalo."I-ANC isikukhombise ngokusobala ukuthi izimisele ukwenza noma yini ukufihla izinto ezazixoxwa emihlanganweni yekomiti. UMengameli, uCyril Ramaphosa, uyena owayengusihlalo wekomiti ngalesikhathi."Bazokwenza noma yini ukuze bafihle ukuthi ukujuba kwabo izikhulu yikona okwenza ukuba kube nokulawulwa kobbuso yidlanzana."Siyajabula ukuthi inkantolo ivumelane nathi. Njengoba inkantolo ivune thina, sinxusa uRamaphosa ukuba enze into elungile, khona kuzophela lempi yezomthetho."Isikhathi sidliwe yinja kwi-ANC njengoba benikwe izinsuku ezingu-15 ukuba basinikeze imibhalo ephelele, engafihliwe amagama abantu."Njengoba besilokhu senza ngesikhathi kuqhubeka lempi yezomthetho, sizothatha izinyathelo zomthetho ezifanele uma singanelisekile,” kusho uDkt Schreiber.Okhulumela i-ANC kuzwelonke uNkk Mahlengi Bhengu-Motsiri, uthe bebengakanqumi ukuthi bazowulandela yini umyalelo wenkantolo."Sisalinde ukuthola isinqumo senkantolo esibhaliwe, sobe sesibona ukuthi sikhona yini isidingo sokusiphonsela inselelo isinqumo senkantolo,” kusho uNkk Bhengu-Motsiri.Uthe bafuna ukuthi nayo iDA ibahlinzeke ngemibhalo yekomiti elijuba izikhulu lapho iphethe khona."Thina siyayilandela imiyalelo kodwa iDA iyabaleka neyayo imibhalo. Kuhluleke noma sesifaka isicelo sokunikezwa imibhalo ngaphansi komthetho iPromotion of Access to Information Act."Banqaba baphetha ukusinikeza imibhalo emayelana nokujutshwa kwezikhulu eminyangweni kahulumeni waseWestern Cape nakuMasipala waseCape Town. Sicela ukuthi iDA isinike lemibhalo,” kuphetha uNkk Bhengu-Mmotsiri.
UYALELWE ukuthi ahambise i-passport yakhe kubaphenyi, angaxhumani nofakazi obenguSomlomo wePhalamende uNkk Nosiviwe Mapisa-Nqakula ngoLwesine ngesikhathi ededelwa ngebheyili kaR50 000 yinkantolo yasePitoli.Kuvele ukuthi akayona ingozi yokuthi angase abalekele kwamanye amazwe njengoba ezinikele kwabezomthetho.UMbuso uveze ukuthi uhlela ukwengeza omunye ufakazi ecaleni likaNkk Mapisa-Nqakula obhekene namacala angu-12, athinta inkohlakalo nokushushumbisa imali ubuye asolwe ngokwamukela intshontsho komunye wosonkontileka owayethole ithenda eMnyangweni wezokuVikela, ngesikhathi esanguNgqongqoshe kulo mnyango.Umshushisi u-Advocate Bheki Manyathi, ubefune ukuthi uNkk Mapisa-Nqakula anikwe ibheyili kaR100 000, kodwa wakhala ummeli wakhe u-Advocate Graham Kerr-Phillips, otshele imantshi uNkk Anna Oosthuizen, ukuthi usesempeshenini ngakho ngeke abe nemali engaka.Imantshi ithe kumele abuyele enkantolo ngoJuni 4, 2024.UManyathi uthe unecala eliqinile ngakho ufuna liye enkantolo enkulu.Uthe ubhekene necala lenkohlakalo yemali efinyelela kuR4.5 million, kule mali uR2.1 million wawuthola uwukheshi izikhawu ezehlukene kanti wabuye wathola izipho ezehlukene okubalwa izikhwama newigi ebizayo.UNkk Mapisa-Nqakula uzinikele esiteshini samaphoyisa iLyttelton, wase edlulela enkantolo. Ubephelezelwa umyeni wakhe uMnuz Charles Nqakula, kanti enkantolo bekukhona owayengusomlomo wePhalamende uNksz Baleka Mbete, obezomeseka.Efunda incwadi efungelwe uKerr-Phillips, uthe uNkk Mapisa-Nqakula, akazi lutho ngamacala abhekene nawo.Uthe usekhulile futhi uphila nezifo ezingamahlalakhona.Ubalule ukuthi udla amaphilisi esifo somfutho wegazi ophezulu."Lesi sifo siyingozi ngoba kudingeka ahlale edla amaphilisi aso. Ukhathazekile ngesimo samajele nokuthi isifo anaso siyingozi.” UManyathi uthe ngeke bayiphikise ibheyili ngenxa yesimo sempilo yakhe nokuthi akayona ingozi yokuthi angabalekela kwamanye amazwe.Eminye yemibandela yebheyili ngukuthi i-passport yakhe kumele ayihambise ngoMsombuluko, ngo-Ephreli 8 ungakashayi u-4 ntambama, kumele angasifaki esinye isicelo se-passport entsha. I-DA isiphakamise ukuthi sisheshe sivalwe isikhala sikaSomlomo wePhalamende.Leli qembu lithe asikho isidingo sokulinda kanti ithe iyakwamukela ukusula kwakhe esikhundleni.Namanye amaqembu athe ayahambisana nesinqumo sakhe sokusula esikhundleni.IPhini lokuqala likanobhala jikelele we-ANC , uNkk Nomvula Mokonyane, lithe uNkk Mapisa-Nqakula, usule njengelungu lePhalamende kanjalo nokuba uSomlomo."Akasulanga njengelungu le-ANC, usayilungu eligcwele lenhlangano,” kusho uNkk Mokonyane.
UPHENDUKELWE amakhansela eqembu lakhe uMengameli weTeam Sugar SA (TSSA), uMnuz Musa "Shukela” Thwala, okhishwe esikhundleni sephini lemeya kuMasipala waseNewcastle.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi amakhansela amane eTSSA avotele isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaThwala emhlanganweni womkhandlu obungeledlule.Kulo mhlangano amakhansela avumelane ngokuthi uThwala akhishwe esigungwini esiphezulu, bese isikhala sakhe sithathwa elinye ikhansela leTSSA.Ukukhishwa kwakhe esigungwini esiphezulu kusho ukuthi uzophunyukwa nayisikhundla sokuba usihlalo wekomiti elibhekelele ingqalasizinda yamanzi nemigwaqo.I-TSSA inamakhansela ayisikhombisa kulo mkhandlu, ibambisene ne-IFP ekuphatheni.Amakhansela eTSSA ayekade eyalelwe ukuthi angalubhadi emhlanganweni.Ngaphambilini, uThwala wake waveza ukuthi akanelisekile ngokubambisana kwabo ne-IFP kuMasipala waseNewcastle, kuvela ukuthi amakhansela eqembu lakhe ahlukene phakathi ngalolu daba njengoba kukhona asafuna beqhubeke nokusebenzisana ne-IFP.USomlomo womkhandlu, uMntwana uThengi Zulu, uthe uThwala ukhishelwe ukulova emihlanganweni."Walova emihlanganweni emithathu yesigungu esiphezulu elandelanayo. Sibe sesivumelana ngokuthi akhishwe esigungwini esiphezulu. Naye uThwala uyazi ukuthi umthetho awuvumi ukuthi ikhansela lilove emihlanganweni emithathu elandelanayo.”Amakhansela e-ANC nawe-EFF awazange alubhade emhlanganweni.UMntwana uThengi uthe wonke amakhansela ayazisiwe ngomhlangano, kodwa amanye akhetha ukungezi.Uthe uThwala ubazisile ukuthi uzokuphonsela inselelo ukukhishwa kwakhe esikhundleni."Wangishayela ucingo emva komhlangano, wathi angimthumelele amaminithi omhlangano. Wangitshela ukuthi abameli bakhe bafuna ukuthatha izinyathelo. Ngimtshelile ukuthi amaminithi omhlangano uzowathola uma esephasisiwe. Naye uyazi ukuthi amaminithi awukwazi ukuwathola ngokushesha, kufanele aqale alungiswe, bese eyaphasiswa emhlanganweni womkhandlu. Thina sanelisekile ukuthi kwalandelwa yonke imigomo ngesikhathi kunomhlangano.”UThwala uthe ubengakayitholi into ebhalwe phansi esho ukuthi usekhishiwe esikhundleni kodwa wathi usephuciwe imoto yomkhandlu nabaqaphi."Kuyangikhathaza lokhu kokuthi ngiphucwe abaqaphi njengoba kunenkinga yokubulawa kosopolitiki KwaZulu-Natal. Ngizokuphonsela inselelo ukukhishwa kwami ngoba akuzange kulandelwe imigomo.”UThwala uthe azothathelwa izinyathelo zokuqondiswa ubugwegwe amakhansela eTSSA ashaya indiva umyalelo wokuba angayi emhlanganweni."Isigungu esiphezulu kwiTSSA sahlala phansi, savumelana ngokuthi amakhansela eTSSA angayi emhlanganweni ngoba sasingajabule ngezinhlelo ezithile. Uma sesithole amaminithi omhlangano, sizothatha izinyathelo ezifanele.”
KUZOSHUBA kwabahlomule ngokungafanele ngesibonelelo sika-R370 sabangasebenzi njengoba uhulumeni ephasise umthetho wokuthi basikhokhe abasithole kungafanele.Lo mthetho uvumela uNgqongqoshe wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi, uNkk Lindiwe Zulu, ukuba alande uR370 otholwe abakade bengafanele ukuwuthola.Uzoqala ukusebenza kule nyanga njengoba uNkk Zulu efuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi uR370 okhuphuke kule nyanga, usuka kuR350, utholwa ngabantu abawudinga ngempela."ISouth African Social Security Agency (Sassa) ifuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi isibonelelo sabangasebenzi esiwele kumuntu ongafanele siyabuyiswa. Ngokwesigaba esibizwa ngo-sub regulation 2, iSassa igqugquzela abantu ukuba baqinisekise ukuthi imininingwane yabo yileyo efanele. Uma umuntu ofake isicelo engatholakali, engawuthinti uSassa noma engavuseleli imininingwane yakhe ngeke simkhokhele isibonelelo,” kuchaza uNkk Zulu.Uveze ukuthi abantu abangayithinti iSassa ezinsukwini eziwu-90 emuva kokuthi becelwe ukuba bathinte le nhlangano ngeke basithole isibonelelo sabangasebenzi.Isibonelelo sabo sizobuyela kuhulumeni njengoba iSassa ifuna yonke imali iye kubantu abaziwayo ukuthi bakhona futhi abasebenzi.Uthe kufanele abantu baqinisekise ukuthi iSassa inemininingwane yabo efanelekile okuhlanganisa nenamba yocingo abatholakala kuyona, kanjalo nemininingwane yasebhange efanelekile.Ngokwezibalo zikahulumeni bangaphezu kuka-8 million abantu abahola isibonelelo sabangasebenzi kuleli.
BASALE bemangele emva kokuthi owesilisa ongumakhelwane egwaza ebulala ilungu lomndeni wabo esehlakalweni esenzeke KwaVimbukhalo, eNdwedwe, ngoMsombuluko.Kuthiwa uMnuz Siyabonga Blose (36) uphelele egcekeni emva kokugwazwa umsolwa inxeba elilodwa enhliziyweni.Ngokusho kukamamkhulu wakhe, uNkk Sebenzile Ximba, obekhona ngesikhathi umufi ehlaselwa, baqale bangazitshela ukuthi umsolwa uzombulala ngempela umufi njengoba ebesho."Ngendlela imindeni yethu ekhonzene ngayo, singomakhelwane abasondelene kakhulu. Uma omunye nomunye enze izinkukhwana, asilenzi iphutha, siyahambelana,” kuchaza uNkk Ximba.Elandisa ngokwenzeke ngosuku lwesigameko, uthe umsolwa ufike wabuza umufi ukuthi uphi."Uthe namuhla uzombulala, futhi ufuna ukumbulalela kubo,” kusho uNkk Ximba, othe bamtshela ukuthi umufi akekho, nakhona bengazitsheli ukuthi uqinisile.Uveze ukuthi kwaphinde kwafika nonina kamufi nodadewabo, bethi bazomkhuza ukuthi angayenzi into embi."Umufi wafika kukhulunywa, wabuza ukuthi wezwa kuphathwa igama lakhe kwenzenjani, umsolwa wagxuma wahlala embuza ukuthi uyibulaleleni iselula yakhe. Akabange esakwazi ukuphendula ngoba uvele wamgwaza ngempela,” kusho yena.Uveze ukuthi umndeni wonke, okamsolwa nomphakathi umangele ngoba bebengayilindele into efana nale.Uthe emva kwesigameko bakhethe ukuthula, bayeke amaphoyisa asebenze."Uboshiwe umsolwa. Siwumndeni sikhethe ukungathathi ngezinhliziyo,” kusho uNkk Ximba.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uConstable Thenjiswa Ngcobo, uthe amaphoyisa aseNsuze abophe owesilisa ngecala lokubulala umakhelwane."Uvelile eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseNsuze, uzophinde avele ngoLwesithathu oluzayo esecela ibheyili. Umsolwa usagqunywe esitokisini,” kusho uConst Ngcobo.
UNEPHUPHO lokuba unjiniyela ohlonishwayo kuleli nakwamanye amazwe, umfundi oqokwe ukuba ayomela elakuleli emqhudelwaneni wamazwe omhlaba, i- International Science Technology Engineering Competition, ozokuba se-Indonesia ngenyanga ezayo.USiqiniseko Mpontshana (20) waseNdumo kuMasipala Umkhanyakude, ofunda u-Grade 12 eMandla Mthethwa School of Excellence, uqokwe ohlelweni i-Eskom Expo for Young Scientists olukhuthaza ukuqhamuka namakhono nezinto ezintsha ezingalekelela umphakathi kanti umqhudelwano uzothatha izinsuku ezintathu phakathi kukaMeyi 2 no- 5.Engxoxweni neSolezwe, lo mfundi oseke wadla umhlanganiso emiqhudelwaneni yakuleli ngombukiso wakhe wemoto azisungulele yona, uthe isifiso sakhe ukuba yi-Megatronic Electrical Engineer. "Ngiqale ukuba nombono wokwakha le moto ngisemncane kakhulu ngifunda amabanga aphansi eJozini Primary. Ngesikhathi ngikhula, ngenza nocwaningo, bengilokhu ngiqhubeka nokuthuthukisa umsebenzi wami okuthe ngo-2021 ngathola indondo yethusi ezingeni lesifunda emqhudelwaneni we-Eskom Expo for Young Scientists,” usho kanje.Uthe uphinde wawungenela ngonyaka olandelayo esethe ukuthuthukisa umsebenzi wakhe, wahlomula ngendondo yegolide, okumvulele amasango njengoba eqokwe ukuthi abe yingxenye yososayensi abahambele i- International Science Fair eGoli nyakenye.USiqiniseko, ongumagcino kwabo ezinganeni eziyisikhombisa, uthe umbono wokwakha imoto esebenza ngogesi edonsa inqola ngaphandle kokuthi ixhunywe kuyo umfikele ngoba abantu abaningi abakwazi ukushayela izimoto ezidonsa izinqola. "Amanani ka-phethroli ayanyuka, ngakho uhlobo lwemoto enje lungaba yisisombululo. Ngiphinde ngabona indlela izingozi ezanda ngayo emigwaqweni okudalwa ubudedengu babashayeli ngabona ukuthi uma kungasungulwa imoto ekwazi ukuthi izishayele zingancipha,” kulandisa yena.Okunye akufakile, umayibuthe ovimba ukuthi imoto ingasondeli kakhulu kwenye athi kungehlisa ukushayisana kwezimoto kanti imoto yakhe iyashajwa isikhathi esingangemizuzu eyishumi kuphela.Yize kumthokozisa ukuthola isimemo, kodwa uthe leli thuba eliyingqayizivele lingamphunyuka ngenxa yesimo somnotho njengoba kungekho muntu osebenzayo kwabo.Ngokwencwadi eshicilelwe abenkampani, i-Eskom izokhokha izindleko zika-R45 000 okubalwa kuzona ukukhokhela uhambo, indawo yokulala nokudla bese kuthi oqokiwe ahlangabeze ngo-R6000 kuphela.Unina uNkk Ntombiziphi Mpontshana uthe ngesikhathi bethola ukuthi indodana yabo ithole ithuba lokuyokhangisa umsebenzi wayo phesheya iqhudelana nezincitha-buchopho zakwamanye amazwe, kube yizindaba ezibajabulisa kakhuku ekhaya."Uvele ungumuntu ozimiselayo uma enza okuthile. Ukhule ewumuntu othandayo ukusebenza ngokuzimisela futhi ethanda izinto ezithinta ubuchwepheshe. Nokho sisadidekile ukuthi sizokwenzenjani ngezindleko zohambo njengoba kukhona imali okudingeka ukuthi ayikhokhe kuqala ewu- R6000 ukuhlangabezana ne-Eskom, ezokhokhela uhambo, ukudla nendawo yokulala,” usho kanje.Uthe njengoba lesi simemo bebengasilindele, okwamanje ubamba uyayeka, ngakho ufisa noma ngubani ongalekelela ekufezweni kwephupho lendodana yakhe.

Kufe abayisishiyagalolunye, kanti alikho iphoyisa elilimalile. Amaphoyisa athole izibhamu ezintathu ezincane nesisodwa esikhulu, kanti kusathungathwa abanye ababili okuthiwa bayingxenye yale migulukudu abasagcwele amathafa,” usho kanje.
IBHEMILE kwabazotholakala ukuthi benza inkohlakalo ngesikhathi kwakhiwa eminye imitapo yolwazi KwaZulu-Natal njengoba uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa esejube uphiko oluphenya amacala enkohlakalo iSpecial Investigating Unit (SIU), ukuthi luphenye.Lolu phiko luyalelwe nguRamaphosa ukuthi luphenye uMnyango wezemiDlalo, ubuCiko namaSiko esifundazweni ngokwakhiwa kwemitapo yolwazi eyisishiyagalombili kanjalo nokusatshalaliswa kwezincwadi kuyona.Uphiko luzophenya ukuthi ngabe ayisebenzanga yini ngendlela engafanele imali yomphakathi ngesikhathi kwakhiwa imitapo kusuka ngoJanuwari 1, 2020 kuya kuMashi 28, 2024.Okhulumela i-SIU uMnuz Kaizer Kganyago, uthe umengameli ugunyaze ukuthi kuphenywe umnyango ukuze kubuyiswe imali yabakhokhi bentela eyalahleka.Uthe bazophenya nethimba losonkontileka abasabalalisa izincwadi.Uveze ukuthi imitapo yolwazi okuphenywa ukwakhiwa kwayo yiDukuduku Library, Nibela Modular Library, Kwankosi Khumalo Modular Library, Kwakhetha Modular Library, Mpembeni Modular Library, Ntunjambili Modular Library, Donny Dalton Modular Library, Mfekayo Modular Library neKwanzimakwe Modular Library."Siphenya nokuthi ngabe kwakukhona yini ukusetshenziswa kwemali ngendlela engafanele ngesikhathi kwenziwa le misebenzi. Siphenya ukuthi bakhona yini abasebenzi bakahulumeni abathintekayo, osonkontileka kanjalo nanoma ngubani othintekayo.”Uthe bazokwenza izincomo zokuthi ngomuso kungavikelwa kanjani ukulahleka kwemali yomphakathi."Ngokomthetho esiyothola ukuthi bayathinteka, sizobadlulisela ophikweni lwezokushushisa iNational Prosecuting Authority (NPA), ukuze ibhekane nabo. Sigunyazwe ngumthetho olawula iSIU, ukuthi sishushise abathintekayo enkantolo enkulu,” kusho uKganyago. Lumatasa lolu phiko kulezi zinsuku njengoba lusanda kujutshwa nguRamaphosa ukuthi luphenye izinto ezenzeka eMnyangweni wezaseKhaya mayelana nokukhishwa kwezimvume zokuba kuleli luphenye nakwaPrasa.
UMHOLI weMK oyikhansela kuMasipala waseThekwini, uMnuz Visvin Reddy uthweswe icala lokuphehla udlame emva kwenkulumo yakhe esabisa ngokuthi kuzokuba nodungunyane uma kukhishwa iMK ohlwini lwamaqembu angenele ukhetho.UReddy uvele eNkantolo yeMantshi eChatsworth ngoLwesithathu lapho ebekwe khona icala ngaphansi komthetho olawula ukuhlangana kwabantu, iRiotous Assemblies Act.Okhulumela iNational Prosecuting Authority KwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Natasha Ramkisson-Kara uthe icala likaReddy lihlehliselwe uJune 14 kanti selizoqulwa eNkantolo yesifunda eThekwini.” UReddy uyilungu eliqavile leMK, uvela ohlwini lwamalungu alenhlangano aya ePhalamende emva kokhetho oluzayo. Izolo ubonakale engathukile ngaphandle kwenkantolo.Utshele amalungu eMK abezomeseka ngaphandle kwenkantolo ukuthi lelizwe alikayitholi inkululeko, wathi iyotholakala mhla iMK yanqoba ukhetho."I-ANC kaRamaphosa (Mengameli, uCyril) ihlezi ifuna sigubhe usuku lwenkululeko ngo-Ephreli 27."U-Ephreli 27 akusilo usuku lwenkululeko. Usuku lwenkululeko kuzokuba uMeyi 29, lapho iMK iyonqoba ukhetho ngamalengiso,” kusho uReddy.UReddy wazifaka otakwini ngokusongela izinkantolo nenhlangano eyengamele ukhetho, i-Independent Electoral Commission (IEC).UReddy ekhuluma emcimbini weMK, wathi kuzokuba nodlame uma izinkantolo zithatha izinqumo ezinqinda amandla leli qembu elikhankaselwa owayenguMengameli uJacob Zuma.Inkulumo yakhe wayenza ngenyanga eyedlule ngaphambi kokuthi kulalelwe amacala amabili lapho i-ANC imangalele kuwo iMK.Icala lokuqala lalalelwa eNkantolo yezoKhetho, lapho i-ANC yayifuna ukuthi iMK ikhishwe ohlwini lwamaqembu azongenela ukhetho.Isicelo se-ANC sachithwa. Icala lesibili lalilalelwe eNkantolo eNkulu eThekwini, lapho i-ANC yayisola iMK ngokuntshontsha igama nophawu lombutho wezempi owahlakazwa, uMkhonto weSizwe.Kwi-video esabalale ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, uReddy uzwakala ethi kuzosuka izibhelu uma kukhishwa iMK ohlwini lwamaqembu angenele ukhetho."Siyazi ukuthi izinkantolo zichemile. Uma kuvinjwa iMK, kuzosuka udungunyane kuleli zwe. Kuzokuba nemibhikisho engakaze ibonwe. "Kwalona ukhetho lolo ngeke lube khona. Akekho umuntu waseNingizimu Afrika ozovota iMK ingekho okhethweni,” kusho uReddy,Uphinde wasabisa ngodlame uma kukhishwa igama likaZuma ohliwni lwabangenele ukhetho.UZuma uvele usekhishiwe ohlwini, kepha usiphonsela inselelo lesinqumo.
KUKHULEKELWE abasebenzi bakaMasipala uMhlathuze kulandela isigameko esishaqisayo sokubulalana konogada ngaphakathi emahhovisi kamasipala ngesonto eledlule. Abefundisi, abasebenzi, izikhulu zikamasipala nezinhlaka ezehlukene bahlangane eRichards Bay Civic Center kwaba nenkonzo yokukhulekela izimo ezehlukene. Lokhu kulandela ukuthi ngoLwesine olwedlule ekuseni kwafa uMnuz Ntokozo Mthembu obeqapha imeya (uMnuz Xolani Ngwezi) okuthiwa wadutshulwa uzakwabo emuva kokuthi evulele ngenhlambu kuMnuz Simo Zulu oqapha imenenja kamasipala.Okhulumela umasipala uMnuz Bongani Gina, uthe ngomkhuleko kuhloswe ukuletha ukuthula kumasipala, ukuthoba amanxeba kubasebenzi ababona okwenzeka kanjalo nemindeni elahlekelwe abathandiweyo bayo. "Sibize ongoti abeluleka ngokwengqondo ukuzokweluleka abathikanyezwe yilesi sigameko. Nabasebenzi sibathumelele umbiko wokuthi bangesabi baphumele obala uma benengcindezi. Umasipala uzimisele ngokuthi baxhumane nabaphathi uma bedinga ukuba sekhaya. Kukhona nabathuswa ukubona ama-video nokungabathikamiza, sifisa bavele bathole usizo," kusho uGina.Amaphoyisa esifundazweni KwaZulu-Natal ebuzwa ngalesi sigameko athe asematasa nophenyo. Selokhu senzeka abantu bazwakalisa ukushaqeka ezinkundleni zokuxhumana. Babodwa abanovalo lokuya emahhovisi njengoba umasipala usiza umphakathi ngezinsiza ezehlukene. UGina uthe amalungu omphakathi ayekhona kwenzeka isigameko bacela avele azokwelulekwa ngokwengqondo.
UDEDELWE ngebheyili uNkk Nosiviwe Mapisa-Nqakula osanda kusula esikhundleni sakhe sokuba nguSomlomo wePhalamende nanjengelungu lePhalamende. UMapisa-Nqakula uzinikele emaphoyisa esiteshini samaphoyisa iLyttelton, eCenturion ngoLwesine ekuseni. Ubhekene namacala angu-13, angu-12 enkohlakalo nelilodwa lokushushumbisa imali.Umshushisi utshele inkantolo ukuthi lo msolwa wathola imali engaphezu kukaR2 million eyintshontsho. Ngaleyo ndlela ufanelwe wukunikezwa ibheyili kaR100 000. Ummeli kaMapisa-Nqakula unxuse inkantolo ukuba imnikeze ibheyili kaR50 000 ngoba useminyakeni yempesheni, iyona mali angakwazi ukuyikhokha.IMantshi u-Anna Oosthuizen unikeze uNkk Mapisa-Nqakula ibheyili kaR50 000 wayalelwa nokuthi anike abaphenyi izincwadi zakhe zokuvakasha.
UBESEHLALA ekubhaceni owesifazane waseMariannhill eDesai, othi kudlwengulwe indodakazi yakhe, yena evalelwe ekamelweni okukholakala ukuthi kwenziwe ngabanye abasolwa abayisishiyagalolunye abaqothwe amaphoyisa entathakusa ngoLwesithathu.Owesifazane ekhuluma nabezindaba, uthe ukudlwengulwa kwendodakazi yakhe ena-24 ngoJanuwari nonyaka, kushiye yena nomgilwa nezibazi ezisekude ukuphola."Sasizihlalele ekhaya ngabo-12 ebusuku ngesikhathi abasolwa abayisithupha ababezifihlile bekhahlela umnyango osekhishini. Bangena bathatha amafoni, amateku ne-TV. Indlu inamakamelo amabili okulala, bangiphushela ekamelweni ngadonsa indodakazi yami encane ena-16 bathi angilale embhedini ngimboze ngengubo nendodakazi yami, omunye umsolwa wasala wadlwengula lena endala eyidlwengulela kwelinye ikamelo,” kubalisa yenaUthe kusuka lapho washiya ikhaya kanti ngesikhathi abezindaba befika kwakhe ubefaka izimpahla esebuyela emzini wakhe, emva kokuthi ezwe ezindabeni ngesigameko sokudutshulwa kwabasolwa. Uthe unethemba elikhulu emaphoyiseni akuleli. Uthe bese ehlala ethukile selokhu kwenzeka lesi sigameko ikakhulu uma kuphela inyanga ngoba unemiqasho futhi abasolwa babesho ukuthi bafuna imali.Uthe ubugebengu obebuqhutshwa abasolwa bebumlimaza ngisho ebhizinisini lakhe lokuqashisa aziphilisa ngalo njengoba kunezindlu ezingenamuntu, abantu besaba ukuqasha kule ndawo ngenxa yobugebengu.Amalungu omphakathi athi okushaqisayo ukuthi abanye balaba abebehlukumeza yizingane ezaziwayo ezikhulele phambi kwabo. Elinye ilungu lomphakathi elithe linesitolo esincane esidayisa ukudla, lithe bese lisivale izinsuku ezintathu emva kokusongelwa abasolwa abebethi bafuna akhokhe imali ethile ngalo kungenjalo bazolenzakalisa. UMnuz Dawood Chirwari osekomitini elibhekele ubugebengu emphakathini, ekhuluma nabezindaba, uthe namanje usanezibazi njengoba kwadutshulwa kwabulawa indodana yakhe eyahlaselwa ikubo ngo-2020, nodadewabo oshone emva kokudutshulwa ehamba emgwaqweni kuyo le ndawo, asola ukuthi lezi zigameko zenziwa yibona abasolwa."Umphakathi walapha ubusuhlukumezeke kakhulu. Uma uzobheka imizi eminingi ayinamuntu nakuba ngingasho ukuthi bakhishwa ngenkani kodwa akekho umuntu ongahlala endaweni abonayo ukuthi akuphephile kuyo,” usho kanje.Uthe abantu kufanele bajabule ngoba sebezokwazi ukuhamba ngokukhululeka.
