SINIKWE izinsuku eziwu-14 ukuba sibiye kahle ucingo lwaso isiqiwi esizimele KwaZulu-Natal, iMawana Game Reserve.IMawana yakhelene nemiphakathi yaseHlonyane, Mkholo, Nhlazatshe neMkholokotho Olundi.AbezeMvelo KZN Wildlife bathe lesi siqiwi yisona okweqa kuso izindlovu eziwuvanzi Olundi bese zilimaza umphakathi.UMnuz Musa Mntambo obhekelele ezokuxhumana kwezeMvelo KZN Wildlife, uthe imiphakathi eyakhele iMawana ibilokhu ikhala ngezindlovu eziwuhlalise lubhojozi ezeqa eMawana.NgoMashi 22 enye yalezi zindlovu yalimaza kanzima indoda eyayiluse izinkomo zayo, yasindiswa wukuzenza sengathi ifile ukuze indlovu iyiyeke.Usizo yaze yaluthola ngakusasa sekufika omunye umelusi endaweni efanayo.UMntambo uthe emuva kwalesi sigameko, Ezemvelo zithathe isinqumo sokuyalela iMawana ukuba ibiye isiqiwi kungakapheli izinsuku eziwu-14.Esitatimendeni esithunyelwe kwabezindaba uMnuz Joe Phadima oyiNhloko yeScientific Services kwezeMvelo KZN Wildlife, uthe uma abaseMawana behluleka wukubiya nokulandela eminye imithetho yokongiwa kwemvelo, bazothathelwa izinyathelo zomthetho kubuye kubulawe izindlovu eziwuhlupho.Uveze ukuthi miningi imizamo asebeyizamile yokulekelela abaseMawana ukuba baphathe kahle isiqiwi sabo kodwa ngebhadi ayitheli izithelo ezinhle njengoba umndeni ophethe lesi siqiwi unombango wefa oqhubeka ezinkantolo.Kulezi zinsuku eziwu-14 ezibekiwe abazeMvelo KZN Wildlife bazofundisa umphakathi ukuthi uzivikele kanjani uma uhlangana nezindlovu kanti usuthinte nabezinhlangano ezizimele ukuba basondele nezinye izisombululo.Uthe kube nomhlangano nabaseMawana, umphakathi nabasezemvelo ngalolu daba. Umphakathi ufuna zisuswe izindlovu kule ndawo njengoba abaseMawana belokhu bekhala ngokuthi abanamali yokuzisusa.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi iMawana Game Reserve yasungulwa nguMnuz Cornelius van der Walt ngo-2003. Ushone ngo-2017 waseshiya lesi siqiwi ezinganeni zakhe.Ngo-2017 umkhwenyana wakwa-Van der Walt uMnuz Beyers Coetzee obebhekelele ukusebenza kwalesi siqiwi nomkhakhe uNkk Una uye wabulawa yizo izindlovu ezazeqe esiqiwini ngesikhathi ezama ukuzibuyisela emuva.Ngonyaka odlule kuye kwabulawa izilwane eziwu-900 zasendle eMawana ngoba omunye wezingane zakhona efuna ukwenza imali yokuqhuba umsebenzi wokulungisa lesi siqiwi, kodwa wamiswa izingane zakubo ezaya enkantolo.
UKHOMISHANA wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLt Col Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi uthi azoboshwa amaphoyisa aphula umthetho ngoba akekho umuntu ongaphezu komthetho.Usho lokhu emuva kokuboshwa kwephoyisa elisebenza esiteshini saseMpumalanga, eHammarsdale elibhekene necala lokushaya ngenhloso yokulimaza intombi yalo.Lesi sigameko kuthiwa senzeke emgwaqweni uMthoko Mkhize ngeSonto.Intombi yaleli phoyisa, uNksz Thandeka P Ngcongo inikele ezinkundleni zokuxhumana yabhala ukuthi amaphoyisa esiteshi iMpumalanga, eHammarsdale anqabile ukuyivulela icala uma iveza ukuthi ishaywe yiphoyisa elisebenza kulesi siteshi.Lona wesifazane izolo ukuqinisekisile ukuthi likhona icala elivuliwe ngalesi sigameko.Izolo ntambama amaphoyisa aqinisekise ukuthi nalo wesifazane ugcine eboshiwe ngecala lokushaya nokucekela phansi impahla emuva kokuthi iphoyisa nalo livule icala. Ngokwamaphoyisa, lo wesifazane ulishayile walimaza isicabha semoto yalo. Kuvela ukuthi bobabili bebedle amanzi amponjwana. Lusaqhubeka uphenyo. ULt-Gen Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi uthe akekho umuntu ongaphezu komthetho, ngisho namaphoyisa. Leli phoyisa lizovela enkantolo ngoLwesine.Uveze ukuthi seluqalile nophenyo ngezinsolo zokuthi kunamaphoyisa anqabile ukuvulela owesifazane icala ngesikhathi ezobika ngokushaywa kwakhe esiteshini samaphoyisa.Uma kukhona okubambekayo ngalezi zinsolo, uMkhwanazi uthe kuzoqala izinhlelo zokuqondisa ubugwegwe, ezizolandela imigomo yokusebenza kwamaphoyisa.Uthe amaphoyisa alusukumela phezulu udaba lodlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane elandela umthetho iDomestic Violence Act. Udonse ngendlebe amaphoyisa ukuthi abe yisibonelo esihle."Abesifazane nezingane kufanele bazizwe bephephile uma kukhona amadoda, kufanele bazibone bephephe kakhulu uma kukhona amaphoyisa noma ngabe engasebenzi."Amaphoyisa kufanele abe yisibonelo esihle, alwa nalo lonke uhlobo lobugebengu olubhekiswe kwabesifazane nezingane."Uma amaphoyisa enza noma ngabe yiluphi uhlobo lobugebengu, sizokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi abhekana nomthetho,” kusho Lt-Gen Mkhwanazi.Khonamanjalo uNgqongqoshe wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi KwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Nonhlanhla Khoza uzwakalise ukushaqeka ngezigameko zokuhlaselwa kwabesifazane ezithinta amaphoyisa.Uzigxekile lezi zigameko esho nokuthi kumphethe kabi ukuthi amaphoyisa okufanele avikele abantu, yiwona anodlame.Ube esedlulisa amazwi enduduzo emndenini wephoyisa lesifazane likaMasipala weTheku eligwazwe labulawa ngobeyisoka lalo naye obeyiphoyisa likamasipala.Ubuye wagxeka ukushaywa kanzima kukaNksz Ngcobo wathi amaphoyisa kufanele awaphenye kabanzi lamacala athinta amaphoyisa noma ngabe enziwe wozakwabo.Uveze ukuthi sebekhiphe ithimba losonhlalakahle elizosiza imindeni ethintekayo."Kusiphethe kabi ukuthi amaphoyisa enze lezi zigameko. Njengoba sekukhona ababoshiwe sikholwa ukuthi umthetho uzothatha indawo yawo. Sifuna izinkantolo zenze isibonelo ngabenzi balobu bugebengu obubi. Kufanele kucace ukuthi akekho ongaphezu komthetho," kusho uNkk Khoza.
IPHINI likaNobhala Jikelele kwi-ANC, uNkk Nomvula Mokonyane uthi ingqalabutho yalenhlangano uNkk Winnie Madikizela-Mandela yakhetha ukuhlala kwi-ANC noma yayibhekene nezikhathi ezinzima.UNkk Mokonyane uthe uWinnie akazange enze njengabanye abakhetha ukuyosungula amaqembu abo uma bebhekene nezikhathi ezinzima kwi-ANC.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi kunomcimbi obuhlelwe i-ANC Women’s League wokukhumbula usuku okwashona ngalo uNkk Madikizela-Mandela.NgoLwesibili bekuhlangana iminyaka eyisithupha kwashona uNkk Madikizela-Mandela.Abaholi be-ANC babeke izimbali ethuneni likaNkk Madikizela-Mandela eliseFouways Memorial Park, kwase kuba nomcimbi wokukhanyisa amakhandlela emzini kaNkk Madikizela-Mandela oseSoweto.UNkk Mokonyane uthe uNkk Madikizela-Mandela wakhombisa uthando olukhulu kwi-ANC nangezikhathi ezinzima."Waze wafa eyilungu lokuqina le-ANC. Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika kufanele bangakukhohlwa ukuthi uNkk Madikizela-Mandela akazange ayilaxaze i-ANC nangezikhathi ezinzima."Ziningi izinto ezazingamenza ashiye i-ANC ayozivulela isitokofela sakhe esincane, noma inkulisa yakhe encane, kodwa wakhetha ukuhlala kwi-ANC."Wahlala kwi-ANC yize noma ayethandwa kakhulu abantu abangewona amalungu ayo. Lokhu wayekwenziswa wukuthi wayazi ukuthi i-ANC yiyo eyamenza waba yilento ayeyiyo,” kusho uNkk Mokonyane.Uthe abantu abaningi bamthande ngoba engasekho uNkk Madikizela-Mandela.Uqhubeke ngokuthi iyefana nekaJesu, sisanda kubuya ezinkonzweni zePhasika. Indaba kaNkk Madikizela-Mandela ithi ayifane nokubethelwa kukaJesu esiphambanweni. Emva kokushona kwakhe, ngisho nezitha zakhe imbala zamvuma.UNkk Mokonyane uthe bazohlezi beliqhakambisa igalelo likaNkk Madikizela-Mandela."Size lapha ukuzozibophezela kabusha. Siqhamuka kwinhlangano kaNomzamo Madikizela-Mandela, i-ANC."Nathi njengenhlangano sesike sabhekana nezikhathi ezinzima, kodwa sizibophezela ekuqhubekeni nokulandela ezinyathelweni zakho. Kuningi esesikubonile,” kubalisa uNkk Mokonyane.Unxuse abazukulu bakaNkk Madikizela-Mandela ngokulandela ezinyathelweni zikagogo wabo, bavotele i-ANC okhethweni oluzayo.Umzukulu kaNkk Madikizela-Mandela, uNkk Zamaswazi Dlamini-Mandela, unxuse abantu bakuleli ukuba baphume ngobuningi baye okhethweni lwangenyanga ezayo."Lokhu sicela nikwenze egameni lokuhlonipha ugogo wethu. Sicela ningakhohlwa ngamagalelo akhe nezinye izingqalabutho ezalwela inkululeko."Kubalulekile ukuthi wonke umuntu avote, lonke ivoti libalulekile. Kuphela iminyaka engu-30 elakuleli lathola inkululeko. Lokhu kubalulekile kakhulu kuthina njengomndeni,” kusho umzukulu kaNkk Madikizela-Mandela.
KUSUKE esinamathambo izolo ngaphandle kweNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini, umndeni wephoyisa likamasipala okuboshwe isoka lalo nalo eliyiphoyisa ubona umndeni kamsolwa. Umsolwa, uMnuz Sizwe Ngema (27) ubevele okokuqala enkantolo ngecala lokubhokoda ngommese uNksz Yolanda Biancha Khuzwayo (24) waze wafa eflethini lakhe (umsolwa) elisenkabeni yeTheku, ngeSonto.Unina omncane kaYolanda, uNksz Nozipho Khuzwayo, wehlulekile ukuzibamba wafokofisa umndeni kaNgema, ewubuza ukuthi yini oyilande enkantolo."Ninesibindi sokuzokweseka umbulali. Yini nje enizoyenza enkantolo?” kusho uNozipho, zehla izinyembezi ebakhomba ngomunwe. Abomndeni kamsolwa abebekhuluma abazange baphendule, bebebukeka bedabukisa. Ekhuluma nabezindaba ngaphandle kwenkantolo uveze ukuthi ezinsukwini ezimbalwa ngaphambi kokubulawa kukaYolanda, ubethe ufuna bahlale phansi baxoxe ngokuthile.Uthe usho lokhu ngesonto eledlule, umufi ehambe ngemoto nomsolwa, nokulapho aqaphele khona ukuthi umsolwa "unehlo likaSathane”.UMSOLWA oyiphoyisa likaMasipala weTheku, uMnuz Sizwe Ngema, evele enkantolo ngecala lokubulala intombi yakhe nayo eyiphoyisa Isithombe: SIBONELO NGCOBO/INDEPENDENT MEDIAUveze ukuthi umsolwa wamkluluza ngesikhathi ebuza uYolanda ukuthi bangabangani kuphela yini benomsolwa, maqede waphendula ngelithi: "Sizoxoxa ngeSonto mamncance”."Ngakhuluma nje ngahlwayela, ngithi oyoke akuthinte Yolanda uyobe uthinte mina uqobo nomndeni wonke, wangithi klulu ngehlo likaSathane lo mfana,” kusho uNozipho.Uthe uyasola ukuthi umufi ubezokhuluma ngento ebalulekile, abezodinga ukuthi ambonise kuyo.UMNDENI kamufi, udinda isililo ngaphakathi enkantolo emva kokuhlehliswa kwecala Isithombe: ZIMBILI VILAKAZIEphawula ngekhulunywa ezinkundleni zokuxhumana yokuthi umsolwa ubulale umufi ngenxa yokuthi uthole ukuthi ingane ayikhulelwe bekungesiyo eyakhe nokuthi uhushule isisu, uthe kufikile kubona. "Kufikile ngabangani. Engikwaziyo ukuthi uYolanda ubengeke athathe isinyathelo esithize, ngaphandle kokuthi akhulume nami. Ngikholwa ukuthi isizathu sokuthi athi uzokhuluma nami ngeSonto, ubefuna ukwendlala udaba oluthile, acele ngimbonise."UYolanda uvame ukuza kimina uma efuna ukuboniswa kukho konke, ukube ubefuna ukuhushula isisu, ubezoza kimina azongitshela,” kusho uNozipho.Uthe okubadina kakhulu ukuthi umsolwa unazo ezinye izingane kwabanye abesifazane angazondli."Kodwa unesibindi sokubeka isizathu sokuthi ubulele ngoba bekuzohushulwa isisu?” kubuza uNozipho.Uqhube wathi uma umsolwa evela emndenini ophilayo kufanele umbonise ngokuthi akavele alivume icala, kungalokhu kugqigqwa izinkantolo, liqulwa ngoba uze wafaka ngisho ne-video ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ukuthi kubone wonke umuntu."Kukhombisa ukuthi ubezishaya isifuba ngakwenzile, bekungesilo iphutha kodwa ukwenze ngenhloso,” kusho uNozipho.Udadewabo kaYolanda, uNksz Philasande Khuzwayo, uthe umufi ubengumuntu onenhliziyo enhle, engakuthandi ukulwa, kubethusile ukuthi abulawe ngesihluku esinje.Udalule ukuthi umufi nomsolwa baqale ukwazana ngesikhathi beyofundela ubuphoyisa, bagcina sebethandana.Uveze ukuthi ubulawa nje, yena ubezitshela ukuthi umufi nomsolwa sebahlukana kulandela ukumxwayisa kwakhe ngabantu besilisa abanodlame."Emva kokungixoxela ukuthi baxabene, wamshaya, ngamtshela ukuthi akamyeke ngoba uma umuntu wesilisa eke waqala washaya, akabe esayeka. Ubengasangixoxeli lutho ke ngothando lwabo ngoba ngaqinisa ubuso ngamtshela ukuthi kungagcina kuphume umphefumulo. Ngakho ngithukile ukuthi ilo, ngoba mina bengizitshela ukuthi abasathandani,” kusho uPhilasande.Uqinisekise ukuthi ubekhulelwe, wathi nakuba engazi kahle ukuthi izinyanga bese zingaki, kodwa bese kuqala ukubonakala.Uphinde waveza nokuthi umufi ubenengane yomfana eneminyaka eyisihlanu, ayithola ngaphambi kokuthandana nomsolwa.Ngaphakathi enkantolo bebesidinda buthule isililo, ngesikhathi umsolwa emi phambi kwemantshi, efake i-jean, nesikibha esi-maroon esibhalwe ukuthi 'Living My Best Life’.Icala lihlehliselwe u-Ephreli 9, ukuthi umsolwa afake isicelo sakhe sebheyili, nokuthi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi usemisiwe yini emaphoyiseni kaMasipala weTheku ukuze akwazi ukuthola usizo lommeli kahulumeni aveze ukuthi uyaludinga ngesikhathi evela izolo.

KULINDELEKE ukuthi bafake isicelo sebheyili abasolwa abangu-15 ababoshwe ezifundazweni ezahlukene kuleli ngecala lokubulala nokuzama ukubulala eNyuvesi yaseFort Hare.UNgqongqoshe wezamaPhoyisa, uMnuz Bheki Cele, noGeneral Fannie Masemola bazifikele mathupha ngoLwesibili eNkantolo yeMantshi eDimbaza, e-Eastern Cape, ngesikhathi bevela okokuqala abasolwa ababhekene namacala amabili okubulala nelilodwa lokuzama ukubulala.Ithimba lamaphoyisa elabunjwa ukuze liphenye izigameko zokubulawa kwabantu enyuvesi, libophe abasolwa abangu-15. Babuyele enkantolo namuhla kanti kulindeleke ukuthi bafake izicelo zebheyili.Ukuboshwa kwabo kwenyusa isibalo sabantu ababoshelwe amacala athinta inyuvesi safinyelela ku-25. UZimele Chiliza ongusomatekisi KwaZulu-Natal, uPelisa Nkonyeni ongummeli nephoyisa uLindokuhle Manjati elisebenza ngaphansi kophiko lwabaphenyi eMthatha.Bonke abasolwa babhekene namacala amabili okubulala, amathathu nokuzama ukubulala, ukutholakala nezibhamu nezinhlamvu okungekho emthethweni nokweba imoto. UPeter, Mbulawa noKhuza babekwe nelinye icala lokukhwabanisa.Indaba yaqala ngesikhathi kuqashwa uSolwazi Sakhela Buhlungu kwesokuba ngusomaqhuzu eNyuvesi yaseFort Hare ngo-2017. Ngo-2020 lo solwazi wathola ukuthi kunobudedengu kwezokuphatha, inkohlakalo nokukhwabanisa. Wakusukumela lokhu wabe esevula amacala obugebengu kanjalo nokuqondiswa ubugwegwe kubasolwa ababesezikhundleni eziphezulu enyuvesi.Ngo-2022, kwahlaselwa uMnuz Petrus Roets owayeqashwe nguBuhlungu kwesokuba ngumphathi wezithuthi kule nyuvesi. Akubanga yisikhathi esitheni besebenza ndawonye, wahlaselwa uVesele ngoyaba lwezinhlamvu ngaphandle kwamagceke omuzi kaBuhlungu, waphangalala khona lapho, ngoJanuwari 2023.
I-South African National Defence Force (SANDF) ichitha imibiko yokuthi amasosha amabili alo mbutho ajutshwe eDemocratic Republic Of Congo (DRC) athunjwe ngamavukelambuso iM23.Amasosha akuleli ajutshwe eDRC njengengxenye yeSouthern African Development Community Mission in the Democratic Republic of Congo (SAMIDRC) ukuyosiza uhulumeni wakuleliya zwe ukudala ukuthula nozinzo.Ngokubika kwe-website yeNational Security News, amasosha akuleli awanazo izikhali ezanele kanti ashaqwe ngamavukelambuso ngesonto eledlule.Ibike ukuthi asethunjwe yiM23.Esitatimendeni i-SANDF ithe wonke amasosha ayo ajutshiwe aphelele."Akukhona okokuqala ukuthi kubhalwe izindaba ezingenasisekelo njengalezi ngeSANDF kusuka yajutshwa eDRC ngaphansi kweSAMIDRC," kusho iSANDF.Ithe ngeke ize ithule futhi ivume ukuthi igama layo lingcoliswe yile mibiko.Ithe izokwazisa abantu bakuleli ngaso sonke isikhathi ngesimo nokuphepha kwamasosha ayo eDRC.Sekufe amasosha amane akuleli eDRC kusuka kuqale unyaka. Esigamekweni sokuqala kwafa amabili ngesikhathi kuqhunyiswa inkambi yawo.Kwesesibili elinye ladubula uzakwabo ngesibhamu somsebenzi ngaphambi kokuzidubula life nalo.
IZAKHAMIZI zaseMariannhill zivuswe wukuduma kwezulu lezandla ngoLwesithathu ekuseni eDesai, eMariannhill ngesikhathi amaphoyisa egasela lapho obekuhleli khona abasolwa ngokuba yizigebengu ebezihlalise lubhojozi umphakathi kule ndawo.Ngokwesitatimende samaphoyisa, bayisishiyagalolunye abasolwa abafe ujuqu kanti babili abasathungathwa.Laba bebefunelwa amacala ahlukene okubalwa kuwo ukudlwengula nokubamba inkunzi emizini yabantu. "Kuthiwa abasolwa bahlasela kubo kwale ntombazane bezogebenga maqede bayidlwengula beshintshana ngayo umama wayo ekhona,” kusho uColonel Robert Netshiunda okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal. UCol Netshiunda uthe uphenyo lwamaphoyisa luveze ukuthi laba basolwa bebehlela ukuyosoconga umuntu ngoLwesithathu, yilapho anqume ukubavimbezela ngesikhathi ezwa ukuthi bahlangene emzini okhona kule ndawo.Emzini okwenzeke kuwo isigameko amaphoyisa aveza ukuthi athole izibhamu ezine okukhona kuzo nesikhulu.Amalungu emindeni yabasolwa okuvele ukuthi bangabasendaweni afikile ezohlonza izidumbu zababulewe. IYAQONGA ingcindezi yokuthi azinikele kwabezomthetho ukuze zimkhalele uSomlomo wePhalamende osahlabe ikhefu uNkk Nosiviwe Mapisa-Nqakula, ochithwe inkantolo enkulu ePitoli esicelweni sakhe sokuthi angaboshwa.Le nkantolo, ngoLwesibili, imchithe nezindleko uNkk Mapisa-Nqakula kulesi sicelo sakhe esiphuthumayo, kulandela ukukhalaza ngokuthi uyazi uphiko lwezokuShushisa lumfuna ukumhlambalaza ngokumbopha esidlangalaleni ngamacala enkohlakalo.Usolwa ngokwamukela intshontsho le mali nezipho okwevile kuR4 million, ngesikhathi esanguNgqongqoshe wezokuVikela.Amaqembu asePhalamende i-UDM ne-EFF, athe kumele aboshwe ngokushesha uNkk Mapisa-Nqakula.Umholi we-UDM uMnuz Bantu Holomisa unxuse abezomthetho ukuthi bangapholisi maseko kodwa bambophe ngokushesha uNkk Mapisa-Nqakula.Uthe bayasamukela isinqumo senkantolo wathi akaye emaphoyiseni."Sabhalela ikomiti lezokuVikela ngoMashi 2021 ngesikhathi kuvela izinsolo zokuthi uNkk Mapisa-Nqakula wakhokhelwa imali eyevile kuR5 million, kusuka ngo-2017 kuya ku-2019. "Ngatshelwa ukuthi lezi zinsolo angiye kozibika emaphoyiseni, nokuyinto engayenza. Silinde uNkk Mapisa-Nqakula ukuthi enze okufanele, asifuni ukuthi siye ePhalamende silokhu siyobhunga ngokungabethembi ubuholi bakhe ngoba simatasa sikhankasela ukhetho. Yena nje akaziyele emaphoyiseni, ayoboshwa,” kusho uHolomisa. I-EFF ithe akekho ongaphezu komthetho ngakho akaboshwe.Ithe abezomthetho abambophe ngokushesha ukuze abhekane nalezi zinsolo."Ngeke sibavikele abantu abadayise abanye ngokuthi bagwazelwe ngemali. Simfuna ehlile esikhundleni sakhe ePhalamende. Sinxusa wonke amaqembu ukuthi aseke isiphakamiso sokuthi akhishwe ngevoti ePhalemende,” kusho i-EFF.Okhulumela i-ANC uNkk Mahlengi Bhengu-Motsiri, uthe bayasamukela isinqumo senkantolo wathi bayawuhlonipha umthetho ukuthi uthathe indawo yawo.Uthe bazolandela umgomo wenhlangano wokuthi kumele ahoxe njengokomyalelo wemigomo yenhlangano kulabo abasuke bebhekene namacala.USotswebhu we-DA uNksz Siviwe Gwarube uthe sebebhalele iBamba likaSomlomo uMnuz Lechesa Tsenoli, befuna ahlalise ngokushesha iPhalamende ukuze kubhungwe isiphakamiso sobungabuthembi ubuholi bukaNkk Mapisa-Nqakula. Uthe kumele uSomlomo aphendule kulezi zinsolo wathi nemigomo yendlu iyasho ukuthi lesi siphakamiso kumele sisheshe sihlale. "Siyasamukela isinqumo senkantolo esiveze ngokusobala ukuthi abantu ababhekene nezinsolo ezifuze lezi abakwazi ukubaleka bangashushiswa. Akekho umuntu ongaphezu komthetho kuleli, ” kuphetha uNksz Gwarube. Okhulumela uPhiko lwezokuShushisa u-Advocate Mthunzi Mhaga, akafunanga ukudalula ukuthi bazombopha nini uNkk Mapisa-Nqakula wathi kodwa umthetho uzothatha indawo yawo.
UMNDENI wewele laseWestrich eNewlands West ebelithunjiwe ufuna aboshwe ngokushesha umbulali. Isidumbu sikaSibusiso Mpangase (9) obesekuphele amasonto amabili edukile kuthiwa sitholwe ngabadobi sintanta emfuleni uMngeni ngoLwesithathu olwedlule. Kwakubikwe ukuthi uthunjwe yindoda engaziwa eyayihamba ngeToyota Etios e-silver grey ngoMashi 20 ebuya kodlala epaki yendawo.Ngesikhathi kwenzeka isehlakalo, uSibusiso kuthiwa wayehamba newele lakhe nenye ingane (14) yakubo.Umalumekazi kaSibusiso, uNksz Thobile Mpangase uthe bafuna kuboshwe umbulali."Amaphoyisa awasisize asitholele umbulali, ambambe, ambophe ngento asenze yona,” kusho uNksz Mpangase.Echaza ngesimo abeyiso uSibusiso ngesikhathi umndeni uyoqinisekisa ukuthi nguye yini, uthe isikhumba besiphalwe sonke, iso lingekho, ekhanda egundiwe ezinye izinwele zishuthekwe ebuchosheni, kukhona izinzwane ezisikiwe, kwaphinde kwasikwa nengxenye yesitho sakhe sangasese.Uveze ukuthi ukungabonakali kahle kwakhe ngenxa yokucwiywa kwenze amalungu omndeni abeyoqinisekisa ngoLwesithathu atholwe ngalo, abuya ethi akuyena.Uthe kuze kwaba amalungu omndeni aye ngoLwesine abone ukuthi uyena emva kokucela abasemakhazeni ukuthi bawashe izimpahla abezigqokile. Uthe emuva kokuwashwa kwezingubo bakwazile ukubona ukuthi nguyena, kwazise bezifana nayezigqoke ngosuku anyamalala ngalo."Sikholwa ukuthi umuntu owamthumba wayenolwazi lonke lokuthi uyiwele uSibusiso. Futhi sikholwa ukuthi ucwiye ezinye izitho zomzimba wakhe ukuze ayothwala ngazo ngoba kuye kushiwo ukuthi abantu abangamawele, banenhlanhla,” usho kanje.Ngesikhathi Isolezwe libika ngokuthunjwa kukaSibusiso ngeledlule, uNksz Mpangase washo ukuthi owesilisa osolwa ngokuthumba uSibusiso wazenza umuntu omthuma esitolo ukuthi ayomthengela ugwayi.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uColonel Robert Netshiunda ukuqinisekisile ukuthi isidumbu sikaSibusiso sitholakele, kwavulwa idokodo lokufa komuntu, imbangela yokufa kwakhe ayikaziwa njengoba kusalindwe imiphumelela yokuhlolwa kwesidumbu.
USATHUTHUMELA umndeni wephoyisa likaMasipala weTheku okuthiwa libulawe isoka lalo, nalo eliyiphoyisa kuwo lomasipala ngeSonto.UBiancha Khuzwayo (23) waseGlenmore eThekwini ugwazwe waze wafa eflethini elisemgwaqweni uJoseph Nduli enkabeni yeTheku, ezintatha zangeSonto.Umsolwa (27) kuthiwa umgwaze amanxeba angu-13 umufi, kwathi uma usuzophuma umphefumulo, washutha ivideo, wayisabalalisa ezinkundleni zokuxhumana nakubangani bakamufi.Kuyona kubonakala yena umufi ngemizuzu yakhe yokugcina. Kubonakala umtafula ubhajwe entanyeni kumufi, ephuma igazi ngamakhala elinye elixubene namagwebu liphuma ngomlomo. Isikibha esimhlophe abesigqokile umufi, naso sigcwele igazi.Kuvele ukuthi bebekade benephathi, lapho bebungaza khona ukuthi umsolwa uthenge iflethi. Kule phathi kuthiwa bekukhona abangani nozakwabo abangamaphoyisa.Isolezwe lithinta unina, okuthiwe naye uyisikhulu esiphezulu emaphoyiseni kaMasipala weTheku, igama lakhe elingatholakalanga, uzwakale eluphendula ngomoya ophansi ucingo, kuzwakala ukuthi akekho esimeni esikahle sokukhuluma.UMUFI uNksz Biancha Khuzwayo Isithombe: FACEBOOKEzwa ukuthi intatheli emfonelayo, ucele ukudlulisa ucingo kumuntu ongaba namandla okukhuluma nabezindaba.Eluphendula owesifazane odluliselwe ucingo, uthe akukho abangakuphawula okwamanje."Asazi kahle ukuthi kwenzekeni. Silinde ukuhlangana nomphenyi wecala ngoLwesibili, nokunguye esilinde ukuthi asilandise kabanzi, bese sikwazi ukuphawula kahle,” kusho lona wesifazane, okuthe uma ebuzwa igama, wavele waluvala ucingo.Abayixoxa ezinkundleni zokuxhumana bathi umufi ubekhulelwe. Sikhona nesithombe sikamufi nomsolwa ababukeka bejabule ngaphakathi egumbini likadokotela, phakathi kwabo kukhona i-screen se-ultrasound scan ekhombisa umntwana esiswini.Yize kungaveli ukuthi bese zingaki izinyanga kodwa kuthiwa umsolwa ubejabule, ezitshela ukuthi bazoba nomntwana nomufi.Kuthiwa konakale ngesikhathi ethola ngomngani kamufi ukuthi ingane ayithwele akuyona ekamsolwa nokuyilapho avele wamgwaza khona, wambulala.Ubesethatha i-video eyibhadlaza ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, nakuye lomngani obemputshuzele izindaba zokuthi ingane akuyona eyakhe.Umngani osolwa ngokuqhatha lezi zithandani uthelekelwe abantu khona ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, bembuza ukuthi uziqhatheleni izithandani, abanye bethi akaphumele obala ngokuthi ubambe liphi iqhaza ekutheni kuze kubulawe lona wesifazane.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe umsolwa kulindeleke ukuthi avele ngoLwesibili eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini.Uthe ngokwemibiko abayitholile, lezi zithandani beziphuze utshwala ngesikhathi owesilisa egwaza owesifazane embulala."Kuthiwa uze waqopha ne-video ngesikhathi umufi esefa, wayithumela inqwaba yabantu, waphinde wayinameka nasezinkundleni zokuxhumana,” kusho uNetshiunda.Uqhube wathi yize kubikwa uphuzo oludakayo nezinye izidakamizwa esenzweni sikamsolwa, akukacaci ukuthi yini eholele ekutheni agwaze umufi.
UTHEMBISA amanye amacwecwe ashisayo uGatsheni njengoba ehlabane ngendondo ye-Best Newcomer kumaCultural and Creative Industry Awards (Ccia) abebanjelwe eSandton Convention Centre, eGoli ngempelasonto.Lo mculi wasePhongolo ubesembangweni wendondo nentokazi esencane uTyla, owahlabana ngendondo yeBest African Music Perfomance kumaGrammy Awards ekuqaleni kwalo nyaka.Lo mcimbi obekungowokuqala, ubuwenziwe uMnyango weZemidlalo amaCiko namaSiko kuzwelonkeUGatsheni othathelwe yimenenja yakhe indondo kulo mcimbi, ekhuluma neSolezwe uthe ujabule ngukuhlomula ngendondo enkulu kangaka nesho lukhulu kuye nasemsebenzini wakhe.Uphinde watshela leliphephandaba ukuthi baningi abaculi asebenzisana nabo manje.UMusa Mothat ongomunye wabathole indondo emcimbini wokuklomelisa amaciko akuleli obuseSandton "Ngisebenzile namaQwabe Twins senza ingoma ethi uMalambane, ngasebenza noBig Zulu senza ingoma ethi Ikhaya Lami, ngaphinde ngasebenza noJaiva Zimnike senza izingoma ezimbili kwi-album yakhe ephume kamuva," kubeka uGatsheni.Uthe njengoba ephezu kokwenza umculo omusha nje angeke awuqhathanise nowakamuva. "Ngizosebenza ngokuzikhandla noma ngingezukuqophisana namuntu futhi ngingezubhala umculo ogadla kothile.Inhloso yami wukwenza umculo ozongena ugxile kubantu ngaphandle kokuwuqhathanisa nalo wakamuva," kuqhuba lo mculi.Umlingisi uConnie Chiume Elinye lamaciko elingumlingisi ophinde abe ngumculi uWiseman Mncube, uthe ukuhlonishwa njengamaciko kuyabagqugquzela ukuthi basebenze kanzima."Kusinika amandla futhi kuyasigqugquzela ukuthi lento esiyenzayo abantu bayayibona, bayayithakasela imisebenzi esiyenzayo okuzokwenza laba abaqhamuka emva kwethu ukuthi nabo baphakamise amasokisi."Kubanika ithemba lokuthi njengoba senza, asenzeli ize kodwa basinika amandla okuthi sizimisele siqhubeke siye phambili," usho kanje.UNgqongqoshe woMnyango uMnuz uZizi Kodwa uthe kubalulekile ukuthi amaciko abongwe ngomsebenzi omuhle awenzayo."Njengomnyango sibone kubalulekile ukuthi sibabonge ngomsebenzi abawenzela izwe."Iningi labo eliphesheya kwezilwandle liphakamisa igama laseNingizimu Afrika. Namuhla sihlangene kanti abanye babo abasekho kodwa kubalulekile ukuthi amaciko ahlangane," usho kanje.
SEKUZANDLENI zejaji ngekusasa likanesi othweswe icala lokuthengela umyeni wakhe owayengunjiniyela izinkabi ukuthi zimbulale ngoSepthemba 2020.IJaji elibambile, uSolwazi Bonke Dumisa, kulindeleke ukuthi likhiphe isinqumo sokuthi liyamlahla ngecala noma limkhipha phambili unesi, uNksz Nompumelelo Goncalves.Ligcina ukuhlala icala, uDumisa wathi isinqumo uzosikhipha ngo-Ephreli 2. Waveza nokuthi kungenzeka athathe usuku noma ezimbili efunda isinqumo sakhe ngoba buningi kakhulu ubufakazi ethulelwa bona.Lo wesifazane ongummangalelwa wesibili ecaleni athweswe lona nomfowabo, uMnuz Nkosinathi Zungu ongummangalelwa wokuqala. Basolwa ngokuthumba futhi babulale behlelile uMnuz Nkosi Timmy Langa.Bayawaphika amacala abathweswe wona yize uZungu atshela inkantolo ukuthi uLanga wabulawa "ngephutha” abantu ayekade ehamba nabo.UMbuso usola uZungu nomngani wakhe, uJames Mashudu Mthimkhulu, ukuthi bathumba uLanga emzini wakhe osePinetown.Isidumbu sikamufi satholakala sesiqala ukonakala ehlathini elisoZwathini, eNdwedwe, ngoNovemba 2020.UMthimkhulu, walivuma icala wase egwetshwa iminyaka engu-20 ebhadla ejele. Waphenduka ufakazi woMbuso waninda ngecala bobabili abammangalelwa ngesikhathi ethula ubufakazi enkantolo.UMbuso usola ukuthi uNksz Goncalves waqasha uZungu noMthimkhulu ukuthi bathumbe, babulale futhi badayise iveni kaLanga.Enkantolo kwavela ukuthi uLanga waklinywa ngentambo ye-ayina washona.Enkantolo kwavela nokuthi bahluleka ukudayisa iveni likaLanga abagqigqa nalo koMsinga naseBergville bagcina belishiye dengwane. Enkantolo kwavela nokuthi esebulewe uLanga, kwaba khona inkokhelo eyenziwa nguNksz Goncalves ayeyibhekise kuMthimkhulu. Kwathi uma umshushisi u-Advocate Krishen Shah, ebuza ukuthi kwakungeyani le mali, uNksz Goncalves wathi kwakuyimali ayekade ecelwe uZungu ukuthi ayithumele uMthimkhulu ngoba wayekade emkweleta yona.
BANIKWE kuze kube yinamhlanje ntambama ukuthi bafake izikhalo zabo enkantolo yezokhetho labo abachithwe yikhomishini eyengamele ukhetho ukuba yingxenye yokhetho ngoMeyi 29, nonyaka.Laba bazokwazi ngo-Ephreli 9, okuwusuku le nkantolo ezonquma ngalo ukuthi kakade bazoba yingxenye yokhetho noma le nkantolo izohambisana nesinqumo sekhomishini yezokhetho i-Independent Electoral Commission.Ikhomishini yathola izikhalo ngabangu-82, ngokungamele babe yingxenye yalolu khetho.Owayengumengameli wezwe uJacob Zuma, okhankasela iqembu Umkhonto weSizwe, ungomunye owachithwa yikhomishini ukuthi abe yingxenye yokhetho ngoba walahlwa yicala lokuthi adonse isigwebo sezinyanga ezingu-15.Phezu kwalokhu iqembu lakhe iMK limile ekutheni uZuma, kumnyama kubomvu uzoba yingxenye yokhetho. Ekhuluma nabezindaba bakwaSABC muva nje, inhloko yezokhetho yeMK uMnuz Musa Mkhize, uveze ukuthi bazophikisana nesinqumo se-IEC odabeni lokuvimba uZuma ukuthi abe yingxenye yokhetho.UMkhize uthe basamatasa babheka lesi sinqumo se-IEC wathi kodwa akukho okuzovimba uZuma ukuthi abe ngumengameli wezwe kusuka ngoJuni 1.Uveze ukuthi bazosebenzisa umthetho wakuleli ukulwa nalesi sinqumo sekhomishini. USihlalo we-IEC kuzwelonke uMnuz Mosotho Moepya, uthe izikhaloo abazitholile bezivela kumaqembu angu-21 ezepolitiki.Uthe balandele umthetho wakuleli wathi abangeneme banelungelo lokuthi baphikisane nalesi sinqumo ngokuya enkantolo yezokhetho."Kumele bakwenze lokhu ngo-Ephreli 2, 2024. Inkantolo izonquma ngabakhalazile ngo-Ephreli 9, bese ikhomishini idedela uhlu lokugcina ngo-Ephreli 10, 2024.” Odabeni lukaZuma uthe balandele umthetho wathi ngeke abe yingxenye yokhetho."Akudingeki ukuthi iqembu elikhalazayo ngesinqumo sethu libhalele thina ngqo kodwa kumele liye enkantolo yezokhetho. Iyona ezoba nezwi lokugcina kulolu daba.” UMoepya uveze ukuthi bayisithupha abangenela ukhetho ngokuzimela abazobanga izihlalo ePhalamende.EziShayamthetho zezifundazwe bayisithupha abazobe bebanga izikhundla. NgoLwesine ikhomishini izoba nomcimbi wokusayinwa kwesibophezelo sokuthi amaqembu azohlonipha umgomo obekiwe wezokhetho. Ngalolu suku kuzotonyulwa neqembu elizoba phezulu ephepheni lokuvota.
KULINDELEKE ukuthi uNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa noKhomishana wawo babe senkantolo uma sekuvela abasolwa abangu-15, ababoshelwe amacala okubalwa nawokubulala eNyuvesi iFort Hare.UMnuz Bheki Cele, noGeneral Fannie Masemola balindeleke ukuthi namuhla bathamele icala eNkantolo yeMantshi eDimbaza, e-Eastern Cape.Ithimba lamaphoyisa elabunjwa ukuze liphenye izigameko zokubulawa kwabantu enyuvesi, libophe abasolwa abangu-15.Kuthiwa abasolwa baboshwe ngempelasonto ezifundazweni ezihlukene okubalwa iKwaZulu-Natal, Gauteng, Western Cape, nase-Eastern Cape.Ukuboshwa kwabo kwenyusa isibalo sabantu ababoshelwe amacala athinta inyuvesi safinyelela ku-25.Abasolwa babhekene noxhaxha lwamacala okuhlanganisa awenkohlakalo, ukukhwabanisa, awokuthumba, awokuzama ukubulala nawokubulala.UGeneral Masemola uthe ithimba lamaphoyisa abalibumba ukuba liphenye futhi libophe abasolekayo, lizoqhubeka nokwenza umsebenzi walo ngaphandle kokwesaba nokwenzelela."Limatasa ithimba lamaphoyisa emsebenzini wokuthola umnyombo nokuthi ngobani abasekhaleni lenkohlakalo, ukukhwabanisa nokubulawa kwabantu kule nyuvesi,” kuchaza uMasemola.Udalule nokuthi umsebenzi wabo ukuphenya bajule, baqoqe ubufakazi obuqanda ikhanda, kuthi uma befaka icala enkantolo nakanjani libagojele abasolwayo.Umvusi wenyamazane kwaba yisehlakalo sokudutshulwa ngoyaba lwezinhlamvu kubulawe uMnuz Mboneni Vesele, ngoJanuwari 2023.UVesele wayeneminyaka emihlanu engumqaphi wePhini likaShansela wenyuvesi, uSolwazi Sakhele Buhlungu. Wasocongelwa emotweni kaVesele, owayengekho ngaleso sikhathi.Kuthiwa uBuhlungu wayekade etholelwe baqaphi emuva kokuthi ethole izinsongo zokuyiswa kwagoqanyawo ngesikhathi ephenya ngezinsolo ezazishaqisa zokwehliswa ngomlenze kwemali yenyuvesi.

Siyakubonga konke ukwesekwa ikakhulukazi kulesi sikhathi esinzima esidlula kuso njengeWorship House Family."Sinxuse ukuthi kuqhutshekwe nokukhulekelwa kwemindeni ethintekayo.Abantu baphawule ekhasini leqembu bethi sengathi umoya wakhe ungaphumula ngokuthula.
BAZONGENA bashone emaphaketheni abantu baseNingizimu Afrika njengoba ikhuphukile intengo kagesi izolo ilanywa eduzane ekaphethroli.U-Eskom ukhuphule intengo kagesi ngo-12.74% onyakeni wezimali u-2024/25. Phakathi kwamabili namuhla intengo kaphethroli izonyuka ngo-67 cents ilitha.Mayelana nentengo kadizili, kulindeleke ikhuphuke ngo-3 cents ilitha maphakathi nezwe. Ezifundazweni ezigudle ulwandle yehle ngo-4 cents ilitha.Lokhu kukhuphuka kwentengo kaphethroli kuthiwa kubangelwa ukunyuka kwamanani emikhiqizo emhlabeni nokuba buthaka kwamandla erandi.USomnotho ozimele uSolwazi Bonke Dumisa ukhale ngakubize ngama-administered prices, okuyimali uhulumeni aba nezwi lokugcina kuyona okubalwa ama-rates, intengo kagesi nekaphethroli.UDumisa uthe ukunyuswa kwentengo kagesi kubonwa abantu ngento engathetheleleki ngoba kuyaqhubeka ukucishwa kukagesi ngenhloso yokuwonga.Uhlabe inkohlakalo egubuzele u-Eskom wathi ingakho lenkampani ephehla ugesi ngelahle ifuna imali ukuze ikwazi ukwenza umsebenzi wayo.UMnuz Layton Beard wakwa-Automobile Association uxwayise ngokuthi kuzoguga iphakethe kubashayeli bezimoto.UBeard uthe ukunyuka kwentengo kaphethroli kusasa kungase kwelanywe okunye maduze."Okubi ukuthi amaholo abasebenzi awakhushulwa alingane nentengo kaphethroli ekhuphuka njalo. Ukukhushulwa kwentengo kungagcina sekunyusa nemali yokugibela kwizithuthi zomphakathi,” kusho uBeard.Ukhale ngokuthi kumanje abathengi bathwele ijoka ngenxa yokumba eqolo kwamanani ezinto ezitolo.UBeard ukhuthaze abashayeli ukuthi basebenzise izindlela eziphusile zokonga imali njengokuthi bacele kubaqashi ukuba basebenze ezinye izinsuku besemakhaya uma kwenzeka."Uma usebenzisa imoto yakho kancane, lokho kuzokongela uphethroli ugcine usebenzisa imali encane,” kuphetha uBeard.

Siyathemba ukuthi ngalo mkhuleko kukhona okuzoqaqeka,''usho kanje.Uchaze umkhuleko njengethuluzi elinamandla okunqoba nanoma yini ema endleleni yomuntu. "Sifuna abantu bakithi bahlome ngomkhuleko basebenzise wona ukunqoba zonke izinkinga abazithola bebhekene nazo,'' echaza.Ukuvezile ukuthi minyaka yonke baye babe nalo luhlobo lwenkonzo athe ukholwa ukuthi luhamba ibanga elide ekulapheni abantu.
KUZOCACA uma sekusayine uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ukuthi luzovelaphi uxhaso lomshwalense wezempilo kuleli, iNational Health Insurance (NHI). UNgqongqoshe weziMali uMnuz Enoch Godongwana uthe abakanqumi ukuthi izovelaphi imali yokuxhasa lo mshwalense.Okwamanje basalinde uRamaphosa ukuthi aqale asayine umthethosivivinywa wezempilo ukuze ube semthethweni.URamaphosa usekuveze izikhawu eziningi ukuthi maduzane uzowusayina lo mthethosivivinywa."Uma sekusayiniwe sizobe sesihlwaya ukuthi sizoluthathaphi uxhaso lwalo mshwalense. Asingabazi ukuthi uRamaphosa uzowusayina lo mthethosivivinywa,” kusho uGodongwana.Ukusho lokhu ephendula imibuzo yamalungu ePhalamende njengoba abefuna ukwazi ukuthi imali yokuxhasa lo mshwalense izovelaphi njengoba izwe libhekene nenkinga yezikweletu.IPhalamende laphasisa umthethosivivinywa iNHI ngoDisemba nyakenye. UGodongwana uthe abantu bakhuluma indaba yokuthi kuzosetshenziswa imali yentela ukuxhasa lo mshwalense, okungelona neze iqiniso,"Angikaze ngisenze lesi simemezelo. Abantu nje abazisholo okwabo, into engingakaze ngiyenze leyo. Ngikhuluma ngendaba yentela kanye ngonyaka uma ngithula isabelomali."Uma ngizokhuluma ngezinto ezithinta intela, ngizokwenza ngonyaka ozayo ngoFebhuwari uma sekuthulwa isabelomali sezwe,” kusho uGodongwana.Uthe akusho ngukuthi ziningi iziphakamiso ezithinta ukuxhaswa kwalo mshwalense."Yingakho ngithi uma sekusayiniwe kwaba ngumthetho, ngizobe sengisebenza noMnyango wezeMpilo ukubheka izindlela ezahlukene zokuxhasa lo mshwalense.” Uveze ukuthi lo mshwalense uzoqala ngezikhawu ezahlukene. Ubalule nokuthi uhulumeni ufuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kukhona yonke ingqalasizinda efanele uma sekuqalwa ngalo mshwalense. "Sifuna le ngqalasizinda ibe sezingeni elifanele ngaphambi kokuqala indaba yalo mshwalense, ekugcineni izobakhona,” kusho uGodongwana.Uveze nokuthi akuzona zonke izikhungo zikahulumeni ezisesimweni esingesihle zokuthi kuqale lo mshwalense.Uthe uma sikhona isidingo bazosebenza nezikhungo ezizimele ukuqala lo luhlelo. Akulona futhi iqiniso ukuthi imali yalo mshwalense izofinyelela kuR1 trillion.
UZULELWA ngamanqe owayengumsakazi woKhozi FM, uSbu Buthelezi, osekuvele izindaba zokuvulelwa amacala ngabantu abathi wabaqola izigidi zemali ababeyilondoloze enkampanini yakhe i-Abombuso Investments.Isolezwe Ngempelasonto lixoxe nabambalwa abathi kwacwila izigidi zabantu ezilinganiselwa ku-R60 million enkampanini kaButhelezi. Baveza ukuthi abacwila balinganiselwa ku-600 000.Baze basho nokuthi kwakuyinto encane kabi le yokushaywa kukaSbu ngamalungu eSikebhe ngoba kwakukhulunywa ngemali yomuntu oyedwa bengaveziwe ukuthi baningi ngalolu hlobo abalahlekelwe.Kukhona namacala asevuliwe kanti amanye kuthiwa azovulwa maduze.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uwaqinisekisile amacala amabili asevuliwe.Kukhona elivulwe wuNksz Nompumelelo Nxumalo eDurban Central kanti elesibili livulwe wuMnuz Lindani Gumede esiteshini samaphoyisa eManzimtoti.UNetshiunda uthe womabili la macala asaphenywa kodwa akekho oseboshiwe ngawo.Ekukhaleni kwabantu kuvela nezindaba ezishaqisayo ngabantu abalahlekelwa yimali beyilondoloze enkampanini kaSbu Buthelezi.UMnuz Mbongeni Ndlovu ongomunye wabakhala ngokuthi waqolwa wuSbu Buthelezi, uthe kumanje kunemindeni esihlakazekile ngenxa kaSbu."Njengoba siseqoqweni likaWhatsApp angaseyona ingxenye yalo uSbu, kuvela izindaba ezithusayo ngabantu abadlele imali. Kunogogo nje oneminyaka engu-87 ohlala ekhala ezimathonsi ngemali ayifaka kuSbu yacwila."Omunye uthe kumanje usexabene nomyeni wakhe ekhaya sebelala ngokuhlukana ngoba wayemkhuza ukuthi angayifaki imali kule nkampani kaSbu kodwa waqhubeka ngenkani ngethemba lokuthi uzothola inzuzo."Kumanje sekuhluleke ngisho abefundisi bezama ukuthi kube nokuthula kulo mndeni kodwa indoda imi ngelokuthi yayimkhuzile unkosikazi wayo ngokufaka imali kuSbu waqhubeka ngenkani, ngeke imxolele."Omunye uthe uSbu wafika ehleli emakhandleleni eshonelwe wumyeni wakhe, wathi akafake yonke imali yempesheni yomyeni wakhe, yacwila yonke,” kusho uNdlovu.UNdlovu uthe kunamaqoqo kaWhatsApp abunjwe ngokuhlukana ngokwezifundazwe njengoba kuthiwa le nkampani kaSbu yaqola inqwaba yabantu.Kuwona amaqoqo kuthiwa abantu baze baxabane bodwa ngoba kukhona nabafuna ukuzifikela mathupha kuButhelezi kodwa bashaywe wukuthi akatholakali kuzona zonke izindawo okwaziwa ukuthi uhlala kuzona.UMnuz Lindani Gumede, uthe naye ubesejwayele ukuthola izingcingo ezivela kuSbu emsabisa ngokuthi uyamazi lapho ehlala khona, akayeke ukufaka abantu umoya wokufuna imali yabo. Kumanje kuthiwa kunephoyisa elizibophezele ukuthi lizobalekelela bonke abafuna ukuvulela uSbu amacala okuqolwa.Abakhala ngokuthi baqolwa kulindeleke ukuthi bahlangane ngobuningi kwesinye seziteshi zamaphoyisa eThekwini ukuzovula amacala maduze ukuze amaphoyisa aqale ukumthungatha uButhelezi.NgoJanuwari 26, uSbu Buthelezi ukhiphe incwadi eyithumelela abantu abakhala ngokuthi wabaqola, ebathembisa ukuthi bazoqala ukukhokhelwa ngenyanga edlule. Kuze kube yimanje bathe akukho noyedwa osekhokheliwe.Kule ncwadi Isolezwe Ngempelasonto elinayo ikhophi yayo, uSbu uveza eminye imizamo yokuthi adayisele laba bantu amasheya ukuze akwazi ukubakhokhela imali yabo.Uze asho nokuthi uyazi ukuthi abanye sebezonda kwasani into ethi "bangababusi” okuyigama athi liyisiphrofetho kubona njengenkampani ukuthi bazobusa.Uthi kunalokho abantu bazibiza "ngabaqolwa” nakho athe kuyisiphrofetho sabo ngoba uma becabanga kanjalo bazohlupheka impilo yabo yonke.Abanye bathe bacikwa nawukufunda le ncwadi yonke ngoba kudala uSbu Buthelezi ebakhohlisa kugcine kucwebe iziziba ngemali yabo.
AZIBUYELE emasisweni, ingane yakho akube ngeyami, neyami kube ngeyakho.Lokhu kungahle kulekelele ekutheni kunqandwe isihlava sokuhlukunyezwa kwezingane, kwephulwe amalungelo azo okubukeka sekuphenduke insakavukela eNingizimu Afrika.Izingane kumele zifundisweIzigameko zokuhlukunyezwa kwezingane kubikwa ngakho nsuku zaphuma ikakhulukazi ezisuke zishayiwe, zidlwenguliwe, zithunjiwe, zidayisiwe ezinye ziyabulawa imbala.UMnyango wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi eNingizimu Afrika usanda kudalula ukuthi zingu-250 izingane ezishiywe dengwane ngonyaka odlule.Kuvela nokuthi ukuphulwa kwamalungelo ezingane kwenziwa kakhulu abantu abasondelene nazo, nokumele ngabe bangabavikeli bazo.Isikhulu esiphezulu kwiNelson Mandela Children’s Fund, uDkt Linda Ncube-Nkomo ukhombe ngenjumbane abantu emiphakathini wathi bayihlaba indaba yokuvikela izingane.Ekhuluma neziko labezindaba iNewzroom Afrika uthe kuzwisa ubuhlungu ukuthi izingane zihlukunyezwa emakubo.Uma ingane ingaphephile kubo, ihleli nabantu okumele bayivikele, bayondle futhi bayikhulise, wubani ozoyivikela emphakathini?,” kubuza lesikhulu.Siqhuba sithi ingane kumele ikhuliswe wumphakathi wonke, ngakho-ke uma kunengane elahlekayo, wonke umuntu akayibheke. UDkt Ncube-Nkomo uthe uma kunengane esuke ilahlekile emphakathini, ukhona umuntu osuke azi ukuthi ikuphi.Uxwayise ngokuthi uma kuqhubeka ngendlela okwenzeka ngayo manje, lezingane zizoba ngabantu abadala ngomuso, zenze izinto ezinesihluku ngoba zikhule zingawazi amalungelo azo nemithetho ezivikelayo.Indaba esematheni eyokuduka kukaJoshlin Smith oneminyaka eyisithupha waseDiazville, eSaldanha Bay, eWestern Cape.Unyamalale ngoFebhuwari 19, kuze kube manje usacingwa akakatholakali. Okuthuse abaningi ukuthi unina kaJoshlin, uNksz Kelly Smith ungomunye wabasolwa abane ababoshiwe.Kamuva kutholakale isidumbu sikaLusanda Nkomo obeneminyaka engu-10 owayebikwe ukuthi ulahlekile ngoMashi 17, kwaboshwa owesilisa ongumakhelwane wakhe eMkhomazi.Isidumbu sikaLusanda kuthiwa satholwa ngumelusi wezinkomo futhi sihlubule, kwavulwa icala lokubulala nelokudlwengula.Kubukeka kuyinkombankombane phakathi kwahulumeni nabantu emphakathini ngokuthi ubani okumele abe sekhaleni ekuvikeleni izingane.Uphiko oluyinhlanganisela yeminyango kahulumeni ebhekele ukuvikela nenhlalo yomphakathi, lusanda kuzwakalisa ukukhathazeka kwalo ngalesi sihlava."Sikhathazwa amacala avulwayo okuthumba noma ukulahleka kwezingane ezinye ezibulawayo. Siyagcizelela ukuthi ngeke silubekezelele udlame olubhekiswe ezinganeni,” kusho uphiko.Okhulumela uMnyango wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Mhlaba Memela uthe kuwumsebenzi wawo wonke umuntu emphakathini ukuvikela ingane."Sonke siwumphakathi kumele sibambisane ekulwisaneni nokuhlukunyezwa kwezingane futhi siqinisekise ukuthi amalungelo azo ayahlonishwa."Kuqala ekhaya ukuvikelwa kwengane. Kumele bafundise ingane yomfana neyentombazane ngendlela efanayo,” kusho uMemela.Ukhuthaze abantu emiphakathini ngokunakekela izingane, noma ngabe uyifica ikusiphi isimo, wena njengomuntu omdala kumele kube semahlombe akho ukuthi uyinakekele ingane.Uthe kuyishwa ukuthi isikhathi esiningi abantu abadala yibona kanye abahlukumeza izingane. Bayazama bewuhulumeni ukuthi izingane zivikelwe, kodwa bawudinga umphakathi ngokungabafihli abazihlukumezayo.Uhlabe abafihla abahlukumeza izingane emphakathini wathi abenzi ubuntu.Uhulumeni usanda kunxenxa amaphoyisa ukuthi awangabi madolonzima uma ebikelwa ngala macala athinta izingane nokuthi umphakathi usebenzisane nawo.Ngakolunye uhlangothi amaphoyisa akhiphe amathiphu okuvikela izingane:Ingane mayitshele umzali uma kunento eyenza isabe noma ingazizwa kahle.Kuyalwe ingane ukuba ingamtsheli umuntu engamazi igama layo nalapho ihlala khona.Ingane akumele idlale yodwa ngaphandle kwakubo noma ezindaweni zomphakathi.Uma kunomuntu osondela enganeni bese iyesaba, kumele imemeze ifune usizo.Kukhuthazwa izingane ukuba zingangeni emotweni noma zamukele izipho ebantwini ezingabazi, futhi zingabavuleli emakhaya azo.Izingane zikhuthazwe ukuba zibikele umuntu omdala ukuthi ziya kuphi futhi zizobuya nini.Uhulumeni uphonsela inselelo izakhamuzi ukuba zibikele amaphoyisa ngokushesha uma zisola ukuthi kunengane elahlekile."Abazali noma abaqapha izingane kumele baxoxe nazo bazifundise izindlela zokuphepha. Yiqeqeshe ingane, ikwazi ukubona ubungozi nokumele ikwenze,” kusho uhulumeni.

Nginalombuzo. Usengozini kulabo abamzondayo. Usengozini kubantu abafuna ukumbulala. Abakhumbule labo abamfuna efile ukuthi abahlaseli yena yedwa kodwa bahlasela lonke izwe. "Bahlasela thina sonke ngoba okwenzeka kuye, kuyobe kwenzeke kithi sonke. Yingakho sizokwenza nanoma yini ukuvikela uMengameli," kugcizelela uKhabazela.UMkhize uthe njengamanje uZuma usekubhaceni lapho ecashiswe khona ngokuba kusatshelwa ukuphepha kwakhe.Unxuse ukuba kuthandazelwe ukuphepha kukaZuma ngoba impilo yakhe isengcupheni. Uthe njengamanje icala selisemaphoyiseni ukuze kutholakale ukuthi ngubani obezama ukubulala uZuma ngengozi yemoto. Unxuse ungqongqoshe wamaphoyisa ukuba enze konke okusemandleni ukuthi uZuma uyavikeleka, ngale kokubheka ukuthi uZuma weseka liphi iqembu okhethweni lukazwelonke ngoMeyi 29, kulo nyaka.Kwenzeka lokhu nje, igama likaZuma lihoxisiwe ohlwini lwabaholi beMK abangase balibhekise ePhalamende.UMkhize uthe njengamanje baxhumana nabameli babo ukuba balwe baze banqamuke izandla ngoba emuva kokhetho, akukho okuyovimba uZuma ekubeni yilungu lePhalamende nokuba wuMengameli wezwe.

Uthe ngakusasa ingane itholwe ilaxazwe emfuleni kanti ubelokhu exhumana nomsolwa ku-WhatsApp.Enkulumweni yabo eqoshiwe yakuWhatsApp Isolezwe eliyizwile, umsolwa ecashunwa lapho ekhuluma khona ngesiZulu, ubezwakala ekhala ebalisa ethi uyazisola ngakwenzile. Ubengaliphucile ikhanda nentshebe.Bekukhona namalungu omphakathi nawenhlangano elwa nodlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane, abebezokweseka umndeni kamufi obusenkantolo.

INYUNYANA yamaphoyisa, i-Police and Prisons Civil Rights Union isichithile isinqumo sokukhushulelwa kwabasebenzi bakahulumeni amaholo ngo- 4,7%, okumenyezelwe wuNgqongqoshe weziSebenzi zikaHulumeni nokuPhathwa, uNkk Noxolo Kiviet, ngesonto eledlule.UNkk Kiviet uthe ngokwesinqumo esathathwa ezingxoxweni zamaholo nyakenye emhlanganweni wesigungu esihlanganisa umqashi nabamele abasebenzi, i-Public Sector and Coordinated Bargaining Council, uhulumeni uzothi phohlo ngo- 4.7% emaholweni abasebenzi kusuka ngo- Ephreli, 1, ngesonto elizayo.I-Popcru ithi ayikaze isisayine lesi sivumelwano nyakenye ngoba ikholwa ukuthi ukwenyuswa kwamaholo abasebenzi ngale ndlela kuyinhlamba kumalungu ayo futhi kuwukuwabukela phansi.UMengameli we-Popcru uMnuz Thulani Ngwenya, uthe lesi siphakamiso singaphansi ngisho kwezindleko zempilo njengoba zifinyelele ku- 5.6% ngenyanga edlule."Ukukhushulwa kwemali ngaleli phesenti, kukhombisa ukuthi uhulumeni akanandaba kangakanani nabasebenzi bakhe. Akwenele ekutheni kungaphucula impilo yabasebenzi emazingeni aphansi nokumelana nezindleko ezikhuphukayo zemihla yonke. Asiwakholwa amampunge kahulumeni owayethi akubeke etafuleni ukuphela kwento angakwazi ukuyinikeza abasebenzi, ngakho asisayinanga,” kusho uNgwenya.Uthe abezinye izinyunyana, babaxwayisa ngokusayina lesi sivumelwano seminyaka emibili sokukhushulwa kwamaholo, ngakho sekuyisikhathi sokuthi kuvikelwe abasebenzi.Ngo-2022, le nyunyana yaba nokhukhulelangoqo wemashi ngenhloso yokuphoqa uhulumeni ukuthi enze okuthiwa wayekuthembisile ngo-2018 kokuthi ngonyaka wezimali u-2020/2021, uzokhuphula imiholo yabasebenzi ibe ngaphezulu ngephesenti elilodwa, ephesentini lezindleko zempilo. Okunye ababekumashela, ukukhushulwa kwamaholo abasebenzi ngo- 3% okuthiwa umqashi wakwenza ngaphandle kokuvumelana nezinyunyana zabasebenzi.Nakuba i-Popcru engaphansi komfelandawonye wezinyunyana iCosatu engamadlelandawonye nenhlangano ebusayo i-ANC bavumelana ngokuthi bazokweseka le nhlangano njengoba kubhekwe okhethweni, kodwa uNgwenya uthe abasebenzi abangamalungu abo sebetshengise ukumungabaza uhulumeni ekutheni akazikhathalele izidingo zabo, ngakho bakulungele ukungena emgwaqweni."Okwamanje kubukeka sengathi abasebenzi bashaywa ngesithende njengoba kungekho iqembu lezepolitiki eliphumele obala ngamalungelo abasebenzi ngesikhathi ekhankasa enxenxa amavoti. Noma ngabe yiliphi iqembu elizovotelwa ngoMeyi kumele lazi ukuthi abasebenzi bazohleze bekhona nangale kukaMeyi,” usho kanje.
UYA esiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal uNdunankulu kaZulu uMfundisi Thulasizwe Buthelezi nePhini lakhe Inkosi Phathisiwe Chiliza uma kungukuthi amaqembu abo athola amavoti anele okuthi bathole izihlalo ngemuva kokhetho. UButhelezi oyiMeya kaMasipala waseZululand, uyomela i-IFP njengoba esendaweni yesishiyagalolunye ohlwini lwaleli qembu.UChiliza oyinkosi yesizwe saseMadungeni, uya esiShayamthetho ngethikithi leqembu elesekwa ngowayenguMengameli weZwe ne-ANC uJacob Zuma, Umkhonto weSizwe, kanti ohlwini lwaleli qembu ungunombolo 42.Inkosi Phathisizwe ChilizaUButhelezi noChiliza basanda kumenyezelwa yiSilo samaBandla uMisuzulu kaZwelithini njengazosebenza nabo emsebenzini wesizwe.Inkosi Zuzifa ButheleziUChiliza akalona ivukane emsebenzini othinta amakhosi njengoba eke waba ngusihlalo wawo esifundazweni. Usebenze kakhulu neSilo esesabuza uMdlokombane.UZuma usanda kumemezela ukuthi ohlwini lwabajutshiwe usazokwenza izinguquko kulona njengoba befuna kumeleleke zonke izinhlaka.Ohlwini lwe-IFP olukhishwe yikhomishini yezokhetho kukhona neNkosi yeSizwe saKwaButhelezi, uZuzifa oyindodana yomsunguli we-IFP Inkosi Mangosuthu Buthelezi, okhothame nyakenye.Inkosi uZuzifa inethezekile endaweni yesikhombisa ohlwini lwabajutshwe yi-IFP ePhalamende. Uhlu lwaleli qembu kuzwelonke luholwa ngumengameli uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa, kulandele abanye abaholi okubalwa nomkhulumeli waleli qembu uMnuz Mkhuleko Hlengwa nabanye.Ohlwini lwe-IFP oluya esiShayamthetho sesifundazwe kuqhwakele usihlalo waleli qembu uMnuz Thami Ntuli oyiMeya yaseKing Cetshwayo, kuthi indodakazi kaShenge uMntwana uPhumzile Buthelezi yena usendaweni yesishiyagalolunye ohlwini lwesifundazwe. IMeya kaMasipala uMzinyathi uMnuz Petros Ngubane ungunombolo 24 ohlwini lwabaya esiShayamthetho, kuthi uMfundisi Musa Zondi, osanda kufungiswa esiShayamthetho ukhuza ibuya ohlwini lwe-IFP njengoba ehleli kunombolo 16. IMK ifolosa ngoMnuz Nhlanhla Ngidi ohlwini lwabazojutshelwa esiShayamthetho sesifundazwe. UNgidi wayenguMqondisi Jkelele kuhulumeni wesifundazwe.UNgidi nguyena obhekiwe ukuthi abe ngundunankulu ngokwe-MK uma idla umhlanganiso kulolu khetho lwangoMeyi 29. Okunye okuqaphelekayo ohlwini lwe-MK amalungu abekwi-ANC okubalwa uMnuz Thobani Zuma, ongumgqugquzeli waleli qembu esifundazweni kanti uhlale ebonakala lapho kukhona khona uJZ. UZuma wayeyiphini leMeya kuMasipala uMsunduzi.Omunye osohlwini lweMK uDkt Kwazi Mbanjwa owayengumqondisi jikelele esifundazwenu kanti wayeyinhloko yoMnyango wezokuThutha esifundazweni.Ohlwini lweqembu okunombango wobuholi iNFP kufoloswa ngoMnuz Ivan Barnes kuzwelonke, esifundazweni lifolosa ngoNksz Mbali Shinga.I-EFF esifundazweni iholwa nguMnuz Mongezi Twala. Iqembu i-Abantu Batho Congress, eholwa ngowayeyiPhini leMeya kuMasipala weTheku lifolosa ngomholi walo uMnuz Philani Mavundla, kwabaya ePhalamende.I-African People’s Movement ifolosa ngomholi wayo uMnuz Vikizitha Mlotshwa kanti kunamanye amaqembu azobanga izihlalo esiShayamthetho sesifundazwe okuyiJustice and Employment Party ne-People’s Freedom Party. Ikhomishini ivale izolo ntambama ithuba lokuthi umphakathi uphawule ngohlu olushicilelwe.Namhlanje kulindeleke ukuthi ikhulume nesizwe ngezikhalazo ezitholile.Ngo-Ephreli 10, izoshicilela uhlu lokugcina lwabaya ePhalamende naseziShayamthetho njengoba kukhona abavela ohlwini lwamanye amaqembu.
KUVELE negama lowakwaGcaba ecaleni lokubulawa komrepha uKiernan "AKA” Forbes noTebello "Tibz” Motsoane.Izolo enkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini bekuvele abahlanu abayamaniswa naleli cala okungoLindokuhle Thabani Mkhwanazi (30), Lindani Zenzele Ndimande (35), Eddie Syanda Myeza (21), Mzwethemba Harvy Gwabeni (36) noLindokuhle Mhlaliseni Ndimande (29).UMbuso ubukade wenza izethulo zawo uphikisana nesicelo sebheyili yabasolwa. UMshushisi omkhulu u-Adv Gcweka uveze ukuthi uGwabeni washayela uMnuz Sydney Mfunda Gcaba ucingo.Uthe ngemuva kwalokho kwaba nemali engu-R800 000 eyangena ebhange likaGwabeni."UGwabeni washayela uGcaba ucingo ngemuva kokuba sekuzwakele ukuthi u-AKA useshonile,” usho kanje.Ngokwesitatimende esifundwe umshushisi enkantolo, imali eyangena yayivela kwi-akhawunti yenkampani iBright Circle (pty) Ltd okuvela ukuthi inomqondisi oyedwa okunguMnuz Sydney Mfunda Gcaba kanti kwakubhalwe ukuthi imali eyayikhokhelwa umsebenzi wokubonisana (consult). UMbuso uveze ukuthi ngombono wawo kwakucashiswa ukuthi le mali ngeyani njengoba bekholwa ukuthi kwakungeyokudubula. Kuvela ukuthi uGwabeni esethumela imali wasebenzisa igama elithi isabelo (dividends) kodwa akukho lapho okuvela khona ukuthi abasolwa nababili bakwaNdimande babenamasheya enkampanini yakhe. UMshushisi uthathe bonke abebesenkantolo ngamehlo engqondo ebalandisa ngakho konke okwenzeka ngosuku lwesigameko.Uveze ukuthi konke kwaqala ngokuthi kube khona abamlandelayo u-AKA ngesikhathi efika esikhumulweni sezindiza eKing Shaka.Abasolwa ababemlandela uthe babehamba nge VW Polo, abanye babehamba ngeBMW eyayishayelwa uGwabeni. Uveze nokuthi imoto kwakungesiyona ekaGwabeni kodwa wayeyiqashile.Uthe esesuka lo mculi eya ehhotela abasolwa baqhubeka nokumelusa.Uthe ngemuva kwalokho u-AKA waya eWish nokuyilapho afika wakhuluma khona nomphathi wendawo uMnuz Kweyama."UKweyama watshela lo mculi ukuthi akapake imoto yakhe e-salon yakhe,” kuchaza yena.Ngesikhathi esengaphakathi eWish, uMshushisi uveze ukuthi uNdimande (Lindo) wayekhona naye ngaphakathi esamqaphile, waze washintsha nendawo ukuze ababone kahle.UMshushisi uthe ngesikhathi sekudutshulwa lo mculi abantu babaleka kodwa uNdimande waqhubeka wazihlalela ekhombisa ukungathuki.Uthe i-video iyamveza owayedubula ecuthile phakathi kwezimoto efake ikepisi elimhlophe. Kuvele ukuthi owadubula uMnuz Malusi Ndimande (osagcinwe eSwatini) nomfowabo. UMshushisi uveze ukuthi umsolwa wesibili uNdimande, uGwabeni noLindo yibona abaya eJacobs beyolanda iMercedes eyayinezibhamu ezazizosetshenziselwa ukubulala u-AKA.UMshushisi uveze ukuthi ubufakazi buveza ukuthi abasolwa babekhona endaweni yesigameko.UMshushisi uthe uyasiphikisa isicelo sabasolwa sokuthola ibheyili.Uthe umsolwa wokuqala uMkhwanazi akanayo indawo yokuhlala.Owesibili uNdimande uzoba yingozi emphakathini uma ethola ibheyili.Umsolwa wesithathu uMyeza, uMshushisi uthe uma engathola ibheyili angase angafiki uma sekuqulwa icala futhi akanayo indawo ahlala kuyona.Umsolwa wesine uGwabeni, uthe nguyena ungqondongqondo wetulo lokusocongwa kwalo mculi futhi angalibalekela icala.Owesihlanu uLindokuhle uthe naye uyingozi emphakathini.Icala lizobuyela enkantolo ngoLwesibili.
UBONAKALE ehlengezela izinyembezi umsolwa obhekene nohide lwamacala okubalwa kuwo nelokubulala.UNkk Agnes Sekgomotsi Setshwantsho (49) ubuyele eNkantolo yeMantshi eMolopo ngecala lokubulala, amabili okukhwabanisa nelokwephula umthetho.Icala lakhe lihlehliselwe umhlaka 22 Meyi 2024 lapho kuzozwakala khona isinqumo somqondisi wezokushushisa kuleli ngokudluliswa kwaleli cala liye enkantolo enkulu."Ubucayi baleli cala yibona obenza kube nesidingo sokuba lidluliselwe enkantolo enkulu, lokhu kuzozwakala mhla libuyela enkantolo icala. Umsolwa uzoqhubeka nokugqunywa esitokisini njengoba ahluleka esicelweni sakhe sebheyili,” kusho uHenry Mamothame okhulumela iNPA eNorth West.Uphenyo olunzulu olwenziwe wuphiko lwezobunhloli oluholwa uSergeant Kheshi Mabunda lwaholela ekuboshweni komsolwa ngezinsolo zokuthi wabulala izihlobo zakhe ukuze ahlomule ngezicelo zomshuwalense.Lo nkosikazi waboshwa endaweni yaseCenturion ngemuva kokuthi amaphoyisa ephenye ngokufa kukamshana wakhe, okwadingeka ukuba kumbiwe isidumbu sakhe ukuze sihlolwe.Lokhu kwenzeka ngemuva kokuthi umyeni kamshana namanye amalungu omndeni azwakalisa ukungenami kwawo ngendlela ashona ngayo nangokuthi umsolwa wayethathe umshuwalense ka-R3 million egameni likamufi, ezinyangeni ezimbalwa ngaphambi kokuba ashone.Ethula ubufakazi uSergeant Mabunda, utshele inkantolo ukuthi umsolwa akafanelwe wukuthola ibheyili ngoba esaphenywa ngamanye amacala okubulala indodana yakhe, umyeni wakhe namadodakazi akhe amabili.U-Sgt Mabunda uthe uphenyo lokufa kwendodana kamsolwa uKutlo luguqulelwe ecaleni lokubulala ngemuva kokuvela kombiko othi unina nguyena muntu wokugcina wokubona indodana yakhe iphila.Kuthiwa indodana yakhe wayeyikhave ngomshuwalense ka-R6 million. Kuthiwa umufi wagcina ukudla i-burger yaseSteers ayithengelwa ngunina ngesikhathi besendleleni ebheke eMothibistad, besuka eKapa lapho yayifunda khona ngaphambi kokudlula emhlabeni.
SIBALISA ngokusala dengwane kubulawa umzukulu, isaguga esinguninakhulu wowesifazane okuthiwa ushaywe yinhlamvu ebinhlanhlatha ngesikhathi kuqhunyiswa izibhamu enkonzweni yomngcwabo wowayeyisosha loMkhonto WeSizwe, obusenkundleni yezemidlalo eChesterville, ngeSonto.Lesi sigameko esishiye abantu beshaqekile, kuthiwa senzeke kungcwatshwa uMnuz Story Shelembe owayeyisosha loMkhonto weSizwe, kanti ngesikhathi kuviliyelwa kuqhunyiswa izibhamu okukholakala ukuthi bekwenziwa ngenhloso yokuhlonipha umufi, kuphethe ngezinyemebezi emndenini wakaNdlovu. Kudubuleke ilungu lawo uNksz Thobile Goodness Ndlovu (24), okuthiwa ubezimele nabanye esangweni lenkundla yezemidlalo bebukela kuqhubeka umngcwabo.Uninakhulu kaThobile, uNksz Constance Ndlovu (81) ekhuluma neSolezwe, uthe ufe olwembiza ngomzukulu wakhe abethembele kuyo njengoba ubezihlalela naye emlekelela njengoba esewumuntu ophila nezifo ezingamahlalakhona ngenxa yokukhula."Ubengekho ngisho ngaphakathi emngcwabeni ngokuzwa kwethu. Ubezimele esangweni nezinye izingane bebukela buqamama njengoba bekuviliyela amasosha, kanti kuzothi sekuqhunyiswa izibhamu, inhlamvu ivele ikhethe yena. Ngibuhlungu kakhulu ngoba bekuyona ngane ebengizihlalela nayo, abazali bayo abanginikeza yona ukuthi inginakekele njengoba sengikhulile futhi ngihlala ngokugula,” kubalisa yena.Uthe okubuhlungu kakhulu ukuthi umufi ushiye ingane enezinyanga eziwu-18 abebehlala nayo osekuzophoqa ukuthi iyohlala noninakhulu.Uthe inhlamvu ingene esweni kanti uphuthunyiswe emtholampio nokuyilapho ephelele khona."Bengingazi lutho ngizihlalele ekhaya. Ngibone kuma iveni yamaphoyisa egcekeni bangitshela ngalokhu esekwenzekile. Ngiyafisa ukuthola izimpendulo ukuthi ubani odubule umzukulu wami,” usho kanje.UMnuz Zethembe Cele owayemgqugquzeli ophikweni lomakadebona boMkhonto WeSizwe, i-MK Military Veterans Association osefudukele kwi- MK Party, uthe wazisiwe ngesigameko esenzeke kuqhubeka inkonzo yomngcwabo kazakwabo."Odubulile akulona isosha ngiyasola umuntu nje. Amasosha aqeqeshiwe kakhulu ngokudubula futhi ayazi ukuthi uma udubula ungahlose kulimaza umuntu, isibhamu sibhekiswa emoyeni futhi kungaqondaniswa nendawo enesixuku sabantu,” kusho uCele.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uConstable Thenjiswa Ngcobo uthe amaphoyisa aseCato Manor aphenya icala lokubulala emva kokuthi owesifazane oneminyaka engu-24, kusolwa ukuthi udutshulwe inhlamvu ebinhlanhlatha ivela kumsolwa ongaziwe, obalekile emva kwesigameko.
ATHEMBISANE ukukhiphana inkani okhethweni oluzayo amalungu e-ANC naweMK enqwamana eNkantolo eNkulu eThekwini.Kugqame kakhulu ukuklolodelana phakathi kwamalungu alamaqembu abecula ngaphandle kwenkantolo lapho bekulalelwe isicelo esifakwe i-ANC, esola iMK ngokuntshontsha uphawu negama lombutho wezempi wayo owawubizwa ngoMkhonto weSizwe.Amalungu alamaqembu abelokhu ekhumbuzana ukuthi 'angawandawonye’, ngesikhathi elokhu echomelana.Umculo ubusho phezulu ngaphandle kwenkantolo.Womabili amaqembu abehlele imicimbi lapho abaholi bekhulume khona nabalandeli.Amalungu e-ANC abeholwa uNobhala Jikelele, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, nobuholi baKwaZulu-Natal.AbeMK bona bebeholwa owayengumengameli, uJacob Zuma. Abaholi bebelokhu bexoxa, bejabulelana.Enkantolo abameli be-ANC bathe ukuvela kweMK ohlwini lwamaqembu angenele ukhetho kungadida abantu, abangazitshela ukuthi ihlobene ne-ANC njengoba umbutho wezempi kwi-ANC wawubizwa ngoMkhonto weSizwe.Ummeli we-ANC, u-Advocate Gavin Marriott, uthe iMK izama ukukotela nge-ANC."Bafuna abantu bazitshele ukuthi bahlobene ne-ANC ukuze nezothola amavoti anele ukuthi bathola izihlalo ePhalamende. Inhloso yabo ileyo."UMarriott uthe i-ANC isikuthola kunzima ngisho ukusebenzisa uphawu lwayo olunomkhonto ngoba kuzokuba sengathi idumisa iMK.Abameli beMK bathe uphawu lweMK nolophiko lwempi kwi-ANC azifani.Bathe umkhonto ophawini lweMK ukhombe ngenhla kwesinqa kanti kwelophiko lwezempi kwi-ANC ukhombe ekhanda.Ummeli weMk, u-Advocate Dali Mpofu uthe igama nophawu lweMK akusikho olwe-ANC.Uthe lolu phawu lwabhaliswa phansi yinhlangano engenzi nzuzo, iLegacy Project."Emva kokuthi iMK isingenele ukhetho, i-ANC yagijima yayothenga uphawu ngesamba esingadalulwanga. ILegacy Project yabhalisa uphawu eminyakeni eyishumi eyedlule. I-ANC ayizange yenze lutho ngalokho, iqale ukusukuma uma iMK isingenela ukhetho. Inhloso enkulu ukuphazamisa umkhankaso weMK."Ngaphandle kwenkantolo uZuma utshele amalungu eMK ukuthi bazowunqoba lombango wezomthetho njengoba benzile nasecaleni ebeliseNkantolo yezoKhetho.UZuma uthe abameli be-ANC bafike bakhuluma into engezwakali enkantolo, wathi kusale kancane ukuthi ijaji libahleke.Uthe balungiselela ukunqoba ngamalengiso ukhetho oluzayo, wabafanisa namagwala labo abangezukuyivotela iMK."Lawo amagwala asaba abelungu, bathi basaba ukuthi abelungu baphatha izibhamu.”UZuma wenze izinsolo zokuthi kunetulo lokukhwabanisa amavoti okhethweni oluzayo.Uthe bathole ulwazi lokuthi amavoti azokhwatshaniswa ngosuku okuzokube kuvotwa ngalo, labo abavota ngokukhethekile.Unxuse amalungu eMK ukuba aqaphele kakhulu ngalolo suku, waphinde wathi ukuvota angeke kube imfihlo uma sekuphethe iMK.UNobhala -Jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula ubuze ukuthi uZuma uzolunqoba kanjani ukhetho lukazwelonke ekubeni esahlulwa ukunqoba ngakubo.UMasipala waseNkandla noWard 14, lapho kwakhe khona uZuma, baphethwe yi-IFP."Kukhona abahamba bethi bazonqoba ukhetho ngokubili kokuthathu. Uzolunqoba kanjani ukhetho esahlulwa i-IFP?"UMbalula uthe i-ANC ihambe ibizwa ngamasela nje kungenxa kaZuma kanye nabanye asebejoyine iMK athe bashiya i-ANC negama elibi.UMbalula uthe abanankinga noZuma, wathi bona bavikela ifa le-ANC."Kungani inhlangano yakhe engayiqambi ngegama lakhe? Uma kuwukuthi igama lakhe liyahlonishwa emphakathini, kufanele engasabi ukuqamba inhlangano yakhe ngegama lakhe."UMbalula uthe angeke basidlulisele phambili isinqumo senkantolo yezoKhetho, esichithe isicelo sabo sokuba kukhishwe iMK ohlwini lwamaqembu azongenela ukhetho."Thina siyazihlonipha izinqumo zenkantolo. Uma sihluliwe ngeke usizwe silokhu sisabisa ngokususa udlame njengoba kade kwenza abanye. Into esesizoyilwela manje ukunqoba ukhetho."Isinqumo sigodliwe.Amalungu eMK eviliyela ngaphandle kweNkantolo eNkulu eThekwini Isithombe:Khaya Ngwenya..Owayengumengameli, uJacob Zuma, ngaphandle kweNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu Isithombe: Khaya Ngwenya.South Africa - Durban 27 March 2024: Jacob Zuma during the MK vs ANC at the Durban High Court .Photographer: Khaya Ngwenya.
UMASIPALA waseMhlathuze uqinisekise imibiko yokudutshulwa kwabasebenzi ababili emmahovisi aseRichards Bay. Asavaliwe amahhovisi alo masipala.Ngokombiko othunyelwe abezindaba ngoLwesine ekuseni, kuthiwa lesi sehlakalo senzeke ekuseni namhlanje kanti ukufa kwalaba basebenzi okubukwa ukuthi ngonogada babanye babaholi balo masipala kuqinisekiswe amaphoyisa khona kule ndawo.Ngokombiko wamaphoyisa, kuthiwa unogada obengekho emsebenzini ufike wavulela ngenhlamvu kuzakwabo, washona, kwathi omunye unogada waphindisela ngenhlamvu kumsolwa, naye wasala enkundleni.Amaphoyisa athi uphenyo luyaqhunbeka.Umholi we-Action SA KwaZulu-Natal uMnuz Zwakele Mncwango udlulise amazwi enduduzo emindenini yalabo abashonile, wasigxeka isenzo sokuhlaselana kwabasebenzi phakathi emagcekeni kamasipala.
KUZOBA ukhethu’ khethi kubavoti kuleli njengoba bengu-14 662 abantu abazongenela ukhetho ekubeni izihlalo ezibangwayo zingu-887 kuphela.Lezi zihlalo ezasePhalamende kanjalo neziShayamthetho zezifundazwe.Okhulumela ikhomishini yezokhetho uNkk Kate Bapela, uthe bangu-6 743 ababanga izihlalo eziShayamthetho, babe ngu-3 596 ababanga izihlalo ePhalamende kuthi abangu-4 323 babange izihlalo zeProportional Representation (PR) ezibangwa amaqembu kuphela.Uthe abantu banikwe kuze kube ngu-5 ntambama namhlanje ukuthi bakhononde ngabantu abangenela ukhetho okubalwa nabalungenela ngokuzimela.Uveze ukuthi bangu-42 abantu okuvele ukuthi bebesohlwini lwamanye amaqembu."Laba bavela emaqenjini angu-39, kanti omunye ongenela ukhetho ngokuzimela uvela ohlwini lwelinye iqembu. Uhlu lwabantu abangenela ukhetho lutholakala emahhovisi ethu.” Uveze ukuthi iGauteng iyona ezoba nabantu abaningi njengoba inamaqembu angu-40, nababili abangenela ukhetho ngokuzimela ngakho iyona ezoba nephepha elide kunawo wonke kuleli.Uveze ukuthi ikhomishini izonquma ngalabo okukhalwa ngabo kusasa kanti uma bengeneme ngesinqumo se-IEC bangamangala enkantolo yezokhetho ezonquma ngo-Ephreli 2. Ubalule ukuthi uhlu lokugcina lwabangenele ukhetho luzoshicilelwa ngo-Ephreli 10. Ukhumbuze abantu ukuthi bazokwazi ukuvota lapho behlala khona kuphela.Uthe abazobe bengekho lapho behlala khona ngosuku lokhetho bangabhalela isikhulu sekhomishini bafake isicelo sokuthi bazobe bevota kwesinye isikhungo.Kumele bakwenze lokhu ungakashayi uMeyi 17 njengoba ukhetho lungoMeyi 29. Ukufakwa kwesicelo sokuvota lapho ungahlali khona akuhambisani nokufaka isicelo sokuvota ngokuyisipesheli okuzovulwa isicelo sakho maphakathi noMeyi. Abazosheshe bavote abazobe besebenza ngosuku lokhetho, abagulayo, abangakwazi ukuhamba kanjalo nezaguga.
OVELA ohlwini lwamalungu azomela i-DA ePhalamende, uMnuz Maliyakhe Shelembe, uthe akubaqwashisi ukudlondlobala koMkhonto weSizwe (MK) KwaZulu-Natal.UShelembe uthe akukho simanga kwiMK ekhankaselwa owayengumengameli, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, wathi abantu abaningi abalandela iMK bayilandela ngoba nakhu iholwa uZuma abamthandela ukuthi udansa kahle.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi exoxa neSolezwe emva komcimbi wokumenyezelwa kwabaholi baKwaZulu-Natal abazomela iDA esiShayamthetho sesifundazwe nasePhalamende.UShelembe, oke waba yimeya kaMasipala waseMtshezi, uvela ohlwini lwabaholi abaya ePhalamende.Umbango wokuhola iKwaZulu-Natal mkhulu, uShelembe ungomunye wabaholi abanesipiliyoni sokukhankasa KwaZulu-Natal njengoba eke waba imeya amahlandla amabili ngesikhathi eseyilungu le-IFP, waphinde waba iphini lemeya kuMasipala wesiFunda uThukela ngesikhathi eseyilungu leNFP. UShelembe uthe umkhankaso wabo awufani nowamanye amaqembu, wathi awuncikile esiqwini somuntu oyedwa."Uma ukhuluma naboMkhonto, bakutshela ngoMsholozi, bakhuluma ngoZuma, abanye baze baphimisele, bathi simthanda uma esedansa. Lokho kukutshela ukuthi abanye abantu ababheki ukuthi ikusasa lezwe limi kanjani. Babheka ukuthi umuntu ubhekene nayiphi inkinga ngaleso sikhathi, bese bemeseka kuleyo nkinga. Umkhankaso weDA ugxile kakhulu ezintweni iqembu elithembisa ukuthi lizozenza. Umehluko mukhulu kakhulu phakathi kweDA namaqembu akhonza umuntu oyedwa.”Uhlu lwabe-DA abaya esiShayamthetho luholwa ogaqele isikhundla sikandunankulu wesifundazwe, uMnuz Chris Pappas, olandelwa umholi weDA esifundazweni, uMnuz Francios Rodgers.Amagama abaholi abasha aqaphelekayo elikaMnuz Sbongiseni Vilakazi, ovela endaweni yesithupha noMnuz Mlondi Mdluli, ongowesi-12 ohlwini.URodgers uthe zonke izinhlanga zimelelekile ohlwini lweDA."Ngike ngalubona uhlu lwe-ANC, luyamangaza. Akukho ukumeleleka kwazo zonke izinhlanga.”URodgers uthe balungiselela ukuphatha iKwaZulu-Natal emva kokhetho lwangoMeyi."Kuza izinguquko KwaZulu-Natal. Ingakho siqale manje ukulungiselela izinguquko ezizayo. Kusukela manje, akulalwa, sikhankasela ukhetho.”USihlalo weDA KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Dean Macpherson, uthe kubathathe isikhathi eside ukukhetha amagama abaholi abazomela iqembu esiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal."Sathola izicelo ezingaphezu kuka-100. Uhlelo lokuhlunga beluhlukene izigaba ezing-11. Abakhethiwe babhale izivivinyo, benza nenhlolokhono.”UMacpherson uthe okujabulisayo ukuthi akekho okhalaza ngohlelo olulandeliwe."Akekho umuntu osiyisa enkantolo, uma ubheka kukhona abayisa i-ANC enkantolo. Lokhu kukutshela ukuthi bonke abantu bayayamukela imiphumela yohlelo esilulandelile.”
SIYALELWE ukuthi sifunele izitshudeni ezinye izindawo zokufunda nokuthi singabe sisamukela izitshudeni ezintsha izikhungo ezine ezingaphansi kwe-Educor, ezikhishwe ohlwini lwezikhungo ezizimele nguMnyango weMfundo ePhakeme nokuQeqesha.Lokhu kuvezwe nguNgqongqoshe walo Mnyango uDkt Blade Nzimande izolo ekhuluma nabezindaba ePitoli ukuthi lezi zikhungo okuyiDamelin, City Varsity, Icesa City Campus neLyceum College, zikhishiwe ngaphansi kwezikhungo ezibhalisiwe ngumnyango wakhe.Uthe izinkinga ezithinta inkohlakalo, ukungalethwa kolwazi oluthinta ukusebenza kwezimali, ukukokotelwa kwesibalo sezitshudeni, ukungakhokhelwa kwabasebenzi ngezinye zezinto ezibhekene nalezi zikhungo.Uveze ukuthi ngoLwesihlanu umnyango wakhe ufake ngaphansi komqulu kahulumeni ukuthi lezi zikhungo azisabhalisiwe ngaphansi kwawo."Kusuka ngo-2021 no-2022 i-Educor ephethe lezi zikhungo ihlulekile ukuletha ulwazi oluthinta ukusebenza kwezimali."Kumele i-Educor ifunele izitshudeni ezinye izindawo zokufunda ukuze ziphothule iziqu zazo. Siqale ukusebenza nobuholi obusha balezi zikhungo kusuka ngo-2012."Besibucela ukuthi bulungise izinto buhambisane nomthetho kodwa bulokhu bucela ukululelwa isikhathi ukuze buzilungise, okugcina ngokuthi zingalungi,” kusho uDkt Nzimande. Uthe manje kumele kuqhutshekwe nezitshudeni ezikhona zize zithweswe iziqu kungamukelwa ezintsha. Udalule ukuthi sekuyihlandla lesithathu i-Educor icela ukululelwa isikhathi ukuze ilungise izinto. Manje icele kuze kube u-Okthoba nonyaka.Uthe bazoyinika leli thuba lokulungisa izinto ngoba bafuna ukuvikela isithunzi seziqu zakuleli, ukuze kungabi nongabazane ngazo.Ukhale ngokuthi i-Educor yakokotela isibalo sezitshudeni enazo yathi zingu-50 000, ekubeni zingu-13 086 kanti ubezithola izikhalazo njalo ngalezi zikhungo."Kukhona ezinye ezithinta ukuthi izitshudeni zagixabezwa ngamamaki okuthi ziphasile ekubeni zingaphasanga. Okunye ukungaholelwa kwezisebenzi, izinga eliphansi lokufundisa, abasebenzi abangenazo iziqu ezifanele zokufundisa, ukushaywa indiva uma izitshudeni zifuna imali yazo, ukukhokhelwa imali encane kwabasebenzi nezinye,” eqhuba.Uthe izinto ezithinta ukusebenza kwemali ezikhungweni yinto ebalulwa ngisho emthethweni.Uveze ukuthi izinto okukhalwa ngazo ngalezi zikhungo zigcina zingalungiswanga. "Izitshudeni kumele ezinsukwini ezingu-14 kushicilelwe indaba yalezi zikhungo, zinikwe imiphumela yazo, zibuyiselwe imali nokuthi lezo esezizophothula iziqu zibhaliswe izivivinyo zithweswe nemiyezane. UPHIKO lwezokushushisa kuleli iNational Prosecuting Authority (NPA), lumile ekutheni uSomlomo wePhalamende osahlabe ikhefu uNkk Nosiviwe Mapisa-Nqakula, ekugcineni kumele avele njengawo wonke umuntu enkantolo ngoba umthetho awunasikhundla.Ummeli weNPA u-Advocate Makhosi Gwala, uthe abakwazi ukuthi banganqunyelwa ngumsolwa ngendlela okumele benze ngayo izinto.Uthe uma bengase bavumele ukuthi umuntu ongumsolwa abatshele ukuthi ufuna ukuvela nini enkantolo, kusho ukuthi umthetho uyothathwa njengento engekho.Uveze ibanga abalihambile bezama ukunxenxa uNkk Mapisa-Nqakula ukuthi avele enkantolo ngezinsolo zenkohlakalo."Saqala ukuxhumana naye ngoMashi 8, simazisa ukuthi sekuphume isinqumo sokuthi ashushiswe."Asikaze simsabise ngokumbopha, okunalokho samnxusa ukuthi azinikele yena emaphoyiseni ehamba nabameli bakhe. Iyona ndlela elandelwayo le ngokomthetho,” kusho u-Advocate Gwala. Ukusho lokhu izolo ngesikhathi kudingidwa amaphuzu enkantolo enkulu ePitoli ngesicelo esiphuthumayo asifakile esivimba ukuthi aboshwe.UGwala uthe ukushushiswa kukaNkk Mapisa-Nqakula, akuphambene nomthetho."Asikwazi ukuthi singavumela umsolwa ukuthi asitshele indlela okumele ashushiswe ngayo. Umthetho awazi sikhundla, wonke umuntu uyalingana ngaphambi kwawo.” Uveze nokuthi akuphuthumi ukuthi umsolwa angathola idokodo ngaphambi kokubekwa amacala ngokusemthethweni.UGwala uthe imigomo yeNPA ayikwazi ukuthi ingancika esikhundleni somuntu ongumsolwa.UNkk Mapisa-Nqakula usolwa ngokwamukela intshontsho komunye wosonkontileka owayethola amathenda eMnyangweni wezokuVikela ngesikhathi esanguNgqongqoshe wawo.Kuthiwa wamukela imali engukheshi ebalelwa ngaphezu kukaR2 million, izikhawu ezahlukene. Okunye okuthiwa wagwazelwa ngakho i-wigi kanjalo nezinye izinto. Ubhekene namacala angu-12 enkohlakalo efinyelela kuR4 million, okufaka nelokushushumbisa imali. Ummeli kaNkk Mapisa-Nqakula u-Advocate Reg Willis SC, uthe kwakungekho emthethweni ukuseshwa komuzi kaSomlomo ngeledlule ngoba nommeli wakhe wayengekho. Uthe uNkk Mapisa-Nqakula unamalungelo njengawo wonke umuntu wathi kodwa yena uyahlonishwa uma eqhathanisa nabanye abantu. "Sifake amaphepha enkantolo ngoba sifuna ukuvimba ukuboshwa kwakhe, kuze kuphume isinqumo kanjalo nokuthi anikwe idokodo,” kusho uWilllis .Usole umbuso ngokuputshuza izitatimende zofakazi okwenze uNkk Mapisa-Nqakula waba ngumsolwa.Unxuse ijaji ukuthi uma libachitha esicelweni sabo kodwa libanike isivikelo sokuthi angaboshwa uNkk Mapisa-Nqakula kuze kukhishwe isinqumo.Ijaji Sulet Potterill lisigodlile isinqumo kuleli cala, lizoze lisikhiphe ngoLwesibili oluzayo. Livumile ukuthi uNkk Mapisa-Nqakula angaboshwa kuze kukhishwe lesi sinqumo.

KUZOCACA namhlanje ukuthi iqembu Umkhonto weSizwe lizoqhubeka nokungenela ukhetho lukazwelonke ngoMeyi 29, njengoba sibhekwe ngabomvu isinqumo senkantolo yezokhetho ezinze eBloemfontein.Le nkantolo ezokhipha lesi sinqumo eGoli hhayi eBloemfontein ngokwesimemezelo esenziwe izolo, kulindeleke inqume kuleli cala elibhekwe ngabomvu elafakwa yi-ANC ikhala ngokubhaliswa kweMK eyesekwa ngowayenguMengameli weZwe ne-ANC uJacob Zuma.I-ANC ikhala ngokuthi kunezinto ezingahanjiswanga kahle ngesikhathi ikhomishini yezokhetho i-Independent Electoral Commission, ilibhalisa iqembu leMK .Akubhekiwe isinqumo sale nkantolo kuphela kodwa i-IEC izodedelela umphakathi nohlu lwabantu abazomela amaqembu kulolu khetho.Kulolu luhlu kuzodedelwa namagama abantu abazongenela ukhetho ngokuzimela njengoba bezobe beqala ukuba yingxenye yalolu khetho.
