Le nselelo ayigcini nje ngokuthi kungaqashwa odokotela kodwa yenza nokuthi lungavulwa uphiko lomama nezingane esibhedlela esisha iDr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial, KwaMashu.UMphathiswa woMnyango uNksz Nomagugu Simelane, utshele amalungu esiShayamthetho ukuthi inkinga yemali yenza bangakwazi ukuvala izikhala zodokotela njengoba kukhona abangaqashiwe.Uthe babalelwa ku-200 odokotela abangaqashiwe emnyangweni ekubeni kunezikhala."Noma sinazo izikhala ezingavaliwe kodwa iqiniso ngukuthi asikwazi ukuzivala ngenxa yokunconzulwa kwemali emnyangweni. Uma isikhala sivuleka, asibe sisakwazi ukusivala ngisho noma kuthiwa sishiywe ngumuntu obeqashwe ngokugcwele,” kusho uNksz Simelane.Uthe lokhu kuyawudida umphakathi ngoba ukhala ngokuthi lowo muntu ohambile ubehlelelwe ukuthi uzowuthola umholo wakhe njengoba ubeqashiwe ngokugcwele."Siyaqhubeka nokuxoxa nomnyango kazwelonke mayelana nalolu daba. Siyakujabulela ukwesekwa ngumnyango kazwelonke, njengoba uNgqongqoshe ezama ukuthi sithole imali ethe xaxa njalo uma kuqala unyaka wemali,” kusho uNksz Simelane ngesikhathi lumnyango uvele ngaphambi kwekomiti elibhekele ukusebenza kwemali yomphakathi, iStanding Commitee on Public Accounts, esiShayamthetho muva nje.Sekube nezikhawu lapho odokotela abangaqashiwe bemashele emnyangweni wesifundazwe, kanjalo nokazwelonke bekhala ngokungaqashwa.UNgqongqoshe wezeMpilo kuzwelonke,uDkt Joe Phaahla, usanda kuveza ephendula imibuzo ePhalamende, ukuthi sebeziqalile izinhlelo zokuqasha odokotela.UPhaahla uthe kodokotela ababalelwa ku-800 abakhala ngokuthi abasebenzi, abangu-270 sebeqashiwe ezweni lonke.Inhloko yomnyango esifundazweni, uDkt Sandile Tshabalala, ithe sebeluqalile nohlelo lwe-e health ukuze imininingwane yeziguli itholakale kalula.Ukhale ngokuthi kwesinye isikhathi abeduka amafayela eziguli ezikhungweni zabo.Kulo mhlangano kuvele nokuthi uphiko lwezingane nomama alukasebenzi esibhedlela iPixley ngenxa yokuthi imali ayikho.Kuvele ukuthi kudingeka uR146 million ukuze lolu phiko lusebenze.Kubalulwe nokuthi kusasebenza ama-wodi angu-32 kuphela kulesi sibhedlela kwangu-38.Usihlalo weScopa, uNkk Maggie Govender, uthe uphiko lomama nezingane esibhedlela iPixley lubaluleke kakhulu emphakathini ngakho kudingeka lubhekelwe uma kuvela imali."Umphakathi uludinga kakhulu lolu phiko ngakho kudingeka ukuthi lunikwe imali uma kwenzeka ivela. Siyazazi izinkinga ezibhekene nomnyango ngenxa yezinkinga zokunconzulwa kwemali kodwa ngqongqoshe nethimba lakho awugcini ngokukhala nje, wenza izinto zenzeke,” kusho uNkk Govender.
ZISASHAQEKILE namanje izihlobo zomngani ogwaze wabulala omunye emqashweni wakhe kwaH eNtuzuma, ngoLwesihlanu.UNksz Fezeka Dlamini (32) obeqashe kwaH kodwa ongowokuzalwa eMtshezi, kuthiwa ubulawe ngowesifazane obengumngani, bengamathe nolimi naye. Kuthiwa umgwaze ngommese wokupheka.Ziningi izinto ezikhulunywayo okuthiwa ziyimbangela yokubulawa kwakhe.Udaba lokuphuma kwesidumbu sikhishwa ngumngani, belukhulunywa nasezinkundleni zokuxhumana.Abanye bathi umsolwa ucasulwe ukuthi umufi okuthiwa ubenemali, ubesethi useyolala yena kanti umsolwa ubesafuna kuqhutshekwe kuhlalwe kuphuzwe.Abanye bathi bekubangwa imali yokuqasha.Isolezwe likwaze ukuthola udadewabo kamsolwa, uNksz Sanelisiwe Ngqeqe (39) othe umsolwa uyamlama.Uthe namanje isajama ingqondo uma ethi uyaqala uyacabanga ukuthi kwenzeke kanjani ukuthi udadewabo omncane, abulale umuntu abebengamathe nolimi naye."Umufi wafikela ekhaya ngesikhathi ezozama impilo eThekwini. Uhlale iminyaka engu-15 ekhaya ngaphambi kokuyohlala emqashweni. Baqala lapho ukuzwana nodadewethu,” kusho uNksz Ngqeqe.Uthe ukuhlala emqashweni ubesanda kuqala.Uthe ngisho abantu bakubo kamufi, bebethi uma bezobheka amatoho eThekwini, bebefikela kubo sekungathi bangumndeni.Echaza ngokuzwana kukamufi nomsolwa, uthe bese kungathi bayazalana."Umuntu obengazi, ubezitshela ukuthi yizelamani. Esikhathini esiningi udadewethu ubekuthola kulula ukuvuleleka kumufi kunokuthi avuleleke kimi ngingowakwabo,” kulandisa uNksz Ngqeqe.Uthe emva kokwenzeka kwesigameko, ushayelwe ucingo yizingane zakwabo ezimelamayo njengoba bengasenabazali futhi kunguye omdala, wathi abamtholanga ocingweni kwaze kwaba ukuthi baya eZimangweni, lapho ahlala khona."Ngifike endaweni yesigameko esethule umufi, udadewethu esethathwe ngamaphoyisa, kugcwele inqwaba yabantu,” kusho uNksz Ngqeqe.Uthe ugcine engayizwa imbangela ecacile yokuxabana kwabo."Ngizwe kancane kuthiwa bebebanga imali ye-rent kodwa ngazibuza ukuthi bayibanga kanjani imali ye-rent udadewethu enekhaya esalishiyelwa ngabazali bethu kwaM. Ngizibuze ukuthi yini emhlanganisa nemali ye-rent?” usho kanje, wathi uhlela ukuphindela khona endaweni yesigameko ayoqala phansi abuze ukuthi bekubangwani.Udalule ukuthi umufi nomsolwa bebefika ezinkambeni zikaFaro futhi bekuke kwenzeke ukuthi baphikisane ngamazwi."Kodwa ubuthi uyababona ngakusasa, sebeyazwana, sebeyahleka, usungaphika ukuthi ngayizolo bebeke baphambana ngemibono,” kuchaza uNksz Ngqeqe.UNksz Ngqeqe ubelokhu ekhale njalo ngelithi noma ngabe kuthi bese kufike isikhathi sokuthi umufi ashone kodwa "ubese angaze ahambe ngesandla sikadadewabo pho?”Ukhale nangokuthi umsolwa njengoba eboshiwe nje, ubashiye nengane enezinyanga ezinhlanu, eyazalwa singakashayi isikhathi.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uthe amaphoyisa aseNtuzuma abophe owesifazane emva kokusolwa ngokugwaza umngani wakhe washona emgwaqweni uMartin Gumede kwaH eNtuzuma, ngoLwesihlanu."Kuthiwa umufi ubesemqashweni wakhe nomngani bephuza ngesikhathi kusuka ingxabano. Kuthiwa umsolwa ugwaze umufi washona. Uboshwe ngamaphoyisa, kanti uzovela enkantolo namuhla,” kusho uNetshiunda.
Uphiko lwentsha ye-ANC esifundeni iJosiah Gumede lusola iPhini leMeya kaMasipala Ukhahlamba, uNkk Nothile Tshabalala, ngokuqasha amalungu omndeni walo kumasipala.Esitatimendeni esithunyelelwe abezindaba esinegama likanobhala wesifunda uMnuz Sphelele Masuku nelomkhulumeli uMnuz Lindokuhle Maphalala, i-ANCYL ithe isikhathele wuTshabalala, oyilungu le-ANC, ngenxa yezizathu ezehlukene."I-ANCYL isebenzise izinhlaka ezifanele izama ukugxeka ngokwakhayo iphini lemeya kusuka ehhovisi likasotswebhu kuya kwi-ANC uqobo. Kusobala ukuthi iphini lemeya livimba ukuthi i-ANC ithuthukise intsha ikakhulukazi ekudaleni amathuba omsebenzi,” kusho isitatimende.Lolu phiko luthe uTshabalala uma eqasha uyenzelela njengoba muva nje kuqashwe umfowabo njengomqaphi wakhe nodadewabo usekhushulelwe kaningi ezikhundleni.Luthe kumele i-ANC ingenele ngokushesha.UNkk Tshabalala uthe yena njengekhansela akaqashi kodwa kuqasha imenenja kamasipala. Uthe kungamanga aluhlaza ukuthi uqasha izihlobo zakhe."Yinto ongakwazi ukuyiphenya leyo. Umuntu uma eqashwe kwamasipala ungamfihla kanjani? Ngisho noma ngabe bengiyimenenja kamasipala bengingeke ngiqashe i-ANC Youth League kodwa bengizoqasha umphakathi. Asivotelwanga yi-ANC Youth League kodwa sivotelwe wumphakathi,” kusho uTshabalala.Uthe umasipala uphethwe ngokubambisana yizinhlangano ezehlukene ngakho uma kunokuphambene akwenzayo kusho ukuthi "imeya nosomlomo bayizithumuthumu zami”."Sisemkhandlwini olawulwa ngokubambisana, akekho ongenza okuphambene. Umkhandlu wethu uhlale uthola umbiko womcwaningi mabhuku ongenagcobho, amabhuku awaphekwa. Izingane (ANCYL) zinomkhankaso wazo nje eziwuphushayo,” kusho uTshabalala.
LIZOGAYA ngomunye umhlathi eqenjini elesekwa owayengumengameli wezwe ne-ANC uJacob Zuma, Umkhonto weSizwe, njengoba abazoba sesigungwini esiphezulu saleli qembu bengeke bazinuke izikhundla zokuba ongqongqoshe.UZuma uthe izinto zizokwenziwa ngendlela ehlukile kuleli qembu."Niyabona nje, senze ngamabomu ukuthi singabi naso isigungu sabaholi abaphezulu kuleli qembu okujwayelekile emaqenjini ezepolitiki. Sifuna ukugada abajaha izikhundla,” kusho uZuma.Uthe inkinga idalwa ngukuthi umuntu oyedwa uba sesigungwini seqembu, abe ngungqongqoshe bese engabikhona ozomgada."Kuzoba lula uma eqenjini kukhona abazomgada. Abanye sizobakhipha ohlwini ukuze babone ukuthi abanazo izikhundla. Ningathuki uma sekwenzeka lokhu, nibuze ukuthi senzani.” Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabeseka leli qembu eMsinga ngempelasonto.Uthe izwe lizobuyela emakhosini okuyiwo azohlonishwa ashaye nomthetho."Sithathe isinqumo sokuthi silithathe izwe libuyele kithina ngoba siyabona ukuthi abafowethu abalengamele abaliphethe kahle. Uhulumeni kwamanye amazwe ukhothama futhi usebenzele Inkosi yakhona. ENgilandi akekho umengameli, kodwa kukhona obambele osebenza ngaphansi kwenkosi yakhona. Kungani amakhosi ethu enganikwa la mandla? Sibaphuca abaphethe izwe ngoba sifuna amakhosi abe namandla nezwi ekuphathweni kwezwe. Akube yiwona azosithuma njengabanikazi bezwe.” Uthe ivoti libalulekile wathi ukube kuya ngaye ngabe kuvotwa kuvulelekile."Kungani yonke into isobala kuleli kodwa ivoti liyimfihlo. Sizowushintsha umthetho, sifuna kuvotwe ngokuvulelekile. Umuntu akavote kubonakale ukuthi uvoteleni. Kungani kumele usabe uma uvotele into oyithandayo? Yingakho sithi asibuyele eMkhontweni, sivotele leli qembu njengendlu emnyama. Benza imfihlo yokuvota ngoba bafuna ukusirobha, izigebengu ziyakhwabanisa.” Uthe iMK ilona qembu elizoletha inkululeko abantu abazoyibamba ngezandla.Uveze ukuthi izimayini zizophathwa abamnyama wathi izimboni kumele zibe semakhaya."Sifuna ukuyishintsha nemithetho esigwebayo nsuku zonke. Sisebenzisa imithetho yabelungu, iRoman Dutch Law, sizoyishintsha sifake umthetho ophethe abantu base-Afrika. Ngihlale ejele iminyaka ngenxa yalo mthetho wabelungu, ngiyazi ngo-si into engikhuluma ngayo.” Uthe izimpimpi zihlale zikhona ezweni wathi ngesikhathi kusaliwa yayigaxwa ithayi.Ubalule nokuthi uhulumeni uzoba nemali yokufundisa yonke intsha."Uma ubalekela isikole sizokufaka ejele, ufundele khona uze ugogode. Ingane encane efundayo uma iqeda u-matric iya emasosheni, iyofundela ukuvikela izwe. Iyofunda ukuhlonipha, bese iya enyuvesi. Akekho ongeke aye enyuvesi, uzobe ehlaleleni? Akukho ngane ezophuza utshwala, lutho. Intando yabantu ivuna ukuthi ingane iphuze noyise, kuzophela lokhu.”

UPHITHENE amakhanda umndeni wakwaMpangase eWestrich, eNewlands West, eThekwini, kulandela ukuthunjwa kwengane yawo ngoLwesithathu.UNksz Thobile Mpangase ongumalumekazi wewele elilahlekile, uSibusiso Mpangase (9), uthe basola ukuthi uthunjwe owesilisa ohamba nge-Toyota Etios e-silver grey.Uthe uSibusiso ulahleke ebuya kodlala epaki yendawo nezingane zabafana ezimbili zakubo, eyodwa eyiwele lakhe nenye eneminyaka engu-14. Uthe kwakungabo-9 ekuseni kwenzeka lo mshophi.Uveze ukuthi izingane zithi zathi uma ziphuma nje epaki zibuya zeza ekhaya, kwama i-Etios eduze kwazo, umshayeli wayo owayehamba yedwa, wakhomba iwele likaSibusiso, wathi alize kuyena ufuna ukulithuma ugwayi nephepha lokuwugoqa esitolo."Lo ona-14 uthe wavele walidonsa ngengalo iwele likaSibusiso, wathi lingayi lapho,” kusho uNksz Mpangase.Uthe lokhu wayekusho ngoba ekhaya babadonsa ngendlebe ukuthi bangasondeli ezimotweni zabantu abangabazi.Uveze ukuthi uSibusiso yena wavele waziyela emotweni yale ndoda.Uma emchaza uSibusiso, uthe uyingane egangile, basola ukuthi yileso kuphela isizathu abacabanga ukuthi samyisa emotweni yomuntu ongaziwa yize umndeni wabayala ukuthi bangakwenzi lokhu."Bafika ekhaya badla, bangasho ukuthi kwenzekeni ngenxa yobungane. Nathi saqala sanganaka ukuthi uSibusiso akekho. Ngesikhathi kuqhubeka usuku saqala sanaka ukuthi akekho uSibusiso ngoba kufanele ingabe useqhamukile wazodla naye.” UNksz Mpangase uthe yilapho okwabuzwa khona izingane ayekade ehambe nazo ukuyodlala ukuthi uphi, zasho ukuthi uthunywe esitolo umalume wemoto ezingamazi."Ngabo-3 ntambama sekubuye nomkhulu wakhe, saqala sambheka yonke indawo ngisho nasebanganini bakhe abanye nakomakhelwane, kodwa bonke balandula,” usho kanje.Uthe bagcina beya nasesitolo sendawo, umnikazi waso wathi akakaze afike uSibusiso esitolo ukuzothenga.Ngakusasa bavukela emaphoyiseni ukuyobika, kwaqhutshekwa kwacingwa kodwa namanje ingane ayitholakali."Siphithene amakhanda. Siyazibuza ukuthi ingane ingabe iphi futhi injani lapho ikhona?” kusho yena.Uthe ubugebengu bokuthunjwa kwezingane buyaqala ngakubo, bahlale bezwa ngezigameko zakude."Sifisa itholakale iphila ingane, ibuye ize ekhaya. KUKIKIZE umndeni kushona ilungu lawo othi ubulihlalise lubhojozi emva kwesigameko sokudlwengula udadewabo maqede lambulala, eMahesheni, eNquthu.Umufi uMnuz Khanyisani Buthelezi (27) okuthiwa ubeyisigebengu esesatshwayo kule ndawo kuvela ukuthi ushonele eGoli, ngoLwesibili emini.Kuthiwa ubesesatshiswa okwenyoka njengoba kuthiwa ubefuna ukuya ocansini nabo bonke odadewabo nezingane zamantombazane zakubo, emva kwesigameko sokubulala udadewabo esemdlwengulile.UMUFI uNKSZ Nomvula Buthelezi okuthiwa wabulawa nguKhanyisaniKakucaci ukuthi ibe yini imbangela yokufa kwakhe. Kunamahebezi okuthi uzikhungile. Ilungu lomndeni lokuqala, uNkk MaThusini Buthelezi lithe aphume nobovu ngokufa kwelunga lawo.Eqhuba uthe umufi ubenonya nesihluku esiyisimanga. Ulimise ngesihloko elokuthi umufi wazakhela inzondo engapheli emndenini ngo-2020 ngesikhathi edlwengula maqede ebulala udadewabo uNksz Nomvula Buthelezi owayedume ngelikaJuba."Siyawuhalalisela wonke umndeni wakwaButhelezi ngokuthi lo mfana amane akhethe isinqumo esihle kangaka sokuthi adlule emhlabeni. Phela iqiniso limile nje hheyi uhluphile kakhulu nangu umuntu wesilisa,'' usho kanje.Ekhuluma ngesigameko sokudlwengulwa nokubulawa kukaNksz Buthelezi, uthe umufi wamngenela egunjini lakhe lokulala wamdlwengula wathi eseqedile wambulala. Emva kwalokho wase emumboza samuntu osalele ongakavuki ebuthongweni.Emva kwesigameko uButhelezi wakhalelwa ngamasongo kaSigonyela, wahlala ejele iminyaka imibili wase ephuma.Kuthiwa kuleso sigameko kwatholakala insimbi eyayigcwele igazi egunjini likaButhelezi nephenti likamufi elalinegazi."Waxolisa kithina ngakwenzile, kodwa namanje akuvumi ukuthi sikhohlwe ukuthi kunomuntu ongenza isihluku esinjengalesi kumuntu wakubo,'' kuchaza uNksz Buthelezi.UNksz Jabu Buthelezi naye ukugcizelele ukuthi ibinzima kakhulu impilo esadla anhlamvana umfowabo.Uveze ukuthi izingane zamantombazane zonke zakwaButhelezi bezihlafuna zijeqeza ngoba ubefuna ukulala nazo njalo uma ethola ithuba."Thina asazi ukuthi kanti kakuyisilwane sini sona lesi uNkulunkulu ayesilethile kulo mndeni wethu,'' usho kanjena sakubalisa.Elinye ilungu lalo mndeni liveze ukuthi kunenye ingane yentombazane yasemndenini agcina ephumelelile ukulala nayo ngenkani.Umndeni uthe uzomngcwaba uButhelezi kodwa akukho buhlungu obuzwayo ngokushona kwakhe.
KUMUNCU enkampanini yezobuchwepheshe inqunyelwa ugwayi katiki ngokubuyisa uR500 milion ngezinkontileka ezimbili ze-Eskom okuthiwa azikho emthethweni.ISpecial Tribunal okuyisigungu esikhethekile esilalela amacala aphenywa yiSpecial Investigating Unit (SIU) ikhiphe umyalelo wokuthi iSystems Applications Products (SAP) ikhokhe imali enguR500 million zingakapheli izinsuku eziyisikhombisa.Lokhu kulandela uphenyo olwenziwe yiSIU ngezinkontileka ezimbili eziphakathi kwale nkampani ne-Eskom.Kuthiwa phakathi kuka-2013 no-2016, i-Eskom neSAP bangene ezinkontilekeni ezimbili ezibizwa nge-Enabling Agreement ne-Cloud Services Agreement zenani lika-R1.1billion. Uphenyo lwe-SIU luthole ukuthi i-Eskom ingene esivumelwaneni se-Enabling Agreement ne-SAP ukuze yenze imisebenzi yokuyitholela amalayisensi futhi iqaphe umsebenzi wokunakekela nokwenza okunye okuyizinsiza zesikhashana ngenani lenkontileka engu-R1 037 045 965.50."Ngemuva kwalokho, i-Eskom neSAP basayine isivumelwano sesibili seCloud Services ngenani lenkontileka engu-R21 712 514.82,” kusho iSIU ngesitatimende.
nguMoyomuhle Maphanga waseRumana MahomedKulula ukubhala incwadi yefa futhi kulula ukuqinisekisa ukuthi isayinwe ngokusemthethweni, okungelula ukuqinisekisa ukuthi konke okubhalwe encwadini yefa kuyenzeka.Empeleni akulungile ukuqala ngokubhala incwadi yefa. Phela incwadi yefa yisigaba sokugcina sokuhlela konke onakho, iphinde ibe ingxenye yokuhlela izimali zakho. Konke lokhu kufanele kulandelane ngendlela efanele, ukuze ugweme izinkinga.Yisiphi isinyathelo sokuqala ongasithatha ukuze impilo yakho ihleleke? Qala ngokubhala konke nakho, yilokho ofuna ukuba nakho, uzibuze ukuthi ufuna ukwenzani ngesikhathi usaphila nokuthi ufuna kwenzekeni mhla usungasekho. Zibuze ukuthi ufisani, uzokwenza kanjani lokho, nokuthi imali yokukwenza izovelaphi. Zibuze ukuthi yini ezokwenzeka ngezinto zakho mhla usungasekho emhlabeni.Emva kwalokho usungahlala phansi uzibuze ukuthi: Uma ngihamba emhlabeni manje, ngubani okufanele athole okuthile kulokhu enginakho? Kulapho- ke usungaqala khona ucabange ukuthi incwadi yakho yefa izothini. Lo mbuzo kufanele uzibuze wona njalo emva kweminyaka emibili okungenani, kodwa kungaba ngaphansi kweminyaka emibili uma kunoshintsho olukhulu empilweni yakho. Ushintsho kungaba umshado, ukuzalwa kwengane noma umzukulu, ukushona kwelunga lo mndeni wakho, ukuthengwa kwendlu, nokunye.ENingizimu Afrika sinelungelo lokwaba izinto zethu encwadini yefa ngendlela esifisa ngayo, kodwa lokhu kunezingqinamba. Akusizi ukwaba ifa ngendlela ofisa ngayo ekubeni kunemali encane efeni lakho yokukhokhela izikweletu zakho (zihlangene ne ntela) kanye nezindleko. Lokhu kusho ukuthi umabi wefa kufanele akhethe okukodwa ezintweni ezimbili: izindlalifa kufanele zifake imali efeni ukuze zizuze imoto, yindlu nokunye okuyifa okushiyile, noma amafa owashiyile kufanele adayiswe ukuze kuhlangane imali eyanele yokukhokhela izikweletu nezindleko zakho.Indlela oshade ngayo nayo ibalulekile. Uma ushade umshado ohlanganisa amafa, uhhafu wefa ungowakho, okusho ukuthi awukwazi ukucaza omunye uhhafu ngendlela othanda ngayo. Umaushade umshado ohlukanisa amafa kodwa othi lokho enizokuthola nishadile ngokwenu nobabili, lokho enikuthole nobabili kuzocazwa kuqala ngaphambi kokuthi kwabiwe okubhalwe encwadini yefa.Abashadikazi (nabahlalisene) kufanele bahlale bazi ukuthi uma kushona oyedwa, lowo osele uyakwazi ukufaka isicelo sokuthola izinto zalowo oshonile ngaphansi komthetho iMaintenance of Surviving Spouses Act. Lokhu kwenzeka esimeni lapho ophilayo esele nemali encane noma engakwazi ukuzinakekela.Okusempeshenini yakho noma okusesikhwameni sakho somhlala phansi, iprovident fund, kwabiwa ngokulandela iPension Funds Act. Ungabaqoka abantu okufanele imali iye kubona, kodwa ababhekelele isikhwama sempesheni ababoshiwe yilokho okubhale phansi.Uma ubabhalile okufanele bahlomule ngezimali zakho zenqubo mgomo yempilo neminye imishwalense, asikho isidingo sokubhala ngalesi sinqumo encwadini yakho yefa. Umshwalense uzokhokhela labo ababhalwe phansi.Uma abazali noma ogogo nomkhulu benze iskhwama sokwethemba, phecelezi iTrust, la begcine khona izinto ezibalulekile, njenge ndlu, izimoto nomunye umcebo, awukwazi ukufaka lezi zinto encwadini yakho yefa. Ngisho noma ngabe unesabelo kuzona.Mayelana nezinto okwazi ukuphisana ngazo, incwadi yakho yefa iyona ezokukhulumela uma ungasekho. Yingakho kubalulekile ukuthi ibhalwe kahle, icace, kungabikho okudidayo kuyo.Ngisho ukufakwa kokhefana endaweni engafanele kungaba yinkinga. Inkantolo ayikwazi ukubheka okunye ngaphandle kwalokho okubhale encwadini yakho yefa. Kubalulekile ukubhala amagama ngendlela efanele encwadeni yefa lakho, ngoba uma engabiziwe ngendlela efanele kungabhedisa izinhlelo zakho.Kubalulekile ukuthi uqoke umuntu ozobhekelela izindaba zefa lakho. Uma engekho oqokiwe, uMaster weNkantolo enkulu uzoziqokela umuntu ozobhekelela amafa akho emva kokuxoxisana nezinhlaka ezithintekayo. Lokhu kuthatha isikhathi kanti isikhathi siyimali. Umuntu ozokwengamela amafa akho kufanele aqokwe wuMaster ngaphandle uma lowo muntu engakwazi ukwengamela amafa.Funda kabanzi ngokubaluleka kokubhala incwadi yefa isithombe: SithunyelweUkuhlela amafa akho nokubhala incwadi yefa, yisona sinyathelo esingayidli imali eningi. Thola isazi esizokusisa ukuhlela izinto zakho, wazi ukuthi uzokhokha imali encane.Eminyakeni eyishumi (10) edlule, iJaji lenkantolo yokudluliswa kwamacala, uLeach lathi: "Kuyamangaza njalo ukuthi abantu abaningi bathatha usizo kulabo abangazi lutho ngokubhalwa kwencwadi yefa. Le ncwadi ingenye yezincwadi ezibalulekile ukuthi umuntu ayisayine.”IJaji uWeiner naye wenkantolo yokudluliswa kwamacala, wacaphuna kwinkulumo ka-Ambrose Pierce: "Ukufa akukona umphela ndawo. Kusala umbango wefa, oliwa ngezomthetho.”Yenza isiqiniseko sokuthi incwadi yakho yefa ayiqali umbango ozogcina enkantolo, kodwa kube incwadi ecacile engenaso isidingo sokuya enkantolo.Uyisayina kanjani incwadi yefa ngokusemthethweni.• ENingizimu Afrika, incwadi yefa kufanele isayinwe ephepheni. Kungaba yiphepha elibhalwe ngesandla noma elishicilelwe ngomshini, kodwa kungcono uma lishicilelwe ngomshini.• Umnikazi wefa kufanele asayine ezansi kwalo lonke ikhasi lencwadi yefa. Ekhasini lokugcina lencwadi yefa, kufanele asayine ngezansi komusho wokugcina.• Kufanele asayine phambi kofakazi ababili okufanele babe neminyaka engaphezu kweyi-14, abazokwazi nokuya enkantolo bayokwethula ubufakazi uma kunesidingo.• Ofakazi nabo kufanele basayine ekhasini lokugcina (kodwa kuyagqugquzelwa ukuba basayine wonke amakhasi).• Ofakazi kufanele babe khona uma kusayina umnikazi wefa, nabo basayine phambi kwakhe. • Ofakazi abavumelekile ukuhlomula efeni nokuthi kube yibona abalicazayo noma ababhekelela izindaba ezithinta ifa kodwa lokhu akuyenzi incwadi yefa ingabi semthethweni.• Uma umnikazi wefa engakwazi ukusayina, ngenxa yokukhubazeka, ukugula, nokuthi akafundile, kufanele kutholakale usizo longoti bezamafa. Umnikazi wefa uzokwazi ukwenza uphawu oluthile noma omunye umuntu angamsayinela, lokhu kufanele kugunyazwe wukhomishana onelungelo lokwenza izitatimende ezifungelwe.FUNDA kabanzi ngencwadi yefa ngokucindezela le link:https://www.fisa.net.za/wills/
BABHADLE ezitokisini abesifazane ababoshelwe amacala okukhipha imiphefumulo yabesilisa ezigamekweni ezimbili ezehlukene ezenzeke eMandeni, emasontweni amabili elandelana.Esigamekweni sakamuva esenzeke izolo, kuboshwe owesifazane oneminyaka ewu-30 ngecala lokubulawa kukaMnuz Ayanda Ngobese waKwaSithebe, khona eMandeni, okuthiwa ugwaziwe. UMNUZ Siyanda MpanzaKuthiwa uNgobese nomsolwa bangabangani kanti bebezihlalele bephuza kwenye indawo yokucima ukoma elokishini e-Chappies, ngesikhathi kuqubuka ingxabano phakathi kabo. Kuthiwa umsolwa ukhiphe ummese wamgwaza, ngaphambi kokuthi anyamalale, kanti umgilwa uphelele emtholampilo. Umsolwa ubeseboshwa amaphoyisa izolo, kanti kulindeleke ukuthi avele enkantolo namhlanje.Kwesinye isigameko esenzeke ngesonto eledlule, uMnuz Siyanda Mpanza (35) ongowokudabuka eMangethe, okuthiwa ubeqashe nentombi yakhe uNksz Samkelisiwe Bhengu KwaSithebe, kusolwa ukuthi babe nengxabano eholele ekutheni imgence ngegeja, washona emva kwesikhashana engeniswe emtholampilo.Umfowabo kamufi uMnuz Siphamandla Mpanza elandisa Isolezwe, uthe umfowabo ubehlala nentombi yakhe beqashe KwaSithebe, ngenxa yamatoho kanti iwumuntu owaziwayo nakubo njengoba besekunesikhathi bathandana."Umastende uthe uzwe kunomsindo obekukhombisa ukuthi bayaxabana okuthe emva kwesikhathi kwathula. Kukholakala ukuthi umsolwa umgence ngegeja ebelikhona endlini, kanti eqeda ukwenza lokho, uphumile endlini wamkhiyela waze wabuya ngezintatha ngakusasa kulokho bexabane kuqala ukuhwalala,” usho kanje.Uthe umastende uvukile waphoqa umsolwa ukuthi avule endlini ngoba uzwile ukuthi bebexabana, okuthe uma bevula umfowabo ubesevele kade eqalile ukopha emva kokugencwa, kanti ushonele emtholampilo eSundumbili.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi amaphoyisa aseSundumbili aphenya amacala okubulala nokuthi abasolwa baboshiwe. Uveze ukuthi uNksz Bhengu uvelile ngesonto eledlule njengoba kulindeleke ukuthi aphinde avele kuleli sonto.

UPHENYEKE izinqe uMuzikawukhulelwa Sibiya ongummangalelwa wokuqala ecaleni lokufa kukaSenzo Meyiwa, ngesikhathi ufakazi eveza ukuthi wayekhona eGauteng ngo-2014 ekubeni ethe wayengekho.UMeyiwa wadutshulwa wabulawa ekubo kwentombi yakhe uKelly Khumalo, eVosloorus, eGoli ngo-2014.USuperintendent Chupye Christopher Matlou ongumphenyi kwiRoad Traffic Management Corporation (RTMC), ufakaze walahla uSibiya.UMatlou uveze ukuthi uSibiya wayeseGauteng ngo-2014 waze wafaka isicelo sokubhala ukuhlolelwa izincwadi zokushayela."NgoJulayi 17, 2014 wabhala ehlolelwa izincwadi zokushayela eBrakpan wafeyila. Waphinda wafaka esinye isicelo ngalolo suku esefuna ukubhalela eBoksburg. Wabhala ngoSepthemba 15 waphasa,’’ kuchaza uMatlou. Ummeli wommangalelwa wokuqala osewamxosha, uMnuz Sipho Ramosepele, phambilini wathi uSibiya wayengekho eGauteng ngonyaka okwabulawa ngawo uMeyiwa. URamosepele wathi uSibiya waphelelwa wumsebenzi, wahamba ngoMashi 2013 wabuyela kwelakubo KwaZulu-Natal waze wabuyela eGauteng ngo-2015. UMshushisi u-Advocate George Baloyi uthe ubize lo fakazi ngamabomu ukuze aveze ukuthi uSibiya wakhuluma amanga.UMatlou uphinde waveza ukuthi ummangalelwa wesihlanu uFisokuhle Ntuli wayenemoto iVW emhlophe ebhaliswe ngaphansi kwegama lakhe kwabezokuthutha. Izitatimende zokuvuma amacala zabamangalelwa, ziveza ukuthi babehamba ngeVW Polo emhlophe ngesikhathi kuyosocongwa uMeyiwa.Kuvela nokuthi leyo moto yayishayelwa wuyena uNtuli okuthiwa wafika wasala ngaphandle komuzi okwadutshulwa kuwona uMeyiwa.Ufakazi uveze ukuthi uNtuli wayehamba ngayo le moto ngoFebhuwari 2, 2016 ngesikhathi emiswa yiphoyisa elambhala ithikithi.Ufakazi uthe uNtuli uphinde avele emabhukwini abo ukuthi wayehamba ngayo ngolunye usuku emiswa amaphoyisa ophiko lweJohannesburg Metro, nawo ambhala elinye ithikithi.UMatlou uthe uyafunga uyagomela ukuthi amarekhodi abo awashayi eceleni futhi lokhu akwethule enkantolo kuyiqiniso elimsulwa.Ummeli u-Advocate Charles Mnisi, uzamile ukuphebeza ukwethulwa kobufakazi ekhala ngokuthi abanikwanga ngesikhathi isitatimende sikafakazi. Abanye abameli bathe bona banikwa kusenesikhathi.Leli phuzu libangiwe kakhulu kodwa ijaji lanquma ukuthi ubufakazi buqhubeke. Kulindeleke ukuthi abameli baphose imibuzo kuMatlou ngoMsombuluko uma icala selibuyela enkantolo.

IMEYA yeTheku, uMnuz Mxolisi Kaunda, ikhwele yadilika kumakhansela amaqembu aphikisayo, yathi into ayaziyo ukusonga izandla agxeke, awafuni umasipala uzenzele ngokwawo imali.UKaunda uthe ayikho imali ezovele iqhamuke phezulu njengemana yaseBhayibhelini futhi uyazi ukuthi la maqembu ngeke akuvotele ukuphasiswa kwesabelomali.Uphawule kanje emuva kokwethula isabelomali esihlongozwayo sikaR67.3 billion.Amaqembu aphikisayo okubalwa kuwona i-ActionSA, IFP, DA ekhale ngobunzima obuzothwalwa ngabantu kusukela ngoJulayi1.Athe kumanje zimapeketwane izinto eThekwini, yini lena ezobe ikhokhelwa abantu ngoba abazitholi izinsiza kumanje? UMBHISHOBHI Mandla Mkhize weBandla lamaZayoni ophinde abe ngusomabhizinisi uthi uzimisele ngokuthuthukisa abaculi.UMkhize lokhu ukusho ngemuva kokuba ethule izinhlelo zokusebenzisana nabaculi be-Afro Jazz, abangamawele i-SS Twins.Iqembu ama-SS Twins libunjwe nguSiyabonga benoSibongiseni Sithole abaneminyaka engu-42 yobudala. Eminyakeni emihlanu kuya kweyishumi ezayo aphokophelele ikusasa elingcono kwezomculo.Athe afisa ukudlondlobala kakhulu aziwe ezweni lonke aze afinyelele naphesheya kwezilwandle.Aveze ukuthi isitimela yisingili abahlose ngayo ukuveza ukubaluleka kothado phakathi kwabantu ababili.
NKOSIKHONA CELEBELIGXILE kakhulu ekulekeleleni umphakathi elikuwona ibandla, iCovenant Fellowship Church International (CFCI) elibungaza ukuhlanganisa kwalo iminyaka engu-30 laba khona.Lokhu kudalulwe umholi walo uMphostoli Collins Dhlomo obekade elandisa kabanzi ngemisebenzi yale libandla selokhu lasungulwa ngo-1994.Uveze ukuthi leli bandla laklama indima enkulu kakhulu ekulekeleleni abantu abaningi ababenesifo sesandulela ngculazi. Lokhu uthe bakwenza ngesikhathi besanda kuthenga isakhiwo sabo sokuqala esiseSikhawini, ngenani lika-R300 000.Uthe odokotela bebandla bangaleso sikhathi babesebenzisa sona ukulekelela ababehlaselwe yilesi sifo."Lokhu sakwenza ngoba sasibona ukuthi lesi sifo sihlasele ngempela siyefana nje netsunami,'' usho kanje. Uthi abagcinanga lapho izintandane zaziza kulesi sakhiwo zizolanda ukudla okwakuthengwa yibandla."Senza konke okusemandleni ethu ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izintandane siyazinakekela. Cishe ngaloyo nyaka zagcina zifinyelela ngisho ku-40 000 izintandane ezazondliwa yibandla,'' echaza.Ukhulume nangomtholampilo okudebuduze nakhona eSikhawini, iSiboniso Clinic athe wakhiwa yile libandla. "Sahlanganisa siyibandla ngemuva kokuba sikuqaphelile ukuthi sikhulu isidingo sawo kule ndawo,'' echaza.Namanje uthe kunemindeni abayondlayo abahambisa amagilosa kuyona nyanga zonke.Ukhulume nangendima eyaklanywa yibandla kwezemfundo nokuyinto athe lisayenza namanje.Uveze ukuthi bayambonga kakhulu uNkulunkulu ngokuhlanganisa iminyaka engu-30 kwale libandla.Ugcizelele ukuthi bekungelula nhlobo, zibe khona izinselelo maphakathi nendlela.Uqhakambise amandla kaNkulunkulu njengoba ethe uyakhumbula lisungulwa ibandla bekhonzela emzini womuntu.Uveze ukuthi wake wacabanga ukuliqamba ngokuthi yiZululand Covenant Church kodwa wabuye wathola izeluleko waguquka kuloyo mqondo.Njengamanje le libandla uthe linezakhiwo ezahlukene KwaZulu Natal nabazalwane abalinganiselwa ku-20 000.
KULINDELEKE ukuthi avele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMtshezi maduze ngecala lokubulawa kobengumsolwa, amaphoyisa amabili aboshwe ngoLwesibili.Kuthiwa umgilwa oneminyaka ewu-29 obengumsolwa ecaleni elithile kubikwe ukuthi udukile ngoLwesibili emva kokuthi ebonakale ethathwa amaphoyisa enkabeni yedolobha eMtshezi, okuthe ngokuhamba kwesikhathi kwatholakala isidumbu sakhe.Okhulumela uphiko olubhekelele ukuziphatha kwamaphoyisa, i-Independent Police Investigative Directorate (Ipid) uMnuz Phaladi Shuping, uthe abaphenyi abangaphansi kwalo luphiko banikele endaweni yesigameko lapho kutholwe khona isidumbu sikamsolwa baqhuba uphenyo lwabo olunzulu."Lo luphiko luthole umbiko othi amaphoyisa amathathu aseMtshezi abelandela umkhondo ngomsolwa okuthe ngokuhamba kwesikhathi watholwa ebulewe. Kuboshwe amabili, elisebenzela esiteshini saseWembezi nelisebenzela eMabhanoyini,” usho kanje.Uthe uphenyo lwe-Ipid luholele ekutheni kuhlonzwe abasolwa, zabakhalela.
ABELAPHI bendabuko bathi kunabaqashi abasanyathela amalungelo abasebenzi ngokungazemukeli izincwadi zokugula ezibuye nabasebenzi abelashwe ngokwesintu.Laba belaphi bathi kunabasebenzi abangaphezu kuka-30 abakhonjwe indlela ngesinye isitolo esidayisa izingubo esiseHammarsdale, sithi izincwadi zabelaphi bendabuko ezifike nabasebenzi ziwumgunyathi.UMnuz Mbongeni Dlamini wesikhungo esiqeqesha abelaphi bendabuka i-Abelaphi Bendabuko Traditional Practices Isithombe: SithunyelweUMnuz Mbongeni Dlamini wesikhungo esiqeqesha abelaphi ngenhlanzeko nokuthi kumele bayilandele kanjani imithetho yokwelapha ngokuhambisana nemigomo yoMnyango wezeMpilo kuleli, Abelaphi Bendabuko Traditional Practices, uthe lesi sitolo sikhombe indlela abasebenzi abangaphezu kuka-30 ngezincwadi abafika nazo ziphuma kubelaphi abehlukene phakathi kuka-2018 kuya ku-2023."Lesi sitolo sicindezela amalungelo abasebenzi. Kusho ukuthi siyabaphoqa ukuthi basebenzise odokotela basentshonalanga okushayisanayo noMthethosisekelo wakuleli. Kuleli sonto singabelaphi siphelezele abasebenzi abafake lolu daba kumxazululi wezindaba zabasebenzi iCommission for Conciliation, Mediation and Arbitration (CCMA)," kusho yena.Uthe lesi sikhungo sigunyaziwe ukuthi siqeqeshe abelaphi bese sibanikeza igunya lokuthi bakhiphe izincwadi, omunye wabelaphi okuthiwa izincwadi zakhe ziwumgunyathi ugunyazwe ilesi sikhungo ukuthi anikeze iziguli zakhe izincwadi.UMnuz Lonwabo Khakhana, owumgqungquzeli wenyunyana, iFree At Last Workers Union of South Africa (FALWUSA), okuyinyunyana emele laba basebenzi ecaleni eselize lafinyelela kwaCCMA, uthe ngokubona kwabo umqashi akayilandelanga imigomo ngoba uvele wabaxosha abasebenzi ekubeni zikhona ezinye izijeziso abengazikhipha uma ekholwa ukuthi izincwadi zabo ziwumgunyathi."Umqashi phambilini ubezemukela izincwadi ezifika nabasebenzi ababonwe ngabelaphi, futhi abakhokhele, gwiqiqi ngesikhathi seCovid-19, washintsha wathi lezi zincwadi ziwumgunyathi. "Umqashi usebenzise ithuba lokuthi iningi lalaba basebenzi abekho ngaphansi kwenyunyana futhi nemithetho kabayazi kanti ushaye phansi ngoba thina sibone ukuthi kunyathelwa amalungelo abasebenzi sase sisondela kubo ukuze sibalekele. ENingizimu Afrika umsebenzi uvumelekile ukuthi azikhethele ukuthi welashwa umelaphi wendabuko noma udokotela wasentshonalanga. Lokhu sikubona kuyindlela yokucindezela nokuphoqa abasebenzi ukuthi basebenzise odokotela basentshonalanga. "Lapha asikhulumi ngomelaphi oyedwa, eziningi izincwadi ngezomelaphi waseHammarsdale kodwa kukhona nezomelaphi waseFolweni. Njengoba siye kumxazululi sifuna umqashi acacise ukuthi ufinyelele kanjani ekutheni aze axoshe abasebenzi ngaphandle ngokubexwayisa?" kusho uKhakhana.Kusukela ngo-2014, udaba lokuthi abelaphi bendabuko bakhiphe izincwadi eziwubufakazi bokuthi babonwe umelaphi wendabuko lujwayele ukususa umsindo kuleli. Ngo-2014, uMnyango wezeMpilo wathi izincwadi zabelaphi zivumelekile kodwa wasungula umkhandlu wabelaphi, iTraditional Healer Council, njengoba kuyalela komthetho i-Traditional Health Practitioners Act 22 of 2007, ukuze abelaphi ababhalise kuwo kube yibo abavumelekile ukuthi bakhiphe izincwadi kodwa okwamanje kusanemicikilisho esashoda ekutheni lo mkhandlu usebenze kahle. Abelaphi balandela imigudu elawulwa ilo mnyango nezinhlangano zabelaphi ezibhaliswe kuwo ukuze bagunyazwe ukuthi bakhiphe izincwadi.
IBAGIXABEZE ngodilikajele abathathu umuntu ngamunye iNkantolo yesiFunda sasoLundi abesilisa ababili abalahlwe ngecala lokubulala umndeni wabathathu.Ngokusho kokhulumela iNational Prosecuting Authority (NPA) KwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Natasha Ramkisson-Kara, ababulali babesola oyedwa wabagilwa ngokuthakatha.Echaza ngesehlakalo, uNkk Ramkisson-Kara uthe ngoDisemba 2019 uNtethelelo Madi (21) no-Ayanda Khanyile bahlahlela ngobhushu owesilisa (68), umkakhe nomzukulu eMahlabathini."Itulo lokubulala balihlanganisa phambi kwabesilisa ababili kanti oyedwa wabo wayehlobene nabagilwa. UMadi wanikela kubo ukuyothatha ubhushu maqede bahamba noKhanyile baya emzini wabagilwa,” kuchaza uNkk Ramkisson.Uqhube wathi uMadi noKhanyile bangena kulo muzi ngefasitela bagenca owesilisa (68) ngobhushu. Uthe baphinde benza okufanayo kunkosikazi kamufi nomzukulu ngaphambi kokushaya bachithe."Emva kwesigameko babuye bagonyuluka koyedwa wabesilisa ababehlela itulo phambi kwabo, bamsabisa ngokuthi angayithi vu,” kusho uNkk Ramkisson-Kara.Udalule ukuthi emva kwezinsuku ezimbalwa abagilwa bebulewe, uphenyo lwamaphoyisa lwawaholela kulaba besilisa uMadi noKhanyile ababopha itulo lokubulala phambi kwabo."Benza izitatimende emaphoyiseni ezibheca uMadi noKhanyile ngecala,” usho kanje.UNkk Ramkisson-Kara uthe enkantolo uMshushisi woMbuso, uMnuz Mzwandile Baldwin Mtshali, wahola ubufakazi balona wesilisa uMadi noKhanyile abagonyuluka kuye, waphinde wabeka phambi kwenkantolo umbiko wokuhlolwa kwezidumbu."Bagwetshwe odilikajele abathathu umuntu ngamunye ngamacala amathathu okubulala. Izigwebo zabo bazozidonsa kanye kanye. Inkantolo iphinde yanquma ukuthi abakufanele ukuba nezibhamu,” kusho uNkk Ramkisson-Kara.Khonamanjalo, iNkantolo eNkulu yaseMgungundlovu igixabeze uDelisani Mkhize (54) ngodilikajele ababili neminyaka engu-10 ngaphezulu ngecala lokubulala unina nodadewabo ngoDisemba 2023.Ukugwetshwa kukaMkhize kuza emva kokuthi evele walivuma icala lokudubula abulale unina, uNkk Mathithi Mkhize, nodadewabo, uNksz Celiwe Mkhize, eMid-Illovo.Echaza ngesigameko, uNkk Ramkisson-Kara uthe nakuso umbulali wayesola abagilwa ngokumthakatha."Ngosuku lwesigameko uMkhize wathatha isibhamu sakhe wanikela ekhaya labagilwa, wabadubula ngaphambi kokuthi abanqume, waphosa amakhanda abo ethoyilethi lomgodi,” kusho uNkk Ramkisson.Echaza ngesigwebo, uthe unikwe odilikajele ababili ngecala lokubulala umuntu ngamunye bese kuba iminyaka eyishumi ngecala lesibhamu esingekho emthethweni.
AKHALELWE ngamasongo kaSigonyela amadoda okusolakala ukuthi ayimigulukudu ebikade isibhubhisile ekugqekezeni nasekujamiseni ama-signal ezimoto eThekwini.Lawa madoda kulindeleke ukuthi avele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini.Kubikwa ukuthi eyodwa yawo ibanjwe oqotsheni ngamaphoyisa ngesikhathi igqekeza imoto eSydenham, eThekwini ngoLwesihlanu.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant Colonel Nqobile Gwala uthe ngoLwesihlanu ngamadina amaphoyisa aqaphele imoto iHaval enombala obomvu ebikade isolisa.Uqhube wathi lemoto beyikade inezinombolo okungezona ezayo futhi beyipakwe eduzane kwendlu yesonto."Amaphoyisa abelokhu eyibeke iso lemoto. Kube sekwehla kuyona owesilisa oqonde emotweni iToyota Etios empunga ebikade ipakwe eduzane kweHaval. Le ndoda izame ukuvula lemoto isebenzisa ukhiye wokuzakhela,” kulandisa uLt Col Gwala.Uqhube wathi le ndoda ivulile yangena ngaphakathi emotweni iToyota kwathi ngesikhathi isakwaqazisa, isizama ukuyidumisa iyebe, yavele yathelekelwa amaphoyisa ayibamba.Kuvela ukuthi le ndoda ibe isiqhutshwa ibuyiselwa emotweni iHaval ebiyehle kuyona kwaficwa ngaphakathi amadoda amabili ezihlalele."Amaphoyisa ayiseshile iHaval. Lawa madoda atholakale nezinto eziningi ezisetshenziswayo uma kugqekezwa noma kujanyiswa i-signal yemoto. Abe eseboshwa womathathu abekwa icala lokuzama ukuduna imoto nelokutholakala nezinto zokuyigqekeza,” kusho uLt Col Gwala.
KUMANGALE abantu enkantolo ngesikhathi uMbuso udalula ukuthi owesifazane oboshiwe uvume amacala athweswe wona, okungelokuthumba nelokudayisa uJoshlin Smith (6).UNksz Lourencia Lombaard (32), ongumsolwa wesine ecaleni uvele izolo eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseVredenburg, eWestern Cape.Inkantolo ilihlehlisele uMsombuluko ngesonto elizayo icala ukuze umsolwa afake isicelo sebheyili futhi kuqhutshekwe nophenyo. UMbuso ukhombise zisuka wathi uzophikisana nokuthi uNksz Lombaard anikwe ibheyili.UMbuso uthe umsolwa wenze isitatimende lapho evuma khona amacala athweswe wona, wengeza ngokuthi okuningi kuzovela mhlazane sekubuyelwa enkantolo.Kukholakala ukuthi umsolwa ungomunye babantu abagcina ukubona uJoshlin ngelanga anyamalala ngalo ngoFebhuwari 19, nonyaka.Ungene enkantolo igcwele abesebenzi bayo, amaphoyisa, nabezindaba ebukeka edidekile. Ucele ukuba atolikelwe ngesiBhunu konke okukhulunywa enkantolo.Abanye abasolwa ecalemi bagqunywe ezitokisini, kubalwa unina kaJoshlin, uNksz Kelly Smith, isoka lakhe uMnuz Jacquen Appolis, noMnuz Steven van Rhyn.Bobathathu batshela inkantolo ukuthi bayayibonga ibheyili balunge begqunywe ezitokisini, icala labo lahlehliswa. Owayengumsolwa wesine, okuyisangoma, waboshwa wavela enkantolo kepha amacala ahoxiswa.Bekuthulekile ngaphandle kwenkantolo, bengekho ababhikishayo futhi kungahenqiwe ngocingo oluhlabayo njengoba kwenzeka ngesonto eledlule.Bekunedlanzana labantu ebeliqhinqe ngaphandle kwenkantolo ligqoke izikibha ezinobuso bukaJoshlin.Phambilini umphakathi waphuma inqina uthungatha uJoshlini kodwa wathola kuphela izimpahla ayekade ezigqokile.Kwafika ngisho uNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa, uMnuz Bheki Cele kubo kwaJoshlin eSaldanha Bay, ngemva kokunyamalala kwakhe.
UKUSABALALA kwenkulumo uNdunankulu kaZulu, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, ayezoyethula ephakamisa iSilo emcimbini wokukhunjulwa kweNgonyama uDinuzulu, kuveze obala ukuthi kungani owayephethe uhlelo uMnuz Siboniso Duma agxumisa okwenhlamvu wayabula umbhobho uButhelezi engakafiki engqikithini yephuzu lakhe.Enkulumweni eyayibhalwe phansi kaButhelezi kuvela ukuthi umsuka wendaba usekuphawuleni kukaNobhala we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Bheki Mtolo, eqoqweni likaWhatsapp elibizwa ngokuthi Indonsa Yesizwe Think Tank. USolwazi Musa Xulu, ongumhlaziyi wezamasiko nokunguye owengamele leli gunundu, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi uMtolo wabiza iSilo uMisuzulu kaZwelithini ngeSilo sase-Ballito embhalweni awufaka kuleli qoqo.Esikhathini esiphambilini, ngesikhathi kuqala umsindo wombango weSihlalo eNdlunkulu, kuke kwaba khona ukungcofa obekubhekiswe kwiNdlulamithi abangayemukeli njengeNgonyama beyibizwa ngeSilo saseBallito, esikhundleni sokuthi esikaZulu.Nokho uXulu, onguMfundisi waseLuthela, uthe uMtolo wabuye wachaza ukuthi kungani ebiza Indlulamithi ngeSilo saseBallito."Wabuye wachaza ukuthi iBallito iKwaDukuza, lapho Ilembe lalibusa khona. Yiqiniso lelo," kusho uXulu.Inkulumo ebhalwe phansi iveza ukuthi uMfu Buthelezi wayehlose ukukhalaza ngalesi senzo sikaMtolo, kodwa kangafika ndawo ephucwa umbhobho wokukhuluma uDuma, onguSihlalo qwe-ANC KwaZulu-Natal."Kufanele senzenjani thina bantu beSilo uma uMtolo ethuka iSilo eqoqweni leNdonsa? Kuleli qoqo uMtolo waphinde wahlasela uNdunankulu kaZulu, wathi 'inabo osikhotheni i-IFP, usikhotheni we-IFP uThulasizwe Buthelezi’. Amabutho kufanele enze njani uma kuthukwa umkhuzi wawo?" kusho inkulumo kaButhelezi eputshukile.UXulu uthe kujwayelekile ukuthi kube nemibono ehlukene kwiNdonsa athe igcwele izifundiswa, ababhishobhi, amakhosi, amalungu ePhalamende neziShayamthetho, abaholi bamaqembu ezombusazwe, abaNtwana basendlunkulu nabadidiyeli bamabutho.Uqhubeke ngokuthi uButhelezi naye wabhala kuyo iNdonsa ukuthi uzophendula inkulumo kaMtolo phambi kukaRamaphosa."UDuma naye ukhona kwiNdonsa. Ngicabanga ukuthi wayazi ukuthi uButhelezi uyaphi njengoba ayeseqalile efunda amagama abantu athi bayizitha zeSilo,” kusho uXulu.Ebuzwa ukuthi ikhona yini indlela anayo ukulawula okubhalwa kule nkundla okungaba yizinto ezisusa udweshu, uXulu uthe yonke into ebhalwa eqoqweni iyingxenye yentando yeningi.Kubuzwa okhulumela i-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Mafika Mndebele, ngokubizwa kweMbube ngeSilo saseBallito, ume kwelokuthi uButhelezi wayehlose ukuxova umcimbi wangoMgqibelo.Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kukaMtolo ayizange iphumelele njengoba ucingo lwakhe belukhala lungabanjwa futhi akazange awuphendule umyalezo awuthunyelelwe.NgoLwesithathu uMtolo usincome njengobuqhawe isenzo sikaDuma sokuyabula umbhobho, wathi wakhombisa ubunsizwa ngokuvimba enkulu inhlekelele eyayizokwenzeka.Usole uButhelezi ngokusebenzisa isikhundla sakhe ukulwa izimpi zepolitiki, wathi lo mkhuba wawenza nasesigodlweni eMachobeni ngesikhathi kunoMkhosi wamaGanu."Akwenzile eMachobeni uShenge, ubefuna ukukuphinda KwaCeza kanti akabhulanga, ikhona insizwa yakwaDuma, uMthombeni, uLwandle kaluwelwa luwelwa zinkonjane kuphela, insizwa engesabi nakusatshiswa. Wathi ngeke phambi kwami, yimi oshayela lolu hlelo, inhlekelele engenzeka lapha iyobuzwa kimi, wayivimba.”Kanjalo noNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Nomusa Dube-Ncube uthe uDuma wenza kahle ngokuphuca uButhelezi umbhobho.Uthe uDuma ubachazelile beyikhabhinethi lesifundazwe ukuthi wamphucelani uButhelezi umbhobho, wathi incazelo kaDuma ibanelisile."Siyameseka uDuma kulokhu akwenza. Ukube akawuthathanga umbhobho kwakuzothukwa abantu emcimbini kahulumeni. UDuma usitshele ukuthi uzokuya koshweleza eSilweni,” kusho uNdunankulu Dube-Ncube.Amakhosi athe afuna ukuba nomhlangano nekhabhinethi yaKwaZulu-Natal kanti ake ahlangana esiShayamthetho esidala ngoLwesithathu.USihlalo wendlu yobuholi bomdabu KwaZulu-Natal, Inkosi Sifiso Shinga, uthe bafuna ukuthi uDuma aqale kubo ngaphambi kokuyoshweleza eSilweni.UShinga uthe uDuma wadelela iSilo ngokuphuca uButhelezi umbhobho kanti kuwumkhuba owaziwayo ukuthi iSilo sisukunyiswa undunankulu waso.Omele iSilo endlini yobuholi bomdabu, uMntwana uSimphiwe Zulu, uthe iSilo nendlunkulu bakhathazekile ngalesi simo kanti banethemba lokuthi lolu daba luzoxazululwa ngokushesha.
UGWETSHWE udilikajele neminyaka engu-18 owesilisa (52) olahlwe ngecala lokuthumba nokudlwengula owesifazane oneminyaka engu-55. Kuthiwa lo wesilisa wagila le mikhuba ngoJulayi 25, 2022 kanti wayevele enikwe incwadi eyisivimbelo senkantolo sokuthi angasondeli kulo wesifazane. Ngokwesitatimende sophiko lwezokushushisa iNPA, laba bobabili babethandana ngo-2019, kwathi ngo-Agasti 2021 owesifazane wanquma ukumala lo wesilisa ekhala ngokuhlukunyezwa. NgoJulayi 2022 kuthiwa lo wesilisa wahlasela umgilwa, wamklinya, wamdonsela endlini eseduze lapho afike amshayela khona, wamgqema ngesando, wamgwaza wabe esemdlwengula elokhu ehleli naye ekwenza lokhu ephindelela izinsuku ezingu-10. Lo wesifazane waphunyuka wabaleka ngesikhathi kukhona owayevakashele lo wesilisa, wayobikela umndeni wakhe ngalesi sigameko. Uthe esebabikele abomndeni babe sebemthatha bemyisa esikhungweni esilekela abahlukumezekile iThuthuzela Care Centre eseMlaza. Okhulumela uphiko lwezokushushiswa komphakathi KwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Natasha Ramkisson-Kara, uthe bayasemukela isigwebo esinikwe lo wesilisa. "Izigwebo ezifana nalezi zitshengisa amandla ophiko lwezokushushiswa komphakathi lokulwela ubulungiswa. Siyawuncoma umsebenzi owenziwe abashushisi kanye namaphoyisa ophiko lwe-SAPS,” kusho yena.Lo mlisa ugwetshwe udilikajele ngokudlwengula, iminyaka emihlanu ngokuthumba, iminyaka engu-10 ngokushaya nemithathu ngokuphula incwadi yesivimbelo senkantolo.
USOMLOMO wePhalamende uNkk Nosiviwe Mapisa-Nqakula, uthi akayi phansi engandlalelwe kwabafuna ukumgaxa ozankosi ngezinsolo zenkohlakalo.Kusabalale imibiko yokuthi uzovela enkantolo emuva kokuthi abaphenyi bepekequle umuzi wakhe. Uhlabe ikhefu elikhethekile emuva kokuqonga kwalezi zindaba. Ibalelwa ku-R4 million imali okuthiwa wanikwa yona egwazelwa.UNkk Mapisa-Nqakula ubhekene nezinsolo ezibucayi zokugwazelwa ngezigidi okuthiwa wayezinikwa ngesikhathi esewungqongqoshe. Kuthiwa usomabhizinisi uthi wayehlala egqigqa kuNkk Mapisa-Nqakula eyocubuza amagabade ngamasaka emali.Ubelokhu ezihlangula ethi umsulwa akaze enze inkohlakalo futhi ethi usola ukuthi kukhona abazama ukungcolisa igama lakhe.UNkk Mapisa-Nqakula ufake isicelo senkantolo esiphuthumayo ethi akuvinjwe ukuboshwa kwakhe. Emaphepheni uveza nokuthi ucela ukunikwa idokodo lophenyo nezitatimende zofakazi abone kahle konke.Iphalamende likhiphe isitatimende lichitha imibiko yokuboshwa kukaNkk Mapisa-Nqakula lithi usekhaya nomndeni wakhe uyalusebenza udaba.Lishona nje ayicaci ekaNkk Mapisa-Nqakula kodwa abeSABC bebenkanise esangweni lomuzi wakhe. Bekubonakala abaqaphi bakhe beyaluza bephuma bengena khona. Kubonakale nendoda yomlungu iphuma nepotimende yashaya imoto yachitha.Iqembu eliphikisayo ePhalamende iDA ithe awukho umthetho ogunyaza ukuthi uSomlomo athathe ikhefu elikhethekile. I-DA ithe ifuna ukufaka isicelo sokungabethembi ubuholi bukaSomlomo bese iyamketula.I-ANC nayo ike yakhipha isitatimende ithi iyazi ngodaba lukaSomlomo futhi iyasemukela isinqumo sakhe sokushenxa esikhundleni. Ithe yona ilinde ukuthi abomthetho bathini bese iqhubeka nodaba.
KUBE yisimo esingajwayelekile ngesikhathi isisebenzi sasesontweni sithola izidumbu ezintathu zabefundisi zidindilizile.Umbiko othunyelwe abeNPA uveza ukuthi ngomhlaka 12 kwephezulu isisebenzi saseCaptic Orthodox Church sibingelelwe yigazi nezidumbu sifika kule ndawo.Ngesikhathi kuphenywa isimo sale ndawo, kutholakale ukuthi abefundisi abathathu okunguTakla Elsmwaeili Ayoub Attia Mossoud Mouss, Marcos Shawkat Nasry Morid Wanas Mina noMarcos Mofed Tawfek Isaac Youstos bagwazwe bafa.Kuthiwa bonke abasolwa nabagilwa bebehlala kulo leli sonto."Isisebenzi sifike sazithela kulezi zidumbu sase sibikela umdikoni webandla okunguyena oshayele amaphoyisa. Amaphoyisa apheke ngemibuzo abasolwa ababili uSaeed Basonda (37) oyiMonk nomfundisi uSamuel Avamarkos (47) abagcine bekhalelwa ngamasongo kasiGonyela,” kusho uLumka Mahanjana okhulumela iNPA eGauteng.Laba basolwa bavele phambi kweMantshi yaseCullinan ngamacala amathathu okubulala. ABHOKA ayakhahlela amaqembu aphikisayo ePhalamende ngekhefu elithathwe wuSomlomo wePhalamende onukelwa yijele ngezinsolo zokukhwabanisa nokushushumbisa imali.Iyaqonga ingcindezi yokuthi uNkk Nosiviwe Mapisa-Nqakula ehle esikhundleni njengoba i-DA isiphakamise ukuthi akashiye emuva kokuba kugasele uphiko lwezokushushisa emzini wakhe oseBruma eGoli, luqoqa ubufakazi ngezinsolo abhekene nazo.Ngemuva kokuhlaselwa ngabaphenyi, kube sekuvela amahlebezi okuthi isilungisiwe nencwadi egunyaza ukuboshwa kwakhe. NgoLwesine ntambama, kuvele umbiko wokuthi uhoxile ohambweni lwethimba lasephalamende elibheke eGeneva eSwitzerland. Kubikwa ukuthi incwadi yokuthatha ikhefu lezinsukwana emsebenzini ukuze akwazi ukubhekana nodaba lwamacala anukwa ngawo.Kuse ngoLwesihlanu kunamahlebezi wokuthi uzinikele emaphoyiseni asePitoli, lokhu kulandela ukubonakala kwezimoto ezimhlophe zimi esangweni lakwakhe ekuseni okuthiwa bezizomlanda.Kuthe kusabhekwe lokho, kulindelwe nokuthi avele phambi kwenkantolo yeMantshi ePitoli, wadedela abammeli bakhe abaphuthume enkantolo enkulu yakuleli bayofuna isivimbelo sokuboshwa.Ngokwamaphepha afakwe enkantolo, uMapisa-Nqakula ufake isicelo esiphuthumayo esibheke kwabahlanu ababaluliwe okubalwa ungqongqoshe wamaphoyisa, umphathi wezokushushisa nabanye. Le ncwadi iveza nokuthi uMapisa-Nqakula ufuna nokubona idokodo lamacala abekwa wona.Kuqhubeka lokhu-nje iDA ithi iphini likasomlomo wephalamende lisamukele isicelo sabo sevoti lokungabethembi ubuholi bukasomlomo. USiviwe Gwarube uthe: "Akukho lokhu okwenziwe wusomlomo ngokuthatha ikhefu. Ngokomthetho wephalamende umuntu uthatha ikhefu ngokuvunyelwa yindlu yonke ngevoti.”UGwarube uthe usomlomo bekumele asule esikhundleni ngoba isikhundla sakhe asifanelwe wukuphathwa wumuntu ongazithola esehlazweni elifana naleli.Uthi banethemba lokuthi isicelo sabo sevoti lokungabethembi ubuholi bakhe, sizophumelela.
UMGUBHO wosuku lwamalungelo abantu obekukhunjulwa kulona abangu-69, ababulawa ngumbuso wobandlululo esibhicongweni sango-1960 eSharpeville eGoli, luphenduke inkundla yokugxeka uhulumeni kaMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, okwenziwe abaholi abahlukene bamaqembu ezombusazwe.Laba baholi bebekhala ngokuthi kuze kwadingeka ukuthi bangene ngenkani emalibeni okungcwatshwe kuwona lezi zinkumbi ezafa embhikishweni wokulwa nokuphathwa kwamapasi ngoMashi 21, 1960. Abaholi okubalwa owePAC uMnuz Mzwanele Nyhontso, owe-Action SA uMnuz Herman Mashaba, oweBuild One South Africa uMnuz Mmusi Maimane, uMnuz Ace Magashule we-African Congress for Transformation (ACT), owe-Azapo uMnuz Nelvis Qekema, babhikishe ngaphandle kwenkundla iGeorge Thabe obekubanjwe kuyona lo mgubho.Bagxeke uhulumeni ngokufaka ubukhazikhazi okubalwa okhaphethi ababomvu ugubha lo lusuku ekubeni ngabe ulisebenzisela ukukhumbula labo abasala enkundleni. Laba baholi bathe kudingeke ukuthi baze bangene ngenkani emalibeni ngoba akuwona awe-ANC kodwa iPAC eyaqhamuka nalo lusuku."Safelwa izishoshovu ngaloluya suku. Asilugubhi lo lusuku kodwa sisuke sikhumbula abasishiya, belwela umzabalazo. Kuyichilo okwenziwa nguhulumeni ngoba kuza umengameli wezwe bese kufakwa okhaphethi ababovu, siphinde sivinjwe ukungena,” kusho uNyhontso.Uthe bameme amaqembu anomqondo ofana nowabo ukuzogubha lolu suku.UQekema ugxeke ukubizwa kwalo lusuku ngolwamalungelo ekubeni kumele kuthiwe usuku lwaseSharpeville."Sizohlangana okhethweni sikhiphe i-ANC emandleni singamaqembu ahlukene. Sifuna lo lusuku lubuyele kwiSharpeville ngoba asazi lwashintshelwani.” Nabanye abaholi bahambe emazwini kaQekema okuthi kumele kubuyelwe ekutheni usuku lwaseSharpeville.UMENGAMELI Cyril Ramaphosa ebeka izimbali esikhumbuzweni sabashona esibhicongweni saseSharpeville Isithombe:Kopano Tlape/GCISEthula inkulumo yosuku uRamaphosa ugxeke umbuso wobandlululo wathi waletha inhlupheko yeminyaka kubantu bakuleli ikakhulu kwabamnyama.Uthe kuningi osekwenziwe nguhulumeni ukubakhipha ebubheni."Abantu sebenezindlu, banogesi, amanzi, bathola isibonelelo, bafunda mahhala nokunye. Inkinga yokucishwa kukagesi, simatasa nayo, sizoqeda ngayo.”Uthe abantwana abavela emindenini ehlwempu sebeyasiphothula isikole, baze bayofunda emanyuvesi."Sesikwaze ukubuyisa umhlaba ongama-hektha angu-4 million kubantu ababephucwe lo mhlaba. Sesikwaze ukubuyisa omunye ongu-5 million wama-hektha kwabasebenza kanjalo nabahlala emapulazini.” Uveze ukuthi izingane zithola izibonelelo, ziyadla ezikoleni mahhala wathi abangatohozi nabo bathola isibonelelo."Yize sisephezulu isibalo sabangasebenzi kuleli, kodwa sesikwazile ukunyusa izinga labasebenzayo cishe ngohhafu eminyakeni engu-30 kuleli. Siyaqhubeka nezinhlelo zokuqasha abangasebenzi kuleli.” Uthe iningi labesifazane lithola amathuba njengoba u-60% wabasebenzi bahulumeni abesimame.UMENGAMELI Cyril Ramaphosa noNdunankulu waseGauteng uMnuz Panyaza Lesufi kukhunjulwa abantu abashona eSharpeville ngo-1960 Isithombe: Kopano Tlape/GCISUveze ukuthi kumele kuqiniswe izinhlelo zokugcina abafundi besezikoleni baze baphothule u-matric.Kube nokuphazamiseka kwenkulumo kaRamaphosa ngesikhathi ama-generator ethatha isikhathi eside ukudonsa, okwenze abanye abebethamele lo mgubho bacule amaculo ahlukene okweseka i-ANC.Khonamanjalo uNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal uNkk Nomusa Dube-Ncube, uhloniphe ababhubha kulesi sibhicongo wathi bangamaqhawe alwa ukuze abantu bakhululeke.Unxuse abantu bakuleli ukuthi babukele kula maqhawe wathi kumele kuliwe nesihlava sokubulawa kwabesifazane.

SIBHUNTSHILE isigcawu sokuquliswa kweJaji Tshifhiwa Maumela elaliphethe icala lokufa kukaSenzo Meyiwa, elingeniswe esibhedlela lixinwe wukugula.UMaumela waba yijaji lokuqala ukunikwa icala lokufa kukaMeyiwa kodwa kuthe sekuphakathi wamiswa emsebenzini kwafakwa iJaji Ratha Mokgoatlheng. UMaumela nakuba wayebike ukugula kodwa kwavela ukuthi umisiwe uzoya esigcawini.IJaji uMaumela limangalelwe wuMengameli wamaJaji eGauteng iJaji Dunstan Mlambo, elikhala ngokuthi wehlulwa wumsebenzi, uthatha isikhathi ukukhipha izinqumo. UMlambo kade eseqalile ukwethula udaba echaza ngokumangalela uMaumela.UMaumela bekufanele avele okwesibili esigcawini sokumshushisa izolo eGoli kodwa kwavela ukuthi ungeniswe esibhedlela engemuhle kahle.USihlalo wesigcawu Ijaji Chris Jafta odla umhlalaphansi, ungene esexolisa ngokuthi kungaqalwa ngesikhathi wathi kukhona osekuqhamukile okuphazamisayo." Siyaxolisa ngokuthi singaqali ngesikhathi ngoba bekufanele siqale ngo-9 kodwa kunodaba oluvelile oludale ukuthi singaqali ngesikhathi,’’ kusho uJafta ophose izintambo kumholi wobufakazi nakummeli kaMaumela.Ummeli kaMaumela u-Advocate Ghandi Badela, uchaze ngodaba lwekhasimende lakhe." Kunjengoba sekuchaziwe impela kunesimo esingaphezu kwamandla esiphoqa ukuthi senze ngenye indlela. IJaji uMaumela lingeniswe esibhedlela, manje besikhuleka ukuthi udaba luhlehle kuze kube uyelulama. Siphakamisa uMeyi 27 njengosuku esiyobuya ngalo ngokuvumelana nabanye ozakwethu la,’’ kusho uBadela.IJaji uJafta lithe lolo suku olokubambisa ngoba akwaziwa ukuthi isimo sizoba njani kodwa kuyobuzwa ngalo kubonakale ukuthi kumiswa kanjani.NgoMsombuluko okuqale ngawo isigcawu, ummangali uMlambo ubebeka izinto ngembaba engahlonizi ngokungenami kwakhe ngoMaumela. UMlambo uthe uMaumela ugodla izinqumo isikhathi eside, uma emshayela izingcingo angamtholi futhi angabuyeli kuye.Uthe icala lokufa kukaMeyiwa kwakungafanele lihlalelwe wuMaumela kodwa wazenzela ngokuthanda kwakhe." Wayenikwe umyalelo wokuthi alisebenze icala nokuyothi uma selilungele ukungena enkantolo bese elibuyisa kodwa wavele wayongena nalo enkantolo. Kwase kuvele kwenzekile kwakunzima ukumephuca lona,’’ kusho uMlambo.
LITHINTE amalakazane iJaji Ratha Mokgoatlheng, eliqula icala lokubulawa kukaSenzo Meyiwa, ngamagama eliwashilo lisola abameli abamnyama ngobuhlathi.Inhlangano yabameli abamnyama iBlack Lawyers Association (BLA), ithe ifuna umhlangano neNhloko yamaJaji eGauteng, uJaji Dunstan Mlambo.IJaji belihlalele udaba ngoLwesithathu lapho elikhulume khona amagama okuthiwa awanambitheki kubameli abamnyama. Inhlangano yabameli ikholwa wukuthi ijaji likhulume leqisa laze lasho okungafanele.IJaji licasulwe wukungafiki kommeli u-Advocate Thulani Mngomezulu enkantolo okuthiwa ubike kumsizi weJaji nakozakwabo ukuthi akezi. IJaji lidinwe wukuthi uMngomzeulu akalithintanga lona ngqo alazise ngokulova kwalo.UMeyiwa owayeyisilomo se-Orlando Pirates neBafana Bafana, wadutshulwa wabulawa ekubo kwentombi yakhe uKelly Khumalo eVosloorus, eGauteng ngo-2014.Icala liyaqulwa eNkantolo eNkulu ePitoli kanti bahlanu abalisa abasebhokisini okuthiwa yibona abacoboshisa uMeyiwa.IJaji belibonakala ukuthi licikekile ngalo ludaba."Yiyona ndlela abameli abamnyama abasebenza ngayo le, mhlambe angithi abanye babo? Kungathi engangibikelanga mina? Ngabe yiyona ndlela ummeli oqeqesheke kahle okumele enze ngayo le?"Ngize ngithola umyalezo kumsizi wami kodwa ummeli akalifoneli ijaji futhi kulindeleke ukuthi lona lisineke lijabule ngoba ummeli omnyama,’’ kusho iJaji lilinganisa ukuhleka.UMengameli weBLA uMnuz Nkosana Mvundlela, uthe abeneme ngendlela iJaji elikhulume ngayo futhi kufanele lulungiswe lo ludaba ngokushesha."Kungaba yishwa ukuthi unemibono enjalo, kungabe impela kuthunaza umsebenzi wabo bonke abameli kuleli. "Kungaba kubi ukuthi iJaji elihlonishwa njengaleli, licabange ukuthi uzakwethu wenze lokhu okuthiwa ukwenzile ngoba emnyama,’’ kusho uMvundlela.IJaji Mokgoatlheng aliqali ukuba sematheni ngokuphawula kwalo enkantolo. Phambilini lake lathathana no-Advocate Zandile Mshololo kodwa naye wama ekutheni kufanele iJaji limhloniphe ngoba uwummeli.Kulindeleke ukuthi icala lokufa kukaMeyiwa libuyele enkantolo namuhla lapho kuzoqhubeka khona ubufakazi.
UFUNA ubulungiswa umndeni wowesifazane oyinkosazana ebandleni lamaNazaretha aseBuhleni ovulele ilungu elaziwayo kuleli bandla icala lokudlwengula.Umsolwa (igama lakhe eligodliwe), okuthiwa uwumacaphuna kusale, kuvele ukuthi wayenga umgilwa ona-18 waseMlaza ngokuthi abahlangane enkabeni yedolobha iTheku ngaphambi kokuthi amcele ukuthi bayodla kwesinye sezitolo zokudlela esiseMorningside.Unina kamgilwa elandisa Isolezwe, uthe indodakazi yakhe ebiseyintombi nto ngaphambi kwalesi sigameko, iyikholwa kuleli bandla kanti ithi umsolwa imbone emhlanganweni wasentabeni iKhenana wacela inamba yagcina ngokumnika."Indodakazi yathi ijwayele ukumbona umsolwa uma kunemihlangano emikhulu uma kuzofika inkosi yamaNazaretha uNyazilwezulu njengoba evamise ukubonakala ngaphambili ehamba ngesithuthuthu egudluza abantu phambi kwezimoto zenkosi. Uthe wacela inamba yocingo wagcina ngokumnika, kwathi ngoMsombuluko wamfonela ecela behlangane eThekwini,” usho kanje.Uthe ngenxa yokuthi indodakazi yakhe izihlalela ekhaya njengoba iqede u-matric nyakenye, ngesikhathi eyicela imazisile ukuthi ayinayo imali futhi idolobha ayilazi kahle, wathembisa ukuyifakela u- R100 nge-e-wallet ukuze igibele. Uveze ukuthi umsolwa ulethwe yi-uber, wanxenxa umgilwa ukuthi agibele emotweni eyomkhombisa enye yezindawo zokudlela, eMorningside."Ngesikhathi befika endaweni yokuphumula, ithe uyibambe ngesandla bangena egunjini elithile lokulala wakhiya umnyango, wathatha ukhiye wangena nawo endaweni yokugezela wabuya esebhince ithawula. Emva kwalokho ithe uyiphoqe ukuthi ikhumule waqala wayidlwengula, kuthe eseqedile waphuma wayishiya lapho,” usho kanje.Uthe wasizwa owesifazane ohlanza le ndawo emva kokumlandisa ngokwenzekile, wamkhombisa amatekisi abheke erenki, waqonda esibhedlela i-Prince Mshiyeni Memorial lapho ehlolwe khona.Uthe okubaphatha kabi wukuthi umsolwa akakaboshwa kunalokho usalokhu ebafonela ebancenga ethi akukhulunywe eveza ukuthi bebethandana nomgilwa futhi ubezomkhetha ebandleni. Uveze ukuthi selokhu bavula icala amaphoyisa awakaze axhumane nabo, okubenza bathuke njengoba kubatshazwa ubunjinga kumsolwa.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uLieutenant Colonel Nqobile Gwala, uthe kubikwe icala lokudlwengula emaphoyiseni aseMlaza."Lokhu kulandela isigameko sokudlwengulwa kwentombazane ena-18 okusolakala ukuthi idlwengulwe umsolwa owaziyo ngoLwesibili,” kusho uLieutenant Colonel Gwala.
ISIFO sofuba sisalokhu sihamba phambili ngokubulala abantu abaningi kuleli nasemhlabeniLokhu kushiwo uSolwazi Sizulu Moyo, woMkhandlu owenza ucwaningo lwesayensi ethinta abantu, iHuman Science Research Council (HSRC), ngasikhathi kunesigcawu ebesiyizolo sokuchaza ngebanga eselihanjwe iNingizimu Afrika ukuze iqede isifo sofuba ngo-2030.USolwazi Moyo, uthe imiphumela yango 2022 yocwaningo olubheka ukwelashwa kwalesi sifo nezinga lokusabalala kwaso ekhishwe nyakenye ikhomba ukuthi bangu-54 000 abantu ababulawa isifo sofuba ngonyaka kuleli, okusho ukuthi emizuzwini eyishumi kunomuntu obulawa isifo sofuba."ENingizimu Afrika isibalo sabantu abaneHIV abahaqwa iTB siphezulu. Isifo sofuba neHIV kusondelene yize iTB ihlasela nabantu abangenayo iHIV.USolwazi Violet Chihota wesikhungo i-Aurum Institute, uthe umbiko wango-2022, uveza ukuthi ukhona umehluko uma kubhekwa ukuthi eNingizimu Afrika ukusabalala kwaleli gciwane kwehle ngo-11% ngo-2015 ngemuva kokuthi uhulumeni ehlanganise amasu okulwa neTB neHIV ngo-2014. Kusukela lapho izinga lokusabalala kwaso lilokhu lehla. "Ngokubona kwethu lokhu kudalwa ukuthi iningi labantu abaneHIV lidla imishanguzo,” kusho uSolwazi Moyo.UDkt Nkhensani Nkwashu, womkhandlu wengculazi, iSA National Aids Council (SANAC), uthe amasu ka-2023 kuya ku-2028 kumele asize iNingizimu Afrika ukuze ukwamukelwa kwabantu abahaqwe iHIV neTB kusuke ku-85% wango-2022, kuye ku-95%, kwehle isibalo sabahaqwe isifo sofuba sisuke ku-56% wango-2022 siye ku-36%, ukwelashwa ngempumelelo kwalesi sifo kusuke ku-78% wango-2022 kuye ku-90%."Okunye okungamele sikukhohlwe ukuthi kunezimo ezithile ezenza isimo sibe nzima okubalwa ububha, ukushoda kokudla okunempilo okumele kudliwe ngabantu abahaqekile. Ukwelashwa kwalesi sifo kungaba nemiphumela emihle kakhulu uma umphakathi ungabamba iqhaza elibonakalayo ezinhlelweni zokulwa naleli gciwane," kusho uSolwazi Nkwashu. USolwazi Moyo, uthe zisekhona izinto eziyizingqinamba ekwelashweni kwalesi sifo, njengokuthi kusenzima ukuhlonzwa kwezingane ezihaqwe yileli gciwane nokuthi imishanguzo emisha esetshenziswa isikhathi esifishane ehlolwayo ayizilungele izingane.
UTHEMBELE emaphoyiseni ngokubanjwa kwabasolwa umndeni wesitshudeni saseDurban University of Technology, ophikweni lwayo oluseMgungundlovu, okuthiwa sidutshulwe abebebamba inkunzi eduze kwendawo ehlala izitshudeni zale nyuvesi, eScottsville, entathakusa ngeSonto.USinenhlanhla Dlamini (21) obenza unyaka wesibili kwiBusiness Information Management ,kuthiwa ushonele endaweni yesigameko emva kokuhlaselwa abasolwa abangaziwa babaphuca amafoni.Udadewabo kaSinenhlanhla, uNksz Mandisa Dlamini elandisa Isolezwe, uthe umufi ubehamba neqeqebana lezitshudeni bephuma emcimbini i- All Varsity Picnic obusenkundleni yezemidlalo iHarry Gwala, ngesikhathi kuma imoto ebinesigejana sabelisa, bakhonjwa ngesibhamu."Kuthiwa ngesikhathi imoto ima, kwehle abasolwa babakhomba ngesibhamu babaphuca amafoni nemali abebeyiphethe. KUZOGAYWA amaphepha okuvota angu-90 million njengoba kubhekwe okhethweni lukazwelonke ngoMeyi 29. Umsebenzi wokugaya la maphepha uqala ngenyanga ezayo uze uphothulwe ngoMeyi.Lokhu kuvezwe yiPhini lesikhulu esiphezulu sekhomishini eyengamele ukhetho kuleli i-Independent Electoral Commission (IEC), uMnuz Masego Sheburi, ngesikhathi le khomishini ivele ngaphambi kwekomiti lasePhalamende.USheburi uthe njengoba amaphepha okuvota ezobe emathathu kulolu khetho, bazogaya u-30 million iphepha ngalinye okwenza ukuthi esewonke abe ngu-90 million. Kuzobe kungokokuqala okhethweni ukuthi abangenele ukhetho ngokuzimela babe yingxenye yalo."Sizogaya la maphepha ezikhungweni eziyisithupha kuleli. Asifuni ukuthi wonke umsebenzi wenziwe yinkampani eyodwa ngoba mkhulu kakhulu umsebenzi wokugaya amaphepha okuvota angu-90 million. Konke sekumi ngomumo mayelana nokugaywa kwalawa maphepha okuvota.”Uthe ngo-Ephreli 4 kuzokwenziwa uhlelo lokutomula iqembu elizobe liphezulu ephepheni lokuvota."Sizotomula leli qembu elizobe liphezulu ephepheni lokuvota. Sizobe sesitomula nokuthi amanye amaqembu azoma kanjani kuleli phepha.” Uthe angu-370 amaqembu abhalisele ukhetho.Uveze nokuthi ngoLwesihlanu bazokwazisa amaqembu ngabantu azobajuba abavela ohlwini lwamanye amaqembu."Sizonika amaqembu ithuba lokuthi afake elinye igama lomuntu ozongena esikhaleni salowo ozobe evela ohlwini lwelinye iqembu. Uma kungukuthi amaqembu awalisusi leli gama, kusho ukuthi uzovela ohlwini lwamaqembu ahlukene uma sekuvotwa kodwa uma sekwabiwa izihlalo, uzothola esisodwa hhayi eziningi. Sifuna ukuxwayisa amaqembu ukuthi akulona ithuba lokuthi ashintshe lonke uhlu alulethile kodwa ukushintsha afake elinye igama uma kungukuthi igama livela kolunye uhlu.” UMnuz Mawethu Mosery wekhomishini, uthe abangenele ukhetho ngokuzimela bazoba sohlwini olufanayo namaqembu."Ngeke kube nokuhlukana kube nabangenela ukhetho ngokuzimela bodwa kanjalo namaqembu. Bonke bazobe behlangene endaweni eyodwa, ephepheni lokuvota,” kusho uMosery. USheburi uveze nokuthi ngesonto elizayo uMashi 26 noMashi 27, bazokhipha uhlu lwabantu amaqembu afolosa ngabo."Ngo-Ephreli 10, ikhomishini izoshicilela uhlu lokugcina lwabazongenela ukhetho. Ilapho ke okuzobe sekucaca ukuthi bangaki abazongenela ukhetho ngokuzimela kanjalo namaqembu azobanga amavoti,” kusho uSheburi. Uveze nokuthi bakulindele ukuthi abazokhala ngaphansi okhethweni, bazozithethelela ngokuthi ukhetho belungakhululekile."Njengoba sanda isibalo samaqembu angenela ukhetho kodwa kugcina ngokuthi kukhethwe ambalwa azoya ePhalamende naseziShayamthetho. Okhethweni lwango-1999 angu-26 amaqembu angenela ukhetho. Njalo uma kunokhetho, siyanda isibalo samaqembu angenela ukhetho kodwa ambalwa avotelwayo. Manje angu-370 abhalisele ukhetho kodwa uthola ukuthi angu-13 avotelwayo, okwenza abasuke bekhale ngaphansi bese bekhala ngokuthi ukhetho belungakhululekile.” Ubalule nokuthi abasuke bemele amaqembu ezikhungweni zokuvota basheshe bahambe uma bebona ukuthi izinto azihambi kahle.
UTHATHWE amaphoyisa ukuyohlonywa ngemibuzo umakhelwane, kutholwa isidumbu somfundi owaduka ngeSonto, silaxazwe ehlathini eliphesheya kwakubo eNewhaven, eMkhomazi ngoMsombuluko.Isidumbu sikaLusa Nkomo (10) obefunda u-Grade 4 esikoleni iDrift Primary eMkhomazi, kuthiwa sitholwe umelusi sidindilize ehlathini sinezibazi zokuklinywa, simbozwe ngengubo abeyigqokile eceleni kwaso kukhona amakhondomu abesesebenzile.Kuthiwa ubegcine ukubonakala ehambisana nomakhelwane oyiNdiya oyisiqashi endaweni, ogcine eboshwe amaphoyisa ngoMsombuluko ntambama.UNksz Zandile Mzwendaba osekomitini lomphakathi, osondelene kakhulu nomndeni wakwaNkomo, uthe ingane bagcina ukuyibona iphuma esontweni, umakhelwane wacela ukuyithuma okuthile esitolo."Ngokulandisa kwengane eyayihamba naye (umgilwa), emva kokuthi ebuye esitolo lapho ayethunywe khona waveza ukuthi umalume (umakhelwane) umcele ukuthi amphelezele bayocinga inja yakhe komunye umuzi ongaphesheya lapho ayezwe ukuthi ikhona.Bagcina ukubonakala behamba naye, kanti umsolwa wangena kamfowabo wahlala isikhashana ingane imlinde ngaphandle, washeshe waphuma behamba belandelana kwaba ukugcina ukubonakala kwayo,” usho kanje.Uthe ngesikhathi bethungatha bengayitholi, bathole ukuthi igcine ukubonakala nalo makhelwane okuthe uma befuna ukuzobheka lapho ehlala khona njengoba eqashe sakugada umuzi owumakhelwane nakamgilwa umnikazi ongahlali kuwona, kuthiwa uvulele izinja okwenze kwangaba lula ukungena kuwo.Kuthiwa emva kokutholakala kwesidumbu sikaLusa sidindilize ehlathini, amalungu omphakathi abewotha ubomvu anikela lapho kuhlala khona umakhelwane acekela phansi impahla yakhe ayikhiphela emnyango ayokhela ngomlilo. Kuthiwa kusize ukufika kwamaphoyisa njengoba kuyiwona amthathe amfaka evenini, waphepha olakeni lomphakathi.Uninomncane kaLusa uNksz Dumisile Nkomo, uthe bafe olwembiza njengoba bengazi ukuthi bazothathani bahlanganise nani."Isimo lapha ekhaya sibi njengoba kwehla lesi sehlo ebesingalindelwe, kuduma amakhanda kwazise unina kaLusa kuphela obamba amatoho ekhaya,” kubalisa yena.UMphathiswa wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi esifundazweni uNkk Nonhlanhla Khoza usigxekile lesi senzo."Ukutholakala kwesidumbu sengane kuboshwe umakhelwane, kwenza ukuthi sizibuze imibuzo eminingi. Silindele ukuthi balekelele ekugadweni kwezingane uma abazali bengekho,” usho kanje.Ukhuthaze amalungu omphakathi ukuthi noma lesi simo sibuhlungu kodwa angazijeziseli kumsolwa.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uLieutenent Colonel Nqobile Gwala, uthe amaphoyisa asaqoqa ubufakazi ngalolu daba, kanti aphenya icala lokudlwengula nokubulala.

Zinhlanu izingane anazo kula makhosikazi, zineminyaka ephakathi kowodwa nengu-16.UGwabini uneziqu ze-Information Technology (IT) azithola eDurban University of Technology (DUT).Uthe emacaleni abekwa wona umbuso, uyawaphika wonke ngoba icala abekwe lona lintekenteke.Ngaphambi kokufundwa kwesitatimende sikaGwabini, kufundwe esikamsolwa wesihlanu uMnuz Lindokuhle Ndimande, esifundwe ngummeli wakhe u-Advocate Simphiwe Mlotshwa.Kuhlaluke kuso ukuthi uyazisebenza njengoba enepulazi lezinkukhu abambisene kulo nabanye ababili. IMIPHUMELA yocwaningo idalula ukuthi siphezulu isibalo seziguli ezihlaselwa yizifo ezithinta umgudu womchamo eNingizimu Afrika, uma siqhathaniswa nezakwamanye amazwe.Lokhu kuvele ocwaningweni olushicilelwe kwi-Journal of Health and Biological Sciences muva nje. Ucwaningo belubheka izinga lezifo ezihlasela umgudu womchamo ama-Urinary Tract Infections (UTI), eSub-Sahara Afrika.Kulezi zifo kubalwa izinkinga zesinye ezihlasela abantu abaningi emhlabeni kodwa eNingizimu Afrika, baningi kakhulu abanezinkinga zaso.Ngokombiko wocwaningo, iNingizimu Afrika ihamba phambili ngo- 67.6% , kulandele iNigeria ngo-43 kuya 65%), kube yiZambia ngo-38.25%.Luphinde luveze ukuthi ama-UTI ajwayelekile eNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulu kwabesifazane ngenxa yokuthi abanye banamasosha antekenteke, abanye banesifo sikashukela, abanye abagezi ngendlela efanele ngoba amanzi ahlanzekile kwesinye isikhathi awatholakali. Ukungabikhona kwengqalasizinda yokuthuthwa kwendle esezingeni nakho kubuye kube nomthelela wokuthi abesifazane bathole amagciwane agcina ehlasela umgudu womchamo ngesikhathi besebenzisa izindlu zangasese.UNkk Elani van Zyl, umphathi wophiko olukhiqiza imikhiqizo enakekela izifo ezibucayi kwi- kwaPharma Dynamics, uthi izifo eziphindelelayo ze-UTI zithinta u-25-30% wabesifazane abaneminyaka ephakathi kuka-20 nengu-40."Ukuthola ama-UTI amabili ezinyangeni eziyisithupha noma ezintathu ngonyaka kuthathwa ngokuba nama-UTI aphindelelayo. Izifo zesinye (cystitis) zenzeka lapho amagciwane amancane ekhuphuka ngomgudu womchamo aze ayongena esinyeni. Lokho kubangela ukutheleleka okubuhlungu emgudwini womchamo ongezansi, nakuba elapheka kalula kodwa ama-UTI anganyukela emgudwini womchamo ophezulu, adale izinkinga eziningi. Yingakho kubalulekile ukuthi onalesi sifo athole ukuhlolwa okufanele kusenesikhathi,” kugcizelela uNkk van Zyl.Uqhube wathi ukuya ocansini kungase kungenise amagciwane angafuneki emgudwini womchamo abe seduze nawo ngoba i-ishubhu elikhipha umchamo kwabesifazane, liseduze kakhulu nesitho sokulahla indle kunakubantu besilisa. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukuthi amagciwane aphelele esinyeni.UNkk van Zyl, uphethe ngokuthi ezinye izinsiza zokuhlela umndeni okungaba ama-spermicide, ama-diaphragm, nama-cap omlomo wesibeletho nazo zingawandisa amagciwane angadala ingozi yama-UTI.

I-ANC imangalele uMkhonto weSizwe nenhlangano yezokhetho i-IEC ngokubhaliswa kwaleli qembu elisha.Mabili amacala asenkantolo elokubhaliswa kweqembu bese kuba elombango wophawu lona elizongena eNkantolo eNkulu eThekwini, ngesonto elizayo ngoLwesithathu.UNOBHALA-Jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, ubefuna ukuzizwela eNkantolo yezoKhetho eBloemfontein, eFree State, lapho abamngalele khona uMkhonto weSizwe ne-IEC Isithombe: FACEBOOK/FIKILE MBALULAUKhongolose ukhala ngokuthi i-IEC yabheda ngokuvumela ukubhaliswa kweMK ekubeni izibiza ngegama lombutho wawo wezempi.
