Kufanele siyilungise ngoba siyobe silungisela nokhetho oluzayo komasipala, ezifundazweni nakwezinye zindawo,’’ kusho uRamogale.Amajaji athe isinqumo sigodliwe sekuyokwaziswa amaqembu ukuthi sizokhishwa nini. UZuma ubonakale enkantolo namalungu oMkhonto weSizwe. Ithimba le-ANC beliholwa wuNobhala-Jikelele, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula.
UMASIPALA waseThekwini uthi umphakathi usungaqala uwukhiphe udoti kulandela ukuthi kade uthe awume ukuwukhipha noma uzilahlele wona ezikhungweni olahlwa kuzo.Imeya yalo masipala uMnuz Mxolisi Kaunda isho lokhu ohlelweni lwayo lokwazisa umphakathi ngezinto ezenzeka kulo masipala oluba kwesinye seziteshi zomsakazo ngoLwesibili.Uthe ngoMsombuluko kukhona imiphakathi ewukhiphile udoti kodwa wangalandwa, wathembisa ukuthi uzolandwa izolo."Umphakathi besiwucelile ukuthi uma ungakwazi, ungazihambisela udoti ezikhungweni olahlwa kuzo, singawukhokhisi ngoba uma uyozilahlela udoti uyakhokha ngokujwayelekile," kusho uKaunda.Isitatimende esithunyelwe umasipala, izolo sithe uphiko lukagesi lwenza konke okusemandleni ukubhekana nokusilela emuva ekulungisweni kukagesi."Sigxile ekubuyiseleni ugesi kumakhasimende asenezinsuku eziningi engenawo ugesi, kodwa-ke amaphutha kagesi asanda kufakwa nawo siyawabhekwa," kusho isitatimende.UKaunda uthe ukucisha kukagesi kwezinye izindawo kudalwe izinkinga zawo, kodwa okunye kwenziwe ngamabomu njengoba bekunesiteleka sabasebenzi abangaphansi kwe-SA Municipal Workers Union (SAMWU)."Sicela umphakathi usebenzisane nathi ngokuthi unciphise imibhikisho enodlame, ehlanganisa ukuvalwa kwemigwaqo, okubambezela abasebenzi uma beyolungisa inkinga yamanzi nogesi ezindaweni ezingenawo," kusho uKaunda.Uthe ezindaweni ezifana naseDube Village, KwaMashu, eLindelani ugesi ubuyile ngempelasonto kodwa zikhona izindawo ongakalungiswa kuzo ezifana naKwaMakhutha nezinye eziseningizimu. Khonamanjalo, inhloko yophiko lukagesi kulo masipala uMnuz Maxwell Mthembu, inikwe incwadi yokuthi isizomiswa emsebenzini ngenxa yokwehluleka kwakhe ukuxosha abasebenzi bophiko lwakhe ababambe iqhaza esitelekeni esingavikelekile. Umasipala usuxoshe abasebenzi abangaphezu kuka-81 abebesesitelekeni kanti abanye abangu-88 bamisiwe, basazothamela izigcawu zokuqondiswa kwezigwegwe.UNkk Gugu Sisilana okhulumela umasipala, uthe umasipala awuzikhulumi izindaba ezithinta abasebenzi nabezindaba.
ZIYANDA izinkinga kuMasipala weTheku njengoba enye inyunyana yabasebenzi enamalungu kuwona isiqale uhlelo lokuhlola ukuthi ngabe amalungu ayo ayafuna yini ukuya esitelekeni noma cha.Inyunyana yabasebenzi i-Municipal and Allied Trade Union of SA (MATUSA), ithi inesitifiketi esigunyazayo ukuthi ingaya esitelekeni uma umqashi engagobi uphondo.Mayelana nodaba lokuthi ifuna abasebenzi bakulo masipala abasesigabeni ucategory 10, bahole iholo elilingana nelabanye abasebenzi bakwabanye omasipala abangama-Metro, okuyinto ebifunwa yinyunyana iSA Municipal Workers Union (SAMWU) yaze yangena esitelekeni esingavikelekile esithathe amasonto amathathu.UNobhala -Jikele wale nyunyana uMnuz Thulani Ngwenya, uthe le nyunyana enamamalungu angaphezulu kancane kwangu-5000 kulo masipala sekunesikhathi inesitifiketi eyasithola kwiNational Bargaining Council kodwa bebesaqhubeka nezingxoxo kwaze kwaba isonto eledlule lapho ibone khona ukuthi sekumele ithathe isinyathelo esilandelayo."Ngasekupheleni kwesonto eledlule siqale uhlelo lokuthi abasebenzi abangamalungu ethu bavote basho ukuthi bayafuna yini singene esitelekeni noma cha. Uma sithola amavoti asivumelayo ukuthi singene esitelekeni sizobe sesitshela umqashi ukuthi siya esitelekeni. Okwamanje asikazi ukuthi sizoluphothula nini uhlelo lokuvota."Okunye okusiphazamisayo ukuthi abanye babasebenzi bethu bathole izincwadi zokuqondiswa ubugwegwe ngenxa yokuthi bebengakwazi ukusebenza ngesikhathi kuqhubeka isiteleka seSAMWU, ” kusho UNgwenya.USihlalo we-IMATU eThekwini uNksz Queen Mbatha uthe okwamanje abakehluleki ezingxoxweni ezikhona ezingeni likazwelonke, basazoqhubeka nokukhuluma nomqashi."Isiteleka usicabanga uma izingxoxo sezihlulekile, okwamanje asikahluleki," kusho yena.Uthe abakuxoxa nomasipala okwabasebenzi abangamalungu abo abathole izincwadi zokumiswa nezokuthi bachaze ukuthi kungani kungamele baxoshwe."Amalungu ethu yize ebengekho esitelekeni bekunzima ukuthi asebenze ngoba abesatshiswa. Sinabo ubufakazi balokho. Njengamanje siyaxoxa nomqashi simkhombisa nobufakazi," kusho uNksz Mbatha.UNkk Gugu Sisilana okhulumela uMasipala weTheku ebuzwa ngalokhu uphendule wathi umasipala ngeke uziphendule izindaba ezithinta noma iyiphi inyunyana yabasebenzi kwabezindaba." Lukhona uhlaka olusemthethweni okuyi-Bargaining Council lapho zonke izindaba zabasebenzi nezikhalo kuxoxwa ngazo khona. Umasipala uyazihlonipha lezi zinqubo futhi uzoqhubeka nokuxoxa nezinyunyana zabasebenzi kulezi zinhlaka ezaziwayo.”kusho yena.
ABADIDIYELI bamabutho bafuna uSihlalo we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Siboniso Duma, adliwe izinkomo eziwu-100 "ngokwehlisa” isithunzi uNdunankulu kaZulu, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi.Izinduna zamabutho zithe zifuna ukuthi uDuma axolisele ukugcwaneka phambi kweSilo uMisuzulu kaZwelithini noMengameli, uCyril Ramaphosa, ngesikhathi kunomcimbi wokukhumbula iSilo uDinuzulu kaCetshwayo.UDuma, owayephethe uhlelo emcimbini, wayabula umbhobho kuButhelezi ngesikhathi ethula iSilo.Umdidiyeli wamabutho kaZulu, uMnuz Sipho "Masefa” Mhlongo, uthe ukube kuya ngabo uDuma ubezodliwa izinkomo eziwu-100.Lokhu ukusho esithangamini nabezindaba, ebesiseThekwini, izolo. UMhlongo uthe okwenzeka emcimbini kwathela ngehlazo iSilo noRamaphosa."Ukube sobe sikhona lapho besiyothi abadliwe izinkomo eziwu-100 laba abenze lokhu. Le nto eyenzeke lapha ayamukelekile. Kuyabonakala ukuthi usemkhulu umsebenzi okusamele siwenze njengabadidiyeli bamabutho. Siyethemba ukuthi uma benonembeza laba abenze lokhu, bazohamba beyoxolisa.”UMhlongo uthe abezukumbekela uDuma umnqamulajuqu wokuthi kufanele axolise nini, kodwa wathi akufanele athathe isikhathi eside."Akufanele kuthathe isikhathi kuze kube sengathi kukhona abakuphushayo. Uma uwumholi kufanele uzibonele uma usephutheni. Asikho isikhathi esithi uDuma unqunyelwa sona, engaya nakusasa. Asifuni kuze kube isikhathi eside ngoba mhlawumbe izitha zingaze zigcine sezithi uhlaleleni isikhathi eside kangaka?”Ebuzwa uMhlongo ukuthi kungani bengasho ukuthi noButhelezi akahlawuliswe, uthe ngokwabo akukho okubheke eceleni okwashiwo uButhelezi."Undunankulu uthe u(Nobhala we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Bheki) Mtolo wenzeni? Wathi esathi uMtolo, wahlwithwa umbhobho. Phela kwakufanele sizwe ukuthi uMtolo wenzeni, bese siyasho ukuthi undunankulu uyanhlanhlatha. Umqondisi wehlelo usuke enethuba lonke lokulungisa okungalungile. Wayengasukuma nje amfake kahle endleleni ngenhlonipho, noma amphendule uma eseqedile ukukhuluma.”UMhlongo ukuchithile ukuthi amalungu e-ANC alimala emcimbini ahlaselwa ngamalungu e-IFP.UMhlongo uthe abantu bahlaselwa yizigangi nje, uthe amabutho ayengasekho ngesikhathi kwenzeka isigameko.Uthe bazokuya kovela kwabalimele, wathi bazophuma nomkhankaso wokuthola izigilamakhuba ezagqema abantu abangu-16.UMhlongo uthe abayizwa kahle eyokuthi uhulumeni awumamukeli uNdunankulu kaZulu ngoba isikhundla asikho kuMthethosisekelo.Uthe njengoba uNdunankulu kaZulu eqokwa iSilo, uyizwi leSilo. UMhlongo unxuse abaholi bezepolitiki ukuthi bangalwi izimpi zabo phambi kweSilo."Osopolitiki bafike baxabane emakhoneni, bese beyabuya-ke sebezolwa phambi kweSilo. Sibonga ukuthi uButhelezi wavele wazithulela ngesikhathi kwenzeka le nto ngoba kwakuzoqhuma iqupha.”UMtolo umxolisele uDuma ngokuthi aqophisane noButhelezi phambi kweSilo noRamaphosa."Kufanele ubheke ukuthi isigangi usishaya kuphi, ungasishayi phambi kwabantu abadala.”UMtolo uthe bafuna ukuthi uButhelezi akhuzwe, angafaki ipolitiki ezintweni zasendlunkulu.Uthe amabutho kwakufanele asithathe iSilo, ahambe naso ngesikhathi uButhelezi efaka igama lakhe nele-ANC.
UHULUMENI waKwaZulu-Natal uyaseseka isenzo soMphathiswa wezokuThuthukiswa koMnotho, uMnuz Siboniso Duma, sokuyabula umbhobho kukhuluma undunankulu kaZulu, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi.Undunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Nomusa Dube-Ncube, uthe uDuma wenza into efanele ngesikhathi ephuca uButhelezi, owayethula iSilo uMisuzulu kaZwelithini, umbhobho.Ukusho lokhu kwisithangami nabezindaba, ngoLwesithathu.UNkk Dube-Ncube uthe uDuma ubachazelile beyikhabhinethi lesifundazwe ukuthi wamphucelani uButhelezi umbhobho wokukhuluma ngesikhathi kunomcimbi wokukhumbula iSilo uDinuzulu kaCetshwayo.UNkk Dube-Ncube uthe incazelo kaDuma ibanelisile."Siyameseka uDuma kulokhu akwenza. Ukube akawuthathanga umbhobho kwakuzothukwa abantu emcimbini kahulumeni.”UNkk Dube-Ncube uthe uDuma ubatshele ukuthi uzokuya koshweleza eSilweni."Akezukuxolisela ukuphuca uButhelezi umbhobho, kodwa uzoxolisela ukuthi isigameko senzeka phambi kweSilo.”UNkk Dube-Ncube ugxeke labo abathi uDuma kufanele ahlawuliswe.Abadidiyeli bamabutho ibona abaphumele obala, bathi bafuna uDuma ahlawule ngokuthela ngechilo iSilo.UNkk Dube-Ncube uthe laba abasho lokhu baphuca iSilo igunya lokunquma ukuthi uDuma ufanelwe yini ukuhlawula.UNkk Dube-Ncube ugxeke uButhelezi, wamsola ngokuzama ukuphazamisa umcimbi wangoMgqibelo.Uthe uButhelezi wayevele eshilo ukuthi uzowuphazamisa umcimbi."Wayesophe ukuthela iSilo nendlunkulu ngehlazo.”

SICHITHWE nezindleko isicelo sokukhipha umholi wamaNazaretha, inkosi Mduduzi 'Unyazilwezulu’ Shembe ebesifakwe wumholi webandla lakwaShembe owavunwa yinkantolo ukuhola ibandla, inkosi Phinda 'Ukukhanyakwelanga’ Shembe.Inkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini ikhiphe lesi sinqumo ebese sinesikhathi silindiwe.Ummeli woKukhanyakwelanga, uMnuz Trevor Nkosi uthe azikho izizathu ezibambekayo ngokuchithwa kwesicelo sabo enkantolo."Kuvele kwathiwa isicelo sethu siyachithwa kwangakhishwa zizathu ukuthi kungani sichithwa. Kuthiwe zombili izinhlangothi zizozikhokhela zona izindleko zecala, kwaphela kanjalo,” kusho uNkosi.Uthe noma bengakazitholi izizathu zokuchithwa kwesicelo sabo, basezinhlelweni zokufaka isicelo sokubuyekezwa kwalesi sinqumo.Umthombo waleli phephandaba, uthe kuyaxaka okweziwe yinkantolo."Wonke umuntu usele nemibuzo ngoba akekho obelindele isinqumo salolu hlobo. Kwakhona ukuthi zingabikhona izizathu kuyinkomba yokuthi kukhona okushaya amanzi. Nokuthi isinqumo sidonse kanje ukuthi sikhishwe bekuyizinkomba zakho ukuthi kunemizamo yokusibambezela,” kusho umthombo.Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kokhulumela umholi wamaNazaretha Ukukhanyakwelanga, uMnuz Chance Sibisi ayiphumelelanga. Ucingo lwakhe belukhala lungabanjwa. Eselubamba akaphendulanga kodwa bekuzwakala abantu bekhuluma eceleni ukuthi basemhlanganweni oshubile.Okhulumela uNyazilwezulu, uMnuz Thokozani Mncwabe uthe babonga amandla oNyazilwezulu ngalesi sinqumo."Inkosi uNyazi lugile izimanga njengoba engekho obezitshela ukuthi kuzophuma isinqumo salolu hlobo. Lokhu kuyinjabulo enkulu kuthina njengamaNazaretha ngaphansi kobuholi boNyazilwezulu. Lesi sinqumo siqondane kahle nokuthi kule nyanga yisikhumbuzo senkosi Inyangayezulu, esizongena maduze nje,” kusho uMncwabe. UKhomishana wamaPhoyisa kaMasipala weTheku uSibonelo Mchunu uthi amaphoyisa akhe anelungelo lokushaqa imoto eshintshwe i-suspension yakhasa phansi.Wumkhuba owandile kuleli dolobha ukuthi abashayeli bashune izimoto zabo bazenze zikhase phansi okuwumkhuba odume ngokuthi yi-stance.UMchunu uthe akukho emthethweni ukwenza izinguquko eziphazamisa indlela imoto ebambelela ngayo emgwaqweni noma ijubane layo.Ubekhuluma neSolezwe ngemuva kwezikhalo zabanye abashayeli, amaphoyisa eshaqe izimoto zabo ngenxa yokuthi zikhasa phansi kunendlela eziphuma zakhiwe ngayo emagaraji.Omunye wabashayeli onemoto eyehlisiwe uMnuz Sphamandla Shabane, uthe kuyamthusa ukuthi amaphoyisa aseyazishaqa manje izimoto ezihushayo."Uma kuwumthetho okhona obhaliwe phansi, anginankinga nawo. Kuyathusa kodwa kithina singabashayeli ngoba lento isiqala ukuvela manje ngoba sekudume "ingezo” nokuyinto edume nyakenye lapho abashayeli besuke betsaka ngobunono nobuhle bezimoto edume emalokishini amaningi. Le nto yezimoto ezihushayo akuyona into yamanje kodwa ingenise kakhulu ngenhloso yokugqugquzela ukuthi izimoto zibe zinhle ukuze abagibeli bezothokozela ukugibela izimoto ezihlanzekile. Kusho ukuthi lo mthetho ubukhona kodwa ubunganakekile ngoba bezingandile kakhulu izimoto ezinjalo kodwa kuyathusa,” kusho uShabane.UMchunu uthe kuyicala ukushintsha imoto uyenze ikhase phansi."Wonke amaphoyisa anelungelo lokuthi ayishaqe imoto ayibona ukuthi ayikho semthethweni ukuthi ibe semgwaqweni. Amaphoyisa ayazi ukuthi imoto kumele iphakame kangakanan futhi nokuxebula -idisc yemoto kuba kulo iphoyisa uma libona ukuthi ayikufanele ukuba semgwaqweni. Inhloso yephoyisa ngokwenza leso senzo ukuthi linqande ingozi engenzeka engafaka impilo yabantu abaningi engcupheni,” kusho uMchunu.Ngokomthetho we-National Road Traffic Act 93 wango-1996, ukuguqulwa noma ukuphazamisa ukuphepha kwendlela imoto eyakhiwe ngayo kwenza imoto ingabibikho semthethweni noma ingakufaneli ukuba semgwaqweni ngaphandle kokuthi lokho kwenziwe lapho imoto yakhiwe khona.

UPHINDE wakhala ngaphansi loyo owayengumengameli, uJacob Zuma, emzamweni wakhe wokushenxisa umshushisi omkhulu ecaleni lakhe lenkohlakalo, u-Advocate Billy Downer.INkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu ichithe isicelo sesibili sikaZuma sokuba kushenxe uDowner ecaleni.UZuma usola uDowner ngokuchema, ukhala ngokuthi waputshuzela izintatheli imininingwane yecala kanye nethinta impilo yakhe.IJaji Nkosinathi Chili lithe uZuma wehlulekile ukuveza ukuthi amalungelo akhe azocindezeleka kanjani uma uDowner engashenxi ecaleni.Isicelo sokuqala sachithwa iJaji Piet Koen, owagcina eshenxa kuleli cala.Ummeli kaZuma, u-Advocate Dali Mpofu, uthe bazosiphonsela inselelo isinqumo sikaChili."Amaphepha okuphonsela inselelo isinqumo senkantolo sizowaletha singakapheli isikhathi esibekelwe sona.”UDonwer uthe bafuna kuqale ngokushesha ukuqulwa kwecala."Sekuneminyaka kubambezeleka ukuqulwa kwecala. Kufanele kuqale ngokushesha ukuqulwa kwecala.”Icala lizobuyela enkantolo ngenyanga ezayo.
KUBOSHWE owesifazane waKwaLindizwe, KwaNongoma, obonakala kwi-video, ezungeza ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, eshaya ngesihluku ingane yakhe (2).Umsolwa okuthiwa uboshwe ngempelasonto, ubevele eNkantolo yeMantshi kwaNongoma.Kwi-video okukholakala ukuthi iqoshwe othile obesendlini edlala ngaphezudlwana kweminithi, ubonakala ebhaxabula ingane ngesicathulo, abuye ayicindezele phansi sakuyincisha umoya. Kanti kukhona lapho eyishaya khona ngesipuni sokuphaka seplastiki.Akucaci ukuthi beyenzeni kodwa umsolwa uzwakala ethi: "Angithi uhlupha uMvelo wena? Angithi uyamhlupha?”Abasendlini abanye bezwakala bemkhuza kanti okukholakala ukuthi uyena oqophe i-video, ulokhu emxwayisa ngokuthi njengoba eqhubeka nokushaya ingane uyamqopha, uphethe ubufakazi.Lesi sihluku esinyantisayo sinyakazise ngisho ubuholi endaweni njengoba kuthiwa induna yesigodi iyalele ikhansela ukuthi libize umhlangano ukuthi kukhuzwe lesi sihlava.UMnuz Zithulele Dlamini oyikhansela endaweni, uthe nakuba bengakwazanga ukuthola ukuthi lesi sigameko senzeke kumuphi umuzi kodwa bakubone kuyijoka labo ukuthi basukume bakhuze umhlola zingaze zande izigameko ezifuze lesi."Sihlanganile nenduna yendawo nayo ekuvezile ukuthi beyingazi ngalolu daba. Ngiyikhombisa i-video, ithuke yoma yathi angicishe ngingabe ngisaqhubeka ngenxa yesihluku esibonakala kuyo, savumelana ngokuthi kubizwe umhlangano ozokuba ngeSonto, ukuze sikhuze le nto eyihlazo ingaphinde yenzeke,” usho kanje.UMphathiswa wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi KwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Nonhlanhla Khoza, usigxekile lesi senzo."Sifuna ukubona othintekayo ebhekana nesijeziso esimfanele ngokuhlukumeza ingane. Akusho lutho ukuthi uhlobene nengane, ziningi izindlela zokuyiqondisa kunalesi sihluku esibonakala kule video,” usho kanje.Uncome amaphoyisa ngokusukumela phezulu ukubopha umsolwa.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant Colonel Nqobile Gwala, uthe amaphoyisa ophiko olubhekelele uDlame lwaseMindenini, ukuVikelwa kweziNgane namaCala aphathelene noCansi, Olundi ayaphenya. Uqinisekise ukuthi umsolwa uvelile enkantolo.
UFAKAZI woMbuso, iMantshi uNkk Vivienne Cronje, ufunde isitatimende esiveze ukuthi abamangalelwa bashayela uKelly Khumalo ucingo ngesikhathi sebesuka beyodubula umufi uSenzo Meyiwa.Kuvela lokhu nje phambilini ofakazi ababesendlini bathi uMeyiwa wavinjwa esehamba, kwathiwa akabuyele endlini azovalelisa kahle nokwathi emuva kwalokho kwaba yisikhashana kwangena abahlaseli.UNkk Cronje ufunde isitatimende sikammangalelwa wesibili uBongani Ntanzi athi wasenza evuma iqhaza lakhe ekufeni kukaMeyiwa. UMeyiwa wadutshulwa wabulawa ekubo kaKelly ngo-2014 eVosloorus, eGauteng.Ufakazi uthe uNtanzi walethwa kuyena wathi ufisa ukubhala isitatimende achaze konke akwaziyo ngalolu daba. Uthe uNtanzi wamtshela ukuthi yena washayelwa wummangalelwa wesihlanu uFisokuhle Ntuli emazisa ngetoho. Ufakazi uthe uNtanzi wasuka eCarletonville, eGauteng, waya ehostela eVosloorus eyozwa kahle ngomsebenzi ayebizelwa wona. Uthe kulapho abamba khona umhlangano nommangalelwa wokuqala uMzikawukhulekwa Sibiya nowesihlanu uNtuli.Uthe bamtshela ukuthi kuyobulawa uMeyiwa nokuwumsebenzi abawunikwe wuKelly. "UCarlos (ummangalelwa wesithathu) noMaphisa (ummangalelwa wesine) bashayela uKelly ucingo bemazisa ukuthi konke kuqondile, sesiyeza. Sasihamba nePolo Vivo kodwa ezimpambanweni zomgwaqo sahlangana nenye iPolo Vivo yabanye esasizohamba nabo,’’ kusho isitatimende sikaNtanzi.Isitatimende siveza ukuthi uNtanzi nommangalelwa wesithathu uMthobisi Mncube yibona abangena endlini. Kuvela ukuthi ummangalelwa wesithathu wabakhomba ngesibhamu wathi abalale phansi kodwa umufi uMeyiwa wathatha isihlalo wazama ukushaya uMncube.Kuvele ukuthi balwa wabe eyadutshulwa uMeyiwa, uNtanzi waphuma ngejubane namaselula. UNtanzi uthe abanye abamangalelwa bambona ukuthi uthukile bamsabisa ngokuthi uma eke wakhuluma nje uzofa.Isitatimende sikaNtanzi siveza nokuthi umndeni wommangalelwa wokuqala uSibiya wake waba nenguyazana ngalolu daba. Kuvele ukuthi omunye wodadewabo bakaSibiya wayefuna ukumceba emaphoyiseni ukuthi uyathinteka ekufeni kukaMeyiwa.Icala liguqele ukuthi libuyele enkantolo kusasa lapho kuzoqhutshekwa kulalelwe ubufakazi boMbuso.
KUPHELA amaphupho namuhla ngoLwesithathu eNkantolo eNkulu eThekwini njengoba kulindeleke ukuthi ijaji limemezele isinqumo ngesicelo sokukhipha umholi wamaNazaretha, inkosi Mduduzi 'Unyazilwezulu’ Shembe eBuhleni.Ukumenyezelwa kwesinqumo kuza emva kwesicelo esafakwa wumholi wamaNazaretha, inkosi Phinda Shembe Ukukhanyakwelanga nyakenye ecela inkantolo ukuthi igudluze uNyazi njengoba selalahlwa amacala okuba ngumholi wamaNazaretha.Lezi zindaba ziqinisekiswe wummeli woKukhanyakwelanga, uMnuz Trevor Nkosi othe isinqumo ngesicelo sabo sizomenyezelwa namuhla."Akuzoba yinto ezothatha isikhathi eside ngoba bekungasaqulwa icala. Bekungukubheka isicelo ebesisifake enkantolo sokuthi uNyazi ludilike esikhundleni njengoba selwachithwa yizona zonke izinkantolo ukuthi lungumholi wamaNazaretha,” kusho uNkosi.Uthe isinqumo sizomenyezelwa yiJaji uHlatshwayo. Echaza ngokukhishwa koNyazi eBuhleni, uNkosi uthe esicelweni sabo kwakungukuthi lungabe lusaziphathisa okomholi futhi lwehle esihlalweni lugudlukele umholi ofanele Ukukhanyakwelanga ukuthi aqhubeke nemisebenzi yenkonzo.Uthe ngokwesicelo sabo ukuthi uNyazi lungagqokisi komholi wamaNazaretha, luphinde lungaziholi izinkonzo kuzona zonke izindawo zebandla lamaNazaretha. Uqhube wathi ngaphandle kwekomkhulu lebandla eBuhleni, babecele ukuthi kungabikhona lapho luzobonakala khona luhola ibandla. Uveze ukuthi abalunqabele ukuthi uNyazi lungahlala kunoma yimuphi umuzi wakubo kaShembe kodwa kungabikhona lapho luzohola khona ibandla ezindaweni zenkonzo. Nasezintweni ezithinta imali yebandla, uthe nakhona babefake isicelo sokuthi lungahlangani nazo njengoba lungeyena umholi wamaNazaretha.Lesi sinqumo besilokhu sibhekwe ngabomvu kusuka nyakenye safakwa. UNkosi uphinde wachaza ukuthi bekumele ukuthi bafake lesi sicelo yize izinkantolo sezanquma ukuthi uNyazi aluyena umholi.Ngokwesinqumo secala esasichitha uNyazi njengomholi wamaNazaretha uthe kwakungukuqinisekisa ukuthi aluyena umholi, sekumele bafake isicelo sokulugudluza. Ephetha uthe okwamanje akulula ukusho okuzokwenzeka ngoba kulindelekile ukuthi ozochithwa yicala phakathi kwabo, afake isicelo sokulibuyekeza enkantolo.
UMENGAMELI uCyril Ramaphosa uthi kuningi okusengenziwa ukuqinisekisa ukuvikelwa kwamalungelo abantu baseNingizimu Afrika.URamaphosa uthe yize kukuningi okwenziwe kule minyaka engu-30 eyedlule, lide ibanga okusafanele lihanjwe.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi evula ingqungquthela ebibizelwe ukuzobhunga udaba lwamalungelo abantu.URamaphosa uthe inkohlakalo nokungahanjiswa kwezidingo emphakathini kuphazamisa imizamo yokuvikela amalungelo abantu."Siyavuma ukuthi kuningi okusadinga ukwenziwa. Inkohlakalo nokwehluleka komasipala ukuhambisa izidingo, kubukela phansi imizamo yokuvikela isithunzi sabantu bakuleli."Sonke sihlalelwe umsebenzi omkhulu wokuvikela amalungelo abantu. Abantu bakithi kufanele bathole zonke izidingo zabo. Yinde indlela esasihlalele. Sineminyaka engu-30 sathola inkululeko, nesayithola emva kweminyaka eminingi siphila ngaphansi kohulumeni wobandlululo,” kusho uRamaphosa.Uthe eminyakeni engu-30 eyedlule kuningi okwenziwe ukuvikela amalungelo abantu nesithunzi sabo kule lizwe.Eminyakeni eyedlule uthe sasaziwa njengezwe elicindezela abantu, kodwa manje saziwa ngokuhlonipha amalungelo abo. Kufanele siziqhenye ngebanga eselihanjiwe.Uqhubeke ngokuthi ngaphansi kukahulumeni wentando yeningi kushaywe imithetho eminingi ethuthukisa abesifazane."Namhlanje baningi abesifazane abaphethe izikhundla eziphezulu kuhulumeni nasezinkampanini ezizimele. Ngesikhathi sikahulumeni wobandlululo abesifazane babecindezelekile kakhulu. Miningi imithetho esiyishayile evikela abesifazane nezingane odlameni lwezobulili, ” kusho umengameli.Udalule nokuthi ingxenye enkulu yesabelomali sikahulumeni iya ekuvikeleni amalungelo abantu.Uthe baningi abantu manje asebethola ithuba lokufunda, abakwazi nokusebenzisa imitholampilo, ezikoleni kutholakala ukudla, futhi baningi abantu abathola izibonelelo.Uyivumile eyokuthi izibonelelo azanele, abantu badinga imisebenzi, uthe bayazama ukudala amathuba emisebenzi.Uthe isinqumo abasithatha sokweseka abantu basePalestine ngesikhathi kusuka impi eGaza ngoba bayazi ukuthi kunzima kangakanani ukuphila ngaphansi kukahulumeni wengcindezelo.Elakuleli lamangalela elakwa-Israel enkantolo yamacala amazwe omhlaba, liyisola ngokusoconga abantu basePalestine kulempi esidlule nemiphefumulo engaphezu kuka-30 000."Nathi siphilile ngaphansi kukahulumeni wengcindezelo iminyaka eminingi. Maningi amazwe asesekela, silwela inkululeko. Inkululeko yethu kobe ayikagcwali kahle uma abantu basePalestine bengakakhululeki,” kuphetha uRamaphosa.
UMCULI kamaskandi ophinde abe ngusomatekisi ongumsolwa wesibili ecaleni lokubulawa komrepha uKiernan "AKA” Forbes nomngani wakhe uTebello "Tibz” Motsoane usole amaphoyisa ngokuchema nomndeni abasembangweni nawo embonini yamatekisi. ULindani Zenzele Ndimande (36) odume ngelikaShiselansimbi kumaskandi efaka isicelo sakhe sebheyili enkantololo yeMantshi eThekwini, ngoMsombuluko, ngesitatimende esifungelwe esifundwe ummeli wakhe, u-Advocate Joe Wolmarans, kuvele ukuthi useke wagwetshwa iminyaka engu-10 ngecala lokubamba inkunzi esebenzisa isihluku.Uveze nokuthi umndeni wakhe ugxile kakhulu embonini yamatekisi, yena unawakhe amatekisi amane, amngenisela u-R250 000 ngenyanga.Ubuye waveza ukuthi ngenxa yombango werenki yamatekisi aseMalukazi nomndeni wakwaGumede, uselahlekelwe amalungu omndeni ayisithupha, edutshulwa wuphiko lwamaphoyisa uNational Intervention Unit (NIU)."Lolu phiko lumi ngasohlangothini lomndeni esingabhekani nawo,” kusho isitatimende sikaNdimande.Udalule ukuthi ngenxa yale mpi, izelamani zakubo ezimbili, nazo ezithintekayo kuleli cala, zaphoqeleka ukuthi ziyobhaca eSwatini."Zazibalekela iNIU, eyayifuna ukuzisoconga,” kusho isitatimende.Lesi sitatimende siveze ukuthi unengoduso ayithembise umshado kanti ulungiselela ukushada, waveza nokuthi unezingane ezineminyaka ephakathi kowodwa neminyaka engu-15. Uthe izingane zakhe, umndeni wakhe nebhizinisi lakhe lamatekisi, konke kubheke yena, yikho efuna ukukhishwa ngebheyili.UNdimande ufake isicelo sebheyili emuva kwesomsolwa wokuqala nowesithathu ngoLwesine olwedlule. Sekubuywa ekhefini lesikhashana, kuqubuke inkulumo-mpikiswano phakathi kukamshushisi woMbuso, u-Advocate Lawrence Gcaba noWolmarans, kubangwa amaphepha anohlu lwamacala ezelamani zakwaNdimande eziboshwe eSwatini, nazo ezisolwa kuleli cala.Ngesikhathi uWolmarans esezofunda isitatimende esifungelwe somsolwa wesine, uMnuz Mziwethemba Gwabini, uGcaba uqale waveza ukuthi akaqondi ukuthi ukuxhumana kwakhe nommeli, uNksz Yolanda Gielink, omele ummangalelwa wesithathu, ngama-email kugcine kufinyelela kanjani kwabanye abameli."Ngithole ukuthi ama-email ami aseyingxenye yesicelo sikamsolwa wesine. Bengingabafakanga laba bameli ngesizathu ezithize, kungimangazile uma sengibona ama-email ami eseyingxenye yesicelo sikammangalelwa wesine,” kusho uGcaba.Mayelana nalokhu, uWolmarans uthe emva kwesikhalo sikaGcaba, bagcine beyisusa ingxenye uGcaba abekhala ngokuthi ifinyelele kanjani kubona.UGcaba uphinde wezwakalisa ukungenami ngokuthola ukuthi esicelweni sikaGwabini sebheyili siqukethe uhlu lwamacala ezelamani zakwaNdimande ezihamba icala eNkantolo yaKwaManzini, eSwatini."Ngimangazwa ukuthi amaphepha enkantolo yakwelinye izwe, afike kanjani kwelinye izwe,” kusho uGcaba.Uthe okubuye kudide kakhulu ukuthi leli phepha liphinde libe namanothi abhalwe ngesandla."Sizokwazi ngani ukuthi leli phepha kuseyilo elahanjiswa enkantolo yakuleliya lizwe?” kubuza uGcaba, ongeze ngelithi uyafisa ukwazi ukuthi ingabe ubani obhale amanothi akula maphepha.Imantshi, uMnuz Vincent Hlatshwayo, ithe aliguqe icala liqhubeke namuhla ngenxa yokuthi amanzi awekho enkantolo, nokho wakhala ngokuthi sekuwusuku lwesibili abameli bekhombisa ukuthi abazihlelele ngokwanele njengoba befaka isicelo sebheyili sabasolwa.
KUPHAZAMISE uSomlomo ogcine engafikanga ePhalamende ukuzokwengamela uhlelo lukaMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa lokuphendula imibuzo, ukugasela kophiko lwezokuShushisa kuleli emzini kaNkk Nosiviwe Mapisa-Nqakula, ophenywa ngezinsolo zokuthi wamukela intshontsho esanguNgqongqoshe wezokuVikela.Iyaqonga ingcindezi yokuthi uNkk Mapisa-Nqakula ehle esikhundleni njengoba i-DA isiphakamise ukuthi akashiye emuva kokuba kugasele lo luphiko emzini wakhe oseBruma eGoli.Okhulumela iPhalamende uMnuz Moloto Mothapo uthe lo luphiko lugasele emzini kaSomlomo luzophenya.Uthe lokhu kugasela kumphazamisile uSomlomo njengoba engafikanga ukuzokwengamela uhlelo lukamengameli lokuphendula imibuzo."Ugcine ejuba iphini likasomlomo ukuthi lengamele lo luhlelo lokuphendula imibuzo. USomlomo umile ekutheni akukho akufihlile futhi nophenyo uyalweseka.”USotswebhu we-DA uNksz Siviwe Gwarube uthe usomlomo kumele ahoxe ngenxa yokuthi ubhekene nezinsolo zenkohlakalo ebalelwa ku-R2.3 million."Le mali kusolwa ukuthi wayithola izikhawu komunye wosonkontileka esaphethe uMnyango wezokuVikela. Kumele ahloniphe isifungo asenza sokuthi uzoziphatha ngendlela. Sifuna ikomiti lasePhalamende liphuthumise uphenyo.” Okhulumela uphiko lwezokuShushisa u-Advocate Mthunzi Mhaga, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi bagaselile emzini kasomlomo izolo beyophenya wathi ngeke bande kakhulu. Umholi we-DA uMnuz John Steenhuisen ufune ukuthi uRamaphosa aphendule ngokuthi kumele usomlomo ahoxe njengoba ebhekene nezinsolo zenkohlakalo.UMnuz Cedrick Frolick obengusihlalo ngesikhathi sokuphendulwa kwemibuzo, uthe umbuzo omusha ngalokho ulele kuRamaphosa ukuthi aphendule noma angaphenduli.URamaphosa unqume ukuthi angawuphenduli lo mbuzo.Ephendula eminye imibuzo ethinta ukuqasheka kwentsha, uRamaphosa uthe kumele yenze imikhakha edingwa umnotho wezwe.Uthe akusizi ukuthi yenze imikhakha egcina ngokuthi ibhuquze ekhaya."Yingakho sinezinhlelo zokuthi iye emakolishi amakhono ukuze yenze imikhakha yamakhono. Akusizi ukuthi yenze iziqu ezogcina ihleli nazo ekhaya.” Odabeni oluthinta izincomo zekhomishini eyayiphenya ngokulawulwa kombuso yidlanzana, uthe lezi zincomo uyazilandelela. Ukuchithile ukuthi abenzi lutho ngazo.Akulona iqiniso ukuthi asenzi lutho ngezincomo zekhomishini yejaji uZondo. Izincomo ezibalelwa ku-200 siyazisebenza, hhayi ngoba singenzi lutho ngazo,” kusho uRamaphosa. Uveze ukuthi le khomishini yadla enkulu imali wathi kuningi okwenziwayo ukubamba abathinteka embikweni wayo.Mayelana nezinhlelo zokulwa nobugebengu kuleli, uthe bandisa isibalo samaphoyisa ukuze kuqiniswe izinhlelo zokulwa nabo.
IKHOMISHINI yezokhetho kuleli i-Independent Electoral Commission (IEC), ithi ikulindele ukuthi kube khona abazokhononda ngokuthi ukhetho belungakhululekile.Ngokusho kwekhomishini kujwayelekile ukuthi kukhalaze abasuke bekhale ngaphansi okhethweni.UMnuz Masego Sheburi isikhulu sekhomishini, uthe njengoba sanda isibalo samaqembu angenela ukhetho, kugcina ngokuthi kukhethwe ambalwa azoya ePhalamende, naseziShayamthetho.Echaza uSheburi ubeke kanje:"Okhethweni lwango-1999 angu-26 amaqembu angenela ukhetho. Njalo uma kunokhetho siyanda isibalo samaqembu angenela ukhetho kodwa ambalwa avotelwayo. Manje angu-370 abhalisele ukhetho kodwa uthola ukuthi angu-13 avotelwayo, okwenza abasuke bekhale ngaphansi bese bekhononda ngokuthi ukhetho belungakhululekile ngoba amaqembu abebewafuna engaphumelelanga.” Uthe sebelulungele ukhetho wathi zingaphezu kuka-23 000 iziteshi zokuvota. USheburi uveze nokuthi kuneziteshi ezingomahamba nendlwana abazisebenzisa okwesikhashana.Ubalule nokuthi abasuke bemele amaqembu ezikhungweni zokuvota basheshe bahambe uma bebona ukuthi izinto azihambi kahle."Uma sekuvotiwe, isikhungo siyavalwa bese siqala ukubala. Alikho iphepha eliphuma esikhungweni sokuvota lingabaliwe. Kodwa uthola ukuthi iqembu eliwinayo kugcina sekuba yilona elisayina ukugunyaza imiphumela yalesi sikhungo, amanye engasabonwa.”

Kufanele zonke izinhlaka zikhunjuzwe ngesigaba sokuhlonipha uma siphambi kukaNomthebe wesizwe.”Isigameko sesidale itwetwe lokuthi kungase kuqubuke udlame lwezepolitiki KwaZulu-Natal njengoba kugcine kulimala amalungu e-ANC angu-16.UChiliza ukhuze ukuchitheka kwegazi KwaZulu-Natal."Sinxusa abaholi bezepolitiki ukuba baqaphele into abayikhulumayo, bangaphehli udlame. Akufanele abantu baze bagcine sebethatha izinqumo ezingalungile, ezizosibuyisela emumva. Sinxusa bonke abantu ukuthi behlise amaphaphu.”Izinduna zamabutho zizoba nesithangami nabezindaba, eThekwini, namhlanje.Kunamahlebezi okuthi kukhona amabutho afuna uDuma angabe esavunyelwa emicimbini yasendlunkulu.Unobhala wezinduna zesiFunda iZululand, uMnuz Muzi Nyandeni uvumile ukuthi sibacikile isenzo sikaDuma kodwa wangafuna ukuphumela obala ngodaba lokuthi kukhona amabutho afuna ukuthi uDuma avalwe endlunkulu."Okuningi sizokukhuluma kusasa (namhlanje). Engingakutshela khona ukuthi izinduna namabutho abeneme ngalokhu okwenziwe uDuma, kokungahloniphi Ingonyama. Wakhombisa ukuba luhlaza cwe.”Umdidiyeli wamabutho esiFundeni iKing Cetshwayo, uMnuz Zakheleni Xulu, uthe ukuhlaselwa kwabantu emcimbini kuthunaza isithunzi samabutho njengoba kukhona izinsolo zokuthi abalimala bashaywa yiwo."Sikhathele udlame lwezepolitiki KwaZulu-Natal. Kufanele ikhuzwe le nto, ikakhulukazi njengoba sekunukeka amabutho. Asikwamukeli ukuthi abaholi abakuleli zinga benze ukuganga okunje. Noma ngabe bebephambene kanjani bekufanele bahloniphane, benzele iSilo."Mina angikaze ngikubone ukuthi uma osopolitiki bengcofana, bese bephucana umbhobho. Ngazi ukuthi omunye uyamlinda aze aqede, bese eyamphendula. Kwakha siphi isithombe lokhu okwenziwe uDuma kokuthi aphuce uNdunankulu kaZulu umbhobho,” kuphawula uXulu.Isolezwe lizame ukukhuluma noButhelezi, kodwa wacela ukuba kukhulunywe noChiliza.Okhulumela i-IFP, uMnuz Mkhuleko Hlengwa, uthe uDuma usekukhombise kaningi ukuthi akamamukeli uButhelezi njengoNdunankulu kaZulu.UHlengwa utshele abeNewzroom Afrika ukuthi sekukaningi ubuholi be-ANC KwaZulu-Natal bubukela phansi iSilo.Uthe abazi ukuthi uButhelezi wayefuna ukuthini ngesikhathi ephucwa umbhobho."Simthintile uButhelezi sifuna ukumbuza ngale nto. Besikhathazwa ukuthi sekuthinteka igama le-IFP. Usitshele ukuthi lokhu abefuna ukukusho ubengunyaziwe iSilo.”Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kukaDuma ayizange iphumelele njengoba ucingo lwakhe belukhala lungabanjwa, ekazange awuphendule nombuzo awuthunyelwe.NgeSonto uDuma utshele abeNewzroom Afrika ukuthi uButhelezi wayengekho ohlelweni lwangoMgqibelo.Uthe isikhundla sikaNdunankulu kaZulu asikho kuMthethosisekelo.Usole uButhelezi ngokusebenzisa isikhundla sakhe ukulwa izimpi zepolitiki.
OMELE iBuild One SA Movement (Bosa) embangweni wesikhundla sikaNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal uMnuz Ntokozo Biyela ukhala ngamathuba okufukula umnotho wesifundazwe athi awasetshenziswa.UBiyela uthe iKwaZulu-Natal ingaba yisikhondlakhondla kwezomnotho uma kungasetshenziswa amathuba akhona.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma neSolezwe lapho ephawula khona ngokuqokwa kwakhe ukungenela umbango wesikhundla sikaNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal.UBiyela uthembise ukusebenzisa lamathuba ezomnotho ukufukula iKwaZulu-Natal uma benqoba okhethweni oluzayo.Uthe iKwaZulu-Natal inamachweba amabili amakhulu, elaseThekwini nelaseRichard’s Bay, angasetshenziswa ngokugcwele."Maningi amathuba akhona kula machweba, kuphinde kube nezimayini ezingakatholakali. Uma kungavulwa lezi zimayini, maningi amathuba angavela,” kusho uBiyela.Umbango wokuhola iKwaZulu-Natal mkhulu, lesi sifundazwe singesesibili ngokwesibalo sabantu abaningi ababhalisele ukuvota.UBiyela uthe babheke ukuthi intsha kube yiyona ezobaweza embangweni wokuhola isifundazwe.Kubantu abangu-27.79 million ababhalisele ukuvota kuzwelonke, abangu-11.7 million baneminyaka ephakathi kuka-18 no-39."Umbango mkhulu kakhulu KwaZulu-Natal, sizibona sinethuba. Konke kusezandleni zabantu bakhona. Kukubona ukuthi ngabe bayafuna yini ukuholwa abaholi abanamava, sizokhuluma nentsha, siyicele ukubambisana nathi."Sizoyinxusa ngokuhambisana nathi ngoba inhloso enkulu yethu ukwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi iba nekusasa eliqhakazile,” kuqhuba uBiyela.Udalule ukuthi balungiselela ukwethula umqulu wezethembiso KwaZulu-Natal cishe ngo-Ephreli yize usudlulile okazwelonke, bebesalindele ukuthi kumenyezelwe ozomela iqembu kulesi sifundazwe.UBiyela ongowokuzalwa eNquthu, useke wabamba izikhundla ezahlukene ezinkampanini ezinkulu usekulungele ukuphatha iKwaZulu-Natal kanti akawangabazi amava anawo.Isimemezelo sokuthi uBiyela uzomela iBosa kwesobundunankulu ngoLwesihlanu kanti nguyena kuphela osamenyezelwe kweso balesi sifundazwe.Okhulumela iBosa kuzwelonke uMnuz Roger Solomons uthe bakhethe ukuqala KwaZulu-Natal ngenxa yombango oshisa phansi khona.
OMELE iDA embangweni wesikhundla sikandunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Chris Pappas, uthembisa ukuqala isibonelelo sabafuna imisebenzi uma benqoba ukhetho esifundazweni.UPappas uthe bafuna ukunika intsha imali yokugibela ukuze kube lula uma iyofuna imisebenzi.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ethula umqulu wezethembiso zokhetho weDA KwaZulu-Natal, eVerulam, ngoMgqibelo.Ukwethulwa komqulu waKwaZulu-Natal kulandela ukwethulwa komqulu weDA kazwelonke owethulwa ngenyanga eyedlule.UPappas uthe abantu abaningi bagcina belahla ithawula ekufuneni imisebenzi ngenxa yokweswela imali yokugibela."Kunzima ukuba ngumuntu ofuna umsebenzi. Kufanele ube nemali yokugibela ekubeni ungaholi ndawo. Ingakho sizoqhamuka nesibonelelo ukuze abantu abasha bezokwazi ukuyofuna imisebenzi.”UPappas uthembise ukusungula amathuba emisebenzi angu-300 000 uma enikwa ithuba lokuphatha.Uthe lokhu uzokwenza ngokutshala imali kwingqalasizinda nakwezomnotho."Uma ngikhuluma ngamathuba emisebenzi, angikhulumi ngamatoho lawa i-ANC ehlezi iwathembisa ohlelweni lwemisebenzi yomphakathi. Ngicela ningizwe kahle, akukho okubi ngemisebenzi yomphakathi kodwa iqiniso ukuthi iyimisebenzi yesikhashana. Imisebenzi yomphakathi ayisona isisombululo sokuqeda indlala. Uma ngikhuluma ngokudalwa kwamathuba emisebenzi, ngisho imisebenzi lapho abantu bezoqashwa khona ngokugcwele.”UPappas uthe ngeke abalahle labo abaneminyaka engaphezu kuka-35."Abaneminyaka engaphezu kuka-35 basele dengwane, abanikwa amathuba emisebenzi. Uma ngikhethwa njengondunankulu, ngizoqhamuka nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa abantu abaneminyaka engu-35.”UPappas uthe ukucishwa kukagesi kuphazamisa imizamo yokudala amathuba emisebenzi."Ngizokwandisa umthamo kagesi esinawo ngokuthenga ugesi ezinkampanini ezizimele, sisebenzise nezinye izinhlobo zikagesi. Indaba yokuthembela kwi-Eskom ikhona okusilimazayo. Uma kunikwa abanye abantu ithuba lokuthi basihlinzeke ngogesi, kuzokwenza ukuthi sibe nogesi omningi, namanani kagesi azokwehla.”UPappas ukhale ngezinga eliphezulu lobugebengu KwaZulu-Natal.Uthe bafuna kusungulwe uphiko lwamaphoyisa aKwaZulu-Natal."Ngizolwela ukuthi kusungulwe uphiko lwamaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal. Lolu phiko ngifuna luhlinzekwe ngezinsiza, amaphoyisa aqeqeshwe futhi kungabi khona ukugxambukela kosopolitiki ezindabeni ezithinta amaphoyisa. Angeke sithembele kungqongqoshe wamaphoyisa ukuthi uzokulwa nobugebengu ekubeni ezihlalele ePitoli. Sifuna amaphoyisa azokwazi izinkinga esibhekene nazo emiphakathini yethu.”
UMNYANGO wezaseKhaya uthe awuzixoshi izivakashi ezinama-visa asephelelwe yisikhathi zinelungelo lokuwavuselela. UNgqongqoshe walo Mnyango, uDkt Aaron Motsoaledi, ukusho lokhu esithangamini nabezindaba izolo. Kulesi sithangami uMotsoaledi ubezochaza ngesekhula eyasusa umsindo eyayithi zonke izivakashi ezinama-visa asephelelwe yisikhathi sezinsuku ezingu-90, ezingawavuselelanga kumele zibuyele emazweni azo ngoFebhuwari 23. Uthe okwakushiwo kule sekhula kwezwakala sengathi kuxoshwa izivakashi ezihlala zivakashela amazwe ehlukene uma kusehlobo ekubeni leli lizwe lizidinga kakhulu izivakashi kanti kwakukhunjuzwa abasebenza ngaphakathi ngomthetho. Uthe isiliphu sokuvuselela sinikeza ovuselele i-visa ilungelo lokuthi ahlale, kuze kube umnyango uyaphendula.Uthe le sekhula kwakungeyokuxhumana ngaphakathi yagcina isifinyelele kwabezindaba, okudale ukuthi kuzwakale sengathi umnyango wakhe uxosha izivakashi ezaziwa ngama-Sun Chasers, ezifika kuleli njalo uma kuqala ihlobo okujwayele ukuthi kube ngu-Okthoba zihambe uma sekungena ubusika ziye emazweni okusuke kuyisehlobo kuwo."Mhlawumbe kwakumele singayibhali isekhula, sisebenzise izindlela zangaphakathi zokuxhumana ngoba sasifuna ukukhumbuza abasemingceleni ngale mithetho ekhona kuleli. Siyasebenzisana noMnyango wezokuVakasha," kuchaza uMotsoaledi.'Uthe kusukela kuphume isekhula kuvela ukuthi ziyisithupha izivakashi ezithintekile kodwa udaba lwazo lulungisiwe." Akuyona into entsha ukuthi uma usuphelelwe isikhathi sokuba sezweni elithize kusuke kumele uvuselele i-visa, nakwamanye amazwe lolu uhlelo lukhona. Kwamanye amazwe ushayelwa ucingo ukhunjuzwe, thina ukwenza kanjalo ngoba ubuchwepheshe esibusebenzisayo abukwenzi lokho," kugcizelela uNgqongqoshe.UNgqongqoshe wezokuVakasha, uNkk Patricia De Lille, ephawula, uthe isekhula yezwakala sengathi izivakashi ziyaxoshwa okwafaka ingebhe kwabakulo mkhakha ngoba basatabalasa ekubuyiseni izivakashi kusukela kwahlasela iCovid-19."Siyajabula ukuthi uNgqongqoshe usecacisile ngale sekhula, uke wacacisa ePhalamende kodwa bekumele aphinde acacise futhi ukuze wonke umuntu aqonde,” kusho uNkk De Lille.
IZINHLANGANO ezibhekelele abaphila ngezibonelelo kuleli zithi kuyihlazo ukwenyuswa kwemali eyisibonelelo sabangasebenzi u-R350 ngo-R20.UNgqongqoshe wezeziMali, uMnuz Enoch Godongwana, uthe isibonelelo sabangasebenzi esiwu-R350, sizoqala ukukhokhwa sesiwu-R 370 ngo-Ephreli 1, nonyaka. UGodongwana usho lokhu ekhuluma ePhalamende, ngesikhathi ecacisa ngodaba lokwenyuswa kwemali kuleli ngeledlule.Lesi sibonelelo saqala ngo-2020, ngenhloso yokusiza abaphelelwa umsebenzi ngesikhathi kuhlasele iCovid-19 kodwa izinhlangano ezimele abahola izibonelelo ezingaphansi kweGlobal Reformed Advocacy Platforms for Engagement (GRAPE) zithi, uR20 ngeke wenze mehluko kwabahola le mali.UNkk Bukelwa Hans ongumdidiyeli uthe lesi sibonelelo asikaze sinyuswe selokhu saqala ukuba khona, ngaphezu kwalokho, ukudla kwenyuke kakhulu okwenza ukuthi abahola lesi sibonelelo bangakwazi ngisho ukuthenga ukudla okuzohlala isonto ngale mali."Ngale mali abahola lesi sibonelelo bathenga ukudla okuhlala izinsuku ezimbili kuya kwezintathu, bekungagcono ukuthi yenyuswe ngo-R90 obekungenza ukuthi okungenani bakwazi ukuthenga ukudla okuzoqeda isonto. Le mali kwesinye isikhathi ifakwa emabhange, amabhange athathe izindleko zawo, abahola le mali bagcine behola ubala," kusho yena.Uthe uyazi ukuthi uNgqongqoshe wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi, uNkk Lindiwe Zulu, wathi bangu-11 million ababhalisele lesi sibonelelo kodwa uyazi ukuthi bangu-9 million abasiholayo."Uhulumeni ngokubona kwethu ubengakwazi ukwenyusa ngemali ethe xaxa ukube ubonisana nabantu abathintekayo, angathathi izinqumo engenalo ulwazi. Okunye okufaka ngcindezi intela yentengo iVAT efakwa uma uthenga. Kwabampofu le ntela yenza izinto zibe nzima kakhulu," kusho yena.IPhini likaNgqongqoshe woMnyango wezoBulungiswa kuleli, uMnuz John Jeffrey, ephawula mayelana nalesi sibonelo nokuthi sisiza ekutheni abantu bathole ilungelo lokudla kakhululazi izingane, uthe lesi sibonelelo sengeza phezu kwezinye izibonelelo ezikhona ezifana nesibonelelo sezingane nokuthi izingane ziyadla ezikoleni."Sasenzelwe ukuthi sisize abantu abaphelelwa umsebenzi kakhulukazi ngo-2020 ngesikhathi kuhlasele iCovid-19," kugcizelela uJeffrey.Ngenyanga edlule, izinhlangano ezizibiza nge- Alternative Information and Development Centre (AIDC), okuyi-Amandla PE Forum, iBack to Work Campaign (B2WC), iBlack Sash, iCry of the Xcluded, iFight Inequality Alliance South Africa, iGlobal Reformed Advocacy Platforms for Engagement (GRAPE), i-Institute for Economic Justice (IEJ), i#PayTheGrants, iTreatment Action Campaign (TAC), iTrust for Community Outreach and Education (TCOE) ne-350Africa.org, zimashe ngaphambi kokuthi kwethulwe isabelomali salo nyaka. Bezifuna ukuthi ukuhulumeni anikeze isibonelelo esiqala ku-R1 500, kumiswe ukuncishiswa kwesabelomali, kukhushulwe intela kwabacebile, kuphinde kunikezwe izidingongqangi zamahhala kubo bonke abadla imbuya ngothi, uhulumeni aqhamuke namanye amasu okuphatha izikweletu zomphakathi.

I-Library and Information Association of South Africa (LIASA) ikumema ukuthi ugubhe i-South African Library Week (SALW) 2024, ibambisene noMnyango wobuCiko, amaSiko, i-Sabinet ne-EBSCO, – ngaphansi kwendikimba ethi "ethi "Libraries foster social cohesion”, okusho ukuthi "Imitapo yolwazi yakha ukuzwana kwemiphakathi ehlukene”.Yonke imitapo yolwazi ezweni isebenzisa lo mcimbi waminyaka yonke odonsa isonto lonke njengethuba lokuqhakambisa ukukhangisa imisebenzi yayo ebantwini, umphakathi wonkana, izinhlangano zomphakathi nabantu abathatha izinqumo. Inhloso ngukubaneqhaza ekutheni abantu baqonde iqhaza elibalulekile lemitapo yolwazo ezweni elinamalungelo abantu. Imitapo yolwazi isabalalisa ukukwazi ukufunda nokubhala, igcwalise ilungelo lamuntu elinqala lokukwazi ukutho ulwazi futhi igqugquzele ukubekezelelana nokuhloniphana phakathi kwabantu baseNingizimu Afrika.Le ndikimba igcizelela iqhaza elimqoka lemitapo yolwazi ekuhlanganiseni imiphakathi, njengoba eyizindawo lapho abantu abavela emiphakathini ehlukene behlangana khona ukucobelelana ngemibono, ukufunda bahlangane nangemicimbi yamasiko nemfundo. Ngokwenza kutholakale ulwazi, ubuchwepheshe, izinsizakusebenza nezinhlelo, imitapo yolwazi yandisa ulwazi, ihlanganise abantu futhi yenze ukuthi abantu bazizwe benenjongo eyodwa futhi beyinto eyodwa. Imitapo yolwazi ihlinzeka izindawo eziphephile emiphakathini encisheke amathuba ukuthi abhekane nezindaba zenhlalo nezentuthuko, bacobelelana ngolwazi futhi igqugquzele ukuhlalisana phakathi kwemiphakathi engafani.I-SALW izogujwa phakathi komhlaka-18 kuya mhlaka-24 Mashi.UMnyango wezeMidlalo, eZobuciko namaSiko uchaza ukuhlalisana kwemiphakathi engafani "njengezinga lokuhlangana ngokuhlalisana nokuhlanganiswa kwemiphakathi yesizwe sonke nezinga lokubonakala kokuzwelana phakathi kwabantu nemiphakathi”.Funda iziphephabhuku lobuchwepheshe le-LIASA SALW 2024 lapha: Imitapo yolwazi yandisa ukuhlalisana emphakathini ngokufaka wonke umuntuUkuhlanganisa abantu yinsika yemitapo yolwazi. Kulapho wonke umuntu emukeleke khona, iyizindawo ezakha ukuxhumana nokuthembana phakathi kwamaqoqo angefani emphakathini. Imitapo yolwazi ineqhaza elimqoka ekuhlalisaneni abantu kwabantu emphakathini ngokwenza ukuthi wonke umuntu abeneqhaza, ikhuthaze ingxoxo futhi igqugquzele ukuhloniphana kwabantu abavela ezindaweni ezingafani. Yenza imisebenzi yayo ihambisane nezidingo zemiphakathi, igqugquzele ukuthi abantu bahlale befunda futhi yeseke umsebenzi wokuthi abantu bakwazi ukufunda nokubhala.Imitapo yolwazi yandisa ukuhlalisana emphakathini ngokweseka izinjongo zentuthukoImitapo yolwazi ineqhaza elimqoka ekwandiseni ukuhlalisana emphakathini ngokweseka imikhankaso ehlose ukulekelela izinjongo zentuthuko emhlabeni, kuthi ngaleyo ndlela ilekelele ukubhekana nezinselelo zentuthuko ezikhona ezweni nasemhlabeni. Yenza ukuthi abantu bakwazi ukuthola ulwazi futhi kuxazululeke, phakathi kwezinye izinto, ukungalingani ngokwenhlalo nangokomnotho, ulwazi ngezinto ezithinta ukuvikela isimo sezulu nokuvikela imveloImitapo yolwazi isabalalisa ukukwazi ukufunda nokubhala, igcwalise ilungelo lamuntu elinqala lokukwazi ukutho ulwazi futhi igqugquzele ukubekezelelana nokuhloniphana phakathi kwabantu baseNingizimu Afrika.Isithombe: FreepikImitapo yolwazi yakha ukuhlalisana emphakathini ngemfundoImitapo yolwazi ibhukulela ukuletha ukuhlalisana emphakathini ngokuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo zemfundo ezakha isimilo emiphakathini. Ngalezi zinhlelo, imitapo yolwazi igqugquzela ukuqondeka kwamasiko, imilando, umlando wezindawo namasiko okwehlukene futhi igqugquzela ukubekezelana nokwandisa amakhono okukwazi ukufunda nokubhala, okuyizinto ezidengeka kakhulu ekuhlalisaneni kwabantu.Imitapo yolwazi ikhuthaza ukuhlalisana ngobuchwephesheImitapo yolwazi ivala igebe lobuchwepheshe ngokuhlinzeka ngolwazi nangobuchwepheshe bokuxhumana nokusebenzisana nemiphakathi ngezinkundla zokuxhumana namaziko kwesimanjemanje. Ahlomisa abantu nemiphakathi ngokwakha imiphakathi exhumene nengasele ngaphandle ezintweni. KUHLOSWE ukudala imisebenzi, kuliwe nokunqamuka kukagesi futhi kuthuthukiswe imiphakathi ngohlelo oluzocija ngamakhono intsha engu-6 000 eThekwini.IMeya yeTheku uMnuz Mxolisi Kaunda nabeKwaZulu-Natal Education Development Trust basayine isivumelwano sokusebenzisana ngoLwesihlanu.IMEYA yeTheku uMnuz Mxolisi Kaunda omemezele ukuthi kuzoqeqeshwa intsha engu-6 000 ngamakhono emisebenzi Isithombe: SithunyelweSisayinwe esikhungweni iShukela Training Centre, eMount Edgecombe. Imeya ithi intsha izoqeqeshwa kulesi sikhungo esifundisa imisebenzi enhlobonhlobo.UKaunda uthe lo luhlelo lugxile kwezamandla ngakho-ke intsha izoqeqeshelwa ubuchwepheshe bama-solar."Izozibeka emathubeni amahle ukuthi ithathwe yizimboni ezizimele nohulumeni usebenze kwezithinta ingqalasizinda kagesi."Lo luhlelo luzokwenza intsha ibe yingxenye yohlelo lukamasipala lokuphehla ugesi kusetshenziswa indlela yesimanje” kusho uKaunda.Uthe ugesi ozotholakala kulindeleke ukuthi usetshenziswe ezikoleni, ezibhedlela nasemitholampilo nasemiphakathini.Uqhubeke ngokuthi kubalulekile ukuhlomisa intsha ngolwazi nangamakhono adingekayo, kwazise izwe libhekene nengwadla kagesi."Ukuze izwe likwazi ukubhekana nenkinga kagesi, kubalulekile ukucija intsha ngamakhono ngoba yiyona eyikusasa la lelizwe. "Sijabule ngesivumelwano esisayindiwe esizodala amathuba emisebenzi angu-6 000 entsheni eyakhele iTheku,” kuchaza uKaunda.Isigaba sokuqala sohlelo kulindeleke ukuthi kufakwe ama-solar panels ne bio-gas digester ezikoleni.Uhlelo lwesibili kuthiwa luzogxila ezikhungweni zempilo bese kuthi olokugcina kufakwe amalambu azokhanyisa emalokishini nasemakhaya.UKaunda uthe lokhu kuzolekelela ekulweni nobugebengu ikakhulukazi uma ucishiwe ugesi ngenhloso yokuwonga.Uphethe ngokuthi intsha ayizoqeqeshelwa nje ukuthi uma isiqedile ifune imisebenzi kodwa bafuna uma isiqedile izimele ngokuvula amabhizinisi ayo iqashe abanye.
SEKUQUBUKE impi yamazwi phakathi kwabaholi be-ANC nabe-IFP kulandela ukugqenywa izingozi kwamalungu e-ANC abehambele umcimbi wokukhumbula iSilo uDinuzulu kaCetshwayo.I-ANC yenze izinsolo zokuthi amalungu alimale emcimbini obuKwaCeza, ashaywe ngamalungu e-IFP. I-ANC ithe amalungu ayo ahlaselwe amalungu e-IFP aqhamuka ehostela.Kepha i-IFP iyaziphika lezi zinsolo ethe azinabufakazi, isabisa nokubika udaba kwinhlangano eyengameli ukhetho, i-Independent Electoral Commission.Amalungu e-ANC ayisishiyagalolunye aphuthunyiswe esibhedlela kukubi, emva kokuthelekelwa abantu abebephethe izinduku.Oyedwa kuthiwa ubusesimweni esingagwinyisi mathe, emva kokuquleka.Ezinkundleni zokuxhumana kusabalale izithombe ebezikhombisa amalungu e-ANC ebhandishile emakhanda. Kunezwi eliqoshiwe elisabalale ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, ebelibabaza isihluku."Sihlalo, uma ikhona indlela awuzame ukuyibika kubuholi besifundazwe le nto. Sesibulewe nenduku, isisibulele Inkatha ngenduku lapha KwaCeza. Amaqabane amaningi asefile induku, asesibhedlela kuyimanje.”Lesi sigameko senzeke umcimbi usuphelile, izicukuthwane okubalwa kuzo iSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini noMengameli, uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa, bese behambile.Ezinye izicukuthwane bezisadla endaweni ebezihlelelwe yona, kanti amalungu omphakathi wona abesahleli etendeni, ejabulela izingoma ebezidlala emsakazweni.Osinde kulesi sigameko ocele ukuba igama lakhe lingadalulwa, uthe bathelekelwe iviyo elifike kamumva, umcimbi usuphelile."Amabutho abengasekho, abesesendaweni abehlelelwe yona ngesikhathi kwenzeka isigameko. Laba bantu bafike ngamakhumbi, begqoke izikibha ezimhlophe nezibomvu. Bafike bashaya abantu abebefake izikibha ze-ANC. Bebeqinisa kakhulu ekhanda.”Okhulumela i-ANC kuzwelonke, uNkk Mahlengi Bhengu-Motsiri, uthe bafuna amaphoyisa aphenye ngokuhlaselwa kwamalungu enhlangano yabo."Kuyadumaza ukuhlaselwa kwamalungu e-ANC emva komcimbi obe impumelelo. Siyazi ukuthi kunemizamo yokuqeda udlame lwezepolitiki KwaZulu-Natal. Kufanele kubhekwane nalabo abasabhebhezela udlame. Sithanda ukukhumbuza labo abasagqugquzela udlame ukuthi udlame saluqeda ngo-1994. Sinxusa abantu baKwaZulu-Natal ukuthi baziqhelelanisa nalabo abagqugquzela udlame.”Okhulumela i-IFP, uMnuz Mkhuleko Hlengwa, uthe i-ANC ibathela ngodaka, wathi ithuswa yimpumelelo yabo.Uthe kufanele kusolwe uSihlalo we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Siboniso Duma, ngokwedelela isihlalo sobukhosi bukaZulu emcimbini wangoMgqibelo."Thina kade sinomcimbi wokwethula izethembiso zokhetho obe yimpumelelo. Siyaqhubeka nokunqoba izinketho zokuchibiyela. Ukukhula kwe-IFP kuyabatatazelisa. Okunzima ukuthi noDuma ngapha naye wenza okubheke eceleni. Ukhombise ukungasihloniphi isihlalo nomengameli wabo. Benza izinsolo ngaphandle kokuletha ubufakazi.”
ISILO uMisuzulu kaZwelithini sizibonele okokuqala selokhu singene esihlalweni isisusa samafindo angaqaqiwe kwezombusazwe KwaZulu-Natal ngesikhathi uSihlalo we-ANC esifundazweni uMnuz Siboniso Duma eyabula umbhobho kusakhuluma uNdunankulu wesizwe uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi. UButhelezi ubuye abe yilungu lesigungu esiphezulu se-IFP. Lesi sigameko sithele ngechilo iSilo uMisuzulu noMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa kulo mcimbi wokukhumbula iSilo uDinuzulu kaCetshwayo obukwaCeza ngempelasonto. Ibabaza Inyosi yeSilo, uMnuz Buzetsheni Mdletshe, ebikhona, ithe ayikaze ihlangabezane nesimo esinje eminyakeni eminingi isebenza neSilo esesabuza uZwelithini. UMdletshe uthe kufanele kushwelezwe njengoba kugcine kuchitheka igazi, kwashaywa namalungu e-ANC agcine elashwe ezibhedlela."Ingonyama noRamaphosa bathelwe ngegazi. Uma betholakala labo abenze lo mkhuba, kufanele baboshwe. Kodwa-ke obenze umcimbi kufanele ashweleze.”Ukukhathazeka kukaMdletshe kuzwakaliswe nawungoti wezamasiko, nomhlaziyi wezepolitiki abakuchaze njengechilo ukudonsisana kukaMphathiswa (wezokuThuthukiswa koMnotho), uDuma, noMfu Buthelezi, phambi kweSilo noRamaphosa.Umdonsiwano uqale ngesikhathi uDuma ephuca uButhelezi umbhobho wokukhuluma. UButhelezi, obezokwethula iSilo, uqale inkulumo yakhe ngokuncoma uRamaphosa ngokuhlonipha ubukhosi bukaZulu.Inkinga iqale ngesikhathi uButhelezi ecela uhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal ukuba ubukele kuRamaphosa, uhloniphe iSilo. UDuma uvele wasukuma wadumela umbhobho wokukhuluma ngesikhathi uButhelezi ebiza igama likanobhala we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Bheki Mtolo."Cha ngeke besicela ukuthi sihloniphe umcimbi esize kuwona. Shenge sicela uhlale phansi, uyawona umcimbi weSilo.”UDuma ube eseyalela Inyosi Mdletshe ukuba isukumise iSilo.UMdletshe wenqabile, wathi umthetho awuvumi ukuthi kube nguye osukumisa iSilo ekubeni undunankulu kaZulu ekhona.Lesi sigameko sicasule amabutho avele asukuma, akhuza izaga.UButhelezi ugcine ewunikiwe umbhobho, wabe naye esekhuza izaga ezigadlayo. Izaga azibizile ngesithi, 'wathinta amabhubesi’, esithi 'ikhuzeni lenkukhu’, nesithi 'wathinta uZulu udakwe yini’.Impi yabaholi iqhubekile nangemuva kwenkulumo yeSilo njengoba kubonakale uDuma enqaba ukunikeza uButhelezi umbhobho ngesikhathi kufanele ethule isipho sikaRamaphosa.UDuma ubonakale ezama ukuwunikeza iSilo umbhobho, kodwa ekugcineni wathathwa uButhelezi.Ekhuluma neSolezwe, uchaze ngenqubo eyamukelekile ekwethuleni iSilo, wathi akukho emandleni akhe ukwenza lokhu."Uma engekho undunankulu kuyaye kuthathwe umuntu omdala endlunkulu, kube uye owenza lo msebenzi. Kuyenzeka-ke uma engekho omdala endlunkulu kuloyo mcimbi, bese kuba yinyosi eyenza lowo msebenzi. Naye ngimtshelile uMhlonishwa ukuthi umthetho awuvumi. Okungijabulisile ukuthi naye uButhelezi akasukanga wayohlala phansi. Uqhubekile wama, waze wagcina elitholile ithuba lokwenza umsebenzi wakhe.”Ungoti wezamasiko, uSolwazi Sihawukele Ngubane, uthe okwenzekile kwehlisa isithunzi seSilo."Thina njengoZulu saziwa ngenhlonipho. Kuyasehlisa isithunzi seMbube noZulu uma kuzokwenzeka into enje phambi kweSilo. Kufanele ikhuzwe le nto. Uma iSilo sibukeleka phansi, noZulu uzobukeleka phansi.”Umhlaziyi wezepolitiki wase-University of KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Zakhele Ndlovu, ubabhangqe ngabhadelinye oButhelezi noDuma ethi baziphathise okwezingane.UNdlovu uthe uButhelezi bekungafanele afake ipolitiki emcimbini kahulumeni, wathi noDuma bekufanele azithibe."Basiphoxile, baziphathise okwezingane. UShenge uyena oqale leya nto. UDuma bekufanele amlinde aqede, bese eyamphendula.”UNdlovu uxwayise ngokuthi ukuhlaselwa kwamalungu e-ANC kuzovusa izilonda ezingakapholi."Le nto abayenzile ifana nokubhebhethekisa umlilo oshayo. Izokwenza ukuthi kubhekwane ngeziqu zamehlo. Kubi ngoba le nto yenzeka sibheke okhethweni.”ISilo sikhumbuze abebehambele umcimbi ukuthi siyiSilo samabandla onke."Ngingakaqhubeki nenkulumo yami, ngicela ukunikhumbuza nina beSilo ukuthi nonke njengoba nilapha, nonke ningabami.”

Sithembisa ukwenza ubaba aziqhenye ngathi,” kusho uZiyanda obebuye acaphune amavesi eBhayibheli.Uthe ubethanda umndeni wakhe, abangani nozakwabo.UBeekay ubeyingane yesithathu kuyise uNhlamvana Mchunu nonina uBonakele Mchunu ongasekho.UBeekay ushiye emhlabeni izingane zakhe eziyisithupha, odadewabo nabafowabo abayisishiyagalolunye sebebonke.Umfowabo kaBeekay, uSifiso, uthe bebefisa ukumngcwaba kwesaKwaMthethwa lapho azalwa khona kodwa umholi wamaNazaretha aseBuhleni uNyazi, lwanqaba lubuza ukuthi kukhona bani khona?"Ngithe mina ukhona ubaba omncane. Wabuza ukuthi akude kangakanani amathuna? Ngithe athe ukuqhela. Wathi ngeke uBeekay angcwatshwe kanjalo, phela inkosi le. Bazophalazela kuye bagezele kuye. Zama indlela, ngithi mina angazi baba lapho esikhona. Sebakuvala ukuthi uma wakhe ngaleyo ndlela ungcwabe egcekeni. Uthe hamba ukhulume noZungu,” kusho uSifiso.Uthe usuke kuNyazi ephithene ikhanda kodwa iNkosi uZungu yavuma.Enkonzweni yomngcwabo abantu bebephume ngobuningi babo, abanye beyithamele bukhoma kwiFacebook ekhasini leNcanda Funerals lapho ebisakazwa khona.Uhlelo beluphethwe nguLinda Sibiya, Dudu Khoza noNgizwe Mchunu.Bekukhona abasakazi, izikhulu zikahulumeni, osomabhizinisi nabanye.
NKOSIKHONA CELEUGQIGQA ezinkantolo umfundisi waseZayoni iSolezwe Ngempelasonto elabika kabanzi ngaye nyakenye, ngesikhathi kuvela ukuthi ulobole abesifazane abangu-22.UMfu Zamani Shozi webandla iGalile, kuvela ukuthi akukho ukuphumula kuyena, ugqiga ezinkantolo ezahlukene zaKwaZulu Natal ngamacala ehlukene.NgoLwesibili, uShozi ubekade evele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaKwaDukuza ngecala lokushaya kabi alimaze owesifazane esithweni sakhe sangasese. Lo wesifazane ungomunye walaba abalobolile.Kulelo cala iMantshi uM. Blose yathi ilihlehlisela uLwesihlanu oluzayo ngoba kusanophenyo olunzulu olumayelana nesigameko okumele luphothulwe."Icala lakho inkantolo iyalihlehlisa ukuze kuqhutshekwe nolunye uphenyo mayelana nalo lolu daba,’’ kubeka uBlose.UQWEMBE oluveza ukuthi uShozi uyiphoyisaYamtshela ukuthi isicelo sakhe sebheyili sizobuye senziwe uma selutholakale lonke ulwazi oludingekayo ngecala abhekene nalo.Mayelana naleso sigameko sokushaya owesifazane, kuvela ukuthi wamlimaza kabi ngemuva kwengxabano ababa nayo. Kuthiwa lo wesifazane wayesetholile ukuthi uShozi ulobole inqwaba yabesifazane.Ephawula ngaleso sigameko lo wesifazane ocele ukuba okwamanje ligodlwe igama lakhe, uthe ufisa ukumbona ebolela ejele uShozi.Wamchaza njengowesilisa ombethe isikhumba semvu kanti uyimpisi. "Unesihluku nangu umfundisi wabantu. Empilweni yami yonke mina angikaze ngize ngokuthole ukuhlukumezeka okunjena,'' usho kanje.NgoLwesine, uShozi uphinde wavela enkantolo yasePinetown ngecala lokushushumbiswa kwemali. Icala lakhe lihlehliselwe inyanga ezayo.NgoMeyi 24, kuwona lo nyaka kuvela ukuthi uzovela eNkantolo yaseMgungundlovu ngecala lokweba amatekisi amane omunye wesifazane ayesemlobolile.Ngesikhathi iSolezwe Ngempelasonto libika kabanzi ngoShozi, lakuveza ukuthi nasebandleni ujola nenqwaba yabesifazane.Laveza nesigqebhe sekhadi lomgunyathi ayezenza ngalo iphoyisa.Kunomunye wesifazane ocele ukuba ligodlwe igama lakhe, yena ukhala ngokuthi weba u-R85 000 wakhe.Kuvela ukuthi uShozi walihamba lelo cala isikhashana kodwa laphela ngendlela engaqondakali.Ngokombiko owashicilelwa yileli phephandaba, uShozi ucathamela abesifazane ababukeka bemi kahle ngasezimalini. Abesifazane abaphumela obala baveza ukuthi usheshe afune ukuyolobola enza nemicimbi ehambisana nalokho njengemembeso ibe wubukhazikhazi. Emva kwalokho, bathi ushaya achithe nezinto zakho. Abanye babala izimoto anyamalala nazo, abanye bamsola ngokubaqola izizumbulu ethi abatshale imali enkampanini mbumbulu athi ngeyakhe.
ISITHUNZI senhlangano yokhetho kuleli i-IEC sifana neqanda elidinga ukuphathwa ngobukhulu ubunono okungathi uma lifa, kube kuphelile. Siyahlonishwa isithunzi se-IEC futhi kuyohlala kunjalo kodwa nonyaka isimo sibucayi kakhulu ngenxa yokhetho oluzayo.Ukhetho lwangoMeyi 29, lufana nomdlalo womkhumulajezi ngoba wonke amehlo azobe ethe njo ngenxa yesasasa elikhona. I-IEC ifana nonompempe ophethe umdlalo wamanqamu wezinkunzi okukade kwasa zithibelene. Akukwazi ukuthi unompempe angathembeki emdlaweni ngoba kusuka umsindo.I-ANC yiyona esemandleni okwamanje selokhu yangena ngo-1994, emva kokukhipha uhulumeni wobandlululo. Ukwehla kokwesekwa kweqembu kancane kancane, sekwenze kwanemibono yokuthi ingase ihluleke wukunqoba ukhetho. Umbono oqhutshwa ngamanye amaqembu.Kuyaziwa ezweni lonke ukuthi kuzoshiyana ukwenza phakathi kwamaqembu okhethweni olungoMeyi 29 nonyaka, lapho kuyogezelwana khona. Ukhetho lwezwe lubalulekile ngoba lunikeza abantu ithuba lokukhetha uhulumeni abamfunayo.Kuleli uhulumeni ubekelwa iminyaka emihlanu, emuva kwalokho kubuyelwe okhethweni kunikwe abantu ithuba lokukhetha kabusha.Iyini inhlangano yokhetho i-IEC ?I-Independent Electoral Commission (IEC), yinhlangano yokhetho ezimele eNingizimu Afrika, eyasungulwa ngo-Okthoba 17, 1996. Izwe laliqeda ukuphuma kuhulumeni wobandlululo lingena kuhulumeni wentando yeningi.Umsebenzi wayo wukusingatha ukhetho olukhululekile, nolungachemile esigabeni sikazwelonke, izifundazwe nokomasipala emazingeni aphansi.I-IEC ingena ngaphansi kohlu lwezikhungo ezibizwa ngeChapter 9, ezinjengehhovisi loMvikeli woMphakathi, neSouth African Human Rights Commission (SAHRC). Izikhungo zinomsebenzi omkhulu futhi onzima wokuhlonipha imigomo yomthethosisekelo wentando yeningi.I-IEC ivamile ukuthi uma yenza umsebenzi wayo kube khona abayikhomba ngeminwe uma bengenelisekile ngemiphumela yokhetho.Okwenza ukuthi i-IEC ibe wundabamlonyeni kulokhu wukuthi sekukhona ukukhuluma okwandile okuthi kufanele ibhekwe ingakhwabanisi amavoti ilekelele inhlangano ebusayo kuleli. I-DA ibhale incwadi icela usizo e-USA, ithi kayithembi ukuthi ukhetho luzosingathwa ngendlela efanele. Yacela ukuthi i-USA ithumele izingqapheli ezizibheka ukuthi konke kuhamba okhethweni.Ngaphandle kwalokho kukhona amaqembu akhala ngokuthi othisha abaqashiwe ukuthi bavotise bangamalungu enyunyana iSadtu, edlelana ne-ANC. Bathi lokho kuzokwenza kungethembeki ukuthi bazokwenza umsebenzi ngokujutshwa yi-IEC, ngobuqotho futhi bangachemi.Okunye okucishe kwathunaza isithunzi se-IEC, wukuthi ingene ehlazweni ngemva kokuputshuka kohlu lwamagama abantu abajutshwa ngamaqembu ukuthi babe ngamalungu ePhalamende, emuva kokhetho. Uhlu lwamalungu amaqembu belungakamenyezelwa ngokusemthethweni kodwa kube nesigangi ngaphakathi kwi-IEC.Indlela i-IEC esingathe ngayo udaba ikhombise ubuqotho nobuyoninco ngoba ilusukumele ngokushesha ngoba iyakuqonda ukuthi isithunzi sayo siyikho konke ngakho kufanele isivikele. Isikhulu se-IEC uMnuz Sy Mamabolo, sithe benze uphenyo oluveze ukuthi umkhuba usekhaya."Imiphumela yophenyo lwethu lokuqala ikhomba ukuthi kukhona omunye wabasebenzi oputshuze uhlu esebenzisa amakhompyutha ethu. Uqede ukwenza lokhu wase elucima uhlu akade eluthumela. Umsebenzi usezobhekana nezinyathelo zokuqondiswa ubugwegwe ngaphakathi,’’ kusho uMamabolo.Kufana nokuthi umsebenzi we-IEC ogile umkhuba uphushele inhlangano esizibeni esinengwenya ngoba isikhathi okwenzeke ngaso lokhu sibucayi. Kubikwe ukuthi umsebenzi we-IEC ugcine exoshiwe emuva kokulahlwa yicala lokwephula umthetho.Esinye isikhulu se-IEC, uNksz Akhtari Henning phambilini sikhale ngabantu abasola i-IEC ngokukhwabanisa ekubeni benganabo ubufakazi."Izinsolo ezingamampunge lezi futhi siyacela ukuthi uma abantu benza izinsolo basisize phela ngobufakazi bese siyaphenya. Thina simile ekutheni sinikwe umsebenzi wokusingatha ukhetho ngokuzimela ngaphandle kokuchema,’’ kuchaza uNksz Akhtari.KULINDELEKE ukuthi ziqine ezokuphepha ezikhungweni zokhetho uma sekuvotwa ngoMeyi nonyaka Isithombe : PHANDO JIKELO/INDEPENDENT MEDIAAkasalanga ngaphandle uMengameli uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa, usigxekile isenzo sokuputshuzwa kohlu lwenhlangano yakhe wathi kuyadumaza futhi kuthunaza umsebenzi we-IEC. "Kuyishwa ukuthi kube khona umuntu omagange ohlulekayo nokuzibamba ojahe ukukhipha uhlu lwe-ANC. Kucekela phansi isithunzi se-IEC lokhu ekubeni kuyisikhungo esisethembayo futhi okufanele sisivikele ngayo yonke indlela,’’ kuphawula uRamaphosa.Lugadwa ngeso lokhozi ukhetho ngoba i-IEC iqeqesha abasebenzi bayo abalusingathayo. Kuba nabamele amaqembu ezikhungweni abagada ukuthi konke kuhamba kahle yini. Kuba khona izingqapheli zokhetho ezivela kwamanye amazwe, ezisuke zizogada ukhetho.Ngaphezu kwalokho kuba khona abezokuphepha ezikhungweni abasuke bezoqinisekisa ukuthi konke kuhamba ngendlela efanele. Uyabona laba abangene ekhaya ekubeni kunesifo impela banesibindi,'' usho kanje.Elinye ilungu lomphakathi elicele ukuba ligodlwe igama lalo liqinisekisile ukuthi kungekudala kuzosuka udungunyane kule ndawo."Ngiyakutshela mina lukhulu udlame oluzayo lapha eMbumbulu. Sikhathele manje ngeke phela size sidlale abantu bedlala ngemfuyo yethu,'' usho kanje sakusonga.UMnuz Zwakele Zondi owebelwe izinkomo ezine ufunge wagomela wathi buzochitheka bugayiwe."’Angeke kulunge phela sidlale abanye abafana. Impela bayisukelile inyoka emgodini wayo,’’ usho kanje.Bonke laba ababelwe imfuyo bathi ababikanga emaphoyiseni ngalokho, kodwa babika enduneni yendawo, uMnuz Simphiwe Msweli.Ngebhadi leli phephandaba lithe lizama ukuxhumana naye ngalezi zinsolo, kwavela ukuthi ubulewe ngenyanga edlule. Uyabona-ke ukuthi uma sekubulewe induna ngenxa yalokhu lungakanani ke udlame olufufusayo kule ndawo?'' usho kanje.Imizamo yokuxhumana nekhansela lakule ndawo, uMnuz Ayanda Ndlovu, iphunzile ucingo belukhala kodwa lungaphendulwa.

"Kulo mkhosi kuzobe kumenywe bonke abake bafunda kulesi sikole, amalungu omphakathi ngokunjalo nabahlobo beGcotsheni abavela emikhakheni ehlukahlukene. Bangaphezu kuka-500 okulindelwe ukuba bathamele umcimbi.”IGcotsheni idume ngokuba yindawo okwazalelwa kuyona ababhali abayizingwazi abanjengoSolwazi uDBZ Ntuli nabanye. USibiya uthe empeleni babalelwa eshumini ababhali abadabuka eGcotsheni futhi zibalelwa ku-200 izincwadi abazibhale ngabodwana noma ngokuhlanganyela. Uthe singakhula kakhulu isibalo sezincwadi uma kubalwa nalezo abazibhale nabalobi bakwezinye izindawo. "Ngokwesibonelo nje, uPB Maphumulo usebhale amanoveli awu-11, imidlalo emide neyomsakazo ewuchungechunge ewu-14, kanti zingaphezu kuka-150 izindaba ezimfushane nemidlalo emifushane eziphume osibeni lwaseGcotsheni. Kusukela ngo1963 kuze nganeno, cishe akekho umuntu ofunde isiZulu esikoleni noma esikhungweni semfundo ephakeme ongakaze ayifunde incwadi, okungenani yombhali oyedwa waseGcotsheni”USibiya, wodumo lwencwadi ethi Bengithi Lizokuna nethi Kuxolelwa Abanjani, uthe bambalwa kakhulu abaziyo ukuthi owayeyisishoshovu somzabalazo owasocongwa ngo-1990, uMbuso Shabalala, wafunda eGcotsheni."Wayekhaliphe ngendlela exakile umfo kaMshengu, evame ukweqiswa amakilasi athile. Sasisagcina kwaStandard 4 (Grade 6)isikole, kwathi phakathi nonyaka uthishanhloko, uMthembu wenza izinhlelo zokuba adlulele kwesinye isikole ukuze ayofunda uStandard 5 (Grade 7), nakhona wafike wabaqwaqwada nanxa wayefike phakathi nonyaka”USibiya uthe ngale kwegalelo kwezemfundo, kwezemibhalo nakwezokulwela inkululeko, likhulu neqhaza labantu abavamile nje baseGcotsheni okwathi noma bengafunde kuyaphi, kokunye bengafunde nhlobo, bakwazi ukusungula amabhizinisi anjengezitolo, ezokuthutha, ezolimo, baphemba amabandla enkolo, babalwa nezikhuthali nakwezinye izinhlaka nemikhakha.USibiya unxuse osomabhizinisi, iminyango kahulumeni nomasipala ukuba baphonse itshe esivivaneni ukuze lo mcimbi ube sezingeni elicokeme. KUVELE ukuvunana kwezitatimende zabamangalelwa ecaleni lokufa kukaSenzo Meyiwa nezofakazi bombuso ababesendlini ngobusuku besigameko. Ofakazi bebelokhu bemile ekutheni kwangena amadoda nokuyiwona adubula uMeyiwa.Kufundwe izitatimende zabamangalelwa kwavela okwashiwo wofakazi kwaze kwavela nezinsolo zokuthi uKelly Khumalo wakhipha uR100 000 ethenga izinkabi.UMeyiwa owayeyintandokazi ye-Orlando Pirates neBafana Bafana, wadutshulwa wabulawa ekubo kwentombi yakhe ewumculi uKelly eVosloorus, eGauteng ngo 2014.Amaphoyisa athi ummangalelwa wokuqala uMuzikawukhulelwa Sibiya nowesibili uBongani Ntanzi, bawavuma amacala basayina nezitatimende. Abamangalelwa bese beziphika izitatimende bethi baphoqwa ukuzisayina kodwa inkantolo yanquma ukuthi zizosebenza.Iphoyisa uLieutenant Colonel Solomon Raphadu elathatha isitatimende kuNtanzi, lisifundile enkantolo.URaphadu uthe wathatha isitatimende kuNtanzi ngoJuni 2020 esiteshini samaphoyisa eMoroka lapho ayeqeqebula khona.Uqhubeke ngokuthi uNtanzi wabhala ukuthi washayelwa ucingo wummangalelwa wesine uMnuz Mthokoziseni Maphisa, emazisa ngomsebenzi ophuthumayo wokubulala uMeyiwa. Isitatimende siveza ukuthi uNtanzi wasuka eNorth West waya eGoli.Kuvela ukuthi bahlanganela ehostela eVosloorus lapho okwaxoxwa khona ngokubulala uMeyiwa." Bangitshela ukuthi uKelly Khumalo ukhiphe umsebenzi wokuthi kubulawe uSenzo Meyiwa. UKUKHULELWA kwabafundi, inkemane ebhekene neminye imindeni, udlame emiphakathini ngezinye zezinto ezenza abafundi balaxaze isikole bengakafiki ebangeni, lika-matric.Lokhu kudalulwe nguMengameli wezwe uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa, okhale ngesihlava sabafundi abalaxa isikole.URamaphosa obekhuluma engqungqutheleni ehlelwe nguMnyango weMfundo eyisiSekelo esongwa kusasa eGoli, uthe kumele kwenziwe okuthile ngokushesha ngale nkinga."Iyakhathaza eyokuthi abafundi abaningi abasuke beqale isikole bagcina bengasiqedanga, bashiya phansi ukufunda. Ziningi izinto ezidala izinkinga okungaba ukukhulelwa kwabafundi, udlame emiphakathini, abanye kudingeka bagade ogogo babo kanti kokunye yinkinga yendlala,” kuchaza uMongameli wezwe.Uqhube wathi kuningi osekwenziwe ngumnyango ukuzama ukugcina abafundi besezikoleni."Okunye kwakho ngukuthi kunohlelo lokudla ezikoleni okuhlomula abafundi abangu-9 million nsuku zonke. Ezikoleni eziningi, cishe u-80% wazo akukhokhwa nhlobo imali yokufunda. Abafundi banikwa izincwadi zokufunda mahhala ezikoleni. Kwabadonsa kanzima kukhona isibonelelo sabantwana ukuze kungabikhona abantu abazobhuqwa yindlala,” kuqhuba uRamaphosa. Ukhale ngezinga eliphezulu labantu abasha abagcina bebhuquza emakhaya bengenzi lutho.Kwenzeka lokhu nje, uNgqongqoshe weMfundo ePhakeme nokuQeqesha uDkt Blade Nzimande, ukhale ngokuthi bambalwa abafundi abafinyelela emanyuvesi kulabo abasuke beqale uGrade 1. UNzimande obekhuluma izolo emhlanganweni nabaqashi eKapa, uveze ukuthi kubafundi abangu-100, abaqala uGrade 1, bayisithupha kuphela abaya emanyuvesi."Umkhakha wasemanyuvesi mkhulu kakhulu kodwa bayisithupha kuphela abafundi abaya khona uma beqeda u-matric. Sizibuza ukuthi u-94 walaba bafundi bayaphi? Abanye bafeyila u-matric, abanye balaxaza isikole bengaqedanga. Esifuna ukukushintsha siwuhulumeni wuhlelo lwezemfundo ngoba ezweni elifana neGermany, u-30% wabaqede isikole baya emanyuvesi, enye ingxenye iya emabhizinisini amancane,” kuchaza uNzimande. Uqhube wathi uhlangana nenqwaba yabaqashi lapho ehamba khona abakhala ngokuthi kukhiqizwa izitshudeni ezingadingwa ngumnotho."Angikwazi ukuthi ngingungqongqoshe ngikhiqize izitshudeni ezidingwa ngumnotho uma kungukuthi abaqashi abavuli amathuba okuqeqesha abasuke bephothule iziqu zabo. Kumele iphele le nkinga yentsha ebhuquza emakhaya, engasebenzi,” kuqhuba uNzimande.USihlalo weNational Education Collaboration Trust uMnuz Sizwe Nxasana, ekhuluma engqungqutheleni yezemfundo, uveze ukuthi kuningi okusamele kwenziwe ukunxenxa abafundi ukuthi benze i-maths.Ukhale ngokuthi bancane abafundi abathatha lesi sifundo wathi bambalwa abenza kahle kusona. Uveze nokuthi kubafundi ababhale lesi sifundo kwa-matric nyakenye, u-6% kuphela wabo abasiphase ngo-60% kuya phezulu.

SEKUXWAYISWE oskhwili phambana nobhoko abasabisa ngokuthi kuzoba nodlame njengoba kuzoba nokhetho lukazwelonke ngoMeyi 29.IKhabhinethi isixwayise ngokuthi labo abasabisa ngokuthi kuzoba nezibhelu, bazobhekana nengalo yomthetho.Lesi sexwayiso sikhishwe nguNgqongqoshe ehhovisi likamengameli uNksz Khumbudzo Ntshavheni, esithangamini nabezindaba izolo ngemuva komhlangano weKhabhinethi.Ubephendula imibuzo yezintatheli ezimbuze ngokuthi iziphi izinyathelo ezizothathelwa labo abasabisa ngodungunyane njengoba kubhekwe okhethweni nokuthi kungenzeka yini umlando uziphinde ngokuthi kube nezibhelu zokutatshwa kwempahla okwenzeka ngoJulayi 2021, ikakhulu KwaZulu-Natal naseGauteng. Ukhetho luzoba ngolukhululekile futhi izinhlaka zomthetho zizoqinisekisa ukuthi kunokuphepha ezweni.” Usho lokhu nje abanye babaholi beqembu elesekwa ngowayengumengameli we-ANC nezwe uMnuz Jacob Zuma, uMkhonto weSizwe, basabise ngokuthi kuzoba nodungunyane uma kungukuthi leli qembu alibi yingxenye yokhetho.NgoLwesithathu umholi wesikhashana wophiko lwentsha lweMK, uMnuz Bonginkosi Khanyile, ekhuluma nabezindaba eGoli, usabise ngokuthi ngeke luhlale ukhetho uma kususwa uZuma ohlwini lokuvota."Uma kususwa iMK noZuma emqulwini wokuvota ngeke lubekhona ukhetho kuleli. Asesabi ukuthi singaboshwa ngalokhu esikushoyo,” kusho uKhanyile.Uthe bayaya enkantolo ukuyobhekana ngqo ne-ANC, ecaleni elithinta umbango wegama kanjalo nophawu elisetshenziswa yileli qembu. Uveze nokuthi sebethuthukise izindawo okwakhiwe kuzo imijondolo ezingu-578, ohlelweni lokuqala wathi kwelesibili bahlela ukuthuthukisa ezingu-1 497. Uthe nophenyo angeke aluphazamise.Ngaphakathi enkantolo bekugcwele njengenjwayelo. Uyise ka-AKA, uTony Forbes, ubekhona ephelezelwa ngonogada bakhe.Ephawula uyise ka-AKA, ukhulume ngalaba abanye ababoshelwe eSwatini angakatholakali amaphepha agunyaza ukuthi babuyiselwe eNingizimu Afrika."Kuzothatha isikhathi, angicabangi ukuthi kuzoshesha ukuthi balethwe ngalapha. Kungenzeka kugcine kuthatha ngisho izinyanga. Angazi ukuthi yindaba singakafakwa isicelo sokuthi balethwe kuleli,'' usho kanje.Uthe uyacabanga ukuthi abamelwe ukwenza loyo msebenzi basamatasa nokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi uyaphumelela.Lolu hlelo ulifanise nomjaho wathi, kuzodingeka isikhathi ukuze kugcine kutholakale iqiniso.Mayelana noMkhwanazi ongumsolwa wokuqala, uthe kunelinye icala athola kulona ibheyili, kodwa futhi ufuna enye ibheyili kuleli lika-AKA."Ngiyazibuza ukuthi njengoba elokhu ebalisa ngomkakhe wayenaye yini ngosuku lokubulawa kwendodana yami?'' usho kanje.Ukhale ngokuthi kuyamxaka manje ukuzwa uMkhwanazi yonke into useyenza ibe mayelana nomkakhe.Ubephendula ukuthi unalo yini uzwelo njengoba kuvela ukuthi unkosikazi kaMkhwanazi uzithwele?"Nami indodana yami inengane eneminyaka engu-8. Konke lokhu okubalwa uMkhwanazi akubalulekile,'' echaza.Okuqaphelekile ngabasolwa abahlanu ukuthi bebengazifihlile kulokhu futhi bebonakala bekhululekile.Ngesikhathi sebehla bebebonakala bebingelela abantu ababaziyo abebesenkantolo.Leli cala lizobuyela enkantolo ngoMsombuluko.
KUVUSELELEKE ufuqufuqu lokuthatha isifundazwe iKwaZulu-Natal okhethweni lwangoMeyi kubaholi be-IFP behlwitha amawadi abephethwe i-ANC.I-IFP yenze i-ANC isilo sengubo iyiphuca amawadi amathathu okhethweni lokuchibiyela obelungoLwesithathu.I-IFP ithathe uWard 12, 19 no-23, kuMasipala waseNewcastle, izikhala kulamawadi zavuleka emva kokusula kwamakhansela e-ANC.Usihlalo we-IFP KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, uthe le miphumela ifike ngesikhathi esihle lapho belungiselela ukhetho oluzayo."Njengoba sibheke okhethweni lukazwelonke nezifundazwe, ukunqoba izinketho zokuchibiyela kuzosigqugquzela kakhulu kuphinde kudlondlobalise umkhankaso wethu wokwakha kabusha iKwaZulu-Natal neNingizimu Afrika. Sizoqhubeka nalo mgqigqo. Sizimisele ngokuletha ushintsho ezimpilweni zabantu baKwaZulu-Natal.”Kuwo wonke amawadi i-IFP izigwazele ibhece kuWard 12 ithole amavoti angu-1 973, yalandelwa i-ANC ngamavoti angu-763.KuWard 19 ithole angu-1 566, ilandelwa i-ANC ngawu-732, kwathi kuWard 23 khona yathola angu-1 498, i-ANC yalandela ngawu-315."Le miphumela ikhombisa ukuthi i-IFP iyakhula. Sibonga abantu baseNewcastle ngokuqhubeka nokusethemba.”Ukunqoba kwe-IFP amawadi amathathu kusho ukuthi sukuyiyo enezihlalo eziningi kulo mkhandlu ewubusa ngokubambisana namaqembu amancane.I-IFP isinezihlalo ezingu-22, ilandelwa i-ANC, enezihlalo ezingu-18.UNtuli, ogaqele esikandunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, unxuse amakhansela amasha ukuba asebenze ngokuzikhandla.I-ANC esifundeni iMbuso Kubheka, ikhale ngomkhonyovu.Unobhala we-ANC kulesi sifunda, uMnuz Chris Mhlophe, uthe bathole ukuthi kunenqwaba yabantu abebebhalisele ukuvota ukhetho lwangoLwesithathu abasebenzisa ikheli elilodwa.Uthe bathe uma bephenya leli kheli bathola ukuthi indawo nje evulekile, engenasakhiwo."Njengamanje sisezinhlelweni zokuvula icala emaphoyiseni, siphinde sifake isikhalazo enhlanganweni eyengamele ukhetho, i-IEC (Independent Electoral Commission). Sifisa ukuthi i-IEC ithathele izinyathelo iqembu lezepolitiki noma amalungu eqembu lezepolitiki okuzotholakala ukuthi enza lo mkhuba. Kuyicala ukuvota endaweni lapho ungahlali khona.”I-ANC ikwaze ukugcina uWard 6 kuMasipala waseMshwathi.Le wadi ibikade ivele iphethwe yiyo i-ANC.Iqembu elisha, uMkhonto weSizwe, elikhombisa ukwenza kahle ezinkethweni zokuchibiyela, bebengazingenelanga izinketho zokuchibiyela ebezingoLwesithathu.Kunamahlebezi athi kunekhansela lomkhandlu waseNewcastle eselisulile, lajoyina uMkhonto weSizwe, nokusho ukuthi kungase kuphinde kube nolunye ukhetho lokuchibiyela kulo masipala.
UKUBEKWA kwemfuyo umaka kuseyiyona ndlela ebonakala ingaba wusizo ekuvikeleni ukwebiwa kwayo.Lokhu kushiwo uMphathiswa wezoLimo KwaZulu-Natal uMnuz Super Zuma ngesikhathi umnyango wethula omaka abasha asebezosebenza kulesi sifundazwe.Lo luhlelo ulwethule izolo ngaphansi kukaMasipala iNkosi Langalibalele maphakathi nesifundazwe.
