Ngonyaka odlule ngo-Agasti nangoNovemba, ngalahlekelwa yizimbuzi nezinkomo eziyisi-7 ngokulandelana kwazo."Kwakubuhlungu ukubona izinkomo zami zithathwa kimi. Kungithathe iminyaka ukuqongelela imali yokuthenga ezinye."Ngomzuzwana ngalahlekelwa yikho konke. Iyangikhuthaza imizamo yomnyango yokunqanda ukwebiwa kwemfuyo. Njengabafuyi sifuna ukubona amasela ebhekana nomthetho,” kusho uNdlovu.UGeneral Khumalo wasesiteshini samaphoyisa i-Upper Tugela, uthe liyakhathaza izinga eliphezulu lokwebiwa kwemfuyo kule ndawo, amanye amacala okwebiwa kwemfuyo aholela ekubulaweni kwabantu."Kuyadumaza ukubona ukuzimisela kwalezi zigebengu. Kuke kwaba nezikhathi lapho ubusela buholele ekutheni kubulawe abalimi. Ngikholelwa ekutheni ukubulawa kwabantu okungenasidingo bekungeke kwenzeke ukuba besisebenzisana."Kuwo wonke amacala esikwaze ukubopha kuwo besisizwa ngamalungu omphakathi asinike umkhondo. Sidinga abantu abaningi ukuthi basisize ukuze sinqobe lezi zigebengu."Siyayibonga imizamo yomnyango futhi sizosebenzisana nawo ukuze siqede ukwebiwa kwemfuyo,” kusho uKhumalo.Inkosi Sifiso Shinga enguSihlalo weNdlu yabaHoli boMdabu KwaZulu-Natal ithe amasela eba imfuyo, aphuca izizukulwane ifa lazo. "Isifundazwe sonke siyahlushwa ngamasela emfuyo.Kubuhlungu ukubona imindeni ilahlekelwa yingcebo yayo. Lezi zigebengu zinonya, siyameseka uhulumeni emizamweni yakhe yokuqeda lobu bugebengu."Ngicela umphakathi usebenzisane namaphoyisa ukuze kuboshwe amasela,” kusho Inkosi uShinga.
UKUDEMBESELA kwabantu ukuhlolwa izifo kufaka ingebhe yokuthi bangahlaselwa izifo ezithinta inhliziyo bengazi. Ucwaningo olwenziwe iDiscovery Vitality phakathi kuka-2019 no-2023 luveza ukuthi abanye bantu kuphela iminyaka emithathu bengazange bahlolwe ukuthi ngabe zikhona yini izifo abanazo egazini, okuholela ekutheni baze bagule kube ima kuvela ukuthi izifo sezinesikhathi zikhona egazini.Lolu cwaningo luveze ukuthi kubantu abangu-10 bakuleli bayisithupha abazihlolayo njalo ngonyaka ukuthi abanazo yini izifo ezibangenile.UDkt Mosima Mabunda, oyinhloko yophiko lokuzinakekela ngokwezempilo, eDiscovery Vitality, uthe ucwaningo lwabo bebelwenza ngokubheka amalungu abo ukuthi ayalulandela yini uhlelo lokuhlolwa ukuthi awanazo yini izifo, bathola ukuthi iningi alizikhathazi ngokwenza lokhu yize line-medical aid. "Emhlabeni wonke, izifo zenhliziyo nesifo sikashukela yizona ezihamba phambili ngokuba yimbangela yokufa kwabantu, ukukhubazeka nokuba nempilo ebuthaka. Kuyashaqisa ukuthi cishe uhhafu wabantu abadala abaphila nomfutho wegazi ophezulu noma isifo sikashukela abazi ukuthi banalezi zifo. Ukuhlaziya kwethu kwakamuva kukhomba ukuthi uma ukuhlolwa kwenziwe kahle kuyasiza ukuze kutholakale ukwelashwa okufanele. Njengoba abantu abaningi bengazi ukuthi banalezi zimo, kusho ukuthi abakutholi ukunakekelwa okudingekayo okwandisa ingozi yokuqhubeka kwezifo," kusho uDkt Mabunda.Uqhube wathi emhlabeni wonke siyakhula isibalo sabantu abahlaselwa izifo ezithinta inhliziyo ngakho kudingeka ukuthi kugxilwe ezinhlelweni zokugwema izifo, ukuzelapha nokuzilawula."Ukuzihlola kunomthelela omuhle wokonga noma wokugwema izindleko ezihambisana nokwelashwa kwezifo esezinesikhathi eside zikhona egazini," kusho uDkt Mabunda.
ZIZONEKELWA izwe enkantolo izitatimende zabamangalelwa kwelokubulawa kukaSenzo Meyiwa emuva kokuthi zamukelwe njengengxenye yobufakazi obuzobhekwa uma sekuqulwa icala.UMeyiwa owayeyintandokazi ye-Orlando Pirates neBafana Bafana, wadutshulwa wabulawa ekubo kwentombi yakhe uKelly Khumalo eVosloorus, eGauteng, ngo-2014. Kushushiswa abalisa abahlanu okuthiwa yibona abayisa uMeyiwa kwagoqanyawo bethengiwe.UMbuso umi ngezitatimende okuthiwa zasayinwa abamangalelwa ababili kuleli cala bevuma amacala belandisa abaphenyi ukusuka nokuhlala ngokufa kukaMeyiwa. Abamangalelwa bathi bavuma basayina izitatimende ngoba base bevuthiwe yisibhaxu samaphoyisa.Ummangalelwa wokuqala uMuzikawukhulelwa Sibiya nommangalelwa wesibili uBongani Ntanzi, kuthiwa yibona ababhala izitatimende. UNtanzi waze wathatha amaphoyisa eyowakhombisa kubo kaKelly lapho okwafela khona uMeyiwa.Abaphenyi bathi abamangalelwa badalula ngisho umqashi wabo owabanika itoho lokucoboshisa uMeyiwa futhi bakhokhelwa emuva kwalokho.Abamangalelwa bafaka isicelo sokuthi izitatimende zingemukelwa zichithwe ngoba zatholakala ngokungemthetho. UMbuso ubize ofakazi bawo abachaze kabanzi ngokuthathwa kwezitatimende kanti nabamangalelwa babize ababo. IJaji Ratha Makgotlheng likhiphe isinqumo salo izolo lichitha abamangalelwa esicelweni sabo. IJaji lithe liyazemukela izitatimende njengobufakazi obuzobhekwa uma sekuqulwa icala."Emuva kokucubungula kabanzi bonke ubufakazi ngithole ukuthi ummangalelwa wokuqala wazivumela yena icala wabhala isitatimende ngokuthanda kwakhe. Ummangalelwa wesibili naye wazivumela ngokuthanda kwakhe futhi wayengaphoqiwe nokuyokhomba indawo yesigameko,’’ kusho iJaji.IJaji lithe ukwemukelwa kwezitatimende akusona isinqumo secala lonke kodwa kuyingxenye nje yecala. Kuvele nokuthi izitatimende zokuvuma amacala azisebenzi kwabanye abamangalelwa kodwa zisebenza kulabo abazibhalile kuphela.Ngesikhathi iJaji liqeda ukufunda isinqumo, kube sekutolikelwa abamangalelwa nokuthe uma bebuzwa ukuthi bayezwa yini bazibukela nje bangaphendula.UMshushisi woMbuso u-Advocate George Baloyi usemukele isinqumo wathi usezobiza ofakazi ukuze bazokwenaba kabanzi ngezitatimende zokuvunywa kwamacala.Ummeli wabamangalelwa uMnuz Sipho Ramosepele ucele ukuthi bangaqali bahanjiswe ejele abahlala kulona usafuna inguyazana nabo. Icala libuyela namuhla enkantolo.

BAKHATHAZEKILE abazali bezingane ezifunda esikoleni iNtathakusa High, eBergville okuthiwa sekungenele esontweni lesihlanu ziduve emakhaya emva kokumiselwa ukulwa esikoleni.Abafundi okuthiwa bevile kwabayishumi bafunda u-Grade 10 kuya ku-Grade 12, bamiswe isigungu esibhekele ukuqondiswa kobugwegwe esikoleni emva kokulwa emagcekeni esikole ngoFebhuwari. Othisha bafunda besaba izingane zingena nezikhali ezinkulu esikoleni. IPHOYISA ladubula amahlandla amaningi kwaze kwajama isibhamu libhekise kowesilisa owekade encike ngendololwane emotweni yalo imizuzwana emithathu eMolweni, eThekwini.Ummangalelwa uSergeant Sibonelo Shabangu kuthiwa waqeda wabaleka walahla phansi isibhamu ayekade edubula ngaso esasala sibangwa abantu.Lobu ubufakazi obethulelwe iNkantolo yeMantshi yasePinetown, izolo, ngumngani kamufi futhi ongumshayeli wetekisi, uMnuz Ayanda Ngcobo.UShabangu, ongaphandle ngebheyili kaR5 000, usolwa ngokudubula amahlandla amane uyise wezingane ezinhlanu, uMnuz Qaphela Mdima.UMdima washona esanda kungeniswa emtholampilo waKwaDabeka.Isigameko senzeka ebusuku ngoNovemba 25, 2022, lapho kupakwa khona izimoto endaweni yobumnandi eCasa Blanca Lifestyle eMolweni, eThekwini.UNgcobo utshele inkantolo ukuthi uShabangu ulandise wathi bafika behamba bengabangani beyisithupha eCasa Blanca ngo-11 ebusuku bahlala endaweni yezicukuthwane.Kwakunguye (uNgcobo), umufi nowesilisa athe uNjabulo, abaphuma ngaphandle kwendawo yobumnandi."UMandla (indoda eyazana nomufi abayifica eCasa) wagaxa umufi wathi abaphumele phandle baye kumuntu ababekweleta naye uMdima uR200. Singakafiki kulowo muntu, UShabangu wayalela uMandla ukuthi angasondeli eduze wemoto yakhe nomufi, " kusho UNgcobo.Uqhube wathi umufi owayengahlomile futhi eneme, waphendula uShabangu wathi: "Awu mfethu, ngoba ngithi sesayilungisa nje leya nto, yinindaba singavele sithenge i-drink, sidlule kule nto.”Kuthiwa uShabangu wavele wahosha isibhamu emotweni yekhe wavulela ngenhlamvu ebhekise kuMdima wawa phansi.Kuthiwa wadutshulwa ngisho esephakamise izandla zombili samuntu ocela uxolo kodwa uShabangu wadubula saze sajama isibhamu.UNgcobo uthe wabaleka nayekade ehamba nabo uShabangu, watshinga phansi isibhamu.Bekuqale kwethulwa ubufakazi uDkt Njabulo Ndlovu owahlola isidumbu sikaMdima. Uthe umufi wayenamanxeba amane okudutshulwa elalisesifubeni, amabili emhlane nasesihluzwini.UNgcobo uzoqhubeka nokwethula ubufakazi ngo-Ephreli 25. Uzobe ehlonywa imibuzo ummeli kaShabangu, uMnuz Andile Dakela.
INKANTOLO yezokhetho iyona ezoba nezwi lokugcina ngabazongenela ukhetho lukazwelonke ngoMeyi 29. Inkantolo izonquma ngalabo okuzobe kufakwe izikhalo ngabo, ngokuthi abakulungele ukungenela ukhetho ngoba bake balahlwa amacala phambilini.Ithuba lokufaka izikhalo lizovulwa ngoMashi 26 noMashi 27, nokuyilapho ikhomishini eyengamele ukhetho i-Independent Electoral Commission (IEC), izoshicilela uhlu lwabantu abazongenela ukhetho.Umphakathi uzobe usukwazi ukufaka izikhalo ngabazobe besohlwini lokuvotelwa, abangafanele.Lokhu kuvezwe yiphini lesikhulu esiphezulu se-IEC uMnuz Masego Shebhuri.Ekhuluma neSAfm izolo ekuseni, uthe uma sekuphothulwe lolu hlelo abantu abafuna kubuyekezwe isinqumo se-IEC sokuthi ibachithile ukungenela ukhetho, bangaya enkantolo yezokhetho.Uthe amaqembu azonikwa ithuba lokuthi alungise izikhalazo ezizofakwa. "Inkantolo ezoba nezwi lokugcina. Okwamanje asikwazi ukusho ukuthi umuntu othile uzokwazi yini noma ngeke akwazi ukungenela ukhetho ngoba uhlelo alukavulwa,” kusho uShebhuri.Usho lokhu nje kusanemibuzo ngokuthi owayengumengameli wezwe uJacob Zuma, okumanje ukhankasela iqembu elisha Umkhonto weSizwe, uzokwazi yini ukungenela ukhetho.Leli qembu liyiklame liyiklamile ekutheni nguZuma ozolimela okhethweni njengoba kukhona nezingqwembe ezinobuso bakhe. Nasohlwini lwaleli qembu elifolosa ngalo nguZuma ozihola phambili. UShebhuri uthe iqembu eliphakamise umuntu kumele liqinisekise ukuthi lowo muntu uvumelekile ukuthi angenele ukhetho."Kwayena lowo muntu ongenela ukhetho kumele akuveze ukuthi uvumelekile ukuthi angangenela ukhetho. Ukuze ungenele ukhetho kumele kube ngukuthi awukaze udonse isigwebo ngaphakathi ejele esiyizinyanga ezingu-12, esihambisana nokuthi awuvunyelwanga ukukhokha inhlawulo. Okunye okubhekwayo ngukuthi ngabe isiphelile yini iminyaka emihlanu umuntu aqeda ukudonsa isigwebo,” kusho uShebhuri. UZuma wagwetshwa izinyanga ezingu-15 edonsa ejele yinkantolo yoMthethosisekelo ngokudelela imiyalelo yokuvela ngaphambi kwekhomishini eyayiphenya ngokulawulwa koMbuso yidlanzana.Khonamanjalo sikhonjwe indlela isisebenzi se-IEC esiputshuze uhlu lwamagama abajutshwe yi-ANC neMK ePhalamende.Isikhulu se-IEC uMnuz Sy Mamabolo, siveze ukuthi lesi sisebenzi sinqanyulelwe inkontileka yaso.UMamabolo uthe bekungamele sikhiphe ulwazi olufuze lolu wathi besisebenza emahhovisi ekhomishini eGauteng."Noma ngubani ophula imigomo yekhomishini ngeke simbekezelele. Sizimisele futhi sizibophezele ngokuthi sibe nokhetho olungenagcobho.” Izolo ntambama ikhomishini ikhiphe isitifiketi somqulu wezokhetho okhule waba nabantu abangu-27.79 million abazovota.

KULEZI zinsuku abantu abaningi bayazifela ngokuba nesikhumba esibusheshelezi esikhazimulayo abaningi abakubiza nge-glow.Ezinkundleni zokuxhumana kunamakhasi amaningi aluleka ngezinto ongazisebenzisa uma ufuna ukuba nesikhumba esinje, kusukela ekususeni izinduna, amabala, nokukhanyisa isikhumba esinezisihla.Abantu basebenzisa izinto eziningi ukuze babe ne-glow njengokuphuza amaphilisi athile nokugcoba kodwa muva nje abasendimeni yokuzicwala bathi indlela engenisile yokuzicwala yokwenza isikhumba sibe bushelelezi ukusetshenziswa kwamavithamini angangeni ngomlomo kodwa afakwa ngemijovo emincane kujovwe isikhumba okwaziwa nge-micro-needling,ebuye yaziwe nge-collagen induction therapy.Kule ndlela kusetshenziswa izinaliti ezincane ezikwi-micro needling pen. Phakathi kwezinto ezenziwa ile ndlela yokuzinakekela ukwenza isikhumba sibe bushelelezi, ukususa izibazi, ukusiza isikhumba ukuthi sikwazi ukumunca masinyane imithi yokwelapha isikhumba, ukhilimu wokugcoba noma ukusikhuthaza ukuthi sikwazi ukukhiqiza i-collagen ngokwaso.UNksz Philile Ngcobo wenkampani ecwala isikhumba kusetshenziswa izindlela ezintsha kuzo okukhona nayo imicro-needling, iSkinPlus, uthe ezinalitini ezincane ezingena esikhunjeni kusuke kunengxube yamavithamini ahambisana nokuthi umuntu ufuna ukwenziwani nokuthi ufuna ukuzuzani." Kunamavithamini afanayo nalawa abantu abawaphuza ngomlomo, umehluko ukuthi wona angena ngqo esikhunjeni. Le ndlela yokwelapha noma ukuzicwala isingenisile nakwabamnyama abayiqondayo ukuthi isebenza kanjani. Iningi eliyisebenzisayo lineminyaka ephakathi kuka-20 kuya ku-30 bayisebenzisela ukuthi babe nesikhumba esibushelelezi," kusho uNksz Ngcobo.Uthe kunelinye iqembu elineminyaka engaphezulu kwengu-40 eliyisebenzisela ukuthi isikhumba salo singagugi ngokushesha ngoba kule minyaka isikhumba esisebusweni sisuke sesiqala ukuthamba ngenxa yokuhamba kweminyaka." Kunabantu abafuna ukuthi bahlale bebukeka bebasha nabo bayisebenzisa kakhulu imicro -needling," kusho yena.Uthe lolu hlobo lokuzicwala alubizi kangako, kuya ngokuthi kufakwe maphi amavithamini emjoveni."Kunezindawo ezenza lolu hlobo lokuzicwala ngemali eqala ku-R350. Uma usaqala kudingeka ukuthi uye kanye noma kabili ngesonto. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi uyisebenzisa ugcina usuya kanye ngenyanga noma kanye ezinyangeni ezintathu kuye ngokuthi usebenzisa maphi amavithamini," kuchaza uNksz NgcoboABANYE abathanda ukuzicwala kusetshenziswa okusazinaliti basebenzisa amapheshi nawo anokusazinaliti okuhlaba isikhumba Isithombe: SIGCINIWEUqhube wathi into enhle ngalolu hlobo lokuzicwala ukuthi lulungele zonke izinhlobo zesikhumba futhi abukho ukungozi obungakanani kukho ngoba kufana nokuphuza amavithamini."Abanye baye bathi bezwa ubuhlungu esikhumbeni esiphongweni nasekhaleni, uma umpofu ubuso buba bomvu ngesikhathi uqeda ukwenza kodwa uma unesikhumba esizothile akubi khona okubonakalayo," kusho yena.

KUNOHLANGOTHI oluzogqemeka udume lwengozi ecaleni lokufa kukaSenzo Meyiwa uma iJaji Ratha Makgoatlheng selikhipha isinqumo maqondana nezitatimende okuthiwa ezabamangalewa abavuma kuzo amacala.UMeyiwa, owayeyisilomo se-Orlando Pirates neBafana Bafana, wadutshulwa wabulawa ekubo kwentombi yakhe, uKelly Khumalo, eVosloorus, eGauteng, ngo-2014. Amadoda amahlanu abhekene necala lokufa kukaMeyiwa kodwa ayawaphika wonke amacala.Uhlangothi loMbuso lwethula izitatimende oluthi zabhalwa, zasayinwa abamangalelwa bevuma amacala bechakida nomuntu abathi wayebathumile. Abamangalelwa bathi bashaywa amaphoyisa abaphoqa ukuthi bavume amacala abasayinisa ngenkani.Uhlangothi lwabameli babamangalelwa lwafaka isicelo sokuthi zichithwe izitatimende. Bathi akufanele zibe wubufakazi ngoba zatholakala ngendlela engekho emthethweni.Izinhlangothi zombili ziqedile ukwenza izethulo. IJaji lithe lizokhipha isinqumo kusasa maqondana nokuthi izitatimende ziyemukwelwa noma cha.Ungoti wezomthetho onguMqondisi weZikalala Attorneys, uMnuz Mpumelelo Zikalala, uchazile ngesigaba icala elikusona. Uthe okokuqala okufanele abantu bakuqonde wukuthi icala lehlulelwa ngobufakazi obusuke bubekwe phambi kwenkantolo.Uthe uma izitatimende zemukelwa kuyobe kuwudume lwengozi kubameli kodwa kuyobe kungaphelile ngecala. UZikalala uthe kukhona into esemqoka eshiwo yijaji selivala."IJaji lishilo ukuthi sinqumo salo sizobe sinquma ngezitatimende kuphela, hhayi ngecala lonke. Isinqumo sizobe singachazi ukuthi sekufike ekugcineni. Ukwemukelwa kwezitatimende kuzobe kungasho ukuthi sekuyomiwa ngazo ngoba okuqukethwe kuzona kusazobhekwa,’’ kusho uZikalala.Uthe uma izitatimende zichithwa, kuyobe kuwudume kwaboMbuso. Uthe lokhu kuyonika abameli ithuba lokufaka isicelo ngaphansi kukaSection 174 weCriminal Procedure Act 51 ka-1977. Lesi sigatshana sigunyaza abameli ukuthi bafake isicelo sokuthi abamangalelwa bakhishwe phambili uma kuvela ukuthi uMbuso uyehluleka wukuveza ubufakazi.

KUSUKE isidumo ehostela labesifazane iThokoza, eThekwini, ngesikhathi betholana phezulu namaphoyisa bebhikishela ukungabi nawo ugesi osekungenele eviki lesibili bengenawo. Laba besifazane bavuke umbhejazane bashisa amathayi, bebulala namabhodlela, baphinde bavala umgwaqo uYusuf Dadoo ngenxa yokunengwa yindaba kagesi neyenza babolelwe ukudla okugcinwa emafrijini.Kuphazamiseke izimoto kulo mgwaqo njengoba ugcine uvaliwe kungavunyelwe ukuthi izimoto zidlule, nabebebhikisha bezijikisa. Kugcine kufika amaphoyisa ophiko olubhekelele udlame emphakathini nakamasipala, kwafika nendiza enophephela emhlane ebilokhu indiza ngaphezu kwalapho bekubhikishwa khona. Amaphoyisa agcine ephoqeleke ukuthi asebenzise izinhlamvu zenjoloba ukuhlakaza isixuku sabesifazane abebengagayelwe mphako nokuholele ekukhalelweni ngamasongo kaSigonyela kwabesifazane abahlanu.ABAHLALA ehostela labesifazane eThekwini iThokoza ngesikhathi bebhikisha emgwaqweni uYusuf Dadoo Isithombe: NHLAKANIPHO MNQAYIKulokhu kungqubuzana phakathi kwamaphoyisa nalaba besifazane, ababili badubulekile. Omunye udubuleke ehlombe kwathi omunye wadubuleka ezinqeni ngesikhathi amaphoyisa ehlakaza isixuku.Owesifazane obeyingxenye yombhikisho ongathandanga ukudalulwa, utshele Isolezwe ukuthi sebeze baphelelwa nayimali yokuthenga ukudla ngenxa yokuthi ugesi abanawo."Sekuphele izinsuku eziyisikhombisa ugesi singenawo, asidli ngenxa yokuthi ugesi asinawo. Yingakho sinqume ukungena emgwaqweni mhlawumbe izikhalo zethu zizozwakala uma senza kanje. Noma kunzima kodwa sizoyibamba ngoba wathinta abafazi wathinta imbokodo,” kusho lo wesifazane.USihlalo we-Economic Freedom Fighters (EFF) KwaZulu-Natal, uMongezi Thwala ekhuluma nabezindaba, uthe isimo abantu abahlala kuso emalokishini nalapha edolobheni asisihle."Kuyacaca ukuthi ubuholi baseThekwini abusafuni ukunikeza abantu izimfuno nokulethwa kwezidingo. IMeya yeTheku uMxolisi Kaunda akafuni ukulalela abasebenzi abafuna izimfuno nabalwela amalungelo abo njengoba ecasha ngokuthi lesi siteleka asikho emthethweni. Njengeqembu le-EFF ngeke sithule sibukele abantu bakithi bephila ngaphansi kwalezi zimo. Sizophuma sime nabantu bakithi silwe nobuholi baseThekwini ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bayazithola izidingo njengoba bekhokha intela. Abantu bakithi bayayihlonipha imigomo ebekwe umasipala njengoba wona umasipala uhluleka ukuhlinzeka abantu ngamanzi, ugesi nokuhlanza iTheku.” kusho uThwala.Uthe abahambisani nobulelesi babantu abalimaza ingqalasizinda, amaphoyisa nomthetho awubhekane nabo. Uthe bazoma nabasebenzi ukuze imiholo yabo ilinganiswe neyabanye abasebenzi abasebenza komasipala abakhulu. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant Colonel Nqobile Gwala, ukuqinisekile ukuthi abesifazane abahlanu baboshiwe kanti bavulelwe icala lokuphehla udlame emphakathini."Icala lokuphehla udlame emphakathini liyaphenywa ngamaphoyisa ase-Durban Central emva kokuthi amalungu omphakathi abebhikisha eshise amathayi futhi aphonsa nezinto ebhekise emaphoyiseni. Kuboshwe abasolwa abahlanu ngecala lokuphehla udlame kanti bazovela enkantolo maduzane,” kusho uLieutenant Gwala.Ikhansela lendawo, uMnuz Ntando Khuzwayo, likhuluma neSolezwe lithe imizamo yokuwulungisa ugesi iyaqhubeka."Okwamanje akukho engingakubika ngoba le ndawo efile yindawo kamasipala. Siqashe izinkontileka ezizimele ukuzama ukuwulungisa futhi nginesiqiniseko sokuthi namuhla (izolo) singase silale usukhanya," kusho uKhuzwayo.

LISHAYE ungqimphothwe lathi selizosifaka isicelo sebheyili isosha lombutho wezempi eNingizimu Afrika elisolwa ngokudubula libulale inkosikazi yalo emzini wabo osePinetown, eThekwini.Phambilini uMnuz Lwanda Mxolisi Zungu (37) watshela iNkantolo yeMantshi yasePinetown ukuthi uyayibonga ibheyili ngaleso sikhathi.Kushintshile ukudla epuletini ngoMsombuluko ngesikhathi uZungu, ogqunywe ezitokisini, esethi uzofaka isicelo sebheyili.Inkantolo ibe isikubekela uMashi 26 nonyaka ukulalelwa kwalesi sicelo sebheyili sikaZungu.Leli cala lidonse amehlo amaningi nabamahlelo ahlukene emphakathini okufakazelwa wukugcwala enkantolo kwabantu abasuke bezolithamela.UZungu usolwa ngokudubula amahlandla amaningi abulale inkosikazi yakhe, uTania Msane-Zungu (36), ngoJanuwari 3 nonyaka.Kuthiwa endlini kwakukhona unina kamufi, uNkk Gwen Msane, nezingane zalaba bashadikazi ababili ngesikhathi kwenzeka lesi sigameko.Le ndoda kuthiwa yagcwala izinkalo emuva kwesigameko kodwa yagcina izinikele emaphoyiseni iphelezelwa ngummeli wayo.NgoJanuwari umndeni kamufi wasola uZungu ngokuthi ungumuntu obenesandla esilula futhi esebenzisa indlakadla emshadweni wakhe. Lo mndeni wathi ufuna inkantolo imncishe ibheyili uZungu.Ngakolunye uhlangothi ilungu lomndeni kaZungu lathi ubulale inkosikazi yakhe ngoba ubekade eyisola ngokuthi iyaphinga nomuntu amaziyo.

Okwamanje kusanophenyo okumele luqhubeke," isho kanje.UShozi ngesikhathi evela enkantolo ubebonakala ekhululekile engathukile.Phambilini ubeke ezwakale eshumayela emisakazweni ehlukene yaKwaZulu Natal.Ibandla lakhe linabazalwane abaningi kodwa kuvela ukuthi sekunoqhekeko kubazalwane ngemuva kokuba kuvele ukuthi uthandana nenqwaba yabesifazane.Lo mfundisi waziwa ngokuphila impilo ewubukhazikhazi futhi uhamba ngezinhlobonhlobo zezimoto ezibizayo.Kuvela nokuthi uhlala emzini obizayo endaweni yomntakabani eThekwini.Ngo-2020 uke wavulelwa icala ngomunye wesifazane waseMgungundlovu ayemsola ngokumntshontshela amatekisi akhe.Isolezwe likhulume naye owesifazane ongumgilwa obekhona enkantolo ngombandela wokuthi angavezwa okwamanje.Ukhale ngesihluku esikhulu esikhonjiswe nguMfundisi kuyena. ZISHAQEKILE izingwazi zamaciko aluleli ngokuthola emthonjeni wezindaba ukuthi zishaywe ngesithende ohlwini lwabaholi abawu-100 abazomela i-Economic Freedom Fighters (EFF).Emuva kokuba iphephandaba langeSonto, iSunday World, lidalule ukuthi inkakha yomculo we-kwaito, u-Eugene Mthethwa, umculi we-Afro soul, uRingo Madlingozi nomlingisi uFana Mokoena, sebezokubukela kwithelevishini okwenzeka ePhalamendene likazwelonke, Isolezwe libe selixhumana nawo.RINGO MADLINGOZI"Kungaba kubi uma kuliqiniso ukuthi singathola izindaba ezinjalo emithonjeni yezindaba okuyinto ebiyenzeka kozakwethu abasemisakazweni nakwithelevishini nasemafilimini. Bebebona emaphephandabeni angeSonto ukuthi izivumelwano abanazo, ngeke zivuselelwe," kuphawula u-Eugene ongene ePhalamende ngethikithi le-EFF nyakenye, emuva kokulaxaza i-ANC. Nakuba kunjalo, u-Eugene uthe noma amahlebezi engaba yiqiniso kodwa ngeke kudikize ngisho inqulu ngoba akajoyinanga umzabalazo ngoba elandela ibhodwe eliconsayo.EUGENE MTHETHWAUthe kodwa wajoyina i-EFF ngenxa yokuzwakala kwezwi layo ekukhathalaleni umkhakha wezobuciko, okuyinto ebonakele nakusomqulu wayo obuqinisekisa ukuthi izolwela izikhalazo zamaciko akuleli.URingo, owangena ePhalamende emuva kokhetho lukazwelonke ngo-2019, uthe yena uqala ukuzwa ngeSolezwe ukuthi ushiywe ngaphandle ohlwini."Hhayi mntasekhaya, ngiqala ukuyizwa ngawe le ndaba. Sengiyokuzwa kahle uma sekufika incwadi eshoyo, ebuya komkhulu," kushaya ngezinqamulelayo uRingo wodumo lwengoma ethi Ndiyagodola nethi Sondela.NoFana, owayenguDkt Sithole kwiGenerations, uthe akaqondi nqindi nasibhakela ngendaba yohlu lwe-EFF.FANA MOKOENA"Ngiqala nje ukuzwa ngawe ngokwenzeka khona,” kusho uFana owaqala ukuba sePhalamende kusukela ngo-2014.Libuzwa yiSolezwe ngalolu daba, iPhini likaMengameli we-EFF, uMnuz Floyd Shivambu, livele lathi wumbhedo wodwa obhalwe ngala maciko."Uhlu luzoshicilelwa ngabe-IEC. Singalibeka ngembaba elokuthi wumbhedo wokuqala nowokugcina obhalwe yiphephandaba (Sunday World), ebesesicabanga ukuthi selibuyelwa yisithunzi," kusho uShivambu.Eqhuba uthe uhlu aludingidwa ngaphandle kwezinhlaka zeqembu. "Uhlelo lwangaphakathi oluzidalulwelwa umphakathi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi," kuphetha uShivambu. Abanye osaziwayo abangamalungu aleli qembu elahlubuka kwi-ANC ngoLinda Sibiya, Ntando Duma nabanye.
IQEMBU elisha, uMkhonto weSizwe, lithi kalisahlehli esinqumeni salo njengoba owayengumengameli, uJacob Zuma, ephezulu ohlwini lwalo, lifuna abuyele aphathe izwe.Amaqembu ezepolitiki amatasa alungiselela ukhetho lukazwelonke oluzoba ngoMeyi 29, nonyaka. Inhlangano yokhetho i-IEC ngoLwesihlanu, ivalile ukwemukela uhlu lwabazomela amaqembu ePhalamende.Uhlu lwamalungu e-ANC luputshukile, kuthe kusabatshazwa lona kwavela nolweMK ehlasela ngoZuma phezulu eqhulwini.UMkhonto weSizwe yiqembu elimenyezelwe ngoDisemba nyakenye, lapho uZuma aphumela khona obala ethi uyaleseka, akasayingeni eye-ANC. Kunengqinamba yokuthi uZuma uke walahlwa yicala kanti i-IEC ayibemukeli abantu abanjalo ohlwini.Kuphinde kube nemibuzo yokuthi njengoba eke waba wumengameli usazokwazi yini ukuphinda angenele umbango wesikhundla esebuya ngelinye iqembu?Okhulumela uMkhonto weSizwe, uMnuz uNhlamulo Ndhlela, uxoxe neSolezwe ngohlu lwabo lwasePhalamende olusabalele ezinkundleni zokuxhumana. Uhlu lukhomba uZuma phezulu eqhulwini, alanywe nguMnuz Jabulani Khumalo olele isibili.Uthe bazolwa banqumuke izindla impela akusajiki, uZuma kufanele abe wumengameli uma benqoba. Sekuvele kuqalile ukusabalala izithombe zikaZuma njengokunguyena owubuso beMK.UNdhlela uthe bakhathezekile ngokuthi uhlu lwabo luputshukile futhi basafuna ukubheka ukuthi yilona ngqo yini. Uthe kuyiqiniso ukuthi uZuma uphezulu ohlwini lwabo futhi kufanele abe wumengameli wezwe."Uzoba wubuso esizokhankasa ngabo futhi wuyena esihlasela ngaye kwesikamengameli. Indaba yerekhodi lobugebengu ayikho ngoba kwakungelona icala lobugebengu kodwa kwakuyicala lombango. UZuma akaze avele enkantolo yemantshi noma enkantolo enkulu alahlwe yicala,’’ kusho uNdhlela.Ungoti wezomthetho uMnuz Mpumelelo Zikalala onguMqondisi weZikalala Attorneys, uthe awekho nakancane amathuba okuthi abeMK banqobe noma bengaya enkantolo ngalolu daba. "I-IEC yiyona enamandla okumchitha uZuma ngenxa yokuthi walahlwa yicala. Umthetho uthi uma umuntu walahlwa yicala wagwetshwa izinyanga ezingu-12 enganikiwe nethuba lolukhokha inhlawulo, ngeke aye ePhalamende. UZuma wagwetshwa izinyanga ezingu-15 futhi wayengeke asidonse isigwebo uma engatholwanga enecala,’’ kusho uZikalala.Uthe uZuma akanalo ithuba lokungena ePhalamede futhi lokho kucace bha, kungenzeka ukuthi basebenzisa igama lakhe nje ngoba ewumuntu onodumo kwezepolitiki.Ngokuvamile uma iqembu lididiyela uhlu lwasePhalamende, lowo abahlasela ngaye kwesikamengameli uba ngowokuqala ohlwini. Abanye abaqaphelekayo ohlwini nguMnuz Des Van Rooyen wodumo lwesikhundla sikangqongqoshe wezeziMali owafakwa wakhishwa.UVan Rooyen ungunombolo 12 ohlwini kanti kuvela negama lendodakazi kaZuma, uDuduzile. IQEMBU elisha, uMkhonto weSizwe, lithi kalisahlehli esinqumeni salo njengoba owayengumengameli, uJacob Zuma, ephezulu ohlwini lwalo, lifuna abuyele aphathe izwe.Amaqembu ezepolitiki amatasa alungiselela ukhetho lukazwelonke oluzoba ngoMeyi 29, nonyaka. Inhlangano yokhetho i-IEC ngoLwesihlanu, ivalile ukwemukela uhlu lwabazomela amaqembu ePhalamende.Uhlu lwamalungu e-ANC luputshukile, kuthe kusabatshazwa lona kwavela nolweMK ehlasela ngoZuma phezulu eqhulwini.UMkhonto weSizwe yiqembu elimenyezelwe ngoDisemba nyakenye, lapho uZuma aphumela khona obala ethi uyaleseka, akasayingeni eye-ANC. Kunengqinamba yokuthi uZuma uke walahlwa yicala kanti i-IEC ayibemukeli abantu abanjalo ohlwini.Kuphinde kube nemibuzo yokuthi njengoba eke waba wumengameli usazokwazi yini ukuphinda angenele umbango wesikhundla esebuya ngelinye iqembu?Okhulumela uMkhonto weSizwe, uMnuz uNhlamulo Ndhlela, uxoxe neSolezwe ngohlu lwabo lwasePhalamende olusabalele ezinkundleni zokuxhumana. BAVUKE umbhejazane bavala umgwaqo ngamathayi avuthayo abahlala ehostela labesifazane, iThokoza, bekhala ngokungabi nagesi izinsuku eziyisishiyagalolunye.Laba besifazane batshele Isolezwe ukuthi babone kungcono bangene emgwaqweni ngoba bazizwa benzelwa phansi wuMasipala weTheku.UNksz Ntombi Mkhize ongomunye wabaseThokoza uthe: "Inkinga nje esinayo ugesi phaqa. ULAKA lwabalaleli bomsakazo Ukhozi FM, abasola lo msakazo ngokubaqola ngomncintiswano wangoJuni nyakenye, luphoqe iSABC ukuthi iphumele obala ivume induku ngokungamemezeli umuntu owawina.Lokhu kuza emva kokuthi omunye wabebeqokwe kulo mncintiswano ekhale ngokuthi akasazi nokuthi uzophendula athini kubantu ababemvotela njengoba kwavele kwacweba iziziba sebevotelwe.Kwakuqokwe abantu abangu-63 emiphakathini eyahlukene nabayiswa emoyeni ezinhlelweni ezahlukene kuKhozi FM, bechaza ngemisebenzi yabo eyenze ukuthi baqokwe. Lo mncintiswano ubuqhutshwa ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi #Ukhozifm63 njengoba lo msakazo ubugubha iminyaka engu-63 wasungulwa. Abalaleli babenxuswe ukuthi bavotele umuntu oqokiwe ngokuthumela umqhafazo owawubiza u-R1.50.Isikhulu esibambile kwaSABC, uMmoni Seapolelo, sithe baxolisa kakhulu ngokuthi angamenyezelwa umuntu owinile kulo mncintiswano."Singakuqinisekisa ukuthi ngenxa yezimo ezingeke zidalulwe, ukumenyezelwa komuntu owawina emncintiswaneni #Ukhozifm63 akamenyezelwanga ngosuku olwalushiwo. Isiteshi sisazomemezela umuntu owawina kwabangu-63 ababeqokiwe baze bayokhuluma nasezinhlelweni ezehlukene zomsakazo Ukhozi FM. Sizoqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abaqokiwe kuseyibona, kuphinde kube ne-audit okuyinto eyenziwa kuyona yonke imincintiswano yethu. I-SABC idlulisa ukuxolisa kakhulu kubalaleli boKhozi FM ngokubambezeleka ukuthi kumenyezelwe owinile,” kusho uMmoni.Umncintiswano ubunyakenye ngoJune 1, waphela ngo-Agasti 2. Ubuqhutshwa ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: #ukhozifm63.Kulo mncintiswano kwakucelwe imiphakathi ukuthi iphakamise abantu abenza kahle ezindaweni abahlala kuzo. Ukhozi FM laphinda labiza ababeqokiwe ukuthi beze ezinhlelweni ezehlukene zomsakazo becacisa ngabakwenza ngasemakubo nokuholele ekutheni baqokwe wumphakathi.Emva kwalokho kwanxuswa umphakathi ukuthi ubavotele. Babevotelwa ngokuthumela umqhafazo obiza u-R1.50 futhi kuvumeleke ukuthi umuntu angavota noma ikangaki.Ngeshwa imiphumela ayikaze imenyezelwe kuze kube yimanje. Omunye wababeqokiwe, ozibize ngoPhondolwendlovu Mzolo waseMkhambathini, uthe uke wazama ukukhuluma nabanye ayeqokwe nabo ukuzwa imiphumela, wathola ukuthi bonke basebumnyameni ngalo mncintiswano futhi akekho ovelayo ukuthi wawina kuwona.Uthe uke wenza imizamo yokuthi abuze nakhona oKhozini kodwa wangazithola izimpendulo njengoba bekucaca ukuthi akekho onolwazi.Uthe okubuhlungu abantu babavotela manje abasenayo impendulo uma bebuzwa ngabantu ukuthi kwenzekani ngomncintiswano.
SIYINDABA egudwini kumalungu omphakathi wasoDidini, eMbumbulu, isehlakalo sokudutshulwa kubulawe induna endaweni ebiphinde ibe ngusomabhizinisi.UMnuz Sphiwe Msweli (54) kubikwa ukuthi udutshulwe ngoyaba lwezinhlamvu eqeda kuvala ebhusha lakhe elibude buduze nomuzi wakhe.Umthombo weSolezwe uveze ukuthi uMsweli ubengusomabhizinisi owaziwayo nohlonishwayo kakhulu kule ndawo."Akuqondakali ukuthi yini imbangela yokudutshulwa kwakhe. Sonke njengamalungu omphakathi siyazibuza siyaziphendula ukuthi ingampela ubulawelweni?’’Kuvela ukuthi abasolwa abadubule umufi bafike behamba ngeveni emhlophe okuthiwa babaleke ngayo sebedubulile. "Sizwe kuthiwa, uthe eselele phansi bamkhuthuza, asibange sisezwa ke ukuthi bathatheni,” kusho umthombo.Ugcizelele ukuthi uMsweli ubengusomabhizinisi othandayo ukufaka isandla ngenhloso yokulekelela abaswele emphakathini.Nomsebenzi wakhe wobunduna, umthombo uthe ubewenza ngokuzikhandla nangokuthembeka okukhulu.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu Natal, uLieutenant Colonel Nqobile Gwala, uthe kuvulwe icala lokubulala, elokuzama ukubulala, nelokweba esiteshini samaphoyisa eMbumbulu."Kubikwa ukuthi ngoMashi 8, owesilisa udutshulwe wabulawa, ngaphandle kwebhizinisi lakhe oDidini, eMbumbulu, ngabasolwa abangaziwa,” kusho uLt Col Gwala.Uqhube wathi umufi uphinde wantshontshelwa isibhamu sakhe, amaphoyisa asaphenya ngembangela yokubulawa kwakhe.Imizamo yokuthola umndeni ayiphumelelanga njengoba inombolo yocingo ebitholwe Isolezwe ibikhala ingabanjwa. Usihlalo weNdlu yobuKhosi boMdabu KwaZulu Natal, iNkosi Sifiso Shinga, ithe kuyabakhathaza ukuthi namanje akukho okutheni okwenziwayo ukulwa nesihlava sokubulawa kwezinduna namakhosi."Akwenziwa lutho. Nomthetho awuyilimi indima yawo uma kuziwa ngakulolu daba,” kusho uShinga.Enza isibonelo, uthe amakhansela ayanikwa abaqaphi uma ezizwa engaphephile."Kodwa ezinduneni, uhulumeni uye akhale ngokungabibikho kwemali. Ngokomthetho izinduna namakhosi akubona abantu okufanele bahambe ngaphandle kwabaqaphi."Ngasohlangothini lwamaphoyisa, siye sibone amanye amacala okubulawa kwabathile ebekwa eqhulwini ngophenyo, kodwa awokubulawa kwezinduna namakhosi, wona awathathelwa phezulu,” kusho uShinga.Uthe kusuka ngo-2019, zingaphezu kuka-50 izinduna ezibulelwe, wathi amakhosi angu-12.
ISILO samabandla uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini, siyalele ukuthi kubenomzuzu wokugobisa amakhanda kuzothwe ukuhlonipha iSilo uMdlokombane, njengoba namhlanje kuphela unyaka wesithathu sakhothama.Esitatimendeni esikhishwe uNdunankulu kaZulu uMfundisi Thulasizwe Buthelezi, iNdlulamithi iyalela ukuthi ngo- 12 emini wonke uZulu nabasondelene nalesi sizwe bazothe umzuzu ukuhlonipha iSilo uZwelithini kaBhekuzulu esikhothame ngalo lolu suku, ngo- 2021."ISilo uZwelithini siwuphawu lobunye noxolo esifundazweni iKwaZulu-Natal futhi lokhu kuzohlale kukhona ezinhliziyweni zabantu besizwe sikaZulu kulo lonke leli. nasemhlabeni jikelele. Ukuthatha umzuzu wokuzotha ngalesi sikhathi kungabe emsebenzini, esikoleni noma ekhaya kuzobe kuwukuhlonipha inkosi yethu ebithandwa futhi ihlonishwa kuzwelonke,” kusho uButhelezi esitatimendeni.Inhlangano engenzi nzuzo yeSilo uZwelithini, i-The Goodwill Foundation nendlunkulu bazohola umkhuleko, okuthiwa owaminyaka yonke ongowesibili kulo nyaka, ukubungaza lolu suku. Ngokwesitatimende esikhishwe uMntwana uMbonisi kaBhekuzulu, umkhuleko uzoba KwaNongoma, eMahhashini khona namhlanje.Khonamanjalo uNdunankulu kaZulu uqinisekise ukuthi iSilo esibusayo, sizohola indlunkulu namabutho emcimbini wokubungaza iSilo uDinuzulu kaCetshwazayo ozoba ngoMgqibelo, kwaCeza. Uveze ukuthi umcimbi wokuvulwa komfuziselo weSilo uZwelithini obuzokuba kuleli sonto usuhlehlile ngenxa yezinhlelo zemicimbi yasendlunkulu eyandulela oweSilo uDinuzulu. Ngesonto eledlule, kudingeke ukuthi ihhovisi likaNdunankulu esifundazweni uNkk Nomusa Dube-Ncube lixolise eendlunkulu emva kokuthi belimemezela ukuthi umcimbi wosuku lokuhlonishwa kweSilo uDinuzulu uzoba ngempelasonto edlule, okuvele ukuthi lesi simemezelo senziwe kungaxhunyanwanga neSilo esibusayo nokugcine kuphoqa ukuthi kubekwe olunye usuku.Zivele seziqalile izinhlelo zokugubha iqhaza leSilo uDinuzulu ekulweni nohulumeni wengcindezelo, njengoba kuthe ngesonto eledlule uNkk Dube Ncube wamhlonipha ngokubeka izimbali egunjini ayeboshelwe kulo, ejele eliseMgungundlovu.Undunankulu uphinde wahambela epaki i-King Dinuzulu eThekwini, lapho kunomfuziselo wakhe.
KUZOBA ukheth’ khethu okhethweni lwalo nyaka lukazwelonke njengoba engu-101 amaqembu ezepolitiki abengamelelekile ePhalamende naseziShayamthetho zezifundazwe, akwazile ukuhlangabezana nomnqamulajuqu wokungenela ukhetho.Akugcinanga ngalawa maqembu kuphela, kodwa nabangenela ukhetho ngokuzimela abazobe beqala ngqa ukuba yingxenye yalolu khetho, bangu-16 abagcine bekwazile ukungena.Lezi zibalo zivezwe yikhomishini yezokhetho i-Independent Electoral Commission (IEC), eveze ukuthi angu-115, amaqembu akwazile ukuhlangabezana nalo mnqamulajuqu nakuba kusazohlungwa kahle kubhekwe ukuthi zonke izinto azilethile.Okhulumela i-IEC, uNkk Kate Bapela, uthe amaqembu angu-14 abevele emelelekile akwazile nawo ukuhlangabezana nomnqamujuqu yingakho engu-115 amaqembu esewonke.Uveze ukuthi bangu-11 abangenela ukhetho ngokuzimela abangenele ezifundazweni."Njengoba kuvalwe ngoLwesihlanu ukulethwa kwezimfanelo, sizocubungula ukuthi zonke izinto ebezidingeka zikhona yini. Uma kungukuthi ezinye zazo azikho, lelo qembu noma ongenela ukhetho ngokuzimela uyochithwa, angakwazi ukuba yingxenye yokhetho,” kusho uNkk Bapela. Uthe ngoMashi 22, bazokwazisa amaqembu kanjalo nalabo abangenela ngokuzimela abavela ohlwini lwamanye amaqembu."Amaqembu azonikwa kuze kube uMashi 25, ukuthi asuse lowo muntu ovela kulonye uhlu. NgoMashi 26 no-27, ikhomishini izovula ithuba lokuthi kuhlolwe uhlu lwabantu amaqembu azobajuba ePhalamende naseziShayamthetho.” Uveze ukuthi ngo-Ephreli 10, kuzobe sekuvezwa bonke abazongenela ukhetho bese kugaywa amaphepha okuvotaMayelana nokuputshuka kohlu lwamaqembu i-ANC noMkhonto weSizwe ngoLwesihlanu ebusuku, ikhomishini ithe iyaphenya ngoba kuvela ukuthi lwaputshuka ngaphakathi kwikhomishini.Isikhulu esiphezulu sekhomishini uMnuz Sy Mamabolo, sithe bazokwehlisa nesibalo sabantu abakwazi ukubona imibiko ngaphakathi kwikhomishini ukuze kungabi nokuputshuka kweminye imibiko.Uthe yingakho bejube uphenyo ukuze bathole owenze lokhu.UMengameli we-ANC nezwe, uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa, uthe nakuba uhlu luputshukile kodwa abantu abayethembe ikhomishini.Uveze ukuthi ngenxa yalokhu abantu abaqhubeke babe nethemba ekusebenzeni kwekhomishini nokuthi ukhetho kuzoba ngolukhululekile.
UPHITHENE amakhanda umndeni wowesifazane wasoShabeni, ePort Shepstone, osekuyisonto lesibili edukile okuthiwa ushiye incwajana esonga ngokuziphonsa eweni okungayi elibuyayo kulo, nokusolwa ukuthi ugajwe yisikhwele sesoka ebeseliqonyiwe.Umndeni kaNkk Nosihle "Nono” Khuboni-Sengane (33), uthe usumthungathe wancama, kangangoba naseweni ayesonge ngokuziphonsa kulo Ophengeni, amaphoyisa asezame nangezinja zomkhondo kodwa abuya elambatha.Kuthiwa ubeseceliwe yisoka elisha emva kokushona komyeni wakhe, oshone eminyakeni edlule, kanti beseziphothuliwe nezingxoxo zokuthunyelwa kwabakhongi obekulindeleke bafike namalobolo ngePhasika.UNkk Samke Khuboni ogane umfowabo, uthe uskwiza wakhe uhlala naye emzini kamfowabo selokhu abuya emzini emva kokushona komyeni. Ungumuntu ofihlayo, ohleze ezihlekela okungelula ukubona uma kukhona into emdlayo."Sitholile ukuthi kube nengxabano emva kokuthola ukuthi isoka lakhe liqonyiwe. Sengathi ushaye ucingo labanjwa yintombi engikholwa ukuthi leyo nto uyithathe ngamawala ngenxa yesikhwele, wabona kungcono athathe lesi sinqumo. Sesimbheke yonke indawo kangangoba nesoka lakhe liyafika sizocinga nalo kodwa awukho umkhondo esiwuhoshayo kuze kubemanje,” usho kanje.Uthe ukugcina ukubonakala, ubekade ephelezele ingane yakhe eneminyaka eyisishiyagalolunye eyoyigibelisa izimoto isiphindela kubo kaSengane lapho ayeganele khona kwazisa ihlala khona, wabuya kodwa waphinde wanyamalala eshiye zonke izingcingo zakhe.Ugcizelele ukuthi ubewumuntu obengazuli, ezihlalela ekhaya futhi enomngani oyedwa abamaziyo, naye okhungatheke kanye nabo. Uthe ubephuma uma eya esontweni noma eyohlangana nesoka lakhe nalapho ubesho uma ezohamba.Encwadwini okuthiwa uyibhale wayishiya kubo Isolezwe eliyibonile, ibhalwe kanje;"Bafowethu umhlaba ungehlule. Uma nifica ngingekho ningethuki, sengifuna ukuphumula manje… Iyobonana kwelizayo uma iNkosi isasigcinile. Ngicela ningishayelele ucingo uNhlanhla (isoka), nimtshele ukuthi ngiyohleze ngimthanda, ningivalelisele nasenganeni yami,’’ okunye okubhalwe kule ncwadi.Kule ncwadi, obhalile unxuse ukuthi umndeni ulivumele isoka lakhe libambe iqhaza uma kwenziwa amalungiselelo okungcatshwa kwakhe.UNksz Sindi Sengane okuwuyena onamathelise ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ecela ukufuniswa, uthe uNkk Khuboni-Sengane ongunkosikazi kamfowabo ongasekho, uthe ukewaba nemicabango yokuthi kungenzeka mhlawumbe uphathwe kabi ukuthi kuzoba nomhlangano wemindeni, owakwaKhuboni nowakaSengane. Bekuzodingidwa udaba lwamalobolo njengoba besekudingeka alotsholwe lapho abeshadele khona, kodwa wabuye wayiphepheza kwazise bekuyinto obekumele imhluphe ngoba ayikho kakhulu ngaye. "Sigcina ukuxoxa naye bekumuntu okhululekile nje ongakhombisi lutho, ngakho ngisashaqekile ukuthi yini lena eyayimudla engadala ukuthi adlinze ngokuzibulala pho? ” kusho uNksz Sengane.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant Colonel Nqobile Gwala, uthe kubikwe ngokulahleka komuntu, esiteshini samaphoyisa eMehlomnyama, wathi ukuthungatha kusaqhubeka njengoba engatholakali
LUSUSE umsindo uhlelo lokuxhaswa kwezinhlangano zamabhizinisi ezaqalwa ondlunkulu bamakhosi ezindaweni zasemakhaya ukufukula umnotho njengoba kuthiwa abanye baphuma beshwiba izandla ngesikhathi kudluliswa izinsiza- kusebenza, emcimbini obuseMnambithi, ngoLwesihlanu. Lolu hlelo loMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana nobuHoli boMdabu KwaZulu-Natal olubizwa ngokuthi Ondlunkulu Rural Economic Development Programme, belwethulwa ngokusemthethweni. Kuthiwa kuhloswe ngalo ukuhlomulisa abesifazane abenza imisebenzi ehlukene ukususa ikati eziko nokufukula umnotho wasemakhaya ngokuxhasa izinhlangano ezaqalwa ondlunkulu bamakhosi ngenhloso yokwenza umehluko emphakathini. Nakuba injabulo ibinkulu kwabanye abahlomulile, kodwa ababuye belambatha baphume bedemelayisa njengoba kumenyezelwe izinhlangano ezingu- 40 kuphela ekubeni bonke abebefake izicelo bebelindele ukuthi amabhizinisi abo azohlomula kulolu hlelo lomnyango olubekelwe izigidi.Ezinkulumeni zondlunkulu abangeneme okuthiwa ziputshuke bexoxa eqoqweni labo kwi-WhatsApp, omunye ezwini eliqoshiwe uzwakala esola umnyango ngokuchema nondlunkulu bamakhosi aziwayo naseke ahola ezinhlakeni ezithile ngaphansi kohlaka lweNdlu yabaHoli boMdabu KwaZulu-Natal, eveza ukuthi undlunkulu kaSihlalo walolu hlaka Inkosi Sifiso Shinga nowePhini likaNdunankulu kaZulu Inkosi Phathisizwe Chiliza nabanye abavela emakhosini anamagama, bahlomulile. "Lezi zinto ezabantu vele abanemali, abasezikhundleni izinto zitholwa yibona. Futhi ngeke isayekwa, Ogwini nje kunjalo. Abanye baphume no- R300 000. Mina ngisheshe ngayibona nje le nto ngize ngasho ngathi imali iyakwazi kwabo,” kubalisa omunye.Omunye uthe wathatha imali yakhe yokugcina ehambisa amafomu okufaka isicelo kulolu hlelo ngethemba lokuthi uzobhekelwa. Bathi izikhulu zomnyango zahambela ezindaweni, kuthathwa nezithombe zezinhlelo abazenzayo sekuyamangaza ukuthi sekuqokwa abangu- 40 kuphela futhi akucaci ukuthi kulandelwe miphi imigudu ngokuqokwa kwabo.Okhulumela uMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana KwaZulu-Natal uMnuz Siboniso Mngadi ukuchithile ukuthi ondlunkulu bamakhosi asezinhlakeni kuphela abahlomula kulolu hlelo."Lolu uhlelo oluqhubekayo njengoba umnyango ubeke eceleni u- R10 million ukubhekana nalo. Kulaba abawu- 40 bokuqala, eminye yemigudu ebilandelwa bekunikwa asebevele banamabhizinisi asesebenza kodwa kungasho ukuthi abangahlomulanga ngeke besahlomula, kusuka kuleli sonto, umnyango uzoqala uthinte bonke abanye okumele bahlomule abafake izicelo ukuthi bazomukela amasheke, ” usho kanje.Uthe nemali etholwa ondlunkulu ayilingani kodwa lokhu kuncike ebhizinisini afake ngalo isicelo nokuthi selivele liqalile ukwenza umehluko emphakathini elikuwo. Ugcizelele ukuthi ababizwe kulo mcimbi bayingxenye yabazohlomula yize kungesibo bonke, waqinisekisa ukuthi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi umnyango uzimisele ukuthi bonke ondlunkulu bahlomule kulolu hlelo.Ekhuluma emcimbini wokwethulwa kwalo , uNkk Sithole-Moloi uthe umnyango ubulokhu uxhasa ubuholi bomdabu, kodwa ubungakenzi ngokwanele ngasohlangothini londlunkulu" Kuyagqugquzela ukuthi iningi londlunkulu livele seliqale ukusebenza ngaphambi kokuthi lolu hlelo lwethulwe ngokusemthethweni. Kuyajabulisa ukwethula lolu hlelo olubalulekile ngosuku lokubungaza abesifazane lomhlaba wonke,” usho kanje.USihlalo weNdlu yabaHoli boMdabu KwaZulu-Natal, Inkosi Sifiso Shinga, ukushayele ihlombe okwenziwe yilo mnyango.
ZIKHATHAZEKILE izikhulu zoMnyango wezokuThutha KwaZulu-Natal ngokuthi njalo uma kunemicimbi emikhulu ehlanganisa izinkumbi zabantu kubakhona abantu abalimalayo.Lokhu kulandela ingozi yamabhasi okulimale kuyo inqwaba yamalungu e-IFP ngeSonto ekuseni abelibhekise eralini yaleli qembu enkundleni yemidlalo iMoses Mabhida eThekwini.Ngokwemibiko kuthiwa amabhasi amathathu abelibangise kule rali yokwethulwa komqulu wezethembiso zokhetho, ashayisane ngaseGingindlovu kuN2.Okhulumela uMnyango wezokuThutha uMnuz Kwanele Ncalane, uzwakalise ukukhathazeka ngezingozi ezibakhona uma kunemicimbi efuze le.Uthe abashayeli kumele bandiswe uma bezohamba amabanga amade.Uveze ukuthi abanye basuke sebekhathele bese kudaleka izingozi.KUSHAYISANE amabhasi abelibangise eralini ye-IFP ebiseThekwini izolo ekuseni kuN2 Isithombe: IPSS Medical Rescue"Sinxusa abahleli bemicimbi ukuthi baqinisekise ukuthi babili abashayeli abasuke bezoshintshana uma bezohamba amabanga amade ukuze baphumule. Abanye uthola ukuthi bahamba amabanga amade, abanye ngisho ebusuku ngakho basuke bekudinga ukuphumula.” Uthe akekho oshonile kule ngozi ngaphandle kwabalimele.Ngokombiko wabezimo eziphuthumayo bakwa-IPSS Medical Rescue, bangu-36 abalimale kule ngozi eyenzeke ngabo-9 ekuseni.Okhulumela abe-IPSS uNksz Samantha Meyrick, uthe bayisishiyagalombili abaphuthunyiswe esibhedlela, abanye belimele kanzima. Uthe abanye bebenemihuzukwana nje wathi abanye babalaphele endaweni yesehlakalo. I-ANC esifundazweni ifisele abalimele ukwelulama okusheshayo.Kwenzeka lokhu nje ngenyanga edlule kushone abalandeli be-ANC abayisishiyagalombili, ngesikhathi bephuma eralini yokwethulwa komqulu wezithembiso zokhetho eyayikule nkundla. Ibhasi yayilibangise eMpumalanga kanti ingozi yenzeka emgwaqweni uR33 eDumbe.NgoJanuwari kwashona abalandeli abayisithupha be-ANC ababeye emgubheni iJanuwari 8 eMpumalanga.Le ngozi yenzeka eLimpopo kanti ibhasi yayiya enkundleni yemidlalo iMbombela.

UMPHATHISWA woMnyango wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi KwaZulu-Natal uNkk Nonhlanhla Khoza uqhakambise iqhaza losonhlalakahle ababhekela inhlalakahle yabantu.Ukusho lokhu njengoba kugujwa inyanga eyaziwa njengeyokuhlonipha lezi zisebenzi zomphakathi egujwa umhlaba wonke.Uthe le nyanga eyokukhumbula, ukuqhakambisa nokubonga ukusebenza ngokungakhathali nokuzinikela kwalezi zisebenzi kulo mkhakha."Ukubaluleka kosonhlakahle emphakathini wethu ngeke kubukelwe phansi. ISIKHWAMA esixhasa ngemali yokufunda ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme, iNational Students’ Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS), sesigxeke isehlakalo sokuvalelwa kwezisebenzi zalesi sikhwama ngaphandle kwemvume yazo, ngesikhathi ziyoxazulula izinkinga ezithinta izindawo zokuhlala izitshudeni eNyuvesi yaseZululand, oNgoye.Lesi sehlakalo kuthiwa senzeke ngoLwesihlanu, kulesi sikhungo lapho lezi zithunywa zigcine sezisatshiswa.Okhulumela isikhwama, uMnuz Ishmael Mnisi, uthe lesi sehlakalo senzeke emuva kokuba kube nomhlangano wohlaka oluthinta izindawo zokuhlala kulesi sikhwama, elalihlangane nabahlinzeka ngezindawo zokuhlala abazimele kanjalo nezikhulu zenyuvesi ngoLwesibili odlule, kubhungwa mayelana nokukhokhelwa kwalezi zindawo. Uthe kulo mhlangano kwavunyelwana ngokuthi kujutshwe ithimba lesikhwama ukuze lifake isandla ohlelweni lokuthi kufakwe izitshudeni ohlelweni lweNSFAS ukuze kukwazi ukuthi kukhokhelwe abanikazi balezi zindawo."I-NSFAS isacubungula eyokuthathela izinyathelo abahlinzeka ngezindawo zokuhlala, ababeyingxenye yalesi sehlakalo sasoNgoye. Sihlaba nekhwelo lokuthi izikhungo zemfundo kungaba amanyuvesi noma amakolishi amakhono ama-TVET, ukuthi ziqinisekise ukuthi lezo zitshudeni ezingakangeni ngaphansi kohlelo lweNSFAS, zisheshe zifakwe ukuze zikwazi ukukhokhelwa.” Uthe uma kunokubambezeleka ngeke zisheshe zithole imihlomulo yazo yezindawo zokuhlala."Abanikazi bezindawo zokuhlala kumele baqikelele ukuthi izinkontileka okumele zisayinwe izitshudeni ezithinta lezi zindawo, ziyazisayina ngokushesha. UMnisi uthe baqale ukukhokha imihlomulo yezindawo zokuhlala yezitshudeni ezihlala emakolishi amakhono ngeledlule.Usho lokhu nje, kuke kwaba nezikhalazo kwizitshudeni ezihlala emakolishi ahlukene ezixoshwe abanikazi bezindawo zokuhlala ngoba lesi sikhwama singakhokhile kuze kube yimanje.Lezi zitshudeni bezikhala ngokuthi azazi ukuthi zizoshonaphi njengoba bezikhishwa nasebusuku, zigcina sezilala endle.Ugxeke nezinsolo zenkohlakalo zokusebenzisana phakathi kwezitshudeni, abahlinzeka ngezindawo zokuhlala, abasebenzi bezikhungo kanjalo nabahola izitshudeni."Ngeke siyibekezelele inkohlakalo kanti sizophenya zonke izinsolo ezikhona. Sizophenya ezikhungweni ngoba asifuni kube nokuxhashazwa kwezitshudeni." Unxuse abangaba nolwazi ngenkohlakalo ukuthi babike ku:Vuvuzela, kwinombolo ethi: 0860 247 653. Bangathumela no-Call Back ku: 30916.Ukhumbuze abahlinzeka ngezindawo zokuhlala ukuthi uma ziqhele ngo-5km kuya phansi kumele bahlinzeke izitshudeni ngezinto zokuzithwala ziye ezikhungweni noma sezibuya.Ubalule nokuthi kumele baqinisekise nokuthi lezi zindawo ziphephile.
ISINQUMO sokuchithwa kwamajaji amabili akuleli iJaji uJohn Hlophe, ebeliwumengameli wamaJaji eWestern Cape neselithathe umhlalaphansi iJaji uNkola Motata, sishiye imibono ehlukene.Bekuqala ngoHlophe noMotata ukuthi kuketulwe noma kuchithwe amajaji ngaphansi kombuso wentando yeningi. Bekulindelekile ukuthi kube wudaba oludala umsindo ezinhlakeni ezehlukene.Kuvamile ukuthi kube nezikhalo zokuthi umkhakha wezomthetho kuleli unamabatha futhi lokhu kudala ukuthi ungethenjwa kahle. Kuhlala kukhalwa ngokuthi amajaji abuye engathembeki ekutheni ngabe asebenza ngobuqotho na.Inhloko yamaJaji kuleli, iJaji Raymond Zondo, selizame kaningi ukuvikela amajaji, lithi uma kukhona onobufakazi akabuhambise kuphenywe. UZondo usuke evika izagila amajaji esolwa ngokungaziphathi kahle nangenkohlakalo.IPhalamende lisanda kuvota ligunyaza ukuchithwa kwamajaji uHlophe noMotata alahlwe amacala ehlukene. UHlophe ulahlwe yicala lokuzama ukunxenxa amajaji ukuthi enzelele owayengumengameli uMnuz Jacob Zuma.UHlophe kuthiwa waphula umthetho wokuziphatha mhla ecubuzela uZuma amagabade emajajini. Kukhalwa ngokuthi wathunaza umkhakha wamajajai nezobulungiswa kuleli.UHlophe uphike kwaze kwaba sekugcineni, ethi amacala abekwa wona awekho kodwa kunetulo elihambisana nepolitiki. Kuthathe iminyaka cishe ewu-15 ukuthi kuphothulwe udaba lwakhe. Kungenzeka lufinyelele enkantolo lolu daba ngoba uHlophe akeneme ngesinqumo.UMotata yena walahlwa yicala emuva kokuthi eshayele ebukhile, washayisa udonga lwesakhiwo thizeni nokuwudaba owlaba wundabamlonyeni.Ngaphandle kukaHlophe noMotata, kukhona namanye amajaji ashushiswayo wona angakalahlwa amacala. Phakathi kwayo kukhona iJaji uNomonde Mngqibisa-Thusi neJaji uTshifhiwa Maumela.Nawo la majaji asolwa ngokungaziphathi kahle emsebenzini wawo nokwaphoqa ukuthi kufakwe isikhalo amiswe bese eyophenywa aphendule phambi kwezithangami ezifanele.Kuyini ukuchithwa kwamajaji alahlwe amacala?Isizindalwazi seJudges Matters sichaza kabanzi ngokuketulwa kwejaji liphucwe amandla. Bakhuluma ngesigatshana 77 soMthethosisekelo wezwe ogunyaza ukuketulwa noma ukuchithwa kwejaji okuhlukene izigaba ezintathu."Isigaba sikhuluma ngokususwa kwejaji uma likhombisa ukwehlulwa wumsebenzi noma lilahlwe amacala kumbe ukungaziphathi kahle. Kufanele udaba lubekwe ePhalamende, bese kuyavotwa, iningi uma livumelana bese kuphuma isinqumo,’’ kusho isizindalwazi.Ngaphambi kwalokho, udaba lusuke luqale kwiJudicial Service Commission ibambisene neJudicial Conduct Tribunal ephenyayo. Kuvela ukuthi uma udaba lufika ePhalamende lubhekwa nawumnyango wezomthetho bese wululeka usomlomo.Usomlomo uba esexhumana nehhovisi lenhloko yamajaji nezinye izinhlaka ezithintekayo. Uma kuqedwa ukuvota ePhalamende, uSomlomo ubhalela umengameli emazisa ngomphumela nesinqumo okufanele asithathe. Uma sekuphothuliwe konke, ijaji liyephucwa lelo gama bese libizwa njengabantu abajwayelekile. Akugcini lapho kodwa lephucwa nemihlomulo ehambisana nomholo nakho konke okunye.Amajaji ahola cishe imali efinyelela kuR1 million ngonyaka nemihlomulo ehambisana nezimoto nokunye. Konke lokhu kuyahlwithwa uma ijaji lichithwa.Ukuchithwa kwamajaji uHlophe noMotata, kususe umsindo omkhulu ikakhulukazi emaqenjini ezepolitiki akhala ngokuthi ngamajaji amnyama achithiwe. Amaqembu akhala ngokuthi lokhu kubuyisela emuva umsebenzi omkhulu wezokuphuculwa kwezomthetho kuleli.Inhlangano ebusayo i-ANC yiyona eyiningi ePhalamende nokuchaza ukuthi amalungu ayo avota ngobuningi bawo echitha amajaji amabili. UNobhala-Jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, waphawula ngalolu daba lwesikhalo ngamajaji amnyama."Siyahambisana impela nokuthi abantu abamnyama bangene ezikhundleni eziqavile njengawo amajaji kodwa uma umuntu etholwe enecala akukho esingakwenza. Kuphoqe isimo ukuthi amajaji achithwe noma kubuhlungu kunjalo kodwa iqiniso limile,’’ kusho uMbalula.I-EFF ikugxekile kakhulu ukuchithwa kukaHlophe, yathi iyazwelana naye kakhulu futhi ngeke alale engadlile ikhona. UMalema uke wabonakala evakashele uHlophe ekhombisa ukumeseka, waxoxa naye kabanzi ngalolu daba.Ngaphandle kodaba lwamajaji, kade kusanda kuphothulwa uhlelo lokuchithwa kobengumvikeli womphakathi, u-Advocate Busisiwe Mkhwebane naye owakhishwa yiPhalamende. I-EFF nalapho ikugxeke kakhulu ukuchithwa kwakhe njengomuntu omnyama emkhakheni wezomthetho aphinde abe ngowesifazane.Phambilini, abamnyama nabesifazane bebengavamile ukuba sezikhundleni eziphezulu zomthetho kuleli nokuyinto okube nesidingo sokuthi ilungiswe. PHEZU kokuba othisha besifazane kuyibo abaningi emkhakheni wemfundo kuleli kodwa basembalwa abangothishanhloko bezikole.Lokhu kuvezwe nguNgqongqoshe weMfundo eyisiSekelo, uNkk Angie Motshekga, obekhuluma engqungqutheleni yokubuyekeza imigomo yeSadtu, eGoli, ngempelasonto.UNkk Motshekga uthe lide ibanga elihanjiwe ukufukula abesifazane babe sezikhundleni.Uveze ukuthi u-71% wothisha kuleli abesifazane."Kulaba kodwa u-41% wabo abangothishanhloko. Ingxenye eningi abesilisa abangothishanhloko. Akufani khona ngoba u-66% wabesifazane bayizinhloko zeminyango.”Uveze ukuthi u-56% wabesifazane basethimbeni labaphathi ezikoleni, ama-school management teams."Njengoba kuphela iminyaka engu-30 izwe lakhululeka, lide ibanga eselihanjiwe kwezemfundo noma singakafinyeleli lapho sifuna khona singabesifazane. Siyawubona umehluko ngoba phambilini abesifazane yayingacatshangwa nje indaba yabo. Ngezikhathi zethu sisafundisa, wawungayicabangi nje eyokuthi owesifazane angaba nguthishanhloko. Nakhona uma unguthishanhloko wawugcina ezikoleni zamabanga aphansi, ungeke ube uthishanhloko ezikoleni zamabanga aphezulu,” kusho uNkk Motshekga.Uthe ingane yomfana kumele ifundiswe ukuthi iyiveze imizwa yayo uma kukhona okungayiphethe kahle."Akumele sifundise izingane ukuthi ngoba zingabafana, akumele zikhale. Akumele sithi uma zikhala sizibize ngokuthi zingosisi ngoba nazo zinayo imizwa. Kumele sizifundise ukuthi uma kunzima indoda iyakhala,” kuqhuba uNkk Motshekga.Uveze nokuthi izingane zamantombazane ziyaqhubeka nokwenza kahle ezifundweni zazo ukudlula abafana.Ubalule nokuthi ludla lubi udlame olubhekiswe ezinganeni ezikoleni njengoba kukhona abasebenzisa induku, wathi nakuba ikhona imigomo enqanda lokhu.UMnuz Nkosana Dolopi iPhini likaNonbhala weSadtu, uthe imigomo yenyunyana kumele ilandelwe ngaso sonke isikhathi.Uthe eminye yemigomo elawula othisha kuleli esetshensizwa wumkhandlu wothisha, iSouth African Council for Educators (SACE), yenziwa yibona."Le migomo ithinta izinto eziningi ezifaka nothisha abasalala nabafundi. Le migomo kumele ilandelwe yingakho nathi sifuna ukubuyekeza eyeSadtu, ukubheka ukuthi isahambisana nesimo samanje.” Uveze ukuthi njengoba kungamalungu aphakamisa le migomo, okwabo njengabaholi kunguthi baqinisekise ukuthi iyalandelwa."Njengoba kuzovotwa nje, isinqumo sithi sivotela i-ANC, okuyinto eyaziwayo. Uma wena usuphambana nalokhu, kusho ukuthi usuphambana nezinto esavumelana ngazo.”

Sizoqeda ngenkinga kagesi ekhungethe kuleli, sakhe amathuba emisebenzi njengoba u-80% wale misebenzi izobekelwa abantu bakuleli, u-20% abantu bokufika. Sizonyusa imali yezibonelelo, eyezingane kanjalo neyabantu abadala. Sifuna kube nesibonelelo sabangasebenzi sikaR3 000 esizosiza besafuna imisebenzi.”Ukhale ngokuvalwa kwezindawo zokuholela izaguga wathi bazovuselela namakolishi avalwa okubalwa othisha nawabahlengikazi."Abesifazane nezingane abakwazi ukuhamba ngokukhululeka. Sizotshala amasosha ezindaweni ezihaqwe ubugebengu kuleli obuhlalise umphakathi lubhojozi.” Uthe bazonika amandla izinkantolo zamakhosi ukuze zikwazi ukukhipha izigwebo ezinzima kwabenza ubugebengu, kuqashwe namaphoyisa enele ukulwa nale nkinga.Uveze ukuthi kuzobuyekezwa isikhwama esixhasa ngemali yokufunda emakolishi nasemanyuvesi iNSFAS.Odabeni lwabokufika, uthe kumele babe namaphepha acacile okuthi bazohlala isikhathi esingakanani njengoba kwenzeka nakwamanye amazwe, ngeke kube yikwampunzi edla emini."Asicwasi abantu bokufika kodwa sibeka abantu bakuleli phambili. Sifuna kuhlomule bona ngezinsiza zakuleli.” Uveze ukuthi kuzokwehliswa ukubiza kwentengo kaphethroli ukuze kungabizi ukudla.Kwezemfundo, uthe bazoqeqesha kabusha othisha."Sifuna ukunika othisha ithuba lokuthola amakhono amasha. Kwezempilo sifuna wonke umuntu athole ukunakekeleka, sakhe imitholampilo lapho kuhlala khona abantu.” Uthe bazokwakhela abantu izindlu ezizobanika isithunzi, okuzothi uma iqeda ukwakhiwa ifakwe ugesi welanga ukuze kungabi nenkinga yokucishwa kukagesi."Siyovala imigodi egcwele emigwaqweni. Imali eningi iyoyiswa komasipala, sizovuselela izitimela namabhasi. Sizoxoxa nosomatekisi ukuze sizwe ngezinkinga zabo ngoba yiyona mboni ephethwe ngabantu abamnyama.” Uthe umhlaba ohleli ongenziwa lutho uyonikwa abantu ukuze bawusebenzise."Senibhikishe kwanela, nashisa amathayi, navala imigwaqo, kodwa akukho zinguquko. Ziyekeni lezi zinto manje, hambani niyoshintsha uhulumeni ngevoti ngoMeyi 29.” Kube nomunyu ngesikhathi kudlalwa i-video kaShenge lapho ayevivisa khona abalandeli.

Uveze ukuthi wenziwa yindlunkulu ihlangene kanjalo nenhlangano engenzinzuzo, iGoodwill Foundation. Ngokusho kwesitatimende esithunyelwe uMntwana uMbonisi kwabezindaba, umkhuleko owenziwa kulandela ukukhothama koNgangezwe lakhe, ngoMashi 2021, uzoba seMahhashini KwaNongoma.UMntwana uMbonisi uthe okubajabulisayo ukuthi kuzobe kungokokuqala ukuthi lesi sikhumbuzo sibanjwe yindlunkulu ihlangene."Lokhu kuwuphawu lokuzibophezela ekubuyiseni ukuthula, ubumbano nesithunzi sendlunkulu,” kusho uMntwana.Echaza ngokuzobe kwenzeka ngalolu suku, uthe kuzobe kukhulekwa, kubungazwa neqhaza leSilo esakhothama, kuphinde kwenziwe nezibophezelo emibonweni yaso.Uthe kuzosetshenziswa umkhuleko ukukhulekela ukuthula nobumbano endlunkulu.Uqhube wathi bayibonile imizamo yezepolitiki ezama ukudukisa nokuhlukanisa phakathi indlunkulu."Labo bazifunela nje amavoti besebenzisa isizwe sikaZulu. Asihambisani nosopolitiki abasebenzisa isiko likaZulu nemicimbi ebalulekile ukuzama ukugaya amavoti,” usho kanje.Echaza iSilo esesakhothama, uthe njengenkosi ebesemlandweni wokuhola isikhathi eside ukuwadlula wonke emlandweni wesizwe samaZulu, kubalulekile ukukhunjulwa kwaso.Umkhuleko uthe uvuleleke kuwo wonke umuntu.

UMMELI wabamangalewa ecaleni lokufa kukaSenzo Meyiwa, u-Advocate Thulani Mngomezulu, usole umholi wabaphenyi uBrigadier Bongani Gininda, ngokunyanyalata nokuqamba amanga.UMeyiwa owayeyintandokazi kanozinti we-Orlando Pirates neBafana Bafana, wadutshulwa wabulawa ekubo kwentombi yakhe uKelly Khumalo ngo2014. Kushushiswa abalisa abahlanu okuthiwa yibona abathengwa ukuthi baqede ngaye.UMbuso umi ngezitatimende othi zabhalwa zasayinwa ngabamangalelwa ngesikhathi begeqa amagula ngeqhaza labo ekufeni kukaMeyiwa. Izinhlangoti zombili zenza izethulo phambi kwejaji.UMbuso uqedile ukwenza izethulo kwase kuba yithuba labameli ukuthi babeke awabo amaphuzu. Incwadi ayisebenzisa ukubabopha yatholakala ngokungemthetho,’’ kubeka uMngomezulu.Ukhale ngokuthi kubukeka sengathi uGininda wayengazi ukuthi bangaki abantu afuna ukubabopha."Nkosi yenkantolo khona lapho okubhalwe ukuthi abamangalelwa bayisihlanu, ajike athi bayisithupha. Phathaphatha usekhuluma ngoKelly Khumalo athi nguyena owabaqasha. Kufike kuthiwe kwakubanjwa inkunzi khona lapho futhi kwakungabantu abathengiwe, kuyadida nje,’’ kusho uMngomezulu.UMngomezulu uthi iphoyisa uWarrant Officer Meshack Makhubo, lishilo ukuthi amaphoyisa aphikisana aze ahlukana phakathi ngokwakumele baboshwe. Uthe kukodwa nje lokho kuyakhomba ukuthi kunenkinga.UMngomezulu ucelele abamangalelwa ukuthi ubufakazi babo buthathwe njengeqiniso uma sekubhekwa isinqumo. Inkinga yamanzi ibithanda ukusiphazamisa kodwa sabona ukuthi kufanele size neminye imizamo,” kusho uNksz Mfeka.Uthe ebusika amanzi awabi khona ngisho emfuleni ayasha bese ephoqeleka ukuba ayowathenga esitolo.Isifiso sakhe wukuthola ojojo abazokwazi ukugcina amanzi emvula nokuba angene ezifundweni zolimo njengoba kuyinto ayithandayo."Amanzi kamasipala ayaphela amasonto amabili engaphumi empompini. Mhla ephuma awahlali isikhathi eside. Ehlobo kuba ngcono ngoba imvula isuke ikhona ukusilekelela kodwa ebusika kuba nzima ngoba nomfula esithembele kuwona uyasha. Ngiyakudinga ukuxhaswa ngojojo engizokwazi ukugcina kubo amanzi,” kusho uNksz Mkhize.Ugqugquzele intsha ukuba ingalindi ukuqashwa ezinkampanini ezizimele kodwa izame ukuzakhela amathuba omsebenzi lapho ikhona. Uthe kulula ukungena kwezolimo ngoba uma unomhlaba uyakwazi ukutshala okuncane ozokwazi ukuzidlela kona wena nabanye.

Kufanele uqhubeke nokuzivocavoca uze ubone umehluko. Ukhumbule ukuthi ukudla okunomsoco kubaluleke ukudlula ukuzivocavoca,” kuphetha uNksz Mkhize.
