Isolezwe like labika ngomcimbi wokwethulwa kwe-albhamu kaShiselansimbi, owawusehholo lomphakathi eCilwane, ngoJuni 2021. Kanti omakhelwane bakhe bamchaza njengomuntu oyisibonelo esihle. Lo maskanda kuthiwa wahleshulelwa uR133 000, esambeni semali ewuR800 000 obikwa ukuthi wakhokhelwa ababulali baka-AKA. Ngokophenyo lwamaphoyisa, iseleula kaShiselansimbi iveza ukuthi wayekhona umculi endaweni yesigameko phambi kwaseWish on Florida, eThekwini, waxhumana nomunye wabamangalelwa.U-AKA, nomngani wakhe uTebello 'Tibz’ Motsoane, balalelwa unyendle ngabantu maqede bashonela endaweni yesigameko ngesikhathi bephuma endaweni yokudlela.Kuleli cala uShiselansimbi, obuye abe wusomatekisi, usolwa noMnuz Lindokuhle Thabani Mkhwanazi (30), ongusomatekisi, uMnuz Siyanda Eddie Myeza (21) ongumahlalela eMlaza, uMnuz Mziwethemba Harvey Gwabeni (36) ongusomabhizinisi onezimayini eLimpopo, uMnuz Lindokuhle Ndimande (29) onepulazi eCamperdown ngaseMgungundlovu, uMnuz Siyabonga Gezani Ndimande/Nxele (28) noMnuz Malusi 'Mjay’ Dave Ndimande (29). Kwenzeka lokhu nje, kusanda kusala enkundleni omunye umculi kamaskandi uSjula 'Iqhawe LakoMenziwa’ Biyela. Lokhu kwenzeka ngesikhathi amaphoyisa ophiko oluphenya amacala abucayi iNational Intervention Unit (NIU), edubulana nabasolwa ngobugebengu obenzeka eNtibane Lodge, phakathi kwasoLundi, naseMelmoth ngenyanga edlule. Kulesi sigameko, uSjula wadlula emhlabeni noMnuz Sihle 'Gwajo’ Biyela, Mnuz Bizokwakhe Sithole noMnuz Lindani Ncanana.
UMENGAMELI we-IFP, uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa, unxuse abantu ukuba bangavumi ukubuswa wumcabango wokuthi ukuphuma kwe-ANC emandleni kungenza izinto zibe mapeketwane.UHlabisa uthe ukukhishwa kwe-ANC okhethweni lwangoMeyi 29, angeke kuphazamise ukuphathwa kwezwe, wathi eNingizimu Afrika kunenqwaba yabaholi abakulungele ukuthatha izintambo uma kukhishwa i-ANC.Lokhu ukusho emcimbini wokwethulwa kwencwadi ekhuluma ngokuphathwa kwamazwe, i-Poor state, rich state.Le ncwadi ebhalwe nguDkt Greg Mills, yethulwe ngokusemthethweni eMgungundlovu.Incwadi iveza ukuthi izinto kazihambi kahle eNingizimu Afrika.UHlabisa ugcine engafikanga kulo mcimbi ngenxa yesiminyaminya ebesikuthelawayeka, uN3, wagcina ethumela inkulumo ebhaliwe, efundwe emcimbini.Kule nkulumo ebhaliwe, uHlabisa uthe bakhona labo abanenkolelo yokuthi ukuphuma kwe-ANC emandleni kungona izinto eziningi."Le nto ayisilo iqiniso. Lapha eNingizimu Afrika sinenqwaba yabaholi abanamava okuphatha nabaqotho, abakulungele ukuphatha. Thina njenge-IFP sikulungele ukuthatha izwe, siliyise phambili. Sesikulungele ukuphatha emva kokhetho."UHlabisa uthe sekuyisikhathi sokuba i-ANC iphume emandleni."I-ANC ikhathalele ukufeza izifiso zedlanzana. I-ANC iyinto engeke isalungiseka. Ayidingi ukwakhiwa kabusha, idinga ukuqalwa phansi. Lokho sikushiyela kuyona i-ANC."Esikwaziyo ukuthi angeke izwe siphinde silinike laba bantu. Izwe lethu lisesimweni esibucayi, kungashabalala konke uma bengaphinde baphathe eminye iminyaka emihlanu. Kabanayo imigomo yokukhulisa umnotho. Noma iliphi iqembu lebhola liyazi uma sekufanele lixoshe umqeqeshi. Kusobala ukuthi eNingizimu Afrika sidinga ushintsho oluzoyisa izwe lakithi phambili."UHlabisa uthe ngaphansi koMbuso we-ANC kuningi okonakele.Uthe amathuba emisebenzi nezinga lobugebengu kwakungcono eminyakeni eyishumi yokuqala ngaphansi koMbuso wentandoyeningi."Njengamanje, izinga lobugebengu liphezulu kakhulu. Kanjalo nelokuswelakala kwamathuba emisebenzi liphezulu kakhulu. UMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa wakhala ngokuLawulwa koMbuso yiDlanzana, nokubheduka kobhubhane iCorona ngesikhathi ethula inkulumo ayibhekise ezweni."Iqiniso ukuthi ngaphambi kokuthi kubheduke iCorona, umnotho wethu ubuvele ukhula kancane, abatshalimali base bevele sebeqalile ukulaxaza elakuleli. Asikwazi ukukhala ngeCorona ngoba izinto kade zaqala ukonakala."I-IFP izokwethula umkhankaso wezethembiso zokhetho ngeSonto, eThekwini.
KUKHUZWA umkhuba okuthiwa uyadlanga, wokujikijelwa kwezitimela ezihambela emalokishini akhele idolobha iTheku, osekuholele ekuncipheni kwesibalo sezitimela ngenxa yokuthi zisuke zisayolungiswa.Uphiko lwezitimela ezithwala abagibeli, i-Passanger Rail Agency of South Africa, luthi lesi sihlava sesiholele ekulahlekeni kwemali eningi njengoba kubiza imali eshisiwe ukuthenga amawindi afa kulezi zigameko, okukholakala ukuthi isikhathi esiningi zenziwa yizingane ezidlala eceleni kukajantshi.Olukhulumelayo KwaZulu- Natal uMnuz Zama Nomnganga, uthe izigameko zokujikijelwa kwezitimela ngamatshe zenzeka kakhulu emizileni ebheke esiteshini iThembalihle KwaMashu naseCato Ridge."Sesehlile isibalo sezitimela ezihambela KwaMashu naseCato Ridge. Lokhu kwenziwa ukuthi izitimela ezimbili ebezisebenzisa umzila waKwaMashu zikhishiwe zisayolungiswa, kanti sinye esikhishwe emzileni waseCato Ridge. Okwenzekayo ukuthi izitimela ezintsha azifani nezindala obekukhishwa amakhanda ayolungiswa uma enenkinga kusetshenziswe elinye ukudonsa isitimela. Lezi zamanje uma ubulala iwindi langaphambili, kumele sikhishwe sonke emzileni siyolungiswa ngoba asihlukaniseki,” usho kanje.Uthe ukufakwa kwamawindi kudla izigidi ngobudedengu nje babantu abayekela izingane zenze umdlalo ongemuhle wokucekela phansi impahla. Unxuse abazali nomphakathi ukuthi balekelele ekukhuzeni izingane ezenza lo mdlalo kwazise awugcini ngokushodisa izitimela nje kuphela, kodwa ubuye ubeke impilo yabagibeli engozini ngoba ukushayeka kwewindi lesitimela sihamba, kungathusa umshayeli siphume emzileni kudaleke isibhicongo.UNomnganga uthe bakhathezekile njengoba kusondela ukuvalwa kwezikole, okusho ukuthi isibalo sezingane ezenza lo mkhuba singase sande.Uthe ikhona imikhankaso asebevele bayiqalile yokuhambela izikole beqwashisa ngengozi yokujikijelwa kwezitimela kanti bayahlangana nezinhlaka ezehlukene zomphakathi ezilekelela ngokukhuza lesi sihlava.
KUQUBUKE impi yamazwi phakathi kwamalungu ekomiti lemigomo yePhalamende. Bekudingidwa ngokungasukunyelwa kwezinsolo zenkohlakalo ezibhekiswe kuSomlomo wePhalamende, uNkk Nosiviwe Mapisa-Nqakula.Amalungu aphikisayo abuze ukuthi yiziphi izinyathelo ezizothathelwa uNkk Mapisa-Nqakula, ngezinsolo zokuthi wagwazelwa cishe ngoR2 million? Kuthi imali wayinikezwa ngomunye usonkontileka owayethole ithenda emnyangweni wezokuVikela ngesikhathi usaphethwe nguSomlomo. Nakuba uNkk Mapisa-Nqakula ezichithile izinsolo futhi wazibophezela ekutheni uzobambisana nophenyo kodwa amalungu ePhalamende akhale ngokuthi kubukeka inganakwa eyezinsolo. UNksz Hlengiwe Mkhaliphi we-EFF, ubuze ukuthi yikuphi abakwenzayo ngezinsolo, wafuna ukuthi udaba lubhungwe izolo emhlanganweni.Ibamba likasomlomo uMnuz Cedric Frolick, liphendule ngokuthi udaba lusezithebeni zekomiti elibhekele ukuziphatha kwamalungu. UFrolick uthe uma kuwukuthi bayalubhunga udaba, bazobe bephula imigomo yekomiti okumele ilucubungule. Kodwa uNksz Mkhaliphi uthe ngeke avume ukuthi batshelwe ukuthi yiziphi izinto okumele bazixoxe nokungamele bazixoxe.Kujobelele uSotswebhu weDA uNksz Siviwe Gwarube, wathi bazofaka isikhalazo ekomitini lezokuziphatha kwamalungu ePhalamende. Wathi kumele sivikelwe isithunzi sePhalamende futhi wathi labo abatholakala benecala lenkohlakalo kumele babhekane nomthetho.UFrolick uchazile ukuthi ikomiti elibhekele ukuphenya izinsolo ezibhekiswe kuSomlomo, lagcina ukuhlangana ngo-2023, nakhona lahlangana izikhawu eziyisithupha. Uveze ukuthi kulo nyaka alikaze lihlangane.Lokhu kudale ukuthi amalungu avuke umbhejazane, abuza ukuthi ngabe bukhona yini ubulungiswa obuzokwenziwa yikomiti elihlangana izikhawu ezimbalwa ngonyaka?"Asikwazi ukuthi singahlala singenzi lutho kunezinsolo ezinzima kanje,” kusho uNksz Mkhaliphi.USotswebhu we-ANC uNksz Pemmy Majodina, uvikele uNkk Mapisa-Nqakula, wathi akumele izinsolo ezingakaqinisekiswa ziphenduke inkundla yokunqakisana ngamazwi.UNksz Gwarube uthe uma ikomiti limthola ukuthi kumele aphendule ngezinsolo uSomlomo, kumele kuqale uhlelo lokumsusa esikhundleni.Okhulumela uSomlomo uMnuz Mike Ramagoma, uthe uma kunophenyo olwenziwayo uNkk Mapisa-Nqakula uzobambisana nalo futhi uzophendula yonke imibuzo. Kepha, uRamagoma ukuqinisekisele ukuthi usomlomo umsulwa ezinsolweni asolwa ngazo.
USIHLALO we-IFP KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thamsanqa Ntuli, uthe abantu abazothamela umcimbi weqembu wezethembiso zokhetho enkundleni iMoses Mabhida, eThekwini, ngeke bavunyelwe ukugcaluza bayoze baphume sekuphele umcimbi.UNtuli ukhulume neSolezwe enkundleni iMoses Mabhida, ngesikhathi ehlola isimo ngoba balungiselela umcimbi ozoba ngeSonto. Kulindeleke ukuthi i-IFP yethule umhlahlandlela wokhetho wokuqala selokhu kwakhothama umsunguli wayo, inkosi Mangosuthu Buthelezi.UNtuli ubehamba nabasebenzi be-IFP, nabanye abaholi bezinye izinhlaka zayo. Bekubonakala ukuthi bamatasa balungiselela ukufakwa kwezithombe zabaholi kanti nesiteji bese sixhunyiwe.Njengamanye amaqembu, i-IFP ilungiselela ukhetho lukazwelonke olukhonjwe kuMeyi 29, lapho kuyogezelwana khona kucace ukuthi ngubani ozobusa izwe.Kulindeleke ukuthi abalandeli be-IFP baqhamuke kuzo zonke izinkalo bezothamela umhlahlandlela weqembu. UMengameli we-IFP uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa, uzokwethula inkulumo yosuku.I-IFP yelama amanye amaqembu asephuma khona kule nkundla ebukeka inesibunge emaqenjini. Kuqale i-EFF kwalandela i-ANC abenze imicimbi yabo ebithanyelwe yizinkumbi zabantu. Muva nje, kwabonakala abalandeli be-ANC sebethe chithi saka olwandle, bengasayingeni eyomcimbi.I-IFP iyafunga iyagomela ukuthi izogcwala ichichime inkundla futhi ngeke abantu babe wuvanzi. UNtuli uthe indaba yokugcaluza izobe ingavumelekile, kufanele abantu baziphathe kahle bahloniphe umcimbi."Sithe abantu uma sebengene ngaphakathi abaphumi, ezokuphepha zizobe ziqinile ukubheka ukuthi ongaphakathi akaphumeli ngaphandle. Sizoyenza yonke imizamo yokuthi abantu bahlale, umengameli aze aqede ukukhuluma emuva kwalokho abantu sebengaya emabhishi,’’ kusho uNtuli.Uthe bayamangala ngendlela abantu abakhombisa isasasa ngayo kwi-IFP uze abone ukuthi uShenge lapho ekhona uyazimemela abantu. UNtuli uthe banqume ukuyisa umkhankaso wabo kule nkundla ngoba kunabantu abaningi abayilambele i-IFP.UNtuli uthe kunabantu bazobe bevela nakwezinye izifundazwe abafuna ukuzozizwela bona umyalezo we-IFP. Uthe ngeSonto kuzobe kufakwe izikibha zobuso bomsunguli weqembu ezimhlophe qwa. Uthe bami ngesisekelo somsebenzi kaShenge, ashiya ewenzile esebenzela abantu bakuleli.
ZIMBILI VILAKAZI NONHLAKANIPHO MNQAYIKWENGEZWE amanye amacala amabili kwabasolwa ngokudubula babulale umculi uKiernan "AKA” Forbes nomngani wakhe uTebello "Tibz” Motsoane ngoFebhuwari nyakenye.U-AKA noTibs badutshulwa ngaphandle kwendawo yokudlela eseyavalwa iWish esemgwaqweni odumile uFlorida.Abasolwa okungoMnuz Lindani Thabani Mkhwanazi (30), Lindani Zenzele Ndimande (35), Siyanda Eddie Myeza (21), Mziwethemba Harvey Gwabini (36) noLindokuhle Lindo Ndimande (29) bebevela okwesibili eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini. ABASOLWA ngokubulala umculi u-AKA, ngokulandelana kwabo kusuka kwesobunxele uMnuz Lindani Thabani Mkhwanazi, Lindani Zenzele Ndimande, Siyanda Eddie Myeza, Mziwethemba Harvey Gwabini noLindokuhle Lindo NdimandeIsithombe: SIBONELO NGCOBO/INDEPENDENT MEDIABangene belandelana bebhekise amakhanda phansi, bebukeka bengakhathazekile kangako ebusweni.UMshushisi woMbuso odume ngokungawabheki amacala athinta izinkabi, u-Adv Elvis Gcweka, uthe phezu kwamacala ayishumi abasolwa ababhekene nawo uMbuso wengeze amabili okushintshisana ngemali ngokungemthetho.Ngokwamaphepha asenkantolo kuvela ukuthi uGwabini ongummangalelwa wesine kuleli cala wafakelwa imali engu-R803 455 ngokungemthetho ngoFebhuwari 11, okungusuku olwandulela okwabulawa ngalo ababili.Kuvela ukuthi le mali yayiyinkokhelo yokubulawa kwabo.Amaphepha aqhuba athi laba abanye abamangalelwa, okungoMkhwanazi, Ndimande (Lindani), Myeza noNdimande (Lindokuhle) elabo icala lokushintshisana ngemali libandakanya ukuthi bathola isamba semali eyayivela kuGwabini umuntu ngamunye.Lokhu kusho ukuthi asengu-12 amacala ababhekene nawo, kuwona kubalwa elokwakha itulo lokubulala, amabili okubulala, elokutholakala nesibhamu esingekho emthethweni, elokutholakala nezinhlamvu bese kuba ayisihlanu okuzama ukubulala.Okuphinde kwahlaluka enkantolo ukuthi abamangalelwa abane bashintshe abameli babo.Ummangalelwa wokuqala (uMkhwanazi) nommangalelwa wesihlanu (uLindokuhle Ndimande) sebemelwe u-Adv Simphiwe Mlotshwa. Ummangalelwa wesibili (uLindani Ndimande) nommangalelwa wesine (uGwabini) sebemelwe u-Adv Cele igama lakhe elingatholakalanga.Ummangalelwa wesithathu (uMyeza) yena usamelwe uYolanda Gielink obevele emumele phambilini.Ekhuluma nabezindaba uGielink uthe akukho okuhlanganisa uMyeza naleli cala."Wayeneminyaka engu-20 ngaleso sikhathi. Uyise owayengusomatekisi, washona. Asazi ukuthi yini eyenze bamhlanganisa naleli cala ngoba uthola imali enele emabhizinisini akubo (amatekisi) ukuthi ubengathatha uR200 000 ayobulala umuntu ebeka engcupheni impilo yakhe,” kusho uGielink.Uphinde waveza ukuthi wuye omele abasolwa ababili okungoMnuz Siyabonga Gezani Ndimande noMalusi Dave Ndimande abasabhajwe eSwatini nabo okuthiwa bayathinteka kuleli cala.Izelamani zakwaNdimande ziboshelwe ukuba kuleliyazwe ngaphandle kwamaphepha abagunyaza ukuba kulo. Kuthiwa bafudukela khona beyobhaca emva kokubandakayeka ecaleni lokubulawa kuka-AKA noTibz."Angikawatholi amaphepha okwamanje, ngisawacelile kodwa ngiyakuphikisa ukubuyiselwa kwabo kuleli. Nginezizathu zalokho. Ngeke ngikwazi ukuqhubeka ngiphawule kakhulu ngalokho njengoba besangale. Uma seluphothuliwe uhlelo lokubuyiswa kwabo yilapho engingakwazi khona ukuthi ngiphawule kangcono sengithathe imiyalelo kubo,” kusho uGielink.IMantshi, uMnuz Vincent Hlatshwayo, ithe kuzoqalwa ngoLwesine oluzayo ukulalelwa kwesicelo sebheyili.
IBHEKENE nembedumehlwana imindeni emibili yaseThandanani, eTrenance Park, eVerulam, kulandela ukubekwa kwabantu emhlabeni wayo okukhona kuwo namathuna.Ngokusho kwayo, laba bantu asebakhe kule ndawo, babekwa yikomiti le-ANC elihlala ezindlini zemixhaso eziseduze kwale ndawo. Imindeni ethintekayo owakwaCebekhulu nowakwaNdlela.UMnuz Nkosinathi Cebekhulu ekhuluma neSolezwe, uthe ukubekwa kwabantu kuqale ngo-2022 kodwa kube mandla ngoDisemba nyakenye."Izindlu ezakhiwe phezu kwamathuna asekhaya zilinganiselwa ku-30, angizibali ezinye eziyinqwaba ezakhiwe emhlabeni ongenamathuna,” kusho uCebekhulu.Uthe uke waxoxa nabantu asebakhe emathuneni akubo, bamtshela ukuthi ikomiti belibakhokhisa uR800, ikesi likabhiya, ibhodlela nenyama yokosa.Uthe le nto ibaphatha kabi kangangokuthi balubikile udaba ezinhlakene ezehlukene okukhona kuzo namaphoyisa."Sekunesikhathi sibikile kodwa asiwuboni umnyakazo,” kusho uCebekhulu.Uveze ukuthi bake bazama ukubiza umhlangano nalaba asebehleli emhlabeni wabo, ikomiti athi libabekile nemindeni yomibili ethintekayo, kodwa wabhuntsha umhlangano njengoba bengafikanga abakhe emhlabeni wabo."Sigcine sithola ukuthi ikomiti libatshele ukuthi abangezi, lizobamela bona. Sawuduba ke umhlangano ngoba besifuna bageqe amagula phambi kwawo wonke umuntu ukuthi kwenzeke kanjani ukuthi bakhe phezu kwamathuna ethu,” kusho uCebekhulu.Uqhube wathi afuna ukukubona kwenzeka ukuthi ajeze amalungu aleli komiti ngesenzo sawo."Sifuna ukuthi laba abahleli emathuneni asekhaya basuke. Singabantu abamnyama, le nto eyenzekayo ukuthi abantu bakhe emathuneni asekhaya iphambene nesiko nenkolo yethu,” kusho uCebekhulu.Osohlangothini lomndeni wakwaNdlela, uMnuz Zakhele Ndlela, uthe bake bazama kaningi ukuxoxa nabantu abakhe emhlabeni wabo ukuthi bapheze ukwenza lokhu."Abanye babeqonda isikhalo sethu bayeke, kodwa abanye baqhubeke,” kusho uNdlela.Naye uthe abahambisani nokwenziwa ikomiti."Ikomiti lenza imali ngomhlaba wethu. Njengoba bakhe baze bafika nasemathuneni, sifuna basuke,” kukhala uNdlela.Kuthintwa uMnuz Msawenkosi Zuma osekomitini, uthe akukho angasiza ngakho intatheli."Asikwazi thina lokho ukuthi badlelwe umhlaba. Ngisekomitini lomphakathi kodwa umsebenzi wethu ukuhambisa izidingo kubantu, hhayi okunye. Abantu abadla umhlaba bakwenza lokho ngendlela yabo,” kusho uZuma.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant Colonel Nqobile Gwala, uthe amaphoyisa aseVerulam aphenya icala lokungena emhlabeni ngokungemthetho nokuthikanyezwa kwempahla."Ofake isikhalazo uthe iqeqebana labantu badle umhlaba, bakha izindlu ngaphandle kwemvume. Uthe bacekele phansi amatshe amathuna. Udaba lusaphenywa,” kusho uLt Col Gwala.
UMENGAMELI wezimantshi KwaZulu-Natal, omisiwe emsebenzini, usolwa ngokuthumela uzakwabo owayeyimantshi isithombe somphambili wakhe, inkinga engalawuleki yokugembula eCasino, ukugwazisa ngemali nangesinene kwababegaqele izikhundla zokuba izimantshi.UMnuz Sibusiso Eric Nzimande usolwa nangokushaya ucingo izikhawu ezingu-16 eshayela owayengumsolwa ecaleni elithinta ukuqashwa kwebhilidi okwakusolakala ukuthi kudayiswa kulona izingane.Lobu obunye bobufakazi obethulwe iphoyisa elingumphenyi uColonel Jason McGray eThekwini.UMcGray uveze nokuthi yayiza ngohologo iyindimbane imali eyayithunyelwa kuxhaxha lwama-akhawunti kaNzimande.Le mali uthe kwathi uma ephenya, enye kwavela ukuthi iqhamuka ebantwini iningi labo elafika lisanda kuqokwa ezikhundleni zokuba izimantshi okwesikhashana.UMcGray ubekade egeqa amagula esigcawini esiqondisa ubugwegwe uNzimande obhekene namacala angu-162.Leli phoyisa belikade leluswa ngemibuzo ugalagala lommeli omele iKhomishini yeziMantshi, eshushisa uNzimande, u-Advocate Sipokazi Poswa-LerotholiUMcGray uthe wayazi ukuthi uphenya mayelana nezinsolo zenkohlakalo ethinta izimantshi nabameli ngakho kwakungamele axhamazele enze amaphutha ophenyweni lwakhe."Ummangali uNkk Gumede (Lindelwa, owayeyimantshi ebambile) encwadini ayenza efungelwe wathi kukhona lapho athunyelelwa khona umqhafazo uNzimande. Umqhafazo kwakuyisithombe esasiveza isitho sikaNzimande sangasese. Akanginikanga leso sithombe kunalokho wathi ucingo lwakhe lwafa, kwalahleka izinto eziningi ezazikulona,” kusho uMcGray.UNkk Gumede waqokelwa esikhundleni sokuba imantshi okwesikhashana ngo-2011.UMcGray uthe encwadini efungelwe kaNkk Gumede, wayephoqwa uNzimande ukuthi amkhokhele emsabisa ngokuthi uma engakhokhi noma engalali naye uzomxoshisa emsebenzini awutholelwa uyena.UMcGray uthe uNkk Gumede wagcina esekhokhele uNzimande uR140 000 eminyakeni emibili."Lo mmangali waveza nezinsolo zokuthi uNzimande wamtshela ukuthi baningi asebenza nabo ayesezimbandakanye nabo ngokocansi. UNkk Gumede waveza nokuthi uNzimande unenkinga yemali ngenxa yokugembula kwakhe,”Umphenyi uthe imali yayithunyelwa kuNzimande ifakwa kuma-akhawunti akhe amaningi asemabhange ehlukene.Uthe wenza jphenyo olunzulu olubandakanya izingcingo eziqoshiwe, izitatimende zasemabhange nemininingwane yamaCasino akhona kuleli efuna ukuthola kabanzi ngoNzimande.Ikhomishini isola uNzimande ngokugembula ngesikhathi somsebenzi.Isigcawu siyaqhubeka namuhla.
KUZOSHAYEKA abahlala emijondolo nabalimi abasafufusa kuncishiswa imali eyabelwe uhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal.UMgcinimafa kazwelonke unciphise imali yokuthuthukiswa kwemijondolo, neyokuthuthukisa abalimi abasafufusa eyabelwa iKwaZulu-Natal njengoba siqhubeka nokuba sibi isimo sezezimali kuhulumeni.Izindaba zokuncishiswa kwemali eyabelwe uhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal zidalulwe uMphathiswa wezeziMali, uNkk Peggy Nkonyeni, ngesikhathi ethula isabelosemali, izolo, esiShayamthetho.Imali ebekelwe ukuthuthukisa imijondolo, i-Informal Settlements Upgrading Partnership Grant, incishiswe ngo-R228.6 million kunyaka wezimali ozayo.UNkk Nkonyeni uthe uMgcinimafa kazwelonke unqume ukunciphisa le mali ukuze kuzogcwaliselwa emalini eyabelwe ukunyusela abasebenzi bakahulumeni imiholo.Inhloso yemali encishisiwe ukuhlinzeka abahlala emijondolo ngamanzi, ugesi, ukuthuthwa kwendle, nemigwaqo.UNkk Nkonyeni uthe enye imali ebekelwe ukuthuthukisa ezokuhlaliswa kwabantu, iHuman Settlements Development Grant, nayo incishiswe ngo-R268.7 million.Nayo le mali ethathwe kwisabelomali izogcwalisela emalini eyabelwe ukunyusela abasebenzi bakahulumeni imiholo.Imali eyabelwe ukulekelela abalimi abamnyama abasafufusa, Ilima/Letsema Projects Grant, inciphiswe ngo-R24 million."UMgcinimafa kazwelonke uthathe le mali wayoyifaka ohlelweni lukamengameli lokudala amathuba emisebenzi."UNkk Nkonyeni uthe isiyonke imali okuncishiswe ngayo isabelomali sesifundazwe kulo nyaka wezimali ozayo ingu-R4 billion.Izoqhubeka nokuncishiswa ngemali engaphezu kukaR4 billion kwiminyaka emithathu yezimali ezayo.UNkk Nkonyeni uthe akuzange kube lula ukunciphisa isabelomali."Uma sibuka ukuthi kufanele kwenziwe kanjani ukunciphisa isabelomali kulo nyaka bekufanele sijule, ngoba sesibe neminyaka eminingi yokuncishiswa kwaso, ngakho ke akukho lula ukukwenza kulo nyaka wezimali. Isabelomali sesifundazwe asikho esimweni esihle. Kodwa ke akukho ebesingakwenza, yingakho kumele sikwenze kuze kuba isimo somnotho siyashintsha."UNkk Nkonyeni uthe iminyango kahulumeni yezifundazwe kufanele izibambe ziqine njengoba umnotho ukhula kancane.Uthe babheke ukuthi umnotho waKwaZulu-Natal ukhule kangcono uma sekuxazululwe inkinga yokushoda kukagesi.UMnyango wezeMfundo nowezeMpilo iyona ethola isabelo esibhekile.Isabelosemali sesifundazwe singu-R150 billion.UMnyango wezeMfundo uthole uR62 billion, owezeMpilo wathola uR53 billion, kwathi owezokuThutha wona wathola uR13 billion.UMnyango wezokuThuthukiswa koMnotho uthole uR3.4 billion, owezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi nawo wathola uR3.4 billion, kwathi owezokuHlaliswa kwaBantu wathola uR3.5 billion.UMnyango wezoLimo uthole uR2,6 billion, owezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu uthole uR1.7 billion, owezeMisebenzi yoMphakathi wathola uR1.8 billion, kwathi owezeMidlalo wona wathola uR1.5 billion.IHhovisi likaNdunankulu lithole uR784 million, elikaSomlomo lithole uR782 million, elikaMgcinimafa lathola uR680 million, kwathi uMnyango wezokuPhepha koMphakathi wona wathola uR243 million.
BANIKWE izinsuku eziyishumi abasebenzi bakaMasipala weTheku abebesesitelekeni esingekho emthethweni ukuthi babeke izizathu eziqinile zokuthi kungani kufanele bangaxoshwa.Lokhu kuvezwe uNkk Gugu Sisilana esitatimendeni asithumelele abezindaba izolo.Ngokusho kwakhe, bangu-79 abasebenzi abanikwe izincwadi kanti basebenzela izinhlaka ezehlukene. Bazibandakanye esitelekeni esaqala ngoFebhuwari 27.Abasebenzi abebetelekile bafuna ukuthi umasipala ubaholele amaholo alingana nawalabo abasebenza imisebenzi efana neyabo abasebenza komasipala abasezingeni elilingana nowabo, benza isibonelo ngowaseKurhuleni."Mayelana namaholo asesigabeni seshumi, kufanele kuqondwe ukuthi udaba lwamaholo ezisebenzi zikaMasipala weTheku lusadingidwa ezingeni likazwelonke,” kusho uNkk Sisilana.Uqhube wathi selokhu siqalile isiteleka kube khona ukusatshiswa kwabasebenzi okuholele ekutheni kuphazamiseke ukuhanjiswa kwezidingo ebantwini.Phakathi kwazo ubale amanzi, ukuqoqwa kukadoti kanjalo nokulungiswa kukagesi.Uthe ezigamekweni ezehlukene bekuba khona ukucekelwa phansi kwengqalasizinda yokuhanjiswa kwalezi zidingo."Ngokusebenzisana nezinhlaka zamaphoyisa nabezokuphepha, umasipala uyaqhubeka nokuqinisekisa ukuthi isimo siyabuyiselwa kwesejwayelekile. Lokhu sikwenza nangokuthi uma kudingeka ukuthi kuyolungiswa endaweni ethile, kucelwe amaphoyisa ukuthi aphelezele abayokwenza lowo msebenzi. Sibala ukuhlanzwa kwemigwaqo, ukulungiswa kukagesi, amapayipi amanzi anqanyuliwe nokuqoqwa kukadoti,” kwenaba uNkk Sisilana.Uthe banxusa izakhamuzi ukuthi zingaqale ziwukhiphe udoti ziwubeke ngaphandle kuze kube ukuthi umasipala ukhipha isimemezelo sokuthi ziwukhiphe."Siyaxolisa nakosomabhizinisi nakumalungu omphakathi akhahlanyezwe isiteleka, sicela ukuthi sibekezelelwe ngesikhathi silungisa umonakalo,” kusho yena.Usomabhizinisi wesifazane wakwaF KwaMashu, uNksz Thobile Dlamini, uthe lesi siteleka sishaye kwezwela ebhizinisini lakhe lokubhaka nokupheka."Emizamweni yokwenza imadlana, ngiye ngithenge isitokwe kakhulu. Ukuhamba kukagesi, kushaye kwazwela kimina ngesitokwe engisigcina efrijini ngoba sonakale sonke, ngagcina ngingasasithengi esiningi ngenxa yokuhamba kukagesi okuqhubekayo,” kusho uNksz Dlamini.Uthe lokhu kuholele ekutheni bagcine bengasawathathi ama-oda ansuku zonke, nokubalahlekisele ngemali.
UDEDELWE ngebheyili ka-R 5000 uNobhala we-ANC eThekwini, uMnuz Musa Nciki nomqaphi wakhe uMnuz Ivan Khoza, ababoshelwe izinsolo zokungahloniphi imithetho yomgwaqo. UNciki noKhoza bavele eNkantolo yeMantshi eThekwini, bathola ibheyili, icala lase lihlehlela u-Ephreli 10, ukuze kuqhubeke uphenyo.Okhulumela abezokushushisa (NPA) KwaZulu-Natal , uNkk Natasha Ramkisson-Kara, uthe abasolwa babhekene necala lokushayela budedengu. Uthe abakwazanga ukumisa imoto irobhothi livalile futhi bebeshayela imoto engagunyaziwe.UNciki nomqaphi wakhe baboshwe ngoLwesithathu ebusuku, emgwaqweni uLighthouse, eMhlanga, eThekwini. Kuthiwa uNciki uzithethelele ngokuthi babone bexinwa yimoto ebingabonakali ukuthi eyamaphoyisa, bayexwaya.UNciki waziwa ngokuba yisithenjwa sikasihlalo we-ANC, eThekwini uNkk Zandile Gumede, futhi bakhethwa kanye kanye engqungutheleni ngo-2022. UNciki enkantolo ubonakale engaxwayile, efake isikibha esiluhlaza esifake ngaphakathi nejakhethi.UNciki ubonakale ebingelela abezindaba eseshona phansi emgodini, eyolinda kulungiswe udaba lwebheyili yakhe. UKhoza ubehamba phambili efake ishethi eliluhlaza naye engaxwayile kangako.UNobhala we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Bheki Mtolo esitatimendeni, uthe abakwazi ukuphawula, balinde umbiko ophelele. Bathe bayezwa abezindaba bebabuza ngokuboshwa komholi wesifunda."Okwamanje sibona sengathi ngeke kube yinto ephusile ukuphawula ngodaba olusasetshenzwa amaphoyisa. Sizokwazi ukuphawula uma sesithole umbiko ophelele ovela kubaholi besifunda,’’ kusho UMtolo.I-ANC inomgomo wokuthi abaholi abahamba amacala bashenxe ezikhundleni kuze kusombululwe amacala enkantolo. UMtolo akakuphathanga lokho, wathi bazobuye baphawule kahle.IMeya yaseMngeni, uMnuz Chris Pappas, engenele umbango wesikhundla sikandunankulu iphawulile ngalolu daba. UPappas uthe bayakwemukela ukuboshwa kukaNciki. Uthe i-ANC ikhuluma ngokubuyisa isithunzi sayo ilwe nenkohlakalo kodwa ibuye iziphikise.
IJAJI uRatha Makgoatlheng elihlalele icala lokubulawa kukaSenzo Meyiwa, lithimule lingabhemile ngobufakazi babamangalelwa, lathi buyadida futhi bulishiya nemibuzo. UMeyiwa owayeyisilomo se-Orlando Pirates neBafana Bafana, wadutshuwa wabulawa ekubo kwentombi yakhe uKelly Khumalo eVosloorus ngo-2014.Kuboshwe abalisa abahlanu okuthiwa yibona ababulala uMeyiwa bethengiwe. Abamangalelwa bayawaphika wonke amacala ababekwe wona, bathi amaphoyisa abaphoqa ukuvuma amacala. UMbuso umi ngezitatimende othi abasolwa bazibhala bazisayina bevuma amacala.Phambilini, bekuhlala kuvela ukushayisana phakathi kwabamangalelwa nabameli babo uma kwethulwa ubufakazi. Uma bebuzwa abamangalelwa bethi, abazi akubuzwe abameli bazoziphendulela. Abameli babamangalewa bafaka isicelo sokuthi zichithwe izitatimende ngoba amaphoyisa awenzanga kahle ngesikhathi zisayinwa. Ijaji nakuba lingakasikhiphi isinqumo ngalolu daba kodwa belilokhu liphawula, kuzwakala ukuthi liyakuthimula okuningi okushiwo abamangalelwa.Umshushisi u-Advocate George Baloyi ubetasa nezethulo zoMbuso ngesikhathi ijaji lilokhu liphawula. Ijaji lithe kunezinto eziningi ezishiya imibuzo uma licubungula ubufakazi babamangalewa."Ummangalewa wesibili uthi wayevuvukele ezihlakaleni esikwe wozankosi. Uthi washawa wopha emlonyeni. Waya yini esibhedlela ngenxa yalokhu? Wawabikela yini amaphoyisa ngoba phela uthi isikibha sasinamabala egazi?” kubuza ijaji.Ijaji lithe okunye okuxakayo wukuthi kunobufakazi bokuthi omunye wabamangalelwa washawa amaphoyisa egaraji eliphithizela abantu kwangaba ndaba zalutho."Igaraji liseduze komgwaqo futhi kunendawo edayisa okudliwayo ephithizelayo, kunezindawo zokuhlala nendawo yokwetha uphethroli negesi nabantu bayaphithiza. Amaphoyisa ayizilima, avele ashaya umuntu endaweni enjalo?” kubuza ijaji ebelibuye lizwakale ligquma samuntu oxakekile.Liphinde lathi kunendawana lapho ummangalelwa wesibili, uMnuz Bongani Ntanzi, ethi umphenyi uSergeant Vusimuzi Mogane, wayefika esiteshini angasebenzi kusona aphuce amaphoyisa umsebenzi alawule. Uthe konke lokhu akuvamile nje, kuyethusa uma kuthiwa kwenzeka ngoba kunendlela enemibandela enzima ngokusebenza esiteshini.Umshushisi uBaloyi ucele inkantolo ukuthi ikuchithe okushiwo abamangalelwa bese yamukela izitatimende zabo njengobufakazi okufanele bubhekwe. Kulindeleke ukuthi uBaloyi asonge namuhla ekuseni bese kuyaqhutshekwa.
KUNENHLANSI yethemba empini yokulwa nobugebengu kuleli njengoba kunezinhlelo zokulungiswa kwesikhungo okubikwa kusona ubugebengu kuleli, i-10111. Lokhu kuvezwe nguMqondisi jikelele ehhovisi likamengameli, uNksz Phindile Baleni, neNhloko yoKlebe, uLieutenant General Godfrey Lebeya, abathe maduzane umphakathi uzokwazi ukusebenzisa le nombolo ukubika izehlakalo zobugebengu. ULebeya uthe lokhu bakwenza ngokuhlanganyela nosomabhizinisi bakuleli."Sifuna ukusishintsha lesi sikhungo ukuze umphakathi ukwazi ukuqhubeka ubike amacala obugebengu. Lezi ngezinye zezinhlelo zokuqinisa ukulwa nobugebengu kuleli.”Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi lesi sikhungo sibhekene nezinkinga njengoba kuke kuphele isikhathi singasebenzi, abantu bangakwazi ukubika amacala.UNksz Baleni utshele abezindaba ukuthi mkhulu umsebenzi osuwenziwe ngaphansi kobudlelwano abanabo nalabo somabhizinisi emkhakheni ehlukene okubalwa nokulwa nobugebengu kuleli.Uthe kuhle ukuthi labo somabhizinisi bafaka isandla empini yokulwa nobugebengu kuleli."Indaba yesikhungo i-10111 ngenye yezinto ezolungiswa ukuze kuqiniswe impi yokulwa nobugebengu. Uma sekulungiswe yonke into sizovivinya indaba yalesi sikhungo ekomkhulu laso eMidrand.” Uthe kunezinye izinhlelo zokuthi kusungulwe iForensic Laboratory ukusheshisa izinto ezithinta uphenyo. "Ukuphasiwa komthethosivivinywa, iNPA Amendment Bill, kuzoqinisa kuphinde kwenze uphiko lwezokushushisa luzimele. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi ziqhubeke izinhlelo zokulwa nenkohlakalo kuleli,” kusho uLebeya. UNksz Baleni uthe ngaphansi kwalokhu kusebenzisana nosomabhizinisi sekwehlise ukucishwa kukagesi kuleli."Kwehlile ukucishwa kukagesi ngo-61% uma kuqhathaniswa nesikhathi esifanayo ngonyaka odlule. Lokhu kwenziwe wukuthi kubuye ukusebenza kwesikhungo sikagesi, iKusile, kanjalo nezinhlelo ezikhona zokuthi kufakwe ama-solar ophahleni lwezindlu.” Uthe ziyaqhubeka izinhlelo zokuqeda le nkinga njengoba sekunebhodi eliqokiwe enkampanini, iNational Transmission Company of South Africa (NTCSA). Maduzane kunezinhlelo zokuthi le nkampani iqale ukusebenza." Uveze ukuthi izinhlelo zalo nyaka wukuthi kunyuswe ugesi okhona kuleli ufinylele ku-11.5 GW. Ubalule nokuthi izinkinga ezibhekene nokuthuthwa kwempahla kuleli ziyalungiswa."Uhulumeni nosomabhizinisi bayazilungisa ezithinta nokuphuculwa kwezithinta ukuthuthwa kwempahla kusetshenziswa amaguzu. Sikhuluma nje sesehlile nesibalo semikhumbi ebibhajwe echwebeni laseThekwini. Amaphoyisa amatasa nezinhlelo zokuqapha ingqalasizinda.”
UNGQONGQOSHE weMfundo eyisiSekelo uNkk Angie Motshekga, uthe ingcabha ikubazali nasezigungwini ezilawula izikole ngodaba lwenyufomu egqokwa ezikoleni.Uthe abazali nezigungu kumele banqume ukuthi yiluphi uhlobo lwenyufomu okumele lugqokwe nokuthi lugqokwa kangaki, wathi umnyango ungabeka imigomo kodwa ngeke uzinqumele izikole nabazali ukuthi kumele benzenjani.Ukusho lokhu kulandela ukwethulwa kombiko wekhomishini yamalungelo abantu, owethulwe ekomitini lezemfundo ePhalamende, oveze ukuthi ezinye izikole ziba namanyufomu ahlukene.Umbiko uveze ukuthi kwezinye izikole abafundi abenza u-matric bagqoka inyufomu ehlukile, okufaka ingcindezi kubazali okudingeka bathenge enye inyufomu kuleli banga ekubeni abafundi bezoyigqoka izinyanga ezimbalwa."Okungijabulisayo ngukuthi ikhomishini ayisho ukuthi akuyekwe ukugqokwa kwenyufomu ezikoleni. Kubalulekile ukuthi igqokwe ukuze kube lula ukuhlonza abafundi,” kusho uNkk Motshekga.Uthe okunye okumele kubhungwe eyabafundi abagqebhezayo uma begqoke inyufomu."Abanye balaba bafundi bagqoka amanyufomu amancane adlulwa ngisho ama-jakhethi abawagqokayo. Abakwazi ngisho ukugoba ngoba kuzovela iphenti, okungenye yezinto okumele kubhungwe ngazo.” Uthe kumanje kunezikhalazo azilungisayo ezithinta abafundi benkolo yama-muslim, abagqoka izikhafu."Yinto engiyilungisayo njengongqongqoshe. Ziningi izikhalazo ezikhona ezithinta inyufomu esibhekana nazo singumnyango,” kusho uNkk Motshekga.Odabeni lwezinwele zabafundi kukhalwe ngokuthi zingaphazamisa uma zizinde kakhulu ngesikhathi kufundwa.Ikhomishini iphakamise ukuthi kudingeka kubekwe isikalo semali senyufomu ngoba kwezinye izikhawu ibiza kakhulu okushaya abazali ephaketheni.Amalungu ePhalamende athe akumele kuyekwe ukugqokwa kwenyufomu ezikoleni.USihlalo wekomiti ePhalamende uNkk Bongiwe Mbinqo-Gigaba, uthe ukugqokwa kwenyufomu kusiza ekutheni abafundi babe yinto eyodwa.Uthe elakuleli libhekene nenkinga yokungalingani ngakho ukugqokwa kwenyufomu kwenza kube nokulingana."Udaba lokubiza kwenyufomu kumele lubhekane nekhomishini yezokuncintisana. Umnyango kumele uyibheke eyokuthi kwezinye izikole kunenyufomu egqokwa ehlobo, enye igqokwa ebusika bese kuba naleyo egqokwa ngu-matric wodwa.” UMqondisi jikelele emnyangweni uMnuz Mathanzima Mweli, uthe sebeke bahlangana nekhomishini yezokuncintisana wathi indaba yokubiza kwamanyufomu yinto eseke yaphenywa kwakhishwa umbiko ngokuthi kukhona ukusebenzisana kwezinkampani ezikhiqiza amanyufomu nemali eziyibizayo.
ZIYAQONGA izinkinga zobuholi kwiNFP, abaholi abakhethwe engqungqutheleni yangonyaka owedlule, sebephenduke inkukhu nempaka.UNobhala Jikelele, uMnuz Teddy Thwala, ufuna inhlangano eyengamele ukhetho, i-Independent Electoral Commission (IEC), ingabemukeli ubuholi akhethwa nabo engqungqutheleni eyayiseThekwini.UThwala ufake isicelo esiphuthumayo eNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu, lapho khona ekhala ngokuthi akuzange kulandelwe imigomo ngesikhathi bekhethwa.UThwala ufuna isicelo sakhe silalelwe ngoLwesihlanu, okuwumnqamulajuqu obekwe i-IEC wokuba wonke amaqembu ezepolitiki alethe amagama abantu abazowamela.Phezu kwecala elifakwe uThwala, kuphinde kube khona elifakwe usihlalo weNFP kwisifunda iTheku, uMnuz Sikhumbuzo Zulu, eNkantolo yezoKhetho.UZulu naye ufuna ukuthi kuchithwe isinqumo se-IEC sokuvuma ubuholi obusha.I-IEC isanda kuveza ukuthi izokwamukela ubuholi obakhethwa ngoDisemba, nokubuyise ithemba lokuthi iNFP izokwazi ukungenela ukhetho lwangoMeyi.Emaphepheni asenkantolo, uThwala uveze ukuthi kunecala eliphonsela inselelo imiphumela yengqungquthela eyabakhetha."Icala lizolalelwa ngo-Ephreli 30. Mina nabanye esakhethwa siyakwamukela ukuthi akuzange kulandelwe imigomo ngesikhathi kuqhubeka ingqungquthela."UThwala uthe kunganyomfeka izinhlelo zeNFP zokhetho uma i-IEC ingaqhubeka nokwamukela ubuholi obusha."Lokho kungasho ukuthi uhlu lwabazomela iNFP luzokube lugcwele abantu abakhethwe engqungqutheleni engekho emthethweni. Sebeqalile balungiselela ukuhambisa uhlu lwamagama. Kungaba nzima ukulungisa lo monakalo uma inkantolo isinqumo ukuchitha ubuholi obakhethwa ngonyaka owedlule."UThwala uthe bafuna ukuthi i-IEC yamukele ubuholi besikhashana obebuhola iNFP ngaphambi kwengqungquthela yangonyaka owedlule.UZulu yena ufuna ukuthi i-IEC yamukele ubuholi obakhethwa engqungqutheleni yango-2019.Labu buholi bahlakazwa emva kwesinqumo seNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu esathi yayingekho emthethweni ingqungquthela obakhethwa kuyo.UZulu uthe ubuholi obakhethwa ngo-2019, kufanele budedelwe buqhubeke nokuhola iNFP ngoba busidlulisele phambili isinqumo sokuhlakazwa kwabo.Uthe i-IEC akufanele yamukele ubuholi obakhethwa ngonyaka owedlule ngoba kusenecala elisenkantolo."Isinqumo se-IEC sizokwandisa izinkinga kwiNFP, nokuzokwenza ukuthi kube nzima ukubuyisana kwiNFP."UZulu ufuna iNkantolo yezoKhetho ilalele isicelo sakhe ngokushesha. UMengameli weNFP, uMnuz Ivan Barnes, uthe angakwazi ukuphawula ngalolu daba emva komhlangano wesigungu esiphezulu seNFP obuyizolo, ntambama.Lo mhlangano ububizelwe ukuzobhunga ngala macala.
BAZOZIFAKA ngesonto elizayo izicelo zebheyili abasebenzi abawu-13 bakaMasipala waseThekwini, ababoshelwe ukuvala umgwaqo eSydneham, abebevele enkantolo yeMantshi eThekwini.Laba basebenzi bekulindeleke ukuthi izolo bafake isicelo sebheyili kodwa umshushisi, uMnuz Calvin Govender, wathi uMbuso uzokuhlehlisa ukulalelwa kwesicelo salaba basebenzi abangaphansi kwenyunyana, iSouth African Municipal Workers’ Union (Samwu), ngoba usafuna ukuthola olunye ulwazi ngababoshiwe. INKANTOLO yeMantshi eThekwini ikuhlehlisele isonto elizayo ukulalelwa kwesicelo sebheyili sabasebezi bamasipala abangaphansi kwenyunyana yabasebenzi iSamwu abebevele enkantolo ngamacala okususa udlame emphakathini ISITHOMBE: SIBONELO NGCOBO: INDEPENDENT MEDIA Ummeli wabo, ephendula umshushisi, uthe akhona amakheli abo bonke abasolwa kodwa umshushisi wathi amakheli wodwa awenele, basadinga olunye ulwazi oluchaza ukuthi basebenza kuwo yini umasipala bonke, uma kunjalo kumuphi umnyango noma abanye abangamalungu omphakathi."Ngesikhathi beboshwa abasolwa kwaba nesiphithiphithi ngoba babebaningi abantu kuleyo ndawo. Kusadingeka ukuthi sithole ulwazi oluphelele ngabo ngaphambi kokuthi bafake isicelo sebheyili," kusho umshushisi.Imantshi ibe isikuhlehlisela uLwesithathu oluzayo ukulalelwa kwesicelo sebheyili.UGovender uthe umsolwa ngamunye ubekwe amacala amabili elokudala udlame emphakathini nelokulimaza impahla esemqoka okubalwa nengqalasizinda.Izihlobo nabeseka ababoshiwe abebegcwele enkantolo badumele ngalesi sinqumo. Bebengafuni ukukhuluma nezintatheli. Ngaphambi kokuthi kuqale icala, abasolwa batshele ummeli wabo ukuthi bafuna ukuthi izintatheli zingavunyelwa ukuthi zibashuthe, uma zivunyelwe zingabavesi ubuso.Umshushisi uthe: "Inkantolo iyisikhungo somphakathi esivulelekile, ngaphezu kwalokho, ama-video nezithombe zabasolwa zigcwele ezinkundleni zezokuxhumana."USihlalo weSamwu eThekwini, uMnuz Siyabonga Dladla, ethintwa ngalokhu, uthe ufike ngemuva kwesikhathi, ubengekho enkantolo, ngakho ngeke aphawule.IMeya yeTheku, uMnuz Mxolisi Kaunda esitatimendeni esithunyelelwe abezindaba, ithe ngeke balukhulume udaba lokungalingani kweholo iSamwu ekhala ngalo ngoba lolo daba olusingethwe ezingeni likazwelonke, umhlangano wakhona ungesonto elizayo."Abasebenzi beSamwu bathi abekho esitelekeni kodwa imiphakathi eminingi ivalelwe amanzi nogesi, kwezinye izindawo udoti awulandiwe okufaka ingcindezi emphakathini ozikhokhelayo lezi zidingo. Abasebenzi abatholakala bephule umthetho bazobhekana nokuqondiswa kobugwegwe," kusho uKaunda.UMnuz Roshan Lil-Ruthan wenhlangano yomphakathi iVerulam Rate Payers Association, uthe lesi siteleka siholele ekutheni izakhamizi ezibalelwa ku-150 000 zaseVerulam zingabi nawo amanzi."Abantu abashayeke kakhulu abantu abahluphekayo abahlala ezindaweni eziyimijondolo, abangenazo izimoto zokuhamba bayofuna amanzi ezindaweni ezinawo noma imali yokuwathenga. Amaloli amanzi umasipala uke wawathumela kodwa ajika ngoba esatshiswa ngabasebenzi abatelekile," kusho uLil -Ruthan.
USHALAZELE isicelo sebheyili osolwa ngokubulala ngesihluku indodakazi yakamakhelwane, isidumbu sayo esitholwe sisongwe ngengubo yokulala emotweni kayise okuthiwa wayeyiphuthumisa esibhedlela, esigamakweni esenzeke eManzimtoti, ngesonto eledlule.INkantolo yeMantshi yaseMbumbulu inqume ukulihlehlisela u- Ephreli 4, kulo nyaka, icala elibhekene noMnuz Mzo Mkhize (33) osolwa ngokubulawa kukaThobeka Radebe (19). Kuthiwa uboshwe ngoMgqibelo, ebhace eClairwood, kanti unyamalale emva kokubhadanywa nguyise kamgilwa egwaza indodakazi yakhe okuthiwa yayisele yodwa kubo, abazali besemsebenzini, izingane ezincane zakwabo zisesikoleni.UMnuz Aggripa Radebe uyise kamgilwa ekhuluma neSolezwe emva kokuhlehliswa kwecala, uthe ukunqaba kwakhe ukuphuma ngebheyili mhlawumbe kumsizile njengoba bebaningi abasamdinelwe ngalesi senzo."Bekuzoba nzima ukumbona njengoba kuwumuntu ohlala emzini osondelene nasekhaya. Engingakusho ukuthi uzisize yena ngokungayiceli ibheyili, ngoba angazi besizombhekelwa ubani,” kusho uRadebe.Uqinisekise ukuthi uThobeka ufihlwe ngoMgqibelo. URadebe ofundisa esikoleni Isipingo Beach, ngosuku lwesigameko, uthe wajika esesemsebenzini ngesikhathi ezizwa eshiywa yigazi, watshela uthishomkhulu ukuthi akazizwa kahle. Uveze ukuthi ngesikhathi eqhamukela ekhaya, wabona kuvulwe isicabha segaraji okuyilapho kwaphuma khona umsolwa waqhasha okuthiwa udume endaweni ngokuhlalisa umphakathi lubhojozi. Isidumbu sikaThobeka sitholwe ngamaphoyisa emotweni kaRadebe eyayimi emgwaqweni uKingsway iphantshelwe amasondo. URadebe nayehamba naye bahlonywa ngemibuzo, babuye badedelwa emva kokuchaza ukuthi unguyise wengane, ubeyiphuthumisa esibhedlela. Wabika ukuthi amasondo emoto yakhe agwazwa wumsolwa ngesikhathi yena esematasa ezama ukuhlenga impilo yendodakazi yakhe.
LUGOBILE uphondo kuhulumeni waKwaZulu- Natal wagcina uwuhlehlisa umcimbi wokukhumbula iSilo uDinuzulu kaCetshwayo obekufanele ube ngeSonto kwaCeza, oLundi. Uhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal ubuhlele ukugubha iminyaka ewu-110 kwakhothama uMamonga woSuthu.UMgwazi kadinwa zingqapheli, wahlala esihlaweni sikayise ngo-1884 wakhothama ngo-1913 eneminyaka engu-45. Uhulumeni waKwaZulu- Natal ubumemezele ukuthi umcimbi uzoba ngoMashi 10.Bekulindeleke ukuthi umcimbi uthanyelwe yiSilo uMisuzulu kaZwelithini okuyisona esibusayo manje. Izolo Isolezwe lithole isitatimende sikaNdunankulu kaZulu uMfundisi uThulasizwe Buthelezi ethi iSilo sizobe singekho lapho.UMfundisi uButhelezi uthe isizathu wukuthi kukhona izinto ezingaxoxwanga kahle neSilo ngalo mcimbi." Ngenxa yemibuzo eminingi yabezindaba , iSilo sithe angidlulise umyalezo wokuthi ngeke sibe khona emcimbini wokukhumbula iSilo uDinuzulu ozoba ngoMashi 10. Akekho umuntu ovela endlunkulu ozomela iSilo. ISilo siyawuthokozela umcimbi kodwa kufanele kuxoxwe naso ngendaba yesikhathi nendawo,’’ kusho uButhelezi.Emuva kwalokhu Isolezwe lithole ngezingede zalo ukuthi umcimbi uhlehlile. Isolezwe libone incwadi okuthiwa ibhalwe wuNdunankulu uNkk Nomusa Dube - Ncube ekhuleka kuBayede emazisa ngoshintsho.Incwadi iveza ukuthi usuku lomcimbi lushintshe emuva kokubonana naendlunkulu kaZulu ngalolu daba."Bayede! Le ncwadi yazisa iSilo ngoshintsho olukhona emuva komhlangano nendlunkulu ngoMashi 2 lapho bekuxoxwa khona ngomcimbi wokukhumbula iSilo uDinuzulu. Indlunkulu iphakamise ukuthi umcimbi ube ngoMashi 16,’’ kusho incwadi.Iyaqhubeka ibalule ukuthi indlunkulu ikhathazwa wukuthi uhulumeni awuyinakanga indaba yesikhumbuzo sokukhothama kweSilo uZwelithini kaBhekuzulu esebuza ngoMashi 12, 2021." Kuvele ukuthi indlunkulu ibivele ihlele umkhuleko wokukhumbula ukukhothama kweSilo ozoba ngeSonto ngoMashi 10. Kungakho sithi umcimbi weSilo uDinuzulu uzoba ngoMashi 16 kwaCeza esifundeni iZululand,’’ kusho incwadi.Okhulumela ihhovisi likaNdunankulu, uMnuz Bongi Gala, ebuzwa ngalokhu akaphikanga akavumanga kodwa uthe bazokhipha isitatimende ngalolu daba.

ZIKHISHWE ngendlakadla ezindlini zazo izitshudeni zaseThekwini TVET College, ophikweni uMbilo College ngoba kuthiwa asizikhokhelile isikhwama esixhasa izitshudeni, iNational Student Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS).Izitshudeni okuthiwa zibalelwa ku-120, zithi zilale emgwaqweni zaqhuqhwa amakhaza zanethwa yimvula.Ngesikhathi zikhuluma neSolezwe zibalise ngobunzima ezizithole zibhekene nabo. Izitshudeni ezikhulume neSolezwe ziveze ukuthi zithole umyalezo kumaselula azo obuzazisa ngokuthi maziphume ezindlini ngoba iNSFAS ayizikhokhelile.Isolezwe liwubonile umyalezo othunyelelwe izitshudeni uzazisa ngokuthi aziphume eflethini ngoba azikhokheliwe.UNomasonto Khawula (23) ofunda kuleli kolishi, uthe bayitholile imiyalezo kodwa bangaphuma.Uthe kodwa ngoLwesibili bagcine sebekhishwa ngendluzula ngabantu abangaziwa."Ibuhlungu kakhulu le nto esehlele. Silale emgwaqweni saqhuqhwa ngamakhaza. Okubuhlungu kakhulu ukuthi sigcine sesinethwa nayimvula,'' usho kanje.Lezi zitshudeni ziveze ukuthi bese zihlale inyanga kuleli flethi. USlindile Ngcamu (22) naye ofunda kulesi sikhungo ubalise ngobuhlungu abadlule kubona.Uthe abasazi manje ukuthi bazothathani bahlanganise nani ukuze kulungiswe indaba yokuthi iNSFAS ikhokhele izindlu abahlala kuzona."Uyabona isiqala ukuba yinkinga enkulu ngempela le nto. Nangonyaka odlule sazithola sibhekana nale nkinga,'' usho kanje.Abanye Isolezwe elikhulume nabo, omunye ohlala eMgababa omunye ohlala ePort Shepstone bathe sebevele babuyela emakhaya bazolinda kuze kulungiswe lesi simo. Umnikazi waflethi uzanywe kaningi ngocingo wathunyelelwa nomyalezo, engaphenduli, ucingo lwakhe lwagcina lungasangeni. Okhulumela inhlangano iSouth African Technical Vocational Education and Training Students Association, uBongani Mgwali, uthe bayazi ngenkinga yalesi sikhungo.Uthe emasontweni amathathu edlule bayile beyoxisana nezitshudeni nabaphathi besikhungo ngoba bese bezwile ukuthi kukhona inkinga yokuthi kungenzeka zikhishwe eflethini.Uthe bawabonile ama-video akhombisa izitshudeni zilele emnyango. "Sithole ukuthi iNSFAS engayifakile imali esikhungweni sizophinda sizame ukuthi sithole isixazululo kule nkinga,’’ usho kanje.Kwenzeka lokhu nje esithangamini nabezindaba ebesisePitoli ngoMsombuluko obambe njengosihlalo ebhodini lalesi sikhwama, uSolwazi Lourens Van Staden uqinisekise ukuthi bona abukho ubudlelwano abanabo nabezindawo zokuhlala izitshudeni.Uveze nokuthi izinsolo zenkohlakalo nokugwazisa phakathi kwabanikazi bezindawo zokuhlala nabanikezwe umsebenzi wokugunyaza izindawo ezisezingeni lokuhlala izitshudeni sezifinyelele kubona.Ugcizelele ukuthi esikhathini esizayo bahlela ukuthi kungabibikho isitshudeni esihlomulayo esikhwameni seNSFAS esizohlala endaweni engagunyaziwe yisona.Ngeledlule, amalungu ekomiti loMnyango weMfundo ePhakeme anxuse uMnyango weMfundo ePhakeme ukuthi uphenye njengoba kunomdonsiswano phakathi kwezikhungo, iNSFAS nezitshudeni osekwenze kwaqubuka neziteleka ezidalwa nawukuthi lesi sikhwama asikayikhokhi nemihlomulo yezitshudeni. Isolezwe lizame kaningi ukuxhumana nabesikhungo kodwa kwaba nhlanga zimuka nomoya. Ucingo belukhala lungabanjwa kwaze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela.

Umuntu enambulala namzwisa ubuhlungu obukhulu. Kodwa naqhubeka ngoba naninenhloso eyodwa nobabili. WAYEFAKELWA imali yesitokofela neyokubolekwa kuma-akhawunti asebhange uMengameli wezimantshi KwaZulu-Natal, omisiwe emsebenzini ngoxhaxha lwamacala athinta ukugwazisa nawocansi.Lokhu kushiwo ummeli, uMnuz Ravindra Maklilall, esigcawini esiqondisa ubugwegwe uMnuz Sibusiso Eric Nzimande eThekwini.UMaklilall ubekade ebuza futhi ecacisela ufakazi, uMnuz Johannes Meijer, ukuthi kwakungeyona imali okwakugwazelwa ngayo uNzimande.UNzimande, owamiswa emsebenzini ngo-Okthoba 2018, uthweswe amacala angu-162.Kulawa macala kukhona nawokugwazisa ngemali nangocansi kwababekade befuna ukuba yizimantshi okwesikhashana, okuyizinsolo aziphikayo uNzimande.UMaklilall utshele uMeijer ukuthi uhlu lwamacala aluhlanganisa waze wayolubika emaphoyiseni luyageja, akulandelwanga umthetho futhi kwaphulwa amalungelo kaNzimande, kwathunazwa isithunzi sakhe.Lo mmeli ube esekhanyisela uMeijer ngezigatshana zomthetho, wambuza ukuthi kuyicala yini okwakwenziwa uNzimande nozakwabo emsebenzini uma bebolekana imali?UMeijer uhlonywe imibuzo yalulo hlobo kaningi, wagcina esebuka ngasethimbeni labameli beKhomishini yeziMantshi afakaza ohlangothini lwalo.UMaklilall utshele lo fakazi wathi ukubuka kwakhe, abameli ngeke kumsize ngalutho, akaphendule imibuzo.UNzimande, ophucile ekhanda, ubegqoke isudu nezicathulo ezimnyama, ihembe elimhlophe nothayi nezibuko. Ubethule du, eloba phansi konke okukhulunywa uMeijer.Ubebuye abhale ephepheni okuthile abekudlulisela kuMaklilall obenqekuzisa ikhanda samuntu ovumayo.UMaklilall uvalele ekhoneni uMeijer, obebuye aphendule ngokuthi akazi, akasakhumbuli, eminye imibuzo ayibhekiswe kwababekade bephenya uNzimande, okwakhe kwakuwukuhlanganisa uhlu lwamacala anikezwa lona wasebikela amaphoyisa."Imali enguR140 000 enithi yafakwa kwi-akhawunti yasebhange kaNzimande wuNkk Gumede (Lindelwa) wayebolekwa yona. UNzimande wawukhokha uR40 000 wayo. Nencwadi efungelwe kaNkk Gumede iyacacisa ukuthi babebolekene imali,” kuchaza uMaklilall.Ummeli ucacise nangemali okuthiwa yakhokhwa kwi-akhawunti kaNzimande ngumabhalane wasenkantolo. Le mali, uMaklilall uthe kwakungeyesitokofela ababesidlala noNzimande.UMaklilall ube esengena nakwamanye amacala athweswe uNzimande, wathi asolwa ngokwenza nabo inkohlakalo bayazihlangula."Laba abasebenzi abenza imisebenzi eyehlukene enkantolo, bakhala ngokuthi kungcoliswa amagama abo ngenhloso yokubanqinda bangakhuphukeli ezikhundleni eziphezulu ngomuso,” kusho uMaklilall.Ummeli ubuze uMeijer ukuthi bamazisa yini uNzimande ukuthi uyaphenywa njengoba aze athola ngombiko wabezindaba? Uphendule wathi akazi, akuyena owayephenya.Isigcawu siyaqhubeka.

BELUYINDABA egudwini udaba lwamaselula abasolwa ecaleni lokubulawa komrepha u-AKA, abebevele eNkantolo yeMantshi kwaManzini, eSwatini. UMnuz Siyabonga Gezani Ndimande obuye aziwe ngoNxele noMnuz Malusi Dave Ndimande bebesenkantolo.Bekuyokhulunywa ngezinhlelo zokubuyiselwa kwabo kuleli lapho okuzoqhubeka khona icala lokufa komrepha okwashiya abaningi bethuthumela. Kuvele ukuthi amaphepha esicelo sokubuyiswa kwabo avela kuleli abengakafakwa.U-AKA igama lakhe nguKiernan Forbes, wadutshulwa wabulawa nomngani wakhe uTebello "Tibz” Matsoane eThekwini nyakenye. Bahlaselwa amadoda bemi ngaphandle kwendawo yokudlela iWish on Florida eyagcina ivaliwe.Izinsizwa zakwaNdimande zibanjwe amaphoyisa eZone 4, eMbabane, eSwatini emqashweni lapho bezigobe khona amadlangala. ONdimande bafike enkantolo behamba bezifihla bengafuni ukushuthwa.Omunye ubefake ijakhethi emnyama enesigqoko kodwa esidedelile silenga ngemuva. Omunye efake ijakhethi emibalabala naye esiyekile isigqoko. Babonakale behla elolini neziboshwa eziningi befaswe ngamaketango.Omunye wabo ubebuye ahlebe okuthile kumfowabo bese ehleka kodwa ebhokisini bebegebise amakhanda sakucasha.UMshushisi uMnuz Macebo Dlamini, utshele inkantolo ukuthi besingakafiki isicelo esivela kuleli esinxusa ukuba kubuyiswe abamangalelwa. Uthe udaba baluthatha njengoluphuthuma kakhulu futhi bayathemba ukuthi isicelo sizofika maduze.Umshushisi uveze udaba lwamaselula abamangalelwa athathwa ngesikhathi beboshwa. Uthe abomthetho bakuleli bawadonse ngendlebe amaphoyisa aseSwatini bathi awathatha amaselula ngoba angase abe nobufakazi obuzosiza ophenyweni.Amaselula amane abephethwe ngezikhwanyana eziwucwazi obonakalayo ngaphakathi, athuwe phambi kwenkantolo. Ummeli wabamangalelwa uMnuz Sivesonke Ngwenya, uthe unenkinga ngendaba yokuthathwa kwamaselula amakhasimende akhe."Kuthiwa kunencwadi efungelwe ebhalwe wumphenyi wecala maqondana nokuthathwa kwamaselula kodwa mina angikaze ngiyibone. Bengicela ukuthi udaba lwamaselula luhlehlele uMashi 12,’’ kusho uNgwenya.UMshushisi ukhuze wababaza wathi udaba lokuthathwa kwamaselula akufanele lulokhu lubangwa kufanele athathwe ukuze ahlale kahle ngaphansi kweso lamaphoyisa. Inkantolo igunyaze ukuthathwa kwamaselula yase ithi kodwa udaba lwawo luzoxoxwa kahle uma udaba selubuyela enkantolo. Icala lihlehlele uMashi 12 elizobuyela ngawo eNkantolo yeMantshi kwaManzini. Kulindeleke ukuthi abalisa abakuleli babuyele eNkantolo yeMantshi eThekwini namuhla.

UPHIKA ulala ngomhlane uSomlomo wePhalamende, uNkk Nosiviwe Mapisa-Nqakula, ukuthi wathola intshontsho lezigidi zamaRandi ngesikhathi esengungqongqoshe woMnyango wezokuVikela.UNkk Mapisa-Nqakula uthe akusilona iqiniso ukuthi wagwazelwa ngo-R2.3 million izinkampani ezathola amathenda ngesikhathi esengungqongqoshe womnyango.Ukusho lokhu esitatimendeni lapho ebephendula khona umbiko oshicilelwe iphephandaba eliphuma ngeSonto.Umbiko wephephandaba uthe uNkk Mapisa-Nqakula uphenywa ngezinsolo zokugwazisa.UNkk Mapisa-Nqakula waqala ukuphenywa ngo-2021, emva kwesikhalo esafakwa umholi we-UDM, uMnuz Bantu Holomisa.Kepha uphenyo lwabuye lwavalwa ngenxa yokungabi bikho kobufakazi.Imibiko yangempelasonto iveze ukuthi kunobufakazi obusha, obukhomba ngenjumbane uNkk Mapisa-Nqakula.Kulobu bufakazi kuthiwa kunencwadi efungelwe yesikhulu senkampani eyathola ithenda emnyangweni.Isikhulu senkampani kuthiwa sikusho singananazi ukuthi safumbathisa uNkk Mapisa-Nqakula izigidi zamaRandi.Kepha uNkk Mapisa-Nqakula ukuphikile lokhu.Esitatimendeni, ihhovisi likaNkk Mapisa-Nqakula lithe lezi zinsolo uziqabuke embikweni wephephandaba langempelasonto."Ngikholelwa ekutheni uphenyo lwezinsolo ezibucayi ngalolu hlobo kufanele luphathwe ngobuchule. Kuyakhathaza ukubona izinsolo ezibucayi ngalolu hlobo ziputshuzelwa abezindaba.”UNkk Mapisa-Nqakula uthe uzobambisana nezinhlaka eziphenya izinsolo abekwa zona."Ngiyakugcizelela ukuthi ngimsulwa, futhi ngisazimisele ngokuqhubeka nokusebenza ngokuzikhandla. Kuzo zonke izikhundla esengike ngaziphatha, ngiziphathe ngobuqotho.”Kuvele sekukhona amaqembu afuna ukuthi uNkk Mapisa-Nqakula akhishwe esikhundleni.UHolomisa uthe uNkk Mapisa-Nqakula akakulungele ukuphatha isikhundla.Uthe kunobufakazi obubambekayo obuzogojela uNkk Mapisa-Nqakula."Ekuqaleni babungekho ubufakazi obuphathekayo. Kulokhu usomabhizinisi wenze incwadi efungelwe. Kuyakhombisa ukuthi usomabhizinisi uzimisele ngokubhekana noNkk Mapisa-Nqakula. Sifuna kuqale uphenyo ngokushesha. IPhalamende liyisikhungo esihlonishwayo. Kufanele sibuvikele ubuqotho bePhalamende, labo ababhekene namacala kufanele bathathelwe izinyathelo.”UNkk Mapisa-Nqakula uyaqhubeka nokwenza umsebenzi wakhe owejwayelekile njengoba kuleli sonto ezohola amalungu ePhalamende azoya emcimbini wokugubha usuku lwabantu besifazane.Umcimbi uzokuba seFrance, eParis.I-ANC ibingakaphawuli ngodaba lukaNkk Mapisa-Nqakula.
AKAWUVALI umlomo owayengumengameli, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, ngomshado afuna wakhiwe iqembu alikhankaselayo, uMkhonto weSizwe ne-EFF.UZuma uthe umbimbi lungenza lukhulu uma seluphethe izwe emva kokhetho lwangoMeyi.Lokhu ukusho kwi-video, lapho ebefisela khona umholi we-EFF, uMnuz Julius Malema, usuku oluhle lokuzalwa.UMalema ubegubha ukuhlanganisa iminyaka engu-43, ngeSonto.UZuma, obelokhu emamatheka uma ekhuluma ngombimbi alufunayo, uthe uMalema usethubeni lokuba yingxenye yokuqoshwa komlando.Kwi-video, uZuma uthe bafuna ukuthi ukhetho balunqobe ngamalengiso ukuze bezokwazi ukushintsha isimo sakuleli."Ngifisela wena nathi sonke ukuba sikwazi ukuguqula isimo sezwe. Lokhu ngifuna sikwenze noma kukhona abangathandi. Kuyaphoqa ukuthi siwine ukhetho ngokubili kokuthathu. Ngaleyo ndlela nawe uyoxoxa ukuthi wenza isimanga esingaka uneminyaka engu-43. Jabula, wenze konke ofuna ukukwenza. Kodwa ungakhohlwa ukuthi kufanele sinqobe ukhetho ngokubili kokuthathu.”I-MK ne-EFF kabanaso isivumelwano sokusebenzisana, uZuma akacacisanga ukuthi bazosebenzisana kanjani uma bengagcina besitholile isibalo samavoti abasifunayo."Okunye nokunye sizokuxoxa emva kokhetho.”UZuma noMalema bake baba inkukhu nempaka.Ubudlelwano babo baqala ukonakala ngesikhathi uMalema engaweseki umkhankaso kaZuma wokuhola i-ANC ngesikhathi kunengqungquthela, wagcina exoshiwe kuyona, wabe esesungula i-EFF.UMalema ubehlezi ephazamisa izinkulumo zikaZuma ePhalamende, futhi wayeyingxenye yemikhankaso yokuba uZuma aphume esikhundleni.Babuye bakhombisa ukubuyisana ngesikhathi uZuma ebhekene nokuboshwa, ngo-2021.UMalema waya "kophuza itiye” emzini kaZuma ngesikhathi kwakusaphikiswana ngesinqumo sokuthi uZuma kufanele aye ejele.Okhulumela iMK, uMnuz Nhlamulo Ndhlela, uthe bebengakanqumi ukuthi bazosebenzisana namaphi amaqembu ezepolitiki."Njengamanje, alukabi khona ukhetho, asazi ukuthi sizothola amavoti amangaki. Uma singathi siyaqala sikhuluma indaba yokusebenzisana, singathi sikhuluma ngamaphi amavoti? Njengamanje sigxile ekukhankaseleni ukhetho.”UNdhlela uthe bazosebenzisana kuphela namaqembu anemigomo efana neyabo."Kubalulekile ukuthi amaqembu acabanga ngokufana abe yimbumba. Lezo zingxoxo sizokuba nazo emva kokhetho.”Ebuzwa yiSABC ngomyalezo awuthunyelwe uZuma, uMalema uthe bazimisele ngokusebenzisana namaqembu anemigomo efanayo neyabo."Akhona amaqembu anemigomo efanayo neyethu, iPAC, ATM. Manje sekukhona neMK ekhuluma indaba yokuthathwa komhlaba ngaphandle kwesinxephezelo. Sihlezi sikusho ukuthi sifuna kube nobumbano.”Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kokhulumela i-EFF, uMnuz Sinawo Thambo, ayizange iphumelele njengoba ucingo lwakhe belukhala lungabanjwa.Khonamanjalo: UNdhlela ugxeke ukuqhubeka kwezigameko zokubulawa kosopolitiki KwaZulu-Natal.Lokhu ukusho emva kokubulawa komxhumanisi we-ANC kuWard 74, kuMasipala waseThekwini, uMnuz Vusumuzi "Blesser” Ntuli.UNtuli udutshulwe wabulawa ngoMgqibelo ehostela eTehuis, ephuma emhlanganweni weMK."Sifuna kube nobulungiswa. Kufanele kuphele ukubulawa kwabaholi bezepolitiki KwaZulu-Natal. Sinxusa amalungu oMkhonto ukuba ehlise imimoya, adedele uphenyo lwamaphoyisa. Sinxusa nabaholi bamaqembu ezepolitiki ukuba bangakhulumi izinto ezisusa udlame uma bekhuluma emiphakathini.”
BABAMBE umoya abaholi be-ANC ababhekene namacala njengoba le nhlangano inomhlangano wokuphothula uhlu lwabazoyimela ePhalamende naseziShayamthetho.Abaholi be-ANC abangaphezu kuka-70, basengcupheni yokusala ngaphandle ohlwini njengoba bebhekene namacala.Umhlangano wesigungu esiphezulu kwi-ANC obizelwe ukuzophothula uhlu, uqale ngoMsombuluko.Lo mhlangano uzobheka amagama aphakanyiswe ngesikhathi kunemihlangano yamagatsha.BABAMBE umoya abaholi be-ANC ababhekene namacala njengoba le nhlangano inomhlangano wokuphothula uhlu lwabazoyimela ePhalamende naseziShayamthetho. isithombe; Fikile Mbalula/XPhakathi kwezinto ezizobhekwa ukuthi ngabe abaphakanyisiwe ababhekene yini namacala, nokuthi banazo yini iziqu zemfundo ezifanele?Abaholi abaningi be-ANC bavinjwa ukungenela umbango ngesikhathi kunezingqungquthela zokukhetha ubuholi.Phakathi kwabo kubalwa nosihlalo we-ANC kwisifunda iTheku, uNkk Zandile Gumede, owayephakanyiselwa ukuba angenele umbango wezikhundla ngesikhathi kunengqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi be-ANC KwaZulu-Natal.UNobhala Jikelele kwi-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, uthe bazowabhekisisa amagama abaholi aphakanyiswe amagatsha."Kunemigomo okufanele ibhekwe uma siphothula uhlu lwethu. Imigomo icacile. Sizobheka igama ngalilodwa. Sizobheka ukuthi ngabe loyo mholi akanawo yini amacala, sibheke ukuthi azikho yini izinsolo zenkohlakalo ababhekene nazo?”UMbalula uvele wangena ezintangeni uma ebuzwa ngekusasa lamalungu esigungu esiphezulu okukhona kuwo noDkt Zweli Mkhize, abasolwa ngenkohlakalo.UMkhize washiya kwesokuba ungqongqoshe wezeMpilo emva kwezinsolo zenkohlakalo."Yonke imibuzo sizoyiphendula emva komhlangano wesigungu esiphezulu. Zonke izinto ezithinta abaholi okuthiwa abashenxe ezikhundleni, abathinteka embikweni weKhomishini kaZondo (Jaji Raymond), sizozikhuluma emva komhlangano. Sizochaza ukuthi kungani abaholi abathile bekhona ohlwini, sichaze nangalabo abangekho.”UMbalula uthe imigomo iqinile kakhulu kwabazomela i-ANC ePhalamende naseziShayamthetho.Uthe kuzobhekwa nokuthi abanye basebenze kanjani ezikhundleni abebejutshwe kuzo, ngaphambi kokuthi bafakwe ohlwini."Uhlelo olude oluzolandelwa. Abaholi baye kwinhlolokhono. UMengameli (uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa) kwaqala yena kwinhlolokhono. Wahlala amahora amabili kwinhlolokhono, ebuzwa ngemigomo ye-ANC. Bangu-284 abaholi abaye kwinhlokhono.”UMbalula uthe bazokwazi ukuhlangabezana nomnqamulajuqu wangoLwesihlanu, obekwe inhlangano eyengamele ukhetho, i-Independent Electoral Commission (IEC), wokuba wonke amaqembu ezepolitiki alethe amagama abantu abazowamela ePhalamende naseziShayamthetho.Okhethweni lohulumeni basekhaya olwalungo-2021, i-ANC yehluleka ukuhambisa ngesikhathi amagama kwabanye omasipala, i-IEC yabuye yalula isikhathi.
SESENYUKELE kubantu abangu-1 044 isibalo sabantu abahaqwe isifo samehlo uphenyane KwaZulu-Natal.Izibalo zakamuva ezikhishwe wuMnyango wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal zikhombisa ukuthi kusukela ngeSonto, bese zingu-1 044 iziguli ezihaqwe ilesi sifo.Izimpawu zaso zihlanganisa ukuvuvukala kolwelwesi lweso, ukukhala kweso nokuluma kwalo. Kulezi ziguli umnyango, uthe ezine zihlala ezindaweni ezingaphansi kukaMasipala Ugu ezingu-1 040 zihlala eThekwini.Lesi sitatimende siqhuba sithi uMphathiswa walo mnyango, uNkk Nomagugu Simelane, unxusa abantu abazibona benezimpawu zalesi sifo ukuthi bavakashele emtholampilo noma kudokotela ngokushesha. "Umnyango unohlelo oluqhubekayo lokufundisa umphakathi usebenzisa izinkundla ezehlukene zokuxhumana nemithombo yezindaba. Indlela yokusigwema ukugeza izandla nokuthi abanaso bagweme ukuhlala nabanye abantu noma bafake izinto ezivikela amehlo," kusho isitatimende.
USIHLALO we-ActionSA KwaZulu- Natal, uMnuz Zwakele Mncwango, uthi kungakuhle uNdunankulu kaZulu uMfundisi uThulasizwe Buthelezi, ahoxise amazwi akhe esidlangaleni. UMncwango ubize isithangami nabezindaba eThekwini, ezocacisa ngamazwi okuthiwa ashiwo nguButhelezi ngaye.Umsindo usukela emcimbini wokuvulwa kwesiShayamthetho saKwaZulu- Natal, eMgungundlovu, lapho okwakhuluma khona iSilo uMisuzulu kaZwelithini.UNdunankulu wesifundazwe uNkk Nomusa Dube - Ncube, welama iSilo ngenkulumo ngoLwesithathu kepha sasikade sikhulume ngoLwesibili. Kwakhalwa ngokuthi inkulumo kaBayede ibe mfishane kakhulu kangangokuthi abanye baze bathi umcimbi kufanele ube ngowosuku olulodwa.UMncwango uthi uButhelezi ukhulume kabi ngaye esho okungelona iqiniso ngesikhathi esukumisa iSilo esigodlweni eMachobeni, eNgwavuma kugujwa uMkhosi wamaGanu. UMncwango uthi kuthiwa yena wathi iSilo uMisuzulu kaZwelithini akufanele sikhulume uma kuvulwa iSishayamthetho.Kunenkulumo eqoshiwe okuthiwa kukhuluma kuyona uButhelezi ethi abasondelene noMncwango abamkhuze ngoba usekhuluma izindaba ezingaphezu kwakhe.UMncwango ubebabaza imihlolo ethi akakaze ayisho leyo nto."Ngingubani mina ongathi iSilo asingabe sisakhuluma? Mina ngangiphakamisa ukuthi kungaba njani uma umcimbi ungaba wusuku olulodwa ukuze kongiwe imali. Ngimangele uma sekuthiwa ngathi iSilo asingakhulumi, uShenge kungaba kuhle axolise impela kufanele axolise esidlangaleni,’’ kusho uMncwango.Uthe bayazana noShenge bahlala bexoxa, uma kunodaba olunjalo bekufanele amthinte ambuze bakhulume kahle. UMncwango uthe uyazi ngobukhosi ngoba uyingxenye yamabutho, uyasihlonipha iSilo nobuholi bendabuko bonke.Uthe usehlele umhlangano nezinduna zamabutho ukuze acacise ngodaba, uma kwenzeka ebonana neSilo."Abantu abaningi ababengishayela ucingo babeshaqekile ngoba bayazi ukuthi ngeke ngiyisho leyo nto. Ngihlele umhlangano nezinduna zamabutho ukuze zizwe uhlangothi lwami, neSilo ngiyafisa ukubonana naso ngalolu daba,’’ kuchaza uMncwango.Ebuzwa ngalokhu uNdunankulu kaZulu uButhelezi, uthe uMncwango akahloniphi uzama ukubukwa ngeSilo."Ubengekho uMhlonishwa uMncwango eMachobeni, ngakho kuyangimangaza ukuthi uMhlonishwa angaphawula ngomcimbi abekade engekho kuwona. Nakho lokhu kokuthi uMhlonishwa afune ukugqama ngeSilo akukhombisi inhlonipho,’’ kuphendula uButhelezi.
IMIPHAKATHI yaseThekwini ebidinwe ukuthi sekuphele izinsuku ezintathu kuya phezulu ingenawo amanzi noma ugesi ivale imigwaqo ngamathayi nemigoqo.Le miphakathi ibithi sekungaphezu kwamandla njengoba sekubole ukudla emafrijini, amathoyilethi ayanuka, awekho amanzi okugeza nawokuphuza.KwaMashu abahlala ehostela, bavale imigwaqo ekuseni nokuphazamise abebeya emsebenzi bethi sekuphele izinsuku ezine ugesi ungekho kule ndawo.ENtuzuma umphakathi uvale umgwaqo omkhulu okuhamba kuwo amabhasi kamasipala.Okunye obekukhathaza umphakathi ukuthi abanye ompompi abasemgwaqweni umphakathi obuthola kuwo amanzi bebengasaphumi lutho. Abahlala kwezinye izingxenye zaseNtuzuma naKwaMashu ebebesenawo amanzi bese benqaba nawo bethi kuzokwenyuka izikweletu zabo.UNdunakulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Nomusa Dube -Ncube, obekhuluma esithangamini nabezindaba, izolo, uthe umasipala wenza konke okusemandleni ukuze umphakathi uthole izidingo ikakhulukazi amanzi, ugesi nokuthuthwa kwendle.Uthe kunethimba elakhiwe iminyango kahulumeni ehlukene nabamabhizinisi elizolekelela ekutheni kubuyiselwe amanzi emiphakathini ikakhulukazi ehlala eNyakatho yeTheku okuyiyona ephazamiseke kakhulu. Uthe isiteleka esingekho emthethweni sabasebenzi benyunyana i-SAMWU, siqale sekusele usuku olulodwa kuphothulwe umsebenzi wokulungiswa kwamapayipi nama-valve kule ndawo."Umsebenzi obuwenziwa ubusuphothuliwe kodwa kudingeka kube nabasebenzi abazoqapha ukungena kwamanzi emapayipini , aze ayongena lapho egcinwa khona ngaphambi kokuthi aye emphakathini," kusho uNdunankulu.Uthe bayaqonda ukuthi abasebenzi kumele bakhale uma kukhona abengenelisekile ngakho kodwa lokho akusho ukuthi sekumele kunyathelwe ilungelo lomphakathi. Uthe sekwakhiwe ithimba lezinhlaka zamaphoyisa ezehlukene elizophelezela abasebenzi abangatelekile abasatshiswayo uma beyosebenza. Kuqashwe nezinkampani ezizimele ezizolekelela ekuhanjisweni kwezinye izidingo ezifana nokuqoqwa kwemfucuza. Uqhube wathi umqashi okunguMasipala weTheku awukahlangani neSAMWU ngoba azikho izikhalo ezilethwe ile nyunyana kuye kodwa uMnuz Siya Dladla weSAMWU, uthe umqashi uyazi ukuthi bafuna ukuhlangana naye, balinde ukuthi anqume usuku. UNdunakulu uthe abasebenzi beSAMWU babenomhlangano ngoLwesibili olwedlule, ngemuva kwalowo mhlangano ababuyelanga emsebenzini.Imibiko ithi abasebenzi abatelekile bafuna kulungiswe umholo wabo ulingane nowabanye abasenza komasipala abangama-metroIMeya yeTheku, uMnuz Mxolisi Kaunda, ithe ayinaso isibalo esigcwele sokuthi bangaki abasebenzi abatelekile ngoba abanye bayasatshiswa. Uthe akwaziyo ukuthi kuthinteke wonke umasipala, hhayi uphiko lwamanzi nolukadoti kuphela.Uthe kuzophela isonto isimo sesibuyele kwesijwayelekile, wathi kuzolandelwa izindlela ezifanele zokuqondiswa ubugwegwe kwabangenele isiteleka esingekho emthethweni.
UFAKAZI esigcawini esiqondisa ubugwegwe uMengameli wezimantshi KwaZulu-Natal, uthe ubucayi bezinsolo zokugwazisa ngemali nangocansi kwababefuna izikhundla zokuba yizimantshi kwamphoqa ukuthi avule icala emaphoyiseni.IMantshi uJohannes Meijer yethule ubufakazi esigcawini esiqondisa ubugwegwe uMnuz Eric Sibusiso Nzimande ngoMsombuluko.Isigcawu esenganyelwe ngusihlalo okuyiJaji Jeremiah Shongwe, osathatha umhlalaphansi, siqhubeka eNkantolo edingida amacala athinta imindeni ePhoyinti, eThekwini."Akukho lapho mina engaphenya khona ngokwami kodwa ngasebenzisa imininingwane engahlinzekwa yona, ngavula icala emaphoyiseni. Umthetho uyangiphoqa ngenxa yesikhundla sami ukuthi ngibikele amaphoyisa ngoba ngangiyoba senkingeni uma ngithula nolwazi mayelana nezinsolo zenkohlakalo,” kusho uMeijer.UNzimande, obekade ebukeka ezikhululekele futhi ebhala phansi obekushiwo wufakazi ngaye, ubekwe amacala awu-162 yiKhomishini yeziMantshi.UMeijer usophikweni olubheke ukusebenza ngobuqotho kusukela ngonyaka u-2000, izinsolo abekade efakaza ngazo, uthe zazivela kuNkk Lindelwa Gumede owayesebenza noNzimande ngoJulayi 2015.Kuthiwa wayesola uNzimande ukuthi ugwazisa ngemali nangezinto ezithinta ucansi kwababegaqele ukuba yizimantshi okwesikhashana.UNkk Gumede kuthiwa wenza izinsolo zokuthi wayesegwazele uNzimande izikhawu. Kuvela nokuthi langa limbe wacelwa nguNzimande azohlala emathangeni akhe khona ezomphulula, baxoxe ngocansi.UMeijer uthe nakuba uNkk Gumede awahoxisa ngo-2016 amacala, kodwa wagcizelela ukuthi kuyiqiniso ayekubhale encwadini efungelwe eyanikwa amaphoyisa.UMeijer uthe umthetho unika igunya Nzimande ukuba enze izincomo kwiphini likangqongqoshe eMnyangweni wezobuLungiswa ngabalungele ukuba izimantshi okwesikhashana.Ummeli kaNzimande, uMnuz Ravindra Maklilall, upheke Meijer ngemibuzo ethi buphi ubufakazi bokuthi uNzimande wagwazisa uNkk Gumede uR140 000?UMeijer ubebuye athi okunye akanalo ulwazi lwakho. Lapho uNzimande ubewahlome kuMeijer amehlo akhe uma ephendula abuye abhale phansi.Emacaleni uMeijer athi wawabikela amaphoyisa, kukhona nawokuba seCasino egembula ngesikhathi somsebenzi uNzimande.UNzimande uthe uyakweshwama kushiwo ngaye futhi anyathelwa ngezinyawo amalungelo akhe kwenziwa uphenyo, wathi kuyinto abazoyiveza esigcawini.UMaklilall ubuze sakubhuqa uMeijer ukuthi uyazi yini ukuthi u-50% wabantu okuthiwa bagwazela uNzimande, babhala izitatimende bekuchitha njengamampunge okushiwo ngabo?UMeijer uthe akanalwazi ngoba kwakungeyena umphenyi.Isigcawu siyaqhubeka.

IQEMBU i-EFF lengeze ithimba labaholi balo abajutshwe ukuba baqhube umkhankaso KwaZulu-Natal njengoba isifundazwe sibhekwe ngabomvu okhethweni olungoMeyi 29.I-EFF inqume ukwandisa ithimba eliholwa yiPhini likaMengameli, uMnuz Floyd Shivambu, ngabaholi abane.Isinqumo sokwandisa ithimba labaholi sithathwe emhlanganweni wekomiti elididiyela imikhankaso yokhetho kwi-EFF.Abaholi abajutshwe ukuba bazoqinisa ithimba; uNobhala Jikelele, uMnuz Marshal Dlamini, owayeyiphini likanobhala jikelele, uNksz Hlengiwe Mkhaliphi namalungu esigungu esiphezulu; uMnuz Fana Mokoena, noNksz Reneiloe Mashabela.I-EFF ithatha lesi sinqumo nje, isanda kwethula umkhankaso wezethembiso zokhetho kuso isifundazwe iKwaZulu-Natal.Okhulumela i-EFF, uMnuz Sinawo Thambo, uthe emva kwempumelelo yomcimbi wokwethulwa kwezethembiso zokhetho babone isidingo sokuba baqinise ithimba labaholi."IKwaZulu-Natal iyona elele isibili ngokwezinombolo zabantu ababhalisele ukuvota njengoba bengu-5 723 821 abantu ababhalisile esifundazweni. Umbango uzokuba mkhulu eKZN. Ingakho sikhethe ukuqinisa ithimba eliholwa uShivambu.”I-EFF yenza kahle KwaZulu-Natal okhethweni olwedlule njengoba yathola izihlalo eziyisishagalombili esiShayamthetho sesifundazwe, isuka kwezimbili.UThambo uthe bafuna ukuphinde bandise isibalo samavoti abazowathola KwaZulu-Natal okhethweni lwangoMeyi."Muhle kakhulu umsebenzi owenziwa ithimba labaholi elijutshwe eKZN. I-EFF ikhombisa ukukhula nokulungela ukhetho. Ukugcwalisa kwethu inkundla ngesikhathi sethula umkhankaso wokhetho kukutshela lukhulu. Inkundla yagcwaliswa kuphela abantu abaqhamuka KwaZulu-Natal, nokusho ukuthi i-EFF iyathandwa eKZN. Asikungabazi ukuthi umsebenzi omuhle owenziwa ithimba labaholi uzoheha abantu abaningi ukuba bavotele i-EFF ukuze sikhiphe i-ANC emandleni. I-ANC yehluleke yancama ukuphatha.”Khonamanjalo: Umholi we-EFF, uMnuz Julius Malema, wethule umqulu wezethembiso zokhetho esifundazweni iGauteng, ngoMgqibelo.UMalema utshele izinkumbi ebezigcwele enkundleni iDobsonville ukuthi i-EFF izolunqoba ukhetho oluzayo.UMalema ukhwele wadilika emndenini wezimpunyela zakwa-Oppenheimer.Amalungu alo mndeni asematheni emva kokunikela ngezigidi zamaRandi kumaqembu ezepolitiki aphikisayo.Mumva nje, uNksz Rebecca Oppenheimer unikele ngoR15 million kwiqembu lezepolitiki elisha, iRise Mzansi."Kungani abantu bakwa-Oppenheimer benikela ngezigidi kumaqembu ezepolitiki amasha, angenamlando? Sekunesikhathi eside abantu bakwa-Oppenheimer belawula izwe lethu. Sekuyisikhathi sokuthi sibuyise izwe lethu.”
ABAMANGALELWA ababoshelwe ukufa komrepha u-AKA, uMnuz Siyabonga Gezani Ndimande noMnuz Malusi Dave Ndimande, kuthiwa babeke imibandela ngokubuyiswa kwabo kuleli besuka eSwatini. Bacele ukuphelezelwa ngamaphoyisa aseSwatini nabameli babo babanikele ezikhulwini zejele kuleli, hhayi emaphoyiseni.Kuvela ukuthi abafisi ukunikelwa emaphoyiseni akuleli ngoba bayawesaba. Kulindeleke ukuthi kudingidwe nodaba lokubuysiwa kwabakwaNdimande abavaleleke eSwatini.Izinsizwa zakwaNdimande okuthiwa zinebhizinisi lamatekisi, ziyamaniswa nokufa kukaMnuz William Kunene obedume ngoMtimande owayengumnikazi wamatekisi. Ziphinde zithinteke kwelinye icala lokufa komunye usomabhizinisi.KULINDELEKE ukuthi libuyele eNkantolo yeMantshi eThekwini kusasa, icala lokubulawa komrepha u-AKA owabulawa nomngani wakhe uTebello Matsoane Isithombe: FACEBOOK/AKA
UTHI awumthusi umbango oshisa phansi wokuhola isifundazwe iKwaZulu-Natal ohola iRise Mzansi esifundazweni, uNkk Nonkululeko Hlongwane-Mhlongo.UNkk Hlongwane-Mhlongo uthe bona bagxile kakhulu emkhankasweni wabo, wathi abafuni ukuphazanyiswa izinto ezenzeka emaceleni.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi enengxoxo ekhethekile neSolezwe.UNkk Hlongwane-Mhlongo ungumholi wesikhashana weRise Mzansi KwaZulu-Natal, kulindeleke ukuthi athulwe ngokusemthethweni njengomele iqembu embangweni wesikhundla sikandunankulu eKZN ngoLwesithathu.Umbango mkhulu KwaZulu-Natal njengoba i-IFP neqembu elikhankaselwa owayengumengameli, uJacob Zuma, uMkhonto weSizwe, likhombisa ukwenza kahle ezinkethweni zokuchibiyela zakamumva ezibe KwaZulu-Natal.UNkk Hlongwane-Mhlongo uthe babheke ukwenza kahle KwaZulu-Natal."Siyazi ukuthi amaqembu amaningi ayibhekile iKwaZulu-Natal njengoba ingeyesibili ngokwesibalo sabantu ababhalisele ukuvota. IKwaZulu-Natal ithathwa njengababeki benkosi. Thina asithukile. Siyazi ukuthi kuzokuba nesiphithiphithi, nomsindo."Kodwa iqiniso esilaziyo ukuthi abantu baKwaZulu-Natal abamane bavotele noma iliphi iqembu lezepolitiki. Abantu baKwaZulu-Natal bavotela iqembu abalaziyo ukuthi lizofeza izidingo zabo. Njengoba siya okhethweni abantu angeke bawavotele amaqembu angazifezi izethembiso.”UNkk Hlongwane-Mhlongo uthe umqulu wezethembiso zokhetho wabo unezinto ezidingwa abantu baKwaZulu-Natal."Engikuthandayo ngomqulu wethu ukuthi abantu baKwaZulu-Natal babambe iqhaza ngesikhathi siwubhala. Siyile kubona, saxoxa nabo, basitshela izinto abazifunayo. "Phakathi kwezinhlaka esixhumane nazo ngesikhathi sibhala umqulu, iKZN Blind Society. Sahlala nabo, basitshela izidingo zabo. Uma ubona izinto ezithinta abantu abaphila nokukhubazeka emqulwini wethu, kuyobe kuyizinto esizithathe kubona.”UNkk Hlongwane-Mhlongo uthe kumjabulisile ukuba afakwe embangweni wesikhundla sobundunankulu.Uthe ukhethwe emva kohlelo olude obeluqhutshwa yikomiti elizimele."Ikomiti elizimele lathola amagama angaphezu kuka-400. Kwabe sekuhlungwa, kwenziwa inhlolokhono. Emva kwalokho ke, ikomiti labe selikhetha igama lami. Kungijabulisile kakhulu ukuba ngikhethwe. Engikuthandayo ukuthi uhlelo beluqhutshwa yikomiti elizimele.”UNkk Hlongwane-Mhlongo usebenze kakhulu nezinhlangano ezingenzi nzuzo, njengoba esebenze kulo mkhakha iminyaka engu-12.Uphinde wasebenza kakhulu nomasipala.
UMASIPALA weTheku usuqashe amalungu omphakathi waseBuffelsdraai, eVerulam, angu-185 ukwenza umsebenzi wokongiwa kwamahlathi endaweni eyakhele indawo yokulahla udoti.Lokhu kuvezwe yiMeya yeTheku, uMnuz Mxolisi Kaunda, ngoMgqibelo, ngesikhathi ibize umhlangano nomphakathi wakule ndawo.Inhloso yomhlangano bekuwukuzowazisa ngenqubekela phambili ngezinhlelo ezamenyezelwa nyakenye, kulandela udlame phakathi kwawo nonogada abagade endawweni.Kulolo dlame olwaba ngoJulayi nyakenye, onogada basolwa ngokudubula uMnuz Njabulo Mbonambi (27) wasoSindisweni wafa. Kwathiwa wadutshulwa ngezinhlamvu zangempela esifubeni, washonela endaweni yesigameko.Kwabikwa ukulimala kwabevile ku-16 abaphuthinyiswa esibhedlela. Bonke abagilwa babengabantu ababezicoshela udoti kule ndawo ngenhloso yokuziphilisa. UKaunda ekhuluma nomphakathi obugcwele phama itende, uthe iminyango eyahlukene yomasipala isatshalaliswe kule ndawo ukuthi isungule izinhlelo ezizokwenza ngcono impilo yabantu.IMEYA yeTheku uMnuz Mxolisi Kaunda ekhuluma neNkosiyesizwe samaQadi uMnuz Mqoqi ngcobo emhlanganweni womphakathi waseBuffelsdraai obumayelana nezinhlelo zokuwuthuthukisa Isithombe: SITHUNYELWE"Bangu-185 asebenikwe umsebenzi ohlelweni lokongiwa kwamahlathi akhele indawo iBuffelsdraai kanjalo nendawo yokulahla udoti,” kusho uKaunda.Uqhube wathi ingu-30 imifelandawonye yamabhizinisi esibhalisiwe kusuka ngalesiya sikhathi kuze kube yimanje.IMEYA yeTheku, uMnuz Mxolisi Kaunda, ikhuluma nomphakathi waseBuffelsdraai ngezinhlelo zokuwuthuthukisa Isithombe: SITHUNYELWEUKaunda uveze nokuthi inqwaba yemilutha yezidakamizwa ingaphansi kohlelo lokuhlunyeleliswa."Abanye babo sebesiziwe ngokuphelele, base beyohlanganiswa nemindeni yabo,” kuchaza uKanda.Uqhube wathi bazimisele ngokusiza intsha ebisicwile ezidakamizweni ukuthi ithole amathuba omsebenzi ukuze ingaphindeli ekusebenziseni izidakamizwa."Ngokusebenzisana nama-SETA’s, sizobafaka ezinhlelweni zokuqeqeshelwa i-carpentry, plumbing, ne-brick laying,” kusho uKaunda.Olunye usizo athe lulethelwe umphakathi waseBuffelsdraai, olokubhalisela omazisi, kulabo abangakaze babenabo.Uphinde waveza ukuthi useqokiwe usonkontileka ozokwenza umsebenzi wokwakha isiphehlimanzi sasoGunjini, esizolekelela izinkinga zamanzi.Uphinde wagcizelela ukuthi kuyingozi kubantu ukuya endaweni yokulahla udoti.Le ndawo namanje isavaliwe kulabo abafuna ukuzicoshela udoti. Lesi sinqumo sathathwa umasipala kulandela izidubedube zokubulawa komuntu owayezozicoshela udoti ngoJulayi nyakenye.
KUSOLWA ukuziphindisela kudutshulwa owesifazane obelele nosana eMalukazi washona, ngoLwesihlanu entathakusa.UNksz Ncamisile Mkhize (40) kuthiwa ubelele nosana lwakhe olunezinyanga eziyithupha ngesikhathi kungena amadoda amabili endlini, eyodwa yabanga isibhamu nomyeni wakhe, enye yaqonda akamelweni lokulala yamdubula elele, kwadubuleka nosana abelele nalo.Kuthiwa eminyakeni emithathu edlule uNksz Mkhize wabopha owesilisa okhulile owayethi uthandana nendodakazi yakhe eyayineminyaka ewu-14 ngaleso sikhathi. Owesilisa waboshelwa icala lokudlwengula ngoba indodakazi yakhe yayisengaphansi ngokweminyaka. Kuthiwa waphuma ejele, kungakapheli sikhathi esingakanani sekudutshulwa unina wentombazane owavula icala.Umyeni kaNksz Mkhize, uMnuz Nanana Dlamini, uthe uzwe umsindo obekungathi kukhona ongena emjondolo ongaphandle, wavuka ethi uyobheka.Kuthe esathi uyovula ngasekhishini, engakavuli abebengaphandle bakhahlela isicabha, savuleka bahlangana khona ekhishini. Kwangena amadoda amabili, egqoke izigqoko ezivale ubuso. Engene kuqala uzame ukulwa nayo kodwa kwaba nzima ngoba ibiphethe isibhamu. Eyesibili ingene yaqonda ekamelweni labo lokulala yafike yadubula umkakhe nengane abelele nayo embhedeni."Sisale ekhishini nalesi sigebengu esingene kuqala. Ngizwe kuqhuma isibhamu. Umkami udutshulwe elele, ingane nayo idubulekile kodwa yona isindile. Iyiswe esibhedlela yabhandishwa yabuya," kuchaza yenaUthe umsolwa obedubula uzishaye ngempama izingane ebese zivuswe umsindo wesibhamu, zizama ukubaleka, wazibuza ukuthi siphi isibhamu sikanina."Umkami ubengenaso isibhamu futhi akakaze abe naso. Izigebengu zithathe amaselula abo nesikhwama semali obekuseduze kombhede," kusho yena.Uqhube wathi umkakhe ubengakaze abike ukuthi kukhona umuntu axabene naye."Ngisadidekile nje ukuthi ngizothi udutshulelwani ngoba akujwayelekile ukuthi izigebengu zisike ama-buglar guards ngoba zifuna amaselula," kusho yena.Ebuzwa ngezinsolo zokuziphindisela, uthe akanalo ulwazi lwalokho, obesho njalo kungenzeka ukuthi unolwazi umndeni ongenalo kodwa ukhona umuntu owaboshelwa ukudlwengula indodakazi yabo. Okhulumela amaphoyisa kulesi sifundazwe uLt Col Nqobile, usiqinisekisile isigameko, wathi amaphoyisa aphenya amacala amathathu, elokugqekeza, elokubulala nelokuzama ukubulala.
