SIMUNCU isimo emphakathini waseDumaneni, oLundi, kulandela ukubulawa kwabayisithupha ngempelasonto ezigamekweni ezimbili ezehlukene.Esigamekweni sangeSonto kudutshulwe ubaba wekhaya (66) kwaMayise, umkakhe (63) namadodakazi amathathu aneminyaka ephakathi kuka-29 no-36.Kuthiwa indodakazi eno-29 ishone endleleni eya esibhedlela.Ikhansela lendawo, uMnuz Thulani Nxumalo, lithe bathole ukuthi laba bahlaselwe abantu abangaziwa abagasele ekhaya ezintatha zangeSonto."Abahlaseli bafike badubula wonke umndeni onamalungu ayisihlanu. Ashone wonke,” kusho uNxumalo.Kuvela ukuthi amadodakazi abengothisha womathathu ezikoleni ezimbili zendawo, iJobo High neKujulukeni Primary.UNxumalo uthe kwenzeka lesi sigameko nje ngoLwesihlanu emndenini wakwaBiyela kushone umfana oneminyaka engu-16."Yena uhlaselwe sekuhwalele. Kuthiwa ubefika ngemoto ehamba namanye amalungu omndeni bebuya ndawana thize. Bafike sebelindiwe abahlaseli abavele bathushuka egcekeni babadubula,” kusho uNxumalo.Uthe umfana ushonele endaweni yesigameko, kwathi abanye ababili baphuthunyiswa esibhedlela."Lukhulu uvalo olukhona emphakathini ngoba bonke laba ababulawayo bahlobene. Emva kwesigameko sangempelasonto, abanye bebecela ngisho nokungena ezimotweni zamaphoyisa ebezihambele izigameko, babaleke kule ndawo,” kwenaba uNxumalo.Uqhube wathi miningi imindeni esithuthile yahamba ngenxa yokuzibona ingaphephile.Uveze nokuthi kusuka ngo-2021 bevile ku-20 abantu asebebulelwe kule ndawo, abahlobene.Ezigamekweni ezimbili ezingaphambi kwalezi zangempelasonto, ngoFebhuwari 2 kwadutshulwa umkhulu walo mfana ona-16 odutshulwe ngoLwesihlanu. Kuthiwa abahlaseli bambulalela ekhaya.Leso sigameko salandelwa ngesokubulawa kwenduna yendawo, uZuma, nayehamba naye, uMbatha. Bona badutshulelwa emotweni ngabantu abazenza abacela ukugitshezwa, kwathi uma ima imoto bakhipha isibhamu badubula uZuma, amachaphazelo asale esethela noMbatha, bashona bobabili.Imizamo yokuthola imindeni ayiphumelelanga.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant Colonel Nqobile Gwala, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi kuvulwe amacala ayisithupha okubulala esiteshini samaphoyisa sasoLundi."Esigamekweni sangeSonto abafi baneminyaka ephakathi kwengu-29 nengu-66, bahlaselwe ekhaya eDumaneni. Oneminyaka engu-29 ushone endleleni eya esibhedlela, bonke laba abanye bashonele endaweni yesigameko,” kusho uLt Col Gwala.Uqhube wathi esigamekweni sangoLwesihlanu kudutshulwe umfana (16) wafa."Akukaboshwa muntu, amaphoyisa asaphenya,” kusho uLt Col Gwala.
AMAQEMBU ezepolitiki amancane avuke azithatha, athula imiqulu yezethembiso zokhetho njengoba kusondela usuku lokuvota.Ngempelasonto, amaqembu amathathu okuyi-UDM, PAC ne-FF Plus, athule imikhankaso yawo yakhetho.La maqembu athula imiqulu yawo emva kokuthi amaqembu amakhulu i-ANC, DA, ne-EFF, eseyivulile indlela.I-ANC, DA ne-EFF, iwona anezihlalo eziningi ePhalamende, futhi iwona aba ngowokuqala ukwethula izethembiso zokhetho.Njengoba ukhetho lwangoMeyi selusondele, kulindeleke ukuthi abe maningi amaqembu amancane azokwethula izethembiso zokhetho.Amaqembu athule izethembiso ngempelasonto, athembise amathuba emisebenzi, ukuthuthukisa umnotho nokulwa nenkohlakalo.Umholi we-UDM, uMnuz Bantu Holomisa, uthe bafuna kuphele ukuphathwa ngendlela engafani kwabaholi bomdabu eNingizimu Afrika. UHolomisa uthe bafuna ukuthi abaholi bomdabu baphathwe ngendlela efanayo kuzo zonke izifundazwe zakuleli.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ethula umqulu wezethembiso zokhetho, eGoli, ngoMgqibelo.UHolomisa uthe akulungile ukuthi abaholi bomdabu bathole izinto ezingafani."Uma abaholi bomdabu bethengelwa izimoto eLimpopo naKwaZulu-Natal, abathengelwe nakwezinye izifundazwe. Ayiyekwe le nto yokukhetha iphela emasini."UHolomisa uthe iqembu lakhe lizimisele ngokulwa nenkohlakalo."Inkohlakalo idla lubi lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Abantu abazitholi izidingo ngenxa yokuthi imali yehliswa ngemilenze. Iphutha elikhulu elenziwa ngabantu ukuthi bayaqhubeka nokuvotela abantu abanukwa ngenkohlakalo."Thina angeke siyibekezelele inkohlakalo. Namanje siyalwa nenkohlakalo. Ingakho sesisungule uphiko olulwa nenkohlakalo."Selokhu i-UDM yasungulwa eminyakeni engaphezu kwengu-27 eyedlule, uHolomisa uyena obelokhu eyihola.Ebuzwa ukuthi ucabanga ukwehla nini esikhundleni, uHolomisa uthe ulindele igama elizophuma kumalungu eqembu."Uma ubheka, sengiqalile ukucija abaholi bakusasa. Baningi abaholi abasebasha kwi-UDM. Ngilindele ukuthi bangihlebele uma sebekulungele ukuthatha. Bazosho uma sebefuna ukuthatha."Khonamanjalo: I-PAC yethule umqulu wezethembiso zokhetho, eGoli, ngoMgqibelo.UMengameli wePAC, uMnuz Mzwanele Nyhontso, uthembise ukwenza izinguquko kwezobulungiswa uma benqoba ukhetho.UNyhontso uthe imithetho yakuleli iyaphambana namasiko akuleli."Imithetho yezwe kufanele ihambisane namasiko abantu bomdabu. Imithetho yezwe akufanele ihambisane nokwabamhlophe."UNyhontso uthe iPAC iyohlezi ibeka phambili izidingo zabantu bakuleli."Thina asifani ne-ANC. Kulo mqulu siyasibophezela ekufezeni izidingo zabantu bakithi."I-FF Plus yona ithe ifuna ukuqeda uhlelo lokunikezwa amathuba angcono kosomabhizinisi abamnyama iBEE, yathi iyaphikisana nohlelo lwezempilo olusha oluhlongozwayo iNational Health Insurance (NHI).
UZOYISEBENZISELA ukukhokhela ezinye izinto ezingakhokhelwa yisikhwama esixhasa izitshudeni, iNational Student Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS), imali anikwe yona oklonyeliswe wumasipala ngokuphasa kahle.UMalusi Nxele ongomunye wabafundi abaklonyeliswe wuMasipala uMhlathuze ngo-R10 000 emcimbini obuwenziwe yilo masipala wokuklomelisa abangu-20 abaphase kahle u-matric ngo-2023 abebefunda ezikoleni ezingaphansi kwalo masipala, nabafundi ababili abakhethe ukwenza izifundo ze-Electrical Engineering, ngosizo lwenkampani ekhuthaza ukuthi abafundi bafunde iScience, Technology, Engineering neMathematics (STEM). Abafundi abaklonyeliswe ngokuphasa kahle bathole imiklomelo engama-laptop, izitifiketi no-R6 000 wokubhalisa. UNxele owenza i-Electrical Engineering, eNyuvesi yaseZululand, ophikweni oluseRichards Bay, ubefunda eMangwe High, uthe ukufunda kwakhe kukhokhelwa yiNSFAS kodwa zikhona izinto okubuye kudingeke ukuthi zikhokhelwe umzali. Le mali izomsiza lapho.UMnuz Nkululeko Mbuyazi uthishanhloko waseMangwe, uthe kuyabajabulisa ukuthi umasipala ubone umsebenzi abawenzayo ngokuthi uklomelise abafundi."Isikole sethu siphase ngo-100%. Ukuze abafundi bethu bafunde izinto ezizobasiza, zisize nendawo abahlala kuyo, nyakenye siqale uhlelo lokufundisa iCoding & Robotics okuyizifundo ezisiza ekutheni zixazulule izinkinga kusetshenziswa ubuchwepheshe.Uthe ngokubambisana nenye yezinkampani, abafundi bakhe irobhothi elikutshelayo ukuthi uma unephepha ongasalidingi lifake kulo mgqomo."Inkinga yemfucuza elahlwa budlabha inkinga ekhona emphakathini, abafundi bafuna ukuyixazulula. Isikole sethu asigcini ngokufundisa abafundi bethu kuphela kodwa sisiza nabafundi baseDover Farm School nabaseZiphozonke High uma befuna ukwenza izifundo zeCoding neRobotics.IMeya yaseMhlathuze, uMnuz Xolani Ngwezi, ithe bakhuthaza ukuthi abafundi bafunde izifundo ezizobavulela amathuba omsebenzi khona endaweni."Sinezimboni ngakho kubalulekile ukuthi abafundi bafunde izifundo ezzaziwa ngeSTEM ngoba izimboni eziningi zidinga lawo makhono. Siyafisa isikole Amangwe High siqhubeke sibe yisikhungo esizofundisa ezinye izikole kusetshenziswa ezobuchwepheshe ngeCoding neRobotics,” kusho uNgwezi.

AYABALISA amakhosikazi asePulangweni, KwaMaphumulo, asesithenjini athi akhonjwe indlela ngumyeni wawo ongusomabhizinisi ethi unengwa ukuthi kukhulelwe ingane yakhe yentombazane eneminyaka engu-16.UNkk Zandile Mthembu (uMaMchunu) (40), noNkk Nomaswazi Mthembu (uMaMhlongo) (38) bakhala ngesenzo sikaMnuz Vukile Mthembu (50).Bobabili bathi basamangele kakhulu ngesenzo somyeni wabo. Uveze ukuthi ingane ekhulelwe yentombazane ngeyakhe.Uthi bona abazange bamazise uMthembu ngokukhulelwa kwendodakazi yakhe encane kodwa bakhetha ukuthi azibonele yena ngenxa yokuthi uyindoda enolaka."Ngesonto eledlule ubonile ukuthi u.....(egagula ingane ngegama) ukhulelwe. Uvele waduba ngisho ukudla wathetha waze wabomvu amehlo. Angikaze ngimbone ecasuke kanjena selokhu ngamazi. Yebo kubi ukukhulelwa kwengane encane kangaka kodwa ukuthi usengaze asixoshe pho,'' usho kanje sakubalisa.Uqhuba uthi ngakusasa ekuseni ubatshele ukuthi mabahambe, usazoke acabange kahle ukuthi uyawadinga yini amakhosikazi anganamsebenzi njengabo."Uthe singamakhosikazi ahlulekayo ukukhulisa umntwana, wathi kuhle siphindele emakithi. Ngikhuluma nawe nje nami ngikithi KwaNongoma,'' usho kanje.Uthi ubone kungcono ukuthi umtanakhe okhulelwe ahambe naye. Ukhale kakhulu ngolaka lomyeni wakhe wathi kusamele athi ukulwehlisa.Uveze ukuthi banengane eyodwa kuphela. Musa-ke ukungicasula ngoba uqala into ongeke uze uyimele,'' ethetha.Uthe uma kungukuthi amakhosikazi lawa agijime ayohlebela Isolezwe ngokuxoshwa kwawo, azokwenza kube nzima kakhulu kulesi simo abhekene naso ngoba kusho ukuthi awasile.Isolezwe Ngempelasonto litholile ukuthi uMthembu unezitolo. SIQALE ngegiya eliphezulu isigcawu esiqondisa ubugwegwe uMengameli wezimantshi KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Eric Nzimande.Isigcawu sihlelelwe ukuhlala kusukela ngoMashi 4 kuze kube nguMashi 15, nonyaka, eNkantolo yasePhoyinti eThekwini.UNzimande uthweswe amacala angu-162, awaphika wonke, okukhona awokugwazisa ngemali nangocansi abafuna izikhundla, ukugembula e-casino ngesikhathi somsebenzi namanye.IKhomishini yeziMantshi iyona eshushisa uNzimande phambi kweJaji uJeremiah Shongwe eselathatha umhlalaphansi.Ngokusho kuka-Advocate Sipikazi Poswa-Lerithole SC, ohola ithimba lekhomishini, bafuna uNzimande alahlwe ngawo wonke amacala athweswe wona.Lolu qweqwe lommeli luthi umvusi wenyamazane, uNkk Lindelwa Gumede owabika uNzimande kwikhomishini ngamacala okugwazisa ukuze ahambise igama lakhe kwiphini likaNgqogqoshe woMnyango wezobuLungiswa, uMnuz John Jeffreys, khona ezothola isikhundla sokuba yimantshi okwesikhashana.Kusolakala ukuthi uNkk Lindiwe wayencamela ukugwaza ngemali eyagcina isinguR140 000 ngoba egwema okwakufunwa uNzimande owayefuna azohlala emathangeni akhe bawotawotane, kukhulunywe ngocansi.UNkk Gumede kuthiwa wakhokha kwaguga iphakethe, kwathi esehluleka wavele wabika izinsolo ngoJulayi 2015.Kodwa ngo-2016, lo mmangali wawahoxisa amacala ayesebikwe nasemaphoyiseni ebhekiswe kuNzimande kodwa wama ekutheni akushilo esitatimendeni esifungelwe kuyiqiniso.Kuthiwa washenxa ngoba eshodelwa yimali yokuqhubeka necala. ZIBALELWA ku-161 iziguli okuqinisekiswe ukuthi zihlaselwe yisifo samehlo, uphenyane (pink eye), eThekwini.UMphathiswa wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Nomagugu Simelane, uthe iziguli ezingu-55 zihlonzwe esibhedlela iClairwood, ezingu-50 eKZN Children’s Hospital, ezingu-39 emtholampilo, iCato Manor Community Health Centre, ezingu-15 esibhedlela iMcCord kuthi ezimbili zihlonzwe eHalley Stott Clinic.Uthe uma unophenyane kuvuvukala untwentwesi olusobala olugudle iso kanye nenhlamvu yeso. Ngesikhathi seCovid-19 sasungula imikhuba eminingi ekhuthaza inhlanzeko njengokugeza izandla njalo ngensipho namanzi noma izihlanzi. Lezo ngezinye zezinto okumele sizijwayeze zona ezingagwema ukusabalala kophenyane,” kusho yena.Uthe ungakuvimbela ukuba neso elibomvana ngokuthi ungawathinti amehlo akho, ugeze izandla zakho njalo, ukusebenzisa ithawula elihlanzekile nendwangu yokugeza nsuku zonke. Ningasebenzisi amathawula noma izindwangu zokugeza ezizodwa nibe baningi, ukushintsha imicamelo yakho njalo, ukulahla izimonyo zamehlo ezindala ezifana ne-mascara nokugwema ukuzisebenzisa nomunye umuntu.Omunye wabahlengikazi, ongavumelekile ukukhuluma nabezindaba, uthe iziguli eziningi eziphethwe uphenyane yizingane zesikole. Kunzima ukululawula kuzona ngoba umgomo uthi akumele zisondelane nokungelula ngoba ngeke zingadlali, ezinye zigibela nezimoto zomalume ndawonye.

IBASE ingomane yomlilo i-DA ngodaba lokujutshwa kwamalungu e-ANC ezikhundleni zikahulumeni futhi ibukeka iwukhwezela kakhulu kunakuqala. I-DA isuse umsindo omkhulu ithi i-ANC kufanele ikhiphe onke amaminithi emihlangano yekomiti lokujutshwa kwabantu.Kuhlala kukhalwa emazingeni aphansi komasipala abantu bethi kuqashwa ngokuthi umuntu ukuyiphi inhlangano akubhekwa kakhulu ukuthi uneziqu noma umsebenzi uyawazi yini.Kamuva nje i-DA isanda kumemezela ukuthi iwusabalalisela ezifundazweni umkhankaso wayo wokulwa nomgomo wokujuba amalungu ezikhundleni. Ithe ifuna ukuthi kuvele indlela okujutshwa ngayo abantu kuhulumeni wezifundazwe nakomasipala.Ithe uma i-ANC igoloza ukuyinika imininingwane, izoya enkantolo iyoyiphoqa njengoba yenzile kuKhongolose kuzwelonke.I-DA ikhala ngokuthi uhlelo lokujuba amalungu ezikhundleni olwenziwa yi-ANC, yilona kanye oludala inkohlakalo. Ikhala nangokuthi kujutshwa abantu abasuke bengenawo amakhono nesipiliyoni esifanele. Ikhala nangokuthi uma sebefakiwe ezikhundleni basuke bezodansela isigingci se-ANC benze inkohlakalo.UMholi weDA uMnuz John Steenhuisen, uthe umgomo wokujuba amalungu amaqembu ezikhundleni udala inkinga." Abantu bakhethelwa ezikhundleni kubhekwa ukuthi baphethe amakhadi aliphi iqembu bese kuchithwa abasuke bazi umsebenzi. Uma wenza kanjalo usuke ubanga ukuthi abantu bakuleli babe nenkinga enkulu ngenxa yokuba nomuntu ongawazi umsebenzi nonomlando wenkohlakalo,’’ kusho uSteenhuisen.Uthe yingakho izwe libhekene nokucinywa kukagesi nokungasebenzi kahle kwezinkampani zikahulumeni. Uthe uma bengena emandleni, bayophasisa umthetho wokuthi uqedwe lo mkhuba wokujuba abantu ezikhundleni ngokwamaqembu.Kuyini ukujutshwa kwamalungu ezikhundleni ?Inhlangano uma ingenela ukhetho bese inqoba ukhetho ingena kuhulumeni, kube sekuba nesidingo sokuthi kuqashwe abantu kuhulumeni. Izikhundla eziqavile abafakwa kuzona ezifana nezezinhloko zeminyango namaphini azo. Izinhloko zezinkampani zikahulumeni nezinye izikhundla eziqavile. I-ANC yaphumela obala yasho ukuthi yona inekomiti elijuba abantu ezikhundleni futhi ikwenza lokhu ngoba isuke ifuna ukufaka abantu abaqonda kabanzi imigomo ye-ANC. UMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa wayilanda kabanzi indaba evele phambi kwekhomishini eyayiholwa yiJaji Raymond Zondo. URamaphosa wathi akukhona ukufaka amalungu kodwa basuke bewagqugquzela ukuthi awafake izicelo nawo azobhekwa uma sekubhekwa abantu. URamaphosa wakuphika ukuthi inenkohlakalo indlela abajuba ngayo amalungu.URamaphosa watshela ikhomishini ukuthi abantu abasuke bebaphakamisela ezikhundleni basuke benawo wonke amakhono afunekayo, iziqu nesipiliyoni.Izinsolo ezibekwe kuyona i-DAI-DA ngesikhathi imatasa ikhwezela umlilo oshisa i-ANC, kuvumbuke izinsolo zokuthi nayo inawo amakomiti ajuba abantu ezikhundleni kodwa izenza ngcono. UMengameli we-ANC uRamaphosa ukhale kakhulu ngeDA ethi iyaxokiza ngoba nayo iyakwenza lokhu esola ngakho i-ANC.Kuvumbuke ababengabaholi beDA asebashiya kuyona bethi nayo inalo ikomiti elijuba abantu ezikhundleni lapho esuke iphethe khona. UMengameli we-ActionSA uMnuz Herman Mashaba uthe i-DA iyamangaza ngalokhu ekushoyo." Kufanele siyivimbe indaba yokuthi amaqembu ajube abantu ezikhundleni. I-DA yake yakuzama lokhu ngesikhathi ngiseyimeya kodwa kwasho ukuthi ngiyanqaba mina,’’ kusho uMashaba.UMnuz Zwakele Mncwango we-ActionSA oke waba kwiDA naye uke wabhala eyichitha indaba yesikhalo seDA ngalolu daba.UMnuz Dulton Adams we-ACDP uthe lolu daba kudlalwa ngalo ipolitiki njengamanje.USolwazi Kedibone Phako ekhuluma nabe-eNCA uthe kuyahlekisa okwenziwa yiDA ngoba nayo inawo lo mgomo njengoba ixake i-ANC." Uma ubheka lapho bephethe khona eCape Town, eTshwane neCity of Johannesburg bebezama ukuphusha osopolitiki babo ukuthi bangene ezikhundleni zokuphatha. Lokho kukodwa kudunga isimo sokusebenza kulabo abasuke bebekwe ezikhundleni,’’ kusho uPhako.Lo msindo okhona ukhomba ukuthi kusafanele kubhekwe kabanzi ukuthi awukho yini umthetho okufanele uphasiswe ukulawula indlela okufanele kwenziwe ngayo. Udaba lokuqashwa kwabantu lubaluleke kakhulu kuleli njengoba kushoda amathuba emisebenzi.Kungenzeka ukuthi baningi abaphuthwa wumsebenzi ngenxa yokuthi abawona amalungu amaqembu ezepolitiki kodwa bebe benazo zonke izimfanelo.
NKOSIKHONA CELEUKHUTHAZA abefundisi ukuba bangazitheli ngabandayo kodwa bahambe bayothekela ulwazi ezikoleni zebhayibheli, uMbhishobhi Thamsanqa Ngidi ongumholi webandla, iDwala Lokuphila.UNgidi onguRector wekolishi iRock Bible College (RBC), uthi kuyamkhulisa kakhulu emqondweni umfundisi ukuya emakolishi."Kuningi okuhle abefundisi abakuzuzayo ngokuya ekolishi lebhayibheli. Izikhathi seziguqukile manje akusefani nakuqala. Manje kuyadinga ukuba umfundisi aye esikoleni,'' kukhuthaza uNgidi.Ugcizelele kakhulu ukuthi ukufunda akukhethi ibala, nabulili. Wathi yingakho bekhuthaza nabefundisi besifazane ukuthi bangalenzi iphutha lokuthi bahudule izinyawo, uma kukhulunywa ngokuya emakolishi ezebhayibheli."Kuyadingeka ukuthi abefundisi besifazane nabo singabashiyi ngaphandle uma sikhuluma ngokuyothekela ulwazi ezikoleni zebhayibheli,'' usho kanje uMbhishobhi.UNgidi uqhube wathi ukholwa ukuthi indlela yokuziphatha kubefundisi abaye ekolishi iyehluka ngoba basuke sebehlome ngolwazi olwengeziwe ngaphezulu. Wathi ngenxa yaleso sizathu uyabakhuthaza ukuba baye esikoleni.UMbhishobhi ugcizelele ukuthi ufisa ukusibona sikhula isibalo sabefundisi baseZayoni, abaya esikoleni. Lokho uthe ukholwa ukuthi kungalithuthukisa kakhulu ibandla libonakale lidlondlobala ngezindlela ezahlukene."Kungaba yinto enhle kakhulu ukubona senyuka isibalo sabefundisi baseZayoni, abathekela ulwazi emakolishi. Lokho kungachaza ukuthi sizokuba namabandla aseZayoni aholwa ngendlela enobuqotho nenenqubekela phambili,’’ usho kanje uNgidi.Wengeza ngokuthi nezinto ezingamahlazo okuvamise ukuthi kutholakale abefundisi bebandakanyeka kuzona, zingagwemeka kalula nazo.Ukhulume nangendumezulu yenkonzo yePhasika, ehlelwa yibandla wathi izosukela ngoMashi 29, iphume ngomhlaka-31. Iyobe isesakhiweni sebandla lama-Afrika, eLovu.

INYUNYANA yothisha iNational Teachers’ Union (Natu) isinxuse abazali namalungu emiphakathi eyahlukene ukuba baqinisekise ukuthi bayalibamba iqhaza ekukhethweni kwezigungu ezilawula ukuphathwa kwezikole.Lokhu kushiwo uNobhala Jikelele weNatu, uMnuz Doctor Ngema, esitatimendeni asithumele abezindaba.Ukhetho lwezigungu ezilawula ukuphathwa kwezikole kuqalwe ngoLwesihlanu, kanti kulindeleke ukuthi kuqhubeke yonke le nyanga.Izigungu ezilawula ukuphathwa kwezikole ezisemandleni njengamanje, zizogcina ekupheleni kwenyanga (Mashi 31), bese kungena ezintsha okuqhubeka ukukhethwa kwazo njengamanje."INatu ikushayela ihlombe ukusebenza ngokuzikhandla kwezigungu esezibeka phansi izintambo njengamanje,” kusho uNgema.Uqhube wathi bona bengothisha bazimisele ukusebenza ngokubambisana nezigungu ezintsha njengoba lokho kulima indima enkulu emfundweni yabafundi."Njengoba luqalile uhlelo lokukhethwa kwezigungu zezikole ngoLwesihlanu, sinxusa abazali ukuthi baphume ngobuningi babo ukuyovotela izigungu ezintsha,” kusho uNgema.Uphethe ngelithi, abazali ngesikhathi bevota, kufanele bakubeke emqondweni ukuthi okubaluleke kunakho konke ukuthi babeke imfundo yabantwana babo phambili."Bakhethe abantu abababonayo ukuthi bazokwazi ukusebenzisana kahle nothishanhloko nothisha, kungabi abantu abanezinhloso eziphambene nomthetho,” kusho uNgema.
SELUSHINTSHILE usuku obekufanele kulalelwe ngalo icala lombango wophawu lweqembu uMkhonto weSizwe, elizoba seNkantolo eNkulu eThekwini. UMkhonto weSizwe kwakungumbutho wezempi we-ANC owasungulwa ngoDisemba 1961.Kuhambe, kwahamba wahlakazwa ngoDisemba 1993, izwe selizongena kuhulumeni wentando yabantu.I-ANC imangalele uMkhonto weSizwe iwusola ngokusebenzisa uphawu lwayo ngaphandle kwemvume. IMK yiqembu elisha elethulwe ngoDisemba lesekwa ngowayengumengameli uMnuz Jacob Zuma.Akwehlanga kahle lokhu kwi-ANC ekhale ngokuthi kwebiwe igama nophawu konke okungokwayo. Amacala afakwe yi-ANC ahlukene kabili, kukhona umbango wophawu nokuyicala ebelizongena ngoLwesithathu ngoMashi 6. Yilona leli elihlehlele kuMashi 27 nonyaka.Okhulumela iMK, uMnuz Nhlamulo Ndhlela uthe isinqumo sokuhlehlisa icala sithathwe ngokuvumelana kwezinhlangothi zonke."Sibe nomhlangano nomphathi wamajaji nabameli be-ANC, savumelana ukuthi sihlehlise ukuze zonke izinhlangothi zinikwe ithuba elanele,’’ kusho uNdhlela.Icala lesibili yilelo elifakwe eNkantolo yezoKhetho, eBloemfontein elimayelana nokubhaliswa koMkhonto weSizwe kwi-IEC. Leli cala lesibili lona libekelwe uMashi 19, elizongena ngawo enkantolo.UNdhlela uthe beyiMK bazobe begcwele kuwo wonke amacala bezokweseka abameli babo beqinisekise ukuthi bayanqoba. IMK ibinemashi enkulu eThekwini, lapho ibikhala khona ngokusweleka kwezidingo zomphakathi isola umasipala ngokungenzi kahle.

NKOSIKHONA CELENJALO uma kunemiphumela emihle kamatric, kunconywa abafundi bodwa othisha bazitshwe. Lesi yisikhalo esizwakaliswe yiMeya yaKwaDukuza, uNkk Lindile Nhaca, ngesikhathi lo masipala unomcimbi wokuklonyeliswa kothisha bezikole ezenze kahle kumatric ka-2023 ngoLwesihlanu KwaDukuza Town Hall.Uthe inkulu indima eklanywa wothisha emiphumeleni emihle kamatric KwaDukuza. SIBEKELWE izinsuku ezine isigcawu sokuquliswa kweJaji Tshifhiwa Maumela, elaphucwa amandla okulalela icala lokubulawa kukaSenzo Meyiwa, owayengunozinti we-Orlando Pirates, neBafana Bafana. UMaumela umiswe emsebenzi ngoJuni nyankenye, esolwa ngokuthatha isikhathi eside kakhulu ukukhipha izinqumo emacaleni.Kuhlala udaba lukaMaumela nje, kusanda kuphuma isinqumo sokuthi obenguMengameli wamaJaji eWestern Cape, iJaji John Hlophe neJaji Nkola Motala baketulwe. UHlophe ulahlwe yicala lokuzama ukucubuzela uMnuz Jacob Zuma, amagabade kwamanye amajaji. UMotala ulahlwe yicala lokushayela ephuzile nokudala ingozi ngokuhloma imoto odongeni. Kulindeleke ukuthi udaba lukaMaumela luhlalelwe ngamajaji amathathu azolalela isikhalo, nobufakazi bese eyanquma.UMaumela uzoquliswa wuhlaka olubizwa ngeJudicial Conduct Tribunal, olubhekele ukuziphatha kwamajaji nolunamandla okuwaqulisa uma kunezikhalo ngawo. Isikhalo safakwa nguMengameli wamaJaji eGauteng, iJaji Dunstan Mlambo.Incwadi yokumiswa kwakhe yabe isikhishwa ngokusemthethweni nguMengameli wezwe uCyril Ramaphosa, ngokwamandla akhe awanikwa wumthethosisekelo.UMaumela wayehlalele icala lokubulawa kukaMeyiwa ngesikhathi emiswa emsebenzini kwase kuqokwa iJaji Ratha Makgoatlhleng, elibuyiswe selidla endala.Akamiswanga yedwa uMaumela akamiswanga kodwa neJaji uNomonde Mngqibisa - Thusi lamiswa futhi belihamba isigcawu kulezi zinsuku ezedlule. Abaphethe isigcawu bathumele isitatimende bazisa abezindaba ukuthi isithangami sikaMaumela sizoqala kule nyanga.Kuvela ukuthi isithangami sizoqala ngoMashi 18 kuya ku-20 siphinde singene ngoMashi 22. IJaji Makgoatlheng elathatha icala lokufa kukaMeyiwa yilona elisaqhubeka namanje ecelani.Kulindeleke ukuthi icala lokufa kukaMeyiwa, libuyele eNkantolo eNkulu eTshwane ngoMsombuluko. Icala liguqiswe ngenyanga edlule emuva kokuthi izinhlangothi ezimbili, uMbuso nabameli besonge ubufakazi babo.Icala lisesigabeni lapho kubangwa khona ukuthi izitatimende zokuvuma amacala okuthiwa zasayinwa abamangalelwa, kufanele yini zamukelwe njengobufakazi enkantolo.Abamangalelwa bayawaphika wonke amacala ababekwe wona bathi bashawa ngamaphoyisa abavumisa icala futhi abasayinisa ngenkani izitatimende. Kulindeleke ukuthi uma libuya icala kwenziwe izethulo zokugcina bese kuhsiyela kulona ijaji ukuthi linqume.
UMNUZ Tony Forbes, onguyise womrepha ongasekho u-AKA, uthi akakagezeki igilo engakamboni ubhongoza okhipha imali eyiziduli zabasali ekhokhela abamangalelwa nabameli babo. U-AKA igama lakhe langempela okunguKiernan Forbes, wadutshulwa wabulawa ngoFebhruwari 10 nyakenye, endaweni yokudla iWish kuFlorida, eThekwini. Isilomo esingu-AKA sabulawa nomngani waso uTebello " Tibz” Motsoane.Isigameko sokudutshulwa kwabo esashiya abaningi bekhexile, saqoshwa yikhamera sasabalala yonke indawo. Bekulokhu kuvela imibiko yokuthi amaphoyisa ayababopha abantu kodwa wona akuphike lokho.UForbes uxoxe nabezindaba eNkantolo yeMantshi eThekwini, lapho obekuvele khona abamangalelwa ababoshelwe izinsolo zokuqeda ngendodana yakhe. Utheleke enkantolo ehamba namadoda afake amasudi nezibuko zelanga ezimnyama ebukeka njengabaqaphi.Uthe okokuqala nje, kuyamcika ukuthi abamangalelwa bazifihle ubuso ngoba kufanele babonwe yizwe lonke."Kufanele kube khona into eyenziwayo ngendaba yokuthi uma umuntu evele enkantolo phambi kwabantu azifihle ubuso. Nginethemba khona ngokuthi siyasondela eqinisweni kodwa angikholwa wukuthi ubhongoza oqale yonke le nto useboshiwe,’’ kusho uForbes.UForbes ukhulume kanje nje, abasolwa baqale bangena bezimbozile kodwa inkantolo yabuye yabayalela ukuthi baziveze. Uthe kusafanele kuvele ukuthi imali yayisukaphi ngoba yanikwa ummangalelwa okunguyena owakhokhela abanye."Kunemali eyanikwa umdidiyeli wabo, yayisuka kuphi yona? Uma yangena ebhange kufanele amaphoyisa alandele lapho ukuthi yayisukaphi,’’ kusho uForbes.Abamangalelwa oMnuz Lindokuhle Thabani Mkhwanazi (30), Lindani Zenzele Ndimande (35), Siyanda Eddie Myeza (21), Mziwethemba Harvey Gwabini (36) noLindokuhle Ndimande (29). Bonke bavele enkantolo bathweswa amacala ayishumi esewonke.UNdimande (Lindani) noGwabini bamelwe u-Advocate Paul Jorgensen ojwayele ukubonakala emele osomatekisi kanti wake waqokwa nangumholi we-ANC, uMnuz Mike Mabuyakhulu, amacaleni ayebhekene nawo kodwa achithwa yinkantolo. UMkhwanazi umelwe uMnuz Dlamini kanti uMyeza noNdimande Lindokuhle) bamelwe uNksz Gielink. Ngokuthola kweSolezwe, abanye o-advocate babiza uR50 000 kuya phezulu ngosuku ukumela amakhasimende abo. Abanye abamangalelwa ababili kusafanele babuyiswe kuleli emuva kokuthi beboshwe eSwatini, lapho okuthiwa bebecashe khona. Ngaphandle kwecala lokufa kuka-AKA laba balisa babuye bayamaniswe namanye.UForbes uthe indaba yokufa kwendodana yakhe iyisilonda esingapholi ngoba namanje umndeni usakhala. Uthe kunzima nokuyixoxa nendokazi yakhe umufi ngoba ayazi okwamanje ukuthi kwenzekani.Umkhuzi wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, uthe kuyakhathaza ukuthi abamangalelwa baqhamuka nabameli bezinga eliphezulu. UMkhawanazi uthe yinto abahlala beyixoxa nezikhulu zakhe ukuthi iyakhathaza."Iyinkinga le nto ngoba kwesinye isikhathi, kuboshwa umuntu ongasebenzi ongenamali kodwa aqashe ummeli ophezulu. Kufanele sizibuze ukuthi laba bameli basuke beze ngokuzobamela ngesihle noma ngemali,’’ kusho uMkhwanazi.
Isosha lakuleli lidubule uzakwabo ngaphambi kokuzibulala ngesibhamu somsebenzi eDemocratic Republic of Congo (DRC) ngoLwesine.Amasosha eSouth African National Defence Force (Sandf) ajutshwe eDRC njengengxenye ye-United Nations Organisation Stabilisation Mission in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Munusco).UNgqongqoshe wezokuVikela uNkk Thandi Modise uzwakalise ukushaqeka ngalesi sigameko.I-Sandf isisungule ibhodi elizophenya lisebenzisana neMunsco ukuthola ngokuholele kulesi sigameko.Kwenzeka lokhu nje, ngenyanga edlule kufe amanye amasosha amabili aseNingizimu Afrika ngesikhathi kuqhunyiswa inkambu yawo khona eDRC. Kukesi sigameko kwalimala amanye amathathu.Ekuqaleni kwenyanga edlule kuhlaselwe indiza enophephela emhlane yeSANDF khona eDRC ngesikhathi isuka eRwindi ilibangise eGoma.Kwalimala umshayeli wayo owadubuleka emunweni nomunye wosizo lokuqala owalimala esifubeni. Abanye ababephakathi abalimalanga kanti indiza yakwazi ukufika kahle eGoma, ngokusho kweSANDF ngaleso sikhathi.
UBEKWE okwesikhashana ezandleni zamanyuvesi kuleli umsebenzi wokukhokha imihlomulo yezitshudeni ezixhaswe yisikhwama sezimali iNational Students’ Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS). Lokhu kuvezwe yisitatimende esikhishwe yilesi sikhwama esiveze ukuthi lo msebenzi unikwe lezi zikhungo ukuthi zikhokhele izitshudeni le mihlomulo kusuka ngenyanga edlule uFebhuwari kuze kube ile nyanga, uMashi.Isitatimende sithe lokhu kwenziwe ngenxa yezinselelo ezibekhona ekuqaleni konyaka ezibambezele ukukhokhelwa kwezitshudeni ngenxa yokuthi kunemininingwane amanyuvesi abengakayihambisi kwiNSFAS."Amanyuvesi anikwe izinyanga ezimbili (Febhuwari noMashi) ukukhokha le mihlomulo, ngo-Ephreli 2024 kuzobe sekubuyela izinkampani ezine ebezenza lo msebenzi nyakenye. Lezi zinkampani zizobe zikhokhela ngqo izitshudeni le mihlomulo kusuka ngenyanga ezayo,” kusho iNSFAS.Lesi sikhwama sithe izitshudeni zasemanyuvesi zikhokhelwe ekupheleni kwenyanga edlule uFebhuwari, sathi ezasemakolishi amakhono zizokhokhelwa ngoMashi 6, 2024. "Sinxusa izitshudeni ukuthi zibambisane nezikhungo ukuze kungabi nokuphazamiseka ekukhokhweni kwale mihlomulo. Izikhungo zinxuswa ukuthi ziqhubeke nokunikeza lesi sikhwama imininingwane yezitshudeni.”Lesi sikhwama sinxuse izikhungo ukuthi zixhumane nezisebenzi zalesi sikhwama ezijutshwe ezikhungweni ezehlukene. Emhlanganweni wekomiti lemfundo ephakeme ePhalamende ngoLwesithathu, amalungu abuze ukuthi kungani kuzoqhubeka lezi zinkampani ezine ukukhokha le mihlomulo ekubeni umbiko wethimba labameli abenza uphenyo, baphakamisa ukuthi kumele ziphucwe lo msebenzi.UMqondisi jikelele eMnyangweni weMfundo ePhakeme nokuQeqesha uDkt Nkosinathi Sishi, uveze ukuthi zikhona izinhlelo zokuthi lezi zinkampani ziphucwe umsebenziUthe ngokomthetho awumane nje uvuke unqamule inkontileka ngoba kusuke kunezinto ezithinta umthetho.USishi uveze ukuthi izikhungo zikujabulele ukuthi kubuyiselwe kuzona uhlelo lokuthi zikhokhe imihlomulo njengoba zazingafuni phambilini ukuphucwa leli qatha."Lezi zikhungo zazingafuni ukuphucwa umsebenzi wokukhokha imihlomulo nokukhokha imali yezindawo zokuhlala kwasekuqaleni ngakho ziyajabula ukuthi zibuyiselwe okwesikhashana ukuthi ziwenze. Ngihlanganile nenhlangano emele abaphathi bamanyuvesi i-Usaf, yavuma ukuthi izowenza ngempumelelo umsebenzi wokukhokha imihlomulo.”USishi uthe uyazi ukuthi iNSFAS ibisafuna umbono wezomthetho ngokunqanyulwa kwezinkontileka zalezi zinkampani wathi lokhu isikwenzile ngakho ekugcineni izinkontileka zizonqanyulwa."Esingakufuni ngukuthi kuphazamiseke ukukhokhwa kwemihlomulo yezitshudeni. Yingakho sibuyisele ezikhungweni ukuthi zilwenze lolu hlelo ukuze izitshudeni zingalindi umlibe ,” kusho uSishi.Izitshudeni ezikhungweni ezehlukene okubalwa i-UKZN ne-DUT zibe nombhikisho zikhala ngokucotha kohlelo lokukhokhwa kwemihlomulo okuhlanganisa nezinkinga ngohlelo lweNSFAS nezindawo zokuhlala kulabo abaxhaswayo.

Kule ndawo yethu umgwaqo mubi kuke kungahambi lutho ngenxa yesimo sawo. Lokho kusitshela ukuthi izingane zethu zizoba nezinsuku zokungayi esikoleni ngenxa yalesi simo,.
