INKANTOLO ibigcwele ichichima Isithombe: SIBONELO NGCOBO/INDEPENDENT MEDIAUmsolwa wesithathu, uMyeza obedle ngokuba mncane ngomzimba, ubegqoke isikibha esinemikhono emifishane se-Nike esinembobo ngemumva.Umsolwa wesine, uGwabini obebukeka eyincwasimende, ubeshaye ibhantshi lesudi, isikibha ne-jean.Kuthi uNdimande (Lindokuhle) yena efake i-jean ekhanyayo, nejakhethi emnyama, abedlubhe nesigqoko sayo.Ezinyaweni bonke bebegqoke ophaqa. Bebengabukeki bethukile futhi bebengalokhu beqalaza izethameli.Kubuye kwaqapheleka nokuthi bebelokhu bewagobise njalo amakhanda, bencisha ubuso abemithombo yezindaba abebehlome beyizingovolo ngamakhamera namaselula.Emva kokuthatha ikhefu lesikhashana, iMantshi uMnuz Vincent Hlatshwayo, ibuye ingasagayelwe mphako, ibuza ukuthi yisiphi isizathu esiqinile esiholele ekutheni abasolwa bazifihle ubuso phambi kwenkantolo?UHlatshwayo uthe akasazi isizathu sokuzifihla kwabo njengoba lungeke lubekhona uhlelo lokukhonjwa kwabasolwa oluzokwenziwa.Bagcine bezisusa izigqoko abebezigqokile abanye, baphinde bakhumula nezifonyo.
I-ANC iyiphika ima ngomhlane eyokuthi njalo uma kuzoba nokhetho ifudumeza izethembiso ezindala eyazenza kubantu njengoba nomqulu wayo ugidagida ezintweni ezizodwa, osekuneminyaka ezinye zazo zingenzeki.Le nhlangano ithe izethembiso eyazenza kubantu ngeke izishintshe noma kungathiwa kunezinguquko esezikhona kulowo mkhakha.Iphini likasihlalo wekomiti elibhekele izinguquko kwezomnotho kwi-ANC, uMnuz Zuko Godlimpi, utshele abezindaba esithangamini ngoLwesine, ukuthi labo abathi ayikho into entsha emqulwini wezethembiso zokhetho bakhuluma into engekho. Umqulu wezethembiso uthulwe uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ngempelasonto enkundleni yemidlalo iMoses Mabhida eThekwini.Uthe abaningi bathi i-ANC imane yafudumeza izethembiso ezindala akukho okusha okuvezwe iyona okuzoyisa izwe phambili."Uma ubheka umqulu we-ANC sisakhuluma ngezinto esazithembisa, ezifaka ukwakha amathuba emisebenzi, ezemfundo, ezempilo nezinye izethembiso. Imfundo namanje sisayibeke phambili noma kungathiwa kukhona abafunda mahhala kodwa nangomuso sizoqhubeka sikhulume ngokubeka phambili imfundo.” Uthe naseminyakeni engu-30 ezayo, le nhlangano izobe isagqamisa cishe izinto ezifanayo emqulwini wayo wezokhetho njengoba sekuphele iminyaka engu-30.Abahlaziyi bezepolitiki kanjalo namaqembu amaningi bayawuchitha umqulu we-ANC, bathi akukho okusha njengoba nezethembiso ezithinta ukwakha amathuba emisebenzi zigcina zingafezekanga.UGodlimpi uthe nakulo mqulu bathembise ukwakha amathuba emisebenzi angu-2.5 million, kubantu bakuleli."Lokhu sizokwenza ngokuthi kube nezimboni. Sidinga ukuba nogesi owenele ukuze sikwazi ukwenza lokhu. Indaba kagesi iyalungiswa.” Usihlalo waleli komiti, uNksz Mmamoloko Kubayi, uvikele uNgqongqoshe wezikaGesi, uMnuz Kgosientsho "Sputla" Ramokgopa, wathi usebenza ngokuzikhandla emkhakheni ajutshwe kuwona.Uthe njalo uyahlangana naleli komiti alichazele ngebanga elihanjiwe ukuxazulula le nkinga kagesi.Uveze ukuthi nomphakathi uyaziswa ngokuthi ugesi uzocishwa nini nokuthi isimo sawo singase sibuyele nini endaweni ejwayelekile."Kukhona nabanye abathi singongqongqoshe be-ANC asenziwa lutho uma singasebenzi. Ngiyakuchitha lokhu, selokhu ngajutshelwa emnyangweni wezokuhlaliswa kwabantu sengiphendula kabili ngengikwenzayo emnyangweni. Akulona iqiniso ukuthi asenziwa lutho ngokungazihambisi izidingo emphakathini.” Uveze ukuthi ziningi izinto esezenziwe eminyakeni engu-30 edlule kuleli.
NGOSUKU lwesithathu abasebenzi bakaMasipala weTheku bechitha udoti emigwaqweni ngoba bekhala ngokuhola imali encane, umasipala umemezele ukuthi usuthole incwadi yasenkantolo evimbela laba basebenzi ukuba bateleke.Abasebenzi baseThekwini baqale ukuteleka ngoLwesibili (27 Febhuwari) ngoba bethi imiholo yabo ayilingani neyozakwabo abasebenza kwabanye omasipala abakhulu.Bathe amaholo abo ashoda ngo-R3 000 emalini etholwa ozakwabo abenza umsebenzi ofanayo kwabanye omasipala abakhulu.Esitatimendeni esithunyelwe kwabezindaba, uMasipala weTheku uthe uthole incwadi evimbela abasebenzi ukuba bateleke ngoba efuna ukugcina abantu bephephile nokuvikela ingqalasizinda.Uzwakalise ukuthi ukhathazekile ngodlame, ukusatshiswa kwabantu nokucekelwa phansi kwengqalasizinda okwenziwa ngabasebenzi abatelekile.Incwadi yasenkantolo, ivimbela abasebenzi abatelekile futhi abangamalungu eSouth African Municipal Workers Union (Samwu), ukuba baphazamise ozakwabo abasebenzayo nokuthi baphule umthetho.Iyabavimba ukuthi basabise noma bahlasele abangatelekile futhi kuthiwe abaqhubeka nokusabisa abanye, nokuceleka phansi impahla yokusebenza bazoqondiswa ubugwegwe.Kuyalelwe abasebenzi ukuthi balandele okubhalwe ezinkontilekeni zabo. Bayalelwe ukuba bangavimbi izimoto zikamasipala futhi bangabeki engcupheni ukuphepha kwezakhamuzi zeTheku nabanye abasebenzi. Abaphambana nale miyalelo bazoqondiswa ubugwegwe.Umasipala uthe azikho izikhalo osuzitholile ezivela kwiSamwu kodwa yaphakamisa ukuthi iTheku kufanele lingabe lisakleliswa esigabeni sesishiyagalombili kodwa likleliswe esigabeni sika-10, ukuze amaholo abasebenzi ahambisane nawozakwabo abasebenzela omasipala abakhulu.Uthe uyahambisana nokuxazulula zonke izikhalo zabasebenzi eziphakanyiswa ngendlela efanele elandela umthetho.Uphethe ngokuthi usunxuse amaphoyisa ukuba abophe abaphula umthetho, nabahlukumeza abantu abasebenzisa imigwaqo yeTheku.Ngeminye imibuzo Isolezwe liyalelwe ukuba lifunde isitatimende sokuthi umasipala uthole incwadi evimbela isiteleka.Izolo Isolezwe libone abasebenzi abatelekile eSpringfield kodwa bebengafuni ukukhuluma nezintatheli bezisabisa ngokuzishaya.Baqhubekile abasebenzi abatelekile nokuvimba imigwaqo yeTheku ngokusaphaza udoti, isihlabathi nenye imfucuza, phezu kokuba umasipala esethole incwadi evimbela isiteleka.UMnuz Siyabonga Dladla onguSihlalo weSamwu eThekwini, uthe bazohlala phansi namalungu abo ukuze bahlahle indlela eya phambili ngalolu daba lwencwadi evimbela isiteleka.Uthe akusilo iqiniso ukuthi umasipala akazazi izikhalo zabo ngoba ngoSepthemba ngonyaka odlule bamashela umasipala bashiya nohlu lwezikhalo. Uveze ukuthi namanje bamazisile ukuthi abaneme ngodaba lokukleliswa kweTheku esigabeni sesishiyagalombili.UNksz Queen Mbatha oyiPhini likaMengameli we-Independent Municipal and Allied Trade Union (Imatu), obuye abe nguSihlalo wayo eThekwini, uthe ayisiyo ingxenye yesiteleka."Amalungu e-Imatu ayasebenza kodwa inkinga wukuthi awaphephile. Siwubhalele umasipala siwazisa ngalokhu ngoba amalungu ethu akhishwa ngisho ezimotweni zikamasipala uma eyosebenza. Asazi ukuthi isiteleka ngesani, asihlangene naso. Siyafisa kuqiniswe umthetho njengoba sekunencwadi evimbela isiteleka. Abaphula umthetho mababoshwe,” kusho uNksz Mbatha.
UKUPHINDILE lokho esinda kwesinye isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bakhe uSomlomo woMasipala waseThekwini, uMnuz Thabani Nyawose.UNyawose ubebhekane nesiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bakhe emhlanganweni womkhandlu obungoLwesine.Isiphakamiso besifakwe yikhansela le-IFP, uMnuz Mzwethu Gwala, okhale ngokuthi uNyawose uyehluleka ukwenza umsebenzi wakhe.Isiphakamiso sikaGwala sichithiwe emva kokuthi amakhansela amaningi ephikisene naso.Isiphakamiso sivotelwe amakhansela angu-74, kwathi angu-108 avotela ukuba sichithwe.UGwala uthe abagculisekile ngomsebenzi owenziwa uNyawose."Sekuphele iminyaka emibili sakhethwa kodwa amanye amakhansela awakaze ahlinzekwe ngamahhovisi. Emihlanganweni asivunyelwa ukukhuluma ngokukhululeka. Imihlangano idonsa kuze kube sebusuku. Lena into entsha eThekwini. Usomlomo uchemile.”Ikhansela leDA, uMnuz Thabani Mthethwa, lithe uNyawose uyehluleka ukuphatha imihlangano yemikhandlu."UNyawose ungusomlomo womasipala oyisizinda somnotho. Ukwehluleka kwakhe ukulawula imihlangano yomkhandlu kuphazamisa ukuhanjiswa kwezidingo. Lokhu asikusho ngoba nakhu simzonda uNyawose. Uma ngingakhuluma iqiniso, asinankinga noNyawose, kodwa angeke sakufihla ukuthi uyehluleka ukulawula imihlangano yomkhandlu.”Ikhansela le-ANC, uMnuz Nkosenhle Madlala, lithe basajabule ngomsebenzi owenziwa uNyawose."Sibona sengathi lena yimizamo yokuphazamisa ukusebenza komkhandlu. Lokhu kuyishwa njengoba sihlalelwe umsebenzi omkhulu wokuthuthukiswa impilo yabantu. Njengoba sihleli lapha sikhokhelwa imali eshisiwe ukube sithuthukise impilo yabantu kodwa kubukeka sengathi thina sizimisele ngokulwela izikhundla. Lokhu ngikusho ngoba kuke kwafakwa isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bemeya. Emva kwalokho, kwabe sekufakwa isiphakamiso sokuthi kuhlakazwe umkhandlu. Nakhu sesibona kufakwa isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bukasomlomo.”Ikhansela le-NFP, uNksz Zandile Myeni, lisole amaqembu aphikisayo ngokudlala ipolitiki."Lesi siphakamiso sifakwe abantu nje abazama ukukhankasa. Iqiniso ukuthi njengamanje sibheke okhethweni. Ayikho into ebambekayo kulesi siphakamiso. Ingakho thina njenge-NFP sisibona njengemizamo yokuvimba ukuthi siye phambili.”Bekungekhona okokuqala uNyawose ebhekene nesiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bakhe.Ngonyaka owedlule, waphunyula ngesikhathi kuchithwa isiphakamiso sokungabethembi ubuholi bakhe.Umkhandlu usanda kuchitha isiphakamiso sokuba kukhishwe iMeya yomkhandlu, uMnuz Mxolisi Kaunda, nesokuba kuhlakazwe umkhandlu.
OSOMABHIZINISI bajabule ngokuqokwa kwesikhulu esiphezulu eTransnet.NgoLwesine inhlangano yosomabhizinisi, iBusiness Unity South Africa, ithe ukuqokwa kukaNkk Michelle Phillips njengesikhulu esiphezulu eTransnet kuzosiza le nkampani ukuba ikwazi ukuba nozinzo.UNkk Phillips ubekade ebambile kulesi sikhundla kanti kuleli sonto uNgqongqoshe wamaBhizinisi kaHulumeni, uMnuz Pravin Gordhan, uye wamqoka njengesikhulu esiphezulu. Ubuye waqoka uNkk Nosipho Maphumulo njengesikhulu esiphethe izimali zaseTransnet.UMengameli weBusa, uMnuz Mxolisi Mgojo, uthe ukuqokwa kwalaba baholi kusho ukuthi kuzoba nozinzo eTransnet."Sesisebenze noNkk Phillips izinyanga eziyisithupha njengoba besilungisa ezokuthutha. Ngimbonile ukuthi uwumuntu othanda ukulungisa isimo futhi okholelwa ekwenzeni kunokukhuluma kakhulu. Unesipiliyoni seminyaka ewu-20 ngakho ngimbona ewumuntu ozokwazi ukukhipha iTransnet kulezi zinkinga ebhekene nazo,” kusho uMgojo.Uthe uNkk Phillips uyakwazi okufunwa wosomabhizinisi nohulumeni ukuze kulungiswe ezokuthutha.Ubalule ukuthi ukwazile ukwehlisa isiminyaminya samakhonteyna eThekwini nemikhumbi ebilinde ukungena echwebeni.Wathi ukuqokwa kwakhe kusho ukuthi ngeke uphazamiseke umsebenzi akade ewuqalile wokushintsha isimo.Uthembise ukuthi osomabhizinisi bazobeseka ubuholi obusha eTransnet ngoba bafuna izwe lisebenze.Uveze ukuthi ukungasebenzi kahle kwamaguzu namachweba kulahlekisela izwe ngoR1 billion ngosuku. Umkhakha wezimayini ngonyaka odlule ulahlekelwe wuR50 billion ngenxa yalesi simo.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi Isolezwe libike ukuthi i-Anglo Platinum izodiliza abasebenzi abawu-3 712, ikhala ngokungasebenzi kahle kwamaguzu afanele ukuthutha umkhiqizo wayo osuka ezimayini uye echwebeni. Nokungasebenzi kahle kwamachweba akuleli.Ezinye izinkampani ezifuna ukudiliza abasebenzi zikhala nangogesi onqamuka umlibe.
LIYISWE enkantolo yesifunda icala elibhekene nabamangalelwa ababili abasolwa ngokukhwabanisa izishaqane zemali yomqashi wabo.UNksz Phindile Khoza noMnuz Nkosingiphile Bhengu bavele izolo, eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini, ngecala lokukhwabanisa imali yomqashi enkampanini yonogada iCalvin and Family Security.IMantshi uQuim de Freitas ike yathi ukulibuyisela eceleni isikhashana leli cala, ithi inkantolo yayo ayinalo igunya lokulilalela, yagcina ilihlehlisela uMashi 4.Ilihlehlisa, ithe lizodluliselwa enkantolo E, lapho okuhleli khona iNkantolo yesiFunda saseThekwini.Ezwakalisa ukumangala kwakhe, ubuze ukuthi lingene kanjani ohlwini lwamacala abezolalela iyona?"Leli cala limayelana nokukhwatshaniswa kwemali engaphezu kukaR900 000. Imali enkulu kabi le, ubani ogunyaze ukuthi lize kule nkantolo?” kusho imantshi.Ngesikhathi uMbuso uveza ukuthi abamangalelwa bayeba izigaba ezahlukene imali, uDe Freitas, uthe yize kunjalo, lokho akusho lutho ngoba uma seliqulwa kuhlanganiswa yonke imali eyebiwe ibe yisamba esisodwa.Umshushisi uMnuz CP Dludla ube esenza isicelo sokuthi lidluliselwe enkantolo E.Ummeli wabasolwa, uNksz Zinhle Mzimela, uke wezwakalisa ukuthi amakhasimende akhe afuna ukufaka isicelo sebheyili.Nokho uDe Freitas akagxilanga kulesi sicelo, ethi singafakwa esikhathini esiyizinsuku eziyisikhombisa ezizayo.Isolezwe lithinta umqashi wabamangalelwa, uMnuz Calvin Mathibeli, uthe bekunguNovemba nyakenye, ngesikhathi bebamba ukuthi abamangalelwa bakhwabanisa imali enkampanini. Uthe baqala ukuyikhwabanisa ngoJulayi nyakenye."Sathi uma sibuka amaholo abasebenzi, saqaphela ukuthi kukhona i-site enesibalo esikhulu ngendlela engajwayelekile sabasebenzi nokuholele ekutheni kube nesamba esisolisayo samaholo,” kusho uMathibeli.Uthe bathi uma sebecwaninga kahle amabhuku, bebheka nehhovisi lakwandaba zabantu, kwavela ukuthi abamangalelwa bafake abasebenzi abangu-30 abayizipoki.Uqhube wathi laba ababili, athe bebesehhovisi lenkampani eliseDurban North, bazama ukugqiba ubufakazi ngokuthi basebenzise inombolo eyimfihlo yesinye isisebenzi ukususa lonke ulwazi lwalezi zisebenzi eziyizipoki ababezifakile kodwa amakhamera aveza ukuthi yibona.Uthe ngokolwazi lwabo, laba ababili baqale ngoJulayi nyakenye, ukugila imikhuba, wathi ngoSepthemba nango-Okthoba, bakhwabanise imali engaphezu kukaR300 000 inyanga ngayinye.Uveze ukuthi uBhengu ubenonyaka eqashiwe kanti uNksz Khoza enezinyanga eziyishumi. Bobabili bebesebenza kwa-Payroll.Udalule ukuthi bobabili babaleka emsebenzini emva kokuvela kwalo mkhonyovu, wathi uNksz Khoza wabuyisa uR100 000 wemali ababeyikhwabanisile, waxolisa wathi enye bazoyikhokha kancane."Engikufunayo ukubona umthetho udlala indima yawo ngoba sifike sinike abantu amathuba omsebenzi, bona bese bebona kugcono ukuthi basigebenge,” kusho yena.
NHLAKANIPHO MNQAYIUMZUKULU osolwa ngokubulala ugogo wakhe kuvela ukuthi waya enyangeni eMtubatuba, ngenhloso yokuyozihlambulula emuva kwesigemeko. UZama Gumede owayengumsolwa wokuqala kuleli cala, owavuma icala wagwetshwa, Isolezwe elithole ukuthi useshaye ungqimphothwe, kuthiwa wathumela uMnuz Sphamandla Hlengwa ongumsolwa wesibili ukuba ayosoconga umufi, uNkk Fikile Gumede, ngoJuni 2019, KwaMashu. Kuvela ukuthi uHlengwa wamgwaza amanxeba amathathu emqaleni umufi, wathatha izimpahla zasendlini.enkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini, ngesikhathi kuvele uHlengwa, umphenyi wecala, uCaptain Philangaye Mkhiye ethula ubufakazi, udalule ukuthi umzukulu watshela amaphoyisa ukuthi emuva kokwenza isigameko baya enyangeni. "UZama noHlengwa bazisholo bona ukuthi baya enyangeni beyozihlambulula," kusho uMkhize.Eqhubeka elandisa inkantolo, uveze ukuthi baqale babopha umzukulu ngaphambi kokuba babophe uHlengwa.UMkhize ubekade ephendula inqwaba yemibuzo ebivela kumshushisi uMbongeni Mbokazi.Kuye kwaba khona isikhathi lapho uMkhize zivele zazehlela kuyena izinyembezi ngesikhathi umshushisi embuza ngokuthi uphi umlingani wakhe, uSergeant Ndlela owayehamba naye ngesikhathi beyobopha umsolwa wesibili kubo KwaCinci, eMtubatuba.UMkhize uphendule ngamafuphi wathi akasekho emhlabeni. Kuphoqeleke ukuthi inkantolo iguqe isikhashana ngenxa yesimo abonakale ekusona uMkhize.Ummeli kaHlengwa, uAdv Andrew Matlamela, uqhamuke nezinsolo abezibhekise kuMkhize zokuthi amaphoyisa ambhaxabula kabuhlungu uHlengwa emphoqa ukuba avume icala."Ngiyakuphikisa lokho, asikaze simbeke isandla uHlengwa. Kodwa nguyena owacela ukuthi agonyuluke ngakho konke okwenzeka ngosuku lwesigameko," usho kanje.Ufakazi wesibili, uCaptain uNaidoo naye owayekhona ngesikhathi umsolwa wesibili ekhalelwa amasongo kaSigonyela, naye usolwe ngu-Adv Matlamela ngokuthi wambeka isandla.
USOLA impi ebhekiswe kuye uMnuz Vika Biyela, ongumfowabo womsakazi woKhozi uZimiphi "Zimdollar” Biyela, eshiselwa enye itekisi.Ngokusho kwakhe, kulesi sigameko esenzeke eNtambanana, eMpangeni, ngoMgqibelo, kuphinde kwalimala nomshayeli wetekisi kulandela ukudutshulwa kwakhe ngabantu abangaziwa."Umshayeli wayebuya embuthwaneni eThekwini, itekisi iqashwe ukuhambisa abantu khona. Uthe uma esefike eMpangeni ehambe ehlisa abantu, uqaphele ukuthi kukhona iQuantum emlandelayo,” kusho uBiyela.Uqhube wathi iQuantum liqale ukuhlasela emva kokuba eseqedile ukwehlisa abantu umshayeli."Kwaqala kwaba khona ukudubula okubhekiswe kuye esehamba emgwaqweni omkhulu. Wayimisa itekisi, waphuma wabalekela esikhotheni, bangabona abahlaseli,” kuchaza uBiyela.Uveze ukuthi abahlaseli, bathi besuka babehla kwiQuantum labo, bafike bashisa itekisi yakhe ngebhomu likaphethroli.Ubuye waveza ukuthi ngoDisemba, kungenelwe omunye wabashayeli bakhe, uMnuz Sakhile Shezi ekhaya eShowe, wadutshulwa wabulawa.Ngaphambi kwalokho, washiselwa amatekisi angu-14."Lokhu kubeka ngokusobala ukuthi kukhona ukuhlaselwa okubhekiswe kimi ngqo,” kusho yena.Uqhube wathi kukhona amacala amaningi awavule emaphoyiseni, kodwa angakawaboni ethela izithelo zobulungiswa.Echaza ngemboni yezokuthutha ngakubo, uthe kuke kwaba khona intuthu eshunqayo ngakhona kodwa yake yathi ukuthula kulethwe uhlobo oluthize lwamphoyisa."Afika ahlala izinyanga eziyisithupha, kwake kwathi ukuthula, kodwa kuthe ngokuhamba kwawo umsindo waqala phansi,” kusho yena.Uthe babefisa ukuthi kungagcini ngokuqashwa komsindo kuphela kodwa kube khona ababoshwayo.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe kuvela icala lokuzama ukubulala kuphela, aliveli elokushishwa kwempahla.
KUZOKWAKHIWA isigodlo esisha seSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini.Undunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Nomusa Dube-Ncube, uveze ukuthi basezingxoxweni zokuqedela amalungiselelo okwakhiwa kwesigodlo esisha.Lokhu ukusho ngesikhathi ethula inkulumo ngesimo sesifundazwe, eMgungundlovu.ISilo besiyingxenye yenkulumo kaNkk Dube-Ncube ebisenkundleni i-Oval Cricket Stadium.ISilo sijwayele ukusebenzisa isigodlo kwaNkomonye, esisoNdini.Lesi sigodlo silungiswe ngonyaka odlule.Ngaphambi kokulungiswa kwalesi sigodlo bekunezikhalo zokuthi iSilo asihlali esigodlweni, nokwenza kube nzima kulabo abafuna ukuzosotha.UNkk Dube-Ncube uthe isigodlo esisha sizokuba KwaNongoma."Kuyasikhuthaza ukubona ubudlelwano bukahulumeni neSilo buqhubeka. Njengoba besenza eSilweni esikhotheme, siyaqhubeka nokweseka iSilo esisesihlalweni.”UNongoma uteketiswa ngeleHlalankosi njengoba unezigodlo uKhethomthandayo, kwaDlamahlahla, Khangelamankengane, Nyokeni noLinduzulu, nokuyizigodlo ebezivele zikhona ngaphambi kokuba iSilo singene esihlalweni.ISilo siphuma esigodlweni kwaKhangelamankengane, nokuyisigodlo esakhiwa iSilo uGoodwill Zwelithini kaBhekuzulu ngesikhathi egcagcelwa iNdlovukazi uShiyiwe Manftombi Dlamini-Zulu.UNkk Dube-Ncube uthe uhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal uyaqhubeka nokweseka indlunkulu kaZulu."Kule minyaka eyedlule uhulumeni ufake ucingo olusha ezigodlweni eziyisithupha. Sithenge izimoto zondlunkulu beSilo uMdlokombane, neyeNdlovukazi (uMayvis Zungu Zulu).”UNkk Dube-Ncube uphinde wamemezela izinhlelo zokweseka amakhosi.UNkk Dube-Ncube uthe babeke eceleni u-R10 million ozoxhasa imisebenzi eyenziwa ondlunkulu bamakhosi."Lesi sikhwama semisebenzi yondlunkulu sizokwethulwa ngokusemthethweni ohlelweni lwe-Invest Rural, oluzokuba ngo-Ephreli. Inhloso yalolu hlelo ukuthuthukisa umnotho, kufukulwe ingqalasizinda, kwenziwe ngcono nempilo yemiphakathi yasezindaweni zasemakhaya.”UNkk Dube-Ncube uthe miningi imithetho asebeyishayile yokuthuthukisa amakhosi."Ngaphambi kuka-2004 amakhosi ayehola imali elinganiselwa ku-R5 000, izinduna zazingaholi. Le mali isinyukile, amakhosi asehola uR279 000 ngonyaka. Okusho ukuthi le mali inyuke ngo-300% kule minyaka engu-20 eyedlule. "Ukuze kuvikeleke isithunzi samakhosi emphakathini, ngo-2005 uhulumeni wesifundazwe wethula uhlelo lokwakhela amakhosi imizi yezizwe ewafanele. Sikhuluma nje ingu-40 imizi yezizwe eyakhiwe.”UNkk Dube-Ncube uthe bayalusukumela udaba lokusocongwa kwamakhosi.Uthe kunamakhosi agadwayo, nosekuphinde kwaqiniswa ezokuphepha emizini yawo."Ukubulawa kwamakhosi kuyichilo esasingacabangi ukuthi siyoke silibone.”
UMNDENI wezelamani eziboshwe kwelaseSwatini ngecala lokubulala umrepha wakuleli uKiernan 'AKA' Forbes noTebello 'Tibz' Motsoane ukhala ngokuhlaselwa amaphoyisa kufunwa lezi zinsizwa.Ilungu lomndeni elingadaluliwe likhulume nentatheli yeNewzroom Afrika lithi sebelahlekelwa ngamalungu omndeni amaningi ezandleni zamaphoyisa.Uthi kwaqubuka impi yamatekisi eMalukazi eThekwini, uthe le mpi yagadla kwazwela emndenini ngo-2022 kwaze kwaba wukuthi amalungu omndeni anquma ukuziphindiselela."Kwaze kwafika ithimba elalijutshwe ngungqongqoshe wamaphoyisa ukuthi akukhuzwe le mpi yamatekisi. Leli thimba lafika la ekhaya lizokhuluma lolo daba,” kusho leli lungu lomndeni.Lithe ngemuva kwalokhu, kwakungathi kufakwa umfutho omkhulu kule mpi kangangokuba amalungu omndeni aqoma ukubhaca kwamanye amazwe.Leli lungu lomndeni likholwa wukuthi bebezofa laba bafana ngazo izandla zengalo yomthetho yakuleli ukube ababoshwanga eSwatini.Uthe ngeke aphike noma avume ukuthi bayathinteka ekufeni kuka-AKA ngoba kwake kwavela ukukhuluma okuthi bazonamekwa ngamacala amaningi nabangathinteki kuwona.Ukukhuluma kwaleli lungu lomndeni kufakazela okukakhomishana wamaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal oveze ukuthi abasolwa bebeboshelwa amanye amacala angahlangene nokufa kuka-AKA ngenhloso yokuthi babagcine esitokisini kuze kube wukuthi bahlanganiswa nabanye abathintekayo futhi nobufakazi sebanele ukuthi bangabekwa icala.U-Assistant Superintendent Nosipho Mnguni okhulumela amaphoyisa eSwatini uthe bathola umbiko osuka emaphoyiseni aseNingizimu Afrika ngabasolwa ababhace emzini oseSwatini. eSwatini police say they will continue to work with police in SA to ensure that the 2 suspects linked to the murder of Kiernan 'AKA' Forbes & Tebello 'Tibz' Motsoane are extradited to answer for the crimes they allegedly committed. @mwelimasilela reports.https://t.co/PMQXCvNhzK pic.twitter.com/hMLZDuOwLD— Newzroom Afrika (@Newzroom405) February 29, 2024 UMnguni uthe ngesikhathi befika endlini ababekhonjiswe yona ukuthi inabasolwa, bathola ababili abebesendlini, kodwa ikhona imibiko yokuthi babebathathu, owesithathu wahamba ngaphambi kokuba kufike amaphoyisa. Uthi abanalo ulwazi lokuthi uyathinteka yini kuleli cala nokuthi uhambe washonaphi.Uqhubeke wathi yize abasolwa ababili bebingelele imantshi kuleli sonto, kulindeleke ukuthi babuyele eManzini ngoLwesibili njengoba kuqhubeka isicelo samaphoyisa akuleli sokuthi babuyiswe.Amalungu omphakathi eSwatini, athi lezi zinsizwa zafika kule ndawo zizine kodwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi wahamba oyedwa, basala abathathu. Uthi nalo wesithathu wahamba kwasala ababili. Bathi lezi zinsizwa zazihleli kahle emphakathnii zingenankinga namuntu futhi zibonakala emphakathini nasezitolo. Kuthiwa bebethanda nokwenza imicimbi kosiwe inyama endlini ababehlala kuyo.Kuthiwa amaphoyisa agasela emzini ababehlala kuwo ekuseni ngezithuba zabo-5 ngoMgqibelo, ngakho-ke akukho msindo owazwakala noma ukuhilizisana okwenzeka.Uma laba basolwa ababili bededelwa emaphoyiseni akuleli bazojoyina abanye abasolwa abahlanu abavele namhlanje enkantolo yeMantshi eThekwini.Icala labahlanu lihlehliselwe umhla ka 6 Mashi 2024 lapho kuzoqala izingxoxo zesicelo sebheyili yize iMantshi ivezile ukuthi leli cala lizohlehla izikhawu eziningi ngayo inyanga uMashi ngoba kulindeleke ukuthi kube khona ukuphazamiseka.Abasolwa abathathu kulaba bazogcinwa esitokisini sasesiteshini samaphoyisa eChatsworth kanti ababili bazogqunywa eWestville.
UKHULUME ngokubaluleka kokuqokwa kwakhe njengoNdunankulu wesifazane wokuqala waKwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Nomusa Dube-Ncube, ethula inkulumo yakhe ngesimo sesifundazwe, i-State of the Province Address (Sopa), abaningi ababona sengathi bekungeyokugcina.Uthe ukuqokwa kwakhe njengondunankulu wesifazane wokuqala kusho ukuthi noma iliphi iphupho lingafezeka.UNkk Dube-Ncube wethule inkulumo ngesimo sesifundazwe, izolo, eMgungundlovu.Lena bekuyinkulumo yakhe yokugcina ngaphambi kokhetho oluzayo.Abaningi babona uNkk Dube-Ncube engeke abuyele kulesi sikhundla emva kokhetho noma ngabe i-ANC iyalunqoba.UNkk Dube-Ncube waqokelwa kulesi sikhundla ngo-Agasti 10, 2022. Uthe ukuqokwa kwakhe kusho lukhulu."Ukuqokwa kwami kwakhombisa ngokusobala ukuthi i-ANC izimisele ukuthi kube nokulingana ngokwezobulili, kwakhombisa ukuthi noma ngabe uyingane ebihamba ngezinyawo iya esikoleni KwaMaphumulo, amaphupho akho angafezeka."Ngesikhathi ngithatha isifungo, ngangazi kahle ukuthi ngiyithemba labo bonke abesifazane abadala nabancane, baKwaMashu kuya eMkhanyakude. Ngesikhathi ngithatha isifungo ngangazi kahle ukuthi ngihlalelwe umsebenzi wokufezekisa amaphupho ezigidi zabantu ezilangazelele iKwaZulu-Natal, enokuthula nenqubekela phambili.”UNkk Dube-Ncube uchithe isikhathi esiningi ekhuluma ngebanga elihanjwe wuhulumeni kusukela ngo-1994.Uthe abantu baKwaZulu-Natal baqale ukubona ushintsho ngesikhathi kungena i-ANC ngo-2004.Ngaphambi kwalokhu, isifundazwe sasiphethwe yi-IFP."Izithelo zenkululeko KwaZulu-Natal ziqale ukubonakala emva kweminyaka eyishumi kuphethe uhulumeni wentando yeningi. Ukulethwa kwezidingo kuqale ukubonakala ngo-2004. Kulapho kwaze kwaqhamuka isiqubulo esithi ”intuthuko asiyibuzi, siyibona ngamehlo!” UNkk Dube-Ncube uthe bewuhulumeni ophumayo babhekane nezingqinamba okubalwa kuzo ukubheduka kobhubhane iCorona, izikhukhula, nezibhelu zokuzitapela."Izingqinamba esibhekane nazo zisiqinisile kakhulu. Kunezikhathi lapho khona ebesizitshela khona ukuthi isifundazwe sizoguqa ngamadolo kodwa sikwazile ukubhekana nezingqinamba, sazinqoba.”Umemezele ukuthi uhulumeni uyaqhubeka ngezinhlelo zokwakha isiShayamthetho esisha, eMgungundlovu.UNkk Dube-Ncube uthe isakhiwo sesiShayamthetho esizokuba namahhovisi eminyango kahulumeni sizothatha iminyaka ukuba siphothulwe.Usho kanjena nje, kunamaqembu afuna isiShayamthetho sibuyele oNdini uma kuphuma i-ANC emandleni.Uchithe isikhathi esiningi eqhosha ngemisebenzi eyenziwe uhulumeni we-ANC.Uthe bakwazile ukufaka ugesi, amanzi, benza ngcono ezemfundo nezomnotho.Inkulumo yakhe ibibuye iphazamiseke, abamaqembu aphikisayo bexokozela.
INHLANGANO emele amaciko kuleli idlulise ukubonga emaphoyiseni ngokubopha abasolwa abayisikhombisa abathinteka ecaleni lokubulala umrepha wakuleli, uKiernan AKA Forbes nomngani wakhe uTebelo Tibz Motsoane.Amaphoyisa aKwaZulu-Natal, ngoLwesibili ebusuku, amemezele izindaba zokuthi kuboshwe abalisa abayisithupha kanti izolo ekuseni, kwavela ukuthi sekuboshwe omunye wesikhombisa.Bonke laba kulindeleke ukuthi bavele namhlanje eNkantolo yeMantshi eThekwini.UJoy Mbewana ongumengameli womfelandawonye wezinyunyana zamaciko kuleli, iCreative Cultural Industry Federation of South Africa (Ccifsa), uthe ubusufana nesihlava umgwaqo uFlorida, okwenzeka khona isigameko njengoba amanye amaciko abesesaba ukuyosebenzela kuwona."Ukuboshwa kwalaba kuyasijabulisa njengoba ingane yakhe uKairo kithi ifana neciko, izokwazi ukuhamba zonke izindawo ngaphandle kokusaba, kanjalo nonina wayo uDJ Zinhle uzothola ukuphumula emoyeni njengoba naye akubeka kwacaca ukuthi uyasaba ukuza kuleli dolobha ngemuva kwalesi sigameko. Siyabonga emaphoyiseni ngomsebenzi awenzile, bekuhlala kukhalwa ngokungabanjwa kwabasolwa. Kuke kwaba nezinkulumo zokuthi njengoba eqeda unyaka adlula ake senze into yokumkhumbula,” kusho uJoy.Uthe ukushona kwalaba kwadala ukuthi kuvalwe amabhizinisi amaciko afana neWish, nokuyinto ekhahlameza umkhakha abakuwo."Amaciko amanye abengasamemezeli uma kukhona indawo ayodlala kuyo kulo mgwaqo ngenxa yakho ukwesaba. Siyanxusa ukuthi amaphoyisa aqhubeke nokubamba abanye abantu futhi nomthetho wenze ubulungiswa ecaleni likaSenzo Meyiwa. Kulo mkhakha esikuwo siyafisa ukuthi abhekwe amacala eGBV njengoba ethe chithi saka. Sijabule ngokwenzekile ecaleni lika-AKA nomndeni wakhe kukhona lapho uzophola khona amanxeba akade evulekile ngalesi sigameko,” kuchaza yena.Amaciko akuwona nje kuphela athintekile ngalesi sigameko nabantu bakuleli baphawulile ngokuboshwa kwalaba basolwa.U-@Mama_KGOTLI uthe: "Kwakungamele bambulale u-AKA. Ukushona kwakhe akusoze kwadlula.”U-@_sophi_sticated uthe: "Yonke le nto yavele yavusa amanxeba angakapholi, ngaze ngaphuka emoyeni. Angazi ke-kunjani emndenini wakhe nakubantu abasondelene naye.”U-@KhumaloDanica uthe: "Bonke laba basolwa ngeke balikhulume iqiniso ngokuthi ubani umuntu owayehlele leli tulo. Bayamsaba lona wesilisa bazothula. Babengamzondi u-AKA, babezifunela imali nje futhi bayithola. Okuyena owahlela leli tulo nguye okumele abe sejele kuqala.
IZINKINGA phezu kwezinye kuMasipala weTheku njengoba abasebenzi bevale imigwaqo ngengqumbi yenhlabathi eSiphingo, eMlaza nakwezinye indawo kwaphoqeleka ukuthi izimoto zijike. Ngenxa yalesi siteleka umasipala izolo ntambama ukhiphe isitatimende unxusa izakhamuzi ukuba zingawukhiphi udoti ngoba kunokuphazamiseka kokuqoqwa kwawo okudalwe isiteleka abathi asigunyaziwe. Isiteleka kuthiwa siphazamise nokushanelwa kwemigwaqo. Abasebenzi bateleka nje umasipala umatasa nokulungisa izinkinga zamanzi eNyakatho yeTheku kwazise izolo abengekho. Inkinga yamanzi isijwayelekile eThekwini njengoba evamise ukuphela ezindaweni eziningi, kukhalwe ngamaphampu afile nengqalasizinda endala. Emasontweni adlule izakhamuzi zasePhoenix bezivuka zivale imigwaqo ngenxa yokungabi namanzi selokhu ingqalasizinda yakhona yakhahlanyezwa yizikhukhula.Ezinye izakhamuzi zeTheku zikhala ngesikweletu samanzi esingaphezu kwamandla njengoba umasipala waveza ukuthi ubezigixabeza ngamanzi ebezingafanele ukuba ziwathole. Kuyimanje inkinga yesikweletu samanzi ayikalungiswa sekucelwe nezakhamuzi ukuba zivakashele eSizakala ukuze ziyokwenza isivumelwano sokukhokha kancane kancane. Ezinye izakhamuzi zikhala ngokuxathuka kweTheku nokucanasa kwamaphara abamba inkunzi. Ngenxa yalezi zinkinga amaqembu ezepolitiki eMkhandlwini weTheku asefake iziphakamiso zokungabethembi ubuholi beMeya uMnuz Mxolisi Kaunda. Abanye abantu baseThekwini bakhala ngemigwaqo engalungisiwe.Izolo abasebenzi abatelekile babuye bavala izikhungo zikaSizakala ngamatshe, izingodo namathayi avuthayo. Bakhala ngamaholo angalingani nawabanye komasipala abakhulu.Amaphoyisa athunyelwe ukuqapha isimo emigwaqweni yeTheku abigcwele ingqumbi yenhlabathi Isithombe:Andre BeetgeUMnuz Xolani Dube onguNobhala weSouth African Municipal Workers Union (Samwu) eThekwini, uthe abasebenzi batelekele ukuthi amaholo abo awafani nawozakwabo abasebenza komasipala abakhulu."Abasebenzi bafuna ukuholelwa imali efanayo neyozakwabo abasebenza komasipala abakhulu. Njengamanje imali yabo ingaphansi ngo-R3 000 uma iqhathaniswa namaholo abasebenzi bakaMasipala waseTshwane, Ekurhuleni naseGoli. Kudala beyikhuluma le ndaba, sekuphele iminyaka engaphezu kwesishiyagalombili,” kusho uDube.Uthe uMasipala weTheku ukleliswe esigabeni sesishiyagalombili somasipala kodwa abanye omasipala abakhulu bakleliswe esigabeni 10.Lokhu uthi kwenza abasebenzi baseThekwini bahole imali encane uma beqhathaniswa nozakwabo bakwabanye omasipala abakhulu.Isolezwe limshayele esazoya emhlanganweni nomasipala kodwa uthe okwamanje abasebenzi bafuna kulalelwe izimfuno zabo.UNkk Gugu Sisilana oyiMenenja yezokuxhumana kuMasipala weTheku, uthe bayazi ngesiteleka esingekho semthethweni esiqalwe ngabanye abasebenzi babo.Uthe izinhlaka zomthetho zisiqaphile isimo ngoba kubasebenzi abawu-27 000 abaqashwe wumasipala bawu-500 abaqale isiteleka esingekho emthethweni.Uveze ukuthi bekunomhlangano wamahora amabili weSamwu obungoLwesibili.Uthe abatelekile ngeke baziholele izinsuku akade bengasebenzi ngazo bebhikisha.Ubuye wathi abaqale isiteleka esingekho emthethweni bazoqondiswa ubugwegwe ngoba izikhalo kufanele zithunyelwe ngendlela efanele.Ugqugquzele abaholi bezinyunyana zabasebenzi ukuba bakhulume namalungu abo ukuze kulandelwe umthetho ngaso sonke isikhathi.Ikhansela leDA eThekwini, uMnuz Andre Beetge lithe isiteleka asenzeki enkabeni yeTheku naseSiphingo kuphela kodwa siyaqhubeka eVerulam, oThongathi nakwezinye izindawo.Ucele abantu ukuthi badlalele kude nabasebenzi abatelekile.
ZIMKHALELE ngoLwesithathu, umsolwa wesikhombisa ecaleni lokubulawa komculi uKiernan "AKA” Forbes nomngani wakhe uTebello "Tibz” Motsoane.U-AKA noTibz badutshulwa ngaphandle kwendawo yokudlela esemgwaqweni uFlorida, iWish ngoFebhuwari, nyakenye.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa asembophile umsolwa wesikhombisa kuleli cala."Umsolwa oneminyaka engu-30, uboshwe namuhla (esho izolo). Lokhu kwenza isibalo sababoshiwe sifinyelele kwabayisikhombisa,” kusho uNetshiunda.Uthe abasolwa abayisihlanu bazovela eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini, namuhla.IMeya yaseThekwini, uMnuz Mxolisi Kaunda, ikushayela ihlombe ukusebenza kwamaphoyisa ebopha abasolwa.Uthe ukuboshwa kwalaba kuzobuyisa ithemba kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi ingalo yomthetho ifinyelela kunoma ngubani owenze ubugebengu."Lezi zindaba zakamumva zizophinde zibuyise ithemba ngisho nakosomabhizinisi, abahwebi, izivakashi nezakhamuzi ukuthi sizimisele nokulwa nobugebengu ukuqinisekisa ukuthi iTheku yindawo ephephile yokutshala imali nokuvakasha,” kusho uKaunda.NgoLwesibili, uNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa kuzwelonke, uMnuz Bheki Cele nomkhuzi wawo KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, baveze imininingwane ngokuboshwa kwabasolwa.UMkhwanazi uqinisekise ukuboshwa kwabasolwa ababili abayizelamani eSwatini ngoMgqibelo. Ababili baboshwe ngoLwesibili kanti omunye waboshwa ngo-Ephreli, nyakenye. Uthe iqhinga labo kwakungukuthi abasolwayo baqale bababoshelwe amanye amacala abathinteka kuwo, kuyima kwengezwa elokufa kuka-AKA, ukugwema ukuthi babaleke.Kubasolwa, uthe kukhona ababili abadubula, kube khona ababili ababemlandela yonke indawo lapho ayehamba khona kusuka esikhumulweni sezindiza iKing Shaka International, isehhotela kanjalo nasendaweni yokudlela agcina edutshulwa ngaphandle kwayo. Kuthiwa omunye wabasolwa uye owaba ngumdidiyeli, owahlanganisa izibhamu nezimoto okwasetshenziswa kuleli cala waphinde wakhokhela bonke abasolwa emva kokubulala.Uthe zine izimoto ezasetshenziswa, kuzona kukhona iMercedes Benz, i-BMW okuthiwa yayo eyayilandela u-AKA, kube iHyundai Grand i10 kanjalo ne-VW Polo. Izimoto ezimbili kuthiwa zaziqashiwe kanti amaphoyisa abuqoqa bonke ubufakazi kumnikazi wazo, obufaka phakathi imininingwane yababeziqashile.UMkhwanazi uveze ukuthi kwakuhlelwe ukuthi u-AKA adutshulelwe emotweni kodwa wathatha isikhathi ebingelela abangani, wagcina esedutshulelwa ngaphandle kwendawo yokudla. UTibz yena kuthiwa wathelwa amachaphazelo. Yize amaphoyisa engafunanga ukuveza imali abakhokhelwa yona kwabezindaba kodwa ngokwemibiko yephepha laseSwatini, iTimes of eSwatini, bakhokhelwa u-R800 000 okuthiwa bawucazelana ngokulinganayo.
UNGQONGQOSHE wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi, uNkk Lindiwe Zulu, uthe asikho isidingo sokuthi abazali bakhathazeke ngemali yokufunda uma izingane ebezihola isibonelelo sikahulumeni seziphase u-matric.Uthe izingane ziba sohlwini lokuthola uxhaso kwiNational Student Financial Aid Scheme (Nsfas) njengoba uhulumeni esuke azi ukuthi zivela emindenini eswele.NgoLwesihlanu, uNkk Zulu, oyiPhini likaNgqongqoshe wezeMpilo, uDkt Sibongiseni Dhlomo noMphathiswa wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Mbali Frazer, bebehalalisela izingane ebezihola isibonelelo sikahulumeni ezenze kahle ku-matric.Utshele abazali ukuthi uhulumeni akafuni kube nezingane ezingakwazi ukuqhuba imfundo yazo uma seziphothule u-matric."Uhulumeni uyalwazi usizi lwabazali abangenayo imali, yingakho athatha isinqumo sokuthi izingane ezihola izibonelelo zixhaswe uma seziya emabangeni emfundo ephakeme. Isibonelelo sazo ngeke sinqamuke, zizoqhubeka nokubonelelwa wuhulumeni zize ziphothule izifundo zazo,” kusho uNkk Zulu.UNkk Thamo Mzobe ophethe iSouth African Social Security Agency (Sassa) KwaZulu-Natal, ubonge abafundi abenze kahle ku-matric nabazali babo.Uthe laba bafundi nabazali bebeya eSassa uma bebizwa ukuze kubhekwe ukuthi basaqhuba kahle yini esikoleni.UNkanyenzi Maphumulo (18) obefunda eLamontville High, uthe usefunda eNyuvesi yaseZululand lapho enza khona iziqu kwezomthetho.Ubonge iSassa ngokubenzela umcimbi wokubahalalisela, esho ukuthi emakhaya abo beyingekho imali yokubabungaza ngokuphasa kahle.Ugqugquzele abanye abafundi abahola izibonelelo zikahulumeni ukuba bazimisele esikoleni, wathi uma sebeqedile uhulumeni uyaqhubeka ngokubaxhasa ngo-NSFAS ukuze baqhubeke nezifundo zabo.Unina kaNkanyezi, uNksz Ayanda Maphumulo, uthe uyaziqhenya kakhulu ngendodakazi yakhe, wabonga iSassa ngokuhamba nabo yonke le ndlela njengabazali abangenayo imali.Omunye umzali, uNksz Nomfundo Nduli, uthe ingane yakhe yaqala ukuhola isibonelelo sikahulumeni ineminyaka emine kwaze kwaba iqeda u-matric.Ugqugquzele abazali ukuthi babambisane nabasebenzi baseSassa ngokuthi baye emihlanganweni abasuke bebizwa kuyo, waphetha ngokuthi kubalulekile ukweseka ingane, uyinike nothando ukuze izokwazi ukwenza kangcono.
KUVUKE amanxeba amadala, esalukwazini esithole usana lulahliwe esithi naso sehlelwa wumshophi ofanayo silahlwa wunina sinezinsuku ezintathu kuphela sizelwe.UNkk Cebile Nsele (66) waseNanda, eNewtown A, ozithele phezu kosana lushiywe kuveranda kamakhelwane, ekhuluma neSolezwe, uthe ukholwa ukuthi okwenzekile kuyicebo likaNkulunkulu ekutheni abuyisele isihe asitshengiswa ugogo wakhe emva kokutholwa elahlwe esidulini wunina enezinsuku ezelwe.Lolu sana olutholwe ngesonto eledlule, kuthiwa kuboshwe unina ona-38 waseNtuzuma, obekulindeleke ukuthi avele enkantolo yemantshi ngoMsombuluko. Kugcine kwenzeke ngendlela engaqondakali njengoba igama lakhe belingaveli ohlwini labebezobingelela inkantolo, okushiye amalungu omphakathi abekulindele ngamehlo abomvu ukuvela kwakhe edidekile. Ngesikhathi Isolezwe lihambele kule nkantolo, amalungu omphakathi abelokhu elindele ukubizwa kwegama lakhe, ahlale kwaze kwashaya isikhathi sokuvalwa kwezinkantolo, lutho ukuvela nokuthola ukuthi kwenzekeni ngaye.Engxongxweni kaNkk Nsele neSolezwe, uthe ukuthola kwakhe lolu sana obelusanosuku luzelwe kubhibhise izilonda ebesezaphola, ngomlando axoxelwa ngawo wokuzaleka kwakhe."Ngithe uma ngiluthatha kwabuya bonke ubuhlungu njengoba belukhala. Ngiludlulisele kundodakazi yami lwanamathela lwathula sengathi likunina. Ngiyafisa ukuthi ngisale sengiluthatha ngiludlulisele endodakazini yami ngoba ngibonile amagazi abo ayemukelana,” usho kanje.Uthe uxoxile nonina womsolwa ngokutholakala kosana, wamcela ukuthi asale eseluthatha kube olwakwakhe, ekhala ngokuthi yena akahlali ekhaya, uyasebenza futhi akazi uzolunakekela kanjani njengoba indodakazi yakhe ivele inezingane eziningi. Ngokuthola kweSolezwe, umsolwa unamasu ayisishiyagalolunye kanti kuthiwa cishe ziyisikhombisa izingane zakhe eziphilayo.Elandisa kafushane ngempilo yakhe, uNkk Nsele uthe unina omzalayo wayethathwe ukuyosebenza emzini othile eGoli wafika wakhulelwa wathola yena. Uthe ngenxa yokuthi wayekhuleliswe ubaba wakamakhelwane, owesifazane owayemsebenzela waphoqeka ukumposa nengane eyayinezinsuku ezintathu izelwe, wayishiya esidulini ngakubo eNgwavuma, washaya wachitha kanti kukhona abambonile babikela unina wazithathela yona wayikhulisa.Kuthiwa usana luyelashwa esibhedlela i-King Edward VIII, livele selingaphansi kweso losonhlalakahle.
UZIZWE eshiywa igazi wajika esesemsebenzini, wabuyela ekhaya uyise wentombazane isidumbu sayo esitholwe amaphoyisa emotweni yakhe sisongwe ngengubo yokulala, sinamanxeba okugwazwa, eManzimtoti, ngoMsombuluko ekuseni, okusolwa ukuthi iqale yadlwengulwa.Isidumbu sikaThobeka Radebe (17), oyisitshudeni kwesinye sezikhungo esiseMbilo, sitholwe sisongwe ngengubo sinamanxeba okugwazwa emotweni okuthiwa ibihamba uyise, uMnuz Aggripa Radebe nomunye wesilisa, etholwe ngamaphoyisa iphantshiswe amasondo ekhoneni lomgwaqo uKingsway no-Ocean View, eManzimtoti.URadebe nabehamba naye kuthiwa bathathwe ngamaphoyisa ukuyobahloma ngemibuzo ngesikhathi beficwa endaweni yesigameko kodwa babuye badedelwa emva kokuthi kuvezile ukuthi unguyise kamgilwa kanti ubemphuthumisa esibhedlela.Uveze ukuthi uThobeka ubevamise ukusala yedwa ekhaya njengoba ubengena izinsuku ezithile kuphela esikhungweni abeqeqeshwa kuso, izingane zakwabo ezimbili ziyafunda kanti abazali bobabili bayasebenza.Elandisa Isolezwe ngokwenzekile, uthe ufundisa eSipingo Beach Secondary, kanti ngesikhathi efika nje emsebenzini ngoMsombuluko ekuseni, uzizwe eshiywa yigazi umzimba wakhe uphansi, wabikela uthishanhloko ngaphambi kokuthi anqume ukujika abuyele ekhaya."Ngithe uma ngiqhamuka ngaqaphela ukuthi isivalo segaraji sivuliwe, kodwa nganganaka ngizitshela ukuthi mhlawumbe indodakazi unqume ukuhlala khona. Ngiqale esitolo ukuthenga okuthile, ngase ngidlulela ekhaya. Ngibone kuphuma owesilisa othile egaraji oyiphara lendawo elaziwayo, ebaleka ejikela emva kwendlu,” usho kanje.Uthe ngesikhathi ebona lokhu, uqonde egaraji, wazithela phezu kwendodakazi yakhe idindilizile, yopha esifubeni nasekhanda kanti beyikhunyulwe ngezansi izimpahla ize, watatazela wazama ukuyisiza. URadebe uthe umsolwa uphume wajikela ngasemotweni wagwaza amasondo emoto yakhe asesandleni sokudla ngokuthile ngaphambi kokuthi abaleke. Uveze ukuthi nokuthi amasondo agwaziwe, ukuzwe ngomakhelwane abebebukela ngaphesheya ababonile kuphuma umsolwa. Uthe ngenxa yokuthi ubesetatazela ethukile ebona indodakazi iphelela emehlweni akhe, unxuse othile ukuthi amshayelele beyiphuthumise esibhedlela eKingsway, imoto ikwazile ukuhamba ibanga elingamakhilomitha amahlanu isuka eBhekulwandle, eManzimtoti, kodwa ngenxa yesimo samasondo yagcina imile kanti indodakazi yakhe ibisishonile. URadebe uthe kulapho beficwe khona amaphoyisa, kwanokungaboni ngaso linye, ezama ukuwachazela ukuthi uwuyise kamufi ubemphuthumisa esibhedlela, kodwa agcina ebathathile.Ikhansela lendawo, uMnuz Menzi Manqele, uthe batshelwe wumphakathi namalungu omndeni azibonele umsolwa ebaleka ukuthi uwumuntu oyingozi ohlalise lubhojozi umphakathi."Isigameko sikhombisa ubulwane Kuthiwa umsolwa ziningi izigameko ahlukumeza kuzo umphakathi ikakhulu abantu besifazane, kanti bayiqeqebana elisatshwayo endaweni. Kuyimanje usekubhaceni kodwa siyacela abantu basebenzisane namaphoyisa ukuze atholakale aboshwe ngalesi senzo esibuhlungu asolelwa kuso,” usho kanje.UMphathiswa woMnyango wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi KwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Nonhlanhla Khoza, ukugxekile ukubulawa ngesihluku kwalesi sitshudeni."Sinxusa amaphoyisa ukuthi asebenze ngokuzikhandla ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ubulungisa buyenzeka, kuboshwe isigilamkhuba,” usho kanje.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uConstable Thenjiswa Ngcobo, uthe amaphoyisa aseManzimtoti aphenya icala lokubulala.
UTHOLWE osebeni lolwandle, eThekwini, ngoMsombuluko esagqoke isikibha se-ANC umfundi waseWelbedacht East eChatsworth owaminza ngoMgqibelo.USfundo Shezi (16) obefunda uGrade 10 eWelbedene Secondary, waminza kade ehambele irali ye-ANC ebisenkundleni yezemidlalo iMoses Mabhida.Uyise, uMnuz Lucas Baloyi ukuqinisekise izolo ukutholakala kwesidumbu sendodana yakhe.Uthe ushayelwe ucingo ama-life guards ngabo-6 ntambama emazisa ukuthi uSfundo utholakale olwandle olungaseCountry Club."Sinikele khona, safike sakuqinisekisa ukuthi uyena. Ubesasigqokile isikibha sakhe se-ANC. Isidumbu sakhe bese siqala ukonakala,” kuchaza uBaloyi.Uqhube wathi yize kubuhlungu ukulahlekelwa yindodana ngale ndlela kodwa babonga ukutholakala kwethambo layo."Sizokwazi ukumfihla ngendlela enesizotha, sazi nokuthi ithambo lakhe likuphi. Bekuzoba buhlungu ezinhliziyweni zethu ukuba ubegcina engatholakali,” usho kanje.USfundo ngesikhathi eminza wayebhukuda nabangani bakhe olwandle lwaseBlue Lagoon.Ngosuku lwesigameko kuthiwa umufi nabangani bakhe basuka eMabhida, baya olwandle beyokhipha ukushisa ngokubhukuda. Kuthiwa ngesikhathi bebhukuda, kwaqhamuka igagasi elinamandla labathatha. Kuvela ukuthi abangani bakhe babhukuda baphumela ngaphandle, kodwa yena wahluleka, wamuka nolwandle.Echaza ngohambo lwabo uBaloyi wathi baphuma ekhaya bejabulele ukuyothamela umcimbi. Waqhuba wathi bagcinana ekuseni ngabo-7 bethathwa amabhasi eWelbedacht East. Wathi yena nonina omncane kamufi bangena kwelinye ibhasi, kwathi uSfundo nabangani bakhe bangena kwelinye.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uLieutenant Colonel Nqobile Gwala, uthe kuphenywa ngokufa komuntu esiteshini samaphoyisa iDurban Central.
ABHALELE ikhomishini eyengamele ukhetho i-Independent Electoral Commission (IEC), amaqembu ezepolitiki asePhalamende nangamelelekile ePhalamende akhala nge-time-table yezokhetho.Okukhalisa kakhulu lawa maqembu okubalwa i-African Transformation Movement (ATM), Build One South Africa (Bosa), United Democratic Movement (UDM), Umkhonto weSizwe (MK Party), namanye wukulethwa kwezinto ezithinta ama-signature, kanjalo nabantu azofolosa ngabo njengoba umnqamulajuqu ungoLwesihlanu oluzayo, uMashi 8. Umholi we-ATM, uMnuz Vuyo Zungula, uthe bazwelana namanye amaqembu yingakho bekhalaza nabo kwi-IEC.Uthe sebelungise yonke into ethinta imali yokungenela ukhetho kanjalo nohlu lwabantu abazofolosa ngabo okhethweni."Ngeke sithule sibuke nje amanye amaqembu ekhala ngento nathi esikhala ngayo noma kuthiwa sesimi ngomumo ngokhetho. Sifuna kululwe isikhathi ngoba lusekude usuku lokhetho okunguMeyi 29,” kusho uZungula.Uthe amanye awekho ePhalamende, wathi amanye akhalayo okubalwa nabo bamelelekile ePhalamende.Isikhulu esiphezulu se-IEC, uMnuz Sy Mamabolo, siveze ukuthi bazimisele ukuhlangana namaqembu ehlukene.Ekhuluma nesiteshi sezindaba sethelevishini, uthe kudingeka basheshise izinto kulolu khetho ngoba luzobe lungafani nokhetho olwedlule."Sidinga isikhathi njengoba ezoba mathathu amaphepha okuvota kulolu khetho. Ukufakwa kwabangenela ukhetho ngokuzimela kushintshe izinto, kudingeka sisheshise ukuze sithi sigaya amaphepha okuvota yonke into ibi isimi ngomumo,” kusho uMamabolo.UMamabolo uthe wonke amaqembu kulindeleke ukuthi alethe uhlu lwabantu nemali yokhetho ngo-5 ntambama ngoMashi 8, 2024. Le khomishini iveze ukuthi azishintshi izinsuku ezishicilelwe kwi-time-table ngoba bekuvele kulindelwe ukuthi ukhetho luyeza. Ngo-2016, iNFP yahluleka ukungenela ukhetho lukazwelonke emuva kokuhluleka ukuhlangabezana nomnqamulajuqu wokulethwa kwemali yokungenela ukhetho.Khonamanjalo: UMnuz Paul Mashatile oyiPhini likaMengameli wezwe, linxuse abaholi bamaqembu ezepolitiki ukuthi bakhankase ngendlela efanele, bangakhulumi izinto ezizovusa uhlevane.UMashatile obekhuluma izolo, eGoli, ngesikhathi i-IEC nezinye izinhlaka zezokhetho e-Afrika, zibambe umhlangano ngokusetshenziswa kwezinkundla zokuxhumana okhethweni, uthe kubalulekile ukuthi kube nemigomo ezolawula izinkundla zokuxhumana okhethweni."Sizoqhubeka nokuqikelela ukuthi ukhetho kuba ngolukhululekile nolunokuthula. Singakhankasa ngaphandle kokuthi sehlise isithunzi samanye amaqembu.”
INGONYAMA uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini, inxuse amaqembu ezepolitiki akhankasela ukhetho oluzayo ukuba abekezelelane.ISilo sinxuse ukuthi kube nokuthula KwaZulu-Natal, njengoba amaqembu ezepolitiki eqinisa imikhankaso yokhetho oluzokuba ngoMeyi 29.Lokhu sikusho ngesikhathi sethula inkulumo yokuvula isiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal."Ngifisela wonke amaqembu azokube ekhankasela ukhetho inhlanhla,” kusho iNgonyama.Umcimbi wokuvulwa kwesiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal ubuseMgungundlovu, izolo. IKwaZulu-Natal ibhekene nengwadla yokubulawa kosopolitiki.Ngokwezibalo zamaphoyisa angaphezu kuka-52 amakhansela asebulewe KwaZulu-Natal kusukela ngo-2018.ISilo sikhiphe umyalelo wokuba kuphele ukubulawa kosopolitiki namakhosi."Ukubulawa kwamakhosi nosopolitiki kufanele kuphele, lona umyalelo oqhamuka endlunkulu. Siyisifundazwe esinokuthula. Konke lokhu kuchitheka kwegazi kufanele kuphele. Ngifisa ukunxusa abezokuphepha ukuba balandele lezigilamkhuba ezinikeza isifundazwe sethu igama elibi.”ISilo sisebenzise inkulumo yayizolo ukuqinisekisa izinqumo esisanda kuzithatha.Sibikele amalungu esiShayamthetho ngokuqokwa kukandunankulu kaZulu, Mfundisi Thulasizwe Buthelezi, nephini likandunankulu kaZulu, inkosi Phathisizwe Chiliza.UButhelezi noChliza baqokwa ngenyanga eyedlule ngesikhathi kunoMkhosi waseSandlwana.ISilo siyalele uButhelezi noChiliza ukuba basukume, babonwe yiwo wonke amalungu esiShayamthetho. Lokhu sithe sikwenza ngoba nakhu kukhona abathi ababazi."Basebenze kakhulu neSilo esebuzile, yingakho ngibathemba kakhulu. Ngokubambisana nabo sizoyisa isizwe phambili.”ISilo siqinisekise amalungu esiShayamthetho ukuthi senze izinguquko esikhwameni esibhekele umhlaba kaZulu, Ingonyama Trust.Phakathi kwezinguquko ezenziwa yiSilo, kubalwa ukhomba indlela owayengusihlalo, inkosi Thanduyise kaMpiyezintombi Mzimela, sabe sesizibambela sona."Inhloso yezinguquko ukubona abantu abahlala ngaphansi kweNgonyama Trust behlomula.”ISilo sitshele amalungu esiShayamthetho ukuthi kuzovulwa ngokusemthethweni umfuziselo weSilo uShaka, esikhumulweni sezindiza iKing Shaka. Kuzophinde kuvulwe umfuziselo weSilo uGoodwill Zwelithini kaBhekuzulu, esiShayamthetho esidala, oNdini.ISilo siphinde sagcoba owengumsakazi woKhozi FM, uNgizwe Mchunu, njengomengameli wamabhinca.Usihlalo we-EFF KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Mongezi Thwala, uthe kubaphoxile ukuqokwa kukaMchunu. Uthe nakuba besihlonipha isinqumo seSilo kodwa abasoze bamhlonipha uMchunu.UThwala ukhale ngokuthi uMchunu uhlale esusa udweshu, wathi akakwazi ukuhlanganisa abantu.ISilo sithe abadidiyeli bamabutho kaZulu kufanele basebenzisane namabhinca."Lesi sizwe sibukeka sikhula, kufanele sisisondeze eduze.”UNgizwe ujabulise okwengane ngemva kokuvunywa yiSilo.Uthe akusikhona okokuqala ukuba evunywa endlunkulu wathi noMdlokombane wamqoka ukuba abe yinxusa ngaphansi komkhankaso wokukhuthaza abafana ukuba basoke.Umcimbi wayizolo ubuhanjelwe abasendlunkulu, okukhona kubo uMntwana uBambindlovu kaZwelithini, undlunkulu wakwaLinduzulu, uThandekile Jane Ndlovu Zulu, ababengondunankulu baKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Sibusiso Ndebele, Dkt Zweli Mkhize, noMnuz Willies Mchunu, kanye nezinye izicukuthwane.ISILO uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini noNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Nomusa Dube-Ncube, emcimbini wokuvulwa kwesiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal Isithombe: SIBONELO NGCOBO/ Independent MediaISILO uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini ngesikhathi kuvulwa isiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal Isithombe: SIBONELO NGCOBO/ Independent Media
UMENGAMELI Cyril Ramaphosa uphakamise iJaji Mandisa Lindelwa Maya njengomehluleli wamajaji kuleli.URamaphosa umatasa uxhumana nabaholi bamaqembu asePhalamende, iJudicial Service Commission, ukubazisa ngesiphakamiso sakhe.Okhulumela umengameli wezwe uMnuz Vincent Magwenya, uthe uRamaphosa usebenzise isigatshana somthetho u-174(3) woMthethosisekelo, ukuqala izingxoxo nezinhlaka ezifanele ngalesi siphakamiso.IJaji uMandisa Maya, liyiPhini leNhloko yamaJaji kuleli kanti phambilini like laba ngumengameli wamajaji eNkantolo yezokuDluliswa kwamacala.URamaphosa umphakamisa nje kungenxa yokuthi isikhundla sikamengameli wamajaji, esiphathwe yiJaji Raymond Zondo, sizovuleka ngo-Agasti 31, 2024."UZondo wayeqokwe isikhathi esiyiminyaka engu-12 njengeNhloko yeNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo ngoSepthemba 1, 2012. Ihlandla lakhe kule nkantolo liphela ngo-Agasti 31, 2023,” kuchaza uMagwenya. Kuzoqopheka umlando ukuqhwakela kukaJaji Maya kulesi sikhundla ngoba kuzobe kungokokuqala senganyelwe ngowesifazane omnyama.Uthe umengameli unxusa abaholi bamaqembu ukuthi baphawule ngesiphakamiso sakhe ngoJaji Maya. Uveze ukuthi bangachaza uma benezizathu zokuthi bamchithe kulesi sikhundla.UJaji Maya unamava emkhakheni wezomthetho njengoba ngo-2000 waqokelwa ekubeni yijaji eNkantolo eNkulu e-Eastern Cape.Uneziqu zeB.Proc (Nyuvesi iTranskei); LLB (Nyuvesi iNatal); neLLM (Nyuvesi iDuke, North Carolina, United States of America) kanjalo nezintathu zeLLD (Honoraris), zaseNyuvesi yaseFort Hare, Walter Sisulu naseNelson Mandela University. UMagwenya uthe uRamaphosa uxhumane neJSC eholwa nguZondo, ekuphakanyisweni kweJaji Dumisani Hamilton Zondi, kwesePhini likaMengameli weNkantolo yezokuDluliswa kwamacala. UZondi uneziqu zeB.Juris zasenyuvesi iFort Hare, ezeLLB zaseNyuvesi iNatal esiyaziwa nge-UKZN, nezeLLM azithole eNyuvesi iGeorgetown ese-United States of America.UZondi waqokelwa ebhentshini laseWestern Cape, ngo-2007. "Ngo-2011 waba yijaji lenkantolo ebuyekeza amacala yezokuncintisana. Wanyuselwa enkantolo yezokudluliswa kwamacala ngoJuni 2014. Ngo-2022 waqokelwa ekubeni ngusihlalo wenkantolo yezokhetho.” UMangwenya uveze ukuthi uRamaphosa unxuse iJSC ukuthi ilethe iziphakamiso ngokulungela kukaZondi ukuthatha izintambo.
INHLANGANO yezokhetho i-IEC iyalele iNFP ukuthi ihambise umbiko wokusebenza kwemali ngaphambi kokuthi ithole imali yoxhaso enikwa amaqembu. INFP ilokhu ibhekene nezinkinga ibanga ubuholi nokuholele ekutheni i-IEC imise uxhaso lwemali kuze kuxazululwe umbango.Izwe lilungiselela ukhetho lukazwelonke okulindeleke ukuthi lube ngoMeyi 29, nonyaka. I-NFP yake yangena ehlazweni yehluleka wukukhokhela ukungenela ukhetho lohulumeni basekhaya ngo-2016.Isolezwe liyibonile incwadi evela kwabe-IEC ophikweni lwabo lezomthetho nekhomba ukuthi ithunyelwe ngoMsombuluko.I-IEC inomgomo wokunika amaqembu imali yoxhaso ukuwalekelela ukuqhubeka nezinhlelo zawo. I-NFP yayalelwa ukuthi ilungise izinkinga zayo ibuye nombiko oqondile ngobuholi.I-NFP inezinkinga zobuholi njengoba kugcine sekunezinhlangothi ezimbili ezizibiza ngobuholi obusemthethweni.NgoDisemba 15 no-16 nyakenye, iNFP ibambe ingqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi eThekwini. Kwakhethwa uMnuz Ivan Barnes waba wuMengameli, uMnuz Milton Sokhela wakhethelwa kwesePhini likaMengameli. UBarnes ongumengameli uthe bayitholile incwadi futhi bajabule baswele amaphiko ngoba lokhu kusho ukuthi bayaya okhethweni."Sijabule kakhulu futhi nakanjani sizolungenela ukhetho, okuningi sizokuchaza esithangamini sabezindaba. I-IEC ithe kufanele sihambise umbiko wezezimali, sihlanganisa wona siwuhambise sibone ukuthi bathini,’’ kusho uBarnes.I-IEC itshele iNFP incwadi iyazisa ngokuthi yemukela ubuholi bayo obukhethwe ngoDisemba wonyaka odlule. Ungqingetshe ovelile wukuthi nakuba bemukelwa ubuholi kodwa kusafuneka umbiko wezezimali."Emuva kokucubungula konke esithunyelelwe khona, siphume nokuthi ingqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi yabanjwa ngoDisemba 15 no-16 2023, lapho izinhlaka zakhetha khona. Semukela lobo buholi njengobusemthethweni nokuyinto eyojika uma kukhona umyalelo wenkantolo ochitha lokhu,’’ kusho i-IEC.Ibe isidonsa ngendlebe iNFP ngodaba lwezezimali ithi kufanele ilulungise ngaphambi kokuqhubekela phambili."I-NFP iyexwayiswa ukuthi akukho mali ezoyithola kuze kube iletha amabhuku akhomba ukusebenza kwemali yayo njengokusho komyalelo emthethweni wokuxhaswa kwamaqembu,’’ kusho incwadi.

UMNYANGO wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, ushaqekile ngezinsolo ezibhekene nothisha wasesikoleni samabanga aphansi eMlaza, okuthiwa uboshwe emva kokuthi abazali bemvulele icala lokupansa nokuphulula izinqe zabafundi.Omunye wabazali uthe batshelwe ukuthi umsolwa uvelile eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMlaza, ukufaka isicelo sebheyili, kanti ubingelele le nkantolo ngesonto eledlule emva kokuboshwa. Kushaye isikhathi sokushicelela Isolezwe lingakatholi ukuthi umsolwa uyinikeziwe ibheyili noma cha njengoba kuthiwa ubevelile.Okhulumela umnyango KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Muzi Mahlambi, uthe lezi zinsolo zifika ngesikhathi esibi kusanda kuqala unyaka, kuqhutshwa usiko lokufunda nokufundisa ezikoleni."Uma izinsolo ziyiqiniso siyathemba ukuthi inkantolo ilima indima yayo bese kuthi nathi njengomnyango silime eyethu ngokulandela imigudu yangaphakathi emnyangweni. Sizosebenzisa izinhlelo zangaphakathi ukubhekana nezinsolo uma kuqinisekiswa ukuthi lokhu ukwenzile,” kusho uMahlambi.Ngesonto eledlule, abazali bezingane ezifunda kulesi sikole banikele esikoleni bediniwe befuna uthisomkhulu nezikhulu zomnyango zithathele uthisha izinyathelo. Kuthiwa abazali bamvulele amacala emva kokutshelwa ukuthi izingane zabo, ezineminyaka eko-11, ukuthi uyazipansa kanti kuvele ukuthi yinto osekunesikhathi ayiqala.Omunye wabazali okhulume neSolezwe uthe kunomunye uthisha wesifazane ofundisa kuso lesi sikole okuthiwa uthethisa abafundi ebagxeka ngokuceba umsolwa."Izingane sezifunda kabi. Lo thisha uzibelesela ngokuthi kungani baceba umsolwa ngoba bamqedela isinkwa? Le nto izogcina iziphazamisa kakhulu izingane,” usho kanje.

UBUCHULE nesineke samaphoyisa bufake kunoxhaka abasolwa abayisithupha ngecala lokubulawa komculi uKiernan "AKA” Forbes nomngani wakhe uTebello 'Tibz' Motsoane abadutshulwa eThekwini ngoFebhuwari nyakenye.Laba kulindeleke bavele bavele enkantolo ngoLwesine.Ekhuluma nabezindaba ngoLwesibili ebusuku uMkhuzi wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLt General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, uthe iqhinga labo bekungukuthi abasolwayo baqale bababophele amanye amacala abathinteka kuwo ngaphambi kokuthi bababophele elokufa kuka-AKA ngoba babengafuni ukuthi kube khona ababalekayo. Uveze ukuthi umsolwa wokuqala waboshwa ngo-Ephreli nyakenye, wathi kulaba ababoshiwe kukhona umdidiyeli wetulo lokubulawa kuka-AKA. Kubo kukhona ababili abadubula, kube khona ababili ababemelusile beqaphile lapho ehamba khona, omunye wamlandela esuka esikhumulweni sezindiza iKing Shaka Airport efika waze wafika ehhotela. Omunye wayengaphakathi endaweni yokudlela owadutshulwa ephuma kuyo u-AKA. Uthe omunye wayehlanganisa izibhamu nezimoto okwasetshenziswa kuleli cala. Uthe kwasetshenziswa izimoto ezine kuhlelwa ukusocongwa kuka-AKA. Uthe ngoMashi 2023 bathola imoto iMercedes Benz eyasetshenziswa ngoMeyi 2, bathola isibhamu ngoJuni 23 bakwazi ukusiyamanisa nala macala womabili okubulala. Ngo-Agasti 2 bathola imoto i-BMW eyayilandela u-AKA esuka esikhumulweni sezindiza. Ngo-Okthoba 20 bathola imoto iHyundai Grand i10 kanti ngo-Okthoba 23 bathola imoto i-VW Polo. Izimoto zokugcina ukutholwa amaphoyisa uveze ukuthi zaziqashiwe kanti bakwazi ukuqoqa ubufakazi kumnikazi wazo bokuthi ngobani ababeziqashile. Uthe umsolwa wesibili owayelandela u-AKA waboshwa ngo-Okthoba 24 nyakenye ngelinye icala, umsolwa wesithathu waboshwa ngoDisemba 14 nyakenye ngelinye icala elenzeka eManzimtoti. UMkhwanazi ubuye wathi ngoFebhuwari 24 bahlonza abasolwa ababili ababoshwe ngoMgqibelo ekuseni eSwatini emuva kokuthi bethole ukuthi baqashe indlu kuleliya zwe. Uthe bakhulume nophiko lwezokushushisa ukuba lwenze i-affidavit abayithathile besebenzisana ne-Interpol laba ababili base beyaboshwa. Uthe emuva kokuvela kwezindaba zokuboshwa kwabasolwa, abanye abasolwa babalekile kodwa bathola izincwadi ezigunyaza ukuthi baboshwe. Laba basolwa baboshwe izolo ntambama. Njengamanje abakuleli abasolwa abane kanti abanye ababili yilaba abasaboshelwe eSwatini naveze ukuthi ngeke asho ukuthi bazofika nini kuleli ngoba kukhona uhlelo lwezomthetho olusalandelwa ukuze babuyiswe kuleli. Uthe kwakuhlelwe ukuthi u-AKA adutshulwe esemotweni kodwa wathatha isikhathi ukuvalelisa kubangani. Umngani wakhe wathelwa amachaphazelo. Uveze ukuthi umuntu owahlanganisa izibhamu nezimoto nguyena "umdidiyeli wezinkabi" ngoba nguyena futhi owakhokhela abasolwa emuva komsebenzi. Ebuzwa ngendaba yemali abakhokhelwa yona abasolwa ukuze babulale u-AKA, uthe ngeke asho kodwa ngokwemibiko yephephandaba i-Times of Swaziland abasolwa bakhokhelwa uR800 000. Ngokwaleli phephandaba kuleliya zwe kuboshwe izelamani. Kulesi sithangami kuvele ukuthi kunomunye umsolwa wesikhombisa osabalekile. UMkhwanazi uqhube wathi kusengenzeka ukuthi kube khona abanye abasolwa ababoshwayo uma uphenyo lwamaphoyisa lubiza ukuthi baboshwe.Uthe okwamanje ngeke basho ukuthi "umdidiyeli” nguye ongungqondongqondo owayefuna kubulawe u-AKA, noma naye wayethunywe abathize.
KUHLUKANE imibono emaqenjini ezepolitiki iSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini sishaya ngamafuphi ngesikhathi sethula inkulumo yokuvula isiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal.Yize kube namaqembu ezepolitiki athe iNdlulamithi ikhathule enkulu indima, amanye akhale ngokuthi ubufishane benkulumo yayo kwenza abone kunesidingo sokuthi umcimbi wokuvulwa kwesiShayamthetho ube usuku olulodwa.Amaqembu athe afuna ukuthi kuqale iSilo sikhulume ekuseni, bese emini kukhuluma undunankulu wesifundazwe.Njengamanje undunankulu wesifundazwe wethula inkulumo yakhe ngosuku olulandelayo.Inkulumo yeSilo ithathe imizuzu engaphezudlwana kweyishumi.Kushaye u-12 indlu isiguqile njengoba bese kuqedwe konke okosuku.IsiShayamthetho sisebenzise uR3 milliom ukuhlela umcimbi wezinsuku ezimbili.Amanye amaqembu ezepolitiki athe kungongiwa imali uma umcimbi ungaba ngosuku olulodwa.Kodwa lo mbono uchithiwe uNdunankulu kaZulu, uMfundisi Thulasizwe Buthelezi, kanye neqembu eliphikisa ngokusemthethweni esiShayamthetho, i-IFP.UButhelezi uthe abafuna ukuthi umcimbi ube usuku olulodwa bakhombisa ukungabuhloniphi ubuholi bomdabu.Ohola i-IFP esiShayamthetho KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Blessed Gwala, uthe akekho umuntu okufanele akhulume uma sekukhulume iSilo."Indaba yokuthi umcimbi ube izinsuku ezimbili yaqalwa yithi njenge-IFP ngesikhathi sisaphethe KwaZulu-Natal. Lokhu sasikwenza ngamabomu ukuze kungaphazamiseki inkulumo yeSilo. Uyabona nje namhlanje wonke umuntu ukhuluma ngokushiwo iSilo, akekho okhuluma ngokushiwo undunankulu.”Oxhumanisa iKhabhinethi yaKwaZulu-Natal nesiShayamthetho, uMnuz Siboniso Duma, uthe bebengakaluxoxi udaba lokuthi umcimbi wenziwe ngosuku olulodwa."Uma kunesikhalo sokuthi sibhekene nesimo somnotho esingesihle, singasibheka leso siphakamiso, bese sixoxa nendlunkulu. Ngeke siphange umdaka linganile.”Ohola iDA esiShayamthetho KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Francios Rodgers, uthe iningi imali engongiwa uma umcimbi ungenziwa ngosuku olulodwa."Isifundazwe sethu asinayo imali eyanele. Sihlezi sisho ukuthi undunankulu angethula inkulumo yakhe ntambama emva kokuba iSilo sesikhulumile ekuseni.”Usihlalo we-ActionSA KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Zwakele Mncwango, uthe bafuna ukuthi iqembu elizophatha iKwaZulu-Natal emva kokhetho liyicabangisise indaba yokwenza umcimbi ube usuku olulodwa."Vele iqembu eliphethe njengamanje seliyaphuma. Ingakho ngikhuleka kulamaqembu esizosebenzisana nawo emva kokhetho ukuba ayibhekisise kahle le ndaba.”Amaqembu ezepolitiki akushayele ihlombe ukuba iSilo sikhuze ukubulawa kosopolitiki namakhosi.Ohola i-EFF esiShayamthetho KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Mongezi Thwala, uthe kubalulekile ukuba kube nokubekezelelana KwaZulu-Natal uma sekuqhubeka imikhankaso yokhetho.

OWAYENGUMENGAMELI wezwe ne-ANC uMnuz Jacob Zuma, uthe uMkhonto weSizwe (MK) ufuna ukuqeda ngabantu abasha abavilaphayo ukusebenza kepha bakhuthalele amankwebevu. UZuma ubekhuluma enkundleni yezemidlalo, eMaqongqo, lapho abekhankasela khona uMkhonto weSizwe.Umcimbi obekukhuluma kuwona uZuma ubuhambisana nokuhlonipha inkosi Mhlabunzima Maphumulo, eyakhothama neyayiyisishoshovu somzabalazo.Elakuleli lilungiselela ukhetho lukazwelonke oluzoba ngoMeyi 29, lapho kulindeleke ukuthi zidlane imilala. Amaqembu amaningi aphansi phezulu azicelela amavoti ebantwini.UZuma uphumele obala ngoDisemba odlule wethula uMkhonto weSizwe wachayisa i-ANC wathi ngeke ayivotele kodwa usehamba neqembu elisha. Kulezi zinsuku uMsholozi unqamula izinkalo ekhankasela iMK ewundabamlonyeni kwabaningi.UZuma uthe okuningi kuyoshintsha uma iMK ithatha amandla kuhulumeni emuva kokhetho oluzayo. Uthe iyinkinga indaba yentsha yabamnyama ezikholisa ngamambawu ekubeni ezinye izizwe zifunda zizithuthukisa."Abekho abafana abancane abazoba amavila bahlale otshwaleni, Cha! Uma beqhubeka bedakwa ezinye izizwe zifundisa izingane zazo, uzobona umhlola, siyomusa ngenkani esikoleni,’’ kusho uZuma.UZuma uthe uma kufanele izinto zilunge kumele kungancengwa muntu kuqiniswe isandla. UZuma uthe kufanele izingane zonke zidlule ekuqeqeshweni kobusosha noma unyaka owodwa." Asizukuncengana, asikwazi ukuthi sihleli singamadoda sibangaka, izingane ziyaphuza la ekuseni lize liyoshona, izwe liyafa. Ingane kufanele uma isifundile yaqeda u-matric bese ithatha unyaka iyofunda ubusosha, ifunde inhlonipho nokuvikela izwe layo. Sizoyiqeda le nto yokuthi kukhona omalala esikhotheni,’’ kusho uZuma enanelwa yinhlokomo.UZuma uthe kufanele kube neqhinga lokufundisa intsha ngokuziphatha ingajahi ukuzalisana izingane isikhathi singakafiki.Ukhale kakhulu nangendaba yabantu abayimilalandle asebebizwa ngamaphara wathi kufanele kubakhathaze abantu abamnyama lokho." Yini thina kube khona laba bantu abalala emapayipini, kwezinye izizwe akukho lokho kodwa? Ubugebengu budalwa yindlala ngoba abantu abasebenzi, uma elambile umuntu uzothini, alambe aze afe? Ukuqeda ubugebengu wukuqeda ukuhlupheka,’’ kusho uZuma.Khonamanjalo i-MK isaqhubeka nokutheza kwi-ANC njengoba ijoyinwe wuMnuz Mervyn Dirks obeyilungu lesiShayamthetho KwaZulu- Natal. Siyajabula kakhulu ukuthi abasebenzi bezempilo bayakwazi ukuthi basheshe ngaleyo ndlela,” kusho uNksz Simelane.UNksz Manzini uthe okubathokozisayo ukuthi iningi labangeniswe esibhedlela nasemtholampilo bezokwelashwa sebededelwe."Sivumelane ngokuthi abalimele ngeke sibadlulisele kwezinye izibhedlela eziseduze nasemakhaya okuyinto ebesizobhunga ngayo. Sithe abalashwe lapha ngoba bavele banakekelwa khona, ngakho asifuni ukuthi uhlelo lokwelashwa kwabo luphazamiseke,” kusho uNksz Manzini.Ngokwesitatimende esikhishwe yilo mnyango, bangu-57 abebesebhasini ngesikhathi kwehla lesi sigameko. Oyedwa kwabane abalashwa esibhedlela esiseVryheid udluliselwe esibhedlela i-Grey’s esiseMgungundlovu.

UMKHUZI wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, akayivumanga futhi akayiphikanga imibiko yokuthi ngoLwesihlanu kuboshwe amadoda amabili asolwa ngokuba yizinkabi eSwatini, athinteka ecaleni lokubulawa komrepha u-AKA.U-AKA , nomgani wakhe uTebello 'Tibz’ Motsoane, badutshulwa babulawa ngabantu abangaziwa ngoFebhuwari nyakenye emgwaqweni uFlorida, eThekwini.Izolo, iphephandaba laseSwatini, iTimes of Swaziland, libike ukuthi amaphoyisa akuleliya zwe abophe abasolwa ababili abayizelamani ezineminyaka engu-28 no-29.Kuthiwa lokhu kwenzeke ngemuva kokucelwa ngamaphoyisa akuleli. Laba kuthiwa bebebhace endlini abebeqashe kuyo bebathathu kodwa omunye wabaleka.Ngokwemibiko banukeka nasemacaleni okufa kosomatekisi abathathu.UMkhwanazi esitatimendeni uthe useyibonile imibiko yabezindaba evela eSwatini, mayelana nokubuyiswa kwabasolwa ababili ababoshwe khona.Uthe ufuna ukukubeka kucace ukuthi abasolwa bazobuyiswa kuleli ukuzobhekana necala lokubulala nelokuzama ukubulala lapho owesilisa owayegibele emotweni wadutshulwa wabulawa eBerea, ngoMashi 6, 2023. Umshayeli wasinda waya egaraji likaphethroli ukuyofuna usizo. Uphenyo luholele ekutheni abasolwa batholwe eSwatini.Ngokwemibiko yangaleso sikhathi, owesifazane washayela waya egaraji ngemuva kokuhlaselwa kwabo besezimpambanweni zemigwaqo uMansfield, noBerea. Umshayeli walimala waphuthunyiswa esibhedlela.Ubonge abezomthetho kuleli yazwe. Uthe uyazi ukuthi abantu bafuna ukwazi ngokufa kuka-AKA noTibz futhi uma kukhona okwenzekayo bazokukhuluma nomndeni kuqala ngaphambi kokutshela umphakathi."Uphenyo kulolu daba lusesigabeni esibucayi futhi amaphoyisa awafisi ukuveza ulwazi olungaluphazamisa. Icala lokufa kuka-AKA noTibz luthinta izinto eziningi futhi kunenqwaba yolwazi oluwubufakazi okumele lucutshungulwe. Lolu wuphenyo olushayelwa ngabashushisi futhi uma amaphoyisa eseqede konke. Kuzokwenziwa isimemezelo ngophenyo nokuthi lukusiphi isigaba,” kusho uMkhwanazi.Uphethe ngokubonga abaphenyi athe abalali behubha abasolwa nokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi abagilwa nemindeni yabo bathola ubulungiswa.Abasolwa ababoshiwe bekulindeleke ukuthi bavele enkantolo eSwatini, izolo, ngamacala okuba kuleliya zwe ngaphandle kwamaphepha aqondile.Bobathathu kuthiwa bafuneka nangokuthumba nokushushumbisa imali.Omunye wabo usolwa ngokuba sembonini yezokuthutha futhi amanye amacala okubulala anukwa kuwo asuka engxabanweni abe nayo nezimbangi ebhizinisini.
UNGQONGQOSHE kagesi, uDkt Kgosientsho Ramokgopa, uthi bakwazile ukwehlisa ukunqamuka kukagesi ngamahora awu-600 kulezi zinyanga eziwu-12 ezidlule.URamokgopa uthe ngo-2022 ugesi wanqamuka amahora awu-1 800 kodwa ngonyaka odlule unqamuke amahora awu-1 200."Sisebenza ngokuzikhandla ukuqeda inkinga yokunqamuka kukagesi. Okwenzeke ngesonto eledlule lapho kuye kwabuya ukunqamuka kukagesi ngesigaba sesihlanu kube yiphutha. Kufe imishini emihlanu eKendal. Okuhle wukuthi lizoshona elanamhlanje isisebenza emithathu,” kusho uRamokgopa.Uthe banezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa ingqalasizinda yokuthumela ugesi kubantu."Ukuthuthukiswa kwengqalasizinda yokuthumela ugesi kuzodla uR400 billion. Le ngqalasizinda ngingayifanisa nemigwaqo okuhamba kuyo izimoto ngoba nayo ihambisa ugesi. Simatasa nokulungisa izinhlelo zethu zokuthi le ngqalasizinda izokwakhiwa kanjani, sizosebenzisana nobani, imisebenzi ezodaleka nokunye okuningi. Sizokwazi ukuyithola imali ngeke kube yinkinga futhi ngeke sidinge usizo lukahulumeni,” kusho uRamokgopa.Uveze ukuthi ugesi ongekho ngenxa yokuthi kulungiswa imishini usuke ku-17 000MW waya ku-14 000MW.Lokhu uthe kubanika isikhathi sokuba balungise imishini yabo njengoba befuna kuthi kushaya ubusika ugesi ongekho ngenxa yemishini efile ube usuwu-5 000MW.Ubalule ukuthi bafuna ngoMashi umehluko ube usubonakala ezinhlelweni zokulungiswa kwemishini.Uthe ngoMashi isikhulu esisha esiphezulu sase-Eskom, uMnuz Dan Marokane sizoqala umsebenzi waso.URamokgopa ubuye wacacisa ukuthi izindaba ezithinta amasheya, ezokuphatha nokunye zikhulunywa wuNgqongqoshe wamaBhizinisi kaHulumeni. Wathi yena umatasa nokuqeda inkinga yokunqamuka kukagesi.Isazi sezamandla, uDkt Mohamed Madhi, sithe umnotho waseNingizimu Afrika ngeke ukhule uma kusanqamuka ugesi ezweni.UMadhi ekhuluma kuNewzroom Afrika, uthe kufanele izinhlelo zokusabalalisa ugesi zisheshe, zibhekelele inhlakalahle yabantu bakuleli nesimo sesikweletu sezwe.Uphethe ngokuthi ukuphehla ugesi ohlanzekile kufanele kudale amathuba omsebenzi futhi kukhulise umnotho wezwe.
UNDUNANKULU waKwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Nomusa Dube-Ncube, uthembise ukweseka abeTransnet Pipelines njengoba izinhlelo zabo zizothuthukisa umnotho zidale amathuba omsebenzi. UNkk Dube-Ncube ube nomhlangano nesikhulu sale nkampani, uMnuz Sibongiseni Khathi, oyingxenye yochungechunge lwemihlangano undunankulu azoba nayo nezinhlaka ezihlukene njengoba ezothula inkulumo yesifundazwe ngoLwethathu.UKhathi ukhombise uNkk Dube-Ncube izinhlelo zentuthuko ezizayo kwazise ngeke besathutha uphethroli kuphela kodwa bazothutha nohlobo legesi ebizwa nge-liquefied natural gas.Lokhu kuzokwenzeka echwebeni laseRicards Bay kanti kwakhiwa namathangi amakhulu echwebeni laseThekwini.Lezi zinhlelo, uKhathi uthe zizoletha omkhulu umehluko emnothweni waKwaZulu-Natal.Ubuye wachazela uNkk Dube-Ncube ngezingqinamba ababhekene nazo abale ukwebiwa kukaphethroli ngamasela axhuma emapayipini abo, wakhala nangabantu abakha basondele emapayipini abo yize kunomthetho ocacisayo ukuthi lokhu akulungile.Ucele undunankulu ukuba abasheshisele izinhlelo zokuhlolwa kwemvelo ngaphambi kokuba baqale intuthuko yabo."Siyakholelwa kakhulu ekwakheni ubudlelwano nohulumeni nomphakathi ukuze sikwazi ukuya phambili. Siyajabula ngomhlangano wethu nondunankulu futhi izinhlelo zethu zizowuthuthukisa umnotho uma siqhubeka nokubambisana,” kusho uKhathi.UNkk Dube-Ncube uthe bazoyiseka iTransnet Pipelines ngoba ukuphumelela kwayo kusho ukuthuthuka komnotho."Siwuhulumeni oza nezisombululo ngoba siyazi izinhlelo zeTransnet Pipelines zizothuthukisa umnotho bese zidala namathuba omsebenzi. Sizosebenzisana nazo zonke izinhlaka ezithintekayo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi iKwaZulu-Natal iyadlondlobala,” kusho uNkk Dube-Ncube.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi Isolezwe selike labika izikhawu eziningi ngabantu abeba uphethroli nodizili othwalwa amapayipi eTransnet Pipelines.Amanye amasela ayaboshwa njengoba umphakathi uye ushayele amaphoyisa. AbeTransnet Pipelines bagqugquzele umphakathi ukuthi ube yiso labo. Ubike uma kukhona okusolisayo eduze kwamapayipi amakhulu.
USINDELE amaphoyisa owesifazane waseNtuzuma, uveva umphakathi ngezinsolo zokuthi uzibelethise usana wase elulaxaza eduzane nesitolo esiseNanda, lunosuku olulodwa luzelwe. Usana lutholwe lusongwe ngengubo kanti kuthiwa lutholwe ngothile luphila. Manje luyelashwa esibhedlela iKing Edward VIII.Umsolwa ona-38 kuthiwa uthathwe amaphoyisa kukubi umphakathi usho ukumqeda, ngosuku olulandela okutholwe ngalo usana. Isolezwe lithole ukuthi umsolwa unamasu evile kwayisishiyagalolunye. Kuthiwa cishe ziyisikhombisa eziphilayo, ezintathu zokuqala wazitetela emtholampilo kanti ezinye kuthiwa wazitetela zona esekhaya bese engalubhadi emtholampilo.Lezi ezinye kuthiwa azinawo ngisho amakhadi omgomo nezitifiketi zokuzalwa. Ilungu lomphakathi elingathandanga ukudalulwa, lilandisa Isolezwe ngokwenzekile, lithe emva kokusabalala ezinkundleni zokuxhumana kwesithombe sosana olutholwe ngasesitolo kwaMthamis eNanda, basolile njengoba kukhona abebehoshe ukuthi usekuphindile lokho kokuzitetisa kodwa ingane ayibonakali."Kubuzwe udadewabo ahlala naye ukuthi u..(emgagula), utetile pho iphi ingane? Uthe akazi lutho, kanti naye umsolwa ubephika ukuthi kukhona ingane ayibelethile. Amalungu omphakathi abethukuthele ngenxa yaleli hlazo abefuna ukumenza isilo sengubo kwasiza othile kuwo othinte ikhansela, elifike lakhuza ulaka ngaphambi kokubiza amaphoyisa afike amthatha ahamba naye,” usho kanje.Uthe okuthukuthelisa umphakathi ukuthi akaqali ukunukeka kulo mkhuba njengoba phambilini kuke kwasoleka ukuthi uzithwele, okuthe sekubona noma wubani ukuthi uzobeletha, kwabonakala isisu singasekho kodwa ingane ingaziwa ukuthi ikuphi.Elinye ilungu lomphakathi nalo elicele ukungavezwa, lithe ukubelethela kwakhe ekhaya ezitetisa naphambilini kube nomthelela omubi ngoba enye yezingane zakhe yagcina ishona esaba ukuyiyisa emtholampilo."Kunengane yakhe eshone inezinyanga ezimbili izelwe ebigula kodwa engayihambisi emtholampilo njengoba yayingenalo ngisho ikhadi lomgomo. Wayihambisa emtholampilo isishonile okwaba yinto ebuhlungu. Nakuba enze into ebuhlungu neyihlazo yokulahla ingane kodwa okunye okubi ukuthi noma engasebenzi kodwa uyaziphantela izingane zakhe, uma eboshwa zizodlani ngoba phela azitholi nesibonelelo? Enye obekumele iyoqala uGrade R, kudingeke ukuthi kuze kungenele omunye umakhelwane wayincengela esikoleni ukuze ifunde,” usho kanje.Uthe kuyashaqisa ukuthi ingane ubeyigcinelani aze ayizale uma engayifuni. Uveze ukuthi zonke izingane zakhe uyaziteta, awe evuka nazo ngakho kubamangazile ukuthi kungani le yokugcina enqume ukuyilahla.Kuthiwa umphakathi uhlukene kabili abanye bebethi akadingiswe endaweni, abanye bethi akatholelwe usizo.UMnuz Fisokuhle Mngadi oyikhansela, uthe emva kokuboshwa komsolwa, amaphoyisa abatshele ukuthi uzovela namhlanje enkantolo, wathi amalungu omphakathi azobe ekhona enkantolo"Yize ubephika ukuthi utetile nabakubo bemvuna ngenxa yokuthi nabo wayebafihlele ukuthi uzithwele, amaphoyisa amthathile amyisa esibhedlela ukuyohlolwa, kwatholakala ukuthi nebala yiqiniso. Emva kwalokho uvumile, waveza ukuthi ubengamazi uyise wengane, okushaqise nabakubo abebemphikela, ukuthi ubekhulelwe,” usho kanje.UMnuz Mhlaba Memela okhulumela uMnyango wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi KwaZulu-Natal, uthe nakuba umsolwa kumele ajeze kodwa ukuboshwa ngeke kumlekelele njengoba kubonakala ukuthi kukhona lapho edinga ukulekelelwa khona."Siwumnyango sihlale sikugqugquzela ukuthi abantu abasebenzise izinhlelo ezikhona zomnyango futhi lukhona uhlelo lokugcinwa kwezingane lwasemnyangweni. Kulandelwa imigudu uma umzali kunesimo esimphoqa ukuthi angakwazi ukuhlala nazo. Osonhlalakahle bethu bazolubheka udaba lwezingane njengoba kuthiwa azinazo izitifiketi ukuze zisizakale, kodwa nonina lukhona uhlelo lokumlekelela kule nkinga abhekene nayo,” kusho uMemela.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uColonel Robert Netshiunda, akaphendulanga imibuzo abethunyelwe yona.
UMHOLI we-ActionSA, uMnuz Herman Mashaba, uthi abantu bakuleli kufanele babe nesibindi uma befuna ukukhipha i-ANC emandleni. UMashaba ubekhuluma eGoli, ngesikhathi ethula izingqwembe zomkhankaso weqembu lakhe njengoba kubhekwe okhethweni.UMashaba wethule i-ActionSA ngo-2020, emuva kokulaxaza iDA eyayike yamjuba esikhundleni sobumeya. Uthe abantu bakuleli banengqayizivele yethuba lokukhipha i-ANC kulolu khetho okuyiwa kulona."Yibani nesibindi bakwethu nibuke engxenye, ninike abanye abantu ithuba lokuqala uhulumeni omusha. Kufanele ukhishwe uhulumeni we-ANC emandleni, lesi yisikhathi sokubhala umlando omusha wezwe,’’ kusho uMashaba.Uqhube wathi izingqwembe zobuso bakhe zizobonakala ezweni lonke ngoba bamatasa nomkhankaso wokhetho. UMashaba usho kanjena nje, selumenyezelwe usuku lokhetho okunguMeyi 29, lapho kuzogezelwana khona.
ISAVALIWE indawo ekhonzwe yizivakashi eThekwini, Ushaka Marine World njengoba kuqhubeka isiteleka sabasebenzi.Selokhu kwavalwa eShaka ngoFebhuwari 12, kanti abasebenzi bathe basazoqhubeka nokuqhinqa nakuleli sonto.UMnuz Xolani Dube onguNobhala weSouth African Municipal Workers Union (Samwu) eThekwini, utshele Isolezwe ukuthi namhlanje banomhlangano kwiCommission for Conciliation Mediation and Arbitration (CCMA), lapho bebizwe khona ukuze kuqale imizamo yokuthola isisombululo salolu daba."Okwamanje isiteleka siyaqhubeka, iShaka Marine World isavaliwe. Kusasa siya emhlanganweni neCCMA ngoba uma isiteleka sesidonse isikhathi eside, ukhomishana uye abize zonke izinhlaka ezithintekayo ukuze zethule amaphuzu azo, bese ezama ukuthola isisombululo,” kuchaza uDube.Uthe abasebenzi bafuna ukuholelwa ngendlela efanele njengoba iShaka Marine World wathola imibiko emibili, ezinkampanini ezimbili ezikubeka kucace ukuthi abasebenzi kufanele baholelwe kanjani."Abasebenzi bazimisele ukubuyela emsebenzini uma izincomo zemibiko yangaphambilini zisetshenziswa kuwo wonke umuntu. Abakhala ngakho wukuthi izincomo zasebenzela idlanzana. Sifuna iCCMA ibone le mibiko ukuze ikwazi ukuza nesisombululo kwizikhalo zabasebenzi,” kuchaza uDube.Ubuye waveza ukuthi ikhona neminye imihlangano ebizwa wuMasipala weTheku nawo ofuna ukuthola isisombululo odabeni lwesiteleka.Utshele Isolezwe ukuthi abasebenzi bayazithanda izivakashi kodwa ngeke babuyele emsebenzini bengazitholile izimfuno zabo.Phambilini, isikhulu saseShaka Marine World, UMnuz Ndabo Khoza, sathi bazimisele ukunyusa amaholo abasebenzi abahola kancane ngo-13% kuya ku-18% ngoba bayasiqonda isimo sabo.Wathembisa ukuthi bazokwenza konke okusemandleni ukuqinisekisa ukuthi siyatholakala isisombululo kulolu daba lwamaholo.

Ubuze ukuthi ingenaphi empilweni yakhe?UNoluthando uvele wababaza uma ezwa ukuthi ukhuluma nentatheli. Uthe ubengaqondile ukumzwisa ubuhlungu udadewabo ngokuthandana nomfundisi. IKHOMISHINI yezokhetho kuleli, i-Independent Electoral Commission (IEC), ithi amaqembu ezepolitiki avumelene ngomnqamulajuqu wezikhathi okumele zilandelwe ukuze kuhlelelwe ukhetho.UMnuz Sy Mamabolo, isikhulu esiphezulu se-IEC, uthe bahlangene namaqembu ezepolitiki bawachazela nge-time table yokulungiselela ukhetho lwangoMeyi 29, 2024, lapho kuzovota abakuleli.Kule time table kunomnqamulajuqu wokuthi amaqembu nabangenela ukhetho ngokuzimela, kumele balethe uhlu lwama-signature, nemali yokungenela ukhetho."Sivumelene sonke ngezinsuku ngoba uma sezize zaphuma, azibe zisashintsha. Ngakho wonke umuntu obeyingxenye yomhlangano wangoLwesihlanu odlule, uyazi kumele kuhlangatshezwane nalezi zinsuku.” UMamabolo ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma esithangamini nabezindaba izolo eGauteng, ngemva kokushicilelwa kosuku lokhetho emqulwini kahulumeni.UDkt Nomsa Masuku wekhomishini, uthe uma sezize zabekwa izinsuku azibe zisashintsha."Kufana nokuthi isitimela esihambayo esingami ndawo ngoba akukho okungenziwa uma izinsuku sezibekiwe ngoba sisuke silungiselela ukhetho. Asikwazi ukwenza ngenye indlela ngoba uhlelo lokulethwa kwama-signature alabo abazongenela ukhetho kade lavulwa,” kuchaza uDkt Masuku. UDABA lokuqashwa kothisha ezikhungweni zokuvota lubukeka luwutwayi abalunwaya luvumbuke abe-IEC, nakuba sebezame konke ukuchaza kodwa uyavutha umlilo.
