Izinyunyana zibuye zibe nobudlelwano namqembu ezepolitiki.Lolu daba luvela nje, izwe lishanela amabala wena owabona kungena udwendwe ngoba kulungsielelwa ukhetho lukazwelonke. UMengameli uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa uselukhombile usuku, kuzovotwa ngoMeyi 29.Kumenyezelwa usuku nje, luyabangwa udaba lokuqashwa kothisha ukuthi baphathe umsebenzi wokuvotisa. Udaba lukhulunywe kakhulu yi-EFF ithi njengoba iSadtu idlelana ne-ANC, bese othisha abangamalungu ayo bevotisa, kungase kube nenkinga yokwenzelela. I-EFF ithi lokhu kuzodala ukuthi imiphumela yokhetho ingathembeki.Okhulumela i-EFF uMnuz Sinawo Tambo ukhulume kabanzi ngodaba."Lokhu kudala ukuthi uhlelo lokhetho ludungeke ngoba phela kuyaziwa ukuthi iSadtu indawonye neCosatu bonke beseka i-ANC. Lokhu kusho ukuthi bafisa ukuthi i-ANC inqobe ukhetho. Kukhona abantu abaneziqu abanamakhono abangasebenzi ngabe kuqashwa bona esikhundleni sokuqasha abantu abavele besebenza,’’ kukhononda uTambo.Uthe bazimisele ngokulwa kuze kube sekugcineni ukuphikisana nokuthi othisha beSadtu bavotise ezikhungweni. UTambo uthe kufanele kube nomgomo ovimba lokhu ukuthi kwenzeke ukuze imiphumela yokhetho ibe qotho.I-EFF ithe abasuke bemele amaqembu ezikhungweni zokuvota kufanele ihlale ineso elibukhali igade ukuthi akukho yini ukukhwabanisa okwenzekayo.Umholi we-UDM uMnuz Bantu Holomisa, naye uke wazijikijela izagila zakhe kwi-IEC eyisola ngakho ukufaka abantu beSadtu ezikhungweni. UHolomisa ubhale enkundleni yokuxhumana iX, ekhala ngokuthi akufanele kuvunyelwe lokhu." I-IEC ifaka othisha beSadtu ukuthi bavotise ekubeni le nyunyana idlelana neCosatu ehambisana ne-ANC. Emhlanganweni wethu singamaqembu aphikisayo ngoFebhruwari 26, kufanele sithathe isinqumo sokuvimba ukukotelwa kwemiphumela yokhetho,’’ kubhoka uHolomisa.Uzithintele iziqandu kwiSadtu evele yakhipha isitatimende isola uHolomisa ngokungcolisa igama layo ekubeni kade waba khona kwezepolitiki."Usopolitiki omdala kulo mkhakha ukhuluma amanga aluhlaza nje. I-IEC ayiqashi abantu beSadtu kodwa iqasha abantu bonke okubalwa nothisha phakathi abasuke befanelwe wumsebenzi. Kukhona othisha abaphuma kwezinye izinyunyana ababamba iqhaza kwezepolitiki nakuyona i-UDM futhi bayaqashwa nabo,’’ kubhala iSadtu, esitatimendeni.ISadtu ikhala ngokuthi uma uHlomisa engalwethembi uhlelo lokuvota pho kungani evumile ukuya ePhalamende elikhethwe ngevoti?Isikhulu se-IEC uMnuz Mashego Shiburi, sike sayichaza indaba yokuqashwa kothisha sakuchitha ukuthi babeka phambili abeSadtu. UShiburi uthe kunemigomo elandelwayo ukuhlonza bafanelwe wukusebenzela i-IEC.Uthe kunekomiti lamaqembu wonke lapho asuke enethuba lokubeka imibono noma izikhalo uma kukhona angeneme ngakho." Lokhu kusho ukuthi amaqembu anethuba lokubeka imibono ngemigomo yokuqasha. Awukho umthetho othi i-IEC kufanele iqashe othisha kuphela ichithe abanye abantu. Awukho umthetho othi kufanele kuqashwe othisha benyunyana ethile kuphela. Uma siqeda ukuqasha abantu amagama abo ayahanjiswa emaqenjini anikwe ithuba lokusola,’’ kuchaza uShiburi.Uthe i-IEC iyababhekisisa abantu uma ibaqasha ukuthi abayona yini ingxenye yamaqembu ezepolitiki abake bawamela okhethweni. Uthe baze babheke nokuthi umuntu abazomqasha akaze alahlwe yini yicala lobugebengu.Izinsolo zokukhwabanisa zihlala zikhona uma kuvotwa futhi zivame ukuvezwa yilabo abasuke behlulwe okhethweni. Uma kuphume imiphumela yokhetho, lisuke livuliwe ithuba lokuthi uma kukhona onganelisekile afake isikhalo.Othisha nabanye abantu abasuke beqashwe yi-IEC, bayaqeqeshwa kakhulu ngendlela okusingathwa ngayo umsebenzi ukuze imiphumela ibe nobuqotho. Zikhona nezindlela i-IEC eyenza ngazo ukwesula umsebenzi wokhetho.Labo abaveza izikhalo ngokuqashwa kothisha abangamalungu enyunyana edlana ne-ANC akufanele basolwe ngalokhu. Izwe okuphilwa kulona ligunyaza ukuthi abantu beze noma babeke imibono yabo ukuze baneliseke.Okufanele kwenzeke nje wukuthi i-IEC izinike isikhathi ichaze njalo uma kukhona imibuzo equbukayo ngokusebenza kwayo ukuze konke kuhlale obala. Ukhetho luyinto enkulu kabi ephethe ukufa nokuphila kwezwe, akufanele iba namathizethize nongabazane.Ngenhlanhla elakuleli alikaze elibe nombango omkhulu kuze kusuke impi ngemiphumela yokhetho kufane namanye amazwe ase-Afrika. Kwamanye amazwe imiphumela yokhetho ike ibangwe kume yonke into kuphazamiseke uzinzo ezweni.I-IEC ozoba matasa kakhulu kulokhu njengoba sekumenyezelwe usuku lokhetho obelubhekwe ngabomvu Isithombe : SIGCINIWE
IGUBUZELWE yifu i-ANC kufa abayisishiyagalolunye engozini okugingqike kuyo ibhasi, okuthiwa belithwele amalungu nabalandeli bale nhlangano abebebuya eralini yokwethulwa komqulu wezethembiso zokhetho obuseThekwini.Ingozi yenzeke ngeSonto ekuseni emgwaqweni u-R33 ngaseDumbe kanti ibhasi beliya eMpumalanga.Esitatimende esithunyelelwe abezindaba, i-ANC ithe lezi zindaba ziyidumaze kakhulu kwazise ibizishaya isifuba ngempumelelo yomcimbi wezithembiso zokhetho obizwa ngeMayihlome Rally, okubonakale kuwo abalandeli namalungu enhlangano egcwalise inkundla yemidlalo iMoses Mabhida.Idlulise amazwi enduduzo emindenini yabashone kule ngozi."Bakhombise ukuzinikela okukhulu enhlanganweni ngokuhambela umcimbi iMayihlome Rally. "Uphenyo lubandakanya isimo sebhasi, esomgwaqo nesimo sezulu esikhathini okwenzeke ngaso ingozi, kanjalo nesomshayeli. Sifisa ukuthumela amazwi enduduzo emindenini elahlekelwe abathandiweyo bayo, sifisele abalimele ukululama ngokushesha,” usho kanje.Kwenzeka lokhu nje i-ANC isazikhotha amanxeba njengoba ngenyanga edlule kwenzeka into efanayo, kushona abayisithupha engozini yebhasi eyayithwele amalungu ayo ayebheke emcimbini wale nhlangano waminyaka yonke owaziwa nge-January 8, owawusesifundazweni iMpumalanga.I-IFP nayo idlulise amazwi enduduzo emindenini yabalahlekelwe. Oyikhulumelayo, uMnuz Mkhuleko Hlengwa, uthe imikhankaso yokuphepha emgwaqweni nokuqaphela kumele kubekwe eqhulwini ngalesi sikhathi amaqembu ezombusazwe enemicimbi ehlukene kulo lonke leli njengoba kubhekwe okhethweni.Ne-EFF idlulise amazwi enduduzo emindenini yabashonelwe.Yize umnyango uveze ukuthi bayisishiyagalolunye okubikwe ukuthi badlule nale ngozi, kodwa ngesikhathi sokushicilela amaphoyisa aqinisekise abayisishiyagalombili.Owakhulumelayo kuzwelonke, uBrigadlier Athlenda Mathe, uthe kuthunyelwe amaphoyisa namathimba ezokutakula endaweni yesigameko.UNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa ekhuluma ne-eNCA, uveze ukuthi ziningi izinto ezizobhekwa kule ngozi.

Okhulumela i-ANC kuzwelonke, uNkk Mahlengi Bhengu-Motsiri, uveze lokhu exoxa eceleni neSolezwe ngesikhathi behlola inkundla iMoses Mabhida.UZuma ngoDisemba umemezele ukuthi usehamba neqembu elisha uMkhonto weSizwe, azolikhankasela alivotele. UZuma wakubeka kwacaca ukuthi akasayingeni indaba ye-ANC ngoba akeneme ngendlela uKhongolose oqhuba ngayo.NgoJanuwari i-ANC ibhalele uZuma imazisa ngokumiswa kwakhe yambhalela nohlu lwamacala ezimisele ngokumthwesa wona. UZuma wayenikwe amahora angu-48 ukuthi aphendule enze izethulo emacaleni athweswe wona. uNkk Motsiri uthe sebelinde baze bakhathala bengayitholi impendulo."Ayikho impendulo ebuyile usathule nje kodwa thina asithule njengaye ngoba siyaqhubeka. Khumbula phela ukuthi udaba lweMK silufake enkantolo nokukhomba ukuthi asithule thina,’’ kusho uNkk Motsiri.OWAYENGUMENGAMELI we-ANC nezwe uJacob Zuma okukhalwa ngokuthi uzibe incwadi ye-ANC emazisa ngokumiswa kwakhe nohlu lwamacala abhekene nawo Isithombe : SIBONELO NGCOBO/INDEPENDENT MEDIANgaphambi kwalokho bekukhulume uNobhala-Jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula ngodaba lweMK. Uthe beyi-ANC abanandaba neMK ngoba yona usuku nosuku ihlala yethula izethembiso kubantu."Bayazethula usuku nosuku bahlala bebonakala nje, uthuka ubona ngezimoto zabo zihlabe ujenge. Yinto nje esingayinakile indaba yeMK. Sasingazi nathi ngelinye ilanga siyobe sehla senyuka sikhuluma indaba kaZuma. Usesebenzisana nezitha zethu manje, akukhona ukulungisa umbutho lokhu akwenzayo,’’ kusho uMbalula.UMbalula usole uZuma ngokuholela abantu ophathe ebatshela ukuthi uphume kwi-ANC ngoba engeneme ekubeni kukhona ezinye izizathu zakhe azifihlile. UMbalula uthe bazokhuluma ngodaba lukaZuma uma sekushaye isikhathi.UZuma uke wakhuluma nge-ANC eseMlaza esho khona ukuthi ngeke ezwe ngayo futhi yena akesabi muntu uqhubeka nokukhankasela uMkhonto weSizwe.Kwenzeka konke lokhu nje, uZuma usanda kuxoshwa yiSANCO esikhundleni sikasihlalo wayo KwaZulu- Natal imsola ngokulova. ISANCO ithi uZuma akaze athamele ngisho nomhlangano owodwa selokhu akhethwa.
ZIGIXABEZWE ngezigidi zamaRandi izinkampani zikahulumeni ezihlalelwe wumsebenzi wokuqeda inkinga yokucishwa kukagesi neyesiminyaminya emachwebeni aKwaZulu-Natal.I-Transnet ne-Eskom basikelwe amavenge abhekile ngesikhathi uNgqongqoshe wezeZimali, uMnuz Enoch Godongwanaba, ethula isabelomali.Imali enikezwe lezi nkampani izosetshenziselwa ukubhekana nenkinga yokushoda kukagesi nokubhekana nesiminyaminya emachwebeni aKwaZulu-Natal.UGodongwana wabele iTransnet u-R47 billion ngesikhathi ekhuluma ePhalamende, izolo.Uthe iTransnet izosebenzisa le mali ukulungisa izinkinga ebhekene nazo, iphinde ikhokhele izikweleti."Le mali ihambisana nombandela wokuthi iTransnet kuzofanele igxile ezintweni eyasungulelwa ukuba izenze, iphinde isebenzisane nezinkampani ezizimele.”Enye yezinkinga ezibhekene neTransnet, yisiminyaminya echwebeni laseThekwini nelaseRichard’s Bay ngenxa yokushoda kwengqalasizinda.UGodongwana uthe bazobambisana nenkampani ezimele ukuthuthukisa ingxenye yechweba laseThekwini, okufikela kuyo iziqukathi."Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi izinkampani ezizimele zitshale imali eningi ezosiza ukuthuthukisa ingqalasizinda nezobuchwepheshe.”UGodongwana uthe bazimisele ngokulungisa izinkinga zokuthuthwa kwempahla."Ikhabhinethi yaphasisa uhlelo lokwenza ngcono ezokuthutha ngonyaka owedlule. Uhlelo luveza izinto okufanele zenziwe ukuze sithuthukise ingqalasizinda emachwebeni, izitimela nezokuphepha.”I-Eskom igixabezwe u-R2 billion wokuba iiqale uhlelo lokuthenga ama-meter esimanjemanje."La mamitha azoqala ukufakwa ezindaweni ezingaphansi komasipala abafake izicelo zokuba basulelwe izikweleti.”UGodongwana uthe inkinga yokucishwa kukagesi iyaqhubeka nokuphazamisa umnotho nempilo yabantu.Uthe kudingeka ukuba kwenziwe izinguquko kwezokukhiqizwa kukagesi ukuze kuqedwe inkinga yokushoda kwawo."Sithathe izinqumo ezifanele kule minyaka emihlanu eyedlule futhi sesiyaqala ukubona izithelo. I-Eskom iyaqhubeka nokubamba iqhaza elibalulekile kwezokukhiqizwa kukagesi.”UGodongwana uthe kuzosetshenziswa izinhlelo ezifana nokufakwa kwamasolar, izinhlelo ezintsha zokukhiqizwa kukagesi ukubhekana nenkinga yokushoda kwawo.UGodongwana uthe bazothula umbiko mayelana nesimo seziteshi zikagesi ezisebenzisa amalahle.Lo mbiko obuwenziwa yinkampani ezimele waphothulwa ngonyaka owedlule, uGodongwana uthe bazowethula lingakapheli isonto.Kukhona abafuna ukuthi iziteshi ezisebenzisa amalahle zivalwe.

KUPHOSELWE inselelo abafundi abenza izifundo zezokuvakasha ukuthi basimamise lo mkhakha owumgomgodla wokuthuthukisa ezomnotho kuleli. Lo mbukiso ubuhlelwe wuMnyango wezokuThuthukiswa koMnotho, ezokuVakasha nezeMvelo esifundazweni ngenhloso yokucija abafundi abakulo mkhakha. Lokhu kusinika ithemba lokuthi lo mkhakha uya ngokukhula,” kusho yena.UMnuz Sibonelo Nzimande, obemele umnyango obuhlele lo mbukiso, ukhuthaze abafundi ukuthi bangawubukeli phansi lo mkhakha futhi yibona asebeyithemba lokuba ngongoti bawo.UNzimande ubuye wamukelisa imiklomelo abafundi abawine emncintiswaneni owenziwa yilo mnyango minyaka yonke, ukukhuthaza abafundi. Omunye wabafundi abawinile nguSphesihle Hlophe (17) waseNombika High eNdwedwe, ophume phambili emkhakheni we-One Day Itinerary."Kulo mncintiswano bekudingeka senze uhlelo lokuvakasha oluzoheha izivakashi. Ngikhethe ukucwaninga ngendawo yangasekhaya ngisizwa ngabantu bendawo. Ukuba kulo mbukiso kunginike ulwazi olunzulu engizoludinga njengoba ngifuna ukugxila emkhakheni wezokuvakasha,” kusho uSphesihle. Usinika ithuba lokufunda kabanzi nangamasiko amanye amazwe,” kusho uNkk Memela.IMeya yoMkhandlu wasoLundi, uMnuz Wilson Ntshangase, ithe bayakujabulela ukuthi umbukiso ulethwe Ondini lapho kunomlando ocebile namagugu.Bangaphezu kuka-30 osomabhizinisi nezikhungo ezahlukene ebeziyingxenye yalo mbukiso.Bathole ithuba lokuchazela abafundi ngamabhizinisi namathuba emisebenzi ahambisana nomkhakha wezokuvakasha. Lo mbukiso uhanjelwe ngabafundi abalinganiselwa ku-4000 ngezinsuku ezimbili, bededelana ngokucobelelana ulwazi.

BATHI bazizwa engathi basebasha ogogo abaqhamuka emalokishini ehlukene abizwa nge-INK, ahlanganisa iNanda, Ntuzuma noMashu, njengoba bengaphansi kohlelo lokujima olubizwa ngeNqubeko Senior Citizens.BATHI bazizwa engathi basebasha ogogo abaqhamuka emalokishini ehlukene abizwa nge-INK, ahlanganisa iNanda, Ntuzuma noMashu, njengoba bengaphansi kohlelo lokujima olubizwa ngeNqubeko Senior Citizens.Labo gogo abaxhaswe yiKCap ngendawo yokujima, bathi kabasaxakwa nayizifo ezingamahlalakhona njengoba bejima izinsuku ezine ngesonto kule ndawo.Bathe uhlelo abangaphansi kwalo lwaqala ngo-2016, futhi silokhu sinyuka isibalo sabo njengoba belokhu bememana ukuthi bazojima. Bathe sebengaphezu kuka-40 bebonke abangaphansi kwalolu hlelo. Ukujima bathe kubenza bahlale benomdlandla kugweme nokuguga kubona futhi babuye bathole nethuba lokuqeqeshelwa ukulingisa imidlalo yeshashalazi kulesi sikhungo.UNkk Thembisile Khoza (60) wakwa-F, eNtuzuma, uthe usehlala ezizwa ejabule ngenxa yokuthi uhlala ejima."Siza izinsuku ezine ngesonto eKCap ukuzojima ekuseni. Angisahlali ngikhathele njengoba bekwenzeka kudala. Indlela engizizwa ngiphila ngayo ingenza ngizizwe njengengane. Angisahlali nginesizungu njengakudala njengoba ngihlala ngijima,” kusho uNkk Khoza.UNkk Nana Nzoyiya (61) wakwa-D KwaMashu, uthe bengogogo bathathe isinqumo sokuthi bashiye abazukulu bazojima."Okusijabulisayo ukuthi asigcini ngokujima kodwa sibuye sidlale nemidlalo esigcina sithokozile. Emva kokuzwa ngalolu hlelo ngamema abanye ogogo esisonta nabo ukuthi silujoyine futhi luyasisebenzela njengoba sesihlala sijabule,” usho kanje.UNkk Siziwe Ngwane (69) wakwa-B KwaMashu, uthe abantu abamkholwa ukuthi unale minyaka ngendlela asebukeka emncane ngayo."Kwesinye isikhathi ngike ngijime ngokwehla ngenyuka izitebhisi ekhaya. Abantu baze babuze ukuthi kanti ngimngakanani ngendlela engisuke ngikhombisa ngayo umdlandla. Nakwami angiseyona into ehlala ilele nje kodwa ngiyakhwishiza,” kusho yena.Omdala kunabo bonke bathe nguNkk Nana Mdima (80) obengafikanga izolo. Bathe uma engaqhamuka singadideka, sizitshele ukuthi kuseyintombazanyana ngendlela akhombisa ukuphila ngayo.Bathe nabantu ababajimisayo babaphethe kahle futhi bayasebenza ngempela ngoba kubona abasakuthathi ngokuthi bajimisa abantu abadala, ngoba sebenomdlandla owenele ukumelana nazo zonke izitayela zokujima.Imenenja yeKCap, uThobile Ximba, uthe ogogo babuye babaxhase ngokubaqeqesha ngokulingisa imidlalo yeshashalazi.

IZINYUNYANA zabasebenzi zithi kuzohlupheka abampofu njengoba izinkampani zilokhu zimemezela izinhlelo zokudiliza abasebenzi ezweni.Kuleli sonto i-Anglo Platimum imemezele ukuthi izodiliza abasebenzi abawu-3 712 nosonkontileka abawu-620.IKumba Iron Ore imemezele ukuthi yona izodiliza abawu-500.Isolezwe libike ukuthi kuzodiliza abasebenzi abawu-6 000 eSouth African Post Office, kudilizwe abawu-214 eSouth African Breweries.Zisamile izinhlelo zokudiliza abasebenzi abawu-3 500 enkampanini yensimbi, i-ArcelorMittal.IPhini likaNobhala Jikelele weNational Union of Mineworkers (Num), uMnuz Mpho Phakedi, lithe badidekile ngesenzo esinonya sabaqashi sokudiliza isibalo esiningi kangaka sabasebenzi."Thina sithole izincwadi zase-Ango Platinum naseKumba Iron Ore, ezithi kuzodilizwa abasebenzi abayela ku-5 000. Yisenzo esinonya, esizohluphekisa abasebenzi basezimayini abampofu. Sizokwenza konke okusemandleni ukulwa naso kodwa kufanele sisho ukuthi sikhathazekile ngokuphela kwemisebenzi,” kusho uPhakedi.Uthe izinkampani ezidilizayo zikhale ngokungabikho kukagesi, amaguzu ahambisa impahla emachwebeni nezingqinamba emkhakheni wensimbi."Asiphiki ukuthi zikhona izingqinamba kodwa abaqashi bahambisa phambili inzuzo kunenhlalakahle yabasebenzi. Bafuna ukuletha amarobhothi ezimayini. Kubuhlungu ngoba vele eNingizimu Afrika sinesibalo sabantu abaningi abangasebenzi,” kuchaza uPhakedi.Ucele uhulumeni ukuba alungise indaba yokunqamuka kukagesi, izinkinga zamaguzu nokulethwa kwensimbi yaphesheya eshibhile kuleli.Ukhale ngokuthi uma zingakalungi lezi zingqinamba, abaqashi bazolokhu bediliza abasebenzi.UMnuz Trevor Shaku, okhulumela iSouth African Federation of Trade Unions (Saftu), ucele uhulumeni ukuba asukume alungise inkinga kagesi, eyengqalasizinda endala, eyamaguzu nokusebenza kwamachweba.Uthe lezi zinkinga aziphazamisi nje izimboni ezinkulu kodwa ziphazamisa nempilo yabantu nsuku zonke.Ugxeke uhulumeni ngokungabi nesisombululo senkinga kagesi yize sekuphele iminyaka iququda abantu baseNingizimu Afrika.Ucele osozimboni ukuba bahlale phansi nezinyunyana ukuze kutholakale isisombululo ezinkingeni ezigcina zilahlekisela abantu ngemisebenzi.UMnuz Matthew Parks, okhulumela iCosatu ePhalamende, naye uthe azicacile kahle izinhlelo zokudala amathuba omsebenzi njengoba neposi lizodiliza inqwaba yabantu.Uthe yize bezwa ukuthi uhulumeni uzosebenzisana nezinkampani ezizimele ukukhiqiza ugesi kodwa akucaci kahle ukuthi uzohamba kanjani, njengoba kufanele kulungiswe uhlelo lokuwusabalalisa.Uphethe ngokuthi bayaqhubeka nokulwela inhlalakahle yabasebenzi baseNingizimu Afrika.Khonamanjalo uNgqongqoshe wezabaSebenzi, uMnuz Thulas Nxesi, ucele i-Anglo Platinum ukuba ihlangane nezinyunyana ukuze kuzomiswa noma kuncishiswe isibalo semisebenzi engase ilahleke.
ITHWALE kanzima, yaphuma ihlehla iNkosi yaMaqadi uMqoqi Ngcobo, emhlanganweni waminyaka yonke wamaNazaretha oqhubeka eGoli ngemuva kokusuka kwempikiswano yokungeneliseki kwabanye ebuholini bebandla.Umhlangano waseGoli uqale ngesonto eledlule, uzoze uphele ngeSabatha. Kuthiwa iNkosi uMqoqi kuphoqeleke ukuthi iphume ngesamagundane kuwona yabuyela eThekwini ngenxa yokwesaba ukwenzakaliswa.Umthombo okhulume neSolezwe uthe umsindo ususwe wukubonakala kweNkosi yamaQadi ebivinjwa ukuthi imemezele ukubuyiselwa esikhundleni koMfundisi omkhulu waseGoli obemisiwe. Kuthiwa kukhona osevele usiqhoqhobele lesi sikhundla esimqoka ebandleni."Kunomfundisi owamiswa, obephethe wonke amathempeli aseGoli. Emva kwakhe kuthathe omunye okunguyena ozwa sifudumele lesi sikhundla ongasafuni ukugudluka kuso. UMfundisi obemisiwe usanda kubuyela enkonzweni njengoba bonke ababemisiwe banikwe ushwele wuNyazilwezulu,” kuchaza umthombo. "Lo ongafuni ukugudluka, kusolwa ukuthi wuyena othumele inhlalisuthi ukuthi ixoshe iNkosi yamaQadi eGoli nethimba layo. Inkinga iqale ngesikhathi abahamba neQadi befuna incazelo ngokungadingeki kwalo. Abaphendulwanga, kuvele kwaqhuma iqupha kwaphoqeleka ukuthi iNkosi iQadi nethimba baphume ngesamagundane,” kusho umthombo.Leli phephandaba linenkulumo eqoshiwe lapho kukhuluma khona omunye wamaNazaretha, ethi okwenziwe ngabantu baseGoli kungukususa impi."Uma kushaywa iQadi kufana nokuthi kushaywe uNyazilwezulu uqobo lwalo. Uma ushaya umntwana wenkosi kusuke kufana nokuthi ushaya inkosi ngqo. Uma sithula lokho kusho ukuthi asizona izinsizwa la KwaZulu-Natal. Ibandla lamaNazaretha lisemaQadini, ngisho namakhosi amane amaNazaretha atshalwe khona eMaqadini. Lapha ngisho kusuka kubabamkhulu uMphrofethi uMqaliwendlela, Ilanga, iNyangayezulu noThingolwenkosazana. Akukwazi ukuthi kungathintwa umuntu omkhulu kangaka emaQadini bese kuyathuleka,” kusho inkulumo eqoshiwe.Kuthintwa iNkosi yamaQadi, ithe impela kuphoqeleke ukuthi ibuye eGoli ngenxa yalesi simo.Ithe okugqamile wukuthi wonke amakhosi esizwe abawafuni eGoli, ngendlela abaziphathe ngayo. Ithe abantu ababambane ngezandla kube yithimba layo, okukhona kulona nohlaka lwayo uSqwa Ngcobo behlaselwa yinhlalisuthi yaseGoli. Iqhube yathi, izoqoqa wonke amakhosi kuyokhulunywa lolu daba kumholi uNyazilwezulu uma sekuphele umhlangano ngoba abebelwa bebekuveza ukuthi abawafuni wonke amakhosi. Okwamanje ithe awekho amacala avuliwe ngokuhlaselwa kwabo eGoli ngoba basalinde ukuthi kuyobikwa udaba oNyazini.Okhulumela uNyazilwezulu, uMnuz Thokozani Mncwabe, uthe beyibandla bazongenela ukulungisa lolu daba."Yimbi le nto eyenziwe abantu baseGoli eQadini. Okubuhlungu uyaziwa umuntu okunguyena ophehla lolu dweshu. Uma eziphathisa okwenkabi akumele azibize ngeNazaretha. Ibandla lamaNazaretha elokhuthula noxolo. Uma eqhuba kanje, yena uzongena kanjani eMaQadini? "INkosi yamaQadi ihlonipheke kabi ukuthi kungenzeka into enje kuyona. Angazi noma abantu sebekukhohliwe yini esakwenzelwa yiQadi ngokuthi limemezele inkosi yamaNazaretha uNyazilwezulu. Ikomiti lizohlangana ukulungisa lolu daba kodwa uma lihluleka kuzomele lwethulwe ebandleni, ukuze kuphume isinqumo ngokumele kwenzeke,” kusho uMncwabe.
KUNEMIBIKO ethi umsebenzi kaMasipala weTheku uMnuz Mlungisi Professor Mondlana (36), oboshelwe ukucekela phansi amakhamera nokweba akaqali ukunukeka entweni efanayo.UMondlana uboshwe ngoLwesibili emahhovisi omkhandlu weTheku emuva kophenyo olunzulu. Kuvele ukuthi ubephenywa wuphiko lwangaphakathi lubambisene namaphoyisa omkhandlu nawakwaSAPS. Usolwa ngokucekela phansi amakhamera nokweba ithelevishini, okuyizimpahla zoMkhandlu weTheku awusebenzelayo. Kuthiwa kukhona obekungahambi kahle kwathi uma kuphenywa wavela kumakhamera. Okunye okuvelayo wukuthi ucekele phansi amakhamera abesanda kufakwa kabusha ukuze kuliwe nobugebengu eThekwini.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi uMondlana wake wasolwa ngokujikisa ikhamera ngesikhathi kubulawa owayeyikhansela laseMlaza uMnuz Sibusiso "Bhabhane” Maphumulo. UMaphumulo wadutshulwa wabulawa ngo-2018 ephuma emhlanganweni wenhlangano yakhe.UNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa uMnuz Bheki Cele wakhala ngokuthi bathole ukuthi ikhamera yomuzi yajikiswa ngaphambi kwesigameko ukuze ingasiqophi.UNkosingiphile Gumede okwavela ukuthi wayeyinkabi waboshwa wagwetshwa ngokufa kwekhansela uMaphumulo.Izingede zeSolezwe zithi uMondlana wasolwa kakhulu ngokujikiswa kwekhamera."Wake waze wathathwa abantu ababezenza amaphoyisa bahamba naye bayomshaya kanzima wacishe wafa. Wayesolwa kakhulu ngendaba yekhamera ngoba uhlala khona futhi kulowo mgwaqo okwenzeka kuwona isigameko,’’ kusho umthombo.UMondlana uvele eNkantolo yeMantshi eThekwini ebhekene namacala amabili elokuphambana nomthetho wokulwa nobugebengu ngezobuchwepheshe. Uthweswe necala lokweba ngoba kuthiwa weba ithelevishini kamasipala.Okhulumela abezokushushisa uNkk Natasha Ramakisson-Kara, echaza ngamacala uthe:" Amacala asukela ekutheni usolwa ngokuphazamisa ukusebenza kwamakhamera kaMasipala weTheku nokweba ithelevishini. Uvelile enkantolo icala lahlehlela uFebhuwari 29 ukuze acele ibheyili,’’ kusho uNkk Kara.UMondlana uboshwa nje uvele kade esemisiwe emsebenzini emuva kokuthi uphenyo lomkhandlu lumkhombile. Kuthiwa ubizwe esekhaya umkhandlu kukhona ofuna ukukuxoxa naye kwabe sekufika amaphoyisa amxhakathisa khona lapho.
UKHONGOLOSE uthi kunesimanga esizokwenzeka esizodala inhlokomo enkulu emcimbini wayo wokwethula izethembiso zokhetho enkundleni iMoses Mabhida. IPhini likaNobhala-Jikelele, uNkk Nomvula Mokonyane, lisho lokhu ngesikhathi ithimba labaholi lihlola inkundla yomcimbi.Umkhankaso we-ANC uzoholwa nguMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ozokwethula inkulumo yosuku.Inkundla iMoses Mabhida ibonakala iwumfula lapho ziphuza khona zonke njengoba amaqembu esina ededelana kuyo. I-ANC yelama i-EFF esivele ibuya khona eMoses Mabhida, yethula izethembiso zayo.I-ANC izokwelanywa yi-IFP ngoMashi 10, nayo ezobe isenkundleni efanayo yethula izethembiso zokhetho. Kulindeleke ukuthi kube matasa eMoses Mabhida, kudanswe kuculwe kube njeyaya uma uKhongolose sewethula izethembiso zawo.Ithimba ebeliholwa nguNobhala-Jikelele, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, lichazele abezindaba ngamalungiselelo omcimbi. I-ANC ihlela umcimbi ezoba inekela kuwo abantu bakuleli izethembiso zayo zokhetho.Ithimba liqede ukukhuluma nabezindaba lase lehla lenyuka enkundleni laze langena phakathi otshanini lihamba likhomba, lichaza ngokuzobe kwenzeka. Kulapho-ke uNkk Mokonyane aveze khona ukuthi kuzokwenzeka isimanga thizeni."Kukhona into enzima kabi enizoyibona uma umengameli eqeda ukusho isiqubulo sethu esithi 'Ayihlome ihlasele!’ Kuzokwenzeka isimanga esingachazeki kodwa yinto enizozibonela yona,’’ kusho uNkk Mokonyane ehleka kancane.Bathe abezindaba bezama ukumshishibeza ngemibuzo ngemfihlo, wanqaba wangafuna ukuchaza. Kuze kwenanela uMbalula encokola ethi wuyena ozokwehla ngentambo esuka phezu kwenkundla.Kube yinsini yodwa emuva kwalokho, besho khona ukuthi kuzobonakala izimanga zikaMichael Jackson. Basho kanjena nje, uMengameli we-EFF, uMnuz Julius Malema, wake walandelwa yinhlokomo ekhuphuka ngomshini thizeni esteji enkundleni i-FNB.Abaholi be-ANC bathi benze konke okusemandleni ukuhlela nokunxenxa abantu ukuze inkundla igcwale kusasa. Bathe balindele abantu abacela ku-75 000 abazohlala, abanye bahlale enkundleni otshanini bese abanye behlala endaweni engaphandle.BEBEPHUMILE abesifazane enkonzweni yomkhuleko ye-ANC Women’s League enkundleni iWestridge eThekwini, izolo. Lo mkhuleko wendulela umcimbi omkhulu wokwethula umqulu wezethembiso ozoba senkundleni yezemidlalo iMoses Mabhida kusasa Isithombe: SIBONELO NGCOBO/INDEPENDENT MEDIA
UNGQONGQHOSHE weMisebenzi yoMphakathi neNgqalasizinda, uMnuz Sihle Zikalala unxuse amalungu omphakathi ukuthi ayiphathise okwezikhali zamaNtungwa iNkantolo yeMantshi yasePort Shepstone, ebivulwa ngokusemthethweni.UZikalala ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ehambele kule ndawo nezinye izikhulu zikahulumeni, okukhona kuzo noNgqongqoshe woMnyango wezoBulungiswa, uMnuz Ronald Lamola.UZikalala uthe ukuvulwa kwenkantolo esezingeni eliphezulu kusho lukhulu emizamweni yabo yokuqinisekisa ukutholakala kwezobulungiswa ebantwini basendaweni."Izoqinisa ukuthula iphinde ixazulule ukungaboni ngasolinye nomsindo kulandelwa indlela efanele, okungumthetho,” kusho uZikalala.Uqhube wathi bayajabula ukuthi umsebenzi wokwakhiwa kwayo ugcine uphothuliwe njengoba kwaqalwa eminyakeni elinganiselwa eshumini eyedlule."Kube nezingqinamba eziningi. NgoSepthemba 2021 kwagcina kuqokwa omunye usonkontileka okwazile ukuthi aqede umsebenzi ngesikhathi ayebekelwe sona,” kusho uZikalala.Ubuye wathi okunye okubuye kwaphazamisa ukwakhiwa kwayo ngama-forum amabhizinisi adume ngokuphazamisa ukwakhiwa nokulungiswa kwezakhiwo zikahulumeni. La ma-forum asuke efuna ngodli ukuhleshulelwa umsebenzi uma kuqhubeka umsebenzi wokwakha. Ubalule ukuthi isezingeni eliphezulu inkantolo futhi phakathi kukhona izinto ezilekelela abantu abakhubazekile nezobuchwepheshe ezisezingeni. Uveze nokuthi ukwakhiwa kwayo kudale inqwaba yamathuba omsebenzi ezakhamizini zasendaweni njengoba ziqeqeshwe kancane emikhakheni ehlukene.
KUMBANGELA ukhwantalala nengcindezi ukucabanga ngosuku okwabulawa ngalo umyeni wakhe, umfelokazi wephoyisa eladutshulwa eWolawola, eNanda ngo-2021.UNksz Thokoza Sibisi wayeyingoduso yephoyisa, uWarrant Officer Maqhawe Sithole (54) owadutshulwa esigamekweni esenzeka kwakhe ngo-24 Juni 2021.Umufi wadutshulwa ngabesilisa abangaziwa eNanda maqede bamphuca isibhamu base bayabaleka.Ngemuva kwalokho ngoJuni 29 amaphoyisa abopha, uMnuz Thembokwakhe Xulu (26) waseMayville ongumsolwa wokuqala.Kwathi ngoJulayi 6 abopha umsolwa wesibili, uMnuz Nkululeko Ntuli (23) waKwaMaphumulo. Bobabili abakaze bayithole ibheyili.Izolo eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseNtuzuma, uNksz Sibisi ubethula ubufakazi ngakubona kwenzeka ngosuku lwesigameko.Utshele inkantolo ukuthi umnyombo wengxabano phakathi kukamufi nabesilisa ababili kwaba ukuthi bamthuka."Mina laba bantu ngangizitshela ukuthi bazongibamba inkunzi ngesikhathi besondela eduze kwami,'' kuchaza yena.Uthe abesilisa babebabili, oyedwa owayegqoke isikibha esimhlophe wamthuka futhi ezenza umuntu odakiwe."Ngesikhathi ngibona ukuthi laba bantu bafuna ukulwa nami ngasuka ngemoto. Bona beza kimina ngokushesha baqamba amanga bathi ngibashayisile,'' kuchaza yena.Ngemuva kwalokho uthe umufi wasondela wababuza ukuthi bamthukelani umkakhe."Kwasuka isixakaxaka lapho. Ngasuka ngokushesha lapho ngoba ngangibona ukuthi kukhona ingozi,'' kuchaza yena.Uthe wabuya sekuthiwa usedutshuliwe umufi, uthe wavele wazulelwa yikhanda base bemphuthumisa esibhedlela ngemoto yomunye wesilisa athe igama lakhe nguDeon.Uthe ngemuva kwezinsuku ezimbili wathola izindaba ezibuhlungu zokuthi umyeni wakhe usedlulile emhlabeni.Ulandise inkantolo ngobunzima bempilo kusukela athola izindaba zokuthi useshonile uSithole."Ngiye ngizizwe nginokhwantalala nengcindezi engingayazi ukuthi ivelaphi njalo uma ngicabanga ngokubulawa kwakhe. Yebo khona ngaya kwabaluleka ngengqondo kodwa le nkinga namanje isakhona,'' echazela inkantolo.Uthe ukhwantalala lumvuka kakhulu uma ecabanga ngezingane zabo ezimbili amshiya nazo.Eyokuqala uthe ineminyaka eyisishiyagalolunye, eyesibili ifunda u-matric nonyaka ineminyaka engu-17."Lo ofunda u-matric ubalisa njalo ngokuthi ukuba uyise usaphila ngabe kuningi okuhamba kahle. Ngivele ngiphatheke kabi njalo uma ngimuzwa esho njalo,'' kuchaza yena.Uthe kwesinye isikhathi ubuye ahlulwe nayimali yasesikoleni abone nje ukuthi kwavula isikhala esikhulu ukubulawa kukayise wezingane zakhe.IMantshi, uM. Motala icala ube eselihlehlisela uMeyi 7 no 8 nonyaka ukuze kuqhubeke nokuthi kubizwe abanye ofakazi."Basebaningi abanye ofakazi okusamele beze lapha bazofakaza kuleli cala,'' kugcizelela uMotala.

UMENGAMELI Cyril Ramaphosa uhlabe ikhwelo kubaholi bomdabu ukuthi bashumayeze ivangeli lokuthula kanjalo nokubekezelelana uma kukhankaswa njengoba kuzovotwa ngoMeyi 29. URamaphosa uthe abantu kumele bakhululeke futhi bavotele noma ngubani, bangakhethelwa abaholi ukuthi yiliphi iqembu okumele balivotele."Ingakho sinxenxa abaholi bomdabu ukuthi bashumayeze leli vangeli ezindaweni abezangamele njengoba seluphumile usuku lokhetho. Abaholi abahlukene bazoza ezindaweni eziphethwe ngamakhosi beyokhankasa, kwabona abatshelwe ukuthi kumele bakhankase ngokuthula bangaxovi,” kusho uRamaphosa evula iNdlu yobaHoli boMdabu namaKhoi-San, eMkhandlwini wezifundazwe ePhalamende eKapa izolo. Uthe akusekho ukujikela emuva ngokhetho njengoba kuwusuku obelubhekwe ngabomvu."Abantu bakuleli bazobe bevotela uhulumeni okwesikhombisa ngaphansi kwentando yabantu. Lokhu kuhambisana nemigubho yeminyaka engu-30, kwatholakala inkululeko. Yingakho sinxenxa abaholi bomdabu ukuthi bagqugquzele abantu ukuthi baphume bayovota.”URamaphosa ugxeke nokubulawa kwabaholi bomdabu, ikakhulu KwaZulu-Natal, wathi bakhathazekile ngalesi sihlava."Sikhathazekile ngokubulawa kwabaholi bomdabu, ikakhulu eKZN. Siyalele abezomthetho ukuthi babophe noma ngubani othinteka kulokhu kubulawa kwabaholi bomphakathi.”Usho lokhu nje babalelwa ku-29 abaholi bomdadu okuhlanganisa amakhosi nezinduna, asebebulewe esifundazweni, eminyakeni emithathu edlule. Amaphoyisa athi ukubulawa kwabo kuhlanganisa izinto eziningi, ezithinta umbango wezikhundla, umbango wendawo, umbango othinta amabhizinisi nokunye.URamaphosa ukhumbule iqhaza lomsunguli we-IFP ongasekho, iNkosi Mangosuthu Buthelezi, wathi likhulu igebe alishiyile ebuholini bomdabu.Uthe uShenge ubehlale ekhona uma kuvulwa iNdlu yabaHoli boMdabu."Ubehlale ezosho okuthile uma kunenkulumompikiswano ngezithinta abaholi bomdabu. Iqhaza lakhe liyabonakala njengoba engasekho. Siyohlale sibukhumbula ubuhlakani bukaMntwana.”Ubuye wanxenxa laba baholi ukuthi babambe iqhaza ekulweni nesihlava sokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane lapho bebusa khona."Le ngenye yezinselelo esibhekene nazo siyizwe. Kudingeka sibambe imikhankaso lapho sihlala khona yokugqugquzela abesilisa ukuthi kuliwe nalesi sihlava.”Uzwakalise ukukhathazeka ngezingane zesikole azibona zeqa imifula eyingozi uma ziya esikoleni.Uveze ukuthi yingakho befuqa umkhankaso wokwakha amabhuloho abizwa ngeWelisizwe ukuze kuqedwe ngale nkinga."Angu-96 amabhuloho afuze lawa esiwakhayo kuleli, amanye asephelile kanti amanye awakapheli. Siyaqhubeka nokwakha amanye ngoba iyangikhathaza eyokubona izingane ezincane zewela imifula eyingozi uma ziya ezikoleni.”Uzwakalise ukukhathazeka ngabafana abaya entabeni beyosokwa abagcina ngokuthi babuye sebeyizidumbu emakhaya."Kumele igqugquzelwe eyokuthi noma lenziwa isiko lokusoka kodwa abafana babuye bephila njengoba besuke behambe bephila. Iyasikhathaza eyokuthi abanye babo ababuyi emakhaya besaphila ngoba bafa besokwa.”
Uyolutheza olunenkume: Ukuyotheza wukuyogawula noma ukuqoqa izinkuni zokubasa umlilo. Inkume yisilwane esifana neshongololo kodwa sona siyashesha kunalo. Kunenkolelo yokuthi inkume iyakwazi ukungena kumuntu ngemuva iguduze njalo ngaphakathi ibhodloze amathumbu imbulale.Kuyenzeka uma umuntu eyotheza abuye nenkume ngoba ikhonzile ukuhala ehlathini nasezinkunini. Umuntu obeyotheza uhambanayo inkume icashe okhunini ize ifike ekhaya ibe yingozi kubantu.Lesi saga sixwayisa umuntu ongalaleli uma etshelwa ukuthi uzozilandela ingozi ayilethe eduze naye. Kuthiwa uyolutheza ugodo noma ukhuni olunenkume bese kunqanyulelwa kuthiwa uyolutheza olunenkume.Ukuyosika ilala : Ilala wuhlobo oluthile lotshani olutholakala ezansi nomfula noma usuyongenela olwandle. Kuyenzeka abantu baphume umkhankaso bayofuna ilala ngoba lisebenza ukwenza izinto ezehlukene.Uma umuntu emuke nomfula kuthiwa uye ukuyosika ilala, kuyenzeka egcine etholwe entanta kulona ilala ezinkwazini zomfula eseshonile.Ukufa kabili okomkhovu:UMKHOVU wumuntu osuke ethwetshulwe ngabathakathi, bethi ufile aze angcwatshwe kanti bafuna ukumsebenzisa ngezindlela zabo. Lowo muntu usuke ezoqhubeka aphile kumthakathi emenzisa imisebenzi yakhe kodwa umkhovu uma usuphelelwe yisikhathi uyafa futhi.Kususelwa lapho ukuthi umuntu ufa imfakabili okomkhovu. Lesi sisho sisebenza kumuntu osuke ehlelwe yinto embi iphindelela.Kuntwela ezansi/sekuntwela ezansi :Ukuntwela wukuvela kokukhanya ebumnyameni. Kuthi uma kade kusebusuku sekusa, uma ubuka kude kusuke kungathi kunesikhala phakathi komkhathi. Kuleso sikhala kubonakala kubomvana, kuvela ukukhanya kwemisebe yelanga.Uma kukhona isimo esibonakala sisibi, kungathi ngeke silunge kodwa kuzanywe kancane kancane sigcine silunga. Kuthi uma sekuqala kuthembisa bese kuthiwa sekuyantwela ezansi.Ulwazi lucashunwe encwadini ebhalwe wu-Emmanuel Phumani Zondi ethi Siphuza Emithonjeni Yokhokho
BASHAYISANA ngamakhanda othisha nabazali njengoba abezokuphepha bevale amakilasi okuthiwa awaphephile kwasala ikilasi elilodwa esikoleni okumele bonke abafundi bafunde kulo.Abazali basesikoleni iMahhafana Primary eseMzimkhulu, sebegqigqe amasonto amabili esikoleni, beyobuza ngezincwadi ezifike nabafundi ezithi kuvalwe amakilasi amathathu kulesi sikole esiqala kuGrade R siye kuGrade 7.BASHAYISANA ngamakhanda abazali kuvalwa amakilasi amathathu eMahhafana Primary, eMzimkhulu Isithombe: SITHUNYELWE Abazali bathi la makilasi abevele engenele kufunda kuwo ama-grade ngamabili ekilasini elilodwa. Kuhlwe emini uma sekufika umhloli ohlola ukuphepha kwamabhilidi ezikoleni ngoFebhruwari 11, ethi uyawavala amathathu, akasafuni muntu ozongena kuwona. Kusale elingumahamba nendlwana elifundela uGrade R.Omunye wabazali onengane efunda uGrade 4, uthe isigungu sokuphathwa kwesikole sibize umhlangano sabonisana ngokuthi okungcono leli kilasi elikhona kushintshwane ngalo kunokuthi izingane zihlale emakhaya."Ingane iya kanye esikoleni, kulezi zingane kunezingane ezifunda uGrade 7 ezizoya ezikoleni zamabanga aphezulu. Asazi zizofika zinjani. Uthishanhloko uthi akazi ukuthi isikole sizowathola yini amakilasi angomahamba nendlwana noma abafundi bazoyiswa kwesinye isikole," kusho lo mzali.Usihlalo wesigungu sabazali sokuphathwa kwesikole, i-School Governing Body (SGB), uNkk Khonzeni Dlamini, uthe kuyiqiniso ukuthi izindonga zamakilasi zineminkenke, bacabanga ukuthi kudalwa izihlahla ezisesikoleni."Umhloli obheka ukuphepha ezikoleni wabala ukuklayeka kwezindonga njengobungozi obudala ukuthi awavale, ukuphuma kwezipikili ophahleni okungaholela ekutheni uma kunesiphepho uphahla luphephuke kalula, ithoyilethi elibhodlokile nokungabikhona kwamanzi esikoleni njengoba sithembele emanzini emvula. "Ngosuku afika ngalo kwakungekho ngisho ibhakede lamanzi esikoleni. Siyavuma ukuthi lezi zinto azibalayo zisho ukuthi akuphephile kodwa manje esifuna ukukwazi ukuthi kuzokwenzekani ngezingane zethu? Sekuphele amasonto amabili umnyango ungasitsheli lutho, uthishanhloko ushaya ucingo phambi kwami abhalele umhloli kodwa abaphenduli. Sesize saqhamuka nokuthi ingane ngayinye ize kanye ngesonto esikoleni nokulimaza izingane," kuyo uNkk Dlamini.UMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uthintiwe ukuze uphawule ngalolu daba kodwa awuphendulanga.

USONGELWA ngokuthi uzomangalelwa umholi wentsha yoMkhonto weSizwe, uBonginkosi Khanyile ngesigameko sokukhaca ilungu leqembu, uThamsanqa 'Mavikabemshaya’ Khuzwayo. UKhanyile ongumholi wesikhashana wentsha yoMkhonto weSizwe, wabonakala kwividiyo ekhaca uKhuzwayo, emcimbini lapho owayengumengameli uMnuz Jacob Zuma amemezela iqembu uMkhonto weSizwe, wathi uzolikhankasela alivotele. Kuthiwa leso sigameko singesinye sezimdonsele amanzi ngomsele eqenjini, wabizwa waqondiswa ubugwegwe njengoba sekulandela incwadi yabameli.Isolezwe liyibonile incwadi yabameli beWendy Cele and Associates ekhomba ukuthi ibhalwe ngoFebhruwari 20 enegama likaKhanyile. Isigameko esasabalala ezinkundleni zokuxhumana senzeka maphakathi nenyanga ngesikhathi intsha yeMK inomhlangano wesifundo ngemfundo yamahhala. Umhlangano wawusehholo kwaQ eMlaza, emasontweni adlule.UKhuzwayo exoxa neSolezwe uthe ulufake kubameli udaba ngoba uthunazwe yindlela akhacwa ngayo nezinsolo ezivezwa wuKhanyile athe azinasisekelo."Sake saxabana siseyizitshudeni eDUT. Ngiyasola usabambe leyo nto. Namanje sibange indaba yokusungulwa kophiko lwezitshudeni lweMK wenqaba yena wathi uphiko lwentsha kufanele lusebenze emanyuvesi,’’ kusho uKhuzwayo.Uthe ngesikhathi eya emhlanganweni eMlaza lapho akhacwa khona, wayengahlose lutho olubi wayeya njengelungu."Wathi uma engibona wavuka inja ebomvu wangihlohloloza, wathi angiphume ngoba ngiwumdayisi ofuna ukuketula uZuma. Wathi ngikhokhelwa wuDD Mabuza, ungithengele indlu. Kuningi nje ayekusho okufanele akuhoxise noma aveze ubufakazi, kungenjalo ngiya enkantolo,’’ kusho uKhuzwayo.UKhanyile ebuzwa ngalolu daba lwencwadi, uthe ucela ukunikwa isikhathi ngoba usesibhedlela." Ngikhuluma nawe nje ngisesibhedlela okwamanje futhi incwadi leyo yinto engathi shu, ngeke ibaluleke ukwedlula impilo yami,’’ kusho uKhanyile. UKhuzwayo uthe okubuhlungu wukuthi yena uwumuntu oneziqu zobuthishela oswele umsebenzi kodwa kuthiwa unikwa imali athengelwe nomuzi.

Lokhu kusiphatha kabi ngoba sifuna ubulungiswa ngokubulawa komfowethu. Zakhala kanye kwasa:Yini ekhalayo: Yizinkukhu. Uma sekusile bekuvame ukuzwakala ngokukhala kwezinkukhu ikakhulu, iqhude likikilida. Ngokuvamile izinkukhu noma iqhude zikikilida izikhawu eziningi kucace ukuthi kusile.Uma kuthiwa zakhala kanye kwasa kusuke kuqondwe ukuthi kusile khona engqondweni yomuntu othile kodwa hhayi kahle kufaniswa nokuthi washeshe wavuka, kungakasi kahle. Lokhu kusuke kushiwo uma kungabazeka ukuphila kahle emqondweni kumuntu.Ukuthela kamuva njengembumba: Imbumba yisithelo esisanhlamvu njengobhontshisi futhi iyaphuza ukuthela. Uma isitshalo sikhipha okudliwayo, kuthiwa siyathela. Lesi sisho sikhuthaza ukwenza izinto ngesikhathi, ungahlali ungumvakwezinye.Uma kuthiwa umuntu uthela kamuva okwembumba usuke ehlala esalela emuva uma kwenziwa izinto.Ukugeqa amagula sengathi uyemuka : Ukugeqa wukuthulula noma wukukhipha konke okuphakathi. Igula yisitsha esakhiwe ngoselwa okugcinwa kusona amasi. Uma umuzi uthutha kuyiwa kwenye indawo bekugeqwa amagula kuqedwe wonke amasi ukuze kuhanjwe nawo elula.Uma umuntu exoxa ekhipha konke okusenhlizweni ngesikhathi esisodwa, kuyaye kuthiwe ugeqa amagula sengathi uyemuka. UVUTHA ungabaselwe umphakathi waseWewe, eShongweni Dam, eThekwini, kulandela isigameko sokudlwengulwa kwengane yentombazane eneminyaka emibili enkulisa ngeledlule.Umgilwa kusolwa ukuthi udlwengulwe owesilisa oganwe amakhosikazi amabili anenkulisa kule ndawo ngoLwesithathu.NgoLwesibili, umphakathi obudinwe ugane unwabu uhlanganyele kule nkulisa ufuna ivalwe kulandela isigameko osichaze njengesinengayo.Ikhansela lendawo, uMnuz Luthando Jali, uthe umphakathi usibuka njengechilo lesi sigameko."Umphakathi udiniwe ngoba uyaqala ukubona amanyala afana nalawa endaweni. Ngesikhathi ngihambela kule nkulisa ngempelasonto, ngithe ayivalwe kodwa abanikazi bangishaya indiva,” kusho uJali.Uthe ngesikhathi befika endaweni yesigameko namaphoyisa, bafune izithombe zamakhamera ezikhombisa ukuthi kwenzekeni ngosuku lwesigameko kodwa bashaqeka uma bethola ukuthi azikho."Zona zodwa ezangalolu suku azitholakalanga. Sitshelwe ukuthi amakhamera abengasebenzi. Sisola ukuthi bayisuse ngamabomu ukucisha ubufakazi,” kusho uJali.Okunye okushaqisayo athe bakutholile, ukuthi amakhosikazi alona wesilisa osolwayo, athe akekho uthole umsebenzi eGauteng."Kuthiwa uwuthole ngosuku lwesigameko. Lokhu kuyasidida futhi kushiya imibuzo,” kusho uJali.Likhuluma nonina kamgilwa Isolezwe, uthe ubone esesekhaya ukuthi umgilwa wehlelwe yinkinga."Ngifike enkulisa ngizomlanda ngiphuma emsebenzini, kwenzeka okungajwayelekile ngimfica elele. Ngiqale nganganaka, ngamthatha, ngambeletha, sagoduka. Ngifike naye endlini, ngambeka phansi, waqhubeka nokulala,” kusho unina kamgilwa.Uthe kuphele isikhathi esingaphezu kwehora umgilwa elele, kwathi kusenjalo, wavula isikhwama sakhe sasenkulisa wakhangwa yiphenti lakhe ebelinokungcola okushiya imibuzo."Ngiye kuyena masinyane, ngamphenya kwesingezansi ngifuna ukubona ukuthi ngabe ulinyazwe yini ngoba ngimhambise enkulisa engenalutho. Ngibe sengizithela phezu kwesidoda esithweni sakhe sangasese, yilapho engisukume khona ngaya esibhedlela,” kuchaza unina kamgilwa.Eqhuba, uthe enkulisa kukhona ubaba wekhaya namadodana akhe amabili, bonke abangasabonwa."Ubaba wakhona kuthiwa uthole umsebenzi, amadodana akhe akuchazwa ukuthi wona anyamalale ashonaphi,” usho kanje.Uveze ukuthi kubuye kube khona abokufika (amaPakistani) aqashe isitolo kuleli khaya, wathi bona ababalekanga futhi bavule izandla bathi bazimisele ngokuya emaphoyiseni ukuyothathwa amasampula olibofuzo ukuze alekelele ophenyweni lwamaphoyisa nokuthi kuvele ukuthi bona bamsulwa.Uthe cishe zingu-25 izingane ezigadwa kule nkulisa, wathi kuzona kukhona ezisagonwa kuphinde kube khona esezikhulakhulile.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uConstable Thenjiswa Ngcobo, uthe amaphoyisa aKwaNdengezi aphenya icala lokunukubeza ngokocansi emva kokuthi owesifazane esole ukuthi indodakazi (2) yakhe ihlukunyeziwe."Uqaphele ukuthi kukhona okungahambi kahle endodakazini yakhe emva kokuyilanda enkulisa,” kusho uConst Ngcobo.UNgqongqoshe wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi uNkk Nonhlanhla Khoza, uthe sebethumele ithimba losonhlalakahle emndenini kamgilwa ukuyolekelela ngosizo lokwelulekwa ngokomqondo.Uthe lizophinde liqoqe nolwazi olubalulekile, oluzosiza nasophenyweni ngesigameko.Uqhube wathi ngokubambisana noMnyango wezeMfundo bazobhekisisa ukuthi inkulisa isebenza ngaphansi kwemigomo efanele yini ukuqinisekisa ukuphepha nenhlalakahle yezingane ezigadwa kuyo."Isigameko saloluhlobo siyakhathaza, sidweba nesithombe sobungozi okungafanele ingabe bukhona ezindaweni ezigcina izingane. Kufanele siqinisekise ukuthi buyenzeka ubulungiswa ngezgameko ezifuze lezi nokuthi kwenziwe konke okusemandleni ukuthi zingaphinde zenzeke,” kusho uNkk Khoza.
ZIZOKWEHLISELWA isikweletu ngohhafu wemali ezibolekwe yona izitshudeni ezaziwa nge-missing middle, ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme uma ziphasa izifundo zazo ngo-70% kuya phezulu. Lezi zitshudeni ezizobolekwa imali yokufunda yisikhwama iNational Students’ Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS), ngaphansi kohlelo olusha lwalesi sikhwama ngenxa yokuthi abazali bahola kakhulu okwenza ukuthi zingakwazi ukuthola umfundaze wamahhala.UDkt Marcia Socikwa isikhuli eMnyangweni weMfundo ePhakeme, utshele ikomiti lasePhalamende izolo, ukuthi lezi zitshudeni zizohlomula uma zenza kahle ezifundweni zazo.Uthe imibandela yokuthi zibolekwe imali yokufunda kufaka nokuthi kumele ziphase izifundo zazo ngo-60% kuya phezulu."Kodwa uma kungukuthi ziphasa izifundo zazo ngo-70% kuya phezulu zizokwehliselwa ngohhafu kuya phezulu izikweletu zazo. Le mali ezizobolekwa yona ngeke izale, zizoyikhokha injalo uma seziphothule izifundo.”Umqondisi jikelele emnyangweni, uDkt Nkosinathi Sishi, uveze ukuthi zingu-22 954 izitshudeni ezifake izicelo zokubolekwa imali kwiNSFAS.Uthe kulezi zicelo zibalelwa ku-139 ezisagunyazwe ukuthi zizobolekwa le mali, ezingu-12 890 zisalinde izimpendulo.USishi uveze ukuthi zingu-31 800 izitshudeni ezizobolekwa imali ngaphansi kwalolu hlelo olusha oluqale kulo nyaka."Kubekwe uR3.8 billion wokuboleka lezi zitshudeni imali yokufunda. Noma kuthiwa wenza muphi unyaka uzobolekwa imali uma uhlangabezana nemibandela ebekiwe.” "U-47% okwamanje ozobolekwa imali ngaphansi kohlelo olusha. Sizonyusa isibalo sabazobolekwa le mali eminyakeni ezayo, okwamanje lolu hlelo siyaluhlola ukuthi luzohamba kanjani.” Izitshudeni ezizobolekwa imali kumele zisayine isivumelwano sokuthi ziyabolekwa le mali. UNgqongqoshe walo mnyango, uDkt Blade Nzimande, uthe bakhathazekile ngesikweletu sezitshudeni ezikhungweni zemfundo esikhula minyaka yonke."Ngisho umengameli wezwe ukhathazekile ngokwanda kwalesi sikweletu. Ezweni elifana nelethu ngeke singabikhona isikweletu sezitshudeni ngoba abazali baboleka imali ukuze bakhokhele izingane zabo.” UNzimande uthe ngomuso kumele kubhungwe ukuthi kumele kwesekwe noma ngubani ngemali yokufunda noma kuhlungwe imikhakha ethile."Kumele le ngxoxo ibekhona emnyangweni ukuthi kuxhaswa uwonke-wonke ngoba efuna ukufunda noma kukhethwa imikhakha ebalulekile ezweni,” kusho uNzimande.
UPHINDE wahlangabezana nenye imbibizane yezomthetho owayengumengameli, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, emizamweni yakhe yokuzishushisela mathupha umshushisi omkhulu ecaleni lakhe lenkohlakalo nokukhwabanisa, u-Adv Billy Downer.INkantolo yoMthethosisekelo ichithe isicelo sikaZuma sokuba uDowner nentatheli amangalelwe nayo baphoqwe ukuba bavele ecaleni abashushisa kulo.UDowner nentatheli abasayi ecaleni ngenxa yokuthi iNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu yanquma ukuthi ukushushiswa kwabo wuZuma akukho emthethweni.UZuma wasidlulisela phambili leso sinqumo.UZuma ubefuna ukuthi iNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo iphoqe uDowner nentatheli ukuthi baqhubeke nokuza ecaleni abashushisa kulo, kuze kube kuphuma isinqumo ecaleni lapho aphonsela khona inselelo isinqumo esithi akukho emthethweni ukushushiswa kwabo.Icala lapho uZuma azishushisela khona uDowner nentatheli lizobuyela eNkantolo ePhakeme eMgungundlovu, ngoMeyi.INkantolo yoMthethosisekelo ichithe isicelo sikaZuma, yathi akalinde isinqumo ecaleni lapho ephonsela khona inselelo isinqumo esithi akukho emthethweni ukushushisa kwakhe uDowner nentatheli.Isinqumo senkantolo sisho ukuthi uDowner nentatheli abaphoqelekile ukuba baye enkantolo uma sekuqhubeka icala abashushiswa kulo wuZuma.Okhulumela inhlangano kaZuma engenzi nzuzo, iJacob G Zuma Foundation, uMnuz Mzwanele Manyi, uthe icala lapho uZuma ezishushisela uDonwer nentatheli lizoqhubeka ngosuku olubekiwe."INkantolo yoMthethosisekelo ithe ayinalo igunya lokulalela isicelo sikaZuma, yanganikeza isizathu salokho. Engingakusho nje wukuthi icala elibekwe uZuma nentatheli lizoqhubeka eNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu ngoMeyi.”UZuma usola uDonwer ngokuputshuzela intatheli ulwazi oluyimfihlo ngesimo sakhe sempilo.Umdoniswano kaZuma noDowner ubambezela ukuqulwa kwecala lenkohlakalo nokukhwabanisa elibhekene noZuma nenkampani yezikhali iThales.UZuma ufuna ukuthi uDowner ashenxe ecaleni lenkohlakalo nokukhwabanisa, ukhala ngokuthi akakulungele ukumshushisa njengoba ebhekene necala.
UBONE kuyinselelo ukukhula kancane komnotho okwenza kube nzima ukuqoqa imali eyenele yokukhokhela zonke izidingo zikahulumeni, uNgqongqoshe wezeziMali, uMnuz Enoch Godongwana, ethula isabelomali sika-2024/2025, eCity Hall eKapa.UGodongwana uthe iyanyuka nemali yokukhokhela isikweletu sikahulumeni, njengoba isifinyelele kuR356 billion, isuka kuR15.7 billion. Uveze ukuthi bayaqhubeka nokubopha izifociya njengoba kulo nyaka isabelomali singuR2.37 trillion, kanti sizoba nguR2.47 trillion, onyakeni ozayo wezimali."Izinselelo ngukuthi umnotho awukhuli ngendlela elindelekile, ngakho asikwazi ukuqoqa imali eyenele. Imali eningi siyiqoqe kwintela ekhokhwa ngabasebenzi esingayinyusanga.” Uthe ngenxa yokunyuka kwemali ekhokhelwa isikweletu sikahulumeni, bazothatha imali esikhwameni esaziwa nge-Gold and Foreign Exchange Contingency Reserve Account (GFECRA)."Le mali izosiza ekutheni kwehliswe ukubolekwa kwemali kanti lesi sikhwama sesikhule saba noR500 billion. Kusona sizothatha uR150 billion kanti sihlose ukwehlisa imali esiyikhokhela isikweletu ize ifinyelele kuR30.2 billion.” Uveze ukuthi baqoqe uR1.73 trillion kwintela ngo-2023/2024, wathi le mali incane ngoR56.1 billion, emalini abebeyihlosile. Uveze nokuthi awukho uhulumeni emhlabeni jikelele ongenaso isikweletu. UGodongwana ubalule nokuthi bazotshala uR943 billion wokuphucula ingqalasizinda."Sizofaka uR531.7 billion kuhulumeni wasekhaya, kuthi izifundazwe sizinika uR2.3 billion. U-R1,4 billion womasipala uzobhekela izinhlekelele ukusiza kulungiswe ingqalasizinda ekhahlanyezwe izikhukhula zangonyaka odlule.”Uveze ukuthi omasipala yibona abasekhaleni lokuhlinzeka izidingo emphakathini."Iningi lalabo masipala abakwazi ukulawula ngendlela imali, kanti kuyagqoza nokuhanjiswa kwezidingo emphakathini. Sinezinhlelo zokufuqa amakhono kubasebenzi ukuze bakwazi ukubhekana nomsebenzi wokuhambisa izidingo emphakathini.”UGodongwana uveze nokuthi kwengezwe uR251.3 billion, wokukhokhela amaholo othisha, abahlengikazi kanjalo nodokotela. Uthe eminyakeni embalwa ezayo uhulumeni uhlela ukuthi izinkampani ezizinze kuleli kodwa ezinamagatsha nakwamanye amazwe zikhokhe intela ebalelwa ku-15% noma kuthiwa inzuzo yazo ziyenze kwamanye amazwe. "Ngalokhu sihlose ukuqoqa uR8 billion owengeziwe kusuka ngo-2026/2027. Sinxusa ukuthi kuphawulwe ngomthethosivivinywa, iGlobal Minimum Tax Bill, eshicilelwe namhlanje (izolo).”Uveze nokuthi uMgcinimafa ubuyekeza imigomo ethinta izinhlekelele ukuze kusheshiswe uhlelo uma kwenzeka kuba nalezi zinhlekelele ezweni. Uthe basebenzisana nomasipala abayisishiyagalombili ngokuthi babe nezinhlelo zokusheshe bahlinzeke ngosizo uma kuba nalezi zinhlekelele.
OWAYENGUMVIKELI womphakathi, u-Advocate Busisiwe Mkhwebane, uthi ulufaka enkantolo udaba lwehhovisi ayelisebenzela eligweve nemali yakhe yomhlomulo ecela kuR10 million.U-Adv Mkhwebane kumanje useyilungu lePhalamende le-EFF nokuyisikhundla angena kusona emuva kokukhishwa kwesoMvikeli woMphakathi. Lesi sikhundla manje siphethwe wu-Advocate Kholeka Gcaleka. U-Adv Mkhwebane wayeqokelwe esikhundleni ngo-2016, wamiswa ngoSepthemba 2023, esolwa ngokuthi akakulungele ukuba sesikhundleni. Wahamba izithangami zePhalamende ephenywa ukuthi ufanelwe yini wumsebenzi kodwa kwatholwa ukuthi akufanele aqhubeke.Ubelokhu ekhala ngokuthi ihhovisi liyenqaba ukumkhokhela imali yakhe ebhalwe phansi ngokwesivumelwano sokuqashwa okwakuthiwa uyoyithola uma esephuma. Ukhiphe isitatimende enkundleni yokuxhumana ethi udaba ulufaka enkantolo."Kuyinto ebuhlungu ukuthi ngimemezele isinqumo sokufaka iHhovisi loMvikeli woMphakathi enkantolo. Sengizame konke nabameli bami ukuze ngikhokhelwe imali yami kodwa kuthulekile,’’ kusho u-Adv Mkhwebane ngesitatimende.Uthe okukhulu kakhulu wukuthi ihhovisi limemezele esidlangaleni ukuthi ngeke limkhokhele imali yakhe ngoba akaziphumelanga ehhovisi. Uthe lokhu akukho emthethweni futhi kuphambene noMthethosikelo wezwe.Uthe ubona sengathi abaqashi bakhe bakudala bahluleka wukutolika umthetho ngendlela efanele."Kubalulekile ukuthi siqaphele ukuthi uMthethosisekelo ukhuluma ngokwephuca imihlomulo uma umengameli ekhishiwe esikhundleni. UMthethosisekelo awusho lutho ngezinhloko zezikhungo ze-Chapter 9,’’ kusho isitatimende.Uthe akusekho okunye angakwenza ngaphande kokuthi afake udaba enkantolo bese kuba yiyona enqumayo ngodaba lwakhe. Uthe akusona isinqumo asithathe kakula lesi kodwa ufuna kube nobulungiswa. Uthe wethembe amajaji ukuthi azosingatha udaba ngaphandle kokwenzelela.Ucele bonke labo abazwelana naye ukuthi bazibambe bahloniphe izinkantolo zenze umsebenzi wazo. Akaqali ukugqigqa izinkantolo njengoba ubephansi phezulu ngodaba lokumiswa kwakhe.Uhambe izinkantolo ezama ukuvimba iPhalamende ukuthi liqale uhlelo lokumphenya kodwa zamchitha izinkantolo.

SIZWAKELE isikhalo sabazali ngokusetshenziswa kwe-hubbly bubbly nama-vapor, uNgqongqoshe weziMali kuleli uMnuz Enock Gondongwana ememezela ukufakwa kwentela kulolu hlobo lokubhenywayo okungenise kakhulu entsheni.UMkhandlu ocwaninga ngezeMpilo, i-Medical Research Council, beyisanda kuxwayisa ngobungozi bokuphafuza i-hubbly bubbly nama-vapor, imvamisa okusetshenziswa yintsha, kanti isimemezelo sikaGodongwana sokwenyusa lolu hlobo lokubhenywayo ngo- R3.04 imililitha senanele ekhweleni labazali.UGodongwana uthe emva kokuthola umbono kaKamogelo Mogane waseSoweto ongomunye wabakuleli abangu-2700 ababelane ngemibono ngabangathanda ukuthi kwenzeke uma sekumenyezelwa isabelomali, eveza ukuthi ufisa kufakwe intela kulolu hlobo lokubhenywayo, uvumelane naye."Njengomzali nami ngivumelana nombono kaKamo, futhi nginesiqiniseko sokuthi uNgqongqoshe woMnyango wezeMpilo uyavumelana nalo mbono,” usho kanje.Isigazu sinyuke ngo- R9.51, iphakethe likasikilidi linyuke ngo- 97 cents bese kuthi iphakethe likagwayi ocashunwayo linyuke ngo- 57 cents.Abaphuza utshwala abasalanga ngaphandle njengoba ikani likabhiya nele-cider linyuke ngo-14 cents. Ibhodlela lewayini likhuphuke ngo- 28 cents, elewayini elinezinga eliphezulu lotshwala lanyuswa ngo- 47 cents, elewayini elihlohlozayo lanyuka ngo- 89 cents. Ibhodlela ikagologo lohlobo le-whisky, i-gin ne-vodka lizonyuka ngo- R5.53.UGodongwana uthe ukunqanda isihlava sokudayiswa kogwayi ongekho emthethweni, uphiko oluqoqa intela i-South African Revenue Service selufake amakhamera nobunye ubuchwepheshe ezindaweni okwenziwa kuzo ugwayi.Uthe ngu- R10 billion olahleka ngokudayiswa kogwayi nokusagolide ngokungemthetho, kanti u- R4 billion kule mali usuqoqiwe.

Izinsizakusebenza nokugcinwa kwazo kwabelwe uR11.3 billion.EzeNhlalakahle zilale isine ngesamba sikaR265 .3 billion. Ngaphansi kwalo mkhakha kukhona omasipala abathole uR101.2 billion. Kukhona ezezindlu, amanzi nogesi kwabelwa uR59.2 billion. INHLANGANO ebhekele ukhetho kuleli i-IEC isemukele ngo-elethu isimemezelo sosuku lokhetho ngoba ithi kufana nokuvuleka kwamasango.Abe-IEC bathe lokhu kusho ukuthi uLwesihlanu, uFebhruwari 23, 2024 luzoba ngolokugcina ukubhalisela ukuvota kwabasafisa ukwenza njalo ngezobuchwepheshe.UMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ngoLwesibili umemezele uMeyi 29 ukuthi wusuku lokhetho lukazwelonke. Izwe ligcine ukuya okhethweni ngo-2019 okusho ukuthi siyaphela isikhathi sikahulumeni owawukhethiwe.Kuzobe kuphela iminyaka engu-30 izwe langena embusweni wentando yabantu, liphuma embusweni wobandlululo.Uhulumeni wakuleli usuke unikwe ihlandla leminyaka emihlanu ubusa, bese kubuyelwa kubantu banikwe ithuba lokukhetha kabusha. I-IEC ithe ukumenyezelwa kosuku lokhetho kwenza kube lula ukusebenza."Ukumenyezelwa kokhetho kwenza ukuthi luphele ungabazane futhi kuyayigqugquzela inhlangano yokhetho ukuthi yenze amalungiselo sekwaziwa ukuthi kubhekwephi. Siyafisa ukugcizelela ukuthi silulungele ukhetho oluzayo,’’ kusho abe-IEC.I-IEC ithi yenze konke okusemandleni ukugqugquzela abantu ukuthi babhalisele ukuvota iphuma ingena ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme, yavula izimpelasonto ezimbili zokubhalisa. Yaba nohlelo lokubhalisa abantu bakwamanye amazwe. Bathi bahambe baze bafinyelela emajele bebhalisa nakhona."Konke lokhu esikwenzile kusithathe kwasibeka kubantu abangu-27.6 million ababhalisile ukuvota. Siyagcizelela ukuthi abantu bazi ukuthi ukubhalisela ukuvota kuzovalwa ngoFebhruwari 23, 2024 ngoLwesihlanu,’’ kusho abe-IEC.Abe-IEC bathe ukumenyezelwa kosuku kusho ukuthi sebezokwazi ukukhipha uhlelo olulandelayo maqondana nomshikashika wokuvota. Bathe uhulumeni uzofaka usuku lokhetho emqulwini wawo ngokusemthethweni emuva kokuxhumana nabamele amaqembu."Uhlelo lokhetho luzobe selukhishwa. Luzobe luqukethe izinto ezifana nokugunyazwa kohlu lwabavoti, ukukhishwa kohlu lwezikhungo zokuvota. Ukuhanjiswa kwamagama abantu abazomela amaqembu. Ukuhanjiswa kwezaziso zokuvota kwabangaphandle kwezwe nokufakwa kwezicelo zokuvota ngokukhethekile,’’ kusho abe-IEC.Bagcizelele nokuthi abantu kufanele babhalise lapho abahlala khona ukuze bakwazi ukuvota. Bathe umuntu uzokwazi ukuvota kwenye indawo angahlali kuyona uma efake isicelo kwabe-IEC, okuwuhlelo abazolumemezela ukuthi luzosebenza kanjani.

UNkosekhaya Lloyd, naye ugwetshwe udilikajele ngecala lokubulala, iminyaka engu-15 ngokugebenga ngenhloso yokulimaza, emihlanu yokuzama ukubulala nemithathu yokutholakala nesibhamu esingekho emthethweni.
UKWENYUKA kwesibalo sabangasebenzi kuleli, kusazoqhubeka nokuba wukhondolo olubi uma kungakahlangabezwana nezingqinamba, okubalwa ukucishwa kukagesi ngenhloso yokuwonga.Lona wumbono womhlaziyi wezomnotho ozimele futhi ongumsunguli wenkampani Amandla Omnotho, uMnuz Gugulethu Xaba. Ubekhuluma izolo, engxoxweni neSolezwe emva kokumenyezelwa kwezibalo zabantu abangasebenzi kuleli zekota yesine yonyaka u-2023/2024, ezikhishwe ngabakwa- Statistics South Africa.Ememezela izibalo esithangamini nabezindaba ePitoli, uMnuz Risenga Maluleke oyiStatistician- General, uthe isibalo sabantu abangasebenzi eminyakeni ewu-10, sikhule safinyelela ku-7,9 million ekoteni yesine ku-2023 ukuqhathanisa nesibalo sekota efanayo ngo-2013 khona ababengu- 4,8 million.Isibalo sabasebenzayo simi ku- 16,7 million ekoteni yesine, okuthiwa naso sehle ngabantu abangu-22 000 okukholakala ukuthi balahlekelwe umsebenzi ezinyangeni ezintathu nje kuphela.UXaba uthi lesi sihlava sisazoqhubeka nokubonakala kwazise elakuleli lingelinye lamazwe ashayeke kakhulu kugasela ubhubhane iCovid 19, kanti ukucishwa kukagesi ngenhloso yokuwonga okuqhubekayo, yikhona okushayela isipikili sokugcina ekuguqeni komnotho."Izigaba zokucishwa kukagesi usuku, nosuku zisho ukuthi amanye amabhizinisi kunamahora angasebenzi ngawo kanti kulimaza kakhulu umnotho. Lesi simo senza nabafisa ukuzotshala imali kuleli bebemanqika kanti amanye amabhizinisi agcina evalwa ngenxa yokwehluleka ukumelana nengcindezi elethwa ukucishwa kukagesi,” usho kanje.Uthe okunye okwenza kube nzima odabeni lokucishwa kukagesi, izethembiso ezingesilona iqiniso ezenziwa osopolitiki ukuhlangabezana nale ngqinambi, wathi nokuthembela kakhulu emkhiqizweni yakwamaanye amazwe kunawo umthelela ekulahlekeni kwemisebenzi.UMaluleke uthe sikhuphuke ngo-100 000 isibalo sabangasebenzi kuleli, ekoteni yesine ezinyangeni ezintathu nje kuphela njengoba bebengu- 7,8 million ekoteni yesithathu nyakenye. Bangu-3 million okuvele ukuthi balahle ithemba ngokufuna umsebenzi kulesi sikhathi okusho ukwehla kwalesi sibalo ngo- 200 000, njengoba bebengu-3,2 million ekoteni yesithathu yonyaka ofanayo."Abaqashiwe behle ngo-128 00 ekoteni yesine ka-2023, kanti abazisebenzayo banyuke ngo-124 000 esikhathini esifanayo. Abasebenza emkhakheni wezokwakha behle ngo- 36 000, kwezolimo behla ngo-35 000, kwezohwebo behla ngo-28 000. Emkhakheni wezimayini isibalo sabasebenza khona sinyuke ngo-57 000,” kuchaza uMaluleke.Abantu abangu-13,4 million kuvele ukuthi abafaki lutho emnothweni wakuleli ngenxa yezizathu ezehlukene okubalwa kuzo ukukhula kakhulu, izitshudeni nabafundi, abagulayo nezinye izizathu.Isibalo sabantu abasha abaneminyaka ephakathi kuka-15 no 34 siqhubekile nokukhula kule kota ngo- 0,9% safinyelela ku- 44,3% ekoteni yesine sisuka ku-43,4% ekoteni yesithathu nyakenye. Bangu- 4,7 million abantu abasha abangasebenzi kuleli, bebengu- 97 000 abalahlekelwe umsebenzi okwenza isibalo sabantu abasha abasebenzayo sibengu- 5,9 million.Nakuba kunjalo, isifundazwe iKwaZulu-Natal, sibenesibalo esikhulu kunazo zonke sabantu abaqashwe ezinyangeni ezintathu njengoba bengu- 62 000.
BANIKEZWE ibheyili kaR20 000 umuntu ngamunye yiNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMgungundlovu ngoLwesibili, abasolwa ababili kwelokukhwabaniswa kwemali eyevile kuR17 million, esikhwameni sezimali zamafa emahhovisi oMnyango wezobuLungiswa nokuThuthukiswa koMthetho-sisekelo.Inkantolo inqume ukulihlehlisela ku-Ephreli 25 nonyaka, icala elibhekene nabasolwa abaneminyaka ephakathi kuka-31 no 42. Bathweswe amacala enkohlakalo, ukweba nokushintshisana ngemali ngendlela engekho emthethweni.Kusolwa ukuthi ngo-Ephreli nyakenye, imali ewuR17 782 132. 59 yafakwa kuma- akhawunti amabhizinisi iRidgeville Investments 2000, ne-LMJ General Trading Pty Ltd. Kuthiwa yakhishwa esikhwameni samafa okubalwa kuwo awezingane ezincane nezintandane, esenganyelwa yi-Master of the High Court. Kuthiwa esikhathini esiningi imali isuke ishiwe yizihlobo esezashonangakho ifakwa esikhwameni ngenhloso yokuyilondolozela abangakwazi ukuzigcinela yona. Okhulumela uphiko lwamaHawk KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant Colonel Simphiwe Mhlongo, uthe kuvulwe icala lokukhwabanisa esiteshini samaphoyisa eMgungundlovu, idokodo ladluliselwa kulolu phiko."Amaphoyisa alolu phiko ngokubambisana nabophiko lokuQoqwa kweMpahla nabe-Financial Intelligence Centre, bakwazile ukubuyisa uR8 million wemali entshontshiwe. Kulindeleke ukuthi sande isibalo sababoshwayo,” kuchaza uMhlongo.Inhloko yophiko iDirectorate Priority for Priority Crime investigation KwaZulu-Natal, uMajor General Leseja Senona, ukwamukele ukuboshwa kwabasolwa, washayela amaphoyisa ihlombe ngomsebenzi wawo. Okhulumela uPhiko lwezokuShushiswa koMphakathi KwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Natasha Kara, uncome amaphoyisa nophiko oluqoqa impahla olungaphansi kwabo ngomsebenzi omuhle.
OWAYEYISIKHULU seBosasa uMnuz Angelo Agrizzi, uzovela okokuqala eNkantolo eNkulu ePitoli ngecala lenkohlakalo ka-R800 000. U-Agrizzi owaduma kakhulu ngokuchakida abantu ngenkohlakalo, uyalelwe ukuthi avele eNkantolo eNkulu ngoFebhruwari 29.U-Agrizzi waboshwa ngo-2020, emuva kokuthi kuvele izinsolo zokuthi wanika owayeyilungu lePhalamende uMnuz Vincent Smith, uR800 000. USmith owayemele i-ANC ePhalamende naye waboshwa uhamba icala lenkohlakalo.IBosasa isolwa ngokugwazela amathenda kahulumeni kanti u-Agrizzi wayebabiza ngamagama abantu abanika imali. Phambilini abezokushushisa baveza ukuthi u-Agrizzi uyohlolwa ingqondo.Kulindeleke ukuthi uma esevela eNkantolo eNkulu ePitoli, kwethulwe umbiko wokuhlolwa kwengqondo ovela kodokotela eWeskoppies. U-Agrizzi ubhekene nelinye icala lenkohlakalo ka-R 1.8 billion nalo alihambayo.
UNGQONGQOSHE wezeziMali, uMnuz Enoch Godongwana, wethule isabelomali sonyaka u-2024. Yize kukhona okuhle okuvelayo okuzojabulisa abaningi njengokukhuphuka kwesondlo sezaguga nezingane, bazokhala ezimathonsi abaphuza iziphuzo ezishisayo njengoba ikhushuliwe intela yotshwala nogwayi.Zimnandi zinoju izindaba zokunyuswa kwesabelomali sezaguga, esomakadebona, izibonelelo zokukhubazeka nese-care dependent ngoR100. Lesi samba sizohlukaniswa sibe wuR90 kusukela ngoMeyi, bese kuthi uR10 kusukela ngo-Okthoba;Ukukhushulwa ngoR50 kwisibonelelo sezintandane; bese kuthi isibonelelo sezingane sona sizonyuswa ngoR20.Mayelana nentela yemikhiqizo yotshwala, kuhlongozwa ukwenyuka kokwehla kwamandla emali ngaphezu kwamaphesenti angu-6.7 no-7.2 ngo-2024/25. Lokhu kusho:Ithini likabhiya likhuphuka ngo-14c;Ithini le-cider nesiphuzo sezithelo ezinotshwala likhuphuka ngamasenti angu-14;Ibhodlela lewayini lizobiza amasenti angu-28;Ibhodlela lewayini eliqinile lizobiza amasenti angu-47 engeziwe;Ibhodlela lewayini elicwebezelayo lizobiza amasenti angu-89; futhiIbhodlela le-spirit, okuhlanganisa i-whiskey, i-gin noma i-vodka, likhuphuka ngoR5.53c.Lo ngqongqoshe ubuye waveza iziphakamiso ezenziwe ngogwayo eziveza ukwenyusa kwentela kagwayi ngamaphesenti angu-4.7 kagwayi nogwayi, namaphesenti angu-8.2 kagwayi wamapayipi nogwayi. Lokhu kuhumushela ku:Ukwenyuswa kwamasenti anguR9.51 kogwayi;Amasenti awu-97 akhuphuka ephaketheni likagwayi; futhiAmasenti awu-57 engeziwe epayipi likagwayi.Thola Isolezwe kusasa ufunde kabanzi ngalesi sabelomali nezinye izinguquko ezizokwenziwa.
KUTHOLOZA isomi ezikhindini kumsebenzi kaMasipala weTheku oboshelwe izinsolo zokweba aphinde acekele phansi amakhamera omkhandlu. Umsebenzi wesilisa oneminyaka ewu-30 ubudala, ulandwe ezaKwaDalawane ngoLwesibili, esemsebenzini.Kuthiwa ungumsebenzi obhekene nokuqapha amakhamera agada ubugebengu kodwa kuthiwa ubebuye enze ngendlela yakhe ukuze angasebenzi kahle (amakhamera), kufezeke izinhloso zakhe. Kuvela ukuthi ubengazelele lutho ngesikhathi kufika ithimba limazisa ukuthi selimshonele, waboshwa kanjalo.UMasipala weTheku unamakhamera owafake ezindaweni ezehlukene ukulwa nobugebengu. Lo mkhankaso wamakhamera uqiniswe kakhulu ngamaholidi kaKhisimusi ngenhloso yokuthuthukisa ukuphepha kwabantu.Okhulumela uMasipala weTheku, uNkk Gugu Sisilana, uthe umsolwa uboshwe emuva kophenyo olunzulu lweCity Intergrity and Investigation Unit (CIIU) nabeSAPS."Uboshwe emuva kokuthi ebonakale ecekela phansi amakhebuli asanda kulungiswa axhumanisa ukusebenza kwamakhamera. La makhamera axhumene nesikhungo sezinhlekelele lapho kubhekwa khona ubugebengu,’’ kusho uNkk Sisilana.UNkk Sisilana uthe umkhandlu ubuvule icala lokweba nokucekela phansi ingqalasizinda kamasipala. Akugcinanga ngokuthi aboshwe kodwa uphinde wanikwa incwadi emazisa ngokumiswa emsebenzini.IMeya yeTheku, uMnuz uMxolisi Kaunda, uncome bonke abenze uphenyo babamba umsolwa."Sizimisele ngokuqeda ngalo lonke uhlobo lobugebengu kumasipala. Asinayo indawo yezigebengu kumasipala, ngeke sivume ukuthi kube nabantu ababeka engcupheni ukuphepha kwezakhamuzi,’’ kusho uKaunda.Inhloko yoMnyango weziNhlekelele neZimo eziPhuthumayo, uMnuz Vincent Ngubane, uthe bazobopha noma wubani ophazamisa ukusebenza kwempahla yomkhandlu. Uthe kubiza kabi ukukhanda impahla uma isifile futhi kubuyisela emuva imizamo yokulwa nobugebengu.UNgubane unxuse ukuthi abantu bangathuli, babikele umasipala uma bebona izigilamkhuba zicekela phansi impahla.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe imininingwane ayicacile kahle, abakakwazi ukuphawula kahle ngalolu daba.
SIPHUMA namuhla isinqumo seNkantolo eNkulu ePitoli mayelana nesicelo seDA sokuthi izinqumo ze-ANC, zokujuba abantu ezikhundleni, zidalulwe njengezingekho emthethweni neziphambene noMthethosisekelo.I-DA ikhala ngokuthi iqembu elibusayo libulala uhulumeni ngokujuba abantu ezikhundleni bebe bengafanelwe yileyo misebenzi kodwa befakwa ngoba bengamalungu ayo. I-DA isanda kunqoba enkantolo iphoqa i-ANC ukuthi idedele amarekhodi emihlangano yekomiti elijuba abantu.I-ANC igcine igobe uphondo yayihambisa imiqingo kanti iDA ithe isazocubungula kahle bese iyamemezela ngezinqumo ezozithatha.Namhlanje kulindeleke ukuthi iNkantolo eNkulu ePitoli inqume ukuthi uhlelo lwe-ANC lokujuba abantu lusemthethweni yini noma cha. Udaba lwalalelwa yithimba lamajaji ngoJanuary 23 no24 sase sigodlwa isinqumo.I-DA ithe umholi wayo, uMnuz John Steenhuisen, uzovukela enkantolo eyothamela ukukhishwa kwesinqumo. Ngokwesitatimende, iDA izwakala inethemba lokuthi inkantolo izovuna bona.Udaba lokujutshwa kwabantu ezikhundleni lulokhu luyindaba egudwini futhi uMengameli we-ANC, uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa, wabuzwa ngalo evele kwikhomishini eyayiphenya ukuqhwagwa kombuso lapho anaba khona ngalo.URamaphosa wavuma ukuthi uma bezojuba umuntu esikhundleni babheka kubantu be-ANC abaqonda kabanzi ngezifiso nemigomo yayo bese bemfaka.

KUNINGI obekungacaci ngowesilisa ongufakazi ecaleni lokubulawa kwephoyisa okwenzeka ngoJuni 23, 2021.UWarrant Officer Maqhawe Sithole (54) wadutshulwa ngabesilisa abangaziwa esigamekweni esenzeka eMachobeni, eNanda.Washona esesibhedlela ngemuva kwezinsuku ezimbili. Esedutshuliwe waphucwa isibhamu ngabasolwa.Ngemuva kwesikhashana, kwaboshwa umsolwa wokuqala, uMnuz Thembokwakhe Xulu (26) waseMayville eboshwa ngoJuni 29.NgoJulayi 6, kwaboshwa umsolwa wesibili, uMnuz Nkululeko Ntuli (23) waKwaMaphumulo.Izolo, eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseNtuzuma kulandwe uMnuz Siyaxola Manyoni (38) ongufakazi okuthiwa wayekhona ngelanga lesigameko.Lo fakazi ubekhulumela phansi futhi ebonakala edidekile kakhulu futhi ethukile.Kuze kwaba amahlandla evile kwamahlanu imantshi imnxenxa ukuba akhulumele phezulu.Ehlohlwa ngemibuzo ngumshushisi uKaystree Ramsamujh, ubesho izinto ezingafani.Uqale wathi ukukhumbula konke okwenzeka ngosuku lwesigameko, gwiqiqi wathi akulula ukuba akhumbule okuningi ngoba sekukudala.Uthe kwakuyizithuba zabo-8 kusihlwa ngesikhathi esendlini yakhe kuhlaselwa umufi.Uthe babili abantu ababona behilizisana nomufi, omunye wayemfishane, omunye emude.Uthe wezwa kuqhuma isibhamu kudutshulwa umufi, wathi kodwa akabonanga muntu owakhipha isibhamu.Uthe wabona kugcwele igazi emhlane kamufi wathi kodwa inxeba akazange alibone. Uthe esedutshuliwe umufi wasondela kuyena wambona ukuthi ulimale kabi emhlane.Ebuzwa ukuthi angabakhomba yini abasolwa wathi angeke, into ayaziyo nje ukuthi oyedwa mude omunye mfishane.Kwale noma esekhonjiswa izithombe zalapho okwenzeka khona isigameko.Ubekhomba izindawo ezahlukene ezithombeni, imantshi imtshele ukuthi angatatazeli, enze isiqiniseko sokuthi ukhomba indawo eyiyo.Namanje kakucaci ukuthi yini eyaholela ekutheni abasolwa babulale iphoyisa. Kusukela ngo-2021, bobabili basesitokisini. Umsolwa wokuqala uXulu wanqatshelwa ibheyili kwathi uNtuli wasilaxaza isicelo sebheyili.Icala liyaqhubeka.
UTHABO Bester nesinqandamathe sakhe uDkt Nandipha Magudumana nabanye abasolwa abayisishiyagalombili bavele okokuqala eNkantolo eNkulu yaseBloemfontein kulandela ukudluliswa kwecala lisuka enkantolo yemantshi ngonyaka odlule.Bekulindeleke ukuthi kulalelwe izethulo zokuqulwa kwecala kodwa kwangenzeka lokho ngoba abasolwa ababili beshintshe abameli.Kuvele ukuthi uThabo Bester unabameli abasha abafikile enkantolo kanti umsolwa wesishiyagalolunye uZanda Moyo, ulaxazwe abameli.Kuphoqeleke ukuba inkantolo ihoxise izinhlelo zosuku kuze kube wukuthi uMoyo, odabuka kwelaseZimbabwe, uthola ummeli omusha.Icala libe selihlehliselwa uJuni 5 nonyaka.Yize kuvunyelwene ngokuhlehla kwecala nosuku olusha, kube nezikhalo ezimbalwa eziqhamuke nommeli kaThabo Bester, u-Advocate Seedat.Lo mmeli ubikele inkantolo ngezikhalo ezintathu zalowo ammele: ukudla okungahambisani nesimo sakhe sempilo, ukunganikezwa izimpahla zakhe ngesikhathi elungiselela ukuya enkantolo kanye nokuncishwa ilungelo lokwenza izingcingo.Ekhuluma ngokudla, lo mmeli utshele inkantolo ukuthi lowo ammele akakaze adle selokhu kusile ngoba ukudla alethelwe khona akuhambisani nesimo sempilo yakhe."Ikilayenti lami linesifo soshukela, ngaleyo ndlela ukudla elikulethelwe kona namuhla ekuseni nami ngikubonile, akumfanele neze umuntu odla imishanguzo yoshukela, yingakho linqabile ukukwamukela lokhu kudla,” kusho ummeli.Ijaji libuzile ukuthi ukudla okulethelwe uBester bekusuka kuphi kodwa kangacaca ukuthi ufike namaphoyisa noma nabasebenzi basejele agcinwe kulo.Lo mmeli ubuye wakhala ngokuthi uBester uyancishwa ilungelo lokuthi axhumane nabameli bakhe ngezingcingo futhi akuqondakali ukuthi kungani kwenzeka lokho ngoba kuyilungelo lakhe. Kulokhu, ijaji liyalele lo mmeli ukuba alusukumele lolu daba njengoba kusikazwe ukuthi icala lingahle liqulwe amasonto ngu-24, uyalidinga ngempela ilungelo lakhe lokuxhumana nommeli wakhe naye azihlelele ngendlela ukuqulwa kwecala.Okunye okuvele njengesikhalo, yindaba yezimpahla zokugqoka. Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi ngesikhathi evela okokuqala nokwesibili enkantolo, kwasuka umsindo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ngoba uBester wayegqoke izimpahla zikanokusho futhi ezinye zazo kungezaphesheya.Manje kuvela ukuthi akasanikezwa izimpahla zakhe ukuba azikhethele okokugqoka kodwa usekhethelwa ngabasebenzi boMnyango wokuHlunyeleliswa kweziMilo."Bonke abasolwa njengoba belapha bayazithola izimpahla zabo uma belungiselela ukuza enkantolo kodwa umsolwa wesikhombisa ukhethelwa ngabasebenzi basejele ukuthi agqoke ini.Lokhu kusukumise uMshushisi u-Advocate Amanda Bester ochazele inkantolo ukuthi uBester uyisiboshwa esesigwetshiwe. Akafani nalaba abanye abasolwa, yena ukhethelwa abasebenzi basejele, kanjalo nokudla akutholayo wukudla akunikezwa ejele.Ijaji liyalele ummeli kaBester ukuthi njengoba icala liguqa, akahlale phansi naye, aqoqe lonke ulwazi ngezikhalo ezikhona zilungiswe isikhathi sisekhona.
UXAMU ugeje umgodi emalungwini oMkhonto weSizwe abecuthele uNobhala Jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, obekumenyezelwe ukuthi uzokhankasa ezindaweni ezakhele iTheku.Amalungu oMkhonto weSizwe ambiswe iqanda lenjelwane ngesikhathi uMbalula ehoxa ngemizuzu yokugcina ezinhlelweni zakhe zokuhambela eTshelimnyama naseMpola.La malungu abe nomkhankaso wokuzibonakalisa ebantwini eduze nalapho obekuzohambela khona uMbalula, elokhu ecula izingoma zomzabalazo eceleni komgwaqo.Bekuthi uma kudlula izimoto ezinamalungu e-ANC acule kakhulu izingoma egxibha uhulumeni ophethe.Kube nokudideka kula malungu engamboni uMbalula.Kuzwakale omunye umholi we-MK etshela amalungu ukuthi aqhubeke nokucula kuze kuba kudlula ubuholi be-ANC, obugcine bungabonakalanga."Maqabane, lawa kusengamavolontiya.
