Angeke sizibekezelele izixhwanguxhwangu ngoba umengameli wasiyala kakhulu ngokuziphatha. Njengoba silapha asizile ukuzophazamisa uhlelo lukaMbalula. Thina uMbalula sizomshaya okhethweni, angeke simshaye la. Ungubaba, ngakho-ke angeke simenze lutho la, sizomnabisa okhethweni.”Amalungu e-ANC abengazibekile phansi eqhubeka nomkhankaso wawo, elokhu edlula phambi kwaboMkhonto weSizwe.Nakwezinye izindawo abaholi be-ANC bebehamba benxenxa abantu ukuthi bahambele umcimbi wangoMgqibelo.USihlalo we-ANC kuzwelonke, uMnuz Gwede Mantashe, ubekhankasa KwaMashu.IPhini likaNobhala Jikelele, uNkk Nomvula Mokonyane, yena ubekhankasa esifunda iTolomani Mnyayiza, oGwini.Amalungu oMkhonto weSizwe abenomkhankaso wokuzibonakalisa eThekwini, izolo Isithombe: Bongiwe Zuma
KUDLA lubi ukusetshenziswa kukagwayi obhenywa ngamapayipi emanyuvesi akuleli.Lokhu kuvezwe ucwaningo lwakamuva olwenziwe isikhungo esicwaninga ngezempilo kuleli, iSouth African Medical Research Council (SAMRC), ngaphansi kophiko lwayo olucwaninga ngezinkinga zokuphazamiseka kwengqondo, ukusetshenziswa kotshwala, izidakamizwa kanye nogwayi.Lolu cwaningo lwethulwe eDurban University of Technology (DUT) muva nje. Ucwaningo luveza ukuthi isitshudeni esisodwa kwezine ezisemanyuvesi ezineminyaka ephakathi kuka-18 kuya kwengu-24 (cishe u-26%) zisebenzisa ugwayi obhenywa ngamapayipi owaziwa nge-e cigaratte, u-40% wazo uke wawusebenzisa kodwa usuwuyekile. Ezitshudenini ezintathu ezineminyaka ephakathi kuka-18 kuya ku 24 esisodwa (32%) sibhema i-hookah, u-47% uke wayibhema kodwa usuyekile.UDkt Catherine Egbe ongomunye wosoSayensi ebebenza lolu cwaningo, uthe ucwaningo luveza ukuthi izitshudeni ezikule minyaka ethintekayo zithatheka kalula uma zibona izikhangiso ezisetshenziswa ngabakhiqizi bale mikhiqizo ezenza ukuthi zikholwe ukuthi ukuzisebenzisa kukwenza ube sezintweni."Sithole ukuthi izitshudeni ezike zabona izikhangiso zokumakethwa kwale mikhiqizo kunamathuba aphindaphindeke kathathu okuthi zisebenzise lolu hlolo lukagwayi kunezingazange zizibone izikhangiso. I-hookah, ebuye yaziwe nge-hubbly bubbly, ishisha noma i-waterpipe, iyona edla ubhedu entsheni. Iningi layo licabanga ukuthi inobungozi obuncane kunogwayi ojwayelekile ngoba intuthu kagwayi idlula emanzini ngaphambi kokuthi ingene emlonyeni womuntu. Abazi ukuthi kumele ilawulwe njengoba kwenzeka kugwayi ojwayelekile," kusho yena.
LIHLEHLELE uMashi 4 nonyaka icala lokubulala elibhekene nenyanga edumile yaseThwalenye eNanda.UMnuz Simphiwe Abraham Mhlaba ubevele kafishane eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseNtuzuma. Icala lahlehliselwa uMashi 4 ukuze afake isicelo sakhe sebheyili.Yize bekulindeleke ukuthi kugcwale enkantolo ngaleli cala elingundabamlonyeni kulezi zinsuku, bekucwebile enkantolo. Bekukhona izethameli ezimbalwa ezivela ngasohlangothini lukammangalelwa.UMhlaba usolwa ngokuthenga izinkabi ezine ukuba zibulale uNkk Patricia Nokuthula Jeza (48) nendodakazi yakhe uNksz Queen Jezelihle Jeza (22) baKwaMasxha eMayville, eThekwini, ngoLwesine.Izidumbu zabo zitholwe endaweni yokulahla udoti eMachobeni ngasemfuleni uMngeni, ngoLwesihlanu.UMhlaba uvela enkantolo nje, amaphoyisa aqhulule ngenhlamvu abasolwa abane ngoMgqibelo okuthiwa bebethengwe nguye ukuthi babulale abesifazane.Ngokusho kwamaphoyisa, abasolwa babanjwe besendleleni ebheke eMpophomeni, ukuyohlanjululwa.Kuthiwa imoto yabo ivinjwe ngamaphoyisa eSikebheni eMzinyathi kwathi ebebephakathi bavele bavulela ngenhlamvu kuqala bebhekise emaphoyiseni, nawo abuyisela ngayo inhlamvu, bafa bobane.Kuvele ukuthi zintathu izibhamu ezitholwe amaphoyisa kubona emva kokubathela othulini.Ngokuthola kweSolezwe, uMhlaba ubesegweva no-R300 000 ayewunikwe wuNkk Jeza emva kwesivumelwano sokuthi uzode emfakela imali ethile njalo ngenyanga.Kuvele ukuthi ugcine engasayingeni eyokumfakela imali yesivumelwano, okuholele ekutheni uNkk Jeza agcine esethi akawubuyise u-R300 000 wakhe.Kuthiwa uvumile ukuthi uNkk Jeza asilande isamba semali, kanti umhlelela ukumholela oPhathe, ngokumthengela izinkabi ezigcine zimbulala nendodakazi yakhe ngoLwesine maqede zayobalahla.UNgqongqoshe woMnyango wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi KwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Nonhlanhla Khoza ephawula ngesigameko, uthe kuyabakhathaza ukuqhubeka kwezigameko zodlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane."Izigameko ezifuze lezi zenza sibone isidingo esikhulu sokuthi sibambisane ukucinga izimpande zesihlava. Sinxusa nanoma ngubani ongaba nolwazi olungalekelela kuleli cala ukuthi aluhambise emaphoyiseni,” kusho uNkk Khoza.
UGALAGALA kwezomthetho u-Advocate Dumisa Ntsebeza SC, luthi kufanele kusungulwe ikhomishini ezophenya umonakalo wokugxambukela kosopolitiki ekushushisweni kwamacala ahlobene neKhomishini yamaQiniso (TRC).UNtsebeza owayejutshwe yiNPA ukuthi aphenye, wethule umbiko wakhe wathi kwaba nokugxambukela kosopolitiki okwavimba ubulungiswa. I-Truth and Reconciliation Commission (TRC), yaqokwa ngoDisemba 1995 ukuze iphenye ngodlame olwenzeka ngaphansi kumbuso wobandlululo.Ngesikhathi imenyezelwa kwathiwa inhloso yayo wukusiza ukwedlulisa okudala kuwelelwe kuhulumeni wentando yeningi. Inqwaba yabantu yafa ngezikhathi zobandlulo abanye bebulawa ngamaphoyisa abanye bebulawa wudlame lwamaqembu ezepolitiki.Ubufakazi obushaqisayo obavela kule khomishini babuvusa iminjunju bushiye abantu bekhala izinyembezi. Kwaba nesikhalo sokuthi kube khona abashushiswayo ukuze kwedlulwe kahle kuphole izilonda.Embikweni kaNtsebenza kuvela ukuthi kukhona izinto ezingahambanga kahle." I-NPA kufanele isingule ikhomishini yophenyo oluzimele ezophenya ngokugxambukela kosopolitiki nomthelela wakho ekuphenyweni kwamacala eTRC ngo-2003 kuya ku-2017,’’ ngokombhalo wombiko. Umbiko uveza nokuthi ithimba eliphenya amacala ahlobene neTRC linamacala angu-133, eliwacubungulayo kumanje futhi lizimisele ukuwaphothula nokuthi kube nobulungiswa. Kujutshwe abaphenyi nabashushisi bamacala abanikwe umsebenzi wokuthi basebenze ngokuzikhandla.Abashushisi nabaphenyi banikezwe umsebenzi wokuphenya wonke amacala ahlobene neTRC bese kushushiswa uma kukhona ubufakazi obuvelayo.I-KwaZulu-Natal inamacala awu-27 futhi yiyona ehamba phambili ngesibalo. IKZN yabelwe abashushisi abahlanu nabaphenyi abayisikhombisa abaphuma ophikweni loKlebe.I-Eastern Cape inamacala angu-23 kanti yabelwe abashushisi abayisikhombisa nabaphenyi abayisishiyagalolunye. Kulandele iWestern Cape ngamacala awu-10 yabelwe abaphenyi abane nabashushisi abathathu.I-Northern Cape inamacala ayisikhombisa yabelwe abaphenyi ababili. I-Free State inamacala ayisikhombisa nabaphenyi ababili.
IZOBUYELA ngesonto elizayo eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseScottburg, inyanga esolwa ngokudlwengula amadodakazi amabili engawazali.Lo msolwa ona-45 (igama lakhe eligodliwe ngenxa yobucayi becala) ongowaseLondon Farm, eMkhomazi, uboshwe ngesonto eledlule kanti kuthiwa ubhekene namacala amabili okudlwengula amadodakazi aneminyaka ewu-16 azalwa amakhosikazi akhe ahlukene okuvele ukuthi enye yawo uqale ukulala nayo ngo-2019.Uzophinde abuyele enkantolo ngoMsombuluko ukufaka isicelo sebheyili.Ngesikhathi evela enkantolo, amalungu omphakathi nezinhlangano ezisemphakathini zihambele inkantolo ngenhloso yokufaka ingcindezi ekutheni umsolwa engayinikwa ibheyili.UNksz S’bo Ngcobo wenhlangano ebhekelele izingane, Uthingo Crisis Centre, uthe ukunikela kwabo enkantolo kungenxa yokwanda kwamacala okuhlukunyezwa kwezingane nabantu besifazane."Sithole ukuthi umsolwa ungusingababa kulezi zingane ezizalwa amakhosikazi akhe amganile. Kuthiwa uphinde abesanyanga njengoba nonkosikazi wesibili bahlangana ngokuthi wayozofuna usizo oluhambisana nokwelashwa kuyena. "Okubuhlungu ukuthi kunengane okuthiwa uyiqale ngo-2019, okuyinto ewubulwane. Ngendlela esesihlale sithuke ngayo ngenxa yalezi zigameko, sekunzima ngisho ukucela usizo oluthile kumuntu ngoba awazi ukuthi yikuphi okulandelayo azokwenza kuwena. Nakuba kunjalo, siyawunxusa umphakathi ukuthi ungafeli ngaphakathi, ukhulume ngalezi zinto uma usola noma uzibona zenzeka ukuze kusizakale abagilwa,” usho kanje.Uthe ngoMsombuluko bazonikela enkantolo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umsolwa akayinikwa ibheyili.Ngesikhathi ememezela izibalo zobugebengu zekota yesithathu, uNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa kuleli, uMnuz Bheki Cele, uthe zehle ngo-208 izigameko zokudlwengula ezibikiwe ezweni lonke njengoba zingu-12, 211 ezibikwe kule kota ukuqhathanisa no-12, 419 wangesikhathi esifanayo ngo-2022.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, Lieutenant Colonel Nqobile Gwala, uthe amaphoyisa ophiko olubhekelele amacala odlame lwasemndenini, ukuvikelwa kwezingane namacala aphathelene nocansi eMlaza, aphenya amacala amabili okudlwengula.
UPHIKO olubhekele ukukhokhela izibonelelo zikahulumeni, i-South African Security Agency KwaZulu-Natal, luthi seluqalile uhlelo lokuvalwa kwezikhungo eziholela impesheni kahulumeni ezingxenyeni ezithile zesifundazwe, okulindeleke ukuthi kuphothulwe ngasekupheleni kwenyanga ezayo.Okhulumela lolu phiko KwaZulu-Natal uNksz Sandy Godlwana engxoxweni neSolezwe, uthe uhulumeni uthathe isinqumo sokuvala lezi zikhungo ngoba iningi lazo selisetshenziswa yisibalo esincane sabantu uma uqhathanisa naphambilini."Abantu abaningi sebesebenzisa ezinye izindlela ukuhola izibonelelo, imali bayikhipha emishinini yasemabhange kanti abanye bayihola ezitolo. Lokhu kwenza kusale ingcosana ethembele ekuholeni kulezi zikhungo, kanti izindleko ezikhokhwa uhulumeni ngalezi zikhungo zinkulu. Unqume ukuthi imali esetshenziswayo ukukhokhela izikhungo, isetshenziselwe okunye okuzosiza umphakathi,” usho kanje.Uveze ukuthi uhulumeni ukhokha imali engango- R200 esikhungweni ngomuntu ohola khona, kanti ngaphandle kwalokho kuphinde kukhishwe izimoto ezihambela izikhungo nabasebenzi abazokwenza umsebenzi wokuholela, bese kufika abantu abambalwa.Ngaphandle kwezindleko, uNksz Godlwana uthe okunye okuba yizinselelo, ubugebengu njengoba kwesinye isikhathi kugcina sekubanjwa inkunzi izimoto eziyoholela ezikhungweni. Uthe uhlelo lokuvalwa kwezikhungo lwenziwa kancane kancane, kubhekwe kuqala lezo esezinesibalo esincane sabantu abahola kuzo, kanti kuxoxiswene nobuholi bomdabu kwezinye izindawo ezisemakhaya ngesinqumo sokuvalwa kwezikhungo. Uqinisekise ukuthi kuhloswe ukuthi kuqambe kuphela uMashi, kube sekuphothuliwe ngohlelo lokuvalwa kwezikhungo.
UHLALISWE phansi wakhuzwa ngokuba namawala umholi woPhiko lweNtsha yoMkhonto weSizwe, uBonginkosi Khanyile osematheni ngokukhaca abantu aphinde akhininde izindaba zenhlangano ezibucayi esidlangaleni.Abantu ezinkundleni zokuxhumana bebekhala ngoKhanyile bethi sekuqale uqhekeko eqenjini elisha njengoba esekhuluma ngemibango yezikhundla.UMkhonto weSizwe usematheni emuva kokuthi wethulwe ngoDisemba. Kuyadingeka ukuthi sibuye siyichushise siyikhuze. Inhloso yakhe wukwenza umsebenzi wokuba wumholi kodwa angenza kangcono kunalokhu akwenzile,’’ kusho uNdlela.UNdlela uthe alukho uqhekeko kodwa okwenzekayo kuvamile kuwo wonke amaqembu amakhulu. Uthe abazimisele ngokuya engqungqutheleni, bayoze baye emuva kokhetho lukazwelonke. Uthe into okufanele bayigade wukuba nezinhlaka ezizibekayo zigcine zivukela umbutho.UKhanyile, onguMdidiyeli weMK Party Youth League, uvela kuma-video ahlukene evuka umbhejazane ekhuluma ngolaka. I-vidiyo imveza ekhaca omunye umuntu omusha ethi akaphumele phandle ngoba uyahlupha."Wena phuma phandle! Phandle demedi! Ungumdayisi. Phuma!,’’ kusho uKhanyile ekhuluma ngombhobho bese kuzwakala omunye ebuzisisa ukuthi kukhishwe muphi. Kubonakala izinsizwa zimkaka lowo okuthiwa akakhishwe zimkhomba indlela.Kwenye i-vidiyo uvela ekhuluma ngoZuma noMnuz Jabulani Khumalo owabhalisa uMkhonto weSizwe. UKhanyile uzwakala esola uKhumalo ngokujikela uZuma ethi usemdala akafanelwe yizikhundla."Kunomfana la okade ehleli ehhotela noKhumalo lo ozibiza ngokhomanda Khumalo. Bebehleli behlohlana nenye intsha bethi uMsholozi usemdala, sekufanele kuhole uKhumalo. Ngeke siyivume indlela efana nobekuphethe ngayo oMbalula,’’ kusho uKhanyile.Uze akhale ngokuthi kukhona abaxakwa amambawu bese benza ukuthanda kwabo eqenjini."UZuma kade emusha ememezela uMkhonto (ngoDisemba), sonke sagijima ngoba sila ngenxa kaZuma. NgoJanuwari usemdala? Kade emusha esawumemezela uMkhonto, uma usuhlangana udla abantu usemdala. Naye uKhumalo siyintsha siqonde ngqo sithi ngeke ahole iqembu kukhona uZuma,’’ kusho uKhanyile enanelwa yinhlokomo.Ubeze abuze ukuthi uKhumalo ungubani, uvelaphi ngoba akaziwa emzabalazweni kodwa kwaziwa uZuma.UKhanyile uthe uma bengeke baholwe wuZuma sekufanele baholwe wubani. UKhanyile owayeyisishoshovu se#FeesMustFall, uqokelwe esikhundleni sokuba umholi wesikhashana ngoJanuwari nonyaka.Ngaphambi kwalokho ubeyilungu lePatriotic Alliance (PA) eyamxosha emuva kokubonakala emhlanganweni woMkhonto weSizwe.UKhanyile uzanywe kaningi ocingweni lungabanjwa wathunyelelelwa nemiyalezo wangayiphendula.
ZIMBIWE yinsele yazishiya emacikweni aKwaZulu-Natal njengoba iphekwa ngomhluzi wenye ngemicimbi yamaqembu ezepolitiki athula izethembiso zokhetho. UMENGAMELI we-ANC, uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa, usikaze ukuthi ingase iphenduleke kusasa imithandazo yezaguga ezifuna ukukhushulelwa imali yesibonelelo ngenxa yokubiza kokudla.URamaphosa uthe uzokhuluma noNgqongqoshe wezeZimali, uMnuz Enoch Godongwana, ukuba akhuphulele izaguga impesheni uma esethula isabelomali, ePhalamende.Lokhu ukusho ngesikhathi ekhuluma nezinkumbi zamalungu e-ANC, eNanda.URamaphosa uthe izaguga eziningi ahlangana nazo zihlezi zimkhalela ngokuthi azisakwazi ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zazo ngenxa yokubiza kokudla.Uthe naye uyavumelana nokuthi kufanele ikhushulwe le mali."Ngiyathemba ukuthi njengoba uGodongwana ezokwethula isabelomali ngoLwesithathu, uzoyikhuphula le mali. Uma sekumenyezelwe usuku lokhetho, kulapho sizoqala ngempela ukukhankasela ukhetho.I-ANC izokwethula umqulu wezethembiso ngoMgqibelo eMoses Mabhida Stadium.URamaphosa uthe umqulu wabo unamaphuzu aqinile."Nabo laba abangasifuni bazovele bathuke uma sebebona amaphuzu esiwaphethe.”
SICHITHWE nezindleko yiNkantolo yezokuLingana eWestern Cape, isicelo sokudluliswa kwesinqumo esifakwe yiStandard Bank sokuthi ivale ama-akhawnti enkampani iSekunjalo Group.Ngesonto eledlule iJaji Judith Cloete lilalele isicelo sokudluliswa kwesinqumo, njengoba ngoSepthemba nyakenye, le nkantolo yayalela amabhange ayesonga ngokuvala ama-akhawunti eSekunjalo Group, ukuthi alumise lolo hlelo.I-Standard Bank yasidlulisa leso sinqumo, okuthe izolo iJaji Cloete laphikisa lesi sicelo, lama esinqumweni saphambilini.Uveze ukuthi iSekunjalo Group kumele inikezwe ithuba lokuveza uhlangothi lwayo enkantolo kulokho esolwa kukho.USihlalo weSekunjalo Investment Holding, uDkt Iqbal Surve usijabulele isinqumo senkantolo."Eminyakeni edlule bekulokhu kuwugingqigongqo ngezinqumo zenkantolo. Nakuba kunjalo, siyathobeka kakhulu futhi sizizwa sinokuthula ukuthi manje sesizokwazi ukuqhubeka nokusebenza ngaphandle kokusaba ukuthi kunama-akhawunti azovalwa. Iphuzu lethu elisemqoka wukukwazi ukuveza eNkantolo yezokuLingana ukubandlulwa kwethu yilawa mabhange, kungesiyona iStandard Bank kuphela,” usho kanje.IJaji Cloete linqume ukuthi bekuzobe akubona ubulungiswa ukuvumela isicelo sokudluliswa kwesinqumo njengoba bekuzolalelwa esikhathini esifishane kunesejwayelekile, njengoba bekuzomele silalelwe ezinyangeni ezinhlanu esikhundleni sonyaka. Ijaji lisichithe nezindleko lesi sicelo kuwona womabili amacala, eliseNkantolo eNkulu neliseNkantolo yezokuLingana.
ININGIZUMU Afrika ingase izithole isenkingeni yokuthi ingakwazi ukuphakela izakhamizi zayo ngegesi uma yehluleka ukuqhamuka namasu ezinyangeni ezine ezizayo.Nyekenye iSasol, okuyiyona ekhiqiza igesi esatshalaliswa kuleli yamemezela ukuthi izoyeka ukukhiqiza igesi eyidayisela izinkampani ezinkulu ezihweba ngegesi neziyisebenzisela ukukhiqiza imikhiqizo ethile ngoJuni 2026, okuzodala ukuthi kushode igesi.Imboni ebhekele ukukhiqizwa kwegesi kuleli, i-Industrial Gas Users SA (Igusa), ithi kumele amasu okuthi igesi izotholakala kanjani abe esekhona ezinyangeni ezine ezizayo, ukuze kungabi nesikhathi lapho igesi ingeke itholakale ngaso ezweni. Uthe uhulumeni sekunesikhathi waziswa ngalokho kodwa awekho amasu akhona aziwa ngeGas Materplan, kukhona amasu angakaphasiswa yi-draft, okungaziwa ukuthi kuzophela izinyanga ezine esephasisiwe yini. UMnuz Jaco Human we-Igusa, uthe sekuphele iminyaka eyisikhombisa kwabonakala ukuthi igesi izogcina iphelile ezweni. Kule minyaka bekulokhu kuzanywa amasu ahlukene ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukukhiqizwa kwayo akupheli. Uthe kuze kube manje alikho isu eliqondile okungabanjelelwa kulo lokuthi uma iSasol iyeka ukukhiqiza igesi kuzokwenziwa njani."Igesi iyisimbiwaphansi esiphelayo. Sekuphele iminyaka ewu-20 imbiwa. Bekwaziwa ukuthi kuzofika isikhathi lapho iphela khona. Eminyakeni eminingi eyedlule besilokhu sikhula isibalo sabantu abasebenzisa igesi. Okunye kudalwe yizinkinga zikagesi ezikhona. Okwamanje ayikabi khona inkinga kodwa ngo-2026 izoba khona inkinga. Uma sehluleka wukuqhamuka nesu elizosebenza uma iSasol isiyeke ukuyidayisa, sisenkingeni. Igesi ibaluleke kakhulu. Ezinye izimboni zisebenzisa yona ukuze zikhiqize imikhiqizo efana nensimbi neminye ngoba ugesi ubuye ungabi khona. Uma kungasetshenziswa udizili nophethroli kungabiza kakhulu," kusho uHuman.Uqhube wathi isifundazwe iGauteng, Mpumalanga neKwaZulu-Natal yizona ezizothinteka kakhulu uma iSasol isiyeka ukukhiqiza igesi. Uthe uma kuphetha ngokuthi lingenziwa isu ngokushesha, igesi izogcina ithengwa phesheya, okuzokwenza ukuthi ibize kakhulu.
I-IFP iphikisana nosuku lokhetho lukazwelonke oluphahlukwe iphini likamengameli, uMnuz Paul Mashatile.Okhulumela i-IFP kuzwelonke, uMnuz Mkhuleko Hlengwa, uthe abahambisani nokuthi ukhetho lube ngoMeyi 24, nokuwusuku uMashatile asikaze ukuthi kuzobanjwa ngalo ukhetho.UMashatile utshele amalungu e-ANC ukuba alungele ukunqoba ukhetho oluzokuba ngalolu suku noma kulezo zinsuku."Kufanele sibumbane, sibe nenhloso eyodwa. Leyo nhloso kufanele kube ukuthi kufika umhla ka-24, noma lezo zinsuku kuMeyi, mhla siya okhethweni, i-ANC iyalunqoba ukhetho.”Lokhu ukusho ngesikhathi ekhuluma namalungu e-ANC ohambweni lwakhe lwasesifundazweni iKwaZulu-Natal.UMashatile uthe umengameli, uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa, uzolumemezela maduze usuku lokhetho, wathi seluseMome."Silinde umkhombandlela kumengameli.”UHlengwa uthe bayaphikisana nalolu suku, wakhala ngokuthi bazokuba bancane abantu abazovota uma ukhetho luba ngoLwesihlanu.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma namalungu e-IFP eGugu Dlamini Park, izolo, lapho bekunomcimbi wokugqugquzela abantu ukuthi bahambele umcimbi wokwethulwa komqulu wezethembiso zokhetho ozokuba seMoses Mabhida, ngenyanga ezayo.UHlengwa uthe uma ukhetho lungoLwesihlanu kusho ukuthi kuzokuba nempelasonto ende, nathe kuzokwenza ukuthi abantu bangaphumi ngobuningi."Asifuni ukuthi ukhetho lube ngoLwesihlanu ngoba abantu abaphumi nobuningi babo uma lungalolu suku. Kubukeka sengathi kunenhloso yokuthi abantu bangayi okhethweni. Njalo kule lizwe uma sinokhetho, ukhetho luba ngoLwesithathu. Lapha abantu bayaye baphume ngobuningi. Ngiyabaxwayisa abe-ANC ukuba bangazami ukucindezela ukhetho. Nginxusa ukuba ukhetho lube ngoMeyi 29.”UHlengwa unxuse uRamaphosa ukuthi amemezele usuku lokhetho ngokushesha."Ukusaba kukaRamaphosa ukukhipha usuku lokhetho kuyizinkomba zabantu abatatazelayo, bayasaba ngoba bayabona ukuthi sesikhathele yibo.”Usihlalo we-IFP KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, unxuse amalungu e-IFP ukuba aphelele eMoses Mabhida ngosuku lokwethulwa komqulu wezethembiso.UNtuli uthe kuzoshiyana ukwenza uma sebethula umqulu wezethembiso."Niyazi nani ukuthi bakhona asebengenile eMabhida, bazama ukuyigcwalisa. Bakhona nabasazongena. Kufanele kuthi uma sekungena indlovu, kucace ukuthi sekungene indlovu.UNtuli uthe bazosebenzisa ukhetho lwakulo nyaka ukuhlonipha umsunguli we-IFP, inkosi Mangosuthu Buthelezi, okhothame ngonyaka odlule."Kubalulekile ukuba sigcwalise iMoses Mabhida, siphinde sibuyise isifundazwe iKwaZulu-Natal okhethweni oluzayo.”
MKHULU umonakalo odalwe yimvula enamandla ebihambisana nokuduma kwezulu KwaNongoma, ngoLwesihlanu.Ngokusho koMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu, ayisishiyagalombili amawadi akhahlamezekile kule mvula.Kuvela ukuthi ingu-78 imizi ecekeleke phansi, emithathu yayo iphele nya.UNgqongqoshe womnyango, uNkk Bongiwe Sithole-Moloyi uthe bangu-600 abantu abakhahlanyezwe yimvula, waveza nokuthi akekho okubikwe ukuthi ushonile noma ulimele."Amakilasi asesikoleni iNhlanhlayethu Secondary nawo athintekile, isakhiwo sesonto nehholo lomphakathi kupheshukelwe wuphahla,” kusho uNkk Sithole-Moloi.Ubuye wabalula nokuthi kuthinteke ingqalasizinda kagesi emawadini amahlanu, kwalimala nesiphehlimanzi okuholele ekutheni kuphazamiseke ukhanjiswa kwamanzi kwezinye izindawo.OMUNYE umonakalo edalwe yimvula enamandla Isithombe: SITHUNYELWE "Siwumnyango siyazwelana nabakhahlamezekile. Amathimba ethu ezinhlekelele asejutshiwe ukuba ayohlola isimo. Siyasebenzisana neminye iminyango owezokuHlaliswa kwaBantu, owezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi nowezeMpilo ukuyonikezela ngosizo,” kusho uNkk Khoza.Uqwashise abantu bakule ndawo ukuthi njengoba lisanda kuna imvula enkulu, imifula eminingi isagcwele."Siyabanxusa ukuthi baqaphele, bangaweli imifula egcwele ukuze bagweme ukulahleka kwempilo,” kusho uNkk Sithole-Moloi.Uveze ukuthi lukhona usizo oseluvele luhanjisiwe, phakathi kwalo ubale amatende, amanzi nokunye."Uhlu lwabakhahlamezekile luzophothulwa bese luhanjiswa eminyangweni efanele ukuze basizakale, njengoMnyango wezaseKhaya kulabo abalahlekelwe womazisi, imithi yabo yezifo ezehlukene nenyufomu ezinganeni ezifunda isikole,” kusho yena.
KUQUBUKE umsindo kubangwa imali yomnikelo phakathi komsakazi woKhozi FM, nomfundisi webandla iSoul Winning Community Church.Umfundisi Thulani Mdladla, ukhomba ngenjubane uSelby "Selbeyonce” Mkhize woKhozi FM, ngokuthi uhlomule ngoR50 000 kungafanele esikhwameni senhlangano engenzi nzuzo engaphansi kwebandla lakhe, iSoul Winnings Community Project (NPO). Le nhlangano izinze eMawoti, eNanda, yaziwa ngokusebenzisana noMnyango wezeMpilo kwaZulu-Natal, ukulekelela abantu abadla imishanguzo yezifo ezingamahlalakhona.Umfundisi Mdladla uthe uSelbeyonce ubewine uR100 000 emncintiswaneni weSABC 1, iDeal or no Deal ngasekuqaleni kukaJanuwari nonyaka, wanikela ngawo enhlanganweni yabo engenzi nzuzo."Ngesikhathi engena emncintiswaneni ufike wakuqinisekisa ukuthi uwungenele ukuze anikele enhlanganweni yethu. Ngenhlanhla uwine u-R100 000. Leyo mali ifakwe kwi-akhawunti yeSoul Winning Community Projects. Besihlele ukukhokhela iParkhome (ihhovisi elingumahambanendlwana). Sigcine sikhiphe uhhafu kaR100 000 ngenxa yokuthi enye imali ithathwe nguSelby akasafuni ukuyibuyisa,” kuchaza umfundisi Mdladla.Uthe uSelby ufike kubona wafuna ingxenye yemali, wathi kumele ahlomule, bamnqabela. Uthe ugcine eseqhamuka nesizathu sokuthi uxakwe ngumashonisa ucela bamboleke uR50 000, uzowubuyisa.Ngemva kwalokho umfundi uthi uSelby ushaye wachitha wangabe esayibuyisa."Nowamkhiphela imali oyilungu lekomiti lenhlangano usevele wasula okwenza sibone sengathi kukhona ubugebengu abebehlangene ngabo. Kwakhona ukuthi imali yakhishwa kunguMgqibelo ebhange kushayisa amakhala ngoba inhlangano ayisebenzi ngempelasonto. Sesibhalele abeLotto Star, nabePrime Media okuyibona abasikhokhela le mali,” kuqhuba umfundisi Mdladla.Kuthintwa uSelbeyonce uthe akukho mali ayithola kodwa umuntu oyiqili ngumfundisi."Njengoba ngangithe imali engiyiwinile nginikela ngayo enhlanganweni, kwaba kanjalo ngempela. Abantu engixhumene nabo ekomitini lenhlangano yibona abangibiza bathi bacela ngilekelele ukuthi imali isheshe isetshenziswe ukuthenga iParkhome ngoba umfundisi ufuna ukuyidla. Bangitshela ukuthi isiningi imali esidliwe ngumfundisi okunikelwa ngayo kule nhlangano zigcine zingenziwanga izidingo zayo. Impela imali enguR50 yakhishwa ebhange kunguMgqibelo sayokhokhela iParkhome. Okwenza singakwazi ukulinda, ukuthi umfundisi ubefuna ukuyithatha yonke njengenhlalayenza,” kusho uSelbeyonce.Isolezwe Ngempelasonto linabo ubufakazi be-Invoice ekhokhelwe inkampani edayisele le nhlangano iParkhome. Kuyona kuvela ukuthi kukhokhwe uR50 000. Kwamanye amaphepha kuvela ukuthi imali ifike kule nhlangano ingu-R87 630 ngenxa yentela.Umfundisi Mdladla uthe kumanje isahleli lapho ithengwe khona futhi ababadayisele bathi sebezoqala ukufaka imali yokuthi babagcinele yona engu-R120 ngosuku, ngenxa yokuthi kudingeka imali athi ithathwe wuSelbeyonce.USelbeyonce uthe ngokwazi kwakhe iParkhome ingu-R70 000. Wathi ngesikhathi bekhokha uR50 000 ikomiti lenhlangano limtshele ukuthi lizobuye liwukhokhe uR20 000, lathi enye imali lizogcina ngayo izidingo zenhlangano.
UTHUKUTHELE uyaveva owesifazane waseMfekayi, eMtubatuba ngoyise athe akamkhulisanga kodwa wathushuka ngelanga lokutsholwa kwakhe esefuna ilobolo.UNksz Samkelisiwe Ntenga (44), okumanje ilobolo lemali likuye, uthe akukho okumhlanganisa noyise, uMnuz Philemon Ntenga (65), ofike ngosuku lokulethwa kwamalobolo esezenza ungqoshishilizi."Lo muntu akangondlanga kodwa unesibindi sokuthi atheleke ngosuku engilotsholwa ngalo esefuna nokuthatha ilobolo. Mina angimfuni lo muntu," kusho uNksz Ntenga.Ngokusho kukaNksz Ntenga, uyise wanyamalala bebancane, akangabondla. Uthe uyise wamgcina ngo-1994, nokwenze athuke kome nasozwaneni uma ethushuka ngosuku lokucelwa kwakhe. Akazi futhi ukuthi uzwe ngobani ukuthi uyalotsholwa ngalolu suku.Uthe kuthe uma uyise efika waphoqa ukuthi imali yamalobolo engu-R35 000 ize kuyena ngoba kulotsholwa indodakazi yakhe."Umbuzo wami omkhulu uthi, uqale nini ukwazi ukuthi mina ngiyindodakazi yakhe? Ngeke ngize ngivume mina ukudlala le ndoda,” kusho le ntokazi.Uveze ukuthi kunina bayisithupha, amadodakazi amabili bese kuba ngamadodana amane. Unina uNksz Snonozi Mashiyane uthe washona ngo-1999."Ngesikhathi umama eshona ngangineminyaka engu-8 (eyishiyagalombili) nje kuphela. Ekhaya sasikhuliswa yinkantolo sibizwa ngezintandane ngoba othisha bethu yibona abasicabangela ukuthi kumele sondliwe kanjalo,’’ echaza.Ugcizelele ukuthi uyise ayimfanele le mali ngoba ubengekho empilweni yakhe iminyaka eminingi kakhulu bakhula engekho. "Buka nje kukhona ngisho nomfowethu onguthisha kodwa akazihluphi ngathi. Omunye unezingane akazondli. Nalapho ngisola ubaba engibona ukuthi babukela kuye,’’ kusho yena evukwa yisibibithwane.Echaza ngakufisayo, ukuthi umshado wakhe ube seqophelweni eliphezulu kodwa uyise angabi bikho kuwona. Ukhale ngokuthi uyise ushiye isifundo esibi kubafowabo sokuthi umndeni awondliwa.Ufunge wagomela wathi akafuni ukuthi kube khoba okubahlanganisayo noyise, ulunge engenamzali."Umuntu angaduka iminyaka eminingi kangaka bese ezoqondanisa nosuku olungaka," kubuza uNksz Ntenga, osho lokhu ngesikhathi egwedwa ngemibuzo yokuthi kwenzekeni.Kumanje indodakazi kaMnuz Ntenga ithe isize yafinyelela esinqumweni sokwenzela uyise incwadi yesivimbelo sasenkantolo. Indodakazi okwamanje akukho lapho isebenza khona, umkhwenyana kuvela ukuthi usebenza emapulazini.Ngakolunye uhlangothi uyise uthe yena wazi ukuthi indodakazi yakhe kumele ikhokhelwe kuyena. Eziphendulela uMnuz Ntenga uzwakalise ukungangabazi ukuthi yini okumele yenzeke."Indodakazi yami lena, angifuni ukuthi kube khona omunye umuntu othatha imali yamalobolo," usho kanje.Kuvela ukuthi imali yamalobolo igcine ithathwa esinye isihlobo sowesilisa, esingumzala kababa kamlobokazi, kodwa wayibuyisela kuyona indodakazi ebizocelwa. Lesi sinyathelo simdine kakhulu uMnuz Ntenga nokubukeka sekuqhathe lo mndeni."Into engicasulayo ukuthi umzala wami ungenaphi ekulotsholweni kwendodakazi yami njengoba kulotsholwa kuyena bese futhi yena imali ayiphindise kundodakazi,’’ kusho uMnuz Ntenga.Uthe akakaze naseJudeni engezwa ukuthi imali yamalobolo iphelela ezandleni zomuntu olotsholwayo.Ethintwa umzala ucingo lwakhe belungangeni.
KUSHIYE isijabane esingachazeki ukubulawa kwabesifazane ababili, indodakazi nonina, abebehlala KwaMasxha, eMayville eThekwini ngoLwesine. Isidumbu sikaNkk Patricia Nokuthula Jeza (48) nendodakazi yakhe uNksz Queen Jezelihle Jeza (22) zitholwe endaweni yokulahla udoti eMachobeni eNanda, ngasemfuleni uMngeni ngoLwesihlanu. Kuvele ukuthi babulawe ngokudutshulwa ngoLwesine. Kuthe kusabatshazwa lokho, amaphoyisa athela othulini abasolwa abane ngoMgqibelo, okukholakala ukuthi bayamene nokubulawa kwabesifazane. Ithathe elinye ijika indaba ngesikhathi amaphoyisa esebopha inyanga edumile yaseNanda, esolwa ngokuthi ibithenge izinkabi ukuthi zibulale laba besifazane.UMUFI uNksz Queen Jezelihle Jeza Ngesikhathi Isolezwe lihambele emzini wabafile izolo, lifice uNksz Pinky Mlambo, ongudadewabo kaNkk Jeza. Bekukhona nezingane ezisencane ezintathu, kuzona kukhona ezimbili zikaNkk Jeza, kuthi eyesithathu kube ngekaNksz Jeza.UNksz Mlambo ubehleli yedwa kumatilasi, engekho obemzimazisile. Izihlobo ezimbalwa ezificwe yiSolezwe, zisheshe zavalelisa.UNksz Mlambo ukhale ngokuba yedwa, angabi nawo amalungu omndeni amesekayo ngesikhathi esinzima, njengoba udadewabo ebulewe nendodakazi yakhe endala, ushiye yena nalezi izingane ezintathu, angazi ukuthi uzoyithini indaba yazo.Isolezwe lihoshe emthonjeni walo ethembekile ukuthi laba besifazane bathengelwe yinyanga izinkabi. Kuthiwa inyanga le ibinqwahe no-R300 000 eyayiwunikwe wuNkk Jeza phambilini, kuvunyelwene ngokuthi izode imfakela imali ethile njalo ngenyanga."Kuthiwa igcine ingasamfakeli imali njengokwesethembiso, okuholele ekutheni agcine ethi ayiwubuyise u-R300 000,” kusho umthombo.Uqhuba umthombo uthe ayizange inqabe inyanga uma esho njalo, kuhlelwe usuku, kwavunyelwana ngokuthi imali ilandwe ngoLwesine."Baphume ekhaya ngoLwesine beyolanda wona-ke (uR300 000) njengoba begcine sebetholwa bebulelwe ngakhona eNanda,” kulandisa umthombo.Phezu kwale mpambankwici, kunomndeni wesosha, uMnuz Bongani Jeza ongasekho owayengumyeni walona wesifazane, oveze okushaqisayo ngabafi, wezwakalisa ubuhlungu ngokushona kwabo bengazikhiphanga 'izimpendulo’.UNkk Nobuhle Mchunu, ongudadewabo kaJeza, uveze ukuthi ngesikhathi eshona ngoSepthemba 2021 kwaphela izinyanga ezimbili engangcwatshiwe, kuphunywa kungenwa ezinkantolo kufunwa imbangela yokufa kwakhe."Uskwiza nendodakazi (abashonile) basho izinkulumo ezingafani ngokufa kukamfowethu owashona esendlini bekhona. Lokho kwasenza sasola ugcobho ngokufa kwakhe. Sathola ummeli ukuthi amise umngcwabo, kwenziwe ukuhlolwa kwesidumbu okuzimele,” kusho uNkk Mchunu.Uthe umphumela wabuya uthi uJeza akazishonelanga njengokusho kukaNkk Jeza nendodakazi kodwa washaywa ngesikhali esithile.UNkk Mchunu uthe kwenzeka lesi sigameko sokubulawa kwalaba ababili bona bebesalinde ukuthi kuqhume icala enkantolo."Besicabanga ukuthi basazoyovela enkantolo, bachaze ukuthi umfowethu wabulawa wubani ngoba endlini kwakukhona bona futhi baqamba amanga, bethi uzishonele,” kusho uNkk Mchunu."Sizwa ubuhlungu ngokuthi baze bashona bengakhulumile,” kusho uyena. Ubuye wathi basola ukuthi imali eyanikwa inyanga iyingxenye yeyaphuma emva kokushona kukamfowabo.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi abasolwa abane abathinteka kuleli cala badutshulwe ngamaphoyisa bafa ngoMgqibelo."Babanjwe besendleleni ebheke eMpophomeni, ukuyohlanjululwa. Imoto yabo ivinjwe ngamaphoyisa eSikebheni eMzinyathi kodwa abebephakathi bavele bavulela ngenhlamvu bebhekise emaphoyiseni. Nawo abuyisela, bafa bobane. Kutholwe izibhamu ezintathu kubona,” kusho uNetshiunda.
ZISALE enkundleni izigebengu ezimbili kulandela ukudubulana kwazo namaphoyisa eVerulam ngoMgqibelo.Izigebengu, ngokusho kwamaphoyisa, bezifunwa uthuli ngamacala abucayi, abandakanya awokubanjwa kwezimoto zemali, awokugqekeza izindlu nokuhlaselwa kwamapulazi.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda uthe izigebengu ezimbili bezisohlwini lwezigebengu ezifunelwa amacala ezisolwa ngawo ezifundazweni ezehlukene.Uthe amaphoyisa avela ezinhlakeni ezehlukene okukhona kuzo iTactical Response Team (TRT), oKlebe nonogada bezinkampani ezizimele abesebenza phezu komkhondo othize abewutholile."Avimbe imoto emgwaqweni uJabu Ngcobo Drive, ebebephakathi bathe uma bewabona, bavele bavulela ngenhlamvu bebhekise kuwona. Amaphoyisa abuyisele ngayo inhlamvu nawo nokuthe uma kuphela ukudubulana, kwatholakala izigebengu ezimbili zifile,” kusho uNetshiunda.Uthe amaphoyisa agcine ethola isibhamu esisodwa kubafi.Uveze ukuthi sikhona isigebengu esisodwa esiphunyukile, sabaleka siphethe isibhamu."Ukucingwa kwaso kuyaqhubeka,” kusho uNetshiunda.Udalule ukuthi ababulewe bayingxenye yabangu-15 abazama ukubulala amaphoyisa eTRT ngesikhathi kuphangwa imoto yemali eNkandla ngo-Agasti 2019.Uthe labo basolwa baboshwa kodwa babalekela inkantolo emva kokukhishwa ngebheyili.
ABESEKA uMntwana uSimakade Jackson kaZwelithini embangweni wesihlalo sobukhosi bukaZulu, baxwayisa iSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini ngobungozi obungadalwa ukuthi sizibambele mathupha ekulawulweni kweNgonyama Trust.Abeseka uMntwana uSimakade bathe ukuqhubeka kweSilo nokuba usihlalo webhodi leNgonyama Trust kungasehlisa isithunzi futhi kungasidonsela amanzi ngomsele uma kufanele kuthathelwe izinyathelo abephethe iNgonyama Trust.Lokhu bakusho esithangamini nabezindaba lapho bebephawula khona ngokuxoshwa kwabebesebenza eduze neSilo kanye nokuqokwa kukaNdunankulu kaZulu omusha, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi.ISilo saveza ukuthi sizoba uSihlalo weNgonyama Trust emva kokuxosha esamjuba njengoSihlalo, Inkosi Thanduyise kaMpiyezintombi Mzimela, sasusa ebhodini nelungu Inkosi uMabhudu Tembe.Okhulumela abeseka uMntwana uSimakade, uMntwana uThokozani Zulu, uthe isinqumo seSilo sokuzibambela sinobungozi."Lokhu kusho ukuthi usezehlisile yena, akaseyena umlomo ongathethi manga. Uma kukhulunywa ePhalamende, kusho ukuthi amalungu ePhalamende anelungelo lokumtshela uma ephuma endleleni. Sekufanele kube uye oziholayo uma Ingonyama Trust iyochaza ngokusetshenziswa kwemali. Uyochaza kuze kushe amathe. Kuyodingeka achaze ngisho nangezinto ezenzeke engakabi uSihlalo weNgonyama Trust. Uma kunesinqumo sokuthi kufanele kuboshwe izikhulu zeNgonyama Trust, naye uyoboshwa.”UMzimela noTembe baxoshwe kanye nobekhulumela iSilo, uMntwana u-Africa wasoNkweni.UMntwana uThokozani uthe bayawelana nalabo abaxoshiwe, wathi ukuxoshwa kwabo kufanele kuvule amehlo abaseduze kweSilo."Siyabakhalela labo abakhonjwe indlela, ikakhulukazi Inkosi uTembe, okwayo kubuhlungu kakhulu ngoba ixoshwe ingakalitholi ithuba lokuba usihlalo. Ijikiswe endleleni. Lokhu kuyisifundo sokuthi akekho ophephile uma usondele eduze kwakhe (iSilo). Baningi ababekade bemeseka kepha bagcina bexoshiwe.”UMntwana uThokozani uthe abahambisani nokuqokwa kukandunankulu kaZulu omusha.UMntwana uThokozani uthe bekungafanele kuqokwe undunankulu kaZulu omusha ekubeni undunankulu kaZulu omdala Inkosi Mangosuthu Buthelezi engakenzelwa yonke imicimbi yasekhaya, nomoya wakhe ungakalandwa esigodlweni.Uthe isimemezelo sokuqokwa kukandunankulu kufanele simenyezelwe esibayeni esikhulu esigodlweni eNyokeni, wathi kufanele senziwe emva koMkhosi woSelwa oba ngasekupheleni konyaka."Le nto ikhombisa ukuthi laba bantu okuthiwa baphethe abayazi into abayenzayo. Kufana nengane ephathiswe ibhokisi likamentshisi.”
IPHINI likamengameli we-ANC, uMnuz Paul Mashatile, lithi i-ANC izomangaza abaningi okhethweni oluzayo.Yize ucwaningo lukhombisa ukuthi i-ANC izothola ngaphansi kuka-50% okhethweni olubhekwe ngabomvu, uMashatile uthe akakungabazi ukuthi le nhlangano izobuyela emandleni.Lokhu ukusho ngesikhathi ekhuluma namalungu e-ANC eMgungundlovu ngoMgqibelo.UMashatile uthe baningi abantu abathi i-ANC isizoshabalala njengoba isiphathe uhulumeni iminyaka engu-30."I-ANC indala kakhulu, iyona kuphela inhlangano yezepolitiki eneminyaka engaphezu kuka-112 lapha ezwenikazi i-Afrika. Amanye amaqembu ayafika aphinde ashabalale. I-ANC iyinqanawe engayi ndawo."Kufanele sikujabulele ukuthi sesiphathe uhulumeni iminyaka engu-30. Amaqembu amaningi ayashabalala uma esephathe iminyaka engu-30. Yingakho abanye becabanga ukuthi nathi sizoshabalala.”UMashatile uthe abawasabi la maqembu asonga ngokubakhipha emandleni."Abanye bahamba bekhuluma bethi bazonqoba ukhetho kodwa uma uthi uyababheka, banezihlalo ezimbili ePhalamende. Asazi ukuthi bacabanga ukuthi bazolunqoba kanjani ukhetho uma besapatanisa kanje.”I-ANC izokwethula umqulu wezethembiso zokhetho eThekwini, ngoMgqibelo esiya kuwo.UMashatile uthe sebewulungele umcimbi ozayo."Ngiyababona abanye bathi sebeyethulile imiqulu yezethembiso. Ngesikhathi abanye bezwa ukuthi siza KwaZulu-Natal, sizokwethula umqulu eMoses Mabhida, bagijima phambili. Kodwa-ke iqiniso ukuthi iMoses Mabhida yinkundla enkulu. Lena yinkundla edinga iqembu elikhulu. "Wonke umuntu uzobona uma sekufika i-ANC ukuthi sekufike iqembu langempela. Kuzocacela noma ubani uma sesifikile,” usho kanje kuzwakala ukuthi ubhinqa i-EFF ebihlangene kule nkundla muva nje. Uthe ubuholi be-ANC buzohlala lapha KwaZulu-Natal kuze kudlule umcimbi, wanxusa bonke abantu ukuba baphume ngobuningi babo bezolalela umengameli.UMashatile uthe umengameli uzomemezela usuku lokhetho maduze."Akusensuku zatshwala uRamaphosa amemezele ukhetho. Kukhona nje okuncane asukucubungula. Thina silindele umhlahlandlela.”UMashatile uqale uhambo lwakhe eThekwini lapho ehlangane khona nezinhlaka ezeseka abantu basePalestine njengoba kuqhubeka impi phakathi kwe-Israel neHamas esifundeni iGaza.UMashatile uncome uhulumeni wakuleli ngokufaka i-Israel enkantolo yamacala amazwe omhlaba."Ngincoma isibindi kuRamaphosa. Kwathi lapho abaholi bamazwe amaningi begwajaza, yena wavele waqunga isibindi. Baningi abebethi izosixaka le nto esiyiqalayo kodwa namhlanje umhlaba wonke uncoma isenzo seNingizimu Afrika.”
KUHLEHLISIWE ukuvalwa kwesiphehlimazi esisenyakatho yeTheku obekuhlelelwe ukuthi kuqale ngoLwesibili kuze kube uLwesithathu.UMasipala weTheku ubumemezele ukuthi lesi siphehlimanzi sizovalwa ukuze kulungiswe ama-valva amanzi abengalungisiwe okuholela ekutheni imiphakathi ehlala ezindaweni ezisenyakatho yeTheku inqanyukelwe amanzi.UNkk Gugu Sisilana uthe lokhu kuvalwa kwamanzi kuhlehlisiwe ngakho-ke umphakathi uzokwaziswa ngosuku okuyilona-lona azolungiswa ngaso. Akachazanga ukuthi kwenziwe yini ukuthi lokhu kuvalwa kwamanzi obekuzothinta izindawo ezifana neNanda, Ntuzuma, uMhlanga, Newlands East, Springfield Durban North, Phoenix neVerulam, kuhlehlisiwe."Siyacela ukuthi umphakathi usebenzise amanzi ngendlela enokuwonga,” kusho uNkk Sisilana.
UHULUMENI wasekhaya yilona hlaka olusondelene kakhulu nabantu emazingeni aphansi. Lokho kwenza ukuthi uma umuntu ecabanga ngohulumeni abone ikhansela nomasipala. Omasipala bavamile ukuhlaselwa yizinkinga zokungabi nozinzo nokungaphathwa kahle kwemali.Umasipala uba nobuholi bezepolitiki obuphathwa yimeya, yiphini lemeya nosomlomo, namakhansela. Okwabo wukwelusa ukusebenza komkhandlu ngaphansi kwemiyalelo nokujutshwa ngamaqembu abo.Ngaphansi kwabo bese kuba khona izikhulu nabasebenzi abaholwa yimenenja zikamasipala, kube khona isikhulu sezimali nezikhulu zeminyango ehlukene. Kugcina kuba nomsindo nokuklwebhana komasipala, ikakhulu kulabo abaphethwe ngokubambisana kwamaqembu.Kusuke kubangwa amandla nezikhundla bese umasipala ugcina ungasebenzi kahle. Kwabanye kuphazamiseka nemihlangano, kufakwane nasenkantolo. Ukuhlasela kwezinkinga komasipala kudalwa yizinto ezehlukene. Kuyenzeka ukuthi kufinyelele ezingeni likahulumeni wesifundazwe bese kuphoqeleka ukuthi angenelele. Uhulumeni wesifundazwe ugunyazwa yisigatshana soMthethosisekelo uSection 139, sokuthi usebenzise umlawuli.Kunomasipala abaningi KwaZulu-Natal, nakwezinye izifundazwe abafakwe ngaphansi komlawuli ngenxa yemisebenzi yabo engagculisi. Yini umsebenzi womlawuli?Umlawuli ngumuntu noma abantu okukholakala ukuthi banolwazi namakhono afanele ukusiza umasipala abasuke bejutshwe nguhulumeni. Lowo muntu noma labo abasuke bejutshiwe basuke bebekelwe isikhathi esithize. Basuke beqashwe uMnyango ubanikeze imiyalelo ngokufanele bakwenze.Isizindalwazi soMnyango wokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu, sichaza ngokuthi kusukelaphi ukufaka umlawuli."USection 139(1), 4 no-5 ugunyaza uhulumeni wesifundazwe ukuthi ungenelele kumasipala uma wehluleka ukuphasisa isabelomali njengokusho komthetho,’’ kusho uMnyango. Lapha umnyango uba nokuthi uma isimo sezimali zomkhandlu sibheda kakhulu kungaphatheki ngendlela, kusuke kuphoqa ukuthi kungenelelwe.Okhulumela uMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Siboniso Mngadi, uthi umnyango awuvuki ekuseni ufake umlawuli."Kwenziwa ucwaningo kubhekwe kabanzi izinto ezehlukene njengesimo sezimali, ukuphathwa komkhandlu nokunye. Umnyango ube usudlulisa udaba esigungwini esiphezulu sikahulumeni kube yisona esinqumayo,’’ kuchaza uMngadi.Izinsolo zokulwa izimpi zepolitiki Udaba lokufakwa komasipala ngaphansi komlawuli luvame ukubangwa kakhulu kuqubuke izinsolo zokudlalisana injeje, emaqenjini epolitiki. KwaZulu-Natal omasipala baphethwe ngokwehlukana, kukhona abangaphansi kwe-IFP, nabangaphansi kwe-ANC.Uhulumeni wesifundazwe uphethwe yi-ANC, okuchaza ukuthi yiyona esemandleni okubheka ukusebenza komasipala nokuthatha izinqumo uma kufanele kufakwe umlawuli. Uqala lapho-ke umsindo! Uma amaqembu esola uhulumeni we-ANC ngokusebenzisa amandla awo ukulwa nomasipala bawo.KUYENZEKA kusuke impi emhlanganweni yomasipala igcine idungeka ngenxa yamaqembu asuke eklwebhana Isithombe : SIGCINIWEI-IFP isikhale kakhulu ngokuthi isola ukuthi kuphunywa iqhubu nomasipala bayo ukuthi bafakwe ngaphansi komlawuli. I-IFP isike yaba nemashi ibheke emahhovisi omnyango iyokhala ngalesi simo. Amaqembu aphikiisayo aze aphosela i-ANC, nohulumeni inselelo yokuthi uma kwenziwa ngeqiniso kufanele noMasipala weTheku, ufakwe ngaphansi komlawuli ngoba usolwa ngokungenzi kahle.UMasipala weTheku uke wasolwa ngokwehlukela wukusebenza ngendlela efanele kwaze kwangenelela umnyango kazwelonke, kwase kuthunyelwa abalekeleli. UMasipala weTheku yiwona wodwa umasipala omkhulu futhi owaziwa ngeMetro esifundazweni.I-DA iphakathi kwamaqembu ashaya amakhala ngendlela okuqokwa ngayo abalawuli bafakwe komasipala bayo.USihlalo weDA KwaZulu- Natal, uMnuz Dean Mcpherson, uke wathi iqembu lifuna ukuthola iseluleko sezomthetho ngokufanele bakwenziwe ngesimo."Indaba yabalawuli igcina iba wumgoqo ekusebenzeni nasekulweni nenkohlakalo. I-ANC igcina isebenzisa abalawuli ukulwa izimpi zepolitiki. Sitholile ukuthi abalawuli bagcina besebenzela i-ANC esikhundleni sokwenza umsebenzi wabo,’’ kukhononda uMcpherson.Uqhube wathi ubona sengathi azikho izinhloso ezinhle ngokufakwa kwabalawuli kodwa kusuke kudlalwa ipolitiki nje. Okuqaphelekayo wukuthi kukhona omasipala abahlala isikhathi eside ngaphansi komlawuli.Muva nje iMeya kaMasipala Abaqulusi, uMnuz Khehla Mkhwanazi, ibikhala ngokuthi uhulumeni ufuna ukufaka umasipala wayo ngaphansi komlawuli kodwa bayakuphikisa lokho.Ibikhala ngokuthi abalawuli banomlando ongemuhle komasipala ngoba abavamile ukusiza ngalutho. Ibikhala ngokuthi abalawuli bafica omasipala besesimeni esibi bona benze sibe nzima kakhulu kunokulekelela.
UMHOLI we-EFF, uMnuz Julius Malema, ukhathazwa wudlame lwezepolitiki olungaqubuka KwaZulu-Natal njengoba sekuneqembu elisha lezepolitiki elikhankaselwa owayengumengameli, uJacob Zuma, uMkhonto weSizwe.UMalema uthe zivele sezikhona izinkomba zokuthi kungase kube nodlame njengoba kubonakale amavidiyo amalungu e-ANC exakazisana namalungu oMkhonto weSizwe ngesikhathi kuqhubeka ukhetho lokuchibiyela kuMasipala wasoPhongolo.Lokhu ukusho ekhuluma nabezindaba lapho ebekhuluma khona ngomcimbi wokwethula umbhalo wezethembiso we-EFF obuseThekwini.UMalema uthe iKwaZulu-Natal iyaziwa ngodlame lwezepolitiki, kufanele kuthathwe izinyathelo ezizonqanda ukuqubuka kodlame."UKhomishana wamaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, Lt Gen Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, kufanele alusukumele lolu daba. Njengoba sesiqalile nje sibona abantu belwa, kusho ukuthi kukhulu okungenzeka.”UMalema uthe naye useke waba yisisulu sodlame lwezepolitiki KwaZulu-Natal."Kunezikhathi lapho kuke kwaba khona abantu abazama ukungivimba ukuba ngingangeni ezikhungweni zokuvota. Kwenye indawo ngake ngavinjwa yindoda endala eyayiphethe ikani lotshwala, yathi ngeke ngingene esikhungweni sokuvota. Ngayitshela ukuthi ngeke ngihambe ngingangenile esikhungweni sokuvota.”UMalema uthe kwaba nemizamo yokuphazamisa umcimbi we-EFF wokwethula kohlu lwezethembiso."Miningi imizamo eyenziwa ngabantu abakhombisa ukucwasa ngokobuhlanga. Siyakugxeka kakhulu ukucwasa ngokobuhlanga.”UMalema uphinde wanxusa umengameli, uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa, ukuba amemezele usuku lokhetho."Njengoba sesiwethulile umqulu wezethembiso, sekufanele engabe sesiyaqala sifaka izingqwembe zasemgwaqweni ezinxenxa abantu ukuthi bavote. Lezi ngqwembe kufanele zibe nosuku lokhetho. Manje-ke asikwazi ukuzifaka, usuku lokhetho singakalwazi.”UMalema wenze izinsolo zokuthi uRamaphosa ubambezela ngamabomu ukumemezela usuku lokhetho ngoba uyesaba ukuthi i-ANC izohlulwa okhethweni."Uma ubheka ngo-2019 uRamaphosa wamemezela usuku lokhetho ngesikhathi ethula inkulumo ayeyibhekise esizweni. Yini emvimbile ukuthi amemezele usuku lokhetho ngesikhathi ethula inkulumo ayibhekise esizweni ngesonto eledlule?"Umehluko wukuthi ngo-2019 wayesenedumela. Wayezethemba futhi engakungabazi ukuthi i-ANC izolunqoba ukhetho. Kulo nyaka izinto zijikile. Uyabona ukuthi akuzi kahle. Yingakho ezama ukubambezela. Mhlawumbe ukhetho uzolukhomba ku-Agasti.”
UBONGA uNkulunkulu umfundisi ongumholi webandla ebelivula ngokusemthethweni isakhiwo esidle imali eshisiwe.Udumise amandla omdali uMbhishobhi Bhekimpi Mchunu, ongumholi weFotress of Hope Church International, ngesikhathi bevula isakhiwo sikaR1,5 million esiseCato Crest, eMayville.UMchunu ubonge bonke abazalwane bebandla ngeminikelo yabo abayikhiphile isuka ngaphakathi othandweni lwabo. Uthe kunemindeni ekhonza ngaphakathi ebandleni enikele ngokwedlulele, wathi konke lokho uNkulunkulu ukubonile.Waqhuba wathi uthakasile kakhulu ngokufezeka kwephupho labo leminyaka lokuthi babe nendawo yabo yokukhonzela.Ngokusho kukaMbhishobhi kuyigxathu elikhulu ukwakhiwa kwendlu yokukhonza."Ngithanda ukuthatha leli thuba ngidlulise ukubonga kwami okukhulu kubona bonke abazalwane balapha ebandleni abakhombise intshisekelo enkulu ngesikhathi simatasa nohlelo lokwakhiwa kwalesi sakhiwo,'' usho kanje uMchunu.Umfundisi uthe kwabanye abantu kuba nongabazane olukhulu uma bekhonza ebandleni elingenaso isakhiwo sokukhonzela. Okuhle ngesakhiwo uMchunu uthe sizobuye sibe wusizo emphakathini wakule ndawo.Leli bandla lihlanganisa iminyaka engu-20 nonyaka, lasungulwa. UMchunu uveze ukuthi bazoba nendumezulu yomcimbi wokogubha iminyaka yebandla ngasekupheleni konyaka babonge uNkulunkulu ngokuhamba nabo ibanga elide kangaka.Inkonzo yokuvulwa kwesakhiwo ibihanjelwe ngabaholi bezenkolo bamahlelo ehlukene KwaZulu-Natal.UMchunu unguSihlalo wenhlangano yabefundisi ebizwa ngokuthi yiChurch Leaders Council of Southern Africa.Ubuye abe ngumsunguli wenhlangano ebhekelele amadoda ebizwa ngokuthi iSukuma Ndoda Sakhe.
UMPHAKATHI waseSinembe, KwaDukuza, ufuna lujule uphenyo kuvele iqiniso lonke futhi ijeziswe indoda eneminyaka engu-43, eboshiwe ngenxa yezinsolo zokushaya indali indodakazi yayo eneminyaka ewu-14 kowokufika.Umphakathi obuhambisana nabaholi be-ANC esifundeni iGeneral Gizenga Mpanza, ubhikishe ngaphandle kweNkantolo yeMantshi KwaDukuza, lapho obekuvele khona abamangalelwa. Uyise wengane uvele enkantolo nowesilisa wokufika oneminyaka engu-23, ongenawo amaphepha okuba kuleli.Izinsolo zithi indoda eneminyaka engu-43, engeke idalulwe ukuze kuvikelwe umgilwa, yabika emaphoysieni ukuthi ingane yayo idukile kanti ihubhuza amanga. Kuthiwa ibikele amaphoyisa ngesonto eledlule yabhala isitatimende kwase kuqala uphenyo.Isolezwe ngeMpelasonto lithole ukuthi kuqubuke ukuvungama umphakathi usuthola ukuthi kuboshwe uyise wengane nomlisa wokufika okusolwa ukuthi uyidlwengulile. Kuthiwa ngesikhathi umphakathi uphume inqina uthungatha ingane itholwe nowokufika ehlathini thizeni.AMALUNGU omphakathi abephumile ebhikisha ngaphandle kweNkantolo yeMantshi KwaDukuza lapho obekuvele khona amadoda amabili asolwa ngokudayiselana ingane isithombe : SITHUNYELWEIhhovisi le-ANC lithe kunezinsolo zokuthi uyise wengane ubethenjiswe ilobolo, wase evuma ukunika umsolwa indodakazi yakhe.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu- Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe uyise wengane uboshiwe nomlisa wokufika."Ubaba wengane oneminyaka engu-43 uboshelwe amacala okushushumbisa umuntu, ukuqamba amanga efungile, ukuphazamisa ukusebenza kwengalo yomthetho, amacala aphathelene nemali nokumosha izinsiza zombuso,’’ kusho uNetshiunda.UNetshiunda uthe umlisa wokufika uboshelwe icala lokudlwengula, nokuba sezweni ngaphandle kwemvume. Kulindeleke ukuthi icala libuyele enkantolo ngoMsombuluko sekuzolalelwa isicelo sebheyili.Abe-ANC bathe bazophinde bawugqugquzele umphakathi ukuthi uphume ngobuningi bawo uyolwela ubulungiswa, uphikise nesicelo sebheyili. Bathe kufanele kuliwe nesihlava esibi sokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane.
UTHUSHUKE neqembu elisha uMnuz Ahmed Munzoor Shaik Emam oyilungu leNFP ePhalamende. Izindaba zeqembu lika-Emam elisha zidalulwe wuMnuz Irvin Barnes we-NFP, ethi bayajabula ngokuhamba kwakhe.I-NFP yaqembuka kwi-IFP ngo-2011 kuphuma owayengusihlalo, uNkk Zanele kaMagwaza-Msibi, ongasekho emhlabeni. Umholi wayo ushona nje isimo seqembu sasivele singasesihle kahle kubhoke ubuqembuqembu nombango.U-Emam ubehola iNFP ePhalamende futhi eyilungu leqembu eliqavile ebese lihlale isikhathi kuyona. UBarnes uthe u-Emam uvule iqembu, i-AM4C, futhi kubukeka sengathi lizongenela ukhetho.'’Sizwa sikhululekile futhi kwehle umthwalo ngokuhamba kwakhe ngoba ubebuye asidalele izinkinga eqenjini. Kuyaqapheleka ukuthi u-Emam uvule iqembu okuthiwa yi-AM4C. Thina sizimisele ngokuhlabela phambili singene esigabeni esisha sobumbano nenqubekela phambili,’’ kusho uBarnes.Esithombeni esithunyele wuBarnes esiveza iqembu elisha, kuvela ikhanda lika-Emam nemibala efana neyenhlangano ebusayo, i-ANC, bese kuba wuphawu olubukeka sengathi yilanga liphuma. Eceleni kwekhanda lika-Emam kubekwe uphawu lokuvota ebhokisini nolujwayele ukuvela uma iqembu likhankasela ukhetho.Kwenzeka lokhu nje iNFP ivele ihlaselwe yizinkinga zombango wezikhundla, ihlala iphuma ingena ezinkantolo. Ihlalisa izingqungquthela kujike kubangwe kuzona kube mapeketwane.Konke lokhu kwenzeka izwe lilungiselela ukhetho lukazwelonke okulindeleke ukuthi lube maphakathi nonyaka.
UNGQONGQOSHE wamaPhoyisa uMnuz Bheki Cele, uthe kuyiqiniso ukuthi umphakathi ubuye ungawethembi kahle amaphoyisa kodwa bakhona abantu abawancomayo ngomsebenzi wawo.UCele ukusho lokhu ngoLwesihlanu eTshwane ngenkathi ethula izibalo zobugebengu zekota yesithathu. Kulezi zibalo kuvele ukuthi isibalo samacala ocansi sehle sisuka ku-15 545 sahlala ku-15 284, okusho ukwehla ngamacala angu-261. Lokhu kuchaza ukuthi ehle ngo-1.7% uma kuqhathaniswa nesikhathi esedlule.Isibalo samacala okubulala senyukile uma kuqhathaniswa nesikhathi esedlule. Isibalo samacala okubulala abikiwe sisuke ku-7 555 sayohlala ku-7 710, okusho ukwenyuka ngamacala angu-155 okuchaza ukuthi amacala athe ukwanda ngo-2.1%. Amacala okuzama ukubulala anyukile esuka ku-70 016 afika ku-70 927, okuchaza ukwanda ngamacala angu-911. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi enyuke ngo-13% uma kuqhathaniswa nesikhathi esedlule.Okunye okuqaphelekile wukwenyuka kwamacala okubamba inkunzi ngendluzula, okunyuke kwasuka ku-37 829 kwafinyelela ku-40 331. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi isibalo senyuke ngamacala angu-2 502, okusho ukwenyuka ngo-6.6%.Abezindaba bacele ukuthi uCele abeke uvo lwakhe ngokwethenjwa kwamaphoyisa emphakathini. Uvumile ukuthi kunenkinga kodwa wathi kufanele kuvezwe zonke izinhlangothi."Yebo, kukhona inkinga yokwehla kokwethenjwa kwamaphoyisa futhi ikhona nemibiko eke iphume ezinhlakeni ezehlukene echaza lokhu. Namuhla kodwa kukhona isiteshi esizoklonyeliswa ngomsebenzi omuhle esiwenzayo. Akhona amazambane abolile kodwa bakhona nabashaya into ecokeme,’’ kuphendula uCele.Uthe kwezinye izindawo umsebenzi wamaphoyisa uyabonakala futhi ayanconywa. Uthe amazambane abolile akhona yonke indawo ngoba bake bethole izibhamu nezinhlamvu emasontweni. Uveze nokuthi phakathi kwabasolwa abahamba izinkantolo kukhona nabathenjiwe abangabafundisi.Ungqongqoshe uthe kodwa basebenza kanzima ukubuyisa isithunzi sombutho wamaphoyisa. Unxuse ukuthi umphakathi ulekelele amaphoyisa ekulweni nobugebengu.Isibalo sokubanjwa kwezimoto zemali sehlile sisuka ku-57 safika ku-46, okusho ukwehla ngamacala angu-11.
OWAYENGUMENGAMELI we-ANC nezwe, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, ukhishiwe esikhundleni sokuba nguSihlalo weSANCO KwaZulu-Natal, esolwa ngokungayi ngisho kowodwa umhlangano wayo selokhu akhethwa.I-SANCO yinhlangano yabahlali engamadlelandawonye ne-ANC. Uthe uma amalungu abo enza njalo ayothathelwa izinyathelo.Kuvela udaba lweSANCO nje, muva nje uZuma uthunyelelwe incwadi yi-ANC, imazisa ukuthi umisiwe njengelungu watshelwa nohlu lwamacala akhe. UZuma ubesathule futhi akucaci noma uzoyiphendula incwadi noma ngeke.Kulindeleke ukuthi i-ANC ithathe isinqumo ngekusasa likaZuma emhlanganweni emuva kwesikhathi imbhalele. UZuma usanda kukhuluma eMlaza, ethi ngeke ezwe nge-ANC futhi akasabi muntu.

LIZOZE libuyele ngoMashi enkantolo icala lokubulawa kowayengunozinti we-Orlando Pirates neBafana Bafana, uSenzo Meyiwa. UMeyiwa, owayedabuka eMlaza, eThekwini, wadutshulwa wabulawa ekubo kwentombi yakhe ewumculi, uKelly Khumalo, eVosloorus, eGauteng ngo-2014.Kuboshwe abalisa abahlanu uMbuso okholwa wukuthi yibona abathengwa ukuthi baqede ngoMeyiwa kodwa bayawaphika onke amacala ababekwe wona. Ukuphika kwabo amacala kuholele ekutheni abameli bafake isicelo sokuthi inkantolo ingazemukeli izitatimende okuthiwa bazibhala bevuma amacala.UMbuso ubize ofakazi bawo waqeda, kwaba yithuba labameli nabo bethula ubufakazi, bagibeza abamangalelwa ebhokisini. UMbuso uthe usubusongile ubufakazi nabameli bathi baqedile sekufanele kwenziwe izethulo zokugcina ezibhalwe phansi.IJaji Ratha Makgoatlheng nezinhlangothi zombili, uMbuso nabameli, baxoxile bebonisana ngokuthi amaphepha kufanele afakwe nini. Bagcine bevumelene ngokuthi uMbuso unikwa kuze kube wuFebhuwari 26 ukuthi ufake amaphepha.Ithimba labameli lanikwa ukuthi lilandele lifake awalo ngomnqamulajuqu kaMashi 1 bese kubuyelwa enkantolo ngoMashi 4, izinhlangothi zizokwenza izethulo kubuka wonke umuntu.Kuyothi uma kuqedwa izethulo bese ijaji licubungula kabanzi likhiphe isinqumo ekutheni kufanele yini izitatimende zisebenze njengobufakazi noma cha.IJaji uMakgoatlheng livumile nakuba bekucaca ukuthi aleneme, likhala ngokuthi abaphathi balo ngeke bayinambithisise kahle le ndaba."UMengameli wamaJaji uzodumala ngalesi sinqumo ngoba ubezitshela ukuthi kuzothi ukushesha kunalokho,’’ kusho iJaji uMakgoatlheng.Ummangalelwa wesibili, uBongani Ntanzi, ube ngowokugcina ukufakaza ngesikhathi kuguqa udaba futhi ubelokhu eqhubeka nokuphika izinto eziningi. UMbuso uthi uNtanzi nommangalelwa wokuqala, uMuzikawukhulelwa Sibiya, bawavuma amacala emaphoyiseni.UMbuso uthi bavuma amacala, babhala izitatimende bazisayina baze bakhomba nomuntu owayebanike itoho lokujuqa uMeyiwa. Abamangalelwa bathi babexinwe amaphoyisa ngesibhaxu baze basayina izitatimende bephephisa impilo yabo.Okunye okuqaphelekile ngesikhathi abamangalelwa bethula ubufakazi bekubuye kuvele ukushayisana nababekusho ekuqaleni ngemilomo yabameli babo.

BANGAPHEZULU kuka- 30 odokotela bakuleli abaqondiswe ubugwegwe ngemuva kokwephula imigomo yokusebenza kwabo nyakenye.Lokhu kuvezwe umbiko womkhandlu wabasebenzi bezempilo, iHealth Practioners Council SA (HPCSA) wonyaka u2022 kuya ku-2023 okhishwe kuleli sonto.Kulo mbiko kuvela ukuthi amacala abebhekene nalabo dokotela abandakanya ukuhlukumeza ngokocansi, ukubulala, ukungalandeli umgomo wokubhalisa imithi ebhukwini elifanele, ungazazisi iziguli ngobungozi bendlela ezolandela uma zelashwa namanye. Kuvela ukuthi ngesikhathi ehlinza isiguli wathinta umthambo omkhulu ohambisa igazi ne-oxygen emzimbeni okwaholela ekutheni isiguli sishone. Waphinde watholakala enecala lokungasazisi lesi siguli ngobucayi bendlela yokwelapha eyayizolandelwa okwaholela ekutheni siyivume singenalo ulwazi."Unecala lokungaziphathi kahle noma ukuziphatha ngokungafanele. Uma kubhekwa umsebenzi wakho ngo-Ephreli 2013, wenza umsebenzi ngendlela ephambene nebekiwe, uhlulekile noma udembesele ukwazisa isiguli ngobungozi obukhona ngeLaparoscopic Nissen Fundoplication," kusho umbiko.Lo dokotela uhlawuliswe u-R20 000, okumele awukhokhe ngoJuni 30 nonyaka.Omunye utholakale enecala lokuhlukumeza ngokocansi ngesigameko asenza ngo-2015, wahlawuliswa uR50 000.Omunye kutholakale ukuthi wafaka isicelo sokukhokhelwa i-medical aid yesiguli, ekubeni engazange awenze umsebenzi ayebhale ukuthi uwenzile ngesikhathi efaka isicelo.Elinye icala okutholakale kulo ukuthi udokotela uphule umthetho, ngelokuthi wehluleka ukugcina ibhuku lapho ebhala khona uma enikeza iziguli imithi esesigabeni esiwu-schedule 6. Udokotela ulivumile icala wahlawuliswa uR100,000 okumele awukhokhe ezinyangeni eziyisithupha kuwo lo nyaka."Udokotela otholakele enecala umisiwe ekutheni akhiphe le mithi izinyanga ezingu-12, waphinde wabekelwa iminyaka emithathu yokuthi angatholakali enecala elifanayo," kusho umbiko

INHLANGANO iSouth African Local Government Association (Salga), KwaZulu-Natal isinxuse abaholi bamaqembu ezepolitiki ahlukene ukuthi baqaphele izinto abazishoyo emphakathini njengoba kusondela ukhetho, ukugwema udungunyana olungaholela ekubulaweni kosopoliki.Lokhu kushiwo wuSihlalo kulesi sifundazwe, uMnuz Thami Ntuli ebize isithangami nabezindaba ebesiseMusgrave eThekwini, ngoLwesithathu.Le nhlangano beyihlose ukudlulisa ilaka layo ngesihlava emva kwesigameko sakamuva sokubulawa kwekhansela le-IFP kuMasipala waKwaNongoma, uMnuz Ndukenhle Duma.UDuma udutshulwe esemotweni yakhe eMtubatuba, okuthiwa ubephuthuma emhlanganweni wamakhansela obuseHluhluwe. Ngakho njengoba silungisela ukhetho, sibona kuqhubeka, kuzoletha ukwesaba kubantu, yingakho sihlaba ikhwelo ekutheni bonke abaholi bezepoliitiki baqikelele abakushoyo uma bekhuluma nomphakathi, kungabi yizinto ezizoqubula udlame,” kusho uNtuli.UNtuli uthe kuyakhathaza ukuthi ababulali basebenzisa izibhamu ezinkulu, iningi lazo ezingatholakali kalula ezitolo. Uthe kuyakhombisa ukuthi ukubulala osopolitiki sekuyibhizinisi lokwenza imali ezinkabini ezisuke ziqashelwe umsebenzi, okuzogcina kwenza sengathi ukubulawa komuntu yinto nje engathi shu kulesi sifundazwe.Uthe isifiso abanaso wukuthi zisetshenziswe izincomo zeKhomishini kaMoerane, eyancoma ukuthi kufundiswe abantu ngokusebenza yentando yeningi, ukuze abantu bengacabangi ukuthi ukubulala kuyisixazululo.Ugcizelele ukuthi amaphoyisa kumele aqinisekise ukubopha izigilamkhuba, kungabi yizinkabi kuphela kodwa kuphenywe kuze kuboshwe nalabo abasuke bezithumile. Ngokolwazi olushicilelwe phansi, osopolitiki abangu-39 abadlule emhlabeni ngenxa yezizathu ezehlukene kusuka ngoNovemba, 2021, abangu-19 kubona babulewe. Uthe olunye udaba olunomthelela ongemuhle komasipala, wolokucishwa kukagesi okwenza bagcine bengakwazi ukuhambisa izidingo zomphakathi kubantu, njengamanzi ngenxa yokuthi ukuze aphume ezindaweni zabo, kudingeka ugesi ukuqinisekisa ukusebenza kwamaphampu.Uthe lokhu akugcini ngokuphazamisa ukunikezelwa komphakathi ngezidingo, kuphazamise nasezikhungweni zikahulumeni, abalule kuzo izikole imitholampilo nezibhedlela lapho kusuke kunesidingo esikhulu sokuthi kutholakale amanzi nsuku zonke.

Sisalinde izimfanelo ezithile, okubalwa nobufakazi obuthinta imali eholwa emakhaya kulezo zitshudeni ezisalinde uxhaso.” Amalungu ekomiti akhale ngokuthi kuqalile ukufunda kuleli sonto ezikhungweni eziningi kuleli, kanti lezi zitshudeni zilinde into ezingayazi.UMnuz Mandla Shikwambana we-EFF, ukhale ngokuthi ezikhungweni eziningi izitshudeni zilala ngaphandle, azibhalisile ngoba zingazitholile izimpendulo.Uthe lokhu kubambezela kuzokwenza ukuthi izitshudeni zize zivuke umbhejazane, ziteleke ngoba zilinde umnyama ongenafu."Ezikhungweni eziningi izitshudeni zilala phandle ngenxa yokuthi azixhasiwe. Zilinde into ezingayazi ukuthi izofika nini ekubeni uFebhuwari usuphakathi sekuqaliwe nokufunda.”Usihlalo wekomiti uNksz Nompendulo Mkhatshwa, utshele izikhulu zoMnyango weMfundo ephakeme kanjalo nezeNSFAS ukuthi abantu bazitshela ukuthi ayikho into yamahhala.Uthe bazitshela ukuthi yiphupho nje ngoba izitshudeni zize zibhikishe nje ngenxa yokuthi ziyaphuza ukuthola uxhaso."Izitshudeni ziyaphuza ukuxhaswa, zize zilahle ithemba. Yingakho zize zicabange ukuthi yinto engekho eyemfundo yamahhala.”URamorwesi uthe bayikhipha imali bayinika izikhungo ukuthi zilungise eyalabo abebekweleta nyakenye.Uveze ukuthi kumele balandele imigomo ebekiwe ngaphambi kokuxhasa izitshudeni.Ubalule nokuthi ohlelweni lokuxhasa izitshudeni ezithathwa ngokuthi abazali bazo bahola kakhulu, abangalutholi uxhaso lomfundazwe lweNSFAS kodwa abazobolekwa imali abazoyibuyisa uma sebesebenza, bathole izicelo ezingu-22 954 zoxhaso.Uthe izicelo zalolu xhaso zivalwa namhlanje."Okwamanje sisaxhase izitshudeni ezingu-139 ngaphansi kwabathathwa ngokuthi abazali babo bahola kakhulu (missing middle). Abangu-12 890 sisalinde ukuthi balethe olunye ulwazi. Abangu-841 bahoxise izicelo zoxhaso, abangu-8 345 ababange besaqhubeka nokufaka izicelo zoxhaso bagcine ngokuvula amaphrofayli kuphela, bangazifaka izicelo.” Uthe bachithe abangu-476 abangalutholanga uxhaso, abahlanu bafake izimangalo, bafuna kubuyekezwe izicelo zabo. Uveze nokuthi bangu-791 405 abaxhasiwe abahola imali yesibonelelo sakwaSASSA, abangu-198 593 abaxhasiwe abasiholi lesi sibonelelo.Ucwaningi mabhuku jikelele kulo mhlangano ukhale ngokuba yinhlakanhlaka kwamabhuku alesi sikhwama njengoba sathola umbiko ongemuhle wezimali.
BAGWETSHWE iminyaka eyisishiyagalombili bebhadla ejele abaganene baseGoli emuva kokulahlwa ngamacala okuzama ukuqola iRoad Accident Fund (RAF) uR31 million.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi inkantolo yaseGoli igwebe uTanya Senekal nomyeni wakhe, uJaco Senekal, emuva kokulahlwa ngamacala awu-403 okukhwabanisa.Kuthiwa ababona abasebenzi kwaRAF noma abameli kodwa ngamaqola nje abone ithuba lokwenza imali esheshayo.Esitatimendeni esithunyelwe yiRAF, iveze ukuthi laba abaganene bebesebenzisana nonina kaTanya, uNkk Magdil Groenewald.Bafake izicelo zokukhokhelwa ngezingozi ezingazange zibe khona eziwu-537.UNkk Groenewald ugwetshwe iminyaka emihlanu njengoba yena afaka izicelo zokukhokhelwa kwiRAF eziwu-134.Kuthiwe isigwebo sakhe kungenzeka asidonsele ngaphandle uma kuwukuthi ibhodi likashwele liyamzwela.Isikhulu esiphezulu seRAF, uMnuz Collins Letsoalo, sithe lo mndeni ubuthola abantu abangalimele bese ubanxenxa ukuthi baqambe amanga ngokulimala ezingozini.Siveze ukuthi bebesebenzisa ama-number plate ezimoto ezindala, ezingasahambi emgwaqeni. Bebebuye bantshontshe nama-number plate ezimoto ebezisuke zizimele."Ukukhwabanisa kunomthelela omubi kwiRAF yingakho abasebenzi bethu bezibhekisisa zonke izicelo zokunxeshezelwa esisuke sizitholile. Ukuqapha kwabo yikona okwenze sakwazi ukubona izicelo zokunxeshezelwa ezingekho emthethweni. Siyabonga ukuthi baboshiwe laba abathathu baze bagixabezwa ngezigwebo ezibafanele,” kusho uLetsoalo.Uthe ukukhwabanisa imali yeRAF kufana nokwebela abasuke belimele ezingozini zomgwaqo, abadinga imali.Uveze ukuthi bayaqhubeka nokuthumela amacala emaphoyiseni njengoba uphiko lwabo oluphenya ngezimali lubhekisisa zonke izicelo zokunxeshezelwa.Ngonyaka wezimali ophelile uthe bakwazile ukumisa inkohlakalo kaR2.6 billion obuzolahleka ukube abaqapheli.Ucele abalimale ezingozini zomgwaqo ukuba bashayele iRAF ku-087 820 1 111 ngoMsombuluko kuya kuLwesihlanu.
KUQHAKANJISWA izilimi zendabuko njalo ngoNhlolanja kanti nonyaka ziningi izinhlelo ezenziwa yizinhlaka ezehlukene ukuzithuthukisa. UFebhuwari 21, usetshenziswa ngamazwe ahlukene njengosuku lkuqhakambisa izilimi zendabuko zezinhlanga ezehlukene futhi ugunyazwe yi-Unesco's Decade of Indigenous Langauges.Inhlangano eyegamele ukulondolozwa nokucwaninga ngezilimi zendabuko ezehlukene i-Ancestral Voices (Amazwi oKhokho), ihlela ukwethula izinhlelo zayo emphakathini. Phakathi kwezinhloso eziseqhulwini futhi ezizothuthukiswa yi-Ancestral Voices kubalwa lezi;Ukugqugquzela ukuthi kube yimpoqo ukusetshenziswa kwezichazamazwi zolimi olulodwa noma ezihlanganisa izilimi ezimbili noma ngaphezulu ezikoleni, ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme nasezindaweni zemitapo yolwazi. Bathi lokhu kwaphakanyiswa emqulwini wePhalamende ngo-Okthoba 24, 2017.Okokuqala emlandweni wokulondolozwa kwezilimi, i-Ancestral Voices, izoqikelela ukuthi izinto ezifundwa ngezilimi zendabuko zihambisana nokwakheka kwamagama nokuphinyiswa kwawo ngendlela efanele.I-Ancestral Voices wuhlaka olubhekela izilimi zendabuko ngokuthi iqoqe futhi igcine izincwadi, amabhuku, nolwazi olwalotshwa kudala ingakabibikho impicuzeko ngenhloso yokuvikela intuthuko yazo. Yasungulwa ngokubambisana phakathi kweSouth African Heritage Publishers, uphiko olugcina ulwazi olukhethekile eNyuvesi yasePitoli, iSouth African National Lexicography Units, iSouth African High Commission engaphansi kwe-United Kingdom, neNorthern Ireland.Ngokocwaningo lweMazwi oKhokho, kutholakala ukuthi kunezincwadi ezalotshwa eminyakeni yawo-1920-1960, ngaphambi kokuthi izilimi zase-Afrika, okuyisiSwati nesiNdebele, zilotshwe phansi. Kunababhali ababalelwa ku-186 abazinikele ngokucobelelana ngolwazi, baloba phansi konke abakwaziyo ngezilimi zendabuko, ngenhloso yokwengeza ngolwazi oluthile. Ngokocwaningo olwenziwe ngabaMazwi oKhokho, kutholakale ukuthi kunababhali abazalwa ngo-1852 kanti omncane wazalwa ngo-1918. Kumanje bahlela ukunxenxa uhulumeni ukuthi ahloniphe abantu ababaneqhaza elithile ekubhalweni komlando wezilimi zebele. Kunemiqingo yezilimi eziyisithupha etholakalayo okubalwa nokuhunyushwe ngesingisi nokunye.Uma udinga olunye ulwazi ungabheka kwi-www.saheritagepublishers.co.za/ancestral-voices Facebook: https://bit.ly/3Neqiur; twitter https://bit.ly/3leRBZE
ISILOMO somlingisi, uTerry Pheto, siphinde sanukeka kolunye uphenyo lweSpecial Investigating Unit (SIU) oluthinta ukudliwa kwemali yoxhaso lwakwiNational Lotteries Commission (NLC).I-SUI ithe isiqede u-90% wesigaba sesibili, kwezintathu, sophenyo mayelana nokusetshenziswa kwemali yeNLC.Imiphumela iyishicilele ekhasini layo le-X ethe selulonke uphenyo ngolwemali elinganiselwa kuR1.4 billion umbuso neNLC okuthiwa uyilahlekele ngenxa yenkohlakalo.Isigaba sokuqala ithe sithinta uR279 710 409, esesibili sithinta uR246 659 310 kuthi esesithathu sithinte uR905 901.04.NgoLwesithathu ibivele ngaphambi kwekomiti lePhalamende lapho iveze khona obunye ubufakazi bayo obuthinte uTerry. UTerry uzakhele udumo edlala indawo ephambili efilimini eyawola izindondo iTsotsi.Usolakala ngokuhlomula kungafanele emalini yeNLC."I-NLC yaphasisa uxhaso lukaR5 million enkampanini iZibisix Non-Profit Company ukuze ithole ipulazi lezinkukhu ngo-2018. Ngemuva kokuthola uR5 million, imali yaphuma kwi-akhawunti kwakhokhwa kanje: ifamu yathengwa ngoR850 000 futhi iSIU ithole ukuthi owayengusihlalo webhodi yeNLC, uSolwazi u-Alfred Nechutanda, nguye owasayina isivumelwano sokuthenga ifamu eVaal," kusho iSIU.Ithe ubufakazi buveza ukuthi ifamu yathengelwa ukuzuzisa udadewabo kaTerry uDimakatso Pheto. Njengamanje sekuqalwe uhlelo lokuthi kuvulwe amacala kuphinde kubuyiswe imali.Kulo R5 million, kuvela ukuthi uTerry wathola uR182 000. Izinkampani angumqondisi wazo iTsoseletso kwangena uR253 000 kuthi iSanguti Projects kwafakwa uR2 800 000.UDimakatso wathola uR315 500 kwi-akhawunti yakhe kuthi inkampani angumqondisi wayo iPheto Safe and Cleaning yathola uR124 000.Inkampani yomsiki wengqephu odumile uThula Sindi, iBlack Planet Trading, yafakelwa uR140 000. Enye imali enguR209 500 yathenga izinto zasepulazini.NgoMashi nyakenye, kwadayiswa umuzi kaTerry oseGoli ngoR3.9 million ngemuva kokudliwa njengoba iSIU yathi wakhiwa ngemali eyathathwa eNLC.I-SIU iphinde yethula ubufakazi bokuthi inkampani iSouth African Movement (SAYM) yafaka isicelo semali egameni lePresley Chweneyagae Foundation yomlingisi uPresley Chweneyagae. UPresley wayelingisa noTerry kwiTsotsi futhi ubedlala indawo kaCobra emdlalweni osanda kuphela iThe River.Imali engu0R15 million kuthiwa kakungeyohlelo lobuciko iTake Back the Future Musical, Domentary and Poetry Arts. Kulo R15 million, uR299 967 wafakelwa inkampani i-Iron Bridge Traveling Agency and Events kaRebotile Malomane owangunkosikazi wowayesikhulu seNLC uPhillemon Letwaba.U-R950 190 wafakelwa iVNMM Consulting Engineers CC kaMeshack Makhubela oshade nendodakazi kaNevhutanda. Kuphinde kwakhishwa uR500 000 wathunyelwa abammeli ababhalisa izindlu. UNevhutanda ufakelwe uR100 000 wokuthenga ibhasi, uR60 000 womncwabo nenye imali engu-R290 190.
ZIKHATHAZEKILE izinhlaka ezibhekele iziqu nezitifiketi kuleli ngokwanda kwezikhungo ezingombombayi kanjalo nabantu abakokotela iziqu zabo.Lezi zinhlaka zixwayise nabaqashi ukuthi baqikelele uma beqasha umuntu ukuthi uneziqu ezingu-ngqo.Ezinye zalezi zinhlaka okungu-Umalusi, i-Council on Higher Education (CHE) ne-Quality Council for Trades and Occupations (QCTO), iSouth African Qualification Authority (SAQA) zikhathazekile ngokwanda kwezikhungo ezingabhalisiwe ikakhulu emadolobheni.UDkt Mafu Rakometsi isikhulu esiphezulu so-Umalusi, uthe ukwanda kwalezi zikhungo kwenza ukuthi izitshudeni ezisuke zifuna izikhala zokufunda zigcine sezithutheleka kuzona.Uthe izitshudeni ezisuka ezindaweni ezisemakhaya zifike zizithole sezibhalisa kulezi zikhungo."Lezi zitshudeni zifika emadolobheni ngenhloso yokuthi ziyofunda ezikhungweni ezifana neNyuvesi yaseWits, Nyuvesi yaseJohannesburg (UJ) nezinye. Uma sezingathathwa kulezi zikhungo, zigcina ngokuya ezikhungweni ezingabhalisiwe.” Uthe abazali bathumela imali ngoba bazi ukuthi ingane yabo ifunda ezikhungweni ezibhalisiwe, ekubeni belahla imali yabo ngokukhokhela izikhungo ezingabhalisiwe.Uveze ukuthi bathembele emaphoyiseni ukuthi aqinise umthetho kulezi zikhungo."Thina asikwazi ukuqinisa umthetho, sithembele emaphoyiseni. Abazali kumele bazi ngalezi zikhungo bangalahli imali ngezikhungo ezingabhalisiwe.”UMnuz Vijayen Naidoo, isikhulu esiphezulu kwiQCTO, uthe izinkundla zokuxhumana yizona ezisetshenziswa ukuheha izitshudeni.Uthe abantu bahehwa yizinto abazibona ezinkundleni zokuxhumana.Isikhulu esiphezulu seSAQA, uNksz Nadia Starr, sixwayise labo abakokotela iziqu ukuthi bazoboshwa.Sithe nabaqashi kumele babaqaphele abafuna umsebenzi ngeziqu zomgunyathi."Uhlelo lwethu ukuqinisekisa ukuthi iziqu zibhalisiwe neNational Qualifications Framework nokuthi leso sikhungo sigunyaziwe yini ukwenzisa lezo ziqu. Sibheka nokuthi leso sitshudeni sinazo ngempela lezo ziqu esithi sinazo. Uma sithola ukuthi iziqu zingumgunyathi sibika ezinhlakeni ezifanele kanjalo nakwebezomthetho.” Unxuse umphakathi ukuthi uqaphele ukuthi ungangeni ogibeni lokufunda ezikhungweni ezingabhalisiwe ngokuthi bazibheke ukubhaliswa kwazo nezinhlaka ezifana nezabo.
Kufe amasosha amabili eSouth African National Defence Force (SANDF) ngesikhathi kuqhunyiswa inkambi yawo eDemocratic Republic of Congo ngoLwesithathu emini.I-SANDF ithe amanye amathathu alimele kulesi sigameko. Alimele aphuthunyiswe esibhedlela esiseduze eGoma ukuyolashwa.Amasosha akuleli athunyelwe kuleliya zwe ukuyolekelela uhulumeni wakhona ukudala ukuthula nozinzo.The SA National DefenceForce Media Statement || Thursday, 15 February 2024 || The SA National DefenceForce soldiers deployed in the SADC Mission in the Democratic Republic of the Congo were injured during an indirect fire.#SANDF#JointOperationsDivision#RIPSASoldiers#DRC pic.twitter.com/cIoxX2E5sw— SA National Defence Force (@SANDF_ZA) February 15, 2024 Ungqongqoshe wezokuVikela kuleli, uNkk Thandi Modise, iPhini lakhe uMnuz Thabang Makwetla nobuholi beSANDF badlulise amazwi enduduzo emindenini eshonelwe. Bafisele abalimele ukuthi balulame ngokushesha.Ekuqaleni kwenyanga kuhlaselwe indiza enophephela emhlane yeSANDF khona eDRC ngesikhathi isuka eRwindi ilibangise eGoma.Kwalimala umshayeli wayo owadubuleka emunweni nomunye wosizo lokuqala owalimala esifubeni. Abanye ababephakathi abalimalanga futhi indiza yakwazi ukufika kahle eGoma, ngokusho kweSANDF ngaleso sikhathi.
IPHENDUKE ihlaya i-DA kuMasipala weTheku emuva kokwehluleka komzamo wayo wokuhlakaza umkhandlu ngoba ikhala ngokuthi wehluleke wancama wukuhambisa izidingo kubantu.Bangu-75 abavotele ukuthi kuhlakazwe umkhandlu kwase kuthi abangu-128 bavotela ukuchitha isiphakamiso.I-DA ikhale ngaphansi esiphakamisweni sayo sokuhlakaza umkhandlu emhlanganweni obuse-ICC, eThekwini, izolo. Kuqale kwaqedelwa umhlangano owagcina unqanyuliwe kwase kungenwa odabeni lwe-DA.UMholi wekhokhasi ye-DA eThekwini, uMnuz Thabani Mthethwa, wethule udaba wathi bafuna kuhlakazwe umkhandlu ngoba i-ANC ihluleke yancama."Yisikhathi sokuthi sizibuze ukuthi ngabe abantu baseThekwini bayakuthola yini lokhu okufanele imali yabo? Akusona isikhathi sokuthi siveze ukuzondana kwethu manje kodwa kumele sibambane seseke lesi siphakamiso,’’ kusho uMthethwa.Amakhansela asole i-DA ngokuzama ukubukwa ngesikhathi sokhetho ibe imosha imali yabakhokhi bentela ngokufaka iziphakamiso abathe azithi shu. UMnuz Nkosenhle Madlala we-ANC, uxwayise ngokumoshwa kwesikhathi nemali."Lezi zinto enizenzayo zimosha imali yabakhokhi bentela, nisebenzisa imithetho kabi. Siyanixwayisa ukuthi nathi uma kubuywa sizoyenza le nto, ningakhali,’’ kusho uMadlala.UMnuz Thanduxolo Sabelo we-ANC naye ugxeke i-DA eyisola ngokwenza into engekho."Bazi kahle ukuthi uma ufuna ukuhlakaza umkhandlu udinga iningi emkhandlwini. I-ANC izohlala iqinisekisa ukuthi imali yabakhokhi bentela ayimosheki ngento engekho. Kuningi nje okwenziwe yi-ANC yenzela abantu baseThekwini,’’ kusho uSabelo.Ikhansela le-Action SA, uMnuz Zwakele Mncwango, nakuba livote nayo i-DA kodwa belikhala ngokuthi iyaganga."Siyavuma ukuthi umkhandlu usenkingeni futhi ubuholi abukho kodwa i-DA idlala ipolitiki ebhedayo nje. I-DA yenze le nto ifuna ukubukwa, bafuna ukuvela njengabantu abenza okuthile,’’ kubeka uMncwango.I-EFF nayo ihambe emazwini amanye amakhansela ithi iyasichitha isiphakamiso. Ithe ngeke nje ize ihambisane ne-DA ngoba iyaziwa ukuthi inomlando onjani. I-DA ivamile nokufaka iziphakamiso zokuthi kuketulwe imeya kodwa ikhale ngaphansi.
UNGQONGQOSHE wezokuMbiwa phansi, uMnuz Gwede Mantashe, uthe i-ANC izoqhubeka nokujuba abanamandla ezikhundleni eziphezulu kuhulumeni kanjalo nakwezinye izinhlaka.UMantashe ongusihlalo we-ANC kuzwelonke, uvikele uhlelo lwe-ANC lokujuba ezikhundleni eziphezulu abaqondisi jikelele kuhulumeni, komasipala kanjalo nasezinkampanini zikahulumeni.Uqinisekise ukuthi bazosihlonipha isinqumo senkantolo yoMthethosisekelo, sokuthi banike i-DA umqingo nohlu lwe-ANC lokujuba abantu bafakwe ezikhundleni eziphezulu.I-DA yaya enkantolo ifuna ukuthi i-ANC ikhiphe lolu hlu kusuka ngo-2013. UMantashe ekhuluma ePhalamende eKapa izolo, ngesikhathi kunenkulumo mpikiswano ngenkulumo kamengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ayethule ngeledlule ayeyibhekise esizweni, uthe noma i-DA ingaya ezinkantolo kodwa ngeke bayeke ukujuba abantu abanamava ezikhundleni eziphezulu."Ngaphambi kokuba i-ANC ingene emandleni ngo-1994, bonke abaqondisi jikelele beminyango kwakungabantu abamhlophe kubalwa nezimeya, amajaji nabantu abasezikhundleni eziphezulu. I-ANC yashintsha izinto kanti sisazoqhubeka nokubajuba abantu abanamava ezikhundleni.” Le nkantolo inike i-ANC izinsuku ezinhlanu ukuthi inike i-DA lolu luhlu kanti ngalesi sikhathi uRamaphosa wayengusihlalo wekomiti likaKhongolose, elalibhekele ukujuba abantu ezikhundleni eziphezulu.UMantashe uthe akukho okubi ngohlelo lokujuba abantu ezikhundleni ngoba namanye amaqembu ayakwenza.I-DA yasola i-ANC ngokujuba abantu bayo ezikhundleni eziphezulu ekubeni bengenawo amava okuphatha. Umholi we-DA uMnuz John Steenhuisen ekhuluma ePhalamende izolo, uthe ukuvunwa kwabo yinkantolo kuveza khona ukuthi bazoyihlula i-ANC baphinde batakule nezwe."Silindele i-ANC ukuthi izohlonipha isinqumo senkantolo isinike le miqingo ukuze siveze izimfihlo zokuthi uRamaphosa wayewajuba kanjani amaqabane angenazo izimfanelo. Uma i-ANC ihluleka ukuhambisana nomyalelo, ngeke sinanaze ukubopha abaholi bayo babhadle ejele,” kusho uSteenhuisen. Umholi we-IFP uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa, ukhale ngokuthi izinkumbi zezitshudeni ezixhaswe yiNSFAS zibhuquza emakhaya azisebenzi.Uthe i-ANC ivala ibhange iThala wathi uRamaphosa ubeka phambili inhlangano kunezwe.Ubalule ukuthi sebekulungele ukuthatha izintambo kuhulumeni ngoba i-ANC ihlulekile. URamaphosa uzophendula kusasa ePhalamende.
LUSEFILE ulwandle kwabebephethe izikhundla eziqavile embusweni weSilo uMisuzulu kaZwelithini, kwadedelwa obengumkhulumeli uMntwana u-Afrika wasoNkweni nobenguSihlalo weNgonyama Trust iNkosi Thanduyise kaMpiyezintombi Mzimela.UMntwana u-Afrika uqokelwe esikhundleni ngoJuni 2023 kanti inkosi uMzimela ibiqokwe ngoMeyi wonyaka odlule ingena esikhundleni seJaji Jerome Ngwenya ebeliphethe iNgonyama Trust.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi uMntwana u-Afrika obekhulumela iSilo uthole incwadi imazisa ngokudedelwa kwakhe. Isolezwe liyibonile incwadi ebhalwe yiSilo sibhalela uMntwana u-Afrika simdedela.Udaba lukaMntwana u-Afrika luqale ukusolisa ngesikhathi kunesithangami nabezindaba ebesibizwe wuNdunankulu kaZulu omusha uMfundisi uThulasizwe Buthelezi lapho uMntwana angabonakalanga khona.Kuleso sithangami uButhelezi wamemezela ukuthi ezokuxhumana ehhovisi leSilo seziphethwe wuyena njengoNdunankulu akusekho okuzophumela kwabezindaba ngaphandle kwakhe.ISilo encwadini sithi uMntwana u-Afrika akasenalo ilungelo lokukhuluma egameni laso. Incwadi ikhomba ukuthi ithunyelwe nakuNdunankulu kaZulu uMfundisi uButhelezi. Iphinde yathunyelwa nakuNdunankulu waKwaZulu- Natal uNkk Nomusa Dube-Ncube. ISilo encwadini sikubeka kucace ukuthi uNdunankulu kaZulu uMfundisi uButhelezi wuyena ozophatha ezokuxhumana zeNgonyama.Isolezwe liphinde lathola ngokudedelwa kwenkosi uMzimela kwesikasihlalo weNgonyama Trust. Inkosi uMzimela nayo kuthiwa idedelwe ngosuku olufanayo noMntwana wasOnkweni.UNdunankulu kaZulu, uMfundisi uButhelezi ukuqinisekisile ukudedelwa kwalaba bobabili. Uthe kube yizinqumo zeSilo zombili lezi zokudedela umkhulumeli waso nosihlalo." Ngithole incwadi ingonyama ingazisa ngokudedela uMntwana u-Afrika njengomkhulumeli wayo nendlunkulu. ISilo sinqume ukuthi sizibambele njegoSihalo weNgonyama Trust ukuze kube nozinzo nokuhlonishwa kwezwi lamakhosi ekulawuleni ukusebenza,’’ kusho uMfundisi uButhelezi.UMntwan u-Afrika ebuzwa ngalokhu, uthe uyitholile incwadi kodwa usazobiza isithangami nabezindaba akhulume konke.
