UPHIKE kwasani enkantolo izolo umsolwa wesibili ecaleni likaSenzo Meyiwa, uBongani Ntanzi ephonswa imibuzo.UNtanzi ubesaqhubeka nokuphoswa ngemibuzo wumshushisi woMbuso u-Adv Ronnie Sibanda njengoba kuqhubeka ukubangwa kwezitatimende zabamangalelwa ababili, uMuzikawukhulelwa Sibiya noNtanzi okuthiwa bavuma ngazo icala.Lapha kubhekwa ukuthi kufanele yini zamukelwe njengobufakazi benkantolo njengoba bethi bazisayinda ngaphansi kwengcindezi yokushawa nokuhlukunyezwa ngamaphoyisa.UMMANGALELWA wesibili, uMnuz Bongani Ntanzi Isithombe: SIGCINIWE Izolo uNtanzi uqale waphika eyokusayina wonke amaphepha lapho okuthiwa wayevuma khona icala, ethi lilodwa iphepha alisayina, nalo walisayina emva kokuthi ekhale ngezinto zokugeza nokushayela ucingo umndeni wakhe awazise ukuthi uboshiwe."Awuzange usayine isitatimende phambi kwakhe (imantshi uVivian Cronje) noma ubeke ama-initials akho?” kubuza uSibanda.UNtanzi uphendule ngokuthi: "Mina ngasayina iphepha elilodwa utolika angitshela ukuthi liqondene nokuthi ngikhalaze ngokuthi angikaze ngigeze, ngidinga izinto zokugeza futhi ngidinga ukukhulunyiswa nomndeni wami.”USibanda uphuthumise omunye umbuzo wokuthi kulo mqingo obekwe phambi kukaNtanzi kukhona ama-initials akhe emakhasini ayisishiyagalolunye bese kuthi kwelokugcina kube khona i-signature yakhe.UNtanzi uphinde waphika eyokwazana no-Advo Ntokozo Mjiyakho ngesikhathi uSibanda eveza ukuthi wabuzwa ukuthi unaye yini ummeli, noma ufuna owoMbuso ngaphambi kokuthi enze isitatimende kuCronje, waphendula ngelithi 'uMnuz Mjiyakho wummeli wami’.Ephendula kulokhu uNtanzi uthe: "Ngiyakuphikisa lokhu. UMnuz Mjiyakho akakaze abe wummeli wami futhi angikaze ngiyisho leyo nto.”USibanda usole uNtanzi ethi kwakufanele akuveze ngaleso sikhathi lokhu asho nokuthi udinga ummeli."Wuye (uMjiyakho) owatshela mina ukuthi uthunywe wumndeni wami, ngabe sengimbuza ukuthi uthunywe wubani emndenini wami ngoba kubona akekho owaziyo ukuthi ngiboshiwe. Ngamyalela ukuthi angikhombise nezinombolo zomndeni wami (axhumane ngazo), waphendula ngokuthi 'sobuye sikukhulume lokho’ maqede wangena (ehhovisi likaCronje) wahlala phansi,” kuchaza uNtanzi."Wawumbona okokuqala,” kubuza uSibanda, uNtanzi. Uphendule ngelithi kunjalo.UMeyiwa wadutshulwa ekubo kanina wengane yakhe ongumculi, uKelly Khumalo ngo-Okthoba 2014.Icala liyaqhubeka namuhla.
SEKUHLATSHWE ikhwelo kubazali ukuthi babe sezigungwini ezilawula izikole, ukuze babe nezwi ezintweni ezithinta ukunyuswa kwemali yokufunda nezinye.Ikhwelo lishaywe nguNgqongqoshe weMfundo eyisiSekelo, uNkk Angie Motshekga, ethula umkhankaso wokuvotelwa kwemikhandlu elawula izikole.UNkk Motshekga uthe abazali abangahambeli kude nezikole, ukuze zibe ngcono futhi zenze kahle."Ngike ngihlangane nabazali bangikhalele ukuthi esikoleni sezingane zabo kunyuswe imali yesikole. Ngiyabatshela ukuthi lezi zinto zinqunywa yisigungu sabazali. Abanye kabayona ngisho ingxenye yalezi zigungu, okuyilapho kuxoxwa khona izinto ezithinta isikole.”Uthe uma uyingxenye yesigungu sesikole uba nolwazi ngezinto ezenzeka esikoleni."Uba nolwazi lokuthi imali izonyuka kangakanani ngonyaka olandelayo. Ngaleyo ndlela ngeke uze ukhale ngokunyuswa kwemali ngoba uzobe uyingxenye yalolu hlelo.” Uveze ukuthi ukuvotelwa kwezigungu ezintsha zezikole kuqala ngoMashi 1 kuya kuMashi 31, 2024."Ngokomthetho izigungu zabazali zikhethwa eminyakeni emithathu. Njengoba sithula lo mkhankaso, sifuna wonke umuntu abe yingxenye yalolu hlelo.” Uthe ukuba yingxenye yezigungu kukhomba ukuthi ukhathalele imfundo yengane."Siyazi ngalesi sikhathi salolu khetho kuzoba namaholidi, kuphinde kuvalwe nezikole. Yingakho sifuna ukuthi izikole zisheshe zilwenze lolu hlelo ngoba wuthola ukuthi ngomhlangano wokuqala ababi baningi abafikayo, kuze kudingeke ukuthi kuhlehle. Ngehlandla lesibili mhlawumbe kuba ngcono ngoba baba baningi abazali bese kuhlala umhlangano.” Uthe abanye abazali bayadembesela, bangayi emihlanganweni bese bebuya bezokhala ngokuthi bashiywe ngaphandle.Uveze nokuthi uma isikole sinesigungu sabazali esisebenzayo, zincane izehlakalo zokucekelwa phansi kwesikole, noma ukugqekezwa kwaso."Ezikoleni eziningi ezenza kahle, abazali baba yingxenye yazo uma uqhathanisa nezingenzi kahle. Abazali balahlekelwa yithemba uma isikole senza kabi. Izikole zidinga ukwesekwa ngabazali ukuze zenze kahle.” Uxwayise ngabazali abafuna ukuba sezigungwini zezikole ezehlukene ngoba bejahe imali.UMnuz James Ndlebe oyisikhulu emnyangweni, uthe uma kuphela uMashi singakhethiwe isigungu esisha, leso sikole ngeke sibe nesigungu sabazali.Uxwayise abafuna ukungena ezigungwini, ekubeni bengenazo izingane wathi uma bebathola bayabasusa ohlwini.
UFUNA ubulungiswa umndeni wowesilisa waseLamontville, eThekwini, okuthiwa ushaywe waze wafa ngumngani wakhe, emsola ngokuba nolwazi ngeselula yakhe ebiyebiwe.USivuyile Rofu (20), ongowokudabuka eNtabankulu, e-Eastern Cape, kuthiwa ubulawe ngowesilisa ebebemvakashele ngeSonto eledlule.Ngokusho kukadadewabo, uNksz Oneli Ndamase, ngosuku lwesigameko umufi ulandwe abangani bakhe ababili ukuba kuyohlanganyelwa nabanye abangani komunye umuzi osendaweni.Kulo muzi kuthiwa kwakuphuzwa, kudliwa, kujatshulwe.UNksz Ndamase uthe ngaphandle kukamufi nabangani bakhe ababili, kwakukhona nabanye abesilisa, kuhlangenwe ngobungani. "Ngesikhathi beselapho kujatshulwa, kube khona oyedwa oweba iselula kamngani wabo ongumnikazi wendlu,” kusho uNksz Ndamase.Uthe bathole ukuthi lona owebe iselula uyebe washaya wachitha."Uma sizwa, umfowethu wone ngokuthi athi uyamazi umsolwa. Kuthiwa umnikazi weselula wavele wadumela yena wamshaya, ethi kuyacaca ukuthi bayazana ngaleso sizathu, uzomkhipha,” kusho uNksz Ndamase.Uveze ukuthi umsolwa (umnikazi weselula) ubegijima phezu kwakhe ngezinyawo, emgxoba kakhulu ekhanda nasebusweni.Ubuye wathi bezwa kuthiwa ubemphihliza nangamabhodlela otshwala, afele kuye emzimbeni.Uthi kuzanyiwe ukuthi aphuthunyiswe esibhedlela kodwa wafike washonela khona.Uthe abaneme neze ngesenzo salona wesilisa obulale ilungu lomndeni wabo lingenze lutho."Sifuna ubulungiswa ngokubulawa kwakhe. Umenzi wobubi akaboshiwe namanje kodwa thina sibulawelwe umfowethu,” kusho uNksz Ndamase.Uveze ukuthi lona wesilisa, okunguye okuthiwa weba iselula, akakaze aphinde abonakale endaweni.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa aseLamontville aphenya icala lokubulala kulandela isigameko sokubulawa kowesilisa oneminyaka engu-20." Kubikwa ukuthi umgilwa wayesesitolo sendawo ngesikhathi ehlaselwa abesilisa ababili, bemsola ngokweba iselula. Umgilwa walimala kakhulu emzimbeni,” kuchaza uNetshiunda.
KUXWAYISWE abafundi ngobungozi bobubhoklolo osebuqonga ezikoleni, nokunomthelela wokuthi abanye babo bagcine ngokuzibulala.Lokhu kuvele emcimbini obekuklonyeliswa kuwo abafundi abaphase ngamalengiso kuGrade 12 wango-2023 obuhlelwe wuMasipala waseMfolosi.Imeya yaseMfolosi, uMnuz Xolani Bhengu obeliqwashiswa abafundi ngokuhlukumezana ezikoleni, uthe umasipala uzowulekelela umnyango wezemfundo ekulweni nalesi sihlava esiholela ekutheni abanye abafundi bagcine bebalekela isikole."Sizoqala imikhankaso ezolekelela ekutheni silishumayeze ivangeli elizosilekelela ekugcizeleleni ukuvikela izingane zamantombazane ezihlukumezekayo. Asifisi ukuthi kube nomfundi ozithola eseshiya isikole ngoba ezizwa engavumelekile. Sizoqinisekisa ukuthi siyalekelela ezinkingeni ezifana nalezi emnyangweni wezemfundo,” kusho uBhengu.Uthe yize kuzwela kakhulu ngasohlangothini lwabafundi bamantombazane, koda umasipala uzongenelela nasekulekeleleni abafana.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi nyakenye, umfundi wase Mpephose High eMakhwezini wathinta abaningi ngesikhathi ephumela obala ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ekhala ngomfana ayethi uyamhlulumeza."Siyazi ukuthi othisha umsebenzi wabo ukufundisa kodwa uma kunesimo esingahambi kahle kusemqoka ukuthi baxhumane nesigungu sesikole ukuze sikwazi ukuthinta abezemthetho,” kuqhuba imeya uBhengu.USihlalo we-IFP Youth Brigade, KwaZulu-Natal, uMncedisi Maphisa uthe, ukuba ingxenye yomcimbi ukufezekisa iphupho lomsebenzi kaMntwana wakwaPhindangene obeyigqugquzela kakhulu imfundo."Izimeya ze-IFP ezikwazi ukulekelela izingane zesikole ngezinsiza, nathi siyi IFP Youth Brigade siyakukhuthaza ukuthi bagxile kwezemfundo ngoba isona sikhiye sempilo,” kusho uMaphisa.Kulo mcimbi kuvele ukuthi umfundi uSibusisiwe Msani, (18) waseWelabasha High School, uthole oDistinction abayisishikhombisa. Uthe ukusebenza ngokuzikhandla yikho okumlekelele ekutheni athole imiphumela emihle ngalolu hlobo.
KUGQUGQUZELWE abaqashi ukuthi baphawule ngemithetho emisha yezokulingana emsebenzini, i-Employment Equity.Uhulumeni uvule ithuba lokuthi zonke izinhlaka ezithintekayo ziphawule ngalo mthetho njengoba kunezigaba ezicaciswe kabanzi.Muva nje inkampani yabameli iCliffe Dekker Hofmeyr (CDH), ibe nesithangami sokucobelelana ngolwazi ngemithetho emisha ethinta ukulingana.UNksz Phetheni Nkuna ongummeli wezabaSebenzi, eCDH, uthe imithetho emisha ayisho ukuthi ukulingana emsebenzini kufanele kubheke ibala lomuntu kodwa ifuna wonke umuntu anikwe amathuba afanayo."Imithetho yezokulingana akufanele ibhekwe njengento egqugquzela ukucwaswa kwabathile ngenxa yebala labo. Empeleni ifuna kuqashwe abantu abanamakhono afanele.Lokhu kungenzeka ngokuthi banikwe ithuba elifanayo lokuncintisana nabanye ozakwabo. Kubalulekile ukuthi abaqashi babeke imibono yabo,” kusho uNksz Nkuna.UMnuz Imraan Mahomed naye owummeli ogxile kwezomthetho ethinta ezokuqasha, uthe uNgqongqoshe wezabaSebenzi, uMnuz Thulas Nxesi, akashongo ukuthi kunabantu okufanele baxoshwe njengoba ehlongoza ukuchibiyela imithetho yezokulingana emsebenzini."Okushiwo kule mithetho ehlongozwayo wukuthi abantu abathole amathuba afanayo. Kufanele abaqashi baqaphele indlela abakhangisa ngayo imisebenzi ngoba uma ukhangisa ngaphakathi kungenzeka uthole abantu abawubulili obufanayo nebala elifanayo. Kubalulekile ukucacisa uma abaqashi sebephawula ukuthi emkhakheni othile kunalezi zingqinamba nokuyikona okwenza kuqashwe abantu ababodwa,” kuchaza u-Mahomed.Uthe kubalulekile nokuthi abaqashi babheke imithetho yezokulingana ethinta umkhakha wabo nesifundazwe abasebenzela kusona.Ubalule ukuthi inkampani esebenza kuzwelonke izogxila kakhulu emithethweni yokulingana kazwelonke bese kuthi leyo ezinze esifundazweni esithile igxile emithethweni yokulingana ehambisana naleso sifundazwe.Ukhumbuze abaqashi ukuthi bangakhohlwa wukuqasha abantu abakhubazekile, abesifazane, intsha, abathandana nabobulili obufanayo njalo njalo.Uveze ukuthi muva nje kunabantu abangathandi ukusho ubulili babo nokuthi bayisiphi isizwe, isibonelo abathandi ukuthi bamnyama noma bamhlophe.Konke lokhu uthe kufanele abaqashi bakucacise uma bephawula ngoba uma le mithetho isiphasile, abahloli boMnyango wezabaSebenzi bazozihlawulisa izinkampani ezingayilandeli.Abaqashi banezinsuku eziwu-90 zokuphawula ngalo mthetho wokulingana ngakho kufanele balisebenzise leli thuba.Ubalule ukuthi uma imithetho isisebenza kufanele izinkampani zisho ukuthi zenza miphi imizamo ukuletha uguquko ukuze kube nazo zonke izinhlanga ezikhundleni eziphezulu.
ITHI ingaba nkulu ingabe isazekeka, lokhu ukuphawula kwabantu ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ecaleni eliphenywa wuphiko lweSIU okuvela kulonaigama likaThula Sindi ongumsiki wengqephu odumile kuleli.Uphenyo lweSIU luveza ukuthi iNational Lottery Commission (NLC) yaxhasa iZibisibix Non-Profit Company ngo-R5 million, ukuze kutholakale ipulazi lezinkukhu ngoDisemba 2018.Ithe ingena le mali yabe icazwa ngezindlela ezehlukene, njengoba kubaluliwe kulesi sithombe.Lesi sithombe sisuse umsindo njengoba kuvela ukuthi imali yasuswa kwi-akhawunti yenhlangano eyathola uxhaso yangena kuma-akhawunti amathathu omlingisi uMoitheri Terry Pheto, okukhona kuwo ne-akhawunti yakhe yangasese, kwabuye kwakhokhelwa uDimakatso Pheto ongudadewabo kaTerry, okhokhelwe kabili. Okudide abaningi ukuvela kwegama likaThula Sindi, owakhokhelwa uR140 000 kuyo yonke le mali.Kuvela nokuthi lathengwa ipulazi lezinkukhu ngoR850 000, lithengwa owayengusihlalo webhodi leNLC uProf. Alfred Nevhutanda, ngokuvela kwegama lakhe encwadini yokuthenga ipulazi eliseVaal. Kuthiwa ipulazi lathengwa ngegama likaDimakatso Pheto.
KUPHAZAMISEKE ukufunda nokufundisa esikoleni iPhakathi Secondary eMariannhill, ngasePinetown othisha bebeka phansi oshoki, benengwa yisimo sokusebenza esingagculisi.Ngokuthola kweSolezwe, ziningi izingqinamba ezikhungethe isikole sabo, ezinye zazo sekuphele iminyaka zikhona.Ukhuluma neSolezwe umthombo ozazi ukusuka nokuhlala izinkinga zalesi sikole, uthe othisha bakhathele wukufundisa ngaphandle kwezinsiza-kusebenza ezanele.Uthe phakathi kwazo yimishini yokugaya amaphepha, osekuphele iminyaka becela ukuthengelwa yona."Amaphepha baze baphoqeleke ukuyowagaya ezikoleni ezingomakhelwane, behamba ngophethroli wabo,” kusho umthombo.Uqhuba uthe kwakunyakenye lapho uthishanhloko athembisa khona ukuthi uzowuthenga umshini kodwa namanje awubonwa.Usole uthishanhloko ngokuhlukumeza othisha, wathi akakhulumi kahle nabo njengoba ebashawoda phambi kwawo wonke umuntu.Uphinde waveza ukuthi wonke amathoyilethi akulesi sikole asesimeni esinyantisa umzimba."Abhlokhile. Abawahlanzayo baze basebenzise amabhakede nezinkomishi ukuphungula ukungcola, bakulahle ngaphandle ukuze akwazi ukuqhubeka asebenziseke,” kusho umthombo.Omunye umthombo uveze ukuthi kuphinde kube nenkinga yokugcwala ngokweqile kwabafundi emakilasini."Ikilasi ngalinye esikhundleni sokuba nabafundi abangu-35, linabafundi abangu-90. Lokhu kwenza othisha bangakwazi ukufundisa kahle,” kusho umthombo, owengeze ngokuthi lokhu kuholele nasekutheni kwehle imiphumela ka-matric nyakenye.Ukhale nangenyufomu yabafundi eshintshwe ngaphandle kokuxoxa nabazali nobuholi besikole."Abazali bayibambe ezinkundleni zokuxhumana sekuzovulwa izikole eyokuthi inyufomu yesikole ishintshile. Ngaleso sizathu kugqokwa inyufomu embili esikoleni, kukhona abagqoka endala, kube khona abagqoka entsha,” kusho umthombo.Ubuye wakhala nango-R200 okhokhwa ngabazali ingane ngayinye, ekubeni isikole singena ngaphansi kohlu lwezikole ezingayikhokhisi imali yesikole.Kuthintwa usihlalo wesigungu sesikole, uNkk Lindiwe Madlala, uvumile ukuthi ubikelwe ngokubeka phansi kothisha oshoki.Uvumile nokuthi isikole sihaqwe yizinkinga.Ekha phezulu, uthe kuyiqiniso ukuthi othisha baze baphume baye ezikoleni ezingomakhelwane, beyofuna izinsiza-kusebenza.Uphawule nangokushintshwa kwenyufomu, wathi kwakungavunyelwene nabazali."Indaba yenyufomu, yavela kancane emhlanganweni wangoNovemba lapho uthishanhloko waveza ukuthi izoshintshwa maqede kwavungama bonke abazali. Bakhombisa ukungahambisani nalokho. Udaba lwayo lwalungekho ngisho ohlwini lwezinto ezazibizelwe umhlangano,” kusho yena.Uthe bebelindele ukuthi luphinde ludingidwe kahle komunye umhlangano lapho bebezozwakalisa ukuthi akufanele ishintshwe ngoba akukapheli neminyaka eyishumi ishintshiwe.Uthe ubezokuphikisa ukushintshwa kwayo ngoba akunasidingo, ikakhulu njengoba isikole sisemphakathini wabazali abahlwempu.Ethintwa uthishanhloko uMnuz Gcaba, walile ukuphawula, ethi uqashwe wumnyango, wathi iwona okufanele uphawule ngoba akaziphethe.Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal uMnuz Muzi Mahlambi, uthunyelelwe umyalezo, wangawuphendula, ethintwa nasocingweni, akaluphendulanga.
NJENGOBA namuhla kuwusuku lwezithandani abaningi bazokhithiza izimbali bazihlobise ngemali yamaphepha, ushokoledi nokunye ukujabulisa izithandwa zabo.UNkk Pearl Cele, obhekelele ezokufundiswa kwabathengi eFNB, uthe ukugubha usuku lwezithandani akusho ukuthi kufanele usale ungenamali."Kuhle ukujabulisa othandiweyo wakho kodwa akusho ukuthi khithiza ngokweqile usale ungasenamali. Kufanele uthenge isipho obusihlelele, hhayi nje ukuthi uthathe noma yini ephambi kwakho. Uyakwazi ukulujabulela lolu suku ngaphandle kokusebenzisa yonke imali yakho,” kusho uNkk Cele.Uthe iValentine’s Day iyahlelelwa ngoba wusuku oluba khona minyaka yonke. Asikho isidingo sokuthi uthenge izipho ngoba ufuna ukubukwa.Ugqugquzele abanamakhadi amaphoyinti ezitolo namavawusha ukuba basebenzise wona kunokuthi bakwelete izipho. Wathi akufanele zithengwe nge-credit card noma ngolunye uhlobo lwezikweletu.Uthe abantu bangaziphekela izithandwa zabo kunokuthi bazikhiphele ezitolo zokudla lapho bezosebenzisa khona imali.Ubalule ukuthi ukupheka ekhaya konga imali futhi kungamjabulisa othandiweyo wakho kunokuya esitolo sokudlela.Uthe abathandanayo kufanele benze ama-picnic ngoba wona bayakwazi ukuwahlelela kahle, bapakishe ukudla."Uma ungumuntu okhonze iValentines Day, kufanele uzihlele kahle ukuze ungazitholi ususebenzisa imali obungahlelanga ukuyisebenzisa. Uthando akufanele lukushiye nezikweletu kodwa kumele lukushiye nenjabulo,” kusho uNkk Cele.
OWAYENGUMENGAMELI we-ANC nezwe, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, uthe azilime ziye etsheni, ngeke atshelwe wubuholi be-ANC futhi akesabi muntu uhlabela phambili noMkhonto weSizwe ngoba ulungisa izwe. UZuma usho lokhu kade evakashele isikole iKhuthala Primary, eMlaza, wase edlulela erenki eZindongeni.UZuma kulezi zinsuku uphansi phezulu ukhankasela uMkhonto weSizwe, okuyiqembu elethulwe ngoDisemba wonyaka odlule, kanti wamemezela ukuthi uyaleseka. I-ANC imthumelele ngencwadi yokummisa enhlanganweni yathi kufanele aphendule kuyona.Erenki eMlaza, uZuma ubelindwe yinqwaba yabantu beMK namalungu omphakathi, bekuphume nesinedolo amakhosikazi namadoda behleli bethe shaye elangeni ebelishisa. Bemukele uZuma ngomkikizo, amakhwela nezingoma zomzabalazo, intsha iviliyela sakushaya itoyitoyi.Ingoma ebisho phezulu ithi Wubani owabopha uMshozoli simthanda?Babodwa abebememeza uZuma bethi: "Baba wethu! Baba wesizwe, awubuyele kuwe umshini manje!’’ Babodwa abebemthopha bethi: "Nxamalala! Msholozi!"UZuma uthe ngeke alalele lutho olushiwo wubuholi be-ANC ngaphansi kukaMenagmeli Cyril Ramaphosa ngoba wayengekho ngisho emzabalazweni.Uthe uRamaphosa wathenga isikhundla ngakho akafanelwe wukubizwa ngomengameli."Ngaboshwa isikhathi eside mina ngilwela inkululeko, abanye abantu bafa. Ngeke ngitshelwe yibona. Ngisazoqhubeka ngilwe, bona bayangithuka ngiyazithulela nje ngoba angihlanyi ekhanda. Angesabi muntu mina, ngiyohlala ngilikhuluma iqiniso,’’ kusho uZuma enanelwa yinhlokomo.UZuma uthe isinyathelo sokweseka uMkhonto weSizwe, usithathe ngoba i-ANC akuseyona le ayaziyo. Kunalokho bese befuna ukuqasha enye inkampani ukuthi ibheke udaba lokuholelwa kwabasebenzi. Kuyacaca ukuthi banayo imali ngoba sebekuzoba yinkampani yesithathu lena abafuna ukuthi yenze into eyodwa. Abasebenzi banqume ukuthi bangene esitelekeni ukuze kuzolalelwa kahle izikhalo zabo,” kusho uDube.Uthe bazimisele ukuxoxa nomqashi noma kunini uma nje ezobeka into engcono etafuleni.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi ngokombiko wezinkampani ezimbili ezazibheka udaba lwamaholo, umsebenzi ohola kancane owenza umsebenzi wokuhlanza, kwakufanele ahole u-R9 500 kodwa kuthiwa uhola u-R3 500.UDube uthe izincomo zemibiko yamaholo zenziwe kubasebenzi abayizimenenja kodwa azenziwa emazingeni aphansi okuyinto ecika abasebenzi.Esitatimendeni esithunyelwe kwabezindaba, uMasipala weTheku uthe abaphathi beShaka Marine World, bebelokhu bexoxa nenyunyana ngodaba lwamaholo kodwa akuzange kufinyelelwe esivumelwaneni.Uthe lokhu yikona okuholele ekutheni inyunyana iqale izinhlelo zesiteleka.Uveze ukuthi kusukela namhlanje kuzobe kuvaliwe kuze kuphele isiteleka.
KUSALE enkundleni nomculi kamaskandi ngesikhathi kuqothwa abane ngenhlamvu, amaphoyisa abebasola ngokuba yizinkabi ebezifunwa ngoxhaxha lwamacala okubulala.Lesi sigameko senzeke endaweni yokuphumula izivakashi, eBabanango entathakusa ngoMgqibelo.USjula Biyela obedume ngeQhawe LakoMenziwa emculweni kamaskandi, kuthiwa uthelwe othulini ngamaphoyisa ethimba i-Stabilization Operations KwaZulu-Natal, okuvele ukuthi abangenele lapho bebebhace khona belele kuyo le ndawo yokuphumula, bashonela lapho nabanye okungoMnuz Thokozani Bizokwakhe Sithole (52), Thubelihle Ncanana (37) noLangelihle Biyela.Ngokwesitatimende esikhishwe amaphoyisa, abasolwa bavulele kuqala ngenhlamvu bebhekise kuwo, abe esephendula ngezulu lezandla.Osondelene kakhulu nomunye wababulewe ocele ukungadalulwa, uthe akulona iqiniso ukuthi bebeyizinkabi kodwa bebengosomatekisi kanti usola ukuthi ukubulawa kwabo kuhlobene nombango wamarenki oLundi."Angikwazi abakushoyo ukuthi bebefunwa ngokubulala abantu. Engikwaziyo ukuthi kube nokungaboni ngasolinye kosomatekisi abasebenzisa irenki enkulu ngaphansi koLundi Taxi Association. Baziphumele inxiwa basungula irenki entsha ehambela amabanga amafishane i-Ezihlabeni Taxi Association, okuthe ngokwenza njalo omunye wabanikazi bamatekisi okhankasela isikhundla kusoseshini, wathi uma bengabeka yena angayilungisa le nto aqede ngale renki babuyele ngaphakathi, esho kuwuLwesithathu. Kuthe-ke ngoMgqibelo bahlaselwa amaphoyisa bezilalele kule ndawo yokuphumula, babulawa okukhombisayo ukuthi kunamaphoyisa asetshenziswa njengezinkabi,” kubalisa yena.Uthe uma bebefunwa ngamacala pho kungani amaphoyisa engababophanga kunokuthi ababulale eveza akuthi akulona iqiniso ukuthi bebedubula bebhekise kuwo.Uveze nezinsolo zokuthi omunye wabo abafi, amaphoyisa amfumbathise isibhamu ngesikhathi eqeda kudubula.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa alandele umkhondo ngabasolwa abebebhace kule ndawo yokuphumula izivakashi."Ngesikhathi amaphoyisa ememezela ukuthi asefikile, abasolwa badubule babhekisa kuwona bengaphakathi emagunjini abo, emizameni yokuzivikela, abuyisela. Emva kokudubulana phakathi kwabo namaphoyisa, laba abasolwa ngokuba yizinkabi batholwe benamanxeba okudutshulwa, kanti bafele endaweni yesigameko,” kusho uNetshiunda.Uthe alikho iphoyisa elilimale ngesikhathi kudutshulwana, wathi kuphinde kwavulwa namacala okuzama ukubulala amaphoyisa.

"IZOBA yingozi into yokwenyuswa nokwandiswa kwezibonelelo zikahulumeni, uma kuwukuthi kuthenjelwe ezinhlakeni ezingekho ngaphakathi kuleli, ukuxhasa lezi zinhlelo”Lokhu kushiwo umhlaziyi wezepolitiki ozimele uMnuz Thobani Zikalala, engxoxweni yakhe neSolezwe emva kokuthi umholi we-Economic Freedom Fighters uMnuz Julius Malema, ethule umqulu wezithembiso zokhetho enkundleni yezemidlalo iMoses Mabhida, ngoMgqibelo.Phakathi kwezinto ezibalulwe uMalema athe leli qembu lizozenza uma lidla umhlanganiso okhethweni lukazwelonke nezifundazwe okulindeleke lube kulo nyaka, ukwenyusa ngokuphindwe kabili zonke izibonelelo zikahulumeni ezinikezwa abantu okubalwa kuzo ezezaguga, izibonelelo zezingane, ezomakadebona bezempi nezinye. Uphinde wathembisa ukwethula isibonelelo esibhekele abafunde bagogoda kodwa abangawutholi umsebenzi aveze ukuthi umuntu oneziqu ze-diploma, i-degree ne-masters ongakawutholi umsebenzi, beyi-EFF bazokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi uthola isibonelelo esiphakathi kuka- R1 000 no-R4 000, kuye ngokuthi umuntu unaziphi iziqu. UZikalala uthe nakuba i-EFF ikhulume into abantu abathanda ukuyizwa, kodwa inselelo enkulu ngodaba oluthinta izibonelelo ukuba nendlela ecacile yakhona ngaphakathi kuleli ezoxhasa uhlelo lwezibonelelo kungaze kuyobolekwa kwamanye amazwe ngoba leyo mali isuke ihambisana nemigomo ethile engaba nomphumela ongemuhle."Inselelo enkulu esinayo ukuthi umnotho wakuleli indlela ohlelwe ngayo, izwe alinalo iqhaza elikhulu elilibambayo ekulawuleni okukhiqizwa kulo, okwenza lingabi nayo imali eningi yokunakekela izakhamuzi. Izwe ligcina seliyoboleka ezikhungweni ezifana ne-International Monetary Fund egcina isiqhamuka nemibandela ethile okwenza izwe ligcine lingakwazi ukuziphathela umnotho walo,” usho kanje.Uthe uhulumeni unenselelo yokuqasha abantu abenele ukwenza imisebenzi kahulumeni, bese uhlelo lwamathenda lusetshenziswa lapha nalaphaya.I-EFF ithe izokwenza kube semahlombe ayo ukubuyiswa komhlaba ngaphandle kwesinxephezelo, iveze ukuthi esikhathini esiyiminyaka emihlanu, izobe isibuyesele okungenani umhlaba ongu- 50%. KUKHALWA ngomkhuba wokwanda kwamaphutha enzeka uma kugaywa amaphepha ka-matric kanjalo nabafundi abasaqhubeka nomkhuba wokukopela sekubhalwa.Lesi sikhalo sikhishwe wumkhandlu oqinisekisa izingabunjalo lika-matric, Umalusi, ngesikhathi izikhulu zomkhandlu zivela phambi kwekomiti lezemfundo ePhalamende.UDkt Mafu Rakometsi isikhulu esiphezulu somkhandlu, uzwakalise ukukhathazeka ngamaphutha enzeka uma kugaywa, kupakishwa amaphepha kanjalo nabafundi abakopelayo.Uthe lezi ngezinye zezinto abayalele umnyango ukuthi uzilungise."Iyasikhathaza eyamaphutha agcwele emaphepheni ka-matric, aphazamisa abafundi. Kuyakhathaza futhi ukuthi minyaka yonke iyanda le nkinga yokukopela kwabafundi ababhala u-matric,” kusho uRakometsi.Uthe imiphumela yabasolwa ngokukopela ibanjiwe, kuze kuphothulwe uphenyo olwenziwa wumnyango."Okukhathaza kakhulu ngukuthi uthola ukuthi nothisha yibona abaseqhulwini lokukopelisa abafundi. Bangu-955 abafundi ababanjwe ukuthi bakopelile nyakenye. Lesi sibalo sehlile sisuka ku-1900 ngo-2022,” kusho uRakometsi.Uveze ukuthi banike umnyango kuze kube wuMashi 15, 2024 ukuthi ulethe uhlelo lokulungisa izikhalazo zabo.UMqondisi-jikelele emnyangweni, uMnuz Mathanzima Mweli, uveze ukuthi sehlile isibalo sabafundi ababanjwa bekopela.Uthe iyabakhathaza eyokukopela kwabafundi. Uthe benza uphenyo.UDkt Rufus Poliah obhekele izivivinyo emnyangweni, uthe benza isibonelo ngababanjwe bekopela noma ababanjwe besiza abafundi ngesikhathi kubhalwa.Uthe omunye wothisha baseMpumalanga, owasiza abafundi bekopela kubhalwa izivivinyo zika-matric, ukhonjwe indlela."Lo thisha waqondiswa ubugwegwe wase exoshwa. Asibabekezeleli labo esibabambe begila lo mkhuba. Liyehla izinga labafundi ababanjwe bekopela u-matric.”Uthe bazolwethulela Umalusi uhlelo lwabo lokuphucula izinto umkhandlu okhale ngazo ngesikhathi kubhalwa. USihlalo wekomiti lezemfundo ePhalamende uNkk Bongiwe Mbinqo-Gigaba, uncome umnyango ngokuthi kunozinzo kwezemfundo.Uthe ukunyuka kwezinga lokuphasa lifihyelele ku-82.9% yinto encomeka kakhulu."Kuyancomeka ukunyuka kwezinga lokuphasa kuleli. Sijabula kakhulu ngokuthi izifundazwe ezisemakhaya, okubalwa iKwaZulu-Natal neLimpopo zenze kahle.”

Ucabanga ukuthi abantu bakuleli bayizilima.”I-EFF idube inkulumo kaMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, emuva kokuchithwa yinkantolo njengoba ibizama ukuthi izinkantolo zishintshe isinqumo sokumiswa kwabaholi bayo ePhalamende.Izolo iNkantolo yaseWestern Cape, inqume ukungasishintshi isinqumo sePhalamende sokumiswa kwamalungu e-EFF ePhalamende inyanga eyodwa nokubanjelwa umholo wenyanga eyodwa. Ngenxa yalesi sizathu wonke amalungu e-EFF ePhalamende, ngeke abe yingxenye yenkulumo yesizwe. Kuyacaca ukuthi iyikhokhasi ye-ANC,” kusho i-EFF esitatimendeni.Ithe uma amalungu ayo eya ePhalamende kuzobe kusho ukuthi ayahambisana nalesi sinqumo esingeyona intando yabantu, esiphambene noMthethosisekelo futhi esivimbela amalungu akhethwe ngabantu ukuba ayobamela ePhalamende. Ngeke siye kwikhokhasi ye-ANC esePhalamende ngoba phela le nkulumo isiphenduke ikhokhasi ye-ANC,” kuqhuba i-EFF.Leli qembu lithe lizogxila entweni ebalulekile njengokulungiselela irali esenkundleni yemidlalo iMoses Mabhida eThekwini kusasa.Kubantu abebekhona owayengumengameli we-ANC nezwe uMnuz Jacob Zuma ubengabonwa nangalukhalo, kukhona uMnuz Thabo Mbeki.U-DJ Black Coffee ubekhona ezihlelweni efake into yokusiza intamo njengoba alimala engozini.

IKHOMISHANA ebhekelele abathengi, iNational Consumer Commussion (NCC), idonse ngendlebe bonke abathenge ipeanut butter yaseDischem ukuba bayibuyisele emuva.Ipeanut butter ebuyiselwa emuva yileyo yaseDischem ebizwa ngeLifestyle ewu-400g e-smooth ne-crunchy naleyo ewu-800g.Kufanele kubuyiselwe emuva naleyo ebizwa nge-Wazoogles Superfoods kusukela kwewu-32g kuya kwewu-20kg.Isaqhubeka nokubuyiselwa emuva ipeanut butter yakwaPick n Pay Isithombe:NCCIsaqhubeka nokubuyiselwa emuva ne-peanut butter yasePick n Pay ewu-No Name ewu-1kg.Ipeanut butter yakwa-Wazoogles nayo kuthiwe ayibuyiselwe ezitolo Isithombe:NCCKufanele abantu babuyisele emuva ne-Eden All Natural. I-Aflatoxin yigciwane elikhiqizwa yizinhlobo ezithile zokudla, kulokhu kutholakale ukuthi liphezulu ngakho kufanele ibuyele emuva le mikhiqizo."Sesiqale uphenyo lweHouse of Natural Butters ekhiqiza le peanut butter. Sizosiqapha ngeso lokhozi isimo, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi le mikhiqizo ayikho emashalofini ezitolo. Sicela abakhiqiza ipeanut butter nokunye ukudla ukuthi bakuhlole njalo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kukulungele ukudayiselwa abantu,” kusho uNksz Mabuza.Uthe i-Aflatoxin ingenza loyo odle ukudla okunayo acanuzelwe yinhliziyo, aphalaze noma abe nobuhlungu esinyeni."Sicela abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bayibusele emuva le mikhiqizo esiyibalile. Imali bazoyithola beneresidi noma bengasenalo. Imithetho yezabathengi ikubeka kucace ukuthi imikhiqizo ebeka engcupheni impilo yabo kufanele ibuyiselwe emuva. Abayibuyisele nalena,” kuphetha uNksz Mabuza.

INHLANGANO ebusayo i-ANC, ithi nakuba zikhona izinselelo kodwa yona iyaziqhenya ngokuningi ekwenzile ikhipha izwe eGibhithe ilifaka ezweni lesethembiso. I-ANC iphawule kanjena nje izincoma ngekwenzile njengoba uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ethule inkulumo ebibhekiswe esizweni izolo ebusuku eKapa.Ithe isivamile ukugxekwa kakhulu ngabantu beyisola ngokwehluleka wukubhekana nosizi lwabantu okuhambisa izidingo kubona ngendlela efanele.I-ANC esitatimendeni sayo ithe iyazi ukuthi kukhona abathanda ukuziqhayisa bazibeke kangcono, bezama inhlanhla ngokugxeka kodwa uKhongolose awubaniki ithuba.Emaphuzwini i-ANC egadla ngawo, ithe kumanje amazwe omhlaba ezwa ngayo ngoba ihamba phambili ekubekeni uvo ngezomhlaba. UKhongolose uthe nakuba kuke kwaba nenhlekelele yeCovid 19 kodwa izwe lihlabela phambili.Ikhulume ngodaba lokulwa nenkohlakalo nokulungisa isimo sokusebenza kukahulumeni."Lo hulumeni ube nejoka lokuvuselela uhulumeni ukuthi ulungiswe kabusha emuva kokuthi ubukhandlwe yinkohlakalo. Ngokubambisana sekwenziwe okuningi ukulungisa isimo futhi konke esikwenzile kuzosiza ukulungisa isimo sangomuso,’’ kusho i-ANC esitatimendeni.Kwezemfundo uKhongolose uthe wenze kahle kakhulu unyusa izinga labantu abafundile, lisuka phansi kakhulu. I-ANC ithe uhulumeni wobandlululo wawubavimbile abantu abamnyama ukuthi bangene emikhakheni esile.I-ANC ithe iyaziqhenza ngezikole okufunda kuzo izingane zithole nokudla khona futhi kunohlelo lokuthutha izingane. UKhongolose uthe uziqhenya ngezitshudeni ezingu 1.3 million ezikwazile ukuthola uxhaso lokufunda bhusende.Uthinte nodaba lwamathuba omsebenzi, wathi baningi abantu abathole imisebenzi kwashintsha impilo yabo. I-ANC ithe udaba lukagesi iyazi ukuthi lunenselelo enkulu futhi kuningi okwenziwe ukubhekana nale nkinga.Iveze ukuthi iyaziqhenya nangezindlu ezakhele abantu abahluphekayo nasezindaweni zasemakhaya, yafaka ugesi namanzi ahlanzekile.I-ANC ithe ibhekene ngqo nempi yobugebengu, ehlalise lubhojozi izwe."Sinyuse nesibalo samaphoyisa ukuze abhekane nobugebengu ezweni. Kukhona namathimba ahlukene esiwasungulile ukuze abhekane nezinhlobonhlobo zobugebengu obuhlupha abantu. Lapha sibala abavukuza ngokungemthetho, ukwebiwa kwamakhebuli, abaphazamisa ukwakha ngoba befuna imali nokunye,’’ kuchaza i-ANC. Ibuye yathinta udaba lwemingcele yakuleli olususa umsindo omkhulu abantu bekhala ngokuthi kukwampunzi edla emini. Eziphendulela uMalema komunye umjikelezo we-EFF obuKwaZulu-Natal, uthe akekho umuntu ongamvimba ekungeneni kule nkundla njengoba bezokwethula umhlahlandlela wabo wokhetho.UNGIZWE Mchunu wathi uMnuz Julius Malema uyongena efile eMoses Mabhida Stadium Isithombe: FACEBOOKUNGIZWE Mchunu wathi uMnuz Julius Malema uyongena efile eMoses Mabhida Stadium Isithombe: FACEBOOKUMalema uthe kuyacaca ukuthi lolu suku luzoshaya uNgizwe engasekho emhlabeni ngoba akasoze amvimba yena.Ubeke kanje uMalema: "Ngize lapha ukuzonitshela ukuthi sesikhona ngokusemthethweni lapha. Kunesilima ebesihamba sithi uMalema ngeke alubeke eMoses Mabhida. Kuchaza ukuthi sizobe sifile ngoMgqibelo. Uyathanda akathandi, sengifikile. Ngikhona. Ngizobe ngiseMoses Mabhida ngoMgqibelo." Uthe akekho umuntu ongenza iKwaZulu-Natal ibe ngu-alubhadwa. "Ngeke i-IFP ikwenze lokho! Ngeke iDA ikwenze lokho! Ngeke i-ANC ikwenze lokho! Akekho umuntu ongavimba mina ukuba ngize KwaZulu-Natal, ngaphandle uma lowo muntu ekulungele ukufihlizwa yisitimela esibomvu. Ngisho ngoba i-EFF iyisitimela esingasanqandeki," kusho uMalema. UNgizwe uhlele indumezulu yomcimbi wamabhinca ngalolu suku, iMabhinca Cultural Carnival and Festival, eGugu Dlamini Park, eThekwini.Uthe kuyoqalwa ngemashi ezosukela esichuseni sikaBotha eBerea, yehle njalo ngomgwaqo uPixley kaSeme (West), iphikelele epaki iGugu Dlamini. Yize oGatsheni noKhuzani sebephumele obala ngokuthi bazonandisa emcimbini we-EFF ngalolu suku kodwa oMzukulu, Saliwa, Dumakahle, Menzi, Gadla neNkosi Yamagcokama sebekuqinisekisile ukuthi bona bahamba noNgizwe. Abanye abaculi ababoshelwe wuNgizwe, kubalwa iZingane Zoma, Imithente, Shwi, Jaiva, Sminofu, Big Zulu, Qhosha, Ntencane, Thokozani Langa, Mdumazi, Njoko, Mjabulisi, Falabo, Ithwasa Lekhansela, Navigator, Bahubhe, Gqizile, Mkhulekelwa, Luve, Skweletu nabanye. Emcimbini we-EFF kulindeleke ukuba kunandise iMajor League DJs, DJ Tira, Big Zulu, Khuzani, Mthandeni, Dladla Mshunqisi, Big NUZ, Babes Wodumo, Jumbo, Bullistik, Mawhoo, Kabza de Small, Gatsheni, Ringo Madlingozi, Young Stunna, Sosha, Linda Sibiya, Ntando Duma, Tshatha Ngobe nabanye.
UGWETSHWE iminyaka emihlanu ebhadla ejele owayeyimeya kuMasipala waKwaZulu-Natal ngecala lenkohlakalo.INkantolo yamacala athinta imali eThekwini izolo imgwebe iminyaka emihlanu uNomagugu Luzulane (49), owayeyimeya kuMasipala Ingwe osuwaziwa ngeDkt Nkosazana Dlamini Zuma.OKlebe bathi ngo-Ephreli 2012 uLuzulane eseyimeya waqala uhlelo okwakuthiwa kuzosizwa ngalo imindeni edonsa kanzima emphakathini.Kuthiwa wathenga ukudla wenza sengathi kuzoyiswa ebantwini abantulayo kanti uzokuyisa emngcwabeni womuntu ayekade esondelene naye.Kuthiwa waphinda waqasha itende nomuntu owayezodlala ingoma emngcwabeni.Okhulumela oKlebe KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant Colonel Simphiwe Mhlongo, uthe uLuzulane waqasha inkampani ephekayo wase eyikhokhela uR50 000, owabuye wanikezwa yena esandleni.UMhlongo uthe lokhu kwalahlekisela umasipala imali enguR71 500."Kwabe sekuvulwa icala lokukhwabanisa nelenkohlakalo koKlebe eThekwini ukuze luphenyisiswe udaba. ULuzulane waboshwa ngo-2017, wase ededelwa ngebheyili. Uvele amahlandla amaningi enkantolo eyamlahla ngecala ngoJulayi 2023 njengoba eze wagwetshwa namuhla (esho izolo)” kusho uMhlongo.ULuzulane ugwetshwe iminyaka eyisikhombisa ebhadla ejele emibii yalengiswa iminyaka eyisihlanu ngombandela wokuthi angalahlwa icala lokukhwabanisa nokweba ngalesikhathi.UMhlongo uthe ubuye wagwetshwa eminye iminyaka emithathu ngamacala amathathu okuphula imigomo eyengamele ukuphathwa kwemali. Izigwebo zakhe kuthiwa uzozidonsa kanyekanye.INhloko yoKlebe KwaZulu-Natal, uMajor General Lesetja Senona, income ithimba labaphenyi nelabashushisi ngomsebenzi eliwenzile oholele ekugwetshweni kukaLuzulane"Lesi sigwebo sizosiza ukunqanda abasebenzi bakahulumeni abasebenzisa budlabha imali yabakhokhi bentela ukuzihlomulisa,” usho kanje.
ISOUTH African National Taxi Council (Santaco), ithe iphoxekile ngokunyuka kwentengo kaphethroli nodizili njengoba lokhu kunomthelela omubi kubantu bakuleli abadonsa kanzima.UNkk Mmatshikhidi Rebecca Phala, okhulumela iSantaco kuzwelonke, uthe yize uphethroli nodizili uhlezi unyuka kodwa imali yokugibela amatekisi bayinyusa kanye ngonyaka."Ilitha likaphetholi selinyuke ngo-75 cents, elikadizili ngo-73 cents. Lokhu kuzokwandisa izindleko zethu. Imboni yamatekisi ayiyinyusi imali yokugibela ngoba isuke icabangela abagibeli. Iningi labo abasebenzi, abafundi namalungu omphakathi abathembele embonini yamatekisi ukuya ezindaweni ezihlukene,” kusho uNkk Phala.Utshele abantu ukuthi imboni yamatekisi iyabanakekela abagibeli, yingakho ingayinyusi imali yokugibela uma kunyuke uphethroli nodizili.Unezezele ngokuthi mhla uphethroli wanyuka kangangokuthi abanikazi bomsebenzi abasakwazi ukuthwala izindleko, ubuholi obuphezulu beSantaco buyohlala phansi bese buthatha isinqumo esiyomenyezelwa emphakathini.Uthe ukunyuka kukaphethroli nodizili kuyabahlupha nabo beyimboni yamatekisi ngoba kusho ukunyuka kwezindleko zabo.Ubalule ukuthi njalo ngonyaka amasondo, amafutha nezinye izinsiza zamatekisi ziyanyuka, ngakho uphethroli wandisa ijoka abalithwele.Uthe bazoqhubeka nokulwela ukuthi uhulumeni abaxhase beyimboni yamatekisi ukuze bakwazi ukubhekana nezindleko ezihlukene.Uveze ukuthi imboni yamabhasi iyaluthola uxhaso kuhulumeni kodwa bona embonini yamatekisi bazithwalela zonke izindleko yize nabo bethutha umphakathi.
AMAPHOYISA aseqinisekise ukuthi aseqoqe ubufakazi obuqanda ikhanda mayelana nabasolwa, kwelokubulawa komrepha wakuleli nomngani wakhe, okwenzeka eThekwini nyakenye.Kusongwa unyaka kwadutshulwa uKiernan 'AKA’ Forbes nomngani wakhe uTebello 'Tibz’ Motsoane, esigamekweni esenzeka bephuma kwenye yezindawo zokudlela i-Wish, esemgwaqweni uFlorida, eMorningside, eThekwini, ngobusuku buka-Febhuwari, 10 nyakenye.Lesi sehlo, saholela ekutheni abanikazi bendawo yokudlela bamemezele ukuvalwa kwayo kusadlule inyanga senzekile, okukholakala ukuthi kwadalwa ukugqoza kwamakhasimende ngenxa yokwethuka. Okhulumela amaphoyisa kuzwelonke uBrigadier Athlenda Mathe uthe amaphoyisa ayabuqonda ubucayi balolu daba.UKiernan 'AKA’ Forbes "Sithanda ukuqinisekisa imindeni ethintekayo nomphakathi ukuthi esikhathini esingangonyaka sisebenze ngokungakhathali ukuthungatha ababulali. Sinethimba lamaphoyisa aqeqeshiwe, abaphenyi abasezingeni eliphezulu, abahlaziyi, abasebenza ngobuchwepheshe abasebenza ngokubambisana nehhovisi likaMqondisi wezokuShushiswa koMphakathi KwaZulu-Natal. Siqoqe ubufakazi obubucayi obuhlanganisa abasolwa abanye abavele basesitokisini ngamanye amacala ahlobene nalawa kanti abanye basagcwele amathafa, amaphoyisa asezithendeni zabo, ” usho kanje.Uthe ukuxhumana nemindeni ngalolu daba kunemikhawulo njengoba uphenyo lusesigabeni esibucayi, kanti ngokwenzenjalo akukhona ukuthi amaphoyisa awayinakile imindeni kodwa enzela ukuze ukuvikelwa kobufakazi kuleli cala.
USETHI khumu ePhalamende uSomlomo wale ndlu, uNkk Nosiviwe Mapisa-Nqakula emuva kokhetho lukazwelonke oluzomenyezelwa maduzane nguMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa.UNkk Mapisa-Nqakula, uthe ungomunye wamalungu e-ANC, asezwakalise ukuthi angathanda ukudeda enkundleni, adedele intsha iqhubeke lapho begcine khona.Uveze ukuthi kodwa konke lokhu kulele ekutheni i-ANC izomvumela yini ukuthi athathe umhlalaphansi.Ekhuluma nesiteshi sethelevishini izolo njengoba uRamaphosa ubethula inkulumo yokugcina ayibhekise esizweni ngaphambi kokhetho, uthe ungomunye wabantu abangena ePhalamende ngo-1994"Kwakuwusuku olumnandi ngesikhathi sifungiswa okokuqala ePhalamende ngaphansi kukahulumeni wentando yeningi. Lolu suku ngeke ngilukhohlwe.” Uveze ukuthi usebenze nabo bonke omengameli abake baphatha ngaphansi kukahulumeni wentando yabantu."Ngike ngaba wungqongqoshe eminyangweni ehlukene njengoba manje ngiwuSomlomo wePhalamende. Akukho engingakwenzanga. Sekufike isikhathi sokuthi manje umuntu adede inkundla kungene abantu abasenomfutho,” kusho uNkk Mapisa-Nqakula.Akuyena kuphela osephumele obala wazwakalisa ukuthi ufuna ukuzibeka phansi izintambo ngemuva kokhetho.UDkt Nkosazana Dlamini Zuma, uNgqongqoshe eHhovisi likaMengameli, waphumela obala wathi uzibeka phansi izintambo.Wabhalela ikomiti lezokhetho le-ANC, eliphonsa imibuzo abazojutshelwa ePhalamende yinhlangano ngemuva kokhetho, wabonga ithuba kodwa wathi usezibeka phansi izintambo ngemuva kokhetho.Intsha yale nhlangano isike yaphumela obala yathi abantu abangena ePhalamende ngo-1994, isikhathi sabo siphelile kumele badede enkundleni.Le nhlangano yathi ifuna intsha igcwale ePhalamende kanjalo naseziShayamthetho zezifundazwe.Lokhu akwehlanga kahle kwabanye abaholi bayo inhlangano, kubalwa noSihlalo kazwelonke uMnuz Gwede Mantashe, owathi intsha ayikwazi ukuthi ingathi ifuna kube no-50% wabantu abasha ePhalamende.UVukayibambe we-ANC wathi iPhalamende akuyona indawo yokuthi abantu abadala bathathe umhlalaphansi kuyona, ngakho abadedele intsha esenomfutho ukuthi igijime.
BELINGAKAQEDI ngisho unyaka esikhundleni ikhansela le-IFP kuMasipala waKwaNongoma, elisocongwe kwaze kwadutshulwa nezingane zesikole ebezidlula. UMnuz Ndukenhle Shawn Duma, waku-ward 11 eMasokaneni KwaNongoma, uthelekelwe amadoda amdubula esuka eMtuba.Kuthiwa kuvele kwama imoto eduze kwakhe abalisa bavulela ngenhlamvu waphelela khona lapho uDuma. UMasipala waKwaNongoma ugubuzelwe yizigameko zokubulawa kwamakhansela athelekelwa abantu ngezibhamu engazelele. Kuthiwa uDuma ubekade elungisa imoto ebikhomba ukuba nenkingana kanti sekuzoba yithuba labahlaseli ukuthi bamthelekele ngenhlamvu.Ngesikhathi ehlaselwa kuthiwa abebemdubula bavulele ngenhlamvu emotweni yezingane zesikole ebidlula ingahlangene nesigameko. Kudubuleke izingane ezine kwashona eyodwa kanti silobe ezinye zilashwa esibhedlela.UDuma ubulawa nje, ubesanda kukhethwa njengekhansela okhethweni lokuchibiyela obelungo-Ephreli nyakenye. Ubezobe eqeda unyaka wokuqala esesikhundleni kulo nyaka.Okhulumela amaphoyisa kuzwelonke uBrigadier Athlenda Mathe, uthe sebejube ithimba eliphenya amacala ezepolitiki ukuthi lithungathe abalisa abagile lo mkhuba. UBrigadier Mathe uthe uMkhuzi wamaPhoyisa uGeneral Fannie Masemola, uthintekile wanxusa amaphoyisa ukuthi aphuthumise uphenyo.UMphathiswa wezokuThutha, ukuPhepha nokuXhunyaniswa koMphakathi KwaZulu-Natal uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka, uthe ufisa abomthetho baphuthume babambe abenzi bobubi. UHlomuka uthe udangele kakhulu nangokulimala kwezingane ezidubuleke kulesi sigameko.Uthe lokhu kubuyisela emuva imisebenzi esiyenziwe yikomiti elizama ukudala ukuthula emaqenjini ezepolitiki.USomlomo kaMasipala waKwaNongoma uNksz Babongile Sithole, uthe bashaqekile ngokubulawa kukaDuma ngoba ubeyindoda yokuthula."Ubengumuntu osemncane futhi kubonakala ukuthi ikusasa lakhe liqhakazile kwezepolitiki. Ubewumuntu onokuthula nje, kusiphathe kabi ukuzwa ngokubulawa kwakhe uMhlonishwa uDuma,’’ kusho uNksz Sithole.Uthe kulindeleke ukuthi uDuma angcwatshwe kubo eMasokaneni, KwaNongoma ngeSonto.Okhulumela i-IFP uMnuz Mkhuleko Hlengwa, uthe kuyakhathaza ukuthi kulokhu kuqhubekile ukubulawa kosopolitiki esifundazweni.

INKAMPANI kaHulumeni ebhekelele ukuthuthukiswa kwemigwaqo ezweni iSanral, ikhiphe isimemezelo ngokuvalwa komgwaqo ophakathi kweWestville Viaduct, neParadise Valley ngenxa yokuthi kulungiswa uN3.Ngokwesitatimende esithunyelwe kwabezindaba, kubikwa ukuthi kuzovalwa ngokugcwele iLancaster Bridge kusukela ngoFebhuwari 26, 2024 kuya kuFebhuwari 28, 2025 phezu kukaN3. Bathi lokho kuzokwenza kube lula ukubhidlizwa nokwakhiwa kabusha kwebhuloho iLancaster (B0461), njengengxenye yohlelo lokwakhiwa nokulungiswa komgwaqo osuka eWestville Viaduct, uye eParadise Valley. UJason Lowe, oyiMenenja yeProjekthi yesiFunda esiseMpumalanga yakwaSANRAL, uthe ukuvalwa ngokuphelele kuzokwenziwa eLancaster Terrace, kuzo zombili izindlela eziya ebhulohweni elinqamula uN3. I-Road Traffic Inspectorate (RTI), ngosizo lwethimba lendawo yokuhlala yosonkontileka, izophatha futhi iqaphe ukuvalwa kwezimoto ngalesi sikhathi. "Abashayeli bezimoto bazokhonjiswa indlela entsha abazoyisebenzisa ngezimpawu kweminye imizila edlula ebhulohweni likaLangford, noDudley Road,” kuchaza uJason Lowe.Uqhube wathi iSANRAL iyaqonda ukuthi lokhu kuzodala ukuphazamiseka ekuhambeni kwezimoto futhi yenze konke okusemandleni ukunciphisa umthelela. Abashayeli bezimoto bayanxuswa ukuthi babekezele ngesikhathi sokuvalwa nokuhlela, balungise izikhathi zabo zokuhamba futhi bahambisane nophawu olufakiwe lwemingcele yesivinini. Lokhu kuzoqinisekisa ukuthi bafika bephephile futhi ngesikhathi lapho beya khona."Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha kwabasebenzisa umgwaqo nethimba labakhi, kuhlelwe imizila ezosetshenziswa ngalesi sikhathi. Abashayeli bezimoto abasebenzisa ingxenye yomgwaqo uN3 njengamanje (phakathi kwePavilion no-M13), nalabo abasebenzisa iLancaster Bridge bazoqaphela ukuthi kumanje kufakwa izimpawu, imigoqo nezindlela zokunciphisa umgwaqo,” kusho uLowe.I-SANRAL iyaxolisa nganoma yikuphi ukuphazamiseka komphakathi futhi iyabonga ngokubekezela kwabo ngalesi sikhathi.
UNGQONGQOSHE kagesi uMnuz Kgosientsho Ramokgopa, uthe lide ibanga eselihanjiwe ukulungisa inkinga yokucishwa kukagesi kuleli.URamokgopa uthe kunenhlansi yethemba ngokuthi le nkinga bazoyinqoba ngoba ugesi awusacishwa njalo."Uma ubheka ugesi awusacishwa njalo. Kunenhlansi yethemba ukuthi le nkinga sizoyinqoba. Uhulumeni we-ANC wenza konke okusemandleni ukulungisa le nkinga.”Ukusho lokhu ekhuluma eCity Hall izolo eKapa njengoba ebethamele inkulumo kamengameli ayibhekise esizweni.Uthe uyazi ukuthi abantu bafuna kuqedwe nya ngale nkinga yokucishwa kukagesi.Usho lokhu nje amaqembu amaningi agiya ngenkinga kagesi athi i-ANC ihluleke yancama ukulungisa le nkinga.Akhala ngokuthi ukucishwa kukagesi kuwisa umnotho wezwe, kuphinde kwenze amabhizinisi athwale kanzima.Abantu abaningi bebekhala ngokuthi bafuna kulungiswe le nkinga kagesi.IPhini likaNgqongqoshe wezamanzi nokuthuthwa kwendle uMnuz David Mahlobo, lithe abantu kumele bathole amanzi ahlanzekile.Ekhuluma nezintatheli eCity Hall, uthe benza konke okusemandleni ukulungisa inkinga yamanzi ebhekene naKwaZulu-Natal, naseThekwini.Lesi sifundazwe sihlaselwe yinkinga yamanzi. Kwezinye izindawo kuphela izinsuku amanzi engekho.Omasipala abehlukene bakhala ngengqalasizinda esindala abathe iyona eyenza ukuthi amanzi avuze.Kukhalwe kakhulu nangamanzi angafinyeleli emphakathini ngenxa yokuthi aphelela emapayipini avuzayo.
UMENGAMELI Cyril Ramaphosa uthi uhulumeni wakhe uzobuyela ezintanjeni zokuphatha izwe bethanda bengathandi labo abafisa ukuthi bahambe beyoshona njengesipikili. URamaphosa upiklele izimbangi ngesikhathi ethula inkulumo yakhe ebhekiswe esizweni eKapa ngoLwesine."Lena yinkulumo yokugcina yalo hulumeni ebhekiswe esizweni kodwa isiZulu sithi sizobuya bethanda bengathandi. Siyabuya kuyo le ndawo,’’ kusho uRamaphosa kwachwaza bebodwa abajabulayo abanye bemchitha bethi akahambe ashone. Ubethula inkulumo yokugcina ebhekiswe esizweni njengoba kulo nyaka kuzophela isikhathi sikahulumeni owakhethwa ngo-2019. Inkulumo kamengameli iqale kahle yaze yaphetha ingaphazamisekanga njengoba amalungu e-EFF abengekho ePhalamende.URamaphosa ukhulume wayidonsa emuva kakhulu kusuka ngo-1994, eqhakambisa izinto esezenziwe wuhulumeni we-ANC eminyakeni engu-30 usemandleni kuleli. Phakathi kwezinto azibalile uthe uhambo lweminyaka engu-30 lube olunezinselelo kakhulu kodwa kuningi okuhle."Iminyaka engu-30 edlule ibe eyoshintsho kuleli futhi abantu abaningi balubonile. Bawabonile amathuba omsebenzi, ukuthula noxolo. Ngeke sikwazi ukuziba umsebenzi ongaka esiwenzile kodwa futhi asizibalekeli izinselelo esibhekene nazo,’’ kusho uRamaphosa.Ukhale ngodaba lokubhozonyelwa koMbuso wathi luwulimaze kakhulu uhulumeni nezwe kodwa sekukuningi okwenziwe ukulungisa umonakalo.Uthe umonakalo wezibhelu zango-2021 Julayi uyezwela kodwa uncome abantu bakuleli ngokubambana bangavumi ukuthi izwe labo liketulwe yilabo athe banezinhloso zabo. Ukhale nangeCovid-19 ethi idlule nemiphefumulo yabantu nemisebenzi yaphazamisa nomnotho.Uthe kodwa noma kunjalo izwe lama labambana ngesikhathi sobunzima, nakuba zikhonjwa izibazi kodwa manje sekwedlule izwe lihlabela phambili.Udlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane nezingane uthe lusalokhu luyinkinga enkulu kodwa amaqhinga okubhekana nalo akhona futhi kuzidingeka umphakathi ubambane ukuze unqobe lesi sihlava.Ukhulume ngokuthi abantu bakuleli bahlomule kakhulu ngezindlu, ugesi amanzi okwakungekho ekuqaleni. Uthe uyaqonda ukuthi inkinga yamanzi isabhokile kwezinye izindawo kodwa baphezu kwayo bayayilungisa njengoba kwakhiwa ingqalasizinda ezindaweni ezehlukene.URamaphosa ubabaze usizo lwemali yesiboneleleo etholwa yizigidi zabantu bakuleli wathi lokhu okwenziwa wuhulumeni kufana nokwakha ikusasa elihle uma usiza abantu.Ukhulume ngokucijwa kwezikhungo zikahulumeni ukuze ziwenze kahle umsebenzi. Uthe izikhungo ezinjenge-SARS zazithithibaliswe ngamabomu kodwa sezivukile manje qingqo. URamaphosa uthe umnotho wakuleli usumkhulu ngokuphindwe kathathu kunalokho owawuyikho ngo-1994. Uthe udaba lukagesi olufana notwayi othi ulunwaya luvumbuka ngeke balukhohlwe bayaqhubeka nokululungisa.Udaba lwezemfundo luchazwe njengolube nempumelelo kakhulu ngoba izinga lokuphasa lenyuke ledlula yonke iminyaka kuleli. URamaphosa uthe izingane zifunda mahhala futhi ziyadla ezikoleni.Kwezempilo wethembise ukuthi usabheka ukusayina eyomshwalense wezempilo i-NHI, athe bazoyifaka kancane kancane kuleli ukuze abantu bathole ezempilo ezifanayo. Ukhulume nangokulekelelwa komasipala ukuze bahambise izidingo kubantu wathi kufanele kufakwe abanamakhono afanele ezikhundleni zokuphatha omasipala.Ubalule nokutshalwa kwamaphoyisa ukulwa nobugebengu kuleli.
UKHULUME waze wafikelwa wusizi wachiphiza izinyembezi ummangalewa wesibili ecaleni lokubulawa kukaSenzo Meyiwa, uBongani Ntanzi ethi ukhumbula ukuhlukunyezwa kwakhe. UMeyiwa wadutshulwa wafa ekubo kwentombi yakhe, uKelly Khumalo, eVosloorus ePitoli, ngo-2014.Bahlanu abalisa abashushiswa ngokufa kukaMeyiwa kodwa baphika bayagelekeqeka ukuthi kukhona okubahlanganisa necala. Bakhala ngokuthi amaphoyisa abavumisa amacala ngenkani ebashaya.UNtanzi ongummangalelwa wesibili ecaleni, udabuka KwaNongoma kodwa ubesebenza emayini eNorth West, okulapho amaphoyisa amthola khona embopha. Ofakazi abalethwa wuMbuso bayamninda uNtanzi abamchaza ngokuthi udume ngelikaMafika.Ithimba labameli ligibeze uNtanzi ebhokisini ukuthi alandise inkantolo ngakwaziyo njengoba amaphoyisa ethi wavuma icala wasayina izitatimende. UNtanzi ulandise inkantolo ukusuka nokuhlala ngokuboshwa kwakhe eyamaniswa nokubulala uMeyiwa. UNtanzi ubegibela ebhokisini elama ummangalelwa wokuqala uMuzikawukhulelwa Sibiya, osefakaze waqeda yena.UNtanzi uthe kunesiwombe lapho amaphoyisa acishe amkhipha khona umphefumulo, emphoqa ukuthi akhulume ngokufa kukaMeyiwa."Iphoyisa uMabena lakhipha uplastiki waseTruworths, langifaka wona ebusweni engimboza ngawo engincisha umoya. Kwakubuhlungu kakhulu futhi ngangiqala ukwenziwa into enje. Namanje inhliziyo yami isebuhlungu ngento abangenza yona,’’ kusho uNtanzi ezwakala enesibibithwane sokukhala.Uzwakale sengathi uphefumula ushintsha amagiya, ebamba ukukhala. UMMANGALELWA wesibili ecaleni lokufa kukaSenzo Meyiwa, uBongani Ntanzi ukhale ngamaphoyisa athe amhlukumeza emvumisa icala Isithombe: OUPA MOKOENA/INDEPENDENT MEDIAUmmeli u-Adv Sipho Ramosepele engayingeni wangamnika ngisho ikhefu lokuziqoqa, waqhubeka wamfaka imibuzo.UNtanzi uthe babemfaka uplastiki, bethi uzosho uma esefuna ukukhuluma. Uthe akugcinanga lapho kodwa babuye bamthela ngamanzi kubanda, bamjijimeza ngento thizeni enogesi."Bangikhumula isikibha, bangibhunyela ngamanzi kubanda. Kukhona enye into ababengibamba ngayo enogesi. Yaba buhlungu kakhulu into abangenza yona, namanje ngisasho ukuthi inkosi ibabusise,’’ kusho uNtanzi ngosizi.Uthe amaphoyisa aba nezikhawu eziningi emshaya, kukhona lapho abambophela khona ensimbini ngozankosi, bamxina ngesibhaxu. Uthe amaphoyisa ayekhala ngokuthi uyedelela.
UTHI azigudluke izaguga njengoba sekufike abaholi abasha, uMnuz Duduzane Zuma ohola iqembu lepolitiki, i-All Game Changers (AGC).UZuma uthe akalwi nabaholi asebekhulile kodwa ubona ukuthi sesadlula isikhathi sabo, kudingeka amasu amasha okudala imisebenzi azoza nabaholi abasha.Ebuzwa ukuthi kungani engasebenzisani noyise, owayengumengameli wezwe, uMnuz Jacob Zuma eqenjini uMkhonto Wesizwe, uDuduzane, uthe ungumholi omusha ozoletha ushintsho oludingekayo ezweni."Ngiwumholi ozimele, ofuna bonke abantu bakuleli baphumelele. Angisebenzisani namanye amaqembu. Nginenhlangano yami i-AGC esebenzisana nabo bonke abantu bakuleli. Sifuna ukudala amathuba emisebenzi ngokuvuselela izimboni. Asizenzi izithembiso kodwa siza nezisombululo ezibonakalayo,” kusho uZuma.Uthe umatasa uhambela izindawo ezahlukene ukuze ipolitiki iphilwe ngabantu bakuleli."Lesi yisikhathi sabaholi abasha abazimisele ukuletha ushintsho oludingekayo ezweni. Simatasa nezinhlelo ze-IEC. Ngeke siye ezinkundleni zemidlalo ukuyokwethula usomqulu wokhetho kodwa sizosebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumana nezinye izindlela ukudlulisa umlayezo wethu,” kusho uZuma.Ugqugquzele abantu ukuba bavote, wathi abangakubhaliselanga ukuvota bayingxenye yezinkinga.Ukhale ngokuthi uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa uzokwethula inkulumo yesizwe kodwa ngeke eze nesisombululo sezinkinga zokungabi bikho kwemisebenzi kuleli.Uveze ukuthi ukuze ukhule umnotho, i-AGC izoqinisekisa ukuthi kunemithetho egqugquzela abatshalizimali ukuba beze kuleli.ABAFUNA ushintsho, uMnuz Duduzane Zuma uthi mabavote Isithombe:BONGIWE ZUMA Ubalule ukuthi uzovuselela izinkampani zikahulumeni eziwayo, okubalwa i-Eskom, Transnet, Denel, SA Post Office nezinye.Uthe akahambisani nokuthi lezi zinkampani zisuke ezandleni zikahulumeni ngoba yizona ezikwazi ukudala izigidi zemisebenzi, zingenise nentela eningi."Uma ubheka njengamanje izinkampani zikahulumeni ziwiswa ngamabomu ukuze zizodayiselwa abathile. Akufanele kwenzeke lokhu. Kufanele zivuselelwe ukuze zizoqhubeka nokudala amathuba omsebenzi. Kuhle ukusebenzisana phakathi kukahulumeni nosomabhizinisi abazimele kodwa hhayi ukubadayisela izinkampani zikahulumeni,” kusho uZuma.Uphethe ngokuthi ngeke kuqhathaniswe ukhetho lwango-1994 nolwalo nyaka ngoba abantu bafuna kulungiswe umnotho, abafuni nje inkululeko ehambisana nobuphofu. Bafuna ukuphuma enhluphekweni babe namathuba afanayo omnotho.
INHLANGANO ebhekele ukuncintisana okuhle, iCompetition Commission, isiludlulisele eNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo udaba lwamabhange asolwa ngokuntengisa iRandi.Ngo-2020 iCompetition Commission yaludlulisela kwiCompetition Tribunal, udaba lokuthi kunamabhange awu-28 akuleli nawaphesheya ayesebenzisana ukuntengezelisa iRandi.La mabhange acelwa ukuba aziphendulele ngezinsolo ngoMashi wonyaka odlule. Adlulisela udaba lwawo eNkantolo yamaCala aDlulisiwe okuncintisana.Emuva kwalokho amabhange awu-17 kwavela ukuthi awasangeni odabeni lokutshekiswa kweRandi.Amabhange amane kuphela ayalelwa ukuba aziphendulele ngezinsolo, okuyi-BNP Parbas, JP Morgan Chase and Co, HSBC Bank Plc neCredit Suisse Securities (USA) LLC.UMnuz Siyabulela Makunga obhekele ezokuxhumana kwiCompetition Commission, uthe badlulisele udaba eNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo ngoba bafuna amabhange aziphendulele.Uthe abantu bakuleli kufanele balazi iqiniso ngezinsolo ezibekiswe kula mabhange.Amabhange asusiwe ohlwini lwawokufanele aziphendulele yiBank of America, Merrill Lynch International Designated Activity Company, JP Morgan Chase Bank N.A, Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Limited, Nomura International, PLC, Commerzbank AG, Macquarie Bank Limited, HSBC Bank, USA National Association, Merrill Lynch Pierce Fenner &Smith Inc, National Association neStandard Americas.Uthe ngeke baludlulise udaba lokukhishwa kweNedbank Group Limited, First Rand Limited, Credit Suisse Group neStandard New York Securities.Uveze ukuthi i-Absa Bank Limtied, Barclays Capital neBarclays Bank bacele ukuxegiselwa isigwebo.ICitibank NA neStandard Bank sebelulungisile udaba lwabo neCompetition Commission. I-Investec Bank Limited isalindeleke ukuba iziphendulele.Kulindeleke ukuthi isinqumo seNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo sicacise ukuthi izinhlangano ezibhekele ukuncintisana zinalo yini igunya lokungenela ezindabeni ezithinta amabhange akuleli.
I-DA ikhala ngokuphazamiseka kokufunda nokufundisa ezikoleni zaKwaZulu-Natal naseThekwini ngenxa yenkinga yamanzi ehlasele.Leli qembu likhala ngokuthi kudingeka abafundi basheshe badedelwe ezikoleni uma kunqamuka noma kuphela amanzi.Okhulumela i-DA kwezemfundo esifundazweni, uDkt Dr Imran Keeka, ukhale ngokuthi uMasipala weTheku usushayeke kakhulu ngale nkinga yamanzi.Uthe lo mkhandlu uyehluleka wukuhlinzeka abantu ngamanzi ahlanzekile kanjalo nezikole."Lokhu kwenza ukuthi izikole zisheshe zidedele abafundi ngoba amanzi engekho. Kuphazamiseka ukufunda nokufundisa ukwenza lokhu.” Uthe kwenzeka lokhu nje akukapheli ngisho iminyaka emingaki kwagadla ubhubhane iCovid-19 kuleli.Sekuyinsakavukela ukuthi njalo uma kunenkinga yamanzi izikole eziningi zisheshe zidedele abafundi ukuthi baye emakhaya ngoba izindlu zangasese zisuke zizogcwala.Kwezinye izikole kuze kuthiwe akufike kuphela u-matric uzofunda abanye abafundi bahlale emakhaya ngenxa yamanzi.Le nkinga ayiphazamisi kuphela izikole kodwa nezikhungo zemfundo ephakeme ziyaphazamiseka ngenxa yenkinga yamanzi.EThekwini umkhandlu uveze ukuthi uyayazi le nkinga futhi uyayisukumela.Izikhulu zomkhandlu zizikhalela ngokuvuza okwenza ukuthi kulahleke amanzi.Zikhala nangokuba ndala kwengqalasizinda okwenza ukuthi ingabi sesimeni esikahle sokuhlinzeka ngamanzi.Okunye okukhalisa izikhulu yizikhukhula ezihlasela eThekwini nezicekela phansi ingqalasizinda.Ikhomishini yamalungelo abantu ithi isebenza ngamandla ukulungisa le nkinga yamanzi eThekwini.
UGAXWE ithayi entanyeni washiswa owesilisa waseNduduzweni eMlaza ngemuva ' kokukhonjwa’ owesifazane othe uwumdlwenguli, kodwa wabuye wathi ubemfanisa. UMnuz Sandile Mzweleni Xaba (30), ongowokudabuka eSinyameni eMthwalume kodwa obehlala kule mijondolo, kuthiwa ugaxwe ithayi entanyeni, wambumbuthelwa ngophethroli wase eyashiswa.Ngokusho kukamfowabo, uMnuz Joe Khumalo, umufi uhlaselwa yiqulu ebusuku nje, laliqale lagasela emini, lihamba nowesifazane omsola ngokumdlwengula nomngani wakhe."Kuthiwa owesifazane wafika wathi 'uyeke lo’ kodwa umngani wakhe wamkhuza ethi akuyena ngoba umufi akanawo amazinyo egolide,” kusho uKhumalo.Uthe kwaba khona impikiswano phakathi kwalaba besifazane iqulu lagcina lihlakazeka likholwa wukuthi ngempela akuyena.UKhumalo uthe emva kwaleso siwombe, umufi wanikela kuye eClermont ezombikela ukuthi usethelekelwe abantu behamba nowesifazane obezomsulela ngecala angalazi."Ngambonisa ukuthi kuzodingeka ayobika emaphoyiseni ngalokhu kuhlaselwa, wathalalisa, ethi akunasidingo ngoba babuye bahlakazeka bengamenzanga lutho,” kuchaza uKhumalo.Uthe wathi uyobheka izihlobo ehostela eWema ngaphambi kokuthi abuyele endlini ebusuku nokuyilapho elaphinde labuya khona iqulu, selivutha lingabaselwe."Ngathola ucingo entombini yakhe eseVerulam ngokusebenza, ithi asiphuthume eNduduzweni ngoba udadewabo uyibikela ukuthi sebephinde babuya laba bantu, kanti kulokhu sebevele bamthatha ngenkani, bahamba naye,” kusho uKhumalo.Uveze ukuthi nebala bafika sekonakele eseshe wangqongqa umufi.Uthe sibaphathe kabi isigameko.Uveze ukuthi bekuvele kukhona ukungahoshelani kahle phakathi komndeni wentombi kamufi nomunye womakhelwane. Wenza izinsolo zokuthi kwalo makhelwane kukhona izelamani zesilisa, ezifuna ukuthatha ngodli umjondolo wakubo kwentombi kamufi."Lo mbango uqale nyakenye kanti uye ngokuqina sekugula unina wentombi kangangokuthi waze wamcela ukuthi akazohlala nabo, ukuze kubuye isithunzi, izelamani ziyeke ukudlala ngabo. Mhlawumbe unezinyanga eziyisithupha ehlala khona,” kusho uKhumalo.Udalule ukuthi kuke kwathi ukuthula ekufikeni kwakhe, kodwa waqala walwiswa ngemumva kokushona kukanina wentombi ngoNovemba."NgoDisemba nje ungibikele ukuthi zifikile izelamani zafike zamhlanganyela zamshaya kodwa wazitshela ukuthi kuzophelela lapho kanti akazi ukuthi kuseza okukhulu,” kubalisa uKhumalo."Amaphoyisa athe alikho icala elivuliwe lokudlwengula, athi sekunesikhathi lagcina ukuvulwa. Lokho kwenza sibone ukuthi umufi ubulawelwe into engekho. Sesibona ukuthi waboshelwa amanqina enyathi ngenxa yombango wendlu,” kwenaba uKhumalo.Ezinkundleni zokuxhumana kukhona ababize umufi ngomalugaju osebaqedile abesifazane endaweni ebadlwengula, ebulala namalungu emindeni yabo, nokho umndeni wakhe uthe amaphoyisa athi azikho izigameko ezifuze lezi ezishiwo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ezibikiwe.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uColonel Robert Netshiunda uthe amaphoyisa aseMlaza aphenya icala lokubulala kulandela isigameko sokushiswa kowesilisa ngabantu abangaziwa.

ULALE ezitokisini ufakazi woMbuso okuthiwa ubeseshaya ungqimphothwe engasafuni ukufakaza ecaleni lephoyisa, elisolwa ngokubulala ngokudubula umuntu.Kusolwa ukuthi iphoyisa uSergeant Sibonelo Shabangu ladubula amahlandla ayisithupha uMnuz Qiniso Mdima ngoba encike emotweni yalo ngaphandle kwendawo yobumnandi eMolweni, eThekwini.Ufakazi uMnuz Mandla Dlamini uvele eNkantolo yeMantshi yasePinetown.UDlamini benoMnuz Ayanda Ngcobo kuthiwa bashaye ungqimphothwe ngomzuzu wokugcina, batshela umshushisi uMnuz Rowen Souls ukuthi abasafuni ukufakaza ngezizathu ezingadalulwanga.Kwale noma uSouls ekhuluma nalawa madoda ewancenga ngoLwesibili. Kunalokho uDlamini kuthiwa uvele wahamba enkantolo, wakhishelwa incwadi egunyaza ukuthi aboshwe.Kuvele ukuthi uDlamini wabuya ngosuku olufanayo sekuhambe isikhathi, wase ekhalelwa ngamasongo kaSigonyela.Izolo uvele phambi kweMantshi M A Khumalo, yathi ngabe isingatha isigcawu azochaza kuso uDlamini ukuthi kungani ehambile enkantolo kodwa ukucima kukagesi ngenhloso yokuwonga, kwenze yasheshe yaguqa inkantolo, waphunyuka kanjalo.UKhumalo ukhiphe uDlamini ngesixwayiso, wathi angaphinde enze akwenzile ngoba uzogqunywa ezitokisini. Kujabule amalungu omndeni wakhe abezomeseka esededelwa.USouls ubekade ecebe labo fakazi kuKhumalo, wathi babhala izitatimende ngesigameko futhi bakhishelwa amasamanisi ayebabizela enkantolo kodwa manje sebeyamhlamuka.Kuthangi uKhumalo ukhiphe isixwayiso esishubile abesibhekise kuNgcobo yena ongahambanga enkantolo."Kunemiphumela engemihle uma unqaba ukwethula ubufakazi. Uzobhekana nengalo yomthetho ngokuphelele. Awukwazi ukumane uzithathele ngokwakho isinqumo sokuthi awusafuni ukufakaza. Icala kumele liqulwe liqedwe, ngakho (inkantolo) ayizomela umuntu olibambezelayo,” kusho uKhumalo.Lapho uNgcobo ebese ethule du, evuma konke obekushiwo nguKhumalo, abuye akhwehlele engaqedi ebukeka engahlalisekile.UShabangu ungaphandle ngebheyili ka-R5 000. Icala lihlehliselwe uMashi nonyaka. Kubikwa ukuthi uMdima washiya emhlabeni abantwana bakhe abahlanu.Kuthiwa isigameko senzeka ngaphandle kwaseCasablanca Lifestyle, eMolweni eThekwini ngoNovemba 2022.Enkantolo kwavela ukuthi umufi wadutshulwa kanye esiphongweni futhi wayenamanxeba ayisihlanu okudutshulwa emhlane.Phambilini enkantolo kwavela ukuthi uShabangu wadubula uMdima ngoba wayezitshela ukuthi uhosha isibhamu enqulwini ngesikhathi ekhuluma naye.
LINGENE ebhokisini labasolwa lama phuhle, livathe umnazaretha, iphoyisa eliboshelwe icala lokushaya unina ngepulangwe elalinezipikili washona.UConstable Lungisani "Mazambane” Xaba (48) ubevele eNkantolo yeMantshi yasePinetown.UXaba, osebe yiphoyisa kusuka ngo-2010, ube esetshela imantshi ukuthi akaphilile, uyagula.Ngesikhathi ezocela ibheyili enkantolo uConstable Lungisani Xaba (48) othweswe icala lokushaya unina ngepulangwe ambulale KwaDabeka, eClermont ngoMeyi Usolwa ngokushaya kanzima abulale unina uNkk Greta Xaba (81) owayehamba ngesihlalo esinamasondo ngenxa yokukhubazeka.Isigameko senzeka emzini kanina kaXaba, KwaDabeka, ngoMeyi 6, 2022.IMantshi uSiphiwe Hlophe ibe isihlehlisa icala yathi uXaba uzobuyela enkantolo ngasekupheleni kukaFebhuwari eseluleme.UHlophe uthe uXaba uzothola nesikhathi sokuthi axoxisane nommeli wakhe okuvela ukuthi usengowesihlanu ukumumela kuleli cala. Uphume enkantolo eqhutshwa amaphoyisa embuyisela ezitokisini nomnazaretha wakhe.Inkantolo isisichithe kabili isicelo sebheyili kaXaba yabeka ukuthi uyabazi ofakazi nakuba ayelandula.Waboshwa ngoMeyi 7, 2022, wabekwa icala lokushaya ngenhloso yokulimaza, elashintshwa laba ngelokubulala sekushone unina ngoMeyi 8.Enkantolo bekukhona amalungu omndeni kaXaba nodadewabo omncane, uNksz Andile Xaba.UNksz Xaba uthe baphatheke kabuhlungu kuhlehla icala ngoba bafuna ukubona isiphetho.UNksz Xaba uthe badonsa kanzima futhi basele dengwane uXaba esebaphuce unina obeyinsika yekhaya bethembele kuyena."Yize umama ubena-81 futhi ehamba ngesihlalo esinamasondo kodwa ubesho lukhulu kithina enendima abeyidlala. ULungisani wayemhlukumeza umama. Wake wamkhomba ngesibhamu, wadubula kwasho ukuthi inhlamvu yinye yashaya phansi,” kusho uNksz Xaba ngosizi.Ulandise wathi bekungekuhle ukuhlala nomsolwa emndenini oseke wahamba wayoqasha emuva kokushiya angalazi kunina.Kuthiwa kwakungu-2019 ebuya emqashweni ephethe uR6 000 awunika unina efuna enze umsebenzi ukuze bakhumelane umlotha."Wathi uR5 000 owokwenza umsebenzi ngoba kwakunguJulayi, yena uyiNazaretha wayengeke akwazi ukuwenza.
