KUBATSHAZWA unya nesihluku enganeni (7) okuthiwa igwilizise enye (4) yaze yashona emfuleni e-Extension 3 eChesterville.Esigamekweni esenzeke ngoLwesibili, kushone uLeeto Mabizela (4) obefunda uGrade R esikoleni, i-HP Ngwenya Primary.Uyise, uMnuz Xolani Mabizela, echazela Isolezwe ngesigameko izolo emva kwenkonzo yomngcwabo kaLeeto, uthe ezwe ngesigameko sekuphele cishe amahora amathathu senzekile.Uthe basizwe ngenye ingane yendawo exoxelwe ngenye ebikhona ngesikhathi kwenzeka isigameko.Uveze ukuthi emva kokubayengela emfuleni, umsolwa ufike wayalela umufi yedwa ukuthi akakhumule izingubo abezigqokile."Kuthiwa uthe esekhumulile, wamphushela endaweni eshonayo emanzini, maqede wagwiliza ngesikhathi bebukela abanye. Kuthiwa uthe esenqashanqasha, bathi laba abanye, akugijinywe kuyotshelwa umama wakhe. Kuthiwa wathi abangakwenzi lokho ngoba uzobagwaza abaphose kulo mfula nabo,” kuchaza uMabizela.Uthe ngobungane nangokwesaba, zithulile izingane, kwabuyelwa emakhaya, okuyilapho eyodwa yazo igcine ixoxela enye ukuthi kwenzekeni emfuleni, maqede yahlaba umkhosi.UMFULA 'okugwiliziswe’ kuwo uLeeto Mabizela (4) Isithombe: SIBONELO NGCOBO/ INDEPENDENT NEWSPAPERSUveze ukuthi unina kaLeeto obekhona ekhaya, uphuthume khona emfuleni, ekhashwa womunye wesilisa wangakhona."Bafike bakhanyisa ngamafoni, nebala bayibona ingane yami intanta emanzini, wayikhipha unina,” kuchaza uMabizela.Uthi naye yize ebesendleleni nomngani wakhe obemcele ukuthi amkhaphe baye endaweni ethize, uvele wajika emva kokuthola ucingo obelumazisa ngesigameko. Nakuba ekuqonda ukuthi umuntu owenze umonakalo usemncane, ngeke aboshwe kodwa uthe kubalimazile ukuziphatha komndeni kamsolwa. Ubuye waveza nokuthi umenzi wobubi uyingane edume ngokuganga vele, kangangoba bebeye bamkhuze uLeeto ukuthi angazijwayezi ukudlala naye kodwa kusho khona ukuthi uyingane."Ugogo wengane nonina wayo, okuyibo abahlala nayo, abakaze bavele lapha ekhaya. Umuntu ozile ngubaba wakhona ongahlali nokuhlala la. Wuye ovelile, waba nathi kwaze kwaba yinamuhla (esho izolo ngosuku lomngcwabo),” kusho yena.Uthe ngesikhathi ephuma eyodlala uLeeto emva kokubuya esikoleni, ubeyingane nje eyodlala njengenjwayelo, bengazitsheli ukuthi angaya emfuleni ngoba akaze waya khona.Ubuye waveza nokuthi okunye okubaphula izinhliziyo wukuthi umndeni kamsolwa uyabagigiyela uma bedlula ngakhona, uhleke uze umphikele nomsolwa ukuthi wenze isigameko."Okubuhlungu wukuthi sithenga esitolo esisodwa. Siyabonana ekubeni bengakhombisi ukuzwelana nathi. Impilo kubona iyaqhubeka kumnandi, bayahleka kodwa thina sishonelwe yingane,” kusho uMabizela.Uthe kuzoba nzima nokuthi kusheshe kudlule isigameko njengoba ezoqhubeka abone ingane 'ebulele’ eyakhe idlala, kumnandi kodwa eyakhe eyingcwabile. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant Nqobile Gwala uthe amaphoyisa aseCato Manor aphenya idokodo lokufa komuntu kulandela isigameko sokugwiliza somfana (4) ngoJanuwari 30.Uthe imbangela yesigameko isaphenywa.
UCWANINGO lwakamuva lwenkampani esiza abacwile ezikweletini, luveza ukuthi abantu sebekhokha isikweletu ngesinye isikweletu.Izolo iDebt Buster, esiza abanezikweletu, ithe ekoteni yokugcina yonyaka odlule u-46% wabantu ubuvele ngekhanda ezikweletini.Labo abacwile kakhulu bahola u-R35 000 kuya phezulu njengoba bekhokhela izindlu, izimoto, ama-credit card nezinye izikweletu.UMnuz Banay Sagers, oyisikhulu esiphezulu seDebt Busters, uthe bathola ukuthi abacwile ezikweletini bafike bahole bese beboleka enye imali yokuthenga igilosa.Uthe lokhu kudalwa yimali mboleko enyuka umlibe, wukubiza kwezinga lokuphila kanjalo nenkinga yokunqamuka kukagesi."Into esiyitholile wukuthi imali mboleko iyayinciphisa imali yamaholo njengoba ingxenye eningi ikhokhela izindlu nezinye izikweletu. Wonke umuntu osebenzayo ngisho nabahola uR5 000 sithola ukuthi bathi behola nje babe bethatha ezinye izikweletu zokuqhuba inyanga,” kusho uSagers.Uthe isibalo sabantu abafuna usizo lwezikweletu siwu-46% kanti esabafuna usizo lokukhishwa ezikweletini online siwu-54%.Njengoba uFebhuwari uyinyanga yokuqwashisa ngezikweletu, uthe indikimba yabo ithi Financial Sustainability."Sibona sanda isibalo sabantu abafuna usizo lokuphuma ezikweletini online. Abaningi sithole ukuthi bacela usizo ngenxa yemali mboleko esiphezulu kakhulu.U-95% wabafake isicelo sokusizwa ngezikweletu sithole ukuthi une-personal loan. Lokhu kukhombisa ngokusobala ukuthi abantu baboleka imali ukuze baqhubeke nempilo,” kusho uSager.Uthe abahola uR35 000 basebenzisa u-71% womholo wabo ukukhokhela zikweletu.Ubalule ukuthi ngaphandle kokukhokhela imizi, izimoto nezikweletu zabo eziseceleni babuye banakelele imindeni yabo abahlala nayo endlini namanye amalungu omndeni ahlala kwezinye izifundazwe.USager uthe akusilo iqiniso ukuthi ukungena ngaphansi kohlelo lokusizwa ngezikweletu kumphuca amandla umthengi kodwa kuyamsiza ngokukhokhela izikweletu. Ubalule ukuthi akakwazi ukwenza isikweletu esisha uma esengaphansi kwalo kodwa uyasizakala ngoba ayikho impahla yakhe emlahlekelayo.
UTHATHWE amaphoyisa ayomhlohla imibuzo omunye wabasebenzi bakaMasipala waseNdumeni, eDundee emuva kokuthi kubanjwe inkunzi kwathathwa uR97 000. UMasipala waseNdumeni wehlelwe wumshophi kwafika abalisa ababophe umqaphi bangena bashaqa imali.Isolezwe Ngempelasonto, lakwabo kwaleli, libike kabanzi ngempelasonto ngalolu daba. UMasipala waseNdumeni uphethwe yi-IFP ngokubambisana ne-DA emuva kokuthi bewephuce i-ANC emuva kokhetho ngo-2021.Kuvele ukuthi umsolwa wokuqala ufike wazenza umsebenzi, ethi kukhona afuna ukuyokuthatha ngaphakathi, nokuthe uma emvulela umqaphi wase emjikela wamkhomba ngesibhamu.Kuthe uma emkhomba, kwavumbuka abanye base bengena baqonda esisefweni semali basisika bakhala bemuka nayo. Kuthiwa imali ebibekwe emahhovisi omkhandlu isuke iphuma kubantu bekhokhela izidingo ezehlukene kanti ibilinde ukuyofakwa ebhange.Umthombo weSolezwe uthe kunomsebenzi othathwe amaphoyisa ayomphosa imibuzo kodwa ngesikhathi elandwa bekungaziwa noma uyaboshwa."Amaphoyisa amthathile ukuze axoxe naye afake imibuzo efuna ukuzwa kahle ukuthi yikuphi akwaziyo. Cha, akaboshwanga ngoba abuye amdedela. Sengathi yinto ejwayelekile ukuthi amaphoyisa amthathe umuntu amphenye ambuyise,’’ kusho umthombo osondelene nodaba.IMenenja kaMasipala, uMnuz Sithembiso Ntombela, uthe uwutholile umbiko ngokuthathwa komunye wabasebenzi."Ngosuku olulandela olwesigameko, amaphoyisa athathe umsebenzi kodwa sizolinda uphenyo luveze ukuthi kwenzekani,’’ kusho uNtombela.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uLieutenant-Colonel Nqobile Gwala uthe bayalwazi udaba lwaseNdumeni. Uthe amaphoyisa aphenya icala lokubamba inkunzi futhi uphenyo lusaqhubeka. Akafunanga ukuyikhuluma eyokuthathwa komsebenzi ephoswa imbuzo.
OWESILISA osolwa ngokushaya abulale umfana wakhe ngoba "elaya” unina utshele inkantolo ukuthi uzoliphika icala uma seliqulwa.Umsolwa uthe ingane yawa ngokwayo yashayeka ngesiphongo etsheni yashona.UMnuz Siyabonga Innocent Shezi (28), ogqunywe ejele emuva kokunqatshelwa ibheyili, ubekade evele eNkantolo yesiFunda yasePinetown.Ubekwe icala lokubulala uSifundo Sibisi (8) ngoJanuwari 13, 2023 eNtshongweni, eThekwini.Umufi wayephasele uGrade 4 esikoleni samabanga aphansi, Umthala Primary, KwaNdengezi.UShezi, okhulume ngomlomo wommeli wakhe wamahhala, uMnuz P Dlamini, utshele iMantshi uJ Goorie ukuthi uzoliphika icala uma seliqulwa ngoMeyi nonyaka."(Umsolwa) Ungitshele ukuthi uzoliphika icala bese ebeka isizathu esithi umufi waziwela ngokwakhe washayeka phansi ngesiphongo etsheni washona,” kusho uDlamini.Izolo kwenziwe izethulo ezindlalela ukuqala kokuqulwa kwecala okuzoba ngoMeyi 21.Kulowo mnyama uDlamini utshele inkantolo ukuthi uShezi uzofaka isicelo sebheyili kabusha.Imantshi ithe isicelo sebheyili sizolalelwa yimantshi eyanqabela uShezi ibheyili ekuqaleni ngesikhathi kusalindwe usuku lwecala.UMshushisi u-Andre De Nysschen uthi uMbuso usola uShezi ngokuthatha uSfundo kubo kwanina KwaNdengezi, wahamba naye waya ehlathini, wafike wamshaya maqede wamklinya wafa.Kuthiwa uShezi wabe esefonela unina wengane yakhe, uNksz Nonhlanhla Sibisi, abase behlukene, wamtshela ukuthi useyibulele, akaphuthume ehlathini eliseNtshongweni ayolanda isidumbu sayo singaze sidliwe yizilwane.Kubekwe izinsuku ezimbili okuzoqulwa ngazo kuqedwe leli cala. UMbuso uzogadla ngofakazi abayisithupha kubalwa nonina kamufi. UDlamini uthe uzobiza uShezi ethule ubufakazi.UDlamini uthe kungenzeka uShezi abuphonsele inselelo ubufakazi boMbuso lapho kuthiwa wagonyuluka khona evuma icala.Kuthiwa uShezi waboshwa kubo ngamaphoyisa ngosuku okwatholakala ngalo isidumbu.Ngaphandle kwenkantolo uNksz Sibisi uthe akumphathi kahle ukuthi uShezi ufuna ibheyili ngoba lokho kubeka impilo yakhe engcupheni."Uma inkantolo imnikeza ibheyili kuyobe iyamthuma ukuthi akeze azobulala mina. Watshela umphenyi wecala ukuthi uma engaphuma uzoqhubeka lapho ayekade egcine khona. Wayekuhlosile akwenza ngoba wathi uqaqa mina. Ngihlukumezekile ngokwenzeka,” kusho uNksz Sibisi ehlengezela izinyembezi.Ukhale ngoShezi wathi uyafona esejele amcele ukuthi amthengele ugwayi ne-voucher. Uthe nangesonto eledlule uphinde wafona wangayibamba ifoni. Ufona nje uShezi inkantolo yayikade ikhiphe umyalelo othi angaxhumani noNksz Shezi.
INKANTOLO yamaCala aDlulisiwe eseBlomfontein isinqumele ugwayi katiki inkampani iVodacom ukuthi zingapheli izinsuku ezingu-30 ingaqhamukanga nemali entsha ezoyikhokhela umsunguli wePlease Call Me, uNkosana Makate.Lokhu kuza emva kokuba inkantolo ichithe u-R47 million iVodacom eyayithe ingakwazi ukuwukhokhela uMakate ngoPlease Call Me.IVodacom iphinde yahlangabezana nenhlanakezela njengoba kuthiwe kuzomele ukhokhele izindleko zokudluliswa kwecala, ikhokhele nabameli abebehlalele udaba.Umbango phakathi kukaMakate neVodacom usuqede iminyaka engu-15 ngenxa yokuthi ummangali ubekhala ngokuthi le nkampani ifuna ukumnika amakinati ngomsebenzi wakhe.UMakate kuthiwa waqhamuka nalo mqondo wePlease Call Me ngesikhathi eseyi-Accountant esaqeqeshwa yiVodacom ngo-2000. Kulapho waqala khona lo mbango njengoba wayefuna ukukhokhelwa ngomqondo wakhe. Ngo-2016 iNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo yamkhipha phambili uMakate ngesimangalo sakhe, yanxusa iVodacom ukuthi ixoxe naye ngesinxephezelo esingamgculisa. IVodacom yaphakamisa u-R47 million kodwa uMakate wayichitha leyo mali. Wathi ufuna ukunika u-R9 billion. INkantolo eNkulu yasePitoli nayo yavumelana naye uMakate ukuthi leyo mali yincane. Yabe isithatha udaba yalubuyisela kuyona iVodacom ukuthi iqhamuke nesinye isiphakamiso. Udaba lukaMakate selwake lwaba ngundabamlonyeni nasezinkundleni zokuxhuma njengoba kukhona ababethi uMakate akabongi. Bethi kumele ngabe uyawuthatha u-R47 million. Baze bathi isenzo sakhe sikhombisa ukuba ngugombela-kwesakhe.
LIGAYA ngomunye umhlathi ePhalamende nonyaka ngoba kunemigomo emisha ezovimba ukuphazamiseka kwenkulumo kaMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, ebhekiswe esizweni.Imigomo emisha izoqala ukusebenza kusasa uma uRamaphosa esethula inkulumo yokugcina ayibhekise esizweni njengoba kuzoba nokhetho lukazwelonke. Inhloso yemigomo wukuthi inqande abazophazamisa umengameli okuyinto esiphenduke insakavukela. Sekufana nesiko ukuthi iqembu i-EFF liphazamise inkulumo kamengameli njengoba yenza kuRamaphosa kanti phambilini bebekwenza kusahola uMnuz Jacob Zuma.USomlomo wePhalamende uNkk Nosiviwe Mapisa-Nqakula, esithangamini sabezindaba izolo, udalule ukuthi inhloso yemigomo emisha wukuthi kungaphazanyiswa inkulumo uma kuhleli izindlu zombili zePhalamende, okubalwa neyoMkhandlu wezifundazwe.Uveze ukuthi imigomo izokwenza kube nozinzo, nesithunzi ePhalamende."Ngokwemigomo alikho ilungu elinemvume yokuphazamisa umengameli uma esethula inkulumo ayibhekise esizweni. Le migomo ibalula nokuthi akumele kube nezinto ezizodingidwa ngaphandle kwenkulumo kamengameli uma kuhleli izindlu zombili. Sethemba ukuthi izohlonishwa imigomo ibuyise nesithunzi sePhalamende.” USihlalo wendlu yoMkhandlu wezifundazwe uMnuz Amos Masondo, uthe imigomo ayibhekisiwe kuphela kwi-EFF."Le migomo ayibhekisiwe eqenjini elithile kuphela kodwa eyawo wonke ePhalamende. Sethemba ukuthi imigomo izolandelwa, ihlonishwe.” INkantolo eNkulu eWestern Cape izolo, iyichithile i-EFF ebifake isicelo esiphuthumayo sokuthi kuvunyelwe abaholi okubalwa nomengameli weqembu uMnuz Julius Malema, iphini lakhe uMnuz Floyd Shivambu, uDkt Mbuyiseni Ndlozi, unobhala jikelele uMnuz Marshall Dlamini, ukuthi babe yingxenye yenkulumo. Bamiswe isikhathi esiyinyanga ePhalamende kanti bazobanjelwa nomholo wenyanga ngokungena esijeti bephethe izingqwembe bebhikisha ngesikhathi uRamaphosa ethula inkulumo ayeyibhekise esizweni nyakenye.Kuvele ukuthi kubekwe uR6.5 milllion wokuvulwa kwePhalamende nenkulumo kaRamaphosa. Eminyakeni edlule bekubekwa uR5 million womcimbi.Kuvele ukuthi kumenywe nababengomengameli bezwe oMnuz Thabo Mbeki, Kgalema Montlanthe noJacob Zuma.Kubheke uZuma ongakaze alibeke selokhu uRamaphosa athatha izintambo.Abanye ababhekiwe kubalwa uMnuz David Mabuza, owayeyiphini likamengameli wezwe, owayenguSomlomo wePhalamende uNksz Baleka Mbete, owayeyiphini likamengameli uNkk Phumzile Mlambo-Ngcuka nezinye izimenywa.
UMMANGALELWA wokuqala ecaleni lokufa kukaSenzo Meyiwa, uMuzikawukhulelwa Sibiya, ubize amaphoyisa ngezilwane ezingenandaba nempilo yomuntu. USibiya ubephekwa ngemibuzo nguMshushisi woMbuso u-Advocate Ronnie Sibanda. UMeyiwa owayeyisilomo se-Orlando Pirates neBafana Bafana, wadutshulwa wabulawa ekubo kwentombi yakhe uKelly Khumalo, eVosloorus, eGauteng ngo-2014. Kushushiswa abalisa abahlanu okusolwa ukuthi yibona abaqeda ngoMeyiwa ngobusuku besigameko. UMbuso umile ekutheni abalisa abahlanu abashushiswayo bayizinkabi ezaqashwa ukuthi ziyise uMeyiwa kwagoqanyawo.Kumanje icala lisesigabeni lapho kubangwa ukuthi izitatimende zabamangalewa zokuvuma amacala kufanele yini zemukelwe njengobufakazi enkantolo. Abameli bagibeze uSibiya ebhokisini wethula ubufakazi wase ephoswa imibuzo.Izolo uSibiya uthe indlela ayehlukunyezwa ngayo amaphoyisa wagcina esayina izitatimende evuma icala ngoba esaba ukuthi angagcina ephangalala. USibiya uthe amaphoyisa ayenesihluku engamazi noma ungumuntu."Uma amaphoyisa amaningi ekubopha kungekho nelilodwa elizwelana nawe, labo bantu bayizilwane. Ngiyawesaba amaphoyisa, kungcono uma ngiphambi kwenkantolo angiwasabi. Uma ngihamba namaphoyisa asejele futhi angiwesabi ngoba ngeke angenze lutho,’’ kusho uSibiya.Uthe indlela ayemhlukumeza ngayo wayephenduka inkomo esengwa yiviyo futhi amaphoyisa ememana azomhlanganyela. Uthe wayeshawa ngisho amaphoyisa ophiko olukhethekile aziwa ngamabherethi."Kwake kwafika nalawo okuthiwa yi-TRT nawo angihlukumeza. Ngaze ngacela ukuyiswa ejele ngisuswe ezitokisini zamaphoyisa ukuze angabe esangithola. Hhayi ! impela amaphoyisa angihlukumeze kakhulu,’’ kusho uSibiya.Uthe amaphoyisa ayemthatha ngezimoto amntantise ehla, enyuka naye ehamba emshaya ethi akakhulume ukuthi wazini ngokufa kukaMeyiwa.Okunye kuqaphelekile wukuthi bezilokhu ziqhubeka nokushayisana izinkulumo zikaSibiya, nommeli wakhe u-Advocate Thulani Mngomezulu. Uma uSibiya ebuzwa ngokuphambana kwezinkulumo ubevele athi ngeke akhulumele uMngomezulu, ucela inkantolo izwe lokhu akushoyo.Uthe ngesikhathi ekhuluma nommeli wakhe wayebuye angamtsheli okunye ngoba wayazi ukuthi usazonikwa ithuba azikhulumele konke okwenzeka.Icala liguqele ukuthi libuyele namuhla enkantolo uMbuso uqhubeke nokupheka uSibiya ngemibuzo.
BANYELWE yinyoni esandleni abafundi baKwaDukuza abangu-106 abakhokhelwe imali yokubhalisa ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme bekhokhelwa umasipala wakule ndawo.Lokhu kwenzeke emcimbini omkhulu obuwethiwe elokuthi yiKwaDukuza 2024Tertiary Financial Assistance obukade uKwaDukuza Town Hall.UNkk Lindiwe Nhaca oyiMeya yakule ndawo uthe lolu hlelo luqondene kakhulu nalabo bafundi abebefunda umatric kodwa abavela emindenini ehlwempu."Iqiniso ukuthi kunabantwana abaphumelele umatric kodwa ababhekene nenkinga yokuthi abanayo imali yokubhalisa. Yilapho ke thina esingenelela khona,''usho kanje.Uveze ukuthi imali ebekelwe lokhu ingu-R840 000 seyiyonke. "Sikholwa ukuthi le mali izokwenza umehluko omkhulu kubafundi bakule ndawo. Asiyikhiphi ingukheshi le mali kodwa siyokhokha kuleso sikhungo umfundi asuke esethathiwe kusona ngokugcwele,''echaza.Uthe KwaDukuza bakholelwa kakhulu ekutheni kumele ibekwe eqhulwini ngaso sonke isikhathi imfundo.Ubadonse ngendlebe bonke abafundi abaya emanyuvesi ukuba bangadidiswa yizinto abazifica phambili baze bakhohlwe ukuthi bavela emakhaya anjani.Eqhuba uMeya uthe isifunda iLembe basishayela elikhulu ihlombe ngenxa yokuthi imiphumela yakhona kamatric ibe mihle kakhulu.USfundo Mthembu obenza umatric eGroutiville High School nobashaye bonke emakhanda kwisiFunda iLembe, ubonge kakhulu ukuthola lolu xhaso.Uthe bazizwa bekhuthazekile kakhulu bonke ngalolu xhaso abalutholayo lokubhalisela ukufunda.UNhaca ukhulume nangohlelo olubizwa ngokuthi yiDress a Child Compaign abalwenza ngokumbisana nebhange lakwa-Absa.Ngalo lolu suku kube nabafundi bezikole ezahlukene abathengelwe izicathulo nomfaniswano wesikole."Ngalolu hlelo sihlose ukuthi sibalekelele ngomfaniswano wesikole abafundi abaningi abavela emindenini entulayo,''kuchaza uNkk Nhaca.
UNDUNANKULU kaZulu omusha, uMfundisi Thulasizwe Buthelezi, uthi inhlanzi ishelwe ngamanzi kwababize ngamankentshane asebenzisa igama leSilo ukukhwahla abantu. UButhelezi usho lokhu exoxa neSolezwe ngemuva kwesithangami sabezindaba eThekwini, izolo. Bekungokokuqala uMfu Buthelezi ebiza abezindaba okokuqala kulandela ukuqokelwa kwakhe esikhundleni esihlonishwayo kwaZulu, esisondele eduze kweSilo.UButhelezi obuye abe yiMeya yaseZululand, uqokelwe esikhundleni sikaNdunankulu kaZulu ngenyanga edlule, emcimbini wokukhumbula iMpi yaseSandlwana. Ungena esikhundleni ebesiphethwe Inkosi Mangosuthu Buthelezi ongasekho, ophathe umsebenzi iminyaka ecela kwengu-70.Isikhundla sikandunankulu kaZulu sinomlando kwaButhelezi njengoba sake saphathwa ngezinye izingwevu zakhona esezalala.UMfu Buthelezi umenyezelwe yiSilo uMisuzulu kaZwelithini, esiqoke Inkosi Phathisizwe Chiliza ukuba yiPhini likaNdunankulu kaZulu. UChiliza ubesondelene kakhulu neSilo esabuza uZwelithini kaBhekuzulu.UMfu Buthelezi uthe iSilo esibusayo sikhalile ngokuthi kukhona abantu abasebenzisa igama leSihlalo sikaZulu ukukhonga imali ezindaweni ezehlukene."Ikhalile iNgonyama ngokuthi kunamankentshane asebenzisa uphawu lobukhosi ukuze azizuzele wona. Kunamankentshane aziveza ekhuluma egameni leSilo, akhiphe nezitatimende egameni leSilo zingaphumi kuso. INgonyama ingithumile ukuthi konke okuphumayo kudlule ehhovisi lami, ngikucubungule ukuthi kufanele yini,’’ kusho uButhelezi.Esitatimendeni sakhe sabezindaba uButhelezi, uthe kukhona ngisho ababuye bakokotele uphawu lokusayina lweSilo ngoba befuna ukufeza izinhloso zabo.UNDUNANKULU kaZulu uMfundisi uThulasizwe Buthelezi ekhuluma nabezindaba izolo eThekwini Isithombe: SIBONELO NGCOBO/INDEPENDENT MEDIAUShenge ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba umemezele izinhlelo ezikhona zeNdlulamithi. "UKUKLASANA" kwabafundi ngaphakathi esikoleni kuphethe ngokuphuma kwesidumbu empini okuthiwa iqubuke esikoleni iBrookdale Secondary, ePhoenix, ngoLwesihlanu. Umfundi ogwazwe wabulawa uSiyabonga Mngomezulu (16) waseMawoti obefunda uGrade 10 kulesi sikole. Kuthiwa uhlanganyelwe abangamabhobhodleyana njengaye kodwa abafunda uGrade 8 ngemuva kwengxabano ebisuke ngaphakathi esikoleni. Ababonile bathi kube nothuthuva phakathu kukaSiyabonga nalaba bafundi bakwa-Grade 8, wabehlula ngezikhathi zasekuseni. Kusolwa ukuthi laba ababili babe sebedudana nabanye, okuthiwa abafana nabo abahlala khona eMawoti, bakha icebo lokuhlasela umufi uma sekuphume isikole.Ilungu lomndeni elicele ukungadalulwa lithe abanye abafundi bashilo ukuthi impi, okungaqondakali ukuthi ibimayelana nani, iqale phakathi esikoleni ngesifundo sesithathu.Liqhube lathi emva kokubashaya abehlule bobabili, uzitshele ukuthi isidlulile."Kugcine kuvela ukuthi ibingaphelile njengoba ngokuphuma kwesikole, bamhlanganyele nabangani babo ngaphandle kwesango lesikole, bamshaya, omunye wabo wamgwaza ephindelela,” kusho ilungu.Kuthiwa amanxeba abegcwele umzimba wonke kuSiyabonga, washonela esibhedlela ngoMgqibelo.Siqhuba isihlobo sikaSiyabonga, sithe kubaphathe kabi ukuthi umufi angalanyulelwa ngisho onogada besikole esigamekweni abathi esenzeke phambi kwabo."Nakho ukuthi abulawe ngesikhali. Kusobala ukuthi besivele singaphakathi egcekeni lesikole,” kusho ilungu.Isihlobo sithe ngesikhathi bebuza othisha, bathe ngokujwayelekile abafundi bayaseshwa njalo kodwa ngosuku lwesigameko uGrade 8 no-Grade 9 awuseshwanga."Bathe abacabanganga ukuthi ukhona kubona ongaphatha isikhali ngoba basebancane kodwa okubuhlungu ukuthi umbulali uphume khona kwa-Grade 8,” kusho ilungu.Lithe kuhambe omunye umfundi wangakubo (eMawoti), waze wayofika kubona, ezobika ukuthi uSiyabonga usegwaziwe abaphuthume esikoleni, engekho omsukumelayo nomhambisa esibhedlela."Sithe sifika, kwathiwa siphambana naye uthisha okuyima emphuthumisa emtholampilo,” kusho ilungu.Umufi ushonele esibhedlela iDkt Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial KwaMashu.Ilungu lithe eminyakeni edlule abasolwa abafanayo bake bazama ukuphuca umufi amakhadi okudlala ekade eye esitolo sendawo, wabashaya waze wabayeka sebemkhiphele ummese. Ngaleso sikhathi kuthiwa bathi 'ayiphelile’. Ilungu lomndeni lithe ngaleso sikhathi kwakungakafundwa ndawonye.Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Muzi Mahlambi, uthe basalihlaba namanje ikhwelo kubazali lokuthi abaziqaphele izingane zabo ukuthi ziphuma ziphetheni uma ziya ezikoleni. "Umfundi isikhali usuka naso ekhaya eze naso esikoleni,” kusho uMahlambi. Uthe kulesi sigameko bayazwelana kakhulu nomndeni womfundi obulewe, wathi balindele ukuthi amaphoyisa asebenze abophe umfundi owenze isigameko.Uqhube wathi uyazwelana futhi nomndeni womsolwa ngoba akekho umzali othuma ingane ukuba iyobulala enye esikoleni. Uphiko lwezokuxhumana emaphoyiseni luthe akuveli lutho emaphoyiseni asePhoenix ngesigameko, kodwa lwathi luzosithinta isiteshi sasePhoenix.

Bebelokhu bengibuza bethi kanti kuvotwa nini?,” kusho uRamaphosa.URamaphosa uthe njengoba ezolumemezela maduze usuku okuzovotwa ngalo, wonke umuntu uzojabula.Uthe ukuzwa emakhaleni ukunqoba kwe-ANC athe izothola ngaphezulu kuka-50% wamavoti iqhubeke iphathe.Izolo uRamaphosa ubekade eseMamelodi ePitoli wathi ukungcola nokuxhutha akubone khona kuyamangaza.Ukhale ngeDA ehola uhulumeni ophethe uMasipala iTshwane, wathi ihlezi izishaya isifuba ithi lapho iphethe khona kuhle futhi iyazihambisa izidingo kubantu kodwa akukho okukhombisa lokho eMamelodi.URamaphosa uthe udaba ngezinkinga zamanzi komasipala seluphethwe uhulumeni kazwelonke ngaphansi kukaNgqongqoshe waManzi nokuThuthwa kweNdle, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu.Umengameli uzokwethula inkulumo ayibhekise esizweni ngoLwesine ehholo eCity Hall, eCape Town eyiPhalamende lesikhashana ngo-7 ebusuku.Umholi weDA, uMnuz John Steenhuisen, uphonselele inselelo uRamaphosa wathi akamemezele usuku lokhetho ngokushesha.Uthe iDA ilulungele ukhetho futhi konke kumi ngomumo ngisho kungathiwa kuvotwa kusasa banganqoba.UMengameli we-IFP, uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa, obenxenxa abantu ukuthi babhalisele ukuvota eNdwedwe izolo, ukhale ngokuthi abantu sebedikibele ngenxa yezethembiso ezenziwa uhulumeni angazifezi.UMnuz Julius Malema, ongumholi we-EFF, uphoqe uRamaphosa ukuthi amemezele usuku lokhetho, athe wusuku izwe elizomkhipha ngalo ezintanjeni.

Babethi ngingumthakathi futhi ngiyazitshela ngoba izingane zami zifunda ezikoleni ezizimele. Sebedelile ukungishaya babethi sebeyihlabile inkomo yabo." KULINDELEKE ukuthi avele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseKrugersdorp ngoMsombuluko owesilisa oboshelwe icala lokushayela budedengu ngezinsolo zokuphazamisa ujenga lwezimoto zezicukuthwane, ngasesikhumulweni sezindiza iLanseria ngeSonto ekuseni.Owesilisa oneminyaka engu-57 kuthiwa uxwayiswe ngamaphoyisa omgwaqo naweSAPS abephelezela izicukuthwane ngokuthi angasondeli ojengeni lwezimoto kodwa wawaziba."Uzame ukujoyiya ujenga futhi ngesikhathi esezama okwesithathu, amaphoyisa ammisile ambopha,” kusho uBrigadier Athlenda Mathe, okhulumela amaphoyisa kuzwelonke.Uthe ngokomthetho iNational Road Traffic Act, izimoto ezibhanyaza amalambu aluhlaza zinelungelo lokudlula uma kuphephile futhi abashayeli bagqugquzelwa ukuthi bazinike indlela.Ukhumbuze abantu ukuthi izimoto ezinelungelo lokuba namalambu aluhlaza ngezamaphoyisa eSAPS, amaphoyisa kamasipala, awomgwaqo namaphoyisa amasosha.Uthe umphakathi uzoba necala uma utholakala usebenzisa amalambu aluhlaza.
UPHELE kabi umjolo wesalukazi esineminyaka engu-68 sibulawa yisoka ngesitini.Ngokombiko wamaphoyisa, umufi ubelele endlini yakhe eRamotshinyadi, eMopani District, eLimpopo, ngesikhathi kufika isoka lakhe ngabo-4 ekuseni ngeSonto.Kuthiwa kuqale ingxabano phakathi kwalaba bobabili isoka labe selilanda isitini lashaya isalukazi saquleka."Kubizwe abezimo eziphuthumayo abafike kulo muzi bazama ukwelapha owesifazane. UKUNYUKA kwezinga lokuphasa kukhuphule ithemba ngobungcono bempilo eMsinga ebidume ngezigameko zodlame.Lokhu kuvele ngesikhathi kuklonyeliswa izikole ezenze kahle kuMatric wango-2023, iMsinga Matric Excellence Awards ngoLwesihlanu.INkosi Ngangendlovu Mchunu yasemaChunwuni, ithe okwenziwa yizikole zakule ndawo kubenza baziqhenye bengamakhosi ukuthi uMsinga ngeke usabukelwa phansi."Phambilini uma kucatshangwa uMsinga, abantu bebezibonela indawo yempi. Ayikho into ebikhulunywa ngaphandle kokuthi kuyaliwa, kufe nabantu kungekho okuhle esingakhuluma ngakho. Manje sibona kuguquka konke lokho njengoba kunezikole ezenza kahle ngalolu hlobo eMsinga. Yize zidonsa kanzima ngenxa yokushoda ngezinsiza kodwa ziyaqhubeka, okwenza siziqhenye ngezemfundo eMsinga. Siyabonga nakothisha ngokuzimisela kwabo ukuthi izikole zikhiqize imiphumela emihle ngalolu hlobo," kusho iNkosi uMchunu.Ukuklonyeliswa kwabafundi baka-matric kuqale ngo-2017 eMsinga. Uhlelo lokuklomelisa abafundi nezikole ezenze kahle lwasungulwa wuMasipala waseMsinga noMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, ngengenhloso yokugqugquzela imfundo endaweni eyayidume kabi ngempi yezigodi.Kusuka lwaqala uhlelo lubukeka luthela izithelo njengoba elokhu enyukile amaphesenti okuphasa endaweni.Kulokhu izikole zasendaweni ziphase ngo-87% okuyisibalo esiphezulu uma kuqhathaniswa neminyaka edlule, okwaqala ngayo ukuklonyeliswa kwabafundi nezikole.Ngisho nezikole zendawo nabafundi sezihlala zisemqhudelwaneni wokwenza kahle, ukuze zibeke uMsinga ebalazweni nokuthi zigqame kule ndawo. IMacingwane High isalokhu iziholile kusuka lwaqala uhlelo lokuklonyeliswa kwezikole ngokuba nemiphumela emihle ukuzidlula zonke. Okuphinde kujabulise ngalesi sikole wukuthi uthishanhloko, uMnuz Sizwayinkosi Dlamini osiphethe ungomncane kunabo bonke ezikoleni zendawo futhi udabuka khona eMsinga.IMeya yaseMsinga, uDkt Felinkosi Sikhakhane, ithe izikole zaseMsinga zibanika ithemba ngendlela ezenza ngayo kwezemfundo."Indlela ezenza ngayo izikole zaseMsinga zenza sisho ngokungahlonizi ukuthi silindele u-90% emiphumeleni ka-matric ka-2024. Ukunyuka kwamaphesenti okuphasa kule ndawo kuyinkomba yokuthi izikole zizimisele ngezemfundo. Sizoqhubeka nokuzeseka ngayo yonke indlela ukuze uMsinga ugqame ngezemfundo. Nabebeyibukela phansi le ndawo, sifuna babone ukuthi akusenjengakuqala," kusho uDkt Sikhakhane.Umfundi waseMsinga High, uMvelo Phungula othole o-distinction abayisithupha ku-matric ka-2023, uthe okumjabulisa kakhulu wukuthi uyabona ukuthi amaphupho akhe azofezeka. Uthe usemukelwe ukuyofundela ubudokotela eStellenbotch University.UMsinga High lapho bekufunda khona uMvelo ungesinye sezikole ebesisalele kakhulu ngemiphumela ka-matric, obekwenza sibe yihlaya endaweni kodwa muva nje naso sigila izimanga ngokuphasa.Izikole nabafundi baklonyeliswe ngezindondo, izitifiketi, zanikwa nezipho okungama-laptop, isichazamagama, ama-pverhead projector namasheke okuthenga izincwadi zesikole.
KUSINDE ingane eneminyaka eyishumi nenye eyenza u-matric ngesikhathi kugasela abesilisa abangaziwa emndenini wakwaManqele eHluhluwe ngesonto eledlule.Laba bafike badubula, bagenca baphinde bashisa umama wekhaya nendodakazi yakhe ngoLwesithathu ebusuku.Lesi sigameko senzeke esigodini saseMagodlanduku, nala kungacaci ukuthi imbangela yaso yini.UNkk Sarafina Manqele nendodakazi ebinguthisha eBhokloza Primary eMtubatuba, uMabusi Manqele, batholwe sebengumlotha.ABEPHUMA engena amalungu omphakathi aseHluhluwe emndenini wakwaManqele la kubulawe khona abesifazane ababili abadutshulwe amadoda angaziwa ngoLwesithathu ebusuku. Imeya yaseMkhanyakude uMnuz Siphile Mdaka ihambele lo mndeni iyokhalisana nawo nala isigxeke khona lesi sigameko yathi sihambisana nokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane IZITHOMBE: ZITHUNYELWEOkhulumela umndeni, uMnuz Bhekingozi Manqele, uveze ukuthi umsindo wezibhamu awuzwa ngalobo busuku ngeke awukhohlwe."Ebusuku sisahleli nje, kwangena umfana wakwamakhelwane nezicabha, wathi silibele ukubanga umsindo ngomsakazo umama wakwaManqele uyadutshulwa ekhaya ngezansi nezingane. Kula nathi siphume khona, uma sithi siyasondela ekhaya isibhamu siyakhala sangakwazi ukufinyelela khona. Sithe sisalalele, sezwa iphimbo lowesifazane ekhala ethi 'kodwa ngomama’."Ngemuva kwalokho, lona wesifazane bamthukile bathi 'thula wena sebe’."Ukukhala kwakhe naye kwase kunqamuka ngemuva kokuthi isibhamu silokhu siqhumile,” kusho uManqele.Uthe ngemuva kwesikhathi babone sekuqubuka intuthu kwase kuba nelangabi."Isibhamu bese sithule, sase siyasondela. Akukho ebesesingakwenza. Nabanye abantu bese bekhona. Abanye omakhelwane basitshele ukuthi ingane eneminyaka eyishumi ingeke emizini yabo igijima ithukile, idubulekile engalweni inuka nophethiloli, nokusicacele ukuthi iphume ngesamagundane yabaleka. Ibuhlungu kakhulu le nto esehlele. Asazi ngempela ukuthi isizathu salokhu yini. Siyazibuza kodwa sizoshiyela emaphoyiseni,” kuchaza yena.Uthe umfanyana olimele uphuthunyiswe emtholampilo wase edluliselwa esibhedlela.IMeya yaseMkhanyakude, uMnuz Siphile Mdaka, isigxeke kakhulu lesi sigameko yathi badabukile futhi bayazwelana nomdeni wakwaManqele."Lokhu kuyahambisana nokuhlukunyezwa kwabantu besifazane. Sifuna ukuthi sisebenze namaphoyisa ukuthi kubanjwe laba njengoba bengabantu abahlukumezayo emphakathini. Lobu wubugebengu okumele umphakathi ubambisane ngakho ukuze kuliwe nabo. Siyanxusa ezikhulwini zamaphoyisa kuzwelonke nala esifundazweni ukuthi babambe lezi zinswelaboya,” kusho uMdaka.Okhulumela amaphoyisa, uLieutenant Colonel Nqobile Gwala, uthe kuphenywa amacala amabili okubulala, elilodwa lokuzama ukubulala nelokucekela impahla.
USIHLALO we-ANC KwaZulu- Natal, uMnuz Siboniso Duma, uhole umkhuleko wokuyocela inhlanhla ethuneni likaMongameli wokuqala wenhlangano uDkt John Dube, Ohlange, eNanda. Umkhankaso obuholwa nguDuma ubuhanjelwe nangabaholi bezenkolo abehlukene.Ithuna likaDube linomlando oqavile kwi-ANC kanti noMnuz Nelson Mandela, wavota okouqala Ohlange, waqeda wabika ethuneni likaDube ukuthi inkululeko isifikile ezweni.I-ANC isiqalile ukweshela abavoti ukuthi bayikhumbule embusweni wayo okhethweni lukazwelonke oluzoba nonyaka. Siyamncoma uDuma ukuthi ashiye konke eze lapha ezobungaza lolu suku lomkhuleko,’’ kusho uDube.
UNGEBASOLE abahleka usulu uma kukhishwa isimemezelo sokuthi izimo ezithile zizojutshelwa ukuphenywa yikhomishini eNingizimu Afrika ngoba lowo mthetho usulithuna lokungcwaba amachilo afanelwe ukubhekana nomthetho kwaphela nya. Izwe ligutshuzelwe yithombonkala ngemibiko yamakhomishini adla ezishisiwe izimali kodwa iningi lawo aseze aqaqelwa ubulwembu ezinqolobaneni zikahulumeni kungathathwa zinyathelo.Sekujwayelekile ukuthi kujutshwe ikhomishini thizeni ukuze iphenye, bese ibiza abezindaba yethule umbiko neziphakamiso emva kwalokho kuthule kuthi cwaka! Ikhomishini yophenyo ngokomthetho isuke ijutshwe ngumengameli noma ngundunankulu wesifundazwe uma kukhona udaba oluxakile futhi oludinga ukuphenywa ukuze kutholakale umnyombo walo, bese kuvezwa ikhambi.Akhona amakhomishini anjengalena eyayiholwa yiJaji u-Ian Farlam, eyayiphenya ngokuqothwa kwabasebenzi basemgodini eMarikana. Udaba lwaseMarikana, lwashiya abaningi beshaqekile emuva kokuthi amaphoyisa eqothe ngenhlamvu abasebenzi ababetelekile.Kuke kwaba khona ikhomishini eyayiphenya ngodaba lwemfundo yamahhala eyayiholwa yiJaji Jonathan Heher, eyayinikezwe umsebenzi wokubheka ukuthi ingalunga yini imfundo yamahhala kuleli.Maningi amanye amakhomishini ezigcawu zophenyo ake aba khona kuleli.Sekuvamisile ukuthi kube nezikhalo ngokuthi amakhomishini awasizi kakhulu kulokhu asuke ephenya ngakho ngoba imibiko yakhona iphelela emoyeni. Abantu basuke belindele ukuthi umphumela ophathekayo futhi kucace nokuthi ikhomishini leyo isiza ngani.Kuleli sonto eliphelayo kade kwethulwa umbiko weSouth African Human Rights Commission (SAHRC), ngophenyo lwayo ngezibhelu zangoJulayi 2021. Izibhelu ezashiya izingxenye zezwe ziwumlotha kukholakala ukuthi zihlobene nokuboshwa kowayengumengameli uMnuz Jacob Zuma.UZuma waboshwa ngecala lokwedelela umyalelo wenkantolo wakhonjwa ejele izinyanga eziwu-15. Kukholakala ukuthi yiwo umyalelo wenkantolo owathukuthelisa inqwaba yabantu, yavuka umbhejezana. Ngokusho kwabe-SAHRC kabukho ubufakazi obukhomba ukuthi izibhelu zazihlobene nokuboshwa kukaZuma.Uphenyo lwe-SAHRC lwelama inqwaba yamanye amakhomishi ake aba khona ezweni ngezigameko ezahlukene. Ikhomishini esakhumbuleka kakhulu yileyo ephenya ukuwulawulwa koMbuso yidlanzana ebiholwa yiJaji Raymond Zondo.Ikhomishini kaZondo yadonsa isikhathi eside kakhulu futhi yayinikwe umsebenzi obanzi wokuphenya ngenkohlakalo nokunye okujulile. Ukuqhutshwa kwekhomishini kwadla izigidigidi zemali yabakhokhi bentela futhi umbiko wayo wethulwa kuMengameli wezwe uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa.Umbiko kaZondo wawunenqwaba yeziphakamiso okwakufanele uhulumeni azilandele ukuze kulungiswe isimo nomonakalo okwakuthiwa udalwe yinkohlakalo yedlanzana. UMengameli qobo lwakhe wabizwa kule khomishini wethula ubufakazi bakhe futhi wazibophezela ekutheni uzosebenzisana nekhomishini.IJaji uZondo lisanda kuphumela obala libhoka ngokuthi lethula umbiko kodwa awukho umnyakazo eliwubonayo wokuzama ukusebenzisa iziphakamiso ezisembikweni walo. Isikhalo sikaZondo sasusa omkhulu umsindo i-ANC ikhala ngokuthi ubelesela yona nohulumeni.Ngaphandle kwekhomishini kaZondo, umengameli wezwe waqoka ithimba lakhe lezazi ukuthi lizame ukuthola kabanzi ukuthi kwenzekeni kuze kushe izwe. URamaphosa wawuthola umbiko wethimba.Ngaphandle kwalokho iSAHRC isanda kwazisa umphakathi ngombiko wocwaningo olwenziwa ngokusweleka kwamanzi KwaZulu-Natal. Kwenziwa iziphakamiso ezithile, nakhona akwaziwa noma zilandeliwe noma zisazolandelwa.Uhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal uke wajuba uphenyo ngenkinga enkulu yokusocongwa kosopolitiki esifundazweni. U-Advocate Marumo Moerane, nethimba lakhe baphenya bawukhipha umbiko oneziphakamiso banika uhulumeni wesifundazwe.Isihlava sokubulawa kosopolitiki namanje sisaqhubeka esifundazweni futhi akwaziwa noma umbiko neziphakamiso kwasetshenziswa yini. Nalapho kwakusebenza imali yabakhokhi bentela futhi kwakunethemba lokuthi kukhona umehluko ozoba khona.Ilungu elimele i-DA ePhalamende, uNkk Dianner Kohler Barnard, lithe liyakhala ngamakhomishini abonakala engasizi ngalutho. UBarnard uthe okuthusayo ngombiko wezibhelu wakamuva ukuthi uthi abukho ubufakazi bokuthi izibhelu zazihlobene nokuboshwa kukaZuma.Uthe kushiya imibuzo ethi kanti uphenyo lwenziwe kanjani uma behlulwe ukubona into esobala kanje? Uthe kunamabhizinisi awu-40 000 nezitolo zabantu ezincane eziwu-50 000 ezangqongqishwa ngomlilo kwasala abantu abangasebenzi. Uthe umnotho wafadalala kwacwila R50 billion kodwa ekugcineni kuzothathwa izinto kancane nje kuthiwe kwakungahlobene? SIZENZE omunye wabasebenzi sakwazi ukungena esinye sezigebengu eziphange uMasipala waseNdumeni, eDundee, zathatha izishaqane zemali enguR 97 000. Isolezwe ngeMpelasonto lihletshelwe wumthombo walo ongaphakathi ukuthi kungene izigebengu kumasipala zashiya kukhalwa.Kuvele ukuthi izigebengu zigasele kulo masipala ebusuku kuleli sonto zingadle nkobe zamuntu zaqonda ngqo, emalini zashanela amabala.UMasipala waseNdumeni ozinze eDundee, usezandleni ze-IFP ewuphethe ngokubambisana neDA, abawephuca i-ANC emuva kokhetho lohulumeni basekhaya ngo-2021.Umthombo uthe kubukeka sengathi izigebengu beziyihlele kahle into yazo."Babophe umqaphi base besika isisefo bathatha imali esuke ikhokhwa abantu okungekagesi, yintela nokunye nje okukhokhelwa kumasipala. Udaba lubikiwe emaphoyiseni kodwa asazi noma yinto ehlelwe nomuntu ongaphakathi,’’ kusho umthombo.IMenenja kaMasipala, uMnuz Sithembiso Ntombela iqinisekisile ukungena kwezigebengu. UNtombela uthe kunomuntu ofike wazenza umsebenzi."Uzenze umsebenzi ozolanda ikhomphyutha, wangena wakhomba umqaphi kwasekungena abanye. Baqonde esisefweni semali bathatha imali ebalelwa kuR97 000. Udaba luphenywa amaphoyisa kukhona nobufakazi bamakhamera konke kuzocwaningwa,’’ kuchaza uNtombela.Maqondana nokugcinwa kwemali enkulu emahhovisi, uNtombela uthe ngenxa yokuhlupha kukagesi bagcina bengakwazi ukusebenza kahle izindaba zokukhokhwa kwemali. Uthe imali iyahlala ize ihambe ngakusasa iye ebhange.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu- Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda uthe amaphoyisa aphenya icala lokuphanga."Amaphoyisa aseDundee, aphenya icala lokubanjwa kwenkunzi emuva kokuthi abalisa abahlanu begasele emahhovisi kamasipala ngoLwesithathu. Umlisa wokuqala uzenze umsebenzi wase eyangena, kube sekuthushuka abanye abane babopha indoda eneminyaka engu-26 bathatha imali,’’ kusho uNetshiunda.
YIZE kunenkolelo yokuthi iwayini elibomvu liyasiza ukuthi abantu bangahlaselwa yisifo senhliziyo kodwa abanye bakhala ngokuthi libaphathisa ngekhanda.Abaphathwa yikhanda ngabantu abaliphuzela ukuphila kahle, abasuke bephuze ingilazi noma ezimbili.Ngokusho kukaMnuz Murray Hewlett, oyisikhulu esiphezulu senkampani egxile kwezempilo, i-Affirnity Health, kuningi okwenza abaphuzi bewayini elibomvu baphathwe yikhanda.Ubalule ukuthi iwayini elibomvu linama-sulfites, okuyizinongo ezisetshenziswa ekudleni ukuze kuhlale isikhathi eside."Ama-sulfites awanawo umthelela omubi kubantu kodwa kuyavela ukuthi abaphuza iwayini elibomvu baphathwa yikhanda ngenxa yokuthi maningi kakhulu kulona kunasewayinini elimhlophe. Kungaba kuhle ukuthi abantu baphuze iwayini elenziwe ngokwemvelo (organic) ngoba alifakwa ama-sulfites amaningi,” kusho uHewlett.Uveze ukuthi amanye amawayini abomvu ane-histamine, okuwumkhiqizo owenzeka ngokwemvelo ekudleni okubalwa newayini, uyasiza ekutheni umzimba ufunde ukuzivikela kodwa ngebhadi kwabanye abantu wenza umzimba usebenze kakhulu, baze baphathwe yikhanda.Uthe isikhumba samagrebhisi sinomkhiqizo obizwa nge-tannin okuyiwona owenza libukeke futhi linambitheke ngendlela elinambitheka ngayo kodwa kwabanye abantu libaphathisa ngekhanda.Ubalule ukuthi abaphuza iwayini ngoba befuna ukuphila kahle, kufanele bafunde ukuphuza amawayini ane-tannin encane, babheke amawayini abomvu angekho bomvu kakhulu (lighter red) ngoba awanayo i-tannin eningi.Uveze ukuthi okunye okudala ikhanda yi-tyramine nayo eyenzeka ekudleni, ikakhulukazi okubekwa isikhathi eside ukuze kunambitheke kahle, okubalwa iwayini, ushizi, inyama e-smoked nokunye.Uthe abaphathwa yikhanda bakhetha amawayini abomvu angenaso isikhathi eside ekhiqiziwe ngoba awanayo i-tyramine eningi.Ugqugquzele abaphuza iwayini ukuthi baphuze namanzi ngoba bonke utshwala benza umzimba ulahlekelwe ngamanzi.Wenze isibonelo ngokuthi abantu abasuke bephuzela impilo badla ukudla okunomsoco, bese bethi motho ingilazi yewayini, ehambisana nengilazi yamanzi.Uthe ukuphathwa yikhanda kwabanye abantu kungasho ukuthi banenye inkinga edinga ukuxilongwa wodokotela ukuze basizakale.
EMUVA kokubhalelwa yiSABC incwadi imxwayisa ngokuthi angabe esaqhubeka nokusebenzisa uphawu lwayo ezintweni zakhe, u-Owen Ndlovu uveze ubufakazi bokuthi unelungelo lokulusebenzisa. NgoJanuwari 12, nonyaka iSABC ibhalele uNdlovu ukuthi akayeke ukusebenzisa uphawu lwayo ezintweni zakhe ngoba akanamvume yalokho. Yathi lolu phawu olweSABC futhi lubhaliswe ngokusemthethweni ukuthi ngolwayo ngoba lukhokhelwa nayiyona. Yathi uma eqhubeka nokulusebenzisa uzobhekana nengalo yomthetho okungagcina esehlawuliswe nemali enzima. Umsindo usuke emva kokuthi uNdlovu enameke ekhasini lakhe leFacebook ukuthi iSABC Summer song iyabuya nonyaka. UNdlovu uthe usefake iSABC kwiCompetitions Commission ngodaba. Wathi unelungelo lokusebenzisa uphawu lweSABC kuze kuphele iminyaka eyishumi.Emaphepheni Isolezwe Ngempelasonto elinawo amakhophi awo, kuvela ukuthi uNdlovu usayine isivumelwano seminyaka ewu-10 neSABC sokusebenzisa uphawu lwayo. Isivumelwano sasayinwa yiSABC nenkampani kaNdlovu, iMichael Owen Productions ngo-2017. Lokhu kusho ukuthi isivumelwano abanaso sokusebenzisa uphawu sizophela ngo-2027.Ebuzwa ngalezi zindaba uNdlovu uthe basayina isivumelwano ngesikhathi bevumelana neSABC ukuthi asingathe umncintiswano weSABC Summer Song."Sangena esivumelwaneni seTrademark seminyaka ewu-10 neSABC. Saze sayobhalisa kwiCompanies And Intellectual Property Commission (CIPC) ukuthi ngikwazi ukusebenzisa uphawu lwayo. Lokho sakwenza ngenhloso yokuthi ngikwazi ukusebenzisa uphawu lwayo ngokukhululeka ngesikhathi siba nesivumelwano sokuthi inkampani yami isingathe umncintiswano weSABC Summer song. Ngokwesivumelwano kwakungukuthi inkontileka yomncintiswano iSABC Summer song izobuyekezwa ngemva kweminyaka emithile iphinde iqhubeke kodwa kwangenzeka. Inkontileka yeTrademark yona yayiseceleni ineminyaka eyishumi ezimele,” kuchaza uNdlovu.Uthe njengoba ibisimvalele ngaphandle yaze yabhala nencwadi yokuthi angalusebenzisi uphawu lwayo, izigwaze ngowayo iSABC. Yingakho ethe udaba uselufake kwiCompetitions Commission."Uma iSABC ingasadingi ukuthi ngisebenzise uphawu lwayo, kumele sibuyele emuva lapho yaqala khona ukungivalela ngaphandle yaqhubeka neSABC Summer song ngaphandle kwami. Lokho kusho ukuthi kumele ingikhokhele yonke imali eyenze kusuka ngaleso sikhathi ngalo mncintiswano. Iphinde ingikhokhele kuze kuphele inkontileka yeTrademark esinayo uma isazimisele ngokuqhubeka nawo,” usho kanje.UMmoni Seapolelo oyi-Acting Group Executive: Corporate Affairs and Marketing, kwaSABC uvele washaya ngezinqamulelayo wathi: "ISABC ayazi luthi ngalolo daba futhi beyingakatholi sikhalazo esinjalo.”
IJAJI Ratha Makgoatlheng, elihlalele icala lokubulawa kowayengunozinti we-Orlando Pirates neBafana Bafana uSenzo Meyiwa, lisole u-Advocate Zandile Mshololo ngokubambezela icala. Icala lisesigabeni lapho kubangwa ukuthi ngabe izitatimende zabamangalelwa zokuvuma icala kufanele yini zamukelwe.UMeyiwa owayeyisilomo sikanozinti wadutshulwa wabulawa ekubo kwentombi yakhe uKelly Khumalo, eVosloorus, eGauteng ngo-2014. Kushushiswa abalisa abahlanu eNkantolo eNkulu, ePitoli, kodwa bonke bayawaphika amacala ababekwe wona.UMbuso ubize uDkt Thabang Hlokwe, ongudokotela wamazinyo owaxilonga ummangalewa wesibili uBongani Ntanzi. UDkt Hlokwe uthe abaphenyi bamcela ukuthi abheke ukuthi uNtanzi ulifakile yini izinyo legolide noma wake walifaka yini phambili.UHlokwe uthe ngaphandle kokuxilonga amazinyo kodwa wahlola nesimo sakhe nje uNtanzi, efuna ukubona ukuthi unjani. Uthe akukho akubona okukhomba ukuthi wayeke washawa noma wafakwa ishubhu njengokusho kwakhe. UHlokwe wethule ubufakazi waqeda, kwavulwa ithuba lokumpheka ngemibuzo. Abameli bamphenye ngemibuzo beshintshisana kubuye kube nokuhilizisana. Iphuzu elibangwe kakhulu ngelokuthi uHlokwe wayehlanganaphi nezinye izingxenye zomzimba ngoba yena ubhekene namazinyo.UHlokwe uthwale kanzima ephendula imibuzo ehlizisana nabameli kwaze kwafika ithuba lika-Adv Mshololo. Uqale wasola uHlokwe ngokuqamba amanga ebufakazini abethulile. U-Adv Mshololo uqale wakhuzwa ngokukhaca uHlokwe, embuza sakumhlohloloza.Uqhubekile u-Adv Mshololo ebuza uHlokwe sakumqinisela iphimbo emshishibeza ngemibuzo eduze. Yilapho iJaji lingenelele khona."Uma kukhona ofuna ukukusho khuluma uqonde Nksz Mshololo ngoba lento olokhu uyenza iyabambezela. Mina ngifuna ukufinyelela esixazulweni saleli cala, lokhu okwenzayo akungisizi. Mina kufanele nginqume ukuthi izitatimende zokuvuma icala zisethethweni noma cha,’’ kubhoka iJaji.Iaji lisole abameli ngokulokhu becokofula ufakazi bembuza imibuzo ebambezelayo engabe baqonda ngqo. Belibuye libasole ngokujijimeza ufakazi, bembuza izinto asezichazile.Kulindeleke ukuthi icala libuyele enkantolo ngoMsombuluko bese abameli babamangalelwa becacisa ukuthi yini elandelayo abazoyenza.
INYUNYANA yamaphoyisa nojele income isikhwama esizolekelela ngemali yokufunda izingane zamaphoyisa ashone esemsebenzini.UMnyango wamaPhoyisa usanda kuveza ukuthi kuno-R6.6 million oqongelelwe ngenhloso yokuxhasa ngawo izingane ezishiywe ngabazali bazo abangamaphoyisa, abanye abebeyizinsika zamakhaya.Isikhwama iSouth African Police Education Trust Fund (Sapset) sixhasa abafundi kusuka kuGrade RR kuyofika emazingeni emfundo ephakeme. Kuthiwa sesixhase abafundi abangu-1 078.Kulesi sibalo abantu abangu-54 bahlomule ngeziqu, kwathi abangu-154 baphasa u-matric.Umnyango wamaphoyisa uthi awu-140 amaphoyisa abulawe esemsebenzini eminyakeni emine edlule eNingizimu Afrika.IPolice and Prisons Civil Rights Union (Popcru) ithi nakuba isishayela ihlombe lesi sinyathelo kodwa usemkhulu umsebenzi okumele wenziwe.Okhulumela iPopcru kuzwelonke, uMnuz Richard Mamabolo ukhale ngobunzima nezimo ezibucayi amaphoyisa asebenza ngaphansi kwazo, ekugcineni aholelwe utiki.Ulandise wathi awenzi lutho kangako u-R250 000 onikezwa umndeni wephoyisa elishone lisemsebenzini, waphakamisa ukuthi ikhushulwe le mali."Selokhe kwathi nhlo ayikhushulwa le mali eyaziwa ngeDeath Grant. Imindeni yabagilwa isilandisa ukuthi iba ncane le mali ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, zigcine sezidonsa kanzima izingane zamaphoyisa ashona esemsebenzini,” kusho uMamabolo.IPopcru iphakamisa ukuthi kusungulwe ekubiza ngeDanger Insurance ka-R250 000 ozonikwa umndeni wephoyisa elishone lisemsebenzini. UMamabolo uthi le mali kumele ikhishwe kanye neDeath Grant.Baphakamisa nokuthi icala lokubulawa kwephoyisa lithathwe njengelokuvukela uMbuso ngoba kusho ukubukela phansi ingalo yomthetho.UNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa kuleli, uMnuz Bheki Cele uncome umsebenzi owenziwa yisikhwama, wathi uxhaso lwemali luzokwenza umehluko empilweni yezingane zamaphoyisa asalala kobandayo.

BATHEMBISA ukusiqeda nya isiminyaminya seziqukathi nezinye izinkinga zamachweba, ababhekele ukuthuthwa kwempahla kuleli.ISouthern Africa Association of Freight Forwarders (Saaff), ithe izinkinga zamachweba nokungabi khona kwamaguzu sekuzoba yindaba endala njengoba iTransnet isisebenzisana nezinhlaka ezihlukene.Isikhulu esiphezulu seSaaff, uDkt Jaunita Maree sithe izinkinga zamaguzu bezidla u-R1 billion ngosuku obekufanele ungene emnothweni wakuleli. Izinkinga zamachweba bezilahlekisela izwe ngo-R200 million ngosuku.Uthe selokhu kwasungulwa iNational Logistics Crisis Committee, likhona ithemba lokuthi izinkinga zizoxazululeka.Ubalule ukuthi kuyimanje iTransnet izokwazi ukususa iziqukahi ezilindele ukungena echwebeni laseThekwini, ngasekupheleni kukaFebhuwari."Njengoba sisebenzisana neTransnet nezinye izinhlaka zikahulumeni, sizokwazi ukunyusa izinga lezokuThutha eNingizimu Afrika. Zizojika izinto echwebeni ngoba namaguzu ayabuya. Sizokwenza isiqiniseko ukuthi izinhlelo zokuthuthwa kwempahla zivikela imisebenzi, zihehe nabatshalizimali. Sifuna izinyunyana zingasabi ukuthi uma uhulumeni esebenzisana nosomabhizinisi kungase kuphele imisebenzi. Sonke sifuna ukuthi amachweba, amaguzu nazo zonke izinhlaka zokuthuthwa kwempahla zihambe kahle,” kusho uDkt Maree.Uthembise abantu bakuleli ukuthi benza konke okusemandleni ukuxazulula izinkinga zezokuthutha namachweba kuleli.Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze iNingizimu Afrika iqhubeke nokuba yizwe eliheha abafuna ukuhambisa impahla yabo kwamanye amazwe.Khonamanjalo uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa wethule ngokusemthethweni uhlelo lwe-Africa Continental Free Trade Area (AFCTA), echwebeni laseThekwini.NgoLwesithathu kuhambe umkhumbi osuka kuleli obheke eGhana neziqukathi eziwu-500, ezinemikhiqizo edinga ukuhlala efrijini.Le mikhiqizo ivela kuleli nakwamanye amazwe ase-Afrika eseNingizimu.UMnuz Wamkele Mene we-AFCTA, uthe lolu hlelo lubalulekile ngoba luzonyusa uhwebo phakathi kwamazwe ase-Afrika.Ubalule ukuthi balindele ukuthi lungenise u-USD 16 trillion ngo-2030 njengoba imikhiqizo yamazwe ahlukene izongena emakethe enabantu abawu-7 billion.Uthe luzokwandisa imikhumbi engena emachwebeni akuleli nemali yentela, okusho ukuthi luzokhulisa nomnotho.

Sisuke sifuna ukuthi abasebenzi bebandla bezwe ubumnandi ngokusebenzela uJehova, bajabule,’’usho kanje.Eqhuba uthe ubethulela isigqoko bonke abasebenzi bebandla aliholayo ngendlela abakhombisa ngayo ukusebenza ngokuzikhandla minyaka yonke."Iyancomeka kakhulu indlela abazinikela ngayo ekwenzeni umsebenzi kaNkulunkulu. Phakathi kokunye kwakho, uLungi uthe bacobelelana ngolwazi ngezindlela ezingcono zokuthuthukisa ibandla.Baphinde bakhumbuzane ngomgomo webandla oseqhulwini, okungukushumayela izwi likaNkulunkulu, kusindiswe nabanye abantu.Ukugcizelelile ukubaluleka kokuba ibandla lingabonakali selichezuka kwelikumele.Ngenxa yokuthi ikhempu ibonakala ithela izithelo ezinhle, uLungi uthe ngeke besayenza kanye, sebezoyenza kabili ngonyaka.Kulo nyaka ngoJuni uthe kukhona enye futhi abahlela ukuthi babe nayo.Uthembise ukuthi nakulo nyaka ibandla lizobonakala liphinde lilekelela umphakathi ngezindlela ezahlukene njengoba lijwayele ukwenza minyaka yonke.Ngomhla ka-29 kuFebhuwari ibandla lizokuba neLovers Night ngehora lesithupha ntambama, eNtos Boutique Hotel, e-15 Braemar Ave, eLa Lucia eMhlanga, ngenhloso yokukhuthaza uthando kubazalwane abaganene.
INKAMPANI yakuleli ekhiqiza amakhambi okwelapha iqale uhlelo lokuthi eminye imithi eyikhiqizayo iyibhale ngesiZulu, ukuze iziguli ezikhuluma lolu limi zifunde kahle yonke imininingwane ngemithi yazo.I-Pharma Dynamics iyinkampani yokuqala kuleli ukubhala imithi ngesiZulu.Ngokusho kukaNkk Nicole Jennings, okhulumela iPharma Dynamics, ukubhala imithi ngesiZulu kuyingxenye yemizamo yenkampani yokuhlonipha amalungelo abantu okunakekelwa kwezempilo, okuyinto uMthethosisekelo oyibheka njengebalulekile."Wonke umuntu kufanele akwazi ukuqonda ulwazi olubhalwe emithini yakhe. Akukhona nje ukulandela iseluleko sikadokotela. Amapheshana emithi anikeza ulwazi olubalulekile, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukusebenzisa imithi yabo ngokuphepha nangendlela efanele." kuchaza uNkk Jennings.Ugcizelela ukuthi lokhu akuwona nje amagama asekhasini kodwa uma abantu beqonda imiyalelo yezempilo ngolimi lwabo lwebele, maningi amathuba okuthi basebenzise imithi yabo ngendlela efanele.Uthe nakuba kubalulekile ukulalela izeluleko zikadokotela okunike imithi kodwa imibhalo emincane ebhalwe ephepheni elinamathele ebhodleleni lomuthi, ibalulekile ukuze isiguli sikwazi ukusebenzisa kahle imishanguzo yaso uma sesisekhaya."Isiguli sesizokwazi ukubuza kahle udokotela uma kukhona esingakuqondi mayelana nomuthi noma amaphilisi. Siphinde siqonde ukuthi izinto ezingezinhle ezidalwa wumuthi okusuke kubhalwe kulo ibhodlela, noma ibhokisi lamaphilisi. Lokho kuzokwenza ukuthi kugwemeke nomkhuba wokuthi iziguli zizengezele isikali ngoba zizobe sezifundile ukuthi kungenzekani uma wengeze isikali," kuchaza yena.Uqhube wathi: "Akusibo bonke abantu ezweni lethu abasazi kahle isiNgisi noma isiBhunu futhi ngeke sicabange ukuthi baqonda amagama okwelapha abhalwe ngalezi zilimi. Yingakho sibone kubalulekile ukuthi le mibhalo itholakale ngolunye ulimi lwebele olukhulunywa yingxenye enkulu yabantu bakuleli," kugcizelela uNkk Jennings.Amapheshana atholakala emikhiqizweni, okungamaphilisi noma imithi ayizinhlobo ezingu-27 asehunyushelwe esiiZulwini esuselwa kwabebhalwe ngesiNgisi noma ngesiBhunu.

KUKHUTHAZWE intsha eneminyaka ephakathi kuka-18 no-29 ukuba ibhalisele ukuvota njengoba kubukeka izithela ngabandayo.Lokhu kuvele esithangamini sabezindaba sekhomishini eyengamele ukhetho, eCenturion eGauteng ngoMgqibelo.I-Independent Electoral Commission (IEC) beyikipha izibalo ngabantu abahambele izikhungo zayo beyobhalisela ukuvota noma behlole ukuthi bayavela ohlwini labavoti.Ngale mpelasonto isemkhankasweni wezinsuku ezimbili wokunxenxa abantu ukuthi babhalisele ukuvota.Iphini lesikhulu esiphezulu kwa-IEC, uMnuz Mashego Sheburi lithe bangaphezu kuka-300 000 abantu abahambele izikhungo zabo ezibalelwa ku-23 300 ezweni.Kulesi sibalo abantu abangu-55 000 babhalisele ukuvota okokuqala ngqa. I-IEC ithi isibalo sabantu abasohlwini labavoti kuleli sengaphezu kwa-27 million."Sikhathazekile ngesibalo sentsha engabhalisile ukuvota ingakho imikhankaso yethu yokunxenxa abavoti igxile kakhulu kuyona,” kusho uSheburi.Uthe zibe mbalwa izehlakalo lapho oskhwiliphambana nobhoko bevimbe abebeyobhalisela ukuvota ngoba benezikhalo ngezinto ezithile. Uveze ukuthi i-IEC isebenza namaphoyisa ukunqanda lezehlakalo.I-IEC ithi abantu abazophuthwa ithuba lokubhalisa ngempelasonto, basengabhalisa kwisizindalwazi sayo (website) noma emahhovisini ayo lungakamenyezelwa usuku lokhethoAmaqembu ehlukene okubalwa i-ANC, DA, EFF, IFP, ActionSA aphume zinkalo zonke anxenxa abantu babhalisele ukuvotaUMengameli we-ANC, uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa ubeseSoweto eGoli lapho ethe intsha axoxisane nayo ifuna amathuba okufunda noxhaso lwemali. INYUNYANA yabasebenzi bensimbi, iNational Union of Metalworkers of South Africa (Numsa) ithi ziyaqhubeka izingxoxo zokuzama ukuhlenga imisebenzi enkampanini yensimbi i-ArcelorMittal.Ngonyaka odlule i-ArcelorMittal imemezele ukuthi izodiliza abasebenzi bayo abawu-3 500 eNewcastle, KwaZulu-Natal naseVereeniging, eGauteng.UNkk Phakamile Hlubi-Majola, okhulumela iNumsa, uthe akakwazi ukudalula okuningi kodwa angakuqinisekisa ukuthi ziyaqhubeka izingxoxo zezinyunyana ne-ArcelorMittal."Siyaxoxa ne-ArcelorMittal. Engingakusho wukuthi sesihlale nabo kabili ezingxoxweni zokudiliza. Sizama konke okusemandleni ukuhlenga imisebenzi yabantu. Okwamanje akukho okuningi engingakudalula njengoba izingxoxo zisaqhubeka,” kusho uNkk Hlubi-Majola.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi iNumsa icele ukuba uNgqongqoshe wezoHwebo, iziMboni nokuNcitisana, uMnuz Ebrahim Patel angenelele ukuze kuhlengwe imisebenzi ewu-20 000 yezinye izimboni ezizoshayeka ngokuvalwa kwe-ArcelorMittal.Kuleli sonto i-ArcelorMittal imemezele ukuthi ilindele ukuthi yehle imali eyingenisile, yathi imatasa nezingxoxo nezinhlaka ezihlukene okukhona kuzo uPatel, izinyunyana, iTransnet nabanye.Ithe ayifuni ukuphathwa ngendlela ehlukile kunaleyo okuphethwe ngayo ezinye izinkampani kodwa ifuna uhulumeni alungise izikhalo zemboni yensimbi.Mayelana nezinhlelo zokuvalwa kwezimboni eNewcastle naseVereeniging, i-ArcelorMittal ithe izobuye yenze esinye isimemezelo."Ukuhoxisa izinhlelo zokuvala imboni kudinga ukuzibophezela kwabanikazi befemu, abathengi bomkhiqizo ewenzayo, uhulumeni, izinkampani zikahulumeni nabasebenzi,” kusho i-ArcelorMittal embikweni wayo.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi le nkampani yathi iyavala ngenxa yezinkinga zikagesi, ezamaguzu athutha umkhiqizo wayo nesiminyaminya emachwebeni akuleli.
UYAZIHLANGULA uthishanhloko ngemva kwezinsolo eziqondiswe kuye ezimayelana nemali okuthiwa uyikhokhisa abafundi kungafanele.Lokhu kwenzeka emva kokuthi abanye abazali abanezingane ezihlala ehostela labafundi esikoleni, bezwakalise ukungenami ngemali abayikhokhayo.UMnuz Mthoko Dlamini, uthishanhloko waseThembimfundo Special School, eShowe, uthe akulona iqiniso ukuthi wenyuse imali wabuye wacacisa nokuthi yena siqu sakhe akazithatheli izinqumo esikoleni."Izinqumo zithathwa yisigungu esilawula isikole. Okwami ukuthi ngibe wumlomo waso. Ngisuke ngicelwe yiso ukuthi ngenze isimemezelo futhi zonke izinqumo ezenziwayo, abazali basuke bazisiwe ngazo,” kuchaza uDlamini.Echaza ngemali ekhokhwa ngabazali, uDlamini uthe isamile kuR12 000 ngonyaka, wathi okushintshile indlela osukhokhwa ngayo.Uveze ukuthi phambilini, abazali bebekhokha uR1000 inyanga ngenyanga kodwa kwabonakala ukuthi ababalelwa ku-30% kuya ku-40%, bayadoja ukukhokha."Umzali ugcina ekhokha mhlawumbe uR1500, abeke izinkinga zasekhaya, angabe esayikhokha enye,” kusho uDlamini.Wengeza ngokuthi abazali ebebenza lomkhuba bebeqoka izikhathi ezithile ukulanda izingane zabo ehostela, ukugwema imibuzo yokuthi abaqedile ukukhokha. Wathi kuye kuthi noma sebebashayela izingcingo abazali, bangabatholi.Uthe indaba yokuphushwa phambili uR2000, yaba wumbono owaphakamiswa ngoMashi nyakenye, emhlanganweni wabazali."Sabekwa isizathu sokuthi uma kwenziwa kanje, umzali usuke esengalikhokha nanoma yinini iR1000 elisele, kulezi zinyanga ezimbili ezisuke zisasele ithemu ngayinye,” kuchaza uDlamini.Uveze ukuthi ngaleso sikhathi abazali bakhombisa ukungenami ngoshintsho babeka nokuthi abanikiwe isikhathi esanele uma kuthiwa aluqalwe ngethemu elandelayo (Juni 2023).Udalule nokuthi bakwamukel ukuzikhalela kwabazali ngaleso sikhathi, bakumisa isikhashana ukuqalwa kohlelo."Sigcine siluvusa lolu daba emhlanganweni esibe nawo ngoSepthemba 28 (2023), lapho esiveze khona kubazali ukuthi uhlelo esasiluhlongoze ngoMashi (2023), luzoqala ngo-2024. Abazali bacaciselwa ukuthi ayikho ingane ezovunyelwa ukungena ehostela ingayikhokhile imali."Sasisho ihostela, hhayi esikoleni ngoba kakade imali ayihlangene neyesikole, iqondene nokuhlaliswa kwabafundi ehostela, okusingathwa yisikole, hhayi ngumnyango,” kuchaza uDlamini.Udalule ukuthi ngo-Okthoba nyakenye uphinde wababhalela abazali, ebakhumbuza ngesivumelwano sangoSepthemba, enzela nalabo ababengekho emhlanganweni."Kwakufanele bakhalaze nyakenye kodwa akekho noyedwa owakwenza lokho, njengoba sebezokhalaza manje,” kuchaza uDlamini.Ugcizelele ukuthi umsindo uphehlwa ngabazali abambalwa futhi usudale uqhekeko phakathi kwabazali. Waphetha ngokuthi abazali abangenayo inkinga yokukhokha, kabeneme ngokuthi basongwe ngabhande linye, kuthiwe abahambisani nohlelo olusha.

SEBEZOBA nebhange elibhekele izidingo zabesifazane bakuleli, emuva kokuthi uNksz Nthabeleng Likotsi ememezele ukuthi sebeyitholile ilayisensi ye-YWBN Mutual Bank.Leli bhange le-Young Woman in Business Network (YWBN) linikwe ilayisensi wuphiko olubhekele ukusebenza kwamabhange lwe-South African Reserve Bank, olubizwa ngePrudential Authority neFinancial Sector Conduct Authority.UNksz Nthabeleng Likotsi uthe bekungelula ukuthola ilayisensi yebhange iYWBN Mutual Bank Isithombe:FACEBOOK kaNTHABELENGEsithangamini nabezindaba ebesingoLwesibili, uNksz Likotsi, uthe bekungelula ukuthi bathole ilayisensi yokuba yiMutual Bank njengoba kubathathe iminyaka eyisishiyagalolunye ukuthi bafike kulesi sigaba."Siqophe umlando njengoba iYWBN Mutual Bank, izoba yibhange lokuqala eliphethwe yiningi labesifazane. Ngafunda ngo-2014 ukuthi abantu abamnyama bangakwazi ukuvula ibhange labo.Bekungelula ngoba baningi abebengakholelwa kithina kodwa iningi lenu beliwujabulela umbono wami,” kusho uNksz Likotsi.Uthe bekubalulekile kuyena ukuthi kube nebhange eliphethwe ngabesifazane abaningi ukuze libavulele amathuba emnothweni.Ubalule ukuthi ufuna abesifazane baphile impilo emnandi ngaphandle kokuhlushwa yizikweletu.Uveze ukuthi ngesikhathi ecela abantu ukuthi batshale imali kwi-YWBN Mutual Bank ngo-2020, bawu-10 000 abasabela ikhwelo lakhe. Bonke laba bantu bangenisa imali engaphezu kuka-R19 million.Uthe kwamphatha kabi ukuthi uphiko olubhekele ukusebenza kwemali lumyalele ukuthi akabuyisele imali kubanikazi bayo ngoba akalandelanga imithetho elawula abasebenza ngemali."Ngayibuyisela imali kuwo wonke umuntu, yize abanye babengafuni ukuthi ngibabuyisele imali yabo. Okuhle wukuthi iphupho lethu lokuthi sibe nebhange liphumelele. Sesinayo ilayisensi yokusebenza njengebhange. Sizosiza abantu ukonga imali, sibabolekele eyokuvula amabhizinisi nokubhekela ezinye izidingo zabo. Kodwa ngingabagqugquzela abantu ukuthi bonge imali ukuze bazakhele umcebo wabo,” kusho uNksz Likotsi.Uthe okwamanje alikavulwa ithuba lokuthenga izabelo kuleli bhange.Mayelana nezinhlelo zokuthi lizotholakala kanjani ibhange, uNksz Likotsi, uthe konke kuzomenyezelwa emcimbini wokulivula ngokusemthethweni usazowazisa umphakathi ngesikhathi esifanele.UNksz Nontsikelelo Sisulu oyingxenye ye-YWBN, uthe ukuthola kwabo ilayisensi kuwubufakazi bokuthi ukubekezela kuzala impumelelo.Uthe bekubalulekile kubona ukuthi balandele umthetho ngisho noma ngabe kubathatha isikhathi eside kangakanani ukuthi bagcine bevula ibhange.
KUZOMELE igcine ngokusebenzisa izimonyo zokwehlisa ukuphasha novaselina Ingudlungudlu namakhosazane ebandleni lamaNazaretha eBuhleni ngemuva kokuphuma komyalelo wokuvala inhlobonhlobo yokuzicwala kwabesifazane kuleli bandla. Isolezwe lithole ukuthi ngasekupheleni kohambo lwasentabeni iKhenana, lolu hlangothi oluholwa Inkosi uMduduzi "Unyazilwezulu” Shembe lukhiphe isimemezelo sokuvalwa kokucwala izinwele, ukuxhuma izinzipho, ukufaka amazinyo egolide nayisiliva nokuziphaqula ubuso kwabazalwane bebandla.Umthombo waleli phephandaba uthe isimemezelo senziwe uMfundisi ohlonishwayo webandla, uNtombela, ngesikhathi kuvalwa umhlangano wentaba ebandleni lamaNazaretha eBuhleni ngeSabatha.Esimemezelweni kuthiwa uNtombela umemezele nokuthi amakholwa aseBuhleni awavunyelwe ukugqiza ngobuhlalu bezangoma. UNtombela ungomunye wabefundisi abahlala esigungwini esiphezulu sebandla lapho kuthathwa khona izinqumo ngezinto ezisuke ziphakanyisiwe ezithinta ibandla.Kuvele ukuthi lezi zindaba kazehlanga kahle kwabaningi njengoba kuthiwa kukhona "asebedlebelekile, benza noma yini ebandleni kungashiwo lutho”. Indaba iqale ngezintombi zeNtethelelo okuthiwa zidlisa ngezinto ezinhle ngoba zisafuna ukukhethwa ebandleni, okuyinto okuthiwa ayivumelekile uma usunengane.Umthombo ocele ukungagagulwa uthe kukhona nasebewulandela lo mkhubama abafika esontweni beswenke beconsa, beziphophothile befake amazinyo esiliva nezinzipho ezixhunyiwe. Le miswenko isuke isithwe yiminazaretha, kubonakale nxa sekuphuma inkonzo sebeyikhumulile. Kukhona abaholi abakhala nangokuthi imfashini le isingene nakomakoti abasebancane. "Ngesikhathi kumenyezelwa ukuthi akusavumelekile konke lokhu, bakhale kakhulu ngoba sekuyindlela yokuzibukisa kwabo le,” kusho umthombo.Kuthiwa esimemezelweni kuyalelwe abakhokheli bamathempeli nabashumayeli ukuthi bayale amaNazaretha emathempelini abo ngalezi zinto.Okhulumela uNyazilwezulu, uMnuz Thokozani Mncwabe, uthe akukho okungalungile ngesimemezelo sikaMfundisi Ntombela."Engingakucacisa wukuthi ibandla alicwasi muntu kodwa kuba nemigomo yalo okusuke kudingeka ukuthi osebhajadiswe kulona ayilandele. Uma uza ebandleni kumele ulandele imithetho yakhona,” kuchaza uMncwabe."Ngokwenqubo yebandla akuvumelekile konke lokhu okusuke kwenzeka. Nenkosi iLanga (JG Shembe) yake yaba nesiphrofetho esithi kuyoba khona abantu abayozithanda ngokwedlulele. Yathi asokwazi ukuthi lokho akuhambisani nenqubo yebandla, abayobe bekwenza bayobe bezenzela,” kucacisa uMncwabe.Ebuzwa ukuthi uma kungukuthi kukhona oqhubekayo nokwenza lezi zinto esontweni uzothathelwa ziphi izinyathelo, uthe: "Noma singeke sikudalule okuzokwenzeka kodwa siba khona isijeziso ngokwenqubo yebandla."Ngisho uzongena ethempelini, kungumthetho ukuthi ukhumule izicathulo. Kuba kuwena-ke ukuthi uyazikhumula noma awungeni nhlobo ethempelini,” usho kanje. Ongumholi wenhlangano elwela abesifazane, iKwaMthaniya Women’s Activist Movement, uZibu MaSotobe Sibiya, uthe abantu besifazane banelungelo lokuthi baphume kuleyo nkonzo uma kuwukuthi abahambisani nemigomo yayo. ISILILO uNyazilwezulu luvala ukuzicwala kwabesifazane ebandleni lamaNazaretha Isithombe: SIGCINIWE
UMASIPALA weTheku uthe kuyagqugquzela ukuthi nakuba usabhekene nezinselelo zokulungisa umonakalo wezikhukhula kodwa ukwazile ukuthola umbiko wezimali omuhle. UMasipala weTheku uphefumule kanje emuva kokuthi uMcwaningimabhuku ethule umbiko ongenagcobho emhlanganweni wamakhansela.Kuvela lo mbiko nje iMeya yeTheku uMnuz Mxolisi Kaunda isanda kusinda besho ukuyiqeda ngevoti lokungabethembi ubuholi bayo.Umbiko ongenagcobho usuke uchaza ukuthi imali iphethwe kahle, akukho okutheni okushayisa amakhala ngamabhuku esikhungo esisuke sibhekwa.Abacwaningimabhuku bathe iTheku liyiphethe kahle imali. Lokhu bakuthole emabhukwini ahanjiswe wumkhandlu. UMasipala weTheku uthe lokhu kukapakela nasezikhungweni ezingaphansi kwawo, iShaka Marine Theme Park ne-ICC."Nakuba sijabula kodwa siyaqonda ukuthi kusekhona izinselelo maqondana nokuthengwa kwempahla nokuphathwa kwezinkontileka, ukulawulwa kwezindleko nokunye. Ikhona imizamo esiphezu kwayo yokulungisa lokhu,’’ kusho umasipala esitatimendeni sawo.UMasipala uthe nakuba kusekhona ubunzima kodwa kuningi okuhle olokhu uqhubeka nokukwenza."Nakuba sisazama ukulungisa umonakalo wezikhukhula zango2022 kodwa siyaqhubeka nokusebenza kahle. Ukusabalaliswa kwamanzi manje kuku-79.08% uma kuqhathaniswa no-40% esahlala kuwona ngemuva kwezikhukhula,’’ kusho umasipala.UKaunda uthe nakuba bejabula kodwa basazimisele ngokuqhubekela phambili balungise okunye. Uthe kukhona amaqhinga abawasebenzisayo ukuzama ukulawula ukusebenza komkhandlu.Uthe uMasipala weTheku uyavumelana neziphakamsio zabacwaningimabhku, ukuthi kuqiniswe ukwelusa ukusebenza komkhandlu ngazo zonke izikhathi.IMenenja kaMasipala weTheku, uMnuz Musa Mbhele nayo ithe kufanele bahlabele phambili baqinise kakhulu kunakuqala. "Sizobheka kakhulu udaba lokwelusa ukusebenza nokubheka ukuthi wonke umuntu usebenza ngendlela, uthobela imithetho. Sifisa nokuqinisa kakhulu kwingqalasizinda bese siphuthumisa izidingo zabantu, kwakhiwe anamthuba omsebenzi,’’ kusho uMbhele.
ZILULELWE isikhathi sokufaka izicelo zokuxhaswa ngemali yokufunda izitshudeni ebezingakazifaki lezi zicelo esikhwameni, iNational Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS).Abalesi sikhwama baphinde bavula nethuba lokuthi labo abebengalutholi uxhaso kulesi sikhwama, ngoba abazali babo behola kakhulu abaziwa nge-missing middle, bafake izicelo ngaphansi kohlelo olusha.Bekumele luvalwe ekupheleni kukaJanuwari uhlelo lokufakwa kwezicelo.Lesi simemezelo senziwe emuva komhlangano webhodi leNSFAS nenhlangano emele imikhandlu yezitshudeni emanyuvesi, iSouth African Union of Students’ (SAUS). Ibamba likasihlalo weNSFAS, uSolwazi Laurens Van Staden, lithe kulo mhlangano kuvunyelwene ngokuthi kwelulwe isikhathi sokufakwa kwezicelo zoxhaso kuze kuvalwe ngoFebhuwari 15, 2024.UVan Staden uthe namhlanje kuzovulwa ithuba kulabo abebengaxhaswa yilesi sikhwama ngoba abazali babo behola kakhulu abaziwa nge-missing middle"Sizovula nethuba kulabo abebengalutholi uxhaso kanti izicelo zoxhaso zizokwamukelwa kuze kube uFebhuwari 15, 2024. Labo abesebevele befake izicelo zoxhaso, asikho isidingo sokuthi baphinde bafake ezintsha.” Uveze ukuthi labo okuzotholakala ukuthi abalutholi uxhaso lomfundaze weNSFAS bazongena ngaphansi kohlelo lwe-missing middle, abazobolekwa kulo imali yokufunda.Udalule ukuthi ukuze uthole uxhaso ngaphansi kwe-missing middle kudingeka abazali bakho bahole umholo osuka kuR350 000 kuya ku-R600 000 ngonyaka uma usuhlanganisiwe.Uveze nokuthi u-70% wabazobaxhasa ngokohlelo olusha kumele benze izifundo zesayensi, ezobuchwepheshe kanjalo nemaths."Sikhumbuza izitshudeni ezifaka izicelo ukuthi kumele zisayine ifomu ukuze sikwazi ukubheka ulwazi ezisinika lona ukuthi luyiqiniso. Sizobe sifuna ukuthola izinto ezifana nomholo wabazali nezinye izinto.” Kuvele ukuthi lesi sikhwama sithole izicelo zoxhaso ezingu-1.7 million kulo nyaka.Kulezi zicelo abangu-940 682 sebelutholile uxhaso, abangu-269 915 balinde ukuthi kucutshungulwe ulwazi abalulethile.U-48 643 uzihoxele, kwathi abangu-232 559 basalinde izimpendulo."Abangu-136 531 bagcine bengaqhubekanga nezicelo. Sichithe izicelo ezingu-102 201 kanti abangu-1 093 basafake izikhalazo.” Umengameli weSAUS, uMnuz Yandisa Ndzoyiya, uthe bavumelene ngokuthi luqhubeke uhlelo lokuphendulwa kwabafake izicelo.Uthe kulo mhlangano kuvele nokuthi ohlelweni lweNSFAS kubhaliswe ukuthi ingu-40 522 imibhede ekhona emakolishi amakhono kuthi emanyuvesi ibe ngu-72 241. "Izikhungo zizokwazi ukungena ohlelweni lweNSFAS ukubona ukuthi mingaki imibhede esele. Sivumelene ukuthi ngesonto elizayo sizoba nesithangami sabezindaba neNSFAS ukuze sichaze ngezinto ezithinta imali efakelwa izitshudeni.”
ZIPHENDUKE imihambima izangoma ebezitheleke eThekwini zithi zizokhulekela izwe, zagcina sezikhala ngokulaxazwa wuMasipala weTheku njengoba nobuholi bebungacacisi. Lezi zangoma ezingaphezu kuka-200 zigcine zibanga unqenqema olusosebenzi lolwandle eThekwini lapho zilale khona izinsuku ezimbili.Uma bechaza omangothobana, bebazi ukuthi bazohlinzekwa wuMasipala weTheku ngamatende abazolala kuwo, ukudla nokunye izinsuku ezine. Kodwa bathi balale bengadlile izinsuku ezimbili, engekho nochazayo ukuthi konakelephi.Lezi zangoma ezingaphansi kwenhlangano, iTraditional Health Practitioners Business Council, zafika ngoLwesibili emini. Nokho umengameli wale nhlangano, uMnuz Thulani Msomi, uphike konke, wathi akukho xhaso ebebelulindele kuMasipala weTheku ngaphandle kwezindlu zangasese.Uphinde wazihlangula ekutheni bebelindele ukuhlinzekwa ngokudla, wathi bona uma beze kulo mkhuleko basuke besebhandeni.Esinye sezangoma ebesilapha esalile negama laso sithe: "Bekumele sihlinzekwe ngezimbuzi ezintathu ebesizokhuleka ngazo, izinkomo ezimbili ebesizozidla.”"Umkhuleko” wazo kuthiwa ubuzoze usongwe namuhla kodwa kwaphoqa ukuthi unqanyulwe izolo kulandela ukuphambana kohlelo.Ngokuthola kweSolezwe, lo "mkhuleko” uphinde uthinte nomsebenzi wazo izangoma wokwelapha kanti ufaka phakathi ukuba solwandle ngezikhathi ezithile, ukugezwa kwazo ngezimbuzi kanjalo nokwenziwa kweladi lasolwandle.Omunye ovumile ukukhuluma neSolezwe uthe bese kungokwesibili lo "mkhuleko" ubanjwa njengoba usungulwe ekupheleni kukaJanuwari nyakenye.Uveze ukuthi izinkinga ziqale ukubonakala ngalo uLwesibili zifika ngamabhasi awo uMasipala weTheku."Kwakulindeleke ukuthi sihlinzekwe ngokudla kwasemini nokwasebusuku. Kwangafika, satshelwa ukuthi kunobuhixihixi obusalungiswa, ukudla akukakafiki netende liyeza, asikhululeke,” usho kanje.Uqhube wathi kwashaya u-9:45 ebusuku kungaqhamuki lutho maqede kwaba nenguyazana ethi ngoba izinto azihlangani, akuhlanganiswe o-R10 no-R20 ukuze kutholakale into ezodliwa."Saze sadla ngo-10:20 ebusuku amasemishi ayizingcezu ezimbili zesinkwa esinopholoni,” kusho lo mthombo.Uthe kwagcina kuvunyelwana ngokuthi izimpahla zabo zifakwe emathoyilethi ukuze ziphephe."Izangoma esezikhulile, nazo zalaliswa khona, thina abanye sandlala ngaphandle. Sibuye emkhulelweni ka-12 ebusuku sazisonga khona lapho (esigangeni) salala,” kusho umthombo.Uthe nasekuseni akubanga khona kudla abakutholile.Uveze ukuthi umengameli wenhlangano ugcine ebatshela ukuthi usahamba, uyolungisa yonke le nhlekelele kuMasipala weTheku."Uthe uyedwa umuntu obeyinkinga, ongasayinanga ukuze sithole uxhaso. Uhambe amahora amaningi wabuya nempendulo ethi impela akuhlangani,” kusho umthombo.Uthe baze behlelwa nawumshophi wokuthi ezinye zezimpahla zabo ziqoqwe amaphoyisa kaMasipala weTheku, waphoqa ukuthi kuyoncengwa ukuze azibuyise.Uveze ukuthi kuze kwaphazamiseka neminye yemikhuleko."Imimoya ibisiyonakele, abantu bezilambele ngoba ukuze udle bese kufanele ushaye iphakethe lakho, uphinde uhambe ibanga elide uye eSpar ukuyothenga isinkwa,” kusho umthombo.Ubuye wabalula nokuthi ebebenemali bahambe ngoLwesithathu bazibuyelela emakhaya.Uthe izolo ekuseni ubuholi benhlangano bumemezele ukuthi sebecele umasipala ukuthi ubuyise amabhasi ayebalethile ukuze kugodukwe ngoba izinto azisahambanga ngokohlelo."Unxuse izangoma ukuthi ziphinde zivume ukuthi kubuywe ngenyanga ezayo uma kwenzeka zilunga izinto. Abantu bavele bazithulela ngoba bese bediniwe,” kusho umthombo.Abebelapha bakuphikile ukuthi bekubanjwe ibhande, babuza ukuthi pho ezani izitsha zokudla okwakuthiwa abaziphathe. Isolezwe liwabonile amabhodwe amakhulu okukholakala ukuthi bekuzophekwa ngawo inyama yenkomo.Intatheli imbuza uMsomi ukuthi kusuke kukhulekelwani kahle hle kulo mkhuleko, uthe: "Nawe sisuke sikukhulekela”.Osophikweni lwezokuxhumana kuMasipala weTheku, uLuthando Ngubane, uthe bayitholile imibuzo ethunyelwe yiSolezwe. Uthe ithimba labo linomgomo wokuthi kufanele linikwe amahora angu-24 ukuthi liphendule imibuzo ukuze liqoqe kahle ulwazi lokuphendula.

Kwezinye izifundazwe ngeke senze ngale ndlela ngoba siphethe.” Usho lokhu nje, amaqembu amaningi asephumele obala amemezela abantu azofolosa ngabo ezikhundleni zondunankulu.Muva nje, i-IFP KwaZulu-Natal imemezele ukuthi izofolosa ngoMnuz Thami Ntuli kwesikandunankulu.UMbalula uthe umhlangano wesigungu esiphezulu senhlangano uzohlala maphakathi nale nyanga ukuze uphothule uhlelo lokuqoka abantu abazomela le nhlangano."Lo mhlangano uzobe ubalulekile ngoba uzonquma ngabazomela le nhlangano ePhalamende naseziShayamthetho zezifundazwe. Manje unalo lonke ilungelo lokuthi azikhulume.”Uthe uZuma udukisa abalandeli beMK abacabanga ukuthi bazowina ngamalengiso okhethweni. UGWETSHWE kanzima owesifazane waseSoshanguve, owathengela umyeni wakhe abantu ukuba bambulale.UMarriod Ndebele (47) wathengela umyeni wakhe weminyaka abantu ukuba bamsoconge ebambisene nesoka lakhe.Kuthiwa umjolo wowesifazane nesoka lakhe, uPiet Tlowaye Monyai (62) yiwona oholele esinqumweni sokubulala umyeni wakhe. Kugwetshwe kanzima abantu abahlanu, kubalwa naye.Kuthiwa wakhuluma nesoka lakhe ngokusoconga umyeni, isoka lamxhumanisa nomzukulu walo, uKoketso Piet Monyai (24) yena osedonsa isigwebo sakhe ngalo leli cala noFrans Kekana (40) oyilungu leSoshanguve Community Policing Forum (CPF), kwakhiwa itulo lokubulala umyeni wakhe. UKoketso wasondeza umngani wakhe uNdivhuwo John Tshiwela ukuba abadayisele isibhamu ngo-R750.00. Isoka likaMorriod layikhipha imali yesibhamu."Ngomhla ka-18 Jumi 2019 isoka likaMarriod lahambisa umzukulu walo uKoketso noKekana emzini kaNdebele lapho bafika babulala ngokuduula ubaba wekhaya. Ngemuva kwalokho, uMarriod wabatshela ukuthi bathathe izinto ezimbalwa zomyeni wakhe, ukuze kube sengathi ubegetshengwa. Sebehambile, uMarriod washayela amaphoyisa ebika isigameko sokuhlaselwa," kusho okhulumela uphiko lwezokushushisa.Uphenyo lwamaphoyisa lwawaholela kuwo lomuzi ngemuva kwezinsuku ezimbalwa. Ngomhla ka-22 kuyo leyo nyanga, kwaboshwa yena umfelokazi. Isoka lakhe uMonyai noKekane bona baboshwa ngomhla ka-24.INkantolo eNkulu ePitoli kayibanga nalo uzwelo kulaba njengoba umfelokazi, yisoka noKekane bagwetshwe udilikajele ngecala lokubulala okuhleliwe. Umfelokazi ubuye wabhanselwa ngeminye iminyaka engu-38 (engu-15 yokutholakala nesibhamu esingekho emthethweni, emihlanu yokutholakala nezinhlamvu, emithathu yokuphazamisa ukusebenza kwengalo yomthetho neminye engu-15 yokugebenga ngenhloso yokulimaza).UKekana naye ubuye wagixatshezwa iminyaka engu-45 ngaphezu kwesigwebo sakhe (iminyaka engu-15 yokuphatha isibhamu esingekho emthethweni, emihlanu yezinhlamvu nengu-25 yokugebenga ngenhloso yokulimaza).
KULULWE isikhathi sokuvalwa kwamahhovisi oMnyango wezaseKhaya, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukulanda omazisi babo.UMnuz Siya Qoza wezokuxhumana emnyangweni, udalule ukuthi amahhovisi azovulwa isikhathi esithe xaxa kusuka namhlanje kuze kube yiSonto.Namhlanje uthe isikhathi sokuvala sizolulwa kusuka ku-4 ntambama kuya ku-6.NgoMgqibelo neSonto azovulwa amahora ayisishiyagalolunye."Azovulwa kusuka ngo-8 ekuseni kuze kube u-5 ntambama ukuze abantu balande omazisi babo. Lokhu kwenziwa ukuze kube lula njengoba kuyimpelasonto yokubhalisela ukuvota okhethweni lukazwelonke.” Uveze ukuthi izinto ezizobe zenziwa emahhovisi ukulandwa komazisi, kanjalo nokufaka izicelo zokuthola i-Temporary Identification Certificate, ezophuma ngaleso sikhathi ezobe ibiza uR70." Lokhu uthe kuzosiza ikakhulu ngalesi sikhathi sokubhalisa. UQoza uthe abantu sebengakwazi ukubekisa izikhathi zokuthi balande izinto zabo emahhovisi omnyango besebenzisa uhlelo i-Branch Appointment Booking System (BABS), etholakala kwi-website yomnyango ethi:www.dha.gov.za.Uthe kodwa abantu basakwazi ukuya emahhovisi omnyango ngaphandle kokubekisa isikhathi.IPhini likaNgqongqoshe kulo mnyango, uMnuz Njabulo Nzuza, linxuse intsha ukuthi ibambe iqhaza ekubhaliseleni ukuvota."Yingakho silule isikhathi kusuka ngoLwesihlanu nempelasonto ukuze ikwazi ukulanda omazisi. Labo abafake izicelo zomazisi asebelinde amasonto amathathu kuya phezulu, abathathe ithuba lokuthi bavakashele emahhovisi ukuze bayobalanda.”Lena impelasonto yokugcina yokuthi abantu babhalisele ukuvota okhethweni olubhekwe ngabomvu.Bangaphezu kuka-27 million abantu abasemqulwini wokuvota okusho ukuthi sinyukile isibalo sabazokwazi ukuvota kulolu khetho.Ikhomishini eyengamele ukhetho i-Independent Electoral Commission, inxuse abantu ukuthi baphume bayobhalisela ukuvota noma bayobheka ukuthi imininingwane yabo kuseyiyona yini ngaphambi kokhetho.

KUTUSWE amagalelo obewumkhuzi wamaphoyisa eGauteng osethatha umhlalaphansi, uLieutenant General Elias Mawela.Bekuwusuku lokugcina lukaMawela emsebenzini izolo. Ubesesebenze iminyaka engu-39 esiphoyiseni.USETHATHA umhlalaphansi embuthweni wamaphoyisa obengumkhuzi wawo eGauteng, uLieutenant Elias Mawela Isithombe: SithunyelweWajoyina umbutho wamaphoyisa ngo-1984 eyithwasa ePitoli. Ukhuphuke ngezimendlela wagcina esenguLieutenant General ngo-2011.Izolo bekuphela inkontileka yeminyaka emihlanu engumkhuzi wamaphoyisa eGauteng.UMkhuzi wamaPhoyisa kuzwelonke, uGeneral Fannie Masemola, uncome imisebenzi emihle kaMawela ayenzele isizwe.UMasemola uchaze uMawela njengomuntu obesebenza ngokubambisana nomphakathi nabamahlelo ehlukene kangangoba waze waqala umkhankaso olwa nobugebengu, i-O kae Molao."Ushiye umbutho wamaphoyisa nefa elinothile eliyosetshenziswa nayizizukulwane ezizayo. Usebenze ngokuzikhandla nangokuzimisela lapho abejutshwe ukuba asebenze khona. Ungumholi obekhuluma into bese eyayenza, kungakhathaleki ukuthi ubekade ejutshwe kuphi,” kusho uMasemola.UMasemola uthe ube nenhlanhla yokuthi asebenze eduzane noMawela azohlala emkhumbula njalo. Ube esebonga nomndeni kaMawela ngokuthi umvumele akwazi ukwenza lo msebenzi wesizwe.Amaphoyisa athi i-O Kae Molao wuhlelo lapho amaphoyisa ehlala khona izithonto izigilamkhuba ezifunwayo, eshaqa impahla ewumbombayi, evundulula izimoto ezebiwe nezibhamu ezingekho emthethweniBathi lolu hlelo lugcine selunabela ezweni lonke njengoba selubizwa ngokuthi i-Operation Shanela.UMawela uphathe izikhundla ezihlukene okubalwa kuzona esokuba u-Deputy Area Commissioner ePitoli, waba iComponent Head: Border Policing, uphinde waba yiDivisional Commissioner: Operational Response Services.Uphinde waba usihlalo wophiko lwezokuphepha, iNational Joint Operational and Intelligence Structure (NATJOINTS).
